signature.statement:
theorem birkhoff_theorem_1_2 (Ω : Set Plane)
    (hΩ : IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain Ω)
    (hCollar : HasContinuousCausticCollar Ω) :
    IsEllipse Ω

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := glancing_collar_conjugation Ω hΩ hCollar
  rcases shape_strip_dichotomy Ω hΩ C with hTrig | hEntire | hFinite
  · exact support_ellipse_criterion Ω hΩ C.toSupportLazutkinData hTrig
  · obtain ⟨E⟩ := hEntire
    exact False.elim (noncritical_and_entire_growth_exclusion.1 E)
  · obtain ⟨S⟩ := hFinite
    have hCrit : CriticalWallData S := noncritical_and_entire_growth_exclusion.2 S
    obtain ⟨hBudget⟩ := critical_angle_budget_and_envelope S hCrit
    exact False.elim (odd_slice_sign_test_contradiction S hCrit hBudget)

birkhoff_theorem_1_2.definitions:
noncomputable def unitNormalVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ]


noncomputable def unitTangentVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![-Real.sin θ, Real.cos θ]


noncomputable def supportAction1_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) -
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


noncomputable def supportAction2_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) +
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


def horizStrip (H : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { s : ℂ | |s.im| < H }


def finiteWallTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star ∧ -h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < h_X p.2 }


noncomputable def frozenFirstFieldG (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if z = 0 then 1 else 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z) / z ^ 3


structure SupportLazutkinData (Ω : Set Plane) where
  c₀ : Plane
  c₀_mem : c₀ ∈ Ω
  h : ℝ → ℝ
  h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h
  h_periodic : Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi)
  h_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ
  r_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ
  frontier_eq : frontier Ω =
    Set.range (fun θ : ℝ => c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ)
  ϕ : ℝ → ℝ
  c : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  ϕ_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ϕ
  ϕ_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv ϕ x
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ x + 2 * Real.pi
  lazutkin_norm : ∀ x : ℝ, (h (ϕ x) + deriv (deriv h) (ϕ x)) * (deriv ϕ x) ^ 3 = c


def HasTrigSpeed {Ω : Set Plane} (L : SupportLazutkinData Ω) : Prop :=
  ∃ B₀ C₀ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    (deriv L.ϕ x) ^ 2 = C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * L.ϕ x) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * L.ϕ x)


structure AnalyticGlancingCollar (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  s₀ : ℝ
  s_h : ℝ
  s₀_pos : 0 < s₀
  s_h_pos : 0 < s_h
  h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  h_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s_h))
  ϕ_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s₀))
  ϕ_ℂ_maps_to : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h)
  h_ℂ_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = h θ
  ϕ_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ_ℂ x = ϕ x
  h_ℂ_periodic : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = h_ℂ w
  h_ℂ_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h),
    h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ w)
  ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ_ℂ z + 2 * Real.pi
  ϕ_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z)
  ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), deriv ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0
  lazutkin_norm_ℂ : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    (h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (ϕ_ℂ z)) * (deriv ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 3 = c
  s₁ : ℝ
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  r₁_lt_s₁ : r₁ < s₁
  s₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ s₀
  U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  U_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r₁ }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁)
  U_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  U_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)
  U_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → U (y, 0) = y
  U_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))
  U_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ + r₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀)
  U_real_deriv_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r₁ →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re) x
  U_real_step_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ →
    0 < (U (x + t, t)).re - (U (x, t)).re ∧
    0 < ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) ∧
    ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) < Real.pi
  glancing_stationary : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
      supportAction2_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  symplectic_jacobian : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y' + t, t)))) y *
      deriv (fun t' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t', t')))) t *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) y = A t
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ → 0 < (A t).re


structure EntireNonisotropicStrip where
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_entire : Differentiable ℂ ϕ
  f_entire : Differentiable ℂ f
  q_entire : Differentiable ℂ q
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s : ℂ, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s : ℂ, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ0 : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 0) (horizStrip s_star) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 1) (horizStrip s_star)
  Γ0_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,
    deriv (fun z => Γ0 z 0) s = -c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ0_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,
    deriv (fun z => Γ0 z 1) s = c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, Γ0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ0 s
  Γ0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ0 s i)
  T : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  T_open : IsOpen T
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ T
  T_param_subset : T ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ T
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y + x, t) ∈ T
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y, -t) ∈ T
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ T
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 T
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰 (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → 𝔰 (y, -t) = 𝔰 (y, t)
  𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 (y, t))
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  θ_edge : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    θ_edge (x - t) t + θ_edge x t = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 = -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (θ_edge x t) ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 = ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = 𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ T


structure FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip where
  H : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  H_pos : 0 < H
  c_pos : 0 < c
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  s_star_lt_H : s_star < H
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStrip H)
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip H)
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStrip H)
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStrip H) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 1) (horizStrip H)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStrip H)
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 0) s ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 1) s
  Γ_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) s = -c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) s = c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s
  Γ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)) * f s
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  Θ_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  p_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 p ∈ horizStrip H
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰 p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰 p
  𝔰_conj : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 p)
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  V_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStrip H)
  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H,
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  Θ_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  p_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ p_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star → 0 < (A t).re
  symplectic_gl : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => p_gl (y', t)) y * deriv (fun t' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y, t')) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => p_gl (y, t')) t * deriv (fun y' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y', t)) y = A t
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < ε → ε < s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = 𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = 𝔰 p


noncomputable def shapeModulus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  max ‖S.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖)


def wallDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - s.im


structure CriticalWallData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  critical_upper_bound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) < S.H →
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        Real.exp ((1 + ε) * k)
  critical_lower_unbounded : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ K₀ : ℝ, ∃ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k ∧
    Real.exp (-k) < S.H ∧
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      Real.exp ((1 - ε) * k) ≤
        shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  cone_passage : ∀ α m₀ δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m₀ → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L δ_star : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < δ_star ∧ δ_star < δ_b ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                d < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
                |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
                ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α } ∧
            (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
              d < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_star →
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) →
              ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
              s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
              s_tilde (p.1, -p.2) = s_tilde p ∧
              ‖s_tilde p - p.1‖ ≤
                C * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
              (δ_star / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
              (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_tilde p = S.𝔰 p))
  deep_first_field_model : ∀ d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < d_seq n ∧ 0 < B_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto d_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto B_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    (∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      d_seq n ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - ξ_seq n| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
      (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S s ≤ C_A * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      F Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    ∀ A₀ T₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → 0 < T₀ →
      ∃ D₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧
        ∃ S_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_lim
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } ∧
          (∀ T Y : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) →
            (S_lim (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
            S_lim (-T, Y) = S_lim (T, Y) ∧
            ‖S_lim (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 3 *
              frozenFirstFieldG
                (T * F (S_lim (T, Y)) * deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y / 2) = 1) ∧
          (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
              ‖(S.𝔰 ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                  p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) -
                (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ) - S_lim p‖ < ε)
  exp_profile_obstruction : ∀ x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ c₀ : ℂ, ∀ α₀ δ_b : ℝ,
    c₀ ≠ 0 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n < S.H ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ 0 < m_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H) →
    Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (S.H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ((TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop) ∨
     (TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop)) →
    ¬ (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - s.im → h_seq n - s.im ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L * (h_seq n - s.im) →
      shapeModulus S s ≤ C_L * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)
  log_deficit_bound : ∃ C_def : ℝ, 0 < C_def ∧
    ∀ z₀ : ℂ, ∀ Δ K : ℝ, 0 < Δ →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖) (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4),
        Δ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖ ≤
          C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖))
  poly_growth_witness : ∀ C_p A_p δ_p : ℝ, 0 < C_p → 0 < A_p → 0 < δ_p →
    (∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, wallDepth S s ≤ δ_p →
      wallDepth S s * shapeModulus S s ≤
        C_p * (1 + Real.log (1 / wallDepth S s)) ^ A_p) →
    ∃ L₀ C₁ C₂ c_star k_star : ℝ,
      0 < L₀ ∧ 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ 0 < c_star ∧ 1 ≤ k_star ∧
      ∀ k x₀ : ℝ, k_star ≤ k →
        ∃ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
          0 < z.im ∧
          |z.re - x₀| ≤ L₀ * wallDepth S z ∧
          k - C₁ * Real.log k ≤ -Real.log (wallDepth S z) ∧
          -Real.log (wallDepth S z) ≤ k + C₂ ∧
          c_star ≤ wallDepth S z * (‖S.f z‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖)


noncomputable def rowMomentF (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2)


noncomputable def rowMomentFull (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖))


structure CriticalAngleBudgetData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  k₀ : ℝ
  C_env : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  k₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀
  exp_neg_k₀_lt : Real.exp (-k₀) < S.H / 10
  C_env_pos : 0 < C_env
  ρ_pos : 0 < ρ
  ρ_lt_one : ρ < 1
  moment_poly_bound : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → rowMomentFull S k ≤ C_env * (1 + k)
  row_sup_poly_bound : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ,
    Real.exp (-k) *
      (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
        Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
      C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2
  angle_budget : ∀ K : ℝ, k₀ ≤ K →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2)
      (Set.Icc k₀ K) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∫ v in k₀..K, (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2) ≤ C_env * K ^ (2 * ρ)
  single_center_vanishing_exclusion :
    ∀ c_exp α₀ δ_b : ℝ,
      0 < c_exp → c_exp < 1 / 2 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 - c_exp →
      0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
      ∃ L_star : ℝ, 0 < L_star ∧
        ∀ k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ → 0 < C₁ →
          (∀ n : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k_seq n) →
          Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l →
            rowMomentFull S l ≤
              C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (c_exp * |l - k_seq n|)) →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
            Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
              C₁ * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ α₀) →
          ¬ (TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
              (fun n Z =>
                ((Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                  S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
              (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } ∧
            TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
              (fun n Z =>
                ((Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
                  S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
              (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 })

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def unitNormalVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ]


noncomputable def unitTangentVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![-Real.sin θ, Real.cos θ]


noncomputable def supportAction1_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) -
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


noncomputable def supportAction2_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) +
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


def horizStrip (H : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { s : ℂ | |s.im| < H }


def finiteWallTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star ∧ -h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < h_X p.2 }


noncomputable def frozenFirstFieldG (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if z = 0 then 1 else 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z) / z ^ 3


structure SupportLazutkinData (Ω : Set Plane) where
  c₀ : Plane
  c₀_mem : c₀ ∈ Ω
  h : ℝ → ℝ
  h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h
  h_periodic : Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi)
  h_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ
  r_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ
  frontier_eq : frontier Ω =
    Set.range (fun θ : ℝ => c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ)
  ϕ : ℝ → ℝ
  c : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  ϕ_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ϕ
  ϕ_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv ϕ x
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ x + 2 * Real.pi
  lazutkin_norm : ∀ x : ℝ, (h (ϕ x) + deriv (deriv h) (ϕ x)) * (deriv ϕ x) ^ 3 = c


def HasTrigSpeed {Ω : Set Plane} (L : SupportLazutkinData Ω) : Prop :=
  ∃ B₀ C₀ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    (deriv L.ϕ x) ^ 2 = C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * L.ϕ x) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * L.ϕ x)


structure AnalyticGlancingCollar (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  s₀ : ℝ
  s_h : ℝ
  s₀_pos : 0 < s₀
  s_h_pos : 0 < s_h
  h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  h_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s_h))
  ϕ_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s₀))
  ϕ_ℂ_maps_to : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h)
  h_ℂ_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = h θ
  ϕ_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ_ℂ x = ϕ x
  h_ℂ_periodic : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = h_ℂ w
  h_ℂ_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h),
    h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ w)
  ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ_ℂ z + 2 * Real.pi
  ϕ_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z)
  ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), deriv ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0
  lazutkin_norm_ℂ : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    (h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (ϕ_ℂ z)) * (deriv ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 3 = c
  s₁ : ℝ
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  r₁_lt_s₁ : r₁ < s₁
  s₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ s₀
  U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  U_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r₁ }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁)
  U_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  U_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)
  U_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → U (y, 0) = y
  U_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))
  U_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ + r₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀)
  U_real_deriv_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r₁ →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re) x
  U_real_step_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ →
    0 < (U (x + t, t)).re - (U (x, t)).re ∧
    0 < ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) ∧
    ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) < Real.pi
  glancing_stationary : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
      supportAction2_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))

    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y' + t, t)))) y *
      deriv (fun t' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t', t')))) t *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) y = A t
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ → 0 < (A t).re


structure EntireNonisotropicStrip where
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ

  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_entire : Differentiable ℂ ϕ
  f_entire : Differentiable ℂ f
  q_entire : Differentiable ℂ q
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s : ℂ, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s

  f_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)

  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s : ℂ, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ0 : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 0) (horizStrip s_star) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 1) (horizStrip s_star)
  Γ0_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,

  Γ0_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,

  Γ0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, Γ0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ0 s
  Γ0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ0 s i)
  T : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  T_open : IsOpen T
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ T
  T_param_subset : T ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ T
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y + x, t) ∈ T
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y, -t) ∈ T
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ T
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 T
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰 (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → 𝔰 (y, -t) = 𝔰 (y, t)
  𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 (y, t))
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  θ_edge : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    θ_edge (x - t) t + θ_edge x t = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 = -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (θ_edge x t) ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 = ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = 𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ T


structure FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip where
  H : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  H_pos : 0 < H
  c_pos : 0 < c
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  s_star_lt_H : s_star < H
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStrip H)
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip H)
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStrip H)
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStrip H) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 1) (horizStrip H)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStrip H)
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 0) s ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 1) s
  Γ_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) s = -c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) s = c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s
  Γ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)) * f s
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  Θ_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  p_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 p ∈ horizStrip H
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰 p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰 p
  𝔰_conj : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 p)
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0

  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H,
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  Θ_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  p_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ p_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star → 0 < (A t).re
  symplectic_gl : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => p_gl (y', t)) y * deriv (fun t' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y, t')) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => p_gl (y, t')) t * deriv (fun y' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y', t)) y = A t
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < ε → ε < s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = 𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = 𝔰 p


noncomputable def shapeModulus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  max ‖S.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖)


def wallDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - s.im


structure CriticalWallData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  critical_upper_bound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) < S.H →
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        Real.exp ((1 + ε) * k)
  critical_lower_unbounded : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ K₀ : ℝ, ∃ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k ∧
    Real.exp (-k) < S.H ∧
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      Real.exp ((1 - ε) * k) ≤

  ρ : ℝ

by
  
  have polar_rep : ∀ x y : ℝ, (x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) →
      ∃ r θ : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ∧ x = r * Real.cos θ ∧ y = r * Real.sin θ := by
    intro x y hxy
    let z : ℂ := ⟨x, y⟩
    have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz0
      rcases hxy with hx | hy
      · exact hx (congr_arg Complex.re hz0)
      · exact hy (congr_arg Complex.im hz0)
    refine ⟨‖z‖, z.arg, norm_pos_iff.mpr hz, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_mk]
      ring
    · exact (Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z).symm
    · exact (Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z).symm

  
  obtain ⟨B₀, C₀, D₀, h_speed⟩ := hTrig
  have hϕ_add_nat : ∀ n : ℕ, L.ϕ (n * (2 * Real.pi)) = L.ϕ 0 + n * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have hstep : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hstep, L.ϕ_quasiperiodic, ih]
      push_cast; ring
  have hϕ_sub_nat : ∀ n : ℕ, L.ϕ (-((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))) = L.ϕ 0 - n * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have hstep := L.ϕ_quasiperiodic (-(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))
      have harg : -(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi = -((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [harg, ih] at hstep
      push_cast at hstep ⊢
      linarith
  have hϕ_surj : Function.Surjective L.ϕ := by
    intro θ
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|θ - L.ϕ 0| / (2 * Real.pi))
    have habs : |θ - L.ϕ 0| < (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn h2pi
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt h2pi)] at hmul
    have hn_pos : 0 < (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg _) habs
    have hab : -((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by linarith
    have hbounds := abs_lt.mp habs
    have hmem : θ ∈ Set.Icc (L.ϕ (-((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))) (L.ϕ ((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      rw [hϕ_sub_nat, hϕ_add_nat]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab L.ϕ_smooth.continuous.continuousOn hmem
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩

  let q_N : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * θ) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * θ)

    intro θ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hϕ_surj θ
    have hdx : 0 < deriv L.ϕ x := L.ϕ_deriv_pos x
    have hsq : (deriv L.ϕ x) ^ 2 = q_N (L.ϕ x) := h_speed x
    nlinarith
  have h_ode : ∀ θ : ℝ, (L.h θ + deriv (deriv L.h) θ) * (Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) ^ 3 = L.c := by
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hϕ_surj θ
    have hdx : 0 ≤ deriv L.ϕ x := le_of_lt (L.ϕ_deriv_pos x)
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (q_N (L.ϕ x)) = deriv L.ϕ x := by
      dsimp [q_N]
      rw [← h_speed x, Real.sqrt_sq hdx]
    rw [hsqrt]
    exact L.lazutkin_norm x

  
  let Δ_N : ℝ := C₀ ^ 2 - B₀ ^ 2 - D₀ ^ 2
  have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ_N := by
    by_cases hBD : -B₀ = 0 ∧ -D₀ = 0
    · have hB0 : B₀ = 0 := by linarith [hBD.1]
      have hD0 : D₀ = 0 := by linarith [hBD.2]

        have h0 := hq_pos 0
        simp [q_N, hB0, hD0] at h0

      rw [hB0, hD0]
      nlinarith
    · have hBD' : -B₀ ≠ 0 ∨ -D₀ ≠ 0 := not_and_or.mp hBD

    α * ((2 * (C₀ - q_N θ) * Real.sqrt (q_N θ) - p θ * (p θ / Real.sqrt (q_N θ))) /

    intro θ
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id θ).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have hq_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt q_N (2 * p θ) θ := by
    intro θ
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.cos (2 * t)) (-Real.sin (2 * θ) * 2) θ :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (2 * θ)).comp θ (h2_deriv θ)
    have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.sin (2 * t)) (Real.cos (2 * θ) * 2) θ :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (2 * θ)).comp θ (h2_deriv θ)
    have hcomb := ((hasDerivAt_const θ C₀).add (hc.const_mul B₀)).add (hs.const_mul D₀)
    convert hcomb using 1
    dsimp [p]
    ring
  have hp_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt p (2 * (C₀ - q_N θ)) θ := by
    intro θ
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.cos (2 * t)) (-Real.sin (2 * θ) * 2) θ :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (2 * θ)).comp θ (h2_deriv θ)
    have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.sin (2 * t)) (Real.cos (2 * θ) * 2) θ :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (2 * θ)).comp θ (h2_deriv θ)
    have hcomb := (hs.const_mul (-B₀)).add (hc.const_mul D₀)
    convert hcomb using 1
    dsimp [q_N]
    ring
  have hsqrt_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.sqrt (q_N t)) (p θ / Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) θ := by
    intro θ
    have hs := (hq_deriv θ).sqrt (ne_of_gt (hq_pos θ))
    convert hs using 1
    ring
  have hhE_deriv₁ : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt h_E (dh_E θ) θ :=
    fun θ => (hsqrt_deriv θ).const_mul α
  have hhE_deriv₂ : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt dh_E (ddh_E θ) θ := by
    intro θ
    have hne : Real.sqrt (q_N θ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ))
    exact ((hp_deriv θ).div (hsqrt_deriv θ) hne).const_mul α
  have hhE_ode : ∀ θ : ℝ, (h_E θ + ddh_E θ) * (Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) ^ 3 = L.c := by
    intro θ
    set s := Real.sqrt (q_N θ)
    have hs_pos : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ)
    have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_pos
    have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q_N θ := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq_pos θ))
    have hΔ_ne : Δ_N ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hΔ_pos
    have htrig : Real.cos (2 * θ) ^ 2 + Real.sin (2 * θ) ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (2 * θ)
    have hstep1 : (h_E θ + ddh_E θ) * s ^ 3 =
        α * (s ^ 4 + 2 * (C₀ - q_N θ) * s ^ 2 - p θ ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [h_E, ddh_E]
      change (α * s + α * ((2 * (C₀ - q_N θ) * s - p θ * (p θ / s)) / s ^ 2)) * s ^ 3 =
        α * (s ^ 4 + 2 * (C₀ - q_N θ) * s ^ 2 - p θ ^ 2)
      field_simp [hs_ne]
      ring
    have hstep2 : s ^ 4 + 2 * (C₀ - q_N θ) * s ^ 2 - p θ ^ 2 = Δ_N := by
      have hs4 : s ^ 4 = q_N θ ^ 2 := by
        calc s ^ 4 = (s ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = q_N θ ^ 2 := by rw [hs_sq]
      rw [hs4, hs_sq]
      dsimp [q_N, p, Δ_N]
      calc (C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * θ) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * θ)) ^ 2 +
            2 * (C₀ - (C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * θ) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * θ))) *
              (C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * θ) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * θ)) -
            (-B₀ * Real.sin (2 * θ) + D₀ * Real.cos (2 * θ)) ^ 2
          = C₀ ^ 2 - (B₀ ^ 2 + D₀ ^ 2) * (Real.cos (2 * θ) ^ 2 + Real.sin (2 * θ) ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = C₀ ^ 2 - B₀ ^ 2 - D₀ ^ 2 := by rw [htrig]; ring
    rw [hstep1, hstep2]
    dsimp [α]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ L.c hΔ_ne
  have h_harm_eq : ∀ θ : ℝ, L.h θ + deriv (deriv L.h) θ = h_E θ + ddh_E θ := by
    intro θ
    have hs3_pos : 0 < (Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) ^ 3 := pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ)) 3
    have heq : (L.h θ + deriv (deriv L.h) θ) * (Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) ^ 3 =
        (h_E θ + ddh_E θ) * (Real.sqrt (q_N θ)) ^ 3 := by
      rw [h_ode θ, hhE_ode θ]
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hs3_pos) heq

  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℝ L.h := L.h_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hdh_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv L.h) :=
    (L.h_smooth.of_le (by simp : (1 + 1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞)).deriv'.differentiable_one
  let u : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => L.h θ - h_E θ
  let du : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => deriv L.h θ - dh_E θ
  let ddu : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => deriv (deriv L.h) θ - ddh_E θ
  have hu_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt u (du θ) θ :=
    fun θ => (hh_diff θ).hasDerivAt.sub (hhE_deriv₁ θ)
  have hdu_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt du (ddu θ) θ :=
    fun θ => (hdh_diff θ).hasDerivAt.sub (hhE_deriv₂ θ)
  have hu_osc : ∀ θ : ℝ, u θ + ddu θ = 0 := by
    intro θ
    dsimp [u, ddu]
    linarith [h_harm_eq θ]
  let I₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => u θ * Real.cos θ - du θ * Real.sin θ
  let I₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => u θ * Real.sin θ + du θ * Real.cos θ
  have hI₁_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt I₁ 0 θ := by
    intro θ
    have h1 := (hu_deriv θ).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ)
    have h2 := (hdu_deriv θ).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ)
    have hsub := h1.sub h2
    convert hsub using 1
    calc (0 : ℝ) = -(u θ + ddu θ) * Real.sin θ := by rw [hu_osc θ]; ring
      _ = (du θ * Real.cos θ + u θ * -Real.sin θ) - (ddu θ * Real.sin θ + du θ * Real.cos θ) := by ring
  have hI₂_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, HasDerivAt I₂ 0 θ := by
    intro θ
    have h1 := (hu_deriv θ).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ)
    have h2 := (hdu_deriv θ).mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ)
    have hadd := h1.add h2
    convert hadd using 1
    calc (0 : ℝ) = (u θ + ddu θ) * Real.cos θ := by rw [hu_osc θ]; ring
      _ = (du θ * Real.sin θ + u θ * Real.cos θ) + (ddu θ * Real.cos θ + du θ * -Real.sin θ) := by ring
  have hI₁_const : ∀ θ : ℝ, I₁ θ = I₁ 0 := fun θ =>
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun t => (hI₁_deriv t).differentiableAt)
      (fun t => (hI₁_deriv t).deriv) θ 0
  have hI₂_const : ∀ θ : ℝ, I₂ θ = I₂ 0 := fun θ =>
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun t => (hI₂_deriv t).differentiableAt)
      (fun t => (hI₂_deriv t).deriv) θ 0
  let c₁ : ℝ := I₁ 0
  let c₂ : ℝ := I₂ 0
  have hh_formula : ∀ θ : ℝ, L.h θ = c₁ * Real.cos θ + c₂ * Real.sin θ + h_E θ := by
    intro θ
    have hu_eq : u θ = c₁ * Real.cos θ + c₂ * Real.sin θ := by
      calc u θ = u θ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; ring
        _ = I₁ θ * Real.cos θ + I₂ θ * Real.sin θ := by dsimp [I₁, I₂]; ring
        _ = c₁ * Real.cos θ + c₂ * Real.sin θ := by rw [hI₁_const θ, hI₂_const θ]
    dsimp [u] at hu_eq
    linarith
  have hdh_formula : ∀ θ : ℝ, deriv L.h θ = -c₁ * Real.sin θ + c₂ * Real.cos θ + dh_E θ := by
    intro θ
    have hdu_eq : du θ = -c₁ * Real.sin θ + c₂ * Real.cos θ := by
      calc du θ = du θ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; ring
        _ = -I₁ θ * Real.sin θ + I₂ θ * Real.cos θ := by dsimp [I₁, I₂]; ring
        _ = -c₁ * Real.sin θ + c₂ * Real.cos θ := by rw [hI₁_const θ, hI₂_const θ]
    dsimp [du] at hdu_eq
    linarith

  
  let c_shift : Plane := (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![c₁, c₂]
  let c_ell : Plane := L.c₀ + c_shift
  let β : ℝ := (α ^ 2 * Δ_N)⁻¹
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := inv_pos.mpr (mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hα_pos) hΔ_pos)
  have hβαΔ : β * α ^ 2 * Δ_N = 1 := by
    dsimp [β]
    have hne : α ^ 2 * Δ_N ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hα_pos) hΔ_pos)
    field_simp [hne]
  let Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
    !![β * (C₀ - B₀), -β * D₀; -β * D₀, β * (C₀ + B₀)]
  have hQ_symm : Q.IsSymm := by
    rw [Matrix.IsSymm.ext_iff]
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Q]
  have hQ_herm : Q.IsHermitian := by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Q]
  have hCB_pos : 0 < C₀ - B₀ := by
    have h := hq_pos (Real.pi / 2)
    dsimp [q_N] at h
    have h2 : 2 * (Real.pi / 2) = Real.pi := by ring
    rw [h2, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi] at h
    linarith
  have hQ_quad : ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      v ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec v =
        β * ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0 ^ 2 - 2 * D₀ * v 0 * v 1 + (C₀ + B₀) * v 1 ^ 2) := by
    intro v
    simp [Q, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hQ_posDef : Q.PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hQ_herm
    intro v hv
    have hstar : star v = v := by ext i; simp
    rw [hstar, hQ_quad v]
    have hv_nz : v 0 ≠ 0 ∨ v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h0
      push_neg at h0
      apply hv
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0.1
      · exact h0.2
    have hsq_id : (C₀ - B₀) * ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0 ^ 2 - 2 * D₀ * v 0 * v 1 + (C₀ + B₀) * v 1 ^ 2) =
        ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0 - D₀ * v 1) ^ 2 + Δ_N * v 1 ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [Δ_N]
      ring
    have hrhs_pos : 0 < ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0 - D₀ * v 1) ^ 2 + Δ_N * v 1 ^ 2 := by
      by_cases hv1 : v 1 = 0
      · rw [hv1]
        have hv0 : v 0 ≠ 0 := hv_nz.resolve_right (not_not.mpr hv1)
        have hprod : (C₀ - B₀) * v 0 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hCB_pos) hv0
        have hsq_pos : 0 < ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hprod
        linarith
      · have hv1_sq : 0 < v 1 ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hv1
        have h1 : 0 ≤ ((C₀ - B₀) * v 0 - D₀ * v 1) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        nlinarith
    have hinner_pos : 0 < (C₀ - B₀) * v 0 ^ 2 - 2 * D₀ * v 0 * v 1 + (C₀ + B₀) * v 1 ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    exact mul_pos hβ_pos hinner_pos

  let γ : ℝ → Plane :=
    fun θ => L.c₀ + L.h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv L.h θ • unitTangentVec θ
  have hγ_coord0 : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      Real.sqrt (q_N θ) * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 =
        α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) := by
    intro θ
    set s := Real.sqrt (q_N θ)
    have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ))
    have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q_N θ := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq_pos θ))
    have hcoord : (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 = h_E θ * Real.cos θ - dh_E θ * Real.sin θ := by
      simp [γ, c_ell, c_shift, unitNormalVec, unitTangentVec]
      rw [hh_formula θ, hdh_formula θ]
      linear_combination c₁ * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    rw [hcoord]
    have h1 : s * (h_E θ * Real.cos θ - dh_E θ * Real.sin θ) =
        α * (q_N θ * Real.cos θ - p θ * Real.sin θ) := by
      dsimp [h_E, dh_E]
      change s * (α * s * Real.cos θ - α * (p θ / s) * Real.sin θ) =
        α * (q_N θ * Real.cos θ - p θ * Real.sin θ)
      rw [← hs_sq]
      field_simp [hs_ne]
    rw [h1]
    dsimp [q_N, p]
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul', Real.sin_two_mul]
    calc α * ((C₀ + B₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) +
            D₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ)) * Real.cos θ -
            (-B₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) +
            D₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2)) * Real.sin θ)
        = α * (C₀ * Real.cos θ + (B₀ * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) *
            (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2)) := by ring
      _ = α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; ring

  have hγ_coord1 : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      Real.sqrt (q_N θ) * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 =
        α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) := by
    intro θ
    set s := Real.sqrt (q_N θ)
    have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ))
    have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q_N θ := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq_pos θ))
    have hcoord : (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 = h_E θ * Real.sin θ + dh_E θ * Real.cos θ := by
      simp [γ, c_ell, c_shift, unitNormalVec, unitTangentVec]
      rw [hh_formula θ, hdh_formula θ]
      linear_combination c₂ * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    rw [hcoord]
    have h1 : s * (h_E θ * Real.sin θ + dh_E θ * Real.cos θ) =
        α * (q_N θ * Real.sin θ + p θ * Real.cos θ) := by
      dsimp [h_E, dh_E]
      change s * (α * s * Real.sin θ + α * (p θ / s) * Real.cos θ) =
        α * (q_N θ * Real.sin θ + p θ * Real.cos θ)
      rw [← hs_sq]
      field_simp [hs_ne]
    rw [h1]
    dsimp [q_N, p]
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul', Real.sin_two_mul]
    calc α * ((C₀ + B₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) +
            D₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ)) * Real.sin θ +
            (-B₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) +
            D₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2)) * Real.cos θ)
        = α * (C₀ * Real.sin θ + (D₀ * Real.cos θ - B₀ * Real.sin θ) *
            (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2)) := by ring
      _ = α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; ring

  have hq_expand : ∀ θ : ℝ, q_N θ =
      (C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + 2 * D₀ * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ +
        (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ ^ 2 := by
    intro θ
    dsimp [q_N]
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul', Real.sin_two_mul]
    calc C₀ + B₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) + D₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ)
        = C₀ * 1 + B₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) +
            D₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) := by ring
      _ = C₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) + B₀ * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) +
            D₀ * (2 * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ) := by rw [← Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ]
      _ = (C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + 2 * D₀ * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ +
            (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ ^ 2 := by ring

  let F : Plane → ℝ := fun x => (x - c_ell).ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec (x - c_ell).ofLp
  have h_front_F : frontier Ω = { x : Plane | F x = 1 } := by
    rw [L.frontier_eq]
    change Set.range γ = { x : Plane | F x = 1 }
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨θ, rfl⟩
      set s := Real.sqrt (q_N θ)
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ)
      have hs2_ne : s ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sq_pos_of_pos hs_pos)
      have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q_N θ := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq_pos θ))
      have h0 : s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 = α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) :=
        hγ_coord0 θ
      have h1 : s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 = α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) :=
        hγ_coord1 θ
      have hs2F : s ^ 2 * F (γ θ) = s ^ 2 * 1 := by
        change s ^ 2 * ((γ θ - c_ell).ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp) = s ^ 2 * 1
        rw [hQ_quad ((γ θ - c_ell).ofLp)]
        calc s ^ 2 * (β * ((C₀ - B₀) * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 ^ 2 -
              2 * D₀ * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 +
              (C₀ + B₀) * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 ^ 2))
            = β * ((C₀ - B₀) * (s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0) ^ 2 -
              2 * D₀ * (s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0) * (s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1) +
              (C₀ + B₀) * (s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = β * ((C₀ - B₀) * (α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ)) ^ 2 -
              2 * D₀ * (α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ)) *
                (α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ)) +
              (C₀ + B₀) * (α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ)) ^ 2) := by rw [h0, h1]
          _ = (β * α ^ 2 * Δ_N) *
              ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + 2 * D₀ * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ +
                (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by dsimp [Δ_N]; ring
          _ = q_N θ := by rw [hβαΔ, ← hq_expand θ]; ring
          _ = s ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [hs_sq]; ring
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hs2_ne hs2F
    · intro hxF
      set u := (x - c_ell).ofLp
      let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := Q.mulVec u
      have hv0_def : v 0 = β * (C₀ - B₀) * u 0 - β * D₀ * u 1 := by
        simp [v, Q, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        ring
      have hv1_def : v 1 = -β * D₀ * u 0 + β * (C₀ + B₀) * u 1 := by
        simp [v, Q, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have huv : u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 = 1 := by
        simpa [F, u, v, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hxF
      have hv_nz : v 0 ≠ 0 ∨ v 1 ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h0
        push_neg at h0
        rw [h0.1, h0.2] at huv
        norm_num at huv
      obtain ⟨r, θ, hr_pos, _, hv0, hv1⟩ := polar_rep (v 0) (v 1) hv_nz
      have hu0 : u 0 = α ^ 2 * r * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) := by
        calc u 0 = (β * α ^ 2 * Δ_N) * u 0 := by rw [hβαΔ]; ring
          _ = α ^ 2 * ((C₀ + B₀) * (β * (C₀ - B₀) * u 0 - β * D₀ * u 1) +
              D₀ * (-β * D₀ * u 0 + β * (C₀ + B₀) * u 1)) := by dsimp [Δ_N]; ring
          _ = α ^ 2 * ((C₀ + B₀) * v 0 + D₀ * v 1) := by rw [← hv0_def, ← hv1_def]
          _ = α ^ 2 * r * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) := by rw [hv0, hv1]; ring
      have hu1 : u 1 = α ^ 2 * r * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) := by
        calc u 1 = (β * α ^ 2 * Δ_N) * u 1 := by rw [hβαΔ]; ring
          _ = α ^ 2 * (D₀ * (β * (C₀ - B₀) * u 0 - β * D₀ * u 1) +
              (C₀ - B₀) * (-β * D₀ * u 0 + β * (C₀ + B₀) * u 1)) := by dsimp [Δ_N]; ring
          _ = α ^ 2 * (D₀ * v 0 + (C₀ - B₀) * v 1) := by rw [← hv0_def, ← hv1_def]
          _ = α ^ 2 * r * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) := by rw [hv0, hv1]; ring
      set s := Real.sqrt (q_N θ)
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq_pos θ)
      have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs_pos
      have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = q_N θ := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hq_pos θ))
      have hars_sq : (α * r * s) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        calc (α * r * s) ^ 2 = α ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = α ^ 2 * r ^ 2 * q_N θ := by rw [hs_sq]
          _ = α ^ 2 * r ^ 2 *
              ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ ^ 2 + 2 * D₀ * Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ +
                (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by rw [hq_expand θ]
          _ = (α ^ 2 * r * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ)) * (r * Real.cos θ) +
              (α ^ 2 * r * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ)) * (r * Real.sin θ) := by ring
          _ = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 := by rw [← hu0, ← hu1, ← hv0, ← hv1]
          _ = 1 := huv
      have hars_pos : 0 < α * r * s := mul_pos (mul_pos hα_pos hr_pos) hs_pos
      have hars : α * r * s = 1 := by nlinarith
      have hsu0 : s * u 0 = s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 0 := by
        rw [hu0, hγ_coord0 θ]
        calc s * (α ^ 2 * r * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ))
            = (α * r * s) * (α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ)) := by ring
          _ = α * ((C₀ + B₀) * Real.cos θ + D₀ * Real.sin θ) := by rw [hars]; ring
      have hsu1 : s * u 1 = s * (γ θ - c_ell).ofLp 1 := by
        rw [hu1, hγ_coord1 θ]
        calc s * (α ^ 2 * r * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ))
            = (α * r * s) * (α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ)) := by ring
          _ = α * (D₀ * Real.cos θ + (C₀ - B₀) * Real.sin θ) := by rw [hars]; ring
      have hsub_eq : γ θ - c_ell = x - c_ell := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hs_ne hsu0).symm
        · exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hs_ne hsu1).symm
      exact ⟨θ, sub_left_injective hsub_eq⟩

  
  have hF_center : F c_ell = 0 := by
    simp [F]
  have hF_ray : ∀ (t : ℝ) (w : Plane),
      F (c_ell + t • w) = t ^ 2 * (w.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec w.ofLp) := by
    intro t w
    have hsub : c_ell + t • w - c_ell = t • w := add_sub_cancel_left c_ell (t • w)
    change (c_ell + t • w - c_ell).ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec (c_ell + t • w - c_ell).ofLp =
      t ^ 2 * (w.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec w.ofLp)
    rw [hsub]
    have hl : (t • w).ofLp = t • w.ofLp := rfl
    rw [hl, Matrix.mulVec_smul, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hF_pos : ∀ x : Plane, x ≠ c_ell → 0 < F x := by
    intro x hx
    have hne : (x - c_ell).ofLp ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      have hsub0 : x - c_ell = 0 := by
        ext i
        exact congr_fun h0 i
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub0
    have hp := hQ_posDef.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    have hstar : star (x - c_ell).ofLp = (x - c_ell).ofLp := by ext i; simp
    rwa [hstar] at hp

  have hc_ell_mem : c_ell ∈ Ω := by
    let e₁ : Plane := (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![1, 0]
    have hm_eq : e₁.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec e₁.ofLp = β * (C₀ - B₀) := by
      rw [hQ_quad e₁.ofLp]
      simp [e₁]
    have hm_pos : 0 < e₁.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec e₁.ofLp := by
      rw [hm_eq]
      exact mul_pos hβ_pos hCB_pos
    set m := e₁.ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec e₁.ofLp
    let t₀ : ℝ := (Real.sqrt m)⁻¹
    have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt m := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hm_pos
    have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
    have ht₀_sq : t₀ ^ 2 * m = 1 := by
      dsimp [t₀]
      have hne : Real.sqrt m ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hsqrt_pos
      have hsq : (Real.sqrt m) ^ 2 = m := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hm_pos)
      field_simp [hne]
      exact hsq.symm
    let p_pos : Plane := c_ell + t₀ • e₁
    let p_neg : Plane := c_ell + (-t₀) • e₁
    have hp_pos_cl : p_pos ∈ closure Ω := by
      apply frontier_subset_closure
      rw [h_front_F]
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hF_ray t₀ e₁]
      exact ht₀_sq
    have hp_neg_cl : p_neg ∈ closure Ω := by
      apply frontier_subset_closure
      rw [h_front_F]
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hF_ray (-t₀) e₁, neg_sq]
      exact ht₀_sq
    have hp_ne : p_pos ≠ p_neg := by
      intro heq
      have h0 : (p_pos - p_neg).ofLp 0 = 0 := by rw [heq]; simp
      have hcalc : (p_pos - p_neg).ofLp 0 = 2 * t₀ := by
        simp [p_pos, p_neg, e₁]
        ring
      linarith
    have hc_seg : c_ell ∈ openSegment ℝ p_pos p_neg := by
      refine ⟨1 / 2, 1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
      dsimp [p_pos, p_neg]
      module
    exact hΩ.domain.openSegment_subset p_pos hp_pos_cl p_neg hp_neg_cl hp_ne hc_seg

  have h_not_front_of_mem : ∀ y ∈ Ω, y ∉ frontier Ω := by
    intro y hy hy_front
    have hint : y ∈ interior Ω := by
      rwa [hΩ.domain.isOpen.interior_eq]
    exact hy_front.2 hint

  have hΩ_eq : Ω = { x : Plane | F x < 1 } := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_contra hge
      push_neg at hge
      have hFx_nonneg : 0 ≤ F x := by linarith
      let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (F x)
      have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := Real.sqrt_nonneg (F x)
      have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = F x := Real.sq_sqrt hFx_nonneg
      have hr_ge_one : 1 ≤ r := by nlinarith
      have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := by linarith
      let s : ℝ := r⁻¹
      have hs_pos : 0 < s := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
      have hs_le_one : s ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hr_ge_one
      let y : Plane := (1 - s) • c_ell + s • x
      have hy_mem : y ∈ Ω :=
        hΩ.domain.convex hc_ell_mem hx (by linarith) (le_of_lt hs_pos) (by ring)
      have hy_eq : y = c_ell + s • (x - c_ell) := by
        dsimp [y]
        module
      have hy_F : F y = 1 := by
        rw [hy_eq, hF_ray s (x - c_ell)]
        change (r⁻¹) ^ 2 * F x = 1
        rw [← hr_sq]
        calc (r⁻¹) ^ 2 * r ^ 2 = (r * r⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne]; norm_num
      have hy_front : y ∈ frontier Ω := by
        rw [h_front_F]
        exact hy_F
      exact h_not_front_of_mem y hy_mem hy_front
    · intro hx
      by_cases hxc : x = c_ell
      · rwa [hxc]
      · have hFx_pos : 0 < F x := hF_pos x hxc
        let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt (F x)
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hFx_pos
        have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_pos
        have hr_sq : r ^ 2 = F x := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hFx_pos)
        have hr_lt_one : r < 1 := by nlinarith
        let y : Plane := c_ell + r⁻¹ • (x - c_ell)
        have hy_F : F y = 1 := by
          rw [hF_ray r⁻¹ (x - c_ell)]
          change (r⁻¹) ^ 2 * F x = 1
          rw [← hr_sq]
          calc (r⁻¹) ^ 2 * r ^ 2 = (r * r⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne]; norm_num
        have hy_cl : y ∈ closure Ω := by
          apply frontier_subset_closure
          rw [h_front_F]
          exact hy_F
        have hc_cl : c_ell ∈ closure Ω := subset_closure hc_ell_mem
        have hcy_ne : c_ell ≠ y := by
          intro heq
          have h0 : F c_ell = F y := congr_arg F heq
          rw [hF_center, hy_F] at h0
          norm_num at h0
        have hx_seg : x ∈ openSegment ℝ c_ell y := by
          refine ⟨1 - r, r, by linarith, hr_pos, by ring, ?_⟩
          have hry : r • y = r • c_ell + x - c_ell := by
            calc r • (c_ell + r⁻¹ • (x - c_ell))
                = r • c_ell + (r * r⁻¹) • (x - c_ell) := by rw [smul_add, smul_smul]
              _ = r • c_ell + (1 : ℝ) • (x - c_ell) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_ne]
              _ = r • c_ell + x - c_ell := by module
          calc (1 - r) • c_ell + r • y
              = (1 - r) • c_ell + (r • c_ell + x - c_ell) := by rw [hry]
            _ = x := by module
        exact hΩ.domain.openSegment_subset c_ell hc_cl y hy_cl hcy_ne hx_seg

  exact ⟨c_ell, Q, hQ_symm, hQ_posDef, hΩ_eq⟩
