      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖)) ∧
  ((∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-signTestH1 K)) ∨
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖))

def cycNext (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

def cycPrev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + N - 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

noncomputable def jacobiM0 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    (if i = k then (ℓ_vec (cycPrev N i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if k = cycNext N i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if i = cycNext N k then (ℓ_vec k)⁻¹ else 0)

noncomputable def jacobiVDiag (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  2 * (f_vec j) ^ 3 / ((c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j))

noncomputable def jacobiH (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec - Matrix.diagonal (jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec)

noncomputable def modifiedJacobiB (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ)
    (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (I F : Finset (Fin N)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
      jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec i else 0)
    else if i = k then 1 else 0

noncomputable def jacobiNullVec (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec sp_vec : Fin N → ℂ)
    (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j) * (f_vec j)⁻¹ ^ 2 * sp_vec j

noncomputable def sliceParamT0 (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.pi / (N : ℝ)

noncomputable def sliceHeight (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  S.h_X (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)

noncomputable def sliceImpactSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.𝔰 (y + (j : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))

noncomputable def sliceAngleSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSpeedSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.f (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSupportSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.H0 (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def slicePosSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  S.Γ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

structure OddPeriodicSliceData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  N : ℕ
  instNeZero : NeZero N
  N_odd : Odd N
  N_ge_three : 3 ≤ N
  t₀_lt_r_star : sliceParamT0 N < S.r_star
  θ_seq : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ
  θ_holo : ∀ j : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (θ_seq j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  θ_quasiperiodic : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_shift_N : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j + (N : ℤ)) y = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_conj : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (θ_seq j y)
  θ_sum : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j - 1) y + θ_seq j y = 2 * sliceAngleSeq S N j y
  θ_real : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    θ_seq j x =
      S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + ((((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * sliceParamT0 N : ℝ) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))
  ℓ_num : Fin N → ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_num_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_num j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  ℓ_num_periodic : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    ℓ_num j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = ℓ_num j y
  ℓ_real : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ x : ℝ,
    ℓ_num j x / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x) =
      (S.ℓ_chord (x + (j.val : ℝ) * sliceParamT0 N) (sliceParamT0 N) : ℂ)
  C_rec : ℝ
  C_rec_pos : 0 < C_rec
  Z_all : Set ℂ
  Z_all_subset : Z_all ⊆ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N)
  reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all)
  real_not_mem_Z_all : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ Z_all
  Z_all_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ Z_all ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Z_all
  Z_all_compact_finite : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < sliceHeight S N →
    (Z_all ∩ {y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ sliceHeight S N - ε}).Finite
  reg_speed_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y ≠ 0
  reg_sin_d0_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_vec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 =
      -(ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y) ∧
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 =
      (ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.cos (θ_seq j.val y)
  reg_deriv_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 0) y =
      -(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y ∧
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 1) y =
      (S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y
  reg_deriv_support : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (sliceSupportSeq S N j.val) y =
      (-slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) +
        slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)) *
      deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y
  pos_reconstruction : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ B_ang B_sup : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_ang → 0 ≤ B_sup →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y‖ +
        |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (θ_seq k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y)‖| ≤ B_ang) →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceSupportSeq S N k.val y‖ ≤ B_sup) →
      ∀ j : Fin N, ‖slicePosSeq S N j.val y‖ ≤ C_rec * Real.exp (C_rec * B_ang) * B_sup
  jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    (@jacobiH N instNeZero S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => ℓ_num j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec N S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y)) = 0
  jacobi_M0_mulVec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    2 * sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y =
      (@jacobiM0 N instNeZero
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
        (jacobiNullVec N S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y)) j
  modified_det_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        I F).det ≠ 0
  cofactor_norm : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    (jacobiNullVec N S.c
      (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
      (∏ i : Fin N, (ℓ_num i y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
  boundary_contact : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
    ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ∃ s_lim : Fin N → ℂ,
        (∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone → ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
            (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + ((sgn * sliceHeight S N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) ∧
                |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (sliceHeight S N - |y.im|)})
            (nhds (s_lim j))) ∧
        ∃ j : Fin N, |(s_lim j).im| = S.H

instance instNeZeroOddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    NeZero P.N :=
  P.instNeZero

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.d0 {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)) (y : ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ :=
  modifiedJacobiB P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i y) I F

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.w_vec {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : Fin P.N → ℂ :=
  jacobiNullVec P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y)

noncomputable def unifTwoPiMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ :=
  (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ •
    MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))

abbrev WalkSpace : Type := ℕ → ℝ

noncomputable def walkMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure WalkSpace :=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure)

noncomputable def walkPos (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (om 0 : ℂ)
  | m + 1 =>
      walkPos ρ om m + (ρ (walkPos ρ om m) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (m + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

noncomputable def sliceShapeDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im|

noncomputable def sliceLogDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  -Real.log (sliceShapeDepth S P j y)

noncomputable def sliceGeomCost (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun j : Fin P.N =>
    ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
      Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| +
      |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|

noncomputable def sliceHistory (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) (j : Fin P.N) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.range (m + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ m)⟩ fun n =>
    sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om n)

noncomputable def sliceStopTau (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @dite _
    (∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m))
    (Classical.propDecidable _)
    (fun h => @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h)
    (fun _ => 0)

noncomputable def sliceFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ L om, Or.inl le_rfl⟩

noncomputable def sliceLastFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  J.sup' hJ fun j => sliceFirstHit S P ρ L d j om

noncomputable def sliceDiskExit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d r_exit : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N)
    (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om ≤ m ∧
        (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨
          r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om))‖))
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨max (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om),
      le_max_left _ _, Or.inl (le_max_right _ _)⟩

structure StoppedSliceGeometryData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) where
  stepRadius : ℝ → ℂ → ℝ
  L_min : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  C_hit : ℝ
  C_clk : ℝ
  C_rem : ℝ
  L_min_ge_two : 2 ≤ L_min
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  C_hit_pos : 0 < C_hit
  C_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk
  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem
  stepRadius_measurable : ∀ L : ℝ, Measurable (stepRadius L)
  walk_in_reg_domain : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    walkPos (stepRadius L) om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
    0 < stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_small_step : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    m < sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (m + 1)) -
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_stops_ae : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om j m)
  walk_clock_bound : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
        (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
      (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_clk
  all_power_geometry : ∀ σ δ : ℝ, 0 < σ → 0 < δ →
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, L_min ≤ L₁ ∧ ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
          L ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)} ≤ δ
  modified_inverse_bound : ∀ L U V : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)
  first_hit_interval_domination : ∀ L d r_int : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    L_min ≤ L → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  remaining_clock_tail : ∀ L d B : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    L_min ≤ L → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)
  stopped_displacement_bound : ∀ L d r_exit q_K : ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    L_min ≤ L → i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P (stepRadius L) L d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * L ^ 3)) *
          (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceDiskExit S P (stepRadius L) L d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceLastFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def signTestH1 (K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)

noncomputable def robustDiskRadius (K k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k - signTestH1 K / 4)

noncomputable def upperRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def lowerRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) - ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

def HasRobustSignDisk (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ((∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-signTestH1 K)) ∨
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖)) ∧
  ((∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-signTestH1 K)) ∨
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖))

def cycNext (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

def cycPrev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + N - 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

noncomputable def jacobiM0 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    (if i = k then (ℓ_vec (cycPrev N i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if k = cycNext N i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if i = cycNext N k then (ℓ_vec k)⁻¹ else 0)

noncomputable def jacobiVDiag (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  2 * (f_vec j) ^ 3 / ((c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j))

noncomputable def jacobiH (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec - Matrix.diagonal (jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec)

noncomputable def modifiedJacobiB (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ)
    (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (I F : Finset (Fin N)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
      jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec i else 0)
    else if i = k then 1 else 0

noncomputable def jacobiNullVec (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec sp_vec : Fin N → ℂ)
    (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j) * (f_vec j)⁻¹ ^ 2 * sp_vec j

noncomputable def sliceParamT0 (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.pi / (N : ℝ)

noncomputable def sliceHeight (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  S.h_X (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)

noncomputable def sliceImpactSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.𝔰 (y + (j : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))

noncomputable def sliceAngleSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSpeedSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.f (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSupportSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.H0 (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def slicePosSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  S.Γ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

structure OddPeriodicSliceData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  N : ℕ
  instNeZero : NeZero N
  N_odd : Odd N
  N_ge_three : 3 ≤ N
  t₀_lt_r_star : sliceParamT0 N < S.r_star
  θ_seq : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ
  θ_holo : ∀ j : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (θ_seq j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  θ_quasiperiodic : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_shift_N : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j + (N : ℤ)) y = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_conj : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (θ_seq j y)
  θ_sum : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j - 1) y + θ_seq j y = 2 * sliceAngleSeq S N j y
  θ_real : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    θ_seq j x =
      S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + ((((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * sliceParamT0 N : ℝ) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))
  ℓ_num : Fin N → ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_num_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_num j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  ℓ_num_periodic : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    ℓ_num j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = ℓ_num j y
  ℓ_real : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ x : ℝ,
    ℓ_num j x / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x) =
      (S.ℓ_chord (x + (j.val : ℝ) * sliceParamT0 N) (sliceParamT0 N) : ℂ)
  C_rec : ℝ
  C_rec_pos : 0 < C_rec
  Z_all : Set ℂ
  Z_all_subset : Z_all ⊆ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N)
  reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all)
  real_not_mem_Z_all : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ Z_all
  Z_all_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ Z_all ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Z_all
  Z_all_compact_finite : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < sliceHeight S N →
    (Z_all ∩ {y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ sliceHeight S N - ε}).Finite
  reg_speed_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y ≠ 0
  reg_sin_d0_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_vec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 =
      -(ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y) ∧
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 =
      (ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.cos (θ_seq j.val y)
  reg_deriv_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 0) y =
      -(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y ∧
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 1) y =
      (S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y
  reg_deriv_support : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (sliceSupportSeq S N j.val) y =
      (-slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) +
        slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)) *
      deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y
  pos_reconstruction : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ B_ang B_sup : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_ang → 0 ≤ B_sup →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y‖ +
        |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (θ_seq k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y)‖| ≤ B_ang) →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceSupportSeq S N k.val y‖ ≤ B_sup) →
      ∀ j : Fin N, ‖slicePosSeq S N j.val y‖ ≤ C_rec * Real.exp (C_rec * B_ang) * B_sup
  jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    (@jacobiH N instNeZero S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => ℓ_num j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec N S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y)) = 0
  jacobi_M0_mulVec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    2 * sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y =
      (@jacobiM0 N instNeZero
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
        (jacobiNullVec N S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y)) j
  modified_det_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        I F).det ≠ 0
  cofactor_norm : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    (jacobiNullVec N S.c
      (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
      (∏ i : Fin N, (ℓ_num i y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
  boundary_contact : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
    ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ∃ s_lim : Fin N → ℂ,
        (∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone → ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
            (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + ((sgn * sliceHeight S N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) ∧
                |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (sliceHeight S N - |y.im|)})
            (nhds (s_lim j))) ∧
        ∃ j : Fin N, |(s_lim j).im| = S.H

instance instNeZeroOddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    NeZero P.N :=
  P.instNeZero

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.d0 {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)) (y : ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ :=
  modifiedJacobiB P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i y) I F

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.w_vec {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : Fin P.N → ℂ :=
  jacobiNullVec P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y)

noncomputable def unifTwoPiMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ :=
  (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ •
    MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))

abbrev WalkSpace : Type := ℕ → ℝ

noncomputable def walkMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure WalkSpace :=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure)

noncomputable def walkPos (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (om 0 : ℂ)
  | m + 1 =>
      walkPos ρ om m + (ρ (walkPos ρ om m) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (m + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

noncomputable def sliceShapeDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im|

noncomputable def sliceLogDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  -Real.log (sliceShapeDepth S P j y)

noncomputable def sliceGeomCost (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun j : Fin P.N =>
    ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
      Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| +
      |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|

noncomputable def sliceHistory (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) (j : Fin P.N) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.range (m + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ m)⟩ fun n =>
    sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om n)

noncomputable def sliceStopTau (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @dite _
    (∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m))
    (Classical.propDecidable _)
    (fun h => @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h)
    (fun _ => 0)

noncomputable def sliceFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ L om, Or.inl le_rfl⟩

noncomputable def sliceLastFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  J.sup' hJ fun j => sliceFirstHit S P ρ L d j om

noncomputable def sliceDiskExit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d r_exit : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N)
    (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om ≤ m ∧
        (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨
          r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om))‖))
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨max (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om),
      le_max_left _ _, Or.inl (le_max_right _ _)⟩

structure StoppedSliceGeometryData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) where
  stepRadius : ℝ → ℂ → ℝ
  L_min : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  C_hit : ℝ
  C_clk : ℝ
  C_rem : ℝ
  L_min_ge_two : 2 ≤ L_min
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  C_hit_pos : 0 < C_hit
  C_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk
  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem
  stepRadius_measurable : ∀ L : ℝ, Measurable (stepRadius L)
  walk_in_reg_domain : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    walkPos (stepRadius L) om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
    0 < stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_small_step : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    m < sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (m + 1)) -
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_stops_ae : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om j m)
  walk_clock_bound : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
        (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
      (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_clk
  all_power_geometry : ∀ σ δ : ℝ, 0 < σ → 0 < δ →
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, L_min ≤ L₁ ∧ ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
          L ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)} ≤ δ
  modified_inverse_bound : ∀ L U V : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)
  first_hit_interval_domination : ∀ L d r_int : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    L_min ≤ L → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val

def smallChordDomain (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (η_SL : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ |
    q.1 ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧ q.1 + q.2 ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
    ‖q.2 * S.f q.1‖ < η_SL ∧
    ‖q.2 ^ 2 * deriv S.f q.1‖ < η_SL ∧
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖q.2 ^ 2 * S.q (q.1 + (w : ℂ) * q.2)‖ < η_SL }

noncomputable def frozenPhiFirst (Λ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if Λ = 0 then (1 / 24 : ℂ)
  else (Λ / 2 - Complex.sin (Λ / 2)) / (4 * (Λ / 2) ^ 3)

noncomputable def frozenPhiSecond (μ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * μ ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) /
    (2 * (1 + ∑' m : ℕ, μ ^ m / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)))

structure SmallFieldChordActionData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  η_SL : ℝ
  C_SL : ℝ
  Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  η_SL_pos : 0 < η_SL
  η_SL_lt : η_SL < 1 / 4
  C_SL_pos : 0 < C_SL
  domain_open : IsOpen (smallChordDomain S η_SL)
  Phi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Phi (smallChordDomain S η_SL)
  Phi_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, Phi (s, 0) = 1 / 24
  Phi_rev : ∀ s h : ℂ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    (s + h, -h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    Phi (s + h, -h) = Phi (s, h)
  Phi_bound : ∀ s h : ℂ, ∀ M_q : ℝ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    0 ≤ M_q →

      C_SL * (M_q + ‖h ^ 2 * deriv S.f s‖)
  Phi_approx_second : ∀ s h μ : ℂ, ∀ M_diff : ℝ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    ‖μ‖ < η_SL →
    0 ≤ M_diff →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h) - μ‖ ≤ M_diff) →
    ‖Phi (s, h) - frozenPhiSecond μ‖ ≤
      C_SL * (M_diff + ‖h * S.f s‖ + ‖h ^ 2 * deriv S.f s‖)

          let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
          let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
          let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
          let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
          (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL ∧
          (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL ∧
          ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          ‖J_p - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
            t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =

            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∃ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep

            (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,

              |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) →

              (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_steep p = S.𝔰 p))

      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hℓ_tendsto) 1 zero_lt_one
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hb_tendsto) (max B 0)
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.1
      have hm_pos : 0 < m_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.2
      have hℓ_lt_one : ℓ_seq n < 1 := by
        have hd := hN₁ n hn₁
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos] at hd
        exact hd
      have hprod_ge : max B 0 ≤ ℓ_seq n * m_seq n := hN₂ n hn₂
      have hprod_le : ℓ_seq n * m_seq n ≤ m_seq n := by nlinarith
      exact le_trans (le_max_left B 0) (le_trans hprod_ge hprod_le)
    have hh_div_ℓ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop]
      intro B
      let B' : ℝ := max B 1
      have hB'_pos : 0 < B' := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right B 1)
      have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hh_tendsto) (S.H / 2) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ :=
        (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hℓ_tendsto) ((S.H / 2) / B') (by positivity)
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.1
      have hh_gt : S.H / 2 < h_seq n := by
        have hd := hN₁ n hn₁
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hd
        linarith
      have hℓ_lt : ℓ_seq n < (S.H / 2) / B' := by
        have hd := hN₂ n hn₂
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos] at hd
        exact hd
      have hmul_lt : ℓ_seq n * B' < S.H / 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hB'_pos).mp hℓ_lt
      have hmul_lt' : B' * ℓ_seq n < S.H / 2 := by linarith
      have hdiv_gt : B' < h_seq n / ℓ_seq n :=
        (lt_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr (lt_trans hmul_lt' hh_gt)
      exact le_trans (le_max_left B 1) hdiv_gt.le
    have hexh : ∀ R_exh : ℝ, 0 < R_exh → ∃ N_exh : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_exh, ∀ Z : ℂ,
        ‖Z‖ ≤ R_exh →
          (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈
            S.toExpStripData.D_strip := by
      intro R_exh hR_pos
      have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hh_tendsto) (S.H / 2) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ :=
        (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hℓ_tendsto) ((S.H / 2) / R_exh) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hgap_tendsto) (R_exh + 1)
      refine ⟨max (max N₁ N₂) N₃, fun n hn Z hZ => ?_⟩
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
      have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
      have hn₃ : N₃ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.1
      have hh_gt : S.H / 2 < h_seq n := by
        have hd := hN₁ n hn₁
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hd
        linarith
      have hℓ_lt : ℓ_seq n < (S.H / 2) / R_exh := by
        have hd := hN₂ n hn₂
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos] at hd
        exact hd
      have hmul_lt : ℓ_seq n * R_exh < S.H / 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hR_pos).mp hℓ_lt
      have hgap_ge : R_exh + 1 ≤ (S.H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n := hN₃ n hn₃
      have hgap_mul : (R_exh + 1) * ℓ_seq n ≤ S.H - h_seq n :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp hgap_ge
      have hgap_mul' : ℓ_seq n * R_exh + ℓ_seq n ≤ S.H - h_seq n := by linarith
      have hZ_im : |Z.im| ≤ R_exh := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm Z) hZ
      rw [abs_le] at hZ_im
      change |((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z).im| < S.H
      have him_eq :
          ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z).im =
            h_seq n + ℓ_seq n * Z.im := by simp
      rw [him_eq, abs_lt]
      have hlo : -(ℓ_seq n * R_exh) ≤ ℓ_seq n * Z.im := by nlinarith [hZ_im.1]
      have hhi : ℓ_seq n * Z.im ≤ ℓ_seq n * R_exh := by nlinarith [hZ_im.2]
      constructor <;> linarith
    rcases hProf with ⟨hf_conv, hq_conv⟩ | ⟨hf_conv, hq_conv⟩
    · let seq : ExpSequenceData S.toExpStripData .firstField :=
        { x_seq := x_seq
          h_seq := h_seq
          ℓ_seq := ℓ_seq
          m_seq := m_seq
          c₀ := c₀
          c₀_ne_zero := hc₀
          ℓ_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.1
          m_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.2
          m_tendsto := hm_tendsto
          b_tendsto := hb_tendsto
          h_div_ℓ_tendsto := hh_div_ℓ
          exhausts_ℂ := hexh
          f_conv := hf_conv
          q_conv := hq_conv }
      have hDeep := hDeepFin S P_S .firstField seq α₀ δ_b hα₁ hα₂ hδ₁ hδ₂
        (fun n => (h_bounds n).1) hh_tendsto hℓ_tendsto hgap_tendsto hCone
      exact corridor_tracking_and_bypass_contradiction
        S.toExpStripData hX_S P_S .firstField seq hDeep M_first
    · let seq : ExpSequenceData S.toExpStripData .secondField :=
        { x_seq := x_seq
          h_seq := h_seq
          ℓ_seq := ℓ_seq
          m_seq := m_seq
          c₀ := c₀
          c₀_ne_zero := hc₀
          ℓ_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.1
          m_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.2
          m_tendsto := hm_tendsto
          b_tendsto := hb_tendsto
          h_div_ℓ_tendsto := hh_div_ℓ
          exhausts_ℂ := hexh
          f_conv := hf_conv
          q_conv := hq_conv }
      have hDeep := hDeepFin S P_S .secondField seq α₀ δ_b hα₁ hα₂ hδ₁ hδ₂
        (fun n => (h_bounds n).1) hh_tendsto hℓ_tendsto hgap_tendsto hCone
      exact corridor_tracking_and_bypass_contradiction
        S.toExpStripData hX_S P_S .secondField seq hDeep M_second
  · intro E x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq c₀ α₀ C_ℓ C_cone hc₀ hα₁ hα₂ hCℓ hCcone
      h_bounds hh_tendsto hb_tendsto hlog_tendsto hProf hCone
    have hX_E : IsExpObstructionStrip E.toExpStripData := hStripEnt E
    obtain ⟨P_E⟩ := hChord E.toExpStripData hX_E
    have hm_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop]
      intro B
      let B' : ℝ := max B 0
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hb_tendsto) (B' * C_ℓ)
      refine ⟨N₁, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hℓ_le : ℓ_seq n ≤ C_ℓ := (h_bounds n).2.2.1
      have hm_pos : 0 < m_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.2.2
      have hprod_ge : B' * C_ℓ ≤ ℓ_seq n * m_seq n := hN₁ n hn
      have hprod_le : ℓ_seq n * m_seq n ≤ C_ℓ * m_seq n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hℓ_le hm_pos.le
      have hB'_le : B' ≤ m_seq n := by nlinarith
      exact le_trans (le_max_left B 0) hB'_le
    have hh_div_ℓ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop]
      intro B
      let B' : ℝ := max B 0
      have hB'_nonneg : 0 ≤ B' := le_max_right B 0
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hh_tendsto) (B' * C_ℓ)
      refine ⟨N₁, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_bounds n).2.1
      have hℓ_le : ℓ_seq n ≤ C_ℓ := (h_bounds n).2.2.1
      have hh_ge : B' * C_ℓ ≤ h_seq n := hN₁ n hn
      have hmul_le : B' * ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hℓ_le hB'_nonneg) hh_ge
      have hdiv_ge : B' ≤ h_seq n / ℓ_seq n := (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr hmul_le
      exact le_trans (le_max_left B 0) hdiv_ge
    have hexh : ∀ R_exh : ℝ, 0 < R_exh → ∃ N_exh : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_exh, ∀ Z : ℂ,
        ‖Z‖ ≤ R_exh →
          (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈
            E.toExpStripData.D_strip :=
      fun _ _ => ⟨0, fun _ _ _ _ => Set.mem_univ _⟩
    rcases hProf with ⟨hf_conv, hq_conv⟩ | ⟨hf_conv, hq_conv⟩
    · let seq : ExpSequenceData E.toExpStripData .firstField :=
        { x_seq := x_seq
          h_seq := h_seq
          ℓ_seq := ℓ_seq
          m_seq := m_seq
          c₀ := c₀
          c₀_ne_zero := hc₀
          ℓ_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.1
          m_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.2.2
          m_tendsto := hm_tendsto
          b_tendsto := hb_tendsto
          h_div_ℓ_tendsto := hh_div_ℓ
          exhausts_ℂ := hexh
          f_conv := hf_conv
          q_conv := hq_conv }
      have hDeep := hDeepEnt E P_E .firstField seq α₀ C_ℓ C_cone hα₁ hα₂ hCℓ hCcone
        (fun n => ⟨(h_bounds n).1, (h_bounds n).2.2.1⟩) hh_tendsto hlog_tendsto hCone
      exact corridor_tracking_and_bypass_contradiction
        E.toExpStripData hX_E P_E .firstField seq hDeep M_first
    · let seq : ExpSequenceData E.toExpStripData .secondField :=
        { x_seq := x_seq
          h_seq := h_seq
          ℓ_seq := ℓ_seq
          m_seq := m_seq
          c₀ := c₀
          c₀_ne_zero := hc₀
          ℓ_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.1
          m_pos := fun n => (h_bounds n).2.2.2
          m_tendsto := hm_tendsto
          b_tendsto := hb_tendsto
          h_div_ℓ_tendsto := hh_div_ℓ
          exhausts_ℂ := hexh
          f_conv := hf_conv
          q_conv := hq_conv }
      have hDeep := hDeepEnt E P_E .secondField seq α₀ C_ℓ C_cone hα₁ hα₂ hCℓ hCcone
        (fun n => ⟨(h_bounds n).1, (h_bounds n).2.2.1⟩) hh_tendsto hlog_tendsto hCone
      exact corridor_tracking_and_bypass_contradiction
        E.toExpStripData hX_E P_E .secondField seq hDeep M_second

exponential_profile_obstruction.definitions:
inductive ExpProfileKind where
  | firstField
  | secondField

noncomputable def frozenActionP (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      ∑' m : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
  | .secondField =>
      (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))) /
        Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2)

noncomputable def frozenEnergyE (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J * deriv (frozenActionP kind lam) J - frozenActionP kind lam J

def IsRegularFrozenState (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : Prop :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J ≠ 0
  | .secondField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J ≠ 0

structure ExpStripData where
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  D_strip : Set ℂ
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  Γ_base : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Tube : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  θ_edge : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

noncomputable def FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip.toExpStripData
    (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ExpStripData where
  c := S.c
  s_star := S.s_star
  r_star := S.r_star
  D_strip := horizStrip S.H
  ϕ := S.ϕ
  f := S.f
  q := S.q
  Γ_base := S.Γ
  Tube := finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X
  𝔰 := S.𝔰
  θ_edge := fun x t => (S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re
  ℓ_chord := S.ℓ_chord

def EntireNonisotropicStrip.toExpStripData
    (E : EntireNonisotropicStrip) : ExpStripData where
  c := E.c
  s_star := E.s_star
  r_star := E.r_star
  D_strip := Set.univ
  ϕ := E.ϕ
  f := E.f
  q := E.q
  Γ_base := E.Γ0
  Tube := E.T
  𝔰 := E.𝔰
  θ_edge := E.θ_edge
  ℓ_chord := E.ℓ_chord

structure IsExpObstructionStrip (X : ExpStripData) : Prop where
  c_pos : 0 < X.c
  s_star_pos : 0 < X.s_star
  r_star_pos : 0 < X.r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : X.r_star < X.s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : X.r_star < Real.pi
  D_strip_open : IsOpen X.D_strip
  D_strip_convex : Convex ℝ X.D_strip
  base_strip_subset : horizStrip X.s_star ⊆ X.D_strip
  D_strip_add_real : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, ∀ x : ℝ, s + (x : ℂ) ∈ X.D_strip
  D_strip_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ X.D_strip
  D_strip_vert_balanced : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ |s.im| →
    (s.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ X.D_strip
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.ϕ X.D_strip
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.f X.D_strip
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.q X.D_strip
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, deriv X.ϕ s = X.f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, deriv (deriv X.f) s = X.q s * X.f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (X.f x).re ∧ (X.f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, X.f s ≠ 0
  Γ_base_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => X.Γ_base s 0) (horizStrip X.s_star) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => X.Γ_base s 1) (horizStrip X.s_star)
  Γ_base_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star,
    deriv (fun z => X.Γ_base z 0) s = -X.c * (X.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (X.ϕ s)
  Γ_base_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star,
    deriv (fun z => X.Γ_base z 1) s = X.c * (X.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (X.ϕ s)
  Γ_base_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, X.Γ_base (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.Γ_base s
  Γ_base_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    X.Γ_base (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (X.Γ_base s i)
  Tube_open : IsOpen X.Tube
  Tube_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < X.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < X.r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ X.D_strip ∧ p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ X.Tube
  Tube_param_subset : X.Tube ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < X.r_star }
  Tube_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y + (x : ℂ), t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y, -t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ X.Tube
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.𝔰 X.Tube
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ X.Tube, X.𝔰 p ∈ X.D_strip
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < X.s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < X.r_star →
    X.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip X.s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ X.D_strip, X.𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    X.𝔰 (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → X.𝔰 (y, -t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)
  𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    X.𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.𝔰 (y, t))
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < X.r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (X.𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < X.r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (X.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (X.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x - t) t + X.θ_edge x t = 2 * (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = X.θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < X.ℓ_chord x t ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (X.θ_edge x t) ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (X.θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < X.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W, s_tilde p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ X.Tube

structure ExpSequenceData (X : ExpStripData) (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  x_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  h_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  ℓ_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  m_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  c₀ : ℂ
  c₀_ne_zero : c₀ ≠ 0
  ℓ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ℓ_seq n
  m_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < m_seq n
  m_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  b_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  h_div_ℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  exhausts_ℂ : ∀ R_exh : ℝ, 0 < R_exh → ∃ N_exh : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_exh, ∀ Z : ℂ,
    ‖Z‖ ≤ R_exh →
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ X.D_strip
  f_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)
     | .secondField => fun _ => 0)
    Filter.atTop
  q_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun _ => 0
     | .secondField => fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z))
    Filter.atTop

structure ChordActionPackage (X : ExpStripData) where
  p_act : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ
  η_sf : ℝ
  C_sf : ℝ
  r_rec : ℝ
  η_sf_pos : 0 < η_sf
  C_sf_pos : 0 < C_sf
  r_rec_pos : 0 < r_rec
  r_rec_lt : r_rec < X.r_star
  p_act_zero : ∀ s J : ℂ, p_act s J 0 = J ^ 3 / 24
  small_field : ∀ (s₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t M₀ : ℝ),
    0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 4 * r_t ≤ r_s → 0 ≤ M₀ → r_t * M₀ ≤ η_sf →
    Metric.ball s₀ r_s ⊆ X.D_strip →
    (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M₀) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t } ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t / 2 →
      p_act (s + t * J) J (-t) = p_act s J t) ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      ‖p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24‖ ≤ C_sf * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M₀ ^ 2)
  base_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < X.s_star / 3 → 0 < ‖t‖ → ‖t‖ < r_rec →
    let s_prev := X.𝔰 (y - t, t)
    let s_curr := X.𝔰 (y, t)
    let s_next := X.𝔰 (y + t, t)
    let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
    let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
    deriv (fun J' => p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
      t * deriv (fun s' => p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
      deriv (fun J' => p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev
  frozen_conv : ∀ (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
      (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenState kind (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
    ∃ (δ_reg : ℝ) (N_reg : ℕ), 0 < δ_reg ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
            p_act
              ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
              q.2.1
              (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) =>
          p_act
            ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
            q.2.1
            (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
          frozenActionP kind (q.2.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2.1)
        Filter.atTop
        { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }

def DeepInitializedModelData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D₀ C_deep α : ℝ) (S_deep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C_deep ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_deep { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } ∧
      (∀ Y T : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → ‖T‖ < T_max →
        ‖S_deep (Y, T) - Y‖ ≤ C_deep * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
        S_deep (Y, -T) = S_deep (Y, T) ∧
        frozenEnergyE kind
          (T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_deep (Y, T)))
          (deriv (fun Y' => S_deep (Y', T)) Y) = 1 / 12) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → S_deep (Y, 0) = Y) ∧
      (∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D₀ + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
              |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, N_init ≤ N₁ ∧ ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - S_deep p‖ < ε))

def branchSectorPlus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w - θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchSectorMinus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w + θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchInnerDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∪ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ ∪ branchSectorMinus R ν θ δ_θ

def branchOuterDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp ν ∧
    |Complex.arg w| < θ + δ_θ }

structure BranchMonodromyPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  R : ℝ
  ν : ℝ
  θ : ℝ
  δ_θ : ℝ
  r_uniq : ℝ
  Δ_inner : ℂ → ℂ
  Δ_outer : ℂ → ℂ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  ν_pos : 0 < ν
  ν_lt_one : ν < 1
  θ_pos : 0 < θ
  θ_lt : θ < Real.pi / 4
  δ_θ_pos : 0 < δ_θ
  δ_θ_lt : δ_θ < θ / 2
  r_uniq_pos : 0 < r_uniq
  r_uniq_lt : r_uniq < R
  Δ_inner_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_inner (branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_outer_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_outer (branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_inner_zero : Δ_inner 0 = 0
  Δ_inner_even_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, Δ_inner (-w) = Δ_inner w
  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_inner (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  inner_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_inner w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_inner w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  outer_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_outer w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_outer w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  overlap_plus_eq : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ ∩ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ,
    Δ_outer w = Δ_inner w
  monodromy_minus_ne : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u < ν →
    let w_minus := (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((u : ℂ) - (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    Δ_outer w_minus ≠ Δ_inner w_minus

inductive ExpProfileKind where
  | firstField
  | secondField

noncomputable def frozenActionP (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      ∑' m : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
  | .secondField =>
      (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))) /
        Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2)

noncomputable def frozenEnergyE (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J * deriv (frozenActionP kind lam) J - frozenActionP kind lam J

def IsRegularFrozenState (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : Prop :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J ≠ 0
  | .secondField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J ≠ 0

  Tube_param_subset : X.Tube ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < X.r_star }
  Tube_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y + (x : ℂ), t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y, -t) ∈ X.Tube

  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →

  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < X.r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (X.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (X.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x - t) t + X.θ_edge x t = 2 * (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = X.θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < X.ℓ_chord x t ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (X.θ_edge x t) ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (X.θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < X.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W, s_tilde p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ X.Tube

structure ExpSequenceData (X : ExpStripData) (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  x_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  h_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  ℓ_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  m_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  c₀ : ℂ
  c₀_ne_zero : c₀ ≠ 0
  ℓ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ℓ_seq n
  m_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < m_seq n
  m_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  b_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  h_div_ℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  exhausts_ℂ : ∀ R_exh : ℝ, 0 < R_exh → ∃ N_exh : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_exh, ∀ Z : ℂ,
    ‖Z‖ ≤ R_exh →
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ X.D_strip
  f_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)
     | .secondField => fun _ => 0)
    Filter.atTop
  q_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun _ => 0
     | .secondField => fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z))
    Filter.atTop

structure ChordActionPackage (X : ExpStripData) where
  p_act : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ
  η_sf : ℝ
  C_sf : ℝ
  r_rec : ℝ
  η_sf_pos : 0 < η_sf
  C_sf_pos : 0 < C_sf
  r_rec_pos : 0 < r_rec
  r_rec_lt : r_rec < X.r_star
  p_act_zero : ∀ s J : ℂ, p_act s J 0 = J ^ 3 / 24
  small_field : ∀ (s₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t M₀ : ℝ),
    0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 4 * r_t ≤ r_s → 0 ≤ M₀ → r_t * M₀ ≤ η_sf →
    Metric.ball s₀ r_s ⊆ X.D_strip →
    (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M₀) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t } ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t / 2 →
      p_act (s + t * J) J (-t) = p_act s J t) ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      ‖p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24‖ ≤ C_sf * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M₀ ^ 2)
  base_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < X.s_star / 3 → 0 < ‖t‖ → ‖t‖ < r_rec →
    let s_prev := X.𝔰 (y - t, t)
    let s_curr := X.𝔰 (y, t)
    let s_next := X.𝔰 (y + t, t)
    let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
    let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
    deriv (fun J' => p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
      t * deriv (fun s' => p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
      deriv (fun J' => p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev
  frozen_conv : ∀ (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
      (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenState kind (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
    ∃ (δ_reg : ℝ) (N_reg : ℕ), 0 < δ_reg ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
            p_act
              ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
              q.2.1
              (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) =>
          p_act
            ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
            q.2.1
            (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
          frozenActionP kind (q.2.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2.1)
        Filter.atTop
        { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }

def DeepInitializedModelData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D₀ C_deep α : ℝ) (S_deep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C_deep ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_deep { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } ∧
      (∀ Y T : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → ‖T‖ < T_max →
        ‖S_deep (Y, T) - Y‖ ≤ C_deep * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
        S_deep (Y, -T) = S_deep (Y, T) ∧
        frozenEnergyE kind
          (T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_deep (Y, T)))
          (deriv (fun Y' => S_deep (Y', T)) Y) = 1 / 12) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → S_deep (Y, 0) = Y) ∧
      (∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D₀ + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
              |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, N_init ≤ N₁ ∧ ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - S_deep p‖ < ε))

def branchSectorPlus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w - θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchSectorMinus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w + θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchInnerDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∪ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ ∪ branchSectorMinus R ν θ δ_θ

def branchOuterDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp ν ∧
    |Complex.arg w| < θ + δ_θ }

structure BranchMonodromyPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  R : ℝ
  ν : ℝ
  θ : ℝ
  δ_θ : ℝ
  r_uniq : ℝ
  Δ_inner : ℂ → ℂ
  Δ_outer : ℂ → ℂ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  ν_pos : 0 < ν
  ν_lt_one : ν < 1
  θ_pos : 0 < θ
  θ_lt : θ < Real.pi / 4
  δ_θ_pos : 0 < δ_θ
  δ_θ_lt : δ_θ < θ / 2
  r_uniq_pos : 0 < r_uniq
  r_uniq_lt : r_uniq < R
  Δ_inner_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_inner (branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_outer_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_outer (branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_inner_zero : Δ_inner 0 = 0
  Δ_inner_even_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, Δ_inner (-w) = Δ_inner w
  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_inner (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  inner_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_inner w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_inner w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  outer_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_outer w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_outer w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  overlap_plus_eq : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ ∩ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ,
    Δ_outer w = Δ_inner w
  monodromy_minus_ne : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u < ν →
    let w_minus := (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((u : ℂ) - (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    Δ_outer w_minus ≠ Δ_inner w_minus

  have h_even_conv_mono : ∀ (I : Set ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ),

      (∀ y ∈ I, ρ (-y) = ρ y) →
      ConvexOn ℝ I ρ →
      ∀ y₁ y₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ y₁ → y₁ ≤ y₂ → y₂ ∈ I → ρ y₁ ≤ ρ y₂ := by
    intro I ρ hI_symm hρ_even hρ_conv y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₁₂ hy₂I
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (le_trans hy₁ hy₁₂) with hy₂_zero | hy₂_pos
    · have hy₁_eq : y₁ = y₂ := by linarith
      rw [hy₁_eq]
    · let a : ℝ := (y₂ - y₁) / (2 * y₂)
      let b : ℝ := (y₂ + y₁) / (2 * y₂)
      have ha : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have hb : 0 ≤ b := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have hab : a + b = 1 := by
        dsimp [a, b]
        field_simp [hy₂_pos.ne']
        ring
      have hcomb : a • (-y₂) + b • y₂ = y₁ := by
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        dsimp [a, b]
        field_simp [hy₂_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_ineq := hρ_conv.2 (hI_symm y₂ hy₂I) hy₂I ha hb hab
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_ineq hcomb
      rw [hcomb, hρ_even y₂ hy₂I] at h_ineq
      calc ρ y₁ ≤ a * ρ y₂ + b * ρ y₂ := h_ineq
        _ = (a + b) * ρ y₂ := by ring
        _ = ρ y₂ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have h_ell_inv_bound : ∀ ℓ v : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → 1 ≤ v → |Real.log ℓ| / v < 1 / 8 →

      (ℓ / 2)⁻¹ * (1 + (ℓ / 2)⁻¹) ≤ 6 * Real.exp ((1 / 4) * v) := by

      have h_const_le_exp : 6 * C_strip * (1 + 2 * P_f) ≤ Real.exp k := by

      have hq_z₀ : Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖ ≤ Real.exp (P * k) := by

    obtain ⟨δ_b, C_f, h_seq, ℓ_seq, m_seq,

        (fun n => ⟨(h_basic n).2.2.1, (h_basic n).2.2.2.1,

    have h_ev_log := h_log_zero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8))
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev_log
    obtain ⟨N_log, hN_log⟩ := h_ev_log
    have h_ev_h := h_h_tendsto.eventually

    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev_h

    let K_cone_S : ℝ :=

    let N_cone : ℕ := max (max N₁_f N_log) (max (max N_h N_ell) N_v)
    let C_cone : ℝ := max C_f 1
    have hC_cone_pos : 0 < C_cone := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
    have h_cone_all : ∀ n ≥ N_cone, ∀ s : ℂ,

      have hn_ell : N_ell ≤ n :=

      have hn_v : N_v ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
      obtain ⟨hh_pos, hh_lt_H, hℓ_pos, hm_pos, hm_eq, hv_ge_one⟩ := h_basic n
      let v : ℝ := ρ (h_seq n)

      have hh_gt_34 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * S.H < h_seq n := hN_h n hn_h
      have hℓ_lt_14 : ℓ_seq n < S.H / 4 := hN_ell n hn_ell

      have hq_raw := hQ_strip s Δ v hΔ_pos h_sub_strip h_f_band
      obtain ⟨hℓ_ge_exp, hΔ_inv⟩ := h_ell_inv_bound (ℓ_seq n) v hℓ_pos hv_ge_one (hN_log n hn_log)
      rw [max_eq_left hv_pos.le] at hq_raw
      have hv_le_exp8 : v ≤ 8 * Real.exp ((1 / 8) * v) := by

      have hq_upper : Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖ ≤ 96 * C_strip * Real.exp ((3 / 8) * v) := by

        rw [h_num_eq] at hrpow_ge
        have h_eq : Real.exp v * (Real.exp (-(3 / 32) * v) / δ_b ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) =
            Real.exp ((29 / 32) * v) / δ_b ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1

        rw [hm_eq, ← h_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_ge (by positivity)

      c₀ (3 / 4) δ_b

def UniversalDiskLogDeficitProp : Prop :=
  ∃ C_def : ℝ, 0 < C_def ∧
    ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f q : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ q U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) z = q z * f z) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0 → deriv f z ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (Δ K : ℝ), 0 < Δ →
        Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ U →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖f w‖) (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4),
          Δ * Real.sqrt ‖q z‖ ≤
            C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
              ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖f w‖))

structure PeriodicShapeField (U : Set ℂ) (s_star : ℝ) (f q : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  isOpen_U : IsOpen U
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  lower_strip_subset : horizStrip s_star ⊆ U
  slab_mem : ∀ w ∈ U, ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ |w.im| → z ∈ U
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q U
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ U, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ U, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ U, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0

noncomputable def rowLogSup (f : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (sSup ((fun x : ℝ => ‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ''
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)))

def UniversalDiskLogDeficitProp : Prop :=

      IsOpen U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
