proof.tactics:
by
  unfold CriticalUpperBoundProp
  by_contra! hNotCrit
  obtain ⟨P₀, K_init, hP₀_gt, hFin⟩ := hFinOrd
  obtain ⟨ε_bad, hε_bad_pos, hUnbdd⟩ := hNotCrit
  
  have h_period_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      shapeModulus S (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = shapeModulus S s := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro s _
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro s hs
      have hs_n : s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        simpa [horizStrip] using hs
      have h_step : s + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_step]
      have hf := S.f_periodic (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hs_n
      have hq := S.q_periodic (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hs_n
      have h_eq :
          shapeModulus S ((s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi) =
            shapeModulus S (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        simp only [shapeModulus, hf, hq]
      rw [h_eq, ih s hs]
  have h_period_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      shapeModulus S (s + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = shapeModulus S s := by
    intro k s hs
    rcases k with n | n
    · simpa using h_period_nat n s hs
    · set s' : ℂ := s + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hs' : s' ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        simpa [s', horizStrip] using hs
      have h_back : s' + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = s := by
        simp only [s', Int.cast_negSucc]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h1 := h_period_nat (n + 1) s' hs'
      rw [h_back] at h1
      exact h1.symm
  have h_mod_2pi : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      ∃ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        shapeModulus S s = shapeModulus S ((x₀ : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro s hs
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let k : ℤ := ⌊s.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x₀ : ℝ := s.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ s.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
    have hk_lt : s.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hx₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ x₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_le
      linarith
    have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_lt
      linarith
    refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀_nonneg, hx₀_le⟩, ?_⟩
    set s₀ : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hs₀ : s₀ ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      simpa [s₀, horizStrip] using hs
    have hs_eq : s₀ + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = s := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [s₀, x₀]
      · simp [s₀]
    rw [← hs_eq, h_period_int k s₀ hs₀]
  have hM_cont : ContinuousOn (shapeModulus S) (horizStrip S.H) := by
    have hf_c : ContinuousOn (fun s => ‖S.f s‖) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.f_holo.continuousOn
    have hq_c : ContinuousOn (fun s => Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_norm).comp_continuousOn S.q_holo.continuousOn
    exact ContinuousOn.sup hf_c hq_c
  
  let k₀ : ℝ := max (max K_init 1) (-Real.log (S.H / 2))
  have hk₀_ge_init : K_init ≤ k₀ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hexp_k₀_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 2 := by
    have h1 : -Real.log (S.H / 2) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right _ _
    calc Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 2)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = S.H / 2 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  have hre_ofReal : ∀ x y : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = x := fun x y => by simp
  have him_ofReal : ∀ x y : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y := fun x y => by simp
  let γ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.2 : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := by fun_prop
  have hγ_mem : ∀ k x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → γ (k, x) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro k x hk
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-k) ≤ S.H / 2 :=
      le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hexp_k₀_le
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos _
    have him : (γ (k, x)).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k) := him_ofReal x (S.H - Real.exp (-k))
    change |(γ (k, x)).im| < S.H
    rw [him, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
  let F_mod : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => shapeModulus S (γ p)
  have hF_mod_cont : ContinuousOn F_mod { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } := by
    refine hM_cont.comp hγ_cont.continuousOn ?_
    intro p hp
    exact hγ_mem p.1 p.2 hp
  have hF_mod_per : ∀ k x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      ∃ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), F_mod (k, x) = F_mod (k, x₀) := by
    intro k x hk
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, h_eq⟩ := h_mod_2pi (γ (k, x)) (hγ_mem k x hk)
    refine ⟨x₀, hx₀, ?_⟩
    have him : (γ (k, x)).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k) := him_ofReal x (S.H - Real.exp (-k))
    dsimp only [F_mod, γ]
    rwa [him] at h_eq
  have hF_mod_upper : ∀ k x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → F_mod (k, x) ≤ Real.exp (P₀ * k) := by
    intro k x hk
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp (-k) < S.H := by
      have : Real.exp (-k) ≤ S.H / 2 :=
        le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hexp_k₀_le
      linarith [S.H_pos]
    exact hFin k (le_trans hk₀_ge_init hk) hexp_lt x
  have hP₀_gt_bad : 1 + ε_bad < P₀ := by
    obtain ⟨T_star, hT_ge, _, x_star, hT_gt⟩ := hUnbdd k₀
    have hT_le : F_mod (T_star, x_star) ≤ Real.exp (P₀ * T_star) :=
      hF_mod_upper T_star x_star hT_ge
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp ((1 + ε_bad) * T_star) < Real.exp (P₀ * T_star) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hT_gt hT_le
    have hmul_lt : (1 + ε_bad) * T_star < P₀ * T_star := Real.exp_lt_exp.mp hexp_lt
    have hT_pos : 0 < T_star := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans hk₀_ge_one hT_ge)
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right hmul_lt hT_pos.le
  let α₁ : ℝ := 1 + ε_bad / 3
  let α₂ : ℝ := 1 + 2 * ε_bad / 3
  let P : ℝ := P₀ + 1
  have h1_lt_α₁ : 1 < α₁ := by dsimp [α₁]; linarith
  have hα₁_lt_α₂ : α₁ < α₂ := by dsimp [α₁, α₂]; linarith
  have hα₂_lt_bad : α₂ < 1 + ε_bad := by dsimp [α₂]; linarith
  have hP₀_lt_P : P₀ < P := by dsimp [P]; linarith
  have hα₂_lt_P : α₂ < P := by linarith
  
  let Φ₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => F_mod p * Real.exp (-α₁ * p.1)
  let Φ₂ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => F_mod p * Real.exp (-P * p.1)
  have hΦ₁_cont : ContinuousOn Φ₁ { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } :=
    hF_mod_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
  have hΦ₂_cont : ContinuousOn Φ₂ { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } :=
    hF_mod_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
  have h_step_n : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ k_n x_n : ℝ,
      k₀ + (n : ℝ) ≤ k_n ∧
      x_n ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Real.exp (α₂ * k_n) ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) ∧
      F_mod (k_n, x_n) ≤ Real.exp (P * k_n) ∧
      (∀ k x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → k ≤ k_n →
        F_mod (k, x) ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * (k - k_n))) ∧
      (∀ k x : ℝ, k_n ≤ k →
        F_mod (k, x) ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (k - k_n))) := by
    intro n
    have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have h2pi_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let Q_init : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
      Set.Icc k₀ (k₀ + (n : ℝ)) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hQ_init_comp : IsCompact Q_init := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hQ_init_ne : Q_init.Nonempty :=
      ⟨(k₀, 0), ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩, ⟨le_rfl, h2pi_nonneg⟩⟩
    have hQ_init_sub : Q_init ⊆ { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } := fun _ hp => hp.1.1
    obtain ⟨p_init, _, hp_init_max⟩ :=
      hQ_init_comp.exists_isMaxOn hQ_init_ne (hΦ₁_cont.mono hQ_init_sub)
    let M_init : ℝ := max 1 (Φ₁ p_init)
    have hM_init_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_init := le_max_left _ _
    have hM_init_pos : 0 < M_init := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_init_ge_one
    have hdiff_pos : 0 < α₂ - α₁ := sub_pos.mpr hα₁_lt_α₂
    let K_wit : ℝ := max (k₀ + (n : ℝ)) ((Real.log M_init + 1) / (α₂ - α₁))
    obtain ⟨T_n, hT_ge_wit, _, x_raw, hT_raw⟩ := hUnbdd K_wit
    have hT_ge_kn : k₀ + (n : ℝ) ≤ T_n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hT_ge_wit
    have hT_ge_k₀ : k₀ ≤ T_n := by linarith
    have hT_pos : 0 < T_n := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans hk₀_ge_one hT_ge_k₀)
    obtain ⟨x_wit, hx_wit_mem, hx_wit_eq⟩ := hF_mod_per T_n x_raw hT_ge_k₀
    have hF_T_gt : Real.exp (α₂ * T_n) < F_mod (T_n, x_wit) := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (α₂ * T_n) < Real.exp ((1 + ε_bad) * T_n) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hα₂_lt_bad hT_pos)
      have h2 : Real.exp ((1 + ε_bad) * T_n) < F_mod (T_n, x_raw) := hT_raw
      linarith [hx_wit_eq]
    have hΦ₁_T_gt_exp : Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * T_n) < Φ₁ (T_n, x_wit) := by
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hF_T_gt (Real.exp_pos (-α₁ * T_n))
      have hexp_eq : Real.exp (α₂ * T_n) * Real.exp (-α₁ * T_n) =
          Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * T_n) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
      rwa [hexp_eq] at hmul
    have hΦ₁_T_gt_M : M_init < Φ₁ (T_n, x_wit) := by
      have h_div : (Real.log M_init + 1) / (α₂ - α₁) ≤ T_n :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hT_ge_wit
      have h_log_le : Real.log M_init + 1 ≤ (α₂ - α₁) * T_n := by
        have := (div_le_iff₀ hdiff_pos).mp h_div
        linarith
      have hexp1 : 1 < Real.exp 1 := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr zero_lt_one
      calc M_init = M_init * 1 := (mul_one M_init).symm
        _ < M_init * Real.exp 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp1 hM_init_pos
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log M_init + 1) := by
            rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hM_init_pos]
        _ ≤ Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * T_n) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_le
        _ < Φ₁ (T_n, x_wit) := hΦ₁_T_gt_exp
    let Q₁ : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc k₀ T_n ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hQ₁_comp : IsCompact Q₁ := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hQ₁_ne : Q₁.Nonempty := ⟨(k₀, 0), ⟨le_rfl, hT_ge_k₀⟩, ⟨le_rfl, h2pi_nonneg⟩⟩
    have hQ₁_sub : Q₁ ⊆ { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } := fun _ hp => hp.1.1
    obtain ⟨⟨r_n, y_n⟩, ⟨⟨hr_lo, hr_hi⟩, hy_mem⟩, hp₁_max⟩ :=
      hQ₁_comp.exists_isMaxOn hQ₁_ne (hΦ₁_cont.mono hQ₁_sub)
    have hT_mem_Q₁ : (T_n, x_wit) ∈ Q₁ := ⟨⟨hT_ge_k₀, le_rfl⟩, hx_wit_mem⟩
    have hΦ₁_T_le_r : Φ₁ (T_n, x_wit) ≤ Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) := hp₁_max hT_mem_Q₁
    have hr_gt_kn : k₀ + (n : ℝ) < r_n := by
      by_contra h_le
      push Not at h_le
      have h_in_init : (r_n, y_n) ∈ Q_init := ⟨⟨hr_lo, h_le⟩, hy_mem⟩
      have h1 : Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) ≤ Φ₁ p_init := hp_init_max h_in_init
      have h2 : Φ₁ p_init ≤ M_init := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have hF_r_gt : Real.exp (α₂ * r_n) < F_mod (r_n, y_n) := by
      have hexp_le : Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * r_n) ≤ Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * T_n) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_hi hdiff_pos.le)
      have h1 : Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * r_n) < Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hexp_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hΦ₁_T_gt_exp hΦ₁_T_le_r)
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (Real.exp_pos (α₁ * r_n))
      have hlhs : Real.exp ((α₂ - α₁) * r_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * r_n) = Real.exp (α₂ * r_n) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
      have hrhs : Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * r_n) = F_mod (r_n, y_n) := by
        dsimp [Φ₁]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        have : -α₁ * r_n + α₁ * r_n = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at hmul
    let μ_n : ℝ := Φ₂ (r_n, y_n)
    have hμ_pos : 0 < μ_n := by
      dsimp [μ_n, Φ₂]
      exact mul_pos (lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hF_r_gt) (Real.exp_pos _)
    let K_cut : ℝ := max r_n (-Real.log μ_n + 1)
    let Q₂ : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc r_n K_cut ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hQ₂_comp : IsCompact Q₂ := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hQ₂_ne : Q₂.Nonempty := ⟨(r_n, 0), ⟨le_rfl, le_max_left _ _⟩, ⟨le_rfl, h2pi_nonneg⟩⟩
    have hQ₂_sub : Q₂ ⊆ { p : ℝ × ℝ | k₀ ≤ p.1 } :=
      fun _ hp => le_trans hr_lo hp.1.1
    obtain ⟨⟨k_n, x_n⟩, ⟨⟨hk_ge_r, _⟩, hx_n_mem⟩, hp₂_max⟩ :=
      hQ₂_comp.exists_isMaxOn hQ₂_ne (hΦ₂_cont.mono hQ₂_sub)
    have hr_mem_Q₂ : (r_n, y_n) ∈ Q₂ := ⟨⟨le_rfl, le_max_left _ _⟩, hy_mem⟩
    have hμ_le_kn : μ_n ≤ Φ₂ (k_n, x_n) := hp₂_max hr_mem_Q₂
    have hk_n_ge_k₀ : k₀ ≤ k_n := le_trans hr_lo hk_ge_r
    have h_tail_Φ₂ : ∀ k x : ℝ, r_n ≤ k → Φ₂ (k, x) ≤ Φ₂ (k_n, x_n) := by
      intro k x hk_r
      have hk_k₀ : k₀ ≤ k := le_trans hr_lo hk_r
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_mem, hx₀_eq⟩ := hF_mod_per k x hk_k₀
      have hΦ₂_eq : Φ₂ (k, x) = Φ₂ (k, x₀) := by dsimp [Φ₂]; rw [hx₀_eq]
      rw [hΦ₂_eq]
      by_cases hk_le : k ≤ K_cut
      · exact hp₂_max ⟨⟨hk_r, hk_le⟩, hx₀_mem⟩
      · push Not at hk_le
        have hk_gt_log : -Real.log μ_n + 1 < k :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hk_le
        have hF_up : F_mod (k, x₀) ≤ Real.exp (P₀ * k) := hF_mod_upper k x₀ hk_k₀
        have hΦ₂_le_exp : Φ₂ (k, x₀) ≤ Real.exp (-k) := by
          calc Φ₂ (k, x₀) = F_mod (k, x₀) * Real.exp (-P * k) := rfl
            _ ≤ Real.exp (P₀ * k) * Real.exp (-P * k) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hF_up (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = Real.exp (-k) := by
                rw [← Real.exp_add]
                dsimp [P]
                ring_nf
        have hexp_lt_μ : Real.exp (-k) < μ_n := by
          calc Real.exp (-k) < Real.exp (Real.log μ_n) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
            _ = μ_n := Real.exp_log hμ_pos
        exact le_trans hΦ₂_le_exp (le_trans hexp_lt_μ.le hμ_le_kn)
    have h_tail_F : ∀ k x : ℝ, r_n ≤ k →
        F_mod (k, x) ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (k - k_n)) := by
      intro k x hk_r
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_tail_Φ₂ k x hk_r) (Real.exp_pos (P * k)).le
      have hlhs : Φ₂ (k, x) * Real.exp (P * k) = F_mod (k, x) := by
        dsimp [Φ₂]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        have : -P * k + P * k = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      have hrhs : Φ₂ (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * k) =
          F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (k - k_n)) := by
        dsimp [Φ₂]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        congr 2
        ring
      rwa [hlhs, hrhs] at hmul
    refine ⟨k_n, x_n, by linarith, hx_n_mem, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have h1 : Real.exp (α₂ * r_n - P * r_n) < μ_n := by
        dsimp [μ_n, Φ₂]
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hF_r_gt (Real.exp_pos (-P * r_n))
        have hexp_eq : Real.exp (α₂ * r_n) * Real.exp (-P * r_n) =
            Real.exp (α₂ * r_n - P * r_n) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
        rwa [hexp_eq] at hmul
      have h2 : Real.exp (α₂ * r_n - P * r_n) < Φ₂ (k_n, x_n) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hμ_le_kn
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 (Real.exp_pos (P * k_n))
      have hlhs : Real.exp (α₂ * r_n - P * r_n) * Real.exp (P * k_n) =
          Real.exp (α₂ * r_n + P * (k_n - r_n)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
      have hrhs : Φ₂ (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * k_n) = F_mod (k_n, x_n) := by
        dsimp [Φ₂]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        have : -P * k_n + P * k_n = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      rw [hlhs, hrhs] at hmul
      have hexp_mono : Real.exp (α₂ * k_n) ≤ Real.exp (α₂ * r_n + P * (k_n - r_n)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        nlinarith [hα₂_lt_P, hk_ge_r]
      exact le_trans hexp_mono hmul.le
    · 
      have hkn_pos : 0 < k_n := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans hk₀_ge_one hk_n_ge_k₀)
      exact le_trans (hF_mod_upper k_n x_n hk_n_ge_k₀)
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP₀_lt_P.le hkn_pos.le))
    · 
      intro k x hk_lo hk_hi
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) := by
        dsimp [F_mod, shapeModulus]
        exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
      by_cases hk_r : r_n ≤ k
      · have h1 := h_tail_F k x hk_r
        have hexp_le : Real.exp (P * (k - k_n)) ≤ Real.exp (α₁ * (k - k_n)) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          nlinarith [hα₁_lt_α₂, hα₂_lt_P, hk_hi]
        exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le hM_nonneg)
      · push Not at hk_r
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_mem, hx₀_eq⟩ := hF_mod_per k x hk_lo
        rw [hx₀_eq]
        have hk_mem_Q₁ : (k, x₀) ∈ Q₁ := ⟨⟨hk_lo, le_trans hk_r.le hr_hi⟩, hx₀_mem⟩
        have h1 : Φ₁ (k, x₀) ≤ Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) := hp₁_max hk_mem_Q₁
        have hmul1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_pos (α₁ * k)).le
        have hlhs1 : Φ₁ (k, x₀) * Real.exp (α₁ * k) = F_mod (k, x₀) := by
          dsimp [Φ₁]
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          have : -α₁ * k + α₁ * k = 0 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
        have hrhs1 : Φ₁ (r_n, y_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * k) =
            F_mod (r_n, y_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * (k - r_n)) := by
          dsimp [Φ₁]
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 2
          ring
        rw [hlhs1, hrhs1] at hmul1
        have hr_bound : F_mod (r_n, y_n) ≤ F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (r_n - k_n)) :=
          h_tail_F r_n y_n le_rfl
        have hcomb : F_mod (k, x₀) ≤
            F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (r_n - k_n) + α₁ * (k - r_n)) := by
          calc F_mod (k, x₀)
              ≤ F_mod (r_n, y_n) * Real.exp (α₁ * (k - r_n)) := hmul1
            _ ≤ (F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (r_n - k_n))) *
                  Real.exp (α₁ * (k - r_n)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr_bound (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = F_mod (k_n, x_n) * Real.exp (P * (r_n - k_n) + α₁ * (k - r_n)) := by
                rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        have hexp_le : Real.exp (P * (r_n - k_n) + α₁ * (k - r_n)) ≤
            Real.exp (α₁ * (k - k_n)) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          nlinarith [hα₁_lt_α₂, hα₂_lt_P, hk_ge_r]
        exact le_trans hcomb (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le hM_nonneg)
    · 
      intro k x hk_ge_kn
      exact h_tail_F k x (le_trans hk_ge_r hk_ge_kn)
  
  choose k_seq x_max hk_seq using h_step_n
  let d_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-k_seq n)
  let m_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => F_mod (k_seq n, x_max n)
  have hm_seq_ge_one : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ m_seq n := by
    intro n
    have hk_ge_one : 1 ≤ k_seq n := by
      have h1 := (hk_seq n).1
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      linarith
    have hα₂_pos : 0 < α₂ * k_seq n := by nlinarith
    exact le_trans (Real.one_le_exp hα₂_pos.le) (hk_seq n).2.2.1
  have hs_eq_γ : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < wallDepth S s →
      s = γ (-Real.log (wallDepth S s), s.re) := by
    intro s hδ_pos
    have hexp_eq : Real.exp (- -Real.log (wallDepth S s)) = wallDepth S s := by
      rw [neg_neg, Real.exp_log hδ_pos]
    dsimp only [γ]
    rw [hexp_eq]
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact (hre_ofReal s.re (S.H - wallDepth S s)).symm
    · rw [him_ofReal]
      unfold wallDepth
      ring
  have hrpow_exp_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ β : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      (d_seq n / δ) ^ β = Real.exp (β * (-Real.log δ - k_seq n)) := by
    intro n δ β hδ_pos
    have hd_pos : 0 < d_seq n := Real.exp_pos _
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (div_pos hd_pos hδ_pos) β, Real.log_div hd_pos.ne' hδ_pos.ne']
    dsimp [d_seq]
    rw [Real.log_exp]
    congr 1
    ring
  let R : SuperlinearRecordScales S :=
    { α₁ := α₁
      α₂ := α₂
      P := P
      k₀ := k₀
      one_lt_α₁ := h1_lt_α₁
      α₁_lt_α₂ := hα₁_lt_α₂
      α₂_lt_P := hα₂_lt_P
      one_le_k₀ := hk₀_ge_one
      exp_neg_k₀_le_half_H := hexp_k₀_le
      k_seq := k_seq
      d_seq := d_seq
      m_seq := m_seq
      x_max := x_max
      k_seq_ge := fun n => (hk_seq n).1
      d_seq_eq := fun _ => rfl
      m_seq_pos := hm_seq_ge_one
      m_seq_lower := fun n => (hk_seq n).2.2.1
      m_seq_upper := fun n => (hk_seq n).2.2.2.1
      x_max_mem := fun n => (hk_seq n).2.1
      x_max_attains := fun _ => rfl
      coarse_tail_bound := by
        intro n s hd_lo hd_hi
        have hδ_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hd_lo
        let k : ℝ := -Real.log (wallDepth S s)
        have hk_lo : k₀ ≤ k := by
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log hδ_pos hd_hi
          rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
          dsimp [k]
          linarith
        have hk_hi : k ≤ k_seq n := by
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hd_lo
          rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
          dsimp [k]
          linarith
        have hs_eq : shapeModulus S s = F_mod (k, s.re) := by
          dsimp [F_mod, k]
          rw [← hs_eq_γ s hδ_pos]
        rw [hs_eq, hrpow_exp_eq n (wallDepth S s) α₁ hδ_pos]
        exact (hk_seq n).2.2.2.2.1 k s.re hk_lo hk_hi
      fine_cap_bound := by
        intro n s hδ_pos hd_hi
        let k : ℝ := -Real.log (wallDepth S s)
        have hk_lo : k_seq n ≤ k := by
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log hδ_pos hd_hi
          dsimp [d_seq] at hlog
          rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
          dsimp [k]
          linarith
        have hs_eq : shapeModulus S s = F_mod (k, s.re) := by
          dsimp [F_mod, k]
          rw [← hs_eq_γ s hδ_pos]
        rw [hs_eq, hrpow_exp_eq n (wallDepth S s) P hδ_pos]
        exact (hk_seq n).2.2.2.2.2 k s.re hk_lo }
  
  have hNoAllF : ∀ (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → ∀ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ →
      ¬ ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (-Complex.I) (1 / 8),

noncomputable def taylor2D (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ))

noncomputable def centeredTaylor2D (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀

noncomputable def compPowerSeries2D (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (ψ ^ n)

structure BaseCollarAndCramerData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) where
  s_det : ℝ
  r_det : ℝ
  s_det_pos : 0 < s_det
  s_det_le_s₁ : s_det ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_det_le_s₀ : s_det ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_det_pos : 0 < r_det
  r_det_lt_s_det : r_det < s_det / 4
  r_det_lt_r₁ : r_det < C.r₁ / 2
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_det → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_det →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  theta_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingTheta C p.1 p.2)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 3 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  offset_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingOffset C p.1 p.2)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  dualLine_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  impact_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) W
  eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  impact_support_proj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det + r_det → ‖t‖ < r_det →
    (glancingImpact C (y - t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C y t) +
      glancingImpact C (y - t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C y t) =
        glancingOffset C y t) ∧
    (glancingImpact C (y + t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C y t) +
      glancingImpact C (y + t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C y t) =
        glancingOffset C y t)
  cramer_edge_identities : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det + r_det → ‖t‖ < r_det →
    let P_minus := glancingImpact C (y - t / 2) t
    let P_plus := glancingImpact C (y + t / 2) t
    let Λ := glancingDualLine C y t
    let Δ := P_minus 0 * P_plus 1 - P_minus 1 * P_plus 0
    (P_minus 0 * Λ 0 + P_minus 1 * Λ 1 = 1 ∧ P_plus 0 * Λ 0 + P_plus 1 * Λ 1 = 1) ∧
    (Δ * Λ 0 = P_plus 1 - P_minus 1 ∧ Δ * Λ 1 = P_minus 0 - P_plus 0)
  real_chord_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_det →
    0 < (glancingOffset C (x : ℂ) (t : ℂ)).re ∧
    (glancingOffset C (x : ℂ) (t : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < (glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 0 *
          glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 1 -
        glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 1 *
          glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 0).re ∧
    (glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 0 *
      glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 1 -
    glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 1 *
      glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2) (t : ℂ) 0).im = 0

structure AlgebraicLiftingToolkit : Prop where
  formal_arc :
    ∀ (K : Subfield ℂ) (N : ℕ) (c : Fin N → ℂ),
      (∃ r : Fin N, ¬ IsAlgebraic (↥K) (c r)) →
      let F : Subfield ℂ := Subfield.closure ((K : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range c)
      ∃ Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ,
        (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K),
          Φ ⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) ∧
        (∀ y : ↥F, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ)) ∧
        (∃ r : Fin N,
          Φ ⟨c r, Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r, rfl⟩)⟩ ≠ PowerSeries.C (c r))
  lift_separable :
    ∀ (ι_all : Type) [Countable ι_all]
      (σ : ℕ → Type) [∀ M, Fintype (σ M)] [∀ M, DecidableEq (σ M)]
      (emb : ∀ M, σ M → ι_all),
      (∀ S : Finset ι_all, ∃ M : ℕ, (S : Set ι_all) ⊆ Set.range (emb M)) →
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → W.Nonempty →
      ∀ (jetFn : ι_all → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (zFn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ v : ι_all, DifferentiableOn ℂ (jetFn v) W) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ zFn W →
        ∀ (a_lo a_hi d_lo d_hi : ℝ), a_lo < a_hi → d_lo < d_hi →
        ∀ (U_a U_d : Set ℂ),
          IsOpen U_a → IsPreconnected U_a → IsOpen U_d → IsPreconnected U_d →
          (∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo a_lo a_hi, (a : ℂ) ∈ U_a) →

  ∀ (a₀ R δ_star C₀ : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < δ_star → 0 < C₀ → C₀ * δ_star < R / 2 →
  ∀ (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen U₀ → IsOpen U_plus →
    (∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀) →
    (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus) →
  ∀ (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) U₀) →
    (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) U_plus) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B U_plus →

      |(ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧

    (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
      (∀ i : Fin m, w i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
      Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m =>
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
          deriv (fun z : ℂ => ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ))) →
  ∀ (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ → δ₁ < δ_star → |a₁ - a₀| < R - C₀ * δ_star →
  ∀ (f : Fin m → PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∑ i : Fin m,
      taylor2D (w i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      taylor2D B ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) →
    ∃ (W_ψ : Set ℂ) (V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W_ψ ∧ IsPreconnected W_ψ ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ) ∧
      IsOpen V_plus ∧ IsPreconnected V_plus ∧ V_plus ⊆ U₀ ∧ V_plus ⊆ U_plus ∧

noncomputable def taylor2D (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ))

noncomputable def centeredTaylor2D (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀

noncomputable def compPowerSeries2D (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (ψ ^ n)

      (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) W_ψ) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        ψ i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_ψ ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          iteratedDeriv n (g i) (ψ i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
            PowerSeries.coeff n (f i)) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ V_plus,
        (∀ i : Fin m, ψ i p ∈ W_ψ) ∧
        ∑ i : Fin m, w i p * g i (ψ i p) = B p)

def LineEndpointDetProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_det r_det : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ)
      (Disc : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (lineJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              (y, t))
            (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (y + (j : ℂ) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            (y, t))
          (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            (y, t))
          Disc ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (env : LineJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin D,
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)

def PointEndpointDetProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_det r_det : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ)
      (Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (pointJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              C.A (y, t))
            (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (y + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (pointJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            C.A (y, t))
          (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (pointJetEnv M
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
            (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
            C.A (y, t))
          Disc ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
        MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin D,
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)

def MeroDiskContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (r_w ρ R : ℝ) (w₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ),
    0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → ρ < R → 0 < r₀ →
    Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w →
    ∀ (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))
      (F₀ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
      MeroEqOn F F₀ (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
      ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
        MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })

structure CollarWidthTubeData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  s_base : ℝ
  r_base : ℝ
  s_base_pos : 0 < s_base
  s_base_le_det : s_base ≤ hDet.s_det
  s_base_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_base_le_s₀ : s_base ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_base_pos : 0 < r_base
  r_base_le_det : r_base ≤ hDet.r_det
  r_base_lt_s_base : r_base < s_base / 4
  r_base_lt_r₁ : r_base < C.r₁ / 2
  r_base_lt_pi : r_base < Real.pi
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_base →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  h_X : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_L : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_X_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) ≤ h_X t
  h_L_eq : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base,
    h_L t = h_X t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2)
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_L_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_L (-t) = h_L t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_L_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_L (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_X_supermean : ∀ (t₀ : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_base →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_X t₀
  L_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_L)
  X_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_X)
  L_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (L_mero i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  X_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  h_L_maximal : ∀ (t : ℂ) (b δ : ℝ),
    t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base → s_base < b → 0 < δ →
    Metric.ball t δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base →
    ∀ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D ({ y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)) →
      ENNReal.ofReal b ≤ h_L t
  real_interval_countable_transfer : ∀ (t₀ δ_star M : ℝ) (E_cnt : Set ℝ),
    0 < δ_star → |t₀| + δ_star < r_base → E_cnt.Countable →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ_star) (t₀ + δ_star) \ E_cnt,
      ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t : ℂ)) →
    ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t₀ : ℂ)

def NoPatchAtRealProp {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) : Prop :=
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.X_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }) ∧
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.L_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ })

structure ZeroSliceCollarData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) where
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    W.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ_slice z i

structure CollarWidthTubeData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  s_base : ℝ
  r_base : ℝ
  s_base_pos : 0 < s_base
  s_base_le_det : s_base ≤ hDet.s_det
  s_base_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_base_le_s₀ : s_base ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_base_pos : 0 < r_base
  r_base_le_det : r_base ≤ hDet.r_det
  r_base_lt_s_base : r_base < s_base / 4
  r_base_lt_r₁ : r_base < C.r₁ / 2
  r_base_lt_pi : r_base < Real.pi
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_base →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  h_X : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_L : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_X_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) ≤ h_X t
  h_L_eq : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base,
    h_L t = h_X t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2)
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_L_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_L (-t) = h_L t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_L_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_L (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_X_supermean : ∀ (t₀ : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_base →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_X t₀
  L_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_L)
  X_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_X)
  L_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (L_mero i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  X_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  h_L_maximal : ∀ (t : ℂ) (b δ : ℝ),
    t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base → s_base < b → 0 < δ →
    Metric.ball t δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base →
    ∀ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D ({ y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)) →
      ENNReal.ofReal b ≤ h_L t
  real_interval_countable_transfer : ∀ (t₀ δ_star M : ℝ) (E_cnt : Set ℝ),
    0 < δ_star → |t₀| + δ_star < r_base → E_cnt.Countable →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ_star) (t₀ + δ_star) \ E_cnt,
      ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t : ℂ)) →
    ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t₀ : ℂ)

def NoPatchAtRealProp {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) : Prop :=
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.X_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }) ∧
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.L_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ })

structure ZeroSliceCollarData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) where
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    W.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ_slice z i

by

  have hn₀_abs : 1 ≤ n₀.natAbs :=

  obtain ⟨P₀⟩ := isotropic_center_rational_profile n₀.natAbs hn₀_abs G₀
  obtain ⟨_, ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_le, hε₀_symm⟩ :=
    wronskian_simplicity_and_local_reflection n₀.natAbs hn₀_abs G₀ P₀
  obtain ⟨h_top, _⟩ := hG₀_cb ε₀ hε₀_pos hε₀_le hε₀_symm
  have hD_univ : horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) = Set.univ := by
    ext s
    simp [horizStripENNR, h_top]
  have ha_mero_univ : MeromorphicOn M.a_mero Set.univ := hD_univ ▸ M.a_mero_mero
  have ha_mero_at : ∀ q : ℂ, MeromorphicAt M.a_mero q :=
    fun q => ha_mero_univ q (Set.mem_univ q)
  have hp₀_ord_mero : meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero p₀ = (n₀ : WithTop ℤ) := by
    refine (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at p₀)).mpr ⟨u₀, hu₀_ana, hu₀_ne, ?_⟩
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha_p₀
  have hp₀_im : p₀.im ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp₀_im0
    have hp₀_eq : ((p₀.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = p₀ :=

    have ha_ne_p₀ : M.a_mero p₀ ≠ 0 := h_reg_p₀.2.2.2.2.1
    have hp₀_ord_zero : meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero p₀ = ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by

    rw [hp₀_ord_mero] at hp₀_ord_zero

  have ha_nf : MeromorphicNFOn a_nf Set.univ :=
    meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn M.a_mero Set.univ
  have ha_nf_at : ∀ q : ℂ, MeromorphicNFAt a_nf q :=
    fun q => ha_nf (Set.mem_univ q)
  have ha_nf_eq_of_not_disc : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → a_nf s = M.a_mero s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ M.a_mero s :=

    have hs_nf : MeromorphicNFAt M.a_mero s :=

    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, -, hr₂_disc⟩ :=

    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds q (lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos)] with z hz hz_ne
    have hz₁ : z ∉ M.E_disc :=
      hr₁_disc z (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _)))
        hz_ne
    have hz₂_ball : starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ Metric.ball (starRingEnd ℂ q) r₂ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      simpa [Complex.dist_eq, ← map_sub] using
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hz₂_ne : starRingEnd ℂ z ≠ starRingEnd ℂ q :=
      fun h => hz_ne ((RingHom.injective (starRingEnd ℂ)) h)
    have hz₂ : starRingEnd ℂ z ∉ M.E_disc := hr₂_disc (starRingEnd ℂ z) hz₂_ball hz₂_ne
    rw [ha_nf_eq_of_not_disc (starRingEnd ℂ z) hz₂, ha_nf_eq_of_not_disc z hz₁]
    exact B.a_conj_reg z (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ z) hz₁
      (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ _) hz₂
  have hp₀_ord : meromorphicOrderAt a_nf p₀ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [meromorphicOrderAt_congr (ha_nhdsNE p₀), hp₀_ord_mero]
    exact fun h => hn₀ (WithTop.coe_inj.mp h)
  have ha_centers : ∀ q : ℂ, meromorphicOrderAt a_nf q ≠ 0 →
      (meromorphicOrderAt a_nf q = 1 ∨ meromorphicOrderAt a_nf q = -1) ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, a_nf (2 * q - s) = -a_nf s := by
    intro q hq_ord
    have hq_ord_eq : meromorphicOrderAt a_nf q = meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q :=
      meromorphicOrderAt_congr (ha_nhdsNE q)
    have hq_ne_top : meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤ :=
      B.order_ne_top q (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ q)
    cases h_ord_q : meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q with
    | top => exact absurd h_ord_q hq_ne_top
    | coe n_q =>
      have hn_q_ne : n_q ≠ 0 := by
        intro hn_q0
        apply hq_ord
        rw [hq_ord_eq, h_ord_q, hn_q0]
        rfl
      obtain ⟨u_q, hu_q_ana, hu_q_ne, ha_q_smul⟩ :=
        (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at q)).mp h_ord_q
      have ha_q : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - q) ^ n_q * u_q z := by
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha_q_smul
      have hn_q_abs : 1 ≤ n_q.natAbs :=
        Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hn_q_ne)
      obtain ⟨G_q, hG_q_cb⟩ :=
        B.positive_germ_of_center q (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ q)
          n_q u_q hn_q_ne hu_q_ana hu_q_ne ha_q
      obtain ⟨P_q⟩ := isotropic_center_rational_profile n_q.natAbs hn_q_abs G_q
      obtain ⟨hn_q_one, ε_q, hε_q_pos, hε_q_le, hε_q_symm⟩ :=
        wronskian_simplicity_and_local_reflection n_q.natAbs hn_q_abs G_q P_q
      obtain ⟨_, ha_mero_refl⟩ := hG_q_cb ε_q hε_q_pos hε_q_le hε_q_symm
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hq_ord_eq, h_ord_q]
        rcases Int.natAbs_eq n_q with h_pos | h_neg
        · left
          have : n_q = 1 := by omega
          simp [this]
        · right
          have : n_q = -1 := by omega
          simp [this]
      · intro s
        have hg_nf : MeromorphicNFAt (fun z => (-1 : ℂ) * a_nf ((-1 : ℂ) * z + 2 * q)) s :=
          ha_nf_affine (-1) (-1) (2 * q) s (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
        have hg_nf' : MeromorphicNFAt (fun z => -a_nf (2 * q - z)) s := by
          have h_fun : (fun z : ℂ => (-1 : ℂ) * a_nf ((-1 : ℂ) * z + 2 * q)) =
              (fun z : ℂ => -a_nf (2 * q - z)) := by
            ext z
            ring_nf
          rwa [h_fun] at hg_nf
        obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, -, hr₁_disc⟩ := M.E_disc_isolated s (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ s)
        obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, -, hr₂_disc⟩ :=
          M.E_disc_isolated (2 * q - s) (hD_univ.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ _)
        have h_eq_punc : (fun z => -a_nf (2 * q - z)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ] a_nf := by
          rw [eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_iff]
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds s (lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos)] with z hz hz_ne
          have hz₁ : z ∉ M.E_disc :=
            hr₁_disc z
              (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _)))
              hz_ne
          have hz₂_ball : 2 * q - z ∈ Metric.ball (2 * q - s) r₂ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
            have h_sub : (2 * q - z) - (2 * q - s) = -(z - s) := by ring
            rw [h_sub, norm_neg, ← dist_eq_norm]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_right _ _)
          have hz₂_ne : 2 * q - z ≠ 2 * q - s := by
            intro h
            apply hz_ne
            simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            linear_combination -h
          have hz₂ : 2 * q - z ∉ M.E_disc := hr₂_disc (2 * q - z) hz₂_ball hz₂_ne
          rw [ha_nf_eq_of_not_disc (2 * q - z) hz₂, ha_nf_eq_of_not_disc z hz₁,
            ha_mero_refl z hz₁ hz₂, neg_neg]
        have h_pt : -a_nf (2 * q - s) = a_nf s :=
          ((hg_nf'.eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds (ha_nf_at s)).mp h_eq_punc).eq_of_nhds
        linear_combination -h_pt
  have hϕ_diff : Differentiable ℝ C.ϕ := C.ϕ_smooth.differentiable (by decide)
  have hϕ_deriv : deriv C.ϕ 0 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (C.ϕ_deriv_pos 0)
  exact elliptic_normal_pole_cancellation a_nf C.ϕ p₀ ha_nf hϕ_diff hϕ_deriv
    ha_real ha_per ha_conj hp₀_im hp₀_ord ha_centers

structure LocalPositiveCenterGerm (n : ℕ) where
  c : ℝ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  Z_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  W_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  a_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  f_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  u_a : ℂ → ℂ
  N_Z : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  N_W : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  D_ZW : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Z_mero : MeromorphicAt Z_loc 0
  W_mero : MeromorphicAt W_loc 0
  u_a_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_a 0
  u_a_ne_zero : u_a 0 ≠ 0
  a_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → a_loc z = z ^ n * u_a z
  reg_on_punctured : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ →
    AnalyticAt ℂ Z_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ W_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_loc z ∧
    a_loc z ≠ 0 ∧
    f_loc z ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv Z_loc z = Complex.I * (c : ℂ) * a_loc z / (f_loc z) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv W_loc z = -Complex.I * (c : ℂ) / (a_loc z * (f_loc z) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_loc z = Complex.I * f_loc z * a_loc z
  N_Z_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_Z (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  N_W_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_W (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  D_ZW_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_ZW (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  D_ZW_slice_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → D_ZW (z, 0) ≠ 0
  slice_Z_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → N_Z (z, 0) = Z_loc z * D_ZW (z, 0)
  slice_W_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → N_W (z, 0) = W_loc z * D_ZW (z, 0)
  even_Z : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
    N_Z (z, -t) * D_ZW (z, t) = N_Z (z, t) * D_ZW (z, -t)
  even_W : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
    N_W (z, -t) * D_ZW (z, t) = N_W (z, t) * D_ZW (z, -t)
  rank_one_punc : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < δ₀ →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
      D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧
      deriv (fun z' => N_Z (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z *
        deriv (fun t' => N_W (z, t') / D_ZW (z, t')) t =
      deriv (fun t' => N_Z (z, t') / D_ZW (z, t')) t *
        deriv (fun z' => N_W (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z
  iso_reflect_punc : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < δ₀ →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
      D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧ D_ZW (z - t, t) ≠ 0 ∧ D_ZW (z + t, t) ≠ 0 ∧
      (N_Z (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t) - N_Z (z - t, t) / D_ZW (z - t, t)) *
        (N_Z (z + t, t) / D_ZW (z + t, t) - N_Z (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t)) *
        (deriv (fun z' => N_W (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z) ^ 2 =
      (N_W (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t) - N_W (z - t, t) / D_ZW (z - t, t)) *
        (N_W (z + t, t) / D_ZW (z + t, t) - N_W (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t)) *
        (deriv (fun z' => N_Z (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z) ^ 2

structure RationalProfileData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n) where
  ne_three : n ≠ 3
  Z₀ : ℂ
  W₀ : ℂ
  u_Z : ℂ → ℂ
  u_W : ℂ → ℂ
  δ₁ : ℝ
  δ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁
  δ₁_le : δ₁ ≤ G.δ₀
  u_Z_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_Z 0
  u_W_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_W 0
  u_Z_ne_zero : u_Z 0 ≠ 0
  u_W_ne_zero : u_W 0 ≠ 0
  Z_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.Z_loc z - Z₀ = z ^ (n + 3) * u_Z z
  W_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    G.W_loc z - W₀ = z ^ ((3 : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) * u_W z
  R₀ : ℝ
  R₀_pos : 0 < R₀
  U_germ : ℂ → ℂ
  U_germ_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ U_germ 0
  U_germ_zero : U_germ 0 = 1
  ξ : ℂ → ℂ
  ξ_def : ∀ w : ℂ, R₀ < ‖w‖ → ξ w = w * U_germ w⁻¹ ∧ ξ w ≠ 0
  poly_power_rational : ∀ (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) (b : ℤ) (u_Q : ℂ → ℂ),
    AnalyticAt ℂ u_Q 0 → u_Q 0 ≠ 0 →
    (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q = z ^ b * u_Q z) →
    ∃ (P_rat Q_rat : Polynomial ℂ) (R_Q : ℝ),
      Q_rat ≠ 0 ∧ R₀ < R_Q ∧
      ∀ w : ℂ, R_Q < ‖w‖ → Q_rat.eval w ≠ 0 ∧ (ξ w) ^ b * Q_rat.eval w = P_rat.eval w
  profile_reflection_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, R₀ + 1 < ‖w‖ →
    ((3 - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) *
      ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) =
    (((n : ℤ) + 3 : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      (ξ w) ^ (2 * (((n : ℤ) + 3) - (3 - (n : ℤ)))) *
      ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ))) *
      ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)))

structure CollarIsotropicBridge {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  real_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
    (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
    (x : ℂ) ∉ M.E_disc ∧
    M.a_mero x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ x)
  a_periodic_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (s + 2 * Real.pi) = M.a_mero s
  a_conj_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (starRingEnd ℂ s) * starRingEnd ℂ (M.a_mero s) = 1
  order_ne_top : ∀ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤
  positive_germ_of_center : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ u p → u p ≠ 0 →
      (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z) →
      ∃ G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n.natAbs,
        ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ G.δ₀ →
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ε →
            G.Z_loc (-z) = G.Z_loc z ∧ G.W_loc (-z) = G.W_loc z ∧ G.a_loc (-z) = -G.a_loc z) →
          M.h_X 0 = ⊤ ∧
          ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → 2 * p - s ∉ M.E_disc → M.a_mero (2 * p - s) = -M.a_mero s

      ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ))) *
      ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)))

structure CollarIsotropicBridge {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  real_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
    (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
    (x : ℂ) ∉ M.E_disc ∧
    M.a_mero x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ x)
  a_periodic_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (s + 2 * Real.pi) = M.a_mero s
  a_conj_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (starRingEnd ℂ s) * starRingEnd ℂ (M.a_mero s) = 1
  order_ne_top : ∀ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤
  positive_germ_of_center : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ u p → u p ≠ 0 →
      (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z) →
      ∃ G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n.natAbs,
        ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ G.δ₀ →
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ε →
            G.Z_loc (-z) = G.Z_loc z ∧ G.W_loc (-z) = G.W_loc z ∧ G.a_loc (-z) = -G.a_loc z) →
          M.h_X 0 = ⊤ ∧
          ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → 2 * p - s ∉ M.E_disc → M.a_mero (2 * p - s) = -M.a_mero s
