nonisotropic_global_shape_lift.definitions:
noncomputable def shiftWidthENNR (w : ENNReal) (δ : ℝ) : ENNReal :=
  if w = ⊤ then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (w.toReal + δ)

def shiftedMeroTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ENNReal) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  meroTubeENNR r_star (fun t => shiftWidthENNR (h_X t) (b_shift t).im)

def shiftedLiftMap (𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  𝔰_raw (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingTheta {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingOffset {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingOffset C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

structure NonisotropicCurveData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  a : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  a_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ a (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  a_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a s ≠ 0
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv ϕ s = f s
  exp_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ s) = a s
  deriv_a : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv a s = Complex.I * f s * a s
  base_ϕ_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, ϕ s = C.ϕ_ℂ s ∧ f s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  a_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a (s + 2 * Real.pi) = a s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_base_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 1) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 0) s ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 1) s
  Γ_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) s = -C.c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) s = C.c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s
  Γ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i)
  Γ_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, Γ s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s
  Γ_slice_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), s ∉ M.E_disc → f s ≠ 0 → Γ s = M.Γ_slice s
  Γ_real_simple : ∀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ, Γ x₁ = Γ x₂ → ∃ k : ℤ, x₁ - x₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ z i
  s_init : ℝ
  r_init : ℝ
  s_init_pos : 0 < s_init
  s_init_le : s_init ≤ M.s_base / 2
  r_init_pos : 0 < r_init
  r_init_lt : r_init < s_init / 4
  r_init_le : r_init ≤ M.r_base / 2
  𝔰_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_init_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_init { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_init }
  𝔰_init_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (y, t) ∈ horizStrip M.s_base
  𝔰_init_ϕ : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    ϕ (𝔰_init (y, t)) = glancingMidAngle C y t
  𝔰_init_impact : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    glancingImpact C y t = Γ (𝔰_init (y, t))
  𝔰_init_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → 𝔰_init (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_init_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰_init (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_init_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init → 𝔰_init (y, -t) = 𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_init_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_init (y, t))

structure NormalizedGlobalLiftData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_raw_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  𝔰_raw_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_raw_init_eq : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < K.s_init → ‖t‖ < K.r_init →
    𝔰_raw (y, t) = K.𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_raw_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), 𝔰_raw (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_raw_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰_raw p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_raw_even : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰_raw p
  𝔰_raw_conj : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_raw p)
  𝔰_raw_comp_X : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, K.f (𝔰_raw p) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i) (Metric.ball p r)
  b_shift : ℂ → ℂ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  s_star_le : s_star ≤ K.s_init / 2
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  r_star_le : r_star ≤ K.r_init / 2
  b_shift_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b_shift (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base)
  b_shift_zero : b_shift 0 = 0
  b_shift_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base, b_shift (-t) = b_shift t
  b_shift_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base,
    b_shift (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (b_shift t)
  b_shift_small : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, ‖b_shift t‖ < s_star / 4
  T_norm_iff : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift ↔
    ‖p.2‖ < r_star ∧ (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift)
    (shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift)
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) =
      shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (p.1, -p.2) = shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p
  𝔰_conj : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p)
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (x, t) - x)) = 0
  zero_slice_nhd : ∀ y₀ ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ∃ δ_y δ_t : ℝ,
    0 < δ_y ∧ 0 < δ_t ∧ δ_t ≤ r_star ∧
    Metric.ball y₀ δ_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t ⊆ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift
  Θ_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  p_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  symplectic_gl : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift (y', t)) y *
      deriv (fun t' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift (y, t')) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift (y, t')) t *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift (y', t)) y = C.A t

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.h_X_ennr {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (t : ℂ) : ENNReal :=
  shiftWidthENNR (M.h_X t) (L.b_shift t).im

abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.T_norm {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  shiftedMeroTube L.r_star M.h_X L.b_shift

abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.𝔰 {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedLiftMap L.𝔰_raw L.b_shift

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.Θ_gl {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedGlancingTheta C L.b_shift

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.p_gl {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedGlancingOffset C L.b_shift

structure SpeedAndCollarPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    K.f s = 0 → deriv K.f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv K.f) s = 0
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (deriv K.f) s = q s * K.f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = K.Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s
  V_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (K.f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K.f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < L.r_star →
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (L.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

structure EntireTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  T_open : IsOpen L.T_norm
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < L.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ L.T_norm
  T_param_subset : L.T_norm ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y + x, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y, -t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ L.T_norm
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = L.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ L.T_norm

structure FiniteWallTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (H : ℝ) where
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  tube_eq : finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X = L.T_norm
  H_pos : 0 < H
  s_star_lt_H : L.s_star < H
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, L.s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < L.r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < ε → ε < L.s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = L.𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - L.s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = L.𝔰 p

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def shiftWidthENNR (w : ENNReal) (δ : ℝ) : ENNReal :=
  if w = ⊤ then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (w.toReal + δ)

def shiftedMeroTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ENNReal) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  meroTubeENNR r_star (fun t => shiftWidthENNR (h_X t) (b_shift t).im)

def shiftedLiftMap (𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  𝔰_raw (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingTheta {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingOffset {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingOffset C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

structure NonisotropicCurveData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  a : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  a_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ a (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  a_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a s ≠ 0
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv ϕ s = f s
  exp_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ s) = a s
  deriv_a : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv a s = Complex.I * f s * a s
  base_ϕ_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, ϕ s = C.ϕ_ℂ s ∧ f s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  a_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a (s + 2 * Real.pi) = a s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_base_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 1) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 0) s ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 1) s
  Γ_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) s = -C.c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) s = C.c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s
  Γ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i)
  Γ_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, Γ s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s
  Γ_slice_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), s ∉ M.E_disc → f s ≠ 0 → Γ s = M.Γ_slice s
  Γ_real_simple : ∀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ, Γ x₁ = Γ x₂ → ∃ k : ℤ, x₁ - x₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ z i
  s_init : ℝ
  r_init : ℝ
  s_init_pos : 0 < s_init
  s_init_le : s_init ≤ M.s_base / 2
  r_init_pos : 0 < r_init
  r_init_lt : r_init < s_init / 4
  r_init_le : r_init ≤ M.r_base / 2
  𝔰_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_init_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_init { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_init }
  𝔰_init_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (y, t) ∈ horizStrip M.s_base
  𝔰_init_ϕ : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    ϕ (𝔰_init (y, t)) = glancingMidAngle C y t
  𝔰_init_impact : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    glancingImpact C y t = Γ (𝔰_init (y, t))
  𝔰_init_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → 𝔰_init (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_init_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰_init (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_init_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init → 𝔰_init (y, -t) = 𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_init_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
    𝔰_init (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_init (y, t))

structure NormalizedGlobalLiftData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_raw_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  𝔰_raw_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_raw_init_eq : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < K.s_init → ‖t‖ < K.r_init →
    𝔰_raw (y, t) = K.𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_raw_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), 𝔰_raw (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_raw_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰_raw p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_raw_even : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰_raw p
  𝔰_raw_conj : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_raw p)
  𝔰_raw_comp_X : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, K.f (𝔰_raw p) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i) (Metric.ball p r)
  b_shift : ℂ → ℂ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  s_star_le : s_star ≤ K.s_init / 2
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  r_star_le : r_star ≤ K.r_init / 2
  b_shift_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b_shift (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base)
  b_shift_zero : b_shift 0 = 0
  b_shift_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base, b_shift (-t) = b_shift t
  b_shift_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base,
    b_shift (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (b_shift t)
  b_shift_small : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, ‖b_shift t‖ < s_star / 4
  T_norm_iff : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift ↔
    ‖p.2‖ < r_star ∧ (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift)
    (shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift)
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) =
      shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (p.1, -p.2) = shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p
  𝔰_conj : ∀ p ∈ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift,
    shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift p)
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (shiftedLiftMap 𝔰_raw b_shift (x, t) - x)) = 0
  zero_slice_nhd : ∀ y₀ ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ∃ δ_y δ_t : ℝ,
    0 < δ_y ∧ 0 < δ_t ∧ δ_t ≤ r_star ∧
    Metric.ball y₀ δ_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t ⊆ shiftedMeroTube r_star M.h_X b_shift
  Θ_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  p_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift)
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  symplectic_gl : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift (y', t)) y *
      deriv (fun t' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift (y, t')) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingOffset C b_shift (y, t')) t *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => shiftedGlancingTheta C b_shift (y', t)) y = C.A t

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.h_X_ennr {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (t : ℂ) : ENNReal :=
  shiftWidthENNR (M.h_X t) (L.b_shift t).im

abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.T_norm {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  shiftedMeroTube L.r_star M.h_X L.b_shift

abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.𝔰 {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedLiftMap L.𝔰_raw L.b_shift

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.Θ_gl {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedGlancingTheta C L.b_shift

noncomputable abbrev NormalizedGlobalLiftData.p_gl {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  shiftedGlancingOffset C L.b_shift

structure SpeedAndCollarPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    K.f s = 0 → deriv K.f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv K.f) s = 0
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (deriv K.f) s = q s * K.f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = K.Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s
  V_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (K.f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K.f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < L.r_star →
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (L.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

structure EntireTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  T_open : IsOpen L.T_norm
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < L.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ L.T_norm
  T_param_subset : L.T_norm ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y + x, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y, -t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ L.T_norm
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = L.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ L.T_norm

structure FiniteWallTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (H : ℝ) where
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  tube_eq : finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X = L.T_norm
  H_pos : 0 < H
  s_star_lt_H : L.s_star < H
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, L.s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < L.r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < ε → ε < L.s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = L.𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - L.s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = L.𝔰 p

by
  intro ε hε
  by_contra h_not
  have h_ex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ,
      max (10240000 * max hBudget.C_env 1) (2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40) ≤ K ∧
      ∃ j : ℝ,
        (j ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ∧
          K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S j) ∧
        ∀ k ∈ Set.Icc ((4 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((11 / 5 : ℝ) * K),
          ε ≤ lmRowModerateMeas S K k := by
    intro n
    let K₁ : ℝ := max (10240000 * max hBudget.C_env 1) (2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40)
    have hK₁_ge : hBudget.k₀ ≤ K₁ := by
      have hk₀ : 1 ≤ hBudget.k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have h_lin : hBudget.k₀ ≤ 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 := by linarith
      exact le_trans h_lin (le_max_right _ _)
    by_contra h_none
    apply h_not
    refine ⟨K₁, hK₁_ge, ?_⟩
    intro K hK ⟨j, hj_mem, hj_mom⟩
    by_contra hk_none
    apply h_none
    refine ⟨K, hK, j, ⟨hj_mem, hj_mom⟩, ?_⟩
    intro k hk_mem
    by_contra h_lt
    exact hk_none ⟨k, hk_mem, le_of_not_ge h_lt⟩
  choose K_seq hK_spec using h_ex
  choose j_seq hj_spec using fun n => (hK_spec n).2
  have hK_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto K_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop]
    intro b
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge b
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hN_le : (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
    have hk₀ : 1 ≤ hBudget.k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
    have h_rhs : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_spec n).1
    linarith
  have h_H_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have h_exp_k₀_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_exp_k₀_lt : Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) < S.H / 10 := hBudget.exp_neg_k₀_lt
  obtain ⟨L_star, hL_star, hL_excl⟩ :=
    hBudget.single_center_vanishing_exclusion
      (1 / 8 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) (Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  obtain ⟨k_seq, x_seq, C_cone, M_exhaust, hEnv, h_sel⟩ :=
    large_moment_normal_center_selection S hBudget ε L_star hε hL_star K_seq j_seq
      hK_tendsto (fun n => (hK_spec n).1) (fun n => (hj_spec n).1) (fun n => (hj_spec n).2)
  obtain ⟨ϕ, F, Q, hϕ_mono, _hF_holo, hQ_holo, hF_conv, hQ_conv, h_dichot⟩ :=
    rescaled_strip_montel_dichotomy S hBudget L_star C_cone M_exhaust k_seq x_seq
      hL_star hL_excl hEnv
  have hK_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => K_seq (ϕ n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    hK_tendsto.comp hϕ_mono.tendsto_atTop
  have h_sub_scales : ∀ n : ℕ,
      1 ≤ K_seq (ϕ n) ∧
      (17 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq (ϕ n) ≤ k_seq (ϕ n) ∧
      Real.exp (-k_seq (ϕ n)) < S.H / 10 ∧
      (K_seq (ϕ n)) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq (ϕ n)) := by
    intro n
    have hk₀ : 1 ≤ hBudget.k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
    have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ϕ n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have h_rhs : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (ϕ n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K_seq (ϕ n) :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_spec (ϕ n)).1
    have hK_ge_one : 1 ≤ K_seq (ϕ n) := by linarith
    have hk_ge_k₀ : hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq (ϕ n) := hEnv.k_ge_k₀ (ϕ n)
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-k_seq (ϕ n)) ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    exact ⟨hK_ge_one, (h_sel (ϕ n)).2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt h_exp_le h_exp_k₀_lt, (h_sel (ϕ n)).1⟩

      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq (ϕ n)) (k_seq (ϕ n)) (x_seq (ϕ n)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by

    exact div_pos hε (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ :=
    Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp h_tendsto_zero (ε / (4 * Real.pi)) h_pos)

    (h_sel (ϕ N)).2.2
  have h_lt : lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq (ϕ N)) (k_seq (ϕ N)) (x_seq (ϕ N)) < ε / (4 * Real.pi) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h_dist

def lmLowerHalfPlane : Set ℂ :=
  { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 }

def lmCompactRect (r : ℕ) : Set ℂ :=
  { Z : ℂ |
    Z.re ∈ Set.Icc (-((r : ℝ) + 2)) ((r : ℝ) + 2) ∧
    Z.im ∈ Set.Icc (-((r : ℝ) + 3)) (-(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2))) }

noncomputable def lmRescaledF (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.exp (-k) / rowMomentFull S k : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z)

noncomputable def lmRescaledQ (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.exp (-k) / rowMomentFull S k : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
    S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z)

noncomputable def lmRowModerateMeas (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.real
    {x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) |
      Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ∧
      ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}

noncomputable def lmBoxModerateFraction (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real
    {p : ℝ × ℝ |
      p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧
      Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
        ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
      ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
        Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}

structure NormalizedCenterEnvelope (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (L_star C_cone : ℝ)
    (M_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ) (k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  C_cone_pos : 0 < C_cone
  M_exhaust_pos : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < M_exhaust r
  k_ge_k₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq n
  k_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  moment_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  normal_level : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
    rowMomentFull S l ≤
      rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k_seq n|)
  cone_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
    Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
    wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8 →
    |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
      C_cone * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  compact_exhaust_bound : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, r ≤ n → ∀ Z ∈ lmCompactRect r,
    (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
    ‖lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖lmRescaledQ S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖ ≤ M_exhaust r

subgoal_signatures.name: rescaled_strip_montel_dichotomy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (L_star C_cone : ℝ)
    (M_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ) (k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hL_star : 0 < L_star)
    (hL_excl : ∀ k_seq' x_seq' : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ → 0 < C₁ →
      (∀ n : ℕ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq' n) →
      Filter.Tendsto k_seq' Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
        rowMomentFull S l ≤
          C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k_seq' n|)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
        Real.exp (-k_seq' n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
        wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8 →
        |s.re - x_seq' n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
        (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
          C₁ * (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) →
      ¬ (TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
          (fun n Z =>
            ((Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              S.f ((x_seq' n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) : ℂ) * Z))
          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
          (fun n Z =>
            ((Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
              S.q ((x_seq' n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) : ℂ) * Z))
          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 }))
    (hEnv : NormalizedCenterEnvelope S hBudget L_star C_cone M_exhaust k_seq x_seq) :
    ∃ (ϕ : ℕ → ℕ) (F Q : ℂ → ℂ),
      StrictMono ϕ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Q lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun n Z => lmRescaledF S (k_seq (ϕ n)) (x_seq (ϕ n)) Z)
        F Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun n Z => lmRescaledQ S (k_seq (ϕ n)) (x_seq (ϕ n)) Z)
        Q Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      ((∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
          {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0}.Finite) ∨

            ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = 0}.Finite ∧

            (∃ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im ≠ 0) →
            {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = 0}.Finite))

small_moment_row_sign_test.definitions:
noncomputable def stripSymDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - |z.im|

noncomputable def localAmp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (‖S.f z‖ + stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖)

noncomputable def truncLogSpeed (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ε)

noncomputable def tileCurvBound (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + sSup ((fun z : ℂ => stripSymDepth S z * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖) ''
    Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 2))

noncomputable def stripExitKernel (H_p y₀ u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * H_p)⁻¹ *
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) * Real.cos (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p))) /
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2)

noncomputable def rowOccupDensity (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ε h₀ x v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if |truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)| ≤ h₀ then
    ∫ s in (2 : ℝ)..(4 : ℝ),
      ∫ u : ℝ,
        min ((truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
          truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2) (h₀ ^ 2) *
        stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u
  else 0

def DiscreteTanakaProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℕ) (h R : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
    0 < h → h < R →
    (∀ m ≤ M, Continuous (g m)) →
    (∀ m ≤ M, Function.Periodic (g m) (2 * Real.pi)) →
    (∀ m < M, Continuous (κ m)) →
    (∀ m < M, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ m u) →
    (∀ m < M, MeasureTheory.Integrable (κ m) MeasureTheory.volume) →
    (∀ m < M, (∫ u : ℝ, κ m u) = 1) →
    (∀ m < M, ∀ x : ℝ, g m x ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, g (m + 1) (x + u) * κ m u) →
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (if |g m x| ≤ h then
          ∫ u : ℝ, min ((g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2) (h ^ 2) * κ m u
        else 0)) ≤
      25 * h * (h + 2 * R + 2 * Real.sqrt
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u))) +
      (M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 *
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u)) /
        (R - h) ^ 2

structure StripExitKernelData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  kernel_cont : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    Continuous (stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d))
  kernel_pos : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u
  kernel_integrable : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d)) MeasureTheory.volume
  kernel_integral_one : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    (∫ u : ℝ, stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u) = 1
  kernel_tail_le : ∀ d d' R : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H → 0 < R →
    (∫ u in {u : ℝ | R * d < |u|}, stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u) ≤ 1 / R
  kernel_core_ge : ∀ d s u : ℝ, 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    s ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) (4 : ℝ) → |u| ≤ 2 * d →
    (120 * d)⁻¹ ≤ stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-s) * d) (S.H - d) u
  trunc_submean : ∀ ε v v' x : ℝ, 0 < ε → v < v' → Real.exp (-v) < S.H →
    truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x) ≤
      ∫ u : ℝ, truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v' (x + u)) *
        stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-v')) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u

structure AmplitudeDeficitData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) where
  C_amp : ℝ
  C_glob : ℝ
  K_amp : ℝ
  one_le_C_amp : 1 ≤ C_amp
  one_le_C_glob : 1 ≤ C_glob
  K_amp_ge : max hBudget.k₀ 200 ≤ K_amp
  tile_amp_osc : ∀ x d : ℝ, 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (3 * d / 8),
      |localAmp S z - localAmp S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)| ≤
        C_amp * tileCurvBound S x d
  disk_raw_and_trunc_l2 : ∀ x d r ε : ℝ,
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → d / 16 ≤ r → r ≤ d / 8 → 0 < ε →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 2),
      Real.log ε ≤ localAmp S z) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun ζ : ℂ => (localAmp S ζ - Real.log ‖S.f ζ‖) ^ 2)
      (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun ζ : ℂ => (localAmp S ζ - truncLogSpeed S ε ζ) ^ 2)
      (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ *
      (∫ ζ in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r,
        (localAmp S ζ - Real.log ‖S.f ζ‖) ^ 2) ≤
      C_amp * (tileCurvBound S x d) ^ 2 ∧
    (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ *
      (∫ ζ in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r,
        (localAmp S ζ - truncLogSpeed S ε ζ) ^ 2) ≤
      C_amp * (tileCurvBound S x d) ^ 2
  global_amp_poly_bound : ∀ K : ℝ, K_amp ≤ K →
    ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) →
      |localAmp S z| ≤ C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ)
  small_moment_row_l2 : ∀ K : ℝ, K_amp ≤ K →
    (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
      rowMomentFull S v ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc K (2 * K),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (tileCurvBound S x (Real.exp (-w))) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w x) -
          truncLogSpeed S (Real.exp (-C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K))
            (upperRowPt S w x)) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileCurvBound S x (Real.exp (-w))) ^ 2) ≤
        C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w x) -
            truncLogSpeed S (Real.exp (-C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K))
              (upperRowPt S w x)) ^ 2) ≤
        C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)

noncomputable def AmplitudeDeficitData.epsK {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    {hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S} (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget) (K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-A.C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K)

def SmallMomentOccupationBound (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    {hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S} (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget) : Prop :=
  ∃ C_occ K_occ : ℝ, 0 < C_occ ∧ A.K_amp ≤ K_occ ∧
    ∀ K : ℝ, K_occ ≤ K →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
        rowMomentFull S v ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K))
        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ p in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
        rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2) ≤
        C_occ * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ)

        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K))

      (∫ p in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
        rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2) ≤

by
  
  have h_quad_taylor : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (_hU : IsOpen U) (f q : ℂ → ℂ)
      (_hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
      (_hq : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) w = q w * f w)
      (z₀ : ℂ) (ρ M_q M_f : ℝ) (_hMq : 0 ≤ M_q) (_hMf : 0 ≤ M_f)
      (_hsub : Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ U)
      (_hq_b : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, ‖q w‖ ≤ M_q)
      (_hf_b : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, ‖f w‖ ≤ M_f)
      (z : ℂ) (_hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ),
      ‖f z - (f z₀ + deriv f z₀ * (z - z₀))‖ ≤ M_q * M_f * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro U hU f q hf hq z₀ ρ M_q M_f hMq hMf hsub hq_b hf_b z hz
    set r_z : ℝ := ‖z - z₀‖
    have hr_z_nonneg : 0 ≤ r_z := norm_nonneg _
    have hr_z_le : r_z ≤ ρ := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, r_z] using hz
    have hsub_z : Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z ⊆ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hr_z_le
    have hdf : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv f) U := hf.deriv hU
    let A : ℂ := deriv f z₀
    let R₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => deriv f w - A
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_z_nonneg
    have hR₁_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z, ‖R₁ w‖ ≤ M_q * M_f * r_z := by
      intro w hw
      have hR₁_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z,
          HasDerivWithinAt R₁ (q u * f u) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z) u := by
        intro u hu
        have huU : u ∈ U := hsub (hsub_z hu)
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt (deriv f) (q u * f u) u := by
          rw [← hq u huU]
          exact (hdf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds huU)).hasDerivAt
        exact (hd2.sub_const A).hasDerivWithinAt
      have hqf_bound : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z, ‖q u * f u‖ ≤ M_q * M_f := by
        intro u hu
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hq_b u (hsub_z hu)) (hf_b u (hsub_z hu)) (norm_nonneg _) hMq
      have h_mvt₁ := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        hR₁_deriv hqf_bound (convex_closedBall z₀ r_z) hz₀_mem hw
      have hR₁_z₀ : R₁ z₀ = 0 := sub_self A
      rw [hR₁_z₀, sub_zero] at h_mvt₁
      have hw_le : ‖w - z₀‖ ≤ r_z := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      exact le_trans h_mvt₁ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_le (mul_nonneg hMq hMf))
    let R : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => f w - (f z₀ + A * (w - z₀))
    have hR_deriv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z,
        HasDerivWithinAt R (R₁ w) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hwU : w ∈ U := hsub (hsub_z hw)
      have hdf_w : HasDerivAt f (deriv f w) w :=
        (hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hwU)).hasDerivAt
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => f z₀ + A * (u - z₀)) A w := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => A * (u - z₀)) (A * 1) w :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id w).sub_const z₀).const_mul A

        exact h1.const_add (f z₀)
      exact (hdf_w.sub hlin).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r_z := by
      simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, r_z]
    have h_mvt₂ := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      hR_deriv hR₁_bound (convex_closedBall z₀ r_z) hz₀_mem hz_mem
    have hR_z₀ : R z₀ = 0 := by simp [R]
    rw [hR_z₀, sub_zero] at h_mvt₂
    calc ‖f z - (f z₀ + deriv f z₀ * (z - z₀))‖

          linarith
      have him_diff : |z₁.1.im - z₂.1.im| < r / 2 := by
        have h1_lo : (⌊2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r⌋ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r := Int.floor_le _
        have h1_hi : 2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r < (⌊2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r⌋ : ℝ) + 1 :=
          Int.lt_floor_add_one _
        have h2_lo : (⌊2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r⌋ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (z₂.1.im - c) / r := by
          rw [hy_int]; exact Int.floor_le _
        have h2_hi : 2 * (z₂.1.im - c) / r < (⌊2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := by
          rw [hy_int]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
        have hd_lt : 2 * (z₁.1.im - z₂.1.im) / r < 1 := by
          have : 2 * (z₁.1.im - z₂.1.im) / r =
              2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r - 2 * (z₂.1.im - c) / r := by ring
          linarith
        have hd_gt : -1 < 2 * (z₁.1.im - z₂.1.im) / r := by
          have : 2 * (z₁.1.im - z₂.1.im) / r =
              2 * (z₁.1.im - c) / r - 2 * (z₂.1.im - c) / r := by ring
          linarith
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor
        · have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hd_gt hr
          field_simp [hr.ne'] at this ⊢
          linarith
        · have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hd_lt hr
          field_simp [hr.ne'] at this ⊢
          linarith
      have hnorm_lt : ‖z₁.1 - z₂.1‖ < r := by
        have h_le := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (z₁.1 - z₂.1)
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at h_le
        linarith
      by_contra h_ne
      have h_ne_val : z₁.1 ≠ z₂.1 := fun h => h_ne (Subtype.ext h)
      have hz₁_mem : z₁.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall z₂.1 r := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        exact hnorm_lt.le
      exact h_sep z₂.1 z₂.2 z₁.1 hz₁_mem h_ne_val z₁.2.2.2.2.2
    haveI : Finite Z := Finite.of_injective gridMap hg_inj
    have hZ_fin : Z.Finite := Set.toFinite Z
    let F : Finset ℂ := hZ_fin.toFinset
    refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      exact hZ_fin.mem_toFinset
    · let gridMapF : F → Fin Nx × Fin Ny :=
        fun z => gridMap ⟨z.1, hZ_fin.mem_toFinset.mp z.2⟩
      have hgF_inj : Function.Injective gridMapF := by
        intro z₁ z₂ h_eq
        have h_sub := hg_inj h_eq
        have h_val : z₁.1 = z₂.1 := congrArg (fun u : Z => u.1) h_sub
        exact Subtype.ext h_val
      have hcard_nat : F.card ≤ Nx * Ny := by
        have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective gridMapF hgF_inj
        simpa [Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] using h
      have hNx_le : (Nx : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (b - a) / r + 1 := by
        have h1 : ((Mx.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) = (Mx : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hMx_nonneg
        have h2 : (Mx : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (b - a) / r := Int.floor_le _
        have h3 : (Nx : ℝ) = (Mx.toNat : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [Nx]; push_cast; ring
        have h4 : (Mx.toNat : ℝ) = ((Mx.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
        linarith
      have hNy_le : (Ny : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (e - c) / r + 1 := by
        have h1 : ((My.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) = (My : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Int.toNat_of_nonneg hMy_nonneg
        have h2 : (My : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (e - c) / r := Int.floor_le _
        have h3 : (Ny : ℝ) = (My.toNat : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [Ny]; push_cast; ring
        have h4 : (My.toNat : ℝ) = ((My.toNat : ℤ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; rfl
        linarith
      calc (F.card : ℝ)
          ≤ ((Nx * Ny : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard_nat
        _ = (Nx : ℝ) * (Ny : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
        _ ≤ (2 * (b - a) / r + 1) * (2 * (e - c) / r + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul hNx_le hNy_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
              (by have : 0 ≤ 2 * (b - a) / r := div_nonneg (by linarith) hr.le; linarith)

  
  have h_s3 : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (_hU : IsOpen U) (f q : ℂ → ℂ)
      (_hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
      (_hq : ∀ w ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) w = q w * f w)
      (ζ : ℂ) (r_exc M_q : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r_exc) (_hMq : 0 ≤ M_q)
      (_hsub : Metric.closedBall ζ r_exc ⊆ U)
      (_hq_b : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ r_exc, ‖q w‖ ≤ M_q)
      (_hsmall : M_q * r_exc ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 12)
      (_hnz : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball ζ r_exc, f w ≠ 0),
      ‖deriv f ζ‖ ≤ (2 / r_exc) * ‖f ζ‖ := by
    intro U hU f q hf hq ζ r_exc M_q hr hMq hsub hq_b hsmall hnz
    have hfζ_ne : f ζ ≠ 0 := hnz ζ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
    have hfζ_pos : 0 < ‖f ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfζ_ne
    by_contra h_gt
    push_neg at h_gt
    let lam : ℂ := deriv f ζ / f ζ
    have hlam_mul : lam * f ζ = deriv f ζ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfζ_ne
    have hlam_norm : ‖lam‖ = ‖deriv f ζ‖ / ‖f ζ‖ := norm_div _ _
    have hlam_gt : 2 / r_exc < ‖lam‖ := by
      rw [hlam_norm, lt_div_iff₀ hfζ_pos]
      exact h_gt
    have hlam_pos : 0 < ‖lam‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) hlam_gt
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp hlam_pos.ne'
    let ρ : ℝ := 2 / ‖lam‖
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := div_pos zero_lt_two hlam_pos
    have hρ_lt : ρ < r_exc := by
      dsimp [ρ]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hlam_pos]
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlam_gt hr
      field_simp [hr.ne'] at this
      linarith
    have hρ_ball : Metric.closedBall ζ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball ζ r_exc :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hρ_lt
    have hρ_cb : Metric.closedBall ζ ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall ζ r_exc :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ_lt.le
    have hρ_U : Metric.closedBall ζ ρ ⊆ U := Set.Subset.trans hρ_cb hsub
    have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall ζ ρ) := isCompact_closedBall ζ ρ
    have h_nonemp : (Metric.closedBall ζ ρ).Nonempty := Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hρ_pos.le
    have hf_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => ‖f w‖) (Metric.closedBall ζ ρ) :=
      continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hρ_U)
    obtain ⟨w_star, hw_star_mem, hw_star_max⟩ := h_comp.exists_isMaxOn h_nonemp hf_cont
    set M : ℝ := ‖f w_star‖
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := norm_nonneg _
    have hf_le_M : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ, ‖f w‖ ≤ M :=
      fun w hw => isMaxOn_iff.mp hw_star_max w hw
    have hqb_ρ : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ, ‖q w‖ ≤ M_q :=
      fun w hw => hq_b w (hρ_cb hw)
    have hMq_ρ : M_q * ρ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 12 := by
      have hsq : ρ ^ 2 ≤ r_exc ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hρ_pos.le hρ_lt.le 2
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hMq) hsmall
    have h_rem_twelfth : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ,
        ‖f w - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w - ζ))‖ ≤ (1 / 12) * M := by
      intro w hw
      have ht := h_quad_taylor U hU f q hf hq ζ ρ M_q M hMq hM_nonneg hρ_U hqb_ρ hf_le_M w hw
      have hw_le : ‖w - ζ‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have hsq : ‖w - ζ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw_le 2
      calc ‖f w - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w - ζ))‖
          ≤ M_q * M * ‖w - ζ‖ ^ 2 := ht
        _ ≤ M_q * M * ρ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (mul_nonneg hMq hM_nonneg)
        _ = (M_q * ρ ^ 2) * M := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 12) * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMq_ρ hM_nonneg
    have hM_bound : M ≤ (36 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by
      have h1 : M ≤ ‖f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)‖ +
          ‖f w_star - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ))‖ := by
        dsimp [M]
        calc ‖f w_star‖
            = ‖(f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)) +
                (f w_star - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)))‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)‖ +
              ‖f w_star - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ))‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have hw_star_le : ‖w_star - ζ‖ ≤ ρ := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw_star_mem
      have hdfζ_pos : 0 < ‖deriv f ζ‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) h_gt
      have h_df_ρ : ‖deriv f ζ‖ * ρ = 2 * ‖f ζ‖ := by
        dsimp [ρ]
        rw [hlam_norm]
        field_simp [hfζ_pos.ne', hlam_pos.ne', hdfζ_pos.ne']
      have h2 : ‖f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)‖ ≤ 3 * ‖f ζ‖ := by
        calc ‖f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)‖
            ≤ ‖f ζ‖ + ‖deriv f ζ * (w_star - ζ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖f ζ‖ + ‖deriv f ζ‖ * ‖w_star - ζ‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ ‖f ζ‖ + ‖deriv f ζ‖ * ρ := by
              linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_star_le (norm_nonneg (deriv f ζ))]
          _ = 3 * ‖f ζ‖ := by linarith
      have h3 := h_rem_twelfth w_star hw_star_mem
      linarith
    let w₀ : ℂ := ζ - lam⁻¹
    let r₀ : ℝ := 1 / ‖lam‖
    have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := div_pos one_pos hlam_pos
    have h_lin_id : ∀ w : ℂ, f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w - ζ) = f ζ * lam * (w - w₀) := by
      intro w
      rw [← hlam_mul]
      dsimp [w₀]
      calc f ζ + lam * f ζ * (w - ζ)
          = f ζ * (1 - lam * lam⁻¹) + f ζ * lam * (w - (ζ - lam⁻¹)) := by ring
        _ = f ζ * 0 + f ζ * lam * (w - (ζ - lam⁻¹)) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne, sub_self]
        _ = f ζ * lam * (w - (ζ - lam⁻¹)) := by ring
    have h_rem_3_11 : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ,
        ‖f w - f ζ * lam * (w - w₀)‖ ≤ (3 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← h_lin_id w]
      calc ‖f w - (f ζ + deriv f ζ * (w - ζ))‖
          ≤ (1 / 12) * M := h_rem_twelfth w hw
        _ ≤ (1 / 12) * ((36 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖) := by linarith
        _ = (3 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by ring
    have hw₀_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall w₀ r₀ ⊆ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw ⊢
      have hw₀_dist : ‖w₀ - ζ‖ = r₀ := by
        dsimp [w₀, r₀]
        simp [sub_eq_add_neg, one_div]
      calc ‖w - ζ‖
          = ‖(w - w₀) + (w₀ - ζ)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖w - w₀‖ + ‖w₀ - ζ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ r₀ + r₀ := by linarith
        _ = ρ := by dsimp [r₀, ρ]; ring
    have hw₀_mem_ρ : w₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ :=
      hw₀_cb_sub (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr₀_pos.le)
    have hfw₀_upper : ‖f w₀‖ ≤ (3 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by
      have h := h_rem_3_11 w₀ hw₀_mem_ρ
      simpa using h
    have hfw₀_ne : f w₀ ≠ 0 := hnz w₀ (hρ_ball hw₀_mem_ρ)
    have hfw₀_pos : 0 < ‖f w₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfw₀_ne
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (f z)⁻¹
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball ζ r_exc) := by
      intro z hz
      have hzU : z ∈ U := hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz)
      exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzU)).inv (hnz z hz)).differentiableWithinAt
    have hg_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Metric.ball w₀ r₀) :=
      hg_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (Set.Subset.trans hw₀_cb_sub hρ_ball)
    have hg_front : ∀ w ∈ frontier (Metric.ball w₀ r₀), ‖g w‖ ≤ (11 / 8) / ‖f ζ‖ := by
      intro w hw
      rw [frontier_ball w₀ hr₀_pos.ne'] at hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - w₀‖ = r₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have hw_mem_ρ : w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ ρ :=
        hw₀_cb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
      have h_lin_norm : ‖f ζ * lam * (w - w₀)‖ = ‖f ζ‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hw_dist]
        dsimp [r₀]
        field_simp [hlam_pos.ne']
      have h_rem := h_rem_3_11 w hw_mem_ρ
      have h_tri : ‖f ζ * lam * (w - w₀)‖ ≤ ‖f w‖ + ‖f w - f ζ * lam * (w - w₀)‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le (f w) (f w - f ζ * lam * (w - w₀))
        simpa [sub_sub_cancel] using this
      have hfw_lower : (8 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ ≤ ‖f w‖ := by linarith
      have h8_pos : 0 < (8 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by positivity
      dsimp [g]
      rw [norm_inv]
      calc (‖f w‖)⁻¹
          ≤ ((8 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ h8_pos hfw_lower
        _ = (11 / 8) / ‖f ζ‖ := by ring
    have hw₀_cl : w₀ ∈ closure (Metric.ball w₀ r₀) :=
      subset_closure (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos)
    have hgw₀_le : ‖g w₀‖ ≤ (11 / 8) / ‖f ζ‖ :=
      Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
        Metric.isBounded_ball hg_dc hg_front hw₀_cl
    dsimp [g] at hgw₀_le
    rw [norm_inv, inv_le_comm₀ hfw₀_pos (by positivity)] at hgw₀_le
    have hfw₀_lower : (8 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ ≤ ‖f w₀‖ := by
      have : ((11 / 8) / ‖f ζ‖)⁻¹ = (8 / 11) * ‖f ζ‖ := by field_simp [hfζ_pos.ne']
      linarith
    linarith

  
  have h_s4 : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (_hU : IsOpen U) (f : ℂ → ℂ)
      (_hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
      (z₀ : ℂ) (R B : ℝ) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (_hB : 0 ≤ B)
      (_hsub : Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ U)
      (_hderiv : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R, ‖deriv f z‖ ≤ B * ‖f z‖)
      (ζ : ℂ) (_hζ : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R),
      Real.exp (-B * R) * ‖f z₀‖ ≤ ‖f ζ‖ ∧ ‖f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (B * R) * ‖f z₀‖ := by
    intro U hU f hf z₀ R B hR hB hsub hderiv ζ hζ
    have h_seg : ∀ w₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R, ∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
        ‖f w₁‖ ≤ Real.exp (B * ‖w₁ - w₀‖) * ‖f w₀‖ := by
      intro w₀ hw₀ w₁ hw₁
      set L : ℝ := B * ‖w₁ - w₀‖
      have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L := mul_nonneg hB (norm_nonneg _)
      let γ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => w₀ + z * (w₁ - w₀)
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => γ_ℂ (t : ℂ)
      have hγ_mem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ t ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R := by
        intro t ht
        have h_conv : γ t = (1 - t) • w₀ + t • w₁ := by
          dsimp [γ, γ_ℂ]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_conv]
        exact convex_closedBall z₀ R hw₀ hw₁ (by linarith [ht.2]) ht.1 (by ring)
      let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
        Real.exp (-2 * L * t) * ((f (γ t)).re ^ 2 + (f (γ t)).im ^ 2)
      let φ' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
        Real.exp (-2 * L * t) * (-2 * L) * ((f (γ t)).re ^ 2 + (f (γ t)).im ^ 2) +
        Real.exp (-2 * L * t) *
          (2 * (f (γ t)).re * (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).re +
           2 * (f (γ t)).im * (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).im)
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt φ (φ' t) t := by
        intro t ht
        have hγU : γ t ∈ U := hsub (hγ_mem t ht)
        have hf_at : HasDerivAt f (deriv f (γ t)) (γ t) :=
          (hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hγU)).hasDerivAt
        have hγ_at : HasDerivAt γ_ℂ (w₁ - w₀) (t : ℂ) := by
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z * (w₁ - w₀)) (1 * (w₁ - w₀)) (t : ℂ) :=
            (hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul_const (w₁ - w₀)
          rw [one_mul] at h1
          exact h1.const_add w₀
        have hcomp_ℂ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => f (γ_ℂ z))
            (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)) (t : ℂ) :=
          hf_at.comp (t : ℂ) hγ_at
        have hre : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (γ s)).re)
            (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).re t :=
          hcomp_ℂ.real_of_complex
        have him : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (γ s)).im)
            (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).im t := by
          have h_negI := (hcomp_ℂ.const_mul (-Complex.I)).real_of_complex
          have h_eq_fn : (fun s : ℝ => ((-Complex.I) * f (γ s)).re) =
              (fun s : ℝ => (f (γ s)).im) := by
            ext s; simp [Complex.mul_re]
          have h_eq_val : ((-Complex.I) * (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀))).re =
              (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).im := by
            simp [Complex.mul_re]
          rwa [h_eq_fn, h_eq_val] at h_negI
        have hsq_re : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (γ s)).re ^ 2)
            (2 * (f (γ t)).re * (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).re) t := by
          convert hre.pow 2 using 1
          push_cast; ring
        have hsq_im : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (γ s)).im ^ 2)
            (2 * (f (γ t)).im * (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).im) t := by
          convert him.pow 2 using 1
          push_cast; ring
        have hexp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * L * s))
            (Real.exp (-2 * L * t) * (-2 * L)) t := by
          have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -2 * L * s) (-2 * L) t := by
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (-2 * L)
          exact Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-2 * L * t) |>.comp t hlin
        exact hexp.mul (hsq_re.add hsq_im)
      have hφ'_nonpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, φ' t ≤ 0 := by
        intro t ht
        set a_r : ℝ := (f (γ t)).re
        set b_r : ℝ := (f (γ t)).im
        set c_r : ℝ := (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).re
        set d_r : ℝ := (deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)).im
        have hab_norm : a_r ^ 2 + b_r ^ 2 = ‖f (γ t)‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
          dsimp [a_r, b_r]; ring
        have hcd_norm : c_r ^ 2 + d_r ^ 2 = ‖deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
          dsimp [c_r, d_r]; ring
        have hcd_le : c_r ^ 2 + d_r ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * (a_r ^ 2 + b_r ^ 2) := by
          rw [hcd_norm, hab_norm]
          have h1 : ‖deriv f (γ t) * (w₁ - w₀)‖ ≤ L * ‖f (γ t)‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul]
            calc ‖deriv f (γ t)‖ * ‖w₁ - w₀‖
                ≤ (B * ‖f (γ t)‖) * ‖w₁ - w₀‖ :=
