    let A_bad : Set ℝ :=
      {x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) | ¬ HasRobustSignDisk S K k x}
    let A_mod : Set ℝ :=
      {x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) |
        Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ∧
        ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}
    let E_shadow : Set ℝ :=
      ⋃ z ∈ F_zeros, Set.Icc (z.re - 2 * r_exc) (z.re + 2 * r_exc)

    have h_subset : A_bad ⊆ A_mod ∪ E_shadow := by
      intro x hx_bad
      by_contra hx_not_union
      have hx_not_mod : x ∉ A_mod := fun hm => hx_not_union (Or.inl hm)
      have hx_not_sh : x ∉ E_shadow := fun hs => hx_not_union (Or.inr hs)
      obtain ⟨hx_Icc, h_not_rob⟩ := hx_bad
      let z_plus : ℂ := upperRowPt S k x
      let z_minus : ℂ := lowerRowPt S k x
      have hz_plus_re : z_plus.re = x := by
        dsimp [z_plus, upperRowPt]
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      have hz_plus_im : z_plus.im = S.H - d := by
        dsimp [z_plus, upperRowPt, d]
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      have h_upper_ball_props : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob),
          ζ ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧ ‖deriv S.f ζ‖ ≤ (2 / r_exc) * ‖S.f ζ‖ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_dist : ‖ζ - z_plus‖ ≤ 3 * r_rob := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, r_rob] using hζ
        have hw_in_rect : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ r_exc,
            -1 ≤ w.re ∧ w.re ≤ 2 * Real.pi + 1 ∧
            S.H - (3 / 2) * d ≤ w.im ∧ w.im ≤ S.H - (1 / 2) * d ∧
            |w.re - x| ≤ 2 * r_exc := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_dist : ‖w - ζ‖ ≤ r_exc := by
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
          have hw_zplus : ‖w - z_plus‖ ≤ r_exc + 3 * r_rob := by
            calc ‖w - z_plus‖ = ‖(w - ζ) + (ζ - z_plus)‖ := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ ‖w - ζ‖ + ‖ζ - z_plus‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ r_exc + 3 * r_rob := by linarith
          have hre_abs : |w.re - x| ≤ r_exc + 3 * r_rob := by
            have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - z_plus)
            simpa [Complex.sub_re, hz_plus_re] using le_trans this hw_zplus
          have him_abs : |w.im - (S.H - d)| ≤ r_exc + 3 * r_rob := by
            have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - z_plus)
            simpa [Complex.sub_im, hz_plus_im] using le_trans this hw_zplus
          have hre_bounds := abs_le.mp hre_abs
          have him_bounds := abs_le.mp him_abs
          refine ⟨by linarith [hx_Icc.1], by linarith [hx_Icc.2],
            by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hw_col : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ r_exc,
            w ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧ ‖S.q w‖ ≤ M_q := by
          intro w hw
          obtain ⟨_, _, him_lo, him_hi, _⟩ := hw_in_rect w hw
          exact h_collar w (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hζ_strip : ζ ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
          (hw_col ζ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_exc_pos.le)).1
        have hnz_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball ζ r_exc, S.f w ≠ 0 := by
          intro w hw hfw_zero
          obtain ⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, him_hi, hre_x⟩ :=
            hw_in_rect w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)
          have hw_F : w ∈ F_zeros :=
            (hF_mem w).mpr ⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, him_hi, hfw_zero⟩
          have hre_x_b := abs_le.mp hre_x
          have hx_sh : x ∈ E_shadow :=
            Set.mem_biUnion hw_F ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          exact hx_not_sh hx_sh
        have hMq_rexc : M_q * r_exc ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 12 := by
          have h_eq : M_q * r_exc ^ 2 =
              1296 * C_env ^ 2 * (K ^ 4 * Real.exp (-h₁ / 5)) := by
            dsimp [M_q, r_exc]
            have hexp_sq : (Real.exp (-h₁ / 10)) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-h₁ / 5) := by
              rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
            rw [mul_pow, hexp_sq]
            field_simp [hd_pos.ne']
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_asymp_A
        refine ⟨hζ_strip, h_s3 (horizStrip S.H) hU_open S.f S.q S.f_holo S.deriv2_f
          ζ r_exc M_q hr_exc_pos hMq_nonneg
          (fun w hw => (hw_col w hw).1) (fun w hw => (hw_col w hw).2)
          hMq_rexc hnz_ball⟩
      have h_osc : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob),
          Real.exp (-h₁) * ‖S.f z_plus‖ ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖ ∧
          ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp h₁ * ‖S.f z_plus‖ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have h_raw := h_s4 (horizStrip S.H) hU_open S.f S.f_holo
          z_plus (3 * r_rob) (2 / r_exc) (by positivity) (by positivity)
          (fun w hw => (h_upper_ball_props w hw).1)
          (fun w hw => (h_upper_ball_props w hw).2) ζ hζ
        have hBR_le : (2 / r_exc) * (3 * r_rob) ≤ h₁ := by
          have h1 : (2 / r_exc) * (3 * r_rob) = 6 * Real.exp (-3 * h₁ / 20) := by
            rw [hr_rob_eq]
            field_simp [hr_exc_pos.ne']; ring
          linarith
        constructor
        · exact le_trans
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (norm_nonneg _))
            h_raw.1
        · exact le_trans h_raw.2
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hBR_le) (norm_nonneg _))
      have h2h1_eq : K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ) = 2 * h₁ := by
        dsimp [h₁, signTestH1]; ring
      have h_ext : ‖S.f z_plus‖ < Real.exp (-2 * h₁) ∨ Real.exp (2 * h₁) < ‖S.f z_plus‖ := by
        by_contra h_mid
        push_neg at h_mid
        apply hx_not_mod
        refine ⟨hx_Icc, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h2h1_eq, show -(2 * h₁) = -2 * h₁ by ring]
          exact h_mid.1
        · rw [h2h1_eq]
          exact h_mid.2
      have h_upper_rob :
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob), ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-h₁)) ∨
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob), Real.exp h₁ ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖) := by
        rcases h_ext with h_small_f | h_large_f
        · left
          intro ζ hζ
          calc ‖S.f ζ‖
              ≤ Real.exp h₁ * ‖S.f z_plus‖ := (h_osc ζ hζ).2
            _ ≤ Real.exp h₁ * Real.exp (-2 * h₁) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_small_f.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = Real.exp (-h₁) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        · right
          intro ζ hζ
          calc Real.exp h₁
              = Real.exp (-h₁) * Real.exp (2 * h₁) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-h₁) * ‖S.f z_plus‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_large_f.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖ := (h_osc ζ hζ).1
      
      have h_conj_center : starRingEnd ℂ z_minus = z_plus := by
        dsimp [z_minus, z_plus, lowerRowPt, upperRowPt]
        simp only [map_sub, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
        ring
      have h_lower_transfer : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_minus (3 * r_rob),
          starRingEnd ℂ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob) ∧
          ‖S.f ζ‖ = ‖S.f (starRingEnd ℂ ζ)‖ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have h_c_mem : starRingEnd ℂ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_plus (3 * r_rob) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hζ ⊢
          rw [← h_conj_center, ← map_sub, Complex.norm_conj]
          exact hζ
        have h_c_strip : starRingEnd ℂ ζ ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
          (h_upper_ball_props (starRingEnd ℂ ζ) h_c_mem).1
        have hζ_strip : ζ ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          dsimp [horizStrip] at h_c_strip ⊢
          simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using h_c_strip
        have h_norm_eq : ‖S.f ζ‖ = ‖S.f (starRingEnd ℂ ζ)‖ := by
          rw [S.f_conj ζ hζ_strip, Complex.norm_conj]
        exact ⟨h_c_mem, h_norm_eq⟩
      have h_lower_rob :
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_minus (3 * r_rob), ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-h₁)) ∨
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z_minus (3 * r_rob), Real.exp h₁ ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖) := by
        rcases h_upper_rob with h_up_lo | h_up_hi
        · left
          intro ζ hζ
          obtain ⟨hc_mem, h_eq⟩ := h_lower_transfer ζ hζ
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_up_lo _ hc_mem
        · right
          intro ζ hζ
          obtain ⟨hc_mem, h_eq⟩ := h_lower_transfer ζ hζ
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_up_hi _ hc_mem
      exact h_not_rob ⟨h_upper_rob, h_lower_rob⟩

    
    have h_vol_mod_lt : MeasureTheory.volume A_mod < ⊤ := by
      have hsub_Icc : A_mod ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := fun _ hx => hx.1
      calc MeasureTheory.volume A_mod
          ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub_Icc
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi - 0) := Real.volume_Icc
        _ < ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    have h_vol_sh_lt : MeasureTheory.volume E_shadow < ⊤ := by
      refine MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_lt_top F_zeros.finite_toSet ?_
      intro z _
      rw [Real.volume_Icc]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    have h_vol_union_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume (A_mod ∪ E_shadow) ≠ ⊤ :=
      (MeasureTheory.measure_union_lt_top h_vol_mod_lt h_vol_sh_lt).ne
    have h_sh_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real E_shadow ≤ δ := by
      calc MeasureTheory.volume.real E_shadow
          ≤ ∑ z ∈ F_zeros,
              MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (z.re - 2 * r_exc) (z.re + 2 * r_exc)) :=
            MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le F_zeros _
        _ = ∑ _z ∈ F_zeros, (4 * r_exc) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => ?_
            rw [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith)]
            ring
        _ = (F_zeros.card : ℝ) * (4 * r_exc) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ ≤ ((1297 * (C_env + 1) * d⁻¹ * K ^ 2) * (145 * (C_env + 1) * K ^ 2)) *
              (4 * r_exc) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hF_card_bound (by positivity)
        _ = 752260 * (C_env + 1) ^ 2 * (K ^ 4 * Real.exp (-h₁ / 10)) := by
            dsimp [r_exc]
            have hd_inv : d⁻¹ * d = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hd_pos.ne'
            calc ((1297 * (C_env + 1) * d⁻¹ * K ^ 2) * (145 * (C_env + 1) * K ^ 2)) *
                    (4 * (d * Real.exp (-h₁ / 10)))
                = 752260 * (C_env + 1) ^ 2 * (K ^ 4 * Real.exp (-h₁ / 10)) * (d⁻¹ * d) := by ring
              _ = 752260 * (C_env + 1) ^ 2 * (K ^ 4 * Real.exp (-h₁ / 10)) := by rw [hd_inv, mul_one]
        _ ≤ δ := h_asymp_B
    calc MeasureTheory.volume.real A_bad
        ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (A_mod ∪ E_shadow) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_subset h_vol_union_ne_top
      _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real A_mod + MeasureTheory.volume.real E_shadow :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le A_mod E_shadow
      _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real A_mod + δ := by linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :
    Nonempty (OddPeriodicSliceData S)

signature.name: odd_slice_jacobi_and_boundary_contact
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :
    Nonempty (OddPeriodicSliceData S)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hChord : OddSliceChordProp S := odd_slice_chord_and_pos_reconstruction S
  have hJac : OddSliceJacobiProp S := odd_slice_jacobi_and_cofactor S hChord
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_odd : Odd N :=
    ⟨Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 1, by dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega⟩
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three)
  have ht0_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 N := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : sliceParamT0 N < S.r_star := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ S.r_star_pos).mp hfl
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have ht0_mem : (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht0_pos]
    exact ht0_lt
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht0_mem).1
  have hC_rec_pos : 0 < oddSliceCRec S := by
    unfold oddSliceCRec
    positivity
  have h_zero_in_strip : ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := by
    simp [horizStrip, hh_pos]
  have h_zero_not_Z : ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∉ oddSliceZAll S :=
    hJac.real_not_mem_Z_all 0
  have h_f_holo : ∀ k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro k
    exact S.f_holo.comp (hChord.impact_holo k.val)
      (fun y hy => hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)
  have h_phi_holo : ∀ k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => S.ϕ (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro k
    exact S.ϕ_holo.comp (hChord.impact_holo k.val)
      (fun y hy => hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)
  have h_shifted_holo : ∀ (j : Fin N) (m : ℕ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateShiftedAngle S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j m) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j m
    unfold stateShiftedAngle
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact h_phi_holo _
    · exact (h_phi_holo _).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
  have h_theta_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    unfold stateTheta
    exact (differentiableOn_const _).add
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun m _ => (differentiableOn_const _).mul (h_shifted_holo j m)))
  have h_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    unfold stateD0
    exact (h_theta_holo j).sub (h_phi_holo j)
  have h_sin_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    exact Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (h_d0_holo j)
  have h_chord_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) :=
    hChord.ℓ_num_holo
  have h_delta_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) (horizStrip h) := by
    unfold stateDeltaRow
    exact (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m)).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m))
  have h_M0_entry_holo : ∀ i k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedM0Entry S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro i k
    unfold stateClearedM0Entry
    have hP_sin : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => ∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m))
        (horizStrip h) :=
      DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m)
    have hP_ell : ∀ r : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m)
        (horizStrip h) :=
      fun r => DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m)
    refine ((?_ : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ (horizStrip h)).add ?_).add ?_
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact (((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).add
          (((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _))).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hki : k = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) i
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hik' : i = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) k
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have h_VDiag_holo : ∀ i : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedVDiag S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro i
    unfold stateClearedVDiag
    exact ((((differentiableOn_const _).mul ((h_f_holo i).pow 3)).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m))).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m)))
  have h_B_entry_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (i k : Fin N),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro I F i k
    simp only [stateClearedB, Matrix.of_apply]
    by_cases hIF : i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F
    · simp only [hIF, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · by_cases hiI : k ∈ I
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          exact (h_M0_entry_holo k k).sub (h_VDiag_holo k)
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_false, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
          exact h_M0_entry_holo k k
      · simp only [hik, false_and, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
        exact h_M0_entry_holo i k
    · simp only [hIF, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact h_delta_holo
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have h_det_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro I F
    have h_eq : (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) =
        fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            ∏ i : Fin N, stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) (σ i) i := by
      ext y
      rw [Matrix.det_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun σ _ =>
      (differentiableOn_const _).mul
        (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd fun i _ => h_B_entry_holo I F (σ i) i)
  obtain ⟨hFatou, hUniq⟩ := strip_nontangential_fatou_and_uniqueness h hh_pos
  have h_ae_lim : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ∃ s_lim : ℂ, |s_lim.im| ≤ S.H ∧
        ∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone →
          Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
            (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (h - |y.im|)})
            (nhds s_lim) := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    exact hFatou S.H S.H_pos (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
      (hChord.impact_holo j.val) (hChord.impact_quasiperiodic j.val)
      (hChord.impact_maps_to j.val)
  have h_ae_f : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun y => S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j))
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    refine hUniq _ (h_f_holo j) ⟨0, fun h0 => h_zero_not_Z ⟨h_zero_in_strip, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inl h0⟩⟩⟩
  have h_ae_sin : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun y => Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j))
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    refine hUniq _ (h_sin_d0_holo j)
      ⟨0, fun h0 => h_zero_not_Z ⟨h_zero_in_strip, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inl h0)⟩⟩⟩
  have h_ae_chord : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    refine hUniq _ (h_chord_holo j)
      ⟨0, fun h0 => h_zero_not_Z ⟨h_zero_in_strip, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inr h0)⟩⟩⟩
  have h_ae_det : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ¬ Filter.Tendsto
          (fun y => (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det)
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    refine hUniq _ (h_det_holo (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅) ⟨0, fun h0 => h_zero_not_Z
      ⟨h_zero_in_strip, Or.inr ⟨Finset.univ.erase j, ∅,
        Finset.erase_ssubset (Finset.mem_univ j), Finset.disjoint_empty_right _, h0⟩⟩⟩
  have h_open_H : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_bdy_contact : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
        ∃ s_lim : Fin N → ℂ,
          (∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone → ∀ j : Fin N,
            Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
              (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + ((sgn * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (h - |y.im|)})
              (nhds (s_lim j))) ∧
          ∃ j : Fin N, |(s_lim j).im| = S.H := by
    filter_upwards [h_ae_lim, h_ae_f, h_ae_sin, h_ae_chord, h_ae_det] with
      x hx_lim hx_f hx_sin hx_chord hx_det
    let s_plus : Fin N → ℂ := fun j => Classical.choose (hx_lim j)
    have hs_plus_im : ∀ j : Fin N, |(s_plus j).im| ≤ S.H :=
      fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hx_lim j)).1
    have hs_plus_lim : ∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone → ∀ j : Fin N,
        Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds (s_plus j)) :=
      fun A_cone hA j => (Classical.choose_spec (hx_lim j)).2 A_cone hA
    have hs_plus_hit : ∃ j : Fin N, |(s_plus j).im| = S.H := by
      by_contra h_no_hit
      push Not at h_no_hit
      have h_in_H : ∀ j : Fin N, s_plus j ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
        fun j => lt_of_le_of_ne (hs_plus_im j) (h_no_hit j)
      let flt : Filter ℂ :=
        nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)}
      have h_lim2 : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => oddSliceStateVec S y j) flt (nhds (s_plus j)) :=
        fun j => hs_plus_lim 2 (by norm_num) j
      have ht_f : ∀ k : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) flt (nhds (S.f (s_plus k))) := by
        intro k
        exact (S.f_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (h_open_H.mem_nhds (h_in_H k))).tendsto.comp
          (h_lim2 k)
      have ht_phi : ∀ k : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => S.ϕ (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) flt (nhds (S.ϕ (s_plus k))) := by
        intro k
        exact (S.ϕ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (h_open_H.mem_nhds (h_in_H k))).tendsto.comp
          (h_lim2 k)
      have ht_K : ∀ (k : Fin N) (i : Fin 2),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => holoScaledPos S (oddSliceStateVec S y k) i) flt
            (nhds (holoScaledPos S (s_plus k) i)) := by
        intro k i
        exact ((hChord.holoScaledPos_holo i).continuousOn.continuousAt
          (h_open_H.mem_nhds (h_in_H k))).tendsto.comp (h_lim2 k)
      have ht_shifted : ∀ (j : Fin N) (m : ℕ),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateShiftedAngle S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j m) flt
            (nhds (stateShiftedAngle S s_plus j m)) := by
        intro j m
        unfold stateShiftedAngle
        split_ifs with hm
        · exact ht_phi _
        · exact (ht_phi _).sub tendsto_const_nhds
      have ht_theta : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) flt
            (nhds (stateTheta S s_plus j)) := by
        intro j
        unfold stateTheta
        exact tendsto_const_nhds.add
          (tendsto_finsetSum _ fun m _ => tendsto_const_nhds.mul (ht_shifted j m))
      have ht_d0 : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) flt
            (nhds (stateD0 S s_plus j)) := by
        intro j
        unfold stateD0
        exact (ht_theta j).sub (ht_phi j)
      have ht_sin_d0 : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)) flt
            (nhds (Complex.sin (stateD0 S s_plus j))) := by
        intro j
        exact (Complex.continuous_sin.continuousAt.tendsto).comp (ht_d0 j)
      have ht_cos_theta : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => Complex.cos (stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)) flt
            (nhds (Complex.cos (stateTheta S s_plus j))) := by
        intro j
        exact (Complex.continuous_cos.continuousAt.tendsto).comp (ht_theta j)
      have ht_sin_theta : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => Complex.sin (stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)) flt
            (nhds (Complex.sin (stateTheta S s_plus j))) := by
        intro j
        exact (Complex.continuous_sin.continuousAt.tendsto).comp (ht_theta j)
      have ht_chord : ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) flt
            (nhds (stateChordNum S s_plus j)) := by
        intro j
        unfold stateChordNum
        exact ((((ht_f j).mul (ht_K _ 0)).sub ((ht_f _).mul (ht_K j 0))).neg.mul
          (ht_sin_theta j)).add
          ((((ht_f j).mul (ht_K _ 1)).sub ((ht_f _).mul (ht_K j 1))).mul (ht_cos_theta j))
      have ht_delta :
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) flt
            (nhds (stateDeltaRow S s_plus)) := by
        unfold stateDeltaRow
        exact (tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_chord m).mul
          (tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_sin_d0 m)
      have ht_M0_entry : ∀ i k : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateClearedM0Entry S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) flt
            (nhds (stateClearedM0Entry S s_plus i k)) := by
        intro i k
        unfold stateClearedM0Entry
        have htP_sin : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun y => ∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m)) flt
            (nhds (∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S s_plus m))) :=
          tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_sin_d0 m
        have htP_ell : ∀ r : Fin N, Filter.Tendsto
            (fun y => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m) flt
            (nhds (∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S s_plus m)) :=
          fun r => tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_chord m
        refine ((?_ : Filter.Tendsto _ flt _).add ?_).add ?_
        · by_cases hik : i = k
          · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
            exact (((((ht_f _).mul (ht_f _)).mul (htP_ell _)).add
              (((ht_f _).mul (ht_f _)).mul (htP_ell _))).mul htP_sin)
          · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
        · by_cases hki : k = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) i
          · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
            exact ((((ht_f _).mul (ht_f _)).mul (htP_ell _)).mul htP_sin)
          · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
        · by_cases hik' : i = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) k
          · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
            exact ((((ht_f _).mul (ht_f _)).mul (htP_ell _)).mul htP_sin)
          · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
      have ht_VDiag : ∀ i : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateClearedVDiag S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) flt
            (nhds (stateClearedVDiag S s_plus i)) := by
        intro i
        unfold stateClearedVDiag
        exact (((tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((ht_f i).pow 3)).mul
          (tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_chord m)).mul
          (tendsto_finsetProd _ fun m _ => ht_sin_d0 m))
      have ht_B_entry : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (i k : Fin N),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) flt
            (nhds (stateClearedB S I F s_plus i k)) := by
        intro I F i k
        simp only [stateClearedB, Matrix.of_apply]
        by_cases hIF : i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F
        · simp only [hIF, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hik : i = k
          · by_cases hiI : k ∈ I
            · simp only [hik, hiI, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
              exact (ht_M0_entry k k).sub (ht_VDiag k)
            · simp only [hik, hiI, and_false, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
              exact ht_M0_entry k k
          · simp only [hik, false_and, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
            exact ht_M0_entry i k
        · simp only [hIF, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hik : i = k
          · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
            exact ht_delta
          · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
            exact tendsto_const_nhds
      have ht_det : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) flt
            (nhds ((stateClearedB S I F s_plus).det)) := by
        intro I F
        have h_eq1 : (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) =
            fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N),
              ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
                ∏ i : Fin N, stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) (σ i) i := by
          ext y; rw [Matrix.det_apply]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
          simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; rfl
        have h_eq2 : (stateClearedB S I F s_plus).det =
            ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N),
              ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
                ∏ i : Fin N, stateClearedB S I F s_plus (σ i) i := by
          rw [Matrix.det_apply]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
          simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; rfl
        rw [h_eq1, h_eq2]
        exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun σ _ =>
          tendsto_const_nhds.mul
            (tendsto_finsetProd _ fun i _ => ht_B_entry I F (σ i) i)
      exact interior_slice_limit_implies_wall_patch S hChord hJac x s_plus h_in_H h_lim2
        (fun j h0 => hx_f j (h0 ▸ ht_f j))
        (fun j h0 => hx_sin j (h0 ▸ ht_sin_d0 j))
        (fun j h0 => hx_chord j (h0 ▸ ht_chord j))
        (fun j h0 => hx_det j (h0 ▸ ht_det (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅))
    intro sgn hsgn
    rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨s_plus, ?_, hs_plus_hit⟩
      intro A_cone hA j
      simpa [one_mul] using hs_plus_lim A_cone hA j
    · refine ⟨fun j => starRingEnd ℂ (s_plus j), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro A_cone hA j
        let coneSet : Set ℂ :=
          {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (h - |y.im|)}
        have h_conj_pt :
            starRingEnd ℂ ((x : ℂ) + (((-1 : ℝ) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
              (x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          simp
        have h_conj_maps : ∀ y ∈ coneSet, starRingEnd ℂ y ∈ coneSet := by
          intro y hy
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
            exact hy.1
          · simpa only [Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hy.2
        have h_conj_tendsto :
            Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ)
              (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (((-1 : ℝ) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) coneSet)
              (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I) coneSet) := by
          refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ ?_ ?_
          · rw [← h_conj_pt]
            exact Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto.comp nhdsWithin_le_nhds
          · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall h_conj_maps
        have h_comp :=
          Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
            ((hs_plus_lim A_cone hA j).comp h_conj_tendsto)
        refine h_comp.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun y (hy : y ∈ coneSet) => hy)] with y hy
        dsimp [Function.comp]
        rw [hChord.impact_conj j.val y hy.1]
        simp only [RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
        rfl
      · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hs_plus_hit
        exact ⟨j₀, by simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hj₀⟩
  exact ⟨{
    N := N
    instNeZero := oddSliceNeZero S
    N_odd := hN_odd
    N_ge_three := hN_ge_three
    t₀_lt_r_star := ht0_lt
    θ_seq := oddSliceTheta S
    θ_holo := hChord.θ_holo
    θ_quasiperiodic := hChord.θ_quasiperiodic
    θ_shift_N := hChord.θ_shift_N
    θ_conj := hChord.θ_conj
    θ_sum := hChord.θ_sum
    θ_real := hChord.θ_real
    ℓ_num := oddSliceChordNum S
    ℓ_num_holo := hChord.ℓ_num_holo
    ℓ_num_periodic := hChord.ℓ_num_periodic
    ℓ_real := hChord.ℓ_real
    C_rec := oddSliceCRec S
    C_rec_pos := hC_rec_pos
    Z_all := oddSliceZAll S
    Z_all_subset := hJac.Z_all_subset
    reg_open := hJac.reg_open
    real_not_mem_Z_all := hJac.real_not_mem_Z_all
    Z_all_periodic := hJac.Z_all_periodic
    Z_all_compact_finite := hJac.Z_all_compact_finite
    reg_speed_ne_zero := hJac.reg_speed_ne_zero
    reg_sin_d0_ne_zero := hJac.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero
    reg_chord_ne_zero := hJac.reg_chord_ne_zero
    reg_chord_vec := fun y hy => hChord.reg_chord_vec_pt y hy.1 (hJac.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy)
    reg_deriv_pos := fun y hy => hChord.reg_deriv_pos_pt y hy.1 (hJac.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy)
    reg_deriv_support := fun y hy =>
      hChord.reg_deriv_support_pt y hy.1 (hJac.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy)
    pos_reconstruction := fun y hy =>
      hChord.pos_reconstruction_pt y hy.1 (hJac.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy)
        (hJac.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy)
    jacobi_null := hJac.jacobi_null
    jacobi_M0_mulVec := hJac.jacobi_M0_mulVec
    modified_det_ne_zero := hJac.modified_det_ne_zero
    cofactor_norm := hJac.cofactor_norm
    boundary_contact := h_bdy_contact
  }⟩

odd_slice_jacobi_and_boundary_contact.definitions:
noncomputable def oddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℕ :=
  2 * Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 3

instance oddSliceNeZero (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : NeZero (oddSliceN S) :=
  ⟨by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

noncomputable def oddSliceCRec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℝ :=
  2 * (oddSliceN S : ℝ) + 3

noncomputable def holoScaledPos (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s) - deriv S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s),
    S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s) + deriv S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s)]

noncomputable def oddSliceTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S),
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) (j - (m : ℤ)) y

noncomputable def stateShiftedAngle (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if h : m ≤ j.val then
    S.ϕ (z ⟨j.val - m, by omega⟩)
  else
    S.ϕ (z ⟨(j.val + oddSliceN S - m) % oddSliceN S,
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by unfold oddSliceN; omega)⟩) - 2 * Real.pi

noncomputable def stateTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S), (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * stateShiftedAngle S z j m

noncomputable def stateD0 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  stateTheta S z j - S.ϕ (z j)

noncomputable def stateChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let j_next : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j;
  let K₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j);
  let K₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j_next);
  (-(S.f (z j) * K₁ 0 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 0)) * Complex.sin (stateTheta S z j) +
    (S.f (z j) * K₁ 1 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 1) * Complex.cos (stateTheta S z j)

noncomputable def oddSliceStateVec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (y : ℂ) :
    Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
  fun j => sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y

noncomputable def oddSliceChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j

noncomputable def stateDeltaRow (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S z m) *
    (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))

noncomputable def stateClearedM0Entry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (i k : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let inst : NeZero (oddSliceN S) := oddSliceNeZero S
  let ip : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycPrev (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let inext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let knext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst k
  let P_sin : ℂ := ∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)
  let P_ell_omit : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
    fun r => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S z m
  (if i = k then
      (S.f (z ip) * S.f (z i) * P_ell_omit ip +
        S.f (z i) * S.f (z inext) * P_ell_omit i) * P_sin
    else 0) +

noncomputable def stateClearedVDiag (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)

def oddSliceZAll (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Set ℂ :=

noncomputable def oddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℕ :=
  2 * Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 3

instance oddSliceNeZero (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : NeZero (oddSliceN S) :=
  ⟨by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

noncomputable def oddSliceCRec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℝ :=
  2 * (oddSliceN S : ℝ) + 3

noncomputable def holoScaledPos (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s) - deriv S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s),
    S.f s * S.H0 s * Complex.sin (S.ϕ s) + deriv S.H0 s * Complex.cos (S.ϕ s)]

noncomputable def oddSliceTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S),
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) (j - (m : ℤ)) y

noncomputable def stateShiftedAngle (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if h : m ≤ j.val then
    S.ϕ (z ⟨j.val - m, by omega⟩)
  else
    S.ϕ (z ⟨(j.val + oddSliceN S - m) % oddSliceN S,
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by unfold oddSliceN; omega)⟩) - 2 * Real.pi

noncomputable def stateTheta (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  (Real.pi : ℂ) +
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (oddSliceN S), (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * stateShiftedAngle S z j m

noncomputable def stateD0 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  stateTheta S z j - S.ϕ (z j)

noncomputable def stateChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let j_next : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j;
  let K₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j);
  let K₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ := holoScaledPos S (z j_next);
  (-(S.f (z j) * K₁ 0 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 0)) * Complex.sin (stateTheta S z j) +
    (S.f (z j) * K₁ 1 - S.f (z j_next) * K₀ 1) * Complex.cos (stateTheta S z j)

noncomputable def oddSliceStateVec (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (y : ℂ) :
    Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
  fun j => sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y

noncomputable def oddSliceChordNum (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (j : Fin (oddSliceN S)) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j

noncomputable def stateDeltaRow (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S z m) *
    (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))

noncomputable def stateClearedM0Entry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (i k : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  let inst : NeZero (oddSliceN S) := oddSliceNeZero S
  let ip : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycPrev (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let inext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst i
  let knext : Fin (oddSliceN S) := @cycNext (oddSliceN S) inst k
  let P_sin : ℂ := ∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)
  let P_ell_omit : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ :=
    fun r => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S z m
  (if i = k then
      (S.f (z ip) * S.f (z i) * P_ell_omit ip +
        S.f (z i) * S.f (z inext) * P_ell_omit i) * P_sin
    else 0) +
  (if k = inext then S.f (z i) * S.f (z inext) * P_ell_omit i * P_sin else 0) +
  (if i = knext then S.f (z k) * S.f (z knext) * P_ell_omit k * P_sin else 0)

noncomputable def stateClearedVDiag (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) (i : Fin (oddSliceN S)) : ℂ :=
  (2 / (S.c : ℂ)) * (S.f (z i)) ^ 3 *
    (∏ m : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S z m) *
    (∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))

noncomputable def stateClearedB (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S))) (z : Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (oddSliceN S)) (Fin (oddSliceN S)) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
      stateClearedM0Entry S z i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then stateClearedVDiag S z i else 0)
    else if i = k then stateDeltaRow S z else 0

def oddSliceZAll (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Set ℂ :=
  { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) ∧
    ((∃ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j) = 0 ∨
        Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) = 0 ∨
        stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j = 0) ∨
     (∃ I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)),
        I ⊂ Finset.univ ∧ Disjoint I F ∧
        (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det = 0)) }

structure OddSliceJacobiProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  Z_all_subset : oddSliceZAll S ⊆ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S))
  reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S)
  real_not_mem_Z_all : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ oddSliceZAll S
  Z_all_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ oddSliceZAll S ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ oddSliceZAll S
  Z_all_compact_finite : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
    (oddSliceZAll S ∩
      { y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        |y.im| ≤ sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - ε }).Finite
  reg_speed_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y ≠ 0
  reg_sin_d0_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      oddSliceChordNum S j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0
  jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    (@jacobiH (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceChordNum S j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y)) = 0
  jacobi_M0_mulVec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      2 * sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
        deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y =
        (@jacobiM0 (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
          (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
            (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y)) j
  modified_det_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      (@modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        I F).det ≠ 0
  cofactor_norm : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)) \ oddSliceZAll S,
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
        (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S),
          (oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
        (@modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
          (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
  cleared_cofactor_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)),
    ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y) ^ 2 *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y i)) ^ 2) *
        (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) ^ (oddSliceN S) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
        (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j)) ^ 4 *
        (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) *
        (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det

    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (div_pos hσ hσ₀_pos) (by linarith : (1 + σ₀) / 2 < 1)
    have h_mul_lt : ((1 + σ₀) / 2) ^ n * σ₀ < σ :=

    have hM₀_le_L : M₀ ≤ L :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right 2 M₀) (le_max_left _ _)) hL₁
    have hA_le_L : A_cap ≤ L :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hL₁
    have hL_ge_one : 1 ≤ L := by linarith
    have hA_mul_L : A_cap * L ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_rpow : L ^ (σ_seq n) ≤ L ^ σ :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hL_ge_one hσ_le

      intro om ⟨m, hm, hgt⟩
      exact ⟨m, hm, lt_of_le_of_lt h_rpow hgt⟩
    exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub)
      (hM₀ L (L ^ 2) hM₀_le_L hA_mul_L (adaptiveStepRadius S P L) (hAdmL2 L hL_ge_two))

        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y

    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 -
          deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 0) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_pos₁ : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 -
          deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 1) y * z‖ ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
  taylor_support : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,

      ‖sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y -

structure WalkBaseAndStopProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk
  walk_in_reg : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
      walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m)
  walk_stops : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)
  walk_clock : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
      (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_clk
  impact_sq_sum : ∀ M : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 2 * S.H ^ 2

def SliceRetreatBoundProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    ∃ M_ret : ℝ, 2 ≤ M_ret ∧
      ∀ M : ℝ, M_ret ≤ M →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
              sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) <
                sliceHistory S P ρ om j m - 4 * Real.log M} ≤ δ

structure AdmissibleHittingAndClockProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_hit C_rem : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_hit_pos : 0 < C_hit
  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem
  first_hit_dom : ∀ M d r_int : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  rem_clock_tail : ∀ M d B : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)
  stopped_disp : ∀ M d r_exit q_K : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

def StoppedLogDeficitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, g y ≠ 0) →
    (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖g x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖g x‖ ≤ C₀) →
    ∃ C_g : ℝ, 0 < C_g ∧
      ∀ M B₀ B₁ : ℝ, 1 ≤ B₀ → 1 ≤ B₁ →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y →
            |Real.log ‖g (y + z)‖ - Real.log ‖g y‖| ≤ 1) →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
              (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ B₀) ∧
              Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -B₁} ≤
            C_g * (1 + B₀) / (1 + B₁)

structure AdmissibleModifiedInverseProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_inv : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  inv_bound : ∀ M U V : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P ρ om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)

def HasUniformPowerGeometry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (σ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ A_cap : ℝ, 1 ≤ A_cap ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ M₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ M₀ ∧
        ∀ M M_cap : ℝ, M₀ ≤ M → A_cap * M ≤ M_cap →
          ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M_cap ρ →
            walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
              ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
                M ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m)} ≤ δ

    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ) : Prop where

def SliceRetreatBoundProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
    ∃ M_ret : ℝ, 2 ≤ M_ret ∧

structure AdmissibleHittingAndClockProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_hit C_rem : ℝ) : Prop where

  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem

def StoppedLogDeficitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, g y ≠ 0) →
    (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖g x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖g x‖ ≤ C₀) →
    ∃ C_g : ℝ, 0 < C_g ∧
      ∀ M B₀ B₁ : ℝ, 1 ≤ B₀ → 1 ≤ B₁ →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y →
            |Real.log ‖g (y + z)‖ - Real.log ‖g y‖| ≤ 1) →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
              (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ B₀) ∧
              Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -B₁} ≤
            C_g * (1 + B₀) / (1 + B₁)

structure AdmissibleModifiedInverseProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_inv : ℝ) : Prop where
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  inv_bound : ∀ M U V : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P ρ om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos ρ om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)

def HasUniformPowerGeometry (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (σ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ A_cap : ℝ, 1 ≤ A_cap ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ M₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ M₀ ∧
        ∀ M M_cap : ℝ, M₀ ≤ M → A_cap * M ≤ M_cap →
          ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M_cap ρ →
            walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
              ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
                M ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m)} ≤ δ

    have h_cost_y : sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ t := h_geom m hm_le_tau
    have hsin_bounds : ∀ k : Fin P.N,
        Real.exp (-t) ≤ ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖ ∧ ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖ ≤ Real.exp t := by
      intro k
      have hk_sup := Finset.le_sup' (fun j : Fin P.N =>
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ + Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
          |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| + |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|)
        (Finset.mem_univ k)
      have hlog1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y‖) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y)])
      have habs : |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖| ≤ t := by
        unfold sliceGeomCost at h_cost_y
        linarith [norm_nonneg (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y),
          abs_nonneg (Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖)]
      rw [abs_le] at habs
      have hpos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hsin_ne k)
      exact ⟨(Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mp habs.1, (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hpos).mp habs.2⟩
    have hℓ_inv_le : ∀ k : Fin P.N, ‖(P.ℓ_slice k y)⁻¹‖ ≤ Real.exp t := by
      intro k
      have hk_sup := Finset.le_sup' (fun j : Fin P.N =>
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ + Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
          |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| + |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|)
        (Finset.mem_univ k)
      have hlog1 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y‖) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y)])
      have habs : |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖| ≤ t := by
        unfold sliceGeomCost at h_cost_y
        linarith [norm_nonneg (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y),
          abs_nonneg (Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖)]
      rw [abs_le] at habs
      have hpos : 0 < ‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hℓ_ne k)
      have hlo : Real.exp (-t) ≤ ‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖ := (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hpos).mp habs.1
      rw [norm_inv]
      have : (‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp (-t))⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) hlo
      rwa [← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg] at this
    let M0 : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ :=
      @jacobiM0 P.N P.instNeZero (fun k => P.ℓ_slice k y)
    have hM0_le : ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖M0 r c‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp t := by
      intro r c
      dsimp only [M0, jacobiM0]
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
      have h1 : ‖if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤
          2 * Real.exp t := by
        split_ifs
        · calc ‖(P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹‖
              ≤ ‖(P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹‖ + ‖(P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ Real.exp t + Real.exp t := add_le_add (hℓ_inv_le _) (hℓ_inv_le _)
            _ = 2 * Real.exp t := by ring
        · simp; positivity
      have h2 : ‖if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤ Real.exp t := by
        split_ifs
        · exact hℓ_inv_le r
        · simp; positivity
      have h3 : ‖if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c y)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤ Real.exp t := by
        split_ifs
        · exact hℓ_inv_le c
        · simp; positivity
      calc ‖(if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0) +
              (if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0) +
              (if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c y)⁻¹ else 0)‖
          ≤ ‖(if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0) +
              (if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0)‖ +
            ‖if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c y)⁻¹ else 0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0‖ +
            ‖if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0‖ +
            ‖if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c y)⁻¹ else 0‖ := by
          linarith [norm_add_le
            (if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) y)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0)
            (if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r y)⁻¹ else 0)]
        _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp t := by linarith
    let w := P.w_vec y
    let w_max : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun a => ‖w a‖)
    have hw_le : ∀ a : Fin P.N, ‖w a‖ ≤ w_max := fun a =>
      Finset.le_sup' (fun b => ‖w b‖) (Finset.mem_univ a)
    have hw_max_nn : 0 ≤ w_max := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hw_le i)
    let h₁ : ℝ := signTestH1 K
    have hh₁_nn : 0 ≤ h₁ := by unfold h₁ signTestH1; positivity
    
    have h_deriv_1 : ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ ≤
        C_der * Real.exp (t - h₁) * w_max := by
      rcases hi_sign with h_small | h_large
      · have hw_norm : ‖w i‖ = S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 i y)‖ *
            ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by
          dsimp only [w, OddPeriodicSliceData.w_vec, jacobiNullVec]
          simp only [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_pos S.c_pos]
        have hf_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hf_ne i)
        have h_id : S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 i y)‖ *
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ =
            ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ^ 2 * ‖w i‖ := by
          rw [hw_norm]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hf_pos]
        have hf_sq_le : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (-h₁) := by
          calc ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ^ 2
              ≤ Real.exp (-h₁) ^ 2 := sq_le_sq' (by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-h₁)]) h_small
            _ = Real.exp (-h₁) * Real.exp (-h₁) := sq _
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-h₁) * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith))
                  (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
            _ = Real.exp (-h₁) := mul_one _
        have h_lhs : S.c * Real.exp (-t) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ ≤
            Real.exp (-h₁) * w_max := by
          calc S.c * Real.exp (-t) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖
              ≤ S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 i y)‖ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsin_bounds i).1 (le_of_lt S.c_pos))
                  (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ^ 2 * ‖w i‖ := h_id
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-h₁) * w_max :=
                mul_le_mul hf_sq_le (hw_le i) (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lhs
          (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr S.c_pos)) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos t)))
        have h_simp_l : (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp t *
            (S.c * Real.exp (-t) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖) =
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by
          have hc_ne : S.c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt S.c_pos
          have het : Real.exp t * Real.exp (-t) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
          calc (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp t * (S.c * Real.exp (-t) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖)
              = ((S.c)⁻¹ * S.c) * (Real.exp t * Real.exp (-t)) *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by ring
            _ = ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by
              rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc_ne, het, one_mul, one_mul]
        have h_simp_r : (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp t * (Real.exp (-h₁) * w_max) =
            (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t - h₁) * w_max := by
          have : Real.exp t * Real.exp (-h₁) = Real.exp (t - h₁) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
          calc (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp t * (Real.exp (-h₁) * w_max)
              = (S.c)⁻¹ * (Real.exp t * Real.exp (-h₁)) * w_max := by ring
            _ = (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t - h₁) * w_max := by rw [this]
        rw [h_simp_l, h_simp_r] at h_mul
        exact le_trans h_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))) hw_max_nn)
      · have hM0_eq : 2 * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y =
            (M0.mulVec w) i := P.jacobi_M0_mulVec y hy_reg i
        have h_rhs_norm : ‖(M0.mulVec w) i‖ ≤ 4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max := by
          dsimp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
          calc ‖∑ k : Fin P.N, M0 i k * w k‖
              ≤ ∑ k : Fin P.N, ‖M0 i k * w k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin P.N, (4 * Real.exp t * w_max) := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
                rw [norm_mul]
                exact mul_le_mul (hM0_le i k) (hw_le k) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max := by simp; ring
        have h_lhs_norm : 2 * Real.exp h₁ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ ≤
            4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max := by
          calc 2 * Real.exp h₁ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖
              ≤ 2 * ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y‖ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_large (by norm_num)) (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖2 * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by
                simp
            _ = ‖(M0.mulVec w) i‖ := by rw [hM0_eq]
            _ ≤ 4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max := h_rhs_norm
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lhs_norm
          (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-h₁))
        have h_simp_l : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-h₁) *
            (2 * Real.exp h₁ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖) =
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by
          have heh : Real.exp (-h₁) * Real.exp h₁ = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
          calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-h₁) *
                (2 * Real.exp h₁ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖)
              = (Real.exp (-h₁) * Real.exp h₁) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by ring
            _ = ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y‖ := by rw [heh, one_mul]
        have h_simp_r : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-h₁) *
            (4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max) =
            2 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp (t - h₁) * w_max := by
          have : Real.exp t * Real.exp (-h₁) = Real.exp (t - h₁) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
          calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-h₁) * (4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp t * w_max)
              = 2 * (P.N : ℝ) * (Real.exp t * Real.exp (-h₁)) * w_max := by ring
            _ = 2 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp (t - h₁) * w_max := by rw [this]
        rw [h_simp_l, h_simp_r] at h_mul
        exact le_trans h_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))) hw_max_nn)
    
    let h₂ : ℝ := t ^ (8 : ℕ)
    let I : Finset (Fin P.N) := Finset.univ \ J
    let F : Finset (Fin P.N) := J.filter (fun j => ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ < Real.exp (-h₂))
    let D : Finset (Fin P.N) := J \ F
    have hI_ssub : I ⊂ Finset.univ := Finset.sdiff_ssubset (Finset.subset_univ J) hJ
    have hIF_disj : Disjoint I F :=
      Disjoint.mono_right (Finset.filter_subset _ J) Finset.sdiff_disjoint
    have hIF_D_disj : Disjoint (I ∪ F) D := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx_IF hx_D
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx_D
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx_IF with hx_I | hx_F
      · exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx_I).2 hx_D.1
      · exact hx_D.2 hx_F
    have hIF_D_univ : (I ∪ F) ∪ D = Finset.univ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, I, D]
      tauto
    have hp_IF : (I, F) ∈ P_fin :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hI_ssub, hIF_disj⟩
    have hom_not_IF : om ∉ Classical.choose (h_inv_ex (I, F) hp_IF) := by
      intro hbad
      apply hom_inv
      refine Set.mem_biUnion hp_IF ?_
      dsimp only [E_bad_fn]
      rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hp_IF)]
      exact hbad
    have h_geom_u₀ : ∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ u₀ := fun n hn =>
      le_trans (h_geom n (le_trans hn hm_le_tau)) ht_le_u₀
    have h_hist_u₀ : ∀ a ∈ I, sliceHistory S P ρ om a m ≤ u₀ := by
      intro a ha
      have h_sub_r : Finset.range (m + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om + 1) :=
        Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hm_le_tau)
      have h_mono : sliceHistory S P ρ om a m ≤
          sliceHistory S P ρ om a (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om) :=
        Finset.sup'_mono (fun n => sliceLogDepth S P a (walkPos ρ om n)) h_sub_r
          ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ m)⟩
      rw [← hu₀_eq_K]
      exact le_trans h_mono (hJ_compl a ha)
    obtain ⟨B_inv, hB_left, hB_norm⟩ :=
      (Classical.choose_spec (h_inv_ex (I, F) hp_IF)).2 om hom_not_IF m hm_le_tau h_geom_u₀ h_hist_u₀
    let VDiag : Fin P.N → ℂ :=
      jacobiVDiag P.N S.c (fun k => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val y) (fun k => P.d0 k y)
    have h_null_row : ∀ a : Fin P.N,
        ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, M0 a k * w k = VDiag a * w a - ∑ k ∈ D, M0 a k * w k := by
      intro a
      have h0 := congr_fun (P.jacobi_null y hy_reg) a
      change ((M0 - Matrix.diagonal VDiag).mulVec w) a = 0 at h0
      dsimp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply] at h0
      have h_sub : (∑ x : Fin P.N, (M0 a x - if a = x then VDiag a else 0) * w x) =
          (∑ x : Fin P.N, M0 a x * w x) - VDiag a * w a := by
        simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
          Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
      rw [h_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0
      rw [← hIF_D_univ, Finset.sum_union hIF_D_disj] at h0
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq h0
    let r_vec : Fin P.N → ℂ := (P.B_mat I F y).mulVec w
    have hr_bound : ∀ a : Fin P.N,
        ‖r_vec a‖ ≤ 2 * (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t - 3 * h₂) * w_max +
          4 * Real.exp t * ∑ k ∈ D, ‖w k‖ := by
      intro a
      have h_sum_D_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ D, ‖w k‖ := Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _
      have h_first_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t - 3 * h₂) * w_max := by positivity
      by_cases ha_IF : a ∈ I ∪ F
      · have hr_IF : r_vec a =
            (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, M0 a k * w k) -
              (if a ∈ I then VDiag a * w a else 0) := by
          dsimp only [r_vec, OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.mulVec,
            dotProduct]
          simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
          rw [← hIF_D_univ, Finset.sum_union hIF_D_disj]
          have h_D_zero : ∑ k ∈ D,
              (if a ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
                M0 a k - if a = k ∧ a ∈ I then VDiag a else 0
              else if a = k then 1 else 0) * w k = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
            have hk_not_IF : k ∉ I ∪ F := Finset.disjoint_right.mp hIF_D_disj hk
            have hak : a ≠ k := fun heq => hk_not_IF (heq ▸ ha_IF)
            simp [hk_not_IF, hak]
          rw [h_D_zero, add_zero]
          have h_IF_simp : ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F,
              (if a ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
                M0 a k - if a = k ∧ a ∈ I then VDiag a else 0
              else if a = k then 1 else 0) * w k =
              ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, (M0 a k * w k -
                if a = k then (if a ∈ I then VDiag a * w a else 0) else 0) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
            rw [if_pos ⟨ha_IF, hk⟩, sub_mul]
            congr 1
            by_cases hak : a = k
            · subst hak
              by_cases haI : a ∈ I <;> simp [haI]
            · simp [hak]
          rw [h_IF_simp, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, if_pos ha_IF]
        rw [hr_IF, h_null_row a]
        have hD_bound : ‖∑ k ∈ D, M0 a k * w k‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp t * ∑ k ∈ D, ‖w k‖ := by
          calc ‖∑ k ∈ D, M0 a k * w k‖
              ≤ ∑ k ∈ D, ‖M0 a k * w k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ = ∑ k ∈ D, ‖M0 a k‖ * ‖w k‖ := by simp
            _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ D, (4 * Real.exp t) * ‖w k‖ :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM0_le a k) (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = 4 * Real.exp t * ∑ k ∈ D, ‖w k‖ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        by_cases ha_I : a ∈ I
        · rw [if_pos ha_I]
          have h_cancel : VDiag a * w a - ∑ k ∈ D, M0 a k * w k - VDiag a * w a =
              -(∑ k ∈ D, M0 a k * w k) := by ring
          rw [h_cancel, norm_neg]
          linarith
        · rw [if_neg ha_I, sub_zero]
          have ha_F : a ∈ F := (Finset.mem_union.mp ha_IF).resolve_left ha_I
          have hfa_lt : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N a.val y‖ < Real.exp (-h₂) :=
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha_F).2
          have hVDiag_le : ‖VDiag a‖ ≤ 2 * (S.c)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t - 3 * h₂) := by
            dsimp only [VDiag, jacobiVDiag]
            simp only [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_real,
              Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos S.c_pos]
            have hf3 : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N a.val y‖ ^ 3 ≤ Real.exp (-3 * h₂) := by
              calc ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N a.val y‖ ^ 3
                  ≤ Real.exp (-h₂) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hfa_lt) 3
                _ = Real.exp (-3 * h₂) := by
                    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.exp_mul]; norm_num; ring_nf
            have hsin_pos : 0 < S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 a y)‖ :=
              mul_pos S.c_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) (hsin_bounds a).1)
            have hden : S.c * Real.exp (-t) ≤ S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 a y)‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsin_bounds a).1 (le_of_lt S.c_pos)

      have h_split : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico T_J η,
            (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 +
              Real.exp (-2 * L ^ 3)) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2 =
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico T_J η,
            2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 *
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) +
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico T_J η,
            Real.exp (-2 * L ^ 3) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => by ring
      rw [h_split]
      linarith
    have hp_Q : (J, i) ∈ Q_fin := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi_J⟩
    refine Set.mem_biUnion hp_Q ?_
    dsimp only [E_disp_p]
    rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true hi_J)]
    exact ⟨h_comb_sum, hη_exit⟩
  
  have h_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ walkMeasure.real
      (E_gap ∪ E_clk ∪ E_geom ∪ E_inv ∪ E_hit ∪ E_rem ∪ E_disp) := by
    calc (1 : ℝ)
        = walkMeasure.real (Set.univ : Set WalkSpace) :=
          (@MeasureTheory.probReal_univ _ _ walkMeasure hProb).symm
      _ ≤ walkMeasure.real (E_gap ∪ E_clk ∪ E_geom ∪ E_inv ∪ E_hit ∪ E_rem ∪ E_disp) :=

  have u2 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure)

  have u3 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure)
    (E_gap ∪ E_clk ∪ E_geom ∪ E_inv) E_hit
  have u4 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure)

  have u5 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) (E_gap ∪ E_clk) E_geom
  have u6 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) E_gap E_clk
  linarith [h_one, u1, u2, u3, u4, u5, u6, hE_gap_le, hE_clk_le, hE_geom_le,

noncomputable def bootRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def bootConeCost (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (δ_b L β₁ : ℝ) (N : ℝ → ℝ) (k x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + sSup { v : ℝ | ∃ s : ℂ,
    Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ wallDepth S s ∧
    wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b ∧
    |s.re - x| ≤ L * wallDepth S s ∧
    v = (wallDepth S s * shapeModulus S s) /
      (N k * (wallDepth S s / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁) }

def BootRealWallTransferProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L δ_star : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < δ_star ∧ δ_star < δ_b ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < min d₀ (δ_star / 4) →
          0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < S.r_star → |t| ≤ r / 2 →
            S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ 2 * d

structure BootConeNegativePartData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (β a C_N C₁ : ℝ) where

  L : ℝ
  β₁ : ℝ
  A_cone : ℝ
  K_tay : ℝ
  c_tay : ℝ
  C_tay : ℝ
  C_neg : ℝ
  C_dom : ℝ
  C_b1 : ℝ
  C_b2 : ℝ
  c_w : ℝ
  z₀ : ℝ
  C_w : ℝ
  δ_b_pos : 0 < δ_b
  δ_b_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2
  L_pos : 0 < L
  β_lt_β₁ : β < β₁
  β₁_lt_half : β₁ < 1 / 2
  one_le_A_cone : 1 ≤ A_cone
  k₀_le_K_tay : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_tay
  c_tay_pos : 0 < c_tay
  c_tay_lt : c_tay < S.r_star / 2
  C_tay_pos : 0 < C_tay
  C_neg_pos : 0 < C_neg
  C_dom_pos : 0 < C_dom
  C_b1_pos : 0 < C_b1
  C_b2_pos : 0 < C_b2
  c_w_pos : 0 < c_w
  c_w_lt : c_w < S.r_star / 2
  z₀_pos : 0 < z₀
  C_w_pos : 0 < C_w
  cone_cost_props : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
    ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      Continuous (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) ∧
      Function.Periodic (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x
  cone_cost_tile_dom : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
    ∀ k x : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x ≤
        C_dom * (1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (Nat.ceil (k - criticalDepthThreshold S) + 5),
          Real.exp (-β₁ * ((n : ℝ) - 3)) *
            (tileSupModulus S A_cone

    ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →

        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x) ≤ C_b1

      S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤
        C_w * Real.exp (-k) * (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ (1 / (1 + a))
  taylor_neg_part : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
    ∀ k x t : ℝ, K_tay ≤ k → 0 < |t| → |t| < S.r_star →

  subquad_neg_part : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
    ∀ k x : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤
        C_neg * (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x) ^

  tile_L2_from_rows : ∀ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → ∃ C_t2 : ℝ, 0 < C_t2 ∧
    ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤
        C_t2 * (1 + ∫ l in (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) (k - A - 1))..(k + A + 1),
          (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2)

noncomputable def bootStripPoissonTerm (h' u y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin (Real.pi * (h' - y) / h') /
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / h') -
      Real.cos (Real.pi * (h' - y) / h'))

noncomputable def bootStripPoissonKernel (h' u y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' n : ℤ, bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n

        Real.rpow_nonneg ht_nonneg α
