          ≤ η * R ^ α := mul_le_mul hmod_bound hrpow_le hrpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hη_pos)
        _ = ε * (R ^ (-α) * R ^ α) := by dsimp [η]; ring
        _ = ε * R ^ (-α + α) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hR_pos]
        _ = ε * R ^ (0 : ℝ) := by ring_nf
        _ = ε := by rw [Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
    · have hd_le_depth : d_n ≤ wallDepth S s := by
        calc d_n = 1 * d_n := (one_mul d_n).symm
          _ ≤ R * d_n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR_ge_one (le_of_lt hd_pos)
          _ ≤ wallDepth S s := h_outer
      have hcone_s := hCone n s hd_le_depth hdepth_hi hre_cone
      let t : ℝ := wallDepth S s / d_n
      have ht_ge_R : R ≤ t := (le_div_iff₀ hd_pos).mpr h_outer
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le hR_pos ht_ge_R
      have hinv_eq : (d_n / wallDepth S s) ^ α₀ = t ^ (-α₀) := by
        have hdt : d_n / wallDepth S s = t⁻¹ := by dsimp [t]; rw [inv_div]
        rw [hdt, Real.inv_rpow (le_of_lt ht_pos) α₀, ← Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt ht_pos) α₀]
      rw [hinv_eq] at hcone_s
      have htα_nonneg : 0 ≤ t ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_pos) α
      have ht_decay : t ^ (-(α₀ - α)) ≤ R ^ (-(α₀ - α)) := by
        have ha : 0 < R ^ (α₀ - α) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR_pos (α₀ - α)
        have hb : 0 < t ^ (α₀ - α) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ht_pos (α₀ - α)
        have hab : R ^ (α₀ - α) ≤ t ^ (α₀ - α) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hR_pos) ht_ge_R (le_of_lt hdiff_pos)
        rw [Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt ht_pos), Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt hR_pos)]
        calc (t ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹
            = (R ^ (α₀ - α) * (R ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹) * (t ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹ := by
              rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt ha), one_mul]
          _ = R ^ (α₀ - α) * ((R ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹ * (t ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹) := by ring
          _ ≤ t ^ (α₀ - α) * ((R ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹ * (t ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab
                (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr ha)) (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hb)))
          _ = (t ^ (α₀ - α) * (t ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹) * (R ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹ := by ring
          _ = (R ^ (α₀ - α))⁻¹ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hb), one_mul]
      calc (d_n / B_n) * shapeModulus S s * t ^ α
          ≤ (C₁ * t ^ (-α₀)) * t ^ α := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcone_s htα_nonneg
        _ = C₁ * (t ^ (-α₀) * t ^ α) := by ring
        _ = C₁ * t ^ (-α₀ + α) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add ht_pos]
        _ = C₁ * t ^ (-(α₀ - α)) := by congr 2; ring
        _ ≤ C₁ * R ^ (-(α₀ - α)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_decay (le_of_lt hC₁)
        _ ≤ ε := hR_decay

structure LogDeficitTransferPackage (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  sqrt_q_first_moment :
    ∃ C_q : ℝ, 0 < C_q ∧
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
          C_q * (1 + k)
  disk_chain_q_bound :
    ∀ (K : Set ℂ) (A : ℝ),
      IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane → 1 ≤ A →
      ∃ C_margin C_chain : ℝ, 0 < C_margin ∧ 0 < C_chain ∧
        ∀ (κ k_a k_n y₀ U D₀ : ℝ),
          criticalDepthThreshold S + C_margin ≤ min κ (min k_a k_n) →
          0 ≤ U → 0 ≤ D₀ →
          (∀ z : ℂ,
            Real.exp (-(max κ (max k_a k_n) + C_margin)) ≤ wallDepth S z →
            wallDepth S z ≤ Real.exp (-(min κ (min k_a k_n) - C_margin)) →
            ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp U) →
          Real.exp (U - D₀) ≤
            ‖S.f ((y₀ : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-κ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ →
          ∀ x : ℝ, |x - y₀| ≤ A * Real.exp (-k_a) →
            ∀ Z ∈ K,
              Real.exp (-k_n) *
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                  (Real.exp (-k_n) : ℂ) * Z)‖ ≤
                C_chain * (1 + D₀) *
                  Real.exp (C_chain * (1 + |κ - k_a| + |k_n - k_a|))
  poisson_q_bound :
    ∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
      ∃ C_margin C_har : ℝ, 0 < C_margin ∧ 0 < C_har ∧
        ∀ (k_a k_n K_top D_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
          criticalDepthThreshold S + C_margin ≤ k_a →
          k_a + C_margin ≤ k_n →
          0 ≤ K_top → 0 ≤ D_a →
          Continuous w →
          Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
          (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(k_n + C_margin)) →
            ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K_top) →
          (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < w y →
            Real.exp (K_top - D_a) ≤
              ‖S.f ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_a) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
              Real.exp (-k_n) *
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                  (Real.exp (-k_n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K) *
              ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
            C_har * (1 + D_a + Real.exp (-k_a) * (1 + K_top))

def IsProhibitedCriticalTuple (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_anc_seq n ∧
    k_anc_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
    0 < ε_seq n ∧
    1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
    rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |j - k_seq n|)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_anc_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => k_seq n - k_anc_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq n) ∧
    Function.Periodic (w_seq n) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w_seq n y) ∧
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w_seq n y) = 1) ∧
  (∀ β A : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ A →
    ∃ C_βA : ℝ, 0 < C_βA ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k_anc_seq n + 3 →
        Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (tileSupModulus S A j x) ^ 2 *
            ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x) ≤
          C_βA * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (β * (k_seq n - j))) ∧
  (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ C_β : ℝ, 0 < C_β ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        |(S.V ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| *
          w_seq n y) ≤
        C_β * (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (2 * β * (k_seq n - k_anc_seq n)) / Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) ∧
  (∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
          (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) *
          ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

structure MomentLawSteepBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq P_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (C_tail : ℝ),
      0 < C_tail ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j ∧ 1 ≤ P_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Filter.Tendsto P_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 - u / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))
        Real.exp Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v →
        m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 + v / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) ≤
          C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)))

structure MomentLawBoundedBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ_star : ℝ → ℝ) (lam C_env P' : ℝ),
      1 ≤ lam ∧
      0 < C_env ∧
      1 ≤ P' ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Continuous ρ_star ∧
      ρ_star 0 = 0 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j + u)))) -
            (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))))
        ρ_star Filter.atTop ∧

def IsProhibitedCriticalTuple (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_anc_seq n ∧
    k_anc_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
    0 < ε_seq n ∧
    1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
    rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |j - k_seq n|)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_anc_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => k_seq n - k_anc_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq n) ∧
    Function.Periodic (w_seq n) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w_seq n y) ∧
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w_seq n y) = 1) ∧
  (∀ β A : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ A →
    ∃ C_βA : ℝ, 0 < C_βA ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k_anc_seq n + 3 →
        Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (tileSupModulus S A j x) ^ 2 *
            ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x) ≤
          C_βA * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (β * (k_seq n - j))) ∧
  (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ C_β : ℝ, 0 < C_β ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        |(S.V ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| *
          w_seq n y) ≤
        C_β * (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (2 * β * (k_seq n - k_anc_seq n)) / Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) ∧
  (∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
          (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) *
          ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

structure MomentLawSteepBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq P_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (C_tail : ℝ),
      0 < C_tail ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j ∧ 1 ≤ P_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Filter.Tendsto P_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 - u / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))
        Real.exp Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v →
        m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 + v / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) ≤
          C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)))

structure MomentLawBoundedBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ_star : ℝ → ℝ) (lam C_env P' : ℝ),
      1 ≤ lam ∧
      0 < C_env ∧
      1 ≤ P' ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Continuous ρ_star ∧
      ρ_star 0 = 0 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j + u)))) -
            (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))))
        ρ_star Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, x_seq j ≤ v →
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - x_seq j) - C_env ≤
          -Real.log (m (Real.exp v))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ x_seq j →
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) - P' * (x_seq j - v) - C_env ≤
          -Real.log (m (Real.exp v))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) ≤ C_env * (1 + x_seq j))

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (k_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (h_basic : ∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n ∧
      0 < ε_seq n ∧ 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n))

    ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℝ → ℝ),
      StrictMono σ ∧
      (∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D) ∧
      m 1 = 1 ∧
      (∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → m D ≤ D⁻¹) ∧

      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn

        m Filter.atTop (Set.Ioi 0)

by

def meshClosedSquare (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | |(z - c).re| ≤ ρ / 2 ∧ |(z - c).im| ≤ ρ / 2 }

def meshPolyTrace : List ℂ → Set ℂ
  | [] => ∅
  | [a] => {a}
  | a :: b :: rest => segment ℝ a b ∪ meshPolyTrace (b :: rest)

noncomputable def meshPolyLength : List ℂ → ℝ
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | a :: b :: rest => ‖b - a‖ + meshPolyLength (b :: rest)

def meshGridAdj4 {W H : ℕ} (p q : Fin W × Fin H) : Prop :=
  |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| + |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| = 1

def meshGridAdj8 {W H : ℕ} (p q : Fin W × Fin H) : Prop :=
  max |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| ≤ 1

  have hb₀_lt_init : b₀ < C_gr.b_init := by dsimp [b₀]; linarith [C_gr.b_init_pos]
  have hb₀_mem_init : b₀ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := ⟨hb₀_pos, hb₀_lt_init⟩
  have h_sub_init : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀ → b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := by
    intro b hb
    exact ⟨hb.1, lt_trans hb.2 hb₀_lt_init⟩
  have hg_mem_strip : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      (θ, C_gr.g_col b θ) ∈ phaseStrip B.h := by
    intro b hb θ
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := C_gr.g_col_bounds b hb θ
    refine ⟨?_, h_hi⟩
    linarith [B.r₀_pos, B.h_pos (θ + Real.pi)]
  let F_raw : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun b θ => P.Theta_plus θ (C_gr.g_col b θ)
  let F_col : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun b x => ϕ_inv (F_raw b (B.ϕ x))
  have hF_raw_cont_init : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F_raw q.1 q.2)
      (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h_pair : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q.2, C_gr.g_col q.1 q.2))
        (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      continuousOn_snd.prodMk C_gr.g_col_cont
    exact P.Theta_plus_cont.comp h_pair (fun q hq => hg_mem_strip hq.1 q.2)
  have hF_col_cont_init : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h_arg : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, B.ϕ p.2)) :=
      continuous_fst.prodMk (hϕ_cont.comp continuous_snd)
    have h_comp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_raw p.1 (B.ϕ p.2))
        (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      hF_raw_cont_init.comp h_arg.continuousOn (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, trivial⟩)
    exact hϕ_inv_cont.comp_continuousOn h_comp
  have hF_col_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Ioo 0 b₀ ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
    hF_col_cont_init.mono (fun p hp => ⟨h_sub_init hp.1, trivial⟩)
  have hF_raw_qp : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      F_raw b (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = F_raw b θ + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro b hb θ
    dsimp [F_raw]
    rw [C_gr.g_col_periodic b hb θ, P.Theta_plus_quasiperiodic θ (C_gr.g_col b θ) (hg_mem_strip hb θ)]
  have hF_col_qp_init : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init → ∀ x : ℝ,
      F_col b (x + 2 * Real.pi) = F_col b x + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro b hb x
    dsimp [F_col]
    rw [B.ϕ_quasiperiodic x, hF_raw_qp hb (B.ϕ x), hϕ_inv_qp]
  have hF_col_step_init : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init → ∀ x : ℝ,
      0 < F_col b x - x ∧ B.ϕ (F_col b x) - B.ϕ x < Real.pi := by
    intro b hb x
    have h_theta_lt : B.ϕ x < F_raw b (B.ϕ x) :=
      (P.Theta_plus_bounds (B.ϕ x) (C_gr.g_col b (B.ϕ x)) (hg_mem_strip hb (B.ϕ x))).1
    have hx_lt : x < F_col b x := by
      have := hϕ_inv_mono h_theta_lt
      rwa [hϕ_left_inv x] at this
    refine ⟨sub_pos.mpr hx_lt, ?_⟩
    dsimp [F_col]
    rw [hϕ_right_inv]
    exact C_gr.F_raw_step_lt_pi b hb (B.ϕ x)
  have hF_col_strictMono_b_init : ∀ b₁ b₂ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < C_gr.b_init →
      ∀ x : ℝ, F_col b₁ x < F_col b₂ x := by
    intro b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ x
    have hb₁_mem : b₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := ⟨hb₁, lt_trans hb₁₂ hb₂⟩
    have hb₂_mem : b₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := ⟨lt_trans hb₁ hb₁₂, hb₂⟩
    have hg_lt := C_gr.g_col_strictAnti_b b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ (B.ϕ x)
    have hθ_lt := P.Theta_plus_strictAnti_p (B.ϕ x)
      (C_gr.g_col b₂ (B.ϕ x)) (C_gr.g_col b₁ (B.ϕ x))
      (hg_mem_strip hb₂_mem (B.ϕ x)) (hg_mem_strip hb₁_mem (B.ϕ x)) hg_lt
    exact hϕ_inv_mono hθ_lt
  have hF_col_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ b₁ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ ∧ b₁ ≤ b₀ ∧
      ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁, ∀ x : ℝ, F_col b x - x < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ_θ, hδ_θ_pos, hδ_θ⟩ := hϕ_inv_unif ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ_p, hδ_p_pos, hδ_p⟩ := P.Theta_plus_tendsto_zero δ_θ hδ_θ_pos
    obtain ⟨b₁_raw, hb₁_raw_pos, hb₁_raw_le, hb₁_raw⟩ := C_gr.g_col_tendsto_h δ_p hδ_p_pos
    refine ⟨min b₁_raw b₀, lt_min hb₁_raw_pos hb₀_pos, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro b hb x
    have hb_raw : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁_raw := ⟨hb.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hb_init : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := ⟨hb.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hb_raw.2 hb₁_raw_le⟩
    let θ := B.ϕ x
    have hg_close : B.h θ - C_gr.g_col b θ < δ_p := hb₁_raw b hb_raw θ
    have h_step_lt : F_raw b θ - θ < δ_θ :=
      (hδ_p θ (C_gr.g_col b θ) (hg_mem_strip hb_init θ) hg_close).1
    have h_step_pos : θ < F_raw b θ :=
      (P.Theta_plus_bounds θ (C_gr.g_col b θ) (hg_mem_strip hb_init θ)).1
    have h_x_eq : x = ϕ_inv θ := (hϕ_left_inv x).symm
    have h_res := hδ_θ θ (F_raw b θ) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr h_step_pos)) h_step_lt
    dsimp [F_col, θ] at h_res ⊢
    linarith [hϕ_left_inv x]
  
  let d_b₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => F_col b₀ x - x
  have hd_b₀_cont : Continuous d_b₀ := by
    have h_open : IsOpen (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) :=
      isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
    have h_b₀_x : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F_col b₀ x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      have h_at : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2) (b₀, x) :=
        hF_col_cont_init.continuousAt (h_open.mem_nhds ⟨hb₀_mem_init, trivial⟩)
      exact h_at.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt
    exact h_b₀_x.sub continuous_id
  have hd_b₀_per : Function.Periodic d_b₀ (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [d_b₀]
    rw [hF_col_qp_init hb₀_mem_init x]
    ring
  obtain ⟨x_min, _, hx_min⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
    ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt h2pi_pos⟩⟩ hd_b₀_cont.continuousOn
  let m₀ : ℝ := d_b₀ x_min
  have hm₀_pos : 0 < m₀ := (hF_col_step_init hb₀_mem_init x_min).1
  have hm₀_le_all : ∀ x : ℝ, m₀ ≤ F_col b₀ x - x := by
    intro x
    let k : ℤ := Int.floor (x / (2 * Real.pi))
    let y : ℝ := x - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (x / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [y]; linarith
    have hy_lt : y < 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [y]; linarith
    have hper_int : d_b₀ x = d_b₀ y := by
      have hx_eq : x = y + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by dsimp [y]; ring
      rw [hx_eq]
      simpa [mul_comm] using hd_b₀_per.int_mul k y
    change m₀ ≤ d_b₀ x
    rw [hper_int]
    exact hx_min ⟨hy0, le_of_lt hy_lt⟩
  let δ_col : ℝ := min m₀ (Real.pi / 2)
  have hδ_col_pos : 0 < δ_col := by
    exact lt_min hm₀_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
  have hδ_col_lt_pi : δ_col < Real.pi := by
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
  have hF_col_iter : ∀ (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      (F_col b)^[n] x = ϕ_inv ((F_raw b)^[n] (B.ϕ x)) := by
    intro b n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x
      simp [hϕ_left_inv x]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih x]
      dsimp [F_col]
      rw [hϕ_right_inv]
  refine ⟨{
    toSupportLazutkinData := B.toSupportLazutkinData
    b₀ := b₀
    δ_col := δ_col
    τ₀ := τ₀
    b₀_pos := hb₀_pos
    δ_col_pos := hδ_col_pos
    δ_col_lt_pi := hδ_col_lt_pi
    τ₀_pos := hτ₀_pos
    F_col := F_col
    F_col_cont := hF_col_cont
    F_col_quasiperiodic := fun b hb x => hF_col_qp_init (h_sub_init hb) x
    F_col_strictMono_x := fun b hb =>
      hϕ_inv_mono.comp ((C_gr.F_raw_strictMono_θ b (h_sub_init hb)).comp hϕ_mono)
    F_col_strictMono_b := fun b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ x =>
      hF_col_strictMono_b_init b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ (lt_trans hb₂ hb₀_lt_init) x
    F_col_step_bounds := fun b hb x => hF_col_step_init (h_sub_init hb) x
    F_col_tendsto_zero := hF_col_tendsto_zero
    F_col_stationary := ?_
    collar_fills_steps := ?_
    forward_step_unique := P.forward_step_unique
    rational_leaf_all_periodic := ?_
  }⟩
  · 
    intro b hb x
    have hb' : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := h_sub_init hb
    let θ₀ : ℝ := B.ϕ x
    let θ₁ : ℝ := F_raw b θ₀
    have hθ₁_eq : B.ϕ (F_col b x) = θ₁ := by
      dsimp [F_col, θ₁, θ₀]
      exact hϕ_right_inv _
    have hθ₂_eq : B.ϕ (F_col b (F_col b x)) = F_raw b θ₁ := by
      dsimp [F_col]
      rw [hϕ_right_inv, hθ₁_eq]
    rw [hθ₁_eq, hθ₂_eq]
    have h1 := (P.Theta_plus_eq θ₁ (C_gr.g_col b θ₁) (hg_mem_strip hb' θ₁)).1
    have h2 := C_gr.g_col_invariant b hb' θ₀
    have h3 := (P.Theta_plus_eq θ₀ (C_gr.g_col b θ₀) (hg_mem_strip hb' θ₀)).2
    dsimp [F_raw, θ₁] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    linarith
  · 
    intro x₀ x₁ hx_pos hx_lt_δ
    have hx₀_lt_x₁ : x₀ < x₁ := sub_pos.mp hx_pos
    have hx₁_lt_top : x₁ < F_col b₀ x₀ := by
      have hm₀_le := hm₀_le_all x₀
      have hδ_le : δ_col ≤ m₀ := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    let γ : ℝ → ℝ := fun b => if b ≤ 0 then x₀ else F_col b x₀
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = x₀ := by simp [γ]
    have hγ_b₀ : γ b₀ = F_col b₀ x₀ := by simp [γ, not_le.mpr hb₀_pos]
    have hγ_cont : ContinuousOn γ (Set.Icc 0 b₀) := by
      intro b hb
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb.1 with rfl | hb_pos
      · rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, hb₁_le, hb₁⟩ := hF_col_tendsto_zero ε hε
        refine ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, ?_⟩
        intro b' hb' hdist
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb'.1 with rfl | hb'_pos
        · simp [hγ0, hε]
        · have hb'_lt_b₁ : b' < b₁ := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hb'_pos] at hdist
            exact hdist
          have hb'_mem : b' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁ := ⟨hb'_pos, hb'_lt_b₁⟩
          have hb'_init : b' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init :=
            ⟨hb'_pos, lt_trans (lt_of_lt_of_le hb'_lt_b₁ hb₁_le) hb₀_lt_init⟩
          have h_step_pos : 0 < F_col b' x₀ - x₀ := (hF_col_step_init hb'_init x₀).1
          have h_step_lt : F_col b' x₀ - x₀ < ε := hb₁ b' hb'_mem x₀
          have hγ_b' : γ b' = F_col b' x₀ := by simp [γ, not_le.mpr hb'_pos]
          rw [hγ_b', hγ0, Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos h_step_pos]
          exact h_step_lt
      · have hb_init : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init := ⟨hb_pos, lt_of_le_of_lt hb.2 hb₀_lt_init⟩
        have h_open_prod : IsOpen (Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) :=
          isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
        have hF_at : ContinuousAt (fun b' : ℝ => F_col b' x₀) b := by
          have h_at2 : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2) (b, x₀) :=
            hF_col_cont_init.continuousAt (h_open_prod.mem_nhds ⟨hb_init, trivial⟩)
          have h_map : Continuous (fun b' : ℝ => (b', x₀)) :=
            continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
          exact ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2)
            (f := fun b' : ℝ => (b', x₀)) h_at2 h_map.continuousAt
        have h_eq : γ =ᶠ[nhds b] (fun b' : ℝ => F_col b' x₀) := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hb_init] with b' hb'
          simp [γ, not_le.mpr hb'.1]
        exact (hF_at.congr h_eq.symm).continuousWithinAt
    have hx₁_mem : x₁ ∈ Set.Icc (γ 0) (γ b₀) :=
      ⟨by rw [hγ0]; exact le_of_lt hx₀_lt_x₁, by rw [hγ_b₀]; exact le_of_lt hx₁_lt_top⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb_mem, hb_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hb₀_pos) hγ_cont hx₁_mem
    have hb_ne_zero : b ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, hγ0] at hb_eq
      linarith
    have hb_ne_b₀ : b ≠ b₀ := by
      intro hb0
      rw [hb0, hγ_b₀] at hb_eq
      linarith
    have hb_pos : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb_mem.1 (Ne.symm hb_ne_zero)
    have hb_lt_b₀ : b < b₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hb_mem.2 hb_ne_b₀
    have hF_b : F_col b x₀ = x₁ := by
      have hγ_b : γ b = F_col b x₀ := by simp [γ, not_le.mpr hb_pos]
      rwa [hγ_b] at hb_eq
    refine ⟨b, ⟨⟨hb_pos, hb_lt_b₀⟩, hF_b⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro b' ⟨hb'_mem, hF_b'⟩
    rcases lt_trichotomy b' b with hlt | rfl | hgt
    · exfalso
      have := hF_col_strictMono_b_init b' b hb'_mem.1 hlt (lt_trans hb_lt_b₀ hb₀_lt_init) x₀
      linarith
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      have := hF_col_strictMono_b_init b b' hb_pos hgt (lt_trans hb'_mem.2 hb₀_lt_init) x₀
      linarith
  · 
    intro l q hl hq hcop hlt
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb, h_all⟩, h_any⟩ := hRat l q hl hq hcop hlt
    refine ⟨⟨b, hb, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro x
      rw [hF_col_iter b q x, h_all (B.ϕ x)]
      have h_comm : B.ϕ x + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) = B.ϕ x + (l : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
      rw [h_comm, hϕ_inv_shift_nat l (B.ϕ x), hϕ_left_inv x]
      ring
    · intro b' hb' ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
      have h_θ₀ : (F_raw b')^[q] (B.ϕ x₀) = B.ϕ x₀ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) := by
        have h_it := hF_col_iter b' q x₀
        rw [hx₀] at h_it
        have h_ap := congrArg B.ϕ h_it
        rw [hϕ_right_inv] at h_ap
        have h_comm : x₀ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) = x₀ + (l : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
        rw [h_comm, hϕ_shift_nat l x₀] at h_ap
        linarith
      have h_all' := h_any b' hb' ⟨B.ϕ x₀, h_θ₀⟩
      intro x
      rw [hF_col_iter b' q x, h_all' (B.ϕ x)]
      have h_comm : B.ϕ x + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) = B.ϕ x + (l : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
      rw [h_comm, hϕ_inv_shift_nat l (B.ϕ x), hϕ_left_inv x]
      ring

rational_caustic_collar_graphs.definitions:
noncomputable def supportBoundaryPt (c₀ : Plane) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ

def phaseStrip (h : ℝ → ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  { z : ℝ × ℝ | -h (z.1 + Real.pi) < z.2 ∧ z.2 < h z.1 }

structure SupportBoundaryPackage (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  r₀ : ℝ
  r₀_pos : 0 < r₀
  closedBall_subset : Metric.closedBall c₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆ Ω
  two_r₀_le_h : ∀ θ : ℝ, 2 * r₀ ≤ h θ
  Γ_mem_frontier : ∀ θ : ℝ, supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ ∈ frontier Ω
  Γ_inj_mod_two_pi : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
    supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₁ = supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₂ →
    ∃ k : ℤ, θ₁ - θ₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
  Γ_outward_normal : ∀ θ : ℝ,
    IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω (supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ) (unitNormalVec θ)
  support_bound_closure : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ closure Ω,
    inner ℝ (x - c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) ≤ h θ

structure SupportPhaseMapData (Ω : Set Plane) (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω) where
  Theta_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  P_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  Theta_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  P_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  Theta_plus_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Theta_plus z.1 z.2) (phaseStrip B.h)
  Theta_minus_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Theta_minus z.1 z.2) (phaseStrip B.h)
  Theta_plus_bounds : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    θ < Theta_plus θ p ∧ Theta_plus θ p < θ + 2 * Real.pi
  Theta_minus_bounds : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    θ - 2 * Real.pi < Theta_minus θ p ∧ Theta_minus θ p < θ
  Theta_plus_quasiperiodic : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    Theta_plus (θ + 2 * Real.pi) p = Theta_plus θ p + 2 * Real.pi
  Theta_plus_strictAnti_p : ∀ θ p₁ p₂ : ℝ,
    (θ, p₁) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → (θ, p₂) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → p₁ < p₂ →
    Theta_plus θ p₂ < Theta_plus θ p₁
  Theta_plus_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ_p : ℝ, 0 < δ_p ∧
    ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → B.h θ - p < δ_p →
      Theta_plus θ p - θ < ε ∧ B.r₀ < P_plus θ p
  Theta_minus_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ_p : ℝ, 0 < δ_p ∧
    ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → B.h θ - p < δ_p →
      θ - Theta_minus θ p < ε ∧ B.r₀ < P_minus θ p
  Theta_plus_eq : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    -supportAction1_ℝ B.h θ (Theta_plus θ p) = p ∧
    P_plus θ p = supportAction2_ℝ B.h θ (Theta_plus θ p)
  P_minus_eq : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    P_minus θ p = -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (Theta_minus θ p) θ
  Phi_maps_to : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →

noncomputable def supportBoundaryPt (c₀ : Plane) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ

def phaseStrip (h : ℝ → ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  { z : ℝ × ℝ | -h (z.1 + Real.pi) < z.2 ∧ z.2 < h z.1 }

structure SupportBoundaryPackage (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  r₀ : ℝ
  r₀_pos : 0 < r₀
  closedBall_subset : Metric.closedBall c₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆ Ω
  two_r₀_le_h : ∀ θ : ℝ, 2 * r₀ ≤ h θ
  Γ_mem_frontier : ∀ θ : ℝ, supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ ∈ frontier Ω
  Γ_inj_mod_two_pi : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
    supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₁ = supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₂ →
    ∃ k : ℤ, θ₁ - θ₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
  Γ_outward_normal : ∀ θ : ℝ,
    IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω (supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ) (unitNormalVec θ)
  support_bound_closure : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ closure Ω,
    inner ℝ (x - c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) ≤ h θ

    -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂') = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) →
    x₂ = x₂'
  chord_reflection : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    ∃ P Q : Plane, P ∈ frontier Ω ∧ Q ∈ frontier Ω ∧ P ≠ Q ∧

            inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (Theta_plus θ p)) = P_plus θ p) ∧
          R - Q = ‖R - Q‖ • unitTangentVec (Theta_plus θ p)) ∧
      (∃ n_P : Plane, IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω P n_P ∧
        ∀ R' ∈ frontier Ω, R' ≠ P →
          (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ R' = P + s • billiardReflect n_P (‖P - Q‖⁻¹ • (P - Q))) →
          (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ P R',
            inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (Theta_minus θ p)) = P_minus θ p) ∧

noncomputable def primPhi_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ζ in (0 : ℝ)..z, Real.exp (w ζ)

noncomputable def midpoint_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) ((primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2)

noncomputable def normAction_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
      (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) -
    (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y,
      (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w z)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z))

noncomputable def normAction1_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (w X) * ∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
    Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)

def IsCandidateRealMesh (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (X : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  X 0 = x ∧
  X q = x + 2 * Real.pi ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    |X j - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    |(X (j + 1) - X j) - 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → X j = 0)

def IsStationaryRealMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (X : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsCandidateRealMesh q x X ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
    normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X (j + 2)) - normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X j) = 0

def HasUniqueGlobalMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  4 ≤ q ∧
  Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w ∧
  ∀ x : ℝ, ∃! X : ℕ → ℝ, IsStationaryRealMesh q w x X

open Classical in
noncomputable def realMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  if h : HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w then Classical.choose (h.2.2.2 x).exists else fun _ => 0

noncomputable def critAction_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, normAction_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))

open Classical in
noncomputable def globalC_coeff (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 0
  else if HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w then
    -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ n.natAbs w x : ℂ))
  else 0

noncomputable def cellKernelMinus_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z) -
    Real.exp (w z) * ∫ ζ in z..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
      Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)

noncomputable def halfCellMinus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=

open Classical in
noncomputable def globalB_mult (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 1
  else if HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w then
    -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
        ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m j
           let Y_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m (j + 1)
           let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
           let term_m : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
               deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p j
           let Y_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p (j + 1)
           let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
           let term_p : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
               deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           term_m + term_p)
  else 1

noncomputable def realDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    r = |iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂) y| }

noncomputable def stripDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
    r = ‖iteratedDeriv j (W₁ - W₂) ζ‖ }

noncomputable def realMeshDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def realMidpointDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) -
    (realMesh q w x j + (realMesh q w x (j + 1) - realMesh q w x j) / 2)

structure StationaryMeshSystem (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  R_mesh : ℝ
  K_mesh : ℝ
  N_mesh : ℕ
  R_mesh_pos : 0 < R_mesh
  K_mesh_pos : 0 < K_mesh
  N_mesh_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mesh
  real_mesh_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w ∧
    realMeshDisp q w 0 = 0 ∧
    realMeshDisp q w q = 0 ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      Function.Periodic (realMeshDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMeshDisp q w j) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMeshDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      Function.Periodic (realMidpointDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDisp q w j) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) x| ≤
          R_mesh) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh))
  real_mesh_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w₁ j y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
            (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)
  strip_mesh_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    ∃ (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),

      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),

        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),

        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh))
  strip_mesh_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),

    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →

    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →

      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₁ j x = realMesh q w₁ x j) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₂ j x = realMesh q w₂ x j)) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₁ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₁ (realMesh q w₁ x j) (realMesh q w₁ x (j + 1))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₂ (realMesh q w₂ x j) (realMesh q w₂ x (j + 1)))) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ₁ j ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) - (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ)) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *

noncomputable def halfCellPlus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) +
    α * (realMesh q w x (j + 1) - midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)))

noncomputable def halfCellInvMinus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) z

noncomputable def halfCellInvPlus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) z

open Classical in
noncomputable def globalB_mult (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 1
  else if HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w then
    -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
        ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m j
           let Y_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m (j + 1)
           let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
           let term_m : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
               deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p j
           let Y_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p (j + 1)
           let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
           let term_p : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
               deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           term_m + term_p)
  else 1

noncomputable def realDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    r = |iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂) y| }

noncomputable def stripDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
    r = ‖iteratedDeriv j (W₁ - W₂) ζ‖ }

noncomputable def realMeshDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def realMidpointDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) -
    (realMesh q w x j + (realMesh q w x (j + 1) - realMesh q w x j) / 2)

structure StationaryMeshSystem (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  R_mesh : ℝ
  K_mesh : ℝ
  N_mesh : ℕ
  R_mesh_pos : 0 < R_mesh
  K_mesh_pos : 0 < K_mesh
  N_mesh_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mesh
  real_mesh_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w ∧
    realMeshDisp q w 0 = 0 ∧
    realMeshDisp q w q = 0 ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      Function.Periodic (realMeshDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMeshDisp q w j) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMeshDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      Function.Periodic (realMidpointDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDisp q w j) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) x| ≤
          R_mesh) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh))
  real_mesh_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w₁ j y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
            (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)
  strip_mesh_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    ∃ (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh))
  strip_mesh_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₁ j x = realMesh q w₁ x j) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₂ j x = realMesh q w₂ x j)) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₁ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₁ (realMesh q w₁ x j) (realMesh q w₁ x (j + 1))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₂ (realMesh q w₂ x j) (realMesh q w₂ x (j + 1)))) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ₁ j ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) - (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ)) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (μ_ℂ₁ j ζ - (X_ℂ₁ j ζ + (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) / 2)) -
              (μ_ℂ₂ j ζ - (X_ℂ₂ j ζ + (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) / 2))) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

subgoal_signatures.name: table_and_zero_action_vanishing
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (R : RationalCollarData Ω) :
    ∃ N_vanish : ℕ, 1 ≤ N_vanish ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (N_vanish : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        globalC_coeff n (fun _ => 0) = 0 ∧
        globalC_coeff n (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x)) = 0)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁) :
    Nonempty (StationaryMeshSystem m M₁)

subgoal_signatures.name: real_action_deriv_and_multiplier_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) :
    ∃ (K_real : ℝ) (N_real : ℕ), 0 < K_real ∧ S.N_mesh ≤ N_real ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ), (N_real : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (globalB_mult n w) ∧
          Function.Periodic (globalB_mult n w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
          (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
            ContDiff ℝ ((m + 15 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
            HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => globalC_coeff n (fun x => w x + t * v x))
              (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * globalB_mult n w x * (v x : ℂ))
              0) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w y - 1) x‖ ≤ K_real / |(n : ℝ)|)) ∧
        (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w₁ y - globalB_mult n w₂ y) x‖ ≤
              (K_real / |(n : ℝ)|) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

subgoal_signatures.name: strip_multiplier_extension_and_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) :
    ∃ (K_strip : ℝ) (N_strip : ℕ), S.K_mesh < K_strip ∧ S.N_mesh ≤ N_strip ∧
      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (n : ℤ), σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 → (N_strip : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
          IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
          ∃ B : ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ B (horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
            (∀ x : ℝ, B x = globalB_mult n w x) ∧
            (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ), B (z + 2 * Real.pi) = B z) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
              ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => B ζ - 1) z‖ ≤ K_strip / |(n : ℝ)|)) ∧
        (∀ (K' : ℝ), K_strip ≤ K' → K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
          ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ B₁ B₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
            IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
            IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
            IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₁ W₁ →
            IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₂ W₂ →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ B₁ (horizStrip ((1 - K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ B₂ (horizStrip ((1 - K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) →
            (∀ x : ℝ, B₁ x = globalB_mult n w₁ x) →
            (∀ x : ℝ, B₂ x = globalB_mult n w₂ x) →
            ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
              ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => B₁ ζ - B₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
                (K_strip / |(n : ℝ)|) * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

by

  obtain ⟨N_op, hN_op_van, hW⟩ := high_mode_wiener_operator_inversion Ω R H_sys'
  obtain ⟨N_init, _, hInit⟩ := initial_truncation_wiener_residual Ω R H_sys'
  let N : ℕ := max N_op N_init

analytic_boundary_regularity.definitions:
noncomputable def periodicFourierCoeff (f : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * f x

noncomputable def fourierSeriesℂ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' k : ℤ, c k * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)

noncomputable def fourierSeriesℝ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (fourierSeriesℂ c (x : ℂ)).re

noncomputable def uTable {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x)

noncomputable def uTableCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  periodicFourierCoeff (fun x => (uTable R x : ℂ)) k

noncomputable def uTableBound {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) : ℝ :=
  8 * Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑' k : ℤ, (1 + |(k : ℝ)|) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖)

noncomputable def uTruncCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω) (P : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  if |k| ≤ (P : ℤ) then uTableCoeff R k else 0

structure WienerHighModeAt {Ω : Set Plane} (R : RationalCollarData Ω)
    (H_sys : HighFreqActionSystem (uTable R)) (N : ℕ) where
  N_pos : 1 ≤ N
  C_quad : ℝ
  C_lip : ℝ
  C_quad_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_quad
  C_lip_pos : 0 < C_lip
  solve_high : ∀ (σ ε : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℤ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 ≤ ε →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w →
    IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ (3 * uTableBound R / 4) w W →
    (∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| → y (-n) = starRingEnd ℂ (y n)) →
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖y n‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) →
    (∑' n : ℤ, if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖y n‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) ≤ ε →
    ∃ c : ℤ → ℂ,
      (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, |k| < (N : ℤ) → c k = 0) ∧
      Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) ∧
      (∑' k : ℤ, ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * H_sys.b_mult n w x *

noncomputable def r_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  B.h_ℂ w + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w

noncomputable def normAction1_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) + B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X))

noncomputable def normAction2_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) - B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ Y))

noncomputable def normAction12_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) *
    Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)

noncomputable def normActionRem_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X b : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 6 : ℂ) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)

noncomputable def sinc_ℂ (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)

noncomputable def fourierDiffMult (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)

noncomputable def fourierCoeff_ℂ (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * F ((x : ℂ), t)

noncomputable def glancingDiffOp (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', p.2)) (p.1 + (μ : ℂ) * p.2)

noncomputable def glancingAvgPlus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingAvgMinus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingSecondAvg (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    (∫ μ in (-lam)..lam, deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t))) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))

noncomputable def glancingResidualOp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let Up := deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) y
  let A_p := glancingAvgPlus U y t
  let A_m := glancingAvgMinus U y t
  let C_pm := glancingSecondAvg U y t
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * Up * (A_p + A_m) * C_pm +
    t * Up *
      (A_p ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (t * A_p) -
        A_m ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (-t * A_m))

noncomputable def glancingPhaseSlope {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + (μ : ℂ) * t, t)) *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingLinCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let U_m := U (y - t / 2, t)
  let U_p := U (y + t / 2, t)
  let W := glancingPhaseSlope B U y t
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ U_m + B.ϕ_ℂ U_p) / 2) *
    W * sinc_ℂ (t * W) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - t / 2) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + t / 2)

    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧

    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), glancingResidualOp B U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (glancingResidualOp B U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => glancingResidualOp B (U_seq n) p)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (glancingResidualOp B U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, glancingResidualOp B U p = 0) →
