        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u y' - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ ^ 3 * deriv u y *
          (normAction1_ℂ B (u y) (u (y + t)) + normAction2_ℂ B (u (y - t)) (u y))) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ * normAction12_ℂ B (u (y - t / 2)) (u (y + t / 2)) *
          deriv u (y - t / 2) * deriv u (y + t / 2))
  enlarged_holo_and_bounds : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_t → V_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ V_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ →
      ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ M_E) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ →
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  linCoeff_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  slice_quad_approx : ∀ (σ ρ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u v : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → ‖t‖ < d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => u z' - z') z‖ ≤ η_adm) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => deriv u z' * v z') z‖ ≤ ρ) →
    ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1 + deriv u q.1 * v q.1) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp
        (fun q =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => u r.1) (q.1, t) *
            glancingDiffOp (fun r => v r.1) (q.1, t))
        (y, t) +
        deriv
          (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun r => u r.1) (z, t) * v z)
          y)‖ ≤ C_quad * ρ ^ 2
  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t₀ → 0 < r_t → t₀ + r_t ≤ d_act →
    0 < σ' → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → σ ≤ s_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_cand (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_cand (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, glancingResidualOp B U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ',
      let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ))
      let z_jet : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun z => deriv (fun t : ℂ => U_cand (z, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv u_star z
      deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_cand (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun q =>
            glancingLinCoeff B U_cand (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
              (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z_jet r.1) (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ))

def RationalCompatProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_rat : ℝ) (B_rat : ℕ), 0 < C_rat ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      C_rat * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_rat * ε ≤ 1 →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ (l : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
        l ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q →
        let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
        |t₀| < d - 2 * δ →
        ∃ W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
            (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
            W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t)) ∧
          (let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
           let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
           DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
             (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
             g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
             ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ∧
             ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun y : ℂ =>
               deriv
                 (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
                 (t₀ : ℂ))
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
             ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤
               C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2 ∧
             ‖deriv
                 (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
                 (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤
               C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2))

def BufferedFourierDivProp : Prop :=
  (∀ (σ M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z ∧ ‖G z‖ ≤ M) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * σ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
      HasSum
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * y))
        (G y))) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    |t.im| / 2 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : ℂ => G (y, t)) (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, G (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = G (y, t)) →
    ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (glancingDiffOp G) n t = fourierDiffMult n t * fourierCoeff_ℂ G n t) ∧
  ∃ (C_div : ℝ) (B_div : ℕ), 0 < C_div ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b J : ℕ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
      (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
      j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → max a (b + 1) + 1 ≤ J → J ≤ 20 →
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) →
        F (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (y, -t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (F (y, t)) ∧
        ‖F (y, t)‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ),
        1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
        |(2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ F n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      ∃ (H_mode R_mode : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, n = 0 ∨ (N : ℤ) < |n| → ∀ t : ℂ, H_mode n t = 0 ∧ R_mode n t = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_mode n)
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
          Differentiable ℂ (R_mode n) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
            fourierDiffMult n t * H_mode n t = fourierCoeff_ℂ F n t - R_mode n t ∧
            ‖R_mode n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv (R_mode n) t‖ ≤
              C_div * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_div * η *
                Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2)))) ∧
        (let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun p =>
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              H_mode n p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * p.1)
         let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
         DifferentiableOn ℂ H
           (glancingDomain 0 (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ →
           H (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (y, -t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (H (y, t)) ∧
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain (ν - 1 / 2) (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖H p‖ ≤ C_div * Q ^ B_div * (M + η)) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖glancingDiffOp H p - F p‖ ≤
             C_div * Q ^ B_div * (η + M * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ))))

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def r_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  B.h_ℂ w + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w

noncomputable def normAction1_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) + B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X))

noncomputable def normAction2_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) - B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ Y))

noncomputable def normAction12_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) *
    Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)

noncomputable def normActionRem_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X b : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 6 : ℂ) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)

noncomputable def sinc_ℂ (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)

noncomputable def fourierDiffMult (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)

noncomputable def fourierCoeff_ℂ (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * F ((x : ℂ), t)

noncomputable def glancingDiffOp (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', p.2)) (p.1 + (μ : ℂ) * p.2)

noncomputable def glancingAvgPlus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingAvgMinus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingSecondAvg (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    (∫ μ in (-lam)..lam, deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t))) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))

noncomputable def glancingResidualOp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let Up := deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) y
  let A_p := glancingAvgPlus U y t
  let A_m := glancingAvgMinus U y t
  let C_pm := glancingSecondAvg U y t
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * Up * (A_p + A_m) * C_pm +
    t * Up *
      (A_p ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (t * A_p) -
        A_m ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (-t * A_m))

noncomputable def glancingPhaseSlope {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + (μ : ℂ) * t, t)) *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingLinCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let U_m := U (y - t / 2, t)
  let U_p := U (y + t / 2, t)
  let W := glancingPhaseSlope B U y t
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ U_m + B.ϕ_ℂ U_p) / 2) *
    W * sinc_ℂ (t * W) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - t / 2) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + t / 2)

structure GlancingScalePackage {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  M_act : ℝ
  M_E : ℝ
  C_quad : ℝ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le_half_s₀ : s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2
  s_act_le_one : s_act ≤ 1
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt_half_s_act : d_act < s_act / 2
  d_act_lt_one : d_act < 1
  d_act_lt_half_δ_col : d_act < B.δ_col / 2
  d_act_lt_half_τ₀ : d_act < B.τ₀ / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le_inv32 : η_adm ≤ 1 / 32
  η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ : η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4
  M_act_pos : 0 < M_act
  M_E_pos : 0 < M_E
  C_quad_pos : 0 < C_quad
  partial_y_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, -t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U (y, t))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), glancingResidualOp B U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (glancingResidualOp B U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => glancingResidualOp B (U_seq n) p)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (glancingResidualOp B U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, glancingResidualOp B U p = 0) →
    ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| + ‖t‖ < s → ‖t‖ < d →
      -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u y' - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ ^ 3 * deriv u y *
          (normAction1_ℂ B (u y) (u (y + t)) + normAction2_ℂ B (u (y - t)) (u y))) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ * normAction12_ℂ B (u (y - t / 2)) (u (y + t / 2)) *
          deriv u (y - t / 2) * deriv u (y + t / 2))
  enlarged_holo_and_bounds : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_t → V_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ V_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ →
      ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ M_E) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ →
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  linCoeff_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  slice_quad_approx : ∀ (σ ρ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u v : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → ‖t‖ < d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => u z' - z') z‖ ≤ η_adm) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => deriv u z' * v z') z‖ ≤ ρ) →
    ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1 + deriv u q.1 * v q.1) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp
        (fun q =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => u r.1) (q.1, t) *
            glancingDiffOp (fun r => v r.1) (q.1, t))
        (y, t) +
        deriv
          (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun r => u r.1) (z, t) * v z)
          y)‖ ≤ C_quad * ρ ^ 2
  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t₀ → 0 < r_t → t₀ + r_t ≤ d_act →
    0 < σ' → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → σ ≤ s_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_cand (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_cand (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, glancingResidualOp B U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ',
      let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ))
      let z_jet : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun z => deriv (fun t : ℂ => U_cand (z, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv u_star z
      deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_cand (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun q =>
            glancingLinCoeff B U_cand (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
              (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z_jet r.1) (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ))

def RationalCompatProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_rat : ℝ) (B_rat : ℕ), 0 < C_rat ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      C_rat * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_rat * ε ≤ 1 →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ (l : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
        l ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q →
        let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
        |t₀| < d - 2 * δ →
        ∃ W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
            (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
            W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t)) ∧
          (let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
           let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
           DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
             (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
             g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
             ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ∧
             ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun y : ℂ =>
               deriv
                 (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
                 (t₀ : ℂ))
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
             ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤

def BufferedFourierDivProp : Prop :=
  (∀ (σ M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z ∧ ‖G z‖ ≤ M) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * σ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
      HasSum
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * y))
        (G y))) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    |t.im| / 2 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : ℂ => G (y, t)) (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, G (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = G (y, t)) →
    ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (glancingDiffOp G) n t = fourierDiffMult n t * fourierCoeff_ℂ G n t) ∧
  ∃ (C_div : ℝ) (B_div : ℕ), 0 < C_div ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b J : ℕ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
      (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
      j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → max a (b + 1) + 1 ≤ J → J ≤ 20 →
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) →
        F (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (y, -t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (F (y, t)) ∧
        ‖F (y, t)‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ),
        1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
        |(2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ F n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      ∃ (H_mode R_mode : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, n = 0 ∨ (N : ℤ) < |n| → ∀ t : ℂ, H_mode n t = 0 ∧ R_mode n t = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_mode n)
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
          Differentiable ℂ (R_mode n) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
            fourierDiffMult n t * H_mode n t = fourierCoeff_ℂ F n t - R_mode n t ∧
            ‖R_mode n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv (R_mode n) t‖ ≤
              C_div * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_div * η *
                Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2)))) ∧
        (let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun p =>
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              H_mode n p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * p.1)
         let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
         DifferentiableOn ℂ H
           (glancingDomain 0 (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ →
           H (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (y, -t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (H (y, t)) ∧
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain (ν - 1 / 2) (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖H p‖ ≤ C_div * Q ^ B_div * (M + η)) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖glancingDiffOp H p - F p‖ ≤
             C_div * Q ^ B_div * (η + M * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ))))

              have hineq : ‖τ_seq n‖ ^ k * ‖glancingIterDslopeAtZero k gy (τ_seq n)‖ ≤

      let c_j : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => glancingIterDslopeAtZero (2 * j) (fun τ => F (y, τ)) 0

      let C_rem : ℝ := 1 + (2 * B2j) / R ^ 2

      let τ_r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => r_t / ((n : ℝ) + 2)

    let s_stage : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (3 / 4 - (j : ℝ) / (4 * ((m : ℝ) + 1))) * G.s_act

      have h_tend_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G.E_op (U_seq n) p)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (G.E_op U_lim p)) :=
        G.E_op_cont s_lim d_lim U_seq U_lim
          hs_lim_pos hs_lim_le hd_lim_pos hd_lim_le hd_lim_lt
          hAdm_seq_full hAdm_lim_full hUnif_diff p hp
      have h_ε_tend : Filter.Tendsto ε_bar Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h_eq : ε_bar = fun n : ℕ => d₀ ^ A_exp * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ A_exp) ^ n := by
          ext n; dsimp [ε_bar]
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow, ← _root_.inv_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm n A_exp, pow_mul,
            ← one_div]
        rw [h_eq]
        have hpow_lt1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ A_exp < 1 :=
          pow_lt_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hA_pos.ne'
        simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by positivity) hpow_lt1).const_mul (d₀ ^ A_exp)
      have h_tend_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G.E_op (U_seq n) p)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun n => ?_) h_ε_tend
        have hp_n : p ∈ glancingDomain 1 (s_seq n) (d_seq n) :=
          ⟨hp.1.trans (hd_seq_bounds n).1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (by linarith [(hs_seq_bounds n).1])⟩
        exact (hU_seq_good n).2 p hp_n
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_tend_lim h_tend_zero
    exact ⟨s_lim, d_lim, U_lim, hs_lim_pos, hs_lim_le, hd_lim_pos, hd_lim_le, hd_lim_lt,
      hAdm_lim, hE_zero⟩
  
  have h_stage3 : ∀ (s_lim d_lim : ℝ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s_lim → s_lim ≤ G.s_act →
      0 < d_lim → d_lim ≤ G.d_act → d_lim < s_lim / 2 →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s_lim d_lim (G.η_adm / 2) U_lim →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s_lim d_lim, G.E_op U_lim p = 0) →
      Nonempty (NormalizedGlancingData B) := by
    clear h_stage1 h_stage2
    intro s_lim d_lim U_lim hs_pos hs_le hd_pos hd_le hd_lt hAdm hZero
    have hη_pos : 0 < G.η_adm := G.η_adm_pos
    have hη_le : G.η_adm ≤ 1 / 4 := G.η_adm_le
    have hs₀_pos : 0 < B.s₀ := B.s₀_pos
    have hs_le_s₀ : s_lim ≤ B.s₀ := hs_le.trans G.s_act_le
    have hAdm_full : IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s_lim d_lim G.η_adm U_lim := by
      refine ⟨hAdm.1, hAdm.2.1, hAdm.2.2.1, hAdm.2.2.2.1, fun k hk y t hyt => ?_⟩
      exact (hAdm.2.2.2.2 k hk y t hyt).trans (by linarith)
    have hOpenStrip : IsOpen (horizStrip s_lim) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hConvStrip : Convex ℝ (horizStrip s_lim) := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      change |z₁.im| < s_lim at hz₁
      change |z₂.im| < s_lim at hz₂
      change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < s_lim
      calc |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im|
          = |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im| := by simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul]
        _ ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ < a * s_lim + b * s_lim := by
            rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha with ha' | rfl
            · exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁ ha')
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hz₂) hb)
            · simp only [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simp [hz₂]
        _ = s_lim := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    let f₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => U_lim (y, 0)
    have hf₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ (horizStrip s_lim) := by
      refine hAdm.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (0 : ℂ))).differentiableOn ?_
      intro y hy
      simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos, horizStrip] at hy ⊢
      linarith
    have hE0 := (G.E_op_props s_lim d_lim U_lim hs_pos hs_le hd_pos hd_le hd_lt hAdm_full).2.2.2
    have hf₀_deriv2 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip s_lim, deriv (deriv f₀) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy0_mem : (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s_lim d_lim := by
        simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos]; exact hy
      have hEq0 : (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv f₀ y) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv f₀) y = 0 := by
        rw [← hE0 y hy, hZero (y, 0) hy0_mem]
      have hf₀_diffAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ f₀ y := hf₀_holo.differentiableAt (hOpenStrip.mem_nhds hy)
      have h_iter1 : iteratedDeriv 1 (fun y' : ℂ => U_lim (y', 0) - y') y = deriv f₀ y - 1 := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
        exact ((hf₀_diffAt.hasDerivAt.sub (hasDerivAt_id y)).deriv)
      have hy0_d0 : (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s_lim d_lim := by
        simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos]; linarith [show |y.im| < s_lim from hy]
      have hnorm1 : ‖deriv f₀ y - 1‖ ≤ G.η_adm / 2 := by
        rw [← h_iter1]; exact hAdm.2.2.2.2 1 (by omega) y 0 hy0_d0
      have hdf₀_ne : deriv f₀ y ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        rw [hzero] at hnorm1
        simp at hnorm1
        linarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hEq0 with hleft | hright
      · exfalso
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hleft with hquarter | hsq
        · norm_num at hquarter
        · exact pow_ne_zero 2 hdf₀_ne hsq
      · exact hright
    have hdf₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv f₀) (horizStrip s_lim) :=
      hf₀_holo.deriv hOpenStrip
    have hdf₀_const : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip s_lim, deriv f₀ y = deriv f₀ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      exact hOpenStrip.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hConvStrip.isPreconnected hdf₀_holo
        (fun z hz => hf₀_deriv2 z hz) hy (by simp [horizStrip, hs_pos])
    let g₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => f₀ y - y
    have hg₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₀ (horizStrip s_lim) :=
      hf₀_holo.sub differentiableOn_id
    let hlin : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => g₀ y - (deriv f₀ 0 - 1) * y
    have hhlin_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ hlin (horizStrip s_lim) :=
      hg₀_holo.sub (differentiableOn_id.const_mul _)
    have hhlin_deriv : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip s_lim, deriv hlin y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hf₀_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ f₀ y := hf₀_holo.differentiableAt (hOpenStrip.mem_nhds hy)
      have hd : HasDerivAt hlin ((deriv f₀ y - 1) - (deriv f₀ 0 - 1) * 1) y :=
        (hf₀_da.hasDerivAt.sub (hasDerivAt_id y)).sub ((hasDerivAt_id y).const_mul (deriv f₀ 0 - 1))
      rw [hd.deriv, hdf₀_const y hy]
      ring
    have hhlin_const : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip s_lim, hlin y = hlin 0 := by
      intro y hy
      exact hOpenStrip.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hConvStrip.isPreconnected hhlin_holo
        (fun z hz => hhlin_deriv z hz) hy (by simp [horizStrip, hs_pos])
    have hc1_eq : deriv f₀ 0 = 1 := by
      have h2pi_mem : (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s_lim := by simp [horizStrip, hs_pos]
      have hqp := hAdm.2.1 0 0 (by simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos, hs_pos])
      have hg₀_2pi : g₀ (2 * Real.pi) = g₀ 0 := by
        simp only [g₀, f₀]
        have : (0 : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := by ring
        rw [← this, hqp]
        ring
      have hh := hhlin_const (2 * Real.pi) h2pi_mem
      simp only [hlin, hg₀_2pi, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hh
      have hmul : (deriv f₀ 0 - 1) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination -hh
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hsub | h2pi
      · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
      · exfalso
        have : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        exact this (by exact_mod_cast h2pi)
    let c_shift : ℝ := (U_lim (0, 0)).re
    have hc_shift_eq : U_lim (0, 0) = (c_shift : ℂ) := by
      have hconj0 := hAdm.2.2.2.1 0 0 (by simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos, hs_pos])
      simp only [map_zero] at hconj0
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [c_shift]
      · have him := congr_arg Complex.im hconj0
        simp at him ⊢
        linarith
    have hU_lim_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip s_lim, U_lim (y, 0) = y + (c_shift : ℂ) := by
      intro y hy
      have hh := hhlin_const y hy
      simp only [hlin, hc1_eq, sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero, g₀, f₀] at hh
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hh, hc_shift_eq]
      ring
    have hLip_t : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_lim → ‖t‖ < d_lim →
        ‖U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)‖ ≤ (G.η_adm / d_lim) * ‖t‖ := by
      intro y t hy ht
      let gt : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => U_lim (y, τ)
      have hgt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ gt (Metric.ball 0 d_lim) := by
        refine hAdm.1.comp ((differentiable_const y).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn ?_
        intro τ hτ
        simp [Metric.mem_ball, glancingDomain] at hτ ⊢
        exact ⟨hτ, by linarith⟩
      have hgt_maps : Set.MapsTo gt (Metric.ball 0 d_lim) (Metric.closedBall (gt 0) G.η_adm) := by
        intro τ hτ
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hτ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h1 : ‖U_lim (y, τ) - y‖ ≤ G.η_adm / 2 := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hAdm.2.2.2.2 0 (by omega) y τ
            (by simp [glancingDomain, hτ]; linarith)
        have h2 : ‖U_lim (y, 0) - y‖ ≤ G.η_adm / 2 := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hAdm.2.2.2.2 0 (by omega) y 0
            (by simp [glancingDomain, hd_pos]; linarith)
        calc ‖U_lim (y, τ) - U_lim (y, 0)‖
            = ‖(U_lim (y, τ) - y) - (U_lim (y, 0) - y)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖U_lim (y, τ) - y‖ + ‖U_lim (y, 0) - y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ G.η_adm := by linarith
      have hdslope_le : ‖dslope gt 0 t‖ ≤ G.η_adm / d_lim :=
        Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hgt_holo hgt_maps (by simp [ht])
      have hsub := sub_smul_dslope gt 0 t
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hsub
      calc ‖U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)‖
          = ‖t * dslope gt 0 t‖ := by rw [hsub]
        _ = ‖t‖ * ‖dslope gt 0 t‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖t‖ * (G.η_adm / d_lim) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdslope_le (norm_nonneg t)
        _ = (G.η_adm / d_lim) * ‖t‖ := mul_comm _ _
    let d_stat : ℝ := min (d_lim / 2) ((B.s₀ * d_lim) / (2 * G.η_adm))
    have hd_stat_pos : 0 < d_stat := lt_min (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have hd_stat_lt_d : d_stat < d_lim :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
    have hU_lim_maps : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_lim → ‖t‖ < d_stat →
        U_lim (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) := by
      intro y t hy ht
      have ht_lim : ‖t‖ < d_lim := ht.trans hd_stat_lt_d
      have hlip := hLip_t y t hy ht_lim
      have ht_bound : ‖t‖ < (B.s₀ * d_lim) / (2 * G.η_adm) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le ht (min_le_right _ _)
      have hdiff_lt : (G.η_adm / d_lim) * ‖t‖ < B.s₀ / 2 := by
        calc (G.η_adm / d_lim) * ‖t‖
            < (G.η_adm / d_lim) * ((B.s₀ * d_lim) / (2 * G.η_adm)) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht_bound (by positivity)
          _ = B.s₀ / 2 := by field_simp
      have hy0 := hU_lim_zero y hy
      have him0 : (U_lim (y, 0)).im = y.im := by rw [hy0]; simp
      change |(U_lim (y, t)).im| < 2 * B.s₀
      have him_split : (U_lim (y, t)).im = (U_lim (y, 0)).im + (U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)).im := by
        rw [← Complex.add_im]; ring_nf
      have him_le : |(U_lim (y, t)).im| ≤ |y.im| + ‖U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)‖ := by
        calc |(U_lim (y, t)).im|
            = |(U_lim (y, 0)).im + (U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)).im| := by rw [him_split]
          _ ≤ |(U_lim (y, 0)).im| + |(U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)).im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ |y.im| + ‖U_lim (y, t) - U_lim (y, 0)‖ := by
              rw [him0]; gcongr; exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      linarith
    have hAdm_stat : IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s_lim d_stat G.η_adm U_lim := by
      have hsub : glancingDomain 0 s_lim d_stat ⊆ glancingDomain 0 s_lim d_lim := by
        intro p hp; exact ⟨hp.1.trans hd_stat_lt_d, hp.2⟩
      exact ⟨hAdm_full.1.mono hsub,
        fun y t hyt => hAdm_full.2.1 y t (hsub hyt),
        fun y t hyt => hAdm_full.2.2.1 y t (hsub hyt),
        fun y t hyt => hAdm_full.2.2.2.1 y t (hsub hyt),
        fun k hk y t hyt => hAdm_full.2.2.2.2 k hk y t (hsub hyt)⟩
    have hStat_lim := G.stationarity_equiv s_lim d_stat U_lim
      hs_pos hs_le hd_stat_pos (hd_stat_lt_d.le.trans hd_le) (hd_stat_lt_d.trans hd_lt)
      hAdm_stat hU_lim_maps
      (fun p hp => hZero p ⟨hp.1.trans hd_stat_lt_d, hp.2⟩)
    let s₁ : ℝ := s_lim / 3
    have hs₁_eq : s₁ = s_lim / 3 := rfl
    have hs₁_pos : 0 < s₁ := by positivity
    have hs₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ B.s₀ := by linarith
    let U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => U_lim (p.1 - (c_shift : ℂ), p.2)
    have h1_le_infty : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
    have h_infty_ne_zero : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
    have hϕ'_cont : Continuous (deriv B.ϕ) := B.ϕ_smooth.continuous_deriv h1_le_infty
    have hϕ'_per : Function.Periodic (deriv B.ϕ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (B.ϕ ∘ fun z => z + 2 * Real.pi) (deriv B.ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi) * 1) x :=
        (B.ϕ_smooth.differentiable h_infty_ne_zero (x + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt.comp x
          ((hasDerivAt_id x).add_const (2 * Real.pi))
      rw [mul_one] at hd1
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => B.ϕ z + 2 * Real.pi) (deriv B.ϕ x) x :=
        (B.ϕ_smooth.differentiable h_infty_ne_zero x).hasDerivAt.add_const (2 * Real.pi)
      have heq : (B.ϕ ∘ fun z => z + 2 * Real.pi) = (fun z => B.ϕ z + 2 * Real.pi) :=
        funext B.ϕ_quasiperiodic
      rw [heq] at hd1
      exact hd1.unique hd2
    obtain ⟨x_max, -, hx_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi))
      (continuous_abs.comp hϕ'_cont).continuousOn
    let M_ϕ : ℝ := 1 + |deriv B.ϕ x_max|
    have hM_ϕ_pos : 0 < M_ϕ := by positivity
    have hϕ'_bound : ∀ x : ℝ, |deriv B.ϕ x| ≤ M_ϕ := by
      intro x
      have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      let k : ℤ := Int.floor (x / (2 * Real.pi))
      let x₀ : ℝ := x - k * (2 * Real.pi)
      have hx₀_mem : x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have := Int.floor_le (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp this
          linarith
        · have := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp this
          linarith
      have hper_k : deriv B.ϕ x = deriv B.ϕ x₀ := by
        have : x = x₀ + k • (2 * Real.pi) := by simp [x₀, zsmul_eq_mul]
        rw [this, hϕ'_per.zsmul k x₀]
      rw [hper_k]
      have hle : |deriv B.ϕ x₀| ≤ |deriv B.ϕ x_max| := hx_max hx₀_mem
      linarith
    let r_raw : ℝ := min (s₁ / 4) (min d_stat (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ)))
    have hr_raw_pos : 0 < r_raw := lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min hd_stat_pos (by positivity))
    let r_in : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_raw
    have hr_in_eq : r_in = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_raw := rfl
    have hr_in_pos : 0 < r_in := mul_pos (by norm_num) hr_raw_pos
    have hr_in_lt_quarter : r_in < s₁ / 4 := by
      have : r_raw ≤ s₁ / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have hr_in_lt_stat : r_in < d_stat := by
      have h1 : r_raw ≤ min d_stat (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ)) := min_le_right _ _
      have h2 : min d_stat (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ)) ≤ d_stat := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have hr_in_lt_pi : r_in < Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ) := by
      have h1 : r_raw ≤ min d_stat (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ)) := min_le_right _ _
      have h2 : min d_stat (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ)) ≤ Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ) := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    have hshift_mem_d0 : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
        (y - (c_shift : ℂ), t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s_lim d_lim := by
      intro y t hy ht
      refine ⟨ht.trans (hr_in_lt_stat.trans hd_stat_lt_d), ?_⟩
      simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      linarith
    have hU_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_in } := by
      refine hAdm.1.comp
        ((differentiable_fst.sub_const (c_shift : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_snd).differentiableOn ?_
      intro p hp
      exact hshift_mem_d0 p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2
    have hU_deriv_re : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r_in →
        HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re)
          (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U_lim (y', t)) ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ))).re x ∧
        (7 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U_lim (y', t)) ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ))).re ∧
        (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U_lim (y', t)) ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ))).re ≤ 9 / 8 := by
      intro x t ht
      have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < r_in := by simpa [Complex.norm_real] using ht
      let gt : ℂ → ℂ := fun y' => U_lim (y', (t : ℂ))
      have hgt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ gt (horizStrip s_lim) := by
        refine hAdm.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (t : ℂ))).differentiableOn ?_
        intro y' hy'
        exact ⟨ht_norm.trans (hr_in_lt_stat.trans hd_stat_lt_d), by simpa [horizStrip] using hy'⟩
      have hx_mem : (x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s_lim := by simp [horizStrip, hs_pos]
      have hgt_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ gt ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ)) :=
        hgt_holo.differentiableAt (hOpenStrip.mem_nhds hx_mem)
      have hcomp_c : HasDerivAt (gt ∘ fun y' : ℂ => y' - (c_shift : ℂ))
          (deriv gt ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ)) * 1) (x : ℂ) :=
        hgt_da.hasDerivAt.comp (x : ℂ) ((hasDerivAt_id (x : ℂ)).sub_const (c_shift : ℂ))
      rw [mul_one] at hcomp_c
      have hreal : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re)
          (deriv gt ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ))).re x :=
        hcomp_c.real_of_complex
      have h_iter1 : iteratedDeriv 1 (fun y' : ℂ => gt y' - y') ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ)) =
          deriv gt ((x : ℂ) - (c_shift : ℂ)) - 1 := by

    have hHolo_derivT : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

        hF.comp (differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)

    have hSlice_da : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),

    let Ω_Θ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < (7 / 4 : ℝ) * N.s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < N.r_in }

    have hOpen_p : IsOpen Ω_p :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)) continuous_const).inter

      ((hHolo_derivT Ω_p p_act hOpen_p hp_act_holo).mul

    let S₁₂ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun θ₁ θ₂ =>

        Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) - deriv B.h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)
    let S₂₂ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun θ₁ θ₂ =>

        Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) + deriv B.h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)
    have hChain_S : ∀ (θ₀ θ₁ : ℂ → ℂ) (z d₀ d₁ : ℂ),

      have hh'_da : HasDerivAt (deriv B.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) μ) μ :=

      have hΔ_d : HasDerivAt (fun w => (θ₁ w - θ₀ w) / 2) ((d₁ - d₀) / 2) z :=

      have h_h'μ : HasDerivAt (deriv B.h_ℂ ∘ fun w => (θ₀ w + θ₁ w) / 2)

      have h_sinΔ : HasDerivAt (Complex.sin ∘ fun w => (θ₁ w - θ₀ w) / 2)
          (Complex.cos Δ * ((d₁ - d₀) / 2)) z := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin Δ).comp z hΔ_d
      have h_cosΔ : HasDerivAt (Complex.cos ∘ fun w => (θ₁ w - θ₀ w) / 2)
          (-Complex.sin Δ * ((d₁ - d₀) / 2)) z := (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos Δ).comp z hΔ_d
      have hs1 := ((h_h'μ.mul h_sinΔ).sub (h_hμ.mul h_cosΔ)).neg
      have hs2 := (h_h'μ.mul h_sinΔ).add (h_hμ.mul h_cosΔ)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hd_eq : -(deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) μ * ((d₀ + d₁) / 2) * Complex.sin Δ +

            deriv B.h_ℂ μ * (Complex.cos Δ * ((d₁ - d₀) / 2)) +
            (deriv B.h_ℂ μ * ((d₀ + d₁) / 2) * Complex.cos Δ +

    have hShear_deriv : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ), (y + t, t) ∈ Ω_p →

        HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun t' : ℂ => (y + t', t')) t hfd

      have hd1_sh : deriv (fun y' : ℂ => g (y' + t, t)) y = L (1, 0) := h1_sh.deriv
      have hd2_sh : deriv (fun t' : ℂ => g (y + t', t')) t = L (1, 1) := h2_sh.deriv
      rw [hd1_sh, hd1, hd2_sh, hd2, hL_add]

    have hShear_inv : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < (5 / 4 : ℝ) * N.s₁ → ‖t‖ < N.r_in →

        dsimp [p₁, p_act, S₂_comp, Θ₀, Θ₁]

        have hsub_cancel : q.1 + q.2 - q.2 = q.1 := by ring

        exact (hd_c.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv
      obtain ⟨hpy_da, hpt_da⟩ := hSlice_da Ω_p p_act 0 t hOpen_p hp_act_holo h0t_p
      obtain ⟨hΘy_da, hΘt_da⟩ := hSlice_da Ω_p Θ₀ 0 t hOpen_p (hΘ₀_holo.mono hp_sub_Θ) h0t_p
      have h1 := hderiv_conj_1d (fun y' => p_act (y', t)) (fun y' => p_act (y', starRingEnd ℂ t))
        0 N.s₁ hs₁_pos hpy_da (fun ζ hζ => by
          have hζ_im : |ζ.im| < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * N.s₁ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
            have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm ζ; linarith
          exact hp_act_conj (ζ, t) ⟨hζ_im, ht_norm⟩)
      have h2 := hderiv_conj_1d (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', t)) (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', starRingEnd ℂ t))
        0 N.s₁ hs₁_pos hΘy_da (fun ζ hζ => by
          have hζ_im : |ζ.im| < (7 / 4 : ℝ) * N.s₁ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
            have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm ζ; linarith
          dsimp [Θ₀]
          rw [N.U_conj ζ t (by linarith) ht_norm,
            B.ϕ_ℂ_conj _ (N.U_maps_to_wide ζ t hζ_im ht_norm)])
      have h3 := hderiv_conj_1d (fun t' => p_act (0, t')) (fun t' => p_act (0, t'))
        t (N.r_in - ‖t‖) (sub_pos.mpr ht_norm) hpt_da (fun ζ hζ => by
          have hζ_lt : ‖ζ‖ < N.r_in := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
            have := norm_sub_norm_le ζ t; linarith
          simpa using hp_act_conj (0, ζ) ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], hζ_lt⟩)
      have h4 := hderiv_conj_1d (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t'))
        t (N.r_in - ‖t‖) (sub_pos.mpr ht_norm) hΘt_da (fun ζ hζ => by
          have hζ_lt : ‖ζ‖ < N.r_in := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
            have := norm_sub_norm_le ζ t; linarith
          dsimp [Θ₀]
          simpa using (congr_arg B.ϕ_ℂ (N.U_conj 0 ζ (by simp [hs₁_pos]) hζ_lt)).trans
            (B.ϕ_ℂ_conj _ (N.U_maps_to_wide 0 ζ (by simp [hs₁_pos]) hζ_lt)))
      simp only [map_zero] at h1 h2
      dsimp [A, B₀_jac]
      rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
      simp
    
    have hA_deriv0 : deriv A 0 = B.c / 4 := by
      let F₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => S₁₂ (Θ₀ (0, t)) (Θ₁ (0, t))
      let F₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t =>
        deriv (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', t)) 0 * deriv (fun t' => Θ₁ (0, t')) t -
        deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) t * deriv (fun y' => Θ₁ (y', t)) 0
      have hA_eq_prod : A =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun t => F₁ t * F₂ t := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr_in_pos] with t ht
        exact hB₀_factor 0 t ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simpa using ht⟩
      have h00_p : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_p := ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simp [hr_in_pos]⟩
      have hΘ₀_00 : Θ₀ (0, 0) = B.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by
        dsimp [Θ₀]; rw [N.U_zero 0 (by simp [hs₁_pos])]
      have hΘ₁_00 : Θ₁ (0, 0) = B.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by
        dsimp [Θ₁]; simp [N.U_zero 0 (by simp [hs₁_pos])]
      
      have hf0_deriv0 : HasDerivAt (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 0 := by
        obtain ⟨_, hf0_da⟩ := hSlice_da Ω_p Θ₀ 0 0 hOpen_p (hΘ₀_holo.mono hp_sub_Θ) h00_p
        have hf0_ev : ((fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) ∘ Neg.neg) =ᶠ[nhds 0] (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr_in_pos] with t' ht'
          simp only [Function.comp_apply]
          dsimp [Θ₀]
          exact congr_arg B.ϕ_ℂ (N.U_even 0 t' (by simp [hs₁_pos]) (by simpa using ht'))
        have hd_neg : HasDerivAt ((fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) ∘ Neg.neg)
            (deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 * (-1)) 0 := by
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) (deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0) (-0) := by
            simpa only [neg_zero] using hf0_da.hasDerivAt
          exact h1.comp 0 (hasDerivAt_neg 0)
        have heq_neg : deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 = -deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 := by
          have := (hf0_da.hasDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hf0_ev).unique hd_neg
          linear_combination this
        have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 = 0 := by linear_combination heq_neg
        have h0 : deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) 0 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
        convert hf0_da.hasDerivAt using 1
        exact h0.symm
      
      have hΘy_00 : deriv (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', 0)) 0 = deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by
        have heq : (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', 0)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] B.ϕ_ℂ := by
          filter_upwards [(hOpenStrip (2 * N.s₁)).mem_nhds (by simp [horizStrip, hs₁_pos])]
            with y' hy'
          dsimp [Θ₀]; rw [N.U_zero y' hy']
        exact heq.deriv_eq
      
      have hf1_deriv0 : HasDerivAt (fun t' => Θ₁ (0, t')) (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) 0 := by
        obtain ⟨_, hf1_da⟩ := hSlice_da Ω_p Θ₁ 0 0 hOpen_p hΘ₁_holo h00_p
        obtain ⟨_, hsh_t⟩ := hShear_deriv Θ₀ 0 0 (by simpa using h00_p) (hΘ₀_holo.mono hp_sub_Θ)
        have heq_f1 : (fun t' => Θ₁ (0, t')) = (fun t' => Θ₀ (0 + t', t')) := by
          ext t'; simp [Θ₁, Θ₀]
        have hd_val : deriv (fun t' => Θ₁ (0, t')) 0 = deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by
          rw [heq_f1, hsh_t]
          simp only [add_zero, hΘy_00, hf0_deriv0.deriv]
        convert hf1_da.hasDerivAt using 1
        exact hd_val.symm
      
      have hF₁_0 : F₁ 0 = 0 := by
        dsimp [F₁, S₁₂]
        rw [hΘ₀_00, hΘ₁_00, sub_self, zero_div, Complex.sin_zero, mul_zero]
      have hF₁_deriv0 : HasDerivAt F₁
          ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * (B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (B.ϕ_ℂ 0)) * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) 0 := by
        let r_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => B.h_ℂ w + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w
        have hr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ r_fn (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) := B.h_ℂ_holo.add hh2_holo
        have hϕ0_mem : B.ϕ_ℂ 0 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
          B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to 0 (by simp [horizStrip, hs₀_pos])
        have hr_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ r_fn (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) :=
          hr_holo.differentiableAt ((hOpenStrip (2 * B.s_h)).mem_nhds hϕ0_mem)
        have hmid_0 : (Θ₀ (0, 0) + Θ₁ (0, 0)) / 2 = B.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by rw [hΘ₀_00, hΘ₁_00]; ring
        have hμ_d : HasDerivAt (fun t => (Θ₀ (0, t) + Θ₁ (0, t)) / 2) ((0 + deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) / 2) 0 :=
          (hf0_deriv0.add hf1_deriv0).div_const (2 : ℂ)
        have hΔ_d : HasDerivAt (fun t => (Θ₁ (0, t) - Θ₀ (0, t)) / 2) ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 - 0) / 2) 0 :=
          (hf1_deriv0.sub hf0_deriv0).div_const (2 : ℂ)
        have hr_comp : HasDerivAt (r_fn ∘ fun t => (Θ₀ (0, t) + Θ₁ (0, t)) / 2)
            (deriv r_fn (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) * ((0 + deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) / 2)) 0 := by
          have hr_at : HasDerivAt r_fn (deriv r_fn (B.ϕ_ℂ 0)) ((Θ₀ (0, 0) + Θ₁ (0, 0)) / 2) := by
            rw [hmid_0]; exact hr_da.hasDerivAt
          exact hr_at.comp 0 hμ_d
        have hsin_comp : HasDerivAt (Complex.sin ∘ fun t => (Θ₁ (0, t) - Θ₀ (0, t)) / 2)
            (Complex.cos 0 * ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 - 0) / 2)) 0 := by
          have hdel_0 : (Θ₁ (0, 0) - Θ₀ (0, 0)) / 2 = 0 := by rw [hΘ₀_00, hΘ₁_00]; ring
          have hs_at : HasDerivAt Complex.sin (Complex.cos 0) ((Θ₁ (0, 0) - Θ₀ (0, 0)) / 2) := by
            rw [hdel_0]; exact Complex.hasDerivAt_sin 0
          exact hs_at.comp 0 hΔ_d
        have hprod := (hr_comp.mul hsin_comp).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ)
        have hfun_eq : F₁ = fun t => (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
            ((r_fn ∘ fun z => (Θ₀ (0, z) + Θ₁ (0, z)) / 2) t *
              (Complex.sin ∘ fun z => (Θ₁ (0, z) - Θ₀ (0, z)) / 2) t) := by
          ext t; dsimp [F₁, S₁₂, r_fn]; ring
        rw [hfun_eq]
        convert hprod using 1
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        rw [hΘ₀_00, hΘ₁_00, sub_self, zero_div, Complex.sin_zero, Complex.cos_zero]
        dsimp [r_fn]
        ring
      
      have hF₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) N.r_in) := by
        have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => deriv (fun y' => Θ₀ (y', t)) 0) (Metric.ball 0 N.r_in) :=
          (hHolo_derivY Ω_p Θ₀ hOpen_p (hΘ₀_holo.mono hp_sub_Θ)).comp
            ((differentiable_const (0 : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simpa using ht⟩)
        have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => deriv (fun t' => Θ₁ (0, t')) t) (Metric.ball 0 N.r_in) :=
          (hHolo_derivT Ω_p Θ₁ hOpen_p hΘ₁_holo).comp
            ((differentiable_const (0 : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simpa using ht⟩)
        have h3 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => deriv (fun t' => Θ₀ (0, t')) t) (Metric.ball 0 N.r_in) :=
          (hHolo_derivT Ω_p Θ₀ hOpen_p (hΘ₀_holo.mono hp_sub_Θ)).comp
            ((differentiable_const (0 : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simpa using ht⟩)
        have h4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => deriv (fun y' => Θ₁ (y', t)) 0) (Metric.ball 0 N.r_in) :=
          (hHolo_derivY Ω_p Θ₁ hOpen_p hΘ₁_holo).comp
            ((differentiable_const (0 : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨by simp [hs₁_pos], by simpa using ht⟩)
        exact (h1.mul h2).sub (h3.mul h4)
      have hF₂_da : HasDerivAt F₂ (deriv F₂ 0) 0 :=
        (hF₂_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_in_pos)).hasDerivAt
      have hF₂_0 : F₂ 0 = (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [F₂]
        rw [hΘy_00, hf1_deriv0.deriv, hf0_deriv0.deriv]
        ring
      have hprod_A : HasDerivAt (fun t => F₁ t * F₂ t)
          ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * (B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (B.ϕ_ℂ 0)) * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 *
            (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) ^ 2 + 0 * deriv F₂ 0) 0 := by
        have hm := hF₁_deriv0.mul hF₂_da
        rw [hF₁_0, hF₂_0] at hm
        exact hm
      rw [zero_mul, add_zero] at hprod_A
      have h_laz := B.lazutkin_norm_ℂ 0 (by simp [horizStrip, hs₀_pos])
      rw [hA_eq_prod.deriv_eq, hprod_A.deriv]
      calc (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (B.ϕ_ℂ 0)) * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0 *
            (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) ^ 2
          = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ 0) + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (B.ϕ_ℂ 0)) *
              (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ 0) ^ 3) := by ring
        _ = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (B.c : ℂ) := by rw [h_laz]
        _ = B.c / 4 := by ring
    
    have hA0 : A 0 = 0 := by
      have h := hA_odd_in 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_in_pos)
      simp only [neg_zero] at h
      have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * A 0 = 0 := by linear_combination h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    have hdA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope A 0) (Metric.ball 0 N.r_in) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_in_pos)).mpr hA_holo_in
    have hdA_cont0 : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℂ => (dslope A 0 t).re) 0 :=
      Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp
        (hdA_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_in_pos)).continuousAt
    have hdA_0_re : (dslope A 0 0).re = B.c / 4 := by
      rw [dslope_same, hA_deriv0]
      norm_cast
    have hc_pos : 0 < B.c := B.c_pos
    have hmem_nhds : { t : ℂ | B.c / 8 < (dslope A 0 t).re } ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
      refine hdA_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds ?_)
      rw [hdA_0_re]; linarith
    obtain ⟨δ_pos, hδ_pos, hball_pos⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmem_nhds
    let r₁ : ℝ := min N.r_in δ_pos
    have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hr_in_pos hδ_pos
    have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ N.r_in := min_le_left _ _
    have hr₁_le_δ : r₁ ≤ δ_pos := min_le_right _ _
    refine ⟨r₁, A, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le,
      hA_holo_in.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le),
      fun y t hy ht => hB₀_eq_A y t hy (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le),
      fun t ht => hA_odd_in t (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le ht),
      fun t ht => hA_conj_in t (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le ht),
      hA_deriv0,
      fun t ht0 ht => ?_⟩
    have ht_ball : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_pos := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le_δ
    have hd_gt : B.c / 8 < (dslope A 0 (t : ℂ)).re := hball_pos ht_ball
    have hsub := sub_smul_dslope A 0 (t : ℂ)
    simp only [sub_zero, hA0, smul_eq_mul] at hsub
    have hre_eq : (A (t : ℂ)).re = t * (dslope A 0 (t : ℂ)).re := by
      rw [← hsub, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    rw [hre_eq]
    exact mul_pos ht0 (by linarith)
  
  obtain ⟨s_init, d_init, M_init, U_init, hs_init_pos, hs_init_le, hd_init_pos, hd_init_le,
    hd_init_lt, hM_init_pos, hAdm_init, _, hRes_init⟩ := h_stage1 (G.B₀ + 1) (by omega)
  have h_exp_eq : 2 * (G.B₀ + 1) + 2 = 2 * G.B₀ + 4 := by omega
  rw [h_exp_eq] at hRes_init
  obtain ⟨s_lim, d_lim, U_lim, hs_lim_pos, hs_lim_le, hd_lim_pos, hd_lim_le, hd_lim_lt,
    hAdm_lim, hZero_lim⟩ :=
    h_stage2 s_init d_init M_init U_init hs_init_pos hs_init_le hd_init_pos hd_init_le
      hd_init_lt hM_init_pos hAdm_init hRes_init
  obtain ⟨N⟩ := h_stage3 s_lim d_lim U_lim hs_lim_pos hs_lim_le hd_lim_pos hd_lim_le
    hd_lim_lt hAdm_lim hZero_lim
  obtain ⟨r₁, A, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, hA_holo, hSymp, hA_odd, hA_conj, hA_deriv0, hA_pos⟩ :=
    h_stage4 N
  exact ⟨{
    toSupportLazutkinData := B.toSupportLazutkinData
    s₀ := B.s₀
    s_h := B.s_h
    s₀_pos := B.s₀_pos
    s_h_pos := B.s_h_pos
    h_ℂ := B.h_ℂ
    ϕ_ℂ := B.ϕ_ℂ
    h_ℂ_holo := B.h_ℂ_holo
    ϕ_ℂ_holo := B.ϕ_ℂ_holo
    ϕ_ℂ_maps_to := B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to
    h_ℂ_real := B.h_ℂ_real
    ϕ_ℂ_real := B.ϕ_ℂ_real
    h_ℂ_periodic := B.h_ℂ_periodic
    h_ℂ_conj := B.h_ℂ_conj
    ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic := B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic
    ϕ_ℂ_conj := B.ϕ_ℂ_conj
    ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero := B.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero
    lazutkin_norm_ℂ := B.lazutkin_norm_ℂ
    s₁ := N.s₁
    r₁ := r₁
    r₁_pos := hr₁_pos
    r₁_lt_s₁ := by linarith [N.s₁_pos, N.r_in_lt_quarter_s₁, hr₁_le]
    s₁_le_s₀ := N.s₁_le_s₀
    U := N.U
    A := A
    U_holo := N.U_holo.mono (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 hr₁_le⟩)
    A_holo := hA_holo
    U_quasiperiodic := fun y t hy ht => N.U_quasiperiodic y t hy (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    U_even := fun y t hy ht => N.U_even y t hy (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    U_zero := N.U_zero
    U_conj := fun y t hy ht => N.U_conj y t hy (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    U_maps_to := fun y t hy ht =>
      N.U_maps_to_wide y t (by linarith [N.s₁_pos, N.r_in_lt_quarter_s₁, hr₁_le])
        (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    U_real_deriv_pos := fun x t ht => N.U_real_deriv_pos x t (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    U_real_step_pos := fun x t ht0 ht => N.U_real_step_pos x t ht0 (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    glancing_stationary := fun y t hy ht =>
      N.glancing_stationary_wide y t (by linarith [N.s₁_pos]) (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr₁_le)
    symplectic_jacobian := hSymp
    A_odd := hA_odd
    A_conj := hA_conj
    A_deriv_zero := hA_deriv0
    A_real_pos := hA_pos
  }⟩

glancing_convergence_and_symplectic_form.definitions:
noncomputable def glancingIterDslopeAtZero : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, g => g
  | n + 1, g => dslope (glancingIterDslopeAtZero n g) 0

structure NormalizedGlancingData {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  s₁ : ℝ
  r_in : ℝ
  s₁_pos : 0 < s₁
  s₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ B.s₀
  r_in_pos : 0 < r_in
  r_in_lt_quarter_s₁ : r_in < s₁ / 4
  U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  U_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_in }
  U_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  U_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)
  U_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → U (y, 0) = y
  U_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))
  U_maps_to_wide : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < (7 / 4 : ℝ) * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)
  U_real_deriv_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r_in →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re) x
  U_real_step_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_in →
    0 < (U (x + t, t)).re - (U (x, t)).re ∧
    0 < B.ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - B.ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) ∧
    B.ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - B.ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) < Real.pi
  glancing_stationary_wide : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r_in →
    -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
      supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
