proof.tactics:
by
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ hBudget.k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
  have hexp_k₀_lt : Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) < S.H / 10 := hBudget.exp_neg_k₀_lt
  have hmom_poly : ∀ k : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k → rowMomentFull S k ≤ hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) :=
    hBudget.moment_poly_bound
  
  obtain ⟨k_seq, hk_ge_k₀, hk_tendsto, hmom_tendsto, h_normal, h_mom_K, hk_Icc, hk_gap⟩ :
      ∃ k_seq : ℕ → ℝ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq n) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
          rowMomentFull S l ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k_seq n|)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, (K_seq n) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, k_seq n ∈ Set.Icc ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n) ((43 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, 3 * (n : ℝ) + 34 ≤ k_seq n - hBudget.k₀) := by
    clear hε₀ hL_star h_bad L_star ε₀
    have h_mom_nonneg : ∀ l : ℝ, 0 ≤ rowMomentFull S l := by
      intro l
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have h_mom_cont : ContinuousOn (rowMomentFull S) (Set.Ici hBudget.k₀) := by
      let Φ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun l x =>
        (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-max l hBudget.k₀) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hΦ_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ p.1 p.2) := by
        refine (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).add ?_
        refine (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_).mul continuous_const
        exact continuous_const.sub (Real.continuous_exp.comp (Continuous.neg (continuous_fst.max continuous_const)))
      have hΦ_mem : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, Φ p.1 p.2 ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        intro p
        simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Φ, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero,
          add_zero, zero_add]
        have h_max : hBudget.k₀ ≤ max p.1 hBudget.k₀ := le_max_right _ _
        have h_epos : 0 < Real.exp (-max p.1 hBudget.k₀) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h_ele : Real.exp (-max p.1 hBudget.k₀) ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        have hH : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hf_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => S.f (Φ p.1 p.2)) :=
        S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦ_cont hΦ_mem
      have hq_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => S.q (Φ p.1 p.2)) :=
        S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦ_cont hΦ_mem
      have h_ing_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖S.f (Φ p.1 p.2)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Φ p.1 p.2)‖) :=
        ((continuous_norm.comp hf_cont).pow 2).add (continuous_norm.comp hq_cont)
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun l : ℝ =>
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖S.f (Φ l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Φ l x)‖)) :=
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          h_ing_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      let μ_clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun l =>
        Real.exp (-max l hBudget.k₀) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖S.f (Φ l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Φ l x)‖))
      have hμ_cont : Continuous μ_clamp := by
        refine (Real.continuous_exp.comp (Continuous.neg (continuous_id.max continuous_const))).mul ?_
        exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul h_int_cont)
      refine hμ_cont.continuousOn.congr ?_
      intro l hl
      have hmax_eq : max l hBudget.k₀ = l := max_eq_left hl
      simp only [rowMomentFull, μ_clamp, Φ, hmax_eq]
    have h_ex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ k : ℝ,
        hBudget.k₀ ≤ k ∧
        (∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
          rowMomentFull S l ≤ rowMomentFull S k * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k|)) ∧
        (K_seq n) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S k ∧
        k ∈ Set.Icc ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n) ((43 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n) ∧
        3 * (n : ℝ) + 34 ≤ k - hBudget.k₀ := by
      intro n
      let K := K_seq n
      let j := j_seq n
      let C_m := max hBudget.C_env 1
      have hCm_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_m := le_max_right _ _
      have hCm_ge_env : hBudget.C_env ≤ C_m := le_max_left _ _
      have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have hK_ge_1 : 10240000 * C_m ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hK_lower n)
      have hK_ge_2 : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_lower n)
      have hK_ge_42 : 42 ≤ K := by linarith
      have hj_lo : (9 / 10 : ℝ) * K ≤ j := (hj_mem n).1.1
      have hj_hi : j ≤ (21 / 10 : ℝ) * K := (hj_mem n).1.2
      have hj_mom : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S j := (hj_mem n).2
      have hj_ge_k₀ : hBudget.k₀ ≤ j := by linarith
      have hK_rpow_ge_one : 1 ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) :=
        Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by norm_num)
      have h_poly_exp : ∀ l u : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l → 0 ≤ u → l ≤ j + u →
          rowMomentFull S l ≤ 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16) := by
        intro l u hl hu hlu
        have h1 : rowMomentFull S l ≤ hBudget.C_env * (1 + l) := hmom_poly l hl
        have h2 : hBudget.C_env * (1 + l) ≤ C_m * (1 + l) := by nlinarith
        have h3 : 1 + l ≤ 48 * K * (1 + u / 16) := by nlinarith
        have h4 : 1 + u / 16 ≤ Real.exp (u / 16) := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (u / 16)]
        have h5 : C_m * (1 + l) ≤ C_m * (48 * K * Real.exp (u / 16)) := by
          have hK_pos : 0 ≤ 48 * K := by linarith
          have h34 : 1 + l ≤ 48 * K * Real.exp (u / 16) :=
            le_trans h3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hK_pos)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h34 (by linarith)
        linarith
      let L_cut : ℝ := j + 768 * C_m * K
      have hj_le_L : j ≤ L_cut := by nlinarith
      let ϕ : ℝ → ℝ := fun l => rowMomentFull S l * Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j|)
      have hϕ_cont : ContinuousOn ϕ (Set.Icc hBudget.k₀ L_cut) := by
        refine (h_mom_cont.mono (fun x hx => hx.1)).mul ?_
        exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))).continuousOn
      obtain ⟨k, hk_Icc_loc, hk_max⟩ :=
        isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn ⟨j, hj_ge_k₀, hj_le_L⟩ hϕ_cont
      have hj_in_Icc : j ∈ Set.Icc hBudget.k₀ L_cut := ⟨hj_ge_k₀, hj_le_L⟩
      have hϕ_j_le_k : ϕ j ≤ ϕ k := hk_max hj_in_Icc
      have hϕ_j_eq : ϕ j = rowMomentFull S j := by simp [ϕ]
      have hϕ_global : ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l → ϕ l ≤ ϕ k := by
        intro l hl
        by_cases hlL : l ≤ L_cut
        · exact hk_max ⟨hl, hlL⟩
        · push_neg at hlL
          let u := l - j
          have hu_gt : 768 * C_m * K < u := by linarith
          have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by nlinarith
          have habs_l : |l - j| = u := abs_of_nonneg hu_nonneg
          have hm_l : rowMomentFull S l ≤ 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16) :=
            h_poly_exp l u hl hu_nonneg (by linarith)
          have h_exp_prod : Real.exp (u / 16) * Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * u) = Real.exp (-u / 16) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            ring_nf
          have h_exp_gt : 48 * C_m * K < Real.exp (u / 16) := by
            have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (u / 16)
            nlinarith
          have h_prod_lt_one : 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (-u / 16) < 1 := by
            have h_pos : 0 < Real.exp (u / 16) := Real.exp_pos _
            have h_eq : Real.exp (-u / 16) = (Real.exp (u / 16))⁻¹ := by
              rw [show -u / 16 = -(u / 16) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact (mul_inv_lt_iff₀ h_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          have hϕ_l_le : ϕ l ≤ 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (-u / 16) := by
            calc ϕ l = rowMomentFull S l * Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * u) := by simp [ϕ, habs_l]
              _ ≤ (48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16)) * Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * u) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_l (Real.exp_nonneg _)
              _ = 48 * C_m * K * (Real.exp (u / 16) * Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * u)) := by ring
              _ = 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (-u / 16) := by rw [h_exp_prod]
          have h1_le_ϕj : 1 ≤ ϕ j := by
            rw [hϕ_j_eq]
            exact le_trans hK_rpow_ge_one hj_mom
          linarith
      have h_normal_loc : ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
          rowMomentFull S l ≤ rowMomentFull S k * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k|) := by
        intro l hl
        have h_ineq := hϕ_global l hl
        have h_pos : 0 < Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j|) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_ineq (le_of_lt h_pos)
        have h_lhs : ϕ l * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j|) = rowMomentFull S l := by
          simp only [ϕ, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          have : -(1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j| + (1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j| = 0 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
        have h_rhs : ϕ k * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - j|) =
            rowMomentFull S k * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * (|l - j| - |k - j|)) := by
          simp only [ϕ, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 2
          ring
        rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_mul
        have h_tri : |l - j| - |k - j| ≤ |l - k| := by
          have h_sub := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (l - j) (k - j)
          have h_eq : (l - j) - (k - j) = l - k := by ring
          rwa [h_eq] at h_sub
        exact le_trans h_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (h_mom_nonneg k))
      let u := |k - j|
      have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := abs_nonneg _
      have h_mom_k_lb : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.exp (u / 8) ≤ rowMomentFull S k := by
        have h_pos : 0 < Real.exp (u / 8) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hϕ_j_le_k (le_of_lt h_pos)
        rw [hϕ_j_eq] at h_mul
        have h_rhs : ϕ k * Real.exp (u / 8) = rowMomentFull S k := by
          simp only [ϕ, u, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          have : -(1 / 8 : ℝ) * |k - j| + |k - j| / 8 = 0 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
        rw [h_rhs] at h_mul
        exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj_mom (le_of_lt h_pos)) h_mul
      have h_mom_k_K : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S k := by
        have h_exp_ge_one : 1 ≤ Real.exp (u / 8) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
        calc K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) = K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
          _ ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.exp (u / 8) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_ge_one (by linarith)
          _ ≤ rowMomentFull S k := h_mom_k_lb
      have hu_le : u ≤ (1 / 20 : ℝ) * K := by
        have h_exp_lb : Real.exp (u / 8) ≤ rowMomentFull S k := by
          calc Real.exp (u / 8) = 1 * Real.exp (u / 8) := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * Real.exp (u / 8) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_rpow_ge_one (Real.exp_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ rowMomentFull S k := h_mom_k_lb
        have hk_le_ju : k ≤ j + u := by
          have : k - j ≤ |k - j| := le_abs_self _
          linarith
        have hm_k_ub : rowMomentFull S k ≤ 48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16) :=
          h_poly_exp k u hk_Icc_loc.1 hu_nonneg hk_le_ju
        have h_exp16 : Real.exp (u / 16) ≤ 48 * C_m * K := by
          have h_comb : Real.exp (u / 8) * Real.exp (-u / 16) ≤
              (48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16)) * Real.exp (-u / 16) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans h_exp_lb hm_k_ub) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
          have h_l : Real.exp (u / 8) * Real.exp (-u / 16) = Real.exp (u / 16) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            ring_nf
          have h_r : (48 * C_m * K * Real.exp (u / 16)) * Real.exp (-u / 16) = 48 * C_m * K := by
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
            have : u / 16 + -u / 16 = 0 := by ring
            rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
          linarith
        have h_quad : 1 + (u / 16) + (u / 16) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.exp (u / 16) := by
          have h3 := Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ u / 16) 3
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Nat.factorial, Nat.cast_one,
            pow_zero, pow_one, div_one, zero_add] at h3
          linarith
        by_contra h_gt
        push_neg at h_gt
        nlinarith
      have hk_bounds : k ∈ Set.Icc ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ((43 / 20 : ℝ) * K) := by
        have habs := abs_le.mp hu_le
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hk_gap_loc : 3 * (n : ℝ) + 34 ≤ k - hBudget.k₀ := by
        have := hk_bounds.1
        linarith
      exact ⟨k, hk_Icc_loc.1, h_normal_loc, h_mom_k_K, hk_bounds, hk_gap_loc⟩
    choose k_seq hk_spec using h_ex
    refine ⟨k_seq, fun n => (hk_spec n).1, ?_, ?_,
      fun n => (hk_spec n).2.1, fun n => (hk_spec n).2.2.1,
      fun n => (hk_spec n).2.2.2.1, fun n => (hk_spec n).2.2.2.2⟩
    · rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop] at hK_tendsto ⊢
      intro b
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hK_tendsto (max (20 / 17 * b) 0)
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have h1 := hN n hn
      have h2 : (20 / 17 : ℝ) * b ≤ K_seq n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) h1
      have h3 := (hk_spec n).2.2.2.1.1
      linarith
    · have h_rpow_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (K_seq n) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ))
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 100)).comp hK_tendsto
      exact Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => (hk_spec n).2.2.1) h_rpow_tendsto
  
  obtain ⟨M_star, W_exhaust, envCost, hM_star_pos, hW_pos, hEnvCost⟩ :
      ∃ (M_star : ℝ) (W_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ) (envCost : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        0 < M_star ∧
        (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < W_exhaust r) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℝ),
          3 * (n : ℝ) + 34 ≤ k - hBudget.k₀ →
          1 ≤ rowMomentFull S k →
          (∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
            rowMomentFull S l ≤ rowMomentFull S k * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k|)) →
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (envCost n k) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), 0 ≤ envCost n k x) ∧
          (∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), envCost n k x) ≤ 2 * Real.pi * M_star ∧
          (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), ∀ s : ℂ,
            Real.exp (-k) ≤ wallDepth S s →
            wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8 →
            |s.re - x| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
            (Real.exp (-k) / rowMomentFull S k) * shapeModulus S s ≤
              Real.sqrt (envCost n k x) * (Real.exp (-k) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n → ∀ Z ∈ lmCompactRect r,
            (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
            ‖lmRescaledF S k x Z‖ ^ 2 + ‖lmRescaledQ S k x Z‖ ≤ W_exhaust r * envCost n k x) := by
    clear hε₀ ε₀ K_seq j_seq hK_tendsto hK_lower hj_mem h_bad hk₀_ge_one hmom_poly

          have h_ind2 : I_x.indicator g_D = (I_x ∩ A_D).indicator 1 := by
            ext y
            by_cases hy1 : y ∈ I_x <;> by_cases hy2 : y ∈ A_D <;> simp [g_D, hy1, hy2]
          rw [h_ind2, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (measurableSet_Icc.inter hAD_meas)]
          rfl
        rw [h_int_shift, h_row_eq]
        exact h_rows D ⟨hD_lo, hD_hi⟩
      · simp only [hp, not_false_eq_true, Set.indicator_of_notMem]
        have h_zero : (fun x : ℝ => χ (x, p)) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext x
          have hxp : (x, p) ∉ E_3D := fun h => hp h.1.2
          simp [χ, hxp]
        simp [h_zero]
    have h_lhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (B_box.indicator (fun _ => ε₀)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff (isClosed_Icc.prod isClosed_Icc).measurableSet]
      exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hB_ne_top
    have h_rhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p => ∫ x, χ (x, p)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hχ_int.integral_prod_right
    have h_mono_p := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_int h_slice_x
    have h_lhs_val : (∫ p, B_box.indicator (fun _ => ε₀) p) = 2 * ε₀ := by
      have h_eq : B_box.indicator (fun _ => ε₀) = fun p => ε₀ * B_box.indicator 1 p := by
        ext p
        by_cases hp : p ∈ B_box <;> simp [hp]
      rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
        MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (isClosed_Icc.prod isClosed_Icc).measurableSet,
        hB_real, mul_comm]
    rw [h_lhs_val, ← MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm _ hχ_int, h_int_p_first] at h_mono_p
    exact ⟨h_box_int, h_ub, by linarith⟩
  
  let B_tot : ℝ := 8 * Real.pi * M_star / ε₀
  have hB_tot_pos : 0 < B_tot := by positivity
  have h_x_ex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      ε₀ / (4 * Real.pi) ≤ lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq n) (k_seq n) x ∧
      envCost n (k_seq n) x ≤ B_tot := by
    intro n
    have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hK_ge_2 : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_lower n)
    have hK_ge_42 : 42 ≤ K_seq n := by linarith
    have h_mom_one : 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) :=
      le_trans (Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by norm_num)) (h_mom_K n)
    have h_env_n := hEnvCost n (k_seq n) (hk_gap n) h_mom_one (h_normal n)
    have h_rows_n : ∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
        ε₀ ≤ lmRowModerateMeas S (K_seq n) (k_seq n - Real.log D) := by
      intro D hD
      have hlog_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log D := Real.log_nonneg hD.1
      have hlog_le_2 : Real.log D ≤ Real.log 2 :=
        Real.log_le_log (by linarith [hD.1]) hD.2
      have hlog2_lt_1 : Real.log 2 < 1 := lt_trans Real.log_two_lt_d9 (by norm_num)
      have hk_lo := (hk_Icc n).1
      have hk_hi := (hk_Icc n).2
      exact h_bad n (k_seq n - Real.log D) ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨hb_int, hb_ub, hb_lb⟩ := h_fub (K_seq n) (k_seq n) (hk_ge_k₀ n) h_rows_n
    let I_x : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hIx_vol : MeasureTheory.volume I_x = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
      simp [I_x, Real.volume_Icc]
    have hIx_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume I_x ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [hIx_vol]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    have hIx_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real I_x = 2 * Real.pi := by
      simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hIx_vol, Real.pi_pos.le]
    let c1 : ℝ := ε₀ / (4 * Real.pi)
    let c2 : ℝ := ε₀ / (8 * Real.pi * M_star)
    have hc2_pos : 0 < c2 := by positivity
    let b : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq n) (k_seq n) x
    let env : ℝ → ℝ := envCost n (k_seq n)
    let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => b x - c1 - c2 * env x
    have hc1_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => c1) I_x MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hIx_ne_top
    have hc2_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => c2 * env x) I_x MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_env_n.1.const_mul c2
    have hΨ_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Ψ I_x MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hb_int.sub hc1_int).sub hc2_int
    have h_int_Ψ_pos : 0 < ∫ x in I_x, Ψ x := by
      have h_sub1 : (∫ x in I_x, Ψ x) =
          (∫ x in I_x, (b x - c1)) - ∫ x in I_x, c2 * env x :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hb_int.sub hc1_int) hc2_int
      have h_sub2 : (∫ x in I_x, (b x - c1)) =
          (∫ x in I_x, b x) - ∫ _x in I_x, c1 :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub hb_int hc1_int
      have h_c1_val : (∫ _x in I_x, c1) = ε₀ / 2 := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, hIx_real]
        dsimp only [c1]
        field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_c2_val : (∫ x in I_x, c2 * env x) ≤ ε₀ / 4 := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        calc c2 * (∫ x in I_x, env x) ≤ c2 * (2 * Real.pi * M_star) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_env_n.2.2.1 hc2_pos.le
          _ = ε₀ / 4 := by
              dsimp only [c2]
              field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hM_star_pos.ne']
              ring
      linarith
    have h_ex_pos : ∃ x ∈ I_x, 0 < Ψ x := by
      by_contra h_all
      have h_le_zero : ∀ x ∈ I_x, Ψ x ≤ 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_contra hgt
        exact h_all ⟨x, hx, lt_of_not_ge hgt⟩
      have h_int_nonpos : (∫ x in I_x, Ψ x) ≤ ∫ _x in I_x, (0 : ℝ) :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hΨ_int (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hIx_ne_top)
          measurableSet_Icc h_le_zero
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at h_int_nonpos
      linarith
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_pos⟩ := h_ex_pos
    refine ⟨x, hx_mem, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_nn : 0 ≤ c2 * env x := mul_nonneg hc2_pos.le (h_env_n.2.1 x hx_mem)
      dsimp only [Ψ, c1, b] at hx_pos ⊢
      linarith
    · have hb1 : b x ≤ 1 := hb_ub x
      have hc1_pos : 0 < c1 := by positivity
      have hc2_lt : c2 * env x ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp only [Ψ] at hx_pos
        linarith
      have h_mul : B_tot * (c2 * env x) ≤ B_tot * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc2_lt hB_tot_pos.le
      have h_cancel : B_tot * (c2 * env x) = env x := by
        dsimp only [B_tot, c2]
        field_simp [hε₀.ne', Real.pi_pos.ne', hM_star_pos.ne']
      linarith
  choose x_seq hx_spec using h_x_ex
  let C_cone : ℝ := Real.sqrt B_tot
  let M_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ := fun r => W_exhaust r * B_tot
  refine ⟨k_seq, x_seq, C_cone, M_exhaust, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine
      { C_cone_pos := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hB_tot_pos
        M_exhaust_pos := fun r => mul_pos (hW_pos r) hB_tot_pos
        k_ge_k₀ := hk_ge_k₀
        k_tendsto := hk_tendsto
        moment_tendsto := hmom_tendsto
        normal_level := h_normal
        cone_bound := ?_
        compact_exhaust_bound := ?_ }
    · intro n s hs_lo hs_hi hs_re
      have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have hK_ge_2 : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K_seq n :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_lower n)
      have h_mom_one : 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) :=
        le_trans (Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by norm_num)) (h_mom_K n)
      have h_env_n := hEnvCost n (k_seq n) (hk_gap n) h_mom_one (h_normal n)
      have h_cone := h_env_n.2.2.2.1 (x_seq n) (hx_spec n).1 s hs_lo hs_hi hs_re
      have h_wd_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hs_lo
      have h_rpow_nn : 0 ≤ (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
      have h_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt (envCost n (k_seq n) (x_seq n)) ≤ C_cone :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hx_spec n).2.2
      exact le_trans h_cone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sqrt_le h_rpow_nn)
    · intro r n hr Z hZ
      have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have hK_ge_2 : 2 * hBudget.k₀ + 4 * (n : ℝ) + 40 ≤ K_seq n :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hK_lower n)
      have h_mom_one : 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) :=
        le_trans (Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) (by norm_num)) (h_mom_K n)
      have h_env_n := hEnvCost n (k_seq n) (hk_gap n) h_mom_one (h_normal n)
      obtain ⟨h_strip, h_bd⟩ := h_env_n.2.2.2.2 (x_seq n) (hx_spec n).1 r hr Z hZ
      refine ⟨h_strip, le_trans h_bd ?_⟩
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hx_spec n).2.2 (hW_pos r).le
  · intro n
    exact ⟨h_mom_K n, (hk_Icc n).1, (hx_spec n).2.1⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (L_star C_cone : ℝ)
    (M_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ) (k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hL_star : 0 < L_star)
    (hL_excl : ∀ k_seq' x_seq' : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ → 0 < C₁ →
      (∀ n : ℕ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq' n) →
      Filter.Tendsto k_seq' Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
        rowMomentFull S l ≤
          C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k_seq' n|)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
        Real.exp (-k_seq' n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
        wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8 →
        |s.re - x_seq' n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
        (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
          C₁ * (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) →
      ¬ (TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
          (fun n Z =>
            ((Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              S.f ((x_seq' n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) : ℂ) * Z))
          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
          (fun n Z =>
            ((Real.exp (-k_seq' n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq' n) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
              S.q ((x_seq' n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq' n) : ℂ) * Z))
          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 }))
    (hEnv : NormalizedCenterEnvelope S hBudget L_star C_cone M_exhaust k_seq x_seq) :
    ∃ (ϕ : ℕ → ℕ) (F Q : ℂ → ℂ),
      StrictMono ϕ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Q lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun n Z => lmRescaledF S (k_seq (ϕ n)) (x_seq (ϕ n)) Z)
        F Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun n Z => lmRescaledQ S (k_seq (ϕ n)) (x_seq (ϕ n)) Z)
        Q Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane ∧
      ((∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
          {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0}.Finite) ∨
        ({D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 |
            ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = 0}.Finite ∧
          ∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
            (∃ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im ≠ 0) →
            {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = 0}.Finite))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hLHP_open : IsOpen lmLowerHalfPlane :=
    isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  
  have hRect_conv : ∀ r : ℕ, Convex ℝ (lmCompactRect r) := by
    intro r Z₁ hZ₁ Z₂ hZ₂ a b ha hb hab
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      exact convex_Icc _ _ hZ₁.1 hZ₂.1 ha hb hab
    · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact convex_Icc _ _ hZ₁.2 hZ₂.2 ha hb hab
  have hRect_compact : ∀ r : ℕ, IsCompact (lmCompactRect r) := by
    intro r
    have h_closed : IsClosed (lmCompactRect r) :=
      (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_im)
    refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * (r : ℝ) + 5)).of_isClosed_subset h_closed ?_
    intro Z hZ
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    have hr_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg r
    have h_re : |Z.re| ≤ (r : ℝ) + 2 := abs_le.mpr hZ.1
    have h_im_upper : -(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ (r : ℝ) + 3 := by
      have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
      have h_neg : -(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2)) < 0 := neg_neg_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr h_pos)
      linarith
    have h_im : |Z.im| ≤ (r : ℝ) + 3 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨hZ.2.1, le_trans hZ.2.2 h_im_upper⟩
    calc
      ‖Z‖ ≤ |Z.re| + |Z.im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im Z
      _ ≤ 2 * (r : ℝ) + 5 := by linarith
  let δ_rect : ℕ → ℝ := fun r => 1 / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 3))
  have hδ_pos : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < δ_rect r := by
    intro r
    have hr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg r
    exact one_div_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hRect_margin : ∀ (r : ℕ) (Z : ℂ),
      Z ∈ lmCompactRect r → Metric.closedBall Z (δ_rect r) ⊆ lmCompactRect (r + 1) := by
    intro r Z hZ W hW
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hW
    have hr : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg r
    have h_denom_ge : 12 ≤ 2 * ((r : ℝ) + 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 3) := by nlinarith
    have hδ_le_one : δ_rect r ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [δ_rect]
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have h_re_diff : |W.re - Z.re| ≤ δ_rect r := by
      calc
        |W.re - Z.re| = |(W - Z).re| := by rw [Complex.sub_re]
        _ ≤ ‖W - Z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (W - Z)
        _ ≤ δ_rect r := hW
    have h_im_diff : |W.im - Z.im| ≤ δ_rect r := by
      calc
        |W.im - Z.im| = |(W - Z).im| := by rw [Complex.sub_im]
        _ ≤ ‖W - Z‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (W - Z)
        _ ≤ δ_rect r := hW
    have h_re_abs := abs_le.mp h_re_diff
    have h_im_abs := abs_le.mp h_im_diff
    have h_upper_im : -(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2)) + δ_rect r ≤ -(1 / (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)) := by
      dsimp [δ_rect]
      push_cast
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
      have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + 3 := by linarith
      have h_eq : -(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2)) + 1 / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 3)) -
          (-(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1 + 2))) = -1 / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 3)) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_neg : -1 / (2 * ((r : ℝ) + 2) * ((r : ℝ) + 3)) ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by norm_num) (by positivity)
      linarith
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · push_cast; linarith [hZ.1.1, h_re_abs.1, hδ_le_one]

      have hQ_ex : ∃ Z₀ ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane, Q Z₀ ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hQ_all
        have hQ_zero : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
            (fun n Z => lmRescaledQ S (k'_seq n) (x'_seq n) Z)
            (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane := by
          refine hQ_conv.congr_right (fun Z hZ => ?_)
          by_contra hne
          exact hQ_all ⟨Z, hZ, hne⟩
        exact h_not_both_zero ⟨hF_zero, hQ_zero⟩
      obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ₀_mem, hQZ₀_ne⟩ := hQ_ex
      have hQZ₀_pos : 0 < ‖Q Z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hQZ₀_ne
      let M : ℝ := max 1 (C_cone ^ 2 / ‖Q Z₀‖ + 1)
      have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
      have hM_pos : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_ge_one
      have hM_gt : C_cone ^ 2 / ‖Q Z₀‖ < M :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_add_one _) (le_max_right _ _)
      let R : ℝ := M ^ 4
      have hR_ge_one : 1 ≤ R := one_le_pow₀ hM_ge_one
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR_ge_one
      let Z_R : ℂ := -(R : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hZR_mem : Z_R ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
        change Z_R.im < 0
        simp [Z_R, hR_pos]
      let δ_b : ℝ := Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8
      have hδ_b_pos : 0 < δ_b := div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)
      have h_ev_bound : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
          ‖lmRescaledQ S (k'_seq n) (x'_seq n) Z_R‖ ≤ C_cone ^ 2 / M ^ 6 := by
        have hev_k := hk'_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop (-Real.log (δ_b / R))
        have hev_mom := hmom'_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop 1
        filter_upwards [hev_k, hev_mom] with n hn_k hn_mom
        let s_n : ℂ :=
          (x'_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k'_seq n) : ℂ) * Z_R
        have hs_re_im : ∀ (x H e r_val : ℝ),
            ((x : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (e : ℂ) * (-(r_val : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re = x ∧
            H - ((x : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (e : ℂ) * (-(r_val : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
              e * r_val := by
          intro x H e r_val
          constructor <;> simp
        have hs_re : s_n.re = x'_seq n :=
          (hs_re_im (x'_seq n) S.H (Real.exp (-k'_seq n)) R).1
        have hs_depth : wallDepth S s_n = Real.exp (-k'_seq n) * R :=
          (hs_re_im (x'_seq n) S.H (Real.exp (-k'_seq n)) R).2
        have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k'_seq n) := Real.exp_pos _
        have h_d_lo : Real.exp (-k'_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s_n := by
          rw [hs_depth]
          exact le_mul_of_one_le_right hexp_pos.le hR_ge_one
        have h_d_hi : wallDepth S s_n ≤ δ_b := by
          rw [hs_depth]
          have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-k'_seq n) ≤ δ_b / R := by
            rw [← Real.exp_log (div_pos hδ_b_pos hR_pos)]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
          exact (le_div_iff₀ hR_pos).mp h_exp_le
        have h_re_cone : |s_n.re - x'_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s_n := by
          rw [hs_re, sub_self, abs_zero, hs_depth]
          positivity
        have h_cone_n := hEnv.cone_bound (ϕ n) s_n h_d_lo h_d_hi h_re_cone
        let lam_n : ℝ := Real.exp (-k'_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k'_seq n)
        have hlam_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam_n :=
          div_nonneg hexp_pos.le (by linarith)
        have h_ratio : Real.exp (-k'_seq n) / wallDepth S s_n = (M ^ 4)⁻¹ := by
          rw [hs_depth]
          dsimp [R]
          field_simp [hexp_pos.ne']
        have h_rpow : ((M ^ 4)⁻¹) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) = (M⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
          rw [← inv_pow]
          have h_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ M⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hM_pos.le
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast M⁻¹ 4, ← Real.rpow_mul h_inv_nonneg]
          norm_num
        have h_sqrt_le : lam_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s_n‖ ≤ C_cone * (M⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
          calc
            lam_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s_n‖ ≤ lam_n * shapeModulus S s_n :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hlam_nonneg
            _ ≤ C_cone * (Real.exp (-k'_seq n) / wallDepth S s_n) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := h_cone_n
            _ = C_cone * (M⁻¹) ^ 3 := by rw [h_ratio, h_rpow]
        have h_lhs_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s_n‖ :=
          mul_nonneg hlam_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
        have h_sq_le : (lam_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s_n‖) ^ 2 ≤ (C_cone * (M⁻¹) ^ 3) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h_lhs_nonneg h_sqrt_le 2
        have h_lhs_eq : ‖lmRescaledQ S (k'_seq n) (x'_seq n) Z_R‖ =
            (lam_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s_n‖) ^ 2 := by
          change ‖((lam_n : ℂ) ^ 2) * S.q s_n‖ = _
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam_nonneg,
            mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        have h_rhs_eq : (C_cone * (M⁻¹) ^ 3) ^ 2 = C_cone ^ 2 / M ^ 6 := by
          field_simp [hM_pos.ne']
        rw [h_lhs_eq, ← h_rhs_eq]
        exact h_sq_le
      have h_tendsto_norm : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => ‖lmRescaledQ S (k'_seq n) (x'_seq n) Z_R‖)
          Filter.atTop (nhds ‖Q Z_R‖) :=
        continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hQ_conv.tendsto_at hZR_mem)
      have hQZR_le : ‖Q Z_R‖ ≤ C_cone ^ 2 / M ^ 6 :=
        le_of_tendsto h_tendsto_norm h_ev_bound
      have hM_le_M6 : M ≤ M ^ 6 := by
        have hM5 : 1 ≤ M ^ 5 := one_le_pow₀ hM_ge_one
        nlinarith
      have h_strict : C_cone ^ 2 / M ^ 6 < ‖Q Z₀‖ := by
        have hM6_pos : 0 < M ^ 6 := pow_pos hM_pos 6
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hM6_pos]
        have h1 : C_cone ^ 2 < M * ‖Q Z₀‖ := (div_lt_iff₀ hQZ₀_pos).mp hM_gt
        nlinarith
      have h_ne : Q Z₀ ≠ Q Z_R := by
        intro h_eq
        rw [h_eq] at hQZ₀_pos h_strict
        linarith
      exact ⟨Z₀, hZ₀_mem, Z_R, hZR_mem, h_ne⟩
  
  have h_real_zeros : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ),
      IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, (t : ℂ) ∈ U) →
      z₀ ∈ U → g z₀ ≠ 0 →
      {t ∈ Set.Icc a b | g (t : ℂ) = 0}.Finite := by
    intro U g a b z₀ hU_open hU_conv hg_holo hI_sub hz₀_mem hgz₀_ne
    by_contra h_not_fin
    have hS_inf : {t ∈ Set.Icc a b | g (t : ℂ) = 0}.Infinite := Set.not_finite.mp h_not_fin
    have hZ_inf : ((fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) '' {t ∈ Set.Icc a b | g (t : ℂ) = 0}).Infinite :=
      hS_inf.image Complex.ofReal_injective.injOn
    have hK_compact : IsCompact ((fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) '' Set.Icc a b) :=
      isCompact_Icc.image Complex.continuous_ofReal
    have hZ_sub : (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) '' {t ∈ Set.Icc a b | g (t : ℂ) = 0} ⊆
        (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) '' Set.Icc a b :=
      Set.image_mono (fun _ ht => ht.1)
    obtain ⟨w_star, hw_mem_K, hw_acc⟩ :=
      hZ_inf.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact hK_compact hZ_sub
    rcases hw_mem_K with ⟨t_star, ht_star, rfl⟩
    have hw_mem_U : (t_star : ℂ) ∈ U := hI_sub t_star ht_star
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ w in nhdsWithin (t_star : ℂ) {(t_star : ℂ)}ᶜ, g w = 0 := by
      refine (accPt_iff_frequently_nhdsNE.mp hw_acc).mono ?_
      rintro w ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      exact ht.2
    have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g U := hg_holo.analyticOnNhd hU_open
    have h_zero : Set.EqOn g 0 U :=
      hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero hU_conv.isPreconnected hw_mem_U h_freq
    exact hgz₀_ne (h_zero hz₀_mem)
  have h_sub_conj_eq_zero : ∀ w : ℂ, w - starRingEnd ℂ w = 0 ↔ w.im = 0 := by
    intro w
    constructor
    · intro hw
      have him := congr_arg Complex.im hw
      simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.conj_im, sub_neg_eq_add, Complex.zero_im] at him
      linarith
    · intro him
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp
      · simp [him]
  refine ⟨ϕ, F, Q, hϕ_mono, hF_holo, hQ_holo, hF_conv, hQ_conv, ?_⟩
  rcases h_nondeg with ⟨Z₀, hZ₀_mem, hFZ₀_ne⟩ | ⟨Z₁, hZ₁_mem, Z₂, hZ₂_mem, hQ_ne⟩
  · left
    intro D hD
    let U : Set ℂ := {z : ℂ | z.im < D}
    have hU_open : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ U := convex_halfSpace_im_lt D
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => F (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)) U := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_shift : z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
        change (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 0
        have hz_im : z.im < D := hz
        simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
          Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
        linarith
      have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
        (hF_holo _ hz_shift).differentiableAt (hLHP_open.mem_nhds hz_shift)
      exact (hF_at.comp z (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const _))).differentiableWithinAt
    have hI_sub : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (t : ℂ) ∈ U := by
      intro t _
      change ((t : ℂ)).im < D
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_im]
      linarith [hD.1]
    have hz₀_mem : Z₀ + (D : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U := by
      change (Z₀ + (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < D
      have hZ₀_im : Z₀.im < 0 := hZ₀_mem
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
      linarith
    have hgz₀_ne : F ((Z₀ + (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [add_sub_cancel_right] using hFZ₀_ne
    exact h_real_zeros U (fun z => F (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (-1) 1
      (Z₀ + (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) hU_open hU_conv hg_holo hI_sub hz₀_mem hgz₀_ne
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h_deg_not_fin
      let U_pos : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | 0 < w.re}
      have hU_pos_open : IsOpen U_pos := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
      have hU_pos_conv : Convex ℝ U_pos := convex_halfSpace_re_gt 0
      have h_rect_im_zero : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
          (Q ((u : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = 0 := by
        intro u hu y hy
        let η_u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Q ((u : ℂ) - w * Complex.I)
        let G_u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => η_u w - starRingEnd ℂ (η_u (starRingEnd ℂ w))
        have hη_diff : ∀ w ∈ U_pos, DifferentiableAt ℂ η_u w := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_re : 0 < w.re := hw
          have hw_lhp : (u : ℂ) - w * Complex.I ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
            change ((u : ℂ) - w * Complex.I).im < 0
            simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im,
              mul_one, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_sub, neg_lt_zero]
            exact hw_re
          have hQ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Q ((u : ℂ) - w * Complex.I) :=
            (hQ_holo _ hw_lhp).differentiableAt (hLHP_open.mem_nhds hw_lhp)
          exact hQ_at.comp w ((differentiableAt_const _).sub
            (differentiableAt_id.mul (differentiableAt_const _)))
        have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_u U_pos := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_re : 0 < w.re := hw
          have hw_conj : starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ U_pos := by
            change 0 < (starRingEnd ℂ w).re
            simpa only [Complex.conj_re] using hw_re
          have h_refl := (hη_diff (starRingEnd ℂ w) hw_conj).conj_conj
          rw [starRingEnd_self_apply] at h_refl
          change DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => starRingEnd ℂ (η_u (starRingEnd ℂ z))) w at h_refl
          exact ((hη_diff w hw).sub h_refl).differentiableWithinAt
        have hI_pos : ∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, (D : ℂ) ∈ U_pos := by
          intro D hD
          change 0 < ((D : ℂ)).re
          simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
          linarith [hD.1]
        have hG_all_zero : ∀ w ∈ U_pos, G_u w = 0 := by
          intro w₀ hw₀
          by_contra hw₀_ne
          have h_fin := h_real_zeros U_pos G_u 1 2 w₀ hU_pos_open hU_pos_conv hG_holo
            hI_pos hw₀ hw₀_ne
          apply h_deg_not_fin
          refine h_fin.subset ?_
          intro D hD
          refine ⟨hD.1, ?_⟩
          dsimp [G_u, η_u]
          rw [Complex.conj_ofReal]
          exact (h_sub_conj_eq_zero _).mpr (hD.2 u hu)
        have hy_mem : (y : ℂ) ∈ U_pos := by
          change 0 < ((y : ℂ)).re
          simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using hy
        have hGy := hG_all_zero (y : ℂ) hy_mem
        dsimp [G_u, η_u] at hGy
        rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hGy
        exact (h_sub_conj_eq_zero _).mp hGy
      let V : Set ℂ := {Z : ℂ | -1 < Z.re ∧ Z.re < 1 ∧ -2 < Z.im ∧ Z.im < -1}
      have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
          ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
            ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
              (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
      have hV_sub : V ⊆ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
        intro Z hZ
        change Z.im < 0
        linarith [hZ.2.2.2]
      have hV_im_zero : ∀ Z ∈ V, (Q Z).im = 0 := by
        intro Z hZ
        have hu_mem : Z.re ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hZ.1.le, hZ.2.1.le⟩
        have hy_pos : 0 < -Z.im := by linarith [hZ.2.2.2]
        have hZ_eq : ((Z.re : ℂ) - ((-Z.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Z := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp
        simpa only [hZ_eq] using h_rect_im_zero Z.re hu_mem (-Z.im) hy_pos
      have hQ_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Q lmLowerHalfPlane :=
        hQ_holo.analyticOnNhd hLHP_open
      rcases hQ_ana.is_constant_or_isOpen (convex_halfSpace_im_lt 0).isPreconnected with
        ⟨c, hc⟩ | h_open_map
      · exact hQ_ne ((hc Z₁ hZ₁_mem).trans (hc Z₂ hZ₂_mem).symm)
      · have hQV_open : IsOpen (Q '' V) := h_open_map V hV_sub hV_open
        let Z_star : ℂ := -((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        have hZ_star_mem : Z_star ∈ V := by
          dsimp [V, Z_star]
          simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one, sub_self, neg_zero,
            Complex.neg_im, Complex.mul_im, add_zero]
          norm_num
        obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, h_ball⟩ :=
          Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hQV_open (Q Z_star) ⟨Z_star, hZ_star_mem, rfl⟩
        let w₁ : ℂ := Q Z_star + ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        have hw₁_ball : w₁ ∈ Metric.ball (Q Z_star) ε := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          have h_sub : w₁ - Q Z_star = ((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := add_sub_cancel_left _ _
          rw [h_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (half_pos hε_pos).le]
          linarith
        obtain ⟨Z', hZ'_mem, hQZ'⟩ := h_ball hw₁_ball
        have hw₁_im_zero : w₁.im = 0 := hQZ' ▸ hV_im_zero Z' hZ'_mem
        have hw₁_im_pos : w₁.im = ε / 2 := by
          dsimp [w₁]
          simp [hV_im_zero Z_star hZ_star_mem]
        linarith
    · intro D hD ⟨u₀, hu₀_mem, hu₀_ne⟩
      let U_D : Set ℂ := {z : ℂ | -D < z.im ∧ z.im < D}
      have hU_D_open : IsOpen U_D :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
      have hU_D_conv : Convex ℝ U_D :=
        (convex_halfSpace_im_gt (-D)).inter (convex_halfSpace_im_lt D)
      let ψ_D : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Q (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      let h_D : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ψ_D z - starRingEnd ℂ (ψ_D (starRingEnd ℂ z))
      have hψ_diff : ∀ z ∈ U_D, DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_D z := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_lhp : z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
          change (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 0
          simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
          linarith [hz.2]
        have hQ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Q (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
          (hQ_holo _ hz_lhp).differentiableAt (hLHP_open.mem_nhds hz_lhp)
        exact hQ_at.comp z (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const _))
      have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_D U_D := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_conj : starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ U_D := by
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [Complex.conj_im]
            linarith [hz.2]
          · simp only [Complex.conj_im]
            linarith [hz.1]
        have h_refl := (hψ_diff (starRingEnd ℂ z) hz_conj).conj_conj
        rw [starRingEnd_self_apply] at h_refl
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (ψ_D (starRingEnd ℂ w))) z at h_refl
        exact ((hψ_diff z hz).sub h_refl).differentiableWithinAt
      have hI_D : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (u : ℂ) ∈ U_D := by
        intro u _
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [Complex.ofReal_im]
          linarith [hD.1]
        · simp only [Complex.ofReal_im]
          linarith [hD.1]
      have hhu₀_ne : h_D (u₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h_eq
        dsimp [h_D, ψ_D] at h_eq
        rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at h_eq
        exact hu₀_ne ((h_sub_conj_eq_zero _).mp h_eq)
      have h_fin := h_real_zeros U_D h_D (-1) 1 (u₀ : ℂ)
        hU_D_open hU_D_conv hh_holo hI_D (hI_D u₀ hu₀_mem) hhu₀_ne
      refine h_fin.subset ?_
      intro u hu
      refine ⟨hu.1, ?_⟩
      dsimp [h_D, ψ_D]
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal]
      exact (h_sub_conj_eq_zero _).mpr hu.2

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (K_seq k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hK_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto K_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (h_scales : ∀ n : ℕ,
      1 ≤ K_seq n ∧
      (17 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
      Real.exp (-k_seq n) < S.H / 10 ∧
      (K_seq n) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n))
    (hF_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z)
      F Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane)
    (hF_zeros : ∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
      {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0}.Finite) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq n) (k_seq n) (x_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

signature.name: nonzero_first_field_box_extinction
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (K_seq k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hK_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto K_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (h_scales : ∀ n : ℕ,
      1 ≤ K_seq n ∧
      (17 / 20 : ℝ) * K_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
      Real.exp (-k_seq n) < S.H / 10 ∧
      (K_seq n) ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n))
    (hF_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z)
      F Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane)
    (hF_zeros : ∀ D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2,
      {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 | F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0}.Finite) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => lmBoxModerateFraction S (K_seq n) (k_seq n) (x_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  let E : ℕ → Set (ℝ × ℝ) := fun n =>
    {p : ℝ × ℝ |
      p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧
      Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
        ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
      ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
        Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}
  
  have hE_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (E n) := by
    intro n
    let K : ℝ := K_seq n
    let k : ℝ := k_seq n
    let x : ℝ := x_seq n
    let M : ℝ := K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)
    let c_D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => max 1 (min 2 p.2)
    let Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p =>
      (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (c_D p : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hc_cont : Continuous c_D :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_snd)
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).sub
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hc_cont).mul continuous_const)))
    have hΨ_mem : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, Ψ p ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro p
      have hc_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ c_D p := le_max_left 1 (min 2 p.2)
      have hc_le : c_D p ≤ 2 := max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left 2 p.2)
      have hd_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
      have hd_lt : Real.exp (-k) < S.H / 10 := (h_scales n).2.2.1
      have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
      have hdc_ge : Real.exp (-k) ≤ Real.exp (-k) * c_D p :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt hd_pos) hc_ge
      have hdc_le : Real.exp (-k) * c_D p ≤ Real.exp (-k) * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc_le (le_of_lt hd_pos)
      have him : (Ψ p).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k) * c_D p := by
        simp only [Ψ, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      change |(Ψ p).im| < S.H
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hh_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖) :=
      (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem).norm
    have hF_closed : IsClosed
        ((Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) ∩
          ({p : ℝ × ℝ | Real.exp (-M) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖} ∩
            {p : ℝ × ℝ | ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp M})) :=
      (isClosed_Icc.prod isClosed_Icc).inter
        ((isClosed_le continuous_const hh_cont).inter (isClosed_le hh_cont continuous_const))
    have h_eq : E n =
        (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) ∩
          ({p : ℝ × ℝ | Real.exp (-M) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖} ∩
            {p : ℝ × ℝ | ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp M}) := by
      ext p
      change (p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧ p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧
          Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
            ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
          ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
            Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))) ↔
        (p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧ p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) ∧
          (Real.exp (-M) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ∧ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp M)
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hp1, hp2, hlo, hhi⟩
        have hc_eq : c_D p = p.2 := by
          dsimp only [c_D]
          rw [min_eq_right hp2.2, max_eq_right hp2.1]
        dsimp only [Ψ, M, K, k, x]
        rw [hc_eq]
        exact ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hlo, hhi⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hlo, hhi⟩
        have hc_eq : c_D p = p.2 := by
          dsimp only [c_D]
          rw [min_eq_right hp2.2, max_eq_right hp2.1]
        dsimp only [Ψ, M, K, k, x] at hlo hhi
        rw [hc_eq] at hlo hhi
        exact ⟨hp1, hp2, hlo, hhi⟩
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hF_closed.measurableSet
  
  have h_blowup : ∀ Z ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane, F Z ≠ 0 →
      ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) <
          ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z)‖ := by
    intro Z hZ hFZ
    have h_tendsto_norm :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖)
          Filter.atTop (nhds ‖F Z‖) :=
      (hF_conv.tendsto_at hZ).norm
    have hFZ_pos : 0 < ‖F Z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hFZ
    have h_ev1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        ‖F Z‖ / 2 < ‖lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖ :=
      h_tendsto_norm.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (half_lt_self hFZ_pos))
    let K_thr : ℝ := (20 / 7 : ℝ) * (2 / ‖F Z‖ + 1 / 2)
    have h_ev2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, K_thr ≤ K_seq n :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop.mp hK_tendsto K_thr
    refine (h_ev1.and h_ev2).mono ?_
    rintro n ⟨h1, h2⟩
    let K : ℝ := K_seq n
    let k : ℝ := k_seq n
    let B : ℝ := rowMomentFull S k
    let s_n : ℂ := (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := (h_scales n).1
    have hk_ge : (17 / 20 : ℝ) * K ≤ k := (h_scales n).2.1
    have hB_ge_rpow : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ B := (h_scales n).2.2.2
    have hB_ge_one : 1 ≤ B :=
      le_trans (Real.one_le_rpow hK1 (by norm_num)) hB_ge_rpow
    have hB_pos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB_ge_one
    have hd_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    have h_norm_eq : ‖lmRescaledF S k (x_seq n) Z‖ = (Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖ := by
      change ‖((Real.exp (-k) / B : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s_n‖ = (Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (le_of_lt hd_pos) (le_of_lt hB_pos))]
    have h_prod_eq : (Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖ * (B * Real.exp k) = ‖S.f s_n‖ := by
      have hB_ne : B ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB_pos
      calc (Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖ * (B * Real.exp k)
          = ((Real.exp (-k) / B) * B) * Real.exp k * ‖S.f s_n‖ := by ring
        _ = Real.exp (-k) * Real.exp k * ‖S.f s_n‖ := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hB_ne]
        _ = Real.exp (-k + k) * ‖S.f s_n‖ := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ = ‖S.f s_n‖ := by simp
    have h_sf_lower : (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ ‖S.f s_n‖ := by
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ Real.exp k :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hk_ge
      have h_be_ge : Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ B * Real.exp k := by
        calc Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K)
            = 1 * Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) := by ring
          _ ≤ B * Real.exp k :=
              mul_le_mul hB_ge_one h_exp_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (le_of_lt hB_pos)
      have h1_le : ‖F Z‖ / 2 ≤ (Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖ := by
        rw [← h_norm_eq]
        exact le_of_lt h1
      calc (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K)
          ≤ (‖F Z‖ / 2) * (B * Real.exp k) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_be_ge (by positivity)
        _ ≤ ((Real.exp (-k) / B) * ‖S.f s_n‖) * (B * Real.exp k) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le (by positivity)
        _ = ‖S.f s_n‖ := h_prod_eq
    have h_rpow_le_sqrt : K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt K := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK1 (by norm_num)
    have h_sqrt_le_lin : Real.sqrt K ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * K + 1 / 2 := by
      have h_sq : (Real.sqrt K) ^ 2 = K := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt K - 1) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    let Δ : ℝ := (17 / 20 : ℝ) * K - K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)
    have hΔ_ge : 2 / ‖F Z‖ ≤ Δ := by
      change (20 / 7 : ℝ) * (2 / ‖F Z‖ + 1 / 2) ≤ K at h2
      dsimp only [Δ]
      linarith
    have h_exp_Δ : 2 / ‖F Z‖ < Real.exp Δ := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp Δ
      linarith
    have h_one_lt : 1 < (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp Δ := by
      have hF_ne : ‖F Z‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hFZ_pos
      calc (1 : ℝ) = (‖F Z‖ / 2) * (2 / ‖F Z‖) := by field_simp
        _ < (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp Δ :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_exp_Δ (half_pos hFZ_pos)
    calc Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))
        = 1 * Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ < ((‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp Δ) * Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_one_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
      _ = (‖F Z‖ / 2) * (Real.exp Δ * Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))) := by ring
      _ = (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp (Δ + K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
      _ = (‖F Z‖ / 2) * Real.exp ((17 / 20 : ℝ) * K) := by
          congr 2
          dsimp only [Δ]
          ring
      _ ≤ ‖S.f s_n‖ := h_sf_lower
  
  let I_u : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1
  let I_D : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2
  let B_box : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := I_u ×ˢ I_D
  let χ : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun n => (E n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  let b_box : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := B_box.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hIu_meas : MeasurableSet I_u := measurableSet_Icc
  have hID_meas : MeasurableSet I_D := measurableSet_Icc
  have hB_meas : MeasurableSet B_box := hIu_meas.prod hID_meas
  have hIu_vol : MeasureTheory.volume I_u < ⊤ := by
    rw [Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hID_vol : MeasureTheory.volume I_D < ⊤ := by
    rw [Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hB_vol : (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) B_box < ⊤ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top hIu_vol hID_vol
  have hb_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable b_box
      (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hB_meas]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hB_vol.ne
  have hχ_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (χ n) := fun n =>
    measurable_const.indicator (hE_meas n)
  have hχ_bound_box : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖χ n p‖ ≤ b_box p := by
    intro n p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ E n
    · have hpB : p ∈ B_box := ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩
      simp [χ, b_box, Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hpB]
    · simp only [χ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, norm_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) p
  have hχ_int : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (χ n)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := fun n =>
    hb_int.mono' (hχ_meas n).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hχ_bound_box n))
  let g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n D => ∫ u : ℝ, χ n (u, D)
  have h_vol_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n) = ∫ D : ℝ, g n D := by
    intro n
    have h1 : ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, χ n p = MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n) :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (hE_meas n)
    rw [← h1, MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm (χ n) (hχ_int n)
  let bound_u : ℝ → ℝ := I_u.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hbound_u_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable bound_u MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hIu_meas]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hIu_vol.ne
  have hχ_slice_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D u : ℝ, ‖χ n (u, D)‖ ≤ bound_u u := by
    intro n D u
    by_cases hp : (u, D) ∈ E n
    · have hu : u ∈ I_u := hp.1
      simp [χ, bound_u, Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hu]
    · simp only [χ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, norm_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) u
  have hg_tendsto : ∀ D : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g n D) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro D
    by_cases hD : D ∈ I_D
    · have h_meas_u : ∀ n : ℕ,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun u : ℝ => χ n (u, D)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        fun n => ((hχ_meas n).comp (Continuous.prodMk_left D).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
      let Z_D : Set ℝ := {u ∈ I_u | F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0}
      have hZ_null : MeasureTheory.volume Z_D = 0 :=
        Set.Finite.measure_zero (hF_zeros D hD) MeasureTheory.volume
      have h_ae_notMem : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, u ∉ Z_D := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
        have h_set_eq : {u : ℝ | ¬ u ∉ Z_D} = Z_D := by
          ext u
          exact not_not
        rw [h_set_eq]
        exact hZ_null
      have h_ae_lim : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => χ n (u, D)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        refine h_ae_notMem.mono ?_
        intro u huZ
        by_cases hu : u ∈ I_u
        · have hFW : F ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
            intro hzero
            exact huZ ⟨hu, hzero⟩
          have hW_mem : (u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
            have hD1 : 1 ≤ D := hD.1
            change ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 0
            simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
              Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
            linarith
          have h_ev_blow := h_blowup ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) hW_mem hFW
          have h_ev_zero : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, χ n (u, D) = 0 := by
            refine h_ev_blow.mono ?_
            intro n hn_gt
            have h_not_in : (u, D) ∉ E n := by
              intro hp_in
              exact not_le_of_gt hn_gt hp_in.2.2.2
            exact Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_in _
          exact tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_eq h_ev_zero
        · have h_all_zero : ∀ n : ℕ, χ n (u, D) = 0 := by
            intro n
            have h_not_in : (u, D) ∉ E n := fun hp_in => hu hp_in.1
            exact Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_in _
          simpa only [h_all_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds
      have h_lim := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound_u
        h_meas_u hbound_u_int
        (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hχ_slice_bound n D)) h_ae_lim
      simpa only [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] using h_lim
    · have h_all_zero : ∀ n : ℕ, g n D = 0 := by
        intro n
        have h_u_zero : ∀ u : ℝ, χ n (u, D) = 0 := by
          intro u
          have h_not_in : (u, D) ∉ E n := fun hp_in => hD hp_in.2.1
          exact Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_in _
        simp only [g, h_u_zero, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
      simpa only [h_all_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds
  let bound_D : ℝ → ℝ := I_D.indicator (fun _ => (2 : ℝ))
  have hbound_D_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable bound_D MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hID_meas]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hID_vol.ne
  have hg_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (g n) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    fun n => (hχ_int n).integral_prod_right.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hg_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D : ℝ, ‖g n D‖ ≤ bound_D D := by
    intro n D
    have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ g n D :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) (u, D))
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hg_nonneg]
    by_cases hD : D ∈ I_D
    · dsimp only [bound_D]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hD]
      have h_slice_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun u : ℝ => χ n (u, D)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hbound_u_int.mono'
          (((hχ_meas n).comp (Continuous.prodMk_left D).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hχ_slice_bound n D))
      have h_le : ∀ u : ℝ, χ n (u, D) ≤ bound_u u := by
        intro u
        calc χ n (u, D) ≤ ‖χ n (u, D)‖ := le_abs_self _
          _ ≤ bound_u u := hχ_slice_bound n D u
      calc g n D
          ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, bound_u u := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_slice_int hbound_u_int h_le
        _ = MeasureTheory.volume.real I_u := MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one hIu_meas
        _ = 2 := by
            rw [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
            norm_num
    · have h_u_zero : ∀ u : ℝ, χ n (u, D) = 0 := by
        intro u
        have h_not_in : (u, D) ∉ E n := fun hp_in => hD hp_in.2.1
        exact Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_in _
      simp [g, bound_D, h_u_zero, Set.indicator_of_notMem hD]
  have h_outer := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound_D
    hg_meas hbound_D_int
    (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hg_bound n))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg_tendsto)
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at h_outer
  have h_vol_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [← h_vol_eq] using h_outer
  
  have h_half := h_vol_tendsto.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  rw [mul_zero] at h_half
  exact h_half

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_s1 : ∀ (Q_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (D a b : ℝ),
      D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 → -1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ Z : ℂ, -3 ≤ Z.im → Z.im < 0 → DifferentiableAt ℂ (Q_seq n) Z) →
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn Q_seq Q Filter.atTop lmLowerHalfPlane →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, (Q ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im ≠ 0) →
      ∃ (U : Set ℂ) (c₁ c_ψ C_ψ C_kern : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
        (p_seq ψ_seq ψ_inv_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (IsOpen U ∧
          (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, (u : ℂ) ∈ U) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ U, -3 ≤ (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ∧ (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 0)) ∧
        (0 < c₁ ∧ 0 < c_ψ ∧ c_ψ ≤ C_ψ ∧ 0 ≤ C_kern) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (p_seq n) U ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ_seq n) U ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ_inv_seq n) U ∧
          (∀ z ∈ U,
            (p_seq n z) ^ 2 = Q_seq n (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∧
            ψ_seq n z * ψ_inv_seq n z = 1 ∧
            (ψ_inv_seq n z) ^ 2 = p_seq n z) ∧
          (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b,
            c₁ ≤ (p_seq n (u : ℂ)).re ∧
            c_ψ ≤ ‖ψ_seq n (u : ℂ)‖ ∧
            ‖ψ_seq n (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_ψ ∧
            ‖ψ_seq n (u : ℂ) * deriv (deriv (ψ_seq n)) (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_kern) := by
    intro Q_seq D a b hD ha hab hb hQ_seq_holo hQ_seq_conv h_im_ne
    let K_base : Set ℂ :=
      {z : ℂ | z.re ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 4 : ℝ)) (1 / 4)}
    have hKb_closed : IsClosed K_base :=
      (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_im)
    have hKb_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded K_base := by
      refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : ℂ)) (r := 3)).subset (fun z hz => ?_)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hre : |z.re| ≤ 2 := abs_le.mpr hz.1
      have him : |z.im| ≤ 1 / 4 := abs_le.mpr hz.2
      have hnorm := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im z
      linarith
    have hKb_compact : IsCompact K_base :=
      Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hKb_closed hKb_bdd
    have hKb_ne : K_base.Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [K_base]⟩
    let shiftD : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hshift_cont : Continuous shiftD := continuous_id.sub continuous_const
    have hKb_shift : ∀ z ∈ K_base,
        -3 ≤ (shiftD z).im ∧ (shiftD z).im < 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have him : (shiftD z).im = z.im - D := by simp [shiftD]
      rw [him]
      constructor <;> linarith [hz.2.1, hz.2.2, hD.1, hD.2]
    let Q_inf : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Q (shiftD z)
    have hQ_inf_cont : ContinuousOn Q_inf K_base :=
      hQ_holo.continuousOn.comp hshift_cont.continuousOn (fun z hz => (hKb_shift z hz).2)
    have h_real_mem_Kb : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, (u : ℂ) ∈ K_base := by
      intro u hu
      change (u : ℂ).re ∈ Set.Icc (-2 : ℝ) 2 ∧ (u : ℂ).im ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 4 : ℝ)) (1 / 4)
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Set.mem_Icc]
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩⟩
    have h_im_cont : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => |(Q_inf (u : ℂ)).im|) (Set.Icc a b) :=
      continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
        (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
          (hQ_inf_cont.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn h_real_mem_Kb))
    obtain ⟨u_star, hu_star_mem, hu_star_min⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hab) h_im_cont
    let η_m : ℝ := |(Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)).im| / 3
    have hη_pos : 0 < η_m :=
      div_pos (abs_pos.mpr (h_im_ne u_star hu_star_mem)) (by norm_num)
    have h_im_ge_3eta : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 3 * η_m ≤ |(Q_inf (u : ℂ)).im| := by
      intro u hu
      have hmin : |(Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)).im| ≤ |(Q_inf (u : ℂ)).im| := hu_star_min hu
      dsimp [η_m]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨z_max, _hz_max_mem, hz_max_top⟩ :=
      hKb_compact.exists_isMaxOn hKb_ne hQ_inf_cont.norm
    let M_Q : ℝ := ‖Q_inf z_max‖ + 1
    have h_norm_le_MQ : ∀ z ∈ K_base, ‖Q_inf z‖ ≤ ‖Q_inf z_max‖ := fun z hz => hz_max_top hz
    have hMQ_gt_eta : η_m < M_Q := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ |(Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)).im| := abs_nonneg _
      have h1 : |(Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)).im| ≤ ‖Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      have h2 : ‖Q_inf (u_star : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖Q_inf z_max‖ :=
        h_norm_le_MQ (u_star : ℂ) (h_real_mem_Kb u_star hu_star_mem)
      dsimp [η_m, M_Q]
      linarith
    have hMQ_pos : 0 < M_Q := lt_trans hη_pos hMQ_gt_eta
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
        (hKb_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hQ_inf_cont) η_m hη_pos
    let δ_m : ℝ := min (1 / 8 : ℝ) (δ₀ / 3)
    have hδm_pos : 0 < δ_m := lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have hδm_le : δ_m ≤ 1 / 8 := min_le_left _ _
    have h2δm_lt : 2 * δ_m < δ₀ := by
      have : δ_m ≤ δ₀ / 3 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    let K_m : Set ℂ :=
      {z : ℂ | z.re ∈ Set.Icc (a - δ_m) (b + δ_m) ∧ z.im ∈ Set.Icc (-δ_m) δ_m}
    let U : Set ℂ :=
      {z : ℂ | a - δ_m < z.re ∧ z.re < b + δ_m ∧ -δ_m < z.im ∧ z.im < δ_m}
    have hU_open : IsOpen U :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
        ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
          ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
            (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
    have hU_sub_Km : U ⊆ K_m := fun z ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨le_of_lt h1, le_of_lt h2⟩, ⟨le_of_lt h3, le_of_lt h4⟩⟩
    have hKm_sub_Kb : K_m ⊆ K_base := by
      intro z ⟨hre, him⟩
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hre.1], by linarith [hre.2]⟩,
        ⟨by linarith [him.1], by linarith [him.2]⟩⟩
    have hKm_closed : IsClosed K_m :=
      (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_im)
    have hKm_compact : IsCompact K_m := hKb_compact.of_isClosed_subset hKm_closed hKm_sub_Kb
    have h_Qinf_Km : ∀ z ∈ K_m, 2 * η_m < |(Q_inf z).im| := by
      intro z hz
      let u_z : ℝ := max a (min b z.re)
      have huz_mem : u_z ∈ Set.Icc a b :=
        ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hab (min_le_left _ _)⟩
      have hre_diff : |z.re - u_z| ≤ δ_m := by
        dsimp [u_z]
        rcases le_total b z.re with hbz | hzb
        · rw [min_eq_left hbz, max_eq_right hab, abs_le]
          exact ⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩
        · rw [min_eq_right hzb]
          rcases le_total a z.re with haz | hza
          · rw [max_eq_right haz, sub_self, abs_zero]
            exact le_of_lt hδm_pos
          · rw [max_eq_left hza, abs_le]
            exact ⟨by linarith [hz.1.1], by linarith⟩
      have him_abs : |z.im| ≤ δ_m := abs_le.mpr hz.2
      have hdist_lt : dist z (u_z : ℂ) < δ₀ := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        have hle := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (z - (u_z : ℂ))
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
          sub_zero] at hle
        linarith
      have hQ_diff : ‖Q_inf z - Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)‖ < η_m := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using
          hδ₀ z (hKm_sub_Kb hz) (u_z : ℂ) (h_real_mem_Kb u_z huz_mem) hdist_lt
      have him_diff : |(Q_inf z - Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)).im| < η_m :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hQ_diff
      have him_u : 3 * η_m ≤ |(Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)).im| := h_im_ge_3eta u_z huz_mem
      have htri : |(Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)).im| ≤
          |(Q_inf z - Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)).im| + |(Q_inf z).im| := by
        have h_add := abs_add_le ((Q_inf (u_z : ℂ)).im - (Q_inf z).im) (Q_inf z).im
        rw [sub_add_cancel, abs_sub_comm] at h_add
        simpa only [Complex.sub_im] using h_add
      linarith
    have hLHP_open : IsOpen lmLowerHalfPlane := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    have hKm'_compact : IsCompact (shiftD '' K_m) := hKm_compact.image hshift_cont
    have hKm'_sub : shiftD '' K_m ⊆ lmLowerHalfPlane := by
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact (hKb_shift z (hKm_sub_Kb hz)).2
    have h_unif :=
      (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hLHP_open).mp hQ_seq_conv
        (shiftD '' K_m) hKm'_sub hKm'_compact
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h_unif
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (h_unif (min η_m 1) (lt_min hη_pos zero_lt_one))
    let Q_loc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => Q_seq n (shiftD z)
    let L_fn : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => Complex.log (Q_loc n z)
    let p_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => Complex.exp (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * L_fn n z)
    let ψ_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => Complex.exp (((-1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * L_fn n z)
    let ψ_inv_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n z => Complex.exp (((1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * L_fn n z)
    let c₁ : ℝ := η_m / (2 * Real.sqrt M_Q)
    let c_ψ : ℝ := Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log M_Q)
    let C_ψ : ℝ := Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log η_m)
    let r_c : ℝ := δ_m / 3
    let C_kern : ℝ := C_ψ * ((C_ψ / r_c) / r_c)
    have hu_mem_U : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, (u : ℂ) ∈ U := by
      intro u hu
      change a - δ_m < (u : ℂ).re ∧ (u : ℂ).re < b + δ_m ∧
        -δ_m < (u : ℂ).im ∧ (u : ℂ).im < δ_m
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2], by linarith, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨U, c₁, c_ψ, C_ψ, C_kern, N₀, p_seq, ψ_seq, ψ_inv_seq, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨hU_open, hu_mem_U, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      exact hKb_shift z (hKm_sub_Kb (hU_sub_Km hz))
    · refine ⟨div_pos hη_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hMQ_pos)),
        Real.exp_pos _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        have hlog : Real.log η_m ≤ Real.log M_Q := Real.log_le_log hη_pos (le_of_lt hMQ_gt_eta)
        linarith
      · have : 0 < C_ψ := Real.exp_pos _
        have : 0 < r_c := by dsimp [r_c]; positivity
        dsimp [C_kern]; positivity
    · intro n hn
      have hQ_bounds : ∀ z ∈ K_m,
          η_m < |(Q_loc n z).im| ∧ ‖Q_loc n z‖ < M_Q := by
        intro z hz
        have hdist := hN₀ n hn (shiftD z) ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hdist
        have h_lt_eta : ‖Q_loc n z - Q_inf z‖ < η_m :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (min_le_left _ _)
        have h_lt_one : ‖Q_loc n z - Q_inf z‖ < 1 :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hdist (min_le_right _ _)
        have him_diff : |(Q_loc n z - Q_inf z).im| < η_m :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) h_lt_eta
        have him_inf : 2 * η_m < |(Q_inf z).im| := h_Qinf_Km z hz
        have htri_im : |(Q_inf z).im| ≤
            |(Q_loc n z - Q_inf z).im| + |(Q_loc n z).im| := by
          have h_add := abs_add_le ((Q_inf z).im - (Q_loc n z).im) (Q_loc n z).im
          rw [sub_add_cancel, abs_sub_comm] at h_add
          simpa only [Complex.sub_im] using h_add
        have htri_norm : ‖Q_loc n z‖ ≤ ‖Q_loc n z - Q_inf z‖ + ‖Q_inf z‖ := by
          have h_add := norm_add_le (Q_loc n z - Q_inf z) (Q_inf z)
          rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h_add
        have hnorm_inf : ‖Q_inf z‖ ≤ ‖Q_inf z_max‖ := h_norm_le_MQ z (hKm_sub_Kb hz)
        exact ⟨by linarith, by dsimp [M_Q]; linarith⟩
      have hL_diff : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℂ (L_fn n) z := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_shift := hKb_shift z (hKm_sub_Kb (hU_sub_Km hz))
        have hQ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (Q_loc n) z :=
          (hQ_seq_holo n (shiftD z) hz_shift.1 hz_shift.2).comp z
            (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const _))
        have him_pos : 0 < |(Q_loc n z).im| :=
          lt_trans hη_pos (hQ_bounds z (hU_sub_Km hz)).1
        have h_slit : Q_loc n z ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
          Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr (abs_pos.mp him_pos))
        exact (hQ_diff.hasDerivAt.clog h_slit).differentiableAt
      have hp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (p_seq n) U := fun z hz =>
        (Complex.differentiable_exp.differentiableAt.comp z
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul (hL_diff z hz))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ_seq n) U := fun z hz =>
        (Complex.differentiable_exp.differentiableAt.comp z
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul (hL_diff z hz))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hψ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ_inv_seq n) U := fun z hz =>
        (Complex.differentiable_exp.differentiableAt.comp z
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul (hL_diff z hz))).differentiableWithinAt
      have h_alg : ∀ z ∈ U,
          (p_seq n z) ^ 2 = Q_loc n z ∧
          ψ_seq n z * ψ_inv_seq n z = 1 ∧
          (ψ_inv_seq n z) ^ 2 = p_seq n z := by
        intro z hz
        have him_pos : 0 < |(Q_loc n z).im| :=
          lt_trans hη_pos (hQ_bounds z (hU_sub_Km hz)).1
        have h_ne : Q_loc n z ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; rw [h0, Complex.zero_im, abs_zero] at him_pos; exact lt_irrefl 0 him_pos
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · dsimp [p_seq, L_fn]
          rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add]
          have h_sum : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log (Q_loc n z) +
              ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log (Q_loc n z) = Complex.log (Q_loc n z) := by
            push_cast; ring
          rw [h_sum, Complex.exp_log h_ne]
        · dsimp [ψ_seq, ψ_inv_seq]
          rw [← Complex.exp_add]
          have h_sum : ((-1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * L_fn n z + ((1 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * L_fn n z = 0 := by
            push_cast; ring
          rw [h_sum, Complex.exp_zero]
        · dsimp [ψ_inv_seq, p_seq]
          rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add]
          congr 1
          push_cast; ring
      have hψ_pt_bounds : ∀ z ∈ U, c_ψ ≤ ‖ψ_seq n z‖ ∧ ‖ψ_seq n z‖ ≤ C_ψ := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨him_gt, hnorm_lt⟩ := hQ_bounds z (hU_sub_Km hz)
        have hnorm_gt : η_m < ‖Q_loc n z‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le him_gt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _)
        have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖Q_loc n z‖ := lt_trans hη_pos hnorm_gt
        have hnorm_eq : ‖ψ_seq n z‖ = Real.exp (-(1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.log ‖Q_loc n z‖) := by
          dsimp [ψ_seq, L_fn]
          rw [Complex.norm_exp]
          congr 1
          simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
            Complex.log_re]
          ring
        rw [hnorm_eq]
        have hlog_lo : Real.log η_m ≤ Real.log ‖Q_loc n z‖ :=
          Real.log_le_log hη_pos (le_of_lt hnorm_gt)
        have hlog_hi : Real.log ‖Q_loc n z‖ ≤ Real.log M_Q :=
          Real.log_le_log hnorm_pos (le_of_lt hnorm_lt)
        exact ⟨Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith), Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)⟩
      have hp_re_ge : ∀ z ∈ U, c₁ ≤ (p_seq n z).re := by
        intro z hz

    obtain ⟨h_growth_right, h_growth_left⟩ := h_growth
    let S_mod : Set ℝ :=
      {u ∈ Set.Icc a b | Real.exp (-M) ≤ ‖g (u : ℂ)‖ ∧ ‖g (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp M}

    have h_exp_dom_eq : ((3 * C_ψ / c_ψ) ^ 2) * Real.exp (4 * M) =

      rw [Real.exp_add, mul_comm, show (2 : ℝ) * Real.log (3 * C_ψ / c_ψ) =

        c_ψ * r₂ ≤ 2 * Real.exp M →

      have hsq1 : 4 * Real.exp (-2 * M) ≤ 9 * C_ψ ^ 2 * r₁ ^ 2 := by

        have h2 : (2 * Real.exp (-M)) ^ 2 = 4 * Real.exp (-2 * M) := by
          rw [mul_pow, sq (Real.exp _), ← Real.exp_add]
          norm_num
          ring_nf
        linarith [show (3 * C_ψ * r₁) ^ 2 = 9 * C_ψ ^ 2 * r₁ ^ 2 by ring]
      have hsq2 : c_ψ ^ 2 * r₂ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (2 * M) := by

        calc Real.exp (B * c₁ * (u₂ - u₁)) * (4 * c_ψ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * M))

          _ = 9 * C_ψ ^ 2 * c_ψ ^ 2 * (Real.exp (B * c₁ * (u₂ - u₁)) * r₁ ^ 2) := by ring
          _ ≤ 9 * C_ψ ^ 2 * c_ψ ^ 2 * r₂ ^ 2 :=

        have hexp_ne : Real.exp (-2 * M) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos _)
        field_simp [hc_ne, hexp_ne]
        ring
      have h_lin := Real.exp_le_exp.mp h_exp_le
      dsimp [Δ_dom]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
    have h_diam_Ep : ∀ u₁ ∈ E_p, ∀ u₂ ∈ E_p, u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ - u₁ ≤ Δ_dom := by
      intro u₁ ⟨⟨hu₁_ab, hg1_lo, _⟩, hw1⟩ u₂ ⟨⟨hu₂_ab, _, hg2_hi⟩, hw2⟩ hu12
      have hw1_le : ‖w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (w_m (u₁ : ℂ))]
      have h_gr := (h_growth_right u₁ hu₁_ab u₂ hu₂_ab hu12 hw1_le).1
      have hr1 : 2 * Real.exp (-M) ≤ 3 * C_ψ * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by
        have h_eq : ‖g (u₁ : ℂ)‖ = ‖ψ (u₁ : ℂ)‖ * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ) + w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by
          rw [hg_decomp (u₁ : ℂ) (h_Icc_U u₁ hu₁_ab), norm_mul]
        have h_tri : ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ) + w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (w_p (u₁ : ℂ)) (w_m (u₁ : ℂ)); linarith
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul (h_row u₁ hu₁_ab).2.2.1 h_tri (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hC_ψ_pos)
        linarith
      have hr2 : c_ψ * ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp M := by
        have h_eq : ‖g (u₂ : ℂ)‖ = ‖ψ (u₂ : ℂ)‖ * ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ) + w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by
          rw [hg_decomp (u₂ : ℂ) (h_Icc_U u₂ hu₂_ab), norm_mul]
        have h_rev : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ) + w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by

        have h_mul := mul_le_mul (h_row u₂ hu₂_ab).2.1 h_rev (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)

    have h_diam_Em : ∀ u₁ ∈ E_m, ∀ u₂ ∈ E_m, u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ - u₁ ≤ Δ_dom := by
