      have hw2_le : ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (w_p (u₂ : ℂ))]
      have h_gr := (h_growth_left u₁ hu₁_ab u₂ hu₂_ab hu12 hw2_le).1
      have hr2 : 2 * Real.exp (-M) ≤ 3 * C_ψ * ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by

        have h_mul := mul_le_mul (h_row u₂ hu₂_ab).2.2.1 h_tri (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hC_ψ_pos)

      have hr1 : c_ψ * ‖w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp M := by
        have h_eq : ‖g (u₁ : ℂ)‖ = ‖ψ (u₁ : ℂ)‖ * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ) + w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by
          rw [hg_decomp (u₁ : ℂ) (h_Icc_U u₁ hu₁_ab), norm_mul]

          have h_tri : ‖w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ) + w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ + ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by

    have h_diam_E0p : ∀ u₁ ∈ E_0p, ∀ u₂ ∈ E_0p, u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ - u₁ ≤ Δ_mid := by
      intro u₁ ⟨⟨hu₁_ab, hg1_lo, _⟩, hw1_lo, _⟩ u₂ ⟨⟨hu₂_ab, _, _⟩, _, hw2_hi⟩ hu12
      obtain ⟨h_gr, h_lyap⟩ := h_growth_right u₁ hu₁_ab u₂ hu₂_ab hu12 hw1_lo
      have hRp1_pos : 0 < ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h_eq : ‖g (u₁ : ℂ)‖ = ‖ψ (u₁ : ℂ)‖ * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ) + w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ := by

      have h_lin := Real.exp_le_exp.mp h_exp_le

    have h_diam_E0m : ∀ u₁ ∈ E_0m, ∀ u₂ ∈ E_0m, u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ - u₁ ≤ Δ_mid := by
      intro u₁ ⟨⟨hu₁_ab, _, _⟩, _, hw1_hi⟩ u₂ ⟨⟨hu₂_ab, hg2_lo, _⟩, hw2_lo, _⟩ hu12

        have h_eq : ‖g (u₂ : ℂ)‖ = ‖ψ (u₂ : ℂ)‖ * ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ) + w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by

        have h_mul := mul_le_mul (h_row u₂ hu₂_ab).2.2.1 h_tri (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hC_ψ_pos)

        have hprod_pos : 0 < C_ψ * (2 * ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖) := by linarith
        have hwm_pos : 0 < ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ := by
          by_contra hle; have h0 : ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hle) (norm_nonneg _)
          rw [h0] at hprod_pos; norm_num at hprod_pos
        positivity
      have hRm1_le_4Rp1 : ‖w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
        have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw1_hi 2
        linarith [show (2 * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖) ^ 2 = 4 * ‖w_p (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 by ring]
      have hRp2_le_Rm2 : ‖w_p (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 :=

      have hRm1_le_12 : ‖w_m (u₁ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 12 * ‖w_m (u₂ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by linarith

    have h_diam_vol : ∀ (E : Set ℝ) (Δ : ℝ),

        (∀ u₁ ∈ E, ∀ u₂ ∈ E, u₁ ≤ u₂ → u₂ - u₁ ≤ Δ) →
        MeasureTheory.volume.real E ≤ Δ := by
      intro E Δ hE_sub hΔ h_diam
      rcases E.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hE_ne
      · simpa [MeasureTheory.measureReal_empty] using hΔ
      · let m : ℝ := sInf E
        have h_bdd : BddBelow E := bddBelow_Icc.mono hE_sub
        have h_sub_Icc : E ⊆ Set.Icc m (m + Δ) := by

          have h_le_m : u - Δ ≤ m := by

            rcases le_total v u with hvu | huv

            · linarith

            ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc m (m + Δ)) :=

          _ = (m + Δ) - m := Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith)
          _ = Δ := by ring
    have h_cover : S_mod ⊆ (E_p ∪ E_m) ∪ (E_0p ∪ E_0m) := by

    have h_union_fin : MeasureTheory.volume ((E_p ∪ E_m) ∪ (E_0p ∪ E_0m)) ≠ ⊤ :=

    have h_vEm := h_diam_vol E_m Δ_dom (fun u hu => hu.1.1) hΔ_dom_nn h_diam_Em

    have h_vE0m := h_diam_vol E_0m Δ_mid (fun u hu => hu.1.1) hΔ_mid_nn h_diam_E0m

      _ = (8 * M + 4 * Real.log (3 * C_ψ / c_ψ) + 2 * Real.log 12) / (c₁ * B) := by

  have h_s3 : ∀ (A : ℕ → Set ℝ) (F_zero : Set ℝ),
      F_zero.Finite →
      (∀ a b : ℝ, -1 ≤ a → a < b → b ≤ 1 →
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, u ∉ F_zero) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.volume.real (A n ∩ Set.Icc a b))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => MeasureTheory.volume.real (A n ∩ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro A F_zero hF_fin h_good
    classical
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    let F₀ : Finset ℝ := hF_fin.toFinset

    have hB_large : 8 * C_kern ≤ c₁ * B_n ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 8 * C_kern / c₁ ≤ R_thr :=
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      have h2_raw : 8 * C_kern ≤ t_n * c₁ :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hc₁).mp (le_trans h1 htn_ge_R)
      have h2 : 8 * C_kern ≤ c₁ * t_n := by linarith
      have h3 : t_n ≤ B_n ^ 2 := by nlinarith [htn_ge_one, hBn_ge_one]
      exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (le_of_lt hc₁))
    let Ψ_n : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    let g_n : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => S.f (Ψ_n z)
    have hΨ_deriv : ∀ z : ℂ, HasDerivAt Ψ_n (d_n : ℂ) z := by
      intro z
      have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w) 1 z := hasDerivAt_id z
      have h_sub := h_id.sub_const ((D : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have h_mul := h_sub.const_mul (d_n : ℂ)
      rw [mul_one] at h_mul
      exact h_mul.const_add ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hΨ_mem_U : ∀ z ∈ U, Ψ_n z ∈ horizStrip S.H := fun z hz =>
      h_strip_mem n (z - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) (hU_im z hz).1 (hU_im z hz).2
    have hg_deriv1 : ∀ z ∈ U, HasDerivAt g_n (deriv S.f (Ψ_n z) * (d_n : ℂ)) z := by
      intro z hz
      have h_mem := hΨ_mem_U z hz
      have hf_d : HasDerivAt S.f (deriv S.f (Ψ_n z)) (Ψ_n z) :=
        ((S.f_holo _ h_mem).differentiableAt (isOpen_horizStrip.mem_nhds h_mem)).hasDerivAt
      exact hf_d.comp z (hΨ_deriv z)
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_n U := fun z hz =>
      (hg_deriv1 z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hf'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      S.f_holo.deriv isOpen_horizStrip
    have hg_ode : ∀ z ∈ U,
        deriv (deriv g_n) z = (B_n : ℂ) ^ 2 * (p_seq n z) ^ 2 * g_n z ∧
        ψ_seq n z * ψ_inv_seq n z = 1 ∧
        (ψ_inv_seq n z) ^ 2 = p_seq n z := by
      intro z₀ hz₀
      obtain ⟨hp_sq, h_prod_one, h_inv_sq⟩ := h_alg z₀ hz₀
      refine ⟨?_, h_prod_one, h_inv_sq⟩
      have h_mem := hΨ_mem_U z₀ hz₀
      have hf'_d : HasDerivAt (deriv S.f) (deriv (deriv S.f) (Ψ_n z₀)) (Ψ_n z₀) :=
        ((hf'_holo _ h_mem).differentiableAt (isOpen_horizStrip.mem_nhds h_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have h_comp := (hf'_d.comp z₀ (hΨ_deriv z₀)).mul_const (d_n : ℂ)
      have h_ev : deriv g_n =ᶠ[nhds z₀] (fun w => deriv S.f (Ψ_n w) * (d_n : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
          (fun w hw => (hg_deriv1 w hw).deriv)
      have hg2_val : deriv (deriv g_n) z₀ =
          (deriv (deriv S.f) (Ψ_n z₀) * (d_n : ℂ)) * (d_n : ℂ) :=
        (h_comp.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).deriv
      rw [hg2_val, S.deriv2_f (Ψ_n z₀) h_mem, hp_sq]
      dsimp [lmRescaledQ, g_n, Ψ_n, B_n, d_n]
      have hBn_ne_c : (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hBn_pos)
      push_cast
      field_simp [hBn_ne_c]
    have h_meas_le := h_s2 U a b g_n (p_seq n) (ψ_seq n) (ψ_inv_seq n)
      B_n t_n c₁ c_ψ C_ψ C_kern hU_open (le_of_lt hab_lt) h_Icc_U
      hBn_pos (by positivity) hc₁ hc_ψ hC_ψ hC_kern hB_large
      hg_holo hp_holo hψ_holo hψ_inv_holo hg_ode h_row
    have h_inter_eq : A_row n ∩ Set.Icc a b =
        {u ∈ Set.Icc a b | Real.exp (-t_n) ≤ ‖g_n (u : ℂ)‖ ∧ ‖g_n (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp t_n} := by
      ext u; exact and_comm
    rw [h_inter_eq] at *
    have h_frac_lt : (8 * t_n + C_num) / (c₁ * B_n) < ε := by
      have h_num_le : 8 * t_n + C_num ≤ (8 + C_num) * t_n := by nlinarith [htn_ge_one]
      have h_den_ge : c₁ * t_n ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * B_n :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htn_sq_le_Bn (le_of_lt hc₁)
      have h1 : (8 * t_n + C_num) / (c₁ * B_n) ≤ ((8 + C_num) * t_n) / (c₁ * t_n ^ 2) := by
        calc (8 * t_n + C_num) / (c₁ * B_n)
            ≤ ((8 + C_num) * t_n) / (c₁ * B_n) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le (by positivity)
          _ ≤ ((8 + C_num) * t_n) / (c₁ * t_n ^ 2) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) h_den_ge
      have h2 : ((8 + C_num) * t_n) / (c₁ * t_n ^ 2) = (8 + C_num) / (c₁ * t_n) := by
        have htn_ne : t_n ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have hc1_ne : c₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₁
        field_simp [htn_ne, hc1_ne]
      have h3 : (8 + C_num) / (c₁ * t_n) < (8 + C_num + 1) / (c₁ * t_n) :=
        div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have h4 : (8 + C_num + 1) / (c₁ * t_n) ≤ ε := by
        have hR_eps : (8 + C_num + 1) / (c₁ * ε) ≤ t_n :=
          le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) htn_ge_R
        have h_mul : 8 + C_num + 1 ≤ t_n * (c₁ * ε) :=
          (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hR_eps
        exact (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (by rw [h2]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h3 h4)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg]
    have h_meas_le' : MeasureTheory.volume.real
        {u ∈ Set.Icc a b | Real.exp (-t_n) ≤ ‖g_n (u : ℂ)‖ ∧ ‖g_n (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ Real.exp t_n} ≤
        (8 * t_n + C_num) / (c₁ * B_n) := by
      dsimp [C_num]
      rwa [← add_assoc]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_meas_le' h_frac_lt
  
  let E : ℕ → Set (ℝ × ℝ) := fun n =>
    {p : ℝ × ℝ |
      p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧
      Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
        ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
      ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
        Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}
  have hE_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (E n) := by
    intro n
    let c_D : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => max (1 : ℝ) (min (2 : ℝ) p.2)
    have hc_cont : Continuous c_D :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_snd)
    let Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p =>
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (c_D p : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).sub
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hc_cont).mul continuous_const)))
    have hΨ_mem : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, Ψ p ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro p
      have hc1 : 1 ≤ c_D p := le_max_left _ _
      have hc2 : c_D p ≤ 2 := max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hd_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k_seq n) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hd_lt : Real.exp (-k_seq n) < S.H / 10 := (h_scales n).2.2.1
      have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
      have him : (Ψ p).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k_seq n) * c_D p := by
        simp only [Ψ, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      show |(Ψ p).im| < S.H
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    have h_norm_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖) :=
      (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem).norm
    have hE_eq : E n =
        (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2) ∩
        ({p : ℝ × ℝ | Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖} ∩
          {p : ℝ × ℝ | ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}) := by
      ext p
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hp1, hp2, hlo, hhi⟩
        have hc : c_D p = p.2 := by
          dsimp [c_D]; rw [min_eq_right hp2.2, max_eq_right hp2.1]
        have hΨ_eq : Ψ p = (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          dsimp [Ψ]; rw [hc]
        refine ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖; rwa [hΨ_eq]
        · change ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)); rwa [hΨ_eq]
      · rintro ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hlo, hhi⟩
        have hc : c_D p = p.2 := by
          dsimp [c_D]; rw [min_eq_right hp2.2, max_eq_right hp2.1]
        have hΨ_eq : Ψ p = (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          dsimp [Ψ]; rw [hc]
        have hlo' : Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ := hlo
        have hhi' : ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) := hhi
        rw [hΨ_eq] at hlo' hhi'
        exact ⟨hp1, hp2, hlo', hhi'⟩
    rw [hE_eq]
    exact ((isClosed_Icc.prod isClosed_Icc).inter
      ((isClosed_le continuous_const h_norm_cont).inter
        (isClosed_le h_norm_cont continuous_const))).measurableSet
  let B_box : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2
  have hB_meas : MeasurableSet B_box := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hB_fin : MeasureTheory.volume B_box ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_prod,
      Real.volume_Icc, Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hB_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (B_box.indicator (fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ)))
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hB_meas).mpr
      (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hB_fin)
  let χ : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun n => (E n).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hχ_int : ∀ n : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (χ n) (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    intro n
    rw [← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    refine hB_int.mono' ((measurable_const.indicator (hE_meas n)).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_)
    by_cases hp : p ∈ E n
    · have hpB : p ∈ B_box := ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩
      simp [χ, hp, hpB]
    · by_cases hpB : p ∈ B_box <;> simp [χ, hp, hpB]
  let g_slice : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n D => ∫ u : ℝ, χ n (u, D) ∂MeasureTheory.volume
  have h_vol_eq : ∀ n : ℕ,
      MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n) = ∫ D : ℝ, g_slice n D ∂MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro n
    calc MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n)
        = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, χ n p ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (hE_meas n)).symm
      _ = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, χ n p ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      _ = ∫ D : ℝ, g_slice n D ∂MeasureTheory.volume :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm (χ n) (hχ_int n)
  let S_row : ℕ → ℝ → Set ℝ := fun n D => (fun u : ℝ => (u, D)) ⁻¹' (E n)
  have hS_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D : ℝ, MeasurableSet (S_row n D) := fun n D =>
    (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).measurable (hE_meas n)
  have hg_eq_vol : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D : ℝ,
      g_slice n D = MeasureTheory.volume.real (S_row n D) := by
    intro n D
    have h_ind : (fun u : ℝ => χ n (u, D)) = (S_row n D).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
      ext u
      by_cases h : (u, D) ∈ E n <;> simp [χ, S_row, h]
    dsimp [g_slice]
    rw [h_ind]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (hS_meas n D)
  have hg_out : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D : ℝ, D ∉ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 → g_slice n D = 0 := by
    intro n D hD
    rw [hg_eq_vol]
    have hempty : S_row n D = ∅ := by
      ext u
      simp only [S_row, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro h
      exact hD h.2.1
    rw [hempty, MeasureTheory.measureReal_empty]
  let bound : ℝ → ℝ := (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2).indicator (fun _ => (2 : ℝ))
  have h_bound_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable bound MeasureTheory.volume := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Icc).mpr ?_
    refine MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const ?_
    rw [Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have h_dom : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ D : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ‖g_slice n D‖ ≤ bound D := by
    intro n
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun D => ?_)
    by_cases hD : D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2
    · rw [hg_eq_vol, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg]
      have hb : bound D = 2 := Set.indicator_of_mem hD _
      rw [hb]
      have h_sub : S_row n D ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := fun u hu => hu.1
      have h_fin : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ≠ ⊤ := by
        rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      calc MeasureTheory.volume.real (S_row n D)
          ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :=
            MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub h_fin
        _ = 1 - (-1) := Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by norm_num)
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    · rw [hg_out n D hD, norm_zero]
      have hb : bound D = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem hD _
      rw [hb]
  have h_ae_not_deg : ∀ᵐ D : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, D ∉ D_deg := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
    have h_eq : {D : ℝ | ¬ D ∉ D_deg} = D_deg := by ext D; simp
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Set.Finite.measure_zero hQ_deg_rows MeasureTheory.volume
  have h_ae_lim : ∀ᵐ D : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g_slice n D) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    refine h_ae_not_deg.mono (fun D hD_ndeg => ?_)
    by_cases hD : D ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2
    · have h_eq_fn : (fun n => g_slice n D) =
          (fun n => MeasureTheory.volume.real
            {u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 |
              Real.exp (-(K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
                ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                  (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
              ‖S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * ((u : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
                Real.exp ((K_seq n) ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}) := by
        ext n
        rw [hg_eq_vol]
        congr 1
        ext u
        exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, _, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨h1, h3, h4⟩, fun ⟨h1, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨h1, hD, h3, h4⟩⟩
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      exact h_row_ext D hD hD_ndeg
    · have h_zero : (fun n => g_slice n D) = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext n; exact hg_out n D hD
      rw [h_zero]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
  have h_tendsto_vol : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.volume.real (E n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h_int_lim :=
      MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence bound
        (fun n => (hχ_int n).integral_prod_right.aestronglyMeasurable)
        h_bound_int h_dom h_ae_lim
    simp only [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at h_int_lim
    exact Filter.Tendsto.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (h_vol_eq n).symm) h_int_lim
  have h_half := h_tendsto_vol.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  rw [mul_zero] at h_half
  exact h_half

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro S
    have hs_sub : horizStrip S.s_star ⊆ horizStrip S.H :=
      fun s hs => lt_trans hs S.s_star_lt_H
    refine
      { c_pos := S.c_pos
        s_star_pos := S.s_star_pos
        r_star_pos := S.r_star_pos
        r_star_lt_half_s_star := S.r_star_lt_half_s_star
        r_star_lt_pi := S.r_star_lt_pi
        D_strip_open := isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
        D_strip_convex := by
          intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
          change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < S.H
          change |z₁.im| < S.H at hz₁
          change |z₂.im| < S.H at hz₂
          have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
          rw [him]
          calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im|
              ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
            _ < a * S.H + b * S.H := by
                rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
                · simp only [zero_add] at hab
                  subst hab
                  linarith
                · nlinarith
            _ = (a + b) * S.H := by ring
            _ = S.H := by rw [hab, one_mul]
        base_strip_subset := hs_sub
        D_strip_add_real := by
          intro s hs x
          change |(s + (x : ℂ)).im| < S.H
          change |s.im| < S.H at hs
          simpa using hs
        D_strip_conj := by
          intro s hs
          change |((starRingEnd ℂ) s).im| < S.H
          change |s.im| < S.H at hs
          simpa using hs
        D_strip_vert_balanced := by
          intro s hs y hy
          change |((s.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
          change |s.im| < S.H at hs
          have him : ((s.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y := by simp
          rw [him]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt hy hs

      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →

  ((∀ (M Δ : ℝ) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Δ →
      ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →

def RefSteepContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_steep : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    ∃ (C_st η_st : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_st ∧ 0 < η_st ∧ η_st < 1 / 16 ∧
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
        (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
        4 * d ≤ δ_ceil - Δ_slab → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
        12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α ≤ Δ_slab / 16 →
        r / d ≤ η_st →
        r * d ^ (-α) * M_scale ≤ η_st →
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
        (let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
         let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ h_ref - s.im → h_ref - s.im ≤ (5 / 4) * δ_ceil →
           |s.re - x₀| ≤ L_in * (h_ref - s.im) →
           s ∈ X.D_strip ∧
           ‖X.f s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α) ∧
           Real.sqrt ‖X.q s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α)) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init →
           s_init (y, -t) = s_init (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ S_init → s_init (y, 0) = y) →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, t ≠ 0 →
           (y - t, t) ∈ S_init → (y, t) ∈ S_init → (y + t, t) ∈ S_init →
           let s_prev := s_init (y - t, t)
           let s_curr := s_init (y, t)
           let s_next := s_init (y + t, t)
           let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
           let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
         ∃ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep ∧
           (∀ p ∈ W_steep, s_steep p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             δ_ceil - (3 / 4) * Δ_slab < h_ref - y.im →
             s_steep (y, t) = s_init (y, t)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
             (y - t, t) ∈ W_steep → (y, t) ∈ W_steep → (y + t, t) ∈ W_steep →
             let s_prev := s_steep (y - t, t)
             let s_curr := s_steep (y, t)
             let s_next := s_steep (y + t, t)
             let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
             let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
               t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
               deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev))

def SchwarzPoissonBumpProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (M_dip η_plus γ₀ : ℝ),
    0 < M_dip → 0 < η_plus → 0 < γ₀ → γ₀ < 1 / 8 →
    ∃ (C_bump C_err γ_steep : ℝ),
      0 < C_bump ∧ 0 < C_err ∧ 0 < γ_steep ∧ γ_steep < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), ‖c‖ < 1 / 3 → 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
        ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r)) ∧
          g 0 = 0 ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
            ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump ∧ -M_dip ≤ (g ζ).im ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1,
            |(c + ζ).im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_steep * ‖c + ζ‖ →
            0 ≤ M_dip + (g ζ).im ∧ M_dip + (g ζ).im ≤ C_err * (1 - r))

def RefDyadicConeFillingProp : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 →
    ∃ (D_dip C_bump M_ceil γ_dyad : ℝ),
      2 ≤ D_dip ∧ 0 < C_bump ∧ 8 < M_ceil ∧ 0 < γ_dyad ∧ γ_dyad < 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip → Convex ℝ X.D_strip →
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m₀ d δ₀ r M_scale C_st A₀ : ℝ)
        (s_band₀ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m₀ → 0 < d → d < δ₀ → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 < C_st → 0 ≤ A₀ →
        (let m_aux : ℝ := max m₀ ((C_bump + 4) / (D_dip - 1))
         let m_steep : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + C_bump + 2)
         let A_ind : ℝ := max A₀ (2 ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st)
         let Ω_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ₀ < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_aux * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_dyad * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         let Ω_out : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_band₀ Ω_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_init →
           s_band₀ (y, -t) = s_band₀ (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_band₀ (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             A₀ * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →

def DeepPassageAnchorData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D_anc C_anc α : ℝ),
      0 < D_anc ∧ 0 < C_anc ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      ∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D_anc + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
              D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top → |y.re| < A * (-y.im) →
              s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
                s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
                C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

def RefSteepContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_steep : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    ∃ (C_st η_st : ℝ), 1 ≤ C_st ∧ 0 < η_st ∧ η_st < 1 / 16 ∧
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
        (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
        4 * d ≤ δ_ceil - Δ_slab → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
        12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α ≤ Δ_slab / 16 →
        r / d ≤ η_st →
        r * d ^ (-α) * M_scale ≤ η_st →
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
        (let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
         let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ h_ref - s.im → h_ref - s.im ≤ (5 / 4) * δ_ceil →
           |s.re - x₀| ≤ L_in * (h_ref - s.im) →
           s ∈ X.D_strip ∧
           ‖X.f s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α) ∧
           Real.sqrt ‖X.q s‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - s.im) ^ (-α)) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init →
           s_init (y, -t) = s_init (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ S_init → s_init (y, 0) = y) →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, t ≠ 0 →
           (y - t, t) ∈ S_init → (y, t) ∈ S_init → (y + t, t) ∈ S_init →
           let s_prev := s_init (y - t, t)
           let s_curr := s_init (y, t)
           let s_next := s_init (y + t, t)
           let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
           let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
         ∃ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep ∧
           (∀ p ∈ W_steep, s_steep p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
             δ_ceil - (3 / 4) * Δ_slab < h_ref - y.im →
             s_steep (y, t) = s_init (y, t)) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
             (y - t, t) ∈ W_steep → (y, t) ∈ W_steep → (y + t, t) ∈ W_steep →
             let s_prev := s_steep (y - t, t)
             let s_curr := s_steep (y, t)
             let s_next := s_steep (y + t, t)
             let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
             let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
               t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
               deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev))

def SchwarzPoissonBumpProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (M_dip η_plus γ₀ : ℝ),
    0 < M_dip → 0 < η_plus → 0 < γ₀ → γ₀ < 1 / 8 →
    ∃ (C_bump C_err γ_steep : ℝ),
      0 < C_bump ∧ 0 < C_err ∧ 0 < γ_steep ∧ γ_steep < γ₀ ∧
      ∀ (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), ‖c‖ < 1 / 3 → 1 / 2 ≤ r → r < 1 →
        ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r)) ∧
          g 0 = 0 ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
            ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump ∧ -M_dip ≤ (g ζ).im ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1,
            |(c + ζ).im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_steep * ‖c + ζ‖ →
            0 ≤ M_dip + (g ζ).im ∧ M_dip + (g ζ).im ≤ C_err * (1 - r))

def RefDyadicConeFillingProp : Prop :=
  ∀ α : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 →
    ∃ (D_dip C_bump M_ceil γ_dyad : ℝ),
      2 ≤ D_dip ∧ 0 < C_bump ∧ 8 < M_ceil ∧ 0 < γ_dyad ∧ γ_dyad < 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsOpen X.D_strip → Convex ℝ X.D_strip →
      ∀ (x₀ h_ref m₀ d δ₀ r M_scale C_st A₀ : ℝ)
        (s_band₀ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < m₀ → 0 < d → d < δ₀ → 0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 < C_st → 0 ≤ A₀ →
        (let m_aux : ℝ := max m₀ ((C_bump + 4) / (D_dip - 1))
         let m_steep : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + C_bump + 2)
         let A_ind : ℝ := max A₀ (2 ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st)
         let Ω_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             δ₀ < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_aux * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
             γ_dyad * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
         let Ω_out : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
           { p : ℂ × ℂ |
             d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ ∧
             |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
             ‖p.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α }
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_band₀ Ω_init →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_init →
           s_band₀ (y, -t) = s_band₀ (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_band₀ (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             A₀ * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_init → s_band₀ (y, 0) = y) →
         DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep W_steep →
         (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_steep →
           s_steep (y, -t) = s_steep (y, t) ∧
           ‖s_steep (y, t) - y‖ ≤
             C_st * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
         (∀ p ∈ Ω_init ∩ W_steep, s_band₀ p = s_steep p) →
         (∀ y : ℂ, d < h_ref - y.im → h_ref - y.im < 2 * δ₀ →
           |y.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - y.im) →
           Metric.ball y
             (2 * A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im)) ⊆
             X.D_strip) →
         ∃ s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
           DifferentiableOn ℂ s_cone Ω_out ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out, s_cone p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
           (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_out →
             s_cone (y, -t) = s_cone (y, t) ∧
             ‖s_cone (y, t) - y‖ ≤
               A_ind * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
           (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_out → s_cone (y, 0) = y) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out ∩ Ω_init, s_cone p = s_band₀ p) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_out ∩ W_steep, s_cone p = s_steep p))

def DeepPassageAnchorData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D_anc C_anc α : ℝ),
      0 < D_anc ∧ 0 < C_anc ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      ∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D_anc + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
              D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top → |y.re| < A * (-y.im) →
              s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
                s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
                C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

by

  have hSlit : LocalSlitChartProp kind D.R D.Δ_ball := by
    cases kind with
    | firstField =>
      obtain ⟨hvc, hbridge⟩ := I.real_bridge
      let M_real : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => (I.M (r : ℂ)).re

      · intro r hr

      · intro r hr
        exact (hbridge r hr).1
      · intro r hr
        have hr_vc : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c := by simpa [hvc] using hr
        have hderiv := (D.w_real_props r hr_vc).2.2.1
        have hP_rel := (hbridge r hr).2

      · intro r hr
        have hr_vc : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c := by simpa [hvc] using hr

      · simpa [hvc] using D.w_real_tendsto
    | secondField =>

      let M_real : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => (I.M (r : ℂ)).re

      · intro r hr

      · intro r hr

      · intro r hr
        have hr_vc : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c := by simpa [hvc] using hr

      · simpa [hvc] using D.w_real_tendsto
  obtain ⟨r_patch, ε_ov, Δ_slit_in, Δ_slit_out,
    hr_pos, hr_lt_R, hε_pos, hε_lt_r,
    h_in_holo, h_out_holo, h_real_eq, h_in_reg, h_out_reg, h_plus_eq, h_minus_ne⟩ := hSlit
  let D_ov : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R ∩ Metric.ball (D.R : ℂ) r_patch
  have hD_ov_open : IsOpen D_ov := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hD_ov_preconn : IsPreconnected D_ov :=
    ((convex_ball (0 : ℂ) D.R).inter (convex_ball (D.R : ℂ) r_patch)).isPreconnected
  have hD_ov_sub_slit : D_ov ⊆ slitInDomain D.R r_patch := by
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨hw.2, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl ?_)⟩
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ < D.R := by simpa using hw.1
    have hw_re : w.re ≤ ‖w‖ := Complex.re_le_norm w
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
    linarith
  have h_ana_in : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Δ_slit_in D_ov :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hD_ov_open).mpr (h_in_holo.mono hD_ov_sub_slit)
  have h_ana_ball : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ D.Δ_ball D_ov :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hD_ov_open).mpr
      (D.Δ_ball_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
  let x₀ : ℝ := D.R - ε_ov / 2
  have hx₀_pos : 0 < x₀ := by dsimp [x₀]; linarith
  have hx₀_lt_R : x₀ < D.R := by dsimp [x₀]; linarith
  have hx₀_mem : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ D_ov := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos hx₀_pos]
      exact hx₀_lt_R
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hsub : x₀ - D.R = -(ε_ov / 2) := by dsimp [x₀]; ring
      rw [hsub, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      linarith
  let seq_r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => x₀ + (ε_ov / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
  let seq_c : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (seq_r n : ℂ)
  have h_seq_tendsto_r : Filter.Tendsto seq_r Filter.atTop (nhds x₀) := by
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (ε_ov / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
        (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
    simpa [seq_r] using tendsto_const_nhds.add h0
  have h_seq_tendsto_c : Filter.Tendsto seq_c Filter.atTop (nhds (x₀ : ℂ)) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto x₀).comp h_seq_tendsto_r
  have h_seq_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, seq_c n ≠ (x₀ : ℂ) := by
    intro n h_eq
    have h_re : seq_r n = x₀ := Complex.ofReal_injective h_eq
    have h_pos_step : 0 < (ε_ov / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    dsimp [seq_r] at h_re
    linarith
  have h_seq_nhdsWithin :
      Filter.Tendsto seq_c Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (x₀ : ℂ) {(x₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨h_seq_tendsto_c, Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_seq_ne⟩
  have h_seq_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, Δ_slit_in (seq_c n) = D.Δ_ball (seq_c n) := by
    intro n
    apply h_real_eq (seq_r n)
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hstep_pos : 0 < (ε_ov / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have hstep_le : (ε_ov / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ ε_ov / 4 :=
      div_le_self (by positivity) hn1
    dsimp [seq_r, x₀]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (x₀ : ℂ) {(x₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ, Δ_slit_in z = D.Δ_ball z :=
    h_seq_nhdsWithin.frequently (Filter.Frequently.of_forall h_seq_eq)
  have h_ev_x₀ : Δ_slit_in =ᶠ[nhds (x₀ : ℂ)] D.Δ_ball :=
    ((h_ana_in (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_mem).frequently_eq_iff_eventually_eq
      (h_ana_ball (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_mem)).mp h_freq
  have h_eq_ov : Set.EqOn Δ_slit_in D.Δ_ball D_ov :=
    h_ana_in.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h_ana_ball hD_ov_preconn hx₀_mem h_ev_x₀
  have h_slitIn_open : IsOpen (slitInDomain D.R r_patch) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
      (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
  let Δ_inner : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => if w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R then D.Δ_ball w else Δ_slit_in w
  let Δ_outer : ℂ → ℂ := Δ_slit_out
  have h_eq_ball : Set.EqOn Δ_inner D.Δ_ball (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R) := by
    intro w hw
    simp only [Δ_inner, hw, ↓reduceIte]
  have h_eq_slit : Set.EqOn Δ_inner Δ_slit_in (slitInDomain D.R r_patch) := by
    intro w hw
    by_cases hw_b : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R
    · have hw_ov : w ∈ D_ov := ⟨hw_b, hw.1⟩
      simp only [Δ_inner, hw_b, ↓reduceIte]
      exact (h_eq_ov hw_ov).symm
    · simp only [Δ_inner, hw_b, ↓reduceIte]
  have h_germ_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R,
      Δ_inner =ᶠ[nhds w] D.Δ_ball ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ Δ_inner w ∧
        deriv Δ_inner w = deriv D.Δ_ball w := by
    intro w hw
    have hev : Δ_inner =ᶠ[nhds w] D.Δ_ball :=
      h_eq_ball.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ Δ_inner w :=
      hev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr
        (D.Δ_ball_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw))
    exact ⟨hev, hdiff, hev.deriv_eq⟩
  have h_germ_slit : ∀ w ∈ slitInDomain D.R r_patch,
      Δ_inner =ᶠ[nhds w] Δ_slit_in ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ Δ_inner w ∧
        deriv Δ_inner w = deriv Δ_slit_in w := by
    intro w hw
    have hev : Δ_inner =ᶠ[nhds w] Δ_slit_in :=
      h_eq_slit.eventuallyEq_of_mem (h_slitIn_open.mem_nhds hw)
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ Δ_inner w :=
      hev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr
        (h_in_holo.differentiableAt (h_slitIn_open.mem_nhds hw))
    exact ⟨hev, hdiff, hev.deriv_eq⟩
  let θ : ℝ := min (Real.pi / 8) (r_patch / (8 * D.R))
  let δ_θ : ℝ := θ / 4
  let ν : ℝ := min (1 / 2) ((1 / 4) * Real.log (1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R)))
  have hR_pos : 0 < D.R := D.R_pos
  have hθ_pos : 0 < θ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hθ_le_pi8 : θ ≤ Real.pi / 8 := min_le_left _ _
  have hθ_le_r : θ ≤ r_patch / (8 * D.R) := min_le_right _ _
  have hθ_lt_pi4 : θ < Real.pi / 4 := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_θ := by dsimp [δ_θ]; positivity
  have hδ_lt : δ_θ < θ / 2 := by dsimp [δ_θ]; linarith
  have hlog_arg_gt_one : 1 < 1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R) := by
    have : 0 < r_patch / (2 * D.R) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hlog_pos : 0 < Real.log (1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R)) := Real.log_pos hlog_arg_gt_one
  have hν_pos : 0 < ν := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hν_lt_one : ν < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  have h4ν_le_log : 4 * ν ≤ Real.log (1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R)) := by
    have : ν ≤ (1 / 4) * Real.log (1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R)) := min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  have hexp_4ν_le : Real.exp (4 * ν) ≤ 1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R) := by
    calc Real.exp (4 * ν)
        ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R))) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h4ν_le_log
      _ = 1 + r_patch / (2 * D.R) := Real.exp_log (by linarith)
  have hR_exp_4ν : D.R * (Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1) ≤ r_patch / 2 := by
    have hsub : Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1 ≤ r_patch / (2 * D.R) := by linarith
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub hR_pos.le
    have hcancel : D.R * (r_patch / (2 * D.R)) = r_patch / 2 := by
      field_simp [hR_pos.ne']
    rwa [hcancel] at hmul
  have h4θ_R_le : D.R * (4 * θ) ≤ r_patch / 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hθ_le_r (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * D.R)
    have hcancel : 4 * D.R * (r_patch / (8 * D.R)) = r_patch / 2 := by
      field_simp [hR_pos.ne']
      ring
    linarith
  have h_chord : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1‖ ≤ 2 * |φ| := by
    intro φ
    have hexp_eq :
        Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1 =
          ((Real.cos φ - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.sin φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hcos_id : Real.cos φ - 1 = -(2 * Real.sin (φ / 2) ^ 2) := by
      have h1 : Real.cos (2 * (φ / 2)) = Real.cos (φ / 2) ^ 2 - Real.sin (φ / 2) ^ 2 :=
        Real.cos_two_mul' (φ / 2)
      have h2 : Real.cos (φ / 2) ^ 2 + Real.sin (φ / 2) ^ 2 = 1 :=
        Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (φ / 2)
      have h2φ : 2 * (φ / 2) = φ := by ring
      rw [h2φ] at h1
      linarith
    have hcos_abs : |Real.cos φ - 1| ≤ |φ| := by
      rw [hcos_id, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have hs1 : |Real.sin (φ / 2)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one (φ / 2)
      have hs2 : |Real.sin (φ / 2)| ≤ |φ / 2| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
      have hsq : Real.sin (φ / 2) ^ 2 ≤ |φ / 2| := by
        calc Real.sin (φ / 2) ^ 2
            = |Real.sin (φ / 2)| * |Real.sin (φ / 2)| := by rw [← sq_abs]; ring
          _ ≤ 1 * |φ / 2| :=
              mul_le_mul hs1 hs2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = |φ / 2| := one_mul _
      have habs_div : |φ / 2| = |φ| / 2 := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith
    have hsin_abs : |Real.sin φ| ≤ |φ| := Real.abs_sin_le_abs
    rw [hexp_eq]
    calc ‖((Real.cos φ - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.sin φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖
        ≤ ‖((Real.cos φ - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖((Real.sin φ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |Real.cos φ - 1| + |Real.sin φ| := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ 2 * |φ| := by linarith
  have h_polar_ball : ∀ (ρ φ : ℝ),
      D.R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ρ → ρ < D.R * Real.exp (2 * ν) → |φ| < 2 * θ →
      ((ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ Metric.ball (D.R : ℂ) r_patch := by
    intro ρ φ hρ_lo hρ_hi hφ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq]
    have hdecomp :
        (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (D.R : ℂ) =
          ((ρ - D.R : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
            (D.R : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hrad_abs : |ρ - D.R| < r_patch / 2 := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      have hexp_2ν_lt : Real.exp (2 * ν) < Real.exp (4 * ν) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have hexp_4ν_gt_one : 1 < Real.exp (4 * ν) :=
        Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      have hexp_neg_lt_one : Real.exp (-4 * ν) < 1 :=
        Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      have h_upper : ρ - D.R < r_patch / 2 := by
        have : ρ < D.R * Real.exp (4 * ν) :=
          lt_trans hρ_hi (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp_2ν_lt hR_pos)
        linarith
      have h_lower : -(r_patch / 2) < ρ - D.R := by
        have h1 : 1 - Real.exp (-4 * ν) = Real.exp (-4 * ν) * (Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1) := by
          rw [mul_sub, ← Real.exp_add]
          norm_num
        have h2 : D.R * (1 - Real.exp (-4 * ν)) < D.R * (Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1) := by
          rw [h1]
          have : Real.exp (-4 * ν) * (Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1) < 1 * (Real.exp (4 * ν) - 1) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hexp_neg_lt_one (by linarith)
          nlinarith
        linarith
      exact ⟨h_lower, h_upper⟩
    have hang_bound :
        ‖(D.R : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖ < r_patch / 2 := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos]
      have h1 : D.R * ‖Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1‖ ≤ D.R * (2 * |φ|) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_chord φ) hR_pos.le
      have h2 : D.R * (2 * |φ|) < D.R * (4 * θ) := by nlinarith
      linarith
    rw [hdecomp]
    calc ‖((ρ - D.R : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
            (D.R : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖
        ≤ ‖((ρ - D.R : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
            ‖(D.R : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |ρ - D.R| + ‖(D.R : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((φ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 1)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ < r_patch / 2 + r_patch / 2 := add_lt_add hrad_abs hang_bound
      _ = r_patch := by ring
  have h_plus_sub : ∀ w ∈ branchSectorPlus D.R ν θ δ_θ,
      w ∈ slitInDomain D.R r_patch ∧ 0 < w.im := by
    intro w ⟨_, hw_lo, hw_hi, hw_arg⟩
    have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) hw_lo
    have h2δ : 2 * δ_θ = θ / 2 := by dsimp [δ_θ]; ring
    rw [h2δ, abs_lt] at hw_arg
    have harg_pos : 0 < w.arg := by linarith
    have harg_lt_pi : w.arg < Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have harg_abs : |w.arg| < 2 * θ := by
      rw [abs_of_pos harg_pos]
      linarith
    have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball (D.R : ℂ) r_patch := by
      have hpolar := h_polar_ball ‖w‖ w.arg hw_lo hw_hi harg_abs
      rwa [Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I] at hpolar
    have him_pos : 0 < w.im := by
      rw [← Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg]
      exact mul_pos hw_pos (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi harg_pos harg_lt_pi)
    refine ⟨⟨hw_ball, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr ?_)⟩, him_pos⟩
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_sub, neg_ne_zero]
    exact him_pos.ne'
  have h_minus_sub : branchSectorMinus D.R ν θ δ_θ ⊆ slitInDomain D.R r_patch := by
    intro w ⟨_, hw_lo, hw_hi, hw_arg⟩
    have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) hw_lo
    have h2δ : 2 * δ_θ = θ / 2 := by dsimp [δ_θ]; ring
    rw [h2δ, abs_lt] at hw_arg
    have harg_neg : w.arg < 0 := by linarith
    have hneg_arg_pos : 0 < -w.arg := by linarith
    have hneg_arg_lt_pi : -w.arg < Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have harg_abs : |w.arg| < 2 * θ := by
      rw [abs_of_neg harg_neg]
      linarith
    have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball (D.R : ℂ) r_patch := by
      have hpolar := h_polar_ball ‖w‖ w.arg hw_lo hw_hi harg_abs
      rwa [Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I] at hpolar
    have him_neg : w.im < 0 := by
      rw [← Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg]
      have hsin_neg : Real.sin w.arg < 0 := by
        have := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hneg_arg_pos hneg_arg_lt_pi
        rwa [Real.sin_neg, Left.neg_pos_iff] at this

      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
      linarith

      simpa [Complex.sub_im] using him

    θ := θ
    δ_θ := δ_θ
    r_uniq := D.r_uniq
    Δ_inner := Δ_inner
    Δ_outer := Δ_outer
    R_pos := D.R_pos
    ν_pos := hν_pos
    ν_lt_one := hν_lt_one
    θ_pos := hθ_pos
    θ_lt := hθ_lt_pi4
    δ_θ_pos := hδ_pos
    δ_θ_lt := hδ_lt

    r_uniq_lt := D.r_uniq_lt

    Δ_inner_even_ball := ?_

  · intro w hw

    have h_eq := D.local_uniqueness w_coeff D₁ S_loc hD₁ hS_holo hS_decay hw_bound hS_energy Y hY
    have hwY_mem : w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) D.R := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans (hw_bound Y hY) D.r_uniq_lt
    rwa [← h_eq_ball hwY_mem] at h_eq

      rw [h_eq_ball hw_b, (h_germ_ball w hw_b).2.2]

      dsimp only

      exact h_in_reg w hw_s

      dsimp only

      exact h_in_reg w hw_s
  · intro w hw

    have hw_out_s := h_outer_sub hw_out
    obtain ⟨hw_in_s, him_pos⟩ := h_plus_sub w hw_plus

      push_cast
      ring

      rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hθ_pos]
      linarith

      rw [hw_polar]
      exact h_polar_ball (D.R * Real.exp u) (-θ) hρ_lo hρ_hi hφ_abs
    have him_neg : w_minus.im < 0 := by
      rw [hw_polar, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero,
        Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, Real.sin_neg]
      have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin θ :=
        Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
      have hrad_pos : 0 < D.R * Real.exp u := by positivity
      nlinarith

      refine ⟨hw_ball, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr ?_)⟩
      simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_sub, neg_ne_zero]
      exact him_neg.ne
    have hw_out_s : w_minus ∈ slitOutDomain D.R r_patch := by
      refine ⟨hw_ball, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inr ?_)⟩
      simpa [Complex.sub_im] using him_neg.ne
    have h_ne := h_minus_ne w_minus ⟨hw_in_s, hw_out_s⟩ him_neg
    have h_eq' : Δ_slit_out w_minus = Δ_slit_in w_minus := by
      calc Δ_slit_out w_minus = Δ_outer w_minus := rfl
        _ = Δ_inner w_minus := h_eq_minus
        _ = Δ_slit_in w_minus := h_eq_slit hw_in_s
    exact h_ne h_eq'

exponential_model_branch_monodromy.definitions:
noncomputable def firstFieldSinc (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def firstFieldG (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, 6 * (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m) /
    ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def secondFieldSinhc (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def secondFieldGNum (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, 6 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)

structure FrozenCalculusProp : Prop where
  sinc_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldSinc
  gF_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldG
  sinhc_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldSinhc
  gQ_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldGNum
  sinc_zero : firstFieldSinc 0 = 1
  gF_zero : firstFieldG 0 = 1
  sinhc_zero : secondFieldSinhc 0 = 1
  gQ_zero : secondFieldGNum 0 = 1
  sinc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * firstFieldSinc z = Complex.sin z
  gF_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 3 * firstFieldG z = 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z)
  sinhc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * secondFieldSinhc z = Complex.sinh z
  gQ_mul : ∀ z : ℂ,
    2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z = 3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z)
  energy_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
    frozenEnergyE .firstField lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * firstFieldG (lam * J / 2)
  twist_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
    deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J =
      (J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2)
  energy_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
    frozenEnergyE .secondField lam J =
      (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 2)) * secondFieldGNum (lam * J / 2)
  twist_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
    deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J =
      (J * secondFieldSinhc (lam * J / 2)) / (4 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 3)
  local_J_inj : ∃ δ_E : ℝ, 0 < δ_E ∧
    ∀ (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J₁ J₂ : ℂ),
      ‖lam‖ < δ_E → ‖J₁ - 1‖ < δ_E → ‖J₂ - 1‖ < δ_E →
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J₁ = frozenEnergyE kind lam J₂ → J₁ = J₂

structure ModelDiskInput (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  v_c : ℝ
  P : ℂ → ℂ
  M : ℂ → ℂ
  p_even : ℕ → ℝ
  v_c_pos : 0 < v_c
  p_zero : p_even 0 = 1
  p_one_pos : 0 < p_even 1
  p_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ p_even m
  P_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c)
  P_ne_zero : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c, P v ≠ 0
  P_hasSum : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c,
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (p_even m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (P v)
  M_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ M (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c)
  M_zero : M 0 = 0
  M_even : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c, M (-v) = M v
  M_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < v_c → (M (r : ℂ)).im = 0
  disk_energy_reg : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) v_c,
    let lam := 2 * v * Complex.exp (M v)
    let J := P v * (1 + v * deriv M v)
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  real_bridge :
    match kind with
    | .firstField =>
        v_c = Real.pi ∧
        ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi,
          ((Real.exp ((M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 = firstFieldG (r : ℂ) ∧
          (Real.sin r / r) * (P (r : ℂ)).re = Real.exp (2 * (M (r : ℂ)).re)
    | .secondField =>
        v_c = 1 ∧
        (∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (P (r : ℂ)).re = Real.exp (2 * (M (r : ℂ)).re)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z →
          (((2 * Real.tanh z * Real.exp ((M (Real.tanh z : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 3 =
            12 * ((Real.tanh z : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) / (Complex.cosh (z : ℂ)) ^ 2))

structure InnerDiskModelPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  R : ℝ
  r_uniq : ℝ
  Δ_ball : ℂ → ℂ
  w_real : ℝ → ℝ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  r_uniq_pos : 0 < r_uniq
  r_uniq_lt : r_uniq < R
  Δ_ball_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_ball (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)
  Δ_ball_zero : Δ_ball 0 = 0
  Δ_ball_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, Δ_ball (-w) = Δ_ball w
  ball_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_ball w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_ball (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  w_real_cont : ContinuousOn w_real (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto w_real (nhdsWithin I.v_c (Set.Iio I.v_c)) (nhds R)
  w_real_props : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    0 < w_real r ∧ w_real r < R ∧
    HasDerivAt w_real (w_real r / (r * (I.P (r : ℂ)).re)) r ∧
    Δ_ball (w_real r : ℂ) =
      Complex.I * Complex.log (((2 * r * Real.exp ((I.M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (w_real r : ℂ))

def slitInDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ (R : ℂ) - w ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def slitOutDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ w - (R : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def LocalSlitChartProp (kind : ExpProfileKind) (R : ℝ) (Δ_ball : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r_patch ε_ov : ℝ) (Δ_slit_in Δ_slit_out : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < r_patch ∧ r_patch < R ∧ 0 < ε_ov ∧ ε_ov < r_patch ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_in (slitInDomain R r_patch) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_out (slitOutDomain R r_patch) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (R - ε_ov) R, Δ_slit_in (x : ℂ) = Δ_ball (x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_in w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_in w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_out w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_out w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      0 < w.im → Δ_slit_out w = Δ_slit_in w) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      w.im < 0 → Δ_slit_out w ≠ Δ_slit_in w)

  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_ball (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  w_real_cont : ContinuousOn w_real (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto w_real (nhdsWithin I.v_c (Set.Iio I.v_c)) (nhds R)
  w_real_props : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    0 < w_real r ∧ w_real r < R ∧
    HasDerivAt w_real (w_real r / (r * (I.P (r : ℂ)).re)) r ∧
    Δ_ball (w_real r : ℂ) =
      Complex.I * Complex.log (((2 * r * Real.exp ((I.M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (w_real r : ℂ))

def slitInDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ (R : ℂ) - w ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def slitOutDomain (R r_patch : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | w ∈ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch ∧ w - (R : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane }

def LocalSlitChartProp (kind : ExpProfileKind) (R : ℝ) (Δ_ball : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r_patch ε_ov : ℝ) (Δ_slit_in Δ_slit_out : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < r_patch ∧ r_patch < R ∧ 0 < ε_ov ∧ ε_ov < r_patch ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_in (slitInDomain R r_patch) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_slit_out (slitOutDomain R r_patch) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (R - ε_ov) R, Δ_slit_in (x : ℂ) = Δ_ball (x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_in w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_in w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_slit_out w)
      let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_slit_out w
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      0 < w.im → Δ_slit_out w = Δ_slit_in w) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      w.im < 0 → Δ_slit_out w ≠ Δ_slit_in w)
