corridor_tracking_and_bypass_contradicti.definitions:
def IsDownwardVertConvex (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧
  ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U → 0 ≤ y.im →
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
      ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U

noncomputable def expBasePt {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def rescaledLift {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (s_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (s_fn (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) -
    expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)

def SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
  let s_prev : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y - a_n)
  let s_curr : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn Y
  let s_next : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y + a_n)
  let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
  let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
  deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
    t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev

def IsRegularFrozenModel {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V_mod ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V_mod ∧
  ∀ p ∈ V_mod,
    let lam : ℂ := p.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star p)
    let J : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J

noncomputable def circleAvgCont (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))

structure DiskContinuationToolkitProp : Prop where
  vertical_tube_uniqueness :
    ∀ (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ t₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ),
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₁ →
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₂ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
      (y₀, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
      0 ≤ y₀.im →
      0 < δ₀ →
      (∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f₁ (y, t₀) = f₂ (y, t₀)) →
      f₁ (y₀, t₀) = f₂ (y₀, t₀)
  binomial_dip_poly :
    ∀ (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ C_dip η_plus : ℝ),
      0 < C_dip → 0 < η_plus →
      ∃ (δ_ϕ : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_ϕ ∧
        Differentiable ℂ g ∧
        g 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ 8 * C_dip ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
        (∀ ϕ : ℝ,
          (∃ k : ℤ, |ϕ - ϕ₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
                    |ϕ - ϕ₂ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ) →
          (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤ -C_dip)
  circle_average_disk_continuation :
    ∀ (W U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      IsOpen U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (W ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, Φ (p, 0) = p) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, ∀ ϕ : ℝ, Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (circleAvgCont f₀ Φ) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀) →
        circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p = f₀ p) ∧
      (∀ (U_star : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U_star →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f_star U_star →
        ∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U_star) →
          ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
            (∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
              ‖f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
                f_star (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ B) →
            ‖circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p - f_star p‖ ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsExpObstructionStrip X →
        (∀ q ∈ U₀, f₀ q ∈ X.D_strip) →
        ∀ p ∈ W, circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p ∈ X.D_strip)
  partial_derivs_holo_3d :
    ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1) U

structure RegularCorridorTrackingProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  horizontal_chain_tracking :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (T₀ Y_plus : ℂ)
      (ε_plus L_max : ℝ) (S_init : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (N_base : ℕ) (N_step : ℕ → ℕ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      T₀ ≠ 0 → 0 < ε_plus → 0 < L_max →
      Metric.closedBall Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) ×ˢ ({T₀} : Set ℂ) ⊆ V_mod →
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_plus ε_plus, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L_max,
        (Z + (τ : ℂ) * T₀, T₀) ∈ V_mod) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_init n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus))) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus),
        Z - T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        Z + T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n Z T₀) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_init (fun Z => S_star (Z, T₀))
        Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_plus)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max) →
      ∃ (N_tr : ℕ) (S_chain : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        N_base ≤ N_tr ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_chain n j) (Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          S_chain n 0 Z = S_init n Z ∧ S_chain n 1 Z = S_init n (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j < N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          Z + a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus →
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_chain n j (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ ≥ N_tr, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
            let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            ‖S_chain n j Z - S_star (Z + (j : ℂ) * a_n, T₀)‖ < ε)
  steep_vertical_passage :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (σ η T_max : ℝ) (U_T : Set ℂ) (x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top : ℝ)
      (K_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < η → 0 < T_max →
      IsOpen U_T →
      U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
      x_lo < x_hi → y_bot < y_top →
      (let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T }
       let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
       let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
       B_init ⊆ V_mod →
       IsCompact K_steep →
       K_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
         x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
         y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } →
       (∀ p ∈ K_steep, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
         let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
         let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
           (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
         x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
         (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi) →
       ∃ W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
         IsOpen W_steep ∧
         K_steep ⊆ W_steep ∧
         W_steep ⊆ V_mod ∧
         W_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
           y_bot + δ_y / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, (Y, T) ∈ W_steep →
           ∀ τ : ℝ, y_bot + δ_y ≤ τ → τ ≤ Y.im →
             ((Y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, T) ∈ W_steep) ∧
         ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_low : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_low n) B_init) →
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
             (Y, T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
           (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B_init →
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_low S_star Filter.atTop K) →
           ∃ (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
             N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
               expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
               S_ext n p = S_low n p) ∧
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_ext S_star Filter.atTop K_steep)

structure RadialBypassPatchesData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) where
  ν' : ℝ
  ε_patch : ℝ
  N_patch : ℕ
  U_plus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  U_minus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  s_plus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  s_minus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  δ_zero : ℕ → ℝ
  ν'_pos : 0 < ν'
  ν'_lt : ν' < M.ν
  ε_patch_pos : 0 < ε_patch
  ε_patch_lt_ν : ε_patch < ν' / 12
  ε_patch_lt_δ : ε_patch < M.δ_θ / 12
  patch_props : ∀ n ≥ N_patch,
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let t₀_n : ℝ := T_star / seq.m_seq n
    let x₀_plus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c - M.θ)
    let x₀_minus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c + M.θ)
    let b_plus_n : ℝ := seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4)
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_plus n) ∧
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_minus n) ∧
    0 < δ_zero n ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_plus n) (U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_plus n, s_plus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_minus n) (U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_minus n, s_minus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_plus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_plus n ∧ s_plus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_minus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_minus n ∧ s_minus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b_plus_n →
      ((x₀_plus_n : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_minus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_patch),
      Z - (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq
        (fun W => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n W (T_star : ℂ)) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
  conv_plus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_patch))
  conv_minus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_minus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_minus (2 * ε_patch))

and_nodes.definitions_block:
def IsDownwardVertConvex (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧
  ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U → 0 ≤ y.im →
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
      ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U

noncomputable def expBasePt {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def rescaledLift {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (s_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (s_fn (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) -
    expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)

def SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
  let s_prev : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y - a_n)
  let s_curr : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn Y
  let s_next : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_fn (Y + a_n)
  let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
  let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
  deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
    t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev

def IsRegularFrozenModel {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V_mod ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V_mod ∧
  ∀ p ∈ V_mod,
    let lam : ℂ := p.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star p)
    let J : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J

noncomputable def circleAvgCont (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))

structure DiskContinuationToolkitProp : Prop where
  vertical_tube_uniqueness :
    ∀ (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ t₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ),
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₁ →
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₂ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
      (y₀, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
      0 ≤ y₀.im →
      0 < δ₀ →
      (∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f₁ (y, t₀) = f₂ (y, t₀)) →
      f₁ (y₀, t₀) = f₂ (y₀, t₀)
  binomial_dip_poly :
    ∀ (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ C_dip η_plus : ℝ),
      0 < C_dip → 0 < η_plus →
      ∃ (δ_ϕ : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_ϕ ∧
        Differentiable ℂ g ∧
        g 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ 8 * C_dip ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) ∧
        (∀ ϕ : ℝ,
          (∃ k : ℤ, |ϕ - ϕ₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
                    |ϕ - ϕ₂ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ) →
          (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤ -C_dip)
  circle_average_disk_continuation :
    ∀ (W U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      IsOpen U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (W ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, Φ (p, 0) = p) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, ∀ ϕ : ℝ, Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (circleAvgCont f₀ Φ) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀) →
        circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p = f₀ p) ∧
      (∀ (U_star : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U_star →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f_star U_star →
        ∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U_star) →
          ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
            (∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
              ‖f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
                f_star (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ B) →
            ‖circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p - f_star p‖ ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (X : ExpStripData), IsExpObstructionStrip X →
        (∀ q ∈ U₀, f₀ q ∈ X.D_strip) →
        ∀ p ∈ W, circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p ∈ X.D_strip)
  partial_derivs_holo_3d :
    ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1) U

structure RegularCorridorTrackingProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  horizontal_chain_tracking :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (T₀ Y_plus : ℂ)
      (ε_plus L_max : ℝ) (S_init : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (N_base : ℕ) (N_step : ℕ → ℕ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      T₀ ≠ 0 → 0 < ε_plus → 0 < L_max →
      Metric.closedBall Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) ×ˢ ({T₀} : Set ℂ) ⊆ V_mod →
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_plus ε_plus, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L_max,
        (Z + (τ : ℂ) * T₀, T₀) ∈ V_mod) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_init n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus))) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus),
        Z - T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        Z + T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n Z T₀) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_init (fun Z => S_star (Z, T₀))
        Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_plus)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max) →
      ∃ (N_tr : ℕ) (S_chain : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        N_base ≤ N_tr ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_chain n j) (Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          S_chain n 0 Z = S_init n Z ∧ S_chain n 1 Z = S_init n (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j < N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          Z + a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus →
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_chain n j (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ ≥ N_tr, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
            let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            ‖S_chain n j Z - S_star (Z + (j : ℂ) * a_n, T₀)‖ < ε)
  steep_vertical_passage :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (σ η T_max : ℝ) (U_T : Set ℂ) (x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top : ℝ)
      (K_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < η → 0 < T_max →
      IsOpen U_T →
      U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
      x_lo < x_hi → y_bot < y_top →
      (let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T }
       let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
       let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
       B_init ⊆ V_mod →
       IsCompact K_steep →
       K_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
         x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
         y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } →
       (∀ p ∈ K_steep, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
         let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
         let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
           (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
         x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
         (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi) →
       ∃ W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
         IsOpen W_steep ∧
         K_steep ⊆ W_steep ∧
         W_steep ⊆ V_mod ∧
         W_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
           y_bot + δ_y / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, (Y, T) ∈ W_steep →
           ∀ τ : ℝ, y_bot + δ_y ≤ τ → τ ≤ Y.im →
             ((Y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, T) ∈ W_steep) ∧
         ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_low : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_low n) B_init) →
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
             (Y, T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
           (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B_init →
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_low S_star Filter.atTop K) →
           ∃ (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
             N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
               expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
               S_ext n p = S_low n p) ∧
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_ext S_star Filter.atTop K_steep)

structure RadialBypassPatchesData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) where
  ν' : ℝ
  ε_patch : ℝ
  N_patch : ℕ
  U_plus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  U_minus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  s_plus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  s_minus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  δ_zero : ℕ → ℝ
  ν'_pos : 0 < ν'
  ν'_lt : ν' < M.ν
  ε_patch_pos : 0 < ε_patch
  ε_patch_lt_ν : ε_patch < ν' / 12
  ε_patch_lt_δ : ε_patch < M.δ_θ / 12
  patch_props : ∀ n ≥ N_patch,
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let t₀_n : ℝ := T_star / seq.m_seq n
    let x₀_plus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c - M.θ)
    let x₀_minus_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c + M.θ)
    let b_plus_n : ℝ := seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4)
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_plus n) ∧
    IsDownwardVertConvex (U_minus n) ∧
    0 < δ_zero n ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_plus n) (U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_plus n, s_plus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_minus n) (U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_minus n, s_minus n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_plus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_plus n ∧ s_plus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_minus_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_minus n ∧ s_minus n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b_plus_n →
      ((x₀_plus_n : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_plus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_minus (3 * ε_patch),
      (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ U_minus n) ∧
    (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_patch),
      Z - (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_patch) →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq
        (fun W => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n W (T_star : ℂ)) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
  conv_plus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_plus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_patch))
  conv_minus :
    let T_star : ℝ := (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹
    let α_c : ℝ := Complex.arg seq.c₀
    let Y_minus : ℂ :=
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z => rescaledLift seq (s_minus n) n Z (T_star : ℂ))
      (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_minus (2 * ε_patch))

      obtain ⟨hm1, hp1, hm2, hp2, htr⟩ := hD_shift_mem y t hy ht
      have h1 : y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) - t / 2 = (y - t / 2) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
      have h2 : y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) + t / 2 = (y + t / 2) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
      dsimp [M_ang, glancingMidAngle, glancingTheta]
      rw [h1, h2, C.U_quasiperiodic _ t hm2 htr, C.U_quasiperiodic _ t hp2 htr,
        C.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic _ (C.U_maps_to _ t hm1 htr),
        C.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic _ (C.U_maps_to _ t hp1 htr)]
      ring
    have hM_ang_int_quasi : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y t : ℂ), |y.im| < M.s_base → ‖t‖ < M.r_base →

      intro k y t hy ht
      have hsub := h_int_per (fun w => M_ang (w, t) - w) M.s_base
        (fun w hw => by rw [hM_ang_quasi w t hw ht]; ring) k y hy
      linear_combination hsub
    have hM_ang_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < M.s_base → ‖t‖ < M.r_base →
        M_ang (y, -t) = M_ang (y, t) := by
      intro y t hy ht
      obtain ⟨_, _, hm2, hp2, htr⟩ := hD_shift_mem y t hy ht
      have h1 : y - (-t) / 2 = y + t / 2 := by ring
      have h2 : y + (-t) / 2 = y - t / 2 := by ring
      dsimp [M_ang, glancingMidAngle, glancingTheta]
      rw [h1, h2, C.U_even _ t hp2 htr, C.U_even _ t hm2 htr]
      ring
    have hM_ang_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < M.s_base → ‖t‖ < M.r_base →
        M_ang (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (M_ang (y, t)) := by
      intro y t hy ht
      obtain ⟨hm1, hp1, hm2, hp2, htr⟩ := hD_shift_mem y t hy ht
      dsimp [M_ang, glancingMidAngle, glancingTheta]
      have hc1 : starRingEnd ℂ y - starRingEnd ℂ t / 2 = starRingEnd ℂ (y - t / 2) := by

      have hc2 : starRingEnd ℂ y + starRingEnd ℂ t / 2 = starRingEnd ℂ (y + t / 2) := by
        simp [map_ofNat]
      rw [hc1, hc2, C.U_conj _ t hm2 htr, C.U_conj _ t hp2 htr,
        C.ϕ_ℂ_conj _ (C.U_maps_to _ t hm1 htr),
        C.ϕ_ℂ_conj _ (C.U_maps_to _ t hp1 htr)]
      simp [map_ofNat]
    let K_col : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ × ℂ => ((q.1 : ℂ) + (q.2.1 : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2.2)) ''

      rintro p ⟨⟨u, v, t⟩, ⟨_, hv, ht⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im,

        have : |v| ≤ M.s_base / 2 := abs_le.mpr hv
        linarith [M.s_base_pos]
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at ht
        linarith [M.r_base_pos]
    have hM_im_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (M_ang p).im) K_col :=

    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_uc⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
      (hK_col_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hM_im_cont) η₀ hη₀_pos
    let s_init : ℝ := min s_inv (δ₂ / 2)
    have hs_init_pos : 0 < s_init := lt_min hs_inv_pos (half_pos hδ₂_pos)
    have hs_init_le_inv : s_init ≤ s_inv := min_le_left _ _
    have hs_init_le_base : s_init ≤ M.s_base / 2 := le_trans hs_init_le_inv hs_inv_le_half
    let r_init : ℝ := min (s_init / 8) (M.r_base / 2)
    have hr_init_pos : 0 < r_init := lt_min (by linarith) (half_pos M.r_base_pos)
    have hr_init_lt : r_init < s_init / 4 := by
      have : r_init ≤ s_init / 8 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have hr_init_le : r_init ≤ M.r_base / 2 := min_le_right _ _

    have hM_ang_maps : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init → M_ang (y, t) ∈ horizStrip η₀ := by
      intro y t hy ht
      let k : ℤ := ⌊y.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋

      have hk_im : ((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im = 0 := by norm_cast
      have hk_re : ((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).re = k * (2 * Real.pi) := by norm_cast

      have hy₀_re_lo : 0 ≤ y₀.re := by
        have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (y.re / (2 * Real.pi)))

      have hy₀_re_hi : y₀.re ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by

      have hy_im_le : |y.im| ≤ M.s_base / 2 := le_trans hy.le hs_init_le_base
      have ht_le : ‖t‖ ≤ M.r_base / 2 := le_trans ht.le hr_init_le
      have hp₁_K : (y₀, t) ∈ K_col :=
        ⟨(y₀.re, y₀.im, t),

          Prod.ext (Complex.re_add_im y₀) rfl⟩
      have hp₂_K : ((y₀.re : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ K_col :=
        ⟨(y₀.re, 0, 0),
          ⟨⟨hy₀_re_lo, hy₀_re_hi⟩, ⟨by linarith [M.s_base_pos], by linarith [M.s_base_pos]⟩,

          by simp⟩
      have hdist : dist (y₀, t) ((y₀.re : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) < δ₂ := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq]
        refine max_lt ?_ ?_
        · rw [dist_eq_norm]
          have : y₀ - (y₀.re : ℂ) = (y₀.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            nth_rw 1 [← Complex.re_add_im y₀]; ring
          rw [this, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, hy₀_im]
          have : s_init ≤ δ₂ / 2 := min_le_right _ _
          linarith
        · rw [dist_zero_right]
          have : s_init ≤ δ₂ / 2 := min_le_right _ _
          linarith
      have huc := hδ₂_uc (y₀, t) hp₁_K ((y₀.re : ℂ), 0) hp₂_K hdist
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at huc
      have hy₀_real_im : (M_ang ((y₀.re : ℂ), 0)).im = 0 := by
        rw [hM_ang_zero (y₀.re : ℂ) (by simp [M.s_base_pos]), C.ϕ_ℂ_real y₀.re, Complex.ofReal_im]
      rw [hy₀_real_im, sub_zero] at huc
      have hy_eq : y = y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by dsimp [y₀]; ring
      have hy₀_lt_base : |y₀.im| < M.s_base := by rw [hy₀_im]; linarith [M.s_base_pos]
      have ht_lt_base : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [M.r_base_pos]
      have hM_shift : (M_ang (y, t)).im = (M_ang (y₀, t)).im := by
        rw [hy_eq, hM_ang_int_quasi k y₀ t hy₀_lt_base ht_lt_base]
        simp [hk_im]
      simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hM_shift]
      exact huc
    let 𝔰_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Φ_inv (M_ang p)
    have h𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_init B_init :=
      hΦ_holo.comp (hM_ang_holo.mono hB_init_sub_D) (fun p hp => hM_ang_maps p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2)
    have h𝔰_inv_mem : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        𝔰_init (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_inv := fun y t hy ht =>
      (hΦ_props (M_ang (y, t)) (hM_ang_maps y t hy ht)).1
    have h𝔰_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →

      intro y t hy ht
      have hmem := h𝔰_inv_mem y t hy ht
      simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hmem ⊢
      linarith [hs_inv_le_half, M.s_base_pos]
    have h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        C.ϕ_ℂ (𝔰_init (y, t)) = glancingMidAngle C y t := fun y t hy ht =>
      (hΦ_props (M_ang (y, t)) (hM_ang_maps y t hy ht)).2
    have h𝔰_impact : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        glancingImpact C y t = glancingBoundaryCurve C (𝔰_init (y, t)) := by
      intro y t hy ht
      simp only [glancingImpact, glancingBoundaryCurve, h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ y t hy ht]
    have h𝔰_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → 𝔰_init (y, 0) = y := by
      intro y hy
      have h0_lt : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ < r_init := by simpa using hr_init_pos
      have hy_inv : y ∈ horizStrip s_inv := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hs_init_le_inv
      have hy_base : |y.im| < M.s_base := by linarith [hs_init_le_base, M.s_base_pos]
      apply hϕ_ℂ_inj (h𝔰_inv_mem y 0 hy h0_lt) hy_inv
      rw [h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ y 0 hy h0_lt]
      exact hM_ang_zero y hy_base
    have h𝔰_quasi : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        𝔰_init (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰_init (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      intro y t hy ht
      have hy2 : |(y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im| < s_init := by
        simpa [h2pi_im] using hy
      have h1_inv := h𝔰_inv_mem (y + 2 * Real.pi) t hy2 ht
      have h2_inv : 𝔰_init (y, t) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s_inv := by
        have := h𝔰_inv_mem y t hy ht
        simpa [horizStrip, h2pi_im] using this
      apply hϕ_ℂ_inj h1_inv h2_inv
      have hy_base : |y.im| < M.s_base := by linarith [hs_init_le_base, M.s_base_pos]
      have ht_base : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [hr_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
      rw [h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ _ t hy2 ht,
        C.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic _ (hs_inv_sub_2s0 (h𝔰_inv_mem y t hy ht)),
        h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ y t hy ht]
      exact hM_ang_quasi y t hy_base ht_base
    have h𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        𝔰_init (y, -t) = 𝔰_init (y, t) := by
      intro y t hy ht
      have hy_base : |y.im| < M.s_base := by linarith [hs_init_le_base, M.s_base_pos]
      have ht_base : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [hr_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
      dsimp [𝔰_init]
      rw [hM_ang_even y t hy_base ht_base]
    have h𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_init → ‖t‖ < r_init →
        𝔰_init (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_init (y, t)) := by
      intro y t hy ht

      have htc : ‖starRingEnd ℂ t‖ < r_init := by simpa using ht
      have h1_inv := h𝔰_inv_mem (starRingEnd ℂ y) (starRingEnd ℂ t) hyc htc
      have h2_inv : starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_init (y, t)) ∈ horizStrip s_inv := by
        have := h𝔰_inv_mem y t hy ht
        simpa [horizStrip] using this
      apply hϕ_ℂ_inj h1_inv h2_inv
      have hy_base : |y.im| < M.s_base := by linarith [hs_init_le_base, M.s_base_pos]
      have ht_base : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [hr_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
      rw [h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ _ _ hyc htc,
        C.ϕ_ℂ_conj _ (hs_inv_sub_2s0 (h𝔰_inv_mem y t hy ht)),
        h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ y t hy ht]
      exact hM_ang_conj y t hy_base ht_base
    exact ⟨s_init, r_init, 𝔰_init, hs_init_pos, hs_init_le_base, hr_init_pos, hr_init_lt,
      hr_init_le, h𝔰_holo, h𝔰_maps_to, h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ, h𝔰_impact, h𝔰_zero, h𝔰_quasi, h𝔰_even, h𝔰_conj⟩
  obtain ⟨s_init, r_init, 𝔰_init, hs_init_pos, hs_init_le_base, hr_init_pos, hr_init_lt,
    hr_init_le, h𝔰_holo, h𝔰_maps_to, h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ, h𝔰_impact, h𝔰_zero, h𝔰_quasi, h𝔰_even, h𝔰_conj⟩ :=
    h_part4
  have h_vpath : ∀ (U S : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → S.Countable →
      IsPreconnected (U \ S) := by
    intro U S hU_open hU_conv hS
    refine isPreconnected_of_forall_pair fun p hp q hq => ?_
    by_cases hpq : p = q
    · exact ⟨{p}, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hp, rfl, hpq.symm, isPreconnected_singleton⟩
    · let d : ℂ := q - p
      have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hpq)
      have hd_pos : 0 < ‖d‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hd_ne
      let m : ℂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • p + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • q
      have hm_U : m ∈ U := hU_conv hp.1 hq.1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      have hm_eq : m = (p + q) / 2 := by dsimp [m]; push_cast; ring
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hball_U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open m hm_U
      let δ : ℝ := ε / (2 * ‖d‖)
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hε_pos (mul_pos zero_lt_two hd_pos)
      let w : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => m + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I * d
      have hw_U : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, w t ∈ U := by
        intro t ht
        apply hball_U
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hdiff : w t - m = (t : ℂ) * Complex.I * d := by dsimp [w]; ring
        rw [hdiff, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hlt : |t| * ‖d‖ < δ * ‖d‖ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (abs_lt.mpr ht) hd_pos
        have hδd : δ * ‖d‖ = ε / 2 := by dsimp [δ]; field_simp [hd_pos.ne']
        linarith
      have hw_div : ∀ t : ℝ, (w t - p) / d = (1 / 2 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        intro t; dsimp [w, d]; rw [hm_eq]; field_simp [hd_ne]; ring
      let L : ℝ → Set ℂ := fun t =>
        { z ∈ S |
          (∃ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, z = (1 - (u : ℂ)) * p + (u : ℂ) * w t) ∨
          (∃ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, z = (1 - (u : ℂ)) * w t + (u : ℂ) * q) }
      have h_coord1 : ∀ (t u : ℝ) (z : ℂ), z = (1 - (u : ℂ)) * p + (u : ℂ) * w t →
          ((z - p) / d).re = u / 2 ∧ ((z - p) / d).im = u * t := by
        intro t u z hz
        have hdiv : (z - p) / d = ((u / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((u * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          have hsub : z - p = (u : ℂ) * (w t - p) := by rw [hz]; ring
          rw [hsub, mul_div_assoc, hw_div t]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hdiv]; simp
      have h_coord2 : ∀ (t u : ℝ) (z : ℂ), z = (1 - (u : ℂ)) * w t + (u : ℂ) * q →
          ((z - p) / d).re = (1 + u) / 2 ∧ ((z - p) / d).im = (1 - u) * t := by
        intro t u z hz
        have hdiv : (z - p) / d = (((1 + u) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((1 - u) * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          have hsub : z - p = (1 - (u : ℂ)) * (w t - p) + (u : ℂ) * d := by
            dsimp [d]; rw [hz]; ring
          rw [hsub, add_div, mul_div_assoc, hw_div t, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hd_ne]
          push_cast; ring
        rw [hdiv]; simp
      have hL_eq : ∀ t₁ t₂ : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ L t₁ → z ∈ L t₂ → t₁ = t₂ := by
        intro t₁ t₂ z hz₁ hz₂
        rcases hz₁.2 with ⟨u₁, hu₁, he₁⟩ | ⟨u₁, hu₁, he₁⟩ <;>
          rcases hz₂.2 with ⟨u₂, hu₂, he₂⟩ | ⟨u₂, hu₂, he₂⟩
        · obtain ⟨hre₁, him₁⟩ := h_coord1 t₁ u₁ z he₁
          obtain ⟨hre₂, him₂⟩ := h_coord1 t₂ u₂ z he₂
          have hu : u₁ = u₂ := by linarith
          subst hu; exact mul_left_cancel₀ hu₁.1.ne' (him₁.symm.trans him₂)

          obtain ⟨hre₂, _⟩ := h_coord2 t₂ u₂ z he₂
          linarith [hu₁.2, hu₂.1]
        · obtain ⟨hre₁, _⟩ := h_coord2 t₁ u₁ z he₁
          obtain ⟨hre₂, _⟩ := h_coord1 t₂ u₂ z he₂
          linarith [hu₁.1, hu₂.2]
        · obtain ⟨hre₁, him₁⟩ := h_coord2 t₁ u₁ z he₁
          obtain ⟨hre₂, him₂⟩ := h_coord2 t₂ u₂ z he₂
          have hu : u₁ = u₂ := by linarith
          subst hu
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hu₁.2.ne') (him₁.symm.trans him₂)
      let Bad : Set ℝ := { t : ℝ | (L t).Nonempty }
      have hBad_cnt : Bad.Countable := by
        rw [← Set.countable_coe_iff]
        have : Countable ↥S := hS.to_subtype
        let φ : ↥Bad → ↥S := fun t => ⟨t.2.some, t.2.some_mem.1⟩
        refine Function.Injective.countable (f := φ) fun a b hab => ?_
        have hval : a.2.some = b.2.some := congr_arg Subtype.val hab
        have hb_mem : a.2.some ∈ L b.1 := by rw [hval]; exact b.2.some_mem
        exact Subtype.ext (hL_eq a.1 b.1 a.2.some a.2.some_mem hb_mem)
      have hex_t₀ : ∃ t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, t₀ ∉ Bad := by
        by_contra hall
        have hall' : Set.Ioo (-δ) δ ⊆ Bad := fun t ht => by
          by_contra hnb; exact hall ⟨t, ht, hnb⟩
        have hvol_le : MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) ≤ MeasureTheory.volume Bad :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_mono hall'
        rw [hBad_cnt.measure_zero, Real.volume_Ioo] at hvol_le
        exact not_lt_of_ge hvol_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith))

      have hd2 := (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hsh_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hev : (fun w => C.h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds w₀] C.h_ℂ := by
        filter_upwards [hsh_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem] with w hw
        exact C.h_ℂ_periodic w hw
      exact (hd1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev.symm).unique hd2
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [glancingBoundaryCurve, hϕ_2pi, w₀, hh_2pi, hdh_2pi,
        Complex.cos_add_two_pi, Complex.sin_add_two_pi]
  have hΓ_0_conj : ∀ i : Fin 2, starRingEnd ℂ (Γ 0 i) = Γ 0 i := by
    intro i
    rw [hΓ_base_eq 0 h0_in_base]
    let w₀ : ℂ := C.ϕ_ℂ 0
    have hw₀_real : w₀ = (C.ϕ 0 : ℂ) := by simpa [w₀] using C.ϕ_ℂ_real 0
    have hw₀_conj : starRingEnd ℂ w₀ = w₀ := by rw [hw₀_real]; simp
    have hw₀_mem : w₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to 0 (hbase_sub_2s0 h0_in_base)
    have hsh_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) := hstrip_open (2 * C.s_h)
    have hdh_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ w₀) = deriv C.h_ℂ w₀ := by
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (C.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w)))
          (starRingEnd ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ w₀)) w₀ := by
        have hd_at := (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hsh_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem)).hasDerivAt
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, hw₀_conj] using hd_at.conj_conj
      have hd2 := (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hsh_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hev : (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (C.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w))) =ᶠ[nhds w₀] C.h_ℂ := by
        filter_upwards [hsh_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem] with w hw
        have hwc : starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
          simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] at hw ⊢; exact hw
        rw [← C.h_ℂ_conj _ hwc, Complex.conj_conj]
      exact (hd1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev.symm).unique hd2
    have hh_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (C.h_ℂ w₀) = C.h_ℂ w₀ := by
      rw [hw₀_real, C.h_ℂ_real]; simp
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [glancingBoundaryCurve, w₀, hh_conj, hdh_conj, ← Complex.cos_conj, ← Complex.sin_conj,
        hw₀_conj]
  have hΓ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ D_H, f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s := by
    intro s hsD hfs
    funext i
    let P_i : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Γ (z + 2 * Real.pi) i - Γ z i
    have hPi_deriv : ∀ z ∈ D_reg, HasDerivAt P_i 0 z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hD_reg_eq] at hz
      have hz2_D : z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) ∈ D_H := hDH_add_2pi z hz.1
      have hz2_f : f (z + 2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by rw [hf_periodic z hz.1]; exact hz.2
      have hd1 := (hΓ_hasDeriv _ hz2_D hz2_f i).comp_add_const z (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
      have hd2 := hΓ_hasDeriv z hz.1 hz.2 i
      have hω_eq : ω_vec i (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ω_vec i z := by
        fin_cases i <;>
          simp [ω_vec, hf_periodic z hz.1, hϕ_quasiperiodic z hz.1,
            Complex.sin_add_two_pi, Complex.cos_add_two_pi]
      rw [hω_eq] at hd1
      have h0 : ω_vec i z - ω_vec i z = 0 := sub_self _
      exact h0 ▸ hd1.sub hd2
    have hs_reg : s ∈ D_reg := by rw [hD_reg_eq]; exact ⟨hsD, hfs⟩
    have hconst := hD_reg_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hD_reg_pre
      (fun z hz => (hPi_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun z hz => (hPi_deriv z hz).deriv) hs_reg h0_in_reg
    dsimp [P_i] at hconst
    rw [congr_fun hΓ_0_2pi i, sub_self] at hconst
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hconst
  have hΓ_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H, f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i) := by
    intro s hsD hfs i
    let Q_i : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => starRingEnd ℂ (Γ (starRingEnd ℂ z) i) - Γ z i
    have hQi_deriv : ∀ z ∈ D_reg, HasDerivAt Q_i 0 z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hD_reg_eq] at hz
      have hzc_D : starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ D_H := hDH_conj z hz.1
      have hzc_f : f (starRingEnd ℂ z) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hf_conj z hz.1]; exact map_ne_zero_iff (starRingEnd ℂ) (RingHom.injective _) |>.mpr hz.2
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (Γ (starRingEnd ℂ w) i))
          (starRingEnd ℂ (ω_vec i (starRingEnd ℂ z))) z := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.conj_conj] using
          (hΓ_hasDeriv _ hzc_D hzc_f i).conj_conj
      have hd2 := hΓ_hasDeriv z hz.1 hz.2 i
      have hω_eq : starRingEnd ℂ (ω_vec i (starRingEnd ℂ z)) = ω_vec i z := by
        fin_cases i <;>
          simp [ω_vec, hf_conj z hz.1, hϕ_conj z hz.1, ← Complex.sin_conj, ← Complex.cos_conj]
      rw [hω_eq] at hd1
      have h0 : ω_vec i z - ω_vec i z = 0 := sub_self _
      exact h0 ▸ hd1.sub hd2
    have hs_reg : s ∈ D_reg := by rw [hD_reg_eq]; exact ⟨hsD, hfs⟩
    have hconst := hD_reg_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hD_reg_pre
      (fun z hz => (hQi_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun z hz => (hQi_deriv z hz).deriv) hs_reg h0_in_reg
    dsimp [Q_i] at hconst
    rw [map_zero, hΓ_0_conj i, sub_self] at hconst
    have heq := sub_eq_zero.mp hconst
    have heq' := congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) heq
    rwa [Complex.conj_conj] at heq'
  exact ⟨{
    a := a
    ϕ := ϕ
    f := f
    a_holo := ha_holo
    ϕ_holo := hϕ_holo
    f_holo := hf_holo
    a_ne_zero := ha_ne_zero
    deriv_ϕ := hderiv_ϕ
    exp_ϕ := hexp_ϕ
    deriv_a := hderiv_a
    base_ϕ_eq := hbase_ϕ_eq
    ϕ_quasiperiodic := hϕ_quasiperiodic
    f_periodic := hf_periodic
    a_periodic := ha_periodic
    ϕ_conj := hϕ_conj
    f_conj := hf_conj
    f_real_pos := hf_real_pos
    f_base_ne_zero := hf_base_ne_zero
    f_nonconstant := hf_nonconstant
    Γ := Γ
    Γ_mero := hΓ_mero
    Γ_reg_holo := fun s hs hfs =>
      ⟨(hΓ_hasDeriv s hs hfs 0).differentiableAt, (hΓ_hasDeriv s hs hfs 1).differentiableAt⟩
    Γ_deriv₀ := fun s hs hfs => (hΓ_hasDeriv s hs hfs 0).deriv
    Γ_deriv₁ := fun s hs hfs => (hΓ_hasDeriv s hs hfs 1).deriv
    Γ_periodic := hΓ_periodic
    Γ_conj := hΓ_conj
    Γ_base_eq := hΓ_base_eq
    Γ_slice_eq := fun s hs hsE _ => hΓ_reg_eq s hs hsE
    Γ_real_simple := fun x₁ x₂ hΓ => by
      rw [hΓ_base_eq x₁ (hreal_in_base x₁), hΓ_base_eq x₂ (hreal_in_base x₂)] at hΓ
      exact h_real_simple x₁ x₂ hΓ
    no_1d_patch_Γ := hno_1d_patch
    s_init := s_init
    r_init := r_init
    s_init_pos := hs_init_pos
    s_init_le := hs_init_le_base
    r_init_pos := hr_init_pos
    r_init_lt := hr_init_lt
    r_init_le := hr_init_le
    𝔰_init := 𝔰_init
    𝔰_init_holo := h𝔰_holo
    𝔰_init_maps_to := h𝔰_maps_to
    𝔰_init_ϕ := fun y t hy ht =>
      (hbase_ϕ_eq _ (h𝔰_maps_to y t hy ht)).1.trans (h𝔰_ϕ_ℂ y t hy ht)
    𝔰_init_impact := fun y t hy ht =>
      (h𝔰_impact y t hy ht).trans (hΓ_base_eq _ (h𝔰_maps_to y t hy ht)).symm
    𝔰_init_zero := h𝔰_zero
    𝔰_init_quasiperiodic := h𝔰_quasi
    𝔰_init_even := h𝔰_even
    𝔰_init_conj := h𝔰_conj
  }⟩

structure RegularCollarLocusData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  eqOn_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
    p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ → Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ W →
    (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 2 0 f) W
  iterDerivYT_comm : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    ∀ p ∈ W, iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p = iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p
  T_mero_open : IsOpen (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  T_mero_preconnected : IsPreconnected (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  T_mero_star : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ 1 →
    (((p.1.re : ℂ) + ((u * p.1.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I), p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  base_sub_T_mero : { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } ⊆
    meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  U_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  U_reg_sub : U_reg ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  U_reg_open : IsOpen U_reg
  X_true : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  X_true_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_true i) U_reg
  r_origin : ℝ
  r_origin_pos : 0 < r_origin
  ball_origin_sub : Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin ⊆
    U_reg ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init }
  X_true_origin_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    X_true i q = K.Γ (K.𝔰_init q) i
  chart_nonvanishing : ∀ p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    ∃ (r₀ : ℝ) (B_chart : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r₀ ∧
      r₀ ≤ min ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) ∧
      Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ B_chart (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) ∧
      (∃ q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀ / 2), B_chart q₁ ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, B_chart q ≠ 0 →
        q ∈ U_reg ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 ∧
          (M.X_mero i).num p₀ q = X_true i q * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q
  G_6 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  R_ratio : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  G_6_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_6 U_reg
  R_ratio_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_ratio U_reg
  G_6_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_reg, G_6 p ≠ 0
  compat_eq : ∀ p ∈ U_reg,
    iterDerivYT 0 1 G_6 p - R_ratio p * iterDerivYT 1 0 G_6 p -
      6 * G_6 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 R_ratio p = 0
  init_ode : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin,
    (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 6 = G_6 q ∧
    iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q = R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q
  ball_chain_reach : ∀ p ∈ U_reg,
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ρ : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ),
      c 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∧
      ρ 0 = r_origin ∧
      p ∈ Metric.ball (c (Fin.last N)) (ρ (Fin.last N)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ k ∧ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ U_reg) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin N,
        (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
          Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty)

structure RegularExponentialLiftData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K) where
  v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  v_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ v Reg.U_reg
  v_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, v p ≠ 0
  v_origin_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin,
    v q = Complex.exp (Complex.I * K.𝔰_init q)
  v_local_lift : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg,
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (𝔰_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r ∧
      Metric.ball p r ⊆ Reg.U_reg ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_loc (Metric.ball p r) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q) = v q ∧
        𝔰_loc q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        K.f (𝔰_loc q) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰_loc q) i

structure RawGlobalLiftPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) where
  𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_raw_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  𝔰_raw_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  𝔰_raw_init_eq : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < K.s_init → ‖t‖ < K.r_init →
    𝔰_raw (y, t) = K.𝔰_init (y, t)
  𝔰_raw_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), 𝔰_raw (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_raw_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰_raw p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_raw_even : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰_raw p
  𝔰_raw_conj : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
    𝔰_raw (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_raw p)
  𝔰_raw_comp_X : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, K.f (𝔰_raw p) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i) (Metric.ball p r)

open Classical in
noncomputable def speedPotentialQ {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if K.f s = 0 then deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) s / deriv K.f s
  else deriv (deriv K.f) s / K.f s

noncomputable def supportProfileH0 {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ)
    (fun z => K.Γ z 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ z) + K.Γ z 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ z))

noncomputable def firstImpactDisplacementV {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0

noncomputable def realCollarChordLen {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {M : MeromorphicCollarData C} {K : NonisotropicCurveData C M}
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (x t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0).re * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
    (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1).re * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

def RealCollarChordProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) : Prop :=
  ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < L.r_star →
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (L.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < realCollarChordLen L x t ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -realCollarChordLen L x t * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      realCollarChordLen L x t * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

def MeroEqOnPullback {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ W₁ ∧ Set.MapsTo Φ U W₂ ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ F₁.rad p ∧
    Set.MapsTo Φ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Φ p) (F₂.rad (Φ p))) ∧

  L_back : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀)
  L_fwd : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀)
  back_eq_fwd : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroEqOn (L_back i) (L_fwd i)
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀)
  η₂ : ℝ
  η₂_pos : 0 < η₂
  η₂_le : η₂ ≤ 2 * d
  back_eq_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroEqOnPullback (L_back i) (M.L_mero i)
      (fun p => (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2))
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ })

noncomputable def sfcaEtaSL : ℝ := 1 / 256

noncomputable def sfcaRhoB : ℝ := 1 / 16

noncomputable def sfcaRhoC : ℝ := 1 / 32

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraIter (y₀ : ℝ → ℂ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ
  | 0, w => y₀ w
  | m + 1, w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraC (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun _ => 1) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraK (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun v => (v : ℂ)) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v

noncomputable def sfcaSlopeA1 (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1) / sfcaVolterraK Q 1

noncomputable def sfcaFieldF (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q w

noncomputable def sfcaFieldFDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w

noncomputable def sfcaPotPlus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaPotMinus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaNumN (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let k₀ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  let k_p := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  let k_m := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  k₀ * (1 - Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2)))

noncomputable def sfcaDivH (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀

noncomputable def sfcaUniversalPsi (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaDivH Q a₀ (a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 + a₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPot (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s h : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPhi (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaUniversalPsi (sfcaStripPot S q.1 q.2) (q.2 * S.f q.1) (q.2 ^ 2 * deriv S.f q.1)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def sfcaEtaSL : ℝ := 1 / 256

noncomputable def sfcaRhoB : ℝ := 1 / 16

noncomputable def sfcaRhoC : ℝ := 1 / 32

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraIter (y₀ : ℝ → ℂ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ
  | 0, w => y₀ w
  | m + 1, w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraC (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun _ => 1) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraK (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter (fun v => (v : ℂ)) Q m w

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v

noncomputable def sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v

noncomputable def sfcaSlopeA1 (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1) / sfcaVolterraK Q 1

noncomputable def sfcaFieldF (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q w

noncomputable def sfcaFieldFDeriv (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  z₀ * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w

noncomputable def sfcaPotPlus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaPotMinus (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2

noncomputable def sfcaNumN (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let k₀ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  let k_p := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  let k_m := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1
  k₀ * (1 - Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2)))

noncomputable def sfcaDivH (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀

noncomputable def sfcaUniversalPsi (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaDivH Q a₀ (a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 + a₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPot (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s h : ℂ) (w : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)

noncomputable def sfcaStripPhi (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sfcaUniversalPsi (sfcaStripPot S q.1 q.2) (q.2 * S.f q.1) (q.2 ^ 2 * deriv S.f q.1)

by
  have hJets : SteepContJetProp S A := steep_action_perturbation_jets S A
  have hSolver : SteepContSolverProp S A := steep_holomorphic_step_solver S A hJets
  have hBase : SteepContBaseBoundsProp S A := base_substrip_lift_quadratic_bounds S A
  have hAdm : SteepContStepAdmProp S A :=
    steep_cone_step_admissibility_and_mesh_sum S A hJets
  have hUp : SteepContUpwardProp S :=
    upward_steep_sector_passage S A hSolver hBase hAdm
  intro α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b hα1 hα2 hm_pos hγ_pos hγ_lt hδc_pos hδc_lt_b hδb_lt_H
  let L : ℝ := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
  have hL_ge : m_steep ≤ L := by
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < 1 / γ_steep := div_pos one_pos hγ_pos
    dsimp [L]
    linarith
  refine ⟨L, hL_ge, ?_⟩
  intro K hK_pos
  obtain ⟨C_st, ε_st, d_st, hC_pos, hε_st_pos, hd_st_pos, hUpK⟩ :=
    hUp α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b hα1 hα2 hm_pos hγ_pos hγ_lt hδc_pos hδc_lt_b hδb_lt_H K hK_pos
  refine ⟨C_st, ε_st, d_st, hC_pos, hε_st_pos, hd_st_pos, ?_⟩
  intro d x₀ r ε hd_pos hd_lt hr_pos hr_le hε_pos hε_le hCone
  obtain ⟨s_up, hs_up_holo, hs_up_props⟩ :=
    hUpK d x₀ r ε hd_pos hd_lt hr_pos hr_le hε_pos hε_le hCone
  let W_up : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
      |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
      ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
      γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im }
  let W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
      |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
      ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
      γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
  let s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => if 0 ≤ p.2.im then s_up p else s_up (p.1, -p.2)
  refine ⟨s_steep, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    have h_abs_pos : 0 < |p.2.im| :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ_pos.le (norm_nonneg p.2)) hp.2.2.2.2
    have him_ne : p.2.im ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp h_abs_pos
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne him_ne with him_neg | him_pos
    · let U_neg : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q : ℂ × ℂ | q.2.im < 0 }
      have hU_neg_open : IsOpen U_neg :=
        isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
      let neg2 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, -q.2)
      have hneg2_diff : Differentiable ℂ neg2 :=
        Differentiable.prodMk differentiable_fst differentiable_snd.neg
      have h_maps : Set.MapsTo neg2 (W_steep ∩ U_neg) W_up := by
        intro q hq
        rcases hq with ⟨⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4, hq5⟩, hq_neg⟩
        have habs : |q.2.im| = -q.2.im := abs_of_neg hq_neg
        refine ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [neg2] using hq4
        · simpa [neg2, habs] using hq5
      have h_comp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_up ∘ neg2) (W_steep ∩ U_neg) :=
        hs_up_holo.comp hneg2_diff.differentiableOn h_maps
      have h_eq : Set.EqOn s_steep (s_up ∘ neg2) (W_steep ∩ U_neg) := by
        intro q hq
        have h_not_nonneg : ¬ (0 ≤ q.2.im) := not_le.mpr hq.2
        simp [s_steep, neg2, h_not_nonneg]
      have h_inter : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ s_steep (W_steep ∩ U_neg) p :=
        (h_comp_holo.congr h_eq) p ⟨hp, him_neg⟩
      exact (differentiableWithinAt_inter (hU_neg_open.mem_nhds him_neg)).mp h_inter
    · let U_pos : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q : ℂ × ℂ | 0 < q.2.im }
      have hU_pos_open : IsOpen U_pos :=
        isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)
      have h_sub : W_steep ∩ U_pos ⊆ W_up := by
        intro q hq
        rcases hq with ⟨⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4, hq5⟩, hq_pos⟩
        have habs : |q.2.im| = q.2.im := abs_of_pos hq_pos
        refine ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4, ?_⟩
        rwa [habs] at hq5
      have h_up_inter : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_up (W_steep ∩ U_pos) :=
        hs_up_holo.mono h_sub
      have h_eq : Set.EqOn s_steep s_up (W_steep ∩ U_pos) := by
        intro q hq
        have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q.2.im := le_of_lt hq.2
        dsimp only [s_steep]
        split_ifs
        rfl
      have h_inter : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ s_steep (W_steep ∩ U_pos) p :=
        (h_up_inter.congr h_eq) p ⟨hp, him_pos⟩
      exact (differentiableWithinAt_inter (hU_pos_open.mem_nhds him_pos)).mp h_inter
  · intro p hp1 hp2 hp3 hp4 hp5
    have h_abs_pos : 0 < |p.2.im| :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ_pos.le (norm_nonneg p.2)) hp5
    have him_ne : p.2.im ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp h_abs_pos
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne him_ne with him_neg | him_pos
    · have h_not_nonneg : ¬ (0 ≤ p.2.im) := not_le.mpr him_neg
      have h_neg_nonneg : 0 ≤ (-p.2).im := by simp; linarith
      have habs : |p.2.im| = (-p.2).im := by simp [abs_of_neg him_neg]
      have h_up := hs_up_props (p.1, -p.2) hp1 hp2 hp3
        (by simpa using hp4) (by simpa [habs] using hp5)
      have hs_eq : s_steep p = s_up (p.1, -p.2) := by
        dsimp only [s_steep]
        split_ifs
        rfl
      have hs_even : s_steep (p.1, -p.2) = s_steep p := by
        rw [hs_eq]
        dsimp only [s_steep]
        split_ifs
        rfl
      refine ⟨?_, hs_even, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hs_eq]
        exact h_up.1
      · rw [hs_eq]
        simpa using h_up.2.1
      · intro hp_tube
        rcases hp_tube with ⟨ht_norm, ht_lo, ht_hi⟩
        have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht_norm
        have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using ht_norm
        have h_neg_tube : (p.1, -p.2) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
          refine ⟨by simpa using ht_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [map_neg, S.h_X_even (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) hconj_ball]
            exact ht_lo
          · rw [S.h_X_even p.2 ht_ball]
            exact ht_hi
        have h_tube_orig : p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := ⟨ht_norm, ht_lo, ht_hi⟩
        rw [hs_eq, h_up.2.2 h_neg_tube, S.𝔰_even p h_tube_orig]
    · have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ p.2.im := him_pos.le
      have h_neg_not_nonneg : ¬ (0 ≤ (-p.2).im) := by simp [not_le, him_pos]
      have habs : |p.2.im| = p.2.im := abs_of_pos him_pos
      have h_up := hs_up_props p hp1 hp2 hp3 hp4 (by rwa [habs] at hp5)
      have hs_eq : s_steep p = s_up p := by
        dsimp only [s_steep]
        split_ifs
        rfl
      have hs_even : s_steep (p.1, -p.2) = s_steep p := by
        rw [hs_eq]
        dsimp only [s_steep]
        split_ifs
        simp
      refine ⟨?_, hs_even, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hs_eq]
        exact h_up.1
      · rw [hs_eq]
        exact h_up.2.1
      · intro hp_tube
        rw [hs_eq]
        exact h_up.2.2 hp_tube

steep_sector_cone_continuation.definitions:
noncomputable def steepContActionA (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J ^ 3 * (Phi (s, t * J) - (1 / 24 : ℂ))

noncomputable def steepContActionDJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s J' t) J

noncomputable def steepContActionDS (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s' J t) s

noncomputable def steepContPerturbG (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  steepContActionDJ Phi s_0 J t - t * steepContActionDS Phi s_0 J t

noncomputable def steepContResidual (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    steepContPerturbG Phi s_0 t J -
    steepContActionDJ Phi s_m J_m t

def steepContTripleDomain (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (η_SL : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | (q.1, q.2.2 * q.2.1) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL }

noncomputable def steepContIterJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * steepContResidual Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def steepContSolJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def steepContChain (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_base (y_bot, t), s_base (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := steepContChain Phi s_base y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * steepContSolJ Phi prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def steepContPsi (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (steepContChain Phi s_base (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

def SteepContJetProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  IsOpen (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J =
      (deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s_0) -
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    HasDerivAt (fun J' => steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J')
      ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J) J) ∧
  (∀ s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ, ∀ ρ_s ρ_J M_a : ℝ,
    0 < ρ_s → 0 < ρ_J → 0 ≤ M_a → ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
      ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
        (s', t * J') ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
        ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
    (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤
        4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) ∧
    ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
    ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ ≤
      (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖)

def IsSteepContContractivePt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : Prop :=
  t ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < ρ_J ∧ ρ_J ≤ 1 / 32 ∧
  let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
  ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J ∧
  (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
  (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
    ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32) ∧
  ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J / 8

def SteepContSolverProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ ρ_J : ℝ, ∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
    IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t →
    let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let J_p := steepContSolJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
    ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
    deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
      t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m ∧
    (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J'' t) J' -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J' t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J'' t) J_m →
      J' = J_p)) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_m U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_0 U →
    (∀ p ∈ U, IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContSolJ A.Phi (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) U)

def SteepContBaseBoundsProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ_ceil : ℝ, 0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ r_base C_base : ℝ, 0 < r_base ∧ r_base < S.r_star ∧ 0 < C_base ∧
      ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| ≤ S.H - δ_ceil / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_base →
        (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
        (t ≠ 0 →
          let s_m := S.𝔰 (y - t, t)
          let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
          let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
          let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
          let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
          ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
            t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
            deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m)

def SteepContStepAdmProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ β x_start Δ : ℝ, ∀ M : ℕ,
    1 < β → 0 < x_start → 0 < Δ →
    Δ * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (x_start + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Δ) ^ (-β)) ≤
      x_start ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) ∧
  (∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b K : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 → 0 < K →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    let ρ_J := 1 / (400 * (1 + 20 * K))
    ∃ Θ_adm C_res : ℝ, 0 < Θ_adm ∧ 0 < C_res ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε →
        10 * K * d ^ (1 - α) + 10 * ε ≤ Θ_adm →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∀ z_0 t s_m s_0 : ℂ,
          γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
          d / 2 < wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          wallDepth S (z_0 - t) < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_ceil →
          |(z_0 + t).re - x₀| ≤ (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep) * wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          ‖t‖ < 10 * r * (wallDepth S (z_0 + t) / d) ^ α →
          ‖s_m - (z_0 - t)‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S (z_0 - t) →
          ‖s_0 - z_0‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S z_0 →
          ‖(s_0 - s_m) / t - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
          IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t ∧
          8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t ((s_0 - s_m) / t)‖ ≤
            C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * (wallDepth S z_0) ^ (-2 * α - 1))

def SteepContUpwardProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C_st ε_st d_st : ℝ, 0 < C_st ∧ 0 < ε_st ∧ 0 < d_st ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d_st → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε_st →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∃ s_up : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ s_up
            { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
              ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧

            |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) →
            ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
            γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im →
            s_up p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
