noncomputable def steepContActionA (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J ^ 3 * (Phi (s, t * J) - (1 / 24 : ℂ))

noncomputable def steepContActionDJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s J' t) J

noncomputable def steepContActionDS (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionA Phi s' J t) s

noncomputable def steepContPerturbG (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  steepContActionDJ Phi s_0 J t - t * steepContActionDS Phi s_0 J t

noncomputable def steepContResidual (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    steepContPerturbG Phi s_0 t J -
    steepContActionDJ Phi s_m J_m t

def steepContTripleDomain (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (η_SL : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | (q.1, q.2.2 * q.2.1) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL }

noncomputable def steepContIterJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * steepContResidual Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def steepContSolJ (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (steepContIterJ Phi s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def steepContChain (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_base (y_bot, t), s_base (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := steepContChain Phi s_base y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * steepContSolJ Phi prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def steepContPsi (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (steepContChain Phi s_base (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

def SteepContJetProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  IsOpen (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J =
      (deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s_0) -
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m) ∧
  (∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    HasDerivAt (fun J' => steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J')
      ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J) J) ∧
  (∀ s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ, ∀ ρ_s ρ_J M_a : ℝ,
    0 < ρ_s → 0 < ρ_J → 0 ≤ M_a → ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
      ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
        (s', t * J') ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
        ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
    (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤
        4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) ∧
    ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
    ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ ≤
      (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖)

def IsSteepContContractivePt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : Prop :=
  t ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < ρ_J ∧ ρ_J ≤ 1 / 32 ∧
  let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
  ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J ∧
  (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
  (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
    (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
    ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32) ∧
  ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J / 8

def SteepContSolverProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ ρ_J : ℝ, ∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
    IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t →
    let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let J_p := steepContSolJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
    ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
    deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
      t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m ∧
    (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
      deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J'' t) J' -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J' t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J'' t) J_m →
      J' = J_p)) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_m U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_0 U →
    (∀ p ∈ U, IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContSolJ A.Phi (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) U)

def SteepContBaseBoundsProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ δ_ceil : ℝ, 0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ r_base C_base : ℝ, 0 < r_base ∧ r_base < S.r_star ∧ 0 < C_base ∧
      ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| ≤ S.H - δ_ceil / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_base →
        (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
        (t ≠ 0 →
          let s_m := S.𝔰 (y - t, t)
          let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
          let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
          let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
          let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
          ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 ∧
          (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
            t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
            deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m)

def SteepContStepAdmProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop :=
  (∀ β x_start Δ : ℝ, ∀ M : ℕ,
    1 < β → 0 < x_start → 0 < Δ →
    Δ * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (x_start + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Δ) ^ (-β)) ≤
      x_start ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) ∧
  (∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b K : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 → 0 < K →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    let ρ_J := 1 / (400 * (1 + 20 * K))
    ∃ Θ_adm C_res : ℝ, 0 < Θ_adm ∧ 0 < C_res ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε →
        10 * K * d ^ (1 - α) + 10 * ε ≤ Θ_adm →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∀ z_0 t s_m s_0 : ℂ,
          γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
          d / 2 < wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          wallDepth S (z_0 - t) < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_ceil →
          |(z_0 + t).re - x₀| ≤ (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep) * wallDepth S (z_0 + t) →
          ‖t‖ < 10 * r * (wallDepth S (z_0 + t) / d) ^ α →
          ‖s_m - (z_0 - t)‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S (z_0 - t) →
          ‖s_0 - z_0‖ ≤ (1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)) * wallDepth S z_0 →
          ‖(s_0 - s_m) / t - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
          IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t ∧
          8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t ((s_0 - s_m) / t)‖ ≤
            C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * (wallDepth S z_0) ^ (-2 * α - 1))

def SteepContUpwardProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    let L := 2 * (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep + 1)
    ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C_st ε_st d_st : ℝ, 0 < C_st ∧ 0 < ε_st ∧ 0 < d_st ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d_st → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε_st →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
        ∃ s_up : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ s_up
            { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
              ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
              γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im } ∧
          (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) →
            ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
            γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im →
            s_up p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
            ‖s_up p - p.1‖ ≤
              C_st * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_up p = S.𝔰 p))

    have h_cone_open : ∀ δ_m : ℝ, 0 < δ_m → IsOpen (adConeDomain S.H x₀ m d r α δ_m δ_ceil) := by

        calc a_lo = (u + v) * a_lo := by rw [huv, one_mul]

          _ = (u + v) * a_hi := by ring
          _ = a_hi := by rw [huv, one_mul]
      · rw [hre, hdepth]
        have hsplit : u * y₁.re + v * y₂.re - x₀ = u * (y₁.re - x₀) + v * (y₂.re - x₀) := by

        rw [hsplit]

          _ = u * |y₁.re - x₀| + v * |y₂.re - x₀| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hu_pos, abs_of_pos hv_pos]
          _ < u * (slope * (S.H - y₁.im)) + v * (slope * (S.H - y₂.im)) :=
              add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_re hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_re hv_pos)
          _ = slope * (u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im)) := by ring

          have hle2 : δ_m ≤ S.H - y₂.im := min_le_right _ _

          rw [Real.div_rpow hδy_pos.le hd_pos.le] at hp4
          linarith [show r * (δ_y ^ α / d ^ α) = (r / d ^ α) * δ_y ^ α by ring]
        calc ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((r / d ^ α) * δ_y ^ α) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp4' 2
          _ = (r / d ^ α) ^ 2 * (δ_y ^ α) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by ring
          _ = (r / d ^ α) ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (2 * α) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (δ_y ^ α) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hδy_pos.le]
              ring_nf
      have hδy_pow : δ_y ^ (2 * α) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) = δ_y := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hδy_pos]
        ring_nf
        exact Real.rpow_one _
      calc ‖s_tilde p - p.1‖
          ≤ C * B ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) := h_diff_bd
        _ ≤ C * B ^ 2 * ((r / d ^ α) ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (2 * α)) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2_sq_le (by positivity))
              (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hδy_pos _).le
        _ = (C * (B * (r / d ^ α)) ^ 2) * (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α)) := by ring
        _ = (C * (B * (r / d ^ α)) ^ 2) * δ_y := by rw [hδy_pow]
        _ < (1 / 2) * δ_y := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hCB_sq hδy_pos
        _ = δ_y / 2 := by ring
    have him_diff : |(s_tilde p).im - p.1.im| < δ_y / 2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (s_tilde p - p.1)) hnorm_lt_half
    change |(s_tilde p).im| < S.H
    rw [abs_lt] at him_diff ⊢
    dsimp [δ_y] at him_diff
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hs_even : s_tilde (p.1, -p.2) = s_tilde p := by
    dsimp [s_tilde]
    rw [hUfin_even p hp_Ωd]
    ring
  have hs_base_tube : δ_star / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := fun hhalf =>
    hΩ₀_tube p ⟨hhalf, hp_Ωd.2⟩
  refine ⟨hs_strip, hs_even, h_diff_bd, hs_base_tube, ?_⟩
  intro hp_tube
  rcases p with ⟨y₀, t₀⟩
  let U_s : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ U_cone ∩ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X }
  let V_s : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ U_cone ∩ Ω₀ }
  have hUs_open : IsOpen U_s :=
    (hU_cone_open.inter S.tube_open).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hΩ₀_open : IsOpen Ω₀ := by
    have h1 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | δ_star / 2 < S.H - q.1.im } :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
    have h2 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | S.H - q.1.im < δ_ceil } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)) continuous_const
    have h3 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.re - x₀| < m * (S.H - q.1.im) } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)))
    have hrpow_cont : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => r * ((S.H - q.1.im) / d) ^ α) :=
      continuous_const.mul
        (((continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)).div_const d).rpow_const
          (fun _ => Or.inr hα_pos.le))
    have h4 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2‖ < r * ((S.H - q.1.im) / d) ^ α } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) hrpow_cont
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
  have hVs_open : IsOpen V_s :=
    (hU_cone_open.inter hΩ₀_open).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hUs_conv : Convex ℝ U_s := by
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ u v hu hv huv
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu with rfl | hu_pos
    · have hv1 : v = 1 := by linarith
      subst hv1; simpa using hy₂
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hv with rfl | hv_pos
    · have hu1 : u = 1 := by linarith
      subst hu1; simpa using hy₁
    rcases hy₁ with ⟨⟨h1_lo, h1_hi, h1_re, h1_t⟩, ⟨ht_r, h1_tlo, h1_thi⟩⟩
    rcases hy₂ with ⟨⟨h2_lo, h2_hi, h2_re, h2_t⟩, ⟨_, h2_tlo, h2_thi⟩⟩
    have him : (u • y₁ + v • y₂).im = u * y₁.im + v * y₂.im := by simp [Complex.real_smul]
    have hre : (u • y₁ + v • y₂).re = u * y₁.re + v * y₂.re := by simp [Complex.real_smul]
    have hdepth : S.H - (u • y₁ + v • y₂).im = u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im) := by
      rw [him]
      calc S.H - (u * y₁.im + v * y₂.im) = (u + v) * S.H - (u * y₁.im + v * y₂.im) := by
            rw [huv, one_mul]
        _ = u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im) := by ring
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨ht_r, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hdepth]
      calc d = (u + v) * d := by rw [huv, one_mul]
        _ = u * d + v * d := by ring
        _ < u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im) :=
            add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_lo hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_lo hv_pos)
    · rw [hdepth]
      calc u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im)
          < u * δ_star + v * δ_star :=
            add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_hi hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_hi hv_pos)
        _ = (u + v) * δ_star := by ring
        _ = δ_star := by rw [huv, one_mul]
    · rw [hre, hdepth]
      have hsp : u * y₁.re + v * y₂.re - x₀ = u * (y₁.re - x₀) + v * (y₂.re - x₀) := by
        calc u * y₁.re + v * y₂.re - x₀ = u * y₁.re + v * y₂.re - (u + v) * x₀ := by
              rw [huv, one_mul]
          _ = u * (y₁.re - x₀) + v * (y₂.re - x₀) := by ring
      rw [hsp]
      calc |u * (y₁.re - x₀) + v * (y₂.re - x₀)|
          ≤ |u * (y₁.re - x₀)| + |v * (y₂.re - x₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = u * |y₁.re - x₀| + v * |y₂.re - x₀| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hu_pos, abs_of_pos hv_pos]
        _ < u * (m₀ * (S.H - y₁.im)) + v * (m₀ * (S.H - y₂.im)) :=
            add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_re hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_re hv_pos)
        _ = m₀ * (u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im)) := by ring
    · rw [hdepth]
      let δ_m : ℝ := min (S.H - y₁.im) (S.H - y₂.im)
      have hδm_pos : 0 < δ_m := lt_min (lt_trans hd_pos h1_lo) (lt_trans hd_pos h2_lo)
      have hδm_le : δ_m ≤ u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im) := by
        calc δ_m = (u + v) * δ_m := by rw [huv, one_mul]
          _ = u * δ_m + v * δ_m := by ring
          _ ≤ u * (S.H - y₁.im) + v * (S.H - y₂.im) :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left _ _) hu)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right _ _) hv)
      have ht_m : ‖t₀‖ < r * (δ_m / d) ^ α := by
        rcases min_choice (S.H - y₁.im) (S.H - y₂.im) with hmin | hmin <;>
        · dsimp [δ_m]; rwa [hmin]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht_m
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδm_le hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le)
          hr_pos.le)
    · change -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀) < (u • y₁ + v • y₂).im
      rw [him]
      calc -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀) = (u + v) * (-S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀)) := by rw [huv, one_mul]
        _ = u * (-S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀)) + v * (-S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀)) := by ring
        _ < u * y₁.im + v * y₂.im :=
            add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_tlo hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_tlo hv_pos)
    · change (u • y₁ + v • y₂).im < S.h_X t₀
      rw [him]
      calc u * y₁.im + v * y₂.im < u * S.h_X t₀ + v * S.h_X t₀ :=
            add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_thi hu_pos) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2_thi hv_pos)
        _ = (u + v) * S.h_X t₀ := by ring
        _ = S.h_X t₀ := by rw [huv, one_mul]
  let δ_low : ℝ := max (S.H - y₀.im) ((3 / 4) * δ_star)
  let y_low : ℂ := (y₀.re : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_low : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hy_low_im : S.H - y_low.im = δ_low := by simp [y_low]
  have hδ_low_ge1 : S.H - y₀.im ≤ δ_low := le_max_left _ _
  have hδ_low_ge2 : (3 / 4) * δ_star ≤ δ_low := le_max_right _ _
  have hδ_low_lt : δ_low < δ_star := max_lt hp2 (by linarith)
  have hy_low_cone : (y_low, t₀) ∈ U_cone := by
    have hre : y_low.re = y₀.re := by simp [y_low]
    have h0_pos : 0 < S.H - y₀.im := lt_trans hd_pos hp1
    have hrpow_le : ((S.H - y₀.im) / d) ^ α ≤ (δ_low / d) ^ α :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ_low_ge1 hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hy_low_im]; linarith [hd_lt_δs4]
    · rw [hy_low_im]; exact hδ_low_lt
    · rw [hre, hy_low_im]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_low_ge1 hm₀_pos.le)
    · rw [hy_low_im]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp4 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le hr_pos.le)
  have hy_low_Ω₀ : (y_low, t₀) ∈ Ω₀ :=
    ⟨by rw [hy_low_im]; linarith, (hU_cone_sub hy_low_cone).2⟩
  have hy_low_V : y_low ∈ V_s := ⟨hy_low_cone, hy_low_Ω₀⟩
  have hy_low_U : y_low ∈ U_s := ⟨hy_low_cone, hΩ₀_tube (y_low, t₀) hy_low_Ω₀⟩
  have hf1_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => s_tilde (y, t₀)) U_s := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ s_tilde (y, t₀) :=
      hs_tilde_holo.differentiableAt (hU_cone_open.mem_nhds hy.1)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, t₀)) y :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t₀)
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => s_tilde (z, t₀)) y :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp y h1 h2
    exact h3.differentiableWithinAt
  have hf2_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => S.𝔰 (y, t₀)) U_s := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.𝔰 (y, t₀) :=
      S.𝔰_holo.differentiableAt (S.tube_open.mem_nhds hy.2)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, t₀)) y :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t₀)
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => S.𝔰 (z, t₀)) y :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp y h1 h2
    exact h3.differentiableWithinAt
  have hev : (fun y => s_tilde (y, t₀)) =ᶠ[nhds y_low] (fun y => S.𝔰 (y, t₀)) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨V_s, hVs_open.mem_nhds hy_low_V, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    dsimp [s_tilde]
    rw [hUfin_U₀ (w, t₀) hw.2]
    have hmul := (hU₀_even_mul (w, t₀) (hΩ₀_cyl (w, t₀) hw.2).2.1 (hΩ₀_cyl (w, t₀) hw.2).2.2).2
    dsimp at hmul
    rw [hmul]
    ring
  exact (hf1_diff.analyticOnNhd hUs_open).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
    (hf2_diff.analyticOnNhd hUs_open) hUs_conv.isPreconnected hy_low_U hev ⟨hp_cone, hp_tube⟩

        (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 2) = 1
  S_lim_zero : ∀ Y : ℂ, D_mod < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y

structure DeepPureRescaledPassages (α A₀ T₀ : ℝ) (B_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (Phi_sq W : ℂ → ℂ) where
  D_pass : ℝ
  D_rec : ℝ
  C_pass : ℝ
  S_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  p_seq : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ)

  trunc_passages : ∀ R_top : ℝ, D_pass < R_top →
    ∃ N_cone : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_cone,

        { p : ℂ × ℂ |

          D_pass / 2 < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < R_top ∧

        ‖S_seq n (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C_pass * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        S_seq n (0, Y) = Y)
  action_holo_and_conv : ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ →
    ∀ K_Z : Set ℂ, IsCompact K_Z →
      K_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Z.im) } →
      (∃ U_Z : Set ℂ, IsOpen U_Z ∧ K_Z ⊆ U_Z ∧
        U_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } ∧
        ∃ N_holo : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_holo,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => p_seq n T q.1 q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => p_seq n T q.1 q.2)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T q.1 q.2)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T q.1 J') q.2)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun Z' => p_seq n T Z' q.2) q.1)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Z' => deepPureFrozenAction Phi_sq W T Z' q.2) q.1)
        Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8))
  recurrence_eq : ∀ R_top : ℝ, 3 * D_rec < R_top →
    ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → T ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N_rec : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_rec,
        ∀ Y : ℂ, 2 * D_rec < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top - 2 → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) →
          let h_n : ℂ := T / (B_seq n : ℂ)
          let J_p : ℂ := (S_seq n (T, Y + h_n) - S_seq n (T, Y)) / h_n
          let J_m : ℂ := (S_seq n (T, Y) - S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) / h_n
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧ ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          D_rec < -(S_seq n (T, Y)).im ∧
          |(S_seq n (T, Y)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(S_seq n (T, Y)).im) ∧
          D_rec < -(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im ∧
          |(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im) ∧
          deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T (S_seq n (T, Y)) J') J_p -
            deriv (fun J' => p_seq n T (S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) J') J_m =
            h_n * deriv (fun Z' => p_seq n T Z' J_p) (S_seq n (T, Y))

by
  have h_s1 : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ), IsOpen U →

      (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0 → deriv f z ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → Metric.closedBall c R ⊆ U →
      ∃ (S : Finset ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ S ↔ a ∈ Metric.closedBall c R ∧ f a = 0) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, g z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ U, f z = g z * ∏ a ∈ S, (z - a)) := by
    intro U f hU hf hsimple c R _hR hSub
    let Z : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall c R ∩ f ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℂ)
    have hZ_closed : IsClosed Z :=
      (hf.continuousOn.mono hSub).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_closedBall isClosed_singleton
    have hZ_comp : IsCompact Z :=
      IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (isCompact_closedBall c R) hZ_closed Set.inter_subset_left
    have hZ_iso : ∀ a ∈ Z, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball a r, w ∈ Z → w = a := by
      intro a ha
      have haU : a ∈ U := hSub ha.1
      have hfa : f a = 0 := ha.2
      have hU_nhds : U ∈ nhds a := hU.mem_nhds haU

        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hU_nhds).mpr hf
      have hd_cont : ContinuousAt (dslope f a) a :=
        (hd_diff.differentiableAt hU_nhds).continuousAt
      have hd_ne : dslope f a a ≠ 0 := by
        rw [dslope_same]
        exact hsimple a haU hfa
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_ball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hd_cont.eventually_ne hd_ne)
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, fun w hw_ball hwZ => ?_⟩
      have hfw : f w = 0 := hwZ.2
      have h_eq : (w - a) * dslope f a w = 0 := by
        simpa [smul_eq_mul, hfw, hfa] using sub_smul_dslope f a w
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq).resolve_right (hr_ball w hw_ball))
    choose r hr_pos hr_iso using fun (a : Z) => hZ_iso a.1 a.2
    obtain ⟨t, ht_cover⟩ :=
      hZ_comp.elim_finite_subcover (fun a : Z => Metric.ball (a : ℂ) (r a))

        (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩)
    have hZ_sub : Z ⊆ ↑(t.image Subtype.val) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨a, ha_mem⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht_cover hx)
      rw [Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image]

    have hZ_fin : Z.Finite := (t.image Subtype.val).finite_toSet.subset hZ_sub
    let S : Finset ℂ := hZ_fin.toFinset
    have hS_mem : ∀ a : ℂ, a ∈ S ↔ a ∈ Metric.closedBall c R ∧ f a = 0 := by
      intro a
      exact hZ_fin.mem_toFinset
    have h_div : ∀ T : Finset ℂ, (∀ a ∈ T, a ∈ U ∧ f a = 0) →
        ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g U ∧ ∀ z ∈ U, f z = g z * ∏ a ∈ T, (z - a) := by
      intro T
      induction T using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        intro _
        exact ⟨f, hf, fun z _ => by simp⟩
      | @insert b T hb_not_mem ih =>
        intro hT_all
        obtain ⟨g_T, hg_T_holo, hg_T_eq⟩ :=
          ih (fun a ha => hT_all a (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ha))
        obtain ⟨hbU, hfb⟩ := hT_all b (Finset.mem_insert_self b T)
        have hprod_ne : (∏ a ∈ T, (b - a)) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
          intro a ha

        have hg_T_b : g_T b = 0 := by
          have h1 := hg_T_eq b hbU
          rw [hfb] at h1

        refine ⟨dslope g_T b, (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hU.mem_nhds hbU)).mpr hg_T_holo, ?_⟩
        intro z hzU
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hb_not_mem]

      h_div S (fun a ha => ⟨hSub ((hS_mem a).mp ha).1, ((hS_mem a).mp ha).2⟩)

    by_cases hfz : f z = 0

        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const z
      have hd_P : DifferentiableAt ℂ P_rest z := by
        dsimp [P_rest]
        fun_prop
      have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => g w * P_rest w) z :=
        (hg_holo.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzU)).mul hd_P
      have hd_mul := hd1.mul hd2.hasDerivAt
      rw [one_mul, sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero] at hd_mul

      rw [h_deriv_eq] at hdf_ne

    · rw [hg_eq z hzU] at hfz

  have h_s2 : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ) (Δ B : ℝ), 0 < Δ → 0 ≤ B →
      ContinuousOn g {w : ℂ | w.im ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ)} →
      (∀ w : ℂ, w.im ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ) → 0 ≤ g w) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ),
        g (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =

      (∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ),

    intro g z₀ Δ B hΔ hB_nn hg_cont hg_nn hg_per hg_row
    let x_star : ℝ := z₀.re - Δ
    let m : ℕ := Nat.floor (Δ / Real.pi) + 1

    let I_x : Set ℝ := Set.Icc x_star (x_star + (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))

      have him : |w.im - z₀.im| < Δ :=

    have h_cont_P : ContinuousOn h P := by

      intro p hp

      have hx_le : x_star ≤ x_star + (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by

        linarith
      have h_eq_int : (∫ x in I_x, h (x, y)) =

    exact le_trans h_mono_set (by

  have h_s3 : ∀ (D : Set ℂ) (K_pos M : ℝ),
      MeasurableSet D →
      ContinuousOn f D →
      0 ≤ K_pos →
      0 ≤ M →
      (∀ w ∈ D, ‖f w‖ ≤ Real.exp K_pos) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖) D MeasureTheory.volume →
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (∫⁻ w in D,
          ENNReal.ofReal
            ((K_pos + 1) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) ^ 2))) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal M) →
      (∫ w in D, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤ M := by
    intro D K_pos M hD hf_cont hK_nn hM_nn hf_bdd hInt hReg
    have h_def_nn : ∀ w ∈ D, 0 ≤ K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖ := by
      intro w hw
      by_cases hfw : f w = 0
      · simp [hfw, hK_nn]
      · have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖f w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfw
        have hlog_le : Real.log ‖f w‖ ≤ K_pos := by
          have := Real.log_le_log hnorm_pos (hf_bdd w hw)
          rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
        linarith
    have h_eq_lint :
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ w in D, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) =
          ∫⁻ w in D, ENNReal.ofReal (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖) :=
      MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hInt
        (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hD h_def_nn)
    let ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
    have hε_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ε_seq n := fun n => by dsimp [ε_seq]; positivity
    let g_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ := fun n w =>
      (K_pos + 1) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2)
    let G_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ENNReal := fun n w => ENNReal.ofReal (g_seq n w)
    have hG_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, AEMeasurable (G_seq n) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict D) := by
      intro n
      have h_arg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2) D :=
        ((continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hf_cont).pow 2).add continuousOn_const
      have h_gn_cont : ContinuousOn (g_seq n) D :=
        continuousOn_const.sub
          (continuousOn_const.mul
            (h_arg_cont.log (fun w _ => by have := hε_pos n; positivity)))
      exact (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn h_gn_cont).aemeasurable hD
    have hG_mono : ∀ w : ℂ, Monotone (fun n => G_seq n w) := by
      intro w m n hmn
      have hm_pos : 0 < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hmn_cast : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hmn 1
      have hε_le : ε_seq n ≤ ε_seq m := inv_anti₀ hm_pos hmn_cast
      have hsq_le : (ε_seq n) ^ 2 ≤ (ε_seq m) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (hε_pos n).le hε_le 2
      have hlog_le : Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2) ≤
          Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq m) ^ 2) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by have := hε_pos n; positivity) (by linarith)
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by dsimp [g_seq]; linarith)
    have h_dom : ∀ w : ℂ, ENNReal.ofReal (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖) ≤ ⨆ n : ℕ, G_seq n w := by
      intro w
      by_cases hfw : f w = 0
      · refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup (fun n => G_seq n w) 0)
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        simp [g_seq, ε_seq, hfw]
      · have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖f w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfw
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖f w‖⁻¹
        have hn1 : ‖f w‖⁻¹ < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
        have hε_le_norm : ε_seq n ≤ ‖f w‖ := by
          have h1 := inv_anti₀ (inv_pos.mpr hnorm_pos) hn1.le
          rwa [inv_inv] at h1
        have hsq_le : (ε_seq n) ^ 2 ≤ ‖f w‖ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (hε_pos n).le hε_le_norm 2
        have h2_le_exp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
          have := Real.add_one_le_exp 2
          linarith
        have h_sum_le : ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp 2 * ‖f w‖ ^ 2 := by
          calc ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖f w‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
            _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * ‖f w‖ ^ 2 :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2_le_exp2 (sq_nonneg _)
        have hlog_bound : Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2) ≤ 2 + 2 * Real.log ‖f w‖ := by
          calc Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (ε_seq n) ^ 2)
              ≤ Real.log (Real.exp 2 * ‖f w‖ ^ 2) :=
                Real.log_le_log (by have := hε_pos n; positivity) h_sum_le
            _ = Real.log (Real.exp 2) + Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2) :=
                Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos 2).ne' (sq_pos_of_pos hnorm_pos).ne'
            _ = 2 + 2 * Real.log ‖f w‖ := by rw [Real.log_exp, Real.log_pow]; ring
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup (fun k => G_seq k w) n)
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        dsimp [g_seq]
        linarith
    have h_ennr :
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ w in D, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M := by
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ w in D, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖))
          = ∫⁻ w in D, ENNReal.ofReal (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖) := h_eq_lint
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ w in D, ⨆ n : ℕ, G_seq n w := MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono h_dom
        _ = ⨆ n : ℕ, ∫⁻ w in D, G_seq n w :=
            MeasureTheory.lintegral_iSup' hG_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hG_mono)
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M := iSup_le hReg
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hM_nn).mp h_ennr

    dsimp [s_ext, Y_ext]
    split_ifs with hw_nn
    · have h1 : 0 < w_top.im + δ_U / 2 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_pos h1, ← abs_of_nonneg hw_nn, hw_top_im_abs]
    · push Not at hw_nn
      have h1 : w_top.im + -(δ_U / 2) < 0 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_neg h1]
      have h2 : -(w_top.im + -(δ_U / 2)) = -w_top.im + δ_U / 2 := by ring
      rw [h2, ← abs_of_neg hw_nn, hw_top_im_abs]
  have hStrip_ext : horizStrip Y_ext ⊆ U := by
    intro s hs
    change |s.im| < Y_ext at hs
    exact hPer.slab_mem w_ext hw_ext_mem s (by linarith [hw_ext_im_abs])
  have hy_lt_Yext : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ), |y| < Y_ext := by
    intro y hy
    have hy_abs : |y| ≤ |z₀.im| + Δ := by
      have hdiff : |y - z₀.im| ≤ Δ := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hy.1], by linarith [hy.2]⟩
      calc |y| = |(y - z₀.im) + z₀.im| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |y - z₀.im| + |z₀.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |z₀.im| + Δ := by linarith
    dsimp [Y_ext]
    linarith
  
  let K_pos : ℝ := max K 0
  have hK_pos_nn : 0 ≤ K_pos := le_max_right K 0
  have h_closedBall_bdd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K_pos := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have him : |z.im - z₀.im| ≤ Δ :=
      le_trans (by simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - z₀)) hz
    rw [abs_le] at him
    have hz_eq : ((z.re : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) = z := Complex.re_add_im z
    have h1 := hBand z.re z.im ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [hz_eq] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_max_left K 0))
  obtain ⟨hInt_ball, hDisk_q⟩ :=
    hDisk U f q hPer.isOpen_U hPer.f_holo hPer.q_holo hPer.deriv2_f hPer.f_simple_zeros
      z₀ Δ K_pos hΔ hSub h_closedBall_bdd
  have hz₀_mem_q : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4) := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  have hq_disk := hDisk_q z₀ hz₀_mem_q
  
  let B_row : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (K_pos + 1 + C_0)
  have hB_row_nn : 0 ≤ B_row := by dsimp [B_row]; positivity
  let M_tot : ℝ := 2 * Δ * (Δ + 1) * B_row
  have hM_tot_nn : 0 ≤ M_tot := by dsimp [M_tot]; positivity
  have h_reg_all : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∫⁻ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ,
        ENNReal.ofReal
          ((K_pos + 1) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + (((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) ^ 2))) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal M_tot := by
    intro n
    let ε_n : ℝ := ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
    have hε_n_pos : 0 < ε_n := by dsimp [ε_n]; positivity
    have hε_n_le_one : ε_n ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [ε_n]
      have hn_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by linarith)
    let g_n : ℂ → ℝ := fun w =>
      (K_pos + 1) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2)
    let W_band : Set ℂ := {w : ℂ | w.im ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ)}
    have hW_sub_U : W_band ⊆ U := fun w hw => hStrip_ext (hy_lt_Yext w.im hw)
    have hgn_cont : ContinuousOn g_n W_band := by
      have hf_W : ContinuousOn f W_band := hPer.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hW_sub_U
      have harg : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) W_band :=
        ((continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hf_W).pow 2).add continuousOn_const
      exact continuousOn_const.sub
        (continuousOn_const.mul (harg.log (fun _ _ => by positivity)))
    have hgn_nn : ∀ w ∈ W_band, 0 ≤ g_n w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_eq : ((w.re : ℂ) + (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) = w := Complex.re_add_im w
      have hfw : ‖f w‖ ≤ Real.exp K_pos := by
        have h1 := hBand w.re w.im hw
        rw [hw_eq] at h1
        exact le_trans h1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_max_left K 0))
      have hfw_sq : ‖f w‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * K_pos) := by
        calc ‖f w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp K_pos) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hfw 2
          _ = Real.exp K_pos * Real.exp K_pos := sq _
          _ = Real.exp (K_pos + K_pos) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
          _ = Real.exp (2 * K_pos) := by ring_nf
      have hε_sq : ε_n ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * K_pos) := by
        have h1 : ε_n ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
        have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (2 * K_pos) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_zero]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h2_le_e2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp 2
        linarith
      have hsum_le : ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * (K_pos + 1)) := by
        calc ‖f w‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * K_pos) := by linarith
          _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (2 * K_pos) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2_le_e2 (by positivity)
          _ = Real.exp (2 + 2 * K_pos) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
          _ = Real.exp (2 * (K_pos + 1)) := by ring_nf
      have hlog_le : Real.log (‖f w‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) ≤ 2 * (K_pos + 1) := by
        have := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hsum_le
        rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
      dsimp [g_n]
      linarith
    have hgn_per : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ),
        g_n (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          g_n ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro x y hy
      set s : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hs_U : s ∈ U := hW_sub_U (by simpa [W_band, s] using hy)
      have h_shift : (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) = s + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [s]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_shift]
      dsimp [g_n]
      rw [hPer.f_periodic s hs_U]
    have hgn_row : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ),
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_n ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤ B_row := by
      intro y hy
      have hI0_le_reg0 :
          I_0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) := by
        have h_reg0_int :
            IntervalIntegrable
              (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2))
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
          have h_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2)) :=
            continuous_const.mul
              (Continuous.log (((continuous_norm.comp hf_real_cont).pow 2).add continuous_const)
                (fun x => by
                  have hpos_sq : 0 < ε_n ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hε_n_pos
                  have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
                  linarith))
          exact h_c.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by positivity) hlog_real_int h_reg0_int ?_
        intro x _
        have hpos : 0 < ‖f (x : ℂ)‖ := hf_real_norm_pos x
        have h_eq : Real.log ‖f (x : ℂ)‖ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [Real.log_pow]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        have h1 : Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2) ≤ Real.log (‖f (x : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) :=
          Real.log_le_log (sq_pos_of_pos hpos) (by linarith [sq_nonneg ε_n])
        linarith
      have h_row_lower :
          -2 * Real.pi * C_0 ≤
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) :=
        le_trans hI_0_lower
          (le_trans hI0_le_reg0 (h_s1 Y_ext ε_n y hY_ext_pos hStrip_ext hε_n_pos (hy_lt_Yext y hy)))
      have h_regy_cont :
          Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2)) := by
        have hf_y : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          hPer.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop)
            (fun x => hW_sub_U (by
              change (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im) ∈ Set.Icc (z₀.im - Δ) (z₀.im + Δ)
              have him : ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y := by simp
              rw [him]
              exact hy))
        exact continuous_const.mul
          (Continuous.log (((continuous_norm.comp hf_y).pow 2).add continuous_const)
            (fun x => by
              have hpos_sq : 0 < ε_n ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hε_n_pos
              have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
              linarith))
      have h_split :
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_n ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
            (∫ _x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K_pos + 1)) -
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 + ε_n ^ 2) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const
          (h_regy_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      rw [h_split, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
      dsimp [B_row]
      linarith
    exact h_s2 g_n z₀ Δ B_row hΔ hB_row_nn hgn_cont hgn_nn hgn_per hgn_row
  
  have h_ball_sub_U : Metric.ball z₀ Δ ⊆ U :=
    Set.Subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hSub
  have h_int_bound :
      (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤ M_tot :=
    h_s3 (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) K_pos M_tot measurableSet_ball
      (hPer.f_holo.continuousOn.mono h_ball_sub_U) hK_pos_nn hM_tot_nn
      (fun w hw => h_closedBall_bdd w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw))
      hInt_ball h_reg_all
  have h_avg_bound :
      (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤
        4 * (2 + C_0) * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) := by
    have h1 : (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤
        (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * M_tot :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_bound (by positivity)
    have h2 : (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * M_tot = 4 * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (K_pos + 1 + C_0) := by
      dsimp [M_tot, B_row]
      have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_pos.ne'
      have hΔ_ne : Δ ≠ 0 := hΔ.ne'
      field_simp [hpi_ne, hΔ_ne]
      ring
    have h3 : K_pos + 1 + C_0 ≤ (2 + C_0) * (1 + K_pos) := by
      nlinarith [hK_pos_nn, hC_0_nn]
    rw [h2] at h1
    calc (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖))
        ≤ 4 * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (K_pos + 1 + C_0) := h1
      _ ≤ 4 * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * ((2 + C_0) * (1 + K_pos)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * (2 + C_0) * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) := by ring
  have h_one_le_prod : 1 ≤ (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) := by
    have hΔ_inv_pos : 0 < Δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hΔ
    nlinarith [hK_pos_nn]
  have h_Δ_q : Δ * Real.sqrt ‖q z₀‖ ≤ C_strip * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) := by
    have h_inner :
        1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖)) ≤
          (1 + 4 * (2 + C_0)) * ((1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos)) := by
      calc 1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖))
          ≤ (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) + 4 * (2 + C_0) * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) :=
            add_le_add h_one_le_prod h_avg_bound
        _ = (1 + 4 * (2 + C_0)) * ((1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos)) := by ring
    calc Δ * Real.sqrt ‖q z₀‖
        ≤ C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K_pos - Real.log ‖f w‖))) :=
          hq_disk
      _ ≤ C_def * ((1 + 4 * (2 + C_0)) * ((1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inner hC_def_pos.le
      _ = C_strip * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos) := by dsimp [C_strip]; ring
  have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Δ_q (inv_pos.mpr hΔ).le
  have h_lhs : Δ⁻¹ * (Δ * Real.sqrt ‖q z₀‖) = Real.sqrt ‖q z₀‖ := by
    field_simp [hΔ.ne']
  rw [h_lhs] at h_mul
  calc Real.sqrt ‖q z₀‖
      ≤ Δ⁻¹ * (C_strip * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + K_pos)) := h_mul
    _ = C_strip * Δ⁻¹ * (1 + Δ⁻¹) * (1 + max K 0) := by dsimp [K_pos]; ring

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (c₁ C₁ : ℝ),
      (∀ y : ℝ, ρ (-y) = ρ y) →
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ ρ →
      0 < c₁ →
      (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → c₁ * y - C₁ ≤ ρ y) →
      EntireScalePackage ρ) ∧
    (∀ (H : ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ),
      0 < H →
      (∀ y : ℝ, |y| < H → ρ (-y) = ρ y) →
      ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioo (-H) H) ρ →
      (∀ P K₀ : ℝ, 1 < P →
        ∃ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k ∧ Real.exp (-k) < H ∧ P * k < ρ (H - Real.exp (-k))) →
      FiniteWallScalePackage H ρ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_rising_sun :
      ∀ (R_b R : ℝ) (μ : ℝ → ℝ),
        R_b + 3 ≤ R →
        MonotoneOn μ (Set.Icc R_b R) →
        ∃ v : ℝ,
          R_b + (R - R_b) / 3 ≤ v ∧
          v ≤ R_b + 2 * (R - R_b) / 3 ∧
          ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc R_b R,
            |μ z - μ v| ≤
              ((12 * (μ R - μ R_b) + 6) / (R - R_b)) * |z - v| +
                (12 * (μ R - μ R_b) + 6) / (R - R_b) := by
    have h_right_shadow : ∀ (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
        0 < η →
        (∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → j ≤ N → a i ≤ a j) →
        ∀ d m : ℕ, m ≤ N → N - m = d →
          η * (((Finset.Icc m N).filter
            (fun i : ℕ => ∃ k : ℕ, i + 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ N ∧
              η * ((k : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) < a k - a i)).card : ℝ) ≤
            a N - a m := by
      intro N η a hη ha d
      induction d using Nat.strongRecOn with
      | ind d ih =>
        intro m hmN hdm
        let P : ℕ → Prop := fun i : ℕ =>
          ∃ k : ℕ, i + 1 ≤ k ∧ k ≤ N ∧ η * ((k : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)) < a k - a i
        change η * (((Finset.Icc m N).filter P).card : ℝ) ≤ a N - a m
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hmN with rfl | hm_lt
        · have h_empty : (Finset.Icc m m).filter P = ∅ := by
            ext i
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, k, hk1, hk2, _⟩
              omega
            · simp
          rw [h_empty]
          simp
        · by_cases hmP : P m
          · obtain ⟨k, hmk, hkN, hslope⟩ := hmP
            have h_sub :
                (Finset.Icc m N).filter P ⊆ Finset.Ico m k ∪ (Finset.Icc k N).filter P := by
              intro i hi
              simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_union,
                Finset.mem_Ico] at hi ⊢
              by_cases hik : i < k
              · exact Or.inl ⟨hi.1.1, hik⟩
              · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨by omega, hi.1.2⟩, hi.2⟩
            have h_card_nat :
                ((Finset.Icc m N).filter P).card ≤
                  (k - m) + ((Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card := by
              calc ((Finset.Icc m N).filter P).card
                  ≤ (Finset.Ico m k ∪ (Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card :=
                    Finset.card_le_card h_sub
                _ ≤ (Finset.Ico m k).card + ((Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card :=
                    Finset.card_union_le _ _
                _ = (k - m) + ((Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card := by rw [Nat.card_Ico]
            have h_card_real :
                (((Finset.Icc m N).filter P).card : ℝ) ≤
                  ((k : ℝ) - (m : ℝ)) + (((Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card : ℝ) := by
              have h1 : (((Finset.Icc m N).filter P).card : ℝ) ≤
                  (((k - m) + ((Finset.Icc k N).filter P).card : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
                Nat.cast_le.mpr h_card_nat
              rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : m ≤ k)] at h1
              exact h1
            have h_ih := ih (N - k) (by omega) k hkN rfl
            have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_card_real hη.le
            linarith
          · have h_eq : (Finset.Icc m N).filter P = (Finset.Icc (m + 1) N).filter P := by
              ext i
              simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
              constructor
              · rintro ⟨⟨hmi, hiN⟩, hiP⟩
                rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hmi with rfl | hlt
                · exact absurd hiP hmP
                · exact ⟨⟨by omega, hiN⟩, hiP⟩
              · rintro ⟨⟨hmi, hiN⟩, hiP⟩
                exact ⟨⟨by omega, hiN⟩, hiP⟩
            rw [h_eq]
            have h_ih := ih (N - (m + 1)) (by omega) (m + 1) (by omega) rfl
            have ha_step : a m ≤ a (m + 1) := ha m (m + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
            linarith
    have h_left_shadow : ∀ (N : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
        0 < η →
        (∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → j ≤ N → a i ≤ a j) →
        η * (((Finset.Icc 0 N).filter
          (fun i : ℕ => ∃ k : ℕ, k + 1 ≤ i ∧
            η * ((i : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) < a i - a k)).card : ℝ) ≤
          a N - a 0 := by
      intro N η a hη ha
      let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun u => -a (N - u)
      have hb_mono : ∀ u w : ℕ, u ≤ w → w ≤ N → b u ≤ b w := by
        intro u w huw hwN
        dsimp [b]
        have := ha (N - w) (N - u) (by omega) (by omega)
        linarith
      let S_left := (Finset.Icc 0 N).filter
        (fun i : ℕ => ∃ k : ℕ, k + 1 ≤ i ∧ η * ((i : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) < a i - a k)

  have h_convex_inv :

        have hb : 0 ≤ b := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity)

          field_simp [hy₂_pos.ne']
          ring

          dsimp [a, b]
          field_simp [hy₂_pos.ne']

        rw [hcomb, hρ_even y₂ hy₂] at hineq
        refine ⟨hy₁_mem, ?_⟩

          _ = ρ y₂ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
    let D_plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => derivWithin ρ (Set.Ioi y) y
    let s₀ : ℝ := (ρ h_b - ρ 0) / h_b

    have hD_mono : MonotoneOn D_plus U_symm := by

      have hyk_mem : y_k ∈ Set.Ioo (-H) H := ⟨by linarith, hyk_lt_H⟩
      obtain ⟨_, hyk_inv⟩ := hSys.h_left_inv y_k hyk_mem hyk_ge_b
      let R₁ : ℝ := ρ y_k
      have hPk_lt_R₁ : P * k < R₁ := hρ_k
      have hk_lt_Pk : k < P * k := by nlinarith
      have hR₁_ge_star : R_star ≤ R₁ := by linarith
      have h_wd := h_wall_decay R₁ hR₁_ge_star
      dsimp [R₁] at h_wd
      rw [hyk_inv] at h_wd
      have h_sub_eq : H - y_k = Real.exp (-k) := by dsimp [y_k]; ring
      rw [h_sub_eq] at h_wd
      have hexp_lt : C₀ * Real.exp (-c * (ρ y_k)) < Real.exp (Real.log C₀ - (2 + c) * k) := by
        have h1 : -c * (ρ y_k) < -c * (P * k) := by nlinarith
        have h2 : -c * (P * k) = -(2 + c) * k := by
          dsimp [P]
          field_simp [hc_pos.ne']
        rw [h2] at h1
        calc C₀ * Real.exp (-c * (ρ y_k))
            < C₀ * Real.exp (-(2 + c) * k) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h1) hC₀_pos
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log C₀) * Real.exp (-(2 + c) * k) := by rw [Real.exp_log hC₀_pos]
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log C₀ + -(2 + c) * k) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log C₀ - (2 + c) * k) := by ring_nf
      have h_exp_k := lt_of_le_of_lt h_wd hexp_lt
      have h_lin_k : -k < Real.log C₀ - (2 + c) * k := Real.exp_lt_exp.mp h_exp_k
      have h_log_le : Real.log C₀ ≤ |Real.log C₀| := le_abs_self _
      have hck_pos : 0 < c * k := mul_pos hc_pos hk_pos
      linarith
    obtain ⟨R_seq, v_seq, hvR_n1, _, h_basic, hv_top, h_prod_top,
      h_log_zero, h_fwd_gap, h_loc_lin, N₁_up, h_coarse_up⟩ :=
      h_extract_scales (Set.Ioo (-H) H) ρ h_b h μ hSys hR_ex
    let h_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => h (v_seq n)
    let ℓ_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-μ (v_seq n))
    let m_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (v_seq n)
    have hh_lt_H : ∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n < H := fun n => (h_basic n).2.2.1.2
    have hh_tendsto_H : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds H) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      let δ_ε : ℝ := min (ε / 2) δ_b
      have hδ_ε_pos : 0 < δ_ε := lt_min (by positivity) hδb_pos
      have hδ_ε_le_δb : δ_ε ≤ δ_b := min_le_right _ _
      have hδ_ε_lt_ε : δ_ε < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      let y_ε : ℝ := H - δ_ε
      have hy_ε_ge_b : h_b ≤ y_ε := by dsimp [y_ε, δ_b] at hδ_ε_le_δb ⊢; linarith
      have hy_ε_lt_H : y_ε < H := by dsimp [y_ε]; linarith
      have hy_ε_mem : y_ε ∈ Set.Ioo (-H) H := ⟨by linarith, hy_ε_lt_H⟩
      obtain ⟨hρ_yε_ge_b, hy_ε_inv⟩ := hSys.h_left_inv y_ε hy_ε_mem hy_ε_ge_b
      have hv_seq_top : Filter.Tendsto v_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        hv_top.congr fun n => (h_basic n).2.2.2.1
      have hev := hv_seq_top.eventually_ge_atTop (ρ y_ε + 1)
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := hev
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hv_gt : ρ y_ε < v_seq n := by linarith [hN₀ n hn]
      have hv_ge_b : ρ h_b ≤ v_seq n := le_trans hρ_yε_ge_b hv_gt.le
      have hy_lt_hn : y_ε < h_seq n := by
        calc y_ε = h (ρ y_ε) := hy_ε_inv.symm
          _ < h (v_seq n) := hSys.h_strictMono hρ_yε_ge_b hv_ge_b hv_gt
      have hhn_lt_H : h_seq n < H := hh_lt_H n
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hhn_lt_H)]
      dsimp [y_ε] at hy_lt_hn
      linarith
    have hℓ_tendsto_zero : Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (h_inv_succ_zero H) ε hε
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨_, hh_pos, _, _, _, hℓ_pos, _, hℓ_sec, _, _⟩ := h_basic n
      have hvn1 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ v_seq n - ρ h_b := (hvR_n1 n).2
      have hv_sub_ge : (n : ℝ) + 1 < v_seq n - ρ 0 := by linarith
      have hn1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hℓ_le : ℓ_seq n ≤ H / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        calc ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n / (v_seq n - ρ 0) := hℓ_sec
          _ ≤ H / (v_seq n - ρ 0) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hh_lt_H n).le (by linarith)
          _ ≤ H / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hH_pos.le hn1_pos hv_sub_ge.le
      have h_target := hN₀ n hn
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (div_pos hH_pos hn1_pos)] at h_target
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hℓ_le h_target
    have h_wall_gap_top :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop]
      intro B
      let M : ℝ := max B 1
      have hM_pos : 0 < M := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_fwd_gap M hM_pos
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have h_lt_hR := hN₀ n hn
      have hhR_lt_H : h (R_seq n) < H := (hSys.h_mem_and_inv (R_seq n) (hvR_n1 n).1).2.1.2
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.2.1
      have hM_le : M ≤ (H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n := (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM_le
    have h_coarse_fin : ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ y : ℝ,
        ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - y → h_seq n - y ≤ δ_b →
        0 < y ∧ y < H ∧
        Real.exp (ρ y) ≤ 4 * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - y)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      obtain ⟨N_h, hN_h⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hh_tendsto_H δ_b hδb_pos
      refine ⟨max N₁_up N_h, fun n hn y hy_lo hy_hi => ?_⟩
      have hn_up : N₁_up ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn_h : N_h ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have h_dist := hN_h n hn_h
      have hhn_lt_H : h_seq n < H := hh_lt_H n
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hhn_lt_H)] at h_dist
      have hy_gt_b : h_b < y := by dsimp [δ_b] at h_dist hy_hi; linarith
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_seq n := (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.2.1
      have hy_lt_H : y < H := by linarith
      exact ⟨lt_trans hb_pos hy_gt_b, hy_lt_H, h_coarse_up n hn_up y hy_gt_b hy_lo⟩
    exact ⟨δ_b, 4, h_seq, ℓ_seq, m_seq, hδb_pos, hδb_lt_half, by norm_num,
      fun n => ⟨(h_basic n).2.1, hh_lt_H n, (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.2.1,
        (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
        (h_basic n).2.2.2.2.1⟩,
      hh_tendsto_H, hℓ_tendsto_zero, hv_top, h_prod_top, h_wall_gap_top, h_log_zero,
      fun M_u η hM_u hη => by
        obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_loc_lin M_u η hM_u hη
        refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn u hu => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨h_pos_u, h_mem_u, h_rho_u⟩ := hN₀ n hn u hu
        exact ⟨by rw [abs_of_pos h_pos_u]; exact h_mem_u.2, h_rho_u⟩,
      h_coarse_fin⟩

convex_growth_profile_scales.definitions:
structure CgpsInverseChordData (U_symm : Set ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (h_b : ℝ) (h μ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  hb_pos : 0 < h_b
  hb_mem : h_b ∈ U_symm
  Rb_ge_one : 1 ≤ ρ h_b
  Rb_gt_zero_val : ρ 0 < ρ h_b
  ρ_mono_nonneg : ∀ y₁ y₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ y₁ → y₁ ≤ y₂ → y₂ ∈ U_symm → y₁ ∈ U_symm ∧ ρ y₁ ≤ ρ y₂
  ρ_bdd_on_Icc : ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → B ∈ U_symm → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 B, ρ y ≤ M
  h_mem_and_inv : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → h_b ≤ h z ∧ h z ∈ U_symm ∧ ρ (h z) = z
  h_strictMono : StrictMonoOn h (Set.Ici (ρ h_b))
  h_left_inv : ∀ y ∈ U_symm, h_b ≤ y → ρ h_b ≤ ρ y ∧ h (ρ y) = y
  μ_mono : MonotoneOn μ (Set.Ici (ρ h_b))
  exp_μ_ge_secant : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → (z - ρ 0) / h z ≤ Real.exp (μ z)
  exp_μ_ge_base : ∀ z : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z → (ρ h_b - ρ 0) / h_b ≤ Real.exp (μ z)
  chord_bounds : ∀ z₁ z₂ : ℝ, ρ h_b ≤ z₁ → z₁ < z₂ →
    Real.exp (-μ z₂) * (z₂ - z₁) ≤ h z₂ - h z₁ ∧
    h z₂ - h z₁ ≤ Real.exp (-μ z₁) * (z₂ - z₁)
  exp_decay_height : ∀ c R_star : ℝ, 0 < c → ρ h_b ≤ R_star →
    (∀ z : ℝ, R_star ≤ z → c * z ≤ μ z) →
    ∀ R₁ R₂ : ℝ, R_star ≤ R₁ → R₁ ≤ R₂ →
      h R₂ - h R₁ ≤ Real.exp (-c * R₁) / (1 - Real.exp (-c))

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (U : Set ℂ) (s_star : ℝ) (f q : ℂ → ℂ),
      PeriodicShapeField U s_star f q →
      (∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U →
        (∃ x_max ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ‖f ((x_max : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = Real.exp (rowLogSup f y)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, ‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp (rowLogSup f y))) ∧
      (U = Set.univ →
        (∀ y : ℝ, rowLogSup f (-y) = rowLogSup f y) ∧
        ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (rowLogSup f)) ∧
      (∀ H : ℝ, 0 < H → U = horizStrip H →
        (∀ y : ℝ, |y| < H → rowLogSup f (-y) = rowLogSup f y) ∧
        ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioo (-H) H) (rowLogSup f))) ∧
    (∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      Differentiable ℂ f →
      (∀ s : ℂ, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0) →
      (∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ c₁ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < c₁ ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → c₁ * y - C₁ ≤ rowLogSup f y) ∧
    (∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
      IsOpen U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ 0 < m_seq n) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U ∧
        ‖f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ = m_seq n) →
      (∀ M_u η : ℝ, 0 < M_u → 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Z : ℂ, ‖Z‖ ≤ M_u →
        (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ U ∧
        ‖f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z)‖ ≤
          m_seq n * Real.exp (Z.im + η)) →
      ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (c₀ : ℂ),
        StrictMono σ ∧ c₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformly
          (fun k Z =>
            ((m_seq (σ k))⁻¹ : ℂ) *
              f ((x_seq (σ k) : ℂ) + (h_seq (σ k) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (ℓ_seq (σ k) : ℂ) * Z))
          (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z))
          Filter.atTop)

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro U s_star f q hPer
    have h_slab_im : ∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U → ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ |y| → z ∈ U := by
      intro y hy z hz
      refine hPer.slab_mem ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) hy z ?_
      simpa using hz
    have h_row_mem : ∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U := by
      intro y hy x
      apply h_slab_im y hy
      simp
    have h_thick : ∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U →
        ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ |y| + δ → z ∈ U := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hPer.isOpen_U ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) hy
      refine ⟨r / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      let y' : ℝ := if 0 ≤ y then y + r / 2 else y - r / 2
      have hy'_dist : dist ((y' : ℂ) * Complex.I) ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I) < r := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        have hsub : (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I =
            ((y' - y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have habs : |y' - y| = r / 2 := by
          dsimp [y']
          split_ifs with h0
          · rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
          · rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
        linarith
      have hy'_mem : (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U := hr_sub hy'_dist
      have hy'_abs : |y'| = |y| + r / 2 := by
        dsimp [y']
        split_ifs with h0
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), abs_of_nonneg h0]
        · have hy_neg : y < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h0
          rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith), abs_of_neg hy_neg]
          ring
      exact h_slab_im y' hy'_mem z (by linarith)
    have h_period_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ U →
        f (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = f s := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro s _
        simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro s hs
        have hs_n : s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ U :=
          hPer.slab_mem s hs _ (by simp)
        have h_step : s + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_step, hPer.f_periodic _ hs_n, ih s hs]
    have h_period_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ U →
        f (s + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = f s := by
      intro k s hs
      rcases k with n | n
      · simpa using h_period_nat n s hs
      · set s' : ℂ := s + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        have hs' : s' ∈ U := hPer.slab_mem s hs s' (by simp [s'])
        have h_back : s' + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = s := by
          simp only [s', Int.cast_negSucc]
          push_cast
          ring
        have h1 := h_period_nat (n + 1) s' hs'
        rw [h_back] at h1
        exact h1.symm
    have h_mod_2pi : ∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ U → ∀ x : ℝ,
        ∃ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) = f ((x₀ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro y hy x
      have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      let k : ℤ := ⌊x / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
      let x₀ : ℝ := x - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
      have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ x / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
      have hk_lt : x / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hx₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ x₀ := by
        have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_le
        linarith
      have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
        have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_lt
        linarith

      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      calc ‖I_nat k‖ * Real.exp (c₁ * y)
          ≤ ((M_y * Real.exp (-c₁ * y)) * (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.exp (c₁ * y) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_norm_int (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = M_y * (2 * Real.pi) * (Real.exp (-c₁ * y) * Real.exp (c₁ * y)) := by ring
        _ = M_y * (2 * Real.pi) * Real.exp (-c₁ * y + c₁ * y) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ = M_y * (2 * Real.pi) := by simp
    have h_lhs_pos : 0 < (‖I_nat k‖ / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.exp (c₁ * y) := by positivity
    have h_log := Real.log_le_log h_lhs_pos h_My_lower
    rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp] at h_log
    unfold rowLogSup
    change c₁ * y - C₁ ≤ Real.log M_y
    dsimp [C₁]
    linarith
  · intro U f x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq hU_open hf_holo h_pos h_anchor h_bound
    let ψ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n Z =>
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z
    let F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n Z => ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) * f (ψ n Z)
    let K_ball : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun r => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 1)
    have hF_norm_le : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Z : ℂ) (η : ℝ),
        ‖f (ψ n Z)‖ ≤ m_seq n * Real.exp (Z.im + η) →
        ‖F n Z‖ ≤ Real.exp (Z.im + η) := by
      intro n Z η hle
      have hm : 0 < m_seq n := (h_pos n).2
      dsimp [F]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hm.le]
      calc (m_seq n)⁻¹ * ‖f (ψ n Z)‖
          ≤ (m_seq n)⁻¹ * (m_seq n * Real.exp (Z.im + η)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le)
        _ = Real.exp (Z.im + η) := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hm.ne' _
    have h_subseq_step : ∀ (r : ℕ) (τ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono τ →
        ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
          ∃ f_r : ℂ → ℂ,
            TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => F (τ (φ k)) Z) f_r Filter.atTop (K_ball r) := by
      intro r τ hτ
      have : CompactSpace (K_ball r) :=
        isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 1))
      obtain ⟨N_r, hN_r⟩ := h_bound ((r : ℝ) + 4) 1 (by positivity) zero_lt_one
      let B_r : ℝ := Real.exp ((r : ℝ) + 5)
      have hB_r_pos : 0 < B_r := Real.exp_pos _
      let W_r : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 7 / 2)
      have h_W_sub : W_r ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 4) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      have hF_diff_W : ∀ n ≥ N_r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) W_r := by
        intro n hn
        have hψ_maps : Set.MapsTo (ψ n) W_r U :=
          fun z hz => (hN_r n hn z (by simpa using h_W_sub hz)).1
        exact (hf_holo.comp (by dsimp [ψ]; fun_prop) hψ_maps).const_mul _
      have hF_bound_cb : ∀ n ≥ N_r, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ (r : ℝ) + 4 → ‖F n z‖ ≤ B_r := by
        intro n hn z hz
        have h1 := hF_norm_le n z 1 (hN_r n hn z hz).2
        have him : z.im ≤ (r : ℝ) + 4 := le_trans (Complex.im_le_norm z) hz
        exact le_trans h1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith))
      have hF_lip : ∀ n ≥ N_r, ∀ x ∈ K_ball r, ∀ y ∈ K_ball r,
          ‖F n y - F n x‖ ≤ B_r * ‖y - x‖ := by
        intro n hn x hx y hy
        let V_r : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 2)
        have hV_sub_W : V_r ⊆ W_r := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
        have hF_diffAt : ∀ c ∈ V_r, DifferentiableAt ℂ (F n) c :=
          fun c hc => ((hF_diff_W n hn) c (hV_sub_W hc)).differentiableAt
            (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hV_sub_W hc))
        have hF_deriv_le : ∀ c ∈ V_r, ‖deriv (F n) c‖ ≤ B_r := by
          intro c hc
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hc
          have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall c 1 ⊆ W_r := by
            intro z hz
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
            have hnorm : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖c‖ + ‖z - c‖ := norm_le_insert' z c
            linarith
          have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) (Metric.ball c 1) :=
            ((hF_diff_W n hn).mono
              (Subset.trans Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall h_cb_sub)).diffContOnCl
          have h_sph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c 1, ‖F n z‖ ≤ B_r := by
            intro z hz
            have hz_cb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall c 1 := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz
            have hz_4 : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 4) := h_W_sub (h_cb_sub hz_cb)
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz_4
            exact hF_bound_cb n hn z hz_4
          have h_est :=
            Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le zero_lt_one h_dc h_sph
          rwa [div_one] at h_est
        have hK_sub_V : K_ball r ⊆ V_r := by
          intro z hz
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          linarith
        exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hF_diffAt hF_deriv_le
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) ((r : ℝ) + 2)) (hK_sub_V hx) (hK_sub_V hy)
      have hK_sub_W : K_ball r ⊆ W_r := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      let g_r : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ := fun n =>
        if hn : N_r ≤ n then
          BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact
            ⟨fun z : K_ball r => F n z.1,
              ((hF_diff_W n hn).continuousOn.mono hK_sub_W).domRestrict⟩
        else 0
      have hg_r_val_le : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : K_ball r),
          g_r n z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) B_r := by
        intro n z
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        dsimp [g_r]
        split_ifs with hn
        · simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_apply]
          have hz4 : ‖z.1‖ ≤ (r : ℝ) + 4 := by
            have hz1 := z.2
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz1
            linarith
          exact hF_bound_cb n hn z.1 hz4
        · simp [hB_r_pos.le]
      have hg_r_lip : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x y : K_ball r),
          dist (g_r n x) (g_r n y) ≤ B_r * dist x y := by
        intro n x y
        dsimp [g_r]
        split_ifs with hn
        · simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_apply,
            Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
          exact hF_lip n hn y.1 y.2 x.1 x.2
        · simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, dist_self]
          positivity
      let A : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ) := Set.range g_r
      have hA_val : ∀ (g : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ) (x : K_ball r),
          g ∈ A → g x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) B_r := by
        rintro _ x ⟨n, rfl⟩
        exact hg_r_val_le n x
      have hA_lip : ∀ g : A,
          LipschitzWith B_r.toNNReal
            (fun x : K_ball r => (g : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ) x) := by
        rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩
        exact LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' (fun x y => hg_r_lip n x y)
      have hA_equi : Equicontinuous
          (fun g : A => (⇑(g : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ) : K_ball r → ℂ)) :=
        UniformEquicontinuous.equicontinuous
          (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous
            (fun g : A => (⇑(g : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ball r) ℂ) : K_ball r → ℂ))
            B_r.toNNReal hA_lip)
      have h_comp_cl : IsCompact (closure A) :=
        BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) B_r)
          (isCompact_closedBall _ _) A hA_val hA_equi
      obtain ⟨g_lim, _, φ, hφ_mono, hφ_conv⟩ :=
        h_comp_cl.tendsto_subseq (fun k => subset_closure ⟨τ k, rfl⟩)
      rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly] at hφ_conv
      classical
      let f_r : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => if hZ : Z ∈ K_ball r then g_lim ⟨Z, hZ⟩ else 0
      have hf_r_coe : (f_r ∘ Subtype.val : K_ball r → ℂ) = ⇑g_lim := by
        ext ⟨Z, hZ⟩
        simp [f_r, hZ]
      refine ⟨φ, hφ_mono, f_r, ?_⟩
      rw [tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformly_comp_coe, hf_r_coe]
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff] at hφ_conv ⊢
      intro ε hε
      filter_upwards [hφ_conv ε hε, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_r] with k hk_dist hk_ge z
      have h_ge : N_r ≤ τ (φ k) := le_trans hk_ge ((hτ.comp hφ_mono).id_le k)
      have h_eq : g_r (τ (φ k)) z = F (τ (φ k)) z.1 := by
        simp [g_r, h_ge, BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact_apply]
        rfl
      simpa [h_eq] using hk_dist z
    let nextSub (r : ℕ) (τ : { t : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono t }) : { t : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono t } :=
      let φ := Classical.choose (h_subseq_step r τ.1 τ.2)
      have hφ : StrictMono φ := (Classical.choose_spec (h_subseq_step r τ.1 τ.2)).1
      ⟨τ.1 ∘ φ, τ.2.comp hφ⟩
    let τ_seq : ℕ → { t : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono t } :=
      Nat.rec ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩ (fun r τ => nextSub r τ)
    let step_φ : ℕ → (ℕ → ℕ) := fun r =>
      Classical.choose (h_subseq_step r (τ_seq r).1 (τ_seq r).2)
    have hstep_φ : ∀ r : ℕ, StrictMono (step_φ r) :=
      fun r => (Classical.choose_spec (h_subseq_step r (τ_seq r).1 (τ_seq r).2)).1
    let step_lim : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) := fun r =>
      Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_subseq_step r (τ_seq r).1 (τ_seq r).2)).2
    have hstep_conv : ∀ r : ℕ,
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => F ((τ_seq (r + 1)).1 k) Z)
          (step_lim r) Filter.atTop (K_ball r) :=
      fun r =>
        Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_subseq_step r (τ_seq r).1 (τ_seq r).2)).2
    let σ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => (τ_seq k).1 k
    have hσ_mono : StrictMono σ := by
      refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => ?_
      change (τ_seq k).1 k < (τ_seq k).1 (step_φ k (k + 1))
      apply (τ_seq k).2
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt ((hstep_φ k).id_le k) ((hstep_φ k) (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
    have hσ_conv_ball : ∀ r : ℕ,
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => F (σ k) Z) (step_lim r) Filter.atTop (K_ball r) := by
      intro r
      let idx : ℕ → { α : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono α } :=
        Nat.rec ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩
          (fun d α => ⟨α.1 ∘ step_φ (r + 1 + d), α.2.comp (hstep_φ (r + 1 + d))⟩)
      have h_idx_eq : ∀ (d j : ℕ),
          (τ_seq (r + 1 + d)).1 j = (τ_seq (r + 1)).1 ((idx d).1 j) := by
        intro d
        induction d with
        | zero =>
          intro j
          rfl
        | succ d ih =>
          intro j
          change (τ_seq (r + 1 + d)).1 (step_φ (r + 1 + d) j) =
            (τ_seq (r + 1)).1 ((idx d).1 (step_φ (r + 1 + d) j))
          exact ih (step_φ (r + 1 + d) j)
      let β : ℕ → ℕ := fun d => (idx d).1 (r + 1 + d)
      have hβ_mono : StrictMono β := by
        refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun d => ?_
        change (idx d).1 (r + 1 + d) < (idx d).1 (step_φ (r + 1 + d) (r + 1 + d + 1))
        apply (idx d).2
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt ((hstep_φ (r + 1 + d)).id_le (r + 1 + d))
          ((hstep_φ (r + 1 + d)) (Nat.lt_succ_self (r + 1 + d)))
      have hβ_σ : ∀ d : ℕ, (τ_seq (r + 1)).1 (β d) = σ (r + 1 + d) :=
        fun d => (h_idx_eq d (r + 1 + d)).symm
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have h_ev :=
        hβ_mono.tendsto_atTop.eventually ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hstep_conv r)) ε hε)
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_ev ⊢
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := h_ev
      refine ⟨r + 1 + D, fun k hk Z hZ => ?_⟩
      let d : ℕ := k - (r + 1)
      have hd_ge : D ≤ d := by omega
      have hk_eq : r + 1 + d = k := by omega
      have h1 := hD d hd_ge Z hZ
      rwa [hβ_σ d, hk_eq] at h1
    let F_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => step_lim ⌊‖Z‖⌋₊ Z
    have hF_pt : ∀ Z : ℂ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (σ k) Z) Filter.atTop (nhds (F_lim Z)) := by
      intro Z
      have hZ_mem : Z ∈ K_ball ⌊‖Z‖⌋₊ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact le_of_lt (Nat.lt_floor_add_one ‖Z‖)
      exact (hσ_conv_ball ⌊‖Z‖⌋₊).tendsto_at hZ_mem
    have hσ_conv_F_lim : ∀ r : ℕ,
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => F (σ k) Z) F_lim Filter.atTop (K_ball r) := by
      intro r
      refine (hσ_conv_ball r).congr_right ?_
      intro Z hZ
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ((hσ_conv_ball r).tendsto_at hZ) (hF_pt Z)
    have h_tlu : TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun k Z => F (σ k) Z) F_lim Filter.atTop := by
      rw [tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact]
      intro K hK
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : ℂ)
      let r : ℕ := ⌈R⌉₊
      have hK_sub : K ⊆ K_ball r := by
        refine Subset.trans hR (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall ?_)
        have : R ≤ (r : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil R
        linarith
      exact (hσ_conv_F_lim r).mono hK_sub
    have hF_entire : Differentiable ℂ F_lim := by
      intro z
      let R : ℝ := ‖z‖ + 1
      let V : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
      have hz_V : z ∈ V := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        dsimp [R]
        linarith
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_bound R 1 (by dsimp [R]; positivity) zero_lt_one
      have h_ev_diff : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F (σ k)) V := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
        refine ⟨N₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        have hn : N₀ ≤ σ k := le_trans hk (hσ_mono.id_le k)
        have hψ_maps : Set.MapsTo (ψ (σ k)) V U := by
          intro w hw
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hw
          exact (hN₀ (σ k) hn w hw.le).1
        exact (hf_holo.comp (by dsimp [ψ]; fun_prop) hψ_maps).const_mul _
      have h_diff_V : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_lim V :=
        (h_tlu.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn).differentiableOn h_ev_diff isOpen_ball
      exact (h_diff_V z hz_V).differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz_V)
    have hF_zero_norm : ‖F_lim 0‖ = 1 := by
      have h_const_one : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖F (σ k) 0‖ = 1 := by
        intro k
        have hm : 0 < m_seq (σ k) := (h_pos (σ k)).2
        have hψ0 : ψ (σ k) 0 = (x_seq (σ k) : ℂ) + (h_seq (σ k) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          simp [ψ]
        dsimp [F]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hm.le, hψ0,
          (h_anchor (σ k)).2, inv_mul_cancel₀ hm.ne']
      have h_tend_norm : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ‖F (σ k) 0‖) Filter.atTop (nhds ‖F_lim 0‖) :=
        continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hF_pt 0)
      simp_rw [h_const_one] at h_tend_norm
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_tend_norm tendsto_const_nhds
    have hF_global_bound : ∀ Z : ℂ, ‖F_lim Z‖ ≤ Real.exp Z.im := by
      intro Z
      have h_eta : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ‖F_lim Z‖ ≤ Real.exp (Z.im + η) := by
        intro η hη
        obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := h_bound (‖Z‖ + 1) η (by positivity) hη
        have h_ev_le : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, ‖F (σ k) Z‖ ≤ Real.exp (Z.im + η) := by
          rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
          refine ⟨N₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
          exact hF_norm_le (σ k) Z η
            (hN₀ (σ k) (le_trans hk (hσ_mono.id_le k)) Z (by linarith)).2
        exact le_of_tendsto (continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hF_pt Z)) h_ev_le
      have h_inv_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => ((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.congr (fun j => one_div ((j : ℝ) + 1))
      have h_exp_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => Real.exp (Z.im + ((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp Z.im)) := by
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (Real.exp ∘ fun j : ℕ => Z.im + ((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (Z.im + 0))) :=
          (Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt (x := Z.im + 0)).tendsto.comp
            (tendsto_const_nhds.add h_inv_zero)
        rwa [add_zero] at h1
      exact ge_of_tendsto' h_exp_tend
        (fun j : ℕ => h_eta (((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹) (inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_add_one_pos j)))
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => Complex.exp (Complex.I * Z) * F_lim Z
    have hG_diff : Differentiable ℂ G :=
      ((differentiable_id.const_mul Complex.I).cexp).mul hF_entire
    have hG_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range G) := by
      rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨Z, rfl⟩
      dsimp [G]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre : (Complex.I * Z).re = -Z.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      calc Real.exp (-Z.im) * ‖F_lim Z‖
          ≤ Real.exp (-Z.im) * Real.exp Z.im :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF_global_bound Z) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = Real.exp (-Z.im + Z.im) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
        _ = 1 := by simp
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := hG_diff.exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded hG_bdd
    have hc₀_zero : F_lim 0 = c₀ := by
      have h0 := hc₀ 0
      simpa [G] using h0
    have hc₀_ne : c₀ ≠ 0 := by
      apply norm_ne_zero_iff.mp
      rw [← hc₀_zero, hF_zero_norm]
      exact one_ne_zero
    have hF_eq : F_lim = fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) := by
      ext Z
      calc F_lim Z
          = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) * G Z := by
            dsimp [G]
            rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
            have : -Complex.I * Z + Complex.I * Z = 0 := by ring
            rw [this, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
        _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) * c₀ := by rw [hc₀ Z]
        _ = c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) := mul_comm _ _
    rw [hF_eq] at h_tlu
    exact ⟨σ, c₀, hσ_mono, hc₀_ne, h_tlu⟩
