signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (R : SuperlinearRecordScales S) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (c₀ : ℝ)
    (hφ : StrictMono φ) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hAll : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (-Complex.I) (1 / 8),
      c₀ ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z‖) :
    False

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have h_compact_simple_zeros_finite : ∀ (U K : Set ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0 → deriv f z ≠ 0) →
      IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      {z : ℂ | z ∈ K ∧ f z = 0}.Finite := by
    intro U K f hU hf hsimple hK hKU
    let Z : Set ℂ := K ∩ f ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℂ)
    have hZ_eq : {z : ℂ | z ∈ K ∧ f z = 0} = Z := by
      ext z
      simp [Z]
    rw [hZ_eq]
    have hZ_closed : IsClosed Z :=
      (hf.continuousOn.mono hKU).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK.isClosed isClosed_singleton
    have hZ_comp : IsCompact Z := hK.of_isClosed_subset hZ_closed Set.inter_subset_left
    have h_iso : ∀ z : Z, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z.1 r, w ∈ Z → w = z.1 := by
      intro ⟨z, hzK, hfz⟩
      have hzU : z ∈ U := hKU hzK
      have hderiv_ne : deriv f z ≠ 0 := hsimple z hzU hfz
      have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope f z) U :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hU.mem_nhds hzU)).mpr hf
      have hg_cont : ContinuousAt (dslope f z) z :=
        hg_diff.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hzU)
      have hg_same : dslope f z z ≠ 0 := by
        rw [dslope_same]
        exact hderiv_ne
      have h_nhds : {w : ℂ | dslope f z w ≠ 0} ∈ nhds z :=
        hg_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hg_same)
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, ?_⟩
      intro w hw_ball hw_Z
      have hgw_ne : dslope f z w ≠ 0 := hr_sub hw_ball
      have hfw : f w = 0 := hw_Z.2
      have h_smul := sub_smul_dslope f z w
      rw [hfw, hfz, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_zero] at h_smul
      rcases h_smul with h_sub | h_dsl
      · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub
      · exact False.elim (hgw_ne h_dsl)
    choose r hr_pos hr_iso using h_iso
    have h_cov : Z ⊆ ⋃ z : Z, Metric.ball z.1 (r z) := by
      intro w hw
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos ⟨w, hw⟩)⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht_cov⟩ :=
      hZ_comp.elim_finite_subcover (fun z : Z => Metric.ball z.1 (r z))
        (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) h_cov
    refine (t.image Subtype.val).finite_toSet.subset ?_
    intro w hw
    have hw_un := ht_cov hw
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hw_un
    obtain ⟨z, hz_t, hw_ball⟩ := hw_un
    have hw_eq : w = z.1 := hr_iso z w hw_ball hw
    rw [hw_eq]
    exact Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Subtype.val hz_t)

  
  have h_unit_disk_lower_bound : ∀ (δ₀ : ℝ), 0 < δ₀ →
      ∃ N_zero : ℕ, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 1 / 2 →
        ∃ c_low : ℝ, 0 < c_low ∧
          ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ),
            IsOpen U →
            Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ U →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ h U →
            (∀ u ∈ U, h u = 0 → deriv h u ≠ 0) →
            (∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖h u‖ ≤ 1) →
            δ₀ ≤ ‖h 0‖ →
            ∃ S₀ : Finset ℂ, S₀.card ≤ N_zero ∧
              ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2),
                (∀ b ∈ S₀, η ≤ ‖u - b‖) → c_low ≤ ‖h u‖ := by
    intro δ₀ hδ₀_pos
    let N_zero : ℕ := Nat.floor (4 * Real.log (1 / δ₀))
    refine ⟨N_zero, ?_⟩
    intro η hη_pos hη_le
    let c_low : ℝ := Real.exp (-4) * δ₀ ^ 5 * (η / 2) ^ N_zero
    have hc_low_pos : 0 < c_low := by positivity
    refine ⟨c_low, hc_low_pos, ?_⟩
    intro U h hU hB1_sub hh hsimple hbound h0_ge
    let K34 : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (3 / 4)
    have hK34_sub_B1 : K34 ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num)
    have hK34_sub_U : K34 ⊆ U := Set.Subset.trans hK34_sub_B1 hB1_sub
    have hZ_fin : {z : ℂ | z ∈ K34 ∧ h z = 0}.Finite :=
      h_compact_simple_zeros_finite U K34 h hU hh hsimple
        (isCompact_closedBall 0 (3 / 4)) hK34_sub_U
    let S₀ : Finset ℂ := hZ_fin.toFinset
    have hS₀_mem : ∀ b : ℂ, b ∈ S₀ ↔ b ∈ K34 ∧ h b = 0 := fun b => hZ_fin.mem_toFinset
    have h_factor : ∀ T : Finset ℂ, (∀ b ∈ T, b ∈ U ∧ h b = 0) →
        ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g U ∧ ∀ u : ℂ, h u = g u * ∏ b ∈ T, (u - b) := by
      intro T
      induction T using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        intro _
        refine ⟨h, hh, fun u => by simp⟩
      | @insert a T ha_not_mem ih =>
        intro hT
        have ha_prop : a ∈ U ∧ h a = 0 := hT a (Finset.mem_insert_self a T)
        obtain ⟨gT, hgT_diff, hgT_eq⟩ := ih (fun b hb => hT b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
        have hprod_ne : (∏ b ∈ T, (a - b)) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
          intro b hb
          exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hab => ha_not_mem (hab ▸ hb))
        have hgT_a : gT a = 0 := by
          have ha0 := hgT_eq a
          rw [ha_prop.2, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at ha0
          exact ha0.resolve_right hprod_ne
        let g' : ℂ → ℂ := dslope gT a
        have hg'_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g' U :=
          (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hU.mem_nhds ha_prop.1)).mpr hgT_diff
        refine ⟨g', hg'_diff, ?_⟩
        intro u
        have h_smul := sub_smul_dslope gT a u
        rw [hgT_a, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h_smul
        rw [hgT_eq u, ← h_smul, Finset.prod_insert ha_not_mem]
        ring
    obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀_diff, hg₀_eq⟩ := h_factor S₀ (fun b hb => by
      have hb' := (hS₀_mem b).mp hb
      exact ⟨hK34_sub_U hb'.1, hb'.2⟩)
    have hg₀_ne : ∀ u ∈ K34, g₀ u ≠ 0 := by
      intro u huK
      by_cases huS : u ∈ S₀
      · have hu_prop := (hS₀_mem u).mp huS
        have huU : u ∈ U := hK34_sub_U huK
        have hderiv_ne : deriv h u ≠ 0 := hsimple u huU hu_prop.2
        let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => g₀ w * ∏ b ∈ S₀.erase u, (w - b)
        have h_eq_F : h = fun w => (w - u) * F w := by
          ext w
          rw [hg₀_eq w, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase S₀ (fun b => w - b) huS]
          dsimp [F]
          ring
        have hF_diffAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ F u := by
          refine (hg₀_diff.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds huU)).mul ?_
          have : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ∏ b ∈ S₀.erase u, (w - b)) := by fun_prop
          exact this.differentiableAt
        have h_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w => (w - u) * F w)
            ((1 : ℂ) * F u + (u - u) * deriv F u) u :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const u).mul hF_diffAt.hasDerivAt
        have hderiv_eq : deriv h u = F u := by
          rw [h_eq_F]
          simpa using h_hd.deriv
        intro hg0_zero
        apply hderiv_ne
        rw [hderiv_eq]
        dsimp [F]
        rw [hg0_zero, zero_mul]
      · have hhu_ne : h u ≠ 0 := fun h0 => huS ((hS₀_mem u).mpr ⟨huK, h0⟩)
        intro hg0_zero
        apply hhu_ne
        rw [hg₀_eq u, hg0_zero, zero_mul]
    let H_quot : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => g₀ u * ∏ b ∈ S₀, (1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * u)
    have hHq_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_quot U := by
      refine hg₀_diff.mul ?_
      have : Differentiable ℂ (fun u : ℂ => ∏ b ∈ S₀, (1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * u)) := by fun_prop
      exact this.differentiableOn
    have hHq_sphere : ∀ u ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1), ‖H_quot u‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero]
      intro u hu_sph
      have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by simpa using hu_sph
      have h_star_mul : starRingEnd ℂ u * u = 1 := by
        rw [mul_comm, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hu_norm]
        norm_num
      have h_factor_norm : ∀ b : ℂ, ‖1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * u‖ = ‖u - b‖ := by
        intro b
        have h_id : starRingEnd ℂ u * (1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * u) = starRingEnd ℂ (u - b) := by
          rw [map_sub]
          calc starRingEnd ℂ u * (1 - starRingEnd ℂ b * u)
              = starRingEnd ℂ u - starRingEnd ℂ b * (starRingEnd ℂ u * u) := by ring
            _ = starRingEnd ℂ u - starRingEnd ℂ b := by rw [h_star_mul, mul_one]
        have h_n := congrArg norm h_id
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj, Complex.norm_conj, hu_norm, one_mul] at h_n
        exact h_n
      have h_eq_norm : ‖H_quot u‖ = ‖h u‖ := by
        dsimp [H_quot]
        rw [hg₀_eq u, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_prod, norm_prod]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => h_factor_norm b
      rw [h_eq_norm]
      exact hbound u (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu_sph)
    have hHq_le_one : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖H_quot u‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro u hu
      rw [← closure_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero] at hu
      exact Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball
        (hHq_diff.diffContOnCl_ball hB1_sub) hHq_sphere hu
    have hHq0_eq : H_quot 0 = g₀ 0 := by simp [H_quot]
    have hh0_norm : ‖h 0‖ = ‖H_quot 0‖ * ∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖ := by
      rw [hg₀_eq 0, hHq0_eq, norm_mul, norm_prod]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => by simp
    have hb_le_34 : ∀ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := by
      intro b hb
      have hbK := ((hS₀_mem b).mp hb).1
      simpa [K34] using hbK
    have hprod_b_le_34 : (∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := by
      calc (∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖) ≤ ∏ _b ∈ S₀, (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
            gcongr with b hb
            exact hb_le_34 b hb
        _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := Finset.prod_const (3 / 4 : ℝ)
    have hprod_b_le_one : (∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖) ≤ 1 := by
      calc (∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := hprod_b_le_34
        _ ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hHq0_le_one : ‖H_quot 0‖ ≤ 1 := hHq_le_one 0 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one)
    have hHq0_ge_δ₀ : δ₀ ≤ ‖H_quot 0‖ := by
      calc δ₀ ≤ ‖h 0‖ := h0_ge
        _ = ‖H_quot 0‖ * ∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖ := hh0_norm
        _ ≤ ‖H_quot 0‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod_b_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖H_quot 0‖ := mul_one _
    have hHq0_pos : 0 < ‖H_quot 0‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ₀_pos hHq0_ge_δ₀
    have hlog_inv_δ₀ : Real.log (1 / δ₀) = -Real.log δ₀ := by
      rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hcard_le : S₀.card ≤ N_zero := by
      have hδ_le_pow : δ₀ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := by
        calc δ₀ ≤ ‖h 0‖ := h0_ge
          _ = ‖H_quot 0‖ * ∏ b ∈ S₀, ‖b‖ := hh0_norm
          _ ≤ 1 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card :=
              mul_le_mul hHq0_le_one hprod_b_le_34
                (Finset.prod_nonneg fun b _ => norm_nonneg b) zero_le_one
          _ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := one_mul _
      have h34_le_exp : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-1 / 4) := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-1 / 4)
        linarith
      have hδ_le_exp : δ₀ ≤ Real.exp (-(S₀.card : ℝ) / 4) := by
        calc δ₀ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ S₀.card := hδ_le_pow
          _ ≤ (Real.exp (-1 / 4)) ^ S₀.card := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) h34_le_exp _
          _ = Real.exp ((S₀.card : ℝ) * (-1 / 4)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul (-1 / 4) S₀.card).symm
          _ = Real.exp (-(S₀.card : ℝ) / 4) := by ring_nf
      have hlog_le := Real.log_le_log hδ₀_pos hδ_le_exp
      rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog_le
      have hcard_real : (S₀.card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (1 / δ₀) := by linarith
      exact Nat.le_floor hcard_real
    let B34 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 4)
    have hB34_sub_K34 : B34 ⊆ K34 := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hB34_sub_U : B34 ⊆ U := Set.Subset.trans hB34_sub_K34 hK34_sub_U
    have hHq_ne_B34 : ∀ u ∈ B34, H_quot u ≠ 0 := by
      intro u huB
      dsimp [H_quot]
      refine mul_ne_zero (hg₀_ne u (hB34_sub_K34 huB)) ?_
      rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      intro b hb h_eq
      have hu_lt : ‖u‖ < 3 / 4 := by simpa [B34] using huB
      have hb_le : ‖b‖ ≤ 3 / 4 := hb_le_34 b hb
      have h1_eq : (1 : ℂ) = starRingEnd ℂ b * u := sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
      have h_norm := congrArg norm h1_eq
      rw [norm_one, norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj] at h_norm
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg u, norm_nonneg b]
    have hlog_deriv_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u => -deriv H_quot u / H_quot u) B34 := by
      have hd_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv H_quot) B34 :=
        (hHq_diff.deriv hU).mono hB34_sub_U
      exact (hd_diff.neg).div (hHq_diff.mono hB34_sub_U) hHq_ne_B34
    obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := hlog_deriv_diff.isExactOn_ball
    let a₀ : ℝ := -Real.log ‖H_quot 0‖
    have ha₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ a₀ := by
      have : Real.log ‖H_quot 0‖ ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hHq0_pos.le hHq0_le_one
      dsimp [a₀]; linarith
    have ha₀_le : a₀ ≤ Real.log (1 / δ₀) := by
      have h1 : Real.log δ₀ ≤ Real.log ‖H_quot 0‖ := Real.log_le_log hδ₀_pos hHq0_ge_δ₀
      dsimp [a₀]; linarith
    let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => P₀ u - P₀ 0 + (a₀ : ℂ)
    have hψ_zero : ψ 0 = (a₀ : ℂ) := by simp [ψ]
    have hψ_deriv : ∀ u ∈ B34, HasDerivAt ψ (-deriv H_quot u / H_quot u) u := by
      intro u hu
      simpa [ψ] using ((hP₀ u hu).sub_const (P₀ 0)).add_const (a₀ : ℂ)
    let E_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => H_quot u * Complex.exp (ψ u)
    have hE_hd : ∀ u ∈ B34, HasDerivAt E_fn 0 u := by
      intro u hu
      have hHq_at : HasDerivAt H_quot (deriv H_quot u) u :=
        (hHq_diff.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hB34_sub_U hu))).hasDerivAt
      have hexp_at : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (ψ w))
          (Complex.exp (ψ u) * (-deriv H_quot u / H_quot u)) u :=
        (hψ_deriv u hu).cexp
      have hprod_at := hHq_at.mul hexp_at
      have h_zero : deriv H_quot u * Complex.exp (ψ u) +
          H_quot u * (Complex.exp (ψ u) * (-deriv H_quot u / H_quot u)) = 0 := by
        have hne := hHq_ne_B34 u hu
        field_simp [hne]
        ring
      rwa [h_zero] at hprod_at
    have hE_diffOn : DifferentiableOn ℂ E_fn B34 :=
      fun u hu => (hE_hd u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have h0_B34 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B34 := Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)
    have hE_const : ∀ u ∈ B34, E_fn u = E_fn 0 := by
      intro u hu
      refine Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 4)).isPreconnected hE_diffOn ?_ hu h0_B34
      intro w hw
      exact (hE_hd w hw).deriv
    have hE0_norm : ‖E_fn 0‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [E_fn]
      rw [hψ_zero, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp, Complex.ofReal_re]
      dsimp [a₀]
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hHq0_pos, mul_inv_cancel₀ hHq0_pos.ne']
    have hHq_exp : ∀ u ∈ B34, ‖H_quot u‖ = Real.exp (-(ψ u).re) := by
      intro u hu
      have h_eq := congrArg norm (hE_const u hu)
      rw [hE0_norm] at h_eq
      dsimp [E_fn] at h_eq
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp] at h_eq
      calc ‖H_quot u‖ = ‖H_quot u‖ * (Real.exp (ψ u).re * Real.exp (-(ψ u).re)) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
        _ = (‖H_quot u‖ * Real.exp (ψ u).re) * Real.exp (-(ψ u).re) := by ring
        _ = 1 * Real.exp (-(ψ u).re) := by rw [h_eq]
        _ = Real.exp (-(ψ u).re) := one_mul _
    have hψ_re_nonneg : ∀ u ∈ B34, 0 ≤ (ψ u).re := by
      intro u hu
      have hle : Real.exp (-(ψ u).re) ≤ Real.exp 0 := by
        rw [Real.exp_zero, ← hHq_exp u hu]
        exact hHq_le_one u (Set.Subset.trans hB34_sub_K34 hK34_sub_B1 hu)
      linarith [Real.exp_le_exp.mp hle]
    let A₀ : ℝ := a₀ + 1
    have hA₀_pos : 0 < A₀ := by dsimp [A₀]; linarith
    let ψ_t : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => ψ u + 1
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (ψ_t u - (A₀ : ℂ)) / (ψ_t u + (A₀ : ℂ))
    let Θ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => ((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Φ u
    have hψt_den_ne : ∀ u ∈ B34, ψ_t u + (A₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro u hu h_eq
      have hre := congrArg Complex.re h_eq
      simp only [ψ_t, Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      linarith [hψ_re_nonneg u hu]
    have hΘ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ B34 := by
      have hψ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ B34 :=
        fun u hu => (hψ_deriv u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hψt_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ_t B34 := hψ_diff.add_const 1
      have hΦ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ B34 :=
        (hψt_diff.sub_const (A₀ : ℂ)).div (hψt_diff.add_const (A₀ : ℂ)) hψt_den_ne
      exact hΦ_diff.const_mul _
    have hΘ_zero : Θ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [Θ, Φ, ψ_t, A₀]
      rw [hψ_zero]
      push_cast
      simp
    have hnorm_34 : ‖((3 / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = 3 / 4 := by norm_num
    have hΘ_maps : Set.MapsTo Θ B34 (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (3 / 4)) := by
      intro u hu
      simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hre_pos : 0 ≤ (ψ_t u).re := by
        simp only [ψ_t, Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re]
        linarith [hψ_re_nonneg u hu]
      have hsq_le : ‖ψ_t u - (A₀ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ_t u + (A₀ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
        simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
          Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
        nlinarith
      have hnum_le : ‖ψ_t u - (A₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖ψ_t u + (A₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ψ_t u - (A₀ : ℂ)), norm_nonneg (ψ_t u + (A₀ : ℂ))]

    have h_staircase_eq : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (t : ℂ)) =

            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..y_prev j, g ((x j : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =

    have h_inv_sq_le : ∀ s : ℂ, B ≤ ‖S.f s‖ → ‖g s‖ ≤ (B ^ 2)⁻¹ := by

            have hj_lt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj

        ∫ t in x_step j..x_step (j + 1), (S.f ((t : ℂ) + (y_step j : ℂ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ ^ 2) +
        Complex.I * (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..y_step j,
          (S.f ((x_step (j + 1) : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ ^ 2) -
        Complex.I * (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..y_step j,
          (S.f ((x_step j : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * Complex.I))⁻¹ ^ 2) = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have hyj_Icc := hy_step_Icc j hj
    have hyj_nonneg : 0 ≤ y_step j := le_trans hy_lo_nonneg hyj_Icc.1
    have hyj_lt_H : y_step j < S.H := lt_of_le_of_lt hyj_Icc.2 hy_hi_lt_H
    have hbox_sub : Set.Icc (x_step j) (x_step (j + 1)) ×ℂ Set.Icc 0 (y_step j) ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Complex.mem_reProdIm] at hz
      change |z.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hz.2.1]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hz.2.2 hyj_lt_H
    have hbot_nz : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (x_step j) (x_step (j + 1)),
        S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro x _ h0
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at h0
      have hre := (S.f_real_pos x).1
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have htop_nz : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (x_step j) (x_step (j + 1)),
        S.f ((x : ℂ) + (y_step j : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hx h0
      have hb := h_tread_bound j hj x hx
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at hb
      linarith
    have hleft_nz : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 (y_step j),
        S.f ((x_step j : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => h_vert_nz j hj y ⟨hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hyj_Icc.2⟩
    have hright_nz : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 (y_step j),
        S.f ((x_step (j + 1) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_hi_mem : y ∈ Set.Icc 0 y_hi := ⟨hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hyj_Icc.2⟩
      by_cases hj1 : j + 1 < M
      · exact h_vert_nz (j + 1) hj1 y hy_hi_mem
      · have hj_eq : j + 1 = M := le_antisymm (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj) (not_lt.mp hj1)
        rw [hj_eq, hx_step_M]
        have hs0_mem : (x_step 0 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          change |((x_step 0 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
          have him : ((x_step 0 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y := by simp
          rw [him, abs_of_nonneg hy.1]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt hy.2 hyj_lt_H
        have hshift : ((x_step 0 + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I =
            ((x_step 0 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          push_cast
          ring
        have h0_lt_M : 0 < M := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp hM_ge_1)
        rw [hshift, S.f_periodic _ hs0_mem]
        exact h_vert_nz 0 h0_lt_M y hy_hi_mem
    have hrect0 := h_rect_inv_sq_zero (horizStrip S.H) S.f (x_step j) (x_step (j + 1)) 0 (y_step j)
      hOpen_strip S.f_holo S.f_simple_zeros (hx_step_mono j hj) hyj_nonneg
      hbox_sub hbot_nz htop_nz hleft_nz hright_nz
    simpa using hrect0

  
  have hI_upper : I_real ≤ (2 * Real.pi + (M : ℝ) * (y_hi - y_lo)) / B_val ^ 2 :=
    h_staircase_bound M y_lo y_hi B_val x_step y_step hM_ge_1 hy_lo_nonneg hy_lo_le_hi
      hy_hi_lt_H hB_pos hx_step_M hx_step_mono hy_step_Icc h_vert_nz
      h_tread_bound h_riser_bound h_cell_rect
  have hy_diff_eq : y_hi - y_lo = d / 4 := by dsimp [y_lo, y_hi]; ring
  rw [hy_diff_eq] at hI_upper
  have hB2_pos : 0 < B_val ^ 2 := pow_pos hB_pos 2
  have h_prod_lt_7pi : I_real * B_val ^ 2 < 7 * Real.pi := by
    have h1 : I_real * B_val ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.pi + (M : ℝ) * (d / 4) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hB2_pos).mp hI_upper
    linarith [hMd4_lt_5pi]
  have hm_gt_K : K_target < m := by
    have hk_ge_ceil : Nat.ceil K_target + 1 ≤ k := le_max_right _ _
    have hceil_le : K_target ≤ (Nat.ceil K_target : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil K_target
    have hceil_lt_k : (Nat.ceil K_target : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_ge_ceil
    linarith [hm_ge_k1]
  have hK_nonneg : 0 ≤ K_target := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hK_sq : K_target ^ 2 = 7 * Real.pi / (c_cell ^ 2 * I_real) := by
    dsimp [K_target]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hm_sq_gt : 7 * Real.pi / (c_cell ^ 2 * I_real) < m ^ 2 := by
    rw [← hK_sq]
    exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ hm_gt_K hK_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have h_7pi_lt : 7 * Real.pi < I_real * B_val ^ 2 := by
    have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < c_cell ^ 2 * I_real)).mp hm_sq_gt
    calc 7 * Real.pi < m ^ 2 * (c_cell ^ 2 * I_real) := h1
      _ = I_real * B_val ^ 2 := by dsimp [B_val]; ring
  linarith
