proof.tactics:
by
  have h_strip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_lhp_open : IsOpen superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  have h_lhp_preconn : IsPreconnected superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    refine Convex.isPreconnected ?_
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
    change (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im < 0
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
    change z₁.im < 0 at hz₁
    change z₂.im < 0 at hz₂
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · subst ha0; simp at hab; subst hab; linarith
    · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
      nlinarith
  have hα₁_pos : 0 < R.α₁ := lt_trans zero_lt_one R.one_lt_α₁
  have hP_gt_one : 1 < R.P := lt_trans R.one_lt_α₁ (lt_trans R.α₁_lt_α₂ R.α₂_lt_P)
  have hP_pos : 0 < R.P := lt_trans zero_lt_one hP_gt_one
  have hd_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < R.d_seq n := fun n => by
    rw [R.d_seq_eq n]; exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hm_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < R.m_seq n := fun n =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (R.m_seq_pos n)

  
  have h_rescaled_bounds : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ),
      0 < -Z.im → R.d_seq n * (-Z.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) →
      ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H) ∧
      (1 ≤ -Z.im →
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁)) ∧
      (∀ δ_min : ℝ, 0 < δ_min → δ_min ≤ 1 → δ_min ≤ -Z.im →
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P ∧
        ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ ≤ ((1 / δ_min) ^ R.P) ^ 2) := by
    intro n x Z hD_pos hdD_le
    set d := R.d_seq n
    set m := R.m_seq n
    set D := -Z.im
    set s : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z
    have hd : 0 < d := hd_pos n
    have hm : 0 < m := hm_pos n
    have hs_im : s.im = S.H - d * D := by simp [s, D]
    have hwd : wallDepth S s = d * D := by unfold wallDepth; rw [hs_im]; ring
    have hdD_lt_half : d * D ≤ S.H / 2 := le_trans hdD_le R.exp_neg_k₀_le_half_H
    have hs_mem : s ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      change |s.im| < S.H
      rw [hs_im, abs_lt]
      have hdD_pos : 0 < d * D := mul_pos hd hD_pos
      constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
    have h_ratio : d / wallDepth S s = D⁻¹ := by rw [hwd]; field_simp [hd.ne']
    have h_norm_F : ∀ B : ℝ, shapeModulus S s ≤ m * B →
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x d m Z‖ ≤ B := by
      intro B hB
      have h1 : ‖S.f s‖ ≤ m * B := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB
      unfold superlinearRescaledF
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le)]
      calc m⁻¹ * ‖S.f s‖ ≤ m⁻¹ * (m * B) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le)
        _ = B := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hm.ne' B
    have h_norm_Q : ∀ B : ℝ, shapeModulus S s ≤ m * B →
        Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ B := by
      intro B hB
      have h1 : Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖ ≤ m * B := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB
      unfold superlinearRescaledQ
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg m)),
        Real.sqrt_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg m)), ← inv_pow,
        Real.sqrt_sq (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le)]
      calc m⁻¹ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖ ≤ m⁻¹ * (m * B) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le)
        _ = B := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hm.ne' B
    have h_coarse : 1 ≤ D →
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x d m Z‖ ≤ D ^ (-R.α₁) ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ D ^ (-R.α₁) := by
      intro hD1
      have hd_le_wd : d ≤ wallDepth S s := by rw [hwd]; nlinarith
      have hwd_le : wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by rwa [hwd]
      have h_mod := R.coarse_tail_bound n s hd_le_wd hwd_le
      rw [h_ratio, Real.inv_rpow hD_pos.le, ← Real.rpow_neg hD_pos.le] at h_mod
      exact ⟨h_norm_F _ h_mod, h_norm_Q _ h_mod⟩
    refine ⟨hs_mem, h_coarse, ?_⟩
    intro δ_min hδ_pos hδ_le_one hδ_le_D
    have h_one_le_inv : 1 ≤ 1 / δ_min := (one_le_div hδ_pos).mpr hδ_le_one
    have h_one_le_cap : 1 ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P := Real.one_le_rpow h_one_le_inv hP_pos.le
    by_cases hD1 : 1 ≤ D
    · obtain ⟨hF1, hQ1⟩ := h_coarse hD1
      have h_dec_le_one : D ^ (-R.α₁) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg hD_pos.le]
        exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (Real.one_le_rpow hD1 hα₁_pos.le)
      have hF_cap : ‖superlinearRescaledF S x d m Z‖ ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P :=
        le_trans hF1 (le_trans h_dec_le_one h_one_le_cap)
      have hQ_sqrt : Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P :=
        le_trans hQ1 (le_trans h_dec_le_one h_one_le_cap)
      have hQ_cap : ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ ((1 / δ_min) ^ R.P) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hQ_sqrt 2
      exact ⟨hF_cap, hQ_cap⟩
    · push Not at hD1
      have hwd_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := by rw [hwd]; positivity
      have hwd_le_d : wallDepth S s ≤ d := by rw [hwd]; nlinarith
      have h_mod := R.fine_cap_bound n s hwd_pos hwd_le_d
      rw [h_ratio, ← one_div] at h_mod
      have h_div_le : 1 / D ≤ 1 / δ_min := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hδ_pos hδ_le_D
      have h_rpow_le : (1 / D) ^ R.P ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_div_le hP_pos.le
      have hF_cap : ‖superlinearRescaledF S x d m Z‖ ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P :=
        le_trans (h_norm_F _ h_mod) h_rpow_le
      have hQ_sqrt : Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ (1 / δ_min) ^ R.P :=
        le_trans (h_norm_Q _ h_mod) h_rpow_le
      have hQ_cap : ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z‖ ≤ ((1 / δ_min) ^ R.P) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hQ_sqrt 2
      exact ⟨hF_cap, hQ_cap⟩

  
  have h_local_hill : ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (x d m : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → m ≠ 0 →
      (∀ Z ∈ U, (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (superlinearRescaledF S x d m) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (superlinearRescaledQ S x d m) U ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ U, deriv (deriv (superlinearRescaledF S x d m)) Z =
        ((d * m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * superlinearRescaledQ S x d m Z *
          superlinearRescaledF S x d m Z) := by
    intro U x d m hU_open hm_ne hMaps
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z
    have hΦ_deriv : ∀ Z : ℂ, HasDerivAt Φ (d : ℂ) Z := fun Z => by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (d : ℂ) * w) (d : ℂ) Z := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id Z).const_mul (d : ℂ)
      exact h1.const_add ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hf_d1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      S.f_holo.deriv h_strip_open
    have hF_hasDeriv : ∀ Z ∈ U, HasDerivAt (superlinearRescaledF S x d m)
        (((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (deriv S.f (Φ Z) * (d : ℂ))) Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hs_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.f (Φ Z) :=
        S.f_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (hMaps Z hZ))
      exact (hs_at.hasDerivAt.comp Z (hΦ_deriv Z)).const_mul ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hQ_hasDeriv : ∀ Z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℂ (superlinearRescaledQ S x d m) Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hq_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.q (Φ Z) :=
        S.q_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (hMaps Z hZ))
      exact ((hq_at.hasDerivAt.comp Z (hΦ_deriv Z)).const_mul
        ((((m ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))).differentiableAt
    refine ⟨fun Z hZ => (hF_hasDeriv Z hZ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
      fun Z hZ => (hQ_hasDeriv Z hZ).differentiableWithinAt, ?_⟩
    intro W hW
    let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (deriv S.f (Φ Z) * (d : ℂ))
    have h_eq_nhds : deriv (superlinearRescaledF S x d m) =ᶠ[nhds W] g₁ := by
      filter_upwards [hU_open.mem_nhds hW] with Z hZ
      exact (hF_hasDeriv Z hZ).deriv
    have hdf_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv S.f) (Φ W) :=
      hf_d1.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (hMaps W hW))
    have hg₁_deriv : HasDerivAt g₁
        (((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((deriv (deriv S.f) (Φ W) * (d : ℂ)) * (d : ℂ))) W :=
      (((hdf_at.hasDerivAt.comp W (hΦ_deriv W)).mul_const (d : ℂ)).const_mul ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))
    have hF_d2 : HasDerivAt (deriv (superlinearRescaledF S x d m))
        (((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((deriv (deriv S.f) (Φ W) * (d : ℂ)) * (d : ℂ))) W :=
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.hasDerivAt_iff h_eq_nhds).mpr hg₁_deriv
    rw [hF_d2.deriv, S.deriv2_f (Φ W) (hMaps W hW)]
    unfold superlinearRescaledF superlinearRescaledQ
    have hm_c : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hm_ne
    change ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((S.q (Φ W) * S.f (Φ W) * (d : ℂ)) * (d : ℂ)) =
      ((d * m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((((m ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.q (Φ W)) *
        (((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f (Φ W))
    push_cast
    field_simp [hm_c]

  
  have hPure : SuperlinearPureExtractionProp S R := by
    intro φ hφ x_seq
    let F_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k Z =>
      superlinearRescaledF S (x_seq k) (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z
    let Q_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k Z =>
      superlinearRescaledQ S (x_seq k) (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z
    let K_rect : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun ν =>
      { Z : ℂ | |Z.re| ≤ (ν : ℝ) + 1 ∧
        -((ν : ℝ) + 2) ≤ Z.im ∧ Z.im ≤ -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) }
    let U_slab : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun ν =>
      { W : ℂ | -((ν : ℝ) + 3) < W.im ∧ W.im < -(1 / (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))) }

    have hK_comp : ∀ ν : ℕ, IsCompact (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν
      let R_prod : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
        Set.Icc (-((ν : ℝ) + 1)) ((ν : ℝ) + 1) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc (-((ν : ℝ) + 2)) (-(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)))
      let emb : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have h_eq : K_rect ν = emb '' R_prod := by
        ext Z
        simp only [K_rect, R_prod, emb, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_prod,
          Set.mem_Icc, Prod.exists, abs_le]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
          exact ⟨Z.re, Z.im, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩, Complex.re_add_im Z⟩
        · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩, rfl⟩
          have hre : ((a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = a := by simp
          have him : ((a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = b := by simp
          rw [hre, him]
          exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image (by fun_prop)

    have hK_conv : ∀ ν : ℕ, Convex ℝ (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      rcases hz₁ with ⟨hz₁_re, hz₁_im1, hz₁_im2⟩
      rcases hz₂ with ⟨hz₂_re, hz₂_im1, hz₂_im2⟩
      rw [abs_le] at hz₁_re hz₂_re
      have hre : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).re = a * z₁.re + b * z₂.re := by
        simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul]
      have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul]
      refine ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by rw [hre]; nlinarith, by rw [hre]; nlinarith⟩,
        by rw [him]; nlinarith, by rw [him]; nlinarith⟩

    have hU_open : ∀ ν : ℕ, IsOpen (U_slab ν) := fun ν =>
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)

    have h_extract_one : ∀ (ν : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono σ →
        ∃ (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ), StrictMono τ ∧
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => (F_seq (σ (τ k)) Z, Q_seq (σ (τ k)) Z))
            g Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν σ hσ
      let r_ν : ℝ := 1 / (2 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))
      have hr_pos : 0 < r_ν := by dsimp [r_ν]; positivity
      let M_ν : ℝ := (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) ^ R.P
      have hν_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ν : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg ν
      have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_ν := by
        dsimp [M_ν]
        exact Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith) hP_pos.le
      have hM_pos : 0 < M_ν := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_ge_one
      let L_ν : ℝ := M_ν ^ 2 / r_ν
      have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L_ν := by dsimp [L_ν]; positivity
      let L_nn : NNReal := ⟨L_ν, hL_nonneg⟩

      have h_cb_sub : ∀ Z ∈ K_rect ν, Metric.closedBall Z r_ν ⊆ U_slab ν := by
        intro Z hZ W hW
        rcases hZ with ⟨_, hZ1, hZ2⟩
        have h_im_diff : |W.im - Z.im| ≤ r_ν := by
          calc |W.im - Z.im| = |(W - Z).im| := by simp
            _ ≤ ‖W - Z‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (W - Z)
            _ = dist W Z := (dist_eq_norm W Z).symm
            _ ≤ r_ν := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hW
        rw [abs_le] at h_im_diff
        have hr_le_half : r_ν ≤ 1 / 4 := by
          dsimp [r_ν]
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
          linarith
        have h_top : -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) + r_ν < -(1 / (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))) := by
          dsimp [r_ν]
          have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (ν : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
          field_simp [hpos.ne']
          linarith
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

      have hK_sub_U : K_rect ν ⊆ U_slab ν := fun Z hZ =>
        h_cb_sub Z hZ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_pos.le)

      have h_large_k : ∀ m_idx : ℕ, ν + 3 ≤ m_idx →
          (∀ Z ∈ K_rect ν, ‖F_seq m_idx Z‖ ≤ M_ν ∧ ‖Q_seq m_idx Z‖ ≤ M_ν ^ 2) ∧
          (∀ z₁ ∈ K_rect ν, ∀ z₂ ∈ K_rect ν,
            ‖F_seq m_idx z₁ - F_seq m_idx z₂‖ ≤ L_ν * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ ∧
            ‖Q_seq m_idx z₁ - Q_seq m_idx z₂‖ ≤ L_ν * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) := by
        intro m_idx hm_idx
        have hφ_ge : ν + 3 ≤ φ m_idx := le_trans hm_idx (hφ.id_le m_idx)
        have h_on_U : ∀ W ∈ U_slab ν,
            ((x_seq m_idx : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (R.d_seq (φ m_idx) : ℂ) * W ∈ horizStrip S.H) ∧
            ‖F_seq m_idx W‖ ≤ M_ν ∧ ‖Q_seq m_idx W‖ ≤ M_ν ^ 2 := by
          intro W hW
          rcases hW with ⟨hW_lo, hW_hi⟩
          have hD_pos : 0 < -W.im := by
            have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) := by positivity
            linarith
          have hD_lt : -W.im < (ν : ℝ) + 3 := by linarith
          have hk_ge : R.k₀ + ((ν : ℝ) + 3) ≤ R.k_seq (φ m_idx) := by
            have h1 := R.k_seq_ge (φ m_idx)
            have h2 : ((ν + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (φ m_idx : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hφ_ge
            push_cast at h2
            linarith
          have hexp_d : R.d_seq (φ m_idx) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - ((ν : ℝ) + 3)) := by
            rw [R.d_seq_eq (φ m_idx)]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
          have h_lin_exp : (ν : ℝ) + 3 ≤ Real.exp ((ν : ℝ) + 3) := by
            have := Real.add_one_le_exp ((ν : ℝ) + 3)
            linarith
          have hdD_le : R.d_seq (φ m_idx) * (-W.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
            calc R.d_seq (φ m_idx) * (-W.im)
                ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - ((ν : ℝ) + 3)) * Real.exp ((ν : ℝ) + 3) :=
                  mul_le_mul hexp_d (le_trans hD_lt.le h_lin_exp) hD_pos.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
              _ = Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          let δ_min : ℝ := 1 / (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))
          have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_min := by dsimp [δ_min]; positivity
          have hδ_le_one : δ_min ≤ 1 := by
            dsimp [δ_min]
            rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
            linarith
          have h_inv_δ : 1 / δ_min = 4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2) := by
            dsimp [δ_min]; field_simp
          obtain ⟨hs_mem, _, h_cap⟩ := h_rescaled_bounds (φ m_idx) (x_seq m_idx) W hD_pos hdD_le
          obtain ⟨hF_b, hQ_b⟩ := h_cap δ_min hδ_pos hδ_le_one (by dsimp [δ_min]; linarith)
          rw [h_inv_δ] at hF_b hQ_b
          exact ⟨hs_mem, hF_b, hQ_b⟩
        obtain ⟨hF_holo_U, hQ_holo_U, _⟩ := h_local_hill (U_slab ν) (x_seq m_idx)
          (R.d_seq (φ m_idx)) (R.m_seq (φ m_idx)) (hU_open ν)
          (hm_pos (φ m_idx)).ne' (fun W hW => (h_on_U W hW).1)
        have h_deriv_K : ∀ Z ∈ K_rect ν,
            ‖deriv (F_seq m_idx) Z‖ ≤ L_ν ∧ ‖deriv (Q_seq m_idx) Z‖ ≤ L_ν := by
          intro Z hZ
          have hcb := h_cb_sub Z hZ
          have h_cl_eq : closure (Metric.ball Z r_ν) = Metric.closedBall Z r_ν :=
            closure_ball Z hr_pos.ne'
          have hF_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (F_seq m_idx) (Metric.ball Z r_ν) :=
            ⟨hF_holo_U.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb),
             hF_holo_U.continuousOn.mono (by rw [h_cl_eq]; exact hcb)⟩
          have hQ_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (Q_seq m_idx) (Metric.ball Z r_ν) :=
            ⟨hQ_holo_U.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb),
             hQ_holo_U.continuousOn.mono (by rw [h_cl_eq]; exact hcb)⟩
          have hF_d := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr_pos hF_dc
            (fun w hw => (h_on_U w (hcb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw))).2.1)
          have hQ_d := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr_pos hQ_dc
            (fun w hw => (h_on_U w (hcb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw))).2.2)
          have hM_le_sq : M_ν / r_ν ≤ L_ν := by
            dsimp [L_ν]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [hM_ge_one]) hr_pos.le
          exact ⟨le_trans hF_d hM_le_sq, hQ_d⟩
        refine ⟨fun Z hZ => ⟨(h_on_U Z (hK_sub_U hZ)).2.1, (h_on_U Z (hK_sub_U hZ)).2.2⟩, ?_⟩
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
        have hF_lip := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (fun z hz => hF_holo_U.differentiableAt ((hU_open ν).mem_nhds (hK_sub_U hz)))
          (fun z hz => (h_deriv_K z hz).1) (hK_conv ν) hz₂ hz₁
        have hQ_lip := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (fun z hz => hQ_holo_U.differentiableAt ((hU_open ν).mem_nhds (hK_sub_U hz)))
          (fun z hz => (h_deriv_K z hz).2) (hK_conv ν) hz₂ hz₁
        exact ⟨hF_lip, hQ_lip⟩

      have hK_cs : CompactSpace ↥(K_rect ν) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (hK_comp ν)
      let G_bcf : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K_rect ν) (ℂ × ℂ) := fun k =>
        if hk : ν + 3 ≤ σ k then
          BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact
            ⟨fun z : ↥(K_rect ν) => (F_seq (σ k) z.1, Q_seq (σ k) z.1), by
              refine Continuous.prodMk ?_ ?_
              · exact (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := L_nn) fun x y => by
                  rw [dist_eq_norm, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
                  exact ((h_large_k (σ k) hk).2 x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2).1).continuous
              · exact (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := L_nn) fun x y => by
                  rw [dist_eq_norm, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
                  exact ((h_large_k (σ k) hk).2 x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2).2).continuous⟩
        else 0

      let S_val : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) M_ν ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (M_ν ^ 2)
      have hS_comp : IsCompact S_val :=
        (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod (isCompact_closedBall _ _)

      have hG_in_S : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ↥(K_rect ν)), G_bcf k z ∈ S_val := by
        intro k z
        dsimp [G_bcf]
        split_ifs with hk
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (h_large_k (σ k) hk).1 z.1 z.2
          exact ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa using h2⟩
        · exact ⟨by simp [hM_pos.le], by simp [sq_nonneg M_ν]⟩

      have hG_lip : ∀ k : ℕ, LipschitzWith L_nn (G_bcf k) := by
        intro k
        refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x y => ?_
        dsimp [G_bcf, L_nn]
        split_ifs with hk
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (h_large_k (σ k) hk).2 x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2
          change dist (F_seq (σ k) x.1, Q_seq (σ k) x.1)
            (F_seq (σ k) y.1, Q_seq (σ k) y.1) ≤ L_ν * dist x y
          rw [dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
          exact max_le h1 h2
        · simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, dist_self]
          exact mul_nonneg hL_nonneg dist_nonneg

      let A_set : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K_rect ν) (ℂ × ℂ)) := Set.range G_bcf
      have hA_in_S : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K_rect ν) (ℂ × ℂ)) (z : ↥(K_rect ν)),
          f ∈ A_set → f z ∈ S_val := by
        rintro f z ⟨k, rfl⟩
        exact hG_in_S k z
      have hA_equi : Equicontinuous
          (fun (x : A_set) => ⇑(x : BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K_rect ν) (ℂ × ℂ))) := by
        refine (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous _ L_nn ?_).equicontinuous
        rintro ⟨f, k, rfl⟩
        exact hG_lip k

      have h_cl_comp : IsCompact (closure A_set) :=
        BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli S_val hS_comp A_set hA_in_S hA_equi
      obtain ⟨G_lim, _, τ, hτ, hG_tendsto⟩ :=
        h_cl_comp.tendsto_subseq (fun k => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self k))

      have h_unif_sub : TendstoUniformly (fun k (z : ↥(K_rect ν)) => G_bcf (τ k) z)
          (fun z => G_lim z) Filter.atTop :=
        BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp hG_tendsto

      classical
      let g_ext : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun Z =>
        if hZ : Z ∈ K_rect ν then G_lim ⟨Z, hZ⟩ else (0, 0)
      have h_unif_on_G : TendstoUniformlyOn
          (fun k Z => if hZ : Z ∈ K_rect ν then G_bcf (τ k) ⟨Z, hZ⟩ else (0, 0))
          g_ext Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := by
        rw [tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformly_comp_coe]
        have h_coe_eq : g_ext ∘ Subtype.val = (fun z : ↥(K_rect ν) => G_lim z) := by
          funext z; simp [g_ext, z.2]
        have h_lhs_eq : (fun (i : ℕ) (x : ↥(K_rect ν)) =>
            if hZ : (x : ℂ) ∈ K_rect ν then G_bcf (τ i) ⟨(x : ℂ), hZ⟩ else (0, 0)) =
            (fun k (z : ↥(K_rect ν)) => G_bcf (τ k) z) := by
          funext i x; simp [x.2]
        rw [h_coe_eq, h_lhs_eq]
        exact h_unif_sub
      refine ⟨τ, g_ext, hτ, h_unif_on_G.congr ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (ν + 3)] with k hk Z hZ
      have hστ : ν + 3 ≤ σ (τ k) :=
        le_trans hk (le_trans (hτ.id_le k) (hσ.id_le (τ k)))
      simp [hZ, G_bcf, hστ]

    let Subseq := { s : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono s }
    have h_ex_sub : ∀ (ν : ℕ) (s : Subseq),
        ∃ p : (ℕ → ℕ) × (ℂ → ℂ × ℂ), StrictMono p.1 ∧
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => (F_seq (s.1 (p.1 k)) Z, Q_seq (s.1 (p.1 k)) Z))
            p.2 Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν s
      obtain ⟨τ, g, hτ, hg⟩ := h_extract_one ν s.1 s.2
      exact ⟨(τ, g), hτ, hg⟩
    choose nextPair h_pair_mono h_pair_conv using h_ex_sub
    let nextSubseq : ℕ → Subseq → Subseq := fun ν s =>
      ⟨s.1 ∘ (nextPair ν s).1, s.2.comp (h_pair_mono ν s)⟩
    let limOnRect : ℕ → Subseq → (ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) := fun ν s =>
      (nextPair ν s).2
    have h_next_conv : ∀ (ν : ℕ) (s : Subseq),
        TendstoUniformlyOn
          (fun k Z => (F_seq ((nextSubseq ν s).1 k) Z, Q_seq ((nextSubseq ν s).1 k) Z))
          (limOnRect ν s) Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := fun ν s =>
      h_pair_conv ν s

    let diagChain : ℕ → Subseq :=
      Nat.rec (nextSubseq 0 ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩) (fun ν s_prev => nextSubseq (ν + 1) s_prev)
    let g_rect : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun ν =>
      Nat.casesOn ν (limOnRect 0 ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩) (fun μ => limOnRect (μ + 1) (diagChain μ))

    have h_chain_conv : ∀ ν : ℕ,
        TendstoUniformlyOn
          (fun k Z => (F_seq ((diagChain ν).1 k) Z, Q_seq ((diagChain ν).1 k) Z))
          (g_rect ν) Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν
      cases ν with
      | zero => exact h_next_conv 0 ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩
      | succ μ => exact h_next_conv (μ + 1) (diagChain μ)

    have h_chain_tail : ∀ (ν d x : ℕ),
        ∃ m ≥ x, (diagChain (ν + d)).1 x = (diagChain ν).1 m := by
      intro ν d
      induction d with
      | zero =>
        intro x
        exact ⟨x, le_rfl, rfl⟩
      | succ d ih =>
        intro x
        let τ_step := (nextPair (ν + d + 1) (diagChain (ν + d))).1
        have hτ_step : StrictMono τ_step := h_pair_mono (ν + d + 1) (diagChain (ν + d))
        obtain ⟨m, hm_ge, hm_eq⟩ := ih (τ_step x)
        refine ⟨m, le_trans (hτ_step.id_le x) hm_ge, ?_⟩
        change (diagChain (ν + d)).1 (τ_step x) = (diagChain ν).1 m
        exact hm_eq

    let ψ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => (diagChain k).1 k
    have hψ : StrictMono ψ := by
      refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => ?_
      let τ_step := (nextPair (k + 1) (diagChain k)).1
      have hτ_step : StrictMono τ_step := h_pair_mono (k + 1) (diagChain k)
      have hk_lt : k < τ_step (k + 1) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (hτ_step.id_le k) (hτ_step (Nat.lt_succ_self k))
      exact (diagChain k).2 hk_lt

    have hψ_unif : ∀ ν : ℕ,
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k Z => (F_seq (ψ k) Z, Q_seq (ψ k) Z))
          (g_rect ν) Filter.atTop (K_rect ν) := by
      intro ν
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have h_orig := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (h_chain_conv ν)) ε hε
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop] at h_orig ⊢
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_orig
      refine ⟨max ν M, fun k hk Z hZ => ?_⟩
      have hk_ν : ν ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk
      have hk_M : M ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk
      obtain ⟨m, hm_ge, hm_eq⟩ := h_chain_tail ν (k - ν) k
      have h_idx : ν + (k - ν) = k := Nat.add_sub_of_le hk_ν
      have hψ_eq : ψ k = (diagChain ν).1 m := by
        dsimp [ψ]
        nth_rw 1 [← h_idx]
        exact hm_eq
      rw [hψ_eq]
      exact hM m (le_trans hk_M hm_ge) Z hZ

    have h_exh_nhds : ∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, ∃ ν : ℕ, K_rect ν ∈ nhds Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      change Z.im < 0 at hZ
      have hD_pos : 0 < -Z.im := neg_pos.mpr hZ
      obtain ⟨ν, hν_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (max |Z.re| (-Z.im)) (1 / (-Z.im)))
      refine ⟨ν, ?_⟩
      let V_open : Set ℂ :=
        { W : ℂ | |W.re| < (ν : ℝ) + 1 ∧
          -((ν : ℝ) + 2) < W.im ∧ W.im < -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) }
      have hV_open : IsOpen V_open :=
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re) continuous_const).inter
          ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
            (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const))
      have hZ_in_V : Z ∈ V_open := by
        have h1 : |Z.re| < (ν : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hν_gt
        have h2 : -Z.im < (ν : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hν_gt
        have h3 : 1 / (-Z.im) < (ν : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hν_gt
        have hν2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (ν : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
        have h_inv : 1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2) < -Z.im := by
          have h3' : 1 / (-Z.im) < (ν : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
          exact (div_lt_iff₀ hν2_pos).mpr (by
            have := (div_lt_iff₀ hD_pos).mp h3'
            linarith)
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hV_sub : V_open ⊆ K_rect ν := fun W ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨h1.le, h2.le, h3.le⟩
      exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hV_open.mem_nhds hZ_in_V) hV_sub

    have hK_sub_lhp : ∀ ν : ℕ, K_rect ν ⊆ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      intro ν Z ⟨_, _, h_hi⟩
      change Z.im < 0
      have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
      linarith

    classical
    let limPair : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun Z =>
      if hZ : Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane then
        g_rect (Classical.choose (h_exh_nhds Z hZ)) Z
      else (0, 0)
    let F_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => (limPair Z).1
    let Q_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => (limPair Z).2

    have h_rect_eq : ∀ (μ : ℕ) (Z : ℂ), Z ∈ K_rect μ → g_rect μ Z = (F_lim Z, Q_lim Z) := by
      intro μ Z hZ_μ
      have hZ_lhp : Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := hK_sub_lhp μ hZ_μ
      let ν₀ := Classical.choose (h_exh_nhds Z hZ_lhp)
      have hZ_ν₀ : Z ∈ K_rect ν₀ := mem_of_mem_nhds (Classical.choose_spec (h_exh_nhds Z hZ_lhp))
      have ht1 := (hψ_unif μ).tendsto_at hZ_μ
      have ht2 := (hψ_unif ν₀).tendsto_at hZ_ν₀
      have h_eq := tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
      simpa [F_lim, Q_lim, limPair, hZ_lhp, ν₀] using h_eq

    have h_loc_pair : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun k Z => (F_seq (ψ k) Z, Q_seq (ψ k) Z))
        (fun Z => (F_lim Z, Q_lim Z)) Filter.atTop superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      refine tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_of_forall_exists_nhds fun Z hZ => ?_
      let ν₀ := Classical.choose (h_exh_nhds Z hZ)
      have h_nhds : K_rect ν₀ ∈ nhdsWithin Z superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Classical.choose_spec (h_exh_nhds Z hZ))
      refine ⟨K_rect ν₀, h_nhds, (hψ_unif ν₀).congr_right fun W hW => h_rect_eq ν₀ W hW⟩

    have hF_loc : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k Z => F_seq (ψ k) Z)
        F_lim Filter.atTop superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      rw [tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact h_lhp_open] at h_loc_pair ⊢
      intro K hK_sub hK_comp
      have hp := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (h_loc_pair K hK_sub hK_comp)
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      filter_upwards [hp ε hε] with k hk Z hZ
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) (by simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hk Z hZ)

    have hQ_loc : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k Z => Q_seq (ψ k) Z)
        Q_lim Filter.atTop superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      rw [tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact h_lhp_open] at h_loc_pair ⊢
      intro K hK_sub hK_comp
      have hp := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (h_loc_pair K hK_sub hK_comp)
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      filter_upwards [hp ε hε] with k hk Z hZ
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (by simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hk Z hZ)

    have h_holo_and_prod : ∀ Z₀ ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ F_lim Z₀ ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℂ Q_lim Z₀ ∧
        Q_lim Z₀ * F_lim Z₀ = 0 := by
      intro Z₀ hZ₀
      change Z₀.im < 0 at hZ₀
      have hD₀_pos : 0 < -Z₀.im := neg_pos.mpr hZ₀
      let ρ₀ : ℝ := (-Z₀.im) / 2
      have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := by dsimp [ρ₀]; positivity
      let B₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball Z₀ ρ₀
      have hB₀_sub : B₀ ⊆ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
        intro W hW
        have him_diff : |W.im - Z₀.im| < ρ₀ := by
          calc |W.im - Z₀.im| = |(W - Z₀).im| := by simp
            _ ≤ ‖W - Z₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (W - Z₀)
            _ = dist W Z₀ := (dist_eq_norm W Z₀).symm
            _ < ρ₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hW
        rw [abs_lt] at him_diff
        change W.im < 0
        dsimp [ρ₀] at him_diff
        linarith
      obtain ⟨K_B, hK_B⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (-Z₀.im))
      have h_ev_B₀ : ∀ k ≥ K_B,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_seq (ψ k)) B₀ ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (Q_seq (ψ k)) B₀ ∧
          (∀ W ∈ B₀, deriv (deriv (F_seq (ψ k))) W =
            ((R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * R.m_seq (φ (ψ k)) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
              Q_seq (ψ k) W * F_seq (ψ k) W) := by
        intro k hk
        refine h_local_hill B₀ (x_seq (ψ k)) (R.d_seq (φ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ (ψ k)))
          Metric.isOpen_ball (hm_pos _).ne' fun W hW => ?_
        have him_diff : |W.im - Z₀.im| < ρ₀ := by
          calc |W.im - Z₀.im| = |(W - Z₀).im| := by simp
            _ ≤ ‖W - Z₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (W - Z₀)
            _ = dist W Z₀ := (dist_eq_norm W Z₀).symm
            _ < ρ₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hW
        rw [abs_lt] at him_diff
        have hDW_pos : 0 < -W.im := neg_pos.mpr (hB₀_sub hW)
        have hDW_lt : -W.im < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (-Z₀.im) := by dsimp [ρ₀] at him_diff; linarith
        have hn_ge : K_B ≤ φ (ψ k) :=
          le_trans hk (le_trans (hψ.id_le k) (hφ.id_le (ψ k)))
        have h_exp_n : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (-Z₀.im) ≤ Real.exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (K_B : ℝ) ≤ (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn_ge
          have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)
          linarith
        have hd_le : R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [R.d_seq_eq]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [R.k_seq_ge (φ (ψ k))])
        have hdD_le : R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * (-W.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
          calc R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * (-W.im)
              ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)) * Real.exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) :=
                mul_le_mul hd_le (le_trans hDW_lt.le h_exp_n) hDW_pos.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        exact (h_rescaled_bounds (φ (ψ k)) (x_seq (ψ k)) W hDW_pos hdD_le).1

      have hF_B₀ : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => F_seq (ψ k)) F_lim Filter.atTop B₀ :=
        hF_loc.mono hB₀_sub
      have hQ_B₀ : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => Q_seq (ψ k)) Q_lim Filter.atTop B₀ :=
        hQ_loc.mono hB₀_sub
      have hF_ev_holo : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_seq (ψ k)) B₀ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨K_B, fun k hk => (h_ev_B₀ k hk).1⟩
      have hQ_ev_holo : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Q_seq (ψ k)) B₀ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨K_B, fun k hk => (h_ev_B₀ k hk).2.1⟩

      have hF_holo_B₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_lim B₀ :=
        hF_B₀.differentiableOn hF_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hQ_holo_B₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_lim B₀ :=
        hQ_B₀.differentiableOn hQ_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball

      have hF_d1_B₀ : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => deriv (F_seq (ψ k)))
          (deriv F_lim) Filter.atTop B₀ :=
        hF_B₀.deriv hF_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hF_d1_ev_holo : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (F_seq (ψ k))) B₀ :=
        hF_ev_holo.mono fun k hk => hk.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hF_d2_B₀ : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => deriv (deriv (F_seq (ψ k))))
          (deriv (deriv F_lim)) Filter.atTop B₀ :=
        hF_d1_B₀.deriv hF_d1_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball

      have hZ₀_mem_B₀ : Z₀ ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ₀_pos
      refine ⟨hF_holo_B₀.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ₀_mem_B₀),
        hQ_holo_B₀.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ₀_mem_B₀), ?_⟩

      let b_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * R.m_seq (φ (ψ k))
      let β : ℝ := R.α₂ - 1
      have hβ_pos : 0 < β := by dsimp [β]; linarith [R.one_lt_α₁, R.α₁_lt_α₂]
      have hb_lower : ∀ k : ℕ, β * (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ b_seq k := by
        intro k
        let n := φ (ψ k)
        have hn_ge : k ≤ n := le_trans (hψ.id_le k) (hφ.id_le (ψ k))
        have hk_ge : (k : ℝ) ≤ R.k_seq n := by
          have h1 := R.k_seq_ge n
          have h2 : (k : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn_ge
          linarith [R.one_le_k₀]
        have hb_exp : Real.exp (β * R.k_seq n) ≤ b_seq k := by
          dsimp [b_seq]
          rw [R.d_seq_eq n]
          calc Real.exp (β * R.k_seq n)
              = Real.exp (-R.k_seq n) * Real.exp (R.α₂ * R.k_seq n) := by
                rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; dsimp [β]; ring
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-R.k_seq n) * R.m_seq n :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (R.m_seq_lower n) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        have h_lin := Real.add_one_le_exp (β * R.k_seq n)
        nlinarith
      have hb_inv_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => (((b_seq k) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨N_ε, hN_ε⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((1 / ε) / β)
        refine ⟨N_ε, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        have hb_ge1 : 1 ≤ β * (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
          have : 0 ≤ β * (k : ℝ) := by positivity
          linarith
        have hb_k := hb_lower k
        have hb_pos : 0 < b_seq k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans hb_ge1 hb_k)
        have h_sq_ge : β * (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (b_seq k) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have hk_gt : (1 / ε) / β < (k : ℝ) :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hN_ε (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)
        have hβk_gt : 1 / ε < β * (k : ℝ) := by
          have := (div_lt_iff₀ hβ_pos).mp hk_gt
          linarith
        have h_inv_lt : ((b_seq k) ^ 2)⁻¹ < ε := by
          rw [inv_lt_comm₀ (by positivity) hε]
          rw [one_div] at hβk_gt
          linarith
        simpa [dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (b_seq k))] using h_inv_lt

      have h_prod_zero : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun k => (((b_seq k) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) * deriv (deriv (F_seq (ψ k))) Z₀)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hb_inv_tendsto.mul (hF_d2_B₀.tendsto_at hZ₀_mem_B₀)
      have h_prod_QF : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Q_seq (ψ k) Z₀ * F_seq (ψ k) Z₀)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Q_lim Z₀ * F_lim Z₀)) :=
        (hQ_B₀.tendsto_at hZ₀_mem_B₀).mul (hF_B₀.tendsto_at hZ₀_mem_B₀)
      have h_ev_eq : (fun k => Q_seq (ψ k) Z₀ * F_seq (ψ k) Z₀) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
          (fun k => (((b_seq k) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) * deriv (deriv (F_seq (ψ k))) Z₀) := by
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop K_B] with k hk
        rw [(h_ev_B₀ k hk).2.2 Z₀ hZ₀_mem_B₀]
        have hb_pos : 0 < b_seq k := mul_pos (hd_pos _) (hm_pos _)
        have hb_ne : (b_seq k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hb_pos.ne'
        dsimp [b_seq] at hb_ne ⊢
        field_simp [hb_ne]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_prod_QF (h_prod_zero.congr' h_ev_eq.symm)

    have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_lim superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
      fun Z hZ => (h_holo_and_prod Z hZ).1.differentiableWithinAt
    have hQ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_lim superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
      fun Z hZ => (h_holo_and_prod Z hZ).2.1.differentiableWithinAt

    have h_pure_or : (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, F_lim Z = 0) ∨
        (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, Q_lim Z = 0) := by
      by_cases hF_all : ∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, F_lim Z = 0
      · exact Or.inl hF_all
      · push Not at hF_all
        obtain ⟨Z_star, hZ_star_mem, hF_nz⟩ := hF_all
        right
        have hF_cont : ContinuousAt F_lim Z_star :=
          (h_holo_and_prod Z_star hZ_star_mem).1.continuousAt
        have hF_ev_nz : ∀ᶠ W in nhds Z_star, F_lim W ≠ 0 :=
          hF_cont.eventually_ne hF_nz
        have hQ_ev_zero : Q_lim =ᶠ[nhds Z_star] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
          filter_upwards [h_lhp_open.mem_nhds hZ_star_mem, hF_ev_nz] with W hW_lhp hFW_nz
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (h_holo_and_prod W hW_lhp).2.2).resolve_right hFW_nz
        have hQ_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Q_lim superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
          (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn h_lhp_open).mpr hQ_holo
        have h0_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
          (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn h_lhp_open).mpr
            (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ))
        exact fun Z hZ => hQ_anal.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h0_anal
          h_lhp_preconn hZ_star_mem hQ_ev_zero hZ

    have h_deep_decay : ∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im →
        max ‖F_lim Z‖ (Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖) ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) := by
      intro Z hZ hD1
      have hD_pos : 0 < -Z.im := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hD1
      obtain ⟨K_Z, hK_Z⟩ := exists_nat_ge (-Z.im)
      have h_ev_coarse : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop,
          ‖F_seq (ψ k) Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) ∧
          Real.sqrt ‖Q_seq (ψ k) Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) := by
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop K_Z] with k hk
        have hn_ge : K_Z ≤ φ (ψ k) :=
          le_trans hk (le_trans (hψ.id_le k) (hφ.id_le (ψ k)))
        have h_exp_n : -Z.im ≤ Real.exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : (K_Z : ℝ) ≤ (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn_ge
          have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)
          linarith
        have hd_le : R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)) := by
          rw [R.d_seq_eq]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [R.k_seq_ge (φ (ψ k))])
        have hdD_le : R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * (-Z.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
          calc R.d_seq (φ (ψ k)) * (-Z.im)
              ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀ - (φ (ψ k) : ℝ)) * Real.exp (φ (ψ k) : ℝ) :=
                mul_le_mul hd_le h_exp_n hD_pos.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
            _ = Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        exact (h_rescaled_bounds (φ (ψ k)) (x_seq (ψ k)) Z hD_pos hdD_le).2.1 hD1
      have hF_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ‖F_seq (ψ k) Z‖) Filter.atTop (nhds ‖F_lim Z‖) :=
        continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hF_loc.tendsto_at hZ)
      have hQ_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Real.sqrt ‖Q_seq (ψ k) Z‖)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖)) :=
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_norm).continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hQ_loc.tendsto_at hZ)
      exact max_le (le_of_tendsto hF_t (h_ev_coarse.mono fun _ h => h.1))
        (le_of_tendsto hQ_t (h_ev_coarse.mono fun _ h => h.2))

    exact ⟨ψ, F_lim, Q_lim, hψ, hF_holo, hQ_holo, hF_loc, hQ_loc, h_pure_or, h_deep_decay⟩

  refine ⟨hPure, ?_⟩

  
  by_contra hNoQuiet
  let K₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (-Complex.I) (1 / 8)
  have hK₀_comp : IsCompact K₀ := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hK₀_sub : K₀ ⊆ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro Z hZ
    have him : |Z.im - (-1)| ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      calc |Z.im - (-1)| = |(Z - (-Complex.I)).im| := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖Z - (-Complex.I)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = dist Z (-Complex.I) := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
        _ ≤ 1 / 8 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hZ
    rw [abs_le] at him
    change Z.im < 0
    linarith

  have h_step2a : ∃ (c₀ : ℝ) (N₁ : ℕ), 0 < c₀ ∧ ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ x : ℝ,
      (∃ Z ∈ K₀, c₀ ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖) ∨
      (∃ Z ∈ K₀, c₀ ≤ Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖) := by
    by_contra! h_bad
    have h_ex : ∀ (k N : ℕ), ∃ p : ℕ × ℝ, N ≤ p.1 ∧
        (∀ Z ∈ K₀, ‖superlinearRescaledF S p.2 (R.d_seq p.1) (R.m_seq p.1) Z‖ <
          1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
        (∀ Z ∈ K₀, Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S p.2 (R.d_seq p.1) (R.m_seq p.1) Z‖ <
          1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      intro k N
      obtain ⟨n, hn, x, hF, hQ⟩ := h_bad (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) N (by positivity)
      exact ⟨(n, x), hn, hF, hQ⟩
    choose nextP h_next_ge h_next_F h_next_Q using h_ex
    let seq₀ : ℕ → ℕ × ℝ :=
      Nat.rec (nextP 0 0) (fun k prev => nextP (k + 1) (prev.1 + 1))
    let φ₀ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => (seq₀ k).1
    let x₀ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (seq₀ k).2
    have hφ₀ : StrictMono φ₀ :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => h_next_ge (k + 1) ((seq₀ k).1 + 1)
    have h_small : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ Z ∈ K₀,
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S (x₀ k) (R.d_seq (φ₀ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₀ k)) Z‖ <
          1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S (x₀ k) (R.d_seq (φ₀ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₀ k)) Z‖ <
          1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro k Z hZ
      cases k with
      | zero => exact ⟨h_next_F 0 0 Z hZ, h_next_Q 0 0 Z hZ⟩
      | succ m =>
        exact ⟨h_next_F (m + 1) ((seq₀ m).1 + 1) Z hZ,
          h_next_Q (m + 1) ((seq₀ m).1 + 1) Z hZ⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, F_lim, Q_lim, hψ, hF_holo, hQ_holo, hF_conv, hQ_conv, _, _⟩ :=
      hPure φ₀ hφ₀ x₀
    have h_zero_K₀ : ∀ Z ∈ K₀, F_lim Z = 0 ∧ Q_lim Z = 0 := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hZ_lhp := hK₀_sub hZ
      have hF_t : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun k => ‖superlinearRescaledF S (x₀ (ψ k)) (R.d_seq (φ₀ (ψ k)))
            (R.m_seq (φ₀ (ψ k))) Z‖)
          Filter.atTop (nhds ‖F_lim Z‖) :=
        continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hF_conv.tendsto_at hZ_lhp)
      have hQ_t : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun k => Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S (x₀ (ψ k)) (R.d_seq (φ₀ (ψ k)))
            (R.m_seq (φ₀ (ψ k))) Z‖)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖)) :=
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_norm).continuousAt.tendsto.comp
          (hQ_conv.tendsto_at hZ_lhp)
      have hF_z : F_lim Z = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hpos : 0 < ‖F_lim Z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
        obtain ⟨N_b, hN_b⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ‖F_lim Z‖)
        have h_le : ‖F_lim Z‖ ≤ 1 / ((N_b : ℝ) + 1) := by
          refine le_of_tendsto hF_t (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N_b, fun k hk => ?_⟩)
          have hψk : N_b ≤ ψ k := le_trans hk (hψ.id_le k)
          have h_cast : (N_b : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (ψ k : ℝ) + 1 := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hψk 1
          exact le_trans (h_small (ψ k) Z hZ).1.le
            (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) h_cast)
        have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hpos).mp hN_b
        have h2 := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (N_b : ℝ) + 1)).mp h_le
        nlinarith
      have hQ_z : Q_lim Z = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hne)
        obtain ⟨N_b, hN_b⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖)
        have h_le : Real.sqrt ‖Q_lim Z‖ ≤ 1 / ((N_b : ℝ) + 1) := by
          refine le_of_tendsto hQ_t (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N_b, fun k hk => ?_⟩)
          have hψk : N_b ≤ ψ k := le_trans hk (hψ.id_le k)
          have h_cast : (N_b : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (ψ k : ℝ) + 1 := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hψk 1
          exact le_trans (h_small (ψ k) Z hZ).2.le
            (one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) h_cast)
        have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hpos).mp hN_b
        have h2 := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (N_b : ℝ) + 1)).mp h_le
        nlinarith
      exact ⟨hF_z, hQ_z⟩
    have h_negI_lhp : (-Complex.I) ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      change (-Complex.I).im < 0; simp
    have h_ball_nhds : Metric.ball (-Complex.I) (1 / 8) ∈ nhds (-Complex.I) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))
    have hF_ev0 : F_lim =ᶠ[nhds (-Complex.I)] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ball_nhds] with Z hZ
      exact (h_zero_K₀ Z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hZ)).1
    have hQ_ev0 : Q_lim =ᶠ[nhds (-Complex.I)] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ball_nhds] with Z hZ
      exact (h_zero_K₀ Z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hZ)).2
    have h0_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn h_lhp_open).mpr
        (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ))
    have hF_eq0 : Set.EqOn F_lim (fun _ => 0) superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
      ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn h_lhp_open).mpr hF_holo
        |>.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h0_anal h_lhp_preconn h_negI_lhp hF_ev0)
    have hQ_eq0 : Set.EqOn Q_lim (fun _ => 0) superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
      ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn h_lhp_open).mpr hQ_holo
        |>.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h0_anal h_lhp_preconn h_negI_lhp hQ_ev0)
    exact hNoQuiet ⟨φ₀ ∘ ψ, x₀ ∘ ψ, hφ₀.comp hψ,
      hF_conv.congr_right hF_eq0, hQ_conv.congr_right hQ_eq0⟩

  obtain ⟨c₀, N₁, hc₀_pos, hN₁⟩ := h_step2a

  have h_step2b : ∃ N₂ ≥ N₁, ∀ n ≥ N₂, ∀ x : ℝ,
      ¬ ((∃ Z₁ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z₁‖) ∧
         (∃ Z₂ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z₂‖)) := by
    by_contra! h_both
    have h_ex : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ × ℝ, N ≤ p.1 ∧
        (∃ Z₁ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S p.2 (R.d_seq p.1) (R.m_seq p.1) Z₁‖) ∧
        (∃ Z₂ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S p.2 (R.d_seq p.1) (R.m_seq p.1) Z₂‖) := by
      intro N
      obtain ⟨n, hn, x, h1, h2⟩ := h_both (max N N₁) (le_max_right _ _)
      exact ⟨(n, x), le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn, h1, h2⟩
    choose nextP h_ge h_F h_Q using h_ex
    let seq₁ : ℕ → ℕ × ℝ := Nat.rec (nextP 0) (fun _ prev => nextP (prev.1 + 1))
    let φ₁ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => (seq₁ k).1
    let x₁ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (seq₁ k).2
    have hφ₁ : StrictMono φ₁ :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => h_ge ((seq₁ k).1 + 1)
    have h_both_k : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∃ Z₁ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S (x₁ k) (R.d_seq (φ₁ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₁ k)) Z₁‖) ∧
        (∃ Z₂ ∈ K₀, (c₀ / 3) ^ 2 ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledQ S (x₁ k) (R.d_seq (φ₁ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₁ k)) Z₂‖) := by
      intro k
      have hk_raw : (∃ Z₁ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledF S (x₁ k) (R.d_seq (φ₁ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₁ k)) Z₁‖) ∧
          (∃ Z₂ ∈ K₀, c₀ / 3 ≤ Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S (x₁ k) (R.d_seq (φ₁ k)) (R.m_seq (φ₁ k)) Z₂‖) := by
        cases k with
        | zero => exact ⟨h_F 0, h_Q 0⟩
        | succ m => exact ⟨h_F ((seq₁ m).1 + 1), h_Q ((seq₁ m).1 + 1)⟩
      rcases hk_raw with ⟨h1, ⟨Z₂, hZ₂, h2⟩⟩
      refine ⟨h1, Z₂, hZ₂, ?_⟩
      rw [← Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h2 2
    obtain ⟨ψ, F_lim, Q_lim, _, _, _, hF_conv, hQ_conv, hPureOr, _⟩ := hPure φ₁ hφ₁ x₁
    have hF_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun k Z => superlinearRescaledF S (x₁ (ψ k)) (R.d_seq (φ₁ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ₁ (ψ k))) Z)
        F_lim Filter.atTop K₀ :=
      (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact h_lhp_open).mp hF_conv K₀ hK₀_sub hK₀_comp
    have hQ_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun k Z => superlinearRescaledQ S (x₁ (ψ k)) (R.d_seq (φ₁ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ₁ (ψ k))) Z)
        Q_lim Filter.atTop K₀ :=
      (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact h_lhp_open).mp hQ_conv K₀ hK₀_sub hK₀_comp
    rcases hPureOr with hF0 | hQ0
    · have hF_ev := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hF_unif) (c₀ / 3) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hF_ev.exists
      obtain ⟨Z₁, hZ₁, h_ge1⟩ := (h_both_k (ψ k)).1
      have h_lt := hk Z₁ hZ₁
      rw [hF0 Z₁ (hK₀_sub hZ₁), dist_zero_left] at h_lt
      linarith
    · have hQ_ev := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hQ_unif) ((c₀ / 3) ^ 2) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hQ_ev.exists
      obtain ⟨Z₂, hZ₂, h_ge2⟩ := (h_both_k (ψ k)).2
      have h_lt := hk Z₂ hZ₂
      rw [hQ0 Z₂ (hK₀_sub hZ₂), dist_zero_left] at h_lt
      linarith

  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂_ge, hN₂⟩ := h_step2b

  have hK₀_in_strip : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ), Z ∈ K₀ →
      (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro n x Z hZ
    have him : |Z.im - (-1)| ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      calc |Z.im - (-1)| = |(Z - (-Complex.I)).im| := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖Z - (-Complex.I)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = dist Z (-Complex.I) := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
        _ ≤ 1 / 8 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hZ
    rw [abs_le] at him
    have hd_le_half : R.d_seq n ≤ S.H / 2 := by
      rw [R.d_seq_eq n]
      have hk_ge : R.k₀ ≤ R.k_seq n := by
        have := R.k_seq_ge n
        linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
      exact le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) R.exp_neg_k₀_le_half_H
    have hd : 0 < R.d_seq n := hd_pos n
    change |((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z).im| < S.H
    have him_pt : ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z).im =
        S.H + R.d_seq n * Z.im := by simp
    rw [him_pt, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [S.H_pos]

  let U_F : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n =>
    ⋃ Z ∈ K₀, { x : ℝ | c₀ / 2 < ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ }
  let U_Q : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n =>
    ⋃ Z ∈ K₀, { x : ℝ | c₀ / 2 < Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq n) (R.m_seq n) Z‖ }

  have hUF_open : ∀ n : ℕ, IsOpen (U_F n) := by
    intro n
    refine isOpen_biUnion fun Z hZ => isOpen_lt continuous_const ?_
    have h_map_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z) := by fun_prop
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous h_map_cont (fun x => hK₀_in_strip n x Z hZ)
    exact continuous_norm.comp (continuous_const.mul hf_cont)

  have hUQ_open : ∀ n : ℕ, IsOpen (U_Q n) := by
    intro n
    refine isOpen_biUnion fun Z hZ => isOpen_lt continuous_const ?_
    have h_map_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z) := by fun_prop
    have hq_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (R.d_seq n : ℂ) * Z)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous h_map_cont (fun x => hK₀_in_strip n x Z hZ)
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_const.mul hq_cont))

  have h_dich_n : ∀ n ≥ N₂, (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ U_F n) ∨ (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ U_Q n) := by
    intro n hn
    have h_cov : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ U_F n ∪ U_Q n := by
      intro x _
      rcases hN₁ n (le_trans hN₂_ge hn) x with ⟨Z, hZ, hF⟩ | ⟨Z, hZ, hQ⟩
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_biUnion hZ (by change c₀ / 2 < _; linarith))
      · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion hZ (by change c₀ / 2 < _; linarith))
    have h_disj : Disjoint (U_F n) (U_Q n) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxF hxQ
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hxF hxQ
      rcases hxF with ⟨Z₁, hZ₁, hF1⟩
      rcases hxQ with ⟨Z₂, hZ₂, hQ2⟩
      change c₀ / 2 < _ at hF1 hQ2
      exact hN₂ n hn x ⟨⟨Z₁, hZ₁, by linarith⟩, ⟨Z₂, hZ₂, by linarith⟩⟩
    rcases h_cov (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) with h0F | h0Q
    · left
      have h_sub := IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union (hUF_open n) (hUQ_open n)
        h_disj h_cov ⟨0, Set.mem_univ 0, h0F⟩ isPreconnected_univ
      exact fun x => h_sub (Set.mem_univ x)
    · right
      have h_sub := IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union (hUQ_open n) (hUF_open n)
        h_disj.symm (by rwa [Set.union_comm] at h_cov) ⟨0, Set.mem_univ 0, h0Q⟩ isPreconnected_univ
      exact fun x => h_sub (Set.mem_univ x)

  have h_all_Q_tail : ∃ N₃ ≥ N₂, ∀ n ≥ N₃, ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ U_Q n := by
    by_contra! h_no_N₃
    have h_ex : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ N, ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ U_F n := by
      intro N
      obtain ⟨n, hn_ge, x_bad, hx_not_Q⟩ := h_no_N₃ (max N N₂) (le_max_right _ _)
      have hF_or_Q := h_dich_n n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_ge)
      refine ⟨n, le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_ge, ?_⟩
      rcases hF_or_Q with hF_all | hQ_all
      · exact hF_all
      · exact False.elim (hx_not_Q (hQ_all x_bad))
    choose nextN h_nextN_ge h_nextN_F using h_ex
    let φ_F : ℕ → ℕ := Nat.rec (nextN 0) (fun _ prev => nextN (prev + 1))
    have hφ_F : StrictMono φ_F :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => h_nextN_ge (φ_F k + 1)
    refine hNoAllF φ_F hφ_F (c₀ / 2) (by positivity) fun k x => ?_
    have hx_in : x ∈ U_F (φ_F k) := by
      cases k with
      | zero => exact h_nextN_F 0 x
      | succ m => exact h_nextN_F (φ_F m + 1) x
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hx_in
    rcases hx_in with ⟨Z, hZ, hgt⟩
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, le_of_lt hgt⟩

  obtain ⟨N₃, _, hN₃⟩ := h_all_Q_tail
  let φ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => N₃ + k + 1
  have hφ : StrictMono φ := fun a b hab => by dsimp [φ]; omega
  let c₁ : ℝ := (c₀ / 2) ^ 2
  have hc₁_pos : 0 < c₁ := by dsimp [c₁]; positivity
  have hAllQ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ Z ∈ K₀,
      c₁ ≤ ‖superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z‖ := by
    intro k x
    have hx := hN₃ (φ k) (by dsimp [φ]; omega) x
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨Z, hZ, hgt⟩
    change c₀ / 2 < _ at hgt
    refine ⟨Z, hZ, ?_⟩
    rw [← Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hgt.le 2

  let M_F : ℝ := (4 : ℝ) ^ R.P
  have hM_F_pos : 0 < M_F := by dsimp [M_F]; positivity
  let B_78 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (-Complex.I) (7 / 8)
  let K_34 : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (-Complex.I) (3 / 4)

  have h_step4 : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ x : ℝ,
      1 ≤ R.m_seq (φ k) *
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) (-Complex.I)‖ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k))) B_78 ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ K_34,
        ‖superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z‖ ≤ M_F) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ B_78,
        deriv (deriv (superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)))) Z =
          ((R.d_seq (φ k) * R.m_seq (φ k) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
            superlinearRescaledQ S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z *
            superlinearRescaledF S x (R.d_seq (φ k)) (R.m_seq (φ k)) Z) := by
    intro k
    let n := φ k
    have hn_ge_one : 1 ≤ n := by dsimp [n, φ]; omega
    let d := R.d_seq n
    let m := R.m_seq n
    have hd : 0 < d := hd_pos n
    have hm : 0 < m := hm_pos n
    have hd_le_half_k₀ : d ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) / 2 := by
      dsimp [d]
      rw [R.d_seq_eq n]
      have hk_ge : R.k₀ + 1 ≤ R.k_seq n := by
        have h1 := R.k_seq_ge n
        have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn_ge_one
        linarith
      have hexp1 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp 1
        linarith
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (-R.k_seq n) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) * (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have hinv_le : (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hexp1
      calc Real.exp (-R.k_seq n)
          ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) * (Real.exp 1)⁻¹ := hexp_le
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) * (1 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-R.k₀) / 2 := by ring
    have hd_le_quarter_H : d ≤ S.H / 4 := by
      linarith [R.exp_neg_k₀_le_half_H]
    let h_row : ℝ := S.H - d
    let γ_row : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (t : ℂ) + (h_row : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hγ_mem : ∀ t : ℝ, γ_row t ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro t
      change |(γ_row t).im| < S.H
      have him : (γ_row t).im = S.H - d := by simp [γ_row, h_row]
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
    have hγ_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => S.ϕ (γ_row s)) (S.f (γ_row t)) t := by
      intro t
      have h_ofR : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp
      have hγ_d : HasDerivAt γ_row (1 : ℂ) t := h_ofR.add_const ((h_row : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have hϕ_at : HasDerivAt S.ϕ (S.f (γ_row t)) (γ_row t) := by
        have hd_at := (S.ϕ_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (hγ_mem t))).hasDerivAt
        rwa [S.deriv_ϕ (γ_row t) (hγ_mem t)] at hd_at
      have h_sc := hϕ_at.scomp t hγ_d
      rw [one_smul] at h_sc
      exact h_sc
    have hf_row_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => S.f (γ_row t)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) hγ_mem
    have h_int_eq : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), S.f (γ_row t)) = (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hγ_deriv t)
        (hf_row_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      have h_shift : γ_row (2 * Real.pi) = γ_row 0 + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [γ_row]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h_shift, S.ϕ_quasiperiodic (γ_row 0) (hγ_mem 0)]
      ring
    have h_Icc_ne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, le_rfl, by positivity⟩
    obtain ⟨x, _, hx_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn h_Icc_ne
      (continuous_norm.comp hf_row_cont).continuousOn
    have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    have h_int_norm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 2 * Real.pi) (C := ‖S.f (γ_row x)‖)
      (f := fun t => S.f (γ_row t)) fun t ht => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le h2pi_pos.le] at ht
        exact hx_max ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
    rw [h_int_eq] at h_int_norm
    have h_lhs_norm : ‖((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = 2 * Real.pi :=
      Complex.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_pos.le
    have h_abs_2pi : |2 * Real.pi - 0| = 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos h2pi_pos]
    have h_fx_ge_one : 1 ≤ ‖S.f (γ_row x)‖ := by
      have h_in : 2 * Real.pi ≤ ‖S.f (γ_row x)‖ * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        simpa [h_lhs_norm, h_abs_2pi] using h_int_norm
      nlinarith
    have h_pt_eq : (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * (-Complex.I) = γ_row x := by
      dsimp [γ_row, h_row]; push_cast; ring
    have h_norm_wit : 1 ≤ m * ‖superlinearRescaledF S x d m (-Complex.I)‖ := by
      unfold superlinearRescaledF
      rw [h_pt_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le),
        ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm.ne', one_mul]
      exact h_fx_ge_one

    have h_B78_bounds : ∀ Z ∈ B_78,
        0 < -Z.im ∧ d * (-Z.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
      intro Z hZ
      have him : |Z.im - (-1)| < 7 / 8 := by
        calc |Z.im - (-1)| = |(Z - (-Complex.I)).im| := by simp
          _ ≤ ‖Z - (-Complex.I)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ = dist Z (-Complex.I) := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
          _ < 7 / 8 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hZ
      rw [abs_lt] at him
      have hD_pos : 0 < -Z.im := by linarith
      have hD_lt : -Z.im < 15 / 8 := by linarith
      have hdD : d * (-Z.im) ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by
        calc d * (-Z.im)
            ≤ (Real.exp (-R.k₀) / 2) * (15 / 8) :=
              mul_le_mul hd_le_half_k₀ hD_lt.le hD_pos.le (by positivity)
          _ = (15 / 16) * Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by ring
          _ ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-R.k₀)]
      exact ⟨hD_pos, hdD⟩

    obtain ⟨hF_holo_B, _, hF_ode_B⟩ := h_local_hill B_78 x d m Metric.isOpen_ball hm.ne'
      (fun Z hZ => (h_rescaled_bounds n x Z (h_B78_bounds Z hZ).1 (h_B78_bounds Z hZ).2).1)

  obtain ⟨r_c, hr_c_lo, hr_c_hi, hr_c_nz⟩ := h_exists_rc

  have h_align : ∀ w ∈ S_c, ∃ e : ℂ, ‖e‖ = 1 ∧

  let c' : ℝ := (9 / 40) * m_Q

        have h1 : dist (Φ_w (v : ℂ)) w < 1 / 4 := by

        intro v hv

          Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hg_d1 v hv)
        have him : HasDerivAt (fun x => (g x).im) (g₁ v).im v :=
          Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hg_d1 v hv)
        have hre1 : HasDerivAt (fun x => (g₁ x).re) (g₂ v).re v :=
          Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hg_d2 v hv)
        have him1 : HasDerivAt (fun x => (g₁ x).im) (g₂ v).im v :=
          Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt v (hg_d2 v hv)
        exact (((hre.mul hre1).add (him.mul him1)).const_mul 2)

      have hu_subsol : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ, μ ^ 2 * u v ≤ u₂ v := by
        intro v hv
        have hv_open : v ∈ I_open := ⟨by linarith [hv.1, hδ_le_eighth],
          by linarith [hv.2, hδ_le_eighth]⟩
        have h_ode := hF_row_ode (ψ j) (Φ_w (v : ℂ)) (hI_in_B78 v hv_open)
        let W : ℂ := e ^ 2 * Q_sub j (Φ_w (v : ℂ))
        have hg₂_eq : g₂ v = ((b ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (W * g v) := by
          dsimp [g₂, g, W, b, b_sub, Q_sub]
          rw [h_ode]
          push_cast
          ring
        have h_dot : (g v).re * (g₂ v).re + (g v).im * (g₂ v).im =
            b ^ 2 * W.re * u v := by
          rw [hg₂_eq]
          simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
            zero_mul, sub_zero, add_zero]
          dsimp [u]
          ring
        have hW_re : c' ≤ W.re := he_re j hj v hv
        have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u v := by dsimp [u]; positivity
        have h_u₂_simp : u₂ v = 2 * ((g₁ v).re ^ 2 + (g₁ v).im ^ 2) +
            2 * b ^ 2 * W.re * u v := by
          dsimp [u₂]
          linear_combination 2 * h_dot
        rw [h_u₂_simp, hμ_sq]
        have h_g₁_nn : 0 ≤ (g₁ v).re ^ 2 + (g₁ v).im ^ 2 := by positivity
        have h_term : c' * (b ^ 2 * u v) ≤ W.re * (b ^ 2 * u v) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW_re (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg b) hu_nn)
        linarith

      let C_B : ℝ := M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ)
      let B_bar : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => C_B * Real.cosh (μ * v)
      let B₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => C_B * (Real.sinh (μ * v) * μ)
      let B₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => C_B * (Real.cosh (μ * v) * μ * μ)
      have hB_d1 : ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt B_bar (B₁ v) v := fun v => by
        have hm : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => μ * x) μ v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul μ
        exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_cosh (μ * v)).comp v hm).const_mul C_B
      have hB_d2 : ∀ v : ℝ, HasDerivAt B₁ (B₂ v) v := fun v => by
        have hm : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => μ * x) μ v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul μ
        exact (((Real.hasDerivAt_sinh (μ * v)).comp v hm).mul_const μ).const_mul C_B

      let ψ_bar : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => u v - B_bar v
      let ψ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => u₁ v - B₁ v
      let ψ₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => u₂ v - B₂ v
      have hψ_d1 : ∀ v ∈ I_open, HasDerivAt ψ_bar (ψ₁ v) v :=
        fun v hv => (hu_d1 v hv).sub (hB_d1 v)
      have hψ_d2 : ∀ v ∈ I_open, HasDerivAt ψ₁ (ψ₂ v) v :=
        fun v hv => (hu_d2 v hv).sub (hB_d2 v)

      have h_Icc_sub_open : Set.Icc (-δ) δ ⊆ I_open := fun v hv =>
        ⟨by linarith [hv.1, hδ_le_eighth], by linarith [hv.2, hδ_le_eighth]⟩

      have hu_norm_sq : ∀ v : ℝ, u v = ‖g v‖ ^ 2 := fun v => by
        rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; dsimp [u]; ring

      have h_bdry_cap : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ, u v ≤ M_F ^ 2 := by
        intro v hv
        rw [hu_norm_sq]
        have hZ_K34 : Φ_w (v : ℂ) ∈ K_34 := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
          have hv_abs : |v| ≤ δ := abs_le.mpr ⟨hv.1, hv.2⟩
          have h1 : dist (Φ_w (v : ℂ)) w ≤ δ := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]
            have hsub : Φ_w (v : ℂ) - w = e * (v : ℂ) := by dsimp [Φ_w]; ring
            rw [hsub, norm_mul, he_norm, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact hv_abs
          calc dist (Φ_w (v : ℂ)) (-Complex.I)
              ≤ dist (Φ_w (v : ℂ)) w + dist w (-Complex.I) := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ δ + r_c := add_le_add h1 (Metric.mem_sphere.mp hw).le
            _ ≤ 3 / 4 := by linarith
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hF_row_cap (ψ j) _ hZ_K34) 2

      have hψ_pos_bdry : ψ_bar δ ≤ 0 ∧ ψ_bar (-δ) ≤ 0 := by
        have hcosh_ne : Real.cosh (μ * δ) ≠ 0 := (Real.cosh_pos (μ * δ)).ne'
        have hB_pos : B_bar δ = M_F ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [B_bar, C_B]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ (M_F ^ 2) hcosh_ne
        have hB_neg : B_bar (-δ) = M_F ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [B_bar, C_B]
          have : μ * (-δ) = -(μ * δ) := by ring
          rw [this, Real.cosh_neg]
          exact div_mul_cancel₀ (M_F ^ 2) hcosh_ne
        exact ⟨by dsimp [ψ_bar]; linarith [h_bdry_cap δ ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩],
               by dsimp [ψ_bar]; linarith [h_bdry_cap (-δ) ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩]⟩

      have hψ_zero_nonpos : ψ_bar 0 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra h_gt0
        push Not at h_gt0
        have hψ_cont : ContinuousOn ψ_bar (Set.Icc (-δ) δ) := fun v hv =>
          (hψ_d1 v (h_Icc_sub_open hv)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀_mem, hv₀_max⟩ :=
          isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, h0_mem⟩ hψ_cont
        have hψ_v₀_pos : 0 < ψ_bar v₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le h_gt0 (hv₀_max h0_mem)
        have hv₀_lt_hi : v₀ < δ := lt_of_le_of_ne hv₀_mem.2 fun h_eq => by
          rw [h_eq] at hψ_v₀_pos; linarith [hψ_pos_bdry.1]
        have hv₀_gt_lo : -δ < v₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hv₀_mem.1 fun h_eq => by
          rw [← h_eq] at hψ_v₀_pos; linarith [hψ_pos_bdry.2]
        have h_loc_max : IsLocalMax ψ_bar v₀ :=
          hv₀_max.isLocalMax (Icc_mem_nhds hv₀_gt_lo hv₀_lt_hi)
        have hψ₁_v₀ : ψ₁ v₀ = 0 :=
          h_loc_max.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (hψ_d1 v₀ (h_Icc_sub_open hv₀_mem))
        have h_ev_pos : ∀ᶠ x in nhds v₀, 0 < ψ_bar x :=
          (tendsto_order.mp (hψ_d1 v₀ (h_Icc_sub_open hv₀_mem)).continuousAt).1 0 hψ_v₀_pos
        obtain ⟨r_nhd, hr_nhd_pos, hr_nhd⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_ev_pos
        let η : ℝ := min (r_nhd / 2) ((δ - v₀) / 2)
        have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith)
        let J_seg : Set ℝ := Set.Icc v₀ (v₀ + η)
        have hJ_sub : J_seg ⊆ Set.Icc (-δ) δ := fun x hx =>
          ⟨by linarith [hv₀_mem.1, hx.1],
           by have : η ≤ (δ - v₀) / 2 := min_le_right _ _; linarith [hx.2]⟩
        have hψ₂_pos_J : ∀ x ∈ J_seg, 0 < ψ₂ x := by
          intro x hx
          have hx_dist : dist x v₀ < r_nhd := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hx.1])]
            have : η ≤ r_nhd / 2 := min_le_left _ _
            linarith [hx.2]
          have hψ_x_pos : 0 < ψ_bar x := hr_nhd hx_dist
          have hu₂_ge := hu_subsol x (hJ_sub hx)
          have hB₂_eq : B₂ x = μ ^ 2 * B_bar x := by dsimp [B₂, B_bar]; ring
          dsimp [ψ₂, ψ_bar] at hψ_x_pos ⊢
          rw [hB₂_eq]
          have h_mul : 0 < μ ^ 2 * (u x - B_bar x) :=
            mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hμ_pos) hψ_x_pos
          linarith
        have hψ₁_mono : StrictMonoOn ψ₁ J_seg := by
          refine strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (convex_Icc v₀ (v₀ + η))
            (fun x hx => (hψ_d2 x (h_Icc_sub_open (hJ_sub hx))).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
            (fun x hx => (hψ_d2 x (h_Icc_sub_open (hJ_sub (interior_subset hx)))).hasDerivWithinAt)
            (fun x hx => hψ₂_pos_J x (interior_subset hx))
        have hψ_mono : StrictMonoOn ψ_bar J_seg := by
          refine strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (convex_Icc v₀ (v₀ + η))
            (hψ_cont.mono hJ_sub)
            (fun x hx => (hψ_d1 x (h_Icc_sub_open (hJ_sub (interior_subset hx)))).hasDerivWithinAt)
            fun x hx => ?_
          rw [interior_Icc] at hx
          have h_lt := hψ₁_mono ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩ ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩ hx.1
          rwa [hψ₁_v₀] at h_lt
        have h_gt_end : ψ_bar v₀ < ψ_bar (v₀ + η) :=
          hψ_mono ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩ ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩ (by linarith)
        have h_le_end : ψ_bar (v₀ + η) ≤ ψ_bar v₀ :=
          hv₀_max (hJ_sub ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩)
        linarith

      have hu0_le : ‖F_sub j w‖ ^ 2 ≤ M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ) := by
        have h1 : u 0 ≤ B_bar 0 := by dsimp [ψ_bar] at hψ_zero_nonpos; linarith
        have hg0 : g 0 = F_sub j w := by simp [g, Φ_w]
        have hB0 : B_bar 0 = M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ) := by simp [B_bar, C_B]
        rw [hu_norm_sq 0, hg0] at h1
        rwa [hB0] at h1

      have h_cosh_lower : Real.exp (μ * δ) / 2 ≤ Real.cosh (μ * δ) := by
        rw [Real.cosh_eq]
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-(μ * δ))]
      have h_div_le : M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ) ≤ (2 * M_F * Real.exp (-c_dec * b)) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ) ≤ M_F ^ 2 / (Real.exp (μ * δ) / 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg M_F) (by positivity) h_cosh_lower
        have h2 : M_F ^ 2 / (Real.exp (μ * δ) / 2) = 2 * M_F ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(μ * δ)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_neg]; field_simp
        have h_exp_eq : Real.exp (-(μ * δ)) = (Real.exp (-c_dec * b)) ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          dsimp [μ, c_dec]
          ring
        rw [h2, h_exp_eq] at h1
        calc M_F ^ 2 / Real.cosh (μ * δ)
            ≤ 2 * M_F ^ 2 * (Real.exp (-c_dec * b)) ^ 2 := h1
          _ ≤ 4 * M_F ^ 2 * (Real.exp (-c_dec * b)) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith [sq_nonneg (M_F * Real.exp (-c_dec * b))]
          _ = (2 * M_F * Real.exp (-c_dec * b)) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_sq_final := le_trans hu0_le h_div_le
      exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq_final (by positivity)).2

    have h_cb_rc_sub : Metric.closedBall (-Complex.I) r_c ⊆ B_78 :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (F_sub j) (Metric.ball (-Complex.I) r_c) :=
      ⟨(hF_row_holo (ψ j)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans h_cb_rc_sub),
       (hF_row_holo (ψ j)).continuousOn.mono
         (by rw [closure_ball (-Complex.I) hr_c_pos.ne']; exact h_cb_rc_sub)⟩
    have h_fr : ∀ w ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (-Complex.I) r_c),
        ‖F_sub j w‖ ≤ 2 * M_F * Real.exp (-c_dec * b) := by
      rw [frontier_ball (-Complex.I) hr_c_pos.ne']
      exact h_sphere_bound
    exact Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball h_dc h_fr
      (subset_closure (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_c_pos))

  let β : ℝ := R.α₂ - 1
  have hβ_pos : 0 < β := by dsimp [β]; linarith [R.one_lt_α₁, R.α₁_lt_α₂]
  let C_top : ℝ := R.P + max (Real.log (2 * M_F)) 0
  have hC_top_pos : 0 < C_top := by
    dsimp [C_top]
    have : 0 ≤ max (Real.log (2 * M_F)) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    linarith [hP_pos]
  let K_thresh : ℝ := 4 * C_top / (c_dec * β ^ 2)
  let j_bad : ℕ := max N₀ (Nat.ceil K_thresh + 1)
  have hj_ge_N₀ : N₀ ≤ j_bad := le_max_left _ _
  let n_bad : ℕ := φ (ψ j_bad)
  let κ : ℝ := R.k_seq n_bad
  have hκ_gt_thresh : K_thresh < κ := by
    have hj_ge_ceil : Nat.ceil K_thresh + 1 ≤ j_bad := le_max_right _ _
    have hn_ge_j : j_bad ≤ n_bad := le_trans (hψ.id_le j_bad) (hφ.id_le (ψ j_bad))
    have h1 : K_thresh ≤ (Nat.ceil K_thresh : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil K_thresh
    have h2 : (Nat.ceil K_thresh : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (n_bad : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast le_trans hj_ge_ceil hn_ge_j
    have h3 := R.k_seq_ge n_bad
    linarith [R.one_le_k₀]
  have hκ_ge_one : 1 ≤ κ := by
    have h3 := R.k_seq_ge n_bad
    linarith [R.one_le_k₀, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n_bad]

  have hb_quad : (β ^ 2 / 4) * κ ^ 2 < b_sub j_bad := by
    have hb_exp : Real.exp (β * κ) ≤ b_sub j_bad := by
      dsimp [b_sub, n_bad, κ]
      rw [R.d_seq_eq n_bad]
      calc Real.exp (β * R.k_seq n_bad)
          = Real.exp (-R.k_seq n_bad) * Real.exp (R.α₂ * R.k_seq n_bad) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; dsimp [β]; ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-R.k_seq n_bad) * R.m_seq n_bad :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (R.m_seq_lower n_bad) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h_half_exp : β * κ / 2 + 1 ≤ Real.exp (β * κ / 2) := Real.add_one_le_exp (β * κ / 2)
    have h_sq_exp : (β * κ / 2 + 1) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (β * κ) := by
      have h_eq : Real.exp (β * κ / 2) ^ 2 = Real.exp (β * κ) := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_half_exp 2
    have h_strict : (β ^ 2 / 4) * κ ^ 2 < (β * κ / 2 + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_strict (le_trans h_sq_exp hb_exp)

  have h_one_le_prod : 1 ≤ Real.exp (R.P * κ + Real.log (2 * M_F) - c_dec * b_sub j_bad) := by
    have h_wit : 1 ≤ R.m_seq n_bad * ‖F_sub j_bad (-Complex.I)‖ := hx_norm (ψ j_bad)
    have h_dec := h_center_decay j_bad hj_ge_N₀
    have h_m_up := R.m_seq_upper n_bad
    calc (1 : ℝ)
        ≤ R.m_seq n_bad * ‖F_sub j_bad (-Complex.I)‖ := h_wit
      _ ≤ Real.exp (R.P * κ) * (2 * M_F * Real.exp (-c_dec * b_sub j_bad)) :=
          mul_le_mul h_m_up h_dec (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp (R.P * κ) * (Real.exp (Real.log (2 * M_F)) *
            Real.exp (-c_dec * b_sub j_bad)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
      _ = Real.exp (R.P * κ + Real.log (2 * M_F) - c_dec * b_sub j_bad) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring

  have h_exp_arg_nn : 0 ≤ R.P * κ + Real.log (2 * M_F) - c_dec * b_sub j_bad := by
    rw [← Real.exp_zero] at h_one_le_prod
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mp h_one_le_prod

  have h_lin_upper : R.P * κ + Real.log (2 * M_F) ≤ C_top * κ := by
    have h_log_le : Real.log (2 * M_F) ≤ max (Real.log (2 * M_F)) 0 * κ := by
      have h1 : Real.log (2 * M_F) ≤ max (Real.log (2 * M_F)) 0 := le_max_left _ _
      have h2 : 0 ≤ max (Real.log (2 * M_F)) 0 := le_max_right _ _
      nlinarith
    dsimp [C_top]
    linarith

  have h_quad_gt : C_top * κ < c_dec * b_sub j_bad := by
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < c_dec * β ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h1 : 4 * C_top < κ * (c_dec * β ^ 2) := (div_lt_iff₀ h_denom_pos).mp hκ_gt_thresh
    calc C_top * κ
        < (c_dec * (β ^ 2 / 4) * κ) * κ := by nlinarith [hκ_ge_one]
      _ = c_dec * ((β ^ 2 / 4) * κ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ < c_dec * b_sub j_bad := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hb_quad hc_dec_pos
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hH_open : IsOpen superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  have hH_conv : Convex ℝ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    change (a • x + b • y).im < 0
    change x.im < 0 at hx
    change y.im < 0 at hy
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at hab ⊢
      nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  have hH_preconn : IsPreconnected superlinearLowerHalfPlane := hH_conv.isPreconnected
  let rescaledLift : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ d m Y =>
    (S.𝔰 ((ξ : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Y, ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) -
      (ξ : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d : ℂ)
  let δ_b : ℝ := min (Real.exp (-R.k₀)) (S.H / 3)
  have hδb_pos : 0 < δ_b := lt_min (Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  have hδb_le_exp : δ_b ≤ Real.exp (-R.k₀) := min_le_left _ _
  have hδb_le_third : δ_b ≤ S.H / 3 := min_le_right _ _
  have hδb_lt_half : δ_b < S.H / 2 := by linarith [S.H_pos, hδb_le_third]
  have h1_lt_α₂ : 1 < R.α₂ := lt_trans R.one_lt_α₁ R.α₁_lt_α₂
  have hk_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 + (n : ℝ) ≤ R.k_seq n := fun n => by
    linarith [R.one_le_k₀, R.k_seq_ge n]
  have hk_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < R.k_seq n := fun n => by

  have hStrip_base : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ b → ∃ N_ab : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_ab,

  obtain ⟨L_anc, δ_star_anc, _, hδs_anc_pos, hδs_anc_lt, hConeK_anc⟩ :=
