      dsimp [d, r]
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hd_n_pos.le]
      calc (ε_anc / (2 / m_n)) * (D_base ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))
          = ((ε_anc * D_base ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) / 2) * m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
            field_simp [hm_n_pos.ne']
        _ = m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by rw [hε_D_base_eq]; ring
    have h_sq_le : (1 + (ε_anc / r) * d ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
        4 * m_n ^ 2 * d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h_term1]
      have h_ge1 : 1 ≤ m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := hmd_34_ge_one n
      have h_le2 : 1 + m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) := by linarith
      have hd_sq : (d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) = d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hd_n_pos.le]
        norm_num
      calc (1 + m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2
          ≤ (2 * (m_n * d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_le2 2
        _ = 4 * m_n ^ 2 * (d_n ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by ring
        _ = 4 * m_n ^ 2 * d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [hd_sq]
    have h_exp_simp : (1 : ℝ) - 2 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [h_exp_simp] at h_disp
    have h_rhs_le :
        C_cp_anc * (1 + (ε_anc / r) * d ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2 *
          (D * d_n) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * d_n := by
      have h_mul_le :
          C_cp_anc * (1 + (ε_anc / r) * d ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            (D * d_n) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤
          C_cp_anc * (4 * m_n ^ 2 * d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            (D * d_n) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq_le hC_cp_anc_pos.le
      refine le_trans h_mul_le (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [Real.mul_rpow hD_pos.le hd_n_pos.le]
      have hd_prod : d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = d_n := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hd_n_pos]
        norm_num
      have hm_cancel : m_n ^ 2 * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2 = 1 := by field_simp [hm_n_pos.ne']
      calc C_cp_anc * (4 * m_n ^ 2 * d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            (D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * d_n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))
          = 4 * C_cp_anc * (m_n ^ 2 * (m_n⁻¹) ^ 2) * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
              (d_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_n ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) := by ring
        _ = C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * d_n := by rw [hm_cancel, hd_prod]; dsimp [C₁]; ring
    have hs_norm_le : ‖S.𝔰 p - p.1‖ ≤ C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * d_n :=
      le_trans h_disp h_rhs_le
    have h_lift_diff_eq :
        rescaledLift ξ d_n m_n Y_pt - Y_pt = (S.𝔰 p - p.1) / (d_n : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [rescaledLift, p]
      have hd_ne : (d_n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hd_n_pos.ne'
      field_simp [hd_ne]
      ring
    rw [h_lift_diff_eq, norm_div]
    have hd_norm : ‖(d_n : ℂ)‖ = d_n := by simp [abs_of_pos hd_n_pos]
    rw [hd_norm, div_le_iff₀ hd_n_pos]
    exact hs_norm_le

  
  obtain ⟨ψ, F, Q, hψ, hF_holo, hQ_holo, hF_conv, hQ_conv, hPureFQ, hTailFQ⟩ :=
    hPure φ hφ (fun k => R.x_max (φ k))
  let G_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k =>
    rescaledLift (R.x_max (φ (ψ k))) (R.d_seq (φ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ (ψ k)))
  have hStrip : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ b → ∃ K_ab : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K_ab,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_seq k) { Y : ℂ | -b < Y.im ∧ Y.im < -a } ∧
      ∀ Y : ℂ, -b < Y.im → Y.im < -a → G_seq k Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro a b ha hab
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hWidth_φ a ha
    obtain ⟨N_ab, hN_ab⟩ := hStrip_base a b ha hab
    refine ⟨max K₁ N_ab, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    have h_ge_K₁ : K₁ ≤ ψ k := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) (hψ.id_le k)
    have h_ge_Nab : N_ab ≤ φ (ψ k) :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk) ((hφ.comp hψ).id_le k)
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hK₁ (ψ k) h_ge_K₁
    exact hN_ab (φ (ψ k)) h_ge_Nab hw1 hw2 (R.x_max (φ (ψ k)))
  have hAnchor : ∀ D : ℝ, D₁ ≤ D → ∃ K_D : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K_D, ∀ x : ℝ,
      ‖G_seq k ((x : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) - ((x : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro D hD
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hWidth_φ D (lt_of_lt_of_le hD₁_pos hD)
    obtain ⟨N_D, hN_D⟩ := hAnchor_base D hD
    refine ⟨max K₁ N_D, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    have h_ge_K₁ : K₁ ≤ ψ k := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) (hψ.id_le k)
    have h_ge_ND : N_D ≤ φ (ψ k) :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk) ((hφ.comp hψ).id_le k)
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hK₁ (ψ k) h_ge_K₁
    exact hN_D (φ (ψ k)) h_ge_ND hw1 hw2 (R.x_max (φ (ψ k))) x

  let cayley : ℂ → ℂ := fun W => (W + Complex.I) / (W - Complex.I)
  let cayleyInv : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w)
  have h_norm_sub_I : ∀ W : ℂ, ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 = W.re * W.re + (W.im - 1) * (W.im - 1) := by
    intro W
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    simp [Complex.normSq_apply]
  have h_norm_add_I : ∀ W : ℂ, ‖W + Complex.I‖ ^ 2 = W.re * W.re + (W.im + 1) * (W.im + 1) := by
    intro W
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    simp [Complex.normSq_apply]
  have hW_sub_gt_one : ∀ W ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 < ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro W hW
    change W.im < 0 at hW
    rw [h_norm_sub_I]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg W.re]
  have hW_sub_ne : ∀ W ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, W - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    intro W hW h0
    have h1 := hW_sub_gt_one W hW
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1
    norm_num at h1
  have hcayley_norm_sq : ∀ W ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane,
      ‖cayley W‖ ^ 2 = 1 - 4 * (-W.im) / ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro W hW
    have h_pos : 0 < ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 := lt_trans zero_lt_one (hW_sub_gt_one W hW)
    have h_diff : ‖W + Complex.I‖ ^ 2 = ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 - 4 * (-W.im) := by
      rw [h_norm_add_I, h_norm_sub_I]
      ring
    dsimp [cayley]
    rw [norm_div, div_pow, h_diff, sub_div, div_self h_pos.ne']
  have hcayley_lt_one : ∀ W ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, ‖cayley W‖ < 1 := by
    intro W hW
    change W.im < 0 at hW
    have h_pos : 0 < ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 := lt_trans zero_lt_one (hW_sub_gt_one W hW)
    have h_div_pos : 0 < 4 * (-W.im) / ‖W - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 := div_pos (by linarith) h_pos
    have h_sq : ‖cayley W‖ ^ 2 < 1 := by
      rw [hcayley_norm_sq W hW]
      linarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cayley W)]
  have hcayley_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ cayley superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    (differentiableOn_id.add (differentiableOn_const Complex.I)).div
      (differentiableOn_id.sub (differentiableOn_const Complex.I))
      (fun W hW => hW_sub_ne W hW)
  have h1_sub_ne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, 1 - w ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw h0
    have hw1 : w = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hw1, norm_one] at hw
    exact lt_irrefl 1 hw
  have hcayleyInv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ cayleyInv (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
    ((differentiableOn_const (-Complex.I)).mul
      ((differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).add differentiableOn_id)).div
      ((differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).sub differentiableOn_id)
      (fun w hw => h1_sub_ne w hw)
  have hcayleyInv_maps : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, cayleyInv w ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ < 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw
    have hw_sq : w.re * w.re + w.im * w.im < 1 := by
      have h1 : Complex.normSq w < 1 := by
        rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
      simpa [Complex.normSq_apply] using h1
    have hden_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (1 - w) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr (h1_sub_ne w hw)
    change (cayleyInv w).im < 0
    dsimp [cayleyInv]
    rw [Complex.div_im, ← sub_div]
    apply div_neg_of_neg_of_pos _ hden_pos
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re,
      Complex.sub_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
    nlinarith
  have hcayley_left_inv : ∀ W ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, cayleyInv (cayley W) = W := by
    intro W hW
    have h1 : cayley W ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact hcayley_lt_one W hW
    have h_ne1 : 1 - cayley W ≠ 0 := h1_sub_ne (cayley W) h1
    have h_neW : W - Complex.I ≠ 0 := hW_sub_ne W hW
    dsimp [cayleyInv]
    field_simp [h_ne1]
    dsimp [cayley]
    field_simp [h_neW]
    ring

  let a_ν : ℕ → ℝ := fun ν => 1 / (2 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))
  let b_ν : ℕ → ℝ := fun ν => (ν : ℝ) + 3
  let r_ν : ℕ → ℝ := fun ν => 1 / (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2))
  let U_ν : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun ν => { Y : ℂ | -b_ν ν < Y.im ∧ Y.im < -a_ν ν }
  let K_ν : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun ν =>
    { Y : ℂ | |Y.re| ≤ (ν : ℝ) + 1 ∧ -((ν : ℝ) + 2) ≤ Y.im ∧ Y.im ≤ -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) }
  have ha_pos : ∀ ν : ℕ, 0 < a_ν ν := fun ν => by dsimp [a_ν]; positivity
  have hr_pos : ∀ ν : ℕ, 0 < r_ν ν := fun ν => by dsimp [r_ν]; positivity
  have hab_le : ∀ ν : ℕ, a_ν ν ≤ b_ν ν := by
    intro ν
    have h1 : a_ν ν ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [a_ν]
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) ν]
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ b_ν ν := by
      dsimp [b_ν]
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) ν]
    exact le_trans h1 h2
  have hU_open : ∀ ν : ℕ, IsOpen (U_ν ν) := fun ν =>
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
      (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
  have hK_comp : ∀ ν : ℕ, IsCompact (K_ν ν) := by
    intro ν
    let R_rect : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
      Set.Icc (-((ν : ℝ) + 1)) ((ν : ℝ) + 1) ×ˢ
        Set.Icc (-((ν : ℝ) + 2)) (-(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)))
    let emb : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have h_eq : K_ν ν = emb '' R_rect := by
      ext Y
      constructor
      · intro hY
        refine ⟨(Y.re, Y.im), ⟨abs_le.mp hY.1, hY.2.1, hY.2.2⟩, ?_⟩
        exact Complex.re_add_im Y
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hx, hy1, hy2⟩, rfl⟩
        have hre : (emb (x, y)).re = x := by simp [emb]
        have him : (emb (x, y)).im = y := by simp [emb]
        exact ⟨by rw [hre]; exact abs_le.mpr hx, by rw [him]; exact hy1, by rw [him]; exact hy2⟩
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image (by fun_prop)
  have hK_conv : ∀ ν : ℕ, Convex ℝ (K_ν ν) := by
    intro ν x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    have hre : (a • x + b • y).re = a * x.re + b * y.re := by simp
    have him : (a • x + b • y).im = a * x.im + b * y.im := by simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hre]
      calc |a * x.re + b * y.re|
          ≤ |a * x.re| + |b * y.re| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |x.re| + b * |y.re| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ ≤ a * ((ν : ℝ) + 1) + b * ((ν : ℝ) + 1) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.1 ha) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.1 hb)
        _ = (a + b) * ((ν : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
        _ = (ν : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hab, one_mul]
    · rw [him]
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2.1 ha
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2.1 hb
      nlinarith
    · rw [him]
      calc a * x.im + b * y.im
          ≤ a * (-(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2))) + b * (-(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2))) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.2.2 ha)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.2.2 hb)
        _ = (a + b) * (-(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2))) := by ring
        _ = -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have hK_cball_sub : ∀ (ν : ℕ), ∀ Y ∈ K_ν ν, Metric.closedBall Y (r_ν ν) ⊆ U_ν ν := by
    intro ν Y hY Z hZ
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hZ
    have him_diff : |Z.im - Y.im| ≤ r_ν ν :=
      le_trans (by simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Z - Y)) hZ
    rw [abs_le] at him_diff
    have hr_lt_one : r_ν ν < 1 := by
      dsimp [r_ν]
      rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) ν]
    have h_quarter : -(1 / ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) + r_ν ν < -a_ν ν := by
      dsimp [r_ν, a_ν]
      have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (ν : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
      field_simp [hden.ne']
      linarith
    exact ⟨by dsimp [b_ν]; linarith [hY.2.1, him_diff.1], by linarith [hY.2.2, him_diff.2]⟩
  have hK_sub_U : ∀ ν : ℕ, K_ν ν ⊆ U_ν ν := fun ν Y hY =>
    hK_cball_sub ν Y hY (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hr_pos ν).le)
  choose K_adm hK_adm using fun ν : ℕ => hStrip (a_ν ν) (b_ν ν) (ha_pos ν) (hab_le ν)
  let Ψ_trunc : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun ν k Y =>
    if K_adm ν ≤ k then cayley (G_seq k Y) else 0
  have hΨ_trunc_norm : ∀ (ν k : ℕ), ∀ Y ∈ U_ν ν, ‖Ψ_trunc ν k Y‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro ν k Y hY
    dsimp [Ψ_trunc]
    split_ifs with hk
    · exact (hcayley_lt_one _ ((hK_adm ν k hk).2 Y hY.1 hY.2)).le
    · simp
  have hΨ_trunc_lip : ∀ (ν k : ℕ), ∀ x y : K_ν ν,
      dist (Ψ_trunc ν k x.1) (Ψ_trunc ν k y.1) ≤
        (4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2)) * dist x y := by
    intro ν k x y
    rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    by_cases hk : K_adm ν ≤ k
    · have h_eq : Ψ_trunc ν k = fun Z => cayley (G_seq k Z) := by
        funext Z
        simp [Ψ_trunc, hk]
      rw [h_eq]
      let f_k : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => cayley (G_seq k Z)
      have hf_diff_U : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_k (U_ν ν) :=
        hcayley_holo.comp (hK_adm ν k hk).1 (fun Z hZ => (hK_adm ν k hk).2 Z hZ.1 hZ.2)
      have hf_diff_at : ∀ z ∈ K_ν ν, DifferentiableAt ℂ f_k z := fun z hz =>
        (hf_diff_U z (hK_sub_U ν hz)).differentiableAt ((hU_open ν).mem_nhds (hK_sub_U ν hz))
      have hf_deriv_bound : ∀ z ∈ K_ν ν, ‖deriv f_k z‖ ≤ 4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2) := by
        intro z hz
        have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f_k (Metric.ball z (r_ν ν)) :=
          hf_diff_U.diffContOnCl_ball (hK_cball_sub ν z hz)
        have hsph : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere z (r_ν ν), ‖f_k w‖ ≤ 1 := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_U : w ∈ U_ν ν :=
            hK_cball_sub ν z hz (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
          exact (hcayley_lt_one _ ((hK_adm ν k hk).2 w hw_U.1 hw_U.2)).le
        have h_est := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (hr_pos ν) hdc hsph
        have h_inv : 1 / r_ν ν = 4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2) := by
          dsimp [r_ν]
          have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (ν : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
          field_simp [hden.ne']
        rwa [h_inv] at h_est
      simpa [f_k, norm_sub_rev] using
        Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hf_diff_at hf_deriv_bound (hK_conv ν) y.2 x.2
    · simp only [Ψ_trunc, hk, ↓reduceIte, sub_self, norm_zero]
      positivity
  have h_subseq_step : ∀ (ν : ℕ) (τ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono τ →
      ∃ (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), StrictMono ρ ∧
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun m Y => cayley (G_seq (τ (ρ m)) Y)) g Filter.atTop (K_ν ν) := by
    intro ν τ hτ
    have : CompactSpace (K_ν ν) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (hK_comp ν)
    let L_nn : NNReal := ⟨4 * ((ν : ℝ) + 2), by positivity⟩
    have h_lip_k : ∀ k : ℕ, LipschitzWith L_nn (fun x : K_ν ν => Ψ_trunc ν k x.1) := fun k =>
      LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun x y => hΨ_trunc_lip ν k x y)
    let F_bcf : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ν ν) ℂ := fun k =>
      BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨fun x => Ψ_trunc ν k x.1, (h_lip_k k).continuous⟩
    let A : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ν ν) ℂ) := Set.range (fun k => F_bcf (τ k))
    have hA_mem : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ν ν) ℂ) (x : K_ν ν),
        f ∈ A → f x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rintro _ x ⟨k, rfl⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hΨ_trunc_norm ν (τ k) x.1 (hK_sub_U ν x.2)
    have hA_equi : Equicontinuous
        (fun f : A => (⇑(f : BoundedContinuousFunction (K_ν ν) ℂ) : K_ν ν → ℂ)) := by
      refine (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous _ L_nn ?_).equicontinuous
      rintro ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩
      exact h_lip_k (τ k)
    have hA_comp : IsCompact (closure A) :=
      BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)
        (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) A hA_mem hA_equi
    obtain ⟨f_lim, _, ρ, hρ, h_tendsto⟩ :=
      hA_comp.tendsto_subseq (fun k => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self k))
    have h_unif_sub : TendstoUniformly

      let z_m : ℂ := (ξ_sub m : ℂ) + ((S.H - d_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hz_eq : (ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * (-Complex.I) = z_m := by
        dsimp [z_m]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hf_norm :
          ‖superlinearRescaledF S (ξ_sub m) (d_sub m) (m_sub m) (-Complex.I)‖ =
            (m_sub m)⁻¹ * ‖S.f z_m‖ := by
        unfold superlinearRescaledF
        rw [hz_eq, norm_mul]
        simp [abs_of_pos hm_sub_pos]
      have hq_sqrt :
          Real.sqrt ‖superlinearRescaledQ S (ξ_sub m) (d_sub m) (m_sub m) (-Complex.I)‖ =
            (m_sub m)⁻¹ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z_m‖ := by
        unfold superlinearRescaledQ
        rw [hz_eq, norm_mul]
        have hnorm_inv2 : ‖((((m_sub m) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ((m_sub m)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
          simp [inv_pow]
        rw [hnorm_inv2, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hinv_pos.le]
      rw [hf_norm, hq_sqrt, ← mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hinv_pos.le]
      change (m_sub m)⁻¹ * shapeModulus S z_m = 1
      rw [R.x_max_attains (ν_seq m)]
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hm_sub_pos.ne'
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lim (by simp_rw [h_eq_one]; exact tendsto_const_nhds)

  have hdB_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < d_sub m ∧ 0 < B_sub m := fun m =>
    ⟨hd_pos (ν_seq m), mul_pos (hd_pos (ν_seq m)) (hm_pos (ν_seq m))⟩
  have hd_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto d_sub Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ε)
    refine ⟨M₀, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (hd_pos (ν_seq m))]
    have hm_le : (M₀ : ℝ) ≤ (ν_seq m : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_trans hm (hν.id_le m))
    have h1 : 1 / ε < (ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h2 : 1 / ((ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1) < ε := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp h1
      linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hd_le_inv (ν_seq m)) h2
  have hB_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto B_sub Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    rw [Filter.tendsto_atTop]
    intro b
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 0 b / (R.α₂ - 1))
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop M₀] with m hm
    have hm_le : (M₀ : ℝ) ≤ (ν_seq m : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_trans hm (hν.id_le m))
    have h1 : max 0 b / (R.α₂ - 1) < (ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h2 : max 0 b < (R.α₂ - 1) * ((ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith [h1_lt_α₂])).mp h1
      linarith
    have hb_le : b ≤ max 0 b := le_max_right _ _
    dsimp [B_sub, d_sub, m_sub]
    linarith [hB_lower (ν_seq m)]
  have h_ratio_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, d_sub m / B_sub m = (m_sub m)⁻¹ := fun m => by
    dsimp [B_sub]
    have hd_ne : d_sub m ≠ 0 := (hd_pos (ν_seq m)).ne'
    have hm_ne : m_sub m ≠ 0 := (hm_pos (ν_seq m)).ne'
    field_simp [hd_ne, hm_ne]
  have h_cone_model : ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      d_sub m ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - ξ_sub m| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
      (d_sub m / B_sub m) * shapeModulus S s ≤
        C_A * (d_sub m / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    intro A _
    refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, 0, ?_⟩
    intro m _ s hs_lo hs_hi _
    have hwd_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := lt_of_lt_of_le (hd_pos (ν_seq m)) hs_lo
    have h_coarse := R.coarse_tail_bound (ν_seq m) s hs_lo (le_trans hs_hi hδb_le_exp)
    let q : ℝ := d_sub m / wallDepth S s
    have hq_pos : 0 < q := div_pos (hd_pos (ν_seq m)) hwd_pos
    have hq_le_one : q ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hwd_pos).mpr hs_lo
    have hq_rpow : q ^ R.α₁ ≤ q ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hq_pos hq_le_one (by linarith [R.one_lt_α₁])
    rw [h_ratio_eq m, one_mul]
    calc (m_sub m)⁻¹ * shapeModulus S s
        ≤ (m_sub m)⁻¹ * (m_sub m * q ^ R.α₁) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_coarse (inv_nonneg.mpr (hm_pos (ν_seq m)).le)
      _ = q ^ R.α₁ := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hm_pos (ν_seq m)).ne' _
      _ ≤ q ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := hq_rpow
  have hF_model_eq :
      (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        S.f ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z)) =
      (fun m Z => superlinearRescaledF S (ξ_sub m) (d_sub m) (m_sub m) Z) := by
    funext m Z
    unfold superlinearRescaledF
    rw [h_ratio_eq m]
  have hQ_model_eq :
      (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        S.q ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z)) =
      (fun m Z => superlinearRescaledQ S (ξ_sub m) (d_sub m) (m_sub m) Z) := by
    funext m Z
    unfold superlinearRescaledQ
    rw [h_ratio_eq m]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    rw [inv_pow]
  have h_tube_at_one : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane,
      ∃ M_tube : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ M_tube,
        ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Y,
          (1 : ℂ) * (d_sub m : ℂ) / (B_sub m : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro Y hY
    change Y.im < 0 at hY
    obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hWidth_φ (-Y.im / 2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((-Y.im) / S.H)
    refine ⟨max K₁ M₂, ?_⟩
    intro m hm
    have hm_K₁ : K₁ ≤ ψ (σ m) :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) ((hψ.comp hσ).id_le m)
    have hm_M₂ : M₂ ≤ ν_seq m :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm) (hν.id_le m)
    obtain ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ := hK₁ (ψ (σ m)) hm_K₁
    have h2_eq : (1 : ℂ) * (d_sub m : ℂ) / (B_sub m : ℂ) = (((m_sub m)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [one_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_div, h_ratio_eq m]
    rw [h2_eq]
    have h2_norm : ‖(((m_sub m)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
      dsimp [m_sub, ν_seq]
      simpa [abs_of_pos (hm_pos (φ (ψ (σ m))))] using hw1
    have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ (((m_sub m)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using h2_norm
    have h_ss : S.s_star ≤ S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ (((m_sub m)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      (S.h_X_bounds _ hconj_ball).1
    have hd_im_lt : (-Y.im) * d_sub m < S.H := by
      have h1 : (-Y.im) / S.H < (ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have : (M₂ : ℝ) ≤ (ν_seq m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hm_M₂
        linarith
      have h2 : (-Y.im) * (1 / ((ν_seq m : ℝ) + 1)) < S.H := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have := (div_lt_iff₀ S.H_pos).mp h1
        linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hd_le_inv (ν_seq m)) (by linarith)) h2
    have h1_im : ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Y).im =
        S.H + d_sub m * Y.im := by simp
    refine ⟨h2_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h1_im]
      linarith [S.s_star_pos]
    · rw [h1_im]
      have h_half : S.H + d_sub m * Y.im < S.H - (-Y.im / 2) * d_sub m := by
        nlinarith [hd_pos (ν_seq m), hY]
      dsimp [d_sub, m_sub, ν_seq] at h_half ⊢
      linarith [hw2]
  have h_lift_at_one : ∀ (m : ℕ) (Y : ℂ),
      (S.𝔰 ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Y,
          (1 : ℂ) * (d_sub m : ℂ) / (B_sub m : ℂ)) -
        (ξ_sub m : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_sub m : ℂ) = G_seq (σ m) Y := by
    intro m Y
    have h2_eq : (1 : ℂ) * (d_sub m : ℂ) / (B_sub m : ℂ) = (((m_sub m)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [one_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_div, h_ratio_eq m]
    rw [h2_eq]

  rcases hPureFQ with hF_zero | hQ_zero
  · 
    have hQ_norm_one : Real.sqrt ‖Q (-Complex.I)‖ = 1 := by
      have hF0_val : ‖F (-Complex.I)‖ = 0 := by rw [hF_zero (-Complex.I) h_negI_mem, norm_zero]
      rw [hF0_val, max_eq_right (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)] at h_unit_max
      exact h_unit_max
    have hQ_tail : ∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im →
        Real.sqrt ‖Q Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) := fun Z hZ h1 =>
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hTailFQ Z hZ h1)
    have hF_model_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } := by
      rw [hF_model_eq]
      exact hF_conv_ν.congr_right (fun Z hZ => hF_zero Z hZ)
    have hQ_model_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z))
        Q Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } := by
      rw [hQ_model_eq]
      exact hQ_conv_ν
    obtain ⟨D₀, _, hD₀_pos, _, S_lim, _, hs_lim_props, _, hs_lim_conv⟩ :=
      hSecond d_sub B_sub ξ_sub (3 / 4) δ_b Q (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        hδb_pos hδb_lt_half hQ_holo hdB_pos hd_sub_tendsto hB_sub_tendsto
        h_cone_model hF_model_conv hQ_model_conv 1 2 zero_lt_one zero_lt_two
    have hS_eq_lim : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < -Y.im → S_inf Y = S_lim (1, Y) := by
      intro Y hY1 hY2
      have hY_mem : Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by change Y.im < 0; linarith
      have h_lim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => G_seq (σ m) Y)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (S_lim (1, Y))) := by
        rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
        intro ε hε
        have hK_sub : ({((1 : ℂ), Y)} : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) ⊆
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < 2 ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < 1 * (-p.2.im) } := by
          intro p hp
          rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
          subst hp
          exact ⟨by norm_num, hY1, by linarith⟩
        obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hs_lim_conv {((1 : ℂ), Y)} isCompact_singleton hK_sub ε hε
        obtain ⟨M_tube, hM_tube⟩ := h_tube_at_one Y hY_mem
        refine ⟨max N₁ M_tube, ?_⟩
        intro m hm
        have h_est := hN₁ m (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) (1, Y) (Set.mem_singleton _)
          (hM_tube m (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm))
        rw [dist_eq_norm, ← h_lift_at_one m Y]
        exact h_est
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hS_ptwise Y hY_mem) h_lim2
    refine ⟨{
      D₁ := D₁
      C₁ := C₁
      D₀ := D₀
      D₁_pos := hD₁_pos
      C₁_pos := hC₁_pos
      D₀_pos := hD₀_pos
      S_inf := S_inf
      S_inf_holo := hS_holo
      S_inf_maps_to := hS_maps
      S_inf_anchor := hS_anchor
      pure_energy_branch := Or.inr ⟨Q, hQ_holo, hQ_norm_one, hQ_tail, ?_⟩
    }⟩
    intro Y hY1 hY2
    let U_deep : Set ℂ := { Z : ℂ | D₀ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < -Z.im }
    have hU_open_deep : IsOpen U_deep :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im.neg).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re.abs Complex.continuous_im.neg)
    have hev_deep : S_inf =ᶠ[nhds Y] (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (1, Y')) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_open_deep.mem_nhds ⟨hY1, hY2⟩)
        (fun Z hZ => hS_eq_lim Z hZ.1 hZ.2)
    have h_deriv_eq : deriv S_inf Y = deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (1, Y')) Y :=
      hev_deep.deriv_eq
    have h_en :=
      (hs_lim_props 1 Y (by norm_num) hY1 (by linarith)).2.2.2.2
    rw [h_deriv_eq, hS_eq_lim Y hY1 hY2]
    simpa using h_en
  · 
    have hF_norm_one : ‖F (-Complex.I)‖ = 1 := by
      have hQ0_val : Real.sqrt ‖Q (-Complex.I)‖ = 0 := by
        rw [hQ_zero (-Complex.I) h_negI_mem, norm_zero, Real.sqrt_zero]
      rw [hQ0_val, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)] at h_unit_max
      exact h_unit_max
    have hF_tail : ∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im →
        ‖F Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁) := fun Z hZ h1 =>
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hTailFQ Z hZ h1)
    have hF_model_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z))
        F Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } := by
      rw [hF_model_eq]
      exact hF_conv_ν
    have hQ_model_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun m Z => ((d_sub m / B_sub m : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_sub m : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_sub m : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } := by
      rw [hQ_model_eq]
      exact hQ_conv_ν.congr_right (fun Z hZ => hQ_zero Z hZ)
    obtain ⟨D₀, _, hD₀_pos, _, S_lim, _, hs_lim_props, _, hs_lim_conv⟩ :=
      hFirst d_sub B_sub ξ_sub (3 / 4) δ_b F (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        hδb_pos hδb_lt_half hF_holo hdB_pos hd_sub_tendsto hB_sub_tendsto
        h_cone_model hF_model_conv hQ_model_conv 1 2 zero_lt_one zero_lt_two
    have hS_eq_lim : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < -Y.im → S_inf Y = S_lim (1, Y) := by
      intro Y hY1 hY2
      have hY_mem : Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by change Y.im < 0; linarith
      have h_lim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => G_seq (σ m) Y)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (S_lim (1, Y))) := by
        rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
        intro ε hε
        have hK_sub : ({((1 : ℂ), Y)} : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) ⊆
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < 2 ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < 1 * (-p.2.im) } := by
          intro p hp
          rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
          subst hp
          exact ⟨by norm_num, hY1, by linarith⟩
        obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hs_lim_conv {((1 : ℂ), Y)} isCompact_singleton hK_sub ε hε
        obtain ⟨M_tube, hM_tube⟩ := h_tube_at_one Y hY_mem
        refine ⟨max N₁ M_tube, ?_⟩
        intro m hm
        have h_est := hN₁ m (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) (1, Y) (Set.mem_singleton _)
          (hM_tube m (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm))
        rw [dist_eq_norm, ← h_lift_at_one m Y]
        exact h_est
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hS_ptwise Y hY_mem) h_lim2
    refine ⟨{
      D₁ := D₁
      C₁ := C₁
      D₀ := D₀
      D₁_pos := hD₁_pos
      C₁_pos := hC₁_pos
      D₀_pos := hD₀_pos
      S_inf := S_inf
      S_inf_holo := hS_holo
      S_inf_maps_to := hS_maps
      S_inf_anchor := hS_anchor
      pure_energy_branch := Or.inl ⟨F, hF_holo, hF_norm_one, hF_tail, ?_⟩
    }⟩
    intro Y hY1 hY2
    let U_deep : Set ℂ := { Z : ℂ | D₀ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < -Z.im }
    have hU_open_deep : IsOpen U_deep :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im.neg).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re.abs Complex.continuous_im.neg)
    have hev_deep : S_inf =ᶠ[nhds Y] (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (1, Y')) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_open_deep.mem_nhds ⟨hY1, hY2⟩)
        (fun Z hZ => hS_eq_lim Z hZ.1 hZ.2)
    have h_deriv_eq : deriv S_inf Y = deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (1, Y')) Y :=
      hev_deep.deriv_eq
    have h_en :=
      (hs_lim_props 1 Y (by norm_num) hY1 (by linarith)).2.2.2
    rw [h_deriv_eq, hS_eq_lim Y hY1 hY2]
    simpa using h_en

signature.statement:
(α₁ : ℝ) (hα₁ : 1 < α₁)
    (L : SuperlinearLimitingLiftData α₁) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hH_open : IsOpen superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  have hH_preconn : IsPreconnected superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    (convex_halfSpace_im_lt 0).isPreconnected
  have hnegI_mem : -Complex.I ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    change (-Complex.I).im < 0
    simp
  have h_inv_sqrt_lt : ∀ A δ R : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < δ → (A / δ) ^ 2 < R →
      A * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) < δ := by
    intro A δ R hA hδ hR_sq
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_trans (by positivity) hR_sq
    have hR_half_sq : (R ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) = R := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hR_pos.le]
      norm_num
    have h_lt_half : A / δ < R ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      apply lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (by positivity)
      rwa [hR_half_sq]
    have h_prod_one : R ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hR_pos]
      norm_num
    have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_lt_half (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR_pos (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))
    rw [h_prod_one] at h_mul
    have h_mul2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_mul hδ
    have h_cancel : δ * (A / δ * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) = A * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      field_simp [hδ.ne']
    linarith

  
  let f₁_term : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ := fun u m =>
    (3 * (2 * m + 2) : ℂ) * (-u) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)
  let g_sq1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => ∑' m : ℕ, f₁_term u m
  have hf₁_summable : ∀ u : ℂ, Summable (f₁_term u) := by
    intro u
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial ‖u‖).mul_left 3) ?_

    have hC₁_R_lt : L.C₁ * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) < δ_v / 4 :=

      have h_tri : ‖(3 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖J ^ 2 + J + 1‖ + ‖rem_J‖ := by
        rw [h_id]; exact norm_sub_le _ _
      have h_rem : ‖rem_J‖ ≤ ‖(J - 1) ^ 2‖ + ‖3 * (J - 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_pow, norm_mul] at h_rem
      have h3_norm : ‖(3 : ℂ)‖ = (3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [h3_norm] at h_tri h_rem
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (J - 1)]
    set Z_y : ℂ := L.S_inf c_y
    have hZy_mem : Z_y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := L.S_inf_maps_to c_y hc_mem
    have hZy_im_le : Z_y.im ≤ -y := by
      have hc_im : c_y.im = -y := by simp [c_y]
      exact (h_im_le c_y hc_mem).trans_eq hc_im
    have hy_le_Zy : y ≤ -Z_y.im := by linarith
    have hW_Zy : ‖W Z_y‖ ≤ y ^ (-2 * α₁) := by
      have h1 : ‖W Z_y‖ ≤ (-Z_y.im) ^ (-2 * α₁) := hW_dec Z_y hZy_mem (by linarith)
      have h2 : (-Z_y.im) ^ (-2 * α₁) ≤ y ^ (-2 * α₁) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hy_pos hy_le_Zy (by linarith)
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    set w : ℂ := (1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 * W Z_y * J ^ 2
    have hw_bound : ‖w‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (-2 * α₁) := by
      have h_quarter : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      calc ‖w‖ = ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ * ‖W Z_y‖ * ‖J‖ ^ 2 := by
            dsimp [w]; rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow J 2]
        _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (‖W Z_y‖ * ‖J‖ ^ 2) := by rw [h_quarter]; ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (y ^ (-2 * α₁) * 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul hW_Zy hJ2_le (sq_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy_pos _).le)
              (by norm_num)
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (-2 * α₁) := by ring
    have hw_quarter : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have hy_rpow_inv : y ^ (-2 * α₁) ≤ y ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_one] at hy_rpow_inv
      have hy_inv_le : y⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        rw [inv_le_comm₀ hy_pos (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
        exact hy_ge4
      linarith
    have hJ_eq_one : J ^ 3 * G_sq w = 1 := hRayEq y hy_D₀
    have h_cubic : (J - 1) * (J ^ 2 + J + 1) = J ^ 3 * (1 - G_sq w) := by
      calc (J - 1) * (J ^ 2 + J + 1) = J ^ 3 - 1 := by ring
        _ = J ^ 3 - J ^ 3 * G_sq w := by rw [hJ_eq_one]
        _ = J ^ 3 * (1 - G_sq w) := by ring
    have h_norm_cubic : 2 * ‖J - 1‖ ≤ 4 * y ^ (-2 * α₁) := by
      calc 2 * ‖J - 1‖
          ≤ ‖J - 1‖ * ‖J ^ 2 + J + 1‖ := by
            have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ_quad_ge (norm_nonneg (J - 1))
            linarith
        _ = ‖(J - 1) * (J ^ 2 + J + 1)‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
        _ = ‖J ^ 3 * (1 - G_sq w)‖ := by rw [h_cubic]
        _ = ‖J‖ ^ 3 * ‖1 - G_sq w‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        _ ≤ 2 * (4 * ‖w‖) :=
            mul_le_mul hJ3_le (hG_lip w hw_quarter) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ 2 * (4 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ (-2 * α₁))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_bound (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
        _ = 4 * y ^ (-2 * α₁) := by ring
    rw [h_deriv_Δ_eq]
    linarith

  let C₂ : ℝ := 2 / (2 * α₁ - 1)
  have hC₂_pos : 0 < C₂ := div_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hΔ_seg_bound : ∀ y R : ℝ, Y_thr ≤ y → y ≤ R →
      ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C₂ * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁) := by
    intro y R hy hyR
    let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (t : ℂ) * (-Complex.I)
    have hφ_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, φ t = -(t : ℂ) * Complex.I := fun t => by simp [φ]
    let f_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Δ (φ t) - Δ (φ y)
    let f_ray' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => (-Complex.I) • deriv Δ (φ t)
    let B_ray : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => C₂ * (y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁) - t ^ (1 - 2 * α₁))
    let B_ray' : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2 * t ^ (-2 * α₁)
    have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ (Set.Icc y R) superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hY_thr_ge_four]) ht.1
      change (φ t).im < 0
      simp [φ, ht_pos]
    have hf_cont : ContinuousOn f_ray (Set.Icc y R) :=
      (hΔ_holo.continuousOn.comp (by fun_prop) hφ_maps).sub continuousOn_const
    have hf_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico y R,
        HasDerivWithinAt f_ray (f_ray' t) (Set.Ici t) t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_mem : φ t ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := hφ_maps ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
      have hΔ_at : HasDerivAt Δ (deriv Δ (φ t)) (φ t) :=
        (hΔ_holo.differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds ht_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hφ_at : HasDerivAt φ (-Complex.I) t := by
        simpa [φ] using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)).mul_const (-Complex.I)
      have h_comp : HasDerivAt (Δ ∘ φ) (f_ray' t) t :=
        HasDerivAt.scomp t hΔ_at hφ_at
      exact (h_comp.sub_const (Δ (φ y))).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hB_cont : ContinuousOn B_ray (Set.Icc y R) := by
      refine continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_const.sub ?_)
      refine ContinuousOn.rpow_const continuousOn_id ?_
      intro t ht
      left
      have : 4 ≤ t := le_trans (le_trans hY_thr_ge_four hy) ht.1
      linarith
    have hB_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico y R,
        HasDerivWithinAt B_ray (B_ray' t) (Set.Ici t) t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hY_thr_ge_four]) ht.1
      have hr : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s ^ (1 - 2 * α₁))
          ((1 - 2 * α₁) * t ^ ((1 - 2 * α₁) - 1)) t :=
        Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ht_pos.ne')
      have h_sub := (hasDerivAt_const t (y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁))).sub hr
      have h_mul := h_sub.const_mul C₂
      have h_eq : C₂ * (0 - (1 - 2 * α₁) * t ^ ((1 - 2 * α₁) - 1)) = B_ray' t := by
        dsimp [C₂, B_ray']
        have h_exp : (1 : ℝ) - 2 * α₁ - 1 = -2 * α₁ := by ring
        rw [h_exp]
        have hne : 2 * α₁ - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp [hne]
        ring
      rw [h_eq] at h_mul
      exact h_mul.hasDerivWithinAt
    have hf_a : ‖f_ray y‖ ≤ B_ray y := by
      simp [f_ray, B_ray]
    have h_norm_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico y R, ‖f_ray' t‖ ≤ B_ray' t := by
      intro t ht
      dsimp [f_ray', B_ray']
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, hφ_eq]
      exact hΔ_deriv_bound t (le_trans hy ht.1)
    have h_mvt :=
      image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_le_deriv_boundary' hf_cont hf_deriv hf_a hB_cont hB_deriv
        h_norm_deriv ⟨hyR, le_rfl⟩
    dsimp [f_ray, B_ray] at h_mvt
    rw [hφ_eq R, hφ_eq y] at h_mvt
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hY_thr_ge_four]) (le_trans hy hyR)
    have hR_rpow_pos : 0 < R ^ (1 - 2 * α₁) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR_pos _
    nlinarith [hC₂_pos]

  have h_ray_o : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ y : ℝ, 1 < y ∧
      y * ‖L.S_inf (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    let p : ℝ := 2 * α₁ - 2
    have hp_pos : 0 < p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
    let y : ℝ := max Y_thr ((2 * C₂ / ε) ^ (1 / p) + 1)
    have hy_thr : Y_thr ≤ y := le_max_left _ _
    have hy_gt_one : 1 < y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith [hY_thr_ge_four]) hy_thr
    have hy_pos : 0 < y := lt_trans zero_lt_one hy_gt_one
    have hy_gt_rpow : (2 * C₂ / ε) ^ (1 / p) < y := by
      have : (2 * C₂ / ε) ^ (1 / p) + 1 ≤ y := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have h_base_pos : 0 < 2 * C₂ / ε := by positivity
    have hy_p_gt : 2 * C₂ / ε < y ^ p := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h_base_pos _).le hy_gt_rpow hp_pos
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul h_base_pos.le, one_div_mul_cancel hp_pos.ne', Real.rpow_one] at h1
      exact h1
    have h_term1 : C₂ * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) < ε / 2 := by
      have h_prod : y ^ p * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hy_pos]
        have : p + (2 - 2 * α₁) = 0 := by dsimp [p]; ring
        rw [this, Real.rpow_zero]
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hy_p_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy_pos (2 - 2 * α₁))
      rw [h_prod] at hmul
      have hmul2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hmul (by positivity : 0 < ε / 2)
      have h_cancel : ε / 2 * (2 * C₂ / ε * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁)) = C₂ * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) := by
        field_simp [hε.ne']
      linarith
    let R : ℝ := max y (((y * L.C₁) / (ε / 2)) ^ 2 + 1)
    have hy_le_R : y ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
    have hR_D₁ : L.D₁ ≤ R := by
      have : 2 * L.D₁ + 2 ≤ Y_thr := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
      linarith [L.D₁_pos]
    have hR_sq : ((y * L.C₁) / (ε / 2)) ^ 2 < R := by
      have : ((y * L.C₁) / (ε / 2)) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ R := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have h_term2 : (y * L.C₁) * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) < ε / 2 :=
      h_inv_sqrt_lt (y * L.C₁) (ε / 2) R (mul_pos hy_pos L.C₁_pos) (by positivity) hR_sq
    have hΔR : ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ L.C₁ * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa [Δ] using L.S_inf_anchor 0 R hR_D₁
    have h_seg := hΔ_seg_bound y R hy_thr hy_le_R
    have h_tri : ‖Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := by
      calc ‖Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
          = ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ := by
            ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
              ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
              ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := add_comm _ _
    have hy_rpow_mul : y * (C₂ * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁)) = C₂ * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) := by
      calc y * (C₂ * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁))
          = C₂ * (y ^ (1 : ℝ) * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁)) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]; ring
        _ = C₂ * y ^ (1 + (1 - 2 * α₁)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hy_pos]
        _ = C₂ * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) := by ring_nf
    refine ⟨y, hy_gt_one, ?_⟩
    change y * ‖Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε
    calc y * ‖Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ y * (‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I) - Δ (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
            ‖Δ (-(R : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tri hy_pos.le
      _ ≤ y * (C₂ * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁) + L.C₁ * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h_seg hΔR) hy_pos.le
      _ = y * (C₂ * y ^ (1 - 2 * α₁)) + (y * L.C₁) * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = C₂ * y ^ (2 - 2 * α₁) + (y * L.C₁) * R ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by rw [hy_rpow_mul]
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add h_term1 h_term2
      _ = ε := add_halves ε

  
  let h : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => -Complex.I * (Y - L.S_inf Y)
  have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    (differentiableOn_id.sub L.S_inf_holo).const_mul (-Complex.I)
  have hh_re_nonneg : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 0 ≤ (h Y).re := by
    intro Y hY
    have him := h_im_le Y hY
    have hre : (h Y).re = Y.im - (L.S_inf Y).im := by simp [h]
    linarith
  have hh_norm : ∀ Y : ℂ, ‖h Y‖ = ‖L.S_inf Y - Y‖ := by
    intro Y
    dsimp [h]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, norm_sub_rev]

  have hh0_re_zero : (h (-Complex.I)).re = 0 := by
    have hv₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ (h (-Complex.I)).re := hh_re_nonneg (-Complex.I) hnegI_mem
    by_contra hv₁_ne
    have hv₁_pos : 0 < (h (-Complex.I)).re := lt_of_le_of_ne hv₁_nonneg (Ne.symm hv₁_ne)
    set h₀ : ℂ := h (-Complex.I)
    set v₁ : ℝ := h₀.re
    let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => -Complex.I * (1 + ζ) / (1 - ζ)
    have h1_sub_ne : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, 1 - ζ ≠ 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ h_eq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
      have hζ1 : ζ = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq).symm
      rw [hζ1, norm_one] at hζ
      exact lt_irrefl 1 hζ
    have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      (((differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).add differentiableOn_id).const_mul (-Complex.I)).div
        ((differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).sub differentiableOn_id) h1_sub_ne
    have hψ_maps : Set.MapsTo ψ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hne : 1 - ζ ≠ 0 := h1_sub_ne ζ hζ
      have hden_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (1 - ζ) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
      have hnorm_sq : Complex.normSq ζ < 1 := by
        rw [← Complex.sq_norm]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg ζ]
      rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at hnorm_sq
      change (ψ ζ).im < 0
      dsimp [ψ]
      rw [Complex.div_im]
      have h_num : (-Complex.I * (1 + ζ)).im * (1 - ζ).re / Complex.normSq (1 - ζ) -
          (-Complex.I * (1 + ζ)).re * (1 - ζ).im / Complex.normSq (1 - ζ) =
          (ζ.re * ζ.re + ζ.im * ζ.im - 1) / Complex.normSq (1 - ζ) := by
        simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
        ring
      rw [h_num]
      exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hden_pos
    let Θ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => (h (ψ ζ) - h₀) / (h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀)
    have h_quad_id : ∀ w : ℂ,
        ‖w + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖ ^ 2 - ‖w - h₀‖ ^ 2 = 4 * w.re * v₁ := by
      intro w
      rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp [v₁]
      ring
    have hΘ_den_ge : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, v₁ ≤ ‖h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖ := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hw_re : 0 ≤ (h (ψ ζ)).re := hh_re_nonneg (ψ ζ) (hψ_maps hζ)
      have h_re : v₁ ≤ (h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀).re := by
        simp [v₁]
        linarith
      exact le_trans h_re (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _))
    have hΘ_den_ne : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ h0
      have := hΘ_den_ge ζ hζ
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
      linarith
    have hΘ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
      have h_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => h (ψ ζ)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
        hh_holo.comp hψ_holo hψ_maps
      exact (h_comp.sub (differentiableOn_const h₀)).div
        (h_comp.add (differentiableOn_const (starRingEnd ℂ h₀))) hΘ_den_ne
    have hΘ_maps : Set.MapsTo Θ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp [Θ]
      rw [norm_div]
      have hden_pos : 0 < ‖h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hv₁_pos (hΘ_den_ge ζ hζ)
      rw [div_le_one hden_pos]
      have hw_re : 0 ≤ (h (ψ ζ)).re := hh_re_nonneg (ψ ζ) (hψ_maps hζ)
      have hq := h_quad_id (h (ψ ζ))
      have h_sq_le : ‖h (ψ ζ) - h₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖h (ψ ζ) + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (h (ψ ζ) - h₀), hden_pos]
    have hΘ_zero : Θ 0 = 0 := by
      have hψ0 : ψ 0 = -Complex.I := by simp [ψ]
      dsimp [Θ, h₀]
      rw [hψ0, sub_self, zero_div]
    obtain ⟨y, hy_gt_one, hy_small⟩ := h_ray_o (v₁ / 4) (by positivity)
    have hy_pos : 0 < y := lt_trans zero_lt_one hy_gt_one
    set r_y : ℝ := (y - 1) / (y + 1)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_y := div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hr_lt_one : r_y < 1 := (div_lt_one (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
    set ζ_y : ℂ := (r_y : ℂ)
    have hζ_norm : ‖ζ_y‖ = r_y := by
      simp [ζ_y, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    have hζ_lt : ‖ζ_y‖ < 1 := by linarith
    have hψ_ζ : ψ ζ_y = -(y : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      dsimp [ψ, ζ_y, r_y]
      have hy1_ne : (y : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by linarith : y + 1 ≠ 0)
      push_cast
      field_simp [hy1_ne]
      ring
    have h_schwarz :=
      Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball hΘ_holo hΘ_maps hΘ_zero hζ_lt
    rw [hζ_norm] at h_schwarz
    set w_y : ℂ := h (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hw_y_eq : h (ψ ζ_y) = w_y := by rw [hψ_ζ]
    have hw_re_nonneg : 0 ≤ w_y.re :=
      hh_re_nonneg (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I) (by change (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 0; simp [hy_pos])
    have hD_ge : v₁ ≤ ‖w_y + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖ := by
      rw [← hw_y_eq]
      exact hΘ_den_ge ζ_y (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right])
    set D_y : ℝ := ‖w_y + starRingEnd ℂ h₀‖
    have hD_pos : 0 < D_y := lt_of_lt_of_le hv₁_pos hD_ge
    have hΘ_val : ‖Θ ζ_y‖ = ‖w_y - h₀‖ / D_y := by
      dsimp [Θ, D_y]
      rw [hw_y_eq, norm_div]
    rw [hΘ_val] at h_schwarz
    have h_num_le : ‖w_y - h₀‖ ≤ r_y * D_y := (div_le_iff₀ hD_pos).mp h_schwarz
    have h_sq_le : ‖w_y - h₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ (r_y * D_y) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_num_le 2
    have h_id_y : D_y ^ 2 - ‖w_y - h₀‖ ^ 2 = 4 * w_y.re * v₁ := h_quad_id w_y
    have h1_sub_r2 : 1 - r_y ^ 2 = 4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [r_y]
      have hy1 : y + 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp [hy1]
      ring
    have h_lower1 : (4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2) * v₁ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w_y.re * v₁ := by
      calc (4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2) * v₁ ^ 2
          ≤ (4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2) * D_y ^ 2 := by
            gcongr
        _ = (1 - r_y ^ 2) * D_y ^ 2 := by rw [h1_sub_r2]
        _ = D_y ^ 2 - (r_y * D_y) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ D_y ^ 2 - ‖w_y - h₀‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
        _ = 4 * w_y.re * v₁ := h_id_y
    have h_clear : 4 * y * v₁ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w_y.re * v₁ * (y + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have hp : 0 < (y + 1) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lower1 hp.le
      have hlhs : 4 * y / (y + 1) ^ 2 * v₁ ^ 2 * (y + 1) ^ 2 = 4 * y * v₁ ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [hp.ne']
      linarith
    have hy1_sq_le : (y + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * y ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_bound_re : v₁ / 4 ≤ y * w_y.re := by
      have hwv_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * w_y.re * v₁ := by positivity
      have h_step : 4 * w_y.re * v₁ * (y + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * y ^ 2 * w_y.re * v₁ := by
        calc 4 * w_y.re * v₁ * (y + 1) ^ 2
            ≤ 4 * w_y.re * v₁ * (4 * y ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1_sq_le hwv_nonneg
          _ = 16 * y ^ 2 * w_y.re * v₁ := by ring
      have h_comb : (16 * y * v₁) * (v₁ / 4) ≤ (16 * y * v₁) * (y * w_y.re) := by
        linarith [le_trans h_clear h_step]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_comb (by positivity : 0 < 16 * y * v₁)
    have hw_re_le_norm : w_y.re ≤ ‖L.S_inf (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := by
      rw [← hh_norm]
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _)
    have h_contra_le :
        v₁ / 4 ≤ y * ‖L.S_inf (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (-(y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ :=
      le_trans h_bound_re (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_re_le_norm hy_pos.le)
    linarith

  let β : ℝ := (h (-Complex.I)).im
  let h₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => h Y - (β : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hh₁_zero : h₁ (-Complex.I) = 0 := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [h₁, hh0_re_zero]
    · simp [h₁, β]
  have hh₁_re_nonneg : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 0 ≤ (h₁ Y).re := by
    intro Y hY
    have : (h₁ Y).re = (h Y).re := by simp [h₁]
    rw [this]
    exact hh_re_nonneg Y hY
  have hh₁_add_one_ge : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ ‖h₁ Y + 1‖ := by
    intro Y hY
    have hre := hh₁_re_nonneg Y hY
    have hre1 : 1 ≤ (h₁ Y + 1).re := by simp; linarith
    exact le_trans hre1 (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _))
  have hh₁_add_one_ne : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, h₁ Y + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro Y hY h0
    have := hh₁_add_one_ge Y hY
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  let G_inv : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => (h₁ Y + 1)⁻¹
  have hG_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_inv superlinearLowerHalfPlane :=
    ((hh_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)).add (differentiableOn_const 1)).inv hh₁_add_one_ne
  have hG_inv_negI : ‖G_inv (-Complex.I)‖ = 1 := by
    simp [G_inv, hh₁_zero]
  have hG_inv_max : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ G_inv) superlinearLowerHalfPlane (-Complex.I) := by
    intro Y hY
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hG_inv_negI, G_inv, norm_inv]
    exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (hh₁_add_one_ge Y hY)
  have hG_inv_const :=
    Complex.norm_eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn hH_preconn hH_open hG_inv_holo hnegI_mem
      hG_inv_max
  have hh₁_eq_zero : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, h₁ Y = 0 := by
    intro Y hY
    have h_eq : ‖G_inv Y‖ = 1 := by
      have := hG_inv_const hY
      simpa [hG_inv_negI] using this
    dsimp [G_inv] at h_eq
    rw [norm_inv, inv_eq_one] at h_eq
    have h_sq : ‖h₁ Y + 1‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [h_eq]; norm_num
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply] at h_sq
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, add_zero] at h_sq
    have hre := hh₁_re_nonneg Y hY
    have hre_zero : (h₁ Y).re = 0 := by nlinarith
    have him_zero : (h₁ Y).im = 0 := by nlinarith
    exact Complex.ext hre_zero him_zero
  have hS_shift : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, L.S_inf Y - Y = (β : ℂ) := by
    intro Y hY
    have h0 : h Y - (β : ℂ) * Complex.I = 0 := hh₁_eq_zero Y hY
    have h_eq : -Complex.I * (Y - L.S_inf Y) = (β : ℂ) * Complex.I := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    have h_mul := congr_arg (fun z : ℂ => Complex.I * z) h_eq
    have hlhs : Complex.I * (-Complex.I * (Y - L.S_inf Y)) = Y - L.S_inf Y := by
      calc Complex.I * (-Complex.I * (Y - L.S_inf Y))
          = -(Complex.I ^ 2) * (Y - L.S_inf Y) := by ring
        _ = Y - L.S_inf Y := by simp
    have hrhs : Complex.I * ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I) = -(β : ℂ) := by
      calc Complex.I * ((β : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          = (β : ℂ) * Complex.I ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = -(β : ℂ) := by simp
    rw [hlhs, hrhs] at h_mul
    linear_combination -h_mul
  have hβ_zero : β = 0 := by
    by_contra hβ_ne
    have hβ_pos : 0 < |β| := abs_pos.mpr hβ_ne
    let D : ℝ := max L.D₁ ((L.C₁ / (|β| / 2)) ^ 2 + 1)
    have hD_ge : L.D₁ ≤ D := le_max_left _ _
    have hD_pos : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le L.D₁_pos hD_ge
    have hD_sq : (L.C₁ / (|β| / 2)) ^ 2 < D := by
      have : (L.C₁ / (|β| / 2)) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ D := le_max_right _ _
      linarith
    have h_lt := h_inv_sqrt_lt L.C₁ (|β| / 2) D L.C₁_pos (by positivity) hD_sq
    set Y_D : ℂ := -(D : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hYD_mem : Y_D ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
      change Y_D.im < 0
      simp [Y_D, hD_pos]
    have h_anc : ‖L.S_inf Y_D - Y_D‖ ≤ L.C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa [Y_D] using L.S_inf_anchor 0 D hD_ge
    rw [hS_shift Y_D hYD_mem, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_anc
    linarith
  have hS_id : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, L.S_inf Y = Y := by
    intro Y hY
    have := hS_shift Y hY
    rw [hβ_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hS_deriv : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, deriv L.S_inf Y = 1 := by
    intro Y hY
    have h_ev : L.S_inf =ᶠ[nhds Y] id :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hH_open.mem_nhds hY) (fun Z hZ => hS_id Z hZ)
    rw [h_ev.deriv_eq, deriv_id]

  
  let z_star : ℂ := -((L.D₀ + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hz_star_mem : z_star ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane := by
    change z_star.im < 0
    simp [z_star]
    linarith [L.D₀_pos]
  have h_ball_props : ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball z_star 1,
      Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      1 ≤ -Y.im ∧
      L.D₀ < -Y.im ∧
      |Y.re| < -Y.im ∧
      (-Y.im) ^ (-α₁) ≤ 1 := by
    intro Y hY
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hY
    have hre : |(Y - z_star).re| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hY
    have him : |(Y - z_star).im| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hY
    simp only [z_star, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
      sub_zero, neg_zero, Complex.neg_im, Complex.mul_im, add_zero, sub_neg_eq_add] at hre him
    rw [abs_lt] at him
    have hY_depth : L.D₀ + 2 < -Y.im := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Y.im < 0; linarith [L.D₀_pos]
    · linarith [L.D₀_pos]
    · linarith
    · linarith [L.D₀_pos]
    · exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith [L.D₀_pos]) (by linarith)

  rcases L.pure_energy_branch with ⟨F, hF_holo, hF_norm, hF_dec, hF_eq⟩ |
      ⟨Q, hQ_holo, hQ_norm, hQ_dec, hQ_eq⟩
  · have hF_ball_zero : ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball z_star 1, F Y = 0 := by
      intro Y hY
      obtain ⟨hY_H, hY_1, hY_D₀, hY_re, hY_rpow⟩ := h_ball_props Y hY
      have h_eq := hF_eq Y hY_D₀ hY_re
      rw [hS_id Y hY_H, hS_deriv Y hY_H] at h_eq
      simp only [one_pow, mul_one, one_mul] at h_eq
      have h_norm_half : ‖F Y / 2‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
        have hF_le : ‖F Y‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans (hF_dec Y hY_H hY_1) hY_rpow
        linarith
      have h_half_zero := h_ker1_zero (F Y / 2) h_norm_half h_eq
      exact div_eq_zero_iff.mp h_half_zero |>.resolve_right (by norm_num)
    have hF_ev : F =ᶠ[nhds z_star] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one)) hF_ball_zero
    have hF_eqOn :=
      (hF_holo.analyticOnNhd hH_open).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
        analyticOnNhd_const hH_preconn hz_star_mem hF_ev
    have hF_negI : F (-Complex.I) = 0 := hF_eqOn hnegI_mem
    rw [hF_negI, norm_zero] at hF_norm
    norm_num at hF_norm
  · have hQ_ball_zero : ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball z_star 1, Q Y = 0 := by
      intro Y hY
      obtain ⟨hY_H, hY_1, hY_D₀, hY_re, hY_rpow⟩ := h_ball_props Y hY
      have h_eq := hQ_eq Y hY_D₀ hY_re
      rw [hS_id Y hY_H, hS_deriv Y hY_H] at h_eq
      simp only [one_pow, mul_one, one_mul] at h_eq
      have hQ_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt ‖Q Y‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans (hQ_dec Y hY_H hY_1) hY_rpow
      have hQ_le_one : ‖Q Y‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hQ_sqrt_le 2
        rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _), one_pow] at h1
      have h_norm_quarter : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 * Q Y‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        have hq : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
        rw [hq]
        linarith
      have h_q_zero := (h_ker2_props ((1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 * Q Y) h_norm_quarter).2 h_eq
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_q_zero).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    have hQ_ev : Q =ᶠ[nhds z_star] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one)) hQ_ball_zero
    have hQ_eqOn :=
      (hQ_holo.analyticOnNhd hH_open).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
        analyticOnNhd_const hH_preconn hz_star_mem hQ_ev
    have hQ_negI : Q (-Complex.I) = 0 := hQ_eqOn hnegI_mem
    rw [hQ_negI, norm_zero, Real.sqrt_zero] at hQ_norm
    norm_num at hQ_norm

proof.tactics:
by
  intro M h R g κ hh hR hg_cont hg_per hκ_cont hκ_nonneg hκ_int hκ_one h_sub
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_trans hh hR
  have hRh_pos : 0 < R - h := sub_pos.mpr hR
  
  have hg_bdd_ex : ∃ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ m ≤ M, ∀ x : ℝ, |g m x| ≤ B := by
    have h_each : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, m ≤ M → ∀ x : ℝ, |g m x| ≤ C := by
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m ≤ M
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hg_cont m hm).continuousOn
        refine ⟨C, fun _ x => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨y, hy_mem, hxy⟩ := (hg_per m hm).exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos x
        rw [hxy, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hC y (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy_mem)
      · exact ⟨0, fun h' => False.elim (hm h')⟩
    choose C_fn hC_fn using h_each
    refine ⟨1 + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), max (C_fn m) 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), max (C_fn m) 0 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => le_max_right _ _)
      linarith
    · intro m hm x
      have h1 : |g m x| ≤ C_fn m := hC_fn m hm x
      have h2 : C_fn m ≤ max (C_fn m) 0 := le_max_left _ _
      have h3 : max (C_fn m) 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), max (C_fn j) 0 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => le_max_right _ _) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      linarith
  obtain ⟨B, hB_ge_one, hg_bdd⟩ := hg_bdd_ex
  have hB_pos : 0 < B := by linarith
  have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := le_of_lt hB_pos
  
  have hStepProb : ∀ m < M, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcStepMeasure κ m) := by
    intro m hm
    rw [MeasureTheory.isProbabilityMeasure_iff]
    simp only [dtpcStepMeasure, MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_univ]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hκ_int m hm)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hκ_nonneg m hm)), hκ_one m hm, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  have hStepIntEq : ∀ m < M, ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∫ u, f u ∂dtpcStepMeasure κ m) = ∫ u : ℝ, f u * κ m u := by
    intro m hm f
    rw [dtpcStepMeasure, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
      (hκ_cont m hm).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)) f]
    congr 1; ext u
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hκ_nonneg m hm u), smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hChainProb : ∀ n ≤ M, MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcChainMeasure κ n) := by
    intro n hn
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      change MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
        (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ •
          MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)))
      rw [MeasureTheory.isProbabilityMeasure_iff, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
        MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ioc, sub_zero,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), inv_mul_cancel₀ Real.two_pi_pos.ne',
        ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    | succ n ih =>
      have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcChainMeasure κ n) := ih (by omega)
      have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcStepMeasure κ n) := hStepProb n (by omega)
      change MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ((dtpcChainMeasure κ n).prod (dtpcStepMeasure κ n))
      infer_instance
  have hProbM : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcChainMeasure κ M) := hChainProb M le_rfl
  have hPathMeas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (dtpcChainPath n) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro k
      change Measurable (id : ℝ → ℝ)
      exact measurable_id
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro k
      by_cases hk : k ≤ n
      · simp only [dtpcChainPath, hk, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((measurable_pi_apply k).comp ih).comp measurable_fst
      · simp only [dtpcChainPath, hk, ↓reduceIte]
        exact (((measurable_pi_apply n).comp ih).comp measurable_fst).add measurable_snd
  have hStepExtMeas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun p : (ℕ → ℝ) × ℝ => dtpcStepExtend m p.1 p.2) := by
    intro m
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro k
    by_cases hk : k ≤ m
    · simp only [dtpcStepExtend, hk, ↓reduceIte]
      exact (measurable_pi_apply k).comp measurable_fst
    · simp only [dtpcStepExtend, hk, ↓reduceIte]
      exact ((measurable_pi_apply m).comp measurable_fst).add measurable_snd
  have hChainIntOfBdd : ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ M → ∀ (Φ : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      Measurable Φ → (∀ w, |Φ w| ≤ C) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => Φ (dtpcChainPath n om)) (dtpcChainMeasure κ n) := by
    intro n hn Φ C hΦ hC
    have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcChainMeasure κ n) := hChainProb n hn
    exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound (hΦ.comp (hPathMeas n)).aestronglyMeasurable C
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun om => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC _))
  have hChainProj : ∀ (r N : ℕ), r ≤ N → N ≤ M → ∀ (Φ : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ),
      dtpcDependsUpTo r Φ →
      (∫ om, Φ (dtpcChainPath N om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ N) =
        ∫ om, Φ (dtpcChainPath r om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ r := by
    intro r N hrN hNM Φ hdep
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      have hr0 : r = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hrN
      subst hr0; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hrn : r = n + 1
      · subst hrn; rfl
      · have hr_le_n : r ≤ n := by omega
        have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcChainMeasure κ n) := hChainProb n (by omega)
        have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (dtpcStepMeasure κ n) := hStepProb n (by omega)
        have h_pt : ∀ p : dtpcChainSpace (n + 1),
            Φ (dtpcChainPath (n + 1) p) = Φ (dtpcChainPath n p.1) * (1 : ℝ) := by
          intro p
          rw [mul_one]
          apply hdep
          intro k hk
          have hk_n : k ≤ n := le_trans hk hr_le_n
          simp [dtpcChainPath, hk_n]
        calc (∫ p, Φ (dtpcChainPath (n + 1) p) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ (n + 1))
            = ∫ p : dtpcChainSpace n × ℝ, Φ (dtpcChainPath n p.1) * (1 : ℝ)
                 ∂(dtpcChainMeasure κ n).prod (dtpcStepMeasure κ n) :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_pt)
          _ = (∫ q, Φ (dtpcChainPath n q) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ n) *
                (∫ _ : ℝ, (1 : ℝ) ∂dtpcStepMeasure κ n) :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_prod_mul (fun q => Φ (dtpcChainPath n q)) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
          _ = ∫ q, Φ (dtpcChainPath n q) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ n := by
              rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul, mul_one]
          _ = ∫ om, Φ (dtpcChainPath r om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ r :=
              ih hr_le_n (by omega)
  have hChainCondStep : ∀ (m : ℕ), m < M → ∀ (Φ : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      Measurable Φ → (∀ w, |Φ w| ≤ C) → dtpcDependsUpTo (m + 1) Φ →
      (∫ om, Φ (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) =
        (∫ hist, (∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m (dtpcChainPath m hist) u) * κ m u)
          ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ m) ∧
      Measurable (fun w : ℕ → ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u) ∧
      (∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, |∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u| ≤ max C 0) := by
    intro m hm Φ C hΦ_meas hΦ_bdd hΦ_dep
    have h_meas_inner : Measurable (fun w : ℕ → ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u) := by
      have h_joint : Measurable (fun p : (ℕ → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ (dtpcStepExtend m p.1 p.2) * κ m p.2) :=
        (hΦ_meas.comp (hStepExtMeas m)).mul ((hκ_cont m hm).measurable.comp measurable_snd)
      exact h_joint.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.measurable
    have h_bdd_inner : ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, |∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u| ≤ max C 0 := by
      intro w
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖∫ u : ℝ, Φ (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u‖
          ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, max C 0 * κ m u := by
            apply MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le ((hκ_int m hm).const_mul (max C 0))
            exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => by

          nlinarith [sq_abs (d u), abs_nonneg (d u)]
        have hY_inner_pt : ∀ u : ℝ, ΔY2 m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u =
            (2 * Z_mart m w) * (d u * κ m u) + (d u) ^ 2 * κ m u := by
          intro u
          rw [hΔY2_eq]
          have hAm_u : A_surv m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) :=
            (hA_dep m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) w (fun i hi => h_ext_le i hi u)).mpr hAm
          have hZm_u : Z_mart m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) = Z_mart m w :=
            hZ_dep m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) w (fun i hi => h_ext_le i hi u)
          have hCm_u : C_pred m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) := by
            intro hE_u; apply hCm; intro i hi
            have him : i ≤ m := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
            simpa [h_ext_le i him u] using hE_u i hi
          have h_not : ¬ (m + 1 ≤ m) := by omega
          have hξ_u : ξ_inc m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) = d u := by
            simp [ξ_inc, hCm_u, dtpcStepExtend, h_not, d, x]
          simp only [hAm_u, ↓reduceIte, hZm_u, hξ_u]; ring
        have hQ_decomp_pt : ∀ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u =
            ((d u) ^ 2 * κ m u + (2 * b) * (d u * κ m u)) + b ^ 2 * κ m u := by
          intro u; simp only [d, b]; ring
        have h_int_d2_add : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun u : ℝ => (d u) ^ 2 * κ m u + (2 * b) * (d u * κ m u)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
          h_int_d2.add (h_int_d.const_mul (2 * b))
        simp_rw [hY_inner_pt, hQ_decomp_pt]
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (h_int_d.const_mul (2 * Z_mart m w)) h_int_d2,
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_d_zero, mul_zero, zero_add,
          MeasureTheory.integral_add h_int_d2_add ((hκ_int m hm).const_mul (b ^ 2)),
          MeasureTheory.integral_add h_int_d2 (h_int_d.const_mul (2 * b)),
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_d_zero, mul_zero, add_zero,
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hκ_one m hm, mul_one]
        linarith [sq_nonneg b]
      · have hY_zero : ∀ u : ℝ, ΔY2 m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) * κ m u = 0 := by
          intro u
          rw [hΔY2_eq]
          by_cases hAm : A_surv m w
          · have hCm : ¬ C_pred m w := fun hc => hAC ⟨hAm, hc⟩
            have h_not_Cm_u : ¬ C_pred m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) := by
              intro hc_u; apply hCm; intro hE_w; apply hc_u; intro i hi
              have him : i ≤ m := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
              simpa [h_ext_le i him u] using hE_w i hi
            have hξ_zero : ξ_inc m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) = 0 := by simp [ξ_inc, h_not_Cm_u]
            split_ifs <;> simp [hξ_zero]
          · have h_not_Am_u : ¬ A_surv m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) :=
              fun ha_u => hAm ((hA_dep m (dtpcStepExtend m w u) w (fun i hi => h_ext_le i hi u)).mp ha_u)
            simp [h_not_Am_u]
        simp_rw [hY_zero, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
        exact MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hκ_nonneg m hm u))
    have h_tel : ∀ om : dtpcChainSpace M,
        (Y_stop M (dtpcChainPath M om)) ^ 2 =
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ΔY2 m (dtpcChainPath M om) := by
      intro om
      have h_sub_tel := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => (Y_stop k (dtpcChainPath M om)) ^ 2) M
      have hY0 : Y_stop 0 (dtpcChainPath M om) = 0 := by simp [Y_stop]
      rw [hY0] at h_sub_tel
      linarith
    simp_rw [h_tel]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range M) (fun m hm => by
        have hm' : m < M := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
        exact hChainIntOfBdd M le_rfl (ΔY2 m) (2 * ((M : ℝ) * (2 * B)) ^ 2)
          (((hY_meas (m + 1) (by omega)).pow_const 2).sub ((hY_meas m (by omega)).pow_const 2))
          (fun w => by
            have h1 := hY_bdd (m + 1) (by omega) w
            have h2 := hY_bdd m (by omega) w
            have h1s : (Y_stop (m + 1) w) ^ 2 ≤ ((M : ℝ) * (2 * B)) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith [sq_abs (Y_stop (m + 1) w), abs_nonneg (Y_stop (m + 1) w)]
            have h2s : (Y_stop m w) ^ 2 ≤ ((M : ℝ) * (2 * B)) ^ 2 := by
              nlinarith [sq_abs (Y_stop m w), abs_nonneg (Y_stop m w)]
            calc |ΔY2 m w|
                ≤ |(Y_stop (m + 1) w) ^ 2| + |(Y_stop m w) ^ 2| := abs_sub _ _
              _ = (Y_stop (m + 1) w) ^ 2 + (Y_stop m w) ^ 2 := by
                  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
              _ ≤ 2 * ((M : ℝ) * (2 * B)) ^ 2 := by linarith)),
      show (∫ om, QVar (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ∫ om, ΔQ m (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M from
        MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range M) (fun m hm => by
          have hm' : m < M := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
          exact hChainIntOfBdd M le_rfl (ΔQ m) (4 * B ^ 2)
            (((hMeasG (m + 1) (by omega)).sub (hMeasG m (by omega))).pow_const 2)
            (hQTermBdd m hm'))]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => h_step_L2 m (Finset.mem_range.mp hm))
  have hPostBound : (∫ om, PostOccup (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) ≤
      (M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 * (∫ om, QVar (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) / (R - h) ^ 2 := by
    have hPost_int := hChainIntOfBdd M le_rfl PostOccup ((M : ℝ) * h ^ 2) hPostOccupMeas hPostOccupBdd
    have hYM2_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om => (Y_stop M (dtpcChainPath M om)) ^ 2) (dtpcChainMeasure κ M) :=
      hChainIntOfBdd M le_rfl (fun w => (Y_stop M w) ^ 2) (((M : ℝ) * (2 * B)) ^ 2)
        ((hY_meas M le_rfl).pow_const 2)
        (fun w => by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
          have h1 := hY_bdd M le_rfl w
          nlinarith [sq_abs (Y_stop M w), abs_nonneg (Y_stop M w)])
    have h_dom_int := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hPost_int
      (hYM2_int.const_mul ((M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 / (R - h) ^ 2))
      (fun om => hPostDom (dtpcChainPath M om))
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul] at h_dom_int
    have h_mul_L2 : ((M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 / (R - h) ^ 2) *
          (∫ om, (Y_stop M (dtpcChainPath M om)) ^ 2 ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) ≤
        ((M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 / (R - h) ^ 2) *
          (∫ om, QVar (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYM_L2 (by positivity)
    calc (∫ om, PostOccup (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M)
        ≤ ((M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 / (R - h) ^ 2) *
            (∫ om, QVar (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) :=
          le_trans h_dom_int h_mul_L2
      _ = (M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 *
            (∫ om, QVar (dtpcChainPath M om) ∂dtpcChainMeasure κ M) / (R - h) ^ 2 := by ring
  
  rw [hOccSplit, hVarSplit]
  exact add_le_add hPreBound hPostBound

discrete_tanaka_periodic_chain.definitions:
def dtpcChainSpace : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℝ
  | n + 1 => dtpcChainSpace n × ℝ

instance dtpcInstMeasurableChainSpace : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSpace (dtpcChainSpace n)
  | 0 => Real.measurableSpace
  | n + 1 => @Prod.instMeasurableSpace (dtpcChainSpace n) ℝ
      (dtpcInstMeasurableChainSpace n) Real.measurableSpace

noncomputable def dtpcStepMeasure (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.withDensity (fun u : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (κ m u))

noncomputable def dtpcChainMeasure (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) :
    (n : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (dtpcChainSpace n)
  | 0 =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ •
        MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  | n + 1 =>
      (dtpcChainMeasure κ n).prod (dtpcStepMeasure κ n)

def dtpcChainPath : ∀ (n : ℕ), dtpcChainSpace n → (ℕ → ℝ)
  | 0, x₀, _ => x₀
  | n + 1, p, k =>
      if k ≤ n then dtpcChainPath n p.1 k else dtpcChainPath n p.1 n + p.2

def dtpcStepExtend (m : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  fun k => if k ≤ m then w k else w m + u

def dtpcDependsUpTo (r : ℕ) (Φ : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k ≤ r, w₁ k = w₂ k) → Φ w₁ = Φ w₂

noncomputable def dtpcStopX (R : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ
  | 0, w => g 0 (w 0)
  | m + 1, w =>
      if ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), g k (w k) ≤ R then
        g (m + 1) (w (m + 1))
      else
        dtpcStopX R g m w
