proof.tactics:
by
  have h_base : ∀ H_p y₀ : ℝ, 0 < H_p → |y₀| < H_p →
      Continuous (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) ∧
      (∀ u : ℝ, 0 < stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ u : ℝ, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) = 1 ∧
      ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A →
        (∫ u in {u : ℝ | A < |u|}, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) =
          (2 / Real.pi) * Real.arctan
            (Real.cos (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p)) / Real.sinh (Real.pi * A / (2 * H_p))) := by
    intro H_p y₀ hHp hy₀
    have hy₀_bounds : -H_p < y₀ ∧ y₀ < H_p := abs_lt.mp hy₀
    set θ : ℝ := Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p)
    have h2Hp_pos : 0 < 2 * H_p := by positivity
    have hθ_mem : θ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
      constructor
      · rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2Hp_pos]
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, hy₀_bounds.1]
      · rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2Hp_pos]
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos, hy₀_bounds.2]
    have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos θ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo hθ_mem
    have h_denom_eq : ∀ u : ℝ,
        Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 =
          Real.sinh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 + Real.cos θ ^ 2 := by
      intro u
      have hc := Real.cosh_sq (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p))
      have hs := Real.sin_sq θ
      linarith
    have h_denom_pos : ∀ u : ℝ,
        0 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 := by
      intro u
      rw [h_denom_eq u]
      positivity
    have h_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u := by
      intro u
      unfold stripExitKernel
      have hch : 0 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) := Real.cosh_pos _
      have hd : 0 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2 := h_denom_pos u
      positivity
    have h_cont : Continuous (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) := by
      unfold stripExitKernel
      have h_lin : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) :=
        (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).div_const _
      have h_ch : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p))) :=
        Real.continuous_cosh.comp h_lin
      refine Continuous.div ?_ ?_ (fun u => ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos u))
      · exact continuous_const.mul (h_ch.mul continuous_const)
      · exact (h_ch.pow 2).sub continuous_const
    have h_even : ∀ u : ℝ, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ (-u) = stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u := by
      intro u
      unfold stripExitKernel
      have hneg : Real.pi * (-u) / (2 * H_p) = -(Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) := by ring
      rw [hneg, Real.cosh_neg]
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      Real.pi⁻¹ * Real.arctan (Real.sinh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) / Real.cos θ)
    have hF_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) u := by
      intro u
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.pi * t / (2 * H_p)) (Real.pi / (2 * H_p)) u := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul Real.pi).div_const (2 * H_p)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.sinh (Real.pi * t / (2 * H_p)))
          (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) * (Real.pi / (2 * H_p))) u :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_sinh _).comp u h1
      have h3 := (h2.div_const (Real.cos θ)).arctan.const_mul Real.pi⁻¹
      convert h3 using 1
      unfold stripExitKernel
      change (2 * H_p)⁻¹ * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) * Real.cos θ) /
          (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin θ ^ 2) = _
      rw [h_denom_eq u]
      have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
      have hHp_ne : H_p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hHp
      have hcos_ne : Real.cos θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hcos_pos
      have hd_ne : Real.sinh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 + Real.cos θ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      ring
    have hF_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      have h_lin_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p))
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
        have hpos : 0 < Real.pi / (2 * H_p) := by positivity
        exact (Filter.tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop hpos).congr (fun u => by simp only [id_eq]; ring)
      have h_sinh_top : Filter.Tendsto Real.sinh Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
        refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono' Filter.atTop ?_ Filter.tendsto_id
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with x hx
        exact Real.self_le_sinh_iff.mpr hx
      have h_quot_top : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun u : ℝ => Real.sinh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) / Real.cos θ)
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        ((h_sinh_top.comp h_lin_top).const_mul_atTop (inv_pos.mpr hcos_pos)).congr
          (fun u => (inv_mul_eq_div _ _))
      have h_atan :=
        ((Real.tendsto_arctan_atTop.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds).comp h_quot_top).const_mul
          Real.pi⁻¹
      convert h_atan using 1
      have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
      congr 1
      field_simp
    have h_Ioi_int : ∀ a : ℝ,
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) (Set.Ioi a) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      fun a => MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg'
        (fun x _ => hF_deriv x) (fun x _ => le_of_lt (h_pos x)) hF_tendsto
    have h_Ioi_val : ∀ a : ℝ,
        (∫ u in Set.Ioi a, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) = 1 / 2 - F a :=
      fun a => MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg'
        (fun x _ => hF_deriv x) (fun x _ => le_of_lt (h_pos x)) hF_tendsto
    have h_ind_neg : ∀ a : ℝ,
        (fun u : ℝ => (Set.Ioi a).indicator (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) (-u)) =
          (Set.Iio (-a)).indicator (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) := by
      intro a
      ext u
      by_cases hu : u < -a
      · have hnu : -u ∈ Set.Ioi a := by simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]; linarith
        have hu' : u ∈ Set.Iio (-a) := hu
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hnu, Set.indicator_of_mem hu', h_even u]
      · have hnu : -u ∉ Set.Ioi a := by simp only [Set.mem_Ioi]; linarith
        have hu' : u ∉ Set.Iio (-a) := hu
        simp only [Set.indicator, hnu, hu', ↓reduceIte]
    have h_Iio_int : ∀ a : ℝ,
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) (Set.Iio (-a)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro a
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Iio, ← h_ind_neg a]
      exact ((MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (h_Ioi_int a)).comp_neg
    have h_Iio_val : ∀ a : ℝ,
        (∫ u in Set.Iio (-a), stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) = 1 / 2 - F a := by
      intro a
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Iio, ← h_ind_neg a,
        MeasureTheory.integral_neg_eq_self, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,
        h_Ioi_val a]
    have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by simp [F]
    have h_Iic0_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) (Set.Iic 0)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h0 := h_Iio_int 0
      rw [neg_zero] at h0
      exact h0.congr_set_ae MeasureTheory.Iio_ae_eq_Iic.symm
    have h_Iic0_val : (∫ u in Set.Iic 0, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_set MeasureTheory.Iio_ae_eq_Iic]
      have h0 := h_Iio_val 0
      rw [neg_zero, hF0, sub_zero] at h0
      exact h0
    have h_univ_eq : Set.Iic (0 : ℝ) ∪ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) = Set.univ := Set.Iic_union_Ioi
    have h_disj0 : Disjoint (Set.Iic (0 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := Set.Iic_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
    have h_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (stripExitKernel H_p y₀) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integrableOn_univ, ← h_univ_eq]
      exact h_Iic0_int.union (h_Ioi_int 0)
    have h_mass : (∫ u : ℝ, stripExitKernel H_p y₀ u) = 1 := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_univ, ← h_univ_eq,
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj0 measurableSet_Ioi h_Iic0_int (h_Ioi_int 0),
        h_Iic0_val, h_Ioi_val 0, hF0]
      norm_num
    refine ⟨h_cont, h_pos, h_int, h_mass, ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    have h_set_eq : {u : ℝ | A < |u|} = Set.Iio (-A) ∪ Set.Ioi A := by
      ext u
      change A < |u| ↔ u ∈ Set.Iio (-A) ∪ Set.Ioi A
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_Ioi, lt_abs]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact Or.inr h
        · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
      · rintro (h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
        · exact Or.inl h
    have h_disjA : Disjoint (Set.Iio (-A)) (Set.Ioi A) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
      intro u hu
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_Ioi] at hu
      linarith [hu.1, hu.2]
    rw [h_set_eq,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disjA measurableSet_Ioi (h_Iio_int A) (h_Ioi_int A),
      h_Iio_val A, h_Ioi_val A]
    have h_arg_pos : 0 < Real.pi * A / (2 * H_p) := by positivity
    have h_sinh_pos : 0 < Real.sinh (Real.pi * A / (2 * H_p)) :=
      Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr h_arg_pos
    set t : ℝ := Real.sinh (Real.pi * A / (2 * H_p)) / Real.cos θ
    have ht_pos : 0 < t := div_pos h_sinh_pos hcos_pos
    have h_inv : Real.cos θ / Real.sinh (Real.pi * A / (2 * H_p)) = t⁻¹ :=
      (inv_div _ _).symm
    rw [h_inv, Real.arctan_inv_of_pos ht_pos]
    dsimp only [F]
    have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_tail_le : ∀ d d' R : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H → 0 < R →
      (∫ u in {u : ℝ | R * d < |u|}, stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u) ≤ 1 / R := by
    intro d d' R hd' hdd' hd hR
    have hd_pos : 0 < d := lt_trans hd' hdd'
    set H_p : ℝ := S.H - d'
    set y₀ : ℝ := S.H - d
    have hHp : 0 < H_p := by linarith
    have hy₀_pos : 0 < y₀ := by linarith
    have hy₀_lt : |y₀| < H_p := by rw [abs_of_pos hy₀_pos]; linarith
    have hA_pos : 0 < R * d := mul_pos hR hd_pos
    have h_tail := (h_base H_p y₀ hHp hy₀_lt).2.2.2.2 (R * d) hA_pos
    rw [h_tail]
    set φ : ℝ := Real.pi * (d - d') / (2 * H_p)
    have hφ_pos : 0 < φ := by
      have hdd'_pos : 0 < d - d' := sub_pos.mpr hdd'
      positivity
    have h_cos_eq : Real.cos (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p)) = Real.sin φ := by
      have h_ang : Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p) = Real.pi / 2 - φ := by

          rw [h0, norm_zero] at hgt
          linarith
        have h_log_avg := hf_analytic.circleAverage_log_norm_of_ne_zero hf_ne
        have h_congr : Set.EqOn w_eps (fun ζ => Real.log ‖S.f ζ‖) (Metric.sphere c |r|) := by
          intro ζ hζ
          have hgt := hcb_gt ζ (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)
          dsimp only [w_eps, truncLogSpeed]
          rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)]
        have hwc : w_eps c = Real.log ‖S.f c‖ := by
          dsimp only [w_eps, truncLogSpeed]
          rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hfc_gt)]
        rw [Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_congr, h_log_avg, hwc]
    have h_im_sq_avg : ∀ (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
        Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2) c r = c.im ^ 2 + r ^ 2 / 2 := by
      intro c r hr
      let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        ((c.im ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((2 * c.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ζ - c) -
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((ζ - c) * (ζ - c))
      have hP_diff : Differentiable ℂ P := by
        intro ζ
        dsimp only [P]
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z - c) ζ :=
          differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const c)
        exact ((differentiableAt_const _).sub ((differentiableAt_const _).mul hd)).sub
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul (hd.mul hd))
      have hP_avg : Real.circleAverage P c r = P c :=
        circleAverage_of_differentiable_on_off_countable Set.countable_empty
          hP_diff.continuous.continuousOn (fun z _ => hP_diff z)
      have hP_ci : CircleIntegrable P c r :=
        hP_diff.continuous.continuousOn.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr)
      have hPre_avg : Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => (P ζ).re) c r = c.im ^ 2 := by
        have hcomm := Complex.reCLM.circleAverage_comp_comm hP_ci
        change Real.circleAverage (⇑Complex.reCLM ∘ P) c r = c.im ^ 2
        rw [hcomm, hP_avg]
        simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply, P, sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero, Complex.ofReal_re]
      have h_sph_eq : Set.EqOn (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2)
          (fun ζ : ℂ => (P ζ).re + r ^ 2 / 2) (Metric.sphere c |r|) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_sphere, Complex.dist_eq, abs_of_pos hr] at hζ
        have hnsq : (ζ.re - c.re) ^ 2 + (ζ.im - c.im) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
          have h1 : Complex.normSq (ζ - c) = r ^ 2 := by
            rw [← Complex.sq_norm, hζ]
          rw [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at h1
          linarith
        have hPre_val : (P ζ).re =
            c.im ^ 2 + 2 * c.im * (ζ.im - c.im) -
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((ζ.re - c.re) ^ 2 - (ζ.im - c.im) ^ 2) := by
          dsimp only [P]
          simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
          ring
        dsimp only
        rw [hPre_val]
        linarith
      have hPre_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => (P ζ).re) c r :=
        (Complex.continuous_re.comp hP_diff.continuous).continuousOn.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr)
      have hconst_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => r ^ 2 / 2) c r :=
        continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr)
      rw [Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_sph_eq,
        Real.circleAverage_fun_add hPre_ci hconst_ci, hPre_avg,
        Real.circleAverage_const]
    have hD_le_zero : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ z ∈ ({z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} : Set ℂ),
        w_eps z - U z + η * (z.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2) ≤ 0 := by
      intro η hη
      let D_eta : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => w_eps z - U z + η * (z.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2)
      have hD_cont : ContinuousOn D_eta {z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} :=
        (hw_cont.sub hU_cont).add
          (continuousOn_const.mul ((Complex.continuous_im.pow 2).continuousOn.sub continuousOn_const))
      let R_comp : Set ℂ :=
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H_p) H_p)
      have hR_compact : IsCompact R_comp :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
      have hR_nonempty : R_comp.Nonempty :=
        ⟨0, ⟨(0, 0), ⟨⟨le_rfl, by positivity⟩, ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt hHp⟩⟩, by simp⟩⟩
      have hR_sub : R_comp ⊆ {z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} := by
        rintro z ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨_, hy⟩, rfl⟩
        change |((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| ≤ H_p
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
        exact abs_le.mpr hy
      obtain ⟨z_max, hz_max_R, hz_max_on⟩ :=
        hR_compact.exists_isMaxOn hR_nonempty (hD_cont.mono hR_sub)
      have hz_max_strip : z_max ∈ ({z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} : Set ℂ) := hR_sub hz_max_R
      have hD_global_max : ∀ z ∈ ({z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} : Set ℂ), D_eta z ≤ D_eta z_max := by
        intro z hz
        have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
        set k : ℤ := ⌊z.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        set z_red : ℂ := z + ((-k : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)
        have hz_red_R : z_red ∈ R_comp := by
          refine ⟨(z.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi), z.im), ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · have h1 : (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ z.re :=
              (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le _)
            linarith
          · have h2 : z.re < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi) :=
              (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
            linarith
          · exact abs_le.mp hz
          · apply Complex.ext <;> simp [z_red] <;> ring
        have hD_eq : D_eta z_red = D_eta z := by
          have hz_H : z ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_sub_H hz
          have hf_eq := hf_per_int (-k) z hz_H
          have hU_eq := hU_per_int (-k) z
          have him_eq : z_red.im = z.im := by simp [z_red]
          dsimp only [D_eta, w_eps, truncLogSpeed, z_red] at *
          rw [hf_eq, hU_eq, him_eq]
        rw [← hD_eq]
        exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hz_max_on z_red hz_red_R
      have hD_max_le : D_eta z_max ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra h_pos_neg
        have hD_pos : 0 < D_eta z_max := not_le.mp h_pos_neg
        have hz_max_le : |z_max.im| ≤ H_p := hz_max_strip
        have hz_max_lt : |z_max.im| < H_p := by
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz_max_le with hlt | heq
          · exact hlt
          · exfalso
            have hbd := hw_le_bdry z_max heq
            have him_sq : z_max.im ^ 2 = H_p ^ 2 := by
              rw [← sq_abs z_max.im, heq]
            dsimp only [D_eta] at hD_pos
            rw [him_sq, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero] at hD_pos
            linarith
        obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub, hw_avg_ge⟩ := hw_submean z_max hz_max_lt
        have h_sph_sub : Metric.sphere z_max r ⊆ {z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ H_p} := by
          intro ζ hζ
          have hlt : |ζ.im| < H_p := hr_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)
          exact le_of_lt hlt
        have hw_ci : CircleIntegrable w_eps z_max r :=
          (hw_cont.mono h_sph_sub).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
        have hU_ci : CircleIntegrable U z_max r :=
          (hU_cont.mono h_sph_sub).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
        let q_pert : ℂ → ℝ := fun ζ => η * (ζ.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2)
        have hq_ci : CircleIntegrable q_pert z_max r :=
          (continuous_const.mul ((Complex.continuous_im.pow 2).sub continuous_const)).continuousOn.circleIntegrable
            (le_of_lt hr_pos)
        have hD_ci : CircleIntegrable D_eta z_max r :=
          (hw_ci.sub hU_ci).add hq_ci
        have hq_avg : Real.circleAverage q_pert z_max r =
            η * (z_max.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2) + η * r ^ 2 / 2 := by
          have him2_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2) z_max r :=
            (Complex.continuous_im.pow 2).continuousOn.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
          have hc_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => H_p ^ 2) z_max r :=
            continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
          have h1 : Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ => η • (ζ.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2)) z_max r =
              η • Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2) z_max r :=
            Real.circleAverage_fun_smul
          change Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ => η • (ζ.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2)) z_max r = _
          rw [h1, smul_eq_mul, Real.circleAverage_fun_sub him2_ci hc_ci,
            h_im_sq_avg z_max r hr_pos, Real.circleAverage_const]
          ring
        have hD_avg_eq : Real.circleAverage D_eta z_max r =
            Real.circleAverage w_eps z_max r - Real.circleAverage U z_max r +
              Real.circleAverage q_pert z_max r := by
          have hadd := Real.circleAverage_fun_add
            (f₁ := fun ζ => w_eps ζ - U ζ) (f₂ := q_pert) (hw_ci.sub hU_ci) hq_ci
          change Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => (w_eps ζ - U ζ) + q_pert ζ) z_max r = _
          rw [hadd, Real.circleAverage_fun_sub hw_ci hU_ci]
        have hU_avg_eq := hU_harm z_max r hr_pos hr_sub
        have hD_avg_le : Real.circleAverage D_eta z_max r ≤ D_eta z_max := by
          refine Real.circleAverage_mono_on_of_le_circle hD_ci ?_
          intro ζ hζ
          rw [abs_of_pos hr_pos] at hζ
          exact hD_global_max ζ (h_sph_sub hζ)
        have hr2_pos : 0 < η * r ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
        dsimp only [D_eta] at hD_avg_le
        rw [hD_avg_eq, hU_avg_eq, hq_avg] at hD_avg_le
        linarith
      intro z hz
      exact le_trans (hD_global_max z hz) hD_max_le
    intro z hz
    by_contra h_gt_neg
    have h_gt : U z < w_eps z := not_le.mp h_gt_neg
    set δ_gap : ℝ := w_eps z - U z
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_gap := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
    set η : ℝ := δ_gap / (2 * H_p ^ 2 + 1)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := by positivity
    have hD_nonpos := hD_le_zero η hη_pos z hz
    have him_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ z.im ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h_eta_Hp : η * H_p ^ 2 < δ_gap := by
      dsimp only [η]
      have hden_pos : 0 < 2 * H_p ^ 2 + 1 := by positivity
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hden_pos]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg H_p]
    have h_eta_term : -δ_gap < η * (z.im ^ 2 - H_p ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  refine
    { kernel_cont := fun d d' hd' hdd' hd =>
        (h_base (S.H - d') (S.H - d) (by linarith)
          (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < S.H - d)]; linarith)).1
      kernel_pos := fun d d' hd' hdd' hd =>
        (h_base (S.H - d') (S.H - d) (by linarith)
          (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < S.H - d)]; linarith)).2.1
      kernel_integrable := fun d d' hd' hdd' hd =>
        (h_base (S.H - d') (S.H - d) (by linarith)
          (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < S.H - d)]; linarith)).2.2.1
      kernel_integral_one := fun d d' hd' hdd' hd =>
        (h_base (S.H - d') (S.H - d) (by linarith)
          (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < S.H - d)]; linarith)).2.2.2.1
      kernel_tail_le := h_tail_le
      kernel_core_ge := h_core_ge
      trunc_submean := ?_ }
  intro ε v v' x hε hvv' hev
  have hev'_lt : Real.exp (-v') < Real.exp (-v) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hev'_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-v') := Real.exp_pos _
  set H_p : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-v')
  have hHp_pos : 0 < H_p := by dsimp only [H_p]; linarith
  have hHp_lt : H_p < S.H := by dsimp only [H_p]; linarith
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v' t)
  have hrow_re : ∀ (w y : ℝ), (upperRowPt S w y).re = y := by
    intro w y
    unfold upperRowPt
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one, sub_self, add_zero]
  have hrow_im : ∀ (w y : ℝ), (upperRowPt S w y).im = S.H - Real.exp (-w) := by
    intro w y
    unfold upperRowPt
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
    have hw_cont_H : ContinuousOn (truncLogSpeed S ε) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).comp_continuousOn
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.f_holo.continuousOn)).log
        (fun z _ => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hε (le_max_right _ _)))
    have hrow_cont : Continuous (upperRowPt S v') :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    exact hw_cont_H.comp_continuous hrow_cont (fun t => by
      change |(upperRowPt S v' t).im| < S.H
      rw [hrow_im v' t, show S.H - Real.exp (-v') = H_p from rfl, abs_of_pos hHp_pos]
      exact hHp_lt)
  have hg_per : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro t
    have hmem : upperRowPt S v' t ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      change |(upperRowPt S v' t).im| < S.H
      rw [hrow_im v' t, show S.H - Real.exp (-v') = H_p from rfl, abs_of_pos hHp_pos]
      exact hHp_lt
    have hshift : upperRowPt S v' (t + 2 * Real.pi) = upperRowPt S v' t + 2 * Real.pi := by
      unfold upperRowPt
      push_cast
      ring
    dsimp only [g, truncLogSpeed]
    rw [hshift, S.f_periodic _ hmem]
  obtain ⟨hU_cont, hU_per, hU_bdry, hU_harm⟩ := h_dirichlet H_p g hHp_pos hg_cont hg_per
  let U : ℂ → ℝ := fun z =>
    if |z.im| < H_p then
      ∫ u : ℝ, g (z.re + u) * stripExitKernel H_p z.im u
    else
      g z.re
  have h_bdry_le : ∀ t : ℝ,
      truncLogSpeed S ε ((t : ℂ) + (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        U ((t : ℂ) + (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∧
      truncLogSpeed S ε ((t : ℂ) + (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        U ((t : ℂ) - (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro t
    have h_eq_pt : (t : ℂ) + (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I = upperRowPt S v' t := rfl
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hU_bdry t
    change U ((t : ℂ) + (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g t at hb1
    change U ((t : ℂ) - (H_p : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g t at hb2
    rw [hb1, hb2, h_eq_pt]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have h_maj := h_majorant H_p ε U hHp_pos hHp_lt hε hU_cont hU_per h_bdry_le hU_harm
  have hz₀_re : (upperRowPt S v x).re = x := hrow_re v x
  have hz₀_im : (upperRowPt S v x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-v) := hrow_im v x
  have hz₀_abs : |(upperRowPt S v x).im| < H_p := by
    rw [hz₀_im, abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < S.H - Real.exp (-v))]
    dsimp only [H_p]
    linarith
  have h_le := h_maj (upperRowPt S v x) (le_of_lt hz₀_abs)
  dsimp only [U] at h_le
  rw [if_pos hz₀_abs, hz₀_re, hz₀_im] at h_le
  exact h_le

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) :
    Nonempty (AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget)

signature.name: local_amplitude_and_blaschke_deficit
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) :
    Nonempty (AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hOpenStrip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hDerivFHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    S.f_holo.deriv hOpenStrip
  have hAmpArgPos : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, 0 < ‖S.f z‖ + stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have hd_pos : 0 < stripSymDepth S z := sub_pos.mpr hz
    by_cases hf0 : S.f z = 0
    · have hdf : deriv S.f z ≠ 0 := (S.f_simple_zeros z hz hf0).1
      have h1 : 0 < ‖deriv S.f z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hdf
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖S.f z‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    · have h1 : 0 < ‖S.f z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hf0
      have h2 : 0 ≤ stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖ :=
        mul_nonneg hd_pos.le (norm_nonneg _)
      linarith
  have hAmpCont : ContinuousOn (localAmp S) (horizStrip S.H) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.log ?_ (fun z hz => (hAmpArgPos z hz).ne')
    refine ContinuousOn.add S.f_holo.continuousOn.norm ?_
    refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ hDerivFHolo.continuousOn.norm
    exact (continuous_const.sub (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)).continuousOn
  have hAmpPer : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, localAmp S (z + 2 * Real.pi) = localAmp S z := by
    intro z hz
    have hdepth : stripSymDepth S (z + 2 * Real.pi) = stripSymDepth S z := by
      simp [stripSymDepth]
    have hderiv_eq : deriv S.f (z + (2 * Real.pi : ℝ)) = deriv S.f z := by
      have hev : (fun w : ℂ => S.f (w + (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))) =ᶠ[nhds z] S.f := by
        filter_upwards [hOpenStrip.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        simpa using S.f_periodic w hw
      have h1 : deriv (fun w : ℂ => S.f (w + (2 * Real.pi : ℝ))) z = deriv S.f z :=
        hev.deriv_eq
      rw [deriv_comp_add_const] at h1
      exact h1
    simp only [localAmp]
    have hf_eq : S.f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = S.f z := S.f_periodic z hz
    have hcast : z + (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hf_eq, hdepth]
    congr 3
    simpa [hcast] using congrArg norm hderiv_eq
  have hAmpConj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, localAmp S (starRingEnd ℂ z) = localAmp S z := by
    intro z hz
    have hdepth : stripSymDepth S (starRingEnd ℂ z) = stripSymDepth S z := by
      simp [stripSymDepth]
    have hderiv_conj : deriv S.f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv S.f z) := by
      refine HasDerivAt.deriv ?_
      have hd₀ : 0 < stripSymDepth S z := sub_pos.mpr hz
      have hdf : HasDerivAt S.f (deriv S.f z) z :=
        (S.f_holo.differentiableAt (hOpenStrip.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero] at hdf ⊢
      have h_conj_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
        refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _
          ((by simpa using Complex.continuous_conj.tendsto (0 : ℂ) :
            Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (nhds 0) (nhds 0)).mono_left
            nhdsWithin_le_nhds) ?_
        filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h hh
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hh ⊢
        exact (map_ne_zero (starRingEnd ℂ)).mpr hh
      have h_comp := (Complex.continuous_conj.tendsto (deriv S.f z)).comp (hdf.comp h_conj_nhds)
      refine h_comp.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hd₀)] with h hh
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have h_mem : z + starRingEnd ℂ h ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        show |(z + starRingEnd ℂ h).im| < S.H
        have h1 : ‖starRingEnd ℂ h‖ < stripSymDepth S z := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hh
        have h2 : |(starRingEnd ℂ h).im| ≤ ‖starRingEnd ℂ h‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        have h3 : |(z + starRingEnd ℂ h).im| ≤ |z.im| + |(starRingEnd ℂ h).im| := by

        have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - ((x₀ : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        have h2 : (z - ((x₀ : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = z.im - (S.H - d) := by
          simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
          ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        exact le_trans h1 hdist
      have hb := abs_sub_le_iff.mp him_diff
      have him_pos : 0 < z.im := by linarith
      have h2_exp : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
      have hexp_m1 : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)]
        norm_num
        exact h2_exp
      have hd_half_ge : Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ d / 2 := by
        have h1 : Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ Real.exp (-1 - w) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hw.2])
        have h2 : Real.exp (-1 - w) = Real.exp (-1) * d := by
          dsimp [d]; rw [show -1 - w = -1 + (-w) by ring, Real.exp_add]
        have h3 : Real.exp (-1) * d ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_m1 hd_pos.le
        linarith
      have hz_im_bound : |z.im| ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) := by
        rw [abs_of_pos him_pos]
        linarith
      have hamp_abs := h_glob K hK z hz_im_bound
      have hamp_lo : -C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) ≤ localAmp S z := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hamp_abs).1
        linarith
      dsimp [ε_K]
      rw [Real.log_exp]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hi1, hi2, hb1, hb2⟩ := h_s4 K w ε_K hK hSmall hw hε_pos hSeg
    have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    exact ⟨hi1, hi2, by linarith, hb2⟩

by
  obtain ⟨C_inc, K_inc, hC_inc_pos, hK_inc_ge, hStepInc⟩ :=
    trunc_speed_step_l2_increment S hBudget hKern A
  set C_slice : ℝ := 100 * (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt C_inc) + 16 * C_inc
  have hC_slice_pos : 0 < C_slice := by
    dsimp only [C_slice]
    positivity
  have hC_occ_pos : 0 < 4 * Real.pi * C_slice := by positivity

  intro K hK hSmall
  have hK_amp_le : A.K_amp ≤ K := le_trans hK_inc_ge hK
  have hk₀_le_amp : hBudget.k₀ ≤ A.K_amp := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) A.K_amp_ge
  have h200_le_amp : (200 : ℝ) ≤ A.K_amp := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) A.K_amp_ge
  have hk₀_le_K : hBudget.k₀ ≤ K := le_trans hk₀_le_amp hK_amp_le
  have h200_le_K : (200 : ℝ) ≤ K := le_trans h200_le_amp hK_amp_le
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hv_le : (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K ≤ (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K := by linarith
  have hExpK : Real.exp (-K) < S.H / 4 := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (-K) ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp_of_le (by linarith)
    linarith [hBudget.exp_neg_k₀_lt, S.H_pos]
  have hExpVlo : Real.exp (-((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)) < S.H / 4 := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (-((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)) ≤ Real.exp (-K) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp_of_le (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hEpsPos : 0 < A.epsK K := Real.exp_pos _
  have hh₀Pos : 0 < K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos _
  obtain ⟨hInt2D, hIntSlice, hFubini⟩ :=
    row_occup_fubini_and_integrable S hKern (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ))
      ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K) hEpsPos hh₀Pos hv_le hExpVlo
  refine ⟨hInt2D, ?_⟩
  have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_slice * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) :=

noncomputable def stepOccupDensity (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ε h₀ s x v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if |truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)| ≤ h₀ then
    ∫ u : ℝ,
      min ((truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
        truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2) (h₀ ^ 2) *
      stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u
  else 0

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (hε : 0 < ε) (hh₀ : 0 < h₀) (hv_le : v_lo ≤ v_hi)

      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) 4,
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun v : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), stepOccupDensity S ε h₀ s x v)
        (Set.Icc v_lo (v_hi + 8)) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
    (∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) 4,
        (∫ v in v_lo..v_hi,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), stepOccupDensity S ε h₀ s x v) ≤ B) →

        rowOccupDensity S ε h₀ p.1 p.2) ≤ 4 * Real.pi * B)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hPolyGrowth : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) →
      wallDepth S s * shapeModulus S s ≤
        hBudget.C_env * (1 + Real.log (1 / wallDepth S s)) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
    intro s hs hd_le
    have hs_im : s.im < S.H := (abs_lt.mp hs).2
    have hd_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := by
      dsimp [wallDepth]
      linarith
    set d : ℝ := wallDepth S s
    set k_s : ℝ := Real.log (1 / d)
    have hk_s_eq : k_s = -Real.log d := by
      dsimp [k_s]
      rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
    have hk_s_ge : hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_s := by
      have hlog_le : Real.log d ≤ Real.log (Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hd_pos hd_le
      rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog_le
      linarith [hk_s_eq]
    have hexp_ks : Real.exp (-k_s) = d := by
      rw [hk_s_eq, neg_neg, Real.exp_log hd_pos]
    have hs_pt : (s.re : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_s) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I = s := by
      rw [hexp_ks]
      have h_im_eq : S.H - d = s.im := by
        dsimp [d, wallDepth]
        ring
      rw [h_im_eq]
      exact Complex.re_add_im s
    have h_sup := hBudget.row_sup_poly_bound k_s hk_s_ge s.re
    rw [hs_pt, hexp_ks] at h_sup
    have h_mod_le : shapeModulus S s ≤ ‖S.f s‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖ := by
      dsimp [shapeModulus]
      exact max_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S.q s‖], by linarith [norm_nonneg (S.f s)]⟩
    have h1ks_pos : 0 ≤ 1 + k_s := by linarith [hBudget.k₀_ge_one, hk_s_ge]
    have hrpow_two : (1 + k_s) ^ (2 : ℝ) = (1 + k_s) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Real.rpow_natCast (1 + k_s) 2
    rw [hrpow_two]
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mod_le (le_of_lt hd_pos)) h_sup
  obtain ⟨L₀, C₁, C₂, c_star, k_star, hL₀, hC₁, hC₂, hc_star, hk_star, hWit⟩ :=
    hCrit.poly_growth_witness hBudget.C_env (2 : ℝ) (Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀))
      hBudget.C_env_pos (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _) hPolyGrowth
  
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂_pos, h_udisk⟩ :=
    unit_disk_curv_log_oscillation (c_star ^ (2 : ℕ) / 1024) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨K_cone, C_cone, hK_cone_ge, hC_cone_pos, h_cone⟩ :=
    cone_curv_envelope_and_amp_chain S hBudget A L₀ C₁ C₂ hL₀ hC₁ hC₂
  obtain ⟨K_win, C_win, hK_win_ge, hC_win_pos, h_win⟩ :=
    two_disk_witness_window_lower_bound S hBudget hKern A c_star c₂ hc_star hc₂_pos h_udisk
  obtain ⟨C_occ, K_occ, hC_occ_pos, hK_occ_ge, h_occ⟩ := hOcc
  
  have hOpen_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hf_cont : ContinuousOn S.f (horizStrip S.H) := S.f_holo.continuousOn
  have hderiv_f_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    (S.f_holo.analyticOnNhd hOpen_strip).deriv.continuousOn
  have hAmpInner_pos : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
      0 < ‖S.f z‖ + stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have hsym_pos : 0 < stripSymDepth S z := by
      dsimp [stripSymDepth]
      linarith [(show |z.im| < S.H from hz)]
    by_cases hfz : S.f z = 0
    · have hdfz : deriv S.f z ≠ 0 := (S.f_simple_zeros z hz hfz).1
      have hmul_pos : 0 < stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖ :=
        mul_pos hsym_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hdfz)
      linarith [norm_nonneg (S.f z)]
    · have hfn_pos : 0 < ‖S.f z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfz
      have hmul_nn : 0 ≤ stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖ :=
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hsym_pos) (norm_nonneg _)
      linarith
  have hLocalAmp_cont : ContinuousOn (localAmp S) (horizStrip S.H) := by
    have hInner_cont : ContinuousOn
        (fun z : ℂ => ‖S.f z‖ + stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖) (horizStrip S.H) :=
      hf_cont.norm.add
        ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)).continuousOn.mul
          hderiv_f_cont.norm)
    exact hInner_cont.log fun z hz => ne_of_gt (hAmpInner_pos z hz)
  
  have hPow_le_rpow : ∀ (b K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 ≤ b → m ≠ 0 → b ^ m ≤ K →
      b ≤ K ^ (1 / (m : ℝ)) := by
    intro b K m hb hm hbm

    have h1 : (b ^ m) ^ (1 / (m : ℝ)) ≤ K ^ (1 / (m : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (pow_nonneg hb m) hbm (by positivity)
    have h2 : (b ^ m) ^ (1 / (m : ℝ)) = b := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast b m, ← Real.rpow_mul hb,
        mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt hm_pos), Real.rpow_one]
    rwa [h2] at h1
  
  intro ε hε
  have hC_amp_pos : 0 < A.C_amp := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one A.one_le_C_amp
  have hC_glob_pos : 0 < A.C_glob := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one A.one_le_C_glob
  set M_typ : ℝ := 12 * C_win * (L₀ + 1) * (200 * C₁ + C₂ + 2) * C_occ
  have hM_typ_pos : 0 < M_typ := by positivity
  set B₁ : ℝ := max hBudget.k₀ (max K_cone (max K_win (max K_occ k_star)))
  set B₂ : ℝ := max (2 * (L₀ + 1) / Real.pi) (max (4 / c_star) ((4 : ℝ) ^ (20 : ℕ)))

  refine ⟨max B₁ (max B₂ B₃), le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro K hK hSmall
  have hB₁ : B₁ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hK
  have hB₂₃ : max B₂ B₃ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hK
  have hB₂ : B₂ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₂₃
  have hB₃ : B₃ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB₂₃
  have hk₀_le_K : hBudget.k₀ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₁
  have hB₁_1 : max K_cone (max K_win (max K_occ k_star)) ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB₁
  have hK_cone_le : K_cone ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₁_1
  have hB₁_2 : max K_win (max K_occ k_star) ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB₁_1
  have hK_win_le : K_win ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₁_2
  have hB₁_3 : max K_occ k_star ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB₁_2
  have hK_occ_le : K_occ ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₁_3
  have hk_star_le : k_star ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB₁_3
  have hKamp_le_K : A.K_amp ≤ K := le_trans hK_cone_ge hK_cone_le
  have h200_le_K : (200 : ℝ) ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans A.K_amp_ge hKamp_le_K)
  have h1_le_K : (1 : ℝ) ≤ K := by linarith
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
  
  have hLw_K : 2 * (L₀ + 1) / Real.pi ≤ K := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB₂

        rw [h1, h2]

      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hrew hr50_pos

      have h1 : 8 * Real.pi * A.C_amp / ε ≤ K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := by linarith only [hK_rpow50]
      have h2 := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp h1
      have hcomm : K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) * ε = ε * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := mul_comm _ _
      have hassoc : (ε / 4) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (ε * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by ring
      linarith only [h2, hcomm, hassoc]
    have hfin : K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad1 ≤
        K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) * (ε / 4) := by linarith only [hdiv_le, hamp_le]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hfin hr50_pos
  
  set S_bad2 : Set ℝ :=
    {x ∈ I_x | K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) < coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x k}
  have hBad2_le : MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 ≤ ε / 4 := by
    let g₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x k

      hCone_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn fun x hx => ⟨hx, hk_mem⟩

    have hg₂_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ g₂ x := by
      intro x
      dsimp [g₂, coneCurvEnvelope]
      refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) ?_
      have hlog_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * K) := Real.log_nonneg h2K_ge_1
      have hC1_nn : 0 ≤ C₁ * Real.log (2 * K) := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC₁) hlog_nn
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith only [hC1_nn, hC₂]) fun t _ => ?_
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith only [hL₀]) fun τ _ => ?_
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (norm_nonneg _)

      have h_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, g₂ x ∂μ_row) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g₂ x := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le,
          ← MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hCone_avg k hk_mem
    have hMarkov2 := MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg₂_nn) hg₂_int (K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ))
    have hSub2 : S_bad2 ⊆ {x : ℝ | K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ g₂ x} := fun x hx => le_of_lt hx.2

      hμ_row_eq S_bad2 fun x hx => hx.1

      MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hSub2 (hμ_row_fin _)
    have hr_split : K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) = K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hK_pos]
      norm_num
    have hprod_le : K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 ≤

        (le_trans hMarkov2 hg₂_int_le)

    have hr3_pos : 0 < K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos _
    have hr1_pos : 0 < K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos _
    have hdiv_le : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 ≤ C_cone := by
      have hrew : (K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) ≤

        have h1 : (K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) =
            K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 := by ring
        rw [h1]
        exact hprod_le
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hrew hr3_pos
    have hcone_le : C_cone ≤ (ε / 4) * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by

      have hcomm : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * ε = ε * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := mul_comm _ _
      have hassoc : (ε / 4) * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (ε * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) := by ring
      linarith only [h2, hcomm, hassoc]
    have hfin : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 ≤
        K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * (ε / 4) := by linarith only [hdiv_le, hcone_le]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hfin hr1_pos
  
  set S_mod : Set ℝ :=
    {x ∈ I_x | Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ∧
      ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}

    · by_cases h2 : coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x k ≤ K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ)
      · have h_mem_RK : (x, k) ∈ R_K := ⟨hx.1, hk_mem⟩
        exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨⟨⟨h_mem_RK, hx.2.1⟩, ⟨h_mem_RK, hx.2.2⟩⟩,
          ⟨⟨h_mem_RK, h1⟩, ⟨h_mem_RK, h2⟩⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.1, lt_of_not_ge h2⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hx.1, lt_of_not_ge h1⟩)
  have hUnion_sub_Ix : (S_typ k ∪ S_bad1) ∪ S_bad2 ⊆ I_x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with (hx_typ | hx_b1) | hx_b2
    · exact (hSub_Etyp hx_typ).1
    · exact hx_b1.1
    · exact hx_b2.1
  have hUnion_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume ((S_typ k ∪ S_bad1) ∪ S_bad2) ≠ ⊤ := by
    have hIx_lt : MeasureTheory.volume I_x < ⊤ := by
      rw [Real.volume_Icc]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    exact ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hUnion_sub_Ix) hIx_lt)
  have hMod_vol_le : MeasureTheory.volume.real S_mod ≤
      MeasureTheory.volume.real (S_typ k) + MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad1 +
        MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 := by
    calc MeasureTheory.volume.real S_mod
        ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real ((S_typ k ∪ S_bad1) ∪ S_bad2) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hMod_sub hUnion_ne_top
      _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (S_typ k ∪ S_bad1) + MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real (S_typ k) + MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad1 +
            MeasureTheory.volume.real S_bad2 :=
          add_le_add (MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (S_typ k) S_bad1) le_rfl
  linarith only [hMod_vol_le, hk_typ_le, hBad1_le, hBad2_le]

    (L₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hC₂ : 0 < C₂) :

        (∀ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ∀ k ∈ Set.Icc ((6 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((9 / 5 : ℝ) * K),

            coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x₀ k ≤ K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) →

            |z₁.re - x₀| ≤ L₀ * wallDepth S z₁ →

            let x₁ : ℝ := z₁.re

            let v₁ : ℝ := -Real.log δ₁
            let δ₂ : ℝ := Real.exp (-3) * δ₁
            let z₂ : ℂ := (x₁ : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

      have h_raw := h_three_lines (fun s => S.f s ^ 2) hf2_holo hf2_per
        (y_fn D₀) (y_fn D₁) b hy₀ hy₁ hb hb_le
      simp only [norm_pow] at h_raw
      rwa [← hy_comb, ← ha_eq] at h_raw
    have hC_tl : C_fn (y_fn (a * D₀ + b * D₁)) ≤

      have h_raw := h_three_lines S.q S.q_holo S.q_periodic
        (y_fn D₀) (y_fn D₁) b hy₀ hy₁ hb hb_le
      rwa [← hy_comb, ← ha_eq] at h_raw
    obtain ⟨hA₀_pos, hC₀_nn⟩ := h_row_pos (y_fn D₀) hy₀
    obtain ⟨hA₁_pos, hC₁_nn⟩ := h_row_pos (y_fn D₁) hy₁
    obtain ⟨hAb_pos, hCb_nn⟩ := h_row_pos (y_fn (a * D₀ + b * D₁)) hyb
    let S₀ : ℝ := A_fn (y_fn D₀) + C_fn (y_fn D₀)
    let S₁ : ℝ := A_fn (y_fn D₁) + C_fn (y_fn D₁)

    have hS₁_pos : 0 < S₁ := by dsimp [S₁]; linarith

      Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted ha hb
        (div_nonneg hC₀_nn (le_of_lt hS₀_pos))
        (div_nonneg hC₁_nn (le_of_lt hS₁_pos)) hab
    rw [Real.div_rpow (le_of_lt hA₀_pos) (le_of_lt hS₀_pos),
      Real.div_rpow (le_of_lt hA₁_pos) (le_of_lt hS₁_pos), div_mul_div_comm] at h_amgm1
    rw [Real.div_rpow hC₀_nn (le_of_lt hS₀_pos),
      Real.div_rpow hC₁_nn (le_of_lt hS₁_pos), div_mul_div_comm] at h_amgm2

      mul_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hS₀_pos a) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hS₁_pos b)

      rw [add_div]
      calc A_fn (y_fn D₀) ^ a * A_fn (y_fn D₁) ^ b / (S₀ ^ a * S₁ ^ b) +
            C_fn (y_fn D₀) ^ a * C_fn (y_fn D₁) ^ b / (S₀ ^ a * S₁ ^ b)
          ≤ (a * (A_fn (y_fn D₀) / S₀) + b * (A_fn (y_fn D₁) / S₁)) +
              (a * (C_fn (y_fn D₀) / S₀) + b * (C_fn (y_fn D₁) / S₁)) :=
            add_le_add h_amgm1 h_amgm2
        _ = a * (S₀ / S₀) + b * (S₁ / S₁) := by dsimp [S₀, S₁]; ring

    have hSb_le : Sb ≤ S₀ ^ a * S₁ ^ b := by
      have h1 := (div_le_one h_denom_pos).mp h_sum_div

      linarith

        _ = Real.log (S₀ ^ a) + Real.log (S₁ ^ b) :=
            Real.log_mul (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hS₀_pos a).ne' (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hS₁_pos b).ne'

            rw [Real.log_rpow hS₀_pos, Real.log_rpow hS₁_pos]

      intro S_val hS_val
      rw [Real.log_mul hc_pos.ne' (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS_val).ne', Real.log_sqrt (le_of_lt hS_val)]

      a * Real.log (c_n * Real.sqrt S₀) + b * Real.log (c_n * Real.sqrt S₁)
    rw [hlog_decomp Sb hSb_pos, hlog_decomp S₀ hS₀_pos, hlog_decomp S₁ hS₁_pos]
    have hc_sum : a * Real.log c_n + b * Real.log c_n = Real.log c_n := by
      calc a * Real.log c_n + b * Real.log c_n = (a + b) * Real.log c_n := by ring
        _ = Real.log c_n := by rw [hab, one_mul]
    linarith
  have hm_upper : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (R_seq n),
      Real.log (m_seq n D) ≤ -Real.log D + ε_seq n * |Real.log D| := by
    intro n D hD
    have hk_log : k₀ ≤ k_seq n - Real.log D := (h_geom (k_seq n) D (h_basic n).1 hD).2
    have h_primary := h_norm n (k_seq n - Real.log D) hk_log
    have habs_eq : |(k_seq n - Real.log D) - k_seq n| = |Real.log D| := by
      have : (k_seq n - Real.log D) - k_seq n = -Real.log D := by ring
      rw [this, abs_neg]
    rw [habs_eq] at h_primary
    have hμ_pos : 0 < rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (h_basic n).2.2
    have h_div : m_seq n D ≤ D⁻¹ * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |Real.log D|) := by
      dsimp [m_seq]
      calc rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D) / (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * D)
          ≤ (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |Real.log D|)) /
              (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * D) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_primary (le_of_lt (mul_pos hμ_pos hD.1))
        _ = D⁻¹ * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |Real.log D|) := by
            field_simp [hμ_pos.ne', hD.1.ne']
    calc Real.log (m_seq n D)

          Real.log_le_log (hm_pos n D hD) h_div
      _ = Real.log D⁻¹ + Real.log (Real.exp (ε_seq n * |Real.log D|)) :=
          Real.log_mul (inv_ne_zero hD.1.ne') (Real.exp_ne_zero _)
      _ = -Real.log D + ε_seq n * |Real.log D| := by
          rw [Real.log_inv, Real.log_exp]
  
  let ψ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n D => Real.log (m_seq n D)
  have hψ_one : ∀ n : ℕ, ψ n 1 = 0 := fun n => by simp [ψ, hm_one n]
  let K_M : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun M => Set.Icc ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M) ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)
  let a_M : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (M + 1)
  let b_M : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + 1)
  let K'_M : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun M => Set.Icc (a_M M) (b_M M)
  let U_M : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => 2 * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log 2 + 1
  let B_M : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + 2) * U_M M
  let L_M : ℕ → ℝ := fun M => 2 * B_M M / a_M M
  have ha_pos : ∀ M : ℕ, 0 < a_M M := fun M => by positivity
  have ha_le_half : ∀ M : ℕ, a_M M ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro M
    dsimp [a_M]
    rw [pow_succ]
    have : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hb_ge_two : ∀ M : ℕ, 2 ≤ b_M M := by
    intro M
    dsimp [b_M]
    rw [pow_succ]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ M := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hU_pos : ∀ M : ℕ, 0 < U_M M := by

    have : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
    dsimp [U_M]
    positivity

  have hU_le_B : ∀ M : ℕ, U_M M ≤ B_M M := by
    intro M
    dsimp [B_M]
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (M + 2) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    nlinarith [hU_pos M]
  have hL_pos : ∀ M : ℕ, 0 < L_M M := fun M => div_pos (mul_pos zero_lt_two (hB_pos M)) (ha_pos M)
  have h_exists_N : ∀ M : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, b_M M ≤ R_seq n ∧ ε_seq n ≤ 1 := by

  have h_bound_K' : ∀ (M n : ℕ), N_M M ≤ n → ∀ D ∈ K'_M M, |ψ n D| ≤ B_M M := by
    intro M n hn D hD

    have hK'_sub : K'_M M ⊆ Set.Ioc 0 (R_seq n) := by

      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (ha_pos M) hx.1, le_trans hx.2 hR_b⟩
    have h_upper_K' : ∀ x ∈ K'_M M, ψ n x ≤ U_M M := by
      intro x hx
      have hx_Ioc : x ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (R_seq n) := hK'_sub hx
      have hx_pos : 0 < x := hx_Ioc.1
      have ha_eq : a_M M = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (M + 1))⁻¹ := by

        have hw₂ : 0 ≤ w₂ := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hden)

        have hw_pt : w₁ * D + w₂ * b_M M = 1 := by dsimp [w₁, w₂]; field_simp [hden.ne']; ring

        have h_cvx := (hm_conv n).2 (hK'_sub hD) (hK'_sub hb_mem) hw₁ hw₂ hw_sum
        simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_cvx
        rw [hw_pt, hm_one n, Real.log_one] at h_cvx
        have h_b_up : ψ n (b_M M) ≤ U_M M := h_upper_K' (b_M M) hb_mem
        have h_lin : 0 ≤ w₁ * ψ n D + w₂ * U_M M := by
          have : w₂ * ψ n (b_M M) ≤ w₂ * U_M M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_b_up hw₂

          linarith
        have h_mul_den : 0 ≤ (b_M M - 1) * ψ n D + (1 - D) * U_M M := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lin (le_of_lt hden)
          have heq : (b_M M - D) * (w₁ * ψ n D + w₂ * U_M M) =

            dsimp [w₁, w₂]; field_simp [hden.ne']
          linarith

        linarith [hB_pos M]
      · have ha_le := ha_le_half M
        have hden : 0 < D - a_M M := by linarith

        let w₂ : ℝ := (1 - a_M M) / (D - a_M M)
        have hw₁ : 0 ≤ w₁ := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hden)
        have hw₂ : 0 ≤ w₂ := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hden)
        have hw_sum : w₁ + w₂ = 1 := by dsimp [w₁, w₂]; field_simp [hden.ne']; ring
        have hw_pt : w₁ * a_M M + w₂ * D = 1 := by dsimp [w₁, w₂]; field_simp [hden.ne']; ring
        have ha_mem : a_M M ∈ K'_M M :=
          ⟨le_rfl, le_trans ha_le (le_trans (by norm_num) (hb_ge_two M))⟩
        have h_cvx := (hm_conv n).2 (hK'_sub ha_mem) (hK'_sub hD) hw₁ hw₂ hw_sum
        simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_cvx
        rw [hw_pt, hm_one n, Real.log_one] at h_cvx
        have h_a_up : ψ n (a_M M) ≤ U_M M := h_upper_K' (a_M M) ha_mem
        have h_lin : 0 ≤ w₁ * U_M M + w₂ * ψ n D := by
          have : w₁ * ψ n (a_M M) ≤ w₁ * U_M M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_a_up hw₁
          dsimp [ψ] at *
          linarith
        have h_mul_den : 0 ≤ (D - 1) * U_M M + (1 - a_M M) * ψ n D := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lin (le_of_lt hden)
          have heq : (D - a_M M) * (w₁ * U_M M + w₂ * ψ n D) =

            dsimp [w₁, w₂]; field_simp [hden.ne']
          linarith

    intro M n hn

      have h_s2 := (hm_conv n).slope_mono_adjacent

        rw [div_le_iff₀ h_dy] at this

    rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | rfl | hyx
    · rw [abs_sub_comm (ψ n x) (ψ n y), abs_sub_comm x y, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hxy)]
      exact h_lt x hx y hy hxy
    · simp
    · rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hyx)]
      exact h_lt y hy x hx hyx
  have h_step : ∀ (M : ℕ) (τ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono τ →
      ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
        ∃ f_M : ℝ → ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k D => ψ (τ (φ k)) D) f_M Filter.atTop (K_M M) := by
    intro M τ hτ
    let X_M := ↥(K_M M)
    have : CompactSpace X_M := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_Icc
    let τ' : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => τ (k + N_M M)
    have hτ'_ge : ∀ k : ℕ, N_M M ≤ τ' k := fun k =>
      le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (hτ.id_le _)
    let K_lip : NNReal := ⟨L_M M, le_of_lt (hL_pos M)⟩
    have hg_lip : ∀ k : ℕ, LipschitzWith K_lip (fun x : X_M => ψ (τ' k) x.1) := by
      intro k
      apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      change |ψ (τ' k) x.1 - ψ (τ' k) y.1| ≤ L_M M * |x.1 - y.1|
      exact h_lip_K M (τ' k) (hτ'_ge k) x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2
    let F : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction X_M ℝ := fun k =>
      BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨fun x : X_M => ψ (τ' k) x.1, (hg_lip k).continuous⟩
    have h_range : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction X_M ℝ) (x : X_M),
        f ∈ Set.range F → f x ∈ Set.Icc (-B_M M) (B_M M) := by
      rintro f x ⟨k, rfl⟩
      have hx_K' : x.1 ∈ K'_M M := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have hx1 := x.2.1
          have : a_M M ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M := by
            dsimp [a_M]; rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [(by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M)]
          linarith
        · have hx2 := x.2.2
          have : (2 : ℝ) ^ M ≤ b_M M := by
            dsimp [b_M]; rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [(by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M)]
          linarith
      exact abs_le.mp (h_bound_K' M (τ' k) (hτ'_ge k) x.1 hx_K')
    have h_equi : Equicontinuous (fun f : ↥(Set.range F) => ⇑f.1) := by
      apply (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous
        (fun f : ↥(Set.range F) => ⇑f.1) K_lip ?_).equicontinuous
      intro f
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := f.2
      rw [← hk]
      exact hg_lip k
    have h_comp_cl : IsCompact (closure (Set.range F)) :=
      BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (Set.Icc (-B_M M) (B_M M)) isCompact_Icc
        (Set.range F) h_range h_equi
    obtain ⟨f_lim, _, φ₀, hφ₀_mono, hφ₀_tendsto⟩ :=
      h_comp_cl.tendsto_subseq (fun k => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self k))
    have h_unif_X :
        TendstoUniformly (fun k (x : X_M) => ψ (τ' (φ₀ k)) x.1) (⇑f_lim) Filter.atTop :=
      BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp hφ₀_tendsto
    let φ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => φ₀ k + N_M M
    have hφ_mono : StrictMono φ := fun a b hab => Nat.add_lt_add_right (hφ₀_mono hab) (N_M M)
    let f_M : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => if hD : D ∈ K_M M then f_lim ⟨D, hD⟩ else 0
    refine ⟨φ, hφ_mono, f_M, ?_⟩
    rw [tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformly_comp_coe]
    have h_f_coe : f_M ∘ Subtype.val = ⇑f_lim := by
      ext x
      simp [f_M, x.2]
    rw [h_f_coe]
    exact h_unif_X
  let SubMap := { γ : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono γ }
  let next_φ : ℕ → SubMap → SubMap := fun M τ =>
    ⟨Classical.choose (h_step M τ.1 τ.2), (Classical.choose_spec (h_step M τ.1 τ.2)).1⟩
  let lim_fn : ℕ → SubMap → (ℝ → ℝ) := fun M τ =>
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_step M τ.1 τ.2)).2
  have h_lim_fn : ∀ (M : ℕ) (τ : SubMap),
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k D => ψ (τ.1 ((next_φ M τ).1 k)) D)
        (lim_fn M τ) Filter.atTop (K_M M) :=
    fun M τ => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_step M τ.1 τ.2)).2
  let τ_seq : ℕ → SubMap := Nat.rec ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩ fun M τ_prev =>
    ⟨τ_prev.1 ∘ (next_φ M τ_prev).1, τ_prev.2.comp (next_φ M τ_prev).2⟩
  let σ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => (τ_seq n).1 n
  have hσ_mono : StrictMono σ := by
    apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro n
    change (τ_seq n).1 n < (τ_seq n).1 ((next_φ n (τ_seq n)).1 (n + 1))
    apply (τ_seq n).2
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ((next_φ n (τ_seq n)).2.id_le (n + 1))
  let tail_map : ℕ → ℕ → SubMap := fun a =>
    Nat.rec ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩ fun d γ_prev =>
      ⟨γ_prev.1 ∘ (next_φ (a + d) (τ_seq (a + d))).1,
        γ_prev.2.comp (next_φ (a + d) (τ_seq (a + d))).2⟩
  have h_tau_tail : ∀ a d : ℕ, (τ_seq (a + d)).1 = (τ_seq a).1 ∘ (tail_map a d).1 := by
    intro a d
    induction d with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ d ih =>
      ext k
      change (τ_seq (a + d)).1 ((next_φ (a + d) (τ_seq (a + d))).1 k) =
        (τ_seq a).1 ((tail_map a d).1 ((next_φ (a + d) (τ_seq (a + d))).1 k))
      exact congr_fun ih _
  have h_diag_unif : ∀ M : ℕ,
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n D => ψ (σ n) D) (lim_fn M (τ_seq M)) Filter.atTop (K_M M) := by
    intro M
    have h_base := h_lim_fn M (τ_seq M)
    let β : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => (tail_map (M + 1) (n - (M + 1))).1 n
    have hβ_top : Filter.Tendsto β Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono
        (fun n => (tail_map (M + 1) (n - (M + 1))).2.id_le n) Filter.tendsto_id
    have h_sub_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n D => ψ ((τ_seq (M + 1)).1 (β n)) D)
        (lim_fn M (τ_seq M)) Filter.atTop (K_M M) :=
      fun u hu => hβ_top.eventually (h_base u hu)
    apply h_sub_unif.congr
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (M + 1)] with n hn D _
    have h_idx : (M + 1) + (n - (M + 1)) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hn
    have h_eq := congr_fun (h_tau_tail (M + 1) (n - (M + 1))) n
    rw [h_idx] at h_eq
    exact congr_arg (fun idx => ψ idx D) h_eq.symm
  have h_compact_in_KM : ∀ K : Set ℝ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 →
      ∃ M : ℕ, K ⊆ K_M M := by
    intro K hK_comp hK_ne hK_pos
    obtain ⟨x_min, hx_min_mem, hx_min_le⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMinOn hK_ne continuousOn_id
    obtain ⟨x_max, hx_max_mem, hx_max_ge⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne continuousOn_id
    have h_min_pos : 0 < x_min := hK_pos hx_min_mem
    have h2_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ M) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt one_lt_two
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (h2_top.eventually_ge_atTop (max x_max x_min⁻¹)).exists
    refine ⟨M, fun x hx => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h_inv_le : x_min⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM
      have h_half_eq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M = ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹ := by rw [one_div, inv_pow]
      rw [h_half_eq]
      have h_le_min : ((2 : ℝ) ^ M)⁻¹ ≤ x_min := by
        simpa using inv_anti₀ (inv_pos.mpr h_min_pos) h_inv_le
      exact le_trans h_le_min (hx_min_le hx)
    · exact le_trans (hx_max_ge hx) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM)
  let ψ_lim : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => ψ (σ n) D)
  have hψ_unif_KM : ∀ M : ℕ,
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n D => ψ (σ n) D) ψ_lim Filter.atTop (K_M M) := by
    intro M
    have h_eq : Set.EqOn (lim_fn M (τ_seq M)) ψ_lim (K_M M) := by
      intro D hD
      exact ((h_diag_unif M).tendsto_at hD).limUnder_eq.symm
    exact (h_diag_unif M).congr_right h_eq
  have hψ_tendsto_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ψ (σ n) D) Filter.atTop (nhds (ψ_lim D)) := by
    intro D hD
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_compact_in_KM {D} isCompact_singleton (Set.singleton_nonempty D)
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hD)
    exact (hψ_unif_KM M).tendsto_at (hM rfl)
  let m : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => if 0 < D then Real.exp (ψ_lim D) else 1
  have hm_pos_out : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D := by
    intro D hD
    simp [m, hD, Real.exp_pos]
  have hm_one_out : m 1 = 1 := by
    have h1 : ψ_lim 1 = 0 := by
      dsimp [ψ_lim]
      simp_rw [hψ_one]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds.limUnder_eq
    simp [m, zero_lt_one, h1]
  have hm_le_inv : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → m D ≤ D⁻¹ := by
    intro D hD
    have hR_sub : Filter.Tendsto (R_seq ∘ σ) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      hR_top.comp hσ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have hε_sub : Filter.Tendsto (ε_seq ∘ σ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      hε_zero.comp hσ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ψ (σ n) D ≤ -Real.log D + ε_seq (σ n) * |Real.log D| := by
      filter_upwards [hR_sub.eventually_ge_atTop D] with n hn
      exact hm_upper (σ n) D ⟨hD, hn⟩
    have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => -Real.log D + ε_seq (σ n) * |Real.log D|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (-Real.log D)) := by
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hε_sub.mul tendsto_const_nhds)
    have hψ_le : ψ_lim D ≤ -Real.log D :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (hψ_tendsto_pos D hD) h_rhs h_ev
    simp only [m, hD, ↓reduceIte]
    calc Real.exp (ψ_lim D)
        ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log D) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hψ_le
      _ = D⁻¹ := by rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hD]
  have hm_conv_out : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun D => Real.log (m D)) := by
    refine ⟨convex_Ioi 0, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hx hy
    have h_comb_pos : 0 < a * x + b * y := (convex_Ioi (0 : ℝ)) hx hy ha hb hab
    have hlog_eq : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → Real.log (m z) = ψ_lim z := by
      intro z hz
      simp [m, hz, Real.log_exp]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hlog_eq _ h_comb_pos, hlog_eq _ hx, hlog_eq _ hy]
    have hR_sub : Filter.Tendsto (R_seq ∘ σ) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      hR_top.comp hσ_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        ψ (σ n) (a * x + b * y) ≤ a * ψ (σ n) x + b * ψ (σ n) y := by
      filter_upwards [hR_sub.eventually_ge_atTop (max x y)] with n hn
      have hx_mem : x ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (R_seq (σ n)) := ⟨hx, le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn⟩
      have hy_mem : y ∈ Set.Ioc 0 (R_seq (σ n)) := ⟨hy, le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn⟩
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (hm_conv (σ n)).2 hx_mem hy_mem ha hb hab
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
      (hψ_tendsto_pos _ h_comb_pos)
      (((hψ_tendsto_pos x hx).const_mul a).add ((hψ_tendsto_pos y hy).const_mul b))
      h_ev
  have hm_loc_unif : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n D => m_seq (σ n) D) m
      Filter.atTop (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact isOpen_Ioi]
    intro K hK_sub hK_comp
    rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hK_ne
    · exact tendstoUniformlyOn_empty
    obtain ⟨M, hK_in_KM⟩ := h_compact_in_KM K hK_comp hK_ne hK_sub
    have hKM_in_K'M : K_M M ⊆ K'_M M := by
      intro D hD
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have : a_M M ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M := by
          dsimp [a_M]; rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [(by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ M)]
        exact le_trans this hD.1
      · have : (2 : ℝ) ^ M ≤ b_M M := by
          dsimp [b_M]; rw [pow_succ]; nlinarith [(by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ M)]
        exact le_trans hD.2 this
    have h_ev_box : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ D ∈ K_M M,
        ψ (σ n) D ∈ Set.Icc (-B_M M) (B_M M) := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (N_M M)] with n hn D hD
      exact abs_le.mp (h_bound_K' M (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ_mono.id_le n)) D (hKM_in_K'M hD))
    have h_lim_box : ∀ D ∈ K_M M, ψ_lim D ∈ Set.Icc (-B_M M) (B_M M) := by
      intro D hD
      have hD_pos : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hD.1
      exact isClosed_Icc.mem_of_tendsto (hψ_tendsto_pos D hD_pos)
        (h_ev_box.mono fun n hn => hn D hD)
    have h_exp_uc : UniformContinuousOn Real.exp (Set.Icc (-B_M M) (B_M M)) :=
      isCompact_Icc.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
    have h_exp_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n D => Real.exp (ψ (σ n) D))
        (fun D => Real.exp (ψ_lim D)) Filter.atTop (K_M M) :=
      h_exp_uc.comp_tendstoUniformlyOn_eventually h_ev_box h_lim_box (hψ_unif_KM M)
    have h_m_eq_on : Set.EqOn (fun D => Real.exp (ψ_lim D)) m (K_M M) := by
      intro D hD
      have hD_pos : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hD.1
      simp [m, hD_pos]
    have h_m_seq_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n D => m_seq (σ n) D) m Filter.atTop (K_M M) := by
      apply (h_exp_unif.congr_right h_m_eq_on).congr
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (N_M M)] with n hn D hD
      have hσ_ge : N_M M ≤ σ n := le_trans hn (hσ_mono.id_le n)
      obtain ⟨hR_b, _⟩ := hN_M M (σ n) hσ_ge
      have hD_pos : 0 < D := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hD.1
      have hD_le_R : D ≤ R_seq (σ n) := le_trans (hKM_in_K'M hD).2 hR_b
      exact Real.exp_log (hm_pos (σ n) D ⟨hD_pos, hD_le_R⟩)
    exact h_m_seq_unif.mono hK_in_KM
  exact ⟨σ, m, hσ_mono, hm_pos_out, hm_one_out, hm_le_inv, hm_conv_out, hm_loc_unif⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨p, ρ_c, hρ_cont, hρ_mono, hρ_ge, hp_pos, hp_exp, hp_int,
      hρc_cont, hρc_bounds, hρc_lo, hρc_lb, hρc_att, hρc_flat⟩ :=
    convex_log_moment_envelope_calculus m hm_pos hm_one hm_le hm_conv
  by_cases h_unbdd : ∀ x₀ M : ℝ, ∃ z : ℝ,
      x₀ ≤ z ∧ ρ_c z = -Real.log (m (Real.exp z)) ∧ M ≤ p z
  · exact Or.inl (unbounded_contact_steep_branch m p ρ_c
      hm_pos hp_pos hp_exp hp_int hρc_bounds hρc_lb hρc_att h_unbdd)
  · simp only [not_forall, not_exists, not_and, not_le] at h_unbdd
    rcases h_unbdd with ⟨x₀_raw, M_raw, h_raw⟩
    let x₀ : ℝ := max x₀_raw 0
    let K₁ : ℝ := max M_raw 1
    have hx₀ : 0 ≤ x₀ := le_max_right x₀_raw 0
    have hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁ := le_max_right M_raw 1
    have h_bdd : ∀ z : ℝ, x₀ ≤ z → ρ_c z = -Real.log (m (Real.exp z)) → p z ≤ K₁ := by
      intro z hz h_eq
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (h_raw z (le_trans (le_max_left x₀_raw 0) hz) h_eq)
        (le_max_left M_raw 1))
    obtain ⟨hρc_lip, r, hr_eq, hr_lo, hr_hi, hr_ge⟩ :=
      bounded_contact_envelope_lipschitz m p ρ_c x₀ K₁
        hK₁ hρ_cont hp_exp hp_int hρc_cont hρc_bounds hρc_lo hρc_flat h_bdd
    obtain ⟨m_seq, q_star, lam, hlam, _, hm_seq_ge, hm_seq_top,
        hq_cont, hq_zero, hq_lip, hq_top, hq_bot, hq_lim⟩ :=
      bilipschitz_shift_two_ended_slope r x₀ K₁ hx₀ hK₁ hr_lo hr_hi hr_ge
    exact Or.inr (contact_limit_transfer_to_bounded_branch
      m p ρ_c r m_seq q_star x₀ K₁ lam
      hx₀ hK₁ hlam hρ_mono hρ_ge hp_pos hp_exp hp_int
      hρc_bounds hρc_lo hρc_lip hρc_flat hr_eq
      hm_seq_ge hm_seq_top hq_cont hq_zero hq_lip hq_top hq_bot hq_lim)

subgoal_signatures.name: convex_log_moment_envelope_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hm_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D)
    (hm_one : m 1 = 1)
    (hm_le : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → m D ≤ D⁻¹)
    (hm_conv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun D => Real.log (m D))) :
    ∃ p ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ,
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      Monotone (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < p x) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u) ∧
      (∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
        IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧
        (∫ y in a..b, p y) = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp b))) - (-Real.log (m (Real.exp a)))) ∧
      Continuous ρ_c ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ_c x ∧ ρ_c x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c u) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, x ≤ y →
        ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ≤ (-Real.log (m (Real.exp y))) - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * y) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∃ w : ℝ, x ≤ w ∧
        ρ_c w = -Real.log (m (Real.exp w)) ∧
        ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo u v, ρ_c w < -Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) →
        ρ_c v - ρ_c u = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u))

subgoal_signatures.name: unbounded_contact_steep_branch
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(m p ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hm_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D)
    (hp_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < p x)
    (hp_exp : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u)

by
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  let δ_b : ℝ := (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀)
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_b := by positivity
  have hδ_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2 := by
    have hk₀_ge : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
    have hSH20_pos : 0 < S.H / 20 := by linarith [S.H_pos]
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      calc
        Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log hSH20_pos
    have hδ_def : δ_b = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀) := rfl
    linarith [S.H_pos]
  obtain ⟨C_tail', h_seq, ℓ_seq, m0_seq, hDiag⟩ :=
    steep_diagonal_moment_scale_transfer S k_seq ε_seq m
      h_basic hk_top hB_top hε_zero h_norm hm_pos hm_lim hSteep
  obtain ⟨x_seq, m_seq, hm_seq_pos, h_prod_top, h_orig, h_circ, h_balls_strip, h_cone⟩ :=
    strip_cauchy_penalty_center_selection S δ_b C_tail' h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq
      hδ_pos hδ_lt hDiag
  let φ_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun j Z =>
    (x_seq j : ℂ) + (h_seq j : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq j : ℂ) * Z
  let ℱ_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun j Z => ((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * S.f (φ_seq j Z)
  let 𝒬_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun j Z => (((m_seq j) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) * S.q (φ_seq j Z)
  let b_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ℓ_seq j * m_seq j
  have hOpen_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hdf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    S.f_holo.deriv hOpen_strip
  have hφ_hasDeriv : ∀ (j : ℕ) (W : ℂ), HasDerivAt (φ_seq j) (ℓ_seq j : ℂ) W := by
    intro j W
    simpa [φ_seq, mul_one] using
      ((hasDerivAt_id W).const_mul (ℓ_seq j : ℂ)).const_add
        ((x_seq j : ℂ) + (h_seq j : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have h_balls_ode : ∀ R : ℕ, 1 ≤ R → ∃ M_R : ℝ, 0 < M_R ∧ ∃ N_R : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N_R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝒬_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 1),
        ‖ℱ_seq j Z‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j Z‖ ≤ M_R) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq j)) Z = (b_seq j : ℂ) ^ 2 * 𝒬_seq j Z * ℱ_seq j Z) := by
    intro R hR
    obtain ⟨M_R, hM_R_pos, N_R, hN_R⟩ := h_balls_strip R hR
    refine ⟨M_R, hM_R_pos, N_R, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h_in_strip, h_norm_R⟩ := hN_R j hj
    have hℱ_hasDeriv : ∀ W ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2),
        HasDerivAt (ℱ_seq j)
          ((((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ)) * deriv S.f (φ_seq j W)) W := by
      intro W hW
      have hf_at : HasDerivAt S.f (deriv S.f (φ_seq j W)) (φ_seq j W) :=
        (S.f_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_strip.mem_nhds (h_in_strip W hW))).hasDerivAt
      have h_raw : HasDerivAt (ℱ_seq j)
          (((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (deriv S.f (φ_seq j W) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ))) W :=
        (hf_at.comp W (hφ_hasDeriv j W)).const_mul ((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ)
      convert h_raw using 1
      ring
    have hℱ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) :=
      fun W hW => (hℱ_hasDeriv W hW).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have h𝒬_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝒬_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) := by
      intro W hW
      have hq_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.q (φ_seq j W) :=
        S.q_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_strip.mem_nhds (h_in_strip W hW))
      exact ((hq_at.comp W (hφ_hasDeriv j W).differentiableAt).const_mul
        (((m_seq j) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ)).differentiableWithinAt
    refine ⟨hℱ_diff, h𝒬_diff, h_norm_R, ?_⟩
    intro Z hZ
    have h1_le_R2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (R : ℝ) + 2 := by
      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) R]
    have hZ_R : Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball h1_le_R2 hZ
    let g_j : ℂ → ℂ := fun W =>
      (((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ)) * deriv S.f (φ_seq j W)
    have h_ev : deriv (ℱ_seq j) =ᶠ[nhds Z] g_j := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ_R] with W hW
      exact (hℱ_hasDeriv W hW).deriv
    have hdf_at : HasDerivAt (deriv S.f) (deriv (deriv S.f) (φ_seq j Z)) (φ_seq j Z) :=
      (hdf_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_strip.mem_nhds (h_in_strip Z hZ_R))).hasDerivAt
    have hg_at : HasDerivAt g_j
        ((((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ)) *
          (deriv (deriv S.f) (φ_seq j Z) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ))) Z :=
      (hdf_at.comp Z (hφ_hasDeriv j Z)).const_mul (((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ))
    have hℱ2_at : HasDerivAt (deriv (ℱ_seq j))
        ((((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ)) *
          (deriv (deriv S.f) (φ_seq j Z) * (ℓ_seq j : ℂ))) Z :=
      (h_ev.hasDerivAt_iff).mpr hg_at
    rw [hℱ2_at.deriv, S.deriv2_f (φ_seq j Z) (h_in_strip Z hZ_R)]
    have hm_ne : (m_seq j : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hm_seq_pos j).ne'
    dsimp only [b_seq, 𝒬_seq, ℱ_seq]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hm_ne]
  obtain ⟨σ, c₀, hσ, hc₀_ne, hLimDisj⟩ :=
    entire_unit_circle_mean_exp_rigidity ℱ_seq 𝒬_seq b_seq h_prod_top h_orig h_circ h_balls_ode
  have h_sub_basic : ∀ n : ℕ, h_seq (σ n) < S.H ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq (σ n) ∧ 0 < m_seq (σ n) := by
    intro n
    rcases hDiag.row_basic (σ n) with ⟨_, hh_lt, _, hℓ_pos, _, _, _⟩
    exact ⟨hh_lt, hℓ_pos, hm_seq_pos (σ n)⟩
  have h_sub_cone : ∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      ℓ_seq (σ n) ≤ h_seq (σ n) - s.im →
      h_seq (σ n) - s.im ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - x_seq (σ n)| ≤ L * (h_seq (σ n) - s.im) →
      shapeModulus S s ≤
        C_L * m_seq (σ n) * (ℓ_seq (σ n) / (h_seq (σ n) - s.im)) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ) := by
    intro L hL
    obtain ⟨C_L, hC_L, N_L, hN_L⟩ := h_cone L hL
    exact ⟨C_L, hC_L, N_L, fun n hn s hs1 hs2 hs3 =>
      hN_L (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n)) s hs1 hs2 hs3⟩
  exact hCrit.exp_profile_obstruction
    (x_seq ∘ σ) (h_seq ∘ σ) (ℓ_seq ∘ σ) (m_seq ∘ σ) c₀ (9 / 16 : ℝ) δ_b
    hc₀_ne (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hδ_pos hδ_lt
    h_sub_basic
    (hDiag.h_tendsto.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop)
    (hDiag.ℓ_tendsto.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop)
    (h_prod_top.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop)
    (hDiag.ratio_tendsto.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop)
    hLimDisj
    h_sub_cone

structure SteepDiagonalRowData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (δ_b C_tail' : ℝ) (h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  C_tail_pos : 0 < C_tail'
  row_basic : ∀ j : ℕ,
    0 < h_seq j ∧
    h_seq j < S.H ∧
    S.H - h_seq j < δ_b ∧
    0 < ℓ_seq j ∧
    0 < m0_seq j ∧
    3 * ((j : ℝ) + 3) * ℓ_seq j < S.H - h_seq j ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j) = (m0_seq j) ^ 2
  h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H)
  ℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
  prod_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => ℓ_seq j * m0_seq j) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  ratio_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => (S.H - h_seq j) / ℓ_seq j) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  unit_band_bound : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1,
    |h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u| < S.H ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
      Real.exp (2 * u) + (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹
  local_band_bound : ∀ j : ℕ,
    ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)) (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)),
      |h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u| < S.H ∧
      steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * Real.exp (2 * |u|) + 1
  coarse_tail_bound : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → ℓ_seq j * v ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b →
    |h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v| < S.H ∧
    steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
      C_tail' * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ))

structure SecondScaleKernelTileToolkit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  poisson_props :
    ∀ (d_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      0 < d_a →
      Continuous w →
      Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
      Continuous (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) ∧
      Function.Periodic (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) = 1 ∧
      (∀ B h : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → |h| ≤ B * d_a →
        ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous G → Function.Periodic G (2 * Real.pi) →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (G (x + h)) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) ≤
            2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (G x) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x))
  tile_props :
    ∀ A k : ℝ, 0 ≤ A → criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      Continuous (tileSupModulus S A k) ∧
      Function.Periodic (tileSupModulus S A k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ tileSupModulus S A k x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ upperStripTile S A k x,
        Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S s ≤ tileSupModulus S A k x)
  q_sup_cont :
    ∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
      ∀ d c : ℝ, 0 < d → 0 ≤ c → (∀ Z ∈ K, d * (-Z.im) < S.H) →
        Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
          min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
            c * ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)))

by
