              (G.den p₁ w * deriv (fun t' => G.den p₂ (w.1, t')) w.2 +
                deriv (fun t' => G.den p₁ (w.1, t')) w.2 * G.den p₂ w) * h0 }
    have h_derivT_agrees : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G : MeroOn2D U) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g V → MeroAgreesHolo G g V →
        MeroAgreesHolo (meroDerivT G) (fun q => deriv (fun t' => g (q.1, t')) q.2) V := by
      intro U V G g hVo hg hagr
      refine ⟨hagr.1, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hagr.2 q hq
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have h_ev : (fun t' => G.num q (w.1, t')) =ᶠ[nhds w.2]
          fun t' => g (w.1, t') * G.den q (w.1, t') := by
        have h_pre : (fun t' : ℂ => (w.1, t')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball q r ∈ nhds w.2 :=
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
            (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)
        filter_upwards [h_pre] with t' ht'
        exact hr_eq (w.1, t') ht'
      have hg_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t' => g (w.1, t')) w.2 := by
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ (g ∘ fun t' => (w.1, t')) w.2
        exact (hg.differentiableAt (hVo.mem_nhds (hr_sub hw))).comp w.2
          ((differentiableAt_const _).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      have hQ_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t' => G.den q (w.1, t')) w.2 := by
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ (G.den q ∘ fun t' => (w.1, t')) w.2
        exact ((G.den_holo q (hagr.1 hq)).differentiableAt
          (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le hw))).comp w.2
          ((differentiableAt_const _).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      have hd_rhs := (hg_d.hasDerivAt.mul hQ_d.hasDerivAt).deriv
      change deriv (fun t' => g (w.1, t') * G.den q (w.1, t')) w.2 = _ at hd_rhs
      have hd := h_ev.deriv_eq.trans hd_rhs
      dsimp [meroDerivT]
      rw [hd, hr_eq w hw]
      ring
    let linMap2D : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun σ τ q => (q.1 + σ * q.2, τ * q.2)
    have h_linMap_lip : ∀ (σ τ : ℂ), ‖σ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖τ‖ ≤ 1 →
        ∀ w q : ℂ × ℂ, dist (linMap2D σ τ w) (linMap2D σ τ q) ≤ 2 * dist w q := by
      intro σ τ hσ hτ w q
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq]
      simp only [linMap2D, dist_eq_norm]
      have h1 : ‖w.1 + σ * w.2 - (q.1 + σ * q.2)‖ ≤
          2 * max ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖ := by
        have heq : w.1 + σ * w.2 - (q.1 + σ * q.2) = (w.1 - q.1) + σ * (w.2 - q.2) := by ring
        rw [heq]
        have ha : ‖(w.1 - q.1) + σ * (w.2 - q.2)‖ ≤ ‖w.1 - q.1‖ + ‖σ‖ * ‖w.2 - q.2‖ := by
          simpa [norm_mul] using norm_add_le (w.1 - q.1) (σ * (w.2 - q.2))
        have hb : ‖σ‖ * ‖w.2 - q.2‖ ≤ 1 * max ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖ :=
          mul_le_mul hσ (le_max_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        linarith [le_max_left ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖]
      have h2 : ‖τ * w.2 - τ * q.2‖ ≤ 2 * max ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖ := by
        have heq : τ * w.2 - τ * q.2 = τ * (w.2 - q.2) := by ring
        rw [heq, norm_mul]
        have hb : ‖τ‖ * ‖w.2 - q.2‖ ≤ 1 * max ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖ :=
          mul_le_mul hτ (le_max_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        have hc : 0 ≤ max ‖w.1 - q.1‖ ‖w.2 - q.2‖ :=
          le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
        linarith
      exact max_le h1 h2
    let meroPullback : ∀ {U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hU' : IsOpen U') (σ τ : ℂ)
        (hσ : ‖σ‖ ≤ 1) (hτ : τ = 1 ∨ τ = -1)
        (h_maps : ∀ q ∈ U', linMap2D σ τ q ∈ U) (G : MeroOn2D U), MeroOn2D U' :=
      fun {U U'} hU' σ τ hσ hτ h_maps G =>
        have hτ_norm : ‖τ‖ ≤ 1 := by rcases hτ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
        have h_inv_σ : ‖-σ * τ‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_neg]
          simpa using mul_le_mul hσ hτ_norm (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        have h_lin_diff : Differentiable ℂ (linMap2D σ τ) :=
          (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_snd.const_mul σ)).prodMk
            (differentiable_snd.const_mul τ)
        { rad := fun q =>
            if hq : q ∈ U' then
              min (Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq)) (G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2)
            else 1
          num := fun q w => G.num (linMap2D σ τ q) (linMap2D σ τ w)
          den := fun q w => G.den (linMap2D σ τ q) (linMap2D σ τ w)
          rad_pos := fun q hq => by
            rw [dif_pos hq]
            exact lt_min (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq)).1
              (half_pos (G.rad_pos _ (h_maps q hq)))
          ball_sub := fun q hq => by
            rw [dif_pos hq]
            exact (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans
              (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq)).2
          num_holo := fun q hq => by
            rw [dif_pos hq]
            refine (G.num_holo _ (h_maps q hq)).comp h_lin_diff.differentiableOn fun w hw => ?_
            rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
            have h1 := h_linMap_lip σ τ hσ hτ_norm w q
            have h2 : dist w q < G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2 :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hw (min_le_right _ _)
            linarith
          den_holo := fun q hq => by
            rw [dif_pos hq]
            refine (G.den_holo _ (h_maps q hq)).comp h_lin_diff.differentiableOn fun w hw => ?_
            rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
            have h1 := h_linMap_lip σ τ hσ hτ_norm w q
            have h2 : dist w q < G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2 :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hw (min_le_right _ _)
            linarith
          den_ne_zero := fun q hq => by
            rw [dif_pos hq]
            let rq := min (Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq))
              (G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2)
            have hrq_pos : 0 < rq :=
              lt_min (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq)).1
                (half_pos (G.rad_pos _ (h_maps q hq)))
            have hrq_le : rq ≤ G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2 :=
              min_le_right (Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' q hq))
                (G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) / 2)
            have hrad_pos_q : 0 < G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q) := G.rad_pos _ (h_maps q hq)
            have h_sub_b : Metric.ball (linMap2D σ τ q) (rq / 2) ⊆
                Metric.ball (linMap2D σ τ q) (G.rad (linMap2D σ τ q)) :=
              Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
            obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀_b, hu₀_ne⟩ := h_den_nz G (linMap2D σ τ q) (h_maps q hq)
              isOpen_ball ⟨linMap2D σ τ q, Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hrq_pos)⟩ h_sub_b
            let w₀ := linMap2D (-σ * τ) τ u₀
            have hτ2 : τ * τ = 1 := by rcases hτ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
            have h_inv_q : linMap2D (-σ * τ) τ (linMap2D σ τ q) = q := by
              ext
              · dsimp [linMap2D]; linear_combination -σ * q.2 * hτ2
              · dsimp [linMap2D]; linear_combination q.2 * hτ2
            have h_fwd_u : linMap2D σ τ w₀ = u₀ := by
              ext
              · dsimp [w₀, linMap2D]; ring
              · dsimp [w₀, linMap2D]; linear_combination u₀.2 * hτ2
            have hw₀_b : w₀ ∈ Metric.ball q rq := by
              rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← h_inv_q]
              have h1 := h_linMap_lip (-σ * τ) τ h_inv_σ hτ_norm u₀ (linMap2D σ τ q)
              have h2 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hu₀_b
              linarith
            exact ⟨w₀, hw₀_b, h_fwd_u.symm ▸ hu₀_ne⟩
          compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ w ⟨hw1, hw2⟩ => by
            rw [dif_pos hp₁] at hw1
            rw [dif_pos hp₂] at hw2
            refine G.compat _ (h_maps p₁ hp₁) _ (h_maps p₂ hp₂) (linMap2D σ τ w) ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
              have h1 := h_linMap_lip σ τ hσ hτ_norm w p₁
              have h2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw1) (min_le_right _ _)
              linarith
            · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
              have h1 := h_linMap_lip σ τ hσ hτ_norm w p₂
              have h2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw2) (min_le_right _ _)
              linarith }
    have h_pullback_agrees : ∀ {U U' V V' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hU' : IsOpen U') (hV' : IsOpen V')
        (σ τ : ℂ) (hσ : ‖σ‖ ≤ 1) (hτ : τ = 1 ∨ τ = -1)
        (h_maps : ∀ q ∈ U', linMap2D σ τ q ∈ U)
        (hV'_sub : V' ⊆ U') (hV'_maps : ∀ q ∈ V', linMap2D σ τ q ∈ V)
        (G : MeroOn2D U) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        MeroAgreesHolo G g V →
        MeroAgreesHolo (meroPullback hU' σ τ hσ hτ h_maps G) (fun q => g (linMap2D σ τ q)) V' := by
      intro U U' V V' hU' hV' σ τ hσ hτ h_maps hV'_sub hV'_maps G g hagr
      have hτ_norm : ‖τ‖ ≤ 1 := by rcases hτ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
      refine ⟨hV'_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := hagr.2 (linMap2D σ τ q) (hV'_maps q hq)
      obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV' q hq
      let rad_q := (meroPullback hU' σ τ hσ hτ h_maps G).rad q
      have hrad_pos := (meroPullback hU' σ τ hσ hτ h_maps G).rad_pos q (hV'_sub hq)
      let r := min rad_q (min r₂ (r₁ / 2))
      refine ⟨r, lt_min hrad_pos (lt_min hr₂_pos (half_pos hr₁_pos)), min_le_left _ _,
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))).trans hr₂_sub,
        fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have hw_r1 : linMap2D σ τ w ∈ Metric.ball (linMap2D σ τ q) r₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        have h1 := h_linMap_lip σ τ hσ hτ_norm w q
        have h2 : dist w q < r₁ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw)
          ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
        linarith
      exact hr₁_eq (linMap2D σ τ w) hw_r1
    have h_meroEqOn_of_seed : ∀ {U V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ G₂ : MeroOn2D U) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty →
        MeroAgreesHolo G₁ g V₀ → MeroAgreesHolo G₂ g V₀ →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U := by
      intro U V₀ G₁ G₂ g hUo hUp hV₀o hV₀n h1 h2
      refine ⟨fun _ h => ⟨h, h⟩, ?_⟩
      let E : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        {q ∈ U | ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball q (min (G₁.rad q) (G₂.rad q)),
          G₁.num q w * G₂.den q w = G₂.num q w * G₁.den q w}
      have h_step : ∀ p₁ ∈ E, ∀ p₂ ∈ U,
          (Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)) ∩
            Metric.ball p₂ (min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂))).Nonempty →
          p₂ ∈ E := by
        intro p₁ ⟨hp₁_U, hp₁_eq⟩ p₂ hp₂_U h_non
        refine ⟨hp₂_U, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        let B_ov := Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)) ∩
          Metric.ball p₂ (min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂))
        have hBov_open : IsOpen B_ov := isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball
        have hBov_sub1 : B_ov ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)) := Set.inter_subset_left
        have hBov_sub2 : B_ov ⊆ Metric.ball p₂ (min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂)) := Set.inter_subset_right
        have hd_prod_nz : ∃ x ∈ B_ov, G₁.den p₁ x * G₂.den p₁ x ≠ 0 := by
          obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := h_non
          obtain ⟨ρ_x, hρx_pos, hρx_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hBov_open x₀ hx₀
          obtain ⟨y_nz, hy_nz_b, hy_nz⟩ := h_prod_nz isOpen_ball (h_ball_preconn x₀ ρ_x)
            ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁_U).mono
              (hρx_sub.trans (hBov_sub1.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))))
            ((G₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁_U).mono
              (hρx_sub.trans (hBov_sub1.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))))
            (h_den_nz G₁ p₁ hp₁_U isOpen_ball ⟨x₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hρx_pos⟩
              (hρx_sub.trans (hBov_sub1.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))))
            (h_den_nz G₂ p₁ hp₁_U isOpen_ball ⟨x₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hρx_pos⟩
              (hρx_sub.trans (hBov_sub1.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))))
          exact ⟨y_nz, hρx_sub hy_nz_b, hy_nz⟩
        obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁_ov, hx₁_ne⟩ := hd_prod_nz
        have hd_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z => G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₁ z) x₁ :=
          (((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁_U).differentiableAt
            (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx₁_ov.1))).continuousAt).mul
            (((G₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁_U).differentiableAt
              (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx₁_ov.1))).continuousAt)
        obtain ⟨r_x, hrx_pos, hrx_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
          (Filter.inter_mem (hBov_open.mem_nhds hx₁_ov) (hd_cont.eventually_ne hx₁_ne))
        have h_van_rx : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₁ r_x,
            G₁.num p₂ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₂ z = 0 := by
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨hz_ov, hz_d_ne⟩ := hrx_sub hz
          have c1 := G₁.compat p₁ hp₁_U p₂ hp₂_U z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz_ov.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz_ov.2⟩
          have c2 := G₂.compat p₁ hp₁_U p₂ hp₂_U z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz_ov.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz_ov.2⟩
          have e1 := hp₁_eq z hz_ov.1
          have h_mul_z : (G₁.num p₂ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₂ z) *
              (G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₁ z) = 0 := by
            linear_combination -G₂.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z * c1 +
              G₁.den p₂ z * G₂.den p₂ z * e1 + G₁.den p₁ z * G₁.den p₂ z * c2
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_mul_z).resolve_right hz_d_ne
        have hf2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun z => G₁.num p₂ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₂ z)
            (Metric.ball p₂ (min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂))) :=
          (((G₁.num_holo p₂ hp₂_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((G₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
            (((G₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
              ((G₁.den_holo p₂ hp₂_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D isOpen_ball (h_ball_preconn p₂ _) isOpen_ball
          ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hrx_pos⟩
          (fun z hz => (hrx_sub hz).1.2) hf2_holo h_van_rx w hw)
      have hE_open : IsOpen E := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        intro p₁ hp₁
        let r₁ := min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)
        have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁.1)
        refine ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, fun p₂ hp₂ => ?_⟩
        have hp₂_U : p₂ ∈ U := G₁.ball_sub p₁ hp₁.1 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₂)
        have hr₂_pos : 0 < min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂) :=
          lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₂ hp₂_U) (G₂.rad_pos p₂ hp₂_U)
        exact h_step p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂_U ⟨p₂, hp₂, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₂_pos⟩
      have hEc_open : IsOpen (U \ E) := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        rintro p₂ ⟨hp₂_U, hp₂_nE⟩
        let r₂ := min (G₁.rad p₂) (G₂.rad p₂)
        have hr₂_pos : 0 < r₂ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₂ hp₂_U) (G₂.rad_pos p₂ hp₂_U)
        refine ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, fun p₁ hp₁ => ?_⟩
        have hp₁_U : p₁ ∈ U := G₁.ball_sub p₂ hp₂_U (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₁)
        refine ⟨hp₁_U, fun hp₁_E => hp₂_nE ?_⟩
        have hr₁_pos : 0 < min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁) :=
          lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_U) (G₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_U)
        exact h_step p₁ hp₁_E p₂ hp₂_U ⟨p₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos, hp₁⟩
      have hV₀_sub_E : V₀ ⊆ E := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := h1.2 q hq
        obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, _, hr₂_eq⟩ := h2.2 q hq
        have hq_U : q ∈ U := h1.1 hq
        refine ⟨hq_U, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hf_h : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun z => G₁.num q z * G₂.den q z - G₂.num q z * G₁.den q z)
            (Metric.ball q (min (G₁.rad q) (G₂.rad q))) :=
          (((G₁.num_holo q hq_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((G₂.den_holo q hq_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
            (((G₂.num_holo q hq_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
              ((G₁.den_holo q hq_U).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
        refine sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D isOpen_ball (h_ball_preconn q _) isOpen_ball
          ⟨q, Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos)⟩
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_min hr₁_le hr₂_le)) hf_h ?_ w hw)
        intro z hz
        rw [hr₁_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz),
          hr₂_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)]
        ring
      intro q hq w hw
      by_contra h_neq
      have hq_nE : q ∉ E := fun hqE => h_neq (hqE.2 w hw)
      obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hV₀n

    have hDZW_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_ZW_raw B₀ := hRD0_holo.mul hRD1_holo
    have hNZ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_Z_raw B₀ :=
      (hRN0_holo.mul hRD1_holo).add ((hRN1_holo.mul hRD0_holo).const_mul Complex.I)
    have hNW_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_W_raw B₀ :=
      (hRN0_holo.mul hRD1_holo).sub ((hRN1_holo.mul hRD0_holo).const_mul Complex.I)
    have hDZW_slice_nz : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → D_ZW_raw (z, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz_pos hz_lt
      have hpz_pos : 0 < ‖(p + z) - p‖ := by simpa using hz_pos
      have hpz_lt : ‖(p + z) - p‖ < R.δ := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ₀_R
      exact mul_ne_zero (R.D_slice_ne_zero 0 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt)
        (R.D_slice_ne_zero 1 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt)
    have h_slice_Z_raw : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ →
        N_Z_raw (z, 0) = Z_raw z * D_ZW_raw (z, 0) := by
      intro z hz_pos hz_lt
      have hpz_pos : 0 < ‖(p + z) - p‖ := by simpa using hz_pos
      have hpz_lt : ‖(p + z) - p‖ < R.δ := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ₀_R
      dsimp [N_Z_raw, Z_raw, D_ZW_raw]
      rw [R.slice_eq 0 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt, R.slice_eq 1 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt]
      ring
    have h_slice_W_raw : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ →
        N_W_raw (z, 0) = W_raw z * D_ZW_raw (z, 0) := by
      intro z hz_pos hz_lt
      have hpz_pos : 0 < ‖(p + z) - p‖ := by simpa using hz_pos
      have hpz_lt : ‖(p + z) - p‖ < R.δ := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ₀_R
      dsimp [N_W_raw, W_raw, D_ZW_raw]
      rw [R.slice_eq 0 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt, R.slice_eq 1 (p + z) hpz_pos hpz_lt]
      ring
    have h_even_Z_raw : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
        N_Z_raw (z, -t) * D_ZW_raw (z, t) = N_Z_raw (z, t) * D_ZW_raw (z, -t) := by
      intro z t hz ht
      have hzR : ‖(p + z) - p‖ < R.δ := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz hδ₀_R
      have htR : ‖t‖ < R.δ := lt_of_lt_of_le ht hδ₀_R
      have e0 := R.even_eq 0 (p + z) t hzR htR
      have e1 := R.even_eq 1 (p + z) t hzR htR
      dsimp [N_Z_raw, D_ZW_raw]
      linear_combination R.D 1 (p + z, -t) * R.D 1 (p + z, t) * e0 +
        Complex.I * R.D 0 (p + z, -t) * R.D 0 (p + z, t) * e1
    have h_even_W_raw : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
        N_W_raw (z, -t) * D_ZW_raw (z, t) = N_W_raw (z, t) * D_ZW_raw (z, -t) := by
      intro z t hz ht
      have hzR : ‖(p + z) - p‖ < R.δ := by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz hδ₀_R
      have htR : ‖t‖ < R.δ := lt_of_lt_of_le ht hδ₀_R
      have e0 := R.even_eq 0 (p + z) t hzR htR
      have e1 := R.even_eq 1 (p + z) t hzR htR
      dsimp [N_W_raw, D_ZW_raw]
      linear_combination R.D 1 (p + z, -t) * R.D 1 (p + z, t) * e0 -
        Complex.I * R.D 0 (p + z, -t) * R.D 0 (p + z, t) * e1
    let X_R : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i w => R.N i w / R.D i w
    have h_local_punc_ball : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < δ₀ →
        ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
          D_ZW_raw (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧
          D_ZW_raw (z - t, t) ≠ 0 ∧
          D_ZW_raw (z + t, t) ≠ 0 ∧
          N_Z_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t) = pairIsoZ X_R (p + z, t) ∧
          N_Z_raw (z - t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z - t, t) = pairIsoZ X_R (p + z - t, t) ∧
          N_Z_raw (z + t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z + t, t) = pairIsoZ X_R (p + z + t, t) ∧
          N_W_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t) = pairIsoW X_R (p + z, t) ∧
          N_W_raw (z - t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z - t, t) = pairIsoW X_R (p + z - t, t) ∧
          N_W_raw (z + t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z + t, t) = pairIsoW X_R (p + z + t, t) ∧
          deriv (fun z' => N_Z_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z *
            deriv (fun t' => N_W_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) t =
          deriv (fun t' => N_Z_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) t *
            deriv (fun z' => N_W_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z ∧
          (N_Z_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t) - N_Z_raw (z - t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z - t, t)) *
            (N_Z_raw (z + t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z + t, t) - N_Z_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t)) *
            (deriv (fun z' => N_W_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z) ^ 2 =
          (N_W_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t) - N_W_raw (z - t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z - t, t)) *
            (N_W_raw (z + t, t) / D_ZW_raw (z + t, t) - N_W_raw (z, t) / D_ZW_raw (z, t)) *
            (deriv (fun z' => N_Z_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z) ^ 2 := by
      intro z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt
      have hz₀_B₀ : (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B₀ :=
        ⟨by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right], Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀_pos⟩
      have hc_D : ContinuousAt D_ZW_raw (z₀, 0) :=
        (hDZW_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hz₀_B₀)).continuousAt
      obtain ⟨r_c, hrc_pos, hrc_nz⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
        (hc_D.eventually_ne (hDZW_slice_nz z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt))
      let r₁ := min r_c (δ₀ - ‖z₀‖)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hrc_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz₀_lt)
      have h_on_r1 : ∀ w t' : ℂ, ‖w - z₀‖ < r₁ → ‖t'‖ < r₁ →
          D_ZW_raw (w, t') ≠ 0 ∧
          (p + w, t') ∈ Metric.ball p R.δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.δ ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, R.D i (p + w, t') ≠ 0) ∧
          N_Z_raw (w, t') / D_ZW_raw (w, t') = pairIsoZ X_R (p + w, t') ∧
          N_W_raw (w, t') / D_ZW_raw (w, t') = pairIsoW X_R (p + w, t') := by
        intro w t' hw ht'
        have h_rc : (w, t') ∈ Metric.ball (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) r_c := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
          have h_r1_rc : r₁ ≤ r_c := min_le_left r_c (δ₀ - ‖z₀‖)
          have hw' : dist w z₀ < r₁ := by rwa [dist_eq_norm]
          have ht'' : dist t' 0 < r₁ := by rwa [dist_zero_right]
          exact max_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hw' h_r1_rc) (lt_of_lt_of_le ht'' h_r1_rc)
        have hD_ne : D_ZW_raw (w, t') ≠ 0 := hrc_nz h_rc
        have hD0_ne : R.D 0 (p + w, t') ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hD_ne
        have hD1_ne : R.D 1 (p + w, t') ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hD_ne
        have h_r1_sub : r₁ ≤ δ₀ - ‖z₀‖ := min_le_right r_c (δ₀ - ‖z₀‖)
        have hw_norm : ‖w‖ < δ₀ := by
          have h_tri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le (w - z₀) z₀
          linarith
        have ht'_norm : ‖t'‖ < δ₀ := by
          linarith [norm_nonneg z₀]
        have h_mem_R : (p + w, t') ∈ Metric.ball p R.δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.δ :=
          h_sh2_maps (w, t') ⟨by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right],
            by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]⟩
        have hDi : ∀ i : Fin 2, R.D i (p + w, t') ≠ 0 := fun i => by
          fin_cases i <;> [exact hD0_ne; exact hD1_ne]
        have hqZ : N_Z_raw (w, t') / D_ZW_raw (w, t') = pairIsoZ X_R (p + w, t') := by
          dsimp [N_Z_raw, D_ZW_raw, pairIsoZ, X_R]
          field_simp [hD0_ne, hD1_ne]
        have hqW : N_W_raw (w, t') / D_ZW_raw (w, t') = pairIsoW X_R (p + w, t') := by
          dsimp [N_W_raw, D_ZW_raw, pairIsoW, X_R]
          field_simp [hD0_ne, hD1_ne]
        exact ⟨hD_ne, h_mem_R, hDi, hqZ, hqW⟩
      refine ⟨r₁ / 2, half_pos hr₁_pos, fun z t hz ht => ?_⟩
      have hz_r1 : ‖z - z₀‖ < r₁ := by linarith
      have ht_r1 : ‖t‖ < r₁ := by linarith
      have hzm_r1 : ‖(z - t) - z₀‖ < r₁ := by
        have : ‖(z - t) - z₀‖ ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ + ‖t‖ := by
          have h := norm_add_le (z - z₀) (-t)
          simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_right_comm] using h
        linarith
      have hzp_r1 : ‖(z + t) - z₀‖ < r₁ := by
        have : ‖(z + t) - z₀‖ ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ + ‖t‖ := by
          have h := norm_add_le (z - z₀) t
          simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_right_comm] using h
        linarith
      obtain ⟨hD0, hmem0, hDi0, hqZ0, hqW0⟩ := h_on_r1 z t hz_r1 ht_r1
      obtain ⟨hDm, hmemm, hDim, hqZm, hqWm⟩ := h_on_r1 (z - t) t hzm_r1 ht_r1
      obtain ⟨hDp, hmemp, hDip, hqZp, hqWp⟩ := h_on_r1 (z + t) t hzp_r1 ht_r1
      have h_add_m : p + (z - t) = p + z - t := by ring
      have h_add_p : p + (z + t) = p + z + t := by ring
      rw [h_add_m] at hmemm hDim hqZm hqWm
      rw [h_add_p] at hmemp hDip hqZp hqWp
      have hdZz : deriv (fun z' => N_Z_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z =
          deriv (fun y' => pairIsoZ X_R (y', t)) (p + z) := by
        have hev : (fun z' => N_Z_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            fun z' => pairIsoZ X_R (p + z', t) := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] :
            z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₁)] with z' hz'
          exact (h_on_r1 z' t (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz') ht_r1).2.2.2.1
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_comp_const_add (fun y' => pairIsoZ X_R (y', t)) p z]
      have hdWz : deriv (fun z' => N_W_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) z =
          deriv (fun y' => pairIsoW X_R (y', t)) (p + z) := by
        have hev : (fun z' => N_W_raw (z', t) / D_ZW_raw (z', t)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            fun z' => pairIsoW X_R (p + z', t) := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] :
            z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₁)] with z' hz'
          exact (h_on_r1 z' t (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hz') ht_r1).2.2.2.2
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_comp_const_add (fun y' => pairIsoW X_R (y', t)) p z]
      have hdZt : deriv (fun t' => N_Z_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) t =
          deriv (fun t' => pairIsoZ X_R (p + z, t')) t := by
        have hev : (fun t' => N_Z_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) =ᶠ[nhds t]
            fun t' => pairIsoZ X_R (p + z, t') := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] :
            t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁)] with t' ht'
          exact (h_on_r1 z t' hz_r1 (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht')).2.2.2.1
        exact hev.deriv_eq
      have hdWt : deriv (fun t' => N_W_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) t =
          deriv (fun t' => pairIsoW X_R (p + z, t')) t := by
        have hev : (fun t' => N_W_raw (z, t') / D_ZW_raw (z, t')) =ᶠ[nhds t]
            fun t' => pairIsoW X_R (p + z, t') := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] :
            t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁)] with t' ht'
          exact (h_on_r1 z t' hz_r1 (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht')).2.2.2.2
        exact hev.deriv_eq
      have h_rk := R.rank_one_on_reg (p + z, t) hmem0 hDi0
      have h_rf := R.iso_reflect_on_reg (p + z, t) hmem0 hmemm hmemp
        (fun i => ⟨hDi0 i, hDim i, hDip i⟩)
      dsimp [SatisfiesRankOneAt] at h_rk
      dsimp [SatisfiesIsoReflectAt] at h_rf
      refine ⟨hD0, hDm, hDp, hqZ0, hqZm, hqZp, hqW0, hqWm, hqWp, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rwa [hdZz, hdWt, hdZt, hdWz]
      · rwa [hqZ0, hqZm, hqZp, hqW0, hqWm, hqWp, hdWz, hdZz]
    have h_unflip_Γ : ∀ z : ℂ, Z_raw (-z) = Z_raw z → W_raw (-z) = W_raw z →
        ∀ i : Fin 2, M.Γ_slice (p - z) i = M.Γ_slice (p + z) i := by
      intro z hZ hW i
      have hp_sub : p + -z = p - z := (sub_eq_add_neg p z).symm
      dsimp [Z_raw, W_raw] at hZ hW
      rw [hp_sub] at hZ hW
      fin_cases i
      · change M.Γ_slice (p - z) 0 = M.Γ_slice (p + z) 0
        linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hZ + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hW
      · change M.Γ_slice (p - z) 1 = M.Γ_slice (p + z) 1
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
        linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hZ - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * hW
    have hd_neg_fn : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ), deriv (fun x => -g x) w = -deriv g w :=
      fun _ _ => deriv.neg
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hn_neg | hn_pos
    · have hn_abs : (n.natAbs : ℤ) = -n := Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hn_neg)
      have hn_eq : n = -(n.natAbs : ℤ) := by omega
      let G_neg : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n.natAbs :=
        { c := C.c
          δ₀ := δ₀
          c_pos := C.c_pos
          δ₀_pos := hδ₀_pos
          Z_loc := fun z => -W_raw z
          W_loc := fun z => -Z_raw z
          a_loc := fun z => (a_raw z)⁻¹
          f_loc := fun z => -f_raw z
          u_a := fun z => (u_raw z)⁻¹
          N_Z := fun q => -N_W_raw q
          N_W := fun q => -N_Z_raw q
          D_ZW := D_ZW_raw
          Z_mero := hWraw_mero.neg
          W_mero := hZraw_mero.neg
          u_a_analytic := huraw_ana0.inv huraw_ne0
          u_a_ne_zero := inv_ne_zero huraw_ne0
          a_eq := fun z hz_pos hz_lt => by
            have h_pow : z ^ n = (z ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ := by
              nth_rw 1 [hn_eq]
              rw [_root_.zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
            rw [haraw_eq z hz_pos hz_lt, h_pow, mul_inv, inv_inv]
          reg_on_punctured := fun z hz_pos hz_lt => by
            obtain ⟨hZa, hWa, haa, hfa, ha_ne, hf_ne, hdZ, hdW, hda⟩ :=
              h_punc_reg_raw z hz_pos hz_lt
            have hd_Zloc : deriv (fun w => -W_raw w) z =
                Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (a_raw z)⁻¹ / (-f_raw z) ^ 2 := by
              rw [hd_neg_fn, hdW]
              field_simp [ha_ne, hf_ne]
            have hd_Wloc : deriv (fun w => -Z_raw w) z =
                -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) / ((a_raw z)⁻¹ * (-f_raw z) ^ 2) := by
              rw [hd_neg_fn, hdZ]
              field_simp [ha_ne, hf_ne]
            have hd_aloc : deriv (fun w => (a_raw w)⁻¹) z =
                Complex.I * (-f_raw z) * (a_raw z)⁻¹ := by
              have hd_inv := (haa.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.inv ha_ne).deriv
              change deriv (fun w => (a_raw w)⁻¹) z = _ at hd_inv
              rw [hd_inv, hda]
              field_simp [ha_ne]
            exact ⟨hWa.neg, hZa.neg, haa.inv ha_ne, hfa.neg,
              inv_ne_zero ha_ne, neg_ne_zero.mpr hf_ne, hd_Zloc, hd_Wloc, hd_aloc⟩
          N_Z_holo := hNW_holo.neg
          N_W_holo := hNZ_holo.neg
          D_ZW_holo := hDZW_holo
          D_ZW_slice_ne_zero := hDZW_slice_nz
          slice_Z_eq := fun z hz_pos hz_lt => by
            rw [h_slice_W_raw z hz_pos hz_lt]; ring
          slice_W_eq := fun z hz_pos hz_lt => by
            rw [h_slice_Z_raw z hz_pos hz_lt]; ring
          even_Z := fun z t hz ht => by
            linear_combination -(h_even_W_raw z t hz ht)
          even_W := fun z t hz ht => by
            linear_combination -(h_even_Z_raw z t hz ht)
          rank_one_punc := fun z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt => by
            obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_spec⟩ := h_local_punc_ball z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt
            refine ⟨r, hr_pos, fun z t hz ht => ?_⟩
            obtain ⟨hD0, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hrk, -⟩ := hr_spec z t hz ht
            refine ⟨hD0, ?_⟩
            simp only [neg_div, hd_neg_fn]
            linear_combination -hrk
          iso_reflect_punc := fun z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt => by
            obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_spec⟩ := h_local_punc_ball z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt
            refine ⟨r, hr_pos, fun z t hz ht => ?_⟩
            obtain ⟨hD0, hDm, hDp, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hrf⟩ := hr_spec z t hz ht
            refine ⟨hD0, hDm, hDp, ?_⟩
            simp only [neg_div, hd_neg_fn]
            linear_combination -hrf }
      refine ⟨G_neg, fun ε hε_pos _ h_symm => ⟨ε, hε_pos, fun z hz_pos hz_lt => ?_⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨hZ_ev, hW_ev, ha_odd⟩ := h_symm z hz_pos hz_lt
      dsimp [G_neg] at hZ_ev hW_ev ha_odd
      have hW_raw_ev : W_raw (-z) = W_raw z := neg_inj.mp hZ_ev
      have hZ_raw_ev : Z_raw (-z) = Z_raw z := neg_inj.mp hW_ev
      have ha_raw_odd : M.a_mero (p - z) = -M.a_mero (p + z) := by
        have h_inv : (a_raw (-z))⁻¹ = (-a_raw z)⁻¹ := by rwa [inv_neg]
        have h_eq := inv_inj.mp h_inv
        simpa [a_raw, sub_eq_add_neg] using h_eq
      exact ⟨h_unflip_Γ z hZ_raw_ev hW_raw_ev, ha_raw_odd⟩
    · have hn_abs : (n.natAbs : ℤ) = n := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hn_pos)
      let G_pos : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n.natAbs :=
        { c := C.c
          δ₀ := δ₀
          c_pos := C.c_pos
          δ₀_pos := hδ₀_pos
          Z_loc := Z_raw
          W_loc := W_raw
          a_loc := a_raw
          f_loc := f_raw
          u_a := u_raw
          N_Z := N_Z_raw
          N_W := N_W_raw

collar_isotropic_germ_and_symmetries.definitions:
noncomputable def pairIsoZ (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  X 0 q + Complex.I * X 1 q

noncomputable def pairIsoW (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  X 0 q - Complex.I * X 1 q

def SatisfiesRankOneAt (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  deriv (fun y' => pairIsoZ X (y', q.2)) q.1 *
    deriv (fun t' => pairIsoW X (q.1, t')) q.2 =
  deriv (fun t' => pairIsoZ X (q.1, t')) q.2 *
    deriv (fun y' => pairIsoW X (y', q.2)) q.1

def SatisfiesIsoReflectAt (X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  (pairIsoZ X q - pairIsoZ X (q.1 - q.2, q.2)) *
    (pairIsoZ X (q.1 + q.2, q.2) - pairIsoZ X q) *
    (deriv (fun y' => pairIsoW X (y', q.2)) q.1) ^ 2 =
  (pairIsoW X q - pairIsoW X (q.1 - q.2, q.2)) *
    (pairIsoW X (q.1 + q.2, q.2) - pairIsoW X q) *
    (deriv (fun y' => pairIsoZ X (y', q.2)) q.1) ^ 2

def meroTubeShift (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ W ∧ (q.1 - q.2, q.2) ∈ W ∧ (q.1 + q.2, q.2) ∈ W }

def collarBaseBox {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base }

def collarHalfBaseBox {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base / 2 ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base / 2 }

structure SliceSymmetryWallData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Prop where
  real_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
    (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
    (x : ℂ) ∉ M.E_disc ∧
    M.a_mero x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ x)
  a_periodic_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (s + 2 * Real.pi) = M.a_mero s
  a_conj_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (starRingEnd ℂ s) * starRingEnd ℂ (M.a_mero s) = 1
  order_ne_top : ∀ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤
  center_im_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ u p → u p ≠ 0 →
      (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z) →
      p.im ≠ 0
  wall_top_and_global_odd : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    p.im ≠ 0 →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ε →
        (∀ i : Fin 2, M.Γ_slice (p - z) i = M.Γ_slice (p + z) i) ∧
        M.a_mero (p - z) = -M.a_mero (p + z)) →
      M.h_X 0 = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → 2 * p - s ∉ M.E_disc → M.a_mero (2 * p - s) = -M.a_mero s

  δ : ℝ

  N : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  D : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ

  even_eq : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - p‖ < δ → ‖t‖ < δ →

    (∀ i : Fin 2, D i q ≠ 0) →

isotropic_center_rational_profile.definitions:
noncomputable def normDiffQuot (F : ℂ → ℂ) (s h : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope F s (s + h) / deriv F s

noncomputable def diffQuotCoeff (F : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv (k + 1) F s / (((k + 1).factorial : ℂ) * deriv F s)

noncomputable def reflDiffCoeff {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (k₁ k₂ : ℕ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (-1 : ℂ) ^ k₁ *
    (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc k₁ s * diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc k₂ s -
     diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc k₁ s * diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc k₂ s)

structure ZeroSliceCenterData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n) where
  ne_three : n ≠ 3
  Z₀ : ℂ
  W₀ : ℂ
  u_Z : ℂ → ℂ
  u_W : ℂ → ℂ
  f_tilde : ℂ → ℂ
  δ₁ : ℝ
  δ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁
  δ₁_le : δ₁ ≤ G.δ₀
  u_Z_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ u_Z z ∧ u_Z z ≠ 0
  u_W_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ u_W z ∧ u_W z ≠ 0
  f_tilde_ball : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ f_tilde z ∧ f_tilde z ≠ 0
  f_tilde_zero : f_tilde 0 = -Complex.I * (n : ℂ)
  f_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.f_loc z = z⁻¹ * f_tilde z
  Z_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.Z_loc z - Z₀ = z ^ (n + 3) * u_Z z
  W_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    G.W_loc z - W₀ = z ^ ((3 : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) * u_W z
  deriv_Z_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → deriv G.Z_loc z ≠ 0
  deriv_W_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → deriv G.W_loc z ≠ 0
  refl_coeff_analytic : ∀ k₁ k₂ : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂) z
  refl_coeff_mero_order : ∀ k₁ k₂ m : ℕ,
    MeromorphicAt (iteratedDeriv m (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂)) 0 ∧
    ((-(k₁ : ℤ) - (k₂ : ℤ) - (m : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
      meromorphicOrderAt (iteratedDeriv m (reflDiffCoeff G k₁ k₂)) 0
  refl_deg0 : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → reflDiffCoeff G 0 0 z = 0
  refl_deg1 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 1 0 z * h_minus + reflDiffCoeff G 0 1 z * h_plus =
      Complex.I * G.f_loc z * (h_plus - h_minus)
  refl_deg2 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 2 0 z * h_minus ^ 2 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 1 1 z * h_minus * h_plus +
      reflDiffCoeff G 0 2 z * h_plus ^ 2 =
      -Complex.I * deriv G.f_loc z * (h_plus - h_minus) ^ 2
  refl_deg3 : ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    reflDiffCoeff G 3 0 z * h_minus ^ 3 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 2 1 z * h_minus ^ 2 * h_plus +
      reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus ^ 2 +
      reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * h_plus ^ 3 =
      (h_plus - h_minus) *
        (reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * (h_plus ^ 2 + h_plus * h_minus + h_minus ^ 2) +
          reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus)

structure PuncturedLiftData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (S : ZeroSliceCenterData G) where
  v_jet : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  v_jet_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, v_jet 0 z = 0
  v_jet_analytic : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < S.δ₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ (v_jet j) z
  v_jet_mero : ∀ j : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (v_jet j) 0
  local_lift : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < S.δ₁ →
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < S.δ₁) ∧
      2 * r < G.δ₀ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) ∧
      (∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ‖t‖ < 2 * r →
        0 < ‖v (z, t)‖ ∧ ‖v (z, t)‖ < S.δ₁ ∧
        G.D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧
        v (z, -t) = v (z, t) ∧
        G.N_Z (z, t) / G.D_ZW (z, t) = G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) ∧
        G.N_W (z, t) / G.D_ZW (z, t) = G.W_loc (v (z, t))) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ k : ℕ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
          if Even k then v_jet (k / 2) z else 0) ∧
      (∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
        normDiffQuot G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) (-(v (z, t) - v (z - t, t))) *
          normDiffQuot G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) (v (z + t, t) - v (z, t)) -
        normDiffQuot G.W_loc (v (z, t)) (-(v (z, t) - v (z - t, t))) *
          normDiffQuot G.W_loc (v (z, t)) (v (z + t, t) - v (z, t)) = 0)

structure PoleBoundedLiftData {n : ℕ} {G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n}
    (S : ZeroSliceCenterData G) (L : PuncturedLiftData G S) where
  w_jet : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  w_jet_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, w_jet 0 z = 0
  w_jet_analytic : ∀ j : ℕ, AnalyticAt ℂ (w_jet j) 0
  v_jet_eq : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j →
    ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      L.v_jet j z = z ^ ((1 : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) * w_jet j z

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_part1 :
      (n = 1 → ∃ (b₀ : ℂ) (R_sq : ℝ), P.R₀ < R_sq ∧
        ∀ w : ℂ, R_sq < ‖w‖ → (P.ξ w) ^ 2 = (w + b₀) * (w + b₀ + 1)) ∧
      ∃ (P_ρ Q_ρ : Polynomial ℂ) (s : ℕ),
        1 ≤ s ∧ P_ρ.Monic ∧ Q_ρ.Monic ∧ P_ρ.natDegree = s ∧ Q_ρ.natDegree = s ∧
        IsCoprime P_ρ Q_ρ ∧ P_ρ - Q_ρ ≠ 0 ∧ (P_ρ - Q_ρ).natDegree = s - 1 ∧
        (n = 2 →
          (P_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ 5 - Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ 5) *
              (P_ρ ^ 5 - Q_ρ ^ 5) =
            25 * (P_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) - Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1)) *
              (P_ρ - Q_ρ) * P_ρ ^ 4 * Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ 4) ∧
        (4 ≤ n →
          let d₀ := Nat.gcd (n + 3) (n - 3)
          let α := (n + 3) / d₀
          let γ := (n - 3) / d₀
          1 ≤ γ ∧ γ < α ∧ Nat.Coprime α γ ∧
          Polynomial.C ((γ : ℂ) ^ 2) *
            (P_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ γ *
              (P_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ α - Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ α) *
              Q_ρ ^ γ * (P_ρ ^ α - Q_ρ ^ α)) =
          Polynomial.C ((α : ℂ) ^ 2) *
            (Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ α *
              (P_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ γ - Q_ρ.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) ^ γ) *
              P_ρ ^ α * (P_ρ ^ γ - Q_ρ ^ γ))) := by
    have h_poly_zero_nat : ∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (k₀ : ℕ),
        (∀ m : ℕ, F.eval ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ) = 0) → F = 0 := by
      intro F k₀ h_eval
      by_contra hF_ne
      let emb : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ)
      have hemb_inj : Function.Injective emb := by
        intro i j hij
        exact Nat.add_left_cancel (Nat.cast_injective hij)
      have h_sub : (Finset.range (F.natDegree + 1)).image emb ⊆ F.roots.toFinset := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨m, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hF_ne, Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
        exact h_eval m
      have hc1 : F.natDegree + 1 ≤ F.roots.toFinset.card := by
        calc F.natDegree + 1
          = ((Finset.range (F.natDegree + 1)).image emb).card := by
              rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hemb_inj, Finset.card_range]
          _ ≤ F.roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card h_sub
      have hc2 : F.roots.toFinset.card ≤ F.natDegree :=
        le_trans (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _) (Polynomial.card_roots' F)
      omega
    have h_poly_zero : ∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (R : ℝ),
        (∀ w : ℂ, R < ‖w‖ → F.eval w = 0) → F = 0 := by
      intro F R h_eval
      apply h_poly_zero_nat F (Nat.ceil (max R 0) + 1)
      intro m
      apply h_eval
      rw [Complex.norm_natCast]
      have h1 : R ≤ max R 0 := le_max_left _ _
      have h2 : max R 0 ≤ (Nat.ceil (max R 0) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_root_bound : ∀ (B : Polynomial ℂ), B ≠ 0 →
        ∃ R_B : ℝ, 0 < R_B ∧ ∀ w : ℂ, R_B < ‖w‖ → B.eval w ≠ 0 := by
      intro B hB_ne
      let R_B : ℝ := 1 + ∑ z ∈ B.roots.toFinset, ‖z‖
      have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ z ∈ B.roots.toFinset, ‖z‖ :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
      refine ⟨R_B, by dsimp [R_B]; linarith, ?_⟩
      intro w hw h0
      have hw_mem : w ∈ B.roots.toFinset :=
        Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr ((Polynomial.mem_roots hB_ne).mpr h0)
      have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ ∑ z ∈ B.roots.toFinset, ‖z‖ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖) (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) hw_mem
      dsimp [R_B] at hw
      linarith
    have h_shift_ratio : ∀ (A B : Polynomial ℂ), B ≠ 0 →
        A.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) * B = A * B.comp (Polynomial.X + 1) →
        ∃ c₀ : ℂ, A = Polynomial.C c₀ * B := by
      intro A B hB_ne h_eq
      obtain ⟨R_B, _, hRB⟩ := h_root_bound B hB_ne
      let k₀ : ℕ := Nat.ceil R_B + 1
      have hB_k : ∀ m : ℕ, B.eval ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro m
        apply hRB
        rw [Complex.norm_natCast]
        have := Nat.le_ceil R_B
        push_cast [k₀]
        linarith
      let c₀ : ℂ := A.eval (k₀ : ℂ) / B.eval (k₀ : ℂ)
      have h_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, A.eval ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ) = c₀ * B.eval ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
          simp only [Nat.add_zero]
          exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by simpa using hB_k 0)).symm
        | succ m ih =>
          have h_ev := congrArg (Polynomial.eval ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ)) h_eq
          simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_add,
            Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one] at h_ev
          have h_step : (((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1) = ((k₀ + (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) := by

          rw [h_step, ih] at h_ev
          apply mul_right_cancel₀ (hB_k m)
          linear_combination h_ev
      refine ⟨c₀, sub_eq_zero.mp ?_⟩
      apply h_poly_zero_nat (A - Polynomial.C c₀ * B) k₀
      intro m
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, h_ind m, sub_self]
    let D_pos : ℤ := (n : ℤ) + 3
    let D_neg : ℤ := 3 - (n : ℤ)
    have hD_pos_ne : D_pos ≠ 0 := by dsimp [D_pos]; omega
    let Q_mv_pos : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ := MvPolynomial.X 0 - MvPolynomial.C P.Z₀
    let Q_mv_neg : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ := MvPolynomial.X 1 - MvPolynomial.C P.W₀
    have hZ_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
        MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q_mv_pos = z ^ D_pos * P.u_Z z := by
      rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff]
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) P.δ₁_pos] with z hz hz_ne
      simp only [Q_mv_pos, map_sub, MvPolynomial.eval_X, MvPolynomial.eval_C, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [P.Z_expansion z (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne) (by simpa using hz)]
      have h_exp : D_pos = ((n + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [h_exp, zpow_natCast]
    have hW_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
        MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q_mv_neg = z ^ D_neg * P.u_W z := by
      rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff]
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) P.δ₁_pos] with z hz hz_ne
      simp only [Q_mv_neg, map_sub, MvPolynomial.eval_X, MvPolynomial.eval_C, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      exact P.W_expansion z (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne) (by simpa using hz)
    obtain ⟨P_pos, Q_pos, R_pos, hQ_pos_ne, hR_pos, h_rat_pos⟩ :=
      P.poly_power_rational Q_mv_pos D_pos P.u_Z P.u_Z_analytic P.u_Z_ne_zero hZ_ev
    obtain ⟨P_neg, Q_neg, R_neg, hQ_neg_ne, hR_neg, h_rat_neg⟩ :=
      P.poly_power_rational Q_mv_neg D_neg P.u_W P.u_W_analytic P.u_W_ne_zero hW_ev
    have hP_pos_ne : P_pos ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      let w₁ : ℂ := ((R_pos + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hw₁ : R_pos < ‖w₁‖ := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith [P.R₀_pos])]
        linarith
      have hξ_ne := (P.ξ_def w₁ (lt_trans hR_pos hw₁)).2
      have h1 := h_rat_pos w₁ hw₁
      rw [h0, Polynomial.eval_zero] at h1
      exact mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero D_pos hξ_ne) h1.1 h1.2
    have hP_neg_ne : P_neg ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      let w₁ : ℂ := ((R_neg + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hw₁ : R_neg < ‖w₁‖ := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith [P.R₀_pos])]
        linarith
      have hξ_ne := (P.ξ_def w₁ (lt_trans hR_neg hw₁)).2
      have h1 := h_rat_neg w₁ hw₁
      rw [h0, Polynomial.eval_zero] at h1
      exact mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero D_neg hξ_ne) h1.1 h1.2
    let d₀ : ℕ := Int.gcd D_pos D_neg
    have hd₀_pos : 1 ≤ d₀ := by
      have hd₀_ne : d₀ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hdvd : (d₀ : ℤ) ∣ D_pos := Int.gcd_dvd_left D_pos D_neg
        rw [h0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_dvd_iff] at hdvd
        exact hD_pos_ne hdvd
      omega
    let u_bez : ℤ := Int.gcdA D_pos D_neg
    let v_bez : ℤ := Int.gcdB D_pos D_neg
    have h_bez : (d₀ : ℤ) = D_pos * u_bez + D_neg * v_bez := Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab D_pos D_neg
    let numZ : Polynomial ℂ → Polynomial ℂ → ℤ → Polynomial ℂ :=
      fun A B k => if 0 ≤ k then A ^ k.natAbs else B ^ k.natAbs
    let denZ : Polynomial ℂ → Polynomial ℂ → ℤ → Polynomial ℂ :=
      fun A B k => if 0 ≤ k then B ^ k.natAbs else A ^ k.natAbs
    have h_zpow_frac : ∀ (A B : Polynomial ℂ) (k : ℤ), A ≠ 0 → B ≠ 0 →

          x ^ k * (denZ A B k).eval w = (numZ A B k).eval w := by

      · dsimp [numZ]; split_ifs <;> exact pow_ne_zero _ (by assumption)
      · dsimp [denZ]; split_ifs <;> exact pow_ne_zero _ (by assumption)

        split_ifs with hk
        · have hk_eq : k = (k.natAbs : ℤ) := Int.eq_natAbs_of_nonneg hk

            conv_lhs => rw [hk_eq]
            exact zpow_natCast x k.natAbs
          rw [h_xk, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_pow, ← mul_pow, h_eq]

          have h_xk : x ^ k = (x ^ k.natAbs)⁻¹ := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hk_eq]
            rw [_root_.zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
          rw [h_xk, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_pow]
          have hx_pow_ne : x ^ k.natAbs ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hx
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ hx_pow_ne

            _ = (A.eval w) ^ k.natAbs := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx_pow_ne, one_mul]

            _ = x ^ k.natAbs * (B.eval w) ^ k.natAbs := mul_pow _ _ _
    obtain ⟨h_num1_ne, h_den1_ne, h_zf1⟩ := h_zpow_frac P_pos Q_pos u_bez hP_pos_ne hQ_pos_ne
    obtain ⟨h_num2_ne, h_den2_ne, h_zf2⟩ := h_zpow_frac P_neg Q_neg v_bez hP_neg_ne hQ_neg_ne
    let A₀ : Polynomial ℂ := numZ P_pos Q_pos u_bez * numZ P_neg Q_neg v_bez
    let B₀ : Polynomial ℂ := denZ P_pos Q_pos u_bez * denZ P_neg Q_neg v_bez
    have hA₀_ne : A₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero h_num1_ne h_num2_ne
    have hB₀_ne : B₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero h_den1_ne h_den2_ne
    obtain ⟨R_Pp, _, hR_Pp⟩ := h_root_bound P_pos hP_pos_ne
    obtain ⟨R_Pn, _, hR_Pn⟩ := h_root_bound P_neg hP_neg_ne
    obtain ⟨R_B0, _, hR_B0⟩ := h_root_bound B₀ hB₀_ne
    let c_B0 : ℂ := B₀.leadingCoeff
    have hc_B0_ne : c_B0 ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hB₀_ne
    let A_R : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.C c_B0⁻¹ * A₀
    let B_R : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.C c_B0⁻¹ * B₀
    have hA_R_ne : A_R ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero hc_B0_ne)) hA₀_ne
    have hB_R_monic : B_R.Monic := by
      rw [Polynomial.Monic, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C]

    have hR₁_gt_R₀ : P.R₀ < R₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hR_pos (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
    have hR_eq_on_R₁ : ∀ w : ℂ, R₁ < ‖w‖ →
        B_R.eval w ≠ 0 ∧ (P.ξ w) ^ d₀ * B_R.eval w = A_R.eval w := by

      have hw_pos : R_pos < ‖w‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hw
      have hw_neg : R_neg < ‖w‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hw
      have hw_Pp : R_Pp < ‖w‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hw
      have hw_Pn : R_Pn < ‖w‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)) hw
      have hw_B0 : R_B0 < ‖w‖ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)) hw
      have hξw_ne : P.ξ w ≠ 0 := (P.ξ_def w (lt_trans hR_pos hw_pos)).2
      have h1 := h_rat_pos w hw_pos
      have h2 := h_rat_neg w hw_neg
      have h_u := h_zf1 ((P.ξ w) ^ D_pos) w (zpow_ne_zero D_pos hξw_ne) (hR_Pp w hw_Pp) h1.1 h1.2
      have h_v := h_zf2 ((P.ξ w) ^ D_neg) w (zpow_ne_zero D_neg hξw_ne) (hR_Pn w hw_Pn) h2.1 h2.2
      have hB_R_eval_ne : B_R.eval w ≠ 0 := by
        simp only [B_R, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
        exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hc_B0_ne) (hR_B0 w hw_B0)
      refine ⟨hB_R_eval_ne, ?_⟩
      have h_pow_d0 : ((P.ξ w) ^ d₀ : ℂ) =
          ((P.ξ w) ^ D_pos) ^ u_bez * ((P.ξ w) ^ D_neg) ^ v_bez := by
        rw [← zpow_natCast, h_bez, zpow_add₀ hξw_ne, _root_.zpow_mul, _root_.zpow_mul]

            (((P.ξ w) ^ D_neg) ^ v_bez * (denZ P_neg Q_neg v_bez).eval w)) := by ring
        _ = c_B0⁻¹ * ((numZ P_pos Q_pos u_bez).eval w * (numZ P_neg Q_neg v_bez).eval w) := by
            rw [h_u, h_v]
    let m : ℕ := B_R.natDegree
    let p_deg : ℕ := A_R.natDegree
    have hA_R_monic_deg : A_R.Monic ∧ A_R.natDegree = m + d₀ := by
      let inv_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => ((k : ℂ))⁻¹

        have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
        have h_comp := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
        convert h_comp using 1
        ext k
        simp [inv_seq]
      have h_poly_lim : ∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (D : ℕ), F.natDegree ≤ D →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => F.eval (k : ℂ) * (inv_seq k) ^ D)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (F.coeff D)) := by

            (fun k : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), F.coeff i * (inv_seq k) ^ (D - i))
            Filter.atTop (nhds (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), F.coeff i * (0 : ℂ) ^ (D - i))) :=
          tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (h_inv_lim.pow (D - i)).const_mul (F.coeff i))

          · intro i hi hi_ne

            rw [zero_pow h_pos, mul_zero]

        rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hFD), Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hi_le : i ≤ D := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)

        calc F.coeff i * (inv_seq k) ^ (D - i)
          = F.coeff i * ((k : ℂ) * ((k : ℂ))⁻¹) ^ i * (((k : ℂ))⁻¹) ^ (D - i) := by

              rw [← pow_add, ← h_split]
      have h_U_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (P.U_germ (inv_seq k)) ^ d₀)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by

  have hτ_eq_neg : ∀ z ∈ B, τ z = -z := by
    have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => τ w + w) B :=
      fun w hw => ((hτ_ana w hw).differentiableAt.add differentiableAt_id).differentiableWithinAt
    have hg_deriv : Set.EqOn (deriv (fun w => τ w + w)) 0 B := by
      intro w hw
      have h_hd : HasDerivAt (fun u => τ u + u) (deriv τ w + 1) w :=
        (hτ_ana w hw).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt.add (hasDerivAt_id w)
      simp [h_hd.deriv, hτ'_eq w hw]
    intro z hz
    have h_eq := Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) ε₁).isPreconnected
      hg_diff hg_deriv hz h0_mem_B
    simp only [hτ0, add_zero] at h_eq
    linear_combination h_eq
  have hua_sum_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => G.u_a (-z) + G.u_a z) 0 :=
    ((G.u_a_analytic.fun_comp_of_eq analyticAt_id.neg neg_zero).add G.u_a_analytic).continuousAt
  have hua_sum_ne0 : G.u_a (-(0 : ℂ)) + G.u_a 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [neg_zero, ← two_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero G.u_a_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_ne⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hua_sum_cont.eventually_ne hua_sum_ne0)
  refine ⟨min ε₁ r₂, lt_min hε₁_pos hr₂_pos, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hε₁_le, ?_⟩
  intro z hz_pos hz_lt
  have hz_lt1 : ‖z‖ < ε₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  have hz_ltr2 : ‖z‖ < r₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (min_le_right _ _)
  have hz_B : z ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hz_lt1)
  have hz_U₁ : z ∈ U₁ := ⟨hz_pos, hz_lt1⟩
  have hz_U₀ : z ∈ U₀ := ⟨hz_pos, lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt1 hε₁_le⟩
  have hneg_U₀ : -z ∈ U₀ := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hz_pos
    · simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt1 hε₁_le
  have hτz := hτ_eq_neg z hz_B
  have hZ_even : G.Z_loc (-z) = G.Z_loc z := by
    have := (hτ_symm z hz_pos hz_lt1).2.2.1
    rwa [hτz] at this
  have hW_even : G.W_loc (-z) = G.W_loc z := by
    have := (hτ_symm z hz_pos hz_lt1).2.2.2
    rwa [hτz] at this
  have hZ'_odd : deriv G.Z_loc (-z) * (-1) = deriv G.Z_loc z := by
    have h := (hZ'_comp z hz_U₁).symm
    rwa [hτz, hτ'_eq z hz_B] at h
  have hW'_odd : deriv G.W_loc (-z) * (-1) = deriv G.W_loc z := by
    have h := (hW'_comp z hz_U₁).symm
    rwa [hτz, hτ'_eq z hz_B] at h
  have hZaW_z := (hU₀_ident z hz_U₀).2.1
  have hZaW_neg := (hU₀_ident (-z) hneg_U₀).2.1
  have hW'_ne : deriv G.W_loc z ≠ 0 :=
    fun h0 => (hU₀_ident z hz_U₀).1 (by simp [h0])
  have ha_sq : (G.a_loc (-z)) ^ 2 = (G.a_loc z) ^ 2 := by
    have h_diff : ((G.a_loc (-z)) ^ 2 - (G.a_loc z) ^ 2) * deriv G.W_loc z = 0 := by
      linear_combination -hZaW_neg - hZaW_z - hZ'_odd - (G.a_loc (-z)) ^ 2 * hW'_odd
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h_diff).resolve_right hW'_ne)
  have ha_z := G.a_eq z hz_U₀.1 hz_U₀.2
  have ha_neg := G.a_eq (-z) hneg_U₀.1 hneg_U₀.2
  simp only [pow_one] at ha_z ha_neg
  have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hz_pos
  have hua_sq : (G.u_a (-z)) ^ 2 = (G.u_a z) ^ 2 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hz_ne)
    calc
      z ^ 2 * (G.u_a (-z)) ^ 2 = ((-z) * G.u_a (-z)) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (G.a_loc (-z)) ^ 2 := by rw [ha_neg]
      _ = (G.a_loc z) ^ 2 := ha_sq
      _ = (z * G.u_a z) ^ 2 := by rw [ha_z]
      _ = z ^ 2 * (G.u_a z) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hua_prod : (G.u_a (-z) - G.u_a z) * (G.u_a (-z) + G.u_a z) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hua_sq
  have hua_sum_ne : G.u_a (-z) + G.u_a z ≠ 0 :=
    hr₂_ne (by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hz_ltr2)
  have hua_even : G.u_a (-z) = G.u_a z :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hua_prod).resolve_right hua_sum_ne)
  refine ⟨hZ_even, hW_even, ?_⟩
  rw [ha_neg, ha_z, hua_even]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(a : ℂ → ℂ) (ϕ : ℝ → ℝ) (p₀ : ℂ)
    (ha_nf : MeromorphicNFOn a Set.univ)
    (hϕ_diff : Differentiable ℝ ϕ)
    (hϕ_deriv : deriv ϕ 0 ≠ 0)
    (ha_real : ∀ x : ℝ, a x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ x))
    (ha_per : ∀ s : ℂ, a (s + 2 * Real.pi) = a s)
    (ha_conj : ∀ q : ℂ, ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ, a (starRingEnd ℂ z) * starRingEnd ℂ (a z) = 1)
    (hp₀_im : p₀.im ≠ 0)
    (hp₀_ord : meromorphicOrderAt a p₀ ≠ 0)
    (ha_centers : ∀ q : ℂ, meromorphicOrderAt a q ≠ 0 →
      (meromorphicOrderAt a q = 1 ∨ meromorphicOrderAt a q = -1) ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, a (2 * q - s) = -a s) :
    ∃ B₀ C₀ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      (deriv ϕ x) ^ 2 = C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * ϕ x) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * ϕ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpLim : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ s : ℂ, ∃ (V : Set ℂ) (q_s : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V ∧ s ∈ V ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ q_s V ∧ ∀ z ∈ V, z ≠ s → f z = q_s z) →
      Differentiable ℂ (fun s => Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) f) ∧
      (∀ (s : ℂ) (V : Set ℂ) (q_s : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V → s ∈ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ q_s V → (∀ z ∈ V, z ≠ s → f z = q_s z) →
        Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) f = q_s s) ∧
      (∀ w_per : ℂ, (∀ z : ℂ, f (z + w_per) = f z) →
        ∀ s : ℂ, Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin (s + w_per) {s + w_per}ᶜ) f =
          Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) f) := by
    intro f hf_loc
    have h_local_tend : ∀ (s : ℂ) (V : Set ℂ) (q_s : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V → s ∈ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ q_s V → (∀ z ∈ V, z ≠ s → f z = q_s z) →
        ∀ z ∈ V, Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ) (nhds (q_s z)) := by
      intro s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg z hz
      have h_ev : f =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] q_s := by
        by_cases hzs : z = s
        · subst hzs
          filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hV.mem_nhds hs), self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hwV hw_ne
          exact hfg w hwV hw_ne
        · have hVs : V \ {s} ∈ nhds z := (hV.sdiff isClosed_singleton).mem_nhds ⟨hz, hzs⟩
          filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds hVs] with w hw
          exact hfg w hw.1 hw.2
      have hq_cont : ContinuousAt q_s z := (hq_diff.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).continuousAt
      exact hq_cont.continuousWithinAt.tendsto.congr' h_ev.symm
    have h_eq_on : ∀ (s : ℂ) (V : Set ℂ) (q_s : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V → s ∈ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ q_s V → (∀ z ∈ V, z ≠ s → f z = q_s z) →
        ∀ z ∈ V, Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ) f = q_s z := by
      intro s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg z hz
      exact (h_local_tend s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg z hz).limUnder_eq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s
      obtain ⟨V, q_s, hV, hs, hq_diff, hfg⟩ := hf_loc s
      have h_ev_nhds : (fun z => Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ) f) =ᶠ[nhds s] q_s :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hs) (h_eq_on s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg)
      exact (hq_diff.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hs)).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev_nhds
    · intro s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg
      exact h_eq_on s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg s hs
    · intro w_per hω s
      obtain ⟨V, q_s, hV, hs, hq_diff, hfg⟩ := hf_loc s
      have htend_s : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ)
          (nhds (Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) f)) := by
        rw [h_eq_on s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg s hs]
        exact h_local_tend s V q_s hV hs hq_diff hfg s hs
      have h_sub_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℂ => w - w_per)
          (nhdsWithin (s + w_per) {s + w_per}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have h_cont : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ => w - w_per) (s + w_per) :=
            continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const
          simpa using h_cont.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
        · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hw
          simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hw ⊢
          intro h_eq
          apply hw
          linear_combination h_eq
      have htend_shift : Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin (s + w_per) {s + w_per}ᶜ)
          (nhds (Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) f)) := by
        refine (htend_s.comp h_sub_tend).congr ?_
        intro w
        dsimp
        have := hω (w - w_per)
        ring_nf at this ⊢
        exact this.symm
      exact htend_shift.limUnder_eq
  
  have ha_nf_at : ∀ q : ℂ, MeromorphicNFAt a q := fun q => ha_nf (Set.mem_univ q)
  have ha_mero_at : ∀ q : ℂ, MeromorphicAt a q := fun q => (ha_nf_at q).meromorphicAt
  have h_ord_tri : ∀ q : ℂ,
      meromorphicOrderAt a q = 0 ∨ meromorphicOrderAt a q = 1 ∨ meromorphicOrderAt a q = -1 := by
    intro q
    by_cases h0 : meromorphicOrderAt a q = 0
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · exact Or.inr (ha_centers q h0).1
  have h_ord_int : ∀ q : ℂ, ∃ n : ℤ,
      (n = 0 ∨ n = 1 ∨ n = -1) ∧ meromorphicOrderAt a q = (n : WithTop ℤ) := by
    intro q
    rcases h_ord_tri q with h0 | h1 | hm1
    · exact ⟨0, Or.inl rfl, h0⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), h1⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl), hm1⟩
  
  have ha_shift_ord_nf : ∀ (ε c s : ℂ), ε ≠ 0 →
      MeromorphicNFAt (fun z => ε * a (z + c)) s ∧
      meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => a (z + c)) s = meromorphicOrderAt a (s + c) := by
    intro ε c s hε
    obtain ⟨n, _, hn_ord⟩ := h_ord_int (s + c)
    obtain ⟨u, hu_ana, hu_ne, hu_eq⟩ :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at (s + c))).mp hn_ord
    have h_aff : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z + c) s := analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const
    let u₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => u (z + c)
    have hu₁_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ u₁ s := hu_ana.fun_comp_of_eq h_aff rfl
    have hu₁_ne : u₁ s ≠ 0 := hu_ne
    have h_add_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => z + c)
        (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin (s + c) {s + c}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨h_aff.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      exact fun h => hz (add_right_cancel h)
    have hg₁_eq : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ, a (z + c) = (z - s) ^ n • u₁ z := by
      filter_upwards [h_add_tend.eventually hu_eq] with z hz
      have h_sub : z + c - (s + c) = z - s := by ring
      simpa [u₁, h_sub] using hz
    have hg₁_mero : MeromorphicAt (fun z => a (z + c)) s :=
      MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mpr ⟨n, u₁, hu₁_ana, hg₁_eq⟩
    have hg₁_ord : meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => a (z + c)) s = (n : WithTop ℤ) :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hg₁_mero).mpr ⟨u₁, hu₁_ana, hu₁_ne, hg₁_eq⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hg₁_ord.trans hn_ord.symm⟩
    rcases meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mp (ha_nf_at (s + c)) with h_ana | ⟨_, h_neg, h_val0⟩
    · refine meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mpr (Or.inl ?_)
      exact analyticAt_const.mul (h_ana.fun_comp_of_eq h_aff rfl)
    · let u₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ε * u (z + c)
      have hu₂_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ u₂ s := analyticAt_const.mul hu₁_ana
      have hu₂_ne : u₂ s ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hε hu₁_ne
      have hg₂_eq : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ, ε * a (z + c) = (z - s) ^ n • u₂ z := by
        filter_upwards [hg₁_eq] with z hz
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, u₁, u₂] at hz ⊢
        rw [hz]
        ring
      have hg₂_mero : MeromorphicAt (fun z => ε * a (z + c)) s :=
        MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mpr ⟨n, u₂, hu₂_ana, hg₂_eq⟩
      have hg₂_ord : meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => ε * a (z + c)) s = (n : WithTop ℤ) :=
        (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hg₂_mero).mpr ⟨u₂, hu₂_ana, hu₂_ne, hg₂_eq⟩
      refine meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hg₂_mero, ?_, ?_⟩)
      · rwa [hg₂_ord, ← hn_ord]
      · simp [h_val0]
  
  have h_zero_pole : ∀ q : ℂ,
      (a q = 0 ↔ meromorphicOrderAt a q ≠ 0) ∧
      (¬ AnalyticAt ℂ a q ↔ meromorphicOrderAt a q = -1) := by
    intro q
    rcases h_ord_tri q with h0 | h1 | hm1
    · have h_not_neg : ¬ (meromorphicOrderAt a q < 0) := by rw [h0]; decide
      have h_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ a q := by
        rcases meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mp (ha_nf_at q) with hA | ⟨_, hlt, _⟩
        · exact hA
        · exact absurd hlt h_not_neg
      obtain ⟨u, hu_ana, hu_ne, hu_eq⟩ :=
        (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at q)).mp h0
      have hu_eq' : a =ᶠ[nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ] u := by
        filter_upwards [hu_eq] with z hz
        simpa using hz
      have ha_tend : Filter.Tendsto a (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds (a q)) :=
        h_ana.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
      have hu_tend : Filter.Tendsto a (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds (u q)) :=
        hu_ana.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto.congr' hu_eq'.symm
      have ha_eq_u : a q = u q := tendsto_nhds_unique ha_tend hu_tend
      have ha_ne : a q ≠ 0 := ha_eq_u ▸ hu_ne
      refine ⟨⟨fun h => absurd h ha_ne, fun h => absurd h0 h⟩,
        ⟨fun h => absurd h_ana h, fun h => absurd (h0.symm.trans h) (by decide)⟩⟩
    · have h_not_neg : ¬ (meromorphicOrderAt a q < 0) := by rw [h1]; decide
      have h_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ a q := by
        rcases meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mp (ha_nf_at q) with hA | ⟨_, hlt, _⟩
        · exact hA
        · exact absurd hlt h_not_neg
      obtain ⟨u, hu_ana, _, hu_eq⟩ :=
        (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at q)).mp h1
      have ha_tend : Filter.Tendsto a (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds (a q)) :=
        h_ana.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
      have h_prod_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - q) * u z) q :=
        (continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).mul hu_ana.continuousAt
      have h_prod_tend : Filter.Tendsto a (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds ((q - q) * u q)) := by
        refine h_prod_cont.continuousWithinAt.tendsto.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hu_eq] with z hz
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hz.symm
      have ha_zero : a q = 0 := by
        have := tendsto_nhds_unique ha_tend h_prod_tend
        simpa using this
      have h1_ne0 : meromorphicOrderAt a q ≠ 0 := by rw [h1]; decide
      refine ⟨⟨fun _ => h1_ne0, fun _ => ha_zero⟩,
        ⟨fun h => absurd h_ana h, fun h => absurd (h1.symm.trans h) (by decide)⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu_ana, hu_ne, hu_eq⟩ :=
        (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff (ha_mero_at q)).mp hm1
      have h_not_ana : ¬ AnalyticAt ℂ a q := by
        intro h_ana
        have h_prod_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - q) * a z) q :=
          (continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).mul h_ana.continuousAt
        have h_tend1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (z - q) * a z)
            (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds ((q - q) * a q)) :=
          h_prod_cont.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
        have h_tend2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun z : ℂ => (z - q) * a z)
            (nhdsWithin q {q}ᶜ) (nhds (u q)) := by
          refine hu_ana.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto.congr' ?_
          filter_upwards [hu_eq, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz hz_ne
          have hzq : z - q ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz_ne
          simp only [_root_.zpow_neg_one, smul_eq_mul] at hz
          rw [hz, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hzq, one_mul]
        have h0_eq : (q - q) * a q = u q := tendsto_nhds_unique h_tend1 h_tend2
        simp at h0_eq
        exact hu_ne h0_eq.symm
      have ha_zero : a q = 0 := by
        rcases meromorphicNFAt_iff_analyticAt_or.mp (ha_nf_at q) with hA | ⟨_, _, h0⟩
        · exact absurd hA h_not_ana
        · exact h0
      have hm1_ne0 : meromorphicOrderAt a q ≠ 0 := by rw [hm1]; decide
      exact ⟨⟨fun _ => hm1_ne0, fun _ => ha_zero⟩, ⟨fun _ => hm1, fun _ => h_not_ana⟩⟩
  have ha_zero_iff : ∀ q : ℂ, a q = 0 ↔ meromorphicOrderAt a q ≠ 0 := fun q => (h_zero_pole q).1
  have ha_pole_iff : ∀ q : ℂ, ¬ AnalyticAt ℂ a q ↔ meromorphicOrderAt a q = -1 :=
    fun q => (h_zero_pole q).2
  
  have ha_real_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, AnalyticAt ℂ a x ∧
      deriv a x = Complex.I * (↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ x) := by
    intro x
    have hax_ne : a x ≠ 0 := by
      rw [ha_real x]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hax_ord0 : meromorphicOrderAt a x = 0 :=
      not_ne_iff.mp (mt (ha_zero_iff x).mpr hax_ne)
    have hax_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ a x := by
      by_contra h_nana
      have := (ha_pole_iff x).mp h_nana
      rw [hax_ord0] at this
      exact absurd this (by decide)
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a t) (deriv a x) x :=

        hΨ_diff_s, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, n, h_case⟩ := ha_poles_class s hs_ana
      have h_per_mn : isPer (m • b 0 + n • b 1) := isPer_zsmul m n
      have h_shift_data : ∃ (δ ε : ℂ), s = q₁ + δ ∧ (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧
          ∀ y : ℂ, a (y + δ) = ε * a y := by
        rcases h_case with hs1 | hs2
        · refine ⟨m • b 0 + n • b 1, 1, by rw [hs1]; abel, Or.inl rfl, fun y => ?_⟩
          simpa using h_per_mn y
        · refine ⟨η + (m • b 0 + n • b 1), -1, by rw [hs2]; abel, Or.inr rfl, fun y => ?_⟩
          have h_add : y + (η + (m • b 0 + n • b 1)) = (y + η) + (m • b 0 + n • b 1) := by abel
          rw [h_add, h_per_mn, ha_eta, neg_one_mul]
      obtain ⟨δ, ε, hs_eq, hε, ha_δ⟩ := h_shift_data
      have hΨ_δ := hΨ_shift δ ε hε ha_δ
      refine ⟨Metric.ball s r₀, fun z => H₁ (z - δ), Metric.isOpen_ball,
        Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z hz
        have hzB : z - δ ∈ B := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
          have h_sub : (z - δ) - q₁ = z - s := by rw [hs_eq]; abel
          rwa [h_sub]
        have hd_H₁ : DifferentiableAt ℂ H₁ (z - δ) :=
          hH₁_diff.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzB)
        exact (hd_H₁.comp z (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const δ))).differentiableWithinAt
      · intro z hz hz_ne
        have hzB : z - δ ∈ B := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
          have h_sub : (z - δ) - q₁ = z - s := by rw [hs_eq]; abel
          rwa [h_sub]
        have hz_ne_q₁ : z - δ ≠ q₁ := by
          intro h_eq
          apply hz_ne
          rw [hs_eq, ← h_eq]
          abel
        calc
          Ψ z = Ψ ((z - δ) + δ) := by ring_nf
          _ = Ψ (z - δ) := hΨ_δ (z - δ)
          _ = H₁ (z - δ) := hΨ_eq_H₁ (z - δ) hzB hz_ne_q₁
  obtain ⟨hΨ_ext_diff, hΨ_ext_val, hΨ_ext_per⟩ := hpLim Ψ hΨ_loc
  have hΨ_per0 : ∀ z : ℂ, Ψ (z + b 0) = Ψ z :=
    hΨ_shift (b 0) 1 (Or.inl rfl) (fun y => by simpa using hb0 y)
  have hΨ_per1 : ∀ z : ℂ, Ψ (z + b 1) = Ψ z :=
    hΨ_shift (b 1) 1 (Or.inl rfl) (fun y => by simpa using hb1 y)
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := hb_liouville _ hΨ_ext_diff
    (hΨ_ext_per (b 0) hΨ_per0) (hΨ_ext_per (b 1) hΨ_per1)
  have h_ode_ana : ∀ s : ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ a s →
      (deriv a s) ^ 2 = A₄ * (a s) ^ 4 + A₂ * (a s) ^ 2 + c₀ := by
    intro s hs_ana
    obtain ⟨r_s, hr_s_pos, hr_s_ana⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hs_ana.eventually_analyticAt
    have ha_diff_s : DifferentiableOn ℂ a (Metric.ball s r_s) :=
      fun z hz => (hr_s_ana z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hda_diff_s : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv a) (Metric.ball s r_s) :=
      ha_diff_s.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hΨ_diff_s : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball s r_s) :=
      ((hda_diff_s.pow 2).sub ((differentiableOn_const A₄).mul (ha_diff_s.pow 4))).sub
        ((differentiableOn_const A₂).mul (ha_diff_s.pow 2))
    have h_val := hΨ_ext_val s (Metric.ball s r_s) Ψ Metric.isOpen_ball
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_s_pos) hΨ_diff_s (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    rw [hc₀ s] at h_val
    dsimp [Ψ] at h_val
    linear_combination -h_val
  
  refine ⟨-(A₄.re + c₀.re), -A₂.re, A₄.im - c₀.im, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨hx_ana, hx_deriv⟩ := ha_real_deriv x
  have h_ode := h_ode_ana x hx_ana
  rw [hx_deriv, ha_real x] at h_ode
  let E : ℂ := Complex.exp (((2 * ϕ x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  let E_inv : ℂ := Complex.exp (((-(2 * ϕ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hE_mul : E * E_inv = 1 := by
    dsimp [E, E_inv]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    have : (((2 * ϕ x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (((-(2 * ϕ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [this, Complex.exp_zero]
  have ha_sq : (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 2 = E := by
    dsimp [E]
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have ha_pow4 : (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 4 = E ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 4 =
          ((Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = E ^ 2 := by rw [ha_sq]
  have hda_sq : (Complex.I * (↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 2 =
      -((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) * E := by
    calc
      (Complex.I * (↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 2
        = Complex.I ^ 2 * (↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (ϕ x : ℂ))) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = -((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) * E := by rw [Complex.I_sq, ha_sq]; ring
  rw [hda_sq, ha_pow4, ha_sq] at h_ode
  have h_solve : ((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) = -A₂ - A₄ * E - c₀ * E_inv := by
    calc
      ((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) = -((-((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) * E) * E_inv) := by
        linear_combination -((↑(deriv ϕ x) : ℂ) ^ 2) * hE_mul
      _ = -((A₄ * E ^ 2 + A₂ * E + c₀) * E_inv) := by rw [h_ode]
      _ = -A₂ * (E * E_inv) - A₄ * E * (E * E_inv) - c₀ * E_inv := by ring
      _ = -A₂ - A₄ * E - c₀ * E_inv := by rw [hE_mul]; ring
  have hE_euler : E = (Real.cos (2 * ϕ x) : ℂ) + (Real.sin (2 * ϕ x) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    dsimp [E]
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
  have hE_inv_euler : E_inv = (Real.cos (2 * ϕ x) : ℂ) - (Real.sin (2 * ϕ x) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    dsimp [E_inv]
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hE_euler, hE_inv_euler] at h_solve
  have h_re := congrArg Complex.re h_solve
  simp only [sq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re,
    Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im] at h_re ⊢
  linarith
