glancing_operator_and_factorization.definitions:
structure UniversalGlancingCalculus : Prop where
  partial_y_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  param_integral_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  param_integral_cont : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ))) (F : ℝ → ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ)) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  deriv_conj_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) →
    ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z)
  sinc_props :
    Differentiable ℂ sinc_ℂ ∧
    sinc_ℂ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (-z) = sinc_ℂ z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (sinc_ℂ z)) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → ‖sinc_ℂ z - 1‖ ≤ ‖z‖)
  diffOp_props :
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ → 0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingDiffOp v)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |p.2.im| < σ }) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ),
      glancingDiffOp v (y, 0) = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', 0)) y) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      t ≠ 0 → |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
      glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t) = t⁻¹ * (u (y + t / 2) - u (y - t / 2))) ∧
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t → (∀ t ∈ V_t, -t ∈ V_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + α * |t.im| < σ → v (y, -t) = v (y, t)) →
      ∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |t.im| < σ →
        glancingDiffOp v (y, -t) = glancingDiffOp v (y, t))
  dslope_quad_bound : ∀ (R M : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < R → 0 ≤ M →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M) →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
      ‖g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0‖ ≤ (4 * M / R ^ 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2

structure NormActionPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  M_act : ℝ
  M_rem : ℝ
  δ_lin : ℝ
  M_act_pos : 0 < M_act
  M_rem_pos : 0 < M_rem
  δ_lin_pos : 0 < δ_lin
  δ_lin_le_eighth_s₀ : δ_lin ≤ B.s₀ / 8
  δ_lin_le_half : δ_lin ≤ 1 / 2
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  ϕ_deriv_strip_lip :
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z‖ ≤ M_act) ∧
    (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4),
      ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_act * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
  real_step_bound : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ δ_lin →
    0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  boundary_lin_close : ∀ X_m X_p W : ℂ,
    X_m ∈ horizStrip B.s₀ →
    ‖X_p - X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖2 * W - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖W‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖4 * ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
      r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X_m + B.ϕ_ℂ X_p) / 2) * W) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16
  normActionRem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
    (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normActionRem_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip B.s₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4))
  normActionRem_bound : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    ‖normActionRem_ℂ B X b‖ ≤ M_rem
  normActionRem_conj : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normActionRem_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ b) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normActionRem_ℂ B X b)
  normAction1_taylor4 : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) = b ^ 2 / 8 + b ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B X b

structure GlancingOperatorCore {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (_A : NormActionPackage B) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  M_E : ℝ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le_half_s₀ : s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2
  s_act_le_one : s_act ≤ 1
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt_half_s_act : d_act < s_act / 2
  d_act_lt_one : d_act < 1
  d_act_lt_half_δ_col : d_act < B.δ_col / 2
  d_act_lt_half_τ₀ : d_act < B.τ₀ / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le_inv32 : η_adm ≤ 1 / 32
  η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ : η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4
  M_E_pos : 0 < M_E
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, -t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U (y, t))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), glancingResidualOp B U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => glancingResidualOp B (U_seq n) p)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (glancingResidualOp B U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, glancingResidualOp B U p = 0) →
    ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| + ‖t‖ < s → ‖t‖ < d →
      -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u y' - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ ^ 3 * deriv u y *
          (normAction1_ℂ B (u y) (u (y + t)) + normAction2_ℂ B (u (y - t)) (u y))) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ * normAction12_ℂ B (u (y - t / 2)) (u (y + t / 2)) *
          deriv u (y - t / 2) * deriv u (y + t / 2))
  enlarged_holo_and_bounds : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_t → V_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ V_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ →
      ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ M_E) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ →
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  linCoeff_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  slice_at_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ),
    0 < σ → DifferentiableOn ℂ w (horizStrip σ) → y ∈ horizStrip σ →
    glancingResidualOp B (fun q => w q.1) (y, 0) =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv w y) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv w) y ∧
    (w y ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => w q.1) (y, 0) = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv w y) ^ 3)
  param_slice_holo_and_bound : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_ζ : Set ℂ) (y t : ℂ) (u_fam : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_ζ → ‖t‖ < d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => u_fam q.1 q.2) (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_ζ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ ζ ∈ V_ζ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u_fam y' ζ - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun ζ : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u_fam q.1 ζ) (y, t)) V_ζ ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ V_ζ, ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u_fam q.1 ζ) (y, t)‖ ≤ M_E)

structure GlancingFactorizationData {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (A : NormActionPackage B) (O : GlancingOperatorCore B A) where
  C_quad : ℝ
  C_quad_pos : 0 < C_quad
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ O.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ O.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ O.η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (glancingResidualOp B U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  slice_quad_approx : ∀ (σ ρ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u v : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ O.s_act → ‖t‖ < O.d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ O.η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => u z' - z') z‖ ≤ O.η_adm) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => deriv u z' * v z') z‖ ≤ ρ) →
    ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1 + deriv u q.1 * v q.1) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp
        (fun q =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => u r.1) (q.1, t) *
            glancingDiffOp (fun r => v r.1) (q.1, t))
        (y, t) +
        deriv
          (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun r => u r.1) (z, t) * v z)
          y)‖ ≤ C_quad * ρ ^ 2
  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t₀ → 0 < r_t → t₀ + r_t ≤ O.d_act →
    0 < σ' → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → σ ≤ O.s_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_cand (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_cand (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * O.η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, glancingResidualOp B U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ',
      let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ))
      let z_jet : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun z => deriv (fun t : ℂ => U_cand (z, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv u_star z
      deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_cand (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun q =>
            glancingLinCoeff B U_cand (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
              (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z_jet r.1) (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ))

structure UniversalGlancingCalculus : Prop where
  partial_y_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  param_integral_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  param_integral_cont : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ))) (F : ℝ → ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ)) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W
  deriv_conj_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) →
    ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z)
  sinc_props :
    Differentiable ℂ sinc_ℂ ∧
    sinc_ℂ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (-z) = sinc_ℂ z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (sinc_ℂ z)) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → ‖sinc_ℂ z - 1‖ ≤ ‖z‖)
  diffOp_props :
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ → 0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingDiffOp v)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |p.2.im| < σ }) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ),
      glancingDiffOp v (y, 0) = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', 0)) y) ∧
    (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      t ≠ 0 → |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
      glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t) = t⁻¹ * (u (y + t / 2) - u (y - t / 2))) ∧
    (∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t → (∀ t ∈ V_t, -t ∈ V_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + α * |t.im| < σ → v (y, -t) = v (y, t)) →
      ∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |t.im| < σ →
        glancingDiffOp v (y, -t) = glancingDiffOp v (y, t))
  dslope_quad_bound : ∀ (R M : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < R → 0 ≤ M →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M) →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
      ‖g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0‖ ≤ (4 * M / R ^ 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2

structure NormActionPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  M_act : ℝ
  M_rem : ℝ
  δ_lin : ℝ
  M_act_pos : 0 < M_act
  M_rem_pos : 0 < M_rem
  δ_lin_pos : 0 < δ_lin
  δ_lin_le_eighth_s₀ : δ_lin ≤ B.s₀ / 8
  δ_lin_le_half : δ_lin ≤ 1 / 2
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  ϕ_deriv_strip_lip :
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z‖ ≤ M_act) ∧
    (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4),
      ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_act * ‖z₁ - z₂‖)
  real_step_bound : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ δ_lin →
    0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  boundary_lin_close : ∀ X_m X_p W : ℂ,
    X_m ∈ horizStrip B.s₀ →
    ‖X_p - X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖2 * W - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
    ‖W‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖4 * ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
      r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X_m + B.ϕ_ℂ X_p) / 2) * W) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16
  normActionRem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
    (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normActionRem_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip B.s₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4))
  normActionRem_bound : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    ‖normActionRem_ℂ B X b‖ ≤ M_rem
  normActionRem_conj : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normActionRem_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ b) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normActionRem_ℂ B X b)
  normAction1_taylor4 : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
    normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) = b ^ 2 / 8 + b ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B X b

structure GlancingOperatorCore {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (_A : NormActionPackage B) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  M_E : ℝ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le_half_s₀ : s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2
  s_act_le_one : s_act ≤ 1
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt_half_s_act : d_act < s_act / 2
  d_act_lt_one : d_act < 1
  d_act_lt_half_δ_col : d_act < B.δ_col / 2
  d_act_lt_half_τ₀ : d_act < B.τ₀ / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le_inv32 : η_adm ≤ 1 / 32
  η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ : η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4
  M_E_pos : 0 < M_E
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

    have ht_neg_ℂ : -(t₀ : ℂ) = (t_pos : ℂ) := by
      rw [ht_eq]
      push_cast
      ring
    let W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => W_plus (p.1, -p.2)
    let refMap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, -p.2)
    have href_diff : Differentiable ℂ refMap := differentiable_fst.prodMk differentiable_snd.neg
    have hball_ref : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        -t ∈ Metric.ball (t_pos : ℂ) (δ / 8) := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht ⊢
      have hnorm : -t - (t_pos : ℂ) = -(t - (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
        rw [← ht_neg_ℂ]
        ring
      rw [hnorm, norm_neg]
      exact ht
    have hU_adm : IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d S.η_adm U := by
      refine ⟨hU.1, hU.2.1, hU.2.2.1, hU.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
      intro k hk y t hyt
      exact le_trans (hU.2.2.2.2 k hk y t hyt) (by linarith [S.η_adm_pos])
    have ht_ball_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        ‖t‖ < d ∧ |t.im| < δ / 8 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht
      have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t_pos := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, ht_abs]
      have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < d := by
        have htri : ‖t‖ ≤ ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add t (t₀ : ℂ)
        linarith
      have ht_im : |t.im| < δ / 8 := by
        have him : t.im = (t - (t₀ : ℂ)).im := by simp
        rw [him]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t - (t₀ : ℂ))) ht
      exact ⟨ht_norm, ht_im⟩
    have hstrip_shift : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : ℂ),
        y ∈ horizStrip σ → y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro σ y hy
      change |(y + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im| < σ
      have him : (y + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im = y.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      exact hy
    have hW_jet_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
        (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) :=
      hW_plus_holo.comp href_diff.differentiableOn (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hball_ref p.2 hp.2⟩)
    have hW_jet_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t) := by
      intro y hy t ht
      exact hW_plus_per y hy (-t) (hball_ref t ht)
    have hdiff_W_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t) = glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, -t) :=
      hCyc.2.1 (s - 8 * δ) (s - 9 * δ) t₀ (δ / 8) W_plus W_jet
        (by linarith) (by positivity) (by linarith) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)
    let g_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_plus p
    let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
    have hg_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        g_jet (y, t) = g_plus (y, -t) := by
      intro y hy t ht
      obtain ⟨ht_norm, ht_im⟩ := ht_ball_bounds t ht
      have hyt_dom : (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d := by
        refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
        have hy_im : |y.im| < s - 9 * δ := hy
        linarith
      have ha_even : glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) :=
        ((S.linCoeff_props s d U hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hU_adm).2 y t hyt_dom).2.1
      dsimp [g_jet, g_plus]
      rw [hdiff_W_eq y hy t ht, ha_even]
    have hg_jet_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
        (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) :=
      (hg_plus_holo.comp href_diff.differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hball_ref p.2 hp.2⟩)).congr
        (fun p hp => hg_eq p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2)
    have hg_jet_bounds : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
        ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ∧
        ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε := by
      intro y hy t ht
      have hy_per : y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) := hstrip_shift (s - 9 * δ) y hy
      have ht_ref : -t ∈ Metric.ball (t_pos : ℂ) (δ / 8) := hball_ref t ht
      obtain ⟨hg_p_per, hg_p_norm, hW_p_norm⟩ := hg_plus_bounds y hy (-t) ht_ref
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hg_eq (y + 2 * Real.pi) hy_per t ht, hg_eq y hy t ht]
        exact hg_p_per
      · rw [hg_eq y hy t ht]
        exact le_trans hg_p_norm hM_lin_le
      · rw [hdiff_W_eq y hy t ht]
        exact le_trans hW_p_norm hM_lin_le
    have hdiff_g_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t) = glancingDiffOp g_plus (y, -t) :=
      hCyc.2.1 (s - 9 * δ) (s - 10 * δ) t₀ (δ / 8) g_plus g_jet
        (by linarith) (by positivity) (by linarith) hg_eq
    let H_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_plus p
    let H_compat : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p
    have hH_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
        H_compat (y, t) = H_plus (y, -t) := by
      intro y hy t ht
      obtain ⟨ht_norm, ht_im⟩ := ht_ball_bounds t ht
      have hyt_dom : (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d := by
        refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
        have hy_im : |y.im| < s - 10 * δ := hy
        linarith
      have hE_even : glancingResidualOp B U (y, -t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) :=
        ((S.E_op_props s d U hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hU_adm).2.1 y t hyt_dom).2.1
      dsimp [H_compat, H_plus]
      rw [hdiff_g_eq y hy t ht, hE_even]
    have hH_compat_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_compat
        (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) :=
      (hH_plus_holo.comp href_diff.differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hball_ref p.2 hp.2⟩)).congr
        (fun p hp => hH_eq p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2)
    have hderiv_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
        deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_compat (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
          -deriv (fun u : ℂ => H_plus (y, u)) (t_pos : ℂ) := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : (fun t : ℂ => H_compat (y, t)) =ᶠ[nhds (t₀ : ℂ)]
          (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, -t)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (t₀ : ℂ) (by positivity))
          (fun t ht => hH_eq y hy t ht)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_comp_neg (fun u : ℂ => H_plus (y, u)) (t₀ : ℂ), ht_neg_ℂ]
    have hH_compat_dt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_compat (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ))
        (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) :=
      hH_plus_dt_holo.neg.congr (fun y hy => hderiv_eq y hy)
    have hH_compat_bounds : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
        ‖H_compat (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2 ∧
        ‖deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_compat (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2 := by
      intro y hy
      have ht₀_mem : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8) :=
        Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨hval_plus, hdt_plus⟩ := hH_plus_bounds y hy
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hval_eq : H_compat (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = H_plus (y, (t_pos : ℂ)) := by
          rw [hH_eq y hy (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_mem, ht_neg_ℂ]
        rw [hval_eq]
        exact le_trans hval_plus hM_quad_le
      · rw [hderiv_eq y hy, norm_neg]
        exact le_trans hdt_plus hM_quad_le
    exact ⟨W_jet, hW_jet_holo, hW_jet_per, hg_jet_holo, hg_jet_bounds,
      hH_compat_holo, hH_compat_dt_holo, hH_compat_bounds⟩
  · 
    have hl_eq : (l : ℝ) = (l_pos : ℝ) := by
      have h_int : (l_pos : ℤ) = l := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hl_pos.le
      exact_mod_cast h_int.symm
    have ht_eq : t₀ = t_pos := by
      dsimp [t₀, t_pos]
      rw [hl_eq]
    refine ⟨W_plus, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [ht_eq] using hW_plus_holo
    · intro y hy t ht
      rw [ht_eq] at ht
      exact hW_plus_per y hy t ht
    · simpa only [ht_eq] using hg_plus_holo
    · intro y hy t ht
      rw [ht_eq] at ht
      obtain ⟨hper, hgn, hWn⟩ := hg_plus_bounds y hy t ht
      exact ⟨hper, le_trans hgn hM_lin_le, le_trans hWn hM_lin_le⟩
    · simpa only [ht_eq] using hH_plus_holo
    · simpa only [ht_eq] using hH_plus_dt_holo
    · intro y hy
      rw [ht_eq]
      obtain ⟨hv, hdt⟩ := hH_plus_bounds y hy
      exact ⟨le_trans hv hM_quad_le, le_trans hdt hM_quad_le⟩

def StationaryComplexMeshAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_mesh : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    X_mesh 0 y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
    X_mesh q y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_mesh j) (horizStrip (s - δ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
      X_mesh j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = X_mesh j y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      X_mesh j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_mesh j y) ∧
      ‖X_mesh j y - U (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ η_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    normAction1_ℂ B (X_mesh (j + 1) y) (X_mesh (j + 2) y) +
      normAction2_ℂ B (X_mesh j y) (X_mesh (j + 1) y) = 0)

def StationaryMeshProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_mesh : ℝ) (B_mesh : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_mesh ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε ≤ 1 →
      ∃ X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ,
        StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ (C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε) l q U X_mesh

def ExactRationalSliceAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_slice : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  DifferentiableOn ℂ U_star (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    U_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = U_star y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    U_star (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (U_star y)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℂ => U_star z - U (z, (t₀ : ℂ))) y‖ ≤ η_slice) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    glancingResidualOp B (fun p => U_star p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0)

def CollarExactSliceProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_slice : ℝ) (B_slice : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_slice ∧
    ∀ (s d δ η_mesh : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < η_mesh → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ η_mesh l q U X_mesh →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      C_slice * Q ^ B_slice * η_mesh ≤ 1 →
      ∃ U_star : ℂ → ℂ,
        ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ (C_slice * Q ^ B_slice * η_mesh) l q U U_star

def CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp : Prop :=
  ((∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ V W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => V (y', p.2)) p.1) W) →
    ∀ (σ σ' t₀ r_t M_V : ℝ) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ' → 0 < r_t → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → 0 ≤ M_V →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
        V (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = V (y, t) ∧ ‖V (y, t)‖ ≤ M_V) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingDiffOp V)
        (horizStrip σ' ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ', ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
        glancingDiffOp V (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingDiffOp V (y, t) ∧
        ‖glancingDiffOp V (y, t)‖ ≤ 4 * (σ - σ')⁻¹ * M_V)) ∧
  (∀ (σ σ' t_c r_t : ℝ) (V₁ V₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ' → 0 < r_t → σ' + r_t ≤ σ →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t, V₂ (y, t) = V₁ (y, -t)) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ', ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t,
      glancingDiffOp V₂ (y, t) = glancingDiffOp V₁ (y, -t)) ∧
  (∀ (σ t₀ M_dot : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (a_star E_dot g_init : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 < t₀ → 0 ≤ M_dot → 1 ≤ l → 1 ≤ q →
    (q : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) →
    (∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
        glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1 + f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
          glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) +
            glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) ∧
    (DifferentiableOn ℂ a_star (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ E_dot (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ g_init (horizStrip σ) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, a_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = a_star y ∧ ‖4 * a_star y - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot (y + 2 * Real.pi) = E_dot y ∧ ‖E_dot y‖ ≤ M_dot) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, g_init (y + 2 * Real.pi) = g_init y) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot y = glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_init p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) →
     ∃ z : ℂ → ℂ,
       DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip σ) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖z y‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
         glancingDiffOp
           (fun p => a_star p.1 * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))
           (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = -E_dot y)))

def PositiveRationalJetAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ M_lin M_quad t₀ : ℝ) (U W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
    (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
    W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t)) ∧
  (let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
   DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
     (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
     g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
     ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin ∧
     ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun y : ℂ =>
       deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ))
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
     ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_quad ∧
     ‖deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_quad))

def PositiveJetLiftProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∃ (C_lift : ℝ) (B_lift : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_lift ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 ≤ η_slice → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
      ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      let η_tot := ε + η_slice
      C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ≤ 1 →
      ∃ W_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        PositiveRationalJetAt B s δ
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot)
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ^ 2)
          t₀ U W_plus

def StationaryComplexMeshAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_mesh : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    X_mesh 0 y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
    X_mesh q y = U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_mesh j) (horizStrip (s - δ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
      X_mesh j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = X_mesh j y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      X_mesh j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_mesh j y) ∧
      ‖X_mesh j y - U (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ η_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
    normAction1_ℂ B (X_mesh (j + 1) y) (X_mesh (j + 2) y) +
      normAction2_ℂ B (X_mesh j y) (X_mesh (j + 1) y) = 0)

def StationaryMeshProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_mesh : ℝ) (B_mesh : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_mesh ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε ≤ 1 →
      ∃ X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ,
        StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ (C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε) l q U X_mesh

def ExactRationalSliceAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ η_slice : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  DifferentiableOn ℂ U_star (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    U_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = U_star y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    U_star (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (U_star y)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℂ => U_star z - U (z, (t₀ : ℂ))) y‖ ≤ η_slice) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
    glancingResidualOp B (fun p => U_star p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0)

def CollarExactSliceProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_slice : ℝ) (B_slice : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_slice ∧
    ∀ (s d δ η_mesh : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (X_mesh : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < η_mesh → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < d - 2 * δ →
      StationaryComplexMeshAt B s δ η_mesh l q U X_mesh →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      C_slice * Q ^ B_slice * η_mesh ≤ 1 →
      ∃ U_star : ℂ → ℂ,
        ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ (C_slice * Q ^ B_slice * η_mesh) l q U U_star

def CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp : Prop :=
  ((∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ V W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => V (y', p.2)) p.1) W) →
    ∀ (σ σ' t₀ r_t M_V : ℝ) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ' → 0 < r_t → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → 0 ≤ M_V →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
        V (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = V (y, t) ∧ ‖V (y, t)‖ ≤ M_V) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingDiffOp V)
        (horizStrip σ' ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ', ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
        glancingDiffOp V (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingDiffOp V (y, t) ∧
        ‖glancingDiffOp V (y, t)‖ ≤ 4 * (σ - σ')⁻¹ * M_V)) ∧
  (∀ (σ σ' t_c r_t : ℝ) (V₁ V₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ' → 0 < r_t → σ' + r_t ≤ σ →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t, V₂ (y, t) = V₁ (y, -t)) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ', ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t_c : ℂ) r_t,
      glancingDiffOp V₂ (y, t) = glancingDiffOp V₁ (y, -t)) ∧
  (∀ (σ t₀ M_dot : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (a_star E_dot g_init : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 < t₀ → 0 ≤ M_dot → 1 ≤ l → 1 ≤ q →
    (q : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) →
    (∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
        glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1 + f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
          glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₁ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) +
            glancingDiffOp (fun p => f₂ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) ∧
    (DifferentiableOn ℂ a_star (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ E_dot (horizStrip σ) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ g_init (horizStrip σ) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, a_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = a_star y ∧ ‖4 * a_star y - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot (y + 2 * Real.pi) = E_dot y ∧ ‖E_dot y‖ ≤ M_dot) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, g_init (y + 2 * Real.pi) = g_init y) →
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, E_dot y = glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_init p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))) →
     ∃ z : ℂ → ℂ,
       DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip σ) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖z y‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot) ∧
       (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
         glancingDiffOp
           (fun p => a_star p.1 * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))
           (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = -E_dot y)))

def PositiveRationalJetAt {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (s δ M_lin M_quad t₀ : ℝ) (U W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
    (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
  (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
    W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t)) ∧
  (let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
   DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
     (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
     g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
     ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin ∧
     ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ M_lin) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
   DifferentiableOn ℂ
     (fun y : ℂ =>
       deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ))
     (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
   (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
     ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤ M_quad ∧
     ‖deriv
         (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
         (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_quad))

def PositiveJetLiftProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∃ (C_lift : ℝ) (B_lift : ℕ), 1 ≤ C_lift ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 0 ≤ η_slice → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l q →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
      ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      let η_tot := ε + η_slice
      C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ≤ 1 →
      ∃ W_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        PositiveRationalJetAt B s δ
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot)
          (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot ^ 2)
          t₀ U W_plus

buffered_sinc_fourier_division.definitions:
noncomputable def divRoot_bfd (n j : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)

noncomputable def activeRootIdx_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : Finset ℤ :=
  (Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ)).filter
    (fun j : ℤ => j ≠ 0 ∧ |divRoot_bfd n j| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ)

noncomputable def sincInterp1D_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j ∈ activeRootIdx_bfd d δ b N n,
    f ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * (t - ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)) / 2)

open Classical in
noncomputable def divMode1D_bfd (d δ : ℝ) (b N : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => f z - sincInterp1D_bfd d δ b N n f z
  if fourierDiffMult n t = 0 then deriv G t / deriv (fourierDiffMult n) t
  else G t / fourierDiffMult n t

def StripFourierAndDiffMultProp_bfd : Prop :=
  (∀ (σ M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z ∧ ‖G z‖ ≤ M) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * σ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
      HasSum
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * y))
        (G y))) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    |t.im| / 2 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : ℂ => G (y, t)) (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, G (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = G (y, t)) →
    ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (glancingDiffOp G) n t = fourierDiffMult n t * fourierCoeff_ℂ G n t)

def SincDivisorCalculusProp_bfd : Prop :=
  Differentiable ℂ sinc_ℂ ∧
  sinc_ℂ 0 = 1 ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (-z) = sinc_ℂ z) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, sinc_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (sinc_ℂ z)) ∧
  (∀ z : ℂ, ‖sinc_ℂ z‖ ≤ Real.exp |z.im| ∧ ‖deriv sinc_ℂ z‖ ≤ Real.exp |z.im|) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ),
    (∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (μ : ℂ) * t)) = sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → sinc_ℂ ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (j : ℂ)) = 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℤ,
    Differentiable ℂ (fourierDiffMult n) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult n (-t) = fourierDiffMult n t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult (-n) (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (fourierDiffMult n t))) ∧
  (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 →
    (∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult n t = 0 ↔ ∃ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 ∧ t = ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → deriv (fourierDiffMult n) ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0)) ∧
  (∀ (n : ℤ) (δ : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    1 ≤ |n| → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 100 → ‖t‖ < 1 →
    (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min |(n : ℝ)|⁻¹ δ ≤ ‖t - ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)‖) →
    fourierDiffMult n t ≠ 0 ∧
    ‖fourierDiffMult n t‖⁻¹ ≤ 36 * δ⁻¹ * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * |t.im| / 2))

def SingleModeSincDivProp_bfd : Prop :=
  ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b : ℕ) (n : ℤ),
    0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
    (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
    j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → b ≤ 20 →
    0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
    1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
    (∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ),
        ‖f t‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ - ν * |t.im|))) →
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 → |divRoot_bfd n j| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖f ((divRoot_bfd n j : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      let R_n := sincInterp1D_bfd d δ b N n f
      let H_n := divMode1D_bfd d δ b N n f
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      Differentiable ℂ R_n ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ H_n (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
      (∀ t : ℂ,
        ‖R_n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv R_n t‖ ≤
          3 * Q * η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2))) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
        fourierDiffMult n t * H_n t = f t - R_n t ∧
        ‖H_n t‖ ≤
          324 * Q ^ 2 * (M + η) *
            Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - (ν - 1 / 2) * |t.im|))) ∧
      ((∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ), f (-t) = f t) →
        ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ), H_n (-t) = H_n t)) ∧
    (∀ (f_pos f_neg : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f_pos (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f_neg (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ),
        f_neg (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (f_pos t)) →
      ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
        divMode1D_bfd d δ b N (-n) f_neg (starRingEnd ℂ t) =
          starRingEnd ℂ (divMode1D_bfd d δ b N n f_pos t))

def BufferedFourierDivMainProp_bfd : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_div : ℝ) (B_div : ℕ), 0 < C_div ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b J : ℕ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
      (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
      j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → max a (b + 1) + 1 ≤ J → J ≤ 20 →
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) →
        F (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (y, -t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (F (y, t)) ∧
        ‖F (y, t)‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ),
        1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
        |(2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ F n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      ∃ (H_mode R_mode : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, n = 0 ∨ (N : ℤ) < |n| → ∀ t : ℂ, H_mode n t = 0 ∧ R_mode n t = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_mode n)
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
          Differentiable ℂ (R_mode n) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
            fourierDiffMult n t * H_mode n t = fourierCoeff_ℂ F n t - R_mode n t ∧
            ‖R_mode n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv (R_mode n) t‖ ≤
              C_div * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_div * η *
                Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2)))) ∧
        (let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun p =>
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              H_mode n p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * p.1)
         let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
         DifferentiableOn ℂ H
           (glancingDomain 0 (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ →
           H (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (y, -t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (H (y, t)) ∧
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain (ν - 1 / 2) (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖H p‖ ≤ C_div * Q ^ B_div * (M + η)) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖glancingDiffOp H p - F p‖ ≤
             C_div * Q ^ B_div * (η + M * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ))))

by

    have heq_loc : (fun y' : ℂ => G (y' + 2 * Real.pi, t)) =ᶠ[nhds (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)]

  have h_param_deriv : ∀ {σ : ℝ} {W_t : Set ℂ} {Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {t_pt : ℂ},

    have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall t_pt r₂ ⊆ W_t :=

    let K_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=

    have hK_comp : IsCompact K_box :=

    have hK_sub : K_box ⊆ U_prod := by

      refine ⟨?_, h_cb_sub ht⟩
      show |(x : ℂ).im| < σ
      simpa using hσ
    obtain ⟨B_dom, hB_dom⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦ_t_cont.mono hK_sub)
    have h_real_mem : ∀ (x : ℝ) {t : ℂ}, t ∈ W_t → ((x : ℂ), t) ∈ U_prod := by

    have h_cont_x : ∀ {t : ℂ}, t ∈ W_t → Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Φ ((x : ℂ), t)) := by

    have h_cont_xt : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Φ_t ((x : ℂ), t_pt)) :=

        (fun t ht => (h_cont_x ht).aestronglyMeasurable))

      h_cont_xt.aestronglyMeasurable

        exact (hB_dom ((x : ℂ), t) ⟨⟨x, hx_icc, rfl⟩, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall ht⟩).trans

            (fun w hw => h_real_mem x hw)

  have h_sinc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * sinc_ℂ z = Complex.sin z := by
    intro z
    simp only [sinc_ℂ, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have h_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => Complex.sin ((τ' : ℂ) * z))
          (z * Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)) τ := by
      intro τ _
      have hw0 := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin ((τ : ℂ) * z)).comp (τ : ℂ)
        ((hasDerivAt_id (τ : ℂ)).mul_const z)
      have hw : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Complex.sin (w * z))
          (z * Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)) (τ : ℂ) := by
        convert hw0 using 1
        · ext w; simp [mul_comm]
        · ring
      exact hw.comp_ofReal
    have h_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => z * Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z))
        MeasureTheory.volume (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ) :=
      (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_cos.comp
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable _ _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv h_int]
    simp
  have h_mult_mul : ∀ (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ),
      t * fourierDiffMult n t = 2 * Complex.I * Complex.sin ((n : ℂ) * t / 2) := by
    intro n t
    calc t * fourierDiffMult n t
        = 2 * Complex.I * (((n : ℂ) * t / 2) * sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)) := by
          simp only [fourierDiffMult]; ring
      _ = 2 * Complex.I * Complex.sin ((n : ℂ) * t / 2) := by rw [h_sinc_mul]
  have h_mult_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, fourierDiffMult 0 t = 0 := by
    intro t; simp [fourierDiffMult]
  have h_mult_root : ∀ (n j : ℤ), n ≠ 0 → j ≠ 0 →
      fourierDiffMult n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
    intro n j hn hj
    set t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)
    have hn_R : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
    have hj_R : (j : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hj
    have ht₀_ne : (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
      (div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by positivity) hj_R) hn_R)
    have h_arg : (n : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = (j : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      push_cast [t₀]
      have hn_C : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
      field_simp [hn_C]
    have h_prod := h_mult_mul n (t₀ : ℂ)
    rw [h_arg, Complex.sin_int_mul_pi, mul_zero] at h_prod
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_prod).resolve_left ht₀_ne
  have h_frac_red : ∀ (N : ℕ) (n j : ℤ), 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (l : ℤ) (q : ℕ), l ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ N ∧ Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q ∧
        (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) = (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) := by
    intro N n j hn1 hnN hj
    have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := by intro h0; subst h0; norm_num at hn1
    have hn_pos : 0 < n.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hn_ne
    let g : ℕ := Nat.gcd j.natAbs n.natAbs
    have hg_pos : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hn_pos
    let j' : ℤ := if 0 ≤ n then j else -j
    let l : ℤ := j' / (g : ℤ)
    let q : ℕ := n.natAbs / g
    have hj'_ne : j' ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp [j']; split_ifs <;> simp [hj]
    have hj'_abs : j'.natAbs = j.natAbs := by
      dsimp [j']; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hg_dvd_j' : (g : ℤ) ∣ j' := by
      rw [Int.natCast_dvd, hj'_abs]
      exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
    have hl_mul : l * (g : ℤ) = j' := Int.ediv_mul_cancel hg_dvd_j'
    have hl_ne : l ≠ 0 := by
      intro hl0; rw [hl0, zero_mul] at hl_mul; exact hj'_ne hl_mul.symm
    have hl_abs : l.natAbs = j.natAbs / g := by
      have h1 : l.natAbs * g = j.natAbs := by
        calc l.natAbs * g = (l * (g : ℤ)).natAbs := by rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast]
          _ = j'.natAbs := by rw [hl_mul]
          _ = j.natAbs := hj'_abs
      exact Nat.eq_div_of_mul_eq_left (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hg_pos) h1
    have hq_mul : q * g = n.natAbs := Nat.div_mul_cancel (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with hq0 | hq_pos
      · exfalso; rw [hq0, zero_mul] at hq_mul; omega
      · exact hq_pos
    have hqN : q ≤ N := by
      have hle1 : q ≤ n.natAbs := Nat.div_le_self _ _
      have hle2 : n.natAbs ≤ N := by
        rw [Int.abs_eq_natAbs] at hnN
        exact_mod_cast hnN
      exact hle1.trans hle2
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q := by
      rw [hl_abs]
      exact Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hg_pos
    refine ⟨l, q, hl_ne, hq1, hqN, hcop, ?_⟩
    have hg_R : (g : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hg_pos)
    have hq_R : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
    have hl_R : (j' : ℝ) = (l : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl_mul.symm
    have hqn_R : ((n.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq_mul.symm
    have hn_z : (if 0 ≤ n then n else -n) = (n.natAbs : ℤ) := by
      rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with h | h <;> split_ifs <;> omega
    have hn_z_R : ((if 0 ≤ n then n else -n : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((n.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congr_arg ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ) hn_z
    dsimp [j'] at hl_R
    split_ifs at hl_R hn_z_R with hn_nonneg
    · push_cast at hl_R hn_z_R
      rw [hl_R, hn_z_R, hqn_R]
      field_simp [hq_R, hg_R]
    · push_cast at hl_R hn_z_R
      have hj_R_eq : (j : ℝ) = -(l : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hn_R_eq : (n : ℝ) = -(q : ℝ) * (g : ℝ) := by linarith
      rw [hj_R_eq, hn_R_eq]
      field_simp [hq_R, hg_R]
  have h_dioph : ∀ (l m : ℤ) (q : ℕ), l ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q →
      1 ≤ |m| → ¬ ((q : ℤ) ∣ m) →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      fourierDiffMult m (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧
        ‖(fourierDiffMult m (t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹‖ ≤ ((q : ℝ) * |t₀|) / 4 := by
    intro l m q hl hq hcop hm1 hqm
    dsimp only
    set t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
    have hq_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by positivity) (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hl))
      (ne_of_gt hq_pos_R)
    have ht₀_abs_pos : 0 < |t₀| := abs_pos.mpr ht₀_ne
    let a : ℤ := m * l
    have hq_ndvd_a : ¬ ((q : ℤ) ∣ a) := by
      intro hdvd
      rw [Int.natCast_dvd, Int.natAbs_mul] at hdvd
      have hdvd_m : q ∣ m.natAbs := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdvd
      exact hqm (Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hdvd_m)
    let r₀ : ℤ := a % (q : ℤ)
    let k₀ : ℤ := a / (q : ℤ)
    have hr₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ r₀ := Int.emod_nonneg a (by omega)
    have hr₀_lt : r₀ < (q : ℤ) := Int.emod_lt_of_pos a (by omega)
    have ha_eq : (q : ℤ) * k₀ + r₀ = a := Int.mul_ediv_add_emod a (q : ℤ)
    have hr₀_ne : r₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hr0
      apply hq_ndvd_a
      refine ⟨k₀, ?_⟩
      linarith
    let k_near : ℤ := if 2 * r₀ ≤ (q : ℤ) then k₀ else k₀ + 1
    let d_rem : ℤ := a - (q : ℤ) * k_near
    have hd_bounds : 1 ≤ |d_rem| ∧ 2 * |d_rem| ≤ (q : ℤ) := by
      dsimp [d_rem, k_near]

      have h_den_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ I_den (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - 11 * δ)) := by

    have h_shift_bound : ∀ {t : ℂ}, ‖t‖ < d - 11 * δ → ‖meanShift U h t‖ ≤ 3 * M_h := by

    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(ha_inv_pt p hp).1, (ha_inv_pt p hp).2.1, (ha_inv_pt p hp).2.2.1⟩,

    · intro y t hyt
      have hyt_11 : (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) (s - 11 * δ) (d - 11 * δ) :=

    · intro t ht

  have h_fc_add : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {t : ℂ} (n : ℤ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F₁ ((x : ℂ), t)) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F₂ ((x : ℂ), t)) →
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => F₁ p + F₂ p) n t =
        fourierCoeff_ℂ F₁ n t + fourierCoeff_ℂ F₂ n t := by
    intro F₁ F₂ t n h1 h2
    let e_n : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))
    have he : Continuous e_n :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)
    simp only [fourierCoeff_ℂ]
    have h_pt : (fun x : ℝ => e_n x * (F₁ ((x : ℂ), t) + F₂ ((x : ℂ), t))) =
        (fun x : ℝ => e_n x * F₁ ((x : ℂ), t) + e_n x * F₂ ((x : ℂ), t)) := by
      ext x; ring
    have h1_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => e_n x * F₁ ((x : ℂ), t))
        MeasureTheory.volume (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := (he.mul h1).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have h2_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => e_n x * F₂ ((x : ℂ), t))
        MeasureTheory.volume (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := (he.mul h2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have h_int_eq := intervalIntegral.integral_add h1_int h2_int
    change ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), e_n x * (F₁ ((x : ℂ), t) + F₂ ((x : ℂ), t))) = _
    rw [h_pt, h_int_eq, mul_add]
  have h_fc_sub : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {t : ℂ} (n : ℤ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F₁ ((x : ℂ), t)) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F₂ ((x : ℂ), t)) →
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => F₁ p - F₂ p) n t =
        fourierCoeff_ℂ F₁ n t - fourierCoeff_ℂ F₂ n t := by
    intro F₁ F₂ t n h1 h2
    have h_eq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F₁ p - F₂ p) = (fun p => F₁ p + (-F₂ p)) := by
      ext p; ring
    have h_neg : fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => -F₂ p) n t = -fourierCoeff_ℂ F₂ n t := by
      simp [fourierCoeff_ℂ, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    rw [h_eq, h_fc_add n h1 h2.neg, h_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h_fc_deriv : ∀ {σ : ℝ} {W_t : Set ℂ} {Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {t_pt : ℂ} (m : ℤ),
      0 < σ → IsOpen W_t → t_pt ∈ W_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (horizStrip σ ×ˢ W_t) →
      HasDerivAt (fourierCoeff_ℂ Φ m)
        (fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => deriv (fun w : ℂ => Φ (p.1, w)) t_pt) m 0) t_pt := by
    intro σ W_t Φ t_pt m hσ hW_open ht_pt hΦ_holo
    let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (m : ℂ) * p.1) * Φ p
    have hΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (horizStrip σ ×ˢ W_t) :=
      (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp
        ((differentiable_const _).mul differentiable_fst)).differentiableOn.mul hΦ_holo
    have h_int_d := (h_param_deriv hσ hW_open ht_pt hΨ_holo).const_mul (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
    have h_rhs_eq : ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), deriv (fun w : ℂ => Ψ ((x : ℂ), w)) t_pt) =
        fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => deriv (fun w : ℂ => Φ (p.1, w)) t_pt) m 0 := by
      simp only [fourierCoeff_ℂ, Ψ]
      congr 1
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      have h_slice_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => Φ ((x : ℂ), w)) t_pt :=
        (hΦ_holo.comp (differentiableOn_const (x : ℂ) |>.prodMk differentiableOn_id)

          (hW_open.mem_nhds ht_pt)
      exact deriv_const_mul _ h_slice_diff
    rw [h_rhs_eq] at h_int_d
    exact h_int_d
  have h_cauchy_iter : ∀ {z₀ : ℂ} {R C_b : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} (k : ℕ),
      0 < R → 0 ≤ C_b →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * R)) →
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * R), ‖f w‖ ≤ C_b) →
      ‖iteratedDeriv k f z₀‖ ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) * C_b / R ^ k := by
    intro z₀ R C_b f k hR hCb hf_holo hf_bound
    have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * R) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have h_cl_sub : closure (Metric.ball z₀ R) ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * R) := by
      rw [closure_ball z₀ (ne_of_gt hR)]
      exact h_cb_sub
    have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball z₀ R) :=
      ⟨hf_holo.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)),
        hf_holo.continuousOn.mono h_cl_sub⟩
    exact Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le k hR h_dc
      (fun w hw => hf_bound w (h_cb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)))

      have h_mu_mem_St : ∀ μ ∈ Set.uIcc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ), y + (μ : ℂ) * t ∈ S_t := by
        intro μ hμ
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)] at hμ
        have hμ_abs : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hμ.1], hμ.2⟩
        exact h_mu_in_St μ hμ_abs (y + (μ : ℂ) * t) (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos)
      have h_path : Continuous (fun μ : ℝ => (y + (μ : ℂ) * t, (0 : ℂ))) :=
        (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).prodMk
          continuous_const
      have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun μ : ℝ => deriv (fun z : ℂ => G₁ (z, t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))
          MeasureTheory.volume (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        (hG₁_y_holo.continuousOn.comp h_path.continuousOn
          (fun μ hμ => ⟨h_mu_mem_St μ hμ, trivial⟩)).intervalIntegrable
      have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun μ : ℝ => deriv (fun z : ℂ => h (z, t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))
          MeasureTheory.volume (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        (hh_y_holo.continuousOn.comp h_path.continuousOn
          (fun μ hμ => ⟨h_mu_mem_St μ hμ, trivial⟩)).intervalIntegrable
      have h_sub_int : glancingDiffOp G₁ (y, t) - glancingDiffOp h (y, t) =
          ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ), deriv f_err (y + (μ : ℂ) * t) := by
        simp only [glancingDiffOp]
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int2]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun μ hμ => ?_
        let z_μ := y + (μ : ℂ) * t
        have hz_St : z_μ ∈ S_t := h_mu_mem_St μ hμ
        have h_ev : f_err =ᶠ[nhds z_μ]
            fun z : ℂ => G₁ (z, t) - h (z, t) - meanShift U h t := by
          filter_upwards [(h_open_strip _).mem_nhds hz_St] with z hz
          exact hf_err_eq z hz
        have hG₁_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => G₁ (z, t)) z_μ :=
          hG₁_holo.differentiableAt ((h_open_strip _).mem_nhds hz_St)
        have hh_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => h (z, t)) z_μ :=
          hh_slice_holo.differentiableAt ((h_open_strip _).mem_nhds hz_St)
        rw [h_ev.deriv_eq, deriv_sub_const]
        exact (hG₁_at.hasDerivAt.sub hh_at.hasDerivAt).deriv.symm
      rw [h_sub_int]
      have h_int_norm : ‖∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ), deriv f_err (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)‖ ≤
          (2 * C_v * Q ^ (B_v + 1) * ε ^ 2) * |(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (-1 / 2 : ℝ)| :=
        intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const fun μ hμ => by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)] at hμ
          have hμ_abs : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hμ.1], hμ.2⟩
          let z_μ := y + (μ : ℂ) * t
          have h2 : 2 * (δ / 2) = δ := by ring
          have h_c1 := h_cauchy_iter (z₀ := z_μ) (R := δ / 2) (C_b := C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2)
            1 (half_pos hδ_pos) (by positivity)
            (by rw [h2]; exact hf_err_holo.mono (h_mu_in_St μ hμ_abs))
            (fun w hw => hf_err_bound w (h_mu_in_St μ hμ_abs w (by rwa [h2] at hw)))
          rw [iteratedDeriv_one, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, pow_one] at h_c1
          have h_d_le : δ⁻¹ ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q]; linarith
          calc ‖deriv f_err z_μ‖ ≤ C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 / (δ / 2) := h_c1
            _ = 2 * C_v * δ⁻¹ * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by ring
            _ ≤ 2 * C_v * Q * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by gcongr
            _ = 2 * C_v * Q ^ (B_v + 1) * ε ^ 2 := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      have h_len : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (-1 / 2 : ℝ)| = 1 := by norm_num
      rw [h_len, mul_one] at h_int_norm
      exact h_int_norm
    
    have h_trans_bound :
        ‖deriv (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (z, t) * v (z, t)) y‖ ≤
          2 * C_v * Q ^ (B_v + 1) * ε ^ 2 := by
      obtain ⟨hE_holo, _, _, _⟩ :=
        S.E_op_props s d U hs_pos hs_le hd_pos hd_le hd_lt hU_adm_full
      let f_trans : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => glancingResidualOp B U (z, t) * v (z, t)
      have h_ball_mem : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y δ,
          (w, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d ∧ (w, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 (s - 17 * δ) (d - 17 * δ) := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_dist : ‖w - y‖ < δ := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
        have hw_im : |(w - y).im| ≤ ‖w - y‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        have hw_split : w.im = y.im + (w - y).im := by simp
        have hw_abs := abs_add_le y.im (w - y).im
        have ht_im_nonneg := abs_nonneg t.im
        refine ⟨⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith), ?_⟩, ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith), ?_⟩⟩
        · show |w.im| < s - 1 * |t.im|; rw [hw_split]; linarith
        · show |w.im| < s - 17 * δ - 0 * |t.im|; rw [hw_split]; linarith
      have h2 : 2 * (δ / 2) = δ := by ring
      have hf_trans_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_trans (Metric.ball y (2 * (δ / 2))) := by
        rw [h2]
        exact (hE_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const t))
          (fun w hw => (h_ball_mem w hw).1)).mul
          (hv_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const t))
            (fun w hw => h_dom_mono le_rfl le_rfl (by linarith) (h_ball_mem w hw).2))
      have hf_trans_le : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y (2 * (δ / 2)),
          ‖f_trans w‖ ≤ C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [h2] at hw
        obtain ⟨hw1, hw17⟩ := h_ball_mem w hw
        dsimp [f_trans]
        rw [norm_mul]
        calc ‖glancingResidualOp B U (w, t)‖ * ‖v (w, t)‖
            ≤ ε * (C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε) :=
              mul_le_mul (hE_le (w, t) hw1) (hv_norm (w, t) hw17) (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hε_pos)
          _ = C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_c1 := h_cauchy_iter (z₀ := y) (R := δ / 2) (C_b := C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2)
        1 (half_pos hδ_pos) (by positivity) hf_trans_holo hf_trans_le
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, pow_one] at h_c1
      have h_d_le : δ⁻¹ ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q]; linarith
      calc ‖deriv f_trans y‖ ≤ C_v * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 / (δ / 2) := h_c1
        _ = 2 * C_v * δ⁻¹ * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * C_v * Q * Q ^ B_v * ε ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * C_v * Q ^ (B_v + 1) * ε ^ 2 := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    
    let ρ : ℝ := C_ΔU * Q ^ B_ΔU * ε
    have hρ_le_small : ρ ≤ S.η_adm / 8 := by
      have hC_le : C_ΔU ≤ C_step := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      have hQ_le : Q ^ B_ΔU ≤ Q ^ B₀ := pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ_ge_one (by dsimp [B₀]; omega)
      calc C_ΔU * Q ^ B_ΔU * ε ≤ C_step * Q ^ B₀ * ε := by gcongr
        _ ≤ c_small := h_step_small
        _ = S.η_adm / 8 := rfl
    have hu_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => U (z, t)) (horizStrip (s - 18 * δ)) :=
      hU_adm.1.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const t)) (fun z hz => by
        have hz_im : |z.im| < s - 18 * δ := hz
        refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith), ?_⟩
        show |z.im| < s - 0 * |t.im|; linarith)
    have hv_slice_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => v (z, t)) (horizStrip (s - 18 * δ)) :=
      hv_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const t)) (fun z hz => by
        have hz_im : |z.im| < s - 18 * δ := hz
        refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith), ?_⟩
        show |z.im| < s - 17 * δ - 0 * |t.im|; linarith)
    have h_quad := S.slice_quad_approx (s - 18 * δ) ρ y t
      (fun z => U (z, t)) (fun z => v (z, t))
      (by linarith) (by linarith) (lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith)) (by linarith)
      (by positivity) hρ_le_small hu_holo hv_slice_holo
      (fun k hk z hz => by
        have hz_im : |z.im| < s - 18 * δ := hz
        exact hU_adm_full.2.2.2.2 k (by omega) z t
          ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith), by show |z.im| < s - 0 * |t.im|; linarith⟩)
      (fun k hk z hz => hΔU_c3 k (by omega) z t hz (lt_of_lt_of_le ht20 (by linarith)))
    
    have h_quad_2D :
        ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U q + ΔU q) (y, t) -
          glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) -
          (glancingDiffOp (fun q => a_U (q.1, t) * glancingDiffOp v (q.1, t)) (y, t) +
            deriv (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (z, t) * v (z, t)) y)‖ ≤
          S.C_quad * ρ ^ 2 := h_quad
    
    have hp11 : (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 (s - 11 * δ) (d - 11 * δ) :=
      h_dom_mono le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith) hp20
    have h_h_res := hh_res (y, t) hp11
    let T₁ := glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U q + ΔU q) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp (fun q => a_U (q.1, t) * glancingDiffOp v (q.1, t)) (y, t) +
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (z, t) * v (z, t)) y)
    let T₂ := glancingDiffOp (fun q => a_U (q.1, t) * glancingDiffOp v (q.1, t)) (y, t) -
      glancingDiffOp h (y, t)
    let T₃ := deriv (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (z, t) * v (z, t)) y
    let T₄ := glancingDiffOp h (y, t) + glancingResidualOp B U (y, t)
    have h_sum_4 : glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U q + ΔU q) (y, t) =
        T₁ + T₂ + T₃ + T₄ := by
      dsimp [T₁, T₂, T₃, T₄]; ring
    have hQ_mid : Q ^ B_mid ≤ Q ^ B₀ :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ_ge_one (by dsimp [B₀, B_ΔU, B_v]; omega)
    have hQ_v1 : Q ^ (B_v + 1) ≤ Q ^ B₀ :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ_ge_one (by dsimp [B₀, B_ΔU]; omega)
    have h_quad_B0 : S.C_quad * ρ ^ 2 = S.C_quad * C_ΔU ^ 2 * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [ρ, B₀]
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm B_ΔU 2]
      ring
    have hC_final_le : C_final ≤ C_step := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    rw [h_sum_4]
    calc ‖T₁ + T₂ + T₃ + T₄‖
        ≤ ‖T₁ + T₂ + T₃‖ + ‖T₄‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T₁ + T₂‖ + ‖T₃‖ + ‖T₄‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖T₁‖ + ‖T₂‖ + ‖T₃‖ + ‖T₄‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ S.C_quad * C_ΔU ^ 2 * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 +
            2 * C_v * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 +
            2 * C_v * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 +
            C_mid * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 := by
          gcongr
          · rw [← h_quad_B0]; exact h_quad_2D
          · exact h_diff_lin_bound.trans (by gcongr)
          · exact h_trans_bound.trans (by gcongr)
          · exact h_h_res.trans (by gcongr)
      _ = C_final * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 := by dsimp [C_final]; ring
      _ ≤ C_step * Q ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2 := by gcongr
