proof.tactics:
by
  
  have deriv_per_plane : ∀ (g : ℝ → Plane) (P : ℝ),
      Differentiable ℝ g → Function.Periodic g P → Function.Periodic (deriv g) P := by
    intro g P hg hper t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (y + P)) (deriv g (t + P)) t := by
      convert (hg (t + P)).hasDerivAt.scomp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const P) using 1 <;>
        simp [Function.comp_def]
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (y + P)) (deriv g t) t := by
      have heq : (fun y => g (y + P)) = g := funext hper
      rw [heq]
      exact (hg t).hasDerivAt
    exact h1.unique h2
  have deriv_per_real : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (P : ℝ),
      Differentiable ℝ g → Function.Periodic g P → Function.Periodic (deriv g) P := by
    intro g P hg hper t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (y + P)) (deriv g (t + P)) t := by
      convert (hg (t + P)).hasDerivAt.comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const P) using 1 <;>
        simp [Function.comp_def]
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => g (y + P)) (deriv g t) t := by
      have heq : (fun y => g (y + P)) = g := funext hper
      rw [heq]
      exact (hg t).hasDerivAt
    exact h1.unique h2
  have smooth_primitive : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (y₀ a : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ w →
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => y₀ + a * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..t, w η
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (a * w t) t := by
    intro w y₀ a hw
    dsimp only
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => y₀ + a * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..t, w η
    have hw_cont : Continuous w := hw.continuous
    have hF_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (a * w t) t := by
      intro t
      have hint : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..u, w η) (w t) t :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
          (hw_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
          (hw_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds t))
          hw_cont.continuousAt
      exact (hint.const_mul a).const_add y₀
    have hF_diff : Differentiable ℝ F := fun t => (hF_deriv t).differentiableAt
    have hderiv_eq : deriv F = fun t => a * w t := funext fun t => (hF_deriv t).deriv
    have hderiv_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv F) := by
      rw [hderiv_eq]
      exact contDiff_const.mul hw
    have hF_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F := by
      rw [contDiff_infty]
      intro m
      have hm1 : ContDiff ℝ ((m : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) F := by
        rw [contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        exact ⟨hF_diff, by simp, hderiv_smooth.of_le (by simp)⟩
      exact hm1.of_le (by simp)
    exact ⟨hF_smooth, hF_deriv⟩
  have smooth_quasiperiodic_inv : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (T₁ T₂ : ℝ),
      0 < T₁ → 0 < T₂ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < f' x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f (x + T₁) = f x + T₂) →
      ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ,
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, g (f x) = x) ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, f (g y) = y) ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (f' (g y))⁻¹ y) ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, g (y + T₂) = g y + T₁) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * T₁) = f x + (k : ℝ) * T₂) := by
    intro f f' T₁ T₂ hT₁ hT₂ hf_smooth hf_deriv hf'_pos hf_qp
    have hf_deriv_eq : deriv f = f' := funext fun x => (hf_deriv x).deriv
    have hf_mono : StrictMono f := strictMono_of_deriv_pos (by rw [hf_deriv_eq]; exact hf'_pos)
    have hf_shift_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (n : ℝ) * T₁) = f x + (n : ℝ) * T₂ := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro x; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro x
        have heq : x + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * T₁ = (x + (n : ℝ) * T₁) + T₁ := by push_cast; ring
        rw [heq, hf_qp, ih x]
        push_cast; ring
    have hf_shift_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ), f (x + (k : ℝ) * T₁) = f x + (k : ℝ) * T₂ := by
      intro k x
      rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
      · simpa using hf_shift_nat n x
      · have h1 := hf_shift_nat n (x - (n : ℝ) * T₁)
        have h2 : (x - (n : ℝ) * T₁) + (n : ℝ) * T₁ = x := by ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        have h3 : x + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * T₁ = x - (n : ℝ) * T₁ := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h3]
        push_cast
        linarith
    have hf_surj : Function.Surjective f := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|y - f 0| / T₂)
      have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
      have hNT₂ : |y - f 0| < (N : ℝ) * T₂ := (div_lt_iff₀ hT₂).mp hN
      let a : ℝ := -((N : ℝ) * T₁)
      let b : ℝ := (N : ℝ) * T₁
      have hab : a ≤ b := by dsimp [a, b]; nlinarith
      have hlow : f a ≤ y := by
        have hsub := hf_shift_int (-(N : ℤ)) 0
        have ha_eq : (0 : ℝ) + ((-(N : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * T₁ = a := by dsimp [a]; push_cast; ring
        rw [ha_eq] at hsub
        push_cast at hsub
        linarith [neg_abs_le (y - f 0)]
      have hhigh : y ≤ f b := by
        have hadd := hf_shift_nat N 0
        have hb_eq : (0 : ℝ) + (N : ℝ) * T₁ = b := by dsimp [b]; ring
        rw [hb_eq] at hadd
        linarith [le_abs_self (y - f 0)]
      obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf_smooth.continuous.continuousOn ⟨hlow, hhigh⟩
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    let f_iso : ℝ ≃o ℝ := StrictMono.orderIsoOfSurjective f hf_mono hf_surj
    let f_homeo : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ := f_iso.toHomeomorph
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := f_homeo.symm
    have hg_left : ∀ x : ℝ, g (f x) = x := fun x => f_iso.symm_apply_apply x
    have hg_right : ∀ y : ℝ, f (g y) = y := fun y => f_iso.apply_symm_apply y
    have hg_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g :=
      f_homeo.contDiff_symm_deriv (fun x => ne_of_gt (hf'_pos x)) hf_deriv hf_smooth
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (f' (g y))⁻¹ y := by
      intro y
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun z => f (g z)) (f' (g y) * deriv g y) y :=
        (hf_deriv (g y)).comp y (hg_diff y).hasDerivAt
      have hid : HasDerivAt (fun z => f (g z)) 1 y := by
        have heq : (fun z => f (g z)) = id := funext hg_right
        rw [heq]
        exact hasDerivAt_id y
      have hmul : f' (g y) * deriv g y = 1 := hcomp.unique hid
      have h_eq : deriv g y = (f' (g y))⁻¹ := by
        have hne : f' (g y) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hf'_pos (g y))
        exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact (hg_diff y).hasDerivAt
    have hg_qp : ∀ y : ℝ, g (y + T₂) = g y + T₁ := by
      intro y
      apply hf_mono.injective
      rw [hg_right, hf_qp, hg_right]
    exact ⟨g, hg_smooth, hg_left, hg_right, hg_deriv, hg_qp, hf_shift_int⟩

  
  have plane_inner : ∀ x y : Plane, inner ℝ x y = x 0 * y 0 + x 1 * y 1 := by
    intro x y
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have plane_norm_sq : ∀ x : Plane, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (x 0) ^ 2 + (x 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp
  let e₀ : Plane := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
  let e₁ : Plane := EuclideanSpace.single 1 1
  have hn_eq : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, unitNormalVec ϑ = Real.cos ϑ • e₀ + Real.sin ϑ • e₁ := by
    intro ϑ
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [unitNormalVec, e₀, e₁]
  have he_eq : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, unitTangentVec ϑ = (-Real.sin ϑ) • e₀ + Real.cos ϑ • e₁ := by
    intro ϑ
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [unitTangentVec, e₀, e₁]
  have hn_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ unitNormalVec := by
    have heq : unitNormalVec = fun ϑ => Real.cos ϑ • e₀ + Real.sin ϑ • e₁ := funext hn_eq
    rw [heq]
    exact (Real.contDiff_cos.smul contDiff_const).add (Real.contDiff_sin.smul contDiff_const)
  have hn_deriv : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, HasDerivAt unitNormalVec (unitTangentVec ϑ) ϑ := by
    intro ϑ
    have heq : unitNormalVec = fun u => Real.cos u • e₀ + Real.sin u • e₁ := funext hn_eq
    rw [heq, he_eq ϑ]
    exact ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos ϑ).smul_const e₀).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin ϑ).smul_const e₁)
  have he_deriv : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, HasDerivAt unitTangentVec (-unitNormalVec ϑ) ϑ := by
    intro ϑ
    have heq : unitTangentVec = fun u => (-Real.sin u) • e₀ + Real.cos u • e₁ := funext he_eq
    rw [heq]
    have hneg : -unitNormalVec ϑ = (-Real.cos ϑ) • e₀ + (-Real.sin ϑ) • e₁ := by
      rw [hn_eq ϑ]; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e₀, e₁]
    rw [hneg]
    exact (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin ϑ).neg).smul_const e₀).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos ϑ).smul_const e₁)
  have hn_norm : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, ‖unitNormalVec ϑ‖ = 1 := by
    intro ϑ
    have hsq : ‖unitNormalVec ϑ‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [plane_norm_sq]
      simp [unitNormalVec, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (unitNormalVec ϑ)]
  have hn_self : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitNormalVec ϑ) (unitNormalVec ϑ) = 1 := by
    intro ϑ
    rw [plane_inner]
    simp [unitNormalVec]
    nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ϑ]
  have he_self : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitTangentVec ϑ) (unitTangentVec ϑ) = 1 := by
    intro ϑ
    rw [plane_inner]
    simp [unitTangentVec]
    nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ϑ]
  have hne_orth : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitNormalVec ϑ) (unitTangentVec ϑ) = 0 := by
    intro ϑ
    rw [plane_inner]
    simp [unitNormalVec, unitTangentVec]
    ring
  have hen_orth : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitTangentVec ϑ) (unitNormalVec ϑ) = 0 := by
    intro ϑ
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact hne_orth ϑ
  have hframe_decomp : ∀ (ϑ : ℝ) (v : Plane),
      v = inner ℝ v (unitNormalVec ϑ) • unitNormalVec ϑ +
          inner ℝ v (unitTangentVec ϑ) • unitTangentVec ϑ := by
    intro ϑ v
    ext i
    have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ϑ
    fin_cases i
    · simp [plane_inner, unitNormalVec, unitTangentVec]
      linear_combination -(v.ofLp 0) * hcs
    · simp [plane_inner, unitNormalVec, unitTangentVec]
      linear_combination -(v.ofLp 1) * hcs
  have hn_per : Function.Periodic unitNormalVec (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ϑ
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [unitNormalVec, Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.sin_add_two_pi]
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]

  
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := hΩ.domain.nonempty
  obtain ⟨ε_ball, hε_ball_pos, hball_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ.domain.isOpen c₀ hc₀
  let r₀ : ℝ := ε_ball / 3
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by dsimp [r₀]; linarith
  have hclosedBall_sub : Metric.closedBall c₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆ Ω :=
    Set.Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [r₀]; linarith)) hball_sub
  obtain ⟨γ, L, hγ, hκ⟩ := hΩ.boundary_smooth_pos_curvature

  
  let γ₁ : ℝ → Plane := deriv γ
  let γ₂ : ℝ → Plane := deriv γ₁
  have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℝ γ := hγ.smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hγ₁_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ₁ := hγ.smooth.iterate_deriv 1
  have hγ₂_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ₂ := hγ.smooth.iterate_deriv 2
  have hγ₁_diff : Differentiable ℝ γ₁ := hγ₁_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  let proj₀ : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let proj₁ : Plane →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  have hγ₁_coord_deriv : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun u => γ₁ u i) (γ₂ t i) t := by
    intro i t
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγ₁_diff t).hasDerivAt
  have hγ₁₀_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => γ₁ t 0) := proj₀.contDiff.comp hγ₁_smooth
  have hγ₁₁_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => γ₁ t 1) := proj₁.contDiff.comp hγ₁_smooth
  have hγ₂₀_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => γ₂ t 0) := proj₀.contDiff.comp hγ₂_smooth
  have hγ₂₁_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => γ₂ t 1) := proj₁.contDiff.comp hγ₂_smooth

  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (γ₁ t 0) ^ 2 + (γ₁ t 1) ^ 2
  let s : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ‖γ₁ t‖
  have hs_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < s t := fun t => norm_pos_iff.mpr (hγ.regular t)
  have hs_sq : ∀ t : ℝ, (s t) ^ 2 = q t := fun t => plane_norm_sq (γ₁ t)
  have hq_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < q t := by
    intro t; rw [← hs_sq t]; exact sq_pos_of_pos (hs_pos t)
  have hq_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q := (hγ₁₀_smooth.pow 2).add (hγ₁₁_smooth.pow 2)
  have hs_eq_sqrt : ∀ t : ℝ, s t = Real.sqrt (q t) := by
    intro t; rw [← hs_sq t, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  let s_deriv_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (γ₁ t 0 * γ₂ t 0 + γ₁ t 1 * γ₂ t 1) / s t
  have hs_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt s (s_deriv_fn t) t := by
    intro t
    have hq_d : HasDerivAt q (2 * γ₁ t 0 * γ₂ t 0 + 2 * γ₁ t 1 * γ₂ t 1) t := by
      have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (γ₁ u 0) ^ 2) (2 * γ₁ t 0 * γ₂ t 0) t := by
        convert (hγ₁_coord_deriv 0 t).pow 2 using 1
        simp [mul_assoc]
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (γ₁ u 1) ^ 2) (2 * γ₁ t 1 * γ₂ t 1) t := by
        convert (hγ₁_coord_deriv 1 t).pow 2 using 1
        simp [mul_assoc]
      exact h0.add h1
    have hsqrt := hq_d.sqrt (ne_of_gt (hq_pos t))
    have heq : (fun u => Real.sqrt (q u)) = s := funext fun u => (hs_eq_sqrt u).symm
    rw [heq, ← hs_eq_sqrt t] at hsqrt
    convert hsqrt using 1
    dsimp [s_deriv_fn]
    have hs_ne : s t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    field_simp

  let angRate : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => det2 (γ₁ t) (γ₂ t) / q t
  have hangRate_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ angRate := by
    have hnum : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => det2 (γ₁ t) (γ₂ t)) :=
      (hγ₁₀_smooth.mul hγ₂₁_smooth).sub (hγ₁₁_smooth.mul hγ₂₀_smooth)
    exact hnum.div hq_smooth (fun t => ne_of_gt (hq_pos t))
  have hangRate_eq_curv : ∀ t : ℝ, angRate t = s t * signedCurvature γ t := by
    intro t
    dsimp [angRate, signedCurvature, γ₁, γ₂, s]
    have hs_ne : ‖deriv γ t‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    have hq_eq : q t = ‖deriv γ t‖ ^ 2 := (hs_sq t).symm
    rw [hq_eq]
    field_simp
  have hangRate_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < angRate t := by
    intro t
    rw [hangRate_eq_curv t]
    exact mul_pos (hs_pos t) (hκ t)

  let v₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => γ₁ t 0 / s t
  let v₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => γ₁ t 1 / s t
  have hv_unit : ∀ t : ℝ, (v₀ t) ^ 2 + (v₁ t) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro t
    dsimp [v₀, v₁]
    have hs_ne : s t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    have hsq := hs_sq t
    dsimp [q] at hsq
    field_simp
    linarith
  have hv₀_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt v₀ (-v₁ t * angRate t) t := by
    intro t
    have hd := (hγ₁_coord_deriv 0 t).div (hs_deriv t) (ne_of_gt (hs_pos t))
    convert hd using 1
    dsimp [v₁, angRate, det2, s_deriv_fn]
    rw [← hs_sq t]
    have hs_ne : s t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    field_simp
    rw [hs_sq t]
    dsimp [q]
    ring
  have hv₁_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt v₁ (v₀ t * angRate t) t := by
    intro t
    have hd := (hγ₁_coord_deriv 1 t).div (hs_deriv t) (ne_of_gt (hs_pos t))
    convert hd using 1
    dsimp [v₀, angRate, det2, s_deriv_fn]
    rw [← hs_sq t]
    have hs_ne : s t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    field_simp
    rw [hs_sq t]
    dsimp [q]
    ring

  let z₀ : ℂ := (v₁ 0 : ℂ) + ((-v₀ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let θ₀ : ℝ := Complex.arg z₀
  have hz₀_re : z₀.re = v₁ 0 := by simp [z₀]
  have hz₀_im : z₀.im = -v₀ 0 := by simp [z₀]
  have hz₀_norm : ‖z₀‖ = 1 := by
    have hnsq : Complex.normSq z₀ = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_apply, hz₀_re, hz₀_im]
      nlinarith [hv_unit 0]
    rw [Complex.norm_def, hnsq, Real.sqrt_one]
  have hcos_θ₀ : Real.cos θ₀ = v₁ 0 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z₀
    rwa [hz₀_norm, one_mul, hz₀_re] at h
  have hsin_θ₀ : Real.sin θ₀ = -v₀ 0 := by
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z₀
    rwa [hz₀_norm, one_mul, hz₀_im] at h

  let θ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => θ₀ + (1 : ℝ) * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..t, angRate η
  obtain ⟨hθ_smooth, hθ_deriv_raw⟩ := smooth_primitive angRate θ₀ 1 hangRate_smooth
  have hθ_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt θ (angRate t) t := by
    intro t; simpa [θ] using hθ_deriv_raw t

  let E_lyap : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (v₀ t + Real.sin (θ t)) ^ 2 + (v₁ t - Real.cos (θ t)) ^ 2
  have hE_zero_at_0 : E_lyap 0 = 0 := by
    have hθ0 : θ 0 = θ₀ := by simp [θ]
    dsimp [E_lyap]
    rw [hθ0, hcos_θ₀, hsin_θ₀]
    ring
  have hE_deriv_zero : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt E_lyap 0 t := by
    intro t
    have hsin_d : HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.sin (θ u)) (Real.cos (θ t) * angRate t) t :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (θ t)).comp t (hθ_deriv t)
    have hcos_d : HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.cos (θ u)) (-Real.sin (θ t) * angRate t) t :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (θ t)).comp t (hθ_deriv t)
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (v₀ u + Real.sin (θ u)) ^ 2)
        (2 * (v₀ t + Real.sin (θ t)) * (-v₁ t * angRate t + Real.cos (θ t) * angRate t)) t := by
      convert ((hv₀_deriv t).add hsin_d).pow 2 using 1
      simp [mul_assoc]
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (v₁ u - Real.cos (θ u)) ^ 2)
        (2 * (v₁ t - Real.cos (θ t)) * (v₀ t * angRate t - (-Real.sin (θ t) * angRate t))) t := by
      convert ((hv₁_deriv t).sub hcos_d).pow 2 using 1
      simp [mul_assoc]
    convert hd1.add hd2 using 1
    ring
  have hE_all_zero : ∀ t : ℝ, E_lyap t = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun u => (hE_deriv_zero u).differentiableAt)
      (fun u => (hE_deriv_zero u).deriv) t 0
    rw [hconst, hE_zero_at_0]
  have hγ₁_frenet : ∀ t : ℝ, γ₁ t = s t • unitTangentVec (θ t) := by
    intro t
    have hE := hE_all_zero t
    dsimp [E_lyap] at hE
    have hv₀_eq : v₀ t = -Real.sin (θ t) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v₀ t + Real.sin (θ t)), sq_nonneg (v₁ t - Real.cos (θ t))]
    have hv₁_eq : v₁ t = Real.cos (θ t) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v₀ t + Real.sin (θ t)), sq_nonneg (v₁ t - Real.cos (θ t))]
    have hs_ne : s t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos t)
    have h0 : γ₁ t 0 = s t * (-Real.sin (θ t)) := by
      dsimp [v₀] at hv₀_eq
      exact (div_eq_iff hs_ne).mp hv₀_eq |>.trans (mul_comm _ _)
    have h1 : γ₁ t 1 = s t * Real.cos (θ t) := by
      dsimp [v₁] at hv₁_eq
      exact (div_eq_iff hs_ne).mp hv₁_eq |>.trans (mul_comm _ _)
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [unitTangentVec] using h0
    · simpa [unitTangentVec] using h1
  have hγ₂_frenet : ∀ t : ℝ,
      γ₂ t = s_deriv_fn t • unitTangentVec (θ t) - (s t * angRate t) • unitNormalVec (θ t) := by
    intro t
    have he_comp : HasDerivAt (fun u => unitTangentVec (θ u)) (angRate t • (-unitNormalVec (θ t))) t :=
      (he_deriv (θ t)).scomp t (hθ_deriv t)
    have hrhs : HasDerivAt (fun u => s u • unitTangentVec (θ u))
        (s t • (angRate t • (-unitNormalVec (θ t))) + s_deriv_fn t • unitTangentVec (θ t)) t :=
      (hs_deriv t).smul he_comp
    have hlhs : HasDerivAt (fun u => s u • unitTangentVec (θ u)) (γ₂ t) t := by
      have heq : (fun u => s u • unitTangentVec (θ u)) = γ₁ := funext fun u => (hγ₁_frenet u).symm
      rw [heq]
      exact (hγ₁_diff t).hasDerivAt
    rw [hlhs.unique hrhs]
    ext i
    simp
    ring

  
  have hγ_mem_frontier : ∀ t : ℝ, γ t ∈ frontier Ω := by
    intro t; rw [← hγ.range_eq]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hγ_mem_closure : ∀ t : ℝ, γ t ∈ closure Ω :=
    fun t => frontier_subset_closure (hγ_mem_frontier t)
  have hθ_normal_and_closure : ∀ t₀ : ℝ,
      IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω (γ t₀) (unitNormalVec (θ t₀)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ closure Ω, inner ℝ (x - γ t₀) (unitNormalVec (θ t₀)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro t₀
    have hnot_mem : γ t₀ ∉ Ω := by
      have hfr := hγ_mem_frontier t₀
      rw [frontier, hΩ.domain.isOpen.interior_eq] at hfr
      exact hfr.2
    obtain ⟨f_sep, hf_sep⟩ :=
      geometric_hahn_banach_open_point hΩ.domain.convex hΩ.domain.isOpen hnot_mem
    let w : Plane := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Plane).symm f_sep
    have hw_apply : ∀ y : Plane, inner ℝ y w = f_sep y := by
      intro y
      rw [real_inner_comm]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Plane) (x := y) (y := f_sep)
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw0
      have hlt := hf_sep c₀ hc₀
      have heq : f_sep c₀ - f_sep (γ t₀) = inner ℝ (c₀ - γ t₀) w := by
        rw [inner_sub_left, hw_apply, hw_apply]
      rw [hw0, inner_zero_right] at heq
      linarith
    have hw_norm_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw_ne
    let u : Plane := ‖w‖⁻¹ • w
    have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp [u]; rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hw_norm_pos))]
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hw_norm_pos)
    have hu_open : ∀ x ∈ Ω, inner ℝ (x - γ t₀) u ≤ 0 := by
      intro x hx
      dsimp [u]
      rw [inner_smul_right, inner_sub_left, hw_apply, hw_apply]
      have hlt := hf_sep x hx
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hw_norm_pos)) (by linarith)
    have hu_closure : ∀ x ∈ closure Ω, inner ℝ (x - γ t₀) u ≤ 0 := by
      have hsub : Ω ⊆ {x : Plane | inner ℝ (x - γ t₀) u ≤ 0} := hu_open
      have hcl : IsClosed {x : Plane | inner ℝ (x - γ t₀) u ≤ 0} :=
        isClosed_le ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).inner continuous_const) continuous_const
      exact fun x hx => closure_minimal hsub hcl hx
    let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => inner ℝ (γ t - γ t₀) u
    let φ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => inner ℝ (γ₁ t) u
    have hφ_le : ∀ t : ℝ, φ t ≤ 0 := fun t => hu_closure (γ t) (hγ_mem_closure t)
    have hφ_t₀ : φ t₀ = 0 := by simp [φ]
    have hφ_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt φ (φ₁ t) t := by
      intro t
      have hd := ((hγ_diff t).hasDerivAt.sub_const (γ t₀)).inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const t u)
      simpa [φ, φ₁] using hd
    have hφ₁_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt φ₁ (inner ℝ (γ₂ t) u) t := by
      intro t
      have hd := (hγ₁_diff t).hasDerivAt.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const t u)
      simpa [φ₁] using hd
    have hφ_max : IsLocalMax φ t₀ := by
      have hmax : IsMaxOn φ Set.univ t₀ := fun t _ => by rw [hφ_t₀]; exact hφ_le t
      exact hmax.isLocalMax Filter.univ_mem
    have hφ₁_zero : φ₁ t₀ = 0 := hφ_max.hasDerivAt_eq_zero (hφ_deriv t₀)
    have hu_orth_e : inner ℝ u (unitTangentVec (θ t₀)) = 0 := by
      have h1 : φ₁ t₀ = s t₀ * inner ℝ (unitTangentVec (θ t₀)) u := by
        dsimp [φ₁]; rw [hγ₁_frenet t₀, inner_smul_left]; simp
      rw [hφ₁_zero] at h1
      have h2 : inner ℝ (unitTangentVec (θ t₀)) u = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp h1.symm).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (hs_pos t₀))
      rwa [real_inner_comm]
    let c_u : ℝ := inner ℝ u (unitNormalVec (θ t₀))
    have hu_span : u = c_u • unitNormalVec (θ t₀) := by
      have hdec := hframe_decomp (θ t₀) u
      rw [hu_orth_e, zero_smul, add_zero] at hdec
      exact hdec
    have hcu_abs : |c_u| = 1 := by
      have h1 := hu_norm
      rw [hu_span, norm_smul, hn_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact h1
    have hφ₂_nonpos : inner ℝ (γ₂ t₀) u ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hpos : 0 < inner ℝ (γ₂ t₀) u := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hslope_lim := (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_left_right.mp (hφ₁_deriv t₀)).2
      have hev : {t : ℝ | 0 < slope φ₁ t₀ t} ∈ nhdsWithin t₀ (Set.Ioi t₀) :=
        hslope_lim (Ioi_mem_nhds hpos)
      rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff] at hev
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_sub⟩ := hev
      have hab : t₀ < t₀ + δ / 2 := by linarith
      have hφ_diff : Differentiable ℝ φ := fun t => (hφ_deriv t).differentiableAt
      have hφ_cont : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Icc t₀ (t₀ + δ / 2)) :=
        hφ_diff.continuous.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_eq⟩ :=
        exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope φ φ₁ hab hφ_cont (fun x _ => hφ_deriv x)
      have hξ_ball : ξ ∈ Metric.ball t₀ δ ∩ Set.Ioi t₀ := by
        refine ⟨?_, hξ_mem.1⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hξ_mem.1)]
        linarith [hξ_mem.2]
      have hslope_pos : 0 < slope φ₁ t₀ ξ := hδ_sub hξ_ball
      rw [slope_def_field, hφ₁_zero, sub_zero] at hslope_pos
      have hφ₁_ξ_pos : 0 < φ₁ ξ :=
        (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (sub_pos.mpr hξ_mem.1)).mp hslope_pos
      have hφ₁_ξ_nonpos : φ₁ ξ ≤ 0 := by
        rw [hξ_eq, hφ_t₀, sub_zero]
        exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hφ_le (t₀ + δ / 2)) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hcu_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_u := by
      rw [hγ₂_frenet t₀, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_left] at hφ₂_nonpos
      simp only [conj_trivial] at hφ₂_nonpos
      have he_u : inner ℝ (unitTangentVec (θ t₀)) u = 0 := by
        rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hu_orth_e
      have hn_u : inner ℝ (unitNormalVec (θ t₀)) u = c_u := by
        rw [real_inner_comm]
      rw [he_u, hn_u, mul_zero, zero_sub] at hφ₂_nonpos
      have hsw_pos : 0 < s t₀ * angRate t₀ := mul_pos (hs_pos t₀) (hangRate_pos t₀)
      nlinarith
    have hcu_one : c_u = 1 := by
      rcases abs_eq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) |>.mp hcu_abs with h1 | h2
      · exact h1
      · linarith
    have hu_eq_n : u = unitNormalVec (θ t₀) := by rw [hu_span, hcu_one, one_smul]
    rw [hu_eq_n] at hu_closure hu_open
    refine ⟨⟨hn_norm (θ t₀), ⟨γ, L, t₀, hγ, rfl, ?_⟩, hu_open⟩, hu_closure⟩
    change inner ℝ (unitNormalVec (θ t₀)) (γ₁ t₀) = 0
    rw [hγ₁_frenet t₀, inner_smul_right, hne_orth, mul_zero]

  
  have hγ₁_per : Function.Periodic γ₁ L := deriv_per_plane γ L hγ_diff hγ.periodic
  have hγ₂_per : Function.Periodic γ₂ L := deriv_per_plane γ₁ L hγ₁_diff hγ₁_per
  have hangRate_per : Function.Periodic angRate L := by
    intro t; dsimp [angRate, q]; rw [hγ₁_per t, hγ₂_per t]
  let Δ : ℝ := θ L - θ 0
  have hθ_shift_const : ∀ t : ℝ, θ (t + L) - θ t = Δ := by
    intro t
    have hd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => θ (y + L) - θ y) 0 u := by
      intro u
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => θ (y + L)) (angRate (u + L)) u := by
        convert (hθ_deriv (u + L)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).add_const L) using 1 <;>
          simp [Function.comp_def]
      have h2 := h1.sub (hθ_deriv u)
      rwa [hangRate_per u, sub_self] at h2
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun u => (hd u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hd u).deriv) t 0
    simpa [Δ] using hconst
  have hθ_mono : StrictMono θ :=
    strictMono_of_deriv_pos (by intro t; rw [(hθ_deriv t).deriv]; exact hangRate_pos t)
  have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ := sub_pos.mpr (hθ_mono hγ.period_pos)
  have hcos_Δ : Real.cos Δ = 1 := by
    have hγ₁_L : γ₁ L = γ₁ 0 := by simpa using hγ₁_per 0
    have hs_L : s L = s 0 := by dsimp [s]; rw [hγ₁_L]
    have he_L : unitTangentVec (θ L) = unitTangentVec (θ 0) := by
      have h1 := hγ₁_frenet L
      rw [hγ₁_L, hγ₁_frenet 0, hs_L] at h1
      exact smul_right_injective Plane (ne_of_gt (hs_pos 0)) h1.symm
    have hsin_L : Real.sin (θ L) = Real.sin (θ 0) := by
      have h0 := congrArg (fun v : Plane => v 0) he_L
      simp [unitTangentVec] at h0
      linarith
    have hcos_L : Real.cos (θ L) = Real.cos (θ 0) := by
      have h1 := congrArg (fun v : Plane => v 1) he_L
      simpa [unitTangentVec] using h1
    dsimp [Δ]
    rw [Real.cos_sub, hcos_L, hsin_L]
    nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ 0)]
  obtain ⟨k_wind, hk_wind⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff Δ).mp hcos_Δ
  have hk_pos : 1 ≤ k_wind := by
    have hk_real : 0 < (k_wind : ℝ) := by
      have hprod : 0 < (k_wind : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by linarith
      exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right h2pi_pos).mp hprod
    exact_mod_cast Int.lt_iff_add_one_le.mp (Int.cast_pos.mp hk_real)
  have hk_le_one : k_wind ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hnot_le
    have hk_ge2 : 2 ≤ k_wind := by omega
    have hk_cast : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k_wind : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_ge2
    have hθL_eq : θ L = θ 0 + (k_wind : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by dsimp [Δ] at hk_wind; linarith
    have h_mid_low : θ 0 < θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
    have h_mid_high : θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi < θ L := by rw [hθL_eq]; nlinarith
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁_mem, ht₁_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hγ.period_pos)
      hθ_smooth.continuous.continuousOn ⟨le_of_lt h_mid_low, le_of_lt h_mid_high⟩
    have ht₁_pos : 0 < t₁ := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht₁_mem.1 with rfl | hpos
      · linarith
      · exact hpos
    have ht₁_lt_L : t₁ < L := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht₁_mem.2 with rfl | hlt
      · linarith
      · exact hlt
    have hn_t₁ : unitNormalVec (θ t₁) = unitNormalVec (θ 0) := by
      change θ t₁ = θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi at ht₁_eq
      rw [ht₁_eq]
      exact hn_per (θ 0)
    let p₀ : Plane := γ 0
    let p₁ : Plane := γ t₁
    let n₀ : Plane := unitNormalVec (θ 0)
    have hp₁_p₀ : inner ℝ (p₁ - p₀) n₀ ≤ 0 := (hθ_normal_and_closure 0).2 p₁ (hγ_mem_closure t₁)
    have hp₀_p₁ : inner ℝ (p₀ - p₁) n₀ ≤ 0 := by
      have h := (hθ_normal_and_closure t₁).2 p₀ (hγ_mem_closure 0)
      rwa [hn_t₁] at h
    have hp_orth : inner ℝ (p₁ - p₀) n₀ = 0 := by
      have hneg : inner ℝ (p₀ - p₁) n₀ = -inner ℝ (p₁ - p₀) n₀ := by
        rw [← neg_sub, inner_neg_left]
      linarith
    by_cases hp_eq : p₀ = p₁
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hγ.simple t₁ 0 hp_eq.symm
      have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by
        have : 0 < (m : ℝ) * L := by linarith
        exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right hγ.period_pos).mp this
      have hm_lt1 : (m : ℝ) < 1 := by
        have : (m : ℝ) * L < 1 * L := by linarith
        exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right this (le_of_lt hγ.period_pos)
      have hm_z_pos : 0 < m := Int.cast_pos.mp hm_pos
      have hm_z_lt1 : m < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hm_lt1
      omega
    · let z : Plane := (1 / 2 : ℝ) • p₀ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • p₁
      have hz_openSeg : z ∈ openSegment ℝ p₀ p₁ :=
        ⟨1 / 2, 1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num, by norm_num, rfl⟩
      have hz_mem : z ∈ Ω :=
        hΩ.domain.openSegment_subset p₀ (hγ_mem_closure 0) p₁ (hγ_mem_closure t₁) hp_eq hz_openSeg
      obtain ⟨δ_z, hδ_z_pos, hball_z⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ.domain.isOpen z hz_mem
      let x_in : Plane := z + (δ_z / 2) • n₀
      have hx_in_mem : x_in ∈ Ω := by
        apply hball_z
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hsub : x_in - z = (δ_z / 2) • n₀ := by dsimp [x_in]; abel
        rw [hsub, norm_smul, hn_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        linarith
      have hz_orth : inner ℝ (z - p₀) n₀ = 0 := by
        have hsub_z : z - p₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (p₁ - p₀) := by
          dsimp [z]; ext i; simp; ring
        rw [hsub_z, inner_smul_left, hp_orth, mul_zero]
      have hx_pos : 0 < inner ℝ (x_in - p₀) n₀ := by
        have hsub : x_in - p₀ = (z - p₀) + (δ_z / 2) • n₀ := by dsimp [x_in]; abel
        rw [hsub, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, hz_orth, hn_self, conj_trivial]
        linarith
      have hx_nonpos : inner ℝ (x_in - p₀) n₀ ≤ 0 := (hθ_normal_and_closure 0).1.2.2 x_in hx_in_mem
      linarith
  have hk_one : k_wind = 1 := le_antisymm hk_le_one hk_pos
  have hθ_qp : ∀ t : ℝ, θ (t + L) = θ t + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro t
    have h := hθ_shift_const t
    rw [hk_one] at hk_wind
    push_cast at hk_wind
    linarith

  
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ_smooth, hτ_left, hτ_right, hτ_deriv, hτ_qp, hθ_shift_int⟩ :=
    smooth_quasiperiodic_inv θ angRate L (2 * Real.pi) hγ.period_pos h2pi_pos
      hθ_smooth hθ_deriv hangRate_pos hθ_qp
  let Γ : ℝ → Plane := fun ψ => γ (τ ψ)
  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun ψ => inner ℝ (Γ ψ - c₀) (unitNormalVec ψ)
  have hΓ_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ := hγ.smooth.comp hτ_smooth
  have hh_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := (hΓ_smooth.sub contDiff_const).inner ℝ hn_smooth
  have hΓ_per : Function.Periodic Γ (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ψ; dsimp [Γ]; rw [hτ_qp ψ, hγ.periodic (τ ψ)]
  have hh_per : Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ψ; dsimp [h]; rw [hΓ_per ψ, hn_per ψ]
  have hsupport_closure : ∀ ψ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ closure Ω, inner ℝ (x - c₀) (unitNormalVec ψ) ≤ h ψ := by
    intro ψ x hx
    have hcl := (hθ_normal_and_closure (τ ψ)).2 x hx
    rw [hτ_right ψ] at hcl
    have hsplit : x - Γ ψ = (x - c₀) - (Γ ψ - c₀) := by abel
    rw [hsplit, inner_sub_left] at hcl
    dsimp [h]
    linarith
  have htwo_r₀_le : ∀ ψ : ℝ, 2 * r₀ ≤ h ψ := by
    intro ψ
    let x_ψ : Plane := c₀ + (2 * r₀) • unitNormalVec ψ
    have hx_ball : x_ψ ∈ Metric.closedBall c₀ (2 * r₀) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hsub : x_ψ - c₀ = (2 * r₀) • unitNormalVec ψ := by dsimp [x_ψ]; abel
      rw [hsub, norm_smul, hn_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    have hx_cl : x_ψ ∈ closure Ω := subset_closure (hclosedBall_sub hx_ball)
    have hle := hsupport_closure ψ x_ψ hx_cl
    have hval : inner ℝ (x_ψ - c₀) (unitNormalVec ψ) = 2 * r₀ := by
      have hsub : x_ψ - c₀ = (2 * r₀) • unitNormalVec ψ := by dsimp [x_ψ]; abel
      rw [hsub, inner_smul_left, hn_self, conj_trivial, mul_one]
    linarith
  have hh_pos : ∀ ψ : ℝ, 0 < h ψ := fun ψ => by linarith [htwo_r₀_le ψ]

  let ρ_κ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ψ => (signedCurvature γ (τ ψ))⁻¹
  have hρ_κ_pos : ∀ ψ : ℝ, 0 < ρ_κ ψ := fun ψ => inv_pos.mpr (hκ (τ ψ))
  have hΓ_deriv : ∀ ψ : ℝ, HasDerivAt Γ (ρ_κ ψ • unitTangentVec ψ) ψ := by
    intro ψ
    have hd := (hγ_diff (τ ψ)).hasDerivAt.scomp ψ (hτ_deriv ψ)
    change HasDerivAt Γ ((angRate (τ ψ))⁻¹ • γ₁ (τ ψ)) ψ at hd
    convert hd using 1
    rw [hγ₁_frenet (τ ψ), hτ_right ψ, hangRate_eq_curv (τ ψ), smul_smul]
    congr 1
    dsimp [ρ_κ]
    have hs_ne : s (τ ψ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hs_pos (τ ψ))
    have hκ_ne : signedCurvature γ (τ ψ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hκ (τ ψ))
    field_simp
  have hh_deriv_at : ∀ ψ : ℝ, HasDerivAt h (inner ℝ (Γ ψ - c₀) (unitTangentVec ψ)) ψ := by
    intro ψ
    have hd := ((hΓ_deriv ψ).sub_const c₀).inner ℝ (hn_deriv ψ)
    convert hd using 1
    rw [inner_smul_left, hen_orth, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hh_deriv_eq : ∀ ψ : ℝ, deriv h ψ = inner ℝ (Γ ψ - c₀) (unitTangentVec ψ) :=
    fun ψ => (hh_deriv_at ψ).deriv
  have hsupport_pt_eq : ∀ ψ : ℝ, supportBoundaryPt c₀ h ψ = Γ ψ := by
    intro ψ
    dsimp [supportBoundaryPt]
    rw [hh_deriv_eq ψ, add_assoc]
    have hdec := hframe_decomp ψ (Γ ψ - c₀)
    dsimp [h]
    rw [← hdec]
    abel
  have hh_deriv2_at : ∀ ψ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (deriv h) (ρ_κ ψ - h ψ) ψ := by
    intro ψ
    have hfn : deriv h = fun u => inner ℝ (Γ u - c₀) (unitTangentVec u) := funext hh_deriv_eq
    rw [hfn]
    have hd := ((hΓ_deriv ψ).sub_const c₀).inner ℝ (he_deriv ψ)
    convert hd using 1
    rw [inner_neg_right, inner_smul_left, he_self, conj_trivial, mul_one]
    dsimp [h]
    ring
  have hr_pos : ∀ ψ : ℝ, 0 < h ψ + deriv (deriv h) ψ := by
    intro ψ
    rw [(hh_deriv2_at ψ).deriv]
    linarith [hρ_κ_pos ψ]
  have hfrontier_eq : frontier Ω =
      Set.range (fun ψ : ℝ => c₀ + h ψ • unitNormalVec ψ + deriv h ψ • unitTangentVec ψ) := by
    rw [← hγ.range_eq]
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨θ t, ?_⟩
      change supportBoundaryPt c₀ h (θ t) = γ t
      rw [hsupport_pt_eq (θ t)]
      dsimp [Γ]
      rw [hτ_left t]
    · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨τ ψ, ?_⟩
      exact (hsupport_pt_eq ψ).symm
  have hΓ_mem_fr : ∀ ψ : ℝ, supportBoundaryPt c₀ h ψ ∈ frontier Ω := by
    intro ψ
    rw [hfrontier_eq]
    exact ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
  have hΓ_inj : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
      supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₁ = supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₂ →
      ∃ k : ℤ, θ₁ - θ₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂ heq
    rw [hsupport_pt_eq θ₁, hsupport_pt_eq θ₂] at heq
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hγ.simple (τ θ₁) (τ θ₂) heq
    have hτ_eq : τ θ₁ = τ θ₂ + (k : ℝ) * L := by linarith
    have hθ_ap := congrArg θ hτ_eq
    rw [hτ_right θ₁, hθ_shift_int k (τ θ₂), hτ_right θ₂] at hθ_ap
    exact ⟨k, by linarith⟩
  have hΓ_normal : ∀ ψ : ℝ,
      IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω (supportBoundaryPt c₀ h ψ) (unitNormalVec ψ) := by
    intro ψ
    rw [hsupport_pt_eq ψ]
    have h := (hθ_normal_and_closure (τ ψ)).1
    rwa [hτ_right ψ] at h

  
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun ϑ => h ϑ + deriv (deriv h) ϑ
  have hr_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ r := hh_smooth.add (hh_smooth.iterate_deriv 2)
  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℝ h := hh_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hh'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv h) :=
    (hh_smooth.iterate_deriv 1).differentiable (by simp)
  have hh'_per : Function.Periodic (deriv h) (2 * Real.pi) :=
    deriv_per_real h (2 * Real.pi) hh_diff hh_per
  have hh''_per : Function.Periodic (deriv (deriv h)) (2 * Real.pi) :=
    deriv_per_real (deriv h) (2 * Real.pi) hh'_diff hh'_per
  have hr_per : Function.Periodic r (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ϑ; dsimp [r]; rw [hh_per ϑ, hh''_per ϑ]

  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ϑ => Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (r ϑ))
  have hρ_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro ϑ
    have hlog : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u => Real.log (r u)) ϑ :=
      ContDiffAt.comp ϑ (Real.contDiffAt_log.mpr (ne_of_gt (hr_pos ϑ))) hr_smooth.contDiffAt
    exact Real.contDiff_exp.contDiffAt.comp ϑ (contDiffAt_const.mul hlog)
  have hρ_pos : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ϑ := fun ϑ => Real.exp_pos _
  have hρ_per : Function.Periodic ρ (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ϑ; dsimp [ρ]; rw [hr_per ϑ]
  have hρ_cube : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, (ρ ϑ) ^ 3 = r ϑ := by
    intro ϑ
    dsimp [ρ]
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    have hmul : (3 : ℕ) * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (r ϑ)) = Real.log (r ϑ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hmul, Real.exp_log (hr_pos ϑ)]

  let I_laz : ℝ := ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ η
  have hI_pos : 0 < I_laz := by
    obtain ⟨η_min, _, hη_min⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
      ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt h2pi_pos⟩⟩ hρ_smooth.continuous.continuousOn
    have hmono : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ η_min) ≤ I_laz :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (hρ_smooth.continuous.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        (fun x hx => hη_min hx)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hmono
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos h2pi_pos (hρ_pos η_min)) hmono
  let k_laz : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi) / I_laz
  have hk_laz_pos : 0 < k_laz := div_pos h2pi_pos hI_pos
  let c_laz : ℝ := (k_laz ^ 3)⁻¹
  have hc_laz_pos : 0 < c_laz := inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hk_laz_pos 3)
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ϑ => (0 : ℝ) + k_laz * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..ϑ, ρ η
  obtain ⟨hΨ_smooth, hΨ_deriv⟩ := smooth_primitive ρ 0 k_laz hρ_smooth
  have hΨ'_pos : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, 0 < k_laz * ρ ϑ := fun ϑ => mul_pos hk_laz_pos (hρ_pos ϑ)
  have hΨ_qp : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, Ψ (ϑ + 2 * Real.pi) = Ψ ϑ + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro ϑ
    have hd : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y => Ψ (y + 2 * Real.pi) - Ψ y) 0 u := by
      intro u
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => Ψ (y + 2 * Real.pi)) (k_laz * ρ (u + 2 * Real.pi)) u := by
        convert (hΨ_deriv (u + 2 * Real.pi)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).add_const (2 * Real.pi)) using 1 <;>
          simp [Ψ, Function.comp_def]
      have h2 := h1.sub (hΨ_deriv u)
      rwa [hρ_per u, sub_self] at h2
    have hconst := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun u => (hd u).differentiableAt) (fun u => (hd u).deriv) ϑ 0
    have h0 : Ψ (0 + 2 * Real.pi) - Ψ 0 = 2 * Real.pi := by
      dsimp [Ψ]
      rw [zero_add, intervalIntegral.integral_same, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ (2 * Real.pi) (ne_of_gt hI_pos)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ϕ, hϕ_smooth, _, _, hϕ_deriv, hϕ_qp, _⟩ :=
    smooth_quasiperiodic_inv Ψ (fun ϑ => k_laz * ρ ϑ) (2 * Real.pi) (2 * Real.pi)
      h2pi_pos h2pi_pos hΨ_smooth hΨ_deriv hΨ'_pos hΨ_qp
  have hϕ_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv ϕ x := by
    intro x
    rw [(hϕ_deriv x).deriv]
    exact inv_pos.mpr (hΨ'_pos (ϕ x))
  have hlaz_norm : ∀ x : ℝ, (h (ϕ x) + deriv (deriv h) (ϕ x)) * (deriv ϕ x) ^ 3 = c_laz := by
    intro x
    change r (ϕ x) * (deriv ϕ x) ^ 3 = c_laz
    rw [← hρ_cube (ϕ x), (hϕ_deriv x).deriv]
    dsimp [c_laz]
    have hk_ne : k_laz ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hk_laz_pos
    have hρ_ne : ρ (ϕ x) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hρ_pos (ϕ x))
    field_simp

  
  exact ⟨{
    c₀ := c₀
    c₀_mem := hc₀
    h := h
    h_smooth := hh_smooth
    h_periodic := hh_per
    h_pos := hh_pos
    r_pos := hr_pos
    frontier_eq := hfrontier_eq
    ϕ := ϕ
    c := c_laz
    c_pos := hc_laz_pos
    ϕ_smooth := hϕ_smooth
    ϕ_deriv_pos := hϕ_deriv_pos
    ϕ_quasiperiodic := hϕ_qp
    lazutkin_norm := hlaz_norm
    r₀ := r₀
    r₀_pos := hr₀_pos
    closedBall_subset := hclosedBall_sub
    two_r₀_le_h := htwo_r₀_le
    Γ_mem_frontier := hΓ_mem_fr
    Γ_inj_mod_two_pi := hΓ_inj
    Γ_outward_normal := hΓ_normal
    support_bound_closure := hsupport_closure
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (hΩ : IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain Ω)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω) :
    Nonempty (SupportPhaseMapData Ω B)

signature.name: support_phase_billiard_map
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (hΩ : IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain Ω)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω) :
    Nonempty (SupportPhaseMapData Ω B)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℝ B.h := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp B.h_smooth).1
  have hdh_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv B.h) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp B.h_smooth).2
  have hdh_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv B.h) := (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hdh_smooth).1
  have hh_cont : Continuous B.h := B.h_smooth.continuous
  have hdh_cont : Continuous (deriv B.h) := hdh_smooth.continuous
  have hdh_per : Function.Periodic (deriv B.h) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro θ
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => B.h (x + 2 * Real.pi))
        (deriv B.h (θ + 2 * Real.pi) * 1) θ :=
      (hh_diff (θ + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt.comp θ ((hasDerivAt_id θ).add_const (2 * Real.pi))
    have hshift : (fun x : ℝ => B.h (x + 2 * Real.pi)) = B.h := funext B.h_periodic
    rw [hshift, mul_one] at hd1
    exact hd1.deriv.symm
  have hh_sub_pi : ∀ θ : ℝ, B.h (θ - Real.pi) = B.h (θ + Real.pi) := by
    intro θ
    have h1 := B.h_periodic (θ - Real.pi)
    have h2 : θ - Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = θ + Real.pi := by ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  
  let g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun β s =>
    B.h s * Real.cos (β - s) + deriv B.h s * Real.sin (β - s)
  have hg_hasDeriv : ∀ β s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (g β) ((B.h s + deriv (deriv B.h) s) * Real.sin (β - s)) s := by
    intro β s
    have h_sub : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => β - x) (-1) s := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_const s β).sub (hasDerivAt_id s) using 1
      · rfl
      · norm_num
    have h_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (β - x)) (-Real.sin (β - s) * (-1)) s :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (β - s)).comp s h_sub
    have h_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (β - x)) (Real.cos (β - s) * (-1)) s :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (β - s)).comp s h_sub
    have h1 := (hh_diff s).hasDerivAt.mul h_cos
    have h2 := (hdh_diff s).hasDerivAt.mul h_sin
    convert h1.add h2 using 1
    ring
  have hg_cont : ∀ β : ℝ, Continuous (g β) := by
    intro β
    exact (hh_cont.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).add
      (hdh_cont.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))
  have hg_self : ∀ β : ℝ, g β β = B.h β := by
    intro β; simp [g]
  have hg_add_pi : ∀ β : ℝ, g β (β + Real.pi) = -B.h (β + Real.pi) := by
    intro β
    have hsub : β - (β + Real.pi) = -Real.pi := by ring
    simp [g, hsub]
  have hg_sub_pi : ∀ β : ℝ, g β (β - Real.pi) = -B.h (β + Real.pi) := by
    intro β
    have hsub : β - (β - Real.pi) = Real.pi := by ring
    simp [g, hsub, hh_sub_pi β]
  have hg_mono : ∀ β : ℝ, StrictMonoOn (g β) (Set.Icc (β - Real.pi) β) := by
    intro β
    apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc _ _) (hg_cont β).continuousOn
    intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    rw [(hg_hasDeriv β s).deriv]
    exact mul_pos (B.r_pos s)
      (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [hs.2]) (by linarith [hs.1]))
  have hg_anti : ∀ β : ℝ, StrictAntiOn (g β) (Set.Icc β (β + Real.pi)) := by
    intro β
    apply strictAntiOn_of_deriv_neg (convex_Icc _ _) (hg_cont β).continuousOn
    intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    rw [(hg_hasDeriv β s).deriv]
    have hsin_neg : Real.sin (β - s) < 0 := by
      have heq : β - s = -(s - β) := by ring
      rw [heq, Real.sin_neg]
      exact neg_lt_zero.mpr
        (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith [hs.1]) (by linarith [hs.2]))
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (B.r_pos s) hsin_neg
  let F₁ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun θ₁ θ₂ => -supportAction1_ℝ B.h θ₁ θ₂
  let F₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun θ₁ θ₂ => supportAction2_ℝ B.h θ₁ θ₂
  have hF₁_eq_g : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, F₁ θ₁ θ₂ = g θ₁ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂
    dsimp [F₁, supportAction1_ℝ, g]
    have hd : θ₁ - (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 = -((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) := by ring
    rw [hd, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
    ring
  have hF₂_eq_g : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, F₂ θ₁ θ₂ = g θ₂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂
    dsimp [F₂, supportAction2_ℝ, g]
    have hd : θ₂ - (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 = (θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hd]
    ring
  have hF₁_diag : ∀ θ : ℝ, F₁ θ θ = B.h θ := by
    intro θ; rw [hF₁_eq_g, show (θ + θ) / 2 = θ by ring, hg_self]
  have hF₁_top : ∀ θ : ℝ, F₁ θ (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = -B.h (θ + Real.pi) := by
    intro θ; rw [hF₁_eq_g, show (θ + (θ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = θ + Real.pi by ring, hg_add_pi]
  have hF₂_diag : ∀ θ : ℝ, F₂ θ θ = B.h θ := by
    intro θ; rw [hF₂_eq_g, show (θ + θ) / 2 = θ by ring, hg_self]
  have hF₂_bot : ∀ θ : ℝ, F₂ (θ - 2 * Real.pi) θ = -B.h (θ + Real.pi) := by
    intro θ; rw [hF₂_eq_g, show (θ - 2 * Real.pi + θ) / 2 = θ - Real.pi by ring, hg_sub_pi]
  have hF₁_per : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, F₁ (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) = F₁ θ₁ θ₂ := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂
    dsimp [F₁, supportAction1_ℝ]
    have hm : (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi + (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    have hd : (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi - (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = (θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hm, hd, B.h_periodic ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2), hdh_per ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2)]
  have hF₂_per : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, F₂ (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) = F₂ θ₁ θ₂ := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂
    dsimp [F₂, supportAction2_ℝ]
    have hm : (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi + (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    have hd : (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi - (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = (θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hm, hd, B.h_periodic ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2), hdh_per ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2)]
  have hF₁_anti : ∀ θ : ℝ, StrictAntiOn (F₁ θ) (Set.Icc θ (θ + 2 * Real.pi)) := by
    intro θ a ha b hb hab
    rw [hF₁_eq_g, hF₁_eq_g]
    exact hg_anti θ
      ⟨by linarith [ha.1], by linarith [ha.2]⟩
      ⟨by linarith [hb.1], by linarith [hb.2]⟩
      (by linarith)
  have hF₂_mono : ∀ θ : ℝ, StrictMonoOn (fun θ₁ => F₂ θ₁ θ) (Set.Icc (θ - 2 * Real.pi) θ) := by
    intro θ a ha b hb hab
    dsimp
    rw [hF₂_eq_g, hF₂_eq_g]
    exact hg_mono θ
      ⟨by linarith [ha.1], by linarith [ha.2]⟩
      ⟨by linarith [hb.1], by linarith [hb.2]⟩
      (by linarith)
  have hF₁_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => F₁ u.1 u.2) := by
    have hmid : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => (u.1 + u.2) / 2) :=
      (contDiff_fst.add contDiff_snd).div_const 2
    have hdiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => (u.2 - u.1) / 2) :=
      (contDiff_snd.sub contDiff_fst).div_const 2
    exact (((hdh_smooth.comp hmid).mul (Real.contDiff_sin.comp hdiff)).sub
      ((B.h_smooth.comp hmid).mul (Real.contDiff_cos.comp hdiff))).neg
  have hF₂_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => F₂ u.1 u.2) := by
    have hmid : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => (u.1 + u.2) / 2) :=
      (contDiff_fst.add contDiff_snd).div_const 2
    have hdiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => (u.2 - u.1) / 2) :=
      (contDiff_snd.sub contDiff_fst).div_const 2
    exact ((hdh_smooth.comp hmid).mul (Real.contDiff_sin.comp hdiff)).add
      ((B.h_smooth.comp hmid).mul (Real.contDiff_cos.comp hdiff))
  have hF₁_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => F₁ u.1 u.2) := hF₁_smooth.continuous
  have hF₂_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ × ℝ => F₂ u.1 u.2) := hF₂_smooth.continuous
  have hF_chord_strip : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, θ₁ < θ₂ → θ₂ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi →
      (θ₁, F₁ θ₁ θ₂) ∈ phaseStrip B.h ∧ (θ₂, F₂ θ₁ θ₂) ∈ phaseStrip B.h := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂ h1 h2
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hlt := hF₁_anti θ₁ ⟨le_of_lt h1, le_of_lt h2⟩ ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩ h2
      dsimp
      rwa [hF₁_top] at hlt
    · have hlt := hF₁_anti θ₁ ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩ ⟨le_of_lt h1, le_of_lt h2⟩ h1
      dsimp
      rwa [hF₁_diag] at hlt
    · have hlt := hF₂_mono θ₂ ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩ ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt h1⟩ (by linarith)
      dsimp at hlt ⊢
      rwa [hF₂_bot] at hlt
    · have hlt := hF₂_mono θ₂ ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt h1⟩ ⟨by linarith, le_rfl⟩ h1
      dsimp at hlt ⊢
      rwa [hF₂_diag] at hlt
  
  have h_ex_plus_pt : ∀ θ p : ℝ,
      ∃ θ₂ : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
        (θ < θ₂ ∧ θ₂ < θ + 2 * Real.pi) ∧ F₁ θ θ₂ = p := by
    intro θ p
    by_cases hp : (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h
    · have hcont1 : ContinuousOn (F₁ θ) (Set.Icc θ (θ + 2 * Real.pi)) :=
        (hF₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousOn
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Set.Icc (F₁ θ (θ + 2 * Real.pi)) (F₁ θ θ) := by
        rw [hF₁_top, hF₁_diag]
        exact ⟨le_of_lt hp.1, le_of_lt hp.2⟩
      obtain ⟨θ₂, hθ₂_mem, hθ₂_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (by linarith) hcont1 hp_mem
      have hne_lo : θ₂ ≠ θ := by
        intro h_eq; rw [h_eq, hF₁_diag] at hθ₂_eq; linarith [hp.2]
      have hne_hi : θ₂ ≠ θ + 2 * Real.pi := by
        intro h_eq; rw [h_eq, hF₁_top] at hθ₂_eq; linarith [hp.1]
      exact ⟨θ₂, fun _ => ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hθ₂_mem.1 hne_lo.symm,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hθ₂_mem.2 hne_hi⟩, hθ₂_eq⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨θ, fun h => False.elim (hp h)⟩
  obtain ⟨Theta_plus, hTheta_plus⟩ : ∃ Theta_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
        (θ < Theta_plus θ p ∧ Theta_plus θ p < θ + 2 * Real.pi) ∧ F₁ θ (Theta_plus θ p) = p :=
    ⟨fun θ p => Classical.choose (h_ex_plus_pt θ p),
     fun θ p hp => Classical.choose_spec (h_ex_plus_pt θ p) hp⟩
  let P_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun θ p => F₂ θ (Theta_plus θ p)
  have h_ex_minus_pt : ∀ θ p : ℝ,
      ∃ θ₁ : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
        (θ - 2 * Real.pi < θ₁ ∧ θ₁ < θ) ∧ F₂ θ₁ θ = p := by
    intro θ p
    by_cases hp : (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h
    · have hcont2 : ContinuousOn (fun θ₁ => F₂ θ₁ θ) (Set.Icc (θ - 2 * Real.pi) θ) :=
        (hF₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).continuousOn
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Set.Icc (F₂ (θ - 2 * Real.pi) θ) (F₂ θ θ) := by
        rw [hF₂_bot, hF₂_diag]
        exact ⟨le_of_lt hp.1, le_of_lt hp.2⟩
      obtain ⟨θ₁, hθ₁_mem, hθ₁_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith) hcont2 hp_mem
      dsimp at hθ₁_eq
      have hne_lo : θ₁ ≠ θ - 2 * Real.pi := by
        intro h_eq; rw [h_eq, hF₂_bot] at hθ₁_eq; linarith [hp.1]
      have hne_hi : θ₁ ≠ θ := by
        intro h_eq; rw [h_eq, hF₂_diag] at hθ₁_eq; linarith [hp.2]
      exact ⟨θ₁, fun _ => ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hθ₁_mem.1 hne_lo.symm,
        lt_of_le_of_ne hθ₁_mem.2 hne_hi⟩, hθ₁_eq⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨θ, fun h => False.elim (hp h)⟩
  obtain ⟨Theta_minus, hTheta_minus⟩ : ∃ Theta_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
        (θ - 2 * Real.pi < Theta_minus θ p ∧ Theta_minus θ p < θ) ∧ F₂ (Theta_minus θ p) θ = p :=
    ⟨fun θ p => Classical.choose (h_ex_minus_pt θ p),
     fun θ p hp => Classical.choose_spec (h_ex_minus_pt θ p) hp⟩
  let P_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun θ p => F₁ (Theta_minus θ p) θ
  
  have hTheta_plus_unique : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, θ₁ < θ₂ → θ₂ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi →
      Theta_plus θ₁ (F₁ θ₁ θ₂) = θ₂ := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂ h1 h2
    have hp := (hF_chord_strip θ₁ θ₂ h1 h2).1
    obtain ⟨hb, heq⟩ := hTheta_plus θ₁ (F₁ θ₁ θ₂) hp
    exact (hF₁_anti θ₁).injOn ⟨le_of_lt hb.1, le_of_lt hb.2⟩ ⟨le_of_lt h1, le_of_lt h2⟩ heq
  have hTheta_minus_unique : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, θ₁ < θ₂ → θ₂ < θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi →
      Theta_minus θ₂ (F₂ θ₁ θ₂) = θ₁ := by
    intro θ₁ θ₂ h1 h2
    have hp := (hF_chord_strip θ₁ θ₂ h1 h2).2
    obtain ⟨hb, heq⟩ := hTheta_minus θ₂ (F₂ θ₁ θ₂) hp
    exact (hF₂_mono θ₂).injOn ⟨le_of_lt hb.1, le_of_lt hb.2⟩ ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt h1⟩ heq
  have hPhi_maps_to : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
      (Theta_plus θ p, P_plus θ p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h ∧
      (Theta_minus θ p, P_minus θ p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h := by
    intro θ p hp
    obtain ⟨hb_p, _⟩ := hTheta_plus θ p hp
    obtain ⟨hb_m, _⟩ := hTheta_minus θ p hp
    exact ⟨(hF_chord_strip θ (Theta_plus θ p) hb_p.1 hb_p.2).2,
      (hF_chord_strip (Theta_minus θ p) θ hb_m.2 (by linarith [hb_m.1])).1⟩
  have hPhi_left_inv : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
      Theta_minus (Theta_plus θ p) (P_plus θ p) = θ ∧
      P_minus (Theta_plus θ p) (P_plus θ p) = p := by
    intro θ p hp
    obtain ⟨hb_p, heq_p⟩ := hTheta_plus θ p hp
    have h1 : Theta_minus (Theta_plus θ p) (P_plus θ p) = θ :=
      hTheta_minus_unique θ (Theta_plus θ p) hb_p.1 hb_p.2
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    dsimp [P_minus]
    rw [h1, heq_p]
  have hPhi_right_inv : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
      Theta_plus (Theta_minus θ p) (P_minus θ p) = θ ∧
      P_plus (Theta_minus θ p) (P_minus θ p) = p := by
    intro θ p hp
    obtain ⟨hb_m, heq_m⟩ := hTheta_minus θ p hp
    have h1 : Theta_plus (Theta_minus θ p) (P_minus θ p) = θ :=
      hTheta_plus_unique (Theta_minus θ p) θ hb_m.2 (by linarith [hb_m.1])
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    dsimp [P_plus]
    rw [h1, heq_m]
  have hTheta_plus_qp : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
      Theta_plus (θ + 2 * Real.pi) p = Theta_plus θ p + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro θ p hp
    obtain ⟨hb_p, heq_p⟩ := hTheta_plus θ p hp
    have h1 := hTheta_plus_unique (θ + 2 * Real.pi) (Theta_plus θ p + 2 * Real.pi)
      (by linarith [hb_p.1]) (by linarith [hb_p.2])
    rwa [hF₁_per, heq_p] at h1
  have hTheta_plus_anti_p : ∀ θ p₁ p₂ : ℝ,
      (θ, p₁) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → (θ, p₂) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → p₁ < p₂ →
      Theta_plus θ p₂ < Theta_plus θ p₁ := by
    intro θ p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ hlt
    obtain ⟨hb₁, heq₁⟩ := hTheta_plus θ p₁ hp₁
    obtain ⟨hb₂, heq₂⟩ := hTheta_plus θ p₂ hp₂
    by_contra h_not
    rw [not_lt] at h_not
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_not with h_eq | h_gt
    · rw [h_eq] at heq₁
      linarith [heq₁, heq₂]
    · have := hF₁_anti θ ⟨le_of_lt hb₁.1, le_of_lt hb₁.2⟩ ⟨le_of_lt hb₂.1, le_of_lt hb₂.2⟩ h_gt
      linarith [heq₁, heq₂]
  have h_fwd_unique : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ x₂' : ℝ,
      0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ → B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi →
      0 < B.ϕ x₂ - B.ϕ x₁ → B.ϕ x₂ - B.ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
      0 < B.ϕ x₂' - B.ϕ x₁ → B.ϕ x₂' - B.ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) →
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂') = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) →
      x₂ = x₂' := by
    intro x₀ x₁ x₂ x₂' _ _ h2_lo h2_hi h2'_lo h2'_hi heq heq'
    have hϕ_inj : Function.Injective B.ϕ := (strictMono_of_deriv_pos B.ϕ_deriv_pos).injective
    apply hϕ_inj
    apply (hF₁_anti (B.ϕ x₁)).injOn
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    dsimp [F₁]
    exact heq.trans heq'.symm
  
  have h_per_red : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∃ θ₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, Function.Periodic f (2 * Real.pi) → f θ = f θ₀ := by
    intro θ
    let k : ℤ := Int.floor (θ / (2 * Real.pi))
    let θ₀ : ℝ := θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have h0 : 0 ≤ θ₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (θ / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [θ₀]; linarith
    have h1 : θ₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (θ / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [θ₀]; linarith
    refine ⟨θ₀, ⟨h0, h1⟩, ?_⟩
    intro f hf
    have heq := hf.int_mul k θ₀
    convert heq using 2
    dsimp [θ₀]; ring
  have hTheta_plus_tendsto : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ_p : ℝ, 0 < δ_p ∧
      ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → B.h θ - p < δ_p →
        Theta_plus θ p - θ < ε ∧ B.r₀ < P_plus θ p := by
    intro ε hε
