      refine ⟨?_, by rw [hRQ_norm, ← hRQ_sub]⟩
      rintro y ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, rfl⟩
      have hy_sub : (a • Q + b • R) - B.c₀ = (Q - B.c₀) + (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_p := by
        rw [hR_eq]
        calc (a • Q + b • (Q + s • unitTangentVec θ_p)) - B.c₀
            = (a + b) • Q - B.c₀ + (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_p := by module
          _ = (Q - B.c₀) + (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_p := by rw [hab, one_smul]
      rw [hy_sub, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left, hinner_en, sub_self, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero,
        add_zero, hinner_Γ ψ_p θ_p, ← hF₂_eq_g θ θ_p]
    · refine ⟨unitNormalVec ψ_m, B.Γ_outward_normal ψ_m, ?_⟩
      intro R' _ _ ⟨s, hs_pos, hR'_eq⟩
      have hPQ_sub : P - Q = (-lam) • unitTangentVec θ := by
        calc P - Q = -(Q - P) := by abel
          _ = -(lam • unitTangentVec θ) := by rw [hQP_eq]
          _ = (-lam) • unitTangentVec θ := (neg_smul lam _).symm
      have hPQ_norm : ‖P - Q‖ = lam := by rw [norm_sub_rev, hQP_norm]
      have hunit_in : ‖P - Q‖⁻¹ • (P - Q) = -unitTangentVec θ := by
        rw [hPQ_norm, hPQ_sub, smul_smul, show lam⁻¹ * (-lam) = -1 by field_simp [ne_of_gt hlam_pos],
          neg_one_smul]
      have hrefl : billiardReflect (unitNormalVec ψ_m) (‖P - Q‖⁻¹ • (P - Q)) =
          -unitTangentVec θ_m := by
        rw [hunit_in, hreflect_neg_e, show 2 * ψ_m - θ = θ_m by dsimp [ψ_m]; ring]
      rw [hrefl] at hR'_eq
      have hPR'_sub : P - R' = s • unitTangentVec θ_m := by
        rw [hR'_eq]; simp [smul_neg]
      have hPR'_norm : ‖P - R'‖ = s := by
        rw [hPR'_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hnorm_e, mul_one, abs_of_pos hs_pos]
      refine ⟨?_, by rw [hPR'_norm, ← hPR'_sub]⟩
      rintro y ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, rfl⟩
      have hy_sub : (a • P + b • R') - B.c₀ = (P - B.c₀) - (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_m := by
        rw [hR'_eq]
        calc (a • P + b • (P + s • -unitTangentVec θ_m)) - B.c₀
            = (a + b) • P - B.c₀ - (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_m := by module
          _ = (P - B.c₀) - (b * s) • unitTangentVec θ_m := by rw [hab, one_smul]
      rw [hy_sub, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, hinner_en, sub_self, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero,
        sub_zero, hinner_Γ ψ_m θ_m, ← hF₁_eq_g θ_m θ]
  exact ⟨{
    Theta_plus := Theta_plus
    P_plus := P_plus
    Theta_minus := Theta_minus
    P_minus := P_minus
    Theta_plus_cont := hTheta_plus_cont
    Theta_minus_cont := hTheta_minus_cont
    Theta_plus_bounds := fun θ p hp => (hTheta_plus θ p hp).1
    Theta_minus_bounds := fun θ p hp => (hTheta_minus θ p hp).1
    Theta_plus_quasiperiodic := hTheta_plus_qp
    Theta_plus_strictAnti_p := hTheta_plus_anti_p
    Theta_plus_tendsto_zero := hTheta_plus_tendsto
    Theta_minus_tendsto_zero := hTheta_minus_tendsto
    Theta_plus_eq := fun θ p hp => ⟨(hTheta_plus θ p hp).2, rfl⟩
    P_minus_eq := fun θ p _ => rfl
    Phi_maps_to := hPhi_maps_to
    Phi_left_inv := hPhi_left_inv
    Phi_right_inv := hPhi_right_inv
    Phi_measure_preserving := hPhi_meas
    forward_step_unique := h_fwd_unique
    chord_reflection := hchord_refl
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (hΩ : IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain Ω)
    (hCollar : HasContinuousCausticCollar Ω)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω)
    (P : SupportPhaseMapData Ω B) :
    Nonempty (PhaseCollarGraphData Ω B P)

signature.name: caustic_collar_invariant_graphs
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (hΩ : IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain Ω)
    (hCollar : HasContinuousCausticCollar Ω)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω)
    (P : SupportPhaseMapData Ω B) :
    Nonempty (PhaseCollarGraphData Ω B P)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨A, _, _, _, H₀, hSlice0, hCaustic⟩ := hCollar
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]

  
  have h_inner_eq : ∀ u v : Plane, inner ℝ u v = u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 := by
    intro u v
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hn_inner_self : ∀ θ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitNormalVec θ) (unitNormalVec θ) = 1 := by
    intro θ
    rw [h_inner_eq]
    change Real.cos θ * Real.cos θ + Real.sin θ * Real.sin θ = 1
    linear_combination Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  have hn_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖unitNormalVec θ‖ = 1 := by
    intro θ
    have hsq : ‖unitNormalVec θ‖ * ‖unitNormalVec θ‖ = 1 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, hn_inner_self]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (unitNormalVec θ)]
  have h_tn_orth : ∀ θ : ℝ, inner ℝ (unitTangentVec θ) (unitNormalVec θ) = 0 := by
    intro θ
    rw [h_inner_eq]
    change (-Real.sin θ) * Real.cos θ + Real.cos θ * Real.sin θ = 0
    ring
  have hn_cont : Continuous unitNormalVec := by
    unfold unitNormalVec
    exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ)).comp
      (continuous_pi fun i => by fin_cases i <;> fun_prop)
  have hn_per : ∀ θ : ℝ, unitNormalVec (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = unitNormalVec θ := by
    intro θ
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change Real.cos (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = Real.cos θ
      exact Real.cos_add_two_pi θ
    · change Real.sin (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = Real.sin θ
      exact Real.sin_add_two_pi θ
  have hn_add_pi : ∀ θ : ℝ, unitNormalVec (θ + Real.pi) = -unitNormalVec θ := by
    intro θ
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change Real.cos (θ + Real.pi) = -Real.cos θ
      exact Real.cos_add_pi θ
    · change Real.sin (θ + Real.pi) = -Real.sin θ
      exact Real.sin_add_pi θ
  have h_frame : ∀ (v : Plane) (θ : ℝ),
      v = inner ℝ v (unitNormalVec θ) • unitNormalVec θ +
          inner ℝ v (unitTangentVec θ) • unitTangentVec θ := by
    intro v θ
    rw [h_inner_eq v (unitNormalVec θ), h_inner_eq v (unitTangentVec θ)]
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change v 0 = (v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ) * Real.cos θ +
          (v 0 * (-Real.sin θ) + v 1 * Real.cos θ) * (-Real.sin θ)
      linear_combination -v 0 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    · change v 1 = (v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ) * Real.sin θ +
          (v 0 * (-Real.sin θ) + v 1 * Real.cos θ) * Real.cos θ
      linear_combination -v 1 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  have h_polar : ∀ u : Plane, ‖u‖ = 1 → ∃ θ : ℝ, unitNormalVec θ = u := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm_sq : u 0 * u 0 + u 1 * u 1 = 1 := by
      have h1 : inner ℝ u u = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_mul_norm, hu, mul_one]
      rw [h_inner_eq] at h1
      exact h1
    let z : ℂ := ⟨u 0, u 1⟩
    have hz_normSq : Complex.normSq z = 1 := by
      simp [Complex.normSq, z, hnorm_sq]
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, hz_normSq, Real.sqrt_one]
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at hz_norm
      norm_num at hz_norm
    refine ⟨Complex.arg z, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · change Real.cos (Complex.arg z) = u 0
      rw [Complex.cos_arg hz_ne, hz_norm, div_one]
    · change Real.sin (Complex.arg z) = u 1
      rw [Complex.sin_arg, hz_norm, div_one]

  let uVec : ℝ → UnitCircle := fun θ =>
    ⟨unitNormalVec θ, by rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, hn_norm]⟩
  have huVec_cont : Continuous uVec := hn_cont.subtype_mk _
  have : Nonempty UnitCircle := ⟨uVec 0⟩

  
  have h_hahn_banach : ∀ (U : Set Plane), Convex ℝ U → IsOpen U → U.Nonempty →
      ∀ z : Plane, z ∉ U →
        ∃ u : Plane, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ closure U, inner ℝ (x - z) u ≤ 0 := by
    intro U hconv hopen hne z hz
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_open_point hconv hopen hz
    have hf_ne : f ≠ 0 := by
      intro hf0
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hne
      have hlt := hf x₀ hx₀
      simp [hf0] at hlt
    let w : Plane := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Plane).symm f
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw0
      apply hf_ne
      exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ Plane).symm.map_eq_zero_iff).mp hw0
    have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw_ne
    let u : Plane := ‖w‖⁻¹ • w
    have hu_norm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hw_pos),
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hw_pos)]
    have hU_le : U ⊆ {x : Plane | inner ℝ (x - z) u ≤ 0} := by
      intro x hx
      have hfx : inner ℝ w x < inner ℝ w z := by
        simpa [w, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply] using hf x hx
      have hsub : inner ℝ (x - z) u = ‖w‖⁻¹ * (inner ℝ w x - inner ℝ w z) := by
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right,
          real_inner_comm x w, real_inner_comm z w]
        ring
      change inner ℝ (x - z) u ≤ 0
      rw [hsub]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hw_pos)) (by linarith)
    have hclosed : IsClosed {x : Plane | inner ℝ (x - z) u ≤ 0} :=
      isClosed_le ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).inner continuous_const) continuous_const
    exact ⟨u, hu_norm, fun x hx => closure_minimal hU_le hclosed hx⟩

  have h_deriv_max : ∀ (α : ℝ → Plane), ContDiff ℝ ∞ α →
      ∀ (z v : Plane) (t₀ : ℝ),
        (∀ t : ℝ, inner ℝ (α t - z) v ≤ inner ℝ (α t₀ - z) v) →
        inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) v = 0 := by
    intro α hα z v t₀ hmax
    have hd_α : HasDerivAt α (deriv α t₀) t₀ :=
      (hα.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hd_inner := HasDerivAt.inner ℝ (hd_α.sub_const z) (hasDerivAt_const t₀ v)
    simp only [inner_zero_right, zero_add] at hd_inner
    have hloc : IsLocalMax (fun t : ℝ => inner ℝ (α t - z) v) t₀ :=
      IsMaxOn.isLocalMax (s := Set.univ) (fun t _ => hmax t) Filter.univ_mem
    exact hloc.hasDerivAt_eq_zero hd_inner

  
  let supp : Set Plane → ℝ → ℝ := fun S θ =>
    sSup ((fun x : Plane => inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ)) '' S)
  let g_col : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun b θ =>
    if hb : b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 then supp (collarSlice H₀ b hb) θ else 0

  have hg_col_univ : ∀ (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) (θ : ℝ),
      g_col b θ =
        sSup ((fun ζ : UnitCircle =>
          inner ℝ ((H₀ (ζ, ⟨b, hb⟩) : Plane) - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ)) '' Set.univ) := by
    intro b hb θ
    dsimp only [g_col, supp, collarSlice]
    rw [dif_pos hb]
    congr 1
    ext r
    simp

  let D_ico : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ
  have hg_cont_ico : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g_col z.1 z.2) D_ico := by
    let Φ : ↑D_ico → UnitCircle → ℝ := fun p ζ =>
      inner ℝ ((H₀ (ζ, ⟨p.1.1, p.2.1⟩) : Plane) - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec p.1.2)
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry Φ) := by
      have h_pair : Continuous (fun q : ↑D_ico × UnitCircle =>
          (q.2, (⟨q.1.1.1, q.1.2.1⟩ : Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1))) :=
        continuous_snd.prodMk
          ((continuous_fst.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).subtype_mk _)
      have h_pt : Continuous (fun q : ↑D_ico × UnitCircle =>
          (H₀ (q.2, ⟨q.1.1.1, q.1.2.1⟩) : Plane) - B.c₀) :=
        ((continuous_subtype_val.comp H₀.continuous).comp h_pair).sub continuous_const
      have h_vec : Continuous (fun q : ↑D_ico × UnitCircle => unitNormalVec q.1.1.2) :=
        hn_cont.comp (continuous_snd.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst))
      exact h_pt.inner h_vec
    have h_sup_cont : Continuous (fun p : ↑D_ico => sSup (Φ p '' Set.univ)) :=
      isCompact_univ.continuous_sSup hΦ_cont
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    have h_eq : D_ico.domRestrict (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g_col z.1 z.2) =
        (fun p : ↑D_ico => sSup (Φ p '' Set.univ)) := by
      ext p
      exact hg_col_univ p.1.1 p.2.1 p.1.2
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_sup_cont

  have hg_per_ico : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, Function.Periodic (g_col b) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb θ
    simp only [g_col, dif_pos hb, supp, hn_per]

  have hg_zero : ∀ θ : ℝ, g_col 0 θ = B.h θ := by
    intro θ
    have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_rfl, zero_lt_one⟩
    dsimp only [g_col, supp]
    rw [dif_pos hb0, hSlice0]
    apply IsGreatest.csSup_eq
    refine ⟨⟨supportBoundaryPt B.c₀ B.h θ, B.Γ_mem_frontier θ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have hsub : supportBoundaryPt B.c₀ B.h θ - B.c₀ =
          B.h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv B.h θ • unitTangentVec θ := by
        dsimp [supportBoundaryPt]
        abel
      dsimp only
      rw [hsub, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
        hn_inner_self, h_tn_orth]
      ring
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact B.support_bound_closure θ x (frontier_subset_closure hx)

  have hg_lt_h : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ θ : ℝ, g_col b θ < B.h θ := by
    intro b hb_oo θ
    have hb : b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hb_oo.1, hb_oo.2⟩
    let C_b : Set Plane := collarSlice H₀ b hb
    have hC_comp : IsCompact C_b :=
      isCompact_range
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp (H₀.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)))
    have hC_ne : C_b.Nonempty := ⟨(H₀ (uVec 0, ⟨b, hb⟩) : Plane), uVec 0, rfl⟩
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : Plane => inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ)) :=
      (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).inner continuous_const
    obtain ⟨y_max, hy_mem_C, hy_max⟩ := hC_comp.exists_isMaxOn hC_ne hf_cont.continuousOn
    have hg_eq : g_col b θ = inner ℝ (y_max - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) := by
      dsimp only [g_col, supp]
      rw [dif_pos hb]
      apply IsGreatest.csSup_eq
      refine ⟨⟨y_max, hy_mem_C, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hy_max hx
    have hy_mem_Ω : y_max ∈ Ω := (hCaustic b hb_oo.1 hb_oo.2).1 hy_mem_C
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_ball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ.domain.isOpen y_max hy_mem_Ω
    let δ : ℝ := η / 2
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
    let y' : Plane := y_max + δ • unitNormalVec θ
    have hy'_dist : dist y' y_max < η := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, show y' - y_max = δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos, hn_norm, mul_one]
      dsimp [δ]; linarith
    have hy'_cl : y' ∈ closure Ω := subset_closure (hη_ball hy'_dist)
    have h_bound := B.support_bound_closure θ y' hy'_cl
    have h_inner_y' : inner ℝ (y' - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) = g_col b θ + δ := by
      rw [show y' - B.c₀ = (y_max - B.c₀) + δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
        inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, hn_inner_self, mul_one, hg_eq]
    linarith

  have hg_tendsto_raw : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ b₁ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ ∧ b₁ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁, ∀ θ : ℝ, B.h θ - g_col b θ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ D_ico := fun z hz => ⟨⟨hz.1.1, by linarith [hz.1.2]⟩, trivial⟩
    have huc : UniformContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g_col z.1 z.2) K :=
      hK_comp.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hg_cont_ico.mono hK_sub)
    rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at huc
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := huc ε hε
    refine ⟨min δ (1 / 2), lt_min hδ_pos (by norm_num), min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro b hb θ
    let k : ℤ := Int.floor (θ / (2 * Real.pi))
    let θ₀ : ℝ := θ - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hθ₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ θ₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (θ / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [θ₀]; linarith
    have hθ₀_lt : θ₀ < 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (θ / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [θ₀]; linarith
    have hb_le_half : b ≤ 1 / 2 := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2 (min_le_right _ _))
    have hb_lt_δ : b < δ := lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2 (min_le_left _ _)
    have hbK : (b, θ₀) ∈ K := ⟨⟨le_of_lt hb.1, hb_le_half⟩, ⟨hθ₀_nonneg, le_of_lt hθ₀_lt⟩⟩
    have h0K : ((0 : ℝ), θ₀) ∈ K := ⟨⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩, ⟨hθ₀_nonneg, le_of_lt hθ₀_lt⟩⟩
    have hdist : dist (b, θ₀) ((0 : ℝ), θ₀) < δ := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, sub_self, abs_zero,
        abs_of_pos hb.1, max_eq_left (le_of_lt hb.1)]
      exact hb_lt_δ
    have h_close := hδ (b, θ₀) hbK ((0 : ℝ), θ₀) h0K hdist
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hg_zero θ₀] at h_close
    have hθ_eq : θ = θ₀ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by dsimp [θ₀]; ring
    have hh_per : B.h θ = B.h θ₀ := by
      rw [hθ_eq]
      simpa [mul_comm] using B.h_periodic.int_mul k θ₀
    have hg_per_b : g_col b θ = g_col b θ₀ := by
      have hb_ico : b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hb.1, by linarith⟩
      rw [hθ_eq]
      simpa [mul_comm] using (hg_per_ico b hb_ico).int_mul k θ₀
    rw [hh_per, hg_per_b]
    linarith [abs_sub_comm (g_col b θ₀) (B.h θ₀), le_abs_self (B.h θ₀ - g_col b θ₀)]

  
  obtain ⟨δ_p, hδ_p_pos, hδ_p⟩ :=
    P.Theta_plus_tendsto_zero (Real.pi / 2) (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
  let δ_init : ℝ := min (B.r₀ / 2) δ_p
  have hδ_init_pos : 0 < δ_init := lt_min (by linarith [B.r₀_pos]) hδ_p_pos
  obtain ⟨b_init, hb_init_pos, hb_init_le_half, hb_init_close⟩ :=
    hg_tendsto_raw δ_init hδ_init_pos
  have hb_init_lt_one : b_init < 1 := by linarith

  have hb_ico_of : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init → b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    fun hb => ⟨le_of_lt hb.1, lt_trans hb.2 hb_init_lt_one⟩
  have hb_ioo_of : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init → b ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    fun hb => ⟨hb.1, lt_trans hb.2 hb_init_lt_one⟩

  have hg_bounds : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
      B.r₀ < g_col b θ ∧ g_col b θ < B.h θ := by
    intro b hb θ
    refine ⟨?_, hg_lt_h b (hb_ioo_of hb) θ⟩
    have h_close : B.h θ - g_col b θ < B.r₀ / 2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hb_init_close b hb θ) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_2r : 2 * B.r₀ ≤ B.h θ := B.two_r₀_le_h θ
    linarith [B.r₀_pos]

  have hg_strip : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
      (θ, g_col b θ) ∈ phaseStrip B.h := by
    intro b hb θ
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := hg_bounds b hb θ
    refine ⟨?_, h_hi⟩
    linarith [B.r₀_pos, B.h_pos (θ + Real.pi)]

  have hg_step_and_P : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
      P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ) - θ < Real.pi ∧ B.r₀ < P.P_plus θ (g_col b θ) := by
    intro b hb θ
    have h_close : B.h θ - g_col b θ < δ_p :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hb_init_close b hb θ) (min_le_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨h_step, h_P⟩ := hδ_p θ (g_col b θ) (hg_strip b hb θ) h_close
    exact ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three], h_P⟩

  
  let U_of : ℝ → Set Plane := fun b =>
    if hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init then
      Classical.choose (hCaustic b hb.1 (lt_trans hb.2 hb_init_lt_one)).2.1
    else ∅

  have hU_spec : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init),
      IsBoundedStrictlyConvexDomain (U_of b) ∧
        frontier (U_of b) = collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb) := by
    intro b hb
    dsimp only [U_of]
    rw [dif_pos hb]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hCaustic b hb.1 (lt_trans hb.2 hb_init_lt_one)).2.1

  have hU_max : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init) (θ : ℝ),
      (∃ y ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb),
        inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) = g_col b θ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ closure (U_of b), inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) ≤ g_col b θ) := by
    intro b hb θ
    obtain ⟨hU_dom, hU_front⟩ := hU_spec b hb
    have hcl_comp : IsCompact (closure (U_of b)) :=
      Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded isClosed_closure hU_dom.isBounded.closure
    have hcl_ne : (closure (U_of b)).Nonempty := hU_dom.nonempty.closure
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : Plane => inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ)) :=
      (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).inner continuous_const
    obtain ⟨y_max, hy_cl, hy_max⟩ := hcl_comp.exists_isMaxOn hcl_ne hf_cont.continuousOn
    have hy_not_in_U : y_max ∉ U_of b := by
      intro hy_in
      obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_ball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_dom.isOpen y_max hy_in
      let δ : ℝ := η / 2
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
      let y' : Plane := y_max + δ • unitNormalVec θ
      have hy'_dist : dist y' y_max < η := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, show y' - y_max = δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
          norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos, hn_norm, mul_one]
        dsimp [δ]; linarith
      have hy'_cl : y' ∈ closure (U_of b) := subset_closure (hη_ball hy'_dist)
      have h_le : inner ℝ (y' - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) ≤
          inner ℝ (y_max - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) := hy_max hy'_cl
      have h_eq : inner ℝ (y' - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) =
          inner ℝ (y_max - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) + δ := by
        rw [show y' - B.c₀ = (y_max - B.c₀) + δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
          inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, hn_inner_self, mul_one]
      linarith
    have hy_slice : y_max ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb) := by
      rw [← hU_front, hU_dom.isOpen.frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨hy_cl, hy_not_in_U⟩
    have h_slice_sub : collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb) ⊆ closure (U_of b) := by
      rw [← hU_front]
      exact frontier_subset_closure
    have hg_eq : g_col b θ = inner ℝ (y_max - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) := by
      dsimp only [g_col, supp]
      rw [dif_pos (hb_ico_of hb)]
      apply IsGreatest.csSup_eq
      refine ⟨⟨y_max, hy_slice, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hy_max (h_slice_sub hx)
    refine ⟨⟨y_max, hy_slice, hg_eq.symm⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [hg_eq]
    exact hy_max hx

  have hU_ball : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, Metric.closedBall B.c₀ B.r₀ ⊆ U_of b := by
    intro b hb z hz_ball
    by_contra hz_not_in
    obtain ⟨hU_dom, _⟩ := hU_spec b hb
    obtain ⟨u, hu_norm, hu_sep⟩ :=
      h_hahn_banach (U_of b) hU_dom.convex hU_dom.isOpen hU_dom.nonempty z hz_not_in
    obtain ⟨θ_star, hθ_star⟩ := h_polar u hu_norm
    obtain ⟨⟨y_max, hy_slice, hy_val⟩, _⟩ := hU_max b hb θ_star
    have hy_cl : y_max ∈ closure (U_of b) := by
      rw [← (hU_spec b hb).2] at hy_slice
      exact frontier_subset_closure hy_slice
    have h_sep_y := hu_sep y_max hy_cl
    rw [← hθ_star] at h_sep_y
    have h_le_z : inner ℝ (y_max - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ_star) ≤
        inner ℝ (z - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ_star) := by
      have : y_max - z = (y_max - B.c₀) - (z - B.c₀) := by abel
      rw [this, inner_sub_left] at h_sep_y
      linarith
    have hz_norm : ‖z - B.c₀‖ ≤ B.r₀ := by simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz_ball
    have h_cs : inner ℝ (z - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ_star) ≤ B.r₀ := by
      calc inner ℝ (z - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ_star)
          ≤ ‖z - B.c₀‖ * ‖unitNormalVec θ_star‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ = ‖z - B.c₀‖ := by rw [hn_norm, mul_one]
        _ ≤ B.r₀ := hz_norm
    have hg_gt : B.r₀ < g_col b θ_star := (hg_bounds b hb θ_star).1
    linarith

  have h_slice_norm_gt : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init),
      ∀ y ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb), B.r₀ < ‖y - B.c₀‖ := by
    intro b hb y hy
    obtain ⟨hU_dom, hU_front⟩ := hU_spec b hb
    rw [← hU_front, hU_dom.isOpen.frontier_eq] at hy
    by_contra h_le
    push_neg at h_le
    have hy_ball : y ∈ Metric.closedBall B.c₀ B.r₀ := by
      simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using h_le
    exact hy.2 (hU_ball b hb hy_ball)

  let ρ : ℝ → UnitCircle → ℝ := fun b u =>
    sSup {t : ℝ | 0 ≤ t ∧ B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b}

  have hρ_props : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init) (u : UnitCircle),
      B.r₀ ≤ ρ b u ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < ρ b u → B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b) ∧
      (B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb) ∧
        B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∉ U_of b) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, ρ b u < t → B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∉ closure (U_of b)) := by
    intro b hb u
    obtain ⟨hU_dom, hU_front⟩ := hU_spec b hb
    have hu_norm : ‖(u : Plane)‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.2
    let S_ray : Set ℝ := {t : ℝ | 0 ≤ t ∧ B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b}
    have hr₀_mem : B.r₀ ∈ S_ray := by
      refine ⟨le_of_lt B.r₀_pos, hU_ball b hb ?_⟩
      rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos B.r₀_pos, hu_norm, mul_one]
    have hS_ne : S_ray.Nonempty := ⟨B.r₀, hr₀_mem⟩
    obtain ⟨R_b, hR_b⟩ := hU_dom.isBounded.subset_closedBall B.c₀
    have hS_bdd : BddAbove S_ray := by
      refine ⟨R_b, ?_⟩
      intro t ht
      have hball := hR_b ht.2
      rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1, hu_norm, mul_one] at hball
      exact hball
    have hρ_ge : B.r₀ ≤ ρ b u := le_csSup hS_bdd hr₀_mem
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ b u := lt_of_lt_of_le B.r₀_pos hρ_ge
    have hc₀_in_U : B.c₀ ∈ U_of b :=
      hU_ball b hb (mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt B.r₀_pos))
    have h_in : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < ρ b u → B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b := by
      intro t ht0 ht_lt
      obtain ⟨t', ht'_mem, htt'⟩ := (lt_csSup_iff hS_bdd hS_ne).mp ht_lt
      have ht'_pos : 0 < t' := lt_of_le_of_lt ht0 htt'
      have hw1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t / t' := sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one ht'_pos).mpr (le_of_lt htt'))
      have hw2 : 0 ≤ t / t' := div_nonneg ht0 (le_of_lt ht'_pos)
      have hconv := hU_dom.convex hc₀_in_U ht'_mem.2 hw1 hw2 (by ring)
      have hdiv : (t / t') * t' = t := div_mul_cancel₀ t (ne_of_gt ht'_pos)
      have heq : (1 - t / t') • B.c₀ + (t / t') • (B.c₀ + t' • (u : Plane)) =
          B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) := by
        calc (1 - t / t') • B.c₀ + (t / t') • (B.c₀ + t' • (u : Plane))
            = ((1 - t / t') + t / t') • B.c₀ + ((t / t') * t') • (u : Plane) := by
                rw [smul_add, add_smul, mul_smul]; abel
          _ = B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) := by rw [sub_add_cancel, one_smul, hdiv]
      rwa [heq] at hconv
    have h_not_in : B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∉ U_of b := by
      intro hp_in
      obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_ball⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_dom.isOpen (B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane)) hp_in
      let δ : ℝ := η / 2
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
      have hp_δ_in : B.c₀ + (ρ b u + δ) • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b := by
        apply hη_ball
        rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm,
          show (B.c₀ + (ρ b u + δ) • (u : Plane)) - (B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane)) =
            δ • (u : Plane) by rw [add_smul]; abel,
          norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos, hu_norm, mul_one]
        dsimp [δ]; linarith
      have h_mem_δ : ρ b u + δ ∈ S_ray := ⟨by linarith, hp_δ_in⟩
      have h_le := le_csSup hS_bdd h_mem_δ
      linarith
    have h_in_cl : B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∈ closure (U_of b) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro ε hε
      let δ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (B.r₀ / 2)
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith [B.r₀_pos])
      have hδ_le_r₀ : δ ≤ B.r₀ / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      have ht_in : B.c₀ + (ρ b u - δ) • (u : Plane) ∈ U_of b :=
        h_in (ρ b u - δ) (by linarith [B.r₀_pos]) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨B.c₀ + (ρ b u - δ) • (u : Plane), ht_in, ?_⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm,
        show (B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane)) - (B.c₀ + (ρ b u - δ) • (u : Plane)) =
          δ • (u : Plane) by rw [sub_smul]; abel,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos, hu_norm, mul_one]
      have : δ ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have h_slice : B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb) := by
      rw [← hU_front, hU_dom.isOpen.frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨h_in_cl, h_not_in⟩
    have h_out : ∀ t : ℝ, ρ b u < t → B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) ∉ closure (U_of b) := by
      intro t ht_gt hy_cl
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := lt_trans hρ_pos ht_gt
      have hy_ne : B.c₀ ≠ B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane) := by
        intro heq
        have hnorm : ‖(B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane)) - B.c₀‖ = 0 := by
          rw [← heq, sub_self, norm_zero]
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos ht_pos, hu_norm, mul_one] at hnorm
        linarith
      have hseg_mem : B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) ∈
          openSegment ℝ B.c₀ (B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane)) := by
        refine ⟨1 - ρ b u / t, ρ b u / t,
          sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_one ht_pos).mpr ht_gt),
          div_pos hρ_pos ht_pos, by ring, ?_⟩
        have hdiv : (ρ b u / t) * t = ρ b u := div_mul_cancel₀ (ρ b u) (ne_of_gt ht_pos)
        calc (1 - ρ b u / t) • B.c₀ + (ρ b u / t) • (B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane))
            = ((1 - ρ b u / t) + ρ b u / t) • B.c₀ + ((ρ b u / t) * t) • (u : Plane) := by
                rw [smul_add, add_smul, mul_smul]; abel
          _ = B.c₀ + ρ b u • (u : Plane) := by rw [sub_add_cancel, one_smul, hdiv]
      exact h_not_in (hU_dom.openSegment_subset B.c₀ (subset_closure hc₀_in_U)
        (B.c₀ + t • (u : Plane)) hy_cl hy_ne hseg_mem)
    exact ⟨hρ_ge, h_in, ⟨h_slice, h_not_in⟩, h_out⟩

  have hρ_slice_norm : ∀ b (hb : b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init),
      ∀ y ∈ collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb), ∀ u : UnitCircle,
        ‖y - B.c₀‖⁻¹ • (y - B.c₀) = (u : Plane) → ‖y - B.c₀‖ = ρ b u := by
    intro b hb y hy u hu_eq
    obtain ⟨hU_dom, hU_front⟩ := hU_spec b hb
    have hy_gt : B.r₀ < ‖y - B.c₀‖ := h_slice_norm_gt b hb y hy
    have hy_norm_pos : 0 < ‖y - B.c₀‖ := lt_trans B.r₀_pos hy_gt
    have hy_rep : B.c₀ + ‖y - B.c₀‖ • (u : Plane) = y := by
      rw [← hu_eq, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hy_norm_pos), one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
    have hy_front : y ∈ closure (U_of b) \ U_of b := by
      rwa [← hU_dom.isOpen.frontier_eq, hU_front]
    obtain ⟨_, h_in, _, h_out⟩ := hρ_props b hb u
    rcases lt_trichotomy ‖y - B.c₀‖ (ρ b u) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso
      have := h_in ‖y - B.c₀‖ (le_of_lt hy_norm_pos) hlt
      rw [hy_rep] at this
      exact hy_front.2 this
    · exact heq
    · exfalso
      have := h_out ‖y - B.c₀‖ hgt
      rw [hy_rep] at this
      exact this hy_front.1

  have h_nest_of_ρ : ∀ b₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ b₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init,
      (∀ u : UnitCircle, ρ b₁ u < ρ b₂ u) → closure (U_of b₁) ⊆ U_of b₂ := by
    intro b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ h_lt y hy_cl
    by_cases hy_eq : y = B.c₀
    · rw [hy_eq]
      exact hU_ball b₂ hb₂ (mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt B.r₀_pos))
    · have h_sub_ne : y - B.c₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hy_eq
      have h_norm_pos : 0 < ‖y - B.c₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr h_sub_ne
      let u : UnitCircle := ⟨‖y - B.c₀‖⁻¹ • (y - B.c₀), by
        rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_norm_pos), inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_norm_pos)]⟩
      have hy_rep : B.c₀ + ‖y - B.c₀‖ • (u : Plane) = y := by
        dsimp [u]
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_norm_pos), one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
      have h_le : ‖y - B.c₀‖ ≤ ρ b₁ u := by
        by_contra h_gt
        push_neg at h_gt
        have h_not := (hρ_props b₁ hb₁ u).2.2.2 ‖y - B.c₀‖ h_gt
        rw [hy_rep] at h_not
        exact h_not hy_cl
      have h_lt₂ : ‖y - B.c₀‖ < ρ b₂ u := lt_of_le_of_lt h_le (h_lt u)
      have h_in₂ := (hρ_props b₂ hb₂ u).2.1 ‖y - B.c₀‖ (le_of_lt h_norm_pos) h_lt₂
      rwa [hy_rep] at h_in₂

  have hρ_cont_cyl : ∀ a d : ℝ, 0 < a → a ≤ d → d < b_init →
      Continuous (fun p : Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle => ρ p.1.1 p.2) := by
    intro a d ha had hd
    have hb_mem_ioo : ∀ b' : Set.Icc a d, b'.1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init :=
      fun b' => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha b'.2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt b'.2.2 hd⟩
    let ι : Set.Icc a d → Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun b' => ⟨b'.1, hb_ico_of (hb_mem_ioo b')⟩
    have hι_cont : Continuous ι := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
    let Y : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d → Plane :=
      fun q => (H₀ (q.1, ι q.2) : Plane) - B.c₀
    have hY_cont : Continuous Y :=
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp H₀.continuous).comp
        (continuous_fst.prodMk (hι_cont.comp continuous_snd))).sub continuous_const
    have hY_slice : ∀ q : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d,
        (H₀ (q.1, ι q.2) : Plane) ∈ collarSlice H₀ q.2.1 (hb_ico_of (hb_mem_ioo q.2)) :=
      fun q => ⟨q.1, rfl⟩
    have hY_pos : ∀ q : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d, 0 < ‖Y q‖ := fun q =>
      lt_trans B.r₀_pos (h_slice_norm_gt q.2.1 (hb_mem_ioo q.2) _ (hY_slice q))
    have hY_ne : ∀ q : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d, ‖Y q‖ ≠ 0 := fun q => ne_of_gt (hY_pos q)
    let u_map : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d → UnitCircle := fun q =>
      ⟨‖Y q‖⁻¹ • Y q, by
        rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hY_pos q)), inv_mul_cancel₀ (hY_ne q)]⟩
    have hu_map_cont : Continuous u_map :=
      (((continuous_norm.comp hY_cont).inv₀ hY_ne).smul hY_cont).subtype_mk _
    let Ψ : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d → Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle :=
      fun q => (q.2, u_map q)
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ := continuous_snd.prodMk hu_map_cont
    have hY_norm_eq : ∀ q : UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d, ‖Y q‖ = ρ q.2.1 (u_map q) :=
      fun q => hρ_slice_norm q.2.1 (hb_mem_ioo q.2) _ (hY_slice q) (u_map q) rfl
    have hΨ_inj : Function.Injective Ψ := by
      intro q₁ q₂ h_eq
      have hb_eq : q₁.2 = q₂.2 := congrArg Prod.fst h_eq
      have hu_eq : u_map q₁ = u_map q₂ := congrArg Prod.snd h_eq
      have hnorm_eq : ‖Y q₁‖ = ‖Y q₂‖ := by
        rw [hY_norm_eq q₁, hY_norm_eq q₂, hb_eq, hu_eq]
      have hunit_eq : ‖Y q₁‖⁻¹ • Y q₁ = ‖Y q₂‖⁻¹ • Y q₂ := congrArg Subtype.val hu_eq
      have hYq_eq : Y q₁ = Y q₂ := by
        calc Y q₁ = ‖Y q₁‖ • (‖Y q₁‖⁻¹ • Y q₁) := by
                rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hY_ne q₁), one_smul]
          _ = ‖Y q₂‖ • (‖Y q₂‖⁻¹ • Y q₂) := by rw [hunit_eq, hnorm_eq]
          _ = Y q₂ := by rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hY_ne q₂), one_smul]
      have hH_val : (H₀ (q₁.1, ι q₁.2) : Plane) = (H₀ (q₂.1, ι q₂.2) : Plane) := by
        dsimp [Y] at hYq_eq
        exact sub_left_inj.mp hYq_eq
      have hH_eq : (q₁.1, ι q₁.2) = (q₂.1, ι q₂.2) :=
        H₀.injective (Subtype.ext hH_val)
      exact Prod.ext (Prod.mk.inj hH_eq).1 hb_eq
    have hΨ_surj : Function.Surjective Ψ := by
      rintro ⟨b', u⟩
      have hu_norm : ‖(u : Plane)‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.2
      have h_mem := (hρ_props b'.1 (hb_mem_ioo b') u).2.2.1.1
      obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := h_mem
      dsimp only at hζ
      refine ⟨(ζ, b'), Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)⟩
      have hY_val : Y (ζ, b') = ρ b'.1 u • (u : Plane) := by
        dsimp [Y, ι]
        rw [hζ, add_sub_cancel_left]
      have hr_pos : 0 < ρ b'.1 u :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le B.r₀_pos (hρ_props b'.1 (hb_mem_ioo b') u).1
      have hY_n : ‖Y (ζ, b')‖ = ρ b'.1 u := by
        rw [hY_val, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos, hu_norm, mul_one]
      change ‖Y (ζ, b')‖⁻¹ • Y (ζ, b') = (u : Plane)
      rw [hY_n, hY_val, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr_pos), one_smul]
    have : CompactSpace (Set.Icc a d) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_Icc
    let Ψ_equiv : (UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d) ≃ (Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle) :=
      Equiv.ofBijective Ψ ⟨hΨ_inj, hΨ_surj⟩
    have hΨ_equiv_cont : Continuous Ψ_equiv := hΨ_cont
    let Ψ_homeo : (UnitCircle × Set.Icc a d) ≃ₜ (Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle) :=
      hΨ_equiv_cont.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2
    have hρ_eq : (fun p : Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle => ρ p.1.1 p.2) =
        (fun p : Set.Icc a d × UnitCircle => ‖Y (Ψ_homeo.symm p)‖) := by
      ext p
      let q := Ψ_homeo.symm p
      have hΨq : Ψ q = p := Ψ_homeo.apply_symm_apply p
      have hq2 : q.2 = p.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hΨq
      have hqu : u_map q = p.2 := congrArg Prod.snd hΨq
      rw [← hq2, ← hqu, ← hY_norm_eq q]
    rw [hρ_eq]
    exact continuous_norm.comp (hY_cont.comp Ψ_homeo.symm.continuous)

  have hρ_ne : ∀ b₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ b₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init,
      b₁ ≠ b₂ → ∀ u : UnitCircle, ρ b₁ u ≠ ρ b₂ u := by
    intro b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ hne u heq
    obtain ⟨ζ₁, hζ₁⟩ := (hρ_props b₁ hb₁ u).2.2.1.1
    obtain ⟨ζ₂, hζ₂⟩ := (hρ_props b₂ hb₂ u).2.2.1.1
    rw [← heq] at hζ₂
    have hH_val : (H₀ (ζ₁, ⟨b₁, hb_ico_of hb₁⟩) : Plane) =
        (H₀ (ζ₂, ⟨b₂, hb_ico_of hb₂⟩) : Plane) := hζ₁.trans hζ₂.symm
    have h_pair := H₀.injective (Subtype.ext hH_val)
    exact hne (congrArg (fun p => p.2.1) h_pair)

  have h_nest_of_u0 : ∀ b₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ b₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init,
      ρ b₁ (uVec 0) < ρ b₂ (uVec 0) → closure (U_of b₁) ⊆ U_of b₂ := by
    intro b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ h_lt0
    have hne : b₁ ≠ b₂ := fun h => by subst h; exact lt_irrefl _ h_lt0
    apply h_nest_of_ρ b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂
    intro u
    obtain ⟨θ_u, hθ_u⟩ := h_polar (u : Plane) (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.2)
    have hu_eq : u = uVec θ_u := Subtype.ext hθ_u.symm
    rw [hu_eq]
    let a : ℝ := min b₁ b₂
    let d : ℝ := max b₁ b₂
    have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_min hb₁.1 hb₂.1
    have had : a ≤ d := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hd_lt : d < b_init := max_lt hb₁.2 hb₂.2
    have hcyl := hρ_cont_cyl a d ha_pos had hd_lt
    let b₁_sub : Set.Icc a d := ⟨b₁, le_min_iff.mp le_rfl |>.1, le_max_left _ _⟩
    let b₂_sub : Set.Icc a d := ⟨b₂, le_min_iff.mp le_rfl |>.2, le_max_right _ _⟩
    let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ϑ => ρ b₂ (uVec ϑ) - ρ b₁ (uVec ϑ)
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun ϑ : ℝ => ρ b₂_sub.1 (uVec ϑ)) :=
        hcyl.comp (continuous_const.prodMk huVec_cont)
      have h2 : Continuous (fun ϑ : ℝ => ρ b₁_sub.1 (uVec ϑ)) :=
        hcyl.comp (continuous_const.prodMk huVec_cont)
      exact h1.sub h2
    have hφ0 : 0 < φ 0 := sub_pos.mpr h_lt0
    have hφ_ne : ∀ ϑ : ℝ, φ ϑ ≠ 0 := fun ϑ =>
      sub_ne_zero.mpr (hρ_ne b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ hne (uVec ϑ)).symm
    by_contra h_not_lt
    push_neg at h_not_lt
    have hφ_neg : φ θ_u < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (sub_nonpos.mpr h_not_lt) (hφ_ne θ_u)
    rcases le_or_gt 0 θ_u with h0_le | h_neg
    · obtain ⟨ϑ, _, hϑ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' h0_le hφ_cont.continuousOn
        ⟨le_of_lt hφ_neg, le_of_lt hφ0⟩
      exact hφ_ne ϑ hϑ
    · obtain ⟨ϑ, _, hϑ⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt h_neg) hφ_cont.continuousOn
        ⟨le_of_lt hφ_neg, le_of_lt hφ0⟩
      exact hφ_ne ϑ hϑ

  have hg_strictAnti_b : ∀ b₁ b₂ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < b_init → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      g_col b₂ θ < g_col b₁ θ := by
    intro b₁ b₂ hb₁_pos hb₁₂ hb₂_lt θ
    have hb₁ : b₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init := ⟨hb₁_pos, lt_trans hb₁₂ hb₂_lt⟩
    have hb₂ : b₂ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init := ⟨lt_trans hb₁_pos hb₁₂, hb₂_lt⟩
    let ε₀ : ℝ := B.h 0 - g_col b₂ 0
    have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ := sub_pos.mpr (hg_bounds b₂ hb₂ 0).2
    obtain ⟨b_ε, hb_ε_pos, _, hb_ε⟩ := hg_tendsto_raw ε₀ hε₀_pos
    let b₀ : ℝ := min b₁ b_ε / 2
    have hb₀_pos : 0 < b₀ := by dsimp [b₀]; exact half_pos (lt_min hb₁_pos hb_ε_pos)
    have hb₀_lt_b₁ : b₀ < b₁ := by
      dsimp [b₀]
      linarith [min_le_left b₁ b_ε]
    have hb₀_lt_bε : b₀ < b_ε := by
      dsimp [b₀]
      linarith [min_le_right b₁ b_ε]
    have hb₀ : b₀ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init := ⟨hb₀_pos, lt_trans hb₀_lt_b₁ hb₁.2⟩
    have hg_b₂_lt_b₀ : g_col b₂ 0 < g_col b₀ 0 := by
      have h_close := hb_ε b₀ ⟨hb₀_pos, hb₀_lt_bε⟩ 0
      dsimp [ε₀] at h_close
      linarith
    have hρ_b₂_lt_b₀ : ρ b₂ (uVec 0) < ρ b₀ (uVec 0) := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy (ρ b₂ (uVec 0)) (ρ b₀ (uVec 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
      · exact hlt
      · exfalso
        exact hρ_ne b₂ hb₂ b₀ hb₀ (ne_of_gt (lt_trans hb₀_lt_b₁ hb₁₂)) (uVec 0) heq
      · exfalso
        have h_sub : closure (U_of b₀) ⊆ U_of b₂ := h_nest_of_u0 b₀ hb₀ b₂ hb₂ hgt
        obtain ⟨⟨y₀, hy₀_slice, hy₀_val⟩, _⟩ := hU_max b₀ hb₀ 0
        have hy₀_cl₀ : y₀ ∈ closure (U_of b₀) := by
          rw [← (hU_spec b₀ hb₀).2] at hy₀_slice
          exact frontier_subset_closure hy₀_slice
        have hy₀_cl₂ : y₀ ∈ closure (U_of b₂) := subset_closure (h_sub hy₀_cl₀)
        have h_le := (hU_max b₂ hb₂ 0).2 y₀ hy₀_cl₂
        linarith
    have hρ_b₂_lt_b₁ : ρ b₂ (uVec 0) < ρ b₁ (uVec 0) := by
      have hb₀_le_b₂ : b₀ ≤ b₂ := le_of_lt (lt_trans hb₀_lt_b₁ hb₁₂)
      have hcyl := hρ_cont_cyl b₀ b₂ hb₀_pos hb₀_le_b₂ hb₂_lt
      let ψ : Set.Icc b₀ b₁ → ℝ := fun t =>
        ρ t.1 (uVec 0) - ρ b₂ (uVec 0)
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by
        let emb : Set.Icc b₀ b₁ → Set.Icc b₀ b₂ × UnitCircle := fun t =>
          (⟨t.1, ⟨t.2.1, le_trans t.2.2 (le_of_lt hb₁₂)⟩⟩, uVec 0)
        have hemb_cont : Continuous emb :=
          (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _).prodMk continuous_const
        exact (hcyl.comp hemb_cont).sub continuous_const
      have hψ_ne : ∀ t : Set.Icc b₀ b₁, ψ t ≠ 0 := by
        intro t
        have ht_ioo : t.1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init :=
          ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hb₀_pos t.2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt t.2.2 hb₁.2⟩
        have ht_ne : t.1 ≠ b₂ := ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt t.2.2 hb₁₂)
        exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hρ_ne t.1 ht_ioo b₂ hb₂ ht_ne (uVec 0))
      let t₀_pt : Set.Icc b₀ b₁ := ⟨b₀, le_rfl, le_of_lt hb₀_lt_b₁⟩
      let t₁_pt : Set.Icc b₀ b₁ := ⟨b₁, le_of_lt hb₀_lt_b₁, le_rfl⟩
      by_contra h_not_lt
      push_neg at h_not_lt
      have hψ_t₁_neg : ψ t₁_pt < 0 :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (sub_nonpos.mpr h_not_lt) (hψ_ne t₁_pt)
      have hψ_t₀_pos : 0 < ψ t₀_pt := sub_pos.mpr hρ_b₂_lt_b₀
      have hψ_real_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => ρ x (uVec 0) - ρ b₂ (uVec 0))
          (Set.Icc b₀ b₁) :=
        continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mpr hψ_cont
      obtain ⟨x_star, hx_star, hx_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hb₀_lt_b₁)
        hψ_real_cont ⟨le_of_lt hψ_t₁_neg, le_of_lt hψ_t₀_pos⟩
      exact hψ_ne ⟨x_star, hx_star⟩ hx_eq
    have h_sub : closure (U_of b₂) ⊆ U_of b₁ := h_nest_of_u0 b₂ hb₂ b₁ hb₁ hρ_b₂_lt_b₁
    obtain ⟨⟨y₂, hy₂_slice, hy₂_val⟩, _⟩ := hU_max b₂ hb₂ θ
    have hy₂_cl₂ : y₂ ∈ closure (U_of b₂) := by
      rw [← (hU_spec b₂ hb₂).2] at hy₂_slice
      exact frontier_subset_closure hy₂_slice
    have hy₂_in₁ : y₂ ∈ U_of b₁ := h_sub hy₂_cl₂
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_ball⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hU_spec b₁ hb₁).1.isOpen y₂ hy₂_in₁
    let δ : ℝ := η / 2
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
    let y' : Plane := y₂ + δ • unitNormalVec θ
    have hy'_dist : dist y' y₂ < η := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, show y' - y₂ = δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
        norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos, hn_norm, mul_one]
      dsimp [δ]; linarith
    have hy'_cl₁ : y' ∈ closure (U_of b₁) := subset_closure (hη_ball hy'_dist)
    have h_le₁ := (hU_max b₁ hb₁ θ).2 y' hy'_cl₁
    have h_inner_y' : inner ℝ (y' - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) = g_col b₂ θ + δ := by
      rw [show y' - B.c₀ = (y₂ - B.c₀) + δ • unitNormalVec θ by dsimp [y']; abel,
        inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, hn_inner_self, mul_one, hy₂_val]
    linarith

  
  have hg_inv : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
      P.P_plus θ (g_col b θ) = g_col b (P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ)) := by
    intro b hb θ
    let C : Set Plane := collarSlice H₀ b (hb_ico_of hb)
    obtain ⟨hC_sub, ⟨U, hU, hFront⟩, ⟨α, L, hα, hTang⟩⟩ :=
      hCaustic b hb.1 (lt_trans hb.2 hb_init_lt_one)
    have hα_cont : Continuous α := hα.smooth.continuous
    have hα_mem_C : ∀ t : ℝ, α t ∈ C := by
      intro t
      dsimp [C]
      rw [← hα.range_eq]
      exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
    have hC_param_max : ∀ ϑ : ℝ,
        BddAbove ((fun x : Plane => inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ)) '' C) ∧
        ∃ t₀ : ℝ,
          inner ℝ (α t₀ - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ) = g_col b ϑ ∧
          ∀ t : ℝ, inner ℝ (α t - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ) ≤
            inner ℝ (α t₀ - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ) := by
      intro ϑ
      let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => inner ℝ (α t - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ)
      have hφ_cont : Continuous φ :=
        (hα_cont.sub continuous_const).inner continuous_const
      obtain ⟨t₀, _, ht₀_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
        ⟨0, le_rfl, le_of_lt hα.period_pos⟩ hφ_cont.continuousOn
      have h_all : ∀ t : ℝ, φ t ≤ φ t₀ := by
        intro t
        let k : ℤ := Int.floor (t / L)
        let t' : ℝ := t - (k : ℝ) * L
        have ht'_nonneg : 0 ≤ t' := by
          have := (le_div_iff₀ hα.period_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (t / L))
          dsimp [t']; linarith
        have ht'_lt : t' < L := by
          have := (div_lt_iff₀ hα.period_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (t / L))
          dsimp [t']; linarith
        have ht_eq : t = t' + (k : ℝ) * L := by dsimp [t']; ring
        have hα_per : α t = α t' := by
          rw [ht_eq]
          simpa [mul_comm] using hα.periodic.int_mul k t'
        have hφ_per : φ t = φ t' := by dsimp [φ]; rw [hα_per]
        rw [hφ_per]
        exact ht₀_max ⟨ht'_nonneg, le_of_lt ht'_lt⟩
      have h_greatest : IsGreatest
          ((fun x : Plane => inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec ϑ)) '' C) (φ t₀) := by
        refine ⟨⟨α t₀, hα_mem_C t₀, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        dsimp [C] at hx
        rw [← hα.range_eq] at hx
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hx
        exact h_all t
      refine ⟨h_greatest.bddAbove, t₀, ?_, h_all⟩
      dsimp only [g_col, supp]
      rw [dif_pos (hb_ico_of hb), h_greatest.csSup_eq]
    let p : ℝ := g_col b θ
    let θ' : ℝ := P.Theta_plus θ p
    obtain ⟨_, t₀, ht₀_eq, ht₀_max⟩ := hC_param_max θ
    have h_deriv_t₀ : inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) (unitNormalVec θ) = 0 :=
      h_deriv_max α hα.smooth B.c₀ (unitNormalVec θ) t₀ ht₀_max
    obtain ⟨P₀, Q₀, hP₀, hQ₀, hPQ_ne, hPQ_dir, hPQ_seg, ⟨n_Q, hn_Q, hRefl_Q⟩, _⟩ :=
      P.chord_reflection θ p (hg_strip b hb θ)
    have hα_t₀_C : α t₀ ∈ C := hα_mem_C t₀
    have hα_t₀_seg : α t₀ ∈ segment ℝ P₀ Q₀ := hPQ_seg (α t₀) (hC_sub hα_t₀_C) ht₀_eq
    have hQP_ne : Q₀ - P₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hPQ_ne.symm
    have hQP_norm_ne : ‖Q₀ - P₀‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hQP_ne
    have hTang_PQ : IsBilliardSegmentTangentTo α P₀ Q₀ := by
      refine ⟨t₀, hα_t₀_seg, inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) (unitTangentVec θ) * ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹, ?_⟩
      have h_fr := h_frame (deriv α t₀) θ
      rw [h_deriv_t₀, zero_smul, zero_add] at h_fr
      have he_eq : ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹ • (Q₀ - P₀) = unitTangentVec θ := by
        calc ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹ • (Q₀ - P₀)
            = ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹ • (‖Q₀ - P₀‖ • unitTangentVec θ) :=
                congrArg (fun v => ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹ • v) hPQ_dir
          _ = unitTangentVec θ := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hQP_norm_ne, one_smul]
      calc deriv α t₀
          = inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) (unitTangentVec θ) • unitTangentVec θ := h_fr
        _ = inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) (unitTangentVec θ) • (‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹ • (Q₀ - P₀)) := by
              rw [← he_eq]
        _ = (inner ℝ (deriv α t₀) (unitTangentVec θ) * ‖Q₀ - P₀‖⁻¹) • (Q₀ - P₀) := by
              rw [smul_smul]
    obtain ⟨R, hR_front, hR_ne, hR_ray, hTang_QR⟩ :=
      (hTang P₀ hP₀ Q₀ hQ₀ hPQ_ne hTang_PQ).1 n_Q hn_Q
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁_seg, c₁, hc₁⟩ := hTang_QR
    obtain ⟨h_seg_val, hRQ_dir⟩ := hRefl_Q R hR_front hR_ne hR_ray
    have ht₁_val : inner ℝ (α t₁ - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ') = P.P_plus θ p :=
      h_seg_val (α t₁) ht₁_seg
    have hα_t₁_C : α t₁ ∈ C := hα_mem_C t₁
    have h_le_g : P.P_plus θ p ≤ g_col b θ' := by
      dsimp only [g_col, supp]
      rw [dif_pos (hb_ico_of hb)]
      exact le_csSup (hC_param_max θ').1 ⟨α t₁, hα_t₁_C, ht₁_val⟩
    have hα_t₁_not_U : α t₁ ∉ U := by
      have h_in_front : α t₁ ∈ closure U \ U := by
        rw [← hU.isOpen.frontier_eq, hFront]
        exact hα_t₁_C
      exact h_in_front.2
    obtain ⟨u, hu_norm, hu_sep⟩ :=
      h_hahn_banach U hU.convex hU.isOpen hU.nonempty (α t₁) hα_t₁_not_U
    have hC_sub_clU : C ⊆ closure U := by
      dsimp [C]
      rw [← hFront]
      exact frontier_subset_closure
    have hu_max_t₁ : ∀ t : ℝ,
        inner ℝ (α t - α t₁) u ≤ inner ℝ (α t₁ - α t₁) u := by
      intro t
      rw [sub_self, inner_zero_left]
      exact hu_sep (α t) (hC_sub_clU (hα_mem_C t))
    have h_deriv_t₁ : inner ℝ (deriv α t₁) u = 0 :=
      h_deriv_max α hα.smooth (α t₁) u t₁ hu_max_t₁
    have h_deriv_dir : deriv α t₁ = (c₁ * ‖R - Q₀‖) • unitTangentVec θ' := by
      calc deriv α t₁
          = c₁ • (R - Q₀) := hc₁
        _ = c₁ • (‖R - Q₀‖ • unitTangentVec θ') := congrArg (fun v => c₁ • v) hRQ_dir
        _ = (c₁ * ‖R - Q₀‖) • unitTangentVec θ' := by rw [smul_smul]
    have h_scalar_ne : c₁ * ‖R - Q₀‖ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hα.regular t₁
      rw [h_deriv_dir, h0, zero_smul]
    have hu_orth_e : inner ℝ u (unitTangentVec θ') = 0 := by
      rw [h_deriv_dir, real_inner_smul_left] at h_deriv_t₁
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_deriv_t₁ with h0 | h0
      · exact False.elim (h_scalar_ne h0)
      · rwa [real_inner_comm]
    have hu_span : u = inner ℝ u (unitNormalVec θ') • unitNormalVec θ' := by
      have h_fr := h_frame u θ'
      rw [hu_orth_e, zero_smul, add_zero] at h_fr
      exact h_fr
    have hu_abs : |inner ℝ u (unitNormalVec θ')| = 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖u‖ = |inner ℝ u (unitNormalVec θ')| := by
        nth_rw 1 [hu_span]
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hn_norm, mul_one]
      linarith
    have hu_eq_n : u = unitNormalVec θ' := by
      rcases abs_eq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) |>.mp hu_abs with hpos | hneg
      · rw [hu_span, hpos, one_smul]
      · exfalso
        have hu_neg : u = unitNormalVec (θ' + Real.pi) := by
          rw [hu_span, hneg, neg_one_smul, hn_add_pi]
        have hg_pi_le : g_col b (θ' + Real.pi) ≤ -P.P_plus θ p := by
          dsimp only [g_col, supp]
          rw [dif_pos (hb_ico_of hb)]
          have hC_ne : ((fun x : Plane =>
              inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (θ' + Real.pi))) '' C).Nonempty :=
            ⟨_, ⟨α 0, hα_mem_C 0, rfl⟩⟩
          apply csSup_le hC_ne
          rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
          have h_sep_x := hu_sep x (hC_sub_clU hx)
          rw [hu_neg] at h_sep_x
          have h_split : x - α t₁ = (x - B.c₀) - (α t₁ - B.c₀) := by abel
          rw [h_split, inner_sub_left] at h_sep_x
          have h_neg_val : inner ℝ (α t₁ - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (θ' + Real.pi)) =
              -P.P_plus θ p := by
            rw [hn_add_pi, inner_neg_right, ht₁_val]
          linarith
        have hg_pi_gt : B.r₀ < g_col b (θ' + Real.pi) :=
          (hg_bounds b hb (θ' + Real.pi)).1
        have hP_gt : B.r₀ < P.P_plus θ p := (hg_step_and_P b hb θ).2
        linarith [B.r₀_pos]
    have hg_le_P : g_col b θ' ≤ P.P_plus θ p := by
      dsimp only [g_col, supp]
      rw [dif_pos (hb_ico_of hb)]
      have hC_ne : ((fun x : Plane =>
          inner ℝ (x - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ')) '' C).Nonempty :=
        ⟨_, ⟨α t₁, hα_t₁_C, rfl⟩⟩
      apply csSup_le hC_ne
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have h_sep_x := hu_sep x (hC_sub_clU hx)
      rw [hu_eq_n] at h_sep_x
      have h_split : x - α t₁ = (x - B.c₀) - (α t₁ - B.c₀) := by abel
      rw [h_split, inner_sub_left, ht₁_val] at h_sep_x
      linarith
    exact le_antisymm h_le_g hg_le_P

  have hF_mono : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init,
      StrictMono (fun θ : ℝ => P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ)) := by
    intro b hb
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ)
    let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ϑ => P.Theta_minus ϑ (g_col b ϑ)
    have hg_b_cont : Continuous (g_col b) :=
      hg_cont_ico.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun θ => ⟨hb_ico_of hb, trivial⟩)
    have hF_cont : Continuous F :=
      P.Theta_plus_cont.comp_continuous (continuous_id.prodMk hg_b_cont) (hg_strip b hb)
    have hGF : Function.LeftInverse G F := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [G, F]
      rw [← hg_inv b hb θ]
      exact (P.Phi_left_inv θ (g_col b θ) (hg_strip b hb θ)).1
    have hF_inj : Function.Injective F := hGF.injective
    have hF_2pi : F 0 < F (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hper : g_col b (0 + 2 * Real.pi) = g_col b 0 :=
        hg_per_ico b (hb_ico_of hb) 0
      have hqp : F (0 + 2 * Real.pi) = F 0 + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [F]
        rw [hper, P.Theta_plus_quasiperiodic 0 (g_col b 0) (hg_strip b hb 0)]
      rw [zero_add] at hqp
      linarith
    rcases hF_cont.strictMono_of_inj hF_inj with hmono | hanti
    · exact hmono
    · exfalso
      linarith [hanti h2pi_pos]

  
  refine ⟨{
    b_init := b_init
    b_init_pos := hb_init_pos
    g_col := g_col
    g_col_cont := hg_cont_ico.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hb_ico_of hz.1, trivial⟩)
    g_col_periodic := fun b hb => hg_per_ico b (hb_ico_of hb)
    g_col_bounds := hg_bounds
    g_col_strictAnti_b := hg_strictAnti_b
    g_col_tendsto_h := ?_
    g_col_invariant := hg_inv
    F_raw_strictMono_θ := hF_mono
    F_raw_step_lt_pi := fun b hb θ => (hg_step_and_P b hb θ).1
  }⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, _, hb₁⟩ := hg_tendsto_raw ε hε
  refine ⟨min b₁ b_init, lt_min hb₁_pos hb_init_pos, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro b hb θ
  exact hb₁ b ⟨hb.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩ θ

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω)
    (P : SupportPhaseMapData Ω B)
    (C_gr : PhaseCollarGraphData Ω B P) :
    ∃ τ₀ : ℝ, 0 < τ₀ ∧
      ∀ l q : ℕ, 0 < l → 0 < q → Nat.Coprime l q →
        (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < τ₀ →
        (∃ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (C_gr.b_init / 2),
          ∀ θ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ =
            θ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (C_gr.b_init / 2),
          (∃ θ₀ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ₀ =
            θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) →
          ∀ θ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ =
            θ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ))

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω)
    (P : SupportPhaseMapData Ω B)
    (C_gr : PhaseCollarGraphData Ω B P) :
    ∃ τ₀ : ℝ, 0 < τ₀ ∧
      ∀ l q : ℕ, 0 < l → 0 < q → Nat.Coprime l q →
        (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < τ₀ →
        (∃ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (C_gr.b_init / 2),
          ∀ θ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ =
            θ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (C_gr.b_init / 2),
          (∃ θ₀ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ₀ =
            θ₀ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) →
          ∀ θ : ℝ, (fun θ' => P.Theta_plus θ' (C_gr.g_col b θ'))^[q] θ =
            θ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
  let I : Set ℝ := Set.Ioo 0 C_gr.b_init
  have hI_open : IsOpen (I ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) := isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ
  let F_raw : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun b θ => P.Theta_plus θ (C_gr.g_col b θ)
  have hg_strip : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ θ : ℝ, (θ, C_gr.g_col b θ) ∈ phaseStrip B.h := by
    intro b hb θ
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := C_gr.g_col_bounds b hb θ
    exact ⟨by linarith [B.r₀_pos, B.h_pos (θ + Real.pi)], h_hi⟩
  have hF_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_raw p.1 p.2) (I ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h_pair : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.2, C_gr.g_col p.1 p.2)) (I ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      continuousOn_snd.prodMk C_gr.g_col_cont
    exact P.Theta_plus_cont.comp h_pair (fun p hp => hg_strip hp.1 p.2)
  have hF_iter_cont :
      ∀ n : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (F_raw p.1)^[n] p.2) (I ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact continuousOn_snd
    | succ n ih =>
      have h_eq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (F_raw p.1)^[n + 1] p.2) =
          (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F_raw q.1 q.2) ∘
            (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, (F_raw p.1)^[n] p.2)) := by
        ext p
        simp [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hF_cont.comp (continuousOn_fst.prodMk ih) (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, trivial⟩)
  have hF_b_cont : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → Continuous (F_raw b) := by
    intro b hb
    rw [← continuousOn_univ]
    exact hF_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
      (fun θ _ => ⟨hb, trivial⟩)
  have hF_iter_contAt_b : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ),
      ContinuousAt (fun b' : ℝ => (F_raw b')^[n] θ) b := by
    intro b hb n θ
    have h_at : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (F_raw p.1)^[n] p.2) (b, θ) :=
      (hF_iter_cont n).continuousAt (hI_open.mem_nhds ⟨hb, trivial⟩)
    exact ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (F_raw p.1)^[n] p.2)
      (f := fun b' : ℝ => (b', θ)) h_at (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt
  have hF_qp : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      F_raw b (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = F_raw b θ + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro b hb θ
    dsimp [F_raw]
    rw [C_gr.g_col_periodic b hb θ, P.Theta_plus_quasiperiodic θ (C_gr.g_col b θ) (hg_strip hb θ)]
  have hF_iter_qp : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ),
      (F_raw b)^[n] (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = (F_raw b)^[n] θ + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro b hb n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro θ; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro θ
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih θ, hF_qp hb]
  have hF_iter_qp_nat : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ (n k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ),
      (F_raw b)^[n] (θ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) =
        (F_raw b)^[n] θ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb n k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro θ; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro θ
      have h_add : θ + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
          (θ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_add, hF_iter_qp hb n, ih θ]
      push_cast; ring
  have hF_iter_qp_int : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (θ : ℝ),
      (F_raw b)^[n] (θ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) =
        (F_raw b)^[n] θ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb n k θ
    rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩
    · simpa using hF_iter_qp_nat hb n m θ
    · have h1 := hF_iter_qp_nat hb n m (θ + ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))
      have h2 : (θ + ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = θ := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h2] at h1
      push_cast at h1 ⊢
      linarith
  have hF_strictMono_b : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : ℝ}, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < C_gr.b_init →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, F_raw b₁ θ < F_raw b₂ θ := by
    intro b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ θ
    have hb₁_mem : b₁ ∈ I := ⟨hb₁, lt_trans hb₁₂ hb₂⟩
    have hb₂_mem : b₂ ∈ I := ⟨lt_trans hb₁ hb₁₂, hb₂⟩
    exact P.Theta_plus_strictAnti_p θ (C_gr.g_col b₂ θ) (C_gr.g_col b₁ θ)
      (hg_strip hb₂_mem θ) (hg_strip hb₁_mem θ)
      (C_gr.g_col_strictAnti_b b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ θ)
  have hF_iter_strictMono_b : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : ℝ}, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < C_gr.b_init →
      ∀ {n : ℕ}, 0 < n → ∀ θ : ℝ, (F_raw b₁)^[n] θ < (F_raw b₂)^[n] θ := by
    intro b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ n hn
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
    clear hn
    have hb₂_mem : b₂ ∈ I := ⟨lt_trans hb₁ hb₁₂, hb₂⟩
    induction k with
    | zero => intro θ; simpa using hF_strictMono_b hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ θ
    | succ k ih =>
      intro θ
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply' (F_raw b₁), Function.iterate_succ_apply' (F_raw b₂)]
      exact lt_trans (hF_strictMono_b hb₁ hb₁₂ hb₂ ((F_raw b₁)^[k + 1] θ))
        (C_gr.F_raw_strictMono_θ b₂ hb₂_mem (ih θ))
  
  let F_hat : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun b y => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * F_raw b (2 * Real.pi * y)
  have hF_hat_mono : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → Monotone (F_hat b) := by
    intro b hb y₁ y₂ hy
    dsimp [F_hat]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((C_gr.F_raw_strictMono_θ b hb).monotone (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy h2pi_pos.le))
      (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
  have hF_hat_cont : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → Continuous (F_hat b) := by
    intro b hb
    exact continuous_const.mul ((hF_b_cont hb).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))
  have hF_hat_add_one : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → ∀ y : ℝ, F_hat b (y + 1) = F_hat b y + 1 := by
    intro b hb y
    dsimp [F_hat]
    have h_mul : 2 * Real.pi * (y + 1) = 2 * Real.pi * y + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    rw [h_mul, hF_qp hb, mul_add, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne]
  let f_lift : ∀ b : ℝ, b ∈ I → CircleDeg1Lift :=
    fun b hb => CircleDeg1Lift.mk ⟨F_hat b, hF_hat_mono hb⟩ (hF_hat_add_one hb)
  have hf_lift_coe : ∀ {b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ I), (⇑(f_lift b hb) : ℝ → ℝ) = F_hat b := fun _ => rfl
  have hf_lift_pow : ∀ {b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ I) (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ),
      (f_lift b hb ^ n) y = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (F_raw b)^[n] (2 * Real.pi * y) := by
    intro b hb n y
    rw [CircleDeg1Lift.coe_pow, hf_lift_coe hb]
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply]
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
      dsimp [F_hat]
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul]
  let τ_hat : ℝ → ℝ := fun b => if hb : b ∈ I then (f_lift b hb).translationNumber else 0
  have hτ_eq : ∀ {b : ℝ} (hb : b ∈ I), τ_hat b = (f_lift b hb).translationNumber := by
    intro b hb; simp [τ_hat, hb]
  have hτ_mono : MonotoneOn τ_hat I := by
    intro b₁ hb₁ b₂ hb₂ hle
    rw [hτ_eq hb₁, hτ_eq hb₂]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with rfl | hlt
    · exact le_rfl
    · apply CircleDeg1Lift.translationNumber_mono
      intro y
      change F_hat b₁ y ≤ F_hat b₂ y
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_of_lt (hF_strictMono_b hb₁.1 hlt hb₂.2 (2 * Real.pi * y)))
        (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
  have hτ_pos : ∀ {b : ℝ}, b ∈ I → 0 < τ_hat b := by
    intro b hb
    rw [hτ_eq hb]
    let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => F_hat b y - y
    have hd_cont : Continuous d := (hF_hat_cont hb).sub continuous_id
    have hd_per : Function.Periodic d 1 := by
      intro y
      dsimp [d]
      rw [hF_hat_add_one hb y]
      ring
    have hd_pos : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < d y := by
      intro y
      have h_lt : 2 * Real.pi * y < F_raw b (2 * Real.pi * y) :=
        (P.Theta_plus_bounds (2 * Real.pi * y) (C_gr.g_col b (2 * Real.pi * y))
          (hg_strip hb (2 * Real.pi * y))).1
      have hy_lt : y < F_hat b y := by
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_lt (inv_pos.mpr h2pi_pos)
        rwa [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul] at this
      exact sub_pos.mpr hy_lt
    obtain ⟨y_min, _, hy_min⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn
      ⟨(0 : ℝ), ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩⟩ hd_cont.continuousOn
    let m_b : ℝ := d y_min
    have hm_pos : 0 < m_b := hd_pos y_min
    have hm_le : ∀ y : ℝ, m_b ≤ d y := by
      intro y
      let k : ℤ := Int.floor y
      have hy_eq : y = (y - (k : ℝ)) + (k : ℝ) * 1 := by ring
      have h_per_k : d y = d (y - (k : ℝ)) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hy_eq]
        exact hd_per.int_mul k (y - (k : ℝ))
      rw [h_per_k]
      exact hy_min ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr (Int.floor_le y),
        by linarith [Int.lt_floor_add_one y]⟩
    have h_half : m_b / 2 < (f_lift b hb).translationNumber := by
      apply CircleDeg1Lift.lt_translationNumber_of_forall_add_lt (f_lift b hb) (hF_hat_cont hb)
      intro y
      have := hm_le y
      change m_b ≤ F_hat b y - y at this
      change y + m_b / 2 < F_hat b y
      linarith
    linarith
  have hτ_lim0 : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ b₁ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ ∧ b₁ ≤ C_gr.b_init ∧
      ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁, τ_hat b < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ_p, hδ_p_pos, hδ_p⟩ := P.Theta_plus_tendsto_zero (2 * Real.pi * (ε / 2)) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, hb₁_le, hb₁⟩ := C_gr.g_col_tendsto_h δ_p hδ_p_pos
    refine ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, hb₁_le, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    have hb_I : b ∈ I := ⟨hb.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2 hb₁_le⟩
    rw [hτ_eq hb_I]
    have h_lt_half : (f_lift b hb_I).translationNumber < ε / 2 := by
      apply CircleDeg1Lift.translationNumber_lt_of_forall_lt_add (f_lift b hb_I) (hF_hat_cont hb_I)
      intro y
      have hg_close := hb₁ b hb (2 * Real.pi * y)
      have h_step := (hδ_p (2 * Real.pi * y) (C_gr.g_col b (2 * Real.pi * y))
        (hg_strip hb_I (2 * Real.pi * y)) hg_close).1
      have h_raw : F_raw b (2 * Real.pi * y) < 2 * Real.pi * (y + ε / 2) := by
        dsimp [F_raw]; linarith
      have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_raw (inv_pos.mpr h2pi_pos)
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul] at h_mul
      exact h_mul
    linarith
  have hτ_cont : ContinuousOn τ_hat I := by
    apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
    intro b_star hb_star
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (3 / ε)
    have hN_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := lt_trans (by positivity) hN
    have h3_div_lt : 3 / (N : ℝ) < ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos_real).mpr
      (by have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hN; linarith)
    have h_map_cont : ContinuousAt (fun b : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (F_raw b)^[N] 0) b_star :=
      continuousAt_const.mul (hF_iter_contAt_b hb_star N 0)
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at h_map_cont
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ := h_map_cont 1 zero_lt_one
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isOpen_Ioo b_star hb_star

      exact (h_trap b hb z.1 ⟨hz.1, hz.2.1⟩).2 m hm ⟨hz_in.1, hz_in.2.1⟩
  
  have h_all_per : ∀ {b_star : ℝ}, b_star ∈ I → ∀ (l q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      τ_hat b_star = (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, (F_raw b_star)^[q] θ = θ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) := by
    intro b_star hb_star l q hq hτ_star
    refine hτ_pinch hb_star l q hq ?_ ?_
    · intro b_lo hb_lo
      have hb_lo_I : b_lo ∈ I := ⟨hb_lo.1, lt_trans hb_lo.2 hb_star.2⟩
      have h_le : τ_hat b_lo ≤ (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by
        rw [← hτ_star]; exact hτ_mono hb_lo_I hb_star hb_lo.2.le
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne h_le
        (fun h_eq => h_no_plateau l q hq hb_lo.1 hb_lo.2 hb_star.2 h_eq hτ_star)
    · intro b_hi hb_hi
      have hb_hi_I : b_hi ∈ I := ⟨lt_trans hb_star.1 hb_hi.1, hb_hi.2⟩
      have h_ge : (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ≤ τ_hat b_hi := by
        rw [← hτ_star]; exact hτ_mono hb_star hb_hi_I hb_hi.1.le
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne h_ge
        (fun h_eq => h_no_plateau l q hq hb_star.1 hb_hi.1 hb_hi.2 hτ_star h_eq.symm)
  let b₀ : ℝ := C_gr.b_init / 2
  have hb₀_pos : 0 < b₀ := by dsimp [b₀]; linarith [C_gr.b_init_pos]
  have hb₀_lt_init : b₀ < C_gr.b_init := by dsimp [b₀]; linarith [C_gr.b_init_pos]
  have hb₀_I : b₀ ∈ I := ⟨hb₀_pos, hb₀_lt_init⟩
  refine ⟨2 * Real.pi * τ_hat b₀, mul_pos h2pi_pos (hτ_pos hb₀_I), ?_⟩
  intro l q hl hq _hcop h_lt_τ₀
  have hq_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hq
  have hl_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (l : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hl
  have h_rat_pos : 0 < (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := div_pos hl_pos_real hq_pos_real
  have h_rat_lt_b₀ : (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) < τ_hat b₀ := by
    have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hq_pos_real).mp h_lt_τ₀
    exact (div_lt_iff₀ hq_pos_real).mpr (by nlinarith)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁_pos, _, hb₁⟩ := hτ_lim0 ((l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) h_rat_pos
    let b_low : ℝ := min (b₁ / 2) (b₀ / 2)
    have hb_low_pos : 0 < b_low := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hb_low_lt_b₀ : b_low < b₀ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
    have hb_low_lt_b₁ : b_low < b₁ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
    have hτ_low_lt : τ_hat b_low < (l : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := hb₁ b_low ⟨hb_low_pos, hb_low_lt_b₁⟩
    have hτ_cont_sub : ContinuousOn τ_hat (Set.Icc b_low b₀) :=
      hτ_cont.mono (fun b hb => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hb_low_pos hb.1,
        lt_of_le_of_lt hb.2 hb₀_lt_init⟩)
    obtain ⟨b_star, hb_star_mem, hb_star_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc
      hb_low_lt_b₀.le hτ_cont_sub ⟨hτ_low_lt.le, h_rat_lt_b₀.le⟩
    have hb_star_ne_b₀ : b_star ≠ b₀ := by
      intro h_eq
      rw [h_eq] at hb_star_eq
      linarith
    have hb_star_Ioo : b_star ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀ :=
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hb_low_pos hb_star_mem.1, lt_of_le_of_ne hb_star_mem.2 hb_star_ne_b₀⟩
    exact ⟨b_star, hb_star_Ioo,
      h_all_per ⟨hb_star_Ioo.1, lt_trans hb_star_Ioo.2 hb₀_lt_init⟩ l q hq hb_star_eq⟩
  · intro b hb ⟨θ₀, hθ₀⟩
    have hb_I : b ∈ I := ⟨hb.1, lt_trans hb.2 hb₀_lt_init⟩
    exact h_all_per hb_I l q hq ((hτ_rat_iff hb_I l q hq).mpr ⟨θ₀, hθ₀⟩)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hRestrict, hTransfer, hGlueLoc, hGlueGlob⟩ := mero2d_sheaf_and_gluing_toolkit
  intro r_w ρ R w₀ r₀ hr_w hρ hρR hr₀ hsub₀ F F₀ hEq₀
  let A : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }
  have hEq₀_symm : MeroEqOn F₀ F (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ A) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Set.inter_comm]
      exact hEq₀.1
    · intro p hp q hq
      rw [min_comm] at hq
      exact (hEq₀.2 p hp q hq).symm
  let S : Set ℂ :=
    { w : ℂ | ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      Metric.ball w δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
      ∃ G : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
        MeroEqOn G F (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ A) }
  have hS_open : IsOpen S := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    rintro w ⟨δ, hδ, hsub, G, hEq⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun w' hw' => ?_⟩
    have hdist : dist w' w < δ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw'
    have hδ' : 0 < δ - dist w' w := sub_pos.mpr hdist
    have hsub' : Metric.ball w' (δ - dist w' w) ⊆ Metric.ball w δ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨G', hEq'⟩ := hRestrict w w' δ (δ - dist w' w) ρ R _ F G hδ' hρ hρR hsub' hEq
    exact ⟨δ - dist w' w, hδ', Set.Subset.trans hsub' hsub, G', hEq'⟩
  have hS_nonempty : (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∩ S).Nonempty :=
    ⟨w₀, hsub₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀), r₀, hr₀, hsub₀, F₀, hEq₀_symm⟩
  have hS_closed : closure S ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ⊆ S := by
    rintro w₁ ⟨hw₁_cl, hw₁_mem⟩
    obtain ⟨r, ε_r, δ₀, m, G, hδ₀, hε_r, hρ_lt, hr_lt, hδ₀_sub, hClF⟩ :=
      slice_pole_clearing_on_circle r_w ρ R w₁ hr_w hρ hρR hw₁_mem F
    have hr_gt : ε_r < r := by linarith
    obtain ⟨w₂, hw₂_S, hdist₁₂⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hw₁_cl δ₀ hδ₀
    obtain ⟨δ_S, hδ_S, _, G_S, hEq_S⟩ := hw₂_S
    have hdist₂₁ : dist w₂ w₁ < δ₀ := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hdist₁₂
    let δ₂ : ℝ := min δ_S (δ₀ - dist w₂ w₁)
    have hδ₂ : 0 < δ₂ := lt_min hδ_S (sub_pos.mpr hdist₂₁)
    have hδ₂_le : δ₂ ≤ δ₀ - dist w₂ w₁ := min_le_right _ _
    have hsub₂_S : Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball w₂ δ_S :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsub₂_₀ : Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨G₂, hEq₂⟩ := hRestrict w₂ w₂ δ_S δ₂ ρ R _ F G_S hδ₂ hρ hρR hsub₂_S hEq_S
    have hClG₂ : IsSliceClearedOnCollar G₂ (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂) w₁ r ε_r m G :=
      hTransfer r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ δ₂ w₁ w₂ m G F G₂ hδ₂ hε_r hρ_lt hr_lt hsub₂_₀ hClF hEq₂
    obtain ⟨hHoloL, d₀, hDetZero⟩ :=
      uniform_hankel_rank_from_subdisk w₁ w₂ δ₀ δ₂ r ε_r R m G G₂
        hδ₀ hδ₂ hε_r hr_gt hr_lt hsub₂_₀ hClF.2.1 hClG₂
    obtain ⟨N_tilde, Q, hHoloN, hHoloQ, hNZ, hColEq⟩ :=
      cramer_annihilator_and_cauchy_interior w₁ δ₀ r ε_r d₀ G
        hδ₀ hε_r hr_gt hClF.2.1 hHoloL hDetZero
    obtain ⟨G_loc, hEq_loc⟩ :=
      hGlueLoc r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ w₁ m G N_tilde Q F
        hr_w hρ hδ₀ hε_r hρ_lt hr_lt hδ₀_sub hClF hHoloN hHoloQ hNZ hColEq
    exact ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀_sub, G_loc, hEq_loc⟩
  have hSubS : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ⊆ S :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r_w).isPreconnected.subset_of_closure_inter_subset
      hS_open hS_nonempty hS_closed
  exact hGlueGlob r_w ρ R F hr_w hρ hρR (fun w hw => hSubS hw)

def IsSliceClearedOnCollar {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W)
    (U_w : Set ℂ) (w₁ : ℂ) (r ε_r : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let U_col := U_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }
  U_col ⊆ W ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ G U_col ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U_col, ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η ≤ F.rad p ∧ Metric.ball p η ⊆ U_col ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p η,
      G q * F.den p q = (q.1 - w₁) ^ m * F.num p q

noncomputable def laurentMoment (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), G (w, ζ) * ζ ^ n

noncomputable def hankelSubmatrix (L : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ) (I : Fin d → ℕ) (w : ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℂ :=
  fun a b => L (I a + (b : ℕ)) w

def Mero2DSheafGluingToolkit : Prop :=
  (∀ (w_a w_b : ℂ) (δ_a δ_b ρ R : ℝ) (W_F : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
     (F : MeroOn2D W_F)
     (G_a : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w_a δ_a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
     0 < δ_b → 0 < ρ → ρ < R →
     Metric.ball w_b δ_b ⊆ Metric.ball w_a δ_a →
     MeroEqOn G_a F (Metric.ball w_a δ_a ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
     ∃ G_b : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w_b δ_b ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn G_b F (Metric.ball w_b δ_b ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ δ₂ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))
     (G₂ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
     0 < δ₂ → 0 < ε_r → ρ < r - ε_r → r + ε_r < R →
     Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) w₁ r ε_r m G →
     MeroEqOn G₂ F (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar G₂ (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂) w₁ r ε_r m G) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R r ε_r δ₀ : ℝ) (w₁ : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (G N_tilde Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })),
     0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → 0 < δ₀ → 0 < ε_r → ρ < r - ε_r → r + ε_r < R →
     Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w →
     IsSliceClearedOnCollar F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) w₁ r ε_r m G →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tilde (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) →
     DifferentiableOn ℂ Q (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) →
     (∃ w_nz ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, w_nz ≠ w₁ ∧
       ∃ z_nz ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, Q (w_nz, z_nz) ≠ 0) →
     (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { z : ℂ | r - ε_r / 2 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < r },
       N_tilde p = Q p * G p) →
     ∃ G_loc : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn G_loc F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) ∧
  (∀ (r_w ρ R : ℝ)
     (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })),
     0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → ρ < R →
     (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
       Metric.ball w δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
       ∃ G : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
         MeroEqOn G F (Metric.ball w δ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) →
     ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
       MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hs_pos : 0 < collarBaseS hDet := hDet.s_det_pos
  have hr_pos : 0 < collarBaseR hDet := lt_min hDet.r_det_pos (half_pos Real.pi_pos)
  have hr_le_det : collarBaseR hDet ≤ hDet.r_det := min_le_left _ _
  obtain ⟨h_X_ge_two, h_L_ge_two, h_X_even, h_L_even, h_X_lsc, h_L_lsc,
    L_mero, X_mero, hL_agrees_two, hX_agrees_two⟩ :=
    collar_glued_tubes_and_symmetries Ω C hDet
  have h_L_eq :=
    collar_width_cramer_reflection_duality Ω C hDet h_X_ge_two h_L_ge_two h_X_even h_L_even
  have hBaseSubDet :
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * collarBaseS hDet ∧ ‖p.2‖ < collarBaseR hDet } ⊆
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨hp.1, by linarith [hp.2, hr_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
  have hImpactHolo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * collarBaseS hDet ∧ ‖p.2‖ < collarBaseR hDet } :=
    fun i => (hDet.impact_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet
  have hDualHolo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * collarBaseS hDet ∧ ‖p.2‖ < collarBaseR hDet } :=
    fun i => (hDet.dualLine_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet
  have hSuperX : HolomorphicDiskSupermeanProp (collarBaseR hDet) (collarWidthX C hDet) :=
    holomorphic_disk_supermean (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet) hs_pos hr_pos
      (fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i) hImpactHolo h_X_ge_two h_X_lsc
      X_mero hX_agrees_two hDisk
  have hSuperL : HolomorphicDiskSupermeanProp (collarBaseR hDet) (collarWidthL C hDet) :=
    holomorphic_disk_supermean (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet) hs_pos hr_pos
      (fun i p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i) hDualHolo h_L_ge_two h_L_lsc
      L_mero hL_agrees_two hDisk
  refine ⟨{
    s_base := collarBaseS hDet
    r_base := collarBaseR hDet
    s_base_pos := hs_pos
    s_base_le_det := le_refl _
    s_base_le_s₁ := hDet.s_det_le_s₁
    s_base_le_s₀ := hDet.s_det_le_s₀
    r_base_pos := hr_pos
    r_base_le_det := hr_le_det
    r_base_lt_s_base := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_s_det
    r_base_lt_r₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_r₁
    r_base_lt_pi := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (half_lt_self Real.pi_pos)
    offset_ne_zero := fun y t hy ht =>
      hDet.offset_ne_zero y t hy (by linarith [ht, hr_le_det])
    h_X := collarWidthX C hDet
    h_L := collarWidthL C hDet
    h_X_ge_two := h_X_ge_two
    h_L_eq := h_L_eq
    h_X_even := h_X_even
    h_L_even := h_L_even
    h_X_lsc := h_X_lsc
    h_L_lsc := h_L_lsc
    h_X_supermean := by
      intro t₀ ρ hρ ht₀ q hq_cont hq_per hq_lt
      let R_Φ : ℝ := (collarBaseR hDet - ‖t₀‖) / ρ
      let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * ζ
      have hR_gt_one : 1 < R_Φ := (one_lt_div hρ).mpr (by linarith)
      have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) :=
        ((differentiable_const t₀).add
          ((differentiable_const (ρ : ℂ)).mul differentiable_id)).differentiableOn
      have hΦ_maps :
          ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ ⊢
        have hζ_mul : ρ * ‖ζ‖ < collarBaseR hDet - ‖t₀‖ := by
          have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ hρ
          rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hρ)] at hmul
        calc ‖t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * ζ‖
            ≤ ‖t₀‖ + ‖(ρ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖t₀‖ + ρ * ‖ζ‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hρ)]
          _ < collarBaseR hDet := by linarith
      have hΦ_deriv : deriv Φ 0 ≠ 0 := by
        have hd : HasDerivAt Φ (ρ : ℂ) 0 := by
          simpa [Φ, mul_one] using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul (ρ : ℂ)).const_add t₀
        rw [hd.deriv]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hρ)
      have hres := hSuperX R_Φ Φ hR_gt_one hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hΦ_deriv q hq_cont hq_per hq_lt
      simpa [Φ] using hres
    L_mero := L_mero
    X_mero := X_mero
    L_agrees_two := hL_agrees_two
    X_agrees_two := hX_agrees_two
    h_L_maximal := fun _t b δ _ht hb hδ hsub G hG =>
      le_sSup ⟨b, ⟨hb, δ, hδ, hsub, G, hG⟩, rfl⟩
    real_interval_countable_transfer :=
      half_disk_countable_superharmonic_transfer (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet)
        hs_pos hr_pos (collarWidthL C hDet) h_L_ge_two h_L_lsc hSuperL
  }⟩

collar_widths_and_superharmonicity.definitions:
noncomputable def collarBaseS {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℝ :=
  hDet.s_det

noncomputable def collarBaseR {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℝ :=
  min hDet.r_det (Real.pi / 2)

def IsCollarHeightWitness (s_base r_base : ℝ) (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (t : ℂ) (b : ℝ) : Prop :=
  s_base < b ∧
  ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball t δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base ∧
    ∃ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D ({ y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ),
      ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (F_init i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)

noncomputable def meroStripWidth (s_base r_base : ℝ) (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (t : ℂ) : ENNReal :=
  sSup { x : ENNReal | ∃ b : ℝ, IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t b ∧
    x = ENNReal.ofReal b }

noncomputable def collarWidthX {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℂ → ENNReal :=
  meroStripWidth (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet)
    (fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)

noncomputable def collarWidthL {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) : ℂ → ENNReal :=
  meroStripWidth (collarBaseS hDet) (collarBaseR hDet)
    (fun i p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)

def HolomorphicDiskSupermeanProp (r_base : ℝ) (h_F : ℂ → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ (R_Φ : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℂ),
    1 < R_Φ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base) →
    deriv Φ 0 ≠ 0 →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_F (Φ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_F (Φ 0)
