            ∀ t₂ ∈ Set.Ioo (u.1 - (B_fn u).r₁ / 2) (u.1 + (B_fn u).r₁ / 2) \ E_bad,
              ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + ε / 16) ≤ W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) := by
      intro u
      have hu_abs : |u.1| < W.r_base := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith [u.2.1.1, u.2.1.2, hδ_star_pos, hδ_star_lt,
          le_abs_self t₀, neg_le_abs t₀]
      obtain ⟨E_bad, hE_cnt, hE_prop⟩ :=
        weierstrass_wall_monodromy_defect Ω C hDet W H₁ (ε / 16) u.1
          (by linarith) hu_abs (B_fn u)
      refine ⟨E_bad, hE_cnt, fun t₂ ht₂ => ?_⟩
      rcases hE_prop t₂ ht₂ with h_ge | hD
      · exact h_ge
      · obtain ⟨D_wall⟩ := hD
        have hRefl : PolyReflectionProp C W.s_base W.r_base D_wall.K :=
          loop_involution_polynomial_reflection Ω C hDet W t₂ D_wall
        exact False.elim
          (differential_shear_root_contradiction Ω C hDet W.s_base W.r_base
            W.s_base_pos W.s_base_le_det W.r_base_pos W.r_base_le_det
            W.r_base_lt_s_base D_wall.K hRefl)
    choose E_bad hE_bad_cnt hE_bad_bound using h_weier
    let J : I_irr → Set ℝ :=
      fun u => Set.Ioo (u.1 - (B_fn u).r₁ / 2) (u.1 + (B_fn u).r₁ / 2)
    obtain ⟨T_cnt, hT_cnt, hT_union⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable J (fun _ => isOpen_Ioo)
    let E_rat : Set ℝ := Set.range (fun q : ℚ => (q : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))
    let E_cnt : Set ℝ := E_rat ∪ ⋃ u ∈ T_cnt, E_bad u
    have hE_cnt : E_cnt.Countable :=
      (Set.countable_range _).union (hT_cnt.biUnion (fun u _ => hE_bad_cnt u))
    have h_ae :
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ_star) (t₀ + δ_star) \ E_cnt,
          ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + ε / 16) ≤ W.h_L (t : ℂ) := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_not_rat : t ∉ E_rat := fun h => ht.2 (Or.inl h)
      have ht_irr : Irrational (t / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
        rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
        apply ht_not_rat
        refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
        have h2pi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.two_pi_pos
        dsimp only
        rw [hq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2pi]
      let u₀ : I_irr := ⟨t, ht.1, ht_irr⟩
      have ht_Ju₀ : t ∈ J u₀ := by
        have hr₁_pos : 0 < (B_fn u₀).r₁ := (B_fn u₀).r₁_pos
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have ht_iUnion : t ∈ ⋃ u : I_irr, J u := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u₀, ht_Ju₀⟩
      rw [← hT_union] at ht_iUnion
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp ht_iUnion with ⟨u₁, hu₁_mem, ht_Ju₁⟩
      have ht_not_bad : t ∉ E_bad u₁ :=
        fun hbad => ht.2 (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨u₁, hu₁_mem, hbad⟩))
      exact hE_bad_bound u₁ t ⟨ht_Ju₁, ht_not_bad⟩
    have h_transfer : ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + ε / 16) ≤ W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) :=
      W.real_interval_countable_transfer t₀ δ_star (H₁ + ε / 16) E_cnt
        hδ_star_pos (by linarith) hE_cnt h_ae
    rw [hhL] at h_transfer
    have h_le_real : H₁ + ε / 16 ≤ H₁ :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₁_pos)).mp h_transfer
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t₀ x₀ H₁ ε ht₀ hhX hε_pos hε_lt ⟨g, δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le, hg⟩
    have ht₀_ball : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht₀
    have hhL : W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ := by
      have h_eq := W.h_L_eq (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball
      simpa [hhX] using h_eq
    exact h_no_patch t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ ht₀ hhL hε_pos hε_lt hδ_pos hδ_le (Or.inl ⟨g, hg⟩)
  · intro t₀ x₀ H₁ ε ht₀ hhL hε_pos hε_lt ⟨g, δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le, hg⟩
    exact h_no_patch t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ ht₀ hhL hε_pos hε_lt hδ_pos hδ_le (Or.inr ⟨g, hg⟩)

structure FullBandPolyData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (H₁ η t₁ : ℝ) where
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  ball_sub_base : Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base
  h_L_lower : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁, ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - η) < W.h_L t
  N_cov : ℕ
  y_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  τ_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  ρ_y : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_t : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_pos : ∀ β : Fin N_cov, 0 < ρ_y β ∧ 0 < ρ_t β ∧
    Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β) ⊆ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁
  covers_band : ∀ (x y_im : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
    y_im ∈ Set.Icc (H₁ - η) (H₁ + η) →
    t ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (r₁ / 2) →
    ∃ β : Fin N_cov,
      ((x : ℂ) + (y_im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (3 * ρ_y β / 4) ∧
      t ∈ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (3 * ρ_t β / 4)
  deg : Fin N_cov → Fin 2 → ℕ
  deg_pos : ∀ β ι, 1 ≤ deg β ι
  C_coeff : ∀ (β : Fin N_cov) (ι : Fin 2), Fin (deg β ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  H_exc : Fin N_cov → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  coeff_holo : ∀ β ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_coeff β ι d)
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β))
  exc_holo : ∀ β,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_exc β)
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β))
  exc_ne_zero : ∀ β,
    ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β), H_exc β p ≠ 0
  lead_dvd_exc : ∀ β ι, ∃ G_div : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G_div
      (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β),
      H_exc β q = C_coeff β ι (Fin.last (deg β ι)) q * G_div q
  separable_at : ∀ β ι,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β),
      H_exc β q ≠ 0 →
      C_coeff β ι (Fin.last (deg β ι)) q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι + 1), C_coeff β ι d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * C_coeff β ι d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  primary_solves : ∀ β ι,
    ∀ p ∈ (Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β)) ∩
        meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L,
      ∃ r_p : ℝ, 0 < r_p ∧ r_p ≤ (W.L_mero ι).rad p ∧
        Metric.ball p r_p ⊆
          Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ_y β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ_t β) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r_p,
          ∑ d : Fin (deg β ι + 1),
            C_coeff β ι d q *
              ((W.L_mero ι).num p q) ^ (d : ℕ) *
              ((W.L_mero ι).den p q) ^ (deg β ι - (d : ℕ)) = 0

def WallRegAt {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ H₂ x : ℝ) : Prop :=

structure AlignedWallDefectData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) (t₂ : ℝ) where
  t₂_mem : |t₂| < W.r_base
  t₂_irr : Irrational (t₂ / (2 * Real.pi))
  H₂ : ℝ
  h_L_eq_H₂ : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂
  H₂_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₂
  x_star : ℝ
  K : ℕ
  unaligned_wall_reg : ∀ q : ℤ, (q ≤ 0 ∨ K < q.natAbs) →
    WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + (q : ℝ) * t₂)
  ρ₀ : ℝ
  ρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀
  ρ₀_lt : ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2
  loop_branch_one : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ →
    ∃ (δ_w δ_loop : ℝ) (Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ_w ∧ δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < δ_loop ∧
      Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
      let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
      let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
            w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) } ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
      p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip) ∧
      (∃ r_att : ℝ, 0 < r_att ∧
        ∀ w t : ℂ, ‖w - w_start‖ < r_att → ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < r_att →
          (w, t) ∈ LoopStrip ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2,
            (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
            (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) =
              Λ_loop ι (w, t) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t)) ∧
      (∃ ι : Fin 2,
        ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            Λ_loop ι (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι p)

abbrev SymJetVar (N_idx M : ℕ) : Type :=
  Fin N_idx × Fin 2 × Fin (M + 1) × Fin (M + 1)

noncomputable def symJetEnv {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
      (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 v.2.1) p

def PolyReflectionProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_b r_b : ℝ) (K : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (N_idx M D : ℕ) (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
    (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, (q_idx a ≤ 0 ∨ K < (q_idx a).natAbs) ∧
      ∃ b : Fin N_idx, q_idx b = -q_idx a) →
    let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
    let V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

structure AlignedWallDefectData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) (t₂ : ℝ) where
  t₂_mem : |t₂| < W.r_base
  t₂_irr : Irrational (t₂ / (2 * Real.pi))
  H₂ : ℝ
  h_L_eq_H₂ : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂
  H₂_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₂
  x_star : ℝ
  K : ℕ
  unaligned_wall_reg : ∀ q : ℤ, (q ≤ 0 ∨ K < q.natAbs) →
    WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + (q : ℝ) * t₂)
  ρ₀ : ℝ
  ρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀
  ρ₀_lt : ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2
  loop_branch_one : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ →
    ∃ (δ_w δ_loop : ℝ) (Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ_w ∧ δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < δ_loop ∧
      Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
      let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
      let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
            w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) } ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
      p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip) ∧
      (∃ r_att : ℝ, 0 < r_att ∧
        ∀ w t : ℂ, ‖w - w_start‖ < r_att → ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < r_att →
          (w, t) ∈ LoopStrip ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2,
            (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
            (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) =
              Λ_loop ι (w, t) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t)) ∧
      (∃ ι : Fin 2,
        ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            Λ_loop ι (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι p)

abbrev SymJetVar (N_idx M : ℕ) : Type :=
  Fin N_idx × Fin 2 × Fin (M + 1) × Fin (M + 1)

noncomputable def symJetEnv {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
      (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 v.2.1) p

def PolyReflectionProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_b r_b : ℝ) (K : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (N_idx M D : ℕ) (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
    (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, (q_idx a ≤ 0 ∨ K < (q_idx a).natAbs) ∧
      ∃ b : Fin N_idx, q_idx b = -q_idx a) →
    let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
    let V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
    (∀ p ∈ V_dom,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

structure ZeroSliceExtractedData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) where
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_nf : MeromorphicNFOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicNFOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  Γ_conj_nhdsNE : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), ∀ i : Fin 2,
    ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ,
      Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice z i)
  L_slice_holo_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s →
        ∃ (r_z : ℝ) (L_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < r_z ∧
          Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z))

def slabBox (x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + 2 * δ_slab ∧
    |p.1.im - y_row| < 2 * δ_slab ∧
    ‖p.2‖ < 2 * δ_t }

    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) (H₀ : ℝ) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  R_0 : ℝ
  y_row : ℝ
  δ_slab : ℝ
  δ_t : ℝ
  δ_rec : ℝ
  C_rec : ℝ

  H₀_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀
  R_0_pos : 0 < R_0
  R_0_lt : R_0 < W.s_base / 2

  δ_t_pos : 0 < δ_t

  G_succ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  L_line : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_slab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  G_succ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_succ
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  G_succ_cubic : ∀ V Δ : ℂ,
    V ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 →
    Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
    ‖G_succ (V, Δ) - Δ‖ ≤ C_rec * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3
  L_line_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_line i)
    (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec)
  V_slab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_slab (slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t)
  V_slab_quad : ∀ p ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t,

  slab_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ,
    (y - t, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →

    ‖V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t)‖ < δ_rec ∧
    ‖V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)‖ < δ_rec ∧

      G_succ (V_slab (y, t), V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t))
  slab_agrees_L : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i)
      (fun p => L_line i (V_slab p, V_slab (p.1 + p.2, p.2) - V_slab p))
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + δ_slab ∧
        |p.1.im - y_row| < δ_slab ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < δ_t }
  L_mero_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L,
    (p.1, -p.2) ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (p.1, -p.2))),
      (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) =
        (W.L_mero i).num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) * (W.L_mero i).den p q

def steepCorridorY (x_edge H₀ R_0 y_row δ_slab : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { y : ℂ |
    |y.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 8 ∧
    y_row - δ_slab / 2 < y.im ∧ y.im < H₀ + R_0 / 32 }

def steepSectorT (r_steep : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < r_steep ∧ ‖t‖ / 3 < |t.im| }

            (steepSectorT r_steep ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_μ))

def slabBox (x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |

    |p.1.im - y_row| < 2 * δ_slab ∧

              supportAction2_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) * db) u := by
          have hh_m : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 2 * R.h (((a₀ + v * da) + (b₀ + v * db)) / 2))
              (2 * (deriv R.h (((a₀ + u * da) + (b₀ + u * db)) / 2) * ((da + db) / 2))) u :=
            ((hh_diff _).hasDerivAt.comp u hm).const_mul 2
          exact (hh_m.mul hd.sin).congr_deriv (by
            simp only [supportAction1_ℝ, supportAction2_ℝ]
            ring)
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => v * (A_lin j * da + B_lin j * db))
            (A_lin j * da + B_lin j * db) u :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id u).mul_const (A_lin j * da + B_lin j * db)).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
        exact (hS.sub hlin).congr_deriv (by simp only [γ']; ring)
      have hiγ : IntervalIntegrable γ' MeasureTheory.volume (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        have hm_c : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((a₀ + u * da) + (b₀ + u * db)) / 2) := by continuity
        have hd_c : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((b₀ + u * db) - (a₀ + u * da)) / 2) := by continuity
        have hs1_c : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => supportAction1_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db)) :=
          ((hdh_smooth.continuous.comp hm_c).mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hd_c)).sub
            ((R.h_smooth.continuous.comp hm_c).mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hd_c))
        have hs2_c : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => supportAction2_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db)) :=
          ((hdh_smooth.continuous.comp hm_c).mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hd_c)).add
            ((R.h_smooth.continuous.comp hm_c).mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hd_c))
        exact (((hs1_c.sub continuous_const).mul continuous_const).add
          ((hs2_c.sub continuous_const).mul continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hint_γ := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hdγ hiγ
      have hγ_end : γ 1 - γ 0 =
          S_gen (θ_orb x₂ j) (θ_orb x₂ (j + 1)) - S_gen (θ_orb x₁ j) (θ_orb x₁ (j + 1)) -
            (A_lin j * da + B_lin j * db) := by
        have ha1 : a₀ + 1 * da = θ_orb x₂ j := by simp [a₀, da, Δ]
        have hb1 : b₀ + 1 * db = θ_orb x₂ (j + 1) := by simp [b₀, db, Δ]
        have ha0 : a₀ + 0 * da = θ_orb x₁ j := by simp [a₀]
        have hb0 : b₀ + 0 * db = θ_orb x₁ (j + 1) := by simp [b₀]
        dsimp only [γ]
        rw [ha1, hb1, ha0, hb0]
        ring
      rw [← hγ_end, ← hint_γ, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hbnd_u : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖γ' u‖ ≤ 32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 := by
        intro u hu
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hu
        have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu.1
        have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := hu.2
        have hl1 : |supportAction1_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) - A_lin j| ≤
            2 * M_h * (|da| + |db|) := by
          have := hS1_lip (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) a₀ b₀
          have hda_u : |(a₀ + u * da) - a₀| ≤ |da| := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg da]
          have hdb_u : |(b₀ + u * db) - b₀| ≤ |db| := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg db]
          exact le_trans this (by gcongr)
        have hl2 : |supportAction2_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) - B_lin j| ≤
            2 * M_h * (|da| + |db|) := by
          have := hS2_lip (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) a₀ b₀
          have hda_u : |(a₀ + u * da) - a₀| ≤ |da| := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg da]
          have hdb_u : |(b₀ + u * db) - b₀| ≤ |db| := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg db]
          exact le_trans this (by gcongr)
        have hda_le : |da| ≤ 2 * M_ϕ * |x₂ - x₁| := hΔ_bnd j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
        have hdb_le : |db| ≤ 2 * M_ϕ * |x₂ - x₁| := hΔ_bnd (j + 1) hj
        have hsum_d_le : |da| + |db| ≤ 4 * M_ϕ * |x₂ - x₁| := by linarith
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have h1 : |(supportAction1_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) - A_lin j) * da +
            (supportAction2_ℝ R.h (a₀ + u * da) (b₀ + u * db) - B_lin j) * db| ≤
            2 * M_h * (|da| + |db|) * |da| + 2 * M_h * (|da| + |db|) * |db| := by
          refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) ?_
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          exact add_le_add (by gcongr) (by gcongr)
        calc _ ≤ 2 * M_h * (|da| + |db|) ^ 2 := by linarith
          _ ≤ 2 * M_h * (4 * M_ϕ * |x₂ - x₁|) ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = 32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * |x₂ - x₁| ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
      have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbnd_u
      simpa using this
    have h_diff_c :
        R.c * (critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₂ - critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₁) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          (S_gen (θ_orb x₂ j) (θ_orb x₂ (j + 1)) - S_gen (θ_orb x₁ j) (θ_orb x₁ (j + 1)) -
            (A_lin j * Δ j + B_lin j * Δ (j + 1))) := by
      have hc2 := h_crit_closed x₂
      have hc1 := h_crit_closed x₁
      have hsub_sum :
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, S_gen (θ_orb x₂ j) (θ_orb x₂ (j + 1))) -
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, S_gen (θ_orb x₁ j) (θ_orb x₁ (j + 1))) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            (S_gen (θ_orb x₂ j) (θ_orb x₂ (j + 1)) - S_gen (θ_orb x₁ j) (θ_orb x₁ (j + 1)) -
              (A_lin j * Δ j + B_lin j * Δ (j + 1))) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, h_lin_sum_zero, sub_zero, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      linarith
    have hc_abs : R.c * |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₂ - critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₁| ≤
        (q : ℝ) * (32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2) := by
      calc R.c * |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₂ - critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₁|
          = |R.c * (critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₂ - critAction_ℝ q u_tab x₁)| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos R.c_pos]
        _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
              |S_gen (θ_orb x₂ j) (θ_orb x₂ (j + 1)) - S_gen (θ_orb x₁ j) (θ_orb x₁ (j + 1)) -
                (A_lin j * Δ j + B_lin j * Δ (j + 1))| := by
              rw [h_diff_c]; exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, (32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j hj => h_cell_quad j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))
        _ = (q : ℝ) * (32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2) := by simp
    rw [show K_quad * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2 =
        ((q : ℝ) * (32 * M_h * M_ϕ ^ 2 * (x₂ - x₁) ^ 2)) / R.c by
          simp only [K_quad]; ring]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ R.c_pos).mpr (by linarith)
  
  by_contra hne
  have hdiff_pos : 0 < |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x_target - critAction_ℝ q u_tab 0| :=
    abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_nat_gt
    (max 1 ((K_quad * x_target ^ 2) / |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x_target - critAction_ℝ q u_tab 0|))
  have hM_gt1 : 1 < M := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hM)
  have hM_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (M : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < M)
  have hM_ne : (M : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hM_pos
  let pt : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ((m : ℝ) / (M : ℝ)) * x_target
  have h_subdiv : |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x_target - critAction_ℝ q u_tab 0| ≤
      (K_quad * x_target ^ 2) / (M : ℝ) := by
    have hpt0 : pt 0 = 0 := by simp [pt]
    have hptM : pt M = x_target := by simp [pt, div_self hM_ne]
    have htel := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun m => critAction_ℝ q u_tab (pt m)) M
    rw [hpt0, hptM] at htel
    rw [← htel]
    calc |∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
            (critAction_ℝ q u_tab (pt (m + 1)) - critAction_ℝ q u_tab (pt m))|
        ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
            |critAction_ℝ q u_tab (pt (m + 1)) - critAction_ℝ q u_tab (pt m)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _m ∈ Finset.range M, (K_quad * (x_target / (M : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => ?_)
          have hstep : pt (m + 1) - pt m = x_target / (M : ℝ) := by
            simp only [pt, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]; ring
          simpa only [hstep] using h_crit_quad (pt m) (pt (m + 1))
      _ = (M : ℝ) * (K_quad * (x_target / (M : ℝ)) ^ 2) := by simp
      _ = (K_quad * x_target ^ 2) / (M : ℝ) := by field_simp [hM_ne]
  have hM_gt : (K_quad * x_target ^ 2) /
      |critAction_ℝ q u_tab x_target - critAction_ℝ q u_tab 0| < (M : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hM
  have h1 := (div_lt_iff₀ hdiff_pos).mp hM_gt
  have h2 := (le_div_iff₀ hM_pos).mp h_subdiv
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨J_R⟩ := real_jet_and_candidate_uniqueness m M₁ hm hM₁
  obtain ⟨J_C⟩ := strip_holomorphic_jet_and_midpoint m M₁ hm hM₁
  obtain ⟨R_sys⟩ := real_dirichlet_mesh_contraction m M₁ hm hM₁ J_R
  obtain ⟨S_sys⟩ := strip_dirichlet_mesh_contraction m M₁ hm hM₁ R_sys J_C
  let R_mesh : ℝ := max R_sys.R_real S_sys.R_strip
  let K_mesh : ℝ := S_sys.K_strip
  let N_mesh : ℕ := max R_sys.N_real S_sys.N_strip
  refine ⟨{
    R_mesh := R_mesh
    K_mesh := K_mesh
    N_mesh := N_mesh
    R_mesh_pos := lt_max_of_lt_left R_sys.R_real_pos
    K_mesh_pos := S_sys.K_strip_pos
    N_mesh_ge_four := le_trans R_sys.N_real_ge_four (le_max_left _ _)
    real_mesh_props := ?_
    real_mesh_lip := ?_
    strip_mesh_ext := ?_
    strip_mesh_lip := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro q w hq hw
    have hq_real : R_sys.N_real ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hq
    obtain ⟨hUniq, hDisp0, hDispq, hDisp, hMid⟩ := R_sys.real_mesh_props q w hq_real hw
    refine ⟨hUniq, hDisp0, hDispq, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hPer, hSmooth, hBnd⟩ := hDisp j hj
      exact ⟨hPer, hSmooth, fun k hk x => le_trans (hBnd k hk x) (le_max_left _ _)⟩
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hPer, hSmooth, hStepBnd, hMidBnd⟩ := hMid j hj
      exact ⟨hPer, hSmooth,
        fun k hk x => le_trans (hStepBnd k hk x) (le_max_left _ _),
        fun k hk x => le_trans (hMidBnd k hk x) (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  · intro q w₁ w₂ hq hw₁ hw₂
    have hq_real : R_sys.N_real ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hq
    obtain ⟨hLip1, hLip2, hLip3⟩ := R_sys.real_mesh_lip q w₁ w₂ hq_real hw₁ hw₂
    have hSupNonneg : 0 ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨j, _, y, _, rfl⟩
      exact abs_nonneg _
    have hMul : R_sys.R_real * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ≤ R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hSupNonneg
    exact ⟨fun j hj k hk x => le_trans (hLip1 j hj k hk x) hMul,
      fun j hj k hk x => le_trans (hLip2 j hj k hk x) hMul,
      fun j hj k hk x => le_trans (hLip3 j hj k hk x) hMul⟩
  · intro σ q w W hσ hq hKq hw hW
    have hq_strip : S_sys.N_strip ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hq
    obtain ⟨X_ℂ, μ_ℂ, hEnds, hX, hμ⟩ := S_sys.strip_mesh_ext σ q w W hσ hq_strip hKq hw hW
    refine ⟨X_ℂ, μ_ℂ, hEnds, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hHolo, hReal, hPer, hConj, hMaps, hBnd⟩ := hX j hj
      exact ⟨hHolo, hReal, hPer, hConj, hMaps,
        fun k hk z hz => le_trans (hBnd k hk z hz) (le_max_right _ _)⟩
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hHolo, hReal, hPer, hConj, hMaps, hStepBnd, hMidBnd⟩ := hμ j hj
      exact ⟨hHolo, hReal, hPer, hConj, hMaps,
        fun k hk z hz => le_trans (hStepBnd k hk z hz) (le_max_right _ _),
        fun k hk z hz => le_trans (hMidBnd k hk z hz) (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · intro σ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ hσ hq hKq hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ hX hμ
    have hq_strip : S_sys.N_strip ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hq
    obtain ⟨hLip1, hLip2, hLip3⟩ :=
      S_sys.strip_mesh_lip σ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ hσ hq_strip hKq hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ hX hμ
    have hSupNonneg : 0 ≤ stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨j, _, ζ, _, rfl⟩
      exact norm_nonneg _
    have hMul : S_sys.R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ≤ R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hSupNonneg
    exact ⟨fun j hj k hk z hz => le_trans (hLip1 j hj k hk z hz) hMul,
      fun j hj k hk z hz => le_trans (hLip2 j hj k hk z hz) hMul,
      fun j hj k hk z hz => le_trans (hLip3 j hj k hk z hz) hMul⟩

uniform_stationary_mesh_system.definitions:
def IsRealJetPerturb (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Function.Periodic e (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) e ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k e x| ≤ B

def IsStripJetPerturb (p : ℕ) (σ' α B : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ') ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (z + 2 * Real.pi) = e z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (e z)) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖deriv e z‖ ≤ α) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k e z‖ ≤ B)

structure RealJetAndUniquenessData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  C_mid_R : ℝ
  C_jet_R : ℝ
  N_jet_R : ℕ
  C_mid_R_pos : 0 < C_mid_R
  C_jet_R_pos : 0 < C_jet_R
  N_jet_R_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_jet_R
  a_R : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ
  b_R : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  action_factor : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X T : ℝ, |T| ≤ 2 →
      normAction1_ℝ w X (X + T) =
        T ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + a_R w X * T ^ 2 + T ^ 3 * b_R w X T)
  candidate_unique : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet_R ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ (x : ℝ) (X₁ X₂ : ℕ → ℝ),
      IsStationaryRealMesh q w x X₁ →
      IsStationaryRealMesh q w x X₂ →
      X₁ = X₂
  midpoint_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet_R ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_T x
    let μ_disp : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => midpoint_ℝ w (X x) (X x + T x) - (X x + T x / 2)
    Function.Periodic μ_disp (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) μ_disp ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k μ_disp x| ≤ C_mid_R
  jet_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet_R ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T x
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => a_R w (X x)) ∧
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => b_R w (X x) (T x))
  midpoint_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ Δe Δτ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet_R ≤ q →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) x| ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) x| ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₁ x
    let T₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_T₁ x
    let X₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₂ x
    let T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_T₂ x
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k
          (fun y =>
            (midpoint_ℝ w₁ (X₁ y) (X₁ y + T₁ y) - (X₁ y + T₁ y / 2)) -
              (midpoint_ℝ w₂ (X₂ y) (X₂ y + T₂ y) - (X₂ y + T₂ y / 2))) x| ≤
        C_mid_R * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

  DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ') ∧

  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (e z)) ∧

by
  have hCalc : NormActionCalculusProp := normAction_real_calculus_and_variation
  obtain ⟨H_inv⟩ := halfCell_inverse_system m M hm hM S
  obtain ⟨H_kern⟩ := forward_cell_kernel_system m M hm hM S
  obtain ⟨K_real, N_real, hKr_pos, hNr_max, hMult⟩ :=
    multiplier_oscillatory_assembly_and_bounds m M hm hM S H_inv H_kern
  have hInv_le_real : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_real :=
    le_trans (le_max_left H_inv.N_inv H_kern.N_kern) hNr_max
  have hMesh_le_real : S.N_mesh ≤ N_real :=
    le_trans H_inv.N_inv_ge hInv_le_real
  refine ⟨K_real, N_real, hKr_pos, hMesh_le_real, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hn_inv : (H_inv.N_inv : ℤ) ≤ |n| :=
    le_trans (Int.ofNat_le.mpr hInv_le_real) hn
  obtain ⟨hMult1, hMult2⟩ := hMult n hn
  refine ⟨?_, hMult2⟩
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨hCont, hBnd⟩ := hMult1 w hw
  obtain ⟨hPer, hDeriv⟩ :=
    action_directional_deriv_and_periodicity m M hm hM S hCalc H_inv n hn_inv w hw
  exact ⟨hCont, hPer, hDeriv, hBnd⟩

noncomputable def k0Minus (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2) * (3 * α ^ 2 - 1)

noncomputable def k0Plus (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.pi ^ 2 / 2) * (3 * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1)

noncomputable def fwdKernelMinus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))
    (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x)

noncomputable def fwdKernelPlus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))
    (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x)

noncomputable def halfCellInvDispMinus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z - (z - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def halfCellInvDispPlus (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z - (z - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) / (q : ℝ))

def NormActionCalculusProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
    ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => midpoint_ℝ w p.1 p.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelMinus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelPlus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    (∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z) ∧
    (∀ X Y : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y) (normAction1_ℝ w X Y) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X Y') (-normAction1_ℝ w Y X) Y) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
      Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1) ∧
      (∀ X Y : ℝ, X < Y →
        X < midpoint_ℝ w X Y ∧ midpoint_ℝ w X Y < Y ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + t * v z) X Y)
          ((∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y), cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z * v z) +
            (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y, cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z * v z))
          0))

structure HalfCellInverseSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_inv_ge : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    j < q →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
  inv_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    j < q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispMinus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispMinus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispPlus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispPlus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

structure ForwardKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_kern : ℝ
  N_kern : ℕ
  C_kern_pos : 0 < C_kern
  N_kern_ge : S.N_mesh ≤ N_kern
  kern_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
    N_kern ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    j < q →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fwdKernelMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fwdKernelPlus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fwdKernelMinus q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fwdKernelPlus q w j α) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelMinus q w j α y - k0Minus α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x| ≤
          C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 ∧
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelPlus q w j α y - k0Plus α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x| ≤
          C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3))
  kern_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
    N_kern ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    j < q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelMinus q w₁ j α y - fwdKernelMinus q w₂ j α y) x| ≤
        (C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelPlus q w₁ j α y - fwdKernelPlus q w₂ j α y) x| ≤
        (C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

  halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z - (z - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) / (q : ℝ))

def NormActionCalculusProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
    ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => midpoint_ℝ w p.1 p.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelMinus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelPlus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
    (∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z) ∧
    (∀ X Y : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y) (normAction1_ℝ w X Y) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X Y') (-normAction1_ℝ w Y X) Y) ∧
    (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ),
      Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1) ∧
      (∀ X Y : ℝ, X < Y →
        X < midpoint_ℝ w X Y ∧ midpoint_ℝ w X Y < Y ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + t * v z) X Y)
          ((∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y), cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z * v z) +
            (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y, cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z * v z))
          0))

structure HalfCellInverseSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_inv_ge : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    j < q →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α x) *
          deriv (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
        |iteratedDeriv k (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j α) z| ≤ C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
  inv_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),
    N_inv ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    j < q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispMinus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispMinus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          halfCellInvDispPlus q w₁ j α y - halfCellInvDispPlus q w₂ j α y) z| ≤
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

structure ForwardKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  C_kern : ℝ

  kern_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ),

        (C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

by
  have hStripEqOn : ∀ (H : ℝ), 0 < H → ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip H) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f x = g x) →
      Set.EqOn f g (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H hH f g hf hg hreal
    have hOpen : IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hConv : Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < H
      change |z₁.im| < H at hz₁
      change |z₂.im| < H at hz₂
      have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im|
          ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ < a * H + b * H := by
            rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
            · simp at hab ⊢; subst hab; simpa using hz₂
            · have h1 : a * |z₁.im| < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁ ha_pos
              have h2 : b * |z₂.im| ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hz₂) hb
              linarith
        _ = H := by nlinarith
    have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
      change |(0 : ℂ).im| < H
      simpa using hH
    have hFreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, f z = g z := by
      rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
      intro U hU
      rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff] at hU
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hSub⟩ := hU
      refine ⟨((ε / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), hSub ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hreal (ε / 2)⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,

    rwa [hq_sq]
  have hKmesh_q_lt_one : S.K_mesh / (n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have h1 : S.K_mesh / (n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ H_inv.K_inv / (n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt H_inv.K_mesh_lt) (sq_nonneg _)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hKinv_q_lt_one
  have hBuildTuple : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
      ∃ (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
        IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ n.natAbs w W
          X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus := by
    intro w W hw hW
    have hw_M1 : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) (M + 1) w :=
      ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, fun k hk x => le_trans (hw.2.2 k hk x) (by linarith)⟩
    have hW_M1 : IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ (M + 1) w W :=
      ⟨hW.1, hW.2.1, hW.2.2.1, hW.2.2.2.1,
        fun k hk z hz => le_trans (hW.2.2.2.2 k hk z hz) (by linarith)⟩
    obtain ⟨X_ℂ, μ_ℂ, hMesh⟩ :=
      S.strip_mesh_ext σ n.natAbs w W hσ hNmesh_le_q hKmesh_q_lt_one hw_M1 hW_M1
    obtain ⟨xInvMinus, xInvPlus, hInv⟩ :=
      H_inv.inv_ext σ n.natAbs w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ hσ hNinv_le_q hKinv_q_lt_one hw hW hMesh
    exact ⟨X_ℂ, μ_ℂ, xInvMinus, xInvPlus, hw, hW, hMesh, hInv⟩
  obtain ⟨hMult1, hMult2⟩ := hMult σ n hσ hn hKinv_lt_one
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w W hw hW
    obtain ⟨X_ℂ, μ_ℂ, xInvMinus, xInvPlus, hAdm⟩ := hBuildTuple w W hw hW
    obtain ⟨hB_holo, hB_real, hB_per, hB_bnd⟩ :=
      hMult1 w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus hAdm
    have hSub :
        horizStrip ((1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ) ⊆
          horizStrip ((1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ) := by
      intro z hz
      change |z.im| < (1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ at hz
      change |z.im| < (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
      have hWidth : (1 - K_strip / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ ≤ (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hσ_nonneg
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz hWidth
    refine ⟨stripB_canon n W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus,
      hB_holo.mono hSub, hB_real, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      exact hB_per z (hSub hz)
    · intro k hk z hz
      exact le_trans (hB_bnd k hk z (hSub hz))
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hCm_le_Ks (abs_nonneg _))
  · intro K' hKs_le_K' hK'_lt_one w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ B₁ B₂ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂
      hB₁_holo hB₂_holo hB₁_real hB₂_real k hk z hz
    obtain ⟨X_ℂ₁, μ_ℂ₁, xInvMinus₁, xInvPlus₁, hAdm₁⟩ := hBuildTuple w₁ W₁ hw₁ hW₁
    obtain ⟨X_ℂ₂, μ_ℂ₂, xInvMinus₂, xInvPlus₂, hAdm₂⟩ := hBuildTuple w₂ W₂ hw₂ hW₂
    obtain ⟨hBc₁_holo, hBc₁_real, _, _⟩ :=
      hMult1 w₁ W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ hAdm₁
    obtain ⟨hBc₂_holo, hBc₂_real, _, _⟩ :=
      hMult1 w₂ W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ hAdm₂
    let H' : ℝ := (1 - K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    have hH'_pos : 0 < H' := mul_pos (by linarith) hσ_pos
    have hKinv_le_K' : H_inv.K_inv ≤ K' := le_trans hKinv_le_Ks hKs_le_K'
    have hKinv_div_le_K' : H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ K' / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hKinv_le_K' (sq_nonneg _)
    have hSub' :
        horizStrip H' ⊆ horizStrip ((1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      change |ζ.im| < H' at hζ
      change |ζ.im| < (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
      have hWidth : H' ≤ (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hσ_nonneg
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ hWidth
    let B_c₁ := stripB_canon n W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁
    let B_c₂ := stripB_canon n W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂
    have hEq₁ : Set.EqOn B₁ B_c₁ (horizStrip H') :=
      hStripEqOn H' hH'_pos B₁ B_c₁ hB₁_holo (hBc₁_holo.mono hSub')
        (fun x => (hB₁_real x).trans (hBc₁_real x).symm)
    have hEq₂ : Set.EqOn B₂ B_c₂ (horizStrip H') :=
      hStripEqOn H' hH'_pos B₂ B_c₂ hB₂_holo (hBc₂_holo.mono hSub')
        (fun x => (hB₂_real x).trans (hBc₂_real x).symm)
    have hEqDiff : Set.EqOn (fun ζ : ℂ => B₁ ζ - B₂ ζ) (fun ζ : ℂ => B_c₁ ζ - B_c₂ ζ)
        (horizStrip H') := by
      intro ζ hζ
      simp only [hEq₁ hζ, hEq₂ hζ]
    have hOpen' : IsOpen (horizStrip H') :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hEvEq : (fun ζ : ℂ => B₁ ζ - B₂ ζ) =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun ζ : ℂ => B_c₁ ζ - B_c₂ ζ) :=
      hEqDiff.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen'.mem_nhds hz)
    rw [hEvEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
    have hLip :=
      hMult2 w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂
        hAdm₁ hAdm₂ k hk z (hSub' hz)
    have hSupNonneg : 0 ≤ stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨j, _, ζ, _, rfl⟩
      exact norm_nonneg _
    have hK_le : C_mult / |(n : ℝ)| ≤ K_strip / |(n : ℝ)| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hCm_le_Ks (abs_nonneg _)
    exact le_trans hLip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_le hSupNonneg)

def IsStripMeshExt (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m M₁)
    (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (_W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh))

noncomputable def deltaPhi_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (ζ₂ - ζ₁) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁)))

noncomputable def cellKernelMinus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W X z)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (μ - z) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z)))

noncomputable def cellKernelPlus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W z Y)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (z - μ) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)) Y) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)))

noncomputable def stripCellIntegrand_ℂ (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let x_m := xInvMinus j α z
  let X_m := X_ℂ j x_m
  let μ_m := μ_ℂ j x_m
  let term_m : ℂ :=
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X_m μ_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
      deriv (xInvMinus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_m - z))
  let x_p := xInvPlus j α z
  let Y_p := X_ℂ (j + 1) x_p
  let μ_p := μ_ℂ j x_p
  let term_p : ℂ :=
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y_p μ_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
      deriv (xInvPlus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_p - z))
  term_m + term_p

noncomputable def stripB_canon (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
      ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, stripCellIntegrand_ℂ n W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus j z α

def IsHalfCellInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  let σ_inv := (1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvMinus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvPlus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh ∧
        xInvPlus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z)) = z ∧
        μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α z) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z)) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvMinus j α z + 2 * Real.pi ∧
        xInvPlus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvPlus j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        xInvMinus j α x = halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvMinus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) x ∧
        xInvPlus j α x = halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvPlus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) x) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvMinus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + α / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvPlus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvMinus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvPlus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))

def IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W ∧
  IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ ∧
  IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus

structure StripHalfCellInvSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  K_inv : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  K_mesh_lt : S.K_mesh < K_inv
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_mesh_le : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ →
    ∃ (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus
  inv_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₁ W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₂ W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvMinus₁ j α ζ - xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvPlus₁ j α ζ - xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

structure StripKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) where
  C_ker : ℝ
  N_ker : ℕ
  C_ker_pos : 0 < C_ker
  N_inv_le : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_ker
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  composed_props : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_ker ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w W
      X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        let K_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ
        let K_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ
        let h_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
        let h_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_m ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * α ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_p ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_p ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelPlus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  composed_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_ker ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₁ W₁
      X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₂ W₂
      X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      let K_m₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₁ (X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) ζ
      let K_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₂ (X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) ζ
      let K_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W₁ (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) ζ
      let K_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W₂ (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) ζ
      let h_m₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)
      let h_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => K_m₁ ζ - K_m₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_ker * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => K_p₁ ζ - K_p₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_ker * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m₁ ζ - h_m₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_ker * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => h_p₁ ζ - h_p₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_ker * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

def IsStripMeshExt (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m M₁)
    (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (_W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
        S.R_mesh))

noncomputable def deltaPhi_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (ζ₂ - ζ₁) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁)))

noncomputable def cellKernelMinus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W X z)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (μ - z) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z)))

noncomputable def cellKernelPlus_ℂ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W z Y)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
    Complex.exp (W z) * (z - μ) *
      ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)) Y) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)))

noncomputable def stripCellIntegrand_ℂ (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let x_m := xInvMinus j α z
  let X_m := X_ℂ j x_m
  let μ_m := μ_ℂ j x_m
  let term_m : ℂ :=
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X_m μ_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
      deriv (xInvMinus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_m - z))
  let x_p := xInvPlus j α z
  let Y_p := X_ℂ (j + 1) x_p
  let μ_p := μ_ℂ j x_p
  let term_p : ℂ :=
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y_p μ_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
      deriv (xInvPlus j α) z *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x_p - z))
  term_m + term_p

noncomputable def stripB_canon (n : ℤ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
      ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, stripCellIntegrand_ℂ n W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus j z α

def IsHalfCellInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  let σ_inv := (1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
  ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvMinus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (xInvPlus j α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh ∧
        xInvPlus j α z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α z)) = z ∧
        μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z) +
          (α : ℂ) * (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α z) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α z)) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        xInvMinus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvMinus j α z + 2 * Real.pi ∧
        xInvPlus j α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = xInvPlus j α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        xInvMinus j α x = halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvMinus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) x ∧
        xInvPlus j α x = halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α x ∧
        deriv (xInvPlus j α) x = deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) x) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvMinus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + α / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              xInvPlus j α ζ -
                (ζ - ((((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
          C_inv)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvMinus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInvPlus j α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))

def IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (K_inv C_inv σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W ∧
  IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ ∧
  IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus

structure StripHalfCellInvSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) where
  K_inv : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  N_inv : ℕ
  K_mesh_lt : S.K_mesh < K_inv
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  N_mesh_le : S.N_mesh ≤ N_inv
  inv_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ →
    ∃ (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsHalfCellInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus
  inv_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_inv ≤ q →
    K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₁ W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S K_inv C_inv σ q w₂ W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvMinus₁ j α ζ - xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvPlus₁ j α ζ - xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_inv * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

structure StripKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) where
  C_ker : ℝ
  N_ker : ℕ
  C_ker_pos : 0 < C_ker
  N_inv_le : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_ker
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  composed_props : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_ker ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w W
      X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        let K_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ
        let K_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ
        let h_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
        let h_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ K_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_m (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_p (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_m ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * α ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                K_p ζ -
                  (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                    ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => h_p ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_ker)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                cellKernelPlus_ℂ W
                  (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn
          (fun α : ℝ =>
            iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  composed_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_ker ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₁ W₁
