      refine hseg_mvt (∑' k : ℤ, wienerKernel K₂ σ' D_η n k * ‖c k‖) fun t ht => ?_
      obtain ⟨hbd_cont, G_t, hGt_holo, hGt_real, hGt_per, hGt_bd⟩ := hseg_b t ht
      obtain ⟨_, hconv_eq⟩ := (hF_pair c
        (fun x => H_sys.b_mult n (fun y => w y + t * fourierSeriesℝ c y) x - H_sys.b_mult n w x)
        hc_conj hc_sum_l1 hbd_cont n).1
      rw [hconv_eq]
      have hτ_pos : 0 < (1 - K₂ / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ' := mul_pos (by linarith) hσ'.1
      have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ (K₂ * D_η) / |(n : ℝ)| := by positivity
      have hterm_le : ∀ k : ℤ,
          ‖periodicFourierCoeff
              (fun x => H_sys.b_mult n (fun y => w y + t * fourierSeriesℝ c y) x -
                H_sys.b_mult n w x) (n - k) * c k‖ ≤
            wienerKernel K₂ σ' D_η n k * ‖c k‖ := by
        intro k
        rw [norm_mul]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg (c k))
        have hbd := hF_strip ((1 - K₂ / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ') ((K₂ * D_η) / |(n : ℝ)|)
          (fun x => H_sys.b_mult n (fun y => w y + t * fourierSeriesℝ c y) x - H_sys.b_mult n w x)
          G_t hτ_pos hL_nonneg hGt_holo hGt_real hGt_per hGt_bd (n - k)
        refine le_trans hbd (le_of_eq ?_)
        dsimp [wienerKernel]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_div]
        ring_nf
      have hnorm_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ =>
          ‖periodicFourierCoeff
              (fun x => H_sys.b_mult n (fun y => w y + t * fourierSeriesℝ c y) x -
                H_sys.b_mult n w x) (n - k) * c k‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm_le (hW_row_sum n hn)
      exact le_trans (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm_sum)
        (hnorm_sum.tsum_le_tsum hterm_le (hW_row_sum n hn))
    obtain ⟨hrem_sum, hrem_tsum⟩ := hW_rem_le hrem_pt
    refine ⟨hrem_sum, le_trans hrem_tsum ?_⟩
    calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D_η * (∑' k : ℤ, ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|))
        ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D_η * B_c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc_le_w (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 1 * D_η * B_c := by nlinarith
  · intro n hn w₁ w₂ D hD hw₁ hw₂ hdiff
    obtain ⟨hn₂, hn1, _⟩ := hn_props n hn
    exact (h_act M K₂ N₂ hM_pos hB n hn₂).2.2.1 w₁ w₂ D hn1 hD hw₁ hw₂ hdiff
  · intro c_star hu_smooth hu_sum hu_eq hc_conj hc_sum hc_low hc_smooth hc_zero x
    have hu_conj : ∀ k : ℤ, uTableCoeff R (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (uTableCoeff R k) :=
      fun k => hF_conj (fun y => (uTable R y : ℂ)) (fun y => (uTable R y : ℂ))
        (fun y => (Complex.conj_ofReal _).symm) k
    let d : ℤ → ℂ := fun k => c_star k - uTableCoeff R k
    have hd_conj : ∀ k : ℤ, d (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (d k) :=
      fun k => by dsimp [d]; rw [hc_conj, hu_conj, map_sub]
    have hd_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
        (fun k => norm_sub_le (c_star k) (uTableCoeff R k))
        (hc_sum.add hu_sum)
    have hd_low : ∀ k : ℤ, |k| < (N : ℤ) → d k = 0 :=
      fun k hk => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hc_low k hk)
    have hd_real : ∀ y : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ d y = fourierSeriesℝ c_star y - uTable R y :=
      fun y => by rw [hF_sub c_star (uTableCoeff R) hc_sum hu_sum y, hu_eq y]
    have hd_sum_w0 : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖ * Real.exp (0 * |(k : ℝ)|)) := by
      simpa using hd_sum
    obtain ⟨hW0_row, hW0_ton⟩ := hW_ton 0 1 (fun k => ‖d k‖) (fun n => ‖d n‖)
      ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩ zero_le_one (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hd_sum_w0
    have hd_pt : ∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        ‖d n‖ ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, wienerKernel K₂ 0 1 n k * ‖d k‖ := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hn₂, _, _⟩ := hn_props n hn
      have hn_van : (H_sys.N_vanish : ℤ) ≤ |n| := le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hN₂_van) hn₂
      obtain ⟨hseg_u, hmvt_u⟩ := (h_act M K₂ N₂ hM_pos hB n hn₂).2.2.2
        (uTable R) (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) hu_smooth hc_smooth
        (H_sys.C_table_zero n hn_van) (hc_zero n hn)
      refine hmvt_u (d n) (∑' k : ℤ, wienerKernel K₂ 0 1 n k * ‖d k‖) fun t ht => ?_
      obtain ⟨hbt_cont, hbt_per, hbt_cd, hbt_bd⟩ := hseg_u t ht
      have hunital := ((hF_pair d
        (H_sys.b_mult n (fun y => uTable R y + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star y - uTable R y)))
        hd_conj hd_sum hbt_cont n).2).2
      have hint_eq : (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) *
            H_sys.b_mult n (fun z => uTable R z + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star z - uTable R z)) y *
            ((fourierSeriesℝ c_star y - uTable R y : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) *
            H_sys.b_mult n (fun z => uTable R z + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star z - uTable R z)) y *
            (fourierSeriesℝ d y : ℂ)) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun y _ => ?_
        rw [hd_real y]
      rw [hint_eq, hunital, add_sub_cancel_left]
      have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ K₂ / |(n : ℝ)| := div_nonneg hK₂.le (abs_nonneg _)
      have hterm_le : ∀ k : ℤ,
          ‖periodicFourierCoeff
              (fun y => H_sys.b_mult n
                (fun z => uTable R z + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star z - uTable R z)) y - 1)
              (n - k) * d k‖ ≤
            wienerKernel K₂ 0 1 n k * ‖d k‖ := by
        intro k
        rw [norm_mul]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg (d k))
        have hbd := hF_real
          (fun y => H_sys.b_mult n
            (fun z => uTable R z + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star z - uTable R z)) y - 1)
          (K₂ / |(n : ℝ)|) hL_nonneg hbt_per hbt_cd hbt_bd (n - k)
        refine le_trans hbd (le_of_eq ?_)
        dsimp only [wienerKernel]
        simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_div]
      have hnorm_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ =>
          ‖periodicFourierCoeff
              (fun y => H_sys.b_mult n
                (fun z => uTable R z + t * (fourierSeriesℝ c_star z - uTable R z)) y - 1)
              (n - k) * d k‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm_le (hW0_row n hn)
      exact le_trans (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm_sum)
        (hnorm_sum.tsum_le_tsum hterm_le (hW0_row n hn))
    obtain ⟨_, hd_tsum_le⟩ := hW0_ton hd_pt
    have hlhs_eq : (fun n : ℤ => if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then ‖d n‖ * Real.exp (0 * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0) =
        fun n : ℤ => ‖d n‖ := by
      ext n
      by_cases hn : (N : ℤ) ≤ |n|
      · simp [hn]
      · simp [hn, hd_low n (lt_of_not_ge hn)]
    have hrhs_eq : (fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖ * Real.exp (0 * |(k : ℝ)|)) = fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖ := by
      ext k; simp
    rw [hlhs_eq, hrhs_eq] at hd_tsum_le
    have hd_tsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, ‖d k‖ := tsum_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _
    have hd_tsum_zero : (∑' k : ℤ, ‖d k‖) = 0 := by linarith
    have hhas0 : HasSum (fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖) 0 := hd_tsum_zero ▸ hd_sum.hasSum
    have hd_zero_fn : (fun k : ℤ => ‖d k‖) = 0 :=
      (hasSum_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun k => norm_nonneg (d k))).mp hhas0
    have hc_eq_u : c_star = uTableCoeff R := by
      ext k
      have hk0 : ‖d k‖ = 0 := congrFun hd_zero_fn k
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hk0)
    rw [hc_eq_u, hu_eq x]

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
  have hexp_real_norm : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
    intro k x
    have h_eq : -Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = ((-(k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have hexp_pos_real_norm : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
    intro k x
    have h_eq : Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = (((k : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have h_four_norm_le : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℂ) (L : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
      0 ≤ L → (∀ x : ℝ, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) → ‖periodicFourierCoeff g k‖ ≤ L := by
    intro g L k hL hg
    unfold periodicFourierCoeff
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_pos.le]
    have h_int : ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * g x‖ ≤ L * |2 * Real.pi - 0| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro x _
      rw [norm_mul, hexp_real_norm, one_mul]
      exact hg x
    rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos h2pi_pos] at h_int
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * g x‖
        ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (L * (2 * Real.pi)) := by gcongr
      _ = L := by field_simp [h2pi_ne]
  have h_ibp_step : ∀ (U U' : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ),
      k ≠ 0 →
      (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt U (U' x) x) →
      U (2 * Real.pi) = U 0 →
      Continuous U' →
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U x) =
        (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U' x := by
    intro U U' k hk hU hU_per hU'_cont
    set c : ℂ := -Complex.I * (k : ℂ)
    have hc : c ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero) (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hk)
    let V : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => c⁻¹ * Complex.exp (c * (x : ℂ))
    let V' : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp (c * (x : ℂ))
    have hV_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt V (V' x) x := by
      intro x
      have he : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => c⁻¹ * Complex.exp (c * z))
          (c⁻¹ * (Complex.exp (c * (x : ℂ)) * (c * 1))) (x : ℂ) :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id (x : ℂ)).const_mul c).cexp).const_mul c⁻¹
      have h_simp : c⁻¹ * (Complex.exp (c * (x : ℂ)) * (c * 1)) = V' x := by
        dsimp [V']; field_simp [hc]
      rw [h_simp] at he
      exact he.comp_ofReal
    have hV_per : V (2 * Real.pi) = V 0 := by
      dsimp [V]
      have h_arg : c * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((-k : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        dsimp [c]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I (-k)]
      simp
    have hV'_cont : Continuous V' :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)
    have h_comm1 : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => U x * V' x) := by
      ext x; dsimp [V', c]; ring
    rw [h_comm1, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
      (fun x _ => hU x) (fun x _ => hV_deriv x)
      (hU'_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hV'_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    rw [hU_per, hV_per, sub_self, zero_sub]
    have h_comm2 : (fun x : ℝ => U' x * V x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => c⁻¹ * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U' x)) := by
      ext x; dsimp [V, c]; ring
    rw [h_comm2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have h_cinv : -(c⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U' x) =
        (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * U' x := by
      have hc_eq : c = -(Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) := by dsimp [c]; ring
      rw [hc_eq, inv_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg]
    exact h_cinv
  have h_ibp_iter : ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℂ) (k : ℤ),
      k ≠ 0 →
      (∀ p ≤ m, Continuous (iteratedDeriv p g)) →
      (∀ p < m, Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv p g)) →
      (∀ p < m, Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv p g) (2 * Real.pi)) →
      periodicFourierCoeff g k =
        ((Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) ^ m)⁻¹ * periodicFourierCoeff (iteratedDeriv m g) k := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        intro g k _ _ _ _
        simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ m ih =>
        intro g k hk h_cont h_diff h_per
        rw [ih g k hk (fun p hp => h_cont p (Nat.le_succ_of_le hp))
          (fun p hp => h_diff p (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hp))
          (fun p hp => h_per p (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hp))]
        unfold periodicFourierCoeff
        have h_step := h_ibp_step (iteratedDeriv m g) (iteratedDeriv (m + 1) g) k hk
          (fun x => by rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact (h_diff m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) x).hasDerivAt)
          (by simpa using h_per m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) 0)
          (h_cont (m + 1) le_rfl)
        rw [h_step, pow_succ, mul_inv]
        ring
  have h_ibp_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℂ) (L : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
      k ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ L →
      (∀ p ≤ m, Continuous (iteratedDeriv p g)) →
      (∀ p < m, Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv p g)) →
      (∀ p < m, Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv p g) (2 * Real.pi)) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m g x‖ ≤ L) →
      ‖periodicFourierCoeff g k‖ ≤ L / |(k : ℝ)| ^ m := by
    intro m g L k hk hL h_cont h_diff h_per h_bd
    rw [h_ibp_iter m g k hk h_cont h_diff h_per, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, norm_mul,
      Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_intCast]
    have h1 := h_four_norm_le (iteratedDeriv m g) L k hL h_bd
    calc (|(k : ℝ)| ^ m)⁻¹ * ‖periodicFourierCoeff (iteratedDeriv m g) k‖
        ≤ (|(k : ℝ)| ^ m)⁻¹ * L := by gcongr
      _ = L / |(k : ℝ)| ^ m := by ring

  
  have h_s1 :
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 4) (uTable R) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, uTableCoeff R (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (uTableCoeff R k)) ∧
      Summable (fun k : ℤ => (1 + |(k : ℝ)|) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) ∧
      Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ (uTableCoeff R) x = uTable R x) ∧
      (∀ P : ℕ, 1 ≤ P →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 53 (uTableBound R / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P)) ∧
        IsBoundedStripExt 53 (1 / (P : ℝ)) (uTableBound R / 4)
          (fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P)) (fourierSeriesℂ (uTruncCoeff R P)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, |fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P) x - uTable R x| ≤
          uTableBound R / (P : ℝ) ^ 53)) := by
    let u : ℝ → ℝ := uTable R
    have hϕ'_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (deriv R.ϕ) := by
      simpa using R.ϕ_smooth.iterate_deriv 1
    have hu_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u :=
      hϕ'_smooth.log (fun x => ne_of_gt (R.ϕ_deriv_pos x))
    have hϕ'_per : Function.Periodic (deriv R.ϕ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x
      have hϕ_diff : Differentiable ℝ R.ϕ := R.ϕ_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => R.ϕ (t + 2 * Real.pi))
          (deriv R.ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi) * 1) x :=
        (hϕ_diff (x + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt.comp x ((hasDerivAt_id x).add_const (2 * Real.pi))
      rw [mul_one] at hd1
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => R.ϕ t + 2 * Real.pi) (deriv R.ϕ x) x :=
        (hϕ_diff x).hasDerivAt.add_const (2 * Real.pi)
      have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => R.ϕ (t + 2 * Real.pi)) = (fun t : ℝ => R.ϕ t + 2 * Real.pi) :=
        funext R.ϕ_quasiperiodic
      rw [hfun] at hd1
      exact hd1.unique hd2
    have hu_per : Function.Periodic u (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x; simp [u, uTable, hϕ'_per x]
    have hu_iter_smooth : ∀ p : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (iteratedDeriv p u) := by
      intro p
      rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
      exact hu_smooth.iterate_deriv p
    have hu_iter_per : ∀ p : ℕ, Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv p u) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro p
      induction p with
      | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hu_per
      | succ p ih =>
          intro x
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
          have hd_diff : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv p u) :=
            (hu_iter_smooth p).differentiable (by simp)
          have hd_in : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t + 2 * Real.pi) 1 x :=
            (hasDerivAt_id x).add_const (2 * Real.pi)
          have hd_out : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv p u)
              (deriv (iteratedDeriv p u) (x + 2 * Real.pi)) (x + 2 * Real.pi) :=
            (hd_diff (x + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt
          have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => iteratedDeriv p u (t + 2 * Real.pi))
              (deriv (iteratedDeriv p u) (x + 2 * Real.pi)) x := by
            simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_one] using hd_out.comp x hd_in
          have hd2 : HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv p u) (deriv (iteratedDeriv p u) x) x :=
            (hd_diff x).hasDerivAt
          have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => iteratedDeriv p u (t + 2 * Real.pi)) = iteratedDeriv p u :=
            funext ih
          rw [hfun] at hd1
          exact hd1.unique hd2
    let u_ℂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (u x : ℂ)
    have hu_ℂ_iter : ∀ p : ℕ, iteratedDeriv p u_ℂ = fun x : ℝ => ((iteratedDeriv p u x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro p
      induction p with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ p ih =>
          ext x

              (Real.exp (-τn * d) * Real.exp (σ0 * a)) := by
          generalize (1 + d) ^ 38 = D38
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv K38 a, div_eq_mul_inv _ D38, div_eq_mul_inv 1 (a * D38), mul_inv]
          ring
        have h_rew2 :
            (2 ^ 38 * K38 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) * ((1 + b) ^ 53 / ((P : ℝ) ^ 36 * (1 + a) ^ 2)) *
              Real.exp 2 =
            (2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 / (P : ℝ) ^ 36 * fS2 n) *
              ((1 + b) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) := by
          dsimp [fS2, a]
          generalize (1 + b) ^ 53 = B53
          generalize (P : ℝ) ^ 36 = P36
          generalize (1 + |(n : ℝ)|) ^ 2 = A2
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv B53 (P36 * A2), div_eq_mul_inv _ P36, div_eq_mul_inv 1 A2, mul_inv]
          ring
        rw [h_rew1, ← h_rew2]
        have h_c_nn : 0 ≤ 2 ^ 38 * K38 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖ :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hK38_pos.le) (norm_nonneg _)
        have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (1 + b) ^ 53 / ((P : ℝ) ^ 36 * (1 + a) ^ 2) :=
          div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by linarith [abs_nonneg (k : ℝ)]) 53)
            (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hP_pos.le 36) (sq_nonneg _))
        refine mul_le_mul ?_ hexp_prod
          (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _))
          (mul_nonneg h_c_nn h_rhs_nn)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_peetre h_c_nn
      calc ‖H_sys.C_coeff n u0‖ * Real.exp (σ0 * |(n : ℝ)|)
          ≤ B_sum * Real.exp (σ0 * |(n : ℝ)|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmvt (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = ∑ k ∈ IP, ‖uTableCoeff R k‖ *
              ((2 ^ 38 * (K38 / |(n : ℝ)|) / (1 + |((n - k : ℤ) : ℝ)|) ^ 38) *
                Real.exp (-τn * |((n - k : ℤ) : ℝ)|)) *
              Real.exp (σ0 * |(n : ℝ)|) := by
            dsimp [B_sum]; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ IP, (2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 / (P : ℝ) ^ 36 * fS2 n) *
              ((1 + |(k : ℝ)|) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_term_peetre
        _ = (2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 / (P : ℝ) ^ 36 * fS2 n) *
              ∑ k ∈ IP, (1 + |(k : ℝ)|) ^ 53 * ‖uTableCoeff R k‖ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ (2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 / (P : ℝ) ^ 36 * fS2 n) * M :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIP_M (by positivity)
        _ = (2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 * M / (P : ℝ) ^ 36) * fS2 n := by ring
    
    let f_high : ℤ → ℝ := fun n =>
      if (P : ℤ) < |n| then ‖H_sys.C_coeff n u0‖ * Real.exp (σ0 * |(n : ℝ)|) else 0
    let C_maj : ℝ := 2 ^ 38 * Real.exp 2 * K38 * M / (P : ℝ) ^ 36
    have hf_high_dom : ∀ n : ℤ, f_high n ≤ C_maj * fS2 n := by
      intro n
      dsimp [f_high]
      split_ifs with hn
      · exact h_high_pt n hn
      · positivity
    have hf_high_sum : Summable f_high :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => by dsimp [f_high]; split_ifs <;> positivity)
        hf_high_dom (hfS2_sum.mul_left C_maj)
    have hP_pow2 : (P : ℝ) ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hf_high_tsum : (∑' n : ℤ, f_high n) ≤ 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34) := by
      calc ∑' n : ℤ, f_high n
          ≤ ∑' n : ℤ, C_maj * fS2 n :=
            Summable.tsum_le_tsum hf_high_dom hf_high_sum (hfS2_sum.mul_left C_maj)
        _ = C_maj * S2 := tsum_mul_left
        _ = ((2 ^ 39 * Real.exp 2 * K38 * M * S2) / (P : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34)) := by
            dsimp [C_maj]
            field_simp [ne_of_gt hP_pos]
        _ ≤ 1 * (1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
            rw [div_le_one (pow_pos hP_pos 2)]
            exact le_trans hTail_le_P hP_pow2
        _ = 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34) := one_mul _
    exact ⟨hf_high_sum, hf_high_tsum⟩

  
  obtain ⟨N_init, hN_init_van, hMid⟩ := h_s2
  obtain ⟨P2, hP2_pos, hHigh⟩ := h_s3
  refine ⟨N_init, hN_init_van, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  obtain ⟨P1, hNP1, hMidN⟩ := hMid N hN
  let P0 : ℕ := max P1 P2
  refine ⟨hu17, hconj, hsum1, hinv, P0, lt_of_lt_of_le hNP1 (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro P hPP0
  have hPP1 : P1 ≤ P := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hPP0
  have hPP2 : P2 ≤ P := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hPP0
  have hP_pos_nat : 1 ≤ P := le_trans hP2_pos hPP2
  have hNP : N < P := lt_of_lt_of_le hNP1 hPP1
  obtain ⟨hu0_53, hU0_53, htail⟩ := htrunc P hP_pos_nat
  let u0 : ℝ → ℝ := fourierSeriesℝ (uTruncCoeff R P)
  let U0 : ℂ → ℂ := fourierSeriesℂ (uTruncCoeff R P)
  have hu0_17 : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (uTableBound R / 4) u0 :=
    ⟨hu0_53.1, hu0_53.2.1.of_le (by norm_num), fun k hk x => hu0_53.2.2 k (by omega) x⟩
  have hU0_17 : IsBoundedStripExt 17 (1 / (P : ℝ)) (uTableBound R / 4) u0 U0 :=
    ⟨hU0_53.1, hU0_53.2.1, hU0_53.2.2.1, hU0_53.2.2.2.1,
      fun k hk z hz => hU0_53.2.2.2.2 k (by omega) z hz⟩
  let Smid : Finset ℤ := (Finset.Icc (-(P : ℤ)) (P : ℤ)).filter (fun n => (N : ℤ) ≤ |n|)
  let w_term : ℤ → ℝ := fun n =>
    ‖H_sys.C_coeff n u0‖ * Real.exp ((1 / (P : ℝ)) * |(n : ℝ)|)
  let f_all : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then w_term n else 0
  let f_mid : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => if n ∈ Smid then w_term n else 0
  let f_high : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => if (P : ℤ) < |n| then w_term n else 0
  have hf_split : ∀ n : ℤ, f_all n = f_mid n + f_high n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [f_all, f_mid, f_high, Smid]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, ← abs_le]
    by_cases hnN : (N : ℤ) ≤ |n|
    · by_cases hnP : |n| ≤ (P : ℤ)
      · have hnot : ¬ ((P : ℤ) < |n|) := not_lt.mpr hnP
        simp [hnN, hnP, hnot]
      · have hlt : (P : ℤ) < |n| := not_le.mp hnP
        simp [hnN, hnP, hlt]
    · have hnotP : ¬ ((P : ℤ) < |n|) := by omega
      simp [hnN, hnotP]
  have hf_mid_sum : Summable f_mid :=
    summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Smid) (fun n hn => by simp [f_mid, hn])
  have hf_mid_tsum : (∑' n : ℤ, f_mid n) ≤ 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34) := by
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Smid) (fun n hn => by simp [f_mid, hn])]
    have h_sum_eq : (∑ n ∈ Smid, f_mid n) = ∑ n ∈ Smid, w_term n :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n hn => by simp [f_mid, hn])
    rw [h_sum_eq]
    exact hMidN P hPP1 u0 hu0_17 htail
  obtain ⟨hf_high_sum, hf_high_tsum⟩ := hHigh P hPP2
  have hf_all_eq : f_all = fun n => f_mid n + f_high n := funext hf_split
  have hf_all_sum : Summable f_all := by
    rw [hf_all_eq]
    exact hf_mid_sum.add hf_high_sum
  have hf_all_tsum : (∑' n : ℤ, f_all n) ≤ 1 / (P : ℝ) ^ 34 := by
    rw [hf_all_eq, hf_mid_sum.tsum_add hf_high_sum]
    calc (∑' n : ℤ, f_mid n) + (∑' n : ℤ, f_high n)
        ≤ 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34) + 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ) ^ 34) :=
          add_le_add hf_mid_tsum hf_high_tsum
      _ = 1 / (P : ℝ) ^ 34 := by ring
  exact ⟨hu0_17, hU0_17, hf_all_sum, hf_all_tsum⟩

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hN
  
  
  
  have h_strip_open : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip r) := by
    intro r
    exact isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)

  have h_strip_preconn : ∀ r : ℝ, IsPreconnected (horizStrip r) := by
    intro r
    have h_eq : horizStrip r = Complex.imCLM ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) r := by
      ext z
      simp [horizStrip, Metric.mem_ball]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact ((convex_ball (0 : ℝ) r).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).isPreconnected

  have h_real_mem_strip : ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip r := by
    intro r hr x
    simp [horizStrip, hr]

  have h_exp_norm_strip :
      ∀ {τ : ℝ} (z : ℂ), |z.im| ≤ τ → ∀ k : ℤ,
        ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)‖ ≤ Real.exp (τ * |(k : ℝ)|) := by
    intro τ z hz k
    rw [Complex.norm_exp, Real.exp_le_exp]
    have hre : (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z).re = -(k : ℝ) * z.im := by
      simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [hre]
    calc -(k : ℝ) * z.im
        ≤ |-(k : ℝ) * z.im| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |(k : ℝ)| * |z.im| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_neg]
      _ ≤ |(k : ℝ)| * τ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = τ * |(k : ℝ)| := mul_comm _ _

  have h_exp_norm_real :
      ∀ (x : ℝ) (k : ℤ), ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
    intro x k
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    have hre : (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)).re = 0 := by
      simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [hre, Real.exp_zero]

  have h_fsC_per :
      ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (z : ℂ), fourierSeriesℂ c (z + 2 * Real.pi) = fourierSeriesℂ c z := by
    intro c z
    unfold fourierSeriesℂ
    congr 1
    ext k
    congr 1
    have hexp : Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by ring
    rw [hexp, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]

  have h_fsR_per : ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ), Function.Periodic (fourierSeriesℝ c) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro c x
    unfold fourierSeriesℝ
    have hcast : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, h_fsC_per]

  have h_fsC_conj :
      ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) →
        ∀ z : ℂ, fourierSeriesℂ c (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (fourierSeriesℂ c z) := by
    intro c hc z
    unfold fourierSeriesℂ
    symm
    change Complex.conjCLE (∑' k : ℤ, c k * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)) = _
    rw [Complex.conjCLE.map_tsum, ← (Equiv.neg ℤ).tsum_eq]
    refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
    simp only [Equiv.neg_apply, Complex.conjCLE_apply, map_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    have hck : (starRingEnd ℂ) (c (-k)) = c k := by
      simpa using congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) (hc k)
    rw [hck]
    refine congrArg (c k * ·) (congrArg Complex.exp ?_)
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp

  have h_fsC_real :
      ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ), (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) →
        ∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℂ c (x : ℂ) = (fourierSeriesℝ c x : ℂ) := by
    intro c hc x
    unfold fourierSeriesℝ
    have h1 : starRingEnd ℂ (fourierSeriesℂ c (x : ℂ)) = fourierSeriesℂ c (x : ℂ) := by
      rw [← h_fsC_conj c hc (x : ℂ), Complex.conj_ofReal]
    exact (Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp h1).symm

  have h_smooth_mono :
      ∀ {r₀ : ℕ} {M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {w : ℝ → ℝ},
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded r₀ M₁ w → M₁ ≤ M₂ → IsPeriodicSmoothBounded r₀ M₂ w := by
    intro r₀ M₁ M₂ w hw hM
    exact ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, fun k hk x => le_trans (hw.2.2 k hk x) hM⟩

  have h_strip_mono :
      ∀ {r₀ : ℕ} {σ₁ σ₂ M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {w : ℝ → ℝ} {W : ℂ → ℂ},
        IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ₁ M₁ w W → σ₂ ≤ σ₁ → M₁ ≤ M₂ →
          IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ₂ M₂ w W := by
    intro r₀ σ₁ σ₂ M₁ M₂ w W hW hσ hM
    have hsub : horizStrip σ₂ ⊆ horizStrip σ₁ := fun z hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hz hσ
    exact ⟨hW.1.mono hsub, hW.2.1, fun z hz => hW.2.2.1 z (hsub hz),
      fun z hz => hW.2.2.2.1 z (hsub hz),
      fun k hk z hz => le_trans (hW.2.2.2.2 k hk z (hsub hz)) hM⟩

  
  have h_wiener_strip_calc :
      ∀ (c : ℤ → ℂ) (σ σ' B : ℝ),
        0 < σ' → σ' < σ → σ - σ' ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ B →
        (∀ k : ℤ, c (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c k)) →
        Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) →
        (∑' k : ℤ, ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ B →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (σ - σ')⁻¹ ^ 17 * B) (fourierSeriesℝ c) ∧
        IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ' (((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (σ - σ')⁻¹ ^ 17 * B)
          (fourierSeriesℝ c) (fourierSeriesℂ c) := by
    intro c σ σ' B hσ'_pos hσ'σ ha_le hB_nn hc_conj hc_sum hc_le
    let a : ℝ := σ - σ'
    have ha_pos : 0 < a := sub_pos.mpr hσ'σ
    let F_term : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p k z =>
      (Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) ^ p * c k * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)
    let F_ser : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z => ∑' k : ℤ, F_term p k z
    let u_maj : ℕ → ℤ → ℝ := fun p k =>
      (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * (‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|))
    have hu_sum : ∀ p : ℕ, Summable (u_maj p) := fun p => hc_sum.mul_left _
    have h_term_bound : ∀ (p : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip σ' →
        ‖F_term p k z‖ ≤ u_maj p k := by
      intro p k z hz
      have hzim : |z.im| ≤ σ' := le_of_lt hz
      have hexp := h_exp_norm_strip z hzim k
      have hnorm_ik : ‖(Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) ^ p‖ = |(k : ℝ)| ^ p := by
        rw [norm_pow, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_intCast,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_pow_exp : |(k : ℝ)| ^ p * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|) ≤
          (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|) := by
        have hfac_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (p.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos p)
        have hap_pos : 0 < a ^ p := pow_pos ha_pos p
        have h1 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|) (by positivity) p
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hfac_pos, mul_pow] at h1
        have h2 : |(k : ℝ)| ^ p ≤ (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|) := by
          calc |(k : ℝ)| ^ p
              = (a ^ p)⁻¹ * (a ^ p * |(k : ℝ)| ^ p) := by
                  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hap_pos), one_mul]
            _ ≤ (a ^ p)⁻¹ * (Real.exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|) * (p.factorial : ℝ)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hap_pos))
            _ = (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|) := by
                  rw [inv_pow]; ring
        calc |(k : ℝ)| ^ p * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|)
            ≤ ((p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|)) *
                Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Real.exp_nonneg _)
          _ = (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p *
                (Real.exp (a * |(k : ℝ)|) * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|)) := by ring
          _ = (p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add]
              congr 2
              dsimp [a]
              ring
      calc ‖F_term p k z‖
          = ‖(Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) ^ p‖ * ‖c k‖ * ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)‖ := by
              dsimp [F_term]; rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ = ‖c k‖ * (|(k : ℝ)| ^ p * ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * z)‖) := by
              rw [hnorm_ik]; ring
        _ ≤ ‖c k‖ * (|(k : ℝ)| ^ p * Real.exp (σ' * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ ‖c k‖ * ((p.factorial : ℝ) * a⁻¹ ^ p * Real.exp (σ * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_exp (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = u_maj p k := by dsimp [u_maj]; ring
    have h_term_deriv : ∀ (p : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (z : ℂ),
        HasDerivAt (F_term p k) (F_term (p + 1) k z) z := by
      intro p k z
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => Complex.I * (k : ℂ) * ζ) (Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) z := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul (Complex.I * (k : ℂ))
      have h2 := (h1.cexp).const_mul ((Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) ^ p * c k)
      convert h2 using 1
      dsimp [F_term]
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring
    have h_ser_deriv : ∀ (p : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip σ' →
        HasDerivAt (F_ser p) (F_ser (p + 1) z) z := by
      intro p z hz
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ' := by simp [horizStrip, hσ'_pos]
      have h0_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => F_term p k 0) :=
        Summable.of_norm <|
          Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (fun k => h_term_bound p k 0 h0_mem) (hu_sum p)
      exact hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (hu_sum (p + 1)) (h_strip_open σ')
        (h_strip_preconn σ') (fun k y _ => h_term_deriv p k y)
        (fun k y hy => h_term_bound (p + 1) k y hy) h0_mem h0_sum hz
    have h_iter_C : ∀ (p : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip σ' →
        iteratedDeriv p (fourierSeriesℂ c) z = F_ser p z := by
      intro p
      induction p with
