    intro j ⟨c, hc_conj, _, _, hc_sm, hc_ext, hc_res_sum, hc_res_le⟩
    have hB_le_34 : B_seq j ≤ 3 * M / 4 := le_trans (hB_le_half j) (by linarith)
    exact W_op.solve_high (σ_seq j) (ε_seq j) (fourierSeriesℝ c) (fourierSeriesℂ c)
      (fun n => H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c))
      (hσ_mem_Ioc j) (hε_nn j)
      (h_smooth_mono hc_sm hB_le_34)
      (h_strip_mono hc_ext le_rfl hB_le_34)
      (fun n _ => H_sys.C_conj_symm n (fourierSeriesℝ c))
      hc_res_sum hc_res_le

  let nextStep : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : { c : ℤ → ℂ // State j c }),
      { dc : ℤ → ℂ // StepSpec j s.1 dc } :=
    fun j s => ⟨Classical.choose (h_exists_step j s), Classical.choose_spec (h_exists_step j s)⟩

  have h_next_state : ∀ (j : ℕ) (s : { c : ℤ → ℂ // State j c }),
      State (j + 1) (s.1 + (nextStep j s).1) := by
    intro j s
    let c := s.1
    let dc := (nextStep j s).1
    rcases s.2 with ⟨hc_conj, hc_low, hc_wsum, hc_sm, hc_ext, _, _⟩
    rcases (nextStep j s).2 with ⟨hdc_conj, hdc_low, hdc_wsum, hdc_wle, hdc_lin⟩
    have hσ_next_pos : 0 < σ_seq (j + 1) := (hσ_mem_Ioc (j + 1)).1
    have hσ_next_le : σ_seq (j + 1) ≤ σ_seq j := le_of_lt (hσ_step_lt j)
    
    obtain ⟨hdc_sm_raw, hdc_ext_raw⟩ :=
      h_wiener_strip_calc dc (σ_seq j) (σ_seq (j + 1)) (2 * ε_seq j)
        hσ_next_pos (hσ_step_lt j) (hσ_diff_le_one j) (by positivity)
        hdc_conj hdc_wsum hdc_wle
    let D_η : ℝ := C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹
    have hD_raw_eq :
        ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (σ_seq j - σ_seq (j + 1))⁻¹ ^ 17 * (2 * ε_seq j) = D_η := by
      rw [hσ_diff j, inv_inv]
      dsimp [ε_seq, D_η, C₁]
      have hP34 : (P : ℝ) ^ 34 = (P : ℝ) ^ 17 * (P : ℝ) ^ 17 := by ring
      have hP17_ne : (P : ℝ) ^ 17 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (pow_pos hP_pos 17)
      have h_two_pow : ((2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 17 * (((2 : ℝ) ^ 18)⁻¹) ^ j = ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ := by
        rw [pow_right_comm (2 : ℝ) j 17, ← mul_pow]
        rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ 18)⁻¹ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num, inv_pow]
      calc ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 * (P : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 17 *
              (2 * (((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * (((2 : ℝ) ^ 18)⁻¹) ^ j))
          = 2 * ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ 17 *
              ((P : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹) *
              (((2 : ℝ) ^ j) ^ 17 * (((2 : ℝ) ^ 18)⁻¹) ^ j) := by ring
        _ = 2 * ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ := by
              rw [hP34, mul_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hP17_ne, h_two_pow]
    have hdc_sm : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 D_η (fourierSeriesℝ dc) := by
      rwa [hD_raw_eq] at hdc_sm_raw
    have hdc_ext : IsBoundedStripExt 17 (σ_seq (j + 1)) D_η
        (fourierSeriesℝ dc) (fourierSeriesℂ dc) := by
      rwa [hD_raw_eq] at hdc_ext_raw
    have hD_η_nn : 0 ≤ D_η := by dsimp [D_η]; positivity
    have hD_η_le : D_η ≤ M / 4 := by
      calc D_η
          = C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ := rfl
        _ ≤ C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h2j_inv_le_one j) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ 2 * C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ := by
              have h_nn : 0 ≤ C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ := by positivity
              linarith
        _ ≤ M / 4 := hC₁_thresh
    
    have hc_wsum_next : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity)
        (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ_next_le (abs_nonneg _)))
          (norm_nonneg _)) hc_wsum
    have hdc_wsum_next : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖dc k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity)
        (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ_next_le (abs_nonneg _)))
          (norm_nonneg _)) hdc_wsum
    have hdc_wle_next :
        (∑' k : ℤ, ‖dc k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ 2 * ε_seq j :=
      le_trans
        (Summable.tsum_le_tsum
          (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ_next_le (abs_nonneg _)))
            (norm_nonneg _)) hdc_wsum_next hdc_wsum)
        hdc_wle
    
    obtain ⟨hAddR, h_sum_sm, h_sum_ext⟩ :=
      h_wiener_add c dc (σ_seq (j + 1)) (B_seq j) D_η hσ_next_pos
        hc_wsum_next hdc_wsum_next hc_sm hdc_sm
        (h_strip_mono hc_ext hσ_next_le le_rfl) hdc_ext
    have hB_step_eq : B_seq j + D_η = B_seq (j + 1) := by
      dsimp [B_seq, D_η]
      rw [pow_succ, mul_inv]
      ring
    
    obtain ⟨hrem_sum, hrem_le⟩ :=
      W_op.taylor_rem_wiener (σ_seq (j + 1)) D_η (2 * ε_seq j)
        (fourierSeriesℝ c) (fourierSeriesℂ c) (fourierSeriesℂ dc) dc
        (hσ_mem_Ioc (j + 1)) hD_η_nn hD_η_le (by positivity)
        (h_smooth_mono hc_sm (hB_le_half j))
        (h_strip_mono hc_ext hσ_next_le (hB_le_half j))
        hdc_conj hdc_wsum_next hdc_wle_next hdc_sm hdc_ext
    have hrem_eq :
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then
            ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c + dc))‖ *
              Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(n : ℝ)|)
          else 0) =
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          if (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| then
            ‖(H_sys.C_coeff n (fun x => fourierSeriesℝ c x + fourierSeriesℝ dc x) -
              H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c) -
              ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
                    H_sys.b_mult n (fourierSeriesℝ c) x * (fourierSeriesℝ dc x : ℂ))‖ *
              Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(n : ℝ)|)
          else 0) := by
      ext n
      split_ifs with hn
      · congr 2
        have hfun : (fun x => fourierSeriesℝ c x + fourierSeriesℝ dc x) = fourierSeriesℝ (c + dc) :=
          funext (fun x => (hAddR x).symm)
        rw [hfun, hdc_lin n hn]
        ring
      · rfl
    have h_quad_contract : W_op.C_quad * D_η * (2 * ε_seq j) ≤ ε_seq (j + 1) := by
      have hε_rel : ε_seq j = (2 : ℝ) ^ 18 * ε_seq (j + 1) := by
        dsimp [ε_seq]
        rw [pow_succ]
        ring
      have h_id : W_op.C_quad * D_η * (2 * ε_seq j) =
          (C₂ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ 18) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ * ε_seq (j + 1) := by
        rw [hε_rel]
        dsimp [D_η, C₂]
        ring
      rw [h_id]
      have hprod_le_one :
          (C₂ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ 18) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
        calc (C₂ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ 18) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹
            ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hC₂_thresh (h2j_inv_le_one j) (by positivity) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
      calc (C₂ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ) ^ 18) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ * ε_seq (j + 1)
          ≤ 1 * ε_seq (j + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod_le_one (hε_nn (j + 1))
        _ = ε_seq (j + 1) := one_mul _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      simp [Pi.add_apply, hc_conj k, hdc_conj k, map_add]
    · intro k hk
      simp [Pi.add_apply, hc_low k hk, hdc_low k hk]
    · exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity)
        (fun k => by
          dsimp [Pi.add_apply]
          calc ‖c k + dc k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|)
              ≤ (‖c k‖ + ‖dc k‖) * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_add_le _ _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖c k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|) +
                  ‖dc k‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq (j + 1) * |(k : ℝ)|) := add_mul _ _ _)
        (hc_wsum_next.add hdc_wsum_next)
    · rwa [hB_step_eq] at h_sum_sm
    · rwa [hB_step_eq] at h_sum_ext
    · rw [hrem_eq]; exact hrem_sum
    · rw [hrem_eq]; exact le_trans hrem_le h_quad_contract

  let iter : ∀ j : ℕ, { c : ℤ → ℂ // State j c } :=
    Nat.rec ⟨uTruncCoeff R P, h_state_zero⟩
      (fun j s => ⟨s.1 + (nextStep j s).1, h_next_state j s⟩)
  let c_seq : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ := fun j => (iter j).1
  let Δc : ℕ → ℤ → ℂ := fun j => (nextStep j (iter j)).1

  
  
  
  let q : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ 18)⁻¹
  have hq_nn : 0 ≤ q := by dsimp [q]; positivity
  have hq_lt_one : q < 1 := by dsimp [q]; norm_num
  have hq_geom_le : (∑' j : ℕ, q ^ j) ≤ 2 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one hq_nn hq_lt_one]
    dsimp [q]
    norm_num

  let σ_inf : ℝ := 1 / (2 * (P : ℝ))
  let σ_raw : ℝ := 1 / (4 * (P : ℝ))
  have hσ_raw_pos : 0 < σ_raw := by dsimp [σ_raw]; positivity
  have hσ_raw_lt_inf : σ_raw < σ_inf := by
    dsimp [σ_raw, σ_inf]
    have : 2 * (P : ℝ) < 4 * (P : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity) this
  have hσ_inf_sub_raw : σ_inf - σ_raw = (4 * (P : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [σ_inf, σ_raw]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hσ_inf_sub_le_one : σ_inf - σ_raw ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hσ_inf_sub_raw]
    apply inv_le_one_of_one_le₀
    linarith
  have hσ_inf_le_seq : ∀ j : ℕ, σ_inf ≤ σ_seq j := by
    intro j
    dsimp [σ_inf, σ_seq]
    gcongr
    have : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ j)⁻¹ := by positivity
    linarith

  let f_2d : ℕ × ℤ → ℝ := fun p => ‖Δc p.1 p.2‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(p.2 : ℝ)|)
  have hf_2d_nn : 0 ≤ f_2d := fun _ => by dsimp [f_2d]; positivity

  have hf_row_sum : ∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℤ => f_2d (j, k)) := by
    intro j
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by dsimp [f_2d]; positivity)
      (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hσ_inf_le_seq j) (abs_nonneg _)))
        (norm_nonneg _))
      (nextStep j (iter j)).2.2.2.1

  have hf_row_le : ∀ j : ℕ, (∑' k : ℤ, f_2d (j, k)) ≤ 2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by
    intro j
    exact le_trans
      (Summable.tsum_le_tsum
        (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hσ_inf_le_seq j) (abs_nonneg _)))
          (norm_nonneg _))
        (hf_row_sum j) (nextStep j (iter j)).2.2.2.1)
      (by simpa [ε_seq, q, mul_assoc] using (nextStep j (iter j)).2.2.2.2.1)

  have h_maj_geom_sum : Summable (fun j : ℕ => 2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) :=
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq_nn hq_lt_one).mul_left _

  have hf_outer_sum : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ∑' k : ℤ, f_2d (j, k)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => tsum_nonneg (fun _ => by dsimp [f_2d]; positivity))
      hf_row_le h_maj_geom_sum

  have hf_2d_sum : Summable f_2d :=
    (summable_prod_of_nonneg hf_2d_nn).mpr ⟨hf_row_sum, hf_outer_sum⟩

  have hf_swap := (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p : ℤ × ℕ => hf_2d_nn p.swap)).mp hf_2d_sum.prod_symm
  have hf_col_sum : ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j : ℕ => f_2d (j, k)) := hf_swap.1
  have hf_col_outer : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ∑' j : ℕ, f_2d (j, k)) := hf_swap.2

  have hΔc_norm_sum : ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖Δc j k‖) := by
    intro k
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => ?_) (hf_col_sum k)
    dsimp [f_2d]
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _)
      (Real.one_le_exp (by dsimp [σ_inf]; positivity))

  have hΔc_sum : ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j : ℕ => Δc j k) :=
    fun k => Summable.of_norm (hΔc_norm_sum k)

  let d_star : ℤ → ℂ := fun k => ∑' j : ℕ, Δc j k
  let c_star : ℤ → ℂ := uTruncCoeff R P + d_star

  have hd_star_conj : ∀ k : ℤ, d_star (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (d_star k) := by
    intro k
    dsimp [d_star]
    symm
    change Complex.conjCLE (∑' j : ℕ, Δc j k) = _
    rw [Complex.conjCLE.map_tsum]
    exact tsum_congr fun j => ((nextStep j (iter j)).2.1 k).symm

  have hd_star_w_le : ∀ k : ℤ,
      ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|) ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, f_2d (j, k) := by
    intro k
    calc ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|)
        ≤ (∑' j : ℕ, ‖Δc j k‖) * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hΔc_norm_sum k)) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      _ = ∑' j : ℕ, f_2d (j, k) := tsum_mul_right.symm

  have hd_star_wsum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity) hd_star_w_le hf_col_outer

  have hd_star_wbound :
      (∑' k : ℤ, ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|)) ≤ 4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ := by
    calc (∑' k : ℤ, ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_inf * |(k : ℝ)|))
        ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, ∑' j : ℕ, f_2d (j, k) :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum hd_star_w_le hd_star_wsum hf_col_outer
      _ = ∑' j : ℕ, ∑' k : ℤ, f_2d (j, k) :=
          Summable.tsum_comm (f := fun j k => f_2d (j, k)) hf_2d_sum
      _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum hf_row_le hf_outer_sum h_maj_geom_sum
      _ = 2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * ∑' j : ℕ, q ^ j := tsum_mul_left
      _ ≤ 2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_geom_le (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ := by ring

  
  obtain ⟨hd_sm_raw, hd_ext_raw⟩ :=
    h_wiener_strip_calc d_star σ_inf σ_raw (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹)
      hσ_raw_pos hσ_raw_lt_inf hσ_inf_sub_le_one (by positivity)
      hd_star_conj hd_star_wsum hd_star_wbound

  have hd_bound_le :
      ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (σ_inf - σ_raw)⁻¹ ^ 17 * (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹) ≤ M / 4 := by
    rw [hσ_inf_sub_raw, inv_inv]
    have hP34 : (P : ℝ) ^ 34 = (P : ℝ) ^ 17 * (P : ℝ) ^ 17 := by ring
    have hP17_ne : (P : ℝ) ^ 17 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (pow_pos hP_pos 17)
    have h_eq : ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 * (P : ℝ)) ^ 17 * (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹) =
        2 * C₁ * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [C₁]
      calc ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 * (P : ℝ)) ^ 17 * (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹)
          = 4 * ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹) := by ring
        _ = 2 * (2 * ((Nat.factorial 17) : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ 17) * ((P : ℝ) ^ 17)⁻¹ := by
              rw [hP34, mul_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hP17_ne]; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hC₁_thresh

  have hd_sm : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (M / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ d_star) :=
    h_smooth_mono hd_sm_raw hd_bound_le
  have hd_ext : IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ_raw (M / 4)
      (fourierSeriesℝ d_star) (fourierSeriesℂ d_star) :=
    h_strip_mono hd_ext_raw le_rfl hd_bound_le

  have hd_wsum_raw : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity)
      (fun k => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hσ_raw_lt_inf) (abs_nonneg _)))
        (norm_nonneg _)) hd_star_wsum

  obtain ⟨h0_sm, h0_ext, _, _⟩ := hInitP P hP₀_le
  have hσ_raw_le_1P : σ_raw ≤ 1 / (P : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [σ_raw]
    exact le_of_lt (one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hP_pos (by linarith))

  obtain ⟨_, hc_star_sm_raw, hc_star_ext_raw⟩ :=
    h_wiener_add (uTruncCoeff R P) d_star σ_raw (M / 4) (M / 4) hσ_raw_pos
      (h_c0_wiener σ_raw) hd_wsum_raw h0_sm hd_sm
      (h_strip_mono h0_ext hσ_raw_le_1P le_rfl) hd_ext

  have hM_quarter_add : M / 4 + M / 4 = M / 2 := by ring
  have hc_star_sm : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (M / 2) (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) := by
    rwa [hM_quarter_add] at hc_star_sm_raw
  have hc_star_ext : IsBoundedStripExt 17 σ_raw (M / 2)
      (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) (fourierSeriesℂ c_star) := by
    rwa [hM_quarter_add] at hc_star_ext_raw

  have hc_star_conj : ∀ k : ℤ, c_star (-k) = starRingEnd ℂ (c_star k) := by
    intro k
    simp [c_star, Pi.add_apply, h_c0_conj k, hd_star_conj k, map_add]

  have hc_star_low : ∀ k : ℤ, |k| < (N : ℤ) → c_star k = uTableCoeff R k := by
    intro k hk
    have hkP : |k| ≤ (P : ℤ) := by omega
    have hd0 : d_star k = 0 := by
      have hzero : ∀ j : ℕ, Δc j k = 0 := fun j => (nextStep j (iter j)).2.2.1 k hk
      simp [d_star, hzero]
    simp [c_star, Pi.add_apply, uTruncCoeff, hkP, hd0]

  have hc_star_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c_star k‖) := by
    have hw : Summable (fun k : ℤ =>
        ‖uTruncCoeff R P k‖ * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|) +
          ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|)) :=
      (h_c0_wiener σ_raw).add hd_wsum_raw
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_) hw
    calc ‖c_star k‖
        ≤ ‖uTruncCoeff R P k‖ + ‖d_star k‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖uTruncCoeff R P k‖ + ‖d_star k‖) * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|) :=
            le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity)
              (Real.one_le_exp (by positivity))
      _ = ‖uTruncCoeff R P k‖ * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|) +
            ‖d_star k‖ * Real.exp (σ_raw * |(k : ℝ)|) := add_mul _ _ _

  have hc_seq_sum : ∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c_seq j k‖) := by
    intro j
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_) (iter j).2.2.2.1
    exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _)
      (Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hσ_mem_Ioc j).1) (abs_nonneg _)))

  
  have hc_seq_partial : ∀ (j : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      c_seq j k = uTruncCoeff R P k + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, Δc i k := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      simp [c_seq, iter]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro k
      change c_seq j k + Δc j k = _
      rw [ih k, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc]

  have h_tail_diff : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      |fourierSeriesℝ c_star x - fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j) x| ≤
        4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by
    intro j x
    have h_coeff_tail : ∀ k : ℤ, c_star k - c_seq j k = ∑' i : ℕ, Δc (i + j) k := by
      intro k
      rw [hc_seq_partial j k]
      dsimp [c_star, Pi.add_apply, d_star]
      rw [← Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add j (hΔc_sum k)]
      ring
    let g_tail : ℕ × ℤ → ℝ := fun p => ‖Δc (p.1 + j) p.2‖
    have hg_nn : 0 ≤ g_tail := fun _ => norm_nonneg _
    have hg_le_f : ∀ (i : ℕ) (k : ℤ), g_tail (i, k) ≤ f_2d (i + j, k) := by
      intro i k
      dsimp [g_tail, f_2d]
      exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _)
        (Real.one_le_exp (by dsimp [σ_inf]; positivity))
    have hg_row_sum : ∀ i : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℤ => g_tail (i, k)) :=
      fun i => Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
        (fun k => hg_le_f i k) (hf_row_sum (i + j))
    have hg_row_le : ∀ i : ℕ,
        (∑' k : ℤ, g_tail (i, k)) ≤ (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * q ^ i := by
      intro i
      calc (∑' k : ℤ, g_tail (i, k))
          ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, f_2d (i + j, k) :=
            Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => hg_le_f i k) (hg_row_sum i) (hf_row_sum (i + j))
        _ ≤ 2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ (i + j) := hf_row_le (i + j)
        _ = (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * q ^ i := by rw [pow_add]; ring
    have h_tail_geom : Summable (fun i : ℕ => (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * q ^ i) :=
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hq_nn hq_lt_one).mul_left _
    have hg_outer_sum : Summable (fun i : ℕ => ∑' k : ℤ, g_tail (i, k)) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => tsum_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _))
        hg_row_le h_tail_geom
    have hg_2d_sum : Summable g_tail :=
      (summable_prod_of_nonneg hg_nn).mpr ⟨hg_row_sum, hg_outer_sum⟩
    have hg_swap :=
      (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p : ℤ × ℕ => hg_nn p.swap)).mp hg_2d_sum.prod_symm
    have h_norm_tail_le : ∀ k : ℤ, ‖c_star k - c_seq j k‖ ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, g_tail (i, k) := by
      intro k
      rw [h_coeff_tail k]
      exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hg_swap.1 k)
    have h_diff_sum : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖c_star k - c_seq j k‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_norm_tail_le hg_swap.2
    calc |fourierSeriesℝ c_star x - fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j) x|
        ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, ‖c_star k - c_seq j k‖ :=
          h_real_diff_l1 c_star (c_seq j) hc_star_sum (hc_seq_sum j) x
      _ ≤ ∑' k : ℤ, ∑' i : ℕ, g_tail (i, k) :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_norm_tail_le h_diff_sum hg_swap.2
      _ = ∑' i : ℕ, ∑' k : ℤ, g_tail (i, k) :=
          Summable.tsum_comm (f := fun i k => g_tail (i, k)) hg_2d_sum
      _ ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, ((2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * q ^ i) :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum hg_row_le hg_outer_sum h_tail_geom
      _ = (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * ∑' i : ℕ, q ^ i := tsum_mul_left
      _ ≤ (2 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) * 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_geom_le (by positivity)
      _ = 4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by ring

  
  have hc_star_sm34 : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * M / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) :=
    h_smooth_mono hc_star_sm (by linarith)

  have hc_star_C_zero : ∀ n : ℤ, (N : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
      H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    have h_bound_j : ∀ j : ℕ,
        ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c_star)‖ ≤
          (4 * W_op.C_lip + 1) * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by
      intro j
      rcases (iter j).2 with ⟨_, _, _, hc_j_sm, _, hc_j_res_sum, hc_j_res_le⟩
      have hc_j_sm34 : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded 17 (3 * M / 4) (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j)) :=
        h_smooth_mono hc_j_sm (le_trans (hB_le_half j) (by linarith))
      have h_lip := W_op.C_coeff_lip n hn (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))
        (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) (by positivity) hc_star_sm34 hc_j_sm34 (h_tail_diff j)
      have h_res_j : ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))‖ ≤
          ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by
        have h_term_le := Summable.le_tsum hc_j_res_sum n
          (fun m _ => by split_ifs <;> positivity)
        simp only [hn, ↓reduceIte] at h_term_le
        have h1 : ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))‖ ≤
            ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))‖ * Real.exp (σ_seq j * |(n : ℝ)|) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (norm_nonneg _)
            (Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hσ_mem_Ioc j).1) (abs_nonneg _)))
        exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h_term_le (by simpa [ε_seq, q] using hc_j_res_le))
      calc ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c_star)‖
          ≤ ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ c_star) -
                H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))‖ +
              ‖H_sys.C_coeff n (fourierSeriesℝ (c_seq j))‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add _ _
        _ ≤ W_op.C_lip * (4 * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j) + ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j :=
              add_le_add h_lip h_res_j
        _ = (4 * W_op.C_lip + 1) * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j := by ring
    have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun j : ℕ => (4 * W_op.C_lip + 1) * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹ * q ^ j)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq_nn hq_lt_one).const_mul
        ((4 * W_op.C_lip + 1) * ((P : ℝ) ^ 34)⁻¹)
    exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp
      (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' tendsto_const_nhds h_tendsto h_bound_j)

  
  have hc_star_real_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, fourierSeriesℝ c_star x = uTable R x :=
    W_op.real_uniqueness c_star hu_smooth hu_sum hu_eq hc_star_conj hc_star_sum
      hc_star_low hc_star_sm34 hc_star_C_zero

  
  refine ⟨{
    σ_raw := σ_raw
    M_raw := M / 2
    σ_raw_pos := hσ_raw_pos
    M_raw_pos := by positivity
    u_raw := fourierSeriesℂ c_star
    u_raw_holo := hc_star_ext.1
    u_raw_real := fun x => by
      rw [hc_star_ext.2.1 x, hc_star_real_eq x]
      rfl
    u_raw_periodic := hc_star_ext.2.2.1
    u_raw_conj := hc_star_ext.2.2.2.1
    u_raw_bound := fun z hz => by
      have hb0 := hc_star_ext.2.2.2.2 0 (by decide) z hz
      have hb1 := hc_star_ext.2.2.2.2 1 (by decide) z hz
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb0
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb1
      exact ⟨hb0, hb1⟩
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (R : RationalCollarData Ω)
    (U_data : AnalyticLogSpeedData R) :
    Nonempty (AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)

signature.name: complex_lazutkin_support_strip
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (R : RationalCollarData Ω)
    (U_data : AnalyticLogSpeedData R) :
    Nonempty (AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hStrip_eq : ∀ H : ℝ, horizStrip H = Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
    intro H; ext s; simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
  have hStrip_open : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H; rw [hStrip_eq]; exact isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  have hStrip_convex : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H; rw [hStrip_eq]; exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap
  have hStrip_real : ∀ {H : ℝ}, 0 < H → ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H hH x; simp [horizStrip, hH]
  have hStrip_zero : ∀ {H : ℝ}, 0 < H → (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H hH; simpa using hStrip_real hH 0
  have hStrip_add_two_pi : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz; simpa [horizStrip] using hz
  have hStrip_conj : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz; simpa [horizStrip] using hz
  have hStrip_mono : ∀ {H₁ H₂ : ℝ}, H₁ ≤ H₂ → horizStrip H₁ ⊆ horizStrip H₂ := by
    intro H₁ H₂ hle z hz; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz hle
  have hStrip_const : ∀ {H : ℝ} {F : ℂ → ℂ}, 0 < H →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip H, HasDerivAt F 0 z) → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip H, F z = F 0 := by
    intro H F hH hF z hz
    have hbound := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun w hw => (hF w hw).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun _ _ => le_rfl)
      (hStrip_convex H) (hStrip_zero hH) hz
    simpa [norm_zero, zero_mul, sub_eq_zero] using hbound
  have hHasDerivAt_conj : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {f' z : ℂ},
      HasDerivAt f f' (starRingEnd ℂ z) →
      HasDerivAt (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (f (starRingEnd ℂ w))) (starRingEnd ℂ f') z := by
    intro f f' z hf
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hf.conj_conj
  have hHasDerivAt_shift_ℂ : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {f' w c : ℂ},
      HasDerivAt f f' (w + c) → HasDerivAt (fun ζ => f (ζ + c)) f' w := by
    intro f f' w c hf
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ + c) 1 w := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_id' w).add (hasDerivAt_const w c) using 1
      ring
    have hcomp := hf.comp w hc
    rw [mul_one] at hcomp
    exact hcomp
  have hHasDerivAt_shift_ℝ : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f' x c : ℝ},
      HasDerivAt f f' (x + c) → HasDerivAt (fun y => f (y + c)) f' x := by
    intro f f' x c hf
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y + c) 1 x := by
      convert (hasDerivAt_id' x).add (hasDerivAt_const x c) using 1
      ring
    have hcomp := hf.comp x hc
    rw [mul_one] at hcomp
    exact hcomp

  
  
  
  let σ₁ : ℝ := U_data.σ_raw
  let M₁ : ℝ := U_data.M_raw
  have hσ₁ : 0 < σ₁ := U_data.σ_raw_pos
  have hM₁ : 0 < M₁ := U_data.M_raw_pos
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Complex.exp (U_data.u_raw z)
  have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip σ₁) :=
    Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn U_data.u_raw_holo
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀_within⟩ :=
    (hStrip_convex σ₁).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt hg_holo
  have hF₀_deriv : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, HasDerivAt F₀ (g z) z :=
    fun z hz => (hF₀_within z hz).hasDerivAt ((hStrip_open σ₁).mem_nhds hz)
  let ϕ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F₀ z - F₀ 0 + (R.ϕ 0 : ℂ)
  have hϕ_ℂ_zero : ϕ_ℂ 0 = (R.ϕ 0 : ℂ) := by simp [ϕ_ℂ]
  have hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, HasDerivAt ϕ_ℂ (g z) z :=
    fun z hz => ((hF₀_deriv z hz).sub_const (F₀ 0)).add_const (R.ϕ 0 : ℂ)
  have hϕ_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip σ₁) :=
    fun z hz => (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hϕ_ℂ_deriv : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, deriv ϕ_ℂ z = g z :=
    fun z hz => (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv z hz).deriv

  have hϕ_diff : Differentiable ℝ R.ϕ := R.ϕ_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hϕ_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ_ℂ x = R.ϕ x := by
    let d : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => ϕ_ℂ y - (R.ϕ y : ℂ)
    have hd_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt d 0 y := by
      intro y
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ϕ_ℂ t) (g y) y :=
        (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv y (hStrip_real hσ₁ y)).comp_ofReal
      have hgy : g y = ((deriv R.ϕ y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [g]
        rw [U_data.u_raw_real y, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log (R.ϕ_deriv_pos y)]
      rw [hgy] at h1
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (R.ϕ t : ℂ)) ((deriv R.ϕ y : ℝ) : ℂ) y :=
        (hϕ_diff y).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp
      convert h1.sub h2 using 1
      ring
    have hd_const : ∀ x : ℝ, d x = d 0 := fun x =>
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun y => (hd_deriv y).differentiableAt)
        (fun y => (hd_deriv y).deriv) x 0
    intro x
    have hx := hd_const x
    have h0 : d 0 = 0 := by simp [d, hϕ_ℂ_zero]
    rw [h0] at hx
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

  have hϕ_ℂ_qper : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ϕ_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ_ℂ z + 2 * Real.pi := by
    let Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ϕ_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) - ϕ_ℂ w - 2 * Real.pi
    have hQ_deriv : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ₁, HasDerivAt Q 0 w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_add_two_pi hw
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => ϕ_ℂ (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) (g (w + 2 * Real.pi)) w :=
        hHasDerivAt_shift_ℂ (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv (w + 2 * Real.pi) hw')
      have hg_per : g (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g w := by
        dsimp [g]; rw [U_data.u_raw_periodic w hw]
      rw [hg_per] at h1
      convert (h1.sub (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw)).sub_const (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) using 1
      ring
    intro z hz
    have hQz := hStrip_const hσ₁ hQ_deriv z hz
    have hQ0 : Q 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [Q]
      have h2pi : (0 : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h2pi, hϕ_ℂ_real (2 * Real.pi), hϕ_ℂ_zero]
      have hqp := R.ϕ_quasiperiodic 0
      rw [zero_add] at hqp
      rw [hqp]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hQ0] at hQz
    dsimp [Q] at hQz
    linear_combination hQz

  have hϕ_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) := by
    let C_sym : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w)) - ϕ_ℂ w
    have hC_deriv : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ₁, HasDerivAt C_sym 0 w := by
      intro w hw
      have h1 := hHasDerivAt_conj (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv (starRingEnd ℂ w) (hStrip_conj hw))
      have hg_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (g (starRingEnd ℂ w)) = g w := by
        dsimp [g]
        rw [← Complex.exp_conj, U_data.u_raw_conj w hw]
        simp
      rw [hg_conj] at h1
      convert h1.sub (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw) using 1
      ring
    intro z hz
    have hCz := hStrip_const hσ₁ hC_deriv (starRingEnd ℂ z) (hStrip_conj hz)
    have hC0 : C_sym 0 = 0 := by
      simp [C_sym, hϕ_ℂ_zero]
    rw [hC0] at hCz
    dsimp [C_sym] at hCz
    simp only [RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply] at hCz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hCz).symm

  have hg_norm : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖g z‖ ≤ Real.exp M₁ := by
    intro z hz
    dsimp [g]
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((Complex.re_le_norm _).trans (U_data.u_raw_bound z hz).1)

  have h_sub_re_norm : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - (z.re : ℂ)‖ = |z.im| := by
    intro z
    have h_eq : z - (z.re : ℂ) = (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [h_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]

  have hϕ_ℂ_im_le : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, |(ϕ_ℂ z).im| ≤ Real.exp M₁ * |z.im| := by
    intro z hz
    have hmv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun w hw => (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw).hasDerivWithinAt)
      hg_norm (hStrip_convex σ₁) (hStrip_real hσ₁ z.re) hz
    rw [h_sub_re_norm z] at hmv
    have him_re : (ϕ_ℂ (z.re : ℂ)).im = 0 := by rw [hϕ_ℂ_real z.re]; simp
    calc |(ϕ_ℂ z).im|
        = |(ϕ_ℂ z - ϕ_ℂ (z.re : ℂ)).im| := by simp [him_re]
      _ ≤ ‖ϕ_ℂ z - ϕ_ℂ (z.re : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      _ ≤ Real.exp M₁ * |z.im| := hmv

  have hϕ'_per : Function.Periodic (deriv R.ϕ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y => R.ϕ (y + 2 * Real.pi)) (deriv R.ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi)) x :=
      hHasDerivAt_shift_ℝ (hϕ_diff (x + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => R.ϕ y + 2 * Real.pi) (deriv R.ϕ x) x :=
      (hϕ_diff x).hasDerivAt.add_const (2 * Real.pi)
    have h12 : (fun y => R.ϕ (y + 2 * Real.pi)) = (fun y => R.ϕ y + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      funext R.ϕ_quasiperiodic
    rw [h12] at h1
    exact h1.unique h2

  have hϕ'_cont : Continuous (deriv R.ϕ) := R.ϕ_smooth.continuous_deriv (by simp)
  obtain ⟨x_min, _, hx_min⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn ⟨(0 : ℝ), le_rfl, Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩ hϕ'_cont.continuousOn
  let m_ϕ : ℝ := deriv R.ϕ x_min
  have hm_ϕ_pos : 0 < m_ϕ := R.ϕ_deriv_pos x_min
  have hm_ϕ_le : ∀ x : ℝ, m_ϕ ≤ deriv R.ϕ x := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hϕ'_per.exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos x
    rw [hxy]
    exact hx_min (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy)

  have hϕ_surj : Function.Surjective R.ϕ := by
    let f_lin : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => R.ϕ x - m_ϕ * x
    have hf_lin_d : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt f_lin (deriv R.ϕ x - m_ϕ) x := by
      intro x
      convert (hϕ_diff x).hasDerivAt.sub ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul m_ϕ) using 1
      ring
    have h_mono : Monotone f_lin := by
      apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun x => (hf_lin_d x).differentiableAt)
      intro x
      rw [(hf_lin_d x).deriv]
      linarith [hm_ϕ_le x]
    intro θ
    let B : ℝ := |θ - R.ϕ 0| / m_ϕ
    have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hm_ϕ_pos.le
    have hmB : m_ϕ * B = |θ - R.ϕ 0| := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hm_ϕ_pos.ne'
    have h_lo_mono : f_lin (-B) ≤ f_lin 0 := h_mono (neg_nonpos.mpr hB_nonneg)
    have h_hi_mono : f_lin 0 ≤ f_lin B := h_mono hB_nonneg
    dsimp [f_lin] at h_lo_mono h_hi_mono
    have h_lo : R.ϕ (-B) ≤ θ := by
      have habs : -(θ - R.ϕ 0) ≤ |θ - R.ϕ 0| := neg_le_abs _
      linarith
    have h_hi : θ ≤ R.ϕ B := by
      have habs : θ - R.ϕ 0 ≤ |θ - R.ϕ 0| := le_abs_self _
      linarith
    obtain ⟨x₀, _, hx₀⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -B ≤ B)
      hϕ_diff.continuous.continuousOn ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩
    exact ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩

  let σ₂ : ℝ := min (σ₁ / 2) (1 / (4 * M₁))
  have hσ₂_pos : 0 < σ₂ := lt_min (half_pos hσ₁) (by positivity)
  have hσ₂_le_half_σ₁ : σ₂ ≤ σ₁ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hσ₂_le_σ₁ : σ₂ ≤ σ₁ := hσ₂_le_half_σ₁.trans (by linarith)
  have hσ₂_le_inv : σ₂ ≤ 1 / (4 * M₁) := min_le_right _ _
  let c₁ : ℝ := m_ϕ / 4
  have hc₁_pos : 0 < c₁ := by positivity
  let L₂ : ℝ := M₁ * Real.exp M₁
  have hL₂_pos : 0 < L₂ := by positivity

  have hre_deriv_lower : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, c₁ ≤ (deriv ϕ_ℂ z).re := by
    intro z hz
    have hz₁ : z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ hz
    have hu_mv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun w hw =>
        (U_data.u_raw_holo.differentiableAt ((hStrip_open σ₁).mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun w hw => (U_data.u_raw_bound w hw).2)
      (hStrip_convex σ₁) (hStrip_real hσ₁ z.re) hz₁
    rw [h_sub_re_norm z] at hu_mv
    let δ : ℂ := U_data.u_raw z - U_data.u_raw (z.re : ℂ)
    have hδ_norm : ‖δ‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have hzim_le : |z.im| ≤ 1 / (4 * M₁) := (le_of_lt hz).trans hσ₂_le_inv
      calc ‖δ‖ ≤ M₁ * |z.im| := hu_mv
        _ ≤ M₁ * (1 / (4 * M₁)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzim_le hM₁.le
        _ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp [hM₁.ne']
    have hδ_re : |δ.re| ≤ 1 / 4 := (Complex.abs_re_le_norm δ).trans hδ_norm
    have hδ_im : |δ.im| ≤ 1 / 4 := (Complex.abs_im_le_norm δ).trans hδ_norm
    have hexp_δ : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.exp δ.re := by
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp hδ_re).1
      have h2 := Real.add_one_le_exp δ.re
      linarith
    have hcos_δ : 1 / 2 ≤ Real.cos δ.im := by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hδ_im
      have h3 := Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (x := δ.im)
      nlinarith
    have hprod_δ : 1 / 4 ≤ Real.exp δ.re * Real.cos δ.im := by nlinarith
    have hu_decomp : U_data.u_raw z = (Real.log (deriv R.ϕ z.re) : ℂ) + δ := by
      simp [δ, U_data.u_raw_real]
    have hre_eq : (deriv ϕ_ℂ z).re = deriv R.ϕ z.re * (Real.exp δ.re * Real.cos δ.im) := by
      rw [hϕ_ℂ_deriv z hz₁]
      dsimp [g]
      rw [hu_decomp, Complex.exp_re]
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_add]
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (R.ϕ_deriv_pos z.re), mul_assoc]
    rw [hre_eq]
    have hm_le := hm_ϕ_le z.re
    dsimp [c₁]
    nlinarith

  have h_deriv2_hasDeriv :
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, HasDerivAt (deriv ϕ_ℂ) (g z * deriv U_data.u_raw z) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hu_d : HasDerivAt U_data.u_raw (deriv U_data.u_raw z) z :=
      (U_data.u_raw_holo.differentiableAt ((hStrip_open σ₁).mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hg_d : HasDerivAt g (g z * deriv U_data.u_raw z) z := hu_d.cexp
    exact hg_d.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hStrip_open σ₁).mem_nhds hz) hϕ_ℂ_deriv)

  have h_deriv2_norm : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖g z * deriv U_data.u_raw z‖ ≤ L₂ := by
    intro z hz
    rw [norm_mul, show L₂ = Real.exp M₁ * M₁ by dsimp [L₂]; ring]
    exact mul_le_mul (hg_norm z hz) (U_data.u_raw_bound z hz).2 (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le

  
  
  
  have hϕ_ℂ_inj : Set.InjOn ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip σ₂) := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ h_eq
    by_contra hne
    have hd_ne : z₂ - z₁ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne)
    let γ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ((ϕ_ℂ (z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁)) - ϕ_ℂ z₁) / (z₂ - z₁)).re
    have hζ_mem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁) ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := by
      intro t ht
      have hconv_eq : (1 - t) • z₁ + t • z₂ = z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁) := by
        simp [Complex.real_smul]; ring
      rw [← hconv_eq]
      exact (hStrip_convex σ₂) hz₁ hz₂ (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) ht.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 t)
    have hγ_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt γ (deriv ϕ_ℂ (z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁))).re t := by
      intro t ht
      let ζ : ℂ := z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁)
      have hζ₁ : ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ (hζ_mem t ht)
      have h_line : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₁ + (s : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁)) (z₂ - z₁) t := by
        convert (((hasDerivAt_id' t).ofReal_comp).mul_const (z₂ - z₁)).const_add z₁ using 1
        simp
      have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ϕ_ℂ (z₁ + (s : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁)))
          ((z₂ - z₁) * deriv ϕ_ℂ ζ) t := by
        have hs := (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv ζ hζ₁).scomp t h_line
        rw [← hϕ_ℂ_deriv ζ hζ₁, smul_eq_mul] at hs
        exact hs
      have h_quot : HasDerivAt
          (fun s : ℝ => (ϕ_ℂ (z₁ + (s : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁)) - ϕ_ℂ z₁) / (z₂ - z₁))
          (deriv ϕ_ℂ ζ) t := by
        convert (h_comp.sub_const (ϕ_ℂ z₁)).div_const (z₂ - z₁) using 1
        exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (deriv ϕ_ℂ ζ) hd_ne).symm
      exact (Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt (x := _)).comp_hasDerivAt t h_quot
    have hγ_cont : ContinuousOn γ (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
      fun t ht => (hγ_deriv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨t_star, ht_star, h_slope⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope γ
      (fun t => (deriv ϕ_ℂ (z₁ + (t : ℂ) * (z₂ - z₁))).re) zero_lt_one hγ_cont
      (fun t ht => hγ_deriv t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = 0 := by simp [γ]
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = 0 := by simp [γ, h_eq]
    rw [hγ1, hγ0, sub_self, zero_div] at h_slope
    have h_low := hre_deriv_lower _ (hζ_mem t_star (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht_star))
    linarith

  have h_deriv_lip : ∀ ζ₁ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ∀ ζ₂ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
      ‖deriv ϕ_ℂ ζ₁ - deriv ϕ_ℂ ζ₂‖ ≤ L₂ * ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ := by
    intro ζ₁ hζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₂
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun w hw => (h_deriv2_hasDeriv w (hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ hw)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun w hw => h_deriv2_norm w (hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ hw))
      (hStrip_convex σ₂) hζ₂ hζ₁

  let ρ : ℝ := min (σ₂ / 2) (c₁ / (2 * L₂))
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := lt_min (half_pos hσ₂_pos) (by positivity)
  have hρ_le_σ₂ : ρ ≤ σ₂ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hρ_le_lip : ρ ≤ c₁ / (2 * L₂) := min_le_right _ _
  let s_h : ℝ := c₁ * ρ / 4
  have hs_h_pos : 0 < s_h := by positivity

  have h_surj_strip : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), ∃ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ϕ_ℂ z = w := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hϕ_surj w.re
    let B : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (x₀ : ℂ) ρ
    have hB_sub : B ⊆ horizStrip σ₂ := by
      intro z hz
      have hdist : ‖z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [B, dist_eq_norm] using hz
      have him : |z.im| ≤ ‖z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
        have h1 : z.im = (z - (x₀ : ℂ)).im := by simp
        rw [h1]; exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      change |z.im| < σ₂
      linarith
    have hx₀_B : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ B := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
    have hx₀_σ₂ : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hB_sub hx₀_B
    let A₀ : ℂ := deriv ϕ_ℂ (x₀ : ℂ)
    have hc₁_le_A₀ : c₁ ≤ ‖A₀‖ :=
      (hre_deriv_lower (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_σ₂).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm A₀))
    have hA₀_pos : 0 < ‖A₀‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁_pos hc₁_le_A₀
    have hA₀_ne : A₀ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hA₀_pos
    have hA₀_inv_le : ‖A₀⁻¹‖ ≤ c₁⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv]; exact inv_anti₀ hc₁_pos hc₁_le_A₀
    let T_w : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + A₀⁻¹ * (w - ϕ_ℂ z)
    have hT_deriv : ∀ z ∈ B, HasDerivAt T_w (1 - A₀⁻¹ * deriv ϕ_ℂ z) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hz₁ : z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ (hB_sub hz)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => ζ + A₀⁻¹ * (w - ϕ_ℂ ζ))
          (1 + A₀⁻¹ * (0 - g z)) z :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' z).add (((hasDerivAt_const z w).sub (hϕ_ℂ_hasDeriv z hz₁)).const_mul A₀⁻¹)
      rw [← hϕ_ℂ_deriv z hz₁] at hd
      convert hd using 1
      ring
    have hT_deriv_le : ∀ z ∈ B, ‖1 - A₀⁻¹ * deriv ϕ_ℂ z‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro z hz
      have h_alg : 1 - A₀⁻¹ * deriv ϕ_ℂ z = A₀⁻¹ * (A₀ - deriv ϕ_ℂ z) := by
        field_simp [hA₀_ne]
      rw [h_alg, norm_mul]
      have hdist : ‖(x₀ : ℂ) - z‖ ≤ ρ := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev]; simpa [B, dist_eq_norm] using hz
      have hdlip := h_deriv_lip (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_σ₂ z (hB_sub hz)
      calc ‖A₀⁻¹‖ * ‖A₀ - deriv ϕ_ℂ z‖
          ≤ c₁⁻¹ * (L₂ * ‖(x₀ : ℂ) - z‖) :=
            mul_le_mul hA₀_inv_le hdlip (norm_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hc₁_pos.le)
        _ ≤ c₁⁻¹ * (L₂ * ρ) := by gcongr
        _ ≤ c₁⁻¹ * (L₂ * (c₁ / (2 * L₂))) := by gcongr
        _ = 1 / 2 := by field_simp [hc₁_pos.ne', hL₂_pos.ne']
    have hT_lip_norm : ∀ z₁ ∈ B, ∀ z₂ ∈ B, ‖T_w z₁ - T_w z₂‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
      exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        (fun ζ hζ => (hT_deriv ζ hζ).hasDerivWithinAt)
        hT_deriv_le (convex_closedBall (x₀ : ℂ) ρ) hz₂ hz₁
    have hT_center : ‖T_w (x₀ : ℂ) - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ρ / 2 := by
      have h_sub_x₀ : T_w (x₀ : ℂ) - (x₀ : ℂ) = A₀⁻¹ * ((w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        dsimp [T_w]
        rw [hϕ_ℂ_real x₀, hx₀]
        have hw_im : w - (w.re : ℂ) = (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp
        rw [hw_im]; ring
      rw [h_sub_x₀, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
      have hw_lt : |w.im| ≤ c₁ * ρ / 2 := by
        have h1 : |w.im| < 2 * s_h := hw
        dsimp [s_h] at h1
        linarith
      calc ‖A₀⁻¹‖ * |w.im|
          ≤ c₁⁻¹ * (c₁ * ρ / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul hA₀_inv_le hw_lt (abs_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hc₁_pos.le)
        _ = ρ / 2 := by field_simp [hc₁_pos.ne']
    have hMaps : Set.MapsTo T_w B B := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_dist : ‖z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ρ := by simpa [B, dist_eq_norm] using hz
      have h1 := hT_lip_norm z hz (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_B
      have h2 : ‖T_w z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ρ := by
        calc ‖T_w z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖
            = ‖(T_w z - T_w (x₀ : ℂ)) + (T_w (x₀ : ℂ) - (x₀ : ℂ))‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖T_w z - T_w (x₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖T_w (x₀ : ℂ) - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ + ρ / 2 := add_le_add h1 hT_center
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ + ρ / 2 := by linarith
          _ = ρ := by ring
      simpa [B, dist_eq_norm] using h2
    have : CompleteSpace ↥B := Metric.isClosed_closedBall.completeSpace_coe
    have : Nonempty ↥B := ⟨⟨(x₀ : ℂ), hx₀_B⟩⟩
    let T_B : ↥B → ↥B := fun z => ⟨T_w z.1, hMaps z.2⟩
    have hLip_B : LipschitzWith (1 / 2 : NNReal) T_B := by
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun z₁ z₂ => ?_
      change dist (T_w z₁.1) (T_w z₂.1) ≤ ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ℝ) * dist z₁.1 z₂.1
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hT_lip_norm z₁.1 z₁.2 z₂.1 z₂.2
    have hContr : ContractingWith (1 / 2 : NNReal) T_B := ⟨by norm_num, hLip_B⟩
    let z_fix : ↥B := ContractingWith.fixedPoint T_B hContr
    have hz_eq : T_w z_fix.1 = z_fix.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (ContractingWith.fixedPoint_isFixedPt hContr)
    dsimp [T_w] at hz_eq
    have h_zero : A₀⁻¹ * (w - ϕ_ℂ z_fix.1) = 0 := by linear_combination hz_eq
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_zero with hinv0 | hw0
    · exact False.elim (inv_ne_zero hA₀_ne hinv0)
    · exact ⟨z_fix.1, hB_sub z_fix.2, (sub_eq_zero.mp hw0).symm⟩

  let ψ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := Function.invFunOn ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip σ₂)
  have hψ_ϕ : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ψ_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) = z := hϕ_ℂ_inj.leftInvOn_invFunOn
  have hψ_maps : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), ψ_ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ₂ :=
    fun w hw => (Function.invFunOn_pos (h_surj_strip w hw)).1
  have hϕ_ψ : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), ϕ_ℂ (ψ_ℂ w) = w :=
    fun w hw => (Function.invFunOn_pos (h_surj_strip w hw)).2
  have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s_h)) := by
    intro w hw
    let a : ℂ := ψ_ℂ w
    have ha : a ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hψ_maps w hw
    have ha₁ : a ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ ha
    have ha_strict : HasStrictDerivAt ϕ_ℂ (deriv ϕ_ℂ a) a :=
      (hϕ_ℂ_holo.analyticAt ((hStrip_open σ₁).mem_nhds ha₁)).hasStrictDerivAt
    have hda_ne : deriv ϕ_ℂ a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hlow := hre_deriv_lower a ha
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hlow
      linarith
    have hev_left : ∀ᶠ z in nhds a, ψ_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) = z :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hStrip_open σ₂).mem_nhds ha) hψ_ϕ
    have hψ_strict := ha_strict.to_local_left_inverse hda_ne hev_left
    rw [hϕ_ψ w hw] at hψ_strict
    exact hψ_strict.hasDerivAt.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  have hψ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ψ_ℂ (R.ϕ x) = x := by
    intro x
    rw [← hϕ_ℂ_real x]
    exact hψ_ϕ (x : ℂ) (hStrip_real hσ₂_pos x)

  have hψ_qper : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), ψ_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = ψ_ℂ w + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro w hw
    have hz : ψ_ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hψ_maps w hw
    have hz₁ : ψ_ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ hz
    have h_step : ϕ_ℂ (ψ_ℂ w + 2 * Real.pi) = w + 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [hϕ_ℂ_qper (ψ_ℂ w) hz₁, hϕ_ψ w hw]
    rw [← h_step]
    exact hψ_ϕ (ψ_ℂ w + 2 * Real.pi) (hStrip_add_two_pi hz)

  have hψ_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), ψ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (ψ_ℂ w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hz : ψ_ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hψ_maps w hw
    have hz₁ : ψ_ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ hz
    have h_step : ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (ψ_ℂ w)) = starRingEnd ℂ w := by
      rw [hϕ_ℂ_conj (ψ_ℂ w) hz₁, hϕ_ψ w hw]
    rw [← h_step]
    exact hψ_ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ (ψ_ℂ w)) (hStrip_conj hz)

  
  
  
  have h2sh_pos : 0 < 2 * s_h := by positivity
  let U_h : Set ℂ := horizStrip (2 * s_h)
  let rad_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (R.c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-3 * U_data.u_raw (ψ_ℂ w))
  have hr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ rad_ℂ U_h := by
    have hu_ψ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => U_data.u_raw (ψ_ℂ w)) U_h :=
      U_data.u_raw_holo.comp hψ_holo (fun w hw => hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ (hψ_maps w hw))
    exact (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn (hu_ψ.const_mul (-3 : ℂ))).const_mul
      (R.c : ℂ)

  have hr_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, rad_ℂ θ = ((R.h θ + deriv (deriv R.h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hϕ_surj θ
    dsimp [rad_ℂ]
    rw [hψ_real x, U_data.u_raw_real x]
    have hcast : (-3 : ℂ) * (Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x) : ℂ) =
        ((-3 * Real.log (deriv R.ϕ x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    congr 1
    let p : ℝ := deriv R.ϕ x
    have hp_pos : 0 < p := R.ϕ_deriv_pos x
    have hp_ne : p ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hp_pos.ne'
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hp_ne
    have hexp_cancel : Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * p ^ 3 = 1 := by
      have hp_exp : p = Real.exp (Real.log p) := (Real.exp_log hp_pos).symm
      calc Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * p ^ 3
          = Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * (Real.exp (Real.log p)) ^ 3 := by rw [← hp_exp]
        _ = Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * Real.exp (3 * Real.log p) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
        _ = Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p + 3 * Real.log p) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
        _ = 1 := by simp
    calc R.c * Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * p ^ 3
        = R.c * (Real.exp (-3 * Real.log p) * p ^ 3) := by ring
      _ = R.c * 1 := by rw [hexp_cancel]
      _ = R.c := mul_one _
      _ = (R.h (R.ϕ x) + deriv (deriv R.h) (R.ϕ x)) * p ^ 3 := (R.lazutkin_norm x).symm

  have hr_per : ∀ w ∈ U_h, rad_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = rad_ℂ w := by
    intro w hw
    dsimp [rad_ℂ]
    rw [hψ_qper w hw, U_data.u_raw_periodic (ψ_ℂ w) (hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ (hψ_maps w hw))]

  have hr_conj : ∀ w ∈ U_h, rad_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (rad_ℂ w) := by
    intro w hw
    dsimp [rad_ℂ]
    rw [hψ_conj w hw, U_data.u_raw_conj (ψ_ℂ w) (hStrip_mono hσ₂_le_σ₁ (hψ_maps w hw))]
    have h3 : -3 * starRingEnd ℂ (U_data.u_raw (ψ_ℂ w)) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (-3 * U_data.u_raw (ψ_ℂ w)) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_neg, map_ofNat]
    rw [h3, Complex.exp_conj, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]

  have h_neg_rsin_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => -rad_ℂ w * Complex.sin w) U_h :=
    hr_holo.neg.mul Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableOn
  have h_rcos_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => rad_ℂ w * Complex.cos w) U_h :=
    hr_holo.mul Complex.differentiable_cos.differentiableOn
  obtain ⟨A₀_fn, hA₀_within⟩ :=
    (hStrip_convex (2 * s_h)).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt h_neg_rsin_holo
  obtain ⟨B₀_fn, hB₀_within⟩ :=
    (hStrip_convex (2 * s_h)).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt h_rcos_holo
  let h0_ℂ : ℂ := ((R.h (0 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let h'0_ℂ : ℂ := ((deriv R.h (0 : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let A : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => A₀_fn w - A₀_fn 0 + h0_ℂ
  let B : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => B₀_fn w - B₀_fn 0 + h'0_ℂ
  have hA_deriv : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt A (-rad_ℂ w * Complex.sin w) w :=
    fun w hw => (((hA₀_within w hw).hasDerivAt ((hStrip_open (2 * s_h)).mem_nhds hw)).sub_const
      (A₀_fn 0)).add_const h0_ℂ
  have hB_deriv : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt B (rad_ℂ w * Complex.cos w) w :=
    fun w hw => (((hB₀_within w hw).hasDerivAt ((hStrip_open (2 * s_h)).mem_nhds hw)).sub_const
      (B₀_fn 0)).add_const h'0_ℂ

  let h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => A w * Complex.cos w + B w * Complex.sin w
  let g_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -A w * Complex.sin w + B w * Complex.cos w
  have hh_ℂ_zero : h_ℂ 0 = h0_ℂ := by simp [h_ℂ, A, B]
  have hh_ℂ_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt h_ℂ (g_ℂ w) w := by
    intro w hw
    convert ((hA_deriv w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos w)).add
      ((hB_deriv w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin w)) using 1
    dsimp [g_ℂ]; ring
  have hh_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ U_h :=
    fun w hw => (hh_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hh_ℂ_deriv : ∀ w ∈ U_h, deriv h_ℂ w = g_ℂ w :=
    fun w hw => (hh_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw).deriv
  have hderiv_h_ℂ_zero : deriv h_ℂ 0 = h'0_ℂ := by
    rw [hh_ℂ_deriv 0 (hStrip_zero h2sh_pos)]
    simp [g_ℂ, A, B]

  have hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt (deriv h_ℂ) (rad_ℂ w - h_ℂ w) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hg_d : HasDerivAt g_ℂ (rad_ℂ w - h_ℂ w) w := by
      convert (((hA_deriv w hw).neg).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin w)).add
        ((hB_deriv w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos w)) using 1
      dsimp [h_ℂ]
      linear_combination rad_ℂ w * (Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq w).symm
    exact hg_d.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hStrip_open (2 * s_h)).mem_nhds hw) hh_ℂ_deriv)

  have hh_ℂ_ode : ∀ w ∈ U_h, h_ℂ w + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) w = rad_ℂ w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [(hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv w hw).deriv]
    ring

  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℝ R.h := R.h_smooth.differentiable (by simp)
  have hh'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv R.h) := by
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
    exact R.h_smooth.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 1 (by simp)

  have hh_real_both :
      ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = ((R.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧ deriv h_ℂ θ = ((deriv R.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    let δ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => h_ℂ t - ((R.h t : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let δ' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => deriv h_ℂ t - ((deriv R.h t : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hδ_d : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt δ (δ' t) t := by
      intro t
      have ht_mem : (t : ℂ) ∈ U_h := hStrip_real h2sh_pos t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h_ℂ s) (deriv h_ℂ t) t := by
        rw [hh_ℂ_deriv t ht_mem]
        exact (hh_ℂ_hasDeriv t ht_mem).comp_ofReal
      exact h1.sub ((hh_diff t).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp)
    have hδ'_d : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt δ' (-δ t) t := by
      intro t
      have ht_mem : (t : ℂ) ∈ U_h := hStrip_real h2sh_pos t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => deriv h_ℂ s) (rad_ℂ t - h_ℂ t) t :=
        (hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv t ht_mem).comp_ofReal
      convert h1.sub ((hh'_diff t).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp) using 1
      dsimp [δ]
      rw [hr_real t]
      push_cast; ring
    let E₁ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => δ t * Complex.cos t - δ' t * Complex.sin t
    let E₂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => δ t * Complex.sin t + δ' t * Complex.cos t
    have hE₁_d : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt E₁ 0 t := by
      intro t
      convert ((hδ_d t).mul ((Complex.hasDerivAt_cos t).comp_ofReal)).sub
        ((hδ'_d t).mul ((Complex.hasDerivAt_sin t).comp_ofReal)) using 1
      ring
    have hE₂_d : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt E₂ 0 t := by
      intro t
      convert ((hδ_d t).mul ((Complex.hasDerivAt_sin t).comp_ofReal)).add
        ((hδ'_d t).mul ((Complex.hasDerivAt_cos t).comp_ofReal)) using 1
      ring
    have hE₁_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, E₁ t = 0 := by
      intro t
      have hc := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun s => (hE₁_d s).differentiableAt)
        (fun s => (hE₁_d s).deriv) t 0
      have h0 : E₁ 0 = 0 := by simp [E₁, δ, δ', hh_ℂ_zero, hderiv_h_ℂ_zero, h0_ℂ, h'0_ℂ]
      exact hc.trans h0
    have hE₂_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, E₂ t = 0 := by
      intro t
      have hc := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun s => (hE₂_d s).differentiableAt)
        (fun s => (hE₂_d s).deriv) t 0
      have h0 : E₂ 0 = 0 := by simp [E₂, δ, δ', hh_ℂ_zero, hderiv_h_ℂ_zero, h0_ℂ, h'0_ℂ]
      exact hc.trans h0
    intro θ
    have h1 := hE₁_eq θ
    have h2 := hE₂_eq θ
    have hδ_zero : δ θ = 0 := by
      have hid : δ θ = E₁ θ * Complex.cos θ + E₂ θ * Complex.sin θ := by
        dsimp [E₁, E₂]
        linear_combination δ θ * (Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ : ℂ)).symm
      rw [hid, h1, h2]; simp
    have hδ'_zero : δ' θ = 0 := by
      have hid : δ' θ = -E₁ θ * Complex.sin θ + E₂ θ * Complex.cos θ := by
        dsimp [E₁, E₂]
        linear_combination δ' θ * (Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ : ℂ)).symm
      rw [hid, h1, h2]; simp
    exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp hδ_zero, sub_eq_zero.mp hδ'_zero⟩

  have hh_ℂ_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = R.h θ := fun θ => (hh_real_both θ).1

  have hWronskian_zero : ∀ (D D' : ℂ → ℂ), D 0 = 0 → D' 0 = 0 →
      (∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D (D' w) w) →
      (∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D' (-D w) w) →
      ∀ w ∈ U_h, D w = 0 := by
    intro D D' hD0 hD'0 hDd hD'd
    let E₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => D w * Complex.cos w - D' w * Complex.sin w
    let E₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => D w * Complex.sin w + D' w * Complex.cos w
    have hE₁_d : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt E₁ 0 w := by
      intro w hw
      convert ((hDd w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos w)).sub
        ((hD'd w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin w)) using 1
      ring
    have hE₂_d : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt E₂ 0 w := by
      intro w hw
      convert ((hDd w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin w)).add
        ((hD'd w hw).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos w)) using 1
      ring
    intro w hw
    have h1 : E₁ w = 0 := by
      rw [hStrip_const h2sh_pos hE₁_d w hw]; simp [E₁, hD0, hD'0]
    have h2 : E₂ w = 0 := by
      rw [hStrip_const h2sh_pos hE₂_d w hw]; simp [E₂, hD0, hD'0]
    have hid : D w = E₁ w * Complex.cos w + E₂ w * Complex.sin w := by
      dsimp [E₁, E₂]
      linear_combination D w * (Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq w).symm
    rw [hid, h1, h2]; simp

  have hh'_per : Function.Periodic (deriv R.h) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro θ
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => R.h (t + 2 * Real.pi)) (deriv R.h (θ + 2 * Real.pi)) θ :=
      hHasDerivAt_shift_ℝ (hh_diff (θ + 2 * Real.pi)).hasDerivAt
    have h2 : HasDerivAt R.h (deriv R.h θ) θ := (hh_diff θ).hasDerivAt
    have h12 : (fun t => R.h (t + 2 * Real.pi)) = R.h := funext R.h_periodic
    rw [h12] at h1
    exact h1.unique h2

  have hh_ℂ_per : ∀ w ∈ U_h, h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = h_ℂ w := by
    let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) - h_ℂ w
    let D' : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => deriv h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) - deriv h_ℂ w
    have h2pi_0 : (0 : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [D]
      rw [h2pi_0, hh_ℂ_real (2 * Real.pi), hh_ℂ_zero]
      dsimp [h0_ℂ]
      have hp := R.h_periodic 0; rw [zero_add] at hp; simp [hp]
    have hD'0 : D' 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [D']
      rw [h2pi_0, (hh_real_both (2 * Real.pi)).2, hderiv_h_ℂ_zero]
      dsimp [h'0_ℂ]
      have hp := hh'_per 0; rw [zero_add] at hp; simp [hp]
    have hDd : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D (D' w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w + 2 * Real.pi ∈ U_h := hStrip_add_two_pi hw
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => h_ℂ (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) (deriv h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi)) w := by
        rw [hh_ℂ_deriv (w + 2 * Real.pi) hw']
        exact hHasDerivAt_shift_ℂ (hh_ℂ_hasDeriv (w + 2 * Real.pi) hw')
      have h2 : HasDerivAt h_ℂ (deriv h_ℂ w) w := by
        rw [hh_ℂ_deriv w hw]; exact hh_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw
      exact h1.sub h2
    have hD'd : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D' (-D w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : w + 2 * Real.pi ∈ U_h := hStrip_add_two_pi hw
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => deriv h_ℂ (ζ + 2 * Real.pi))
          (rad_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) - h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi)) w :=
        hHasDerivAt_shift_ℂ (hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv (w + 2 * Real.pi) hw')
      convert h1.sub (hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv w hw) using 1
      dsimp [D]; rw [hr_per w hw]; ring
    intro w hw
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hWronskian_zero D D' hD0 hD'0 hDd hD'd w hw)

  have hh_ℂ_conj : ∀ w ∈ U_h, h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ w) := by
    let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w)) - h_ℂ w
    let D' : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (deriv h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w)) - deriv h_ℂ w
    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by simp [D, hh_ℂ_zero, h0_ℂ]
    have hD'0 : D' 0 = 0 := by simp [D', hderiv_h_ℂ_zero, h'0_ℂ]
    have hDd : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D (D' w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hcw : starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ U_h := hStrip_conj hw
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ ζ)))
          (starRingEnd ℂ (deriv h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w))) w := by
        rw [hh_ℂ_deriv (starRingEnd ℂ w) hcw]
        exact hHasDerivAt_conj (hh_ℂ_hasDeriv (starRingEnd ℂ w) hcw)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt h_ℂ (deriv h_ℂ w) w := by
        rw [hh_ℂ_deriv w hw]; exact hh_ℂ_hasDeriv w hw
      exact h1.sub h2
    have hD'd : ∀ w ∈ U_h, HasDerivAt D' (-D w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hcw : starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ U_h := hStrip_conj hw
      have h1 := hHasDerivAt_conj (hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv (starRingEnd ℂ w) hcw)
      convert h1.sub (hh_ℂ_deriv2_hasDeriv w hw) using 1
      dsimp [D]
      rw [map_sub, hr_conj w hw]
      simp only [RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
      ring
    intro w hw
    have hzero := hWronskian_zero D D' hD0 hD'0 hDd hD'd (starRingEnd ℂ w) (hStrip_conj hw)
    dsimp [D] at hzero
    simp only [RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply] at hzero
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm

  
  
  
  let s₀ : ℝ := min (σ₂ / 4) (s_h / (2 * Real.exp M₁))
  have hs₀_pos : 0 < s₀ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have h2s₀_le_σ₂ : 2 * s₀ ≤ σ₂ := by
    have h1 : s₀ ≤ σ₂ / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have h2s₀_le_σ₁ : 2 * s₀ ≤ σ₁ := h2s₀_le_σ₂.trans hσ₂_le_σ₁

  have hϕ_maps_to : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz₁ : z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz
    have him_le := hϕ_ℂ_im_le z hz₁
    have hs₀_le : s₀ ≤ s_h / (2 * Real.exp M₁) := min_le_right _ _
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp M₁ := Real.exp_pos M₁
    have h_prod_lt : Real.exp M₁ * |z.im| < s_h := by
      have hzim_lt : |z.im| < 2 * s₀ := hz
      calc Real.exp M₁ * |z.im|
          < Real.exp M₁ * (2 * s₀) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hzim_lt hexp_pos
        _ ≤ Real.exp M₁ * (2 * (s_h / (2 * Real.exp M₁))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hexp_pos.le
        _ = s_h := by field_simp [hexp_pos.ne']
    change |(ϕ_ℂ z).im| < 2 * s_h
    linarith

  refine ⟨{
    toRationalCollarData := R
    s₀ := s₀
    s_h := s_h
    s₀_pos := hs₀_pos
    s_h_pos := hs_h_pos
    u_ℂ := U_data.u_raw
    h_ℂ := h_ℂ
    ϕ_ℂ := ϕ_ℂ
    u_ℂ_holo := U_data.u_raw_holo.mono (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁)
    u_ℂ_real := U_data.u_raw_real
    u_ℂ_periodic := fun z hz => U_data.u_raw_periodic z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)
    u_ℂ_conj := fun z hz => U_data.u_raw_conj z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)
    deriv_ϕ_ℂ_eq_exp := fun z hz => hϕ_ℂ_deriv z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)
    h_ℂ_holo := hh_ℂ_holo
    ϕ_ℂ_holo := hϕ_ℂ_holo.mono (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁)
    ϕ_ℂ_maps_to := hϕ_maps_to
    h_ℂ_real := hh_ℂ_real
    ϕ_ℂ_real := hϕ_ℂ_real
    h_ℂ_periodic := hh_ℂ_per
    h_ℂ_conj := hh_ℂ_conj
    ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic := fun z hz => hϕ_ℂ_qper z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)
    ϕ_ℂ_conj := fun z hz => hϕ_ℂ_conj z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)
    ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero := fun z hz => by
      rw [hϕ_ℂ_deriv z (hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz)]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    lazutkin_norm_ℂ := fun z hz => by
      have hz₂ : z ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₂ hz
      have hz₁ : z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := hStrip_mono h2s₀_le_σ₁ hz
      have hw : ϕ_ℂ z ∈ U_h := hϕ_maps_to z hz
      rw [hh_ℂ_ode (ϕ_ℂ z) hw, hϕ_ℂ_deriv z hz₁]
      dsimp [rad_ℂ, g]
      rw [hψ_ϕ z hz₂]
      have hexp3 : (Complex.exp (U_data.u_raw z)) ^ 3 = Complex.exp (3 * U_data.u_raw z) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
      rw [hexp3, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
      have h_cancel : -3 * U_data.u_raw z + 3 * U_data.u_raw z = 0 := by ring
      rw [h_cancel, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h_s1 : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x_T ρ_T : Fin N → ℝ), (∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ρ_T i) →
      ∃ S : Finset (Fin N),
        (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → (ρ_T i + ρ_T j) / 2 ≤ |x_T i - x_T j|) ∧
        MeasureTheory.volume.real
          (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x_T i - ρ_T i / 2) (x_T i + ρ_T i / 2)) ≤
          3 * (∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j) ∧
        (∀ m ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, |x - x_T m| ≤ ρ_T m / 8 →
          ∑ j ∈ S.erase m, ρ_T j / (x - x_T j) ^ 2 ≤ 6 / ρ_T m) := by
    intro N x_T ρ_T hρ_pos
    have h_vitali : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Finset (Fin N)), U.card = n →
        ∃ S ⊆ U,
          (∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → (ρ_T i + ρ_T j) / 2 ≤ |x_T i - x_T j|) ∧
          (∀ i ∈ U, ∃ j ∈ S,
            Set.Icc (x_T i - ρ_T i / 2) (x_T i + ρ_T i / 2) ⊆
              Set.Icc (x_T j - 3 * ρ_T j / 2) (x_T j + 3 * ρ_T j / 2)) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro U hU_card
        by_cases hU : U.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀_mem, hj₀_max⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image U ρ_T hU
          let C : Finset (Fin N) :=
            U.filter (fun i => |x_T i - x_T j₀| < (ρ_T i + ρ_T j₀) / 2)
          have hj₀_C : j₀ ∈ C := by
            rw [Finset.mem_filter]
            refine ⟨hj₀_mem, ?_⟩
            simp only [sub_self, abs_zero]
            linarith [hρ_pos j₀]

        exact hz_not_Ω ⟨hz_Ro, h_not⟩
      obtain ⟨m, hmS, hzm_cb⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz_Bc
      have hzm_not_b : z ∉ Metric.ball (c' m) (ρ' m / 8) :=
        fun hb => hz_not_Bo (Set.mem_biUnion hmS hb)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hzm_cb
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, not_lt] at hzm_not_b
      have hzm_sph : z ∈ Metric.sphere (c' m) (ρ' m / 8) :=
        Metric.mem_sphere.mpr (le_antisymm hzm_cb hzm_not_b)
      refine ⟨hV_sph m hmS z hzm_sph, ?_⟩
      have h_aff_cm : aff (c' m) = (x_T m : ℂ) - (d_T m : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        dsimp [aff, c', x', d']
        have hd_c : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hd.ne'
        push_cast
        field_simp [hd_c]
        ring
      have h_aff_ball : aff z ∈
          Metric.closedBall ((x_T m : ℂ) - (d_T m : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_T m / 8) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, ← h_aff_cm]
        have h_diff : aff z - aff (c' m) = (d : ℂ) * (z - c' m) := by dsimp [aff]; ring
        rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hd), ← dist_eq_norm]
        calc d * dist z (c' m) ≤ d * (ρ' m / 8) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzm_cb (le_of_lt hd)
        _ = ρ_T m / 8 := by dsimp [ρ']; field_simp [hd.ne']
      exact hF_bad m (aff z) h_aff_ball
    · left
      obtain ⟨hz1, hz2, hz3⟩ := hz_Rc
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz1 with h1_lt | h1_eq
      · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz2 with h2_lt | h2_eq
        · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hz3 with h3_lt | h3_eq
          · exact False.elim (hz_Ro ⟨h1_lt, h2_lt, h3_lt⟩)
          · exact hV_tb z hz1 (Or.inr h3_eq)
        · exact hV_tb z hz1 (Or.inl h2_eq.symm)
      · exact hV_lat z h1_eq hz2 hz3
  have hw₀_mem' : (-Complex.I : ℂ) ∈ Ω' := by
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun h_cb => ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.I_re, neg_zero, abs_zero]; linarith
    · simp only [Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_im, neg_neg]; linarith
    · simp only [Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_im, neg_neg]; norm_num
    · obtain ⟨j, hjS, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp h_cb
      obtain ⟨hρj_pos, haj, _, hdj_half, _, _⟩ := hS_tiles' j hjS
      have hρj_le : ρ' j ≤ 1 / 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hzj
      have h_im_le : |((-Complex.I : ℂ) - c' j).im| ≤ ‖(-Complex.I : ℂ) - c' j‖ :=
        Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      have h_im_val : ((-Complex.I : ℂ) - c' j).im = -(1 - d' j) := by
        simp [c']; ring
      rw [h_im_val, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)] at h_im_le
      linarith
  have hF'_wit : Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F' (-Complex.I)‖ := by
    have : aff (-Complex.I) = (p : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I := by dsimp [aff]; ring
    dsimp [F']; rw [this]; exact hF_wit
  have hV_ub : V (-Complex.I) ≤ 2 * C_disk * (U₀ / H_def) :=
    h_s3 Ω' U_open' F' V M_top U₀ H_def C_disk (-Complex.I)
      hΩ'_open hΩ'_bdd hU_open' h_clos_U' hF'_diff hV_cont_clos
      (fun z₀ _ r hr hcb => hV_mean z₀ r hr hcb)
      hU₀ hH hC_disk hF'_top h_front' hw₀_mem' hF'_wit
  have h_sum_ρ : ∑ j ∈ S, ρ' j = (∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j) / d := by
    dsimp [ρ']; exact (Finset.sum_div S ρ_T d).symm
  rw [h_sum_ρ] at hV_wit
  have h_sum_bound : ∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j ≤ (2 * C_disk / c_wit) * d * (U₀ / H_def) := by
    have h1 : c_wit * ((∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j) / d) ≤ 2 * C_disk * (U₀ / H_def) :=
      le_trans hV_wit hV_ub
    calc
      ∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j = (d / c_wit) * (c_wit * ((∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j) / d)) := by
        field_simp [hc_wit.ne', hd.ne']
      _ ≤ (d / c_wit) * (2 * C_disk * (U₀ / H_def)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
      _ = (2 * C_disk / c_wit) * d * (U₀ / H_def) := by ring
  calc
    MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x_T i - ρ_T i / 2) (x_T i + ρ_T i / 2)) ≤
        3 * (∑ j ∈ S, ρ_T j) := hS_meas
    _ ≤ 3 * ((2 * C_disk / c_wit) * d * (U₀ / H_def)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_bound (by norm_num)
    _ = (6 * C_disk / c_wit) * d * (U₀ / H_def) := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have zero_free_ball_modulus_lower_bound
      (G : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ) (R₁ M T : ℝ)
      (hR₁ : 0 < R₁) (hT : 0 < T)
      (hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball q R₁))
      (hG_nz : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q R₁, G z ≠ 0)
      (hG_up : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q R₁, ‖G z‖ ≤ Real.exp M)
      (hG_q : Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖G q‖) :
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall q (R₁ / 2), Real.exp (M - 6 * T) ≤ ‖G z‖ := by
    set B : Set ℂ := Metric.ball q R₁
    have hB_open : IsOpen B := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hq_mem : q ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball_self hR₁
    have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => -deriv G z / G z) B :=
      ((hG_holo.deriv hB_open).neg).div hG_holo hG_nz
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := Convex.exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt (convex_ball q R₁) hf_holo
    let L : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => L₀ z - L₀ q
    have hL_q : L q = 0 := sub_self (L₀ q)
    have hL_deriv : ∀ z ∈ B, HasDerivAt L (-deriv G z / G z) z := by
      intro z hz
      exact ((hL₀ z hz).hasDerivAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hz)).sub_const (L₀ q)
    have hL_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ L B :=
      fun z hz => (hL_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    let H : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => G z * Complex.exp (L z)
    have hH_deriv : ∀ z ∈ B, HasDerivAt H 0 z := by
      intro z hz
      have hG_at : HasDerivAt G (deriv G z) z :=
        (hG_holo.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
      have hE_at : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (L w))
          (Complex.exp (L z) * (-deriv G z / G z)) z :=
        (hL_deriv z hz).cexp
      have hmul := hG_at.mul hE_at
      have hzero : deriv G z * Complex.exp (L z) +
          G z * (Complex.exp (L z) * (-deriv G z / G z)) = 0 := by
        have hnz := hG_nz z hz
        field_simp [hnz]
        ring
      rwa [hzero] at hmul
    have hH_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ H B :=
      fun z hz => (hH_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hH_d0 : Set.EqOn (deriv H) 0 B := fun z hz => (hH_deriv z hz).deriv
    have hH_const : ∀ z ∈ B, G z * Complex.exp (L z) = G q := by
      intro z hz
      have heq := hB_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (convex_ball q R₁).isPreconnected
        hH_diff hH_d0 hz hq_mem
      simpa [H, hL_q] using heq
    have hRe_low : ∀ z ∈ B, -2 * T ≤ (L z).re := by
      intro z hz
      have hnorm_eq : ‖G q‖ = ‖G z‖ * Real.exp ((L z).re) := by
        rw [← hH_const z hz, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
      have hle : Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ Real.exp (M + (L z).re) := by
        calc Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖G q‖ := hG_q
          _ = ‖G z‖ * Real.exp ((L z).re) := hnorm_eq
          _ ≤ Real.exp M * Real.exp ((L z).re) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hG_up z hz) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
          _ = Real.exp (M + (L z).re) := (Real.exp_add M ((L z).re)).symm
      have := Real.exp_le_exp.mp hle
      linarith
    let c4T : ℂ := ((4 * T : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let Ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => L z / (L z + c4T)
    have h_denom_nz : ∀ z ∈ B, L z + c4T ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz h0
      have hre : (L z + c4T).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
      have hre2 : (L z + c4T).re = (L z).re + 4 * T := by simp [c4T]
      have := hRe_low z hz
      linarith
    have hΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ B :=
      hL_holo.div (hL_holo.add (differentiableOn_const c4T)) h_denom_nz
    have hΨ_q : Ψ q = 0 := by simp [Ψ, hL_q]
    have hΨ_maps : Set.MapsTo Ψ B (Metric.closedBall (Ψ q) 1) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hΨ_q, dist_zero_right]
      have hsq1 : ‖L z‖ ^ 2 = (L z).re * (L z).re + (L z).im * (L z).im := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
      have hsq2 : ‖L z + c4T‖ ^ 2 =
          ((L z).re + 4 * T) * ((L z).re + 4 * T) + (L z).im * (L z).im := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
        simp [c4T]
      have hre_z := hRe_low z hz
      have hle_sq : ‖L z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L z + c4T‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hn1 : 0 ≤ ‖L z‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hn2 : 0 < ‖L z + c4T‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_denom_nz z hz)
      have hle_norm : ‖L z‖ ≤ ‖L z + c4T‖ := by nlinarith
      simpa [Ψ, norm_div] using div_le_one_of_le₀ hle_norm (le_of_lt hn2)
    intro z hz_cb
    have hz_dist : dist z q ≤ R₁ / 2 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hz_cb
    have hz_B : z ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith)
    have h_schwarz := Complex.dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball hΨ_holo hΨ_maps hz_B
    have hΨ_half : ‖Ψ z‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have hd : dist (Ψ z) (Ψ q) = ‖Ψ z‖ := by rw [hΨ_q, dist_zero_right]
      have hbound : 1 / R₁ * dist z q ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        calc 1 / R₁ * dist z q ≤ 1 / R₁ * (R₁ / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz_dist (by positivity)
          _ = 1 / 2 := by field_simp [hR₁.ne']
      linarith
    have hL_eq : L z = Ψ z * (L z + c4T) := by
      simp only [Ψ]
      exact (div_mul_cancel₀ (L z) (h_denom_nz z hz_B)).symm
    have hc4T_norm : ‖c4T‖ = 4 * T := by
      simp only [c4T, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 4 * T)]
    have hL_norm : ‖L z‖ ≤ 4 * T := by
      have h1 : ‖L z‖ = ‖Ψ z‖ * ‖L z + c4T‖ := by
        calc ‖L z‖ = ‖Ψ z * (L z + c4T)‖ := congrArg norm hL_eq
          _ = ‖Ψ z‖ * ‖L z + c4T‖ := norm_mul _ _
      have h2 : ‖L z + c4T‖ ≤ ‖L z‖ + 4 * T := by
        calc ‖L z + c4T‖ ≤ ‖L z‖ + ‖c4T‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖L z‖ + 4 * T := by rw [hc4T_norm]
      have h3 : ‖Ψ z‖ * ‖L z + c4T‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * (‖L z‖ + 4 * T) :=
        mul_le_mul hΨ_half h2 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hRe_up : (L z).re ≤ 4 * T :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm (L z)).trans hL_norm)
    have hnorm_eq : ‖G q‖ = ‖G z‖ * Real.exp ((L z).re) := by
      rw [← hH_const z hz_B, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
    have hGz_eq : ‖G z‖ = ‖G q‖ * Real.exp (-(L z).re) := by
      rw [hnorm_eq, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    rw [hGz_eq]
    calc Real.exp (M - 6 * T)
        = Real.exp (M - 2 * T) * Real.exp (-4 * T) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖G q‖ * Real.exp (-(L z).re) := by
            apply mul_le_mul hG_q
            · exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
            · positivity
            · exact norm_nonneg _
  have single_tile_blaschke_zero_factorization
      (F : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (ρ M T : ℝ)
      (hρ : 0 < ρ)
      (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball c (100 * ρ)))
      (hF_up : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c (100 * ρ), ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M)
      (hq_ex : ∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare c ρ, Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖F q‖) :
      ∃ (q : ℂ) (N : ℕ) (a : Fin N → ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
        (N : ℝ) ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) * T ∧
        meshClosedSquare c (9 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball q (30 * ρ)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), G z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), ‖G z‖ ≤ Real.exp M) ∧
        Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖G q‖ ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ),
          ‖G z‖ * (2 / (135 * ρ)) ^ N * (∏ i : Fin N, ‖z - a i‖) ≤ ‖F z‖) := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq_sq, hFq⟩ := hq_ex
    have h_l1 : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ≤ |w.re| + |w.im| := by
      intro w
      calc ‖w‖ = ‖(w.re : ℂ) + (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := by rw [Complex.re_add_im]
        _ ≤ ‖(w.re : ℂ)‖ + ‖(w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |w.re| + |w.im| := by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hqc : ‖q - c‖ ≤ ρ := by
      have h1 := h_l1 (q - c)
      have h2 := hq_sq.1
      have h3 := hq_sq.2
      linarith
    have h_sq_sub : meshClosedSquare c (9 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hzc : ‖z - c‖ ≤ 9 * ρ := by
        have h1 := h_l1 (z - c)
        have h2 := hz.1
        have h3 := hz.2
        linarith
      have hzq : ‖z - q‖ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖q - c‖ := by
        calc ‖z - q‖ = ‖(z - c) - (q - c)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖q - c‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      linarith
    set U₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball q (90 * ρ)
    set R₀ : ℝ := 60 * ρ
    have hR₀_pos : 0 < R₀ := by positivity
    have hU₀_sub : U₀ ⊆ Metric.ball c (100 * ρ) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
      have hzq : ‖z - c‖ ≤ ‖z - q‖ + ‖q - c‖ := by
        calc ‖z - c‖ = ‖(z - q) + (q - c)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - q‖ + ‖q - c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      linarith
    have h_cb_R₀_U₀ : Metric.closedBall q R₀ ⊆ U₀ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      linarith
    let D_fn : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun a z => ((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 - starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) * (z - q)
    let B_fn : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun a z => ((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - a) / D_fn a z
    have hR₀_C_norm : ‖((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R₀ := by
      simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR₀_pos]
    have hD_nz : ∀ a ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), ∀ z ∈ U₀, D_fn a z ≠ 0 := by
      intro a ha z hz h0
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ha hz
      have hprod : ‖starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) * (z - q)‖ < 2700 * ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a - q), norm_nonneg (z - q)]
      have hRsq : ‖((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = 3600 * ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_pow, hR₀_C_norm]
        dsimp [R₀]
        ring
      have heq : ((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) * (z - q) := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
      have hnorm_eq : ‖((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = ‖starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) * (z - q)‖ := by rw [heq]
      nlinarith
    have hB_sphere : ∀ a ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere q R₀, ‖B_fn a z‖ = 1 := by
      intro a ha z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ha
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      have hza_nz : z - a ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hza : z = a := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
        subst hza
        linarith
      have hRsq_w : ((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = (z - q) * starRingEnd ℂ (z - q) := by
        rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hz]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hD_fac : D_fn a z = (z - q) * starRingEnd ℂ (z - a) := by
        dsimp [D_fn]
        rw [hRsq_w]
        have hconj : starRingEnd ℂ (z - a) = starRingEnd ℂ (z - q) - starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) := by
          rw [← map_sub]
          congr 1
          ring
        rw [hconj]
        ring
      dsimp [B_fn]
      rw [hD_fac, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul, hR₀_C_norm, hz, Complex.norm_conj]
      have hpos : R₀ * ‖z - a‖ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hR₀_pos.ne' (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hza_nz)
      exact div_self hpos
    have hB_center : ∀ a ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), ‖B_fn a q‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro a ha
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ha
      have hDq : D_fn a q = ((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 := by simp [D_fn]
      have hBq : ‖B_fn a q‖ = ‖a - q‖ / R₀ := by
        dsimp [B_fn]
        rw [hDq, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, hR₀_C_norm, norm_sub_rev]
        field_simp [hR₀_pos.ne']
      rw [hBq]
      have : R₀ = 60 * ρ := rfl
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hR₀_pos]
      linarith
    have hB_lower : ∀ a ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ), ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ),
        (2 / (135 * ρ)) * ‖z - a‖ ≤ ‖B_fn a z‖ := by
      intro a ha z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ha
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      have hz_U₀ : z ∈ U₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        linarith
      have hD_pos : 0 < ‖D_fn a z‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (hD_nz a (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]) z hz_U₀)
      have hD_up : ‖D_fn a z‖ ≤ 4050 * ρ ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖D_fn a z‖
            ≤ ‖((R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2‖ + ‖starRingEnd ℂ (a - q) * (z - q)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = R₀ ^ 2 + ‖a - q‖ * ‖z - q‖ := by
                rw [norm_pow, hR₀_C_norm, norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj]
          _ ≤ 4050 * ρ ^ 2 := by
                have : R₀ = 60 * ρ := rfl
                nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a - q), norm_nonneg (z - q)]
      dsimp [B_fn]
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, hR₀_C_norm]
      calc (2 / (135 * ρ)) * ‖z - a‖
          = (R₀ * ‖z - a‖) / (4050 * ρ ^ 2) := by
              have : R₀ = 60 * ρ := rfl
              rw [this]
              field_simp [hρ.ne']
