      · have hre : (a • u + b • v - c k).re = a * (u - c k).re + b * (v - c k).re := by
          calc (a • u + b • v - c k).re
              = a * u.re + b * v.re - (a + b) * (c k).re := by simp [hab]
            _ = a * (u - c k).re + b * (v - c k).re := by simp [Complex.sub_re]; ring
        rw [hre, abs_le]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      · have him : (a • u + b • v - c k).im = a * (u - c k).im + b * (v - c k).im := by
          calc (a • u + b • v - c k).im
              = a * u.im + b * v.im - (a + b) * (c k).im := by simp [hab]
            _ = a * (u - c k).im + b * (v - c k).im := by simp [Complex.sub_im]; ring
        rw [him, abs_le]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
    have h_seg1_safe : ∀ (k : Fin (m + 1)) {z : ℂ},
        z ∈ segment ℝ (P k.castSucc) (M_c k) → P_safe z := by
      intro k z hz
      have hz_sq := h_seg_sq k (hA_props k).1 (hM_sq k) hz
      apply hSafe k z hz_sq
      intro j hz_ball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz_ball
      rcases hz with ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, rfl⟩
      have him : (a • P k.castSucc + b • M_c k).im = (P k.castSucc).im := by
        simp [hM_im k, ← add_mul, hab]
      have habs : |(P k.castSucc).im - (w_b k j).im| < r_b k j := by
        calc |(P k.castSucc).im - (w_b k j).im|
            = |(a • P k.castSucc + b • M_c k - w_b k j).im| := by rw [Complex.sub_im, him]
          _ ≤ ‖a • P k.castSucc + b • M_c k - w_b k j‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ < r_b k j := hz_ball
      rw [abs_lt] at habs
      exact (hA_props k).2 j ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_seg2_safe : ∀ (k : Fin (m + 1)) {z : ℂ},
        z ∈ segment ℝ (M_c k) (P k.succ) → P_safe z := by
      intro k z hz
      have hz_sq := h_seg_sq k (hM_sq k) (hB_props k).1 hz
      apply hSafe k z hz_sq
      intro j hz_ball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz_ball
      rcases hz with ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, rfl⟩
      have hre : (a • M_c k + b • P k.succ).re = (P k.succ).re := by
        simp [hM_re k, ← add_mul, hab]
      have habs : |(P k.succ).re - (w_b k j).re| < r_b k j := by
        calc |(P k.succ).re - (w_b k j).re|
            = |(a • M_c k + b • P k.succ - w_b k j).re| := by rw [Complex.sub_re, hre]
          _ ≤ ‖a • M_c k + b • P k.succ - w_b k j‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
          _ < r_b k j := hz_ball
      rw [abs_lt] at habs
      exact (hB_props k).2 j ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_len_k : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
        ‖M_c k - P k.castSucc‖ + ‖P k.succ - M_c k‖ ≤ 18 * ρ k := by
      intro k
      have h1 : M_c k - P k.castSucc = (((P k.succ).re - (P k.castSucc).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [M_c]
      have h2 : P k.succ - M_c k = (((P k.succ).im - (P k.castSucc).im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [M_c]
      have hn1 : ‖M_c k - P k.castSucc‖ ≤ 9 * ρ k := by
        rw [h1, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have ha1 := abs_le.mp (hA_props k).1.1
        have hb1 := abs_le.mp (hB_props k).1.1
        simp only [Complex.sub_re] at ha1 hb1
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      have hn2 : ‖P k.succ - M_c k‖ ≤ 9 * ρ k := by
        rw [h2, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
        have ha2 := abs_le.mp (hA_props k).1.2
        have hb2 := abs_le.mp (hB_props k).1.2
        simp only [Complex.sub_im] at ha2 hb2
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      linarith
    have h_chain : ∀ (r : ℕ) (Pts : Fin (r + 1) → ℂ) (Mid : Fin r → ℂ),
        ∃ (γ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []),
          γ.head hγ = Pts 0 ∧
          γ.getLast hγ = Pts (Fin.last r) ∧
          meshPolyTrace γ ⊆ {Pts (Fin.last r)} ∪
            ⋃ k : Fin r, (segment ℝ (Pts k.castSucc) (Mid k) ∪ segment ℝ (Mid k) (Pts k.succ)) ∧
          meshPolyLength γ ≤ ∑ k : Fin r, (‖Mid k - Pts k.castSucc‖ + ‖Pts k.succ - Mid k‖) := by
      intro r
      induction' r with r ih
      · intro Pts _
        refine ⟨[Pts 0], List.cons_ne_nil _ _, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz; left; simpa [meshPolyTrace, Fin.last] using hz
        · simp [meshPolyLength]
      · intro Pts Mid
        obtain ⟨γ', hγ', hhead', hlast', htrace', hlen'⟩ :=
          ih (fun k => Pts k.succ) (fun k => Mid k.succ)
        cases γ' with
        | nil => exact False.elim (hγ' rfl)
        | cons v tail =>
          have hv : v = Pts (0 : Fin (r + 1)).succ := by simpa using hhead'
          let γ : List ℂ := Pts 0 :: Mid 0 :: v :: tail
          have hγ : γ ≠ [] := List.cons_ne_nil _ _
          refine ⟨γ, hγ, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · dsimp [γ]
            exact hlast'.trans (by rw [Fin.succ_last])
          · intro z hz
            dsimp [γ, meshPolyTrace] at hz
            rcases hz with hz1 | hz2 | hz3
            · right
              refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, Or.inl ?_⟩
              simpa using hz1
            · right
              refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, Or.inr ?_⟩
              simpa [hv] using hz2
            · have hz3' := htrace' hz3
              rcases hz3' with h_end | h_rest
              · left
                simpa [Fin.succ_last] using h_end
              · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp h_rest
                right
                refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k.succ, ?_⟩
                simpa [Fin.castSucc_succ] using hk
          · dsimp [γ, meshPolyLength]
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
            simp only [Fin.castSucc_succ]
            have hv' : ‖v - Mid 0‖ = ‖Pts (0 : Fin (r + 1)).succ - Mid 0‖ := by rw [hv]
            have hc0 : Pts (0 : Fin (r + 1)).castSucc = Pts 0 := rfl
            rw [hv', hc0]
            linarith
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ, hhead, hlast, htrace, hlen⟩ := h_chain (m + 1) P M_c
    have htrace_segs : meshPolyTrace γ ⊆
        ⋃ k : Fin (m + 1), (segment ℝ (P k.castSucc) (M_c k) ∪ segment ℝ (M_c k) (P k.succ)) := by
      intro z hz
      rcases htrace hz with h_end | h_segs
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h_end
        subst h_end
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k_last, Or.inr ?_⟩
        have hlast_succ : P (Fin.last (m + 1)) = P k_last.succ := rfl
        rw [hlast_succ]
        exact right_mem_segment ℝ _ _
      · exact h_segs
    refine ⟨γ, hγ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hhead, hP_zero]; exact hq_start_sq
    · rw [hlast, hP_last]; exact hq_end_sq
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (htrace_segs hz)
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, h_seg_sq k (hA_props k).1 (hM_sq k) hk⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k, h_seg_sq k (hM_sq k) (hB_props k).1 hk⟩
    · calc meshPolyLength γ
          ≤ ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), (‖M_c k - P k.castSucc‖ + ‖P k.succ - M_c k‖) := hlen
        _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), 18 * ρ k := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => h_len_k k
        _ = 18 * ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (htrace_segs hz)
      · exact h_seg1_safe k hk
      · exact h_seg2_safe k hk
  let K₀ : ℝ := 6750 * Real.exp 1
  have hK₀_gt1 : 1 < K₀ := by
    have hexp1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
      linarith
    dsimp [K₀]
    linarith
  have hK₀_pos : 0 < K₀ := zero_lt_one.trans hK₀_gt1
  have hlogK₀_pos : 0 < Real.log K₀ := Real.log_pos hK₀_gt1
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  let C_route : ℝ := 6 + (2 / Real.log 2) * Real.log K₀
  have hC_route_pos : 0 < C_route := by positivity
  refine ⟨C_route, 18, hC_route_pos, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro m c ρ F M T hT hρ hTouch hGood
  have h_s2 : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      ∃ (q : ℂ) (N : ℕ) (a : Fin N → ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
        (N : ℝ) ≤ (2 / Real.log 2) * T ∧
        meshClosedSquare (c k) (9 * ρ k) ⊆ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ k) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball q (30 * ρ k)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ k), G z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q (30 * ρ k), ‖G z‖ ≤ Real.exp M) ∧
        Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖G q‖ ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall q (15 * ρ k),
          ‖G z‖ * (2 / (135 * ρ k)) ^ N * (∏ i : Fin N, ‖z - a i‖) ≤ ‖F z‖) :=
    fun k => single_tile_blaschke_zero_factorization F (c k) (ρ k) M T (hρ k)
      (hGood k).1 (hGood k).2.1 (hGood k).2.2
  choose q N a G hN_le hsq_cb hG_holo hG_nz hG_up hG_q hFG_low using h_s2
  have h_s3 : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      ∃ r : Fin (N k) → ℝ,
        (∀ j : Fin (N k), 0 ≤ r j) ∧
        (∑ j : Fin (N k), r j) ≤ (3 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, (∀ j : Fin (N k), z ∉ Metric.ball (a k j) (r j)) →
          (((1 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k) / Real.exp 1) ^ (N k) ≤ ∏ i : Fin (N k), ‖z - a k i‖ := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨r, hr_nn, hr_sum, hr_prod⟩ :=
      finite_boutroux_cartan_covering (N k) ((1 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k) (by positivity [hρ k]) (a k)
    refine ⟨r, hr_nn, ?_, hr_prod⟩
    linarith
  choose r hr_nn hr_sum hr_prod using h_s3
  apply chain_axis_parallel_ball_avoiding_routing m c ρ
    (fun z => Real.exp (M - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F z‖) N a r hρ hTouch hr_nn hr_sum
  intro k z hz_sq hz_av
  have hz_cb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (q k) (15 * ρ k) := hsq_cb k hz_sq
  have hG_low : Real.exp (M - 6 * T) ≤ ‖G k z‖ := by
    have h1 := zero_free_ball_modulus_lower_bound (G k) (q k) (30 * ρ k) M T
      (by positivity [hρ k]) hT (hG_holo k) (hG_nz k) (hG_up k) (hG_q k) z
    have hrad : 30 * ρ k / 2 = 15 * ρ k := by ring
    rw [hrad] at h1
    exact h1 hz_cb
  have hP_low := hr_prod k z hz_av
  have hF_k := hFG_low k z hz_cb
  have h_prod_base :
      (2 / (135 * ρ k)) ^ (N k) * ((((1 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k) / Real.exp 1) ^ (N k)) =
      Real.exp (-(N k : ℝ) * Real.log K₀) := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    have h_inner : (2 / (135 * ρ k)) * (((1 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k) / Real.exp 1) =
        Real.exp (-Real.log K₀) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hK₀_pos]
      dsimp [K₀]
      have hρ_nz := (hρ k).ne'
      have hexp_nz := (Real.exp_pos 1).ne'
      field_simp [hρ_nz, hexp_nz]
      ring
    rw [h_inner, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    ring_nf
  have h_exp_step : Real.exp (M - C_route * T) ≤
      Real.exp (M - 6 * T) * Real.exp (-(N k : ℝ) * Real.log K₀) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hNk_mul : (N k : ℝ) * Real.log K₀ ≤ ((2 / Real.log 2) * T) * Real.log K₀ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hN_le k) hlogK₀_pos.le
    dsimp [C_route]
    linarith
  calc Real.exp (M - C_route * T)
      ≤ Real.exp (M - 6 * T) * Real.exp (-(N k : ℝ) * Real.log K₀) := h_exp_step
    _ = Real.exp (M - 6 * T) *
          ((2 / (135 * ρ k)) ^ (N k) * ((((1 / 100 : ℝ) * ρ k) / Real.exp 1) ^ (N k))) := by
          rw [h_prod_base]
    _ ≤ ‖G k z‖ *
          ((2 / (135 * ρ k)) ^ (N k) * (∏ i : Fin (N k), ‖z - a k i‖)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul hG_low
          · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP_low (by positivity [hρ k])
          · positivity [hρ k]
          · exact norm_nonneg _
    _ = ‖G k z‖ * (2 / (135 * ρ k)) ^ (N k) * (∏ i : Fin (N k), ‖z - a k i‖) := by ring
    _ ≤ ‖F z‖ := hF_k

proof.tactics:
by
  intro W H hW hH good
  have hToFin : ∀ x y : ℤ, 0 ≤ x → x < (W : ℤ) → 0 ≤ y → y < (H : ℤ) →
      (((dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (x, y)).1.val : ℤ) = x ∧
       ((dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (x, y)).2.val : ℤ) = y) := by
    intro x y hx0 hxW hy0 hyH
    have hx : x.toNat < W := by omega
    have hy : y.toNat < H := by omega
    simp only [dualGridToFinCell, hx, hy, ↓reduceDIte]
    omega
  let Reach : Fin W × Fin H → Prop := fun p =>
    ∃ (L : List (Fin W × Fin H)) (hL : L ≠ []),
      (∀ q ∈ L, good q = true) ∧
      List.IsChain meshGridAdj4 L ∧
      (L.head hL).1.val = 0 ∧
      L.getLast hL = p
  by_cases hCross : ∃ p : Fin W × Fin H, Reach p ∧ p.1.val = W - 1
  · rcases hCross with ⟨p, ⟨L, hL, hGoodL, hChainL, hHeadL, hLastL⟩, hpW⟩
    exact Or.inl ⟨L, hL, hGoodL, hChainL, hHeadL, by rw [hLastL]; exact hpW⟩
  · right
    have hNoCross : ∀ p : Fin W × Fin H, Reach p → p.1.val ≠ W - 1 := by
      intro p hp hpW
      exact hCross ⟨p, hp, hpW⟩
    let inMark : ℤ × ℤ → Bool := fun c =>
      if c.1 = -1 ∧ 0 ≤ c.2 ∧ c.2 < (H : ℤ) then true
      else if 0 ≤ c.1 ∧ c.1 < (W : ℤ) ∧ 0 ≤ c.2 ∧ c.2 < (H : ℤ) then
        @decide (Reach (dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH c)) (Classical.propDecidable _)
      else false
    have hLeft : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 ≤ j → j < (H : ℤ) → inMark (-1, j) = true := by
      intro j hj0 hjH
      simp [inMark, hj0, hjH]
    have hRight : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 ≤ j → j < (H : ℤ) → inMark ((W : ℤ) - 1, j) = false := by
      intro j hj0 hjH
      have hne : (W : ℤ) - 1 ≠ -1 := by omega
      have h0 : 0 ≤ (W : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
      have hlt : (W : ℤ) - 1 < (W : ℤ) := by omega
      simp only [inMark, hne, false_and, ↓reduceIte, h0, hlt, hj0, hjH, and_self,
        decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      intro hRp
      have hcoord := (hToFin ((W : ℤ) - 1) j h0 hlt hj0 hjH).1
      have hpval : (dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH ((W : ℤ) - 1, j)).1.val = W - 1 := by omega
      exact hNoCross _ hRp hpval
    have hFrontier : ∀ lx ly rx ry : ℤ,
        0 ≤ rx → rx < (W : ℤ) → 0 ≤ ry → ry < (H : ℤ) → 0 ≤ ly → ly < (H : ℤ) →
        |lx - rx| + |ly - ry| = 1 →
        inMark (lx, ly) = true → inMark (rx, ry) = false →
        good (dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (rx, ry)) = false := by
      intro lx ly rx ry hrx0 hrxW hry0 hryH hly0 hlyH hadj hl_true hr_false
      let q := dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (rx, ry)
      have hrx_ne : rx ≠ -1 := by omega
      have hnotReach_q : ¬ Reach q := by
        have hr_eq : inMark (rx, ry) =
            @decide (Reach q) (Classical.propDecidable _) := by
          simp [inMark, hrx_ne, hrx0, hrxW, hry0, hryH, q]
        rw [hr_eq, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hr_false
        exact hr_false
      cases hgood_q : good q with
      | false => rfl
      | true =>
        exfalso
        by_cases hlx1 : lx = -1
        · have hrx_eq0 : rx = 0 := by
            have habs1 : |lx - rx| = 1 + rx := by
              rw [hlx1, abs_of_nonpos (by omega)]
              ring
            have habs2 : 0 ≤ |ly - ry| := abs_nonneg (ly - ry)
            omega
          have hq1_int : (q.1.val : ℤ) = rx := (hToFin rx ry hrx0 hrxW hry0 hryH).1
          have hq1 : q.1.val = 0 := by omega
          apply hnotReach_q
          refine ⟨[q], List.cons_ne_nil _ _, ?_, List.isChain_singleton q, hq1, rfl⟩
          intro r hr
          simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hr
          rw [hr, hgood_q]
        · by_cases hl_in : 0 ≤ lx ∧ lx < (W : ℤ)
          · let p := dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (lx, ly)
            have hReach_p : Reach p := by
              have hl_eq : inMark (lx, ly) =
                  @decide (Reach p) (Classical.propDecidable _) := by
                simp [inMark, hlx1, hl_in.1, hl_in.2, hly0, hlyH, p]
              rw [hl_eq] at hl_true
              exact @of_decide_eq_true (Reach p) (Classical.propDecidable _) hl_true
            rcases hReach_p with ⟨L, hL, hGoodL, hChainL, hHeadL, hLastL⟩
            have hp_coords := hToFin lx ly hl_in.1 hl_in.2 hly0 hlyH
            have hq_coords := hToFin rx ry hrx0 hrxW hry0 hryH
            have hpq : meshGridAdj4 p q := by
              dsimp [meshGridAdj4, p, q]
              rw [hp_coords.1, hp_coords.2, hq_coords.1, hq_coords.2]
              exact hadj
            apply hnotReach_q
            have hL' : L ++ [q] ≠ [] := by simp
            refine ⟨L ++ [q], hL', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
            · intro r hr
              rcases List.mem_append.mp hr with hrL | hrq
              · exact hGoodL r hrL
              · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hrq
                rw [hrq, hgood_q]
            · refine hChainL.append (List.isChain_singleton q) ?_
              intro u hu v hv
              rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast hL, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hu
              simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hv
              rw [← hu, hLastL, ← hv]
              exact hpq
            · cases L with
              | nil => exact absurd rfl hL
              | cons a tl => simpa using hHeadL
            · simp
          · have hl_false : inMark (lx, ly) = false := by
              rcases not_and_or.mp hl_in with h0 | hW'
              · simp [inMark, hlx1, h0]
              · simp [inMark, hlx1, hW']
            rw [hl_false] at hl_true
            exact Bool.false_ne_true hl_true

    
    let Ω : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) := dualGridActiveFinset W H inMark
    let S₀ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) := Ω.filter (fun e => (dualGridStartPt e).2 = 0)
    let T₀ : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) := Ω.filter (fun e => (dualGridEndPt e).2 = 0)
    let T_goal : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) := Ω.filter (fun e => (dualGridEndPt e).2 = (H : ℤ))
    have hMemΩ_iff : ∀ e : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        e ∈ Ω ↔ dualGridInBox W H e = true ∧ dualGridIsBoundary inMark e = true := by
      rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩
      dsimp only [Ω]
      simp only [dualGridActiveFinset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product,
        Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Bool.and_eq_true]
      constructor
      · exact fun h => h.2
      · rintro ⟨hbox, hbd⟩
        refine ⟨?_, hbox, hbd⟩
        interval_cases d <;>
          simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox <;>
          omega

    
    have hLocalTurn : ∀ e : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        dualGridIsBoundary inMark e = true →
        dualGridStartPt (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = dualGridEndPt e ∧
        dualGridIsBoundary inMark (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = true ∧
        dualGridPrevEdge inMark (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = e := by
      rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩ hbd
      interval_cases d
      · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
          Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
        rcases hbd with ⟨hBL, hBR⟩
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x, y + 1)) with h1 | h1 <;>
          rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x - 1, y + 1)) with h2 | h2 <;>
          simp [dualGridNextEdge, dualGridPrevEdge, dualGridEndPt, dualGridStartPt,
            dualGridTurnRight, dualGridTurnLeft, dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell,
            dualGridRightCell, dualGridInEdge, hBL, hBR, h1, h2]
      · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
          Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
        rcases hbd with ⟨hBL, hBR⟩
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x + 1, y - 1)) with h1 | h1 <;>
          rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x + 1, y)) with h2 | h2 <;>
          simp [dualGridNextEdge, dualGridPrevEdge, dualGridEndPt, dualGridStartPt,
            dualGridTurnRight, dualGridTurnLeft, dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell,
            dualGridRightCell, dualGridInEdge, hBL, hBR, h1, h2]
      · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
          Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
        rcases hbd with ⟨hBL, hBR⟩
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x - 1, y - 1 - 1)) with h1 | h1 <;>
          rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x, y - 1 - 1)) with h2 | h2 <;>
          simp [dualGridNextEdge, dualGridPrevEdge, dualGridEndPt, dualGridStartPt,
            dualGridTurnRight, dualGridTurnLeft, dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell,
            dualGridRightCell, dualGridInEdge, hBL, hBR, h1, h2]
      · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
          Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
        rcases hbd with ⟨hBL, hBR⟩
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x - 1 - 1, y)) with h1 | h1 <;>
          rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (inMark (x - 1 - 1, y - 1)) with h2 | h2 <;>
          simp [dualGridNextEdge, dualGridPrevEdge, dualGridEndPt, dualGridStartPt,
            dualGridTurnRight, dualGridTurnLeft, dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell,
            dualGridRightCell, dualGridInEdge, hBL, hBR, h1, h2]

    have hStepSys : ∀ e ∈ Ω, e ∉ T₀ → e ∉ T_goal →
        dualGridStartPt (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = dualGridEndPt e ∧
        dualGridNextEdge inMark e ∈ Ω ∧
        dualGridNextEdge inMark e ∉ S₀ ∧
        dualGridPrevEdge inMark (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = e := by
      intro e he heT₀ heTg
      have ⟨hbox, hbd⟩ := (hMemΩ_iff e).mp he
      have ⟨hStart, hNextBd, hPrevNext⟩ := hLocalTurn e hbd
      have hv_ne0 : (dualGridEndPt e).2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        exact heT₀ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, h0⟩)
      have hv_neH : (dualGridEndPt e).2 ≠ (H : ℤ) := by
        intro hH'
        exact heTg (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨he, hH'⟩)
      have hv_bounds : 0 ≤ (dualGridEndPt e).1 ∧ (dualGridEndPt e).1 < (W : ℤ) ∧
          1 ≤ (dualGridEndPt e).2 ∧ (dualGridEndPt e).2 < (H : ℤ) := by
        rcases e with ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩
        interval_cases d <;>
          simp only [dualGridInBox, dualGridEndPt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox hv_ne0 hv_neH ⊢ <;>
          omega
      have hNextInBox : dualGridInBox W H (dualGridNextEdge inMark e) = true := by
        set ne := dualGridNextEdge inMark e
        have hne_xy : ne.1 = (dualGridEndPt e).1 ∧ ne.2.1 = (dualGridEndPt e).2 := by
          have hs : (ne.1, ne.2.1) = dualGridEndPt e := hStart
          exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hs, congrArg Prod.snd hs⟩
        rcases ne with ⟨nx, ny, ⟨nd, hnd⟩⟩
        dsimp only at hne_xy
        rcases hne_xy with ⟨hnx, hny⟩
        interval_cases nd
        · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]
          omega
        · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]
          refine ⟨by omega, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
          by_contra hge
          have hnx_eq : nx = (W : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
          have hbd1 := hNextBd
          simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, Bool.and_eq_true] at hbd1
          rw [hnx_eq, hRight ny (by omega) (by omega)] at hbd1
          exact Bool.false_ne_true hbd1.1
        · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]
          omega
        · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]
          refine ⟨?_, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩
          by_contra hlt
          have hnx_eq : nx = 0 := by omega
          have hbd3 := hNextBd
          simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridRightCell, Bool.and_eq_true,
            Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd3
          have h0m1 : (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 := by norm_num
          rw [hnx_eq, h0m1, hLeft ny (by omega) (by omega)] at hbd3
          exact Bool.false_ne_true hbd3.2.symm
      have hNextMem : dualGridNextEdge inMark e ∈ Ω :=
        (hMemΩ_iff _).mpr ⟨hNextInBox, hNextBd⟩
      have hNextNotS₀ : dualGridNextEdge inMark e ∉ S₀ := by
        intro hmemS
        have hs0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hmemS).2
        rw [hStart] at hs0
        omega
      exact ⟨hStart, hNextMem, hNextNotS₀, hPrevNext⟩

    
    have hCellSys : ∀ e ∈ Ω,
        (0 ≤ (dualGridRightCell e).1 ∧ (dualGridRightCell e).1 < (W : ℤ) ∧
         0 ≤ (dualGridRightCell e).2 ∧ (dualGridRightCell e).2 < (H : ℤ)) ∧
        (0 ≤ (dualGridLeftCell e).2 ∧ (dualGridLeftCell e).2 < (H : ℤ)) ∧
        |(dualGridLeftCell e).1 - (dualGridRightCell e).1| +
          |(dualGridLeftCell e).2 - (dualGridRightCell e).2| = 1 ∧
        dualGridIsBoundary inMark e = true ∧
        (e ∈ S₀ → (dualGridRightCell e).2 = 0) ∧
        (e ∈ T_goal → (dualGridRightCell e).2 = (H : ℤ) - 1) := by
      rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩ he
      have ⟨hbox, hbd⟩ := (hMemΩ_iff ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩).mp he
      interval_cases d
      · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hbd, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [dualGridRightCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell]; ring_nf; norm_num
        · intro hS
          have hy0 : y = 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
          simp [dualGridRightCell, hy0]
        · intro hG
          have hyH : y + 1 = (H : ℤ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hG).2
          simp only [dualGridRightCell]; omega
      · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hbd, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [dualGridRightCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell]; ring_nf; norm_num
        · intro hS
          have hy0 : y = 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
          omega
        · intro hG
          have hyH : y = (H : ℤ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hG).2
          omega
      · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox
        have hx_pos : 1 ≤ x := by
          by_contra hlt
          have hx0 : x = 0 := by omega
          have hbd2 := hbd
          simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridRightCell, Bool.and_eq_true,
            Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd2
          have h0m1 : (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 := by norm_num
          rw [hx0, h0m1, hLeft (y - 1) (by omega) (by omega)] at hbd2
          exact Bool.false_ne_true hbd2.2.symm
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hbd, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [dualGridRightCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell]; ring_nf; norm_num
        · intro hS
          have hy0 : y = 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
          omega
        · intro hG
          have hyH : y - 1 = (H : ℤ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hG).2
          omega
      · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hbd, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [dualGridRightCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell]; omega
        · simp only [dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell]; ring_nf; norm_num
        · intro hS
          have hy0 : y = 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hS).2
          omega
        · intro hG
          have hyH : y = (H : ℤ) := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hG).2
          omega

    
    have hAdj8Local : ∀ e₁ e₂ : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        dualGridEndPt e₁ = dualGridStartPt e₂ →
        max |(dualGridRightCell e₁).1 - (dualGridRightCell e₂).1|
          |(dualGridRightCell e₁).2 - (dualGridRightCell e₂).2| ≤ 1 := by
      rintro ⟨x₁, y₁, ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩⟩ ⟨x₂, y₂, ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩⟩ hconn
      have hxy : (dualGridEndPt ⟨x₁, y₁, ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩⟩).1 = x₂ ∧
          (dualGridEndPt ⟨x₁, y₁, ⟨d₁, hd₁⟩⟩).2 = y₂ :=
        ⟨congrArg Prod.fst hconn, congrArg Prod.snd hconn⟩
      rw [max_le_iff, abs_le, abs_le]
      interval_cases d₁ <;> interval_cases d₂ <;>
        simp only [dualGridEndPt, dualGridRightCell] at hxy ⊢ <;>
        omega

    
    have hExcess : T₀.card < S₀.card := by
      let pS : ℕ → Prop := fun i =>
        inMark ((i : ℤ) - 1, 0) = true ∧ inMark ((i : ℤ), 0) = false
      let pT : ℕ → Prop := fun i =>
        inMark ((i : ℤ), 0) = true ∧ inMark ((i : ℤ) - 1, 0) = false
      let fS : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4 := fun i => ((i : ℤ), 0, ⟨0, by decide⟩)
      let fT : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4 := fun i => ((i : ℤ), 1, ⟨2, by decide⟩)
      have hfS_inj : Function.Injective fS := by
        intro a b hab
        have h1 : (a : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) := congrArg Prod.fst hab
        omega
      have hfT_inj : Function.Injective fT := by
        intro a b hab
        have h1 : (a : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) := congrArg Prod.fst hab
        omega
      have hS₀_eq : S₀ = ((Finset.range W).filter pS).image fS := by
        apply Finset.ext
        rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩
        change (x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩) ∈ Ω.filter (fun e => (dualGridStartPt e).2 = 0) ↔ _
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, hMemΩ_iff]
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, pS, fS]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hbox, hbd⟩, hy0⟩
          simp only [dualGridStartPt] at hy0
          subst hy0
          interval_cases d
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox
            simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
              Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
            refine ⟨x.toNat, ⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
            · have hx : ((x.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = x := by omega
              rw [hx]; exact hbd
            · ext <;> simp; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox; omega
        · rintro ⟨i, ⟨hiW, hiBd⟩, heq⟩
          rw [← heq]
          refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega
          · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
              Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true']
            exact hiBd
      have hT₀_eq : T₀ = ((Finset.range W).filter pT).image fT := by
        apply Finset.ext
        rintro ⟨x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩⟩
        change (x, y, ⟨d, hd⟩) ∈ Ω.filter (fun e => (dualGridEndPt e).2 = 0) ↔ _
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, hMemΩ_iff]
        simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, pT, fT]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hbox, hbd⟩, hend0⟩
          interval_cases d
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, dualGridEndPt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox hend0; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, dualGridEndPt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox hend0; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, dualGridEndPt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox hend0
            have hy1 : y = 1 := by omega
            subst hy1
            simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
              sub_self, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd
            refine ⟨x.toNat, ⟨by omega, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
            · have hx : ((x.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = x := by omega
              rw [hx]; exact hbd
            · ext <;> simp; omega
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, dualGridEndPt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hbox hend0; omega
        · rintro ⟨i, ⟨hiW, hiBd⟩, heq⟩
          rw [← heq]
          refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · simp only [dualGridInBox, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega
          · simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, dualGridLeftCell, dualGridRightCell,
              sub_self, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true']
            exact hiBd
          · simp [dualGridEndPt]
      have hcardS : S₀.card = ((Finset.range W).filter pS).card := by
        rw [hS₀_eq, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hfS_inj]
      have hcardT : T₀.card = ((Finset.range W).filter pT).card := by
        rw [hT₀_eq, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hfT_inj]
      let g : ℕ → ℤ := fun i => if inMark ((i : ℤ) - 1, 0) = true then 1 else 0
      have hdiff_int : (S₀.card : ℤ) - (T₀.card : ℤ) = 1 := by
        rw [hcardS, hcardT, Finset.card_filter, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_sum,
          ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        have hsum_eq :
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range W,
              (((if pS i then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((if pT i then 1 else 0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range W, (g i - g (i + 1)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          dsimp only [pS, pT, g]
          have hi1 : (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = (i : ℤ) := by omega
          simp only [hi1]
          cases h1 : inMark ((i : ℤ) - 1, 0) <;> cases h2 : inMark ((i : ℤ), 0) <;> simp
        rw [hsum_eq, Finset.sum_range_sub' g W]
        have hg0 : g 0 = 1 := by
          simp only [g, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, ite_eq_left_iff]
          intro hnot
          exact absurd (hLeft 0 (by omega) (by omega)) hnot
        have hgW : g W = 0 := by
          simp [g, hRight 0 (by omega) (by omega)]
        omega
      omega

    
    let step := dualGridNextEdge inMark
    let prev := dualGridPrevEdge inMark
    let isStop : (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → Bool := fun e => decide (e ∈ T₀ ∨ e ∈ T_goal)
    let StepRel : (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → Prop :=
      fun u v => u ∈ Ω ∧ v ∈ Ω ∧ v = step u ∧ u ∉ T₀ ∧ u ∉ T_goal
    have hWalk_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ e : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e ≠ [] := by
      intro n e
      cases n with
      | zero => simp [dualGridWalkFrom]
      | succ n =>
        simp only [dualGridWalkFrom]
        split_ifs <;> simp
    have hWalk_head : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ e : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e).head (hWalk_ne n e) = e := by
      intro n e
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n =>
        simp only [dualGridWalkFrom]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
    have hWalk_get0 : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ e : ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4,
        (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[0]'(List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (hWalk_ne n e)) = e := by
      intro n e
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n =>
        simp only [dualGridWalkFrom]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
    have hWalk_props : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ e ∈ Ω,
        (∀ u ∈ dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e, u ∈ Ω) ∧
        List.IsChain StepRel (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, ∀ hk : k + 1 < (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e).length,
          (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[k]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk) ∈ Ω ∧
          (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[k]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk) ∉ T₀ ∧
          (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[k]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk) ∉ T_goal ∧
          (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[k + 1]'hk =
            step ((dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e)[k]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk))) ∧
        ((dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e).getLast (hWalk_ne n e) ∈ T₀ ∨
         (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e).getLast (hWalk_ne n e) ∈ T_goal ∨
         (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n e).length = n + 1) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro e he
        refine ⟨?_, List.isChain_singleton e, ?_, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)⟩
        · intro u hu
          simp only [dualGridWalkFrom, List.mem_singleton] at hu
          rwa [hu]
        · intro k hk
          simp [dualGridWalkFrom] at hk
      | succ n ih =>
        intro e he
        by_cases hstop : isStop e = true
        · have hstop' : e ∈ T₀ ∨ e ∈ T_goal := by
            simpa [isStop, decide_eq_true_eq] using hstop
          have hwalk_eq : dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e = [e] := by
            simp [dualGridWalkFrom, hstop]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro u hu
            rw [hwalk_eq, List.mem_singleton] at hu
            rwa [hu]
          · rw [hwalk_eq]
            exact List.isChain_singleton e
          · intro k hk
            rw [hwalk_eq] at hk
            simp at hk
          · have hlast : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e).getLast
                (hWalk_ne (n + 1) e) = e := by
              simp [hwalk_eq]
            rw [hlast]
            rcases hstop' with hT0 | hTg
            · exact Or.inl hT0
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hTg)
        · have hstop_f : isStop e = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hstop
          have hnot_stop : ¬ (e ∈ T₀ ∨ e ∈ T_goal) := by
            simpa [isStop, decide_eq_false_iff_not] using hstop_f
          have heT₀ : e ∉ T₀ := fun h => hnot_stop (Or.inl h)
          have heTg : e ∉ T_goal := fun h => hnot_stop (Or.inr h)
          have hstep_e := hStepSys e he heT₀ heTg
          obtain ⟨ih_mem, ih_chain, ih_idx, ih_end⟩ := ih (step e) hstep_e.2.1
          have hwalk_eq : dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e =
              e :: dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e) := by
            simp [dualGridWalkFrom, hstop_f]
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro u hu
            rw [hwalk_eq, List.mem_cons] at hu
            rcases hu with rfl | hu'
            · exact he
            · exact ih_mem u hu'
          · rw [hwalk_eq]
            have hne' := hWalk_ne n (step e)
            have hhd' := hWalk_head n (step e)
            cases hL' : dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e) with
            | nil => exact absurd hL' hne'
            | cons b tl =>
              have hb : b = step e := by
                simpa [hL'] using hhd'
              have hb_mem : b ∈ Ω := by
                rw [hb]; exact hstep_e.2.1
              rw [hL'] at ih_chain
              exact List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr
                ⟨⟨he, hb_mem, hb, heT₀, heTg⟩, ih_chain⟩
          · intro k hk
            cases k with
            | zero =>
              have h0 : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e)[0]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk) = e := by
                simp [hwalk_eq]
              have h1 : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e)[1]'hk = step e := by
                have hk' : 0 < (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e)).length :=
                  List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (hWalk_ne n (step e))
                calc (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e)[1]'hk
                    = (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e))[0]'hk' := by simp [hwalk_eq]
                  _ = step e := hWalk_get0 n (step e)
              rw [h0, h1]
              exact ⟨he, heT₀, heTg, rfl⟩
            | succ k' =>
              have hk' : k' + 1 < (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e)).length := by
                simp only [hwalk_eq, List.length_cons] at hk
                omega
              have h_at1 : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e)[k' + 1]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk) =
                  (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e))[k']'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk') := by
                simp [hwalk_eq]
              have h_at2 : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e)[k' + 2]'hk =
                  (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e))[k' + 1]'hk' := by
                simp [hwalk_eq]
              rw [h_at1, h_at2]
              exact ih_idx k' hk'
          · have hlast : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e).getLast
                (hWalk_ne (n + 1) e) =
                (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e)).getLast (hWalk_ne n (step e)) := by
              simp [hwalk_eq, List.getLast_cons (hWalk_ne n (step e))]
            have hlen : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop (n + 1) e).length =
                (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop n (step e)).length + 1 := by
              simp [hwalk_eq]
            rw [hlast, hlen]
            rcases ih_end with hT0 | hTg | hlen'
            · exact Or.inl hT0
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hTg)
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))

    let fuel := Ω.card
    let walkOf : (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → List (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) :=
      fun a => dualGridWalkFrom step isStop fuel a
    let endState : (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) :=
      fun a => (walkOf a).getLast (hWalk_ne fuel a)

    have hS₀_sub : S₀ ⊆ Ω := Finset.filter_subset _ _

    have hBack : ∀ a ∈ S₀, ∀ b ∈ S₀,
        ∀ ia ib : ℕ, ∀ hia : ia < (walkOf a).length, ∀ hib : ib < (walkOf b).length,
          (walkOf a)[ia]'hia = (walkOf b)[ib]'hib → ia = ib ∧ a = b := by
      intro a ha b hb ia
      have haΩ : a ∈ Ω := hS₀_sub ha
      have hbΩ : b ∈ Ω := hS₀_sub hb
      have hpa := (hWalk_props fuel a haΩ).2.2.1
      have hpb := (hWalk_props fuel b hbΩ).2.2.1
      induction ia with
      | zero =>
        intro ib hia hib heq
        have ha0 : (walkOf a)[0]'hia = a := hWalk_get0 fuel a
        cases ib with
        | zero =>
          have hb0 : (walkOf b)[0]'hib = b := hWalk_get0 fuel b
          rw [ha0, hb0] at heq
          exact ⟨rfl, heq⟩
        | succ jb =>
          obtain ⟨hub_Ω, hub_T₀, hub_Tg, hstep_b⟩ := hpb jb hib
          have hnotS₀ := (hStepSys _ hub_Ω hub_T₀ hub_Tg).2.2.1
          rw [ha0, hstep_b] at heq
          rw [heq] at ha
          exact absurd ha hnotS₀
      | succ ja ih =>
        intro ib hia hib heq
        obtain ⟨hua_Ω, hua_T₀, hua_Tg, hstep_a⟩ := hpa ja hia
        have hsys_a := hStepSys _ hua_Ω hua_T₀ hua_Tg
        cases ib with
        | zero =>
          have hb0 : (walkOf b)[0]'hib = b := hWalk_get0 fuel b
          rw [hstep_a, hb0] at heq
          rw [← heq] at hb
          exact absurd hb hsys_a.2.2.1
        | succ jb =>
          obtain ⟨hub_Ω, hub_T₀, hub_Tg, hstep_b⟩ := hpb jb hib
          have hsys_b := hStepSys _ hub_Ω hub_T₀ hub_Tg
          rw [hstep_a, hstep_b] at heq
          have hprev_eq : (walkOf a)[ja]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hia) =
              (walkOf b)[jb]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hib) := by
            calc (walkOf a)[ja]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hia)
                = prev (step ((walkOf a)[ja]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hia))) := hsys_a.2.2.2.symm
              _ = prev (step ((walkOf b)[jb]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hib))) := congrArg prev heq
              _ = (walkOf b)[jb]'(Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hib) := hsys_b.2.2.2
          obtain ⟨hidx, hab⟩ := ih jb (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hia) (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hib) hprev_eq
          exact ⟨by omega, hab⟩

    have hTerm : ∀ a ∈ S₀, endState a ∈ T₀ ∨ endState a ∈ T_goal := by
      intro a ha
      have haΩ : a ∈ Ω := hS₀_sub ha
      obtain ⟨hmem_a, _, _, hend_a⟩ := hWalk_props fuel a haΩ
      rcases hend_a with hT0 | hTg | hlen_full
      · exact Or.inl hT0
      · exact Or.inr hTg
      · exfalso
        have hnodup : (walkOf a).Nodup := by
          rw [List.nodup_iff_injective_getElem]
          intro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hij
          exact Fin.ext (hBack a ha a ha i j hi hj hij).1
        have hsub : (walkOf a).toFinset ⊆ Ω := by
          intro u hu
          exact hmem_a u (List.mem_toFinset.mp hu)
        have hle : (dualGridWalkFrom step isStop fuel a).length ≤ fuel := by
          change (walkOf a).length ≤ Ω.card
          rw [← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup]
          exact Finset.card_le_card hsub
        omega

    have hInjEnd : Set.InjOn endState ↑S₀ := by
      intro a ha b hb heq
      have ha' : a ∈ S₀ := ha
      have hb' : b ∈ S₀ := hb
      have hpos_a : 0 < (walkOf a).length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (hWalk_ne fuel a)
      have hpos_b : 0 < (walkOf b).length := List.length_pos_of_ne_nil (hWalk_ne fuel b)
      have hia : (walkOf a).length - 1 < (walkOf a).length := by omega
      have hib : (walkOf b).length - 1 < (walkOf b).length := by omega
      have hlast_a : endState a = (walkOf a)[(walkOf a).length - 1]'hia :=
        List.getLast_eq_getElem (hWalk_ne fuel a)
      have hlast_b : endState b = (walkOf b)[(walkOf b).length - 1]'hib :=
        List.getLast_eq_getElem (hWalk_ne fuel b)
      rw [hlast_a, hlast_b] at heq
      exact (hBack a ha' b hb' _ _ hia hib heq).2

    have hExistsGoal : ∃ a ∈ S₀, endState a ∈ T_goal := by
      by_contra hno
      have hno' : ∀ a ∈ S₀, endState a ∉ T_goal := fun a ha hg => hno ⟨a, ha, hg⟩
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo endState ↑S₀ ↑T₀ := by
        intro a ha
        rcases hTerm a ha with hT0 | hTg
        · exact hT0
        · exact absurd hTg (hno' a ha)
      have hcard_le : S₀.card ≤ T₀.card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn endState hmaps hInjEnd
      omega

    
    obtain ⟨a_star, ha_star, hGoal_star⟩ := hExistsGoal
    let W_list := walkOf a_star
    have hW_ne : W_list ≠ [] := hWalk_ne fuel a_star
    obtain ⟨hW_mem, hW_chain, _, _⟩ := hWalk_props fuel a_star (hS₀_sub ha_star)
    let toCell : (ℤ × ℤ × Fin 4) → Fin W × Fin H :=
      fun e => dualGridToFinCell W H hW hH (dualGridRightCell e)
    let B : List (Fin W × Fin H) := W_list.map toCell
    have hB : B ≠ [] := by
      simp [B, hW_ne]
    refine ⟨B, hB, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      rcases List.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨e, heW, rfl⟩
      have heΩ : e ∈ Ω := hW_mem e heW
      obtain ⟨hr_bds, hl_bds, hadj_lr, hbd_e, _, _⟩ := hCellSys e heΩ
      simp only [dualGridIsBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at hbd_e
      exact hFrontier (dualGridLeftCell e).1 (dualGridLeftCell e).2
        (dualGridRightCell e).1 (dualGridRightCell e).2
        hr_bds.1 hr_bds.2.1 hr_bds.2.2.1 hr_bds.2.2.2
        hl_bds.1 hl_bds.2 hadj_lr hbd_e.1 hbd_e.2
    · refine List.isChain_map_of_isChain toCell ?_ hW_chain
      rintro e₁ e₂ ⟨he₁, he₂, rfl, he₁T₀, he₁Tg⟩
      have hconn : dualGridEndPt e₁ = dualGridStartPt (step e₁) :=
        (hStepSys e₁ he₁ he₁T₀ he₁Tg).1.symm
      have hr₁ := (hCellSys e₁ he₁).1
      have hr₂ := (hCellSys (step e₁) he₂).1
      have hc₁ := hToFin (dualGridRightCell e₁).1 (dualGridRightCell e₁).2
        hr₁.1 hr₁.2.1 hr₁.2.2.1 hr₁.2.2.2
      have hc₂ := hToFin (dualGridRightCell (step e₁)).1 (dualGridRightCell (step e₁)).2
        hr₂.1 hr₂.2.1 hr₂.2.2.1 hr₂.2.2.2
      dsimp only [meshGridAdj8, toCell]
      rw [hc₁.1, hc₁.2, hc₂.1, hc₂.2]
      exact hAdj8Local e₁ (step e₁) hconn
    · have hhead_eq : B.head hB = toCell (W_list.head hW_ne) := List.head_map hB
      rw [hhead_eq, hWalk_head fuel a_star]
      have haΩ : a_star ∈ Ω := hS₀_sub ha_star
      have hr := (hCellSys a_star haΩ).1
      have hry0 : (dualGridRightCell a_star).2 = 0 := (hCellSys a_star haΩ).2.2.2.2.1 ha_star
      have hc := (hToFin (dualGridRightCell a_star).1 (dualGridRightCell a_star).2
        hr.1 hr.2.1 hr.2.2.1 hr.2.2.2).2
      dsimp only [toCell]
      exact Int.ofNat.inj (hc.trans hry0)
    · have hlast_eq : B.getLast hB = toCell (W_list.getLast hW_ne) := List.getLast_map hB
      rw [hlast_eq]
      let e_last := W_list.getLast hW_ne
      have hlast_goal : e_last ∈ T_goal := hGoal_star
      have hlast_Ω : e_last ∈ Ω := Finset.filter_subset _ _ hlast_goal
      have hr := (hCellSys e_last hlast_Ω).1
      have hryH : (dualGridRightCell e_last).2 = (H : ℤ) - 1 :=
        (hCellSys e_last hlast_Ω).2.2.2.2.2 hlast_goal
      have hc := (hToFin (dualGridRightCell e_last).1 (dualGridRightCell e_last).2
        hr.1 hr.2.1 hr.2.2.1 hr.2.2.2).2
      have hH_cast : (((H - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = (H : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
      change (toCell e_last).2.val = H - 1
      dsimp only [toCell]
      exact Int.ofNat.inj (hc.trans (hryH.trans hH_cast.symm))

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases hMesh.epochs_and_witnesses with ⟨L₀, E, hL₀, hE_pos, hE_dense, hE_wit⟩
  obtain ⟨M_lat, C_shad, hM_lat_gt, hC_shad, hSh_raw⟩ :=
    hShadow 1024 2048 (L₀ + 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hM_lat : 0 < M_lat := by linarith
  have hOpenH : IsOpen criticalLowerHalfPlane :=
    isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
  have hSh : DyadicShadowBoundAt L₀ M_lat C_shad := by
    intro p d τ M_top_loc U₀ H_def F_loc N x_T d_T ρ_T hd hτ hτd hU₀ hH hTiles hF_loc hBox hWit hBalls
    refine hSh_raw p d τ M_top_loc U₀ H_def F_loc criticalLowerHalfPlane N x_T d_T ρ_T
      hd hτ hτd hU₀ hH hTiles hOpenH ?_ hF_loc hBox hWit hBalls
    intro z hz
    show z.im < 0
    linarith [hz.2.1]
  rcases hRoute with ⟨C_route, C_len, hC_route, hC_len, hRt_raw⟩
  have hRt : DyadicChainRoutingAt C_route C_len := hRt_raw
  let C_small : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (min (1 / (16384 * C_shad)) (1 / (6144 * C_len)))
  have hC_small : 0 < C_small := by positivity
  have hC_small_le_quarter : C_small ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hC_small_le_shad : C_small ≤ 1 / (16384 * C_shad) :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hC_small_le_len : C_small ≤ 1 / (6144 * C_len) :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hShad_mul_small : C_shad * C_small ≤ 1 / 16384 := by
    have h1 : C_shad * C_small ≤ C_shad * (1 / (16384 * C_shad)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC_small_le_shad hC_shad.le
    have h2 : C_shad * (1 / (16384 * C_shad)) = 1 / 16384 := by
      field_simp [hC_shad.ne']
    linarith
  have hLen_le_inv_small : C_len * 6144 ≤ 1 / C_small := by
    have h1 : (C_len * 6144) * C_small ≤ (6144 * C_len) * (1 / (6144 * C_len)) := by
      have hcomm : C_len * 6144 = 6144 * C_len := mul_comm _ _
      rw [hcomm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC_small_le_len (by positivity)
    have h2 : (6144 * C_len) * (1 / (6144 * C_len)) = 1 := by
      field_simp [hC_len.ne']
    have h3 : ((C_len * 6144) * C_small) * (1 / C_small) ≤ 1 * (1 / C_small) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h1.trans_eq h2) (by positivity)
    have h4 : ((C_len * 6144) * C_small) * (1 / C_small) = C_len * 6144 := by
      field_simp [hC_small.ne']
    linarith
  rcases doubling_epoch_band_schedule F lam L₀ M_lat C_small E
      hlam hL₀ hM_lat hC_small hMesh.upper_growth hE_pos hE_dense hE_wit with
    ⟨u, ε_seq, M_top, L_a, L_b, hu_step, hu_top, hε_bounds, hε_anti, hε_zero,
     hεu_ge, hL_sep, hL_span, hM_bounds, hBox_unif, hWit_curr, hWit_prev⟩
  let A : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 1))⁻¹
  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 1))⁻¹
  let η : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (C_route + 2) * ε_seq j
  let B_low : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (lam - ε_seq j) * u j
  let T_good : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (M_top j - B_low j) / 2
  let U₀_j : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)
  have inv_two_pow_lt : ∀ m n : ℕ, n < m → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ < ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro m n hnm
    exact inv_strictAnti₀ (by positivity) (pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnm)
  have inv_two_pow_le : ∀ m n : ℕ, n ≤ m → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro m n hnm
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hnm with rfl | hlt
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact (inv_two_pow_lt m n hlt).le
  have hAB : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < A j ∧ A j < B j ∧ B (j + 1) < A j := by
    intro j
    have hj0 := hL_sep j
    have hj1 := hL_sep (j + 1)
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact inv_two_pow_lt (L_a j + 1) (L_b j - 1) (by omega)
    · exact inv_two_pow_lt (L_b (j + 1) - 1) (L_a j + 1) (by omega)
  have hLb_ge_succ : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 ≤ L_b j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      have := (hL_sep 0).1
      omega
    | succ j ih =>
      have h1 := (hL_sep j).2.1
      have h2 := (hL_sep j).2.2
      omega
  have hB_zero : Filter.Tendsto B Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h_geom : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ j) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_geom
      (fun j => by positivity) (fun j => ?_)
    have h1 : B j = (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 1) := by
      dsimp [B]
      rw [inv_pow]
    rw [h1]
    have hj := hLb_ge_succ j
    exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hη_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < η j := by
    intro j
    have := (hε_bounds j).1
    positivity
  have hη_anti : Antitone η := by
    intro i j hij
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hε_anti hij) (by positivity)
  have hη_zero : Filter.Tendsto η Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 := hε_zero.const_mul (C_route + 2)
    rwa [mul_zero] at h1
  have hBadExcl := bad_dyadic_barriers_exclusion F hF_holo L₀ M_lat C_shad hL₀ hC_shad hSh
  have hGoodRt := good_dyadic_chains_to_routed_curves F hF_holo C_route C_len hC_route hC_len hRt
  have h_epoch_j : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ∃ (γ σL σR : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []) (hσL : σL ≠ []) (hσR : σR ≠ []),
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace γ,
          -4 ≤ w.re ∧ w.re ≤ 4 ∧ A j < -w.im ∧ -w.im < B j) ∧
        (γ.head hγ).re ≤ -2.5 ∧
        2.5 ≤ (γ.getLast hγ).re ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace σL,
          -2.4 < w.re ∧ w.re < -1.1 ∧ 0 < -w.im) ∧
        B j ≤ -(σL.head hσL).im ∧
        -(σL.getLast hσL).im ≤ A (j + 2) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace σR,
          1.1 < w.re ∧ w.re < 2.4 ∧ 0 < -w.im) ∧
        B j ≤ -(σR.head hσR).im ∧
        -(σR.getLast hσR).im ≤ A (j + 2) ∧
        meshPolyLength γ ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        meshPolyLength σL ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        meshPolyLength σR ≤ Real.exp (η j * u j) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace γ ∪ meshPolyTrace σL ∪ meshPolyTrace σR,
          Real.exp ((lam - η j) * u j) ≤ ‖F w‖ ∧
          ‖F w‖ ≤ Real.exp ((lam + η j) * u j)) := by
    intro j
    have hu_ge_one : 1 ≤ u j := (hu_step j).1
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε_seq j := (hε_bounds j).1
    let X : ℝ := ε_seq j * u j
    have hX_pos : 0 < X := mul_pos hε_pos (by linarith)
    have hU₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ U₀_j j := by dsimp [U₀_j]; positivity
    have hM_lo : lam * u j ≤ M_top j := (hM_bounds j).1
    have hM_hi : M_top j ≤ lam * u j + C_small * X := (hM_bounds j).2
    have hDiff_lo : X ≤ M_top j - B_low j := by
      dsimp [X, B_low]
      linarith
    have hDiff_pos : 0 < M_top j - B_low j := lt_of_lt_of_le hX_pos hDiff_lo
    have hT_pos : 0 < T_good j := by dsimp [T_good]; linarith
    have hT_le_X : T_good j ≤ X := by
      dsimp [T_good, B_low, X]
      nlinarith [hC_small_le_quarter, hX_pos]
    have hBlow_eq : M_top j - 2 * T_good j = B_low j := by
      dsimp [T_good]
      ring
    have hRatio_le : U₀_j j / (M_top j - B_low j) ≤ C_small := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hDiff_pos]
      have : C_small * X ≤ C_small * (M_top j - B_low j) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDiff_lo hC_small.le
      simpa [U₀_j, X] using this
    have hShad_ratio : C_shad * (U₀_j j / (M_top j - B_low j)) ≤ 1 / 16384 := by
      calc C_shad * (U₀_j j / (M_top j - B_low j))
          ≤ C_shad * C_small := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRatio_le hC_shad.le
        _ ≤ 1 / 16384 := hShad_mul_small
    have hSep0 := hL_sep j
    have hSep1 := hL_sep (j + 1)
    have hSep2 := hL_sep (j + 2)
    have hLb_eq : L_b (j + 1 + 1) = L_b (j + 2) := rfl
    have hLa_le_La2 : L_a j + 16 ≤ L_a (j + 2) := by omega
    have hLb_lt_La : L_b j < L_a j := by omega
    have hLb_lt_La2 : L_b j < L_a (j + 2) := by omega
    have hLb3_lt_La23 : L_b j - 3 < L_a (j + 2) + 3 := by omega
    
    have hNoBadVert : ¬ DyadicBadVertChain (-3) 12 (L_b j) (L_a j)
        (meshTileIsGood F (B_low j)) := by
      refine hBadExcl.1 (L_b j) (L_a j) (M_top j) (B_low j) (U₀_j j)
        hLb_lt_La hU₀_nonneg hDiff_pos (by linarith) ?_
      intro x₀ hx₀
      rcases hWit_curr j x₀ hx₀ with ⟨p, δ_w, hδ1, hδ2, hp, _, hF_wit, hF_box⟩
      exact ⟨p, δ_w, hδ1, hδ2, hp, hF_wit, hF_box⟩
    have hGoodHoriz : DyadicGoodHorizChain (-3) 12 (L_b j) (L_a j)
        (meshTileIsGood F (M_top j - 2 * T_good j)) := by
      rw [hBlow_eq]
      rcases (graded_dyadic_grid_dichotomy hDual (-3) 12 (L_b j) (L_a j)
          (by norm_num) hLb_lt_La (meshTileIsGood F (B_low j))).1 with hG | hB
      · exact hG
      · exact False.elim (hNoBadVert hB)
    have hBox_horiz : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.re| ≤ 5 →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 1))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ →
        ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j) := by
      intro z hz_re hz_lo hz_hi
      have h_lo' : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im :=
        le_trans (inv_two_pow_le (L_a (j + 2) + 6) (L_a j + 1) (by omega)) hz_lo

  ∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare c ρ, Real.exp B_low ≤ ‖F q‖

def DyadicShadowBoundAt (L₀ M_lat C_shad : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p d τ M_top U₀ H_def : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (N : ℕ) (x_T d_T ρ_T : Fin N → ℝ),
    0 < d → 0 < τ → τ < d / 4 → 0 ≤ U₀ → 0 < H_def →
    (∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ρ_T i ∧ 1024 * ρ_T i ≤ d_T i ∧ d_T i ≤ 2048 * ρ_T i ∧
      d_T i ≤ d / 2 ∧ |x_T i - p| ≤ (L₀ + 3) * d ∧ τ < d_T i / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane →
    (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * d → τ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * d →
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) →
    Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (d : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ →
    (∀ i : Fin N, ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x_T i : ℂ) - (d_T i : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_T i / 8),
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top - H_def)) →
    MeasureTheory.volume.real
      (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x_T i - ρ_T i / 2) (x_T i + ρ_T i / 2)) ≤
      C_shad * d * (U₀ / H_def)

def DyadicChainRoutingAt (C_route C_len : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (M T : ℝ),
    0 < T →
    (∀ k : Fin (m + 1), 0 < ρ k) →
    (∀ k : Fin m,
      (meshClosedSquare (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
        meshClosedSquare (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty ∧
      ρ k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ k.succ ∧ ρ k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ k.castSucc) →
    (∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k), ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M) ∧
      (∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare (c k) (ρ k), Real.exp (M - 2 * T) ≤ ‖F q‖)) →
    ∃ (γ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []),
      γ.head hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c 0) (ρ 0) ∧
      γ.getLast hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c (Fin.last m)) (ρ (Fin.last m)) ∧
      meshPolyTrace γ ⊆ (⋃ k : Fin (m + 1), meshClosedSquare (c k) (9 * ρ k)) ∧
      meshPolyLength γ ≤ C_len * (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ meshPolyTrace γ, Real.exp (M - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F z‖

def DyadicGoodHorizChain (x_left : ℝ) (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ)
    (isGoodTile : ℂ → ℝ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ),
    (∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      0 < ρ k ∧
      1024 * ρ k ≤ -(c k).im ∧
      -(c k).im ≤ 2048 * ρ k ∧
      x_left + ρ k / 2 ≤ (c k).re ∧
      (c k).re ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ k / 2 ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ k / 2 ≤ -(c k).im ∧
      -(c k).im ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ k / 2 ∧
      isGoodTile (c k) (ρ k)) ∧
    (c 0).re = x_left + ρ 0 / 2 ∧
    (c (Fin.last m)).re = x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ (Fin.last m) / 2 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin m,
      (meshClosedSquare (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
        meshClosedSquare (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty ∧
      ρ k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ k.succ ∧ ρ k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ k.castSucc) ∧
    (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ≤ 512 * (M_w : ℝ) * ((L_max - L_min : ℕ) : ℝ)

def DyadicBadVertChain (x_left : ℝ) (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ)
    (isGoodTile : ℂ → ℝ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r : ℕ) (x_T d_T ρ_T : Fin (r + 1) → ℝ),
    (∀ k : Fin (r + 1),
      0 < ρ_T k ∧
      1024 * ρ_T k ≤ d_T k ∧
      d_T k ≤ 2048 * ρ_T k ∧
      x_left + ρ_T k / 2 ≤ x_T k ∧
      x_T k ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ_T k / 2 ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ_T k / 2 ≤ d_T k ∧
      d_T k ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ_T k / 2 ∧
      ¬ isGoodTile ((x_T k : ℂ) - (d_T k : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_T k)) ∧
    d_T 0 = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ_T 0 / 2 ∧
    d_T (Fin.last r) = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ_T (Fin.last r) / 2 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin r,
      |x_T k.succ - x_T k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ_T k.castSucc + ρ_T k.succ) / 2 ∧
      |d_T k.succ - d_T k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ_T k.castSucc + ρ_T k.succ) / 2 ∧
      ρ_T k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ_T k.succ ∧ ρ_T k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ_T k.castSucc)

def DyadicGoodVertChain (x_left : ℝ) (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ)
    (isGoodTile : ℂ → ℝ → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℂ) (ρ : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ),

    -(c 0).im = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ 0 / 2 ∧

def DyadicBadLatChain (x_left : ℝ) (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ)

  ∃ (r : ℕ) (x_T d_T ρ_T : Fin (r + 1) → ℝ),

def EpochBandScheduleData (F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam L₀ M_lat C_small : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u ε_seq M_top : ℕ → ℝ) (L_a L_b : ℕ → ℕ),

    Antitone ε_seq ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 / C_small ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 10 ≤ L_b j ∧ L_b j + 4 ≤ L_a j ∧ L_a j + 4 ≤ L_b (j + 1)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ((L_a (j + 2) + 3 - (L_b j - 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, lam * u j ≤ M_top j ∧ M_top j ≤ lam * u j + C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ,
      |z.re| ≤ 5 →
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im →
      -z.im ≤ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ →
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a j)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat) * δ_w ≤ 1 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j))) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 3))⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)))

def DyadicChainRoutingAt (C_route C_len : ℝ) : Prop :=

      γ.head hγ ∈ meshClosedSquare (c 0) (ρ 0) ∧

      meshPolyLength γ ≤ C_len * (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ∧

def DyadicGoodHorizChain (x_left : ℝ) (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ)

      0 < ρ k ∧

      (c k).re ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ k / 2 ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ k / 2 ≤ -(c k).im ∧
      -(c k).im ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ k / 2 ∧
      isGoodTile (c k) (ρ k)) ∧
    (c 0).re = x_left + ρ 0 / 2 ∧
    (c (Fin.last m)).re = x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ (Fin.last m) / 2 ∧

      ρ k.castSucc / 2 ≤ ρ k.succ ∧ ρ k.succ ≤ 2 * ρ k.castSucc) ∧

def EpochBandScheduleData (F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam L₀ M_lat C_small : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (u ε_seq M_top : ℕ → ℝ) (L_a L_b : ℕ → ℕ),
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ u j ∧ u j + 1 ≤ u (j + 1)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < ε_seq j ∧ ε_seq j ≤ C_small) ∧
    Antitone ε_seq ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 / C_small ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, 10 ≤ L_b j ∧ L_b j + 4 ≤ L_a j ∧ L_a j + 4 ≤ L_b (j + 1)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ((L_a (j + 2) + 3 - (L_b j - 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ε_seq j * u j) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, lam * u j ≤ M_top j ∧ M_top j ≤ lam * u j + C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ,
      |z.re| ≤ 5 →
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im →
      -z.im ≤ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ →
      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a j)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat) * δ_w ≤ 1 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j))) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 3))⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)))

    have h_abs : |v.arg| < Real.pi / 2 :=

      0 < u₁.re → u₁.im < 0 →
      0 < u₂.re → 0 < u₂.im →
      u₃.re < 0 → 0 < u₃.im →
      (Complex.log (Complex.I * u₁) - Complex.log (Complex.I * u₀)) +
        (Complex.log u₂ - Complex.log u₁) +
        (Complex.log (-Complex.I * u₃) - Complex.log (-Complex.I * u₂)) +
        (Complex.log (-u₀) - Complex.log (-u₃)) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I := by
    intro u₀ u₁ u₂ u₃ hu₀r hu₀i hu₁r hu₁i hu₂r hu₂i hu₃r hu₃i

    have h2 := h_q4_log (-Complex.I * u₂) (by simp [hu₂i]) (by simp [hu₂r])
    have h3 := h_q4_log (-u₃) (by simp [hu₃r]) (by simp [hu₃i])
    have h4 := h_q4_log (Complex.I * u₀) (by simp [hu₀i]) (by simp [hu₀r])
    have heq2 : Complex.I * (-Complex.I * u₂) = u₂ := by rw [← mul_assoc]; simp
    have heq3 : Complex.I * (-u₃) = -Complex.I * u₃ := by ring
    have heq4 : Complex.I * (Complex.I * u₀) = -u₀ := by rw [← mul_assoc]; simp
    rw [heq2] at h2; rw [heq3] at h3; rw [heq4] at h4

      have hg2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g2 a) criticalLowerHalfPlane :=

      have hg3_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g3 a) criticalLowerHalfPlane :=

          have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - a) ^ 2) (2 * (z - a) ^ 1 * 1) z :=

          have hg2_at : HasDerivAt (g2 a) (deriv (g2 a) z) z :=

      have h_iso : ∀ w : K_rect N, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧

          exact ⟨r, hr_pos, fun z hz hFz =>

      obtain ⟨t, ht_cov⟩ := (hK_compact N).elim_finite_subcover

      have hz_un := ht_cov hzK
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz_un

      have hz_eq : z = (w : ℂ) := hr_iso w z hz_ball hFz
      rw [hz_eq]

    have h_mem_ZF : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ b : ℂ, b ∈ ZF N ↔ b ∈ K_rect N ∧ F b = 0 :=
      fun N b => Set.Finite.mem_toFinset (hZ_fin N)
    have hZF_mono : ∀ {N M : ℕ}, N ≤ M → ZF N ⊆ ZF M := by
      intro N M hNM b hb
      rw [h_mem_ZF] at hb ⊢
      exact ⟨(hRK_mono hNM).2 hb.1, hb.2⟩
    have h_sum_pp_deriv : ∀ (S_fin : Finset ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        (∀ b ∈ S_fin, z ≠ b) →
        HasDerivAt (fun w => ∑ b ∈ S_fin, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹)
          (∑ b ∈ S_fin, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
      intro S_fin z hz_ne
      have h_term : ∀ b ∈ S_fin,
          HasDerivAt (fun w => -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹)
            ((deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
        intro b hb
        have hzb : z - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz_ne b hb)
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - b)⁻¹) (-1 / (z - b) ^ 2) z :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const b).inv hzb
        have h2 := h1.const_mul (-(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2)
        have h_alg : -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (-1 / (z - b) ^ 2) =
            (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [hzb]
        rwa [h_alg] at h2
      exact HasDerivAt.fun_sum h_term
    have h_sum_pp2_diff : ∀ (S_fin : Finset ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        (∀ b ∈ S_fin, z ≠ b) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => ∑ b ∈ S_fin, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
      intro S_fin z hz_ne
      refine DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b hb => ?_)
      have hzb : z - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz_ne b hb)
      exact (differentiableAt_const _).mul
        (((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const b)).inv hzb).pow 2)
    let S_pp : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun N z =>
      ∑ b ∈ ZF N, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹
    let h_reg : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun N z =>
      if z ∈ ZF N then
        rho z z - ∑ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2
      else
        (F z)⁻¹ ^ 2 - ∑ b ∈ ZF N, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2
    have hh_reg_holo : ∀ N : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_reg N) (R_rect N) := by
      intro N z₀ hz₀
      have hz₀_K : z₀ ∈ K_rect N := (hRK_sub N).1 hz₀
      have hz₀_H : z₀ ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane := (hRK_sub N).2 hz₀_K
      suffices DifferentiableAt ℂ (h_reg N) z₀ from this.differentiableWithinAt
      by_cases hFz₀ : F z₀ = 0
      · have hz₀_ZF : z₀ ∈ ZF N := (h_mem_ZF N z₀).mpr ⟨hz₀_K, hFz₀⟩
        obtain ⟨hg1_holo, hg3_holo, hg1_same, hg1_mul, _, h_rat_id⟩ :=
          h_zero_dslope z₀ hz₀_H hFz₀
        have hF1_ne : deriv F z₀ ≠ 0 := (h_zero_simple z₀ hz₀_H hFz₀).1
        have hg1_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (g1 z₀) z₀ :=
          (hg1_holo z₀ hz₀_H).differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀_H)
        have hg3_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (g3 z₀) z₀ :=
          (hg3_holo z₀ hz₀_H).differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀_H)
        have hrho_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (rho z₀) z₀ := by
          dsimp [rho]
          have h_den_ne : (deriv F z₀) ^ 2 * (g1 z₀ z₀) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
            rw [hg1_same]
            exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hF1_ne) (pow_ne_zero 2 hF1_ne)
          exact ((hg3_at.neg).mul (hg1_at.add (differentiableAt_const _))).div
            ((differentiableAt_const _).mul (hg1_at.pow 2)) h_den_ne
        have h_erase_ne : ∀ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, z₀ ≠ b :=
          fun b hb => (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hb).symm
        have h_loc_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun z => rho z₀ z - ∑ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z₀ :=
          hrho_at.sub (h_sum_pp2_diff ((ZF N).erase z₀) z₀ h_erase_ne)
        have h_ev_R : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, z ∈ R_rect N := (hR_open N).mem_nhds hz₀
        have h_ev_g1 : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, g1 z₀ z ≠ 0 :=
          hg1_at.continuousAt.eventually_ne (by rw [hg1_same]; exact hF1_ne)
        have h_ev_er : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, ∀ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, z ≠ b :=
          (Filter.eventually_all_finset ((ZF N).erase z₀)).mpr
            (fun b hb => eventually_ne_nhds (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hb).symm)
        refine h_loc_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [h_ev_R, h_ev_g1, h_ev_er] with z hz_R hz_g1 hz_er
        by_cases hzz₀ : z = z₀
        · subst hzz₀
          simp [h_reg, hz₀_ZF]
        · have hFz_ne : F z ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← hg1_mul z]
            exact mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hzz₀) hz_g1
          have hz_not_ZF : z ∉ ZF N := fun hm => hFz_ne ((h_mem_ZF N z).mp hm).2
          simp only [h_reg, hz_not_ZF, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hz₀_ZF]
          linear_combination h_rat_id z hzz₀ hz_g1
      · have hz₀_not_ZF : z₀ ∉ ZF N := fun hm => hFz₀ ((h_mem_ZF N z₀).mp hm).2
        have h_all_ne : ∀ b ∈ ZF N, z₀ ≠ b := by
          intro b hb h_eq
          exact hz₀_not_ZF (h_eq ▸ hb)
        have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F z₀ :=
          (hF_holo z₀ hz₀_H).differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀_H)
        have h_loc_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun z => (F z)⁻¹ ^ 2 - ∑ b ∈ ZF N, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z₀ :=
          ((hF_at.inv hFz₀).pow 2).sub (h_sum_pp2_diff (ZF N) z₀ h_all_ne)
        have h_ev_er : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, ∀ b ∈ ZF N, z ≠ b :=
          (Filter.eventually_all_finset (ZF N)).mpr
            (fun b hb => eventually_ne_nhds (h_all_ne b hb))
        refine h_loc_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [h_ev_er] with z hz_ne
        have hz_not_ZF : z ∉ ZF N := fun hm => hz_ne z hm rfl
        simp [h_reg, hz_not_ZF]
    choose H_raw hH_raw_within using
      fun N => (hR_conv N).exists_forall_hasDerivWithinAt (hh_reg_holo N)
    have hH_raw_deriv : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, HasDerivAt (H_raw N) (h_reg N z) z :=
      fun N z hz => (hH_raw_within N z hz).hasDerivAt ((hR_open N).mem_nhds hz)
    let H_norm : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun N z => H_raw N z - H_raw N z_base
    let C0_loc : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun N z => H_norm N z + S_pp N z - S_pp N z_base
    have hH_norm_deriv : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, HasDerivAt (H_norm N) (h_reg N z) z :=
      fun N z hz => (hH_raw_deriv N z hz).sub_const (H_raw N z_base)
    have hC0_loc_deriv : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, F z ≠ 0 →
        HasDerivAt (C0_loc N) ((F z)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
      intro N z hz hFz
      have hz_not_ZF : z ∉ ZF N := fun hm => hFz ((h_mem_ZF N z).mp hm).2
      have hz_ne_b : ∀ b ∈ ZF N, z ≠ b := fun b hb heq => hz_not_ZF (heq ▸ hb)
      have h1 := hH_norm_deriv N z hz
      simp only [h_reg, hz_not_ZF, ↓reduceIte] at h1
      have h2 := h_sum_pp_deriv (ZF N) z hz_ne_b
      have h3 := (h1.add h2).sub_const (S_pp N z_base)
      simpa [C0_loc, S_pp, sub_add_cancel] using h3
    have hC0_compat : ∀ {N M : ℕ}, N ≤ M → ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, F z ≠ 0 →
        C0_loc M z = C0_loc N z := by
      intro N M hNM
      let D_NM : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
        H_norm M z - H_norm N z +
          (∑ b ∈ ZF M \ ZF N, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹) -
          (S_pp M z_base - S_pp N z_base)
      have h_sdiff_ne : ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, ∀ b ∈ ZF M \ ZF N, z ≠ b := by
        intro z hz b hb heq
        subst heq
        obtain ⟨hbM, hb_not_N⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hb
        exact hb_not_N ((h_mem_ZF N z).mpr ⟨(hRK_sub N).1 hz, ((h_mem_ZF M z).mp hbM).2⟩)
      have hD_deriv : ∀ z ∈ R_rect N,
          HasDerivAt D_NM
            (h_reg M z - h_reg N z + ∑ b ∈ ZF M \ ZF N, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
        intro z hz
        exact (((hH_norm_deriv M z ((hRK_mono hNM).1 hz)).sub (hH_norm_deriv N z hz)).add
          (h_sum_pp_deriv (ZF M \ ZF N) z (h_sdiff_ne z hz))).sub_const _
      have hD_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_NM (R_rect N) :=
        fun z hz => (hD_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hD_eq_diff : ∀ z ∈ R_rect N, D_NM z = C0_loc M z - C0_loc N z := by
        intro z _
        have h_sum_eq : S_pp M z - S_pp N z =
            ∑ b ∈ ZF M \ ZF N, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [S_pp]
          rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff (hZF_mono hNM)]
          ring
        dsimp [D_NM, C0_loc]
        linear_combination -h_sum_eq
      have hF_cont_base : ContinuousAt F z_base :=
        (hF_holo z_base ((hRK_sub 0).2 ((hRK_sub 0).1 hz_base_R0))).continuousWithinAt.continuousAt
          (hH_open.mem_nhds ((hRK_sub 0).2 ((hRK_sub 0).1 hz_base_R0)))
      have h_ev_base : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z_base, z ∈ R_rect N ∧ F z ≠ 0 :=
        Filter.inter_mem ((hR_open N).mem_nhds (hz_base_R N))
          (hF_cont_base.eventually_ne hz_base_ne)
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_ball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_ev_base
      have hD_ball_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z_base r₀, D_NM z = 0 := by
        intro z hz_b
        have h_diff_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z_base r₀, DifferentiableAt ℂ D_NM w :=
          fun w hw => (hD_deriv w (hr₀_ball hw).1).differentiableAt
        have h_d0_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z_base r₀, ‖deriv D_NM w‖ ≤ 0 := by
          intro w hw
          obtain ⟨hw_R, hw_F⟩ := hr₀_ball hw
          have hw_not_M : w ∉ ZF M := fun hm => hw_F ((h_mem_ZF M w).mp hm).2
          have hw_not_N : w ∉ ZF N := fun hm => hw_F ((h_mem_ZF N w).mp hm).2
          have hd := (hD_deriv w hw_R).deriv
          simp only [h_reg, hw_not_M, hw_not_N, ↓reduceIte] at hd
          have h_cancel : ((F w)⁻¹ ^ 2 - ∑ b ∈ ZF M, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) -
              ((F w)⁻¹ ^ 2 - ∑ b ∈ ZF N, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹ ^ 2) +
              ∑ b ∈ ZF M \ ZF N, (deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (w - b)⁻¹ ^ 2 = 0 := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff (hZF_mono hNM)]
            ring
          rw [hd, h_cancel, norm_zero]
        have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le h_diff_ball h_d0_ball
          (convex_ball z_base r₀) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos) hz_b
        rw [zero_mul, norm_le_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at h_mvt
        have hD_base : D_NM z_base = 0 := by
          rw [hD_eq_diff z_base (hz_base_R N)]
          simp [C0_loc, H_norm]
        exact h_mvt.trans hD_base
      have hD_ev0 : D_NM =ᶠ[nhds z_base] 0 :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z_base hr₀_pos) hD_ball_zero
      have hD_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ D_NM (R_rect N) := hD_holo.analyticOnNhd (hR_open N)
      intro z hz _
      have hD_z : D_NM z = 0 :=
        hD_an.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq analyticOnNhd_const
          (hR_conv N).isPreconnected (hz_base_R N) hD_ev0 hz
      rw [hD_eq_diff z hz] at hD_z
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hD_z
    let C₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      if hz : z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane then C0_loc (Nat.find (h_exh z hz)) z else 0
    have hC₀_eq_loc : ∀ (N : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ R_rect N → F z ≠ 0 → C₀ z = C0_loc N z := by
      intro N z hz hFz
      have hzH : z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane := (hRK_sub N).2 ((hRK_sub N).1 hz)
      simp only [C₀, hzH, ↓reduceDIte]
      let N₀ : ℕ := Nat.find (h_exh z hzH)
      have hzN₀ : z ∈ R_rect N₀ := Nat.find_spec (h_exh z hzH)
      let K : ℕ := max N N₀
      have h1 : C0_loc K z = C0_loc N₀ z := hC0_compat (le_max_right N N₀) z hzN₀ hFz
      have h2 : C0_loc K z = C0_loc N z := hC0_compat (le_max_left N N₀) z hz hFz
      exact h1.symm.trans h2
    have hC₀_deriv : ∀ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, F z ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt C₀ ((F z)⁻¹ ^ 2) z := by
      intro z₀ hz₀ hFz₀
      obtain ⟨N, hz₀_R⟩ := h_exh z₀ hz₀
      have hF_cont : ContinuousAt F z₀ :=
        (hF_holo z₀ hz₀).continuousWithinAt.continuousAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
      have h_ev : C0_loc N =ᶠ[nhds z₀] C₀ := by
        filter_upwards [(hR_open N).mem_nhds hz₀_R, hF_cont.eventually_ne hFz₀] with z hzR hFz
        exact (hC₀_eq_loc N z hzR hFz).symm
      exact (hC0_loc_deriv N z₀ hz₀_R hFz₀).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev.symm
    refine ⟨C₀, hC₀_deriv, ?_⟩
    intro c
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => if F z = 0 then -(deriv F z)⁻¹ else F z * (C₀ z - c)
    have hG_eq : ∀ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, F z ≠ 0 → G z = F z * (C₀ z - c) := by
      intro z _ hFz
      simp [G, hFz]
    have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G criticalLowerHalfPlane := by
      intro z₀ hz₀
      suffices DifferentiableAt ℂ G z₀ from this.differentiableWithinAt
      by_cases hFz₀ : F z₀ = 0
      · obtain ⟨N, hz₀_R⟩ := h_exh z₀ hz₀
        have hz₀_ZF : z₀ ∈ ZF N := (h_mem_ZF N z₀).mpr ⟨(hRK_sub N).1 hz₀_R, hFz₀⟩
        obtain ⟨hg1_holo, _, hg1_same, hg1_mul, _, _⟩ := h_zero_dslope z₀ hz₀ hFz₀
        have hF1_ne : deriv F z₀ ≠ 0 := (h_zero_simple z₀ hz₀ hFz₀).1
        have hg1_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (g1 z₀) z₀ :=
          (hg1_holo z₀ hz₀).differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
        let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
          H_norm N z + (∑ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹) -
            S_pp N z_base - c
        have hψ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ z₀ := by
          have h_er_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ
              (fun z => ∑ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹) z₀ :=
            (h_sum_pp_deriv ((ZF N).erase z₀) z₀
              (fun b hb => (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hb).symm)).differentiableAt
          exact (((hH_norm_deriv N z₀ hz₀_R).differentiableAt.add h_er_at).sub_const _).sub_const _
        let G_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
          -(deriv F z₀)⁻¹ ^ 2 * g1 z₀ z + (z - z₀) * g1 z₀ z * ψ z
        have hG_loc_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ G_loc z₀ :=
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul hg1_at).add
            (((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const z₀)).mul hg1_at).mul hψ_at)
        have h_ev_R : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, z ∈ R_rect N := (hR_open N).mem_nhds hz₀_R
        have h_ev_g1 : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀, g1 z₀ z ≠ 0 :=
          hg1_at.continuousAt.eventually_ne (by rw [hg1_same]; exact hF1_ne)
        refine hG_loc_at.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [h_ev_R, h_ev_g1] with z hzR hz_g1
        by_cases hzz₀ : z = z₀
        · subst hzz₀
          simp only [G, hFz₀, ↓reduceIte, G_loc, hg1_same, sub_self, zero_mul]
          field_simp [hF1_ne]
          ring
        · have hza_ne : z - z₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hzz₀
          have hFz_ne : F z ≠ 0 := by
            rw [← hg1_mul z]
            exact mul_ne_zero hza_ne hz_g1
          simp only [G, hFz_ne, ↓reduceIte, hC₀_eq_loc N z hzR hFz_ne]
          have hS_split : S_pp N z = -(deriv F z₀)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - z₀)⁻¹ +
              ∑ b ∈ (ZF N).erase z₀, -(deriv F b)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (z - b)⁻¹ := by
            dsimp [S_pp]
            rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hz₀_ZF]
          dsimp [G_loc, ψ, C0_loc]
          rw [← hg1_mul z, hS_split]
          field_simp [hza_ne]
          ring
      · have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F z₀ :=
          (hF_holo z₀ hz₀).differentiableAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
        have hC₀_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ C₀ z₀ := (hC₀_deriv z₀ hz₀ hFz₀).differentiableAt
        have h_prod_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => F z * (C₀ z - c)) z₀ :=
          hF_at.mul (hC₀_at.sub (differentiableAt_const c))
        refine h_prod_at.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hF_at.continuousAt.eventually_ne hFz₀] with z hFz
        simp [G, hFz]
    have hG_nonzero : ∃ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, G z ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_all
      have h_zero_G : ∀ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, G z = 0 := by
        intro z hz; by_contra hne; exact h_all ⟨z, hz, hne⟩
      have hz_base_H : z_base ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane :=
        (hRK_sub 0).2 ((hRK_sub 0).1 hz_base_R0)
      have hF_cont_base : ContinuousAt F z_base :=
        (hF_holo z_base hz_base_H).continuousWithinAt.continuousAt (hH_open.mem_nhds hz_base_H)
      have h_ev_c : C₀ =ᶠ[nhds z_base] (fun _ => c) := by
        filter_upwards [hH_open.mem_nhds hz_base_H, hF_cont_base.eventually_ne hz_base_ne]
          with z hzH hFz
        have hGz := h_zero_G z hzH
        rw [hG_eq z hzH hFz] at hGz
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hGz).resolve_left hFz)
      have h_d0 : HasDerivAt C₀ 0 z_base :=
        (hasDerivAt_const z_base c).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev_c
      have h_dF : HasDerivAt C₀ ((F z_base)⁻¹ ^ 2) z_base :=
        hC₀_deriv z_base hz_base_H hz_base_ne
      have h_eq0 : (F z_base)⁻¹ ^ 2 = 0 := h_dF.unique h_d0
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (inv_ne_zero hz_base_ne) h_eq0
    exact ⟨G, hG_holo, hG_nonzero, hG_eq⟩
  
  have hs2_cross : ∀ (γ σ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []) (hσ : σ ≠ [])
      (X_L X_R Y_bot Y_top : ℝ),
      X_L < X_R → Y_bot < Y_top →
      (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace γ, Y_bot < w.im ∧ w.im < Y_top) →
      (γ.head hγ).re ≤ X_L →
      X_R ≤ (γ.getLast hγ).re →
      (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace σ, X_L < w.re ∧ w.re < X_R) →
      (σ.head hσ).im ≤ Y_bot →
      Y_top ≤ (σ.getLast hσ).im →
      (meshPolyTrace γ ∩ meshPolyTrace σ).Nonempty := by
    intro γ σ hγ hσ X_L X_R Y_bot Y_top _hX hY hγ_im hγ_head hγ_last hσ_re hσ_head hσ_last
    have h_poly_slit_log : ∀ (L : List ℂ) (hL : L ≠ []) (z₀ c₀ : ℂ),

    let z_pt : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => (γ k).head (hγ k)

      linarith [show 6 * Real.exp ((-2 * lam + 3 * η j) * u j) / (1 - Real.exp (-1)) =

    let C_osc : ℝ := 6 / (1 - Real.exp (-1)) + 4

    refine ⟨c_star, C_osc, J₀, hC_osc_pos, ?_⟩
    intro j hj w hw

      · have h1 := (h_level_osc j).2.2 qp_j hqp_σR w hw_σR

          _ ≤ ‖C₀ w - C₀ qp_j‖ + ‖C₀ qp_j - C₀ (z_pt j)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp ((-2 * lam + 3 * η j) * u j) := by linarith
    have h_w_cstar : ‖C₀ w - c_star‖ ≤ C_osc * Real.exp ((-2 * lam + 3 * η j) * u j) := by

    have hη_j : η j ≤ 1 / 8 := hη_le j hj
    have hu_j : 1 ≤ u j := (hu_step j).1
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc ‖F w‖ * ‖C₀ w - c_star‖
