          nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀_deriv, hG_prod⟩ := hs1_ode
  obtain ⟨u, A, B, η, γ, σ_left, σ_right, hγ, hσL, hσR,
    hu_step, hu_top, hAB, hB_zero, hη_pos, hη_anti, hη_zero, hmesh⟩ :=
    hPolyMesh.exists_mesh
  have hu_mono : Monotone u :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun n => by linarith [(hu_step n).2])
  have hA_strictAnti : StrictAnti A :=
    strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt (fun n => by linarith [(hAB (n + 1)).2.1, (hAB n).2.2])
  have h_sub : ∀ j : ℕ,
      meshPolyTrace (γ j) ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane ∧
      meshPolyTrace (σ_left j) ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane ∧
      meshPolyTrace (σ_right j) ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro j
    rcases hmesh j with ⟨hγ_tr, _, _, hσL_tr, _, _, hσR_tr, _⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw

      have hA_pos := (hAB j).1

    · intro w hw
      have hw_im := (hσL_tr w hw).2.2
      change w.im < 0; linarith
    · intro w hw
      have hw_im := (hσR_tr w hw).2.2
      change w.im < 0; linarith
  have h_cross_pair : ∀ j k : ℕ, B k ≤ B j → A (j + 2) ≤ A k →

      (meshPolyTrace (γ k) ∩ meshPolyTrace (σ_right j)).Nonempty := by
    intro j k hBk hAk
    rcases hmesh k with ⟨hγk_tr, hγk_hd, hγk_tl, _⟩
    rcases hmesh j with ⟨_, _, _, hσL_tr, hσL_hd, hσL_tl, hσR_tr, hσR_hd, hσR_tl, _⟩

        (by linarith) (by linarith),

        (by norm_num) (by linarith [(hAB k).2.1]) ?_ (by linarith) (by linarith) ?_
        (by linarith) (by linarith)⟩
    · intro w hw; have h := hγk_tr w hw; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro w hw; have h := hσL_tr w hw; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro w hw; have h := hγk_tr w hw; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro w hw; have h := hσR_tr w hw; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

    intro j

    intro j
    have hj0 := h_cross_pair j j le_rfl (hA_strictAnti.antitone (by omega))

    exact ⟨hj0.1, hj1.1, hj0.2⟩
  obtain ⟨c_star, C_osc, J₀, hC_osc, h_prod_bd⟩ :=
    hs5_tele C₀ u η γ σ_left σ_right hγ hσL hσR

  obtain ⟨G, hG_holo, ⟨z_nz, hz_nz_mem, hz_nz⟩, hG_eq⟩ := hG_prod c_star

    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N_u, hN_u⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Filter.tendsto_atTop.mp hu_top (2 * Real.log (C_osc / ε) + 1))

    have h_cj0 := h_cross_pair j j le_rfl (hA_strictAnti.antitone (by omega))

        hG_holo hz₀_mem hM_nonneg
        (h_sub j).1 (h_sub j).2.2 (h_sub (j + 2)).1 (h_sub j).2.1

  exact hz_nz (hs4_uniq G hG_holo hG_decay z_nz hz_nz_mem)

mesh_primitive_winding_contradiction.definitions:
noncomputable def mpwcPolyIntegral (f : ℂ → ℂ) : List ℂ → ℂ
  | [] => 0
  | [_] => 0
  | a :: b :: rest =>
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), (b - a) * f ((1 - t) • a + t • b)) +
        mpwcPolyIntegral f (b :: rest)

open Classical in
noncomputable def mpwcPolyPrefixTo :
    (L : List ℂ) → L ≠ [] → (p : ℂ) → p ∈ meshPolyTrace L → List ℂ
  | [], hL, _, _ => absurd rfl hL
  | [_], _, p, _ => [p]
  | a :: b :: rest, _, p, hp =>
      if hseg : p ∈ segment ℝ a b then [a, p]
      else a :: mpwcPolyPrefixTo (b :: rest) (List.cons_ne_nil b rest) p (hp.resolve_left hseg)

signature.name: log_deficit_transfer_estimates
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S) :
    LogDeficitTransferPackage S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hPot : LdtTruncPotentialToolkit S := by
    classical
    have h_open_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have h_cont_on : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
        ContinuousOn (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) (horizStrip S.H) := by
      intro K m
      have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_pos (by norm_num) m
      have hnf : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => ‖S.f z‖) (horizStrip S.H) :=
        continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.f_holo.continuousOn
      have hmax_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)) (horizStrip S.H) :=
        hnf.sup continuousOn_const
      have hlog_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)))
          (horizStrip S.H) :=
        ContinuousOn.log hmax_cont (fun z _ => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hpow_pos (le_max_right _ _)))
      exact continuousOn_const.sub hlog_cont
    have h_periodic : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        ldtTruncDeficit S K m (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z := by
      intro K m z hz
      simp only [ldtTruncDeficit, S.f_periodic z hz]
    have h_conj_symm : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        ldtTruncDeficit S K m (starRingEnd ℂ z) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z := by
      intro K m z hz
      simp only [ldtTruncDeficit, S.f_conj z hz, Complex.norm_conj]
    have h_nonneg_of_norm_le : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
        0 ≤ K → ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K → 0 ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z := by
      intro K m z hK hnorm
      have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_pos (by norm_num) m
      have hpow_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ Real.exp K := by
        have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp K := Real.one_le_exp hK
        linarith
      have hmax_pos : 0 < max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hpow_pos (le_max_right _ _)
      have hmax_le : max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ≤ Real.exp K := max_le hnorm hpow_le
      have hlog_le : Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)) ≤ K :=
        (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hmax_pos).mpr hmax_le
      dsimp [ldtTruncDeficit]
      linarith
    have h_le_of_exp_sub_le : ∀ (K D : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
        Real.exp (K - D) ≤ ‖S.f z‖ → ldtTruncDeficit S K m z ≤ D := by
      intro K D m z hexp
      have hmax_ge : Real.exp (K - D) ≤ max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
        le_trans hexp (le_max_left _ _)
      have hmax_pos : 0 < max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hmax_ge
      have hlog_ge : K - D ≤ Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)) :=
        (Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hmax_pos).mpr hmax_ge
      dsimp [ldtTruncDeficit]
      linarith
    have h_monotone_trunc : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
        Monotone (fun m : ℕ => ldtTruncDeficit S K m z) := by
      intro K z m₁ m₂ hm
      have hpow_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₂ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₁ :=
        pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hm
      have hmax_pos : 0 < max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (by norm_num) m₂) (le_max_right _ _)
      have hmax_le : max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₂) ≤ max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₁) :=
        max_le_max_left ‖S.f z‖ hpow_le
      have hlog_le : Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₂)) ≤
          Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m₁)) :=
        Real.log_le_log hmax_pos hmax_le
      dsimp [ldtTruncDeficit]
      linarith
    have h_ofReal_le : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
        ENNReal.ofReal (K - Real.log ‖S.f z‖) ≤
          ⨆ m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ldtTruncDeficit S K m z) := by
      intro K z
      by_cases hfz : S.f z = 0
      · have h0 : ldtTruncDeficit S K 0 z = K - Real.log ‖S.f z‖ := by
          simp [ldtTruncDeficit, hfz]
        rw [← h0]
        exact le_iSup (fun m : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (ldtTruncDeficit S K m z)) 0
      · have hpos : 0 < ‖S.f z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfz
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hpos (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
        have hm_eq : ldtTruncDeficit S K m z = K - Real.log ‖S.f z‖ := by
          simp only [ldtTruncDeficit, max_eq_left (le_of_lt hm)]
        rw [← hm_eq]
        exact le_iSup (fun n : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (ldtTruncDeficit S K n z)) m
    have h_circle_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
        0 < r → Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
        Real.circleAverage (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) z₀ r ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀ := by
      intro K m z₀ r hr hcb
      let w_m : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m))
      have hw_cont : ContinuousOn w_m (horizStrip S.H) := by
        have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_pos (by norm_num) m
        have hnf : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => ‖S.f z‖) (horizStrip S.H) :=
          continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.f_holo.continuousOn
        exact ContinuousOn.log (hnf.sup continuousOn_const)
          (fun z _ => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hpow_pos (le_max_right _ _)))
      have hw_cint : CircleIntegrable w_m z₀ r :=
        (hw_cont.mono (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall.trans hcb)).circleIntegrable hr.le
      have hc_cint : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => K) z₀ r :=
        continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable hr.le
      have hdef_eq : ldtTruncDeficit S K m = (fun _ : ℂ => K) - w_m := rfl
      rw [hdef_eq, Real.circleAverage_sub hc_cint hw_cint, Real.circleAverage_const]
      change K - Real.circleAverage w_m z₀ r ≤ K - w_m z₀
      suffices h_sub : w_m z₀ ≤ Real.circleAverage w_m z₀ r by linarith
      rcases le_or_gt ‖S.f z₀‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) with hle | hgt
      · have hwz₀ : w_m z₀ = Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
          dsimp [w_m]
          rw [max_eq_right hle]
        rw [hwz₀, ← Real.circleAverage_const (Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)) z₀ r]
        apply Real.circleAverage_mono (continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable hr.le) hw_cint
        intro x _
        dsimp [w_m]
        exact Real.log_le_log (pow_pos (by norm_num) m) (le_max_right _ _)
      · have hpow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_pos (by norm_num) m
        have hfz₀_pos : 0 < ‖S.f z₀‖ := lt_trans hpow_pos hgt
        have hfz₀_ne : S.f z₀ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hfz₀_pos
        have hwz₀ : w_m z₀ = Real.log ‖S.f z₀‖ := by
          dsimp [w_m]
          rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt hgt)]
        rw [hwz₀]
        have habs_r : |r| = r := abs_of_pos hr
        have hf_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S.f (horizStrip S.H) :=
          S.f_holo.analyticOnNhd h_open_strip
        have hf_an_cb : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|) :=
          hf_an.mono (by rw [habs_r]; exact hcb)
        have hf_mero_cb : MeromorphicOn S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|) :=
          hf_an_cb.meromorphicOn
        have hjensen := MeromorphicOn.circleAverage_log_norm hr.ne' hf_mero_cb
        have hz₀_cb : z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ |r| :=
          Metric.mem_closedBall_self (abs_nonneg r)
        have han_z₀ : AnalyticAt ℂ S.f z₀ := hf_an_cb z₀ hz₀_cb
        have htrail : meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt S.f z₀ = S.f z₀ :=
          han_z₀.meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt_of_ne_zero hfz₀_ne
        have hord_z₀ : meromorphicOrderAt S.f z₀ = 0 :=
          han_z₀.meromorphicNFAt.meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero_iff.mpr hfz₀_ne
        have hdiv_z₀ : (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)) z₀ = 0 := by
          rw [MeromorphicOn.divisor_apply hf_mero_cb hz₀_cb, hord_z₀]
          rfl
        have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ (u : ℂ),
            ↑((MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)) u) *
              Real.log (r * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹) := by
          apply finsum_nonneg
          intro u
          by_cases hu_cb : u ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|
          · by_cases huz : u = z₀
            · subst huz
              simp [hdiv_z₀]
            · have hdiv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)) u :=
                MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_nonneg hf_an_cb u
              have hdiv_cast : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ↑((MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)) u) :=
                by exact_mod_cast hdiv_nonneg
              have hdist_pos : 0 < ‖z₀ - u‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr (Ne.symm huz)
              have hdist_le : ‖z₀ - u‖ ≤ r := by
                rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, habs_r, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hu_cb
                exact hu_cb
              have hratio_ge : 1 ≤ r * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹ := by
                rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, one_le_div hdist_pos]
                exact hdist_le
              exact mul_nonneg hdiv_cast (Real.log_nonneg hratio_ge)
          · have hdiv_zero : (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)) u = 0 :=
              (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.f (Metric.closedBall z₀ |r|)).apply_eq_zero_of_notMem hu_cb
            simp [hdiv_zero]
        have hjensen_ge : Real.log ‖S.f z₀‖ ≤
            Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖S.f x‖) z₀ r := by
          rw [hjensen, hdiv_z₀, htrail]
          simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
          linarith
        let Z_cb : Set ℂ := { w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r | S.f w = 0 }
        have hZ_cb_fin : Z_cb.Finite := by
          have hloc : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r,
              ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ (Metric.ball w δ ∩ Z_cb).Finite := by
            intro w hw
            by_cases hfw : S.f w = 0
            · have hderiv_ne : deriv S.f w ≠ 0 := (S.f_simple_zeros w (hcb hw) hfw).1
              have hdiff_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.f w := (hf_an w (hcb hw)).differentiableAt
              have hd_pos : 0 < ‖deriv S.f w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hderiv_ne
              have hev := hdiff_at.hasDerivAt.isLittleO.bound (half_pos hd_pos)
              rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hev
              obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hev
              refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, (Set.finite_singleton w).subset ?_⟩
              rintro z ⟨hz_ball, _, hfz⟩
              by_contra hzw
              have hzw_pos : 0 < ‖z - w‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr hzw
              have hbound := hδ hz_ball
              simp only [hfz, hfw, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, zero_sub, norm_neg, norm_mul] at hbound
              nlinarith
            · have hcont_at : ContinuousAt S.f w := (hf_an w (hcb hw)).continuousAt
              have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds w, S.f z ≠ 0 := hcont_at.eventually_ne hfw
              rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hev
              obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hev
              refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, Set.finite_empty.subset ?_⟩
              rintro z ⟨hz_ball, _, hfz⟩
              exact (hδ hz_ball hfz).elim
          choose δ hδ_pos hδ_fin using hloc
          have hcov : Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆
              ⋃ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r,
                Metric.ball w (if h : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r then δ w h else 1) := by
            intro w hw
            refine Set.mem_biUnion hw ?_
            rw [dif_pos hw]
            exact Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_pos w hw)
          obtain ⟨F, hF_sub, hF_fin, hF_cov⟩ :=
            IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover_image (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)
              (fun w _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcov
          have hZ_sub : Z_cb ⊆ ⋃ w ∈ F,
              (Metric.ball w (if h : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r then δ w h else 1) ∩ Z_cb) := by
            intro z hz
            have hz_cov := hF_cov hz.1
            rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hz_cov ⊢
            obtain ⟨w, hwF, hzw⟩ := hz_cov
            exact ⟨w, hwF, hzw, hz⟩
          refine (hF_fin.biUnion ?_).subset hZ_sub
          intro w hwF
          have hw_cb : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r := hF_sub hwF
          rw [dif_pos hw_cb]
          exact hδ_fin w hw_cb
        let Z_Ico : Set ℝ := Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∩ (circleMap z₀ r) ⁻¹' Z_cb
        have hinj_Ico : Set.InjOn (circleMap z₀ r) (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
          intro θ₁ hθ₁ θ₂ hθ₂ heq
          have hexp_eq : Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Complex.exp ((θ₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
            dsimp [circleMap] at heq
            have hmul : (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
                (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := add_left_cancel heq
            exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne') hmul
          rw [Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int] at hexp_eq
          obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hexp_eq
          have him := congr_arg Complex.im hn
          simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero, Complex.add_im,
            Complex.intCast_re, Complex.intCast_im, zero_mul, Complex.re_ofNat,
            Complex.im_ofNat] at him
          have hpi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
          have hn_gt : (-1 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
            nlinarith [hθ₁.1, hθ₁.2, hθ₂.1, hθ₂.2]
          have hn_lt : (n : ℝ) < 1 := by
            nlinarith [hθ₁.1, hθ₁.2, hθ₂.1, hθ₂.2]
          have hn_gt_int : (-1 : ℤ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn_gt
          have hn_lt_int : n < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn_lt
          have hn_zero : n = 0 := by omega
          subst hn_zero
          push_cast at him
          linarith
        have hZ_Ico_fin : Z_Ico.Finite := by
          refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (hZ_cb_fin.subset ?_)
            (hinj_Ico.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
          rintro _ ⟨θ, ⟨_, hθ_cb⟩, rfl⟩
          exact hθ_cb
        let Z_θ : Set ℝ := { θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) | S.f (circleMap z₀ r θ) = 0 }
        have hZ_θ_fin : Z_θ.Finite := by
          refine (hZ_Ico_fin.union (Set.finite_singleton (2 * Real.pi))).subset ?_
          intro θ ⟨hθ_Icc, hθ_zero⟩
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hθ_Icc.2 with rfl | hlt
          · exact Or.inr rfl
          · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨hθ_Icc.1, hlt⟩, ?_⟩
            exact ⟨Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere z₀ hr.le θ), hθ_zero⟩
        have hf_mero_sph : MeromorphicOn S.f (Metric.sphere z₀ |r|) :=
          fun z hz => hf_mero_cb z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
        have hlog_cint : CircleIntegrable (fun x => Real.log ‖S.f x‖) z₀ r :=
          MeromorphicOn.circleIntegrable_log_norm hf_mero_sph
        have hae_le : (fun θ => Real.log ‖S.f (circleMap z₀ r θ)‖) ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi))]
            (fun θ => w_m (circleMap z₀ r θ)) := by
          rw [Filter.EventuallyLE, MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc]
          have hnull : Z_θᶜ ∈ MeasureTheory.ae MeasureTheory.volume := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.mem_ae_iff, compl_compl]
            exact hZ_θ_fin.measure_zero MeasureTheory.volume
          filter_upwards [hnull] with θ hθ_not hθ_Icc
          have hne : S.f (circleMap z₀ r θ) ≠ 0 := by
            intro hzero
            exact hθ_not ⟨hθ_Icc, hzero⟩
          dsimp [w_m]
          exact Real.log_le_log (norm_pos_iff.mpr hne) (le_max_left _ _)
        have hint_le : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.log ‖S.f (circleMap z₀ r θ)‖) ≤
            (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w_m (circleMap z₀ r θ)) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict (by positivity) hlog_cint hw_cint hae_le
        have hcavg_le : Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖S.f x‖) z₀ r ≤
            Real.circleAverage w_m z₀ r := by
          rw [Real.circleAverage_def, Real.circleAverage_def]
          simp only [smul_eq_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint_le (by positivity)
        exact le_trans hjensen_ge hcavg_le
    have h_ball_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (R : ℝ),
        0 < R → Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
        (Real.pi * R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, ldtTruncDeficit S K m w) ≤
          ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀ := by
      intro K m z₀ R hR hcb
      let g : ℂ → ℝ := ldtTruncDeficit S K m
      have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g (Metric.closedBall z₀ R) :=
        (h_cont_on K m).mono hcb
      have hshift : (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, g w) = (∫ u in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, g (z₀ + u)) := by
        have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
          (fun w : ℂ => (Metric.ball z₀ R).indicator g w) z₀
        simp only [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_ball] at *
        rw [← h1]
        congr 1
        ext u
        by_cases hu : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
        · have hzu : z₀ + u ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left]
            simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
          simp [hu, hzu]
        · have hzu : z₀ + u ∉ Metric.ball z₀ R := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left]
            simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
          simp [hu, hzu]
      have hpolar := Complex.integral_comp_polarCoord_symm
        (fun u : ℂ => (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R).indicator (fun w => g (z₀ + w)) u)
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_ball] at hpolar
      rw [hshift, ← hpolar, polarCoord_target]
      have hind_eq : Set.EqOn
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 • (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R).indicator (fun w => g (z₀ + w))
            (Complex.polarCoord.symm p))
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi).indicator
            (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * g (circleMap z₀ q.1 q.2)) p)
          (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
        intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
        have h_symm_zero : (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) =
            (p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          apply Complex.ext <;>
            simp [Complex.polarCoord, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
        have h_symm_eq : z₀ + (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) = circleMap z₀ p.1 p.2 := by
          rw [h_symm_zero]; rfl
        have h_norm_symm : ‖(Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ)‖ = p.1 := by
          rw [h_symm_zero, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hp1,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
        by_cases hpR : p.1 < R
        · have hmem_ball : (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by

    have hcb_strip_and_norm : ∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x : ℝ,
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n,
          z ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧ ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K_top := by
      intro c hc x z hz
      let u : ℂ := z - ((x : ℂ) + c)
      have hu_cb : u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) Δ_n := by
        dsimp [u]
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      obtain ⟨hδ_lo, hδ_hi, _⟩ := h_center_geom c hc u hu_cb
      have hz_im : z.im = (c + u).im := by dsimp [u]; simp
      have hzim_lo : 0 ≤ z.im := by rw [hz_im]; linarith [S.H_pos]
      have hzim_hi : z.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(k_n + C_margin)) := by rw [hz_im]; linarith
      have hzim_lt : z.im < S.H := by
        have : 0 < Real.exp (-(k_n + C_margin)) := Real.exp_pos _
        linarith
      refine ⟨?_, hf_slab z hzim_lo hzim_hi⟩
      change |z.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hzim_lo]
      exact hzim_lt
    let q_pt : ℝ → ℂ → ℝ := fun x Z =>
      d_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z)‖
    let F_sup : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sSup ((q_pt x) '' K)
    have hq_pt_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => q_pt p.1 p.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ K) := by
      have hmap : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ =>
          (p.1 : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * p.2) := by fun_prop
      refine continuousOn_const.mul ((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_norm).comp_continuousOn
        (S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn ?_))
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨Z_l, hZl_SK, hZ_ball⟩ := hSK_cov p.2 hp.2
      have hc_mem : c_of Z_l ∈ centers := Finset.mem_image_of_mem c_of hZl_SK
      have hz_cb : (p.1 : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * p.2 ∈
          Metric.closedBall ((p.1 : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) Δ_n := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hZ_ball
        have hsub : ((p.1 : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * p.2) -
            ((p.1 : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) = (d_n : ℂ) * (p.2 - Z_l) := by
          dsimp [c_of]; ring
        rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdn_pos]
        dsimp [Δ_n]
        nlinarith [hr_Z_pos]
      exact (hcb_strip_and_norm (c_of Z_l) hc_mem p.1 _ hz_cb).1
    have hq_x_bdd : ∀ x : ℝ, BddAbove ((q_pt x) '' K) := by
      intro x
      have hc : ContinuousOn (q_pt x) K :=
        hq_pt_cont.comp (continuousOn_const.prodMk continuousOn_id) (fun Z hZ => ⟨trivial, hZ⟩)
      exact hK_comp.bddAbove_image hc
    have hF_sup_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ F_sup x := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨Z₀, hZ₀⟩ := hK_ne
      have h0 : 0 ≤ q_pt x Z₀ := by dsimp [q_pt]; positivity
      exact h0.trans (le_csSup (hq_x_bdd x) ⟨Z₀, hZ₀, rfl⟩)
    have hF_sup_cont : Continuous F_sup := by
      refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x₀ => ?_
      let I_loc : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (x₀ - 1) (x₀ + 1)
      have hunif := (isCompact_Icc.prod hK_comp).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous
        (hq_pt_cont.mono (Set.prod_mono (Set.subset_univ I_loc) (Subset.refl K)))
      rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hunif
      rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ_c, hδ_c_pos, hδ_c⟩ := hunif (ε / 2) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨min 1 δ_c, lt_min zero_lt_one hδ_c_pos, ?_⟩
      intro x hx_dist
      have hx_I : x ∈ I_loc := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hx_dist
        have hlt1 : |x - x₀| < 1 := hx_dist.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
        rw [abs_lt] at hlt1
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hx₀_I : x₀ ∈ I_loc := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hd_lt : dist x x₀ < δ_c := hx_dist.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
      have hle1 : F_sup x ≤ F_sup x₀ + ε / 2 := by
        refine csSup_le (hK_ne.image _) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
        have hd_p : dist (x, Z) (x₀, Z) < δ_c := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_left dist_nonneg]; exact hd_lt
        have hdiff := (hδ_c (x, Z) ⟨hx_I, hZ⟩ (x₀, Z) ⟨hx₀_I, hZ⟩ hd_p).le
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdiff
        have h_le_sup : q_pt x₀ Z ≤ F_sup x₀ := le_csSup (hq_x_bdd x₀) ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hdiff).2]
      have hle2 : F_sup x₀ ≤ F_sup x + ε / 2 := by
        refine csSup_le (hK_ne.image _) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
        have hd_p : dist (x, Z) (x₀, Z) < δ_c := by
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_left dist_nonneg]; exact hd_lt
        have hdiff := (hδ_c (x, Z) ⟨hx_I, hZ⟩ (x₀, Z) ⟨hx₀_I, hZ⟩ hd_p).le
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdiff
        have h_le_sup : q_pt x Z ≤ F_sup x := le_csSup (hq_x_bdd x) ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hdiff).1]
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hF_sup_le_sum : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        F_sup x ≤ (C_def / r_Z) * ∑ c ∈ centers,
          (1 + (Real.pi * Δ_n ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖)) := by
      intro x _
      have hterm_nn : ∀ c ∈ centers,
          0 ≤ 1 + (Real.pi * Δ_n ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖) := by
        intro c hc
        have hint_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖) := by
          refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_ball fun w' hw' => ?_
          by_cases hfw : S.f w' = 0
          · simp [hfw, hK_top]
          · have hnorm := (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x w' (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw')).2
            linarith [(Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (norm_pos_iff.mpr hfw)).mpr hnorm]
        exact add_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hint_nn)
      refine csSup_le (hK_ne.image _) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨Z_l, hZl_SK, hZ_ball⟩ := hSK_cov Z hZ
      have hc_mem : c_of Z_l ∈ centers := Finset.mem_image_of_mem c_of hZl_SK
      have hz_in_qtr : (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z ∈
          Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) (Δ_n / 4) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hZ_ball ⊢
        have hsub : ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z) -
            ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) = (d_n : ℂ) * (Z - Z_l) := by
          dsimp [c_of]; ring
        rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdn_pos]
        dsimp [Δ_n]
        calc d_n * ‖Z - Z_l‖ < d_n * (r_Z / 4) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hZ_ball hdn_pos
          _ = d_n * r_Z / 4 := by ring
      have hq_bd := (h_def ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) Δ_n K_top hΔ_n_pos
        (fun z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm (c_of Z_l) hc_mem x z hz).1)
        (fun z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm (c_of Z_l) hc_mem x z hz).2)).2 _ hz_in_qtr
      have hsingle_le := Finset.single_le_sum hterm_nn hc_mem
      have hdiv_le : q_pt x Z ≤ (C_def / r_Z) *
          (1 + (Real.pi * Δ_n ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖)) := by
        dsimp [q_pt]
        have h1 : r_Z * (d_n *
            Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z)‖) =
            Δ_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z)‖ := by
          dsimp [Δ_n]; ring
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_bd (inv_nonneg.mpr hr_Z_pos.le)
        rw [← h1] at hmul
        calc d_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z)‖
            = r_Z⁻¹ * (r_Z * (d_n *
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_n : ℂ) * Z)‖)) := by
              field_simp [hr_Z_pos.ne']
          _ ≤ r_Z⁻¹ * (C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ_n ^ 2)⁻¹ *
                ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖))) := hmul
          _ = (C_def / r_Z) * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ_n ^ 2)⁻¹ *
                ∫ w' in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c_of Z_l) Δ_n, (K_top - Real.log ‖S.f w'‖)) := by
              ring
      exact hdiv_le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsingle_le (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨hρ_cont, hρ_per, hρ_nn, hρ_unit, hρ_shift⟩ :=
      hρ_props d_a w hda_pos hw_cont hw_per hw_nn hw_unit
    let B_row : ℝ := 16 * D_a + 16 * C₁ * d_a * (1 + K_top)
    have hB_row_nn : 0 ≤ B_row := by dsimp [B_row]; positivity
    have h_row_shifted : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Δ_n,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x : ℂ) + c + u) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) ≤ B_row := by
      intro m c hc u hu
      obtain ⟨hδ_lo, hδ_hi, hh_abs⟩ := h_center_geom c hc u (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hu)
      let δ_u : ℝ := S.H - (c + u).im
      let h_u : ℝ := (c + u).re
      have hδ_u_pos : 0 < δ_u := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hδ_lo
      have hU_nn_x : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x : ℂ) + c + u) := by
        intro x
        have hcb_x : (x : ℂ) + c + u ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self_add_left]
          exact le_of_lt (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu)
        exact hPot.nonneg_of_norm_le K_top m _ hK_top
          (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x _ hcb_x).2
      have h1_int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun x => ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x : ℂ) + c + u) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        have hmap : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) + c + u) := by fun_prop
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x : ℂ) + c + u)) :=
          (hPot.cont_on K_top m).comp_continuous hmap fun x => by
            refine (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x _ ?_).1
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self_add_left]
            exact le_of_lt (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu)
        exact (hc1.mul hρ_cont).intervalIntegrable _ _
      let prod_row : ℝ → ℝ := fun x' =>
        ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x'
      have hprod_cont : Continuous prod_row := by
        have hmap : Continuous (fun x' : ℝ =>
            (x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by fun_prop
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun x' : ℝ =>
            ldtTruncDeficit S K_top m ((x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          (hPot.cont_on K_top m).comp_continuous hmap fun x' => by
            change |((x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
            simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
              Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
            rw [abs_lt]
            exact ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith⟩
        exact hc1.mul hρ_cont
      have hprod_per : Function.Periodic prod_row (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro x'
        dsimp [prod_row]
        have heq : (((x' + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
            ((x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
        have hmem : (x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          change |((x' : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
          simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
            Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, abs_lt]
          exact ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith⟩
        rw [heq, hPot.periodic K_top m _ hmem, hρ_per x']
      have h2_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => 4 * prod_row (x + h_u))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        ((hprod_cont.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).const_mul 4).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hmono_sh := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h1_int h2_int fun x _ => by
        have hpt_eq : (x : ℂ) + c + u =
            ((x + h_u : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ_u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h_u, δ_u, add_assoc]
        have hsh_x := hρ_shift x h_u hh_abs
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsh_x (hU_nn_x x)
        dsimp [prod_row]
        rw [← hpt_eq]
        linarith
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, h_per_shift prod_row h_u hprod_per] at hmono_sh
      have hcyl := h_cyl_minorant m k_a K_top D_a δ_u w hk₀_le_ka hδ_u_pos hδ_hi hK_top hD_a
        hw_cont hw_per hw_nn hw_unit
        (fun z hz0 hzH => hf_slab z hz0 (by linarith))
        hf_anc
      have hmul_2pi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono_sh (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
      dsimp [prod_row, B_row] at hmul_2pi hcyl ⊢
      linarith
    have hw_final := hRow.weighted_shifted_balls_bound F_sup (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w)
      centers Δ_n K_top (C_def / r_Z) B_row
      hF_sup_cont hρ_cont hF_sup_nn hρ_nn hΔ_n_pos hK_top (by positivity) hB_row_nn
      (fun c hc x _ z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x z hz).1)
      (fun c hc x _ z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x z hz).2)
      (fun c hc x _ => (h_def ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ_n K_top hΔ_n_pos
        (fun z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x z hz).1)
        (fun z hz => (hcb_strip_and_norm c hc x z hz).2)).1)
      hF_sup_le_sum h_row_shifted
    rw [hρ_unit] at hw_final
    have hcard_1 : (centers.card : ℝ) ≤ (S_K.card : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have hbracket : 1 + B_row ≤ (17 + 16 * C₁) * (1 + D_a + d_a * (1 + K_top)) := by
      dsimp [B_row]
      nlinarith [hD_a, hC₁_pos, hda_pos, hK_top]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          F_sup x * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x)
        ≤ (C_def / r_Z) * (centers.card : ℝ) * (1 + B_row) := hw_final
      _ ≤ (C_def / r_Z) * ((S_K.card : ℝ) + 1) *
          ((17 + 16 * C₁) * (1 + D_a + d_a * (1 + K_top))) := by
          have h1 : (C_def / r_Z) * (centers.card : ℝ) ≤
              (C_def / r_Z) * ((S_K.card : ℝ) + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcard_1 (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_mul h1 hbracket (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = C_har * (1 + D_a + d_a * (1 + K_top)) := by dsimp [C_har]; ring
  exact {
    sqrt_q_first_moment := hRow.sqrt_q_first_moment
    disk_chain_q_bound := hChain
    poisson_q_bound := hPoiss
  }

log_deficit_transfer_estimates.definitions:
noncomputable def ldtTruncDeficit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  K - Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m))

structure LdtTruncPotentialToolkit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  cont_on : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ),
    ContinuousOn (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) (horizStrip S.H)
  periodic : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ldtTruncDeficit S K m (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  conj_symm : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ldtTruncDeficit S K m (starRingEnd ℂ z) = ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  nonneg_of_norm_le : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    0 ≤ K → ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K → 0 ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z
  le_of_exp_sub_le : ∀ (K D : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    Real.exp (K - D) ≤ ‖S.f z‖ → ldtTruncDeficit S K m z ≤ D
  monotone_trunc : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
    Monotone (fun m : ℕ => ldtTruncDeficit S K m z)
  ofReal_deficit_le_iSup_trunc : ∀ (K : ℝ) (z : ℂ),
    ENNReal.ofReal (K - Real.log ‖S.f z‖) ≤
      ⨆ m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ldtTruncDeficit S K m z)
  circle_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
    0 < r → Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    Real.circleAverage (ldtTruncDeficit S K m) z₀ r ≤ ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀
  ball_supermean : ∀ (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ) (R : ℝ),
    0 < R → Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    (Real.pi * R ^ 2)⁻¹ * (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, ldtTruncDeficit S K m w) ≤
      ldtTruncDeficit S K m z₀
  ball_deficit_le_of_trunc_le : ∀ (K B : ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ) (Δ : ℝ),
    0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ B → 0 < Δ →
    Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)
      (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume →
    (∀ m : ℕ, (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, ldtTruncDeficit S K m w) ≤ B) →
    (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)) ≤ B
  slab_max_principle : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℝ),
    a < b →
    ContinuousOn Φ { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ b } →
    (∀ z : ℂ, a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → Φ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = Φ z) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, Φ ((x : ℂ) + (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤ 0 ∧
      Φ ((x : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤ 0) →
    (∀ z₀ : ℂ, a < z₀.im → z₀.im < b →
      ∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₀ →
        Φ z₀ ≤ Real.circleAverage Φ z₀ r) →
    ∀ z : ℂ, a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → Φ z ≤ 0

structure LdtRowAndMomentData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  row_mean_bound : ∃ C_row : ℝ, 0 < C_row ∧
    ∀ (K y : ℝ) (m : ℕ), |y| < S.H →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        ldtTruncDeficit S K m ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤ K + C_row
  weighted_shifted_balls_bound :
    ∀ (F ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (centers : Finset ℂ) (Δ K C₀ B_row : ℝ),
      Continuous F → Continuous ρ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ F x) → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ρ x) →
      0 < Δ → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ B_row →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H) →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
      (∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖)
          (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ) MeasureTheory.volume) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        F x ≤ C₀ * ∑ c ∈ centers,
          (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + c) Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖))) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ c ∈ centers, ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Δ,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ldtTruncDeficit S K m ((x : ℂ) + c + u) * ρ x) ≤ B_row) →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x * ρ x) ≤
        C₀ * (centers.card : ℝ) *
          ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ x) + B_row)
  sqrt_q_first_moment :
    ∃ C_q : ℝ, 0 < C_q ∧
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
          C_q * (1 + k)

proof.tactics:
by
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := le_max_left 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
  have hk₀_ge_log : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
  have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
  have h2pi_ne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
  have hexp_k₀_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have hH20 : 0 < S.H / 20 := by linarith
    calc Real.exp (-k₀)
        ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log hH20
  have hexp_k_le : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    intro k hk
    exact le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hexp_k₀_le
  have h_row_re_im : ∀ k x : ℝ,
      (upperRowPt S k x).re = x ∧ (upperRowPt S k x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k) := by
    intro k x
    dsimp [upperRowPt]
    constructor <;>
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero,
        zero_add]
  have h_row_mem : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ, upperRowPt S k x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro k hk x
    have hk_le := hexp_k_le k hk
    have hk_pos := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    change |(upperRowPt S k x).im| < S.H
    rw [(h_row_re_im k x).2, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have h_f_row_cont : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖) := by
    intro k hk
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => upperRowPt S k x) := by
      dsimp [upperRowPt]; fun_prop
    exact (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (h_row_mem k hk)).norm
  have h_q_row_cont : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖S.q (upperRowPt S k x)‖) := by
    intro k hk
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => upperRowPt S k x) := by
      dsimp [upperRowPt]; fun_prop
    exact (S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (h_row_mem k hk)).norm
  have h_mod_row_cont : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => shapeModulus S (upperRowPt S k x)) := by
    intro k hk
    exact (h_f_row_cont k hk).max (h_q_row_cont k hk).sqrt
  have h_Vim_row_cont : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => |(S.V (upperRowPt S k x)).im|) := by
    intro k hk
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => upperRowPt S k x) := by
      dsimp [upperRowPt]; fun_prop
    exact continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp
      (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (h_row_mem k hk)))
  have h_rowMomentF_cont : ContinuousOn (rowMomentF S) (Set.Ici k₀) := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    let Ψ : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => upperRowPt S (p.1 : ℝ) p.2
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ := by dsimp [Ψ, upperRowPt]; fun_prop
    have hΨ_mem : ∀ p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ, Ψ p ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
      fun p => h_row_mem (p.1 : ℝ) p.1.2 p.2
    have hf2_cont : Continuous (fun p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ^ 2) :=
      ((S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem).norm).pow 2
    have hint_cont : Continuous (fun k : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) =>
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖S.f (upperRowPt S (k : ℝ) x)‖ ^ 2) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf2_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hexp_cont : Continuous (fun k : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) => Real.exp (-(k : ℝ))) := by fun_prop
    exact hexp_cont.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul hint_cont))
  have h_rowMomentFull_cont : ContinuousOn (rowMomentFull S) (Set.Ici k₀) := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    let Ψ : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => upperRowPt S (p.1 : ℝ) p.2
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ := by dsimp [Ψ, upperRowPt]; fun_prop
    have hΨ_mem : ∀ p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ, Ψ p ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
      fun p => h_row_mem (p.1 : ℝ) p.1.2 p.2
    have hfq_cont : Continuous (fun p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ p)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Ψ p)‖) :=
      (((S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem).norm).pow 2).add
        ((S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem).norm)
    have hint_cont : Continuous (fun k : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) =>
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (upperRowPt S (k : ℝ) x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S (k : ℝ) x)‖)) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hfq_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hexp_cont : Continuous (fun k : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) => Real.exp (-(k : ℝ))) := by fun_prop
    exact hexp_cont.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul hint_cont))
  have h_rowMomentF_nonneg : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 ≤ rowMomentF S k :=
    fun k => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-k))) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h_rowMomentFull_nonneg : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 ≤ rowMomentFull S k :=
    fun k => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-k))) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h_rowMomentF_le_Full : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → rowMomentF S k ≤ rowMomentFull S k := by
    intro k hk
    dsimp [rowMomentF, rowMomentFull]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-k)))
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
    · exact ((h_f_row_cont k hk).pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (((h_f_row_cont k hk).pow 2).add (h_q_row_cont k hk)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · intro x _
      linarith [norm_nonneg (S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))]
  have h_upper_growth : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K_ub : ℝ, k₀ ≤ K_ub ∧
      ∀ j : ℝ, K_ub ≤ j → rowMomentFull S j ≤ 2 * Real.exp (ε * j) := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨K₀_ub, hK₀_ub⟩ := hCrit.critical_upper_bound ε hε
    refine ⟨max k₀ K₀_ub, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    have hj_k₀ : k₀ ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hj
    have hj_K₀ : K₀_ub ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hj
    have hexp_lt_H : Real.exp (-j) < S.H := by linarith [hexp_k_le j hj_k₀]
    have hpt_le : ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ≤
          (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      have hmod := hK₀_ub j hj_K₀ hexp_lt_H x
      have hf_le : ‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j) :=
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hmod
      have hq_sqrt_le : Real.sqrt ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j) :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hmod
      have hf_sq : ‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hf_le 2
      have hq_le : ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ≤ (Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖
            = (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)).symm
          _ ≤ (Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hq_sqrt_le 2
      nlinarith
    have hint_le : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖)) ≤
        (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖)) ≤
          ∫ _x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
          ((((h_f_row_cont j hj_k₀).pow 2).add (h_q_row_cont j hj_k₀)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (fun x _ => hpt_le x)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h1
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖)
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi) * (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2 := by field_simp [h2pi_ne]
    have hsqrt_le : Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (upperRowPt S j x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (upperRowPt S j x)‖)) ≤
        2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j) := by
      calc Real.sqrt _
          ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hint_le
        _ = 2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j) := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
    calc rowMomentFull S j
        ≤ Real.exp (-j) * (2 * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-j)))
      _ = 2 * (Real.exp (-j) * Real.exp ((1 + ε) * j)) := by ring
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (-j + (1 + ε) * j) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (ε * j) := by congr 2; ring
  have h_fin_ratio : ∀ (N : ℝ → ℝ) (a c K_base : ℝ),
      0 < a → 0 < c → k₀ ≤ K_base →
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → 1 ≤ N j) →
      (∀ j : ℝ, K_base ≤ j → c * Real.exp (a * j) ≤ N j) →
      ∃ M_fin : ℝ, 0 < M_fin ∧ ∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → rowMomentFull S j ≤ M_fin * N j := by
    intro N a c K_base ha hc hK_base hN_one hN_exp
    obtain ⟨K_ub, _, hK_ub⟩ := h_upper_growth (a / 2) (by linarith)
    let J : ℝ := max K_base K_ub
    have hJ_ge : k₀ ≤ J := le_trans hK_base (le_max_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨j_max, _, hj_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      ⟨k₀, le_rfl, hJ_ge⟩ (h_rowMomentFull_cont.mono Set.Icc_subset_Ici_self)
    let M_fin : ℝ := max (max (rowMomentFull S j_max) 1) (2 * c⁻¹)
    have hM_pos : 0 < M_fin := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ 1) (le_max_left _ _))
    refine ⟨M_fin, hM_pos, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    rcases le_total j J with hjJ | hJj
    · have h1 : rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S j_max := hj_max ⟨hj, hjJ⟩
      have h2 : rowMomentFull S j_max ≤ M_fin :=
        le_trans (le_max_left _ 1) (le_max_left _ _)
      have h3 : 1 ≤ N j := hN_one j hj
      calc rowMomentFull S j ≤ M_fin * 1 := by linarith
        _ ≤ M_fin * N j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (le_of_lt hM_pos)
    · have hj_base : K_base ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hJj
      have hj_ub : K_ub ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hJj
      have hj_pos : 0 ≤ j := by linarith
      have hexp_le : Real.exp ((a / 2) * j) ≤ Real.exp (a * j) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
      have hN_j := hN_exp j hj_base
      have h_c_inv : Real.exp (a * j) ≤ c⁻¹ * N j := by
        calc Real.exp (a * j) = c⁻¹ * (c * Real.exp (a * j)) := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]
          _ ≤ c⁻¹ * N j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN_j (by positivity)
      have h2c_le : 2 * c⁻¹ ≤ M_fin := le_max_right _ _
      have hN_nonneg : 0 ≤ N j := le_trans zero_le_one (hN_one j hj)
      calc rowMomentFull S j
          ≤ 2 * Real.exp ((a / 2) * j) := hK_ub j hj_ub
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (a * j) := by linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * (c⁻¹ * N j) := by linarith
        _ = (2 * c⁻¹) * N j := by ring
        _ ≤ M_fin * N j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2c_le hN_nonneg
  have h_tilt_max : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (u v η : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Ici k₀) →
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → g j ≤ rowMomentFull S j) →
      k₀ ≤ u → u ≤ v → 0 < η → 0 < g v →
      ∃ k_max : ℝ, u ≤ k_max ∧
        ∀ j : ℝ, u ≤ j →
          g j * Real.exp (-η * |j - v|) ≤ g k_max * Real.exp (-η * |k_max - v|) := by
    intro g u v η hg_cont hg_le hu huv hη hgv
    obtain ⟨K_ub, _, hK_ub⟩ := h_upper_growth (η / 2) (by linarith)
    let C_v : ℝ := 2 * Real.exp (η * v)
    have hCv_pos : 0 < C_v := by positivity
    let J : ℝ := max (max v K_ub) ((2 / η) * Real.log (C_v / g v + 1))
    have hv_le_J : v ≤ J := le_trans (le_max_left v K_ub) (le_max_left _ _)
    let h_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun j => g j * Real.exp (-η * |j - v|)
    have hh_cont : ContinuousOn h_fn (Set.Ici k₀) :=
      hg_cont.mul (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
    have hIcc_sub : Set.Icc u J ⊆ Set.Ici k₀ :=
      fun j hj => le_trans hu hj.1
    obtain ⟨k_max, hk_mem, hk_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      ⟨v, huv, hv_le_J⟩ (hh_cont.mono hIcc_sub)
    refine ⟨k_max, hk_mem.1, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    rcases le_total j J with hjJ | hJj
    · exact hk_max ⟨hj, hjJ⟩
    · have hv_le_max : h_fn v ≤ h_fn k_max := hk_max ⟨huv, hv_le_J⟩
      have hj_v : v ≤ j := le_trans hv_le_J hJj
      have hj_ub : K_ub ≤ j := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right v K_ub) (le_max_left _ _)) hJj
      have hj_log : (2 / η) * Real.log (C_v / g v + 1) ≤ j :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hJj
      have hlog_le : Real.log (C_v / g v + 1) ≤ (η / 2) * j := by
        have h1 : η * ((2 / η) * Real.log (C_v / g v + 1)) ≤ η * j :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj_log (le_of_lt hη)
        have h2 : η * ((2 / η) * Real.log (C_v / g v + 1)) =
            2 * Real.log (C_v / g v + 1) := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hη]
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      have hexp_gt : C_v / g v < Real.exp ((η / 2) * j) := by
        have hpos : 0 < C_v / g v + 1 := by positivity
        have h1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog_le
        rw [Real.exp_log hpos] at h1
        linarith
      have hdecay : C_v * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j) ≤ g v := by
        have hlt : C_v < Real.exp ((η / 2) * j) * g v := (div_lt_iff₀ hgv).mp hexp_gt
        calc C_v * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j)
            ≤ (Real.exp ((η / 2) * j) * g v) * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hlt) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
          _ = g v * (Real.exp ((η / 2) * j) * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j)) := by ring
          _ = g v * Real.exp (((η / 2) * j) + (-(η / 2) * j)) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
          _ = g v := by simp
      have habs : |j - v| = j - v := abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)
      have hh_j : h_fn j ≤ C_v * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j) := by
        dsimp [h_fn, C_v]
        rw [habs]
        calc g j * Real.exp (-η * (j - v))
            ≤ (2 * Real.exp ((η / 2) * j)) * Real.exp (-η * (j - v)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (hg_le j (le_trans hu hj)) (hK_ub j hj_ub))
                (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
          _ = 2 * (Real.exp ((η / 2) * j) * Real.exp (-η * (j - v))) := by ring
          _ = 2 * Real.exp ((η / 2) * j + (-η * (j - v))) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
          _ = 2 * Real.exp (η * v + (-(η / 2) * j)) := by congr 2; ring
          _ = 2 * Real.exp (η * v) * Real.exp (-(η / 2) * j) := by rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
      have hfv_eq : h_fn v = g v := by dsimp [h_fn]; simp
      linarith
  have h_cs_gen : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
      Continuous g → 0 < B →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x) ^ 2) ≤ B ^ 2 →

        have hl_le_jA : l ≤ j + A := by

            calc Real.exp (-(j + A)) = Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-j) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
              _ ≤ wallDepth S s := hs_depth_lo
          have hlog := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) h1
          rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
          dsimp [l]; linarith
        have hexp_l_le : Real.exp l ≤ Real.exp A * Real.exp j := by
          have h1 : Real.exp l * Real.exp (-l) = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          have h2 : Real.exp A * Real.exp j * (Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-j)) = 1 := by
            calc Real.exp A * Real.exp j * (Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-j))
                = (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-A)) * (Real.exp j * Real.exp (-j)) := by ring
              _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
              _ = 1 := by ring
          have h3 : Real.exp l * (Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-j)) ≤
              Real.exp A * Real.exp j * (Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-j)) := by
            rw [h2, ← h1, hexp_neg_l]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs_depth_lo (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos l))
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 (by positivity)
        have h1l_le : 1 + l ≤ (1 + A) * (1 + j) := by nlinarith
        have hmod_l := h_mod_sup_poly l hl_ge_k₀ s.re
        rw [hs_eq] at hmod_l
        have hmod_s : shapeModulus S s ≤ Real.exp l * (C_poly * (1 + l) ^ 2) := by
          calc shapeModulus S s
              = Real.exp l * (Real.exp (-l) * shapeModulus S s) := by
                rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
            _ ≤ Real.exp l * (C_poly * (1 + l) ^ 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmod_l (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos l))
        have hsq_le : (1 + l) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 + A) * (1 + j)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h1l_le 2
        calc shapeModulus S s
            ≤ Real.exp l * (C_poly * (1 + l) ^ 2) := hmod_s
          _ ≤ (Real.exp A * Real.exp j) * (C_poly * ((1 + A) * (1 + j)) ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul hexp_l_le (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq_le (le_of_lt hC_poly_pos))
                (by positivity) (by positivity)
          _ = Real.exp j * (Real.exp A * C_poly * (1 + A) ^ 2) * (1 + j) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ Real.exp j * C_tileA * (1 + j) ^ 2 := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos j))
              dsimp [C_tileA]; linarith
      · have hs_im_hi : s.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-k₀) := by
          dsimp [wallDepth] at h_shallow; linarith
        have hs_im_lt_H : |s.im| < S.H := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg hs_im_nonneg]; linarith [Real.exp_pos (-k₀)]
        have hline_per : Function.Periodic
            (fun u : ℝ => shapeModulus S ((u : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
          intro u
          have hz_mem : ((u : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
            change |((u : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
            simpa using hs_im_lt_H
          have hz_add : (((u + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
              ((u : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
          dsimp [shapeModulus]
          rw [hz_add, S.f_periodic _ hz_mem, S.q_periodic _ hz_mem]
        let m : ℤ := ⌊s.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        let u₀ : ℝ := s.re - (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hu₀_lo : 0 ≤ u₀ := by
          have hfl := Int.floor_le (s.re / (2 * Real.pi))
          have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp hfl
          dsimp [u₀, m]; linarith
        have hu₀_hi : u₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
          have hfl := Int.lt_floor_add_one (s.re / (2 * Real.pi))
          have hmul := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp hfl
          dsimp [u₀, m]; linarith
        have hw_mem : Φ_rect (u₀, s.im) ∈ R_shallow :=
          ⟨(u₀, s.im), ⟨⟨hu₀_lo, hu₀_hi⟩, ⟨hs_im_nonneg, hs_im_hi⟩⟩, rfl⟩
        have hw_le : shapeModulus S (Φ_rect (u₀, s.im)) ≤ M_shallow := hz_sh_max hw_mem
        have hs_re_eq : u₀ + (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = s.re := by dsimp [u₀]; ring
        have hs_mod_eq : shapeModulus S s = shapeModulus S (Φ_rect (u₀, s.im)) := by
          have hper_m := hline_per.int_mul m u₀
          rw [hs_re_eq] at hper_m
          have hs_eta : ((s.re : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) = s := Complex.re_add_im s
          rw [hs_eta] at hper_m
          exact hper_m
        have hexp_j_ge : 1 ≤ Real.exp j := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
        have h1j_sq_ge : 1 ≤ (1 + j) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have h1A_pos : 0 < Real.exp A * C_poly * (1 + A) ^ 2 := by positivity
        have hC_ge_M : M_shallow ≤ C_tileA := by dsimp [C_tileA]; linarith
        calc shapeModulus S s
            = shapeModulus S (Φ_rect (u₀, s.im)) := hs_mod_eq
          _ ≤ M_shallow := hw_le
          _ ≤ C_tileA := hC_ge_M
          _ = 1 * C_tileA * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ Real.exp j * C_tileA * (1 + j) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_j_ge (le_of_lt hC_tileA_pos))
                h1j_sq_ge zero_le_one (by positivity)
    dsimp [tileSupModulus]
    calc Real.exp (-j) * sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A j x)
        ≤ Real.exp (-j) * (Real.exp j * C_tileA * (1 + j) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sSup_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
      _ = (Real.exp (-j) * Real.exp j) * C_tileA * (1 + j) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = C_tileA * (1 + j) ^ 2 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hNoProhib : ¬ ProhibitedCriticalSequence S)
    (hDef : LogDeficitTransferPackage S)
    (hPoly : CriticalPolynomialEnvelopeData S) :
    ∃ C_ang ρ : ℝ,
      0 < C_ang ∧
      0 < ρ ∧
      ρ < 1 ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2)
          (Set.Icc (criticalDepthThreshold S) K) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        (∫ v in (criticalDepthThreshold S)..K, (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2) ≤ C_ang * K ^ (2 * ρ)

proof.tactics:
by
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  let upperRowMaxF : ℝ → ℝ := fun j =>
    sSup ((fun x : ℝ =>
      ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi))
  let rowLogMaxF : ℝ → ℝ := fun j => Real.log (upperRowMaxF j)
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := le_max_left 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
  have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have hCp_pos : 0 < hPoly.C_poly := hPoly.C_poly_pos
  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hpt_im : ∀ x y : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y := by intro x y; simp
  have hpt_re : ∀ x y : ℝ, ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = x := by intro x y; simp
  have hZ_im : ∀ x d : ℝ, ∀ Z : ℂ,
      ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z).im = S.H - d * (-Z.im) := by
    intro x d Z; simp
  have hexp_neg_le : ∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → Real.exp (-j) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    intro j hj
    have h1 : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
    have h2 : -j ≤ Real.log (S.H / 20) := by linarith
    calc Real.exp (-j) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by positivity)
  have hy_bounds : ∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j →
      0 < S.H - Real.exp (-j) ∧ S.H - Real.exp (-j) < S.H := by
    intro j hj
    have hle := hexp_neg_le j hj
    have hpos := Real.exp_pos (-j)
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  
  
  have hPart1 :
      ContinuousOn (rowMomentF S) (Set.Ici k₀) ∧
      ContinuousOn (rowMomentFull S) (Set.Ici k₀) ∧
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → 0 ≤ rowMomentF S j ∧ rowMomentF S j ≤ rowMomentFull S j) ∧
      ContinuousOn rowLogMaxF (Set.Ici k₀) ∧
      MonotoneOn rowLogMaxF (Set.Ici k₀) ∧
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → Real.log ‖S.f 0‖ ≤ rowLogMaxF j) ∧
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → ∃ x_max ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ‖S.f ((x_max : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ =
          Real.exp (rowLogMaxF j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-j) →
        ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp (rowLogMaxF j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ,
        Continuous w ∧
        Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) ∧
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 ∧
        (∀ y : ℝ, 0 < w y →
          Real.exp (rowLogMaxF j - 1) ≤
            ‖S.f ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)) ∧
      (∀ (d_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
        0 < d_a → d_a ≤ 1 → Continuous w → Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
        (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
        Continuous (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) ∧
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) ≤
          Real.pi ^ 2 / 2) ∧
      (∀ (K : Set ℂ) (d B : ℝ),
        IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → 0 < d → 0 < B →
        (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ Z ∈ K,
          (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
        Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
          sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
            d * Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ,
          0 ≤ min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
            (d / B) ^ 2 * ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) ∧
          min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
            (d / B) ^ 2 * ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) ≤
            B⁻¹ * sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
              d * Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K))) := by
    have hstrip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    let Ψ : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ → ℂ :=
      fun p => (p.2 : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-(p.1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous Ψ := by
      dsimp [Ψ]; fun_prop
    have hΨ_mem : ∀ p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ, Ψ p ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro p
      have hy := hy_bounds p.1.1 p.1.2
      change |((p.2 : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-(p.1 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
      rw [hpt_im, abs_of_pos hy.1]
      exact hy.2
    have hfΨ_cont : Continuous (fun p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ => S.f (Ψ p)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem
    have hqΨ_cont : Continuous (fun p : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) × ℝ => S.q (Ψ p)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont hΨ_mem
    have hcont_F : ContinuousOn (rowMomentF S) (Set.Ici k₀) := by
      rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
      have hint_cont : Continuous (fun j : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) =>
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖S.f (Ψ (j, x))‖ ^ 2) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' _ 0 (2 * Real.pi)
        exact (continuous_norm.comp hfΨ_cont).pow 2
      exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_subtype_val.neg).mul
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul hint_cont))
    have hcont_Full : ContinuousOn (rowMomentFull S) (Set.Ici k₀) := by
      rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
      have hint_cont : Continuous (fun j : ↥(Set.Ici k₀) =>
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖S.f (Ψ (j, x))‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Ψ (j, x))‖)) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' _ 0 (2 * Real.pi)
        exact ((continuous_norm.comp hfΨ_cont).pow 2).add (continuous_norm.comp hqΨ_cont)
      exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_subtype_val.neg).mul
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (continuous_const.mul hint_cont))
    have hF_le_Full : ∀ j : ℝ, k₀ ≤ j → 0 ≤ rowMomentF S j ∧ rowMomentF S j ≤ rowMomentFull S j := by
      intro j hj
      have hnn : 0 ≤ rowMomentF S j := by
        unfold rowMomentF
        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-j))) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      refine ⟨hnn, ?_⟩
      unfold rowMomentF rowMomentFull
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-j)))
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
      have hmk : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ((⟨j, hj⟩ : ↥(Set.Ici k₀)), x)) :=
        continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ (⟨j, hj⟩, x))‖ ^ 2) :=
        ((continuous_norm.comp hfΨ_cont).pow 2).comp hmk
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f (Ψ (⟨j, hj⟩, x))‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (Ψ (⟨j, hj⟩, x))‖) :=
        (((continuous_norm.comp hfΨ_cont).pow 2).add (continuous_norm.comp hqΨ_cont)).comp hmk
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
        (hc1.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hc2.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun x _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))
    have hf_per_nat : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        S.f (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = S.f z := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro z _; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro z hz
        have hzn_mem : z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          change |(z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)).im| < S.H
          have him : (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)).im = z.im := by simp
          rw [him]; exact hz
        have hadd : z + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
            (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [hadd, S.f_periodic _ hzn_mem, ih z hz]
    have hf_per_int : ∀ m : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        S.f (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = S.f z := by
      intro m z hz
      rcases m with n | n
      · simpa using hf_per_nat n z hz
      · let z' : ℂ := z + (Int.negSucc n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hz'_mem : z' ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          change |z'.im| < S.H
          have him : z'.im = z.im := by simp [z']
          rw [him]; exact hz
        have hz_eq : z' + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) = z := by
          dsimp [z']; push_cast; ring
        have h := hf_per_nat (n + 1) z' hz'_mem
        rw [hz_eq] at h
        exact h.symm
    have hslab_max : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → y < S.H →
        (∃ x_max ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ‖S.f ((x_max : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ =
            sSup ((fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ y →
          ‖S.f z‖ ≤
            sSup ((fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) := by
      intro y hy0 hyH
      let g_y : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
      let M_y : ℝ := sSup (g_y '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      have hg_y_cont : Continuous g_y := by
        refine continuous_norm.comp (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) ?_)
        intro x
        change |((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
        rw [hpt_im, abs_of_nonneg hy0]
        exact hyH
      have hIcc_ne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty := ⟨0, le_rfl, le_of_lt h2pi_pos⟩
      have hbdd_gy : BddAbove (g_y '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) :=
        (isCompact_Icc.image hg_y_cont).bddAbove
      obtain ⟨x_max, hx_max_mem, hx_max_eq⟩ :=
        isCompact_Icc.exists_sSup_image_eq hIcc_ne hg_y_cont.continuousOn
      refine ⟨⟨x_max, hx_max_mem, hx_max_eq.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      have hgy_le : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), g_y x ≤ M_y :=
        fun x hx => le_csSup hbdd_gy ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      let φ_box : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let R_box : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-y) y
      let R_y : Set ℂ := φ_box '' R_box
      have hRy_comp : IsCompact R_y := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image (by fun_prop)
      have hRy_ne : R_y.Nonempty :=
        ⟨0, ⟨(0, 0), ⟨⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt h2pi_pos⟩, ⟨by linarith, hy0⟩⟩, by simp [φ_box]⟩⟩
      have hRy_sub : R_y ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
        rintro w ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨_, hv⟩, rfl⟩
        change |(φ_box (u, v)).im| < S.H
        have him : (φ_box (u, v)).im = v := by simp [φ_box]
        rw [him]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_le.mpr hv) hyH
      have hfn_Ry : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => ‖S.f z‖) R_y :=
        continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (S.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hRy_sub)
      obtain ⟨z_star, hz_star_mem, hz_star_max⟩ :=
        hRy_comp.exists_isMaxOn hRy_ne hfn_Ry
      have hz_le_zstar : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ y → ‖S.f z‖ ≤ ‖S.f z_star‖ := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_strip : z ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_of_le_of_lt hz hyH
        let m : ℤ := Int.floor (z.re / (2 * Real.pi))
        let z' : ℂ := z + ((-m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hre : z'.re = z.re - (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          simp [z', sub_eq_add_neg]
