      have hdiff_le : G (v + C_jmp * Real.log v) - G (v - C_jmp * Real.log v) ≤
          G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K) := by
        rw [← hG_cl_eq _ hv_hi_ge, ← hG_cl_eq _ hv_lo_ge]
        have h1 : G_cl (v + C_jmp * Real.log v) ≤ G_cl (v + L_K) :=
          hG_cl_mono (by linarith)
        have h2 : G_cl (v - L_K) ≤ G_cl (v - C_jmp * Real.log v) :=
          hG_cl_mono (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hcl_diff_nonneg : 0 ≤ G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K) := by
        have := hG_cl_mono (by linarith : v - L_K ≤ v + L_K)
        linarith
      rcases lt_or_ge (μ_f v) (v ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) with hlow | hhigh
      · have hμ_nn : 0 ≤ μ_f v := (hF_le_Full v hv_ge_k₀).1
        have hv_sq : (μ_f v) ^ 2 ≤ (v ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2 :=
          sq_le_sq' (by linarith) (le_of_lt hlow)
        have hv_rpow_eq : (v ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ 2 = v ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (v ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hv_pos)]
          norm_num
        have hv_le_K_half : v ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hv_pos) hv_le_K (by norm_num)
        have hterm_nn : 0 ≤ A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)) :=
          mul_nonneg hAK_nonneg hcl_diff_nonneg
        linarith
      · have hμ_nn : 0 ≤ μ_f v := (hF_le_Full v hv_ge_k₀).1
        have h1v_le : (1 + v) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have hμ_up1 : μ_f v ≤ hPoly.C_poly * (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) :=
          le_trans (hPoly.sublinear_f_bound v hv_ge_k₀)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1v_le (le_of_lt hCp_pos))
        have hjmp_v : c_jmp * μ_f v ≤ G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K) :=
          le_trans (hjump v hv_ge_K₀ hhigh) hdiff_le
        have hμ_up2 : μ_f v ≤ (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)) / c_jmp :=
          (le_div_iff₀ hc_jmp).mpr (by linarith)
        have hsq_le : (μ_f v) ^ 2 ≤ A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)) := by
          calc (μ_f v) ^ 2 = μ_f v * μ_f v := sq (μ_f v)
            _ ≤ (hPoly.C_poly * (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁)) *
                  ((G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)) / c_jmp) :=
                mul_le_mul hμ_up1 hμ_up2 hμ_nn (by positivity)
            _ = A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)) := by dsimp [A_K]; ring
        have hK_half_nn : 0 ≤ K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) _
        linarith
    have h_maj_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ =>
        K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) := by fun_prop
    have h_int_K0_K : (∫ v in K₀..K, (μ_f v) ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ v in K₀..K, (K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hK₀_le_K
        (hsq_int_on K₀ K hk₀_le_K₀ hK₀_le_K) (h_maj_cont.intervalIntegrable K₀ K) hpt
    have h_split_maj :
        (∫ v in K₀..K, (K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)))) =
          (K - K₀) * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
            A_K * (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) := by
      have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume K₀ K :=
        intervalIntegrable_const
      have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => A_K * (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)))
          MeasureTheory.volume K₀ K :=
        (Continuous.intervalIntegrable (by fun_prop) K₀ K)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add h1 h2, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
        smul_eq_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have h_tele :
        (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) =
          (∫ u in (K - L_K)..(K + L_K), G_cl u) -
            (∫ u in (K₀ - L_K)..(K₀ + L_K), G_cl u) := by
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => G_cl (v + L_K)) MeasureTheory.volume K₀ K :=
        (hG_cl_cont.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable K₀ K
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => G_cl (v - L_K)) MeasureTheory.volume K₀ K :=
        (hG_cl_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable K₀ K
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right G_cl L_K,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right G_cl L_K]
      have ha1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (K₀ - L_K) (K₀ + L_K))
        (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (K₀ + L_K) (K + L_K))
      have ha2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (K₀ - L_K) (K - L_K))
        (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (K - L_K) (K + L_K))
      linarith
    have h_hi_int : (∫ u in (K - L_K)..(K + L_K), G_cl u) ≤ 2 * L_K * G (K + L_K) := by
      have hle : K - L_K ≤ K + L_K := by linarith
      have h_eq_top : G_cl (K + L_K) = G (K + L_K) := hG_cl_eq (K + L_K) (by linarith)
      calc ∫ u in (K - L_K)..(K + L_K), G_cl u
          ≤ ∫ _ in (K - L_K)..(K + L_K), G (K + L_K) := by
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hle
              (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const
            intro u hu
            rw [← h_eq_top]
            exact hG_cl_mono hu.2
        _ = 2 * L_K * G (K + L_K) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have h_lo_int : 2 * L_K * G k₀ ≤ ∫ u in (K₀ - L_K)..(K₀ + L_K), G_cl u := by
      have hle : K₀ - L_K ≤ K₀ + L_K := by linarith
      calc 2 * L_K * G k₀
          = ∫ _ in (K₀ - L_K)..(K₀ + L_K), G k₀ := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        _ ≤ ∫ u in (K₀ - L_K)..(K₀ + L_K), G_cl u := by
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hle
              intervalIntegrable_const (hG_cl_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            intro u _
            exact hG_cl_ge u
    have hG_diff_le : G (K + L_K) - G k₀ ≤ M_G * K := by
      have hup : G (K + L_K) ≤ 3 * (K + L_K) + hPoly.C_poly := hG_upper (K + L_K) (by linarith)
      have hneg : -G k₀ ≤ |G k₀| := neg_le_abs (G k₀)
      have hC_nn : 0 ≤ hPoly.C_poly + |G k₀| := by positivity
      calc G (K + L_K) - G k₀
          ≤ 3 * (2 * K) + (hPoly.C_poly + |G k₀|) * 1 := by linarith
        _ ≤ 6 * K + (hPoly.C_poly + |G k₀|) * K := by nlinarith
        _ = M_G * K := by dsimp [M_G]; ring
    have h_tele_le :
        (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) ≤ 2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K := by
      rw [h_tele]
      calc (∫ u in (K - L_K)..(K + L_K), G_cl u) - (∫ u in (K₀ - L_K)..(K₀ + L_K), G_cl u)
          ≤ 2 * L_K * (G (K + L_K) - G k₀) := by linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * L_K * (M_G * K) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG_diff_le (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K := by dsimp [L_K]; ring
    have h_low_rpow : (K - K₀) * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (2 * ρ) := by
      have hK0_pos : 0 ≤ K₀ := by linarith
      have h1 : (K - K₀) * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ K * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) _)
      have h2 : K * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = K ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        calc K * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = K ^ (1 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
          _ = K ^ (1 + 1 / 2 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos 1 (1 / 2)).symm
          _ = K ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      have h3 : K ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (2 * ρ) := by
        have hρ_ge : (7 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ ρ := le_max_left _ _
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_1pK_rpow : (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) := by
      have h1 : (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ (2 * K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h2 : (2 * K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) :=
        Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (le_of_lt hK_pos)
      have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ 2 := by
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
          _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
      calc (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) := by linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) _)
    have h_logK_rpow : Real.log K ≤ (2 / hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) := by
      have hKe_pos : 0 < K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos (hPoly.ε₁ / 2)
      have h1 : Real.log (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2)) ≤ K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hKe_pos
      rw [Real.log_rpow hK_pos (hPoly.ε₁ / 2)] at h1
      have h2 : (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * Real.log K ≤ K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) := by linarith
      calc Real.log K = (2 / hPoly.ε₁) * ((hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * Real.log K) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ (2 / hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
    have h_high_rpow :
        A_K * (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) ≤ C_tail * K ^ (2 * ρ) := by
      have h1 : A_K * (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K))) ≤
          A_K * (2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tele_le hAK_nonneg
      have h2 : A_K ≤ (2 * hPoly.C_poly / c_jmp) * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) := by
        dsimp [A_K]
        calc hPoly.C_poly * (1 + K) ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) / c_jmp
            ≤ hPoly.C_poly * (2 * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁)) / c_jmp := by gcongr
          _ = (2 * hPoly.C_poly / c_jmp) * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) := by ring
      have h3 : 2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K ≤
          (4 * C_jmp * M_G / hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K) := by
        calc 2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K
            ≤ 2 * C_jmp * ((2 / hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2)) * M_G * K := by gcongr
          _ = (4 * C_jmp * M_G / hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K) := by ring
      have h_prod_K : K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K) ≤ K ^ (2 * ρ) := by
        have hp : K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K) = K ^ (2 - hPoly.ε₁ / 2) := by
          calc K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K)
              = K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K ^ (1 : ℝ)) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
            _ = K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2 + 1) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hK_pos]
            _ = K ^ ((1 - hPoly.ε₁) + (hPoly.ε₁ / 2 + 1)) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hK_pos]
            _ = K ^ (2 - hPoly.ε₁ / 2) := by congr 1; ring
        rw [hp]
        have hρ_ge : 1 - hPoly.ε₁ / 4 ≤ ρ := le_max_right _ _
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by linarith)
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K := by positivity
      calc A_K * (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)))
          ≤ A_K * (2 * C_jmp * Real.log K * M_G * K) := h1
        _ ≤ ((2 * hPoly.C_poly / c_jmp) * K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁)) *
              ((4 * C_jmp * M_G / hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K)) :=
            mul_le_mul h2 h3 h_rhs_nn (by positivity)
        _ = C_tail * (K ^ (1 - hPoly.ε₁) * (K ^ (hPoly.ε₁ / 2) * K)) := by
            dsimp [C_tail]; ring
        _ ≤ C_tail * K ^ (2 * ρ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_K (le_of_lt hC_tail_pos)
    have hadj :
        (∫ v in k₀..K, (μ_f v) ^ 2) = I₀ + ∫ v in K₀..K, (μ_f v) ^ 2 := by
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hsq_int_on k₀ K₀ le_rfl hk₀_le_K₀) (hsq_int_on K₀ K hk₀_le_K₀ hK₀_le_K)).symm
    have hI0_le : I₀ ≤ I₀ * K ^ (2 * ρ) :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right hI₀_nonneg h1_le_K2ρ
    calc ∫ v in k₀..K, (μ_f v) ^ 2
        = I₀ + ∫ v in K₀..K, (μ_f v) ^ 2 := hadj
      _ ≤ I₀ + ((K - K₀) * K ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
            A_K * (∫ v in K₀..K, (G_cl (v + L_K) - G_cl (v - L_K)))) := by
          linarith [h_int_K0_K, h_split_maj]
      _ ≤ I₀ * K ^ (2 * ρ) + K ^ (2 * ρ) + C_tail * K ^ (2 * ρ) := by
          linarith [hI0_le, h_low_rpow, h_high_rpow]
      _ = C_ang * K ^ (2 * ρ) := by dsimp [C_ang]; ring

    BootRealWallTransferProp S ∧

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S) :
    BootRealWallTransferProp S ∧
    ∀ β a C_N C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 1 ≤ C_N → 0 < C₁ →
      Nonempty (BootConeNegativePartData S β a C_N C₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hTrans, hStrip⟩ := cone_real_wall_transfer_and_strip_bound S hCrit
  refine ⟨hTrans, ?_⟩
  intro β a C_N C₁ hβ hβ_half ha hCN hC₁
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  let β₁ : ℝ := (β + 1 / 2) / 2
  have hββ₁ : β < β₁ := by dsimp [β₁]; linarith
  have hβ₁_half : β₁ < 1 / 2 := by dsimp [β₁]; linarith
  have hα₁_gt : 1 / 2 < 1 - β₁ := by linarith
  have hα₁_lt : 1 - β₁ < 1 := by linarith
  let δ_b : ℝ := min (S.H / 4) (Real.exp (-k₀) / 2)
  have hδb_pos : 0 < δ_b := by
    refine lt_min ?_ ?_
    · linarith [S.H_pos]
    · exact half_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hδb_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2 := by
    calc
      δ_b ≤ S.H / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      _ < S.H / 2 := by linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hδb_le : δ_b ≤ min (S.H / 4) (Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) / 2) := le_rfl
  obtain ⟨L_tr, δ_star_tr, hLtr_pos, hδtr_pos, hδtr_lt, hTransAt⟩ :=
    hTrans (1 - β₁) δ_b hα₁_gt hα₁_lt hδb_pos hδb_lt
  obtain ⟨L, K_tay, c_tay, C_tay, hLtr_le, hKtay, hctay_pos, hctay_lt, hCtay_pos, hTay⟩ :=
    cone_passage_dslope_taylor_neg_part S hCrit hStrip β a C_N C₁ δ_b L_tr β₁
      hβ hββ₁ hβ₁_half ha hCN hC₁ hδb_pos hδb_lt hLtr_pos
  have hL_pos : 0 < L := lt_of_lt_of_le hLtr_pos hLtr_le
  let A_cone : ℝ := max 3 (L + 1)
  have hA_cone : 1 ≤ A_cone := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ A_cone := le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨hTileContPer, C_t1, C_t2, hCt1_pos, hCt2_pos, hTileMoments⟩ :=
    cone_holomorphic_submean_and_tile_moments S β a C_N C₁ A_cone hβ ha hCN hC₁ hA_cone
  have hTileL1 : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), tileSupModulus S (max 3 (L + 1)) l x) ≤ C_t1 * N l :=
    fun N hN l hl => (hTileMoments N hN).1 l hl
  have hTileL2 : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ M_r : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_r →
        (∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → rowMomentFull S j ≤ M_r * N j) →
        ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
          Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S (max 3 (L + 1)) l x) ^ 2) ≤
            C_t2 * (1 + M_r) * N l :=
    fun N hN M_r hMr hRow l hl => (hTileMoments N hN).2 M_r hMr hRow l hl
  obtain ⟨hConeProps, hConeDom, C_b1, C_b2, hCb1_pos, hCb2_pos, hConeL1, hConeL2⟩ :=
    cone_cost_dyadic_domination_and_moments S β a C_N C₁ δ_b L β₁ C_t1 C_t2
      hβ hββ₁ hβ₁_half ha hCN hC₁ hδb_pos hδb_le hL_pos hCt1_pos hCt2_pos
      hTileContPer hTileL1 hTileL2
  obtain ⟨c_w, z₀, C_w, C_neg, hcw_pos, hcw_lt, hz₀_pos, hCw_pos, hCneg_pos,
      hWidthLevel, hWidthHolder, hSubquad⟩ :=
    cone_width_holder_and_subquad_balancing S β a C_N C₁ δ_b L β₁ L_tr δ_star_tr
      C_b1 K_tay c_tay C_tay hβ hββ₁ hβ₁_half ha hCN hC₁ hδb_pos hδb_lt
      hLtr_pos hLtr_le hδtr_pos hδtr_lt hCb1_pos hKtay hctay_pos hctay_lt hCtay_pos
      hTransAt hConeProps hConeL1 hTay
  exact ⟨{
    δ_b := δ_b
    L := L
    β₁ := β₁
    A_cone := A_cone
    K_tay := K_tay
    c_tay := c_tay
    C_tay := C_tay
    C_neg := C_neg
    C_dom := Real.exp 1
    C_b1 := C_b1
    C_b2 := C_b2
    c_w := c_w
    z₀ := z₀
    C_w := C_w
    δ_b_pos := hδb_pos
    δ_b_lt := hδb_lt
    L_pos := hL_pos
    β_lt_β₁ := hββ₁
    β₁_lt_half := hβ₁_half
    one_le_A_cone := hA_cone
    k₀_le_K_tay := hKtay
    c_tay_pos := hctay_pos

          intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hInt_max.const_mul 2) hInt_g
      _ = 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), max (g x) 0) - 0 := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hImZero]
      _ = 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), max (g x) 0 := sub_zero _

  
  have hPolarBall : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (Ψ : ℂ → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn Ψ (Metric.closedBall z₀ R) →
      (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, Ψ w) =
        ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R, ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * Ψ (circleMap z₀ ρ θ) := by
    intro z₀ R hR Ψ hΨ
    let F₀ : ℂ → ℝ := (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R).indicator (fun ζ => Ψ (z₀ + ζ))
    have hShift : (∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ R, Ψ w) = ∫ ζ : ℂ, F₀ ζ := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_ball,
          ← MeasureTheory.integral_add_left_eq_self (fun w => (Metric.ball z₀ R).indicator Ψ w) z₀]
      congr 1; ext ζ
      by_cases hζ : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
      · have hz : z₀ + ζ ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hζ
        simp [F₀, hζ, hz]
      · have hz : z₀ + ζ ∉ Metric.ball z₀ R := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hζ
        simp [F₀, hζ, hz]
    rw [hShift, ← Complex.integral_comp_polarCoord_symm F₀]
    let S_pol : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi
    let G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => p.1 * Ψ (circleMap z₀ p.1 p.2)
    have hSubTarget : S_pol ⊆ polarCoord.target := fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.1, hp.2⟩
    have hMeasS : MeasurableSet S_pol := measurableSet_Ioo.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have hpol_eq : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, (Complex.polarCoord.symm q : ℂ) =
        (q.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro q
      rw [Complex.polarCoord_symm_apply, Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin,
        Complex.cos_add_sin_I]
    have hIndEq : (∫ p in polarCoord.target, p.1 • F₀ (Complex.polarCoord.symm p)) =
        ∫ p in S_pol, G p := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator polarCoord.open_target.measurableSet,
          ← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeasS]
      congr 1; ext p
      by_cases hp : p ∈ polarCoord.target
      · have hp1 : 0 < p.1 := hp.1
        have hnorm : ‖(Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ)‖ = p.1 := by
          rw [hpol_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg hp1.le, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
        have hcirc : z₀ + (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) = circleMap z₀ p.1 p.2 := by
          simp [circleMap, hpol_eq]
        by_cases hlt : p.1 < R
        · have hmemB : (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hnorm]; exact hlt
          have hmemS : p ∈ S_pol := ⟨⟨hp1, hlt⟩, hp.2⟩
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hmemS]
          dsimp only [F₀, G]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hmemB, hcirc, smul_eq_mul]
        · have hnotB : (Complex.polarCoord.symm p : ℂ) ∉ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hnorm]; exact hlt
          have hnotS : p ∉ S_pol := fun h => hlt h.1.2
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnotS]
          dsimp only [F₀]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hnotB, smul_zero]
      · have hnotS : p ∉ S_pol := fun h => hp (hSubTarget h)
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnotS]
    rw [hIndEq]
    have hContCircle : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => circleMap z₀ p.1 p.2) := by
      simp only [circleMap]
      exact continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul
          continuous_const)))
    have hContG : ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
      refine continuousOn_fst.mul (hΨ.comp hContCircle.continuousOn ?_)
      intro p hp
      have hmem := circleMap_mem_closedBall z₀ hp.1.1 p.2
      exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hp.1.2 hmem
    have hIntG : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G S_pol MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hContG.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    have hIntG' : MeasureTheory.Integrable G
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)).prod
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi))) := by
      rwa [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
    change ∫ p, G p ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict S_pol) = _
    rw [show MeasureTheory.volume.restrict S_pol =
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) R)).prod
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi)) from
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict _ _).symm]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_prod G hIntG']
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hR.le]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro ρ _
    dsimp only
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi)]
    have hPer : Function.Periodic (fun θ : ℝ => ρ * Ψ (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro θ
      simp only [circleMap]
      have hexp : Complex.exp (((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        push_cast
        rw [add_mul, Complex.exp_add]
        have h2pi : Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 1 := by
          simpa [mul_assoc] using Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I
        rw [h2pi, mul_one]
      rw [hexp]
    have hshift := hPer.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-Real.pi) 0
    have hpi1 : -Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = Real.pi := by ring
    have hpi2 : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    rw [hpi1, hpi2] at hshift
    exact hshift

  
  have hStripRect : ∀ (a b l_lo l_hi : ℝ), a ≤ b → l_lo ≤ l_hi → Real.exp (-l_lo) < 2 * S.H →
      ∀ (Φ : ℂ → ℝ), ContinuousOn Φ (horizStrip S.H) →
        let y_lo := S.H - Real.exp (-l_lo)
        let y_hi := S.H - Real.exp (-l_hi)
        let R_box : Set ℂ := {ζ : ℂ | a ≤ ζ.re ∧ ζ.re ≤ b ∧ y_lo ≤ ζ.im ∧ ζ.im ≤ y_hi}
        R_box ⊆ horizStrip S.H ∧
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Φ R_box MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        (∫ ζ in R_box, Φ ζ) =
          ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, ∫ u in a..b, Real.exp (-l) * Φ (bootRowPt S l u) := by
    intro a b l_lo l_hi hab hl hexp Φ hΦ
    dsimp only
    set y_lo := S.H - Real.exp (-l_lo)
    set y_hi := S.H - Real.exp (-l_hi)
    set R_box : Set ℂ := {ζ : ℂ | a ≤ ζ.re ∧ ζ.re ≤ b ∧ y_lo ≤ ζ.im ∧ ζ.im ≤ y_hi}
    have hy_le : y_lo ≤ y_hi := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (-l_hi) ≤ Real.exp (-l_lo) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hSub : R_box ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rcases hζ with ⟨_, _, h3, h4⟩
      change |ζ.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-l_hi)]⟩
    let e := Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm
    have h_e_eq : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, e p = (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      intro p
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [e, Complex.measurableEquivRealProd_symm_apply]
    have hPre : e ⁻¹' R_box = Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi := by
      ext ⟨u, y⟩
      change (a ≤ (e (u, y)).re ∧ (e (u, y)).re ≤ b ∧
        y_lo ≤ (e (u, y)).im ∧ (e (u, y)).im ≤ y_hi) ↔
        (u ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧ y ∈ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi)
      rw [h_e_eq]
      simp [Set.mem_Icc]
      tauto
    have hImg : R_box = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi) := by
      ext ζ
      constructor
      · intro hζ
        exact ⟨(ζ.re, ζ.im), ⟨⟨hζ.1, hζ.2.1⟩, ⟨hζ.2.2.1, hζ.2.2.2⟩⟩, Complex.re_add_im ζ⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨u, y⟩, ⟨⟨hu1, hu2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩⟩, rfl⟩
        simp [R_box, hu1, hu2, hy1, hy2]
    have hContPair : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
    have hCompBox : IsCompact R_box := by
      rw [hImg]
      exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hContPair
    have hIntBox : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Φ R_box MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hΦ.mono hSub).integrableOn_compact hCompBox
    refine ⟨hSub, hIntBox, ?_⟩
    have hEmb := MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb
      Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm e.measurableEmbedding Φ R_box
    rw [← hEmb, hPre]
    have hContComp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ ((p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi) :=
      hΦ.comp hContPair.continuousOn (by
        intro p hp
        apply hSub
        rw [hImg]
        exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
    have hIntProd : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Φ (e p))
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)).prod
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc y_lo y_hi))) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
      exact (hContComp.congr (fun p _ => by rw [h_e_eq])).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
    change ∫ p, Φ (e p) ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi)) = _
    rw [show MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi) =
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b)).prod
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc y_lo y_hi)) from
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict _ _).symm]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm _ hIntProd]
    simp_rw [h_e_eq]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hy_le]
    let g_row : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ u in a..b, Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hRowEq : (∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, ∫ u in Set.Icc a b, Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
        ∫ y in y_lo..y_hi, g_row y := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro y _
      dsimp only [g_row]
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
    rw [hRowEq]
    have hContGrow : ContinuousOn g_row (Set.uIcc y_lo y_hi) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hy_le]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hab with rfl | hab_lt
      · have hzero : g_row = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext fun y => by simp [g_row]
        rw [hzero]
        exact continuousOn_const
      · have hUnif := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hContComp
        rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
        intro y₀ hy₀ ε hε
        rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hUnif
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hUnif (ε / (2 * (b - a))) (by positivity)
        refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun y₁ hy₁ hdist => ?_⟩
        have hInt₀ : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
            MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
          apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
          exact hContComp.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
            (fun u hu => ⟨hu, hy₀⟩)
        have hInt₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
            MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
          apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]
          exact hContComp.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
            (fun u hu => ⟨hu, hy₁⟩)
        rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hInt₁ hInt₀]
        have hle : ‖∫ u in a..b, (Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
            Φ ((u : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
            ∫ _ in a..b, (ε / (2 * (b - a))) := by
          refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hab ?_ intervalIntegrable_const
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u hu => ?_)
          have hu' : u ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hu
          have hd : dist (u, y₁) (u, y₀) < δ := by
            simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hdist
          exact le_of_lt (hδ (u, y₁) ⟨hu', hy₁⟩ (u, y₀) ⟨hu', hy₀⟩ hd)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
        have hconst : (∫ _ in a..b, (ε / (2 * (b - a)))) = ε / 2 := by
          simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab_lt)]
        linarith
    have hSubL := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv'
      (f := fun l : ℝ => S.H - Real.exp (-l))
      (f' := fun l : ℝ => Real.exp (-l))
      (a := l_lo) (b := l_hi)
      (fun l _ => by simpa using ((hasDerivAt_neg l).exp.const_sub S.H))
      (Continuous.continuousOn (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_neg))
      (by
        have heq : (fun l : ℝ => S.H - Real.exp (-l)) '' Set.uIcc l_lo l_hi ⊆
            Set.uIcc y_lo y_hi := by
          rintro _ ⟨l, hl_mem, rfl⟩
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hl] at hl_mem
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hy_le]
          exact ⟨by linarith [Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hl_mem.1] : -l ≤ -l_lo)],
                 by linarith [Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hl_mem.2] : -l_hi ≤ -l)]⟩
        exact hContGrow.mono heq)
    rw [← hSubL]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro l _
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, g_row, bootRowPt]
    rw [mul_comm, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

  
  have hODE : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      (r * shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2 ≤
        128 * (1 + sSup ((fun w : ℂ => r ^ 2 * ‖S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w‖) ''
          Metric.closedBall z₀ r)) := by
    intro z₀ r hr hsub
    let W : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => S.f z ^ 2 + 8 * S.q z
    let S_W : Set ℝ := (fun w : ℂ => r ^ 2 * ‖W w‖) '' Metric.closedBall z₀ r
    have hComp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) := isCompact_closedBall z₀ r
    have hNonemp : (Metric.closedBall z₀ r).Nonempty := Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hr.le
    have hContW : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => r ^ 2 * ‖W w‖) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul
        (((S.f_holo.continuousOn.pow 2).add
          (continuousOn_const.mul S.q_holo.continuousOn)).norm.mono hsub)
    have hBddW : BddAbove S_W := (hComp.image_of_continuousOn hContW).bddAbove
    have hle_MW : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, r ^ 2 * ‖W w‖ ≤ sSup S_W :=
      fun w hw => le_csSup hBddW ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have hMW_nonneg : 0 ≤ sSup S_W :=
      le_trans (by positivity) (hle_MW z₀ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le))
    let Φ : ℂ → ℝ := fun w => (r - ‖w - z₀‖) * ‖S.f w‖
    have hContΦ : ContinuousOn Φ (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) :=
      (continuousOn_const.sub (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm.continuousOn).mul
        (S.f_holo.continuousOn.norm.mono hsub)
    obtain ⟨z_star, hz_star_mem, hz_star_max⟩ := hComp.exists_isMaxOn hNonemp hContΦ
    let A : ℝ := Φ z_star
    have hΦ_z₀ : r * ‖S.f z₀‖ ≤ A := by
      have h0 := hz_star_max (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
      simpa [Φ, A] using h0
    have hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (by positivity) hΦ_z₀
    have hA_sq : A ^ 2 ≤ 128 + sSup S_W := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hA_nonneg with hA0 | hA_pos
      · rw [← hA0]; linarith
      · let r_star : ℝ := r - ‖z_star - z₀‖
        let m_star : ℝ := ‖S.f z_star‖
        have hr_star_nonneg : 0 ≤ r_star := by
          have hd : ‖z_star - z₀‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz_star_mem
          linarith
        have hr_star_le : r_star ≤ r := sub_le_self r (norm_nonneg _)
        have hm_star_nonneg : 0 ≤ m_star := norm_nonneg _
        have hprod : r_star * m_star = A := rfl
        have hr_star_pos : 0 < r_star := by
          by_contra hle
          have h0 : r_star = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) hr_star_nonneg
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at hprod
          linarith
        have hm_star_pos : 0 < m_star := by
          by_contra hle
          have h0 : m_star = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hle) hm_star_nonneg
          rw [h0, mul_zero] at hprod
          linarith
        let ρ : ℝ := r_star / 2
        have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := half_pos hr_star_pos
        have hSubBall : Metric.closedBall z_star ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall z₀ r := by
          intro w hw
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw ⊢
          calc ‖w - z₀‖ = ‖(w - z_star) + (z_star - z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖w - z_star‖ + ‖z_star - z₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ρ + (r - r_star) := by linarith
            _ = r - r_star / 2 := by dsimp [ρ]; ring
            _ ≤ r := by linarith
        have hBoundSphere : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere z_star ρ, ‖S.f w‖ ≤ 2 * m_star := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_cl : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z_star ρ := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw
          have hw_z₀ : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r := hSubBall hw_cl
          have hdist : ‖w - z₀‖ ≤ r - r_star / 2 := by
            rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at hw
            calc ‖w - z₀‖ = ‖(w - z_star) + (z_star - z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ ‖w - z_star‖ + ‖z_star - z₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ = ρ + (r - r_star) := by rw [hw]; ring
              _ = r - r_star / 2 := by dsimp [ρ]; ring
          have hmax_w : (r_star / 2) * ‖S.f w‖ ≤ r_star * m_star := by
            calc (r_star / 2) * ‖S.f w‖
                ≤ (r - ‖w - z₀‖) * ‖S.f w‖ :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)
              _ ≤ A := hz_star_max hw_z₀
              _ = r_star * m_star := rfl
          nlinarith
        have hDiffCl : DiffContOnCl ℂ S.f (Metric.ball z_star ρ) :=
          (S.f_holo.mono (Subset.trans Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall
            (Subset.trans hSubBall hsub))).diffContOnCl
        have hCauchy2 := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le
          2 hρ_pos hDiffCl hBoundSphere
        have hIter2 : iteratedDeriv 2 S.f z_star = deriv (deriv S.f) z_star := by
          simp [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        rw [hIter2] at hCauchy2
        have hDeriv2Bound : ‖deriv (deriv S.f) z_star‖ ≤ 16 * m_star / r_star ^ 2 := by
          calc ‖deriv (deriv S.f) z_star‖
              ≤ (Nat.factorial 2 : ℝ) * (2 * m_star) / ρ ^ 2 := hCauchy2
            _ = 16 * m_star / r_star ^ 2 := by
                norm_num [Nat.factorial, ρ]
                ring
        have hz_star_strip : z_star ∈ horizStrip S.H := hsub hz_star_mem
        have hODE_eq : S.f z_star ^ 3 = W z_star * S.f z_star - 8 * deriv (deriv S.f) z_star := by
          rw [S.deriv2_f z_star hz_star_strip]
          dsimp [W]
          ring
        have hNorm3 : m_star ^ 3 ≤ ‖W z_star‖ * m_star + 128 * m_star / r_star ^ 2 := by
          have h1 : m_star ^ 3 = ‖S.f z_star ^ 3‖ := by simp [m_star]
          rw [h1, hODE_eq]
          calc ‖W z_star * S.f z_star - 8 * deriv (deriv S.f) z_star‖
              ≤ ‖W z_star * S.f z_star‖ + ‖8 * deriv (deriv S.f) z_star‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ = ‖W z_star‖ * m_star + 8 * ‖deriv (deriv S.f) z_star‖ := by simp [m_star]
            _ ≤ ‖W z_star‖ * m_star + 8 * (16 * m_star / r_star ^ 2) := by linarith
            _ = ‖W z_star‖ * m_star + 128 * m_star / r_star ^ 2 := by ring
        have hMul : r_star ^ 2 * m_star ^ 3 ≤ (r_star ^ 2 * ‖W z_star‖ + 128) * m_star := by
          have hr2_pos : 0 < r_star ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr_star_pos
          have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNorm3 hr2_pos.le
          have h3 : r_star ^ 2 * (‖W z_star‖ * m_star + 128 * m_star / r_star ^ 2) =
              (r_star ^ 2 * ‖W z_star‖ + 128) * m_star := by
            field_simp [ne_of_gt hr_star_pos]
          linarith
        have hCancel : r_star ^ 2 * m_star ^ 2 ≤ r_star ^ 2 * ‖W z_star‖ + 128 := by nlinarith
        have hr_sq_le : r_star ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hr_star_nonneg hr_star_le 2
        have hW_z_star : r_star ^ 2 * ‖W z_star‖ ≤ sSup S_W :=
          le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr_sq_le (norm_nonneg _)) (hle_MW z_star hz_star_mem)
        calc A ^ 2 = r_star ^ 2 * m_star ^ 2 := by rw [← hprod]; ring
          _ ≤ r_star ^ 2 * ‖W z_star‖ + 128 := hCancel
          _ ≤ 128 + sSup S_W := by linarith
    have hf_sq : (r * ‖S.f z₀‖) ^ 2 ≤ 128 + sSup S_W :=
      le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hΦ_z₀ 2) hA_sq
    have hq_bound : r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖ ≤ 128 * (1 + sSup S_W) := by
      have h8q : 8 * S.q z₀ = W z₀ - S.f z₀ ^ 2 := by dsimp [W]; ring
      have hnorm8q : 8 * (r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖) ≤ sSup S_W + (128 + sSup S_W) := by
        have h1 : 8 * ‖S.q z₀‖ = ‖8 * S.q z₀‖ := by simp
        calc 8 * (r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖)
            = r ^ 2 * (8 * ‖S.q z₀‖) := by ring
          _ = r ^ 2 * ‖W z₀ - S.f z₀ ^ 2‖ := by rw [h1, h8q]
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * (‖W z₀‖ + ‖S.f z₀ ^ 2‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sub_le _ _) (by positivity)
          _ = r ^ 2 * ‖W z₀‖ + (r * ‖S.f z₀‖) ^ 2 := by simp [norm_pow]; ring
          _ ≤ sSup S_W + (128 + sSup S_W) :=
              add_le_add (hle_MW z₀ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)) hf_sq
      linarith
    have hShapeSq : (r * shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2 =
        max ((r * ‖S.f z₀‖) ^ 2) (r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖) := by
      dsimp [shapeModulus]
      rcases le_total ‖S.f z₀‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) with h | h
      · have h1 : r * ‖S.f z₀‖ ≤ r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hr.le
        have h2 : (r * ‖S.f z₀‖) ^ 2 ≤ (r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 2
        have h3 : (r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖ := by
          rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        rw [max_eq_right h, h3, max_eq_right (h3 ▸ h2)]
      · have h1 : r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖ ≤ r * ‖S.f z₀‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hr.le
        have h2 : (r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) ^ 2 ≤ (r * ‖S.f z₀‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 2
        have h3 : (r * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * ‖S.q z₀‖ := by
          rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (h3 ▸ h2)]
    rw [hShapeSq, max_le_iff]
    exact ⟨by linarith, hq_bound⟩

  
  let avgW : ℂ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (S.f x ^ 2 + 8 * S.q x)
  have hW_from_V : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip S.H,
      ‖S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w‖ ≤ 120 * ‖deriv S.V w‖ + ‖avgW‖ := by
    intro w hw
    have hderiv := S.V_deriv w hw
    have heq : S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w = 120 * deriv S.V w + avgW := by
      dsimp [avgW]
      linear_combination -120 * hderiv
    rw [heq]
    calc ‖120 * deriv S.V w + avgW‖
        ≤ ‖120 * deriv S.V w‖ + ‖avgW‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = 120 * ‖deriv S.V w‖ + ‖avgW‖ := by simp

  
  have hRowBallSup : ∃ C_sup : ℝ, 0 < C_sup ∧
      ∀ k x₀ : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        (Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x₀)) ^ 2 ≤
          C_sup * (1 + sSup ((fun w : ℂ => Real.exp (-k) * ‖S.V w‖) ''
            Metric.closedBall (bootRowPt S k x₀) (Real.exp (-k) / 2))) := by
    refine ⟨2048 * (31 + ‖avgW‖), by positivity, fun k x₀ hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, hdk_le_49, hdk_le_H20⟩ := hk_depth k hk
    set d_k := Real.exp (-k)
    have hdk_pos : 0 < d_k := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    set z₀ := bootRowPt S k x₀
    have hSubHalf : Metric.closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2) ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
      have him_diff : |ζ.im - (S.H - d_k)| ≤ d_k / 2 := by
        have h1 : |(ζ - z₀).im| ≤ ‖ζ - z₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        rw [Complex.sub_im, hBootIm] at h1
        exact le_trans h1 hζ
      change |ζ.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_le] at him_diff
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    set S_V : Set ℝ := (fun w : ℂ => d_k * ‖S.V w‖) '' Metric.closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2)
    have hContSV : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => d_k * ‖S.V w‖) (Metric.closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2)) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul (S.V_holo.continuousOn.norm.mono hSubHalf)
    have hBddSV : BddAbove S_V :=
      ((isCompact_closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2)).image_of_continuousOn hContSV).bddAbove
    have hSV_nonneg : 0 ≤ sSup S_V :=
      le_trans (by positivity)
        (le_csSup hBddSV ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity), rfl⟩)
    let r := d_k / 4
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hSubQtr : Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H :=
      Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by dsimp [r]; linarith)) hSubHalf
    have hODE_z₀ := hODE z₀ r hr_pos hSubQtr
    have hSupW : sSup ((fun w : ℂ => r ^ 2 * ‖S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w‖) '' Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ≤
        30 * sSup S_V + ‖avgW‖ := by
      refine csSup_le ((Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr hr_pos.le).image _) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      have hSubW : Metric.closedBall w r ⊆ Metric.closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw hζ ⊢
        calc ‖ζ - z₀‖ = ‖(ζ - w) + (w - z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖ζ - w‖ + ‖w - z₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add hζ hw
          _ = d_k / 2 := by dsimp [r]; ring
      have hDiffCl : DiffContOnCl ℂ S.V (Metric.ball w r) :=
        (S.V_holo.mono (Subset.trans Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall
          (Subset.trans hSubW hSubHalf))).diffContOnCl
      have hSphere : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere w r, ‖S.V ζ‖ ≤ sSup S_V / d_k := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_mem : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ (d_k / 2) := hSubW (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)
        have hle : d_k * ‖S.V ζ‖ ≤ sSup S_V := le_csSup hBddSV ⟨ζ, hζ_mem, rfl⟩
        exact (le_div_iff₀' hdk_pos).mpr hle
      have hDerivV := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr_pos hDiffCl hSphere
      have hW_w := hW_from_V w (hSubQtr hw)
      have hr2_le_one : r ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        have hr_le : r ≤ 1 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
        nlinarith
      have h1 : r ^ 2 * (120 * (sSup S_V / d_k / r)) = 30 * sSup S_V := by
        dsimp [r]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hdk_pos]
        ring
      calc r ^ 2 * ‖S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w‖
          ≤ r ^ 2 * (120 * ‖deriv S.V w‖ + ‖avgW‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW_w (by positivity)
        _ ≤ r ^ 2 * (120 * (sSup S_V / d_k / r) + ‖avgW‖) := by gcongr
        _ = 30 * sSup S_V + r ^ 2 * ‖avgW‖ := by linear_combination h1
        _ ≤ 30 * sSup S_V + 1 * ‖avgW‖ := by gcongr
        _ = 30 * sSup S_V + ‖avgW‖ := by ring
    calc (d_k * shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2
        = 16 * (r * shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2 := by dsimp [r]; ring
      _ ≤ 16 * (128 * (1 + sSup ((fun w : ℂ => r ^ 2 * ‖S.f w ^ 2 + 8 * S.q w‖) ''
            Metric.closedBall z₀ r))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hODE_z₀ (by positivity)
      _ ≤ 2048 * (1 + (30 * sSup S_V + ‖avgW‖)) := by linarith
      _ ≤ 2048 * (31 + ‖avgW‖) * (1 + sSup S_V) := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg avgW]

  
  have hCauchyImDeriv : ∀ (w : ℂ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      Metric.closedBall w R ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      ‖deriv S.V w‖ ≤ 3 / (Real.pi * R ^ 3) * ∫ ζ in Metric.ball w R, |(S.V ζ).im| := by
    intro w R hR hsub
    have hCircleBound : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) R,
        Real.pi * ρ ^ 2 * ‖deriv S.V w‖ ≤
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)).im| := by
      intro ρ hρ
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hρ.1 with rfl | hρ_pos
      · simp
      · have hSubρ : Metric.closedBall w ρ ⊆ horizStrip S.H :=
          Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ.2) hsub
        have hc1 := (S.V_holo.mono hSubρ).deriv_eq_smul_circleIntegral hρ_pos
        have hc0 := ((S.V_holo.mono (Subset.trans Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall hSubρ)).diffContOnCl).circleIntegral_eq_zero hρ_pos.le
        rw [circleIntegral] at hc1 hc0
        have hρ_ne : (ρ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hρ_pos)
        set I₁ : ℂ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)
        have hc1_simp : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            deriv (circleMap w ρ) θ • ((1 / (circleMap w ρ θ - w) ^ 2) • S.V (circleMap w ρ θ))) =
            (Complex.I / (ρ : ℂ)) * I₁ := by
          dsimp only [I₁]
          rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro θ _
          dsimp only
          rw [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center,
            show -(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I = -((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) by ring, Complex.exp_neg]
          simp only [circleMap, zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
          have hexp_ne : Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
          field_simp [hρ_ne, hexp_ne]
        rw [hc1_simp] at hc1
        have hc1' : I₁ = (2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) * deriv S.V w := by
          have hI : Complex.I ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
          rw [smul_eq_mul] at hc1
          calc I₁ = ((ρ : ℂ) / Complex.I) * ((Complex.I / (ρ : ℂ)) * I₁) := by
                field_simp [hρ_ne, hI]
            _ = ((ρ : ℂ) / Complex.I) * ((2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) * deriv S.V w) := by rw [hc1]
            _ = (2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) * deriv S.V w := by field_simp [hI]
        have hc0_simp : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            deriv (circleMap w ρ) θ • S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) =
            ((ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ) := by
          rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro θ _
          dsimp only
          rw [deriv_circleMap]
          simp only [circleMap, zero_add, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        rw [hc0_simp] at hc0
        have hc0' : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) = 0 :=
          (mul_eq_zero.mp hc0).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hρ_ne Complex.I_ne_zero)
        have hContCircleV : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) :=
          S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap w ρ)
            (fun θ => hSubρ (circleMap_mem_closedBall w hρ_pos.le θ))
        have hContPos : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) :=
          (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).mul hContCircleV
        have hContNeg : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) :=
          (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.neg.mul continuous_const)).mul hContCircleV
        have hConjComm := Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
          (hContPos.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        have hc0_conj : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * starRingEnd ℂ (S.V (circleMap w ρ θ))) = 0 := by
          have hfun : (fun θ : ℝ =>
              Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * starRingEnd ℂ (S.V (circleMap w ρ θ))) =
              fun θ : ℝ => Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap
                (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)) := by
            ext θ
            simp [Complex.conjCLE, ← Complex.exp_conj]
          rw [hfun, hConjComm, hc0', map_zero]
        have hContConj : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * starRingEnd ℂ (S.V (circleMap w ρ θ))) :=
          (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.neg.mul continuous_const)).mul
            (Complex.continuous_conj.comp hContCircleV)
        have hDiffInt : (2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) * deriv S.V w =
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp (-(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
                (S.V (circleMap w ρ θ) - starRingEnd ℂ (S.V (circleMap w ρ θ))) := by
          have hsub_int := intervalIntegral.integral_sub
            (hContNeg.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
            (hContConj.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          simp_rw [← mul_sub] at hsub_int
          rw [hsub_int, hc0_conj, sub_zero]
          exact hc1'.symm
        have hNormInt : ‖(2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) * deriv S.V w‖ ≤
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 2 * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)).im| := by
          rw [hDiffInt]
          refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (by positivity) ?_
            ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp hContCircleV))).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ => ?_)
          have hz_im : ∀ z : ℂ, z - starRingEnd ℂ z = 2 * Complex.I * (z.im : ℂ) := by
            intro z; refine Complex.ext (by simp) (by simp; ring)
          rw [hz_im, norm_mul, show -(θ : ℂ) * Complex.I = ((-θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul,
            Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          norm_num
        have hLHS : ‖(2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) * deriv S.V w‖ = 2 * Real.pi * ρ * ‖deriv S.V w‖ := by
          have hpos : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ρ := by positivity
          rw [show (2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℂ) = ((2 * Real.pi * ρ : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
            norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hpos]
        rw [hLHS, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hNormInt
        have h1 : Real.pi * ρ * ‖deriv S.V w‖ ≤
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |(S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)).im| := by linarith
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hρ_pos.le
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h2
        linarith
    have hContImV : ContinuousOn (fun ζ : ℂ => |(S.V ζ).im|) (Metric.closedBall w R) :=
      (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im).comp_continuousOn (S.V_holo.continuousOn.mono hsub)
    have hPol := hPolarBall w R hR (fun ζ => |(S.V ζ).im|) hContImV
    have hIntRHS : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun ρ : ℝ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ θ)).im|)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 R := by
      have hCont2D : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * |(S.V (circleMap w p.1 p.2)).im|)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) R ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
        refine continuousOn_fst.mul (hContImV.comp ?_ ?_)
        · simp only [circleMap]
          exact (continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).mul
            (Complex.continuous_exp.comp ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul
              continuous_const)))).continuousOn
        · intro p hp
          exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hp.1.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall w hp.1.1 p.2)
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR.le]
      have hUnif := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hCont2D
      rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
      intro ρ₀ hρ₀ ε hε
      rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hUnif
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hUnif (ε / (4 * Real.pi)) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun ρ₁ hρ₁ hd => ?_⟩
      have hI₀ : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => ρ₀ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ₀ θ)).im|) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im).comp
          (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap w ρ₀)
            (fun θ => hsub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₀.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall w hρ₀.1 θ)))))).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hI₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => ρ₁ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ₁ θ)).im|) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im).comp
          (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap w ρ₁)
            (fun θ => hsub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₁.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall w hρ₁.1 θ)))))).intervalIntegrable _ _
      rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI₁ hI₀]
      have hle : ‖∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (ρ₁ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ₁ θ)).im| - ρ₀ * |(S.V (circleMap w ρ₀ θ)).im|)‖ ≤
          ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ε / (4 * Real.pi) :=
        intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (by positivity)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ hθ => by
            rw [← dist_eq_norm]
            exact le_of_lt (hδ (ρ₁, θ) ⟨hρ₁, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hθ⟩
              (ρ₀, θ) ⟨hρ₀, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hθ⟩ (by simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hd)))
          intervalIntegrable_const
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
      have hc : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ε / (4 * Real.pi)) = ε / 2 := by
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
        ring

        classical
        have hCoverZ : Z ⊆ ⋃ w ∈ Z, Metric.ball w (if h : w ∈ Z then δ_fn w h else 1) := by
          intro w hw
          refine Set.mem_biUnion hw ?_
          rw [dif_pos hw]
          exact Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_pos w hw)
        obtain ⟨F_fin, hF_sub, hF_fin, hF_cov⟩ := hCompZ.elim_finite_subcover_image
          (fun w _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hCoverZ
        have hZ_sub_F : Z ⊆ F_fin := by
          intro z hz
          have hz_mem := hF_cov hz
          rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz_mem with ⟨w, hwF, hzw⟩
          have hwZ : w ∈ Z := hF_sub hwF
          rw [dif_pos hwZ] at hzw
          have hzw_eq := hδ_iso w hwZ z hzw hz
          rwa [hzw_eq]
        have hFinZ : Z.Finite := hF_fin.subset hZ_sub_F
        let R_bad : Set ℝ := (fun w : ℂ => ‖w - z₀‖) '' Z
        have hMeasZeroBad : MeasureTheory.volume R_bad = 0 :=
          (hFinZ.image _).countable.measure_zero _
        have hCircleGood : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r \ R_bad,
            2 * Real.pi * ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖ ≤
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := by
          intro ρ ⟨hρ_Ioo, hρ_not_bad⟩
          have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := hρ_Ioo.1
          have hNoZeroSphere : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere z₀ ρ, S.q w ≠ 0 := by
            intro w hw hqw
            have hw_cl : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r :=
              Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ_Ioo.2.le (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
            apply hρ_not_bad
            refine ⟨w, ⟨hw_cl, hqw⟩, ?_⟩
            simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] using hw
          let K_ρ : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ|
          have hAn_ρ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S.q K_ρ := by
            refine hAnStrip.mono ?_
            dsimp [K_ρ]
            rw [abs_of_pos hρ_pos]
            exact Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ_Ioo.2.le) hsub
          have hMero_ρ : MeromorphicOn S.q K_ρ := hAn_ρ.meromorphicOn
          have hJensen := MeromorphicOn.circleAverage_log_norm (ne_of_gt hρ_pos) hMero_ρ
          have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ K_ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self (abs_nonneg ρ)
          have hAn_z₀ : AnalyticAt ℂ S.q z₀ := hAn_ρ z₀ hz₀_mem
          have hTrail : meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt S.q z₀ = S.q z₀ :=
            hAn_z₀.meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt_of_ne_zero hqz₀
          have hDiv_z₀ : MeromorphicOn.divisor S.q K_ρ z₀ = 0 := by
            rw [MeromorphicOn.divisor_apply hMero_ρ hz₀_mem]
            have hOrd : meromorphicOrderAt S.q z₀ = (0 : ℤ) := by
              rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hAn_z₀.meromorphicAt]
              exact ⟨S.q, hAn_z₀, hqz₀, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => by simp⟩
            simp [hOrd]
          have hFinsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ u : ℂ,
              (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.q K_ρ u : ℝ) * Real.log (ρ * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹) := by
            refine finsum_nonneg (fun u => ?_)
            by_cases hu_mem : u ∈ K_ρ
            · by_cases huz₀ : u = z₀
              · subst huz₀; simp [hDiv_z₀]
              · have hdiv_nn : 0 ≤ MeromorphicOn.divisor S.q K_ρ u :=
                  MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_nonneg hAn_ρ u
                have hdist_pos : 0 < ‖z₀ - u‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr (Ne.symm huz₀)
                have hdist_le : ‖z₀ - u‖ ≤ ρ := by
                  have h1 : dist u z₀ ≤ |ρ| := hu_mem
                  rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, abs_of_pos hρ_pos] at h1
                  exact h1
                have hlog_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (ρ * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹) := by
                  apply Real.log_nonneg
                  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, one_le_div hdist_pos]
                  exact hdist_le
                have hdiv_nn_R : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (MeromorphicOn.divisor S.q K_ρ u : ℝ) := by
                  exact_mod_cast hdiv_nn
                exact mul_nonneg hdiv_nn_R hlog_nn
            · have hdiv0 : MeromorphicOn.divisor S.q K_ρ u = 0 :=
                Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.apply_eq_zero_of_notMem _ hu_mem
              simp [hdiv0]
          rw [hTrail, hDiv_z₀] at hJensen
          simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hJensen
          have hLogLe : Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖ ≤
              Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖S.q x‖) z₀ ρ := by linarith
          rw [Real.circleAverage_def] at hLogLe
          simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hLogLe
          have hContCircleQ : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) :=
            S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap z₀ ρ)
              (fun θ => hsub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ_Ioo.2.le
                (circleMap_mem_closedBall z₀ hρ_pos.le θ)))
          have hPosCircleQ : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := fun θ =>
            norm_pos_iff.mpr (hNoZeroSphere _ (circleMap_mem_sphere z₀ hρ_pos.le θ))
          have hContLog : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) :=
            hContCircleQ.log (fun θ => ne_of_gt (hPosCircleQ θ))
          have hContSqrt : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) :=
            Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hContCircleQ
          let s₀ := Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖
          have hs₀_pos : 0 < s₀ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hqz₀)
          have hPtwise : ∀ θ : ℝ,
              s₀ * (1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖)) ≤
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := by
            intro θ
            have htan := Real.add_one_le_exp
              ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖))
            have hexp_eq : s₀ * Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖)) =
                Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := by
              have h1 : s₀ = Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖) := by
                dsimp [s₀]
                rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hqz₀)]
                ring_nf
              have h2 : Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ =
                  Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) := by
                rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (hPosCircleQ θ)]
                ring_nf
              rw [h1, h2, ← Real.exp_add]
              congr 1; ring
            calc s₀ * (1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖))
                ≤ s₀ * Real.exp ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hs₀_pos.le
              _ = Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := hexp_eq
          have hIntLog : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖)
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hContLog.intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hIntSub : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖)
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hIntLog.sub intervalIntegrable_const
          have hIntHalf : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖))
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hIntSub.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
          have hIntOneAdd : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => 1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖))
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            intervalIntegrable_const.add hIntHalf
          have hIntTan : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => s₀ * (1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖)))
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hIntOneAdd.const_mul s₀
          have hIntSqrtCirc : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖)
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hContSqrt.intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hIntMono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
            hIntTan hIntSqrtCirc (fun θ _ => hPtwise θ)
          have hEvalTan : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              s₀ * (1 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ - Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖))) =
              2 * Real.pi * s₀ + (s₀ / 2) * ((∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) - 2 * Real.pi * Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
                intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const hIntHalf,
                intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
                intervalIntegral.integral_sub hIntLog intervalIntegrable_const]
            simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
            ring
          have hLogDiff_nn : 0 ≤ (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Real.log ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖) - 2 * Real.pi * Real.log ‖S.q z₀‖ := by
            have hpi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
            have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLogLe hpi_pos.le
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpi_pos), one_mul] at hm
            linarith
          have hCircle1 : 2 * Real.pi * s₀ ≤
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := by
            rw [hEvalTan] at hIntMono
            nlinarith
          have hCircle2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCircle1 hρ_pos.le
          rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hCircle2
          linarith
        have hPol := hPolarBall z₀ r hr (fun w => Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖) hContSqrtQ
        have hIntRHS : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun ρ : ℝ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖)
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 r := by
          have hCont2D : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ p.1 p.2)‖)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) r ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
            refine continuousOn_fst.mul (hContSqrtQ.comp ?_ ?_)
            · simp only [circleMap]
              exact (continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).mul
                (Complex.continuous_exp.comp ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul
                  continuous_const)))).continuousOn
            · intro p hp
              exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hp.1.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall z₀ hp.1.1 p.2)
          apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le]
          have hUnif := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hCont2D
          rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
          intro ρ₀ hρ₀ ε hε
          rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hUnif
          obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos_u, hδ_u⟩ := hUnif (ε / (4 * Real.pi)) (by positivity)
          refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos_u, fun ρ₁ hρ₁ hd => ?_⟩
          have hI₀ : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => ρ₀ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ₀ θ)‖) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp
              (S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap z₀ ρ₀)
                (fun θ => hsub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₀.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall z₀ hρ₀.1 θ)))))).intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hI₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => ρ₁ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ₁ θ)‖) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp
              (S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap z₀ ρ₁)
                (fun θ => hsub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₁.2 (circleMap_mem_closedBall z₀ hρ₁.1 θ)))))).intervalIntegrable _ _
          rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI₁ hI₀]
          have hle : ‖∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (ρ₁ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ₁ θ)‖ -
                ρ₀ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ₀ θ)‖)‖ ≤
              ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ε / (4 * Real.pi) :=
            intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (by positivity)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ hθ => by
                rw [← dist_eq_norm]
                exact le_of_lt (hδ_u (ρ₁, θ) ⟨hρ₁, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hθ⟩
                  (ρ₀, θ) ⟨hρ₀, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hθ⟩ (by simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hd)))
              intervalIntegrable_const
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hle
          have hc : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ε / (4 * Real.pi)) = ε / 2 := by
            simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
            field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
            ring
          linarith
        have hIntLHS : IntervalIntegrable (fun ρ : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖)
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 r :=
          ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
        have hAE : (fun ρ : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 r)]
            fun ρ : ℝ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := by
          change ∀ᵐ ρ ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 r), _
          rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc]
          have hNull : MeasureTheory.volume (R_bad ∪ ({0, r} : Set ℝ)) = 0 :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_union_null hMeasZeroBad
              (MeasureTheory.measure_union_null (MeasureTheory.measure_singleton 0)
                (MeasureTheory.measure_singleton r))
          rw [← MeasureTheory.compl_mem_ae_iff] at hNull
          filter_upwards [hNull] with ρ hρ_compl hρ_Icc
          apply hCircleGood
          refine ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hρ_Icc.1 (fun h => hρ_compl (Or.inr (Or.inl h.symm))),
            lt_of_le_of_ne hρ_Icc.2 (fun h => hρ_compl (Or.inr (Or.inr h)))⟩,
            fun h => hρ_compl (Or.inl h)⟩
        have hMono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict hr.le hIntLHS hIntRHS hAE
        have hEvalLHS : (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..r, 2 * Real.pi * ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) =
            Real.pi * r ^ 2 * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖ := by
          have h1 : (fun ρ : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ρ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) =
              fun ρ : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) * ρ := by ext ρ; ring
          rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]
          ring
        rw [hEvalLHS, ← hPol] at hMono
        have hpir2 : 0 < Real.pi * r ^ 2 := by positivity
        exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hpir2).mpr hMono
    have hShapeSqEq : (shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2 = max (‖S.f z₀‖ ^ 2) ‖S.q z₀‖ := by
      dsimp [shapeModulus]
      rcases le_total ‖S.f z₀‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q z₀‖) with h | h
      · have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)] at h2
        rw [max_eq_right h, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _), max_eq_right h2]
      · have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h 2
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)] at h2
        rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left h2]
    refine ⟨max_le hf1 hq_half, ?_⟩
    rw [hShapeSqEq]
    exact max_le hf2 hq1

  
  have hTileGeom : ∀ A k : ℝ, 0 ≤ A → criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      (bootRowPt S k 0 ∈ upperStripTile S A k 0) ∧
      IsCompact (upperStripTile S A k 0) ∧
      (upperStripTile S A k 0 ⊆ horizStrip S.H) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, upperStripTile S A k x = ((fun w : ℂ => (x : ℂ) + w) '' upperStripTile S A k 0)) := by
    intro A k hA hk
    obtain ⟨_, _, hdk_le_H20⟩ := hk_depth k hk
    set d_k := Real.exp (-k)
    have hdk_pos : 0 < d_k := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    have hMem0 : bootRowPt S k 0 ∈ upperStripTile S A k 0 := by
      change 0 ≤ (bootRowPt S k 0).im ∧
        Real.exp (-A) * d_k ≤ S.H - (bootRowPt S k 0).im ∧
        S.H - (bootRowPt S k 0).im ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * d_k) ∧
        |(bootRowPt S k 0).re - 0| ≤ A * (S.H - (bootRowPt S k 0).im)
      rw [hBootIm, hBootRe, sub_zero, abs_zero]
      have heA1 : Real.exp (-A) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      have heA2 : 1 ≤ Real.exp A := Real.one_le_exp hA
      have hwd : S.H - (S.H - Real.exp (-k)) = d_k := by dsimp [d_k]; ring
      rw [hwd]
      refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_, by positivity⟩
      · calc Real.exp (-A) * d_k ≤ 1 * d_k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right heA1 hdk_pos.le
          _ = d_k := one_mul _
      · rw [le_min_iff]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by nlinarith⟩
    have hSub0 : upperStripTile S A k 0 ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro w hw
      rcases hw with ⟨hw_im0, hw_lo, _, _⟩
      change |w.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hw_im0]
      have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * d_k := by positivity
      dsimp [wallDepth] at hw_lo
      linarith
    have hClosed0 : IsClosed (upperStripTile S A k 0) := by
      have h1 : IsClosed {w : ℂ | 0 ≤ w.im} := isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
      have h2 : IsClosed {w : ℂ | Real.exp (-A) * d_k ≤ S.H - w.im} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)
      have h3 : IsClosed {w : ℂ | S.H - w.im ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * d_k)} :=
        isClosed_le (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
      have h4 : IsClosed {w : ℂ | |w.re - 0| ≤ A * (S.H - w.im)} :=
        isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))
      exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
    have hBdd0 : Bornology.IsBounded (upperStripTile S A k 0) := by
      rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : ℂ)]
      refine ⟨(A + 1) * S.H, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      rcases hw with ⟨hw_im0, hw_lo, hw_hi, hw_re⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hw_im_le : w.im ≤ S.H := by dsimp [wallDepth] at hw_lo; linarith [ show 0 < Real.exp (-A) * d_k by positivity ]
      have hw_wd_le : wallDepth S w ≤ S.H := by dsimp [wallDepth]; linarith
      have hw_re_le : |w.re| ≤ A * S.H := by
        simpa using le_trans hw_re (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_wd_le hA)
      calc ‖w‖ ≤ |w.re| + |w.im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im w
        _ = |w.re| + w.im := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hw_im0]
        _ ≤ A * S.H + S.H := add_le_add hw_re_le hw_im_le
        _ = (A + 1) * S.H := by ring
    have hShiftTile : ∀ x : ℝ,
        upperStripTile S A k x = ((fun w : ℂ => (x : ℂ) + w) '' upperStripTile S A k 0) := by
      intro x
      ext s
      constructor
      · intro hs
        refine ⟨s - (x : ℂ), ?_, by ring⟩
        rcases hs with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
        refine ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa [wallDepth] using h2,
          by simpa [wallDepth] using h3, by simpa [wallDepth] using h4⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa [wallDepth] using h2,
          by simpa [wallDepth] using h3, ?_⟩
        have hre : ((x : ℂ) + w).re - x = w.re - 0 := by simp
        have hwd : wallDepth S ((x : ℂ) + w) = wallDepth S w := by simp [wallDepth]
        rwa [hre, hwd]
    exact ⟨hMem0, Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hClosed0 hBdd0, hSub0, hShiftTile⟩
