            rw [max_eq_right h, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _), max_eq_right h2]
          · have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h 2
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)] at h2
            rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left h2]
        change (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S l x)) ^ 2 ≤ _
        rw [hmax]
        exact max_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _)) (le_add_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _))
      have hexp_lk : d_k * Real.exp l ≤ Real.exp (A + 1) := by
        dsimp [d_k]
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by dsimp [l_hi] at hl_m; linarith [hl_m.2])
      have hMomEq := hRowMomSqEq l hl_m
      have hExpCancel : Real.exp (-l) * Real.exp (2 * l) = Real.exp l := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      have hIntFQ_nn : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (bootRowPt S l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S l x)‖) :=
        mul_nonneg (by positivity) (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by positivity) fun _ _ => by positivity)
      have hMomInv : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (bootRowPt S l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S l x)‖)) =
          Real.exp (2 * l) * (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hMomEq, ← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
        norm_num
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * L_k * Real.exp (-l) * Φ_row (bootRowPt S l 0))
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * L_k * Real.exp (-l) *
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (‖S.f (bootRowPt S l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S l x)‖)) := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * L_k * Real.exp (-l) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (‖S.f (bootRowPt S l x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S l x)‖)) := by ring
        _ = 2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp A * d_k * (Real.exp (-l) * Real.exp (2 * l)) *
              (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by rw [hMomInv]; dsimp [L_k]; ring
        _ = 2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp A * (d_k * Real.exp l) * (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by
              rw [hExpCancel]; ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp A * Real.exp (A + 1) * (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1) * (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by
              rw [mul_assoc (2 * (A + 1)), ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have hAvgRx : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        ∫ w in R_x x, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1) *
          ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hSwapEq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hl_le
        (hIntΦ_l.const_mul _) (hIntRowMomSq.const_mul _) hBoundL
    have hIntTileSq : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (((hTileContPer A k hA0 hk).1).pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hIntRxOfX : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x => ∫ w in R_x x, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      simp_rw [hRx_shift]
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)]
      have hUnif := (isCompact_Icc.prod hCompR0).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hContJoint
      rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
      intro x₀ hx₀ ε hε
      rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hUnif
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hUnif (ε / (2 * (MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ + 1))) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun x₁ hx₁ hd => ?_⟩
      have hI₀ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ζ => (shapeModulus S ((x₀ : ℂ) + ζ)) ^ 2) R₀ MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (hContJoint.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
          (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hx₀, hζ⟩)).integrableOn_compact hCompR0
      have hI₁ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ζ => (shapeModulus S ((x₁ : ℂ) + ζ)) ^ 2) R₀ MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (hContJoint.comp (Continuous.continuousOn (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
          (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hx₁, hζ⟩)).integrableOn_compact hCompR0
      rw [Real.dist_eq, ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub hI₁ hI₀]
      have hle : ‖∫ ζ in R₀, ((shapeModulus S ((x₁ : ℂ) + ζ)) ^ 2 -
          (shapeModulus S ((x₀ : ℂ) + ζ)) ^ 2)‖ ≤
          ∫ _ in R₀, (ε / (2 * (MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ + 1))) := by
        refine le_trans (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) ?_
        refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on (hI₁.sub hI₀).norm
          (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hCompR0.measure_lt_top.ne)
          ((isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
            ((isClosed_le Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
              ((isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
                (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))).measurableSet
          (fun ζ hζ => le_of_lt (hδ (x₁, ζ) ⟨hx₁, hζ⟩ (x₀, ζ) ⟨hx₀, hζ⟩
            (by simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using hd)))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hle
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ := MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg
      have hlt : MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ * (ε / (2 * (MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ + 1))) < ε := by
        have hden : 0 < 2 * (MeasureTheory.volume.real R₀ + 1) := by positivity
        rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ hden]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have hMainMono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
      hIntTileSq
      (intervalIntegrable_const.add (hIntRxOfX.const_mul _))
      (fun x _ => hTilePt x)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const (hIntRxOfX.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hMainMono
    have hDiv2Pi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMainMono (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)
    have hSimpLHS : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi * M_low ^ 2 +
        (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ∫ w in R_x x, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2) =
        M_low ^ 2 + (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ w in R_x x, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2) := by
      have hpi : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hpi]
    rw [hSimpLHS] at hDiv2Pi
    have hCoef : (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * (2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1)) =
        8 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (4 * A + 1) / Real.pi := by
      calc (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * (2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1))
          = 8 * (A + 1) * (Real.exp (2 * A) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1)) / Real.pi := by ring
        _ = 8 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (4 * A + 1) / Real.pi := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have hMomIntNN : 0 ≤ ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hl_le (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hCt2_a : M_low ^ 2 ≤ C_t2 := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hCt2_b : 8 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (4 * A + 1) / Real.pi ≤ C_t2 :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2)
        ≤ M_low ^ 2 + (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ w in R_x x, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2) := hDiv2Pi
      _ ≤ M_low ^ 2 + (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) *
            (2 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * A + 1) *
              ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) := by gcongr
      _ = M_low ^ 2 + (8 * (A + 1) * Real.exp (4 * A + 1) / Real.pi) *
            ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 := by linear_combination hCoef * ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2
      _ ≤ C_t2 + C_t2 * ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 :=
          add_le_add hCt2_a (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCt2_b hMomIntNN)
      _ = C_t2 * (1 + ∫ l in l_lo..l_hi, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) := by ring

  exact
    { zero_row_mean_P := hRowMean
      real_axis_im_zero := hRealIm
      row_ball_from_V_sup := hRowBallSup
      row_cell_from_P_int := hRowCellInt
      disk_submean_modulus := hDiskSubmean
      tile_cont_per := hTileContPer
      tile_L2_from_rows := hTileL2 }

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S)
    (hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S)
    (hConeData : ∀ β a C_N C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 1 ≤ C_N → 0 < C₁ →
      Nonempty (BootConeNegativePartData S β a C_N C₁)) :
    ∀ β a C_N C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 1 ≤ C_N → 0 < C₁ →
      ∃ C_boot η : ℝ, 0 < C_boot ∧ 0 < η ∧
        (∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
          (∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
            rowMomentFull S k ≤ C_boot * N k ∧
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Real.exp (-k) *
                |(S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im|) ≤
              C_boot * (N k) ^ 2 ∧
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (Real.exp (-k) *
                shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
                N k) ^ (2 + η)) ≤
              C_boot ^ (2 + η)) ∧
          (MonotoneOn N (Set.Ici (criticalDepthThreshold S)) →
            ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ,
              Real.exp (-k) *
                shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
                C_boot * (1 + k) * N k ∧
              Real.exp (-k) *
                |(S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
                C_boot * (1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2)) ∧
        (∀ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → ∃ C_tile : ℝ, 0 < C_tile ∧
          ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
            ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
              Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤ C_tile * N k)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hConeData β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1
  obtain ⟨C_quad, C_p, hCq, hCp, hQuad, hTile⟩ :=
    ucb_quadratic_and_tile_bootstrap S hInt β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 D
  have hStrip : UcbStripPoissonData S := ucb_strip_poisson_representation S hInt
  have hp : 1 < (4 * a + 3) / (4 * a + 2) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨η, C_conc, hη, hCconc, hConc⟩ :=
    ucb_higher_moment_concentration S hInt hStrip β a C_N C₁ C_quad C_p
      ((4 * a + 3) / (4 * a + 2)) hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 hCq hCp hp
      (fun N hN k hk => (hQuad N hN k hk).2.1)
      (fun N hN k hk => (hQuad N hN k hk).2.2)
  obtain ⟨C_mono, hCmono, hMono⟩ :=
    ucb_monotone_global_sup_bounds S hInt β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 D
  let C_boot : ℝ := max (max C_quad C_conc) C_mono
  have hCboot_pos : 0 < C_boot := lt_of_lt_of_le hCmono (le_max_right _ _)
  have hCq_le : C_quad ≤ C_boot := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hCconc_le : C_conc ≤ C_boot := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hCmono_le : C_mono ≤ C_boot := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨C_boot, η, hCboot_pos, hη, ?_, hTile⟩
  intro N hN
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    have hNk_ge_one : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    have hNk_nonneg : 0 ≤ N k := by linarith
    have hNk_sq_nonneg : 0 ≤ (N k) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (N k)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, _⟩ := hQuad N hN k hk
    have h3 := hConc N hN k hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq_le hNk_nonneg)
    · exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCq_le hNk_sq_nonneg)
    · exact le_trans h3 (Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hCconc) hCconc_le (by linarith))
  · intro hMonoN k hk x
    have hk0_ge_one : 1 ≤ criticalDepthThreshold S := by
      unfold criticalDepthThreshold
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hk_ge_one : 1 ≤ k := le_trans hk0_ge_one hk
    have hNk_ge_one : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    have h1k_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + k := by linarith
    have hNk_nonneg : 0 ≤ N k := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := hMono N hN hMonoN k hk x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        Real.exp (-k) *
            shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          ≤ C_mono * (1 + k) * N k := hm1
        _ ≤ C_boot * (1 + k) * N k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCmono_le h1k_nonneg) hNk_nonneg
    · calc
        Real.exp (-k) *
            |(S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im|
          ≤ C_mono * (1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := hm2
        _ ≤ C_boot * (1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCmono_le (sq_nonneg (1 + k))) (sq_nonneg (N k))

unweighted_critical_bootstrap.definitions:
structure UcbStripPoissonData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  kernel_cont : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y)
  kernel_periodic : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    Function.Periodic (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y) (2 * Real.pi)
  kernel_nonneg : ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    0 ≤ bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y
  kernel_integral : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y) = y / h'
  kernel_core_lower : ∃ c_core : ℝ, 0 < c_core ∧
    ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
      h' - y ≤ h' / 4 → |u| ≤ 4 * (h' - y) →
      c_core / (h' - y) ≤ bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y
  strip_harmonic_V : ∀ h' y x : ℝ, 0 < h' → h' < S.H → 0 < y → y < h' →
    (S.V ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
      ∫ ξ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        bootStripPoissonKernel h' (x - ξ) y *
          (S.V ((ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im

by
  intro β a C_N C₁ A hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 hA
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := hConeData β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1
  have hStrip : UcbStripPoissonData S := ucb_strip_poisson_representation S hInt
  obtain ⟨K_ker, C_bal, hK_ker, hC_bal, hBal⟩ := strip_ancestor_harmonic_modulus_balance S hStrip
  obtain ⟨hTileMono, hTile2, hTile3⟩ := weighted_tile_and_row_cell_transfer S hInt
  obtain ⟨C_tr_cone, hC_tr_cone, hTileCone⟩ := hTile2 D.A_cone D.one_le_A_cone
  obtain ⟨C_tr_A, hC_tr_A, hTileA⟩ := hTile2 A hA
  obtain ⟨C_rc, hC_rc, hRowCell⟩ := hTile3
  obtain ⟨C_sub, hC_sub, hSub⟩ :=
    cone_cost_weighted_subquad_bound S hInt β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 D
  let K_anc : ℝ := max K_ker (criticalDepthThreshold S + 2)
  let A_coarse : ℝ := max A D.A_cone
  have hk0_le_Kanc : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_anc := by
    linarith [le_max_right K_ker (criticalDepthThreshold S + 2)]
  have hKker_le_Kanc : K_ker ≤ K_anc := le_max_left _ _
  have hk0_add2_le_Kanc : criticalDepthThreshold S + 2 ≤ K_anc := le_max_right _ _
  have hA_le_Acoarse : A ≤ A_coarse := le_max_left _ _
  have hAcone_le_Acoarse : D.A_cone ≤ A_coarse := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨K_anc, A_coarse, hk0_le_Kanc, hA_le_Acoarse, ?_⟩
  intro M_coarse M_anc hM_coarse hM_anc
  let γ : ℝ := 1 / (1 + a)
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := by
    dsimp [γ]
    positivity
  have hγ_lt1 : γ < 1 := by
    dsimp [γ]
    rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
    linarith
  let m : ℝ := 4 * (2 - γ) / (4 - γ)
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hm_sub : 0 < 2 - m := by
    have h_eq : 2 - m = 2 * γ / (4 - γ) := by
      dsimp [m]
      field_simp [show (4 - γ : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hm_lt2 : m < 2 := by linarith
  let μ_ba : ℝ := max β a
  have hμ_ba_pos : 0 < μ_ba := lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_max_right β a)
  let C_cone_t : ℝ :=
    max 1 (C_N * Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * C_tr_cone * (D.A_cone + 1) * Real.exp (2 * μ_ba * (D.A_cone + 1))))
  let C_A_t : ℝ :=
    max 1 (C_N * Real.sqrt (1 + 2 * C_tr_A * (A + 1) * Real.exp (2 * μ_ba * (A + 1))))
  have hC_cone_t_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_cone_t := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_cone_t_pos : 0 < C_cone_t := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_cone_t_ge1
  have hC_A_t_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_A_t := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_A_t_pos : 0 < C_A_t := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_A_t_ge1
  let C_env1 : ℝ := C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * μ_ba)
  have hC_env1_pos : 0 < C_env1 := by
    dsimp [C_env1]
    positivity
  have h_pow1_pos : 0 < (1 + C_cone_t * M_coarse) ^ m :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) m
  have h_pow2_pos : 0 < C_cone_t ^ m :=
    Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hC_cone_t_pos m
  let K_0 : ℝ :=
    C_rc * (1 + 2 * C_env1 * C_bal *
      (4 * C_sub * (1 + C_cone_t * M_coarse) ^ m + C_N ^ 2 * M_anc))
  let K_1 : ℝ :=
    8 * C_rc * C_env1 * C_bal * C_sub * C_cone_t ^ m
  have hK0_pos : 0 < K_0 := by
    dsimp [K_0]
    positivity
  have hK1_pos : 0 < K_1 := by
    dsimp [K_1]
    positivity
  let B_fine : ℝ := max 1 (max (Real.sqrt (2 * K_0)) ((2 * K_1) ^ (1 / (2 - m))))
  have hB_fine_ge1 : 1 ≤ B_fine := le_max_left _ _
  have hB_fine_pos : 0 < B_fine := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB_fine_ge1
  let C_w : ℝ := C_A_t * (M_coarse + B_fine)
  have hCw_pos : 0 < C_w := by
    dsimp [C_w]
    positivity
  refine ⟨C_w, hCw_pos, ?_⟩
  intro N k_a w hN hk_a hw_cont hw_per hw_nonneg hw_mean hCoarse hAnc
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
  have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le
  have hk_a_ge_k0 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_a := le_trans hk0_le_Kanc hk_a
  have hk_a_ge_k0_add1 : criticalDepthThreshold S + 1 ≤ k_a := by linarith
  have hk_a_ge_ker : K_ker ≤ k_a := le_trans hKker_le_Kanc hk_a
  let d_a : ℝ := Real.exp (-k_a)
  have hda_pos : 0 < d_a := Real.exp_pos (-k_a)
  let ν : ℝ → ℝ := ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w
  obtain ⟨_, hν_cont, hν_per, hν_mean, hν_bounds, hν_shift⟩ :=
    periodic_poisson_and_ancestor_density_bounds d_a w hda_pos hw_cont hw_per hw_nonneg hw_mean
  have hν_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ν x := fun x => (hν_bounds x).1
  let K_max : ℝ := Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - 1)
  have hν_le_max : ∀ x : ℝ, ν x ≤ K_max := fun x => (hν_bounds x).2
  have hKmax_nonneg : 0 ≤ K_max := le_trans (hν_nonneg 0) (hν_le_max 0)
  have hRowMem : ∀ r : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r → ∀ x : ℝ, bootRowPt S r x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro r hr x
    have hlog : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ r :=
      le_trans (le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))) hr
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-r) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      calc Real.exp (-r) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) :=
            Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-r) := Real.exp_pos (-r)
    have him : (bootRowPt S r x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-r) := by
      dsimp [bootRowPt]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    change |(bootRowPt S r x).im| < S.H
    rw [him, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hRowContMod : ∀ r : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) := by
    intro r hr
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => bootRowPt S r x) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hf_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.f (bootRowPt S r x)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (hRowMem r hr)
    have hq_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.q (bootRowPt S r x)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (hRowMem r hr)
    exact hf_c.norm.max (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hq_c.norm)
  have hRowContFq : ∀ r : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) := by
    intro r hr
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => bootRowPt S r x) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hf_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.f (bootRowPt S r x)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (hRowMem r hr)
    have hq_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.q (bootRowPt S r x)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (hRowMem r hr)
    exact (hf_c.norm.pow 2).add hq_c.norm
  have hRowContVim : ∀ r : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (S.V (bootRowPt S r x)).im) := by
    intro r hr
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => bootRowPt S r x) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    exact Complex.continuous_im.comp
      (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (hRowMem r hr))
  let R_ν : ℝ → ℝ := fun r =>
    Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 * ν x)
  have hRν_nonneg : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ R_ν r := fun r => Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hRν_sq : ∀ r : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r →
      (R_ν r) ^ 2 = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 * ν x := by
    intro r _
    apply Real.sq_sqrt
    exact mul_nonneg h2pi_inv_nonneg
      (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hν_nonneg x)))
  obtain ⟨M_fin, hM_fin_pos, hM_fin⟩ := hN.finite_ratio
  have hBdd : BddAbove ((fun r : ℝ => R_ν r / N r) '' Set.Ici (k_a + 3)) := by
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt K_max * M_fin, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr_mem, rfl⟩
    have hr_k0 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ r := by
      have : k_a + 3 ≤ r := hr_mem
      linarith
    have hNr_ge1 : 1 ≤ N r := hN.one_le r hr_k0
    have hNr_pos : 0 < N r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNr_ge1
    have h_mod_sq : ∀ x : ℝ,
        (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 ≤
          ‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖ := by
      intro x
      dsimp [shapeModulus]
      rcases max_choice ‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) with h | h <;> rw [h]
      · linarith [norm_nonneg (S.q (bootRowPt S r x))]
      · rw [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        linarith [sq_nonneg ‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖]
    have h_int_lhs : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 * ν x)

      (((continuous_const.mul (hRowContMod r hr_k0)).pow 2).mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_rhs : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (K_max * (Real.exp (-r)) ^ 2) *
          (‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul (hRowContFq r hr_k0)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_le :
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
        (K_max * (Real.exp (-r)) ^ 2) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int_lhs h_int_rhs (fun x _ => ?_)
      have h1 : (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 ≤
          (Real.exp (-r)) ^ 2 * (‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) := by
        rw [mul_pow]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_mod_sq x) (sq_nonneg _)
      calc (Real.exp (-r) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S r x)) ^ 2 * ν x
          ≤ (Real.exp (-r)) ^ 2 * (‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) * K_max :=
            mul_le_mul h1 (hν_le_max x) (hν_nonneg x) (by positivity)
        _ = (K_max * (Real.exp (-r)) ^ 2) *
            (‖S.f (bootRowPt S r x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S r x)‖) := by ring
    have hRν_le : R_ν r ≤ Real.sqrt K_max * rowMomentFull S r := by
      dsimp [R_ν, rowMomentFull, bootRowPt] at h_int_le ⊢
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le h2pi_inv_nonneg
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_mul
      have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :=
        mul_nonneg h2pi_inv_nonneg
          (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (fun x _ => by positivity))
      have h_eq_rhs :
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((K_max * Real.exp (-r) ^ 2) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)) =
          K_max * (Real.exp (-r) ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-r) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖))) := by ring
      rw [h_eq_rhs, Real.sqrt_mul hKmax_nonneg, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _),

    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) = 1 ∧

      ∃ L_star : ℝ, 0 < L_star ∧
        ∀ β a C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 0 < C₀ →
          ∀ k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ,
            (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n) →
            Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
            (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
              rowMomentFull S l ≤ C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) *
                Real.exp (β * max (k_seq n - l) 0 + a * max (l - k_seq n) 0)) →
            ¬ (∀ c_depth ε : ℝ, 0 < c_depth → 0 < ε →
              ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
                c_depth * Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
                wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
                |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
                (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) *
                  shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / Real.exp (-k_seq n)) ^ α ≤ ε)

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hCrit
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  
  have h_row_strip : ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
      |S.H - Real.exp (-l)| < S.H ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, bootRowPt S l x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro l hl
    have hlog : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ l := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hl
    have hSH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-l) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      calc Real.exp (-l)
        _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by positivity)
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-l) := Real.exp_pos (-l)
    have habs : |S.H - Real.exp (-l)| < S.H := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    refine ⟨habs, fun x => ?_⟩
    change |((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-l) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
    have him : ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-l) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im =
        S.H - Real.exp (-l) := by
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
    rwa [him]
  
  have swap_cont : ∀ (a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀ : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      a₀ ≤ b₀ → c₀ ≤ d₀ → Continuous (Function.uncurry F) →
      (∫ x in a₀..b₀, ∫ y in c₀..d₀, F x y) = ∫ y in c₀..d₀, ∫ x in a₀..b₀, F x y := by
    intro a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀ F hab hcd hF
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hcd]
    apply MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
    have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.Icc a₀ b₀ ×ˢ Set.Icc c₀ d₀) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F)
        (Set.Icc a₀ b₀ ×ˢ Set.Icc c₀ d₀) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hcomp
    refine hint.mono_set ?_
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab]
    exact Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
  
  have periodic_shift_integral : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi) → ∀ w : ℝ,
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (w + x)) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x := by
    intro g hg w
    have h1 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (w + x)) =
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (x + w) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ => ?_
      rw [add_comm]
    rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right]
    simpa [zero_add, add_comm] using hg.intervalIntegral_add_eq w 0
  
  have mean_le_rms_of_cont : ∀ (g h : ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous g → Continuous h → (∀ x : ℝ, (g x) ^ 2 ≤ h x) →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x) ≤
        Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h x) := by
    intro g h hg hh hgh
    set I₁ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x
    set I₂ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x) ^ 2
    have h_var_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x - I₁) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hg.intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hg2_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (g x) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hg.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hh_int : IntervalIntegrable h MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hh.intervalIntegrable _ _
    have h_expand : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x - I₁) ^ 2) =
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x) ^ 2) -
          (2 * I₁) * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x) + (2 * Real.pi) * I₁ ^ 2 := by
      have h_eq : (fun x => (g x - I₁) ^ 2) =
          fun x => ((g x) ^ 2 - (2 * I₁) * g x) + I₁ ^ 2 := by
        ext x; ring
      rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_add (hg2_int.sub (hg_int.const_mul (2 * I₁)))
        intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hg2_int (hg_int.const_mul (2 * I₁)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp [smul_eq_mul]
    have hI1_def : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x) = (2 * Real.pi) * I₁ := by
      dsimp [I₁]; field_simp [h2pi_pos.ne']
    have hI2_def : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x) ^ 2) = (2 * Real.pi) * I₂ := by
      dsimp [I₂]; field_simp [h2pi_pos.ne']
    have h_sq_le_I2 : I₁ ^ 2 ≤ I₂ := by
      rw [h_expand, hI1_def, hI2_def] at h_var_nonneg
      have h_prod : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi) * (I₂ - I₁ ^ 2) := by linarith
      have h_sub : 0 ≤ I₂ - I₁ ^ 2 := nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_prod h2pi_pos
      linarith
    have h_I2_le : I₂ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h x := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le hg2_int hh_int (fun x _ => hgh x)
    exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (h_sq_le_I2.trans h_I2_le)
  
  obtain ⟨C_cell, hCcell_pos, hCell⟩ := hInt.row_cell_from_P_int
  set C_band : ℝ := 16 * C_cell
  have hCband_pos : 0 < C_band := by positivity
  have h_row_band : ∀ k M_band : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S + 1 ≤ k → 0 ≤ M_band →
      (∀ l ∈ Set.Icc (k - 1) (k + 1),
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0) ≤ M_band) →
      (rowMomentFull S k) ^ 2 ≤ C_band * (1 + M_band) := by
    intro k M_band hk1 hM_nonneg hBand
    have hk0 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k := by linarith
    let h_full : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      ‖S.f (bootRowPt S k x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖
    let g_mod : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      (Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2
    have hΦk_cont : Continuous (bootRowPt S k) := by
      unfold bootRowPt; fun_prop
    have hsf_cont : Continuous (fun x => S.f (bootRowPt S k x)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦk_cont (h_row_strip k hk0).2
    have hsq_cont : Continuous (fun x => S.q (bootRowPt S k x)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦk_cont (h_row_strip k hk0).2
    have hh_full_cont : Continuous h_full :=
      (hsf_cont.norm.pow 2).add hsq_cont.norm
    have hg_mod_cont : Continuous g_mod := by
      unfold g_mod shapeModulus
      exact (continuous_const.mul (hsf_cont.norm.max (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hsq_cont.norm))).pow 2
    have h_mu_sq : (rowMomentFull S k) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀) := by
      have h_int_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_full x := by
        refine mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le) ?_
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (fun x _ => by positivity)
      have h_eq_mu : (rowMomentFull S k) ^ 2 =
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * h_full x := by
        unfold rowMomentFull
        change (Real.exp (-k) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_full x)) ^ 2 = _
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h_int_nonneg]
        have hp : (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_full x) =
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * h_full x :=
          (intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _).symm
        calc (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_full x)
          _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_full x) := by
              ring
          _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * h_full x := by
              rw [hp]
      have h_rhs_pull : 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀) =
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 2 * g_mod x₀ := by
        have hp : 2 * (∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀) =
            ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 2 * g_mod x₀ :=
          (intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _).symm
        calc 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀)
          _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀) := by ring
          _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 2 * g_mod x₀ := by rw [hp]
      rw [h_eq_mu, h_rhs_pull]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le
        ((hh_full_cont.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hg_mod_cont.const_mul 2).intervalIntegrable _ _) (fun x _ => ?_)
      have hf_le : ‖S.f (bootRowPt S k x)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _) 2
      have hq_le : ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖ ≤ (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖
          _ = (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖) ^ 2 :=
              (Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)).symm
          _ ≤ (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _) 2
      have hsum : h_full x ≤ 2 * (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [h_full]; linarith
      calc (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * h_full x
        _ ≤ (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * (2 * (shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = 2 * g_mod x := by dsimp [g_mod]; ring
    
    let G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun l u =>
      Real.exp (-max (criticalDepthThreshold S) l) *
        |(S.V (bootRowPt S (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) l) u)).im|
    have hΨ_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        bootRowPt S (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) p.1) p.2) := by
      unfold bootRowPt; fun_prop
    have hSV_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        S.V (bootRowPt S (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) p.1) p.2)) :=
      S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΨ_cont
        (fun p => (h_row_strip _ (le_max_left _ _)).2 p.2)
    have hG_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry G) := by
      have hexp_c : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Real.exp (-max (criticalDepthThreshold S) p.1)) := by fun_prop
      exact hexp_c.mul (_root_.continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp hSV_cont))
    have hG_per : ∀ l : ℝ, Function.Periodic (G l) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro l u
      dsimp [G]
      have hpt : bootRowPt S (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) l) (u + 2 * Real.pi) =
          bootRowPt S (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) l) u + 2 * Real.pi := by
        unfold bootRowPt; push_cast; ring
      rw [hpt, S.V_periodic _ ((h_row_strip _ (le_max_left _ _)).2 u)]
    let I_inner : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x₀ l =>
      Real.exp k * ∫ w in (-Real.exp (-k))..(Real.exp (-k)), G l (w + x₀)
    have h_comp_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry
        (fun (p : ℝ × ℝ) (w : ℝ) => G p.2 (w + p.1))) := by
      change Continuous ((Function.uncurry G) ∘ (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (q.1.2, q.2 + q.1.1)))
      exact hG_cont.comp (by fun_prop)
    have hI_inner_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry I_inner) :=
      continuous_const.mul
        (intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          h_comp_cont (-Real.exp (-k)) (Real.exp (-k)))
    have hI_outer_cont : Continuous (fun x₀ : ℝ => ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        hI_inner_cont (k - 1) (k + 1)
    have h_ptwise_cell : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
        g_mod x₀ ≤ C_cell * (1 + ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) := by
      intro x₀
      have h0 : |x₀ - x₀| ≤ Real.exp (-k) / 4 := by
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; positivity
      have hc := hCell k x₀ x₀ hk0 h0
      have h_eq_int : (∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1),
          Real.exp k * ∫ u in (x₀ - Real.exp (-k))..(x₀ + Real.exp (-k)),
            Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im|) =
          ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun l hl => ?_
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hl
        have hl_k0 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l := by linarith [hl.1]
        have hmax : max (criticalDepthThreshold S) l = l := max_eq_right hl_k0
        dsimp [I_inner, G]
        simp only [hmax]
        congr 1
        have hshift := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right
          (fun u => Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im|) x₀
          (a := -Real.exp (-k)) (b := Real.exp (-k))
        have ha : -Real.exp (-k) + x₀ = x₀ - Real.exp (-k) := by ring
        have hb : Real.exp (-k) + x₀ = x₀ + Real.exp (-k) := by ring
        rw [ha, hb] at hshift
        exact hshift.symm
      change g_mod x₀ ≤ C_cell * (1 + ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1),
        Real.exp k * ∫ u in (x₀ - Real.exp (-k))..(x₀ + Real.exp (-k)),
          Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im|) at hc
      rwa [h_eq_int] at hc
    have h_avg_cell : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_mod x₀) ≤
        C_cell * (1 + (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) := by
      have h_rhs_c : Continuous (fun x₀ : ℝ =>
          C_cell * (1 + ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l)) :=
        continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.add hI_outer_cont)
      have h_mono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h2pi_pos.le
        (hg_mod_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (h_rhs_c.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun x₀ _ => h_ptwise_cell x₀)
      have h_rhs_eval : (∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          C_cell * (1 + ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l)) =
          C_cell * (2 * Real.pi +
            ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
          intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
            (hI_outer_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const]
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h_rhs_eval] at h_mono
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
      have h_rhs : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (C_cell * (2 * Real.pi +
          ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l)) =
          C_cell * (1 + (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) := by
        field_simp [h2pi_pos.ne']
      linarith
    
    have h_fubini : (∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), I_inner x₀ l) =
        ∫ l in (k - 1)..(k + 1), 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G l x) := by
      rw [swap_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi) (k - 1) (k + 1) I_inner h2pi_pos.le (by linarith) hI_inner_cont]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun l _ => ?_
      dsimp [I_inner]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have hGl_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun x₀ w : ℝ => G l (w + x₀))) := by
        change Continuous ((Function.uncurry G) ∘ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (l, q.2 + q.1)))
        exact hG_cont.comp (by fun_prop)
      rw [swap_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi) (-Real.exp (-k)) (Real.exp (-k))
        (fun x₀ w => G l (w + x₀)) h2pi_pos.le (by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-k)]) hGl_cont]
      have h_per_eq : (∫ w in (-Real.exp (-k))..(Real.exp (-k)),
          ∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G l (w + x₀)) =
          ∫ _w in (-Real.exp (-k))..(Real.exp (-k)),
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G l x) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun w _ => ?_
        exact periodic_shift_integral (G l) (hG_per l) w
      rw [h_per_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]

        · linarith [le_max_right (k - k_ref) 0]
      have hψ_le : ψ j ≤ ψ k + a * (j - k) := by
        dsimp [ψ]
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax1 hβ0,
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax2 ha.le]
      calc N j
        _ = C₀' * B * Real.exp (ψ j) := rfl
        _ ≤ C₀' * B * Real.exp (ψ k + a * (j - k)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hψ_le) (by positivity)
        _ = 1 * N k * Real.exp (a * (j - k)) := by
            dsimp [N]; rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
    · intro k hk0
      let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)
      let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
        ‖S.f (bootRowPt S k x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖
      have hΦ_cont : Continuous (bootRowPt S k) := by unfold bootRowPt; fun_prop
      have hsf_c : Continuous (fun x => S.f (bootRowPt S k x)) :=
        S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦ_cont (h_row_strip k hk0).2
      have hsq_c : Continuous (fun x => S.q (bootRowPt S k x)) :=
        S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦ_cont (h_row_strip k hk0).2
      have hg_c : Continuous g :=
        hsf_c.norm.max (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hsq_c.norm)
      have hh_c : Continuous h := (hsf_c.norm.pow 2).add hsq_c.norm
      have hgh : ∀ x : ℝ, (g x) ^ 2 ≤ h x := by
        intro x
        rcases max_choice ‖S.f (bootRowPt S k x)‖
          (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (bootRowPt S k x)‖) with hmax | hmax
        · dsimp [g, h, shapeModulus]
          rw [hmax]
          linarith [norm_nonneg (S.q (bootRowPt S k x))]
        · dsimp [g, h, shapeModulus]
          rw [hmax, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
          linarith [sq_nonneg ‖S.f (bootRowPt S k x)‖]
      have h_rms := mean_le_rms_of_cont g h hg_c hh_c hgh
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rms (Real.exp_pos (-k)).le
      change Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x) ≤
        rowMomentFull S k at h_mul
      calc Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x)
        _ ≤ rowMomentFull S k := h_mul
        _ ≤ N k := hMomDom k hk0
        _ = 1 * N k := (one_mul _).symm
  
  have h_small_band : ∀ l ∈ Set.Icc (k_ref - 1) (k_ref + 1),
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0) ≤ ε * B ^ 2 := by
    intro l hl
    have hl_k0 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l := by linarith [hl.1]
    have hl_Ktay : D.K_tay ≤ l := by linarith [hl.1]
    have hNl_le : N l ≤ C_loc * B := by
      have hm1 : max (k_ref - l) 0 ≤ 1 := max_le (by linarith [hl.1]) zero_le_one
      have hm2 : max (l - k_ref) 0 ≤ 1 := max_le (by linarith [hl.2]) zero_le_one
      have hψ_le : ψ l ≤ β + a := by
        dsimp [ψ]
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 hβ0, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm2 ha.le]
      calc N l
        _ = C₀' * B * Real.exp (ψ l) := rfl
        _ ≤ C₀' * B * Real.exp (β + a) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hψ_le) (by positivity)
        _ = C_loc * B := by dsimp [C_loc]; ring
    have hNl_pos : 0 < N l := lt_of_lt_of_le hB_pos (hB_le_N l)
    have hNl_sq_le : (N l) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 := by
      calc (N l) ^ 2
        _ ≤ (C_loc * B) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hNl_pos.le hNl_le 2
        _ = B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 := by ring
    have hexp_l_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-l) := Real.exp_pos (-l)
    have hdn_le_el : d_n ≤ e1 * Real.exp (-l) := by
      calc d_n
        _ = Real.exp (-k_ref) := rfl
        _ ≤ Real.exp (1 + -l) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hl.2])
        _ = e1 * Real.exp (-l) := Real.exp_add 1 (-l)
    have hel_le_dn : Real.exp (-l) ≤ e1 * d_n := by
      calc Real.exp (-l)
        _ ≤ Real.exp (1 + -k_ref) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hl.1])
        _ = e1 * d_n := Real.exp_add 1 (-k_ref)
    have hΔ_rel_le : (S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l) ≤ c_req * e1 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hexp_l_pos]
      calc S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)
        _ ≤ c_req * d_n := h_width_collapse
        _ ≤ c_req * (e1 * Real.exp (-l)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdn_le_el hcreq_pos.le
        _ = c_req * e1 * Real.exp (-l) := by ring
    have hΔ_half : S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ) ≤ Real.exp (-l) / 2 := by
      have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ hexp_l_pos).mp (hΔ_rel_le.trans hcreq_e1)
      linarith
    set z : ℝ := |t_n| * N l / Real.exp (-l)
    have hz_upper : z ≤ T * e1 * C_loc := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [htn_abs, div_le_iff₀ hexp_l_pos]
      calc t_n * N l
        _ ≤ t_n * (C_loc * B) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNl_le htn_pos.le
        _ = T * d_n * C_loc := by dsimp [t_n]; field_simp [hB_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ T * (e1 * Real.exp (-l)) * C_loc :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdn_le_el hT_pos.le) hCloc_pos.le
        _ = T * e1 * C_loc * Real.exp (-l) := by ring
    have hz_lower : T / e1 ≤ z := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [htn_abs, le_div_iff₀ hexp_l_pos]
      calc T / e1 * Real.exp (-l)
        _ ≤ T / e1 * (e1 * d_n) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hel_le_dn (by positivity)
        _ = t_n * B := by dsimp [t_n]; field_simp [he1_pos.ne', hB_pos.ne']
        _ ≤ t_n * N l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB_le_N l) htn_pos.le
    have hz_pos : 0 < z := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hz_lower
    let b : ℝ → ℝ := bootConeCost S D.δ_b D.L D.β₁ N l
    obtain ⟨hb_cont, _, hb_ge_one⟩ := D.cone_cost_props N hCritEnv l hl_k0
    
    have h_ptwise : ∀ x : ℝ,
        Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 ≤
          B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      have hbx_ge_one : 1 ≤ b x := hb_ge_one x
      have hbx_pos : 0 < b x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hbx_ge_one
      have h_tail_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2 := by
        have := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA_pos (-(2 - m))
        positivity
      rcases le_or_gt (b x) A with hbx_le | hbx_gt
      · 
        have hzb_le : z * b x ≤ D.c_tay := by
          calc z * b x
            _ ≤ (T * e1 * C_loc) * A :=
                mul_le_mul hz_upper hbx_le hbx_pos.le (by positivity)
            _ = T * (e1 * C_loc * A) := by ring
            _ ≤ D.c_tay := hT_ctay
        have htay := D.taylor_neg_part N hCritEnv l x t_n hl_Ktay
          (by rw [htn_abs]; exact htn_pos) htn_lt_rstar hzb_le hΔ_half
        change Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2 ≤
          D.C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2 +
            z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4) at htay
        have hNl2_pos : 0 < (N l) ^ 2 := by positivity
        have htay_mul : Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 ≤
            B ^ 2 * (C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay *
              (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2) +
              C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay * (z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4)) := by
          have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ hNl2_pos).mp htay
          have h_rhs_nonneg : 0 ≤ D.C_tay *
              (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4) := by
            positivity
          calc Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0
            _ ≤ D.C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2 +
                  z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4) * (N l) ^ 2 := h1
            _ ≤ D.C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2 +
                  z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4) * (B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNl_sq_le h_rhs_nonneg
            _ = B ^ 2 * (C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay *
                  (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2) +
                  C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay * (z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4)) := by
                ring
        have h_term1 : C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay *
            (((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2) ≤ ε / 4 := by
          have hz2_lo : (T / e1) ^ 2 ≤ z ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hz_lower 2
          have h_div : ((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2 ≤
              e1 ^ 3 * c_req / T ^ 2 := by
            calc ((S.H - S.h_X (t_n : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-l)) / z ^ 2
              _ ≤ (c_req * e1) / z ^ 2 :=
                  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hΔ_rel_le (by positivity)
              _ ≤ (c_req * e1) / (T / e1) ^ 2 :=
                  div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) hz2_lo
              _ = e1 ^ 3 * c_req / T ^ 2 := by field_simp [he1_pos.ne', hT_pos.ne']
          exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div (by positivity)).trans hcreq_tay
        have h_term2 : C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_tay * (z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4) ≤ ε / 4 := by
          have hz2_hi : z ^ 2 ≤ (T * e1 * C_loc) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ hz_pos.le hz_upper 2
          have hb4_hi : (b x) ^ 4 ≤ A ^ 4 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ hbx_pos.le hbx_le 4
          have hprod : z ^ 2 * (b x) ^ 4 ≤ (T * e1 * C_loc) ^ 2 * A ^ 4 :=
            mul_le_mul hz2_hi hb4_hi (by positivity) (by positivity)
          exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity)).trans hT_quad
        exact htay_mul.trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (sq_nonneg B))
      · 
        have hsub := D.subquad_neg_part N hCritEnv l x hl_k0
        change Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2 ≤
          D.C_neg * (b x) ^ m at hsub
        have hNl2_pos : 0 < (N l) ^ 2 := by positivity
        have hbm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (b x) ^ m := Real.rpow_nonneg hbx_pos.le m
        have hsub_mul : Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 ≤
            B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * (b x) ^ m := by
          have h1 := (div_le_iff₀ hNl2_pos).mp hsub
          calc Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0
            _ ≤ D.C_neg * (b x) ^ m * (N l) ^ 2 := h1
            _ ≤ D.C_neg * (b x) ^ m * (B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNl_sq_le (by positivity)
            _ = B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * (b x) ^ m := by ring
        have h_rpow_le : (b x) ^ m ≤ A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2 := by
          have h1 : A ^ (2 - m) ≤ (b x) ^ (2 - m) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow hA_pos.le hbx_gt.le h2m_pos.le
          have h2 : A ^ (2 - m) * (b x) ^ m ≤ (b x) ^ 2 := by
            calc A ^ (2 - m) * (b x) ^ m
              _ ≤ (b x) ^ (2 - m) * (b x) ^ m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hbm_nonneg
              _ = (b x) ^ ((2 - m) + m) := (Real.rpow_add hbx_pos (2 - m) m).symm
              _ = (b x) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
              _ = (b x) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_two (b x)
          have hAd_pos : 0 < A ^ (2 - m) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hA_pos (2 - m)
          rw [Real.rpow_neg hA_pos.le]
          exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hAd_pos).mpr h2
        have h_tail_le := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le
          (by positivity : 0 ≤ B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg)
        calc Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0
          _ ≤ B ^ 2 * C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * (A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2) :=
              hsub_mul.trans h_tail_le
          _ = B ^ 2 * (0 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ ≤ B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (sq_nonneg B)
    
    have hΦl_cont : Continuous (bootRowPt S l) := by unfold bootRowPt; fun_prop
    have hSVl_cont : Continuous (fun x => S.V (bootRowPt S l x)) :=
      S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hΦl_cont (h_row_strip l hl_k0).2
    have hlhs_cont : Continuous (fun x =>
        Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((Complex.continuous_im.comp hSVl_cont).max continuous_const)
    have h_b2_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2) :=
      continuous_const.mul (hb_cont.pow 2)
    have hrhs_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2)) :=
      continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.add h_b2_c)
    have h_int_mono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) h2pi_pos.le
      (hlhs_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hrhs_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (fun x _ => h_ptwise x)
    have h_rhs_int_eval : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (b x) ^ 2)) =
        B ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi) * (ε / 2) +
          C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const (h_b2_c.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h_rhs_int_eval] at h_int_mono
    
    have h_bL2_sqrt := D.cone_cost_L2 N hCritEnv 1 zero_le_one
      (fun j hj => by simpa using hMomDom j hj) l hl_k0
    have h_b2_int_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
        (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _))
    have h_b2_avg : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2) ≤
        (2 * D.C_b2) ^ 2 := by
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2
        _ = (Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
            (Real.sq_sqrt h_b2_int_nonneg).symm
        _ ≤ (D.C_b2 * (1 + 1)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h_bL2_sqrt 2
        _ = (2 * D.C_b2) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_avg_mono := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_mono (inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le)
    have h_simp_rhs : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (B ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi) * (ε / 2) +
        C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2)) =
        B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) *
          ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2)) := by
      field_simp [h2pi_pos.ne']
    rw [h_simp_rhs] at h_avg_mono
    have h_tail_avg : C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) *
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      have hA_rpow_nonneg : 0 ≤ A ^ (-(2 - m)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hA_pos.le _
      calc C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) *
              ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2)
        _ ≤ C_loc ^ 2 * D.C_neg * A ^ (-(2 - m)) * (2 * D.C_b2) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_b2_avg (by positivity)
        _ = K_tail * A ^ (-(2 - m)) := by dsimp [K_tail]; ring
        _ ≤ ε / 2 := hA_tail
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0
      _ ≤ B ^ 2 * (ε / 2 + ε / 2) :=
          h_avg_mono.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (sq_nonneg B))
      _ = ε * B ^ 2 := by ring
  
  have hB2_le := h_row_band k_ref (ε * B ^ 2) hk_ge_k0_1 (by positivity) h_small_band
  have h_cancel_band : C_band * (1 + ε * B ^ 2) = C_band + B ^ 2 / 2 := by
    dsimp [ε]; field_simp [hCband_pos.ne']
  rw [h_cancel_band] at hB2_le
  have hB2_bound : B ^ 2 ≤ 2 * C_band := by linarith
  have hB_le_B2 : B ≤ B ^ 2 := by
    calc B
      _ = 1 * B := (one_mul B).symm
      _ ≤ B * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB_ge_one hB_pos.le
      _ = B ^ 2 := (sq B).symm
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hPartialY : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => f (y', p.2)) p.1) W := by
    intro W hW f hf p₀ hp₀
    suffices hAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => f (y', p.2)) p.1) p₀ from
      hAt.differentiableWithinAt
    obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hR₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    set y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
    set t₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
    set r : ℝ := R₀ / 3
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := by positivity
    have h2r_pos : 0 < 2 * r := by positivity
    have h3r_pos : 0 < 3 * r := by positivity
    have hball3_sub : Metric.ball y₀ (3 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball t₀ (3 * r) ⊆ W := by
      intro q hq
      apply hR₀_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      have h3r_eq : 3 * r = R₀ := by simp [r]; ring
      exact ⟨h3r_eq ▸ hq.1, h3r_eq ▸ hq.2⟩
    set K : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * r)
    have hK_sub_ball3 : K ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ (3 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball t₀ (3 * r) := by
      intro q hq
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1) (by linarith)),
        Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2) (by linarith))⟩
    have hK_sub_W : K ⊆ W := hK_sub_ball3.trans hball3_sub
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K :=
      (isCompact_closedBall y₀ (2 * r)).prod (isCompact_closedBall t₀ (2 * r))
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_compact.bddAbove_image ((hf.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_W).norm)
    set M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    have hM_bound : ∀ q ∈ K, ‖f q‖ ≤ M := fun q hq =>

      have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.cos (u - θ_0)) (-Real.sin (ψ - θ_0)) ψ := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (ψ - θ_0)).comp ψ ((hasDerivAt_id ψ).sub_const θ_0)
      convert (h1.mul h2).add (h3.mul h4) using 1
      ring
    have hF_cont : Continuous F_mono :=
      Differentiable.continuous fun ψ => (hF_hasDeriv ψ).differentiableAt
    have hstep_m := C.U_real_step_pos (x - t) t ht_pos ht_r₁
    have hstep_p := C.U_real_step_pos x t ht_pos ht_r₁
    have hU_m_eq : C.ϕ (C.U (((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re = θ_0 := by
      have h_cancel : ((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_cancel]
    have hU_p_eq : C.ϕ (C.U ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re = θ_p := by
      have h_add : (x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) = ((x + t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [h_add]
    have hθ0_sub_θm_pos : 0 < θ_0 - θ_m := by simpa [hU_m_eq, θ_m] using hstep_m.2.1
    have hθ0_sub_θm_lt : θ_0 - θ_m < Real.pi := by simpa [hU_m_eq, θ_m] using hstep_m.2.2
    have hθp_sub_θ0_pos : 0 < θ_p - θ_0 := by simpa [hU_p_eq, θ_0] using hstep_p.2.1
    have hθp_sub_θ0_lt : θ_p - θ_0 < Real.pi := by simpa [hU_p_eq, θ_0] using hstep_p.2.2
    have hψm_lt_ψp : ψ_m < ψ_p := by dsimp [ψ_m, ψ_p]; linarith
    have hF'_pos : ∀ ψ ∈ Set.Icc ψ_m ψ_p, 0 < deriv F_mono ψ := by
      intro ψ hψ
      rw [(hF_hasDeriv ψ).deriv]
      refine mul_pos (C.r_pos ψ) (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
      · dsimp [ψ_m] at hψ; linarith [hψ.1]
      · dsimp [ψ_p] at hψ; linarith [hψ.2]
    have hF_mono : StrictMonoOn F_mono (Set.Icc ψ_m ψ_p) :=
      strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc ψ_m ψ_p) hF_cont.continuousOn
        (fun ψ hψ => hF'_pos ψ (interior_subset hψ))
    have hF_lt : F_mono ψ_m < F_mono ψ_p :=
      hF_mono ⟨le_rfl, hψm_lt_ψp.le⟩ ⟨hψm_lt_ψp.le, le_rfl⟩ hψm_lt_ψp
    refine ⟨hgt_pos, hOffset_real_im x t ht_abs_r₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hΔ_cast, Complex.ofReal_re, hΔ_factor]
      exact mul_pos hgt_pos (sub_pos.mpr hF_lt)
    · rw [hΔ_cast, Complex.ofReal_im]
  exact ⟨{
    s_det := s_det
    r_det := r_det
    s_det_pos := hs_det_pos
    s_det_le_s₁ := hs_det_le_init.trans hs_init_s₁
    s_det_le_s₀ := hs_det_le_init.trans hs_init_s₀
    r_det_pos := hr_det_pos
    r_det_lt_s_det := hr_det_lt_s4
    r_det_lt_r₁ := hr_det_lt_r₁_half
    offset_ne_zero := hoff_ne_zero
    theta_holo := hTh_det
    offset_holo := hOff_det
    dualLine_holo := hDual_det
    impact_holo := hImp_det
    iterDerivYT_holo := hIterYT
    eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D := hId2D
    impact_support_proj := hProj
    cramer_edge_identities := hCramer
    real_chord_pos := hRealChord
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  refine {
    formal_arc := ?_
    lift_separable := ?_
    sqrt_power_sum_zero := ?_
  }
  · 
    have hTaylor : ∀ {A : Type} [CommRing A] (P : Polynomial A) (a b : A),
        ∃ rem : A, P.eval (a + b) = P.eval a + P.derivative.eval a * b + rem * b ^ 2 := by
      intro A _ P a b
      have hPow : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ rem : A,
          (a + b) ^ d = a ^ d + (d : A) * a ^ (d - 1) * b + rem * b ^ 2 := by
        intro d
        induction d with
        | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
        | succ d ih =>
          rcases d with _ | k
          · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
          · rcases ih with ⟨r, hr⟩
            refine ⟨((k + 1 : ℕ) : A) * a ^ k + r * (a + b), ?_⟩
            have h1 : (a + b) ^ (k + 2) = (a + b) ^ (k + 1) * (a + b) := pow_succ (a + b) (k + 1)
            rw [h1, hr]
            simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
            ring
      induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
      | add p q hp hq =>
        rcases hp with ⟨rp, hrp⟩
        rcases hq with ⟨rq, hrq⟩
        refine ⟨rp + rq, ?_⟩
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.derivative_add]
        rw [hrp, hrq]
        ring
      | monomial d s =>
        rcases hPow d with ⟨r, hr⟩
        refine ⟨s * r, ?_⟩
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_monomial, Polynomial.derivative_monomial]
        rw [hr]
        ring
    have hMapEval : ∀ {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B)
        (P : Polynomial A) (a : A), f (P.eval a) = (P.map f).eval (f a) := by
      intro A B _ _ f P a
      induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
      | add p q hp hq =>
        rw [Polynomial.eval_add, map_add, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.eval_add, hp, hq]
      | monomial d s =>
        rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.map_monomial,
          Polynomial.eval_monomial]
    have hHensel : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥L →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
        (hΦ_cc : ∀ y : ↥L, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ))
        (α : ℂ) (h_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥L) α),
        ∃ γ : PowerSeries ℂ,
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff γ = α ∧
          Polynomial.eval₂ Φ γ (minpoly (↥L) α) = 0 := by
      intro L Φ hΦ_cc α h_alg
      have : CharZero (↥L) := L.subtype.charZero
      let m : Polynomial (↥L) := minpoly (↥L) α
      have hm_irr : Irreducible m := minpoly.irreducible h_alg.isIntegral
      let m_ℂ : Polynomial ℂ := m.map L.subtype
      have hm_ℂ_sep : m_ℂ.Separable := hm_irr.separable.map
      let M : Polynomial (PowerSeries ℂ) := m.map Φ
      have hM_cc : M.map PowerSeries.constantCoeff = m_ℂ := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_map]
        congr 1
        ext y
        exact hΦ_cc y
      have hm_ℂ_eval : m_ℂ.eval α = 0 := by
        rw [Polynomial.eval_map]
        exact minpoly.aeval (↥L) α
      let μ : ℂ := m_ℂ.derivative.eval α
      have hμ_ne : μ ≠ 0 := by
        rcases hm_ℂ_sep with ⟨u, v, huv⟩
        have hev := congr_arg (Polynomial.eval α) huv
        simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_one,
          hm_ℂ_eval, mul_zero, zero_add] at hev
        intro h0
        dsimp only [μ] at h0
        rw [h0, mul_zero] at hev
        exact zero_ne_one hev
      let g : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun k =>
        Nat.rec (PowerSeries.C α)
          (fun n gn =>
            gn + PowerSeries.C (-PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (M.eval gn) / μ) *
              PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1)) k
      have hg_zero : g 0 = PowerSeries.C α := rfl
      have hg_succ : ∀ n : ℕ, g (n + 1) =
          g n + PowerSeries.C (-PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (M.eval (g n)) / μ) *
            PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1) := fun _ => rfl
      have hg_cc : ∀ k : ℕ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (g k) = α := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => simp [hg_zero]
        | succ n ih =>
          rw [hg_succ, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_X,
            zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), mul_zero, add_zero, ih]
      have hg_stab : ∀ (j k : ℕ), j ≤ k → PowerSeries.coeff j (g k) = PowerSeries.coeff j (g j) := by
        intro j k hjk
        induction k with
        | zero =>
          have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hjk
          subst hj0; rfl
        | succ n ih =>
          rcases Nat.of_le_succ hjk with hle | rfl
          · rw [hg_succ, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow,
              ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h (by omega)), mul_zero, add_zero, ih hle]
          · rfl
      have hg_vanish : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ j ≤ k, PowerSeries.coeff j (M.eval (g k)) = 0 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero =>
          intro j hj
          have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hj
          subst hj0
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hMapEval PowerSeries.constantCoeff M (g 0),
            hM_cc, hg_cc 0, hm_ℂ_eval]
        | succ n ih =>
          intro j hj
          set c_step : ℂ := -PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (M.eval (g n)) / μ
          rcases hTaylor M (g n) (PowerSeries.C c_step * PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1)) with ⟨rem, hrem⟩
          rw [hg_succ, hrem, map_add, map_add]
          have hrem_zero : PowerSeries.coeff j
              (rem * (PowerSeries.C c_step * PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2) = 0 := by
            have hb2 : rem * (PowerSeries.C c_step * PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1)) ^ 2 =
                PowerSeries.X ^ (2 * n + 2) * (rem * PowerSeries.C (c_step ^ 2)) := by
              rw [mul_pow, ← map_pow, ← pow_mul]
              ring
            rw [hb2, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
              ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h (by omega))]
          rw [hrem_zero, add_zero]
          have hlin_rewrite : M.derivative.eval (g n) *
              (PowerSeries.C c_step * PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1)) =
              PowerSeries.X ^ (n + 1) * (PowerSeries.C c_step * M.derivative.eval (g n)) := by ring
          rw [hlin_rewrite, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
          rcases Nat.of_le_succ hj with hlt | rfl
          · rw [ih j hlt, ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h (by omega)), add_zero]
          · simp only [le_refl, ↓reduceIte, Nat.sub_self, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
              PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
            have hderiv_cc : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (M.derivative.eval (g n)) = μ := by
              rw [hMapEval PowerSeries.constantCoeff M.derivative (g n),
                ← Polynomial.derivative_map, hM_cc, hg_cc n]
            rw [hderiv_cc]
            dsimp only [c_step]
            field_simp [hμ_ne]
            ring
      let γ : PowerSeries ℂ := PowerSeries.mk (fun k => PowerSeries.coeff k (g k))
      have hγ_cc : PowerSeries.constantCoeff γ = α := by
        rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
        change PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.mk _) = α
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hg_cc 0]
      refine ⟨γ, hγ_cc, ?_⟩
      rw [← Polynomial.eval_map]
      change M.eval γ = 0
      ext k
      rw [map_zero]
      let tail_k : PowerSeries ℂ :=
        PowerSeries.mk (fun d => PowerSeries.coeff (d + (k + 1)) (γ - g k))
      have hγ_split : γ = g k + PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k := by
        ext j
        rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
        by_cases hjk : k + 1 ≤ j
        · simp only [hjk, ↓reduceIte, tail_k, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
            Nat.sub_add_cancel hjk, map_sub]
          ring
        · simp only [hjk, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
          have hj_le : j ≤ k := by omega
          change PowerSeries.coeff j (PowerSeries.mk _) = PowerSeries.coeff j (g k)
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hg_stab j k hj_le]
      rcases hTaylor M (g k) (PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k) with ⟨rem, hrem⟩
      rw [hγ_split, hrem, map_add, map_add, hg_vanish k k (le_refl k), zero_add]
      have hlin0 : PowerSeries.coeff k
          (M.derivative.eval (g k) * (PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k)) = 0 := by
        have hcomm : M.derivative.eval (g k) * (PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k) =
            PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * (M.derivative.eval (g k) * tail_k) := by ring
        rw [hcomm, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h (by omega))]
      have hquad0 : PowerSeries.coeff k
          (rem * (PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k) ^ 2) = 0 := by
        have hcomm : rem * (PowerSeries.X ^ (k + 1) * tail_k) ^ 2 =
            PowerSeries.X ^ (2 * k + 2) * (rem * tail_k ^ 2) := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          ring
        rw [hcomm, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h (by omega))]
      rw [hlin0, hquad0, add_zero]
    have hExtendSingle : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥L →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
        (hΦ_cc : ∀ y : ↥L, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ))
        (α : ℂ) (δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (hδ_cc : PowerSeries.constantCoeff δ = 0),
        let F₁ : Subfield ℂ := Subfield.closure ((L : Set ℂ) ∪ {α})
        ∃ Φ_ext : ↥F₁ →+* PowerSeries ℂ,
          (∀ y : ↥L, Φ_ext ⟨(y : ℂ), Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl y.2)⟩ = Φ y) ∧
          (∀ z : ↥F₁, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ_ext z) = (z : ℂ)) ∧
          (¬ IsAlgebraic (↥L) α →
            Φ_ext ⟨α, Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)⟩ = PowerSeries.C α + δ) := by
      intro L Φ hΦ_cc α δ hδ_cc F₁
      let ev_ℂ : Polynomial (↥L) →+* ℂ := Polynomial.eval₂RingHom L.subtype α
      have hev_aeval : ∀ P : Polynomial (↥L), ev_ℂ P = Polynomial.aeval α P := fun _ => rfl
      by_cases h_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥L) α
      · rcases hHensel L Φ hΦ_cc α h_alg with ⟨γ, hγ_cc, hγ_eval⟩
        let m : Polynomial (↥L) := minpoly (↥L) α
        have hm_irr : Irreducible m := minpoly.irreducible h_alg.isIntegral
        have hm_ev0 : ev_ℂ m = 0 := by
          rw [hev_aeval]
          exact minpoly.aeval (↥L) α
        let E_alg : Subfield ℂ := {
          carrier := Set.range ev_ℂ
          mul_mem' := by
            rintro _ _ ⟨P, rfl⟩ ⟨Q, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨P * Q, map_mul ev_ℂ P Q⟩
          one_mem' := ⟨1, map_one ev_ℂ⟩
          add_mem' := by
            rintro _ _ ⟨P, rfl⟩ ⟨Q, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨P + Q, map_add ev_ℂ P Q⟩
          zero_mem' := ⟨0, map_zero ev_ℂ⟩
          neg_mem' := by
            rintro _ ⟨P, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨-P, map_neg ev_ℂ P⟩
          inv_mem' := by
            rintro _ ⟨P, rfl⟩
            by_cases hP0 : ev_ℂ P = 0
            · rw [hP0, _root_.inv_zero]
              exact ⟨0, map_zero ev_ℂ⟩
            · have h_ndvd : ¬ (m ∣ P) := by
                rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
                exact hP0 (by rw [map_mul, hm_ev0, zero_mul])
              rcases hm_irr.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr h_ndvd with ⟨A, B, hAB⟩
              have hev1 := congr_arg ev_ℂ hAB
              simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_one, hm_ev0, mul_zero, zero_add] at hev1
              refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
              exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hev1
        }
        have hF₁_le : F₁ ≤ E_alg := by
          refine Subfield.closure_le.mpr ?_
          rintro w (hwL | rfl)
          · exact ⟨Polynomial.C ⟨w, hwL⟩, by simp [ev_ℂ]⟩
          · exact ⟨Polynomial.X, by simp [ev_ℂ]⟩
        let ψ : Polynomial (↥L) →+* PowerSeries ℂ := Polynomial.eval₂RingHom Φ γ
        have hψ_cc : ∀ P : Polynomial (↥L), PowerSeries.constantCoeff (ψ P) = ev_ℂ P := by
          intro P
          induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
          | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
          | monomial d s => simp [ψ, ev_ℂ, hΦ_cc s, hγ_cc]
        have hψ_m : ψ m = 0 := hγ_eval
        have h_wd : ∀ P Q : Polynomial (↥L), ev_ℂ P = ev_ℂ Q → ψ P = ψ Q := by
          intro P Q hPQ
          have hsub0 : Polynomial.aeval α (P - Q) = 0 := by
            rw [← hev_aeval, map_sub, hPQ, sub_self]
          rcases minpoly.dvd (↥L) α hsub0 with ⟨R, hR⟩
          have hψ_sub : ψ (P - Q) = 0 := by
            rw [hR, map_mul, hψ_m, zero_mul]
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by rwa [← map_sub])
        have h_rep : ∀ z : ↥F₁, ∃ P : Polynomial (↥L), ev_ℂ P = (z : ℂ) := fun z => hF₁_le z.2
        have h_apply : ∀ (z : ↥F₁) (P : Polynomial (↥L)), ev_ℂ P = (z : ℂ) →
            ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z)) = ψ P := fun z P hP =>
          h_wd _ _ ((Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z)).trans hP.symm)
        let Φ_ext : ↥F₁ →+* PowerSeries ℂ := {
          toFun := fun z => ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z))
          map_one' := by simp [h_apply 1 1 (map_one ev_ℂ)]
          map_mul' := fun z₁ z₂ => by
            change ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep (z₁ * z₂))) =
              ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z₁)) * ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z₂))
            rw [h_apply (z₁ * z₂) (Classical.choose (h_rep z₁) * Classical.choose (h_rep z₂))
              (by rw [map_mul, Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z₁), Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z₂)]; rfl),
              map_mul]
          map_zero' := by simp [h_apply 0 0 (map_zero ev_ℂ)]
          map_add' := fun z₁ z₂ => by
            change ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep (z₁ + z₂))) =
              ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z₁)) + ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z₂))
            rw [h_apply (z₁ + z₂) (Classical.choose (h_rep z₁) + Classical.choose (h_rep z₂))
              (by rw [map_add, Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z₁), Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z₂)]; rfl),
              map_add]
        }
        refine ⟨Φ_ext, fun y => ?_, fun z => ?_, fun hna => absurd h_alg hna⟩
        · change ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep _)) = Φ y
          rw [h_apply _ (Polynomial.C y) (by simp [ev_ℂ])]
          simp [ψ]
        · change PowerSeries.constantCoeff (ψ (Classical.choose (h_rep z))) = (z : ℂ)
          rw [hψ_cc, Classical.choose_spec (h_rep z)]
      · have h_ev_ne : ∀ Q : Polynomial (↥L), Q ≠ 0 → ev_ℂ Q ≠ 0 := by
          intro Q hQ h0
          exact h_alg ⟨Q, hQ, by rwa [← hev_aeval]⟩
        let E_tr : Subfield ℂ := {
          carrier := { w : ℂ | ∃ P Q : Polynomial (↥L), Q ≠ 0 ∧ w = ev_ℂ P / ev_ℂ Q }
          mul_mem' := by
            rintro _ _ ⟨P₁, Q₁, hQ₁, rfl⟩ ⟨P₂, Q₂, hQ₂, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨P₁ * P₂, Q₁ * Q₂, mul_ne_zero hQ₁ hQ₂, by simp [map_mul, div_mul_div_comm]⟩
          one_mem' := ⟨1, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp⟩
          add_mem' := by
            rintro _ _ ⟨P₁, Q₁, hQ₁, rfl⟩ ⟨P₂, Q₂, hQ₂, rfl⟩
            refine ⟨P₁ * Q₂ + P₂ * Q₁, Q₁ * Q₂, mul_ne_zero hQ₁ hQ₂, ?_⟩
            rw [div_add_div _ _ (h_ev_ne Q₁ hQ₁) (h_ev_ne Q₂ hQ₂)]
            simp [map_add, map_mul]
            ring
          zero_mem' := ⟨0, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp⟩
          neg_mem' := by
            rintro _ ⟨P, Q, hQ, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨-P, Q, hQ, by rw [map_neg, neg_div]⟩
          inv_mem' := by
            rintro _ ⟨P, Q, hQ, rfl⟩
            by_cases hP : P = 0
            · exact ⟨0, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp [hP]⟩
            · exact ⟨Q, P, hP, by rw [inv_div]⟩
        }
        have hF₁_le : F₁ ≤ E_tr := by
          refine Subfield.closure_le.mpr ?_
          rintro w (hwL | rfl)
          · exact ⟨Polynomial.C ⟨w, hwL⟩, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp [ev_ℂ]⟩
          · exact ⟨Polynomial.X, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp [ev_ℂ]⟩
        let γ : PowerSeries ℂ := PowerSeries.C α + δ
