    have hre := (hψ_base i q hq).2.2
    change 1 / 2 ≤ (pderivA (ψ i) ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re at hre
    rw [hzero, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    linarith
  have hcov_ode :
      ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
        ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_base : q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star := htrap_sub_base q hq
    refine sys.mem_ode_domain ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))
      ⟨hU₀_cov q hq_base, hU_plus_cov q hq⟩
      (hweb_nondeg q hq).1 (hpderivA_ne q hq_base) (hweb_nondeg q hq).2
  have hq₁_trap : (a₁, δ₁) ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀ := by
    refine ⟨hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_lt, ?_⟩
    have hmul : C₀ * δ₁ < C₀ * δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ₁_lt hC₀
    dsimp only
    linarith
  set p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  have hp₁_ode : p₁ ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus := hcov_ode (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap
  obtain ⟨V_formal, hV_formal_zero, hV_formal_ode⟩ := sys.formal_ode p₁ hp₁_ode f hf_web
  obtain ⟨V_ode, V, hV_ode_open, hV_ode_pre, hV_ode_sub, hV_ode_cov, hV_holo, hV_taylor, hV_pde⟩ :=
    trapezoid_linear_pde_continuation (Fin m × Fin m) hKit a₀ R δ_star C₀ a₁ δ₁
      hR hδ_star hC₀ hC₀δ hδ₁_pos hδ₁_lt ha₁
      (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus) sys.isOpen_ode hcov_ode
      sys.M_a sys.M_δ sys.c_a sys.c_δ
      sys.M_a_holo sys.M_δ_holo sys.c_a_holo sys.c_δ_holo
      V_formal (fun idx => (hV_formal_ode idx).1) (fun idx => (hV_formal_ode idx).2)
  let F₀ : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => V p (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
  have hF₀_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₀ i) V_ode :=
    fun i => hV_holo (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
  have hF₀_cross :
      ∀ i : Fin m, ∀ p ∈ V_ode,
        pderivD (ψ i) p * pderivA (F₀ i) p = pderivA (ψ i) p * pderivD (F₀ i) p := by
    intro i p hp
    have hp_ode : p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus := hV_ode_sub hp
    have hpde := hV_pde p hp (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
    change pderivD (ψ i) p * pderivA (fun q => V q (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)) p =
      pderivA (ψ i) p * pderivD (fun q => V q (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)) p
    rw [hpde.1, hpde.2]
    exact sys.cross_rel p hp_ode (V p) i
  have hV_ode_sub_U₀ : V_ode ⊆ U₀ := Set.Subset.trans hV_ode_sub sys.ode_sub_U₀
  have hV_ode_sub_U_plus : V_ode ⊆ U_plus := Set.Subset.trans hV_ode_sub sys.ode_sub_U_plus
  obtain ⟨W_ψ, V_plus, g, hW_open, hW_pre, hW_cov, hVp_open, hVp_pre, hVp_sub_ode,
      hVp_cov, hg_holo, hVp_prop⟩ :=
    trapezoid_foliation_edge_descent m hm hKit a₀ R δ_star C₀ hR hδ_star hC₀ hC₀δ
      U₀ V_ode hU₀ hV_ode_open hV_ode_sub_U₀ hU₀_cov hV_ode_cov
      ψ F₀ hψ_holo hF₀_holo hψ_base hF₀_cross
  have hVp_sub_U₀ : V_plus ⊆ U₀ := Set.Subset.trans hVp_sub_ode hV_ode_sub_U₀
  have hVp_sub_U_plus : V_plus ⊆ U_plus := Set.Subset.trans hVp_sub_ode hV_ode_sub_U_plus
  have hp₁_Vp : p₁ ∈ V_plus := hVp_cov (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap
  have hψ_Vp : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) V_plus :=
    fun i => (hψ_holo i).mono hVp_sub_U₀
  have hψ_maps : ∀ i : Fin m, ∀ p ∈ V_plus, ψ i p ∈ W_ψ :=
    fun i p hp => (hVp_prop p hp).1 i
  have hg_comp_taylor :
      ∀ i : Fin m,
        taylor2D (fun p => g i (ψ i p)) p₁ =
          compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D (g i) (ψ i p₁)) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) :=
    fun i => hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hVp_open hW_open hp₁_Vp (hψ_Vp i) (hg_holo i) (hψ_maps i)
  have hg_series : ∀ i : Fin m, holoTaylor1D (g i) (ψ i p₁) = f i := by
    intro i
    have hcongr1 : taylor2D (fun p => g i (ψ i p)) p₁ = taylor2D (F₀ i) p₁ :=
      hKit.taylor2D_congr hVp_open hp₁_Vp (fun p hp => (hVp_prop p hp).2 i)
    have hcomp_eq :
        compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D (g i) (ψ i p₁)) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) =
          compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) := by
      rw [← hg_comp_taylor i, hcongr1]
      exact (hV_taylor (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)).trans (hV_formal_zero i)
    exact hKit.compPowerSeries2D_inj hU₀ (hVp_sub_U₀ hp₁_Vp) (hψ_holo i)
      (hpderivA_ne (a₁, δ₁) (htrap_sub_base (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap) i)
      (holoTaylor1D (g i) (ψ i p₁)) (f i) hcomp_eq
  let term : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => w i p * g i (ψ i p)
  have hterm_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (term i) V_plus := by
    intro i
    exact ((hw_holo i).mono hVp_sub_U_plus).mul
      ((hg_holo i).comp (hψ_Vp i) (fun p hp => hψ_maps i p hp))
  have hsum_holo_and_taylor :
      ∀ s : Finset (Fin m),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∑ i ∈ s, term i p) V_plus ∧
        taylor2D (fun p => ∑ i ∈ s, term i p) p₁ = ∑ i ∈ s, taylor2D (term i) p₁ := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      refine ⟨differentiableOn_const 0, ?_⟩
      simpa using (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hVp_open hp₁_Vp).1 0
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have h_eq : (fun p => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, term i p) =
          (fun p => term a p + ∑ i ∈ s, term i p) := by
        ext p
        exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      refine ⟨(hterm_holo a).add ih.1, ?_⟩
      rw [((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hVp_open hp₁_Vp).2 (hterm_holo a) ih.1).1, ih.2]
  have hsum_taylor_eq_B :
      taylor2D (fun p => ∑ i : Fin m, term i p) p₁ = taylor2D B p₁ := by
    rw [(hsum_holo_and_taylor Finset.univ).2, ← hf_web]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro i _
    have hwi_Vp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) V_plus := (hw_holo i).mono hVp_sub_U_plus
    have hgi_Vp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g i (ψ i p)) V_plus :=
      (hg_holo i).comp (hψ_Vp i) (fun p hp => hψ_maps i p hp)
    have hmul_eq := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hVp_open hp₁_Vp).2 hwi_Vp hgi_Vp).2.2
    change taylor2D (fun p => w i p * g i (ψ i p)) p₁ =
      taylor2D (w i) p₁ * compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁)
    rw [hmul_eq, hg_comp_taylor i, hg_series i]
  have hB_Vp : DifferentiableOn ℂ B V_plus := hB_holo.mono hVp_sub_U_plus
  have hres_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (∑ i : Fin m, term i p) - B p) V_plus :=
    (hsum_holo_and_taylor Finset.univ).1.sub hB_Vp
  have hres_taylor :
      taylor2D (fun p => (∑ i : Fin m, term i p) - B p) p₁ = 0 := by
    rw [((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hVp_open hp₁_Vp).2 (hsum_holo_and_taylor Finset.univ).1 hB_Vp).2.1,
      hsum_taylor_eq_B, sub_self]
  refine ⟨W_ψ, V_plus, g, hW_open, hW_pre, hW_cov, hVp_open, hVp_pre, hVp_sub_U₀,
    hVp_sub_U_plus, hVp_cov, hg_holo, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨hψ_maps i p₁ hp₁_Vp, ?_⟩
    intro n
    have hcoeff := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff n) (hg_series i)
    simpa [holoTaylor1D] using hcoeff
  · intro p hp
    refine ⟨fun i => hψ_maps i p hp, ?_⟩
    have hzero : (∑ i : Fin m, term i p) - B p = 0 :=
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero hVp_open hVp_pre hp₁_Vp hres_holo hres_taylor p hp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

finite_web_ode_continuation.definitions:
noncomputable def pderivA (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun z : ℂ => f (z, p.2)) p.1

noncomputable def pderivD (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun z : ℂ => f (p.1, z)) p.2

noncomputable def mvDerivA (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 0 1) Φ

noncomputable def mvDerivD (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1) Φ

noncomputable def holoTaylor1D (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ))

structure Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  pderiv_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U
  pderiv_comm : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (pderivD f) p = pderivD (pderivA f) p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U
  iterDerivYT_step : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
      iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
      iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
      pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
      pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → taylor2D f p₀ = 0 → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  taylor2D_algebra : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    (∀ c : ℂ, taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
    (∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀)
  mvDeriv_rules :
    (∀ Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      mvDerivA (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ + mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ + mvDerivD Ψ ∧
      mvDerivA (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivD Ψ) ∧
    (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        mvDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
        mvDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀)
  mvDeriv_compPowerSeries2D : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
    mvDerivA (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivA Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ ∧
    mvDerivD (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivD Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  compPowerSeries2D_inj : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → pderivA ψ p₀ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (f₁ f₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
      compPowerSeries2D f₁ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) =
        compPowerSeries2D f₂ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) →
      f₁ = f₂

noncomputable def webDiffCoeffA (A w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, 0 => w
  | 0, _ + 1 => fun _ => 0
  | α + 1, 0 => pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α 0)
  | α + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeffA A w α k p * A p

noncomputable def webDiffCoeff (A B_ψ w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (α : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, k => webDiffCoeffA A w α k
  | β + 1, 0 => pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β 0)
  | β + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β k p * B_ψ p

noncomputable def webVandermondeMat {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun r i =>
    w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivD (ψ i) p) ^ r.val

def webODEDomain {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus | (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).det ≠ 0 }

structure WebPDESystem {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) where
  M_a : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  c_a : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  isOpen_ode : IsOpen (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  ode_sub_U₀ : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U₀
  ode_sub_U_plus : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U_plus
  mem_ode_domain : ∀ p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus,
    (∀ i : Fin m, w i p ≠ 0) →
    (∀ i : Fin m, pderivA (ψ i) p ≠ 0) →
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m => pderivD (ψ i) p / pderivA (ψ i) p) →
    p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus
  M_a_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_a p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  M_δ_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_δ p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_a_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_a p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_δ_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_δ p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  cross_rel : ∀ p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ V : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ, ∀ i : Fin m,
    pderivD (ψ i) p * ((M_a p).mulVec V + c_a p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) =
      pderivA (ψ i) p * ((M_δ p).mulVec V + c_δ p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
  formal_ode : ∀ p₁ ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ f : Fin m → PowerSeries ℂ,
    (∑ i : Fin m,
      taylor2D (w i) p₁ * compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) =
      taylor2D B p₁) →
    ∃ V_formal : Fin m × Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        V_formal (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) = compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁)) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
        mvDerivA (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁ ∧
        mvDerivD (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁)

    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
      iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
      iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
      pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
      pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ W →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → taylor2D f p₀ = 0 → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0
  taylor2D_algebra : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    (∀ c : ℂ, taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
    (∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀)
  mvDeriv_rules :
    (∀ Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      mvDerivA (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ + mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ + mvDerivD Ψ ∧
      mvDerivA (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivA Ψ ∧
      mvDerivD (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivD Ψ) ∧
    (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        mvDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
        mvDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀)
  mvDeriv_compPowerSeries2D : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
    mvDerivA (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivA Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ ∧
    mvDerivD (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
      mvDerivD Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  compPowerSeries2D_inj : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → pderivA ψ p₀ ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (f₁ f₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
      compPowerSeries2D f₁ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) =
        compPowerSeries2D f₂ (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) →
      f₁ = f₂

noncomputable def webDiffCoeffA (A w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, 0 => w
  | 0, _ + 1 => fun _ => 0
  | α + 1, 0 => pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α 0)
  | α + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivA (webDiffCoeffA A w α (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeffA A w α k p * A p

noncomputable def webDiffCoeff (A B_ψ w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (α : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, k => webDiffCoeffA A w α k
  | β + 1, 0 => pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β 0)
  | β + 1, k + 1 => fun p =>
      pderivD (webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β (k + 1)) p + webDiffCoeff A B_ψ w α β k p * B_ψ p

noncomputable def webVandermondeMat {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun r i =>
    w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivD (ψ i) p) ^ r.val

def webODEDomain {m : ℕ} (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus | (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).det ≠ 0 }

structure WebPDESystem {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) where
  M_a : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin m × Fin m) (Fin m × Fin m) ℂ
  c_a : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (Fin m × Fin m → ℂ)
  isOpen_ode : IsOpen (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  ode_sub_U₀ : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U₀
  ode_sub_U_plus : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus ⊆ U_plus
  mem_ode_domain : ∀ p ∈ U₀ ∩ U_plus,
    (∀ i : Fin m, w i p ≠ 0) →
    (∀ i : Fin m, pderivA (ψ i) p ≠ 0) →
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m => pderivD (ψ i) p / pderivA (ψ i) p) →
    p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus
  M_a_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_a p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  M_δ_holo : ∀ idx j : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_δ p idx j) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_a_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_a p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  c_δ_holo : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_δ p idx) (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus)
  cross_rel : ∀ p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ V : Fin m × Fin m → ℂ, ∀ i : Fin m,
    pderivD (ψ i) p * ((M_a p).mulVec V + c_a p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) =
      pderivA (ψ i) p * ((M_δ p).mulVec V + c_δ p) (i, ⟨0, hm⟩)
  formal_ode : ∀ p₁ ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus, ∀ f : Fin m → PowerSeries ℂ,
    (∑ i : Fin m,
      taylor2D (w i) p₁ * compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁) =
      taylor2D B p₁) →
    ∃ V_formal : Fin m × Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ i : Fin m,
        V_formal (i, ⟨0, hm⟩) = compPowerSeries2D (f i) (centeredTaylor2D (ψ i) p₁)) ∧
      (∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
        mvDerivA (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁ ∧
        mvDerivD (V_formal idx) =
          ∑ j : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k hk j hj0 hjk ι
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := line_glancing_chart_and_hessian Ω C B k hk
  let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := lineChainBox C B k
  have hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hW_open : IsOpen W := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
  have hW_convex : Convex ℝ W := by
    intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp_all
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im := by simp
        rw [h1]
        calc |a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im|
            ≤ |a * p.1.im| + |b * q.1.im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |p.1.im| + b * |q.1.im| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          _ < a * B.s_det + b * B.s_det := by
              have hlt1 : a * |p.1.im| < a * B.s_det := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp.1 ha_pos
              have hle2 : b * |q.1.im| ≤ b * B.s_det :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq.1) hb
              linarith
          _ = B.s_det := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      · have h2 : (a • p + b • q).2 = a • p.2 + b • q.2 := rfl
        rw [h2]
        calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖
            ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
          _ < a * (B.r_det / (k : ℝ)) + b * (B.r_det / (k : ℝ)) := by
              have hlt1 : a * ‖p.2‖ < a * (B.r_det / (k : ℝ)) :=
                mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp.2 ha_pos
              have hle2 : b * ‖q.2‖ ≤ b * (B.r_det / (k : ℝ)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq.2) hb
              linarith
          _ = B.r_det / (k : ℝ) := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  have hW_nonempty : W.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨(0, 0), ?_⟩
    simp [W, lineChainBox, B.s_det_pos, div_pos B.r_det_pos hk_pos]
  have hemb_exhaust : ∀ S : Finset LineJetAll,
      ∃ M : ℕ, (S : Set LineJetAll) ⊆ Set.range (lineJetEmb M) := by
    intro S
    refine ⟨S.sup (fun v => max v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2), ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    have hv_sup : max v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 ≤ S.sup (fun u => max u.2.2.1 u.2.2.2) :=
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun u : LineJetAll => max u.2.2.1 u.2.2.2) hv
    have h1 : v.2.2.1 < S.sup (fun u => max u.2.2.1 u.2.2.2) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((le_max_left _ _).trans hv_sup)
    have h2 : v.2.2.2 < S.sup (fun u => max u.2.2.1 u.2.2.2) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((le_max_right _ _).trans hv_sup)
    exact ⟨(v.1, v.2.1, ⟨v.2.2.1, h1⟩, ⟨v.2.2.2, h2⟩), rfl⟩
  have hShift_maps : ∀ (m : ℕ), m ≤ k →
      Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (m : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) W
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * B.r_det } := by
    intro m hm q hq
    have hm_le : (m : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hm
    have hq2_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖q.2‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h_im_le : |((m : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ (k : ℝ) * ‖q.2‖ := by
      calc |((m : ℂ) * q.2).im|
          ≤ ‖(m : ℂ) * q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = (m : ℝ) * ‖q.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
        _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * ‖q.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hq2_nonneg
    have h_mul_lt : (k : ℝ) * ‖q.2‖ < B.r_det := (lt_div_iff₀' hk_pos).mp hq.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have him_eq : (q.1 + (m : ℂ) * q.2).im = q.1.im + ((m : ℂ) * q.2).im :=
        Complex.add_im _ _
      rw [him_eq]
      have htri : |q.1.im + ((m : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ |q.1.im| + |((m : ℂ) * q.2).im| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      linarith [hq.1, B.r_det_lt_s_det, B.s_det_pos]
    · have hk_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ k)
      have hdiv_le : B.r_det / (k : ℝ) ≤ B.r_det :=
        div_le_self (le_of_lt B.r_det_pos) hk_ge1
      linarith [hq.2, B.r_det_pos]
  have hShift_holo : ∀ (m : ℕ), m ≤ k → ∀ c : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (m : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c) W := by
    intro m hm c
    have haff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (m : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) :=
      (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const _ |>.mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
        differentiable_snd
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ
      ((fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 c) ∘
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (m : ℂ) * q.2, q.2))) W
    exact (B.dualLine_holo c).comp haff.differentiableOn (hShift_maps m hm)
  have hW_sub_base : W ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * B.r_det } := by
    intro q hq
    refine ⟨by linarith [hq.1, B.s_det_pos], ?_⟩
    have hk_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ k)
    have hdiv_le : B.r_det / (k : ℝ) ≤ B.r_det :=
      div_le_self (le_of_lt B.r_det_pos) hk_ge1
    linarith [hq.2, B.r_det_pos]
  have hjet_holo : ∀ v : LineJetAll, DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineJetFnAll C k v) W := by
    intro v
    unfold lineJetFnAll
    split_ifs
    · exact B.iterDerivYT_holo hW_open ((B.dualLine_holo v.2.1).mono hW_sub_base) v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2
    · exact B.iterDerivYT_holo hW_open (hShift_holo k le_rfl v.2.1) v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2
  let zFn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + (j : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 ι
  have hzFn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ zFn W :=
    hShift_holo j (le_of_lt hjk) ι
  have h_strip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_real_mem_strip : ∀ θ : ℝ, (θ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
    intro θ
    simp [horizStrip, C.s_h_pos]
  have h_deriv1_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, deriv C.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ) = ((deriv C.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    have hℂ : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) (deriv C.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ)) θ :=
      ((C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (h_real_mem_strip θ))).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
    have hℝ : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((deriv C.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) θ :=
      (((C.h_smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt).hasDerivAt).ofReal_comp
    have hfun : (fun x : ℝ => C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) = (fun x : ℝ => ((C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      funext C.h_ℂ_real
    exact hℂ.unique (hfun ▸ hℝ)
  have hh'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv h_strip_open
  have h_deriv2_real : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ : ℂ) = ((deriv (deriv C.h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    have hℂ : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => deriv C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ : ℂ)) θ :=
      ((hh'_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_open.mem_nhds (h_real_mem_strip θ))).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
    have hh'_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ((1 : WithTop ℕ∞)) (deriv C.h) := by
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ((1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) C.h := C.h_smooth.of_le (by decide)
      exact h2.deriv'
    have hℝ : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ))
        ((deriv (deriv C.h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) θ :=
      ((hh'_smooth.differentiable_one.differentiableAt).hasDerivAt).ofReal_comp
    have hfun : (fun x : ℝ => deriv C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) = (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      funext h_deriv1_real
    exact hℂ.unique (hfun ▸ hℝ)
  have hr_ne_all : ∀ a : ℝ, C.h_ℂ (a : ℂ) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro a
    rw [C.h_ℂ_real a, h_deriv2_real a, ← Complex.ofReal_add]
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (C.r_pos a))
  have hK0_count : Countable (↥(⊥ : Subfield ℂ)) := by
    rw [Subfield.bot_eq_of_charZero]
    exact Set.countable_range (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)
  have ha_lt : G.a₀ - G.R / 4 < G.a₀ + G.R / 4 := by linarith [G.R_pos]
  have ha_sub : ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4), (a : ℂ) ∈ G.U_a := by
    intro a ha
    rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [ha.1, ha.2, G.R_pos]
  have hd_sub : ∀ d ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) G.δ_star, (d : ℂ) ∈ G.U_d := by
    intro d hd
    rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hd.1]
    linarith [hd.2, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hΨ_maps_W : ∀ q ∈ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d, G.Ψ q ∈ W :=
    fun q hq => G.V_W_sub (G.Ψ_maps_V_W q hq)
  have hΨ_surj_V : ∀ p ∈ G.V_W, ∃ q ∈ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d, G.Ψ q = p := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨_, (G.Φ_right_inv p hp).1, (G.Φ_right_inv p hp).2⟩
  have hPtAlg : ∀ a₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4),
      ∀ δ₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) G.δ_star,
        IsAlgebraic (↥(linePointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁))
          (zFn (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))) := by
    intro a₁ ha₁ δ₁ hδ₁
    obtain ⟨E⟩ := line_core_vandermonde_elimination Ω C B k hk G hAlg a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
    have hCoreAlg : ∀ r : Fin E.N_core, IsAlgebraic (↥E.K_end) (E.coreTuple r) := by
      by_contra hNotAll
      rw [not_forall] at hNotAll
      obtain ⟨D_cont⟩ :=
        line_formal_arc_web_continuation Ω C B k hk G a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁ E hAlg hWeb hNotAll
      have hg_zero_Ioo : ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
          D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀ (a : ℂ) = 0 := by
        intro a ha
        exact line_coalescing_cubic_variational_zero k D_cont.p hk D_cont.p_pos a C.h_ℂ
          (hr_ne_all a) (fun i => D_cont.g_lead i (a : ℂ)) hAlg
          (fun n hn => D_cont.trunc_models (n * D_cont.p)
            (by nlinarith [D_cont.p_pos]) a ha)
          D_cont.i₀
      have hg_analytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀) D_cont.W_lead :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn D_cont.W_lead_open).mpr
          (D_cont.g_lead_holo D_cont.i₀)
      have ha₀_mem : (G.a₀ : ℂ) ∈ D_cont.W_lead :=
        D_cont.real_mem_W_lead G.a₀ (by simp [G.R_pos])
      have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (G.a₀ : ℂ) {(G.a₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ,
          D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀ z = 0 := by
        let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => G.a₀ + G.R / ((n : ℝ) + 2)
        have hx_tendsto_R : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds G.a₀) := by
          have hdiv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G.R / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
              (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
          simpa [x_seq] using tendsto_const_nhds.add hdiv
        have hx_tendsto_C : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (x_seq n : ℂ))
            Filter.atTop (nhds (G.a₀ : ℂ)) :=
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto G.a₀).comp hx_tendsto_R
        have hx_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, (x_seq n : ℂ) ∈ ({(G.a₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := by
          intro n
          simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Complex.ofReal_inj, x_seq]
          have hpos : 0 < G.R / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := div_pos G.R_pos (by positivity)
          linarith
        have hx_nhdsWithin : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (x_seq n : ℂ))
            Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (G.a₀ : ℂ) {(G.a₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ) :=
          tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ hx_tendsto_C
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hx_ne)
        have hx_zero : ∀ n : ℕ, D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀ (x_seq n : ℂ) = 0 := by
          intro n
          apply hg_zero_Ioo (x_seq n)
          have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
          have hden : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
          have hpos : 0 < G.R / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := div_pos G.R_pos (by linarith)
          have hle : G.R / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ G.R / 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt G.R_pos) (by norm_num) hden
          constructor <;> linarith [G.R_pos]
        exact hx_nhdsWithin.frequently (Filter.Frequently.of_forall hx_zero)
      have hg_eq_zero : Set.EqOn (D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀) 0 D_cont.W_lead :=
        hg_analytic.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
          D_cont.W_lead_preconn ha₀_mem h_freq
      let z₁ : ℂ := G.ψ_fn D_cont.i₀ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
      have hz₁_mem : z₁ ∈ D_cont.W_lead := (D_cont.g_lead_taylor D_cont.i₀).1
      have h_ev_zero : D_cont.g_lead D_cont.i₀ =ᶠ[nhds z₁] (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (D_cont.W_lead_open.mem_nhds hz₁_mem)
          (fun w hw => hg_eq_zero hw)
      have hf_zero : D_cont.f_lead D_cont.i₀ = 0 := by
        ext n
        rw [map_zero, ← (D_cont.g_lead_taylor D_cont.i₀).2 n,
          h_ev_zero.iteratedDeriv_eq n, iteratedDeriv_const]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      exact D_cont.f_lead_i₀_ne_zero hf_zero
    let z_val : ℂ := zFn (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
    have hz_mem_F : z_val ∈ E.F_val := E.dualLine_mem_F_val j hj0 hjk ι
    have hz_alg_Kend : IsAlgebraic (↥E.K_end) z_val := by
      by_contra hz_not_alg
      let c_ext : Fin (E.N_core + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc E.coreTuple z_val
      have hc_last : c_ext (Fin.last E.N_core) = z_val :=
        Fin.snoc_last (α := fun _ => ℂ) z_val E.coreTuple
      have hc_cast : ∀ r : Fin E.N_core, c_ext r.castSucc = E.coreTuple r :=
        fun r => Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := fun _ => ℂ) z_val E.coreTuple r
      have h_ext_nonAlg : ∃ s : Fin (E.N_core + 1), ¬ IsAlgebraic (↥E.K_end) (c_ext s) :=
        ⟨Fin.last E.N_core, hc_last.symm ▸ hz_not_alg⟩
      obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ_K, hΦ_const, ⟨s₀, hs₀_ne⟩⟩ :=
        hAlg.formal_arc E.K_end (E.N_core + 1) c_ext h_ext_nonAlg
      let F_ext : Subfield ℂ := Subfield.closure ((E.K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range c_ext)
      have hΦ_fixes_alg : ∀ (y : ↥F_ext),
          IsAlgebraic (↥E.K_end) (y : ℂ) → Φ y = PowerSeries.C (y : ℂ) := by
        intro y hy_alg
        rcases hy_alg with ⟨P, hP_ne, hP_aeval⟩
        let P_ℂ : Polynomial ℂ := P.map (algebraMap (↥E.K_end) ℂ)
        have hP_ℂ_ne : P_ℂ ≠ 0 :=
          Polynomial.map_ne_zero hP_ne
        have hP_ℂ_eval : P_ℂ.eval (y : ℂ) = 0 := by
          have haeval_eq : Polynomial.aeval (y : ℂ) P = P_ℂ.eval (y : ℂ) := by
            rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map]
          exact haeval_eq ▸ hP_aeval
        have hK_le_Fext : E.K_end ≤ F_ext :=
          fun x hx => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)
        let ι_K : ↥E.K_end →+* ↥F_ext := Subfield.inclusion hK_le_Fext
        have hΦ_comp : Φ.comp ι_K = PowerSeries.C.comp (algebraMap (↥E.K_end) ℂ) :=
          RingHom.ext fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => hΦ_K x hx
        have hP_Φ_eval : (P_ℂ.map PowerSeries.C).eval (Φ y) = 0 := by
          have hmap : P_ℂ.map PowerSeries.C = (P.map ι_K).map Φ := by
            rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, hΦ_comp]
          rw [hmap, Polynomial.eval_map_apply Φ y, ← map_zero Φ]
          congr 1
          apply Subtype.ext
          change algebraMap (↥F_ext) ℂ ((P.map ι_K).eval y) = (0 : ℂ)
          have hval : (algebraMap (↥F_ext) ℂ).comp ι_K = algebraMap (↥E.K_end) ℂ := rfl
          rw [← Polynomial.eval_map_apply (algebraMap (↥F_ext) ℂ) y,
            Polynomial.map_map, hval]
          exact hP_ℂ_eval
        obtain ⟨Q, hPQ, hQ_ndvd⟩ :=
          Polynomial.exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd P_ℂ hP_ℂ_ne (y : ℂ)
        have hQ_eval_ne : Q.eval (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hQ0
          exact hQ_ndvd (Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hQ0)
        have hprod_zero :
            (Φ y - PowerSeries.C (y : ℂ)) ^ (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (y : ℂ) P_ℂ) *
              (Q.map PowerSeries.C).eval (Φ y) = 0 := by
          have h := hP_Φ_eval
          rw [hPQ, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_sub,
            Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
            Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] at h
          exact h
        have hQ_ps_ne : (Q.map PowerSeries.C).eval (Φ y) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hQ_ps
          apply hQ_eval_ne
          have hc := congr_arg PowerSeries.constantCoeff hQ_ps
          rw [map_zero] at hc
          have hc_eq : PowerSeries.constantCoeff ((Q.map PowerSeries.C).eval (Φ y)) =
              Q.eval (y : ℂ) := by
            rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map, Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
            have hcomp : PowerSeries.constantCoeff.comp (PowerSeries.C (R := ℂ)) =
                RingHom.id ℂ :=
              RingHom.ext fun w => by simp
            rw [hcomp, hΦ_const y, Polynomial.eval₂_id]
          exact hc_eq ▸ hc
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod_zero with hpow | hQ0
        · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hpow)
        · exact False.elim (hQ_ps_ne hQ0)
      let L_fix : Subfield ℂ :=
        { carrier := { w : ℂ | ∃ hw : w ∈ F_ext, Φ ⟨w, hw⟩ = PowerSeries.C w }
          mul_mem' := by
            rintro a b ⟨ha, hΦa⟩ ⟨hb, hΦb⟩
            refine ⟨F_ext.mul_mem ha hb, ?_⟩
            change Φ (⟨a, ha⟩ * ⟨b, hb⟩) = PowerSeries.C (a * b)
            rw [map_mul, hΦa, hΦb, map_mul]
          one_mem' := ⟨F_ext.one_mem, by change Φ 1 = PowerSeries.C 1; rw [map_one, map_one]⟩
          add_mem' := by
            rintro a b ⟨ha, hΦa⟩ ⟨hb, hΦb⟩
            refine ⟨F_ext.add_mem ha hb, ?_⟩
            change Φ (⟨a, ha⟩ + ⟨b, hb⟩) = PowerSeries.C (a + b)
            rw [map_add, hΦa, hΦb, map_add]
          zero_mem' := ⟨F_ext.zero_mem, by change Φ 0 = PowerSeries.C 0; rw [map_zero, map_zero]⟩
          neg_mem' := by
            rintro a ⟨ha, hΦa⟩
            refine ⟨F_ext.neg_mem ha, ?_⟩
            change Φ (-⟨a, ha⟩) = PowerSeries.C (-a)
            rw [map_neg, hΦa, map_neg]
          inv_mem' := by
            rintro a ⟨ha, hΦa⟩
            refine ⟨F_ext.inv_mem ha, ?_⟩
            by_cases ha0 : a = 0
            · subst ha0
              have h0 : (⟨(0 : ℂ)⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ : ↥F_ext) = 0 := by
                apply Subtype.ext
                exact _root_.inv_zero
              rw [h0, _root_.inv_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
            · have ha_sub_ne : (⟨a, ha⟩ : ↥F_ext) ≠ 0 := Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mp ha0
              have hCa_ne : (PowerSeries.C a : PowerSeries ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
                intro hC0
                exact ha0 (by simpa using congr_arg PowerSeries.constantCoeff hC0)
              apply mul_right_cancel₀ hCa_ne
              calc Φ ⟨a⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ * PowerSeries.C a
                  = Φ ⟨a⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ * Φ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by rw [← hΦa]
                _ = Φ (⟨a, ha⟩⁻¹ * ⟨a, ha⟩) := by rw [← map_mul]; rfl
                _ = 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha_sub_ne, map_one]
                _ = PowerSeries.C (a⁻¹ * a) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha0, map_one]
                _ = PowerSeries.C a⁻¹ * PowerSeries.C a := by rw [map_mul] }
      have hFval_le_Lfix : E.F_val ≤ L_fix := by
        apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
        rintro w (hwK | ⟨r, rfl⟩)
        · exact ⟨Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hwK), hΦ_K w hwK⟩
        · have hr_mem : E.coreTuple r ∈ F_ext :=
            Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, hc_cast r⟩)
          exact ⟨hr_mem, hΦ_fixes_alg ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ (hCoreAlg r)⟩
      rcases hFval_le_Lfix hz_mem_F with ⟨hz_Fext, hΦz⟩
      refine hs₀_ne ?_
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ s₀
      · have hsub_eq : (⟨c_ext (Fin.last E.N_core),
            Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨Fin.last E.N_core, rfl⟩)⟩ : ↥F_ext) =
            ⟨z_val, hz_Fext⟩ := Subtype.ext hc_last
        rw [hsub_eq, hc_last]
        exact hΦz
      · intro r
        have hr_mem : E.coreTuple r ∈ F_ext :=
          Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, hc_cast r⟩)
        have hsub_eq : (⟨c_ext r.castSucc,
            Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, rfl⟩)⟩ : ↥F_ext) =
            ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ := Subtype.ext (hc_cast r)
        rw [hsub_eq, hc_cast r]
        exact hΦ_fixes_alg ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ (hCoreAlg r)
    exact E.K_end_alg_over_pt z_val hz_alg_Kend
  obtain ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, hVanish, ⟨p_wit, hp_wit, hQD_ne, hDisc_ne⟩, hSep⟩ :=
    hAlg.lift_separable LineJetAll LineJetVar lineJetEmb hemb_exhaust W hW_open hW_convex
      hW_nonempty (lineJetFnAll C k) zFn hjet_holo hzFn_holo
      (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4) 0 G.δ_star ha_lt G.δ_star_pos
      G.U_a G.U_d Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected ha_sub hd_sub
      G.Ψ G.Ψ_holo hΨ_maps_W G.V_W G.V_W_open G.V_W_nonempty G.V_W_sub hΨ_surj_V
      (⊥ : Subfield ℂ) hPtAlg
  refine ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, ?_, ?_, hSep⟩
  · intro y t hy ht
    exact hVanish (y, t) ⟨hy, ht⟩
  · exact ⟨p_wit.1, p_wit.2, hp_wit.1, hp_wit.2, hQD_ne, hDisc_ne⟩

line_endpoint_chain_determination.definitions:
def lineChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / (k : ℝ) }

abbrev LineJetAll : Type := Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ

def lineJetEmb (M : ℕ) (w : LineJetVar M) : LineJetAll :=
  (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1.1, w.2.2.2.1)

noncomputable def lineJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (v : LineJetAll) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if v.1 = 0 then
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 v.2.1) p
  else
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1) p

noncomputable def linePointField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : LineJetAll => lineJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

noncomputable def lineChainMid {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.castSucc + α i.succ) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainHalfStep {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.succ - α i.castSucc) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainAction {k : ℕ} (h_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, 2 * h_vec i (lineChainMid α i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i)

noncomputable def lineInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  h'_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h'_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_R) -
    h_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_R)

noncomputable def lineInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec h''_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let ψ_L := lineChainMid α i_L
    let d_L := lineChainHalfStep α i_L
    let ψ_R := lineChainMid α i_R
    let d_R := lineChainHalfStep α i_R
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      ((h''_vec i_L ψ_L - h_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L +
        h'_vec i_L ψ_L * Complex.cos d_L) +
      ((h''_vec i_R ψ_R - h_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R -
        h'_vec i_R ψ_R * Complex.cos d_R)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_R ψ_R + h''_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_L ψ_L + h''_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L
    else
      0

noncomputable def lineChartAlpha {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2

noncomputable def lineChartPsi {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainMid (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartHalfStep {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainHalfStep (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartWeight {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * Complex.sin (lineChartHalfStep C k Ψ i q)

noncomputable def lineChartAction {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainAction (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q)

structure LineGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  a₀_eq : a₀ = C.ϕ 0
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ lineChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.1 ∧
    glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
      glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) = p
  α_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  α_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  ψ_maps_strip : ∀ i : Fin k,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      lineChartPsi C k Ψ i q ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  stationary_on_chart : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
        (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s q) r = 0
  action_deriv_a : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
        glancingOffset C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2
  action_deriv_d : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2
  α_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤ (deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (∀ i : Fin k, lineChartWeight C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin k =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ))
      (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_a {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (G.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * G.R)

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_d {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * G.δ_star)

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.α_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ r q

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.d_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.w_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

    (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.A_line {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)

  lineChartAction C k G.Ψ q

structure LineCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  K_end : Subfield ℂ
  N_core : ℕ
  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  K_end_alg_over_pt : ∀ z : ℂ,
    IsAlgebraic (↥K_end) z → IsAlgebraic (↥(linePointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁)) z
  cos_half_zero_mem : Complex.cos ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_zero_mem : Complex.sin ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  cos_half_last_mem : Complex.cos (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_last_mem : Complex.sin (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end
  action_pos_taylor_mem : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d ≠ 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_line ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈ K_end
  action_val_mem :
    G.A_line ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  half_angles_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Complex.cos (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple) ∧
    Complex.sin (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  support_jets_mem : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
    iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  angle_taylor_mem : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  core_entries_subset :
    Set.range coreTuple ⊆
      { z : ℂ |
        (∃ r : Fin (k + 1),
          z = Complex.cos (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∨
          z = Complex.sin (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2)) ∨
        (∃ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
          z = iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))) }
  dualLine_mem_F_val : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    glancingDualLine C
      ((G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).1 + (j : ℂ) * (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2)
      (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2 ι ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)

noncomputable abbrev LineCoreEliminationData.F_val {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ}
    {G : LineGlancingChartData C B k} {a₁ δ₁ : ℝ}
    (E : LineCoreEliminationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure ((E.K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range E.coreTuple)

structure LineTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin k → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_n
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_n
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g i l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g i ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p i
  K : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  α₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  α₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    α₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ α₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  α₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (α₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  α₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (α₀ δ) i ∈ W_n
  α₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (α₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineInteriorGrad
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun i z => deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s)
          r)
      0 = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineChainAction
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) = K l

structure LineContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_lead_i₀_ne_zero : f_lead i₀ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead i) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead i) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead i)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (LineTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a C.h_ℂ (fun i => g_lead i (a : ℂ)))

def lineChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / (k : ℝ) }

abbrev LineJetAll : Type := Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ

def lineJetEmb (M : ℕ) (w : LineJetVar M) : LineJetAll :=
  (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1.1, w.2.2.2.1)

noncomputable def lineJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (v : LineJetAll) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if v.1 = 0 then
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 v.2.1) p
  else
    iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1) p

noncomputable def linePointField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : LineJetAll => lineJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

noncomputable def lineChainMid {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.castSucc + α i.succ) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainHalfStep {k : ℕ} (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (α i.succ - α i.castSucc) / 2

noncomputable def lineChainAction {k : ℕ} (h_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, 2 * h_vec i (lineChainMid α i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i)

noncomputable def lineInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  h'_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h_vec i_L (lineChainMid α i_L) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_L) +
    h'_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α i_R) -
    h_vec i_R (lineChainMid α i_R) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α i_R)

noncomputable def lineInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (h_vec h'_vec h''_vec : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let ψ_L := lineChainMid α i_L
    let d_L := lineChainHalfStep α i_L
    let ψ_R := lineChainMid α i_R
    let d_R := lineChainHalfStep α i_R
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      ((h''_vec i_L ψ_L - h_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L +
        h'_vec i_L ψ_L * Complex.cos d_L) +
      ((h''_vec i_R ψ_R - h_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R -
        h'_vec i_R ψ_R * Complex.cos d_R)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_R ψ_R + h''_vec i_R ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      (h_vec i_L ψ_L + h''_vec i_L ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L
    else
      0

noncomputable def lineChartAlpha {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2

noncomputable def lineChartPsi {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainMid (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartHalfStep {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainHalfStep (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q) i

noncomputable def lineChartWeight {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * Complex.sin (lineChartHalfStep C k Ψ i q)

noncomputable def lineChartAction {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  lineChainAction (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun r => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r q)

structure LineGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  a₀_eq : a₀ = C.ϕ 0
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ lineChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.1 ∧
    glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
      glancingTheta C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2 = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2) = p
  α_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  α_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  ψ_maps_strip : ∀ i : Fin k,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      lineChartPsi C k Ψ i q ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  stationary_on_chart : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
        (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s q) r = 0
  action_deriv_a : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 -
        glancingOffset C (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2
  action_deriv_d : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (lineChartAction C k Ψ) q =
      glancingOffset C ((Ψ q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2
  α_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤ (deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (∀ i : Fin k, lineChartWeight C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun i : Fin k =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => lineChartPsi C k Ψ i (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ))
      (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_a {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (G.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * G.R)

abbrev LineGlancingChartData.U_d {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * G.δ_star)

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.d_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.w_fn {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

noncomputable abbrev LineGlancingChartData.A_line {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}

structure LineCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  K_end : Subfield ℂ
  N_core : ℕ
  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  K_end_alg_over_pt : ∀ z : ℂ,
    IsAlgebraic (↥K_end) z → IsAlgebraic (↥(linePointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁)) z
  cos_half_zero_mem : Complex.cos ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_zero_mem : Complex.sin ((a₁ : ℂ) / 2) ∈ K_end
  cos_half_last_mem : Complex.cos (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end
  sin_half_last_mem : Complex.sin (((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈ K_end
  action_pos_taylor_mem : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d ≠ 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_line ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈ K_end
  action_val_mem :
    G.A_line ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  half_angles_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Complex.cos (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple) ∧
    Complex.sin (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  support_jets_mem : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
    iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  angle_taylor_mem : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  core_entries_subset :
    Set.range coreTuple ⊆
      { z : ℂ |
        (∃ r : Fin (k + 1),
          z = Complex.cos (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2) ∨
          z = Complex.sin (G.α_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) / 2)) ∨
        (∃ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
          z = iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))) }
  dualLine_mem_F_val : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    glancingDualLine C
      ((G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).1 + (j : ℂ) * (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2)
      (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2 ι ∈
      Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)

noncomputable abbrev LineCoreEliminationData.F_val {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ}
    {G : LineGlancingChartData C B k} {a₁ δ₁ : ℝ}
    (E : LineCoreEliminationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure ((E.K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range E.coreTuple)

structure LineTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin k → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_n
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_n
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g i l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g i ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p i
  K : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  α₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  α₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    α₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ α₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  α₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (α₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  α₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (α₀ δ) i ∈ W_n
  α₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (α₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineInteriorGrad
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun i z => deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s)
          r)
      0 = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        lineChainAction
          (fun i z => h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z)
          (fun s => α₀ δ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m δ s))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) = K l

structure LineContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_lead_i₀_ne_zero : f_lead i₀ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead i) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead i) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead i)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (LineTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a C.h_ℂ (fun i => g_lead i (a : ℂ)))

  have hW_open : IsOpen W := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
  have hW_convex : Convex ℝ W := by
    intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp_all
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im := by simp
        rw [h1]
        calc |a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im|
