        zero_mem' := ⟨F_ext.zero_mem, by change Φ 0 = PowerSeries.C 0; rw [map_zero, map_zero]⟩
        neg_mem' := by
          rintro a ⟨ha, hΦa⟩
          refine ⟨F_ext.neg_mem ha, ?_⟩
          change Φ (-⟨a, ha⟩) = PowerSeries.C (-a)
          rw [map_neg, hΦa, map_neg]
        inv_mem' := by
          rintro a ⟨ha, hΦa⟩
          refine ⟨F_ext.inv_mem ha, ?_⟩
          by_cases ha0 : a = 0
          · subst ha0
            have h0 : (⟨(0 : ℂ)⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ : ↥F_ext) = 0 := by
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact _root_.inv_zero
            rw [h0, _root_.inv_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
          · have ha_sub_ne : (⟨a, ha⟩ : ↥F_ext) ≠ 0 := Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mp ha0
            have hCa_ne : (PowerSeries.C a : PowerSeries ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
              intro hC0
              exact ha0 (by simpa using congr_arg PowerSeries.constantCoeff hC0)
            apply mul_right_cancel₀ hCa_ne
            calc Φ ⟨a⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ * PowerSeries.C a
                = Φ ⟨a⁻¹, F_ext.inv_mem ha⟩ * Φ ⟨a, ha⟩ := by rw [← hΦa]
              _ = Φ (⟨a, ha⟩⁻¹ * ⟨a, ha⟩) := by rw [← map_mul]; rfl
              _ = 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha_sub_ne, map_one]
              _ = PowerSeries.C (a⁻¹ * a) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha0, map_one]
              _ = PowerSeries.C a⁻¹ * PowerSeries.C a := by rw [map_mul] }
    have hFval_le_Lfix : E.F_val ≤ L_fix := by
      apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
      rintro w (hwK | ⟨r, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hwK), hΦ_K w hwK⟩
      · have hr_mem : E.coreTuple r ∈ F_ext :=
          Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, hc_cast r⟩)
        exact ⟨hr_mem, hΦ_fixes_alg ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ (hCoreAlg r)⟩
    rcases hFval_le_Lfix hz_mem_F with ⟨hz_Fext, hΦz⟩
    refine hs₀_ne ?_
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ s₀
    · have hsub_eq : (⟨c_ext (Fin.last E.N_core),
          Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨Fin.last E.N_core, rfl⟩)⟩ : ↥F_ext) =
          ⟨z_val, hz_Fext⟩ := Subtype.ext hc_last
      rw [hsub_eq, hc_last]
      exact hΦz
    · intro r
      have hr_mem : E.coreTuple r ∈ F_ext :=
        Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, hc_cast r⟩)
      have hsub_eq : (⟨c_ext r.castSucc,
          Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r.castSucc, rfl⟩)⟩ : ↥F_ext) =
          ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ := Subtype.ext (hc_cast r)
      rw [hsub_eq, hc_cast r]
      exact hΦ_fixes_alg ⟨E.coreTuple r, hr_mem⟩ (hCoreAlg r)
  obtain ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, hVanish, ⟨p_wit, hp_wit, hQD_ne, hDisc_ne⟩, hSep⟩ :=
    hAlg.lift_separable PointJetAll PointJetVar pointJetEmb hemb_exhaust W hW_open hW_convex
      hW_nonempty (pointJetFnAll C k) zFn hjet_holo hzFn_holo
      (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4) 0 G.δ_star ha_lt G.δ_star_pos
      G.U_a G.U_d Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected ha_sub hd_sub
      G.Ψ G.Ψ_holo hΨ_maps_W G.V_W G.V_W_open G.V_W_nonempty G.V_W_sub hΨ_surj_V
      (⊥ : Subfield ℂ) hPtAlg
  have hEnv_eq : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      (fun w : PointJetVar M => pointJetFnAll C k (pointJetEmb M w) p) =
      pointJetEnv M
        (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
        (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
        C.A p := by
    intro p
    funext w
    cases w with
    | inl v =>
        dsimp only [pointJetFnAll, pointJetEmb, pointJetEnv]
        split_ifs <;> rfl
    | inr β =>
        rfl
  refine ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, ?_, ?_, hSep⟩
  · intro y t hy ht
    simpa only [hEnv_eq] using hVanish (y, t) ⟨hy, ht⟩
  · refine ⟨p_wit.1, p_wit.2, hp_wit.1, hp_wit.2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hEnv_eq] using hQD_ne
    · simpa only [hEnv_eq] using hDisc_ne

point_endpoint_chain_determination.definitions:
def pointChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) }

abbrev PointJetAll : Type := Sum (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) ℕ

def pointJetEmb (M : ℕ) : PointJetVar M → PointJetAll
  | Sum.inl v => Sum.inl (v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1.1, v.2.2.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β => Sum.inr β.1

noncomputable def pointJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    PointJetAll → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      if v.1 = 0 then
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 v.2.1)
      else
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β =>
      fun p => iterDeriv1D β C.A p.2

noncomputable def pointBaseField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : PointJetAll => pointJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

def rotCoordX (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => -P 1

def rotCoordY (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 1
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => P 0

def unrotPoint (rotIdx : Fin 4) (x Y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => ![x, Y]
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => ![-x, -Y]
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => ![-Y, x]
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => ![Y, -x]

noncomputable def sqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointEdgeSq {k : ℕ} (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (x_vec i.succ - x_vec i.castSucc) ^ 2 +
    (F_vec i.succ (x_vec i.succ) - F_vec i.castSucc (x_vec i.castSucc)) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointRelEdgeLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  ℓ_base i * sqrt1p ((pointEdgeSq F_vec x_vec i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)

noncomputable def pointRelChainLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i

noncomputable def pointRelInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec F'_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let L_L := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_L
  let L_R := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_R
  ((x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ) - F_vec i_L.castSucc (x_vec i_L.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ)) / L_L -
    ((x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_R.succ (x_vec i_R.succ) - F_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) / L_R

noncomputable def pointInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F F' F'' : ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let Δx_L := x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := F (x_vec i_L.succ) - F (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let Δx_R := x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := F (x_vec i_R.succ) - F (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.succ)
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_L.succ) ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F'' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 -
          n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc) ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F'' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 -
          n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_R.succ) * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 +
        n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc) * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 +
        n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3
    else
      0

noncomputable def pointChartACoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C p.1 p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartBCoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartDetAB {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p

noncomputable def pointChartX {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2)

noncomputable def pointChartAction {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q

noncomputable def pointChartActionAB {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q_ab : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  pointChartAction ℓ_fn (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)

noncomputable def pointChartPsiWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else if r.1 = k - 1 then
    q.1
  else
    q.1 + q.2

noncomputable def pointChartWWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q -
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 2, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else
    -1

structure PointGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  rotIdx : Fin 4
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  W_F : Set ℂ
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  W_F_open : IsOpen W_F
  W_F_preconn : IsPreconnected W_F
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_F
  F_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R + 2 * δ_star →
    (x : ℂ) ∈ W_F ∧ (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0
  F_curv_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R →
    deriv (deriv F) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ v_x : ℝ, deriv F (x : ℂ) = (v_x : ℂ)
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ pointChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ
    (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.1 ∧
    pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx (Ψ q) - pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) = p
  det_ab_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ V_W, pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx p ≠ 0
  x_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  x_holo_maps : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q ∈ W_F ∧
      rotCoordY rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2) =
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q)
  ℓ_holo_sq : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_fn i)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (ℓ_fn i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q) i
  symplectic_mixed_deriv : ∀ q_ab : ℂ × ℂ,
    (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) →
    iterDerivYT 1 1 (pointChartActionAB ℓ_fn) q_ab =
      C.A (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)).2 /
        pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
  stationary_on_nondeg :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0) →
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ_fn i q) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F)
          (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s q) r = 0
  x_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤
      (deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).1.im = 0 ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.im = 0 ∧
    0 < (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      0 < (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re ∧
      (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      pointChartWWeb C k rotIdx F Ψ ℓ_fn r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun r : Fin (k + 1) =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))) F (deriv F)
      (deriv (deriv F))
      (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

abbrev PointGlancingChartData.U_a {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (G.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * G.R)

abbrev PointGlancingChartData.U_d {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ} (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k) : Set ℂ :=

structure PointCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)

  N_core : ℕ
  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  endpoint_graph_jets_mem_K_pt : ∀ m : ℕ,
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ ∧
    iteratedDeriv m G.F ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  action_mixed_ab_mem_K_pt : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  abscissa_mem_F_val : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  chord_len_mem_F_val : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  graph_jets_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ),
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  abscissa_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d
      (centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
        ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  action_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  core_entries_subset :

  dualLine_mem_F_val : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,

structure PointTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_n
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_n
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g r l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g r ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p r
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_n ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_n
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  x₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    x₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ x₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  x₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0
  x₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  x₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) ∈ W_n ∧ ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ δ r ∈ W_n
  ℓ₀_pos : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k,
    0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i
  x₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) (x₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m)
          r)
      0 = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelChainLen (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) =
      U_split l (a : ℂ) + V_split l ((a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ))

structure PointContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_lead_r₀_ne_zero : f_lead ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_endpoints : ∀ z : ℂ, g_lead 0 z = 0 ∧ g_lead (Fin.last k) z = 0
  g_lead_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead r) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
        (G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (PointTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a G.F (fun r => g_lead r (a : ℂ)))

def pointChainBox {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) }

abbrev PointJetAll : Type := Sum (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) ℕ

def pointJetEmb (M : ℕ) : PointJetVar M → PointJetAll
  | Sum.inl v => Sum.inl (v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1.1, v.2.2.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β => Sum.inr β.1

noncomputable def pointJetFnAll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ) :
    PointJetAll → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      if v.1 = 0 then
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 v.2.1)
      else
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1 v.2.2.2 (fun q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 v.2.1)
  | Sum.inr β =>
      fun p => iterDeriv1D β C.A p.2

noncomputable def pointBaseField {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Subfield ℂ :=
  Subfield.closure
    (((⊥ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪
      Set.range (fun v : PointJetAll => pointJetFnAll C k v (Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))))

def rotCoordX (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => -P 1

def rotCoordY (rotIdx : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => P 1
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => -P 1
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => -P 0
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => P 0

def unrotPoint (rotIdx : Fin 4) (x Y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => ![x, Y]
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => ![-x, -Y]
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => ![-Y, x]
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => ![Y, -x]

noncomputable def sqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointEdgeSq {k : ℕ} (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  (x_vec i.succ - x_vec i.castSucc) ^ 2 +
    (F_vec i.succ (x_vec i.succ) - F_vec i.castSucc (x_vec i.castSucc)) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointRelEdgeLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  ℓ_base i * sqrt1p ((pointEdgeSq F_vec x_vec i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)

noncomputable def pointRelChainLen {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i

noncomputable def pointRelInteriorGrad {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_vec F'_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let L_L := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_L
  let L_R := pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_vec x_vec i_R
  ((x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ) - F_vec i_L.castSucc (x_vec i_L.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_L.succ (x_vec i_L.succ)) / L_L -
    ((x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc) +
      (F_vec i_R.succ (x_vec i_R.succ) - F_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) *
        F'_vec i_R.castSucc (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) / L_R

noncomputable def pointInteriorHess {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F F' F'' : ℂ → ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let Δx_L := x_vec i_L.succ - x_vec i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := F (x_vec i_L.succ) - F (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc)
    let Δx_R := x_vec i_R.succ - x_vec i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := F (x_vec i_R.succ) - F (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F' (x_vec i_R.succ)
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_L.succ) ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F'' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 -
          n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
      (((1 + F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc) ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F'' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 -
          n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_R.succ) * F' (x_vec i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 +
        n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F' (x_vec i_L.castSucc) * F' (x_vec i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 +
        n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3
    else
      0

noncomputable def pointChartACoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C p.1 p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartBCoord {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2)

noncomputable def pointChartDetAB {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (pointChartACoord C rotIdx) p *
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx) p

noncomputable def pointChartX {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rotCoordX rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2)

noncomputable def pointChartAction {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q

noncomputable def pointChartActionAB {k : ℕ} (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q_ab : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  pointChartAction ℓ_fn (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)

noncomputable def pointChartPsiWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else if r.1 = k - 1 then
    q.1
  else
    q.1 + q.2

noncomputable def pointChartWWeb {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : r.1 < k - 1 then
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1, by omega⟩ q -
    (F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 2, by omega⟩ q) -
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q)) /
      ℓ_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ q
  else
    -1

structure PointGlancingChartData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) where
  rotIdx : Fin 4
  a₀ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  δ_star : ℝ
  C₀ : ℝ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  δ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star
  C₀_pos : 0 < C₀
  C₀_δ_star_lt : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2
  W_F : Set ℂ
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  W_F_open : IsOpen W_F
  W_F_preconn : IsPreconnected W_F
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_F
  F_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R + 2 * δ_star →
    (x : ℂ) ∈ W_F ∧ (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0
  F_curv_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R →
    deriv (deriv F) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ v_x : ℝ, deriv F (x : ℂ) = (v_x : ℂ)
  V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  ℓ_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_W_open : IsOpen V_W
  V_W_nonempty : V_W.Nonempty
  V_W_sub : V_W ⊆ pointChainBox C B k
  Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ
    (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star))
  Ψ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    Ψ q ∈ V_W
  Φ_left_inv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.1 ∧
    pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx (Ψ q) - pointChartACoord C rotIdx (Ψ q) = q.2
  Φ_right_inv : ∀ p ∈ V_W,
    (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) ∧
    Ψ (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
      pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p) = p
  det_ab_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ V_W, pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx p ≠ 0
  x_endpoints : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ 0 q = q.1 ∧
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ (Fin.last k) q = q.1 + q.2
  x_holo_maps : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q ∈ W_F ∧
      rotCoordY rotIdx (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2) =
        F (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q)
  ℓ_holo_sq : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_fn i)
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (ℓ_fn i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r q) i
  symplectic_mixed_deriv : ∀ q_ab : ℂ × ℂ,
    (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) ∈
      Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) →
    iterDerivYT 1 1 (pointChartActionAB ℓ_fn) q_ab =
      C.A (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)).2 /
        pointChartDetAB C k rotIdx (Ψ (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
  stationary_on_nondeg :
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      (∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0) →
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ_fn i q) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F)
          (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s q) r = 0
  x_at_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a : ℝ, |a - a₀| < R →
    pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) ∧
    deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), z)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  ψ_web_base : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
    (pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
    |(pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
    1 / 2 ≤
      (deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)).re
  trapezoid_nondeg : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀,
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).1.im = 0 ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.im = 0 ∧
    0 < (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re ∧
    (Ψ ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).2.re < B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      0 < (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re ∧
      (ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      pointChartWWeb C k rotIdx F Ψ ℓ_fn r ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ≠ 0) ∧
    Function.Injective (fun r : Fin (k + 1) =>
      deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r ((q.1 : ℂ), z)) (q.2 : ℂ) /
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => pointChartPsiWeb C k rotIdx Ψ r (z, (q.2 : ℂ))) (q.1 : ℂ)) ∧
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => ℓ_fn i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))) F (deriv F)
      (deriv (deriv F))
      (fun s => pointChartX C k rotIdx Ψ s ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0

structure PointCoreEliminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  N_core : ℕ
  coreTuple : Fin N_core → ℂ
  endpoint_graph_jets_mem_K_pt : ∀ m : ℕ,
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ ∧
    iteratedDeriv m G.F ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  action_mixed_ab_mem_K_pt : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  abscissa_mem_F_val : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  chord_len_mem_F_val : ∀ i : Fin k,
    G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  graph_jets_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ),
    iteratedDeriv m G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  abscissa_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d
      (centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1))
        ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  action_ab_taylor_mem_F_val : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  core_entries_subset :
    Set.range coreTuple ⊆
      { z : ℂ |
        (∃ r : Fin (k + 1), z = G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∨
        (∃ i : Fin k, z = G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∨
        (∃ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ),
          z = iteratedDeriv m G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))) }
  dualLine_mem_F_val : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    glancingDualLine C
      ((G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).1 + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2)
      (G.Ψ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))).2 ι ∈
      Subfield.closure
        (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)

noncomputable abbrev PointCoreEliminationData.K_pt {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ}

noncomputable abbrev PointCoreEliminationData.F_val {Ω : Set Plane}
    {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω} {B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C} {k : ℕ}

  Subfield.closure
    (((pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range E.coreTuple)

structure PointTruncatedCoalescingModel (k p J : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) where
  W_n : Set ℂ
  W_n_open : IsOpen W_n
  a_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W_n
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_n
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_n
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W_n, g r l z = 0
  g_at_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (hpJ : p < J + 1), g r ⟨p, hpJ⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p r
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_n ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_n
  δ₀ : ℝ
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  β_zero : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), β 0 δ r = 0
  x₀_endpoints : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    x₀ δ 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧ x₀ δ (Fin.last k) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (δ : ℝ),
    β l δ 0 = 0 ∧ β l δ (Fin.last k) = 0
  x₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0
  x₀_tendsto : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
      (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))
  x₀_maps_W_n : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀,
    (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) ∈ W_n ∧ ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ δ r ∈ W_n
  ℓ₀_pos : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k,
    0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i
  x₀_stat : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ) (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) (x₀ δ) r = 0
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m)
          r)
      0 = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε : ℂ =>
        pointRelChainLen (ℓ₀ δ)
          (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
          (fun m => x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q δ m))
      0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) =
      U_split l (a : ℂ) + V_split l ((a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ))

structure PointContinuedDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  f_lead : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_lead_r₀_ne_zero : f_lead ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ ≠ 0
  W_lead : Set ℂ
  W_lead_open : IsOpen W_lead
  W_lead_preconn : IsPreconnected W_lead
  real_mem_W_lead : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_lead
  g_lead : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  g_lead_endpoints : ∀ z : ℂ, g_lead 0 z = 0 ∧ g_lead (Fin.last k) z = 0
  g_lead_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_lead r) W_lead
  g_lead_taylor : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_lead ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n (g_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
        (G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) / (n.factorial : ℂ) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n (f_lead ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
  trunc_models : ∀ J : ℕ, p ≤ J → ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
    Nonempty (PointTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a G.F (fun r => g_lead r (a : ℂ)))

(k p : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (a v_a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hv_a : deriv F (a : ℂ) = (v_a : ℂ))
    (hr_ne : deriv (deriv F) (a : ℂ) ≠ 0)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)

    ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_p r = 0

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S)
    (M : SecondScaleFirstFieldData S)
    (R ε' : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hε' : 0 < ε') :
    let r := 1 / (M.lam + ε')
    let m₀ := 2 / Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2) + R + 4
    ∃ t₀ c_ε D₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ 0 < c_ε ∧ 10 ≤ D₀ ∧
      ∀ D_min H_req : ℝ, 0 < D_min → D_min ≤ 1 → 0 < H_req →
        ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
          ∃ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            IsOpen U ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ U ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U, (Φ p).im < 0) ∧
            ({ p : ℂ × ℂ |
                p.1.im = 0 ∧ |p.1.re| ≤ t₀ ∧
                D_min + c_ε ^ (-r) * |p.1.re| ^ r < -p.2.im ∧
                -p.2.im < H_req } ⊆ U) ∧
            ({ p : ℂ × ℂ |
                ‖p.1‖ < 2 * t₀ ∧
                D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < H_req ∧
                |p.2.re| < m₀ * (-p.2.im) } ⊆ U) ∧
            (∀ Y : ℂ, 0 < -Y.im → -Y.im < H_req →
              Φ (0, Y) = Y ∧
              deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y)) 0 = 0 ∧
              deriv (deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y))) 0 =
                2 * ((Real.exp (-M.K_seq n) / (rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                  S.V ((M.ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                    (Real.exp (-M.K_seq n) : ℂ) * Y))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro r m₀
  have hlam_ge1 : 1 ≤ M.lam := M.one_le_lam
  have hden_gt1 : 1 < M.lam + ε' := by linarith
  have hden_pos : 0 < M.lam + ε' := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hr1 : r < 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [div_lt_one hden_pos]
    exact hden_gt1
  have hinv_r : 1 / r = M.lam + ε' := by
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hden_pos]
  have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2) :=
    Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos], by nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩
  have hm₀_pos : 0 < m₀ := by
    dsimp [m₀]
    have : 0 < 2 / Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2) := by positivity
    linarith
  let c₁ : ℝ := (1 / 2 + (1 - M.β)) / 2
  let α₁ : ℝ := (1 / 2 + c₁) / 2
  have hc₁_gt_half : 1 / 2 < c₁ := by dsimp [c₁]; linarith [M.β_lt_half]
  have hc₁_lt_sub : c₁ < 1 - M.β := by dsimp [c₁]; linarith [M.β_lt_half]
  have hc₁_lt1 : c₁ < 1 := by linarith [M.β_pos]
  have hα₁_gt_half : 1 / 2 < α₁ := by dsimp [α₁]; linarith
  have hα₁_lt_c₁ : α₁ < c₁ := by dsimp [α₁]; linarith
  have hα₁_lt1 : α₁ < 1 := by linarith
  have hinv_r_gt_c₁ : c₁ < 1 / r := by linarith
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  have hk₀_ge1 : 1 ≤ k₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hexp_k₀_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have hlog : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right _ _
    have h1 : -k₀ ≤ Real.log (S.H / 20) := by linarith
    calc Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h1
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  let δ_b1 : ℝ := Real.exp (-k₀) / 2
  have hδ_b1_pos : 0 < δ_b1 := by dsimp [δ_b1]; positivity
  have hδ_b1_lt : δ_b1 < S.H / 2 := by dsimp [δ_b1]; linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S := liouville_disk_and_interior_transfer S
  have hRealWall : BootRealWallTransferProp S :=
    (cone_real_wall_transfer_and_strip_bound S hCrit).1
  obtain ⟨L₁, δ_star1, hL₁_pos, hδ_star1_pos, hδ_star1_lt, hTransK⟩ :=
    hRealWall α₁ δ_b1 hα₁_gt_half hα₁_lt1 hδ_b1_pos hδ_b1_lt
  obtain ⟨ε₀_1, d₀_1, hε₀_1_pos, hd₀_1_pos, hTrans⟩ := hTransK 1 zero_lt_one
  let A : ℝ := max 1 L₁
  have hA_ge1 : 1 ≤ A := le_max_left 1 L₁
  have hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A := by linarith
  have hL₁_le_A : L₁ ≤ A := le_max_right 1 L₁
  obtain ⟨C_t2, hC_t2_pos, hTileRows⟩ := hInt.tile_L2_from_rows A hA_ge1
  obtain ⟨B_slope, hB_slope⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (M.L_lim_slope_top.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds M.lam hε'))
  let U₀ : ℝ := max 1 B_slope
  have hU₀_ge1 : 1 ≤ U₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hIcc_U₀ : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) U₀).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨u_max, _, hu_max⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_U₀ M.L_lim_cont.continuousOn
  let C_L : ℝ := max 0 (M.L_lim u_max)
  have hC_L_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_L := le_max_left _ _
  have hL_lim_le : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → M.L_lim u ≤ C_L + u / r := by
    intro u hu
    by_cases huU : u ≤ U₀
    · have h1 : M.L_lim u ≤ M.L_lim u_max := isMaxOn_iff.mp hu_max u ⟨hu, huU⟩
      have h2 : M.L_lim u_max ≤ C_L := le_max_right _ _
      have h3 : 0 ≤ u / r := div_nonneg hu (le_of_lt hr0)
      linarith
    · have huU' : U₀ < u := lt_of_not_ge huU
      have hu_pos : 0 < u := by linarith
      have hu_B : B_slope ≤ u := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_of_lt huU')
      have hdist : |M.L_lim u / u - M.lam| < ε' := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hB_slope u hu_B
      have hlt : M.L_lim u / u < 1 / r := by
        rw [hinv_r]
        linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdist).2]
      have hmul : M.L_lim u < (1 / r) * u := (div_lt_iff₀ hu_pos).mp hlt
      have heq : (1 / r) * u = u / r := by ring
      linarith
  let C_glob : ℝ :=
    max M.C_env2 ((Real.exp C_L + 1) * Real.exp ((1 / r - c₁) * (Real.log 20 + A + 1)))
  have hC_glob_pos : 0 < C_glob := lt_of_lt_of_le M.C_env2_pos (le_max_left _ _)
  let q₁ : ℝ := Real.exp (-2 * (1 - α₁))
  let q₂ : ℝ := Real.exp (-2 * (c₁ - α₁))
  have hq₁_pos : 0 < q₁ := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq₁_lt1 : q₁ < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  have hq₂_pos : 0 < q₂ := Real.exp_pos _
  have hq₂_lt1 : q₂ < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  let C_win : ℝ := 2 * (A + 1) * C_glob ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * (1 - c₁) * (A + 1))
  have hC_win_pos : 0 < C_win := by dsimp [C_win]; positivity
  let C_sum_sq : ℝ := C_t2 * (1 / (1 - q₁) + C_win / (1 - q₂))
  have h1mq₁_pos : 0 < 1 - q₁ := by linarith
  have h1mq₂_pos : 0 < 1 - q₂ := by linarith
  have hC_sum_sq_pos : 0 < C_sum_sq := by dsimp [C_sum_sq]; positivity
  let C_cone : ℝ := Real.exp (α₁ + (1 - α₁) * Real.log 20) * Real.sqrt C_sum_sq
  have hC_cone_pos : 0 < C_cone := by dsimp [C_cone]; positivity
  let c_ε : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (ε₀_1 / (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ α₁ * C_cone))
  have hc_ε : 0 < c_ε := by dsimp [c_ε]; positivity
  let t₀ : ℝ := c_ε / 2
  have ht₀ : 0 < t₀ := half_pos hc_ε
  have hMα_lt1 : M.α < 1 := by linarith [M.α_lt_one_sub_β, M.β_pos]
  obtain ⟨L_cp, δ_star2, hL_cp_pos, hδ_star2_pos, hδ_star2_lt, hCP_K⟩ :=
    hCrit.cone_passage M.α m₀ M.δ_b M.half_lt_α hMα_lt1 hm₀_pos M.δ_b_pos M.δ_b_lt
  obtain ⟨C_2, ε₀_2, d₀_2, hC_2_pos, hε₀_2_pos, hd₀_2_pos, hCP⟩ := hCP_K 1 zero_lt_one
  obtain ⟨C_Lcp, hC_Lcp_pos, N_cb, hN_cb⟩ := M.cone_bound L_cp hL_cp_pos
  let D₀ : ℝ := max 10 ((2 * t₀ * C_Lcp / ε₀_2 + 1) ^ 2)
  have hD₀ : 10 ≤ D₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hD₀_pos : 0 < D₀ := by linarith
  have hD₀_ge1 : 1 ≤ D₀ := by linarith
  let ε_cp : ℝ := 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp * D₀ ^ (-M.α)
  have hε_cp_pos : 0 < ε_cp := by dsimp [ε_cp]; positivity
  have hε_cp_le : ε_cp ≤ ε₀_2 := by
    let B_cp : ℝ := 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp / ε₀_2 + 1
    have hB_cp_pos : 0 < B_cp := by dsimp [B_cp]; positivity
    have hB_sq : B_cp ^ 2 ≤ D₀ := le_max_right _ _
    have hB_le_half : B_cp ≤ D₀ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      calc B_cp = Real.sqrt (B_cp ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (le_of_lt hB_cp_pos)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt D₀ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hB_sq
        _ = D₀ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_eq_rpow D₀
    have hhalf_le_α : D₀ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ D₀ ^ M.α :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hD₀_ge1 (le_of_lt M.half_lt_α)
    have hdiv_lt : 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp / ε₀_2 < D₀ ^ M.α := by
      have : 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp / ε₀_2 < B_cp := by dsimp [B_cp]; linarith
      linarith
    have hmul_lt : 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp < ε₀_2 * D₀ ^ M.α := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε₀_2_pos).mp hdiv_lt
      linarith [mul_comm (D₀ ^ M.α) ε₀_2]
    have hcancel : D₀ ^ M.α * D₀ ^ (-M.α) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hD₀_pos, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hmul_lt)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ D₀ ^ (-M.α))
    dsimp [ε_cp]
    linarith [show ε₀_2 * D₀ ^ M.α * D₀ ^ (-M.α) = ε₀_2 by rw [mul_assoc, hcancel, mul_one]]
  refine ⟨t₀, c_ε, D₀, ht₀, hc_ε, hD₀, ?_⟩
  intro D_min H_req hD_min_pos hD_min_le1 hH_req_pos
  have h20_Dmin_gt1 : 1 < 20 / D_min := by
    rw [one_lt_div hD_min_pos]
    linarith
  have hlog20_Dmin_pos : 0 < Real.log (20 / D_min) := Real.log_pos h20_Dmin_gt1
  let U_max : ℝ := Real.log (20 / D_min) + A + 1
  have hU_max_pos : 0 < U_max := by dsimp [U_max]; linarith
  have hUnif_mom : TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n v => Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n + v) / rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n)))
      (fun v => Real.exp (M.L_lim v)) Filter.atTop (Set.Icc 0 U_max) :=
    tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact.mp M.moment_law_conv
      (Set.Icc 0 U_max) isCompact_Icc
  obtain ⟨N_cone, hN_cone⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hUnif_mom 1 zero_lt_one)
  let d_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-M.K_seq n)
  let B_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n)
  have hd_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto d_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp M.K_seq_tendsto)
  let δ_d : ℝ :=
    min (min d₀_1 (δ_star1 / 4))
      (min (d₀_2 / D₀)
        (min (min δ_star2 (S.H / 2) / max H_req (D₀ + 1)) (S.r_star / c_ε)))
  have hδ_d_pos : 0 < δ_d :=
    lt_min (lt_min hd₀_1_pos (div_pos hδ_star1_pos (by norm_num)))
      (lt_min (div_pos hd₀_2_pos hD₀_pos)
        (lt_min
          (div_pos (lt_min hδ_star2_pos (half_pos S.H_pos))
            (lt_of_lt_of_le hH_req_pos (le_max_left _ _)))
          (div_pos S.r_star_pos hc_ε)))
  obtain ⟨N_d, hN_d⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (hd_tendsto.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hδ_d_pos))
  obtain ⟨N_B, hN_B⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop.mp M.B_seq_tendsto (2 * t₀ / D₀))
  let N₀ : ℕ := max (max N_cone N_cb) (max N_d N_B)
  refine ⟨N₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hn_cone : N_cone ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
  have hn_cb : N_cb ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
  have hn_d : N_d ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
  have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
  let K_n : ℝ := M.K_seq n
  let d_n : ℝ := d_seq n
  let B_n : ℝ := B_seq n
  let ξ_n : ℝ := M.ξ_seq n
  have hK_n_ge : k₀ ≤ K_n := (M.K_seq_ge n).1
  have hB_n_ge1 : 1 ≤ B_n := (M.K_seq_ge n).2
  have hB_n_pos : 0 < B_n := by linarith
  have hd_n_pos : 0 < d_n := Real.exp_pos _
  have hd_n_lt_δ : d_n < δ_d := by
    have hdist : |d_n - 0| < δ_d := by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN_d n hn_d
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdist).2]
  have hd_n_lt1 : d_n < min d₀_1 (δ_star1 / 4) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_lt_δ (min_le_left _ _)
  have hd_n_r2 : d_n < min (d₀_2 / D₀)
      (min (min δ_star2 (S.H / 2) / max H_req (D₀ + 1)) (S.r_star / c_ε)) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_lt_δ (min_le_right _ _)
  have hD₀_dn_lt : D₀ * d_n < d₀_2 := by
    have h1 : d_n < d₀_2 / D₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_r2 (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hD₀_pos).mp h1
    linarith
  have hd_n_r3 : d_n < min (min δ_star2 (S.H / 2) / max H_req (D₀ + 1)) (S.r_star / c_ε) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_r2 (min_le_right _ _)
  have hmax_dn_lt : max H_req (D₀ + 1) * d_n < min δ_star2 (S.H / 2) := by
    have hmax_pos : 0 < max H_req (D₀ + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hH_req_pos (le_max_left _ _)
    have h1 : d_n < min δ_star2 (S.H / 2) / max H_req (D₀ + 1) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_r3 (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hmax_pos).mp h1
    linarith
  have hcε_dn_lt : c_ε * d_n < S.r_star := by
    have h1 : d_n < S.r_star / c_ε := lt_of_lt_of_le hd_n_r3 (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 := (lt_div_iff₀ hc_ε).mp h1
    linarith
  have hB_n_ge_t₀ : 2 * t₀ / D₀ ≤ B_n := hN_B n hn_B
  have hSample : ∀ D' : ℝ, D_min ≤ D' → D' ≤ 1 →
      ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ s : ℂ,
        (1 / 20 : ℝ) * d_n * D' ≤ wallDepth S s →
        wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b1 →
        |s.re - x₀| ≤ L₁ * wallDepth S s →
        (d_n / B_n) * shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / (d_n * D')) ^ α₁ ≤
          C_cone * D' ^ (-1 / r) := by
    intro D' hD'_ge hD'_le1
    have hD'_pos : 0 < D' := lt_of_lt_of_le hD_min_pos hD'_ge
    let s_D : ℝ := -Real.log D'
    have hs_D_nonneg : 0 ≤ s_D := by
      have : Real.log D' ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos (le_of_lt hD'_pos) hD'_le1
      dsimp [s_D]; linarith
    have hexp_neg_sD : Real.exp (-s_D) = D' := by
      dsimp [s_D]; rw [neg_neg, Real.exp_log hD'_pos]
    have hexp_sD : Real.exp s_D = D'⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [s_D]; rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hD'_pos]
    have hD'_rpow1 : D' ^ (-1 / r) = Real.exp (s_D / r) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hD'_pos]
      congr 1; dsimp [s_D]; ring
    have hlog20_pos : 0 < Real.log 20 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have hRowBound : ∀ l : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l → l - K_n ≤ Real.log 20 + s_D + A + 1 →
        rowMomentFull S l / (B_n * D') ≤
          C_glob * Real.exp (s_D / r + (c₁ - 1) * ((l - K_n) - s_D)) := by
      intro l hl hu_top
      let u : ℝ := l - K_n
      have hl_eq : K_n + u = l := by dsimp [u]; ring
      have hdiv_eq : rowMomentFull S l / (B_n * D') =
          (rowMomentFull S l / B_n) * Real.exp s_D := by
        rw [hexp_sD, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [hdiv_eq]
      by_cases hu0 : u ≤ 0
      · have hglob := M.global_envelope n l hl
        have hmax1 : max (K_n - l) 0 = -u := by
          have h1 : 0 ≤ K_n - l := by linarith [show l - K_n ≤ 0 from hu0]
          rw [max_eq_left h1]

    have hlhs_eq : 2 * t₀ * ((d_n / B_n) * shapeModulus S s) = r_cp * shapeModulus S s := by
      dsimp [r_cp]; ring
    have hrhs_eq : 2 * t₀ * (C_Lcp * (d_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α) =
        ε_cp * (d_cp / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α := by
      have hd_eq : d_cp / wallDepth S s = D₀ * (d_n / wallDepth S s) := by
        dsimp [d_cp]; ring
      have hcancel_D : D₀ ^ (-M.α) * D₀ ^ M.α = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hD₀_pos, neg_add_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
      rw [hd_eq, Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt hD₀_pos) (by positivity)]
      dsimp [ε_cp]
      calc 2 * t₀ * (C_Lcp * (d_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α)
          = 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp * (D₀ ^ (-M.α) * D₀ ^ M.α) * (d_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α := by
              rw [hcancel_D, mul_one]; ring
        _ = 2 * t₀ * C_Lcp * D₀ ^ (-M.α) * (D₀ ^ M.α * (d_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α) := by ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨s_tilde, hs_tilde_holo, hs_tilde_props⟩ :=
    hCP d_cp ξ_n r_cp ε_cp hd_cp_pos hD₀_dn_lt hr_cp_pos hr_cp_le hε_cp_pos hε_cp_le hcone_cp
  let c_base : ℂ := (ξ_n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let κ_n : ℂ := ((d_n / B_n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (c_base + (d_n : ℂ) * p.2, p.1 * κ_n)
  have hΨ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Ψ :=
    ((differentiable_const c_base).add (differentiable_snd.const_mul (d_n : ℂ))).prodMk
      (differentiable_fst.mul_const κ_n)
  let O1 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Ψ ⁻¹' (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X)
  let O2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      ‖p.1‖ < 2 * t₀ ∧
      D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < δ_star2 / d_n ∧
      |p.2.re| < m₀ * (-p.2.im) }
  let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := O1 ∪ O2
  have hO1_open : IsOpen O1 := S.tube_open.preimage hΨ_diff.continuous
  have hO2_open : IsOpen O2 := by
    have h1 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < 2 * t₀ } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_fst) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.2.im } :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd).neg
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | -p.2.im < δ_star2 / d_n } :=
      isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd).neg continuous_const
    have h4 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.2.re| < m₀ * (-p.2.im) } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_snd))
        (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd).neg)
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := hO1_open.union hO2_open
  let O_cone : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ |
      d_cp < S.H - q.1.im ∧ S.H - q.1.im < δ_star2 ∧
      |q.1.re - ξ_n| < m₀ * (S.H - q.1.im) ∧
      ‖q.2‖ < r_cp * ((S.H - q.1.im) / d_cp) ^ M.α }
  have hΨ_O2 : ∀ p ∈ O2, Ψ p ∈ O_cone := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hp_T, hp_D₀, hp_top, hp_re⟩ := hp
    have him : (Ψ p).1.im = S.H + d_n * p.2.im := by simp [Ψ, c_base]
    have hre : (Ψ p).1.re = ξ_n + d_n * p.2.re := by simp [Ψ, c_base]
    have hdepth : S.H - (Ψ p).1.im = d_n * (-p.2.im) := by linarith
    have hc1 : d_cp < S.H - (Ψ p).1.im := by
      rw [hdepth]
      calc d_cp = d_n * D₀ := mul_comm D₀ d_n
        _ < d_n * (-p.2.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp_D₀ hd_n_pos
    have hc2 : S.H - (Ψ p).1.im < δ_star2 := by
      rw [hdepth]
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ hd_n_pos).mp hp_top
      linarith
    have hc3 : |(Ψ p).1.re - ξ_n| < m₀ * (S.H - (Ψ p).1.im) := by
      have hsub : (Ψ p).1.re - ξ_n = d_n * p.2.re := by linarith
      rw [hsub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd_n_pos, hdepth]
      calc d_n * |p.2.re| < d_n * (m₀ * (-p.2.im)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp_re hd_n_pos
        _ = m₀ * (d_n * (-p.2.im)) := by ring
    have hc4 : ‖(Ψ p).2‖ < r_cp * ((S.H - (Ψ p).1.im) / d_cp) ^ M.α := by
      have hnorm_κ : ‖κ_n‖ = d_n / B_n := by
        dsimp [κ_n]
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hd_n_pos hB_n_pos)]
      have hnorm2 : ‖(Ψ p).2‖ = ‖p.1‖ * (d_n / B_n) := by
        dsimp [Ψ]; rw [norm_mul, hnorm_κ]
      have hlt_rcp : ‖(Ψ p).2‖ < r_cp := by
        rw [hnorm2]; dsimp [r_cp]
        have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hp_T (div_pos hd_n_pos hB_n_pos)
        linarith [show 2 * t₀ * (d_n / B_n) = 2 * t₀ * d_n / B_n by ring]
      have hone_le : 1 ≤ ((S.H - (Ψ p).1.im) / d_cp) ^ M.α :=
        Real.one_le_rpow ((one_le_div hd_cp_pos).mpr (le_of_lt hc1))
          (le_of_lt (by linarith [M.half_lt_α]))
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt_rcp (le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt hr_cp_pos) hone_le)
    exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩
  let Φ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (S.𝔰 (Ψ p) - c_base) / (d_n : ℂ)
  let Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (s_tilde (Ψ p) - c_base) / (d_n : ℂ)
  let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    @ite _ (p ∈ O2) (Classical.propDecidable _) (Φ₂ p) (Φ₁ p)
  have hΦ_eq_O2 : ∀ p ∈ O2, Φ p = Φ₂ p := fun p hp => if_pos hp
  have hΦ_eq_O1 : ∀ p ∈ O1, Φ p = Φ₁ p := by
    intro p hp1
    by_cases hp2 : p ∈ O2
    · obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hΨ_O2 p hp2
      have h_agree := (hs_tilde_props (Ψ p) hc1 hc2 hc3 hc4).2.2.2.2 hp1
      dsimp [Φ, Φ₁, Φ₂]
      rw [if_pos hp2, h_agree]
    · exact if_neg hp2
  have hΦ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₁ O1 := by
    have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => S.𝔰 (Ψ p)) O1 :=
      S.𝔰_holo.comp hΨ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
    simpa [Φ₁, div_eq_mul_inv] using (hcomp.sub_const c_base).mul_const ((d_n : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hΦ₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₂ O2 := by
    have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => s_tilde (Ψ p)) O2 :=
      hs_tilde_holo.comp hΨ_diff.differentiableOn hΨ_O2
    simpa [Φ₂, div_eq_mul_inv] using (hcomp.sub_const c_base).mul_const ((d_n : ℂ)⁻¹)
  have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ U := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with hp1 | hp2
    · have hAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ₁ p :=
        hΦ₁_holo.differentiableAt (hO1_open.mem_nhds hp1)
      have hev : Φ =ᶠ[nhds p] Φ₁ :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO1_open.mem_nhds hp1) hΦ_eq_O1
      exact (hAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableWithinAt
    · have hAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ₂ p :=
        hΦ₂_holo.differentiableAt (hO2_open.mem_nhds hp2)
      have hev : Φ =ᶠ[nhds p] Φ₂ :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO2_open.mem_nhds hp2) hΦ_eq_O2
      exact (hAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableWithinAt
  have him_neg_of_strip : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      ((w - c_base) / (d_n : ℂ)).im < 0 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_lt : w.im < S.H := (abs_lt.mp hw).2
    rw [Complex.div_ofReal_im]
    have him_sub : (w - c_base).im = w.im - S.H := by simp [c_base]
    rw [him_sub]
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hd_n_pos
  have hΦ_im : ∀ p ∈ U, (Φ p).im < 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with hp1 | hp2
    · rw [hΦ_eq_O1 p hp1]
      exact him_neg_of_strip (S.𝔰 (Ψ p)) (S.𝔰_maps_to (Ψ p) hp1)
    · rw [hΦ_eq_O2 p hp2]
      obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hΨ_O2 p hp2
      exact him_neg_of_strip (s_tilde (Ψ p)) (hs_tilde_props (Ψ p) hc1 hc2 hc3 hc4).1
  have hHreq_dn_lt_δ2 : H_req * d_n < δ_star2 := by
    have h1 : H_req * d_n ≤ max H_req (D₀ + 1) * d_n :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (le_of_lt hd_n_pos)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hmax_dn_lt (min_le_left _ _))
  have hHreq_dn_lt_H2 : H_req * d_n < S.H / 2 := by
    have h1 : H_req * d_n ≤ max H_req (D₀ + 1) * d_n :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (le_of_lt hd_n_pos)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hmax_dn_lt (min_le_right _ _))
  have hU_cusp : { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      p.1.im = 0 ∧ |p.1.re| ≤ t₀ ∧
      D_min + c_ε ^ (-r) * |p.1.re| ^ r < -p.2.im ∧
      -p.2.im < H_req } ⊆ U := by
    intro p ⟨hp_im0, hp_re_le, hp_cusp, hp_Hreq⟩
    apply Or.inl
    let σ : ℝ := p.1.re
    have hp1_eq : p.1 = (σ : ℂ) := by
      have h := Complex.re_add_im p.1
      rw [hp_im0] at h
      simpa [σ] using h.symm
    let t_star : ℝ := σ * d_n / B_n
    have hΨ2_eq : (Ψ p).2 = (t_star : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [Ψ, κ_n, t_star]
      rw [hp1_eq]
      push_cast; ring
    have hnorm_Ψ2 : ‖(Ψ p).2‖ < S.r_star := by
      rw [hΨ2_eq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have ht_abs : |t_star| = |σ| * (d_n / B_n) := by
        dsimp [t_star]
        rw [mul_div_assoc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (div_pos hd_n_pos hB_n_pos)]
      rw [ht_abs]
      have hdn_Bn_le : d_n / B_n ≤ d_n := div_le_self (le_of_lt hd_n_pos) hB_n_ge1
      have h1 : |σ| * (d_n / B_n) ≤ t₀ * d_n :=
        mul_le_mul hp_re_le hdn_Bn_le (by positivity) (le_of_lt ht₀)
      have hcε_dn_pos : 0 < c_ε * d_n := mul_pos hc_ε hd_n_pos
      dsimp [t₀] at h1
      linarith [hcε_dn_lt, hcε_dn_pos, show c_ε / 2 * d_n = (c_ε * d_n) / 2 by ring]
    have him_Ψ1 : (Ψ p).1.im = S.H + d_n * p.2.im := by simp [Ψ, c_base]
    have hlow_im : -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p).2) < (Ψ p).1.im := by
      have hball : starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj]
        exact hnorm_Ψ2
      have hs_le : S.s_star ≤ S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ (Ψ p).2) := (S.h_X_bounds _ hball).1
      have hdn_w : d_n * (-p.2.im) < S.H / 2 :=
        calc d_n * (-p.2.im) < d_n * H_req := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp_Hreq hd_n_pos
          _ = H_req * d_n := mul_comm _ _
          _ < S.H / 2 := hHreq_dn_lt_H2
      linarith [S.s_star_pos, S.H_pos, him_Ψ1]
    have hhigh_im : (Ψ p).1.im < S.h_X (Ψ p).2 := by
      have hdef := hDeficit σ hp_re_le
      have hstrict : d_n * (D_min + c_ε ^ (-r) * |σ| ^ r) < d_n * (-p.2.im) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp_cusp hd_n_pos
      rw [hΨ2_eq]
      dsimp [t_star] at hdef ⊢
      linarith [him_Ψ1]
    exact ⟨hnorm_Ψ2, hlow_im, hhigh_im⟩
  have hU_cone : { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      ‖p.1‖ < 2 * t₀ ∧
      D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < H_req ∧
      |p.2.re| < m₀ * (-p.2.im) } ⊆ U := by
    intro p ⟨hp_T, hp_D₀, hp_Hreq, hp_re⟩
    apply Or.inr
    have hlt_div : H_req < δ_star2 / d_n := (lt_div_iff₀ hd_n_pos).mpr hHreq_dn_lt_δ2
    exact ⟨hp_T, hp_D₀, lt_trans hp_Hreq hlt_div, hp_re⟩
  refine ⟨U, Φ, hU_open, hΦ_holo, hΦ_im, hU_cusp, hU_cone, ?_⟩
  intro Y hY_pos hY_lt
  let y₀ : ℂ := c_base + (d_n : ℂ) * Y
  have hy₀_im : y₀.im = S.H + d_n * Y.im := by simp [y₀, c_base]
  have hy₀_strip : y₀ ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    have h1 : 0 < d_n * (-Y.im) := mul_pos hd_n_pos hY_pos
    have h2 : d_n * (-Y.im) < S.H / 2 :=
      calc d_n * (-Y.im) < d_n * H_req := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hY_lt hd_n_pos
        _ = H_req * d_n := mul_comm _ _
        _ < S.H / 2 := hHreq_dn_lt_H2
    change |y₀.im| < S.H
    rw [hy₀_im, abs_lt]
    exact ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith⟩
  let V₀ : Set ℂ := { t : ℂ | (y₀, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X }
  have hV₀_open : IsOpen V₀ :=
    S.tube_open.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have h0_V₀ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ V₀ := by
    change ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star ∧ -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ 0) < y₀.im ∧ y₀.im < S.h_X 0
    rw [norm_zero, map_zero, S.h_X_zero]
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := abs_lt.mp (show |y₀.im| < S.H from hy₀_strip)
    exact ⟨S.r_star_pos, hl, hu⟩
  let g_Y : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => S.𝔰 (y₀, t)
  have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_Y V₀ :=
    S.𝔰_holo.comp ((differentiable_const y₀).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
      (fun _ ht => ht)
  have hg'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g_Y) V₀ := hg_holo.deriv hV₀_open
  let W_Y : Set ℂ := { T : ℂ | T * κ_n ∈ V₀ }
  have hW_open : IsOpen W_Y := hV₀_open.preimage (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)
  have h0_W : (0 : ℂ) ∈ W_Y := by
    change (0 : ℂ) * κ_n ∈ V₀
    rw [zero_mul]; exact h0_V₀
  let φ_Y : ℂ → ℂ := fun T => (g_Y (T * κ_n) - c_base) / (d_n : ℂ)
  have hΦ_eq_φ : ∀ T ∈ W_Y, Φ (T, Y) = φ_Y T := fun T hT => hΦ_eq_O1 (T, Y) hT
  have hd_n_ne : (d_n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hd_n_pos)
  have hB_n_ne : (B_n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hB_n_pos)
  have hjet0 : Φ (0, Y) = Y := by
    rw [hΦ_eq_φ 0 h0_W]
    dsimp [φ_Y, g_Y]
    rw [zero_mul, S.𝔰_zero y₀ hy₀_strip]
    dsimp [y₀]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_left₀ Y hd_n_ne]
  have hderiv1_on : ∀ T ∈ W_Y,
      deriv (fun T' : ℂ => Φ (T', Y)) T = (deriv g_Y (T * κ_n) * κ_n) / (d_n : ℂ) := by
    intro T hT
    have hev : (fun T' : ℂ => Φ (T', Y)) =ᶠ[nhds T] φ_Y :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds hT) hΦ_eq_φ
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have hg_at : HasDerivAt g_Y (deriv g_Y (T * κ_n)) (T * κ_n) :=
      (hg_holo.differentiableAt (hV₀_open.mem_nhds hT)).hasDerivAt
    have hlin_at : HasDerivAt (fun T' : ℂ => T' * κ_n) κ_n T := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id T).mul_const κ_n
    have hcomp_at : HasDerivAt (fun T' : ℂ => g_Y (T' * κ_n))
        (deriv g_Y (T * κ_n) * κ_n) T := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := g_Y) T hg_at hlin_at
    have hφ_at : HasDerivAt φ_Y ((deriv g_Y (T * κ_n) * κ_n) / (d_n : ℂ)) T :=
      (hcomp_at.sub_const c_base).div_const (d_n : ℂ)
    exact hφ_at.deriv
  have hjet1 : deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y)) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hderiv1_on 0 h0_W, zero_mul]
    have h0_deriv : deriv g_Y 0 = 0 := S.𝔰_deriv_t_zero y₀ hy₀_strip
    rw [h0_deriv, zero_mul, zero_div]
  have hjet2 : deriv (deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y))) 0 =
      2 * ((d_n / B_n ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.V y₀ := by
    let ψ_Y : ℂ → ℂ := fun T => (deriv g_Y (T * κ_n) * κ_n) / (d_n : ℂ)
    have hev : deriv (fun T' : ℂ => Φ (T', Y)) =ᶠ[nhds 0] ψ_Y :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds h0_W) hderiv1_on
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    have hg'_at : HasDerivAt (deriv g_Y) (deriv (deriv g_Y) ((0 : ℂ) * κ_n)) ((0 : ℂ) * κ_n) :=
      (hg'_holo.differentiableAt (hV₀_open.mem_nhds (by rw [zero_mul]; exact h0_V₀))).hasDerivAt
    have hlin_at : HasDerivAt (fun T' : ℂ => T' * κ_n) κ_n 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).mul_const κ_n
    have hcomp_at : HasDerivAt (fun T' : ℂ => deriv g_Y (T' * κ_n))
        (deriv (deriv g_Y) ((0 : ℂ) * κ_n) * κ_n) 0 := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := deriv g_Y) (0 : ℂ) hg'_at hlin_at
    have hψ_at : HasDerivAt ψ_Y
        (((deriv (deriv g_Y) ((0 : ℂ) * κ_n) * κ_n) * κ_n) / (d_n : ℂ)) 0 :=
      (hcomp_at.mul_const κ_n).div_const (d_n : ℂ)
    rw [hψ_at.deriv, zero_mul]
    have h2_deriv : deriv (deriv g_Y) 0 = 2 * S.V y₀ := S.𝔰_deriv2_t_zero y₀ hy₀_strip
    rw [h2_deriv]
    dsimp [κ_n]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hd_n_ne, hB_n_ne]
  exact ⟨hjet0, hjet1, hjet2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: liouville_disk_and_interior_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :
    BootInteriorTransferProp S

subgoal_signatures.name: cone_real_wall_transfer_and_strip_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S) :
    BootRealWallTransferProp S ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < S.r_star → ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < y.im → y.im < S.h_X (t : ℂ) →
      (S.𝔰 (y, (t : ℂ)) - y).im ≤ S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)

informal_problem.statement:
(R r t₀ c_ε D₀ m₀ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (hc_ε : 0 < c_ε) (hD₀ : 10 ≤ D₀)
    (hm₀ : 2 / Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2) + R + 4 ≤ m₀) :
    ∃ H_req C_cara : ℝ, 2 ≤ H_req ∧ 0 < C_cara ∧

signature.statement:
(R r t₀ c_ε D₀ m₀ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hr0 : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (hc_ε : 0 < c_ε) (hD₀ : 10 ≤ D₀)
    (hm₀ : 2 / Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2) + R + 4 ≤ m₀) :
