proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let upperHalfDiskOpen : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ‖ζ‖ < t₀ ∧ 0 < ζ.im }
  let upperHalfDiskBdry : Set ℂ :=
    { ζ : ℂ | (ζ.im = 0 ∧ |ζ.re| ≤ t₀) ∨ (‖ζ‖ = t₀ ∧ 0 ≤ ζ.im) }
  let upperHalfDiskIntegral : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ := fun f =>
    (∫ σ in (-t₀)..t₀, f (σ : ℂ)) +
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..Real.pi, deriv (circleMap 0 t₀) θ • f (circleMap 0 t₀ θ))
  let cuspShiftUpper : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun C_star η₀ ζ =>
    -Complex.I * (C_star : ℂ) * ((η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ) ^ (r : ℂ)
  have diffOn_union_open : ∀ {f f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {O₁ O₂ : Set ℂ},
      IsOpen O₁ → IsOpen O₂ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ O₁ → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ O₂ →
      (∀ z ∈ O₁, f z = f₁ z) → (∀ z ∈ O₂, f z = f₂ z) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (O₁ ∪ O₂) := by
    intro f f₁ f₂ O₁ O₂ hO₁ hO₂ hf₁ hf₂ heq₁ heq₂ z hz
    rcases hz with hz₁ | hz₂
    · exact (((hf₁.congr heq₁) z hz₁).differentiableAt (hO₁.mem_nhds hz₁)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact (((hf₂.congr heq₂) z hz₂).differentiableAt (hO₂.mem_nhds hz₂)).differentiableWithinAt
  
  have h_s1 : ∃ C_star D_deep H_req c_star : ℝ,
      0 < C_star ∧ 10 ≤ D_deep ∧ 2 ≤ H_req ∧ 0 < c_star ∧ c_star ≤ t₀ / 8 ∧
      (∀ η₀ : ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀) { ζ : ℂ | -η₀ < ζ.im }) ∧
      (∀ (D x₀ : ℝ), 0 < D → D ≤ 1 → |x₀| ≤ R →
        ∀ Y ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x₀ : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) (D / 8),
        ∀ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
          ({ p : ℂ × ℂ |
              p.1.im = 0 ∧ |p.1.re| ≤ t₀ ∧
              D / 4 + c_ε ^ (-r) * |p.1.re| ^ r < -p.2.im ∧
              -p.2.im < H_req } ⊆ U) →
          ({ p : ℂ × ℂ |
              ‖p.1‖ < 2 * t₀ ∧
              D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < H_req ∧
              |p.2.re| < m₀ * (-p.2.im) } ⊆ U) →
          let ρ_star : ℝ := c_star * D ^ (1 / r);
          let η₀ : ℝ := 2 * ρ_star;
          -Y.im < D_deep ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ upperHalfDiskBdry, ∀ T_c ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_star,
            ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-Y.im) D_deep,
              -η₀ < ζ.im ∧ -η₀ < T_c.im ∧
              (ζ, ((Y.re : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
                cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ -
                cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c) ∈ U) ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (t₀ + ρ_star) ∩ { ζ : ℂ | -ρ_star < ζ.im },
            ∀ T_c ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_star,
            ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball ((Y.re : ℂ) - (D_deep : ℂ) * Complex.I) (1 / 4),
              -η₀ < ζ.im ∧ -η₀ < T_c.im ∧
              (ζ, w + cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ -
                cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c) ∈ U)) := by
    let κ_r : ℝ := Real.cos (Real.pi * r / 2)
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ_r := by
      apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
      constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hκ_le1 : κ_r ≤ 1 := Real.cos_le_one _
    have hm₀_gt6 : 6 < m₀ := by
      have h2 : 2 ≤ 2 / κ_r := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hκ_pos]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have ht₀_half_r : 0 < (t₀ / 2) ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) r
    have h2t₀_r : 0 < (2 * t₀) ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) r
    have hcε_r : 0 < c_ε ^ (-r) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc_ε (-r)
    let C_star : ℝ := max (c_ε ^ (-r) / κ_r) ((D₀ + R + 10) / (κ_r * (t₀ / 2) ^ r)) + 1
    have hC_star_gt1 : 1 < C_star := by
      have : 0 < c_ε ^ (-r) / κ_r := by positivity
      have : 0 < max (c_ε ^ (-r) / κ_r) ((D₀ + R + 10) / (κ_r * (t₀ / 2) ^ r)) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_max_left _ _)
      linarith
    have hC_star_pos : 0 < C_star := by linarith
    have hC_cusp : c_ε ^ (-r) ≤ C_star * κ_r := by
      have h1 : c_ε ^ (-r) / κ_r < C_star := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) (by linarith)
      exact le_of_lt ((div_lt_iff₀ hκ_pos).mp h1)
    have hC_arc : D₀ + R + 10 < C_star * κ_r * (t₀ / 2) ^ r := by
      have h1 : (D₀ + R + 10) / (κ_r * (t₀ / 2) ^ r) < C_star :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (by linarith)
      have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hκ_pos ht₀_half_r)).mp h1
      linarith
    let D_deep : ℝ := D₀ + C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r + R + 10
    have hD_deep_gt20 : 20 < D_deep := by
      have : 0 < C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r := mul_pos hC_star_pos h2t₀_r
      linarith
    let H_req : ℝ := D_deep + C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r + 5
    have hH_req_ge2 : 2 ≤ H_req := by
      have : 0 < C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r := mul_pos hC_star_pos h2t₀_r
      linarith
    let c_star : ℝ := min (t₀ / 8) (((8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r)) / 3)
    have hc_star_pos : 0 < c_star := by
      have h8C : 0 < (8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
      exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hc_star_le : c_star ≤ t₀ / 8 := min_le_left _ _
    have hc_star_3 : 3 * c_star ≤ (8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r) := by
      have := min_le_right (t₀ / 8) (((8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r)) / 3)
      linarith
    have hG_props : ∀ (η₀ : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ), -η₀ < ζ.im →
        let z : ℂ := (η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ
        0 < z.re ∧
        ‖cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ‖ = C_star * ‖z‖ ^ r ∧
        C_star * κ_r * ‖z‖ ^ r ≤ -(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im ∧
        0 < -(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im := by
      intro η₀ ζ hζ z
      have hz_re : z.re = η₀ + ζ.im := by simp [z]
      have hz_re_pos : 0 < z.re := by linarith
      have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        rw [h0] at hz_re_pos
        norm_num at hz_re_pos
      have hz_norm_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne
      have hnorm_G : ‖cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ‖ = C_star * ‖z‖ ^ r := by
        dsimp only [cuspShiftUpper]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hC_star_pos), Complex.norm_cpow_of_ne_zero hz_ne]
        simp
      have harg_lt : |z.arg| < Real.pi / 2 :=
        Complex.abs_arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz_re_pos)
      have hcos_ge : κ_r ≤ Real.cos (z.arg * r) := by
        rw [← Real.cos_abs (z.arg * r)]
        apply Real.antitoneOn_cos
        · constructor
          · exact abs_nonneg _
          · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr0]
            nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
        · constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
        · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr0]
          nlinarith
      have him_G : -(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im =
          C_star * (‖z‖ ^ r * Real.cos (z.arg * r)) := by
        dsimp only [cuspShiftUpper]
        have h1 : -((-Complex.I * (C_star : ℂ) * z ^ (r : ℂ)).im) = C_star * (z ^ (r : ℂ)).re := by
          simp
        rw [h1, Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero hz_ne, Complex.exp_re]
        have hre : (Complex.log z * (r : ℂ)).re = Real.log ‖z‖ * r := by
          simp [Complex.log_re]
        have him : (Complex.log z * (r : ℂ)).im = z.arg * r := by
          simp [Complex.log_im]
        rw [hre, him, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz_norm_pos r]
      have hz_r_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ ^ r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hz_norm_pos r
      have hlow : C_star * κ_r * ‖z‖ ^ r ≤ -(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im := by
        rw [him_G]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcos_ge (le_of_lt (mul_pos hC_star_pos hz_r_pos))
        linarith
      exact ⟨hz_re_pos, hnorm_G, hlow, lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hlow⟩
    refine ⟨C_star, D_deep, H_req, c_star, hC_star_pos, by linarith, hH_req_ge2,
      hc_star_pos, hc_star_le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro η₀
      have hinner : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => (η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ)
          { ζ : ℂ | -η₀ < ζ.im } :=
        (differentiableOn_const (η₀ : ℂ)).sub (differentiableOn_id.const_mul Complex.I)
      have hslit : ∀ ζ ∈ { ζ : ℂ | -η₀ < ζ.im },
          (η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
        intro ζ hζ
        exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (hG_props η₀ ζ hζ).1)
      exact (hinner.cpow_const hslit).const_mul (-Complex.I * (C_star : ℂ))
    · intro D x₀ hD0 hD1 hx₀ Y hY U hU_real hU_cone
      dsimp only
      let ρ_star : ℝ := c_star * D ^ (1 / r)
      let η₀ : ℝ := 2 * ρ_star
      have hDr_pos : 0 < D ^ (1 / r) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hD0 _
      have hDr_le1 : D ^ (1 / r) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one (le_of_lt hD0) hD1 (by positivity)
      have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ_star := mul_pos hc_star_pos hDr_pos
      have hρ_le_c : ρ_star ≤ c_star := mul_le_of_le_one_right (le_of_lt hc_star_pos) hDr_le1
      have hρ_le_t8 : ρ_star ≤ t₀ / 8 := le_trans hρ_le_c hc_star_le
      have hη₀_pos : 0 < η₀ := by dsimp [η₀]; linarith
      have hη₀_le_t4 : η₀ ≤ t₀ / 4 := by dsimp [η₀]; linarith
      have hY_dist : ‖Y - ((x₀ : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ D / 8 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hY
      have hY_re_diff : |Y.re - x₀| ≤ D / 8 := by
        have h1 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Y - ((x₀ : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        simpa using le_trans h1 hY_dist
      have hY_im_diff : |Y.im + D| ≤ D / 8 := by
        have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Y - ((x₀ : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        have h2 : (Y - ((x₀ : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = Y.im + D := by simp
        rw [h2] at h1
        exact le_trans h1 hY_dist
      have hY_re_abs : |Y.re| ≤ R + 1 / 8 := by
        have h1 := (abs_le.mp hY_re_diff).1
        have h2 := (abs_le.mp hY_re_diff).2
        have hx1 := (abs_le.mp hx₀).1
        have hx2 := (abs_le.mp hx₀).2
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hY_im_low : 7 * D / 8 ≤ -Y.im := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hY_im_diff).2]
      have hY_im_high : -Y.im ≤ 9 * D / 8 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hY_im_diff).1]
      have hY_lt_deep : -Y.im < D_deep := by linarith
      have hTc_bound : ∀ T_c ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_star,
          -η₀ < T_c.im ∧ ‖cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c‖ ≤ D / 8 := by
        intro T_c hTc
        have hTc_norm : ‖T_c‖ ≤ ρ_star := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hTc
        have hTc_im_abs : |T_c.im| ≤ ρ_star := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm T_c) hTc_norm
        have hTc_im_gt : -η₀ < T_c.im := by
          have := (abs_le.mp hTc_im_abs).1
          dsimp [η₀]
          linarith
        obtain ⟨_, hnormG, _, _⟩ := hG_props η₀ T_c hTc_im_gt
        have hz_le : ‖(η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * T_c‖ ≤ 3 * ρ_star := by
          have h1 : ‖(η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * T_c‖ ≤ ‖(η₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖Complex.I * T_c‖ :=
            norm_sub_le _ _
          have h2 : ‖(η₀ : ℂ)‖ = η₀ := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hη₀_pos)]
          have h3 : ‖Complex.I * T_c‖ = ‖T_c‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
          dsimp [η₀] at h1 h2 ⊢
          linarith
        have h3ρ_le : 3 * ρ_star ≤ (8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r) * D ^ (1 / r) := by
          dsimp [ρ_star]
          have : 3 * (c_star * D ^ (1 / r)) = (3 * c_star) * D ^ (1 / r) := by ring
          rw [this]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_star_3 (le_of_lt hDr_pos)
        have hz_r_le : ‖(η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * T_c‖ ^ r ≤ (8 * C_star)⁻¹ * D := by
          have hle := Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (le_trans hz_le h3ρ_le) (le_of_lt hr0)
          have hrhs : ((8 * C_star) ^ (-1 / r) * D ^ (1 / r)) ^ r = (8 * C_star)⁻¹ * D := by
            rw [Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _)) (le_of_lt hDr_pos),
              ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hD0)]
            have h1 : (-1 / r) * r = -1 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hr0]
            have h2 : (1 / r) * r = 1 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hr0]
            rw [h1, h2, Real.rpow_neg_one, Real.rpow_one]
          rwa [hrhs] at hle
        have hG_le : ‖cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c‖ ≤ D / 8 := by
          rw [hnormG]
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz_r_le (le_of_lt hC_star_pos)
          have hcancel : C_star * ((8 * C_star)⁻¹ * D) = D / 8 := by
            field_simp [ne_of_gt hC_star_pos]
          linarith
        exact ⟨hTc_im_gt, hG_le⟩
      refine ⟨hY_lt_deep, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro ζ hζ T_c hTc y hy
        obtain ⟨hTc_im, hGTc_norm⟩ := hTc_bound T_c hTc
        have hGTc_re : |(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c).re| ≤ D / 8 :=
          le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hGTc_norm
        have hGTc_im : |(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c).im| ≤ D / 8 :=
          le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hGTc_norm
        have hζ_im_nonneg : 0 ≤ ζ.im := by
          rcases hζ with ⟨him, _⟩ | ⟨_, him⟩ <;> linarith
        have hζ_norm_le : ‖ζ‖ ≤ t₀ := by
          rcases hζ with ⟨him, hre⟩ | ⟨hnorm, _⟩
          · have hζ_eq : ζ = (ζ.re : ℂ) := by
              apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
            rw [hζ_eq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact hre
          · linarith
        have hζ_im_gt : -η₀ < ζ.im := by linarith
        obtain ⟨_, hGζ_norm, hGζ_low, _⟩ := hG_props η₀ ζ hζ_im_gt
        have hz_le_2t : ‖(η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ‖ ≤ 2 * t₀ := by
          have h1 : ‖(η₀ : ℂ) - Complex.I * ζ‖ ≤ ‖(η₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖Complex.I * ζ‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          have h2 : ‖(η₀ : ℂ)‖ = η₀ := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hη₀_pos)]
          have h3 : ‖Complex.I * ζ‖ = ‖ζ‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
          linarith
        have hGζ_upper : ‖cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ‖ ≤ C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r := by
          rw [hGζ_norm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) hz_le_2t (le_of_lt hr0)) (le_of_lt hC_star_pos)
        have hGζ_im_upper : -(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im ≤ C_star * (2 * t₀) ^ r := by
          have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ)
          linarith [(abs_le.mp (le_trans this hGζ_upper)).1]
        let p₂ : ℂ := ((Y.re : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
          cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ - cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c
        have hp₂_im : -p₂.im = y + (-(cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ ζ).im) +
            (cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c).im := by
          simp [p₂]
          ring
        have hp₂_lt_H : -p₂.im < H_req := by
          have hy_u : y ≤ D_deep := hy.2
          have hTc_u : (cuspShiftUpper C_star η₀ T_c).im ≤ 1 / 8 := by
            linarith [(abs_le.mp hGTc_im).2]
          dsimp [H_req]
          linarith

    let Ω_map : Set (ℂ × (ℂ × ℂ)) := Ω_base ∩ F_map ⁻¹' U

        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith

        · have hax := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx_re ha_pos
          have hby := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy_re) hb

    have hUw_preconn : IsPreconnected U_w := hUw_conv.isPreconnected
    have hw₀_in_Uw : w₀ ∈ U_w := by

      · rintro ((⟨hT_b, _⟩ | ⟨hT_b, _⟩) | ⟨hT_b, _⟩) <;> exact hT_b
    have hΨ_O_pos : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₁ O_pos :=
      hΨ₁_holo.mono (Subset.trans hO_pos_sub
        (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ subset_union_left))
    have hΨ_O_neg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun T => Ψ₂ (-T)) O_neg :=
      hΨ₂_holo.comp differentiable_neg.differentiableOn
        (fun T hT => ⟨(hO_neg_maps T hT).1, Or.inl (hO_neg_maps T hT).2⟩)
    have hΨ_V_ov : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun T => Φ (T, Y)) V_ov :=
      hΦ_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const Y))
        (fun T hT => (hV_ov_eq T hT).1)
    have hΨ_pos_neg : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (O_pos ∪ O_neg) :=
      diffOn_union_open hO_pos_open hO_neg_open hΨ_O_pos hΨ_O_neg
        (fun T hT => by
          have hp : 0 < T.im := hT.2
          dsimp [Ψ]
          exact if_pos hp)
        (fun T hT => by
          have hn : T.im < 0 := hT.2
          dsimp [Ψ]
          have hnot_pos : ¬ (0 < T.im) := not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hn)
          rw [if_neg hnot_pos, if_pos hn])
    have hΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ B_star := by
      rw [hB_cover]
      exact diffOn_union_open (hO_pos_open.union hO_neg_open) hV_ov_open
        hΨ_pos_neg hΨ_V_ov (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun T hT => (hV_ov_eq T hT).2)
    have hΨ_im : ∀ T ∈ B_star, (Ψ T).im < 0 := by
      intro T hT_b
      rcases lt_trichotomy 0 T.im with hpos | him0 | hneg
      · dsimp [Ψ]
        rw [if_pos hpos]
        exact hΨ₁_im T (hO_pos_sub ⟨hT_b, hpos⟩)
      · have hT_ov := hV_ov_real T hT_b him0.symm
        rw [(hV_ov_eq T hT_ov).2]
        exact hΦ_im (T, Y) (hV_ov_eq T hT_ov).1
      · dsimp [Ψ]
        have hnot_pos : ¬ (0 < T.im) := not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hneg)
        rw [if_neg hnot_pos, if_pos hneg]
        exact hΨ₂_im (-T) (hO_neg_maps T ⟨hT_b, hneg⟩)
    have h0_ov : (0 : ℂ) ∈ V_ov :=
      hV_ov_real 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos) Complex.zero_im
    obtain ⟨hj0, hj1, hj2⟩ := hJet Y hY_cb
    have hΨ0 : Ψ 0 = Y := by rw [(hV_ov_eq 0 h0_ov).2, hj0]
    have hderiv_ov : ∀ z ∈ V_ov, deriv Ψ z = deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y)) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hev : Ψ =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV_ov_open.mem_nhds hz) (fun T hT => (hV_ov_eq T hT).2)
      exact hev.deriv_eq
    have hΨ1 : deriv Ψ 0 = 0 := by rw [hderiv_ov 0 h0_ov, hj1]
    have hΨ2 : deriv (deriv Ψ) 0 = 2 * A Y := by
      have hev : deriv Ψ =ᶠ[nhds 0] deriv (fun T : ℂ => Φ (T, Y)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV_ov_open.mem_nhds h0_ov) hderiv_ov
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, hj2]
    exact ⟨Ψ, hΨ_holo, hΨ_im, hΨ0, hΨ1, hΨ2⟩
  have hEq_cara : 72 / ρ_star ^ 2 = C_cara * D ^ (-2 / r) := by
    dsimp [ρ_star, C_cara]
    have hD_sq : (D ^ (1 / r)) ^ 2 = D ^ (2 / r) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (D ^ (1 / r)) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hD0)]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hD_inv : (D ^ (2 / r))⁻¹ = D ^ (-2 / r) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_neg (le_of_lt hD0)]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [mul_pow, hD_sq, div_mul_eq_div_mul_one_div, one_div, hD_inv]
  rwa [hEq_cara] at hBound_ρ

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBoot : CriticalBootstrapPackage S)
    (M : SecondScaleFirstFieldData S)
    (hUpper : ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
      ∃ v₀ : ℝ, 0 < v₀ ∧ ∀ v x : ℝ, v₀ ≤ v → |x| ≤ R →
        ‖M.F ((x : ℂ) - (Real.exp (-v) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((M.lam + ε) * v)) :
    let c₁ := (1 / 2 + (1 - M.β)) / 2
    let P₁ := max M.lam (1 + M.a) + 1
    ∃ L₀ : ℝ, 0 < L₀ ∧
      ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
        ∃ u₀ : ℝ, 0 < u₀ ∧
          ∀ u ∈ commonNormalEpochSet M.L_lim c₁ P₁, u₀ ≤ u →
            ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ R →
              ∃ p δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ |p - x| ≤ L₀ * δ ∧
                |-Real.log δ - u| ≤ ε * u ∧
                Real.exp ((M.lam - ε) * u) ≤ ‖M.F ((p : ℂ) - (δ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBoot : CriticalBootstrapPackage S)
    (M : SecondScaleFirstFieldData S)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro c₁ P₁
  have hβ_pos : 0 < M.β := M.β_pos
  have hβ_lt : M.β < 1 / 2 := M.β_lt_half
  have ha_pos : 0 < M.a := M.a_pos
  have hlam_ge1 : 1 ≤ M.lam := M.one_le_lam
  have hα_gt : 1 / 2 < M.α := M.half_lt_α
  have hα_lt_sub : M.α < 1 - M.β := M.α_lt_one_sub_β
  have hc₁_gt : 1 / 2 < c₁ := by dsimp [c₁]; linarith
  have hc₁_lt_sub : c₁ < 1 - M.β := by dsimp [c₁]; linarith
  have hc₁_lt_one : c₁ < 1 := by linarith
  have hc₁_lt_lam : c₁ < M.lam := by linarith
  have hβ_lt_one_sub_c₁ : M.β < 1 - c₁ := by dsimp [c₁]; linarith
  have hP₁_ge_lam : M.lam + 1 ≤ P₁ := by dsimp [P₁]; linarith [le_max_left M.lam (1 + M.a)]
  have hP₁_ge_a : 2 + M.a ≤ P₁ := by dsimp [P₁]; linarith [le_max_right M.lam (1 + M.a)]
  have hP₁_ge_two : 2 ≤ P₁ := by linarith
  let α' : ℝ := (1 / 2 + min M.α c₁) / 2
  have hmin_gt : 1 / 2 < min M.α c₁ := lt_min hα_gt hc₁_gt
  have hmin_lt_one : min M.α c₁ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) hc₁_lt_one
  have hα'_gt : 1 / 2 < α' := by dsimp [α']; linarith
  have hα'_lt_min : α' < min M.α c₁ := by dsimp [α']; linarith
  have hα'_lt_one : α' < 1 := lt_trans hα'_lt_min hmin_lt_one
  have hα'_lt_α : α' < M.α := lt_of_lt_of_le hα'_lt_min (min_le_left _ _)
  have hα'_lt_lam : α' < M.lam :=
    lt_trans (lt_of_lt_of_le hα'_lt_min (min_le_right _ _)) hc₁_lt_lam
  have hα'_pos : 0 < α' := by linarith
  obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀_pos, hQuiet⟩ :=
    hBoot.quiet_cone_exclusion α' M.δ_b hα'_gt hα'_lt_one M.δ_b_pos M.δ_b_lt
  
  have hEnv : ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧
      ∀ u ∈ commonNormalEpochSet M.L_lim c₁ P₁, 1 ≤ u → ∀ B_min : ℝ,
        ∃ N_env : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_env,
          let K'' := M.K_seq n + u
          criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K'' ∧
          B_min ≤ rowMomentFull S K'' ∧
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u) ≤
            Real.exp u * (rowMomentFull S K'' / rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n)) ∧
          ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
            rowMomentFull S l ≤ C₀ * rowMomentFull S K'' *
              Real.exp ((1 - c₁) * max (K'' - l) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (l - K'') 0) := by
    have hδc_pos : 0 < M.lam - c₁ := sub_pos.mpr hc₁_lt_lam
    obtain ⟨U_raw, hU_raw⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (M.L_lim_slope_top.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds M.lam hδc_pos))
    let U_star : ℝ := max 1 U_raw
    have hU_star_nonneg : 0 ≤ U_star := by positivity
    have h_tail : ∀ v : ℝ, U_star ≤ v → c₁ * v - M.L_lim v ≤ 0 := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_pos : 0 < v := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hv)
      have hv_raw : U_raw ≤ v := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hv
      have hdist : |M.L_lim v / v - M.lam| < M.lam - c₁ := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hU_raw v hv_raw
      have hlow : c₁ < M.L_lim v / v := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hdist).1]
      have hmul : c₁ * v < M.L_lim v := (lt_div_iff₀ hv_pos).mp hlow
      linarith
    have h_cont_coarse : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => c₁ * v - M.L_lim v) :=
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub M.L_lim_cont
    obtain ⟨v_max, _, hv_max⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hU_star_nonneg) h_cont_coarse.continuousOn
    let C_coarse : ℝ := max 0 (c₁ * v_max - M.L_lim v_max)
    have hC_coarse_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_coarse := le_max_left _ _
    have h_coarse : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → c₁ * v - M.L_lim v ≤ C_coarse := by
      intro v hv
      by_cases hvU : v ≤ U_star
      · exact le_trans (isMaxOn_iff.mp hv_max v ⟨hv, hvU⟩) (le_max_right _ _)
      · exact le_trans (h_tail v (le_of_not_ge hvU)) hC_coarse_nonneg
    let C₀ : ℝ := max 4 (2 * M.C_env2 * Real.exp C_coarse)
    refine ⟨C₀, lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4) (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
    intro u hu hu1 B_min
    let I_u : Set ℝ := Set.Icc 0 ((P₁ + 1) * u)
    have hIu_top_nonneg : 0 ≤ (P₁ + 1) * u := by positivity
    have hu_in_Iu : u ∈ I_u := ⟨by linarith, by nlinarith⟩
    obtain ⟨v_min, _, hv_min⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hIu_top_nonneg) M.L_lim_cont.continuousOn
    let δ_u : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim v_min)
    have hδ_u_pos : 0 < δ_u := by positivity
    have hUnif_u : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n v => Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n + v) / rowMomentFull S (M.K_seq n)))
        (fun v => Real.exp (M.L_lim v)) Filter.atTop I_u :=
      tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact.mp M.moment_law_conv I_u isCompact_Icc
    obtain ⟨N_mom, hN_mom⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hUnif_u δ_u hδ_u_pos)
    obtain ⟨N_B, hN_B⟩ := Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp M.B_seq_tendsto
      (2 * max B_min 1 * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u))
    refine ⟨max N_mom N_B, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hn_mom : N_mom ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    let K_n : ℝ := M.K_seq n
    let B'_n : ℝ := rowMomentFull S K_n
    let K'' : ℝ := K_n + u
    let B'' : ℝ := rowMomentFull S K''
    have hK_ge : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_n := (M.K_seq_ge n).1
    have hB'_ge1 : 1 ≤ B'_n := (M.K_seq_ge n).2
    have hB'_pos : 0 < B'_n := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB'_ge1
    have hM_bounds : ∀ v ∈ I_u,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim v) ≤
          Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_n + v) / B'_n) ∧
        Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_n + v) / B'_n) ≤
          2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v) := by
      intro v hv
      have hdist : |Real.exp (M.L_lim v) - Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_n + v) / B'_n)| < δ_u := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq, K_n, B'_n] using hN_mom n hn_mom v hv
      have hδ_le : δ_u ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim v) := by
        dsimp [δ_u]
        have hmin_le : M.L_lim v_min ≤ M.L_lim v := isMinOn_iff.mp hv_min v hv
        nlinarith [Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hmin_le]
      obtain ⟨hl_abs, hu_abs⟩ := abs_lt.mp hdist
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (M.L_lim v) := Real.exp_pos _
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hMu_low : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u) ≤ Real.exp u * (B'' / B'_n) :=
      (hM_bounds u hu_in_Iu).1
    have hB'_le_B'' : B'_n ≤ 2 * B'' * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMu_low
        (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u))
      have hL : 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u)) = B'_n := by
        have hexp : Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
        calc 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u))
            = B'_n * (Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * Real.exp (M.L_lim u)) := by ring
          _ = B'_n := by rw [hexp, mul_one]
      have hR : 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * (Real.exp u * (B'' / B'_n)) =
          2 * B'' * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) := by
        have hdiv : B'_n * (B'' / B'_n) = B'' := mul_div_cancel₀ B'' (ne_of_gt hB'_pos)
        calc 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u) * (Real.exp u * (B'' / B'_n))
            = 2 * (B'_n * (B'' / B'_n)) * (Real.exp u * Real.exp (-M.L_lim u)) := by ring
          _ = 2 * B'' * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) := by
            rw [hdiv, ← Real.exp_add, sub_eq_add_neg]
      linarith
    have hB''_ge_max : max B_min 1 ≤ B'' := by
      have hNB_le : 2 * max B_min 1 * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) ≤ B'_n := hN_B n hn_B
      have hcomb : (2 * max B_min 1) * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) ≤
          (2 * B'') * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) := le_trans hNB_le hB'_le_B''
      have h2 := le_of_mul_le_mul_right hcomb (Real.exp_pos (u - M.L_lim u))
      linarith
    have hB''_pos : 0 < B'' := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hB''_ge_max)
    refine ⟨by linarith, le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hB''_ge_max, hMu_low, ?_⟩
    intro l hl
    let v : ℝ := l - K_n
    have hl_eq : K_n + v = l := by dsimp [v]; ring
    have h_diff1 : K_n + u - l = u - v := by dsimp [v]; ring
    have h_diff2 : l - (K_n + u) = v - u := by dsimp [v]; ring
    change rowMomentFull S l ≤ C₀ * B'' *
      Real.exp ((1 - c₁) * max (K_n + u - l) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (l - (K_n + u)) 0)
    rw [h_diff1, h_diff2]
    by_cases hv_in : v ∈ I_u
    · have hMv_up : Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S l / B'_n) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v) := by
        simpa [hl_eq] using (hM_bounds v hv_in).2
      have hl_bound1 : rowMomentFull S l ≤ 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v) := by
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMv_up (by positivity : 0 ≤ B'_n * Real.exp (-v))
        have hL : B'_n * Real.exp (-v) * (Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S l / B'_n)) =
            rowMomentFull S l := by
          have hdiv : B'_n * (rowMomentFull S l / B'_n) = rowMomentFull S l :=
            mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hB'_pos)
          have hexp : Real.exp (-v) * Real.exp v = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          calc B'_n * Real.exp (-v) * (Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S l / B'_n))
              = (B'_n * (rowMomentFull S l / B'_n)) * (Real.exp (-v) * Real.exp v) := by ring
            _ = rowMomentFull S l := by rw [hdiv, hexp, mul_one]
        have hR : B'_n * Real.exp (-v) * (2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v)) =
            2 * B'_n * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v) := by
          calc B'_n * Real.exp (-v) * (2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v))
              = 2 * B'_n * (Real.exp (M.L_lim v) * Real.exp (-v)) := by ring
            _ = 2 * B'_n * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v) := by rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_eq_add_neg]
        linarith
      have hl_bound2 : rowMomentFull S l ≤
          4 * B'' * Real.exp ((M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v)) := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB'_le_B''
          (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v))
        have hR : 2 * B'' * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) * (2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v)) =
            4 * B'' * Real.exp ((M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v)) := by
          calc 2 * B'' * Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) * (2 * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v))
              = 4 * B'' * (Real.exp (u - M.L_lim u) * Real.exp (M.L_lim v - v)) := by ring
            _ = 4 * B'' * Real.exp ((u - M.L_lim u) + (M.L_lim v - v)) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
            _ = 4 * B'' * Real.exp ((M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v)) := by congr 2; ring
        linarith
      have h4_le_C₀ : (4 : ℝ) ≤ C₀ := le_max_left _ _
      by_cases hvu : v ≤ u
      · have hchord : M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u ≤ c₁ * (v - u) := hu.2.1 v hvu
        have hexp_le : (M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v) ≤
            (1 - c₁) * max (u - v) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (v - u) 0 := by
          rw [max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
          linarith
        calc rowMomentFull S l
            ≤ 4 * B'' * Real.exp ((M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v)) := hl_bound2
          _ ≤ C₀ * B'' * Real.exp ((1 - c₁) * max (u - v) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (v - u) 0) := by
            gcongr
      · have huv : u ≤ v := le_of_not_ge hvu
        have hchord : M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u ≤ P₁ * (v - u) := hu.2.2 v huv
        have hexp_le : (M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v) ≤
            (1 - c₁) * max (u - v) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (v - u) 0 := by
          rw [max_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
          linarith
        calc rowMomentFull S l
            ≤ 4 * B'' * Real.exp ((M.L_lim v - M.L_lim u) + (u - v)) := hl_bound2
          _ ≤ C₀ * B'' * Real.exp ((1 - c₁) * max (u - v) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (v - u) 0) := by
            gcongr
    · have hglob := M.global_envelope n l hl
      have hk_diff1 : K_n - l = -v := by dsimp [v]; ring
      have hk_diff2 : l - K_n = v := rfl
      rw [show M.K_seq n = K_n from rfl, show rowMomentFull S K_n = B'_n from rfl,
        hk_diff1, hk_diff2] at hglob
      have hl_bound : rowMomentFull S l ≤
          2 * M.C_env2 * B'' * Real.exp ((u - M.L_lim u) + (M.β * max (-v) 0 + M.a * max v 0)) := by

        have htri : ‖((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s‖ ≤
            ‖M.F Z‖ + ‖M.F Z - ((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s‖ := by
          calc ‖((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s‖
              = ‖M.F Z - (M.F Z - ((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖M.F Z‖ + ‖M.F Z - ((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        change ‖M.F Z - ((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f s‖ < 1 at hdF
        linarith
      have hQ_approx : r_n * Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖ ≤ ‖M.F Z‖ + 1 := by
        have hdQ := hN_Q n hn_Q Z hZ_in
        rw [dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg, hs_eq] at hdQ
        change ‖((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.q s‖ < 1 at hdQ
        have hnorm_Q : ‖((r_n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.q s‖ = r_n ^ 2 * ‖S.q s‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr_n_nonneg]
        rw [hnorm_Q] at hdQ
        have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (r_n ^ 2 * ‖S.q s‖) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
          exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_of_lt hdQ)
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg r_n), Real.sqrt_sq hr_n_nonneg] at hsqrt
        linarith [norm_nonneg (M.F Z)]
      have hshape_rect : r_n * shapeModulus S s ≤ ‖M.F Z‖ + 1 := by
        rcases max_choice ‖S.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖) with hmax | hmax <;>
          rw [shapeModulus, hmax]
        · exact hF_approx
        · exact hQ_approx
      by_cases hv_zone1 : (1 - η) * u ≤ v
      · 
        have hv_win : |v - u| ≤ η * u := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hFZ_le : ‖M.F Z‖ ≤ Real.exp ((M.lam - η) * u) := hFail p v hp_sub hv_win
        have hexp_ge1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((M.lam - η) * u) :=
          Real.one_le_exp (by nlinarith)
        have hshape_z1 : r_n * shapeModulus S s ≤ 2 * Real.exp ((M.lam - η) * u) := by linarith
        have h4_le_Cz : (4 : ℝ) ≤ C_zone :=
          le_trans (by linarith [hM_base_ge1] : (4 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * M_base) (le_max_left _ _)
        have hexp_z1 : α' * (u - v) - L_u + (M.lam - η) * u ≤
            |L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u := by
          have h1 : α' * (u - v) ≤ α' * (η * u) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hα'_pos)
          have h2 : γ * u ≤ ((1 - α') * η) * u :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ_le1 (by linarith)
          linarith
        calc (d'' / B'') * shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / d'') ^ α'
            ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) * (r_n * shapeModulus S s) := hW_master
          _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) * (2 * Real.exp ((M.lam - η) * u)) := by gcongr
          _ = 4 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u + (M.lam - η) * u) := by
            rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
          _ ≤ C_zone * Real.exp (|L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u) := by gcongr
      · 
        have hv_lt : v < (1 - η) * u := lt_of_not_ge hv_zone1
        have hFZ_le : ‖M.F Z‖ ≤ M_base * Real.exp ((M.lam + ε_up) * v) :=
          hF_global v p hv0 hp_le_RL
        have hexp_ge1 : 1 ≤ M_base * Real.exp ((M.lam + ε_up) * v) := by
          have h1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((M.lam + ε_up) * v) :=
            Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hv0)
          nlinarith
        have hshape_z2 : r_n * shapeModulus S s ≤
            2 * M_base * Real.exp ((M.lam + ε_up) * v) := by linarith
        have h4M_le_Cz : 4 * M_base ≤ C_zone := le_max_left _ _
        have hexp_z2 : α' * (u - v) - L_u + (M.lam + ε_up) * v ≤
            |L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u := by
          have hv_lt_u : v ≤ u := by nlinarith
          have h1 : (M.lam - α') * (v - u) ≤ -(M.lam - α') * (η * u) := by
            have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show v - u ≤ -(η * u) by linarith)
              (le_of_lt hlam_sub_α')
            linarith
          have h2 : ε_up * v ≤ ε_up * u :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv_lt_u (le_of_lt hε_up_pos)
          have h3 : γ * u ≤ ε_up * u :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ_le2 (by linarith)
          have hid : α' * (u - v) - L_u + (M.lam + ε_up) * v =
              (M.lam * u - L_u) + (M.lam - α') * (v - u) + ε_up * v := by ring
          have heps_def : ε_up * u = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((M.lam - α') * (η * u)) := by
            dsimp [ε_up]; ring
          linarith
        calc (d'' / B'') * shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / d'') ^ α'
            ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) * (r_n * shapeModulus S s) := hW_master
          _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) *
                (2 * M_base * Real.exp ((M.lam + ε_up) * v)) := by gcongr
          _ = (4 * M_base) * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u + (M.lam + ε_up) * v) := by
            rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
          _ ≤ C_zone * Real.exp (|L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u) := by gcongr
    · 
      have hv_neg : v < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hv0
      have hexp_gt1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (-v) := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
      have hd'_le_w : d'_n ≤ wallDepth S s := by
        rw [← hd_exp_eq]
        exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt hd'_pos) hexp_gt1
      have hre_RL : |s.re - M.ξ_seq n| ≤ (R + L₀) * wallDepth S s := by
        have hre_eq : s.re - M.ξ_seq n = d'_n * p := by
          dsimp [p]
          exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hd'_pos)).symm
        have hp_le : |p| ≤ (R + L₀) * Real.exp (-v) := by nlinarith
        rw [hre_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd'_pos, ← hd_exp_eq]
        calc d'_n * |p| ≤ d'_n * ((R + L₀) * Real.exp (-v)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_le (le_of_lt hd'_pos)
          _ = (R + L₀) * (d'_n * Real.exp (-v)) := by ring
      have hcone_s := hCone n hn_cone s hd'_le_w hd_hi hre_RL
      change r_n * shapeModulus S s ≤ C_cone * (d'_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α at hcone_s
      have hrpow_α : (d'_n / wallDepth S s) ^ M.α = Real.exp (M.α * v) := by
        have hquot : d'_n / wallDepth S s = Real.exp v := by
          rw [← hd_exp_eq, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_self (ne_of_gt hd'_pos),
            one_div, ← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg]
        rw [hquot, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos v), Real.log_exp]
        congr 1; ring
      rw [hrpow_α] at hcone_s
      have h2C_le_Cz : 2 * C_cone ≤ C_zone := le_max_right _ _
      have hexp_z3 : α' * (u - v) - L_u + M.α * v ≤
          |L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u := by
        have h1 : (M.α - α') * v ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) (le_of_lt hv_neg)
        have h2 : γ * u ≤ (M.lam - α') * u :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ_le_lam_α' (by linarith)
        have hid : α' * (u - v) - L_u + M.α * v =
            (M.lam * u - L_u) - (M.lam - α') * u + (M.α - α') * v := by ring
        linarith
      calc (d'' / B'') * shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / d'') ^ α'
          ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) * (r_n * shapeModulus S s) := hW_master
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u) * (C_cone * Real.exp (M.α * v)) := by gcongr
        _ = (2 * C_cone) * Real.exp (α' * (u - v) - L_u + M.α * v) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add]; ring
        _ ≤ C_zone * Real.exp (|L_u - M.lam * u| - γ * u) := by gcongr
  
  by_contra h_no_u₀
  have h_contra_seq : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ u x : ℝ,
      u ∈ commonNormalEpochSet M.L_lim c₁ P₁ ∧
      ((j : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ u ∧
      |x| ≤ R ∧
      ∀ p v : ℝ, |p - x| ≤ L₀ * Real.exp (-v) → |v - u| ≤ η * u →
        ‖M.F ((p : ℂ) - (Real.exp (-v) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((M.lam - η) * u) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hj
    apply h_no_u₀
    refine ⟨((j : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2, by positivity, fun u hu hu_ge x hx => ?_⟩
    by_contra h_wit
    apply hj
    refine ⟨u, x, hu, hu_ge, hx, fun p v hp hv => ?_⟩
    by_contra h_gt
    apply h_wit
    refine ⟨p, Real.exp (-v), Real.exp_pos (-v), hp, ?_, le_of_lt (not_le.mp h_gt)⟩
    simpa [Real.log_exp] using hv
  choose u_seq x_seq hu_mem hu_ge hx_le hF_fail using h_contra_seq
  have hu_ge1 : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ u_seq j := by
    intro j
    have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
    exact le_trans (by nlinarith) (hu_ge j)
  have hu_ge_j1 : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ u_seq j := by
    intro j
    have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
    exact le_trans (by nlinarith) (hu_ge j)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀_pos, hEnv_fn⟩ := hEnv
  obtain ⟨C_zone, hC_zone_pos, hZone_fn⟩ := hZone
  let D_max : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => min (η * u_seq j) (j : ℝ)
  have hD_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ D_max j := fun j =>
    le_min (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hη_pos) (le_trans zero_le_one (hu_ge1 j))) (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
  have hD_le_ηu : ∀ j : ℕ, D_max j ≤ η * u_seq j := fun j => min_le_left _ _
  choose N_env_seq hN_env_seq using fun j : ℕ =>
    hEnv_fn (u_seq j) (hu_mem j) (hu_ge1 j) ((j : ℝ) + 1)
  choose N_field_seq hN_field_seq using fun j : ℕ =>
    hZone_fn (u_seq j) (x_seq j) (D_max j) (M.L_lim (u_seq j))
      (hu_ge1 j) (hx_le j) (hD_nonneg j) (hD_le_ηu j) (hF_fail j)
  let n_seq : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => max (N_env_seq j) (N_field_seq j)
  let K''_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => M.K_seq (n_seq j) + u_seq j
  let x''_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => M.ξ_seq (n_seq j) + Real.exp (-M.K_seq (n_seq j)) * x_seq j
  have h_env_j := fun j : ℕ => hN_env_seq j (n_seq j) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hK''_crit : ∀ j : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K''_seq j :=
    fun j => (h_env_j j).1
  have hK''_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto K''_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (fun j : ℕ => ?_) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ criticalDepthThreshold S := le_max_left _ _
    have h2 : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ M.K_seq (n_seq j) := (M.K_seq_ge (n_seq j)).1
    have h3 := hu_ge_j1 j
    dsimp [K''_seq]
    linarith
  have hB''_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => rowMomentFull S (K''_seq j))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (fun j : ℕ => ?_) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have h1 : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (K''_seq j) := (h_env_j j).2.1
    linarith
  have hK''_env : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
      rowMomentFull S l ≤ C₀ * rowMomentFull S (K''_seq j) *
        Real.exp ((1 - c₁) * max (K''_seq j - l) 0 + (P₁ - 1) * max (l - K''_seq j) 0) :=
    fun j => (h_env_j j).2.2.2
  apply hQuiet (1 - c₁) (P₁ - 1) C₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) hC₀_pos
    K''_seq x''_seq hK''_crit hK''_tendsto hB''_tendsto hK''_env
  intro c_depth ε_q hc_depth hε_q
  obtain ⟨U_slope, hU_slope⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (M.L_lim_slope_top.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds M.lam (half_pos hγ_pos)))
  let T_real : ℝ :=
    max (max (-Real.log c_depth) (1 / η))
      (max U_slope ((2 / γ) * max 0 (Real.log (C_zone / ε_q))))
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀⟩ := exists_nat_ge T_real
  refine ⟨J₀, fun j hj s hs_low hs_hi hs_re => ?_⟩
  have hj_ge_T : T_real ≤ (j : ℝ) := le_trans hJ₀ (Nat.cast_le.mpr hj)
  have hj_ge_logc : -Real.log c_depth ≤ (j : ℝ) :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hj_ge_T
  have hj_ge_invη : 1 / η ≤ (j : ℝ) :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hj_ge_T
  have hu_ge_T : T_real ≤ u_seq j := by
    have hj_le_u : (j : ℝ) ≤ u_seq j := by linarith [hu_ge_j1 j]
    exact le_trans hj_ge_T hj_le_u
  have hu_ge_slope : U_slope ≤ u_seq j :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hu_ge_T
  have hu_ge_logCz : (2 / γ) * max 0 (Real.log (C_zone / ε_q)) ≤ u_seq j :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hu_ge_T
  have hD_eq_j : D_max j = (j : ℝ) := by
    apply min_eq_right
    have h1 : 1 ≤ η * (j : ℝ) := by
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hη_pos).mp hj_ge_invη
      linarith
    have hj_nonneg : 0 ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
    have h2 : (j : ℝ) ≤ η * (j : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h3 : (j : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ u_seq j := by nlinarith [hu_ge j]
    nlinarith
  have hexp_D_le_c : Real.exp (-D_max j) ≤ c_depth := by
    rw [hD_eq_j, ← Real.exp_log hc_depth]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hs_low_D : Real.exp (-D_max j) * Real.exp (-K''_seq j) ≤ wallDepth S s :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_D_le_c (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))) hs_low
  have hW_bound := hN_field_seq j (n_seq j) (le_max_right _ _) (h_env_j j).2.2.1
    s hs_low_D hs_hi hs_re
  have hu_pos : 0 < u_seq j := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hu_ge1 j)
  have hslope_u : |M.L_lim (u_seq j) - M.lam * u_seq j| ≤ (γ / 2) * u_seq j := by
    have hdist : |M.L_lim (u_seq j) / u_seq j - M.lam| < γ / 2 := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hU_slope (u_seq j) hu_ge_slope
    have hmul_eq : M.L_lim (u_seq j) - M.lam * u_seq j =
        (M.L_lim (u_seq j) / u_seq j - M.lam) * u_seq j := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hu_pos]
    rw [hmul_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hu_pos]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hdist) (le_of_lt hu_pos)
  have hlog_le : Real.log (C_zone / ε_q) ≤ (γ / 2) * u_seq j := by
    have h1 : Real.log (C_zone / ε_q) ≤ max 0 (Real.log (C_zone / ε_q)) := le_max_right _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_ge_logCz (by positivity : 0 ≤ γ / 2)
    have hcancel : (γ / 2) * ((2 / γ) * max 0 (Real.log (C_zone / ε_q))) =
        max 0 (Real.log (C_zone / ε_q)) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hγ_pos]
    linarith
  have hexp_decay : C_zone * Real.exp (|M.L_lim (u_seq j) - M.lam * u_seq j| - γ * u_seq j) ≤ ε_q := by
    have hexp_arg : |M.L_lim (u_seq j) - M.lam * u_seq j| - γ * u_seq j ≤
        Real.log (ε_q / C_zone) := by
      have hlog_inv : -Real.log (C_zone / ε_q) = Real.log (ε_q / C_zone) := by
        rw [← Real.log_inv, inv_div]
      linarith
    calc C_zone * Real.exp (|M.L_lim (u_seq j) - M.lam * u_seq j| - γ * u_seq j)
        ≤ C_zone * Real.exp (Real.log (ε_q / C_zone)) := by gcongr
      _ = C_zone * (ε_q / C_zone) := by rw [Real.exp_log (div_pos hε_q hC_zone_pos)]
      _ = ε_q := mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hC_zone_pos)
  exact le_trans hW_bound hexp_decay

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s₀ hs₀ hf₀
  have hOpen_strip : ∀ R : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip R) :=
    fun R => isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hConv_strip : ∀ R : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip R) := by
    intro R x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    change |(a • x + b • y).im| < R
    have him : (a • x + b • y).im = a * x.im + b * y.im := by
      simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [him]
    have hx' : |x.im| < R := hx
    have hy' : |y.im| < R := hy
    have htri : |a * x.im + b * y.im| ≤ a * |x.im| + b * |y.im| := by
      calc
        |a * x.im + b * y.im| ≤ |a * x.im| + |b * y.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |x.im| + b * |y.im| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp only [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; linarith
    · nlinarith [abs_nonneg x.im, abs_nonneg y.im]
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  have h0_rbase : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
  have hsbase_le_hX0 : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ M.h_X 0 := M.h_X_ge 0 h0_rbase
  have hbase_sub_DH : horizStrip M.s_base ⊆ D_H :=
    fun s hs => lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hs) hsbase_le_hX0
  have h0_DH : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_H := by
    apply hbase_sub_DH
    show |(0 : ℂ).im| < M.s_base
    simp [M.s_base_pos]
  obtain ⟨hDH_open, hDH_conv⟩ : IsOpen D_H ∧ Convex ℝ D_H := by
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLtTop
    · have hUniv : D_H = Set.univ :=
        Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun s => by simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, hTop])
      rw [hUniv]
      exact ⟨isOpen_univ, convex_univ⟩
    · let H : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH_eq : ENNReal.ofReal H = M.h_X 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLtTop)
      have hH_pos : 0 < H := by
        by_contra hle
        have h0 : ENNReal.ofReal H = 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (le_of_not_gt hle)
        rw [h0] at hH_eq
        exact not_lt_of_ge (hH_eq ▸ hsbase_le_hX0) (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos)
      have hEq : D_H = horizStrip H := by
        ext s
        change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H
        rw [← hH_eq]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos

        (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds (c_v * 1 + c_u * ψ₁ 0)) := by
      have hcos_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun y : ℂ => Complex.cos ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y)))
          (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds 1) := by
        have harg : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y))
            (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using hpow_mp1_0.mul (hϕ₁_cont.tendsto.comp hz_tendsto_0)
        have hc := Complex.continuous_cos.continuousAt.tendsto.comp harg
        rwa [Complex.cos_zero] at hc
      have hψ_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => ψ₁ (z_fn y))
          (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds (ψ₁ 0)) :=
        hψ₁_cont.tendsto.comp hz_tendsto_0
      have hcomb := (hΔN_lim.mul hcos_lim).add (hΔT_lim.mul hψ_lim)
      have hEq_ev : (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) *
            (Δ0 y * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g₀ y)) + Δ1 y * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g₀ y)))) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ]
          (fun y : ℂ => ((z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) * ΔN y) *
              Complex.cos ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y)) +
            ((z_fn y) ^ (2 * m - 1) * ΔT y) * ψ₁ (z_fn y)) := by
        refine hz_ev_ball.mono (fun y _hy => ?_)
        dsimp only
        rw [hRotProj y (K.ϕ (g₀ y))]
        have hg₀_eq : g₀ y = s₀ + z_fn y := (add_sub_cancel s₀ (g₀ y)).symm
        have hdϕ : K.ϕ (g₀ y) - ϕ₀ = (z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y) := by
          rw [hg₀_eq, hϕ₁_eq (z_fn y)]
        have hdsin : Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g₀ y) - ϕ₀) = (z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ψ₁ (z_fn y) := by
          rw [hg₀_eq, hsin_eq (z_fn y)]
        rw [hdsin, hdϕ]
        have hexp : (m - 2) + (m + 1) = 2 * m - 1 := by omega
        calc
          (z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) *
              (ΔN y * Complex.cos ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y)) +
                ΔT y * ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ψ₁ (z_fn y))) =
            ((z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) * ΔN y) * Complex.cos ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y)) +
              ((z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) * (z_fn y) ^ (m + 1)) * ΔT y * ψ₁ (z_fn y) := by ring
          _ = ((z_fn y) ^ (m - 2) * ΔN y) * Complex.cos ((z_fn y) ^ (m + 1) * ϕ₁ (z_fn y)) +
              ((z_fn y) ^ (2 * m - 1) * ΔT y) * ψ₁ (z_fn y) := by
            rw [← pow_add, hexp, mul_assoc]
      exact hcomb.congr' hEq_ev.symm
    have hProjm_lim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (2 * m - 1) *
          (Δ0 y * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g_m y)) + Δ1 y * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g_m y))))
        (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ)
        (nhds (0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g_m y₀) - ϕ₀) + c_u * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g_m y₀) - ϕ₀))) := by
      have hcos_m : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g_m y) - ϕ₀))
          (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g_m y₀) - ϕ₀))) :=
        (Complex.continuous_cos.continuousAt.comp
          (hϕgm_cont.sub continuousAt_const)).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have hsin_m : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g_m y) - ϕ₀))
          (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds (Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g_m y₀) - ϕ₀))) :=
        (Complex.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
          (hϕgm_cont.sub continuousAt_const)).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      refine ((hΔN_high_lim.mul hcos_m).add (hΔT_lim.mul hsin_m)).congr (fun y => ?_)
      rw [hRotProj y (K.ϕ (g_m y))]
      ring
    have hRHS_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (8 * m - 6) * RHS_fn y)
        (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
      have hlead_0 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun y : ℂ => (C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * (J_slice y) ^ 2 * (z_fn y) ^ (2 * m))
          (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds 0) := by
        have hJ2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℂ => (C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * (J_slice y) ^ 2)
            (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ) (nhds ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * (J_slice y₀) ^ 2)) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((hJ_cont.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds).pow 2)
        simpa using hJ2.mul hpow_2m_0
      have hprod := (hlead_0.mul (hProj0_lim.pow 2)).mul (hProjm_lim.pow 2)
      simp only [zero_mul] at hprod
      have hexp : 8 * m - 6 = 2 * m + (m - 2) * 2 + (2 * m - 1) * 2 := by omega
      refine hprod.congr (fun y => ?_)
      dsimp only [RHS_fn]
      set P0 := Δ0 y * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g₀ y)) + Δ1 y * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g₀ y))
      set Pm := Δ0 y * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (g_m y)) + Δ1 y * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (g_m y))
      calc
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * J_slice y ^ 2 * z_fn y ^ (2 * m) *
            (z_fn y ^ (m - 2) * P0) ^ 2 * (z_fn y ^ (2 * m - 1) * Pm) ^ 2 =
          (z_fn y ^ (2 * m) * (z_fn y ^ (m - 2)) ^ 2 * (z_fn y ^ (2 * m - 1)) ^ 2) *
            ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * J_slice y ^ 2 * P0 ^ 2 * Pm ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = z_fn y ^ (8 * m - 6) * ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 4 * J_slice y ^ 2 * P0 ^ 2 * Pm ^ 2) := by
          rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add, ← hexp]
    have hEq_scaled : (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (8 * m - 6) * LHS_fn y) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ]
        (fun y : ℂ => (z_fn y) ^ (8 * m - 6) * RHS_fn y) :=
      hEv_Diff.mono (fun y hy => by dsimp only; rw [hy])
    have _hNeBot : (nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ).NeBot := inferInstance
    exact hL_inf_ne (tendsto_nhds_unique hLHS_lim (hRHS_lim.congr' hEq_scaled.symm))
  exact ⟨hSimple, hInfl hSimple⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (hSimple : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      K.f s = 0 → deriv K.f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv K.f) s = 0) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (speedPotentialQ K) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      deriv (deriv K.f) s = speedPotentialQ K s * K.f s) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      speedPotentialQ K (s + 2 * Real.pi) = speedPotentialQ K s) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      speedPotentialQ K (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (speedPotentialQ K s)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (supportProfileH0 K) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      supportProfileH0 K (s + 2 * Real.pi) = supportProfileH0 K s) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      supportProfileH0 K (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (supportProfileH0 K s)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
      supportProfileH0 K s = K.Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
      deriv (supportProfileH0 K) s =
        (-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s)

proof.tactics:
by
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  have hD_open : IsOpen D_H := by
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLt
    · have h_univ : D_H = Set.univ := by
        ext s
        simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, hTop]
      rw [h_univ]
      exact isOpen_univ
    · let H : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH_eq : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLt)).symm
      rcases le_or_gt H 0 with hH_le | hH_pos
      · have h_zero : M.h_X 0 = 0 := by
          rw [hH_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]
          exact hH_le
        have h_empty : D_H = ∅ := by
          ext s
          simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, h_zero]
        rw [h_empty]
        exact isOpen_empty
      · have h_eq : D_H = (fun s : ℂ => |s.im|) ⁻¹' Set.Iio H := by
          ext s
          change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H
          rw [hH_eq]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos
        rw [h_eq]
        exact isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hD_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H, s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ D_H := by
    intro s hs
    simpa [D_H, horizStripENNR] using hs
  have hD_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H, starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ D_H := by
    intro s hs
    simpa [D_H, horizStripENNR] using hs
  
  have hf0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ K.f D_H := K.f_holo
  have hf1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv K.f) D_H := hf0_holo.deriv hD_open
  have hf2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv K.f)) D_H := hf1_holo.deriv hD_open
  have hf3_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv (deriv K.f))) D_H := hf2_holo.deriv hD_open
  have hderiv2_f : ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv (deriv K.f) s = speedPotentialQ K s * K.f s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0
    · simp [(hSimple s hs hfs).2, hfs]
    · simp [speedPotentialQ, hfs, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfs]
  have hq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (speedPotentialQ K) D_H := by
    intro s₀ hs₀
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    by_cases hfs₀ : K.f s₀ = 0
    · obtain ⟨hf', hf''⟩ := hSimple s₀ hs₀ hfs₀
      let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope K.f s₀
      let g₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope (deriv (deriv K.f)) s₀
      have hD_nhds : D_H ∈ nhds s₀ := hD_open.mem_nhds hs₀
      have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ D_H :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hD_nhds).mpr hf0_holo
      have hg₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ D_H :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hD_nhds).mpr hf2_holo
      have hg₁_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ g₁ s₀ := hg₁_holo.differentiableAt hD_nhds
      have hg₂_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ g₂ s₀ := hg₂_holo.differentiableAt hD_nhds
      have hg₁_s₀ : g₁ s₀ = deriv K.f s₀ := dslope_same K.f s₀
      have hg₂_s₀ : g₂ s₀ = deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) s₀ := dslope_same (deriv (deriv K.f)) s₀
      have hg₁_ne_s₀ : g₁ s₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hg₁_s₀]; exact hf'
      have h_ev : speedPotentialQ K =ᶠ[nhds s₀] fun z => g₂ z / g₁ z := by
        filter_upwards [hg₁_at.continuousAt.eventually_ne hg₁_ne_s₀] with z hgz
        by_cases hz : z = s₀
        · subst hz
          simp [speedPotentialQ, hfs₀, hg₁_s₀, hg₂_s₀]
        · have hf_eq : K.f z = (z - s₀) * g₁ z := by
            have h1 := sub_smul_dslope K.f s₀ z
            rw [smul_eq_mul, hfs₀, sub_zero] at h1
            exact h1.symm
          have hf2_eq : deriv (deriv K.f) z = (z - s₀) * g₂ z := by
            have h2 := sub_smul_dslope (deriv (deriv K.f)) s₀ z
            rw [smul_eq_mul, hf'', sub_zero] at h2
            exact h2.symm
          have hsub_ne : z - s₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
          have hfz_ne : K.f z ≠ 0 := by
            rw [hf_eq]
            exact mul_ne_zero hsub_ne hgz
          simp only [speedPotentialQ, hfz_ne, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [hf_eq, hf2_eq]
          exact mul_div_mul_left (g₂ z) (g₁ z) hsub_ne
      exact h_ev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr (hg₂_at.div hg₁_at hg₁_ne_s₀)
    · have hD_nhds : D_H ∈ nhds s₀ := hD_open.mem_nhds hs₀
      have hf0_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ K.f s₀ := hf0_holo.differentiableAt hD_nhds
      have hf2_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv (deriv K.f)) s₀ := hf2_holo.differentiableAt hD_nhds
      have h_ev : speedPotentialQ K =ᶠ[nhds s₀] fun z => deriv (deriv K.f) z / K.f z := by
        filter_upwards [hf0_at.continuousAt.eventually_ne hfs₀] with z hfz
        simp [speedPotentialQ, hfz]
      exact h_ev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr (hf2_at.div hf0_at hfs₀)
  have h_per_deriv : ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g D_H →
      (∀ z ∈ D_H, g (z + 2 * Real.pi) = g z) →
      ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv g (s + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv g s := by
    intro g hg hper s hs
    have hs_per : s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ D_H := hD_per s hs
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => g (w + 2 * Real.pi)) (deriv g (s + 2 * Real.pi)) s :=
      (hg.differentiableAt (hD_open.mem_nhds hs_per)).hasDerivAt.comp_add_const s (2 * Real.pi)
    have hev : (fun w => g (w + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds s] g := by
      filter_upwards [hD_open.mem_nhds hs] with w hw
      exact hper w hw
    rw [← hd1.deriv, hev.deriv_eq]
  have hf1_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv K.f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv K.f s :=
    h_per_deriv K.f hf0_holo K.f_periodic
  have hf2_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv (deriv K.f) (s + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (deriv K.f) s :=
    h_per_deriv (deriv K.f) hf1_holo hf1_per
  have hf3_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H,
      deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) (s + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) s :=
    h_per_deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) hf2_holo hf2_per
  have hq_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H, speedPotentialQ K (s + 2 * Real.pi) = speedPotentialQ K s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0 <;>
      simp [speedPotentialQ, K.f_periodic s hs, hf1_per s hs, hf2_per s hs, hf3_per s hs, hfs]
  have h_conj_deriv : ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ g D_H →
      (∀ z ∈ D_H, g (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (g z)) →
      ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv g (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv g s) := by
    intro g hg hconj s hs
    have hs_conj : starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ D_H := hD_conj s hs
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) ∘ g ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ))
        (starRingEnd ℂ (deriv g s)) (starRingEnd ℂ s) :=
      (hg.differentiableAt (hD_open.mem_nhds hs)).hasDerivAt.conj_conj
    have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds (starRingEnd ℂ s)] (⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) ∘ g ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hD_open.mem_nhds hs_conj] with w hw
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hconj w hw, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    exact (hd1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).deriv
  have hf1_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv K.f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv K.f s) :=
    h_conj_deriv K.f hf0_holo K.f_conj
  have hf2_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H,
      deriv (deriv K.f) (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv (deriv K.f) s) :=
    h_conj_deriv (deriv K.f) hf1_holo hf1_conj
  have hf3_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H,
      deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) (starRingEnd ℂ s) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) s) :=
    h_conj_deriv (deriv (deriv K.f)) hf2_holo hf2_conj
  have hq_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H,
      speedPotentialQ K (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (speedPotentialQ K s) := by
    intro s hs
    have hfc : K.f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = 0 ↔ K.f s = 0 := by
      rw [K.f_conj s hs, map_eq_zero]
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0
    · have hfs_c : K.f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = 0 := hfc.mpr hfs
      simp [speedPotentialQ, hfs, hfs_c, hf1_conj s hs, hf3_conj s hs]
    · simp [speedPotentialQ, hfs, K.f_conj s hs, hf2_conj s hs]
  
  let H0_raw : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => K.Γ z 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ z) + K.Γ z 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ z)
  have hH0_raw_hasDeriv : ∀ s ∈ D_H, K.f s ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt H0_raw
        ((-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s) s := by
    intro s hs hfs
    have hΓ₀ : HasDerivAt (fun z => K.Γ z 0)
        (-(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)) s := by
      rw [← K.Γ_deriv₀ s hs hfs]
      exact (K.Γ_reg_holo s hs hfs).1.hasDerivAt
    have hΓ₁ : HasDerivAt (fun z => K.Γ z 1)
        ((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) s := by
      rw [← K.Γ_deriv₁ s hs hfs]
      exact (K.Γ_reg_holo s hs hfs).2.hasDerivAt
    have hϕ : HasDerivAt K.ϕ (K.f s) s := by
      rw [← K.deriv_ϕ s hs]
      exact (K.ϕ_holo.differentiableAt (hD_open.mem_nhds hs)).hasDerivAt
    have hcos : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.cos (K.ϕ z)) (-Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (K.ϕ s)).comp s hϕ
    have hsin : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.sin (K.ϕ z)) (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (K.ϕ s)).comp s hϕ
    convert (hΓ₀.mul hcos).add (hΓ₁.mul hsin) using 1
    ring
  have hH0_eq : ∀ s ∈ D_H, K.f s ≠ 0 →
      supportProfileH0 K s = K.Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) := by
    intro s hs hfs
    exact Filter.Tendsto.limUnder_eq
      (tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (hH0_raw_hasDeriv s hs hfs).continuousAt)
  have hH0_reg_hasDeriv : ∀ s ∈ D_H, K.f s ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt (supportProfileH0 K)
        ((-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s) s := by
    intro s hs hfs

      rw [smul_eq_mul, hF₁0, sub_zero] at h2

            = (C.c : ℂ) * ((w - s₀) * g₁ w)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
                ((g₁ w) ^ 2 * (α⁻¹ ^ 2 + (w - s₀) ^ 2 * h_u w)) := by
                field_simp [hsub_ne, hgw_ne, hf']
          _ = (C.c : ℂ) * (K.f w)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀) := by
                rw [← hf_fac w, ← hc]
          _ = -(-(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f w)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ w)) * Complex.sin ϕ₀ +
                (C.c : ℂ) * (K.f w)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ w) * Complex.cos ϕ₀ := by
                rw [Complex.cos_sub]; ring
      have hinv_d : HasDerivAt (fun z => ((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2) * (z - s₀)⁻¹)
          (((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2) * (-1 / (w - s₀) ^ 2)) w := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => (z - s₀)⁻¹) (-1 / (w - s₀) ^ 2) w :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id w).sub_const s₀).inv hsub_ne
        exact h1.const_mul ((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2)
      convert (hu_d.add hinv_d).sub (hUp w hwB) using 1
      ring
    let w_ref : ℂ := s₀ + ((ρ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hw_ref : w_ref ∈ B_punc := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have heq : w_ref - s₀ = ((ρ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by dsimp [w_ref]; ring
        rw [heq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · intro he
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at he
        dsimp [w_ref] at he
        have he2 : ((ρ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination he
        have he3 : ρ / 2 = 0 := Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp he2
        linarith
    let C_v : ℂ := v_norm w_ref - V_prim w_ref
    let C_u : ℂ := u_tan w_ref + ((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2) * (w_ref - s₀)⁻¹ - U_prim w_ref
    have hv_eq : ∀ w ∈ B_punc, v_norm w = V_prim w + C_v := by
      intro w hw
      have hc := IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hBp_open hBp_preconn
        (fun z hz => (hv_zero_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
        (fun z hz => (hv_zero_deriv z hz).deriv) hw hw_ref
      dsimp [C_v]
      linear_combination hc
    have hu_eq : ∀ w ∈ B_punc,
        u_tan w = -((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2) * (w - s₀)⁻¹ + U_prim w + C_u := by
      intro w hw
      have hc := IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hBp_open hBp_preconn
        (fun z hz => (hu_zero_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
        (fun z hz => (hu_zero_deriv z hz).deriv) hw hw_ref
      dsimp [C_u]
      linear_combination hc
    let F_hol : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      (V_prim w + C_v) * Complex.cos (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀) -
        ((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2) * (w - s₀) * ψ₁ w +
        (U_prim w + C_u) * (w - s₀) ^ 2 * ψ₁ w
    have hF_hol : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_hol B := by
      have hVp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_prim B :=
        fun w hw => (hVp w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hUp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_prim B :=
        fun w hw => (hUp w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hcos_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => Complex.cos (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀)) B :=
        Complex.differentiable_cos.differentiableOn.comp hδϕ_holo (Set.mapsTo_univ _ _)
      have hsub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => w - s₀) B :=
        differentiableOn_id.sub_const s₀
      exact (((hVp_holo.add_const C_v).mul hcos_holo).sub
        ((hsub_holo.const_mul ((C.c : ℂ) / α ^ 2)).mul hψ₁_holo)).add
        (((hUp_holo.add_const C_u).mul (hsub_holo.pow 2)).mul hψ₁_holo)
    have hraw_eq_F : ∀ w ∈ B_punc, H0_raw w = F_hol w := by
      intro w hw
      have hsub_ne : w - s₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hw.2
      have hϕ_split : K.ϕ w = ϕ₀ + (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀) := by ring
      have hframe : H0_raw w =
          v_norm w * Complex.cos (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀) + u_tan w * Complex.sin (K.ϕ w - ϕ₀) := by
        dsimp [H0_raw, v_norm, u_tan]
        conv_lhs => rw [hϕ_split, Complex.cos_add, Complex.sin_add]
        ring
      rw [hframe, hv_eq w hw, hu_eq w hw, hsin_fac w]
      dsimp [F_hol]
      field_simp [hsub_ne, hf']
      ring
    have hH0_eq_F : ∀ z ∈ B, supportProfileH0 K z = F_hol z := by
      intro z hzB
      have hBp_mem : B_punc ∈ nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ := by
        by_cases hz : z = s₀
        · subst hz
          exact Filter.inter_mem (nhdsWithin_le_nhds hB_nhds) self_mem_nhdsWithin
        · exact nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hBp_open.mem_nhds ⟨hzB, hz⟩)
      have hev : F_hol =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] H0_raw := by
        filter_upwards [hBp_mem] with w hw
        exact (hraw_eq_F w hw).symm
      have htend : Filter.Tendsto F_hol (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ) (nhds (F_hol z)) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds
          (hF_hol.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzB)).continuousAt
      exact Filter.Tendsto.limUnder_eq (htend.congr' hev)
    have hH0_ev : supportProfileH0 K =ᶠ[nhds s₀] F_hol := by
      filter_upwards [hB_nhds] with z hz
      exact hH0_eq_F z hz
    exact ⟨hH0_ev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr (hF_hol.differentiableAt hB_nhds),
      ρ, hρ, fun w hw hw_ne => ⟨hB_sub hw, by
        rw [hf_fac w]
        exact mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr hw_ne) (hg₁_ne w hw)⟩⟩
  
  have hH0_diffAt : ∀ s ∈ D_H, DifferentiableAt ℂ (supportProfileH0 K) s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0
    · exact (hH0_zero s hs hfs).1
    · exact (hH0_reg_hasDeriv s hs hfs).differentiableAt
  have hH0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (supportProfileH0 K) D_H :=
    fun s hs => (hH0_diffAt s hs).differentiableWithinAt
  have hH0_per : ∀ s ∈ D_H, supportProfileH0 K (s + 2 * Real.pi) = supportProfileH0 K s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ := (hH0_zero s hs hfs).2
      have hs_per : s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ D_H := hD_per s hs
      have hmem : Metric.ball s ρ \ {s} ∈ nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)))
          self_mem_nhdsWithin
      have hev : supportProfileH0 K =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ]
          fun w => supportProfileH0 K (w + 2 * Real.pi) := by
        filter_upwards [hmem] with w ⟨hwB, hw_ne⟩
        obtain ⟨hwD, hfw⟩ := hball w hwB hw_ne
        exact (hH0_reg_per w hwD hfw).symm
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (supportProfileH0 K)
          (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) (nhds (supportProfileH0 K s)) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (hH0_diffAt s hs).continuousAt
      have hshift_cont : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ => w + 2 * Real.pi) s :=
        continuousAt_id.add continuousAt_const
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => supportProfileH0 K (w + 2 * Real.pi))
          (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) (nhds (supportProfileH0 K (s + 2 * Real.pi))) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds
          ((hH0_diffAt (s + 2 * Real.pi) hs_per).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hshift_cont.tendsto)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht2 (ht1.congr' hev)
    · exact hH0_reg_per s hs hfs
  have hH0_conj : ∀ s ∈ D_H,
      supportProfileH0 K (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (supportProfileH0 K s) := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hfs : K.f s = 0
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ := (hH0_zero s hs hfs).2
      have hs_conj : starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ D_H := hD_conj s hs
      have hmem : Metric.ball s ρ \ {s} ∈ nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)))
          self_mem_nhdsWithin
      have hev : (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (supportProfileH0 K w)) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ]
          fun w => supportProfileH0 K (starRingEnd ℂ w) := by
        filter_upwards [hmem] with w ⟨hwB, hw_ne⟩
        obtain ⟨hwD, hfw⟩ := hball w hwB hw_ne
        exact (hH0_reg_conj w hwD hfw).symm
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => starRingEnd ℂ (supportProfileH0 K w))
          (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) (nhds (starRingEnd ℂ (supportProfileH0 K s))) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds
          (Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.comp (hH0_diffAt s hs).continuousAt)
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun w => supportProfileH0 K (starRingEnd ℂ w))
          (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) (nhds (supportProfileH0 K (starRingEnd ℂ s))) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds
          ((hH0_diffAt (starRingEnd ℂ s) hs_conj).continuousAt.comp
            Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht2 (ht1.congr' hev)
    · exact hH0_reg_conj s hs hfs
  exact ⟨hq_holo, hderiv2_f, hq_per, hq_conj, hH0_holo, hH0_per, hH0_conj, hH0_eq, hH0_deriv⟩

signature.name: real_collar_chord_geometry
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) :
    RealCollarChordProp C M K L

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x t ht0 htr
  
  have ht_r_init : t < K.r_init := by linarith [L.r_star_le, K.r_init_pos]
  have ht_r_base : t < M.r_base := by linarith [K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
  have ht_r₁ : t < C.r₁ := by linarith [M.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
  have hs₁_pos : 0 < C.s₁ := by linarith [C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
  have ht_abs : |t| = t := abs_of_pos ht0
  have ht_abs_r₁ : |t| < C.r₁ := by rwa [ht_abs]
  have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ = t := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, ht_abs]
  have ht_norm_init : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < K.r_init := by rwa [ht_norm]
  have ht_norm_base : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < M.r_base := by rwa [ht_norm]
  have ht_norm_r₁ : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < C.r₁ := by rwa [ht_norm]
  have ht_ball_base : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
    simpa using ht_norm_base
  let β : ℝ := (L.b_shift (t : ℂ)).re
  have hb_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (L.b_shift (t : ℂ)) = L.b_shift (t : ℂ) := by
    have h := L.b_shift_conj (t : ℂ) ht_ball_base
    rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hb_eq : L.b_shift (t : ℂ) = (β : ℂ) :=
    (Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp hb_conj).symm
  
  let v : ℝ → ℝ := fun w : ℝ => (C.U ((w : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re
  have hU_real : ∀ w : ℝ, C.U ((w : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = (v w : ℂ) := by
    intro w
    have hw_im : |(w : ℂ).im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by
      simp [Complex.ofReal_im]
      linarith
    have hc := C.U_conj (w : ℂ) (t : ℂ) hw_im ht_norm_r₁
    rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal] at hc
    exact (Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp hc.symm).symm
  have hv_quasi : ∀ w : ℝ, v (w + 2 * Real.pi) = v w + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro w
    have hw_im : |(w : ℂ).im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by
      simp [Complex.ofReal_im]
      linarith
    have hq := C.U_quasiperiodic (w : ℂ) (t : ℂ) hw_im ht_norm_r₁
    have hcast : (((w + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) =
        ((w : ℂ) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
    have h1 : (v (w + 2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) = ((v w + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← hU_real (w + 2 * Real.pi), hcast, hq, hU_real w]
      push_cast
      ring
    exact Complex.ofReal_inj.mp h1
  have hv_deriv_pos : ∀ w : ℝ, 0 < deriv v w :=
    fun w => C.U_real_deriv_pos w t ht_abs_r₁
  have hv_hasDeriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt v (deriv v w) w :=
    fun w => (differentiableAt_of_deriv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hv_deriv_pos w))).hasDerivAt
  
  have hglΘ_real : ∀ w : ℝ, glancingTheta C (w : ℂ) (t : ℂ) = (C.ϕ (v w) : ℂ) := by
    intro w
    unfold glancingTheta
    rw [hU_real w, C.ϕ_ℂ_real (v w)]
  have hΘ_real : ∀ r : ℝ, L.Θ_gl ((r : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = (C.ϕ (v (r - β)) : ℂ) := by
    intro r
    change glancingTheta C ((r : ℂ) - L.b_shift (t : ℂ)) (t : ℂ) = (C.ϕ (v (r - β)) : ℂ)
    have hsub : (r : ℂ) - L.b_shift (t : ℂ) = ((r - β : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hb_eq]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hsub, hglΘ_real (r - β)]
  have hp_add_half : ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ)) = (((x + t / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hp_sub_half : ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ)) = (((x - t / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hp_add_t : ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = (((x + t : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hp_per_half :
      ((x : ℂ) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ)) =
        (((x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    ext <;> push_cast <;> ring
  let u : ℝ := x - β
  let θ₀ : ℝ := C.ϕ (v (u - t / 2))
  let θ₁ : ℝ := C.ϕ (v (u + t / 2))
  let θ₂ : ℝ := C.ϕ (v (u + 3 * t / 2))
  have hΘ_sub_eq : L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ)) = (θ₀ : ℂ) := by
    rw [hp_sub_half, hΘ_real (x - t / 2)]
    have hr : x - t / 2 - β = u - t / 2 := by dsimp [u]; ring
    rw [hr]
  have hΘ_add_eq : L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ)) = (θ₁ : ℂ) := by
    rw [hp_add_half, hΘ_real (x + t / 2)]
    have hr : x + t / 2 - β = u + t / 2 := by dsimp [u]; ring
    rw [hr]
  have hConj1 : (L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).im = 0 := by
    rw [hΘ_add_eq, Complex.ofReal_im]
  have hΘ_add_re : (L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re = θ₁ := by
    rw [hΘ_add_eq, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hΘ_sub_re : (L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re = θ₀ := by
    rw [hΘ_sub_eq, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hConj6 :
      (L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re =
        (L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re + 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [hp_per_half, hΘ_real (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2), Complex.ofReal_re, hΘ_add_re]
    have hr : x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2 - β = (u + t / 2) + 2 * Real.pi := by dsimp [u]; ring
    rw [hr, hv_quasi (u + t / 2), C.ϕ_quasiperiodic (v (u + t / 2))]
  
  let σ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 ((x' : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re
  let e : ℂ → ℂ := fun z : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (z - (β : ℂ), (t : ℂ))
  have h𝔰_eq_init : ∀ x' : ℝ,
      L.𝔰 ((x' : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = K.𝔰_init (((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    intro x'
    change L.𝔰_raw ((x' : ℂ) - L.b_shift (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) =
      K.𝔰_init (((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ))
    have hsub : (x' : ℂ) - L.b_shift (t : ℂ) = ((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hb_eq]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hsub]
    have him : |((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ).im| < K.s_init := by
      simp [Complex.ofReal_im, K.s_init_pos]
    exact L.𝔰_raw_init_eq ((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ) (t : ℂ) him ht_norm_init
  have h𝔰_real : ∀ x' : ℝ, L.𝔰 ((x' : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = (σ x' : ℂ) := by
    intro x'
    have him : |((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ).im| < K.s_init := by
      simp [Complex.ofReal_im, K.s_init_pos]
    have hc := K.𝔰_init_conj ((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ) (t : ℂ) him ht_norm_init
    rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal] at hc
    have h1 : K.𝔰_init (((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) =
        ((K.𝔰_init (((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re : ℂ) :=
      (Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp hc.symm).symm
    have h2 : (K.𝔰_init (((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re = σ x' := by
      dsimp [σ]
      rw [h𝔰_eq_init x']
    rw [h𝔰_eq_init x', h1, h2]
  have hS_init_open : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init } :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hσ_hasDeriv : ∀ x' : ℝ, HasDerivAt σ (deriv σ x') x' := by
    intro x'
    have hp₀_mem : ((x' : ℂ) - (β : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) ∈
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init } := by
      have hsub : (x' : ℂ) - (β : ℂ) = ((x' - β : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      refine ⟨?_, ht_norm_init⟩
      rw [hsub]
      simp [Complex.ofReal_im, K.s_init_pos]
    have hdiff_init : DifferentiableAt ℂ K.𝔰_init ((x' : ℂ) - (β : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) :=
      K.𝔰_init_holo.differentiableAt (hS_init_open.mem_nhds hp₀_mem)
    have hdiff_map : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z - (β : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) (x' : ℂ) :=
      (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const (β : ℂ))).prodMk
        (differentiableAt_const (t : ℂ))
    have hdiff_e : DifferentiableAt ℂ e (x' : ℂ) :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp (x' : ℂ) hdiff_init hdiff_map
    have hd_re : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (e (r : ℂ)).re) (deriv e (x' : ℂ)).re x' :=
      hdiff_e.hasDerivAt.real_of_complex
    have he_eq_σ : (fun r : ℝ => (e (r : ℂ)).re) = σ := by
      funext r
      dsimp [e, σ]
      rw [h𝔰_eq_init r]
      have hsub : (r : ℂ) - (β : ℂ) = ((r - β : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hsub]
