          (Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hΓ_xt1, hΓ_x1, hΘ_add_re, ← Complex.ofReal_sub]
    change (d₁ : ℂ) = _
    rw [hd₁_eq]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ : ℝ => C.h θ * Real.sin (θ - θ₁) + deriv C.h θ * Real.cos (θ - θ₁)
  have hG_eq : ∀ θ : ℝ, G θ = -γ₀ θ * Real.sin θ₁ + γ₁ θ * Real.cos θ₁ := by
    intro θ
    dsimp [G, γ₀, γ₁]
    rw [Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_sub]
    ring
  have hℓ_G : realCollarChordLen L x t = G ψ₁ - G ψ₀ := by
    rw [hℓ_eq, hG_eq ψ₁, hG_eq ψ₀]
    dsimp [d₀, d₁]
    ring
  have hG_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt G ((C.h θ + deriv (deriv C.h) θ) * Real.cos (θ - θ₁)) θ := by
    intro θ
    have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r - θ₁) 1 θ := (hasDerivAt_id θ).sub_const θ₁
    have hsin := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (θ - θ₁)).comp θ hsub
    change HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Real.sin (r - θ₁)) (Real.cos (θ - θ₁) * 1) θ at hsin
    have hcos := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (θ - θ₁)).comp θ hsub
    change HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Real.cos (r - θ₁)) (-Real.sin (θ - θ₁) * 1) θ at hcos
    have hm1 := (hh_diff θ).hasDerivAt.mul hsin
    have hm2 := (hh'_diff θ).hasDerivAt.mul hcos
    have hsum := hm1.add hm2
    have hval : (deriv C.h θ * Real.sin (θ - θ₁) + C.h θ * (Real.cos (θ - θ₁) * 1)) +
        (deriv (deriv C.h) θ * Real.cos (θ - θ₁) + deriv C.h θ * (-Real.sin (θ - θ₁) * 1)) =
        (C.h θ + deriv (deriv C.h) θ) * Real.cos (θ - θ₁) := by ring
    rw [hval] at hsum
    exact hsum
  have hG_diff : Differentiable ℝ G := fun θ => (hG_deriv θ).differentiableAt
  have hG_mono : StrictMonoOn G (Set.Icc ψ₀ ψ₁) := by
    refine strictMonoOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_pos (convex_Icc ψ₀ ψ₁)
      hG_diff.continuous.continuousOn (fun θ _ => (hG_deriv θ).hasDerivWithinAt) ?_
    intro θ hθ
    rw [interior_Icc] at hθ
    have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos (θ - θ₁) :=
      Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [hψ₀_lower, hθ.1], by linarith [hψ₁_upper, hθ.2]⟩
    exact mul_pos (C.r_pos θ) hcos_pos
  have hConj9 : 0 < realCollarChordLen L x t := by
    have hlt : G ψ₀ < G ψ₁ :=
      hG_mono ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt hψ_lt⟩ ⟨le_of_lt hψ_lt, le_rfl⟩ hψ_lt
    linarith [hℓ_G]
  exact ⟨hConj1, hConj2, hConj3, hConj4, hConj5, hConj6,
    hConj7, hConj8, hConj9, hConj10, hConj11, hConj12⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K)
    (hQ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (speedPotentialQ K) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)))
    (hDeriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      deriv (deriv K.f) s = speedPotentialQ K s * K.f s)
    (hChord : RealCollarChordProp C M K L) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (firstImpactDisplacementV L) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      firstImpactDisplacementV L (s + 2 * Real.pi) = firstImpactDisplacementV L s) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      firstImpactDisplacementV L (starRingEnd ℂ s) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (firstImpactDisplacementV L s)) ∧
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), firstImpactDisplacementV L x) = 0 ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * firstImpactDisplacementV L y) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      deriv (firstImpactDisplacementV L) s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
        (K.f s ^ 2 + 8 * speedPotentialQ K s -
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K.f x ^ 2 + 8 * speedPotentialQ K x)))

proof.tactics:
by
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  let S_base : Set ℂ := horizStrip M.s_base
  let V : ℂ → ℂ := firstImpactDisplacementV L
  
  
  
  have hs_star_lt_base : L.s_star < M.s_base := by
    linarith [L.s_star_le, K.s_init_le, M.s_base_pos]
  have hr_star_lt_base : L.r_star < M.r_base := by
    linarith [L.r_star_le, K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
  have h0_ball_rbase : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
  have hhX0_ge : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ M.h_X 0 :=
    M.h_X_ge 0 h0_ball_rbase
  have hS_base_open : IsOpen S_base :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hS_base_sub_DH : S_base ⊆ D_H := by
    intro s hs
    have hlt : ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hs
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hhX0_ge
  have hreal_S_base : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ S_base := by
    intro x
    change |(x : ℂ).im| < M.s_base
    simpa using M.s_base_pos
  have hreal_DH : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ D_H :=
    fun x => hS_base_sub_DH (hreal_S_base x)
  have hDH_open_conv : IsOpen D_H ∧ Convex ℝ D_H := by
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLtTop
    · have hDH_univ : D_H = Set.univ := by
        ext s
        simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, hTop]
      rw [hDH_univ]
      exact ⟨isOpen_univ, convex_univ⟩
    · let H : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH_eq : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLtTop)).symm
      have hH_pos : 0 < H := by
        have hle : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H := hH_eq ▸ hhX0_ge
        by_contra hnp
        push_neg at hnp
        have h0 : ENNReal.ofReal H = 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr hnp
        rw [h0, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at hle
        linarith [M.s_base_pos]
      have hDH_eq : D_H = horizStrip H := by
        ext s
        change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H
        rw [hH_eq]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos
      rw [hDH_eq]
      refine ⟨isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const, ?_⟩
      intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ a b ha hb hab
      change |(a • s₁ + b • s₂).im| < H
      have him : (a • s₁ + b • s₂).im = a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him]
      by_cases ha0 : a = 0
      · subst ha0
        have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
        subst hb1
        simpa [horizStrip] using hs₂
      · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
        calc |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im|
            ≤ |a * s₁.im| + |b * s₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          _ < a * H + b * H :=
              add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs₁ ha_pos)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs₂.le hb)
          _ = (a + b) * H := by ring
          _ = H := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have hDH_open : IsOpen D_H := hDH_open_conv.1
  have hDH_pre : IsPreconnected D_H := hDH_open_conv.2.isPreconnected
  let W_cyl : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < L.s_star / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star }
  have hW_cyl_open : IsOpen W_cyl :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hW_cyl_sub : W_cyl ⊆ L.T_norm := by
    intro p ⟨hy_im, ht_norm⟩
    rw [L.T_norm_iff]
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
    have ht_rbase : ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base := lt_trans ht_norm hr_star_lt_base
    have hct_rbase : (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      simpa using ht_rbase
    have ht_ball_rbase : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      simpa using ht_rbase
    have hb_small : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < L.s_star / 4 :=
      L.b_shift_small p.2 (by simpa using ht_norm)
    have him_abs : |(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im| < M.s_base := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |(L.b_shift p.2).im| := by
        simpa [Complex.sub_im] using abs_sub p.1.im (L.b_shift p.2).im
      have h2 : |(L.b_shift p.2).im| ≤ ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      linarith [L.s_star_pos, hs_star_lt_base]
    refine ⟨ht_rbase, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hn : -(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im < M.s_base :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (neg_le_abs _) him_abs
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hn)
        (M.h_X_ge _ hct_rbase)
    · have hp1 : (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im < M.s_base :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) him_abs
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hp1)
        (M.h_X_ge _ ht_ball_rbase)
  
  have diffAt_pair : ∀ (a b y₀ t₀ z : ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (a * w + y₀, b * w + t₀)) z := by
    intro a b y₀ t₀ z
    let L_ab : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := fun w => (a * w, b * w)
            map_add' := fun u v => by ext <;> simp [mul_add]
            map_smul' := fun c u => by ext <;> simp [mul_left_comm] }
        cont := (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).prodMk
          (continuous_const.mul continuous_id) }
    have hlin : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => L_ab w + (y₀, t₀)) z :=
      L_ab.differentiableAt.add (differentiableAt_const (y₀, t₀))
    exact hlin
  
  
  
  have norm_le_of_bound_and_local_pow :
      ∀ (N : ℕ) {R M_b : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
        0 < R → 0 ≤ M_b →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖f z‖ ≤ M_b) →
        (∃ C_l δ_l : ℝ, 0 < δ_l ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_l → ‖f z‖ ≤ C_l * ‖z‖ ^ N) →
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖f z‖ ≤ (M_b / R ^ N) * ‖z‖ ^ N := by
    intro N
    induction N with
    | zero =>
      intro R M_b f _ _ _ hM _ z hz
      simpa using hM z hz
    | succ N ih =>
      intro R M_b f hR hM hf_diff hf_bnd ⟨C_l, δ_l, hδ, hloc⟩
      have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by
        have h0 : ‖f 0‖ ≤ C_l * ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ ^ (N + 1) := hloc 0 (by simpa using hδ)
        simp only [norm_zero, ne_eq, Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false,
          not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero] at h0
        exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp h0
      let g : ℂ → ℂ := dslope f 0
      have hball_nhds : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hR
      have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds).mpr hf_diff
      have hg_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g z‖ ≤ M_b / R := by
        intro z hz
        apply Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hf_diff _ hz
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hf0, sub_zero]
        exact hf_bnd w hw
      let C' : ℝ := max C_l 0
      let δ' : ℝ := min δ_l R
      have hδ' : 0 < δ' := lt_min hδ hR
      have hg_punc : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < δ' → ‖g z‖ ≤ C' * ‖z‖ ^ N := by
        intro z hz0 hzδ
        have hgz : g z = f z / z := by
          simp only [g, dslope_of_ne f hz0, slope, sub_zero, hf0, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        rw [hgz, norm_div]
        have hfz : ‖f z‖ ≤ C' * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
          calc ‖f z‖ ≤ C_l * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := hloc z (lt_of_lt_of_le hzδ (min_le_left _ _))
            _ ≤ C' * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _)
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0)]
        calc ‖f z‖ ≤ C' * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := hfz
          _ = C' * ‖z‖ ^ N * ‖z‖ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      have hg0 : ‖g 0‖ ≤ C' * ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ ^ N := by
        have hg_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => ‖g z‖) 0 :=
          (hg_diff.differentiableAt hball_nhds).continuousAt.norm
        have hrhs_cont : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => C' * ‖z‖ ^ N) 0 := by fun_prop
        have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, ‖g z‖ ≤ C' * ‖z‖ ^ N := by
          rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff]
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hδ'] with z hzball hz0
          exact hg_punc z (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hz0) (by simpa using hzball)
        exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hg_cont.continuousWithinAt
          hrhs_cont.continuousWithinAt hev
      have hg_loc : ∃ C₁ δ₁ : ℝ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₁ → ‖g z‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N := by
        refine ⟨C', δ', hδ', fun z hz => ?_⟩
        by_cases hz0 : z = 0
        · subst hz0; exact hg0
        · exact hg_punc z hz0 hz
      have hg_est := ih hR (div_nonneg hM hR.le) hg_diff hg_bnd hg_loc
      intro z hz
      have hfg : z * g z = f z := by
        have := sub_smul_dslope f 0 z
        simpa [g, hf0] using this
      calc ‖f z‖ = ‖z * g z‖ := by rw [hfg]
        _ = ‖z‖ * ‖g z‖ := norm_mul z (g z)
        _ ≤ ‖z‖ * ((M_b / R / R ^ N) * ‖z‖ ^ N) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg_est z hz) (norm_nonneg z)
        _ = (M_b / R ^ (N + 1)) * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
          rw [div_div, ← pow_succ']
          ring
  have even_dslope2 :
      ∀ {R : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
        0 < R →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
        g 0 = 0 →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, g (-z) = g z) →
        ∃ d₂ : ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ d₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, g z = z ^ 2 * d₂ z) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, d₂ (-z) = d₂ z) ∧
          deriv (deriv g) 0 = 2 * d₂ 0 ∧
          (∀ M_b : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_b → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g z‖ ≤ M_b) →
            ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖d₂ z‖ ≤ M_b / R ^ 2) := by
    intro R g hR hg_diff hg0 hg_even
    have hball_nhds : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hR
    let d₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope g 0
    let d₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope d₁ 0
    have hd₁_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds).mpr hg_diff
    have hd₂_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds).mpr hd₁_diff
    have hdg0 : deriv g 0 = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun z : ℂ => g (-z)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] g := by
        filter_upwards [hball_nhds] with z hz using hg_even z hz
      have h1 : deriv (fun z : ℂ => g (-z)) 0 = deriv g 0 := hev.deriv_eq
      rw [deriv_comp_neg, neg_zero] at h1
      linear_combination -h1 / 2
    have hd₁0 : d₁ 0 = 0 := by simpa [d₁, dslope_same] using hdg0
    have hfac1 : ∀ z : ℂ, z * d₁ z = g z := by
      intro z
      have := sub_smul_dslope g 0 z
      simpa [d₁, hg0] using this
    have hfac2 : ∀ z : ℂ, z * d₂ z = d₁ z := by
      intro z
      have := sub_smul_dslope d₁ 0 z
      simpa [d₂, hd₁0] using this
    have hfac : ∀ z : ℂ, g z = z ^ 2 * d₂ z := by
      intro z
      calc g z = z * d₁ z := (hfac1 z).symm
        _ = z * (z * d₂ z) := by rw [hfac2 z]
        _ = z ^ 2 * d₂ z := by ring
    have hd₂_even : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, d₂ (-z) = d₂ z := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases hz0 : z = 0
      · simp [hz0]
      · have hnz : -z ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr hz0
        have hd₁_odd : d₁ (-z) = -d₁ z := by
          simp only [d₁, dslope_of_ne g hnz, dslope_of_ne g hz0, slope, sub_zero, hg0,
            hg_even z hz, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        simp only [d₂, dslope_of_ne d₁ hnz, dslope_of_ne d₁ hz0, slope, sub_zero, hd₁0,
          hd₁_odd, vsub_eq_sub, smul_eq_mul]
        ring

    calc ‖(F₁ z - F₂ z) - (P₁ z - P₂ z)‖ = ‖(F₁ z - P₁ z) - (F₂ z - P₂ z)‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ + ‖F₂ z - P₂ z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N + C₂ * ‖z‖ ^ N :=
        add_le_add (hb₁ z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)))
          (hb₂ z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)))
      _ = (C₁ + C₂) * ‖z‖ ^ N := by ring
  have hJet_const_mul : ∀ {N : ℕ} (c : ℂ) {F P : ℂ → ℂ},
      HasJet N F P → HasJet N (fun z => c * F z) (fun z => c * P z) := by
    intro N c F P ⟨C_j, δ_j, hδ, hC, hb⟩
    refine ⟨‖c‖ * C_j, δ_j, hδ, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) hC, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    calc ‖c * F z - c * P z‖ = ‖c‖ * ‖F z - P z‖ := by rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖c‖ * (C_j * ‖z‖ ^ N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb z hz) (norm_nonneg c)
      _ = (‖c‖ * C_j) * ‖z‖ ^ N := by ring
  have hJet_poly_mod : ∀ {N : ℕ} {F P₁ P₂ : ℂ → ℂ} (Q : ℂ → ℂ),
      Continuous Q → (∀ z : ℂ, P₁ z - P₂ z = z ^ N * Q z) →
      HasJet N F P₁ → HasJet N F P₂ := by
    intro N F P₁ P₂ Q hQ hmod h1
    apply hJet_trans h1
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hQ.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max B 0, 1, zero_lt_one, le_max_right _ _, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzm : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by simpa using hz.le)
    rw [hmod z, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    calc ‖z‖ ^ N * ‖Q z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ N * max B 0 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans (hB z hzm) (le_max_left _ _))
          (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _)
      _ = max B 0 * ‖z‖ ^ N := mul_comm _ _
  have hJet_mul : ∀ {N : ℕ} {F₁ P₁ F₂ P₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      Continuous P₁ → Continuous P₂ →
      HasJet N F₁ P₁ → HasJet N F₂ P₂ →
      HasJet N (fun z => F₁ z * F₂ z) (fun z => P₁ z * P₂ z) := by
    intro N F₁ P₁ F₂ P₂ hP₁ hP₂ ⟨C₁, δ₁, hδ₁, hC₁, hb₁⟩ ⟨C₂, δ₂, hδ₂, hC₂, hb₂⟩
    obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hP₁.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hP₂.continuousOn
    let M₁ := max B₁ 0 + C₁
    let M₂ := max B₂ 0
    have hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁ := add_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hC₁
    have hM₂ : 0 ≤ M₂ := le_max_right _ _
    refine ⟨M₁ * C₂ + C₁ * M₂, min (min δ₁ δ₂) 1, lt_min (lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂) zero_lt_one,
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM₁ hC₂) (mul_nonneg hC₁ hM₂), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz1 : ‖z‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
    have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by simpa using hz1.le)
    have hzδ₁ : ‖z‖ < δ₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hzδ₂ : ‖z‖ < δ₂ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hF₁_bnd : ‖F₁ z‖ ≤ M₁ := by
      have hp : C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N ≤ C₁ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz1.le) hC₁
      have hP1b : ‖P₁ z‖ ≤ max B₁ 0 := le_trans (hB₁ z hzc) (le_max_left _ _)
      have hFb := hb₁ z hzδ₁
      have htri : ‖F₁ z‖ ≤ ‖P₁ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ := by
        calc ‖F₁ z‖ = ‖P₁ z + (F₁ z - P₁ z)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖P₁ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      dsimp [M₁]; linarith
    have hP₂_bnd : ‖P₂ z‖ ≤ M₂ := le_trans (hB₂ z hzc) (le_max_left _ _)
    calc ‖F₁ z * F₂ z - P₁ z * P₂ z‖
        = ‖F₁ z * (F₂ z - P₂ z) + (F₁ z - P₁ z) * P₂ z‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖F₁ z * (F₂ z - P₂ z)‖ + ‖(F₁ z - P₁ z) * P₂ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖F₁ z‖ * ‖F₂ z - P₂ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ * ‖P₂ z‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ M₁ * (C₂ * ‖z‖ ^ N) + (C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N) * M₂ :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul hF₁_bnd (hb₂ z hzδ₂) (norm_nonneg _) hM₁)
          (mul_le_mul (hb₁ z hzδ₁) hP₂_bnd (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hC₁ (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _)))
      _ = (M₁ * C₂ + C₁ * M₂) * ‖z‖ ^ N := by ring
  have hJet_mul_vanish : ∀ {N : ℕ} {F₁ P₁ F₂ P₂ : ℂ → ℂ} (Q₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      Continuous P₁ → Continuous Q₂ → (∀ z : ℂ, P₂ z = z * Q₂ z) →
      HasJet N F₁ P₁ → HasJet (N + 1) F₂ P₂ →
      HasJet (N + 1) (fun z => F₁ z * F₂ z) (fun z => P₁ z * P₂ z) := by
    intro N F₁ P₁ F₂ P₂ Q₂ hP₁ hQ₂ hP₂_eq ⟨C₁, δ₁, hδ₁, hC₁, hb₁⟩ ⟨C₂, δ₂, hδ₂, hC₂, hb₂⟩
    obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hP₁.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hQ₂.continuousOn
    let M₁ := max B₁ 0 + C₁
    let M₂ := max B₂ 0
    have hM₁ : 0 ≤ M₁ := add_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hC₁
    refine ⟨M₁ * C₂ + C₁ * M₂, min (min δ₁ δ₂) 1, lt_min (lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂) zero_lt_one,
      add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM₁ hC₂) (mul_nonneg hC₁ (le_max_right _ _)), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hz1 : ‖z‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
    have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by simpa using hz1.le)
    have hzδ₁ : ‖z‖ < δ₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hzδ₂ : ‖z‖ < δ₂ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hF₁_bnd : ‖F₁ z‖ ≤ M₁ := by
      have hp : C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N ≤ C₁ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz1.le) hC₁
      have hP1b : ‖P₁ z‖ ≤ max B₁ 0 := le_trans (hB₁ z hzc) (le_max_left _ _)
      have hFb := hb₁ z hzδ₁
      have htri : ‖F₁ z‖ ≤ ‖P₁ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ := by
        calc ‖F₁ z‖ = ‖P₁ z + (F₁ z - P₁ z)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖P₁ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      dsimp [M₁]; linarith
    have hQ₂_bnd : ‖Q₂ z‖ ≤ M₂ := le_trans (hB₂ z hzc) (le_max_left _ _)
    calc ‖F₁ z * F₂ z - P₁ z * P₂ z‖
        = ‖F₁ z * (F₂ z - P₂ z) + (F₁ z - P₁ z) * (z * Q₂ z)‖ := by rw [← hP₂_eq z]; ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖F₁ z * (F₂ z - P₂ z)‖ + ‖(F₁ z - P₁ z) * (z * Q₂ z)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖F₁ z‖ * ‖F₂ z - P₂ z‖ + ‖F₁ z - P₁ z‖ * ‖z‖ * ‖Q₂ z‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ M₁ * (C₂ * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1)) + (C₁ * ‖z‖ ^ N) * ‖z‖ * M₂ := by
        refine add_le_add (mul_le_mul hF₁_bnd (hb₂ z hzδ₂) (norm_nonneg _) hM₁) ?_
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb₁ z hzδ₁) (norm_nonneg z)) hQ₂_bnd
          (norm_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₁ (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _)) (norm_nonneg z))
      _ = (M₁ * C₂ + C₁ * M₂) * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  have hJet_comp_vanish : ∀ {N : ℕ} {G P_G u : ℂ → ℂ},
      HasJet N G P_G → HasJet 1 u (fun _ => 0) →
      HasJet N (fun z => G (u z)) (fun z => P_G (u z)) := by
    intro N G P_G u ⟨C_G, δ_G, hδ_G, hC_G, hb_G⟩ ⟨K_u, δ_u, hδ_u, hK_u, hb_u⟩
    have hK1 : 0 < K_u + 1 := by linarith
    refine ⟨C_G * K_u ^ N, min δ_u (δ_G / (K_u + 1)), lt_min hδ_u (div_pos hδ_G hK1),
      mul_nonneg hC_G (pow_nonneg hK_u N), fun z hz => ?_⟩

      simpa using hb_u z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _))
    have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < δ_G / (K_u + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
    have hu_lt : ‖u z‖ < δ_G := by
      calc ‖u z‖ ≤ K_u * ‖z‖ := hzu
        _ ≤ (K_u + 1) * ‖z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg z)
        _ < (K_u + 1) * (δ_G / (K_u + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz_lt hK1
        _ = δ_G := mul_div_cancel₀ δ_G (ne_of_gt hK1)
    calc ‖G (u z) - P_G (u z)‖ ≤ C_G * ‖u z‖ ^ N := hb_G (u z) hu_lt
      _ ≤ C_G * (K_u * ‖z‖) ^ N :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hzu N) hC_G
      _ = (C_G * K_u ^ N) * ‖z‖ ^ N := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
  have hJet_antideriv : ∀ {N : ℕ} {F P F' P' : ℂ → ℂ} {δ₀ : ℝ},
      0 < δ₀ → F 0 = P 0 →
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀, HasDerivAt F (F' w) w) →
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀, HasDerivAt P (P' w) w) →
      HasJet N F' P' → HasJet (N + 1) F P := by
    intro N F P F' P' δ₀ hδ₀ h0 hF' hP' ⟨C_j, δ_j, hδ, hC, hb⟩
    refine ⟨C_j, min δ₀ δ_j, lt_min hδ₀ hδ, hC, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hzδ₀ : ‖z‖ < δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)
    have hzδ : ‖z‖ < δ_j := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
    let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => F w - P w
    let D' : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => F' w - P' w
    have hseg_norm : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z, ‖w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      intro w hw
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ‖z‖ := by simp
      have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ‖z‖ := by simp
      have hw_mem := (convex_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ‖z‖).segment_subset h0_mem hz_mem hw
      simpa using hw_mem
    have hD_deriv : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z,
        HasDerivWithinAt D (D' w) (segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw0 : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ := by
        simpa using lt_of_le_of_lt (hseg_norm w hw) hzδ₀
      exact ((hF' w hw0).sub (hP' w hw0)).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hD'_bnd : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z, ‖D' w‖ ≤ C_j * ‖z‖ ^ N := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_le := hseg_norm w hw
      calc ‖D' w‖ ≤ C_j * ‖w‖ ^ N := hb w (lt_of_le_of_lt hw_le hzδ)
        _ ≤ C_j * ‖z‖ ^ N :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw_le N) hC
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      hD_deriv hD'_bnd (convex_segment (0 : ℂ) z)
      (left_mem_segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z) (right_mem_segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) z)
    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr h0
    have hmvt' : ‖F z - P z‖ ≤ C_j * ‖z‖ ^ N * ‖z‖ := by simpa [D, hD0] using hmvt
    calc ‖F z - P z‖ ≤ C_j * ‖z‖ ^ N * ‖z‖ := hmvt'
      _ = C_j * ‖z‖ ^ (N + 1) := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
  have hJet_mul_deg3 : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : ℂ → ℂ} (a₀ a₁ a₂ a₃ b₀ b₁ b₂ b₃ : ℂ),

  have hinv_geom : HasJet 4 (fun w : ℂ => (1 + w)⁻¹) (fun w => 1 - w + w ^ 2 - w ^ 3) := by

          (fun t => (K.f (s₀ t) * deriv W_pot (s₀ t) / 480) *
            ((h_p t / t) ^ 4 + (h_m t / t) ^ 4)) F₀
          (nhds ((K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv W_pot (x : ℂ) / 480) * ((1 : ℂ) ^ 4 + (-1 : ℂ) ^ 4))) :=
        ((hf_s0_lim.mul hdW_s0_lim).div_const 480).mul ((hlim_p.pow 4).add (hlim_m.pow 4))
      have hcomb := (hlin_term.add hcub_term).add hquart_term
      have hrew_lim : -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ) + 0 +
          (K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv W_pot (x : ℂ) / 480) * ((1 : ℂ) ^ 4 + (-1 : ℂ) ^ 4) =
          -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ) +
          K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv W_pot (x : ℂ) / 240 := by ring
      rw [hrew_lim] at hcomb
      refine hcomb.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hev_t_ne] with t hne
      dsimp [chordPoly]
      field_simp [hne]
      ring
    have hfull_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => R_x t / t ^ 6) F₀
        (nhds (((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2) * (-((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2)) *
          (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) * K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ) +
            K.f (x : ℂ) * deriv W_pot (x : ℂ) / 240) + 0)) := by
      have h1 := ((hTp_lim.mul hTm_lim).mul hP_sum_lim).add hrem_lim
      refine h1.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hev_t_ne] with t hne
      dsimp [R_x, E_p, E_m]
      field_simp [hne]
      ring
    have hzero_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => R_x t / t ^ 6) F₀ (nhds 0) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hev_r₀] with t ht
      simp [hRx_zero t ht]
    have heq0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hfull_lim hzero_lim
    have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt C.c_pos)
    have hfac_ne : ((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2) *
        (-((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2)) * K.f (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      have hinv_ne : (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hfx_ne
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 hinv_ne))
        (neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 hinv_ne)))) hfx_ne
    have hprod0 : (((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2) *
        (-((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f (x : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2)) * K.f (x : ℂ)) *
        (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ) + deriv W_pot (x : ℂ) / 240) = 0 := by
      linear_combination heq0
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod0 with hbad | hgood
    · exact absurd hbad hfac_ne
    · linear_combination -2 * hgood
  
  have hV_deriv : ∀ s ∈ D_H, deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (K.f s ^ 2 + 8 * speedPotentialQ K s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K.f x ^ 2 + 8 * speedPotentialQ K x)) := by
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv V z - (1 / 120 : ℂ) * W_pot z
    have hdV_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv V) D_H := hV_holo.deriv hDH_open
    have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G D_H := hdV_holo.sub (hW_holo.const_mul (1 / 120 : ℂ))
    have hdG_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (deriv G) D_H :=
      (hG_holo.deriv hDH_open).analyticOnNhd hDH_open
    have hdG_real : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv G (x : ℂ) = 0 := by
      intro x
      have hx_nhds : D_H ∈ nhds (x : ℂ) := hDH_open.mem_nhds (hreal_DH x)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (deriv V) (deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) :=
        (hdV_holo.differentiableAt hx_nhds).hasDerivAt
      have h2 : HasDerivAt W_pot (deriv W_pot (x : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) :=
        (hW_holo.differentiableAt hx_nhds).hasDerivAt
      have hG_at : HasDerivAt G
          (deriv (deriv V) (x : ℂ) - (1 / 120 : ℂ) * deriv W_pot (x : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) :=
        h1.sub (h2.const_mul (1 / 120 : ℂ))
      rw [hG_at.deriv, hreal_d2 x, sub_self]
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, deriv G z = 0 := by
      have hseq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_⟩
        · have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
          have h0c := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h0
          simpa [Function.comp_def] using h0c
        · rw [Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero]
          positivity
      exact hseq.frequently ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n : ℕ =>
        hdG_real (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))).frequently)
    have h0_DH : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_H := by simpa using hreal_DH 0
    have hdG_zero : Set.EqOn (deriv G) 0 D_H :=
      hdG_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero hDH_pre h0_DH hfreq
    have hG_const : ∀ z ∈ D_H, G z = G 0 :=
      fun z hz => hDH_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hDH_pre hG_holo hdG_zero hz h0_DH
    have hdV_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => deriv V (x : ℂ)) :=
      hdV_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal hreal_DH
    have hW_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => W_pot (x : ℂ)) :=
      hW_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal hreal_DH
    have hint_dV : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), deriv V (x : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      have hderiv_V : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => V (t : ℂ)) (deriv V (x : ℂ)) x := by
        intro x _
        have hx_nhds : D_H ∈ nhds (x : ℂ) := hDH_open.mem_nhds (hreal_DH x)
        exact ((hV_holo.differentiableAt hx_nhds).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv_V
        (hdV_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))]
      have hcast : ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = (0 : ℂ) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_zero, hV_per 0 h0_DH, sub_self]
    have hint_G : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (x : ℂ)) = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * G 0 := by
      have hcongr : ∀ x : ℝ, G (x : ℂ) = G 0 := fun x => hG_const (x : ℂ) (hreal_DH x)
      simp_rw [hcongr]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp [Complex.real_smul]
    have hint_G2 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (x : ℂ)) =
        -(1 / 120 : ℂ) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), W_pot (x : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [G]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hdV_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          ((hW_cont.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hint_dV, zero_sub]
      ring
    have h2pi_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)
    have hG0_eq : G 0 = -(1 / 120 : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), W_pot (x : ℂ)) := by
      have hlin : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * G 0 =
          -(1 / 120 : ℂ) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), W_pot (x : ℂ) :=
        hint_G.symm.trans hint_G2
      calc G 0 = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))⁻¹ * ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * G 0) := by
            field_simp [h2pi_ne]
        _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))⁻¹ * (-(1 / 120 : ℂ) *
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), W_pot (x : ℂ)) := by rw [hlin]
        _ = -(1 / 120 : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), W_pot (x : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
    intro s hs
    have hGs := hG_const s hs
    rw [hG0_eq] at hGs
    dsimp [G, W_pot] at hGs
    linear_combination hGs
  exact ⟨hV_holo, hV_per, hV_conj, hV_mean, h𝔰_d1, h𝔰_d2, hV_deriv⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_param_cont : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ))) (F : ℝ → ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ)) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W := by
    intro a b W F hF
    let π : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => max (min a b) (min (max a b) τ)
    have hπ_cont : Continuous π :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
    have hπ_mem : ∀ τ : ℝ, π τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b := by
      intro τ
      show min a b ≤ π τ ∧ π τ ≤ max a b
      exact ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le min_le_max (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hπ_eq : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, π τ = τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hτ' : min a b ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ max a b := hτ
      dsimp [π]
      rw [min_eq_right hτ'.2, max_eq_right hτ'.1]
    let g : ↥W → ℝ → ℂ := fun w τ => F (π τ) w.1
    have hg_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry g) := by
      refine hF.comp_continuous
        ((hπ_cont.comp continuous_snd).prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)) ?_
      intro x
      exact ⟨hπ_mem x.2, x.1.2⟩
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun w : ↥W => ∫ τ in a..b, F (π τ) w.1) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hg_cont a b
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    convert h_int_cont using 1
    ext w
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun τ hτ => by rw [hπ_eq τ hτ])).symm

  
  have h_param_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W := by
    intro a b W F hW hCont hHolo p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 3
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have h2r_lt : 2 * r < ε := by dsimp only [r]; linarith
    have h2r_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball h2r_lt).trans hε_sub
    have hK_compact : IsCompact (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r)) :=
      isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * r))
    have hK_sub : Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W :=
      Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl h2r_sub
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hCont.mono hK_sub)
    let M : ℝ := max C₀ 0
    have hM_bound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r), ‖F τ q‖ ≤ M := by
      intro τ hτ q hq
      exact (hC₀ (τ, q) ⟨hτ, hq⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    let s : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r
    have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr
    have hs_2r : ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := by
      intro p hp q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have hp' : dist p p₀ < r := hp
      have hq' : dist q p < r := hq
      linarith [dist_triangle q p p₀]
    have hs_sub : s ⊆ W := fun p hp =>
      h2r_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hp])))
    have h_slice_cont : ∀ p ∈ W, ContinuousOn (fun τ : ℝ => F τ p) (Set.uIcc a b) := fun p hp =>
      hCont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun τ hτ => ⟨hτ, hp⟩)
    let μ₀ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)
    have hμ_le : μ₀ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIcc a b) :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc le_rfl
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => F τ p) μ₀ := by
      filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
      exact ((h_slice_cont p (hs_sub hp)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIcc).mono_measure hμ_le
    have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ => F τ p₀) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀).intervalIntegrable
    let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * (r / 2)
    let h : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((δ n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hδ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < δ n := fun n => by positivity
    have hδ_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, δ n < r := by
      intro n
      have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
      have h1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hn (by positivity)
      dsimp only [δ]
      nlinarith
    have hh_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, h n ≠ 0 := fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hδ_pos n).ne'
    have hh_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖h n‖ < r := by
      intro n
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hδ_pos n).le]
      exact hδ_lt n
    let e₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
    let e₂ : ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))
    have hp1_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, p₀ + h n • e₁ ∈ W := by
      intro n
      apply hs_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Prod.norm_def]
      simp [e₁, hh_norm n]
    have hp2_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, p₀ + h n • e₂ ∈ W := by
      intro n
      apply hs_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Prod.norm_def]
      simp [e₂, hh_norm n]
    have hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (hh_ne n))⟩
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
        simpa [δ] using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.mul_const (r / 2)
      simpa [h, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h0
    let g_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun n τ =>
      ((h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₁) - F τ p₀)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
      ((h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₂) - F τ p₀)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
    have hg_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (g_seq n) μ₀ := by
      intro n
      have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun τ => (h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₁) - F τ p₀)) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (continuousOn_const (c := (h n)⁻¹)).smul ((h_slice_cont _ (hp1_mem n)).sub (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀))
      have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun τ => (h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₂) - F τ p₀)) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (continuousOn_const (c := (h n)⁻¹)).smul ((h_slice_cont _ (hp2_mem n)).sub (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀))
      have hcg : ContinuousOn (g_seq n) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (hc1.smul (continuousOn_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ))).add
          (hc2.smul (continuousOn_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)))
      exact (hcg.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIcc).mono_measure hμ_le
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) μ₀ := by
      refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hg_meas ?_
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with τ hτ_ioc
      have hτ : τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ_ioc
      have hFD : HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) p₀ :=
        ((hHolo τ hτ).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp₀)).hasFDerivAt
      have ht1 := (hasLineDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp (hFD.hasLineDerivAt e₁)).comp hh_tendsto
      have ht2 := (hasLineDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp (hFD.hasLineDerivAt e₂)).comp hh_tendsto
      have ht_sum : Filter.Tendsto (g_seq · τ) Filter.atTop
          (nhds ((fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₁) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
            (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₂) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)) :=
        (ht1.smul_const _).add (ht2.smul_const _)
      have hL_eq : (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₁) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
          (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₂) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ = fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ?_)
        have hv : ((v₁, v₂) : ℂ × ℂ) = v₁ • e₁ + v₂ • e₂ := by ext <;> simp [e₁, e₂]
        conv_rhs => rw [hv, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_add, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_smul,
          (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_smul]
        simp [mul_comm]
      rwa [hL_eq] at ht_sum
    have h_fderiv_bound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r := by
      intro τ hτ p hp
      have hball_sub : Metric.ball p r ⊆ W := fun q hq => h2r_sub (hs_2r p hp q hq)
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (F τ) (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.closedBall (F τ p) (2 * M)) := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have hq2r : q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := hs_2r p hp q hq
        have hp2r : p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := hs_2r p hp p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
        calc ‖F τ q - F τ p‖ ≤ ‖F τ q‖ + ‖F τ p‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add (hM_bound τ hτ q hq2r) (hM_bound τ hτ p hp2r)
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      exact Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball ((hHolo τ hτ).mono hball_sub) hmaps hr
    have h_ae_bound : ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ hτ p hp => h_fderiv_bound τ (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ) p hp)
    have h_ae_diff : ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p) p :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ hτ p hp =>
        ((hHolo τ (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hs_sub hp))).hasFDerivAt)
    have hIntFD := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (F := fun p τ => F τ p) (F' := fun p τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p)
      (bound := fun _ => 2 * M / r)
      hs_nhds hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas h_ae_bound intervalIntegrable_const h_ae_diff
    exact hIntFD.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  
  have h_partial_y : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W := by
    intro W U hW hU p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 2
    have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hε
    let R_c : ℝ := (3 / 2 : ℝ) * r
    have hRc : 0 < R_c := by positivity
    let B₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀.1 r ×ˢ Metric.ball p₀.2 r
    have hB₀_open : IsOpen B₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hp₀_B₀ : p₀ ∈ B₀ := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩
    have h_in_W : ∀ z t : ℂ, dist z p₀.1 ≤ R_c → dist t p₀.2 < r → (z, t) ∈ W := by
      intro z t hz ht
      apply hε_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      dsimp only [r, R_c] at hz ht ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun θ p =>
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
        (deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) θ *
          (((circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹ * U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ, p.2)))
    have h_cm_dist : ∀ θ : ℝ, dist (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ) p₀.1 = R_c := by
      intro θ
      rw [dist_eq_norm, circleMap_sub_center]
      simp [circleMap, abs_of_pos hRc]
    have h_sub_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ B₀, (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro θ p hp
      apply pow_ne_zero 2
      rw [sub_ne_zero]
      intro h_eq
      have hd1 : dist (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ) p₀.1 = R_c := h_cm_dist θ
      have hd2 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r := hp.1
      rw [h_eq] at hd1
      dsimp only [R_c] at hd1
      linarith
    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) := by
      have hc_deriv : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) q.1) := by
        rw [show (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) q.1) =
            fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap 0 R_c q.1 * Complex.I by
          ext q; exact deriv_circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1]
        exact ((continuous_circleMap 0 R_c).comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_const
      have hc_cm : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1) :=
        (continuous_circleMap p₀.1 R_c).comp continuous_fst
      have hc_U : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1, q.2.2))
          (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) := by
        refine hU.continuousOn.comp (hc_cm.prodMk (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)).continuousOn ?_
        intro q hq
        exact h_in_W _ _ (h_cm_dist q.1).le hq.2.2
      have hc_inv : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ((circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1 - q.2.1) ^ 2)⁻¹)
          (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
        ContinuousOn.inv₀
          (((hc_cm.sub (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).pow 2).continuousOn)
          (fun q hq => h_sub_ne q.1 q.2 hq.2)
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (hc_deriv.continuousOn.mul (hc_inv.mul hc_U))
    have hF_holo : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), DifferentiableOn ℂ (F θ) B₀ := by
      intro θ _
      have hd_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹) B₀ :=
        DifferentiableOn.inv
          (((differentiableOn_const (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ)).sub differentiable_fst.differentiableOn).pow 2)
          (fun p hp => h_sub_ne θ p hp)
      have hd_U : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ, p.2)) B₀ :=
        hU.comp ((differentiable_const (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ)).prodMk differentiable_snd).differentiableOn
          (fun p hp => h_in_W _ _ (h_cm_dist θ).le hp.2)
      exact (differentiableOn_const _).mul ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hd_inv.mul hd_U))
    have hInt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F θ p) B₀ :=
      h_param_holo 0 (2 * Real.pi) B₀ F hB₀_open hF_cont hF_holo
    have h_eq_on_B₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) B₀ := by
      refine hInt_holo.congr ?_
      intro p hp
      have hp1_Rc : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball p₀.1 R_c := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        have hd2 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r := hp.1
        dsimp only [R_c]
        linarith
      have hCauchy := (Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
        (hW.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
        (fun z hz => h_in_W z p.2 hz hp.2)
        (hU.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const p.2)).differentiableOn (fun _ hy' => hy'))
        hp1_Rc).symm
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] at hCauchy
      rw [hCauchy, circleIntegral_def_Icc, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      simp [F, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact (h_eq_on_B₀.differentiableAt (hB₀_open.mem_nhds hp₀_B₀)).differentiableWithinAt

  have h_partial_t : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →

  have h_sinc_bound : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → ‖sinc_ℂ z - 1‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    have hexp_half : Real.exp (1 / 2) ≤ 7 / 4 := by
      have hsq : Real.exp (1 / 2) * Real.exp (1 / 2) = Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      have he1 : Real.exp 1 < 49 / 16 :=
        lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num)

    have hcos_half : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2), ‖Complex.cos ζ‖ ≤ 11 / 8 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have him_abs : |ζ.im| ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        (Complex.abs_im_le_norm ζ).trans (by simpa using hζ)
      have him_bounds : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ ζ.im ∧ ζ.im ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mp him_abs
      have hexp_sum : Real.exp (-ζ.im) + Real.exp ζ.im ≤ 11 / 4 := by

          linarith
        · have h1 : Real.exp ζ.im ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr hnonpos
          have h2 : Real.exp (-ζ.im) ≤ 7 / 4 :=
            (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)).trans hexp_half
          linarith
      rw [Complex.cos]

            rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]

    have hcos_sub_one : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ≤ 1 → ‖Complex.cos w - 1‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
      intro w hw
      have hw2_mem : w / 2 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
        linarith
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2) :=
        Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity)

        have hmv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (f := Complex.sin) (C := 11 / 8) (s := Metric.closedBall 0 (1 / 2))
          (fun ζ _ => Complex.differentiable_sin ζ)

          (convex_closedBall 0 (1 / 2)) h0_mem hw2_mem
        simp only [Complex.sin_zero, sub_zero, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat] at hmv
        linarith

        have h2 : w = 2 * (w / 2) := by ring
        have hcs : Complex.cos (w / 2) ^ 2 = 1 - Complex.sin (w / 2) ^ 2 :=

        rw [h2, Complex.cos_two_mul, hcs]
        ring

      have hsin_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖Complex.sin (w / 2)‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hw_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    intro z hz
    have hint_cos : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=

          have hτ_bounds : 0 < τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] using hτ

  have h_diffOp_holo : ∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

        ((differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const (μ : ℂ)).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
