      have hmul : |μ| * |t.im| ≤ (1 / 2) * |t.im| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hμ_abs (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have hderiv_μ : ∀ μ ∈ Set.uIcc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => u (y + (s : ℂ) * t)) (deriv u (y + (μ : ℂ) * t) * t) μ := by
      intro μ hμ
      have hu_at : HasDerivAt u (deriv u (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t) :=
        (hu.differentiableAt ((hStrip_open σ).mem_nhds (h_mem_strip μ hμ))).hasDerivAt
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => y + ζ * t) t (μ : ℂ) := by
        simpa only [id_eq, one_mul] using ((hasDerivAt_id (μ : ℂ)).mul_const t).const_add y
      exact (hu_at.comp (μ : ℂ) hlin).comp_ofReal
    have hdu_cont : ContinuousOn (fun μ : ℝ => deriv u (y + (μ : ℂ) * t) * t)
        (Set.uIcc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun μ : ℝ => deriv u (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))
          (Set.uIcc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
        (hu.deriv (hStrip_open σ)).continuousOn.comp
          (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).continuousOn
          (fun μ hμ => h_mem_strip μ hμ)
      exact hc.mul continuousOn_const
    have hmul_t : glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t) * t = u (y + t / 2) - u (y - t / 2) := by
      rw [glancingDiffOp, ← intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv_μ hdu_cont.intervalIntegrable]
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    calc glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t)
        = t⁻¹ * (glancingDiffOp (fun p => u p.1) (y, t) * t) := by
          rw [mul_comm _ t, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_mul]
      _ = t⁻¹ * (u (y + t / 2) - u (y - t / 2)) := by rw [hmul_t]

  have h_diffOp_even : ∀ (σ α : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ α → IsOpen V_t → (∀ t ∈ V_t, -t ∈ V_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ v { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + α * |p.2.im| < σ } →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + α * |t.im| < σ → v (y, -t) = v (y, t)) →
      ∀ y t : ℂ, t ∈ V_t → |y.im| + (α + 1 / 2) * |t.im| < σ →
        glancingDiffOp v (y, -t) = glancingDiffOp v (y, t) := by
    intro σ α V_t v _ _ _ _ hv_even y t ht hy_im
    have h_flip : glancingDiffOp v (y, t) =
        ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
          deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', t)) (y + ((-μ : ℝ) : ℂ) * t) := by
      let f_int : ℝ → ℂ := fun μ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)
      have hcomp : (∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ), f_int (-μ)) =
          ∫ μ in -(1 / 2 : ℝ)..-(-1 / 2 : ℝ), f_int μ :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg f_int
      have h_end1 : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      have h_end2 : -(-1 / 2 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [h_end1, h_end2] at hcomp
      exact hcomp.symm
    rw [h_flip, glancingDiffOp]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun μ hμ => ?_)
    have hμ_le : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ μ ∧ μ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at hμ
    have hμ_abs : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr (by constructor <;> linarith)
    let z₀ : ℂ := y + (μ : ℂ) * (-t)
    have hz₀_eq : y + ((-μ : ℝ) : ℂ) * t = z₀ := by
      dsimp [z₀]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hz₀_eq]
    have hz₀_im : |z₀.im| < σ - α * |t.im| := by
      have him_eq : z₀.im = y.im - μ * t.im := by simp [z₀]; ring
      rw [him_eq]
      have htri : |y.im - μ * t.im| ≤ |y.im| + |μ| * |t.im| := by
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, abs_mul] using abs_add_le y.im (-(μ * t.im))
      have hmul : |μ| * |t.im| ≤ (1 / 2) * |t.im| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hμ_abs (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    have hU_open : IsOpen { y' : ℂ | |y'.im| < σ - α * |t.im| } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', -t)) =ᶠ[nhds z₀] (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', t)) := by
      filter_upwards [hU_open.mem_nhds hz₀_im] with y' hy'
      exact hv_even y' t ht (by linarith [show |y'.im| < σ - α * |t.im| from hy'])
    exact hev.deriv_eq

  
  have h_dslope : ∀ (R M : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < R → 0 ≤ M →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
        ‖g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0‖ ≤ (4 * M / R ^ 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro R M g hR _ hg hM z hz
    let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope g 0
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self hR
    have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hR)).mpr hg
    have hg_maps : Set.MapsTo g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) (Metric.closedBall (g 0) (2 * M)) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      calc ‖g ζ - g 0‖ ≤ ‖g ζ‖ + ‖g 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add (hM ζ hζ) (hM 0 h0_mem)
        _ = 2 * M := by ring
    have hg₁_bound : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g₁ ζ‖ ≤ 2 * M / R := fun ζ hζ =>
      Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hg hg_maps hζ
    have hg₁_maps : Set.MapsTo g₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) (Metric.closedBall (g₁ 0) (4 * M / R)) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      calc ‖g₁ ζ - g₁ 0‖ ≤ ‖g₁ ζ‖ + ‖g₁ 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * M / R + 2 * M / R := add_le_add (hg₁_bound ζ hζ) (hg₁_bound 0 h0_mem)
        _ = 4 * M / R := by ring
    have hg₂_bound : ‖dslope g₁ 0 z‖ ≤ (4 * M / R) / R :=
      Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hg₁_holo hg₁_maps hz
    have h_alg : g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0 = z ^ 2 * dslope g₁ 0 z := by
      have h1 : z * g₁ z = g z - g 0 := by simpa [g₁, smul_eq_mul] using sub_smul_dslope g 0 z
      have h2 : z * dslope g₁ 0 z = g₁ z - deriv g 0 := by
        simpa [g₁, dslope_same, smul_eq_mul] using sub_smul_dslope g₁ 0 z
      calc g z - g 0 - z * deriv g 0
          = z * g₁ z - z * deriv g 0 := by rw [h1]
        _ = z * (g₁ z - deriv g 0) := by ring
        _ = z * (z * dslope g₁ 0 z) := by rw [h2]
        _ = z ^ 2 * dslope g₁ 0 z := by ring
    rw [h_alg, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    calc ‖z‖ ^ 2 * ‖dslope g₁ 0 z‖
        ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 * ((4 * M / R) / R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg₂_bound (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = (4 * M / R ^ 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by rw [div_div, ← sq]; ring

  exact {
    partial_y_holo := h_partial_y
    partial_t_holo := h_partial_t
    param_integral_holo := h_param_holo
    param_integral_cont := h_param_cont
    deriv_conj_strip := h_deriv_conj
    sinc_props := ⟨h_sinc_diff, h_sinc_zero, h_sinc_neg, h_sinc_conj, h_sinc_mul, h_sinc_bound⟩
    diffOp_props := ⟨h_diffOp_holo, h_diffOp_zero, h_diffOp_ftc, h_diffOp_even⟩
    dslope_quad_bound := h_dslope
  }

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (hCalc : UniversalGlancingCalculus) :
    Nonempty (NormActionPackage B)

signature.name: normalized_action_calculus_and_taylor
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (hCalc : UniversalGlancingCalculus) :
    Nonempty (NormActionPackage B)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hc_pos : 0 < B.c := B.c_pos
  have hs0_pos : 0 < B.s₀ := B.s₀_pos
  have hsh_pos : 0 < B.s_h := B.s_h_pos
  have isOpen_strip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im.abs continuous_const
  have strip_mono : ∀ {H₁ H₂ : ℝ}, H₁ ≤ H₂ → horizStrip H₁ ⊆ horizStrip H₂ :=
    fun hle _ hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hz hle
  have convex_strip : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    have h_eq : horizStrip H = Complex.imCLM ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext z; simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap
  have conj_mem_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < H
    simpa using hz
  have add_real_mem_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (x : ℝ), z ∈ horizStrip H → z + (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z x hz
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    change |(z + (x : ℂ)).im| < H
    simpa using hz
  have add_two_pi_mem_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    have hcast : z + 2 * Real.pi = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast]
    exact add_real_mem_strip _ hz
  have real_mem_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} (x : ℝ), 0 < H → (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H x hH; simp [horizStrip, hH]
  have mid_mem_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {w₁ w₂ : ℂ},
      w₁ ∈ horizStrip H → w₂ ∈ horizStrip H → (w₁ + w₂) / 2 ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    change |w₁.im| < H at hw₁
    change |w₂.im| < H at hw₂
    change |((w₁ + w₂) / 2).im| < H
    have him : ((w₁ + w₂) / 2).im = (w₁.im + w₂.im) / 2 := by simp [add_div]
    rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    linarith [abs_add_le w₁.im w₂.im]
  have hc_ne : (B.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hc_pos.ne'
  have h2c_ne : 2 * (B.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hc_ne
  have norm_c : ‖(B.c : ℂ)‖ = B.c := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc_pos]
  have hS3_sub : horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ⊆ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) :=
    strip_mono (by linarith)
  have hS54_sub : horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) ⊆ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) :=
    strip_mono (by linarith)
  have hS1_sub : horizStrip B.s₀ ⊆ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) :=
    strip_mono (by linarith)

  
  
  
  have hdh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv B.h_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
    B.h_ℂ_holo.deriv (isOpen_strip _)
  have hddh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ)) (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
    hdh_holo.deriv (isOpen_strip _)
  have hr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (r_ℂ B) (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
    B.h_ℂ_holo.add hddh_holo
  have hdr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (r_ℂ B)) (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
    hr_holo.deriv (isOpen_strip _)
  have hdϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) :=
    B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.deriv (isOpen_strip _)
  have hddϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ)) (horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) :=
    hdϕ_holo.deriv (isOpen_strip _)

  have deriv_periodic_strip : ∀ {σ : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, g (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g w) →
      ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv g (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv g w := by
    intro σ g hper w hw
    have hev : (fun z : ℂ => g (z + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)))) =ᶠ[nhds w] g :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_strip σ).mem_nhds hw) (fun z hz => hper z hz)
    have hd1 : deriv (fun z : ℂ => g (z + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)))) w = deriv g w := hev.deriv_eq
    rw [deriv_comp_add_const] at hd1
    exact hd1
  have hdh_per : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h), deriv B.h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv B.h_ℂ w :=
    deriv_periodic_strip B.h_ℂ_periodic
  have hddh_per : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h),
      deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w :=
    deriv_periodic_strip hdh_per
  have hr_per : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h), r_ℂ B (w + 2 * Real.pi) = r_ℂ B w := by
    intro w hw; simp only [r_ℂ, B.h_ℂ_periodic w hw, hddh_per w hw]
  have hdr_per : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h),
      deriv (r_ℂ B) (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (r_ℂ B) w :=
    deriv_periodic_strip hr_per
  have hdϕ_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀), deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [B.deriv_ϕ_ℂ_eq_exp _ (add_two_pi_mem_strip hz), B.deriv_ϕ_ℂ_eq_exp z hz, B.u_ℂ_periodic z hz]
  have hddϕ_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀),
      deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) (z + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) z :=
    deriv_periodic_strip hdϕ_per

  have hdϕ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀),
      deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z) :=
    hCalc.deriv_conj_strip (2 * B.s₀) B.ϕ_ℂ B.ϕ_ℂ_holo B.ϕ_ℂ_conj
  have hdh_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h),
      deriv B.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv B.h_ℂ w) :=
    hCalc.deriv_conj_strip (2 * B.s_h) B.h_ℂ B.h_ℂ_holo B.h_ℂ_conj
  have hddh_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h),
      deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w) :=
    hCalc.deriv_conj_strip (2 * B.s_h) (deriv B.h_ℂ) hdh_holo hdh_conj
  have hr_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h),
      r_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (r_ℂ B w) := by
    intro w hw; simp only [r_ℂ, map_add, B.h_ℂ_conj w hw, hddh_conj w hw]

  
  
  
  have h_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X := by
    intro X Y
    simp only [normAction2_ℂ, normAction1_ℂ, supportAction2_ℂ, supportAction1_ℂ]
    have hmid : (B.ϕ_ℂ Y + B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 = (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 := by ring
    have hdiff : (B.ϕ_ℂ X - B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 = -((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) := by ring
    rw [hmid, hdiff, Complex.sin_neg, Complex.cos_neg]
    ring

  let W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)
  have isOpen_W3 : IsOpen W₃ := (isOpen_strip _).prod (isOpen_strip _)
  have h_act1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2) W₃ := by
    have hϕ1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) W₃ :=
      B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.1)
    have hϕ2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) W₃ :=
      B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.2)
    have hdϕ1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) W₃ :=
      hdϕ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.1)
    have hmid : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 + B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) / 2) W₃ :=
      ((hϕ1.add hϕ2).mul_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.2 - B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) / 2) W₃ :=
      ((hϕ2.sub hϕ1).mul_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    have hmid_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 + B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) / 2) W₃
        (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
      fun _ hq => mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub hq.1)) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub hq.2))
    have hϕ1_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) W₃ (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
      fun _ hq => B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub hq.1)
    have h_sa1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) (B.ϕ_ℂ q.2)) W₃ :=
      ((hdh_holo.comp hmid hmid_maps).mul (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn hdiff)).sub
        ((B.h_ℂ_holo.comp hmid hmid_maps).mul (Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn hdiff))
    have hdϕ1_c : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 / (B.c : ℂ)) W₃ :=
      (hdϕ1.mul_const ((B.c : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    exact hdϕ1_c.mul (h_sa1.add (B.h_ℂ_holo.comp hϕ1 hϕ1_maps))

  have h_act2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2) W₃ := by
    have h_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2) =
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => -(normAction1_ℂ B q.2 q.1)) := by
      ext q; exact h_swap q.1 q.2
    rw [h_eq]
    have hswap_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.2, q.1)) :=
      differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst
    exact (h_act1_holo.comp hswap_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => ⟨hq.2, hq.1⟩)).neg

  have h_act12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2) W₃ := by
    have hϕ1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) W₃ :=
      B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.1)
    have hϕ2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) W₃ :=
      B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.2)
    have hdϕ1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) W₃ :=
      hdϕ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.1)
    have hdϕ2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) W₃ :=
      hdϕ_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hS3_sub hq.2)
    have hmid : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 + B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) / 2) W₃ :=
      ((hϕ1.add hϕ2).mul_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.2 - B.ϕ_ℂ q.1) / 2) W₃ :=
      ((hϕ2.sub hϕ1).mul_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    have hmid_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 + B.ϕ_ℂ q.2) / 2) W₃
        (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
      fun _ hq => mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub hq.1)) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub hq.2))
    have hdϕ12_c : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.1 * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ q.2 / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) W₃ :=
      ((hdϕ1.mul hdϕ2).mul_const ((2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    exact (hdϕ12_c.mul (hr_holo.comp hmid hmid_maps)).mul
      (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn hdiff)

  have h_diag_per_1 : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX0 := hS3_sub hX
    have hY0 := hS3_sub hY
    have hmid_sh : (B.ϕ_ℂ (X + 2 * Real.pi) + B.ϕ_ℂ (Y + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
        (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 + 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic Y hY0]; ring
    have hdiff_sh : (B.ϕ_ℂ (Y + 2 * Real.pi) - B.ϕ_ℂ (X + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
        (B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 := by
      rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic Y hY0]; ring
    have hmid_mem : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
      mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to Y hY0)
    simp only [normAction1_ℂ, supportAction1_ℂ, hdϕ_per X hX0, hmid_sh, hdiff_sh,
      hdh_per _ hmid_mem, B.h_ℂ_periodic _ hmid_mem]
    rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic X hX0, B.h_ℂ_periodic _ (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0)]

  have h_diag_per : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
      normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
      normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    refine ⟨h_diag_per_1 X Y hX hY, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_swap, h_swap X Y, h_diag_per_1 Y X hY hX]
    · have hX0 := hS3_sub hX
      have hY0 := hS3_sub hY
      have hmid_sh : (B.ϕ_ℂ (X + 2 * Real.pi) + B.ϕ_ℂ (Y + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
          (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 + 2 * Real.pi := by
        rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic Y hY0]; ring
      have hdiff_sh : (B.ϕ_ℂ (Y + 2 * Real.pi) - B.ϕ_ℂ (X + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
          (B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 := by
        rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic Y hY0]; ring
      have hmid_mem : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
        mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to Y hY0)
      simp only [normAction12_ℂ, hdϕ_per X hX0, hdϕ_per Y hY0, hmid_sh, hdiff_sh, hr_per _ hmid_mem]

  have h_conj_1 : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX0 := hS3_sub hX
    have hY0 := hS3_sub hY
    have hmid_mem : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
      mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to Y hY0)
    have hmid_c : (B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ X) + B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ Y)) / 2 =
        starRingEnd ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) := by
      rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_conj X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_conj Y hY0]; simp [map_ofNat]
    have hdiff_c : (B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ Y) - B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ X)) / 2 =
        starRingEnd ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) := by
      rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_conj X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_conj Y hY0]; simp [map_ofNat]
    simp only [normAction1_ℂ, supportAction1_ℂ]
    rw [hmid_c, hdiff_c, hdϕ_conj X hX0, hdh_conj _ hmid_mem, B.h_ℂ_conj _ hmid_mem,
      B.ϕ_ℂ_conj X hX0, B.h_ℂ_conj _ (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0), Complex.sin_conj, Complex.cos_conj]
    simp

  have h_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
      normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
      normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y) := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    refine ⟨h_conj_1 X Y hX hY, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_swap, h_swap X Y, map_neg, h_conj_1 Y X hY hX]
    · have hX0 := hS3_sub hX
      have hY0 := hS3_sub hY
      have hmid_mem : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
        mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to Y hY0)
      have hmid_c : (B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ X) + B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ Y)) / 2 =
          starRingEnd ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) := by
        rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_conj X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_conj Y hY0]; simp [map_ofNat]
      have hdiff_c : (B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ Y) - B.ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ X)) / 2 =
          starRingEnd ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) := by
        rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_conj X hX0, B.ϕ_ℂ_conj Y hY0]; simp [map_ofNat]
      simp only [normAction12_ℂ]
      rw [hmid_c, hdiff_c, hdϕ_conj X hX0, hdϕ_conj Y hY0, hr_conj _ hmid_mem, Complex.sin_conj]
      simp [map_ofNat]

  have h_deriv1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX0 := hS3_sub hX
    have hY0 := hS3_sub hY
    let θ₁ := B.ϕ_ℂ X
    let θ₂ := B.ϕ_ℂ Y
    have hmid_mem : (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) :=
      mid_mem_strip (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX0) (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to Y hY0)
    have hϕY : HasDerivAt B.ϕ_ℂ (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y) Y :=
      (B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hY0)).hasDerivAt
    have hψ : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => (θ₁ + B.ϕ_ℂ Y') / 2) (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / 2) Y := by
      simpa using (hϕY.const_add θ₁).div_const (2 : ℂ)
    have hΔ : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => (B.ϕ_ℂ Y' - θ₁) / 2) (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / 2) Y := by
      simpa using (hϕY.sub_const θ₁).div_const (2 : ℂ)
    have hh_at : HasDerivAt B.h_ℂ (deriv B.h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2)) ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) :=
      (B.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hmid_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have hdh_at : HasDerivAt (deriv B.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2)) ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) :=
      (hdh_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hmid_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have h_sa1 := ((hdh_at.comp Y hψ).mul hΔ.csin).sub ((hh_at.comp Y hψ).mul hΔ.ccos)
    have h_tot := ((h_sa1.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext Y'; rfl :
        _ = (fun Y' : ℂ => supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ θ₁ (B.ϕ_ℂ Y'))))).add_const
          (B.h_ℂ θ₁)).const_mul (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X / (B.c : ℂ))
    have h_tot' := h_tot.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext Y'; rfl : _ = (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y')))
    rw [h_tot'.deriv]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, normAction12_ℂ, r_ℂ, θ₁, θ₂]
    ring

  have h_deriv2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hfun : (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) = -(fun X' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B Y X') := by
      ext X'; exact h_swap X' Y
    rw [hfun, deriv.neg, h_deriv1_right Y X hY hX]
    simp only [normAction12_ℂ]
    have hmid : (B.ϕ_ℂ Y + B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 = (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 := by ring
    have hdiff : (B.ϕ_ℂ X - B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2 = -((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) := by ring
    rw [hmid, hdiff, Complex.sin_neg]
    ring

  have h_real_stat : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
      normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
        -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) := by
    have hdh_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, deriv B.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ) = ((deriv B.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro θ
      have hθ_mem : (θ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) := real_mem_strip θ (by positivity)
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => B.h_ℂ (t : ℂ)) (deriv B.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ)) θ :=
        (B.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hθ_mem)).hasDerivAt.comp_ofReal
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (B.h t : ℂ)) ((deriv B.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) θ :=
        (B.h_smooth.differentiable (by simp) θ).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp
      have hfun_eq : (fun t : ℝ => B.h_ℂ (t : ℂ)) = (fun t : ℝ => (B.h t : ℂ)) := by
        ext t; exact B.h_ℂ_real t
      rw [hfun_eq] at hd1
      exact hd1.unique hd2
    have hsa1_real : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
        supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (θ₁ : ℂ) (θ₂ : ℂ) = (supportAction1_ℝ B.h θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) := by
      intro θ₁ θ₂
      simp only [supportAction1_ℂ, supportAction1_ℝ]
      have hm : ((θ₁ : ℂ) + (θ₂ : ℂ)) / 2 = (((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have hd : ((θ₂ : ℂ) - (θ₁ : ℂ)) / 2 = (((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hm, hd, hdh_real, B.h_ℂ_real, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, ← Complex.ofReal_cos]
      push_cast; rfl
    have hsa2_real : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (θ₁ : ℂ) (θ₂ : ℂ) = (supportAction2_ℝ B.h θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) := by
      intro θ₁ θ₂
      simp only [supportAction2_ℂ, supportAction2_ℝ]
      have hm : ((θ₁ : ℂ) + (θ₂ : ℂ)) / 2 = (((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have hd : ((θ₂ : ℂ) - (θ₁ : ℂ)) / 2 = (((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hm, hd, hdh_real, B.h_ℂ_real, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, ← Complex.ofReal_cos]
      push_cast; rfl
    intro x₀ x₁ x₂
    have hsum : normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) =
        (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (x₁ : ℂ) / (B.c : ℂ)) *
          (((supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) +
            supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [normAction1_ℂ, normAction2_ℂ, B.ϕ_ℂ_real, hsa1_real, hsa2_real]
      push_cast; ring
    have hpref_ne : deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (x₁ : ℂ) / (B.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      div_ne_zero (B.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero (x₁ : ℂ) (real_mem_strip x₁ (by positivity))) hc_ne
    rw [hsum, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right hpref_ne, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

  
  
  
  let K_rect : ℝ → Set ℂ := fun H =>
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
      (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H) H)
  have isCompact_K : ∀ H : ℝ, IsCompact (K_rect H) :=
    fun H => (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image (by fun_prop)
  have nonempty_K : ∀ {H : ℝ}, 0 ≤ H → (K_rect H).Nonempty := by
    intro H hH
    exact ⟨0, ⟨(0, 0), ⟨⟨le_rfl, by positivity⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, by simp⟩⟩
  have K_sub_strip : ∀ {H σ : ℝ}, H < σ → K_rect H ⊆ horizStrip σ := by
    rintro H σ hlt _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨_, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    change |(((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im)| < σ
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_le.mpr hy) hlt

  have period_reduce : ∀ {H : ℝ} (z : ℂ), 0 ≤ H → |z.im| ≤ H →
      ∃ z₀ ∈ K_rect H, ∃ k : ℤ, z = z₀ + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro H z _ hz
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let k : ℤ := ⌊z.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let z₀ : ℂ := z - (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hz0_re : z₀.re = z.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      simp [z₀]
    have hz0_im : z₀.im = z.im := by
      simp [z₀]
    have hlo : 0 ≤ z₀.re := by
      have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ z.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
      have h2 : (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ z.re := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp h1
      linarith
    have hhi : z₀.re ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have h1 : z.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h2 : z.re < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi) := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp h1
      linarith
    refine ⟨z₀, ⟨(z₀.re, z₀.im), ⟨⟨hlo, hhi⟩, abs_le.mp (hz0_im.symm ▸ hz)⟩,
      Complex.re_add_im z₀⟩, k, by ring⟩

  have int_shift_mem : ∀ {σ : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (k : ℤ),
      z ∈ horizStrip σ → z + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ z k hz
    have hcast : z + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) = z + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast]
    exact add_real_mem_strip _ hz

  have periodic_int_shift : ∀ {σ : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, g (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g w) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℤ, g (z + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = g z := by
    intro σ g hper z hz k
    refine Int.induction_on k (by simp) (fun i hi => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
    · have hstep : z + (((i : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
          (z + ((i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hstep, hper _ (int_shift_mem (i : ℤ) hz), hi]
    · let w' : ℂ := z + (-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
      have hw'_eq : z + ((-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) = w' := by push_cast; rfl
      have hw'_mem : w' ∈ horizStrip σ := by
        rw [← hw'_eq]; exact int_shift_mem (-(i : ℤ) - 1) hz
      have hstep : w' + 2 * Real.pi = z + (-(i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        simp only [w']; push_cast; ring
      rw [hw'_eq, ← hper w' hw'_mem, hstep]
      simpa using hi

  have ϕ_im_int_shift : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀), ∀ k : ℤ,
      (B.ϕ_ℂ (z + (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi))).im = (B.ϕ_ℂ z).im := by
    intro z hz k
    have hqp : ∀ k' : ℤ, B.ϕ_ℂ (z + (k' : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) =
        B.ϕ_ℂ z + (k' : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro k'
      refine Int.induction_on k' (by simp) (fun i hi => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
      · have hstep : z + (((i : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
            (z + ((i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hstep, B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic _ (int_shift_mem (i : ℤ) hz), hi]
        push_cast; ring
      · let w' : ℂ := z + (-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hw'_eq : z + ((-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) = w' := by push_cast; rfl
        have hw'_mem : w' ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) := by
          rw [← hw'_eq]; exact int_shift_mem (-(i : ℤ) - 1) hz
        have hstep : w' + 2 * Real.pi = z + (-(i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          simp only [w']; push_cast; ring
        have h1 := B.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic w' hw'_mem
        rw [hstep] at h1
        have h2 : B.ϕ_ℂ (z + (-(i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)) =
            B.ϕ_ℂ z + (-(i : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          simpa using hi
        rw [hw'_eq]
        have hGoal : B.ϕ_ℂ w' = B.ϕ_ℂ z + (-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          linear_combination -h1 + h2
        rw [hGoal]
        push_cast; ring
    rw [hqp k]
    simp

  have exists_strip_bound : ∀ (σ H : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ H → H < σ → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip σ) →
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, g (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g w) →
      ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ H → ‖g z‖ ≤ M := by
    intro σ H g hH0 hHσ hg_holo hg_per
    have hg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => ‖g z‖) (K_rect H) :=
      continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hg_holo.continuousOn.mono (K_sub_strip hHσ))
    obtain ⟨z_m, _, hz_max⟩ := (isCompact_K H).exists_isMaxOn (nonempty_K hH0) hg_cont
    refine ⟨max 1 ‖g z_m‖, le_max_left _ _, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀_K, k, rfl⟩ := period_reduce z hH0 hz
    rw [periodic_int_shift hg_per z₀ (K_sub_strip hHσ hz₀_K) k]
    exact le_trans (hz_max hz₀_K) (le_max_right _ _)

  
  have hH3_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * B.s₀ / 2 := by positivity
  have hH3_lt : 3 * B.s₀ / 2 < 2 * B.s₀ := by linarith
  have hϕ_im_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ => |(B.ϕ_ℂ z).im|) (K_rect (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) :=
    Complex.continuous_im.abs.comp_continuousOn (B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.continuousOn.mono (K_sub_strip hH3_lt))
  obtain ⟨z_ϕmax, hz_ϕmax_K, hz_ϕmax⟩ :=
    (isCompact_K (3 * B.s₀ / 2)).exists_isMaxOn (nonempty_K hH3_nonneg) hϕ_im_cont
  let H_ϕ : ℝ := |(B.ϕ_ℂ z_ϕmax).im|
  have hH_ϕ_nonneg : 0 ≤ H_ϕ := abs_nonneg _
  have hH_ϕ_lt : H_ϕ < 2 * B.s_h :=
    B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to z_ϕmax (K_sub_strip hH3_lt hz_ϕmax_K)
  have hϕ_im_le : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ 3 * B.s₀ / 2 → |(B.ϕ_ℂ z).im| ≤ H_ϕ := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀_K, k, rfl⟩ := period_reduce z hH3_nonneg hz
    rw [ϕ_im_int_shift z₀ (K_sub_strip hH3_lt hz₀_K) k]
    exact hz_ϕmax hz₀_K

  let H_h : ℝ := (H_ϕ + 2 * B.s_h) / 2
  have hH_h_pos : 0 < H_h := by simp only [H_h]; linarith
  have hH_ϕ_lt_Hh : H_ϕ < H_h := by simp only [H_h]; linarith
  have hH_h_lt : H_h < 2 * B.s_h := by simp only [H_h]; linarith
  have hHh_sub : horizStrip H_h ⊆ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) := strip_mono hH_h_lt.le
  have hϕ_maps_Hh : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ 3 * B.s₀ / 2 → B.ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H_h :=
    fun z hz => lt_of_le_of_lt (hϕ_im_le z hz) hH_ϕ_lt_Hh

  obtain ⟨M_ϕ1, hM_ϕ1_ge1, hM_ϕ1⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s₀) (3 * B.s₀ / 2) (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) hH3_nonneg hH3_lt hdϕ_holo hdϕ_per
  obtain ⟨M_ϕ2, hM_ϕ2_ge1, hM_ϕ2⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s₀) (3 * B.s₀ / 2) (deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ)) hH3_nonneg hH3_lt hddϕ_holo hddϕ_per
  obtain ⟨M_h0, hM_h0_ge1, hM_h0⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s_h) H_h B.h_ℂ hH_h_pos.le hH_h_lt B.h_ℂ_holo B.h_ℂ_periodic
  obtain ⟨M_h1, hM_h1_ge1, hM_h1⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s_h) H_h (deriv B.h_ℂ) hH_h_pos.le hH_h_lt hdh_holo hdh_per
  obtain ⟨M_r0, hM_r0_ge1, hM_r0⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s_h) H_h (r_ℂ B) hH_h_pos.le hH_h_lt hr_holo hr_per
  obtain ⟨M_r1, hM_r1_ge1, hM_r1⟩ :=
    exists_strip_bound (2 * B.s_h) H_h (deriv (r_ℂ B)) hH_h_pos.le hH_h_lt hdr_holo hdr_per

  
  have hϕ_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2),
      ‖B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun z hz => B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds (hS3_sub hz)))
      (fun z hz => hM_ϕ1 z (le_of_lt hz)) (convex_strip _) hz₂ hz₁
  have hdϕ_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2),
      ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_ϕ2 * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun z hz => hdϕ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds (hS3_sub hz)))
      (fun z hz => hM_ϕ2 z (le_of_lt hz)) (convex_strip _) hz₂ hz₁
  have hr_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ horizStrip H_h, ∀ w₂ ∈ horizStrip H_h,
      ‖r_ℂ B w₁ - r_ℂ B w₂‖ ≤ M_r1 * ‖w₁ - w₂‖ := by
    intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun w hw => hr_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds (hHh_sub hw)))
      (fun w hw => hM_r1 w (le_of_lt hw)) (convex_strip _) hw₂ hw₁

  
  have h_trig_bound : ∀ Δ : ℂ,
      ‖Complex.sin Δ‖ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| ∧ ‖Complex.cos Δ‖ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| := by
    intro Δ
    have hexp1 : ‖Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre : (Δ * Complex.I).re = -Δ.im := by simp
      rw [hre]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_abs _)
    have hexp2 : ‖Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre : (-Δ * Complex.I).re = Δ.im := by simp
      rw [hre]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_abs_self _)
    constructor
    · rw [Complex.sin]
      calc ‖(Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)) * Complex.I / 2‖
          = ‖Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)‖ * ‖Complex.I‖ / ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ := by
            rw [norm_div, norm_mul]
        _ = ‖Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)‖ / 2 := by
            simp [Complex.norm_I]
        _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)‖ + ‖Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)‖) / 2 := by
            gcongr; exact norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| := by linarith
    · rw [Complex.cos]
      calc ‖(Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)) / 2‖
          = ‖Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)‖ / ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ := norm_div _ _
        _ = ‖Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)‖ / 2 := by simp
        _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp (Δ * Complex.I)‖ + ‖Complex.exp (-Δ * Complex.I)‖) / 2 := by
            gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ Real.exp |Δ.im| := by linarith

  let M_act : ℝ := max (M_ϕ1 + 1)
    (max M_ϕ2
      (max ((M_ϕ1 / B.c) * ((M_h1 + M_h0) * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0))
        ((M_ϕ1 ^ 2 / (2 * B.c)) * M_r0 * Real.exp H_ϕ)))
  have hM_act_pos : 0 < M_act :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : 0 < M_ϕ1 + 1) (le_max_left _ _)

  have h_wide_bound_1 : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX_im : |(B.ϕ_ℂ X).im| ≤ H_ϕ := hϕ_im_le X (le_of_lt hX)
    have hY_im : |(B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im| ≤ H_ϕ := hϕ_im_le Y (le_of_lt hY)
    have hmid_im : |((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2).im| ≤ H_h := by
      have him : ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2).im = ((B.ϕ_ℂ X).im + (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im) / 2 := by
        simp [add_div]
      rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith [abs_add_le (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im]
    have hdiff_im : |((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2).im| ≤ H_ϕ := by
      have him : ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2).im = ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im - (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im) / 2 := by
        simp [sub_div]
      rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith [abs_sub (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im]
    have hsin : ‖Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ ≤ Real.exp H_ϕ :=
      le_trans (h_trig_bound _).1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hdiff_im)
    have hcos : ‖Complex.cos ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ ≤ Real.exp H_ϕ :=
      le_trans (h_trig_bound _).2 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hdiff_im)
    have hsa1 : ‖supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) + B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X)‖ ≤
        (M_h1 + M_h0) * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0 := by
      simp only [supportAction1_ℂ]
      calc ‖deriv B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) * Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) -
              B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) * Complex.cos ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) +
              B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X)‖
          ≤ ‖deriv B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) * Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2) -
              B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) * Complex.cos ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ +
            ‖B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖deriv B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2)‖ * ‖Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ +
            ‖B.h_ℂ ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2)‖ * ‖Complex.cos ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ +
            ‖B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X)‖ := by
              gcongr
              exact le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul])
        _ ≤ M_h1 * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0 * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0 := by
            gcongr
            · exact hM_h1 _ hmid_im
            · exact hM_h0 _ hmid_im
            · exact hM_h0 _ (le_trans hX_im hH_ϕ_lt_Hh.le)
        _ = (M_h1 + M_h0) * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0 := by ring
    have h1 : ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤
        (M_ϕ1 / B.c) * ((M_h1 + M_h0) * Real.exp H_ϕ + M_h0) := by
      simp only [normAction1_ℂ, norm_mul, norm_div, norm_c]
      gcongr
      exact hM_ϕ1 X (le_of_lt hX)
    exact le_trans h1 (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))

  have h_wide_bound_12 : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
      ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX_im : |(B.ϕ_ℂ X).im| ≤ H_ϕ := hϕ_im_le X (le_of_lt hX)
    have hY_im : |(B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im| ≤ H_ϕ := hϕ_im_le Y (le_of_lt hY)
    have hmid_im : |((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2).im| ≤ H_h := by
      have him : ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2).im = ((B.ϕ_ℂ X).im + (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im) / 2 := by
        simp [add_div]
      rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith [abs_add_le (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im]
    have hdiff_im : |((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2).im| ≤ H_ϕ := by
      have him : ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2).im = ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im - (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im) / 2 := by
        simp [sub_div]
      rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      linarith [abs_sub (B.ϕ_ℂ Y).im (B.ϕ_ℂ X).im]
    have hsin : ‖Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)‖ ≤ Real.exp H_ϕ :=
      le_trans (h_trig_bound _).1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hdiff_im)
    have h12 : ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤
        (M_ϕ1 ^ 2 / (2 * B.c)) * M_r0 * Real.exp H_ϕ := by
      simp only [normAction12_ℂ, norm_mul, norm_div, norm_c]
      have h2norm : ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = 2 := by simp
      rw [h2norm]
      have hdX := hM_ϕ1 X (le_of_lt hX)
      have hdY := hM_ϕ1 Y (le_of_lt hY)
      have hprod : ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X‖ * ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq]; gcongr
      have hdiv : ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X‖ * ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y‖ / (2 * B.c) ≤ M_ϕ1 ^ 2 / (2 * B.c) := by
        gcongr
      gcongr
      exact hM_r0 _ hmid_im
    exact le_trans h12 (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))

  have h_act_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
      ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
      ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
      ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act := by
    intro X Y hX hY
    have hX3 := hS54_sub hX
    have hY3 := hS54_sub hY
    refine ⟨h_wide_bound_1 X Y hX3 hY3, ?_, h_wide_bound_12 X Y hX3 hY3⟩
    rw [h_swap, norm_neg]
    exact h_wide_bound_1 Y X hY3 hX3

  have h_ϕ_lip_54 :
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z‖ ≤ M_act) ∧
      (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4), ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4),
        ‖deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₁ - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ z₂‖ ≤ M_act * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) := by
    refine ⟨fun z hz => ?_, fun z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ => ?_⟩
    · exact le_trans (hM_ϕ1 z (le_of_lt (hS54_sub hz)))
        (le_trans (by linarith : M_ϕ1 ≤ M_ϕ1 + 1) (le_max_left _ _))
    · have hM2_le : M_ϕ2 ≤ M_act := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      exact le_trans (hdϕ_lip z₁ (hS54_sub hz₁) z₂ (hS54_sub hz₂))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM2_le (norm_nonneg _))

  let K_lin : ℝ :=
    (M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * M_r0) / B.c
  have hK_lin_pos : 0 < K_lin := by
    have hnum : 0 < M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) +
        M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * M_r0 := by positivity
    exact div_pos hnum B.c_pos

  let δ_lin : ℝ :=
    min (min (B.s₀ / 8) (1 / 2)) (min (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ1)) (1 / (16 * K_lin)))
  have hδ_lin_pos : 0 < δ_lin := by
    simp only [δ_lin, lt_min_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨by positivity [B.s₀_pos], by norm_num⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact div_pos Real.pi_pos (by positivity)
    · exact div_pos one_pos (by positivity)
  have hδ_le_eighth : δ_lin ≤ B.s₀ / 8 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_le_half : δ_lin ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hδ_le_pi : δ_lin ≤ Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ1) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_le_klin : δ_lin ≤ 1 / (16 * K_lin) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)

  have h_real_step : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
      0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ δ_lin →
      0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi := by
    intro x₀ x₁ hpos hle
    have hmono : StrictMono B.ϕ := strictMono_of_deriv_pos B.ϕ_deriv_pos
    have hdiff_pos : 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ := sub_pos.mpr (hmono (sub_pos.mp hpos))
    refine ⟨hdiff_pos, ?_⟩
    have hx0 : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := real_mem_strip x₀ (by positivity [B.s₀_pos])
    have hx1 : (x₁ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := real_mem_strip x₁ (by positivity [B.s₀_pos])
    have hlip := hϕ_lip (x₁ : ℂ) hx1 (x₀ : ℂ) hx0
    rw [B.ϕ_ℂ_real, B.ϕ_ℂ_real, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hdiff_pos, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hpos] at hlip
    have h2M : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * M_ϕ1 := by positivity
    have hstep1 : M_ϕ1 * (x₁ - x₀) ≤ M_ϕ1 * (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans hle hδ_le_pi) (by positivity)
    have hstep2 : M_ϕ1 * (Real.pi / (2 * M_ϕ1)) = Real.pi / 2 := by
      field_simp
    linarith [Real.pi_pos]

  have h_lin_close : ∀ X_m X_p W : ℂ,
      X_m ∈ horizStrip B.s₀ →
      ‖X_p - X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
      ‖2 * W - deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ δ_lin →
      ‖W‖ ≤ M_act ∧
      ‖4 * ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
        r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X_m + B.ϕ_ℂ X_p) / 2) * W) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    intro X_m X_p W hXm hXp_dist hW_dist
    have hXm_3 : X_m ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := hS1_sub hXm
    have hXp_3 : X_p ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := by
      change |X_m.im| < B.s₀ at hXm
      change |X_p.im| < 3 * B.s₀ / 2
      have him_eq : X_p.im = X_m.im + (X_p - X_m).im := by simp
      have him_le : |(X_p - X_m).im| ≤ ‖X_p - X_m‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      rw [him_eq]
      linarith [abs_add_le X_m.im (X_p - X_m).im, hXp_dist, hδ_le_eighth, hs0_pos]
    let a_m := deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_m
    let a_p := deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X_p
    let ψ := (B.ϕ_ℂ X_m + B.ϕ_ℂ X_p) / 2
    let r_m := r_ℂ B (B.ϕ_ℂ X_m)
    let r_ψ := r_ℂ B ψ
    let w₂ := 2 * W
    have ha_m : ‖a_m‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 := hM_ϕ1 X_m (le_of_lt hXm_3)
    have hw2 : ‖w₂‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 + 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖w₂‖ ≤ ‖a_m‖ + ‖w₂ - a_m‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le a_m (w₂ - a_m)
      linarith [hW_dist, hδ_le_half]
    have hW_bound : ‖W‖ ≤ M_act := by
      have h2W : 2 * ‖W‖ = ‖w₂‖ := by simp [w₂]
      have hW1 : ‖W‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 + 1 := by linarith [norm_nonneg W]
      exact le_trans hW1 (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨hW_bound, ?_⟩
    have hϕm_Hh : B.ϕ_ℂ X_m ∈ horizStrip H_h := hϕ_maps_Hh X_m (le_of_lt hXm_3)
    have hϕp_Hh : B.ϕ_ℂ X_p ∈ horizStrip H_h := hϕ_maps_Hh X_p (le_of_lt hXp_3)
    have hψ_Hh : ψ ∈ horizStrip H_h := mid_mem_strip hϕm_Hh hϕp_Hh
    have hr_m : ‖r_m‖ ≤ M_r0 := hM_r0 _ (le_of_lt hϕm_Hh)
    have hr_ψ : ‖r_ψ‖ ≤ M_r0 := hM_r0 _ (le_of_lt hψ_Hh)
    have hap_diff : ‖a_p - a_m‖ ≤ M_ϕ2 * δ_lin :=
      le_trans (hdϕ_lip X_p hXp_3 X_m hXm_3) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXp_dist (by positivity))
    have hψ_diff : ‖ψ - B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 * δ_lin := by
      have heq : ψ - B.ϕ_ℂ X_m = (B.ϕ_ℂ X_p - B.ϕ_ℂ X_m) / 2 := by simp only [ψ]; ring
      rw [heq, norm_div, show ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ = 2 by simp]
      have h1 : ‖B.ϕ_ℂ X_p - B.ϕ_ℂ X_m‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 * δ_lin :=
        le_trans (hϕ_lip X_p hXp_3 X_m hXm_3) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXp_dist (by positivity))
      linarith [norm_nonneg (B.ϕ_ℂ X_p - B.ϕ_ℂ X_m)]
    have hr_diff : ‖r_ψ - r_m‖ ≤ M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 * δ_lin) :=
      le_trans (hr_lip ψ hψ_Hh (B.ϕ_ℂ X_m) hϕm_Hh) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hψ_diff (by positivity))
    have h_laz : r_m * a_m ^ 3 = (B.c : ℂ) := B.lazutkin_norm_ℂ X_m (hS3_sub hXm_3)
    have h_tele : 4 * ((a_m * a_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) * r_ψ * W) - 1 =
        (a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂ + a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂ + a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)) /
          (B.c : ℂ) := by
      have h4 : 4 * ((a_m * a_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) * r_ψ * W) = (a_m * a_p * r_ψ * w₂) / (B.c : ℂ) := by
        simp only [w₂]; field_simp [hc_ne]; ring
      rw [h4, div_sub_one hc_ne, ← h_laz]
      ring
    rw [h_tele, norm_div, norm_c]
    have ht1 : ‖a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) * δ_lin := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
      calc ‖a_m‖ * ‖a_p - a_m‖ * ‖r_ψ‖ * ‖w₂‖
          ≤ M_ϕ1 * (M_ϕ2 * δ_lin) * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) := by gcongr
        _ = M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) * δ_lin := by ring
    have ht2 : ‖a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) * δ_lin := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow]
      calc ‖a_m‖ ^ 2 * ‖r_ψ - r_m‖ * ‖w₂‖
          ≤ M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * (M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 * δ_lin)) * (M_ϕ1 + 1) := by gcongr
        _ = M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) * δ_lin := by ring
    have ht3 : ‖a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)‖ ≤ M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * M_r0 * δ_lin := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow]
      gcongr
    have hnum_le : ‖a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂ + a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂ +
        a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)‖ ≤
        (M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * M_r0) * δ_lin := by
      have htri : ‖a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂ + a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂ +
          a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)‖ ≤
          ‖a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂‖ + ‖a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂‖ +
            ‖a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)‖ :=
        le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      linarith
    have hdiv_le : ‖a_m * (a_p - a_m) * r_ψ * w₂ + a_m ^ 2 * (r_ψ - r_m) * w₂ +
        a_m ^ 2 * r_m * (w₂ - a_m)‖ / B.c ≤ K_lin * δ_lin := by
      have h1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum_le hc_pos.le
      have h2 : (M_ϕ1 * M_ϕ2 * M_r0 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 3 * M_r1 * (M_ϕ1 + 1) + M_ϕ1 ^ 2 * M_r0) *
          δ_lin / B.c = K_lin * δ_lin := by simp only [K_lin]; ring
      rwa [h2] at h1
    have hklin_le : K_lin * δ_lin ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_le_klin hK_lin_pos.le
      have h2 : K_lin * (1 / (16 * K_lin)) = 1 / 16 := by field_simp [hK_lin_pos.ne']
      linarith
    exact le_trans hdiv_le hklin_le

  
  
  
  have diffOn_iter : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n g) U := by
    intro U hU g hg n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hg
    | succ k ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact ih.deriv hU

  let M_rem : ℝ := 4 * M_act / (B.s₀ / 8) ^ 4
  have hM_rem_pos : 0 < M_rem := by positivity

  
  let W_rem : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStrip B.s₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4)
  have isOpen_Wrem : IsOpen W_rem := (isOpen_strip B.s₀).prod Metric.isOpen_ball

  have h_rem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normActionRem_ℂ B q.1 q.2) W_rem := by
    let g₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => normAction1_ℂ B p.1 p.2
    let g₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => g₀ (p.1, Y')) p.2
    let g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => g₁ (p.1, Y')) p.2
    let g₃ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => g₂ (p.1, Y')) p.2
    let g₄ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => g₃ (p.1, Y')) p.2
    have hg1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ W₃ := hCalc.partial_t_holo W₃ g₀ isOpen_W3 h_act1_holo
    have hg2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ W₃ := hCalc.partial_t_holo W₃ g₁ isOpen_W3 hg1
    have hg3 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₃ W₃ := hCalc.partial_t_holo W₃ g₂ isOpen_W3 hg2
    have hg4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₄ W₃ := hCalc.partial_t_holo W₃ g₃ isOpen_W3 hg3
    have hg4_eq : ∀ X z : ℂ,
        iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) z = g₄ (X, X + z) := by
      intro X z
      have hcomp := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add 4 (normAction1_ℂ B X) X) z
      rw [hcomp]
      have h0 : (fun Y' => g₀ (X, Y')) = iteratedDeriv 0 (normAction1_ℂ B X) := by
        ext Y'; simp [g₀]
      have h1 : (fun Y' => g₁ (X, Y')) = iteratedDeriv 1 (normAction1_ℂ B X) := by
        ext Y'; simp only [g₁, h0, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have h2 : (fun Y' => g₂ (X, Y')) = iteratedDeriv 2 (normAction1_ℂ B X) := by
        ext Y'; simp only [g₂, h1, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have h3 : (fun Y' => g₃ (X, Y')) = iteratedDeriv 3 (normAction1_ℂ B X) := by
        ext Y'; simp only [g₃, h2, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
      simp only [g₄, h3, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
    let F_rem : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun τ q =>
      ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 * g₄ (q.1, q.1 + (τ : ℂ) * q.2)
    have h_maps_all : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ q ∈ W_rem,
        (q.1, q.1 + (τ : ℂ) * q.2) ∈ W₃ := by
      intro τ hτ q ⟨hq1, hq2⟩
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      refine ⟨hS1_sub hq1, ?_⟩
      change |q.1.im| < B.s₀ at hq1
      change |(q.1 + (τ : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 3 * B.s₀ / 2
      simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hq2
      have hτ_abs : |τ| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.1], hτ.2⟩
      have him_le : |((τ : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
        calc |((τ : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ) * q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ = |τ| * ‖q.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖q.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ_abs (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖q.2‖ := one_mul _
      rw [Complex.add_im]
      linarith [abs_add_le q.1.im ((τ : ℂ) * q.2).im]
    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn (fun r : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F_rem r.1 r.2)
        (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ W_rem) := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun r : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ((1 - r.1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3) := by fun_prop
      have h2 : Continuous (fun r : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => (r.2.1, r.2.1 + (r.1 : ℂ) * r.2.2)) := by
        fun_prop
      exact h1.continuousOn.mul (hg4.continuousOn.comp h2.continuousOn (fun r hr => h_maps_all r.1 hr.1 r.2 hr.2))
    have hF_holo : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_rem τ) W_rem := by
      intro τ hτ
      have h_aff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1, q.1 + (τ : ℂ) * q.2)) :=
        differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_snd.const_mul (τ : ℂ)))
      exact (hg4.comp h_aff.differentiableOn (fun q hq => h_maps_all τ hτ q hq)).const_mul _
    have hint_holo := hCalc.param_integral_holo 0 1 W_rem F_rem isOpen_Wrem hF_cont hF_holo
    have h_rem_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normActionRem_ℂ B q.1 q.2) =
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (1 / 6 : ℂ) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, F_rem τ q) := by
      ext q
      simp only [normActionRem_ℂ, F_rem, hg4_eq]
    rw [h_rem_eq]
    exact hint_holo.const_mul (1 / 6 : ℂ)

  
  have h_rem_bound : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
      ‖normActionRem_ℂ B X b‖ ≤ M_rem := by
    intro X hX b hb
    let r_c : ℝ := B.s₀ / 8
    have hr_c_pos : 0 < r_c := by positivity
    have h_integrand : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
          iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)‖ ≤
          24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4 := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      let Y₀ : ℂ := X + (τ : ℂ) * b
      have hcball_sub : Metric.closedBall Y₀ r_c ⊆ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
        change |X.im| < B.s₀ at hX
        change |w.im| < 3 * B.s₀ / 2
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb
        have hτ_abs : |τ| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.1], hτ.2⟩
        have him_τb : |((τ : ℂ) * b).im| ≤ ‖b‖ := by
          calc |((τ : ℂ) * b).im| ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ) * b‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
            _ = |τ| * ‖b‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ 1 * ‖b‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ_abs (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖b‖ := one_mul _
        have him_w : w.im = X.im + ((τ : ℂ) * b).im + (w - Y₀).im := by simp [Y₀]
        have him_diff : |(w - Y₀).im| ≤ ‖w - Y₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        simp only [r_c] at hw
        rw [him_w]
        linarith [abs_add_le (X.im + ((τ : ℂ) * b).im) (w - Y₀).im,
          abs_add_le X.im ((τ : ℂ) * b).im, hw, hs0_pos]
      have hX_slice : DifferentiableOn ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X) (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) :=
        h_act1_holo.comp ((differentiable_const X).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
          (fun w hw => ⟨hS1_sub hX, hw⟩)
      have h_diffCont : DiffContOnCl ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X) (Metric.ball Y₀ r_c) :=
        (hX_slice.mono (Set.Subset.trans Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall hcball_sub)).diffContOnCl
      have h_sph : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere Y₀ r_c, ‖normAction1_ℂ B X w‖ ≤ M_act :=
        fun w hw => h_wide_bound_1 X w (hS1_sub hX) (hcball_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw))
      have hcauchy := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le 4 hr_c_pos h_diffCont h_sph
      have hcomp := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add 4 (normAction1_ℂ B X) X) ((τ : ℂ) * b)
      have h1mt : ‖((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hτ.2])]
        have hle1 : 1 - τ ≤ 1 := by linarith [hτ.1]
        have hnn : 0 ≤ 1 - τ := by linarith [hτ.2]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - τ)]
      rw [norm_mul, hcomp]
      have hfac : ((4 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * M_act / r_c ^ 4 = 24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4 := by norm_num
      rw [hfac] at hcauchy
      calc ‖((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv 4 (normAction1_ℂ B X) Y₀‖
          ≤ 1 * (24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4) := by gcongr
        _ = 24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4 := one_mul _
    simp only [normActionRem_ℂ, norm_mul]
    have h16 : ‖(1 / 6 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 6 := by norm_num
    rw [h16]
    have hint_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_integrand
    have habs1 : |(1 : ℝ) - 0| = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [habs1, mul_one] at hint_le
    have hrem_step1 : (1 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
          iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)‖ ≤
        (1 / 6) * (24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint_le (by norm_num)
    have hrem_step2 : (1 / 6 : ℝ) * (24 * M_act / r_c ^ 4) = M_rem := by
      simp only [M_rem, r_c]; ring
    linarith

  
  have iter_conj_pair : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) →
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2), f₂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (f₁ w)) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2),
        iteratedDeriv n f₂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (iteratedDeriv n f₁ z) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f₁ f₂ _ _ hrel z hz
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hrel z hz
    | succ k ih =>
      intro f₁ f₂ hf1 hf2 hrel z hz
      let g₁ := iteratedDeriv k f₁
      let g₂ := iteratedDeriv k f₂
      have hg1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) :=
        diffOn_iter (isOpen_strip _) hf1 k
      have hg1_at : HasDerivAt g₁ (deriv g₁ z) z :=
        (hg1_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
      have hcc := hg1_at.conj_conj
      have hev : (⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) ∘ g₁ ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ)) =ᶠ[nhds (starRingEnd ℂ z)] g₂ := by
        refine Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds (conj_mem_strip hz)) (fun w hw => ?_)
        have hw_bar : starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := conj_mem_strip hw
        have hstep := ih f₁ f₂ hf1 hf2 hrel (starRingEnd ℂ w) hw_bar
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply] at hstep ⊢
        exact hstep.symm
      have hg2_at := hev.hasDerivAt_iff.mp hcc
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact hg2_at.deriv

  have h_rem_conj : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
      normActionRem_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ b) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (normActionRem_ℂ B X b) := by
    intro X hX b hb
    have hX3 : X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := hS1_sub hX
    have hXb3 : starRingEnd ℂ X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := conj_mem_strip hX3
    have hf1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X) (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) :=
      h_act1_holo.comp ((differentiable_const X).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun w hw => ⟨hX3, hw⟩)
    have hf2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X)) (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2)) :=
      h_act1_holo.comp ((differentiable_const (starRingEnd ℂ X)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun w hw => ⟨hXb3, hw⟩)
    have hrel : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2),
        normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ w) =
          starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X w) :=
      fun w hw => (h_conj X w hX3 hw).1
    have h_eqon : Set.EqOn
        (fun τ : ℝ => ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
          iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ X + b'))
            ((τ : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ b))
        (fun τ : ℝ => starRingEnd ℂ (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
          iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      intro τ hτ
      dsimp only
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      have hz_mem : X + (τ : ℂ) * b ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := by
        change |X.im| < B.s₀ at hX
        change |(X + (τ : ℂ) * b).im| < 3 * B.s₀ / 2
        simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb
        have hτ_abs : |τ| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.1], hτ.2⟩
        have him_τb : |((τ : ℂ) * b).im| ≤ ‖b‖ := by
          calc |((τ : ℂ) * b).im| ≤ ‖(τ : ℂ) * b‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
            _ = |τ| * ‖b‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ 1 * ‖b‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ_abs (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = ‖b‖ := one_mul _
        rw [Complex.add_im]
        linarith [abs_add_le X.im ((τ : ℂ) * b).im]
      have hc1 := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add 4 (normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X))
        (starRingEnd ℂ X)) ((τ : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ b)
      have hc2 := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add 4 (normAction1_ℂ B X) X) ((τ : ℂ) * b)
      have harg : starRingEnd ℂ X + (τ : ℂ) * starRingEnd ℂ b = starRingEnd ℂ (X + (τ : ℂ) * b) := by
        simp
      rw [hc1, hc2, harg, iter_conj_pair 4 _ _ hf1_holo hf2_holo hrel _ hz_mem]
      simp
    simp only [normActionRem_ℂ]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr h_eqon, map_mul]
    have h16c : starRingEnd ℂ (1 / 6 : ℂ) = 1 / 6 := by simp [map_ofNat]
    rw [h16c]
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, integral_conj]

  
  have h_taylor4 : ∀ X ∈ horizStrip B.s₀, ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 4),
      normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) = b ^ 2 / 8 + b ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B X b := by
    intro X hX b hb
    have hX3 : X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := hS1_sub hX
    have hX2 : X ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) := hS3_sub hX3
    let ϕ₀ := B.ϕ_ℂ X
    let ϕ₁ := deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X
    let ϕ₂ := deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) X
    let r₀ := r_ℂ B ϕ₀
    let r₁ := deriv (r_ℂ B) ϕ₀
    have hϕ0_mem : ϕ₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) := B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to X hX2

    
    have h_laz0 : r₀ * ϕ₁ ^ 3 = (B.c : ℂ) := B.lazutkin_norm_ℂ X hX2
    have h_laz1 : r₁ * ϕ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * r₀ * ϕ₁ * ϕ₂ = 0 := by
      have hϕ_at : HasDerivAt B.ϕ_ℂ ϕ₁ X :=
        (B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hX2)).hasDerivAt
      have hdϕ_at : HasDerivAt (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) ϕ₂ X :=
        (hdϕ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hX2)).hasDerivAt
      have hr_at : HasDerivAt (r_ℂ B) r₁ ϕ₀ :=
        (hr_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hϕ0_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hlhs := (hr_at.comp X hϕ_at).mul (hdϕ_at.pow 3)
      have hev : ((r_ℂ B ∘ B.ϕ_ℂ) * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ ^ 3) =ᶠ[nhds X]
          (fun _ : ℂ => (B.c : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hX2) (fun z hz => B.lazutkin_norm_ℂ z hz)
      have hzero : (r₁ * ϕ₁) * ϕ₁ ^ 3 + r₀ * (((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ϕ₁ ^ (3 - 1) * ϕ₂) = 0 := by
        have hd_eq := hlhs.deriv
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const] at hd_eq
        simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.pow_apply, ϕ₀, ϕ₁, r₀] using hd_eq.symm
      have hfac : ϕ₁ * (r₁ * ϕ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * r₀ * ϕ₁ * ϕ₂) = 0 := by
        calc ϕ₁ * (r₁ * ϕ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * r₀ * ϕ₁ * ϕ₂)
            = (r₁ * ϕ₁) * ϕ₁ ^ 3 + r₀ * (((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ϕ₁ ^ (3 - 1) * ϕ₂) := by norm_num; ring
          _ = 0 := hzero
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfac).resolve_left (B.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero X hX2)

    
    let D_b : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (B.s₀ / 2)
    have h0_Db : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_b := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
    have hDb_maps : ∀ b' ∈ D_b, X + b' ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) := by
      intro b' hb'
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb'
      change |X.im| < B.s₀ at hX
      change |(X + b').im| < 3 * B.s₀ / 2
      have him_b : |b'.im| ≤ ‖b'‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      rw [Complex.add_im]
      linarith [abs_add_le X.im b'.im]
    let f : ℂ → ℂ := fun b' => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')
    have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f D_b :=
      h_act1_holo.comp ((differentiable_const X).prodMk (differentiable_id.const_add X)).differentiableOn
        (fun b' hb' => ⟨hX3, hDb_maps b' hb'⟩)
    have hf_iter_holo : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n f) D_b :=
      diffOn_iter Metric.isOpen_ball hf_holo

    
    have hf0 : iteratedDeriv 0 f 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, f, add_zero, normAction1_ℂ, supportAction1_ℂ]
      have hm : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 = B.ϕ_ℂ X := by ring
      have hd : (B.ϕ_ℂ X - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 = 0 := by ring
      rw [hm, hd, Complex.sin_zero, Complex.cos_zero]
      ring

    let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun b' => ϕ₁ * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b') * r_ℂ B ((ϕ₀ + B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) / 2)
    let S : ℂ → ℂ := fun b' => Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b') - ϕ₀) / 2)
    let S₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun b' =>
      Complex.cos ((B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b') - ϕ₀) / 2) * (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b') / 2)

    have hdf_eq : ∀ b' ∈ D_b, deriv f b' = (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹ * (P b' * S b') := by
      intro b' hb'
      have hc : deriv f b' = deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') (X + b') :=
        deriv_comp_const_add (normAction1_ℂ B X) X b'
      rw [hc, h_deriv1_right X (X + b') hX3 (hDb_maps b' hb')]
      simp only [normAction12_ℂ, P, S, ϕ₀, ϕ₁]
      ring

    have hS0 : S 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [S, add_zero, ϕ₀, sub_self, zero_div, Complex.sin_zero]
    have hP0 : P 0 = r₀ * ϕ₁ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [P, add_zero, ϕ₀, ϕ₁, r₀]
      have hm : (B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2 = B.ϕ_ℂ X := by ring
      rw [hm]; ring
    have hS1_0 : S₁ 0 = ϕ₁ / 2 := by
      simp only [S₁, add_zero, ϕ₀, ϕ₁, sub_self, zero_div, Complex.cos_zero, one_mul]
    have hf1 : iteratedDeriv 1 f 0 = 0 := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hdf_eq 0 h0_Db, hS0, mul_zero, mul_zero]

    have hP_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P D_b := by
      have hϕ_sh : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun b' : ℂ => B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) D_b :=
        B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.comp (differentiable_id.const_add X).differentiableOn
          (fun b' hb' => hS3_sub (hDb_maps b' hb'))
      have hdϕ_sh : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun b' : ℂ => deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) D_b :=
        hdϕ_holo.comp (differentiable_id.const_add X).differentiableOn
          (fun b' hb' => hS3_sub (hDb_maps b' hb'))
      have hmid_sh : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun b' : ℂ => (ϕ₀ + B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) / 2) D_b :=
        ((hϕ_sh.const_add ϕ₀).mul_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).congr (fun _ _ => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
      have hmid_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun b' : ℂ => (ϕ₀ + B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) / 2) D_b
          (horizStrip (2 * B.s_h)) :=
        fun b' hb' => mid_mem_strip hϕ0_mem (B.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (hS3_sub (hDb_maps b' hb')))
      exact (hdϕ_sh.const_mul ϕ₁).mul (hr_holo.comp hmid_sh hmid_maps)
    have hdP_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv P) D_b := hP_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball

    have hϕ_sh_at : ∀ b' ∈ D_b,
        HasDerivAt (B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) b' := by
      intro b' hb'
      have hXb' : X + b' ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) := hS3_sub (hDb_maps b' hb')
      have h_inner : HasDerivAt (HAdd.hAdd X) 1 b' := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id b').const_add X
      have h_out : HasDerivAt B.ϕ_ℂ (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (X + b')) (HAdd.hAdd X b') :=
        (B.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hXb')).hasDerivAt
      have hc := h_out.comp b' h_inner
      rwa [mul_one] at hc

    have hdϕ_sh_at : ∀ b' ∈ D_b,
        HasDerivAt (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) (deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) (X + b')) b' := by
      intro b' hb'
      have hXb' : X + b' ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀) := hS3_sub (hDb_maps b' hb')
      have h_inner : HasDerivAt (HAdd.hAdd X) 1 b' := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id b').const_add X
      have h_out : HasDerivAt (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) (deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) (X + b')) (HAdd.hAdd X b') :=
        (hdϕ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hXb')).hasDerivAt
      have hc := h_out.comp b' h_inner
      rwa [mul_one] at hc

    have hdP_0 : deriv P 0 = -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * r₀ * ϕ₁ * ϕ₂ := by
      have h1 := hdϕ_sh_at 0 h0_Db
      rw [add_zero] at h1
      have hϕ0_at := hϕ_sh_at 0 h0_Db
      rw [add_zero] at hϕ0_at
      have h2_in := (hϕ0_at.const_add ϕ₀).div_const (2 : ℂ)
      have hm0 : (ϕ₀ + (B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) 0) / 2 = ϕ₀ := by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, add_zero, ϕ₀]; ring
      have hr_at : HasDerivAt (r_ℂ B) r₁ ((ϕ₀ + (B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) 0) / 2) := by
        rw [hm0]; exact (hr_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_strip _).mem_nhds hϕ0_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hP_raw := (h1.const_mul ϕ₁).mul (hr_at.comp 0 h2_in)
      have hP_at := hP_raw.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext z; rfl : _ = P))
      rw [hP_at.deriv, Function.comp_apply, hm0]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, add_zero]
      change (ϕ₁ * ϕ₂) * r₀ + (ϕ₁ * ϕ₁) * (r₁ * (ϕ₁ / 2)) = -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * r₀ * ϕ₁ * ϕ₂
      linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℂ) * h_laz1

    have hS_deriv : ∀ b' ∈ D_b, HasDerivAt S (S₁ b') b' := by
      intro b' hb'
      have hΔ := ((hϕ_sh_at b' hb').sub_const ϕ₀).div_const (2 : ℂ)
      exact hΔ.csin.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext z; rfl : _ = S))

    have hS1_at0_raw := by
      have hϕ0_at := hϕ_sh_at 0 h0_Db
      rw [add_zero] at hϕ0_at
      have hΔ0 := (hϕ0_at.sub_const ϕ₀).div_const (2 : ℂ)
      have hdϕ0_at := (hdϕ_sh_at 0 h0_Db).div_const (2 : ℂ)
      rw [add_zero] at hdϕ0_at
      exact (hΔ0.ccos.mul hdϕ0_at).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext z; rfl : _ = S₁))
    have hS1_val : -Complex.sin (((B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) 0 - ϕ₀) / 2) * (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X / 2) *
        ((deriv B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) 0 / 2) +
        Complex.cos (((B.ϕ_ℂ ∘ HAdd.hAdd X) 0 - ϕ₀) / 2) * (deriv (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ) X / 2) = ϕ₂ / 2 := by
      simp [Function.comp_apply, ϕ₀, ϕ₂, sub_self, zero_div, Complex.sin_zero, Complex.cos_zero]
    rw [hS1_val] at hS1_at0_raw

    let f₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun b' => (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹ * (deriv P b' * S b' + P b' * S₁ b')
    have hdf2_eq : ∀ b' ∈ D_b, deriv (deriv f) b' = f₂ b' := by
      intro b' hb'
      have hP_at : HasDerivAt P (deriv P b') b' :=
        (hP_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hb')).hasDerivAt
      have hps := ((hP_at.mul (hS_deriv b' hb')).const_mul (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext z; rfl :
          _ = (fun z : ℂ => (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹ * (P z * S z))))
      have hev : deriv f =ᶠ[nhds b'] (fun z : ℂ => (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹ * (P z * S z)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hb') (fun z hz => hdf_eq z hz)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, hps.deriv]

    have hf2 : iteratedDeriv 2 f 0 = 1 / 4 := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one, hdf2_eq 0 h0_Db]
      simp only [f₂, hS0, hP0, hS1_0, mul_zero, zero_add]
      calc (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹ * (r₀ * ϕ₁ ^ 2 * (ϕ₁ / 2))
          = (r₀ * ϕ₁ ^ 3) / (4 * (B.c : ℂ)) := by ring
        _ = (B.c : ℂ) / (4 * (B.c : ℂ)) := by rw [h_laz0]
        _ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp [hc_ne]

    have hf3 : iteratedDeriv 3 f 0 = 0 := by
      have hdP_at0 : HasDerivAt (deriv P) (deriv (deriv P) 0) 0 :=
        (hdP_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_Db)).hasDerivAt
      have hP_at0 : HasDerivAt P (deriv P 0) 0 :=
        (hP_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_Db)).hasDerivAt
      have hf2_at0 := (((hdP_at0.mul (hS_deriv 0 h0_Db)).add
        (hP_at0.mul hS1_at0_raw)).const_mul (2 * (B.c : ℂ))⁻¹).congr_of_eventuallyEq
          (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext z; rfl : _ = f₂))
      have hev : deriv (deriv f) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] f₂ :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_Db) (fun z hz => hdf2_eq z hz)
      have h3_eq : iteratedDeriv 3 f 0 = deriv (deriv (deriv f)) 0 := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
      rw [h3_eq, hev.deriv_eq, hf2_at0.deriv, hS0, hdP_0, hS1_0, hP0]
      ring

    
    let G_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      iteratedDeriv 0 f (w * b) +
      (1 - w) * b * iteratedDeriv 1 f (w * b) +
      ((1 - w) ^ 2 / 2) * b ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv 2 f (w * b) +
      ((1 - w) ^ 3 / 6) * b ^ 3 * iteratedDeriv 3 f (w * b)
    have hτb_Db : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, (τ : ℂ) * b ∈ D_b := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb ⊢
      have hτ_abs : |τ| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.1], hτ.2⟩
      calc ‖(τ : ℂ) * b‖ = |τ| * ‖b‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖b‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ_abs (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < B.s₀ / 2 := by linarith

    have hG_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => G_ℂ (t : ℂ))
          (b ^ 4 * ((1 / 6 : ℂ) *
            (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 * iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b)))) τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hwb : (τ : ℂ) * b ∈ D_b := hτb_Db τ hτ
      have hw_mul : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ * b) b (τ : ℂ) := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (τ : ℂ)).mul_const b
      have h1mw := ((hasDerivAt_const (τ : ℂ) (1 : ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id (τ : ℂ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext ζ; rfl : _ = (fun ζ : ℂ => 1 - ζ)))
      rw [show (0 : ℂ) - 1 = (-1 : ℂ) by ring] at h1mw
      have hi0 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => iteratedDeriv 0 f (ζ * b))
          (iteratedDeriv 1 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b) (τ : ℂ) := by
        have h := ((hf_iter_holo 0).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hwb)).hasDerivAt.comp (τ : ℂ) hw_mul
        rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h
      have hi1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => iteratedDeriv 1 f (ζ * b))
          (iteratedDeriv 2 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b) (τ : ℂ) := by
        have h := ((hf_iter_holo 1).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hwb)).hasDerivAt.comp (τ : ℂ) hw_mul
        rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h
      have hi2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => iteratedDeriv 2 f (ζ * b))
          (iteratedDeriv 3 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b) (τ : ℂ) := by
        have h := ((hf_iter_holo 2).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hwb)).hasDerivAt.comp (τ : ℂ) hw_mul
        rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h
      have hi3 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => iteratedDeriv 3 f (ζ * b))
          (iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b) (τ : ℂ) := by
        have h := ((hf_iter_holo 3).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hwb)).hasDerivAt.comp (τ : ℂ) hw_mul
        rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h
      have ht1 := (h1mw.mul_const b).mul hi1
      have ht2 := (((h1mw.pow 2).div_const (2 : ℂ)).mul_const (b ^ 2)).mul hi2
      have ht3 := (((h1mw.pow 3).div_const (6 : ℂ)).mul_const (b ^ 3)).mul hi3
      have hG_at := (((hi0.add ht1).add ht2).add ht3).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.EventuallyEq.of_eq (by ext ζ; rfl : _ = G_ℂ))
      have hG_simp :
          iteratedDeriv 1 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b +
          (((-1 : ℂ) * b) * iteratedDeriv 1 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) +
            ((1 - (τ : ℂ)) * b) * (iteratedDeriv 2 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b)) +
          (((((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (1 - (τ : ℂ)) ^ (2 - 1) * (-1 : ℂ) / 2) * b ^ 2) * iteratedDeriv 2 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) +
            ((1 - (τ : ℂ)) ^ 2 / 2 * b ^ 2) * (iteratedDeriv 3 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b)) +
          (((((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (1 - (τ : ℂ)) ^ (3 - 1) * (-1 : ℂ) / 6) * b ^ 3) * iteratedDeriv 3 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) +
            ((1 - (τ : ℂ)) ^ 3 / 6 * b ^ 3) * (iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b) * b)) =
          b ^ 4 * ((1 / 6 : ℂ) * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 * iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b))) := by
        push_cast
        norm_num
        ring
      have hG_real := hG_at.comp_ofReal
      dsimp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hG_real
      rwa [hG_simp] at hG_real

    have hG'_cont : ContinuousOn
        (fun τ : ℝ => b ^ 4 * ((1 / 6 : ℂ) *
          (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 * iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b))))
        (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3) := by fun_prop
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ) * b) := by fun_prop
      have hc3 : ContinuousOn (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv 4 f ((τ : ℂ) * b)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) :=
        (hf_iter_holo 4).continuousOn.comp hc2.continuousOn hτb_Db
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_const.mul (hc1.continuousOn.mul hc3))

    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hG_deriv hG'_cont.intervalIntegrable
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
    have hG1 : G_ℂ (1 : ℂ) = normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) := by
      simp [G_ℂ, f]
    have hG0 : G_ℂ (0 : ℂ) = b ^ 2 / 8 := by
      simp only [G_ℂ, zero_mul, sub_zero, hf0, hf1, hf2, hf3]
      ring
    rw [Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero, hG1, hG0] at hftc
    change b ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B X b = normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b) - b ^ 2 / 8 at hftc
    linear_combination -hftc

  
  
  
  exact ⟨{
    M_act := M_act
    M_rem := M_rem
    δ_lin := δ_lin
    M_act_pos := hM_act_pos
    M_rem_pos := hM_rem_pos
    δ_lin_pos := hδ_lin_pos
    δ_lin_le_eighth_s₀ := hδ_le_eighth
    δ_lin_le_half := hδ_le_half
    normAction1_holo := h_act1_holo
    normAction2_holo := h_act2_holo
    normAction12_holo := h_act12_holo
    normAction_diag_periodic := h_diag_per
    normAction_conj := h_conj
    normAction2_eq_neg_swap := h_swap
    deriv_normAction1_right := h_deriv1_right
    deriv_normAction2_left := h_deriv2_left
    normAction_real_stationary_iff := h_real_stat
    normAction_bound := h_act_bound
    ϕ_deriv_strip_lip := h_ϕ_lip_54
    real_step_bound := h_real_step
    boundary_lin_close := h_lin_close
    normActionRem_holo := h_rem_holo
    normActionRem_bound := h_rem_bound
    normActionRem_conj := h_rem_conj
    normAction1_taylor4 := h_taylor4
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨s_act, d_act, η_adm, M_E, lin_ratio,
      hs_pos, hs_le_half_s₀, hs_le_one,
      hlin_pos, hlin_le_quarter, hM_ratio,
      hη_pos, hη_le_inv32, hη_le_eighth_s₀, hη_le_quarter_s₀, hη_le_lin,
      hd_pos, hd_lt_half_s_act, hd_lt_one, hd_lt_half_δ_col, hd_lt_half_τ₀, hd_le_s₀32, hd_le_lin,
      hME_eq, hME_pos⟩ :
