          rw [hx_2pi, hxm_2pi, hxm_eq, hdΘ_per _ (hreal_mem x),
            hΘ_qper _ (hreal_mem x), hΘ_qper _ (hreal_mem (x - t)),
            hmid_add, hdel_eq, B.h_ℂ_periodic _ hmid_mem, dh1_periodic _ hmid_mem]
        have hF₂_shift : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F₂ x) =
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F₂ (x + t) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right F₂ t, zero_add, add_comm (2 * Real.pi) t,
            hF₂_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq t 0, zero_add]
        let G_act_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
          2 * B.h_ℂ ((Θ z + Θ (z + (t : ℂ))) / 2) * Complex.sin ((Θ (z + (t : ℂ)) - Θ z) / 2)
        have hG_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ,
            HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => G_act_ℂ (r : ℂ)) (F₁ x + F₂ (x + t)) x := by
          intro x
          have hxt_eq : (x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) = ((x + t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
          have hx_mem : (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s := hreal_mem x
          have hxt_mem_s : (x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s := by rw [hxt_eq]; exact hreal_mem (x + t)
          have hdΘ1 : HasDerivAt Θ (deriv Θ (x : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) :=
            (hΘ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_s.mem_nhds hx_mem)).hasDerivAt
          have hdΘ2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Θ (z + (t : ℂ))) (deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) (x : ℂ) := by
            have hda := hΘ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_s.mem_nhds hxt_mem_s)
            have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z + (t : ℂ)) 1 (x : ℂ) := by
              simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (x : ℂ)).add_const (t : ℂ)
            have hc := hda.hasDerivAt.comp (x : ℂ) hlin
            rw [mul_one] at hc
            exact hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
          let ψ : ℂ := (Θ (x : ℂ) + Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) / 2
          let Δ : ℂ := (Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)) - Θ (x : ℂ)) / 2
          have hψ_mem : ψ ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) := hmid_sh_z _ hx_mem _ hxt_mem_s
          have hdψ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (Θ z + Θ (z + (t : ℂ))) / 2)
              ((deriv Θ (x : ℂ) + deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹) (x : ℂ) :=
            (((hdΘ1.add hdΘ2).mul_const ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]))
          have hdΔ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (Θ (z + (t : ℂ)) - Θ z) / 2)
              ((deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)) - deriv Θ (x : ℂ)) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹) (x : ℂ) :=
            (((hdΘ2.sub hdΘ1).mul_const ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]))
          have hdh : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => B.h_ℂ ((Θ z + Θ (z + (t : ℂ))) / 2))
              (deriv B.h_ℂ ψ * ((deriv Θ (x : ℂ) + deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)) (x : ℂ) :=
            ((B.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hψ_mem)).hasDerivAt.comp (x : ℂ) hdψ).congr_of_eventuallyEq
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
          have hdsin : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.sin ((Θ (z + (t : ℂ)) - Θ z) / 2))
              (Complex.cos Δ * ((deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)) - deriv Θ (x : ℂ)) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)) (x : ℂ) :=
            ((Complex.hasDerivAt_sin Δ).comp (x : ℂ) hdΔ).congr_of_eventuallyEq
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
          have hG_c : HasDerivAt G_act_ℂ
              ((2 : ℂ) * ((deriv B.h_ℂ ψ * ((deriv Θ (x : ℂ) + deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)) *
                  Complex.sin Δ +
                B.h_ℂ ψ * (Complex.cos Δ * ((deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)) - deriv Θ (x : ℂ)) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹))))
              (x : ℂ) :=
            (((hdh.mul hdsin).const_mul (2 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by dsimp [G_act_ℂ]; ring))
          have hderiv_alg :
              (2 : ℂ) * ((deriv B.h_ℂ ψ * ((deriv Θ (x : ℂ) + deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ))) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)) *
                  Complex.sin Δ +
                B.h_ℂ ψ * (Complex.cos Δ * ((deriv Θ ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)) - deriv Θ (x : ℂ)) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹))) =
              F₁ x + F₂ (x + t) := by
            have hsub : ((x + t : ℝ) : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
            dsimp only [F₁, F₂, supportAction1_ℂ, supportAction2_ℂ, ψ, Δ]
            rw [hsub, ← hxt_eq]; ring
          rw [hderiv_alg] at hG_c
          exact hG_c.comp_ofReal
        have hG_per : G_act_ℂ ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = G_act_ℂ ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          have h0_2pi : ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = (0 : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
          have ht_2pi : (0 : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi + (t : ℂ) = (t : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
          have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s := by simpa using hreal_mem 0
          have ht_mem_s : (t : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip s := hreal_mem t
          have hmid_0 : (Θ 0 + Θ (t : ℂ)) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s_h) := hmid_sh_z _ h0_mem _ ht_mem_s
          have hmid_add : (Θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi + (Θ (t : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
              (Θ 0 + Θ (t : ℂ)) / 2 + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
          have hdel_eq : (Θ (t : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi - (Θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 =
              (Θ (t : ℂ) - Θ 0) / 2 := by ring
          dsimp only [G_act_ℂ]
          rw [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_add, h0_2pi, ht_2pi,
            hΘ_qper _ h0_mem, hΘ_qper _ ht_mem_s, hmid_add, hdel_eq, B.h_ℂ_periodic _ hmid_0]
        have hint_sum : ((B.c : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ 3) * I_fn (t : ℂ) = 0 := by
          have h1 : ((B.c : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ 3) * I_fn (t : ℂ) =
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F₁ x + F₂ x) := by
            dsimp only [I_fn]
            rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
            exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x _ => hE_pt x
          have hint_F₁ : IntervalIntegrable F₁ MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hF₁_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hint_F₂ : IntervalIntegrable F₂ MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            hF₂_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hint_F₂s : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => F₂ (x + t)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
            (hF₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable _ _
          rw [h1, intervalIntegral.integral_add hint_F₁ hint_F₂, hF₂_shift,
            ← intervalIntegral.integral_add hint_F₁ hint_F₂s,
            intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun x _ => hG_deriv x)
              (hint_F₁.add hint_F₂s),
            hG_per, sub_self]
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hint_sum).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 3 ht_c_ne))
      have hFreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, I_fn z = 0 := by
        let t_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => d / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
        have ht_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < t_seq n := fun n => div_pos hd_pos' (by positivity)
        have ht_lt_d : ∀ n : ℕ, t_seq n < d := by
          intro n
          change d / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) < d
          have hden : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          exact div_lt_self hd_pos' hden
        have ht_tend_real : Filter.Tendsto t_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
          intro ε hε
          obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (d / ε)
          refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
          rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (ht_pos n)]
          have hNn : (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
          have hden_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
          have hd_lt : d < ε * (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            have h1 : d < (N : ℝ) * ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hN
            nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          exact (div_lt_iff₀ hden_pos).mpr hd_lt
        have ht_tend_c : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (t_seq n : ℂ)) Filter.atTop
            (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
          refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ ?_ ?_
          · have hc0 : Filter.Tendsto (Complex.ofReal ∘ t_seq) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
              simpa using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp ht_tend_real
            exact Filter.Tendsto.congr (fun _ => rfl) hc0
          · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
              Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (ht_pos n))
        exact ht_tend_c.frequently (Filter.Frequently.of_forall fun n =>
          hI_real (t_seq n) (ht_pos n) (ht_lt_d n))
      intro t ht
      have ht_mem : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
      exact hI_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) d).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hd_pos') hFreq ht_mem
    exact ⟨hE_holo, h_symm_E s d U hs_pos' hs_le hd_pos' hd_le hd_lt_half_s hAdm, hZeroMean, hAt0⟩
  exact ⟨{
    s_act := s_act
    d_act := d_act
    η_adm := η_adm
    M_E := M_E
    s_act_pos := hs_pos
    s_act_le_half_s₀ := hs_le_half_s₀
    s_act_le_one := hs_le_one
    d_act_pos := hd_pos
    d_act_lt_half_s_act := hd_lt_half_s_act
    d_act_lt_one := hd_lt_one
    d_act_lt_half_δ_col := hd_lt_half_δ_col
    d_act_lt_half_τ₀ := hd_lt_half_τ₀
    η_adm_pos := hη_pos
    η_adm_le_inv32 := hη_le_inv32
    η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ := hη_le_quarter_s₀
    M_E_pos := hME_pos
    real_step_collar := h_real_step_collar
    E_op_props := h_E_op_props
    E_op_cont := h_E_cont
    stationarity_equiv := h_stat
    residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero := h_ne_zero
    enlarged_holo_and_bounds := h_enlarged
    linCoeff_props := h_linCoeff_props
    slice_at_zero := h_slice_at_zero
    param_slice_holo_and_bound := h_param_slice
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have isOpen_horizStrip : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ) := by
    intro σ
    exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have isOpen_glancingDomain : ∀ (ν s_w d_w : ℝ), IsOpen (glancingDomain ν s_w d_w) := by
    intro ν s_w d_w
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        (continuous_const.sub
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)))))
  have im_add_mul_real_le :
      ∀ (z t : ℂ) (c : ℝ), |(z + (c : ℂ) * t).im| ≤ |z.im| + |c| * |t.im| := by
    intro z t c
    have him : (z + (c : ℂ) * t).im = z.im + c * t.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    exact (abs_add_le z.im (c * t.im)).trans (by rw [abs_mul])
  have closedBall_subset_horizStrip :
      ∀ (z : ℂ) (R σ_out : ℝ), |z.im| + R < σ_out →
        Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ horizStrip σ_out := by
    intro z R σ_out hzR w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    change |w.im| < σ_out
    have him : w.im = z.im + (w - z).im := by simp
    rw [him]
    have h1 := abs_add_le z.im (w - z).im
    have h2 := (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - z)).trans hw
    linarith
  have cauchy_deriv_ball :
      ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (R M : ℝ),
        0 < R → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ U →
        (∀ w ∈ U, ‖f w‖ ≤ M) →
        ‖deriv f z‖ ≤ M / R := by
    intro U f z R M hR hf hsub hbd
    exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR
      (hf.diffContOnCl_ball hsub)
      (fun w hw => hbd w (hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)))
  have diffOp_bound_of_deriv_bound :
      ∀ (w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (z t' : ℂ) (σ_in M : ℝ),
        |z.im| + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |t'.im| < σ_in →
        (∀ w_z ∈ horizStrip σ_in, ‖deriv (fun y' : ℂ => w (y', t')) w_z‖ ≤ M) →
        ‖glancingDiffOp w (z, t')‖ ≤ M := by
    intro w z t' σ_in M hz_in hbd
    unfold glancingDiffOp
    have hle := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := M)
      (a := (-1 / 2 : ℝ)) (b := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (f := fun μ : ℝ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => w (y', t')) (z + (μ : ℂ) * t')) ?_
    · have hab : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (-1 / 2 : ℝ)| = 1 := by norm_num
      rw [hab, mul_one] at hle
      exact hle
    · intro μ hμ
      have hμ_cc : μ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        have hsub := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hμ
        rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)] at hsub
      have hμ_abs : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hμ_cc.1], hμ_cc.2⟩
      have hmem : z + (μ : ℂ) * t' ∈ horizStrip σ_in := by
        change |(z + (μ : ℂ) * t').im| < σ_in
        have h1 := im_add_mul_real_le z t' μ
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hμ_abs (abs_nonneg t'.im)
        linarith
      exact hbd _ hmem
  have glancingDiffOp_mul_const :
      ∀ (w : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ),
        glancingDiffOp (fun q => w q * c) p = glancingDiffOp w p * c := by
    intro w p c
    simp only [glancingDiffOp, deriv_mul_const_field, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  have glancingResidualOp_slice :
      ∀ (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U (q.1, t)) (y, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) := by
    intro U y t
    have hAp : glancingAvgPlus (fun q => U (q.1, t)) y t = glancingAvgPlus U y t := by
      unfold glancingAvgPlus; rfl
    have hAm : glancingAvgMinus (fun q => U (q.1, t)) y t = glancingAvgMinus U y t := by
      unfold glancingAvgMinus; rfl
    have hC : glancingSecondAvg (fun q => U (q.1, t)) y t = glancingSecondAvg U y t := by
      unfold glancingSecondAvg; rfl
    simp only [glancingResidualOp, hAp, hAm, hC]
  have glancingLinCoeff_slice :
      ∀ (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => U (q.1, t)) (y, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) := by
    intro U y t
    have hW : glancingPhaseSlope B (fun q => U (q.1, t)) y t = glancingPhaseSlope B U y t := by
      unfold glancingPhaseSlope; rfl
    simp only [glancingLinCoeff, hW]
  have glancingResidualOp_congr_strip :
      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (w₁ w₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
        |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, w₁ z = w₂ z) →
        glancingResidualOp B (fun q => w₁ q.1) (y, t) =
          glancingResidualOp B (fun q => w₂ q.1) (y, t) := by
    intro σ y t w₁ w₂ hyt heq
    have hw_ev : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, w₁ =ᶠ[nhds z] w₂ := fun z hz =>
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip σ).mem_nhds hz) heq
    have hw1 : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv w₁ z = deriv w₂ z := fun z hz =>
      (hw_ev z hz).deriv_eq
    have hw2 : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv (deriv w₁) z = deriv (deriv w₂) z := fun z hz =>
      (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip σ).mem_nhds hz) hw1).deriv_eq
    have mem_shift : ∀ c : ℝ, |c| ≤ 1 → y + (c : ℂ) * t ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro c hc
      change |(y + (c : ℂ) * t).im| < σ
      have h1 := im_add_mul_real_le y t c
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (abs_nonneg t.im)
      linarith
    have hy_mem : y ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      simpa using mem_shift 0 (by norm_num)
    have hAp : glancingAvgPlus (fun q => w₁ q.1) y t = glancingAvgPlus (fun q => w₂ q.1) y t := by
      unfold glancingAvgPlus
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro lam hlam
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      exact hw1 _ (mem_shift lam (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hlam.1], hlam.2⟩))
    have hAm : glancingAvgMinus (fun q => w₁ q.1) y t = glancingAvgMinus (fun q => w₂ q.1) y t := by
      unfold glancingAvgMinus
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro lam hlam
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      dsimp only
      have hsub : y - (lam : ℂ) * t = y + ((-lam : ℝ) : ℂ) * t := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hsub]
      exact hw1 _ (mem_shift (-lam) (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hlam.2], by linarith [hlam.1]⟩))
    have hC : glancingSecondAvg (fun q => w₁ q.1) y t = glancingSecondAvg (fun q => w₂ q.1) y t := by
      unfold glancingSecondAvg
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro lam hlam
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro μ hμ
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith [hlam.1] : -lam ≤ lam)] at hμ
      exact hw2 _ (mem_shift μ (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hμ.1, hlam.2], by linarith [hμ.2, hlam.2]⟩))
    simp only [glancingResidualOp, hAp, hAm, hC, hw1 y hy_mem, heq y hy_mem]
  have hasDerivAt_comp_2d :
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ w₀ ζ₀ d₁ d₂ : ℂ) (γ₁ γ₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → (z₀, w₀) ∈ W →
        γ₁ ζ₀ = z₀ → γ₂ ζ₀ = w₀ →
        HasDerivAt γ₁ d₁ ζ₀ → HasDerivAt γ₂ d₂ ζ₀ →
        HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => F (γ₁ ζ, γ₂ ζ))
          (d₁ * deriv (fun z : ℂ => F (z, w₀)) z₀ +
            d₂ * deriv (fun w : ℂ => F (z₀, w)) w₀) ζ₀ := by
    intro W F z₀ w₀ ζ₀ d₁ d₂ γ₁ γ₂ hW hF hp₀ hγ₁₀ hγ₂₀ hγ₁ hγ₂
    have hFf : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℂ F (z₀, w₀)) (z₀, w₀) :=
      (hF.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp₀)).hasFDerivAt

    change ‖E_next - (E_prev + T_lead)‖ ≤ M_next * ‖t‖ ^ (2 * j + 2)
    rw [hsplit]
    calc ‖(E_next - E_prev - (L_lin + L_drift)) + (L_lin - T_lead) + L_drift‖
        ≤ ‖E_next - E_prev - (L_lin + L_drift)‖ + ‖L_lin - T_lead‖ + ‖L_drift‖ := by
          exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) (le_refl _))
      _ ≤ C_quad * M_u3 ^ 2 * ‖t‖ ^ (2 * j + 2) +
            (M_F / d₁ ^ 2) * ‖t‖ ^ (2 * j + 2) +
            (128 / (123 * δ_s)) * M_prev * M_u * ‖t‖ ^ (2 * j + 2) := by
          linarith [hquad_step.trans hb_quad, hb_lin, hb_drift]
      _ = M_next * ‖t‖ ^ (2 * j + 2) := by
          dsimp [M_next]; ring
  exact ⟨{
    C_quad := C_quad
    C_quad_pos := hC_quad_pos
    formal_perturbation := hPert
    slice_quad_approx := hQuad
    exact_jet_deriv := hJet
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) :
    (M.h_X 0 = ⊤ → Nonempty (EntireTubeObstructionData C M K L)) ∧
    (∀ (H t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ),
      M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H →
      |t₀| < L.r_star →
      M.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ ⊤ →
      0 < ε → ε < L.s_star →
      ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧

          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,

            |p.1.im - (finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ) - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = L.𝔰 p)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h_eqOn_convex : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
      IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
      p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ →
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p := by
    intro W f g p₀ r₀ hW_open hW_conv hf hg hp₀ hr₀ hball p hp
    let φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (p₀.1 + z * (p.1 - p₀.1), p₀.2 + z * (p.2 - p₀.2))
    have hφ_diff : Differentiable ℂ φ :=
      (differentiable_const _ |>.add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _))).prodMk
        (differentiable_const _ |>.add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
    let Ω_z : Set ℂ := φ ⁻¹' W
    have hΩ_open : IsOpen Ω_z := hW_open.preimage hφ_diff.continuous
    have hΩ_conv : Convex ℝ Ω_z := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      have h_aff : φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • φ z₁ + b • φ z₂ := by
        have hab_c : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
        ext
        · simp only [φ, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -hab_c * p₀.1
        · simp only [φ, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -hab_c * p₀.2
      show φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ W
      rw [h_aff]
      exact hW_conv hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
      show φ 0 ∈ W
      simpa [φ] using hp₀
    have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
      show φ 1 ∈ W
      simpa [φ] using hp
    have hd_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f (φ z) - g (φ z)) Ω_z :=
      (hf.sub hg).comp hφ_diff.differentiableOn (fun z hz => hz)
    have hd_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f (φ z) - g (φ z)) Ω_z :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hΩ_open).mpr hd_diff
    have hev0 : ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : ℂ), f (φ z) - g (φ z) = 0 := by
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = p₀ := by simp [φ]
      have hmem : ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : ℂ), φ z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ := by
        apply hφ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually
        rw [hφ0]
        exact Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀)
      exact hmem.mono (fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hball (φ z) hz))
    have h1_zero := hd_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hΩ_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem hev0 h1_mem
    change f (φ 1) - g (φ 1) = 0 at h1_zero
    have hφ1 : φ 1 = p := by simp [φ]
    rw [hφ1] at h1_zero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h1_zero
  have h_eqOn_zero : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0 := by
    intro W V hW_open hW_conv hV_open ⟨p₀, hp₀V⟩ hVW f hf_holo hV_zero
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hball_V⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p₀ hp₀V
    exact h_eqOn_convex hW_open hW_conv hf_holo (differentiableOn_const 0)
      (hVW hp₀V) hr₀_pos (fun q hq => hV_zero q (hball_V hq))
  have hr_star_lt_base : L.r_star < M.r_base := by
    linarith [L.r_star_le, K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
  have hs_star_le_quarter_base : L.s_star ≤ M.s_base / 4 := by
    linarith [L.s_star_le, K.s_init_le]
  have hs_star_lt_base : L.s_star < M.s_base := by
    linarith [hs_star_le_quarter_base, M.s_base_pos]
  have h0_rbase : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
  have h_hX0_pos : 0 < M.h_X 0 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos) (M.h_X_ge 0 h0_rbase)
  have h_base_sub_T_mero :
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } ⊆
        meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := by
    intro p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩
    have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj]
      exact hp_t
    have him := abs_lt.mp hp_im
    refine ⟨hp_t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
        ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr (by linarith))
        (M.h_X_ge _ hconj_ball)
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
        ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr him.2)
        (M.h_X_ge _ ht_ball)
  have h_rect_open_conv : ∀ (x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (r_t : ℝ),
      IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_lo < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_hi ∧ ‖p.2 - t_c‖ < r_t } ∧
      Convex ℝ { p : ℂ × ℂ | x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_lo < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_hi ∧ ‖p.2 - t_c‖ < r_t } := by
    intro x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi t_c r_t
    have h_eq : { p : ℂ × ℂ | x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_lo < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_hi ∧ ‖p.2 - t_c‖ < r_t } =
        ((Complex.reCLM ⁻¹' Set.Ioo x_lo x_hi) ∩
          (Complex.imCLM ⁻¹' Set.Ioo y_lo y_hi)) ×ˢ
          Metric.ball t_c r_t := by
      ext ⟨y, t⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
        Complex.reCLM_apply, Set.mem_Ioo, Complex.imCLM_apply, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      tauto
    rw [h_eq]
    refine ⟨((isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
    exact (((convex_Ioo x_lo x_hi).linear_preimage Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap).inter
      ((convex_Ioo y_lo y_hi).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap)).prod
      (convex_ball t_c r_t)
  have h_lsc_ball : ∀ (t_c : ℂ) (c_val : ℝ),
      t_c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base →
      ENNReal.ofReal c_val < M.h_X t_c →
      ∃ δ_l : ℝ, 0 < δ_l ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t - t_c‖ < δ_l → ENNReal.ofReal c_val < M.h_X t := by
    intro t_c c_val ht_c hc
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t in nhds t_c, ENNReal.ofReal c_val < M.h_X t := by
      have h1 := M.h_X_lsc t_c ht_c (ENNReal.ofReal c_val) hc
      rwa [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht_c)] at h1
    obtain ⟨δ_l, hδ_l, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev
    exact ⟨δ_l, hδ_l, fun t ht => hball t (by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm])⟩
  have h_T_mero_open : IsOpen (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) := by
    have h_sep : ∀ (a : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ),
        t_c ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base →
        ENNReal.ofReal a < M.h_X t_c →
        ∃ c_a : ℝ, a < c_a ∧ ENNReal.ofReal c_a < M.h_X t_c := by
      intro a t_c ht_c ha_lt
      by_cases ha_s : a < M.s_base / 2
      · refine ⟨M.s_base / 2, ha_s, ?_⟩
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le
          ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr (by linarith [M.s_base_pos]))
          (M.h_X_ge t_c ht_c)
      · push_neg at ha_s
        have ha_pos : 0 < a := by linarith [M.s_base_pos]
        rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X t_c) with htop | hlt
        · exact ⟨a + 1, by linarith, htop ▸ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
        · let H_c : ℝ := (M.h_X t_c).toReal
          have hHc_eq : M.h_X t_c = ENNReal.ofReal H_c :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hlt)).symm
          rw [hHc_eq] at ha_lt
          have hHc_pos : 0 < H_c :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (lt_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr ha_pos) ha_lt)
          have ha_Hc : a < H_c := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hHc_pos).mp ha_lt
          refine ⟨(a + H_c) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
          rw [hHc_eq]
          exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hHc_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro p ⟨hp_t, hp_neg, hp_pos⟩
    have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj]
      exact hp_t
    obtain ⟨c_pos, hc_pos_gt, hc_pos_lt⟩ := h_sep p.1.im p.2 ht_ball hp_pos
    obtain ⟨δ_pos, hδ_pos, hball_pos⟩ := h_lsc_ball p.2 c_pos ht_ball hc_pos_lt
    obtain ⟨c_neg, hc_neg_gt, hc_neg_lt⟩ := h_sep (-p.1.im) (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) hconj_ball hp_neg
    obtain ⟨δ_neg, hδ_neg, hball_neg⟩ := h_lsc_ball (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) c_neg hconj_ball hc_neg_lt
    let r_p : ℝ :=
      min (M.r_base - ‖p.2‖)
        (min (min (c_pos - p.1.im) (c_neg + p.1.im)) (min δ_pos δ_neg))
    have hr_p_pos : 0 < r_p :=
      lt_min (by linarith)
        (lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (lt_min hδ_pos hδ_neg))
    refine ⟨r_p, hr_p_pos, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at hq
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hq
    have hr1 : r_p ≤ M.r_base - ‖p.2‖ := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_cpos : r_p ≤ c_pos - p.1.im :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hr_cneg : r_p ≤ c_neg + p.1.im :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hr_dpos : r_p ≤ δ_pos :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hr_dneg : r_p ≤ δ_neg :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have him_diff : |q.1.im - p.1.im| < r_p := by
      have h : (q.1 - p.1).im = q.1.im - p.1.im := by simp
      rw [← h]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hq1
    have him_b := abs_lt.mp him_diff
    have hq2_norm : ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base := by
      have htri : ‖q.2‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ + ‖q.2 - p.2‖ := norm_le_insert' q.2 p.2
      linarith
    have hconj_dist : ‖starRingEnd ℂ q.2 - starRingEnd ℂ p.2‖ < δ_neg := by
      rw [← map_sub, Complex.norm_conj]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 hr_dneg
    refine ⟨hq2_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith))
        (hball_neg (starRingEnd ℂ q.2) hconj_dist)
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith))
        (hball_pos q.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 hr_dpos))
  have h_bshift_real : ∀ (t₀ : ℝ), |t₀| < M.r_base →
      (L.b_shift (t₀ : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ δ_b : ℝ, 0 < δ_b ∧
        ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ_b →
          ‖L.b_shift t - L.b_shift (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < η := by
    intro t₀ ht₀
    have ht₀_ball : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact ht₀
    have him : (L.b_shift (t₀ : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
      have hconj := L.b_shift_conj (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
    refine ⟨him, fun η hη => ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousAt L.b_shift (t₀ : ℂ) :=
      L.b_shift_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht₀_ball)
    obtain ⟨δ_b, hδ_b, hball⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont η hη
    exact ⟨δ_b, hδ_b, fun t ht => by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hball (by rwa [dist_eq_norm])⟩
  
  have h_pole_clear : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (s₁ : ℂ), s₁ ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
      ∃ (r₁ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (N_hol : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r₁ ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ N_hol (Metric.ball s₁ r₁) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₁ r₁, z ≠ s₁ →
          K.f z ≠ 0 ∧ (z - s₁) ^ N * K.Γ z i = N_hol z := by
    intro i s₁ hs₁
    have hDH_open : IsOpen (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) :=
      isOpen_lt (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im))
        continuous_const
    have hDH_conv : Convex ℝ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      have him_le : |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| ≤ max |z₁.im| |z₂.im| := by
        have h1 : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
        rw [h1]
        calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im|
            ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          _ ≤ a * max |z₁.im| |z₂.im| + b * max |z₁.im| |z₂.im| := by
              gcongr
              · exact le_max_left _ _
              · exact le_max_right _ _
          _ = (a + b) * max |z₁.im| |z₂.im| := by ring
          _ = max |z₁.im| |z₂.im| := by rw [hab, one_mul]
      show ENNReal.ofReal |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < M.h_X 0
      calc ENNReal.ofReal |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im|
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (max |z₁.im| |z₂.im|) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal him_le
        _ < M.h_X 0 := by
            rcases max_choice |z₁.im| |z₂.im| with hmax | hmax <;> rw [hmax]
            · exact hz₁
            · exact hz₂
    have h0_DH : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
      show ENNReal.ofReal |(0 : ℂ).im| < M.h_X 0
      simpa using h_hX0_pos
    have hf0_ne : K.f 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos := (K.f_real_pos 0).1
      simp [h0] at hpos
    have hf_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ K.f (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hDH_open).mpr K.f_holo
    have hf_punc : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s₁ {s₁}ᶜ, K.f z ≠ 0 := by
      rcases (hf_ana s₁ hs₁).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hev0 | hev_ne

            refine ⟨γ η, ⟨η, ⟨hη0, hηH₁⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
            rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
            exact ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
          let ε : ℝ := min ε_W (min δ₀ (L.s_star / 2))
          have hε_pos : 0 < ε :=
            lt_min hε_W_pos (lt_min hδ₀_pos (by linarith [L.s_star_pos]))
          have hε_le_W : ε ≤ ε_W := min_le_left _ _
          have hε_le_δ₀ : ε ≤ δ₀ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
          have hε_le_half_s : ε ≤ L.s_star / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
          have hε_lt_s : ε < L.s_star := by linarith [L.s_star_pos]
          have hBnorm_sub_W :
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
                ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ⊆ W := by
            intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
            exact h_in_W_of_dist p H₁ (le_of_lt hH₁_pos) le_rfl
              (lt_of_lt_of_le hp1 hε_le_W) (lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 hε_le_W)
          have hc_lsc : ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 16) < M.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) := by
            rw [hH₁_eq]
            exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₁_pos).mpr (by linarith)
          obtain ⟨δ_lsc, hδ_lsc_pos, hδ_lsc⟩ := h_lsc_ball (t₀ : ℂ) (H₁ - ε / 16) ht₀_ball hc_lsc
          obtain ⟨δ_sh, hδ_sh_pos, hδ_sh⟩ := hb_cont (ε / 16) (by linarith)
          let δ₁ : ℝ := min ε (min (L.r_star - |t₀|) (min δ_lsc δ_sh))
          have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ :=
            lt_min hε_pos (lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min hδ_lsc_pos hδ_sh_pos))
          have hδ₁_le_ε : δ₁ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
          have hδ₁_le_rstar : δ₁ ≤ L.r_star - |t₀| :=
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
          have hδ₁_le_lsc : δ₁ ≤ δ_lsc :=
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          have hδ₁_le_sh : δ₁ ≤ δ_sh :=
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
          let V_bridge : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
            { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              x₀ - ε / 4 < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x₀ + ε / 4 ∧
              -ε / 4 < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < H₁ - ε / 8 ∧
              ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ₁ }
          obtain ⟨hVb_open, hVb_conv⟩ :=
            h_rect_open_conv (x₀ - ε / 4) (x₀ + ε / 4) (-ε / 4) (H₁ - ε / 8) (t₀ : ℂ) δ₁
          have hVb_sub_W : V_bridge ⊆ W := by
            intro p ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
            let η : ℝ := max 0 p.1.im
            have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := le_max_left 0 p.1.im
            have hηH₁ : η ≤ H₁ := max_le (le_of_lt hH₁_pos) (by linarith)
            have him_η : |p.1.im - η| < ε / 4 := by
              by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ p.1.im
              · have h_eq : η = p.1.im := max_eq_right h0
                rw [h_eq, sub_self, abs_zero]
                linarith
              · push_neg at h0
                have h_eq : η = 0 := max_eq_left (le_of_lt h0)
                rw [h_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt]
                exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            have hre_x : |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            have hp1_norm : ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε_W := by
              have hre_eq : (p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re = p.1.re - x₀ := by simp
              have him_eq : (p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = p.1.im - η := by simp
              calc ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
                  ≤ |(p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re| +
                      |(p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| :=
                    Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _
                _ = |p.1.re - x₀| + |p.1.im - η| := by rw [hre_eq, him_eq]
                _ < ε / 4 + ε / 4 := add_lt_add hre_x him_η
                _ ≤ ε_W := by linarith
            exact h_in_W_of_dist p η hη0 hηH₁ hp1_norm
              (lt_of_lt_of_le hp5 (le_trans hδ₁_le_ε hε_le_W))
          have hVb_sub_Tnorm : V_bridge ⊆ L.T_norm := by
            intro p ⟨_, _, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
            rw [L.T_norm_iff]
            have hp2_rstar : ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star := by
              have htri : ‖p.2‖ ≤ ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ := norm_le_insert' p.2 (t₀ : ℂ)
              rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at htri
              linarith
            have hp2_rbase : ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base := lt_trans hp2_rstar hr_star_lt_base
            have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
              rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj]
              exact hp2_rbase
            have hb_im : |(L.b_shift p.2).im| < ε / 16 := by
              have hdiff := hδ_sh p.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le hp5 hδ₁_le_sh)
              have h1 : (L.b_shift p.2 - L.b_shift (t₀ : ℂ)).im = (L.b_shift p.2).im := by
                simp [hb₀_im]
              rw [← h1]
              exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hdiff
            have hb_im_b := abs_lt.mp hb_im
            have him_eq : (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im = p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im := by simp
            refine ⟨hp2_rstar, hp2_rbase, ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [him_eq]
              calc ENNReal.ofReal (-(p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im))
                  < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
                    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr (by linarith)
                _ ≤ M.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) := M.h_X_ge _ hconj_ball
            · rw [him_eq]
              have hc_pos : 0 < H₁ - ε / 16 := by linarith
              calc ENNReal.ofReal (p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im)
                  < ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 16) :=
                    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hc_pos).mpr (by linarith)
                _ < M.h_X p.2 := hδ_lsc p.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le hp5 hδ₁_le_lsc)
          let p_base : ℂ × ℂ := ((x₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))
          let r_base_ball : ℝ := min (ε / 8) δ₁
          have hr_base_ball_pos : 0 < r_base_ball := lt_min (by linarith) hδ₁_pos
          have hp_base_mem : p_base ∈ V_bridge := by
            refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [p_base] <;> linarith
          have hball_base : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_base r_base_ball,
              q ∈ V_bridge ∧ s_tilde q = L.𝔰 q := by
            intro q hq
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at hq
            obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hq
            have hq1_e8 : ‖q.1 - (x₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε / 8 := lt_of_lt_of_le hq1 (min_le_left _ _)
            have hq2_δ₁ : ‖q.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hq2 (min_le_right _ _)
            have hre_lt : |q.1.re - x₀| < ε / 8 := by
              have h : (q.1 - (x₀ : ℂ)).re = q.1.re - x₀ := by simp
              rw [← h]
              exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hq1_e8
            have him_lt : |q.1.im| < ε / 8 := by
              have h : (q.1 - (x₀ : ℂ)).im = q.1.im := by simp
              rw [← h]
              exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hq1_e8
            have hre_b := abs_lt.mp hre_lt
            have him_b := abs_lt.mp him_lt
            refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, hq2_δ₁⟩, ?_⟩
            exact (hs_eq q.1 q.2 (by linarith)
              (lt_of_lt_of_le hq2_δ₁ (le_trans hδ₁_le_ε hε_le_δ₀))).2
          have hs_eq_Vb : ∀ p ∈ V_bridge, s_tilde p = L.𝔰 p :=
            h_eqOn_convex hVb_open hVb_conv
              (hs_holo.mono hVb_sub_W) (L.𝔰_holo.mono hVb_sub_Tnorm)
              hp_base_mem hr_base_ball_pos
              (fun q hq => (hball_base q hq).2)
          refine h_norm_no_patch t₀ x₀ H₁ ε ht₀ hH₁_eq hε_pos hε_lt_s
            ⟨s_tilde, hs_holo.mono hBnorm_sub_W, ?_, δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_le_ε, ?_⟩
          · intro p _ _
            show ENNReal.ofReal |(s_tilde p).im| < M.h_X 0
            rw [hTop]
            exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
          · intro p hp_re hp_im hp_t
            have hre_b := abs_lt.mp hp_re
            have him_b := abs_lt.mp hp_im
            exact hs_eq_Vb p ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, hp_t⟩
    }⟩
  · 
    intro H t₀ x₀ ε hH ht₀ ht_ne_top hε0 hεs
    rintro ⟨g, hg_holo, hg_maps, δ, hδ0, hδ_le, hg_eq⟩
    have ht₀_base : |t₀| < M.r_base := lt_trans ht₀ hr_star_lt_base
    obtain ⟨hb₀_im, _⟩ := h_bshift_real t₀ ht₀_base
    have hH₁_def : finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ) = (M.h_X (t₀ : ℂ)).toReal := by
      simp [finiteWallWidthFn, hb₀_im]
    have hH₁_eq : M.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal (finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
      rw [hH₁_def, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal ht_ne_top]
    have hH_pos : 0 < H := by
      have hpos : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal H := hH ▸ h_hX0_pos
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp hpos
    refine h_norm_no_patch t₀ x₀ (finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ : ℂ)) ε ht₀ hH₁_eq hε0 hεs
      ⟨g, hg_holo, ?_, δ, hδ0, hδ_le, hg_eq⟩
    intro p hp1 hp2
    have him_lt_H : |(g p).im| < H := hg_maps p hp1 hp2
    show ENNReal.ofReal |(g p).im| < M.h_X 0
    rw [hH]
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos).mpr him_lt_H

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K)
    (H : ℝ) (hH : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H) :
    0 < H ∧
    L.s_star < H ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, M.h_X t ≠ ⊤) ∧
    finiteWallTube L.r_star (finiteWallWidthFn M L) = L.T_norm ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star,
      L.s_star ≤ finiteWallWidthFn M L t ∧ finiteWallWidthFn M L t ≤ H) ∧
    finiteWallWidthFn M L 0 = H ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star,
      finiteWallWidthFn M L (-t) = finiteWallWidthFn M L t) ∧
    LowerSemicontinuousOn (finiteWallWidthFn M L) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star) ∧
    IsOpen (finiteWallTube L.r_star (finiteWallWidthFn M L)) ∧
    (∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < L.r_star →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun θ : ℝ => H - finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
        (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      H - finiteWallWidthFn M L t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (H - finiteWallWidthFn M L (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h0_mem_base : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
  have hs_base_ennr : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H := by
    have hge := M.h_X_ge 0 h0_mem_base
    rwa [hH] at hge
  have hH_pos : 0 < H := by
    have hpos_ennr : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos_ennr hs_base_ennr)
  have hs_base_le_H : M.s_base ≤ H :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH_pos)).mp hs_base_ennr
  have h4s_le_base : 4 * L.s_star ≤ M.s_base := by
    linarith [L.s_star_pos, L.s_star_le, K.s_init_le]
  have hs_lt_H : L.s_star < H := by
    linarith [L.s_star_pos]
  have hr_lt_base : L.r_star < M.r_base := by
    linarith [L.r_star_pos, L.r_star_le, K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
  have hB_sub : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hr_lt_base)
  have hStrip : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ↔ |s.im| < H := by
    intro s
    change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H
    rw [hH]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos
  have hb_im_abs : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, |(L.b_shift t).im| < L.s_star / 4 := by
    intro t ht
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (L.b_shift t)) (L.b_shift_small t ht)
  have h_conj_mem : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star,
      starRingEnd ℂ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj]
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
  have hw_ge_of_ne_top : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, M.h_X t ≠ ⊤ →
      3 * L.s_star ≤ finiteWallWidthFn M L t := by
    intro t ht htop
    have hge_raw : M.s_base ≤ (M.h_X t).toReal :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal htop).mp (M.h_X_ge t (hB_sub ht))
    have hbim : -(L.s_star / 4) < (L.b_shift t).im := (abs_lt.mp (hb_im_abs t ht)).1
    unfold finiteWallWidthFn
    linarith [L.s_star_pos]
  have h_ennr_ge : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star,
      ENNReal.ofReal (3 * L.s_star) ≤ L.h_X_ennr t := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases htop : M.h_X t = ⊤
    · simp [NormalizedGlobalLiftData.h_X_ennr, shiftWidthENNR, htop]
    · have hw3 := hw_ge_of_ne_top t ht htop
      simpa [NormalizedGlobalLiftData.h_X_ennr, shiftWidthENNR, htop, finiteWallWidthFn] using
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hw3
  
  have h_ennr_le : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star,
      L.h_X_ennr t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H := by
    intro t ht
    by_contra h_not_le
    have hgt : ENNReal.ofReal H < L.h_X_ennr t := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
    have hδ_exists : ∃ δ_η : ℝ, 0 < δ_η ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (H + δ_η) < L.h_X_ennr t := by
      by_cases hfin : L.h_X_ennr t = ⊤
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, hfin ▸ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
      · have hH_lt_U : H < (L.h_X_ennr t).toReal :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal (le_of_lt hH_pos) hfin).mp hgt
        refine ⟨((L.h_X_ennr t).toReal - H) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal (by linarith) hfin).mpr (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨δ_η, hδ_pos, hδ_lt⟩ := hδ_exists
    let S_rect : Set ℂ := { z : ℂ | -L.s_star < z.im ∧ z.im < H + δ_η }
    have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < L.r_star := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
    have h_in_tube : ∀ z ∈ S_rect, (z, t) ∈ L.T_norm := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (-z.im) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal L.s_star :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith [hz.1])
        have h2 : ENNReal.ofReal L.s_star < ENNReal.ofReal (3 * L.s_star) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith [L.s_star_pos])).mpr
            (by linarith [L.s_star_pos])
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2)
          (h_ennr_ge (starRingEnd ℂ t) (h_conj_mem t ht))
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_lt hz.2)) hδ_lt
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => L.𝔰 (z, t) - z
    have h_pair_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, t)) :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)
    have h_s_holo_rect : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => L.𝔰 (z, t)) S_rect :=
      L.𝔰_holo.comp h_pair_diff.differentiableOn h_in_tube
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g S_rect :=
      h_s_holo_rect.sub differentiableOn_id
    let z₀ : ℂ := 0
    let w₀ : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hz₀_re : z₀.re = 0 := Complex.zero_re
    have hz₀_im : z₀.im = 0 := Complex.zero_im
    have hw₀_re : w₀.re = 2 * Real.pi := by simp [w₀]
    have hw₀_im : w₀.im = H := by simp [w₀]
    have h_rect_sub : Set.uIcc z₀.re w₀.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z₀.im w₀.im ⊆ S_rect := by
      intro z hz
      have hzim : z.im ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) H := by
        simpa [Complex.mem_reProdIm, hz₀_im, hw₀_im] using hz.2
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (le_of_lt hH_pos)] at hzim
      exact ⟨by linarith [L.s_star_pos, hzim.1], by linarith [hzim.2, hδ_pos]⟩

      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      calc ‖z‖ = ‖(z - t₀) + t₀‖ := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ ‖z - t₀‖ + ‖t₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ρ + ‖t₀‖ := by linarith
        _ < M.r_base := by linarith
    have h_cint :=
      (L.b_shift_holo.mono h_cb_sub).circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)
    have h_cint_lhs :
        (∮ z in C(t₀, ρ), (z - t₀)⁻¹ • L.b_shift z) =
          Complex.I * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), L.b_shift (γ θ) := by
      rw [circleIntegral]
      have hcongr :
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            deriv (circleMap t₀ ρ) θ •
              ((circleMap t₀ ρ θ - t₀)⁻¹ • L.b_shift (circleMap t₀ ρ θ))) =
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.I * L.b_shift (γ θ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro θ _
        dsimp only
        have hne : circleMap 0 ρ θ ≠ 0 := @circleMap_ne_center 0 ρ (ne_of_gt hρ) θ
        have hmap : circleMap t₀ ρ θ = γ θ := by simp [circleMap, γ]
        rw [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center, hmap, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        calc (circleMap 0 ρ θ * Complex.I) * ((circleMap 0 ρ θ)⁻¹ * L.b_shift (γ θ))
            = (circleMap 0 ρ θ * (circleMap 0 ρ θ)⁻¹) * (Complex.I * L.b_shift (γ θ)) := by ring
          _ = 1 * (Complex.I * L.b_shift (γ θ)) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hne]
          _ = Complex.I * L.b_shift (γ θ) := one_mul _
      rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [h_cint_lhs, smul_eq_mul] at h_cint
    have h_int_b_complex :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), L.b_shift (γ θ)) =
          (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * L.b_shift t₀ := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
      calc Complex.I * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), L.b_shift (γ θ)
          = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) * L.b_shift t₀ := h_cint
        _ = Complex.I * ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * L.b_shift t₀) := by ring
    have hb_complex_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => L.b_shift (γ θ)) :=
      (L.b_shift_holo.mono hB_sub).continuousOn.comp_continuous hγ_cont hγ_mem
    have hb_im_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im) :=
      Complex.continuous_im.comp hb_complex_cont
    have hb_int :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hb_im_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hb_complex_int :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => L.b_shift (γ θ))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hb_complex_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hb_im_int_eq :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im) =
          (2 * Real.pi) * (L.b_shift t₀).im := by
      have him := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm hb_complex_int
      calc (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im)
          = Complex.imCLM (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), L.b_shift (γ θ)) := him
        _ = ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) * L.b_shift t₀).im := by rw [h_int_b_complex]; rfl
        _ = (2 * Real.pi) * (L.b_shift t₀).im := by simp [Complex.mul_im]
    
    let e : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have he_cont : Continuous e :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have he_per : ∀ θ : ℝ, e (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = e θ := by
      intro θ
      dsimp only [e]
      have hsplit : ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hsplit, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    let Φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n θ φ => g_M φ + (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖
    let I_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n θ => iInf (fun φ : ℝ => Φ n θ φ)
    let q_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n θ => I_seq n θ - M.s_base / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have hΦ_bdd : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, BddBelow (Set.range (fun φ : ℝ => Φ n θ φ)) := by
      intro n θ
      refine ⟨M.s_base, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨φ, rfl⟩
      have hge := (hg_raw_bounds (γ φ) (hγ_mem φ)).1
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (norm_nonneg _)
      dsimp only [Φ, g_M]
      linarith
    have hI_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, M.s_base ≤ I_seq n θ := by
      intro n θ
      refine le_ciInf (fun φ => ?_)
      have hge := (hg_raw_bounds (γ φ) (hγ_mem φ)).1
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (norm_nonneg _)
      dsimp only [Φ, g_M]
      linarith
    have hI_le : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, I_seq n θ ≤ g_M θ := by
      intro n θ
      have hle := ciInf_le (hΦ_bdd n θ) θ
      simpa [Φ] using hle
    have hshift_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < M.s_base / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      intro n
      exact div_pos M.s_base_pos (by positivity)
    have hshift_le_half : ∀ n : ℕ, M.s_base / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ M.s_base / 2 := by
      intro n
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt M.s_base_pos) two_pos
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      linarith
    have hq_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < q_seq n θ := by
      intro n θ
      have h1 := hI_ge n θ
      have h2 := hshift_le_half n
      dsimp only [q_seq]
      linarith [M.s_base_pos]
    have hq_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ : ℝ, q_seq n θ < g_M θ := by
      intro n θ
      have h1 := hI_le n θ
      have h2 := hshift_pos n
      dsimp only [q_seq]
      linarith
    have hq_per : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Periodic (q_seq n) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro n θ
      have hI_eq : I_seq n (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = I_seq n θ := by
        dsimp only [I_seq, Φ]
        simp only [he_per θ]
      dsimp only [q_seq]
      rw [hI_eq]
    have hI_lip : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, I_seq n θ₁ - I_seq n θ₂ ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ := by
      intro n θ₁ θ₂
      have hle : I_seq n θ₁ - (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ ≤ I_seq n θ₂ := by
        refine le_ciInf (fun φ => ?_)
        have h1 : I_seq n θ₁ ≤ g_M φ + (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e φ‖ := ciInf_le (hΦ_bdd n θ₁) φ
        have htri : ‖e θ₁ - e φ‖ ≤ ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ + ‖e θ₂ - e φ‖ := by
          calc ‖e θ₁ - e φ‖ = ‖(e θ₁ - e θ₂) + (e θ₂ - e φ)‖ := by congr 1; ring
            _ ≤ ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ + ‖e θ₂ - e φ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        have hmul :
            (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e φ‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ + (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₂ - e φ‖ := by
          calc (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e φ‖
              ≤ (n : ℝ) * (‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ + ‖e θ₂ - e φ‖) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htri (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
            _ = (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₁ - e θ₂‖ + (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ₂ - e φ‖ := mul_add _ _ _
        dsimp only [Φ]
        linarith
      linarith
    have hq_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (q_seq n) := by
      intro n
      rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      intro θ₀ ε hε
      have hn1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuous_iff.mp he_cont θ₀ (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
        (div_pos hε hn1_pos)
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun θ hθ => ?_⟩
      have he_dist : ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ < ε / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ θ hθ
      have hb1 := hI_lip n θ θ₀
      have hb2 := hI_lip n θ₀ θ
      rw [norm_sub_rev (e θ₀) (e θ)] at hb2
      have habs : |q_seq n θ - q_seq n θ₀| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ := by
        have hdiff : q_seq n θ - q_seq n θ₀ = I_seq n θ - I_seq n θ₀ := by
          dsimp only [q_seq]; ring
        rw [hdiff, abs_le]
        have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ := norm_nonneg _
        constructor <;> linarith
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      calc |q_seq n θ - q_seq n θ₀|
          ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ := habs
        _ < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left he_dist hn1_pos
        _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hn1_pos)
    have hq_tendsto :
        ∀ θ : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => q_seq n θ) Filter.atTop (nhds (g_M θ)) := by
      intro θ
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨U, hU_open, hU_eq⟩ :=
        lowerSemicontinuousOn_iff_preimage_Ioi.mp hlsc_raw (g_M θ - ε / 2)
      have hγθ_in : γ θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star ∩ U := by
        rw [← hU_eq]
        refine ⟨hγ_mem θ, ?_⟩
        change g_M θ - ε / 2 < g_M θ
        linarith
      obtain ⟨δ_z, hδ_z_pos, hball_sub⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hU_open) (γ θ) hγθ_in
      let δ : ℝ := δ_z / ρ
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hδ_z_pos hρ
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (g_M θ / δ) (M.s_base / ε))
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hn_real : (N : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
      have hN_left : g_M θ / δ < (n : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) (lt_of_lt_of_le hN hn_real)
      have hN_right : M.s_base / ε < (n : ℝ) :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) (lt_of_lt_of_le hN hn_real)
      have hI_lower : g_M θ - ε / 2 ≤ I_seq n θ := by
        refine le_ciInf (fun φ => ?_)
        by_cases hclose : ‖e φ - e θ‖ < δ
        · have hγ_dist : ‖γ φ - γ θ‖ < δ_z := by
            have hsub : γ φ - γ θ = (ρ : ℂ) * (e φ - e θ) := by dsimp [γ, e]; ring
            rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ]
            calc ρ * ‖e φ - e θ‖ < ρ * (δ_z / ρ) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hclose hρ
              _ = δ_z := mul_div_cancel₀ δ_z (ne_of_gt hρ)
          have hφ_in : γ φ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star ∩
              (fun t : ℂ => (M.h_X t).toReal) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (g_M θ - ε / 2) := by
            rw [hU_eq]
            apply hball_sub
            simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hγ_dist
          have hgφ : g_M θ - ε / 2 < g_M φ := hφ_in.2
          have hnn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (norm_nonneg _)
          dsimp only [Φ]
          linarith
        · have hfar : δ ≤ ‖e θ - e φ‖ := by
            rw [norm_sub_rev (e θ) (e φ)]
            exact le_of_not_gt hclose
          have hpen : g_M θ < (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖ := by
            have h1 : g_M θ < (n : ℝ) * δ := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ_pos).mp hN_left
            have h2 : (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖e θ - e φ‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfar (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
            linarith
          have hgφ_pos : 0 < g_M φ :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le M.s_base_pos (hg_raw_bounds (γ φ) (hγ_mem φ)).1
          dsimp only [Φ]
          linarith
      have hshift_lt : M.s_base / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) < ε / 2 := by
        have hs_lt : M.s_base < (n : ℝ) * ε := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hN_right
        have hden_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
        rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hden_pos two_pos]
        nlinarith
      have hq_upper := hq_lt n θ
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      dsimp only [q_seq] at hq_upper ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith
    have h_dom_conv :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_seq n θ)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_M θ)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
        (fun _ => H + L.s_star)
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hq_cont n).aestronglyMeasurable)
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ => ?_))
        have hpos := hq_pos n θ
        have hlt := hq_lt n θ
        have hle := (hg_raw_bounds (γ θ) (hγ_mem θ)).2
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos]
        dsimp only [g_M] at hlt
        linarith
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ => hq_tendsto θ)
    have h_supermean_n : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_seq n θ) ≤ (2 * Real.pi) * (M.h_X t₀).toReal := by
      intro n
      have hsm := M.h_X_supermean t₀ ρ hρ ht₀_ρ_base (q_seq n) (hq_cont n) (hq_per n)
        (fun θ => ⟨le_of_lt (hq_pos n θ),
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal (le_of_lt (hq_pos n θ))
            (h_ne_top (γ θ) (hγ_mem θ))).mpr (hq_lt n θ)⟩)
      have hsm_real : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_seq n θ) ≤
          (M.h_X t₀).toReal :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal (h_ne_top t₀ ht₀_mem)).mp hsm
      have h2pi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
      calc (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_seq n θ)
          = (2 * Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_seq n θ) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h2pi), one_mul]
        _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi) * (M.h_X t₀).toReal :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsm_real (le_of_lt h2pi)
    have hg_int_le :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_M θ) ≤ (2 * Real.pi) * (M.h_X t₀).toReal :=
      le_of_tendsto' h_dom_conv h_supermean_n
    have hd_int_split :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), d_γ θ) =
          (2 * Real.pi) * H -
            ((∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_M θ) +
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im) := by
      change (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (H - (g_M θ + (L.b_shift (γ θ)).im))) = _
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (hg_int.add hb_int),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hg_int hb_int]
    rw [hb_im_int_eq] at hd_int_split
    have hd_lower :
        (2 * Real.pi) * (H - finiteWallWidthFn M L t₀) ≤
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), d_γ θ := by
      unfold finiteWallWidthFn
      linarith
    have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le
    have hfinal := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_lower h2pi_inv_nonneg
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ Real.two_pi_pos.ne', one_mul] at hfinal
    exact ⟨hd_intOn, hfinal⟩
  exact ⟨hH_pos, hs_lt_H, h_ne_top, htube_eq, hbounds, hzero, heven, hlsc, htube_open, hdef_sub⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hδ0
  have hH_pos : 0 < H := by linarith [L.s_star_pos]
  have hStrip : horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) = horizStrip H := by
    ext s
    change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H
    rw [hH]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos
  have hStrip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hs_lt_base : L.s_star < M.s_base := by
    linarith [L.s_star_le, K.s_init_le, M.s_base_pos]
  have hr_lt_base : L.r_star < M.r_base := by
    linarith [L.r_star_le, K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]

  have h_conv_lt : ∀ {x y u v a b : ℝ},
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → x < u → y < v → a * x + b * y < a * u + b * v := by
    intro x y u v a b ha hb hab hxu hyv
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp only [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; simp [hyv]
    · have h1 : a * x < a * u := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxu ha_pos
      have h2 : b * y ≤ b * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hyv) hb
      linarith

  have h_conv_lt_right : ∀ {x y c a b : ℝ},
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → x < c → y < c → a * x + b * y < c := by
    intro x y c a b ha hb hab hxc hyc
    calc a * x + b * y < a * c + b * c := h_conv_lt ha hb hab hxc hyc
      _ = (a + b) * c := by ring
      _ = c := by rw [hab, one_mul]

  have h_conv_lt_left : ∀ {c u v a b : ℝ},
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → c < u → c < v → c < a * u + b * v := by
    intro c u v a b ha hb hab hcu hcv
    calc c = (a + b) * c := by rw [hab, one_mul]
      _ = a * c + b * c := by ring
      _ < a * u + b * v := h_conv_lt ha hb hab hcu hcv

  
  
  
  have h_id2D_ball : ∀ (c : ℂ × ℂ) (R : ℝ) {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      p₀ ∈ Metric.ball c R → 0 < r₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f z = 0) →
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball c R, f q = 0 := by
    intro c R p₀ r₀ f hp₀ hr₀ hf hzero q hq
    let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun w => (p₀.1 + w * (q.1 - p₀.1), p₀.2 + w * (q.2 - p₀.2))
    have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
      ((differentiable_const p₀.1).add (differentiable_id.mul_const (q.1 - p₀.1))).prodMk
        ((differentiable_const p₀.2).add (differentiable_id.mul_const (q.2 - p₀.2)))
    let U_1d : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball c R
    have hU_open : IsOpen U_1d := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ U_1d := by
      intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂ a b ha hb hab
      have habC : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have hγ_comb : γ (a • w₁ + b • w₂) = a • γ w₁ + b • γ w₂ := by
        ext
        · simp only [γ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_add, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -p₀.1 * habC
        · simp only [γ, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -p₀.2 * habC
      change γ (a • w₁ + b • w₂) ∈ Metric.ball c R
      rw [hγ_comb]
      exact convex_ball c R hw₁ hw₂ ha hb hab
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₀ := by ext <;> simp [γ]
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = q := by ext <;> simp [γ]
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U_1d := by change γ 0 ∈ Metric.ball c R; rwa [hγ0]
    have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ U_1d := by change γ 1 ∈ Metric.ball c R; rwa [hγ1]
    have hfγ_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun w => f (γ w)) U_1d :=
      (hf.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hw => hw)).analyticOnNhd hU_open
    have hfγ_ev : (fun w => f (γ w)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have h_pre : γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
        hγ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (by rw [hγ0]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr₀)
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem h_pre (fun w hw => hzero (γ w) hw)
    have h1_eq := hfγ_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hU_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem hfγ_ev h1_mem
    change f (γ 1) = 0 at h1_eq
    rwa [hγ1] at h1_eq

  have h_id2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0 := by
    intro W V hWo hWp hVo ⟨p_init, hp_init⟩ hVW f hf hV0
    let O_zero : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ W | ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r, f z = 0 }
    let O_nz : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ W | ∃ r > 0, Metric.ball p r ⊆ W \ O_zero }
    have hO_zero_open : IsOpen O_zero := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨hpW, r, hr, hsub⟩
      obtain ⟨rW, hrW, hballW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWo p hpW
      let r₀ := min r rW
      refine ⟨r₀, lt_min hr hrW, fun q hq => ⟨hballW (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq),
        r₀ - dist q p, sub_pos.mpr hq, ?_⟩⟩
      intro z hz
      exact hsub z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith) hz))
    have hO_nz_open : IsOpen O_nz := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩
      refine ⟨r, hr, fun q hq => ⟨(hsub hq).1, r - dist q p, sub_pos.mpr hq, ?_⟩⟩
      exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)) hsub
    have h_cov : W ⊆ O_zero ∪ O_nz := by
      intro p hpW
      obtain ⟨R, hR, hballW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWo p hpW
      by_cases hp0 : p ∈ O_zero
      · exact Or.inl hp0
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hpW, R, hR, fun q hq => ⟨hballW hq, fun ⟨_, rq, hrq, hqz⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
        exact hp0 ⟨hpW, R, hR, h_id2D_ball p R hq hrq (hf.mono hballW) hqz⟩
    have h_disj : W ∩ (O_zero ∩ O_nz) = ∅ := by
      ext p; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      intro _ hp0 ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩
      exact (hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).2 hp0
    have h_init_zero : p_init ∈ O_zero := by
      obtain ⟨rV, hrV, hballV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVo p_init hp_init
      exact ⟨hVW hp_init, rV, hrV, fun z hz => hV0 z (hballV hz)⟩
    rcases (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hWp) O_zero O_nz hO_zero_open hO_nz_open
        h_cov h_disj with hSub0 | hSubNz
    · intro p hpW
      obtain ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩ := hSub0 hpW
      exact hsub p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
    · obtain ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩ := hSubNz (hVW hp_init)
      exact False.elim ((hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).2 h_init_zero)

  
  
  
  have h_exists_nz : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
      (∃ q₁ ∈ W, f q₁ ≠ 0) → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
      ∃ q ∈ V, f q ≠ 0 := by
    intro W V f hWo hWp hf ⟨q₁, hq₁W, hq₁⟩ hVo hVn hVW
    by_contra h_all
    have h_zero : ∀ q ∈ V, f q = 0 := fun q hq => by
      by_contra hne; exact h_all ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
    exact hq₁ (h_id2D hWo hWp hVo hVn hVW hf h_zero q₁ hq₁W)

  have h_meroEqOn_of_local : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
      U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
      (∀ p ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
        F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q) →
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U F₁ F₂ hU hloc
    refine ⟨hU, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ := hU hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, h_eq⟩ := hloc p hp
    let R := min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    have hR : 0 < R := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
    let r₀ := min r R
    have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hr hR
    have h_diff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z) (Metric.ball p R) := by
      have hsub₁ : Metric.ball p R ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₁.rad p) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
      have hsub₂ : Metric.ball p R ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₂.rad p) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      exact ((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono hsub₁ |>.mul ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).mono hsub₂)).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hp₂).mono hsub₂).mul ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono hsub₁))
    have h_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₀,
        F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (h_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz))
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball p R).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀⟩
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) h_diff_holo h_zero q hq)

  have h_meroEqOn_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U F₁ F₂ ⟨hU, hEq⟩
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(hU hp).2, (hU hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [min_comm] at hq
    exact (hEq p hp q hq).symm

  have h_meroEqOn_mono : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
      V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U V F₁ F₂ hVU ⟨hU, hEq⟩
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU hU, fun p hp => hEq p (hVU hp)⟩

  have h_meroEqOn_trans : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃},
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ U F₁ F₂ F₃ ⟨hU₁₂, hEq₁₂⟩ ⟨hU₂₃, hEq₂₃⟩
    refine h_meroEqOn_of_local F₁ F₃ (fun p hp => ⟨(hU₁₂ hp).1, (hU₂₃ hp).2⟩) (fun p hp => ?_)
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (hU₁₂ hp).1
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (hU₁₂ hp).2
    have hp₃ : p ∈ W₃ := (hU₂₃ hp).2
    let r := min (F₁.rad p) (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p))
    have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (lt_min (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂) (F₃.rad_pos p hp₃))
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have h_sub₂ : Metric.ball p r ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₂.rad p) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    let V_nz : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p r ∩ (F₂.den p) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
    have hV_open : IsOpen V_nz :=
      ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).continuousOn.mono h_sub₂).isOpen_inter_preimage
        Metric.isOpen_ball isOpen_compl_singleton
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F₂.rad p)).isPreconnected
      (F₂.den_holo p hp₂) (F₂.den_ne_zero p hp₂) Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩ h_sub₂
    have hV_ne : V_nz.Nonempty := ⟨q₀, hq₀.1, hq₀.2⟩
    have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z) (Metric.ball p r) := by
      have hs₁ : Metric.ball p r ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₁.rad p) := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
      have hs₃ : Metric.ball p r ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₃.rad p) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      exact ((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono hs₁ |>.mul ((F₃.den_holo p hp₃).mono hs₃)).sub
        (((F₃.num_holo p hp₃).mono hs₃).mul ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono hs₁))
    have h_van : ∀ z ∈ V_nz, F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z ⟨hz_ball, hz_nz⟩
      have hz₁₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_min_left _ (min_le_left _ _)) hz_ball
      have hz₂₃ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz_ball
      have h1 := hEq₁₂ p hp z hz₁₂
      have h2 := hEq₂₃ p hp z hz₂₃
      have hmul : (F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z) * F₂.den p z = 0 := by
        linear_combination F₃.den p z * h1 + F₁.den p z * h2
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right hz_nz
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball p r).isPreconnected hV_open hV_ne (fun _ hz => hz.1) h_holo h_van q hq)

  have h_meroEqOn_propagate : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
      IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U V F₁ F₂ hUo hUp hUW hVo ⟨p_init, hp_init⟩ hVU ⟨_, hVEq⟩
    refine ⟨hUW, ?_⟩
    let δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    let diffFn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p q => F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q - F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q
    let S_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ U | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (δ p), diffFn p q = 0 }
    have h_diff_holo : ∀ p ∈ U, DifferentiableOn ℂ (diffFn p) (Metric.ball p (δ p)) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ := hUW hp
      have hs₁ : Metric.ball p (δ p) ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₁.rad p) := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
      have hs₂ : Metric.ball p (δ p) ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₂.rad p) := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      exact ((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono hs₁ |>.mul ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).mono hs₂)).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hp₂).mono hs₂).mul ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono hs₁))
    have h_transfer : ∀ p₁ ∈ U, ∀ p₂ ∈ U,
        (Metric.ball p₁ (δ p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (δ p₂)).Nonempty →
        (p₁ ∈ S_eq → p₂ ∈ S_eq) := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hB_ne hp₁_eq
      obtain ⟨hp₁W₁, hp₁W₂⟩ := hUW hp₁
      obtain ⟨hp₂W₁, hp₂W₂⟩ := hUW hp₂
      refine ⟨hp₂, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      let B₁₂ := Metric.ball p₁ (δ p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (δ p₂)
      have hB_open : IsOpen B₁₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hB_sub₁ : B₁₂ ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ (F₁.rad p₁) :=
        fun z hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.1
      have hB_sub₂ : B₁₂ ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ (F₂.rad p₁) :=
        fun z hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.1
      let U₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B₁₂ ∩ (F₁.den p₁) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
      have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ :=
        ((F₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁W₁).continuousOn.mono hB_sub₁).isOpen_inter_preimage
          hB_open isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁B, hz₁nz⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p₁ (F₁.rad p₁)).isPreconnected (F₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁W₁) (F₁.den_ne_zero p₁ hp₁W₁)
        hB_open hB_ne hB_sub₁
      let U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U₁ ∩ (F₂.den p₁) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
      have hU₂_open : IsOpen U₂ :=
        ((F₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁W₂).continuousOn.mono (fun z hz => hB_sub₂ hz.1)).isOpen_inter_preimage
          hU₁_open isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂U₁, hz₂nz⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p₁ (F₂.rad p₁)).isPreconnected (F₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁W₂) (F₂.den_ne_zero p₁ hp₁W₂)
        hU₁_open ⟨z₁, hz₁B, hz₁nz⟩ (fun z hz => hB_sub₂ hz.1)
      have h_van_U₂ : ∀ z ∈ U₂, diffFn p₂ z = 0 := by
        intro z ⟨⟨hzB, hden₁⟩, hden₂⟩
        have hc₁ := F₁.compat p₁ hp₁W₁ p₂ hp₂W₁ z
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hzB.1,
           Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hzB.2⟩
        have hc₂ := F₂.compat p₁ hp₁W₂ p₂ hp₂W₂ z
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hzB.1,
           Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hzB.2⟩
        have hp₁_z : diffFn p₁ z = 0 := hp₁_eq.2 z hzB.1
        have hmul : diffFn p₂ z * (F₁.den p₁ z * F₂.den p₁ z) = 0 := by
          dsimp only [diffFn] at hp₁_z ⊢
          linear_combination F₁.den p₂ z * F₂.den p₂ z * hp₁_z -
            F₂.den p₁ z * F₂.den p₂ z * hc₁ + F₁.den p₁ z * F₁.den p₂ z * hc₂
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right (mul_ne_zero hden₁ hden₂)
      have hδ₂ : 0 < δ p₂ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₂ hp₂W₁) (F₂.rad_pos p₂ hp₂W₂)
      exact h_id2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₂ (δ p₂)).isPreconnected
        hU₂_open ⟨z₂, hz₂U₁, hz₂nz⟩ (fun z hz => hz.1.1.2) (h_diff_holo p₂ hp₂) h_van_U₂ q hq
    let O_yes := { p ∈ U | ∃ r > 0, Metric.ball p r ⊆ S_eq }
    let O_no := { p ∈ U | ∃ r > 0, Metric.ball p r ⊆ U \ S_eq }
    have hO_yes_open : IsOpen O_yes := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨hpU, r, hr, hsub⟩
      refine ⟨r, hr, fun q hq => ⟨(hsub hq).1, r - dist q p, sub_pos.mpr hq, ?_⟩⟩
      exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)) hsub
    have hO_no_open : IsOpen O_no := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨hpU, r, hr, hsub⟩
      refine ⟨r, hr, fun q hq => ⟨(hsub hq).1, r - dist q p, sub_pos.mpr hq, ?_⟩⟩
      exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)) hsub
    have hU_cov : U ⊆ O_yes ∪ O_no := by
      intro p hpU
      obtain ⟨rU, hrU, hballU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo p hpU
      obtain ⟨hpW₁, hpW₂⟩ := hUW hpU
      let r := min rU (δ p)
      have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hrU (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hpW₁) (F₂.rad_pos p hpW₂))
      by_cases hpS : p ∈ S_eq
      · refine Or.inl ⟨hpU, r, hr, fun q hq => ?_⟩
        have hqU : q ∈ U := hballU (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
        have hδq : 0 < δ q := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos q (hUW hqU).1) (F₂.rad_pos q (hUW hqU).2)
        exact h_transfer p hpU q hqU
          ⟨q, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq, Metric.mem_ball_self hδq⟩ hpS
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hpU, r, hr, fun q hq => ⟨hballU (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq), ?_⟩⟩
        intro hqS
        have hqU : q ∈ U := hballU (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
        have hδq : 0 < δ q := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos q (hUW hqU).1) (F₂.rad_pos q (hUW hqU).2)
        exact hpS (h_transfer q hqU p hpU
          ⟨q, Metric.mem_ball_self hδq, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq⟩ hqS)
    have h_disj : U ∩ (O_yes ∩ O_no) = ∅ := by
      ext p
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      intro _ ⟨_, r₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨_, r₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
      exact (hs₂ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₂)).2 (hs₁ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁))
    have h_init_yes : p_init ∈ O_yes := by
      obtain ⟨rV, hrV, hballV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVo p_init hp_init
      refine ⟨hVU hp_init, rV, hrV, fun q hq => ⟨hVU (hballV hq), fun z hz => ?_⟩⟩
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hVEq q (hballV hq) z hz)
    rcases (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hUp) O_yes O_no hO_yes_open hO_no_open
        hU_cov h_disj with hSubYes | hSubNo
    · intro p hpU q hq
      obtain ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩ := hSubYes hpU
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).2 q hq)
    · obtain ⟨_, r, hr, hsub⟩ := hSubNo (hVU hp_init)
      obtain ⟨_, r₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ := h_init_yes
      exact False.elim ((hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).2 (hs₁ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁)))

  
  
  
  let reflectW : (Fin 2 → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) :=
    fun P Q => ![P 1 - Q 1, Q 0 - P 0]
  let reflectVtilde : (Fin 2 → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) → ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ) :=
    fun P Q ψ =>
      let W := reflectW P Q
      let dot := W 0 * Complex.cos ψ + W 1 * Complex.sin ψ
      ![2 * dot * Complex.cos ψ - W 0, 2 * dot * Complex.sin ψ - W 1]
  let reflectDen : (Fin 2 → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun P Q ψ =>
      let V := reflectVtilde P Q ψ
      P 0 * V 0 + P 1 * V 1

  have h_Vtilde_homog : ∀ (P Q : Fin 2 → ℂ) (ψ c : ℂ) (i : Fin 2),
      reflectVtilde (fun j => c * P j) (fun j => c * Q j) ψ i =
        c * reflectVtilde P Q ψ i := by
    intro P Q ψ c
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [reflectVtilde, reflectW]; ring
    · simp [reflectVtilde, reflectW]; ring

  have h_Den_homog : ∀ (P Q : Fin 2 → ℂ) (ψ c : ℂ),
      reflectDen (fun j => c * P j) (fun j => c * Q j) ψ =
        c ^ 2 * reflectDen P Q ψ := by
    intro P Q ψ c
    simp [reflectDen, reflectVtilde, reflectW]
    ring

  have h_pole_clear_1d : ∀ s₀ ∈ horizStrip H,
      ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (P_hol : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_s ∧
        Metric.ball s₀ r_s ⊆ horizStrip H ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (P_hol i) (Metric.ball s₀ r_s)) ∧
        (K.f s₀ ≠ 0 → N = 0 ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, P_hol i z = K.Γ z i) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, z ≠ s₀ →
          P_hol i z = (z - s₀) ^ N * K.Γ z i) := by
    intro s₀ hs₀
    have hs₀_ennr : s₀ ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := hStrip.symm ▸ hs₀
    by_cases hf : K.f s₀ ≠ 0
    · have hf_cont : ContinuousAt K.f s₀ :=
        (hStrip ▸ K.f_holo).continuousOn.continuousAt (hStrip_open.mem_nhds hs₀)
      have h_nhds : horizStrip H ∩ { z : ℂ | K.f z ≠ 0 } ∈ nhds s₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem (hStrip_open.mem_nhds hs₀) (hf_cont.eventually_ne hf)
      obtain ⟨r_s, hr_s, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      refine ⟨r_s, 0, fun i z => K.Γ z i, hr_s, fun z hz => (hball hz).1, ?_,
        fun _ => ⟨rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩, fun _ _ _ _ => by simp⟩
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact fun z hz => (K.Γ_reg_holo z (hStrip.symm ▸ (hball hz).1) (hball hz).2).1.differentiableWithinAt
      · exact fun z hz => (K.Γ_reg_holo z (hStrip.symm ▸ (hball hz).1) (hball hz).2).2.differentiableWithinAt
    · obtain ⟨n₀, g₀, hg₀_ana, hg₀_eq⟩ :=
        MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mp (K.Γ_mero.1 s₀ hs₀_ennr)
      obtain ⟨n₁, g₁, hg₁_ana, hg₁_eq⟩ :=
        MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mp (K.Γ_mero.2 s₀ hs₀_ennr)
      let N : ℕ := max (-n₀).toNat (-n₁).toNat
      let M₀ : ℕ := (n₀ + (N : ℤ)).toNat
      let M₁ : ℕ := (n₁ + (N : ℤ)).toNat
      have hM₀ : (M₀ : ℤ) = n₀ + (N : ℤ) := by
