        have hle : (-n₀).toNat ≤ N := le_max_left _ _
        omega
      have hM₁ : (M₁ : ℤ) = n₁ + (N : ℤ) := by
        have hle : (-n₁).toNat ≤ N := le_max_right _ _
        omega
      have h_nhds : (horizStrip H ∩ { z : ℂ | DifferentiableAt ℂ g₀ z } ∩
          { z : ℂ | DifferentiableAt ℂ g₁ z }) ∈ nhds s₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          (Filter.inter_mem (hStrip_open.mem_nhds hs₀)
            (Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mp hg₀_ana))
          (Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mp hg₁_ana)
      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hball₁⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hball₂⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hg₀_eq hg₁_eq)
      let r_s := min r₁ r₂
      have hr_s : 0 < r_s := lt_min hr₁ hr₂
      let P_hol : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ :=
        ![fun z => (z - s₀) ^ M₀ * g₀ z, fun z => (z - s₀) ^ M₁ * g₁ z]
      refine ⟨r_s, N, P_hol, hr_s,
        fun z hz => ((hball₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)).1).1, ?_,
        fun h_abs => absurd h_abs hf, ?_⟩
      · refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz
          have hz₁ := hball₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
          exact (((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const s₀)).pow M₀).mul
            hz₁.1.2).differentiableWithinAt
        · intro z hz
          have hz₁ := hball₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
          exact (((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const s₀)).pow M₁).mul
            hz₁.2).differentiableWithinAt
      · refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz hzne
          obtain ⟨heq₀, _⟩ := hball₂ ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz, hzne⟩
          have hsub_ne : z - s₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hzne
          simp only [P_hol, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
          rw [heq₀, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_natCast (z - s₀) N,
            ← zpow_add₀ hsub_ne, add_comm (N : ℤ) n₀, ← hM₀, zpow_natCast]
        · intro z hz hzne
          obtain ⟨_, heq₁⟩ := hball₂ ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz, hzne⟩
          have hsub_ne : z - s₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hzne
          simp only [P_hol, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
          rw [heq₁, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_natCast (z - s₀) N,
            ← zpow_add₀ hsub_ne, add_comm (N : ℤ) n₁, ← hM₁, zpow_natCast]

  have h_mkReflectedMero : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hWo : IsOpen W) (hWc : Convex ℝ W)
      (g_near g_far : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (hgn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_near W)
      (hgf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_far W)
      (hgn_maps : ∀ p ∈ W, g_near p ∈ horizStrip H)
      (hgf_maps : ∀ p ∈ W, g_far p ∈ horizStrip H)
      (hgn_nc : ∃ q₁ ∈ W, ∃ q₂ ∈ W, g_near q₁ ≠ g_near q₂)
      (hgf_nc : ∃ q₁ ∈ W, ∃ q₂ ∈ W, g_far q₁ ≠ g_far q₂)
      {U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hU₀_sub : U₀ ⊆ W)
      (hU₀_reg : ∀ q ∈ U₀, K.f (g_near q) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (g_far q) ≠ 0)
      {q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} (hq₀ : q₀ ∈ U₀)
      (hD_q₀ : reflectDen (K.Γ (g_near q₀)) (K.Γ (g_far q₀)) (K.ϕ (g_near q₀)) ≠ 0),
      ∃ F : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W,
        ∀ {U_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U_reg → U_reg ⊆ W →
          (∀ q ∈ U_reg, K.f (g_near q) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (g_far q) ≠ 0) →
          (U_reg.Nonempty → ∃ q ∈ U_reg,
            reflectDen (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ U_reg, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ (F 0).rad p ∧ (F 1).rad p = (F 0).rad p ∧
            Metric.ball p r ⊆ U_reg ∧
            ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, ∀ i : Fin 2,
              (F i).num p q =
                reflectVtilde (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) i ∧
              (F i).den p q =
                reflectDen (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q))) := by
    intro W hWo hWc g_near g_far hgn_holo hgf_holo hgn_maps hgf_maps hgn_nc hgf_nc
      U₀ hU₀_sub hU₀_reg q₀ hq₀ hD_q₀
    have hWp : IsPreconnected W := hWc.isPreconnected
    have hϕ_holo_H : DifferentiableOn ℂ K.ϕ (horizStrip H) := hStrip ▸ K.ϕ_holo
    have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => K.ϕ (g_near q)) W :=
      hϕ_holo_H.comp hgn_holo hgn_maps
    have h_local_chart : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ∃ (rad : ℝ) (N₁ N₂ : ℕ) (P_hol Q_hol : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ),
        (p ∈ W →
          0 < rad ∧
          Metric.ball p rad ⊆ W ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => P_hol i (g_near q)) (Metric.ball p rad)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_hol i (g_far q)) (Metric.ball p rad)) ∧
          (K.f (g_near p) ≠ 0 → N₁ = 0 ∧
            ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p rad, P_hol i (g_near q) = K.Γ (g_near q) i) ∧
          (K.f (g_far p) ≠ 0 → N₂ = 0 ∧
            ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p rad, Q_hol i (g_far q) = K.Γ (g_far q) i) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p rad, g_near q ≠ g_near p →
            P_hol i (g_near q) = (g_near q - g_near p) ^ N₁ * K.Γ (g_near q) i) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p rad, g_far q ≠ g_far p →
            Q_hol i (g_far q) = (g_far q - g_far p) ^ N₂ * K.Γ (g_far q) i)) := by
      intro p
      by_cases hp : p ∈ W
      · obtain ⟨r₁, N₁, P_hol, hr₁, _, hP_holo, hP_reg, hP_punc⟩ :=
          h_pole_clear_1d (g_near p) (hgn_maps p hp)
        obtain ⟨r₂, N₂, Q_hol, hr₂, _, hQ_holo, hQ_reg, hQ_punc⟩ :=
          h_pole_clear_1d (g_far p) (hgf_maps p hp)
        have hgn_cont : ContinuousAt g_near p :=
          hgn_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hp)
        have hgf_cont : ContinuousAt g_far p :=
          hgf_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hp)
        have h_nhds : (W ∩ g_near ⁻¹' Metric.ball (g_near p) r₁ ∩
            g_far ⁻¹' Metric.ball (g_far p) r₂) ∈ nhds p :=
          Filter.inter_mem
            (Filter.inter_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hp) (hgn_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hr₁)))
            (hgf_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hr₂))
        obtain ⟨rad, hrad, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
        have hballW : Metric.ball p rad ⊆ W := fun q hq => ((hball hq).1).1
        have hmap₁ : Set.MapsTo g_near (Metric.ball p rad) (Metric.ball (g_near p) r₁) :=
          fun q hq => ((hball hq).1).2
        have hmap₂ : Set.MapsTo g_far (Metric.ball p rad) (Metric.ball (g_far p) r₂) :=
          fun q hq => (hball hq).2
        refine ⟨rad, N₁, N₂, P_hol, Q_hol, fun _ => ⟨hrad, hballW,
          fun i => (hP_holo i).comp (hgn_holo.mono hballW) hmap₁,
          fun i => (hQ_holo i).comp (hgf_holo.mono hballW) hmap₂,
          fun hfn => ⟨(hP_reg hfn).1, fun i q hq => (hP_reg hfn).2 i (g_near q) (hmap₁ hq)⟩,
          fun hff => ⟨(hQ_reg hff).1, fun i q hq => (hQ_reg hff).2 i (g_far q) (hmap₂ hq)⟩,
          fun i q hq hne => hP_punc i (g_near q) (hmap₁ hq) hne,
          fun i q hq hne => hQ_punc i (g_far q) (hmap₂ hq) hne⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨1, 0, 0, fun _ _ => 0, fun _ _ => 0, fun h => absurd h hp⟩
    choose rad N₁ N₂ P_hol Q_hol h_chart using h_local_chart
    let E_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun p q => (g_near q - g_near p) ^ (N₁ p) * (g_far q - g_far p) ^ (N₂ p)
    let P_tilde : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) :=
      fun p q i => (g_far q - g_far p) ^ (N₂ p) * P_hol p i (g_near q)
    let Q_tilde : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ) :=
      fun p q i => (g_near q - g_near p) ^ (N₁ p) * Q_hol p i (g_far q)
    let N_chart : Fin 2 → (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun i p q => E_fn p q * reflectVtilde (P_tilde p q) (Q_tilde p q) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) i
    let D_chart : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun p q => reflectDen (P_tilde p q) (Q_tilde p q) (K.ϕ (g_near q))

    have hE_holo : ∀ p, DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_fn p) W := by
      intro p
      exact ((hgn_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₁ p)).mul
        ((hgf_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₂ p))
    have hN_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_chart i p) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) := by
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨_, hballW, hPh, hQh, _, _, _, _⟩ := h_chart p hp
        have hPt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => P_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
          fun j => (((hgf_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₂ p)).mul (hPh j)
        have hQt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
          fun j => (((hgn_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₁ p)).mul (hQh j)
        have hψ_ball := hψ_holo.mono hballW
        have hcos := hψ_ball.ccos
        have hsin := hψ_ball.csin
        have hW₀ := (hPt 1).sub (hQt 1)
        have hW₁ := (hQt 0).sub (hPt 0)
        have hdot := (hW₀.mul hcos).add (hW₁.mul hsin)
        exact ((hE_holo p).mono hballW).mul
          ((((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdot).mul hcos).sub hW₀)
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨_, hballW, hPh, hQh, _, _, _, _⟩ := h_chart p hp
        have hPt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => P_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
          fun j => (((hgf_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₂ p)).mul (hPh j)
        have hQt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
          fun j => (((hgn_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₁ p)).mul (hQh j)
        have hψ_ball := hψ_holo.mono hballW
        have hcos := hψ_ball.ccos
        have hsin := hψ_ball.csin
        have hW₀ := (hPt 1).sub (hQt 1)
        have hW₁ := (hQt 0).sub (hPt 0)
        have hdot := (hW₀.mul hcos).add (hW₁.mul hsin)
        exact ((hE_holo p).mono hballW).mul
          ((((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdot).mul hsin).sub hW₁)
    have hD_holo : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_chart p) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨_, hballW, hPh, hQh, _, _, _, _⟩ := h_chart p hp
      have hPt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => P_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
        fun j => (((hgf_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₂ p)).mul (hPh j)
      have hQt : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_tilde p q j) (Metric.ball p (rad p)) :=
        fun j => (((hgn_holo.mono hballW).sub (differentiableOn_const _)).pow (N₁ p)).mul (hQh j)
      have hψ_ball := hψ_holo.mono hballW
      have hcos := hψ_ball.ccos
      have hsin := hψ_ball.csin
      have hW₀ := (hPt 1).sub (hQt 1)
      have hW₁ := (hQt 0).sub (hPt 0)
      have hdot := (hW₀.mul hcos).add (hW₁.mul hsin)
      have hV₀ := (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdot).mul hcos).sub hW₀
      have hV₁ := (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdot).mul hsin).sub hW₁
      exact ((hPt 0).mul hV₀).add ((hPt 1).mul hV₁)

    have h_punc_eq : ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (rad p),
        g_near q ≠ g_near p → g_far q ≠ g_far p →
        D_chart p q = (E_fn p q) ^ 2 *
          reflectDen (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, N_chart i p q = (E_fn p q) ^ 2 *
          reflectVtilde (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) i := by
      intro p hp q hq hne₁ hne₂
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hPp, hQp⟩ := h_chart p hp
      have hPt_eq : P_tilde p q = fun j => E_fn p q * K.Γ (g_near q) j := by
        ext j
        dsimp only [P_tilde, E_fn]
        rw [hPp j q hq hne₁]
        ring
      have hQt_eq : Q_tilde p q = fun j => E_fn p q * K.Γ (g_far q) j := by
        ext j
        dsimp only [Q_tilde, E_fn]
        rw [hQp j q hq hne₂]
        ring
      refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
      · dsimp only [D_chart]
        rw [hPt_eq, hQt_eq, h_Den_homog]
      · dsimp only [N_chart]
        rw [hPt_eq, hQt_eq, h_Vtilde_homog]
        ring

    have h_reg_eq : ∀ p ∈ W, K.f (g_near p) ≠ 0 → K.f (g_far p) ≠ 0 →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (rad p),
          D_chart p q = reflectDen (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, N_chart i p q =
            reflectVtilde (K.Γ (g_near q)) (K.Γ (g_far q)) (K.ϕ (g_near q)) i := by
      intro p hp hfn hff q hq
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hPr, hQr, _, _⟩ := h_chart p hp
      obtain ⟨hN₁0, hPeq⟩ := hPr hfn
      obtain ⟨hN₂0, hQeq⟩ := hQr hff
      have hE1 : E_fn p q = 1 := by simp [E_fn, hN₁0, hN₂0]
      have hPt_eq : P_tilde p q = K.Γ (g_near q) := by
        ext j; simp [P_tilde, hN₂0, hPeq j q hq]
      have hQt_eq : Q_tilde p q = K.Γ (g_far q) := by
        ext j; simp [Q_tilde, hN₁0, hQeq j q hq]
      refine ⟨by dsimp only [D_chart]; rw [hPt_eq, hQt_eq],
        fun i => by dsimp only [N_chart]; rw [hE1, one_mul, hPt_eq, hQt_eq]⟩

    have h_gn_nonconst : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
        ∀ s : ℂ, ∃ q ∈ V, g_near q ≠ s := by
      intro V hVo hVn hVW s
      by_contra h_all
      have h_eq : ∀ q ∈ V, g_near q = s := fun q hq => by
        by_contra hne; exact h_all ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
      obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁W, q₂, hq₂W, hne⟩ := hgn_nc
      have h_zero : ∀ z ∈ W, g_near z - s = 0 :=
        h_id2D hWo hWp hVo hVn hVW
          (hgn_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const s))
          (fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (h_eq z hz))
      exact hne ((sub_eq_zero.mp (h_zero q₁ hq₁W)).trans (sub_eq_zero.mp (h_zero q₂ hq₂W)).symm)

    have h_gf_nonconst : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
        ∀ s : ℂ, ∃ q ∈ V, g_far q ≠ s := by
      intro V hVo hVn hVW s
      by_contra h_all
      have h_eq : ∀ q ∈ V, g_far q = s := fun q hq => by
        by_contra hne; exact h_all ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
      obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁W, q₂, hq₂W, hne⟩ := hgf_nc
      have h_zero : ∀ z ∈ W, g_far z - s = 0 :=
        h_id2D hWo hWp hVo hVn hVW
          (hgf_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const s))
          (fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (h_eq z hz))
      exact hne ((sub_eq_zero.mp (h_zero q₁ hq₁W)).trans (sub_eq_zero.mp (h_zero q₂ hq₂W)).symm)

    have h_punc_open_ne : ∀ p₁ ∈ W, ∀ p₂ ∈ W, ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
        ∃ V_st : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_st ∧ V_st.Nonempty ∧ V_st ⊆ V ∧
          ∀ z ∈ V_st, g_near z ≠ g_near p₁ ∧ g_far z ≠ g_far p₁ ∧
            g_near z ≠ g_near p₂ ∧ g_far z ≠ g_far p₂ := by
      intro p₁ _ p₂ _ V hVo hVn hVW
      let V₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V ∩ g_near ⁻¹' {g_near p₁}ᶜ
      have hV₁o : IsOpen V₁ :=
        (hgn_holo.continuousOn.mono hVW).isOpen_inter_preimage hVo isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁V, hz₁⟩ := h_gn_nonconst hVo hVn hVW (g_near p₁)
      let V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V₁ ∩ g_far ⁻¹' {g_far p₁}ᶜ
      have hV₂o : IsOpen V₂ :=
        (hgf_holo.continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1)).isOpen_inter_preimage hV₁o isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂V₁, hz₂⟩ := h_gf_nonconst hV₁o ⟨z₁, hz₁V, hz₁⟩ (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1) (g_far p₁)
      let V₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V₂ ∩ g_near ⁻¹' {g_near p₂}ᶜ
      have hV₃o : IsOpen V₃ :=
        (hgn_holo.continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1.1)).isOpen_inter_preimage hV₂o isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₃, hz₃V₂, hz₃⟩ := h_gn_nonconst hV₂o ⟨z₂, hz₂V₁, hz₂⟩ (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1.1) (g_near p₂)
      let V₄ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V₃ ∩ g_far ⁻¹' {g_far p₂}ᶜ
      have hV₄o : IsOpen V₄ :=
        (hgf_holo.continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1.1.1)).isOpen_inter_preimage hV₃o isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₄, hz₄V₃, hz₄⟩ := h_gf_nonconst hV₃o ⟨z₃, hz₃V₂, hz₃⟩ (fun _ hz => hVW hz.1.1.1) (g_far p₂)
      exact ⟨V₄, hV₄o, ⟨z₄, hz₄V₃, hz₄⟩, fun _ hz => hz.1.1.1.1,
        fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.1.1.2, hz.1.1.2, hz.1.2, hz.2⟩⟩

    have hD_compat : ∀ p₁ ∈ W, ∀ p₂ ∈ W,
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂),
          D_chart p₁ q * (E_fn p₂ q) ^ 2 = D_chart p₂ q * (E_fn p₁ q) ^ 2 := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
      let B₁₂ := Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂)
      have hB_open : IsOpen B₁₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hB_conv : Convex ℝ B₁₂ := (convex_ball p₁ (rad p₁)).inter (convex_ball p₂ (rad p₂))
      have hB_subW : B₁₂ ⊆ W := fun z hz => (h_chart p₁ hp₁).2.1 hz.1
      obtain ⟨V_st, hV_sto, hV_stne, hV_stsub, hV_stpunc⟩ :=
        h_punc_open_ne p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hB_open ⟨q, hq⟩ hB_subW
      have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => D_chart p₁ z * (E_fn p₂ z) ^ 2 - D_chart p₂ z * (E_fn p₁ z) ^ 2) B₁₂ :=
        (((hD_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (fun _ hz => hz.1)).mul (((hE_holo p₂).pow 2).mono hB_subW)).sub
          (((hD_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (fun _ hz => hz.2)).mul (((hE_holo p₁).pow 2).mono hB_subW))
      have h_van : ∀ z ∈ V_st, D_chart p₁ z * (E_fn p₂ z) ^ 2 - D_chart p₂ z * (E_fn p₁ z) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hn₁, hf₁, hn₂, hf₂⟩ := hV_stpunc z hz
        have hzB := hV_stsub hz
        rw [(h_punc_eq p₁ hp₁ z hzB.1 hn₁ hf₁).1, (h_punc_eq p₂ hp₂ z hzB.2 hn₂ hf₂).1]
        ring
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D hB_open hB_conv.isPreconnected
        hV_sto hV_stne hV_stsub h_holo h_van q hq)

    have hND_compat : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p₁ ∈ W, ∀ p₂ ∈ W,
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂),
          N_chart i p₁ q * D_chart p₂ q = N_chart i p₂ q * D_chart p₁ q := by
      intro i p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
      let B₁₂ := Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂)
      have hB_open : IsOpen B₁₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hB_conv : Convex ℝ B₁₂ := (convex_ball p₁ (rad p₁)).inter (convex_ball p₂ (rad p₂))
      have hB_subW : B₁₂ ⊆ W := fun z hz => (h_chart p₁ hp₁).2.1 hz.1
      obtain ⟨V_st, hV_sto, hV_stne, hV_stsub, hV_stpunc⟩ :=
        h_punc_open_ne p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hB_open ⟨q, hq⟩ hB_subW
      have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => N_chart i p₁ z * D_chart p₂ z - N_chart i p₂ z * D_chart p₁ z) B₁₂ :=
        (((hN_holo i p₁ hp₁).mono (fun _ hz => hz.1)).mul ((hD_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (fun _ hz => hz.2))).sub
          (((hN_holo i p₂ hp₂).mono (fun _ hz => hz.2)).mul ((hD_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (fun _ hz => hz.1)))
      have h_van : ∀ z ∈ V_st, N_chart i p₁ z * D_chart p₂ z - N_chart i p₂ z * D_chart p₁ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hn₁, hf₁, hn₂, hf₂⟩ := hV_stpunc z hz
        have hzB := hV_stsub hz
        obtain ⟨hD₁, hN₁eq⟩ := h_punc_eq p₁ hp₁ z hzB.1 hn₁ hf₁
        obtain ⟨hD₂, hN₂eq⟩ := h_punc_eq p₂ hp₂ z hzB.2 hn₂ hf₂
        rw [hN₁eq i, hN₂eq i, hD₁, hD₂]
        ring
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D hB_open hB_conv.isPreconnected
        hV_sto hV_stne hV_stsub h_holo h_van q hq)

    let S_nz : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ W | ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (rad p), D_chart p q ≠ 0 }
    have h_nz_transfer : ∀ p₁ ∈ W, ∀ p₂ ∈ W,
        (Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂)).Nonempty →
        p₁ ∈ S_nz → p₂ ∈ S_nz := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hB_ne ⟨_, hD₁_nz⟩
      refine ⟨hp₂, ?_⟩
      let B₁₂ := Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂)
      have hB_open : IsOpen B₁₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hB_sub₁ : B₁₂ ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) := fun _ hz => hz.1
      have hB_subW : B₁₂ ⊆ W := fun z hz => (h_chart p₁ hp₁).2.1 hz.1
      let U_d : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B₁₂ ∩ (D_chart p₁) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
      have hUd_open : IsOpen U_d :=
        ((hD_holo p₁ hp₁).continuousOn.mono hB_sub₁).isOpen_inter_preimage hB_open isOpen_compl_singleton
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁B, hz₁nz⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p₁ (rad p₁)).isPreconnected (hD_holo p₁ hp₁) hD₁_nz hB_open hB_ne hB_sub₁
      obtain ⟨V_st, _, ⟨z₂, hz₂V⟩, hV_stsub, hV_stpunc⟩ :=
        h_punc_open_ne p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ hUd_open ⟨z₁, hz₁B, hz₁nz⟩ (fun _ hz => hB_subW hz.1)
      have hz₂U : z₂ ∈ U_d := hV_stsub hz₂V
      obtain ⟨_, _, hn₂, hf₂⟩ := hV_stpunc z₂ hz₂V
      have hE₂_nz : (E_fn p₂ z₂) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero 2 (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hn₂))
          (pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hf₂)))
      have hmul : D_chart p₂ z₂ * (E_fn p₁ z₂) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hD_compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ z₂ hz₂U.1]
        exact mul_ne_zero hz₂U.2 hE₂_nz
      exact ⟨z₂, hz₂U.1.2, left_ne_zero_of_mul hmul⟩

    have hq₀W : q₀ ∈ W := hU₀_sub hq₀
    have hq₀_nz : q₀ ∈ S_nz := by
      have hrad_q₀ : 0 < rad q₀ := (h_chart q₀ hq₀W).1
      refine ⟨hq₀W, q₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hrad_q₀, ?_⟩
      rw [(h_reg_eq q₀ hq₀W (hU₀_reg q₀ hq₀).1 (hU₀_reg q₀ hq₀).2 q₀
        (Metric.mem_ball_self hrad_q₀)).1]
      exact hD_q₀

    have hS_open : IsOpen S_nz := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p hpS
      refine ⟨rad p, (h_chart p hpS.1).1, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hqW : q ∈ W := (h_chart p hpS.1).2.1 hq
      exact h_nz_transfer p hpS.1 q hqW ⟨q, hq, Metric.mem_ball_self (h_chart q hqW).1⟩ hpS

    have hSc_open : IsOpen (W \ S_nz) := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨hpW, hp_not⟩
      refine ⟨rad p, (h_chart p hpW).1, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hqW : q ∈ W := (h_chart p hpW).2.1 hq
      exact ⟨hqW, fun hqS =>
        hp_not (h_nz_transfer q hqW p hpW ⟨q, Metric.mem_ball_self (h_chart q hqW).1, hq⟩ hqS)⟩

    have hW_sub_S : W ⊆ S_nz := by
      have h_cov : W ⊆ S_nz ∪ (W \ S_nz) :=
        fun p hp => (Classical.em (p ∈ S_nz)).imp id (fun h => ⟨hp, h⟩)
      have h_disj : W ∩ (S_nz ∩ (W \ S_nz)) = ∅ := by
        ext p; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        rintro ⟨_, hpS, _, hnot⟩; exact hnot hpS
      rcases (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hWp) S_nz (W \ S_nz) hS_open hSc_open
          h_cov h_disj with h1 | h2
      · exact h1
      · exact False.elim ((h2 hq₀W).2 hq₀_nz)

    let F : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W := fun i => {
      rad := rad
      num := N_chart i
      den := D_chart
      rad_pos := fun p hp => (h_chart p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => (h_chart p hp).2.1
      num_holo := hN_holo i
      den_holo := hD_holo
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => (hW_sub_S hp).2
      compat := hND_compat i
    }
    refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
    intro U_reg hUo hUW hUreg
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      obtain ⟨rU, hrU, hballU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo p hp
      have hpW : p ∈ W := hUW hp
      let r := min rU (rad p)
      have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hrU (h_chart p hpW).1
      obtain ⟨q, hq_ball, hDq_nz⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p (rad p)).isPreconnected (hD_holo p hpW) (hW_sub_S hpW).2
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      refine ⟨q, hballU (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq_ball), ?_⟩
      rwa [← (h_reg_eq p hpW (hUreg p hp).1 (hUreg p hp).2 q
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq_ball)).1]
    · intro p hp
      obtain ⟨rU, hrU, hballU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo p hp
      have hpW : p ∈ W := hUW hp
      let r := min rU (rad p)
      refine ⟨r, lt_min hrU (h_chart p hpW).1, min_le_right _ _, rfl,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hballU, fun q hq i => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hDeq, hNeq⟩ := h_reg_eq p hpW (hUreg p hp).1 (hUreg p hp).2 q
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
      exact ⟨hNeq i, hDeq⟩

  
  
  
  let shift_c : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun c p => (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2)
  have hsh_diff : ∀ c : ℂ, Differentiable ℂ (shift_c c) :=
    fun c => (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_snd.const_mul c)).prodMk differentiable_snd
  have hsh_cont : ∀ c : ℂ, Continuous (shift_c c) := fun c => (hsh_diff c).continuous
  have hsh_conv : ∀ {S : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (c : ℂ), Convex ℝ S → Convex ℝ (shift_c c ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro S c hSc p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    have heq : shift_c c (a • p + b • q) = a • shift_c c p + b • shift_c c q := by
      (ext <;> simp [shift_c, Complex.real_smul]); ring
    change shift_c c (a • p + b • q) ∈ S
    rw [heq]
    exact hSc hp hq ha hb hab

  have hCone_open : IsOpen (coneDomain H δ_star d x₀) := by
    have hf_dep : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => H - p.1.im) :=
      continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hf_dep).inter
      ((isOpen_lt hf_dep continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
          (continuous_const.mul hf_dep)).inter
          (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)))

  have hCone_conv : Convex ℝ (coneDomain H δ_star d x₀) := by
    intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    rcases hp with ⟨hpd, hpδ, hpre, hp2⟩
    rcases hq with ⟨hqd, hqδ, hqre, hq2⟩
    have him : (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im := by simp
    have hre : (a • p + b • q).1.re = a * p.1.re + b * q.1.re := by simp
    have hdepth : H - (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * (H - p.1.im) + b * (H - q.1.im) := by
      rw [him]; linear_combination H * hab.symm
    have habs : |(a • p + b • q).1.re - x₀| ≤ a * |p.1.re - x₀| + b * |q.1.re - x₀| := by
      have hlin : (a • p + b • q).1.re - x₀ = a * (p.1.re - x₀) + b * (q.1.re - x₀) := by
        rw [hre]; linear_combination -x₀ * hab.symm
      rw [hlin]
      calc |a * (p.1.re - x₀) + b * (q.1.re - x₀)|
          ≤ |a * (p.1.re - x₀)| + |b * (q.1.re - x₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |p.1.re - x₀| + b * |q.1.re - x₀| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    have hnorm2 : ‖(a • p + b • q).2‖ ≤ a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
      calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
    have hc1 := h_conv_lt_left ha hb hab hpd hqd
    have hc2 := h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hpδ hqδ
    have hc3 := h_conv_lt ha hb hab hpre hqre
    have hc4 := h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hp2 hq2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hdepth]; exact hc1
    · rw [hdepth]; exact hc2
    · rw [hdepth]; linarith
    · linarith

  have hBack_eq : coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ =
      shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∩
      shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ := by
    ext p
    change ((p.1 - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∧
        (p.1 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀) ↔
      ((p.1 + (-3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∧
        (p.1 + (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀)
    have h1 : p.1 - (3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2 = p.1 + (-3 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2 := by ring
    have h2 : p.1 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2 = p.1 + (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2 := by ring
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hFwd_eq : coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ =
      shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∩
      shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ := rfl

  have hBack_open : IsOpen (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀) := by
    rw [hBack_eq]
    exact (hCone_open.preimage (hsh_cont _)).inter (hCone_open.preimage (hsh_cont _))
  have hBack_conv : Convex ℝ (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀) := by
    rw [hBack_eq]
    exact (hsh_conv _ hCone_conv).inter (hsh_conv _ hCone_conv)
  have hFwd_open : IsOpen (coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀) := by
    rw [hFwd_eq]
    exact (hCone_open.preimage (hsh_cont _)).inter (hCone_open.preimage (hsh_cont _))
  have hFwd_conv : Convex ℝ (coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀) := by
    rw [hFwd_eq]
    exact (hsh_conv _ hCone_conv).inter (hsh_conv _ hCone_conv)

  obtain ⟨η₂, p_reg, p_alt, r_reg,
      hη₂_pos, hη₂_d40, hη₂_s8, hη₂_r4,
      h_lsc_η₂, h_bshift_η₂,
      hs_eq_η₂,
      hp_reg_2, hp_alt_2, hp_reg_mem, hp_alt_mem,
      hst_ne, hLs_ne,
      hr_reg_pos, hB_reg_sub, hB_reg_f⟩ :
      ∃ (η₂ : ℝ) (p_reg p_alt : ℂ × ℂ) (r_reg : ℝ),
        0 < η₂ ∧ η₂ ≤ d / 40 ∧ η₂ ≤ L.s_star / 8 ∧ η₂ ≤ L.r_star / 4 ∧
        (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < η₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (H - d / 20) < M.h_X t) ∧
        (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < η₂ → ‖L.b_shift t‖ < min (d / 80) (L.s_star / 8)) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀, ‖q.2‖ < η₂ → s_tilde q = L.𝔰 q) ∧
        p_reg.2 = 0 ∧ p_alt.2 = 0 ∧
        p_reg ∈ coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ ∩ {p | ‖p.2‖ < η₂} ∧
        p_alt ∈ coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ ∩ {p | ‖p.2‖ < η₂} ∧
        s_tilde p_reg ≠ s_tilde p_alt ∧ L.𝔰 p_reg ≠ L.𝔰 p_alt ∧
        0 < r_reg ∧
        Metric.ball p_reg r_reg ⊆
          coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ ∩ {p | ‖p.2‖ < η₂} ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_reg r_reg,
          K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧
          K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0) := by
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
    have h_lt_H : ENNReal.ofReal (H - d / 20) < M.h_X 0 := by
      rw [hH, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH_pos]; linarith
    have hlsc0 :=
      (lowerSemicontinuousWithinAt_iff.mp (M.h_X_lsc 0 h0_mem)) (ENNReal.ofReal (H - d / 20)) h_lt_H
    rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq h0_mem, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball] at hlsc0
    obtain ⟨r_lsc, hr_lsc, h_lsc_ball⟩ := hlsc0
    have hb_cont0 : ContinuousAt L.b_shift 0 :=
      L.b_shift_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)
    let ε_b := min (d / 80) (L.s_star / 8)
    have hε_b : 0 < ε_b := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith [L.s_star_pos])
    have hb_ev : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℂ), L.b_shift t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_b := by
      have hball0 : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_b ∈ nhds (L.b_shift 0) := by
        rw [L.b_shift_zero]
        exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hε_b
      exact hb_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds hball0
    obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b, h_rb_ball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hb_ev
    let η₂ := min η (min r_lsc (min r_b (min (d / 40) (min (L.s_star / 8) (L.r_star / 4)))))
    have hη₂_pos : 0 < η₂ := lt_min hη (lt_min hr_lsc (lt_min hr_b
      (lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith [L.s_star_pos]) (by linarith [L.r_star_pos])))))
    have hη₂_η : η₂ ≤ η := min_le_left _ _
    have hη₂_lsc : η₂ ≤ r_lsc := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hη₂_rb : η₂ ≤ r_b := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hη₂_d40 : η₂ ≤ d / 40 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hη₂_s8 : η₂ ≤ L.s_star / 8 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hη₂_r4 : η₂ ≤ L.r_star / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
    have h_lsc_η₂ : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < η₂ → ENNReal.ofReal (H - d / 20) < M.h_X t := by
      intro t ht
      exact h_lsc_ball t (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith)
    have h_bshift_η₂ : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < η₂ → ‖L.b_shift t‖ < min (d / 80) (L.s_star / 8) := by
      intro t ht
      have hm := h_rb_ball t (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith)
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hm

    let T_sl := { q : ℂ × ℂ | -L.s_star / 2 < q.1.im ∧ q.1.im < H - d / 10 ∧ ‖q.2‖ < η₂ }
    have hT_sl_sub : T_sl ⊆ L.T_norm := by
      intro q ⟨hq_lo, hq_hi, hq_t⟩
      rw [L.T_norm_iff]
      have hqt_r : ‖q.2‖ < L.r_star := by linarith [L.r_star_pos]
      have hqt_base : ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base := lt_trans hqt_r hr_lt_base
      have hb_bd := h_bshift_η₂ q.2 hq_t
      have hb_im : |(L.b_shift q.2).im| ≤ ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      have hb_d : ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ < d / 80 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_left _ _)
      have hb_s : ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ < L.s_star / 8 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_right _ _)
      refine ⟨hqt_r, hqt_base, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_neg_im : -(q.1 - L.b_shift q.2).im < M.s_base := by
          have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).2
          simp only [Complex.sub_im]
          linarith
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr h_neg_im)
          (M.h_X_ge (starRingEnd ℂ q.2) (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, RCLike.norm_conj]; exact hqt_base))
      · have h_pos_im : (q.1 - L.b_shift q.2).im ≤ H - d / 20 := by
          have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).1
          simp only [Complex.sub_im]
          linarith
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_pos_im) (h_lsc_η₂ q.2 hq_t)

    let U₁ := coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2‖ < η₂ }
    have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ :=
      hCone_open.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
    have hU₁_conv : Convex ℝ U₁ := by
      refine hCone_conv.inter (fun p hp q hq a b ha hb hab => ?_)
      have hnorm : ‖(a • p + b • q).2‖ ≤ a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
        calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
      have hc := h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hp hq
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm hc
    have hU₁_sub_T : U₁ ⊆ L.T_norm := by
      intro q ⟨⟨hqd, hqδ, _, _⟩, hqt⟩
      exact hT_sl_sub ⟨by linarith [L.s_star_pos], by linarith, hqt⟩

    have hs_eq_η₂ : ∀ q ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀, ‖q.2‖ < η₂ → s_tilde q = L.𝔰 q := by
      intro q hq_cone hq_t
      let V₁ := U₁ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im }
      have hV₁_open : IsOpen V₁ :=
        hU₁_open.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)))
      let p_deep : ℂ × ℂ := ((x₀ : ℂ) + ((H - 3 * δ_star / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, 0)
      have hp_deep : p_deep ∈ V₁ := by
        have hp_im : p_deep.1.im = H - 3 * δ_star / 4 := by simp [p_deep]
        have hp_re : p_deep.1.re = x₀ := by simp [p_deep]
        refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [hp_im]; linarith
        · rw [hp_im]; linarith
        · rw [hp_re, hp_im, sub_self, abs_zero]; linarith
        · simp [p_deep, hd0]
        · simp [p_deep, hη₂_pos]
        · change δ_star / 2 < H - p_deep.1.im; rw [hp_im]; linarith
      have h_diff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => s_tilde p - L.𝔰 p) U₁ :=
        (hs_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_left).sub (L.𝔰_holo.mono hU₁_sub_T)
      have h_van : ∀ p ∈ V₁, s_tilde p - L.𝔰 p = 0 := by
        intro p ⟨⟨hp_c, hp_η⟩, hp_d⟩
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hs_eq p hp_c hp_d (lt_of_lt_of_le hp_η hη₂_η))
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_id2D hU₁_open hU₁_conv.isPreconnected
        hV₁_open ⟨p_deep, hp_deep⟩ Set.inter_subset_left h_diff_holo h_van q ⟨hq_cone, hq_t⟩)

    let s_mid : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ) + ((H - 3 * d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hs_mid_H : s_mid ∈ horizStrip H := by
      change |s_mid.im| < H
      have him : s_mid.im = H - 3 * d := by simp [s_mid]
      rw [him, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have hStrip_conv : Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < H
      have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      have habs : |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im| ≤ a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
        calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im| ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt habs (h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hz₁ hz₂)
    have hf_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ K.f (horizStrip H) :=
      (hStrip ▸ K.f_holo).analyticOnNhd hStrip_open
    have hf_not_ev_zero : ¬ (∀ᶠ z in nhds s_mid, K.f z = 0) := by
      intro h_ev
      have h0_mem_H : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
        change |(0 : ℂ).im| < H; simp [hH_pos]
      have h0_eq : K.f 0 = 0 :=
        hf_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          hStrip_conv.isPreconnected hs_mid_H h_ev h0_mem_H
      have h0_pos : 0 < (K.f ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)).re := (K.f_real_pos 0).1
      rw [Complex.ofReal_zero, h0_eq, Complex.zero_re] at h0_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 h0_pos
    have hf_punc : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s_mid {s_mid}ᶜ, K.f z ≠ 0 :=
      ((hf_ana s_mid hs_mid_H).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero).resolve_left hf_not_ev_zero
    obtain ⟨ε_f, hε_f, hball_f⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hf_punc
    let δ_x : ℝ := if K.f s_mid ≠ 0 then 0 else min (d / 2) (ε_f / 2)
    have hδ_x_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ_x := by
      dsimp only [δ_x]; split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · exact le_of_lt (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hδ_x_le : δ_x ≤ d / 2 := by
      dsimp only [δ_x]; split_ifs
      · linarith
      · exact min_le_left _ _
    let s_reg : ℂ := s_mid + (δ_x : ℂ)
    have hs_reg_f : K.f s_reg ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp only [s_reg, δ_x]
      split_ifs with hfm
      · simpa
      · have hpos : 0 < min (d / 2) (ε_f / 2) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have h_dist : s_mid + ((min (d / 2) (ε_f / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball s_mid ε_f := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hpos)]
          linarith [min_le_right (d / 2) (ε_f / 2)]
        have h_ne : s_mid + ((min (d / 2) (ε_f / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ s_mid := by
          intro heq
          have hc0 : ((min (d / 2) (ε_f / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination heq
          have := congr_arg Complex.re hc0
          simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at this
          linarith
        exact hball_f ⟨h_dist, h_ne⟩
    have hs_reg_H : s_reg ∈ horizStrip H := by
      change |s_reg.im| < H
      have him : s_reg.im = H - 3 * d := by simp [s_reg, s_mid]
      rw [him, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith
    have hs_alt_H : s_reg + (d : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
      change |(s_reg + (d : ℂ)).im| < H
      have him : (s_reg + (d : ℂ)).im = H - 3 * d := by simp [s_reg, s_mid]
      rw [him, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; linarith

    let p_reg : ℂ × ℂ := (s_reg, 0)
    let p_alt : ℂ × ℂ := (s_reg + (d : ℂ), 0)
    have hp_reg_cone : p_reg ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ := by
      have him : p_reg.1.im = H - 3 * d := by simp [p_reg, s_reg, s_mid]
      have hre : p_reg.1.re = x₀ + δ_x := by simp [p_reg, s_reg, s_mid]
      refine ⟨by rw [him]; linarith, by rw [him]; linarith, ?_, by simp [p_reg, hd0]⟩
      rw [hre, him, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg hδ_x_nonneg]
      linarith
    have hp_alt_cone : p_alt ∈ coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ := by
      have him : p_alt.1.im = H - 3 * d := by simp [p_alt, s_reg, s_mid]
      have hre : p_alt.1.re = x₀ + (δ_x + d) := by simp [p_alt, s_reg, s_mid, add_assoc]
      refine ⟨by rw [him]; linarith, by rw [him]; linarith, ?_, by simp [p_alt, hd0]⟩
      rw [hre, him, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      linarith
    let O_reg := coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ ∩ {p | ‖p.2‖ < η₂}
    have hp_reg_mem : p_reg ∈ O_reg := by
      refine ⟨⟨⟨by simpa [p_reg], by simpa [p_reg]⟩, ⟨by simpa [p_reg], by simpa [p_reg]⟩⟩,
        by simp [p_reg, hη₂_pos]⟩
    have hp_alt_mem : p_alt ∈ O_reg := by
      refine ⟨⟨⟨by simpa [p_alt], by simpa [p_alt]⟩, ⟨by simpa [p_alt], by simpa [p_alt]⟩⟩,
        by simp [p_alt, hη₂_pos]⟩
    have hLs_reg : L.𝔰 p_reg = s_reg := L.𝔰_zero s_reg (hStrip.symm ▸ hs_reg_H)
    have hLs_alt : L.𝔰 p_alt = s_reg + (d : ℂ) := L.𝔰_zero (s_reg + (d : ℂ)) (hStrip.symm ▸ hs_alt_H)
    have hLs_ne : L.𝔰 p_reg ≠ L.𝔰 p_alt := by
      rw [hLs_reg, hLs_alt]
      intro heq
      have hd_zero : (d : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination heq.symm
      have := congr_arg Complex.re hd_zero
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.zero_re] at this
      linarith
    have hst_ne : s_tilde p_reg ≠ s_tilde p_alt := by
      rw [hs_eq_η₂ p_reg hp_reg_cone (by simp [p_reg, hη₂_pos]),
          hs_eq_η₂ p_alt hp_alt_cone (by simp [p_alt, hη₂_pos])]
      exact hLs_ne

    have hO_reg_open : IsOpen O_reg :=
      (hBack_open.inter hFwd_open).inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
    have h_f_shift_nhds : ∀ c : ℂ, shift_c c '' O_reg ⊆ U₁ →
        ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_reg, K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c c q)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro c hc_map
      have hsh_p : shift_c c p_reg = p_reg := by simp [shift_c, p_reg]
      have hLs_cont : ContinuousAt L.𝔰 (shift_c c p_reg) := by
        rw [hsh_p]
        exact (L.𝔰_holo.mono hU₁_sub_T).continuousOn.continuousAt
          (hU₁_open.mem_nhds ⟨hp_reg_cone, by simp [p_reg, hη₂_pos]⟩)
      have hf_cont : ContinuousAt K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c c p_reg)) := by
        rw [hsh_p, hLs_reg]
        exact (hStrip ▸ K.f_holo).continuousOn.continuousAt (hStrip_open.mem_nhds hs_reg_H)
      have hcomp_cont : ContinuousAt (fun q => K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c c q))) p_reg :=
        (hf_cont.comp hLs_cont).comp (hsh_cont c).continuousAt
      exact hcomp_cont.eventually_ne (by rw [hsh_p, hLs_reg]; exact hs_reg_f)
    have h_nhds_all : (O_reg ∩
        {q | K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0} ∩
        {q | K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0} ∩
        {q | K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0} ∩
        {q | K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0}) ∈ nhds p_reg := by
      refine Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem
        (hO_reg_open.mem_nhds hp_reg_mem) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
      · refine h_f_shift_nhds (-3 / 2 : ℂ) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨⟨hqB, _⟩, hqt⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [hBack_eq] at hqB; exact ⟨hqB.1, hqt⟩
      · refine h_f_shift_nhds (-1 / 2 : ℂ) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨⟨hqB, _⟩, hqt⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [hBack_eq] at hqB; exact ⟨hqB.2, hqt⟩
      · refine h_f_shift_nhds (1 / 2 : ℂ) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨⟨_, hqF⟩, hqt⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hqF.1, hqt⟩
      · refine h_f_shift_nhds (3 / 2 : ℂ) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨q, ⟨⟨_, hqF⟩, hqt⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hqF.2, hqt⟩
    obtain ⟨r_reg, hr_reg_pos, hball_reg⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_all
    exact ⟨η₂, p_reg, p_alt, r_reg,
      hη₂_pos, hη₂_d40, hη₂_s8, hη₂_r4,
      h_lsc_η₂, h_bshift_η₂, hs_eq_η₂,
      rfl, rfl, hp_reg_mem, hp_alt_mem, hst_ne, hLs_ne,
      hr_reg_pos,
      fun q hq => ((((hball_reg hq).1).1).1).1,
      fun q hq => ⟨((((hball_reg hq).1).1).1).2, (((hball_reg hq).1).1).2,
        ((hball_reg hq).1).2, (hball_reg hq).2⟩⟩

  let sliceLift : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ | -L.s_star / 2 < q.1.im ∧ q.1.im < H - d / 10 ∧ ‖q.2‖ < η₂ }
  let sliceBack : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' sliceLift ∩ shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' sliceLift
  let sliceFwd : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' sliceLift ∩ shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) ⁻¹' sliceLift

  have hSliceLift_open : IsOpen sliceLift :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)).inter
      ((isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const))
  have hSliceLift_conv : Convex ℝ sliceLift := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ q ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3⟩ a b ha hb hab
    have him : (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im := by simp
    have hnorm : ‖(a • p + b • q).2‖ ≤ a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
      calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
    have hc1 := h_conv_lt_left ha hb hab hp1 hq1
    have hc2 := h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hp2 hq2
    have hc3 := h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hp3 hq3
    exact ⟨by rw [him]; exact hc1, by rw [him]; exact hc2, lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm hc3⟩
  have hSliceBack_open : IsOpen sliceBack :=
    (hSliceLift_open.preimage (hsh_cont _)).inter (hSliceLift_open.preimage (hsh_cont _))
  have hSliceBack_conv : Convex ℝ sliceBack :=
    (hsh_conv _ hSliceLift_conv).inter (hsh_conv _ hSliceLift_conv)
  have hSliceFwd_open : IsOpen sliceFwd :=
    (hSliceLift_open.preimage (hsh_cont _)).inter (hSliceLift_open.preimage (hsh_cont _))
  have hSliceFwd_conv : Convex ℝ sliceFwd :=
    (hsh_conv _ hSliceLift_conv).inter (hsh_conv _ hSliceLift_conv)

  have hSliceLift_sub_T : sliceLift ⊆ L.T_norm := by
    intro q ⟨hq_lo, hq_hi, hq_t⟩
    rw [L.T_norm_iff]
    have hqt_r : ‖q.2‖ < L.r_star := by linarith [L.r_star_pos]
    have hqt_base : ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base := lt_trans hqt_r hr_lt_base
    have hb_bd := h_bshift_η₂ q.2 hq_t
    have hb_im : |(L.b_shift q.2).im| ≤ ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    have hb_d : ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ < d / 80 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_left _ _)
    have hb_s : ‖L.b_shift q.2‖ < L.s_star / 8 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_right _ _)
    refine ⟨hqt_r, hqt_base, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_neg_im : -(q.1 - L.b_shift q.2).im < M.s_base := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).2
        simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr h_neg_im)
        (M.h_X_ge (starRingEnd ℂ q.2)
          (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, RCLike.norm_conj]; exact hqt_base))
    · have h_pos_im : (q.1 - L.b_shift q.2).im ≤ H - d / 20 := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).1
        simp only [Complex.sub_im]; linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_pos_im) (h_lsc_η₂ q.2 hq_t)

  have hCone_η₂_sub_sliceLift :
      coneDomain H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2‖ < η₂ } ⊆ sliceLift := by
    intro q ⟨⟨hqd, hqδ, _, _⟩, hqt⟩
    exact ⟨by linarith [L.s_star_pos], by linarith, hqt⟩

  have hBack_η₂_sub : coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ } ⊆ sliceBack := by
    intro p ⟨hpB, hpt⟩
    rw [hBack_eq] at hpB
    exact ⟨hCone_η₂_sub_sliceLift ⟨hpB.1, hpt⟩, hCone_η₂_sub_sliceLift ⟨hpB.2, hpt⟩⟩

  have hFwd_η₂_sub : coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ } ⊆ sliceFwd := by
    intro p ⟨hpF, hpt⟩
    exact ⟨hCone_η₂_sub_sliceLift ⟨hpF.1, hpt⟩, hCone_η₂_sub_sliceLift ⟨hpF.2, hpt⟩⟩

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨p_real, r_real, hr_real_pos, hB_real_sub, hB_real_maps_base,
      hB_real_f, hB_real_id⟩ :
      ∃ (p_real : ℂ × ℂ) (r_real : ℝ),
        0 < r_real ∧
        Metric.ball p_real r_real ⊆ sliceBack ∩ sliceFwd ∧
        Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2))
          (Metric.ball p_real r_real)
          { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base } ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_real r_real,
          K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧
          K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0 ∧ K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q)) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_real r_real,
          let Pm := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          let Qm := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          let ψm := K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          let Pp := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          let Qp := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          let ψp := K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q))
          reflectDen Pm Qm ψm ≠ 0 ∧ reflectDen Pp Qp ψp ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2,
            reflectVtilde Pm Qm ψm i =
              glancingDualLine C (q.1 - L.b_shift q.2) q.2 i * reflectDen Pm Qm ψm ∧
            reflectVtilde Pp Qp ψp i =
              glancingDualLine C (q.1 - L.b_shift q.2) q.2 i * reflectDen Pp Qp ψp) := by
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
    have hb_cont0 : ContinuousAt L.b_shift 0 :=
      L.b_shift_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)
    let ε_base := min (L.s_star / 8) (M.s_base / 8)
    have hε_base : 0 < ε_base :=
      lt_min (by linarith [L.s_star_pos]) (by linarith [M.s_base_pos])
    have hb_ev : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℂ), L.b_shift t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_base := by
      have hball0 : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_base ∈ nhds (L.b_shift 0) := by
        rw [L.b_shift_zero]
        exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hε_base
      exact hb_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds hball0
    obtain ⟨δ_b, hδ_b, h_δb_ball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hb_ev
    let ρ_y := min (L.s_star / 4) (M.s_base / 4)
    let ρ_t := min η₂ (min δ_b (min (L.s_star / 8) (min (L.r_star / 4)
      (min (M.s_base / 8) (M.r_base / 4)))))
    have hρ_y : 0 < ρ_y :=
      lt_min (by linarith [L.s_star_pos]) (by linarith [M.s_base_pos])
    have hρ_t : 0 < ρ_t := lt_min hη₂_pos (lt_min hδ_b (lt_min (by linarith [L.s_star_pos])
      (lt_min (by linarith [L.r_star_pos]) (lt_min (by linarith [M.s_base_pos])
        (by linarith [M.r_base_pos])))))
    have hρy_s : ρ_y ≤ L.s_star / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hρy_m : ρ_y ≤ M.s_base / 4 := min_le_right _ _
    have hρt_η₂ : ρ_t ≤ η₂ := min_le_left _ _
    have hρt_δb : ρ_t ≤ δ_b := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hρt_s8 : ρ_t ≤ L.s_star / 8 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hρt_r4 : ρ_t ≤ L.r_star / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hρt_ms : ρ_t ≤ M.s_base / 8 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hρt_mr : ρ_t ≤ M.r_base / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))

    let U_base := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < ρ_y ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_t }
    have hU_base_open : IsOpen U_base :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)

    have h_bshift_ub : ∀ p ∈ U_base, ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < ε_base := by
      intro p hp
      have hm := h_δb_ball p.2 (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith [hp.2])
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hm

    have hU_base_slice : ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ ≤ 3 / 2 → ∀ p ∈ U_base, shift_c c p ∈ sliceLift := by
      intro c hc p ⟨hpy, hpt⟩
      have h_im_bd : |(shift_c c p).1.im| < L.s_star / 2 := by
        calc |(p.1 + c * p.2).im| = |p.1.im + (c * p.2).im| := by simp
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + |(c * p.2).im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + ‖c * p.2‖ := by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm (c * p.2)]
          _ = |p.1.im| + ‖c‖ * ‖p.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
          _ < L.s_star / 4 + (3 / 2) * (L.s_star / 8) := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg p.2, norm_nonneg c]
          _ < L.s_star / 2 := by linarith [L.s_star_pos]
      have h_abs := abs_lt.mp h_im_bd
      exact ⟨by linarith [h_abs.1], by linarith [h_abs.2], lt_of_lt_of_le hpt hρt_η₂⟩

    have h_norm_c : ‖(-3 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 3 / 2 ∧ ‖(-1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 3 / 2 ∧
        ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 3 / 2 ∧ ‖(3 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      norm_num

    have hU_base_sub_slices : U_base ⊆ sliceBack ∩ sliceFwd := by
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨⟨hU_base_slice _ h_norm_c.1 p hp, hU_base_slice _ h_norm_c.2.1 p hp⟩,
        ⟨hU_base_slice _ h_norm_c.2.2.1 p hp, hU_base_slice _ h_norm_c.2.2.2 p hp⟩⟩

    have hU_base_maps_m : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2))
        U_base { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base } := by
      intro p ⟨hpy, hpt⟩
      have hb_m : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < M.s_base / 8 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (h_bshift_ub p ⟨hpy, hpt⟩) (min_le_right _ _)
      refine ⟨?_, by linarith [M.r_base_pos]⟩
      calc |(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im| = |p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im| := by simp
        _ ≤ |p.1.im| + |(L.b_shift p.2).im| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ |p.1.im| + ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ := by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm (L.b_shift p.2)]
        _ < M.s_base := by linarith [M.s_base_pos]

    have h_init_eval : ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ ≤ 3 / 2 → ∀ p ∈ U_base,
        K.f (L.𝔰 (shift_c c p)) ≠ 0 ∧
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c p)) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2) p.2 ∧
        K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c p)) = glancingMidAngle C (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2) p.2 := by
      intro c hc p ⟨hpy, hpt⟩
      have hb_s : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < L.s_star / 8 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (h_bshift_ub p ⟨hpy, hpt⟩) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hu_im : |(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2).im| < K.s_init := by
        calc |(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2).im|
            = |p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im + (c * p.2).im| := by simp
          _ ≤ |p.1.im - (L.b_shift p.2).im| + |(c * p.2).im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + |(L.b_shift p.2).im| + ‖c * p.2‖ := by
              linarith [abs_sub p.1.im (L.b_shift p.2).im, Complex.abs_im_le_norm (c * p.2)]
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ + ‖c‖ * ‖p.2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul]; linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm (L.b_shift p.2)]
          _ < L.s_star / 4 + L.s_star / 8 + (3 / 2) * (L.s_star / 8) := by
              nlinarith [norm_nonneg p.2, norm_nonneg c]
          _ < K.s_init := by linarith [L.s_star_pos, L.s_star_le]
      have ht_r : ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init := by linarith [L.r_star_pos, L.r_star_le]
      have h_eq_init : L.𝔰 (shift_c c p) = K.𝔰_init (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2, p.2) := by
        change L.𝔰_raw (p.1 + c * p.2 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2) = _
        have h_arg : p.1 + c * p.2 - L.b_shift p.2 = p.1 - L.b_shift p.2 + c * p.2 := by ring
        rw [h_arg]
        exact L.𝔰_raw_init_eq _ _ hu_im ht_r
      rw [h_eq_init]
      exact ⟨K.f_base_ne_zero _ (K.𝔰_init_maps_to _ _ hu_im ht_r),
        (K.𝔰_init_impact _ _ hu_im ht_r).symm,
        K.𝔰_init_ϕ _ _ hu_im ht_r⟩

    have h_impact_proj : ∀ w t : ℂ, |w.im| < C.s₁ → ‖t‖ < C.r₁ →
        (glancingImpact C (w - t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C w t) +
          glancingImpact C (w - t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C w t) =
            glancingOffset C w t) ∧
        (glancingImpact C (w + t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C w t) +
          glancingImpact C (w + t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C w t) =
            glancingOffset C w t) := by
      intro w t hw ht
      have hstat := C.glancing_stationary w t hw ht
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · let θ₀ := glancingTheta C (w - t) t
        let θ₁ := glancingTheta C w t
        let ψ := (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2
        have hmid : glancingMidAngle C (w - t / 2) t = ψ := by
          dsimp only [glancingMidAngle, ψ, θ₀, θ₁]
          have h1 : w - t / 2 - t / 2 = w - t := by ring
          have h2 : w - t / 2 + t / 2 = w := by ring
          rw [h1, h2]
        have hsub : θ₁ - ψ = (θ₁ - θ₀) / 2 := by dsimp only [ψ]; ring
        have hc := Complex.cos_sub θ₁ ψ
        have hs := Complex.sin_sub θ₁ ψ
        rw [hsub] at hc hs
        dsimp only [glancingImpact, glancingOffset]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hmid]
        change (C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.cos ψ - deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.sin ψ) * Complex.cos θ₁ +
            (C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.sin ψ + deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.cos ψ) * Complex.sin θ₁ =
          -supportAction1_ℂ C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ (C.U (w, t))) (C.ϕ_ℂ (C.U (w + t, t)))
        rw [hstat]
        change (C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.cos ψ - deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.sin ψ) * Complex.cos θ₁ +
            (C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.sin ψ + deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.cos ψ) * Complex.sin θ₁ =
          deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.sin ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2) + C.h_ℂ ψ * Complex.cos ((θ₁ - θ₀) / 2)
        linear_combination C.h_ℂ ψ * hc.symm + deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * hs.symm
      · let θ₁ := glancingTheta C w t
        let θ₂ := glancingTheta C (w + t) t
        let ψ := (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2
        have hmid : glancingMidAngle C (w + t / 2) t = ψ := by
          dsimp only [glancingMidAngle, ψ, θ₁, θ₂]
          have h1 : w + t / 2 - t / 2 = w := by ring
          have h2 : w + t / 2 + t / 2 = w + t := by ring
          rw [h1, h2]
        have hsub : ψ - θ₁ = (θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 := by dsimp only [ψ]; ring
        have hc := Complex.cos_sub ψ θ₁
        have hs := Complex.sin_sub ψ θ₁
        rw [hsub] at hc hs
        dsimp only [glancingImpact, glancingOffset, supportAction1_ℂ]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hmid]
        linear_combination C.h_ℂ ψ * hc.symm - deriv C.h_ℂ ψ * hs.symm

    have h_cramer_step : ∀ w t : ℂ, |w.im| < C.s₁ → |w.im| < 2 * M.s_base → ‖t‖ < M.r_base →
        let P_minus := glancingImpact C (w - t / 2) t
        let P_plus := glancingImpact C (w + t / 2) t
        let Δ := P_minus 0 * P_plus 1 - P_minus 1 * P_plus 0
        let p_w := glancingOffset C w t
        P_plus 1 - P_minus 1 = (Δ / p_w) * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C w t) ∧
        P_minus 0 - P_plus 0 = (Δ / p_w) * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C w t) := by
      intro w t hw_s1 hw_sb ht_rb
      have ht_r1 : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith [M.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
      have hpw_ne : glancingOffset C w t ≠ 0 :=
        M.offset_ne_zero w t hw_sb (by linarith [M.r_base_pos])
      obtain ⟨hm, hp⟩ := h_impact_proj w t hw_s1 ht_r1
      dsimp only
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hpw_ne]
        linear_combination glancingImpact C (w + t / 2) t 1 * hm.symm -
          glancingImpact C (w - t / 2) t 1 * hp.symm
      · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hpw_ne]
        linear_combination glancingImpact C (w - t / 2) t 0 * hp.symm -
          glancingImpact C (w + t / 2) t 0 * hm.symm

    have h_trig_reflect : ∀ θ ψ : ℂ,
        2 * (Complex.cos θ * Complex.cos ψ + Complex.sin θ * Complex.sin ψ) * Complex.cos ψ -
          Complex.cos θ = Complex.cos (2 * ψ - θ) ∧
        2 * (Complex.cos θ * Complex.cos ψ + Complex.sin θ * Complex.sin ψ) * Complex.sin ψ -
          Complex.sin θ = Complex.sin (2 * ψ - θ) := by
      intro θ ψ
      generalize hh : ψ - θ = h
      have hθ : θ = ψ - h := by linear_combination -hh
      have h2 : 2 * ψ - (ψ - h) = ψ + h := by ring
      have hcs : Complex.cos ψ ^ 2 + Complex.sin ψ ^ 2 = 1 := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ψ
      rw [hθ, h2, Complex.cos_sub, Complex.sin_sub, Complex.cos_add, Complex.sin_add]
      exact ⟨by linear_combination 2 * Complex.cos h * Complex.cos ψ * hcs,
             by linear_combination 2 * Complex.cos h * Complex.sin ψ * hcs⟩

    have h_reflect_unit : ∀ (P Q : Fin 2 → ℂ) (a θ ψ : ℂ),
        reflectW P Q 0 = a * Complex.cos θ →
        reflectW P Q 1 = a * Complex.sin θ →
        reflectVtilde P Q ψ 0 = a * Complex.cos (2 * ψ - θ) ∧
        reflectVtilde P Q ψ 1 = a * Complex.sin (2 * ψ - θ) ∧
        reflectDen P Q ψ =
          a * (P 0 * Complex.cos (2 * ψ - θ) + P 1 * Complex.sin (2 * ψ - θ)) := by
      intro P Q a θ ψ hW0 hW1
      obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := h_trig_reflect θ ψ
      have hv0 : reflectVtilde P Q ψ 0 = a * Complex.cos (2 * ψ - θ) := by
        dsimp only [reflectVtilde]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        rw [hW0, hW1]; linear_combination a * ht0
      have hv1 : reflectVtilde P Q ψ 1 = a * Complex.sin (2 * ψ - θ) := by
        dsimp only [reflectVtilde]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        rw [hW0, hW1]; linear_combination a * ht1
      refine ⟨hv0, hv1, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [reflectDen]; rw [hv0, hv1]; ring

    have h_cramer_on_U : ∀ p ∈ U_base,
        let u := p.1 - L.b_shift p.2
        let t := p.2
        let Pm := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let Qm := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let ψm := K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let Pp := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let Qp := K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let ψp := K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p))
        let Δ_m := glancingImpact C (u - t - t / 2) t 0 * glancingImpact C (u - t + t / 2) t 1 -
          glancingImpact C (u - t - t / 2) t 1 * glancingImpact C (u - t + t / 2) t 0
        let Δ_p := glancingImpact C (u + t - t / 2) t 0 * glancingImpact C (u + t + t / 2) t 1 -
          glancingImpact C (u + t - t / 2) t 1 * glancingImpact C (u + t + t / 2) t 0
        reflectDen Pm Qm ψm = (Δ_m / glancingOffset C (u - t) t) * glancingOffset C u t ∧
        reflectDen Pp Qp ψp = (-Δ_p / glancingOffset C (u + t) t) * glancingOffset C u t ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2,
          reflectVtilde Pm Qm ψm i = glancingDualLine C u t i * reflectDen Pm Qm ψm ∧
          reflectVtilde Pp Qp ψp i = glancingDualLine C u t i * reflectDen Pp Qp ψp := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only
      set u := p.1 - L.b_shift p.2
      set t := p.2
      have hb_m : ‖L.b_shift t‖ < M.s_base / 8 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (h_bshift_ub p hp) (min_le_right _ _)
      have ht_rb : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [hp.2, M.r_base_pos]
      have ht_r1 : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith [M.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
      have hu_im : |u.im| < M.s_base := by
        calc |u.im| = |p.1.im - (L.b_shift t).im| := by simp [u, t]
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + |(L.b_shift t).im| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ |p.1.im| + ‖L.b_shift t‖ := by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm (L.b_shift t)]
          _ < M.s_base := by linarith [hp.1, M.s_base_pos]
      have hum_im : |(u - t).im| < M.s_base + M.r_base := by
        calc |(u - t).im| ≤ |u.im| + |t.im| := by simp only [Complex.sub_im]; exact abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ |u.im| + ‖t‖ := by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm t]
          _ < M.s_base + M.r_base := by linarith
      have hup_im : |(u + t).im| < M.s_base + M.r_base := by
        calc |(u + t).im| ≤ |u.im| + |t.im| := by simp only [Complex.add_im]; exact abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ |u.im| + ‖t‖ := by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm t]
          _ < M.s_base + M.r_base := by linarith
      have hp0_ne : glancingOffset C u t ≠ 0 :=
        M.offset_ne_zero u t (by linarith [M.s_base_pos]) (by linarith [M.r_base_pos])

      have h_m1 := h_init_eval (-1 / 2 : ℂ) h_norm_c.2.1 p hp
      have h_m3 := h_init_eval (-3 / 2 : ℂ) h_norm_c.1 p hp
      have h_p1 := h_init_eval (1 / 2 : ℂ) h_norm_c.2.2.1 p hp
      have h_p3 := h_init_eval (3 / 2 : ℂ) h_norm_c.2.2.2 p hp

      have ha_m1 : u + (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * t = u - t / 2 := by ring
      have ha_m1' : u - t + t / 2 = u - t / 2 := by ring
      have ha_m3 : u + (-3 / 2 : ℂ) * t = u - t - t / 2 := by ring
      have ha_p1 : u + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * t = u + t / 2 := by ring
      have ha_p1' : u + t - t / 2 = u + t / 2 := by ring
      have ha_p3 : u + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * t = u + t + t / 2 := by ring

      let Pm := glancingImpact C (u - t / 2) t
      let Qm := glancingImpact C (u - t - t / 2) t
      let ψm := glancingMidAngle C (u - t / 2) t
      let Pp := glancingImpact C (u + t / 2) t
      let Qp := glancingImpact C (u + t + t / 2) t
      let ψp := glancingMidAngle C (u + t / 2) t

      have hPm_eq : K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = Pm := by rw [h_m1.2.1, ha_m1]
      have hQm_eq : K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = Qm := by rw [h_m3.2.1, ha_m3]
      have hψm_eq : K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = ψm := by rw [h_m1.2.2, ha_m1]
      have hPp_eq : K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = Pp := by rw [h_p1.2.1, ha_p1]
      have hQp_eq : K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = Qp := by rw [h_p3.2.1, ha_p3]
      have hψp_eq : K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) = ψp := by rw [h_p1.2.2, ha_p1]

      obtain ⟨hcr_m0, hcr_m1⟩ := h_cramer_step (u - t) t
        (by linarith [M.r_base_lt_s_base, M.s_base_le_s₁, M.s_base_pos])
        (by linarith [M.r_base_lt_s_base, M.s_base_pos]) ht_rb
      simp only [ha_m1'] at hcr_m0 hcr_m1
      let Δ_m := Qm 0 * Pm 1 - Qm 1 * Pm 0
      let p_m := glancingOffset C (u - t) t
      let θ_m := glancingTheta C (u - t) t
      let θ₀ := glancingTheta C u t
      have hWm0 : reflectW Pm Qm 0 = (Δ_m / p_m) * Complex.cos θ_m := by
        dsimp only [reflectW]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]; exact hcr_m0
      have hWm1 : reflectW Pm Qm 1 = (Δ_m / p_m) * Complex.sin θ_m := by
        dsimp only [reflectW]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]; exact hcr_m1
      have h2ψm : 2 * ψm - θ_m = θ₀ := by
        dsimp only [ψm, glancingMidAngle, θ_m, θ₀]
        have h_sub1 : u - t / 2 - t / 2 = u - t := by ring
        have h_sub2 : u - t / 2 + t / 2 = u := by ring
        rw [h_sub1, h_sub2]; ring
      obtain ⟨hVm0, hVm1, hDm⟩ := h_reflect_unit Pm Qm (Δ_m / p_m) θ_m ψm hWm0 hWm1
      rw [h2ψm] at hVm0 hVm1 hDm
      have hproj := h_impact_proj u t (by linarith [M.s_base_le_s₁, M.s_base_pos]) ht_r1
      rw [hproj.1] at hDm

      obtain ⟨hcr_p0, hcr_p1⟩ := h_cramer_step (u + t) t
        (by linarith [M.r_base_lt_s_base, M.s_base_le_s₁, M.s_base_pos])
        (by linarith [M.r_base_lt_s_base, M.s_base_pos]) ht_rb
      simp only [ha_p1'] at hcr_p0 hcr_p1
      let Δ_p := Pp 0 * Qp 1 - Pp 1 * Qp 0
      let p_p := glancingOffset C (u + t) t
      let θ_p := glancingTheta C (u + t) t
      have hWp0 : reflectW Pp Qp 0 = (-Δ_p / p_p) * Complex.cos θ_p := by
        dsimp only [reflectW]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        have : Pp 1 - Qp 1 = -(Qp 1 - Pp 1) := by ring
        rw [this, hcr_p0]; ring
      have hWp1 : reflectW Pp Qp 1 = (-Δ_p / p_p) * Complex.sin θ_p := by
        dsimp only [reflectW]; simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        have : Qp 0 - Pp 0 = -(Pp 0 - Qp 0) := by ring
        rw [this, hcr_p1]; ring
      have h2ψp : 2 * ψp - θ_p = θ₀ := by
        dsimp only [ψp, glancingMidAngle, θ_p, θ₀]
        have h_add1 : u + t / 2 - t / 2 = u := by ring
        have h_add2 : u + t / 2 + t / 2 = u + t := by ring
        rw [h_add1, h_add2]; ring
      obtain ⟨hVp0, hVp1, hDp⟩ := h_reflect_unit Pp Qp (-Δ_p / p_p) θ_p ψp hWp0 hWp1
      rw [h2ψp] at hVp0 hVp1 hDp
      rw [hproj.2] at hDp

      rw [hPm_eq, hQm_eq, hψm_eq, hPp_eq, hQp_eq, hψp_eq]
      have hDm' : reflectDen Pm Qm ψm =
          ((Qm 0 * glancingImpact C (u - t + t / 2) t 1 -
            Qm 1 * glancingImpact C (u - t + t / 2) t 0) / p_m) * glancingOffset C u t := by
        rw [hDm]; dsimp only [Δ_m, Pm]; rw [ha_m1']
      have hDp' : reflectDen Pp Qp ψp =
          (-(glancingImpact C (u + t - t / 2) t 0 * Qp 1 -
            glancingImpact C (u + t - t / 2) t 1 * Qp 0) / p_p) * glancingOffset C u t := by
        rw [hDp]; dsimp only [Δ_p, Pp]; rw [ha_p1']
      refine ⟨hDm', hDp', Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
      · rw [hVm0, hDm]; simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, θ₀]
        field_simp [hp0_ne]
      · rw [hVp0, hDp]; simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, θ₀]
        field_simp [hp0_ne]
      · rw [hVm1, hDm]; simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, θ₀]
        field_simp [hp0_ne]
      · rw [hVp1, hDp]; simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, θ₀]
        field_simp [hp0_ne]

    let t_re : ℝ := ρ_t / 2
    have ht_re_def : t_re = ρ_t / 2 := rfl
    have ht_re_pos : 0 < t_re := by linarith
    have ht_re_init : t_re < K.r_init := by linarith [L.r_star_le, L.r_star_pos]
    have ht_re_m : t_re < M.r_base := by linarith [M.r_base_pos]
    have ht_re_r1 : t_re < C.r₁ := by linarith [M.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
    let p_real : ℂ × ℂ := ((x₀ : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))
    have hp_real_U : p_real ∈ U_base := by
      refine ⟨by simp [p_real, hρ_y], ?_⟩
      simp only [p_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]
      linarith
    have hb_im_zero : (L.b_shift (t_re : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
      have hconj := L.b_shift_conj (t_re : ℂ) (by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]
        exact ht_re_m)
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
    let u_re : ℝ := x₀ - (L.b_shift (t_re : ℂ)).re
    have hu_real_eq : p_real.1 - L.b_shift p_real.2 = (u_re : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [p_real, u_re]
      · simp [p_real, hb_im_zero]

    
    have hϕ_nat_qp : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ),
        C.ϕ (s + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = C.ϕ s + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro s; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro s
        have hstep : s + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
            (s + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hstep, C.ϕ_quasiperiodic, ih]
        push_cast; ring

    have hϕ_int_qp : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℝ),
        C.ϕ (s + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = C.ϕ s + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro k s
      rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg k with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
      · exact_mod_cast hϕ_nat_qp n s
      · have h1 := hϕ_nat_qp n (s - (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))
        have h2 : s - (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = s := by ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        have h_arg : s + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) = s - (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          push_cast; ring
        have h3 : ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) = -(n : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg, h3]
        linarith

    have h_theta_real : ∀ r : ℝ,
        glancingTheta C (r : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) = ((C.ϕ (C.U ((r : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro r
      have htr_norm : ‖(t_re : ℂ)‖ < C.r₁ := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]; exact ht_re_r1
      have hconj := C.U_conj (r : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ)
        (by simp; linarith [C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]) htr_norm
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      have him : (C.U ((r : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))).im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
      have heq : C.U ((r : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ)) = ((C.U ((r : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))).re : ℂ) :=
        Complex.ext rfl (by simp [him])
      dsimp only [glancingTheta]
      exact (congr_arg C.ϕ_ℂ heq).trans (C.ϕ_ℂ_real _)

    have h_real_impact_eval : ∀ y : ℝ,
        ∃ s_y : ℝ,
          glancingImpact C (y : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) = K.Γ (s_y : ℂ) ∧
          C.ϕ s_y =
            (C.ϕ (C.U (((y - t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))).re +
              C.ϕ (C.U (((y + t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))).re) / 2 := by
      intro y
      have hy_im : |(y : ℂ).im| < K.s_init := by simp [K.s_init_pos]
      have ht_norm : ‖(t_re : ℂ)‖ < K.r_init := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]; exact ht_re_init
      let s_c := K.𝔰_init ((y : ℂ), (t_re : ℂ))
      have hconj := K.𝔰_init_conj (y : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) hy_im ht_norm
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      have him : s_c.im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
      have hsc_eq : s_c = (s_c.re : ℂ) := Complex.ext rfl (by simp [him])
      have hsc_strip : s_c ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to _ _ hy_im ht_norm
      have hϕ_eq : (C.ϕ s_c.re : ℂ) = glancingMidAngle C (y : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) := by
        calc (C.ϕ s_c.re : ℂ) = C.ϕ_ℂ (s_c.re : ℂ) := (C.ϕ_ℂ_real s_c.re).symm
          _ = C.ϕ_ℂ s_c := by rw [← hsc_eq]
          _ = K.ϕ s_c := (K.base_ϕ_eq s_c hsc_strip).1.symm
          _ = glancingMidAngle C (y : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) := K.𝔰_init_ϕ _ _ hy_im ht_norm
      refine ⟨s_c.re, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hsc_eq]
        exact K.𝔰_init_impact _ _ hy_im ht_norm
      · have h1 : (y : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2 = ((y - t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        have h2 : (y : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2 = ((y + t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        dsimp only [glancingMidAngle] at hϕ_eq
        rw [h1, h2, h_theta_real, h_theta_real] at hϕ_eq
        have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hϕ_eq
        simpa using hre

    have h_real_delta_nz : ∀ x : ℝ,
        glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0 *
            glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 -
          glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 *
            glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hΔ0
      have hcramer := h_cramer_step (x : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ)
        (by simp; linarith [C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁])
        (by simp [M.s_base_pos])
        (by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]; exact ht_re_m)
      dsimp only at hcramer
      rw [hΔ0, zero_div, zero_mul, zero_mul] at hcramer
      have hP_eq : glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) =
          glancingImpact C ((x : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) := by
        ext i
        rcases Fin.exists_fin_two.mp ⟨i, rfl⟩ with rfl | rfl
        · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcramer.2
        · exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hcramer.1).symm
      obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁_Γ, hs₁_ϕ⟩ := h_real_impact_eval (x - t_re / 2)
      obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂_Γ, hs₂_ϕ⟩ := h_real_impact_eval (x + t_re / 2)
      have hc1 : ((x - t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2 := by push_cast; ring
      have hc2 : ((x + t_re / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hc1] at hs₁_Γ
      rw [hc2] at hs₂_Γ
      rw [hs₁_Γ, hs₂_Γ] at hP_eq
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.Γ_real_simple s₂ s₁ hP_eq.symm
      have hs₂_eq : s₂ = s₁ + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by linarith
      have hϕ_diff_k : C.ϕ s₂ - C.ϕ s₁ = (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [hs₂_eq, hϕ_int_qp]; ring
      have ha1 : x - t_re / 2 - t_re / 2 = x - t_re := by ring
      have ha2 : x - t_re / 2 + t_re / 2 = x := by ring
      have ha3 : x + t_re / 2 - t_re / 2 = x := by ring
      have ha4 : x + t_re / 2 + t_re / 2 = x + t_re := by ring
      rw [ha1, ha2] at hs₁_ϕ
      rw [ha3, ha4] at hs₂_ϕ
      have hstep1 := C.U_real_step_pos (x - t_re) t_re ht_re_pos ht_re_r1
      have ha5 : ((x - t_re + t_re : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_sub] at hstep1 hs₁_ϕ
      have ha5' : (x : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [ha5'] at hstep1
      have hstep2 := C.U_real_step_pos x t_re ht_re_pos ht_re_r1
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_add] at hstep2 hs₂_ϕ
      have h_pos_diff : 0 < C.ϕ s₂ - C.ϕ s₁ := by linarith [hstep1.2.1, hstep2.2.1]
      have h_lt_pi : C.ϕ s₂ - C.ϕ s₁ < Real.pi := by linarith [hstep1.2.2, hstep2.2.2]
      rw [hϕ_diff_k] at h_pos_diff h_lt_pi
      rcases le_or_gt k 0 with hk0 | hk1
      · have hk_nonpos : (k : ℝ) ≤ 0 := Int.cast_nonpos.mpr hk0
        have hmul_le : (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hk_nonpos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
        linarith
      · have hk_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Int.add_one_le_iff.mpr hk1
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

    obtain ⟨hDm_real, hDp_real, _⟩ := h_cramer_on_U p_real hp_real_U
    have htr2_norm : ‖(t_re : ℂ)‖ < 2 * M.r_base := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht_re_pos)]; linarith [M.r_base_pos]
    have hp0_nz : glancingOffset C (u_re : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      M.offset_ne_zero (u_re : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ) (by simp [M.s_base_pos]) htr2_norm

    have hDm_real_nz : reflectDen (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p_real)))
        (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) p_real))) (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p_real))) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hDm_real, hu_real_eq]
      change (((glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0 *
          glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 -
        glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 *
          glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0) /
        glancingOffset C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ)) *
        glancingOffset C (u_re : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ)) ≠ 0
      have hpm_nz : glancingOffset C ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        M.offset_ne_zero ((u_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ) (by simp [M.s_base_pos]) htr2_norm
      have hΔm_nz := h_real_delta_nz (u_re - t_re)
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_sub] at hΔm_nz
      exact mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hΔm_nz hpm_nz) hp0_nz

    have hDp_real_nz : reflectDen (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p_real)))
        (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) p_real))) (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p_real))) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hDp_real, hu_real_eq]
      change ((-((glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0 *
          glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 -
        glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) - (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 1 *
          glancingImpact C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ) / 2) (t_re : ℂ) 0)) /
        glancingOffset C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ)) *
        glancingOffset C (u_re : ℂ) (t_re : ℂ)) ≠ 0
      have hpp_nz : glancingOffset C ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        M.offset_ne_zero ((u_re : ℂ) + (t_re : ℂ)) (t_re : ℂ) (by simp [M.s_base_pos]) htr2_norm
      have hΔp_nz := h_real_delta_nz (u_re + t_re)
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_add] at hΔp_nz
      exact mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hΔp_nz) hpp_nz) hp0_nz

    have h_shift_L_cont : ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ ≤ 3 / 2 →
        ContinuousAt (fun q => K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c q)) 0) p_real ∧
        ContinuousAt (fun q => K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c q)) 1) p_real ∧
        ContinuousAt (fun q => K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c q))) p_real := by
      intro c hc
      have hsh_mem : shift_c c p_real ∈ sliceLift := hU_base_slice c hc p_real hp_real_U
      have hLs_at_sh : ContinuousAt L.𝔰 (shift_c c p_real) :=
        (L.𝔰_holo.mono hSliceLift_sub_T).continuousOn.continuousAt
          (hSliceLift_open.mem_nhds hsh_mem)
      have hs_in_D : L.𝔰 (shift_c c p_real) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) :=
        L.𝔰_maps_to _ (hSliceLift_sub_T hsh_mem)
      have hreg := K.Γ_reg_holo _ hs_in_D (h_init_eval c hc p_real hp_real_U).1
      have hϕ_cont : ContinuousAt K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c p_real)) :=
        (hStrip ▸ K.ϕ_holo).continuousOn.continuousAt (hStrip_open.mem_nhds (hStrip ▸ hs_in_D))
      exact ⟨(hreg.1.continuousAt.comp hLs_at_sh).comp (hsh_cont c).continuousAt,
        (hreg.2.continuousAt.comp hLs_at_sh).comp (hsh_cont c).continuousAt,
        (hϕ_cont.comp hLs_at_sh).comp (hsh_cont c).continuousAt⟩

    have hDen_cont : ∀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ, ‖c₁‖ ≤ 3 / 2 → ‖c₂‖ ≤ 3 / 2 →
        ContinuousAt (fun q =>
          reflectDen (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c₁ q))) (K.Γ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c₂ q))) (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (shift_c c₁ q)))) p_real := by
      intro c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₂
      obtain ⟨hP0, hP1, hψ⟩ := h_shift_L_cont c₁ hc₁
      obtain ⟨hQ0, hQ1, _⟩ := h_shift_L_cont c₂ hc₂
      have hcos := Complex.continuous_cos.continuousAt.comp hψ
      have hsin := Complex.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp hψ
      have hW0 := hP1.sub hQ1
      have hW1 := hQ0.sub hP0
      have hdot := (hW0.mul hcos).add (hW1.mul hsin)
      exact (hP0.mul (((continuousAt_const.mul hdot).mul hcos).sub hW0)).add
        (hP1.mul (((continuousAt_const.mul hdot).mul hsin).sub hW1))

    have hDm_ev := (hDen_cont (-1 / 2) (-3 / 2) h_norm_c.2.1 h_norm_c.1).eventually_ne hDm_real_nz
    have hDp_ev := (hDen_cont (1 / 2) (3 / 2) h_norm_c.2.2.1 h_norm_c.2.2.2).eventually_ne hDp_real_nz
    obtain ⟨r_real, hr_real_pos, hball_real⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (Filter.inter_mem (hU_base_open.mem_nhds hp_real_U) (Filter.inter_mem hDm_ev hDp_ev))
    refine ⟨p_real, r_real, hr_real_pos,
      fun q hq => hU_base_sub_slices (hball_real hq).1,
      fun q hq => hU_base_maps_m (hball_real hq).1,
      fun q hq => ⟨(h_init_eval _ h_norm_c.1 q (hball_real hq).1).1,
        (h_init_eval _ h_norm_c.2.1 q (hball_real hq).1).1,
        (h_init_eval _ h_norm_c.2.2.1 q (hball_real hq).1).1,
        (h_init_eval _ h_norm_c.2.2.2 q (hball_real hq).1).1⟩,
      fun q hq => ⟨(hball_real hq).2.1, (hball_real hq).2.2,
        (h_cramer_on_U q (hball_real hq).1).2.2⟩⟩

  
  
  
  let B_real := Metric.ball p_real r_real
  let B_reg := Metric.ball p_reg r_reg
  have hp_real_mem : p_real ∈ B_real := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_real_pos
  have hp_reg_ball : p_reg ∈ B_reg := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_reg_pos

  have hsh_reg_eq : ∀ c : ℂ, shift_c c p_reg = p_reg ∧ shift_c c p_alt = p_alt := by
    intro c
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · ext <;> simp [shift_c, hp_reg_2]
    · ext <;> simp [shift_c, hp_alt_2]

  have hB_reg_sub_slice : B_reg ⊆ sliceBack ∩ sliceFwd := by
    intro q hq
    have hm := hB_reg_sub hq
    exact ⟨hBack_η₂_sub ⟨hm.1.1, hm.2⟩, hFwd_η₂_sub ⟨hm.1.2, hm.2⟩⟩

  have hLs_sliceLift_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ L.𝔰 sliceLift := L.𝔰_holo.mono hSliceLift_sub_T
  have hLs_sliceLift_maps : ∀ q ∈ sliceLift, L.𝔰 q ∈ horizStrip H :=
    fun q hq => hStrip ▸ L.𝔰_maps_to q (hSliceLift_sub_T hq)

  obtain ⟨Q_back_sl, hQ_back_sl_reg⟩ := h_mkReflectedMero hSliceBack_open hSliceBack_conv
    (fun p => L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) (fun p => L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
    (hLs_sliceLift_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.2))
    (hLs_sliceLift_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1))
    (fun _ hp => hLs_sliceLift_maps _ hp.2)
    (fun _ hp => hLs_sliceLift_maps _ hp.1)
    ⟨p_reg, (hB_reg_sub_slice hp_reg_ball).1,
     p_alt, hBack_η₂_sub ⟨hp_alt_mem.1.1, hp_alt_mem.2⟩,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hLs_ne⟩
    ⟨p_reg, (hB_reg_sub_slice hp_reg_ball).1,
     p_alt, hBack_η₂_sub ⟨hp_alt_mem.1.1, hp_alt_mem.2⟩,
