     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hLs_ne⟩
    (fun _ hq => (hB_real_sub hq).1)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_real_f q hq).2.1, (hB_real_f q hq).1⟩)
    hp_real_mem (hB_real_id p_real hp_real_mem).1

  obtain ⟨Q_fwd_sl, hQ_fwd_sl_reg⟩ := h_mkReflectedMero hSliceFwd_open hSliceFwd_conv
    (fun p => L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) (fun p => L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
    (hLs_sliceLift_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1))
    (hLs_sliceLift_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.2))
    (fun _ hp => hLs_sliceLift_maps _ hp.1)
    (fun _ hp => hLs_sliceLift_maps _ hp.2)
    ⟨p_reg, (hB_reg_sub_slice hp_reg_ball).2,
     p_alt, hFwd_η₂_sub ⟨hp_alt_mem.1.2, hp_alt_mem.2⟩,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hLs_ne⟩
    ⟨p_reg, (hB_reg_sub_slice hp_reg_ball).2,
     p_alt, hFwd_η₂_sub ⟨hp_alt_mem.1.2, hp_alt_mem.2⟩,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hLs_ne⟩
    (fun _ hq => (hB_real_sub hq).2)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_real_f q hq).2.2.1, (hB_real_f q hq).2.2.2⟩)
    hp_real_mem (hB_real_id p_real hp_real_mem).2.1

  have hst_eq_on_B_reg : ∀ q ∈ B_reg,
      s_tilde (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q) = L.𝔰 (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q) ∧
      s_tilde (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q) = L.𝔰 (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q) ∧
      s_tilde (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q) = L.𝔰 (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q) ∧
      s_tilde (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q) = L.𝔰 (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨⟨hqB, hqF⟩, hqt⟩ := hB_reg_sub hq
    rw [hBack_eq] at hqB
    exact ⟨hs_eq_η₂ _ hqB.1 hqt, hs_eq_η₂ _ hqB.2 hqt,
      hs_eq_η₂ _ hqF.1 hqt, hs_eq_η₂ _ hqF.2 hqt⟩

  have hQ_back_B_reg_pack := hQ_back_sl_reg Metric.isOpen_ball
    (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub_slice hq).1)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).1⟩)
  obtain ⟨q₀_back, hq₀_back_mem, hD_q₀_back_sl⟩ := hQ_back_B_reg_pack.1 ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_ball⟩
  have hD_q₀_back_st :
      reflectDen (K.Γ (s_tilde (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_back)))
        (K.Γ (s_tilde (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_back)))
        (K.ϕ (s_tilde (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_back))) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q₀_back hq₀_back_mem).2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q₀_back hq₀_back_mem).1]
    exact hD_q₀_back_sl

  have hQ_fwd_B_reg_pack := hQ_fwd_sl_reg Metric.isOpen_ball
    (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub_slice hq).2)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.2⟩)
  obtain ⟨q₀_fwd, hq₀_fwd_mem, hD_q₀_fwd_sl⟩ := hQ_fwd_B_reg_pack.1 ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_ball⟩
  have hD_q₀_fwd_st :
      reflectDen (K.Γ (s_tilde (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_fwd)))
        (K.Γ (s_tilde (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_fwd)))
        (K.ϕ (s_tilde (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) q₀_fwd))) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q₀_fwd hq₀_fwd_mem).2.2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q₀_fwd hq₀_fwd_mem).2.2.2]
    exact hD_q₀_fwd_sl

  have hBack_maps_near : Set.MapsTo (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ))
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀) (coneDomain H δ_star d x₀) := by
    intro p hp; rw [hBack_eq] at hp; exact hp.2
  have hBack_maps_far : Set.MapsTo (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ))
      (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀) (coneDomain H δ_star d x₀) := by
    intro p hp; rw [hBack_eq] at hp; exact hp.1

  obtain ⟨L_back, hL_back_reg⟩ := h_mkReflectedMero hBack_open hBack_conv
    (fun p => s_tilde (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) (fun p => s_tilde (shift_c (-3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
    (hs_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn hBack_maps_near)
    (hs_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn hBack_maps_far)
    (fun p hp => hs_maps _ (hBack_maps_near hp))
    (fun p hp => hs_maps _ (hBack_maps_far hp))
    ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_mem.1.1, p_alt, hp_alt_mem.1.1,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hst_ne⟩
    ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_mem.1.1, p_alt, hp_alt_mem.1.1,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hst_ne⟩
    (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub hq).1.1)
    (fun q hq => by
      rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).1]
      exact ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).1⟩)
    hq₀_back_mem hD_q₀_back_st

  obtain ⟨L_fwd, hL_fwd_reg⟩ := h_mkReflectedMero hFwd_open hFwd_conv
    (fun p => s_tilde (shift_c (1 / 2 : ℂ) p)) (fun p => s_tilde (shift_c (3 / 2 : ℂ) p))
    (hs_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1))
    (hs_holo.comp (hsh_diff _).differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.2))
    (fun _ hp => hs_maps _ hp.1)
    (fun _ hp => hs_maps _ hp.2)
    ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_mem.1.2, p_alt, hp_alt_mem.1.2,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hst_ne⟩
    ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_mem.1.2, p_alt, hp_alt_mem.1.2,
     by rw [(hsh_reg_eq _).1, (hsh_reg_eq _).2]; exact hst_ne⟩
    (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub hq).1.2)
    (fun q hq => by
      rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.2.2]
      exact ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.2⟩)
    hq₀_fwd_mem hD_q₀_fwd_st

  have hL_back_eq_sl_Breg : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (L_back i) (Q_back_sl i) B_reg := by
    intro i
    have hLb_pack := (hL_back_reg Metric.isOpen_ball (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub hq).1.1)
      (fun q hq => by
        rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).1]
        exact ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).1⟩)).2
    refine h_meroEqOn_of_local (L_back i) (Q_back_sl i)
      (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_reg_sub hq).1.1, (hB_reg_sub_slice hq).1⟩) (fun p hp => ?_)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, _, _, hsub₁, heq₁⟩ := hLb_pack p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, _, _, _, heq₂⟩ := hQ_back_B_reg_pack.2 p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
    have hq₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
    have hq_reg : q ∈ B_reg := hsub₁ hq₁
    obtain ⟨hN₁, hD₁⟩ := heq₁ q hq₁ i
    obtain ⟨hN₂, hD₂⟩ := heq₂ q hq₂ i
    rw [hN₁, hD₁, hN₂, hD₂, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq_reg).2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq_reg).1]

  have hL_fwd_eq_sl_Breg : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (L_fwd i) (Q_fwd_sl i) B_reg := by
    intro i
    have hLf_pack := (hL_fwd_reg Metric.isOpen_ball (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub hq).1.2)
      (fun q hq => by
        rw [(hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq).2.2.2]
        exact ⟨(hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.1, (hB_reg_f q hq).2.2.2⟩)).2
    refine h_meroEqOn_of_local (L_fwd i) (Q_fwd_sl i)
      (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_reg_sub hq).1.2, (hB_reg_sub_slice hq).2⟩) (fun p hp => ?_)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, _, _, hsub₁, heq₁⟩ := hLf_pack p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, _, _, _, heq₂⟩ := hQ_fwd_B_reg_pack.2 p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
    have hq₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
    have hq_reg : q ∈ B_reg := hsub₁ hq₁
    obtain ⟨hN₁, hD₁⟩ := heq₁ q hq₁ i
    obtain ⟨hN₂, hD₂⟩ := heq₂ q hq₂ i
    rw [hN₁, hD₁, hN₂, hD₂, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq_reg).2.2.1, (hst_eq_on_B_reg q hq_reg).2.2.2]

  have hQ_back_B_real_pack := (hQ_back_sl_reg Metric.isOpen_ball
    (fun _ hq => (hB_real_sub hq).1)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_real_f q hq).2.1, (hB_real_f q hq).1⟩)).2
  have hQ_fwd_B_real_pack := (hQ_fwd_sl_reg Metric.isOpen_ball
    (fun _ hq => (hB_real_sub hq).2)
    (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_real_f q hq).2.2.1, (hB_real_f q hq).2.2.2⟩)).2

  have hQ_back_eq_fwd_Breal : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (Q_back_sl i) (Q_fwd_sl i) B_real := by
    intro i
    refine h_meroEqOn_of_local (Q_back_sl i) (Q_fwd_sl i) hB_real_sub (fun p hp => ?_)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, _, _, hsub₁, heq₁⟩ := hQ_back_B_real_pack p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, _, _, _, heq₂⟩ := hQ_fwd_B_real_pack p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
    have hq₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
    have hq_real : q ∈ B_real := hsub₁ hq₁
    obtain ⟨hN₁, hD₁⟩ := heq₁ q hq₁ i
    obtain ⟨hN₂, hD₂⟩ := heq₂ q hq₂ i
    obtain ⟨_, _, hid⟩ := hB_real_id q hq_real
    rw [hN₁, hD₁, hN₂, hD₂, (hid i).1, (hid i).2]
    ring

  have h_back_eq_fwd : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      MeroEqOn (L_back i) (L_fwd i)
        (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ coneDomainFwd H δ_star d x₀) := by
    intro i
    have hQ_slices : MeroEqOn (Q_back_sl i) (Q_fwd_sl i) (sliceBack ∩ sliceFwd) :=
      h_meroEqOn_propagate (hSliceBack_open.inter hSliceFwd_open)
        (hSliceBack_conv.inter hSliceFwd_conv).isPreconnected
        (fun _ hp => hp) Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_real, hp_real_mem⟩ hB_real_sub
        (hQ_back_eq_fwd_Breal i)
    have hQ_Breg : MeroEqOn (Q_back_sl i) (Q_fwd_sl i) B_reg :=
      h_meroEqOn_mono hB_reg_sub_slice hQ_slices
    have hL_Breg : MeroEqOn (L_back i) (L_fwd i) B_reg :=
      h_meroEqOn_trans (h_meroEqOn_trans (hL_back_eq_sl_Breg i) hQ_Breg)
        (h_meroEqOn_symm (hL_fwd_eq_sl_Breg i))
    exact h_meroEqOn_propagate (hBack_open.inter hFwd_open)
      (hBack_conv.inter hFwd_conv).isPreconnected
      (fun _ hp => hp) Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_ball⟩
      (fun _ hq => (hB_reg_sub hq).1) hL_Breg

  let S_shift : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2, p.2)
  let S_unshift : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1 + L.b_shift q.2, q.2)
  let O_rbase : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2‖ < M.r_base }
  have hO_rbase_open : IsOpen O_rbase :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
  have hS_shift_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_shift O_rbase := by
    have hb2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => L.b_shift p.2) O_rbase :=
      L.b_shift_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; exact hp)
    exact (differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.sub hb2).prodMk differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
  have hS_unshift_cont : ContinuousOn S_unshift O_rbase := by
    have hb2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => L.b_shift q.2) O_rbase :=
      L.b_shift_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
        (fun q hq => by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; exact hq)
    exact ((differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.add hb2).prodMk differentiable_snd.differentiableOn).continuousOn

  have hSliceBack_maps_WL : Set.MapsTo S_shift sliceBack (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_L) := by
    intro p ⟨_, hp_m1⟩
    obtain ⟨hp_lo, hp_hi, hpt⟩ := hp_m1
    have hpt_r : ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base := by linarith [L.r_star_pos]
    have hpt_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; exact hpt_r
    have hpt_conj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, RCLike.norm_conj]; exact hpt_r
    have hb_bd := h_bshift_η₂ p.2 hpt
    have hb_im : |(L.b_shift p.2).im| ≤ ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    have hb_d : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < d / 80 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_left _ _)
    have hb_s : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < L.s_star / 8 := lt_of_lt_of_le hb_bd (min_le_right _ _)
    have hhalf_im : |((-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ η₂ / 2 := by
      calc |((-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ ‖(-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = (1 / 2) * ‖p.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul]; norm_num
        _ ≤ η₂ / 2 := by linarith
    have h_decomp : (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im =
        (shift_c (-1 / 2 : ℂ) p).1.im - ((-1 / 2 : ℂ) * p.2).im - (L.b_shift p.2).im := by
      simp [shift_c]
    refine ⟨hpt_r, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_neg : -(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im < M.s_base := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).1
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).2
        have := (abs_le.mp hhalf_im).1
        have := (abs_le.mp hhalf_im).2
        rw [h_decomp]; linarith
      have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (-(p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im) < M.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr h_neg) (M.h_X_ge _ hpt_conj_ball)
      rw [M.h_L_eq _ hpt_conj_ball]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 le_self_add
    · have h_pos : (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im ≤ H - d / 20 := by
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).1
        have := (abs_le.mp hb_im).2
        have := (abs_le.mp hhalf_im).1
        have := (abs_le.mp hhalf_im).2
        rw [h_decomp]; linarith
      have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (p.1 - L.b_shift p.2).im < M.h_X p.2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_pos) (h_lsc_η₂ p.2 hpt)
      rw [M.h_L_eq _ hpt_ball]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 le_self_add

  have hSliceBack_sub_Or : sliceBack ⊆ O_rbase := fun p hp => (hSliceBack_maps_WL hp).1

  have h_pull_rad : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      ∃ r : ℝ, p ∈ sliceBack →
        0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ sliceBack ∧
        Set.MapsTo S_shift (Metric.ball p r)
          (Metric.ball (S_shift p) ((M.L_mero i).rad (S_shift p))) := by
    intro i p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ sliceBack
    · have hΦp : S_shift p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_L := hSliceBack_maps_WL hp
      have hrad_pos : 0 < (M.L_mero i).rad (S_shift p) := (M.L_mero i).rad_pos _ hΦp
      have hΦ_cont : ContinuousAt S_shift p :=
        (hS_shift_holo.mono hSliceBack_sub_Or).continuousOn.continuousAt (hSliceBack_open.mem_nhds hp)
      have h_nhds : sliceBack ∩
          S_shift ⁻¹' Metric.ball (S_shift p) ((M.L_mero i).rad (S_shift p)) ∈ nhds p :=
        Filter.inter_mem (hSliceBack_open.mem_nhds hp)
          (hΦ_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hrad_pos))
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      exact ⟨r, fun _ => ⟨hr, fun q hq => (hball hq).1, fun q hq => (hball hq).2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨1, fun h => absurd h hp⟩
  choose rad_pull h_rad_pull using h_pull_rad

  let L_mero_sl : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D sliceBack := fun i => {
    rad := rad_pull i
    num := fun p q => (M.L_mero i).num (S_shift p) (S_shift q)
    den := fun p q => (M.L_mero i).den (S_shift p) (S_shift q)
    rad_pos := fun p hp => (h_rad_pull i p hp).1
    ball_sub := fun p hp => (h_rad_pull i p hp).2.1
    num_holo := fun p hp =>
      ((M.L_mero i).num_holo _ (hSliceBack_maps_WL hp)).comp
        (hS_shift_holo.mono (Set.Subset.trans (h_rad_pull i p hp).2.1 hSliceBack_sub_Or))
        (h_rad_pull i p hp).2.2
    den_holo := fun p hp =>
      ((M.L_mero i).den_holo _ (hSliceBack_maps_WL hp)).comp
        (hS_shift_holo.mono (Set.Subset.trans (h_rad_pull i p hp).2.1 hSliceBack_sub_Or))
        (h_rad_pull i p hp).2.2
    den_ne_zero := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hr_p, _, _⟩ := h_rad_pull i p hp
      have hΦp : S_shift p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_L := hSliceBack_maps_WL hp
      have hΨ_cont : ContinuousAt S_unshift (S_shift p) :=
        hS_unshift_cont.continuousAt (hO_rbase_open.mem_nhds hΦp.1)
      have hΨΦ : S_unshift (S_shift p) = p := by ext <;> simp [S_shift, S_unshift]
      have h_nhds : S_unshift ⁻¹' Metric.ball p (rad_pull i p) ∩
          Metric.ball (S_shift p) ((M.L_mero i).rad (S_shift p)) ∈ nhds (S_shift p) :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          (hΨ_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hΨΦ]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds p hr_p))
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ ((M.L_mero i).rad_pos _ hΦp))
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball_ε⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      obtain ⟨y_st, hy_st_ball, hy_st_nz⟩ := h_exists_nz Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball (S_shift p) ((M.L_mero i).rad (S_shift p))).isPreconnected
        ((M.L_mero i).den_holo _ hΦp) ((M.L_mero i).den_ne_zero _ hΦp)
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨S_shift p, Metric.mem_ball_self hε⟩
        (fun z hz => (hball_ε hz).2)
      have hΦΨ : S_shift (S_unshift y_st) = y_st := by ext <;> simp [S_shift, S_unshift]
      refine ⟨S_unshift y_st, (hball_ε hy_st_ball).1, ?_⟩
      rwa [hΦΨ]
    compat := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
      exact (M.L_mero i).compat (S_shift p₁) (hSliceBack_maps_WL hp₁)
        (S_shift p₂) (hSliceBack_maps_WL hp₂) (S_shift q)
        ⟨(h_rad_pull i p₁ hp₁).2.2 hq.1, (h_rad_pull i p₂ hp₂).2.2 hq.2⟩
  }

  have hQ_eq_Lmero_Breal : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (Q_back_sl i) (L_mero_sl i) B_real := by
    intro i
    refine h_meroEqOn_of_local (Q_back_sl i) (L_mero_sl i)
      (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_real_sub hq).1, (hB_real_sub hq).1⟩) (fun p hp => ?_)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, _, _, hsub₁, heq₁⟩ := hQ_back_B_real_pack p hp
    have hΦp_base := hB_real_maps_base hp
    obtain ⟨r_L, hr_L, _, _, heq_L⟩ := (M.L_agrees i).2 (S_shift p) hΦp_base
    have hΦ_cont : ContinuousAt S_shift p :=
      (hS_shift_holo.mono hSliceBack_sub_Or).continuousOn.continuousAt
        (hSliceBack_open.mem_nhds (hB_real_sub hp).1)
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hball₂⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (hΦ_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (S_shift p) hr_L))
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
    have hq₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
    have hq_real : q ∈ B_real := hsub₁ hq₁
    obtain ⟨hN₁, hD₁⟩ := heq₁ q hq₁ i
    have hL_q := heq_L (S_shift q) (hball₂ hq₂)
    obtain ⟨_, _, hid⟩ := hB_real_id q hq_real
    dsimp only [L_mero_sl]
    rw [hN₁, hD₁, hL_q, (hid i).1]
    dsimp only [S_shift]
    ring

  have h_back_eq_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      MeroEqOnPullback (L_back i) (M.L_mero i) S_shift
        (coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ }) := by
    intro i
    let U_back := coneDomainBack H δ_star d x₀ ∩ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < η₂ }
    have hU_back_open : IsOpen U_back :=
      hBack_open.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
    have hU_back_conv : Convex ℝ U_back := by
      refine hBack_conv.inter (fun p hp q hq a b ha hb hab => ?_)
      have hnorm : ‖(a • p + b • q).2‖ ≤ a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
        calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm (h_conv_lt_right ha hb hab hp hq)
    have hQ_eq_sl : MeroEqOn (Q_back_sl i) (L_mero_sl i) sliceBack :=
      h_meroEqOn_propagate hSliceBack_open hSliceBack_conv.isPreconnected
        (fun _ hp => ⟨hp, hp⟩) Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_real, hp_real_mem⟩
        (fun _ hq => (hB_real_sub hq).1) (hQ_eq_Lmero_Breal i)
    have hLb_eq_Q : MeroEqOn (L_back i) (Q_back_sl i) U_back :=
      h_meroEqOn_propagate hU_back_open hU_back_conv.isPreconnected
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hBack_η₂_sub hp⟩) Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_reg, hp_reg_ball⟩
        (fun q hq => ⟨(hB_reg_sub hq).1.1, (hB_reg_sub hq).2⟩) (hL_back_eq_sl_Breg i)
    have hLb_eq_Lm : MeroEqOn (L_back i) (L_mero_sl i) U_back :=
      h_meroEqOn_trans hLb_eq_Q (h_meroEqOn_mono hBack_η₂_sub hQ_eq_sl)
    refine ⟨Set.inter_subset_left, hSliceBack_maps_WL.mono_left hBack_η₂_sub, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hp_sl : p ∈ sliceBack := hBack_η₂_sub hp
    let r := min ((L_back i).rad p) ((L_mero_sl i).rad p)
    have hr : 0 < r := lt_min ((L_back i).rad_pos p hp.1) ((L_mero_sl i).rad_pos p hp_sl)
    refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_left _ _,
      (h_rad_pull i p hp_sl).2.2.mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)),
      fun q hq => hLb_eq_Lm.2 p hp q hq⟩

  exact ⟨{
    L_back := L_back
    L_fwd := L_fwd
    back_eq_fwd := h_back_eq_fwd
    η₂ := η₂
    η₂_pos := hη₂_pos
    η₂_le := by linarith
    back_eq_mero := h_back_eq_mero
  }⟩

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K)
    (H δ_star : ℝ)

    (hδ0 : 0 < δ_star)
    (hδH : δ_star < H - L.s_star) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      IsEmpty (ShiftedConeDualLines C M L H δ_star d x₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hTK : QdMero2DPullbackGluingToolkit := by
    clear Ω C M K L H δ_star hH hδ0 hδH
    have eqOn_zero_of_ball_2D :
        ∀ {p₂ p₁ : ℂ × ℂ} {R r₁ : ℝ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R → 0 < r₁ →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball p₂ R) →
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁, f q = 0) →
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R, f q = 0 := by
      intro p₂ p₁ R r₁ f hp₁ hr₁ hf h0 q hq
      let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => p₁ + z • (q - p₁)
      have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
        (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - p₁)).const_add p₁
      let Ω_z : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₂ R
      have hΩ_open : IsOpen Ω_z := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
        show p₁ + (0 : ℂ) • (q - p₁) ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R
        simpa using hp₁
      have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
        show p₁ + (1 : ℂ) • (q - p₁) ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R
        simpa using hq
      have hΩ_conv : Convex ℝ Ω_z := by
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
        show γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R
        have h_aff : γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • γ z₁ + b • γ z₂ := by
          dsimp [γ]
          have habC : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
          ext
          · simp [Complex.real_smul]; linear_combination -(p₁.1) * habC
          · simp [Complex.real_smul]; linear_combination -(p₁.2) * habC
        rw [h_aff]
        exact (convex_ball p₂ R) hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
      have hfg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f ∘ γ) Ω_z :=
        hf.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)
      have hfg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ γ) Ω_z := hfg_diff.analyticOnNhd hΩ_open
      have h_ev : f ∘ γ =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
        have h_nhds : γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₁ r₁ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
          apply hγ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          apply Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
          show p₁ + (0 : ℂ) • (q - p₁) ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁
          rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
          exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁
        exact Filter.eventually_of_mem h_nhds (fun z hz => h0 (γ z) hz)
      have h_eq := hfg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hΩ_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem h_ev h1_mem
      simpa [γ] using h_eq
    have eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D :
        ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
          IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
          (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0 := by
      intro W V f hW_open hW_pre hf hV_open ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ hVW hV0
      let S : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p ∈ W | ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ W ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, f q = 0 }
      have hS_open : IsOpen S := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        rintro p ⟨_, r, hr, hsub, hzero⟩
        refine ⟨r, hr, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
        have hr' : 0 < r - dist p' p := sub_pos.mpr hp'
        have hsub' : Metric.ball p' (r - dist p' p) ⊆ Metric.ball p r := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq hp' ⊢
          linarith [dist_triangle q p' p]
        exact ⟨hsub hp', r - dist p' p, hr', Subset.trans hsub' hsub,
          fun q hq => hzero q (hsub' hq)⟩
      have hWS_ne : (W ∩ S).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open v₀ hv₀
        exact ⟨v₀, hVW hv₀, hVW hv₀, r, hr, Subset.trans hsub hVW, fun q hq => hV0 q (hsub hq)⟩
      have h_cl : closure S ∩ W ⊆ S := by
        rintro p₂ ⟨hp₂_cl, hp₂_W⟩
        obtain ⟨R, hR, hR_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open p₂ hp₂_W
        obtain ⟨p₁, ⟨_, r₁, hr₁, _, hzero₁⟩, hp₁_dist⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₂_cl R hR
        have hp₁_ball : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ R := by
          rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        exact ⟨hp₂_W, R, hR, hR_sub,
          eqOn_zero_of_ball_2D hp₁_ball hr₁ (hf.mono hR_sub) hzero₁⟩
      have hW_sub := hW_pre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hS_open hWS_ne h_cl
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨_, r, hr, _, hzero⟩ := hW_sub hp
      exact hzero p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
    have exists_ne_zero_on_subopen :
        ∀ {B V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          IsOpen B → IsPreconnected B → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
          (∃ q₀ ∈ B, g q₀ ≠ 0) →
          IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B →
          ∃ (q₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball q₁ δ ⊆ V ∧
            ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ δ, g q ≠ 0 := by
      intro B V g hB_open hB_pre hg ⟨q₀, hq₀B, hq₀_ne⟩ hV_open hV_ne hVB
      have h_not_all_zero : ¬ ∀ q ∈ V, g q = 0 := by
        intro hall
        exact hq₀_ne (eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hB_open hB_pre hg hV_open hV_ne hVB hall q₀ hq₀B)
      obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ := not_forall.mp h_not_all_zero
      obtain ⟨hq₁V, hq₁_ne⟩ := not_imp.mp hq₁
      have hg_cont : ContinuousAt g q₁ :=
        (hg.continuousOn.continuousAt (hB_open.mem_nhds (hVB hq₁V)))
      have h_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁, q ∈ V ∧ g q ≠ 0 :=
        Filter.Eventually.and (hV_open.mem_nhds hq₁V) (hg_cont.eventually_ne hq₁_ne)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_ev
      exact ⟨q₁, δ, hδ_pos, fun q hq => (hδ hq).1, fun q hq => (hδ hq).2⟩
    have meroEqOn_of_local :
        ∀ {W₁ W₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
          U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
          (∀ p ∈ U, ∃ V_p : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_p ∧ V_p.Nonempty ∧
            V_p ⊆ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) ∧
            ∀ q ∈ V_p, F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q) →
          MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
      intro W₁ W₂ U F₁ F₂ hU hloc
      refine ⟨hU, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ := hU hp
      obtain ⟨V_p, hVp_open, hVp_ne, hVp_sub, hVp_eq⟩ := hloc p hp
      let r := min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
      have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z) (Metric.ball p r) :=
        ((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) |>.mul
          ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
      have hzero := eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r).isPreconnected
        hf_holo hVp_open hVp_ne hVp_sub (fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hVp_eq z hz)) q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    have h_eq_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
        {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
      intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U ⟨hU, heq⟩
      refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(hU hp).2, (hU hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
      rw [min_comm] at hq
      exact (heq p hp q hq).symm
    have h_eq_trans : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
        {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
      intro W₁ W₂ W₃ F₁ F₂ F₃ U ⟨hU12, heq12⟩ ⟨hU23, heq23⟩
      apply meroEqOn_of_local (fun p hp => ⟨(hU12 hp).1, (hU23 hp).2⟩)
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : p ∈ W₁ := (hU12 hp).1
      have hp2 : p ∈ W₂ := (hU12 hp).2
      have hp3 : p ∈ W₃ := (hU23 hp).2
      let r := min (min (F₁.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) (F₂.rad p)
      have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
        lt_min (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp1) (F₃.rad_pos p hp3)) (F₂.rad_pos p hp2)
      obtain ⟨q₁, δ, hδ_pos, hδ_sub, hδ_ne⟩ :=
        exists_ne_zero_on_subopen Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F₂.rad p)).isPreconnected
          (F₂.den_holo p hp2) (F₂.den_ne_zero p hp2)
          Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos⟩
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      refine ⟨Metric.ball q₁ δ, Metric.isOpen_ball, ⟨q₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos⟩,
        Subset.trans hδ_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)), fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hq_r : q ∈ Metric.ball p r := hδ_sub hq
      have h12 : F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q :=
        heq12 p hp q (Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)) hq_r)
      have h23 : F₂.num p q * F₃.den p q = F₃.num p q * F₂.den p q :=
        heq23 p hp q (Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hq_r)
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (hδ_ne q hq)
      calc (F₁.num p q * F₃.den p q) * F₂.den p q
          = (F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q) * F₃.den p q := by ring
        _ = (F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q) * F₃.den p q := by rw [h12]
        _ = (F₂.num p q * F₃.den p q) * F₁.den p q := by ring
        _ = (F₃.num p q * F₂.den p q) * F₁.den p q := by rw [h23]
        _ = (F₃.num p q * F₁.den p q) * F₂.den p q := by ring
    have h_eq_pre : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
        IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
      intro W₁ W₂ U V F₁ F₂ hU_open hU_pre hU_sub hV_open ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ hVU ⟨_, hV_eq⟩
      have h_step : ∀ {p₁ p₂ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ → p₂ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)),
            F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q = F₂.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₁ q) →
          (Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)) ∩
            Metric.ball p₂ (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂))).Nonempty →
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₂ (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂)),
            F₁.num p₂ q * F₂.den p₂ q = F₂.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₂ q := by
        intro p₁ p₂ ⟨hp₁1, hp₁2⟩ ⟨hp₂1, hp₂2⟩ heq₁ h_inter_ne
        let B₁ := Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁))
        let B₂ := Metric.ball p₂ (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂))
        obtain ⟨q_a, δ_a, hδ_a, hsub_a, hne_a⟩ :=
          exists_ne_zero_on_subopen Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁ (F₁.rad p₁)).isPreconnected
            (F₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁1) (F₁.den_ne_zero p₁ hp₁1)
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) h_inter_ne
            (Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))
        obtain ⟨q_b, δ_b, hδ_b, hsub_b, hne_b⟩ :=
          exists_ne_zero_on_subopen Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁ (F₂.rad p₁)).isPreconnected
            (F₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁2) (F₂.den_ne_zero p₁ hp₁2)
            Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q_a, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a⟩
            (Subset.trans hsub_a
              (Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))))
        have h_eq_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q_b δ_b,
            F₁.num p₂ q * F₂.den p₂ q = F₂.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₂ q := by
          intro q hq
          have hq_a : q ∈ Metric.ball q_a δ_a := hsub_b hq
          have hq_inter : q ∈ B₁ ∩ B₂ := hsub_a hq_a
          have hc1 : F₁.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₂ q = F₁.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₁ q :=
            F₁.compat p₁ hp₁1 p₂ hp₂1 q
              ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq_inter.1,
               Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq_inter.2⟩
          have hc2 : F₂.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₂ q = F₂.num p₂ q * F₂.den p₁ q :=
            F₂.compat p₁ hp₁2 p₂ hp₂2 q
              ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq_inter.1,
               Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq_inter.2⟩
          have he1 : F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q = F₂.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₁ q :=
            heq₁ q hq_inter.1
          have hden_ne : F₁.den p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q ≠ 0 :=
            mul_ne_zero (hne_a q hq_a) (hne_b q hq)
          apply mul_right_cancel₀ hden_ne
          calc (F₁.num p₂ q * F₂.den p₂ q) * (F₁.den p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q)
              = (F₁.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₁ q) * F₂.den p₂ q * F₂.den p₁ q := by ring
            _ = (F₁.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₂ q) * F₂.den p₂ q * F₂.den p₁ q := by rw [← hc1]
            _ = (F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q) * F₁.den p₂ q * F₂.den p₂ q := by ring
            _ = (F₂.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₁ q) * F₁.den p₂ q * F₂.den p₂ q := by rw [he1]
            _ = (F₂.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₂ q) * F₁.den p₂ q * F₁.den p₁ q := by ring
            _ = (F₂.num p₂ q * F₂.den p₁ q) * F₁.den p₂ q * F₁.den p₁ q := by rw [hc2]
            _ = (F₂.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₂ q) * (F₁.den p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q) := by ring
        have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun z => F₁.num p₂ z * F₂.den p₂ z - F₂.num p₂ z * F₁.den p₂ z) B₂ :=
          ((F₁.num_holo p₂ hp₂1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) |>.mul
            ((F₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
          (((F₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
            ((F₁.den_holo p₂ hp₂1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
        intro q hq
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected hf_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
          ⟨q_b, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_b⟩
          (Subset.trans hsub_b (Subset.trans hsub_a Set.inter_subset_right))
          (fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (h_eq_sub z hz)) q hq)
      let S : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p ∈ U | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)),
            F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q }
      have hS_open : IsOpen S := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        rintro p₁ ⟨hp₁U, heq₁⟩
        obtain ⟨rU, hrU, hsubU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p₁ hp₁U
        let r := min rU (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁))
        have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hrU
          (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₁ (hU_sub hp₁U).1) (F₂.rad_pos p₁ (hU_sub hp₁U).2))
        refine ⟨r, hr, fun p₂ hp₂ => ?_⟩
        have hp₂U : p₂ ∈ U := hsubU (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₂)
        have hp₂_B₁ : p₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp₂
        have hp₂_B₂ : p₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂)) :=
          Metric.mem_ball_self
            (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₂ (hU_sub hp₂U).1) (F₂.rad_pos p₂ (hU_sub hp₂U).2))
        exact ⟨hp₂U, h_step (hU_sub hp₁U) (hU_sub hp₂U) heq₁ ⟨p₂, hp₂_B₁, hp₂_B₂⟩⟩
      have hUS_ne : (U ∩ S).Nonempty :=
        ⟨v₀, hVU hv₀, hVU hv₀, hV_eq v₀ hv₀⟩
      have h_cl : closure S ∩ U ⊆ S := by
        rintro p₂ ⟨hp₂_cl, hp₂U⟩
        have hr₂ : 0 < min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂) :=
          lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₂ (hU_sub hp₂U).1) (F₂.rad_pos p₂ (hU_sub hp₂U).2)
        obtain ⟨p₁, ⟨hp₁U, heq₁⟩, hp₁_dist⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₂_cl (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂)) hr₂
        have hp₁_B₂ : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ (min (F₁.rad p₂) (F₂.rad p₂)) := by
          rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        have hp₁_B₁ : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)) :=
          Metric.mem_ball_self
            (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₁ (hU_sub hp₁U).1) (F₂.rad_pos p₁ (hU_sub hp₁U).2))
        exact ⟨hp₂U, h_step (hU_sub hp₁U) (hU_sub hp₂U) heq₁ ⟨p₁, hp₁_B₁, hp₁_B₂⟩⟩
      have hU_S := hU_pre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hS_open hUS_ne h_cl
      exact ⟨hU_sub, fun p hp => (hU_S hp).2⟩
    have h_glue_two : ∀ {U₁ U₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → U = U₁ ∪ U₂ →
        ∀ (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
          MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
          ∃ G : MeroOn2D U, MeroEqOn G G₁ U₁ ∧ MeroEqOn G G₂ U₂ := by
      classical
      intro U₁ U₂ U _ _ hU_eq G₁ G₂ ⟨_, h12⟩
      have mem_U₂ : ∀ {p}, p ∈ U → p ∉ U₁ → p ∈ U₂ := by
        intro p hp hp1
        rw [hU_eq] at hp
        exact hp.resolve_left hp1
      let G : MeroOn2D U := {
        rad := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.rad p else G₂.rad p
        num := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.num p else G₂.num p
        den := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.den p else G₂.den p
        rad_pos := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp1 : p ∈ U₁
          · simp [hp1, G₁.rad_pos p hp1]
          · simp [hp1, G₂.rad_pos p (mem_U₂ hp hp1)]
        ball_sub := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp1 : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp1, ↓reduceIte]
            exact Subset.trans (G₁.ball_sub p hp1) (hU_eq ▸ Set.subset_union_left)
          · simp only [hp1, ↓reduceIte]
            exact Subset.trans (G₂.ball_sub p (mem_U₂ hp hp1)) (hU_eq ▸ Set.subset_union_right)
        num_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp1 : p ∈ U₁
          · simp [hp1, G₁.num_holo p hp1]
          · simp [hp1, G₂.num_holo p (mem_U₂ hp hp1)]
        den_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp1 : p ∈ U₁
          · simp [hp1, G₁.den_holo p hp1]
          · simp [hp1, G₂.den_holo p (mem_U₂ hp hp1)]
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp1 : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp1, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₁.den_ne_zero p hp1
          · simp only [hp1, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₂.den_ne_zero p (mem_U₂ hp hp1)
        compat := by
          have cross_compat : ∀ p₁ ∈ U₁, ∀ p₂ ∈ U₂,
              ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂),
                G₁.num p₁ q * G₂.den p₂ q = G₂.num p₂ q * G₁.den p₁ q := by
            intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
            let B := Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂)
            have hqU1 : q ∈ U₁ := G₁.ball_sub p₁ hp₁ hq.1
            have hqU2 : q ∈ U₂ := G₂.ball_sub p₂ hp₂ hq.2
            let Bq := Metric.ball q (min (G₁.rad q) (G₂.rad q))
            have hrq : 0 < min (G₁.rad q) (G₂.rad q) :=
              lt_min (G₁.rad_pos q hqU1) (G₂.rad_pos q hqU2)
            obtain ⟨q_a, δ_a, hδ_a, hsub_a, hne_a⟩ :=
              exists_ne_zero_on_subopen Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q (G₁.rad q)).isPreconnected
                (G₁.den_holo q hqU1) (G₁.den_ne_zero q hqU1)
                ((Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
                ⟨q, hq, Metric.mem_ball_self hrq⟩
                (Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))
            obtain ⟨q_b, δ_b, hδ_b, hsub_b, hne_b⟩ :=
              exists_ne_zero_on_subopen Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q (G₂.rad q)).isPreconnected
                (G₂.den_holo q hqU2) (G₂.den_ne_zero q hqU2)
                Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q_a, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a⟩
                (Subset.trans hsub_a
                  (Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))))
            have h_eq_sub : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q_b δ_b,
                G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z = G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₁ z := by
              intro z hz
              have hza : z ∈ Metric.ball q_a δ_a := hsub_b hz
              have hzB : z ∈ B ∧ z ∈ Bq := hsub_a hza
              have hc1 : G₁.num p₁ z * G₁.den q z = G₁.num q z * G₁.den p₁ z :=
                G₁.compat p₁ hp₁ q hqU1 z
                  ⟨hzB.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hzB.2⟩
              have hc2 : G₂.num p₂ z * G₂.den q z = G₂.num q z * G₂.den p₂ z :=
                G₂.compat p₂ hp₂ q hqU2 z
                  ⟨hzB.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hzB.2⟩
              have he12 : G₁.num q z * G₂.den q z = G₂.num q z * G₁.den q z :=
                h12 q ⟨hqU1, hqU2⟩ z hzB.2
              apply mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (hne_a z hza) (hne_b z hz))
              calc (G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z) * (G₁.den q z * G₂.den q z)
                  = (G₁.num p₁ z * G₁.den q z) * G₂.den p₂ z * G₂.den q z := by ring
                _ = (G₁.num q z * G₁.den p₁ z) * G₂.den p₂ z * G₂.den q z := by rw [hc1]
                _ = (G₁.num q z * G₂.den q z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z := by ring
                _ = (G₂.num q z * G₁.den q z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z := by rw [he12]
                _ = (G₂.num q z * G₂.den p₂ z) * G₁.den q z * G₁.den p₁ z := by ring
                _ = (G₂.num p₂ z * G₂.den q z) * G₁.den q z * G₁.den p₁ z := by rw [← hc2]
                _ = (G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₁ z) * (G₁.den q z * G₂.den q z) := by ring
            have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun z => G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₁ z) B :=
              ((G₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁).mono Set.inter_subset_left |>.mul
                ((G₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂).mono Set.inter_subset_right)).sub
              (((G₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂).mono Set.inter_subset_right).mul
                ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁).mono Set.inter_subset_left))
            exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
              ((convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
              hf_holo Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q_b, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_b⟩
              (Subset.trans hsub_b (Subset.trans hsub_a Set.inter_subset_left))

        lt_of_lt_of_le ht (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have ht_rb : ‖p.2‖ < r_b := by linarith [hδ_ov_le]
      have hb_lt : ‖L.b_shift p.2‖ < ε' / 16 := by
        have h1 := hb_lip p.2 ht_rb
        have h2 : C_b * ‖p.2‖ < C_b * (ε' / (16 * C_b)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht_cb hC_b_pos
        have h3 : C_b * (ε' / (16 * C_b)) = ε' / 16 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hC_b_pos]
        linarith
      have hb_im : (L.b_shift p.2).im < ε' / 16 :=
        (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hb_lt)).2
      have hquad_lt : ‖(Complex.I / (4 * (d : ℂ))) * p.2 ^ 2‖ < ε' / 800 := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_div, Complex.norm_I, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hd0, norm_pow]
        have ht_eps : ‖p.2‖ < ε' := lt_of_lt_of_le ht hδ_ov_le
        have hsq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < ε' * (d / 200) := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg p.2]
        have hdiv : 1 / (4 * d) * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < 1 / (4 * d) * (ε' * (d / 200)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsq (by positivity)
        have heq : 1 / (4 * d) * (ε' * (d / 200)) = ε' / 800 := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hd0]; ring
        linarith
      have hquad_im : ((Complex.I / (4 * (d : ℂ))) * p.2 ^ 2).im < ε' / 800 :=
        (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hquad_lt)).2
      have him_eq : (qdWallPatchToQuad L.b_shift d x₀ H p).1.im =
          (p.1.im - H) + (L.b_shift p.2).im + ((Complex.I / (4 * (d : ℂ))) * p.2 ^ 2).im := by
        dsimp [qdWallPatchToQuad, qdDiskInv, qdCollarUnshiftMap]
        simp
        ring
      rw [him_eq]
      linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).2]
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp [qdWallPatchToQuad, qdDiskInv, qdCollarUnshiftMap]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hd0]
      have ht_tl : ‖p.2‖ < d * δ_tilde_low :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le ht (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hdiv : ‖p.2‖ / d < (d * δ_tilde_low) / d := div_lt_div_of_pos_right ht_tl hd0
      have heq : (d * δ_tilde_low) / d = δ_tilde_low := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hd0]
      linarith
  have hV_low_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (qdCollarShiftMap L.b_shift ∘ qdDiskMap d x₀ H) V_low :=
    (h_low_inv δ_tilde_low hδ_tl_pos (min_le_left _ _)).2.2.1
  have hg_eq_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (M.L_mero i) O_ov := by
    intro i
    have hComp : MeroEqOnPullback (g i) (M.L_mero i)
        ((qdCollarShiftMap L.b_shift ∘ qdDiskMap d x₀ H) ∘ qdWallPatchToQuad L.b_shift d x₀ H)
        O_ov :=
      hTK.pullback_comp h_patch_inv hV_low_holo hO_ov_open hO_ov_sub_bidisk hO_ov_maps
        (hg_pull i) (hI2_low i)
    have hO_sub_tube : O_ov ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_L := by
      intro p hp
      have hm := hComp.2.1 hp
      have heq :
          ((qdCollarShiftMap L.b_shift ∘ qdDiskMap d x₀ H) ∘
            qdWallPatchToQuad L.b_shift d x₀ H) p = p :=
        h_shift_right_inv H p
      rwa [heq] at hm
    have hId_inv : QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn id id O_ov (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_L) :=
      ⟨hO_ov_open, h_tube_open, differentiableOn_id, hO_sub_tube,
        continuousOn_id, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hSymm : MeroEqOn (M.L_mero i) (g i) O_ov :=
      hTK.pullback_meroEqOn hO_ov_open (fun p hp => ⟨hO_sub_tube hp, hp⟩) hId_inv
        (fun p _ => by simp only [Function.comp_apply, id_eq]; exact h_shift_right_inv H p)
        (hTK.pullback_id_self (M.L_mero i)) hComp
        ⟨fun _ h => ⟨h, h⟩, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩ hO_sub_tube
    exact hTK.eq_symm hSymm
  exact M.no_patch_L_at_real 0 x₀ H ε' h0_r h_hL0_real hε'_pos hε'_lt_sbase
    ⟨g, δ_ov, hδ_ov_pos, hδ_ov_le, hg_eq_mero⟩

quadratic_disk_cone_wall_contradiction.definitions:
noncomputable def qdDiskMap (d x₀ σ : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  ((x₀ : ℂ) + (σ : ℂ) * Complex.I - ((d : ℂ) * Complex.I / 4) * q.2 ^ 2 + q.1,
   (d : ℂ) * q.2)

noncomputable def qdDiskInv (d x₀ σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (σ : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (Complex.I / (4 * (d : ℂ))) * p.2 ^ 2,
   p.2 / (d : ℂ))

def qdFullDisk (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d / 50) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (51 / 50)

def qdAnnulus (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d / 50) ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | 49 / 50 < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < 51 / 50 }

def qdAnnulusUp (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ qdAnnulus d ∧ -‖q.2‖ / 20 < q.2.im }

def qdAnnulusLo (d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | q ∈ qdAnnulus d ∧ q.2.im < ‖q.2‖ / 20 }

noncomputable def qdStepShift (d : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (q.1 + ((d / 100 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)

noncomputable def qdStepShiftInv (d : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (q.1 - ((d / 100 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)

noncomputable def qdCollarShiftMap (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def qdCollarUnshiftMap (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (p.1 + b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def qdWallPatchToQuad (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (d x₀ H : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  qdDiskInv d x₀ H (qdCollarUnshiftMap b_shift p)

def qdBridgeDisk (d : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (-((d / 200 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 125)

def qdLowerHalfDisk (d ε : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | ‖w‖ < (9 / 500 : ℝ) * d ∧ w.im < -ε / 8 }

def qdWallPatchBidisk (x₀ H ε : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
    ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < ε }

def qdWallPatchOverlap (x₀ H ε δ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
    |p.1.im - (H - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
    ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < δ }

def QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn (Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  IsOpen U ∧ IsOpen W ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ U ∧ Set.MapsTo Φ U W ∧
  ContinuousOn Φ_inv W ∧ (∀ p ∈ U, Φ_inv (Φ p) = p) ∧ (∀ q ∈ W, Φ (Φ_inv q) = q)

structure QdMero2DPullbackGluingToolkit : Prop where
  eq_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
      {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U
  eq_trans : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
      {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U
  eq_of_isPreconnected : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
    IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U
  glue_two : ∀ {U₁ U₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → U = U₁ ∪ U₂ →
    ∀ (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
      MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
      ∃ G : MeroOn2D U, MeroEqOn G G₁ U₁ ∧ MeroEqOn G G₂ U₂
  exists_pullback : ∀ {U W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ Φ_inv U W →
    ∀ F : MeroOn2D W, ∃ G : MeroOn2D U, MeroEqOnPullback G F Φ U
  pullback_id_self : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W),
    MeroEqOnPullback F F id W
  pullback_congr : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁}
      {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F : MeroOn2D W₃} {Φ Φ' : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ' V → (∀ q ∈ V, Φ' q = Φ q) →
    MeroEqOn G₂ G₁ V → MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F Φ U →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Φ' V
  pullback_comp : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U₁ U₂ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁}
      {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {G₃ : MeroOn2D W₃} {Φ₁ Φ₁_inv Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ₁ Φ₁_inv U₁ W₂ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₂ U₂ →
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U₁ → Set.MapsTo Φ₁ V U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₂ Φ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ G₃ Φ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₃ (Φ₂ ∘ Φ₁) V
  pullback_meroEqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ W₄ U₁ U₂ V O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₃} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₄}
      {Φ₁ Φ₁_inv Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ₁ Φ₁_inv V W₃ →
    (∀ q ∈ V, Φ₂ q = Φ₁ q) →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₁ Φ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F₂ Φ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ O → Set.MapsTo Φ₁ V O →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ V
  pullback_of_isPreconnected : ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {Φ Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
    IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W₁ →
    QdHasContTwoSidedInvOn Φ Φ_inv U W₂ →
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
    MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ Φ V → MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ Φ U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hTool : rl6_Holo2DRegularToolkit := by
    have heq2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
        p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ → Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ W →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p := by
      intro W f g p₀ r₀ hW_open hW_pre hf hg hp₀ hr₀ hball_sub heq_ball
      let h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => f p - g p
      have hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h W := hf.sub hg
      let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ W ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, h q = 0 }
      have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        rintro p ⟨r, hr, hr_sub, hzero⟩
        refine ⟨r, hr, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
        have hdist : dist p' p < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp'
        have hr' : 0 < r - dist p' p := sub_pos.mpr hdist
        have hsub' : Metric.ball p' (r - dist p' p) ⊆ Metric.ball p r :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
        exact ⟨r - dist p' p, hr', hsub'.trans hr_sub, fun q hq => hzero q (hsub' hq)⟩
      have hU₀_ne : (W ∩ U₀).Nonempty :=
        ⟨p₀, hp₀, r₀, hr₀, hball_sub, fun q hq => sub_eq_zero.mpr (heq_ball q hq)⟩
      have hU₀_cl : closure U₀ ∩ W ⊆ U₀ := by
        rintro p₁ ⟨hp₁_cl, hp₁_W⟩
        obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open p₁ hp₁_W
        let δ : ℝ := δ₂ / 2
        have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := half_pos hδ₂_pos
        have h2δ_sub : Metric.ball p₁ (2 * δ) ⊆ W := by
          have : 2 * δ = δ₂ := by ring
          rwa [this]
        obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂_U₀, hdist₁₂⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₁_cl δ hδ_pos
        obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, _, hzero₂⟩ := hp₂_U₀
        refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans h2δ_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
        let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (p₂.1 + z * (q.1 - p₂.1), p₂.2 + z * (q.2 - p₂.2))
        have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
          ((differentiable_const p₂.1).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _))).prodMk
            ((differentiable_const p₂.2).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
        have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₂ := by ext <;> simp [γ]
        have hγ1 : γ 1 = q := by ext <;> simp [γ]
        let D : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₁ (2 * δ)
        have hD_open : IsOpen D := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
        have h0_D : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D := by
          change γ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (2 * δ)
          rw [hγ0, Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
          linarith
        have h1_D : (1 : ℂ) ∈ D := by
          change γ 1 ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (2 * δ)
          rw [hγ1, Metric.mem_ball]
          have hq' : dist q p₁ < δ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
          linarith
        have hD_conv : Convex ℝ D := by
          intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ u v hu hv huv
          change γ (u • z₁ + v • z₂) ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (2 * δ)
          have huv_ℂ : (u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast huv
          have hγ_aff : γ (u • z₁ + v • z₂) = u • γ z₁ + v • γ z₂ := by
            ext <;> simp only [γ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
              Complex.real_smul]
            · calc p₂.1 + ((u : ℂ) * z₁ + (v : ℂ) * z₂) * (q.1 - p₂.1)
                  = ((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ)) * p₂.1 + ((u : ℂ) * z₁ + (v : ℂ) * z₂) * (q.1 - p₂.1) := by
                    rw [huv_ℂ, one_mul]
                _ = (u : ℂ) * (p₂.1 + z₁ * (q.1 - p₂.1)) + (v : ℂ) * (p₂.1 + z₂ * (q.1 - p₂.1)) := by
                    ring
            · calc p₂.2 + ((u : ℂ) * z₁ + (v : ℂ) * z₂) * (q.2 - p₂.2)
                  = ((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ)) * p₂.2 + ((u : ℂ) * z₁ + (v : ℂ) * z₂) * (q.2 - p₂.2) := by
                    rw [huv_ℂ, one_mul]
                _ = (u : ℂ) * (p₂.2 + z₁ * (q.2 - p₂.2)) + (v : ℂ) * (p₂.2 + z₂ * (q.2 - p₂.2)) := by
                    ring
          rw [hγ_aff]
          exact convex_ball p₁ (2 * δ) hz₁ hz₂ hu hv huv
        have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (h ∘ γ) D :=
          hh.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun z hz => h2δ_sub hz)
        have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (h ∘ γ) D := hg_diff.analyticOnNhd hD_open
        have hev : (h ∘ γ) =ᶠ[nhds 0] 0 := by
          have hnhds : γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₂ r₂ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
            apply hγ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
            rw [hγ0]
            exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₂ hr₂_pos
          filter_upwards [hnhds] with z hz
          exact hzero₂ (γ z) hz
        have h1_eq :=
          hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hD_conv.isPreconnected h0_D hev h1_D
        simpa [Function.comp_def, hγ1] using h1_eq
      have hW_sub : W ⊆ U₀ :=
        hW_pre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hU₀_open hU₀_ne hU₀_cl
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, _, hzero⟩ := hW_sub hp
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toFun := Prod.fst
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toFun := Prod.snd
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_fderiv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, HasFDerivAt Prod.fst π₁ p := fun p => π₁.hasFDerivAt
    have hπ₂_fderiv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, HasFDerivAt Prod.snd π₂ p := fun p => π₂.hasFDerivAt
    have hpartialY_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) W := by
      intro W f hW_open hf p₀ hp₀
      obtain ⟨R, hR_pos, hR_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open p₀ hp₀
      let r : ℝ := R / 3
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := by positivity
      have h2r_pos : 0 < 2 * r := by positivity
      let y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
      let t₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
      let K_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * r)
      have hK_sub : K_box ⊆ W := by
        intro q hq
        apply hR_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
        have h1 : dist q.1 y₀ ≤ 2 * r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1
        have h2 : dist q.2 t₀ ≤ 2 * r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2
        have hmax : max (dist q.1 y₀) (dist q.2 t₀) ≤ 2 * r := max_le h1 h2
        have hlt : 2 * r < R := by dsimp [r]; linarith
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hmax hlt
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K_box :=
        (isCompact_closedBall y₀ (2 * r)).prod (isCompact_closedBall t₀ (2 * r))

  have hcongr10 : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},

  have hTubePreconn : IsPreconnected T_mero := by

  have hmero_unique : ∀ {U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (i : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ},

      ContinuousOn f₁ U₁ → ContinuousOn f₂ U₂ →
      MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) f₁ U₁ → MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) f₂ U₂ →
      f₁ q = f₂ q := by
    intro U₁ U₂ f₁ f₂ i q hU₁ hU₂ hq₁ hq₂ hf₁ hf₂ hM₁ hM₂
    have hq_tube : q ∈ T_mero := hM₁.1 hq₁
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, _, heq₁⟩ := hM₁.2 q hq₁
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, _, heq₂⟩ := hM₂.2 q hq₂

    have hcont_sub : ContinuousAt (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) q :=
      (hf₁.continuousAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hq₁)).sub (hf₂.continuousAt (hU₂.mem_nhds hq₂))
    obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃_pos, hr₃_nz⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hcont_sub.eventually_ne hsub_ne)
    let r : ℝ := min r₃ (min r₁ r₂)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr₃_pos (lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos)
    have hr_le_r₃ : r ≤ r₃ := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_le_r₁ : r ≤ r₁ := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_le_r₂ : r ≤ r₂ := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr_le_rad : r ≤ (M.X_mero i).rad q := hr_le_r₁.trans hr₁_le
    have hden_zero_r : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q r, (M.X_mero i).den q z = 0 := by

      have hz₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball q r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₂ hz
      have hz₃ : z ∈ Metric.ball q r₃ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₃ hz
      have hdiff_mul : (f₁ z - f₂ z) * (M.X_mero i).den q z = 0 := by

      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q ((M.X_mero i).rad q)).isPreconnected
      ((M.X_mero i).den_holo q hq_tube) (differentiableOn_const 0)
      (Metric.mem_ball_self ((M.X_mero i).rad_pos q hq_tube)) hr_pos
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_rad) hden_zero_r
    obtain ⟨z_nz, hz_nz_mem, hz_nz⟩ := (M.X_mero i).den_ne_zero q hq_tube

  have hX_true_eq_of_agrees : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (i : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ},

  have hchart_nhd : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ} {r : ℝ} {X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      rl6_IsLocalRegularImpactChart M p r X_loc →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ r ∧
        Metric.ball p δ ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p δ, ∀ i : Fin 2, rl6_regularImpactMap M i q = X_loc i q := by
    intro p r X_loc ⟨hr_pos, hr_sub, hX_holo, hX_mero, hdot_nz, hdet_nz⟩
    have h0 := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball (hX_holo 0)
    have h1 := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball (hX_holo 1)
    have hdot_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_impactDotYY X_loc) (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (h0.1.pow 2).add (h1.1.pow 2)
    have hdet_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_impactDetYYY X_loc) (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (h0.1.mul h1.2.2).sub (h1.1.mul h0.2.2)
    have hp_mem : p ∈ Metric.ball p r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      ((hdot_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp_mem)).eventually_ne hdot_nz)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      ((hdet_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp_mem)).eventually_ne hdet_nz)
    let δ : ℝ := min r (min δ₁ δ₂)
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hr_pos (lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ₂_pos)
    have hδ_le_r : δ ≤ r := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ_le_1 : δ ≤ δ₁ := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hδ_le_2 : δ ≤ δ₂ := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hball_reg : Metric.ball p δ ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M := by
      intro q hq

      have hrq_pos : 0 < rq := sub_pos.mpr hdist
      have hrq_sub_δ : Metric.ball q rq ⊆ Metric.ball p δ := Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
      have hrq_sub_r : Metric.ball q rq ⊆ Metric.ball p r :=
        hrq_sub_δ.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_le_r)
      refine ⟨hr_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_le_r hq), rq, X_loc, hrq_pos,
        hrq_sub_r.trans hr_sub, fun i => (hX_holo i).mono hrq_sub_r, ?_,

      let rz' : ℝ := min rz (rq - dist z q)
      refine ⟨rz', lt_min hrz_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdist_zq), (min_le_left _ _).trans hrz_le,
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)),
        fun w hw => hrz_eq w (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw)⟩
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le_r, hball_reg, fun q hq i => ?_⟩
    exact hX_true_eq_of_agrees i Metric.isOpen_ball
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_le_r hq) (hball_reg hq)
      (hX_holo i).continuousOn (hX_mero i)

  have hStripSub : horizStrip M.s_base ⊆ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
    intro s hs

  have hΓ_holo_base : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => K.Γ z i) (horizStrip M.s_base) := by
    intro i s hs
    have hreg := K.Γ_reg_holo s (hStripSub hs) (K.f_base_ne_zero s hs)
    fin_cases i
    · exact hreg.1.differentiableWithinAt
    · exact hreg.2.differentiableWithinAt
  have hΓ_wronskian : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base,
      (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0) s) ^ 2 + (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1) s) ^ 2 =
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 4 ∧
      deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0) s * deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1)) s -
        deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1) s * deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0)) s =
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 3 := by
    intro s hs
    have hsD : s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := hStripSub hs
    have hfs : K.f s ≠ 0 := K.f_base_ne_zero s hs
    have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ K.ϕ s :=
      (K.ϕ_holo.mono hStripSub).differentiableAt (hStripOpen.mem_nhds hs)
    have hϕ_hd : HasDerivAt K.ϕ (K.f s) s := by
      rw [← K.deriv_ϕ s hsD]
      exact hϕ_diff.hasDerivAt
    have hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ K.f s :=
      (K.f_holo.mono hStripSub).differentiableAt (hStripOpen.mem_nhds hs)
    have hfinv2_hd : HasDerivAt (fun z => (K.f z)⁻¹ ^ 2)
        ((2 : ℕ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ (2 - 1) * (-deriv K.f s / (K.f s) ^ 2)) s :=
      (hf_diff.hasDerivAt.inv hfs).pow 2
    have hsin_hd : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.sin (K.ϕ z))
        (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (K.ϕ s)).comp s hϕ_hd
    have hcos_hd : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.cos (K.ϕ z))
        (-Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (K.ϕ s)).comp s hϕ_hd
    have hd0_ev : deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0) =ᶠ[nhds s]
        fun z => -(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f z)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ z) := by
      filter_upwards [hStripOpen.mem_nhds hs] with z hz
      exact K.Γ_deriv₀ z (hStripSub hz) (K.f_base_ne_zero z hz)
    have hd1_ev : deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1) =ᶠ[nhds s]
        fun z => (C.c : ℂ) * (K.f z)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ z) := by
      filter_upwards [hStripOpen.mem_nhds hs] with z hz
      exact K.Γ_deriv₁ z (hStripSub hz) (K.f_base_ne_zero z hz)
    have hd2_0 : deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0)) s =
        -(C.c : ℂ) * ((2 : ℕ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ (2 - 1) * (-deriv K.f s / (K.f s) ^ 2)) *
          Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) +
        -(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) :=
      (((hfinv2_hd.const_mul (-(C.c : ℂ))).mul hsin_hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq hd0_ev).deriv
    have hd2_1 : deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1)) s =
        (C.c : ℂ) * ((2 : ℕ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ (2 - 1) * (-deriv K.f s / (K.f s) ^ 2)) *
          Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) +
        (C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (-Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) * K.f s) :=
      (((hfinv2_hd.const_mul (C.c : ℂ)).mul hcos_hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq hd1_ev).deriv
    have hd1_0 := K.Γ_deriv₀ s hsD hfs
    have hd1_1 := K.Γ_deriv₁ s hsD hfs
    have htrig := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (K.ϕ s)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hd1_0, hd1_1]
      calc (-(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)) ^ 2 +
            ((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) ^ 2
          = (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 4 * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) ^ 2 + Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) ^ 2) := by
            ring
        _ = (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 4 := by rw [htrig, mul_one]
    · rw [hd1_0, hd1_1, hd2_0, hd2_1]
      push_cast
      have halg :
          (-(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)) *
            ((C.c : ℂ) * (2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 1 * (-deriv K.f s / (K.f s) ^ 2)) * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) +
              (C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (-Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) * K.f s)) -
          ((C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) *
            (-(C.c : ℂ) * (2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 1 * (-deriv K.f s / (K.f s) ^ 2)) * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) +
              -(C.c : ℂ) * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) * K.f s)) =
          (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f s)⁻¹ ^ 3 * ((K.f s)⁻¹ * K.f s) *
            (Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) ^ 2 + Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) ^ 2) := by
        ring
      rw [halg, inv_mul_cancel₀ hfs, htrig, mul_one, mul_one]

  let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init }

  have hB_init_sub_T : B_init ⊆ T_mero := hB_init_sub_base.trans hBaseSub
  let X_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i q => K.Γ (K.𝔰_init q) i
  have hX_init_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_init i) B_init := by
    intro i
    exact (hΓ_holo_base i).comp K.𝔰_init_holo (fun q hq => K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2)
  have hX_init_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (X_init i) B_init := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨hB_init_sub_T, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hB_init_open p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, _, hr₂_eq⟩ := (M.X_agrees i).2 p (hB_init_sub_base hp)
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos, (min_le_right _ _).trans hr₂_le,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hr₁_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq_init : q ∈ B_init := hr₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
    have hq_r₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
    have himp := congr_fun (K.𝔰_init_impact q.1 q.2 hq_init.1 hq_init.2) i
    rw [hr₂_eq q hq_r₂]
    dsimp only [X_init]
    rw [himp]
  have h𝔰_holo_parts := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo hB_init_open K.𝔰_init_holo
  have hX_init_inv : ∀ q ∈ B_init,
      rl6_impactDotYY X_init q =
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f (K.𝔰_init q))⁻¹ ^ 4 * (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 2 ∧
      rl6_impactDotTY X_init q =
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f (K.𝔰_init q))⁻¹ ^ 4 *
          iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q ∧
      rl6_impactDetYYY X_init q =
        (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (K.f (K.𝔰_init q))⁻¹ ^ 3 * (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 3 := by
    intro q hq
    have h10 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ B_init,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_init i) p =
          deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init p) * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init p := by
      intro i p hp
      have hp_s : K.𝔰_init p ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2
      have hΓ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init p) :=
        (hΓ_holo_base i).differentiableAt (hStripOpen.mem_nhds hp_s)
      have h𝔰_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', p.2)) p.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', p.2)) {y' : ℂ | (y', p.2) ∈ B_init} :=

      exact ((hΓ_at.hasDerivAt.comp p.1 h𝔰_y_at.hasDerivAt).deriv)
    have h01 : ∀ i : Fin 2,

      intro i
      have hq_s : K.𝔰_init q ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2
      have hΓ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init q) :=
        (hΓ_holo_base i).differentiableAt (hStripOpen.mem_nhds hq_s)
      have h𝔰_t_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (q.1, t')) q.2 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (q.1, t')) {t' : ℂ | (q.1, t') ∈ B_init} :=
          K.𝔰_init_holo.comp ((differentiable_const q.1).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun _ ht => ht)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt

      exact ((hΓ_at.hasDerivAt.comp q.2 h𝔰_t_at.hasDerivAt).deriv)
    have h20 : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        iterDerivYT 2 0 (X_init i) q =
          deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i)) (K.𝔰_init q) * (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 2 +
            deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init q) * iterDerivYT 2 0 K.𝔰_init q := by
      intro i
      have hq_s : K.𝔰_init q ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2

      have h𝔰_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', q.2)) {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ B_init} :=

        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq)
      have hsy_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init (y', q.2))
            {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ B_init} :=
          h𝔰_holo_parts.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq)
      have hcongr_eq := hcongr10 hB_init_open (h10 i) q hq
      change iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_init i)) q = _
      rw [hcongr_eq]
      have hprod := (hdΓ_at.hasDerivAt.comp q.1 h𝔰_y_at.hasDerivAt).mul hsy_y_at.hasDerivAt
      have hd_eq : iterDerivYT 1 0
          (fun p => deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init p) * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init p) q =
          (deriv (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i)) (K.𝔰_init q) * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) *
            iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q +
          deriv (fun z => K.Γ z i) (K.𝔰_init q) * iterDerivYT 2 0 K.𝔰_init q :=
        hprod.deriv
      rw [hd_eq]
      ring
    have hq_s : K.𝔰_init q ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2
    obtain ⟨hw_dot, hw_det⟩ := hΓ_wronskian (K.𝔰_init q) hq_s
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [rl6_impactDotYY, h10 0 q hq, h10 1 q hq]
      calc (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 0) (K.𝔰_init q) * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 2 +
            (deriv (fun z => K.Γ z 1) (K.𝔰_init q) * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 2

            rw [hw_dot]
    · simp only [rl6_impactDotTY, h10 0 q hq, h10 1 q hq, h01 0, h01 1]
