  have h00_init : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_init := by
    simp [B_init, K.s_init_pos, K.r_init_pos]
  have hsy_00 : iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = 1 := by
    have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', (0 : ℂ))) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] fun y' : ℂ => y' := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
        continuous_const).mem_nhds (by simp [K.s_init_pos] : |(0 : ℂ).im| < K.s_init)] with y' hy'
      exact K.𝔰_init_zero y' hy'
    change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => K.𝔰_init (y', (0 : ℂ))) 0 = 1
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_id'']
  obtain ⟨r_b0, hr_b0_pos, hr_b0_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hB_init_open ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) h00_init
  obtain ⟨r_sy, hr_sy_pos, hr_sy_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    ((h𝔰_holo_parts.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hB_init_open.mem_nhds h00_init)).eventually_ne
      (by rw [hsy_00]; exact one_ne_zero))
  let r_origin : ℝ := min r_b0 r_sy
  have hr_origin_pos : 0 < r_origin := lt_min hr_b0_pos hr_sy_pos
  let B₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) r_origin
  have hB₀_sub_init : B₀ ⊆ B_init :=
    (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hr_b0_sub
  have hB₀_sy_nz : ∀ q ∈ B₀, iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q ≠ 0 :=
    fun q hq => hr_sy_nz q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
  have hc_ne_zero : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr C.c_pos.ne'
  have hB₀_sub_reg : B₀ ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_init : q ∈ B_init := hB₀_sub_init hq
    have hdist : dist q ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) < r_origin := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
    let rq : ℝ := r_origin - dist q ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
    have hrq_pos : 0 < rq := sub_pos.mpr hdist
    have hrq_sub_B₀ : Metric.ball q rq ⊆ B₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
    have hrq_sub_init : Metric.ball q rq ⊆ B_init := hrq_sub_B₀.trans hB₀_sub_init
    have hq_s : K.𝔰_init q ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq_init.1 hq_init.2
    have hfq : K.f (K.𝔰_init q) ≠ 0 := K.f_base_ne_zero _ hq_s
    have hsy_q : iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q ≠ 0 := hB₀_sy_nz q hq
    obtain ⟨hdot_q, _, hdet_q⟩ := hX_init_inv q hq_init
    refine ⟨hB_init_sub_T hq_init, rq, X_init, hrq_pos, hrq_sub_init.trans hB_init_sub_T,
      fun i => (hX_init_holo i).mono hrq_sub_init, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      refine ⟨hrq_sub_init.trans hB_init_sub_T, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨rz, hrz_pos, hrz_le, _, hrz_eq⟩ := (hX_init_mero i).2 z (hrq_sub_init hz)
      have hdist_zq : dist z q < rq := Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
      let rz' : ℝ := min rz (rq - dist z q)
      refine ⟨rz', lt_min hrz_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdist_zq), (min_le_left _ _).trans hrz_le,
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)),
        fun w hw => hrz_eq w (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw)⟩
    · rw [hdot_q]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_ne_zero)
        (pow_ne_zero 4 (inv_ne_zero hfq))) (pow_ne_zero 2 hsy_q)
    · rw [hdet_q]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_ne_zero)
        (pow_ne_zero 3 (inv_ne_zero hfq))) (pow_ne_zero 3 hsy_q)
  have hOriginSub : B₀ ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M ∩ B_init :=
    fun q hq => ⟨hB₀_sub_reg hq, hB₀_sub_init hq⟩
  have hOriginEq : ∀ q ∈ B₀, ∀ i : Fin 2, rl6_regularImpactMap M i q = K.Γ (K.𝔰_init q) i := by
    intro q hq i
    exact hX_true_eq_of_agrees i hB_init_open (hB₀_sub_init hq) (hB₀_sub_reg hq)
      (hX_init_holo i).continuousOn (hX_init_mero i)
  have hB₀_G6_R_eq : ∀ q ∈ B₀,
      rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M q = (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 6 ∧
      rl6_sixthRootRatioR M q = iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q / iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_init : q ∈ B_init := hB₀_sub_init hq
    have hcongr := hcongr_inv Metric.isOpen_ball (fun i z hz => hOriginEq z hz i) q hq
    obtain ⟨hdot_q, hty_q, hdet_q⟩ := hX_init_inv q hq_init
    have hfq : K.f (K.𝔰_init q) ≠ 0 :=
      K.f_base_ne_zero _ (K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 hq_init.1 hq_init.2)
    have hsy_q : iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q ≠ 0 := hB₀_sy_nz q hq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6]
      rw [hcongr.2.2, hcongr.1, hdet_q, hdot_q]
      field_simp [hc_ne_zero, hfq, hsy_q]
    · dsimp only [rl6_sixthRootRatioR]
      rw [hcongr.2.1, hcongr.1, hty_q, hdot_q]
      field_simp [hc_ne_zero, hfq, hsy_q]
  have hInitOde : ∀ q ∈ B₀,
      (iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q) ^ 6 = rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M q ∧
      iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q = rl6_sixthRootRatioR M q * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hG6, hR⟩ := hB₀_G6_R_eq q hq
    refine ⟨hG6.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [hR, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hB₀_sy_nz q hq)]
  have hCompatOrigin : ∀ q ∈ B₀,
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) q -
        rl6_sixthRootRatioR M q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) q -
        6 * rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthRootRatioR M) q = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_init : q ∈ B_init := hB₀_sub_init hq
    let sy : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init
    let st : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init
    have hsy_q : sy q ≠ 0 := hB₀_sy_nz q hq
    have hdG6_t : iterDerivYT 0 1 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) q =
        6 * (sy q) ^ 5 * iterDerivYT 0 1 sy q := by
      rw [hcongr01 Metric.isOpen_ball (fun z hz => (hB₀_G6_R_eq z hz).1) q hq]
      have hsy_t_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t' : ℂ => sy (q.1, t')) q.2 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t' : ℂ => sy (q.1, t')) {t' : ℂ | (q.1, t') ∈ B_init} :=
          h𝔰_holo_parts.1.comp ((differentiable_const q.1).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun _ ht => ht)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hq_init)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t' : ℂ => (sy (q.1, t')) ^ 6)
          ((6 : ℕ) * (sy q) ^ (6 - 1) * iterDerivYT 0 1 sy q) q.2 :=
        hsy_t_at.hasDerivAt.pow 6
      change deriv (fun t' : ℂ => (sy (q.1, t')) ^ 6) q.2 = _
      rw [hd.deriv]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hdG6_y : iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) q =
        6 * (sy q) ^ 5 * iterDerivYT 1 0 sy q := by
      rw [hcongr10 Metric.isOpen_ball (fun z hz => (hB₀_G6_R_eq z hz).1) q hq]
      have hsy_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => sy (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => sy (y', q.2)) {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ B_init} :=
          h𝔰_holo_parts.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq_init)
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℂ => (sy (y', q.2)) ^ 6)
          ((6 : ℕ) * (sy q) ^ (6 - 1) * iterDerivYT 1 0 sy q) q.1 :=
        hsy_y_at.hasDerivAt.pow 6
      change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => (sy (y', q.2)) ^ 6) q.1 = _
      rw [hd.deriv]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hdR_y : iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthRootRatioR M) q =
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 st q * sy q - st q * iterDerivYT 1 0 sy q) / (sy q) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hcongr10 Metric.isOpen_ball (fun z hz => (hB₀_G6_R_eq z hz).2) q hq]
      have hsy_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => sy (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => sy (y', q.2)) {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ B_init} :=
          h𝔰_holo_parts.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq_init)
      have hst_y_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => st (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => st (y', q.2)) {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ B_init} :=
          h𝔰_holo_parts.2.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((hB_init_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq_init)
      exact (hst_y_at.hasDerivAt.div hsy_y_at.hasDerivAt hsy_q).deriv
    have hcomm_q : iterDerivYT 0 1 sy q = iterDerivYT 1 0 st q :=
      hTool.iterDerivYT_comm hB_init_open K.𝔰_init_holo q hq_init
    obtain ⟨hG6_q, hR_q⟩ := hB₀_G6_R_eq q hq
    rw [hdG6_t, hdG6_y, hdR_y, hG6_q, hR_q, hcomm_q]
    dsimp only [sy, st] at hsy_q ⊢
    field_simp [hsy_q]
    ring

  have hdiv_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → (∀ z ∈ U, g z ≠ 0) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z / g z) U := by
    intro U f g hf hg hgnz
    have hinv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (g z)⁻¹) U :=
      fun z hz => (differentiableAt_inv (hgnz z hz)).comp_differentiableWithinAt z (hg z hz)
    have hmul : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f z * (g z)⁻¹) U := hf.mul hinv
    have heq_fn : (fun z => f z / g z) = (fun z => f z * (g z)⁻¹) := by
      ext z
      exact div_eq_mul_inv (f z) (g z)
    rwa [heq_fn]

  
  let r₀_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p₀ => min ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀)
  have hr₀_pos : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, 0 < r₀_fn p₀ :=
    fun p₀ hp₀ => lt_min ((M.X_mero 0).rad_pos p₀ hp₀) ((M.X_mero 1).rad_pos p₀ hp₀)
  have hr₀_sub : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ T_mero :=
    fun p₀ hp₀ => (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans ((M.X_mero 0).ball_sub p₀ hp₀)

  let A_num : ℂ × ℂ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p₀ i z =>
    iterDerivYT 1 0 ((M.X_mero i).num p₀) z * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z -
      (M.X_mero i).num p₀ z * iterDerivYT 1 0 ((M.X_mero i).den p₀) z
  let C_num : ℂ × ℂ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p₀ i z =>
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (A_num p₀ i) z * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z -
      2 * A_num p₀ i z * iterDerivYT 1 0 ((M.X_mero i).den p₀) z
  let B_chart_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p₀ z =>
    let D₀ := (M.X_mero 0).den p₀ z
    let D₁ := (M.X_mero 1).den p₀ z
    let A₀ := A_num p₀ 0 z
    let A₁ := A_num p₀ 1 z
    let C₀ := C_num p₀ 0 z
    let C₁ := C_num p₀ 1 z
    D₀ * D₁ * (A₀ ^ 2 * D₁ ^ 4 + A₁ ^ 2 * D₀ ^ 4) * (A₀ * C₁ * D₀ - A₁ * C₀ * D₁)

  have hB_chart_holo : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (B_chart_fn p₀) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    have hsub0 : Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsub1 : Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    have hN0 := ((M.X_mero 0).num_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub0
    have hD0 := ((M.X_mero 0).den_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub0
    have hN1 := ((M.X_mero 1).num_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub1
    have hD1 := ((M.X_mero 1).den_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub1
    have hA0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_num p₀ 0) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) :=
      ((hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hN0).1.mul hD0).sub
        (hN0.mul (hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hD0).1)
    have hA1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_num p₀ 1) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) :=
      ((hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hN1).1.mul hD1).sub
        (hN1.mul (hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hD1).1)
    have hC0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_num p₀ 0) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) :=
      ((hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hA0).1.mul hD0).sub
        (((differentiableOn_const 2).mul hA0).mul (hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hD0).1)
    have hC1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_num p₀ 1) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) :=
      ((hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hA1).1.mul hD1).sub
        (((differentiableOn_const 2).mul hA1).mul (hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hD1).1)
    exact (((hD0.mul hD1).mul (((hA0.pow 2).mul (hD1.pow 4)).add ((hA1.pow 2).mul (hD0.pow 4)))).mul
      (((hA0.mul hC1).mul hD0).sub ((hA1.mul hC0).mul hD1)))

  have hB_chart_off_den : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀),
      (M.X_mero 0).den p₀ q ≠ 0 → (M.X_mero 1).den p₀ q ≠ 0 →
      let Q_fn : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i z => (M.X_mero i).num p₀ z / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z
      ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ Metric.ball q η ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Q_fn i) (Metric.ball q η)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (Q_fn i) (Metric.ball q η)) ∧
        B_chart_fn p₀ q =
          ((M.X_mero 0).den p₀ q) ^ 8 * ((M.X_mero 1).den p₀ q) ^ 8 *
            rl6_impactDotYY Q_fn q * rl6_impactDetYYY Q_fn q := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ q hq hD0_q hD1_q Q_fn
    have hsub0 : Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsub1 : Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    have hN_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ ((M.X_mero i).num p₀) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) := by
      intro i; fin_cases i
      · exact ((M.X_mero 0).num_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub0
      · exact ((M.X_mero 1).num_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub1
    have hD_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ ((M.X_mero i).den p₀) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) := by
      intro i; fin_cases i
      · exact ((M.X_mero 0).den_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub0
      · exact ((M.X_mero 1).den_holo p₀ hp₀).mono hsub1
    obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀_pos, hη₀_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (((hD_holo 0).continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq)).eventually_ne hD0_q)
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (((hD_holo 1).continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq)).eventually_ne hD1_q)
    have hdist_qp0 : dist q p₀ < r₀_fn p₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
    let η : ℝ := min (r₀_fn p₀ - dist q p₀) (min η₀ η₁)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hdist_qp0) (lt_min hη₀_pos hη₁_pos)
    have hη_sub : Metric.ball q η ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))
    have hD_nz_η : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q η, (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z ≠ 0 := by
      intro i z hz
      fin_cases i
      · exact hη₀_nz z (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) hz)
      · exact hη₁_nz z (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)) hz)
    have hQ_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Q_fn i) (Metric.ball q η) :=
      fun i => hdiv_holo ((hN_holo i).mono hη_sub) ((hD_holo i).mono hη_sub) (hD_nz_η i)
    have hQ_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (Q_fn i) (Metric.ball q η) := by
      intro i
      refine ⟨hη_sub.trans (hr₀_sub p₀ hp₀), fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'_T : p' ∈ T_mero := hr₀_sub p₀ hp₀ (hη_sub hp')
      have hdist_p'q : dist p' q < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp'
      let r' : ℝ := min ((M.X_mero i).rad p') (η - dist p' q)
      have hr'_pos : 0 < r' := lt_min ((M.X_mero i).rad_pos p' hp'_T) (sub_pos.mpr hdist_p'q)
      have hr'_sub_η : Metric.ball p' r' ⊆ Metric.ball q η :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))
      refine ⟨r', hr'_pos, min_le_left _ _, hr'_sub_η, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have hz_p' : z ∈ Metric.ball p' ((M.X_mero i).rad p') :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
      have hz_p0 : z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero i).rad p₀) := by
        have hz_r0 : z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) := hη_sub (hr'_sub_η hz)
        fin_cases i
        · exact hsub0 hz_r0
        · exact hsub1 hz_r0
      have hcompat := (M.X_mero i).compat p' hp'_T p₀ hp₀ z ⟨hz_p', hz_p0⟩
      have hDz : (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z ≠ 0 := hD_nz_η i z (hr'_sub_η hz)
      dsimp only [Q_fn]
      calc (M.X_mero i).num p' z
          = ((M.X_mero i).num p' z * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z) / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z := by
            rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hDz]
        _ = ((M.X_mero i).num p₀ z * (M.X_mero i).den p' z) / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z := by
            rw [hcompat]
        _ = ((M.X_mero i).num p₀ z / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z) * (M.X_mero i).den p' z := by
            ring
    have hQ_d1 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q η,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (Q_fn i) z = A_num p₀ i z / ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ z) ^ 2 := by
      intro i z hz
      have hz_r0 : z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) := hη_sub hz
      have hN_y : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).num p₀ (y', z.2)) z.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).num p₀ (y', z.2))
            {y' : ℂ | (y', z.2) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)} :=
          (hN_holo i).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const z.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz_r0)
      have hD_y : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', z.2)) z.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', z.2))
            {y' : ℂ | (y', z.2) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)} :=
          (hD_holo i).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const z.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hz_r0)
      exact (hN_y.hasDerivAt.div hD_y.hasDerivAt (hD_nz_η i z hz)).deriv
    have hQ_d2 : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        iterDerivYT 2 0 (Q_fn i) q = C_num p₀ i q / ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ q) ^ 3 := by
      intro i
      have hq_η : q ∈ Metric.ball q η := Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos
      change iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 1 0 (Q_fn i)) q = _
      rw [hcongr10 Metric.isOpen_ball (hQ_d1 i) q hq_η]
      have hA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_num p₀ i) (Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)) :=
        ((hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball (hN_holo i)).1.mul (hD_holo i)).sub
          ((hN_holo i).mul (hTool.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball (hD_holo i)).1)
      have hA_y : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => A_num p₀ i (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => A_num p₀ i (y', q.2))
            {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)} :=
          hA_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq)
      have hD_y : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', q.2)) q.1 := by
        have hcomp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', q.2))
            {y' : ℂ | (y', q.2) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)} :=
          (hD_holo i).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hy => hy)
        exact hcomp.differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq)
      have hDz : (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 := hD_nz_η i q hq_η
      have hd_div : HasDerivAt
          (fun y' : ℂ => A_num p₀ i (y', q.2) / ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', q.2)) ^ 2)
          ((iterDerivYT 1 0 (A_num p₀ i) q * ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ q) ^ 2 -
              A_num p₀ i q *
                ((2 : ℕ) * ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ q) ^ (2 - 1) *
                  iterDerivYT 1 0 ((M.X_mero i).den p₀) q)) /
            (((M.X_mero i).den p₀ q) ^ 2) ^ 2)
          q.1 :=
        hA_y.hasDerivAt.div (hD_y.hasDerivAt.pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hDz)
      change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => A_num p₀ i (y', q.2) / ((M.X_mero i).den p₀ (y', q.2)) ^ 2) q.1 = _
      rw [hd_div.deriv]
      dsimp only [C_num]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hDz]
    refine ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_sub, hQ_holo, hQ_mero, ?_⟩
    have hq_η : q ∈ Metric.ball q η := Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos
    simp only [B_chart_fn, rl6_impactDotYY, rl6_impactDetYYY,
      hQ_d1 0 q hq_η, hQ_d1 1 q hq_η, hQ_d2 0, hQ_d2 1]
    field_simp [hD0_q, hD1_q]

  have hB_chart_fwd : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀),
      B_chart_fn p₀ q ≠ 0 →
      q ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 ∧
        (M.X_mero i).num p₀ q = rl6_regularImpactMap M i q * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ q hq hB_nz
    have hD0_q : (M.X_mero 0).den p₀ q ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hB_nz; simp [B_chart_fn, h0]
    have hD1_q : (M.X_mero 1).den p₀ q ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hB_nz; simp [B_chart_fn, h0]
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_sub, hQ_holo, hQ_mero, hB_eq⟩ :=
      hB_chart_off_den p₀ hp₀ q hq hD0_q hD1_q
    rw [hB_eq] at hB_nz
    have hdet_nz : rl6_impactDetYYY
        (fun i z => (M.X_mero i).num p₀ z / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z) q ≠ 0 :=
      right_ne_zero_of_mul hB_nz
    have hdot_nz : rl6_impactDotYY
        (fun i z => (M.X_mero i).num p₀ z / (M.X_mero i).den p₀ z) q ≠ 0 :=
      right_ne_zero_of_mul (left_ne_zero_of_mul hB_nz)
    have hq_reg : q ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M :=
      ⟨hr₀_sub p₀ hp₀ hq, η, _, hη_pos, hη_sub.trans (hr₀_sub p₀ hp₀), hQ_holo, hQ_mero,
        hdot_nz, hdet_nz⟩
    refine ⟨hq_reg, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hDi_q : (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 := by fin_cases i <;> assumption
    refine ⟨hDi_q, ?_⟩
    have hX_eq := hX_true_eq_of_agrees i Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)
      hq_reg (hQ_holo i).continuousOn (hQ_mero i)
    rw [hX_eq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hDi_q]

  have hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, p₀ ∈ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) →
      ∀ c₀ : ℂ × ℂ, ∀ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ → Metric.ball c₀ ρ₀ ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) →
      ∃ z ∈ Metric.ball c₀ ρ₀, B_chart_fn p₀ z ≠ 0 := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ hp₀_cl c₀ ρ₀ hρ₀_pos hρ₀_sub
    obtain ⟨q_star, hq_star_reg, hdist_q_p0⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₀_cl (r₀_fn p₀) (hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀)
    have hq_star_ball : q_star ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hdist_q_p0
    obtain ⟨ε_star, hε_star_pos, hε_star_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hRegOpen) q_star ⟨hq_star_ball, hq_star_reg⟩
    have hD0_not_all_zero : ∃ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball q_star ε_star, (M.X_mero 0).den p₀ z₁ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall0
      push_neg at hall0
      have hsub_rad0 : Metric.ball q_star ε_star ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) :=
        Set.Subset.trans (fun _ hz => (hε_star_sub hz).1) (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      have hall := hTool.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        ((M.X_mero 0).den_holo p₀ hp₀) (differentiableOn_const 0)
        (hsub_rad0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hε_star_pos)) hε_star_pos hsub_rad0 hall0
      obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_nz⟩ := (M.X_mero 0).den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀
      exact hw_nz (hall w hw_mem)
    obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁_mem, hz₁_D0⟩ := hD0_not_all_zero
    have hz₁_rad0 : z₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hε_star_sub hz₁_mem).1
    obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁_pos, hε₁_D0⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      ((((M.X_mero 0).den_holo p₀ hp₀).continuousOn.continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz₁_rad0)).eventually_ne hz₁_D0)
    let ε₁' : ℝ := min ε₁ (ε_star - dist z₁ q_star)
    have hε₁'_pos : 0 < ε₁' := lt_min hε₁_pos (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz₁_mem))
    have hε₁'_sub_star : Metric.ball z₁ ε₁' ⊆ Metric.ball q_star ε_star :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))
    have hD1_not_all_zero : ∃ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball z₁ ε₁', (M.X_mero 1).den p₀ z₂ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall1
      push_neg at hall1
      have hsub_rad1 : Metric.ball z₁ ε₁' ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) :=
        hε₁'_sub_star.trans
          (Set.Subset.trans (fun _ hz => (hε_star_sub hz).1) (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
      have hall := hTool.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p₀ ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        ((M.X_mero 1).den_holo p₀ hp₀) (differentiableOn_const 0)
        (hsub_rad1 (Metric.mem_ball_self hε₁'_pos)) hε₁'_pos hsub_rad1 hall1
      obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_nz⟩ := (M.X_mero 1).den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀
      exact hw_nz (hall w hw_mem)
    obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂_mem, hz₂_D1⟩ := hD1_not_all_zero
    have hz₂_D0 : (M.X_mero 0).den p₀ z₂ ≠ 0 :=
      hε₁_D0 z₂ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz₂_mem)
    have hz₂_both : z₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ∧ z₂ ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M :=
      hε_star_sub (hε₁'_sub_star hz₂_mem)
    have hB_z₂_nz : B_chart_fn p₀ z₂ ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, _, hQ_holo, hQ_mero, hB_eq⟩ :=
        hB_chart_off_den p₀ hp₀ z₂ hz₂_both.1 hz₂_D0 hz₂_D1
      rw [hB_eq]
      let V_z₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₂ η ∩ rl6_regularLocusSet M
      have hVz₂_open : IsOpen V_z₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hRegOpen
      have hz₂_V : z₂ ∈ V_z₂ := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos, hz₂_both.2⟩
      have hcongr_z₂ := hcongr_inv hVz₂_open
        (fun i w hw =>
          (hX_true_eq_of_agrees i Metric.isOpen_ball hw.1 hw.2
            (hQ_holo i).continuousOn (hQ_mero i)).symm)
        z₂ hz₂_V
      rw [hcongr_z₂.1, hcongr_z₂.2.2]
      obtain ⟨hdot_nz, hdet_nz⟩ := hInvNeZero z₂ hz₂_both.2
      exact mul_ne_zero
        (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 8 hz₂_D0) (pow_ne_zero 8 hz₂_D1)) hdot_nz)
        hdet_nz
    by_contra hall_c0
    push_neg at hall_c0
    have hall := hTool.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)).isPreconnected
      (hB_chart_holo p₀ hp₀) (differentiableOn_const 0)
      (hρ₀_sub (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ₀_pos)) hρ₀_pos hρ₀_sub hall_c0
    exact hB_z₂_nz (hall z₂ hz₂_both.1)

  have hball_sub_cl_reg : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, p₀ ∈ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) →
      Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ⊆ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ hp₀_cl q hq
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
    intro ε hε_pos
    have hdist : dist q p₀ < r₀_fn p₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
    let ρ' : ℝ := min ε (r₀_fn p₀ - dist q p₀)
    have hρ'_pos : 0 < ρ' := lt_min hε_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdist)
    have hρ'_sub : Metric.ball q ρ' ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨z, hz_mem, hz_B⟩ := hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl p₀ hp₀ hp₀_cl q ρ' hρ'_pos hρ'_sub
    refine ⟨z, (hB_chart_fwd p₀ hp₀ z (hρ'_sub hz_mem) hz_B).1, ?_⟩
    rw [dist_comm]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz_mem) (min_le_left _ _)

  have hT_sub_cl_reg : T_mero ⊆ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) := by
    let W_open : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      ⋃ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (_ : p₀ ∈ T_mero ∧ p₀ ∈ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M)),
        Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)
    have hW_open : IsOpen W_open := isOpen_biUnion fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h00_reg : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M :=
      hB₀_sub_reg (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_origin_pos)
    have h00_T : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ T_mero := hRegSub h00_reg
    have hW_ne : (T_mero ∩ W_open).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), h00_T, Set.mem_biUnion ⟨h00_T, subset_closure h00_reg⟩ ?_⟩
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self (hr₀_pos _ h00_T)
    have hW_sub_cl : W_open ⊆ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀_mem⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨⟨hp₀_T, hp₀_cl⟩, hz_ball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp₀_mem
      exact hball_sub_cl_reg p₀ hp₀_T hp₀_cl hz_ball
    have hclW_sub : closure W_open ⊆ closure (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
      closure_minimal hW_sub_cl isClosed_closure
    have hW_cl_inter : closure W_open ∩ T_mero ⊆ W_open := by
      rintro p₀ ⟨hp₀_clW, hp₀_T⟩
      exact Set.mem_biUnion ⟨hp₀_T, hclW_sub hp₀_clW⟩ (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀_T))
    exact (hTubePreconn.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hW_open hW_ne hW_cl_inter).trans hW_sub_cl

  have hChartNonvanishing : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero,
      ∃ (r₀ : ℝ) (B_chart : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r₀ ∧
        r₀ ≤ min ((M.X_mero 0).rad p₀) ((M.X_mero 1).rad p₀) ∧
        Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ T_mero ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ B_chart (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) ∧
        (∃ q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀ / 2), B_chart q₁ ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, B_chart q ≠ 0 →
          q ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q ≠ 0 ∧
            (M.X_mero i).num p₀ q = rl6_regularImpactMap M i q * (M.X_mero i).den p₀ q := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    have hr_pos : 0 < r₀_fn p₀ := hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hq₁_nz⟩ := hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl p₀ hp₀ (hT_sub_cl_reg hp₀)
      p₀ (r₀_fn p₀ / 2) (half_pos hr_pos) (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
    exact ⟨r₀_fn p₀, B_chart_fn p₀, hr_pos, le_rfl, hr₀_sub p₀ hp₀, hB_chart_holo p₀ hp₀,
      ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hq₁_nz⟩, hB_chart_fwd p₀ hp₀⟩

  
  let Reachable : ℂ × ℂ → Prop := fun p =>
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ρ : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ),
      c 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∧
      ρ 0 = r_origin ∧
      p ∈ Metric.ball (c (Fin.last N)) (ρ (Fin.last N)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ k ∧ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin N,
        (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩
          Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty)
  let U_reach : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M | Reachable p }

  have hreach_origin : ∀ p ∈ B₀, Reachable p := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨0, fun _ => ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), fun _ => r_origin, rfl, rfl, hp,
      fun _ => ⟨hr_origin_pos, hB₀_sub_reg⟩, fun k => Fin.elim0 k⟩

  have hreach_step_ball : ∀ {q p p_star : ℂ × ℂ} {r_star : ℝ},
      Reachable q → 0 < r_star → Metric.ball p_star r_star ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M →
      q ∈ Metric.ball p_star r_star → p ∈ Metric.ball p_star r_star → Reachable p := by
    intro q p p_star r_star ⟨N, c, ρ, hc0, hρ0, hq_last, hballs, hov⟩
      hr_star hsub_star hq_star hp_star
    refine ⟨N + 1, Fin.snoc c p_star, Fin.snoc ρ r_star, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (N + 2)) = (0 : Fin (N + 1)).castSucc := rfl
      rw [h0_eq, Fin.snoc_castSucc, hc0]
    · have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (N + 2)) = (0 : Fin (N + 1)).castSucc := rfl
      rw [h0_eq, Fin.snoc_castSucc, hρ0]
    · rw [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_last]
      exact hp_star
    · intro k
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
      · rw [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_last]
        exact ⟨hr_star, hsub_star⟩
      · intro j
        rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact hballs j
    · intro k
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
      · have hsucc_last : (Fin.last N).succ = Fin.last (N + 1) := Fin.succ_last N
        rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc, hsucc_last, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_last]
        exact ⟨q, hq_last, hq_star⟩
      · intro j
        have hsucc_cs : (j.castSucc).succ = (j.succ).castSucc := Fin.succ_castSucc j
        rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc, hsucc_cs, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        exact hov j

  have hreach_chart_transfer : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero,
      ∀ q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ∩ U_reach,
      ∀ q₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ∩ rl6_regularLocusSet M,
      q₂ ∈ U_reach := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ q₁ ⟨hq₁_ball, _, hq₁_reach⟩ q₂ ⟨hq₂_ball, hq₂_reg⟩
    obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁_pos, hε₁_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hRegOpen) q₁ ⟨hq₁_ball, by
        obtain ⟨N, c, ρ, _, _, hmem, hb, _⟩ := hq₁_reach; exact (hb (Fin.last N)).2 hmem⟩
    obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂_pos, hε₂_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hRegOpen) q₂ ⟨hq₂_ball, hq₂_reg⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha_ε₁, ha_B⟩ := hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl p₀ hp₀ (hT_sub_cl_reg hp₀)
      q₁ ε₁ hε₁_pos (fun z hz => (hε₁_sub hz).1)
    obtain ⟨b, hb_ε₂, hb_B⟩ := hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl p₀ hp₀ (hT_sub_cl_reg hp₀)
      q₂ ε₂ hε₂_pos (fun z hz => (hε₂_sub hz).1)
    have ha_reach : Reachable a :=
      hreach_step_ball hq₁_reach hε₁_pos (fun z hz => (hε₁_sub hz).2)
        (Metric.mem_ball_self hε₁_pos) ha_ε₁
    obtain ⟨M_len, d, ε_d, hε_d_pos, hd0, hdl, hd_balls, hd_ov⟩ :=
      hTool.punctured_ball_chain (hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀) (hB_chart_holo p₀ hp₀)
        (hε₁_sub ha_ε₁).1 (hε₂_sub hb_ε₂).1 ha_B hb_B
    have hd_sub_reg : ∀ k : Fin (M_len + 1),
        Metric.ball (d k) ε_d ⊆ rl6_regularLocusSet M := by
      intro k z hz
      obtain ⟨hz_ball, hz_B⟩ := hd_balls k hz
      exact (hB_chart_fwd p₀ hp₀ z hz_ball hz_B).1
    have hind : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ M_len),
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (d ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩) ε_d, Reachable z := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro hm z hz
        have hd0' : d ⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ = a := hd0
        exact hreach_step_ball ha_reach hε_d_pos (hd_sub_reg ⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩)
          (by rw [hd0']; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε_d_pos) hz
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm z hz
        have hm_lt : m < M_len := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm
        let km : Fin M_len := ⟨m, hm_lt⟩
        obtain ⟨w_ov, hw_prev, hw_next⟩ := hd_ov km
        have hw_reach : Reachable w_ov := ih (Nat.le_of_lt hm_lt) w_ov hw_prev
        exact hreach_step_ball hw_reach hε_d_pos (hd_sub_reg km.succ) hw_next hz
    have hb_reach : Reachable b := by
      have hlast_eq : (⟨M_len, Nat.lt_succ_self M_len⟩ : Fin (M_len + 1)) = Fin.last M_len := rfl
      apply hind M_len le_rfl b
      rw [hlast_eq, hdl]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε_d_pos
    exact ⟨hq₂_reg, hreach_step_ball hb_reach hε₂_pos (fun z hz => (hε₂_sub hz).2)
      hb_ε₂ (Metric.mem_ball_self hε₂_pos)⟩

  have hT_sub_cl_reach : T_mero ⊆ closure U_reach := by
    let W_reach : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      ⋃ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (_ : p₀ ∈ T_mero ∧ p₀ ∈ closure U_reach),
        Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀)
    have hWr_open : IsOpen W_reach := isOpen_biUnion fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h00_B₀ : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_origin_pos
    have h00_reach : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_reach := ⟨hB₀_sub_reg h00_B₀, hreach_origin _ h00_B₀⟩
    have h00_T : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ T_mero := hRegSub h00_reach.1
    have hWr_ne : (T_mero ∩ W_reach).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), h00_T, Set.mem_biUnion ⟨h00_T, subset_closure h00_reach⟩ ?_⟩
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self (hr₀_pos _ h00_T)
    have hWr_sub_cl : W_reach ⊆ closure U_reach := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀_mem⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
      obtain ⟨⟨hp₀_T, hp₀_cl⟩, hz_ball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp₀_mem
      obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_reach, hdist₁⟩ :=
        Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₀_cl (r₀_fn p₀) (hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀_T)
      have hq₁_ball : q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hdist₁
      have hsub_reg_reach : Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) ∩ rl6_regularLocusSet M ⊆ U_reach :=
        fun q₂ hq₂ => hreach_chart_transfer p₀ hp₀_T q₁ ⟨hq₁_ball, hq₁_reach⟩ q₂ hq₂
      rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro ε hε_pos
      have hdist_z : dist z p₀ < r₀_fn p₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hz_ball
      let ρ' : ℝ := min ε (r₀_fn p₀ - dist z p₀)
      have hρ'_pos : 0 < ρ' := lt_min hε_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdist_z)
      have hρ'_sub : Metric.ball z ρ' ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀_fn p₀) :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_B⟩ :=
        hB_chart_nonzero_of_cl p₀ hp₀_T (hT_sub_cl_reg hp₀_T) z ρ' hρ'_pos hρ'_sub
      have hw_reg : w ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M :=
        (hB_chart_fwd p₀ hp₀_T w (hρ'_sub hw_mem) hw_B).1
      refine ⟨w, hsub_reg_reach ⟨hρ'_sub hw_mem, hw_reg⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [dist_comm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_mem) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hclWr_sub : closure W_reach ⊆ closure U_reach :=
      closure_minimal hWr_sub_cl isClosed_closure
    have hWr_cl_inter : closure W_reach ∩ T_mero ⊆ W_reach := by
      rintro p₀ ⟨hp₀_cl, hp₀_T⟩
      exact Set.mem_biUnion ⟨hp₀_T, hclWr_sub hp₀_cl⟩ (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr₀_pos p₀ hp₀_T))
    exact (hTubePreconn.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hWr_open hWr_ne hWr_cl_inter).trans hWr_sub_cl

  have hBallChainReach : ∀ p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M, Reachable p := by
    intro p hp
    have hp_T : p ∈ T_mero := hRegSub hp
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_reach, hdist₁⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp (hT_sub_cl_reach hp_T) (r₀_fn p) (hr₀_pos p hp_T)
    have hq₁_ball : q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p (r₀_fn p) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hdist₁
    exact (hreach_chart_transfer p hp_T q₁ ⟨hq₁_ball, hq₁_reach⟩
      p ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hr₀_pos p hp_T), hp⟩).2

  
  have hX0_parts := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo hRegOpen (hXTrueHolo 0)
  have hX1_parts := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo hRegOpen (hXTrueHolo 1)
  have hdotYY_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_impactDotYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M))
      (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    (hX0_parts.1.pow 2).add (hX1_parts.1.pow 2)
  have hdotTY_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_impactDotTY (rl6_regularImpactMap M))
      (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    (hX0_parts.2.1.mul hX0_parts.1).add (hX1_parts.2.1.mul hX1_parts.1)
  have hdetYYY_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_impactDetYYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M))
      (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    (hX0_parts.1.mul hX1_parts.2.2).sub (hX1_parts.1.mul hX0_parts.2.2)
  have hG6_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    hdiv_holo (hdetYYY_holo.pow 4)
      ((differentiableOn_const ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 2)).mul (hdotYY_holo.pow 3))
      (fun p hp => mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_ne_zero)
        (pow_ne_zero 3 (hInvNeZero p hp).1))
  have hR_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (rl6_sixthRootRatioR M) (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    hdiv_holo hdotTY_holo hdotYY_holo (fun p hp => (hInvNeZero p hp).1)
  have hG6_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M, rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hdot_nz, hdet_nz⟩ := hInvNeZero p hp
    exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 4 hdet_nz)
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero 3 hdot_nz))
  let compatFn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) p -
      rl6_sixthRootRatioR M p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M) p -
      6 * rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (rl6_sixthRootRatioR M) p
  have hG6_parts := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo hRegOpen hG6_holo
  have hR_parts := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo hRegOpen hR_holo
  have hcompat_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ compatFn (rl6_regularLocusSet M) :=
    (hG6_parts.2.1.sub (hR_holo.mul hG6_parts.1)).sub
      (((differentiableOn_const 6).mul hG6_holo).mul hR_parts.1)
  have hCompatEq : ∀ p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M, compatFn p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨N, c, ρ, hc0, hρ0, hp_last, hballs, hov⟩ := hBallChainReach p hp
    have hind : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ N),
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩) (ρ ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩),
          compatFn q = 0 := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro hm q hq
        have hc0' : c ⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) := hc0
        have hρ0' : ρ ⟨0, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩ = r_origin := hρ0
        rw [hc0', hρ0'] at hq
        exact hCompatOrigin q hq
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm q hq
        have hm_lt : m < N := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hm
        let km : Fin N := ⟨m, hm_lt⟩
        obtain ⟨q_ov, hq_prev, hq_next⟩ := hov km
        obtain ⟨r_ov, hr_ov_pos, hr_ov_sub⟩ :=
          Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
            q_ov ⟨hq_prev, hq_next⟩
        exact hTool.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball (c km.succ) (ρ km.succ)).isPreconnected
          (hcompat_holo.mono (hballs km.succ).2) (differentiableOn_const 0)
          hq_next hr_ov_pos (fun z hz => (hr_ov_sub hz).2)
          (fun z hz => ih (Nat.le_of_lt hm_lt) z (hr_ov_sub hz).1)
          q hq
    exact hind N le_rfl p hp_last

  exact ⟨{
    eqOn_of_preconnected_2D := hTool.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D
    iterDerivYT_holo := hTool.iterDerivYT_holo
    iterDerivYT_comm := hTool.iterDerivYT_comm
    T_mero_open := hTubeOpen
    T_mero_preconnected := hTubePreconn
    T_mero_star := hTubeStar
    base_sub_T_mero := hBaseSub
    U_reg := rl6_regularLocusSet M
    U_reg_sub := hRegSub
    U_reg_open := hRegOpen
    X_true := rl6_regularImpactMap M
    X_true_holo := hXTrueHolo
    r_origin := r_origin
    r_origin_pos := hr_origin_pos
    ball_origin_sub := hOriginSub
    X_true_origin_eq := hOriginEq
    chart_nonvanishing := hChartNonvanishing
    G_6 := rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 C M
    R_ratio := rl6_sixthRootRatioR M
    G_6_holo := hG6_holo
    R_ratio_holo := hR_holo
    G_6_ne_zero := hG6_ne_zero
    compat_eq := hCompatEq
    init_ode := hInitOde
    ball_chain_reach := hBallChainReach
  }⟩

regular_locus_and_sixth_root_system.definitions:
noncomputable def rl6_impactDotYY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q) ^ 2 + (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q) ^ 2

noncomputable def rl6_impactDotTY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_loc 0) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q +
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_loc 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q

noncomputable def rl6_impactDetYYY (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 0) q * iterDerivYT 2 0 (X_loc 1) q -
    iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_loc 1) q * iterDerivYT 2 0 (X_loc 0) q

def rl6_IsLocalRegularImpactChart {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ)
    (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧
  Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
  (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball p r)) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball p r)) ∧
  rl6_impactDotYY X_loc p ≠ 0 ∧
  rl6_impactDetYYY X_loc p ≠ 0

def rl6_regularLocusSet {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X |
    ∃ (r : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      rl6_IsLocalRegularImpactChart M p r X_loc }

open Classical in
noncomputable def rl6_regularImpactMap {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if h : p ∈ rl6_regularLocusSet M then (Classical.choose h.2.choose_spec) i p else 0

noncomputable def rl6_sixthPowerFieldG6 {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (rl6_impactDetYYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p) ^ 4 /
    ((C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 * (rl6_impactDotYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p) ^ 3)

noncomputable def rl6_sixthRootRatioR {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rl6_impactDotTY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p /
    rl6_impactDotYY (rl6_regularImpactMap M) p

structure rl6_Holo2DRegularToolkit : Prop where
  eqOn_of_preconnected_2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ},
    IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
    p₀ ∈ W → 0 < r₀ → Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ⊆ W →
    (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀, f q = g q) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = g p
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) W ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 2 0 f) W
  iterDerivYT_comm : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ f W →
    ∀ p ∈ W, iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p = iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p
  punctured_ball_chain : ∀ {p₀ a b : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ : ℝ} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    0 < r₀ → DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) →
    a ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ → b ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ →
    h a ≠ 0 → h b ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (M_len : ℕ) (c : Fin (M_len + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε ∧
      c 0 = a ∧
      c (Fin.last M_len) = b ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (M_len + 1), Metric.ball (c k) ε ⊆ { q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀ | h q ≠ 0 }) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin M_len,
        (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) ε ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) ε).Nonempty)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_exists_loc : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg,
      ∃ (r : ℝ) (𝔰_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r ∧
        Metric.ball p r ⊆ Reg.U_reg ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_loc (Metric.ball p r) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
          (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰_loc q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰_loc q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰_loc q) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
          𝔰_loc q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
          K.f (𝔰_loc q) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰_loc q) i) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨N, c, ρ, hc0, hρ0, hp_last, hValid, hOv⟩ := Reg.ball_chain_reach p hp
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := sixth_root_ball_chain_integration Ω C M K Reg N c ρ hc0 hρ0 hValid hOv
    let k_last : Fin (N + 1) := Fin.last N
    have hConf := chain_strip_confinement_and_impact Ω C M K Reg N c ρ S k_last
    let r_p : ℝ := ρ k_last - dist p (c k_last)
    have hr_p : 0 < r_p := sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hp_last)
    have h_ball_sub : Metric.ball p r_p ⊆ Metric.ball (c k_last) (ρ k_last) := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
      have htri : dist q (c k_last) ≤ dist q p + dist p (c k_last) :=
        dist_triangle q p (c k_last)
      linarith
    exact ⟨r_p, S.𝔰 k_last, hr_p, h_ball_sub.trans (hValid k_last).2,
      (S.𝔰_holo k_last).mono h_ball_sub,
      fun q hq => S.𝔰_ode k_last q (h_ball_sub hq),
      fun q hq => hConf q (h_ball_sub hq)⟩
  have h_exp_unique :
      ∀ (p₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (r₁ : ℝ) (𝔰₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
        (p₂ : ℂ × ℂ) (r₂ : ℝ) (𝔰₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        Metric.ball p₁ r₁ ⊆ Reg.U_reg →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₁ (Metric.ball p₁ r₁) →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁,
          (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₁ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q) →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁,
          𝔰₁ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
          K.f (𝔰₁ q) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰₁ q) i) →
        Metric.ball p₂ r₂ ⊆ Reg.U_reg →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₂ (Metric.ball p₂ r₂) →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₂ r₂,
          (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₂ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q) →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₂ r₂,
          𝔰₂ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
          K.f (𝔰₂ q) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰₂ q) i) →
        ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ → q ∈ Metric.ball p₂ r₂ →
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰₂ q) = Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰₁ q) := by
    intro p₁ r₁ 𝔰₁ p₂ r₂ 𝔰₂ hSub₁ hHolo₁ hODE₁ hLift₁ hSub₂ hHolo₂ hODE₂ hLift₂ q hq₁ hq₂
    let r_q : ℝ := min (r₁ - dist q p₁) (r₂ - dist q p₂)
    have hr_q : 0 < r_q :=
      lt_min (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₁)) (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₂))
    have h_sub₁ : Metric.ball q r_q ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
      have hle : r_q ≤ r₁ - dist q p₁ := min_le_left _ _
      have htri : dist z p₁ ≤ dist z q + dist q p₁ := dist_triangle z q p₁
      linarith
    have h_sub₂ : Metric.ball q r_q ⊆ Metric.ball p₂ r₂ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
      have hle : r_q ≤ r₂ - dist q p₂ := min_le_right _ _
      have htri : dist z p₂ ≤ dist z q + dist q p₂ := dist_triangle z q p₂
      linarith
    obtain ⟨ζ, b, s₀, δ, hζ, hδ, h_aff, hDom⟩ :=
      local_lifts_sixth_root_symmetry_germ Ω C M K Reg q r_q 𝔰₁ 𝔰₂ hr_q
        (h_sub₁.trans hSub₁) (hHolo₁.mono h_sub₁) (hHolo₂.mono h_sub₂)
        (fun z hz => hODE₁ z (h_sub₁ hz)) (fun z hz => hODE₂ z (h_sub₂ hz))
        (fun z hz => hLift₁ z (h_sub₁ hz)) (fun z hz => hLift₂ z (h_sub₂ hz))
    obtain ⟨hζ1, k, hb⟩ := curve_affine_symmetry_trivial Ω C M K ζ b s₀ δ hζ hδ hDom
    have h_arg : Complex.I * 𝔰₂ q =
        Complex.I * 𝔰₁ q + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [h_aff, hζ1, hb]
      ring
    rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
  classical
  let r_loc : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, ℝ := fun p hp => (h_exists_loc p hp).choose
  let 𝔰_loc : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun p hp => (h_exists_loc p hp).choose_spec.choose
  have h_loc_spec : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ Reg.U_reg),
      0 < r_loc p hp ∧
      Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp) ⊆ Reg.U_reg ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝔰_loc p hp) (Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp)) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp),
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰_loc p hp) q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (𝔰_loc p hp) q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰_loc p hp) q) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp),
        𝔰_loc p hp q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        K.f (𝔰_loc p hp q) ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰_loc p hp q) i) :=
    fun p hp => (h_exists_loc p hp).choose_spec.choose_spec
  let v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    if hp : p ∈ Reg.U_reg then Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp p) else 0
  have h_v_ball : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ Reg.U_reg), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp),
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp q) = v q := by
    intro p hp q hq_ball
    have hq_reg : q ∈ Reg.U_reg := (h_loc_spec p hp).2.1 hq_ball
    have hq_self : q ∈ Metric.ball q (r_loc q hq_reg) :=
      Metric.mem_ball_self (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).1
    have hv_q : v q = Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q hq_reg q) := by simp [v, hq_reg]
    rw [hv_q]
    exact h_exp_unique q (r_loc q hq_reg) (𝔰_loc q hq_reg) p (r_loc p hp) (𝔰_loc p hp)
      (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.1 (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.1
      (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.2.1 (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.2.2
      (h_loc_spec p hp).2.1 (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.1
      (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.2.1 (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.2.2
      q hq_self hq_ball
  refine ⟨{
    v := v
    v_holo := by
      intro p hp
      have h_ball_nhds : Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp) ∈ nhds p :=
        Metric.ball_mem_nhds p (h_loc_spec p hp).1
      have h_exp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp q))
          (Metric.ball p (r_loc p hp)) :=
        ((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.1).cexp
      have h_exp_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q => Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp q)) p :=
        h_exp_holo.differentiableAt h_ball_nhds
      have h_ev : v =ᶠ[nhds p] (fun q => Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp q)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem h_ball_nhds (fun q hq => (h_v_ball p hp q hq).symm)
      exact (h_exp_at.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
    v_ne_zero := by
      intro p hp
      have hv_p : v p = Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc p hp p) := by simp [v, hp]
      rw [hv_p]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    v_origin_eq := by
      intro q hq
      have hOrigSub : Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin ⊆ Reg.U_reg :=
        fun z hz => (Reg.ball_origin_sub hz).1
      obtain ⟨S₀⟩ := sixth_root_ball_chain_integration Ω C M K Reg 0
        (fun _ => ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) (fun _ => Reg.r_origin)
        rfl rfl (fun _ => ⟨Reg.r_origin_pos, hOrigSub⟩) (fun k => Fin.elim0 k)
      have hConf₀ := chain_strip_confinement_and_impact Ω C M K Reg 0
        (fun _ => ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) (fun _ => Reg.r_origin) S₀ 0
      have hq_reg : q ∈ Reg.U_reg := hOrigSub hq
      have hq_self : q ∈ Metric.ball q (r_loc q hq_reg) :=
        Metric.mem_ball_self (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).1
      have hv_q : v q = Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q hq_reg q) := by simp [v, hq_reg]
      have h_eq : Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q hq_reg q) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * S₀.𝔰 0 q) :=
        h_exp_unique ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin (S₀.𝔰 0)
          q (r_loc q hq_reg) (𝔰_loc q hq_reg)
          hOrigSub (S₀.𝔰_holo 0) (S₀.𝔰_ode 0) hConf₀
          (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.1 (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.1
          (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.2.1 (h_loc_spec q hq_reg).2.2.2.2
          q hq hq_self
      rw [hv_q, h_eq, S₀.𝔰_zero_eq q hq]
    v_local_lift := by
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨r_loc p hp, 𝔰_loc p hp, (h_loc_spec p hp).1, (h_loc_spec p hp).2.1,
        (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.1,
        fun q hq => ⟨h_v_ball p hp q hq, (h_loc_spec p hp).2.2.2.2 q hq⟩⟩
  }⟩

  c_zero : c 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
  ρ_zero : ρ 0 = Reg.r_origin
  balls_valid : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ k ∧ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ Reg.U_reg
  overlaps_nonempty : ∀ k : Fin N,
    (Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ)).Nonempty
  𝔰 : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_zero_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c 0) (ρ 0), 𝔰 0 q = K.𝔰_init q
  𝔰_holo : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝔰 k) (Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))
  𝔰_ode : ∀ k : Fin (N + 1), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k),
    (iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰 k) q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (𝔰 k) q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (𝔰 k) q
  𝔰_overlap_eq : ∀ k : Fin N,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c k.castSucc) (ρ k.castSucc) ∩ Metric.ball (c k.succ) (ρ k.succ),
      𝔰 k.castSucc q = 𝔰 k.succ q

def PuncturedSliceRemovableProp {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M) : Prop :=
  M.h_X 0 = ⊤ →
  ∀ (u₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) (v_sl : ℂ → ℂ) (n d : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < δ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v_sl (Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀}) →
    (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (n i) (Metric.ball u₀ δ) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (d i) (Metric.ball u₀ δ)) →
    (∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀}, ∃ s : ℂ,
      Complex.exp (Complex.I * s) = v_sl u ∧ K.f s ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, d i u ≠ 0 ∧ n i u = K.Γ s i * d i u) →
    ∃ L : ℂ, L ≠ 0 ∧ Filter.Tendsto v_sl (nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ) (nhds L)

structure GlobalExponentialExtensionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (ExpLift : RegularExponentialLiftData C M K Reg) where
  V_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V_plus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_plus (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  V_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_minus (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X)
  V_mul_one : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, V_plus p * V_minus p = 1
  V_plus_reg_eq : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, V_plus p = ExpLift.v p
  V_wall_strict : ∀ H₀ : ℝ, M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ →
    0 < H₀ ∧ ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
      ‖V_plus p‖ < Real.exp H₀ ∧ ‖V_minus p‖ < Real.exp H₀

proof.tactics:
by
  have hBaseSub : { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < M.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } ⊆
      meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by simpa using hp2
    have hct_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, RCLike.norm_conj]
      exact hp2
    refine ⟨hp2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hlt : -p.1.im < M.s_base := lt_of_le_of_lt (neg_le_abs p.1.im) hp1
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hlt)
        (M.h_X_ge _ hct_ball)
    · have hlt : p.1.im < M.s_base := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self p.1.im) hp1
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hlt)
        (M.h_X_ge _ ht_ball)
  have hT_open : IsOpen (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) := by
    have hlsc_half_open : ∀ (σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ) (τ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        Continuous σ → Continuous τ →
        IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖τ p‖ < M.r_base ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (σ p) < M.h_X (τ p) } := by
      intro σ τ hσ hτ
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro p₀ ⟨hτ₀_norm, hσ₀_lt⟩
      have hτ₀_ball : τ p₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := by simpa using hτ₀_norm
      let m : ℝ := max (σ p₀) 0
      have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ m := le_max_right _ _
      have hσ₀_le_m : σ p₀ ≤ m := le_max_left _ _
      have hofReal_m : ENNReal.ofReal m = ENNReal.ofReal (σ p₀) := by
        dsimp only [m]
        rcases le_or_gt 0 (σ p₀) with hge | hlt
        · rw [max_eq_left hge]
        · rw [max_eq_right hlt.le, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos hlt.le]
      have hm_lt : ENNReal.ofReal m < M.h_X (τ p₀) := by rwa [hofReal_m]
      have hex_eps : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (m + ε) < M.h_X (τ p₀) := by
        by_cases htop : M.h_X (τ p₀) = ⊤
        · exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, htop ▸ ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
        · let W_val : ℝ := (M.h_X (τ p₀)).toReal
          have hW_eq : ENNReal.ofReal W_val = M.h_X (τ p₀) := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal htop
          have hW_pos : 0 < W_val := by
            apply ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp
            rw [hW_eq]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos) (M.h_X_ge _ hτ₀_ball)
          have hm_lt_W : m < W_val :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hW_pos).mp (hW_eq.symm ▸ hm_lt)
          refine ⟨(W_val - m) / 2, by linarith, ?_⟩
          rw [← hW_eq]
          exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hW_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hmε_lt⟩ := hex_eps
      have hmε_pos : 0 < m + ε := by linarith
      have hlsc_at := M.h_X_lsc (τ p₀) hτ₀_ball (ENNReal.ofReal (m + ε)) hmε_lt
      rw [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hτ₀_ball)] at hlsc_at
      have hev_hX : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, ENNReal.ofReal (m + ε) < M.h_X (τ p) :=
        hτ.continuousAt.eventually hlsc_at
      have hev_norm : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, ‖τ p‖ < M.r_base :=
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp hτ) continuous_const).mem_nhds hτ₀_norm
      have hev_σ : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, σ p < m + ε :=
        (isOpen_lt hσ continuous_const).mem_nhds (show σ p₀ < m + ε by linarith)
      filter_upwards [hev_norm, hev_hX, hev_σ] with p hp_norm hp_hX hp_σ
      exact ⟨hp_norm, lt_trans ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hmε_pos).mpr hp_σ) hp_hX⟩
    have h1 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖starRingEnd ℂ p.2‖ < M.r_base ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (-p.1.im) < M.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) } :=
      hlsc_half_open (fun p => -p.1.im) (fun p => starRingEnd ℂ p.2)
        ((Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst).neg)
        (Complex.continuous_conj.comp continuous_snd)
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base ∧ ENNReal.ofReal p.1.im < M.h_X p.2 } :=
      hlsc_half_open (fun p => p.1.im) (fun p => p.2)
        (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd
    have heq_set : meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X = { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base } ∩
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖starRingEnd ℂ p.2‖ < M.r_base ∧
          ENNReal.ofReal (-p.1.im) < M.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) } ∩
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < M.r_base ∧ ENNReal.ofReal p.1.im < M.h_X p.2 } := by
      ext p
      simp only [meroTubeENNR, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, RCLike.norm_conj]
      tauto
    rw [heq_set]
    exact (h1.inter h2).inter h3
  have hmem_T_real : ∀ (x : ℝ) (t : ℂ), ‖t‖ < M.r_base →
      ((x : ℂ), t) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X :=
    fun _ _ ht => hBaseSub ⟨by simpa using M.s_base_pos, ht⟩
  
  have hb_pkg : ∃ b_shift : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ b_shift (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base) ∧
      b_shift 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base, b_shift (-t) = b_shift t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base,
        b_shift (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (b_shift t)) ∧
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < M.r_base → |(b_shift t).im| < M.s_base →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (shiftedLiftMap Raw.𝔰_raw b_shift (x, t) - x)) = 0) := by
    let b₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t =>
      ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ))
    refine ⟨b₀, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t₀ ht₀
      have ht₀_norm : ‖t₀‖ < M.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht₀
      set δ : ℝ := (M.r_base - ‖t₀‖) / 4 with hδ_def
      have hδ : 0 < δ := by linarith
      have hball2_sub : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ), ‖w‖ < M.r_base := by
        intro w hw
        have hdist : ‖w - t₀‖ ≤ 2 * δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
        have htri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖t₀‖ + ‖w - t₀‖ := norm_le_insert' w t₀
        linarith
      have hslice_diffAt : ∀ (x : ℝ) (w : ℂ), ‖w‖ < M.r_base →
          DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), ζ)) w := by
        intro x w hw
        exact (Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.differentiableAt (hT_open.mem_nhds (hmem_T_real x w hw))).comp w
          ((differentiableAt_const (x : ℂ)).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      let K_param : Set (ℝ × ℂ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ)
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K_param :=
        isCompact_Icc.prod (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall t₀ (2 * δ))
      have hK_ne : K_param.Nonempty :=
        ⟨(0, t₀), ⟨⟨le_rfl, by positivity⟩, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by linarith)⟩⟩
      have hφ_cont : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ((q.1 : ℂ), q.2)) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd
      have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ((q.1 : ℂ), q.2)) K_param
          (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) :=
        fun q hq => hmem_T_real q.1 q.2 (hball2_sub q.2 hq.2)
      have hS_cont_K : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => ‖Raw.𝔰_raw ((q.1 : ℂ), q.2)‖) K_param :=
        continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn
          (Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.continuousOn.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn hφ_maps)
      obtain ⟨q_max, _, hq_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne hS_cont_K
      let M_bd : ℝ := ‖Raw.𝔰_raw ((q_max.1 : ℂ), q_max.2)‖
      let C_bd : ℝ := M_bd / δ
      let F_int : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun t x => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ)
      let F_int' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun t x => deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), ζ)) t
      have hF_cont : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < M.r_base → Continuous (F_int t) := by
        intro t ht
        have hpsi : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ), t)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.prodMk continuous_const
        exact (Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpsi
          (fun x => hmem_T_real x t ht)).sub Complex.continuous_ofReal
      have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F_int' t₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        let step : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (((δ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
        have hstep_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖step n‖ ≤ 2 * δ := by
          intro n
          have hle : δ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ δ := div_le_self hδ.le (by linarith)
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have hstep_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, step n ≠ 0 :=
          fun _ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
        have hstep_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto step Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
          rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
          refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hstep_ne⟩
          have hreal : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => δ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
              (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
          simpa [Function.comp_def, step] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hreal
        refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
          (f := fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) =>
            (step n)⁻¹ • (Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t₀ + step n) - Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t₀)))
          (fun n => ?_) ?_
        · have ht_n : ‖t₀ + step n‖ < M.r_base := by
            apply hball2_sub
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hstep_norm n
          have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t₀ + step n)) :=
            Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.prodMk continuous_const)
              (fun x => hmem_T_real x _ ht_n)
          have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t₀)) :=
            Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.prodMk continuous_const)
              (fun x => hmem_T_real x t₀ ht₀_norm)
          exact ((hc1.sub hc0).const_smul ((step n)⁻¹)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
          have hd : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), ζ)) (F_int' t₀ x) t₀ :=
            (hslice_diffAt x t₀ ht₀_norm).hasDerivAt
          exact hd.tendsto_slope_zero.comp hstep_tendsto
      have h_int_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_int t x)
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_int' t₀ x) t₀ := by
        refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
          (bound := fun _ => C_bd)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₀ hδ) ?_ ?_ hF'_meas ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_).2
        · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₀ hδ] with t ht
          have ht_cb : t ∈ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ) :=
            Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht)
          exact (hF_cont t (hball2_sub t ht_cb)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact (hF_cont t₀ ht₀_norm).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx t ht => ?_)
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)] at hx
          have ht_dist : ‖t - t₀‖ < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht
          have hsub_ball2 : Metric.closedBall t δ ⊆ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ) := by
            intro w hw
            have hw_dist : ‖w - t‖ ≤ δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            have htri : ‖w - t₀‖ ≤ ‖w - t‖ + ‖t - t₀‖ := by
              simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (w - t) (t - t₀)
            linarith
          have hdiff_cl : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), ζ))
              (Metric.ball t δ) := by
            refine DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl_ball (U := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base) ?_ ?_
            · intro ζ hζ
              have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ < M.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hζ
              exact (hslice_diffAt x ζ hζ_norm).differentiableWithinAt
            · intro w hw
              simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hball2_sub w (hsub_ball2 hw)
          exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hδ hdiff_cl (fun w hw => by
            have hw_cb : w ∈ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ) :=
              hsub_ball2 (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
            have hmem_K : (x, w) ∈ K_param := ⟨⟨le_of_lt hx.1, hx.2⟩, hw_cb⟩
            exact hq_max hmem_K)
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x _ t ht => ?_)
          have ht_cb : t ∈ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * δ) :=
            Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht)
          exact ((hslice_diffAt x t (hball2_sub t ht_cb)).hasDerivAt).sub_const (x : ℂ)
      exact (h_int_deriv.differentiableAt.const_mul
        (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)).differentiableWithinAt
    · have h0_ball : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos
      have hhX0_pos : 0 < M.h_X 0 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos) (M.h_X_ge 0 h0_ball)
      have hx_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
        intro x
        change ENNReal.ofReal |(x : ℂ).im| < M.h_X 0
        simpa using hhX0_pos
      have hx_zero : ∀ x : ℝ, Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), 0) - (x : ℂ) = 0 := by
        intro x
        rw [Raw.𝔰_raw_zero (x : ℂ) (hx_mem x), sub_self]
      simp [b₀, hx_zero]
    · intro t ht
      have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht
      dsimp only [b₀]
      congr 1
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Raw.𝔰_raw_even ((x : ℂ), t) (hmem_T_real x t ht_norm)]
    · intro t ht
      have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < M.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht
      have h_pt : ∀ x : ℝ, Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), starRingEnd ℂ t) - (x : ℂ) =
          starRingEnd ℂ (Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ)) := by
        intro x
        have hc := Raw.𝔰_raw_conj ((x : ℂ), t) (hmem_T_real x t ht_norm)
        dsimp only at hc
        rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hc
        rw [hc, map_sub, Complex.conj_ofReal]
      have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ)) := by
        have hpsi : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ), t)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.prodMk continuous_const
        exact (Raw.𝔰_raw_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpsi
          (fun x => hmem_T_real x t ht_norm)).sub Complex.continuous_ofReal
      have hint_comm : starRingEnd ℂ
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ))) =
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), starRingEnd ℂ (Raw.𝔰_raw ((x : ℂ), t) - (x : ℂ)) :=
        (Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
          (hf_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))).symm
      dsimp only [b₀]
      simp_rw [h_pt]
      rw [map_mul, map_inv₀, Complex.conj_ofReal, hint_comm]
    · have h_rect_gen : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (β : ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g { z : ℂ | |z.im| < M.s_base } →
          (∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| < M.s_base → g (z + 2 * Real.pi) = g z) →
          |β.im| < M.s_base →
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (x : ℂ)) = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * β →
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g ((x : ℂ) - β) - β)) = 0 := by
        intro g β hg_holo hg_per hβ h_int_g
