proof.tactics:
by
  have huIcc_01 : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
  have huIcc_sub : ∀ {w : ℝ}, w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hw.1]
    exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2
  have huIoc_sub : ∀ {w : ℝ}, w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro w hw
    exact Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc.trans (huIcc_sub hw)
  have hPrim_cont : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (fun w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, f v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [← huIcc_01]
    exact intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive_interval
      (hf.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set (by rw [huIcc_01]))
  have hPrim_deriv : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f v) (f w) w := by
    intro f hf w hw
    have hw_Icc : w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
    · exact (hf.mono (huIcc_sub hw_Icc)).intervalIntegrable
    · exact (hf.mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self).stronglyMeasurableAtFilter isOpen_Ioo w hw
    · exact hf.continuousAt (Icc_mem_nhds hw.1 hw.2)
  have hKernel_split : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f v) =
          (w : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, f v) - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (v : ℂ) * f v := by
    intro f hf w hw
    have hf_int : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
      (hf.mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
    have hvf_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * f v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hf
    have hvf_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * f v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
      (hvf_cont.mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
    have h_congr : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f v) =
        ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w : ℂ) * f v - (v : ℂ) * f v) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v _ => ?_)
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_congr, intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hf_int.const_mul (w : ℂ)) hvf_int,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hPicard1D : ∀ {Q y₀ : ℝ → ℂ} {M : ℝ},
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      0 ≤ M →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M) →
      ContinuousOn y₀ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₀ w‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w‖ ≤ (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) ∧
          ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w‖ ≤ M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun w => ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w) =
          y₀ w + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
            ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v)) := by
    intro Q y₀ M hQ hM0 hQbnd hy₀_cont hy₀_bnd
    have hIter : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w‖ ≤ (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨hy₀_cont, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        simpa [sfcaVolterraIter] using hy₀_bnd w hw
      | succ m ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨ih_cont, ih_bnd⟩
        have hf_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v => Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ.mul ih_cont
        have hvf_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v))
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hf_cont
        have hsucc_cont : ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q (m + 1)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          have h_rhs_cont : ContinuousOn
              (fun w : ℝ => (w : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v) -
                ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v))
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul (hPrim_cont hf_cont)).sub
              (hPrim_cont hvf_cont)
          refine h_rhs_cont.congr (fun w hw => ?_)
          have hsp := hKernel_split hf_cont w hw
          simpa only [sfcaVolterraIter, mul_assoc] using hsp
        refine ⟨hsucc_cont, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun v : ℝ => (M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ m)
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow m)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
        have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
            ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖ ≤
              (M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ m := by
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
          have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt hv.1
          have hvw : v ≤ w := hv.2
          have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv0, hvw.trans hw.2⟩
          have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hvw)]
            linarith [hw.2]
          have hQv : ‖Q v‖ ≤ M := hQbnd v hv_Icc
          have hIv : ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖ ≤ (M * v) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) :=
            ih_bnd v hv_Icc
          have hprod1 : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖ ≤ 1 * M :=
            mul_le_mul hwv_le hQv (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          have hprod2 : (‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖) * ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖ ≤
              (1 * M) * ((M * v) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul hprod1 hIv (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖
              = (‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖) * ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
            _ ≤ (1 * M) * ((M * v) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) := hprod2
            _ = (M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ m := by
                rw [mul_pow]
                ring
        have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae hg_int
        have h_eval : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ m) =
            (M * w) ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow,
            zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), sub_zero, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, mul_pow]
          have hfac_ne : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
          have hm1_ne : ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
          field_simp [hfac_ne, hm1_ne]
          push_cast
          ring
        simpa only [sfcaVolterraIter, h_eval] using h_int_le
    have hIter_full : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w‖ ≤ (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) ∧
          ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w‖ ≤ M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro m
      refine ⟨(hIter m).1, fun w hw => ⟨(hIter m).2 w hw, ?_⟩⟩
      refine le_trans ((hIter m).2 w hw) ?_
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hM0 hw.1) (mul_le_of_le_one_right hM0 hw.2) m
    have hSumM : Summable (fun m : ℕ => M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) :=
      Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M
    have hV_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m w)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      continuousOn_tsum (fun m => (hIter_full m).1) hSumM
        (fun m w hw => ((hIter_full m).2 w hw).2)
    refine ⟨hIter_full, hV_cont, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    have hSummable_pt : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        Summable (fun m : ℕ => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v) :=
      fun v hv => Summable.of_norm_bounded hSumM (fun m => ((hIter_full m).2 v hv).2)
    let F_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ :=
      fun m v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v
    let B_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m _ => M * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ))
    have h_dom : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F_seq m v)
        (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
          ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence B_seq
      · intro m
        have hFm_cont : ContinuousOn (F_seq m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          have h_sub_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
          exact (h_sub_cont.mul hQ).mul (hIter_full m).1
        exact (hFm_cont.mono (huIoc_sub hw)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      · intro m
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hw.1] at hv
        have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt hv.1
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv0, hv.2.trans hw.2⟩
        have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)]
          linarith [hw.2]
        have hprod1 : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖ ≤ 1 * M :=
          mul_le_mul hwv_le (hQbnd v hv_Icc) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        calc ‖F_seq m v‖
            = (‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖) * ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v‖ := by
              dsimp [F_seq]
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (1 * M) * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) :=
              mul_le_mul hprod1 (((hIter_full m).2 v hv_Icc).2) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = B_seq m v := by dsimp [B_seq]; ring
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ => hSumM.mul_left M)
      · dsimp only [B_seq]
        exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := huIoc_sub hw hv
        simpa only [F_seq] using
          (hSummable_pt v hv_Icc).hasSum.mul_left (((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v)
    have h_tsum_shift : (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q (m + 1) w) =
        ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
          ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ Q m v) :=
      h_dom.tsum_eq
    rw [(hSummable_pt w hw).tsum_eq_zero_add, h_tsum_shift]
    rfl

  have hOdeLaws : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraC Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraK Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        sfcaVolterraC Q w =
          1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v ∧
        sfcaVolterraK Q w =
          (w : ℂ) + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v) ∧
      sfcaVolterraC Q 0 = 1 ∧
      sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q 0 = 0 ∧
      sfcaVolterraK Q 0 = 0 ∧
      sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraC Q) (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w) w ∧
        HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q) (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w) w ∧
        HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraK Q) (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w) w ∧
        HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q) (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w) w) := by
    intro Q hQ
    obtain ⟨w_max, _, hw_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hQ)
    let M : ℝ := ‖Q w_max‖
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := norm_nonneg _
    have hQbnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M := fun w hw => hw_max hw
    have hy₀_C_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := fun _ _ => by simp
    have hy₀_K_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(w : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hw.1]
      exact hw.2
    obtain ⟨_, hC_cont, hC_eq⟩ := hPicard1D hQ hM0 hQbnd continuousOn_const hy₀_C_bnd
    obtain ⟨_, hK_cont, hK_eq⟩ :=
      hPicard1D hQ hM0 hQbnd Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hy₀_K_bnd
    change ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraC Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) at hC_cont
    change ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraK Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) at hK_cont
    have hQC_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v => Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQ.mul hC_cont
    have hQK_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v => Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQ.mul hK_cont
    have hCD_cont : ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hPrim_cont hQC_cont
    have hKD_cont : ContinuousOn (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      continuousOn_const.add (hPrim_cont hQK_cont)
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    have hC0 : sfcaVolterraC Q 0 = 1 := by
      have h := hC_eq 0 h0_mem
      change sfcaVolterraC Q 0 = _ at h
      simpa using h
    have hK0 : sfcaVolterraK Q 0 = 0 := by
      have h := hK_eq 0 h0_mem
      change sfcaVolterraK Q 0 = _ at h
      simpa using h
    have hCD0 : sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q 0 = 0 := by simp [sfcaVolterraCDeriv]
    have hKD0 : sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q 0 = 1 := by simp [sfcaVolterraKDeriv]
    refine ⟨hC_cont, hK_cont, hCD_cont, hKD_cont,
      fun w hw => ⟨hC_eq w hw, hK_eq w hw⟩, hC0, hCD0, hK0, hKD0, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have hCD_deriv : HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q) (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w) w :=
      hPrim_deriv hQC_cont w hw
    have hKD_deriv : HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q) (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w) w := by
      have h := (hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℂ)).add (hPrim_deriv hQK_cont w hw)
      rw [zero_add] at h
      exact h
    have hid_C : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ)) 1 w := by
      have h := (hasDerivAt_id w).ofReal_comp
      norm_num at h
      exact h
    have hC_deriv : HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraC Q) (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w) w := by
      have hvQC_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hQC_cont
      have hvQC_deriv := hPrim_deriv hvQC_cont w hw
      have h_rhs_deriv : HasDerivAt
          (fun u : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q u -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v))
          ((0 : ℂ) + ((1 : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w)) -
            (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w)) w :=
        ((hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℂ)).add (hid_C.mul hCD_deriv)).sub hvQC_deriv
      have h_ev : sfcaVolterraC Q =ᶠ[nhds w]
          (fun u : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) + (u : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q u -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v)) := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hw] with u hu
        have hu_Icc : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu
        have h1 : sfcaVolterraC Q u =
            1 + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v) := by
          simpa only [sfcaVolterraC, mul_assoc] using hC_eq u hu_Icc
        rw [h1, hKernel_split hQC_cont u hu_Icc]
        dsimp [sfcaVolterraCDeriv]
        ring
      have h_simp : (0 : ℂ) + ((1 : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w +
            (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w)) -
          (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraC Q w) = sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w := by ring
      rw [h_simp] at h_rhs_deriv
      exact h_ev.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr h_rhs_deriv
    have hK_deriv : HasDerivAt (sfcaVolterraK Q) (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w) w := by
      have hvQK_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hQK_cont
      have hvQK_deriv := hPrim_deriv hvQK_cont w hw
      have h_rhs_deriv : HasDerivAt
          (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q u -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v))
          (((1 : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w)) -
            (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w)) w :=
        (hid_C.mul hKD_deriv).sub hvQK_deriv
      have h_ev : sfcaVolterraK Q =ᶠ[nhds w]
          (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q u -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v)) := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hw] with u hu
        have hu_Icc : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hu
        have h1 : sfcaVolterraK Q u =
            (u : ℂ) + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v) := by
          simpa only [sfcaVolterraK, mul_assoc] using hK_eq u hu_Icc
        rw [h1, hKernel_split hQK_cont u hu_Icc]
        dsimp [sfcaVolterraKDeriv]
        ring
      have h_simp : ((1 : ℂ) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w +
            (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w)) -
          (w : ℂ) * (Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w) = sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w := by ring
      rw [h_simp] at h_rhs_deriv
      exact h_ev.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr h_rhs_deriv
    exact ⟨hC_deriv, hCD_deriv, hK_deriv, hKD_deriv⟩

  have hZeroPot : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      sfcaVolterraC (fun _ => 0) w = 1 ∧ sfcaVolterraK (fun _ => 0) w = (w : ℂ) := by
    have hIter0 : ∀ (y₀ : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ), m ≠ 0 →
        sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (fun _ => 0) m w = 0 := by
      intro y₀ m w hm
      cases m with
      | zero => exact False.elim (hm rfl)
      | succ n => simp [sfcaVolterraIter]
    intro w _
    exact ⟨by rw [sfcaVolterraC, tsum_eq_single 0 (fun m hm => hIter0 _ m w hm)]; rfl,
      by rw [sfcaVolterraK, tsum_eq_single 0 (fun m hm => hIter0 _ m w hm)]; rfl⟩

  have hRevSymm : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      sfcaVolterraK (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = sfcaVolterraK Q 1 := by
    intro Q hQ
    let rev : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => 1 - w
    have hrev_cont : Continuous rev := continuous_const.sub continuous_id
    have hrev_maps : Set.MapsTo rev (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      fun w hw => ⟨by linarith [hw.2], by linarith [hw.1]⟩
    let Q_rev : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q (1 - w)
    have hQ_rev : ContinuousOn Q_rev (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQ.comp hrev_cont.continuousOn hrev_maps
    obtain ⟨_, hk_cont, _, hk'_cont, _, _, _, hk0, hk'0, hderivQ⟩ := hOdeLaws Q hQ
    obtain ⟨_, hkr_cont, _, hkr'_cont, _, _, _, hkr0, hkr'0, hderivQr⟩ := hOdeLaws Q_rev hQ_rev
    let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => sfcaVolterraK Q_rev (1 - w)
    let u' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => -sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q_rev (1 - w)
    let W : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => sfcaVolterraK Q w * u' w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w * u w
    have hu_cont : ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hkr_cont.comp hrev_cont.continuousOn hrev_maps
    have hu'_cont : ContinuousOn u' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hkr'_cont.comp hrev_cont.continuousOn hrev_maps).neg
    have hW_cont : ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hk_cont.mul hu'_cont).sub (hk'_cont.mul hu_cont)
    have hW_deriv : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt W 0 w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_rev : 1 - w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hw.2], by linarith [hw.1]⟩
      have h1w_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 - x) (-1 : ℝ) w := by
        have h := (hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id w)
        rw [zero_sub] at h
        exact h
      have hu_d : HasDerivAt u (u' w) w := by
        have h := HasDerivAt.scomp w (hderivQr (1 - w) hw_rev).2.2.1 h1w_deriv
        rw [neg_one_smul] at h
        exact h
      have hu'_d : HasDerivAt u' (Q w * u w) w := by
        have h := (HasDerivAt.scomp w (hderivQr (1 - w) hw_rev).2.2.2 h1w_deriv).neg
        have hval : -((-1 : ℝ) • (Q_rev (1 - w) * sfcaVolterraK Q_rev (1 - w))) = Q w * u w := by
          rw [neg_one_smul, neg_neg]
          dsimp [Q_rev, u]
          ring_nf
        rw [hval] at h
        exact h
      have hk_d := (hderivQ w hw).2.2.1
      have hk'_d := (hderivQ w hw).2.2.2
      have hraw : HasDerivAt W
          ((sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w * u' w + sfcaVolterraK Q w * (Q w * u w)) -
            ((Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w) * u w + sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w * u' w)) w :=
        (hk_d.mul hu'_d).sub (hk'_d.mul hu_d)
      have hzero : (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w * u' w + sfcaVolterraK Q w * (Q w * u w)) -
          ((Q w * sfcaVolterraK Q w) * u w + sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w * u' w) = 0 := by ring
      rw [hzero] at hraw
      exact hraw
    have hW_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le
      zero_le_one hW_cont hW_deriv intervalIntegrable_const
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at hW_ftc
    have hW1 : W 1 = -sfcaVolterraK Q 1 := by
      dsimp [W, u, u']
      rw [sub_self, hkr0, hkr'0]
      ring
    have hW0 : W 0 = -sfcaVolterraK Q_rev 1 := by
      dsimp [W, u, u']
      rw [sub_zero, hk0, hk'0]
      ring
    rw [hW1, hW0] at hW_ftc
    dsimp [Q_rev] at hW_ftc ⊢
    linear_combination -hW_ftc

  have hMom1 : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (w - v)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro w hw
    let F₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => w * v - v ^ 2 / 2
    have hF₁_cont : ContinuousOn F₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) w) :=
      ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub ((continuous_pow 2).div_const 2)).continuousOn
    have hF₁_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) w, HasDerivAt F₁ (w - v) v := by
      intro v _
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => w * x) (w * 1) v :=
        (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul w
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 / 2) ((2 * v ^ 1) / 2) v :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 v).div_const 2
      have hd : HasDerivAt F₁ (w * 1 - (2 * v ^ 1) / 2) v := hd1.sub hd2
      have hval : w * 1 - (2 * v ^ 1) / 2 = w - v := by ring
      rwa [hval] at hd
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
      hF₁_cont hF₁_deriv ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).intervalIntegrable 0 w)
    rw [hftc]
    dsimp [F₁]
    nlinarith [hw.1, hw.2]

  have hMom2 : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (w - v) * v) ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    intro w hw
    let F₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => w * (v ^ 2 / 2) - v ^ 3 / 3
    have hF₂_cont : ContinuousOn F₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) w) :=
      ((continuous_const.mul ((continuous_pow 2).div_const 2)).sub
        ((continuous_pow 3).div_const 3)).continuousOn
    have hF₂_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) w, HasDerivAt F₂ ((w - v) * v) v := by
      intro v _
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => w * (x ^ 2 / 2)) (w * ((2 * v ^ 1) / 2)) v :=
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 v).div_const 2).const_mul w
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 / 3) ((3 * v ^ 2) / 3) v :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow 3 v).div_const 3
      have hd : HasDerivAt F₂ (w * ((2 * v ^ 1) / 2) - (3 * v ^ 2) / 3) v := hd1.sub hd2
      have hval : w * ((2 * v ^ 1) / 2) - (3 * v ^ 2) / 3 = (w - v) * v := by ring
      rwa [hval] at hd
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
      hF₂_cont hF₂_deriv
      (((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable 0 w)
    rw [hftc]
    dsimp [F₂]
    have hw2 : 0 ≤ w ^ 2 := sq_nonneg w
    nlinarith [hw.1, hw.2, hw2]

  have hQuantBounds : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (M_Q : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → 0 ≤ M_Q → M_Q ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M_Q) →
      7 / 8 ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ∧
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1‖ ≤ M_Q ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_Q ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 2 * M_Q ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w - 1‖ ≤ 2 * M_Q := by
    intro Q M_Q hQ hM0 hMhalf hQbnd
    obtain ⟨hC_cont, hK_cont, _, _, hIntEq, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hOdeLaws Q hQ
    obtain ⟨w_c, hw_c_mem, hw_c_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hC_cont.sub continuousOn_const))
    let S_c : ℝ := ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w_c - 1‖
    have hSc_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_c := norm_nonneg _
    have hSc_step : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M_Q + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S_c := by
      intro w hw
      have hsub_eq : sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1 =
          ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v := by
        linear_combination (hIntEq w hw).1
      rw [hsub_eq]
      have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
          ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v‖ ≤ (M_Q * (1 + S_c)) * (w - v) := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hv.1, hv.2.trans hw.2⟩
        have hwv : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = w - v := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)]
        have hCv : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖ ≤ 1 + S_c := by
          calc ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖
              = ‖(1 : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 1 + S_c := by simp [S_c]; exact hw_c_max hv_Icc
        calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v‖
            = (w - v) * (‖Q v‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖) := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hwv, mul_assoc]
          _ ≤ (w - v) * (M_Q * (1 + S_c)) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)
              exact mul_le_mul (hQbnd v hv_Icc) hCv (norm_nonneg _) hM0
          _ = (M_Q * (1 + S_c)) * (w - v) := mul_comm _ _
      have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => (M_Q * (1 + S_c)) * (w - v))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae hg_int
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h1
      have hm1 := hMom1 w hw
      have h2 : M_Q * (1 + S_c) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (w - v)) ≤ M_Q * (1 + S_c) * (1 / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    have hSc_le : S_c ≤ M_Q := by
      have h_at_max : S_c ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M_Q + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S_c := hSc_step w_c hw_c_mem
      linarith
    have hC_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1‖ ≤ M_Q :=
      fun w hw => le_trans (hw_c_max hw) hSc_le

    obtain ⟨w_k, hw_k_mem, hw_k_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hK_cont.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn))
    let S_k : ℝ := ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w_k - (w_k : ℂ)‖
    have hSk_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_k := norm_nonneg _
    have hSk_step : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * M_Q + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S_k := by
      intro w hw
      have hsub_eq : sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ) =
          ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v := by
        linear_combination (hIntEq w hw).2
      rw [hsub_eq]
      have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
          ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ ≤
            M_Q * ((w - v) * v) + (M_Q * S_k) * (w - v) := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
        have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt hv.1
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv0, hv.2.trans hw.2⟩
        have hwv : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = w - v := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)]
        have hKv : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ ≤ v + S_k := by
          have hv_norm : ‖(v : ℂ)‖ = v := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hv0]
          calc ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖
              = ‖(v : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ))‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖(v : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ v + S_k := by
                have hmax : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ)‖ ≤ S_k := hw_k_max hv_Icc
                linarith
        calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v‖
            = (w - v) * (‖Q v‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖) := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hwv, mul_assoc]
          _ ≤ (w - v) * (M_Q * (v + S_k)) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)
              exact mul_le_mul (hQbnd v hv_Icc) hKv (norm_nonneg _) hM0
          _ = M_Q * ((w - v) * v) + (M_Q * S_k) * (w - v) := by ring
      have hg1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => M_Q * ((w - v) * v)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
      have hg2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => (M_Q * S_k) * (w - v)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae (hg1.add hg2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hg1 hg2,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h1
      have hm1 := hMom1 w hw
      have hm2 := hMom2 w hw
      have h2a : M_Q * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (w - v) * v) ≤ M_Q * (1 / 6) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm2 hM0
      have h2b : (M_Q * S_k) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (w - v)) ≤ (M_Q * S_k) * (1 / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 (mul_nonneg hM0 hSk_nonneg)
      nlinarith
    have hSk_le : S_k ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_Q := by
      have h_at_max : S_k ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * M_Q + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S_k := hSk_step w_k hw_k_mem
      linarith
    have hK_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_Q :=
      fun w hw => le_trans (hw_k_max hw) hSk_le

    have hK1_lo : 7 / 8 ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ := by
      have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
      have hk1 : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_Q := by
        simpa using hK_bnd 1 h1_mem
      have h_tri : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - 1‖ := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by simp
          _ = ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - (sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      linarith

    refine ⟨hK1_lo, fun w hw => ⟨hC_bnd w hw, hK_bnd w hw, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hCD_le : ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ ≤ (2 * M_Q) * |w - 0| := by
        apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        intro v hv
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := huIoc_sub hw hv
        have hCv2 : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖ ≤ 2 := by
          have h1 : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖ ≤ 1 + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1‖ := by
            calc ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖
                = ‖(1 : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ = 1 + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v - 1‖ := by simp
          have h2 := hC_bnd v hv_Icc
          linarith
        calc ‖Q v * sfcaVolterraC Q v‖
            = ‖Q v‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q v‖ := norm_mul _ _
          _ ≤ M_Q * 2 := mul_le_mul (hQbnd v hv_Icc) hCv2 (norm_nonneg _) hM0
          _ = 2 * M_Q := mul_comm _ _
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hw.1] at hCD_le
      nlinarith [hw.2]
    · have hKD_eq : sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w - 1 = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v := by
        simp [sfcaVolterraKDeriv]
      rw [hKD_eq]
      have hKD_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ ≤ (2 * M_Q) * |w - 0| := by
        apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        intro v hv
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := huIoc_sub hw hv
        have hKv2 : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ ≤ 2 := by
          have hv_norm : ‖(v : ℂ)‖ = v := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hv_Icc.1]
          have h1 : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ ≤ v + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ)‖ := by
            calc ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖
                = ‖(v : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ))‖ := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ ‖(v : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ = v + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v - (v : ℂ)‖ := by rw [hv_norm]
          have h2 := hK_bnd v hv_Icc
          linarith [hv_Icc.2]
        calc ‖Q v * sfcaVolterraK Q v‖
            = ‖Q v‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraK Q v‖ := norm_mul _ _
          _ ≤ M_Q * 2 := mul_le_mul (hQbnd v hv_Icc) hKv2 (norm_nonneg _) hM0
          _ = 2 * M_Q := mul_comm _ _
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hw.1] at hKD_le
      nlinarith [hw.2]

  have hLipBounds : ∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (M_diff : ℝ),
      ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      0 ≤ M_diff →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ 2 * M_diff ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ 2 * M_diff := by
    intro Q₁ Q₂ M_diff hQ₁ hQ₂ hQ12 hMd0 hQdiff
    obtain ⟨hC₁_cont, hK₁_cont, _, _, hInt₁, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hOdeLaws Q₁ hQ₁
    obtain ⟨hC₂_cont, hK₂_cont, _, _, hInt₂, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hOdeLaws Q₂ hQ₂
    have hQ2_quant := (hQuantBounds Q₂ (1 / 2) hQ₂ (by norm_num) le_rfl
      (fun v hv => (hQ12 v hv).2)).2
    have hPairLip : ∀ {y₁ y₂ : ℝ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn y₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn y₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₂ v‖ ≤ 3 / 2) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          y₁ w - y₂ w =
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v)) →
        ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖y₁ w - y₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff ∧
          ‖(∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * y₁ v) - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₂ v * y₂ v‖ ≤ 2 * M_diff := by
      intro y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ hy₂_bnd hdiff_eq
      obtain ⟨w_s, hw_s_mem, hw_s_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
        (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hy₁.sub hy₂))
      let S : ℝ := ‖y₁ w_s - y₂ w_s‖
      have hS_nonneg : 0 ≤ S := norm_nonneg _
      have h_prod_bnd : ∀ {B : ℝ}, (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₁ v - y₂ v‖ ≤ B) →
          0 ≤ B → ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            ‖Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        intro B hB hB0 v hv
        have hsplit : Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v =
            Q₁ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v) + (Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₂ v := by ring
        rw [hsplit]
        have h1 : ‖Q₁ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v)‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B := by
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hQ12 v hv).1 (hB v hv) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        have h2 : ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₂ v‖ ≤ M_diff * (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hQdiff v hv) (hy₂_bnd v hv) (norm_nonneg _) hMd0
        have htri := norm_add_le (Q₁ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v)) ((Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₂ v)
        linarith
      have hS_step : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖y₁ w - y₂ w‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        intro w hw
        rw [hdiff_eq w hw]
        let K_c : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * S + (3 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff
        have hKc0 : 0 ≤ K_c := by positivity
        have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
            ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v)‖ ≤ K_c * (w - v) := by
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
          have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hv.1, hv.2.trans hw.2⟩
          have hwv : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = w - v := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)]
          rw [norm_mul, hwv, mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (h_prod_bnd (fun u hu => hw_s_max hu) hS_nonneg v hv_Icc) (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)
        have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => K_c * (w - v)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
        have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae hg_int
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h1
        have hm1 := hMom1 w hw
        dsimp [K_c] at h1
        nlinarith
      have hS_le : S ≤ M_diff := by
        have := hS_step w_s hw_s_mem
        linarith
      have hy_diff : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₁ v - y₂ v‖ ≤ M_diff :=
        fun v hv => le_trans (hw_s_max hv) hS_le
      intro w hw
      refine ⟨hy_diff w hw, ?_⟩
      have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v => Q₁ v * y₁ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        ((hQ₁.mul hy₁).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v => Q₂ v * y₂ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        ((hQ₂.mul hy₂).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint1 hint2]
      have h_int_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v)‖ ≤ (2 * M_diff) * |w - 0| := by
        apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        intro v hv
        have hb := h_prod_bnd hy_diff hMd0 v (huIoc_sub hw hv)
        linarith
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hw.1] at h_int_le
      nlinarith [hw.2]

    have hC2_32 : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      intro v hv
      have h1 : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v‖ ≤ 1 + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v - 1‖ := by
        calc ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v‖
            = ‖(1 : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = 1 + ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v - 1‖ := by simp
      have h2 := (hQ2_quant v hv).1
      linarith
    have hK2_32 : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_norm : ‖(v : ℂ)‖ = v := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hv.1]
      have h1 : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v‖ ≤ v + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v - (v : ℂ)‖ := by
        calc ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v‖
            = ‖(v : ℂ) + (sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v - (v : ℂ))‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖(v : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v - (v : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = v + ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v - (v : ℂ)‖ := by rw [hv_norm]
      have h2 := (hQ2_quant v hv).2.1
      linarith [hv.2]
    have hC_diff_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w =
          ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
            ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₁ v - Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v) := by
      intro w hw
      have h_sub_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₁ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (((h_sub_cont.mul hQ₁).mul hC₁_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (((h_sub_cont.mul hQ₂).mul hC₂_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hsub : sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w =
          (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₁ v) -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraC Q₂ v := by
        linear_combination (hInt₁ w hw).1 - (hInt₂ w hw).1
      rw [hsub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v _ => by ring)
    have hK_diff_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w =
          ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
            ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₁ v - Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v) := by
      intro w hw
      have h_sub_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₁ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (((h_sub_cont.mul hQ₁).mul hK₁_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (((h_sub_cont.mul hQ₂).mul hK₂_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hsub : sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w =
          (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₁ v) -
            ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v := by
        linear_combination (hInt₁ w hw).2 - (hInt₂ w hw).2
      rw [hsub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v _ => by ring)
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hC_lip, hCD_lip⟩ := hPairLip hC₁_cont hC₂_cont hC2_32 hC_diff_eq w hw
    obtain ⟨hK_lip, hKD_lip⟩ := hPairLip hK₁_cont hK₂_cont hK2_32 hK_diff_eq w hw
    have hKD_sub : sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w =
        (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₁ v) -
          ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₂ v * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ v := by
      dsimp [sfcaVolterraKDeriv]
      ring
    exact ⟨hC_lip, hK_lip, hCD_lip, by rwa [hKD_sub]⟩

  have hOdeUnique : ∀ (Q g g' : ℝ → ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g (g' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt g' (Q w * g w) w) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        g w = g 0 * sfcaVolterraC Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraK Q w ∧
        g' w = g 0 * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w := by
    intro Q g g' hQ hQbnd hg hg' hg_deriv
    obtain ⟨hC_cont, hK_cont, hCD_cont, hKD_cont, _, hC0, hCD0, hK0, hKD0, hCK_deriv⟩ :=
      hOdeLaws Q hQ
    let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => g w - (g 0 * sfcaVolterraC Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraK Q w)
    let u' : ℝ → ℂ :=
      fun w => g' w - (g 0 * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w + g' 0 * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w)
    have hu_cont : ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hg.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hC_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hK_cont))
    have hu'_cont : ContinuousOn u' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hg'.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hCD_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hKD_cont))
    have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [u]
      rw [hC0, hK0]
      ring
    have hu'0 : u' 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [u']
      rw [hCD0, hKD0]
      ring
    have hu_d : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt u (u' v) v ∧ HasDerivAt u' (Q v * u v) v := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨hgd, hg'd⟩ := hg_deriv v hv
      obtain ⟨hCd, hCDd, hKd, hKDd⟩ := hCK_deriv v hv
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hgd.sub ((hCd.const_mul (g 0)).add (hKd.const_mul (g' 0)))
      · have hraw := hg'd.sub ((hCDd.const_mul (g 0)).add (hKDd.const_mul (g' 0)))
        convert hraw using 1
        dsimp [u]
        ring
    have hu'_int_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        u' w = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * u v := by
      intro w hw
      have hsub_Icc : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2
      have hsub_Ioo : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hw.2
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
        (hu'_cont.mono hsub_Icc)
        (fun v hv => (hu_d v (hsub_Ioo hv)).2)
        (((hQ.mul hu_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable)
      rw [hu'0, sub_zero] at hftc
      exact hftc.symm
    have hu_int_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        u w = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v := by
      intro w hw
      have hsub_Icc : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2
      have hsub_Ioo : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) w ⊆ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hw.2
      let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => u v + ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * u' v
      have h_sub_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
      have hφ_cont : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) w) :=
        (hu_cont.mono hsub_Icc).add ((h_sub_cont.mono hsub_Icc).mul (hu'_cont.mono hsub_Icc))
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) w,
          HasDerivAt φ (((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v) v := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨hud, hu'd⟩ := hu_d v (hsub_Ioo hv)
        have hwv_d : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-1 : ℂ) v := by
          have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_const v w).sub (hasDerivAt_id v)).ofReal_comp
          simpa using h1
        have hraw := hud.add (hwv_d.mul hu'd)
        convert hraw using 1
        ring
      have h_int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun v => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (((h_sub_cont.mul hQ).mul hu_cont).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
        hφ_cont hφ_deriv h_int
      have hφw : φ w = u w := by simp [φ]
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = 0 := by simp [φ, hu0, hu'0]
      rw [hφw, hφ0, sub_zero] at hftc
      exact hftc.symm
    obtain ⟨w_u, hw_u_mem, hw_u_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hu_cont)
    let S_u : ℝ := ‖u w_u‖
    have hSu_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_u := norm_nonneg _
    have hSu_step : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖u w‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * S_u := by
      intro w hw
      rw [hu_int_eq w hw]
      have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
          ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v‖ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * S_u) * (w - v) := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
        have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hv.1, hv.2.trans hw.2⟩
        have hwv : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = w - v := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)]
        calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v‖
            = (w - v) * (‖Q v‖ * ‖u v‖) := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hwv, mul_assoc]
          _ ≤ (w - v) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * S_u) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2)
              exact mul_le_mul (hQbnd v hv_Icc) (hw_u_max hv_Icc) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * S_u) * (w - v) := mul_comm _ _
      have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * S_u) * (w - v))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
      have h1 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae hg_int
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h1
      have hm1 := hMom1 w hw
      nlinarith
    have hSu_zero : S_u ≤ 0 := by
      have := hSu_step w_u hw_u_mem
      linarith
    have hu_eq_zero : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u v = 0 :=
      fun v hv => norm_le_zero_iff.mp (le_trans (hw_u_max hv) hSu_zero)
    intro w hw
    have huw : u w = 0 := hu_eq_zero w hw
    have hu'w : u' w = 0 := by
      rw [hu'_int_eq w hw]
      have hcongr : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * u v) = ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..w, (0 : ℂ) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v hv => ?_)
        rw [hu_eq_zero v (huIcc_sub hw hv), mul_zero]
      rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
    exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp huw, sub_eq_zero.mp hu'w⟩

  have hParamHolo : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q p.1 p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q q w) Ω) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraC (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraK (Q p.1) p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q p.1) p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q p.1) p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraC (Q q) w) Ω ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraK (Q q) w) Ω ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraCDeriv (Q q) w) Ω ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q q) w) Ω := by
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.snd
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    let e₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := fun u => (u, 0)
            map_add' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp }
        cont := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
    let e₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := fun u => (0, u)
            map_add' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp }
        cont := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id }

    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {L : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ} {q : ℂ × ℂ},
        HasFDerivAt g L q →
        HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (L (1, 0)) q.1 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (L (0, 1)) q.2 ∧
        L = π₁.smulRight (deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1) +
          π₂.smulRight (deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2) := by
      intro g L q hg
      have hemb₁ : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) e₁ q.1 := by
        have h_eq : (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) = (fun u : ℂ => e₁ u + (0, q.2)) := by
          ext u <;> simp [e₁]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact e₁.hasFDerivAt.add_const (0, q.2)
      have hemb₂ : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) e₂ q.2 := by
        have h_eq : (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) = (fun u : ℂ => e₂ u + (q.1, 0)) := by
          ext u <;> simp [e₂]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact e₂.hasFDerivAt.add_const (q.1, 0)
      have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (L (1, 0)) q.1 :=
        (hg.comp q.1 hemb₁).hasDerivAt
      have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (L (0, 1)) q.2 :=
        (hg.comp q.2 hemb₂).hasDerivAt
      refine ⟨hd₁, hd₂, ?_⟩
      rw [hd₁.deriv, hd₂.deriv]
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have hv_eq : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        ext <;> simp
      calc L v = L (v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) := by rw [← hv_eq]
        _ = v.1 • L (1, 0) + v.2 • L (0, 1) := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        _ = (π₁.smulRight (L (1, 0)) + π₂.smulRight (L (0, 1))) v := rfl

    have hCauchy2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r C : ℝ},
        IsOpen U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        0 < r →
        0 ≤ C →
        Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ⊆ U →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r), ‖g x‖ ≤ C) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r, ‖fderiv ℂ g q‖ ≤ 2 * C / r := by
      intro U g q₀ r C hU hg hr hC0 hsub hbnd q hq
      have hq_dist : ‖q - q₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
      have hq_mem : q ∈ U := hsub (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
        (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith))
      have hg_at : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q :=
        (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq_mem)).hasFDerivAt
      obtain ⟨_, _, hL_eq⟩ := hfderiv_decomp hg_at
      have hslice₁_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall q.1 r, (u, q.2) ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) := by
        intro u hu
        have hu_r : ‖u - q.1‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · calc ‖u - q₀.1‖ = ‖(u - q.1) + (q.1 - q₀.1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖u - q.1‖ + ‖q.1 - q₀.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ r + ‖q - q₀‖ := by
                refine add_le_add hu_r ?_
                rw [Prod.norm_def]
                exact le_max_left _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
        · calc ‖q.2 - q₀.2‖ ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
      have hslice₂_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall q.2 r, (q.1, u) ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) := by
        intro u hu
        have hu_r : ‖u - q.2‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · calc ‖q.1 - q₀.1‖ ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
        · calc ‖u - q₀.2‖ = ‖(u - q.2) + (q.2 - q₀.2)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖u - q.2‖ + ‖q.2 - q₀.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ r + ‖q - q₀‖ := by
                refine add_le_add hu_r ?_
                rw [Prod.norm_def]
                exact le_max_right _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
      have hd₁_le : ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ ≤ C / r := by
        have hdiff₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (Metric.closedBall q.1 r) := by
          have hemb_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) := fun u => by
            have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) = (fun z : ℂ => e₁ z + (0, q.2)) := by
              ext z <;> simp [e₁]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact (e₁.hasFDerivAt.add_const (0, q.2)).differentiableAt
          exact hg.comp hemb_diff.differentiableOn (fun u hu => hsub (hslice₁_sub u hu))
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
          (hdiff₁.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl)
          (fun u hu => hbnd (u, q.2) (hslice₁_sub u (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu)))
      have hd₂_le : ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ ≤ C / r := by
        have hdiff₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (Metric.closedBall q.2 r) := by
          have hemb_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) := fun u => by
            have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (q.1, z)) = (fun z : ℂ => e₂ z + (q.1, 0)) := by
              ext z <;> simp [e₂]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact (e₂.hasFDerivAt.add_const (q.1, 0)).differentiableAt
          exact hg.comp hemb_diff.differentiableOn (fun u hu => hsub (hslice₂_sub u hu))
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
          (hdiff₂.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl)
          (fun u hu => hbnd (q.1, u) (hslice₂_sub u (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu)))
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
      have hv₁ : ‖v.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
      have hv₂ : ‖v.2‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
      have hCr0 : 0 ≤ C / r := div_nonneg hC0 hr.le
      calc ‖fderiv ℂ g q v‖
          = ‖v.1 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1 +
              v.2 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := by
            rw [hL_eq]
            rfl
        _ ≤ ‖v.1 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ +
              ‖v.2 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖v.1‖ * ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ +
              ‖v.2‖ * ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (C / r) + ‖v‖ * (C / r) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hv₁ hd₁_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul hv₂ hd₂_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = (2 * C / r) * ‖v‖ := by ring

    have hMaster : ∀ {Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ},
        IsOpen Ω →
        ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => F q v) Ω) →
        ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..p.2, F p.1 v)
          (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F q v) Ω) := by
      intro Ω F hΩ hF_cont hF_holo
      have hJointCont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..p.2, F p.1 v)
          (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
        let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => max 0 (min 1 t)
        have hclamp_cont : Continuous clamp :=
          continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
        have hclamp_mem : ∀ t : ℝ, clamp t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
          fun t => ⟨le_max_left 0 _, max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 t)⟩
        have hclamp_id : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, clamp t = t := by
          intro t ht
          dsimp [clamp]
          rw [min_eq_right ht.2, max_eq_right ht.1]
        let f_cl : ↥Ω → ℝ → ℂ := fun q t => F q.1 (clamp t)
        have h_uncurry : Continuous (Function.uncurry f_cl) := by
          have hφ_cont : Continuous (fun x : ↥Ω × ℝ => (x.1.1, clamp x.2)) :=
            (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (hclamp_cont.comp continuous_snd)
          exact hF_cont.comp_continuous hφ_cont (fun x => ⟨x.1.2, hclamp_mem x.2⟩)
        have hprim_cl : Continuous (fun x : ↥Ω × ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..x.2, f_cl x.1 v) :=
          intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_primitive_of_continuous h_uncurry
        have hcl_on : ContinuousOn
            (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..p.2, F p.1 (clamp v))
            (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
          let ψ : ↥(Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → ↥Ω × ℝ :=
            fun x => (⟨x.1.1, x.2.1⟩, x.1.2)
          have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ :=
            ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _).prodMk
              (continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val)
          exact hprim_cl.comp hψ_cont
        refine hcl_on.congr (fun p hp => ?_)
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun v hv => ?_)
        rw [hclamp_id v (huIcc_sub hp.2 hv)]
      refine ⟨hJointCont, fun w hw q₀ hq₀ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ q₀ hq₀
      let r : ℝ := R₀ / 3
      have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
      have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Ω := by
        refine Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball ?_) hball_R₀
        dsimp [r]
        linarith
      have hball_sub : Metric.ball q₀ r ⊆ Ω :=
        Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))) hcb_sub
      let K : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
      have hK_sub : K ⊆ Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.prod_mono_left hcb_sub
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall q₀ (2 * r)).prod isCompact_Icc
      have hK_ne : K.Nonempty :=
        ⟨(q₀, 0), Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity), left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one⟩
      obtain ⟨p_max, _, hp_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hF_cont.mono hK_sub))
      let C : ℝ := ‖F p_max.1 p_max.2‖
      have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := norm_nonneg _
      have hFbnd : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r), ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖F q v‖ ≤ C :=
        fun q hq v hv => hp_max (show (q, v) ∈ K from ⟨hq, hv⟩)
      have hFq_cont : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ContinuousOn (F q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        fun q hq => hF_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
          (fun v hv => ⟨hq, hv⟩)
      let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun q v => fderiv ℂ (fun q' => F q' v) q
      have hF'q₀_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' q₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 w)) := by
        let δ : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        have hδ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := fun n => by positivity
        have hδ_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < r := by
          intro n
          have hden : (1 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          exact div_lt_self hr hden
        have hδ_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, δ n ≠ 0 :=
          fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hδ_pos n).ne'
        have hδ_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖δ n‖ < r := by
          intro n
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hδ_pos n)]
          exact hδ_lt n
        have hδ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
          have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / ((n : ℝ) + 2))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 2)
                Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
              tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
            simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop h_atTop
          have h_c : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            have h := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
            rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at h
            exact h
          exact tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ h_c
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hδ_ne)
        have hq₁_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, (q₀.1 + δ n, q₀.2) ∈ Ω := by
          intro n
          apply hball_sub
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
          simp [hδ_norm n]
        have hq₂_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, (q₀.1, q₀.2 + δ n) ∈ Ω := by
          intro n
          apply hball_sub
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
          simp [hδ_norm n]
        let dq₁ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n v => (δ n)⁻¹ * (F (q₀.1 + δ n, q₀.2) v - F q₀ v)
        let dq₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n v => (δ n)⁻¹ * (F (q₀.1, q₀.2 + δ n) v - F q₀ v)
        let L_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun n v =>
          ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁ (dq₁ n v) +
            ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂ (dq₂ n v)
        have hL_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (L_seq n)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 w)) := by
          intro n
          have hdq₁_c : ContinuousOn (dq₁ n) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            continuousOn_const.mul ((hFq_cont _ (hq₁_mem n)).sub (hFq_cont q₀ hq₀))
          have hdq₂_c : ContinuousOn (dq₂ n) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            continuousOn_const.mul ((hFq_cont _ (hq₂_mem n)).sub (hFq_cont q₀ hq₀))
          have hL_c : ContinuousOn (L_seq n) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁).continuous.comp_continuousOn
              hdq₁_c).add
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂).continuous.comp_continuousOn
              hdq₂_c)
          exact (hL_c.mono (huIoc_sub hw)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
        have hL_lim : ∀ᵐ v ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 w)),
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => L_seq n v) Filter.atTop (nhds (F' q₀ v)) := by
          filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with v hv
          have hv_Icc : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := huIoc_sub hw hv
          have hg_at : HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q v) (F' q₀ v) q₀ :=
            ((hF_holo v hv_Icc).differentiableAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hq₀)).hasFDerivAt
          obtain ⟨hd₁, hd₂, hL_eq⟩ := hfderiv_decomp hg_at
          rw [hd₁.deriv, hd₂.deriv] at hL_eq
          have ht₁ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dq₁ n v) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (F' q₀ v (1, 0))) :=
            (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hd₁).comp hδ_tendsto
          have ht₂ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dq₂ n v) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (F' q₀ v (0, 1))) :=
            (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hd₂).comp hδ_tendsto
          rw [hL_eq]
          exact (((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁).continuous.tendsto _).comp
            ht₁).add
            (((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂).continuous.tendsto _).comp ht₂)
        exact aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hL_meas hL_lim
      have hFDeriv : HasFDerivAt (fun q => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F q v)
          (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F' q₀ v) q₀ := by
        apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
          (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := Metric.ball q₀ r) (bound := fun _ => 2 * C / r)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds q₀ hr)
        · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds q₀ hr] with q hq
          exact ((hFq_cont q (hball_sub hq)).mono (huIoc_sub hw)).aestronglyMeasurable
            measurableSet_uIoc
        · exact ((hFq_cont q₀ hq₀).mono (huIcc_sub hw)).intervalIntegrable
        · exact hF'q₀_meas
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv q hq => ?_)
          exact hCauchy2D hΩ (hF_holo v (huIoc_sub hw hv)) hr hC0 hcb_sub
            (fun x hx => hFbnd x hx v (huIoc_sub hw hv)) q hq
        · exact intervalIntegrable_const
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv q hq => ?_)
          exact ((hF_holo v (huIoc_sub hw hv)).differentiableAt
            (hΩ.mem_nhds (hball_sub hq))).hasFDerivAt
      exact hFDeriv.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    intro Ω Q hΩ hQ_cont hQ_holo
    have hQ_1d : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ContinuousOn (Q q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      fun q hq => hQ_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
        (fun v hv => ⟨hq, hv⟩)
    have hParamPicard : ∀ {y₀ : ℝ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn y₀ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₀ w‖ ≤ 1) →
        ContinuousOn
          (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q p.1) m p.2)
          (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m w) Ω) := by
      intro y₀ hy₀_cont hy₀_bnd
      have hIterReg : ∀ m : ℕ,
          ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q p.1) m p.2)
            (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m w) Ω) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
          refine ⟨hy₀_cont.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.2),
            fun w _ => differentiableOn_const (y₀ w)⟩
        | succ m ih =>
          rcases ih with ⟨ih_cont, ih_holo⟩
          let F₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q v => Q q v * sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m v
          let F₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q v => (v : ℂ) * F₁ q v
          have hF₁_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => F₁ p.1 p.2)
              (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ_cont.mul ih_cont
          have hF₁_holo : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => F₁ q v) Ω :=
            fun v hv => (hQ_holo v hv).mul (ih_holo v hv)
          have hF₂_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => F₂ p.1 p.2)
              (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn.mul hF₁_cont
          have hF₂_holo : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => F₂ q v) Ω :=
            fun v hv => (hF₁_holo v hv).const_mul (v : ℂ)
          obtain ⟨hJ₁_cont, hJ₁_holo⟩ := hMaster hΩ hF₁_cont hF₁_holo
          obtain ⟨hJ₂_cont, hJ₂_holo⟩ := hMaster hΩ hF₂_cont hF₂_holo
          have h_split_pt : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
              sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) (m + 1) w =
                (w : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F₁ q v) - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F₂ q v := by
            intro q hq w hw
            have hF₁_1d : ContinuousOn (F₁ q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              hF₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
                (fun v hv => ⟨hq, hv⟩)
            simpa only [sfcaVolterraIter, F₁, F₂, mul_assoc] using hKernel_split hF₁_1d w hw
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · refine (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn.mul
              hJ₁_cont).sub hJ₂_cont).congr (fun p hp => h_split_pt p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2)
          · intro w hw
            exact (((hJ₁_holo w hw).const_mul (w : ℂ)).sub (hJ₂_holo w hw)).congr
              (fun q hq => h_split_pt q hq w hw)
      have hLocalBall : ∀ q₀ ∈ Ω, ∃ r M : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
          Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Ω ∧
          ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r), ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            ‖sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m w‖ ≤ M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
        intro q₀ hq₀
        obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ q₀ hq₀
        let r : ℝ := R₀ / 3
        have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
        have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Ω := by
          refine Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball ?_) hball_R₀
          dsimp [r]
          linarith
        let K : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
        have hK_comp : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall q₀ (2 * r)).prod isCompact_Icc
        have hK_ne : K.Nonempty :=
          ⟨(q₀, 0), Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity), left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one⟩
        obtain ⟨p_max, _, hp_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne
          (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hQ_cont.mono (Set.prod_mono_left hcb_sub)))
        let M : ℝ := ‖Q p_max.1 p_max.2‖
        refine ⟨r, M, hr, norm_nonneg _, hcb_sub, fun m q hq w hw => ?_⟩
        exact (((hPicard1D (hQ_1d q (hcb_sub hq)) (norm_nonneg _)
          (fun v hv => hp_max (show (q, v) ∈ K from ⟨hq, hv⟩)) hy₀_cont hy₀_bnd).1 m).2 w hw).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro p₀ hp₀
        obtain ⟨r, M, hr, _, hcb_sub, hIterBnd⟩ := hLocalBall p₀.1 hp₀.1
        let U_loc : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ) := Metric.ball p₀.1 (2 * r) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
        have hU_sub : U_loc ⊆ Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
          Set.prod_mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb_sub)
        have hp₀_mem : p₀ ∈ U_loc := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity), hp₀.2⟩

            (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q p.1) m p.2) U_loc :=
          continuousOn_tsum (fun m => (hIterReg m).1.mono hU_sub)
            (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M)
            (fun m p hp => hIterBnd m p.1 (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hp.1) p.2 hp.2)
        refine (h_on_U p₀ hp₀_mem).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin ?_
        rw [mem_nhdsWithin_iff_exists_mem_nhds_inter]
        refine ⟨Metric.ball p₀.1 (2 * r) ×ˢ Set.univ,
          prod_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀.1 (by positivity)) Filter.univ_mem, ?_⟩

        exact ⟨hp.1.1, hp.2.2⟩
      · intro w hw q₀ hq₀
        obtain ⟨r, M, hr, _, hcb_sub, hIterBnd⟩ := hLocalBall q₀ hq₀
        have hball_sub : Metric.ball q₀ r ⊆ Ω :=
          Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans
            (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))) hcb_sub
        let f_part : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ :=
          fun N q => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m w
        let L_term : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
          fun m q => fderiv ℂ (fun q' => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q') m w) q
        let f'_part : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
          fun N q => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, L_term m q
        have hL_bnd : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r,
            ‖L_term m q‖ ≤ (2 / r) * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) := by
          intro m q hq
          have h1 := hCauchy2D hΩ ((hIterReg m).2 w hw) hr (by positivity) hcb_sub

          simpa only [L_term, mul_div_assoc, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using
            (by linarith [show 2 * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) / r =

              ‖fderiv ℂ (fun q' => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q') m w) q‖ ≤
                (2 / r) * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)))
        have hUnif : TendstoUniformlyOn f'_part (fun q => ∑' m : ℕ, L_term m q)
            Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ r) :=
          tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M).mul_left (2 / r))
            hL_bnd
        have hPartDeriv : ∀ (N : ℕ), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r,
            HasFDerivAt (f_part N) (f'_part N q) q := by
          intro N q hq
          have hf_eq : f_part N =
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (fun q' => sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q') m w) := by
            ext q'
            simp [f_part]
          rw [hf_eq]
          exact HasFDerivAt.sum (fun m _ =>
            (((hIterReg m).2 w hw).differentiableAt
              (hΩ.mem_nhds (hball_sub hq))).hasFDerivAt)
        have hPtConv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r,
            Filter.Tendsto (fun N => f_part N q) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (∑' m : ℕ, sfcaVolterraIter y₀ (Q q) m w)) := by

              (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)) hq

            Summable.of_norm_bounded (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M)
              (fun m => hIterBnd m q hq_cb w hw)
          exact hsum_q.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
        have hFD := hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn isOpen_ball hUnif hPartDeriv hPtConv
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
        exact hFD.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    have hy₀_C_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := fun _ _ => by simp
    have hy₀_K_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(w : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hw.1]

    obtain ⟨hC_pcont, hC_pholo⟩ := hParamPicard continuousOn_const hy₀_C_bnd
    obtain ⟨hK_pcont, hK_pholo⟩ :=
      hParamPicard Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hy₀_K_bnd
    change ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraC (Q p.1) p.2)
      (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) at hC_pcont
    change ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraK (Q p.1) p.2)
      (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) at hK_pcont
    change ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraC (Q q) w) Ω at hC_pholo
    change ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraK (Q q) w) Ω at hK_pholo
    obtain ⟨hCD_pcont, hCD_pholo⟩ := hMaster hΩ (hQ_cont.mul hC_pcont)
      (fun v hv => (hQ_holo v hv).mul (hC_pholo v hv))
    obtain ⟨hKD_int_cont, hKD_int_holo⟩ := hMaster hΩ (hQ_cont.mul hK_pcont)
      (fun v hv => (hQ_holo v hv).mul (hK_pholo v hv))
    have hKD_pcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q p.1) p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := continuousOn_const.add hKD_int_cont
    have hKD_pholo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraKDeriv (Q q) w) Ω :=
      fun w hw => (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).add (hKD_int_holo w hw)
    exact ⟨hC_pcont, hK_pcont, hCD_pcont, hKD_pcont,
      fun w hw => ⟨hC_pholo w hw, hK_pholo w hw, hCD_pholo w hw, hKD_pholo w hw⟩⟩

  exact
    { ode_laws := hOdeLaws
      zero_pot := hZeroPot
      quant_bounds := hQuantBounds
      lip_bounds := hLipBounds
      ode_unique := hOdeUnique
      rev_symm := hRevSymm
      param_holo := hParamHolo }
