      fun p hp => hSeg_mem p.1.1 p.1.2 hp.1.1 hp.1.2.1 p.2 hp.2
    exact (((continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst).pow 2).continuousOn).mul
      (S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp hψ_cont.continuousOn hψ_maps)
  have hQ₀_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q₀ q w) Ω := by
    intro w hw
    have h_lin : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 + (w : ℂ) * q.2) Ω :=
      differentiableOn_fst.add
        ((differentiableOn_const (w : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ Ω).mul differentiableOn_snd)
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 + (w : ℂ) * q.2) Ω (horizStrip S.H) :=
      fun q hq => hSeg_mem q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2.1 w hw
    exact (differentiableOn_snd.pow 2).mul (S.q_holo.comp h_lin h_maps)
  obtain ⟨hC0_cont, hK0_cont, hCD0_cont, hKD0_cont, hVolt0_holo⟩ :=
    hVolt.param_holo Ω Q₀ hOpen hQ₀_joint_cont hQ₀_holo
  have h1_icc : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
  have hC0_1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraC (Q₀ q) 1) Ω :=
    (hVolt0_holo 1 h1_icc).1
  have hK0_1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraK (Q₀ q) 1) Ω :=
    (hVolt0_holo 1 h1_icc).2.1
  have hK0_1_ne : ∀ q ∈ Ω, sfcaVolterraK (Q₀ q) 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq hzero
    have hlo := (hEndpoint q hq).1
    dsimp [Q₀] at hzero
    rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hlo
    linarith
  have hConst_holo : ∀ c : ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) Ω :=
    fun c => differentiableOn_const c
  have hDiv_holo : ∀ (f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω → DifferentiableOn ℂ g Ω → (∀ q ∈ Ω, g q ≠ 0) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f q / g q) Ω := by
    intro f g hf hg hne
    have h_eq : (fun q => f q / g q) = fun q => f q * (g q)⁻¹ := by
      ext q
      exact div_eq_mul_inv (f q) (g q)
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hf.mul fun q hq => (hg q hq).fun_inv (hne q hq)
  have hNumN_holo : ∀ z₀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁) Ω := by
    intro z₀ z₁ hz₀ hz₁
    have hA1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaSlopeA1 (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁) Ω :=
      hDiv_holo _ _ ((hConst_holo z₁).sub ((hConst_holo z₀).mul hC0_1_holo)) hK0_1_holo hK0_1_ne
    have hA1_pull_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaSlopeA1 (Q₀ p.1) z₀ z₁)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hA1_holo.continuousOn.comp continuousOn_fst fun p hp => hp.1
    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaFieldF (Q₀ p.1) z₀ z₁ p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hC0_cont).add (hA1_pull_cont.mul hK0_cont)
    have hFD_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => sfcaFieldFDeriv (Q₀ p.1) z₀ z₁ p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hCD0_cont).add (hA1_pull_cont.mul hKD0_cont)
    have hF_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaFieldF (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁ w) Ω := fun w hw =>
      ((hConst_holo z₀).mul (hVolt0_holo w hw).1).add
        (hA1_holo.mul (hVolt0_holo w hw).2.1)
    have hFD_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaFieldFDeriv (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁ w) Ω := fun w hw =>
      ((hConst_holo z₀).mul (hVolt0_holo w hw).2.2.1).add
        (hA1_holo.mul (hVolt0_holo w hw).2.2.2)
    let Q_plus : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q w => sfcaPotPlus (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁ w
    let Q_minus : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q w => sfcaPotMinus (Q₀ q) z₀ z₁ w
    have hQp_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q_plus p.1 p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hQ₀_joint_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hFD_cont)).sub
        (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont.pow 2))
    have hQm_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q_minus p.1 p.2)
        (Ω ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hQ₀_joint_cont.add (continuousOn_const.mul hFD_cont)).sub
        (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont.pow 2))
    have hQp_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_plus q w) Ω :=
      fun w hw =>
        ((hQ₀_holo w hw).sub ((hConst_holo _).mul (hFD_holo w hw))).sub
          ((hConst_holo _).mul ((hF_holo w hw).pow 2))
    have hQm_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Q_minus q w) Ω :=
      fun w hw =>
        ((hQ₀_holo w hw).add ((hConst_holo _).mul (hFD_holo w hw))).sub
          ((hConst_holo _).mul ((hF_holo w hw).pow 2))
    have hKp_1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraK (Q_plus q) 1) Ω :=
      ((hVolt.param_holo Ω Q_plus hOpen hQp_cont hQp_holo).2.2.2.2 1 h1_icc).2.1
    have hKm_1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => sfcaVolterraK (Q_minus q) 1) Ω :=
      ((hVolt.param_holo Ω Q_minus hOpen hQm_cont hQm_holo).2.2.2.2 1 h1_icc).2.1
    let ζ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
      sfcaVolterraK (Q_plus q) 1 * sfcaVolterraK (Q_minus q) 1 /
        (sfcaVolterraK (Q₀ q) 1) ^ 2
    have hζ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ζ Ω :=
      hDiv_holo _ _ (hKp_1_holo.mul hKm_1_holo) (hK0_1_holo.pow 2)
        (fun q hq => pow_ne_zero 2 (hK0_1_ne q hq))
    have hζ_slit : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ζ q ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
      intro q hq
      have hQ_rhoB : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₀ q w‖ < sfcaRhoB :=
        fun w hw => lt_trans (hq.2.2.2.2 w hw) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB])
      have hre :=
        ((hUniv.div_and_slit (Q₀ q) (hPot_cont q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2.1) hQ_rhoB).2 z₀ z₁ hz₀ hz₁).1
      exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by dsimp [ζ, Q_plus, Q_minus]; linarith))
    have hLog_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.log (ζ q)) Ω :=
      fun q hq => (Complex.differentiableAt_log (hζ_slit q hq)).comp_differentiableWithinAt
        q (hζ_holo q hq)
    have hExp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (ζ q))) Ω :=
      Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn ((hConst_holo _).mul hLog_holo)
    exact hK0_1_holo.mul ((hConst_holo 1).sub hExp_holo)
  
  have hHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sfcaStripPhi S) Ω := by
    let z_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ
    have hz_c_cont : Continuous z_c := continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC
    have hz_c_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖z_c θ‖ = 1 / 32 := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [z_c]
      rw [norm_circleMap_zero]
      norm_num [sfcaRhoC]
    have hz_c_rhoB : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖z_c θ‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
      intro θ
      rw [hz_c_norm θ]
      norm_num [sfcaRhoB]
    have hb₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b₀_fn Ω :=
      differentiableOn_snd.mul (S.f_holo.comp differentiableOn_fst fun q hq => hq.1)
    have hb₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b₁_fn Ω :=
      (hb₀_holo.mul hC0_1_holo).add
        (((differentiableOn_snd.pow 2).mul
          (hDerivF_holo.comp differentiableOn_fst fun q hq => hq.1)).mul hK0_1_holo)
    let G : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun q θ₀ θ₁ =>
      sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁) /
        ((z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q))
    have hDen_bounds : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ,
        1 / 64 ≤ ‖z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q‖ ∧ 1 / 64 ≤ ‖z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q‖ ∧
        (z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q) ≠ 0 := by
      intro q hq θ₀ θ₁
      obtain ⟨_, hb₀_lt, hb₁_lt, _⟩ := hEndpoint q hq
      have h0 : 1 / 64 ≤ ‖z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q‖ := by
        have hsub := norm_sub_norm_le (z_c θ₀) (b₀_fn q)
        rw [hz_c_norm θ₀] at hsub
        linarith
      have h1 : 1 / 64 ≤ ‖z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q‖ := by
        have hsub := norm_sub_norm_le (z_c θ₁) (b₁_fn q)
        rw [hz_c_norm θ₁] at hsub
        linarith
      have hne0 : z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        rw [hz, norm_zero] at h0
        linarith
      have hne1 : z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        rw [hz, norm_zero] at h1
        linarith
      exact ⟨h0, h1, mul_ne_zero hne0 hne1⟩
    have hG_bound : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, ‖G q θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ 12288 := by
      intro q hq θ₀ θ₁
      obtain ⟨h0, h1, _⟩ := hDen_bounds q hq θ₀ θ₁
      have hQ_rhoB : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₀ q w‖ < sfcaRhoB :=
        fun w hw => lt_trans (hq.2.2.2.2 w hw) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB])
      have hNum_le : ‖sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁)‖ ≤ 3 :=
        ((hUniv.div_and_slit (Q₀ q) (hPot_cont q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2.1) hQ_rhoB).2
          (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁) (hz_c_rhoB θ₀) (hz_c_rhoB θ₁)).2.2
      have hDen_ge : (1 / 4096 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q)‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        calc (1 / 4096 : ℝ) = (1 / 64) * (1 / 64) := by norm_num
          _ ≤ ‖z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q‖ * ‖z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q‖ :=
              mul_le_mul h0 h1 (by positivity) (le_trans (by positivity) h0)
      have hDen_pos : 0 < ‖(z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q)‖ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hDen_ge
      dsimp [G]
      rw [norm_div, div_le_iff₀ hDen_pos]
      calc ‖sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁)‖
          ≤ 3 := hNum_le
        _ = 12288 * (1 / 4096) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 12288 * ‖(z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDen_ge (by positivity)
    have hG_holo : ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G q θ₀ θ₁) Ω := by
      intro θ₀ θ₁
      have hNum := hNumN_holo (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁) (hz_c_rhoB θ₀) (hz_c_rhoB θ₁)
      have hDen : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => (z_c θ₀ - b₀_fn q) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁_fn q)) Ω :=
        ((hConst_holo (z_c θ₀)).sub hb₀_holo).mul
          ((hConst_holo (z_c θ₁)).sub hb₁_holo)
      exact hDiv_holo _ _ hNum hDen fun q hq => (hDen_bounds q hq θ₀ θ₁).2.2
    have hPair_cont_helper : ∀ (N_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        ContinuousOn N_fn (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB) →
        Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => N_fn (z_c p.1, z_c p.2)) := by
      intro N_fn hN
      exact hN.comp_continuous
        ((hz_c_cont.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (hz_c_cont.comp continuous_snd))
        fun p => ⟨mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (hz_c_rhoB p.1), mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (hz_c_rhoB p.2)⟩
    have hG_uncurry : ∀ q ∈ Ω, Continuous (Function.uncurry (G q)) := by
      intro q hq
      have hQ_rhoB : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₀ q w‖ < sfcaRhoB :=
        fun w hw => lt_trans (hq.2.2.2.2 w hw) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB])
      have hNum_ball : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) z.1 z.2)
          (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB) :=
        (hUniv.div_and_slit (Q₀ q) (hPot_cont q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2.1) hQ_rhoB).1.continuousOn
      have hNum_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) (z_c p.1) (z_c p.2)) :=
        hPair_cont_helper (fun z => sfcaNumN (Q₀ q) z.1 z.2) hNum_ball
      have hDen_cont : Continuous
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (z_c p.1 - b₀_fn q) * (z_c p.2 - b₁_fn q)) :=
        (((hz_c_cont.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const).mul
          ((hz_c_cont.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const))
      exact hNum_cont.div hDen_cont fun p => (hDen_bounds q hq p.1 p.2).2.2
    have hDoubleInt : ∀ (G_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
        (∀ q ∈ Ω, Continuous (Function.uncurry (G_fn q))) →
        (∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G_fn q θ₀ θ₁) Ω) →
        (∀ q ∈ Ω, ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, ‖G_fn q θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ 12288) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_fn q θ₀ θ₁)) Ω := by
      intro G_fn hG_unc hG_h hG_b
      let H_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q θ₀ =>
        ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_fn q θ₀ θ₁
      have hSlice_cont : ∀ q ∈ Ω, ∀ θ₀ : ℝ, Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => G_fn q θ₀ θ₁) := by
        intro q hq θ₀
        have h_pair : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => (θ₀, θ₁)) :=
          continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id'
        exact (hG_unc q hq).comp h_pair
      have hInner : ∀ θ₀ : ℝ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => H_int q θ₀) Ω ∧
          (∀ q ∈ Ω, ‖H_int q θ₀‖ ≤ 12288 * |2 * Real.pi - 0|) := fun θ₀ =>
        hParamInt 0 (2 * Real.pi) 12288 (by norm_num) (fun q θ₁ => G_fn q θ₀ θ₁)
          (fun q hq => hSlice_cont q hq θ₀)
          (fun θ₁ => hG_h θ₀ θ₁)
          (fun q hq θ₁ => hG_b q hq θ₀ θ₁)
      have hH_cont : ∀ q ∈ Ω, Continuous (H_int q) := fun q hq =>
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          (hG_unc q hq) 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      exact (hParamInt 0 (2 * Real.pi) (12288 * |2 * Real.pi - 0|) (by positivity) H_int
        hH_cont
        (fun θ₀ => (hInner θ₀).1)
        (fun q hq θ₀ => (hInner θ₀).2 q hq)).1
    have hOuter := hDoubleInt G hG_uncurry hG_holo hG_bound
    let Phi_int : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
      (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G q θ₀ θ₁)
    have hPhi_int_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Phi_int Ω :=
      (hConst_holo _).mul hOuter
    refine hPhi_int_holo.congr fun q hq => ?_
    obtain ⟨_, hb₀_lt, hb₁_lt, _⟩ := hEndpoint q hq
    have hQ_rhoB : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₀ q w‖ < sfcaRhoB :=
      fun w hw => lt_trans (hq.2.2.2.2 w hw) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB])
    exact hUniv.double_circle_eq (Q₀ q) (b₀_fn q) (b₁_fn q)
      (hPot_cont q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2.1) hQ_rhoB
      (lt_trans hb₀_lt (by norm_num [sfcaRhoC]))
      (lt_trans hb₁_lt (by norm_num [sfcaRhoC]))
  exact ⟨hOpen, hHolo, hRev⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hVolt : SfcaVolterraKernelProp)
    (hUniv : SfcaUniversalChordProp)
    (hOpen : IsOpen (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL))
    (hHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sfcaStripPhi S) (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL)) :
    ∀ H₁ : ℝ, 0 < H₁ → H₁ < S.H →
      ∃ r_sub : ℝ, 0 < r_sub ∧ r_sub < S.r_star ∧
        ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
          (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (t ≠ 0 →
            let s_m := S.𝔰 (y - t, t)
            let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
            let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
            let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
            let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
            (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
            (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
            ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
            ‖J_p - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
            deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_0 J' t) J_p -
              t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s' J_p t) s_0 =
              deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_m J' t) J_m)

proof.tactics:
by

  (∫ ξ in u..v, S.c / (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re ^ 2) -
    Real.sqrt (((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0).re - (S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0).re) ^ 2 +

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)

subgoal_signatures.name: real_collar_stationary_action_recurrence
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hOpen : IsOpen (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL))
    (hHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sfcaStripPhi S) (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL))
    (hGeom : ∀ u v : ℝ, u < v →
      ((u : ℂ), ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL →
      ((S.c * (v - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        sfcaStripPhi S ((u : ℂ), ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u v : ℂ)) :
    ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < S.r_star →
      (S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)),
        S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) - S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) ∈
          smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL →
      (S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)),
        S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) - S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) ∈
          smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL →
      let s_m := S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))
      let s_0 := S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))
      let s_p := S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))
      let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / (t : ℂ)
      let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / (t : ℂ)
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_0 J' (t : ℂ)) J_p -
        (t : ℂ) * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s' J_p (t : ℂ)) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_m J' (t : ℂ)) J_m

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :
    ∀ H₁ : ℝ, 0 < H₁ → H₁ < S.H →
      ∃ (r_sub : ℝ) (J_m_tilde J_p_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_sub ∧ r_sub < S.r_star ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_m_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_p_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
          (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          t * J_m_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y, t) - S.𝔰 (y - t, t) ∧
          t * J_p_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - S.𝔰 (y, t) ∧
          (S.𝔰 (y - t, t), t * J_m_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
          (S.𝔰 (y, t), t * J_p_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
          ‖J_m_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          ‖J_p_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16

              intro q hq
              have hin0 := (hMeshPt_strip z hz_s _ (h_poly_in q hq).2.1).1
              have hinp := (hMeshPt_strip (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) hzp_s _ (h_poly_in q hq).2.2).1
              have hinm := (hMeshPt_strip (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) hzm_s _ (h_poly_in q hq).1).1
              have hb1 := (S.normAction_bound _ _ hin0 hinp).1
              have hb2 := (S.normAction_bound _ _ hinm hin0).2.1
              have ht₀_inv3 : ‖((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 3‖ = (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 := by
                rw [norm_pow, norm_inv, ht₀_norm]
              dsimp [ψ, sqmcStencil]
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, ht₀_inv3]
              have hdu_hi := (hu_props z hz_s).2.1
              have hsum_act : ‖normAction1_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u z (q.1 * q_0 + q.2 * v_0))
                  (sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) (q.1 * q_p + q.2 * v_p)) +
                normAction2_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) (q.1 * q_m + q.2 * v_m))
                  (sqmcMeshPt u z (q.1 * q_0 + q.2 * v_0))‖ ≤ 2 * S.M_act := by
                have htri := norm_add_le
                  (normAction1_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u z (q.1 * q_0 + q.2 * v_0))
                    (sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) (q.1 * q_p + q.2 * v_p)))
                  (normAction2_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) (q.1 * q_m + q.2 * v_m))
                    (sqmcMeshPt u z (q.1 * q_0 + q.2 * v_0)))
                linarith
              calc
                (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * ‖deriv u z‖ * _
                    ≤ (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * (5 / 4) * (2 * S.M_act) := by
                      refine mul_le_mul ?_ hsum_act (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
                      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdu_hi (by positivity)
                _ = M_G := by dsimp [M_G]; ring
            let h_dψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => ψ (lam, ζ)) 0
            have hh_dψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_dψ B_half := by
              have hpt := S.partial_t_holo W_poly ψ hW_poly_open hψ_holo
              have hsl : Differentiable ℂ (fun lam : ℂ => (lam, (0 : ℂ))) :=
                differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)
              have hc := hpt.comp hsl.differentiableOn
                (fun lam hlam => ⟨hlam, Metric.mem_ball_self hR_half_pos⟩)
              exact hc
            have hh_dψ_bnd : ∀ lam ∈ B_half, ‖h_dψ lam‖ ≤ 4 * M_G / R₀ := by
              intro lam hlam
              have hζ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => ψ (lam, ζ)) B_half := by
                have hc := hψ_holo.comp
                  ((differentiable_const lam).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
                  (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hlam, hζ⟩)
                exact hc
              have hmaps_ζ : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : ℂ => ψ (lam, ζ)) B_half
                  (Metric.closedBall (ψ (lam, 0)) (2 * M_G)) := by
                intro ζ hζ
                rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
                have h1 := hψ_bnd (lam, ζ) ⟨hlam, hζ⟩
                have h2 := hψ_bnd (lam, 0) ⟨hlam, Metric.mem_ball_self hR_half_pos⟩
                have htri := norm_sub_le (ψ (lam, ζ)) (ψ (lam, 0))
                linarith
              have hd := Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hζ_holo hmaps_ζ
                (Metric.mem_ball_self hR_half_pos)
              rw [dslope_same] at hd
              have hdiv : 2 * M_G / (R₀ / 2) = 4 * M_G / R₀ := by ring
              rwa [hdiv] at hd
            let g_lam : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => h_dψ lam - h_dψ 0
            have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_lam B_half :=
              hh_dψ_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)
            have h0_B : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B_half := Metric.mem_ball_self hR_half_pos
            have hmaps_g : Set.MapsTo g_lam B_half
                (Metric.closedBall (g_lam 0) (8 * M_G / R₀)) := by
              intro lam hlam
              rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
              have hsub_eq : g_lam lam - g_lam 0 = h_dψ lam - h_dψ 0 := by simp [g_lam]
              rw [hsub_eq]
              have htri := norm_sub_le (h_dψ lam) (h_dψ 0)
              have h1 := hh_dψ_bnd lam hlam
              have h2 := hh_dψ_bnd 0 h0_B
              have h8 : 4 * M_G / R₀ + 4 * M_G / R₀ = 8 * M_G / R₀ := by ring
              linarith
            have hrp_mem : (r_p : ℂ) ∈ B_half := by
              rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hrp_c_norm]
              linarith
            have hd_g := Complex.norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hg_holo hmaps_g hrp_mem
            have hsmul := sub_smul_dslope g_lam 0 (r_p : ℂ)
            simp only [sub_zero, g_lam, sub_self] at hsmul
            have hh_dψ_0 : h_dψ 0 = sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p := by
              have hfn : (fun ζ : ℂ => ψ (0, ζ)) =
                  fun ζ : ℂ => sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (ζ * v_m) (ζ * v_0) (ζ * v_p) := by
                ext ζ
                simp [ψ]
              dsimp [h_dψ]
              rw [hfn]
              exact (hStencil_deriv0 z hz_s v_m v_0 v_p).deriv
            have hh_dψ_rp : h_dψ (r_p : ℂ) =
                deriv (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                  sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (p_m + ζ * v_m) (p_0 + ζ * v_0) (p_p + ζ * v_p)) 0 := by
              have hqm_eq : (r_p : ℂ) * q_m = p_m := mul_div_cancel₀ p_m hrp_c_ne
              have hq0_eq : (r_p : ℂ) * q_0 = p_0 := mul_div_cancel₀ p_0 hrp_c_ne
              have hqp_eq : (r_p : ℂ) * q_p = p_p := mul_div_cancel₀ p_p hrp_c_ne
              have hfn : (fun ζ : ℂ => ψ ((r_p : ℂ), ζ)) =
                  fun ζ : ℂ =>
                    sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (p_m + ζ * v_m) (p_0 + ζ * v_0) (p_p + ζ * v_p) := by
                ext ζ
                simp [ψ, hqm_eq, hq0_eq, hqp_eq]
              dsimp [h_dψ]
              rw [hfn]
            have htarget_eq : deriv (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                  sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (p_m + ζ * v_m) (p_0 + ζ * v_0) (p_p + ζ * v_p)) 0 -
                sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p =
                (r_p : ℂ) • dslope (fun lam => h_dψ lam - h_dψ 0) 0 (r_p : ℂ) := by
              rw [← hh_dψ_rp, ← hh_dψ_0, hsmul]
            rw [htarget_eq, norm_smul, hrp_c_norm]
            calc
              r_p * ‖dslope (fun lam => h_dψ lam - h_dψ 0) 0 (r_p : ℂ)‖
                  ≤ r * ((8 * M_G / R₀) / (R₀ / 2)) :=
                    mul_le_mul hrp_le hd_g (norm_nonneg _) hr0
              _ = C_hess * (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * r := by
                  dsimp [C_hess, M_G]
                  ring
        let η : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ =>
          sqmcRem B U t₀ z (w_m + τ * v_m) (w_0 + τ * v_0) (w_p + τ * v_p)
        let K : Set ℂ := segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) (δ_w : ℂ)
        have hK_seg : ∀ τ ∈ K,
            ‖w_m + τ * v_m‖ ≤ r ∧ ‖w_0 + τ * v_0‖ ≤ r ∧ ‖w_p + τ * v_p‖ ≤ r := by
          intro τ hτ
          rcases hτ with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
          have htau_eq : a • (0 : ℂ) + b • (δ_w : ℂ) = (b : ℂ) * (δ_w : ℂ) := by
            simp [Complex.real_smul]
          rw [htau_eq]
          have ha_norm : ‖(a : ℂ)‖ = a := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha]
          have hb_norm : ‖(b : ℂ)‖ = b := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          have hab_c : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
          have hconv_m : w_m + ((b : ℂ) * (δ_w : ℂ)) * v_m =
              (a : ℂ) * w_m + (b : ℂ) * w_m' := by
            have h1 : (δ_w : ℂ) * v_m = w_m' - w_m := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne
            have ha_eq : (a : ℂ) = 1 - (b : ℂ) := eq_sub_of_add_eq hab_c
            rw [mul_assoc, h1, ha_eq]
            ring
          have hconv_0 : w_0 + ((b : ℂ) * (δ_w : ℂ)) * v_0 =
              (a : ℂ) * w_0 + (b : ℂ) * w_0' := by
            have h1 : (δ_w : ℂ) * v_0 = w_0' - w_0 := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne
            have ha_eq : (a : ℂ) = 1 - (b : ℂ) := eq_sub_of_add_eq hab_c
            rw [mul_assoc, h1, ha_eq]
            ring
          have hconv_p : w_p + ((b : ℂ) * (δ_w : ℂ)) * v_p =
              (a : ℂ) * w_p + (b : ℂ) * w_p' := by
            have h1 : (δ_w : ℂ) * v_p = w_p' - w_p := mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne
            have ha_eq : (a : ℂ) = 1 - (b : ℂ) := eq_sub_of_add_eq hab_c
            rw [mul_assoc, h1, ha_eq]
            ring
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hconv_m]
            calc
              ‖(a : ℂ) * w_m + (b : ℂ) * w_m'‖ ≤ a * ‖w_m‖ + b * ‖w_m'‖ := by
                have htri := norm_add_le ((a : ℂ) * w_m) ((b : ℂ) * w_m')
                rwa [norm_mul, norm_mul, ha_norm, hb_norm] at htri
              _ ≤ a * r + b * r := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwm ha)
                                              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwm' hb)
              _ = (a + b) * r := by ring
              _ = r := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          · rw [hconv_0]
            calc
              ‖(a : ℂ) * w_0 + (b : ℂ) * w_0'‖ ≤ a * ‖w_0‖ + b * ‖w_0'‖ := by
                have htri := norm_add_le ((a : ℂ) * w_0) ((b : ℂ) * w_0')
                rwa [norm_mul, norm_mul, ha_norm, hb_norm] at htri
              _ ≤ a * r + b * r := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0 ha)
                                              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0' hb)
              _ = (a + b) * r := by ring
              _ = r := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          · rw [hconv_p]
            calc
              ‖(a : ℂ) * w_p + (b : ℂ) * w_p'‖ ≤ a * ‖w_p‖ + b * ‖w_p'‖ := by
                have htri := norm_add_le ((a : ℂ) * w_p) ((b : ℂ) * w_p')
                rwa [norm_mul, norm_mul, ha_norm, hb_norm] at htri
              _ ≤ a * r + b * r := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwp ha)
                                              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwp' hb)
              _ = (a + b) * r := by ring
              _ = r := by rw [hab, one_mul]
        have hη_shift : ∀ τ ζ : ℂ,
            η (τ + ζ) =
              sqmcStencil B u t₀ z ((w_m + τ * v_m) + ζ * v_m)
                ((w_0 + τ * v_0) + ζ * v_0) ((w_p + τ * v_p) + ζ * v_p) -
              (sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 + sqmcLinear B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p +
                τ * sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p) -
              ζ * sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p := by
          intro τ ζ
          have ha_m : w_m + (τ + ζ) * v_m = (w_m + τ * v_m) + ζ * v_m := by ring
          have ha_0 : w_0 + (τ + ζ) * v_0 = (w_0 + τ * v_0) + ζ * v_0 := by ring
          have ha_p : w_p + (τ + ζ) * v_p = (w_p + τ * v_p) + ζ * v_p := by ring
          dsimp [η, sqmcRem, sqmcLinear, u]
          rw [ha_m, ha_0, ha_p]
          ring
        have hη_hasDeriv : ∀ τ ∈ K,
            HasDerivAt η
              (deriv (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                sqmcStencil B u t₀ z ((w_m + τ * v_m) + ζ * v_m)
                  ((w_0 + τ * v_0) + ζ * v_0) ((w_p + τ * v_p) + ζ * v_p)) 0 -
               sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p) τ := by
          intro τ hτ
          obtain ⟨hd0_p, _⟩ := h_dir_diff (w_m + τ * v_m) (w_0 + τ * v_0) (w_p + τ * v_p)
            (hK_seg τ hτ).1 (hK_seg τ hτ).2.1 (hK_seg τ hτ).2.2
          let g_sub : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w - τ
          have h_sub_τ : HasDerivAt g_sub 1 τ := by
            simpa [g_sub] using (hasDerivAt_id τ).sub_const τ
          have hd_sub : HasDerivAt
              (fun ζ : ℂ => η (τ + ζ))
              (deriv (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                sqmcStencil B u t₀ z ((w_m + τ * v_m) + ζ * v_m)
                  ((w_0 + τ * v_0) + ζ * v_0) ((w_p + τ * v_p) + ζ * v_p)) 0 -
               sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p) (g_sub τ) := by
            have hg0 : g_sub τ = 0 := sub_self τ
            rw [hg0]
            have h1 := (hd0_p.hasDerivAt.sub_const
              (sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 + sqmcLinear B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p +
                τ * sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p)).sub
              (by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).mul_const (sqmcLinear B U t₀ z v_m v_0 v_p))
            exact h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ζ => (hη_shift τ ζ))
          have hcomp := (hd_sub.comp τ h_sub_τ).congr_of_eventuallyEq
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w : ℂ => show η w = η (τ + g_sub w) by simp [g_sub])
          simpa [mul_one] using hcomp
        have hη_diff : ∀ τ ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℂ η τ :=
          fun τ hτ => (hη_hasDeriv τ hτ).differentiableAt
        have hη_deriv_le : ∀ τ ∈ K, ‖deriv η τ‖ ≤ C_hess * (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * r := by
          intro τ hτ
          rw [(hη_hasDeriv τ hτ).deriv]
          exact (h_dir_diff (w_m + τ * v_m) (w_0 + τ * v_0) (w_p + τ * v_p)
            (hK_seg τ hτ).1 (hK_seg τ hτ).2.1 (hK_seg τ hτ).2.2).2
        have hmv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hη_diff hη_deriv_le
          (convex_segment (0 : ℂ) (δ_w : ℂ))
          (left_mem_segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) (δ_w : ℂ))
          (right_mem_segment ℝ (0 : ℂ) (δ_w : ℂ))
        have hη0 : η 0 = sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p := by simp [η]
        have hη_end : η (δ_w : ℂ) = sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m' w_0' w_p' := by
          dsimp [η]
          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hδw_c_ne]
          simp
        rw [hη0, hη_end, sub_zero, hδw_c_norm] at hmv
        have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_hess * (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * r := by
          dsimp [C_hess]
          positivity [S.M_act_pos]
        exact le_trans hmv (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδw_le hC_nonneg)
  
  
  
  have hLim : SqmcContractionProp := by
    intro σ r M₀ q Φ hσ hM₀ hr hPin hZero hLip hHolo hSymm
    have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by linarith
    have hstrip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip σ) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hstrip_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro y hy
      change |(y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im| < σ
      have him : (y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im = y.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      exact hy
    have hstrip_conj : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, starRingEnd ℂ y ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro y hy
      change |(starRingEnd ℂ y).im| < σ
      rw [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
      exact hy
    let ξ_it : ℕ → ℂ → ℕ → ℂ := sqmcPicardIter q Φ
    have h_zero_pin : IsSqmcPinned q r (fun _ => 0) := by
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => ?_⟩
      simp [hr_nonneg]
    have h_it_pin : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_it n y) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro y _
        exact h_zero_pin
      | succ n ih =>
        intro y hy
        have hpin_n := ih y hy
        obtain ⟨h0, hq_z, hout⟩ := hPin y hy (ξ_it n y) hpin_n
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, h0]
        · simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, hq_z]
        · intro k hk
          have hnk : ¬ (k ≤ q) := not_le.mpr hk
          simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, hnk]
        · intro k hk
          simp only [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, hk, ↓reduceIte]
          have hdiff_zero : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ q → ‖ξ_it n y m - (0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ r := by
            intro m hm
            rw [sub_zero]
            exact hpin_n.2.2.2 m hm
          have hlip0 := hLip y hy (ξ_it n y) (fun _ => 0) r hpin_n h_zero_pin hr_nonneg hdiff_zero k hk
          have hz0 := hZero y hy k hk
          have htri : ‖Φ y (ξ_it n y) k‖ ≤
              ‖Φ y (fun _ => 0) k‖ + ‖Φ y (ξ_it n y) k - Φ y (fun _ => 0) k‖ := by
            have heq : Φ y (ξ_it n y) k =
                Φ y (fun _ => 0) k + (Φ y (ξ_it n y) k - Φ y (fun _ => 0) k) := by ring
            nth_rw 1 [heq]
            exact norm_add_le _ _
          linarith
    have h_it_eq_Φ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ,
        ξ_it (n + 1) y k = Φ y (ξ_it n y) k := by
      intro n y hy k
      by_cases hk : k ≤ q
      · simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, hk]
      · have hqk : q < k := lt_of_not_ge hk
        have hout := (hPin y hy (ξ_it n y) (h_it_pin n y hy)).2.2 k hqk
        simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter, hk, hout]
    have h_it_step : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        ‖ξ_it (n + 1) y k - ξ_it n y k‖ ≤ M₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro y hy k hk
        rw [h_it_eq_Φ 0 y hy k]
        change ‖Φ y (fun _ => 0) k - 0‖ ≤ M₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 0
        simpa using hZero y hy k hk
      | succ n ih =>
        intro y hy k hk
        rw [h_it_eq_Φ (n + 1) y hy k, h_it_eq_Φ n y hy k]
        have hlip_n := hLip y hy (ξ_it (n + 1) y) (ξ_it n y) (M₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
          (h_it_pin (n + 1) y hy) (h_it_pin n y hy) (by positivity)
          (fun m hm => ih y hy m hm) k hk
        calc
          ‖Φ y (ξ_it (n + 1) y) k - Φ y (ξ_it n y) k‖
              ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (M₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) := hlip_n
          _ = M₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    have h_it_holo : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => ξ_it n y k) (horizStrip σ) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro _ _
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
      | succ n ih =>
        intro k hk
        exact (hHolo (ξ_it n) (h_it_pin n) ih k hk).congr fun y hy => h_it_eq_Φ n y hy k
    have h_it_symm : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        ξ_it n (y + 2 * Real.pi) k = ξ_it n y k ∧
        ξ_it n (starRingEnd ℂ y) k = starRingEnd ℂ (ξ_it n y k) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro _ _ _ _
        exact ⟨rfl, by simp [ξ_it, sqmcPicardIter]⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        intro y hy k hk
        have hper_y := hstrip_per y hy
        have hconj_y := hstrip_conj y hy
        obtain ⟨hp, hc⟩ := hSymm (ξ_it n) (h_it_pin n) ih y hy k hk
        rw [h_it_eq_Φ n (y + 2 * Real.pi) hper_y k, h_it_eq_Φ n y hy k,
            h_it_eq_Φ n (starRingEnd ℂ y) hconj_y k]

        have hξ_b := (hξ_pin y hy).2.2.2 j hj
        calc
          ‖deriv u (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))‖ * ‖ξ_lim y j‖
              ≤ (5 / 4) * r_ξ := mul_le_mul hdu_hi hξ_b (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
          _ = 60 * Q ^ 2 * ε := by dsimp [r_ξ]; ring
          _ ≤ C_mesh * Q ^ B_mesh * ε := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (le_of_lt hε0)
              exact mul_le_mul hC_mesh_60 hQ2_le_Q7 (by positivity) (by linarith)
  · intro j hj1 y hy
    have hy_s : y ∈ horizStrip s := lt_of_lt_of_le hy hsδ_le
    have hinv_zero : sqmcFluxInv q t₀ (a_y y) (F_mesh y (ξ_lim y)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      ext k
      have hfix_k := hξ_fix y hy k
      dsimp [Φ] at hfix_k
      by_cases hk : k ≤ q
      · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at hfix_k
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by linear_combination -hfix_k)
      · have hout := (hF_pin_rinv (a_y y) (F_mesh y (ξ_lim y)) (ha_bnd_Y1 y hy)).1.2.2 k
          (lt_of_not_ge hk)
        exact hout
    have hrinv := (hF_pin_rinv (a_y y) (F_mesh y (ξ_lim y)) (ha_bnd_Y1 y hy)).2.1 j hj1
    rw [hinv_zero] at hrinv
    have hop_zero : sqmcFluxOp t₀ (a_y y) (fun _ => 0) (j + 1) = 0 := by
      simp [sqmcFluxOp]
    have hFm_zero : F_mesh y (ξ_lim y) (j + 1) = 0 := by
      rw [← hrinv, hop_zero]
    simp only [F_mesh, sqmcForcing, hj1, ↓reduceIte, sqmcStencil] at hFm_zero
    set z : ℂ := y + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)
    have hz_s : z ∈ horizStrip s := hz_shift_mem s y hy_s (j + 1)
    have hdu_z_ne : deriv u z ≠ 0 := by
      have hlo := (hu_props z hz_s).1
      exact norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
    have hpref_ne : ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 3 * deriv u z ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 3 (inv_ne_zero ht₀_c_ne)) hdu_z_ne
    have hact_zero :
        normAction1_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u z (ξ_lim y (j + 1)))
          (sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) (ξ_lim y (j + 2))) +
        normAction2_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) (ξ_lim y j))
          (sqmcMeshPt u z (ξ_lim y (j + 1))) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hFm_zero).resolve_left hpref_ne
    have hj_le : j ≤ q := by omega
    have hj1_le : j + 1 ≤ q := by omega
    have hj2_le : j + 2 ≤ q := by omega
    have hXj : X_mesh j y = sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) (ξ_lim y j) := by
      simp only [X_mesh, hj_le, ↓reduceIte]
      have hsh : y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = z - (t₀ : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [z]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hsh]
    have hXj1 : X_mesh (j + 1) y = sqmcMeshPt u z (ξ_lim y (j + 1)) := by
      simp [X_mesh, hj1_le, z]
    have hXj2 : X_mesh (j + 2) y = sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) (ξ_lim y (j + 2)) := by
      simp only [X_mesh, hj2_le, ↓reduceIte]
      have hsh : y + ((j + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = z + (t₀ : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [z]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hsh]
    rw [hXj, hXj1, hXj2]
    exact hact_zero

stationary_q_mesh_contraction.definitions:
noncomputable def sqmcFluxOp (t₀ : ℝ) (a ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
      ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        (a (j + 1) * (ξ (j + 2) - ξ (j + 1)) - a j * (ξ (j + 1) - ξ j))

noncomputable def sqmcFluxCumSum (t₀ : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (t₀ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, F (i + 1)

noncomputable def sqmcFluxInit (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ) (a F : ℕ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -(∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a j)⁻¹ * sqmcFluxCumSum t₀ F j) /
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a j)⁻¹)

noncomputable def sqmcFluxInv (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ) (a F : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if k ≤ q then
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k,
      (a j)⁻¹ * (sqmcFluxInit q t₀ a F + sqmcFluxCumSum t₀ F j)
  else 0

def SqmcFluxInvProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) (t₀ : ℝ), 2 ≤ q → t₀ ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (a F : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F 0 = 0 ∧
       sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F q = 0 ∧
       (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k = 0)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
        sqmcFluxOp t₀ a (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F) (j + 1) = F (j + 1)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ,
        sqmcFluxInv q t₀
          (fun j => starRingEnd ℂ (a j))
          (fun i => starRingEnd ℂ (F i)) k =
          starRingEnd ℂ (sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k))) ∧
    (∀ (a ξ : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      ξ 0 = 0 → ξ q = 0 → (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → ξ k = 0) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a (sqmcFluxOp t₀ a ξ) k = ξ k) ∧
    (∀ (a F₁ F₂ : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ),
      sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a (fun i => F₁ i - F₂ i) k =
        sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F₁ k - sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F₂ k) ∧
    (∀ (a F : ℕ → ℂ) (M_F : ℝ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      0 ≤ M_F →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ‖F (j + 1)‖ ≤ M_F) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ‖sqmcFluxInv q t₀ a F k‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_F) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set ℂ) (a_y F_y : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => a_y y j) W) →
      (∀ y ∈ W, ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ‖4 * a_y y j - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => F_y y (j + 1)) W) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => sqmcFluxInv q t₀ (a_y y) (F_y y) k) W)

noncomputable def sqmcMeshPt (u : ℂ → ℂ) (z w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  u z + deriv u z * w

noncomputable def sqmcStencil {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (u : ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 3 * deriv u z *
    (normAction1_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u z w_0) (sqmcMeshPt u (z + (t₀ : ℂ)) w_p) +
     normAction2_ℂ B (sqmcMeshPt u (z - (t₀ : ℂ)) w_m) (sqmcMeshPt u z w_0))

noncomputable def sqmcPotential {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
  deriv (fun w : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) z -
    (deriv (deriv u) z / deriv u z) * glancingResidualOp B U (z, (t₀ : ℂ))

noncomputable def sqmcLinear {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
    (glancingLinCoeff B U (z + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * (w_p - w_0) -
     glancingLinCoeff B U (z - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * (w_0 - w_m)) +
  sqmcPotential B U t₀ z * w_0

noncomputable def sqmcRem {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (z w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
  sqmcStencil B u t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p -
    sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 -
    sqmcLinear B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p

noncomputable def sqmcForcing {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (q : ℕ) (u : ℂ → ℂ) (t₀ : ℝ) (y : ℂ) (ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
      if j + 1 < q then
        sqmcStencil B u t₀ (y + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))
          (ξ j) (ξ (j + 1)) (ξ (j + 2))
      else 0

def SqmcStencilProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s d δ ε t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → 0 < t₀ → t₀ < d →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
    let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
    let R₀ : ℝ := B.s₀ / 4
    let C_hess : ℝ := 40 * S.M_act / R₀ ^ 2
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip s) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv u) (horizStrip s) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip s,
      3 / 4 ≤ ‖deriv u w‖ ∧
      ‖deriv u w‖ ≤ 5 / 4 ∧
      u (w + 2 * Real.pi) = u w + 2 * Real.pi ∧
      deriv u (w + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv u w ∧
      u (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (u w) ∧
      deriv u (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv u w)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ => glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) (horizStrip s) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip s,
      glancingLinCoeff B U (w + 2 * Real.pi, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
        glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ w, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
    (∀ (σ' : ℝ) (w_m w_0 w_p : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ' → σ' ≤ s →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_m (horizStrip σ') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_0 (horizStrip σ') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w_p (horizStrip σ') →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖w_m z‖ ≤ R₀ ∧ ‖w_0 z‖ ≤ R₀ ∧ ‖w_p z‖ ≤ R₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => sqmcStencil B u t₀ z (w_m z) (w_0 z) (w_p z))
        (horizStrip σ')) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip s, ∀ wm w0 wp : ℂ,
      ‖wm‖ ≤ R₀ → ‖w0‖ ≤ R₀ → ‖wp‖ ≤ R₀ →
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ (z + 2 * Real.pi) wm w0 wp =
        sqmcStencil B u t₀ z wm w0 wp ∧
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ (starRingEnd ℂ z)
        (starRingEnd ℂ wm) (starRingEnd ℂ w0) (starRingEnd ℂ wp) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (sqmcStencil B u t₀ z wm w0 wp)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (s - δ),
      sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0 = glancingResidualOp B U (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∧
      ‖sqmcStencil B u t₀ z 0 0 0‖ ≤ ε ∧
      ‖sqmcPotential B U t₀ z‖ ≤ (2 * δ⁻¹ + 1) * ε ∧
      sqmcRem B U t₀ z 0 0 0 = 0) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip (s - δ), ∀ (r M_Δ : ℝ) (w_m w_0 w_p w_m' w_0' w_p' : ℂ),
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ R₀ / 4 → 0 ≤ M_Δ →
      ‖w_m‖ ≤ r → ‖w_0‖ ≤ r → ‖w_p‖ ≤ r →
      ‖w_m'‖ ≤ r → ‖w_0'‖ ≤ r → ‖w_p'‖ ≤ r →
      ‖w_m' - w_m‖ ≤ M_Δ → ‖w_0' - w_0‖ ≤ M_Δ → ‖w_p' - w_p‖ ≤ M_Δ →
      ‖sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m' w_0' w_p' -
         sqmcRem B U t₀ z w_m w_0 w_p‖ ≤
        C_hess * (t₀⁻¹) ^ 3 * r * M_Δ)

def IsSqmcPinned (q : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ξ 0 = 0 ∧ ξ q = 0 ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, q < k → ξ k = 0) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖ξ k‖ ≤ r)

noncomputable def sqmcPicardIter (q : ℕ) (Φ : ℂ → (ℕ → ℂ) → (ℕ → ℂ)) :
    ℕ → ℂ → ℕ → ℂ
  | 0, _, _ => 0
  | n + 1, y, k => if k ≤ q then Φ y (sqmcPicardIter q Φ n y) k else 0

def SqmcContractionProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (σ r M₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (Φ : ℂ → (ℕ → ℂ) → (ℕ → ℂ)),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M₀ → 2 * M₀ ≤ r →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ ξ : ℕ → ℂ, IsSqmcPinned q r ξ →
      Φ y ξ 0 = 0 ∧ Φ y ξ q = 0 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, q < k → Φ y ξ k = 0) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖Φ y (fun _ => 0) k‖ ≤ M₀) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ (ξ₁ ξ₂ : ℕ → ℂ) (M_Δ : ℝ),
      IsSqmcPinned q r ξ₁ → IsSqmcPinned q r ξ₂ → 0 ≤ M_Δ →
      (∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ q → ‖ξ₁ m - ξ₂ m‖ ≤ M_Δ) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → ‖Φ y ξ₁ k - Φ y ξ₂ k‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * M_Δ) →
    (∀ ξ_fn : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_fn y)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => ξ_fn y k) (horizStrip σ)) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => Φ y (ξ_fn y) k) (horizStrip σ)) →
    (∀ ξ_fn : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_fn y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        ξ_fn (y + 2 * Real.pi) k = ξ_fn y k ∧
        ξ_fn (starRingEnd ℂ y) k = starRingEnd ℂ (ξ_fn y k)) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ q →
        Φ (y + 2 * Real.pi) (ξ_fn (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k = Φ y (ξ_fn y) k ∧
        Φ (starRingEnd ℂ y) (ξ_fn (starRingEnd ℂ y)) k = starRingEnd ℂ (Φ y (ξ_fn y) k)) →
    ∃ ξ_lim : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, IsSqmcPinned q r (ξ_lim y)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => ξ_lim y k) (horizStrip σ)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ,
        ξ_lim (y + 2 * Real.pi) k = ξ_lim y k ∧
        ξ_lim (starRingEnd ℂ y) k = starRingEnd ℂ (ξ_lim y k)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ k : ℕ, Φ y (ξ_lim y) k = ξ_lim y k)

proof.tactics:
by
  let C_slice : ℝ := max 40 (80 / S.η_adm)
  let B_slice : ℕ := 2
  have hC_slice_ge40 : (40 : ℝ) ≤ C_slice := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_slice_ge_adm : 80 / S.η_adm ≤ C_slice := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨C_slice, B_slice, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro s d δ η_mesh N l q U X_mesh
    hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hη0 hN hU
    hl hq hqN hCop ht₀_lt hX_mesh Q hSmall
  set t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
  set η_slice : ℝ := C_slice * Q ^ B_slice * η_mesh
  
  have hOpenStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hConvStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < H
    have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    have h1 : |z₁.im| < H := hz₁
    have h2 : |z₂.im| < H := hz₂
    have htri : |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im| ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb] at htri
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp at hab; subst hab; linarith
    · have haH : a * |z₁.im| < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 ha_pos
      have hbH : b * |z₂.im| ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.le hb
      have hsum : a * H + b * H = H := by
        calc a * H + b * H = (a + b) * H := by ring
          _ = H := by rw [hab, one_mul]
      linarith
  have hStripMono : ∀ {H₁ H₂ : ℝ}, H₁ ≤ H₂ → horizStrip H₁ ⊆ horizStrip H₂ :=
    fun hle _ hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hz hle
  have hRealMemStrip : ∀ {H : ℝ}, 0 < H → ∀ r : ℝ, (r : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H hH r
    change |(r : ℂ).im| < H
    simp [hH]
  have hShiftPiStrip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im| < H
    have him : (z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im = z.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    exact hz
  have hConjMemStrip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < H
    rw [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
    exact hz
  have hOfRealEq_of_conj : ∀ w : ℂ, starRingEnd ℂ w = w → ((w.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = w := by
    intro w hw
    have him : (starRingEnd ℂ w).im = w.im := congrArg Complex.im hw
    rw [Complex.conj_im] at him
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp
    · simp; linarith
  
  have hs5_pos : 0 < s - 5 * δ := by linarith
  have hs4_pos : 0 < s - 4 * δ := by linarith
  have hs3_pos : 0 < s - 3 * δ := by linarith
  have hs2_pos : 0 < s - 2 * δ := by linarith
  have hs1_pos : 0 < s - δ := by linarith
  have hq_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hl_ge1_R : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (l : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
  have hpi_gt3 : (3 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := by positivity
  have ht₀_lt_d : t₀ < d := by linarith
  have ht₀_lt_d_act : t₀ < S.d_act := lt_of_lt_of_le ht₀_lt_d hd_act
  have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t₀ := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
  have hδ_inv_pos : 0 < δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hδ0
  have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  have h1_add_δ_le_Q : 1 + δ⁻¹ ≤ Q := by dsimp [Q]; linarith

          have h_eq : (1 - 4 * w) + 4 * w = (1 : ℂ) := by ring
          rw [h_eq, norm_one]
        have h3 : ‖(1 - 4 * w) + 4 * w‖ ≤ ‖1 - 4 * w‖ + ‖4 * w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        have h4 : ‖1 - 4 * w‖ = ‖4 * w - 1‖ := norm_sub_rev _ _
        have h5 : ‖4 * w‖ = 4 * ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_mul]; norm_num
        linarith
      have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
      have hinv_norm : ‖w⁻¹‖ ≤ 16 / 3 := by
        rw [norm_inv]
        have hinv : ‖w‖⁻¹ ≤ (3 / 16 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hw_norm
        norm_num at hinv
        exact hinv
      have hinv_close : ‖w⁻¹ - 4‖ ≤ 4 / 3 := by
        have hfac : w⁻¹ - 4 = (1 - 4 * w) * w⁻¹ := by field_simp [hw_ne]
        rw [hfac, norm_mul, norm_sub_rev]
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (4 * w - 1), norm_nonneg w⁻¹]
      have hinv_re : 8 / 3 ≤ (w⁻¹).re := by
        have habs : |(w⁻¹ - 4).re| ≤ 4 / 3 :=
          le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w⁻¹ - 4)) hinv_close
        have hsub : (w⁻¹ - 4).re = (w⁻¹).re - 4 := by simp
        rw [hsub] at habs
        linarith [(abs_le.mp habs).1]
      exact ⟨hw_ne, hinv_norm, hinv_re⟩
    let D_a : ℂ → ℂ := PiOp a_inv
    have hDa_props : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, 8 / 3 ≤ ‖D_a y‖ ∧ D_a y ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hre : 8 / 3 ≤ (D_a y).re := by
        dsimp [D_a, PiOp]
        have hq_inv : ((q : ℂ)⁻¹ : ℂ) = (((q : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
        rw [hq_inv, Complex.re_ofReal_mul, Complex.re_sum]
        have hsum : (q : ℝ) * (8 / 3 : ℝ) ≤
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a_inv (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))).re := by
          calc
            (q : ℝ) * (8 / 3 : ℝ) = ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, (8 / 3 : ℝ) := by
              simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a_inv (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))).re :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => (ha_inv_props _ (hStrip_jt y j hy)).2.2)
        calc
          (8 / 3 : ℝ) = (q : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((q : ℝ) * (8 / 3 : ℝ)) := by field_simp [hq_R_ne]
          _ ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, (a_inv (y + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))).re :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hq_pos))
      have hnorm : 8 / 3 ≤ ‖D_a y‖ := le_trans hre (Complex.re_le_norm (D_a y))
      exact ⟨hnorm, norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)⟩
    
    let h₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => -KOp E_dot y
    let c₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => -PiOp (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) y * (D_a y)⁻¹
    let ϕ₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => a_inv y * (h₀ y + c₀ y)
    let z : ℂ → ℂ := KOp ϕ₁
    have ha_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ a_inv (horizStrip σ) :=
      ha_holo.inv (fun y hy => (ha_inv_props y hy).1)
    have ha_inv_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, a_inv (y + 2 * Real.pi) = a_inv y :=
      fun y hy => congrArg Inv.inv (ha_pb y hy).1
    have hh₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₀ (horizStrip σ) := (hK_holo E_dot hE_holo).neg
    have hh₀_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, h₀ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = h₀ y :=
      fun y hy => congrArg Neg.neg (hK_per E_dot (fun u hu => (hE_pb u hu).1) y hy)
    have hDa_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_a (horizStrip σ) := hPi_holo a_inv ha_inv_holo
    have hDa_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, D_a (y + 2 * Real.pi) = D_a y :=
      hPi_per a_inv ha_inv_per
    have hah_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
        a_inv (y + 2 * Real.pi) * h₀ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = a_inv y * h₀ y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [ha_inv_per y hy, hh₀_per y hy]
    have hc₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ c₀ (horizStrip σ) :=
      (hPi_holo (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) (ha_inv_holo.mul hh₀_holo)).neg.mul
        (hDa_holo.inv (fun y hy => (hDa_props y hy).2))
    have hc₀_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, c₀ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = c₀ y := by
      intro y hy
      dsimp [c₀]
      rw [hPi_per (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) hah_per y hy, hDa_per y hy]
    have hϕ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ₁ (horizStrip σ) :=
      ha_inv_holo.mul (hh₀_holo.add hc₀_holo)
    have hϕ₁_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ϕ₁ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ₁ y := by
      intro y hy
      dsimp [ϕ₁]
      rw [ha_inv_per y hy, hh₀_per y hy, hc₀_per y hy]
    have hz_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip σ) := hK_holo ϕ₁ hϕ₁_holo
    have hz_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y := hK_per ϕ₁ hϕ₁_per
    
    let B_h : ℝ := (q : ℝ) * t₀ * M_dot
    have hBh_nn : 0 ≤ B_h := by dsimp [B_h]; positivity
    have hh₀_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖h₀ y‖ ≤ B_h := by
      intro y hy
      dsimp [h₀, B_h]
      rw [norm_neg]
      exact hK_bound E_dot M_dot hM_dot (fun u hu => (hE_pb u hu).2) y hy
    have hc₀_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖c₀ y‖ ≤ 2 * B_h := by
      intro y hy
      have hah_b : ∀ u ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖a_inv u * h₀ u‖ ≤ (16 / 3 : ℝ) * B_h := by
        intro u hu
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (ha_inv_props u hu).2.1 (hh₀_bound u hu) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have hnum : ‖PiOp (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) y‖ ≤ (16 / 3 : ℝ) * B_h :=
        hPi_bound (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) ((16 / 3 : ℝ) * B_h) (by positivity) hah_b y hy
      have hden : ‖(D_a y)⁻¹‖ ≤ 3 / 8 := by
        rw [norm_inv]
        have hinv := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) (hDa_props y hy).1
        norm_num at hinv
        exact hinv
      dsimp [c₀]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg]
      calc
        ‖PiOp (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) y‖ * ‖(D_a y)⁻¹‖
            ≤ ((16 / 3 : ℝ) * B_h) * (3 / 8 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul hnum hden (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * B_h := by ring
    have hϕ₁_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖ϕ₁ y‖ ≤ 16 * B_h := by
      intro y hy
      dsimp [ϕ₁]
      rw [norm_mul]
      have hsum : ‖h₀ y + c₀ y‖ ≤ 3 * B_h := by
        calc
          ‖h₀ y + c₀ y‖ ≤ ‖h₀ y‖ + ‖c₀ y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ B_h + 2 * B_h := add_le_add (hh₀_bound y hy) (hc₀_bound y hy)
          _ = 3 * B_h := by ring
      calc
        ‖a_inv y‖ * ‖h₀ y + c₀ y‖ ≤ (16 / 3 : ℝ) * (3 * B_h) :=
          mul_le_mul (ha_inv_props y hy).2.1 hsum (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 16 * B_h := by ring
    have hz_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖z y‖ ≤ 24 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot := by
      intro y hy
      have hk := hK_bound ϕ₁ (16 * B_h) (by positivity) hϕ₁_bound y hy
      have h16 : (q : ℝ) * t₀ * (16 * B_h) = 16 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot := by
        dsimp [B_h]; ring
      rw [h16] at hk
      have hnn : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot := by positivity
      linarith
    
    have hc₀_shift : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, c₀ (w + (t₀ : ℂ)) = c₀ w := by
      intro w hw
      dsimp [c₀, D_a]
      rw [hPi_shift (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) hah_per w hw,
          hPi_shift a_inv ha_inv_per w hw]
    have hc₀_shift_nat : ∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ,
        c₀ (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) = c₀ w := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro w _; simp
      | succ j ihj =>
        intro w hw
        have hstep : w + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) =
            (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) + (t₀ : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hstep, hc₀_shift _ (hStrip_jt w j hw), ihj w hw]
    have hPi_ϕ₁ : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, PiOp ϕ₁ w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have hdecomp : PiOp ϕ₁ w = PiOp (fun u => a_inv u * h₀ u) w + D_a w * c₀ w := by
        dsimp [PiOp, D_a, ϕ₁]
        have hsum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
              a_inv (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) *
                (h₀ (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) + c₀ (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)))) =
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
              a_inv (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) * h₀ (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))) +
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, a_inv (w + (j : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))) * c₀ w := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
          rw [hc₀_shift_nat j w hw, mul_add]
        rw [hsum]
        ring
      rw [hdecomp]
      dsimp [c₀]
      have hDa_ne : D_a w ≠ 0 := (hDa_props w hw).2
      field_simp [hDa_ne]
      ring
    have hpsi_eq : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ,
        a_star w * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) = h₀ w + c₀ w := by
      intro w hw
      have hdz : glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) = ϕ₁ w := by
        rw [hK_diff ϕ₁ hϕ₁_holo hϕ₁_per w hw, hPi_ϕ₁ w hw, sub_zero]
      rw [hdz]
      dsimp [ϕ₁, a_inv]
      have ha_ne : a_star w ≠ 0 := (ha_inv_props w hw).1
      field_simp [ha_ne]
    refine ⟨z, hz_holo, hz_per, hz_bound, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have houter_congr :
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun p => a_star p.1 * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) =
        glancingDiffOp (fun p => h₀ p.1 + c₀ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
      unfold glancingDiffOp
      dsimp only
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun μ _ => ?_)
      set z₀ : ℂ := y + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)
      have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ horizStrip σ := by
        have hc : (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = ((μ * t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
        dsimp [z₀]
        rw [hc]
        exact hStrip_add_real σ y (μ * t₀) hy
      have hev :
          (fun w : ℂ => a_star w * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (w, (t₀ : ℂ))) =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
          (fun w : ℂ => h₀ w + c₀ w) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hStrip_open σ).mem_nhds hz₀)
          (fun w hw => hpsi_eq w hw)
      exact hev.deriv_eq
    rw [houter_congr, h_add h₀ c₀ hh₀_holo hc₀_holo y hy]
    have hc₀_diff : glancingDiffOp (fun p => c₀ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      rw [h_ftc_1d c₀ hc₀_holo y hy]
      have hrew : y + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = (y - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) + (t₀ : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [hrew, hc₀_shift (y - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (hStrip_half_sub y hy), sub_self, mul_zero]
    have hh₀_diff : glancingDiffOp (fun p => h₀ p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = -E_dot y := by
      rw [h_ftc_1d h₀ hh₀_holo y hy]
      have hneg : (t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹ * (h₀ (y + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) - h₀ (y - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2)) =
          -((t₀ : ℂ)⁻¹ * (KOp E_dot (y + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) - KOp E_dot (y - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2))) := by
        dsimp [h₀]; ring
      rw [hneg, ← h_ftc_1d (KOp E_dot) (hK_holo E_dot hE_holo) y hy,
          hK_diff E_dot hE_holo (fun u hu => (hE_pb u hu).1) y hy,
          hPi_Edot y hy, sub_zero]
    rw [hh₀_diff, hc₀_diff, add_zero]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hCyc
  obtain ⟨C_z, hC_z, hSolve⟩ := prelim_lift_and_cyclic_jet_solve Ω B S hCyc
  have hReg := affine_jet_regularity_and_linear_bounds Ω B S hCyc
  have hQuad := exact_jet_cancellation_and_quad_bounds Ω B S
  let C_jet : ℝ := 1 + 10 * C_z
  let C_quad_out : ℝ := 8 * (3 * C_jet + S.C_quad * C_jet ^ 2)
  let B_lift : ℕ := 15
  let C_lift : ℝ := max ((8 / S.η_adm) * C_jet) (max (6 * C_jet) C_quad_out)
  have hη_adm_pos : 0 < S.η_adm := S.η_adm_pos
  have hC_quad_pos : 0 < S.C_quad := S.C_quad_pos
  have hC_jet_ge : 11 ≤ C_jet := by dsimp [C_jet]; linarith
  have hC_lift_ge_adm : (8 / S.η_adm) * C_jet ≤ C_lift := le_max_left _ _
  have hC_lift_ge_lin : 6 * C_jet ≤ C_lift := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC_lift_ge_quad : C_quad_out ≤ C_lift := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hC_lift_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_lift := by linarith
  refine ⟨C_lift, B_lift, hC_lift_ge_one, ?_⟩
  intro s d δ ε η_slice N l q U U_star
    hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hε0 hε1 hη_slice0 hN
    hU hRes hl1 hq2 hqN _hCop t₀ ht₀_lt hU_star Q η_tot hSmall

  have hδ_inv_pos : 0 < δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hδ0
  set Q₀ : ℝ := 1 + δ⁻¹
  have hQ₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ Q₀ := by dsimp [Q₀]; linarith
  have hQ₀_le_Q : Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
    change 1 + δ⁻¹ ≤ 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
    linarith
  have hQ_ge_one : 1 ≤ Q := le_trans hQ₀_ge_one hQ₀_le_Q
  have hQ_pos : 0 ≤ Q := by linarith
  have hη_tot_pos : 0 < η_tot := by change 0 < ε + η_slice; linarith
  have hη_tot_nonneg : 0 ≤ η_tot := le_of_lt hη_tot_pos
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := by
    have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
    change 0 < (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
    positivity

  set M_z : ℝ := C_z * Q ^ 5 * η_tot
  set ρ_jet : ℝ := η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
  have hM_z_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_z := by positivity
  have hρ_jet_nonneg : 0 ≤ ρ_jet := by positivity
  have hρ_jet_le : ρ_jet ≤ C_jet * Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Q ^ 7 := one_le_pow₀ hQ_ge_one
    have hslice_le : η_slice ≤ Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by
      have hle : η_slice ≤ η_tot := by change η_slice ≤ ε + η_slice; linarith
      calc
        η_slice ≤ 1 * η_tot := by linarith
        _ ≤ Q ^ 7 * η_tot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hη_tot_nonneg
    have hQ₀_sq : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hQ₀_le_Q 2
    have hMz_le : 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z ≤ 10 * C_z * Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by
      have hmul : Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z ≤ Q ^ 2 * M_z :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ₀_sq hM_z_nonneg
      calc
        10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z = 10 * (Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z) := by ring
        _ ≤ 10 * (Q ^ 2 * M_z) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (by norm_num)
        _ = 10 * C_z * Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by dsimp [M_z]; ring
    calc
      ρ_jet = η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z := rfl
      _ ≤ Q ^ 7 * η_tot + 10 * C_z * Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by linarith
      _ = C_jet * Q ^ 7 * η_tot := by dsimp [C_jet]; ring

  have hρ_jet_adm : ρ_jet ≤ S.η_adm / 8 := by
    have hpow : Q ^ 7 ≤ Q ^ B_lift :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ_ge_one (by dsimp [B_lift]; omega)
    have hc_pos : 0 ≤ (8 / S.η_adm) * C_jet := by positivity
    have hstep1 : (8 / S.η_adm) * ρ_jet ≤ (8 / S.η_adm) * (C_jet * Q ^ 7 * η_tot) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ_jet_le (by positivity)
    have hstep2 : ((8 / S.η_adm) * C_jet) * Q ^ 7 ≤ C_lift * Q ^ B_lift :=
      mul_le_mul hC_lift_ge_adm hpow (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have hmul : (8 / S.η_adm) * ρ_jet ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        (8 / S.η_adm) * ρ_jet ≤ ((8 / S.η_adm) * C_jet * Q ^ 7) * η_tot := by linarith
        _ ≤ (C_lift * Q ^ B_lift) * η_tot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hstep2 hη_tot_nonneg
        _ ≤ 1 := hSmall
    have h8 : 8 * ρ_jet ≤ S.η_adm := by
      have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (le_of_lt hη_adm_pos)
      have hcancel : S.η_adm * ((8 / S.η_adm) * ρ_jet) = 8 * ρ_jet := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hη_adm_pos]
      linarith
    linarith

  have hη_slice_adm : η_slice ≤ S.η_adm / 8 := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z := by positivity
    have hle : η_slice ≤ ρ_jet := by dsimp [ρ_jet]; linarith
    exact le_trans hle hρ_jet_adm

  obtain ⟨z, hz_holo, hz_per, hz_bnd, hz_cancel⟩ :=
    hSolve s d δ ε η_slice N l q U U_star
      hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hε0 hε1 hη_slice0 hη_slice_adm hN
      hU hRes hl1 hq2 hqN ht₀_lt hU_star

  obtain ⟨hU_tilde_holo7, hW_plus_holo7, hU_tilde_jet7, hW_plus_bnd7,
      hW_plus_holo8, hW_plus_per8, hg_plus_holo9, hg_plus_bounds9,
      hH_plus_holo9_4, hH_plus_holo10_8, hH_plus_dt_holo10⟩ :=
    hReg s d δ η_slice M_z t₀ l q U U_star z
      hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hη_slice0 hM_z_nonneg
      hU ht₀_pos ht₀_lt rfl hU_star hz_holo
      (fun y hy => ⟨hz_per y hy, hz_bnd y hy⟩) hρ_jet_adm

  have hQuad_bounds :=
    hQuad s d δ ε η_slice ρ_jet t₀ l q U U_star z
      hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hε0 hη_slice0 hρ_jet_nonneg hρ_jet_adm
      hU hRes ht₀_pos ht₀_lt rfl hU_star hz_holo hz_cancel
      hU_tilde_holo7 hW_plus_holo7 hU_tilde_jet7 hW_plus_bnd7 hH_plus_holo9_4

  have hM_lin_le : 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet ≤ C_lift * Q ^ B_lift * η_tot := by
    have hpow : Q ^ 8 ≤ Q ^ B_lift :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ hQ_ge_one (by dsimp [B_lift]; omega)
    have h1 : Q₀ * ρ_jet ≤ Q * (C_jet * Q ^ 7 * η_tot) :=
      mul_le_mul hQ₀_le_Q hρ_jet_le hρ_jet_nonneg hQ_pos
    have h2 : (6 * C_jet) * Q ^ 8 ≤ C_lift * Q ^ B_lift :=
      mul_le_mul hC_lift_ge_lin hpow (by positivity) (by linarith)
    calc
      6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet = 6 * (Q₀ * ρ_jet) := by ring
      _ ≤ 6 * (Q * (C_jet * Q ^ 7 * η_tot)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by norm_num)

noncomputable def glancingPrelimLift (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  U p + (U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)))

noncomputable def glancingAffineCand (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  U p + (U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ))) +
    (p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) * (deriv U_star p.1 * z p.1)

noncomputable def glancingJetWitness (t₀ : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ)

  ((U_star p.1 - U (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ))) +

def PrelimCyclicJetSolveProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∃ C_z : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_z ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε η_slice : ℝ) (N l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      0 ≤ η_slice → η_slice ≤ S.η_adm / 8 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      1 ≤ l → 2 ≤ q → q ≤ N →
      let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
      t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
      ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
      let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
      let η_tot := ε + η_slice
      ∃ z : ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), ‖z y‖ ≤ C_z * Q ^ 5 * η_tot) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ),
          glancingDiffOp
            (fun p =>
              glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => U_star r.1) (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
                (glancingDiffOp
                  (fun r =>
                    deriv (fun t : ℂ => U (r.1, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv U_star r.1 + z r.1)
                  (p.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
            (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0)

def AffineJetRegularityProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  CyclicJetAndDiffOpProp →
  ∀ (s d δ η_slice M_z t₀ : ℝ) (l q : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_star z : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 ≤ η_slice → 0 ≤ M_z →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
    0 < t₀ → t₀ < d - 2 * δ →
    t₀ = (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) →
    ExactRationalSliceAt B s δ η_slice l q U U_star →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ z (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ), z (y + 2 * Real.pi) = z y ∧ ‖z y‖ ≤ M_z) →
    let Q₀ := 1 + δ⁻¹
    let ρ_jet := η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
    let U_tilde := glancingAffineCand t₀ U U_star z
    let W_plus := glancingJetWitness t₀ U U_star z
    let g_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_plus p
    let H_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_plus p
    ρ_jet ≤ S.η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_tilde
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w‖ ≤ ρ_jet ∧
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') w‖ ≤ 7 * S.η_adm / 8) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4),
      ‖W_plus (w, t)‖ ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
      W_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_plus (y, t)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ g_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
      g_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_plus (y, t) ∧
      ‖g_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet ∧
      ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus
      (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun y : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ))
      (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ))

    candidate_unique := fun q w hq hw x X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂ =>

    midpoint_props := ?_

    midpoint_lip := ?_

        hsgn hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hde hdτ
  }⟩
  · intro q ρ w e_X τ_T hq hw he hτ
    dsimp only
    have hq_mid : H_mid.N_mid ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hq

    rwa [hEq] at hMid
  · intro q ρ Δe Δτ w₁ w₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hq hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hde hdτ
    dsimp only

    have hc_T : |2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) := by

real_jet_and_candidate_uniqueness.definitions:
noncomputable def realJetA (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 w X - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2 - Real.exp (2 * w X)) / 384

noncomputable def realActE (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ)
  | 1 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w μ * μ₁
      L₁ * Real.exp L₀
  | 2 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 2 w μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      (L₂ + L₁ ^ 2) * Real.exp L₀
  | 3 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let w₃_u := iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let w₂_μ := iteratedDeriv 2 w μ
      let w₃_μ := iteratedDeriv 3 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let μ₃ := μ₂ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁) + μ₁ * (w₂_u - w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - w₁_μ * μ₂)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := w₂_u - 3 * w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      let L₃ := w₃_u - 3 * w₃_μ * μ₁ ^ 3 - 9 * w₂_μ * μ₁ * μ₂ - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₃
      (L₃ + 3 * L₁ * L₂ + L₁ ^ 3) * Real.exp L₀
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActG (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)
  | 1 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 2 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 2 * ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 3 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 3 * ((iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + s * u) +
        3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) +
        (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 3) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActS (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (r * ψ₀)
  | 1 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      sc₁ * ψ₁
  | 2 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      sc₂ * ψ₁ ^ 2 + sc₁ * ψ₂
  | 3 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * w₁_u * e_u
      let ψ₃ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (w₂_u + w₁_u ^ 2) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₃ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 3 * Real.sin (r * ψ₀)
      sc₃ * ψ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * sc₂ * ψ₁ * ψ₂ + sc₁ * ψ₃
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActionH0 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 0)

noncomputable def realActionH3 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let E := realActE w X u
  let G := realActG w X u
  let S := realActS w X u
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    (E 3 * G 0 * S 0 + E 0 * G 3 * S 0 + E 0 * G 0 * S 3 +
      3 * (E 2 * G 1 * S 0 + E 2 * G 0 * S 1 + E 1 * G 2 * S 0 +
        E 0 * G 2 * S 1 + E 1 * G 0 * S 2 + E 0 * G 1 * S 2) +
      6 * (E 1 * G 1 * S 1))

noncomputable def realJetB (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 4 *
    (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * realActionH3 w X (τ * r * T))

noncomputable def realMidpointDispU (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ → ℝ) (u_param x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (X x) (X x + u_param * T x) - (X x + u_param * T x / 2)

structure RealActionTaylorData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  primPhi_hasDerivAt : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ w) (Real.exp (w z)) z
  primPhi_strictMono : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ w)
  primPhi_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (primPhi_ℝ w)
  invPrimPhi_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w))
  invPrimPhi_hasDerivAt : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w))
      (Real.exp (-w (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) y))) y
  midpoint_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X Y : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ w (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) = (primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2
  midpoint_diag_periodic : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X Y : ℝ, midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) =
      midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi
  action_factor : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X T : ℝ, normAction1_ℝ w X (X + T) =
      T ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + realJetA w X * T ^ 2 + T ^ 3 * realJetB w X T)
  diff_global_bound : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    0 ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m + 15 → ∀ z : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) z| ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂

structure RealMidpointDispData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  C_mid_R : ℝ
  N_mid : ℕ
  C_mid_R_pos : 0 < C_mid_R
  N_mid_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mid
  midpoint_u_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mid ≤ q →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T x
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDispU w X T p.1) p.2)) ∧
    ∀ u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      Function.Periodic (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) x| ≤ C_mid_R
  midpoint_u_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T Δe Δτ u_param : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mid ≤ q →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) x| ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) x| ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₁ x
    let T₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T₁ x
    let X₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X₂ x
    let T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T₂ x
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k
          (fun y =>
            realMidpointDispU w₁ X₁ T₁ u_param y -
              realMidpointDispU w₂ X₂ T₂ u_param y) x| ≤
        C_mid_R * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

structure RealActionJetCompData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  C_jet_R : ℝ
  B₀_jet : ℝ
  L₀_jet : ℝ
  N_jet : ℕ
  C_jet_R_pos : 0 < C_jet_R
  B₀_jet_pos : 0 < B₀_jet
  L₀_jet_pos : 0 < L₀_jet
  N_jet_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_jet
  jet_pt_bounds : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    ∀ X₁ X₂ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, |T₁| ≤ 2 → |T₂| ≤ 2 →
      |realJetA w X₁| ≤ B₀_jet ∧
      |realJetB w X₁ T₁| ≤ B₀_jet ∧
      |realJetA w X₁ - realJetA w X₂| ≤ L₀_jet * |X₁ - X₂| ∧
      |realJetB w X₁ T₁ - realJetB w X₂ T₂| ≤ L₀_jet * (|X₁ - X₂| + |T₁ - T₂|)
  jet_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_jet ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
    let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T x
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => realJetA w (X x)) ∧
    IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) C_jet_R (fun x => realJetB w (X x) (T x))
