noncomputable def realJetA (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 w X - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2 - Real.exp (2 * w X)) / 384

noncomputable def realActE (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ)
  | 1 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w μ * μ₁
      L₁ * Real.exp L₀
  | 2 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 2 w μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      (L₂ + L₁ ^ 2) * Real.exp L₀
  | 3 =>
      let μ := midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
      let μ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w μ)
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let w₃_u := iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + u)
      let w₁_μ := iteratedDeriv 1 w μ
      let w₂_μ := iteratedDeriv 2 w μ
      let w₃_μ := iteratedDeriv 3 w μ
      let μ₂ := μ₁ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁)
      let μ₃ := μ₂ * (w₁_u - w₁_μ * μ₁) + μ₁ * (w₂_u - w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - w₁_μ * μ₂)
      let L₀ := 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w μ
      let L₁ := w₁_u - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₁
      let L₂ := w₂_u - 3 * w₂_μ * μ₁ ^ 2 - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₂
      let L₃ := w₃_u - 3 * w₃_μ * μ₁ ^ 3 - 9 * w₂_μ * μ₁ * μ₂ - 3 * w₁_μ * μ₃
      (L₃ + 3 * L₁ * L₂ + L₁ ^ 3) * Real.exp L₀
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActG (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)
  | 1 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 2 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 2 * ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | 3 => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      s ^ 3 * ((iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + s * u) +
        3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) +
        (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 3) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActS (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (r * ψ₀)
  | 1 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      sc₁ * ψ₁
  | 2 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      sc₂ * ψ₁ ^ 2 + sc₁ * ψ₂
  | 3 =>
      let ψ₀ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
      let e_u := Real.exp (w (X + u))
      let w₁_u := iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)
      let w₂_u := iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)
      let ψ₁ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * e_u
      let ψ₂ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * w₁_u * e_u
      let ψ₃ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (w₂_u + w₁_u ^ 2) * e_u
      let sc₁ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r * Real.sin (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₂ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * ψ₀))
      let sc₃ := ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 3 * Real.sin (r * ψ₀)
      sc₃ * ψ₁ ^ 3 + 3 * sc₂ * ψ₁ * ψ₂ + sc₁ * ψ₃
  | _ + 4 => 0

noncomputable def realActionH0 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 0)

noncomputable def realActionH3 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let E := realActE w X u
  let G := realActG w X u
  let S := realActS w X u
  (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
    (E 3 * G 0 * S 0 + E 0 * G 3 * S 0 + E 0 * G 0 * S 3 +
      3 * (E 2 * G 1 * S 0 + E 2 * G 0 * S 1 + E 1 * G 2 * S 0 +
        E 0 * G 2 * S 1 + E 1 * G 0 * S 2 + E 0 * G 1 * S 2) +
      6 * (E 1 * G 1 * S 1))

noncomputable def realJetB (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r ^ 4 *
    (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * realActionH3 w X (τ * r * T))

noncomputable def realMidpointDispU (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X T : ℝ → ℝ) (u_param x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (X x) (X x + u_param * T x) - (X x + u_param * T x / 2)

structure RealActionTaylorData (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  primPhi_hasDerivAt : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →

strip_holomorphic_jet_and_midpoint.definitions:
noncomputable def expSlope_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    deriv W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) * Complex.exp (W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X)

noncomputable def midStepOp_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X T ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  T *
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((v : ℂ) * T)) -
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ) ^ 2 *
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((θ : ℂ) * T * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ))))

noncomputable def zetaSeq_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, z => midStepOp_C W (X z) (T z) (zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zetaLim_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zMid_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) + zetaLim_C W X T z

noncomputable def midCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  X z + T z * zMid_C W X T z

noncomputable def aCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 W Z - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W Z) ^ 2 - Complex.exp (2 * W Z)) / 384

noncomputable def rG_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          3 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀))

noncomputable def rH_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((-2 * iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          12 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) -
          8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (-2 * (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀)))

noncomputable def rSinc_C (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (r : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.sin (((s * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * u))

noncomputable def mFactor_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let z_jet := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + (α₀ / 8) * T₀ + (β₀ / 16) * T₀ ^ 2
  1 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * (z₀ + z_jet) +
    ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) * T₀ ^ 2 * (z₀ ^ 2 + z₀ * z_jet + z_jet ^ 2)

noncomputable def rZ_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let u_z := α₀ / 8 + (β₀ / 16) * T₀
  let Q_jet :=
    α₀ * β₀ / 32 + (α₀ / 2) * u_z ^ 2 +
      ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℂ) * u_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * u_z ^ 2 + T₀ ^ 2 * u_z ^ 3)
  let R_L := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((θ : ℂ) * T₀ * z₀)
  let R_R := (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((v : ℂ) * T₀)
  (R_R - z₀ ^ 4 * R_L - Q_jet) / mFactor_C W X₀ T₀ z₀

noncomputable def rK_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let p₁ := α₀ / 2
  let p₂ := (β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₁ := ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (s : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((s : ℂ) * y)
  let G₁ := 1 + p₁ * y + p₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R₁
  let q₂ := -(A₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₂ :=
    q₂ * (p₁ + p₂ * y + y ^ 2 * R₁) * (G₁ + 1) +
      A₀ ^ 3 * G₁ ^ 3 * rSinc_C (A₀ * y * G₁)
  let h₁ := -2 * α₀
  let h₂ := 2 * α₀ ^ 2 - β₀
  let m₁ := p₁
  let m₂ := p₂ + q₂
  let R_m := p₁ * q₂ + p₂ * q₂ * y + R₂ * G₁ + R₁ * (1 + q₂ * y ^ 2)
  let M_val := 1 + m₁ * y + m₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R_m
  m₁ * h₂ + m₂ * h₁ + m₂ * h₂ * y +
    rH_C W X₀ y * M_val + R_m * (1 + h₁ * y + h₂ * y ^ 2)

noncomputable def rI_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (τ : ℂ) ^ 4 * rK_C W X₀ ((τ : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def bPoint_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let r_z := rZ_C W X₀ T₀ z₀
  let c₂ := (7 * α₀ ^ 2 - 5 * β₀ - A₀ ^ 2) / 24
  let v_z := β₀ / 16 + T₀ * r_z
  let w_z := α₀ / 8 + T₀ * v_z
  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_z + (α₀ / 8) * v_z + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * v_z ^ 2) -
    ((3 * α₀ / 8) * v_z + (3 * α₀ / 4) * w_z ^ 2 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * w_z ^ 3) +
    c₂ *
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * w_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * w_z ^ 2 +
        2 * T₀ ^ 2 * w_z ^ 3 + T₀ ^ 3 * w_z ^ 4) +
    z₀ ^ 5 * rI_C W X₀ (T₀ * z₀)

noncomputable def bCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  bPoint_C W (X z) (T z) (zMid_C W X T z)

noncomputable def shjCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * shjCompConst p B)

def IsStripBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ M

def IsStripHoloSymBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsStripBounded p σ' M f ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z))

structure PointwiseTaylorAndRealActionProp : Prop where
  midStepOp_C_fixed_iff : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    X₀ ∈ horizStrip σ →
    X₀ + T₀ ∈ horizStrip σ →
    X₀ + T₀ * z₀ ∈ horizStrip σ →
    (z₀ - (1 / 2 : ℂ) = midStepOp_C W X₀ T₀ (z₀ - (1 / 2 : ℂ)) ↔
      z₀ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (X₀ + (θ : ℂ) * T₀ * z₀) - W X₀)) =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (X₀ + (v : ℂ) * T₀) - W X₀)))
  real_midpoint_and_action_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_r T_r z_r : ℝ),
    0 < σ →
    ContDiff ℝ (3 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 → ∀ r : ℝ, iteratedDeriv k W (r : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k w r : ℝ) : ℂ)) →
    (z_r : ℂ) - (1 / 2 : ℂ) = midStepOp_C W (X_r : ℂ) (T_r : ℂ) ((z_r : ℂ) - (1 / 2 : ℂ)) →
    midpoint_ℝ w X_r (X_r + T_r) = X_r + T_r * z_r ∧
    (mFactor_C W (X_r : ℂ) (T_r : ℂ) (z_r : ℂ) ≠ 0 →
      ((normAction1_ℝ w X_r (X_r + T_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (T_r : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          ((1 / 8 : ℂ) + aCanon_C W (X_r : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ) ^ 2 +
            (T_r : ℂ) ^ 3 * bPoint_C W (X_r : ℂ) (T_r : ℂ) (z_r : ℂ)))

structure StripMidpointSystem (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where

  N_mid : ℕ
  C_mid_C_pos : 0 < C_mid_C
  C_zeta_pos : 0 < C_zeta

  N_mid_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mid
  midpoint_props : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mid ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X z
    let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T z
    let μ : ℂ → ℂ := midCanon_C W ρ q e_X τ_T
    DifferentiableOn ℂ μ (horizStrip σ') ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', μ z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', μ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', μ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ z)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, μ x = (midpoint_ℝ w (X x).re ((X x).re + (T x).re) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => μ ζ - (X ζ + T ζ / 2)) z‖ ≤ C_mid_C)
  midpoint_lip : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ Δe Δτ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mid ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => e_X₁ ζ - e_X₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => τ_T₁ ζ - τ_T₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X₁ z
    let T₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T₁ z
    let μ₁ : ℂ → ℂ := midCanon_C W₁ ρ q e_X₁ τ_T₁
    let X₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X₂ z
    let T₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T₂ z
    let μ₂ : ℂ → ℂ := midCanon_C W₂ ρ q e_X₂ τ_T₂
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ => (μ₁ ζ - (X₁ ζ + T₁ ζ / 2)) - (μ₂ ζ - (X₂ ζ + T₂ ζ / 2))) z‖ ≤
        C_mid_C * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)
  zeta_props : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ c_T : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mid ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X z
    let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T z
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' (C_zeta / (q : ℝ)) (zetaLim_C W X T) ∧

  zeta_lip : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ c_T Δe Δτ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)

    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mid ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => e_X₁ ζ - e_X₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δe) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => τ_T₁ ζ - τ_T₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δτ) →
    let X₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X₁ z
    let T₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T₁ z
    let X₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X₂ z
    let T₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T₂ z
    IsStripBounded (m + 2) σ'
      (C_zeta * (Δe + Δτ + stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂))
      (fun z => zetaLim_C W₁ X₁ T₁ z - zetaLim_C W₂ X₂ T₂ z)

  jet_comp_props : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ c_T : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W e_X τ_T ζ : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_jet ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_jet / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' (C_zeta / (q : ℝ)) ζ →
    let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X z
    let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T z
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', mFactor_C W (X z) (T z) ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ z) ≠ 0) ∧
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' C_jet_raw (fun z => aCanon_C W (X z)) ∧
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' C_jet_raw
      (fun z => bPoint_C W (X z) (T z) ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ z))
  jet_comp_lip : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ c_T Δe Δτ Δζ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ ζ₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ ζ₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_jet ≤ q →
    α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 6 * α - K_jet / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
    |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
    0 ≤ Δe →
    0 ≤ Δτ →
    0 ≤ Δζ →

    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
    IsStripJetPerturb (m + 2) σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' (C_zeta / (q : ℝ)) ζ₁ →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded (m + 2) σ' (C_zeta / (q : ℝ)) ζ₂ →

    let X₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X₂ z

noncomputable def expSlope_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    deriv W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) * Complex.exp (W (X + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X)

noncomputable def midStepOp_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X T ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  T *
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((v : ℂ) * T)) -
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ) ^ 2 *
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((θ : ℂ) * T * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ))))

noncomputable def zetaSeq_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, z => midStepOp_C W (X z) (T z) (zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zetaLim_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => zetaSeq_C W X T n z)

noncomputable def zMid_C (W X T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) + zetaLim_C W X T z

noncomputable def midCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  X z + T z * zMid_C W X T z

noncomputable def aCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (7 * iteratedDeriv 2 W Z - 8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W Z) ^ 2 - Complex.exp (2 * W Z)) / 384

noncomputable def rG_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          3 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀))

noncomputable def rH_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((-2 * iteratedDeriv 3 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) +
          12 * iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) * iteratedDeriv 2 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) -
          8 * (iteratedDeriv 1 W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y)) ^ 3) *
        Complex.exp (-2 * (W (X₀ + (s : ℂ) * y) - W X₀)))

noncomputable def rSinc_C (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (r : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.sin (((s * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * u))

noncomputable def mFactor_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let z_jet := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + (α₀ / 8) * T₀ + (β₀ / 16) * T₀ ^ 2
  1 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * (z₀ + z_jet) +
    ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) * T₀ ^ 2 * (z₀ ^ 2 + z₀ * z_jet + z_jet ^ 2)

noncomputable def rZ_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let u_z := α₀ / 8 + (β₀ / 16) * T₀
  let Q_jet :=
    α₀ * β₀ / 32 + (α₀ / 2) * u_z ^ 2 +
      ((β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6) *
        ((3 / 4 : ℂ) * u_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * u_z ^ 2 + T₀ ^ 2 * u_z ^ 3)
  let R_L := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((θ : ℂ) * T₀ * z₀)
  let R_R := (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, (v : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((v : ℂ) * T₀)
  (R_R - z₀ ^ 4 * R_L - Q_jet) / mFactor_C W X₀ T₀ z₀

noncomputable def rK_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let p₁ := α₀ / 2
  let p₂ := (β₀ + α₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₁ := ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (s : ℂ) ^ 3 * rG_C W X₀ ((s : ℂ) * y)
  let G₁ := 1 + p₁ * y + p₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R₁
  let q₂ := -(A₀ ^ 2) / 6
  let R₂ :=
    q₂ * (p₁ + p₂ * y + y ^ 2 * R₁) * (G₁ + 1) +
      A₀ ^ 3 * G₁ ^ 3 * rSinc_C (A₀ * y * G₁)
  let h₁ := -2 * α₀
  let h₂ := 2 * α₀ ^ 2 - β₀
  let m₁ := p₁
  let m₂ := p₂ + q₂
  let R_m := p₁ * q₂ + p₂ * q₂ * y + R₂ * G₁ + R₁ * (1 + q₂ * y ^ 2)
  let M_val := 1 + m₁ * y + m₂ * y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 * R_m
  m₁ * h₂ + m₂ * h₁ + m₂ * h₂ * y +
    rH_C W X₀ y * M_val + R_m * (1 + h₁ * y + h₂ * y ^ 2)

noncomputable def rI_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (τ : ℂ) ^ 4 * rK_C W X₀ ((τ : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def bPoint_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X₀ T₀ z₀ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let α₀ := iteratedDeriv 1 W X₀
  let β₀ := iteratedDeriv 2 W X₀
  let A₀ := Complex.exp (W X₀)
  let r_z := rZ_C W X₀ T₀ z₀
  let c₂ := (7 * α₀ ^ 2 - 5 * β₀ - A₀ ^ 2) / 24
  let v_z := β₀ / 16 + T₀ * r_z
  let w_z := α₀ / 8 + T₀ * v_z
  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_z + (α₀ / 8) * v_z + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * v_z ^ 2) -
    ((3 * α₀ / 8) * v_z + (3 * α₀ / 4) * w_z ^ 2 + (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * w_z ^ 3) +
    c₂ *
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * w_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * w_z ^ 2 +
        2 * T₀ ^ 2 * w_z ^ 3 + T₀ ^ 3 * w_z ^ 4) +
    z₀ ^ 5 * rI_C W X₀ (T₀ * z₀)

noncomputable def bCanon_C (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ sgn : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X ζ
  let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ((sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_T ζ
  bPoint_C W (X z) (T z) (zMid_C W X T z)

noncomputable def shjCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * shjCompConst p B)

def IsStripBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ M

def IsStripHoloSymBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsStripBounded p σ' M f ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z))

structure StripCalculusToolkit : Prop where
  vert_strip_maps_to : ∀ (σ σ' α ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    0 < σ' →
    0 ≤ α →
    σ' ≤ (1 - 2 * α) * σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', e (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (e z)) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖deriv e z‖ ≤ α) →
    ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', z + (ρ : ℂ) + e z ∈ horizStrip σ
  stripExt_iteratedDeriv_props : ∀ (r₀ d : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    d ≤ r₀ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W) (horizStrip σ) ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ, iteratedDeriv d W (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = iteratedDeriv d W ζ) ∧
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      iteratedDeriv d W (starRingEnd ℂ ζ) = starRingEnd ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W ζ)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d W) ζ‖ ≤ M₁)
  stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    0 ≤ stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂ ∧
    ∀ (j d : ℕ), j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₁ z - iteratedDeriv d W₂ z) ζ‖ ≤
        stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂
  real_iteratedDeriv_eq : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded r₀ M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r₀ → ∀ r : ℝ, iteratedDeriv k W (r : ℂ) = ((iteratedDeriv k w r : ℝ) : ℂ)
  bounded_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (c : ℂ),
    IsStripBounded p σ' ‖c‖ (fun _ => c)
  holo_const_real : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' c : ℝ),
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' |c| (fun _ => (c : ℂ))
  bounded_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    M₁ ≤ M₂ → IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ f
  holo_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    M₁ ≤ M₂ → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ f
  bounded_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z + g z)
  holo_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z + g z)
  bounded_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  holo_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (M₁ + M₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  bounded_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M f → IsStripBounded p σ' M (fun z => -f z)
  holo_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M (fun z => -f z)
  bounded_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} (c : ℂ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M → IsStripBounded p σ' M f →
    IsStripBounded p σ' (‖c‖ * M) (fun z => c * f z)
  holo_real_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (|c| * M) (fun z => (c : ℂ) * f z)
  bounded_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * M₁ * M₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  holo_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₁ f → IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M₂ g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * M₁ * M₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  bounded_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f M_g Δf Δg : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_f f₁ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₂ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * Δg + Δf * M_g))
      (fun z => f₁ z * g₁ z - f₂ z * g₂ z)
  holo_inv : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M_g →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M_g g →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ'
      ((((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g)
      (fun z => (g z)⁻¹)
  bounded_inv_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g Δg : ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ M_g →
    0 ≤ Δg →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₁ →
    IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₂ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₁ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₂ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
    IsStripBounded p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsStripBounded p σ'
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g * Δg)
      (fun z => (g₁ z)⁻¹ - (g₂ z)⁻¹)
  exp_ball_bound : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.exp (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    (∀ w : ℂ, Complex.exp (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.exp w)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp R)
  sin_ball_bound : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.sin (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    (∀ w : ℂ, Complex.sin (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (Complex.sin w)) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp R)
  comp_bound : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G B : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G f : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ B →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G w‖ ≤ M_G) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') →

  have hJet_const : ∀ c : ℝ, IsRealJetPerturb p |c| (fun _ => c) := by
    intro c
    refine ⟨fun _ => rfl, contDiff_const, ?_⟩
    intro k _ x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_refl _
    · simp only [abs_zero, abs_nonneg]

  have hJet_zero : ∀ {B : ℝ}, 0 ≤ B → IsRealJetPerturb p B (fun _ => 0) := by
    intro B hB
    apply hJet_mono (B₁ := |(0 : ℝ)|)
    · simpa using hB
    · exact hJet_const 0

  have hJet_neg : ∀ {B : ℝ} {u : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u → IsRealJetPerturb p B (fun x => -u x) := by
    intro B u hu
    refine ⟨fun x => by simp [hu.1 x], hu.2.1.neg, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_neg, abs_neg]
    exact hu.2.2 k hk x

  have hJet_add : ∀ {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {u v : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B₁ u → IsRealJetPerturb p B₂ v →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => u x + v x) := by
    intro B₁ B₂ u v hu hv
    refine ⟨fun x => by simp [hu.1 x, hv.1 x], hu.2.1.add hv.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    have hcu : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) u x :=
      (hu.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
    have hcv : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) v x :=
      (hv.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcu hcv]
    exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hu.2.2 k hk x) (hv.2.2 k hk x))

  have hJet_sub : ∀ {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {u v : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B₁ u → IsRealJetPerturb p B₂ v →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => u x - v x) := by
    intro B₁ B₂ u v hu hv
    exact hJet_congr (fun x => (sub_eq_add_neg (u x) (v x)).symm) (hJet_add hu (hJet_neg hv))

  have hJet_const_mul : ∀ (c : ℝ) {B : ℝ} {u : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u → IsRealJetPerturb p (|c| * B) (fun x => c * u x) := by
    intro c B u hu
    refine ⟨fun x => by simp [hu.1 x], contDiff_const.mul hu.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    have hcu : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) u x :=
      (hu.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul c hcu, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu.2.2 k hk x) (abs_nonneg c)

  have hJet_sum : ∀ (n : ℕ) {B : ℝ} (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ B → (∀ i < n, IsRealJetPerturb p B (g i)) →
      IsRealJetPerturb p ((n : ℝ) * B) (fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, g i x) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro B g _ _
      simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
      exact hJet_zero (le_refl 0)
    | succ n ih =>
      intro B g hB hg
      have hprev := ih g hB (fun i hi => hg i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi))
      have hlast := hg n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
      have hsum := hJet_add hprev hlast
      refine hJet_congr (fun x => (Finset.sum_range_succ (fun i => g i x) n).symm) ?_
      refine hJet_mono ?_ hsum
      push_cast
      linarith

  have hJet_mul : ∀ {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {u v : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B₁ u → IsRealJetPerturb p B₂ v →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (C_mul * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => u x * v x) := by
    intro B₁ B₂ u v hu hv
    have hB₁ : 0 ≤ B₁ := hJet_nonneg hu
    have hB₂ : 0 ≤ B₂ := hJet_nonneg hv
    refine ⟨fun x => by simp [hu.1 x, hv.1 x], hu.2.1.mul hv.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    have hcu : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) u x :=
      (hu.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
    have hcv : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) v x :=
      (hv.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hcu hcv]
    have h1 : |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i u x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) v x| ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B₁ * B₂) := by
      refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
      have hi_le : i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) hk
      have hki_le : k - i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), mul_assoc]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      exact mul_le_mul (hu.2.2 i hi_le x) (hv.2.2 (k - i) hki_le x) (abs_nonneg _) hB₁
    have hsum_choose : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum_choose] at h1
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ C_mul := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hk
    exact le_trans h1 (by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (mul_nonneg hB₁ hB₂)
      linarith)

  have hJet_mul_sub : ∀ {B_u B_v Δu Δv : ℝ} {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B_u u₂ → IsRealJetPerturb p B_v v₁ →
      IsRealJetPerturb p Δu (fun x => u₁ x - u₂ x) →
      IsRealJetPerturb p Δv (fun x => v₁ x - v₂ x) →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (C_mul * (Δu * B_v + B_u * Δv)) (fun x => u₁ x * v₁ x - u₂ x * v₂ x) := by
    intro B_u B_v Δu Δv u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ hu₂ hv₁ hΔu hΔv
    have hcomb := hJet_add (hJet_mul hΔu hv₁) (hJet_mul hu₂ hΔv)
    exact hJet_congr' (hJet_mono (by linarith) hcomb) (fun x => by ring)

  have hJet_pow4_prod : ∀ {B : ℝ} {u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄ : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u₁ → IsRealJetPerturb p B u₂ →
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u₃ → IsRealJetPerturb p B u₄ →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) (fun x => u₁ x * u₂ x * u₃ x * u₄ x) := by
    intro B u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄ h1 h2 h3 h4
    have h12 := hJet_mul h1 h2
    have h123 := hJet_mul h12 h3
    have h1234 := hJet_mul h123 h4
    exact hJet_mono (by linarith [show C_mul * (C_mul * (C_mul * B * B) * B) * B = C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 by ring]) h1234

  have hJet_pow5 : ∀ {B : ℝ} {u : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u → IsRealJetPerturb p (C_pow5 * B ^ 5) (fun x => (u x) ^ 5) := by
    intro B u hu
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := hJet_nonneg hu
    have h4 := hJet_pow4_prod hu hu hu hu
    have h5 := hJet_mul h4 hu
    have h_eq : C_mul * (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) * B = C_mul ^ 4 * B ^ 5 := by ring
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ C_mul ^ 4 * B ^ 5 := mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_of_lt hC_mul_pos) 4) (pow_nonneg hB 5)
    have h_le : C_mul * (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) * B ≤ C_pow5 * B ^ 5 := by
      change C_mul * (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) * B ≤ 5 * C_mul ^ 4 * B ^ 5
      linarith
    exact hJet_congr' (hJet_mono h_le h5) (fun x => by ring)

  have hJet_pow5_sub : ∀ {B Δu : ℝ} {u₁ u₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p B u₁ → IsRealJetPerturb p B u₂ →
      IsRealJetPerturb p Δu (fun x => u₁ x - u₂ x) →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (C_pow5 * B ^ 4 * Δu) (fun x => (u₁ x) ^ 5 - (u₂ x) ^ 5) := by
    intro B Δu u₁ u₂ h1 h2 hΔ
    have t0 := hJet_pow4_prod h1 h1 h1 h1
    have t1 := hJet_pow4_prod h1 h1 h1 h2
    have t2 := hJet_pow4_prod h1 h1 h2 h2
    have t3 := hJet_pow4_prod h1 h2 h2 h2
    have t4 := hJet_pow4_prod h2 h2 h2 h2
    have hsum := hJet_add (hJet_add (hJet_add (hJet_add t0 t1) t2) t3) t4
    have hprod := hJet_mul hΔ hsum
    have h_le : C_mul * Δu *
        (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 +
          C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) ≤ C_pow5 * B ^ 4 * Δu := by
      change C_mul * Δu *
        (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 +
          C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) ≤ 5 * C_mul ^ 4 * B ^ 4 * Δu
      linarith [show C_mul * Δu *
        (C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 +
          C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4 + C_mul ^ 3 * B ^ 4) = 5 * C_mul ^ 4 * B ^ 4 * Δu by ring]
    exact hJet_congr' (hJet_mono h_le hprod) (fun x => by ring)

  have hJet_inv_one_add : ∀ {g : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p (1 / 2) g →
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ 1 + g x) ∧ IsRealJetPerturb p C_inv (fun x => (1 + g x)⁻¹) := by
    intro g hg
    have h_lower : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ 1 + g x := by
      intro x
      have hgx := neg_le_of_abs_le (hJet_eval hg x)
      linarith
    refine ⟨h_lower, ?_⟩
    let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (1 + g x)⁻¹
    have h_nz : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 + g x ≠ 0 := fun x => ne_of_gt (by linarith [h_lower x])
    have h_smooth1 : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun x => 1 + g x) := contDiff_const.add hg.2.1
    have h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) h := h_smooth1.inv h_nz
    have h_ind : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k h x| ≤ 2 * C_mul ^ k := by
      intro k
      induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h k ih =>
        intro hk x
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, pow_zero, mul_one]
          have hpos : 0 < 1 + g x := by linarith [h_lower x]
          rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpos)]
          have : (1 + g x)⁻¹ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ))⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) (h_lower x)
          linarith
        | succ m' =>
          have hprod_eq : (fun y : ℝ => (1 + g y) * h y) = (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
            funext y
            exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (h_nz y)
          have h0 : iteratedDeriv (m' + 1) (fun y : ℝ => (1 + g y) * h y) x = 0 := by
            rw [hprod_eq, iteratedDeriv_const]
            simp
          have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ((m' + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => 1 + g y) x :=
            (h_smooth1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
          have hch : ContDiffAt ℝ ((m' + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) h x :=
            (h_smooth.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
          rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hc1 hch, Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h0
          simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, iteratedDeriv_zero,
            Nat.sub_zero] at h0
          have h_eq_neg : (1 + g x) * iteratedDeriv (m' + 1) h x =
              -∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
                ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
                  iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun y => 1 + g y) x *
                  iteratedDeriv (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h x := by linarith
          have h_lhs_abs : (1 + g x) * |iteratedDeriv (m' + 1) h x| =
              |∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
                ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
                  iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun y => 1 + g y) x *
                  iteratedDeriv (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h x| := by
            have hpos : 0 ≤ 1 + g x := by linarith [h_lower x]
            rw [← abs_of_nonneg hpos, ← abs_mul, h_eq_neg, abs_neg]
          have h_sum_bnd : |∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
              ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ) *
                iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun y => 1 + g y) x *
                iteratedDeriv (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h x| ≤
              ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1), ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ) * C_mul ^ m' := by
            refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_)
            have hj_lt : j < m' + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
            have hj1_le : j + 1 ≤ p := le_trans hj_lt hk
            have hc_const : ContDiffAt ℝ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x :=
              contDiff_const.contDiffAt
            have hc_g : ContDiffAt ℝ ((j + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g x :=
              (hg.2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hj1_le)).contDiffAt
            have h_der1 : iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun y => 1 + g y) x = iteratedDeriv (j + 1) g x := by
              rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hc_const hc_g, iteratedDeriv_const]
              simp
            rw [h_der1, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), mul_assoc]
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
            have h_rem_lt : m' + 1 - (j + 1) < m' + 1 := by omega
            have h_rem_le_m : m' + 1 - (j + 1) ≤ m' := by omega
            have h_rem_le_p : m' + 1 - (j + 1) ≤ p := le_trans (le_of_lt h_rem_lt) hk
            have h_ih := ih (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h_rem_lt h_rem_le_p x
            have h_pow_le : C_mul ^ (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) ≤ C_mul ^ m' :=
              pow_le_pow_right₀ hC_mul_ge_one h_rem_le_m
            have h_h_bnd : |iteratedDeriv (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h x| ≤ 2 * C_mul ^ m' := by
              linarith
            have h_g_bnd : |iteratedDeriv (j + 1) g x| ≤ 1 / 2 := hg.2.2 (j + 1) hj1_le x
            have h_prod := mul_le_mul h_g_bnd h_h_bnd (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
            linarith
          have h_choose_le : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1), ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ)) ≤ C_mul := by
            have h_tot : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m' + 2), ((m' + 1).choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m' + 1) := by
              exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose (m' + 1)
            rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h_tot
            simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one] at h_tot
            have h_2le : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m' + 1) ≤ C_mul :=
              pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hk
            linarith
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at h_sum_bnd
          have h_rhs : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1), ((m' + 1).choose (j + 1) : ℝ)) * C_mul ^ m' ≤
              C_mul ^ (m' + 1) := by
            rw [pow_succ']
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_choose_le (pow_nonneg (le_of_lt hC_mul_pos) m')
          have h_half_mul : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv (m' + 1) h x| ≤
              (1 + g x) * |iteratedDeriv (m' + 1) h x| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_lower x) (abs_nonneg _)
          linarith
    refine ⟨fun x => by dsimp [h]; rw [hg.1 x], h_smooth, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    exact le_trans (h_ind k hk x) (by
      have := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC_mul_ge_one hk
      linarith)

  have hJet_inv_one_add_sub : ∀ {Δg : ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
      IsRealJetPerturb p (1 / 2) g₁ → IsRealJetPerturb p (1 / 2) g₂ →
      IsRealJetPerturb p Δg (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) →
      IsRealJetPerturb p (C_inv_lip * Δg) (fun x => (1 + g₁ x)⁻¹ - (1 + g₂ x)⁻¹) := by
    intro Δg g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ hΔ
    obtain ⟨h1_low, h1_inv⟩ := hJet_inv_one_add hg₁
    obtain ⟨h2_low, h2_inv⟩ := hJet_inv_one_add hg₂
    have hprod := hJet_neg (hJet_mul hΔ (hJet_mul h1_inv h2_inv))
    refine hJet_congr ?_ (hJet_mono ?_ hprod)
    · intro x
      have hnz1 : 1 + g₁ x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [h1_low x])
      have hnz2 : 1 + g₂ x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [h2_low x])
      field_simp
      ring
    · change C_mul * Δg * (C_mul * C_inv * C_inv) ≤ C_mul ^ 2 * C_inv ^ 2 * Δg
      linarith [show C_mul * Δg * (C_mul * C_inv * C_inv) = C_mul ^ 2 * C_inv ^ 2 * Δg by ring]

  
  have hDir_zero : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), rdmc_dirichletInv q f 0 = 0 := by
    intro q f
    funext x
    simp [rdmc_dirichletInv]

  have hDir_q : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), 1 ≤ q → rdmc_dirichletInv q f q = 0 := by
    intro q f hq
    funext x
    have hq_nz : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
    simp only [rdmc_dirichletInv, le_refl, ↓reduceIte, rdmc_dirichletSlope0,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
    field_simp [hq_nz]
    ring

  have hDir_gt : ∀ (q j : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ), q < j → rdmc_dirichletInv q f j = 0 := by
    intro q j f hj
    funext x
    have hnot : ¬ j ≤ q := by omega
    simp [rdmc_dirichletInv, hnot]

  have hDir_first_diff : ∀ (q j : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      j < q →
      rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 1) x - rdmc_dirichletInv q f j x =
        rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f j x := by
    intro q j f x hj
    have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ q := by omega
    have hj0 : j ≤ q := by omega
    simp only [rdmc_dirichletInv, hj1, hj0, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring

  have hDir_second_diff : ∀ (q j : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      j + 1 < q →
      rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 2) x - 2 * rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 1) x +
        rdmc_dirichletInv q f j x = f (j + 1) x := by
    intro q j f x hj
    have h1 := hDir_first_diff q (j + 1) f x hj
    have h0 := hDir_first_diff q j f x (by omega)
    have h_eq : rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 2) x - 2 * rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 1) x +
        rdmc_dirichletInv q f j x =
        (rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 2) x - rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 1) x) -
          (rdmc_dirichletInv q f (j + 1) x - rdmc_dirichletInv q f j x) := by ring
    rw [h_eq, h1, h0]
    simp only [rdmc_dirichletPrefix, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring

  have hDir_sub : ∀ (q j : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ),
      rdmc_dirichletInv q f₁ j x - rdmc_dirichletInv q f₂ j x =
        rdmc_dirichletInv q (fun i y => f₁ i y - f₂ i y) j x := by
    intro q j f₁ f₂ x
    have hpref : ∀ r : ℕ,
        rdmc_dirichletPrefix f₁ r x - rdmc_dirichletPrefix f₂ r x =
          rdmc_dirichletPrefix (fun i y => f₁ i y - f₂ i y) r x := by
      intro r
      simp only [rdmc_dirichletPrefix, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hslope :
        rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f₁ x - rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f₂ x =
          rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q (fun i y => f₁ i y - f₂ i y) x := by
      simp only [rdmc_dirichletSlope0, ← mul_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hpref]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ q
    · simp only [rdmc_dirichletInv, hj, ↓reduceIte, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
      rw [← hslope, ← hpref r]
      ring
    · simp [rdmc_dirichletInv, hj]

  have hDir_bound : ∀ (q : ℕ) (M_f : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ q → 0 ≤ M_f →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → IsRealJetPerturb p M_f (f (j + 1))) →
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * M_f) (rdmc_dirichletInv q f) := by
    intro q M_f f hq hMf hf
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hq_nz : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
    have hpref_bnd : ∀ r < q, IsRealJetPerturb p ((q : ℝ) * M_f) (rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r) := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 := hJet_sum r (fun i => f (i + 1)) hMf (fun i hi => hf i (by omega))
      refine hJet_mono ?_ h1
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_of_lt hr)) hMf
    have hslope_bnd : IsRealJetPerturb p ((q : ℝ) * M_f) (rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f) := by
      have hsum := hJet_sum q (rdmc_dirichletPrefix f) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hq_pos) hMf) hpref_bnd
      have hmul := hJet_const_mul (-(q : ℝ)⁻¹) hsum
      refine hJet_mono ?_ hmul
      rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hq_pos)]
      field_simp [hq_nz]
      exact le_refl _
    have hstep_bnd : ∀ r < q,
        IsRealJetPerturb p (2 * (q : ℝ) * M_f)
          (fun x => rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x) := by
      intro r hr
      exact hJet_mono (by linarith) (hJet_add hslope_bnd (hpref_bnd r hr))
    refine ⟨hDir_zero q f, hDir_q q f hq, fun j hj => hDir_gt q j f hj, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      have hsum := hJet_sum j (fun r x => rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x)
        (by positivity) (fun r hr => hstep_bnd r (lt_of_lt_of_le hr hj))
      have heq : (fun x => ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j,
          (rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x)) = rdmc_dirichletInv q f j := by
        funext x
        simp [rdmc_dirichletInv, hj]
      refine hJet_congr (fun x => congrFun heq x) (hJet_mono ?_ hsum)
      have hj_le : (j : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hj
      have h1 : (j : ℝ) * (2 * (q : ℝ) * M_f) ≤ (q : ℝ) * (2 * (q : ℝ) * M_f) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj_le (by positivity)
      have h2 : (q : ℝ) * (2 * (q : ℝ) * M_f) = (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * M_f) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [hq_nz]
      linarith
    · intro j hj
      have h1 := hstep_bnd j hj
      refine hJet_congr (fun x => (hDir_first_diff q j f x hj).symm) (hJet_mono ?_ h1)
      have h2 : 2 * (q : ℝ) * M_f = (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * M_f) / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        field_simp [hq_nz]
      linarith

  
  have hTuple_mono : ∀ {q : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ},
      B₁ ≤ B₂ → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₁ d → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₂ d := by
    intro q B₁ B₂ d hle hd
    refine ⟨hd.1, hd.2.1, hd.2.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      exact hJet_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)) (hd.2.2.2.1 j hj)
    · intro j hj
      exact hJet_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)) (hd.2.2.2.2 j hj)

  have hTuple_zero : ∀ (q : ℕ) {B : ℝ},
      0 ≤ B → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B (fun _ _ => 0) := by
    intro q B hB
    refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro _ _
      exact hJet_zero (div_nonneg hB (by positivity))
    · intro _ _
      simpa only [sub_zero] using hJet_zero (div_nonneg hB (by positivity))

  have hTuple_add : ∀ {q : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ},
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₁ d₁ → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₂ d₂ →
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (B₁ + B₂) (fun j x => d₁ j x + d₂ j x) := by
    intro q B₁ B₂ d₁ d₂ hd₁ hd₂
    refine ⟨by funext x; simp [hd₁.1, hd₂.1],
      by funext x; simp [hd₁.2.1, hd₂.2.1],
      fun j hj => by funext x; simp [hd₁.2.2.1 j hj, hd₂.2.2.1 j hj], ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      refine hJet_mono (by rw [add_div]) (hJet_add (hd₁.2.2.2.1 j hj) (hd₂.2.2.2.1 j hj))
    · intro j hj
      exact hJet_congr'
        (hJet_mono (by rw [add_div]) (hJet_add (hd₁.2.2.2.2 j hj) (hd₂.2.2.2.2 j hj)))
        (fun x => by ring)

  have hTuple_sub : ∀ {q : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {d₁ d₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ},
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₁ d₁ → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q B₂ d₂ →
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (B₁ + B₂) (fun j x => d₁ j x - d₂ j x) := by
    intro q B₁ B₂ d₁ d₂ hd₁ hd₂
    refine ⟨by funext x; simp [hd₁.1, hd₂.1],
      by funext x; simp [hd₁.2.1, hd₂.2.1],
      fun j hj => by funext x; simp [hd₁.2.2.1 j hj, hd₂.2.2.1 j hj], ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      refine hJet_mono (by rw [add_div]) (hJet_sub (hd₁.2.2.2.1 j hj) (hd₂.2.2.2.1 j hj))
    · intro j hj
      exact hJet_congr'
        (hJet_mono (by rw [add_div]) (hJet_sub (hd₁.2.2.2.2 j hj) (hd₂.2.2.2.2 j hj)))
        (fun x => by ring)

  have hUnifDerivLim : ∀ (m' : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (m' : WithTop ℕ∞) (u n)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m' → TendstoUniformly (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (u n)) (g k) Filter.atTop) →
      ContDiff ℝ (m' : WithTop ℕ∞) (g 0) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m' → iteratedDeriv k (g 0) = g k := by
    intro m'
    induction m' with
    | zero =>
      intro u g hu hconv
      have h0 : TendstoUniformly u (g 0) Filter.atTop := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hconv 0 (le_refl 0)
      have hcont : Continuous (g 0) :=
        h0.continuous (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hu n).continuous).frequently
      refine ⟨contDiff_zero.mpr hcont, ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
      subst hk0
      exact iteratedDeriv_zero
    | succ m' ih =>
      intro u g hu hconv
      have hu_diff : ∀ n : ℕ, Differentiable ℝ (u n) := fun n =>
        (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp (by simpa [Nat.cast_succ] using hu n)).1
      have hu'_smooth : ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (m' : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv (u n)) := fun n =>
        (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp (by simpa [Nat.cast_succ] using hu n)).2.2
      have hconv' : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m' →
          TendstoUniformly (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (deriv (u n))) (g (k + 1)) Filter.atTop := by
        intro k hk
        have h1 := hconv (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using h1
      obtain ⟨hg1_smooth, hg1_iter⟩ := ih (fun n => deriv (u n)) (fun k => g (k + 1)) hu'_smooth hconv'
      have hconv0 : TendstoUniformly u (g 0) Filter.atTop := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hconv 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hconv1 : TendstoUniformly (fun n => deriv (u n)) (g 1) Filter.atTop := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hconv' 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hderiv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (g 0) (g 1 x) x :=
        hasDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformly hconv1
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n x => (hu_diff n x).hasDerivAt)
          (fun x => hconv0.tendsto_at x)
      have hg0_diff : Differentiable ℝ (g 0) := fun x => (hderiv x).differentiableAt
      have hg0_deriv : deriv (g 0) = g 1 := funext fun x => (hderiv x).deriv
      have hg0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ((m' + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (g 0) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        refine ⟨hg0_diff, by simp, ?_⟩
        rwa [hg0_deriv]
      refine ⟨hg0_smooth, ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero => exact iteratedDeriv_zero
      | succ r =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hg0_deriv]
        exact hg1_iter r (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk)

  have hGeomTail : ∀ (C : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ C →
      (∀ n : ℕ, |a (n + 1) - a n| ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) →
      ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, |L - a n| ≤ 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro C a _ hstep
    have hdist : ∀ n : ℕ, dist (a n) (a (n + 1)) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
      exact hstep n
    have hcauchy : CauchySeq a := cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2) C (by norm_num) hdist
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcauchy
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    intro n
    have hpart : ∀ d : ℕ,
        |a (n + d) - a n| ≤ 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n - 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + d) := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero => simp
      | succ d ih =>
        have htri : |a (n + (d + 1)) - a n| ≤
            |a (n + d) - a n| + |a (n + d + 1) - a (n + d)| := by
          have : a (n + (d + 1)) - a n = (a (n + d) - a n) + (a (n + d + 1) - a (n + d)) := by
            rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
            ring
          rw [this]
          exact abs_add_le _ _
        have hs := hstep (n + d)
        have hpowC : 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + (d + 1)) = C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + d) := by
          rw [← Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ]
          ring
        linarith
    have hpart_le : ∀ d : ℕ, |a (n + d) - a n| ≤ 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro d
      have hnn : 0 ≤ 2 * C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + d) := by
        have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
          have := hstep 0
          simp only [pow_zero, mul_one] at this
          exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) this
        positivity
      linarith [hpart d]
    have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => |a (n + d) - a n|)
        Filter.atTop (nhds |L - a n|) := by
      have hshift : Filter.Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => a (n + d)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun d : ℕ => a (d + n)) Filter.atTop (nhds L) :=
          hL.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat n)
        exact h1.congr fun d => by rw [Nat.add_comm]
      exact (hshift.sub tendsto_const_nhds).abs
    exact le_of_tendsto htend (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpart_le)

  have hHalf_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  have hPicard : ∀ (q : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (G : (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)),
      1 ≤ q → 0 ≤ R →
      (∀ d, rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d → rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R (G d)) →
      (∀ d₁ d₂ Δ, 0 ≤ Δ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d₁ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d₂ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q Δ (fun j x => d₁ j x - d₂ j x) →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (Δ / 2) (fun j x => G d₁ j x - G d₂ j x)) →
      ∃ d_star : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d_star ∧ G d_star = d_star := by
    intro q R G hq hR hG_self hG_lip
    let dSeq : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n => Nat.recOn n (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ prev => G prev)
    have hdSeq_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R (dSeq n) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact hTuple_zero q hR
      | succ n ih => exact hG_self (dSeq n) ih
    have hdSeq_diff : ∀ n : ℕ,
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (R * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
          (fun j x => dSeq (n + 1) j x - dSeq n j x) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
        have h1 := hdSeq_mem 1
        refine ⟨by funext x; simp [h1.1, (hdSeq_mem 0).1],
          by funext x; simp [h1.2.1, (hdSeq_mem 0).2.1],
          fun j hj => by funext x; simp [h1.2.2.1 j hj, (hdSeq_mem 0).2.2.1 j hj],
          fun j hj => hJet_congr (fun x => (sub_zero _).symm) (h1.2.2.2.1 j hj),
          fun j hj => hJet_congr (fun x => by dsimp [dSeq]; ring) (h1.2.2.2.2 j hj)⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        have h1 := hG_lip (dSeq (n + 1)) (dSeq n) (R * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) (by positivity)
          (hdSeq_mem (n + 1)) (hdSeq_mem n) ih
        exact hTuple_mono (by rw [pow_succ]; linarith) h1
    have h_cauchy_jk : ∀ j ≤ q, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
        ∃ L : ℝ,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x) Filter.atTop (nhds L) ∧
          ∀ n : ℕ, |L - iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x| ≤
            2 * (R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro j hj k hk x
      refine hGeomTail (R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x) (by positivity) ?_
      intro n
      have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (dSeq (n + 1) j) x :=
        (((hdSeq_mem (n + 1)).2.2.2.1 j hj).2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
      have hc0 : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (dSeq n j) x :=
        (((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 j hj).2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
      have hsub := ((hdSeq_diff n).2.2.2.1 j hj).2.2 k hk x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hc1 hc0] at hsub
      exact le_trans hsub (by ring_nf; exact le_refl _)
    let g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j k x =>
      if h : j ≤ q ∧ k ≤ p then Classical.choose (h_cauchy_jk j h.1 k h.2 x) else 0
    have hg_spec : ∀ j (hj : j ≤ q) k (hk : k ≤ p) (x : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x) Filter.atTop (nhds (g j k x)) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, |g j k x - iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x| ≤
          2 * (R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro j hj k hk x
      simpa only [g, hj, hk, and_self, ↓reduceDIte] using
        Classical.choose_spec (h_cauchy_jk j hj k hk x)
    have hg_unif : ∀ j ≤ q, ∀ k ≤ p,
        TendstoUniformly (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j)) (g j k) Filter.atTop := by
      intro j hj k hk
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hlim0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * (R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using hHalf_tendsto.const_mul (2 * (R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hlim0).2 ε hε] with n hn x
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt ((hg_spec j hj k hk x).2 n) hn
    let d_star : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j => if j ≤ q then g j 0 else 0
    have hd_star_smooth : ∀ j ≤ q,
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (d_star j) ∧
        ∀ k ≤ p, iteratedDeriv k (d_star j) = g j k := by
      intro j hj
      simpa only [d_star, hj, ↓reduceIte] using hUnifDerivLim p (fun n => dSeq n j) (g j)
        (fun n => ((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 j hj).2.1) (fun k hk => hg_unif j hj k hk)
    have hd_star_0 : d_star 0 = 0 := by
      funext x
      have h0 : 0 ≤ q := Nat.zero_le q
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n 0 x) Filter.atTop (nhds (d_star 0 x)) := by
        simpa only [d_star, h0, ↓reduceIte, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
          (hg_spec 0 h0 0 (Nat.zero_le p) x).1
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n 0 x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simp [(hdSeq_mem _).1]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
    have hd_star_q : d_star q = 0 := by
      funext x
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n q x) Filter.atTop (nhds (d_star q x)) := by
        simpa only [d_star, le_refl q, ↓reduceIte, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
          (hg_spec q (le_refl q) 0 (Nat.zero_le p) x).1
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n q x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simp [(hdSeq_mem _).2.1]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
    have hd_star_gt : ∀ j : ℕ, q < j → d_star j = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      have hnot : ¬ j ≤ q := by omega
      simp [d_star, hnot]
    have hd_star_per : ∀ j ≤ q, Function.Periodic (d_star j) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro j hj x
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n j (x + 2 * Real.pi)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (d_star j (x + 2 * Real.pi))) := by
        simpa only [d_star, hj, ↓reduceIte, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
          (hg_spec j hj 0 (Nat.zero_le p) (x + 2 * Real.pi)).1
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dSeq n j x) Filter.atTop (nhds (d_star j x)) := by
        simpa only [d_star, hj, ↓reduceIte, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
          (hg_spec j hj 0 (Nat.zero_le p) x).1
      have heq : (fun n => dSeq n j (x + 2 * Real.pi)) = (fun n => dSeq n j x) :=
        funext fun n => ((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 j hj).1 x
      rw [heq] at ht1
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
    have hd_star_mem : rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d_star := by
      refine ⟨hd_star_0, hd_star_q, hd_star_gt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj
        refine ⟨hd_star_per j hj, (hd_star_smooth j hj).1, ?_⟩
        intro k hk x
        rw [(hd_star_smooth j hj).2 k hk]
        exact le_of_tendsto (hg_spec j hj k hk x).1.abs
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 j hj).2.2 k hk x)
      · intro j hj
        have hj0 : j ≤ q := by omega
        have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ q := by omega
        refine ⟨fun x => by simp [hd_star_per (j + 1) hj1 x, hd_star_per j hj0 x],
          ((hd_star_smooth (j + 1) hj1).1).sub ((hd_star_smooth j hj0).1), ?_⟩
        intro k hk x
        have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (d_star (j + 1)) x :=
          (((hd_star_smooth (j + 1) hj1).1).of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
        have hc0 : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (d_star j) x :=
          (((hd_star_smooth j hj0).1).of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hc1 hc0, (hd_star_smooth (j + 1) hj1).2 k hk,
          (hd_star_smooth j hj0).2 k hk]
        have htend_diff : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun n => |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => dSeq n (j + 1) y - dSeq n j y) x|)
            Filter.atTop (nhds |g (j + 1) k x - g j k x|) := by
          have heq_n : (fun n => |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => dSeq n (j + 1) y - dSeq n j y) x|) =
              (fun n => |iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n (j + 1)) x - iteratedDeriv k (dSeq n j) x|) := by
            funext n
            congr 1
            exact iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
              ((((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1).2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt)
              ((((hdSeq_mem n).2.2.2.1 j hj0).2.1.of_le (Nat.cast_le.mpr hk)).contDiffAt)
          rw [heq_n]

        have ht2_2 := hJet_congr (fun x => (sq _).symm) (hJet_mul ht₂ ht₂)
        have hs2_2 := hJet_congr (fun x => (sq _).symm) (hJet_mul hs₂ hs₂)
        refine hJet_mono ?_ (hJet_add ht2_2 hs2_2)
        have h_eq : C_mul * (9 / (q : ℝ)) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) +
            C_mul * (9 / (q : ℝ)) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) = (162 * C_mul) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [hq_nz]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact div_le_self (by positivity) hq2_ge1
      have hprod_sub := hJet_const_mul 8 (hJet_mul_sub hts2_2 ha₁ hΔ_ts2 hΔ_a)
      refine hJet_congr (fun x => by ring) (hJet_mono ?_ hprod_sub)
      rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 8)]
      have h_eq : 8 * (C_mul * ((36 * C_mul * Δ_base) * J_R.C_jet_R +
          (162 * C_mul) * (J_R.C_jet_R * Δ_base))) = C_g2_lip * Δ_base := by
        dsimp [C_g2_lip]
        ring
      linarith
    have hΔ_inv1 := hJet_inv_one_add_sub hg₁_1 hg₁_2 hΔ_g₁
    have hΔ_inv2 := hJet_inv_one_add_sub hg₂_1 hg₂_2 hΔ_g₂
    obtain ⟨_, hinv1_1⟩ := hJet_inv_one_add hg₁_1
    obtain ⟨_, hinv1_2⟩ := hJet_inv_one_add hg₁_2
    obtain ⟨_, hinv2_1⟩ := hJet_inv_one_add hg₂_1
    have hΔ_Q := hJet_mono (B₂ := C_Q_lip * Δ_base)
      (by
        have h_eq : C_mul * ((C_inv_lip * Δ_base) * C_inv +
            C_inv * (C_inv_lip * (C_g2_lip * Δ_base))) = C_Q_lip * Δ_base := by
          dsimp [C_Q_lip]
          ring
        linarith)
      (hJet_mul_sub hinv1_2 hinv2_1 hΔ_inv1 hΔ_inv2)
    have hQ₁ := hJet_mono (B₂ := C_mul * C_inv ^ 2)
      (by linarith [show C_mul * C_inv * C_inv = C_mul * C_inv ^ 2 by ring])
      (hJet_mul hinv1_1 hinv2_1)
    have hN₂ := hJet_mono (B₂ := C_N / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)
      (by
        have h_eq : C_mul * (C_pow5 * (9 / (q : ℝ)) ^ 5) * J_R.C_jet_R +
            C_mul * (C_pow5 * (9 / (q : ℝ)) ^ 5) * J_R.C_jet_R = C_N / (q : ℝ) ^ 5 := by
          dsimp [C_N]
          field_simp [hq_nz]
          ring
        linarith)
      (hJet_add (hJet_mul (hJet_pow5 ht₂) hb_p₂) (hJet_mul (hJet_pow5 hs₂) hb_m₂))
    have hΔ_NQ := hJet_mul_sub hN₂ hQ₁ hΔ_N hΔ_Q
    have hΔ_Force_raw := hJet_const_mul (-(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi)) hΔ_NQ
    refine hJet_congr
      (fun x => by
        simp only [rdmc_elForcing, hj, ↓reduceIte, ρ]
        ring)
      (hJet_mono ?_ hΔ_Force_raw)
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (div_pos (by positivity) hpi_pos)]
    have h2q_le : 2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi ≤ (q : ℝ) :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hpi_pos).mpr (by nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi])
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ C_mul * ((C_N_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)) * (C_mul * C_inv ^ 2) +
        (C_N / (q : ℝ) ^ 5) * (C_Q_lip * Δ_base)) := by positivity
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2q_le h_rhs_nn
    have h2 : (q : ℝ) * (C_mul * ((C_N_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)) * (C_mul * C_inv ^ 2) +
        (C_N / (q : ℝ) ^ 5) * (C_Q_lip * Δ_base))) =
        C_force_lip * (Δ / (q : ℝ) ^ 6 + Δ_w / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
      dsimp [C_force_lip, Δ_base]
      field_simp [hq_nz]
    linarith

  have hStationary : ∀ (q : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      N_force ≤ q → 0 ≤ R → 8 * R ≤ (q : ℝ) →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R d →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        d (j + 2) x - 2 * d (j + 1) x + d j x = rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d (j + 1) x) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, IsStationaryRealMesh q w x
        (fun j => if j ≤ q then x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d j x else 0) := by
    intro q R w d hq hR h8R hw hd hsec x
    have hq5 : 5 ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left 5 _) hq
    have hq_ge5 : (5 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq5
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hq_nz : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
    have hq_ge1 : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hpi_nz : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    let X : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => if j ≤ q then x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d j x else 0
    have hRq2_le_invq : R / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hq_pos 2) hq_pos]
      nlinarith
    have hRq3_le_invq : R / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hRq2_le_invq
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hR (pow_pos hq_pos 2) ?_
      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hq_ge1 (by norm_num : 2 ≤ 3)
    have hCand : IsCandidateRealMesh q x X := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [X, Nat.zero_le q, hd.1]
      · simp only [X, le_refl, ↓reduceIte, hd.2.1, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero]
        field_simp [hq_nz]
      · intro j hj
        simp only [X, hj, ↓reduceIte, add_sub_cancel_left]
        exact le_trans (hJet_eval (hd.2.2.2.1 j hj) x) hRq2_le_invq
      · intro j hj
        have hj0 : j ≤ q := by omega
        have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ q := by omega
        simp only [X, hj0, hj1, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_eq : (x + 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d (j + 1) x -
            (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d j x)) - 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) =
            d (j + 1) x - d j x := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact le_trans (hJet_eval (hd.2.2.2.2 j hj) x) hRq3_le_invq
      · intro j hj
        have hnot : ¬ j ≤ q := by omega
        simp [X, hnot]
    refine ⟨hCand, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hts_le2, _, _, _, _, _, hg_low, _⟩ :=
      hSingleJet q R w d j hq hR h8R hw hd hj
    have hj0 : j ≤ q := by omega
    have hj1 : j + 1 ≤ q := by omega
    have hj2 : j + 2 ≤ q := by omega
    let τ_t : ℝ := d (j + 2) x - d (j + 1) x
    let τ_s : ℝ := d (j + 1) x - d j x
    let t : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_t
    let s : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_s
    have hX1 : X (j + 1) = x + 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d (j + 1) x := by
      simp [X, hj1]
    have hX2 : X (j + 2) = X (j + 1) + t := by
      simp only [X, hj1, hj2, ↓reduceIte, t, τ_t]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hX0 : X j = X (j + 1) + (-s) := by
      simp only [X, hj0, hj1, ↓reduceIte, s, τ_s]
      push_cast
      ring
    change normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X (j + 2)) - normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X j) = 0
    rw [hX2, hX0, J_R.action_factor w hw (X (j + 1)) t (hts_le2 x).1,
      J_R.action_factor w hw (X (j + 1)) (-s) (hts_le2 x).2]
    let a : ℝ := J_R.a_R w (X (j + 1))
    let b_p : ℝ := J_R.b_R w (X (j + 1)) t
    let b_m : ℝ := J_R.b_R w (X (j + 1)) (-s)
    let g₁ : ℝ := ((q : ℝ) / (4 * Real.pi)) * (τ_t + τ_s)
    let g₂ : ℝ := 8 * (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a
    have hg1_nz : 1 + g₁ ≠ 0 := by
      have h1 := (hg_low x).1
      linarith
    have hg2_nz : 1 + g₂ ≠ 0 := by
      have h2 : 1 / 2 ≤ 1 + g₂ := by
        dsimp only [g₂, a, t, s, τ_t, τ_s]
        rw [hX1]
        exact (hg_low x).2
      linarith
    have hts_diff : t - s = rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d (j + 1) x := by
      have h_alg : t - s = d (j + 2) x - 2 * d (j + 1) x + d j x := by
        dsimp [t, s, τ_t, τ_s]
        ring
      rw [h_alg, hsec j hj x]
    have hforce_val : rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d (j + 1) x =
        -(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi) * ((t ^ 5 * b_p + s ^ 5 * b_m) * ((1 + g₁)⁻¹ * (1 + g₂)⁻¹)) := by
      simp only [rdmc_elForcing, hj, ↓reduceIte]
      dsimp [a, b_p, b_m, g₁, g₂, t, s, τ_t, τ_s]
      rw [hX1]
    have hden_fac : (t + s) * (1 / 8 + (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a) =
        (Real.pi / (2 * (q : ℝ))) * (1 + g₁) * (1 + g₂) := by
      dsimp [g₁, g₂, t, s]
      field_simp [hq_nz, hpi_nz]
      ring
    have hpoly : t ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + a * t ^ 2 + t ^ 3 * b_p) -
        (-s) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + a * (-s) ^ 2 + (-s) ^ 3 * b_m) =
        (t - s) * ((t + s) * (1 / 8 + (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a)) + (t ^ 5 * b_p + s ^ 5 * b_m) := by
      ring
    change t ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + a * t ^ 2 + t ^ 3 * b_p) -
      (-s) ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + a * (-s) ^ 2 + (-s) ^ 3 * b_m) = 0
    rw [hpoly, hts_diff, hforce_val, hden_fac]
    field_simp [hq_nz, hpi_nz, hg1_nz, hg2_nz]
    ring

  
  let R_real : ℝ :=
    max (2 * C_force + 1) (max (4 * C_force_lip + 1) (3 * J_R.C_mid_R + 1))
  have hR_real_pos : 0 < R_real :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < 2 * C_force + 1) (le_max_left _ _)
  have h2C_le_R : 2 * C_force ≤ R_real :=
    le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
  have h4Lip_le_R : 4 * C_force_lip ≤ R_real :=
    le_trans (by linarith) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have h3Mid_le_R : 3 * J_R.C_mid_R ≤ R_real :=
    le_trans (by linarith) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hMid_le_R : J_R.C_mid_R ≤ R_real := by
    linarith [J_R.C_mid_R_pos]

  let N_real : ℕ :=
    max 4 (max J_R.N_jet_R (max N_force
      (max (Nat.ceil (8 * R_real) + 1) (Nat.ceil (4 * C_force_lip) + 1))))
  have hN_real_ge4 : 4 ≤ N_real := le_max_left 4 _

  
  have hSolve_w : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      N_real ≤ q →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      let G_w : (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) :=
        fun d => rdmc_dirichletInv q (rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d)
      (∀ u₁ u₂ Δ, 0 ≤ Δ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real u₁ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real u₂ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q Δ (fun j x => u₁ j x - u₂ j x) →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (Δ / 2) (fun j x => G_w u₁ j x - G_w u₂ j x)) ∧
      ∃ d_star : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ,
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real d_star ∧
        G_w d_star = d_star ∧
        HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ j ≤ q,
          realMesh q w x j = x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d_star j x) ∧
        (∀ j ≤ q, realMeshDisp q w j = d_star j) := by
    intro q w hq hw
    dsimp only
    let G_w : (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) → (ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) :=
      fun d => rdmc_dirichletInv q (rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d)
    have hq4 : 4 ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left 4 _) hq
    have hq_jet : J_R.N_jet_R ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right 4 _)) hq
    have hq_force : N_force ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 4 _))) hq
    have hq_8R : Nat.ceil (8 * R_real) + 1 ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 4 _)))) hq
    have hq_4L : Nat.ceil (4 * C_force_lip) + 1 ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 4 _)))) hq
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by omega
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hq_nz : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
    have h8R_le : 8 * R_real ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : 8 * R_real ≤ (Nat.ceil (8 * R_real) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (8 * R_real)
      have h2 : (Nat.ceil (8 * R_real) : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hq_8R
      linarith
    have h4L_le_q2 : 4 * C_force_lip ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 4 * C_force_lip ≤ (Nat.ceil (4 * C_force_lip) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (4 * C_force_lip)
      have h2 : (Nat.ceil (4 * C_force_lip) : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hq_4L
      have hq_ge1 : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hq1
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((q : ℝ) - 1)]
    have hG_self : ∀ d, rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real d →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real (G_w d) := by
      intro d hd
      have hf : ∀ j, j + 1 < q →
          IsRealJetPerturb p (C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) (rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d (j + 1)) :=
        fun j hj => (hSingleJet q R_real w d j hq_force (le_of_lt hR_real_pos) h8R_le hw hd hj).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      have hb := hDir_bound q (C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) (rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d)
        hq1 (by positivity) hf
      refine hTuple_mono ?_ hb
      have h_eq : 2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * (C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) = 2 * C_force := by
        field_simp [hq_nz]
      linarith
    have hG_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ Δ, 0 ≤ Δ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real u₁ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q R_real u₂ →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q Δ (fun j x => u₁ j x - u₂ j x) →
        rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple p q (Δ / 2) (fun j x => G_w u₁ j x - G_w u₂ j x) := by
      intro u₁ u₂ Δ hΔ hu₁ hu₂ hΔu
      have hf_diff : ∀ j, j + 1 < q →
          IsRealJetPerturb p (C_force_lip * (Δ / (q : ℝ) ^ 6))
            (fun x => rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₁ (j + 1) x -
              rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₂ (j + 1) x) := by
        intro j hj
        have h1 := hForcing_lip q R_real Δ w w u₁ u₂ j hq_force (le_of_lt hR_real_pos)
          h8R_le hΔ hw hw hu₁ hu₂ hΔu hj
        rwa [hDiffSup_self w, zero_div, add_zero] at h1
      have hb := hDir_bound q (C_force_lip * (Δ / (q : ℝ) ^ 6))
        (fun i y => rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₁ i y - rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₂ i y)
        hq1 (by positivity) hf_diff
      have heq_G : (fun j x => G_w u₁ j x - G_w u₂ j x) =
          rdmc_dirichletInv q
            (fun i y => rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₁ i y - rdmc_elForcing J_R q w u₂ i y) := by
        funext j x
        exact hDir_sub q j _ _ x
      rw [← heq_G] at hb
      refine hTuple_mono ?_ hb
      have h_eq : 2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 4 * (C_force_lip * (Δ / (q : ℝ) ^ 6)) =
          ((2 * C_force_lip) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δ := by
        field_simp [hq_nz]
      rw [h_eq]
      have h_half : (2 * C_force_lip) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        (div_le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hq_pos 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).mpr (by linarith)
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_half hΔ
      linarith
    obtain ⟨d_star, hd_star, hfix⟩ := hPicard q R_real G_w hq1 (le_of_lt hR_real_pos) hG_self hG_lip
    have hsec_star : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        d_star (j + 2) x - 2 * d_star (j + 1) x + d_star j x =
          rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d_star (j + 1) x := by
      intro j hj x
      have h0 : d_star j x = G_w d_star j x := by rw [hfix]
      have h1 : d_star (j + 1) x = G_w d_star (j + 1) x := by rw [hfix]
      have h2 : d_star (j + 2) x = G_w d_star (j + 2) x := by rw [hfix]
      rw [h0, h1, h2]
      exact hDir_second_diff q j (rdmc_elForcing J_R q w d_star) x hj
    let X_star : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ := fun x j =>
      if j ≤ q then x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d_star j x else 0
    have hX_stat : ∀ x : ℝ, IsStationaryRealMesh q w x (X_star x) :=
      hStationary q R_real w d_star hq_force (le_of_lt hR_real_pos) h8R_le hw hd_star hsec_star
    have hw_c4 : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w :=
      hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hMesh : HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w := by
      refine ⟨hq4, hw.1, hw_c4, ?_⟩
      intro x
      exact ⟨X_star x, hX_stat x, fun Y hY =>
        J_R.candidate_unique q w hq_jet hw x Y (X_star x) hY (hX_stat x)⟩
    have hMesh_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, realMesh q w x = X_star x := by
      intro x
      have hchoose : IsStationaryRealMesh q w x (realMesh q w x) := by
        simpa only [realMesh, hMesh, ↓reduceDIte] using
          Classical.choose_spec (hMesh.2.2.2 x).exists
      exact J_R.candidate_unique q w hq_jet hw x (realMesh q w x) (X_star x) hchoose (hX_stat x)
    have hMesh_eval : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ j ≤ q,
        realMesh q w x j = x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d_star j x := by
      intro x j hj
      rw [hMesh_eq x]
      simp [X_star, hj]
    have hDisp_eq : ∀ j ≤ q, realMeshDisp q w j = d_star j := by
      intro j hj
      funext x
      simp only [realMeshDisp, hMesh_eval x j hj]
      ring
    exact ⟨hG_lip, d_star, hd_star, hfix, hMesh, hMesh_eval, hDisp_eq⟩

  refine ⟨{
    R_real := R_real
    N_real := N_real
    R_real_pos := hR_real_pos
    N_real_ge_four := hN_real_ge4
    real_mesh_props := ?_
    real_mesh_lip := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro q w hq hw
    obtain ⟨_, d_star, hd_star, _, hMesh, hMesh_eval, hDisp_eq⟩ := hSolve_w q w hq hw
    have hq4 : 4 ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left 4 _) hq
    have hq_jet : J_R.N_jet_R ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right 4 _)) hq
    have hq_8R : Nat.ceil (8 * R_real) + 1 ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 4 _)))) hq
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)

      · intro k hk x

        (by rw [hΔτ_eq]; exact (hd_diff_4L.2.2.2.2 j hj).2.2)

real_dirichlet_mesh_contraction.definitions:
def rdmc_IsBoundedDispTuple (p q : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  d 0 = 0 ∧
  d q = 0 ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → d j = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → IsRealJetPerturb p (B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (d j)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    IsRealJetPerturb p (B / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun x : ℝ => d (j + 1) x - d j x))

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletPrefix (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (i + 1) x

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletSlope0 (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(q : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x

noncomputable def rdmc_dirichletInv (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if j ≤ q then
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, (rdmc_dirichletSlope0 q f x + rdmc_dirichletPrefix f r x)
  else 0

noncomputable def rdmc_elForcing {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_R : RealJetAndUniquenessData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (i : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  match i with
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 =>
    if j + 1 < q then
      let X : ℝ := x + 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + d (j + 1) x;
      let τ_t : ℝ := d (j + 2) x - d (j + 1) x;
      let τ_s : ℝ := d (j + 1) x - d j x;
      let t : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_t;
      let s : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + τ_s;
      let g₁ : ℝ := ((q : ℝ) / (4 * Real.pi)) * (τ_t + τ_s);
      let g₂ : ℝ := 8 * (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * J_R.a_R w X;
      (-(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi)) *
        ((t ^ 5 * J_R.b_R w X t + s ^ 5 * J_R.b_R w X (-s)) *
          ((1 + g₁)⁻¹ * (1 + g₂)⁻¹))
    else 0
