  obtain ⟨hAnalyticEq, hRealId⟩ := strip_real_id_and_analytic_uniqueness
  let R_strip : ℝ :=
    max (4 * F_bd.C_force + 1)
      (max (4 * F_bd.C_force_lip + 1) (3 * J_C.C_mid_C + 1))
  let K_strip : ℝ := 6 * R_strip + J_C.K_eval + 1
  let N_strip : ℕ :=
    max (max 4 R_sys.N_real)
      (max F_bd.N_force
        (max (Nat.ceil (16 * R_strip) + 1) (Nat.ceil (8 * F_bd.C_force_lip) + 1)))
  have hC_force_pos : 0 < F_bd.C_force := F_bd.C_force_pos
  have hC_lip_pos : 0 < F_bd.C_force_lip := F_bd.C_force_lip_pos
  have hC_mid_pos : 0 < J_C.C_mid_C := J_C.C_mid_C_pos
  have hK_eval_pos : 0 < J_C.K_eval := J_C.K_eval_pos
  have hR_ge_force1 : 4 * F_bd.C_force + 1 ≤ R_strip := le_max_left _ _
  have hR_ge_lip1 : 4 * F_bd.C_force_lip + 1 ≤ R_strip :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hR_ge_mid1 : 3 * J_C.C_mid_C + 1 ≤ R_strip :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hR_pos : 0 < R_strip := by linarith
  have hR_force : 4 * F_bd.C_force ≤ R_strip := by linarith

  · intro σ q w W hσ hq hKq hw hW
    exact ⟨stripCanonX_ℂ J_C q W, stripCanonMu_ℂ J_C q W,
      (hCanon_props σ q w W hσ hq hKq hw hW).2⟩
  · intro σ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ hσ hq hKq hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ hX hμ
    obtain ⟨hq4, _, hq_force, hq_jet, hq_R, hq_lip⟩ := hq_bounds q hq
    obtain ⟨hσ_mesh_pos, hα_Icc, _, _, hσ_le2, _⟩ := hScale_bounds σ q hσ hq hKq
    let σ_mesh : ℝ := (1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    let α : ℝ := R_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    let d₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₁
    let d₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₂
    let X_c₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonX_ℂ J_C q W₁
    let X_c₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonX_ℂ J_C q W₂
    let μ_c₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonMu_ℂ J_C q W₁
    let μ_c₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonMu_ℂ J_C q W₂
    obtain ⟨hd₁_ball, _, hXc₁_props, hμc₁_props⟩ := hCanon_props σ q w₁ W₁ hσ hq hKq hw₁ hW₁
    obtain ⟨hd₂_ball, _, hXc₂_props, hμc₂_props⟩ := hCanon_props σ q w₂ W₂ hσ hq hKq hw₂ hW₂
    obtain ⟨_, hPicLip⟩ :=
      strip_picard_convergence_and_lip m M₁ hm hM₁ J_C hDir F_bd R_strip K_strip σ q
        hR_pos hR_force hR_lip hK_eval hσ hq_force hq_R hq_lip hKq
    obtain ⟨hLip_d, hLip_step⟩ := hPicLip w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂
    obtain ⟨hd₁_pert, hτ₁_pert⟩ := hBall_to_perturb σ_mesh q d₁ hq hd₁_ball
    obtain ⟨hd₂_pert, hτ₂_pert⟩ := hBall_to_perturb σ_mesh q d₂ hq hd₂_ball
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
    have hq_sq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
    have hq_cube_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_pos hq_pos 3
    have hq_ne_C : (q : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show q ≠ 0 by omega)
    have hSupNonneg : 0 ≤ stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨j, _, ζ, _, rfl⟩
      exact norm_nonneg _
    have hXc₁_eq : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        X_c₁ j = fun ζ : ℂ => ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + d₁ j ζ := by
      intro j hj
      ext ζ
      simp [X_c₁, stripCanonX_ℂ, d₁, hj]
    have hXc₂_eq : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        X_c₂ j = fun ζ : ℂ => ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + d₂ j ζ := by
      intro j hj
      ext ζ
      simp [X_c₂, stripCanonX_ℂ, d₂, hj]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      obtain ⟨hX₁_holo, hX₂_holo, hX₁_real, hX₂_real⟩ := hX j hj
      obtain ⟨hXc₁_holo, hXc₁_real, _⟩ := hXc₁_props j hj
      obtain ⟨hXc₂_holo, hXc₂_real, _⟩ := hXc₂_props j hj
      have hId :=
        hAnalyticEq σ_mesh (X_ℂ₁ j) (X_c₁ j) (X_ℂ₂ j) (X_c₂ j)
          hσ_mesh_pos hX₁_holo hXc₁_holo hX₂_holo hXc₂_holo
          (fun x => (hX₁_real x).trans (hXc₁_real x).symm)
          (fun x => (hX₂_real x).trans (hXc₂_real x).symm)
          k z hz
      have hDiff_eq :
          (fun ζ : ℂ => X_c₁ j ζ - X_c₂ j ζ) = (fun ζ : ℂ => d₁ j ζ - d₂ j ζ) := by
        ext ζ
        rw [hXc₁_eq j hj, hXc₂_eq j hj]
        ring
      rw [hId, hDiff_eq]
      exact hLip_d j hj k hk z hz
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      have hj_le : j ≤ q := le_of_lt hj
      have hj1_le : j + 1 ≤ q := hj
      obtain ⟨hX₁_0, hX₂_0, hX₁_r0, hX₂_r0⟩ := hX j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hX₁_1, hX₂_1, hX₁_r1, hX₂_r1⟩ := hX (j + 1) hj1_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₁_0, hXc₁_r0, _⟩ := hXc₁_props j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₁_1, hXc₁_r1, _⟩ := hXc₁_props (j + 1) hj1_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₂_0, hXc₂_r0, _⟩ := hXc₂_props j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₂_1, hXc₂_r1, _⟩ := hXc₂_props (j + 1) hj1_le
      have hId :=
        hAnalyticEq σ_mesh
          (fun ζ => X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ)
          (fun ζ => X_c₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₁ j ζ)
          (fun ζ => X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ)
          (fun ζ => X_c₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₂ j ζ)
          hσ_mesh_pos
          (hX₁_1.sub hX₁_0) (hXc₁_1.sub hXc₁_0)
          (hX₂_1.sub hX₂_0) (hXc₂_1.sub hXc₂_0)
          (fun x => by dsimp only [X_c₁]; rw [hX₁_r1 x, hX₁_r0 x, hXc₁_r1 x, hXc₁_r0 x])
          (fun x => by dsimp only [X_c₂]; rw [hX₂_r1 x, hX₂_r0 x, hXc₂_r1 x, hXc₂_r0 x])
          k z hz
      have hDiff_eq :
          (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_c₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₁ j ζ) - (X_c₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₂ j ζ)) =
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              (d₁ (j + 1) ζ - d₁ j ζ) - (d₂ (j + 1) ζ - d₂ j ζ)) := by
        ext ζ
        rw [hXc₁_eq (j + 1) hj1_le, hXc₁_eq j hj_le,
          hXc₂_eq (j + 1) hj1_le, hXc₂_eq j hj_le]
        ring
      rw [hId, hDiff_eq]
      exact hLip_step j hj k hk z hz
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      have hj_le : j ≤ q := le_of_lt hj
      have hj1_le : j + 1 ≤ q := hj
      obtain ⟨hX₁_0, hX₂_0, hX₁_r0, hX₂_r0⟩ := hX j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hX₁_1, hX₂_1, hX₁_r1, hX₂_r1⟩ := hX (j + 1) hj1_le
      obtain ⟨hμ₁_holo, hμ₂_holo, hμ₁_real, hμ₂_real⟩ := hμ j hj
      obtain ⟨hXc₁_0, hXc₁_r0, _⟩ := hXc₁_props j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₁_1, hXc₁_r1, _⟩ := hXc₁_props (j + 1) hj1_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₂_0, hXc₂_r0, _⟩ := hXc₂_props j hj_le
      obtain ⟨hXc₂_1, hXc₂_r1, _⟩ := hXc₂_props (j + 1) hj1_le
      obtain ⟨hμc₁_holo, hμc₁_real, _⟩ := hμc₁_props j hj
      obtain ⟨hμc₂_holo, hμc₂_real, _⟩ := hμc₂_props j hj
      have hId :=
        hAnalyticEq σ_mesh
          (fun ζ => μ_ℂ₁ j ζ - (X_ℂ₁ j ζ + (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) / 2))
          (fun ζ => μ_c₁ j ζ - (X_c₁ j ζ + (X_c₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₁ j ζ) / 2))
          (fun ζ => μ_ℂ₂ j ζ - (X_ℂ₂ j ζ + (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) / 2))
          (fun ζ => μ_c₂ j ζ - (X_c₂ j ζ + (X_c₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₂ j ζ) / 2))
          hσ_mesh_pos
          (hμ₁_holo.sub (hX₁_0.add ((hX₁_1.sub hX₁_0).div_const 2)))
          (hμc₁_holo.sub (hXc₁_0.add ((hXc₁_1.sub hXc₁_0).div_const 2)))
          (hμ₂_holo.sub (hX₂_0.add ((hX₂_1.sub hX₂_0).div_const 2)))
          (hμc₂_holo.sub (hXc₂_0.add ((hXc₂_1.sub hXc₂_0).div_const 2)))
          (fun x => by
            dsimp only [μ_c₁, X_c₁]
            rw [hμ₁_real x, hX₁_r0 x, hX₁_r1 x, hμc₁_real x, hXc₁_r0 x, hXc₁_r1 x])
          (fun x => by
            dsimp only [μ_c₂, X_c₂]
            rw [hμ₂_real x, hX₂_r0 x, hX₂_r1 x, hμc₂_real x, hXc₂_r0 x, hXc₂_r1 x])
          k z hz
      let Δ_W : ℝ := stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂
      let Δe : ℝ := R_strip * Δ_W / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
      let Δτ : ℝ := R_strip * Δ_W / (q : ℝ) ^ 3
      let ρ_j : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)
      have hΔe_nonneg : 0 ≤ Δe :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR_pos) hSupNonneg) (le_of_lt hq_sq_pos)
      have hΔτ_nonneg : 0 ≤ Δτ :=
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR_pos) hSupNonneg) (le_of_lt hq_cube_pos)
      have hΔe_bnd : ∀ k' : ℕ, k' ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z' ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
          ‖iteratedDeriv k' (fun ζ => d₁ j ζ - d₂ j ζ) z'‖ ≤ Δe := by
        intro k' hk' z' hz'
        exact (le_div_iff₀' hq_sq_pos).mpr (hLip_d j hj_le k' hk' z' hz')
      have hΔτ_bnd : ∀ k' : ℕ, k' ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z' ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
          ‖iteratedDeriv k'
            (fun ζ => (d₁ (j + 1) ζ - d₁ j ζ) - (d₂ (j + 1) ζ - d₂ j ζ)) z'‖ ≤ Δτ := by
        intro k' hk' z' hz'
        exact (le_div_iff₀' hq_cube_pos).mpr (hLip_step j hj k' hk' z' hz')
      have hMidLip :=
        J_C.midpoint_lip σ σ_mesh α ρ_j Δe Δτ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂
          (d₁ j) (fun ζ => d₁ (j + 1) ζ - d₁ j ζ)
          (d₂ j) (fun ζ => d₂ (j + 1) ζ - d₂ j ζ)
          hσ hq_jet hα_Icc hσ_mesh_pos hσ_le2 hΔe_nonneg hΔτ_nonneg
          hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂
          (hd₁_pert j hj_le) (hτ₁_pert j hj)
          (hd₂_pert j hj_le) (hτ₂_pert j hj)
          hΔe_bnd hΔτ_bnd k hk z hz
      have hCanonMid_eq :
          (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (μ_c₁ j ζ - (X_c₁ j ζ + (X_c₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₁ j ζ) / 2)) -
              (μ_c₂ j ζ - (X_c₂ j ζ + (X_c₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₂ j ζ) / 2))) =
            (fun ζ : ℂ =>
              (J_C.mid_C W₁ ρ_j q (d₁ j) (fun w' => d₁ (j + 1) w' - d₁ j w') ζ -
                ((ζ + (ρ_j : ℂ) + d₁ j ζ) +
                  (((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d₁ (j + 1) ζ - d₁ j ζ)) / 2)) -
              (J_C.mid_C W₂ ρ_j q (d₂ j) (fun w' => d₂ (j + 1) w' - d₂ j w') ζ -
                ((ζ + (ρ_j : ℂ) + d₂ j ζ) +
                  (((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d₂ (j + 1) ζ - d₂ j ζ)) / 2))) := by
        ext ζ
        have hStep₁ :
            X_c₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₁ j ζ =
              ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d₁ (j + 1) ζ - d₁ j ζ) := by
          rw [hXc₁_eq (j + 1) hj1_le, hXc₁_eq j hj_le]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hq_ne_C]
          ring
        have hStep₂ :
            X_c₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_c₂ j ζ =
              ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d₂ (j + 1) ζ - d₂ j ζ) := by
          rw [hXc₂_eq (j + 1) hj1_le, hXc₂_eq j hj_le]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hq_ne_C]
          ring
        have hμ₁_def :
            μ_c₁ j ζ = J_C.mid_C W₁ ρ_j q (d₁ j) (fun w' => d₁ (j + 1) w' - d₁ j w') ζ := by
          simp [μ_c₁, stripCanonMu_ℂ, d₁, ρ_j, hj]
        have hμ₂_def :
            μ_c₂ j ζ = J_C.mid_C W₂ ρ_j q (d₂ j) (fun w' => d₂ (j + 1) w' - d₂ j w') ζ := by
          simp [μ_c₂, stripCanonMu_ℂ, d₂, ρ_j, hj]
        rw [hμ₁_def, hμ₂_def, hStep₁, hStep₂, hXc₁_eq j hj_le, hXc₂_eq j hj_le]
      rw [hId, hCanonMid_eq]
      have hCoeff :
          J_C.C_mid_C * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + Δ_W) ≤ R_strip * Δ_W := by
        have hq_ne_R : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
        have hSum : Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + Δ_W = (2 * α + 1) * Δ_W := by
          simp only [Δe, Δτ, α]
          field_simp [hq_ne_R]
          ring
        rw [hSum]
        have h2α1 : 2 * α + 1 ≤ 3 := by linarith [hα_Icc.2]
        have h1 : (2 * α + 1) * Δ_W ≤ 3 * Δ_W :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2α1 hSupNonneg
        have h2 : J_C.C_mid_C * ((2 * α + 1) * Δ_W) ≤ (3 * J_C.C_mid_C) * Δ_W := by
          calc
            J_C.C_mid_C * ((2 * α + 1) * Δ_W)
              ≤ J_C.C_mid_C * (3 * Δ_W) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (le_of_lt hC_mid_pos)
            _ = (3 * J_C.C_mid_C) * Δ_W := by ring
        exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR_mid3 hSupNonneg)
      exact le_trans hMidLip hCoeff

strip_dirichlet_mesh_contraction.definitions:
def IsStripCJetBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B)

def IsStripMeshDispBall (p q : ℕ) (σ' R : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ z : ℂ, d 0 z = 0 ∧ d q z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → ∀ z : ℂ, d j z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (d j) (horizStrip σ') ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = d j z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (d j z)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (d j) z‖ ≤ R)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d (j + 1) ζ - d j ζ) z‖ ≤ R)

noncomputable def dirichletPartSum_ℂ (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (i + 1) z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope0_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -((q : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dirichletSlope0_ℂ q f z + dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletInv_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, dirichletSlope_ℂ q f r z else 0

noncomputable def stripForcingAt_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)
  let X : ℂ := z + (ρ : ℂ) + d (j + 1) z
  let τ_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d (j + 2) ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let τ_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d j ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let t : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_plus z
  let s : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d (j + 1) z - d j z)
  let a_val : ℂ := J_C.a_C W X
  let b_plus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ 1 q (d (j + 1)) τ_plus z
  let b_minus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ (-1) q (d (j + 1)) τ_minus z
  (-(t ^ 5 * b_plus + s ^ 5 * b_minus)) /
    ((t + s) * (1 / 8 + (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a_val))

noncomputable def stripMeshForcing_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => if j + 1 < q then stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j else 0

noncomputable def stripMeshStep_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ :=
  dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d)

noncomputable def stripMeshIter_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ℕ → (ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0 => fun _ _ => 0
  | n + 1 => stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W (stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n)

noncomputable def stripCanonDisp_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n j z) else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonX_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then
    z + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j z
  else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonMu_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j < q then
    J_C.mid_C W (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) q
      (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j)
      (fun ζ => stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W (j + 1) ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j ζ) z
  else 0

structure StripDirichletInvProp : Prop where
  boundary_and_outside : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    1 ≤ q →
    (∀ z : ℂ, dirichletInv_ℂ q f 0 z = 0 ∧ dirichletInv_ℂ q f q z = 0) ∧

  diff_identities : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),

      dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 1) z - dirichletInv_ℂ q f j z = dirichletSlope_ℂ q f j z) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ z : ℂ,
      dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 2) z - 2 * dirichletInv_ℂ q f (j + 1) z +

  sub_eq : ∀ (q : ℕ) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
    dirichletInv_ℂ q f₁ j z - dirichletInv_ℂ q f₂ j z =
      dirichletInv_ℂ q (fun i ζ => f₁ i ζ - f₂ i ζ) j z
  maps_to_ball : ∀ (p q : ℕ) (σ' M_f : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),

    0 ≤ M_f →

  real_stationary_of_sec_diff :
    ∀ (σ σ' R : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),

  forcing_lip :

      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →

def IsStripCJetBounded (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (z + 2 * Real.pi) = f z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B)

def IsStripMeshDispBall (p q : ℕ) (σ' R : ℝ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ z : ℂ, d 0 z = 0 ∧ d q z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → ∀ z : ℂ, d j z = 0) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (d j) (horizStrip σ') ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = d j z) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', d j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (d j z)) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (d j) z‖ ≤ R)) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d (j + 1) ζ - d j ζ) z‖ ≤ R)

noncomputable def dirichletPartSum_ℂ (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, f (i + 1) z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope0_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -((q : ℂ)⁻¹) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletSlope_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (r : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dirichletSlope0_ℂ q f z + dirichletPartSum_ℂ f r z

noncomputable def dirichletInv_ℂ (q : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then ∑ r ∈ Finset.range j, dirichletSlope_ℂ q f r z else 0

noncomputable def stripForcingAt_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let ρ : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)
  let X : ℂ := z + (ρ : ℂ) + d (j + 1) z
  let τ_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d (j + 2) ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let τ_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => d j ζ - d (j + 1) ζ
  let t : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + τ_plus z
  let s : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (d (j + 1) z - d j z)
  let a_val : ℂ := J_C.a_C W X
  let b_plus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ 1 q (d (j + 1)) τ_plus z
  let b_minus : ℂ := J_C.b_C W ρ (-1) q (d (j + 1)) τ_minus z
  (-(t ^ 5 * b_plus + s ^ 5 * b_minus)) /
    ((t + s) * (1 / 8 + (t ^ 2 + s ^ 2) * a_val))

noncomputable def stripMeshForcing_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => 0
  | j + 1 => if j + 1 < q then stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j else 0

noncomputable def stripMeshStep_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ :=
  dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d)

noncomputable def stripMeshIter_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ℕ → (ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0 => fun _ _ => 0
  | n + 1 => stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W (stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n)

noncomputable def stripCanonDisp_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W n j z) else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonX_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j ≤ q then
    z + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j z
  else 0

noncomputable def stripCanonMu_ℂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ}
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁) (q : ℕ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if j < q then
    J_C.mid_C W (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) q
      (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j)
      (fun ζ => stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W (j + 1) ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j ζ) z
  else 0

      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        d (j + 2) x - 2 * d (j + 1) x + d j x = stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j x) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (x : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + d j x =
          (realMesh q w x j : ℂ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D :
      ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ U, f p = 0 := by
    intro U V f hU_open hU_pre hV_open hV_ne hVU hf hfV
    let Z_int : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball p δ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p δ, f q = 0 }
    have hZ_open : IsOpen Z_int := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      rintro p ⟨δ, hδ, hB_sub, hB_zero⟩
      refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hdist : dist p' p < δ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp'
      have hδ' : 0 < δ - dist p' p := sub_pos.mpr hdist
      have hsub' : Metric.ball p' (δ - dist p' p) ⊆ Metric.ball p δ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
      exact ⟨δ - dist p' p, hδ', Set.Subset.trans hsub' hB_sub,
        fun q hq => hB_zero q (hsub' hq)⟩
    have hZ_ne : (U ∩ Z_int).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hV_ne
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p₀ hp₀
      exact ⟨p₀, hVU hp₀, r₀, hr₀, Set.Subset.trans hr₀_sub hVU,
        fun q hq => hfV q (hr₀_sub hq)⟩
    have hZ_cl : closure Z_int ∩ U ⊆ Z_int := by
      rintro p₁ ⟨hp₁_cl, hp₁_U⟩
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hB₁_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p₁ hp₁_U
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂_Z, hdist₁₂⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₁_cl δ₁ hδ₁
      have hp₂_B₁ : p₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ δ₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        exact hdist₁₂
      obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, _, hf₂⟩ := hp₂_Z
      refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hB₁_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => p₂ + z • (q - p₂)
      have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
        (differentiable_const p₂).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - p₂))
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := hγ_diff.continuous
      let V_z : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₁ δ₁
      have hVz_open : IsOpen V_z := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_cont
      have hVz_conv : Convex ℝ V_z := by
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
        show γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ Metric.ball p₁ δ₁
        have hγ_comb : γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • γ z₁ + b • γ z₂ := by
          dsimp [γ]
          calc
            p₂ + (a • z₁ + b • z₂) • (q - p₂)
                = (a + b) • p₂ + (a • z₁) • (q - p₂) + (b • z₂) • (q - p₂) := by
                    rw [hab, one_smul, add_smul, add_assoc]
            _ = a • p₂ + b • p₂ + a • (z₁ • (q - p₂)) + b • (z₂ • (q - p₂)) := by
                    rw [add_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc]
            _ = a • (p₂ + z₁ • (q - p₂)) + b • (p₂ + z₂ • (q - p₂)) := by
                    simp only [smul_add]
                    abel
        rw [hγ_comb]
        exact convex_ball p₁ δ₁ hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ V_z := by
        show γ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p₁ δ₁
        simpa [γ] using hp₂_B₁
      have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ V_z := by
        show γ 1 ∈ Metric.ball p₁ δ₁
        simpa [γ] using hq
      have hfg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f ∘ γ) V_z :=
        hf.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun z hz => hB₁_sub hz)
      have hfg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ γ) V_z :=
        hfg_diff.analyticOnNhd hVz_open
      have hfg_ev : (f ∘ γ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
        have h_nhds : γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₂ δ₂ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
          apply (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_cont).mem_nhds
          show γ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p₂ δ₂
          have hp₂_self : p₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ δ₂ := Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₂
          simpa [γ] using hp₂_self
        exact Filter.eventually_of_mem h_nhds (fun z hz => hf₂ (γ z) hz)
      have h_eq := hfg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hVz_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem hfg_ev h1_mem
      simpa [Function.comp, γ] using h_eq
    have hU_sub : U ⊆ Z_int :=
      hU_pre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hZ_open hZ_ne hZ_cl
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, _, hzero⟩ := hU_sub hp
    exact hzero p (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)

  have exists_ne_zero_on_open :
      ∀ {B V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen B → IsPreconnected B → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B, g q₀ ≠ 0) → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B →
        ∃ x₁ ∈ V, g x₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro B V g hB_open hB_pre hg ⟨q₀, hq₀B, hq₀_ne⟩ hV_open hV_ne hVB
    by_contra h_all
    have h_zero : ∀ x ∈ V, g x = 0 :=
      fun x hx => Classical.not_not.mp (fun hne => h_all ⟨x, hx, hne⟩)
    exact hq₀_ne (eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hB_open hB_pre hV_open hV_ne hVB hg h_zero q₀ hq₀B)

  have cancel_holo_of_ne_zero :
      ∀ {U B V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → DifferentiableOn ℂ h U →
        IsOpen B → IsPreconnected B → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B, g q₀ ≠ 0) →
        IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U → V ⊆ B →
        (∀ q ∈ V, h q * g q = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ U, h q = 0 := by
    intro U B V h g hU_open hU_pre hh hB_open hB_pre hg hg_nz hV_open hV_ne hVU hVB hprod
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁V, hx₁_ne⟩ :=
      exists_ne_zero_on_open hB_open hB_pre hg hg_nz hV_open hV_ne hVB
    have hcont : ContinuousAt g x₁ :=
      hg.continuousOn.continuousAt (hB_open.mem_nhds (hVB hx₁V))
    have h_nhds : V ∩ g ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ ∈ nhds x₁ :=
      Filter.inter_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hx₁V)
        (hcont.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hx₁_ne))
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    have hh_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball x₁ η₁, h q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq_mem := hη₁_sub hq
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod q hq_mem.1) with hh0 | hg0
      · exact hh0
      · exact False.elim (hq_mem.2 hg0)
    exact eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_open hU_pre Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hη₁⟩
      (fun q hq => hVU (hη₁_sub hq).1) hh hh_sub

  have meroEqOn_symm :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U h
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h.1 hp).2, (h.1 hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [min_comm] at hq
    exact (h.2 p hp q hq).symm

  have meroEqOn_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U V h hVU
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU h.1, fun p hp => h.2 p (hVU hp)⟩

  have meroEqOn_trans :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃}
        {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ F₁ F₂ F₃ U h₁₂ h₂₃
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h₁₂.1 hp).1, (h₂₃.1 hp).2⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (h₁₂.1 hp).1
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (h₁₂.1 hp).2
    have hp₃ : p ∈ W₃ := (h₂₃.1 hp).2
    let r₁₃ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₃.rad p)
    let r₁₂₃ : ℝ := min r₁₃ (F₂.rad p)
    have hr₁₃ : 0 < r₁₃ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₃.rad_pos p hp₃)
    have hr₁₂₃ : 0 < r₁₂₃ := lt_min hr₁₃ (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
    have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => F₁.num p q * F₃.den p q - F₃.num p q * F₁.den p q)
        (Metric.ball p r₁₃) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₃.den_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₃.num_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hprod_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r₁₂₃,
        (F₁.num p q * F₃.den p q - F₃.num p q * F₁.den p q) * F₂.den p q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq₁₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)) hq
      have hq₂₃ : q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hq
      have e₁₂ := h₁₂.2 p hp q hq₁₂
      have e₂₃ := h₂₃.2 p hp q hq₂₃
      linear_combination F₃.den p q * e₁₂ + F₁.den p q * e₂₃
    intro q hq
    have hzero := cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r₁₃).isPreconnected hdiff_holo
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F₂.rad p)).isPreconnected (F₂.den_holo p hp₂)
      (F₂.den_ne_zero p hp₂)
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁₂₃⟩
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      hprod_zero q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

  have restrictMero :
      ∀ {W W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W),
        IsOpen W' → W' ⊆ W → ∃ F' : MeroOn2D W', MeroEqOn F' F W' := by
    intro W W' F hW'_open hSub
    let r_in : ∀ p ∈ W', ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW'_open p hp)
    have hr_in_spec : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W'),
        0 < r_in p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_in p hp) ⊆ W' :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW'_open p hp)
    let F' : MeroOn2D W' := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W' then min (F.rad p) (r_in p hp) else 1
      num := F.num
      den := F.den
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact lt_min (F.rad_pos p (hSub hp)) (hr_in_spec p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hr_in_spec p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.num_holo p (hSub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.den_holo p (hSub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        have hr' : 0 < min (F.rad p) (r_in p hp) :=
          lt_min (F.rad_pos p (hSub hp)) (hr_in_spec p hp).1
        exact exists_ne_zero_on_open
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F.rad p)).isPreconnected
          (F.den_holo p (hSub hp)) (F.den_ne_zero p (hSub hp))
          Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr'⟩
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
        simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceDIte] at hq
        exact F.compat p₁ (hSub hp₁) p₂ (hSub hp₂) q
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1,
           Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2⟩
    }
    exact ⟨F', ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hp, hSub hp⟩, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩⟩

  have meroEq_step :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        {p₀ p₁ : ℂ × ℂ},
        p₀ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ → p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        (Metric.ball p₀ (min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)) ∩
          Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁))).Nonempty →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)),
          G₁.num p₀ q * G₂.den p₀ q = G₂.num p₀ q * G₁.den p₀ q) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)),
          G₁.num p₁ q * G₂.den p₁ q = G₂.num p₁ q * G₁.den p₁ q := by
    intro W₁ W₂ G₁ G₂ p₀ p₁ hp₀ hp₁ hV_ne h₀
    let r₀ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)
    let r₁ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)
    let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ∩ Metric.ball p₁ r₁
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hV_pre : IsPreconnected V :=
      ((convex_ball p₀ r₀).inter (convex_ball p₁ r₁)).isPreconnected
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun q => G₁.num p₁ q * G₂.den p₁ q - G₂.num p₁ q * G₁.den p₁ q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p₁ r₁) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((G₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((G₂.num_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hΔ_mul_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Δ q * G₁.den p₀ q) V :=
      (hΔ_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_right).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1).mono
          (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1))
    have hprod₂ : ∀ q ∈ V, (Δ q * G₁.den p₀ q) * G₂.den p₀ q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have c₁ := G₁.compat p₁ hp₁.1 p₀ hp₀.1 q
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2,
         Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1⟩
      have c₂ := G₂.compat p₁ hp₁.2 p₀ hp₀.2 q
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.2,
         Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.1⟩
      have e₀ := h₀ q hq.1
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination
        G₂.den p₁ q * G₂.den p₀ q * c₁ -
        G₁.den p₁ q * G₁.den p₀ q * c₂ +
        G₁.den p₁ q * G₂.den p₁ q * e₀
    have hprod₁ : ∀ q ∈ V, Δ q * G₁.den p₀ q = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
        hV_open hV_pre hΔ_mul_holo
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (G₂.rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        (G₂.den_holo p₀ hp₀.2) (G₂.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.2)
        hV_open hV_ne Set.Subset.rfl
        (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.1)
        hprod₂
    have hΔ_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁, Δ q = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁ r₁).isPreconnected hΔ_holo
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (G₁.rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        (G₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1) (G₁.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.1)
        hV_open hV_ne Set.inter_subset_right
        (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1)
        hprod₁
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_zero q hq)

  have meroEqOn_of_preconnected :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ Ω V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
        Ω ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ → IsOpen Ω → IsPreconnected Ω →
        V ⊆ Ω → V.Nonempty → MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ V →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ Ω := by
    intro W₁ W₂ Ω V G₁ G₂ hΩ_sub hΩ_open hΩ_pre hV_sub hV_ne hEqV
    let Ω_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (G₁.rad p) (G₂.rad p)),
          G₁.num p q * G₂.den p q = G₂.num p q * G₁.den p q }
    have hΩ_eq_open : IsOpen Ω_eq := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      rintro p₀ ⟨hp₀_W, hp₀_eq⟩
      let r₀ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)
      have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.2)
      refine ⟨r₀, hr₀, fun p₁ hp₁ => ?_⟩
      have hp₁_W : p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ :=
        ⟨G₁.ball_sub p₀ hp₀_W.1 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₁),
         G₂.ball_sub p₀ hp₀_W.2 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp₁)⟩

  have glueMeroFamily :
      ∀ {ι : Type} {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_fam : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (G : ∀ i : ι, MeroOn2D (W_fam i)),
        (∀ p, p ∈ W ↔ ∃ i : ι, p ∈ W_fam i) →
        (∀ i j : ι, MeroEqOn (G i) (G j) (W_fam i ∩ W_fam j)) →
        ∃ F_glued : MeroOn2D W, ∀ j : ι, MeroEqOn F_glued (G j) (W_fam j) := by
    intro ι W W_fam G hcov hcompat
    let idx : ∀ p ∈ W, ι := fun p hp => Classical.choose ((hcov p).mp hp)
    have hidx : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W), p ∈ W_fam (idx p hp) :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec ((hcov p).mp hp)
    let F_glued : MeroOn2D W := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then (G (idx p hp)).rad p else 1
      num := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then (G (idx p hp)).num p else fun _ => 0
      den := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then (G (idx p hp)).den p else fun _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).rad_pos p (hidx p hp)
      ball_sub := fun p hp q hq => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte] at hq
        exact (hcov q).mpr ⟨idx p hp, (G (idx p hp)).ball_sub p (hidx p hp) hq⟩
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).num_holo p (hidx p hp)
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).den_holo p (hidx p hp)
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).den_ne_zero p (hidx p hp)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q₀ hq₀ => by
        simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceDIte] at hq₀ ⊢
        let i₁ : ι := idx p₁ hp₁
        let i₂ : ι := idx p₂ hp₂
        have hi₁ : p₁ ∈ W_fam i₁ := hidx p₁ hp₁
        have hi₂ : p₂ ∈ W_fam i₂ := hidx p₂ hp₂
        have hq₀_1 : q₀ ∈ W_fam i₁ := (G i₁).ball_sub p₁ hi₁ hq₀.1
        have hq₀_2 : q₀ ∈ W_fam i₂ := (G i₂).ball_sub p₂ hi₂ hq₀.2
        let r_q : ℝ := min ((G i₁).rad q₀) ((G i₂).rad q₀)
        have hr_q : 0 < r_q := lt_min ((G i₁).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_1) ((G i₂).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_2)
        let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          (Metric.ball p₁ ((G i₁).rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ ((G i₂).rad p₂)) ∩ Metric.ball q₀ r_q
        have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hV_pre : IsPreconnected V :=
          (((convex_ball p₁ ((G i₁).rad p₁)).inter
            (convex_ball p₂ ((G i₂).rad p₂))).inter (convex_ball q₀ r_q)).isPreconnected
        have hq₀_V : q₀ ∈ V := ⟨hq₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_q⟩
        let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun x => (G i₁).num p₁ x * (G i₂).den p₂ x - (G i₂).num p₂ x * (G i₁).den p₁ x
        have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ V :=
          ((((G i₁).num_holo p₁ hi₁).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.1)).mul
            (((G i₂).den_holo p₂ hi₂).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.2))).sub
          ((((G i₂).num_holo p₂ hi₂).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.2)).mul
            (((G i₁).den_holo p₁ hi₁).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.1)))
        have hΔ_mul_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => Δ x * (G i₁).den q₀ x) V :=
          hΔ_holo.mul (((G i₁).den_holo q₀ hq₀_1).mono
            (fun _ hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx.2))
        have hprod₂ : ∀ x ∈ V, (Δ x * (G i₁).den q₀ x) * (G i₂).den q₀ x = 0 := by
          intro x hx
          have c₁ := (G i₁).compat p₁ hi₁ q₀ hq₀_1 x
            ⟨hx.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx.2⟩
          have c₂ := (G i₂).compat p₂ hi₂ q₀ hq₀_2 x
            ⟨hx.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx.2⟩
          have e₁₂ := (hcompat i₁ i₂).2 q₀ ⟨hq₀_1, hq₀_2⟩ x hx.2
          dsimp [Δ]
          linear_combination
            (G i₂).den p₂ x * (G i₂).den q₀ x * c₁ -
            (G i₁).den p₁ x * (G i₁).den q₀ x * c₂ +
            (G i₁).den p₁ x * (G i₂).den p₂ x * e₁₂
        have hprod₁ : ∀ x ∈ V, Δ x * (G i₁).den q₀ x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
            hV_open hV_pre hΔ_mul_holo
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ ((G i₂).rad q₀)).isPreconnected
            ((G i₂).den_holo q₀ hq₀_2) ((G i₂).den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀_2)
            hV_open ⟨q₀, hq₀_V⟩ Set.Subset.rfl
            (fun _ hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx.2)
            hprod₂
        have hΔ_zero : ∀ x ∈ V, Δ x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
            hV_open hV_pre hΔ_holo
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ ((G i₁).rad q₀)).isPreconnected
            ((G i₁).den_holo q₀ hq₀_1) ((G i₁).den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀_1)
            hV_open ⟨q₀, hq₀_V⟩ Set.Subset.rfl
            (fun _ hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx.2)
            hprod₁
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_zero q₀ hq₀_V)
    }
    refine ⟨F_glued, fun j => ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(hcov p).mpr ⟨j, hp⟩, hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩⟩
    have hpW : p ∈ W := (hcov p).mpr ⟨j, hp⟩
    simp only [F_glued, hpW, ↓reduceDIte] at hq ⊢
    exact (hcompat (idx p hpW) j).2 p ⟨hidx p hpW, hp⟩ q hq

      have hp_F : p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ A := hWann_sub (hVthin_sub_inter hp).2
      have hp_col : p ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r } :=
        ⟨hp.1, by linarith [hp.2.1], by linarith [hp.2.2]⟩
      obtain ⟨η_F, hη_F_pos, _hη_F_le, _, hη_F_eq⟩ := hClF.2.2 p hp_col
      obtain ⟨η_V, hη_V_pos, hη_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVthin_open p hp
      let r_min : ℝ := min (G_in.rad p) (F.rad p)
      have hr_min : 0 < r_min := lt_min (G_in.rad_pos p hp_in) (F.rad_pos p hp_F)
      let η : ℝ := min r_min (min η_F η_V)
      have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hr_min (lt_min hη_F_pos hη_V_pos)
      let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun q => G_in.num p q * F.den p q - F.num p q * G_in.den p q
      have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r_min) :=
        (((G_in.num_holo p hp_in).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
          ((F.den_holo p hp_F).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F.num_holo p hp_F).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((G_in.den_holo p hp_in).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
      have hΔ_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p η, Δ q = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        have hq_V : q ∈ V_thin :=
          hη_V_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hq)
        have hq_F : q ∈ Metric.ball p η_F :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hq
        have e_col := hColEq q hq_V
        have e_cl := hη_F_eq q hq_F
        dsimp [Δ, G_in, D_tilde]
        linear_combination F.den p q * e_col + Q q * e_cl
      intro q hq
      have hzero := eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r_min).isPreconnected
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
        hΔ_holo hΔ_sub q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    have hEq_in_ann_thin : MeroEqOn G_in G_ann V_thin :=
      meroEqOn_trans hEq_in_F
        (meroEqOn_symm (meroEqOn_mono hEq_ann (fun _ hp => (hVthin_sub_inter hp).2)))
    have hEq_in_ann : MeroEqOn G_in G_ann (W_in ∩ W_ann) :=
      meroEqOn_of_preconnected G_in G_ann Set.Subset.rfl hInter_open hInter_pre
        hVthin_sub_inter hVthin_ne hEq_in_ann_thin
    let W_fam : Bool → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun b => cond b W_in W_ann
    let G_fam : ∀ b : Bool, MeroOn2D (W_fam b)
      | true => G_in
      | false => G_ann
    have hcov : ∀ p, p ∈ W_loc ↔ ∃ b : Bool, p ∈ W_fam b := by
      rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hw, hζR⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζR
        rcases lt_or_ge ‖ζ‖ r with hζr | hζr
        · refine ⟨true, hw, ?_⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          exact hζr
        · exact ⟨false, hw, by linarith, hζR⟩
      · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
        cases b
        · exact ⟨hb.1, by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; exact hb.2.2⟩
        · refine ⟨hb.1, ?_⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          have hζr : ‖ζ‖ < r := by simpa using hb.2
          linarith
    have hcompat : ∀ b₁ b₂ : Bool, MeroEqOn (G_fam b₁) (G_fam b₂) (W_fam b₁ ∩ W_fam b₂) := by
      intro b₁ b₂
      cases b₁ <;> cases b₂
      · exact ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
      · simpa [W_fam, G_fam, Set.inter_comm] using meroEqOn_symm hEq_in_ann
      · simpa [W_fam, G_fam] using hEq_in_ann
      · exact ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨G_loc, hGlue⟩ := glueMeroFamily G_fam hcov hcompat
    exact ⟨G_loc, meroEqOn_trans (hGlue false) hEq_ann⟩

  · 
    intro r_w ρ R F _hr_w hρ hρR hLoc
    let D_w : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w
    let D_ζ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
    let A : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }
    let ι : Type := { w : ℂ // w ∈ D_w }
    let δ_fn : ι → ℝ := fun u => Classical.choose (hLoc u.1 u.2)
    have hδ_spec : ∀ u : ι, 0 < δ_fn u ∧
        Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ⊆ D_w ∧
        ∃ G : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ D_ζ),
          MeroEqOn G F (Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ A) :=
      fun u => Classical.choose_spec (hLoc u.1 u.2)
    let W_fam : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun u => Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ D_ζ
    let G_fam : ∀ u : ι, MeroOn2D (W_fam u) :=
      fun u => Classical.choose (hδ_spec u).2.2
    have hEq_fam : ∀ u : ι, MeroEqOn (G_fam u) F (Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ A) :=
      fun u => Classical.choose_spec (hδ_spec u).2.2
    have hcov : ∀ p, p ∈ D_w ×ˢ D_ζ ↔ ∃ u : ι, p ∈ W_fam u := by
      rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hw, hζ⟩
        exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_spec ⟨w, hw⟩).1, hζ⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, hw, hζ⟩
        exact ⟨(hδ_spec u).2.1 hw, hζ⟩
    have hcompat : ∀ u v : ι, MeroEqOn (G_fam u) (G_fam v) (W_fam u ∩ W_fam v) := by
      intro u v
      let U_uv : Set ℂ := Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ∩ Metric.ball v.1 (δ_fn v)
      by_cases hU : U_uv.Nonempty
      · have hInter_eq : W_fam u ∩ W_fam v = U_uv ×ˢ D_ζ := by
          ext ⟨w, ζ⟩
          simp only [W_fam, U_uv, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_prod]
          tauto
        have hInter_open : IsOpen (W_fam u ∩ W_fam v) := by
          rw [hInter_eq]
          exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hInter_pre : IsPreconnected (W_fam u ∩ W_fam v) := by
          rw [hInter_eq]
          exact (((convex_ball u.1 (δ_fn u)).inter
            (convex_ball v.1 (δ_fn v))).prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R)).isPreconnected
        let V_uv : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_uv ×ˢ A
        have hV_sub : V_uv ⊆ W_fam u ∩ W_fam v := by
          rw [hInter_eq]
          rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩ ⟨hw, _, hζR⟩
          exact ⟨hw, by simpa [D_ζ] using hζR⟩
        have hV_ne : V_uv.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨w_star, hw_star⟩ := hU
          refine ⟨(w_star, (((ρ + R) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), hw_star, ?_⟩
          have hpos : 0 < (ρ + R) / 2 := by linarith
          have hnorm : ‖(((ρ + R) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = (ρ + R) / 2 := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hpos)]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hEq_V : MeroEqOn (G_fam u) (G_fam v) V_uv :=
          meroEqOn_trans
            (meroEqOn_mono (hEq_fam u) (Set.prod_mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.Subset.rfl))
            (meroEqOn_symm
              (meroEqOn_mono (hEq_fam v) (Set.prod_mono Set.inter_subset_right Set.Subset.rfl)))
        exact meroEqOn_of_preconnected (G_fam u) (G_fam v) Set.Subset.rfl
          hInter_open hInter_pre hV_sub hV_ne hEq_V
      · refine ⟨fun p hp => hp, fun p hp => ?_⟩
        exact False.elim (hU ⟨p.1, hp.1.1, hp.2.1⟩)
    obtain ⟨F_ext, hGlue⟩ := glueMeroFamily G_fam hcov hcompat
    refine ⟨F_ext, ⟨fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1, by simpa [D_ζ] using hp.2.2⟩, hp⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
    let u : ι := ⟨p.1, hp.1⟩
    have hp_sub : p ∈ Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ A :=
      ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_spec u).1, hp.2⟩
    have hSub_W : Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ A ⊆ W_fam u := by
      rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩ ⟨hw, _, hζR⟩
      exact ⟨hw, by simpa [D_ζ] using hζR⟩
    have hEq_ext_F : MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball u.1 (δ_fn u) ×ˢ A) :=
      meroEqOn_trans (meroEqOn_mono (hGlue u) hSub_W) (hEq_fam u)
    exact hEq_ext_F.2 p hp_sub

(r_w ρ R : ℝ) (w₁ : ℂ)
    (hr_w : 0 < r_w) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρR : ρ < R)
    (hw₁ : w₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w)
    (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })) :
    ∃ (r ε_r δ₀ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ₀ ∧ 0 < ε_r ∧ ρ < r - ε_r ∧ r + ε_r < R ∧
      Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
      IsSliceClearedOnCollar F (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) w₁ r ε_r m G

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hr_w
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (ζ₀ : ℂ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η →
      ∀ (D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ D (Metric.ball w₁ η ×ˢ Metric.ball ζ₀ η) →
        (∃ q ∈ Metric.ball w₁ η ×ˢ Metric.ball ζ₀ η, D q ≠ 0) →
        ∃ (m : ℕ) (d_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ d_tilde (Metric.ball w₁ (η / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball ζ₀ η) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₁ (η / 4), ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball ζ₀ η,
            D (w, ζ) = (w - w₁) ^ m * d_tilde (w, ζ)) ∧
          (∃ ζ ∈ Metric.ball ζ₀ η, d_tilde (w₁, ζ) ≠ 0) := by
    intro ζ₀ η hη D hD hD_nz
    let η' : ℝ := η / 2
    have hη' : 0 < η' := half_pos hη
    have hη'_eq : η' = η / 2 := rfl
    let R_int : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun j p =>
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ •
        ∮ u in C(w₁, η'), ((u - p.1) * (u - w₁) ^ j)⁻¹ * D (u, p.2)
    have h2piI_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
        Complex.I_ne_zero
    
    have hR_holo : ∀ j : ℕ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (R_int j) (Metric.ball w₁ (η / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball ζ₀ η) := by
      intro j p₀ hp₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hw₀ : dist p₀.1 w₁ < η / 4 := hp₀.1
      have hζ₀ : dist p₀.2 ζ₀ < η := hp₀.2
      let δ : ℝ := min (η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁) (η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀) / 3
      have hδ_eq : δ = min (η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁) (η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀) / 3 := rfl
      have hδ : 0 < δ := by
        have h1 : 0 < η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁ := sub_pos.mpr hw₀
        have h2 : 0 < η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀ := sub_pos.mpr hζ₀
        exact div_pos (lt_min h1 h2) (by norm_num)
      have hδ_w : 3 * δ ≤ η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁ := by
        have := min_le_left (η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁) (η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀)
        linarith
      have hδ_ζ : 3 * δ ≤ η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀ := by
        have := min_le_right (η / 4 - dist p₀.1 w₁) (η - dist p₀.2 ζ₀)
        linarith
      let s : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ δ
      have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hδ
      have hs_prod : ∀ p ∈ s, dist p.1 p₀.1 < δ ∧ dist p.2 p₀.2 < δ := by
        intro p hp
        have hp' : p ∈ Metric.ball p₀.1 δ ×ˢ Metric.ball p₀.2 δ := by
          rwa [ball_prod_same]
        exact hp'
      have hs_w : ∀ p ∈ s, dist p.1 w₁ < η / 4 := by
        intro p hp
        have hp1 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < δ := (hs_prod p hp).1
        linarith [dist_triangle p.1 p₀.1 w₁]
      have hs_cb : Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ) ⊆ Metric.ball ζ₀ η := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        linarith [dist_triangle z p₀.2 ζ₀]
      have hs_p2_cb : ∀ p ∈ s, Metric.closedBall p.2 δ ⊆ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ) := by
        intro p hp z hz
        have hp2 : dist p.2 p₀.2 < δ := (hs_prod p hp).2
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz ⊢
        linarith [dist_triangle z p.2 p₀.2]
      let μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
      let u_map : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap w₁ η'
      have hu_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, u_map θ ∈ Metric.sphere w₁ η' :=
        fun θ => circleMap_mem_sphere w₁ hη'.le θ
      have hu_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖u_map θ - w₁‖ = η' :=
        fun θ => mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp (hu_mem θ)
      have hu_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, u_map θ - w₁ ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ h0
        have := hu_norm θ
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      have hu_ball : ∀ θ : ℝ, u_map θ ∈ Metric.ball w₁ η := by
        intro θ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hu_norm θ]
        linarith
      have hu_sub_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s, η / 4 ≤ ‖u_map θ - p.1‖ := by
        intro θ p hp
        have hpw : ‖p.1 - w₁‖ < η / 4 := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hs_w p hp
        have htri : ‖u_map θ - w₁‖ ≤ ‖u_map θ - p.1‖ + ‖p.1 - w₁‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (u_map θ - p.1) (p.1 - w₁)
        rw [hu_norm θ] at htri
        linarith
      have hu_sub_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s, u_map θ - p.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ p hp h0
        have := hu_sub_norm θ p hp
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      let c_θ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => deriv u_map θ * ((u_map θ - w₁) ^ j)⁻¹
      have hc_cont : Continuous c_θ := by
        have hc_eq : c_θ = fun θ => (circleMap 0 η' θ * Complex.I) * ((u_map θ - w₁) ^ j)⁻¹ := by
          ext θ
          dsimp only [c_θ, u_map]
          rw [deriv_circleMap]
        rw [hc_eq]
        exact ((continuous_circleMap 0 η').mul continuous_const).mul
          ((((continuous_circleMap w₁ η').sub continuous_const).pow j).inv₀
            (fun θ => pow_ne_zero j (hu_ne θ)))
      have hc_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖c_θ θ‖ = η' * (η' ^ j)⁻¹ := by
        intro θ
        have hd_norm : ‖deriv u_map θ‖ = η' := by
          dsimp only [u_map]
          rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, norm_circleMap_zero, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
            abs_of_pos hη']
        dsimp only [c_θ]
        rw [norm_mul, hd_norm, norm_inv, norm_pow, hu_norm θ]
      let F_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ =>
        c_θ θ * ((u_map θ - p.1)⁻¹ * D (u_map θ, p.2))
      have hint_eq : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          (∮ u in C(w₁, η'), ((u - p.1) * (u - w₁) ^ j)⁻¹ * D (u, p.2)) =
            ∫ θ, F_int p θ ∂μ := by
        intro p
        rw [circleIntegral_def_Icc]
        congr 1
        ext θ
        simp only [F_int, c_θ, u_map, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv]
        ring
      let L₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ
      let L₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
      let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p θ =>
        c_θ θ • ((u_map θ - p.1)⁻¹ • (deriv (fun ζ => D (u_map θ, ζ)) p.2 • L₂) +
          D (u_map θ, p.2) • ((-(0 - 1) / (u_map θ - p.1) ^ 2) • L₁))
      
      have hK_comp : IsCompact (Metric.sphere w₁ η' ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ)) :=
        (isCompact_sphere w₁ η').prod (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ))
      have hK_sub : Metric.sphere w₁ η' ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ) ⊆
          Metric.ball w₁ η ×ˢ Metric.ball ζ₀ η := by
        rintro ⟨u, ζ⟩ ⟨hu, hζ⟩
        refine ⟨?_, hs_cb hζ⟩
        have hu_eq : ‖u - w₁‖ = η' := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hu
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hu_eq]
        linarith
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hD.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have hM_bd : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * δ), ‖D (u_map θ, ζ)‖ ≤ M := by
        intro θ ζ hζ
        exact le_trans (hM₀ (u_map θ, ζ) ⟨hu_mem θ, hζ⟩) (le_max_left M₀ 0)
      have hD_slice_holo : ∀ θ : ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => D (u_map θ, ζ))
          (Metric.ball ζ₀ η) := by
        intro θ
        exact hD.comp ((differentiableOn_const (u_map θ)).prodMk differentiableOn_id)
          (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hu_ball θ, hζ⟩)
      have hderiv_bd : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s,
          ‖deriv (fun ζ => D (u_map θ, ζ)) p.2‖ ≤ M / δ := by
        intro θ p hp
        have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall p.2 δ ⊆ Metric.ball ζ₀ η :=
          Set.Subset.trans (hs_p2_cb p hp) hs_cb
        have hdcc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ => D (u_map θ, ζ)) (Metric.ball p.2 δ) :=
          (hD_slice_holo θ).diffContOnCl_ball hcb_sub
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hδ hdcc
          (fun ζ hζ => hM_bd θ ζ (hs_p2_cb p hp (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)))
      have hF_fderiv : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F_int q θ) (F' p θ) p := by
        intro θ p hp
        have h_1d : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (u_map θ - z)⁻¹)
            (-(0 - 1) / (u_map θ - p.1) ^ 2) p.1 :=
          ((hasDerivAt_const p.1 (u_map θ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id p.1)).inv (hu_sub_ne θ p hp)
        have hc_fd : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (u_map θ - q.1)⁻¹)
            ((-(0 - 1) / (u_map θ - p.1) ^ 2) • L₁) p :=
          HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (f := L₁) p h_1d L₁.hasFDerivAt

          exact ⟨δ, hδ, fun u hu hne => hδ_prop ⟨hu, hne⟩⟩
      let δ_fn : ℂ → ℝ := fun w => if hw : w ∈ K then (h_iso w hw).choose else 1
      have hδ_pos : ∀ w ∈ K, 0 < δ_fn w := by
        intro w hw; simp only [δ_fn, hw, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_iso w hw).choose_spec.1
      have hδ_ne : ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball w (δ_fn w), u ≠ w → h u ≠ 0 := by
        intro w hw; simp only [δ_fn, hw, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_iso w hw).choose_spec.2
      obtain ⟨S, hS_sub, hS_fin, hS_cov⟩ :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall z (η / 2)).elim_finite_subcover_image
          (c := fun w => Metric.ball w (δ_fn w))
          (fun w _ => isOpen_ball)
          (fun w hw => Set.mem_biUnion hw (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_pos w hw)))

      rintro ζ ⟨hζK, hζ0⟩

      · exact False.elim (hδ_ne w (hS_sub hwS) ζ hζ_ball hζw hζ0)
    let R_bad : Set ℝ :=
      ⋃ z ∈ (I_cov : Set ℂ),

    refine ⟨r, hr_ioo, ?_⟩
    intro z hz ζ hζ_cb hζ_norm hzero
    apply hr_not_bad
    exact Set.mem_biUnion hz ⟨ζ, ⟨hζ_cb, hzero⟩, hζ_norm⟩

  
  let W_F : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }

  let K_ann : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₂ \ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁

  have hK_ann_mem : ∀ z ∈ K_ann, (w₁, z) ∈ W_F := by

    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, not_lt] at hz_ge

  let I_cov : Finset ℂ := hb_fin.toFinset

  have h_fact_ex : ∀ z ∈ I_cov,

    intro z hz
    have hmem := hI_mem z hz
    have hη_z : 0 < F.rad (w₁, z) := F.rad_pos (w₁, z) hmem
    have hden_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F.den (w₁, z))
        (Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z)) ×ˢ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z))) := by
      rw [ball_prod_same]

    have hden_nz : ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z)) ×ˢ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z)),

      rw [ball_prod_same]

    exact s1 z (F.rad (w₁, z)) hη_z (F.den (w₁, z)) hden_holo hden_nz
  let m_cov : ℂ → ℕ := fun z => if hz : z ∈ I_cov then (h_fact_ex z hz).choose else 0
  let d_tilde : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
    if hz : z ∈ I_cov then (h_fact_ex z hz).choose_spec.choose else fun _ => 1
  have hd_holo : ∀ z ∈ I_cov, DifferentiableOn ℂ (d_tilde z)
      (Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z) / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z))) := by
    intro z hz; simp only [d_tilde, hz, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (h_fact_ex z hz).choose_spec.choose_spec.1
  have hd_eq : ∀ z ∈ I_cov, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z) / 4),
      ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z)),
        F.den (w₁, z) (w, ζ) = (w - w₁) ^ (m_cov z) * d_tilde z (w, ζ) := by
    intro z hz; simp only [m_cov, d_tilde, hz, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (h_fact_ex z hz).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.1
  have hd_nz : ∀ z ∈ I_cov, ∃ ζ ∈ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z)), d_tilde z (w₁, ζ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz; simp only [d_tilde, hz, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (h_fact_ex z hz).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2
  have hd_slice_holo : ∀ z ∈ I_cov,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d_tilde z (w₁, ζ)) (Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z))) := by
    intro z hz
    have hrad : 0 < F.rad (w₁, z) := F.rad_pos (w₁, z) (hI_mem z hz)
    exact (hd_holo z hz).comp ((differentiableOn_const w₁).prodMk differentiableOn_id)

  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr₁, hr₂⟩, hr_avoid⟩ := s2 ρ₁ ρ₂ hρ₁₂ I_cov
    (fun z => F.rad (w₁, z)) (fun z ζ => d_tilde z (w₁, ζ))
    (fun z hz => F.rad_pos (w₁, z) (hI_mem z hz))
    hd_slice_holo hd_nz
  have hρr : ρ < r := lt_trans hρ₁ hr₁
  have hrR : r < R := lt_trans hr₂ hρ₂
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_trans hρ hρr
  have hSphere_sub : Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ K_ann := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hnorm : ‖ζ‖ = r := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, hnorm]; linarith
    · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, hnorm, not_lt]; linarith
  have hSphere_cov : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      ∃ z ∈ I_cov, α ∈ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z) / 2) := by
    intro α hα
    obtain ⟨z, hz_b, hα_ball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hb_cov (hSphere_sub hα))
    exact ⟨z, hb_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hz_b, hα_ball⟩

  
  let m : ℕ := I_cov.sup m_cov
  have hm_le : ∀ z ∈ I_cov, m_cov z ≤ m := fun z hz => Finset.le_sup (f := m_cov) hz
  let z_of : ℂ → ℂ := fun α =>
    if hα : α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r then (hSphere_cov α hα).choose else 0
  have hz_of_mem : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, z_of α ∈ I_cov := by
    intro α hα; simp only [z_of, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (hSphere_cov α hα).choose_spec.1
  have hz_of_ball : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      α ∈ Metric.ball (z_of α) (F.rad (w₁, z_of α) / 2) := by
    intro α hα; simp only [z_of, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (hSphere_cov α hα).choose_spec.2
  have h_nbhd_ex : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      ∃ γ > 0,
        Metric.ball (w₁, α) γ ⊆
          Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z_of α) / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball (z_of α) (F.rad (w₁, z_of α)) ∧
        Metric.ball (w₁, α) γ ⊆ Metric.ball (w₁, z_of α) (F.rad (w₁, z_of α)) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (w₁, α) γ, d_tilde (z_of α) q ≠ 0 := by
    intro α hα
    let z := z_of α
    have hzI : z ∈ I_cov := hz_of_mem α hα
    have hα_ball : α ∈ Metric.ball z (F.rad (w₁, z) / 2) := hz_of_ball α hα
    let η := F.rad (w₁, z)
    have hη : 0 < η := F.rad_pos (w₁, z) (hI_mem z hzI)
    have hpt_mem : (w₁, α) ∈ Metric.ball w₁ (η / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball z η :=
      ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity),
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (half_lt_self hη).le hα_ball⟩
    have hcont_at : ContinuousAt (d_tilde z) (w₁, α) :=
      (hd_holo z hzI).continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hpt_mem)
    have hnz_at : d_tilde z (w₁, α) ≠ 0 :=
      hr_avoid z hzI α (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hα_ball)
        (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hα)
    obtain ⟨ε_α, hε_α_pos, hε_α_prop⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont_at ‖d_tilde z (w₁, α)‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hnz_at)
    let γ : ℝ := min (min (η / 4) (η / 2 - dist α z)) ε_α
    have hγ_pos : 0 < γ :=
      lt_min (lt_min (by positivity) (sub_pos.mpr hα_ball)) hε_α_pos
    refine ⟨γ, hγ_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq
      rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq
      have hq1 : dist q.1 w₁ < γ := hq.1
      have hq2 : dist q.2 α < γ := hq.2
      have hγ1 : γ ≤ η / 4 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hγ2 : γ ≤ η / 2 - dist α z := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hq1 hγ1, ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      linarith [dist_triangle q.2 α z]
    · intro q hq
      rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
      have hq1 : dist q.1 w₁ < γ := hq.1
      have hq2 : dist q.2 α < γ := hq.2
      have hγ1 : γ ≤ η / 4 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hγ2 : γ ≤ η / 2 - dist α z := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      refine ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith, ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      linarith [dist_triangle q.2 α z]
    · intro q hq hzero
      have hγ3 : γ ≤ ε_α := min_le_right _ _
      have hdist_lt := hε_α_prop (lt_of_lt_of_le hq hγ3)
      rw [hzero, dist_zero_left] at hdist_lt
      exact lt_irrefl _ hdist_lt
  let γ_fn : ℂ → ℝ := fun α =>
    if hα : α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r then (h_nbhd_ex α hα).choose else 1
  have hγ_pos : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, 0 < γ_fn α := by
    intro α hα; simp only [γ_fn, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_nbhd_ex α hα).choose_spec.1
  have hV_sub_dom : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      Metric.ball (w₁, α) (γ_fn α) ⊆
        Metric.ball w₁ (F.rad (w₁, z_of α) / 4) ×ˢ Metric.ball (z_of α) (F.rad (w₁, z_of α)) := by
    intro α hα; simp only [γ_fn, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_nbhd_ex α hα).choose_spec.2.1
  have hV_sub_rad : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      Metric.ball (w₁, α) (γ_fn α) ⊆ Metric.ball (w₁, z_of α) (F.rad (w₁, z_of α)) := by
    intro α hα; simp only [γ_fn, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_nbhd_ex α hα).choose_spec.2.2.1
  have hV_nz : ∀ α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (w₁, α) (γ_fn α), d_tilde (z_of α) q ≠ 0 := by
    intro α hα; simp only [γ_fn, hα, ↓reduceDIte]; exact (h_nbhd_ex α hα).choose_spec.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨b_cir, hb_cir_sub, hb_cir_fin, hb_cir_cov⟩ :=

      (c := fun α => Metric.ball α (γ_fn α / 2))
      (fun α _ => isOpen_ball)
      (fun α hα => Set.mem_biUnion hα (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos (hγ_pos α hα))))
  let A_cir : Finset ℂ := hb_cir_fin.toFinset
  have hA_sphere : ∀ α ∈ A_cir, α ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r :=

    obtain ⟨α, hα_b, _⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hb_cir_cov hr_sp)

  let V : ℂ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun α => Metric.ball (w₁, α) (γ_fn α)
  have hw₁_norm : ‖w₁‖ < r_w := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw₁
  let δ₀ : ℝ := min ((r_w - ‖w₁‖) / 2) (A_cir.inf' hA_ne γ_fn)
  let ε_r : ℝ := (1 / 2) * min (min (r - ρ) (R - r)) (A_cir.inf' hA_ne (fun α => γ_fn α / 2))
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := by
    refine lt_min (by linarith) ?_
    rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]

  have hε_r_pos : 0 < ε_r := by
    refine mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hρr) (sub_pos.mpr hrR)) ?_)
    rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
    exact fun α hα => half_pos (hγ_pos α (hA_sphere α hα))
  have hρ_lt : ρ < r - ε_r := by
    have h1 : ε_r ≤ (1 / 2) * (r - ρ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hr_lt : r + ε_r < R := by
    have h1 : ε_r ≤ (1 / 2) * (R - r) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hδ₀_sub : Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : δ₀ ≤ (r_w - ‖w₁‖) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have h2 : ‖w - w₁‖ < δ₀ := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hw
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have htri := norm_le_insert' w w₁
    linarith
  let U_col : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }
  have hU_col_sub : U_col ⊆ W_F := by
    rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩ ⟨hw, hζ1, hζ2⟩
    exact ⟨hδ₀_sub hw, lt_trans hρ_lt hζ1, lt_trans hζ2 hr_lt⟩
  have hU_col_open : IsOpen U_col :=
    isOpen_ball.prod
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const))
  
  have hU_col_cov : ∀ p ∈ U_col, ∃ α ∈ A_cir, p ∈ V α := by
    rintro ⟨w, ζ⟩ ⟨hw, hζ1, hζ2⟩
    have hζ_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := lt_trans hρ (lt_trans hρ_lt hζ1)
    have hζ_ne : ‖ζ‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hζ_pos
    let ζ_hat : ℂ := (r / ‖ζ‖ : ℝ) • ζ
    have hζ_hat_sp : ζ_hat ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r := by
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
      simp only [ζ_hat, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hr_pos hζ_pos),
        div_mul_cancel₀ r hζ_ne]
    obtain ⟨α, hα_b, hα_ball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hb_cir_cov hζ_hat_sp)
    have hαA : α ∈ A_cir := hb_cir_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hα_b
    refine ⟨α, hαA, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [V]
    rw [← ball_prod_same]
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hw (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (Finset.inf'_le γ_fn hαA)), ?_⟩
    have hdiff : ζ - ζ_hat = (1 - r / ‖ζ‖ : ℝ) • ζ := by
      simp only [ζ_hat, sub_smul, one_smul]
    have hdist_hat : dist ζ ζ_hat = |‖ζ‖ - r| := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hdiff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h1 : |1 - r / ‖ζ‖| * ‖ζ‖ = |(1 - r / ‖ζ‖) * ‖ζ‖| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hζ_pos]
      rw [h1]
      congr 1
      rw [sub_mul, one_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ r hζ_ne]
    have habs_lt : |‖ζ‖ - r| < ε_r := abs_sub_lt_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hε_le : ε_r ≤ (1 / 2) * (γ_fn α / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (Finset.inf'_le (fun β => γ_fn β / 2) hαA))
        (by norm_num)
    have hγ_pos_α : 0 < γ_fn α := hγ_pos α (hA_sphere α hαA)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hα_ball ⊢
    linarith [dist_triangle ζ ζ_hat α]
  
  let g : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun α q =>
    ((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α) q) / d_tilde (z_of α) q
  have hg_holo : ∀ α ∈ A_cir, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g α) (V α) := by
    intro α hα q hq
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hα_sp := hA_sphere α hα
    have hzI := hz_of_mem α hα_sp
    have hV_nhds : V α ∈ nhds q := isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α))) q :=
      (differentiable_fst.sub (differentiable_const w₁)).pow _ q
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (F.num (w₁, z_of α)) q :=
      ((F.num_holo (w₁, z_of α) (hI_mem _ hzI)).mono (hV_sub_rad α hα_sp)).differentiableAt hV_nhds
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (d_tilde (z_of α)) q :=
      ((hd_holo (z_of α) hzI).mono (hV_sub_dom α hα_sp)).differentiableAt hV_nhds
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (d_tilde (z_of α) p)⁻¹) q :=
      (HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt q (hasDerivAt_inv (hV_nz α hα_sp q hq))
        h3.hasFDerivAt).differentiableAt
    have heq : g α = fun p =>
        ((p.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α) p) * (d_tilde (z_of α) p)⁻¹ := by
      ext p; simp only [g, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [heq]
    exact (h1.mul h2).mul hinv
  have hg_eq_off : ∀ α ∈ A_cir, ∀ β ∈ A_cir, ∀ q ∈ V α ∩ V β, q.1 ≠ w₁ → g α q = g β q := by
    intro α hα β hβ q ⟨hqα, hqβ⟩ hqw
    have hα_sp := hA_sphere α hα
    have hβ_sp := hA_sphere β hβ
    have hzα := hz_of_mem α hα_sp
    have hzβ := hz_of_mem β hβ_sp
    have hcompat := F.compat (w₁, z_of α) (hI_mem _ hzα) (w₁, z_of β) (hI_mem _ hzβ) q
      ⟨hV_sub_rad α hα_sp hqα, hV_sub_rad β hβ_sp hqβ⟩
    have hqα_dom := hV_sub_dom α hα_sp hqα
    have hqβ_dom := hV_sub_dom β hβ_sp hqβ
    have hdenα := hd_eq (z_of α) hzα q.1 hqα_dom.1 q.2 hqα_dom.2
    have hdenβ := hd_eq (z_of β) hzβ q.1 hqβ_dom.1 q.2 hqβ_dom.2
    have hdα_ne := hV_nz α hα_sp q hqα
    have hdβ_ne := hV_nz β hβ_sp q hqβ
    have hsub_ne : q.1 - w₁ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hqw
    have hpowα : (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) =
        (q.1 - w₁) ^ m := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hm_le _ hzα)]
    have hpowβ : (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of β)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β) =
        (q.1 - w₁) ^ m := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hm_le _ hzβ)]
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hdα_ne hdβ_ne]
    have hmul : (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α) q) * d_tilde (z_of β) q) *
          ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β)) =
        (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of β)) * F.num (w₁, z_of β) q) * d_tilde (z_of α) q) *
          ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β)) := by
      calc
        (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α) q) * d_tilde (z_of β) q) *
            ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β))
          = ((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α)) *
              (F.num (w₁, z_of α) q * ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β) * d_tilde (z_of β) q)) := by ring
        _ = (q.1 - w₁) ^ m * (F.num (w₁, z_of α) q * F.den (w₁, z_of β) q) := by
              rw [hpowα, ← hdenβ]
        _ = (q.1 - w₁) ^ m * (F.num (w₁, z_of β) q * F.den (w₁, z_of α) q) := by
              rw [hcompat]
        _ = ((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of β)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β)) *
              (F.num (w₁, z_of β) q * ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) * d_tilde (z_of α) q)) := by
              rw [← hpowβ, hdenα]
        _ = (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of β)) * F.num (w₁, z_of β) q) * d_tilde (z_of α) q) *
              ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of β)) := by ring
    exact mul_right_cancel₀
      (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hsub_ne) (pow_ne_zero _ hsub_ne)) hmul
  have hg_eq : ∀ α ∈ A_cir, ∀ β ∈ A_cir, ∀ q ∈ V α ∩ V β, g α q = g β q := by
    intro α hα β hβ q hq
    by_cases hqw : q.1 = w₁
    · let φ : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun t => (q.1 + (t : ℂ), q.2)
      have hφ_cont : Continuous φ :=
        (continuous_const.add Complex.continuous_ofReal).prodMk continuous_const
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = q := by ext <;> simp [φ]
      have hφ_tend : Filter.Tendsto φ (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds q) :=
        (hφ0 ▸ hφ_cont.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have hgα_cont : ContinuousAt (g α) q :=
        (hg_holo α hα).continuousOn.continuousAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq.1)
      have hgβ_cont : ContinuousAt (g β) q :=
        (hg_holo β hβ).continuousOn.continuousAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq.2)
      have htα : Filter.Tendsto (g α ∘ φ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (g α q)) :=
        hgα_cont.tendsto.comp hφ_tend
      have htβ : Filter.Tendsto (g β ∘ φ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (g β q)) :=
        hgβ_cont.tendsto.comp hφ_tend
      have hev_mem : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), φ t ∈ V α ∩ V β :=
        hφ_tend.eventually ((isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hq)
      have hev_pos : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), (0 : ℝ) < t :=
        eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
      have hev_eq : (g α ∘ φ) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)] (g β ∘ φ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev_mem, hev_pos] with t ht_mem ht_pos
        refine hg_eq_off α hα β hβ (φ t) ht_mem ?_
        dsimp only [φ]
        rw [hqw]
        intro h_eq
        have h_zero : (t : ℂ) = 0 := by
          calc (t : ℂ) = (w₁ + (t : ℂ)) - w₁ := by ring
            _ = w₁ - w₁ := by rw [h_eq]
            _ = 0 := by ring
        exact (ne_of_gt ht_pos) (Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h_zero)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (htα.congr' hev_eq) htβ
    · exact hg_eq_off α hα β hβ q hq hqw
  let G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
    if h : ∃ α ∈ A_cir, q ∈ V α then g h.choose q else 0
  have hG_on_V : ∀ α ∈ A_cir, ∀ q ∈ V α, G q = g α q := by
    intro α hα q hq
    have hex_q : ∃ β ∈ A_cir, q ∈ V β := ⟨α, hα, hq⟩
    simp only [G, hex_q, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact hg_eq hex_q.choose hex_q.choose_spec.1 α hα q ⟨hex_q.choose_spec.2, hq⟩
  have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G U_col := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀, hpV⟩ := hU_col_cov p hp
    have hev : G =ᶠ[nhds p] g α₀ := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hpV] with q hq
      exact hG_on_V α₀ hα₀ q hq
    exact (((hg_holo α₀ hα₀).differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hpV)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      hev).differentiableWithinAt
  refine ⟨r, ε_r, δ₀, m, G, hδ₀_pos, hε_r_pos, hρ_lt, hr_lt, hδ₀_sub,
    hU_col_sub, hG_holo, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀, hpV⟩ := hU_col_cov p hp
  have hα₀_sp := hA_sphere α₀ hα₀
  have hz₀ := hz_of_mem α₀ hα₀_sp
  have hpW : p ∈ W_F := hU_col_sub hp
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hU_col_open.inter isOpen_ball) p ⟨hp, hpV⟩
  let η : ℝ := min η₁ (F.rad p)
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hη₁_pos (F.rad_pos p hpW)
  refine ⟨η, hη_pos, min_le_right _ _,
    fun q hq => (hη₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)).1, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  have hq_inter := hη₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
  have hqV : q ∈ V α₀ := hq_inter.2
  have hq_rad : q ∈ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq
  have hGq : G q = g α₀ q := hG_on_V α₀ hα₀ q hqV
  have hcompat := F.compat p hpW (w₁, z_of α₀) (hI_mem _ hz₀) q
    ⟨hq_rad, hV_sub_rad α₀ hα₀_sp hqV⟩
  have hq_dom := hV_sub_dom α₀ hα₀_sp hqV
  have hden₀ := hd_eq (z_of α₀) hz₀ q.1 hq_dom.1 q.2 hq_dom.2
  have hd₀_ne := hV_nz α₀ hα₀_sp q hqV
  have hpow₀ : (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α₀) =
      (q.1 - w₁) ^ m := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel (hm_le _ hz₀)]
  rw [hGq]
  dsimp only [g]
  refine mul_right_cancel₀ hd₀_ne ?_
  calc
    (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α₀) q / d_tilde (z_of α₀) q) *
        F.den p q) * d_tilde (z_of α₀) q
      = (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α₀) q / d_tilde (z_of α₀) q) *
          d_tilde (z_of α₀) q) * F.den p q := by ring
    _ = ((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * F.num (w₁, z_of α₀) q) * F.den p q := by
          rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd₀_ne]
    _ = (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * (F.num (w₁, z_of α₀) q * F.den p q) := by ring
    _ = (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * (F.num p q * F.den (w₁, z_of α₀) q) := by
          rw [← hcompat]
    _ = (q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) *
          (F.num p q * ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α₀) * d_tilde (z_of α₀) q)) := by
          rw [hden₀]
    _ = (((q.1 - w₁) ^ (m - m_cov (z_of α₀)) * (q.1 - w₁) ^ m_cov (z_of α₀)) *
          F.num p q) * d_tilde (z_of α₀) q := by ring
    _ = ((q.1 - w₁) ^ m * F.num p q) * d_tilde (z_of α₀) q := by rw [hpow₀]

(w₁ w₂ : ℂ) (δ₀ δ₂ r ε_r R : ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (G₂ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R))
    (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) (hδ₂ : 0 < δ₂) (hε_r : 0 < ε_r) (hr : ε_r < r) (hrR : r + ε_r < R)
    (hsub : Metric.ball w₂ δ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀)
    (hHoloG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G
      (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }))
    (hClG₂ : IsSliceClearedOnCollar G₂ (Metric.ball w₂ δ₂) w₁ r ε_r m G) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (laurentMoment G r n) (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀)) ∧
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ (I : Fin (d₀ + 1) → ℕ), ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀,
      (hankelSubmatrix (laurentMoment G r) (d₀ + 1) I w).det = 0
