proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hδ₀
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_trans hε_r hr
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := le_of_lt hr_pos
  let A_col : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }
  have hA_open : IsOpen A_col :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hζ_mem_A : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ζ ∈ A_col := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hnorm : ‖ζ‖ = r := by simpa using hζ
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have hHoloL : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (laurentMoment G r n) (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) := by
    intro n w_star hw_star
    refine DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt ?_
    have hU1_open : IsOpen (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ A_col) := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hA_open
    have hdist_star : dist w_star w₁ < δ₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_star
    let η : ℝ := (δ₀ - dist w_star w₁) / 3
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
    have hcb2_sub : Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) ⊆ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ := by
      intro u hu
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have hu' : dist u w_star ≤ 2 * η := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
      calc dist u w₁ ≤ dist u w_star + dist w_star w₁ := dist_triangle u w_star w₁
        _ ≤ 2 * η + dist w_star w₁ := by linarith
        _ < δ₀ := by dsimp [η]; linarith
    have hcb_sub : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_star η,
        Metric.closedBall w η ⊆ Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) := by
      intro w hw u hu
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have hw' : dist w w_star < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
      have hu' : dist u w ≤ η := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
      calc dist u w_star ≤ dist u w + dist w w_star := dist_triangle u w w_star
        _ ≤ 2 * η := by linarith
    let ζ : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap (0 : ℂ) r
    have hζ_sphere : ∀ θ : ℝ, ζ θ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r :=
      fun θ => circleMap_mem_sphere (0 : ℂ) hr_nonneg θ
    have hζ_A : ∀ θ : ℝ, ζ θ ∈ A_col := fun θ => hζ_mem_A (ζ θ) (hζ_sphere θ)
    let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun u θ => deriv (circleMap (0 : ℂ) r) θ • (G (u, ζ θ) * (ζ θ) ^ n)
    let F' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun u θ => deriv (fun u' => F u' θ) u
    have hK_prod_compact : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall w_star (2 * η)).prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) r)
    have hK_prod_sub : Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r ⊆
        Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ A_col :=
      Set.prod_mono hcb2_sub hζ_mem_A
    have hCont_prod : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => G p * p.2 ^ n)
        (Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      (hHoloG.continuousOn.mono hK_prod_sub).mul (continuous_snd.pow n).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_prod_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hCont_prod
    let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hF_bound : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η), ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖F u θ‖ ≤ r * M := by
      intro u hu θ
      have hderiv_norm : ‖deriv (circleMap (0 : ℂ) r) θ‖ = r := by
        rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, norm_circleMap_zero,
          abs_of_nonneg hr_nonneg]
      have hp_mem : (u, ζ θ) ∈ Metric.closedBall w_star (2 * η) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r :=
        ⟨hu, hζ_sphere θ⟩
      have hGM : ‖G (u, ζ θ) * (ζ θ) ^ n‖ ≤ M :=
        le_trans (hM₀ (u, ζ θ) hp_mem) (le_max_left M₀ 0)
      dsimp [F]
      rw [norm_mul, hderiv_norm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGM hr_nonneg
    have hF_diffAt : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, ∀ θ : ℝ,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u' => F u' θ) u := by
      intro u hu θ
      have hp_mem : (u, ζ θ) ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ A_col := ⟨hu, hζ_A θ⟩
      have hG_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ G (u, ζ θ) :=
        hHoloG.differentiableAt (hU1_open.mem_nhds hp_mem)
      have hslice : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u' : ℂ => G (u', ζ θ)) u :=
        hG_at.comp u (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const (ζ θ)))
      exact (hslice.mul_const ((ζ θ) ^ n)).const_smul (deriv (circleMap (0 : ℂ) r) θ)
    have hF_hasDeriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, ∀ θ : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => F u' θ) (F' u θ) u :=
      fun u hu θ => (hF_diffAt u hu θ).hasDerivAt
    have hF'_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_star η, ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖F' w θ‖ ≤ r * M / η := by
      intro w hw θ
      have hDiffOn : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u' => F u' θ) (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) :=
        fun u hu => (hF_diffAt u hu θ).differentiableWithinAt
      have hDiffCl : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun u' => F u' θ) (Metric.ball w η) :=
        hDiffOn.diffContOnCl_ball (Set.Subset.trans (hcb_sub w hw) hcb2_sub)
      refine Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hη_pos hDiffCl ?_
      intro u hu
      exact hF_bound u (hcb_sub w hw (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu)) θ
    have hF_cont : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, Continuous (F u) := by
      intro u hu
      have hderiv_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (circleMap (0 : ℂ) r) θ) := by
        rw [funext (deriv_circleMap (0 : ℂ) r)]
        exact (continuous_circleMap (0 : ℂ) r).mul_const Complex.I
      have hG_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => G (u, ζ θ)) :=
        hHoloG.continuousOn.comp_continuous
          (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap (0 : ℂ) r))
          (fun θ => ⟨hu, hζ_A θ⟩)
      exact hderiv_cont.smul (hG_cont.mul ((continuous_circleMap (0 : ℂ) r).pow n))
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' w_star)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      let h_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => ((η / ((k : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hh_pos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < η / ((k : ℝ) + 1) :=
        fun k => div_pos hη_pos (by positivity)
      have hh_le : ∀ k : ℕ, η / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ η :=
        fun k => div_le_self (le_of_lt hη_pos) (by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)])
      have hh_ne : ∀ k : ℕ, h_seq k ≠ 0 :=
        fun k => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hh_pos k))
      have hw_add : ∀ k : ℕ, w_star + h_seq k ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ := by
        intro k
        apply hcb2_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self_add_left]
        have hnorm : ‖h_seq k‖ = η / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
          dsimp [h_seq]
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hh_pos k))]
        linarith [hh_le k]
      have hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun k => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (hh_ne k))⟩
        have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => η / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        simpa [Function.comp_def, h_seq] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
      refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
        (f := fun k θ => (h_seq k)⁻¹ • (F (w_star + h_seq k) θ - F w_star θ)) ?_ ?_
      · intro k
        have h_dq_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            (h_seq k)⁻¹ • (F (w_star + h_seq k) θ - F w_star θ)) :=
          ((hF_cont (w_star + h_seq k) (hw_add k)).sub (hF_cont w_star hw_star)).const_smul
            (h_seq k)⁻¹
        exact h_dq_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ =>

          CircleIntegrable (fun ζ : ℂ => P.coeff s • (G (w, ζ) * ζ ^ (i + s))) (0 : ℂ) r := by
        intro s _
        have hc_term : ContinuousOn
            (fun ζ : ℂ => P.coeff s • (G (w, ζ) * ζ ^ (i + s))) (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) :=
          (hContG_sph.mul (continuous_pow (i + s)).continuousOn).const_smul (P.coeff s)
        exact hc_term.circleIntegrable hr_nonneg
      rw [hCongr, circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum hInt_term] at hZeroInt
      rw [← hZeroInt]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s _ => ?_)
      rw [circleIntegral.integral_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    refine ⟨P.natDegree, fun d hd I => ?_⟩
    let v : Fin (d + 1) → ℂ := fun b => P.coeff (b : ℕ)
    have hv_ne : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv0
      let b₀ : Fin (d + 1) := ⟨P.natDegree, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hd⟩
      have hb₀ : v b₀ = 0 := congr_fun hv0 b₀
      dsimp [v, b₀] at hb₀
      exact one_ne_zero (hP_mon.symm.trans hb₀)
    have hv_mul : (hankelSubmatrix (laurentMoment G r) (d + 1) I w).mulVec v = 0 := by
      ext a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hankelSubmatrix, v, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
        (fun s => laurentMoment G r (I a + s) w * P.coeff s) (d + 1)]
      have hsub_range : Finset.range (P.natDegree + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (d + 1) :=
        Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hd)
      rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub_range]
      · simpa [mul_comm] using hRec (I a)
      · intro s _ hs_not
        have hdeg_lt : P.natDegree < s := by
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hs_not
          omega
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hdeg_lt, mul_zero]
    exact Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp ⟨v, hv_ne, hv_mul⟩
  
  refine ⟨hHoloL, ?_⟩
  let L : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := laurentMoment G r
  let W_good : Set ℂ := K_w \ E_w
  have hWg_uncount : ¬ W_good.Countable := by
    intro hWg_cnt
    let J : Set ℝ := Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₃
    have hJ_not_cnt : ¬ J.Countable := by
      intro hJ_cnt
      have hvol0 : MeasureTheory.volume J = 0 := hJ_cnt.measure_zero MeasureTheory.volume
      rw [Real.volume_Ioo, sub_zero] at hvol0
      exact (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hδ₃_pos)) hvol0
    let ι : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => w₂ + (t : ℂ)
    have hι_inj : Function.Injective ι :=
      fun t₁ t₂ h => Complex.ofReal_injective (add_left_cancel h)
    have h_img_sub : ι '' J ⊆ W_good ∪ E_w := by
      rintro z ⟨t, ⟨ht0, ht1⟩, rfl⟩
      have hmem_Kw : w₂ + (t : ℂ) ∈ K_w := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self_add_left, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht0)]
        exact le_of_lt ht1
      by_cases htE : w₂ + (t : ℂ) ∈ E_w
      · exact Or.inr htE
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hmem_Kw, htE⟩
    have h_union_cnt : (W_good ∪ E_w).Countable := hWg_cnt.union hEw_fin.countable
    have h_img_cnt : (ι '' J).Countable := h_union_cnt.mono h_img_sub
    have hJ_cnt : J.Countable := by
      rw [← Set.preimage_image_eq J hι_inj]
      exact h_img_cnt.preimage hι_inj
    exact hJ_not_cnt hJ_cnt
  let W_set : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun d =>
    { w ∈ W_good | ∀ I : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ, (hankelSubmatrix L (d + 1) I w).det = 0 }
  have hWg_cov : W_good ⊆ ⋃ d : ℕ, W_set d := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hSubVan w hw
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨N, hw, hN N (le_refl N)⟩
  have h_ex_d0 : ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ¬ (W_set d₀).Countable := by
    by_contra h_no_d0
    have h_all_cnt : ∀ d : ℕ, (W_set d).Countable :=
      fun d => Classical.not_not.mp (fun hnc => h_no_d0 ⟨d, hnc⟩)
    exact hWg_uncount ((Set.countable_iUnion h_all_cnt).mono hWg_cov)
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀_uncount⟩ := h_ex_d0
  have hd₀_inf : (W_set d₀).Infinite := fun hfin => hd₀_uncount hfin.countable
  obtain ⟨w_acc, hw_acc_Kw, hAcc⟩ := hd₀_inf.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact
    (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall w₂ δ₃) (fun _ hw => hw.1.1)
  have hw_acc_ball1 : w_acc ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ := hsub (hKw_sub hw_acc_Kw)
  have hfreq_d0 : ∃ᶠ w in nhdsWithin w_acc ({w_acc}ᶜ : Set ℂ), w ∈ W_set d₀ :=
    accPt_iff_frequently_nhdsNE.mp hAcc
  refine ⟨d₀, fun I w hw => ?_⟩
  let Δ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (hankelSubmatrix L (d₀ + 1) I u).det
  have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) := by
    have hΔ_eq : Δ = fun u => ∑ σ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (d₀ + 1)))),
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
          ∏ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d₀ + 1))), L (I (σ b) + (b : ℕ)) u := by
      ext u
      simp only [Δ, Matrix.det_apply, hankelSubmatrix, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hΔ_eq]
    refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun σ _ => ?_)
    refine (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun b _ => ?_)).const_mul _
    exact hHoloL (I (σ b) + (b : ℕ))
  have hΔ_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Δ (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀) :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hΔ_holo
  have hΔ_freq : ∃ᶠ u in nhdsWithin w_acc ({w_acc}ᶜ : Set ℂ), Δ u = 0 :=
    hfreq_d0.mono (fun u hu => hu.2 I)
  exact hΔ_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
    (convex_ball w₁ δ₀).isPreconnected hw_acc_ball1 hΔ_freq hw

informal_problem.statement:
(w₁ : ℂ) (δ₀ r ε_r : ℝ)
    (d₀ : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) (hε_r : 0 < ε_r) (hr : ε_r < r)
    (hHoloG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G
      (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }))
    (hHoloL : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (laurentMoment G r n) (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀))
    (hDetZero : ∀ (I : Fin (d₀ + 1) → ℕ), ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀,
      (hankelSubmatrix (laurentMoment G r) (d₀ + 1) I w).det = 0) :
    ∃ (N_tilde Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tilde (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Q (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) ∧
      (∃ w_nz ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀, w_nz ≠ w₁ ∧
        ∃ z_nz ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, Q (w_nz, z_nz) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { z : ℂ | r - ε_r / 2 < ‖z‖ ∧ ‖z‖ < r },
        N_tilde p = Q p * G p)

signature.statement:
(w₁ : ℂ) (δ₀ r ε_r : ℝ)
    (d₀ : ℕ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) (hε_r : 0 < ε_r) (hr : ε_r < r)
    (hHoloG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G
      (Metric.ball w₁ δ₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_trans hε_r hr
  let U_w : Set ℂ := Metric.ball w₁ δ₀
  let L : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := laurentMoment G r
  
  have h1 : ∃ (k : ℕ) (q : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ s : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (q s) U_w) ∧
      (∃ w_star ∈ U_w, q (Fin.last k) w_star ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ U_w, ∑ s : Fin (k + 1), q s w * L (i + (s : ℕ)) w = 0) := by
    classical
    let P_van : ℕ → Prop := fun m =>
      ∀ (I : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ), ∀ w ∈ U_w, (hankelSubmatrix L (m + 1) I w).det = 0
    have hEx : ∃ m : ℕ, P_van m := ⟨d₀, hDetZero⟩
    have hk_spec : P_van (Nat.find hEx) := Nat.find_spec hEx
    have hk_min : ∀ m < Nat.find hEx, ¬ P_van m := fun m hm => Nat.find_min hEx hm
    generalize Nat.find hEx = k at hk_spec hk_min
    rcases k with _ | k'
    · refine ⟨0, fun _ _ => 1, fun _ => differentiableOn_const 1,
        ⟨w₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀, one_ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
      intro i w hw
      have hdet0 : (hankelSubmatrix L 1 (fun _ => i) w).det = 0 := hk_spec (fun _ => i) w hw
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_one] at hdet0
      simpa [hankelSubmatrix] using hdet0
    · have hnot : ¬ P_van k' := hk_min k' (Nat.lt_succ_self k')
      simp only [P_van, not_forall] at hnot
      rcases hnot with ⟨I₀, w_star, hw_star, hΔ₀⟩
      let k := k' + 1
      let M : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ :=
        fun s w a b => L (I₀ a + (s.succAbove b : ℕ)) w
      let q : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun s w => (-1 : ℂ) ^ (k + (s : ℕ)) * (M s w).det
      refine ⟨k, q, ?_, ⟨w_star, hw_star, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro s
        have h_prod : ∀ (f : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ),
            (∀ a, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) U_w) →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∏ a : Fin k, f a w) U_w := by
          intro f hf
          have h_eq : (fun w => ∏ a : Fin k, f a w) = ∏ a : Fin k, f a := by
            ext w; simp
          rw [h_eq]
          exact DifferentiableOn.finsetProd fun a _ => hf a
        have h_sum : ∀ (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) → ℂ → ℂ),
            (∀ σ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f σ) U_w) →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), f σ w) U_w := by
          intro f hf
          have h_eq : (fun w => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), f σ w) =
              ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), f σ := by
            ext w; simp
          rw [h_eq]
          exact DifferentiableOn.sum fun σ _ => hf σ
        have hdet_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, (M s w).det =
            ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
              ∏ i : Fin k, L (I₀ (σ i) + (s.succAbove i : ℕ)) w := by
          intro w
          rw [Matrix.det_apply']
        have hdet_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (M s w).det) U_w := by
          simp_rw [hdet_eq]
          refine h_sum _ fun σ => ?_
          exact (h_prod _ fun i => hHoloL _).const_mul _
        exact hdet_holo.const_mul _
      · have hsign : (-1 : ℂ) ^ (k + (Fin.last k : ℕ)) = 1 := by
          rw [Fin.val_last, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
          norm_num
        have hM_last : M (Fin.last k) w_star = hankelSubmatrix L k I₀ w_star := by
          ext a b
          simp [M, hankelSubmatrix, Fin.succAbove_last]
        simp only [q, hsign, hM_last, one_mul]
        exact hΔ₀
      · intro i w hw
        let A : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ :=
          hankelSubmatrix L (k + 1) (Fin.snoc I₀ i) w
        have hAdet : A.det = 0 := hk_spec (Fin.snoc I₀ i) w hw
        rw [Matrix.det_succ_row A (Fin.last k)] at hAdet
        rw [← hAdet]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
        have hA_entry : A (Fin.last k) s = L (i + (s : ℕ)) w := by
          simp [A, hankelSubmatrix, Fin.snoc_last]
        have hA_sub : A.submatrix (Fin.last k).succAbove s.succAbove = M s w := by
          ext a b
          simp [A, M, hankelSubmatrix, Fin.succAbove_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        rw [Fin.val_last, hA_entry, hA_sub]
        dsimp only [q]
        ring
  obtain ⟨k, q, hHolo_q, ⟨w_star, hw_star, hq_last⟩, hRec⟩ := h1
  
  have hNZ : ∃ w_nz ∈ U_w, w_nz ≠ w₁ ∧
      ∃ z_nz ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, (∑ s : Fin (k + 1), q s w_nz * z_nz ^ (s : ℕ)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hContAt : ContinuousAt (q (Fin.last k)) w_star :=
      (hHolo_q (Fin.last k)).continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw_star)
    have hEv : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w_star, q (Fin.last k) w ≠ 0 :=
      hContAt.eventually_ne hq_last
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hEv
    have hdist_lt : dist w_star w₁ < δ₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_star
    let η : ℝ := min η₁ (δ₀ - dist w_star w₁)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hη₁_pos (sub_pos.mpr hdist_lt)
    let w_nz : ℂ := if w_star = w₁ then w₁ + ((η / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) else w_star
    have hw_nz_ball : w_nz ∈ Metric.ball w_star η := by
      dsimp only [w_nz]
      split_ifs with h_eq
      · rw [h_eq, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (half_pos hη_pos)]
        linarith
      · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos
    have hw_nz_mem : w_nz ∈ U_w := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have h1' : dist w_nz w_star < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_nz_ball
      have h2' : η ≤ δ₀ - dist w_star w₁ := min_le_right _ _
      linarith [dist_triangle w_nz w_star w₁]
    have hw_nz_ne : w_nz ≠ w₁ := by
      dsimp only [w_nz]
      split_ifs with h_eq
      · intro h_contra
        have h0 : ((η / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := add_eq_left.mp h_contra
        have h0_re : η / 2 = 0 := Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h0
        linarith
      · exact h_eq
    have hq_nz : q (Fin.last k) w_nz ≠ 0 :=
      hη₁ w_nz (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw_nz_ball)
    let P : Polynomial ℂ := ∑ s : Fin (k + 1), Polynomial.monomial (s : ℕ) (q s w_nz)
    have hP_coeff : P.coeff k = q (Fin.last k) w_nz := by
      simp only [P, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      have h_eq_s' : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), ((s : ℕ) = k) ↔ s = Fin.last k := by
        intro s
        rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last]
      simp [h_eq_s']
    have hP_ne : P ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hq_nz
      rw [← hP_coeff, h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    have hP_deg : P.natDegree ≤ k := by
      refine (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
      refine Finset.sup_le fun s _ => ?_
      exact (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le _).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp s.isLt)
    let γ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun j => ((((j : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) * r : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hγ_inj : Function.Injective γ := by
      intro j₁ j₂ hj
      have hj_re : ((j₁ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) * r =
          ((j₂ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) * r := Complex.ofReal_injective hj
      have hk2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
      have hj_mul := mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hr_pos) hj_re
      have hj_num : ((j₁ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) = ((j₂ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) :=
        (div_left_inj' (ne_of_gt hk2_pos)).mp hj_mul
      have hj_nat : (j₁ : ℕ) = (j₂ : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast add_right_cancel hj_num
      exact Fin.ext hj_nat
    let S_grid : Finset ℂ := Finset.univ.image γ
    have hS_card : S_grid.card = k + 1 := by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hγ_inj, Finset.card_fin]
    have hroots_lt : P.roots.toFinset.card < S_grid.card := by
      calc P.roots.toFinset.card
          ≤ P.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le P.roots
        _ ≤ P.natDegree := Polynomial.card_roots' P
        _ ≤ k := hP_deg
        _ < k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self k
        _ = S_grid.card := hS_card.symm
    obtain ⟨z_nz, hz_grid, hz_not_root⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hroots_lt
    obtain ⟨j₀, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz_grid
    have hz_mem : γ j₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      simp only [γ, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hpos_num : (0 : ℝ) < ((j₀ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) * r := by positivity
      rw [abs_of_pos hpos_num]
      have hdiv_lt : ((j₀ : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) < 1 := by
        rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]
        have hj₀_lt : (j₀ : ℕ) < k + 1 := j₀.isLt
        exact_mod_cast Nat.add_lt_add_right hj₀_lt 1
      nlinarith
    have hz_eval : (∑ s : Fin (k + 1), q s w_nz * (γ j₀) ^ (s : ℕ)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h_ev0
      apply hz_not_root
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP_ne, Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
      simpa [P, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_monomial] using h_ev0
    exact ⟨w_nz, hw_nz_mem, hw_nz_ne, γ j₀, hz_mem, hz_eval⟩
  
  let Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => ∑ s : Fin (k + 1), q s p.1 * p.2 ^ (s : ℕ)
  let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Q p * G p
  let N_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), (ζ - p.2)⁻¹ * H (p.1, ζ)
  have hHoloQ_any : ∀ S : Set ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ Q (U_w ×ˢ S) := by
    intro S
    have hQ_eq : Q = ∑ s : Fin (k + 1), fun p : ℂ × ℂ => q s p.1 * p.2 ^ (s : ℕ) := by
      ext p
      simp [Q]
    rw [hQ_eq]
    refine DifferentiableOn.sum fun s _ => ?_
    exact ((hHolo_q s).comp differentiableOn_fst (fun _ hp => hp.1)).mul
      (differentiableOn_snd.pow (s : ℕ))
  let U_ann : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | r - ε_r < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < r + ε_r }
  let U_col : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_w ×ˢ U_ann
  let U_in : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r
  have hOpen_ann : IsOpen U_ann :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hOpen_col : IsOpen U_col := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_ann
  have hHoloQ_in : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q U_in := hHoloQ_any (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)
  have hHoloH : DifferentiableOn ℂ H U_col := (hHoloQ_any U_ann).mul hHoloG
  have hHoloN : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tilde U_in := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    apply DifferentiableAt.const_mul

    have hge : r₁ ≤ ‖ζ‖ := not_lt.mp (by simpa [mem_ball_zero_iff] using hζ_nb)
    exact ⟨by linarith [hr₁_def], by linarith⟩
  have hann_open_sub : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r \ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ U_ann := by
    rintro ζ ⟨hζ_b, hζ_ncb⟩
    exact hann_sub ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hζ_b,
      fun h_in => hζ_ncb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h_in)⟩
  have hsphere_r₁_sub : Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ U_ann := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hnorm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
    exact ⟨by linarith [hr₁_def], by linarith [hr₁_def]⟩
  have hMom_r₁ : ∀ i : ℕ, (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), h ζ * ζ ^ i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hfi : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => h ζ * ζ ^ i) U_ann :=
      hHoloh.mul (differentiableOn_id.pow i)
    have hshift := Complex.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiable_on_annulus_off_countable
      (c := (0 : ℂ)) hr₁_pos hr₁_le_r Set.countable_empty
      (hfi.continuousOn.mono hann_sub)
      (fun ζ hζ => hfi.differentiableAt (hOpen_ann.mem_nhds (hann_open_sub hζ.1)))
    rw [← hshift]
    exact hMom_r i
  have hz_ann : z ∈ U_ann := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hdslope_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope h z) U_ann :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hOpen_ann.mem_nhds hz_ann)).mpr hHoloh
  have hdslope_shift :
      (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), dslope h z ζ) = (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), dslope h z ζ) :=
    Complex.circleIntegral_eq_of_differentiable_on_annulus_off_countable
      (c := (0 : ℂ)) hr₁_pos hr₁_le_r Set.countable_empty
      (hdslope_holo.continuousOn.mono hann_sub)
      (fun ζ hζ => hdslope_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_ann.mem_nhds (hann_open_sub hζ.1)))
  
  have h_outer : (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), dslope h z ζ) =
      (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) - h z * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    have heq_r : Set.EqOn (dslope h z) (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ - h z * (ζ - z)⁻¹)
        (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
      have hne : ζ ≠ z := fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
      rw [dslope_of_ne h hne, slope_def_field]
      ring
    have hinv_cont_r : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹) (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) fun ζ hζ => ?_
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
    have hh_cont_r : ContinuousOn h (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      hHoloh.continuousOn.mono hsphere_r_sub
    have hint1_r : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) (0 : ℂ) r :=
      (hinv_cont_r.mul hh_cont_r).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
    have hint2_r : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => h z * (ζ - z)⁻¹) (0 : ℂ) r :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hinv_cont_r).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr_pos)
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr (le_of_lt hr_pos) heq_r,
      circleIntegral.integral_sub hint1_r hint2_r,
      circleIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      circleIntegral.integral_sub_inv_of_mem_ball (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hz₂)]
  
  have h_inner_inv : (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), (ζ - z)⁻¹) = 0 := by
    have hinv_ball : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ‖z‖) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hlt : ‖ζ‖ < ‖z‖ := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hζ
      have hne : ζ - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hlt; linarith
      exact ((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const z)).inv hne).differentiableWithinAt
    have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ‖z‖ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr₁_lt_z
    exact Complex.circleIntegral_eq_zero_of_differentiable_on_off_countable
      (le_of_lt hr₁_pos) Set.countable_empty
      (hinv_ball.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub)
      (fun ζ hζ => hinv_ball.differentiableAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hcb_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hζ.1))))
  have h_inner_h : (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) = 0 := by
    let I₁ : ℂ := ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ
    have hh_cont_r₁ : ContinuousOn h (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
      hHoloh.continuousOn.mono hsphere_r₁_sub
    have hinv_cont_r₁ : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹) (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) fun ζ hζ => ?_
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
    obtain ⟨M₀_h, hM₀_h⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁).bddAbove_image
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hh_cont_r₁)
    let M_h : ℝ := max 0 M₀_h
    have hM_h_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_h := le_max_left 0 M₀_h
    have hM_h_bound : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁, ‖h ζ‖ ≤ M_h :=
      fun ζ hζ => le_trans (hM₀_h (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hζ)) (le_max_right 0 M₀_h)
    have hI₁_eq : ∀ N : ℕ,
        I₁ = ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N) := by
      intro N
      have hgeom_eq : Set.EqOn (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ)
          (fun ζ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * (h ζ * ζ ^ i)) +
            z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N))
          (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
        have hζz_ne : ζ - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
        have h_scalar : (ζ - z)⁻¹ =
            (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * ζ ^ i) +
              z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * ζ ^ N) := by
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ hζz_ne
          rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hζz_ne, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
          have h_term2 : (ζ - z) * (z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * ζ ^ N)) = (ζ * z⁻¹) ^ N := by
            rw [mul_pow]
            calc (ζ - z) * (z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * ζ ^ N))
                = ((ζ - z) * (ζ - z)⁻¹) * (ζ ^ N * z⁻¹ ^ N) := by ring
              _ = 1 * (ζ ^ N * z⁻¹ ^ N) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hζz_ne]
              _ = ζ ^ N * z⁻¹ ^ N := one_mul _
          have h_term1 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (ζ - z) * (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) * ζ ^ i)) =
              1 - (ζ * z⁻¹) ^ N := by
            have h_each : ∀ i : ℕ, (ζ - z) * (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1) * ζ ^ i) =
                -((ζ * z⁻¹) ^ i * (ζ * z⁻¹ - 1)) := by
              intro i
              rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]
              have hzz : z * z⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hz_ne_zero
              calc (ζ - z) * (-(z⁻¹ ^ i * z⁻¹) * ζ ^ i)
                  = -(ζ ^ i * z⁻¹ ^ i * (ζ * z⁻¹ - z * z⁻¹)) := by ring
                _ = -(ζ ^ i * z⁻¹ ^ i * (ζ * z⁻¹ - 1)) := by rw [hzz]
            simp_rw [h_each, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
              geom_sum_mul (ζ * z⁻¹) N]
            ring
          rw [h_term1, h_term2]
          ring
        calc (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ
            = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * ζ ^ i) +
                z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * ζ ^ N)) * h ζ := by rw [← h_scalar]
          _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * (h ζ * ζ ^ i)) +
                z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N) := by
              rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
              congr 1
              · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
              · ring
      have hint_each : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range N,
          CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * (h ζ * ζ ^ i)) (0 : ℂ) r₁ := by
        intro i _
        exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hh_cont_r₁.mul
          (continuousOn_id.pow i))).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr₁_pos)
      have hint_sum : CircleIntegrable
          (fun ζ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * (h ζ * ζ ^ i)) (0 : ℂ) r₁ := by
        refine ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr₁_pos) ?_
        exact continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun i _ =>
          continuousOn_const.mul (hh_cont_r₁.mul (continuousOn_id.pow i))
      have hint_rem : CircleIntegrable
          (fun ζ => z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N)) (0 : ℂ) r₁ :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul ((hinv_cont_r₁.mul hh_cont_r₁).mul
          (continuousOn_id.pow N))).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr₁_pos)
      dsimp only [I₁]
      rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr (le_of_lt hr₁_pos) hgeom_eq,
        circleIntegral.integral_add hint_sum hint_rem,
        circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum hint_each]
      have hsum_zero : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), (-z⁻¹ ^ (i + 1)) * (h ζ * ζ ^ i)) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        rw [circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, hMom_r₁ i, mul_zero]
      rw [hsum_zero, zero_add]
    have h_diff_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ - r₁ := sub_pos.mpr hr₁_lt_z
    have h_norm_I₁ : ∀ N : ℕ,
        ‖I₁‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi * r₁ * (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N := by
      intro N
      rw [hI₁_eq N]
      have h_pt : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁,
          ‖z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N)‖ ≤ (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
        have hsub_ge : ‖z‖ - r₁ ≤ ‖ζ - z‖ := by
          have htri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - ζ‖ + ‖ζ‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le (z - ζ) ζ
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at htri
          linarith
        have hinv_le : ‖(ζ - z)⁻¹‖ ≤ (‖z‖ - r₁)⁻¹ := by
          rw [norm_inv]
          exact inv_anti₀ h_diff_pos hsub_ge
        have hh_le : ‖h ζ‖ ≤ M_h := hM_h_bound ζ hζ
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, hζ_norm]
        have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := lt_trans hr₁_pos hr₁_lt_z
        calc ‖z‖⁻¹ ^ N * (‖(ζ - z)⁻¹‖ * ‖h ζ‖ * r₁ ^ N)
            ≤ ‖z‖⁻¹ ^ N * ((‖z‖ - r₁)⁻¹ * M_h * r₁ ^ N) := by gcongr
          _ = (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N := by
              rw [div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
              field_simp [ne_of_gt hz_pos, ne_of_gt h_diff_pos]
      calc ‖∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), z⁻¹ ^ N * ((ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ * ζ ^ N)‖
          ≤ 2 * Real.pi * r₁ * ((M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N) :=
            circleIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (le_of_lt hr₁_pos) h_pt
        _ = 2 * Real.pi * r₁ * (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N := by ring
    have hr_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ r₁ / ‖z‖ := by
      have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := lt_trans hr₁_pos hr₁_lt_z
      positivity
    have hr_div_lt : r₁ / ‖z‖ < 1 := by
      have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := lt_trans hr₁_pos hr₁_lt_z
      exact (div_lt_one hz_pos).mpr hr₁_lt_z
    have h_tendsto_zero : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N : ℕ => 2 * Real.pi * r₁ * (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)) * (r₁ / ‖z‖) ^ N)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hr_div_nonneg hr_div_lt).const_mul
        (2 * Real.pi * r₁ * (M_h / (‖z‖ - r₁)))
    have hI₁_le_zero : ‖I₁‖ ≤ 0 :=
      ge_of_tendsto' h_tendsto_zero h_norm_I₁
    exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp hI₁_le_zero
  have h_inner : (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r₁), dslope h z ζ) = 0 := by
    have heq_r₁ : Set.EqOn (dslope h z) (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ - h z * (ζ - z)⁻¹)
        (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
      have hne : ζ ≠ z := fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
      rw [dslope_of_ne h hne, slope_def_field]
      ring
    have hinv_cont_r₁ : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹) (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const) fun ζ hζ => ?_
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = r₁ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hζ
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr fun h_eq => by rw [h_eq] at hζ_norm; linarith
    have hh_cont_r₁ : ContinuousOn h (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
      hHoloh.continuousOn.mono hsphere_r₁_sub
    have hint1_r₁ : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) (0 : ℂ) r₁ :=
      (hinv_cont_r₁.mul hh_cont_r₁).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr₁_pos)
    have hint2_r₁ : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ => h z * (ζ - z)⁻¹) (0 : ℂ) r₁ :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hinv_cont_r₁).circleIntegrable (le_of_lt hr₁_pos)
    rw [circleIntegral.integral_congr (le_of_lt hr₁_pos) heq_r₁,
      circleIntegral.integral_sub hint1_r₁ hint2_r₁,
      circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, h_inner_h, h_inner_inv, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have h_int_eq : (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) =
      h z * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    have h_sub_zero :
        (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) - h z * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by
      rw [← h_outer, hdslope_shift, h_inner]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_zero
  have h2pi_ne : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
      Complex.I_ne_zero
  dsimp only [N_tilde]
  change (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ * (∮ ζ in C((0 : ℂ), r), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * h ζ) = Q (w, z) * G (w, z)
  rw [h_int_eq]
  dsimp only [h, H]
  calc (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ * (Q (w, z) * G (w, z) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      = ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
          (Q (w, z) * G (w, z)) := by ring
    _ = 1 * (Q (w, z) * G (w, z)) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne]
    _ = Q (w, z) * G (w, z) := one_mul _

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hScaleIntegral : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g →
      ∫ z in a..b, g z = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (b - a) * g (a + θ * (b - a)) := by
    intro a b g hg
    have hf_deriv : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => a + τ * (b - a)) (b - a) θ := by
      intro θ _
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id θ).mul_const (b - a)).const_add a
    have hEq := intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp hf_deriv continuousOn_const hg
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul, add_sub_cancel] at hEq
    exact hEq.symm

  
  have hParamContDiff :
      ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
        (k : ℕ) (F : E × ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) F →
        ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : E => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, F (p, θ)) := by
    intro E _ _ _ k
    have : ProperSpace E := FiniteDimensional.proper ℝ E
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro F hF
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiff_zero]
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (p : E) (θ : ℝ) => F (p, θ)) hF.continuous 0 1
    | succ k ih =>
      intro F hF
      have hk_cast : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [hk_cast] at hF ⊢
      obtain ⟨hF_diff, _, hF_fderiv⟩ := contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv_apply.mp hF
      let L : E × ℝ → (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
        fun q => (fderiv ℝ F q).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E ℝ)
      have hL_cont : Continuous L :=
        (hF.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_comp continuous_const
      have hF_cont : Continuous F := hF.continuous
      have hHasFDeriv : ∀ p₀ : E,
          HasFDerivAt (fun p : E => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, F (p, θ))
            (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, L (p₀, θ)) p₀ := by
        intro p₀
        have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall p₀ 1 ×ˢ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          (isCompact_closedBall p₀ 1).prod isCompact_uIcc
        obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hL_cont.continuousOn
        apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
          (F := fun p θ => F (p, θ)) (F' := fun p θ => L (p, θ)) (x₀ := p₀)
          (s := Metric.ball p₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => B)
        · exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ zero_lt_one
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p =>
            (hF_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact (hF_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
        · exact (hL_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ hθ p hp =>
            hB (p, θ) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hp, Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hθ⟩
        · exact intervalIntegrable_const
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p _ =>
            (hF_diff (p, θ)).hasFDerivAt.comp p
              ((hasFDerivAt_id p).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const θ p))
      rw [contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv_apply]
      refine ⟨fun p₀ => (hHasFDeriv p₀).differentiableAt, by simp, fun y => ?_⟩
      have hEq : (fun p₀ : E => (fderiv ℝ (fun p : E => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, F (p, θ)) p₀) y) =
          (fun p₀ : E => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (fderiv ℝ F (p₀, θ)) (y, 0)) := by
        ext p₀
        rw [(hHasFDeriv p₀).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
          (φ := fun θ => L (p₀, θ))
          ((hL_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 1) y]
        rfl
      rw [hEq]
      exact ih (fun q => (fderiv ℝ F q) (y, 0)) (hF_fderiv (y, 0))

  
  have hPrimBasic : ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic u (2 * Real.pi) → Continuous u →
      (∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ u) (Real.exp (u z)) z) ∧
      StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ u) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ u)) (primPhi_ℝ u) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ u (z + 2 * Real.pi) = primPhi_ℝ u (2 * Real.pi) + primPhi_ℝ u z) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ u)) (primPhi_ℝ u) := by
    intro u hu_per hu_cont
    have hexp_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => Real.exp (u ζ)) := Real.continuous_exp.comp hu_cont
    have hDeriv : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ u) (Real.exp (u z)) z := fun z =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hexp_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 z)
        (hexp_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds z))
        hexp_cont.continuousAt
    have hMono : StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ u) :=
      strictMono_of_deriv_pos fun z => by rw [(hDeriv z).deriv]; exact Real.exp_pos (u z)
    have hLeft : Function.LeftInverse (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ u)) (primPhi_ℝ u) :=
      Function.leftInverse_invFun hMono.injective
    have hZero : primPhi_ℝ u 0 = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
    have hShift : ∀ z : ℝ,
        primPhi_ℝ u (z + 2 * Real.pi) = primPhi_ℝ u (2 * Real.pi) + primPhi_ℝ u z := by
      let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => primPhi_ℝ u (z + 2 * Real.pi) - primPhi_ℝ u z
      have hd_deriv : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt d 0 z := by
        intro z
        have h1 := (hDeriv (z + 2 * Real.pi)).comp z ((hasDerivAt_id z).add_const (2 * Real.pi))
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ u (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) (Real.exp (u z)) z := by
          rw [hu_per z, mul_one] at h1
          exact h1
        have h3 := h2.sub (hDeriv z)
        rw [sub_self] at h3
        exact h3
      intro z
      have hz0 : d z = d 0 :=
        is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun x => (hd_deriv x).differentiableAt)
          (fun x => (hd_deriv x).deriv) z 0
      simp only [d, zero_add, hZero, sub_zero] at hz0
      linarith
    have hSurj : Function.Surjective (primPhi_ℝ u) := by
      intro y
      set P := primPhi_ℝ u (2 * Real.pi)
      have hP_pos : 0 < P := by
        have := hMono Real.two_pi_pos
        rwa [hZero] at this
      have hNatPos : ∀ n : ℕ, primPhi_ℝ u ((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = (n : ℝ) * P := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => simp [hZero]
        | succ n ih =>
          have hstep : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
              (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
          rw [hstep, hShift, ih]
          push_cast; ring
      have hNatNeg : ∀ n : ℕ, primPhi_ℝ u (-((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))) = -((n : ℝ) * P) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => simp [hZero]
        | succ n ih =>
          have hstep : -(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) + 2 * Real.pi =
              -((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) := by push_cast; ring
          have hs := hShift (-(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))
          rw [hstep, ih] at hs
          push_cast at hs ⊢
          linarith
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|y| / P)
      have hnP : |y| < (n : ℝ) * P := (div_lt_iff₀ hP_pos).mp hn
      have h_lo : -((n : ℝ) * P) ≤ y := by linarith [neg_abs_le y]
      have h_hi : y ≤ (n : ℝ) * P := by linarith [le_abs_self y]
      have hab : -((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        have : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
        linarith
      have hPhi_cont : Continuous (primPhi_ℝ u) :=
        Differentiable.continuous fun z => (hDeriv z).differentiableAt
      have hy_mem : y ∈ Set.Icc (primPhi_ℝ u (-((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))))
          (primPhi_ℝ u ((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        rw [hNatNeg n, hNatPos n]
        exact ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩
      obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab hPhi_cont.continuousOn hy_mem
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨hDeriv, hMono, hLeft, hShift, Function.rightInverse_invFun hSurj⟩

  
  have hMovingLeibniz :
      ∀ (g g₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ → ℝ) (a' b' s₀ : ℝ),
        Continuous g →
        Continuous g₁ →
        (∀ s z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => g (τ, z)) (g₁ (s, z)) s) →
        HasDerivAt a a' s₀ →
        HasDerivAt b b' s₀ →
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ z in a s..b s, g (s, z))
          (g (s₀, b s₀) * b' - g (s₀, a s₀) * a' + ∫ z in a s₀..b s₀, g₁ (s₀, z)) s₀ := by
    have hUpper :
        ∀ (g g₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℝ → ℝ) (b' s₀ : ℝ),
          Continuous g →
          Continuous g₁ →
          (∀ s z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => g (τ, z)) (g₁ (s, z)) s) →
          HasDerivAt b b' s₀ →
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s, g (s, z))
            (g (s₀, b s₀) * b' + ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s₀, g₁ (s₀, z)) s₀ := by
      intro g g₁ b b' s₀ hg hg₁ hg_deriv hb
      let H₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s₀, g (s, z)
      let H₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ z in b s₀..b s, g (s₀, z)
      let R : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∫ z in b s₀..b s, (g (s, z) - g (s₀, z))
      have hDecomp : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s, g (s, z)) =
          fun s => H₁ s + H₂ s + R s := by
        ext s
        have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g (s, z)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (b s₀) :=
          (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 (b s₀)
        have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g (s, z)) MeasureTheory.volume (b s₀) (b s) :=
          (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable (b s₀) (b s)
        have hi0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g (s₀, z)) MeasureTheory.volume (b s₀) (b s) :=
          (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable (b s₀) (b s)
        have hsplit := (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2).symm
        have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi2 hi0
        dsimp [H₁, H₂, R]
        linarith
      have hH₁ : HasDerivAt H₁ (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s₀, g₁ (s₀, z)) s₀ := by
        have hK₁ : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s₀ 1 ×ˢ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (b s₀)) :=
          (isCompact_closedBall s₀ 1).prod isCompact_uIcc
        obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ := hK₁.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hg₁.continuousOn
        exact (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
          (s := Metric.ball s₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => B₁)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ zero_lt_one)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s =>
            (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
          ((hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 (b s₀))
          (hg₁.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z hz s hs =>
            hB₁ (s, z) ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hs, Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hz⟩)
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z _ s _ => hg_deriv s z)).2
      have hH₂ : HasDerivAt H₂ (g (s₀, b s₀) * b') s₀ := by
        have hg0_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => g (s₀, z)) :=
          hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have hFTC : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ z in b s₀..u, g (s₀, z))
            (g (s₀, b s₀)) (b s₀) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
            (hg0_cont.intervalIntegrable (b s₀) (b s₀))
            (hg0_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds (b s₀)))
            hg0_cont.continuousAt
        exact hFTC.comp s₀ hb
      have hR : HasDerivAt R 0 s₀ := by
        rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero]
        have hR0 : R s₀ = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
        have hK₂ : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall s₀ 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (b s₀) 1) :=
          (isCompact_closedBall s₀ 1).prod (isCompact_closedBall (b s₀) 1)
        obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ := hK₂.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hg₁.continuousOn
        set M₂ := max B₂ 0
        have hM₂_nonneg : 0 ≤ M₂ := le_max_right B₂ 0
        have hb_cont : ContinuousAt b s₀ := hb.continuousAt
        have hadd_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => s₀ + t) (nhds 0) (nhds s₀) := by
          have h0 := ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => s₀).add continuous_id).tendsto 0
          change Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => s₀ + t) (nhds 0) (nhds (s₀ + 0)) at h0
          rwa [add_zero] at h0
        have hbt : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => b (s₀ + t)) (nhds 0) (nhds (b s₀)) :=
          hb_cont.tendsto.comp hadd_tend
        have h_ev_nhds : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 0,
            ‖t‖ < 1 ∧ b (s₀ + t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (b s₀) 1 := by
          have h1 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds (0 : ℝ), ‖t‖ < 1 :=
            Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) zero_lt_one) fun t ht => by
              simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht
          have h2 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds (0 : ℝ), b (s₀ + t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (b s₀) 1 :=
            hbt.eventually (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds (b s₀) zero_lt_one)
          exact h1.and h2
        apply squeeze_zero_norm' (a := fun t : ℝ => M₂ * |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀|)
        · filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds h_ev_nhds, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ⟨ht1, hbt1⟩ ht0
          have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp ht0
          have hs_mem : s₀ + t ∈ Metric.closedBall s₀ 1 := by
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            simpa using le_of_lt ht1
          have hR_bound : ‖R (s₀ + t)‖ ≤ (M₂ * ‖t‖) * |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀| := by
            apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
            intro z hz
            have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (b s₀) 1 := by
              rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq] at hbt1 ⊢
              obtain ⟨hbt_lo, hbt_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hbt1
              rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hz) with ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ | ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ <;>
                exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            have hMVT := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
              (f := fun τ : ℝ => g (τ, z)) (s := Metric.closedBall s₀ 1) (C := M₂)
              (fun τ _ => (hg_deriv τ z).differentiableAt)
              (fun τ hτ => by
                rw [(hg_deriv τ z).deriv]
                exact le_trans (hB₂ (τ, z) ⟨hτ, hz_mem⟩) (le_max_left B₂ 0))
              (convex_closedBall s₀ 1)
              (Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one)
              hs_mem
            simpa [add_sub_cancel_left] using hMVT
          rw [hR0, sub_zero, norm_smul, norm_inv]
          calc ‖t‖⁻¹ * ‖R (s₀ + t)‖
              ≤ ‖t‖⁻¹ * ((M₂ * ‖t‖) * |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀|) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR_bound (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg t))
            _ = M₂ * |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀| := by
                have hn_ne : ‖t‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr ht_ne
                field_simp [hn_ne]
        · have h_tend_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => M₂ * |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀|)
              (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
            have h_abs : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => |b (s₀ + t) - b s₀|) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
              simpa [sub_self] using (hbt.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := b s₀))).abs
            simpa using h_abs.const_mul M₂
          exact h_tend_zero.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      rw [hDecomp]
      convert (hH₁.add hH₂).add hR using 1
      ring
    intro g g₁ a b a' b' s₀ hg hg₁ hg_deriv ha hb
    have hEq : (fun s : ℝ => ∫ z in a s..b s, g (s, z)) =
        fun s => (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s, g (s, z)) - (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..a s, g (s, z)) := by
      ext s
      have hi_a : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g (s, z)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (a s) :=
        (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 (a s)
      have hi_ab : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g (s, z)) MeasureTheory.volume (a s) (b s) :=
        (hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable (a s) (b s)
      linarith [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi_a hi_ab]
    rw [hEq]
    have hSub := (hUpper g g₁ b b' s₀ hg hg₁ hg_deriv hb).sub
      (hUpper g g₁ a a' s₀ hg hg₁ hg_deriv ha)
    have hIntAdj : (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..b s₀, g₁ (s₀, z)) - (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..a s₀, g₁ (s₀, z)) =
        ∫ z in a s₀..b s₀, g₁ (s₀, z) := by
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g₁ (s₀, z)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (a s₀) :=
        (hg₁.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 (a s₀)
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => g₁ (s₀, z)) MeasureTheory.volume (a s₀) (b s₀) :=
        (hg₁.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable (a s₀) (b s₀)
      linarith [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2]
    convert hSub using 1
    linarith

  
  have hTriSwapLeft : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (A B : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous A → Continuous B →
      (∫ ζ in a..b, (∫ z in a..ζ, B z) * A ζ) =
        ∫ z in a..b, B z * (∫ ζ in z..b, A ζ) := by
    intro a b A B hA hB
    let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => ∫ z in a..ζ, B z
    let V : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => ∫ s in b..ζ, A s
    have hU : ∀ ζ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt U (B ζ) ζ := fun ζ _ =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hB.intervalIntegrable a ζ)
        (hB.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds ζ)) hB.continuousAt
    have hV : ∀ ζ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt V (A ζ) ζ := fun ζ _ =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hA.intervalIntegrable b ζ)
        (hA.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds ζ)) hA.continuousAt
    have hIBP := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hU hV
      (hB.intervalIntegrable a b) (hA.intervalIntegrable a b)
    have hUa : U a = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
    have hVb : V b = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
    rw [hUa, hVb, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, zero_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hIBP
    rw [hIBP]
    congr 1
    ext z
    have hSymm : -V z = ∫ ζ in z..b, A ζ := by
      dsimp [V]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm z b, neg_neg]
    linarith [congrArg (fun x => B z * x) hSymm]

  have hTriSwapRight : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (A B : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous A → Continuous B →
      (∫ ζ in a..b, (∫ z in ζ..b, B z) * A ζ) =
        ∫ z in a..b, B z * (∫ ζ in a..z, A ζ) := by
    intro a b A B hA hB
    calc (∫ ζ in a..b, (∫ z in ζ..b, B z) * A ζ)
        = -(∫ ζ in b..a, (-(∫ z in b..ζ, B z)) * A ζ) := by
            conv_lhs => rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm b a]
            congr 1; apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr; intro ζ _
            dsimp only
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm b ζ]
      _ = ∫ ζ in b..a, (∫ z in b..ζ, B z) * A ζ := by
            simp only [neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg]
      _ = ∫ z in b..a, B z * (∫ ζ in z..a, A ζ) := hTriSwapLeft b a A B hA hB
      _ = ∫ z in a..b, B z * (∫ ζ in a..z, A ζ) := by
            conv_lhs => rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm a b]
            have : (fun z : ℝ => B z * (∫ ζ in z..a, A ζ)) =
                fun z : ℝ => -(B z * (∫ ζ in a..z, A ζ)) := by
              ext z; rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm a z, mul_neg]
            rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, neg_neg]

  
  have hJointMidC4 : ∀ (w v : ℝ → ℝ),
      Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) → ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
      Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) → ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + p.1 * v ζ) p.2) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => midpoint_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + p.2.2 * v ζ) p.1 p.2.1) := by
    intro w v hw_per hw_reg hv_per hv_reg
    let phi2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + p.1 * v ζ) p.2
    have hphi2_eq : phi2 = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, p.2 * Real.exp (w (θ * p.2) + p.1 * v (θ * p.2)) := by
      ext ⟨t, z⟩
      dsimp [phi2, primPhi_ℝ]
      have hwt_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => Real.exp (w ζ + t * v ζ)) := by
        fun_prop
      rw [hScaleIntegral 0 z (fun ζ => Real.exp (w ζ + t * v ζ)) hwt_cont]
      congr 1; ext θ; simp [sub_zero]
    have hphi2_reg : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) phi2 := by
      rw [hphi2_eq]
      apply hParamContDiff 4 (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
        q.1.2 * Real.exp (w (q.2 * q.1.2) + q.1.1 * v (q.2 * q.1.2)))
      have hθz : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => q.2 * q.1.2) :=
        contDiff_snd.mul (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)
      exact (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst).mul
        (Real.contDiff_exp.comp
          ((hw_reg.comp hθz).add ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).mul (hv_reg.comp hθz))))
    let PhiTilde : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p => (p.1, phi2 p)
    let G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ :=
      fun q => (q.1, Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + q.1 * v ζ)) q.2)
    have hPhiTilde_reg : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) PhiTilde :=
      contDiff_fst.prodMk hphi2_reg
    have hwt_basic : ∀ t : ℝ,
        (∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ))
          (Real.exp (w z + t * v z)) z) ∧
        Function.LeftInverse (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ)))
          (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ)) ∧
        Function.RightInverse (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ)))
          (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ)) := by
      intro t
      have hper : Function.Periodic (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ) (2 * Real.pi) := fun ζ => by
        simp [hw_per ζ, hv_per ζ]
      have hcont : Continuous (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ) :=
        hw_reg.continuous.add (continuous_const.mul hv_reg.continuous)
      obtain ⟨hD, _, hL, _, hR⟩ := hPrimBasic _ hper hcont
      exact ⟨hD, hL, hR⟩
    have hLeftG : Function.LeftInverse G PhiTilde := fun ⟨t, z⟩ =>
      Prod.ext rfl ((hwt_basic t).2.1 z)
    have hRightG : Function.RightInverse G PhiTilde := fun ⟨t, y⟩ =>
      Prod.ext rfl ((hwt_basic t).2.2 y)
    have hG_reg : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) G := by
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro q
      set a := G q
      have hPhi_a : PhiTilde a = q := hRightG q
      have hphi2_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ phi2 a :=
        (hphi2_reg.differentiable (by decide)) a
      let L₀ : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ phi2 a
      let a₀ : ℝ := L₀ (1, 0)
      let b₀ : ℝ := L₀ (0, 1)
      have hb₀_eq : b₀ = Real.exp (w a.2 + a.1 * v a.2) := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => phi2 (a.1, z)) b₀ a.2 :=
          hphi2_diff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt a.2
            ((hasDerivAt_const a.2 a.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id a.2))
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => phi2 (a.1, z))
            (Real.exp (w a.2 + a.1 * v a.2)) a.2 := (hwt_basic a.1).1 a.2
        exact h1.unique h2
      have hb₀_ne : b₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hb₀_eq]; exact Real.exp_ne_zero _
      have hL₀_decomp : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, L₀ u = u.1 * a₀ + u.2 * b₀ := by
        intro u
        have hu : u = u.1 • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) + u.2 • ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
          ext <;> simp
        conv_lhs => rw [hu]
        rw [L₀.map_add, L₀.map_smul, L₀.map_smul]
        simp [a₀, b₀, smul_eq_mul]
      let M : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod L₀
      let N : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
          (b₀⁻¹ • (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ - a₀ • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ))
      have hNM : Function.LeftInverse N M := by
        intro ⟨u₁, u₂⟩
        ext
        · rfl
        · change b₀⁻¹ * (L₀ (u₁, u₂) - a₀ * u₁) = u₂
          rw [hL₀_decomp (u₁, u₂)]
          field_simp [hb₀_ne]
          ring
      have hMN : Function.RightInverse N M := by
        intro ⟨v₁, v₂⟩
        ext
        · rfl
        · change L₀ (v₁, b₀⁻¹ * (v₂ - a₀ * v₁)) = v₂
          rw [hL₀_decomp (v₁, b₀⁻¹ * (v₂ - a₀ * v₁))]
          field_simp [hb₀_ne]
          ring
      let e : (ℝ × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse M N hNM hMN
      have hf_at : ContDiffAt ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) PhiTilde a := hPhiTilde_reg.contDiffAt
      have hf'_at : HasFDerivAt PhiTilde (e : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) a :=
        (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := a)).prodMk hphi2_diff.hasFDerivAt
      have hn : (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by decide
      have hLocSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) (hf_at.localInverse hf'_at hn) (PhiTilde a) :=
        hf_at.to_localInverse hf'_at hn
      have hStrict : HasStrictFDerivAt PhiTilde (e : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) a :=
        hf_at.hasStrictFDerivAt' hf'_at hn
      have hEvEq : G =ᶠ[nhds (PhiTilde a)] hf_at.localInverse hf'_at hn :=
        hStrict.localInverse_unique (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hLeftG)
      rw [← hPhi_a]

    have hMid_eq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => midpoint_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + p.2.2 * v ζ) p.1 p.2.1) =
        fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>

  have hKm_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelMinus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by

    have hIntCont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>

  have hKp_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cellKernelPlus_ℝ w p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by

  have hDerivX : ∀ X Y : ℝ,

    let g_m1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>

    have hgm1_cont : Continuous g_m1 := by dsimp [g_m1]; fun_prop

        have hc := h1.cos

          ((hasDerivAt_const s (1 : ℝ)).sub hc).neg
        have hval : -(0 - -Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w s) * -Real.exp (w s)) =
            Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w s) * Real.exp (w s) := by ring
        rwa [hval] at hs
      simpa [g_m, g_m1] using h2.mul_const (Real.exp (-2 * w z))
    have hgp_deriv : ∀ s z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => g_p (τ, z)) 0 s :=
      fun s z => hasDerivAt_const s (g_p (s, z))
    have hActEq : (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y) =
        fun X' : ℝ => (∫ z in X'..μ X', g_m (X', z)) + (∫ z in μ X'..Y, g_p (X', z)) := by
      ext X'
      dsimp [normAction_ℝ, g_m, g_p, μ]
      simp only [neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [hActEq]
    have hL := hMovingLeibniz g_m g_m1 id μ 1 (deriv μ X) X
      hgm_cont hgm1_cont hgm_deriv (hasDerivAt_id X) hμ_deriv
    have hR := hMovingLeibniz g_p (fun _ => 0) μ (fun _ => Y) (deriv μ X) 0 X

    have hgm_diag : g_m (X, id X) = 0 := by
      dsimp [g_m]; simp
    have hgp_mid : g_m (X, μ X) = g_p (X, μ X) := by
      dsimp [g_m, g_p, μ]
      have hm := hMid_eval X Y
      have hdiff : primPhi_ℝ w (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) - primPhi_ℝ w X =
          primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) := by linarith
      rw [hdiff]
    have hIntEq : (∫ z in id X..μ X, g_m1 (X, z)) = normAction1_ℝ w X Y := by
      dsimp [g_m1, normAction1_ℝ, μ, id]
      have : (fun z : ℝ =>
          Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) =
          fun z : ℝ =>
            Real.exp (w X) * (Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) := by
        ext z; ring
      rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hVal : ((g_m (X, μ X) * deriv μ X - g_m (X, id X) * 1 + ∫ z in id X..μ X, g_m1 (X, z)) +
        (g_p (X, Y) * 0 - g_p (X, μ X) * deriv μ X + ∫ z in μ X..Y, 0)) =
        normAction1_ℝ w X Y := by
      rw [hgm_diag, hgp_mid, hIntEq, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      ring
    rwa [hVal] at hSum

  have hActAntisymm : ∀ X Y : ℝ, normAction_ℝ w X Y = -normAction_ℝ w Y X := by
    intro X Y
    dsimp [normAction_ℝ]
    rw [hMid_symm X Y]
    have h1 : (∫ z in Y..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
        (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w Y)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) =
        -(∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y,
          (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w z)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) Y]
      congr 1; apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr; intro z _
      dsimp only
      have : primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w Y = -(primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w z) := by ring
      rw [this, Real.cos_neg]
    have h2 : (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..X,
        (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w X - primPhi_ℝ w z)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) =
        -(∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
          (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)]
      congr 1; apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr; intro z _
      dsimp only
      have : primPhi_ℝ w X - primPhi_ℝ w z = -(primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) := by ring
      rw [this, Real.cos_neg]
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring

  have hEndPartials : ∀ X Y : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y) (normAction1_ℝ w X Y) X ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X Y') (-normAction1_ℝ w Y X) Y := by

    have hEq : (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X Y') = fun Y' : ℝ => -normAction_ℝ w Y' X := by

    rw [hEq]

  have hAct_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞)
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1) := by
    let phi_tv : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + q.1 * v ζ) q.2
    let mu_tv : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun p => midpoint_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + p.2.2 * v ζ) p.1 p.2.1
    have hphi_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) phi_tv := hPhi_tv_c4.of_le (by decide)
    have hmu_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) mu_tv := hMu_tv_c4.of_le (by decide)
    have hw_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) w := hw_reg.of_le (by decide)
    have hv_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) v := hv_reg.of_le (by decide)
    let Gm : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>
      let X := q.1.1; let t := q.1.2.2; let μ := mu_tv q.1; let θ := q.2
      let z := X + θ * (μ - X)
      (μ - X) * ((1 - Real.cos (phi_tv (t, z) - phi_tv (t, X))) *
        Real.exp (-2 * (w z + t * v z)))
    let Gp : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>
      let Y := q.1.2.1; let t := q.1.2.2; let μ := mu_tv q.1; let θ := q.2
      let z := μ + θ * (Y - μ)
      (Y - μ) * ((1 - Real.cos (phi_tv (t, Y) - phi_tv (t, z))) *
        Real.exp (-2 * (w z + t * v z)))
    have hActScale : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1) =
        fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          -(∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Gm (p, θ)) - (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Gp (p, θ)) := by
      ext ⟨X, Y, t⟩
      dsimp [normAction_ℝ, Gm, Gp, phi_tv, mu_tv]
      have hphi_t_cont : Continuous (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ)) :=
        hPhi_tv_c4.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hw_c : Continuous w := hw_reg.continuous
      have hv_c : Continuous v := hv_reg.continuous
      rw [hScaleIntegral X (midpoint_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ) X Y)
          (fun z => (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ) z -

          (by fun_prop),

          (fun z => (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ (fun ζ => w ζ + t * v ζ) Y -

    have hX_q : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => q.1.1) :=
      contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst
    have hY_q : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => q.1.2.1) :=
      contDiff_fst.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)
    have ht_q : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => q.1.2.2) :=
      contDiff_snd.comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)
    have hμ_q : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => mu_tv q.1) :=

        (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => q.1.1 + q.2 * (mu_tv q.1 - q.1.1)) :=
      hX_q.add (contDiff_snd.mul (hμ_q.sub hX_q))
    have hzp_q : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => mu_tv q.1 + q.2 * (q.1.2.1 - mu_tv q.1)) :=
      hμ_q.add (contDiff_snd.mul (hY_q.sub hμ_q))
    have hGm_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) Gm :=
      (hμ_q.sub hX_q).mul
        (((contDiff_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub (Real.contDiff_cos.comp
            ((hphi_c2.comp (ht_q.prodMk hzm_q)).sub (hphi_c2.comp (ht_q.prodMk hX_q))))).mul
          (Real.contDiff_exp.comp
            ((contDiff_const (c := (-2 : ℝ))).mul
              ((hw_c2.comp hzm_q).add (ht_q.mul (hv_c2.comp hzm_q))))))
    have hGp_c2 : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) Gp :=
      (hY_q.sub hμ_q).mul
        (((contDiff_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).sub (Real.contDiff_cos.comp
            ((hphi_c2.comp (ht_q.prodMk hY_q)).sub (hphi_c2.comp (ht_q.prodMk hzp_q))))).mul
          (Real.contDiff_exp.comp
            ((contDiff_const (c := (-2 : ℝ))).mul
              ((hw_c2.comp hzp_q).add (ht_q.mul (hv_c2.comp hzp_q))))))
    exact (hParamContDiff 2 Gm hGm_c2).neg.sub (hParamContDiff 2 Gp hGp_c2)

  intro X Y hXY

  let wt : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun t z => w z + t * v z

  have hDeltaDeriv : ∀ u₁ u₂ t : ℝ,

    intro u₁ u₂ t
    have hDiffEq : (fun τ : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ (wt τ) u₂ - primPhi_ℝ (wt τ) u₁) =

      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => Real.exp (w z + τ * v z))

      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun z => Real.exp (w z + τ * v z))
          MeasureTheory.volume u₁ u₂ := (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable u₁ u₂
      linarith [intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals hi1 hi2]
    rw [hDiffEq]
    have hL := hMovingLeibniz
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (w q.2 + q.1 * v q.2))
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (w q.2 + q.1 * v q.2) * v q.2)
      (fun _ => u₁) (fun _ => u₂) 0 0 t
      (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun s z => by
        simpa [mul_comm] using
          (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const (v z)).const_add (w z)).exp)
      (hasDerivAt_const t u₁) (hasDerivAt_const t u₂)

        (r.1.2 - u₀) * (Real.exp (w (u₀ + r.2 * (r.1.2 - u₀)) +

  let gm_t : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>

  have hgm_t_deriv : ∀ t ζ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => gm_t (τ, ζ)) (gm_t1 (t, ζ)) t := by

        have hc0 : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ((0 : ℝ), ζ)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id

    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiA hiB,

        (fun ζ => Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ))

            ∫ ζ in z..μ, Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) =
            fun z : ℝ => -(∫ ζ in μ..z,
              Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) := by
          ext z; exact intervalIntegral.integral_symm μ z
        rw [hEq]
        have hf_c : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ =>
            Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) := by fun_prop
        exact (Differentiable.continuous fun z => (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
          (hf_c.intervalIntegrable μ z)
          (hf_c.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds z))
          hf_c.continuousAt).differentiableAt).neg
      exact (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable X μ
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiA hiB']
    congr 1; ext z; dsimp [cellKernelMinus_ℝ, μ]; ring

  have hRightCollapse : (∫ ζ in μt 0..Y, gp_t1 (0, ζ)) =
      ∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y, cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z * v z := by
    rw [hμt0]
    set μ := midpoint_ℝ w X Y
    have h1 : (fun ζ : ℝ => gp_t1 (0, ζ)) = fun ζ : ℝ =>
        2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ)) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ) * v ζ -
        (∫ z in ζ..Y, Real.exp (w z) * v z) *
          (Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) := by
      ext ζ; dsimp [gp_t1]; rw [hwt0]; ring
    rw [h1]
    have hiA : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun ζ => 2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ)) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ) * v ζ)
        MeasureTheory.volume μ Y := (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable μ Y
    have hiB : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun ζ => (∫ z in ζ..Y, Real.exp (w z) * v z) *
          (Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume μ Y := by
      have hIntC : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ∫ z in ζ..Y, Real.exp (w z) * v z) := by
        have hc0 : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ((0 : ℝ), ζ)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
        simpa [Function.comp_def, hwt0] using (hDeltaContRight Y).comp hc0
      exact (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable μ Y
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiA hiB,
      hTriSwapRight μ Y
        (fun ζ => Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ))
        (fun z => Real.exp (w z) * v z) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
    have hiB' : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun z => (Real.exp (w z) * v z) *
          (∫ ζ in μ..z, Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume μ Y := by
      have hSubC : Continuous (fun z : ℝ =>
          ∫ ζ in μ..z, Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) := by
        have hf_c : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ =>
            Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)) := by fun_prop
        exact Differentiable.continuous fun z => (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
          (hf_c.intervalIntegrable μ z)
          (hf_c.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds z))
          hf_c.continuousAt).differentiableAt
      exact (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable μ Y
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hiA hiB']
    congr 1; ext z; dsimp [cellKernelPlus_ℝ, μ]; ring

  have hVal_t :
      ((gm_t (0, μt 0) * deriv μt 0 - gm_t (0, X) * 0 + ∫ ζ in X..μt 0, gm_t1 (0, ζ)) +
        (gp_t (0, Y) * 0 - gp_t (0, μt 0) * deriv μt 0 + ∫ ζ in μt 0..Y, gp_t1 (0, ζ))) =
      (∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y), cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z * v z) +
        (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y, cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z * v z) := by
    rw [hBdryCancel, hLeftCollapse, hRightCollapse]
    ring
  rwa [hVal_t] at hSum_t
