signature.name: halfCell_inverse_system
signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1)) :
    Nonempty (HalfCellInverseSystem m M S)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hm
  have _ := hM
  
  have hChooseSum : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose n
  have hChooseSuccLe : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (n.choose (i + 1) : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    have hsplit := Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun j => (n.choose j : ℝ)) n
    rw [hChooseSum n, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one] at hsplit
    linarith
  have hSumProdBound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c a b : ℕ → ℝ) (M_a M_b : ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_b →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, 0 ≤ c i) →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, |a i| ≤ M_a) →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, |b i| ≤ M_b) →
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * a i * b i| ≤
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i) * (M_a * M_b) := by
    intro n c a b M_a M_b hMb hc ha hb
    calc
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * a i * b i|
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, |c i * a i * b i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i * (M_a * M_b) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hc i hi), mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul (ha i hi) (hb i hi) (abs_nonneg _)
              (le_trans (abs_nonneg (a i)) (ha i hi)))
            (hc i hi)
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, c i) * (M_a * M_b) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  
  have hStage2 : ∀ (p : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ p →
      Function.Periodic e (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) e →
      (∀ x : ℝ, |e x| ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ |deriv e x| ≤ 1 / 2) →
      ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInv ρ e) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInvDisp ρ e) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, hcShiftPerturb ρ e (x + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftPerturb ρ e x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInv ρ e (z + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftInv ρ e z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Function.LeftInverse (hcShiftInv ρ e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) ∧
      Function.RightInverse (hcShiftInv ρ e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, deriv (hcShiftInv ρ e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ e x) * deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) x = 1) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInvDisp ρ e z = -e (hcShiftInv ρ e z)) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, (1 + deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ e z)) * deriv (hcShiftInvDisp ρ e) z =
        -deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ e z)) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInvDisp ρ e z = hcShiftInvDisp 0 e (z - ρ)) := by
    intro p ρ e hp he_per he_cd he_bnd
    have hp_ne : ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p ≠ 0)
    have he_diff : Differentiable ℝ e := he_cd.differentiable hp_ne
    have hCore : ∀ ρ' : ℝ,
        StrictMono (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInv ρ' e) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, hcShiftPerturb ρ' e (x + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInv ρ' e (z + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftInv ρ' e z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        Function.LeftInverse (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) ∧
        Function.RightInverse (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, deriv (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x) *
          deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) x = 1) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e z = -e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, (1 + deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z)) * deriv (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) z =
          -deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z)) := by
      intro ρ'
      have hf_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) :=
        (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).add he_cd
      have hf_hasDeriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) (1 + deriv e x) x := by
        intro x
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y + ρ') 1 x := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).add_const ρ'
        exact h1.add (he_diff x).hasDerivAt
      have hf_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) x = 1 + deriv e x :=
        fun x => (hf_hasDeriv x).deriv
      have hf_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hf_deriv x]
        have h := (abs_le.mp (he_bnd x).2).1
        linarith
      have hf_mono : StrictMono (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) := strictMono_of_deriv_pos hf_deriv_pos
      have hf_surj : Function.Surjective (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) := by
        intro z
        let a : ℝ := z - ρ' - 1
        let b : ℝ := z - ρ' + 1
        have hab : a ≤ b := by dsimp [a, b]; linarith
        have hfa : hcShiftPerturb ρ' e a ≤ z := by
          have ha_bnd := (abs_le.mp (he_bnd a).1).2
          dsimp [hcShiftPerturb, a]
          linarith
        have hfb : z ≤ hcShiftPerturb ρ' e b := by
          have hb_bnd := (abs_le.mp (he_bnd b).1).1
          dsimp [hcShiftPerturb, b]
          linarith
        obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf_cd.continuous.continuousOn ⟨hfa, hfb⟩
        exact ⟨x, hx⟩
      let H : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ :=
        (StrictMono.orderIsoOfSurjective (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) hf_mono hf_surj).toHomeomorph
      have hH_coe : (H : ℝ → ℝ) = hcShiftPerturb ρ' e := rfl
      have hInv_eq_H : hcShiftInv ρ' e = (H.symm : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        ext z
        have hex : ∃ x : ℝ, hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x = z := ⟨H.symm z, H.right_inv z⟩
        have h1 : hcShiftPerturb ρ' e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z) = z := Function.invFun_eq hex
        have h2 : hcShiftPerturb ρ' e (H.symm z) = z := H.right_inv z
        exact hf_mono.injective (h1.trans h2.symm)
      have hLeftInv : Function.LeftInverse (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) := by
        intro x; rw [hInv_eq_H]; exact H.left_inv x
      have hRightInv : Function.RightInverse (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) := by
        intro z; rw [hInv_eq_H]; exact H.right_inv z
      have hg_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInv ρ' e) := by
        rw [hInv_eq_H]
        exact H.contDiff_symm_deriv
          (f' := fun x => 1 + deriv e x)
          (fun x => by have h := (abs_le.mp (he_bnd x).2).1; linarith)
          (fun x => by rw [hH_coe]; exact hf_hasDeriv x)
          (by rw [hH_coe]; exact hf_cd)
      have hψ_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) :=
        hg_cd.sub (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
      have hf_qper : ∀ x : ℝ,
          hcShiftPerturb ρ' e (x + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x + 2 * Real.pi := by
        intro x
        dsimp [hcShiftPerturb]
        rw [he_per x]
        ring
      have hg_qper : ∀ z : ℝ,
          hcShiftInv ρ' e (z + 2 * Real.pi) = hcShiftInv ρ' e z + 2 * Real.pi := by
        intro z
        apply hf_mono.injective
        rw [hRightInv (z + 2 * Real.pi), hf_qper, hRightInv z]
      have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ (hcShiftInv ρ' e) := hg_cd.differentiable hp_ne
      have hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) := hf_cd.differentiable hp_ne
      have hChain : ∀ x : ℝ,
          deriv (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x) * deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) x = 1 := by
        intro x
        have hcomp : deriv ((hcShiftInv ρ' e) ∘ (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e)) x =
            deriv (hcShiftInv ρ' e) (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e x) * deriv (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) x :=
          deriv_comp x (hg_diff _) (hf_diff x)
        have hid : (hcShiftInv ρ' e) ∘ (hcShiftPerturb ρ' e) = id := funext hLeftInv
        rw [hid, deriv_id] at hcomp
        exact hcomp.symm
      have hDispEq : ∀ z : ℝ, hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e z = -e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z) := by
        intro z
        have hz := hRightInv z
        dsimp [hcShiftPerturb] at hz
        dsimp [hcShiftInvDisp]
        linarith
      have hψ_diff : Differentiable ℝ (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) := hψ_cd.differentiable hp_ne
      have hLinDeriv : ∀ z : ℝ,
          (1 + deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z)) * deriv (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) z =
            -deriv e (hcShiftInv ρ' e z) := by
        intro z
        have hg_eq : hcShiftInv ρ' e = fun y : ℝ => (y - ρ') + hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e y := by
          ext y; dsimp [hcShiftInvDisp]; ring
        have h_sub_hd : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y - ρ') 1 z := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const ρ'
        have hg_deriv_z : deriv (hcShiftInv ρ' e) z = 1 + deriv (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) z := by
          have hd : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y - ρ') + hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e y)
              (1 + deriv (hcShiftInvDisp ρ' e) z) z :=
            h_sub_hd.add (hψ_diff z).hasDerivAt
          rw [← hg_eq] at hd
          exact hd.deriv
        have hc := hChain (hcShiftInv ρ' e z)
        rw [hRightInv z, hf_deriv (hcShiftInv ρ' e z), hg_deriv_z] at hc
        linarith
      exact ⟨hf_mono, hf_cd, hg_cd, hψ_cd, hf_qper, hg_qper, hLeftInv, hRightInv,
        hChain, hDispEq, hLinDeriv⟩
    obtain ⟨hf_mono, hf_cd, hg_cd, hψ_cd, hf_qper, hg_qper, hLeftInv, hRightInv,
      hChain, hDispEq, hLinDeriv⟩ := hCore ρ
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hRightInv0, _, _, _⟩ := hCore 0
    refine ⟨hf_cd, hg_cd, hψ_cd, hf_qper, hg_qper, hLeftInv, hRightInv,
      hChain, hDispEq, hLinDeriv, ?_⟩
    intro z
    have hz0 := hRightInv0 (z - ρ)
    dsimp [hcShiftPerturb] at hz0
    have h_eq : hcShiftPerturb ρ e (hcShiftInv 0 e (z - ρ)) =
        hcShiftPerturb ρ e (hcShiftInv ρ e z) := by
      rw [hRightInv z]
      dsimp [hcShiftPerturb]
      linarith
    have hg_shift : hcShiftInv 0 e (z - ρ) = hcShiftInv ρ e z := hf_mono.injective h_eq
    dsimp [hcShiftInvDisp]
    linarith
  
  have hStage3 : ∀ (r : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ B →
      ∃ K_comp : ℝ, 0 < K_comp ∧
        (∀ (g x : ℝ → ℝ) (M_g : ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ ((r : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
          ContDiff ℝ ((r : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) x →
          0 ≤ M_g →
          (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ r → ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j g y| ≤ M_g) →
          (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ r → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j x z| ≤ B) →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g (x y)) z| ≤ K_comp * M_g) ∧
        (∀ (g₁ g₂ x₁ x₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (M_g Δ_g Δ_x : ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ ((r : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
          ContDiff ℝ ((r + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
          ContDiff ℝ ((r : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) x₁ →
          ContDiff ℝ ((r : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) x₂ →
          0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ Δ_g → 0 ≤ Δ_x →
          (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ r → ∀ y : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv j (fun u : ℝ => g₁ u - g₂ u) y| ≤ Δ_g) →
          (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ r + 1 → ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j g₂ y| ≤ M_g) →
          (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ r → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv j x₁ z| ≤ B ∧ |iteratedDeriv j x₂ z| ≤ B) →
          (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ r → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv j (fun u : ℝ => x₁ u - x₂ u) z| ≤ Δ_x) →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (x₁ y) - g₂ (x₂ y)) z| ≤
              K_comp * (Δ_g + M_g * Δ_x)) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro B _hB
      refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro g x M_g _hg _hx _hMg hg_bnd _hx_bnd k hk z
        have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
        subst hk0
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hg_bnd 0 (le_refl 0) (x z)
      · intro g₁ g₂ x₁ x₂ M_g Δ_g Δ_x _hg₁ hg₂ _hx₁ _hx₂ _hMg _hΔg _hΔx
          hdiff_g hg₂_bnd _hx_bnd hdiff_x k hk z
        have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
        subst hk0
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        have h1 : |g₁ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₁ z)| ≤ Δ_g := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hdiff_g 0 (le_refl 0) (x₁ z)
        have hg₂_diff : Differentiable ℝ g₂ :=
          hg₂.differentiable (by norm_num)
        have hg₂_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖deriv g₂ y‖ ≤ M_g := by
          intro y
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, iteratedDeriv_one] using hg₂_bnd 1 (le_refl 1) (le_refl 1) y
        have h2_mvt : |g₂ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₂ z)| ≤ M_g * |x₁ z - x₂ z| := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
            Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
              (fun y _ => hg₂_diff y) (fun y _ => hg₂_deriv y)
              convex_univ (Set.mem_univ (x₂ z)) (Set.mem_univ (x₁ z))
        have hx_z : |x₁ z - x₂ z| ≤ Δ_x := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hdiff_x 0 (le_refl 0) z
        have h2 : |g₂ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₂ z)| ≤ M_g * Δ_x :=
          le_trans h2_mvt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx_z (le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hg₂_deriv 0)))
        have h_tri : |g₁ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₂ z)| ≤ |g₁ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₁ z)| + |g₂ (x₁ z) - g₂ (x₂ z)| :=
          abs_sub_le (g₁ (x₁ z)) (g₂ (x₁ z)) (g₂ (x₂ z))
        linarith
    | succ r ih =>
      intro B hB
      obtain ⟨K_r, hK_r_pos, ih_a, ih_b⟩ := ih B hB
      let K_a : ℝ := 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * K_r * B
      let K_b : ℝ := 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * K_r * (B + 1)
      let K_comp : ℝ := K_a + K_b
      have hK_a_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_a := by
        dsimp [K_a]
        linarith [show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ r * K_r * B by positivity]
      have hK_b_ge1 : 1 ≤ K_b := by
        dsimp [K_b]
        linarith [show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ r * K_r * (B + 1) by positivity]
      have hK_comp_pos : 0 < K_comp := by dsimp [K_comp]; linarith
      have hr1_ne : ((r + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero r
      have hPartA_sharp : ∀ (g x : ℝ → ℝ) (M_g : ℝ),
          ContDiff ℝ ((r + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g →

    have hSinglePrefix : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ m + 1 →

              intro i hi

    have hDiffPrefix : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ m + 1 →

    have hq2_le_q3 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    have hDiffSup_nonneg : 0 ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨l, _, y, _, rfl⟩
      exact abs_nonneg _
    obtain ⟨hε0, hε4⟩ := hEpsSmall q hq
    obtain ⟨hPair_m₁, hPair_p₁⟩ := hSinglePairs q w₁ j hq_mesh hw₁ hj
    obtain ⟨hPair_m₂, hPair_p₂⟩ := hSinglePairs q w₂ j hq_mesh hw₂ hj
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hMeshJ₁, hMidJ₁⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w₁ hq_mesh (hWeakenM w₁ hw₁)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hMeshJ₂, hMidJ₂⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w₂ hq_mesh (hWeakenM w₂ hw₂)
    obtain ⟨hLipD, hLipΔD, hLipMid⟩ :=
      S.real_mesh_lip q w₁ w₂ hq_mesh (hWeakenM w₁ hw₁) (hWeakenM w₂ hw₂)
    have hd_j₁ := hMeshJ₁ j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hd_j1₁ := hMeshJ₁ (j + 1) hj
    have hmid_j₁ := hMidJ₁ j hj
    have hd_j₂ := hMeshJ₂ j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hd_j1₂ := hMeshJ₂ (j + 1) hj
    have hmid_j₂ := hMidJ₂ j hj
    let B₀_lip : ℝ := (S.R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    obtain ⟨hDiff_m_raw, hDiff_p_raw⟩ := hBuildPairs (m + 2) B₀_lip
      (fun x : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w₁ j x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x)
      (fun x : ℝ =>
        (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₁ j x) -
          (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x))
      (fun x : ℝ => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j x - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j x)
      (hd_j₁.1.sub hd_j₂.1)
      ((hd_j1₁.1.sub hd_j₁.1).sub (hd_j1₂.1.sub hd_j₂.1))
      (hmid_j₁.1.sub hmid_j₂.1)
      (hd_j₁.2.1.sub hd_j₂.2.1)
      ((hd_j1₁.2.1.sub hd_j₁.2.1).sub (hd_j1₂.2.1.sub hd_j₂.2.1))
      (hmid_j₁.2.1.sub hmid_j₂.2.1)
      (fun l hl x =>
        ⟨(le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr (hLipD j (Nat.le_of_lt hj) l hl x),
         (le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr
           (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq2_le_q3 (abs_nonneg _))
             (hLipΔD j hj l hl x)),
         (le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr (hLipMid j hj l hl x)⟩)
    have hDiff_m : IsHcBoundedPeriodicPair (m + 2) (3 * B₀_lip)
        (fun x : ℝ => errA_m q w₁ j x - errA_m q w₂ j x)
        (fun x : ℝ => errB_m q w₁ j x - errB_m q w₂ j x) := by
      have hEqBm : (fun x : ℝ => errB_m q w₁ j x - errB_m q w₂ j x) =
          (fun x : ℝ =>
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              ((realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₁ j x) -
                (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x)) +
              (realMidpointDisp q w₁ j x - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j x)) := by
        ext x; dsimp [errB_m]; ring
      rw [hEqBm]
      exact hDiff_m_raw
    have hDiff_p : IsHcBoundedPeriodicPair (m + 2) (3 * B₀_lip)
        (fun x : ℝ => errA_p q w₁ j x - errA_p q w₂ j x)
        (fun x : ℝ => errB_p q w₁ j x - errB_p q w₂ j x) := by
      have hEqAp : (fun x : ℝ => errA_p q w₁ j x - errA_p q w₂ j x) =
          (fun x : ℝ =>
            (realMeshDisp q w₁ j x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                ((realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₁ j x) -
                  (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x)) +
              (realMidpointDisp q w₁ j x - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j x)) := by
        ext x; dsimp [errA_p]; ring
      have hEqBp : (fun x : ℝ => errB_p q w₁ j x - errB_p q w₂ j x) =
          (fun x : ℝ =>
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              ((realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₁ j x) -
                (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w₂ j x)) -
              (realMidpointDisp q w₁ j x - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j x)) := by
        ext x; dsimp [errB_p]; ring
      rw [hEqAp, hEqBp]
      exact hDiff_p_raw
    have h3B₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * B₀_lip := by
      dsimp [B₀_lip]
      exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
        (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt S.R_mesh_pos) hDiffSup_nonneg) (le_of_lt hq2_pos))
    have hDm₁ := (hFwdIds q w₁ j α hq_ne).2.2.2.2.1
    have hDm₂ := (hFwdIds q w₂ j α hq_ne).2.2.2.2.1
    have hDp₁ := (hFwdIds q w₁ j α hq_ne).2.2.2.2.2
    have hDp₂ := (hFwdIds q w₂ j α hq_ne).2.2.2.2.2
    rw [hDm₁, hDm₂, hDp₁, hDp₂]
    have hL_m := hJetLip (ρ_m q j)
      (errA_m q w₁ j) (errB_m q w₁ j) (errA_m q w₂ j) (errB_m q w₂ j)
      (3 * (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) (3 * B₀_lip) hε0 hε4 h3B₀_nonneg
      hPair_m₁ hPair_m₂ hDiff_m α hα k hk z
    have hL_p := hJetLip (ρ_p q j)
      (errA_p q w₁ j) (errB_p q w₁ j) (errA_p q w₂ j) (errB_p q w₂ j)
      (3 * (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) (3 * B₀_lip) hε0 hε4 h3B₀_nonneg
      hPair_p₁ hPair_p₂ hDiff_p α hα k hk z
    have hC_lip_eq : C_jet * (3 * B₀_lip) =
        (C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ := by
      dsimp [C_inv, B₀_lip]; ring
    rw [← hC_lip_eq]
    exact ⟨hL_m, hL_p⟩

halfCell_inverse_system.definitions:
noncomputable def hcShiftPerturb (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x + ρ + e x

noncomputable def hcShiftInv (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (hcShiftPerturb ρ e) z

noncomputable def hcShiftInvDisp (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  hcShiftInv ρ e z - (z - ρ)

def IsHcBoundedPeriodicPair (p : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (A B : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Function.Periodic A (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  Function.Periodic B (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) A ∧
  ContDiff ℝ ((p : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k A x| ≤ ε ∧ |iteratedDeriv k B x| ≤ ε

proof.tactics:
by
  have hJet : RealCJetToolkitProp_fcks := by
    have hConst : ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℝ), HasCJetBound_fcks p |c| (fun _ => c) := by
      intro p c
      refine ⟨contDiff_const, abs_nonneg c, fun k _ x => ?_⟩
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs
      · exact le_rfl
      · simp [abs_nonneg c]
    have hMono : ∀ {p' p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
        p' ≤ p → B₁ ≤ B₂ → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p' B₂ f := by
      intro p' p B₁ B₂ f hp' hB hf
      refine ⟨hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hp'), le_trans hf.2.1 hB, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      exact le_trans (hf.2.2 k (le_trans hk hp') x) hB
    have hAdd : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
        HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x) := by
      intro p B₁ B₂ f g hf hg
      refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, add_nonneg hf.2.1 hg.2.1, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      have hfk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f x := (hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      have hgk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) g x := (hg.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hfk hgk]
      exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hf.2.2 k hk x) (hg.2.2 k hk x))
    have hSub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
        HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x - g x) := by
      intro p B₁ B₂ f g hf hg
      refine ⟨hf.1.sub hg.1, add_nonneg hf.2.1 hg.2.1, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      have hfk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f x := (hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      have hgk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) g x := (hg.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hfk hgk]
      calc |iteratedDeriv k f x - iteratedDeriv k g x|
          ≤ |iteratedDeriv k f x| + |iteratedDeriv k g x| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ B₁ + B₂ := add_le_add (hf.2.2 k hk x) (hg.2.2 k hk x)
    have hConstMul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ},
        HasCJetBound_fcks p B f → HasCJetBound_fcks p (|c| * B) (fun x => c * f x) := by
      intro p B c f hf
      refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hf.1, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hf.2.1, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      have hfk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f x := (hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul c hfk, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf.2.2 k hk x) (abs_nonneg c)
    have hMul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
        HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x) := by
      intro p B₁ B₂ f g hf hg
      have hB1 : 0 ≤ B₁ := hf.2.1
      have hB2 : 0 ≤ B₂ := hg.2.1
      refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, by positivity, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      have hfk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f x := (hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      have hgk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) g x := (hg.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hfk hgk]
      calc |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i f x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) g x|
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), |(k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i f x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) g x| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * B₁ * B₂ := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have hi_le : i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) hk
            have hki_le : k - i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
            have h1 := hf.2.2 i hi_le x
            have h2 := hg.2.2 (k - i) hki_le x
            have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
            gcongr
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) * B₁ * B₂ := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₁ * B₂ := by
            have hchoose : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
              exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
            rw [hchoose]
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂ := by
            have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk
            gcongr
    have hMulDiff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {M_f M_g L_f L_g : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
        HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₂ →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₂ →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p L_g (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * M_g + M_f * L_g))
          (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x) := by
      intro p M_f M_g L_f L_g f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ _ hf₂ hg₁ _ hLf hLg
      have h1 := hMul hLf hg₁
      have h2 := hMul hf₂ hLg
      have hsum := hAdd h1 h2
      have heq : (fun x => (f₁ x - f₂ x) * g₁ x + f₂ x * (g₁ x - g₂ x)) =
          (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x) := by
        ext x; ring
      rw [heq] at hsum
      exact hMono le_rfl (by linarith) hsum
    have hCompFactorNonneg : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ compJetFactor_fcks p B := by
      intro p B hB
      induction p with
      | zero => simp [compJetFactor_fcks]
      | succ p ih =>
        simp only [compJetFactor_fcks]
        positivity
    have hCompOn : ∀ (p : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g B_f : ℝ) (g f : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
        0 ≤ M_g →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k g y| ≤ M_g) →
        HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f →
        (∀ x : ℝ, f x ∈ S) →
        HasCJetBound_fcks p (M_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f) (fun x => g (f x)) := by
      intro p
      induction p with
      | zero =>
        intro S M_g B_f g f hg hMg hgS hf hfS
        refine ⟨hg.comp hf.1, by simp [compJetFactor_fcks, hMg], fun k hk x => ?_⟩
        interval_cases k
        simpa [compJetFactor_fcks] using hgS 0 le_rfl (f x) (hfS x)
      | succ p ih =>
        intro S M_g B_f g f hg hMg hgS hf hfS
        have hBf : 0 ≤ B_f := hf.2.1
        have hcf : 0 ≤ compJetFactor_fcks p B_f := hCompFactorNonneg p B_f hBf
        refine ⟨hg.comp hf.1, mul_nonneg hMg (hCompFactorNonneg (p + 1) B_f hBf), fun k hk x => ?_⟩
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, compJetFactor_fcks]
          have h0 := hgS 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (f x) (hfS x)
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
          have hextra : 0 ≤ M_g * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B_f * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f) := by positivity
          linarith
        | succ r =>
          have hr : r ≤ p := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
          have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg.differentiable (by simp)
          have hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.1.differentiable (by simp)
          have hderiv_eq : deriv (fun y => g (f y)) = fun y => deriv g (f y) * deriv f y := by
            ext y
            exact deriv_comp y hg_diff.differentiableAt hf_diff.differentiableAt
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hderiv_eq]
          have hg' : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv g) := by
            have hg1 : ContDiff ℝ ((p : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) g := by exact_mod_cast hg
            exact (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hg1).2.2
          have hg'S : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv j (deriv g) y| ≤ M_g := by
            intro j hj y hy
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hgS (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) y hy
          have hf_p : HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f :=
            ⟨hf.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p), hBf,
              fun j hj1 hjp z => hf.2.2 j hj1 (le_trans hjp (Nat.le_succ p)) z⟩
          have h_comp_ih := ih S M_g B_f (deriv g) f hg' hMg hg'S hf_p hfS
          have hf'_cd : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f) := by
            have hf1 : ContDiff ℝ ((p : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1) f := by exact_mod_cast hf.1
            exact (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hf1).2.2
          have hf'_jet : HasCJetBound_fcks p B_f (deriv f) := by
            refine ⟨hf'_cd, hBf, fun j hj z => ?_⟩
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hf.2.2 (j + 1) (Nat.succ_pos j) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) z
          have h_prod := (hMul h_comp_ih hf'_jet).2.2 r hr x
          simp only [compJetFactor_fcks]
          nlinarith
    have hDerivSndStep : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiff ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry F) →
        ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (F q.1) q.2) := by
      intro n F hF
      let f2 : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun q y => F q.1 y
      have hf2 : ContDiff ℝ (((n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) (Function.uncurry f2) := by
        have hF' : ContDiff ℝ (((n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) (Function.uncurry F) := by exact_mod_cast hF
        have hlin : ContDiff ℝ (((n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) (fun r : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (r.1.1, r.2)) :=
          (contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd
        exact hF'.comp hlin
      have happ := ContDiff.fderiv_apply hf2 contDiff_snd (contDiff_const (c := (1 : ℝ))) le_rfl
      simpa only [f2, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using happ
    have hIterSndCD : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        k ≤ p → ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry F) →
        ContDiff ℝ ((p - k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro p F _ hF
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero, Function.uncurry_def, Nat.sub_zero] using hF
      | succ k ih =>
        intro p F hk hF
        cases p with
        | zero => omega
        | succ p =>
          have hk' : k ≤ p := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
          have hF1 : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry (fun t x => deriv (F t) x)) :=
            hDerivSndStep p F hF
          have h_ih := ih p (fun t x => deriv (F t) x) hk' hF1
          have heq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (F q.1) q.2) =
              (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (deriv (F q.1)) q.2) := by
            funext q
            exact congr_fun iteratedDeriv_succ' q.2
          rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, heq]
          exact h_ih
    have hIterSndCont : ∀ (p : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry F) →
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
          Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2) := by
      intro p F hF k hk

    have hUnitIntCalc : ∀ (p : ℕ) (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),

            rescaledCellKernel_fcks w₂ (cellBasePlus_fcks q w₂ j) (cellStepPlus_fcks q w₂ j) (1 - α) y) =
        (fun y : ℝ => fwdKernelPlus q w₁ j α y - fwdKernelPlus q w₂ j α y) := by
      ext y; rw [(hEq₁ α y).2, (hEq₂ α y).2]
    rw [hm_eq] at hLM
    rw [hp_eq] at hLP
    exact ⟨hLM.2.2 k hk x, hLP.2.2 k hk x⟩

forward_cell_kernel_system.definitions:
def HasCJetBound_fcks (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k f x| ≤ B

def HasDerivJetBound_fcks (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k f x| ≤ B

def compJetFactor_fcks : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * B * compJetFactor_fcks p B

structure RealCJetToolkitProp_fcks : Prop where
  jet_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℝ), HasCJetBound_fcks p |c| (fun _ => c)
  jet_mono : ∀ {p' p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
    p' ≤ p → B₁ ≤ B₂ → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p' B₂ f
  jet_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x)
  jet_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x - g x)
  jet_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B f → HasCJetBound_fcks p (|c| * B) (fun x => c * f x)
  jet_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B₁ f → HasCJetBound_fcks p B₂ g →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x)
  jet_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {M_f M_g L_f L_g : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
    HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_f f₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₁ → HasCJetBound_fcks p M_g g₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_g (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * M_g + M_f * L_g))
      (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x)
  jet_comp_on : ∀ (p : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g B_f : ℝ) (g f : ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
    0 ≤ M_g →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k g y| ≤ M_g) →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f →
    (∀ x : ℝ, f x ∈ S) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (M_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f) (fun x => g (f x))
  jet_comp_diff_on : ∀ (p : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g L_g B_f L_f : ℝ) (g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    Convex ℝ S →
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
    0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ L_g →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p + 1 → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k g₂ y| ≤ M_g) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ y ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv k (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) y| ≤ L_g) →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f₁ →
    HasDerivJetBound_fcks p B_f f₂ →
    (∀ x : ℝ, f₁ x ∈ S ∧ f₂ x ∈ S) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p
      (L_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * L_f * (M_g * compJetFactor_fcks p B_f))
      (fun x => g₁ (f₁ x) - g₂ (f₂ x))
  jet_unit_integral : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry G) →
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasCJetBound_fcks p B (G t)) →
    HasCJetBound_fcks p B (fun x : ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, G t x)
  contDiff_unit_integral_2d : ∀ (p : ℕ) (G : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => G q.1 q.2) →
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, G t z)
  contDiff_iteratedDeriv_snd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry F) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
      Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2)
  periodic_diff_jet : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    Function.Periodic w₁ (2 * Real.pi) →
    Function.Periodic w₂ (2 * Real.pi) →
    ContDiff ℝ (r₀ : WithTop ℕ∞) w₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (r₀ : WithTop ℕ∞) w₂ →
    HasCJetBound_fcks r₀ (realDiffSup r₀ w₁ w₂) (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x)

noncomputable def realSinc_fcks (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (s * u)

noncomputable def realCos2_fcks (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * Real.cos (s * u)

def cellDeltaW_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  w (B x + c * H x) - w (B x)

noncomputable def cellExpAvgJ_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (B x + (θ * c) * H x) - w (B x))

noncomputable def cellDeltaPhi_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (c x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c * H x * Real.exp (w (B x)) * cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H c x

noncomputable def rescaledCellKernel_fcks (w B H : ℝ → ℝ) (β x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  H x ^ 2 *
    (2 * β ^ 2 * (cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H β x) ^ 2 *
        realCos2_fcks (cellDeltaPhi_fcks w B H β x) *
        Real.exp (-2 * cellDeltaW_fcks w B H β x) -
      (1 - β) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (let γ := β + (1 - β) * τ
         γ * cellExpAvgJ_fcks w B H γ x *
           realSinc_fcks (cellDeltaPhi_fcks w B H γ x) *
           Real.exp (cellDeltaW_fcks w B H β x - 2 * cellDeltaW_fcks w B H γ x)))

def IsCellBaseStepPair_fcks (p : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (σ_sgn : ℝ) (B H : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (σ_sgn = 1 ∨ σ_sgn = -1) ∧
  (∃ (ρ : ℝ) (d : ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ x : ℝ, B x = x + ρ + d x) ∧
    HasCJetBound_fcks p (R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) d) ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p (2 * R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun x => H x - σ_sgn * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

def IsCellBaseStepDiff_fcks (p : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (Δ : ℝ)
    (B₁ H₁ B₂ H₂ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ Δ ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p ((R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δ) (fun x => B₁ x - B₂ x) ∧
  HasCJetBound_fcks p ((2 * R₀ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δ) (fun x => H₁ x - H₂ x)

noncomputable def cellBaseMinus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j

noncomputable def cellStepMinus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x j

noncomputable def cellBasePlus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x (j + 1)

noncomputable def cellStepPlus_fcks (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x (j + 1)

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (hCalc : NormActionCalculusProp) (H_inv : HalfCellInverseSystem m M S)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : (H_inv.N_inv : ℤ) ≤ |n|)
    (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w) :
    Function.Periodic (globalB_mult n w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 15 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => globalC_coeff n (fun x => w x + t * v x))
        (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * globalB_mult n w x * (v x : ℂ))
        0

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (hCalc : NormActionCalculusProp) (H_inv : HalfCellInverseSystem m M S)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : (H_inv.N_inv : ℤ) ≤ |n|)
    (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w) :
    Function.Periodic (globalB_mult n w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 15 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => globalC_coeff n (fun x => w x + t * v x))
        (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * globalB_mult n w x * (v x : ℂ))
        0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have _ := hM
  let q : ℕ := n.natAbs
  have hq_cast : (q : ℤ) = |n| := Int.natCast_natAbs n
  have hq_inv : H_inv.N_inv ≤ q := Int.ofNat_le.mp (hq_cast.symm ▸ hn)
  have hq_mesh : S.N_mesh ≤ q := le_trans H_inv.N_inv_ge hq_inv
  have hq_four : 4 ≤ q := le_trans S.N_mesh_ge_four hq_mesh
  have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : q = 0 := by simp [q, h0]
    omega
  have hw1 : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) (M + 1) w :=
    ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, fun k hk x => le_trans (hw.2.2 k hk x) (by linarith)⟩
  have hw_c4 : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w :=
    hw.2.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 4 ≤ m + 15))
  obtain ⟨hMesh, _, _, hDispProps, _⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w hq_mesh hw1
  obtain ⟨hMid_cont, hKM_cont, hKP_cont, hDiagPer, hActDerivXY, hActVar⟩ :=
    hCalc w hw.1 hw_c4

  have hMesh_eq : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      realMesh q w x i = realMeshDisp q w i x + (x + 2 * Real.pi * (i : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) := by
    intro i x
    simp only [realMeshDisp]
    ring
  have hMesh_cont : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ q → Continuous (fun x : ℝ => realMesh q w x i) := by
    intro i hi
    have heq : (fun x : ℝ => realMesh q w x i) =
        (fun x : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w i x + (x + 2 * Real.pi * (i : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) :=
      funext (hMesh_eq i)
    rw [heq]
    exact (hDispProps i hi).2.1.continuous.add (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
  have hMesh_qper : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ q → ∀ x : ℝ,
      realMesh q w (x + 2 * Real.pi) i = realMesh q w x i + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro i hi x
    rw [hMesh_eq i (x + 2 * Real.pi), hMesh_eq i x, (hDispProps i hi).1 x]
    ring

  
  have hFubini : ∀ {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) (H : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H p.1 p.2) (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d) →
      (∫ u in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, H u y) = ∫ y in c..d, ∫ u in a..b, H u y := by
    intro a b c d hab hcd H hH
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hcd]
    apply MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict]
    exact (hH.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)

  
  have hAffineInt : ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (a0 b0 : ℝ), Continuous φ →
      (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, φ (a0 + α * (b0 - a0)) * (b0 - a0)) = ∫ z in a0..b0, φ z := by
    intro φ a0 b0 hφ
    have hderiv : ∀ α ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun α : ℝ => a0 + α * (b0 - a0)) (b0 - a0) α := by
      intro α _
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id α).mul_const (b0 - a0)).const_add a0
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv' hderiv continuousOn_const hφ.continuousOn
    simpa using h

  
  have hPhasePer : ∀ z : ℝ,
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((z + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) := by
    intro z
    have hexp_eq :
        -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((z + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ) + ((-n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hexp_eq, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I (-n), mul_one]

  
  have hHalfCell : ∀ (a0 b0 : ℝ → ℝ) (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (c_off : ℝ → ℝ)
      (f g disp : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (bCell : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ α z : ℝ, bCell α z =
        ((K (g α z) z * (b0 (g α z) - a0 (g α z)) * deriv (g α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((g α z - z : ℝ) : ℂ))) →
      Continuous a0 →
      Continuous b0 →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2) →
      Continuous c_off →
      (∀ x : ℝ, a0 (x + 2 * Real.pi) = a0 x + 2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, b0 (x + 2 * Real.pi) = b0 x + 2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ x z : ℝ, K (x + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) = K x z) →
      (∀ α z : ℝ, disp α z = g α z - (z - c_off α)) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => disp p.1 p.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (disp p.1) p.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      (∀ α x : ℝ, f α x = a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (f α) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (disp α) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, f α (x + 2 * Real.pi) = f α x + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z : ℝ, g α (z + 2 * Real.pi) = g α z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        Function.LeftInverse (g α) (f α) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, deriv (g α) (f α x) * deriv (f α) x = 1)) →
      (∀ z : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun α => bCell α z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1) ∧
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Function.Periodic (bCell α) (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell α z) ∧
      (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) → Continuous v →
        (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) *
            (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell α z) * (v z : ℂ)) =
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
            ((∫ z in (a0 x)..(b0 x), K x z * v z : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro a0 b0 K c_off f g disp bCell hbCell_def ha0_cont hb0_cont hK_cont hc_cont
      ha0_qper hb0_qper hK_per hdisp_def hdisp_cont0 hdisp_cont1 hf_def hfg_props
    let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ
    have hg_eq : ∀ α z : ℝ, g α z = disp α z + (z - c_off α) := by
      intro α z; linarith [hdisp_def α z]
    have hg_deriv : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z : ℝ,
        deriv (g α) z = deriv (disp α) z + 1 := by
      intro α hα z
      have hd_c1 : ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) (disp α) :=
        (hfg_props α hα).2.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ m + 1))
      have hd_diff : Differentiable ℝ (disp α) := hd_c1.differentiable (by decide)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (disp α) (deriv (disp α) z) z := (hd_diff z).hasDerivAt
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y - c_off α) 1 z :=
        (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const (c_off α)
      have hsum : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => disp α y + (y - c_off α)) (deriv (disp α) z + 1) z :=
        h1.add h2
      simpa only [← funext (hg_eq α)] using hsum.deriv
    
    have hg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g p.1 p.2) D := by
      have hlin : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 - c_off p.1) D :=
        (continuous_snd.sub (hc_cont.comp continuous_fst)).continuousOn
      exact (hdisp_cont0.add hlin).congr (fun p _ => hg_eq p.1 p.2)
    have hdg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (g p.1) p.2) D :=
      (hdisp_cont1.add continuousOn_const).congr (fun p hp => hg_deriv p.1 hp.1 p.2)
    have hbCell_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => bCell p.1 p.2) D := by
      have hK_comp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K (g p.1 p.2) p.2) D :=
        hK_cont.comp_continuousOn (hg_cont.prodMk continuous_snd.continuousOn)
      have hwidth : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => b0 (g p.1 p.2) - a0 (g p.1 p.2)) D :=
        (hb0_cont.comp_continuousOn hg_cont).sub (ha0_cont.comp_continuousOn hg_cont)
      have hreal_part : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          ((K (g p.1 p.2) p.2 * (b0 (g p.1 p.2) - a0 (g p.1 p.2)) *
            deriv (g p.1) p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) D :=
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn ((hK_comp.mul hwidth).mul hdg_cont)
      have hexp_part : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((g p.1 p.2 - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) D := by
        have harg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((g p.1 p.2 - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) D :=
          continuousOn_const.mul
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn (hg_cont.sub continuous_snd.continuousOn))
        exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn harg
      exact (hreal_part.mul hexp_part).congr (fun p _ => hbCell_def p.1 p.2)
    
    have hbCell_per : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Function.Periodic (bCell α) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro α hα z
      have hg_qper := (hfg_props α hα).2.2.2.1
      have hdg_per : deriv (g α) (z + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv (g α) z := by
        calc deriv (g α) (z + 2 * Real.pi)
            = deriv (fun y : ℝ => g α (y + 2 * Real.pi)) z :=
              (deriv_comp_add_const (g α) (2 * Real.pi) z).symm
          _ = deriv (fun y : ℝ => g α y + 2 * Real.pi) z := by
              congr 1; ext y; exact hg_qper y
          _ = deriv (g α) z := deriv_add_const (2 * Real.pi)
      rw [hbCell_def α (z + 2 * Real.pi), hbCell_def α z, hg_qper z, hdg_per,
        ha0_qper (g α z), hb0_qper (g α z), hK_per (g α z) z]
      have hsub2 : (b0 (g α z) + 2 * Real.pi) - (a0 (g α z) + 2 * Real.pi) =
          b0 (g α z) - a0 (g α z) := by ring
      have hsub3 : (g α z + 2 * Real.pi) - (z + 2 * Real.pi) = g α z - z := by ring
      rw [hsub2, hsub3]
    
    have hint_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell α z) := by
      let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun α => max 0 (min 1 α)
      have hclamp_cont : Continuous clamp :=
        continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
      have hclamp_mem : ∀ α : ℝ, clamp α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        fun α => ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left _ _)⟩
      have hclamp_id : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, clamp α = α := by
        intro α hα; simp [clamp, min_eq_right hα.2, max_eq_right hα.1]
      have hcomp_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => bCell (clamp p.2) p.1) :=
        hbCell_cont.comp_continuous (hclamp_cont.comp continuous_snd |>.prodMk continuous_fst)
          (fun p => ⟨hclamp_mem p.2, trivial⟩)
      have hparam : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell (clamp α) z) :=
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          (f := fun z α => bCell (clamp α) z) hcomp_cont 0 1
      have heq : (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell α z) =
          (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell (clamp α) z) := by
        ext z
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
        intro α hα
        dsimp only
        rw [hclamp_id α hα]
      rwa [heq]
    
    have hbCell_int : ∀ z : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun α => bCell α z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      intro z
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact hbCell_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun α hα => ⟨hα, trivial⟩)
    refine ⟨hbCell_int, hbCell_per, hint_cont, ?_⟩
    intro v hv_per hv_cont
    let G : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α z =>
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * bCell α z * (v z : ℂ)
    have hpull_in : ∀ z : ℝ,
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) *
          (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCell α z) * (v z : ℂ) =
        ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, G α z := by
      intro z
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    simp_rw [hpull_in]
    have hG_cont_rect : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G p.2 p.1)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      have hexp_c : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst))).continuousOn
      have hb_c : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => bCell p.2 p.1)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hbCell_cont.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst).continuousOn
          (fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, trivial⟩)
      have hv_c : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (v p.1 : ℂ))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hv_cont.comp continuous_fst)).continuousOn
      exact (hexp_c.mul hb_c).mul hv_c
    rw [hFubini Real.two_pi_pos.le zero_le_one (fun z α => G α z) hG_cont_rect]
    let H_rev : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α x =>
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
        ((K x (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) * (b0 x - a0 x) *
          v (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hAlphaStep : ∀ α ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G α z) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H_rev α x := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      intro α hα
      obtain ⟨hf_cd, _, hf_qper, _, hg_linv, hfg_deriv⟩ := hfg_props α hα
      have hG_per : Function.Periodic (G α) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro z
        simp only [G, hPhasePer z, hbCell_per α hα z, hv_per z]
      have hG_cont_z : Continuous (G α) := by
        have hb_z : Continuous (bCell α) :=
          hbCell_cont.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
            (fun z => ⟨hα, trivial⟩)
        have hexp_z : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ))) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal)
        exact (hexp_z.mul hb_z).mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hv_cont)
      have hshift : (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G α z) =
          ∫ z in (f α 0)..(f α (2 * Real.pi)), G α z := by
        have h1 := (hG_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq (f α 0) 0).symm
        have h0_eq : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := zero_add _
        have hf_2pi : f α (2 * Real.pi) = f α 0 + 2 * Real.pi := by
          simpa only [zero_add] using hf_qper 0
        rw [h0_eq, ← hf_2pi] at h1
        exact h1
      have hf_c1 : ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) (f α) :=
        hf_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ m + 2))
      have hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ (f α) := hf_c1.differentiable (by decide)
      have hf'_cont : Continuous (deriv (f α)) := by
        simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one] using hf_c1.continuous_iteratedDeriv 1 le_rfl
      have hsub_int : (∫ z in (f α 0)..(f α (2 * Real.pi)), G α z) =
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), deriv (f α) x • G α (f α x) :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp'
          (fun x _ => (hf_diff x).hasDerivAt) hf'_cont.continuousOn hG_cont_z.continuousOn).symm
      rw [hshift, hsub_int]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      dsimp only
      rw [Complex.real_smul]
      simp only [G, H_rev, hbCell_def α (f α x), hg_linv x]
      have hexp_prod :
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (f α x : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x - f α x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast; ring
      have hjac := hfg_deriv x
      calc ((deriv (f α) x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (f α x : ℂ)) *
              (((K x (f α x) * (b0 x - a0 x) * deriv (g α) (f α x) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x - f α x : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
              (v (f α x) : ℂ))
          = (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (f α x : ℂ)) *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x - f α x : ℝ) : ℂ))) *
              (((K x (f α x) * (b0 x - a0 x) * v (f α x)) *
                (deriv (g α) (f α x) * deriv (f α) x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            push_cast; ring
        _ = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
              ((K x (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) * (b0 x - a0 x) *
                v (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            rw [hexp_prod, hjac, mul_one, hf_def α x]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr hAlphaStep]
    have hHrev_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H_rev p.1 p.2) := by
      dsimp only [H_rev]
      fun_prop
    rw [hFubini zero_le_one Real.two_pi_pos.le H_rev hHrev_cont.continuousOn]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro x _
    dsimp only [H_rev]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    have hKx_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => K x z) := by fun_prop
    have haff := hAffineInt (fun z : ℝ => K x z * v z) (a0 x) (b0 x) (hKx_cont.mul hv_cont)
    have hmul_comm : (fun α : ℝ =>
        K x (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) * (b0 x - a0 x) * v (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x))) =
        (fun α : ℝ =>
        (K x (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x)) * v (a0 x + α * (b0 x - a0 x))) * (b0 x - a0 x)) := by
      ext α; ring
    rw [hmul_comm, haff]

  
  obtain ⟨bCellMinus, hbCellMinus_def⟩ : ∃ f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ, ∀ j α z, f j α z =
      (let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z
       let X_m := realMesh q w x_m j
       let Y_m := realMesh q w x_m (j + 1)
       let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
       ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
         deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
         Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨bCellPlus, hbCellPlus_def⟩ : ∃ f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ, ∀ j α z, f j α z =
      (let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z
       let X_p := realMesh q w x_p j
       let Y_p := realMesh q w x_p (j + 1)
       let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
       ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
         deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
         Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩

  have hMinusAll : ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      (∀ z : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun α => bCellMinus j α z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1) ∧
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Function.Periodic (bCellMinus j α) (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCellMinus j α z) ∧
      (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) → Continuous v →
        (∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) *
            (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, bCellMinus j α z) * (v z : ℂ)) =
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
            ((∫ z in (realMesh q w x j)..(midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))),
              cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) z * v z : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hInvCont, hInvAlpha⟩ := H_inv.inv_props q w j hq_inv hw hj
    have hX_cont := hMesh_cont j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
    have hY_cont := hMesh_cont (j + 1) hj
    have hμ_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) := by fun_prop
    have hKm_pair_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w p.1 j) (realMesh q w p.1 (j + 1)) p.2) := by fun_prop
    have hc_cont : Continuous (fun α : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) / (q : ℝ)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hμ_qper : ∀ x : ℝ,
        midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w (x + 2 * Real.pi) j) (realMesh q w (x + 2 * Real.pi) (j + 1)) =
        midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      intro x
      rw [hMesh_qper j (Nat.le_of_lt hj) x, hMesh_qper (j + 1) hj x, (hDiagPer _ _ 0).1]
    have hKm_per : ∀ x z : ℝ,
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w (x + 2 * Real.pi) j)
          (realMesh q w (x + 2 * Real.pi) (j + 1)) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) z := by
      intro x z
      rw [hMesh_qper j (Nat.le_of_lt hj) x, hMesh_qper (j + 1) hj x, (hDiagPer _ _ z).2.1]
    have hdisp0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => halfCellInvDispMinus q w j p.1 p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hInvCont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
    have hdisp1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j p.1) p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_one] using (hInvCont 1 (by omega : 1 ≤ m + 1)).1
    exact hHalfCell
      (fun x => realMesh q w x j)
      (fun x => midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)))
      (fun x z => cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) z)
      (fun α => 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) / (q : ℝ))
      (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j)
      (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j)
      (halfCellInvDispMinus q w j)
      (bCellMinus j)
      (hbCellMinus_def j)
      hX_cont hμ_cont hKm_pair_cont hc_cont
      (hMesh_qper j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)) hμ_qper hKm_per
      (fun _ _ => rfl) hdisp0 hdisp1 (fun _ _ => rfl)
      (fun α hα => by
        obtain ⟨hc1, _, hc3, _, hqp1, _, hqp3, _, hli1, _, _, _, hd1, _, _⟩ := hInvAlpha α hα

    have hKp_pair_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>

    have hc_cont : Continuous (fun α : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) / (q : ℝ)) := by

    have hμ_qper : ∀ x : ℝ,

      rw [hMesh_qper j (Nat.le_of_lt hj) x, hMesh_qper (j + 1) hj x, (hDiagPer _ _ z).2.2]
    have hdisp0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => halfCellInvDispPlus q w j p.1 p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by

    have hdisp1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j p.1) p.2)

    exact hHalfCell

      (fun x => realMesh q w x (j + 1))
      (fun x z => cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) z)

      (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j)
      (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j)
      (halfCellInvDispPlus q w j)
      (bCellPlus j)
      (hbCellPlus_def j)
      hμ_cont hY_cont hKp_pair_cont hc_cont
      hμ_qper (hMesh_qper (j + 1) hj) hKp_per
      (fun _ _ => rfl) hdisp0 hdisp1 (fun _ _ => rfl)
      (fun α hα => by

  have hB_unfold : ∀ z : ℝ,

        -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *

  let cellFrozenVar : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun X Y =>

  let frozenActionFourier : ℂ :=
    -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
