  let L_lip : ℝ := S.R_mesh * M_v / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
  have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L_lip :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg S.R_mesh_pos.le hMv_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hMesh_lip : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ δ_v → ∀ (j : ℕ), j ≤ q → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |realMesh q (w_pert t) x j - realMesh q w x j| ≤ L_lip * |t| := by
    intro t ht j hj x
    have hlip0 := (S.real_mesh_lip q (w_pert t) w hq_mesh (hw_pert_adm t ht) hw1).1
      j hj 0 (Nat.zero_le _) x
    simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hlip0
    have hdisp_diff :
        realMeshDisp q (w_pert t) j x - realMeshDisp q w j x =
          realMesh q (w_pert t) x j - realMesh q w x j := by
      simp only [realMeshDisp]; ring
    rw [hdisp_diff] at hlip0
    have hq2_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
    rw [le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos] at *
    have h1 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |realMesh q (w_pert t) x j - realMesh q w x j| ≤
        S.R_mesh * (M_v * |t|) :=
      le_trans hlip0 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hDiffSup_le t) S.R_mesh_pos.le)
    calc |realMesh q (w_pert t) x j - realMesh q w x j|
        = ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |realMesh q (w_pert t) x j - realMesh q w x j|) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [hq2_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ (S.R_mesh * (M_v * |t|)) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hq2_pos.le
      _ = L_lip * |t| := by simp only [L_lip]; ring

  
  have hv_c4 : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) v :=
    hv_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 4 ≤ m + 15))
  obtain ⟨hF_c2, hVar1D⟩ := hActVar v hv_per hv_c4
  let F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun p => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + p.2.2 * v z) p.1 p.2.1
  change ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) F at hF_c2
  have hF_diff : Differentiable ℝ F := hF_c2.differentiable (by decide)
  let DF : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) → ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fderiv ℝ F
  have hDF_c1 : ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) DF := hF_c2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)
  have hDF_diff : Differentiable ℝ DF := hDF_c1.differentiable (by decide)
  have hD2F_norm_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 F p‖) :=
    (hF_c2.continuous_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl).norm

  let K_box : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :=
    Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) (4 * Real.pi + 1) ×ˢ
      (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) (4 * Real.pi + 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
  have hK_compact : IsCompact K_box :=
    isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  have hK_convex : Convex ℝ K_box :=
    (convex_Icc _ _).prod ((convex_Icc _ _).prod (convex_Icc _ _))
  obtain ⟨C_2, hC2⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hD2F_norm_cont.continuousOn
  let M_2 : ℝ := max C_2 0
  have hM2_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_2 := le_max_right _ _
  have hM2_bound : ∀ p ∈ K_box, ‖fderiv ℝ DF p‖ ≤ M_2 := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ DF p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 DF p‖ :=
      (norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := DF) (x := p)).symm
    have h2 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 DF p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 F p‖ :=
      norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := F) (x := p) (n := 1)
    have hp_le := hC2 p hp
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at hp_le
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact le_trans hp_le (le_max_left _ _)

  have hQuadMVT : ∀ (p₀ u : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ),
      p₀ ∈ K_box → p₀ + u ∈ K_box →
      |F (p₀ + u) - F p₀ - DF p₀ u| ≤ M_2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro p₀ u hp₀ hp₀u
    let g_lin : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => F (p₀ + s • u) - F p₀ - s * (DF p₀ u)
    have hseg_mem : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, p₀ + s • u ∈ K_box := by
      intro s hs
      have hconv_eq : (1 - s) • p₀ + s • (p₀ + u) = p₀ + s • u := by
        ext <;> simp <;> ring
      rw [← hconv_eq]
      exact hK_convex hp₀ hp₀u (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2) hs.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 s)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt g_lin (DF (p₀ + s • u) u - DF p₀ u) s := by
      intro s _
      have hline : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => p₀ + s' • u) u s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const u).const_add p₀
      have hcomp := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hF_diff (p₀ + s • u)).hasFDerivAt hline
      have hsub2 : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => s' * (DF p₀ u)) (DF p₀ u) s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const (DF p₀ u)
      convert (hcomp.sub_const (F p₀)).sub hsub2 using 1
      ext s'
      simp [g_lin]
    have hg'_bound : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖DF (p₀ + s • u) u - DF p₀ u‖ ≤ M_2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro s hs
      have hDF_lip : ‖DF (p₀ + s • u) - DF p₀‖ ≤ M_2 * ‖(p₀ + s • u) - p₀‖ :=
        hK_convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
          (fun q _ => hDF_diff q) hM2_bound hp₀ (hseg_mem s hs)
      have hnorm_su : ‖(p₀ + s • u) - p₀‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg u) hs.2
      calc ‖DF (p₀ + s • u) u - DF p₀ u‖
          = ‖(DF (p₀ + s • u) - DF p₀) u‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖DF (p₀ + s • u) - DF p₀‖ * ‖u‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ ≤ (M_2 * ‖u‖) * ‖u‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (le_trans hDF_lip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm_su hM2_nonneg)) (norm_nonneg u)
        _ = M_2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    have hmvt := (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (f := g_lin) (C := M_2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2)
      (fun s hs => (hg_deriv s hs).differentiableAt)
      (fun s hs => by rw [(hg_deriv s hs).deriv]; exact hg'_bound s hs)
      ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩ ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    have hg0 : g_lin 0 = 0 := by simp [g_lin]
    have hg1 : g_lin 1 = F (p₀ + u) - F p₀ - DF p₀ u := by simp [g_lin]
    rw [hg1, hg0, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
    simpa using hmvt

  
  have hDF_eval : ∀ (X₀ Y₀ u₁ u₂ u₃ : ℝ), X₀ < Y₀ →
      DF (X₀, (Y₀, 0)) (u₁, (u₂, u₃)) =
        normAction1_ℝ w X₀ Y₀ * u₁ - normAction1_ℝ w Y₀ X₀ * u₂ +
          cellFrozenVar X₀ Y₀ * u₃ := by
    intro X₀ Y₀ u₁ u₂ u₃ hXY
    let p₀ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ := (X₀, (Y₀, 0))
    have he₁ : DF p₀ (1, (0, 0)) = normAction1_ℝ w X₀ Y₀ := by
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun X' : ℝ => (X', (Y₀, (0 : ℝ)))) (1, (0, 0)) X₀ :=
        (hasDerivAt_id X₀).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const X₀ (Y₀, (0 : ℝ)))
      have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt X₀ (hF_diff p₀).hasFDerivAt hγ
      have hfun : F ∘ (fun X' : ℝ => (X', (Y₀, (0 : ℝ)))) =
          (fun X' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X' Y₀) := by
        ext X'; simp [F]
      rw [hfun] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hActDerivXY X₀ Y₀).1
    have he₂ : DF p₀ (0, (1, 0)) = -normAction1_ℝ w Y₀ X₀ := by
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℝ => (X₀, (Y', (0 : ℝ)))) (0, (1, 0)) Y₀ :=
        (hasDerivAt_const Y₀ X₀).prodMk ((hasDerivAt_id Y₀).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const Y₀ (0 : ℝ)))
      have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt Y₀ (hF_diff p₀).hasFDerivAt hγ
      have hfun : F ∘ (fun Y' : ℝ => (X₀, (Y', (0 : ℝ)))) =
          (fun Y' : ℝ => normAction_ℝ w X₀ Y') := by
        ext Y'; simp [F]
      rw [hfun] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hActDerivXY X₀ Y₀).2
    have he₃ : DF p₀ (0, (0, 1)) = cellFrozenVar X₀ Y₀ := by
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (X₀, (Y₀, τ))) (0, (0, 1)) 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) X₀).prodMk
          ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) Y₀).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)))
      have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (hF_diff p₀).hasFDerivAt hγ
      have hfun : F ∘ (fun τ : ℝ => (X₀, (Y₀, τ))) =
          (fun τ : ℝ => normAction_ℝ (fun z => w z + τ * v z) X₀ Y₀) := by
        ext τ; rfl
      rw [hfun] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hVar1D X₀ Y₀ hXY).2.2
    have hdecomp : (u₁, (u₂, u₃)) =
        u₁ • ((1 : ℝ), ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) +
        u₂ • ((0 : ℝ), ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) +
        u₃ • ((0 : ℝ), ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [hdecomp, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, he₁, he₂, he₃]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

  
  let C_tot : ℝ := (q : ℝ) * M_2 * (max L_lip 1) ^ 2
  have hCtot_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_tot :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq_pos.le hM2_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hCrit_rem : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ δ_v → ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      |critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x - t * critActionFrozenVar x| ≤
        C_tot * t ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht x hx
    let X₀ : ℕ → ℝ := realMesh q w x
    let X_t : ℕ → ℝ := realMesh q (w_pert t) x
    let ΔX : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => X_t i - X₀ i
    have hΔ0 : ΔX 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [ΔX, X_t, X₀, (hStat_pert t ht x).1.1, (hStat_zero x).1.1, sub_self]
    have hΔq : ΔX q = 0 := by
      simp only [ΔX, X_t, X₀, (hStat_pert t ht x).1.2.1, (hStat_zero x).1.2.1, sub_self]
    have hTele :
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          (normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) * ΔX j -
            normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (j + 1)) (X₀ j) * ΔX (j + 1))) = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : q ≠ 0)
      rw [hr, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hΔr : ΔX (r + 1) = 0 := by
        change ΔX r.succ = 0
        rw [← hr]
        exact hΔq
      rw [hΔ0, hΔr, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k hk
      have hk_lt : k + 1 < q := by rw [hr]; exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have hstat_k := (hStat_zero x).2 k hk_lt
      calc normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (k + 1)) (X₀ (k + 1 + 1)) * ΔX (k + 1) -
            normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (k + 1)) (X₀ k) * ΔX (k + 1)
          = (normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (k + 1)) (X₀ (k + 2)) -
              normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (k + 1)) (X₀ k)) * ΔX (k + 1) := by ring
        _ = 0 * ΔX (k + 1) := by rw [hstat_k]
        _ = 0 := zero_mul _
    have hSumRem_eq :
        critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x - t * critActionFrozenVar x =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          (F ((X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))) -
            F (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) -
            DF (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))) := by
      have hcell_id : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          F ((X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))) -
            F (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) -
            DF (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t)) =
          normAction_ℝ (w_pert t) (X_t j) (X_t (j + 1)) -
            normAction_ℝ w (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) -
            t * cellFrozenVar (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) -
            (normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) * ΔX j -
              normAction1_ℝ w (X₀ (j + 1)) (X₀ j) * ΔX (j + 1)) := by
        intro j hj
        have hj_lt : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        rw [hDF_eval (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) (ΔX j) (ΔX (j + 1)) t (hCellOrder_zero x j hj_lt)]
        have hp_sum : (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), (0 : ℝ))) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t)) =
            (X_t j, (X_t (j + 1), t)) := by
          ext <;> simp [ΔX]
        have hf0 : F (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) = normAction_ℝ w (X₀ j) (X₀ (j + 1)) := by
          simp [F]
        have hft : F (X_t j, (X_t (j + 1), t)) = normAction_ℝ (w_pert t) (X_t j) (X_t (j + 1)) :=
          rfl
        rw [hp_sum, hf0, hft]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcell_id, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hTele, sub_zero,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      rfl
    rw [hSumRem_eq]
    calc |∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            (F ((X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))) -
              F (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) -
              DF (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t)))|
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            |F ((X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))) -
              F (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) -
              DF (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), 0)) (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, M_2 * (max L_lip 1) ^ 2 * t ^ 2 := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j hj
          have hj_lt : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
          have hp₀_mem : (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), (0 : ℝ))) ∈ K_box := by
            have h0_le : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ δ_v := by simp [hδ_pos.le]
            have hx0_j : X₀ j ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) (4 * Real.pi + 1) := by
              simpa only [X₀, hw_pert_zero] using hBox_pert 0 h0_le x hx j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt)
            have hx0_j1 : X₀ (j + 1) ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) (4 * Real.pi + 1) := by
              simpa only [X₀, hw_pert_zero] using hBox_pert 0 h0_le x hx (j + 1) hj_lt
            exact ⟨hx0_j, hx0_j1, by norm_num⟩
          have hp_sum : (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), (0 : ℝ))) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t)) =
              (X_t j, (X_t (j + 1), t)) := by
            ext <;> simp [ΔX]
          have hpu_mem : (X₀ j, (X₀ (j + 1), (0 : ℝ))) + (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t)) ∈ K_box := by
            rw [hp_sum]
            have ht_le_one : |t| ≤ 1 := le_trans ht hδ_le_one
            exact ⟨hBox_pert t ht x hx j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt),
              hBox_pert t ht x hx (j + 1) hj_lt, abs_le.mp ht_le_one⟩
          have hq_mvt := hQuadMVT _ _ hp₀_mem hpu_mem
          have hu_norm : ‖(ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))‖ ≤ max L_lip 1 * |t| := by
            simp only [Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            have h1 : |ΔX j| ≤ max L_lip 1 * |t| :=
              le_trans (hMesh_lip t ht j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt) x)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (abs_nonneg t))
            have h2 : |ΔX (j + 1)| ≤ max L_lip 1 * |t| :=
              le_trans (hMesh_lip t ht (j + 1) hj_lt x)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (abs_nonneg t))
            have h3 : |t| ≤ max L_lip 1 * |t| := by
              simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right L_lip 1) (abs_nonneg t)
            exact max_le h1 (max_le h2 h3)
          have hu_sq : ‖(ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (max L_lip 1) ^ 2 * t ^ 2 := by
            have hsq := sq_le_sq' (by
              have : 0 ≤ max L_lip 1 * |t| :=
                mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_right _ _)) (abs_nonneg t)
              linarith [norm_nonneg (ΔX j, (ΔX (j + 1), t))]) hu_norm
            simpa [mul_pow, sq_abs] using hsq
          exact le_trans hq_mvt
            (by simpa [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu_sq hM2_nonneg)
      _ = C_tot * t ^ 2 := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, C_tot]
          ring

  
  have hCrit_cont : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ δ_v → Continuous (critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t)) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hDisp_t, _⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q (w_pert t) hq_mesh (hw_pert_adm t ht)
    have hMesh_t_cont : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ q → Continuous (fun x : ℝ => realMesh q (w_pert t) x i) := by
      intro i hi
      have heq_t : (fun x : ℝ => realMesh q (w_pert t) x i) =
          (fun x : ℝ => realMeshDisp q (w_pert t) i x + (x + 2 * Real.pi * (i : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) := by
        ext x; simp only [realMeshDisp]; ring
      rw [heq_t]
      exact (hDisp_t i hi).2.1.continuous.add (continuous_id.add continuous_const)
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun j hj => by
      have hj_lt : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      have hF_cont : Continuous F := hF_c2.continuous
      have hX_t := hMesh_t_cont j (Nat.le_of_lt hj_lt)
      have hY_t := hMesh_t_cont (j + 1) hj_lt
      change Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        F (realMesh q (w_pert t) x j, (realMesh q (w_pert t) x (j + 1), t)))
      fun_prop

  
  let C_final : ℝ := ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * C_tot
  have hGlobal_rem : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ δ_v →
      ‖globalC_coeff n (w_pert t) - globalC_coeff n w - (t : ℂ) * frozenActionFourier‖ ≤
        C_final * t ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have hMesh_t_abs : HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs (w_pert t) :=
      (S.real_mesh_props q (w_pert t) hq_mesh (hw_pert_adm t ht)).1
    have hCt_eq : globalC_coeff n (w_pert t) =
        -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
                (critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x : ℂ)) := by
      simp only [globalC_coeff, hn_ne, hMesh_t_abs, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
    have hC0_eq : globalC_coeff n w =
        -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ q w x : ℂ)) := by
      simp only [globalC_coeff, hn_ne, hMesh_abs, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
    have hint_t : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
          (critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hct := hCrit_cont t ht
      exact (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hint_0 : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ q w x : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have h0_le : |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ δ_v := by simp [hδ_pos.le]
      have hcont0 : Continuous (critAction_ℝ q w) := by
        simpa only [hw_pert_zero] using hCrit_cont 0 h0_le
      exact (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hint_f : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
          (critActionFrozenVar x : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous _).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hcomb_int :
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x : ℂ)) -
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ q w x : ℂ)) -
          (t : ℂ) *
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critActionFrozenVar x : ℂ)) =
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
            ((critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x -
              t * critActionFrozenVar x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint_t hint_0,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hint_t.sub hint_0) (hint_f.const_mul (t : ℂ))]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      dsimp only
      push_cast; ring
    have hdiff_factor :
        globalC_coeff n (w_pert t) - globalC_coeff n w - (t : ℂ) * frozenActionFourier =
        (-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) *
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
              ((critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x -
                t * critActionFrozenVar x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hCt_eq, hC0_eq, ← hcomb_int]
      simp only [frozenActionFourier]
      ring
    rw [hdiff_factor, norm_mul]
    have hint_norm :
        ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
              ((critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x -
                t * critActionFrozenVar x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          (C_tot * t ^ 2) * |2 * Real.pi - 0| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro x hx_ioc
      have hx_icc : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) :=
        Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self (by simpa [Real.two_pi_pos.le] using hx_ioc)
      have hexp_norm : ‖Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ))‖ = 1 := by
        have harg : -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = ((-(n : ℝ) * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [harg]
        exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _
      rw [norm_mul, hexp_norm, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hCrit_rem t ht x hx_icc
    have hpref_norm :
        ‖-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹‖ =
          ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (by positivity)),
        Real.norm_of_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le]
    rw [hpref_norm]
    calc ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) *
                ((critAction_ℝ q (w_pert t) x - critAction_ℝ q w x -
                  t * critActionFrozenVar x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖
        ≤ ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((C_tot * t ^ 2) * |2 * Real.pi - 0|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint_norm (by positivity)
      _ = C_final * t ^ 2 := by
          rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos]
          simp only [C_final]
          field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']

  
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  have hball : {t : ℝ | |t| < δ_v} ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) := by
    simpa [Metric.ball, Real.dist_eq] using Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) hδ_pos
  have hlin_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => C_final * |t|) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => C_final * |t|) := continuous_const.mul continuous_abs
    simpa using hc.tendsto 0
  have heps_nhds : {t : ℝ | C_final * |t| < ε} ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    hlin_tendsto (Iio_mem_nhds hε)
  rw [Filter.Eventually, mem_nhdsWithin_iff_exists_mem_nhds_inter]
  refine ⟨{t : ℝ | |t| < δ_v} ∩ {t : ℝ | C_final * |t| < ε},
    Filter.inter_mem hball heps_nhds, ?_⟩
  rintro t ⟨⟨ht_δ, ht_ε⟩, ht_ne⟩
  replace ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp ht_ne
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf, dist_eq_norm] at ht_δ ht_ε ⊢
  have hslope_eq :
      t⁻¹ • (globalC_coeff n (w_pert (0 + t)) - globalC_coeff n (w_pert 0)) -
        frozenActionFourier =
      t⁻¹ • (globalC_coeff n (w_pert t) - globalC_coeff n w - (t : ℂ) * frozenActionFourier) := by
    rw [zero_add, hw_pert_zero, ← Complex.real_smul, smul_sub, smul_sub, smul_sub, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ ht_ne, one_smul]
  change ‖t⁻¹ • (globalC_coeff n (w_pert (0 + t)) - globalC_coeff n (w_pert 0)) -
    frozenActionFourier‖ < ε
  rw [hslope_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv]
  have ht_pos : 0 < |t| := abs_pos.mpr ht_ne
  calc |t|⁻¹ * ‖globalC_coeff n (w_pert t) - globalC_coeff n w - (t : ℂ) * frozenActionFourier‖
      ≤ |t|⁻¹ * (C_final * t ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hGlobal_rem t (le_of_lt ht_δ)) (inv_nonneg.mpr ht_pos.le)
    _ = C_final * |t| := by
        have hsq : t ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := (sq_abs t).symm
        rw [hsq]
        field_simp [ht_pos.ne']
    _ < ε := ht_ε

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : HalfCellInverseSystem m M S) (H_kern : ForwardKernelSystem m M S) :
    ∃ (K_real : ℝ) (N_real : ℕ),
      0 < K_real ∧ max H_inv.N_inv H_kern.N_kern ≤ N_real ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ), (N_real : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (globalB_mult n w) ∧
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w y - 1) x‖ ≤
              K_real / |(n : ℝ)|) ∧
        (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w₁ y - globalB_mult n w₂ y) x‖ ≤
              (K_real / |(n : ℝ)|) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hM
  
  
  
  have hCLM_iter : ∀ {E F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
      [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (T : E →L[ℝ] F) (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ → E),
      ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) h →
      ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => T (h y)) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → ∀ x : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun y => T (h y)) x = T (iteratedDeriv k h x) := by
    intro E F _ _ _ _ T n h hh
    refine ⟨T.contDiff.comp hh, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      have h_eq : iteratedDeriv k (fun y => T (h y)) = fun y => T (iteratedDeriv k h y) :=
        funext (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hk))
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, h_eq, iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv k h) :=
        hh.differentiable_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      exact (T.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x (hd x).hasDerivAt).deriv

  have hContDiff_deriv : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
      (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → E),
      ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f) := by
    intro E _ _ p f hf
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hf
    exact (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hf).2.2

  have hc1_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ c1_moab p B := by
    intro p B
    induction p with
    | zero => simp [c1_moab]
    | succ p ih =>
      simp only [c1_moab]
      have hB1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 B := le_max_left 1 B
      have h2p : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * max 1 B := by positivity
      nlinarith

  have hc2_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ c2_moab p B := by
    intro p B
    induction p with
    | zero => simp [c2_moab]
    | succ p ih =>
      simp only [c2_moab]
      have hc1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c1_moab p B := le_trans zero_le_one (hc1_ge_one p B)
      have hc2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c2_moab p B := le_trans zero_le_one ih
      have hB1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 B := le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left 1 B)
      have hprod : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (c1_moab p B + max 1 B * c2_moab p B) := by positivity
      linarith

  have hcCalc_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ cCalc_moab p B := by
    intro p B
    exact le_trans (hc1_ge_one p B) (le_max_left _ _)

  have hChoose_sum_le : ∀ {k p : ℕ}, k ≤ p →
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p := by
    intro k p hkp
    have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
    rw [hsum]
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hkp

  have hComp_single : ∀ {𝔸 : Type} [RCLike 𝔸] (p : ℕ) (B M_g : ℝ)
      (g : ℝ → ℝ → 𝔸) (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_g →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (g α) ∧
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (f α) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (g α) x‖ ≤ M_g) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (f α) z| ≤ B)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
        ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (g q.1) q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (f q.1) q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g α (f α y)) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g α (f α y)) z‖ ≤ c1_moab p B * M_g) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
        ContinuousOn
          (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g q.1 (f q.1 y)) q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) := by
    intro 𝔸 _ p B M_g
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      intro g f _ hPt hCont
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro α hα
        obtain ⟨hg_cd, hf_cd, hg_bnd, _⟩ := hPt α hα
        refine ⟨hg_cd.comp hf_cd, ?_⟩
        intro k hk z
        have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
        subst hk0
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, c1_moab, one_mul]
        exact hg_bnd 0 le_rfl (f α z)
      · intro k hk
        have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
        subst hk0
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        have hg0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g q.1 q.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hCont 0 le_rfl).1
        have hf0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f q.1 q.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hCont 0 le_rfl).2
        exact hg0.comp (continuous_fst.continuousOn.prodMk hf0) (fun q hq => ⟨hq.1, trivial⟩)
    | succ p ih =>
      intro g f hMg hPt hCont
      let g' : ℝ → ℝ → 𝔸 := fun α x => deriv (g α) x
      have hPt' : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (g' α) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (f α) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k (g' α) x‖ ≤ M_g) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (f α) z| ≤ B) := by
        intro α hα
        obtain ⟨hg_cd, hf_cd, hg_bnd, hf_bnd⟩ := hPt α hα
        refine ⟨hContDiff_deriv p (g α) hg_cd, hf_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p),
          ?_, fun k hk1 hkp z => hf_bnd k hk1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hkp) z⟩
        intro k hk x
        change ‖iteratedDeriv k (deriv (g α)) x‖ ≤ M_g
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
        exact hg_bnd (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk) x
      have hCont' : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
          ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (g' q.1) q.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
          ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (f q.1) q.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        intro k hk
        refine ⟨?_, (hCont k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)).2⟩
        have hEq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (g' q.1) q.2) =
            (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (g q.1) q.2) := by
          funext q
          exact congrFun (iteratedDeriv_succ' (n := k) (f := g q.1)).symm q.2
        rw [hEq]
        exact (hCont (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)).1
      obtain ⟨hIH_pt, hIH_cont⟩ := ih g' f hMg hPt' hCont'
      have hDerivFormula : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (k' : ℕ), k' ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv (k' + 1) (fun y : ℝ => g α (f α y)) z =
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
              (k'.choose i : 𝔸) *
                RCLike.ofRealCLM (iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (f α) z) *
                iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z := by
        intro α hα k' hk' z
        obtain ⟨hg_cd, hf_cd, _, _⟩ := hPt α hα
        have hDerivEq : deriv (fun y : ℝ => g α (f α y)) =
            fun y : ℝ => RCLike.ofRealCLM (deriv (f α) y) * g' α (f α y) := by
          funext y
          have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (g α) (f α y) := (hg_cd.differentiable (by simp)) (f α y)
          have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (f α) y := (hf_cd.differentiable (by simp)) y
          have hs := (hgd.hasDerivAt.scomp y hfd.hasDerivAt).deriv
          change deriv ((g α) ∘ (f α)) y = _
          rw [hs]
          simp [g', RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul]
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDerivEq]
        have hdf_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv (f α)) :=
          (hContDiff_deriv p (f α) hf_cd).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk')
        have hCLM := hCLM_iter (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) k' (deriv (f α)) hdf_cd
        have hv_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z :=
          ((hIH_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk')).contDiffAt
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hCLM.1.contDiffAt hv_cd]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
        have hi_le : i ≤ k' := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [hCLM.2 i hi_le z, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro α hα
        obtain ⟨hg_cd, hf_cd, hg_bnd, hf_bnd⟩ := hPt α hα
        refine ⟨hg_cd.comp hf_cd, ?_⟩
        intro k hk z
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
          calc ‖g α (f α z)‖ ≤ M_g := hg_bnd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (f α z)
            _ = 1 * M_g := (one_mul M_g).symm
            _ ≤ c1_moab (p + 1) B * M_g := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc1_ge_one (p + 1) B) hMg
        | succ k' =>
          have hk' : k' ≤ p := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
          rw [hDerivFormula α hα k' hk' z]
          have hB1_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 B := le_max_left 1 B
          have hB1_ge_B : B ≤ max 1 B := le_max_right 1 B
          have hc1_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c1_moab p B := le_trans zero_le_one (hc1_ge_one p B)
          calc
            ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
                (k'.choose i : 𝔸) *
                  RCLike.ofRealCLM (iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (f α) z) *
                  iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
                  (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (max 1 B * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := by
                refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
                have hi_le : i ≤ k' := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
                have h_choose_norm : ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) := by simp
                let r_val : ℝ := iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (f α) z
                have h_f_norm : ‖(RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) r_val‖ ≤ max 1 B := by
                  change ‖(r_val : 𝔸)‖ ≤ max 1 B
                  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal]
                  exact le_trans (hf_bnd (i + 1) (Nat.succ_pos i)
                    (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hi_le hk')) z) hB1_ge_B
                have h_g_norm : ‖iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖ ≤
                    c1_moab p B * M_g :=
                  (hIH_pt α hα).2 (k' - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k' i) hk') z
                calc
                  ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * RCLike.ofRealCLM r_val *
                      iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖
                    ≤ ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * RCLike.ofRealCLM r_val‖ *
                        ‖iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
                  _ ≤ (‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ * ‖(RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) r_val‖) *
                        ‖iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖ :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
                  _ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (‖(RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) r_val‖ *
                        ‖iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' α (f α y)) z‖) := by
                      rw [h_choose_norm, mul_assoc]
                  _ ≤ (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (max 1 B * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := by
                      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                      exact mul_le_mul h_f_norm h_g_norm (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), (k'.choose i : ℝ)) *
                  (max 1 B * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (max 1 B * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hChoose_sum_le hk') (by positivity)
            _ ≤ c1_moab (p + 1) B * M_g := by simp only [c1_moab]; nlinarith
      · intro k hk
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
          have hg0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g q.1 q.2)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
            simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hCont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1
          have hf0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f q.1 q.2)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
            simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (hCont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).2
          exact hg0.comp (continuous_fst.continuousOn.prodMk hf0) (fun q hq => ⟨hq.1, trivial⟩)
        | succ k' =>
          have hk' : k' ≤ p := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
          have hSumCont : ContinuousOn
              (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
                  (k'.choose i : 𝔸) *
                    RCLike.ofRealCLM (iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (f q.1) q.2) *
                    iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' q.1 (f q.1 y)) q.2)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
            refine continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun i hi => ?_
            have hi_le : i ≤ k' := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
            have hf_i : ContinuousOn
                (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => RCLike.ofRealCLM (iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (f q.1) q.2))
                (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
              (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸).continuous.comp_continuousOn
                ((hCont (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hi_le hk'))).2)
            have hg_i : ContinuousOn
                (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g' q.1 (f q.1 y)) q.2)
                (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
              hIH_cont (k' - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k' i) hk')
            exact (continuousOn_const.mul hf_i).mul hg_i
          exact hSumCont.congr fun q hq => hDerivFormula q.1 hq.1 k' hk' q.2

  have hComp_same_diff : ∀ {𝔸 : Type} [RCLike 𝔸] (p : ℕ) (B M_g L_f : ℝ)
      (g₂ : ℝ → 𝔸) (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ L_f →
      ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₁ →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₂ →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p + 1 → ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k g₂ x‖ ≤ M_g) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k f₁ z| ≤ B ∧ |iteratedDeriv k f₂ z| ≤ B) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => f₁ y - f₂ y) z| ≤ L_f) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z‖ ≤
          c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f := by
    intro 𝔸 _ p B M_g L_f
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      intro g₂ f₁ f₂ hMg _ hg₂ _ _ hg₂_bnd _ hf_diff k hk z
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
      subst hk0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, c2_moab, one_mul]
      have hg₂_diff : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g₂ x :=
        fun x _ => (hg₂.differentiable (by simp)) x
      have hg₂_deriv : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), ‖deriv g₂ x‖ ≤ M_g := by
        intro x _; simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hg₂_bnd 1 (by omega) x
      have hMVT := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hg₂_diff hg₂_deriv convex_univ
        (Set.mem_univ (f₂ z)) (Set.mem_univ (f₁ z))
      have hdf0 : ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ ≤ L_f := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hf_diff 0 le_rfl z
      exact le_trans hMVT (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdf0 hMg)
    | succ p ih =>
      intro g₂ f₁ f₂ hMg hLf hg₂ hf₁ hf₂ hg₂_bnd hf_bnd hf_diff k hk z
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        have hg₂_diff : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g₂ x :=
          fun x _ => (hg₂.differentiable (by simp)) x
        have hg₂_deriv : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), ‖deriv g₂ x‖ ≤ M_g := by
          intro x _; simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hg₂_bnd 1 (by omega) x
        have hMVT := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hg₂_diff hg₂_deriv convex_univ
          (Set.mem_univ (f₂ z)) (Set.mem_univ (f₁ z))
        have hdf0 : ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ ≤ L_f := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hf_diff 0 (Nat.zero_le _) z
        calc ‖g₂ (f₁ z) - g₂ (f₂ z)‖ ≤ M_g * L_f :=
              le_trans hMVT (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdf0 hMg)
          _ = 1 * M_g * L_f := by ring
          _ ≤ c2_moab (p + 1) B * M_g * L_f :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc2_ge_one (p + 1) B) hMg) hLf
      | succ k' =>
        have hk' : k' ≤ p := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
        let g₂' : ℝ → 𝔸 := deriv g₂
        have hg₂'_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂' := hContDiff_deriv (p + 1) g₂ hg₂
        have hg₂'_bnd : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ x : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j g₂' x‖ ≤ M_g := by
          intro j hj x
          change ‖iteratedDeriv j (deriv g₂) x‖ ≤ M_g
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          exact hg₂_bnd (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) x
        have hf₁_p : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₁ := hf₁.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p)
        have hf₂_p : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₂ := hf₂.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p)
        have hg₂'_f₁ : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y)) ∧
            ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ y : ℝ,
              ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun u : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ u)) y‖ ≤ c1_moab p B * M_g := by
          have hg₂'_p : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂' :=
            hg₂'_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p)
          have hS := hComp_single (𝔸 := 𝔸) p B M_g (fun _ => g₂') (fun _ => f₁) hMg
            (fun _ _ => ⟨hg₂'_p, hf₁_p,
              fun j hj x => hg₂'_bnd j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj) x,
              fun j hj1 hjp y => (hf_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjp) y).1⟩)
            (fun j hj => ⟨
              (hg₂'_p.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj)).comp_continuousOn
                continuous_snd.continuousOn,
              (hf₁_p.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj)).comp_continuousOn
                continuous_snd.continuousOn⟩)
          exact hS.1 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
        have hDerivDiff : deriv (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) =
            fun y : ℝ =>
              RCLike.ofRealCLM (deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) y) * g₂' (f₁ y) +
              RCLike.ofRealCLM (deriv f₂ y) * (g₂' (f₁ y) - g₂' (f₂ y)) := by
          funext y
          have hg_d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₂ (f₁ y) := (hg₂.differentiable (by simp)) (f₁ y)
          have hg_d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₂ (f₂ y) := (hg₂.differentiable (by simp)) (f₂ y)
          have hf_d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f₁ y := (hf₁.differentiable (by simp)) y
          have hf_d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f₂ y := (hf₂.differentiable (by simp)) y
          have h1 : deriv (fun u : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ u) - g₂ (f₂ u)) y =
              deriv f₁ y • deriv g₂ (f₁ y) - deriv f₂ y • deriv g₂ (f₂ y) :=
            ((hg_d1.hasDerivAt.scomp y hf_d1.hasDerivAt).sub
              (hg_d2.hasDerivAt.scomp y hf_d2.hasDerivAt)).deriv
          have h2 : deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) y = deriv f₁ y - deriv f₂ y :=
            (hf_d1.hasDerivAt.sub hf_d2.hasDerivAt).deriv
          rw [h1, h2]
          simp only [g₂', RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_mul, RCLike.ofRealCLM_apply, map_sub]
          ring
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDerivDiff]
        have hdf_sub_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u)) :=
          (hContDiff_deriv p (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) (hf₁.sub hf₂)).of_le
            (by exact_mod_cast hk')
        have hdf₂_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv f₂) :=
          (hContDiff_deriv p f₂ hf₂).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk')
        have hCLM1 := hCLM_iter (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) k'
          (deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u)) hdf_sub_cd
        have hCLM2 := hCLM_iter (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) k' (deriv f₂) hdf₂_cd
        have hv1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y)) :=
          hg₂'_f₁.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk')
        have hv2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k' : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y) - g₂' (f₂ y)) :=
          ((hg₂'_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk')).comp
            (hf₁_p.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk'))).sub
          ((hg₂'_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk')).comp
            (hf₂_p.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk')))
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hCLM1.1.mul hv1_cd).contDiffAt (hCLM2.1.mul hv2_cd).contDiffAt,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hCLM1.1.contDiffAt hv1_cd.contDiffAt,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hCLM2.1.contDiffAt hv2_cd.contDiffAt]
        have hB1_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 B := le_max_left 1 B
        have hB1_ge_B : B ≤ max 1 B := le_max_right 1 B
        have hc1_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c1_moab p B := le_trans zero_le_one (hc1_ge_one p B)
        have hc2_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ c2_moab p B := le_trans zero_le_one (hc2_ge_one p B)
        have hSum1 : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
            (k'.choose i : 𝔸) *
              iteratedDeriv i (fun y : ℝ => RCLike.ofRealCLM (deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) y)) z *
              iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y)) z‖ ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := by
          calc
            ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _‖
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
                  (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := by
                refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
                have hi_le : i ≤ k' := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
                have h_choose : ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) := by simp
                let u_i : 𝔸 :=
                  iteratedDeriv i
                    (fun y : ℝ => (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸)
                      (deriv (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) y)) z
                let v_i : 𝔸 := iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y)) z
                have h_u : ‖u_i‖ ≤ L_f := by
                  dsimp only [u_i]
                  rw [hCLM1.2 i hi_le z, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                  let r_sub : ℝ := iteratedDeriv (i + 1) (fun u : ℝ => f₁ u - f₂ u) z
                  change ‖(r_sub : 𝔸)‖ ≤ L_f
                  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal]
                  exact hf_diff (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hi_le hk')) z
                have h_v : ‖v_i‖ ≤ c1_moab p B * M_g :=
                  hg₂'_f₁.2 (k' - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k' i) hk') z
                calc
                  ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * u_i * v_i‖
                    ≤ ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * u_i‖ * ‖v_i‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
                  _ ≤ (‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ * ‖u_i‖) * ‖v_i‖ :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
                  _ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (‖u_i‖ * ‖v_i‖) := by rw [h_choose, mul_assoc]
                  _ ≤ (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                        (mul_le_mul h_u h_v (norm_nonneg _) hLf) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
            _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), (k'.choose i : ℝ)) *
                  (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hChoose_sum_le hk') (by positivity)
        have hSum2 : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
            (k'.choose i : 𝔸) *
              iteratedDeriv i (fun y : ℝ => RCLike.ofRealCLM (deriv f₂ y)) z *
              iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y) - g₂' (f₂ y)) z‖ ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) := by
          calc
            ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _‖
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1),
                  (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) := by
                refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
                have hi_le : i ≤ k' := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
                have h_choose : ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) := by simp
                let u_i : 𝔸 :=
                  iteratedDeriv i (fun y : ℝ => (RCLike.ofRealCLM : ℝ →L[ℝ] 𝔸) (deriv f₂ y)) z
                let v_i : 𝔸 := iteratedDeriv (k' - i) (fun y : ℝ => g₂' (f₁ y) - g₂' (f₂ y)) z
                have h_u : ‖u_i‖ ≤ max 1 B := by
                  dsimp only [u_i]
                  rw [hCLM2.2 i hi_le z, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                  let r_f2 : ℝ := iteratedDeriv (i + 1) f₂ z
                  change ‖(r_f2 : 𝔸)‖ ≤ max 1 B
                  rw [RCLike.norm_ofReal]
                  exact le_trans
                    (hf_bnd (i + 1) (Nat.succ_pos i) (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hi_le hk')) z).2
                    hB1_ge_B
                have h_v : ‖v_i‖ ≤ c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f :=
                  ih g₂' f₁ f₂ hMg hLf hg₂'_cd hf₁_p hf₂_p hg₂'_bnd
                    (fun j hj1 hjp y => hf_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjp) y)
                    (fun j hjp y => hf_diff j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjp) y)
                    (k' - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k' i) hk') z
                calc
                  ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * u_i * v_i‖
                    ≤ ‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸) * u_i‖ * ‖v_i‖ := norm_mul_le _ _
                  _ ≤ (‖(k'.choose i : 𝔸)‖ * ‖u_i‖) * ‖v_i‖ :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
                  _ = (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (‖u_i‖ * ‖v_i‖) := by rw [h_choose, mul_assoc]
                  _ ≤ (k'.choose i : ℝ) * (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) :=
                      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                        (mul_le_mul h_u h_v (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
            _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), (k'.choose i : ℝ)) *
                  (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hChoose_sum_le hk') (by positivity)
        calc
          ‖(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _)‖
            ≤ ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _‖ + ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k' + 1), _‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (L_f * (c1_moab p B * M_g)) +
                (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (max 1 B * (c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f)) := add_le_add hSum1 hSum2
          _ ≤ c2_moab (p + 1) B * M_g * L_f := by simp only [c2_moab]; nlinarith

  
  have hComp_diff_ℝ : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B M_g L_g L_f : ℝ) (g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ L_g → 0 ≤ L_f →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
      ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₁ →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f₂ →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p + 1 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k g₂ x| ≤ M_g) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ y - g₂ y) x| ≤ L_g) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k f₁ z| ≤ B ∧ |iteratedDeriv k f₂ z| ≤ B) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => f₁ y - f₂ y) z| ≤ L_f) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z| ≤
          cCalc_moab p B * (L_g + M_g * L_f) := by
    intro p B M_g L_g L_f g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ hMg hLg hLf hg₁ hg₂ hf₁ hf₂ hg₂_bnd hg_diff hf_bnd hf_diff k hk z
    have hg₂_p : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ := hg₂.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ p)
    have hSub_cd : ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun x : ℝ => g₁ x - g₂ x) := hg₁.sub hg₂_p
    have hPart1 := (hComp_single (𝔸 := ℝ) p B L_g (fun _ x => g₁ x - g₂ x) (fun _ => f₁) hLg
      (fun _ _ => ⟨hSub_cd, hf₁,
        fun j hj x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hg_diff j hj x,
        fun j hj1 hjp y => (hf_bnd j hj1 hjp y).1⟩)
      (fun j hj => ⟨
        (hSub_cd.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj)).comp_continuousOn
          continuous_snd.continuousOn,
        (hf₁.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by exact_mod_cast hj)).comp_continuousOn
          continuous_snd.continuousOn⟩)).1 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    have hPart2 := hComp_same_diff (𝔸 := ℝ) p B M_g L_f g₂ f₁ f₂ hMg hLf hg₂ hf₁ hf₂
      (fun j hj x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hg₂_bnd j hj x) hf_bnd hf_diff k hk z
    have hSplit : (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) =
        fun y : ℝ => (g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₁ y)) + (g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) := by
      funext y; ring
    have hc1_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₁ y)) z :=
      (hPart1.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
    have hc2_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z :=
      (((hg₂_p.comp hf₁).sub (hg₂_p.comp hf₂)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
    rw [hSplit, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hc1_cd hc2_cd]
    have hb1 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₁ y)) z| ≤ c1_moab p B * L_g := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hPart1.2 k hk z
    have hb2 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z| ≤
        c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hPart2
    have hc1_le : c1_moab p B ≤ cCalc_moab p B := le_max_left _ _
    have hc2_le : c2_moab p B ≤ cCalc_moab p B := le_max_right _ _
    calc |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₁ y)) z +
            iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z|
        ≤ |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₁ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₁ y)) z| +
            |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => g₂ (f₁ y) - g₂ (f₂ y)) z| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ c1_moab p B * L_g + c2_moab p B * M_g * L_f := add_le_add hb1 hb2
      _ ≤ cCalc_moab p B * L_g + cCalc_moab p B * (M_g * L_f) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1_le hLg)
            (by rw [mul_assoc]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2_le (mul_nonneg hMg hLf))
      _ = cCalc_moab p B * (L_g + M_g * L_f) := by ring

  
  let g_osc : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ))
  have hg_osc_cd : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : WithTop ℕ∞) g_osc :=
    (contDiff_const.mul Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff).cexp
  have hg_osc_iter : ∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), iteratedDeriv j g_osc t = Complex.I ^ j * g_osc t := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro t; simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro t
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, funext ih]
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Complex.I * (s : ℂ)) Complex.I t := by
        simpa [mul_one] using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)).const_mul Complex.I
      have hmul : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Complex.I ^ j * g_osc s)
          (Complex.I ^ j * (g_osc t * Complex.I)) t := hd.cexp.const_mul (Complex.I ^ j)
      rw [hmul.deriv, pow_succ]
      ring
  have hg_osc_norm : ∀ (j : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖iteratedDeriv j g_osc t‖ = 1 := by
    intro j t
    rw [hg_osc_iter j t, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_I, one_pow, one_mul]
    simp [g_osc]

  
  have hIter_zero : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ), iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) z = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro z; rfl
    | succ k ih => intro z; rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, funext ih, deriv_const]

  have hIter_zero_ℝ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℝ), iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) z = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro z; rfl
    | succ k ih => intro z; rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, funext ih, deriv_const]

  have hJet_const : ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : ℂ), HasCJetℂ_moab p ‖c‖ (fun _ => c) := by
    intro p c
    refine ⟨contDiff_const, norm_nonneg c, ?_⟩
    intro k _ z
    cases k with
    | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ k' =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ',
        show deriv (fun _ : ℝ => c) = fun _ => 0 from funext fun x => deriv_const x c,
        hIter_zero k' z, norm_zero]
      exact norm_nonneg c

  have hJet_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℂ},
      B₁ ≤ B₂ → HasCJetℂ_moab p B₁ F → HasCJetℂ_moab p B₂ F := by
    intro p B₁ B₂ F hle ⟨hcd, hB1, hbnd⟩
    exact ⟨hcd, le_trans hB1 hle, fun k hk z => le_trans (hbnd k hk z) hle⟩

  have hJet_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {F G : ℝ → ℂ},
      HasCJetℂ_moab p B₁ F → HasCJetℂ_moab p B₂ G →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p (B₁ + B₂) (fun y => F y + G y) := by
    intro p B₁ B₂ F G ⟨hF, hB1, hbF⟩ ⟨hG, hB2, hbG⟩
    refine ⟨hF.add hG, add_nonneg hB1 hB2, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      (hG.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt]
    exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hbF k hk z) (hbG k hk z))

  have hJet_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {F G : ℝ → ℂ},
      HasCJetℂ_moab p B₁ F → HasCJetℂ_moab p B₂ G →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p (B₁ + B₂) (fun y => F y - G y) := by
    intro p B₁ B₂ F G ⟨hF, hB1, hbF⟩ ⟨hG, hB2, hbG⟩
    refine ⟨hF.sub hG, add_nonneg hB1 hB2, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (hF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      (hG.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt]
    exact le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add (hbF k hk z) (hbG k hk z))

  have hJet_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℂ) {F : ℝ → ℂ},
      HasCJetℂ_moab p B F → HasCJetℂ_moab p (‖c‖ * B) (fun y => c * F y) := by
    intro p B c F ⟨hF, hB, hbF⟩
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hF, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) hB, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z
    have hcm : iteratedDeriv k (fun y => c * F y) z = c * iteratedDeriv k F z :=
      iteratedDeriv_const_mul c (hF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
    rw [hcm, norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbF k hk z) (norm_nonneg c)

  have hJet_ofReal : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) f → 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k f z| ≤ B) →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p B (fun y => (f y : ℂ)) := by
    intro p B f hf hB hbf
    have hCLM := hCLM_iter Complex.ofRealCLM p f hf
    refine ⟨hCLM.1, hB, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y => Complex.ofRealCLM (f y)) z‖ ≤ B
    rw [hCLM.2 k hk z]
    simpa [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply] using hbf k hk z

  have hJet_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {F G : ℝ → ℂ},
      HasCJetℂ_moab p B₁ F → HasCJetℂ_moab p B₂ G →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (B₁ * B₂)) (fun y => F y * G y) := by
    intro p B₁ B₂ F G ⟨hF, hB1, hbF⟩ ⟨hG, hB2, hbG⟩
    refine ⟨hF.mul hG, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hF.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
      (hG.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt]
    calc
      ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F z * iteratedDeriv (k - i) G z‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B₁ * B₂) := by
          refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_)
          have hi_le : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have hc : ‖(k.choose i : ℂ)‖ = (k.choose i : ℝ) := by simp
          calc
            ‖(k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F z * iteratedDeriv (k - i) G z‖
              ≤ (‖(k.choose i : ℂ)‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv i F z‖) * ‖iteratedDeriv (k - i) G z‖ := by
                exact le_trans (norm_mul_le _ _)
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
            _ = (k.choose i : ℝ) * (‖iteratedDeriv i F z‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv (k - i) G z‖) := by
                rw [hc, mul_assoc]
            _ ≤ (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B₁ * B₂) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (mul_le_mul (hbF i (le_trans hi_le hk) z)
                    (hbG (k - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk) z) (norm_nonneg _) hB1)
                  (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) * (B₁ * B₂) :=
          (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (B₁ * B₂) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hChoose_sum_le hk) (mul_nonneg hB1 hB2)

  have hJet_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {M_F M_G ΔF ΔG : ℝ} {F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ : ℝ → ℂ},
      HasCJetℂ_moab p M_F F₂ →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p M_G G₁ →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p ΔF (fun y => F₁ y - F₂ y) →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p ΔG (fun y => G₁ y - G₂ y) →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (ΔF * M_G + M_F * ΔG))
        (fun y => F₁ y * G₁ y - F₂ y * G₂ y) := by
    intro p M_F M_G ΔF ΔG F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ hF₂ hG₁ hΔF hΔG
    have hEq : (fun y => F₁ y * G₁ y - F₂ y * G₂ y) =
        fun y => (F₁ y - F₂ y) * G₁ y + F₂ y * (G₁ y - G₂ y) := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [hEq]
    have h1 := hJet_add (hJet_mul hΔF hG₁) (hJet_mul hF₂ hΔG)
    exact hJet_mono (by linarith) h1

  have hJet_finset_sum : ∀ (p : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (B : ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ B → (∀ j ∈ s, HasCJetℂ_moab p B (F j)) →
      HasCJetℂ_moab p ((s.card : ℝ) * B) (fun y => ∑ j ∈ s, F j y) := by
    intro p s B F hB
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      simpa using hJet_const p (0 : ℂ)
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      intro hFs
      have hHead : HasCJetℂ_moab p B (F a) := hFs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      have hTail : HasCJetℂ_moab p ((s.card : ℝ) * B) (fun y => ∑ j ∈ s, F j y) :=
        ih (fun j hj => hFs j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
      have hEq : (fun y => ∑ j ∈ insert a s, F j y) =
          fun y => F a y + ∑ j ∈ s, F j y := by
        funext y; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [hEq, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem ha]
      have hAdd := hJet_add hHead hTail
      exact hJet_mono (by push_cast; linarith) hAdd

  
  
  
  have hParamDeriv1 : ∀ (H : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) (H α)) →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H q.1 q.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (H q.1) q.2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      ∀ x₀ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, H α z)
        (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv (H α) x₀) x₀ := by
    intro H hSmooth hCont0 hCont1 x₀
    let s : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (x₀ - 1) (x₀ + 1)
    have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds x₀ := Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ s
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ :=
      Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl (Set.subset_univ s)
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hCont1.mono hK_sub)
    have huIcc : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
    have huIoc_sub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hSlice0 : ∀ x : ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => H α x) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro x
      exact hCont0.comp (continuous_id.continuousOn.prodMk continuousOn_const)
        (fun α hα => ⟨hα, trivial⟩)
    have hSlice1 : ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => deriv (H α) x₀) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hCont1.comp (continuous_id.continuousOn.prodMk continuousOn_const)
        (fun α hα => ⟨hα, trivial⟩)
    have hRes : IntervalIntegrable (fun α => deriv (H α) x₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, H α z)
          (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv (H α) x₀) x₀ :=
      intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (E := ℂ)
        (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (bound := fun _ => M₀)
        (F := fun z α => H α z) (F' := fun z α => deriv (H α) z)
        hs_nhds
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
          ((hSlice0 x).mono huIoc_sub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
        ((huIcc.symm ▸ hSlice0 x₀).intervalIntegrable)
        ((hSlice1.mono huIoc_sub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun α hα x hx =>
          hM₀ (α, x) ⟨huIoc_sub hα, hx⟩)
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun α hα x _ =>
          ((hSmooth α (huIoc_sub hα)).differentiable (by simp) x).hasDerivAt)
    exact hRes.2

  have hParamInt : ∀ (p : ℕ) (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (F α)) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
        ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
      ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F α z) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F α z) x =
          ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv k (F α) x := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ hCont
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiff_zero]
        let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun α => max 0 (min 1 α)
        have hclamp_cont : Continuous clamp :=
          continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
        have hclamp_mem : ∀ α : ℝ, clamp α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := fun α =>
          ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left _ _)⟩
        let F_tilde : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z α => F (clamp α) z
        have hF0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F q.1 q.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hCont 0 le_rfl
        have hUncurry : Continuous (Function.uncurry F_tilde) := by
          have hMap : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (clamp q.2, q.1)) :=
            (hclamp_cont.comp continuous_snd).prodMk continuous_fst
          exact hF0.comp_continuous hMap (fun q => ⟨hclamp_mem q.2, trivial⟩)
        have hIntCont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F_tilde z α) :=
          intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
            (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hUncurry 0 1
        have hEq : (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F_tilde z α) =
            (fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F α z) := by
          funext z
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun α hα => ?_
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hα
          have hcl : clamp α = α := by
            simp [clamp, min_eq_right hα.2, max_eq_right hα.1]
          simp [F_tilde, hcl]
        rwa [hEq] at hIntCont
      · intro k hk x
        have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk
        subst hk0
        simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ p ih =>
      intro F hSmooth hCont
      let G : ℝ → ℂ := fun z => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F α z
      let F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α z => deriv (F α) z
      have hSmooth1 : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) (F α) :=
        fun α hα => (hSmooth α hα).of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos p)
      have hCont0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F q.1 q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hCont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      have hCont1 : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => deriv (F q.1) q.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hCont 1 (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _))
      have hG_hasDeriv : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' α x₀) x₀ :=
        hParamDeriv1 F hSmooth1 hCont0 hCont1
      have hG_diff : Differentiable ℝ G := fun x₀ => (hG_hasDeriv x₀).differentiableAt
      have hG_deriv : deriv G = fun z : ℝ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' α z :=

      have hF'_smooth : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (F' α) :=
        fun α hα => hContDiff_deriv p (F α) (hSmooth α hα)

          ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv j (F' q.1) q.2)

  have hLeadEqOne : ∀ (n : ℤ), n ≠ 0 →

    have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero

    let f_m : ℝ → ℂ := fun α =>
      (k0Minus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * α : ℝ) : ℂ))

    have hf_p_int : IntervalIntegrable f_p MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by

    have hf_m_conj_int : IntervalIntegrable f_m_conj MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      refine Continuous.intervalIntegrable ?_ 0 1
      unfold f_m_conj k0Minus; fun_prop

      have hExp : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * (1 + (1 - β)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =

        have hexp_arg : Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * (1 + (1 - β)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =

      rw [sub_self 1, sub_zero 1] at hsub

      have hExpSum : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * α : ℝ) : ℂ)) +

          · rw [h1]; push_cast; congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring
          · rw [hm1, add_comm]; push_cast; congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ring

        push_cast [Complex.ofReal_cos]
        rw [Complex.two_cos]

        _ = ((Real.pi ^ 2 * ((3 * α ^ 2 - 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi * α)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              unfold k0Minus; push_cast; ring
    let P : ℝ → ℝ := fun α =>
      (3 * α ^ 2 - 1) / Real.pi * Real.sin (Real.pi * α) +
      (6 * α) / Real.pi ^ 2 * Real.cos (Real.pi * α) -
      6 / Real.pi ^ 3 * Real.sin (Real.pi * α)
    have hP_deriv : ∀ α : ℝ,

      convert h_tot using 1
      field_simp; ring
    have hRealInt : (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (3 * α ^ 2 - 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi * α)) =

      have hCont : Continuous (fun α : ℝ => (3 * α ^ 2 - 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi * α)) := by
        fun_prop

        (fun x _ => hP_deriv x) (hCont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
      simp only [P, mul_one, mul_zero, Real.sin_pi, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_zero, Real.cos_zero]
      ring
    have hCellInt : (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, leadCellIntegrand_moab n α) =
        (((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * (Real.pi ^ 2 * (-6 / Real.pi ^ 2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hUnfold : (fun α : ℝ => leadCellIntegrand_moab n α) =
          fun α : ℝ => ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (f_m α + f_p α) := rfl
      rw [hUnfold, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_m_int hf_p_int, hInt_p,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_m_int hf_m_conj_int]
      have hCongr : (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (f_m α + f_m_conj α)) =

            ((Real.pi ^ 2 * ((3 * α ^ 2 - 1) * Real.cos (Real.pi * α)) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun α _ => hSum_pt α
      rw [hCongr, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hRealInt]

    rw [hCellInt, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hCancel : -((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) *

    calc
      -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *

        = ((-((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) *
            ((q : ℝ) * ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * (Real.pi ^ 2 * (-6 / Real.pi ^ 2)))) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
