      (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
        α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C'_half / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)
          (fun y => halfTerm w₁ α y - halfTerm w₂ α y)) := by
    intro j hj k0 fwdK ψ xInv s_mid τ hs_mid hτ_cont hk0_bnd hxInv_eq hSingleProps hLipProps
      halfTerm leadHalf
    have hs_abs : |s_mid| = 1 := by
      rcases hs_mid with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

    have hxInv_props : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (xInv w α) ∧
          (deriv (xInv w α) = fun z => 1 + deriv (ψ w α) z) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → ∀ z : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (xInv w α) z| ≤ B_inv)) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (xInv w p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hψ_cont, hψ_pt, _, _⟩ := hSingleProps w hw
      have hDeriv_eq : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          deriv (xInv w α) = fun z : ℝ => 1 + deriv (ψ w α) z := by
        intro α hα
        funext z
        have hEqFn : xInv w α = fun y =>
            (y - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ)) + ψ w α y :=
          funext (hxInv_eq w α)
        rw [hEqFn]
        have hd_ψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (ψ w α) z :=
          ((hψ_pt α hα).1.differentiable (by simp)) z
        exact (((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const _).add hd_ψ.hasDerivAt).deriv
      have hq2_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hq_ge_one
      have hψ_le_Cinv : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 1 → ∀ z : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w α) z| ≤ H_inv.C_inv := by
        intro α hα k hk z
        exact le_trans ((hψ_pt α hα).2 k hk z)
          (div_le_self (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) hq2_ge)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro α hα
        have hEqFn : xInv w α = fun y =>
            (y - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ)) + ψ w α y :=
          funext (hxInv_eq w α)
        have hx_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (xInv w α) := by
          rw [hEqFn]
          exact (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).add
            ((hψ_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m))
        refine ⟨hx_cd, hDeriv_eq α hα, ?_⟩
        intro k hk1 hkm z
        cases k with
        | zero => omega
        | succ k1 =>
          cases k1 with
          | zero =>
            rw [iteratedDeriv_one, hDeriv_eq α hα]
            have h1 := hψ_le_Cinv α hα 1 (by omega) z
            rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at h1
            exact le_trans (abs_add_le 1 (deriv (ψ w α) z)) (by norm_num [B_inv]; linarith)
          | succ k2 =>
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDeriv_eq α hα, iteratedDeriv_succ',
              show deriv (fun y : ℝ => 1 + deriv (ψ w α) y) = deriv (deriv (ψ w α)) from
                funext fun y => deriv_const_add 1,
              ← iteratedDeriv_succ', ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact le_trans (hψ_le_Cinv α hα (k2 + 2) (by omega) z) (by simp [B_inv])
      · intro k hkm
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          have hEq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv 0 (xInv w p.1) p.2) =
              fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
                (p.2 - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ p.1 / 2) / (q : ℝ)) + ψ w p.1 p.2 := by
            funext p; simp [iteratedDeriv_zero, hxInv_eq]
          rw [hEq]
          have hLinCont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
              p.2 - 2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ p.1 / 2) / (q : ℝ)) := by fun_prop
          have hψ0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ψ w p.1 p.2)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
            simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hψ_cont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
          exact hLinCont.continuousOn.add hψ0
        | succ k1 =>
          cases k1 with
          | zero =>
            have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 1 + iteratedDeriv 1 (ψ w p.1) p.2)
                (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
              continuousOn_const.add (hψ_cont 1 (by omega))
            refine h1.congr fun p hp => ?_
            simp [iteratedDeriv_one, hDeriv_eq p.1 hp.1]
          | succ k2 =>
            refine (hψ_cont (k2 + 2) (by omega)).congr fun p hp => ?_
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDeriv_eq p.1 hp.1, iteratedDeriv_succ',
              show deriv (fun y : ℝ => 1 + deriv (ψ w p.1) y) = deriv (deriv (ψ w p.1)) from
                funext fun y => deriv_const_add 1,
              ← iteratedDeriv_succ', ← iteratedDeriv_succ']

    let ℓ_fn : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun w x =>
      (realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w j x) / 2 +
        s_mid * realMidpointDisp q w j x
    have hℓ_props : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (ℓ_fn w) ∧
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k (ℓ_fn w) x| ≤ 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hDisp, hMid⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w hq_mesh (hWeakenM hw)
      obtain ⟨_, hd_j_cd, _⟩ := hDisp j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
      obtain ⟨_, hd_j1_cd, _⟩ := hDisp (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj)
      obtain ⟨_, hη_cd, hd_diff_bnd, hη_bnd⟩ := hMid j hj
      have hSub_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun y => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) := hd_j1_cd.sub hd_j_cd
      have hℓ_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (ℓ_fn w) :=
        (hSub_cd.mul contDiff_const).add (contDiff_const.mul hη_cd)
      refine ⟨hℓ_cd, ?_⟩
      intro k hk x
      have hEq : ℓ_fn w = fun y =>
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) +
          s_mid * realMidpointDisp q w j y := by funext y; simp [ℓ_fn]; ring
      have h1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun y => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) :=
        hSub_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      have h2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDisp q w j) :=
        hη_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((contDiff_const.mul h1_cd).contDiffAt)
        ((contDiff_const.mul h2_cd).contDiffAt),
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) h1_cd.contDiffAt,
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul s_mid h2_cd.contDiffAt]
      have hb_diff : |iteratedDeriv k
          (fun y => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) x| ≤
          S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith [hd_diff_bnd k hk x]
      have hb_diff2 : |iteratedDeriv k
          (fun y => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) x| ≤
          S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have hpow := hInvPow_le (a := 2) (b := 3) (by omega)
        calc _ ≤ S.R_mesh * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) := by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hb_diff
          _ ≤ S.R_mesh * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (le_of_lt hR_mesh_pos)
          _ = S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      have hb_η : |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDisp q w j) x| ≤ S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith [hη_bnd k hk x]
      calc |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k _ x + s_mid * iteratedDeriv k _ x|
          ≤ |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k _ x| + |s_mid * iteratedDeriv k _ x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k _ x| + |iteratedDeriv k _ x| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, hs_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) + S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            have hpos : 0 ≤ S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
            rw [mul_div_assoc]; linarith

    have hℓ_lip : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => ℓ_fn w₁ y - ℓ_fn w₂ y) x| ≤
            (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ := by
      intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ k hk x
      obtain ⟨_, hd_diff_lip, hη_lip⟩ :=
        S.real_mesh_lip q w₁ w₂ hq_mesh (hWeakenM hw₁) (hWeakenM hw₂)
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hDisp1, hMid1⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w₁ hq_mesh (hWeakenM hw₁)
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hDisp2, hMid2⟩ := S.real_mesh_props q w₂ hq_mesh (hWeakenM hw₂)
      have h1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y =>
          (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
          (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) :=
        (((hDisp1 (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj)).2.1.sub (hDisp1 j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)).2.1).sub
          ((hDisp2 (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj)).2.1.sub (hDisp2 j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)).2.1)).of_le
          (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      have h2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun y => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) :=
        ((hMid1 j hj).2.1.sub (hMid2 j hj).2.1).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      have hEq : (fun y => ℓ_fn w₁ y - ℓ_fn w₂ y) = fun y =>
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
            (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) +
          s_mid * (realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) := by
        funext y; simp [ℓ_fn]; ring
      rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((contDiff_const.mul h1_cd).contDiffAt)
        ((contDiff_const.mul h2_cd).contDiffAt),
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) h1_cd.contDiffAt,
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul s_mid h2_cd.contDiffAt]
      let Δw := realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂
      have hΔw_nn : 0 ≤ Δw := hDiffSup_nonneg w₁ w₂
      let f1_sub : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
        (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
          (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)
      let f2_sub : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y
      have hb1_3 : |iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x| ≤ (S.R_mesh * Δw) / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith [hd_diff_lip j hj k hk x]
      have hb1_2 : |iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x| ≤ (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by
        have hpow := hInvPow_le (a := 2) (b := 3) (by omega)
        calc |iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x|
            ≤ (S.R_mesh * Δw) * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) := by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hb1_3
          _ ≤ (S.R_mesh * Δw) * (1 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR_mesh_pos) hΔw_nn)
          _ = (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by ring
      have hb2 : |iteratedDeriv k f2_sub x| ≤ (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by
        have h := hη_lip j hj k hk x
        have h' : |iteratedDeriv k f2_sub x| ≤ (S.R_mesh * Δw) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith
        simpa [mul_div_right_comm] using h'
      calc |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x + s_mid * iteratedDeriv k f2_sub x|
          ≤ |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x| + |s_mid * iteratedDeriv k f2_sub x| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k f1_sub x| + |iteratedDeriv k f2_sub x| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, hs_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) +
              (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by linarith
        _ ≤ (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by
            have hpos : 0 ≤ (S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw := by positivity
            rw [mul_div_assoc, mul_assoc]; linarith

    have hPhase_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (α z : ℝ),
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((xInv w α z - z : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * τ α : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
            g_osc (-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z) := by
      intro w α z
      have hSignJ : ∃ m_j : ℤ,
          -(n : ℝ) * (-2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ)) =
            (m_j : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + Real.pi * σ_n * τ α := by
        rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with h_pos | h_neg
        · refine ⟨(j : ℤ), ?_⟩
          have hn_eq : (n : ℝ) = (q : ℝ) := by rw [h_pos, Int.cast_natCast]
          dsimp only [σ_n]
          rw [hn_eq, Int.cast_natCast]
          field_simp
        · refine ⟨-(j : ℤ), ?_⟩
          have hn_eq : (n : ℝ) = -(q : ℝ) := by
            rw [h_neg, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
          dsimp only [σ_n]
          rw [hn_eq, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
          field_simp; ring
      obtain ⟨m_j, hm_j⟩ := hSignJ
      have hx_sub : xInv w α z - z =
          -2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ) + ψ w α z := by
        rw [hxInv_eq]; ring
      have hArg : -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((xInv w α z - z : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (m_j : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) +
            (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * τ α : ℝ) : ℂ) +
              Complex.I * ((-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        rw [hx_sub]
        have hRealEq : -(n : ℝ) * (-2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ) + ψ w α z) =
            (m_j : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + Real.pi * σ_n * τ α + (-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z) := by
          linarith [hm_j]
        calc -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((-2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ) + ψ w α z : ℝ) : ℂ)
            = Complex.I * ((-(n : ℝ) *
                (-2 * Real.pi * ((j : ℝ) + τ α / 2) / (q : ℝ) + ψ w α z) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
                push_cast; ring
          _ = Complex.I * (((m_j : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) + Real.pi * σ_n * τ α +
                (-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hRealEq]
          _ = (m_j : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) +
                (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * τ α : ℝ) : ℂ) +
                  Complex.I * ((-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hArg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.exp_add]

    let A_fn : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z => (fwdK w α (xInv w α z) : ℂ)
    let B_fn : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z =>
      ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ℓ_fn w (xInv w α z) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let J_fn : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z => ((1 + deriv (ψ w α) z : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let E0_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun α => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * τ α : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let E_fn : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z => E0_fn α * g_osc (-(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z)
    let A0_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun α => ((k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let B0_val : ℂ := ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

    have hHalfTerm_factor : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          halfTerm w α = fun z => (A_fn w α z * B_fn w α z) * (J_fn w α z * E_fn w α z) := by
      intro w hw α hα
      obtain ⟨hx_pt, _⟩ := hxInv_props w hw
      funext z
      dsimp only [halfTerm, A_fn, B_fn, J_fn, E_fn, E0_fn, ℓ_fn]
      rw [(hx_pt α hα).2.1, hPhase_eq w α z]
      push_cast; ring

    have hLeadHalf_factor : ∀ α : ℝ,
        leadHalf α = (A0_fn α * B0_val) * ((1 : ℂ) * E0_fn α) := by
      intro α
      dsimp only [leadHalf, A0_fn, B0_val, E0_fn]
      push_cast
      have hpow : (q : ℂ) ^ 2 * (q : ℂ) = (q : ℂ) ^ 3 := by ring
      calc ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (q : ℂ) ^ 3) * ((k0 α : ℂ) * _)
          = ((k0 α : ℂ) / (q : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((Real.pi : ℂ) / (q : ℂ))) * (1 * _) := by
              rw [div_mul_div_comm, hpow]; ring
        _ = _ := rfl

    have hCont_mul : ∀ (F G : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
        (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (F α) ∧ ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (G α)) →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) ∧
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (G p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F p.1 y * G p.1 y) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      intro F G hSmoothFG hContFG k hk
      have hSum : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (F p.1) p.2 *
                iteratedDeriv (k - i) (G p.1) p.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        refine continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun i hi => ?_
        have hi_le : i ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hContFG i (le_trans hi_le hk)).1).mul
          (hContFG (k - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk)).2
      refine hSum.congr fun p hp => ?_
      obtain ⟨hF_cd, hG_cd⟩ := hSmoothFG p.1 hp.1
      exact iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hF_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
        (hG_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt

    have hFactors_single : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y - A0_fn α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (A_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => B_fn w α y - B0_val) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_B / (q : ℝ)) (B_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => J_fn w α y - 1) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_J (J_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_E / (q : ℝ)) (fun y => E_fn w α y - E0_fn α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_E (E_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
            (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y - A0_fn α * B0_val) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_Q (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_Q / (q : ℝ))
            (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y - (1 : ℂ) * E0_fn α)) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (halfTerm w p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ)) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hψ_cont, hψ_pt, hK_cont, hK_pt⟩ := hSingleProps w hw
      obtain ⟨hx_pt, hx_cont⟩ := hxInv_props w hw
      obtain ⟨hℓ_cd, hℓ_bnd⟩ := hℓ_props w hw
      have hc1_le_calc : c1_moab m B_inv ≤ C_calc := le_max_left _ _
      have hc2_le_calc : c2_moab m B_inv ≤ C_calc := le_max_right _ _
      have hE0_norm : ∀ α : ℝ, ‖E0_fn α‖ = 1 := by
        intro α
        dsimp only [E0_fn]
        simpa [mul_comm] using Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (Real.pi * σ_n * τ α)
      have hB0_norm : ‖B0_val‖ = Real.pi / (q : ℝ) := by
        dsimp only [B0_val]
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      have hA0_jet : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun _ => A0_fn α) := by
        intro α hα
        have hnorm : ‖A0_fn α‖ ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp only [A0_fn]
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2)]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hk0_bnd α hα) (by positivity)
        exact hJet_mono hnorm (hJet_const m (A0_fn α))
      have hB0_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) (fun _ => B0_val) :=
        hJet_mono (le_of_eq hB0_norm) (hJet_const m B0_val)
      have hP0_jet : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_P0 / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun _ => A0_fn α * B0_val) := by
        intro α hα
        have hm1 := hJet_mul (hA0_jet α hα) hB0_jet
        exact hJet_mono (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [M_P0]; ring)) hm1
      have hE0_jet : ∀ α : ℝ, HasCJetℂ_moab m 1 (fun _ => E0_fn α) := fun α =>
        hJet_mono (le_of_eq (hE0_norm α)) (hJet_const m (E0_fn α))

      have hPtAll : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y - A0_fn α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (A_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => B_fn w α y - B0_val) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_B / (q : ℝ)) (B_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => J_fn w α y - 1) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_J (J_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_E / (q : ℝ)) (fun y => E_fn w α y - E0_fn α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_E (E_fn w α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
            (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y - A0_fn α * B0_val) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m M_Q (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_Q / (q : ℝ))
            (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y - (1 : ℂ) * E0_fn α) := by
        intro α hα
        let rK_α : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => fwdK w α x - k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
        have hrK_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) rK_α :=
          ((hK_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ m + 2))).sub contDiff_const
        have hrK_comp := (hComp_single (𝔸 := ℝ) m B_inv (H_kern.C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3)
          (fun _ => rK_α) (fun _ => xInv w α) (by positivity)
          (fun _ _ => ⟨hrK_cd, (hx_pt α hα).1,
            fun k hk x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, rK_α] using (hK_pt α hα).2 k (by omega) x,
            (hx_pt α hα).2.2⟩)
          (fun k hk => ⟨
            (hrK_cd.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast hk)).comp_continuousOn
              continuous_snd.continuousOn,
            ((hx_pt α hα).1.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast hk)).comp_continuousOn
              continuous_snd.continuousOn⟩)).1 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
        have hA_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y - A0_fn α) := by
          have hEq : (fun y => A_fn w α y - A0_fn α) = fun y => ((rK_α (xInv w α y) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            funext y; simp [A_fn, A0_fn, rK_α]
          rw [hEq]
          refine hJet_ofReal hrK_comp.1 (by positivity) fun k hk z => ?_
          have hb : |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => rK_α (xInv w α y)) z| ≤
              c1_moab m B_inv * (H_kern.C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) := by
            simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hrK_comp.2 k hk z
          exact le_trans hb (by
            dsimp only [C_A]
            rw [mul_div_assoc]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1_le_calc (by positivity))
        have hA_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (A_fn w α) := by
          have hEq : A_fn w α = fun y => A0_fn α + (A_fn w α y - A0_fn α) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hAdd := hJet_add (hA0_jet α hα) hA_diff_jet
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
          have hCA : C_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ C_A / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
              (pow_le_pow_right₀ hq_ge_one (by omega))
          dsimp only [M_A]; rw [add_div]; linarith
        have hℓ_cd_m : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (ℓ_fn w) :=
          hℓ_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ m + 2))
        have hℓ_comp := (hComp_single (𝔸 := ℝ) m B_inv (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
          (fun _ => ℓ_fn w) (fun _ => xInv w α) (by positivity)
          (fun _ _ => ⟨hℓ_cd_m, (hx_pt α hα).1,
            fun k hk x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hℓ_bnd k (by omega) x,
            (hx_pt α hα).2.2⟩)
          (fun k hk => ⟨
            (hℓ_cd_m.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast hk)).comp_continuousOn
              continuous_snd.continuousOn,
            ((hx_pt α hα).1.continuous_iteratedDeriv k (by exact_mod_cast hk)).comp_continuousOn
              continuous_snd.continuousOn⟩)).1 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
        have hB_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => B_fn w α y - B0_val) := by
          have hEq : (fun y => B_fn w α y - B0_val) =
              fun y => ((ℓ_fn w (xInv w α y) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            funext y; simp [B_fn, B0_val]
          rw [hEq]
          refine hJet_ofReal hℓ_comp.1 (by positivity) fun k hk z => ?_
          have hb : |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => ℓ_fn w (xInv w α y)) z| ≤
              c1_moab m B_inv * (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
            simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hℓ_comp.2 k hk z
          exact le_trans hb (by
            dsimp only [C_B]
            calc c1_moab m B_inv * (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
                ≤ C_calc * (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1_le_calc (by positivity)
              _ = 2 * C_calc * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring)
        have hB_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_B / (q : ℝ)) (B_fn w α) := by
          have hEq : B_fn w α = fun y => B0_val + (B_fn w α y - B0_val) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hAdd := hJet_add hB0_jet hB_diff_jet
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
          have hCB : C_B / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ C_B / (q : ℝ) := by
            simpa [pow_one] using
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity : 0 ≤ C_B) (by positivity)
                (pow_le_pow_right₀ hq_ge_one (by omega : 1 ≤ 2))
          dsimp only [M_B]; rw [add_div]; linarith
        have hJ_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (fun y => J_fn w α y - 1) := by
          have hEq : (fun y => J_fn w α y - 1) = fun y => ((deriv (ψ w α) y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            funext y; simp [J_fn]
          rw [hEq]
          refine hJet_ofReal (hContDiff_deriv m (ψ w α) (hψ_pt α hα).1) (by positivity)
            fun k hk z => ?_
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          exact (hψ_pt α hα).2 (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk) z
        have hJ_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m M_J (J_fn w α) := by
          have hEq : J_fn w α = fun y => (1 : ℂ) + (J_fn w α y - 1) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hAdd := hJet_add (hJet_mono (B₂ := 1) (by simp) (hJet_const m (1 : ℂ))) hJ_diff_jet
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
          have hq2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hq_ge_one
          have hle : H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ H_inv.C_inv :=
            div_le_self (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) hq2
          dsimp only [M_J]; linarith
        let u_α : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => -(n : ℝ) * ψ w α z
        have hu_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) u_α :=
          contDiff_const.mul ((hψ_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m))
        have hu_bnd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k u_α z| ≤ H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by
          intro k hk z
          have hψ_k : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (ψ w α) z :=
            ((hψ_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)).contDiffAt
          dsimp only [u_α]
          rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul (-(n : ℝ)) hψ_k, abs_mul, abs_neg, hAbs_n_eq_q]
          have hb := (hψ_pt α hα).2 k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) z
          calc (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w α) z|
              ≤ (q : ℝ) * (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (le_of_lt hq_pos)
            _ = H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by field_simp
        have hu_le_B : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k u_α z| ≤ B_inv ∧ |iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) z| ≤ B_inv := by
          intro k _ hk z
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · exact le_trans (hu_bnd k hk z)
              (le_trans (div_le_self (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) hq_ge_one) (by simp [B_inv]))
          · rw [hIter_zero_ℝ k z, abs_zero]; exact le_of_lt hB_inv_pos
        have hg_osc_diff := hComp_same_diff (𝔸 := ℂ) m B_inv 1 (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ))
          g_osc u_α (fun _ => 0) zero_le_one (by positivity)
          (hg_osc_cd.of_le le_top) hu_cd contDiff_const
          (fun k _ x => le_of_eq (hg_osc_norm k x))
          hu_le_B
          (fun k hk z => by simpa [sub_zero] using hu_bnd k hk z)
        have hOsc_sub_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_E / (q : ℝ))
            (fun y => g_osc (u_α y) - 1) := by
          have hg0 : g_osc 0 = 1 := by simp [g_osc]
          refine ⟨((hg_osc_cd.of_le le_top).comp hu_cd).sub contDiff_const, by positivity, ?_⟩
          intro k hk z
          have hb := hg_osc_diff k hk z
          rw [hg0] at hb
          exact le_trans hb (by
            dsimp only [C_E]
            rw [mul_one, mul_div_assoc]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2_le_calc (by positivity))
        have hE_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_E / (q : ℝ)) (fun y => E_fn w α y - E0_fn α) := by
          have hEq : (fun y => E_fn w α y - E0_fn α) =
              fun y => E0_fn α * (g_osc (u_α y) - 1) := by
            funext y; dsimp only [E_fn, u_α]; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hm1 := hJet_const_mul (E0_fn α) hOsc_sub_jet
          rw [hE0_norm α, one_mul] at hm1
          exact hm1
        have hE_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m M_E (E_fn w α) := by
          have hEq : E_fn w α = fun y => E0_fn α + (E_fn w α y - E0_fn α) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hAdd := hJet_add (hE0_jet α) hE_diff_jet
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
          have hle : C_E / (q : ℝ) ≤ C_E := div_le_self (by positivity) hq_ge_one
          dsimp only [M_E]; linarith
        have hP_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (M_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y) :=
          hJet_mono (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [M_P]; ring)) (hJet_mul hA_jet hB_jet)
        have hP_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
            (fun y => A_fn w α y * B_fn w α y - A0_fn α * B0_val) :=
          hJet_mono (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [C_P]; ring))
            (hJet_mul_diff (hA0_jet α hα) hB_jet hA_diff_jet hB_diff_jet)
        have hQ_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m M_Q (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y) :=
          hJet_mul hJ_jet hE_jet
        have hQ_diff_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_Q / (q : ℝ))
            (fun y => J_fn w α y * E_fn w α y - (1 : ℂ) * E0_fn α) := by
          have h1_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m 1 (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
            hJet_mono (B₂ := 1) (by simp) (hJet_const m (1 : ℂ))
          have hm1 := hJet_mul_diff h1_jet hE_jet hJ_diff_jet hE_diff_jet
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hm1
          have hle : H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by
            simpa [pow_one] using
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) (by positivity)
                (pow_le_pow_right₀ hq_ge_one (by omega : 1 ≤ 2))
          have hle' : (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * M_E ≤ (H_inv.C_inv * M_E) / (q : ℝ) := by
            calc (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * M_E ≤ (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * M_E :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)
              _ = (H_inv.C_inv * M_E) / (q : ℝ) := by ring
          dsimp only [C_Q]
          have h2m_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
          have hinner : (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * M_E + 1 * (C_E / (q : ℝ)) ≤
              (H_inv.C_inv * M_E + 1 * C_E) / (q : ℝ) := by
            have h1eq : 1 * (C_E / (q : ℝ)) = (1 * C_E) / (q : ℝ) := by ring
            rw [h1eq, add_div]; linarith
          calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * M_E + 1 * (C_E / (q : ℝ)))
              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E + 1 * C_E) / (q : ℝ)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner h2m_pos
            _ = _ := (mul_div_assoc _ _ _).symm
        exact ⟨hA_diff_jet, hA_jet, hB_diff_jet, hB_jet, hJ_diff_jet, hJ_jet,
          hE_diff_jet, hE_jet, hP_jet, hP_diff_jet, hQ_jet, hQ_diff_jet⟩

      refine ⟨hPtAll, ?_⟩
      have hK_tot_bnd : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k (fwdK w α) x| ≤
            Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 + H_kern.C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        intro α hα k hk x
        have hcd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
            (fun y => fwdK w α y - k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x :=
          (((hK_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≤ m + 2))).sub
            contDiff_const).contDiffAt
        have hEq : fwdK w α = fun y => (fwdK w α y - k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) + k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          funext y; ring
        rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcd1 contDiffAt_const]
        have hb1 := (hK_pt α hα).2 k (by omega) x
        have hb2 : |iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℝ => k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) x| ≤
            Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          cases k with
          | zero =>
            simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2)]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hk0_bnd α hα) (by positivity)
          | succ k' =>
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ',
              show deriv (fun _ : ℝ => k0 α / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) = fun _ => 0 from
                funext fun y => deriv_const y _,
              hIter_zero_ℝ k' x, abs_zero]
            positivity
        exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
      have hA_cont_ℝ := (hComp_single (𝔸 := ℝ) m B_inv
        (Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 + H_kern.C_kern / (q : ℝ) ^ 3)
        (fwdK w) (xInv w) (by positivity)
        (fun α hα => ⟨
          (hK_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ m + 2)),
          (hx_pt α hα).1,
          fun k hk x => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hK_tot_bnd α hα k hk x,
          (hx_pt α hα).2.2⟩)
        (fun k hk => ⟨hK_cont k (by omega), hx_cont k hk⟩)).2
      have hA_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (A_fn w p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        intro k hk
        refine (Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hA_cont_ℝ k hk)).congr fun p hp => ?_
        have hcd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => fwdK w p.1 (xInv w p.1 y)) :=
          ((hK_pt p.1 hp.1).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ m + 2))).comp (hx_pt p.1 hp.1).1
        exact (hCLM_iter Complex.ofRealCLM m _ hcd).2 k hk p.2
      let L_step : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ℓ_fn w x
      have hL_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) L_step :=
        contDiff_const.add (hℓ_cd.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ m + 2)))
      have hL_bnd : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
          |iteratedDeriv k L_step x| ≤ Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        intro k hk x
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          simp only [L_step, iteratedDeriv_zero]
          have hb := hℓ_bnd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) x
          simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb

        let u1 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => -(n : ℝ) * ψ w₁ α z

        have hu1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) u1 :=
          contDiff_const.mul ((hψ1_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m))
        have hu2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) u2 :=
          contDiff_const.mul ((hψ2_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m))
        have hu_le_B : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ m → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k u1 z| ≤ B_inv ∧ |iteratedDeriv k u2 z| ≤ B_inv := by
          intro k _ hk z
          have hb1 : |iteratedDeriv k u1 z| ≤ B_inv := by
            have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (ψ w₁ α) z :=
              ((hψ1_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)).contDiffAt
            dsimp only [u1]
            rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul (-(n : ℝ)) hc, abs_mul, abs_neg, hAbs_n_eq_q]
            have h := (hψ1_pt α hα).2 k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) z
            have hq_div : (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w₁ α) z| ≤ H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by
              calc (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w₁ α) z|
                  ≤ (q : ℝ) * (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hq_pos)
                _ = H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by field_simp
            exact le_trans hq_div
              (le_trans (div_le_self (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) hq_ge_one) (by simp [B_inv]))
          have hb2 : |iteratedDeriv k u2 z| ≤ B_inv := by
            have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (ψ w₂ α) z :=
              ((hψ2_pt α hα).1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)).contDiffAt
            dsimp only [u2]
            rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul (-(n : ℝ)) hc, abs_mul, abs_neg, hAbs_n_eq_q]
            have h := (hψ2_pt α hα).2 k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) z
            have hq_div : (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w₂ α) z| ≤ H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by
              calc (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (ψ w₂ α) z|
                  ≤ (q : ℝ) * (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hq_pos)
                _ = H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by field_simp
            exact le_trans hq_div
              (le_trans (div_le_self (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) hq_ge_one) (by simp [B_inv]))
          exact ⟨hb1, hb2⟩
        have hu_diff : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => u1 y - u2 y) z| ≤ (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by
          intro k hk z
          have hEq : (fun y => u1 y - u2 y) = fun y => -(n : ℝ) * (ψ w₁ α y - ψ w₂ α y) := by
            funext y; dsimp only [u1, u2]; ring
          have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => ψ w₁ α y - ψ w₂ α y) z :=
            (((hψ1_pt α hα).1.sub (hψ2_pt α hα).1).of_le
              (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)).contDiffAt
          rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_const_mul (-(n : ℝ)) hc, abs_mul, abs_neg, hAbs_n_eq_q]
          have h := hψ_lip k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk) z
          calc (q : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => ψ w₁ α y - ψ w₂ α y) z|
              ≤ (q : ℝ) * ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hq_pos)
            _ = (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by field_simp
        have hg_diff := hComp_same_diff (𝔸 := ℂ) m B_inv 1 ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * Δw)
          g_osc u1 u2 zero_le_one (by positivity)
          (hg_osc_cd.of_le le_top) hu1_cd hu2_cd
          (fun k _ x => le_of_eq (hg_osc_norm k x))
          hu_le_B hu_diff
        have hOsc_jet : HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C_E / (q : ℝ)) * Δw)
            (fun y => g_osc (u1 y) - g_osc (u2 y)) := by
          refine ⟨(((hg_osc_cd.of_le le_top).comp hu1_cd).sub
            ((hg_osc_cd.of_le le_top).comp hu2_cd)), by positivity, ?_⟩
          intro k hk z
          refine le_trans (hg_diff k hk z) ?_
          have hc2_le : c2_moab m B_inv ≤ C_calc := le_max_right _ _
          calc c2_moab m B_inv * 1 * ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * Δw)
              ≤ C_calc * ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * Δw) := by
                rw [mul_one]
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2_le (by positivity)
            _ = (C_E / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by dsimp only [C_E]; ring
        have hEq : (fun y => E_fn w₁ α y - E_fn w₂ α y) =
            fun y => E0_fn α * (g_osc (u1 y) - g_osc (u2 y)) := by
          funext y; dsimp only [E_fn, u1, u2]; ring
        rw [hEq]
        have hm1 := hJet_const_mul (E0_fn α) hOsc_jet
        have hnorm1 : ‖E0_fn α‖ = 1 := by
          dsimp only [E0_fn]
          simpa [mul_comm] using Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I (Real.pi * σ_n * τ α)
        rw [hnorm1, one_mul] at hm1
        exact hm1
      have hP_lip : HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C'_P / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw)
          (fun y => A_fn w₁ α y * B_fn w₁ α y - A_fn w₂ α y * B_fn w₂ α y) :=
        hJet_mono (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [C'_P]; ring))
          (hJet_mul_diff hA2 hB1 hA_lip hB_lip)
      have hQ_lip : HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C'_Q / (q : ℝ)) * Δw)
          (fun y => J_fn w₁ α y * E_fn w₁ α y - J_fn w₂ α y * E_fn w₂ α y) := by
        have hm1 := hJet_mul_diff hJ2 hE1 hJ_lip hE_lip
        refine hJet_mono ?_ hm1
        have hle : H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) := by
          simpa [pow_one] using
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hC_inv_pos) (by positivity)
              (pow_le_pow_right₀ hq_ge_one (by omega : 1 ≤ 2))
        have hle' : ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) * M_E ≤
            ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by
          calc ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) * M_E
              = (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (Δw * M_E) := by ring
            _ ≤ (H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ)) * (Δw * M_E) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)
            _ = ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by ring
        have h2m_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
        have hinner : ((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) * M_E +
            M_J * ((C_E / (q : ℝ)) * Δw) ≤
            ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E + M_J * C_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by
          have h2 : ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw + M_J * ((C_E / (q : ℝ)) * Δw) =
              ((H_inv.C_inv * M_E + M_J * C_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by ring
          linarith
        calc (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (((H_inv.C_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Δw) * M_E +
                M_J * ((C_E / (q : ℝ)) * Δw))
            ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (((H_inv.C_inv * M_E + M_J * C_E) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinner h2m_nn
          _ = (C'_Q / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by dsimp only [C'_Q]; ring
      have hEqTot : (fun y => halfTerm w₁ α y - halfTerm w₂ α y) =
          fun y => (A_fn w₁ α y * B_fn w₁ α y) * (J_fn w₁ α y * E_fn w₁ α y) -
            (A_fn w₂ α y * B_fn w₂ α y) * (J_fn w₂ α y * E_fn w₂ α y) := by
        funext y
        rw [hHalfTerm_factor w₁ hw₁ α hα, hHalfTerm_factor w₂ hw₂ α hα]
      rw [hEqTot]
      exact hJet_mono (le_of_eq (by dsimp only [C'_half]; ring))
        (hJet_mul_diff hP2 hQ1 hP_lip hQ_lip)

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨rawFn, hRawFn⟩ : ∃ F : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ, F = rawCellIntegrand_moab n :=
    ⟨rawCellIntegrand_moab n, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨leadFn, hLeadFn⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ → ℂ, L = leadCellIntegrand_moab n :=
    ⟨leadCellIntegrand_moab n, rfl⟩

  have hCellAll : ∀ (j : ℕ), j < q →
      (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (rawFn w j α) ∧
          HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
            (fun y => rawFn w j α y - leadFn α)) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (rawFn w j p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ))) ∧
      (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (α : ℝ),
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
        α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)
          (fun y => rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y)) := by
    intro j hj
    have hMinus := hHalfCell j hj k0Minus
      (fun w => fwdKernelMinus q w j)
      (fun w => halfCellInvDispMinus q w j)
      (fun w => halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j)
      1 (fun α => α)
      (Or.inl rfl) continuous_id hk0Minus_bnd
      (fun w α z => by unfold halfCellInvDispMinus; ring)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨hInvCont, hInvPt⟩ := H_inv.inv_props q w j hq_inv hw hj
        obtain ⟨hKernCont, hKernPt⟩ := H_kern.kern_props q w j hq_kern hw hj
        exact ⟨fun k hk => (hInvCont k hk).1,
          fun α hα => by
            obtain ⟨_, _, hDispM_cd, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hDisp_bnd⟩ := hInvPt α hα
            exact ⟨hDispM_cd, fun k hk z => (hDisp_bnd k hk z).1⟩,
          fun k hk => (hKernCont k hk).1,
          fun α hα => ⟨(hKernPt α hα).1, fun k hk x => ((hKernPt α hα).2.2 k hk x).1⟩⟩)
      (fun w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα =>
        ⟨fun k hk z => (H_inv.inv_lip q w₁ w₂ j α hq_inv hw₁ hw₂ hj hα k hk z).1,
         fun k hk x => (H_kern.kern_lip q w₁ w₂ j α hq_kern hw₁ hw₂ hj hα k hk x).1⟩)
    have hPlus := hHalfCell j hj k0Plus
      (fun w => fwdKernelPlus q w j)
      (fun w => halfCellInvDispPlus q w j)
      (fun w => halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j)
      (-1) (fun α => 1 + α)
      (Or.inr rfl) (continuous_const.add continuous_id) hk0Plus_bnd
      (fun w α z => by unfold halfCellInvDispPlus; ring)
      (fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨hInvCont, hInvPt⟩ := H_inv.inv_props q w j hq_inv hw hj
        obtain ⟨hKernCont, hKernPt⟩ := H_kern.kern_props q w j hq_kern hw hj
        exact ⟨fun k hk => (hInvCont k hk).2,
          fun α hα => by
            obtain ⟨_, _, _, hDispP_cd, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hDisp_bnd⟩ := hInvPt α hα
            exact ⟨hDispP_cd, fun k hk z => (hDisp_bnd k hk z).2⟩,
          fun k hk => (hKernCont k hk).2,
          fun α hα => ⟨(hKernPt α hα).2.1, fun k hk x => ((hKernPt α hα).2.2 k hk x).2⟩⟩)
      (fun w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα =>
        ⟨fun k hk z => (H_inv.inv_lip q w₁ w₂ j α hq_inv hw₁ hw₂ hj hα k hk z).2,
         fun k hk x => (H_kern.kern_lip q w₁ w₂ j α hq_kern hw₁ hw₂ hj hα k hk x).2⟩)

    let halfTerm_m : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z =>
      let x := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z
      let ℓ := (realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w j x) / 2 +
        1 * realMidpointDisp q w j x
      ((fwdKernelMinus q w j α x * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ℓ) *
        deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let halfTerm_p : (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun w α z =>
      let x := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z
      let ℓ := (realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w j x) / 2 +
        (-1) * realMidpointDisp q w j x
      ((fwdKernelPlus q w j α x * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ℓ) *
        deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let leadHalf_m : ℝ → ℂ := fun α =>
      ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((k0Minus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * α : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    let leadHalf_p : ℝ → ℂ := fun α =>
      ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((k0Plus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * (1 + α) : ℝ) : ℂ)))

    have hRawEq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
        ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          rawFn w j α = fun z => halfTerm_m w α z + halfTerm_p w α z := by
      intro w hw α hα
      rw [hRawFn]
      obtain ⟨_, hInvPt⟩ := H_inv.inv_props q w j hq_inv hw hj
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hRight_m, _, hRight_p, _, _, _⟩ := hInvPt α hα
      funext z
      dsimp only [rawCellIntegrand_moab, halfTerm_m, halfTerm_p]
      have hKm : cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
          (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1)) z =
          fwdKernelMinus q w j α (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) := by
        unfold fwdKernelMinus; rw [hRight_m z]
      have hKp : cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
          (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1)) z =
          fwdKernelPlus q w j α (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) := by
        unfold fwdKernelPlus; rw [hRight_p z]
      have hStep_m : ∀ x : ℝ,
          midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x j =
            Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ((realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w j x) / 2 +
              1 * realMidpointDisp q w j x) := by
        intro x; unfold realMeshDisp realMidpointDisp; push_cast; field_simp; ring
      have hStep_p : ∀ x : ℝ,
          realMesh q w x (j + 1) - midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) =
            Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + ((realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) x - realMeshDisp q w j x) / 2 +
              (-1) * realMidpointDisp q w j x) := by
        intro x; unfold realMeshDisp realMidpointDisp; push_cast; field_simp; ring
      change (((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
            (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1)) z *
          (midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
            (realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1)) -
            realMesh q w (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z) j) *
          deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) * _ +
        ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
            (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1)) z *
          (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1) -
            midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) j)
              (realMesh q w (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z) (j + 1))) *
          deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) * _) = _
      rw [hKm, hKp, hStep_m (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z), hStep_p (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z)]

    have hLeadEq : ∀ α : ℝ, leadFn α = leadHalf_m α + leadHalf_p α := by
      intro α; rw [hLeadFn]; dsimp only [leadCellIntegrand_moab, leadHalf_m, leadHalf_p]; ring

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hM_pt, hM_cont⟩ := hMinus.1 w hw
      obtain ⟨hP_pt, hP_cont⟩ := hPlus.1 w hw
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro α hα
        have hcd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (rawFn w j α) := by
          rw [hRawEq w hw α hα]
          exact (hM_pt α hα).1.add (hP_pt α hα).1
        have hRem : HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
            (fun y => rawFn w j α y - leadFn α) := by
          have hEq : (fun y => rawFn w j α y - leadFn α) =
              fun y => (halfTerm_m w α y - leadHalf_m α) + (halfTerm_p w α y - leadHalf_p α) := by
            funext y; rw [hRawEq w hw α hα, hLeadEq α]; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hAdd := hJet_add (hM_pt α hα).2 (hP_pt α hα).2
          refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
          have hmax : C_half ≤ max C_half C'_half := le_max_left _ _
          have hle : C_half + C_half ≤ C_cell := by dsimp only [C_cell]; linarith
          rw [← add_div]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)
        exact ⟨hcd, hRem⟩
      · intro k hk
        have hSumCont : ContinuousOn
            (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
              iteratedDeriv k (halfTerm_m w p.1) p.2 + iteratedDeriv k (halfTerm_p w p.1) p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
          (hM_cont k hk).add (hP_cont k hk)
        refine hSumCont.congr fun p hp => ?_
        rw [hRawEq w hw p.1 hp.1]
        exact iteratedDeriv_fun_add
          (((hM_pt p.1 hp.1).1).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
          (((hP_pt p.1 hp.1).1).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk)).contDiffAt
    · intro w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα
      have hM_lip := hMinus.2 w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα
      have hP_lip := hPlus.2 w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα
      have hEq : (fun y => rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y) =
          fun y => (halfTerm_m w₁ α y - halfTerm_m w₂ α y) +
            (halfTerm_p w₁ α y - halfTerm_p w₂ α y) := by
        funext y; rw [hRawEq w₁ hw₁ α hα, hRawEq w₂ hw₂ α hα]; ring
      rw [hEq]
      have hAdd := hJet_add hM_lip hP_lip
      refine hJet_mono ?_ hAdd
      let Δw := realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂
      have hΔw_nn : 0 ≤ Δw := hDiffSup_nonneg w₁ w₂
      have hmax : C'_half ≤ max C_half C'_half := le_max_right _ _
      have hle : C'_half + C'_half ≤ C_cell := by dsimp only [C_cell]; linarith
      calc (C'_half / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw + (C'_half / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw
          = ((C'_half + C'_half) / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw := by ring
        _ ≤ (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle (by positivity)) hΔw_nn

  have hGlobalB_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
      globalB_mult n w = fun y : ℝ =>
        -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w j α y := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hRawFn]
    have hMesh : HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w := (S.real_mesh_props q w hq_mesh (hWeakenM hw)).1
    funext y
    simp only [globalB_mult, hn_ne, ↓reduceIte, show HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w from hMesh]
    rfl

  have hLead_cont : Continuous leadFn := by
    rw [hLeadFn]
    unfold leadCellIntegrand_moab k0Minus k0Plus
    fun_prop

  have hLeadSumEqOne : -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, leadFn α) = 1 := by
    rw [hLeadFn]
    exact hLeadEqOne n hn_ne

  have hSlice_int : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
      ∀ j < q, ∀ y : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun α => rawFn w j α y) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    intro w hw j hj y
    have h0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rawFn w j p.1 p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using ((hCellAll j hj).1 w hw).2 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    have hMap : ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => (α, y)) (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      continuous_id.continuousOn.prodMk continuousOn_const
    have hSub : Set.MapsTo (fun α : ℝ => (α, y)) (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      intro α hα
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hα
      exact ⟨hα, trivial⟩
    exact (h0.comp hMap hSub).intervalIntegrable

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hw
    have hCell_cd : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range q,
        ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w j α y) := by
      intro j hj_mem
      have hj : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj_mem
      obtain ⟨hPt, hCont⟩ := (hCellAll j hj).1 w hw
      exact (hParamInt m (rawFn w j) (fun α hα => (hPt α hα).1) hCont).1
    have hGlobal_cd : ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (globalB_mult n w) := by
      rw [hGlobalB_eq w hw]
      exact contDiff_const.mul (ContDiff.sum fun j hj => hCell_cd j hj)
    have hRemCell_jet : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range q,
        HasCJetℂ_moab m (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
          (fun y => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w j α y - leadFn α)) := by
      intro j hj_mem
      have hj : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj_mem
      obtain ⟨hPt, hCont⟩ := (hCellAll j hj).1 w hw
      refine hParamJet m (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
        (fun α y => rawFn w j α y - leadFn α)
        (by positivity) (fun α hα => (hPt α hα).2) ?_
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        have h0 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rawFn w j p.1 p.2)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hCont 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
        have hSubCont : ContinuousOn
            (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rawFn w j p.1 p.2 - leadFn p.1)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
          h0.sub (hLead_cont.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hSubCont
      | succ k' =>
        refine (hCont (k' + 1) hk).congr fun p _ => ?_
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ',
          show deriv (fun y => rawFn w j p.1 y - leadFn p.1) =
            deriv (rawFn w j p.1) from funext fun y => deriv_sub_const _,
          ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
    have hSumRem_jet := hJet_finset_sum m (Finset.range q) (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
      (fun j y => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w j α y - leadFn α))
      (by positivity) hRemCell_jet
    rw [Finset.card_range] at hSumRem_jet
    have hGlobalSubOne_eq : (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w y - 1) =
        fun y : ℝ => -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w j α y - leadFn α) := by
      funext y
      rw [hGlobalB_eq w hw, ← hLeadSumEqOne]
      have hSubSum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w j α y) -
          (∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, leadFn α) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w j α y - leadFn α) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj_mem => ?_
        have hj : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj_mem
        exact (intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hSlice_int w hw j hj y)
          (hLead_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)).symm
      calc -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w j α y) -
            (-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, leadFn α))
          = -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w j α y) -
               (∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, leadFn α)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hSubSum]
    have hScaled_jet := hJet_const_mul (-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hSumRem_jet
    refine ⟨hGlobal_cd, ?_⟩
    intro k hk x
    rw [hGlobalSubOne_eq]
    have hb := hScaled_jet.2.2 k hk x
    have hPrefNorm : ‖-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    rw [hPrefNorm] at hb
    refine le_trans hb ?_
    rw [hAbs_n_eq_q]
    have hAlg : ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * ((q : ℝ) * (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)) =
        (C_cell / (6 * Real.pi)) / (q : ℝ) := by field_simp
    rw [hAlg]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp only [K_real]; linarith) (le_of_lt hq_pos)

  · intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ k hk x
    let Δw := realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂
    have hΔw_nn : 0 ≤ Δw := hDiffSup_nonneg w₁ w₂
    have hDiffCell_jet : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range q,
        HasCJetℂ_moab m ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw)
          (fun y => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y)) := by
      intro j hj_mem
      have hj : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj_mem
      obtain ⟨hPt1, hCont1⟩ := (hCellAll j hj).1 w₁ hw₁
      obtain ⟨hPt2, hCont2⟩ := (hCellAll j hj).1 w₂ hw₂
      refine hParamJet m ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw)
        (fun α y => rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y)
        (by positivity)
        (fun α hα => (hCellAll j hj).2 w₁ w₂ α hw₁ hw₂ hα)
        ?_
      intro r hr
      refine ((hCont1 r hr).sub (hCont2 r hr)).congr fun p hp => ?_
      exact iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
        (((hPt1 p.1 hp.1).1).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hr)).contDiffAt
        (((hPt2 p.1 hp.1).1).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hr)).contDiffAt
    have hSumDiff_jet := hJet_finset_sum m (Finset.range q) ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw)
      (fun j y => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y))
      (by positivity) hDiffCell_jet
    rw [Finset.card_range] at hSumDiff_jet
    have hGlobalDiff_eq : (fun y : ℝ => globalB_mult n w₁ y - globalB_mult n w₂ y) =
        fun y : ℝ => -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y) := by
      funext y
      rw [hGlobalB_eq w₁ hw₁, hGlobalB_eq w₂ hw₂]
      have hSubSum : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₁ j α y) -
          (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₂ j α y) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, (rawFn w₁ j α y - rawFn w₂ j α y) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj_mem => ?_
        have hj : j < q := Finset.mem_range.mp hj_mem
        exact (intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hSlice_int w₁ hw₁ j hj y)
          (hSlice_int w₂ hw₂ j hj y)).symm
      calc -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₁ j α y) -
            (-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₂ j α y))
          = -(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₁ j α y) -
               (∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, rawFn w₂ j α y)) := by ring
        _ = _ := by rw [hSubSum]
    have hScaled_jet := hJet_const_mul (-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) hSumDiff_jet
    rw [hGlobalDiff_eq]
    have hb := hScaled_jet.2.2 k hk x
    have hPrefNorm : ‖-(((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    rw [hPrefNorm] at hb
    refine le_trans hb ?_
    rw [hAbs_n_eq_q]
    have hAlg : ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * ((q : ℝ) * ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * Δw)) =
        ((C_cell / (6 * Real.pi)) / (q : ℝ)) * Δw := by field_simp
    rw [hAlg]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp only [K_real]; linarith) (le_of_lt hq_pos)) hΔw_nn

multiplier_oscillatory_assembly_and_boun.definitions:
def c1_moab : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * max 1 B) * c1_moab p B

def c2_moab : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (c1_moab p B + max 1 B * c2_moab p B)

def cCalc_moab (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  max (c1_moab p B) (c2_moab p B)

def HasCJetℂ_moab (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) F ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv k F z‖ ≤ B

noncomputable def rawCellIntegrand_moab (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let q := n.natAbs
  let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α z
  let X_m := realMesh q w x_m j
  let Y_m := realMesh q w x_m (j + 1)
  let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
  let term_m : ℂ :=
    ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
      deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α z
  let X_p := realMesh q w x_p j
  let Y_p := realMesh q w x_p (j + 1)
  let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
  let term_p : ℂ :=
    ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
      deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ q w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
  term_m + term_p

noncomputable def leadCellIntegrand_moab (n : ℤ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  let q : ℝ := (n.natAbs : ℝ)
  let σ_n : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / q
  ((Real.pi / q ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    ((k0Minus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * α : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
     (k0Plus α : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((Real.pi * σ_n * (1 + α) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
