proof.tactics:
by
  have _ : 0 < M := hM
  
  have hStripOpen : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hStripConv : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < H
    change |z₁.im| < H at hz₁
    change |z₂.im| < H at hz₂
    have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im|
        ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ < a * H + b * H := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
          · simp at hab ⊢; subst hab; simpa using hz₂
          · have h1 : a * |z₁.im| < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁ ha_pos
            have h2 : b * |z₂.im| ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hz₂) hb
            linarith
      _ = H := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  have hStripShift2Pi : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(z + 2 * Real.pi).im| < H
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    simpa using hz
  have hStripConj : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < H
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    simpa using hz
  have hContDiffAt : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (s : ℕ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → z ∈ U → ContDiffAt ℂ s f z :=
    fun s hU hf hz => ((hf.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).of_le le_top

  
  have hCompConstMono : ∀ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B →
      (∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ shciCompConst s B) ∧ Monotone (fun s => shciCompConst s B) := by
    intro B hB
    have hge1 : ∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ shciCompConst s B := by
      intro s
      induction s with
      | zero => simp [shciCompConst]
      | succ s ih =>
        simp only [shciCompConst]
        have h2s : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        have h2sB : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * B := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h2s hB
        exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h2sB ih
    refine ⟨hge1, monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun s => ?_⟩
    simp only [shciCompConst]
    have h2s : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have h2sB : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * B := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le h2s hB
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ shciCompConst s B := le_trans zero_le_one (hge1 s)
    calc shciCompConst s B = 1 * shciCompConst s B := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ s * B) * shciCompConst s B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2sB hs0
  have hCompDiffConstMono : ∀ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B →
      (∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ shciCompDiffConst s B) ∧ Monotone (fun s => shciCompDiffConst s B) := by
    intro B hB
    have hc1 := (hCompConstMono B hB).1
    have hge1 : ∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ shciCompDiffConst s B := by
      intro s
      induction s with
      | zero => simp [shciCompDiffConst]
      | succ s ih =>
        simp only [shciCompDiffConst]
        have h2s : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
        have hcs : 1 ≤ shciCompConst s B := hc1 s
        have hBs : 1 ≤ B * shciCompDiffConst s B := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hB ih
        nlinarith
    refine ⟨hge1, monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun s => ?_⟩
    simp only [shciCompDiffConst]
    have h2s : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hcs : 1 ≤ shciCompConst s B := hc1 s
    have hd_pos : 0 ≤ shciCompDiffConst s B := le_trans zero_le_one (hge1 s)
    have hstep1 : shciCompDiffConst s B ≤ B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B := by
      have : 1 * shciCompDiffConst s B ≤ B * shciCompDiffConst s B :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB hd_pos
      linarith
    have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B := by linarith
    calc shciCompDiffConst s B
        ≤ 1 * (B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B) := by linarith
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2s hsum_nonneg
  have hJetBMono : Monotone shciJetB :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun k => le_max_left _ _
  have hJetBGeTwo : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ shciJetB k := fun k =>
    le_trans (by simp [shciJetB]) (hJetBMono (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hJetLMono : Monotone shciJetL :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun k => le_max_left _ _
  have hJetLGeTwo : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ shciJetL k := fun k =>
    le_trans (by simp [shciJetL]) (hJetLMono (Nat.zero_le k))
  have hFactMono : Monotone Nat.factorial :=
    monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos n)

  
  have hChooseSum : ∀ s : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), (s.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ s := by
    intro s
    have hcast := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) (Nat.sum_range_choose s)
    simpa [Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_pow] using hcast
  have hLeibnizBnd : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {u v : ℂ → ℂ} (s : ℕ) (M_u M_v : ℝ) {z : ℂ},
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ u U → DifferentiableOn ℂ v U →
      0 ≤ M_u → 0 ≤ M_v → z ∈ U →
      (∀ i ≤ s, ‖iteratedDeriv i u z‖ ≤ M_u) →
      (∀ j ≤ s, ‖iteratedDeriv j v z‖ ≤ M_v) →
      ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => u ζ * v ζ) z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * M_u * M_v := by
    intro U u v s M_u M_v z hU hu hv hMu hMv hz hub hvb
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hContDiffAt s hU hu hz) (hContDiffAt s hU hv hz)]
    calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1),
            (s.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i u z * iteratedDeriv (s - i) v z‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1),
            ‖(s.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i u z * iteratedDeriv (s - i) v z‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), (s.choose i : ℝ) * (M_u * M_v) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi_le : i ≤ s := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have hsi_le : s - i ≤ s := Nat.sub_le s i
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul (hub i hi_le) (hvb (s - i) hsi_le) (norm_nonneg _) hMu)
            (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), (s.choose i : ℝ)) * (M_u * M_v) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ s * M_u * M_v := by
          rw [hChooseSum s]; ring

  
  have hCompBnd : ∀ (q₀ : ℕ) {U V : Set ℂ} {B M_g : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → 1 ≤ B → 0 ≤ M_g →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f z ∈ V) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ q₀ → ∀ z ∈ U, ‖iteratedDeriv j f z‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q₀ → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv r g w‖ ≤ M_g) →
      ∀ k ≤ q₀, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => g (f ζ)) z‖ ≤ M_g * shciCompConst k B := by
    intro q₀
    induction q₀ with
    | zero =>
      intro U V B M_g f g _ _ _ _ _ _ hMaps _ hg_bnd k hk z hz
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero, shciCompConst] using hg_bnd 0 le_rfl (f z) (hMaps z hz)
    | succ q₀ ih =>
      intro U V B M_g f g hU hV hB hMg hf hg hMaps hf_bnd hg_bnd k hk z hz
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero, shciCompConst] using
          hg_bnd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (f z) (hMaps z hz)
      | succ s =>
        have hs : s ≤ q₀ := Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hk
        have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) V := hg.deriv hV
        have hf' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv f) U := hf.deriv hU
        have hg'f : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => deriv g (f ζ)) U :=
          hg'.comp hf (fun _ hζ => hMaps _ hζ)
        have hEqDeriv : Set.EqOn (deriv (fun ζ => g (f ζ)))
            (fun ζ => deriv g (f ζ) * deriv f ζ) U := by
          intro ζ hζ
          exact deriv_comp ζ (hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hMaps ζ hζ)))
            (hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ))
        have hEv : deriv (fun ζ => g (f ζ)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            (fun ζ => deriv g (f ζ) * deriv f ζ) :=
          hEqDeriv.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq s]
        have hIH : ∀ i ≤ q₀, ∀ ζ ∈ U,
            ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ξ => deriv g (f ξ)) ζ‖ ≤ M_g * shciCompConst i B := by
          apply ih hU hV hB hMg hf hg' hMaps
          · intro j hj1 hjq ζ hζ
            exact hf_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjq) ζ hζ
          · intro r hr w hw
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hg_bnd (r + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hr) w hw
        have hB_pos : 0 ≤ B := by linarith
        have hComp_mono := (hCompConstMono B hB).2
        have hComp_pos : 0 ≤ shciCompConst s B :=
          le_trans zero_le_one ((hCompConstMono B hB).1 s)
        have hLeib := hLeibnizBnd s (M_g * shciCompConst s B) B hU hg'f hf'
          (mul_nonneg hMg hComp_pos) hB_pos hz
          (fun i hi => le_trans (hIH i (le_trans hi hs) z hz)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hComp_mono hi) hMg))
          (fun j hj => by
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hf_bnd (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le j))
              (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hj hs)) z hz)
        calc ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => deriv g (f ζ) * deriv f ζ) z‖
            ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (M_g * shciCompConst s B) * B := hLeib
          _ = M_g * shciCompConst (s + 1) B := by simp [shciCompConst]; ring

  
  have hCompSubBnd : ∀ (q₀ : ℕ) {U V : Set ℂ} {B Δ_f M_g : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → Convex ℝ V → 1 ≤ B → 0 ≤ Δ_f → 0 ≤ M_g →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f₁ z ∈ V) → (∀ z ∈ U, f₂ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ q₀ → ∀ z ∈ U, ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ q₀ → ∀ z ∈ U, ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ ≤ B) →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q₀ → ∀ z ∈ U, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => f₁ ζ - f₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ_f) →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q₀ + 1 → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv r g w‖ ≤ M_g) →
      ∀ k ≤ q₀, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => g (f₁ ζ) - g (f₂ ζ)) z‖ ≤
          M_g * Δ_f * shciCompDiffConst k B := by
    intro q₀
    induction q₀ with
    | zero =>
      intro U V B Δ_f M_g f₁ f₂ g _ hV hV_conv _ _ hMg _ _ hg hMaps₁ hMaps₂ _ _ hdiff hg_bnd
        k hk z hz
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, shciCompDiffConst, mul_one]
      have hLip : ‖g (f₁ z) - g (f₂ z)‖ ≤ M_g * ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ :=
        hV_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (fun _ hw => hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hw))
          (fun w hw => by
            have h1 := hg_bnd 1 (by omega) w hw
            simpa [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] using h1)
          (hMaps₂ z hz) (hMaps₁ z hz)
      have h0 : ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ ≤ Δ_f := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hdiff 0 le_rfl z hz
      exact le_trans hLip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0 hMg)
    | succ q₀ ih =>
      intro U V B Δ_f M_g f₁ f₂ g hU hV hV_conv hB hΔ hMg hf₁ hf₂ hg hMaps₁ hMaps₂
        hf₁_bnd hf₂_bnd hdiff hg_bnd k hk z hz
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, shciCompDiffConst, mul_one]
        have hLip : ‖g (f₁ z) - g (f₂ z)‖ ≤ M_g * ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ :=
          hV_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
            (fun _ hw => hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds hw))
            (fun w hw => by
              have h1 := hg_bnd 1 (by omega) w hw
              simpa [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] using h1)
            (hMaps₂ z hz) (hMaps₁ z hz)
        have h0 : ‖f₁ z - f₂ z‖ ≤ Δ_f := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hdiff 0 (Nat.zero_le _) z hz
        exact le_trans hLip (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0 hMg)
      | succ s =>
        have hs : s ≤ q₀ := Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hk
        have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) V := hg.deriv hV
        have hf₁' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv f₁) U := hf₁.deriv hU
        have hf_sub : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => f₁ ζ - f₂ ζ) U := hf₁.sub hf₂
        have hf_sub' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (fun ζ => f₁ ζ - f₂ ζ)) U := hf_sub.deriv hU
        have hg'₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => deriv g (f₁ ζ)) U :=
          hg'.comp hf₁ (fun _ hζ => hMaps₁ _ hζ)
        have hg'₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => deriv g (f₂ ζ)) U :=
          hg'.comp hf₂ (fun _ hζ => hMaps₂ _ hζ)
        have hTerm1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun ζ => (deriv g (f₁ ζ) - deriv g (f₂ ζ)) * deriv f₁ ζ) U :=
          (hg'₁.sub hg'₂).mul hf₁'
        have hTerm2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun ζ => deriv g (f₂ ζ) * deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ) U :=
          hg'₂.mul hf_sub'
        have hEqDeriv : Set.EqOn (deriv (fun ζ => g (f₁ ζ) - g (f₂ ζ)))
            (fun ζ => (deriv g (f₁ ζ) - deriv g (f₂ ζ)) * deriv f₁ ζ +
              deriv g (f₂ ζ) * deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ) U := by
          intro ζ hζ
          have hdf₁ := hf₁.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)
          have hdf₂ := hf₂.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)
          have hdg₁ := hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hMaps₁ ζ hζ))
          have hdg₂ := hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hMaps₂ ζ hζ))
          have hd1 := (hdg₁.hasDerivAt).comp ζ hdf₁.hasDerivAt
          have hd2 := (hdg₂.hasDerivAt).comp ζ hdf₂.hasDerivAt
          have hd_fsub : deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ = deriv f₁ ζ - deriv f₂ ζ :=
            ((hdf₁.hasDerivAt).sub hdf₂.hasDerivAt).deriv
          exact ((hd1.sub hd2).deriv).trans (by dsimp; rw [hd_fsub]; ring)
        have hEv : deriv (fun ζ => g (f₁ ζ) - g (f₂ ζ)) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            (fun ζ => (deriv g (f₁ ζ) - deriv g (f₂ ζ)) * deriv f₁ ζ +
              deriv g (f₂ ζ) * deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ) :=
          hEqDeriv.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq s,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hContDiffAt s hU hTerm1_holo hz) (hContDiffAt s hU hTerm2_holo hz)]
        have hIH : ∀ i ≤ q₀, ∀ ζ ∈ U,
            ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ξ => deriv g (f₁ ξ) - deriv g (f₂ ξ)) ζ‖ ≤
              M_g * Δ_f * shciCompDiffConst i B := by
          apply ih hU hV hV_conv hB hΔ hMg hf₁ hf₂ hg' hMaps₁ hMaps₂
          · intro j hj1 hjq ζ hζ; exact hf₁_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjq) ζ hζ
          · intro j hj1 hjq ζ hζ; exact hf₂_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjq) ζ hζ
          · intro j hjq ζ hζ; exact hdiff j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjq) ζ hζ
          · intro r hr w hw
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hg_bnd (r + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hr) w hw
        have hComp₂ : ∀ i ≤ q₀, ∀ ζ ∈ U,
            ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ξ => deriv g (f₂ ξ)) ζ‖ ≤ M_g * shciCompConst i B := by
          apply hCompBnd q₀ hU hV hB hMg hf₂ hg' hMaps₂
          · intro j hj1 hjq ζ hζ; exact hf₂_bnd j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjq) ζ hζ
          · intro r hr w hw
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hg_bnd (r + 1) (by omega) w hw
        have hB_pos : 0 ≤ B := by linarith
        have hc_mono := (hCompConstMono B hB).2
        have hd_mono := (hCompDiffConstMono B hB).2
        have hc_pos : 0 ≤ shciCompConst s B :=
          le_trans zero_le_one ((hCompConstMono B hB).1 s)
        have hd_pos : 0 ≤ shciCompDiffConst s B :=
          le_trans zero_le_one ((hCompDiffConstMono B hB).1 s)
        have hL1 := hLeibnizBnd s (M_g * Δ_f * shciCompDiffConst s B) B
          hU (hg'₁.sub hg'₂) hf₁' (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hMg hΔ) hd_pos) hB_pos hz
          (fun i hi => le_trans (hIH i (le_trans hi hs) z hz)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hd_mono hi) (mul_nonneg hMg hΔ)))
          (fun j hj => by
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hf₁_bnd (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le j))
              (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hj hs)) z hz)
        have hL2 := hLeibnizBnd s (M_g * shciCompConst s B) Δ_f
          hU hg'₂ hf_sub' (mul_nonneg hMg hc_pos) hΔ hz
          (fun i hi => le_trans (hComp₂ i (le_trans hi hs) z hz)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc_mono hi) hMg))
          (fun j hj => by
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact hdiff (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (le_trans hj hs)) z hz)
        calc ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => (deriv g (f₁ ζ) - deriv g (f₂ ζ)) * deriv f₁ ζ) z +
              iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => deriv g (f₂ ζ) * deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ) z‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => (deriv g (f₁ ζ) - deriv g (f₂ ζ)) * deriv f₁ ζ) z‖ +
              ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ζ => deriv g (f₂ ζ) * deriv (fun ξ => f₁ ξ - f₂ ξ) ζ) z‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (M_g * Δ_f * shciCompDiffConst s B) * B +
              (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (M_g * shciCompConst s B) * Δ_f := add_le_add hL1 hL2
          _ = M_g * Δ_f * shciCompDiffConst (s + 1) B := by simp [shciCompDiffConst]; ring

  
  let V_Q : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2)
  have hVQ_open : IsOpen V_Q := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hVQ_conv : Convex ℝ V_Q := convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2)
  have hVQ_one_add : ∀ w ∈ V_Q, 1 + w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖(1 + w)⁻¹‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ < 1 / 2 := by simpa [V_Q] using hw
    have hlow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < ‖1 + w‖ := by
      have htri : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ - ‖-w‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) - (-w)‖ := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) (-w)
      simp only [norm_one, norm_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] at htri
      linarith
    have hpos : 0 < ‖1 + w‖ := by linarith
    refine ⟨norm_pos_iff.mp hpos, ?_⟩
    rw [norm_inv]
    calc (‖1 + w‖)⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) (le_of_lt hlow)
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  have hP_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ shciInvOneAdd V_Q := by
    intro w hw
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => 1 + ζ) 1 w := by
      have h0 := (hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℂ)).add (hasDerivAt_id w)
      rw [zero_add] at h0
      exact h0
    exact (hd.inv (hVQ_one_add w hw).1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hP_deriv_eq : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ V_Q,
      iteratedDeriv r shciInvOneAdd w =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ r * (r.factorial : ℂ) * ((1 + w) ^ (r + 1))⁻¹ := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro w _
      simp [shciInvOneAdd]
    | succ r ih =>
      intro w hw
      have hEq : Set.EqOn (iteratedDeriv r shciInvOneAdd)
          (fun ζ => (-1 : ℂ) ^ r * (r.factorial : ℂ) * ((1 + ζ) ^ (r + 1))⁻¹) V_Q :=
        fun ζ hζ => ih ζ hζ
      have hEv := hEq.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVQ_open.mem_nhds hw)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, hEv.deriv_eq]
      have hne : 1 + w ≠ 0 := (hVQ_one_add w hw).1
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => 1 + ζ) 1 w := by
        have h0 := (hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℂ)).add (hasDerivAt_id w)
        rw [zero_add] at h0
        exact h0
      have hdpow : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (1 + ζ) ^ (r + 1))
          (((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (1 + w) ^ r * 1) w := hd1.pow (r + 1)
      have hdinv : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => ((1 + ζ) ^ (r + 1))⁻¹)
          (-(((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (1 + w) ^ r * 1) / ((1 + w) ^ (r + 1)) ^ 2) w :=
        hdpow.inv (pow_ne_zero (r + 1) hne)
      have hdmul := hdinv.const_mul ((-1 : ℂ) ^ r * (r.factorial : ℂ))
      rw [hdmul.deriv, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, pow_succ (-1 : ℂ) r]
      field_simp [hne]
      ring
  have hP_bnd : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ V_Q,
      ‖iteratedDeriv r shciInvOneAdd w‖ ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 1) := by
    intro r w hw
    rw [hP_deriv_eq r w hw, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow,
       one_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, ← inv_pow, norm_pow]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hVQ_one_add w hw).2 (r + 1))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

  
  have hRightInvODE : ∀ {σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ : ℝ} {e x_inv : ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < σ₁ → 0 < σ₂ → 0 ≤ δ_e → δ_e ≤ 1 / 4 →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ₁) →
      (∀ r ≤ 1, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖iteratedDeriv r e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e) →
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ e x_inv →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, deriv e (x_inv z) ∈ V_Q) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, deriv x_inv z = shciInvOneAdd (deriv e (x_inv z))) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => x_inv ζ - (ζ - (ρ : ℂ))) z =
          -(deriv e (x_inv z) * shciInvOneAdd (deriv e (x_inv z)))) := by
    intro σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ e x_inv _ _ _ hδ_le he he_bnd hx
    have hU₁ := hStripOpen σ₁
    have hU₂ := hStripOpen σ₂
    obtain ⟨hx_holo, hx_maps, hx_eq⟩ := hx
    have hg_mem : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, deriv e (x_inv z) ∈ V_Q := by
      intro z hz
      have hb1 : ‖deriv e (x_inv z)‖ ≤ δ_e := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] using
          he_bnd 1 le_rfl (x_inv z) (hx_maps z hz)
      change dist (deriv e (x_inv z)) 0 < 1 / 2
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have hderiv_x : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, deriv x_inv z = shciInvOneAdd (deriv e (x_inv z)) := by
      intro z hz
      have hdx : HasDerivAt x_inv (deriv x_inv z) z :=
        (hx_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
      have hde : HasDerivAt e (deriv e (x_inv z)) (x_inv z) :=
        (he.differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds (hx_maps z hz))).hasDerivAt
      have hd_lhs : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => x_inv ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv ζ))
          (deriv x_inv z + deriv e (x_inv z) * deriv x_inv z) z :=
        (hdx.add_const (ρ : ℂ)).add (hde.comp z hdx)
      have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun ζ => x_inv ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv ζ)) id (horizStrip σ₂) :=
        fun ζ hζ => hx_eq ζ hζ
      have hEv := hEq.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU₂.mem_nhds hz)
      have hd1 : deriv (fun ζ => x_inv ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv ζ)) z = 1 := by
        rw [hEv.deriv_eq, deriv_id]
      have h_eq1 : deriv x_inv z + deriv e (x_inv z) * deriv x_inv z = 1 :=
        hd_lhs.deriv.symm.trans hd1
      have hmul : (1 + deriv e (x_inv z)) * deriv x_inv z = 1 := by
        linear_combination h_eq1
      have hne : 1 + deriv e (x_inv z) ≠ 0 := (hVQ_one_add _ (hg_mem z hz)).1
      change deriv x_inv z = (1 + deriv e (x_inv z))⁻¹
      exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul
    refine ⟨hg_mem, hderiv_x, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hdx : HasDerivAt x_inv (deriv x_inv z) z :=
      (hx_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ - (ρ : ℂ)) 1 z :=
      (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const (ρ : ℂ)
    have hd_sub_ψ : deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => x_inv ζ - (ζ - (ρ : ℂ))) z = deriv x_inv z - 1 :=
      (hdx.sub hlin).deriv
    rw [hd_sub_ψ, hderiv_x z hz]
    have hne : 1 + deriv e (x_inv z) ≠ 0 := (hVQ_one_add _ (hg_mem z hz)).1
    unfold shciInvOneAdd
    field_simp [hne]
    ring

  have hLinZeroHigh : ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
      iteratedDeriv (t + 2) (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ - (ρ : ℂ)) z = 0 := by
    intro ρ t z
    have hd1 : deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ - (ρ : ℂ)) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
      ext ζ; exact ((hasDerivAt_id ζ).sub_const (ρ : ℂ)).deriv
    have hd2 : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by
      ext ζ; exact deriv_const ζ (1 : ℂ)
    rw [show t + 2 = (t + 1) + 1 from rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ', hd1,
      iteratedDeriv_succ', hd2]
    induction t generalizing z with
    | zero => simp
    | succ t _ => simp

  have hJetSingle : ∀ (p : ℕ) {σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ : ℝ} {e x_inv : ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < σ₁ → 0 < σ₂ → 0 ≤ δ_e → δ_e ≤ 1 / 4 →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ₁) →
      (∀ r ≤ p + 1, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖iteratedDeriv r e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e) →
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ e x_inv →
      ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => x_inv ζ - (ζ - (ρ : ℂ))) z‖ ≤ shciJetB k * δ_e := by
    intro p σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ e x_inv hσ₁ hσ₂ hδ0 hδ_le he he_bnd hx

    obtain ⟨hx_holo, hx_maps, hx_eq⟩ := hx

    have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (horizStrip σ₂) :=

    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hkp z hz

        have hG_ge1 : 1 ≤ G := (hCompConstMono B hB_ge1).1 k

          intro j hj1 hjk ζ hζ
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hj1 with rfl | hj_gt1
          · rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero, hderiv_x ζ hζ]
            have h2 := (hVQ_one_add _ (hg_mem ζ hζ)).2
            simpa [shciInvOneAdd] using le_trans h2 hB_ge2
          · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, j = t + 2 := ⟨j - 2, by omega⟩
            have hx_split : x_inv = fun ξ => ψ ξ + (ξ - (ρ : ℂ)) := by ext ξ; simp [ψ]
            have hlin_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => ξ - (ρ : ℂ)) (horizStrip σ₂) :=

            rw [hx_split, iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hContDiffAt (t + 2) hU₂ hψ_holo hζ)

            have hψ_t : ‖iteratedDeriv (t + 2) ψ ζ‖ ≤ shciJetB (t + 2) * δ_e :=

            have hB_mono : shciJetB (t + 2) ≤ B := hJetBMono hjk
            have hBs_pos : 0 ≤ shciJetB (t + 2) := by have := hJetBGeTwo (t + 2); linarith
            calc ‖iteratedDeriv (t + 2) ψ ζ‖
                ≤ shciJetB (t + 2) * δ_e := hψ_t

        have hg_bnd : ∀ r ≤ k, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,

          intro r hrk ζ hζ

            (fun j hj w hw => by

                    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.succ_le_succ hr))
                    (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))

        have hEqψ' : Set.EqOn (deriv ψ)
            (fun ζ => -(deriv e (x_inv ζ) * shciInvOneAdd (deriv e (x_inv ζ))))
            (horizStrip σ₂) := fun ζ hζ => hderiv_ψ ζ hζ
        have hEv := hEqψ'.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU₂.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq k,

            (fun ζ => deriv e (x_inv ζ) * shciInvOneAdd (deriv e (x_inv ζ))) z,

        have hCompG_pos : 0 ≤ shciCompConst k G :=

        have hLeib := hLeibnizBnd k (δ_e * G) (M_P * shciCompConst k G)
          hU₂ hg_holo hPg_holo (mul_nonneg hδ0 (by linarith))
          (mul_nonneg hMP_pos hCompG_pos) hz

            ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (δ_e * G) * (M_P * shciCompConst k G) := hLeib
          _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_P * G * shciCompConst k G) * δ_e := by ring
          _ ≤ shciJetB (k + 1) * δ_e := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMax hδ0

  have hSingleAux : ∀ (p k : ℕ) {σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ : ℝ} {e x_inv : ℂ → ℂ},

      (∀ r ≤ p + 1, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖iteratedDeriv r e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e) →
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ e x_inv →
      (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ‖iteratedDeriv j x_inv ζ‖ ≤ shciJetB k) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ => deriv e (x_inv ξ)) (horizStrip σ₂) ∧
      (∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,

    intro p k σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ e x_inv hkp hσ₁ hσ₂ hδ0 hδ_le he he_bnd hx

    have hU₂ := hStripOpen σ₂

    obtain ⟨hx_holo, hx_maps, _⟩ := hx
    let B := shciJetB k

    have hG_ge1 : 1 ≤ G := (hCompConstMono B hB_ge1).1 k
    let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => x_inv ζ - (ζ - (ρ : ℂ))

    have hx_deriv_bnd : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,

      intro j hj1 hjk ζ hζ

      · rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero, hderiv_x ζ hζ]
        have h2 := (hVQ_one_add _ (hg_mem ζ hζ)).2
        simpa [shciInvOneAdd] using le_trans h2 hB_ge2
      · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, j = t + 2 := ⟨j - 2, by omega⟩
        have hx_split : x_inv = fun ξ => ψ ξ + (ξ - (ρ : ℂ)) := by ext ξ; simp [ψ]
        have hlin_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => ξ - (ρ : ℂ)) (horizStrip σ₂) :=

        have hB_mono : shciJetB (t + 2) ≤ B := hJetBMono hjk

            ≤ shciJetB (t + 2) * δ_e := hψ_t

    have he'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv e) (horizStrip σ₁) := he.deriv hU₁
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ => deriv e (x_inv ξ)) (horizStrip σ₂) :=

    have hg_bnd : ∀ r ≤ k, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,

  have hJetDiff : ∀ (p : ℕ) {σ₁ σ₂ δ_e Δ_e ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ} {e₁ e₂ x₁ x₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < σ₁ → 0 < σ₂ → 0 ≤ δ_e → δ_e ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 ≤ Δ_e →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ e₁ (horizStrip σ₁) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ e₂ (horizStrip σ₁) →
      (∀ r ≤ p + 1, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁,
        ‖iteratedDeriv r e₁ ζ‖ ≤ δ_e ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv r e₂ ζ‖ ≤ δ_e) →
      (∀ r ≤ p + 1, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁,
        ‖iteratedDeriv r (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w) ζ‖ ≤ Δ_e) →
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ₁ e₁ x₁ →
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ₂ e₂ x₂ →

        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => x₁ ζ - x₂ ζ) z‖ ≤

    intro p σ₁ σ₂ δ_e Δ_e ρ₁ ρ₂ e₁ e₂ x₁ x₂ hσ₁ hσ₂ hδ0 hδ_le hΔ0 he₁ he₂ he_bnd hde_bnd hx₁ hx₂

    have hU₂ := hStripOpen σ₂

    obtain ⟨hg₂_mem, hderiv_x₂, _⟩ :=

    have hx₁_full := hx₁
    have hx₂_full := hx₂

    obtain ⟨hx₂_holo, hx₂_maps, hx₂_eq⟩ := hx₂
    let Δ_tot : ℝ := |ρ₁ - ρ₂| + Δ_e
    have hΔ_tot_pos : 0 ≤ Δ_tot := add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hΔ0
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hkp z hz
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, shciJetL]
        have hsub_id : x₁ z - x₂ z =
            -(((ρ₁ - ρ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ)) - (e₁ (x₁ z) - e₁ (x₂ z)) - (e₁ (x₂ z) - e₂ (x₂ z)) := by
          have h1 := hx₁_eq z hz

          have hb := hU₁_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
            (fun _ hw => he₁.differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hw))
            (fun w hw => by
              have h1 := he₁_bnd 1 (by omega) w hw

          conv_lhs => rw [hsub_id]
          calc ‖-(((ρ₁ - ρ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ)) - (e₁ (x₁ z) - e₁ (x₂ z)) - (e₁ (x₂ z) - e₂ (x₂ z))‖

        obtain ⟨hx₂_db, hg₂_holo, hg₂_db⟩ :=
          hSingleAux p k hk_le_p hσ₁ hσ₂ hδ0 hδ_le he₂ he₂_bnd hx₂_full
        have hx_diff_k : ∀ s ≤ k, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
            ‖iteratedDeriv s (fun ξ => x₁ ξ - x₂ ξ) ζ‖ ≤ L * Δ_tot := by
          intro s hsk ζ hζ

        have hde'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w)) (horizStrip σ₁) :=

          hde'_holo.comp hx₂_holo (fun _ hζ => hx₂_maps _ hζ)
        have hg_diff_eq : Set.EqOn (fun ξ => deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ) - deriv e₂ (x₂ ξ))

          intro ξ hξ

          have hd_sub : deriv (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w) (x₂ ξ) =

            ((he₁.differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt.sub

        have hg_diff_bnd : ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
            ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ) - deriv e₂ (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖ ≤ D * Δ_tot := by

          have hEv_g := hg_diff_eq.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU₂.mem_nhds hζ)
          rw [hEv_g.iteratedDeriv_eq j,
            iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hContDiffAt j hU₂ hg_part1_holo hζ)
              (hContDiffAt j hU₂ hg_part2_holo hζ)]
          have hb1 : ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ) - deriv e₁ (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖ ≤
              1 * (L * Δ_tot) * shciCompDiffConst k B := by
            have hraw := hCompSubBnd k hU₂ hU₁ hU₁_conv hB_ge1
              (mul_nonneg hL_pos hΔ_tot_pos) zero_le_one
              hx₁_holo hx₂_holo he₁'_holo hx₁_maps hx₂_maps hx₁_db hx₂_db hx_diff_k
              (fun r hr w hw => by
                rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                exact le_trans (he₁_bnd (r + 1) (by omega) w hw) (by linarith))
              j hjk ζ hζ
            exact le_trans hraw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              ((hCompDiffConstMono B hB_ge1).2 hjk)
              (mul_nonneg zero_le_one (mul_nonneg hL_pos hΔ_tot_pos)))
          have hb2 : ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w) (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖ ≤
              Δ_tot * shciCompConst k B := by
            have hraw := hCompBnd k hU₂ hU₁ hB_ge1 hΔ_tot_pos hx₂_holo hde'_holo hx₂_maps hx₂_db
              (fun r hr w hw => by
                rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                exact le_trans (hde_bnd (r + 1) (by omega) w hw)
                  (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)))
              j hjk ζ hζ
            exact le_trans hraw (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              ((hCompConstMono B hB_ge1).2 hjk) hΔ_tot_pos)
          calc ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ) - deriv e₁ (x₂ ξ)) ζ +
                iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w) (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖
              ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ) - deriv e₁ (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖ +
                ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ξ => deriv (fun w => e₁ w - e₂ w) (x₂ ξ)) ζ‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 1 * (L * Δ_tot) * shciCompDiffConst k B + Δ_tot * shciCompConst k B :=
                add_le_add hb1 hb2
            _ = D * Δ_tot := by dsimp [D]; ring
        have hEq_dx : Set.EqOn (deriv (fun ξ => x₁ ξ - x₂ ξ))
            (fun ξ => shciInvOneAdd (deriv e₁ (x₁ ξ)) - shciInvOneAdd (deriv e₂ (x₂ ξ)))
            (horizStrip σ₂) := by
          intro ξ hξ
          dsimp only
          have hd_sub := ((hx₁_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂.mem_nhds hξ)).hasDerivAt.sub
            (hx₂_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂.mem_nhds hξ)).hasDerivAt).deriv
          exact hd_sub.trans (by rw [hderiv_x₁ ξ hξ, hderiv_x₂ ξ hξ])
        have hEv_dx := hEq_dx.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU₂.mem_nhds hz)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hEv_dx.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
        let M_P : ℝ := ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2)
        have hMP_pos : 0 ≤ M_P := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
        have hFinal := hCompSubBnd k hU₂ hVQ_open hVQ_conv hG_ge1
          (mul_nonneg hD_pos hΔ_tot_pos) hMP_pos
          hg₁_holo hg₂_holo hP_holo hg₁_mem hg₂_mem hg₁_db hg₂_db hg_diff_bnd
          (fun r hr w hw => by
            calc ‖iteratedDeriv r shciInvOneAdd w‖
                ≤ (r.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 1) := hP_bnd r w hw
              _ ≤ M_P := mul_le_mul
                  (Nat.cast_le.mpr (hFactMono hr))
                  (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.succ_le_succ hr))
                  (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          k le_rfl z hz
        have hMax : M_P * D * shciCompDiffConst k G ≤ shciJetL (k + 1) := by
          dsimp [shciJetL, B, G, L, D, M_P]
          exact le_max_right _ _
        calc ‖iteratedDeriv k
                (fun ζ => shciInvOneAdd (deriv e₁ (x₁ ζ)) - shciInvOneAdd (deriv e₂ (x₂ ζ))) z‖
            ≤ M_P * (D * Δ_tot) * shciCompDiffConst k G := hFinal
          _ = (M_P * D * shciCompDiffConst k G) * Δ_tot := by ring
          _ ≤ shciJetL (k + 1) * Δ_tot := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMax hΔ_tot_pos

  
  have hPicard : ∀ {r_max : ℕ} {σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ : ℝ} {g_ℝ : ℝ → ℝ} {e : ℂ → ℂ},
      1 ≤ r_max → 0 < σ₂ → 0 ≤ δ_e → δ_e ≤ 1 / 4 → (1 + 2 * δ_e) * σ₂ ≤ σ₁ →
      IsShciShiftPerturb r_max σ₁ δ_e ρ g_ℝ e →
      let x_inv := shciShiftInv ρ e
      IsShciShiftRightInv σ₁ σ₂ ρ e x_inv ∧
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv (z + 2 * Real.pi) = x_inv z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x_inv x = ((Function.invFun g_ℝ x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
        deriv x_inv x = ((deriv (Function.invFun g_ℝ) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro r_max σ₁ σ₂ δ_e ρ g_ℝ e hr_max hσ₂ hδ0 hδ_le hwidth he
    have hσ₁ : 0 < σ₁ := by nlinarith
    have hU₁ := hStripOpen σ₁
    have hU₁_conv := hStripConv σ₁
    have hU₂ := hStripOpen σ₂
    obtain ⟨he_holo, he_per, he_conj, he_real, he_bnd⟩ := he
    have he_c0 : ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e := fun ζ hζ => by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using he_bnd 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ζ hζ
    have he_c1 : ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖deriv e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e := fun ζ hζ => by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] using he_bnd 1 hr_max ζ hζ
    have he_lip : ∀ ζ₁ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ∀ ζ₂ ∈ horizStrip σ₁,
        ‖e ζ₁ - e ζ₂‖ ≤ δ_e * ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ :=
      fun ζ₁ hζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₂ =>
        hU₁_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (fun _ hw => he_holo.differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hw)) he_c1 hζ₂ hζ₁
    have hVertMaps : ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, φ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (φ z)) →
        (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ‖φ z₁ - φ z₂‖ ≤ 2 * δ_e * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) →
        ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, z - (ρ : ℂ) + φ z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := by
      intro φ hφ_conj hφ_lip z hz
      change |z.im| < σ₂ at hz
      let x₀ : ℂ := (z.re : ℂ)
      have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := by
        change |x₀.im| < σ₂; simpa [x₀] using hσ₂
      have hφ_im0 : (φ x₀).im = 0 := by
        have hc := congrArg Complex.im (hφ_conj x₀ hx₀)
        simp only [x₀, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_im] at hc
        linarith
      have hz_sub : z - x₀ = ((z.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        dsimp [x₀]
        calc z - (z.re : ℂ) = ((z.re : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (z.re : ℂ) := by
              rw [Complex.re_add_im]
          _ = (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by ring
      have hnorm_sub : ‖z - x₀‖ = |z.im| := by
        rw [hz_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
      have him_le : |(φ z).im| ≤ 2 * δ_e * |z.im| := by
        calc |(φ z).im| = |(φ z - φ x₀).im| := by simp [hφ_im0]
          _ ≤ ‖φ z - φ x₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ ≤ 2 * δ_e * ‖z - x₀‖ := hφ_lip z hz x₀ hx₀
          _ = 2 * δ_e * |z.im| := by rw [hnorm_sub]
      change |(z - (ρ : ℂ) + φ z).im| < σ₁
      have him_tot : (z - (ρ : ℂ) + φ z).im = z.im + (φ z).im := by simp
      rw [him_tot]
      calc |z.im + (φ z).im| ≤ |z.im| + |(φ z).im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |z.im| + 2 * δ_e * |z.im| := by linarith
        _ = (1 + 2 * δ_e) * |z.im| := by ring
        _ < (1 + 2 * δ_e) * σ₂ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz (by linarith)
        _ ≤ σ₁ := hwidth
    have hSeqProps : ∀ n : ℕ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (shciPicardSeq ρ e n) (horizStrip σ₂) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
          shciPicardSeq ρ e n (z + 2 * Real.pi) = shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
          shciPicardSeq ρ e n (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ‖shciPicardSeq ρ e n z‖ ≤ δ_e) ∧
        (∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
          ‖shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁ - shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂‖ ≤ 2 * δ_e * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨differentiableOn_const 0, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => by simp [shciPicardSeq],
          fun _ _ => by simpa [shciPicardSeq] using hδ0,
          fun z₁ _ z₂ _ => by
            simpa [shciPicardSeq] using
              mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * δ_e) (norm_nonneg (z₁ - z₂))⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨ih_holo, ih_per, ih_conj, _, ih_lip⟩ := ih
        have hfn_maps := hVertMaps (shciPicardSeq ρ e n) ih_conj ih_lip
        have hfn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun z => z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) (horizStrip σ₂) :=
          (differentiableOn_id.sub (differentiableOn_const (ρ : ℂ))).add ih_holo
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (he_holo.comp hfn_holo (fun _ hz => hfn_maps _ hz)).neg
        · intro z hz
          have hz2 : z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hStripShift2Pi hz
          simp only [shciPicardSeq, ih_per z hz]
          have hsh : (z + 2 * Real.pi) - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z =
              (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
          rw [hsh, he_per _ (hfn_maps z hz)]
        · intro z hz
          have hzc : starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂ := hStripConj hz
          simp only [shciPicardSeq, ih_conj z hz]
          have hcj : starRingEnd ℂ z - (ρ : ℂ) + starRingEnd ℂ (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) =
              starRingEnd ℂ (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) := by
            simp [map_add, map_sub]
          rw [hcj, he_conj _ (hfn_maps z hz), map_neg]
        · intro z hz
          simp only [shciPicardSeq, norm_neg]
          exact he_c0 _ (hfn_maps z hz)
        · intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
          simp only [shciPicardSeq, neg_sub_neg]
          rw [norm_sub_rev]
          have h1 := he_lip _ (hfn_maps z₁ hz₁) _ (hfn_maps z₂ hz₂)
          have h2 : ‖(z₁ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁) -
              (z₂ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
            have hrew : (z₁ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁) -
                (z₂ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂) =
                (z₁ - z₂) + (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁ - shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂) := by ring
            rw [hrew]
            calc ‖(z₁ - z₂) + (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁ - shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂)‖
                ≤ ‖z₁ - z₂‖ + ‖shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁ - shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂‖ :=
                  norm_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ ‖z₁ - z₂‖ + 2 * δ_e * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
                  linarith [ih_lip z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂]
              _ ≤ 2 * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z₁ - z₂)]
          calc ‖e (z₁ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁) -
                e (z₂ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂)‖
              ≤ δ_e * ‖(z₁ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₁) -
                  (z₂ - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z₂)‖ := h1
            _ ≤ δ_e * (2 * ‖z₁ - z₂‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hδ0
            _ = 2 * δ_e * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by ring
    have hSeqStep : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        dist (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) (shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z) ≤
          δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro z hz
        simpa [shciPicardSeq, dist_zero_left] using (hSeqProps 1).2.2.2.1 z hz
      | succ n ih =>
        intro z hz
        have hfn_maps := hVertMaps (shciPicardSeq ρ e n) (hSeqProps n).2.2.1 (hSeqProps n).2.2.2.2
        have hfn1_maps := hVertMaps (shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1))
          (hSeqProps (n + 1)).2.2.1 (hSeqProps (n + 1)).2.2.2.2
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        simp only [shciPicardSeq, neg_sub_neg]
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
        have h1 := he_lip _ (hfn_maps z hz) _ (hfn1_maps z hz)
        have hsub : (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) -
            (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z) =
            shciPicardSeq ρ e n z - shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z := by ring
        rw [hsub] at h1
        calc ‖e (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) -
              e (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z)‖
            ≤ δ_e * ‖shciPicardSeq ρ e n z - shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z‖ := h1
          _ = δ_e * dist (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) (shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z) := by
              rw [dist_eq_norm]
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul (by linarith) (ih z hz) dist_nonneg (by norm_num)
          _ = δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)
    have hTendsto : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) Filter.atTop (nhds (ψ z)) :=
      fun z hz =>
        (cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2) δ_e (by norm_num) (fun n => hSeqStep n z hz)).tendsto_limUnder
    have hDistLim : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        dist (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) (ψ z) ≤ 2 * δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n z hz
      have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2) δ_e (by norm_num)
        (fun k => hSeqStep k z hz) (hTendsto z hz) n
      calc dist (shciPicardSeq ρ e n z) (ψ z)
          ≤ δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2) := hd
        _ = 2 * δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
    have hUnif : TendstoUniformlyOn (shciPicardSeq ρ e) ψ Filter.atTop (horizStrip σ₂) := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hHalf0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
          (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
      have hGeom0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * δ_e * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hHalf0
      filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hGeom0).2 ε hε] with n hn z hz
      rw [dist_comm]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hDistLim n z hz) hn
    have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (horizStrip σ₂) :=
      (hUnif.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn).differentiableOn
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hSeqProps n).1) hU₂
    have hψ_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ψ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ψ z := by
      intro z hz
      have ht1 := hTendsto (z + 2 * Real.pi) (hStripShift2Pi hz)
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n (z + 2 * Real.pi))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (ψ z)) :=
        (hTendsto z hz).congr (fun n => ((hSeqProps n).2.1 z hz).symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
    have hψ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ψ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (ψ z) := by
      intro z hz
      have ht1 := hTendsto (starRingEnd ℂ z) (hStripConj hz)
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n (starRingEnd ℂ z))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (starRingEnd ℂ (ψ z))) :=
        ((Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto).comp (hTendsto z hz)).congr
          (fun n => ((hSeqProps n).2.2.1 z hz).symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht1 ht2
    have hψ_lip : ∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip σ₂, ∀ z₂ ∈ horizStrip σ₂,
        ‖ψ z₁ - ψ z₂‖ ≤ 2 * δ_e * ‖z₁ - z₂‖ := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
      exact le_of_tendsto
        (continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ((hTendsto z₁ hz₁).sub (hTendsto z₂ hz₂)))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hSeqProps n).2.2.2.2 z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂)
    let x_inv := shciShiftInv ρ e
    have hx_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ x_inv (horizStrip σ₂) :=
      (differentiableOn_id.sub (differentiableOn_const (ρ : ℂ))).add hψ_holo
    have hx_maps : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z ∈ horizStrip σ₁ :=
      hVertMaps ψ hψ_conj hψ_lip
    have hx_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv z) = z := by
      intro z hz
      have ht_shift : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e (n + 1) z)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (ψ z)) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr (hTendsto z hz)
      have ht_arg : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (x_inv z)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.add (hTendsto z hz)
      have he_cont : ContinuousAt e (x_inv z) :=
        he_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU₁.mem_nhds (hx_maps z hz))
      have ht_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => -e (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (-e (x_inv z))) :=
        (he_cont.tendsto.comp ht_arg).neg
      have hψ_fix : ψ z = -e (x_inv z) := tendsto_nhds_unique ht_shift ht_rhs
      dsimp [x_inv, shciShiftInv]
      change z - (ρ : ℂ) + ψ z + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv z) = z
      rw [hψ_fix]
      ring
    have hx_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv (z + 2 * Real.pi) = x_inv z + 2 * Real.pi := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp [x_inv, shciShiftInv]
      change (z + 2 * Real.pi) - (ρ : ℂ) + ψ (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        (z - (ρ : ℂ) + ψ z) + 2 * Real.pi
      rw [hψ_per z hz]
      ring
    
    have hg_mono : Function.Injective g_ℝ := by
      have hg_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv g_ℝ x := by
        intro x
        have hx_mem : (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ₁ := by
          change |(x : ℂ).im| < σ₁; simpa using hσ₁
        have hd_F : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ + (ρ : ℂ) + e ζ)
            (1 + deriv e (x : ℂ)) (x : ℂ) :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id (x : ℂ)).add_const (ρ : ℂ)).add
            (he_holo.differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hx_mem)).hasDerivAt
        have hd_re0 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ((u : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) + e (u : ℂ)).re)
            ((1 + deriv e (x : ℂ)).re) x :=
          Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x hd_F.comp_ofReal
        have hd_re1 : HasDerivAt g_ℝ ((1 + deriv e (x : ℂ)).re) x := by
          simpa [he_real] using hd_re0

  have hLinCombBnd : ∀ {σ' : ℝ} {q : ℕ} {A : ℝ} {u Δu m_fn : ℂ → ℂ} (c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℝ),

      (∀ k ≤ m + 2, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k Δu z‖ ≤ S.R_mesh * A) →
      (∀ k ≤ m + 2, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k m_fn z‖ ≤ S.R_mesh * A) →

    have hU := hStripOpen σ'

    have hq2_le_q3 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    have hcu : ContDiffAt ℂ r u z := hContDiffAt r hU hu hz
    have hcΔ : ContDiffAt ℂ r Δu z := hContDiffAt r hU hΔ hz
    have hcm : ContDiffAt ℂ r m_fn z := hContDiffAt r hU hm hz

    have hc1Δ : ContDiffAt ℂ r (fun ζ => (c₁ : ℂ) * Δu ζ) z := hcΔ.const_smul (c₁ : ℂ)
    have hc2m : ContDiffAt ℂ r (fun ζ => (c₂ : ℂ) * m_fn ζ) z := hcm.const_smul (c₂ : ℂ)

      iteratedDeriv_const_mul (c₂ : ℂ) hcm]
    have hΔ_q2 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv r Δu z‖ ≤ S.R_mesh * A :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq2_le_q3 (norm_nonneg _)) (bΔ r hr z hz)
    have htri : ‖(c₀ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r u z + (c₁ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r Δu z +

        ‖iteratedDeriv r u z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv r Δu z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv r m_fn z‖ := by
      calc ‖(c₀ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r u z + (c₁ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r Δu z +
              (c₂ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r m_fn z‖
          ≤ ‖(c₀ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r u z + (c₁ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r Δu z‖ +
            ‖(c₂ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r m_fn z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖(c₀ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r u z‖ + ‖(c₁ : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r Δu z‖ +

        _ = |c₀| * ‖iteratedDeriv r u z‖ + |c₁| * ‖iteratedDeriv r Δu z‖ +

            1 * ‖iteratedDeriv r m_fn z‖ := by
            gcongr

    have hscaled : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *

      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htri (le_of_lt hq2_pos)
      have hbu := bu r hr z hz

  · intro σ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂
      hσ hq hKinv_lt hAdm₁ hAdm₂ j hj α hα k hk z hz
    obtain ⟨_, hq2_pos, hKm_lt1, hσm_pos, hσi_pos, hδ0, hδ_le, _⟩ :=
      hScaleProps hσ hq hKinv_lt
    have hNm_le_q : S.N_mesh ≤ q := le_trans hN_le hq
    obtain ⟨hw₁, hW₁, hMesh₁, hInv₁⟩ := hAdm₁
    obtain ⟨hw₂, hW₂, hMesh₂, hInv₂⟩ := hAdm₂
    obtain ⟨hm₁, hp₁⟩ :=
      (hMeshPerturbSingle hσ hNm_le_q hKm_lt1 hMesh₁ j hj).1 α hα
    obtain ⟨hm₂, hp₂⟩ :=
      (hMeshPerturbSingle hσ hNm_le_q hKm_lt1 hMesh₂ j hj).1 α hα
    have hLipPert :=
      hMeshPerturbLip hσ hNm_le_q hKm_lt1 hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ hMesh₁ hMesh₂ j hj α hα
    obtain ⟨hxm₁_holo, hxp₁_holo, hmaps₁, hfwd₁, _, _, _⟩ := (hInv₁ j hj).1 α hα
    obtain ⟨hxm₂_holo, hxp₂_holo, hmaps₂, hfwd₂, _, _, _⟩ := (hInv₂ j hj).1 α hα
    let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    let σ_inv := (1 - K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    let δ_e := 3 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    let Δ_W := stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂
    have hΔW_pos : 0 ≤ Δ_W := hSupNonneg σ W₁ W₂
    have hRightM₁ : IsShciShiftRightInv σ_mesh σ_inv (shciShiftMinus q j α)
        (shciPerturbMinus q X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ j α) (xInvMinus₁ j α) :=
      ⟨hxm₁_holo, fun ζ hζ => (hmaps₁ ζ hζ).1, fun ζ hζ => by
        have h := (hfwd₁ ζ hζ).1
        dsimp [shciPerturbMinus]
        linear_combination h⟩
    have hRightM₂ : IsShciShiftRightInv σ_mesh σ_inv (shciShiftMinus q j α)
        (shciPerturbMinus q X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ j α) (xInvMinus₂ j α) :=
      ⟨hxm₂_holo, fun ζ hζ => (hmaps₂ ζ hζ).1, fun ζ hζ => by
        have h := (hfwd₂ ζ hζ).1
        dsimp [shciPerturbMinus]
        linear_combination h⟩
    have hRightP₁ : IsShciShiftRightInv σ_mesh σ_inv (shciShiftPlus q j α)
        (shciPerturbPlus q X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ j α) (xInvPlus₁ j α) :=
      ⟨hxp₁_holo, fun ζ hζ => (hmaps₁ ζ hζ).2, fun ζ hζ => by
        have h := (hfwd₁ ζ hζ).2
        dsimp [shciPerturbPlus]
        linear_combination h⟩
    have hRightP₂ : IsShciShiftRightInv σ_mesh σ_inv (shciShiftPlus q j α)
        (shciPerturbPlus q X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ j α) (xInvPlus₂ j α) :=
      ⟨hxp₂_holo, fun ζ hζ => (hmaps₂ ζ hζ).2, fun ζ hζ => by
        have h := (hfwd₂ ζ hζ).2
        dsimp [shciPerturbPlus]
        linear_combination h⟩
    have hLk_le : shciJetL k ≤ max (shciJetB (m + 1)) (shciJetL (m + 1)) :=
      le_trans (hJetLMono hk) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hq2_cancel : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shciJetL k * (0 + δ_e * Δ_W)) =
        (3 * S.R_mesh * shciJetL k) * Δ_W := by
      dsimp [δ_e]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hq2_pos]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hb := hJetDiff (m + 1) hσm_pos hσi_pos hδ0 hδ_le (mul_nonneg hδ0 hΔW_pos)
        hm₁.1 hm₂.1
        (fun r hr ζ hζ => ⟨hm₁.2.2.2.2 r hr ζ hζ, hm₂.2.2.2.2 r hr ζ hζ⟩)
        (fun r hr ζ hζ => (hLipPert r hr ζ hζ).1)
        hRightM₁ hRightM₂ k hk z hz
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero] at hb
      calc (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvMinus₁ j α ζ - xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) z‖
          ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shciJetL k * (0 + δ_e * Δ_W)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (le_of_lt hq2_pos)
        _ = (3 * S.R_mesh * shciJetL k) * Δ_W := hq2_cancel
        _ ≤ (3 * S.R_mesh * max (shciJetB (m + 1)) (shciJetL (m + 1))) * Δ_W :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLk_le (by linarith)) hΔW_pos
        _ ≤ C_inv * Δ_W :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C_inv]; linarith) hΔW_pos
    · have hb := hJetDiff (m + 1) hσm_pos hσi_pos hδ0 hδ_le (mul_nonneg hδ0 hΔW_pos)
        hp₁.1 hp₂.1
        (fun r hr ζ hζ => ⟨hp₁.2.2.2.2 r hr ζ hζ, hp₂.2.2.2.2 r hr ζ hζ⟩)
        (fun r hr ζ hζ => (hLipPert r hr ζ hζ).2)
        hRightP₁ hRightP₂ k hk z hz
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero] at hb
      calc (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => xInvPlus₁ j α ζ - xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) z‖
          ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (shciJetL k * (0 + δ_e * Δ_W)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (le_of_lt hq2_pos)
        _ = (3 * S.R_mesh * shciJetL k) * Δ_W := hq2_cancel
        _ ≤ (3 * S.R_mesh * max (shciJetB (m + 1)) (shciJetL (m + 1))) * Δ_W :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLk_le (by linarith)) hΔW_pos
        _ ≤ C_inv * Δ_W :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C_inv]; linarith) hΔW_pos

strip_half_cell_inv_system.definitions:
noncomputable def shciShiftMinus (q j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((j : ℝ) + α / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def shciShiftPlus (q j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((j : ℝ) + (1 + α) / 2) * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def shciPerturbMinus (q : ℕ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (X_ℂ j ζ + (α : ℂ) * (μ_ℂ j ζ - X_ℂ j ζ)) - (ζ + (shciShiftMinus q j α : ℂ))

noncomputable def shciPerturbPlus (q : ℕ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
    (j : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (ζ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (μ_ℂ j ζ + (α : ℂ) * (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - μ_ℂ j ζ)) - (ζ + (shciShiftPlus q j α : ℂ))

def IsShciShiftPerturb (r_max : ℕ) (σ₁ δ_e ρ : ℝ) (g_ℝ : ℝ → ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ e (horizStrip σ₁) ∧
  (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, e (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = e ζ) ∧
  (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, e (starRingEnd ℂ ζ) = starRingEnd ℂ (e ζ)) ∧
  (∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) + e x = (g_ℝ x : ℂ)) ∧
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ r_max → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ₁, ‖iteratedDeriv r e ζ‖ ≤ δ_e)

def IsShciShiftRightInv (σ₁ σ₂ ρ : ℝ) (e x_inv : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ x_inv (horizStrip σ₂) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z ∈ horizStrip σ₁) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ₂, x_inv z + (ρ : ℂ) + e (x_inv z) = z)

noncomputable def shciPicardSeq (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, z => -e (z - (ρ : ℂ) + shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)

noncomputable def shciShiftInv (ρ : ℝ) (e : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  z - (ρ : ℂ) + Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => shciPicardSeq ρ e n z)

noncomputable def shciInvOneAdd (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 + w)⁻¹

noncomputable def shciCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | s + 1, B => (2 : ℝ) ^ s * B * shciCompConst s B

noncomputable def shciCompDiffConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | s + 1, B => (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (B * shciCompDiffConst s B + shciCompConst s B)

noncomputable def shciJetB : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 2
  | k + 1 =>
      let B := shciJetB k
      let G := shciCompConst k B
      max B ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) * G * shciCompConst k G)

noncomputable def shciJetL : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 2
  | k + 1 =>
      let B := shciJetB k
      let G := shciCompConst k B
      let L := shciJetL k
      let D := L * shciCompDiffConst k B + shciCompConst k B
      max L ((((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2)) * D * shciCompDiffConst k G)

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) :
    Nonempty (StripKernelSystem m M S H_inv)

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCalc : SkrCalcToolkit := strip_ker_calc_toolkit
  have hPt : SkrPointwiseProp := pointwise_kernel_identities_and_factorization
  obtain ⟨H_step⟩ := strip_half_step_comp_system m M hm hM S H_inv hCalc
  obtain ⟨R_ker⟩ :=
    reduced_kernel_asymptotics_and_lipschitz m M H_step.C_step hm hM H_step.C_step_pos hCalc hPt
  let C_ker : ℝ := max H_step.C_step (R_ker.C_red * (1 + H_step.C_step))
  let N_ker : ℕ := max H_step.N_step R_ker.N_red
  have hCs_le : H_step.C_step ≤ C_ker := le_max_left _ _
  have hCr_lip_le : R_ker.C_red * (1 + H_step.C_step) ≤ C_ker := le_max_right _ _
  have hCr_le : R_ker.C_red ≤ C_ker := by
    have h1 : R_ker.C_red ≤ R_ker.C_red * (1 + H_step.C_step) := by
      nlinarith [R_ker.C_red_pos, H_step.C_step_pos]
    exact le_trans h1 hCr_lip_le
  refine ⟨{
    C_ker := C_ker
    N_ker := N_ker
    C_ker_pos := lt_max_of_lt_left H_step.C_step_pos
    N_inv_le := le_trans H_step.N_inv_le (le_max_left _ _)
    real_eq := ?_
    diag_periodic := ?_
    composed_props := ?_
    composed_lip := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro σ w W hσ hw hW X Y z
    have hw_cd1 : ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) w :=
      hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    exact hPt.real_eq σ w W hσ.1 hw_cd1 hW.1 hW.2.1 X Y z
  · intro σ w W hσ hW X Y μ z hX hY hμ hz
    exact hPt.diag_periodic σ W hσ.1 hW.2.2.1 X Y μ z hX hY hμ hz
  · intro σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus hσ hq hKinv_lt hAdm
    dsimp only
    intro j hj
    let σ_inv : ℝ := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    have hKinv_pos : 0 < H_inv.K_inv := lt_trans S.K_mesh_pos H_inv.K_mesh_lt
    have hKinv_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      div_nonneg (le_of_lt hKinv_pos) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hσ_inv_pos : 0 < σ_inv := mul_pos (by linarith) hσ.1
    have hσ_inv_le : σ_inv ≤ σ := by
      dsimp [σ_inv]
      nlinarith [hσ.1]
    have hOpen_inv : IsOpen (horizStrip σ_inv) :=
      (hCalc.horizStrip_open_convex σ_inv).1
    have hq_step : H_step.N_step ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hq
    have hq_red : R_ker.N_red ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hq
    obtain ⟨hStep_α, hStep_cont⟩ :=
      H_step.step_props σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus hσ hq_step hKinv_lt hAdm j hj
    let h_m_fam : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
      μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
    let h_p_fam : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
      X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
    have hMinusStepBnd : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => h_m_fam α ζ - (((1 : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
            H_step.C_step := by
      intro α hα k hk z hz
      have hfn :
          (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m_fam α ζ - (((1 : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            (fun ζ : ℂ => h_m_fam α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        ext ζ
        simp [one_mul]
      rw [hfn]
      exact ((hStep_α α hα).2.2.2 k hk z hz).1
    have hPlusStepBnd : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => -h_p_fam α ζ - (((-1 : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
            H_step.C_step := by
      intro α hα k hk z hz
      have hfn :
          (fun ζ : ℂ => -h_p_fam α ζ - (((-1 : ℝ) * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
            (fun ζ : ℂ => -(h_p_fam α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
        ext ζ
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hfn, iteratedDeriv_fun_neg, norm_neg]
      exact ((hStep_α α hα).2.2.2 k hk z hz).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro α hα
      obtain ⟨hhm_holo, hhp_holo, hEnd, hStep_bnd⟩ := hStep_α α hα
      have hRed_m :=
        R_ker.reduced_props σ σ_inv 1 α q w W (h_m_fam α)
          hσ hσ_inv_pos hσ_inv_le hq_red (Or.inl rfl) hAdm.1 hAdm.2.1 hα hhm_holo
          (fun ζ hζ => by
            have hE := hEnd ζ hζ
            rw [← hE.2.1, ← hE.2.2.1]
            exact ⟨hE.2.2.2.2.2.1, hE.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩)
          (hMinusStepBnd α hα)
      have h1α : 1 - α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hα.2], by linarith [hα.1]⟩
      have hRed_p :=
        R_ker.reduced_props σ σ_inv (-1) (1 - α) q w W (fun ζ => -h_p_fam α ζ)
          hσ hσ_inv_pos hσ_inv_le hq_red (Or.inr rfl) hAdm.1 hAdm.2.1 h1α hhp_holo.neg
          (fun ζ hζ => by
            have hE := hEnd ζ hζ
            have hsub : (1 : ℝ) - (1 - α) = α := by ring
            rw [hsub, ← hE.2.2.2.1, ← hE.2.2.2.2.1]
            exact ⟨hE.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hE.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩)
          (hPlusStepBnd α hα)
      have hEq_m :
          Set.EqOn
            (fun ζ => cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ)
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - (α : ℂ) * h_m_fam α ζ)
                (ζ + ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * h_m_fam α ζ) ζ)
            (horizStrip σ_inv) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        dsimp only
        have hE := hEnd ζ hζ
        rw [hE.2.1, hE.2.2.1]
      have hEq_p :
          Set.EqOn
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ)
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p_fam α ζ))
                (ζ + ((1 - (1 - α) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p_fam α ζ)) ζ)
            (horizStrip σ_inv) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        dsimp only
        have hE := hEnd ζ hζ
        have hsub : (1 : ℝ) - (1 - α) = α := by ring
        rw [hPt.plus_eq_minus, hsub, hE.2.2.2.1, hE.2.2.2.2.1]
      refine ⟨hRed_m.1.congr hEq_m, hRed_p.1.congr hEq_p, hhm_holo, hhp_holo, ?_⟩
      intro k hk z hz
      let c_m : ℂ := (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * α ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      let c_p : ℂ :=
        (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - α) ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hEq_m_sub :
          Set.EqOn
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)) ζ - c_m)
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - (α : ℂ) * h_m_fam α ζ)
                (ζ + ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * h_m_fam α ζ) ζ - c_m)
            (horizStrip σ_inv) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        exact congrArg (· - c_m) (hEq_m hζ)
      have hEq_p_sub :
          Set.EqOn
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelPlus_ℂ W
                (X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)) ζ - c_p)
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p_fam α ζ))
                (ζ + ((1 - (1 - α) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p_fam α ζ)) ζ - c_p)
            (horizStrip σ_inv) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        exact congrArg (· - c_p) (hEq_p hζ)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, le_trans (hStep_bnd k hk z hz).1 hCs_le,
        le_trans (hStep_bnd k hk z hz).2 hCs_le⟩
      · rw [(hEq_m_sub.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen_inv.mem_nhds hz)).iteratedDeriv_eq k]
        exact le_trans (hRed_m.2 k hk z hz) hCr_le
      · rw [(hEq_p_sub.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen_inv.mem_nhds hz)).iteratedDeriv_eq k]
        exact le_trans (hRed_p.2 k hk z hz) hCr_le
    · intro k hk z hz
      have hCont_m_red :=
        R_ker.reduced_param_cont σ σ_inv 1 q w W (fun α => α) h_m_fam
          hσ hσ_inv_pos hσ_inv_le hq_red (Or.inl rfl) hAdm.1 hAdm.2.1 continuousOn_id
          (fun α hα => by
            obtain ⟨hhm_holo, _, hEnd, _⟩ := hStep_α α hα
            refine ⟨hα, hhm_holo, ?_, hMinusStepBnd α hα⟩
            intro ζ hζ
            have hE := hEnd ζ hζ
            rw [← hE.2.1, ← hE.2.2.1]
            exact ⟨hE.2.2.2.2.2.1, hE.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩)
          (fun r hr w' hw' => (hStep_cont r hr w' hw').1)
          k hk z hz
      have hCont_p_red :=
        R_ker.reduced_param_cont σ σ_inv (-1) q w W (fun α => 1 - α)
          (fun α ζ => -h_p_fam α ζ)
          hσ hσ_inv_pos hσ_inv_le hq_red (Or.inr rfl) hAdm.1 hAdm.2.1
          (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id)
          (fun α hα => by
            obtain ⟨_, hhp_holo, hEnd, _⟩ := hStep_α α hα
            refine ⟨⟨by linarith [hα.2], by linarith [hα.1]⟩, hhp_holo.neg, ?_,
              hPlusStepBnd α hα⟩
            intro ζ hζ
            have hE := hEnd ζ hζ

strip_cell_kernel_system.definitions:
noncomputable def skrCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrExp1 (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * v)

noncomputable def skrSlopeW (W : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) (H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv W (z + ((η * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def skrKerRem1 (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let rI₁ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z ((θ - 1) * τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₁ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₁
  let u₁ : ℂ := (τ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₁
  (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
    (2 * H * (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * W z) * I₁ ^ 4 * skrRCos2 u₁ +
      (I₁ + 1) * rI₁)

noncomputable def skrKerRem2Integrand (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ β : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let γ : ℝ := τ + β * (1 - τ)
  let rI₂ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z (θ * γ - τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₂
  let u₂ : ℂ := (γ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂
  let rs : ℂ := ((γ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂) ^ 2 * skrRSinc u₂
  let S₂ : ℂ := 1 + H ^ 2 * rs
  let sw_b : ℂ := -2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H
  let rE₂ : ℂ := sw_b * skrExp1 (H * sw_b)
  let E₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rE₂
  (γ : ℂ) * (rI₂ * S₂ * E₂ + H * rs * E₂ + rE₂)

noncomputable def skrKerRem (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  skrKerRem1 W τ H z -
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z

noncomputable def skrCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * skrCompConst p B)

def IsSkrStripBnd (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B

structure SkrCalcToolkit : Prop where

  bnd_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},

    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (B₁ + B₂) (fun z => f z - g z)
  bnd_neg : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (fun z => -f z)
  bnd_const_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} (c : ℂ) {f : ℂ → ℂ},
    0 ≤ B → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (‖c‖ * B) (fun z => c * f z)
  bnd_mul : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₁ f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B₂ g →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun z => f z * g z)
  bnd_mul_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f M_g Δf Δg : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' M_g g₂ →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * Δg + Δf * M_g))
      (fun z => f₁ z * g₁ z - f₂ z * g₂ z)
  exp_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.exp (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  cos_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →

    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.cos w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  sin_ball_bnd : ∀ (R : ℝ),
    0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Complex.sin (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖iteratedDeriv j Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp R
  comp_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G B : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G f : ℂ → ℂ),
