    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f z ∈ V) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f z‖ ≤ B) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (M_G * skrCompConst p B) (fun z => G (f z))
  comp_diff_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G ΔG B Δf : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G₁ G₂ f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    Convex ℝ V →
    0 ≤ M_G →
    0 ≤ ΔG →
    0 ≤ B →
    0 ≤ Δf →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ V →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ V →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) w‖ ≤ ΔG) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G₂ w‖ ≤ M_G) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ') →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₁ z ∈ V) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₂ z ∈ V) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ ≤ B) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ ≤ B) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (skrCompConst p B * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_G * Δf))
      (fun z => G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₂ z))
  comp_param_cont : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    0 < σ' →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (f α) (horizStrip σ') ∧ ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f α z ∈ V) →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (f α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => G (f α ζ)) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  param_int_bnd : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ' →
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ContinuousOn (fun t => F t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (F t)) →
    IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      iteratedDeriv k (fun w => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t w) z =
        (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv k (F t) z) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => iteratedDeriv k (F t) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  param_int_cont : ∀ (B : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
    0 ≤ B →
    (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (g u) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContinuousOn (fun u => g u t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖g u t‖ ≤ B) →
    ContinuousOn (fun u => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g u t) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)

structure SkrPointwiseProp : Prop where
  plus_eq_minus : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ),
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z = cellKernelMinus_ℂ W Y μ z
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x) →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (z + 2 * Real.pi) = W z) →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  factor_eq : ∀ (σ τ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (H z : ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    z ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (z - (τ : ℂ) * H) (z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) z =
      (((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 + H ^ 3 * skrKerRem W τ H z

structure SkrHalfStepSystem (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S) where
  C_step : ℝ
  N_step : ℕ
  C_step_pos : 0 < C_step
  N_inv_le : H_inv.N_inv ≤ N_step
  step_props : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_step ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w W
      X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      let h_m : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
        μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) - X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ)
      let h_p : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun α ζ =>
        X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) - μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ)
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_m α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_p α) (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
        (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) = ζ - (α : ℂ) * h_m α ζ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) = ζ + ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * h_m α ζ ∧
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) = ζ - ((1 - α : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-h_p α ζ) ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ) = ζ + (α : ℂ) * (-h_p α ζ) ∧
          X_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvMinus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          X_ℂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
          μ_ℂ j (xInvPlus j α ζ) ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_m α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
              C_step ∧
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_p α ζ - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
              C_step)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (h_m α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (h_p α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  step_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
      (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_step ≤ q →
    H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₁ W₁
      X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₂ W₂
      X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    ∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      let h_m₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)
      let h_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)
      let h_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
        X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_m₁ ζ - h_m₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_step * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ ∧
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => h_p₁ ζ - h_p₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
          C_step * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂

structure SkrReducedKernelSystem (m : ℕ) (M B_H : ℝ) where
  C_red : ℝ
  N_red : ℕ
  C_red_pos : 0 < C_red
  N_red_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_red
  reduced_props : ∀ (σ σ' sgn τ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W H : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ => H ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H) →
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ζ) ζ
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ') ∧
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ =>
            G ζ -
              (((Real.pi ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ C_red
  reduced_param_cont : ∀ (σ σ' sgn : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
      (τ_fn : ℝ → ℝ) (H_fam : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
    ContinuousOn τ_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      τ_fn α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_fam α) (horizStrip σ') ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ζ - (τ_fn α : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
        ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ => H_fam α ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H)) →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv r (H_fam α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ContinuousOn
        (fun α : ℝ =>
          iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ =>
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W
                (ζ - (τ_fn α : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ)
                (ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ) ζ) z)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
  reduced_lip : ∀ (σ σ' sgn τ ΔH_scaled : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
      (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ H₁ H₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    0 < σ' →
    σ' ≤ σ →
    N_red ≤ q →
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
    0 ≤ ΔH_scaled →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₂ W₂ →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H₁ (horizStrip σ') →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H₂ (horizStrip σ') →
    (∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ',
      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₁ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₁ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₂ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₂ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ => H₁ ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H ∧
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ => H₂ ζ - ((sgn * (Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ B_H) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ ΔH_scaled) →
    let G₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₁ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) ζ
    let G₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₂ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) ζ
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
        C_red * (ΔH_scaled + stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def skrCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRCos2 (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrRSinc (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u)

noncomputable def skrExp1 (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * v)

noncomputable def skrSlopeW (W : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) (H : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * ∫ η in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv W (z + ((η * c : ℝ) : ℂ) * H)

noncomputable def skrKerRem1 (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let rI₁ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z ((θ - 1) * τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₁ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₁
  let u₁ : ℂ := (τ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₁
  (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
    (2 * H * (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * W z) * I₁ ^ 4 * skrRCos2 u₁ +
      (I₁ + 1) * rI₁)

noncomputable def skrKerRem2Integrand (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ β : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let γ : ℝ := τ + β * (1 - τ)
  let rI₂ : ℂ :=
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      let sw := skrSlopeW W z (θ * γ - τ) H
      sw * skrExp1 (H * sw)
  let I₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₂
  let u₂ : ℂ := (γ : ℂ) * H * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂
  let rs : ℂ := ((γ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (W z) * I₂) ^ 2 * skrRSinc u₂
  let S₂ : ℂ := 1 + H ^ 2 * rs
  let sw_b : ℂ := -2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H
  let rE₂ : ℂ := sw_b * skrExp1 (H * sw_b)
  let E₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rE₂
  (γ : ℂ) * (rI₂ * S₂ * E₂ + H * rs * E₂ + rE₂)

noncomputable def skrKerRem (W : ℂ → ℂ) (τ : ℝ) (H z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  skrKerRem1 W τ H z -
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z

noncomputable def skrCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | p + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * skrCompConst p B)

def IsSkrStripBnd (p : ℕ) (σ' B : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv k f z‖ ≤ B

structure SkrCalcToolkit : Prop where
  horizStrip_open_convex : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) ∧ Convex ℝ (horizStrip H)
  mem_horizStrip_of_tau_seg : ∀ (σ τ c : ℝ) (z H : ℂ),
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) →
    z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + (c : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ
  stripExt_deriv_props : ∀ (r₀ d : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w W →
    d ≤ r₀ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv d W) (horizStrip σ) ∧
    ∀ j : ℕ, j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d W) ζ‖ ≤ M₁
  stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le : ∀ (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M₁ : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt r₀ σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    0 ≤ stripDiffSup r₀ σ W₁ W₂ ∧
    ∀ (j d : ℕ), j + d ≤ r₀ → ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,

structure SkrPointwiseProp : Prop where
  plus_eq_minus : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ),
    cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z = cellKernelMinus_ℂ W Y μ z
  real_eq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x) →
    ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z
  diag_periodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (z + 2 * Real.pi) = W z) →
    ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
      X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
      cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z
  factor_eq : ∀ (σ τ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (H z : ℂ),
    0 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
    τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    z ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
    cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (z - (τ : ℂ) * H) (z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) z =
      (((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 + H ^ 3 * skrKerRem W τ H z

    IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ q w₂ W₂
      X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
    let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ

(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S)
    (H_ker : StripKernelSystem m M S H_inv) :
    ∃ (C_mult : ℝ) (N_mult : ℕ), 0 < C_mult ∧ H_ker.N_ker ≤ N_mult ∧
      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (n : ℤ), σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 → (N_mult : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
        let σ_inv := (1 - H_inv.K_inv / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ)
          (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (xInvMinus xInvPlus : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
          IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ n.natAbs w W
            X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus →
          let B := stripB_canon n W X_ℂ μ_ℂ xInvMinus xInvPlus
          DifferentiableOn ℂ B (horizStrip σ_inv) ∧
          (∀ x : ℝ, B x = globalB_mult n w x) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv, B (z + 2 * Real.pi) = B z) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => B ζ - 1) z‖ ≤ C_mult / |(n : ℝ)|)) ∧
        (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
          (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ)
          (xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
          IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ n.natAbs w₁ W₁
            X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ →
          IsAdmissibleStripInvTuple m M S H_inv.K_inv H_inv.C_inv σ n.natAbs w₂ W₂
            X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                stripB_canon n W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ ζ -
                  stripB_canon n W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
              (C_mult / |(n : ℝ)|) * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hM
  
  
  
  have hOpenStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const

  have hHoloSum : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} (s : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ j ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F j) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ s, F j ζ) U := fun s F hF =>
    (DifferentiableOn.sum hF).congr (fun _ _ => by simp only [Finset.sum_apply])

  have hIterSum : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ j ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F j) U) →
        ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ s, F j ζ) z =
          ∑ j ∈ s, iteratedDeriv k (F j) z := by
    intro U hU z hz s F hF k
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hFa : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (F a) z :=
        ((hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
      have hFs : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ s, F j ζ) z :=
        ContDiffAt.sum fun j hj =>
          ((hF j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)).contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
      have hEq : (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ insert a s, F j ζ) =
          (fun ζ => F a ζ + ∑ j ∈ s, F j ζ) := by
        ext ζ; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hFa hFs,
        ih (fun j hj => hF j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)), Finset.sum_insert ha]

  have hValAndConstBnd : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {F : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {M₀ δ : ℝ},
        ‖c‖ ≤ M₀ → 0 ≤ δ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F ζ - c) z‖ ≤ δ) →
        ∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i F z‖ ≤ M₀ + δ ∧
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun _ : ℂ => c) z‖ ≤ M₀ + δ := by
    intro U hU z hz k F c M₀ δ hcM hδ hF hFB i hi
    have hM₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ M₀ := le_trans (norm_nonneg c) hcM
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases i with _ | i
      · simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        have h0 := hFB 0 (Nat.zero_le k)
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
        have heq : F z = (F z - c) + c := by ring
        rw [heq]
        exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
      · have hFc : ContDiffAt ℂ ((i + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => F ζ - c) z :=
          ((hF.sub (differentiableOn_const c)).contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        have hcc : ContDiffAt ℂ ((i + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun _ : ℂ => c) z :=
          contDiffAt_const
        have heq : F = (fun ζ => (F ζ - c) + c) := by ext ζ; ring
        rw [heq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hFc hcc, iteratedDeriv_const]
        simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
        exact le_trans (hFB (i + 1) hi) (by linarith)
    · rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs
      · linarith
      · rw [norm_zero]; linarith

  have hBinBnd : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {P Q : ℂ → ℂ} {M_P M_Q : ℝ},
        0 ≤ M_P → 0 ≤ M_Q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ P U → DifferentiableOn ℂ Q U →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i P z‖ ≤ M_P) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i Q z‖ ≤ M_Q) →
        ∀ r ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv r (fun ζ => P ζ * Q ζ) z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_P * M_Q := by
    intro U hU z hz k P Q M_P M_Q hMP hMQ hP hQ hPB hQB r hr
    have hPc : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) P z :=
      (hP.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hQc : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) Q z :=
      (hQ.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hPc hQc]
    calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
          (r.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i P z * iteratedDeriv (r - i) Q z‖
        ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
            ‖(r.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i P z * iteratedDeriv (r - i) Q z‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (r.choose i : ℝ) * (M_P * M_Q) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
          rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact mul_le_mul (hPB i (by omega)) (hQB (r - i) (by omega)) (norm_nonneg _) hMP
      _ = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), r.choose i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M_P * M_Q) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, Nat.cast_sum]
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_P * M_Q := by
          rw [Nat.sum_range_choose, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
          ring
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_P * M_Q := by
          have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k :=
            pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hr
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hMP hMQ]

  have hBinCont : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {P Q : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (P α) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (Q α) U) →
      (∀ r ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (P α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (Q α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      ∀ r ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (fun ζ => P α ζ * Q α ζ) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro U hU P Q hHolo hCont r hr z hz
    have hSumCont : ContinuousOn
        (fun α => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
          (r.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (P α) z * iteratedDeriv (r - i) (Q α) z)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      refine continuousOn_finsetSum (Finset.range (r + 1)) fun i hi => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hCont i (by omega) z hz).1).mul
        (hCont (r - i) (by omega) z hz).2
    refine hSumCont.congr (fun α hα => ?_)
    have hPc : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (P α) z :=
      ((hHolo α hα).1.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hQc : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (Q α) z :=
      ((hHolo α hα).2.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    exact iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hPc hQc

  have hFourReg : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₁ α) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₂ α) U ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₃ α) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₄ α) U) →
      (∀ r ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (F₁ α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (F₂ α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (F₃ α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (F₄ α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => F₁ α ζ * F₂ α ζ * F₃ α ζ * F₄ α ζ) U) ∧
      (∀ r ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ U,
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (fun ζ => F₁ α ζ * F₂ α ζ * F₃ α ζ * F₄ α ζ) z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) := by
    intro U hU F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ hHolo hCont
    refine ⟨fun α hα => (((hHolo α hα).1.mul (hHolo α hα).2.1).mul (hHolo α hα).2.2.1).mul
      (hHolo α hα).2.2.2, ?_⟩
    have h12 := hBinCont hU (fun α hα => ⟨(hHolo α hα).1, (hHolo α hα).2.1⟩)
      (fun r hr z hz => ⟨(hCont r hr z hz).1, (hCont r hr z hz).2.1⟩)
    have h123 := hBinCont hU
      (fun α hα => ⟨(hHolo α hα).1.mul (hHolo α hα).2.1, (hHolo α hα).2.2.1⟩)
      (fun r hr z hz => ⟨h12 r hr z hz, (hCont r hr z hz).2.2.1⟩)
    exact hBinCont hU
      (fun α hα => ⟨((hHolo α hα).1.mul (hHolo α hα).2.1).mul (hHolo α hα).2.2.1,
        (hHolo α hα).2.2.2⟩)
      (fun r hr z hz => ⟨h123 r hr z hz, (hCont r hr z hz).2.2.2⟩)

  have hFourProdBnd : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {A B C D : ℂ → ℂ} {M_A M_B M_C M_D : ℝ},
        0 ≤ M_A → 0 ≤ M_B → 0 ≤ M_C → 0 ≤ M_D →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ A U → DifferentiableOn ℂ B U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ C U → DifferentiableOn ℂ D U →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i A z‖ ≤ M_A) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i B z‖ ≤ M_B) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i C z‖ ≤ M_C) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i D z‖ ≤ M_D) →
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => A ζ * B ζ * C ζ * D ζ) z‖ ≤
          (8 : ℝ) ^ k * (M_A * M_B * M_C * M_D) := by
    intro U hU z hz k A B C D M_A M_B M_C M_D hMA hMB hMC hMD hA hB hC hD hAB hBB hCB hDB
    have h12 := hBinBnd hU hz hMA hMB hA hB hAB hBB
    have hM12 : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_A * M_B := by positivity
    have h123 := hBinBnd hU hz hM12 hMC (hA.mul hB) hC h12 hCB
    have hM123 : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_A * M_B) * M_C := by positivity
    have h1234 := hBinBnd hU hz hM123 hMD ((hA.mul hB).mul hC) hD h123 hDB k (le_refl k)
    have hEq : (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * M_A * M_B) * M_C) * M_D =
        (8 : ℝ) ^ k * (M_A * M_B * M_C * M_D) := by
      have h8 : (8 : ℝ) ^ k = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        rw [← mul_pow, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
      rw [h8]; ring
    rwa [hEq] at h1234

  have hFourSub : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ {k : ℕ} {F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ G₁ G₂ G₃ G₄ : ℂ → ℂ}
        {M₁ M₂ M₃ M₄ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ Δ₄ : ℝ},
        0 ≤ M₁ → 0 ≤ M₂ → 0 ≤ M₃ → 0 ≤ M₄ →
        0 ≤ Δ₁ → 0 ≤ Δ₂ → 0 ≤ Δ₃ → 0 ≤ Δ₄ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F₂ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F₃ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F₄ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G₃ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ G₄ U →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i F₁ z‖ ≤ M₁ ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv i G₁ z‖ ≤ M₁ ∧
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - G₁ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ₁) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i F₂ z‖ ≤ M₂ ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv i G₂ z‖ ≤ M₂ ∧
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₂ ζ - G₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ₂) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i F₃ z‖ ≤ M₃ ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv i G₃ z‖ ≤ M₃ ∧
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₃ ζ - G₃ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ₃) →
        (∀ i ≤ k, ‖iteratedDeriv i F₄ z‖ ≤ M₄ ∧ ‖iteratedDeriv i G₄ z‖ ≤ M₄ ∧
          ‖iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₄ ζ - G₄ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ₄) →
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => F₁ ζ * F₂ ζ * F₃ ζ * F₄ ζ - G₁ ζ * G₂ ζ * G₃ ζ * G₄ ζ) z‖ ≤
          (8 : ℝ) ^ k * (Δ₁ * M₂ * M₃ * M₄ + M₁ * Δ₂ * M₃ * M₄ +
            M₁ * M₂ * Δ₃ * M₄ + M₁ * M₂ * M₃ * Δ₄) := by
    intro U hU z hz k F₁ F₂ F₃ F₄ G₁ G₂ G₃ G₄ M₁ M₂ M₃ M₄ Δ₁ Δ₂ Δ₃ Δ₄
      hM₁ hM₂ hM₃ hM₄ hΔ₁ hΔ₂ hΔ₃ hΔ₄ hF₁ hF₂ hF₃ hF₄ hG₁ hG₂ hG₃ hG₄ h1 h2 h3 h4
    let T₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => (F₁ ζ - G₁ ζ) * F₂ ζ * F₃ ζ * F₄ ζ
    let T₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => G₁ ζ * (F₂ ζ - G₂ ζ) * F₃ ζ * F₄ ζ
    let T₃ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => G₁ ζ * G₂ ζ * (F₃ ζ - G₃ ζ) * F₄ ζ
    let T₄ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => G₁ ζ * G₂ ζ * G₃ ζ * (F₄ ζ - G₄ ζ)
    have hTel : (fun ζ => F₁ ζ * F₂ ζ * F₃ ζ * F₄ ζ - G₁ ζ * G₂ ζ * G₃ ζ * G₄ ζ) =
        (fun ζ => (T₁ ζ + T₂ ζ) + (T₃ ζ + T₄ ζ)) := by
      ext ζ; dsimp [T₁, T₂, T₃, T₄]; ring
    have hT₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ T₁ U := (((hF₁.sub hG₁).mul hF₂).mul hF₃).mul hF₄
    have hT₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ T₂ U := (((hG₁.mul (hF₂.sub hG₂)).mul hF₃)).mul hF₄
    have hT₃_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ T₃ U := (((hG₁.mul hG₂).mul (hF₃.sub hG₃))).mul hF₄
    have hT₄_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ T₄ U := ((hG₁.mul hG₂).mul hG₃).mul (hF₄.sub hG₄)
    have hcAt : ∀ {P : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ P U → ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) P z :=
      fun hP => (hP.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hc12 : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => T₁ ζ + T₂ ζ) z :=
      hcAt (hT₁_holo.add hT₂_holo)
    have hc34 : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => T₃ ζ + T₄ ζ) z :=
      hcAt (hT₃_holo.add hT₄_holo)
    rw [hTel, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hc12 hc34,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hcAt hT₁_holo) (hcAt hT₂_holo),
      iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hcAt hT₃_holo) (hcAt hT₄_holo)]
    have hb₁ := hFourProdBnd hU hz hΔ₁ hM₂ hM₃ hM₄ (hF₁.sub hG₁) hF₂ hF₃ hF₄
      (fun i hi => (h1 i hi).2.2) (fun i hi => (h2 i hi).1) (fun i hi => (h3 i hi).1)
      (fun i hi => (h4 i hi).1)
    have hb₂ := hFourProdBnd hU hz hM₁ hΔ₂ hM₃ hM₄ hG₁ (hF₂.sub hG₂) hF₃ hF₄
      (fun i hi => (h1 i hi).2.1) (fun i hi => (h2 i hi).2.2) (fun i hi => (h3 i hi).1)
      (fun i hi => (h4 i hi).1)
    have hb₃ := hFourProdBnd hU hz hM₁ hM₂ hΔ₃ hM₄ hG₁ hG₂ (hF₃.sub hG₃) hF₄
      (fun i hi => (h1 i hi).2.1) (fun i hi => (h2 i hi).2.1) (fun i hi => (h3 i hi).2.2)
      (fun i hi => (h4 i hi).1)
    have hb₄ := hFourProdBnd hU hz hM₁ hM₂ hM₃ hΔ₄ hG₁ hG₂ hG₃ (hF₄.sub hG₄)
      (fun i hi => (h1 i hi).2.1) (fun i hi => (h2 i hi).2.1) (fun i hi => (h3 i hi).2.1)
      (fun i hi => (h4 i hi).2.2)
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z + iteratedDeriv k T₂ z +
        (iteratedDeriv k T₃ z + iteratedDeriv k T₄ z)‖ ≤ _
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z‖ ≤ _ at hb₁
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖ ≤ _ at hb₂
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z‖ ≤ _ at hb₃
    change ‖iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖ ≤ _ at hb₄
    have htri : ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z + iteratedDeriv k T₂ z +
          (iteratedDeriv k T₃ z + iteratedDeriv k T₄ z)‖ ≤
        ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖ +
          ‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖ := by
      calc ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z + iteratedDeriv k T₂ z +
              (iteratedDeriv k T₃ z + iteratedDeriv k T₄ z)‖
          ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z + iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖ +
              ‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z + iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖) +
              (‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖) :=
            add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) (norm_add_le _ _)
        _ = ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖ +
              ‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖ := by ring
    have hsum_le : ‖iteratedDeriv k T₁ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₂ z‖ +
          ‖iteratedDeriv k T₃ z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv k T₄ z‖ ≤
        (8 : ℝ) ^ k * (Δ₁ * M₂ * M₃ * M₄ + M₁ * Δ₂ * M₃ * M₄ +
          M₁ * M₂ * Δ₃ * M₄ + M₁ * M₂ * M₃ * Δ₄) := by
      have hlin := add_le_add (add_le_add hb₁ hb₂) (add_le_add hb₃ hb₄)
      linarith
    exact le_trans htri hsum_le

  let expConst : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Real.exp 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k * k)
  have hExpConstPos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < expConst k := fun k => by
    dsimp [expConst]; positivity
  have hExpConstMono : ∀ {i k : ℕ}, i ≤ k → expConst i ≤ expConst k := by
    intro i k hik
    dsimp [expConst]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.mul_le_mul hik hik)
  have hExpConstStep : ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * expConst k ≤ expConst (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    dsimp [expConst]
    calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * (Real.exp 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (k * k))
        = Real.exp 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) + k * k) := by rw [pow_add]; ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * (k + 1)) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
          exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)

  have hExpBnd : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U → ∀ {Θ : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ U →
      (∀ w ∈ U, ‖Θ w‖ ≤ 1) →
      (∀ r ≤ m, ‖iteratedDeriv r Θ z‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ k ≤ m, ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ ζ)) z‖ ≤ expConst k := by
    intro U hU z hz Θ hΘ hΘ_sup hΘ_jet k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        dsimp [expConst]
        simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
        rw [Complex.norm_exp]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_trans (Complex.re_le_norm _) (hΘ_sup z hz))
      · let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ ζ)
        have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F U := hΘ.cexp
        have hdΘ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv Θ) U := hΘ.deriv hU
        have hDerivEq : deriv F =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun ζ => F ζ * deriv Θ ζ) := by
          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with ζ hζ
          exact (((hΘ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt).cexp).deriv
        have hFc : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) F z :=
          (hF_holo.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        have hdΘc : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv Θ) z :=
          (hdΘ_holo.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        change ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) F z‖ ≤ expConst (k + 1)
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDerivEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hFc hdΘc]
        calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F z * iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ) z‖
            ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                ‖(k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F z * iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ) z‖ :=
              norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (expConst k * 1) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro i hi
              rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
              rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
              exact mul_le_mul
                (le_trans (ih i (by omega) (by omega)) (hExpConstMono (by omega)))
                (hΘ_jet (k - i + 1) (by omega))
                (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (hExpConstPos k))
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * expConst k := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_range_choose,
                Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
              ring
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * expConst k := by
              have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) :=
                pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
              nlinarith [hExpConstPos k]
          _ ≤ expConst (k + 1) := hExpConstStep k

  have hExpLip : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →

        0 ≤ Δ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ₂ U →
        (∀ w ∈ U, ‖Θ₁ w‖ ≤ 1) → (∀ w ∈ U, ‖Θ₂ w‖ ≤ 1) →

        (∀ r ≤ m, ‖iteratedDeriv r Θ₂ z‖ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ r ≤ m, ‖iteratedDeriv r (fun ζ => Θ₁ ζ - Θ₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ Δ) →
        ∀ k ≤ m,
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ₁ ζ) - Complex.exp (Θ₂ ζ)) z‖ ≤
            expConst k * Δ := by
    intro U hU z hz Θ₁ Θ₂ Δ hΔ hΘ₁ hΘ₂ hsup₁ hsup₂ hjet₁ hjet₂ hdiff k
    have hF₂_bnd := hExpBnd hU hz hΘ₂ hsup₂ hjet₂
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        dsimp [expConst]
        simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
        have hmvt : ‖Complex.exp (Θ₁ z) - Complex.exp (Θ₂ z)‖ ≤

            (s := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)
            (fun w _ => Complex.differentiable_exp.differentiableAt)
            (fun w hw => ?_) (convex_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) ?_ ?_
          · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hw
            rw [Complex.deriv_exp, Complex.norm_exp]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_trans (Complex.re_le_norm _) hw)
          · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hsup₂ z hz
          · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hsup₁ z hz
        have h0 := hdiff 0 (Nat.zero_le m)
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
        exact le_trans hmvt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0 (Real.exp_nonneg _))
      · let F₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ₁ ζ)
        let F₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ₂ ζ)
        have hF₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F₁ U := hΘ₁.cexp
        have hF₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F₂ U := hΘ₂.cexp
        have hdΘ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv Θ₁) U := hΘ₁.deriv hU
        have hdΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (fun ζ => Θ₁ ζ - Θ₂ ζ)) U :=
          (hΘ₁.sub hΘ₂).deriv hU
        have hDerivEq : deriv (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            (fun ζ => (F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) * deriv Θ₁ ζ +
              F₂ ζ * deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w) ζ) := by
          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with ζ hζ
          have hd₁ := (hΘ₁.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt
          have hd₂ := (hΘ₂.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt
          have hdF : HasDerivAt (fun w => F₁ w - F₂ w)
              (F₁ ζ * deriv Θ₁ ζ - F₂ ζ * deriv Θ₂ ζ) ζ := hd₁.cexp.sub hd₂.cexp
          have hdΘ : HasDerivAt (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w) (deriv Θ₁ ζ - deriv Θ₂ ζ) ζ :=
            hd₁.sub hd₂
          rw [hdF.deriv, hdΘ.deriv]
          ring
        have hcAt : ∀ {P : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ P U → ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) P z :=
          fun hP => (hP.contDiffOn hU).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
        have hcFdiff : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z :=
          hcAt (hF₁_holo.sub hF₂_holo)
        have hcTerm1 : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
            (fun ζ => (F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) * deriv Θ₁ ζ) z :=
          hcFdiff.mul (hcAt hdΘ₁_holo)
        have hcTerm2 : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
            (fun ζ => F₂ ζ * deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w) ζ) z :=
          (hcAt hF₂_holo).mul (hcAt hdΔ_holo)
        change ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z‖ ≤ expConst (k + 1) * Δ
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDerivEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcTerm1 hcTerm2,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hcFdiff (hcAt hdΘ₁_holo),
          iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hcAt hF₂_holo) (hcAt hdΔ_holo)]
        have hSum1 : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z *
                iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ₁) z‖ ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) := by
          calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z *
                  iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ₁) z‖
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                  ‖(k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z *
                    iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ₁) z‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * ((expConst k * Δ) * 1) := by
                apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                intro i hi
                rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
                rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul
                  (le_trans (ih i (by omega) (by omega))
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hExpConstMono (by omega)) hΔ))
                  (hjet₁ (k - i + 1) (by omega))
                  (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hExpConstPos k)) hΔ)
            _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_range_choose,
                  Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
                ring
        have hSum2 : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F₂ z *
                iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w)) z‖ ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) := by
          calc ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F₂ z *
                  iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w)) z‖
              ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                  ‖(k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F₂ z *
                    iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w)) z‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (expConst k * Δ) := by
                apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                intro i hi
                rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
                rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, ← iteratedDeriv_succ']
                apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul
                  (le_trans (hF₂_bnd i (by omega)) (hExpConstMono (by omega)))
                  (hdiff (k - i + 1) (by omega))
                  (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (hExpConstPos k))
            _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_range_choose,
                  Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        calc ‖(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => F₁ ζ - F₂ ζ) z *
                  iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv Θ₁) z) +
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                (k.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i F₂ z *
                  iteratedDeriv (k - i) (deriv (fun w => Θ₁ w - Θ₂ w)) z)‖
            ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) + (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (expConst k * Δ) :=

          _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * expConst k) * Δ := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
          _ ≤ expConst (k + 1) * Δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hExpConstStep k) hΔ

  have hExpCont : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ U →
      ∀ {Θ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Θ α) U) →

        ∀ k ≤ m, ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => Complex.exp (Θ α ζ)) z)

    intro U hU z hz Θ hΘ_holo hΘ_cont k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (hΘ_cont 0 (Nat.zero_le m))
      · have hSumCont : ContinuousOn
            (fun α => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),

                iteratedDeriv (k - i + 1) (Θ α) z)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by

          rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi

        refine hSumCont.congr (fun α hα => ?_)

          filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with ζ hζ
          exact ((((hΘ_holo α hα).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt).cexp).deriv

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']

  have hParamInt : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {B₀ : ℝ} {G : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ},
      0 ≤ B₀ →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => G ζ α) U) →
      (∀ k ≤ m, ∀ z ∈ U, ContinuousOn (fun α : ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => G ζ α) z)

    intro U hU B₀ G hB₀ hHolo hCont hBnd

      intro r α hα
      induction r with
      | zero => simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hHolo α hα
      | succ r ih => simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ] using ih.deriv hU
    have hStepDeriv : ∀ r < m, ∀ x₀ ∈ U,
        HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv r (fun ζ => G ζ α) x)

                (B₁ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (B₂ / (q : ℝ)) * B₃ * ((C_osc / (q : ℝ)) * S_diff)) =
              ((8 : ℝ) ^ r *
                ((H_ker.C_ker / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * (B₂ / (q : ℝ)) * B₃ * B₄ +
                  (B₁ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (H_ker.C_ker / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * B₃ * B₄ +
                  (B₁ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (B₂ / (q : ℝ)) * (C_osc / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * B₄ +
                  (B₁ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (B₂ / (q : ℝ)) * B₃ * (C_osc / (q : ℝ)))) * S_diff := by
            ring
          rw [heq]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCombineHalf r hr) hS_nonneg
        let subM : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₁ (X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) ζ *
              (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) *
              deriv (xInvMinus₁ j α) ζ *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ - ζ)) -
            cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₂ (X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) ζ *
              (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) *
              deriv (xInvMinus₂ j α) ζ *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ - ζ))
        let subP : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
          cellKernelPlus_ℂ W₁ (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) ζ *
              (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) *
              deriv (xInvPlus₁ j α) ζ *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ - ζ)) -
            cellKernelPlus_ℂ W₂ (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) ζ *
              (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) *
              deriv (xInvPlus₂ j α) ζ *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ - ζ))
        have hSplitΔ : (fun ζ => ΔG j ζ α) = (fun ζ => subM ζ + subP ζ) := by
          ext ζ; dsimp [ΔG, stripCellIntegrand_ℂ, subM, subP]; ring
        have hcM_diff : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) subM w_pt :=
          (((hRegM₁.1 α hα).sub (hRegM₂.1 α hα)).contDiffOn hU_open).contDiffAt
            (hU_open.mem_nhds hw)
        have hcP_diff : ContDiffAt ℂ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) subP w_pt :=
          (((hRegP₁.1 α hα).sub (hRegP₂.1 α hα)).contDiffOn hU_open).contDiffAt
            (hU_open.mem_nhds hw)
        rw [hSplitΔ, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcM_diff hcP_diff]
        calc ‖iteratedDeriv r subM w_pt + iteratedDeriv r subP w_pt‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv r subM w_pt‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv r subP w_pt‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (C_half / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff + (C_half / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff :=
              add_le_add (le_trans hSubM hFactorS) (le_trans hSubP hFactorS)
          _ = (C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff := by dsimp [C_cell]; ring
      have hPInt := hParamInt hU_open
        (mul_nonneg (by dsimp [C_cell]; positivity) hS_nonneg)
        hΔG_holo hΔG_cont hΔG_bnd
      exact ⟨hCont0, hPInt.1, hPInt.2⟩

    let D_lip : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      pref * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α
    have hEvLip : (fun ζ : ℂ =>
        stripB_canon n W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ ζ -
          stripB_canon n W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ ζ) =ᶠ[nhds z] D_lip := by
      filter_upwards [hU_open.mem_nhds hz] with ζ hζ
      dsimp [stripB_canon, D_lip, pref, q]
      have hIntSub : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) =
            (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              stripCellIntegrand_ℂ n W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ j ζ α) -
            (∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              stripCellIntegrand_ℂ n W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ j ζ α) := by
        intro j hj
        have hc := (hCellDiffProps j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).1 ζ hζ
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub
          (hc.1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
          (hc.2.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hIntSub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
    have hSumLipHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) U_inv :=
      hHoloSum (Finset.range q) (fun j ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α)
        (fun j hj => (hCellDiffProps j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).2.1)
    have hSumLipContAt : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun ζ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) z :=
      (hSumLipHolo.contDiffOn hU_open).contDiffAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz)
    rw [hEvLip.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
    dsimp [D_lip]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul pref hSumLipContAt,
      hIterSum hU_open hz (Finset.range q)
        (fun j ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α)
        (fun j hj => (hCellDiffProps j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).2.1) k,
      norm_mul]
    have hpref_norm : ‖pref‖ = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) := by
      dsimp [pref]
      rw [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (by have := Real.pi_pos; positivity)]
    rw [hpref_norm]
    have hSumBnd : ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) z‖ ≤
        (q : ℝ) * ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff) := by
      calc ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) z‖
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
              ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) z‖ :=
            norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range q, ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro j hj
            exact (hCellDiffProps j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).2.2 k hk z hz
        _ = (q : ℝ) * ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
    calc ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) *
          ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range q,
            iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1, ΔG j ζ α) z‖
        ≤ ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi)) * ((q : ℝ) * ((C_cell / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * S_diff)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSumBnd (by have := Real.pi_pos; positivity)
      _ = ((C_cell / (6 * Real.pi)) / (q : ℝ)) * S_diff := by field_simp [hq_ne, hpi_ne]
      _ ≤ (C_mult / |(n : ℝ)|) * S_diff := by
          rw [hn_abs_R]
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hS_nonneg
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hq_pos)
          dsimp [C_mult]; linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have heqOn_zero_ball :
      ∀ {p_a q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {R η : ℝ},
        q₀ ∈ Metric.ball p_a R → 0 < η →
        ∀ {f_ball : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ f_ball (Metric.ball p_a R) →
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, f_ball q = 0) →
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_a R, f_ball q = 0 := by
    intro p_a q₀ R η hq₀_a hη_pos f_ball hf_ball hf_zero q hq
    let φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (q₀.1 + z * (q.1 - q₀.1), q₀.2 + z * (q.2 - q₀.2))
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ :=
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)).prodMk
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))
    have hφ_holo : Differentiable ℂ φ :=
      ((differentiable_const q₀.1).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _))).prodMk
        ((differentiable_const q₀.2).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
    let U_z : Set ℂ := φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p_a R
    have hUz_open : IsOpen U_z := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hφ_cont
    have hUz_conv : Convex ℝ U_z := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      have hab_c : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have h_aff : φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • φ z₁ + b • φ z₂ := by
        ext
        · simp only [φ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_add, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -q₀.1 * hab_c
        · simp only [φ, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, Complex.real_smul]
          linear_combination -q₀.2 * hab_c
      change φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ Metric.ball p_a R
      rw [h_aff]
      exact convex_ball p_a R hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
    have h0_Uz : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := by
      change φ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p_a R
      simpa [φ] using hq₀_a
    have h1_Uz : (1 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := by
      change φ 1 ∈ Metric.ball p_a R
      have hφ1 : φ 1 = q := by ext <;> simp [φ]
      rwa [hφ1]
    have hg_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f_ball (φ z)) U_z :=
      (hf_ball.comp hφ_holo.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)).analyticOnNhd hUz_open
    have hg_ev0 : (fun z => f_ball (φ z)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = q₀ := by ext <;> simp [φ]
      have h_pre : φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball q₀ η ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
        hφ_cont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (by rw [hφ0]; exact Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))
      filter_upwards [h_pre] with z hz
      exact hf_zero (φ z) hz
    have h_eq1 := hg_an.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hUz_conv.isPreconnected h0_Uz hg_ev0 h1_Uz
    have hφ1 : φ 1 = q := by ext <;> simp [φ]
    simpa [hφ1] using h_eq1

  have hpderiv_holo :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U := by
    have h_param_diff :
        ∀ {W s : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {x₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {a b C_bd : ℝ} {c_mul : ℂ}
          {g_target : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
          {F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ} {F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ},
          s ∈ nhds x₀ →
          (∀ᶠ x in nhds x₀,
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b))) →
          IntervalIntegrable (F x₀) MeasureTheory.volume a b →
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) →
          (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x θ‖ ≤ C_bd) →
          (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun y => F y θ) (F' x θ) x) →
          (∀ x ∈ s, g_target x = c_mul * ∫ θ in a..b, F x θ) →
          DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ g_target W x₀ := by
      intro W s x₀ a b C_bd c_mul g_target F F' hs hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas h_bd h_fd h_eq
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun x => ∫ θ in a..b, F x θ) x₀ :=
        (intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          hs hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ x hx => h_bd θ x hx))
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ x hx => h_fd θ x hx))).differentiableAt
      have h_ev : g_target =ᶠ[nhds x₀] (fun x => c_mul * ∫ θ in a..b, F x θ) := by
        filter_upwards [hs] with x hx
        exact h_eq x hx
      exact ((hd.const_mul c_mul).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.fst, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.snd, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_norm : ∀ v : ℂ × ℂ, ‖π₁ v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := fun v => norm_fst_le v
    have hπ₂_norm : ∀ v : ℂ × ℂ, ‖π₂ v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := fun v => norm_snd_le v
    have hpderivD : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD g) W := by
      intro W hW g hg p₀ hp₀
      obtain ⟨R₀, _hR₀_pos, hR₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
      let r : ℝ := R₀ / 3
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
      let K₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r)
      have hK₂_sub_W : K₂ ⊆ W :=
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [r]; linarith)) hR₀_sub
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * r)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hg.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub_W)
      let M_g : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      let B_q : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2)
      have hp₀_Bq : p₀ ∈ B_q := Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr_pos)
      have hBq_nhds : B_q ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp₀_Bq
      have hBq_coord : ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ B_q → dist q.1 p₀.1 < r / 2 ∧ dist q.2 p₀.2 < r / 2 := by
        intro q hq
        have hp : q ∈ Metric.ball p₀.1 (r / 2) ×ˢ Metric.ball p₀.2 (r / 2) :=
          (ball_prod_same p₀.1 p₀.2 (r / 2)).symm ▸ hq
        exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1, Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2⟩
      let z_map : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => circleMap p₀.2 r θ
      have hz_dist : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖z_map θ - p₀.2‖ = r := by
        intro θ
        simpa [z_map, dist_eq_norm] using circleMap_mem_sphere p₀.2 hr_pos.le θ
      have hz_sub_lb : ∀ q ∈ B_q, ∀ θ : ℝ, r / 2 ≤ ‖z_map θ - q.2‖ := by
        intro q hq θ
        have hq2 : ‖q.2 - p₀.2‖ < r / 2 := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact (hBq_coord hq).2
        have h_tri : ‖z_map θ - p₀.2‖ ≤ ‖z_map θ - q.2‖ + ‖q.2 - p₀.2‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (z_map θ - q.2) (q.2 - p₀.2)
        rw [hz_dist θ] at h_tri
        linarith
      have hz_sub_ne : ∀ q ∈ B_q, ∀ θ : ℝ, z_map θ - q.2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro q hq θ h0
        have hlb := hz_sub_lb q hq θ
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at hlb
        linarith
      have h_mem_K₂ : ∀ y : ℂ, dist y p₀.1 ≤ 3 * r / 2 → ∀ θ : ℝ, (y, z_map θ) ∈ K₂ := by
        intro y hy θ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq]
        refine max_le (by linarith) ?_
        rw [dist_eq_norm, hz_dist θ]
        linarith
      have h_cauchy_eq : ∀ q ∈ B_q,
          pderivD g q =
            (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ)) := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨hq1_dist, hq2_dist⟩ := hBq_coord hq
        have hq2_ball : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball p₀.2 r := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith)
        have h_slice_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => g (q.1, z)) (Metric.ball p₀.2 (2 * r)) := by
          refine hg.comp ((differentiableOn_const q.1).prodMk differentiableOn_id) ?_
          intro z hz
          apply hR₀_sub
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
          exact max_lt (lt_trans hq1_dist (by dsimp [r]; linarith))
            (lt_trans (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (by dsimp [r]; linarith))
        have h_ci := Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
          Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)) h_slice_holo hq2_ball
        dsimp only [pderivD]
        rw [← h_ci, circleIntegral]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, z_map]
      have h_pderivA_bound : ∀ q ∈ B_q, ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)‖ ≤ M_g / r := by
        intro q hq θ
        have hq1_dist := (hBq_coord hq).1
        have h_1d_diff : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun w : ℂ => g (w, z_map θ)) (Metric.ball q.1 r) := by
          refine (hg.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const (z_map θ))) ?_).diffContOnCl_ball
            (Set.Subset.refl _)
          intro w hw
          apply hK₂_sub_W
          apply h_mem_K₂ w
          calc dist w p₀.1 ≤ dist w q.1 + dist q.1 p₀.1 := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ r + r / 2 := add_le_add (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hw) hq1_dist.le
            _ = 3 * r / 2 := by ring
        have h_sph : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere q.1 r, ‖g (w, z_map θ)‖ ≤ M_g := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_K₂ : (w, z_map θ) ∈ K₂ := by
            apply h_mem_K₂ w
            calc dist w p₀.1 ≤ dist w q.1 + dist q.1 p₀.1 := dist_triangle _ _ _
              _ ≤ r + r / 2 := add_le_add (by rw [Metric.mem_sphere.mp hw]) hq1_dist.le
              _ = 3 * r / 2 := by ring
          exact le_trans (hM₀ _ hw_K₂) (le_max_left _ _)
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr_pos h_1d_diff h_sph
      let F_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q θ =>
        deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ))
      let F'_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun q θ =>
        (deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ))) • π₁ +
        (deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ))) • π₂
      have h_F_cont : ∀ q ∈ B_q, Continuous (F_int q) := by
        intro q hq
        have h_dc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ) := by
          have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ) = fun θ => circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I :=
            funext (deriv_circleMap p₀.2 r)
          rw [heq]
          exact (continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const
        have h_inv : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          (((continuous_circleMap p₀.2 r).sub continuous_const).pow 2).inv₀

        have h_g : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => g (q.1, z_map θ)) := by

          exact (hg.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub_W).comp_continuous

      have h_meas_F : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p₀,

        filter_upwards [hBq_nhds] with q hq

      have h_int_F0 : IntervalIntegrable (F_int p₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=

      have h_meas_pderivA0 :
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun θ : ℝ => pderivA g (p₀.1, z_map θ))
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        let δ_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let dq_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n θ => dslope (fun w : ℂ => g (w, z_map θ)) p₀.1 (p₀.1 + δ_seq n)
        have h_dq_meas : ∀ n : ℕ,
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (dq_seq n)

          intro n

          have h_eq_div : dq_seq n = fun θ => (g (p₀.1 + δ_seq n, z_map θ) - g (p₀.1, z_map θ)) / δ_seq n := by
            ext θ
            dsimp only [dq_seq]
            rw [dslope_of_ne _ (by simp [hδ_ne]), slope_def_field]
            ring_nf
          rw [h_eq_div]
          have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => g (p₀.1 + δ_seq n, z_map θ)) :=
            (hg.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub_W).comp_continuous
              (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap p₀.2 r))
              (fun θ => h_mem_K₂ (p₀.1 + δ_seq n) (by
                rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h_pos_n]

          have hc2 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => g (p₀.1, z_map θ)) :=
            (hg.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub_W).comp_continuous

        have hδ_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => p₀.1 + δ_seq n) Filter.atTop (nhds p₀.1) := by
          have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
              (Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
                (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds))
          simpa [δ_seq] using tendsto_const_nhds.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h_real)
        refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop h_dq_meas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ => ?_))
        have h_slice_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => g (w, z_map θ)) p₀.1 := by
          have hp_W : (p₀.1, z_map θ) ∈ W := hK₂_sub_W (h_mem_K₂ p₀.1 (by rw [dist_self]; positivity) θ)
          exact (hg.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp_W)).comp p₀.1
            (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _))
        have ht := (continuousAt_dslope_same.mpr h_slice_diff).tendsto.comp hδ_tend
        rw [dslope_same] at ht
        exact ht
      have h_meas_F'0 :
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F'_int p₀)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        have h_dc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ) := by
          have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ) = fun θ => circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I :=
            funext (deriv_circleMap p₀.2 r)
          rw [heq]
          exact (continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const
        have h_inv2 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ((z_map θ - p₀.2) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          (((continuous_circleMap p₀.2 r).sub continuous_const).pow 2).inv₀
            (fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hz_sub_ne p₀ hp₀_Bq θ))
        have h_inv3 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => 2 * ((z_map θ - p₀.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * g (p₀.1, z_map θ)) :=
          (continuous_const.mul
            ((((continuous_circleMap p₀.2 r).sub continuous_const).pow 3).inv₀
              (fun θ => pow_ne_zero 3 (hz_sub_ne p₀ hp₀_Bq θ)))).mul
            ((hg.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub_W).comp_continuous
              (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap p₀.2 r))
              (fun θ => h_mem_K₂ p₀.1 (by rw [dist_self]; positivity) θ))
        have hm := (((h_dc.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
          (h_inv2.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_pderivA0)).smul_const π₁)).add
          ((h_dc.mul h_inv3).aestronglyMeasurable.smul_const π₂)
        exact hm.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))
      let C_bd : ℝ := r * ((2 / r) ^ 2 * (M_g / r)) + r * (2 * (2 / r) ^ 3 * M_g)
      have h_bound : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ q ∈ B_q, ‖F'_int q θ‖ ≤ C_bd := by
        intro θ q hq
        have h_dc_norm : ‖deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ‖ = r := by
          rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
          simpa [dist_zero_right] using circleMap_mem_sphere (0 : ℂ) hr_pos.le θ
        have h_inv_le : ‖(z_map θ - q.2)⁻¹‖ ≤ 2 / r := by
          rw [norm_inv, inv_le_comm₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr (hz_sub_ne q hq θ)) (div_pos zero_lt_two hr_pos)]
          have hlb := hz_sub_lb q hq θ
          rw [inv_div]
          exact hlb
        have h_inv2_le : ‖((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹‖ ≤ (2 / r) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← inv_pow, norm_pow]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_inv_le 2
        have h_inv3_le : ‖((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹‖ ≤ (2 / r) ^ 3 := by
          rw [← inv_pow, norm_pow]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_inv_le 3
        have hq1_dist := (hBq_coord hq).1
        have h_g_le : ‖g (q.1, z_map θ)‖ ≤ M_g :=
          le_trans (hM₀ _ (h_mem_K₂ q.1 (by linarith) θ)) (le_max_left _ _)
        have h_pd_le : ‖pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)‖ ≤ M_g / r := h_pderivA_bound q hq θ
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
        dsimp only [F'_int]
        simp only [_root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        have hb1 : ‖deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₁ v‖ ≤
            r * ((2 / r) ^ 2 * (M_g / r)) * ‖v‖ := by
          simp only [norm_mul, h_dc_norm]
          gcongr
          exact hπ₁_norm v
        have hb2 : ‖deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₂ v‖ ≤
            r * (2 * (2 / r) ^ 3 * M_g) * ‖v‖ := by
          simp only [norm_mul, h_dc_norm, Complex.norm_ofNat]
          gcongr
          exact hπ₂_norm v
        calc ‖deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₁ v +
                deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₂ v‖
            ≤ _ + _ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ r * ((2 / r) ^ 2 * (M_g / r)) * ‖v‖ + r * (2 * (2 / r) ^ 3 * M_g) * ‖v‖ := add_le_add hb1 hb2
          _ = C_bd * ‖v‖ := by dsimp [C_bd]; ring
      have h_has_fderiv : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ q ∈ B_q, HasFDerivAt (fun x => F_int x θ) (F'_int q θ) q := by
        intro θ q hq
        have hq1_dist := (hBq_coord hq).1
        have hp_W : (q.1, z_map θ) ∈ W := hK₂_sub_W (h_mem_K₂ q.1 (by linarith) θ)
        have hd_slice : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g (w, z_map θ)) (pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)) q.1 :=
          ((hg.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp_W)).comp q.1
            (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const _))).hasDerivAt
        have hf_fst := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt q hd_slice π₁.hasFDerivAt
        have hz_ne : z_map θ - q.2 ≠ 0 := hz_sub_ne q hq θ
        have hd_inv : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ((z_map θ - w) ^ 2)⁻¹) (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹) q.2 := by
          have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => z_map θ - w) (-1) q.2 :=
            (hasDerivAt_id q.2).const_sub (z_map θ)
          have hd_sq : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (z_map θ - w) ^ 2)
              (2 * (z_map θ - q.2) ^ (2 - 1) * (-1)) q.2 := hd_sub.pow 2
          have hd_i := hd_sq.inv (pow_ne_zero 2 hz_ne)
          have heq_d : -(2 * (z_map θ - q.2) ^ (2 - 1) * -1) / ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2) ^ 2 =
              2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ := by
            field_simp [hz_ne]; ring
          rwa [heq_d] at hd_i
        have hf_snd := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt q hd_inv π₂.hasFDerivAt
        have hf_prod := (hf_snd.mul hf_fst).const_mul (deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ)
        refine hf_prod.congr_fderiv ?_
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
        dsimp only [F'_int, Function.comp_def]
        simp only [_root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        change deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ *
            (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ) * π₁ v) +
              g (q.1, z_map θ) * (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * π₂ v)) =
          deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹ * pderivA g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₁ v +
            deriv (circleMap p₀.2 r) θ * (2 * ((z_map θ - q.2) ^ 3)⁻¹ * g (q.1, z_map θ)) * π₂ v

      exact h_param_diff hBq_nhds h_meas_F h_int_F0 h_meas_F'0 h_bound h_has_fderiv h_cauchy_eq
    intro U hU f hf
    have hpderivA : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      let swap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := Prod.swap
      have hswap_holo : Differentiable ℂ swap := differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst
      have hswap_open : IsOpen (swap ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage continuous_swap
      have hf_swap : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f (swap p)) (swap ⁻¹' U) :=
        hf.comp hswap_holo.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
      have hd_swap := hpderivD hswap_open hf_swap
      have h_eq : pderivA f = fun p => pderivD (fun q => f (swap q)) (swap p) := by
        ext p
        rfl
      rw [h_eq]

    exact ⟨hpderivA, hpderivD hU hf⟩
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  let T_X : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X
  let T_L : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L
  let U_base2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * W.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base }

  
  have h_open_hs : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_preconn_hs : ∀ H : ℝ, IsPreconnected (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    refine (?_ : Convex ℝ (horizStrip H)).isPreconnected
    intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |s₁.im| < H at hs₁
    change |s₂.im| < H at hs₂
    change |(a • s₁ + b • s₂).im| < H
    have him : (a • s₁ + b • s₂).im = a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im := by
      simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
    rw [him]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      subst hb1
      have h_eq : |(0 : ℝ) * s₁.im + 1 * s₂.im| = |s₂.im| := by ring_nf
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hs₂
    · have h1 : a * |s₁.im| < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs₁ ha_pos
      have h2 : b * |s₂.im| ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs₂.le hb
      have h3 : |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im| ≤ a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by
        calc |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im| ≤ |a * s₁.im| + |b * s₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      calc |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im| ≤ a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := h3
        _ < a * H + b * H := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
        _ = (a + b) * H := by ring
        _ = H := by rw [hab, one_mul]

  have h0_ball : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := Metric.mem_ball_self W.r_base_pos
  have hhX0_ge : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_X 0 := W.h_X_ge_two 0 h0_ball

    · have h_univ : D_H = Set.univ := by

  have hbase_sub_two : horizStrip W.s_base ⊆ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := by

    · rwa [hhL0_eq]

  have h00_U_base2 : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_base2 := by

  have hU_sub_det : U_base2 ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } := by
    intro p hp

  have himpact_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i) U_base2 :=
