  have hh_an_2sh : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ C.h_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    C.h_ℂ_holo.analyticOnNhd (h_open_hs (2 * C.s_h))

  have h_exp_deriv : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w))
        (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hz₀ : z ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := htwo_sub_2s₀ hz
    have hϕ_d : HasDerivAt C.ϕ_ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      (hϕ_an_2s₀ z hz₀).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have h_mul : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w) (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      hϕ_d.const_mul Complex.I
    have h_cexp : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w))
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) * (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z)) z :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)).comp z h_mul
    have h_comm : Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) * (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) =
        Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) := by ring
    rwa [h_comm] at h_cexp

  have h_exp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) :=
    fun z hz => (h_exp_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hexp_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) :=
    h_exp_holo.analyticOnNhd (h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base))
  have hspeed_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) :=
    fun z hz => (hϕ_an_2s₀ z (htwo_sub_2s₀ hz)).deriv
  have hspeed_ne : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base), deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero z (htwo_sub_2s₀ hz)

  have h_curve_derivs : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      HasDerivAt (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0)
        (-(C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) z ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1)
        ((C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hz₀ : z ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := htwo_sub_2s₀ hz
    let θ := C.ϕ_ℂ z
    have hθ : θ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to z hz₀
    have hϕ_d : HasDerivAt C.ϕ_ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      (hϕ_an_2s₀ z hz₀).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hh_d : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ θ) θ :=
      (hh_an_2sh θ hθ).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hh'_d : HasDerivAt (deriv C.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ) θ :=
      (hh_an_2sh θ hθ).deriv.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hd_hϕ : HasDerivAt (fun w => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w)) (deriv C.h_ℂ θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      hh_d.comp z hϕ_d
    have hd_h'ϕ : HasDerivAt (fun w => deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w)) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      hh'_d.comp z hϕ_d
    have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ w)) (-Complex.sin θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos θ).comp z hϕ_d
    have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ w)) (Complex.cos θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) z :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin θ).comp z hϕ_d
    have hc0 : (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0) =
        fun w => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ w) - deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ w) := by
      ext w; simp [glancingBoundaryCurve]
    have hc1 : (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1) =
        fun w => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ w) + deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ w) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ w) := by
      ext w; simp [glancingBoundaryCurve]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hc0]
      have hd := (hd_hϕ.mul hd_cos).sub (hd_h'ϕ.mul hd_sin)
      have heq : deriv C.h_ℂ θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.cos θ +
          C.h_ℂ θ * (-Complex.sin θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) -
          (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.sin θ +
            deriv C.h_ℂ θ * (Complex.cos θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z)) =
          -(C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z) := by
        dsimp only [θ]; ring
      rwa [heq] at hd
    · rw [hc1]
      have hd := (hd_hϕ.mul hd_sin).add (hd_h'ϕ.mul hd_cos)
      have heq : deriv C.h_ℂ θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.sin θ +
          C.h_ℂ θ * (Complex.cos θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) +
          (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.cos θ +
            deriv C.h_ℂ θ * (-Complex.sin θ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z)) =
          (C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z) := by
        dsimp only [θ]; ring
      rwa [heq] at hd

  have hcurve_an : ∀ i : Fin 2, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => glancingBoundaryCurve C z i) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · have h0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => glancingBoundaryCurve C z 0) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) :=
        fun z hz => (h_curve_derivs z hz).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact h0.analyticOnNhd (h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base))
    · have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => glancingBoundaryCurve C z 1) (horizStrip (2 * W.s_base)) :=
        fun z hz => (h_curve_derivs z hz).2.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact h1.analyticOnNhd (h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base))

  have h_iso : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      (deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0) z +
        Complex.I * deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1) z =
        Complex.I * C.c * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) / (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2) ∧
      (deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0) z -
        Complex.I * deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1) z =
        -Complex.I * C.c / (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) * (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz₀ : z ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := htwo_sub_2s₀ hz
    obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := h_curve_derivs z hz
    rw [hd0.deriv, hd1.deriv]
    let θ := C.ϕ_ℂ z
    let R_θ := C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ
    let ϕ' := deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z
    have hϕ'_ne : ϕ' ≠ 0 := C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero z hz₀
    have hϕ'2_ne : ϕ' ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hϕ'_ne
    have hlaz : R_θ * ϕ' ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ) := C.lazutkin_norm_ℂ z hz₀
    have hexp_eq : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) = Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * Complex.I := by
      rw [mul_comm Complex.I θ, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    have hexp_ne : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have h_unit : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) * (Complex.cos θ - Complex.sin θ * Complex.I) = 1 := by
      rw [hexp_eq]
      calc (Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * Complex.I) * (Complex.cos θ - Complex.sin θ * Complex.I)
          = Complex.cos θ ^ 2 - Complex.sin θ ^ 2 * Complex.I ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = Complex.cos θ ^ 2 + Complex.sin θ ^ 2 := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        _ = 1 := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [eq_div_iff hϕ'2_ne]
      calc (-R_θ * ϕ' * Complex.sin θ + Complex.I * (R_θ * ϕ' * Complex.cos θ)) * ϕ' ^ 2
          = Complex.I * (R_θ * ϕ' ^ 3) * (Complex.cos θ + Complex.sin θ * Complex.I) := by
            linear_combination -(R_θ * ϕ' ^ 3 * Complex.sin θ) * Complex.I_sq
        _ = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) := by rw [hlaz, ← hexp_eq]
    · have h_den_ne : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) * ϕ' ^ 2 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hexp_ne hϕ'2_ne
      rw [eq_div_iff h_den_ne]
      calc (-R_θ * ϕ' * Complex.sin θ - Complex.I * (R_θ * ϕ' * Complex.cos θ)) *
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) * ϕ' ^ 2)
          = -Complex.I * (R_θ * ϕ' ^ 3) *
              (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) * (Complex.cos θ - Complex.sin θ * Complex.I)) := by
            linear_combination -(R_θ * ϕ' ^ 3 * Complex.sin θ * Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) * Complex.I_sq
        _ = -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * 1 := by rw [hlaz, h_unit]
        _ = -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) := mul_one _

  have hiso_pos : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0) z +
        Complex.I * deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1) z =
        Complex.I * C.c * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) / (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2 :=
    fun z hz => (h_iso z hz).1
  have hiso_neg : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 0) z -
        Complex.I * deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w 1) z =
        -Complex.I * C.c / (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) * (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2) :=
    fun z hz => (h_iso z hz).2
  have hexp_deriv : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      deriv (fun w => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w)) z =
        Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) :=
    fun z hz => (h_exp_deriv z hz).deriv

  have hcurve_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base), ∀ i : Fin 2,
      glancingBoundaryCurve C (starRingEnd ℂ z) i =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingBoundaryCurve C z i) := by
    intro z hz i
    have hz₀ : z ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := htwo_sub_2s₀ hz
    have hθ : C.ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to z hz₀
    have hθ_bar : starRingEnd ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      change |(C.ϕ_ℂ z).im| < 2 * C.s_h at hθ
      change |(starRingEnd ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z)).im| < 2 * C.s_h
      simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hθ
    have h_deriv_h_conj : deriv C.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) := by
      have hd : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) (C.ϕ_ℂ z) :=
        (hh_an_2sh (C.ϕ_ℂ z) hθ).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hd_cc := hd.conj_conj
      have h_ev : C.h_ℂ =ᶠ[nhds (starRingEnd ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z))]
          (⇑(starRingEnd ℂ) ∘ C.h_ℂ ∘ ⇑(starRingEnd ℂ)) := by
        filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * C.s_h)).mem_nhds hθ_bar] with w hw
        change C.h_ℂ w = starRingEnd ℂ (C.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w))
        rw [C.h_ℂ_conj w hw, Complex.conj_conj]
      exact (hd_cc.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).deriv
    fin_cases i
    · change glancingBoundaryCurve C (starRingEnd ℂ z) 0 = starRingEnd ℂ (glancingBoundaryCurve C z 0)
      dsimp only [glancingBoundaryCurve]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, C.ϕ_ℂ_conj z hz₀, C.h_ℂ_conj (C.ϕ_ℂ z) hθ, h_deriv_h_conj,
        Complex.cos_conj, Complex.sin_conj, map_sub, map_mul]
    · change glancingBoundaryCurve C (starRingEnd ℂ z) 1 = starRingEnd ℂ (glancingBoundaryCurve C z 1)
      dsimp only [glancingBoundaryCurve]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, C.ϕ_ℂ_conj z hz₀, C.h_ℂ_conj (C.ϕ_ℂ z) hθ,
        h_deriv_h_conj, Complex.cos_conj, Complex.sin_conj, map_add, map_mul]

  
  have h_atlas_exists :
      ∀ (T : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : MeroOn2D T)
        (hSlice_sub : ∀ s ∈ D_H, (s, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ T)
        (f_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
        (hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_init U_base2)
        (hf_agrees : MeroAgreesHolo F f_init U_base2),
        ∃ (δ : ℂ → ℝ) (N_tilde D_tilde : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, 0 < δ s) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, Metric.ball s (δ s) ⊆ D_H) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s (δ s),
            ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ, D_tilde s (w, 0) ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_tilde s) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) (δ s))) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_tilde s) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) (δ s))) ∧
          (∀ s₁ ∈ D_H, ∀ s₂ ∈ D_H,
            ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₁ (δ s₁) ∩ Metric.ball s₂ (δ s₂),
              N_tilde s₁ (z, 0) * D_tilde s₂ (z, 0) = N_tilde s₂ (z, 0) * D_tilde s₁ (z, 0)) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s (δ s),
            D_tilde s (z, 0) ≠ 0 →
            ∃ r_z : ℝ, 0 < r_z ∧
              Metric.ball z r_z ⊆ Metric.ball s (δ s) ∧
              Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ T ∧
              DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => N_tilde s q / D_tilde s q) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z) ∧
              MeroAgreesHolo F (fun q => N_tilde s q / D_tilde s q) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z)) ∧
          (∀ s ∈ D_H, ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            IsOpen U → (s, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → MeroAgreesHolo F g U →
            ∀ᶠ w in nhds s, N_tilde s (w, 0) = g (w, 0) * D_tilde s (w, 0)) := by
    intro T F hSlice_sub f_init hf_holo hf_agrees
    have h_compat_transfer :
        ∀ {p_a p_b : ℂ × ℂ} (hp_a : p_a ∈ T) (hp_b : p_b ∈ T)
          {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hV_open : IsOpen V)
          (hV_a : V ⊆ Metric.ball p_a (F.rad p_a))
          (hV_b : V ⊆ Metric.ball p_b (F.rad p_b))
          {N_t D_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
          (hN_cont : ContinuousOn N_t V) (hD_cont : ContinuousOn D_t V)
          (h_eq_a : ∀ q ∈ V, F.num p_a q * D_t q = N_t q * F.den p_a q),
          ∀ q ∈ V, F.num p_b q * D_t q = N_t q * F.den p_b q := by
      intro p_a p_b hp_a hp_b V hV_open hV_a hV_b N_t D_t hN_cont hD_cont h_eq_a q₀ hq₀
      by_contra h_ne
      let g_diff : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => F.num p_b q * D_t q - N_t q * F.den p_b q
      have hg_ne : g_diff q₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
      have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g_diff V :=
        (((F.num_holo p_b hp_b).continuousOn.mono hV_b).mul hD_cont).sub
          (hN_cont.mul ((F.den_holo p_b hp_b).continuousOn.mono hV_b))
      have h_nhds : {q : ℂ × ℂ | g_diff q ≠ 0} ∩ V ∈ nhds q₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          ((hg_cont.continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq₀)).eventually_ne hg_ne)
          (hV_open.mem_nhds hq₀)
      obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
      have h_den_zero_ball : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, F.den p_a q = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        have hq_mem := hη_sub hq
        have hq_V : q ∈ V := hq_mem.2
        have hq_ab : q ∈ Metric.ball p_b (F.rad p_b) ∩ Metric.ball p_a (F.rad p_a) :=
          ⟨hV_b hq_V, hV_a hq_V⟩
        have h_comp := F.compat p_b hp_b p_a hp_a q hq_ab
        have h_prod : g_diff q * F.den p_a q = 0 := by
          dsimp only [g_diff]
          calc (F.num p_b q * D_t q - N_t q * F.den p_b q) * F.den p_a q
              = (F.num p_b q * F.den p_a q) * D_t q - N_t q * F.den p_b q * F.den p_a q := by ring
            _ = (F.num p_a q * F.den p_b q) * D_t q - N_t q * F.den p_b q * F.den p_a q := by
                rw [h_comp]
            _ = (F.num p_a q * D_t q) * F.den p_b q - N_t q * F.den p_b q * F.den p_a q := by ring
            _ = (N_t q * F.den p_a q) * F.den p_b q - N_t q * F.den p_b q * F.den p_a q := by
                rw [h_eq_a q hq_V]
            _ = 0 := by ring
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_prod).resolve_left hq_mem.1
      have h_den_all_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_a (F.rad p_a), F.den p_a q = 0 :=
        heqOn_zero_ball (hV_a hq₀) hη_pos (F.den_holo p_a hp_a) h_den_zero_ball
      obtain ⟨q_nz, hq_nz_mem, hq_nz⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p_a hp_a
      exact hq_nz (h_den_all_zero q_nz hq_nz_mem)

    let dslopeT : (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun g p => dslope (fun t : ℂ => g (p.1, t)) 0 p.2

    have h_dslopeT_step :
        ∀ (s₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀) →
          (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ₀, g (y, 0) = 0) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslopeT g) (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀, p.2 * dslopeT g p = g p) := by
      intro s₀ δ₀ _hδ₀ g hg hg0
      let B : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀
      have hB_prod : B = Metric.ball s₀ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ :=
        (ball_prod_same s₀ (0 : ℂ) δ₀).symm
      have h_fac : ∀ p ∈ B, p.2 * dslopeT g p = g p := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_prod : p ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ := hB_prod ▸ hp
        have h_sub := sub_smul_dslope (fun t : ℂ => g (p.1, t)) 0 p.2
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hg0 p.1 hp_prod.1] at h_sub
        exact h_sub
      let g_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := pderivD g
      have hg_t : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_t B := (hpderiv_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hg).2
      have hg_ty : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA g_t) B :=
        (hpderiv_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hg_t).1
      have hg_tt : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD g_t) B :=
        (hpderiv_holo Metric.isOpen_ball hg_t).2
      have h_scale_mem : ∀ {r : ℝ} {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) r →
          ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) r := by
        intro r q hq u hu
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        refine ⟨hq.1, ?_⟩
        have hq2 : ‖q.2‖ < r := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq.2
        change (u : ℂ) * q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        have hu_norm : ‖(u : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu.1]
          exact hu.2
        calc ‖(u : ℂ) * q.2‖ = ‖(u : ℂ)‖ * ‖q.2‖ := norm_mul _ _
          _ ≤ 1 * ‖q.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu_norm (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖q.2‖ := one_mul _
          _ < r := hq2
      have h_int_eq : ∀ p ∈ B, dslopeT g p = ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, g_t (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2) := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_prod : p ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ := hB_prod ▸ hp
        by_cases ht : p.2 = 0
        · dsimp only [dslopeT, g_t, pderivD]
          rw [ht, dslope_same]
          simp only [mul_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, one_smul]
        · have h_cont_u : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => g_t (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
            rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
            exact hg_t.continuousOn.comp
              (continuousOn_const.prodMk ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn).mul continuousOn_const))
              (fun u hu => h_scale_mem hp u hu)
          have h_deriv_u : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
              HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => g (p.1, (τ : ℂ) * p.2)) (p.2 * g_t (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2)) u := by
            intro u hu
            rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hu
            have hpu : (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2) ∈ B := h_scale_mem hp u hu
            have hg_slice : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => g (p.1, w)) ((u : ℂ) * p.2) :=
              (hg.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hpu)).comp ((u : ℂ) * p.2)
                ((differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
            have h_out : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g (p.1, w)) (g_t (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2)) ((u : ℂ) * p.2) :=
              hg_slice.hasDerivAt
            have h_in : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 u := by
              simpa using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := u)).mul_const p.2
            have h_comp := HasDerivAt.scomp u h_out h_in
            rw [smul_eq_mul] at h_comp
            exact h_comp
          have h_int_prod :
              ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, p.2 * g_t (p.1, (u : ℂ) * p.2) = g p := by
            have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv_u
              ((continuousOn_const.mul h_cont_u).intervalIntegrable)
            simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul,
              hg0 p.1 hp_prod.1, sub_zero] at h_ftc
            exact h_ftc
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_int_prod
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ ht ((h_fac p hp).trans h_int_prod.symm)
      have h_fderiv_eq : ∀ q ∈ B,
          fderiv ℂ g_t q =
            pderivA g_t q • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
            pderivD g_t q • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ := by
        intro q hq
        have hdq : DifferentiableAt ℂ g_t q := hg_t.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq)
        have hL := hdq.hasFDerivAt
        have h1 : (fderiv ℂ g_t q) (1, 0) = pderivA g_t q := by
          have h_in1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) (1, 0) q.1 :=
            (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
          exact (hL.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 h_in1).deriv.symm
        have h2 : (fderiv ℂ g_t q) (0, 1) = pderivD g_t q := by
          have h_in2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (q.1, z)) (0, 1) q.2 :=
            (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
          exact (hL.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 h_in2).deriv.symm
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
        have hv : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
          ext <;> simp
        calc (fderiv ℂ g_t q) v
            = (fderiv ℂ g_t q) (v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) := by
                rw [← hv]
          _ = v.1 • (fderiv ℂ g_t q) (1, 0) + v.2 • (fderiv ℂ g_t q) (0, 1) := by
                rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
          _ = v.1 * pderivA g_t q + v.2 * pderivD g_t q := by
                rw [h1, h2, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
          _ = (pderivA g_t q • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
                pderivD g_t q • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) v := by
                simp [mul_comm]
      have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslopeT g) B := by
        intro p_star hp_star
        have h_dist : dist p_star (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) < δ₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp_star
        let δ₁ : ℝ := (dist p_star (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) + δ₀) / 2
        have hδ₁_gt : dist p_star (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) < δ₁ := by dsimp [δ₁]; linarith
        have hδ₁_lt : δ₁ < δ₀ := by dsimp [δ₁]; linarith
        let B₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁
        let K₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁
        have hp_B₁ : p_star ∈ B₁ := Metric.mem_ball.mpr hδ₁_gt
        have hK₁_sub : K₁ ⊆ B := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hδ₁_lt
        have hB₁_sub_K₁ : B₁ ⊆ K₁ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
        have hK₁_compact : IsCompact K₁ := isCompact_closedBall (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁
        obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := hK₁_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hg_ty.continuousOn.mono hK₁_sub)
        obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ := hK₁_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hg_tt.continuousOn.mono hK₁_sub)
        let M_bd : ℝ := max M₁ 0 + max M₂ 0
        let Φ_clm : ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          fun u => (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).prod ((u : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)
        let F_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun q u => g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)
        let F'_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun q u =>
          pderivA g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
          ((u : ℂ) * pderivD g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
        have h_F_cont : ∀ q ∈ B₁, ContinuousOn (F_int q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          intro q hq
          exact hg_t.continuousOn.comp
            (continuousOn_const.prodMk ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn).mul continuousOn_const))
            (fun u hu => hK₁_sub (hB₁_sub_K₁ (h_scale_mem hq u hu)))
        have h_F'_cont : ContinuousOn (F'_int p_star) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          have h_map : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (p_star.1, (u : ℂ) * p_star.2) ∈ B :=
            fun u hu => hK₁_sub (hB₁_sub_K₁ (h_scale_mem hp_B₁ u hu))
          have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => pderivA g_t (p_star.1, (u : ℂ) * p_star.2)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
            hg_ty.continuousOn.comp
              (continuousOn_const.prodMk ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn).mul continuousOn_const))
              h_map
          have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ) * pderivD g_t (p_star.1, (u : ℂ) * p_star.2)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
            Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul
              (hg_tt.continuousOn.comp
                (continuousOn_const.prodMk ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn).mul continuousOn_const))
                h_map)
          exact (hc1.smul continuousOn_const).add (hc2.smul continuousOn_const)
        have hB₁_nhds : B₁ ∈ nhds p_star := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp_B₁
        have h_meas_F : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_star,
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F_int q) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 1)) := by
          filter_upwards [hB₁_nhds] with q hq
          refine ((h_F_cont q hq).mono ?_).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
          exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
        have h_int_F0 : IntervalIntegrable (F_int p_star) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
          refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
          exact h_F_cont p_star hp_B₁
        have h_meas_F'0 :
            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F'_int p_star) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 1)) := by
          refine (h_F'_cont.mono ?_).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
          exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
        have h_bound : ∀ᵐ u ∂MeasureTheory.volume, u ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            ∀ q ∈ B₁, ‖F'_int q u‖ ≤ M_bd := by
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u hu q hq => ?_)
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hu
          have hu_icc : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hu.1, hu.2⟩
          have hqu_K₁ : (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) ∈ K₁ := hB₁_sub_K₁ (h_scale_mem hq u hu_icc)
          have hb1 : ‖pderivA g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)‖ ≤ max M₁ 0 :=
            le_trans (hM₁ _ hqu_K₁) (le_max_left _ _)
          have hb2 : ‖pderivD g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)‖ ≤ max M₂ 0 :=
            le_trans (hM₂ _ hqu_K₁) (le_max_left _ _)
          have hu_norm : ‖(u : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hu_icc.1]
            exact hu_icc.2
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
          dsimp only [F'_int]
          simp only [_root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst',
            ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul]
          calc ‖pderivA g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) * v.1 +
                  (u : ℂ) * pderivD g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) * v.2‖
              ≤ ‖pderivA g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) * v.1‖ +
                  ‖(u : ℂ) * pderivD g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2) * v.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖pderivA g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)‖ * ‖v.1‖ +
                  ‖(u : ℂ)‖ * ‖pderivD g_t (q.1, (u : ℂ) * q.2)‖ * ‖v.2‖ := by
                  simp only [norm_mul]
            _ ≤ max M₁ 0 * ‖v‖ + 1 * max M₂ 0 * ‖v‖ := by
                  gcongr
                  · exact norm_fst_le v
                  · exact norm_snd_le v
            _ = M_bd * ‖v‖ := by dsimp [M_bd]; ring
        have h_has_fderiv : ∀ᵐ u ∂MeasureTheory.volume, u ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
            ∀ q ∈ B₁, HasFDerivAt (fun x => F_int x u) (F'_int q u) q := by
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u hu q hq => ?_)
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hu
          have hu_icc : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hu.1, hu.2⟩
          have hqu_B : Φ_clm u q ∈ B := hK₁_sub (hB₁_sub_K₁ (h_scale_mem hq u hu_icc))
          have hd_gt : HasFDerivAt g_t (fderiv ℂ g_t (Φ_clm u q)) (Φ_clm u q) :=
            (hg_t.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hqu_B)).hasFDerivAt
          have h_comp := hd_gt.comp q (Φ_clm u).hasFDerivAt
          have h_clm_eq : (fderiv ℂ g_t (Φ_clm u q)).comp (Φ_clm u) = F'_int q u := by
            rw [h_fderiv_eq (Φ_clm u q) hqu_B]
            refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
            simp [Φ_clm, F'_int, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
          rw [h_clm_eq] at h_comp
          exact h_comp
        have h_int_fderiv := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
          hB₁_nhds h_meas_F h_int_F0 h_meas_F'0 h_bound intervalIntegrable_const h_has_fderiv
        have h_ev_eq : dslopeT g =ᶠ[nhds p_star] (fun x => ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..1, F_int x u) := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp_star] with x hx
          exact h_int_eq x hx
        exact (h_int_fderiv.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev_eq).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact ⟨h_holo, h_fac⟩

    have h_dslopeT_iter :
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (s₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀) →
          (∀ j < m, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ₀, (dslopeT^[j] g) (y, 0) = 0) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslopeT^[m] g) (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀, p.2 ^ m * (dslopeT^[m] g) p = g p) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro s₀ δ₀ _ g hg _
        refine ⟨by simpa using hg, fun p _ => by simp⟩
      | succ m ih =>
        intro s₀ δ₀ hδ₀ g hg hvan
        obtain ⟨hm_holo, hm_fac⟩ := ih s₀ δ₀ hδ₀ g hg (fun j hj => hvan j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj))
        obtain ⟨hstep_holo, hstep_fac⟩ :=
          h_dslopeT_step s₀ δ₀ hδ₀ (dslopeT^[m] g) hm_holo (hvan m (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
        refine ⟨by simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using hstep_holo, fun p hp => ?_⟩
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', pow_succ, mul_assoc, hstep_fac p hp, hm_fac p hp]

    have h_den_factor :
        ∀ s₀ ∈ D_H,
          ∃ (k : ℕ) (D_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ D_t (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) (F.rad (s₀, 0))) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) (F.rad (s₀, 0)),
              p.2 ^ k * D_t p = F.den (s₀, 0) p) ∧
            (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ F.rad (s₀, 0) →
              ∃ y₁ ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ, D_t (y₁, 0) ≠ 0) := by
      intro s₀ hs₀
      let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (s₀, 0)
      have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ T := hSlice_sub s₀ hs₀
      let δ_rad : ℝ := F.rad p₀
      have hδ_rad : 0 < δ_rad := F.rad_pos p₀ hp₀
      let D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := F.den p₀
      have hD_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D (Metric.ball p₀ δ_rad) := F.den_holo p₀ hp₀
      have h_ex_m : ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ_rad, (dslopeT^[m] D) (y, 0) ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_no_m
        have h_all_zero : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ_rad, (dslopeT^[m] D) (y, 0) = 0 := by
          intro m y hy
          by_contra h_nz
          exact h_no_m ⟨m, y, hy, h_nz⟩
        obtain ⟨q_star, hq_mem, hq_ne⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀
        have hq_prod : q_star ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ_rad ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rad :=
          (ball_prod_same s₀ (0 : ℂ) δ_rad).symm ▸ hq_mem
        have ht_ne : q_star.2 ≠ 0 := by
          intro ht0
          have h0 := h_all_zero 0 q_star.1 hq_prod.1
          simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] at h0
          apply hq_ne
          calc D q_star = D (q_star.1, q_star.2) := rfl
            _ = D (q_star.1, 0) := by rw [ht0]
            _ = 0 := h0
        have ht_pos : 0 < ‖q_star.2‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ht_ne
        have ht_lt : ‖q_star.2‖ < δ_rad := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq_prod.2
        let r : ℝ := (‖q_star.2‖ + δ_rad) / 2
        have hr_gt : ‖q_star.2‖ < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
        have hr_lt : r < δ_rad := by dsimp [r]; linarith
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_trans ht_pos hr_gt
        have hD_slice_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => D (q_star.1, t)) (Metric.ball 0 δ_rad) := by
          refine hD_holo.comp ((differentiableOn_const q_star.1).prodMk differentiableOn_id) ?_
          intro t ht
          rw [← ball_prod_same]
          exact ⟨hq_prod.1, ht⟩
        obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
          (hD_slice_holo.continuousOn.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr_lt))
        let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
        have h_bound_all : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖D q_star‖ ≤ M * (‖q_star.2‖ / r) ^ m := by
          intro m
          obtain ⟨hm_holo, hm_fac⟩ :=
            h_dslopeT_iter m s₀ δ_rad hδ_rad D hD_holo (fun j _ => h_all_zero j)
          let h_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => (dslopeT^[m] D) (q_star.1, t)
          have hhm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_m (Metric.ball 0 δ_rad) := by
            refine hm_holo.comp ((differentiableOn_const q_star.1).prodMk differentiableOn_id) ?_
            intro t ht
            rw [← ball_prod_same]
            exact ⟨hq_prod.1, ht⟩
          have hhm_diffCont : DiffContOnCl ℂ h_m (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
            hhm_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr_lt)
          have h_front : ∀ z ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r), ‖h_m z‖ ≤ M / r ^ m := by
            intro z hz
            rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hr_pos.ne', Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz
            have hq_z : (q_star.1, z) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ δ_rad := by
              rw [← ball_prod_same]
              refine ⟨hq_prod.1, ?_⟩
              change z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rad
              rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hz]
              exact hr_lt
            have h_eq_z := hm_fac (q_star.1, z) hq_z
            have h_norm_z : r ^ m * ‖h_m z‖ ≤ M := by
              calc r ^ m * ‖h_m z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ m * ‖h_m z‖ := by rw [hz]
                _ = ‖z ^ m * h_m z‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
                _ = ‖D (q_star.1, z)‖ := by rw [h_eq_z]
                _ ≤ M₀ := hM₀ z (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hz])
                _ ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
            exact (le_div_iff₀' (pow_pos hr_pos m)).mpr h_norm_z
          have h_m_pt : ‖h_m q_star.2‖ ≤ M / r ^ m :=
            Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hhm_diffCont h_front
              (subset_closure (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hr_gt))
          calc ‖D q_star‖ = ‖q_star.2 ^ m * h_m q_star.2‖ := by rw [hm_fac q_star hq_mem]
            _ = ‖q_star.2‖ ^ m * ‖h_m q_star.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
            _ ≤ ‖q_star.2‖ ^ m * (M / r ^ m) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_m_pt (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
            _ = M * (‖q_star.2‖ ^ m / r ^ m) := mul_div_left_comm _ _ _
            _ = M * (‖q_star.2‖ / r) ^ m := by rw [← div_pow]
        have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => M * (‖q_star.2‖ / r) ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa only [mul_zero] using
            tendsto_const_nhds.mul
              (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le)
                ((div_lt_one hr_pos).mpr hr_gt))
        have h_le_zero : ‖D q_star‖ ≤ 0 :=
          le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' tendsto_const_nhds h_tend h_bound_all
        exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ)) (lt_of_lt_of_le (norm_pos_iff.mpr hq_ne) h_le_zero)
      let k : ℕ := Nat.find h_ex_m
      obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁_mem, hy₁_ne⟩ := Nat.find_spec h_ex_m
      have hk_min : ∀ j < k, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ_rad, (dslopeT^[j] D) (y, 0) = 0 := by
        intro j hj y hy
        by_contra hy_ne
        exact Nat.find_min h_ex_m hj ⟨y, hy, hy_ne⟩
      obtain ⟨hk_holo, hk_fac⟩ := h_dslopeT_iter k s₀ δ_rad hδ_rad D hD_holo hk_min
      refine ⟨k, dslopeT^[k] D, hk_holo, hk_fac, fun δ hδ _hδ_le => ?_⟩
      by_contra h_no_y
      have h_sub_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ, (dslopeT^[k] D) (y, 0) = 0 := by
        intro y hy; by_contra h_nz; exact h_no_y ⟨y, hy, h_nz⟩
      have h_slice_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y : ℂ => (dslopeT^[k] D) (y, 0)) (Metric.ball s₀ δ_rad) := by
        refine (hk_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const 0)) ?_).analyticOnNhd
          Metric.isOpen_ball
        intro y hy
        rw [← ball_prod_same]
        exact ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_rad⟩
      have h_ev_zero : (fun y : ℂ => (dslopeT^[k] D) (y, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds s₀] 0 := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)] with y hy
        exact h_sub_zero y hy
      have h_eq_all := h_slice_an.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        (convex_ball s₀ δ_rad).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_rad) h_ev_zero
      exact hy₁_ne (h_eq_all hy₁_mem)

    let HasChart : ℂ → Prop := fun s₀ =>
      ∃ (δ : ℝ) (N_t D_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ F.rad (s₀, 0) ∧
        Metric.ball s₀ δ ⊆ D_H ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ N_t (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ D_t (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ) ∧
        (∃ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ, D_t (z₁, 0) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ,
          F.num (s₀, 0) q * D_t q = N_t q * F.den (s₀, 0) q)

    have h0_chart : HasChart 0 := by
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_rad, hr₀_U, hr₀_eq⟩ := hf_agrees.2 (0, 0) h00_U_base2
      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_DH⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hDH_open 0 h0_DH
      let δ := min r₀ r₁
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hr₀_pos hr₁_pos
      refine ⟨δ, f_init, fun _ => 1, hδ_pos, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₀_rad,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) hr₁_DH,
        hf_holo.mono (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr₀_U),
        differentiableOn_const 1,
        ⟨0, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos, one_ne_zero⟩,
        fun q hq => ?_⟩
      simp only [mul_one]
      exact hr₀_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)

    let S_good : Set ℂ := {s ∈ D_H | HasChart s}
    let S_bad : Set ℂ := {s ∈ D_H | ¬ HasChart s}

    have h_good_open : IsOpen S_good := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro s₀ ⟨hs₀_DH, δ₀, N₀, D₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_rad, hδ₀_DH, hN₀_holo, hD₀_holo, ⟨z₁, hz₁_mem, hz₁_ne⟩, h_eq₀⟩
      refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, fun s₁ hs₁ => ?_⟩
      have hs₁_DH : s₁ ∈ D_H := hδ₀_DH hs₁
      refine ⟨hs₁_DH, ?_⟩
      have h_gap : 0 < δ₀ - dist s₁ s₀ := sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hs₁)
      let δ₁ : ℝ := min (δ₀ - dist s₁ s₀) (F.rad (s₁, 0))
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := lt_min h_gap (F.rad_pos (s₁, 0) (hSlice_sub s₁ hs₁_DH))
      have h_sub_1d : Metric.ball s₁ δ₁ ⊆ Metric.ball s₀ δ₀ := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
        have h_le : δ₁ ≤ δ₀ - dist s₁ s₀ := min_le_left _ _
        linarith [dist_triangle z s₁ s₀]
      have h_sub_2d : Metric.ball (s₁, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ₀ := by
        intro q hq
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        exact ⟨h_sub_1d hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg)) hq.2⟩
      have h_nz_1d : ∃ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball s₁ δ₁, D₀ (z₂, 0) ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_no_z
        have h_all_z : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₁ δ₁, D₀ (y, 0) = 0 := by
          intro y hy; by_contra h_nz; exact h_no_z ⟨y, hy, h_nz⟩
        have h_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y : ℂ => D₀ (y, 0)) (Metric.ball s₀ δ₀) := by
          refine (hD₀_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const 0)) ?_).analyticOnNhd
            Metric.isOpen_ball
          intro y hy
          rw [← ball_prod_same]
          exact ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀_pos⟩
        have h_ev : (fun y : ℂ => D₀ (y, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds s₁] 0 := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₁_pos)] with y hy
          exact h_all_z y hy
        exact hz₁_ne (h_an.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          (convex_ball s₀ δ₀).isPreconnected hs₁ h_ev hz₁_mem)
      refine ⟨δ₁, N₀, D₀, hδ₁_pos, min_le_right _ _, Set.Subset.trans h_sub_1d hδ₀_DH,
        hN₀_holo.mono h_sub_2d, hD₀_holo.mono h_sub_2d, h_nz_1d, ?_⟩
      exact h_compat_transfer (hSlice_sub s₀ hs₀_DH) (hSlice_sub s₁ hs₁_DH)
        Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans h_sub_2d (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₀_rad))
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        (hN₀_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub_2d) (hD₀_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub_2d)
        (fun q hq => h_eq₀ q (h_sub_2d hq))

    have h_bad_open : IsOpen S_bad := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro s₀ ⟨hs₀_DH, hs₀_not⟩
      obtain ⟨r_D, hr_D_pos, hr_D_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hDH_open s₀ hs₀_DH
      let δ : ℝ := min r_D (F.rad (s₀, 0))
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hr_D_pos (F.rad_pos (s₀, 0) (hSlice_sub s₀ hs₀_DH))
      have hδ_rad : δ ≤ F.rad (s₀, 0) := min_le_right _ _
      have hδ_DH : Metric.ball s₀ δ ⊆ D_H :=
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr_D_sub
      refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun s₁ hs₁ => ⟨hδ_DH hs₁, ?_⟩⟩
      intro hs₁_chart
      apply hs₀_not
      obtain ⟨δ₁, N₁, D₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_rad, _, hN₁_holo, hD₁_holo, ⟨z₁, hz₁_mem, hz₁_ne⟩, h_eq₁⟩ := hs₁_chart
      obtain ⟨k, D_t, hDt_holo_rad, hDt_fac_rad, hDt_nz⟩ := h_den_factor s₀ hs₀_DH
      have hDt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_t (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ) :=
        hDt_holo_rad.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad)
      let V₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s₀ δ ∩ Metric.ball s₁ δ₁
      have hs₁_V₁ : s₁ ∈ V₁ := ⟨hs₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₁_pos⟩
      have hV₁_open : IsOpen V₁ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h_ex_zstar : ∃ z_star ∈ V₁, D₁ (z_star, 0) ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_no_z
        have h_all_z : ∀ y ∈ V₁, D₁ (y, 0) = 0 := by
          intro y hy; by_contra h_nz; exact h_no_z ⟨y, hy, h_nz⟩
        have h_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y : ℂ => D₁ (y, 0)) (Metric.ball s₁ δ₁) := by
          refine (hD₁_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const 0)) ?_).analyticOnNhd
            Metric.isOpen_ball
          intro y hy
          rw [← ball_prod_same]
          exact ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₁_pos⟩
        have h_ev : (fun y : ℂ => D₁ (y, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds s₁] 0 := by
          filter_upwards [hV₁_open.mem_nhds hs₁_V₁] with y hy
          exact h_all_z y hy
        exact hz₁_ne (h_an.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          (convex_ball s₁ δ₁).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₁_pos) h_ev hz₁_mem)
      obtain ⟨z_star, ⟨hz_s₀, hz_s₁⟩, hz_ne⟩ := h_ex_zstar
      have hz_2d_1 : (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball (s₁, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁ := by
        rw [← ball_prod_same]
        exact ⟨hz_s₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₁_pos⟩
      have h_cont_z : ContinuousAt D₁ (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) :=
        hD₁_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz_2d_1)
      obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀_pos, hη₀_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (h_cont_z.eventually_ne hz_ne)
      let η : ℝ := min η₀ (min (δ - dist z_star s₀) (δ₁ - dist z_star s₁))
      have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hη₀_pos
        (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz_s₀)) (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz_s₁)))
      have hη_sub_s₀ : Metric.ball (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) η ⊆ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ := by
        intro q hq
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg))) hq.2⟩
        have hq1 : dist q.1 z_star < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1
        have h_le : η ≤ δ - dist z_star s₀ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        linarith [dist_triangle q.1 z_star s₀]
      have hη_sub_s₁ : Metric.ball (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) η ⊆ Metric.ball (s₁, (0 : ℂ)) δ₁ := by
        intro q hq
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg))) hq.2⟩
        have hq1 : dist q.1 z_star < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1
        have h_le : η ≤ δ₁ - dist z_star s₁ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        linarith [dist_triangle q.1 z_star s₁]
      have h_trans_η : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) η,
          F.num (s₀, 0) q * D₁ q = N₁ q * F.den (s₀, 0) q :=
        h_compat_transfer (hSlice_sub s₁ (hδ_DH hs₁)) (hSlice_sub s₀ hs₀_DH)
          Metric.isOpen_ball
          (Set.Subset.trans hη_sub_s₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₁_rad))
          (Set.Subset.trans hη_sub_s₀ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad))
          (hN₁_holo.continuousOn.mono hη_sub_s₁)
          (hD₁_holo.continuousOn.mono hη_sub_s₁)
          (fun q hq => h_eq₁ q (hη_sub_s₁ hq))
      let N : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := F.num (s₀, 0)
      have hN_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N (Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ) :=
        (F.num_holo (s₀, 0) (hSlice_sub s₀ hs₀_DH)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad)
      have hN_van : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ k → ∀ j < m, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ, (dslopeT^[j] N) (y, 0) = 0 := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro _ j hj; exact absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
        | succ m ih =>
          intro hm_le j hj
          have hm_prev := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm_le)
          rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj) with hj_lt | hj_eq
          · exact hm_prev j hj_lt
          · rw [hj_eq]
            obtain ⟨hm_holo, hm_fac⟩ := h_dslopeT_iter m s₀ δ hδ_pos N hN_holo hm_prev
            have h_zero_η : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z_star η, (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, 0) = 0 := by
              intro y hy
              let t_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((η / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
              have ht_tend : Filter.Tendsto t_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
                have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => η / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
                  have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
                    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
                      (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds)
                  exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop h_atTop
                have hc := Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h_real
                rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at hc
                exact hc
              have hy0_η : (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) η := by
                rw [← ball_prod_same]
                exact ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
              have h_seq_eq : ∀ n : ℕ,
                  (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, t_seq n) * D₁ (y, t_seq n) =
                  t_seq n ^ (k - m) * N₁ (y, t_seq n) * D_t (y, t_seq n) := by
                intro n
                have h_pos_n : 0 < η / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) :=
                  div_pos hη_pos (by positivity)
                have h_lt_n : η / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) < η := by
                  have h_den_gt : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
                    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
                    linarith
                  exact div_lt_self hη_pos h_den_gt
                have ht_ne : t_seq n ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_pos_n.ne'
                have hq_η : (y, t_seq n) ∈ Metric.ball (z_star, (0 : ℂ)) η := by
                  rw [← ball_prod_same]
                  refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
                  change t_seq n ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) η
                  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                    abs_of_pos h_pos_n]
                  exact h_lt_n
                have hq_s₀ : (y, t_seq n) ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) δ := hη_sub_s₀ hq_η
                have hq_rad : (y, t_seq n) ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) (F.rad (s₀, 0)) :=
                  Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad hq_s₀
                have h1 := hm_fac (y, t_seq n) hq_s₀
                have h2 := h_trans_η (y, t_seq n) hq_η
                have h3 := hDt_fac_rad (y, t_seq n) hq_rad
                have hk_split : k = m + (k - m) := (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm_le)).symm
                apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero m ht_ne)
                calc t_seq n ^ m * ((dslopeT^[m] N) (y, t_seq n) * D₁ (y, t_seq n))
                    = (t_seq n ^ m * (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, t_seq n)) * D₁ (y, t_seq n) := by ring
                  _ = N (y, t_seq n) * D₁ (y, t_seq n) := by rw [h1]
                  _ = N₁ (y, t_seq n) * F.den (s₀, 0) (y, t_seq n) := h2
                  _ = N₁ (y, t_seq n) * (t_seq n ^ k * D_t (y, t_seq n)) := by rw [← h3]
                  _ = N₁ (y, t_seq n) * ((t_seq n ^ m * t_seq n ^ (k - m)) * D_t (y, t_seq n)) := by
                      rw [← pow_add, ← hk_split]
                  _ = t_seq n ^ m * (t_seq n ^ (k - m) * N₁ (y, t_seq n) * D_t (y, t_seq n)) := by ring
              have h_pt_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (y, t_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (y, (0 : ℂ))) :=
                tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds ht_tend
              have h_lhs_tend : Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n : ℕ => (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, t_seq n) * D₁ (y, t_seq n))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds ((dslopeT^[m] N) (y, 0) * D₁ (y, 0))) :=
                ((hm_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hη_sub_s₀ hy0_η))).tendsto.comp h_pt_tend).mul
                  ((hD₁_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hη_sub_s₁ hy0_η))).tendsto.comp h_pt_tend)
              have hk_sub_ne : k - m ≠ 0 := by omega
              have h_rhs_tend : Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n : ℕ => t_seq n ^ (k - m) * N₁ (y, t_seq n) * D_t (y, t_seq n))
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
                have h_pow0 : (0 : ℂ) ^ (k - m) = 0 := zero_pow hk_sub_ne
                have h_t_pow : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => t_seq n ^ (k - m)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
                  simpa [h_pow0] using ht_tend.pow (k - m)
                simpa using (h_t_pow.mul
                  ((hN₁_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hη_sub_s₁ hy0_η))).tendsto.comp h_pt_tend)).mul
                  ((hDt_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hη_sub_s₀ hy0_η))).tendsto.comp h_pt_tend)
              have h_lim_eq : (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, 0) * D₁ (y, 0) = 0 :=
                tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs_tend (by simpa only [← h_seq_eq] using h_rhs_tend)
              have hD1_y0_ne : D₁ (y, 0) ≠ 0 :=
                hη₀_nz (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy0_η) (min_le_left _ _))
              exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_lim_eq).resolve_right hD1_y0_ne
            have h_an_m : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y : ℂ => (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, 0)) (Metric.ball s₀ δ) := by
              refine (hm_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const 0)) ?_).analyticOnNhd
                Metric.isOpen_ball
              intro y hy
              rw [← ball_prod_same]
              exact ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos⟩
            have h_ev_m : (fun y : ℂ => (dslopeT^[m] N) (y, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds z_star] 0 := by
              filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)] with y hy
              exact h_zero_η y hy
            exact h_an_m.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
              (convex_ball s₀ δ).isPreconnected hz_s₀ h_ev_m
      obtain ⟨hNk_holo, hNk_fac⟩ := h_dslopeT_iter k s₀ δ hδ_pos N hN_holo (hN_van k le_rfl)
      refine ⟨δ, dslopeT^[k] N, D_t, hδ_pos, hδ_rad, hδ_DH, hNk_holo, hDt_holo,
        hDt_nz δ hδ_pos hδ_rad, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hq_rad : q ∈ Metric.ball (s₀, (0 : ℂ)) (F.rad (s₀, 0)) := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad hq
      calc F.num (s₀, 0) q * D_t q
          = (q.2 ^ k * (dslopeT^[k] N) q) * D_t q := by rw [hNk_fac q hq]
        _ = (dslopeT^[k] N) q * (q.2 ^ k * D_t q) := by ring
        _ = (dslopeT^[k] N) q * F.den (s₀, 0) q := by rw [hDt_fac_rad q hq_rad]

    have h_all_chart : ∀ s ∈ D_H, HasChart s := by
      intro s hs
      by_contra hs_not
      have h_sub_union : D_H ⊆ S_good ∪ S_bad := fun z hz =>
        by_cases (fun h : HasChart z => Or.inl ⟨hz, h⟩) (fun h => Or.inr ⟨hz, h⟩)
      obtain ⟨w, _, hw_good, hw_bad⟩ :=
        hDH_preconn S_good S_bad h_good_open h_bad_open h_sub_union
          ⟨0, h0_DH, h0_DH, h0_chart⟩ ⟨s, hs, hs, hs_not⟩
      exact hw_bad.2 hw_good.2

    let δ_fn : ℂ → ℝ := fun s => if hs : s ∈ D_H then Classical.choose (h_all_chart s hs) else 1
    let N_fn : ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) := fun s =>
      if hs : s ∈ D_H then Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_all_chart s hs)) else fun _ => 0
    let D_fn : ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) := fun s =>
      if hs : s ∈ D_H then
        Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_all_chart s hs)))
      else fun _ => 1

    have h_spec : ∀ s (hs : s ∈ D_H),
        0 < δ_fn s ∧ δ_fn s ≤ F.rad (s, 0) ∧

      intro s hs

      fun s hs => (h_spec s hs).1,

    · obtain ⟨hδ_pos, _, _, _, hD_holo, ⟨z₁, hz₁_mem, hz₁_ne⟩, _⟩ := h_spec s hs
      have h_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun w : ℂ => D_fn s (w, 0)) (Metric.ball s (δ_fn s)) := by
        refine (hD_holo.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const 0)) ?_).analyticOnNhd

    · obtain ⟨_, hδ₁_rad, hδ₁_DH, hN₁_holo, hD₁_holo, _, h_eq₁⟩ := h_spec s₁ hs₁
      obtain ⟨_, hδ₂_rad, _, hN₂_holo, hD₂_holo, _, h_eq₂⟩ := h_spec s₂ hs₂

      have h_sub₁ : Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) η ⊆ Metric.ball (s₁, (0 : ℂ)) (δ_fn s₁) := by

        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg))) hq.2⟩
        have hq1 : dist q.1 z < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1

        linarith [dist_triangle q.1 z s₁]
      have h_sub₂ : Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) η ⊆ Metric.ball (s₂, (0 : ℂ)) (δ_fn s₂) := by
        intro q hq
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg))) hq.2⟩
        have hq1 : dist q.1 z < η := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1
        have h_le : η ≤ δ_fn s₂ - dist z s₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        linarith [dist_triangle q.1 z s₂]
      have h_tr₁ := h_compat_transfer (hSlice_sub s₁ hs₁) hp_z Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans h_sub₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₁_rad))
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
        (hN₁_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub₁) (hD₁_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub₁)
        (fun q hq => h_eq₁ q (h_sub₁ hq))
      have h_tr₂ := h_compat_transfer (hSlice_sub s₂ hs₂) hp_z Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans h_sub₂ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₂_rad))
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
        (hN₂_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub₂) (hD₂_holo.continuousOn.mono h_sub₂)

      obtain ⟨η', hη'_pos, hη'_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hg_cont.eventually_ne hg_ne)
      let η₂ := min η η'
      have hη₂_pos : 0 < η₂ := lt_min hη_pos hη'_pos
      have h_den_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) η₂, F.den (z, 0) q = 0 := by

        have h_mul : g_cr q * F.den (z, 0) q = 0 := by

          calc (N_fn s₁ q * D_fn s₂ q - N_fn s₂ q * D_fn s₁ q) * F.den (z, 0) q

    · obtain ⟨hδ_pos, hδ_rad, _, hN_holo, hD_holo, _, h_eq⟩ := h_spec s hs
      have hz_2d : (z, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) (δ_fn s) := by
        rw [← ball_prod_same]
        exact ⟨hz, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos⟩
      have hD_cont : ContinuousAt (D_fn s) (z, 0) :=
        hD_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz_2d)
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hD_cont.eventually_ne hDz_ne)

      have h_sub_1d : Metric.ball z r_z ⊆ Metric.ball s (δ_fn s) := by

      have h_sub_2d : Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) (δ_fn s) := by
        intro q hq

        exact ⟨h_sub_1d hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (sub_le_self _ dist_nonneg)) hq.2⟩
      have h_sub_T : Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ T :=
        Set.Subset.trans h_sub_2d

      have h_nz_ball : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z, D_fn s q ≠ 0 :=
        fun q hq => hr₀_nz (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) (min_le_left _ _))
      have h_quot_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => N_fn s q / D_fn s q) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z) := by
        have h_eq_div : (fun q => N_fn s q / D_fn s q) = (N_fn s * fun x => (D_fn s x)⁻¹) :=

        intro q hq

        exact (hN_at.mul h_inv_at).differentiableWithinAt
      refine ⟨r_z, hrz_pos, h_sub_1d, h_sub_T, h_quot_holo, ⟨h_sub_T, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
      have hp_T : p ∈ T := h_sub_T hp

        have h_le : r_p ≤ r_z - dist p (z, 0) := min_le_left _ _
        linarith [dist_triangle q p (z, 0)]
      have h_tr := h_compat_transfer (hSlice_sub s hs) hp_T Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans (Set.Subset.trans hrp_sub_rz h_sub_2d) (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_rad))
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        (hN_holo.continuousOn.mono (Set.Subset.trans hrp_sub_rz h_sub_2d))
        (hD_holo.continuousOn.mono (Set.Subset.trans hrp_sub_rz h_sub_2d))
        (fun q hq => h_eq q (h_sub_2d (hrp_sub_rz hq)))
      refine ⟨r_p, hrp_pos, min_le_right _ _, hrp_sub_rz, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hDs_ne : D_fn s q ≠ 0 := h_nz_ball q (hrp_sub_rz hq)
      have h_mul_q := h_tr q hq
      calc F.num p q = (F.num p q * D_fn s q) / D_fn s q := (mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hDs_ne).symm
        _ = (N_fn s q * F.den p q) / D_fn s q := by rw [h_mul_q]
        _ = (N_fn s q / D_fn s q) * F.den p q := by ring
    · obtain ⟨hδ_pos, _, _, hN_holo, hD_holo, _, h_eq⟩ := h_spec s hs
      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_rad, hr₁_U, hr₁_eq⟩ := hg_agrees.2 (s, 0) hsU
      let η : ℝ := min r₁ (δ_fn s)

      have h_eq_2d : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) η, N_fn s q = g q * D_fn s q := by

              (hD_holo.continuousOn.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))))).continuousAt

        obtain ⟨η', hη'_pos, hη'_nz⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hgd_cont.eventually_ne hgd_ne)
        let r_b : ℝ := min (η - dist q₀ (s, 0)) η'

                  rw [← h_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq_η),

        exact hq_nz (heqOn_zero_ball
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₁_rad) hq₀) hrb_pos

  have h_eq_zero_of_cont_nhdsNE :
      ∀ {R : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}, ContinuousAt R s → (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ, R z = 0) → R s = 0 := by
    intro R s h_cont h_ev
    let z_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => s + ((1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hz_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, z_seq n ≠ s := by
      intro n h_eq
      have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := div_pos one_pos (by positivity)
      dsimp only [z_seq] at h_eq
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_pos.ne' (add_left_cancel (h_eq.trans (add_zero s).symm))
    have hz_tend : Filter.Tendsto z_seq Filter.atTop (nhds s) := by
      have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds)
      simpa [z_seq] using tendsto_const_nhds.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h_real)
    have hz_nhdsNE : Filter.Tendsto z_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ hz_tend
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hz_ne)
    have h_ev_seq : (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] (fun n : ℕ => R (z_seq n)) := by
      filter_upwards [hz_nhdsNE.eventually h_ev] with n hn
      exact hn.symm
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (h_cont.tendsto.comp hz_tend) (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h_ev_seq)

  have hq_mero : ∀ (i : Fin 2) {s : ℂ}, s ∈ D_H → MeromorphicOn (q_chart i s) (B_chart i s) := by
    intro i s hs

  have hΓ_raw_chart_eq : ∀ (i : Fin 2) {s₀ : ℂ} (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ D_H),
      ∀ z ∈ B_chart i s₀, Γ_raw z i = toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀) z := by

    rw [h_raw_def]
    have h_nf_z : MeromorphicNFAt (toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i z) (B_chart i z)) z :=
      meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn _ _ (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i z hz_DH))
    have h_nf_s0 : MeromorphicNFAt (toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀)) z :=
      meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn _ _ hz
    have h_ev_q : q_chart i z =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] q_chart i s₀ := by
      have h_mem_both : B_chart i s₀ ∩ B_chart i z ∈ nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hz, Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i z hz_DH)⟩)
      filter_upwards [h_mem_both,
        hDX_ev_ne i s₀ hs₀ z hz,
        hDX_ev_ne i z hz_DH z (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i z hz_DH))] with w hw hDs0 hDz
      dsimp only [q_chart]
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hDz hDs0]
      exact hX_overlap i z hz_DH s₀ hs₀ w ⟨hw.2, hw.1⟩
    have h_ev_nf : toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i z) (B_chart i z) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ]
        toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀) :=
      ((hq_mero i hz_DH).toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE
        (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i z hz_DH))).trans
        (h_ev_q.trans ((hq_mero i hs₀).toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hz).symm)
    exact ((h_nf_z.eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds h_nf_s0).mp h_ev_nf).eq_of_nhds

  have hΓ_raw_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (fun z => Γ_raw z i) D_H := by
    intro i s₀ hs₀
    have hs₀_ball : s₀ ∈ B_chart i s₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i s₀ hs₀)
    have h_nf_mero : MeromorphicAt (toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀)) s₀ :=
      (meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀)).meromorphicOn s₀ hs₀_ball
    have h_ev : toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s₀) (B_chart i s₀) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s₀ {s₀}ᶜ]
        (fun z => Γ_raw z i) := by
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_ball)] with z hz
      exact (hΓ_raw_chart_eq i hs₀ z hz).symm
    exact h_nf_mero.congr h_ev

  have hΓ_slice_eq_q_nhdsNE : ∀ (i : Fin 2) {s : ℂ} (hs : s ∈ D_H),
      (fun w => Γ_slice w i) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ] q_chart i s := by
    intro i s hs
    have hs_ball : s ∈ B_chart i s := Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i s hs)
    have h1 : (fun w => Γ_slice w i) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ] (fun w => Γ_raw w i) :=
      (hΓ_raw_mero i).toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hs
    have h2 : (fun w => Γ_raw w i) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ]
        toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s) (B_chart i s) := by
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_ball)] with w hw
      exact hΓ_raw_chart_eq i hs w hw
    have h3 : toMeromorphicNFOn (q_chart i s) (B_chart i s) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ] q_chart i s :=
      (hq_mero i hs).toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hs_ball
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

  let dZ_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
    deriv (fun w => Γ_slice w 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (fun w => Γ_slice w 1) z
  let dW_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
    deriv (fun w => Γ_slice w 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (fun w => Γ_slice w 1) z
  let A_2 : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => -dZ_m z / dW_m z
  let f_raw : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv A_2 z / (2 * Complex.I * A_2 z)
  let f_mero : ℂ → ℂ := toMeromorphicNFOn f_raw D_H
  let a_raw : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (f_mero z) ^ 2 * dZ_m z / (Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ))
  let a_mero : ℂ → ℂ := toMeromorphicNFOn a_raw D_H

  have hdZ_mero : MeromorphicOn dZ_m D_H :=
    hΓ_mero.1.deriv.add ((MeromorphicOn.const Complex.I).mul hΓ_mero.2.deriv)
  have hdW_mero : MeromorphicOn dW_m D_H :=
    hΓ_mero.1.deriv.sub ((MeromorphicOn.const Complex.I).mul hΓ_mero.2.deriv)
  have h_neg_dZ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun z => -dZ_m z) D_H :=
    ((MeromorphicOn.const (0 : ℂ)).sub hdZ_mero).congr (fun z _ => zero_sub (dZ_m z)) hDH_open
  have hA2_mero : MeromorphicOn A_2 D_H := h_neg_dZ_mero.div hdW_mero
  have hf_raw_mero : MeromorphicOn f_raw D_H :=
    hA2_mero.deriv.div ((MeromorphicOn.const (2 * Complex.I)).mul hA2_mero)
  have hf_nf : MeromorphicNFOn f_mero D_H := meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn _ _
  have hf_mero_on : MeromorphicOn f_mero D_H := hf_nf.meromorphicOn
  have hf2_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun z => (f_mero z) ^ 2) D_H :=
    (hf_mero_on.mul hf_mero_on).congr (fun z _ => (sq (f_mero z)).symm) hDH_open
  have ha_raw_mero : MeromorphicOn a_raw D_H :=
    (hf2_mero.mul hdZ_mero).div (MeromorphicOn.const (Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ)))
  have ha_nf : MeromorphicNFOn a_mero D_H := meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn _ _
  have ha_mero_on : MeromorphicOn a_mero D_H := ha_nf.meromorphicOn

  have h_Γ_base2_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base), ∀ i : Fin 2,
      Γ_slice z i = glancingBoundaryCurve C z i := by
    intro z hz i
    have hz_DH : z ∈ D_H := htwo_sub_DH hz
    have hz_U2 : (z, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_base2 := ⟨hz, by simp [W.r_base_pos]⟩
    have h_ev_mul := hX_slice_eq i z hz_DH U_base2
      (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i) hU_base2_open hz_U2 (himpact_holo i) (W.X_agrees_two i)
    have h_ev_q : q_chart i z =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w i) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_mul.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hz),
        hDX_ev_ne i z hz_DH z (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos i z hz_DH))] with w hw_mul hw_hs hDw
      dsimp only [q_chart]
      rw [hw_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hDw, himpact_zero w hw_hs i]
    have h_ev_nf := (hΓ_slice_eq_q_nhdsNE i hz_DH).trans h_ev_q
    exact (((hΓ_nf_i i hz_DH).eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds
      (hcurve_an i z hz).meromorphicNFAt).mp h_ev_nf).eq_of_nhds

  have h_af_base2_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
      f_mero z = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z ∧ a_mero z = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) := by
    have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr C.c_pos.ne'
    have h_deriv_Γ_eq : ∀ (i : Fin 2), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
        deriv (fun w => Γ_slice w i) z = deriv (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w i) z := by
      intro i z hz
      have h_ev : (fun w => Γ_slice w i) =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun w => glancingBoundaryCurve C w i) := by
        filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact h_Γ_base2_eq w hw i
      exact h_ev.deriv_eq
    have hdZ_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
        dZ_m z = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) / (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [dZ_m]
      rw [h_deriv_Γ_eq 0 z hz, h_deriv_Γ_eq 1 z hz, hiso_pos z hz]
    have hdW_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
        dW_m z = -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) / (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) * (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 2) := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [dW_m]
      rw [h_deriv_Γ_eq 0 z hz, h_deriv_Γ_eq 1 z hz, hiso_neg z hz]
    have hA2_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
        A_2 z = (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) ^ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [A_2]
      rw [hdZ_eq z hz, hdW_eq z hz]
      have hexp_ne : Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      have hϕ'_ne : deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0 := hspeed_ne z hz
      field_simp [hc_ne, Complex.I_ne_zero, hexp_ne, hϕ'_ne]
    have hf_raw_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base), f_raw z = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z := by
      intro z hz
      have hA2_ev : A_2 =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun w => (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w)) ^ 2) := by
        filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact hA2_eq w hw
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w))
          (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) z := by
        have h_an := hexp_an z hz
        rw [← hexp_deriv z hz]
        exact h_an.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hd_sq : HasDerivAt (fun w => (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w)) ^ 2)
          (2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) ^ (2 - 1) *
            (Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z))) z :=
        hd_exp.pow 2
      have h_deriv_A2 : deriv A_2 z =
          2 * Complex.I * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hA2_ev.deriv_eq, hd_sq.deriv]
        ring
      dsimp only [f_raw]
      rw [h_deriv_A2, hA2_eq z hz]
      have hexp_ne : Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      field_simp [Complex.I_ne_zero, hexp_ne]
    have hf_mero_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base), f_mero z = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_DH : z ∈ D_H := htwo_sub_DH hz
      have h_ev1 : f_mero =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] f_raw :=
        hf_raw_mero.toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hz_DH
      have h_ev2 : f_raw =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] deriv C.ϕ_ℂ := by
        filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hz)] with w hw
        exact hf_raw_eq w hw
      exact (((hf_nf hz_DH).eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds
        (hspeed_an z hz).meromorphicNFAt).mp (h_ev1.trans h_ev2)).eq_of_nhds
    have ha_raw_eq : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base),
        a_raw z = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ z) := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only [a_raw]
      rw [hf_mero_eq z hz, hdZ_eq z hz]
      have hϕ'_ne : deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0 := hspeed_ne z hz
      field_simp [hc_ne, Complex.I_ne_zero, hϕ'_ne]
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨hf_mero_eq z hz, ?_⟩
    have hz_DH : z ∈ D_H := htwo_sub_DH hz
    have h_ev1 : a_mero =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] a_raw :=
      ha_raw_mero.toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hz_DH
    have h_ev2 : a_raw =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] (fun w => Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ w)) := by
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds ((h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hz)] with w hw
      exact ha_raw_eq w hw
    exact (((ha_nf hz_DH).eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds
      (hexp_an z hz).meromorphicNFAt).mp (h_ev1.trans h_ev2)).eq_of_nhds

  have h_slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
      Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
      a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
      f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs2 : s ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := hbase_sub_two hs
    refine ⟨funext (fun i => h_Γ_base2_eq s hs2 i),
      (h_af_base2_eq s hs2).2, (h_af_base2_eq s hs2).1⟩

  let IsSliceReg : ℂ → Prop := fun s =>
    s ∈ D_H ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧ a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧ f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ (r₀ : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r₀ ∧
      Metric.ball s r₀ ⊆ D_H ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r₀ ⊆ T_X ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r₀)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r₀))

  let E_disc : Set ℂ := {s ∈ D_H | ¬ IsSliceReg s}

  have h_base_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, IsSliceReg s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs2 : s ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := hbase_sub_two hs
    have hs_DH : s ∈ D_H := htwo_sub_DH hs2
    have ha_an_s : AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s := by
      refine (hexp_an s hs2).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hs2] with w hw
      exact (h_af_base2_eq w hw).2.symm
    have hf_an_s : AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s := by
      refine (hspeed_an s hs2).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds hs2] with w hw
      exact (h_af_base2_eq w hw).1.symm
    have ha_ne_s : a_mero s ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(h_af_base2_eq s hs2).2]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hf_ne_s : f_mero s ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(h_af_base2_eq s hs2).1]
      exact hspeed_ne s hs2
    let r₀ : ℝ := min W.s_base W.r_base
    have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min W.s_base_pos W.r_base_pos
    have h_sub_1d : Metric.ball s r₀ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := by
      intro z hz
      change |s.im| < W.s_base at hs
      change |z.im| < 2 * W.s_base
      have h_dist_r0 : ‖z - s‖ < r₀ := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
      have h_dist : ‖z - s‖ < W.s_base := lt_of_lt_of_le h_dist_r0 (min_le_left _ _)
      have h_im : |(z - s).im| ≤ ‖z - s‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - s)
      have h_eq : z.im = (z - s).im + s.im := by simp
      rw [h_eq]
      calc |(z - s).im + s.im| ≤ |(z - s).im| + |s.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ < W.s_base + W.s_base := add_lt_add (lt_of_le_of_lt h_im h_dist) hs
        _ = 2 * W.s_base := by ring
    have h_sub_U2 : Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r₀ ⊆ U_base2 := by
      intro p hp
      rw [← ball_prod_same] at hp
      refine ⟨h_sub_1d hp.1, ?_⟩
      have hp2_r0 : ‖p.2‖ < r₀ := by
        have h := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2
        rwa [dist_zero_right] at h
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_r0 (min_le_right _ _)
    refine ⟨hs_DH, ha_an_s, ha_ne_s, hf_an_s, hf_ne_s,
      r₀, fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i, hr₀_pos,
      Set.Subset.trans h_sub_1d htwo_sub_DH,
      Set.Subset.trans h_sub_U2 (W.X_agrees_two 0).1,
      fun i => (himpact_holo i).mono h_sub_U2,
      fun i => ⟨Set.Subset.trans h_sub_U2 (W.X_agrees_two i).1, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_rad, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := (W.X_agrees_two i).2 p (h_sub_U2 hp)
    let r₂ : ℝ := min r₁ (r₀ - dist p (s, 0))
    have hr₂_pos : 0 < r₂ := lt_min hr₁_pos (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hp))
    have hr₂_sub : Metric.ball p r₂ ⊆ Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r₀ := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
      have h_le : r₂ ≤ r₀ - dist p (s, 0) := min_le_right _ _
      linarith [dist_triangle q p (s, 0)]
    exact ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₁_rad, hr₂_sub,
      fun q hq => hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)⟩

  have hE_base_disj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc :=
    fun s hs hE => hE.2 (h_base_reg s hs)

  have ha_ord_ne_top : ∀ s ∈ D_H, meromorphicOrderAt a_mero s ≠ ⊤ := by
    have h0_reg := h_base_reg 0 h0_base
    have h_ev0 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {0}ᶜ, a_mero z ≠ 0 :=
      (h0_reg.2.1.continuousAt.eventually_ne h0_reg.2.2.1).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h0_ne_top : meromorphicOrderAt a_mero 0 ≠ ⊤ :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (ha_mero_on 0 h0_DH)).mpr h_ev0
    exact fun s hs => ha_mero_on.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hDH_preconn h0_DH hs h0_ne_top

  have hf_ord_ne_top : ∀ s ∈ D_H, meromorphicOrderAt f_mero s ≠ ⊤ := by
    have h0_reg := h_base_reg 0 h0_base
    have h_ev0 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {0}ᶜ, f_mero z ≠ 0 :=
      (h0_reg.2.2.2.1.continuousAt.eventually_ne h0_reg.2.2.2.2.1).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h0_ne_top : meromorphicOrderAt f_mero 0 ≠ ⊤ :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (hf_mero_on 0 h0_DH)).mpr h_ev0
    exact fun s hs => hf_mero_on.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hDH_preconn h0_DH hs h0_ne_top

  have hE_isolated : ∀ s ∈ D_H, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ D_H ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc := by
    intro s hs
    have h_ev_all : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ,
        AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero z ∧ a_mero z ≠ 0 ∧
        AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero z ∧ f_mero z ≠ 0 ∧
        D_X 0 s (z, 0) ≠ 0 ∧ D_X 1 s (z, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [(ha_mero_on s hs).eventually_analyticAt,
        (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (ha_mero_on s hs)).mp (ha_ord_ne_top s hs),
        (hf_mero_on s hs).eventually_analyticAt,
        (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (hf_mero_on s hs)).mp (hf_ord_ne_top s hs),
        hDX_ev_ne 0 s hs s (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos 0 s hs)),
        hDX_ev_ne 1 s hs s (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδX_pos 1 s hs))]
        with z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_prop⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp h_ev_all)
    let r : ℝ := min ρ₀ (min (δ_X 0 s) (δ_X 1 s))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hρ₀_pos (lt_min (hδX_pos 0 s hs) (hδX_pos 1 s hs))
    have hr_DH : Metric.ball s r ⊆ D_H :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
        (hδX_strip 0 s hs)
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_DH, fun z hz hzne hE => hE.2 ?_⟩
    have hz_ρ₀ : dist z s < ρ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _)
    obtain ⟨ha_z, ha_nz, hf_z, hf_nz, hD0_nz, hD1_nz⟩ := hρ₀_prop hz_ρ₀ hzne
    have hz_b0 : z ∈ Metric.ball s (δ_X 0 s) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hz
    have hz_b1 : z ∈ Metric.ball s (δ_X 1 s) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hz
    obtain ⟨r_z0, hrz0_pos, hrz0_1d, hrz0_T, hrz0_holo, hrz0_ag⟩ :=
      hX_loc_holo 0 s hs z hz_b0 hD0_nz
    obtain ⟨r_z1, hrz1_pos, _, hrz1_T, hrz1_holo, hrz1_ag⟩ :=
      hX_loc_holo 1 s hs z hz_b1 hD1_nz
    let r_z : ℝ := min r_z0 r_z1

        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
        have h_le : rp' ≤ r_s - dist p (s, 0) := min_le_right _ _
        linarith [dist_triangle q p (s, 0)]
      exact ⟨rp', hrp'_pos, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hrp_rad, hrp'_sub,
        fun q hq => hrp_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)⟩

  have hΓ_conj_nhdsNE : ∀ s ∈ D_H, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ,
        Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice z i) := by
    have h_conj_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        MeromorphicOn (fun z => starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i)) D_H := by
      intro i s hs
      have hs_bar : starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ D_H := hDH_conj s hs
      obtain ⟨n, h, hh_an, hh_ev⟩ :=
        MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mp (hΓ_mero_i i (starRingEnd ℂ s) hs_bar)
      let h_conj : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => starRingEnd ℂ (h (starRingEnd ℂ z))
      have hh_conj_an : AnalyticAt ℂ h_conj s := by
        obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ_an⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hh_an.eventually_analyticAt
        have hh_conj_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_conj (Metric.ball s ρ) := by
          intro z hz
          have hz_bar_dist : dist (starRingEnd ℂ z) (starRingEnd ℂ s) < ρ := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, Complex.norm_conj, ← dist_eq_norm]
            exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
          have hd : HasDerivAt h (deriv h (starRingEnd ℂ z)) (starRingEnd ℂ z) :=
            (hρ_an hz_bar_dist).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
          have hd_cc := hd.conj_conj
          rw [Complex.conj_conj] at hd_cc
          exact hd_cc.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        exact hh_conj_holo.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos))
      have h_conj_tend : Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ) (nhdsWithin s {s}ᶜ)
          (nhdsWithin (starRingEnd ℂ s) {starRingEnd ℂ s}ᶜ) := by
        refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _
          (Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) ?_
        filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz h_eq
        exact hz (by simpa [Complex.conj_conj] using congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) h_eq)
      refine MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mpr ⟨n, h_conj, hh_conj_an, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [h_conj_tend.eventually hh_ev] with z hz
      dsimp only [h_conj]
      rw [hz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_zpow₀, map_sub,
        Complex.conj_conj, Complex.conj_conj]
    intro s hs i
    let R_conj : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i) - Γ_slice z i
    have hR_conj_mero : MeromorphicOn R_conj D_H := (h_conj_mero i).sub (hΓ_mero_i i)
    have hR_conj_zero0 : ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : ℂ), R_conj z = 0 := by
      have h0_2s : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := hbase_sub_two h0_base
      filter_upwards [(h_open_hs (2 * W.s_base)).mem_nhds h0_2s] with z hz
      have hz_bar : starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * W.s_base) := by
        change |z.im| < 2 * W.s_base at hz
        change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < 2 * W.s_base
        simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hz
      dsimp only [R_conj]
      rw [h_Γ_base2_eq (starRingEnd ℂ z) hz_bar i, h_Γ_base2_eq z hz i,
        hcurve_conj z hz i, Complex.conj_conj, sub_self]
    filter_upwards [h_mero_zero_on_nhdsNE hR_conj_mero hR_conj_zero0 s hs] with z hz
    have h_eq : starRingEnd ℂ (Γ_slice (starRingEnd ℂ z) i) = Γ_slice z i := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
    simpa only [Complex.conj_conj] using congr_arg (starRingEnd ℂ) h_eq

  exact ⟨{
    Γ_slice := Γ_slice
    a_mero := a_mero
    f_mero := f_mero
    E_disc := E_disc
    E_disc_sub := fun _ h => h.1
    E_disc_base_disjoint := hE_base_disj
    E_disc_isolated := hE_isolated
    Γ_nf := hΓ_nf
    Γ_mero := hΓ_mero
    a_mero_mero := ha_mero_on
    f_mero_mero := hf_mero_on
    slice_base_eq := h_slice_base_eq
    slice_reg := h_slice_reg
    Γ_conj_nhdsNE := hΓ_conj_nhdsNE
    L_slice_holo_isolated := hL_isolated
  }⟩
