proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hId2D : ∀ {W_dom V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen W_dom → IsPreconnected W_dom → IsOpen V_dom → V_dom.Nonempty → V_dom ⊆ W_dom →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W_dom → (∀ p ∈ V_dom, f p = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ W_dom, f p = 0 := by
    intro W_dom V_dom hWo hWp hVo hVne hVW f hf hzero
    have hBallZero : ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r : ℝ} {U_z : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        0 < r → Metric.ball p₀ r ⊆ W_dom → IsOpen U_z →
        (∀ x ∈ U_z, f x = 0) → (Metric.ball p₀ r ∩ U_z).Nonempty →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, f q = 0 := by
      intro p₀ r U_z hr hsub hUzo hUz0 ⟨p₁, hp₁_ball, hp₁_Uz⟩ q hq_ball
      let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (p₁.1 + z * (q.1 - p₁.1), p₁.2 + z * (q.2 - p₁.2))
      have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
        ((differentiable_const _).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _))).prodMk
          ((differentiable_const _).add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
      let Ω_z : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₀ r
      have hΩz_open : IsOpen Ω_z := Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
      have hΩz_conv : Convex ℝ Ω_z := by
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
        have habC : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
        have hlin : γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • γ z₁ + b • γ z₂ := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · simp only [γ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_add, Complex.real_smul]
            push_cast
            linear_combination -p₁.1 * habC
          · simp only [γ, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, Complex.real_smul]
            push_cast
            linear_combination -p₁.2 * habC
        change γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r
        rw [hlin]
        exact convex_ball p₀ r hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
        change γ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r
        have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₁ := by apply Prod.ext <;> simp [γ]
        rwa [hγ0]
      have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Ω_z := by
        change γ 1 ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r
        have hγ1 : γ 1 = q := by apply Prod.ext <;> simp [γ]
        rwa [hγ1]
      have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => f (γ z)) Ω_z :=
        ((hf.mono hsub).comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)).analyticOnNhd hΩz_open
      have h_ev : (fun z => f (γ z)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr
          ⟨γ ⁻¹' U_z, (hUzo.preimage hγ_diff.continuous).mem_nhds ?_, fun z hz => hUz0 (γ z) hz⟩
        change γ 0 ∈ U_z
        have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₁ := by apply Prod.ext <;> simp [γ]
        rwa [hγ0]
      have h1_eq := hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hΩz_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem h_ev h1_mem
      have hγ1 : γ 1 = q := by apply Prod.ext <;> simp [γ]
      simpa only [hγ1, Pi.zero_apply] using h1_eq
    let U_z : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ W_dom | ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ W_dom ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, f q = 0 }
    have hUzo : IsOpen U_z := by
      refine Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr (fun p ⟨_, r, hr, hsub, hzr⟩ => ?_)
      refine ⟨r / 2, half_pos hr, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hsub_half : Metric.ball p' (r / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball p r := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp' hq ⊢
        linarith [dist_triangle q p' p]
      exact ⟨hsub (hsub_half (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr))),
        r / 2, half_pos hr, Set.Subset.trans hsub_half hsub, fun q hq => hzr q (hsub_half hq)⟩
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hVne
    obtain ⟨rv, hrv_pos, hrv_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hVo.inter hWo) v₀ ⟨hv₀, hVW hv₀⟩
    have hUz_ne : (W_dom ∩ U_z).Nonempty :=
      ⟨v₀, hVW hv₀, hVW hv₀, rv, hrv_pos, fun q hq => (hrv_sub hq).2,
        fun q hq => hzero q (hrv_sub hq).1⟩
    have hUz_cl : closure U_z ∩ W_dom ⊆ U_z := by
      intro p₀ ⟨hp₀_cl, hp₀W⟩
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWo p₀ hp₀W
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁_Uz, hp₁_dist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₀_cl r hr
      have hp₁_in : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r := by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hp₁_dist
      exact ⟨hp₀W, r, hr, hsub, hBallZero hr hsub hUzo
        (fun x ⟨_, rx, hrx, _, hzrx⟩ => hzrx x (Metric.mem_ball_self hrx))
        ⟨p₁, hp₁_in, hp₁_Uz⟩⟩
    have hW_sub : W_dom ⊆ U_z := hWp.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hUzo hUz_ne hUz_cl
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, r, hr, _, hzr⟩ := hW_sub hp
    exact hzr p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)

  
  have exists_ne_zero_on_open :
      ∀ {B_dom V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen B_dom → IsPreconnected B_dom → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B_dom →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B_dom, g q₀ ≠ 0) →
        IsOpen V_dom → V_dom.Nonempty → V_dom ⊆ B_dom →
        ∃ x ∈ V_dom, g x ≠ 0 := by
    intro B_dom V_dom g hBo hBp hg ⟨q₀, hq₀B, hq₀_ne⟩ hVo hVne hVB
    by_contra h_all
    push_neg at h_all
    exact hq₀_ne (hId2D hBo hBp hVo hVne hVB hg h_all q₀ hq₀B)

  have cancel_holo_of_ne_zero :
      ∀ {U_dom B_dom V_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen U_dom → IsPreconnected U_dom → DifferentiableOn ℂ h U_dom →
        IsOpen B_dom → IsPreconnected B_dom → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B_dom →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B_dom, g q₀ ≠ 0) →
        IsOpen V_dom → V_dom.Nonempty → V_dom ⊆ U_dom → V_dom ⊆ B_dom →
        (∀ q ∈ V_dom, h q * g q = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ U_dom, h q = 0 := by
    intro U_dom B_dom V_dom h g hUo hUp hh hBo hBp hg hq₀ hVo hVne hVU hVB hprod
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁V, hx₁_ne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_on_open hBo hBp hg hq₀ hVo hVne hVB
    have hg_contAt : ContinuousAt g x₁ :=
      hg.continuousOn.continuousAt (hBo.mem_nhds (hVB hx₁V))
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_dist⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hg_contAt ‖g x₁‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx₁_ne)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVo x₁ hx₁V
    let η₁ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ₂
    have hη₁_pos : 0 < η₁ := lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ₂_pos
    have hball_U : Metric.ball x₁ η₁ ⊆ U_dom :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (Set.Subset.trans hδ₂_sub hVU)
    have hzero_ball : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball x₁ η₁, h q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hqV : q ∈ V_dom := hδ₂_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
      have hq_dist : dist q x₁ < δ₁ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hgq_ne : g q ≠ 0 := by
        intro hgq0
        have hd := hδ₁_dist hq_dist
        rw [hgq0, dist_zero_left] at hd
        exact lt_irrefl _ hd
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod q hqV)).resolve_right hgq_ne
    exact hId2D hUo hUp Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hη₁_pos⟩ hball_U hh hzero_ball

  have meroEqOn_symm :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U h
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h.1 hp).2, (h.1 hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [min_comm] at hq
    exact (h.2 p hp q hq).symm

  have meroEqOn_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U V hVU h
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU h.1, fun p hp => h.2 p (hVU hp)⟩

  have meroEqOn_of_num_den_eq :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ q, F₁.num p q = F₂.num p q ∧ F₁.den p q = F₂.den p q) →
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U hsub heq
    refine ⟨hsub, fun p hp q _ => ?_⟩
    rw [(heq p hp q).1, (heq p hp q).2]

  have meroEqOn_trans :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃}
        {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ F₁ F₂ F₃ U h₁₂ h₂₃
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h₁₂.1 hp).1, (h₂₃.1 hp).2⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (h₁₂.1 hp).1
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (h₁₂.1 hp).2
    have hp₃ : p ∈ W₃ := (h₂₃.1 hp).2
    let r₁₃ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₃.rad p)
    have hr₁₃_pos : 0 < r₁₃ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₃.rad_pos p hp₃)
    let r₁₂₃ : ℝ := min r₁₃ (F₂.rad p)
    have hr₁₂₃_pos : 0 < r₁₂₃ := lt_min hr₁₃_pos (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z) (Metric.ball p r₁₃) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₃.den_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₃.num_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hprod : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₁₂₃,
        (F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z) * F₂.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz₁₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) := by
        refine Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) ?_)
        exact le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hz₂₃ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) := by
        refine Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) ?_)
        exact le_min (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have e₁₂ := h₁₂.2 p hp z hz₁₂
      have e₂₃ := h₂₃.2 p hp z hz₂₃
      linear_combination e₁₂ * F₃.den p z + e₂₃ * F₁.den p z
    have hzero := cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r₁₃).isPreconnected hh_holo
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F₂.rad p)).isPreconnected
      (F₂.den_holo p hp₂) (F₂.den_ne_zero p hp₂)
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁₂₃_pos⟩
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      hprod q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

  have meroEq_step :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) {p₀ p₁ : ℂ × ℂ},
        p₀ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ → p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        (Metric.ball p₀ (min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)) ∩
          Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁))).Nonempty →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)),
          G₁.num p₀ q * G₂.den p₀ q = G₂.num p₀ q * G₁.den p₀ q) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)),
          G₁.num p₁ q * G₂.den p₁ q = G₂.num p₁ q * G₁.den p₁ q := by
    intro W₁ W₂ G₁ G₂ p₀ p₁ hp₀ hp₁ hVne hp₀_eq
    let r₀ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)
    let r₁ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)
    let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ∩ Metric.ball p₁ r₁
    have hVo : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hVp : IsPreconnected V := ((convex_ball p₀ r₀).inter (convex_ball p₁ r₁)).isPreconnected
    let h₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z => G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₁ z - G₂.num p₁ z * G₁.den p₁ z
    have hh₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₁ (Metric.ball p₁ r₁) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((G₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((G₂.num_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hV_sub_G₁₀ : V ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (G₁.rad p₀) :=
      Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
    have hV_sub_G₂₀ : V ⊆ Metric.ball p₀ (G₂.rad p₀) :=
      Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
    have hprod2 : ∀ z ∈ V, (h₁ z * G₁.den p₀ z) * G₂.den p₀ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have c₁ := G₁.compat p₀ hp₀.1 p₁ hp₁.1 z
        ⟨hV_sub_G₁₀ hz, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2⟩
      have c₂ := G₂.compat p₀ hp₀.2 p₁ hp₁.2 z
        ⟨hV_sub_G₂₀ hz, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.2⟩
      have e₀ := hp₀_eq z hz.1
      dsimp only [h₁]
      calc ((G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₁ z - G₂.num p₁ z * G₁.den p₁ z) * G₁.den p₀ z) * G₂.den p₀ z
          = (G₁.num p₁ z * G₁.den p₀ z) * G₂.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₀ z -
            (G₂.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₀ z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₁.den p₀ z := by ring
        _ = (G₁.num p₀ z * G₁.den p₁ z) * G₂.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₀ z -
            (G₂.num p₀ z * G₂.den p₁ z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₁.den p₀ z := by rw [← c₁, ← c₂]
        _ = (G₁.num p₀ z * G₂.den p₀ z - G₂.num p₀ z * G₁.den p₀ z) *
            (G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₁ z) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [e₀]; ring
    have hprod1 : ∀ z ∈ V, h₁ z * G₁.den p₀ z = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_ne_zero hVo hVp
        ((hh₁_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_right).mul ((G₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1).mono hV_sub_G₁₀))
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (G₂.rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        (G₂.den_holo p₀ hp₀.2) (G₂.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.2)
        hVo hVne Set.Subset.rfl hV_sub_G₂₀ hprod2
    have hzero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁, h₁ z = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_ne_zero
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁ r₁).isPreconnected hh₁_holo
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (G₁.rad p₀)).isPreconnected
        (G₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1) (G₁.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.1)
        hVo hVne Set.inter_subset_right hV_sub_G₁₀ hprod1
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero q hq)

  have meroEqOn_of_preconnected :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        {U_ov V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen U_ov → IsPreconnected U_ov → U_ov ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U_ov → MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ V →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U_ov := by
    intro W₁ W₂ G₁ G₂ U_ov V hUo hUp hU_sub ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ hVU hEqV
    let E_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ U_ov | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (G₁.rad p) (G₂.rad p)),
          G₁.num p q * G₂.den p q = G₂.num p q * G₁.den p q }
    have hEo : IsOpen E_eq := by
      refine Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr (fun p₀ hp₀ => ?_)
      obtain ⟨δ_u, hδ_u_pos, hδ_u_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUo p₀ hp₀.1
      have hp₀W := hU_sub hp₀.1
      let r₀ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀)
      have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₀ hp₀W.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₀ hp₀W.2)
      refine ⟨min δ_u r₀, lt_min hδ_u_pos hr₀_pos, fun p₁ hp₁ => ?_⟩
      have hp₁U : p₁ ∈ U_ov := hδ_u_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₁)
      have hp₁W := hU_sub hp₁U
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁) :=
        lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁W.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁W.2)
      refine ⟨hp₁U, meroEq_step G₁ G₂ hp₀W hp₁W
        ⟨p₁, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos⟩ hp₀.2⟩
    have hE_ne : (U_ov ∩ E_eq).Nonempty :=
      ⟨v₀, hVU hv₀, hVU hv₀, hEqV.2 v₀ hv₀⟩
    have hE_cl : closure E_eq ∩ U_ov ⊆ E_eq := by
      intro p₁ ⟨hp₁_cl, hp₁U⟩
      have hp₁W := hU_sub hp₁U
      let r₁ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p₁) (G₂.rad p₁)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁W.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁W.2)
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀E, hp₀_dist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₁_cl r₁ hr₁_pos
      have hp₀W := hU_sub hp₀E.1
      have hr₀_pos : 0 < min (G₁.rad p₀) (G₂.rad p₀) :=
        lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p₀ hp₀W.1) (G₂.rad_pos p₀ hp₀W.2)
      have hp₀_in_p₁ : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        exact hp₀_dist
      exact ⟨hp₁U, meroEq_step G₁ G₂ hp₀W hp₁W
        ⟨p₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos, hp₀_in_p₁⟩ hp₀E.2⟩
    have hsub : U_ov ⊆ E_eq := hUp.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hEo hE_ne hE_cl
    exact ⟨hU_sub, fun p hp => (hsub hp).2⟩

  have mkHoloMero :
      ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        ∃ H : MeroOn2D U,
          (∀ p q, H.num p q = f q ∧ H.den p q = 1) ∧
          (∀ {W_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W_dom) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
            V ⊆ U → MeroAgreesHolo F f V → MeroEqOn F H V) := by
    intro U hU f hf
    let rad_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ U then Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp) else 1
    have hrad_spec : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ U), 0 < rad_fn p ∧ Metric.ball p (rad_fn p) ⊆ U := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only [rad_fn]
      rw [dif_pos hp]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp)
    let H : MeroOn2D U := {
      rad := rad_fn
      num := fun _ q => f q
      den := fun _ _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => (hrad_spec p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => (hrad_spec p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp => hf.mono (hrad_spec p hp).2
      den_holo := fun _ _ => (differentiable_const (1 : ℂ)).differentiableOn
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad_spec p hp).1, one_ne_zero⟩
      compat := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => by ring
    }
    refine ⟨H, fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro W_dom F V hVU hAg
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hAg.1 hp, hVU hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hpW : p ∈ W_dom := hAg.1 hp
    have hpU : p ∈ U := hVU hp
    let r_m : ℝ := min (F.rad p) (H.rad p)
    have hr_m_pos : 0 < r_m := lt_min (F.rad_pos p hpW) (H.rad_pos p hpU)
    obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a_pos, _, _, hr_a_eq⟩ := hAg.2 p hp
    let η_a : ℝ := min r_m r_a
    have hη_a_pos : 0 < η_a := lt_min hr_m_pos hr_a_pos
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => F.num p z * (1 : ℂ) - f z * F.den p z) (Metric.ball p r_m) :=
      (((F.num_holo p hpW).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        (differentiable_const (1 : ℂ)).differentiableOn).sub
      ((hf.mono (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        (H.ball_sub p hpU))).mul
        ((F.den_holo p hpW).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hzero_sub : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p η_a, F.num p z * (1 : ℂ) - f z * F.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hza : z ∈ Metric.ball p r_a := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz
      rw [hr_a_eq z hza]
      ring
    have hzero := hId2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r_m).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_a_pos⟩
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hh_holo hzero_sub q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

  have mkGlueMero :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W_tgt : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        W₁ ⊆ W_tgt → W₂ ⊆ W_tgt → W_tgt ⊆ W₁ ∪ W₂ →
        ∀ (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
          MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (W₁ ∩ W₂) →
          ∃ G_gl : MeroOn2D W_tgt, MeroEqOn G_gl G₁ W₁ := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W_tgt hW₁ hW₂ hcov G₁ G₂ hEq
    have hCross : ∀ p₁ ∈ W₁, ∀ p₂ ∈ W₂,
        ∀ q₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂),
          G₁.num p₁ q₀ * G₂.den p₂ q₀ = G₂.num p₂ q₀ * G₁.den p₁ q₀ := by
      intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q₀ hq₀
      have hq₀W : q₀ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ :=
        ⟨G₁.ball_sub p₁ hp₁ hq₀.1, G₂.ball_sub p₂ hp₂ hq₀.2⟩
      let r₀ : ℝ := min (G₁.rad q₀) (G₂.rad q₀)
      have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos q₀ hq₀W.1) (G₂.rad_pos q₀ hq₀W.2)
      let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        (Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂)) ∩ Metric.ball q₀ r₀
      have hVo : IsOpen V := (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hVp : IsPreconnected V :=
        (((convex_ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁)).inter (convex_ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂))).inter
          (convex_ball q₀ r₀)).isPreconnected
      have hq₀V : q₀ ∈ V := ⟨hq₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos⟩
      have hV_G₁₀ : V ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ (G₁.rad q₀) :=
        Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      have hV_G₂₀ : V ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ (G₂.rad q₀) :=
        Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      let h_d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z => G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₁ z
      have hhd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_d V :=
        (((G₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)).mul
          ((G₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_right))).sub
        (((G₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_right)).mul
          ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)))
      have hprod2 : ∀ z ∈ V, (h_d z * G₁.den q₀ z) * G₂.den q₀ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have c₁ := G₁.compat p₁ hp₁ q₀ hq₀W.1 z ⟨hz.1.1, hV_G₁₀ hz⟩
        have c₂ := G₂.compat p₂ hp₂ q₀ hq₀W.2 z ⟨hz.1.2, hV_G₂₀ hz⟩
        have e₀ := hEq.2 q₀ hq₀W z hz.2
        dsimp only [h_d]
        calc ((G₁.num p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z - G₂.num p₂ z * G₁.den p₁ z) * G₁.den q₀ z) * G₂.den q₀ z
            = (G₁.num p₁ z * G₁.den q₀ z) * G₂.den p₂ z * G₂.den q₀ z -
              (G₂.num p₂ z * G₂.den q₀ z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₁.den q₀ z := by ring
          _ = (G₁.num q₀ z * G₁.den p₁ z) * G₂.den p₂ z * G₂.den q₀ z -
              (G₂.num q₀ z * G₂.den p₂ z) * G₁.den p₁ z * G₁.den q₀ z := by rw [c₁, c₂]
          _ = (G₁.num q₀ z * G₂.den q₀ z - G₂.num q₀ z * G₁.den q₀ z) *
              (G₁.den p₁ z * G₂.den p₂ z) := by ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [e₀, sub_self, zero_mul]
      have hprod1 : ∀ z ∈ V, h_d z * G₁.den q₀ z = 0 :=
        cancel_holo_of_ne_zero hVo hVp
          (hhd_holo.mul ((G₁.den_holo q₀ hq₀W.1).mono hV_G₁₀))
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ (G₂.rad q₀)).isPreconnected
          (G₂.den_holo q₀ hq₀W.2) (G₂.den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀W.2)
          hVo ⟨q₀, hq₀V⟩ Set.Subset.rfl hV_G₂₀ hprod2
      have hzero : ∀ z ∈ V, h_d z = 0 :=
        cancel_holo_of_ne_zero hVo hVp hhd_holo
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ (G₁.rad q₀)).isPreconnected
          (G₁.den_holo q₀ hq₀W.1) (G₁.den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀W.1)
          hVo ⟨q₀, hq₀V⟩ Set.Subset.rfl hV_G₁₀ hprod1
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero q₀ hq₀V)
    let G_gl : MeroOn2D W_tgt := {
      rad := fun p => if p ∈ W₁ then G₁.rad p else G₂.rad p
      num := fun p => if p ∈ W₁ then G₁.num p else G₂.num p
      den := fun p => if p ∈ W₁ then G₁.den p else G₂.den p
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₁.rad_pos p hp₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₂.rad_pos p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact Set.Subset.trans (G₁.ball_sub p hp₁) hW₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact Set.Subset.trans (G₂.ball_sub p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)) hW₂
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₁.num_holo p hp₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₂.num_holo p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₁.den_holo p hp₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₂.den_holo p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₁.den_ne_zero p hp₁
        · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
          exact G₂.den_ne_zero p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁W p₂ hp₂W q hq => by
        by_cases hp₁ : p₁ ∈ W₁ <;> by_cases hp₂ : p₂ ∈ W₁
        · simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
          exact G₁.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
        · simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
          exact hCross p₁ hp₁ p₂ ((hcov hp₂W).resolve_left hp₂) q hq
        · simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
          exact (hCross p₂ hp₂ p₁ ((hcov hp₁W).resolve_left hp₁) q ⟨hq.2, hq.1⟩).symm
        · simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
          exact G₂.compat p₁ ((hcov hp₁W).resolve_left hp₁) p₂ ((hcov hp₂W).resolve_left hp₂) q hq
    }
    refine ⟨G_gl, ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hW₁ hp, hp⟩, fun p hp q _ => ?_⟩⟩
    dsimp only [G_gl]
    simp only [hp, ↓reduceIte]

  have mkPullbackMero :
      ∀ {W_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W_dom) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen U →
        ∀ (Φ_fn Ψ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
          Differentiable ℂ Φ_fn → Differentiable ℂ Ψ_fn →
          (∀ p, Ψ_fn (Φ_fn p) = p) → (∀ q, Φ_fn (Ψ_fn q) = q) →
          Set.MapsTo Φ_fn U W_dom →
          ∃ G : MeroOn2D U,
            ∀ p q, G.num p q = F.num (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q) ∧ G.den p q = F.den (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q) := by
    intro W_dom F U hU Φ_fn Ψ_fn hΦ hΨ hL hR hMaps
    have hex_rad : ∀ p, p ∈ U →
        ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
          Metric.ball p r ⊆ U ∩ Φ_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) (F.rad (Φ_fn p)) := by
      intro p hp
      have hOo : IsOpen (U ∩ Φ_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) (F.rad (Φ_fn p))) :=
        hU.inter (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hΦ.continuous)
      exact Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hOo p ⟨hp, Metric.mem_ball_self (F.rad_pos (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp))⟩
    let rad_pb : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ U then Classical.choose (hex_rad p hp) else 1
    have hrad_pb : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ U),
        0 < rad_pb p ∧
        Metric.ball p (rad_pb p) ⊆ U ∧
        Set.MapsTo Φ_fn (Metric.ball p (rad_pb p)) (Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) (F.rad (Φ_fn p))) := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only [rad_pb]
      rw [dif_pos hp]
      have hsp := Classical.choose_spec (hex_rad p hp)
      exact ⟨hsp.1, fun q hq => (hsp.2 hq).1, fun q hq => (hsp.2 hq).2⟩
    let G : MeroOn2D U := {
      rad := rad_pb
      num := fun p q => F.num (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q)
      den := fun p q => F.den (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q)
      rad_pos := fun p hp => (hrad_pb p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => (hrad_pb p hp).2.1
      num_holo := fun p hp =>
        (F.num_holo (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp)).comp hΦ.differentiableOn (hrad_pb p hp).2.2
      den_holo := fun p hp =>
        (F.den_holo (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp)).comp hΦ.differentiableOn (hrad_pb p hp).2.2
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        let B_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) (F.rad (Φ_fn p))
        let V_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Ψ_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball p (rad_pb p) ∩ B_t
        have hVto : IsOpen V_t :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hΨ.continuous).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hΦp_mem : Φ_fn p ∈ V_t :=
          ⟨by simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, hL p] using Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad_pb p hp).1,
           Metric.mem_ball_self (F.rad_pos (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp))⟩
        obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀V, hz₀_ne⟩ := exists_ne_zero_on_open
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball (Φ_fn p) (F.rad (Φ_fn p))).isPreconnected
          (F.den_holo (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp)) (F.den_ne_zero (Φ_fn p) (hMaps hp))
          hVto ⟨Φ_fn p, hΦp_mem⟩ Set.inter_subset_right
        refine ⟨Ψ_fn z₀, hz₀V.1, ?_⟩
        simpa only [hR z₀] using hz₀_ne
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
        F.compat (Φ_fn p₁) (hMaps hp₁) (Φ_fn p₂) (hMaps hp₂) (Φ_fn q)
          ⟨(hrad_pb p₁ hp₁).2.2 hq.1, (hrad_pb p₂ hp₂).2.2 hq.2⟩
    }
    exact ⟨G, fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

  have eqOn_of_pullback :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
        {G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁} {G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂}
        {Φ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {V_src V_tgt : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        Continuous Φ_fn → V_src ⊆ U₁ ∩ U₂ → Set.MapsTo Φ_fn V_src V_tgt →
        (∀ p q, G₁.num p q = F₁.num (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q) ∧ G₁.den p q = F₁.den (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q)) →
        (∀ p q, G₂.num p q = F₂.num (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q) ∧ G₂.den p q = F₂.den (Φ_fn p) (Φ_fn q)) →
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V_tgt →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ V_src := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U₁ U₂ F₁ F₂ G₁ G₂ Φ_fn V_src V_tgt hΦ_cont hV_sub hMapsV hG₁ hG₂ hEqF
    refine ⟨hV_sub, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hpU₁ : p ∈ U₁ := (hV_sub hp).1
    have hpU₂ : p ∈ U₂ := (hV_sub hp).2
    have hΦp : Φ_fn p ∈ V_tgt := hMapsV hp
    have hΦpW := hEqF.1 hΦp
    let r_s : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p) (G₂.rad p)
    have hr_s_pos : 0 < r_s := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p hpU₁) (G₂.rad_pos p hpU₂)
    let r_t : ℝ := min (F₁.rad (Φ_fn p)) (F₂.rad (Φ_fn p))
    have hr_t_pos : 0 < r_t := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos (Φ_fn p) hΦpW.1) (F₂.rad_pos (Φ_fn p) hΦpW.2)
    have hOo : IsOpen (Metric.ball p r_s ∩ Φ_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) r_t) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hΦ_cont)
    obtain ⟨η_p, hη_p_pos, hη_p_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hOo p
      ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_s_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t_pos⟩
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => G₁.num p z * G₂.den p z - G₂.num p z * G₁.den p z) (Metric.ball p r_s) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p hpU₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((G₂.den_holo p hpU₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((G₂.num_holo p hpU₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p hpU₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hzero_sub : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p η_p,
        G₁.num p z * G₂.den p z - G₂.num p z * G₁.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_t : Φ_fn z ∈ Metric.ball (Φ_fn p) r_t := (hη_p_sub hz).2
      rw [(hG₁ p z).1, (hG₂ p z).2, (hG₂ p z).1, (hG₁ p z).2]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hEqF.2 (Φ_fn p) hΦp (Φ_fn z) hz_t)
    have hzero := hId2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r_s).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_p_pos⟩
      (fun z hz => (hη_p_sub hz).1) hh_holo hzero_sub q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

  
  have h4R0_lt : 4 * R_0 < H₀ := by

      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos_s (le_trans hge_X (by rw [heq_L]; exact le_self_add))
    · have hb_pos : 0 < b := lt_trans him_pos him_lt

  let A : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }

    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)

    let Φ_pol : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (x.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((x.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hΦ_pol_cont : Continuous Φ_pol :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
    have himg : Φ_pol '' (Set.Ioo ρ R ×ˢ Set.univ) = A := by

  let Φ : ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) := fun σ p =>

    apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp only [Φ, Ψ] <;> push_cast <;> field_simp [hr_0_C_ne] <;> ring

  have h_sq_re : ∀ ζ : ℂ, (ζ ^ 2).re = ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ζ.im ^ 2 := by
    intro ζ
    have h1 : (ζ ^ 2).re = ζ.re * ζ.re - ζ.im * ζ.im := by rw [sq, Complex.mul_re]
    have h2 : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = ζ.re * ζ.re + ζ.im * ζ.im := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
    linarith
  have h_abs_sq_re : ∀ ζ : ℂ, |(ζ ^ 2).re| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := fun ζ =>
    le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (ζ ^ 2)) (by rw [norm_pow])
  have h_abs_sq_im : ∀ ζ : ℂ, |(ζ ^ 2).im| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := fun ζ =>
    le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ ^ 2)) (by rw [norm_pow])
  have hΦ1_re : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      (Φ σ p).1.re = x_edge + η * (p.2 ^ 2).im + p.1.re := by
    intro σ p
    dsimp only [Φ]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hΦ1_im : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      (Φ σ p).1.im = σ - η * (p.2 ^ 2).re + p.1.im := by
    intro σ p
    dsimp only [Φ]
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hΦ2_norm : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ), ‖(Φ σ p).2‖ = r_0 * ‖p.2‖ := by
    intro σ p
    dsimp only [Φ]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_0_pos]
  have hΦ2_abs_im : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ), |(Φ σ p).2.im| = r_0 * |p.2.im| := by
    intro σ p
    dsimp only [Φ]
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero,
      abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_0_pos]

  
  let A_shal : Set ℂ := A ∩ { ζ : ℂ | |ζ.im| < (3 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ }
  let A_steep : Set ℂ := A ∩ { ζ : ℂ | (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ < |ζ.im| }
  have isOpen_A_shal : IsOpen A_shal :=
    isOpen_A.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm))
  have isOpen_A_steep : IsOpen A_steep :=
    isOpen_A.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)
      (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im))
  have h1_mem_shal : (1 : ℂ) ∈ A_shal := by
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num [ρ, R]
  have hA_cov : A ⊆ A_shal ∪ A_steep := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hζ_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := lt_trans hρ_pos hζ.1
    rcases lt_or_ge |ζ.im| ((3 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖) with hlt | hge
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hζ, hlt⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hζ, show (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ < |ζ.im| by linarith⟩

  have hShal_im_lt : ∀ {σ : ℝ}, σ ≤ H₀ →
      ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_shal,
        (Φ σ p).1.im < H₀ - μ := by
    intro σ hσ_hi p ⟨hpw, hpζ_A, hpζ_sh⟩
    change |p.2.im| < (3 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ at hpζ_sh
    have hw_norm : ‖p.1‖ < d_w := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hpw
    have hw_im : p.1.im ≤ ‖p.1‖ := Complex.im_le_norm p.1
    have h_im_sq : p.2.im ^ 2 < (9 / 25 : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ |p.2.im| := abs_nonneg p.2.im
      have hsq : |p.2.im| ^ 2 = p.2.im ^ 2 := sq_abs p.2.im
      nlinarith
    have h_norm_sq : (19 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 2 < ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : (19 / 20 : ℝ) < ‖p.2‖ := hpζ_A.1
      nlinarith
    have h_re_gt : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < (p.2 ^ 2).re := by
      rw [h_sq_re p.2]
      nlinarith
    rw [hΦ1_im]
    dsimp only [μ, d_w] at hw_norm ⊢
    nlinarith

  have hShal_maps_tube : ∀ {σ : ℝ}, σ ∈ Set.Icc (H₀ - 2 * η) H₀ →
      Set.MapsTo (Φ σ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_shal) (meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L) := by
    intro σ ⟨hσ_lo, hσ_hi⟩ p hp
    have him_hi : (Φ σ p).1.im < H₀ - η / 128 := by
      have h1 := hShal_im_lt hσ_hi p hp
      dsimp only [μ] at h1
      linarith
    have hw_norm : ‖p.1‖ < d_w := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1
    have hw_abs : |p.1.im| ≤ ‖p.1‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1
    have hw_lo : -d_w < p.1.im := by linarith [neg_abs_le p.1.im]
    have hζ_norm : ‖p.2‖ < R := hp.2.1.2
    have hζ_sq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < (21 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg p.2
      dsimp only [R] at hζ_norm
      nlinarith
    have hre_le : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (h_abs_sq_re p.2)
    have him_pos : 0 < (Φ σ p).1.im := by
      rw [hΦ1_im]
      dsimp only [d_w] at hw_lo
      nlinarith [h1024η_lt]
    have ht_lsc : ‖(Φ σ p).2‖ < r_lsc := by
      rw [hΦ2_norm]
      have : r_0 * ‖p.2‖ < r_0 * R := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ_norm hr_0_pos
      linarith [hR_r0_lt_lsc]
    exact mem_meroTube_L (Φ σ p) (H₀ - η / 128)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lsc hr_lsc_le) him_pos him_hi (h_lsc_bound (Φ σ p).2 ht_lsc)

  have hSteep_maps : ∀ {σ : ℝ}, σ ∈ Set.Icc (H₀ - 2 * η) H₀ →
      ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_steep,
        (Φ σ p).1 ∈ steepCorridorY x_edge H₀ R_0 y_row δ_slab ∧
        (Φ σ p).2 ∈ steepSectorT S.r_steep ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_μ := by
    intro σ ⟨hσ_lo, hσ_hi⟩ p ⟨hpw, ⟨hpζ_lo, hpζ_hi⟩, hpζ_st⟩
    have hw_norm : ‖p.1‖ < d_w := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hpw
    have hw_re_abs : |p.1.re| < d_w := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm p.1) hw_norm
    have hw_im_abs : |p.1.im| < d_w := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1) hw_norm
    have hζ_sq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < (21 / 20 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg p.2
      dsimp only [R] at hpζ_hi
      nlinarith
    have hre_abs := h_abs_sq_re p.2
    have him_abs := h_abs_sq_im p.2
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hΦ1_re]
      have htri : |x_edge + η * (p.2 ^ 2).im + p.1.re - x_edge| ≤
          η * |(p.2 ^ 2).im| + |p.1.re| := by
        have heq : x_edge + η * (p.2 ^ 2).im + p.1.re - x_edge = η * (p.2 ^ 2).im + p.1.re := by ring
        rw [heq]
        exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hη_pos])
      have hR0_eq : R_0 = 256 * η := by dsimp only [η]; ring
      dsimp only [d_w] at hw_re_abs
      nlinarith
    · rw [hΦ1_im]
      have hy_ub := S.y_row_bounds.2
      have hδ_pos := S.δ_slab_pos
      have hR0_eq : R_0 = 256 * η := by dsimp only [η]; ring
      have hre_le : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ |(p.2 ^ 2).re| := le_abs_self _
      have hw_lo : -d_w < p.1.im := (abs_lt.mp hw_im_abs).1
      dsimp only [d_w] at hw_lo
      nlinarith
    · rw [hΦ1_im]
      have hR0_eq : R_0 = 256 * η := by dsimp only [η]; ring
      have hre_lo : -|(p.2 ^ 2).re| ≤ (p.2 ^ 2).re := neg_abs_le _
      have hw_hi : p.1.im < d_w := (abs_lt.mp hw_im_abs).2
      dsimp only [d_w] at hw_hi
      nlinarith
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hΦ2_norm]
        exact mul_pos hr_0_pos (lt_trans hρ_pos hpζ_lo)
      · rw [hΦ2_norm]
        have : r_0 * ‖p.2‖ < r_0 * R := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpζ_hi hr_0_pos
        linarith [hR_r0_lt_μ, hr_μ_le]
      · rw [hΦ2_norm, hΦ2_abs_im]
        change (2 / 5 : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| at hpζ_st
        have hζ_pos : 0 < ‖p.2‖ := lt_trans hρ_pos hpζ_lo
        nlinarith
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hΦ2_norm]
      have : r_0 * ‖p.2‖ < r_0 * R := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hpζ_hi hr_0_pos
      linarith [hR_r0_lt_μ]

  let W_ag : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    (steepCorridorY x_edge H₀ R_0 y_row δ_slab ∩ { y : ℂ | y.im < H₀ - μ }) ×ˢ
      (steepSectorT S.r_steep ∩ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_μ)
  have isOpen_steepY : IsOpen (steepCorridorY x_edge H₀ R_0 y_row δ_slab) :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))

  have isOpen_steepT : IsOpen (steepSectorT S.r_steep) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter

  have mkAnnularFamily : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (σ : ℝ), σ ∈ Set.Icc (H₀ - 2 * η) H₀ →
      ∃ (F_shal : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_shal))
        (F_ann : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A)),
        (∀ p q, F_shal.num p q = (W.L_mero i).num (Φ σ p) (Φ σ q) ∧
                F_shal.den p q = (W.L_mero i).den (Φ σ p) (Φ σ q)) ∧
        MeroEqOn F_ann F_shal (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_shal) := by
    intro i σ hσ
    let U_sh : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_shal
    let U_st : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A_steep
    have hUsh_o : IsOpen U_sh := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_A_shal
    have hUst_o : IsOpen U_st := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_A_steep
    obtain ⟨F_shal, hF_shal_nd⟩ := mkPullbackMero (W.L_mero i) U_sh hUsh_o
      (Φ σ) (Ψ σ) (hΦ_diff σ) (hΨ_diff σ) (hΨΦ σ) (hΦΨ σ) (hShal_maps_tube hσ)
    have hΛ_comp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => S.Λ_steep i (Φ σ p)) U_st :=
      (S.Λ_steep_holo i).comp (hΦ_diff σ).differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => ⟨(hSteep_maps hσ p hp).1, (hSteep_maps hσ p hp).2.1⟩)
    obtain ⟨F_steep, hF_steep_nd, _⟩ := mkHoloMero U_st hUst_o _ hΛ_comp_holo
    have hΛ_Wag_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S.Λ_steep i) W_ag :=
      (S.Λ_steep_holo i).mono (Set.prod_mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)
    obtain ⟨H_ag, hH_ag_nd, hH_ag_iff⟩ := mkHoloMero W_ag isOpen_Wag (S.Λ_steep i) hΛ_Wag_holo
    have hEq_Wag : MeroEqOn (W.L_mero i) H_ag W_ag :=
      hH_ag_iff (W.L_mero i) W_ag Set.Subset.rfl (hΛ_agrees i)
    have hOv_maps : Set.MapsTo (Φ σ) (U_sh ∩ U_st) W_ag := by
      intro p ⟨hpsh, hpst⟩
      exact ⟨⟨(hSteep_maps hσ p hpst).1, hShal_im_lt hσ.2 p hpsh⟩, (hSteep_maps hσ p hpst).2⟩
    obtain ⟨H_ov_pb, hH_ov_pb_nd⟩ := mkPullbackMero H_ag (U_sh ∩ U_st) (hUsh_o.inter hUst_o)
      (Φ σ) (Ψ σ) (hΦ_diff σ) (hΨ_diff σ) (hΨΦ σ) (hΦΨ σ) hOv_maps
    have hEq_ov1 : MeroEqOn F_shal H_ov_pb (U_sh ∩ U_st) :=
      eqOn_of_pullback (hΦ_diff σ).continuous
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hp⟩) hOv_maps hF_shal_nd hH_ov_pb_nd hEq_Wag
    have hEq_ov2 : MeroEqOn H_ov_pb F_steep (U_sh ∩ U_st) :=
      meroEqOn_of_num_den_eq H_ov_pb F_steep (U_sh ∩ U_st)
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp, hp.2⟩)
        (fun p _ q => by
          rw [(hH_ov_pb_nd p q).1, (hH_ag_nd (Φ σ p) (Φ σ q)).1, (hF_steep_nd p q).1,
              (hH_ov_pb_nd p q).2, (hH_ag_nd (Φ σ p) (Φ σ q)).2, (hF_steep_nd p q).2]
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    have hEq_ov : MeroEqOn F_shal F_steep (U_sh ∩ U_st) := meroEqOn_trans hEq_ov1 hEq_ov2
    obtain ⟨F_ann, hF_ann_sh⟩ := mkGlueMero
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left : U_sh ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A)
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left : U_st ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ A)
      (fun p hp => by
        rcases hA_cov hp.2 with h1 | h2
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hp.1, h1⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hp.1, h2⟩)
      F_shal F_steep hEq_ov
    exact ⟨F_shal, F_ann, hF_shal_nd, hF_ann_sh⟩

  
  let σ_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => H₀ - 2 * η + (k : ℝ) * Δσ

    (((convex_ball (0 : ℂ) d_w).inter

      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)).isPreconnected
  have hUbox_maps_tube : ∀ {k : ℕ}, k ≤ 64 →
      Set.MapsTo (Φ (σ_fn k)) (U_box k) (meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L) := by

    have hw_lo : -d_w < p.1.im := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1) hw_norm)).1
    have hζ_norm : ‖p.2‖ < δ₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hpζ
    have hζ_sq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by

      dsimp only [δ₀] at hζ_norm

    have hre_abs := h_abs_sq_re p.2
    have hre_lo : -‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ (p.2 ^ 2).re := le_trans (neg_le_neg hre_abs) (neg_abs_le _)
    have hre_hi : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hre_abs
    have him_hi : (Φ (σ_fn k) p).1.im < H₀ - η / 128 := by

    have him_pos : 0 < (Φ (σ_fn k) p).1.im := by
      rw [hΦ1_im]

      linarith [hR_r0_lt_lsc]
    exact mem_meroTube_L (Φ (σ_fn k) p) (H₀ - η / 128)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lsc hr_lsc_le) him_pos him_hi (h_lsc_bound (Φ (σ_fn k) p).2 ht_lsc)

  let p_star : ℂ × ℂ := (-(((3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, 0)

  have hAscent : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k : ℕ), k ≤ 64 →
      ∃ (F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R))
        (L_Uk : MeroOn2D (U_box k)),

    have hdiv : (η / r_0 ^ 2) * ε_patch ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      have hmul2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h16 (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hr0_sq_pos))
      have hlhs : 16 * η * ε_patch * (r_0 ^ 2)⁻¹ = 16 * ((η / r_0 ^ 2) * ε_patch) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
      rw [hlhs, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr0_sq_ne] at hmul2
      linarith
    nlinarith [hε_patch_pos]

  obtain ⟨r_seed, hr_seed_pos, hr_seed_le, h_seed_lsc⟩ :=
    exists_lsc_radius (H₀ - ε_patch / 16) (by linarith)
  let δ_seed : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min δ₀ (min (r_seed / r_0) (ε_patch / (16 * η)))
  have hδ_seed_pos : 0 < δ_seed :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min hδ₀_pos
      (lt_min (div_pos hr_seed_pos hr_0_pos) (div_pos hε_patch_pos (by linarith))))
  have hδ_seed_lt_δ₀ : δ_seed < δ₀ := by
    have hm : min δ₀ (min (r_seed / r_0) (ε_patch / (16 * η))) ≤ δ₀ := min_le_left _ _
    dsimp only [δ_seed]
    linarith [hδ₀_pos]
  have hδ_seed_sq : δ_seed ^ 2 < δ_seed := by
    have h1 : δ_seed < 1 := lt_trans hδ_seed_lt_δ₀ (by norm_num [δ₀])
    nlinarith [hδ_seed_pos]
  have hr0_δseed_lt : r_0 * δ_seed < r_seed := by
    have hm : min δ₀ (min (r_seed / r_0) (ε_patch / (16 * η))) ≤ r_seed / r_0 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hlt : δ_seed < r_seed / r_0 := by
      dsimp only [δ_seed]
      linarith [div_pos hr_seed_pos hr_0_pos]
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hr_0_pos
    rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ r_seed (ne_of_gt hr_0_pos)] at hmul
  have hη_δseed_sq_lt : η * δ_seed ^ 2 < ε_patch / 16 := by
    have hm : min δ₀ (min (r_seed / r_0) (ε_patch / (16 * η))) ≤ ε_patch / (16 * η) :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hlt : δ_seed < ε_patch / (16 * η) := by
      dsimp only [δ_seed]
      linarith [div_pos hε_patch_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 16 * η)]
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt hη_pos
    have hrhs : η * (ε_patch / (16 * η)) = ε_patch / 16 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hη_pos]
    rw [hrhs] at hmul
    nlinarith [hδ_seed_sq, hη_pos]

  let V_seed : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ∩ { w : ℂ | w.im < -ε_patch / 8 }) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_seed
  have isOpen_Vseed : IsOpen V_seed :=
    (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod
      Metric.isOpen_ball
  have isPreconn_Vseed : IsPreconnected V_seed :=
    (((convex_ball (0 : ℂ) d_w).inter
      ((convex_Iio (-ε_patch / 8)).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap)).prod
      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ_seed)).isPreconnected
  have hVseed_maps_tube : Set.MapsTo (Φ H₀) V_seed (meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L) := by
    intro p ⟨⟨hpw, hpw_im⟩, hpζ⟩
    have hw_norm : ‖p.1‖ < d_w := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hpw
    have hw_lo : -d_w < p.1.im := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1) hw_norm)).1
    have hζ_norm : ‖p.2‖ < δ_seed := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hpζ
    have hζ_sq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < δ_seed ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg p.2
      nlinarith
    have hre_abs := h_abs_sq_re p.2
    have hre_lo : -‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ (p.2 ^ 2).re := le_trans (neg_le_neg hre_abs) (neg_abs_le _)
    have hre_hi : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hre_abs
    have him_hi : (Φ H₀ p).1.im < H₀ - ε_patch / 16 := by
      rw [hΦ1_im]
      change p.1.im < -ε_patch / 8 at hpw_im
      nlinarith
    have him_pos : 0 < (Φ H₀ p).1.im := by
      rw [hΦ1_im]
      dsimp only [d_w] at hw_lo hε_le_dw
      nlinarith [h1024η_lt, hε_patch_pos]
    have ht_seed : ‖(Φ H₀ p).2‖ < r_seed := by
      rw [hΦ2_norm]
      have : r_0 * ‖p.2‖ < r_0 * δ_seed := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ_norm hr_0_pos
      linarith [hr0_δseed_lt]
    exact mem_meroTube_L (Φ H₀ p) (H₀ - ε_patch / 16)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_seed hr_seed_le) him_pos him_hi (h_seed_lsc (Φ H₀ p).2 ht_seed)

  have hp_star_U64_Vseed : p_star ∈ U_box 64 ∩ V_seed := by
    have hpos_34 : 0 < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := by linarith
    have hp_norm : ‖p_star.1‖ = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := by
      dsimp only [p_star]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos_34]
    have hp_im : p_star.1.im = -(3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := by
      dsimp only [p_star]
      simp only [Complex.neg_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero]
      ring
    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀_pos⟩, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_seed_pos⟩⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hp_norm]; linarith
    · change p_star.1.im < H₀ - d_w / 4 - σ_fn 64
      rw [hp_im, hσ64]; linarith
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hp_norm]; linarith
    · change p_star.1.im < -ε_patch / 8
      rw [hp_im]; linarith [hε_le_dw]

  let s_edge : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let W_patch : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - s_edge‖ < ε_patch ∧ ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < ε_patch }
  have isOpen_Wpatch : IsOpen W_patch :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)

  have hΨ_Wpatch_maps : Set.MapsTo (Ψ H₀) W_patch
      (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    have hp2' : ‖p.2‖ < ε_patch := by simpa [Complex.ofReal_zero, sub_zero] using hp2
    have h_coeff_pos : 0 < η / r_0 ^ 2 := div_pos hη_pos (pow_pos hr_0_pos 2)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [Ψ]
      have htri : ‖p.1 - s_edge + ((η / r_0 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (p.2 ^ 2)‖ ≤
          ‖p.1 - s_edge‖ + (η / r_0 ^ 2) * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 := norm_add_le (p.1 - s_edge) (((η / r_0 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (p.2 ^ 2))
        have h2 : ‖((η / r_0 ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (p.2 ^ 2)‖ =
            (η / r_0 ^ 2) * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h_coeff_pos]
        linarith
      have hp2_sq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 < ε_patch ^ 2 := by
        have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg p.2
        nlinarith
      nlinarith [hε_quad_le, hε_le_dw]
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [Ψ]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos)]
      have hlt : r_0⁻¹ * ‖p.2‖ < r_0⁻¹ * ε_patch :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp2' (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos)
      have hle : r_0⁻¹ * ε_patch ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ₀ := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε_le_r0δ0 (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos))
        have hrhs : r_0⁻¹ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r_0 * δ₀)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ₀ := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hr_0_pos]
        linarith
      dsimp only [δ₀, R] at hle ⊢
      linarith

  let δ : ℝ := min (ε_patch / 4) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r_0 * δ_seed))
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ :=
    lt_min (by linarith) (mul_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos hr_0_pos hδ_seed_pos))
  have hδ_le : δ ≤ ε_patch := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  let O_δ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      |p.1.re - x_edge| < ε_patch / 4 ∧
      |p.1.im - (H₀ - ε_patch / 2)| < ε_patch / 4 ∧
      ‖p.2 - ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < δ }

  have hOδ_sub_Wpatch : O_δ ⊆ W_patch := by
    intro p ⟨hre, him, ht⟩
    refine ⟨?_, lt_of_lt_of_le ht hδ_le⟩
    have hdecomp : p.1 - s_edge =
        ((p.1.re - x_edge : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((p.1.im - H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      dsimp only [s_edge]
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [hdecomp]
    have htri : ‖((p.1.re - x_edge : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((p.1.im - H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ≤
        |p.1.re - x_edge| + |p.1.im - H₀| := by
      refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) ?_
      rw [Complex.norm_real, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have him_bounds := abs_lt.mp him
    have him_abs : |p.1.im - H₀| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * ε_patch :=
      abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    linarith

  have hΨ_Oδ_maps_Vseed : Set.MapsTo (Ψ H₀) O_δ V_seed := by
    intro p hp
    have hpW : p ∈ W_patch := hOδ_sub_Wpatch hp
    obtain ⟨hre, him, ht⟩ := hp
    have ht' : ‖p.2‖ < δ := by simpa [Complex.ofReal_zero, sub_zero] using ht
    refine ⟨⟨(hΨ_Wpatch_maps hpW).1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change ((Ψ H₀ p).1).im < -ε_patch / 8
      have hΨ1_im : ((Ψ H₀ p).1).im = (p.1.im - H₀) + (η / r_0 ^ 2) * (p.2 ^ 2).re := by
        dsimp only [Ψ]
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      rw [hΨ1_im]
      have him_hi : p.1.im - H₀ < -ε_patch / 4 := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp him).2]
      have ht_eps : ‖p.2‖ < ε_patch := lt_of_lt_of_le ht' hδ_le
      have hp2_re : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ ε_patch ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (p.2 ^ 2).re ≤ ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (h_abs_sq_re p.2)
        have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg p.2
        nlinarith
      have h_coeff_pos : 0 < η / r_0 ^ 2 := div_pos hη_pos (pow_pos hr_0_pos 2)
      nlinarith [hε_quad_le]
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [Ψ]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos)]
      have hlt : r_0⁻¹ * ‖p.2‖ < r_0⁻¹ * δ :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ht' (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos)
      have hδ_r0 : δ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r_0 * δ_seed) := min_le_right _ _
      have hle : r_0⁻¹ * δ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_seed := by
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_r0 (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hr_0_pos))
        have hrhs : r_0⁻¹ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r_0 * δ_seed)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_seed := by
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hr_0_pos]
        linarith
      linarith [hδ_seed_pos]

  have hPatch_comp : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∃ g_i : MeroOn2D W_patch, MeroEqOn g_i (W.L_mero i) O_δ := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨F_top, L_U64, hL_U64_nd, _, hTop_U64⟩ := hAscent i 64 le_rfl
    obtain ⟨L_Vseed, hL_Vseed_nd⟩ := mkPullbackMero (W.L_mero i) V_seed isOpen_Vseed
      (Φ H₀) (Ψ H₀) (hΦ_diff H₀) (hΨ_diff H₀) (hΨΦ H₀) (hΦΨ H₀) hVseed_maps_tube
    have hEq_L64_seed : MeroEqOn L_U64 L_Vseed (U_box 64 ∩ V_seed) :=
      meroEqOn_of_num_den_eq L_U64 L_Vseed (U_box 64 ∩ V_seed)
        (fun _ hp => hp)
        (fun p _ q => by
          rw [(hL_U64_nd p q).1, hσ64, (hL_Vseed_nd p q).1,
              (hL_U64_nd p q).2, hσ64, (hL_Vseed_nd p q).2]
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    have hTop_inter : MeroEqOn F_top L_Vseed (U_box 64 ∩ V_seed) :=
      meroEqOn_trans (meroEqOn_mono Set.inter_subset_left hTop_U64) hEq_L64_seed
    have hTop_seed : MeroEqOn F_top L_Vseed V_seed :=
      meroEqOn_of_preconnected F_top L_Vseed
        isOpen_Vseed isPreconn_Vseed
        (fun p hp =>
          ⟨⟨hp.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball
              (le_trans (le_of_lt hδ_seed_lt_δ₀) (by norm_num [δ₀, R])) hp.2⟩, hp⟩)
        ⟨p_star, hp_star_U64_Vseed⟩
        Set.inter_subset_right
        hTop_inter
    obtain ⟨g_i, hg_i_nd⟩ := mkPullbackMero F_top W_patch isOpen_Wpatch
      (Ψ H₀) (Φ H₀) (hΨ_diff H₀) (hΦ_diff H₀) (hΦΨ H₀) (hΨΦ H₀) hΨ_Wpatch_maps
    obtain ⟨L_inv, hL_inv_nd⟩ := mkPullbackMero L_Vseed O_δ
      ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
          continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
          continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)))
      (Ψ H₀) (Φ H₀) (hΨ_diff H₀) (hΦ_diff H₀) (hΦΨ H₀) (hΨΦ H₀) hΨ_Oδ_maps_Vseed
    have hEq_g_Linv : MeroEqOn g_i L_inv O_δ :=
      eqOn_of_pullback (hΨ_diff H₀).continuous
        (fun p hp => ⟨hOδ_sub_Wpatch hp, hp⟩)
        hΨ_Oδ_maps_Vseed hg_i_nd hL_inv_nd hTop_seed
    have hEq_Linv_L : MeroEqOn L_inv (W.L_mero i) O_δ :=
      meroEqOn_of_num_den_eq L_inv (W.L_mero i) O_δ
        (fun p hp =>
          ⟨hp, by simpa only [hΦΨ H₀ p] using hVseed_maps_tube (hΨ_Oδ_maps_Vseed hp)⟩)
        (fun p _ q => by
          rw [(hL_inv_nd p q).1, (hL_Vseed_nd (Ψ H₀ p) (Ψ H₀ q)).1, hΦΨ H₀ p, hΦΨ H₀ q,
              (hL_inv_nd p q).2, (hL_Vseed_nd (Ψ H₀ p) (Ψ H₀ q)).2, hΦΨ H₀ p, hΦΨ H₀ q]
          exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    exact ⟨g_i, meroEqOn_trans hEq_g_Linv hEq_Linv_L⟩

  let g_patch : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W_patch := fun i => Classical.choose (hPatch_comp i)
  have hg_patch_eq : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g_patch i) (W.L_mero i) O_δ :=
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hPatch_comp i)
  exact hNoPatch.2 0 x_edge H₀ ε_patch
    (by simpa only [abs_zero] using W.r_base_pos)
    (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero] using hHL0)
    hε_patch_pos hε_patch_lt
    ⟨g_patch, δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le, hg_patch_eq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
