signature.name: steep_action_perturbation_jets
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) :
    SteepContJetProp S A

proof.tactics:
by
  let U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := smallChordDomain S A.η_SL
  let W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL
  let π : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, q.2.2 * q.2.1)
  have hπ_diff : Differentiable ℂ π :=
    differentiable_fst.prodMk
      ((differentiable_snd.comp differentiable_snd).mul
        (differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_snd))
  have hW₃_open : IsOpen W₃ := A.domain_open.preimage hπ_diff.continuous

  have h_param_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W := by
    intro a b W F hW hCont hHolo p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 3
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have h2r_lt : 2 * r < ε := by dsimp only [r]; linarith
    have h2r_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball h2r_lt).trans hε_sub
    have hK_compact : IsCompact (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r)) :=
      isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * r))
    have hK_sub : Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W :=
      Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl h2r_sub
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hCont.mono hK_sub)
    let M : ℝ := max C₀ 0
    have hM_bound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r), ‖F τ q‖ ≤ M := by
      intro τ hτ q hq
      exact (hC₀ (τ, q) ⟨hτ, hq⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    let s : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r
    have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr
    have hs_2r : ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := by
      intro p hp q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have hp' : dist p p₀ < r := hp
      have hq' : dist q p < r := hq
      linarith [dist_triangle q p p₀]
    have hs_sub : s ⊆ W := fun p hp =>
      h2r_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
        (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hp])))
    have h_slice_cont : ∀ p ∈ W, ContinuousOn (fun τ : ℝ => F τ p) (Set.uIcc a b) := fun p hp =>
      hCont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun τ hτ => ⟨hτ, hp⟩)
    let μ₀ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)
    have hμ_le : μ₀ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIcc a b) :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc le_rfl
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => F τ p) μ₀ := by
      filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
      exact ((h_slice_cont p (hs_sub hp)).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIcc).mono_measure hμ_le
    have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ => F τ p₀) MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀).intervalIntegrable
    let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * (r / 2)
    let h : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((δ n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hδ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < δ n := fun n => by positivity
    have hδ_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, δ n < r := by
      intro n
      have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n)]
      have h1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hn (by positivity)
      dsimp only [δ]
      nlinarith
    have hh_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, h n ≠ 0 := fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hδ_pos n).ne'
    have hh_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖h n‖ < r := by
      intro n
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hδ_pos n).le]
      exact hδ_lt n
    let e₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
    let e₂ : ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))
    have hp1_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, p₀ + h n • e₁ ∈ W := by
      intro n
      apply hs_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Prod.norm_def]
      simp [e₁, hh_norm n]
    have hp2_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, p₀ + h n • e₂ ∈ W := by
      intro n
      apply hs_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Prod.norm_def]
      simp [e₂, hh_norm n]
    have hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun n => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (hh_ne n))⟩
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
        simpa [δ] using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.mul_const (r / 2)
      simpa [h, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h0
    let g_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun n τ =>
      ((h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₁) - F τ p₀)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
      ((h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₂) - F τ p₀)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
    have hg_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (g_seq n) μ₀ := by
      intro n
      have hc1 : ContinuousOn
          (fun τ => (h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₁) - F τ p₀)) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (continuousOn_const (c := (h n)⁻¹)).smul
          ((h_slice_cont _ (hp1_mem n)).sub (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀))
      have hc2 : ContinuousOn
          (fun τ => (h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₂) - F τ p₀)) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (continuousOn_const (c := (h n)⁻¹)).smul
          ((h_slice_cont _ (hp2_mem n)).sub (h_slice_cont p₀ hp₀))
      have hcg : ContinuousOn (g_seq n) (Set.uIcc a b) :=
        (hc1.smul (continuousOn_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ))).add
          (hc2.smul (continuousOn_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)))
      exact (hcg.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIcc).mono_measure hμ_le
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) μ₀ := by
      refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hg_meas ?_
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with τ hτ_ioc
      have hτ : τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ_ioc
      have hFD : HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) p₀ :=
        ((hHolo τ hτ).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp₀)).hasFDerivAt
      have ht1 :=
        (hasLineDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp (hFD.hasLineDerivAt e₁)).comp hh_tendsto
      have ht2 :=
        (hasLineDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp (hFD.hasLineDerivAt e₂)).comp hh_tendsto
      have ht_sum : Filter.Tendsto (g_seq · τ) Filter.atTop
          (nhds ((fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₁) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
            (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₂) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)) :=
        (ht1.smul_const _).add (ht2.smul_const _)
      have hL_eq : (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₁) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
          (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₂) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ = fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ?_)
        have hv : ((v₁, v₂) : ℂ × ℂ) = v₁ • e₁ + v₂ • e₂ := by ext <;> simp [e₁, e₂]
        conv_rhs => rw [hv, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_add, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_smul,
          (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_smul]
        simp [mul_comm]
      rwa [hL_eq] at ht_sum
    have h_fderiv_bound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r := by
      intro τ hτ p hp
      have hball_sub : Metric.ball p r ⊆ W := fun q hq => h2r_sub (hs_2r p hp q hq)
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (F τ) (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.closedBall (F τ p) (2 * M)) := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have hq2r : q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := hs_2r p hp q hq
        have hp2r : p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := hs_2r p hp p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
        calc ‖F τ q - F τ p‖ ≤ ‖F τ q‖ + ‖F τ p‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add (hM_bound τ hτ q hq2r) (hM_bound τ hτ p hp2r)
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      exact Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball ((hHolo τ hτ).mono hball_sub) hmaps hr
    have h_ae_bound :
        ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun τ hτ p hp => h_fderiv_bound τ (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ) p hp)
    have h_ae_diff :
        ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p) p :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ hτ p hp =>
        ((hHolo τ (Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ)).differentiableAt
          (hW.mem_nhds (hs_sub hp))).hasFDerivAt)
    have hIntFD := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (F := fun p τ => F τ p) (F' := fun p τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p)
      (bound := fun _ => 2 * M / r)
      hs_nhds hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas h_ae_bound intervalIntegrable_const h_ae_diff
    exact hIntFD.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  have h_partial_1 : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => U (ξ, p.2)) p.1) W := by
    intro W U hW hU p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 2
    have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hε
    let R_c : ℝ := (3 / 2 : ℝ) * r
    have hRc : 0 < R_c := by positivity
    let B₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀.1 r ×ˢ Metric.ball p₀.2 r
    have hB₀_open : IsOpen B₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hp₀_B₀ : p₀ ∈ B₀ := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩
    have h_in_W : ∀ z t : ℂ, dist z p₀.1 ≤ R_c → dist t p₀.2 < r → (z, t) ∈ W := by
      intro z t hz ht
      apply hε_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      dsimp only [r, R_c] at hz ht ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun θ p =>
      (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
        (deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) θ *
          (((circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹ * U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ, p.2)))
    have h_cm_dist : ∀ θ : ℝ, dist (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ) p₀.1 = R_c := by
      intro θ
      rw [dist_eq_norm, circleMap_sub_center]
      simp [circleMap, abs_of_pos hRc]
    have h_sub_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ B₀, (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro θ p hp
      apply pow_ne_zero 2
      rw [sub_ne_zero]
      intro h_eq
      have hd1 : dist (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ) p₀.1 = R_c := h_cm_dist θ
      have hd2 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r := hp.1
      rw [h_eq] at hd1
      dsimp only [R_c] at hd1
      linarith
    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2)
        (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) := by
      have hc_deriv : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) q.1) := by
        rw [show (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap p₀.1 R_c) q.1) =
            fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap 0 R_c q.1 * Complex.I by
          ext q; exact deriv_circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1]
        exact ((continuous_circleMap 0 R_c).comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_const
      have hc_cm : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1) :=
        (continuous_circleMap p₀.1 R_c).comp continuous_fst
      have hc_U : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1, q.2.2))
          (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) := by
        refine hU.continuousOn.comp
          (hc_cm.prodMk (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)).continuousOn ?_
        intro q hq
        exact h_in_W _ _ (h_cm_dist q.1).le hq.2.2
      have hc_inv : ContinuousOn
          (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ((circleMap p₀.1 R_c q.1 - q.2.1) ^ 2)⁻¹)
          (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
        ContinuousOn.inv₀
          (((hc_cm.sub (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).pow 2).continuousOn)
          (fun q hq => h_sub_ne q.1 q.2 hq.2)
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (hc_deriv.continuousOn.mul (hc_inv.mul hc_U))
    have hF_holo : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), DifferentiableOn ℂ (F θ) B₀ := by
      intro θ _
      have hd_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹) B₀ :=
        DifferentiableOn.inv
          (((differentiableOn_const (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ)).sub
            differentiable_fst.differentiableOn).pow 2)
          (fun p hp => h_sub_ne θ p hp)
      have hd_U : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => U (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ, p.2)) B₀ :=
        hU.comp ((differentiable_const (circleMap p₀.1 R_c θ)).prodMk
          differentiable_snd).differentiableOn
          (fun p hp => h_in_W _ _ (h_cm_dist θ).le hp.2)
      exact (differentiableOn_const _).mul ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hd_inv.mul hd_U))
    have hInt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F θ p) B₀ :=
      h_param_holo 0 (2 * Real.pi) B₀ F hB₀_open hF_cont hF_holo
    have h_eq_on_B₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => U (ξ, p.2)) p.1) B₀ := by
      refine hInt_holo.congr ?_
      intro p hp
      have hp1_Rc : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball p₀.1 R_c := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        have hd2 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r := hp.1
        dsimp only [R_c]
        linarith
      have hCauchy := (Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
        (hW.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))
        (fun z hz => h_in_W z p.2 hz hp.2)
        (hU.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const p.2)).differentiableOn
          (fun _ hy' => hy'))
        hp1_Rc).symm
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] at hCauchy
      rw [hCauchy, circleIntegral_def_Icc, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      simp [F, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact (h_eq_on_B₀.differentiableAt (hB₀_open.mem_nhds hp₀_B₀)).differentiableWithinAt

  have h_partial_2 : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => U (p.1, ζ)) p.2) W := by
    intro W U hW hU
    let S_swap := ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℂ ℂ ℂ
    have h1 := h_partial_1 (S_swap ⁻¹' W) (U ∘ S_swap) (hW.preimage S_swap.continuous)
      (hU.comp S_swap.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hq))
    have h2 := h1.comp S_swap.differentiable.differentiableOn
      (fun p hp => show S_swap (S_swap p) ∈ W by simpa [S_swap] using hp)
    exact h2.congr (fun p _ => rfl)

  let Φ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => A.Phi (ξ, p.2)) p.1
  let Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => A.Phi (p.1, ζ)) p.2
  have hΦ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₁ U₂ := h_partial_1 U₂ A.Phi A.domain_open A.Phi_holo
  have hΦ₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₂ U₂ := h_partial_2 U₂ A.Phi A.domain_open A.Phi_holo

  have hHasDS : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionA A.Phi s' J t)
        (J ^ 3 * Φ₁ (s, t * J)) s := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    let V₁ : Set ℂ := { s' : ℂ | (s', t * J) ∈ U₂ }
    have hV₁_open : IsOpen V₁ := A.domain_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    have h_diff1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s' : ℂ => A.Phi (s', t * J)) s :=
      (A.Phi_holo.comp
        (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (t * J))).differentiableOn
        (fun _ hs' => hs')).differentiableAt (hV₁_open.mem_nhds h_mem)
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℂ => A.Phi (s', t * J)) (Φ₁ (s, t * J)) s :=
      h_diff1.hasDerivAt
    simpa [steepContActionA] using (hd1.sub_const (1 / 24 : ℂ)).const_mul (J ^ 3)

  have hEqDS : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      steepContActionDS A.Phi s J t = J ^ 3 * Φ₁ (s, t * J) := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    exact (hHasDS s J t h_mem).deriv

  have hHasDJ : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionA A.Phi s J' t)
        (3 * J ^ 2 * (A.Phi (s, t * J) - (1 / 24 : ℂ)) + J ^ 3 * (Φ₂ (s, t * J) * t)) J := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    let V₂ : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | (s, ζ) ∈ U₂ }
    have hV₂_open : IsOpen V₂ := A.domain_open.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have h_diff2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => A.Phi (s, ζ)) (t * J) :=
      (A.Phi_holo.comp
        ((differentiable_const s).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun _ hζ => hζ)).differentiableAt (hV₂_open.mem_nhds h_mem)
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => A.Phi (s, ζ)) (Φ₂ (s, t * J)) (t * J) :=
      h_diff2.hasDerivAt
    have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => t * J') t J := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id J).const_mul t
    have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => A.Phi (s, t * J') - (1 / 24 : ℂ))
        (Φ₂ (s, t * J) * t) J :=
      (hd2.comp J h_lin).sub_const (1 / 24 : ℂ)
    have hd_pow : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 3) (3 * J ^ 2) J := by
      simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 3 J
    exact hd_pow.mul hd_comp

  have hEqDJ : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      steepContActionDJ A.Phi s J t =
        3 * J ^ 2 * (A.Phi (s, t * J) - (1 / 24 : ℂ)) + J ^ 3 * (Φ₂ (s, t * J) * t) := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    exact (hHasDJ s J t h_mem).deriv

  have hpJ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => q.2.1) W₃ :=
    (differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_snd).differentiableOn
  have hpt : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => q.2.2) W₃ :=
    (differentiable_snd.comp differentiable_snd).differentiableOn
  have hPhi_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A.Phi (π q)) W₃ :=
    A.Phi_holo.comp hπ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hq)
  have hΦ₁_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => Φ₁ (π q)) W₃ :=
    hΦ₁_holo.comp hπ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hq)
  have hΦ₂_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => Φ₂ (π q)) W₃ :=
    hΦ₂_holo.comp hπ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hq)

  have hDJ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) W₃ := by
    have h_rhs : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
          3 * q.2.1 ^ 2 * (A.Phi (π q) - (1 / 24 : ℂ)) +
            q.2.1 ^ 3 * (Φ₂ (π q) * q.2.2)) W₃ :=
      (((differentiableOn_const (3 : ℂ)).mul (hpJ.pow 2)).mul
        (hPhi_comp.sub_const (1 / 24 : ℂ))).add
        ((hpJ.pow 3).mul (hΦ₂_comp.mul hpt))
    exact h_rhs.congr (fun q hq => hEqDJ q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 hq)

  have hDS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) W₃ := by
    have h_rhs : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => q.2.1 ^ 3 * Φ₁ (π q)) W₃ :=
      (hpJ.pow 3).mul hΦ₁_comp
    exact h_rhs.congr (fun q hq => hEqDS q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 hq)

  have hP_split : ∀ s J' t : ℂ,
      smallChordActionP A.Phi s J' t =
        (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3 + steepContActionA A.Phi s J' t := by
    intro s J' t
    dsimp [smallChordActionP, steepContActionA]
    ring

  have hP_deriv_J : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      deriv (fun J' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s J' t) J =
        (1 / 8 : ℂ) * J ^ 2 + steepContActionDJ A.Phi s J t := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    have hd_cub : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3) ((1 / 8 : ℂ) * J ^ 2) J := by
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_pow 3 J).const_mul (1 / 24 : ℂ)
      convert h1 using 1
      ring
    have hd_act : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionA A.Phi s J' t)
        (steepContActionDJ A.Phi s J t) J := by
      rw [hEqDJ s J t h_mem]
      exact hHasDJ s J t h_mem
    have hd_sum := hd_cub.add hd_act
    have h_fn : (fun J' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s J' t) =
        (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3 + steepContActionA A.Phi s J' t) := by
      ext J'
      exact hP_split s J' t
    rw [h_fn]
    exact hd_sum.deriv

  have hP_deriv_s : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      deriv (fun s' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s =
        steepContActionDS A.Phi s J t := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    have hd_act : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionA A.Phi s' J t)
        (steepContActionDS A.Phi s J t) s := by
      rw [hEqDS s J t h_mem]
      exact hHasDS s J t h_mem
    have hd_sum : HasDerivAt
        (fun s' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J ^ 3 + steepContActionA A.Phi s' J t)
        (steepContActionDS A.Phi s J t) s :=
      hd_act.const_add ((1 / 24 : ℂ) * J ^ 3)
    have h_fn : (fun s' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) =
        (fun s' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J ^ 3 + steepContActionA A.Phi s' J t) := by
      ext s'
      exact hP_split s' J t
    rw [h_fn]
    exact hd_sum.deriv

  have hConj4 : ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      (s_m, t * J_m) ∈ U₂ → (s_0, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J =
        (deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J -
          t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s_0) -
        deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m := by
    intro s_m J_m s_0 t J hm h0
    rw [hP_deriv_J s_0 J t h0, hP_deriv_s s_0 J t h0, hP_deriv_J s_m J_m t hm]
    dsimp [steepContResidual, steepContPerturbG]
    ring

  have hDiffG_J : ∀ s_0 t J : ℂ, (s_0, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J := by
    intro s_0 t J h0
    let ι_J : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun J' => (s_0, (J', t))
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_J :=
      (differentiable_const s_0).prodMk (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t))
    let W_J : Set ℂ := ι_J ⁻¹' W₃
    have hWJ_open : IsOpen W_J := hW₃_open.preimage hι_diff.continuous
    have hDJ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J' t) J :=
      (hDJ_holo.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hJ' => hJ')).differentiableAt
        (hWJ_open.mem_nhds h0)
    have hDS_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J' t) J :=
      (hDS_holo.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hJ' => hJ')).differentiableAt
        (hWJ_open.mem_nhds h0)
    exact hDJ_at.sub (hDS_at.const_mul t)

  have hConj5 : ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      (s_0, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      HasDerivAt (fun J' => steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J')
        ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J) J := by
    intro s_m J_m s_0 t J h0
    have hd_quad : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J' ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2))
        ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J) J := by
      have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 J).sub_const (J_m ^ 2)).const_mul (1 / 8 : ℂ)
      convert h1 using 1
      ring
    have hd_G : HasDerivAt (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t)
        (deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J) J :=
      (hDiffG_J s_0 t J h0).hasDerivAt
    simpa [steepContResidual] using
      (hd_quad.add hd_G).sub_const (steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t)

  have h_cauchy_closed : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R C : ℝ),
      0 < R →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) →
      ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ C / R := by
    intro f c R C hR hf_diff hf_bnd
    have hf_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall c R) :=
      fun z hz => (hf_diff z hz).differentiableWithinAt
    have hf_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) :=
      hf_on.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl
    exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hf_dc
      (fun z hz => hf_bnd z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))

  have hDiffDJ_s : ∀ s J t : ℂ, (s, t * J) ∈ U₂ →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s' : ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi s' J t) s := by
    intro s J t h_mem
    let ι_s : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun s' => (s', (J, t))
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_s :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (J, t))
    let W_s : Set ℂ := ι_s ⁻¹' W₃
    have hWs_open : IsOpen W_s := hW₃_open.preimage hι_diff.continuous
    exact (hDJ_holo.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hs' => hs')).differentiableAt
      (hWs_open.mem_nhds h_mem)

  have hConj6 : ∀ s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ, ∀ ρ_s ρ_J M_a : ℝ,
      0 < ρ_s → 0 < ρ_J → 0 ≤ M_a → ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ ρ_J →
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
        ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
          (s', t * J') ∈ U₂ ∧ ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
      (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤
          4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) ∧
      ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
      ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ ≤
        (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖ := by
    intro s_m s_0 J_m t ρ_s ρ_J M_a hρ_s hρ_J _hM_a hJm hBound
    have hJm_in3 : J_m ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    have hBound0 : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall s_0 ρ_s,
        ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
          (s', t * J') ∈ U₂ ∧ ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a := by
      intro s' hs' J' hJ'
      have hθ1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
      have hs'_1 :
          s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * s_m + ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s := by
        simpa using hs'
      exact hBound 1 hθ1 s' hs'_1 J' hJ'
    have hs0_self : s_0 ∈ Metric.closedBall s_0 ρ_s := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_s.le
    have hDS_s0 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
        ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s := by
      intro J₁ hJ₁
      exact h_cauchy_closed (fun s' => steepContActionA A.Phi s' J₁ t) s_0 ρ_s M_a hρ_s
        (fun s' hs' => (hHasDS s' J₁ t (hBound0 s' hs' J₁ hJ₁).1).differentiableAt)
        (fun s' hs' => (hBound0 s' hs' J₁ hJ₁).2)
    refine ⟨?_, hDS_s0 J_m hJm_in3, ?_⟩
    · intro J hJ
      have hJ_dist1 : ‖J - 1‖ ≤ 2 * ρ_J := by
        have hJ_Jm : ‖J - J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hJ
        calc ‖J - 1‖ = ‖(J - J_m) + (J_m - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖J - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 2 * ρ_J := by linarith
      let r_J : ℝ := ρ_J / 2
      have hr_J : 0 < r_J := half_pos hρ_J
      have hJ1_in3 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J, J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J) := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hJ₁ ⊢
        calc ‖J₁ - 1‖ = ‖(J₁ - J) + (J - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖J₁ - J‖ + ‖J - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 3 * ρ_J := by dsimp [r_J] at hJ₁; linarith
      have hG_bnd : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J,
          ‖steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t J₁‖ ≤ M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        have hz_in3 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall J₁ r_J,
            z ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J) := by
          intro z hz
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz hJ₁ ⊢
          have h_eq : z - 1 = ((z - J₁) + (J₁ - J)) + (J - 1) := by ring
          have h_tri1 := norm_add_le ((z - J₁) + (J₁ - J)) (J - 1)
          have h_tri2 := norm_add_le (z - J₁) (J₁ - J)
          rw [h_eq]
          dsimp [r_J] at hz hJ₁
          linarith
        have hDJ_J1 : ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / r_J :=
          h_cauchy_closed (fun z => steepContActionA A.Phi s_0 z t) J₁ r_J M_a hr_J
            (fun z hz =>
              (hHasDJ s_0 z t (hBound0 s_0 hs0_self z (hz_in3 z hz)).1).differentiableAt)
            (fun z hz => (hBound0 s_0 hs0_self z (hz_in3 z hz)).2)
        have hDS_J1 : ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s :=
          hDS_s0 J₁ (hJ1_in3 J₁ hJ₁)
        calc ‖steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t J₁‖
            = ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J₁ t - t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ := rfl
          _ ≤ ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ + ‖t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ :=
              norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ + ‖t‖ * ‖steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J₁ t‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) :=
              add_le_add hDJ_J1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDS_J1 (norm_nonneg t))
      have h_raw : ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤
          (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) / r_J :=
        h_cauchy_closed (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J r_J
          (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) hr_J
          (fun J₁ hJ₁ => hDiffG_J s_0 t J₁ (hBound0 s_0 hs0_self J₁ (hJ1_in3 J₁ hJ₁)).1)
          hG_bnd
      have h_alg : (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) / r_J =
          4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J) := by
        dsimp [r_J]
        field_simp [hρ_s.ne', hρ_J.ne']
        ring
      rwa [h_alg] at h_raw
    · let h_DJ : ℂ → ℂ := fun s' => steepContActionDJ A.Phi s' J_m t
      have hz_Jm_in3 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
          z ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
        calc ‖z - 1‖ = ‖(z - J_m) + (J_m - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 3 * ρ_J := by linarith
      have h_seg_data : ∀ σ ∈ segment ℝ s_m s_0,
          DifferentiableAt ℂ h_DJ σ ∧ ‖deriv h_DJ σ‖ ≤ M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J) := by
        intro σ hσ
        rw [segment_eq_image ℝ s_m s_0] at hσ
        rcases hσ with ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩
        set c_θ : ℂ := (1 - θ) • s_m + θ • s_0
        have hc_eq : c_θ = (1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0 := by
          simp [c_θ, Complex.real_smul]
        have hBθ : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s,
            ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J),
              (s', t * J') ∈ U₂ ∧ ‖steepContActionA A.Phi s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a := by
          intro s' hs' J' hJ'
          rw [hc_eq] at hs'
          exact hBound θ hθ s' hs' J' hJ'
        have hc_self : c_θ ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_s.le
        have h_diff_σ : DifferentiableAt ℂ h_DJ c_θ :=
          hDiffDJ_s c_θ J_m t (hBθ c_θ hc_self J_m hJm_in3).1
        have h_DJ_ball : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s, ‖h_DJ s'‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_J := by
          intro s' hs'
          exact h_cauchy_closed (fun z => steepContActionA A.Phi s' z t) J_m ρ_J M_a hρ_J
            (fun z hz => (hHasDJ s' z t (hBθ s' hs' z (hz_Jm_in3 z hz)).1).differentiableAt)
            (fun z hz => (hBθ s' hs' z (hz_Jm_in3 z hz)).2)
        have h_deriv_σ : ‖deriv h_DJ c_θ‖ ≤ (M_a / ρ_J) / ρ_s :=
          h_cauchy_closed h_DJ c_θ ρ_s (M_a / ρ_J) hρ_s
            (fun s' hs' => hDiffDJ_s s' J_m t (hBθ s' hs' J_m hJm_in3).1)
            h_DJ_ball
        have h_div_eq : (M_a / ρ_J) / ρ_s = M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J) := by
          rw [div_div, mul_comm ρ_J ρ_s]
        rw [h_div_eq] at h_deriv_σ
        exact ⟨h_diff_σ, h_deriv_σ⟩
      exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun σ hσ => (h_seg_data σ hσ).1)
        (fun σ hσ => (h_seg_data σ hσ).2)
        (convex_segment s_m s_0)
        (left_mem_segment ℝ s_m s_0)
        (right_mem_segment ℝ s_m s_0)

  exact ⟨hW₃_open, hDJ_holo, hDS_holo, hConj4, hConj5, hConj6⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S)
    (hJets : SteepContJetProp S A) :
    SteepContSolverProp S A

signature.name: steep_holomorphic_step_solver
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S)
    (hJets : SteepContJetProp S A) :
    SteepContSolverProp S A

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCore : ∀ (ρ_J : ℝ) (s_m s_0 t : ℂ),
      IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t →
      let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
      let J_p := steepContSolJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
      (∀ n : ℕ, steepContIterJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t n ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        ‖steepContIterJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t n - steepContIterJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t (n + 1)‖ ≤
          (ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (steepContIterJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t) Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) ∧
      (‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
      deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
        t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m ∧
      (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J'' t) J' -
          t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J' t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J'' t) J_m →
        J' = J_p)) := by
    intro ρ_J s_m s_0 t hPt
    rcases hPt with ⟨ht, hρ_pos, hρ_le, hJm_one, hsm_dom, hball, hres_init⟩
    let J_m : ℂ := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let R : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t w
    let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w - (4 : ℂ) * R w
    let u : ℕ → ℂ := steepContIterJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
    let J_p : ℂ := steepContSolJ A.Phi s_m s_0 t
    have hT_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        HasDerivAt T (-(w - 1) - (4 : ℂ) * deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hR_d : HasDerivAt R ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * w + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w) w :=
        hJets.2.2.2.2.1 s_m J_m s_0 t w (hball w hw).1
      have hT_d : HasDerivAt T
          (1 - (4 : ℂ) * ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * w + deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w)) w :=
        (hasDerivAt_id w).sub (hR_d.const_mul (4 : ℂ))
      convert hT_d using 1
      ring
    have hT_deriv_le : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J, ‖deriv T w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have hw_one : ‖w - 1‖ ≤ 2 * ρ_J := by
        have hsplit : w - 1 = (w - J_m) + (J_m - 1) := by ring
        rw [hsplit]
        exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
      have hG_le : ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := (hball w hw).2
      rw [(hT_hasDeriv w hw).deriv]
      have h4 : ‖(4 : ℂ) * deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w‖ =
          4 * ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        norm_num
      have htri := norm_sub_le (-(w - 1)) ((4 : ℂ) * deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) w)
      rw [norm_neg, h4] at htri
      linarith
    have hT_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J, ∀ w₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        ‖T w₂ - T w₁‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w₂ - w₁‖ := by
      intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
      exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun w hw => (hT_hasDeriv w hw).differentiableAt)
        hT_deriv_le (convex_closedBall J_m ρ_J) hw₁ hw₂
    have hJm_mem : J_m ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le
    have hTJm_sub : ‖T J_m - J_m‖ = 4 * ‖R J_m‖ := by
      have hsub : T J_m - J_m = -(4 : ℂ) * R J_m := by dsimp [T]; ring
      rw [hsub, norm_mul]
      norm_num
    have hT_maps : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J, T w ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hw_dist : ‖w - J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have hlip := hT_lip J_m hJm_mem w hw
      have hsplit : T w - J_m = (T w - T J_m) + (T J_m - J_m) := by ring
      rw [hsplit]
      have htri := norm_add_le (T w - T J_m) (T J_m - J_m)
      linarith
    have hu_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, u n ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact hJm_mem
      | succ n ih => exact hT_maps (u n) ih
    have hu_step : ∀ n : ℕ, dist (u n) (u (n + 1)) ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        rw [pow_zero, mul_one, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
        exact hTJm_sub.le
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at ih ⊢
        have h1 : ‖u (n + 1) - u (n + 2)‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖ :=
          hT_lip (u (n + 1)) (hu_mem (n + 1)) (u n) (hu_mem n)
        calc ‖u (n + 1) - u (n + 2)‖
            ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖ := h1
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by norm_num)
          _ = (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
    have hu_step_ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖ ≤ (ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      have hpow : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
      have h1 : dist (u n) (u (n + 1)) ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := hu_step n
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
      calc ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖
          ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := h1
        _ ≤ (ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hpow
    have hu_cauchy : CauchySeq u :=
      cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2 : ℝ) (4 * ‖R J_m‖) (by norm_num) hu_step
    have hu_lim : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) := hu_cauchy.tendsto_limUnder
    have hJp_mem : J_p ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J :=
      Metric.isClosed_closedBall.mem_of_tendsto hu_lim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_mem)
    have hJp_bound : ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ := by
      have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto₀ (1 / 2 : ℝ) (4 * ‖R J_m‖)
        (by norm_num) hu_step hu_lim
      have hu0 : dist (u 0) J_p = ‖J_p - J_m‖ := by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]; rfl
      calc ‖J_p - J_m‖
          ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) / (1 - 1 / 2) := by rwa [← hu0]
        _ = 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ := by dsimp [R]; ring
    have hTJp : T J_p = J_p := by
      have hlim1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (T J_p)) :=
        ((hT_hasDeriv J_p hJp_mem).continuousAt.tendsto).comp hu_lim
      have hlim2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hu_lim
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim1 hlim2
    have hRJp : R J_p = 0 := by
      have hsub : J_p - (4 : ℂ) * R J_p = J_p := hTJp
      have hmul : (4 : ℂ) * R J_p = 0 := by linear_combination -hsub
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    have hJp_rec :
        deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
          t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J' t) J_m := by
      have h_eq := hJets.2.2.2.1 s_m J_m s_0 t J_p hsm_dom (hball J_p hJp_mem).1
      dsimp only [R] at hRJp
      rw [hRJp] at h_eq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq.symm
    have hJp_uniq : ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_0 J'' t) J' -
          t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J' t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J'' => smallChordActionP A.Phi s_m J'' t) J_m →
        J' = J_p := by
      intro J' hJ'_mem hJ'_rec
      have hRJ' : R J' = 0 := by
        dsimp only [R]
        rw [hJets.2.2.2.1 s_m J_m s_0 t J' hsm_dom (hball J' hJ'_mem).1]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hJ'_rec
      have hTJ' : T J' = J' := by simp [T, hRJ']
      have hlip := hT_lip J_p hJp_mem J' hJ'_mem
      rw [hTJ', hTJp] at hlip
      have hnorm_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖J' - J_p‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hnorm_zero : ‖J' - J_p‖ ≤ 0 := by linarith
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp hnorm_zero)
    exact ⟨hu_mem, hu_step_ρ, hu_lim, hJp_bound, hJp_rec, hJp_uniq⟩
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toFun := Prod.snd
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      cont := continuous_snd }
  have htriple_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ f₃ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₃ U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (f₁ p, (f₂ p, f₃ p))) U := by
    intro U f₁ f₂ f₃ hf₁ hf₂ hf₃
    have hlin : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
          f₁ p • ((1 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) +
          f₂ p • ((0 : ℂ), ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) +
          f₃ p • ((0 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))) U :=
      ((hf₁.smul_const _).add (hf₂.smul_const _)).add (hf₃.smul_const _)
    exact hlin.congr (fun p _ => by ext <;> simp)
  have hslice1_hasDeriv : ∀ y t : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, t)) (1, 0) y := by
    intro y t
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id y).smul_const ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const y ((0 : ℂ), t))
    convert h using 1
    · ext ξ <;> simp
    · ext <;> simp
  have hslice2_hasDeriv : ∀ y t : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (y, ζ)) (0, 1) t := by
    intro y t
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const t (y, (0 : ℂ))).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))
    convert h using 1
    · ext ζ <;> simp
    · ext <;> simp
  have hfderiv_2d : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ g (y, t) →
      ‖fderiv ℂ g (y, t)‖ ≤
        ‖deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => g (ξ, t)) y‖ + ‖deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => g (y, ζ)) t‖ := by
    intro g y t hg
    let L := fderiv ℂ g (y, t)
    have hL : HasFDerivAt g L (y, t) := hg.hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ξ : ℂ => g (ξ, t)) (L (1, 0)) y :=
      hL.comp_hasDerivAt y (hslice1_hasDeriv y t)
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => g (y, ζ)) (L (0, 1)) t :=
      hL.comp_hasDerivAt t (hslice2_hasDeriv y t)
    rw [h1.deriv, h2.deriv]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L (by positivity) (fun h => ?_)
    have hh : h = h.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + h.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    have hLh : L h = h.1 • L (1, 0) + h.2 • L (0, 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hh]
      rw [L.map_add, L.map_smul, L.map_smul]
    rw [hLh]
    have hn1 : ‖h.1‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := le_max_left ‖h.1‖ ‖h.2‖
    have hn2 : ‖h.2‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := le_max_right ‖h.1‖ ‖h.2‖
    calc ‖h.1 • L (1, 0) + h.2 • L (0, 1)‖
        ≤ ‖h.1 • L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h.2 • L (0, 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖h.1‖ * ‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h.2‖ * ‖L (0, 1)‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ * ‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h‖ * ‖L (0, 1)‖ := by gcongr
      _ = (‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖L (0, 1)‖) * ‖h‖ := by ring
  refine ⟨fun ρ_J s_m s_0 t hPt => (hCore ρ_J s_m s_0 t hPt).2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro U ρ_J s_m s_0 hU hs_m hs_0 hContr
  let v : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n p => steepContIterJ A.Phi (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2 n
  let v_inf : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => steepContSolJ A.Phi (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2
  have hsnd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) U := π₂.differentiableOn
  have hv0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (v 0) U := by
    have h_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.2)⁻¹) U :=
      hsnd.inv (fun p hp => (hContr p hp).1)
    have h_mul : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (s_0 p - s_m p) * (p.2)⁻¹) U :=
      (hs_0.sub hs_m).mul h_inv
    exact h_mul.congr (fun p _ => div_eq_mul_inv (s_0 p - s_m p) p.2)
  have hcomp3 : ∀ (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) {f₁ f₂ f₃ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (steepContTripleDomain S A.η_SL) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₃ U →
      (∀ p ∈ U, (f₁ p, f₃ p * f₂ p) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F (f₁ p, (f₂ p, f₃ p))) U := by
    intro F f₁ f₂ f₃ hF hf₁ hf₂ hf₃ hmaps
    exact hF.comp (htriple_holo hf₁ hf₂ hf₃) hmaps
  have hv : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (v n) U := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hv0
    | succ n ih =>
      have hvn_dom : ∀ p ∈ U, (s_0 p, p.2 * v n p) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL := by
        intro p hp
        have hvn_mem : v n p ∈ Metric.closedBall ((s_0 p - s_m p) / p.2) ρ_J :=
          (hCore ρ_J (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2 (hContr p hp)).1 n
        exact ((hContr p hp).2.2.2.2.2.1 (v n p) hvn_mem).1
      have hvm_dom : ∀ p ∈ U, (s_m p, p.2 * v 0 p) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL :=
        fun p hp => (hContr p hp).2.2.2.2.1
      have hDJ_n : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi (s_0 p) (v n p) p.2) U :=
        hcomp3 (fun q => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          hJets.2.1 hs_0 ih hsnd hvn_dom
      have hDS_n : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDS A.Phi (s_0 p) (v n p) p.2) U :=
        hcomp3 (fun q => steepContActionDS A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          hJets.2.2.1 hs_0 ih hsnd hvn_dom
      have hDJ_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContActionDJ A.Phi (s_m p) (v 0 p) p.2) U :=
        hcomp3 (fun q => steepContActionDJ A.Phi q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          hJets.2.1 hs_m hv0 hsnd hvm_dom
      have h_quad : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (1 / 8 : ℂ) * ((v n p) ^ 2 - (v 0 p) ^ 2)) U :=
        ((ih.pow 2).sub (hv0.pow 2)).const_mul (1 / 8 : ℂ)
      have h_pert : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContPerturbG A.Phi (s_0 p) p.2 (v n p)) U :=
        hDJ_n.sub (hsnd.mul hDS_n)
      have h_res : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => steepContResidual A.Phi (s_m p) (v 0 p) (s_0 p) p.2 (v n p)) U :=
        (h_quad.add h_pert).sub hDJ_m
      exact ih.sub (h_res.const_mul (4 : ℂ))
  intro p₀ hp₀
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ_J := (hContr p₀ hp₀).2.1
  obtain ⟨R_open, hR_pos, hR_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀
  let r₀ : ℝ := R_open / 3
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by dsimp [r₀]; positivity
  let P₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r₀
  have hP₀_sub : P₀ ⊆ U := by
    intro p hp
    apply hR_sub
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp ⊢
    dsimp [r₀] at hp
    linarith
  have hfderiv_step : ∀ p ∈ P₀, ∀ n : ℕ,
      dist (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) (fderiv ℂ (v (n + 1)) p) ≤ (ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro p hp n
    have hp_dist : max (dist p.1 p₀.1) (dist p.2 p₀.2) < r₀ := by
      simpa [P₀, Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq] using hp
    have hy_lt : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r₀ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp_dist
    have ht_lt : dist p.2 p₀.2 < r₀ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp_dist
    let d_n : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => v n q - v (n + 1) q
    have hdn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d_n U := (hv n).sub (hv (n + 1))
    let V₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball p₀.1 (3 * r₀)
    have hV₁_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, p.2)) V₁ U := by
      intro ξ hξ
      apply hR_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hξ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      dsimp [r₀] at hξ ht_lt
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hslice1_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, p.2)) :=
      fun ξ => (hslice1_hasDeriv ξ p.2).differentiableAt
    have hslice1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) V₁ :=
      hdn_holo.comp hslice1_diff.differentiableOn hV₁_maps
    have hcb1_sub : Metric.closedBall p.1 r₀ ⊆ V₁ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hξ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle ξ p.1 p₀.1) (by linarith)
    have hdc1 : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) (Metric.ball p.1 r₀) :=
      hslice1_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcb1_sub
    have hsph1 : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.sphere p.1 r₀,
        ‖d_n (ξ, p.2)‖ ≤ (ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξU : (ξ, p.2) ∈ U := hV₁_maps (hcb1_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hξ))
      exact (hCore ρ_J (s_m (ξ, p.2)) (s_0 (ξ, p.2)) p.2 (hContr (ξ, p.2) hξU)).2.1 n
    have hderiv1 : ‖deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) p.1‖ ≤
        ((ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr₀_pos hdc1 hsph1
    let V₂ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball p₀.2 (3 * r₀)
    have hV₂_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : ℂ => (p.1, ζ)) V₂ U := by
      intro ζ hζ
      apply hR_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      dsimp [r₀] at hζ hy_lt
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hslice2_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => (p.1, ζ)) :=
      fun ζ => (hslice2_hasDeriv p.1 ζ).differentiableAt
    have hslice2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) V₂ :=
      hdn_holo.comp hslice2_diff.differentiableOn hV₂_maps
    have hcb2_sub : Metric.closedBall p.2 r₀ ⊆ V₂ := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle ζ p.2 p₀.2) (by linarith)
    have hdc2 : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) (Metric.ball p.2 r₀) :=
      hslice2_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcb2_sub
    have hsph2 : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere p.2 r₀,
        ‖d_n (p.1, ζ)‖ ≤ (ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζU : (p.1, ζ) ∈ U := hV₂_maps (hcb2_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ))
      exact (hCore ρ_J (s_m (p.1, ζ)) (s_0 (p.1, ζ)) ζ (hContr (p.1, ζ) hζU)).2.1 n
    have hderiv2 : ‖deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) p.2‖ ≤
        ((ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr₀_pos hdc2 hsph2
    have hpU : p ∈ U := hP₀_sub hp
    have hvn_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (v n) p := (hv n).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hpU)
    have hvn1_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (v (n + 1)) p :=
      (hv (n + 1)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hpU)
    have hdn_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ d_n (p.1, p.2) := hvn_at.sub hvn1_at
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← fderiv_sub hvn_at hvn1_at]
    calc ‖fderiv ℂ d_n (p.1, p.2)‖
        ≤ ‖deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) p.1‖ +
            ‖deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) p.2‖ :=
          hfderiv_2d d_n p.1 p.2 hdn_at
      _ ≤ ((ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ + ((ρ_J / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
          add_le_add hderiv1 hderiv2
      _ = (ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
  let g' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
    fun p => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => fderiv ℂ (v n) p)
  have hg'_tail : ∀ p ∈ P₀, ∀ n : ℕ,
      dist (g' p) (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) ≤ (2 * ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro p hp n
    have hcauchy : CauchySeq (fun k => fderiv ℂ (v k) p) :=
      cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2 : ℝ) (ρ_J / r₀) (by norm_num) (hfderiv_step p hp)
    have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℂ (v k) p) Filter.atTop (nhds (g' p)) :=
      hcauchy.tendsto_limUnder
    have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2 : ℝ) (ρ_J / r₀)
      (by norm_num) (hfderiv_step p hp) hlim n
    rw [dist_comm]
    calc dist (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) (g' p)
        ≤ (ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2) := hd
      _ = (2 * ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
  have hunif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n p => fderiv ℂ (v n) p) g' Filter.atTop P₀ := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hzero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 * ρ_J / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
          (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (2 * ρ_J / r₀)
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.mp hzero).2 ε hε] with n hn p hp
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hg'_tail p hp n) hn
  have hv_fderiv : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ P₀, HasFDerivAt (v n) (fderiv ℂ (v n) x) x := by
    intro n x hx
    exact ((hv n).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hP₀_sub hx))).hasFDerivAt
  have hv_pt : ∀ x ∈ P₀, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => v n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf x)) := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hCore ρ_J (s_m x) (s_0 x) x.2 (hContr x (hP₀_sub hx))).2.2.1
  have h_fderiv_p₀ : HasFDerivAt v_inf (g' p₀) p₀ :=
    hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn Metric.isOpen_ball hunif hv_fderiv hv_pt
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos)
  exact h_fderiv_p₀.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro δ_ceil hδ_pos hδ_lt
  have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  let H_1 : ℝ := S.H - δ_ceil / 8
  let H_2 : ℝ := S.H - (3 / 16 : ℝ) * δ_ceil
  let ρ_z : ℝ := δ_ceil / 32
  have hH1_pos : 0 < H_1 := by dsimp [H_1]; linarith
  have hH1_lt : H_1 < S.H := by dsimp [H_1]; linarith
  have hH2_pos : 0 < H_2 := by dsimp [H_2]; linarith
  have hH2_lt_H1 : H_2 < H_1 := by dsimp [H_1, H_2]; linarith
  have hρz_pos : 0 < ρ_z := by dsimp [ρ_z]; linarith
  obtain ⟨r_sub, hr_sub_pos, hr_sub_lt, hRec⟩ := A.exact_recurrence H_1 hH1_pos hH1_lt
  let r_1 : ℝ := r_sub / 2
  have hr1_pos : 0 < r_1 := by dsimp [r_1]; linarith
  have hr1_lt_sub : r_1 < r_sub := by dsimp [r_1]; linarith
  let r_base : ℝ := min r_1 ρ_z
  have hr_base_pos : 0 < r_base := lt_min hr1_pos hρz_pos
  have hr_base_le_r1 : r_base ≤ r_1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hr_base_le_ρz : r_base ≤ ρ_z := min_le_right _ _
  have hr_base_lt_star : r_base < S.r_star :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt hr_base_le_r1 (lt_trans hr1_lt_sub hr_sub_lt)
  let U_sub : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStrip H_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub
  let g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 p - p.1
  have hU_sub_tube : U_sub ⊆ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hz, ht⟩
    have ht_norm : ‖p.2‖ < r_sub := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
    exact (hRec p.1 p.2 hz ht_norm).1
  have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_sub :=
    (S.𝔰_holo.mono hU_sub_tube).sub differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
  have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g U_sub := hg_holo.continuousOn
  have hg_per_one : ∀ (z t : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H_1 → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      g (z + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g (z, t) := by
    intro z t hz ht
    have h_mem : (z, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := (hRec z t hz ht).1
    have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (z, t) h_mem
    dsimp [g] at hqp ⊢
    rw [hqp]
    ring
  have hg_per_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z t : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H_1 → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      g (z + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ), t) = g (z, t) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro z t _ _
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro z t hz ht
      have hz_n : z + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H_1 := by
        simpa [horizStrip] using hz
      have h_step : z + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (z + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_step, hg_per_one _ t hz_n ht, ih z t hz ht]
  have hg_per_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (z t : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H_1 → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      g (z + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ), t) = g (z, t) := by
    intro k z t hz ht
    rcases k with n | n
    · simpa using hg_per_nat n z t hz ht
    · set z' : ℂ := z + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hz' : z' ∈ horizStrip H_1 := by
        simpa [z', horizStrip] using hz
      have h_back : z' + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = z := by
        simp only [z', Int.cast_negSucc]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h1 := hg_per_nat (n + 1) z' t hz' ht
      rw [h_back] at h1
      exact h1.symm
  have hg_mod_2pi : ∀ (z t : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H_1 → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      ∃ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        g (z, t) = g ((x₀ : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) := by
    intro z t hz ht
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let k : ℤ := ⌊z.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x₀ : ℝ := z.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ z.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
    have hk_lt : z.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hx₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ x₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_le
      linarith
    have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_lt
      linarith
    refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀_nonneg, hx₀_le⟩, ?_⟩
    set z₀ : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ horizStrip H_1 := by
      simpa [z₀, horizStrip] using hz
    have hz_eq : z₀ + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = z := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [z₀, x₀]
      · simp [z₀]
    rw [← hz_eq, hg_per_int k z₀ t hz₀ ht]
  let K_box : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ) :=
    (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H_2) H_2) ×ˢ
      Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_1
  have hK_comp : IsCompact K_box :=
    (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_1)
  have hK_ne : K_box.Nonempty :=
    ⟨((0, 0), 0), ⟨⟨le_rfl, by positivity⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩,
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr1_pos.le⟩
  let ψ : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => ((q.1.1 : ℂ) + (q.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)
  have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
  have hψ_maps : Set.MapsTo ψ K_box U_sub := by
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with ⟨⟨_, hq_im_lo, hq_im_hi⟩, hq_t⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change |((q.1.1 : ℂ) + (q.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < H_1
      have him : ((q.1.1 : ℂ) + (q.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = q.1.2 := by simp
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · exact Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr1_lt_sub hq_t
  have h_norm_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q => ‖g (ψ q)‖) K_box :=
    (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hg_cont).comp hψ_cont.continuousOn hψ_maps
  obtain ⟨q_max, _, hq_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne h_norm_cont
  let M_box : ℝ := max ‖g (ψ q_max)‖ 1
  have hM_box_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_box := le_max_right _ _
  have hM_box_pos : 0 < M_box := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_box_ge_one
  have hg_slab_bdd : ∀ (z t : ℂ), |z.im| ≤ H_2 → ‖t‖ ≤ r_1 → ‖g (z, t)‖ ≤ M_box := by
    intro z t hz_im ht_r1
    have hz_H1 : z ∈ horizStrip H_1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hz_im hH2_lt_H1
    have ht_sub : ‖t‖ < r_sub := lt_of_le_of_lt ht_r1 hr1_lt_sub
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hg_eq⟩ := hg_mod_2pi z t hz_H1 ht_sub
    have hq_mem : ((x₀, z.im), t) ∈ K_box := by
      refine ⟨⟨hx₀, abs_le.mp hz_im⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using ht_r1
    have hg_psi : g ((x₀ : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) = g (ψ ((x₀, z.im), t)) := rfl
    rw [hg_eq, hg_psi]
    exact le_trans (hq_max hq_mem) (le_max_left _ _)
  let C_0 : ℝ := M_box / r_1 ^ 2
  have hC0_pos : 0 < C_0 := by positivity
  have hg_quad_bdd : ∀ (z t : ℂ), |z.im| ≤ H_2 → ‖t‖ ≤ r_1 →
      ‖g (z, t)‖ ≤ C_0 * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro z t hz_im ht_r1
    have hz_H1 : z ∈ horizStrip H_1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hz_im hH2_lt_H1
    have hz_H : z ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_trans hz_H1 hH1_lt
    let f_z : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => g (z, w)
    have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_z (Metric.ball 0 r_sub) := by
      have h_slice_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (z, w)) :=
        Differentiable.prodMk (differentiable_const z) differentiable_id
      have h_slice_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℂ => (z, w)) (Metric.ball 0 r_sub) U_sub :=
        fun w hw => ⟨hz_H1, hw⟩
      exact hg_holo.comp h_slice_diff.differentiableOn h_slice_maps
    have hf0 : f_z 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [f_z, g]
      rw [S.𝔰_zero z hz_H, sub_self]
    have hdf0 : deriv f_z 0 = 0 := by
      have h_d : deriv (fun w : ℂ => S.𝔰 (z, w) - z) 0 = deriv (fun w : ℂ => S.𝔰 (z, w)) 0 :=
        deriv_sub_const z
      dsimp [f_z, g]
      rw [h_d, S.𝔰_deriv_t_zero z hz_H]
    let q_z : ℂ → ℂ := dslope (dslope f_z 0) 0
    have h_nhds : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
      Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_sub_pos
    have hd1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope f_z 0) (Metric.ball 0 r_sub) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope h_nhds).mpr hf_holo
    have hq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q_z (Metric.ball 0 r_sub) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope h_nhds).mpr hd1_holo
    have hd1_zero : dslope f_z 0 0 = 0 := by
      rw [dslope_same, hdf0]
    have hf_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, f_z w = w ^ 2 * q_z w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := sub_smul_dslope f_z 0 w
      have h2 := sub_smul_dslope (dslope f_z 0) 0 w
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hf0, hd1_zero] at h1 h2
      calc f_z w = w * dslope f_z 0 w := h1.symm
        _ = w * (w * q_z w) := by rw [← h2]
        _ = w ^ 2 * q_z w := by ring
    have hq_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ q_z (Metric.ball 0 r_1) :=
      hq_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr1_lt_sub)
    have hq_front : ∀ w ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1), ‖q_z w‖ ≤ C_0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hr1_pos.ne'] at hw
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = r_1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hw
      have hfw : ‖f_z w‖ ≤ M_box := hg_slab_bdd z w hz_im hw_norm.le
      rw [hf_eq w, norm_mul, norm_pow, hw_norm] at hfw
      exact (le_div_iff₀' (sq_pos_of_pos hr1_pos)).mpr hfw
    have ht_cl : t ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1) := by
      rw [closure_ball (0 : ℂ) hr1_pos.ne']
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using ht_r1
    have hqt : ‖q_z t‖ ≤ C_0 :=
      Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hq_dc hq_front ht_cl
    calc ‖g (z, t)‖ = ‖f_z t‖ := rfl
      _ = ‖t ^ 2 * q_z t‖ := by rw [hf_eq t]
      _ = ‖t‖ ^ 2 * ‖q_z t‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      _ ≤ ‖t‖ ^ 2 * C_0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqt (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = C_0 * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _
  let C_base : ℝ := max C_0 (32 * C_0 / δ_ceil)
  have hC_base_pos : 0 < C_base := lt_of_lt_of_le hC0_pos (le_max_left _ _)
  have hC0_le_base : C_0 ≤ C_base := le_max_left _ _
  have hC1_le_base : 32 * C_0 / δ_ceil ≤ C_base := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨r_base, C_base, hr_base_pos, hr_base_lt_star, hC_base_pos, ?_⟩
  intro y t hy_im ht_lt
  have hy_H2 : |y.im| ≤ H_2 := by dsimp [H_2]; linarith
  have hy_H1 : y ∈ horizStrip H_1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hy_H2 hH2_lt_H1
  have ht_r1 : ‖t‖ ≤ r_1 := le_trans ht_lt.le hr_base_le_r1
  have ht_ρz : ‖t‖ ≤ ρ_z := le_trans ht_lt.le hr_base_le_ρz
  have ht_sub : ‖t‖ < r_sub := lt_of_le_of_lt ht_r1 hr1_lt_sub
  have hRec_yt := hRec y t hy_H1 ht_sub
  have h_disp_yt : ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖ = ‖g (y, t)‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ C_0 * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := hg_quad_bdd y t hy_H2 ht_r1
      _ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC0_le_base (sq_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨hRec_yt.1, hRec_yt.2.1, hRec_yt.2.2.1, h_disp_yt, ?_⟩
  intro ht_ne
  have ht_pos : 0 < ‖t‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ht_ne
  rcases hRec_yt.2.2.2 ht_ne with ⟨hDom1, hDom2, _, _, hEq⟩
  let h_t : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g (z, t)
  have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_t (horizStrip H_1) := by
    have h_slice_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, t)) :=
      Differentiable.prodMk differentiable_id (differentiable_const t)
    have h_slice_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℂ => (z, t)) (horizStrip H_1) U_sub :=
      fun z hz => ⟨hz, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht_sub⟩
    exact hg_holo.comp h_slice_diff.differentiableOn h_slice_maps
  have h_open_H1 : IsOpen (horizStrip H_1) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_disk_im : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ_z,
      ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall w ρ_z, |ζ.im| ≤ H_2 := by
    intro w hw ζ hζ
    have hw_norm : ‖w - y‖ ≤ ρ_z := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
    have hζ_norm : ‖ζ - w‖ ≤ ρ_z := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hζ
    have h_im_w : |(w - y).im| ≤ ρ_z := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - y)) hw_norm
    have h_im_ζ : |(ζ - w).im| ≤ ρ_z := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ - w)) hζ_norm
    have h_eq_im : ζ.im = y.im + (w - y).im + (ζ - w).im := by simp
    rw [abs_le] at hy_im h_im_w h_im_ζ ⊢
    dsimp [H_2, ρ_z] at h_im_w h_im_ζ ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h_deriv_bd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ_z,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ h_t w ∧ ‖deriv h_t w‖ ≤ (32 * C_0 / δ_ceil) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have h_sub : Metric.closedBall w ρ_z ⊆ horizStrip H_1 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_disk_im w hw ζ hζ) hH2_lt_H1
    have hw_mem : w ∈ horizStrip H_1 := h_sub (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρz_pos.le)
    have h_diffAt : DifferentiableAt ℂ h_t w :=
      hh_holo.differentiableAt (h_open_H1.mem_nhds hw_mem)
    have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ h_t (Metric.ball w ρ_z) :=
      hh_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_sub
    have h_sph : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere w ρ_z, ‖h_t ζ‖ ≤ C_0 * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      exact hg_quad_bdd ζ t (h_disk_im w hw ζ (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)) ht_r1
    have h_cauchy := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρz_pos h_dc h_sph
    have h_div_eq : (C_0 * ‖t‖ ^ 2) / ρ_z = (32 * C_0 / δ_ceil) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [ρ_z]
      ring
    rw [h_div_eq] at h_cauchy
    exact ⟨h_diffAt, h_cauchy⟩
  have h_conv : Convex ℝ (Metric.closedBall y ρ_z) := convex_closedBall y ρ_z
  have hy_mem : y ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ_z := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρz_pos.le
  have hyp_mem : y + t ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ_z := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using ht_ρz
  have hym_mem : y - t ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ_z := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using ht_ρz
  have h_mvt_p := h_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
    (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).1) (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).2) hy_mem hyp_mem
  have h_mvt_m := h_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
    (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).1) (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).2) hym_mem hy_mem
  have h_diff_p : ‖h_t (y + t) - h_t y‖ ≤ ((32 * C_0 / δ_ceil) * ‖t‖ ^ 2) * ‖t‖ := by
    simpa using h_mvt_p
  have h_diff_m : ‖h_t y - h_t (y - t)‖ ≤ ((32 * C_0 / δ_ceil) * ‖t‖ ^ 2) * ‖t‖ := by
    simpa using h_mvt_m
  dsimp only
  have hJm_eq : (S.𝔰 (y, t) - S.𝔰 (y - t, t)) / t - 1 = (h_t y - h_t (y - t)) / t := by
    dsimp [h_t, g]
    field_simp [ht_ne]
    ring
  have hJp_eq : (S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - S.𝔰 (y, t)) / t - 1 = (h_t (y + t) - h_t y) / t := by
    dsimp [h_t, g]
    field_simp [ht_ne]
    ring
  have hJm_bd : ‖(S.𝔰 (y, t) - S.𝔰 (y - t, t)) / t - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hJm_eq, norm_div]
    exact le_trans ((div_le_iff₀ ht_pos).mpr h_diff_m)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC1_le_base (sq_nonneg _))
  have hJp_bd : ‖(S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - S.𝔰 (y, t)) / t - 1‖ ≤ C_base * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hJp_eq, norm_div]
    exact le_trans ((div_le_iff₀ ht_pos).mpr h_diff_p)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC1_le_base (sq_nonneg _))
  exact ⟨hJm_bd, hJp_bd, hDom1, hDom2, hEq⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  constructor
  · 
    intro β x_start Δ M hβ hx_pos hΔ_pos
    have h1β_neg : 1 - β < 0 := by linarith only [hβ]
    have h1β_ne : 1 - β ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt h1β_neg
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (x_start + u) ^ (1 - β) / (1 - β)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → HasDerivAt g ((x_start + u) ^ (-β)) u := by
      intro u hu
      have hxu_pos : 0 < x_start + u := by linarith only [hx_pos, hu]
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => x_start + v) 1 u := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_add x_start
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => z ^ (1 - β))
          ((1 - β) * (x_start + u) ^ ((1 - β) - 1)) (x_start + u) :=
        Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl (ne_of_gt hxu_pos))
      have h3 : HasDerivAt g
          (((1 - β) * (x_start + u) ^ ((1 - β) - 1) * 1) / (1 - β)) u :=
        (h2.comp u h1).div_const (1 - β)
      have h_eq : ((1 - β) * (x_start + u) ^ ((1 - β) - 1) * 1) / (1 - β) =
          (x_start + u) ^ (-β) := by
        have h_exp : (1 - β) - 1 = -β := by ring
        rw [h_exp, mul_one, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h1β_ne]
      rwa [h_eq] at h3
    let f_tele : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => g ((k : ℝ) * Δ)
    have h_step : ∀ j : ℕ,
        Δ * (x_start + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Δ) ^ (-β) ≤ f_tele (j + 1) - f_tele j := by
      intro j
      set a_j : ℝ := (j : ℝ) * Δ
      set b_j : ℝ := (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Δ
      have ha_nonneg : 0 ≤ a_j := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j) hΔ_pos.le
      have hba : b_j - a_j = Δ := by
        dsimp [a_j, b_j]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hab : a_j < b_j := by linarith only [hba, hΔ_pos]
      have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a_j b_j) := by
        intro u hu
        exact (hg_deriv u (le_trans ha_nonneg hu.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have hg_oo : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo a_j b_j, HasDerivAt g ((x_start + u) ^ (-β)) u := by

        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]

      exact (h_seg_bound 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩ s_m h_sm_mem J_m hJm_mem3).1
    have h_Jball : ∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m ρ_J,
        (s_0, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL ∧
        ‖deriv (steepContPerturbG A.Phi s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := by
      intro J hJ
      have hJ_dist : ‖J - J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hJ
      have hJ_mem3 : J ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 * ρ_J) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_tri : ‖J - 1‖ ≤ ‖J - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (J - J_m) (J_m - 1)
        linarith only [h_tri, hJ_dist, hJm_err, hρJ_pos]
      have h_s0_mem : s_0 ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * s_m + ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s := by
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, hρ_s_pos.le]
      have h_s0_dom := (h_seg_bound 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ s_0 h_s0_mem J hJ_mem3).1
      have hG_raw := hJet_G J hJ
      have ht_over_ρs : 2 * ‖t‖ / ρ_s ≤ 1600 * K := by
        have h_eq : 2 * ‖t‖ / ρ_s = 80 * ‖t‖ / x_p := by dsimp [ρ_s]; ring
        rw [h_eq, div_le_iff₀ hx_p_pos]
        linarith only [ht_lt_20K]
      have hG_le_DG : 4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J) ≤ D_G * M_a := by
        have h_eq : 2 * ‖t‖ * M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J) = (2 * ‖t‖ / ρ_s) * (M_a / ρ_J) := by ring
        have h_le : (2 * ‖t‖ / ρ_s) * (M_a / ρ_J) ≤ (1600 * K) * (M_a / ρ_J) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht_over_ρs (by positivity)
        have h_alg : 4 * M_a / ρ_J ^ 2 + 1600 * K * (M_a / ρ_J) = D_G * M_a := by
          dsimp [D_G]
          ring
        linarith only [h_eq, h_le, h_alg]
      have hDG_Ma : D_G * M_a ≤ 1 / 32 := by
        have hMa_le : M_a ≤ C_Ma * Θ_adm :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΛ0_sq_le_Θ hCMa_pos.le
        have h1 : D_G * M_a ≤ D_G * C_Ma * Θ_adm := by
          calc D_G * M_a ≤ D_G * (C_Ma * Θ_adm) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMa_le hDG_pos.le
            _ = D_G * C_Ma * Θ_adm := by ring
        have h2 : 32 * (D_G * C_Ma * Θ_adm) ≤ 1 := by
          have h_raw := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 32 * D_G * C_Ma)).mp hΘ_le_G
          have h_assoc : Θ_adm * (32 * D_G * C_Ma) = 32 * (D_G * C_Ma * Θ_adm) := by ring
          linarith only [h_raw, h_assoc]
        linarith only [h1, h2]
      exact ⟨h_s0_dom, le_trans hG_raw (le_trans hG_le_DG hDG_Ma)⟩
    
    have h_res_eq : steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m =
        (steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t) -
          t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t := by
      unfold steepContResidual steepContPerturbG
      ring
    have hs0_sub_sm : ‖s_0 - s_m‖ ≤ 2 * ‖t‖ := by
      rw [← htJm, norm_mul]
      have hJm_norm : ‖J_m‖ ≤ 2 := by
        have h_one : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1 := norm_one
        have h_tri : ‖J_m‖ ≤ ‖J_m - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (J_m - 1) 1
        linarith only [h_tri, h_one, hJm_err, hρJ_le]
      calc ‖t‖ * ‖J_m‖ ≤ ‖t‖ * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJm_norm (norm_nonneg t)
        _ = 2 * ‖t‖ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_res_raw : ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤
        (2 / ρ_J + 1) * (‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s) := by
      rw [h_res_eq]
      have h1 : ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ ≤
          (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * (2 * ‖t‖) :=
        le_trans hJet_DJ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs0_sub_sm (by positivity))
      have h2 : ‖t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJet_DS (norm_nonneg t)
      calc ‖(steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t) -
              t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖
          ≤ ‖steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_0 J_m t - steepContActionDJ A.Phi s_m J_m t‖ +
              ‖t * steepContActionDS A.Phi s_0 J_m t‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ (M_a / (ρ_s * ρ_J)) * (2 * ‖t‖) + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) := add_le_add h1 h2
        _ = (2 / ρ_J + 1) * (‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s) := by ring
    have h_inv_ρs : 1 / ρ_s ≤ 40 * K1 / x_0_dep := by
      have h_eq : 1 / ρ_s = 40 / x_p := by dsimp [ρ_s]; ring
      rw [h_eq, div_le_div_iff₀ hx_p_pos hx0_pos]
      linarith only [hx0_lt_K1]
    have h_8res_mid : 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤
        C_res * (‖t‖ / x_0_dep) * Λ_0 ^ 2 := by
      calc 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖
          ≤ 8 * ((2 / ρ_J + 1) * (‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_res_raw (by norm_num)
        _ = 8 * (2 / ρ_J + 1) * (‖t‖ * M_a) * (1 / ρ_s) := by ring
        _ ≤ 8 * (2 / ρ_J + 1) * (‖t‖ * M_a) * (40 * K1 / x_0_dep) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_ρs (by positivity)
        _ = C_res * (‖t‖ / x_0_dep) * Λ_0 ^ 2 := by
            dsimp [C_res, M_a]
            ring
    have h_8res_scale : 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤
        C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * B ^ 2 * x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α - 1) := by
      have hx0_exp : x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α) / x_0_dep = x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α - 1) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.rpow_neg_one x_0_dep, ← Real.rpow_add hx0_pos (-2 * α) (-1)]
        ring_nf
      calc 8 * ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖
          ≤ C_res * (‖t‖ / x_0_dep) * Λ_0 ^ 2 := h_8res_mid
        _ = C_res * (‖t‖ / x_0_dep) * (‖t‖ ^ 2 * B ^ 2 * x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α)) := by
            rw [hΛ0_sq_eq]
        _ = C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * B ^ 2 * (x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α) / x_0_dep) := by ring
        _ = C_res * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * B ^ 2 * x_0_dep ^ (-2 * α - 1) := by rw [hx0_exp]
    have h_res_ρJ8 : ‖steepContResidual A.Phi s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ ρ_J / 8 := by
      have ht_x0_le : ‖t‖ / x_0_dep ≤ 20 * K := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hx0_pos]
        exact ht_lt_20K_x0.le
      have h1 : C_res * (‖t‖ / x_0_dep) * Λ_0 ^ 2 ≤ C_res * (20 * K) * Θ_adm := by
        refine mul_le_mul ?_ hΛ0_sq_le_Θ (by positivity) (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_x0_le hCres_pos.le
      have h2 : C_res * (20 * K) * Θ_adm ≤ ρ_J := by
        have h_raw := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 20 * K * C_res)).mp hΘ_le_res
        have h_assoc : Θ_adm * (20 * K * C_res) = C_res * (20 * K) * Θ_adm := by ring
        linarith only [h_raw, h_assoc]
      linarith only [h_8res_mid, h1, h2]
    have h_contractive : IsSteepContContractivePt S A ρ_J s_m s_0 t :=
      ⟨ht_ne, hρJ_pos, hρJ_le, hJm_err, h_sm_dom, h_Jball, h_res_ρJ8⟩
    exact ⟨h_contractive, h_8res_scale⟩

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S)
