proof.tactics:
by
  intro α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b hα1 hα2 hm_pos hγ_pos hγ_lt hδc_pos hδc_lt_b hδb_lt_H L K hK_pos
  have hδc_lt_half : δ_ceil < S.H / 2 := lt_trans hδc_lt_b hδb_lt_H
  obtain ⟨r_base, C_base, hr_base_pos, hr_base_lt, hC_base_pos, hBase_at⟩ :=
    hBase δ_ceil hδc_pos hδc_lt_half
  have hMesh := hAdm.1
  obtain ⟨Θ_adm, C_res, hΘ_adm_pos, hC_res_pos, hAdm_all⟩ :=
    hAdm.2 α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b K hα1 hα2 hm_pos hγ_pos hγ_lt hδc_pos hδc_lt_b
      hδb_lt_H hK_pos
  have hα_pos : 0 < α := by linarith
  have h1_sub_α_pos : 0 < 1 - α := by linarith
  have h2α_sub_1_pos : 0 < 2 * α - 1 := by linarith
  let ρ_J : ℝ := 1 / (400 * (1 + 20 * K))
  let ρ_pos : ℝ := 1 / (100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2)
  have hρ_J_pos : 0 < ρ_J := by positivity
  have hρ_pos_pos : 0 < ρ_pos := by positivity
  have hρ_pos_le_quarter : ρ_pos ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 20 * K := by linarith
    have hden : (4 : ℝ) ≤ 100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2 := by
      calc (4 : ℝ) ≤ 100 * 1 ^ 2 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 100 * (1 + 20 * K) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le_one h1 2) (by norm_num)
    dsimp [ρ_pos]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hden
  let C_J : ℝ := C_base * δ_ceil ^ (2 * α) + C_res / (2 * α * γ_steep)
  have hC_J_pos : 0 < C_J := by positivity
  let C_st : ℝ := C_base * δ_ceil ^ (2 * α - 1) +
    C_J * (20 * K + 1 / ((2 * α - 1) * γ_steep))
  have hC_st_pos : 0 < C_st := by positivity
  let Θ_star : ℝ := min (min 1 Θ_adm) (min (ρ_J / C_J) (ρ_pos / C_st))
  have hΘ_star_pos : 0 < Θ_star :=
    lt_min (lt_min zero_lt_one hΘ_adm_pos) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  let ε_st : ℝ := Θ_star / 20
  have hε_st_pos : 0 < ε_st := by positivity
  let t_max : ℝ := min (min 1 (min (r_base / 2) (δ_ceil / 100)))
    (min (ρ_J / (2 * C_base)) ((ρ_pos * (δ_ceil / 4)) / C_base))
  have ht_max_pos : 0 < t_max :=
    lt_min (lt_min zero_lt_one (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)))
      (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  let d_st : ℝ := min ((Θ_star / (20 * K)) ^ (1 / (1 - α)))
    ((t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α)) ^ (1 / (1 - α)))
  have hd_st_pos : 0 < d_st :=
    lt_min (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _)
  refine ⟨C_st, ε_st, d_st, hC_st_pos, hε_st_pos, hd_st_pos, ?_⟩
  intro d x₀ r ε hd_pos hd_lt hr_pos hr_le hε_pos hε_le hCone
  have hrpow_inv_cancel : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → (u ^ (1 / (1 - α))) ^ (1 - α) = u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hu.le, one_div_mul_cancel h1_sub_α_pos.ne', Real.rpow_one]
  have hd_Θ : 10 * K * d ^ (1 - α) < Θ_star / 2 := by
    have hd1 : d < (Θ_star / (20 * K)) ^ (1 / (1 - α)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hd_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr1 : d ^ (1 - α) < Θ_star / (20 * K) := by
      calc d ^ (1 - α)
          < ((Θ_star / (20 * K)) ^ (1 / (1 - α))) ^ (1 - α) :=
            Real.rpow_lt_rpow hd_pos.le hd1 h1_sub_α_pos
        _ = Θ_star / (20 * K) := hrpow_inv_cancel _ (by positivity)
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hr1 (show (0 : ℝ) < 10 * K by positivity)
    have h_eq : 10 * K * (Θ_star / (20 * K)) = Θ_star / 2 := by
      field_simp [hK_pos.ne']
      ring
    rwa [h_eq] at hmul
  have hd_tmax : 10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α * d ^ (1 - α) < t_max := by
    have hd2 : d < (t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α)) ^ (1 / (1 - α)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hd_lt (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr2 : d ^ (1 - α) < t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α) := by
      calc d ^ (1 - α)
          < ((t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α)) ^ (1 / (1 - α))) ^ (1 - α) :=
            Real.rpow_lt_rpow hd_pos.le hd2 h1_sub_α_pos
        _ = t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α) := hrpow_inv_cancel _ (by positivity)
    have hδcα_pos : 0 < δ_ceil ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hδc_pos α
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hr2 (show (0 : ℝ) < 10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α by positivity)
    have h_eq : 10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α * (t_max / (10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α)) = t_max := by
      field_simp [hK_pos.ne', hδcα_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq] at hmul
  let Θ : ℝ := 10 * K * d ^ (1 - α) + 10 * ε
  have hΘ_pos : 0 < Θ := by positivity
  have hΘ_le_star : Θ ≤ Θ_star := by
    have : 10 * ε ≤ Θ_star / 2 := by dsimp [ε_st] at hε_le; linarith
    dsimp [Θ]
    linarith
  have hΘ2_le_star : Θ ^ 2 ≤ Θ_star := by
    have hΘ_le_one : Θ ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans hΘ_le_star (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hsq : Θ ^ 2 ≤ Θ := by
      calc Θ ^ 2 = Θ * Θ := sq Θ
        _ ≤ Θ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΘ_le_one hΘ_pos.le
        _ = Θ := mul_one Θ
    exact le_trans hsq hΘ_le_star
  have hΘ_le_adm : Θ ≤ Θ_adm :=
    le_trans hΘ_le_star (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hCJ_Θ2 : C_J * Θ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_J := by
    have h1 : Θ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_J / C_J :=
      le_trans hΘ2_le_star (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    calc C_J * Θ ^ 2 ≤ C_J * (ρ_J / C_J) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hC_J_pos.le
      _ = ρ_J := mul_div_cancel₀ ρ_J hC_J_pos.ne'
  have hCst_Θ2 : C_st * Θ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_pos := by
    have h1 : Θ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_pos / C_st :=
      le_trans hΘ2_le_star (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    calc C_st * Θ ^ 2 ≤ C_st * (ρ_pos / C_st) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hC_st_pos.le
      _ = ρ_pos := mul_div_cancel₀ ρ_pos hC_st_pos.ne'
  have hAdm_step := hAdm_all d x₀ r ε hd_pos hr_pos hr_le hε_pos hΘ_le_adm hCone
  let B : ℝ := 1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α
  have hB_ge_one : 1 ≤ B := by
    have : 0 ≤ (ε / r) * d ^ α := by positivity
    dsimp [B]; linarith
  have hB_pos : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB_ge_one
  have hB2_ge_one : 1 ≤ B ^ 2 := by
    calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 ^ 2 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ B ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le_one hB_ge_one 2
  let W_up : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
      |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
      ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
      γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im }
  have hW_up_open : IsOpen W_up := by
    have hf_depth : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.H - p.1.im) :=
      continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)
    have h1 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im } :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const hf_depth
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil } :=
      isOpen_lt hf_depth continuous_const
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) } :=
      isOpen_lt ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const).abs
        (continuous_const.mul hf_depth)
    have h4 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α } :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_snd.norm
        (continuous_const.mul ((hf_depth.div_const d).rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hα_pos.le)))
    have h5 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd.norm)
        (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter (h4.inter h5)))
  have ht_small : ∀ p ∈ W_up,
      ‖p.2‖ < r_base / 2 ∧
      ‖p.2‖ < δ_ceil / 100 ∧
      2 * C_base * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_J ∧
      C_base * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_pos * (δ_ceil / 4) := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, _, hp4, _⟩
    have hδy_pos : 0 < S.H - p.1.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
    have hd_sub : d / d ^ α = d ^ (1 - α) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hd_pos 1 α, Real.rpow_one]
    have hrpow_le : ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ≤ δ_ceil ^ α / d ^ α := by
      calc ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α
          ≤ (δ_ceil / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hp2.le hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le
        _ = δ_ceil ^ α / d ^ α := Real.div_rpow hδc_pos.le hd_pos.le α
    have ht_lt_max : ‖p.2‖ < t_max := by
      calc ‖p.2‖
          < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α := hp4
        _ ≤ 10 * (K * d) * (δ_ceil ^ α / d ^ α) := by
            refine mul_le_mul (by linarith) hrpow_le (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α * (d / d ^ α) := by ring
        _ = 10 * K * δ_ceil ^ α * d ^ (1 - α) := by rw [hd_sub]
        _ < t_max := hd_tmax
    have ht_le_one : ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans ht_lt_max.le (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have ht2_le : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ t_max := by
      have hsq : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := by
        calc ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 = ‖p.2‖ * ‖p.2‖ := sq _
          _ ≤ ‖p.2‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖p.2‖ := mul_one _
      exact le_trans hsq ht_lt_max.le
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lt_max
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lt_max
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
    · have h1 : ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ_J / (2 * C_base) :=
        le_trans ht2_le (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      calc 2 * C_base * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2
          ≤ 2 * C_base * (ρ_J / (2 * C_base)) :=

            lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ_pos.le (norm_nonneg p.2)) hpW.2.2.2.2
          have htim_lt : p.2.im < δ_ceil / 100 :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2))
              (ht_small p hpW).2.1
          dsimp only [s_up, N_sel]
          split_ifs with h38
          · exact (h_range_inv p hpW 0 N_star (Nat.zero_le N_star)
              (by simp; linarith) (by linarith)).symm
          · push Not at h38
            set N : ℕ := Nat.floor (((5 / 8 : ℝ) * δ_ceil - (S.H - p.1.im)) / p.2.im)
            have hN_le : (N : ℝ) * p.2.im ≤ (5 / 8 : ℝ) * δ_ceil - (S.H - p.1.im) :=
              (le_div_iff₀ htim).mp (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by linarith) htim.le))
            have hN_gt : (5 / 8 : ℝ) * δ_ceil - (S.H - p.1.im) < ((N : ℝ) + 1) * p.2.im :=
              (div_lt_iff₀ htim).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
            rcases le_total N N_star with hle | hle
            · exact (h_range_inv p hpW N N_star hle (by linarith) (by linarith)).symm
            · exact h_range_inv p hpW N_star N hle (by linarith) (by linarith)
        obtain ⟨h_psi_holo, h_psi_bound⟩ :=
          h_chain_closure N_star (W_up ∩ U_star) (hW_up_open.inter hU_star_open)
            Set.inter_subset_left hV_slab
        have h_holo_inter : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ s_up (W_up ∩ U_star) p₀ :=
          (h_psi_holo.congr h_eq_star) p₀ ⟨hp₀, hp₀_U⟩
        refine ⟨(differentiableWithinAt_inter (hU_star_open.mem_nhds hp₀_U)).mp h_holo_inter, ?_⟩
        rw [h_eq_star ⟨hp₀, hp₀_U⟩]
        exact h_psi_bound p₀ ⟨hp₀, hp₀_U⟩
    exact ⟨fun p hp => (h_local p hp).1, fun p hp => (h_local p hp).2⟩
  
  refine ⟨s_up, hs_up_holo_and_bound.1, ?_⟩
  intro p₀ hp1 hp2 hp3 hp4 hp5
  have hp₀ : p₀ ∈ W_up := ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
  have h_bound := hs_up_holo_and_bound.2 p₀ hp₀
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < S.H - p₀.1.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
  have h_strip : s_up p₀ ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    have h_quarter : ‖s_up p₀ - p₀.1‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (S.H - p₀.1.im) := by
      calc ‖s_up p₀ - p₀.1‖
          ≤ C_st * B ^ 2 * ‖p₀.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p₀.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := h_bound
        _ = C_st * (B ^ 2 * ‖p₀.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p₀.1.im) ^ (-2 * α)) * (S.H - p₀.1.im) := by
            rw [h_rpow_1_sub_2α _ hδ₀_pos]; ring
        _ ≤ (C_st * Θ ^ 2) * (S.H - p₀.1.im) := by
            have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (h_cone_D p₀ hp₀ (S.H - p₀.1.im) le_rfl) hC_st_pos.le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hδ₀_pos.le
        _ ≤ ρ_pos * (S.H - p₀.1.im) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCst_Θ2 hδ₀_pos.le
        _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (S.H - p₀.1.im) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hρ_pos_le_quarter hδ₀_pos.le
    have him_diff : |(s_up p₀).im - p₀.1.im| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (S.H - p₀.1.im) := by
      have : |(s_up p₀ - p₀.1).im| ≤ ‖s_up p₀ - p₀.1‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      simpa using le_trans this h_quarter
    rw [abs_le] at him_diff
    change |(s_up p₀).im| < S.H
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [him_diff.1, him_diff.2, hp2, hδc_lt_half, hδ₀_pos, S.H_pos]
  refine ⟨h_strip, h_bound, ?_⟩
  intro hp_tube
  by_cases h_deep : (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_ceil < S.H - p₀.1.im
  · exact hs2_deep p₀ hp₀ h_deep
  · push Not at h_deep
    let y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
    let t₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
    let U_slice : Set ℂ :=
      { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ W_up ∧ (y, t₀) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X }
    let ι : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun y => (y, t₀)
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι :=
      Differentiable.prodMk differentiable_id (differentiable_const t₀)
    have hU_open : IsOpen U_slice :=
      (hW_up_open.inter S.tube_open).preimage hι_diff.continuous
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ U_slice := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
      rcases hy₁ with ⟨⟨hy₁_1, hy₁_2, hy₁_3, hy₁_4, hy₁_5⟩, ⟨ht_r, hy₁_tlo, hy₁_thi⟩⟩
      rcases hy₂ with ⟨⟨hy₂_1, hy₂_2, hy₂_3, hy₂_4, _⟩, ⟨_, hy₂_tlo, hy₂_thi⟩⟩
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < S.H - y₁.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hy₁_1
      have hδ₂_pos : 0 < S.H - y₂.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hy₂_1

      have hz_re : z.re = a * y₁.re + b * y₂.re := by simp [z]
      have hz_im : z.im = a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im := by simp [z]
      have hz_depth : S.H - z.im = a * (S.H - y₁.im) + b * (S.H - y₂.im) := by
        rw [hz_im]
        calc S.H - (a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im)
            = (a + b) * S.H - (a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          _ = a * (S.H - y₁.im) + b * (S.H - y₂.im) := by ring
      have hab_pos : 0 < a ∨ 0 < b := by
        by_contra! h_both
        linarith [ha, hb, hab]
      have h_lt_conv : ∀ u₁ u₂ c : ℝ, u₁ < c → u₂ < c → a * u₁ + b * u₂ < c := by
        intro u₁ u₂ c hu1 hu2
        have hc : c = a * c + b * c := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
        rw [hc]
        rcases hab_pos with ha_p | hb_p
        · exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu1 ha_p)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu2.le hb)
        · exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu1.le ha)
            (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu2 hb_p)
      have h_gt_conv : ∀ u₁ u₂ c : ℝ, c < u₁ → c < u₂ → c < a * u₁ + b * u₂ := by
        intro u₁ u₂ c hu1 hu2
        have hc : c = a * c + b * c := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
        rw [hc]
        rcases hab_pos with ha_p | hb_p
        · exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu1 ha_p)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu2.le hb)
        · exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu1.le ha)
            (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu2 hb_p)
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hy₁_5⟩, ⟨ht_r, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · change d / 2 < S.H - z.im
        rw [hz_depth]
        exact h_gt_conv _ _ _ hy₁_1 hy₂_1
      · change S.H - z.im < δ_ceil
        rw [hz_depth]
        exact h_lt_conv _ _ _ hy₁_2 hy₂_2
      · change |z.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - z.im)
        have hz_re_sub : z.re - x₀ = a * (y₁.re - x₀) + b * (y₂.re - x₀) := by
          rw [hz_re]
          calc a * y₁.re + b * y₂.re - x₀
              = a * y₁.re + b * y₂.re - (a + b) * x₀ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (y₁.re - x₀) + b * (y₂.re - x₀) := by ring
        have htri : |z.re - x₀| ≤ a * |y₁.re - x₀| + b * |y₂.re - x₀| := by
          rw [hz_re_sub]
          calc |a * (y₁.re - x₀) + b * (y₂.re - x₀)|
              ≤ |a * (y₁.re - x₀)| + |b * (y₂.re - x₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ = a * |y₁.re - x₀| + b * |y₂.re - x₀| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        have h_sum_lt : a * |y₁.re - x₀| + b * |y₂.re - x₀| <

          rcases hab_pos with ha_p | hb_p
          · exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁_3 ha_p)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂_3.le hb)
          · exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₁_3.le ha)
              (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₂_3 hb_p)
        rw [hz_depth, mul_add]
        linarith [htri, h_sum_lt]
      · change ‖t₀‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - z.im) / d) ^ α
        rcases le_total (S.H - y₁.im) (S.H - y₂.im) with h12 | h21
        · have hz_ge : S.H - y₁.im ≤ S.H - z.im := by
            have hb_mul : b * (S.H - y₁.im) ≤ b * (S.H - y₂.im) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h12 hb
            rw [hz_depth]
            calc S.H - y₁.im = (a + b) * (S.H - y₁.im) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
              _ = a * (S.H - y₁.im) + b * (S.H - y₁.im) := by ring
              _ ≤ a * (S.H - y₁.im) + b * (S.H - y₂.im) := by linarith
          have hrpow_le : ((S.H - y₁.im) / d) ^ α ≤ ((S.H - z.im) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hz_ge hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy₁_4 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity))
        · have hz_ge : S.H - y₂.im ≤ S.H - z.im := by
            have ha_mul : a * (S.H - y₂.im) ≤ a * (S.H - y₁.im) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h21 ha
            rw [hz_depth]
            calc S.H - y₂.im = (a + b) * (S.H - y₂.im) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
              _ = a * (S.H - y₂.im) + b * (S.H - y₂.im) := by ring
              _ ≤ a * (S.H - y₁.im) + b * (S.H - y₂.im) := by linarith
          have hrpow_le : ((S.H - y₂.im) / d) ^ α ≤ ((S.H - z.im) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hz_ge hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy₂_4 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity))
      · change -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀) < z.im
        rw [hz_im]
        exact h_gt_conv _ _ _ hy₁_tlo hy₂_tlo
      · change z.im < S.h_X t₀
        rw [hz_im]
        exact h_lt_conv _ _ _ hy₁_thi hy₂_thi
    have h_ana_up : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y => s_up (y, t₀)) U_slice :=
      (hs_up_holo_and_bound.1.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hy => hy.1)).analyticOnNhd
        hU_open
    have h_ana_𝔰 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun y => S.𝔰 (y, t₀)) U_slice :=
      (S.𝔰_holo.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hy => hy.2)).analyticOnNhd hU_open
    let y_anch : ℂ := (y₀.re : ℂ) + ((S.H - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_ceil : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hy_anch_re : y_anch.re = y₀.re := by simp [y_anch]
    have hy_anch_im : y_anch.im = S.H - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_ceil := by simp [y_anch]

    have hy₀_lt_anch : S.H - y₀.im < S.H - y_anch.im := by
      rw [hy_anch_depth]; linarith [h_deep, hδc_pos]
    have hy_anch_mem : y_anch ∈ U_slice := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hp5⟩, ⟨hp_tube.1, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact lt_trans hp1 hy₀_lt_anch
      · rw [hy_anch_depth]; linarith [hδc_pos]
      · rw [hy_anch_re]
        exact lt_trans hp3 (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₀_lt_anch hm_pos)
      · have hrpow_le : ((S.H - y₀.im) / d) ^ α ≤ ((S.H - y_anch.im) / d) ^ α :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
            (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hy₀_lt_anch.le hd_pos.le) hα_pos.le
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp4 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity))
      · have hconj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ t₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using hp_tube.1
        have hs_le : S.s_star ≤ S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t₀) :=
          (S.h_X_bounds _ hconj_ball).1
        rw [hy_anch_im]
        linarith [hs_le, S.s_star_pos, hδc_lt_half, S.H_pos]
      · linarith [hy₀_lt_anch, hp_tube.2.2]
    let W_anch : Set ℂ := U_slice ∩ { y : ℂ | (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_ceil < S.H - y.im }
    have hW_anch_open : IsOpen W_anch :=
      hU_open.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))
    have hy_anch_W : y_anch ∈ W_anch :=
      ⟨hy_anch_mem, show (1 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_ceil < S.H - y_anch.im by
        rw [hy_anch_depth]; linarith [hδc_pos]⟩
    have h_ev : (fun y => s_up (y, t₀)) =ᶠ[nhds y_anch] (fun y => S.𝔰 (y, t₀)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW_anch_open.mem_nhds hy_anch_W)
        (fun y hy => hs2_deep (y, t₀) hy.1.1 hy.2)
    have hy₀_mem : y₀ ∈ U_slice := ⟨hp₀, hp_tube⟩
    exact h_ana_up.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h_ana_𝔰 hU_conv.isPreconnected
      hy_anch_mem h_ev hy₀_mem

by
  have h1 :
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (pderivD f) p = pderivD (pderivA f) p) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
          iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
          pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
          pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀) := by
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }

      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.snd
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₁ q = q.1 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₂_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₂ q = q.2 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₁_norm : ‖π₁‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₁ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₁_apply] using norm_fst_le q)
    have hπ₂_norm : ‖π₂‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₂ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₂_apply] using norm_snd_le q)
    have hparam_int_holo : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (r B : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
        (F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ) (F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)),
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, g p = c * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ) →
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p)) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ B) →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      intro p₀ r B hr c g F F' hrep hcont hmeas hbnd hfderiv
      have hint : HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ)
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F' p₀ θ) p₀ :=
        intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr)
          (by filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr] with p hp
              exact (hcont p hp).aestronglyMeasurable)
          ((hcont p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          hmeas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hbnd θ p hp)
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hfderiv θ p hp)
      exact (hint.differentiableAt.const_mul c).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr) hrep)
    have hPartialA : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf p₀ hp₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      let y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
      let t₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
      obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀

      have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
      have hr_eq : 4 * r = R₀ := by dsimp [r]; ring
      have hp_ball : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r → dist p.1 y₀ < r ∧ dist p.2 t₀ < r := by
        intro p hp
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp

      have hmem_U : ∀ y t : ℂ, dist y y₀ < 3 * r → dist t t₀ < 3 * r → (y, t) ∈ U := by
        intro y t hy ht
        apply hball_R₀
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        dsimp only [y₀, t₀] at hy ht
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hsliceA_diff : ∀ t : ℂ, dist t t₀ < 3 * r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f (z, t)) (Metric.ball y₀ (3 * r)) := by
        intro t ht z hz
        have hzw : (z, t) ∈ U := hmem_U z t (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) ht
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzw)).comp z

          have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hA := (heq d' hd'_deg).1
        rw [hmvA_coeff, hmvA_coeff, hd'_add] at hA
        have hne : ((d' 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne hA
    have htaylor_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ),
        taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
      intro p₀ c
      have hiter0 : ∀ (β : ℕ), ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ))) = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro β
        induction β with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ β ih =>
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
          ext z; exact deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
      have hiterY_const : ∀ (α : ℕ), iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro α
        induction α with
        | zero => ext p; exact deriv_const p.1 c
        | succ α ih =>
          ext p
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) (y', p.2)) p.1 = 0
          rw [ih]
          exact deriv_const p.1 (0 : ℂ)
      ext d
      rw [htaylor_coeff, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      by_cases hd : d = 0
      · subst hd
        simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => (hd h).elim)]
        by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0
        · have hd1 : d 1 ≠ 0 := fun hd1_0 => hd ((hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega))
          obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hd1
          rw [hd0, hβ]
          simp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          have hdc : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => c) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by ext z; exact deriv_const z c
          rw [hdc, hiter0 β]
          simp
        · obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hd0
          rw [hα]
          simp only [iterDerivYT, hiterY_const α, hiter0 (d 1)]
          simp
    have htaylor_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [map_add, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) ?_
            intro d' hd'
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p + g p) U := hf.add hg
            have hpA_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivA (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivA f q + pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivD (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivD f q + pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, hcongr hU hp₀ hpA_add,
                (hmv_leib _ _).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1]
              exact ih (hpderiv_holo hU hf).1 (hpderiv_holo hU hg).1 d' (le_of_eq hd')
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, hcongr hU hp₀ hpD_add,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2]
              exact ih (hpderiv_holo hU hf).2 (hpderiv_holo hU hg).2 d' (le_of_eq hd')
      intro f g hf hg
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    have htaylor_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul,
            ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) ?_
            intro d' hd'
            obtain ⟨hfA, hfD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hf
            obtain ⟨hgA, hgD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hg
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * g p) U := hf.mul hg
            have hfAg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivA f p * g p) U := hfA.mul hg
            have hfgA : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivA g p) U := hf.mul hgA
            have hfDg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivD f p * g p) U := hfD.mul hg
            have hfgD : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivD g p) U := hf.mul hgD
            have hpA_mul : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivA (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivA f q * g q + f q * pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD_mul : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivD (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivD f q * g q + f q * pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, hcongr hU hp₀ hpA_mul,
                htaylor_add hU hp₀ hfAg hfgA,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.2.1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfA hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgA d' (le_of_eq hd')]
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, hcongr hU hp₀ hpD_mul,
                htaylor_add hU hp₀ hfDg hfgD,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.2.2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfD hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgD d' (le_of_eq hd')]
      intro f g hf hg
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    refine ⟨hmv_taylor, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      refine ⟨htaylor_const p₀, ?_⟩
      intro f g hf hg
      refine ⟨htaylor_add hU hp₀ hf hg, ?_, htaylor_mul hU hp₀ hf hg⟩
      have hneg_g : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (-1 : ℂ)) p * g p) U :=
        (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)).mul hg
      have hsub_fn : (fun p => f p - g p) =
          (fun p => f p + (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (-1 : ℂ)) p * g p) := by
        ext p; ring
      rw [hsub_fn, htaylor_add hU hp₀ hf hneg_g,
        htaylor_mul hU hp₀ (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg, htaylor_const p₀ (-1),
        map_neg, map_one]
      ring
    · intro U W_ψ hU hW_ψ p₀ hp₀ ψ g₀ hψ hg₀ hmaps
      let Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀
      have hΨ0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 := by
        change MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = 0
        rw [htaylor_coeff]
        simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      have hΨ_sub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) U :=
        hψ.sub (differentiableOn_const (ψ p₀))
      have hΨ_dA : mvDerivA Ψ = taylor2D (pderivA ψ) p₀ := by
        change mvDerivA (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
        rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hΨ_sub_holo).1]
        exact hcongr hU hp₀ (fun q _ => deriv_sub_const (f := fun z => ψ (z, q.2)) (ψ p₀))
      have hΨ_dD : mvDerivD Ψ = taylor2D (pderivD ψ) p₀ := by
        change mvDerivD (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
        rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hΨ_sub_holo).2]
        exact hcongr hU hp₀ (fun q _ => deriv_sub_const (f := fun w => ψ (q.1, w)) (ψ p₀))
      have hderiv_holo1D : ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ),
          PowerSeries.derivative (holoTaylor1D h w₀) = holoTaylor1D (deriv h) w₀ := by
        intro h w₀
        ext n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_succ',
          Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc1 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
        have hc2 : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
        push_cast
        field_simp
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro g _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [htaylor_coeff, hcomp_coeff]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, holoTaylor1D]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro g hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) ?_
            intro d' hd'
            obtain ⟨hψA, hψD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hψ
            have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) W_ψ := hg.deriv hW_ψ
            have hgψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (ψ p)) U :=
              hg.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hg'ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => deriv g (ψ p)) U :=
              hg'.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hpA_comp : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivA (fun p => g (ψ p)) q = pderivA ψ q * deriv g (ψ q) := by
              intro q hq
              have hgat : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (ψ q) :=
                hg.differentiableAt (hW_ψ.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))
              have hdc := deriv_comp q.1 hgat (hslice_at hU hψ q hq).1
              simpa [pderivA, Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using hdc
            have hpD_comp : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivD (fun p => g (ψ p)) q = pderivD ψ q * deriv g (ψ q) := by
              intro q hq
              have hgat : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (ψ q) :=
                hg.differentiableAt (hW_ψ.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))
              have hdc := deriv_comp q.2 hgat (hslice_at hU hψ q hq).2
              simpa [pderivD, Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using hdc
            have hdeg_le_right : ∀ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d',
                r.2 0 + r.2 1 ≤ N := by
              intro r hr
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
              have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hr
              simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at hsum
              omega
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hgψ_holo).1, hcongr hU hp₀ hpA_comp,
                htaylor_mul hU hp₀ hψA hg'ψ_holo,
                (hmv_comp (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ hΨ0).1, hΨ_dA, hderiv_holo1D g (ψ p₀),
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr => ?_)
              rw [ih hg' r.2 (hdeg_le_right r hr)]
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hgψ_holo).2, hcongr hU hp₀ hpD_comp,
                htaylor_mul hU hp₀ hψD hg'ψ_holo,
                (hmv_comp (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ hΨ0).2, hΨ_dD, hderiv_holo1D g (ψ p₀),
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr => ?_)
              rw [ih hg' r.2 (hdeg_le_right r hr)]
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hg₀ d le_rfl
  refine {
    pderiv_holo := h1.1
    pderiv_comm := h1.2.1
    iterDerivYT_holo := h1.2.2.1
    iterDerivYT_step := h1.2.2.2.1
    taylor2D_congr := h1.2.2.2.2
    eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D := h2.1
    eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero := h2.2
    taylor2D_algebra := h4.2.1
    mvDeriv_rules := ⟨h3.1, h4.1⟩
    mvDeriv_compPowerSeries2D := h3.2.1
    taylor2D_comp_1D := h4.2.2
    compPowerSeries2D_inj := ?_
  }
  intro U hU p₀ hp₀ ψ hψ hpA f₁ f₂ hcomp
  refine h3.2.2 (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) ?_ ?_ f₁ f₂ hcomp
  · change iterDerivYT 0 0 (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀ /
        (((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) * ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ)) = 0
    simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  · have hsub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) U :=
      hψ.sub (differentiableOn_const (ψ p₀))
    have hdA : mvDerivA (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA ψ) p₀ := by
      change mvDerivA (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
      rw [(h4.1 hU hp₀ hsub_holo).1]
      exact h1.2.2.2.2 hU hp₀ (fun q _ => deriv_sub_const (f := fun z => ψ (z, q.2)) (ψ p₀))
    rw [hdA]
    change iterDerivYT 0 0 (pderivA ψ) p₀ /
        (((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) * ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ)) ≠ 0
    simpa [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY] using hpA

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hKit : Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit)
    (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hU₀ : IsOpen U₀) (hU_plus : IsOpen U_plus)
    (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hψ_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) U₀)
    (hw_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) U_plus)
    (hB_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ B U_plus) :
    Nonempty (WebPDESystem hm ψ w B U₀ U_plus)

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hKit : Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit)
    (U₀ U_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hU₀ : IsOpen U₀) (hU_plus : IsOpen U_plus)
    (ψ w : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (B : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hψ_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) U₀)
    (hw_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) U_plus)
    (hB_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ B U_plus) :
    Nonempty (WebPDESystem hm ψ w B U₀ U_plus)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsum_holo_gen : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {S : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ j ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F j) S) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∑ j ∈ s, F j p) S := by
    intro ι s S F hF
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa using (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) S)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have heq : (fun p => ∑ j ∈ insert a s, F j p) =
          (fun p => F a p + ∑ j ∈ s, F j p) := by
        ext p
        exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [heq]
      exact (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
        (ih (fun j hj => hF j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
  have hprod_holo : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {S : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ j ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F j) S) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∏ j ∈ s, F j p) S := by
    intro ι s S F hF
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa using (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) S)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have heq : (fun p => ∏ j ∈ insert a s, F j p) =
          (fun p => F a p * ∏ j ∈ s, F j p) := by
        ext p
        exact Finset.prod_insert ha
      rw [heq]
      exact (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).mul
        (ih (fun j hj => hF j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
  have hdet_holo : ∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {S : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix n n ℂ),
      (∀ r c : n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p r c) S) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (M p).det) S := by
    intro n _ _ S M hM
    have heq : (fun p => (M p).det) =
        (fun p => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm n,
          (((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ j : n, M p (σ j) j)) := by
      ext p
      rw [Matrix.det_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      rw [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    refine hsum_holo_gen Finset.univ _ fun σ _ => ?_
    exact (hprod_holo Finset.univ (fun j p => M p (σ j) j)
      (fun j _ => hM (σ j) j)).const_mul (((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ))

  
  let U_inter : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U₀ ∩ U_plus
  have hU_inter : IsOpen U_inter := hU₀.inter hU_plus
  have hA_U₀ : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA (ψ i)) U₀ :=
    fun i => (hKit.pderiv_holo hU₀ (hψ_holo i)).1
  have hBψ_U₀ : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD (ψ i)) U₀ :=
    fun i => (hKit.pderiv_holo hU₀ (hψ_holo i)).2
  have hA_inter : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA (ψ i)) U_inter :=
    fun i => (hA_U₀ i).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hBψ_inter : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD (ψ i)) U_inter :=
    fun i => (hBψ_U₀ i).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hw_inter : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (w i) U_inter :=
    fun i => (hw_holo i).mono Set.inter_subset_right
  have hW_inter : ∀ r i : Fin m,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r i) U_inter := by
    intro r i
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p => w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivD (ψ i) p) ^ r.val) U_inter
    exact ((hw_inter i).mul ((hA_inter i).pow (m - r.val))).mul ((hBψ_inter i).pow r.val)
  have hW_det_inter : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).det) U_inter :=
    hdet_holo (webVandermondeMat ψ w) hW_inter
  have hU_ode : IsOpen (webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus) := by
    have heq : webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus =
        U_inter ∩ (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).det) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ := rfl
    rw [heq]

    intro i r

        (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p).adjugate i r)

        exact Matrix.adjugate_apply (webVandermondeMat ψ w p) i r

      intro a b

      (∀ i : Fin m, pderivA (ψ i) p ≠ 0) →
      Function.Injective (fun i : Fin m => pderivD (ψ i) p / pderivA (ψ i) p) →
      p ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus := by
    intro p hp hw_ne hA_ne hinj
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    let ρ : Fin m → ℂ := fun i => pderivD (ψ i) p / pderivA (ψ i) p
    have hfac : webVandermondeMat ψ w p =
        (Matrix.vandermonde ρ)ᵀ *
          Matrix.diagonal (fun i : Fin m => w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ m) := by
      ext r i
      rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.vandermonde_apply]
      change w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivD (ψ i) p) ^ r.val =

      rw [hB_eq, mul_pow]

        w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (ρ i ^ r.val * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ r.val)

                (w i p * ((pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val) * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ r.val)) := by ring
        _ = ρ i ^ r.val * (w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ (m - r.val + r.val)) := by rw [← pow_add]
        _ = ρ i ^ r.val * (w i p * (pderivA (ψ i) p) ^ m) := by rw [hexp]

    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hinj)
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => mul_ne_zero (hw_ne i) (pow_ne_zero m (hA_ne i)))

    intro ι s U hU p₁ hp₁ h hh
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>

      simpa using (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₁).1 0

  have hmat_solve : ∀ {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₁ ∈ webODEDomain ψ w U₀ U_plus →
      ∀ (X Y : Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ r : Fin m,
        ∑ j : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁ * X j = Y r) →
      ∀ i : Fin m,
        X i = ∑ r : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ * Y r := by
    intro p₁ hp₁ X Y hXY i

        ∑ r : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ * Y r =

                taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) * X j := by

        ∑ r : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ * Y r

                    taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) * X j := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
              rw [← hXY r, Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
              rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = ∑ j : Fin m,
              ∑ r : Fin m,
                (taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                  taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) * X j := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ j : Fin m,
              (∑ r : Fin m,
                taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                  taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) * X j := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [hstep1]
    have hdelta : ∀ j : Fin m,
        (∑ r : Fin m,
          taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
            taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) =
          MvPowerSeries.C ((1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) i j) := by
      intro j
      have hprod_sum :
          (∑ r : Fin m,
            taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
              taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) =
            taylor2D (fun p =>
              ∑ r : Fin m, (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r *
                webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁ := by
        rw [(htaylor_sum Finset.univ hU_ode hp₁
          (fun r p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r * webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j)
          (fun r _ => (hWinv_holo i r).mul (hW_holo r j))).2]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
        exact (((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).2 (hWinv_holo i r) (hW_holo r j)).2.2).symm
      rw [hprod_sum]
      have hcongr : taylor2D (fun p =>
            ∑ r : Fin m, (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r *
              webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁ =
          taylor2D (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) i j) p₁ := by
        refine hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ode hp₁ fun p hp => ?_
        change ((webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ * webVandermondeMat ψ w p) i j =
          (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) i j
        rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (webVandermondeMat ψ w p) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp.2)]
      rw [hcongr, (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).1]
    symm
    calc
      ∑ j : Fin m,
          (∑ r : Fin m,
            taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
              taylor2D (fun p => webVandermondeMat ψ w p r j) p₁) * X j
          = ∑ j : Fin m, MvPowerSeries.C ((1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) i j) * X j := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
            rw [hdelta j]
      _ = MvPowerSeries.C ((1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) i i) * X i := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hji => ?_) (fun hi => False.elim (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)))

        ∑ r : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
            (taylor2D (iterDerivYT (m - r.val) r.val B) p₁ -
              ∑ col : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (C_diff r col) p₁ * V_formal col)
            = (∑ r : Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                taylor2D (iterDerivYT (m - r.val) r.val B) p₁) -
              ∑ r : Fin m,
                ∑ col : Fin m × Fin m,
                  (taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                    taylor2D (C_diff r col) p₁) * V_formal col := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
              rw [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]
              congr 1
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun col _ => ?_
              rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = taylor2D (fun p => d_vec p i) p₁ -
              ∑ col : Fin m × Fin m,
                (∑ r : Fin m,
                  taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                    taylor2D (C_diff r col) p₁) * V_formal col := by
              rw [← hd_ser, Finset.sum_comm]
              congr 1
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun col _ => ?_
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = (∑ col : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => K_mat p i col) p₁ * V_formal col) +
              taylor2D (fun p => d_vec p i) p₁ := by
              have hneg_sum :
                  (∑ col : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => K_mat p i col) p₁ * V_formal col) =
                  -∑ col : Fin m × Fin m,
                    (∑ r : Fin m,
                      taylor2D (fun p => (webVandermondeMat ψ w p)⁻¹ i r) p₁ *
                        taylor2D (C_diff r col) p₁) * V_formal col := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun col _ => ?_
                rw [hK_ser col, neg_mul]
              rw [hneg_sum]
              abel
    
    have hbase_eq : ∀ idx : Fin m × Fin m,
        F_ser idx.1 (idx.2.val + 1) =
          (∑ col : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_base p idx col) p₁ * V_formal col) +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_base p idx) p₁ := by
      intro idx
      by_cases h : idx.2.val + 1 < m
      · have hc0 : taylor2D (fun p => c_base p idx) p₁ = 0 := by
          simp only [c_base, if_pos h]
          rw [(hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).1 0, map_zero]
        rw [hc0, add_zero]
        let target : Fin m × Fin m := (idx.1, ⟨idx.2.val + 1, h⟩)
        symm
        calc
          ∑ col : Fin m × Fin m, taylor2D (fun p => M_base p idx col) p₁ * V_formal col
              = taylor2D (fun p => M_base p idx target) p₁ * V_formal target := by
                refine Finset.sum_eq_single target (fun col _ hcol => ?_)
                  (fun ht => False.elim (ht (Finset.mem_univ target)))
                simp only [M_base, target, dif_pos h, if_neg hcol,
                  (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).1 0, map_zero, zero_mul]
          _ = F_ser idx.1 (idx.2.val + 1) := by
                simp only [M_base, target, dif_pos h, ite_true,
                  (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).1 1, map_one, one_mul]
                rfl
      · have hk_eq : idx.2.val + 1 = m := by
          have := idx.2.isLt
          omega
        simp only [M_base, dif_neg h, c_base, if_neg h]
        rw [hk_eq]
        exact hFm_eq idx.1
    intro idx
    have hch := hchain idx.1 (hode_U₀ hp₁) (f idx.1) idx.2.val
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change mvDerivA (F_ser idx.1 idx.2.val) = _
      rw [hch.1]
      change taylor2D (pderivA (ψ idx.1)) p₁ * F_ser idx.1 (idx.2.val + 1) = _
      rw [hbase_eq idx, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun col _ => ?_
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        congr 1
        exact (((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).2
          (hA_ode idx.1) (hMbase_ode idx col)).2.2).symm
      · exact (((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).2
          (hA_ode idx.1) (hcbase_ode idx)).2.2).symm
    · change mvDerivD (F_ser idx.1 idx.2.val) = _
      rw [hch.2]
      change taylor2D (pderivD (ψ idx.1)) p₁ * F_ser idx.1 (idx.2.val + 1) = _
      rw [hbase_eq idx, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun col _ => ?_
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        congr 1
        exact (((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).2
          (hBψ_ode idx.1) (hMbase_ode idx col)).2.2).symm
      · exact (((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU_ode hp₁).2
          (hBψ_ode idx.1) (hcbase_ode idx)).2.2).symm

informal_problem.statement:
(ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (hKit : Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit)
    (a₀ R δ_star C₀ a₁ δ₁ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hδ_star : 0 < δ_star) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hC₀δ : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2)
    (hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁) (hδ₁_lt : δ₁ < δ_star)
    (ha₁ : |a₁ - a₀| < R - C₀ * δ_star)
    (U_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hU_ode : IsOpen U_ode)
    (hcov : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U_ode)
    (M_a M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (c_a c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ))
    (hMa_holo : ∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_a p idx j) U_ode)
    (hMδ_holo : ∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M_δ p idx j) U_ode)
    (hca_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_a p idx) U_ode)
    (hcδ_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c_δ p idx) U_ode)
    (V_formal : ι → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hformal_a : ∀ idx : ι,
      mvDerivA (V_formal idx) =
        ∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) * V_formal j +
          taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
    (hformal_δ : ∀ idx : ι,
      mvDerivD (V_formal idx) =
        ∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) * V_formal j +
          taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) :
    ∃ (V_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
      IsOpen V_ode ∧ IsPreconnected V_ode ∧ V_ode ⊆ U_ode ∧
      (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_ode) ∧
      (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => V p idx) V_ode) ∧
      (∀ idx : ι, taylor2D (fun p => V p idx) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = V_formal idx) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ V_ode, ∀ idx : ι,
        pderivA (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V p) + c_a p) idx ∧
        pderivD (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (V p) + c_δ p) idx)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hODE : TrapPDE_ODEKit := by
    clear! ι hKit a₀ R δ_star C₀ a₁ δ₁ U_ode
    have h_cont_int_2d : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hU : IsOpen U) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
        {H : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry H) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc a b) →
        ContinuousOn (fun x => ∫ s in a..b, H x s) U := by
      intro U hU a b hab H hH x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨R, hR, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x₀ hx₀
      set r := R / 2
      have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hR
      have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hR)).trans hball
      have hK_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ r ×ˢ Set.Icc a b) :=
        (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r).prod isCompact_Icc
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hH.mono (Set.prod_mono hcb_sub Subset.rfl))
      have huIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Set.Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
      apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      refine intervalIntegral.continuousAt_of_dominated_interval (bound := fun _ => B) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ hr] with x hx
        have hxU : x ∈ U := hcb_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
        have hxs : ContinuousOn (H x) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          hH.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hxU, hs⟩)
        exact (hxs.mono (huIoc.trans_subset Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_uIoc
      · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ hr] with x hx
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at hs
        have hmem : (x, s) ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r ×ˢ Set.Icc a b :=
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx, Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs⟩
        simpa using hB (x, s) hmem
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at hs
        have hs_Icc : s ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
        have hcont_x : ContinuousOn (fun x => H x s) U :=
          hH.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hs_Icc⟩)
        exact hcont_x.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx₀)

    have h_meas_deriv : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) {z₀ : ℂ} (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U)
        {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry F) (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ U) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableAt ℂ (F t) z₀) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => deriv (F t) z₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)) := by
      intro U hU z₀ hz₀ a b hab F hF_cont hF_diff
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z₀ hz₀
      let δr : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
      let δ : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (δr n : ℂ)
      have hδr_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < δr n := fun n => div_pos (half_pos hr) (by positivity)
      have hδ_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, δ n ≠ 0 := fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hδr_pos n))
      have hδ_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, z₀ + δ n ∈ U := by
        intro n
        apply hball
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (hδr_pos n))]
        have hle : δr n ≤ r / 2 := div_le_self (le_of_lt (half_pos hr)) (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hδr_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δr Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
          (Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop tendsto_const_nhds)
      have hδ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        change Filter.Tendsto (Complex.ofReal ∘ δr) Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.ofReal 0))
        exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hδr_tendsto
      have hδ_nhds : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) :=
        tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
          ⟨hδ_tendsto, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (hδ_ne n))⟩
      let approx : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n t => (δ n)⁻¹ • (F t (z₀ + δ n) - F t z₀)
      have huIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Set.Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
      refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop (f := approx) ?_ ?_
      · intro n
        have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun t => F t (z₀ + δ n)) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          hF_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨ht, hδ_mem n⟩)
        have hc0 : ContinuousOn (fun t => F t z₀) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          hF_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun t ht => ⟨ht, hz₀⟩)
        have hc : ContinuousOn (approx n) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          (hc1.sub hc0).const_smul (δ n)⁻¹
        exact (hc.mono (huIoc.trans_subset Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_uIoc
      · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with t ht
        rw [huIoc] at ht
        have ht_Icc : t ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self ht
        exact (hF_diff t ht_Icc).hasDerivAt.tendsto_slope_zero.comp hδ_nhds

    have h_holo_int_1d : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
        {H : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry H) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc a b) →
        (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => H z s) U) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∫ s in a..b, H z s) U := by
      intro U hU a b hab H hH_cont hH_holo z₀ hz₀
      obtain ⟨R, hR, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU z₀ hz₀
      set r := R / 2
      have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hR
      have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ (3 * r / 2) ⊆ U := by
        refine (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball ?_).trans hball
        change 3 * (R / 2) / 2 < R
        linarith
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall z₀ (3 * r / 2)).prod isCompact_Icc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hH_cont.mono (Set.prod_mono hcb_sub Subset.rfl))
      set M := max B 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right B 0
      have huIoc : Set.uIoc a b = Set.Ioc a b := Set.uIoc_of_le hab
      let H' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z s => deriv (fun ζ => H ζ s) z
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      refine ⟨_, (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (s := Metric.ball z₀ r) (bound := fun _ => M / (r / 2)) (F' := H')
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ hr) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_).2⟩
      · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ hr] with z hz
        have hzU : z ∈ U := hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt (half_lt_self hR)) hz)
        have hzs : ContinuousOn (H z) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          hH_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hzU, hs⟩)
        exact (hzs.mono (huIoc.trans_subset Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_uIoc
      · have hz₀s : ContinuousOn (H z₀) (Set.Icc a b) :=
          hH_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun s hs => ⟨hz₀, hs⟩)
        exact hz₀s.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
      · refine h_meas_deriv hU hz₀ hab (F := fun s z => H z s) ?_ ?_
        · exact hH_cont.comp continuous_swap.continuousOn (fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩)
        · intro s hs
          exact (hH_holo s hs z₀ hz₀).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs z hz => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at hs
        have hs_Icc : s ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
        have hsub_cb : Metric.closedBall z (r / 2) ⊆ Metric.closedBall z₀ (3 * r / 2) := by
          intro ξ hξ
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hξ ⊢
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz
          have htri : dist ξ z₀ ≤ dist ξ z + dist z z₀ := dist_triangle ξ z z₀
          linarith
        have hdiff_cl : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ => H ζ s) (Metric.ball z (r / 2)) :=
          (hH_holo s hs_Icc).diffContOnCl_ball (hsub_cb.trans hcb_sub)
        refine Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (half_pos hr) hdiff_cl (fun ξ hξ => ?_)
        have hξ_cb : ξ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ (3 * r / 2) :=
          hsub_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hξ)
        exact (hB (ξ, s) ⟨hξ_cb, hs_Icc⟩).trans (le_max_left B 0)
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs z hz => ?_)
        rw [huIoc] at hs
        have hs_Icc : s ∈ Set.Icc a b := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
        have hzU : z ∈ U := hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt (half_lt_self hR)) hz)
        exact ((hH_holo s hs_Icc z hzU).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzU)).hasDerivAt

    have h_osgood : ∀ {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Set ℂ} (hΩ₁ : IsOpen Ω₁) (hΩ₂ : IsOpen Ω₂)
        {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn g (Ω₁ ×ˢ Ω₂) →
        (∀ z ∈ Ω₂, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => g (w, z)) Ω₁) →
        (∀ w ∈ Ω₁, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => g (w, z)) Ω₂) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Ω₁ ×ˢ Ω₂) := by
      intro Ω₁ Ω₂ hΩ₁ hΩ₂ g hg_cont hg_w hg_z ⟨w₀, z₀⟩ ⟨hw₀, hz₀⟩
      dsimp only at hw₀ hz₀
      obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁, hb₁⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ₁ w₀ hw₀
      obtain ⟨R₂, hR₂, hb₂⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ₂ z₀ hz₀
      set R := min R₁ R₂
      have hR : 0 < R := lt_min hR₁ hR₂
      set r := R / 2
      have hr : 0 < r := half_pos hR
      set ρ := 3 * r / 2
      have hρ : 0 < ρ := by positivity
      have hcb₁ : Metric.closedBall w₀ ρ ⊆ Ω₁ := by
        refine (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball ?_).trans hb₁

              field_simp [ne_of_gt hr]
              ring
            calc ‖g (γ θ, p.2)‖ * (ρ * ‖((γ θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹‖) * ‖q.1‖

    have h_solve_D :
      ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
        (Ω_par Ω_z : Set ℂ),
        IsOpen Ω_par → IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z →

          (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => v₀ w idx) Ω_par) →

            (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) ∧
            (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (w, z₀) = v₀ w) ∧
            (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,

                ((M (w, z)).mulVec (u (w, z)) + c (w, z)) idx) := by
      intro ι _ _ Ω_par Ω_z hΩ_par hΩ_z hΩ_z_conv z₀ hz₀ M c v₀ hM hc hv₀

      have hseg_mem : ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ Ω_z → ∀ {s : ℝ}, s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →

        intro z hz s hs
        exact hΩ_z_conv hz₀ hz (by linarith [hs.2]) hs.1 (by ring)
      have hseg_cont : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℝ => trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1 q.2) := by
        unfold trapPDE_seg
        fun_prop
      have hu_reg : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ idx : ι,
          ContinuousOn (fun p => u_iter n p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => u_iter n (w, z) idx) Ω_par) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u_iter n (w, z) idx) Ω_z) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero =>
          intro idx
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact (hv₀ idx).continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.1)
          · intro _ _
            exact hv₀ idx
          · intro w _
            exact differentiableOn_const (v₀ w idx)
        | succ n ih =>
          intro idx
          let H_int : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p s =>
            (p.2 - z₀) *
              ((∑ j : ι, M (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s) idx j *
                  u_iter n (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s) j) +
                c (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s) idx)
          have h_eq_iter : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
              u_iter (n + 1) p idx = v₀ p.1 idx + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, H_int p s := by
            intro p
            rfl
          have hH_cont : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry H_int)
              ((Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
            have hmap_cont : Continuous (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => (q.1.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1.2 q.2)) := by
              unfold trapPDE_seg
              fun_prop
            have hmap_to : Set.MapsTo (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => (q.1.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1.2 q.2))
                ((Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
              fun q hq => ⟨hq.1.1, hseg_mem hq.1.2 hq.2⟩
            have hsum_cont : ContinuousOn
                (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => ∑ j : ι, M (q.1.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1.2 q.2) idx j *
                  u_iter n (q.1.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1.2 q.2) j)
                ((Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
                ((hM idx j).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to).mul
                  ((ih j).1.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to))
            have hc_cont : ContinuousOn
                (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => c (q.1.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ q.1.2 q.2) idx)
                ((Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              (hc idx).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to
            exact ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const).continuousOn.mul
              (hsum_cont.add hc_cont)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · have hv_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => v₀ p.1 idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
              (hv₀ idx).continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.1)
            exact hv_cont.add (h_cont_int_2d (hΩ_par.prod hΩ_z) zero_le_one hH_cont)
          · intro z hz
            have hint_w : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, H_int (w, z) s) Ω_par := by
              refine h_holo_int_1d hΩ_par zero_le_one (H := fun w s => H_int (w, z) s) ?_ ?_
              · exact hH_cont.comp
                  ((continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const).prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn
                  (fun q hq => ⟨⟨hq.1, hz⟩, hq.2⟩)
              · intro s hs
                have hzs : trapPDE_seg z₀ z s ∈ Ω_z := hseg_mem hz hs
                have hw_to : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℂ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) Ω_par (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
                  fun w hw => ⟨hw, hzs⟩
                have hsum_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                    (fun w => ∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j *
                      u_iter n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) Ω_par := by
                  intro w hw
                  exact DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
                    (((hM idx j).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn hw_to w hw).mul
                      ((ih j).2.1 _ hzs w hw)))
                have hc_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx) Ω_par :=
                  (hc idx).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn hw_to
                exact (hsum_d.add hc_d).const_mul (z - z₀)
            exact (hv₀ idx).add hint_w
          · intro w hw
            have hint_z : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, H_int (w, z) s) Ω_z := by
              refine h_holo_int_1d hΩ_z zero_le_one (H := fun z s => H_int (w, z) s) ?_ ?_
              · exact hH_cont.comp
                  ((continuous_const.prodMk continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn
                  (fun q hq => ⟨⟨hw, hq.1⟩, hq.2⟩)
              · intro s hs
                have hseg_d : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) := by
                  change Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * z₀ + (s : ℂ) * z)
                  fun_prop
                have hz_to : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℂ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) Ω_z (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
                  fun z hz => ⟨hw, hseg_mem hz hs⟩
                have hz_to_1d : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℂ => trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) Ω_z Ω_z :=
                  fun z hz => hseg_mem hz hs
                have hsum_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                    (fun z => ∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j *
                      u_iter n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) Ω_z := by
                  intro z hz
                  exact DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
                    (((hM idx j).comp ((differentiable_const w).prodMk hseg_d).differentiableOn hz_to z hz).mul
                      (((ih j).2.2 w hw).comp hseg_d.differentiableOn hz_to_1d z hz)))
                have hc_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx) Ω_z :=
                  (hc idx).comp ((differentiable_const w).prodMk hseg_d).differentiableOn hz_to
                exact (differentiableOn_id.sub (differentiableOn_const z₀)).mul (hsum_d.add hc_d)
            exact (differentiableOn_const (v₀ w idx)).add hint_z

      let Δ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun n p => u_iter (n + 1) p - u_iter n p
      have h_telesc : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ∀ idx : ι,
          u_iter 0 p idx + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, Δ n p idx = u_iter N p idx := by
        intro N p idx
        induction N with
        | zero => simp
        | succ N ih =>
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← add_assoc, ih]
          simp [Δ]
      have h_loc_unif : ∀ idx : ι,
          TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun N p => u_iter N p idx) (fun p => u p idx)
            Filter.atTop (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) := by
        intro idx
        refine tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_of_forall_exists_nhds (fun ⟨w_star, z_star⟩ ⟨hw_star, hz_star⟩ => ?_)
        obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁, hb₁⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ_par w_star hw_star
        obtain ⟨R₂, hR₂, hb₂⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ_z z_star hz_star
        set r := min R₁ R₂ / 2
        have hr : 0 < r := half_pos (lt_min hR₁ hR₂)
        have hcb_w : Metric.closedBall w_star r ⊆ Ω_par :=
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by
            have : min R₁ R₂ ≤ R₁ := min_le_left _ _
            change min R₁ R₂ / 2 < R₁; linarith)).trans hb₁
        have hcb_z : Metric.closedBall z_star r ⊆ Ω_z :=
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by
            have : min R₁ R₂ ≤ R₂ := min_le_right _ _
            change min R₁ R₂ / 2 < R₂; linarith)).trans hb₂
        let K_z : Set ℂ :=
          (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => trapPDE_seg z₀ q.2 q.1) '' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall z_star r)
        have hKz_comp : IsCompact K_z :=
          (isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall z_star r)).image (by unfold trapPDE_seg; fun_prop)
        have hKz_sub : K_z ⊆ Ω_z := by
          rintro _ ⟨⟨t, ξ⟩, ⟨ht, hξ⟩, rfl⟩
          exact hseg_mem (hcb_z hξ) ht
        have hcb_sub_Kz : Metric.closedBall z_star r ⊆ K_z := by
          intro ξ hξ
          refine ⟨(1, ξ), ⟨⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩, hξ⟩, ?_⟩
          simp [trapPDE_seg]
        have hKz_star : ∀ z ∈ K_z, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s ∈ K_z := by
          rintro _ ⟨⟨t, ξ⟩, ⟨ht, hξ⟩, rfl⟩ s hs
          refine ⟨(s * t, ξ), ⟨⟨mul_nonneg hs.1 ht.1, by nlinarith [hs.1, hs.2, ht.1, ht.2]⟩, hξ⟩, ?_⟩
          simp only [trapPDE_seg, Complex.real_smul]
          push_cast
          ring
        let K_prod : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall w_star r ×ˢ K_z
        have hK_comp : IsCompact K_prod := (isCompact_closedBall w_star r).prod hKz_comp
        have hK_sub : K_prod ⊆ Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z := Set.prod_mono hcb_w hKz_sub
        let μM : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖
        have hμM_cont : ContinuousOn μM K_prod :=
          continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
            continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
              ((hM i j).continuousOn.mono hK_sub).norm))
        obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hμM_cont
        set L := max L₀ 0
        have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L := le_max_right L₀ 0
        have hM_mulVec_le : ∀ p ∈ K_prod, ∀ v : ι → ℂ, ‖(M p).mulVec v‖ ≤ L * ‖v‖ := by
          intro p hp v
          rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL_nonneg (norm_nonneg v))]
          intro i
          have h1 : ‖(M p).mulVec v i‖ ≤ (∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖) * ‖v‖ := by
            calc ‖(M p).mulVec v i‖
                = ‖∑ j : ι, M p i j * v j‖ := rfl
              _ ≤ ∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j * v j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
              _ = ∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖ * ‖v j‖ := by simp only [norm_mul]
              _ ≤ ∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖ * ‖v‖ :=
                  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_le_pi_norm v j) (norm_nonneg _))
              _ = (∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖) * ‖v‖ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
          have h2 : ∑ j : ι, ‖M p i j‖ ≤ μM p :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          have h3 : μM p ≤ L := by
            have hnorm := hL₀ p hp
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
            exact (le_abs_self (μM p)).trans (hnorm.trans (le_max_left L₀ 0))
          exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h2.trans h3) (norm_nonneg v))
        let μ0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => ∑ i : ι, ‖((M p).mulVec (u_iter 0 p) + c p) i‖
        have hμ0_cont : ContinuousOn μ0 K_prod := by
          refine continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => ContinuousOn.norm ?_)
          refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ((hc i).continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
          exact continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
            ((hM i j).continuousOn.mono hK_sub).mul ((hu_reg 0 j).1.mono hK_sub))
        obtain ⟨B_raw, hB_raw⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hμ0_cont
        set B₀ := max B_raw 0
        have hB₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ := le_max_right B_raw 0
        have h0_le : ∀ p ∈ K_prod, ‖(M p).mulVec (u_iter 0 p) + c p‖ ≤ B₀ := by
          intro p hp
          rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hB₀_nonneg]
          intro i
          have h1 : ‖((M p).mulVec (u_iter 0 p) + c p) i‖ ≤ μ0 p :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
          have hnorm := hB_raw p hp
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
          exact h1.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hnorm.trans (le_max_left B_raw 0)))
        have hΔ_bnd : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ K_prod,
            ‖Δ n p‖ ≤ B₀ * L ^ n * ‖p.2 - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
          intro n
          induction n with
          | zero =>
            intro ⟨w, z⟩ hp
            have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ * L ^ 0 * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ 1 / ((1 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
            rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
            intro i
            have hΔ0_eq : Δ 0 (w, z) i =
                ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (z - z₀) *
                  (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter 0 (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
                    c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i) := by
              simp [Δ, u_iter, trapPDE_picardIter]
            rw [hΔ0_eq]
            have hbnd : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (z - z₀) *
                (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter 0 (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
                  c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i)‖ ≤ (‖z - z₀‖ * B₀) * |(1 : ℝ) - 0| := by
              refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun s hs => ?_)
              rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
              have hp_s : (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) ∈ K_prod :=
                ⟨hp.1, hKz_star z hp.2 s (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs)⟩
              rw [norm_mul]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                ((norm_le_pi_norm _ i).trans (h0_le _ hp_s)) (norm_nonneg _)
            simpa [Nat.factorial, mul_comm] using hbnd
          | succ n ih =>
            intro ⟨w, z⟩ hp
            have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ * L ^ (n + 1) * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 2) / ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by
              positivity
            rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
            intro i
            let I1 : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (z - z₀) *
              (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter (n + 1) (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
                c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i)
            let I0 : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (z - z₀) *
              (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
                c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i)
            have hI_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => (z - z₀) *
                (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter k (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
                  c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
              intro k
              have hmap : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) :=
                continuous_const.prodMk (by unfold trapPDE_seg; fun_prop)
              have hto : Set.MapsTo (fun s : ℝ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
                fun s hs => ⟨hcb_w hp.1, hseg_mem (hKz_sub hp.2) hs⟩
              refine continuousOn_const.mul (ContinuousOn.add ?_ ((hc i).continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn hto))
              exact continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
                ((hM i j).continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn hto).mul
                  ((hu_reg k j).1.comp hmap.continuousOn hto))
            have hΔ_eq : Δ (n + 1) (w, z) i =
                ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (z - z₀) *
                  ((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (Δ n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i) := by
              have hsub : Δ (n + 1) (w, z) i = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, I1 s) - (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, I0 s) := by
                simp [Δ, u_iter, trapPDE_picardIter, I1, I0, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
              rw [hsub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub
                ((hI_cont (n + 1)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
                ((hI_cont n).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)]
              refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
              simp only [Pi.add_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Δ, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub]
              rw [← mul_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            rw [hΔ_eq]
            set C_step := B₀ * L ^ (n + 1) * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 2) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
            have h_int_le : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (z - z₀) *
                ((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (Δ n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i)‖ ≤
                ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, C_step * s ^ (n + 1) := by
              refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le zero_le_one ?_
                (((continuous_pow (n + 1)).const_mul C_step).intervalIntegrable _ _)
              refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
              have hs_Icc : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
              have hp_s : (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) ∈ K_prod := ⟨hp.1, hKz_star z hp.2 s hs_Icc⟩
              have hseg_norm : ‖trapPDE_seg z₀ z s - z₀‖ = s * ‖z - z₀‖ := by
                have hdiff : trapPDE_seg z₀ z s - z₀ = s • (z - z₀) := by
                  simp only [trapPDE_seg, Complex.real_smul]
                  push_cast
                  ring
                rw [hdiff, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs_Icc.1]
              rw [norm_mul]
              have h1 : ‖(M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (Δ n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i‖ ≤
                  L * ‖Δ n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)‖ :=
                (norm_le_pi_norm _ i).trans (hM_mulVec_le _ hp_s _)
              have h2 := ih _ hp_s
              rw [hseg_norm] at h2
              calc ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖(M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (Δ n (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) i‖
                  ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ * (L * (B₀ * L ^ n * (s * ‖z - z₀‖) ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hL_nonneg)) (norm_nonneg _)
                _ = C_step * s ^ (n + 1) := by
                    simp only [C_step, mul_pow]
                    ring
