            have h_eval : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, C_step * s ^ (n + 1)) =
                B₀ * L ^ (n + 1) * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 2) / ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by
              rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
              have hfac : ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ) = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
                rw [Nat.factorial_succ (n + 1)]
                push_cast
                ring
              rw [hfac]
              simp only [C_step, one_pow, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), sub_zero]
              push_cast
              field_simp
              ring
            exact h_int_le.trans_eq h_eval
        set D := ‖z_star - z₀‖ + r
        set R_exp := max L 1 * max D 1
        let maj : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => B₀ * (R_exp ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ))
        have hmaj_sum : Summable maj := by
          have h1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R_exp ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) :=
            (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial R_exp)
          exact h1.mul_left B₀
        have h_ball_maj : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (w_star, z_star) r, ‖Δ n p idx‖ ≤ maj n := by
          intro n ⟨w, z⟩ hp
          rw [← ball_prod_same] at hp
          have hpK : (w, z) ∈ K_prod :=
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hp.1, hcb_sub_Kz (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hp.2)⟩
          have hzD : ‖z - z₀‖ ≤ D := by
            have hz_r : ‖z - z_star‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hp.2
            have htri : ‖z - z₀‖ ≤ ‖z - z_star‖ + ‖z_star - z₀‖ := by
              simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (z - z_star) (z_star - z₀)
            linarith
          have hLD : L ^ n * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1) ≤ R_exp ^ (n + 1) := by
            have hL1 : L ^ n ≤ (max L 1) ^ (n + 1) := by
              calc L ^ n ≤ (max L 1) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ hL_nonneg (le_max_left L 1) n
                _ ≤ (max L 1) ^ n * max L 1 := le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) (le_max_right L 1)
                _ = (max L 1) ^ (n + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
            have hD1 : ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1) ≤ (max D 1) ^ (n + 1) :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hzD.trans (le_max_left D 1)) (n + 1)
            calc L ^ n * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1)
                ≤ (max L 1) ^ (n + 1) * (max D 1) ^ (n + 1) :=
                  mul_le_mul hL1 hD1 (by positivity) (by positivity)
              _ = R_exp ^ (n + 1) := (mul_pow _ _ _).symm
          calc ‖Δ n (w, z) idx‖
              ≤ ‖Δ n (w, z)‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ idx
            _ ≤ B₀ * L ^ n * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) := hΔ_bnd n (w, z) hpK
            _ = B₀ * ((L ^ n * ‖z - z₀‖ ^ (n + 1)) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
            _ ≤ B₀ * (R_exp ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by gcongr
        have hunif_tsum := tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat hmaj_sum h_ball_maj
        refine ⟨Metric.ball (w_star, z_star) r,
          nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (w_star, z_star) hr), ?_⟩
        rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hunif_tsum ⊢
        intro ε hε
        filter_upwards [hunif_tsum ε hε] with N hN p hp
        have h_eq1 : u_iter N p idx = u_iter 0 p idx + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, Δ n p idx :=
          (h_telesc N p idx).symm
        have h_eq2 : u p idx = u_iter 0 p idx + ∑' n : ℕ, Δ n p idx := rfl
        rw [h_eq1, h_eq2, dist_add_left]
        exact hN p hp

      have hu_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) := by
        intro idx
        have hu_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
          (h_loc_unif idx).continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hu_reg n idx).1)).frequently
        have hu_w : ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => u (w, z) idx) Ω_par := by
          intro z hz
          have hloc_w : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun N w => u_iter N (w, z) idx)
              (fun w => u (w, z) idx) Filter.atTop Ω_par :=
            (h_loc_unif idx).comp (fun w => (w, z)) (fun w hw => ⟨hw, hz⟩)
              (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          exact hloc_w.differentiableOn
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hu_reg n idx).2.1 z hz)) hΩ_par
        have hu_z : ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u (w, z) idx) Ω_z := by
          intro w hw
          have hloc_z : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun N z => u_iter N (w, z) idx)
              (fun z => u (w, z) idx) Filter.atTop Ω_z :=
            (h_loc_unif idx).comp (fun z => (w, z)) (fun z hz => ⟨hw, hz⟩)
              (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
          exact hloc_z.differentiableOn
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hu_reg n idx).2.2 w hw)) hΩ_z
        exact h_osgood hΩ_par hΩ_z hu_cont hu_w hu_z

      have hu_init : ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (w, z₀) = v₀ w := by
        intro w _
        ext idx
        have h_iter_z0 : ∀ n : ℕ, trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ n (w, z₀) idx = v₀ w idx := by
          intro n
          induction n with
          | zero => rfl
          | succ n _ =>
            simp [trapPDE_picardIter]
        simp [u, trapPDE_picardSol, h_iter_z0]

      let F_rhs : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun idx p => ((M p).mulVec (u p) + c p) idx
      have hF_rhs_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_rhs idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) := by
        intro idx p hp
        refine DifferentiableWithinAt.add ?_ (hc idx p hp)
        exact DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => (hM idx j p hp).mul (hu_holo j p hp))
      have hu_int_eq : ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          u (w, z) idx = v₀ w idx + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (z - z₀) * F_rhs idx (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) := by
        intro w hw z hz idx
        have hmap_cont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) :=
          continuous_const.prodMk (by unfold trapPDE_seg; fun_prop)
        have hmap_to : Set.MapsTo (fun s : ℝ => (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
          fun s hs => ⟨hw, hseg_mem hz hs⟩
        have hunif_s : ∀ j : ι, TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun N s => u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
            (fun s => u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) Filter.atTop (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          intro j
          rw [← tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn_of_compact isCompact_Icc]
          exact (h_loc_unif j).comp _ hmap_to hmap_cont.continuousOn
        have h_lhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun N => u_iter (N + 1) (w, z) idx) Filter.atTop (nhds (u (w, z) idx)) :=
          ((h_loc_unif idx).tendsto_at ⟨hw, hz⟩).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
        let int_N : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun N s =>
          (z - z₀) * (((M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)).mulVec (u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) +
            c (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)) idx)
        let int_lim : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => (z - z₀) * F_rhs idx (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s)
        have hint_N_cont : ∀ N : ℕ, ContinuousOn (int_N N) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          intro N
          refine continuousOn_const.mul (ContinuousOn.add ?_ ((hc idx).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to))
          exact continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
            ((hM idx j).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to).mul
              ((hu_reg N j).1.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to))
        have hint_lim_cont : ContinuousOn int_lim (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          continuousOn_const.mul ((hF_rhs_holo idx).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to)
        have hunif_int : TendstoUniformlyOn int_N int_lim Filter.atTop (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          have hunif_sum : TendstoUniformlyOn
              (fun N s => ∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
              (fun s => ∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
              Filter.atTop (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
            have h_finset : ∀ S : Finset ι, TendstoUniformlyOn
                (fun N s => ∑ j ∈ S, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
                (fun s => ∑ j ∈ S, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
                Filter.atTop (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
              intro S
              induction S using Finset.induction_on with
              | empty =>
                rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
                intro ε hε
                filter_upwards with N s _
                simpa using hε
              | @insert j₀ S hj₀ ihS =>
                simp only [Finset.sum_insert hj₀]
                obtain ⟨C_M, hC_M⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
                  ((hM idx j₀).continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmap_to)
                set K_M := max C_M 0 + 1
                have hKM_pos : 0 < K_M := by positivity
                have hunif_term : TendstoUniformlyOn
                    (fun N s => M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀ * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀)
                    (fun s => M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀ * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀)
                    Filter.atTop (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
                  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
                  intro ε hε
                  have huj := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hunif_s j₀) (ε / K_M) (div_pos hε hKM_pos)
                  filter_upwards [huj] with N hN s hs
                  rw [dist_eq_norm, ← mul_sub, norm_mul]
                  have hm_le : ‖M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀‖ ≤ K_M := by
                    have h1 : ‖M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀‖ ≤ max C_M 0 :=
                      (hC_M s hs).trans (le_max_left C_M 0)
                    linarith
                  have hu_lt : ‖u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀ - u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀‖ < ε / K_M := by
                    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hN s hs
                  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hu_lt
                  calc ‖M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀‖ * ‖u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀ - u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀‖
                      ≤ K_M * ‖u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀ - u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀‖ := by
                        rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le (norm_nonneg _)
                    _ < K_M * (ε / K_M) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu_lt hKM_pos
                    _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hKM_pos)
                rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
                intro ε hε
                filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hunif_term (ε / 2) (half_pos hε),
                  Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp ihS (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)] with N hN1 hN2 s hs
                have hd_le := dist_add_add_le
                  (M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀ * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀)
                  (∑ j ∈ S, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
                  (M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j₀ * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j₀)
                  (∑ j ∈ S, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)
                linarith [hN1 s hs, hN2 s hs]
            exact h_finset Finset.univ
          rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
          intro ε hε
          set Kz := ‖z - z₀‖ + 1
          have hKz_pos : 0 < Kz := by positivity
          filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hunif_sum (ε / Kz) (div_pos hε hKz_pos)] with N hN s hs
          have hdiff_eq : int_lim s - int_N N s =
              (z - z₀) * ((∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) -
                (∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)) := by
            simp only [int_lim, int_N, F_rhs, Pi.add_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
            ring
          rw [dist_eq_norm, hdiff_eq, norm_mul]
          have hs_lt : ‖(∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) -
              (∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)‖ < ε / Kz := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hN s hs
          calc ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖(∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) -
                (∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)‖
              ≤ Kz * ‖(∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j) -
                (∑ j : ι, M (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) idx j * u_iter N (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ z s) j)‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _)
            _ < Kz * (ε / Kz) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs_lt hKz_pos
            _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hKz_pos)
        have h_rhs_int : Filter.Tendsto (fun N => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, int_N N s) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, int_lim s)) := by
          rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
          intro ε hε
          filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hunif_int (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)] with N hN
          rw [dist_eq_norm, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub
            ((hint_N_cont N).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
            (hint_lim_cont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)]
          have hbnd : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (int_N N s - int_lim s)‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * |(1 : ℝ) - 0| := by
            refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun s hs => ?_)
            rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
            exact le_of_lt (by simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hN s (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs))
          linarith [show |(1 : ℝ) - 0| = 1 by norm_num]
        have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun N => v₀ w idx + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, int_N N s) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (v₀ w idx + ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, int_lim s)) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.add h_rhs_int
        exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs h_rhs

      have hu_ode_ne : ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, z ≠ z₀ → ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z) = F_rhs idx (w, z) := by
        intro w hw z hz hne idx
        set ξ := z - z₀
        have hξ_ne : ξ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
        let γ_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => z₀ + (t : ℂ) * ξ
        have hγ1 : γ_ray 1 = z := by simp [γ_ray, ξ]
        have hγ_cont : Continuous γ_ray := by unfold γ_ray; fun_prop
        have hγ_ev : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 1, 0 < t ∧ γ_ray t ∈ Ω_z := by
          have h1 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 1, 0 < t := Ioi_mem_nhds zero_lt_one
          have h2 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds 1, γ_ray t ∈ Ω_z :=
            hγ_cont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hγ1]; exact hΩ_z.mem_nhds hz)
          exact h1.and h2
        let g_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => ξ * F_rhs idx (w, γ_ray τ)
        have h_ev_eq : (fun t : ℝ => u (w, γ_ray t) idx) =ᶠ[nhds 1]
            (fun t : ℝ => v₀ w idx + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, g_ray τ) := by
          filter_upwards [hγ_ev] with t ⟨ht_pos, ht_mem⟩
          have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht_pos
          rw [hu_int_eq w hw (γ_ray t) ht_mem idx]
          congr 1
          have h_integrand : (fun s : ℝ => (γ_ray t - z₀) * F_rhs idx (w, trapPDE_seg z₀ (γ_ray t) s)) =
              (fun s : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * g_ray (s * t)) := by
            ext s
            have hseg_eq : trapPDE_seg z₀ (γ_ray t) s = γ_ray (s * t) := by
              simp only [trapPDE_seg, γ_ray, Complex.real_smul]
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [hseg_eq]
            simp only [γ_ray, g_ray, add_sub_cancel_left]
            ring
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => congr_fun h_integrand s)]
          have h_smul : (fun s : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * g_ray (s * t)) = (fun s : ℝ => t • g_ray (s * t)) := by
            ext s; simp [Complex.real_smul]
          rw [h_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_right g_ray ht_ne,
            smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ht_ne, one_smul, zero_mul, one_mul]
        have hu_z_holo : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ => u (w, ζ) idx) z :=
          (((hu_holo idx).comp ((differentiable_const w).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hw, hζ⟩)) z hz).differentiableAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds hz)
        have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ_ray ξ 1 := by
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) 1 1 := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt
          have h2 := (h1.mul_const ξ).const_add z₀
          rw [one_mul] at h2
          exact h2
        have hlhs_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u (w, γ_ray t) idx)
            (ξ * pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z)) 1 := by
          have hp : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => u (w, ζ) idx) (pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z)) (γ_ray 1) := by
            rw [hγ1]
            exact hu_z_holo.hasDerivAt
          have hsc : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u (w, γ_ray t) idx)
              (ξ • pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z)) 1 := HasDerivAt.scomp (1 : ℝ) hp hγ_deriv
          simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hsc
        have hg_cont_Icc : ContinuousOn g_ray (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          have hto : Set.MapsTo (fun τ : ℝ => (w, γ_ray τ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) := by
            intro τ hτ
            refine ⟨hw, ?_⟩
            have h_eq : γ_ray τ = trapPDE_seg z₀ z τ := by
              simp only [γ_ray, trapPDE_seg, ξ, Complex.real_smul]
              push_cast
              ring
            dsimp only
            rw [h_eq]
            exact hseg_mem hz hτ
          exact continuousOn_const.mul ((hF_rhs_holo idx).continuousOn.comp
            (continuous_const.prodMk hγ_cont).continuousOn hto)
        have hg_cont_at1 : ContinuousAt g_ray 1 := by
          have h_open_pre : {τ : ℝ | (w, γ_ray τ) ∈ Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z} ∈ nhds (1 : ℝ) :=
            (continuous_const.prodMk hγ_cont).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
              (by rw [hγ1]; exact (hΩ_par.prod hΩ_z).mem_nhds ⟨hw, hz⟩)
          have hc : ContinuousOn g_ray {τ : ℝ | (w, γ_ray τ) ∈ Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z} :=
            continuousOn_const.mul ((hF_rhs_holo idx).continuousOn.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk hγ_cont).continuousOn (fun _ h => h))
          exact hc.continuousAt h_open_pre
        have hg_meas_at1 : StronglyMeasurableAtFilter g_ray (nhds 1) MeasureTheory.volume := by
          have h_open : IsOpen {τ : ℝ | (w, γ_ray τ) ∈ Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z} :=
            (hΩ_par.prod hΩ_z).preimage (continuous_const.prodMk hγ_cont)
          have hc : ContinuousOn g_ray {τ : ℝ | (w, γ_ray τ) ∈ Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z} :=
            continuousOn_const.mul ((hF_rhs_holo idx).continuousOn.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk hγ_cont).continuousOn (fun _ h => h))
          exact hc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter h_open 1 ⟨hw, by rw [hγ1]; exact hz⟩
        have hrhs_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => v₀ w idx + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, g_ray τ)
            (ξ * F_rhs idx (w, z)) 1 := by
          have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
            (hg_cont_Icc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one) hg_meas_at1 hg_cont_at1
          have hadd := hint.const_add (v₀ w idx)
          simpa [g_ray, hγ1] using hadd
        have heq_deriv : ξ * pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z) = ξ * F_rhs idx (w, z) :=
          (h_ev_eq.hasDerivAt_iff.mp hlhs_deriv).unique hrhs_deriv
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hξ_ne heq_deriv

      have hu_ode : ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z) = F_rhs idx (w, z) := by
        intro w hw z hz idx
        by_cases hne : z ≠ z₀
        · exact hu_ode_ne w hw z hz hne idx
        · rw [not_ne_iff] at hne
          subst hne
          obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ_z z hz
          let z_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => z + (((r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          have hz_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, z_seq n ∈ Ω_z := by
            intro n
            apply hball
            have hpos : 0 < (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := div_pos (half_pos hr) (by positivity)
            have hle : (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ r / 2 :=
              div_le_self (le_of_lt (half_pos hr)) (by linarith)
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self_add_left, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hpos)]
            linarith
          have hz_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, z_seq n ≠ z := by
            intro n heq
            have hpos : 0 < (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := div_pos (half_pos hr) (by positivity)
            have h0 : (((r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by linear_combination heq
            exact (ne_of_gt hpos) (Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h0)
          have hz_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto z_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z) := by
            have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
              tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
                (Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop tendsto_const_nhds)
            have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
              change Filter.Tendsto (Complex.ofReal ∘ fun n : ℕ => (r / 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
                Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.ofReal 0))
              exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h1
            have h3 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := z)).add h2
            rw [add_zero] at h3
            exact h3
          have hslice_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => u (w, ζ) idx) Ω_z :=
            (hu_holo idx).comp ((differentiable_const w).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
              (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hw, hζ⟩)
          have hlhs_cont : ContinuousAt (fun ζ => pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, ζ)) z :=
            ((hslice_holo.deriv hΩ_z).continuousOn.continuousAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds hz))
          have hrhs_cont : ContinuousAt (fun ζ => F_rhs idx (w, ζ)) z :=
            ((hF_rhs_holo idx).continuousOn.comp
              (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
              (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hw, hζ⟩)).continuousAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds hz)
          have hlhs_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z_seq n))
              Filter.atTop (nhds (pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z))) :=
            hlhs_cont.tendsto.comp hz_tendsto
          have hrhs_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F_rhs idx (w, z_seq n))
              Filter.atTop (nhds (F_rhs idx (w, z))) :=
            hrhs_cont.tendsto.comp hz_tendsto
          have heq_seq : (fun n => pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z_seq n)) =
              (fun n => F_rhs idx (w, z_seq n)) :=
            funext (fun n => hu_ode_ne w hw (z_seq n) (hz_mem n) (hz_ne n) idx)
          rw [heq_seq] at hlhs_lim
          exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlhs_lim hrhs_lim
      exact ⟨u, hu_holo, hu_init, hu_ode⟩

    refine ⟨h_solve_D, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ι _ _ Ω_z Ω_par hΩ_z hΩ_z_conv hΩ_par z₀ hz₀ M c v₀ hM hc hv₀
      let M' : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ := fun p => M p.swap
      let c' : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun p => c p.swap
      have hswap_diff : Differentiable ℂ (Prod.swap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) :=
        differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst
      have hswap_to : Set.MapsTo (Prod.swap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par) :=
        fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩
      have hM' : ∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M' p idx j) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
        fun idx j => (hM idx j).comp hswap_diff.differentiableOn hswap_to
      have hc' : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c' p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z) :=
        fun idx => (hc idx).comp hswap_diff.differentiableOn hswap_to
      obtain ⟨u', hu'_holo, hu'_init, hu'_ode⟩ :=
        h_solve_D ι Ω_par Ω_z hΩ_par hΩ_z hΩ_z_conv z₀ hz₀ M' c' v₀ hM' hc' hv₀
      refine ⟨fun p => u' p.swap, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro idx
        exact (hu'_holo idx).comp hswap_diff.differentiableOn (fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩)
      · intro w hw
        exact hu'_init w hw
      · intro z hz w hw idx
        exact hu'_ode w hw z hz idx
    · intro ι _ _ Ω_z hΩ_z hΩ_z_conv z₀ hz₀ M_z c_z u₁ u₂ hM_cont hu₁_holo hu₂_holo h_init hu₁_ode hu₂_ode z hz
      let D : ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun ζ => u₁ ζ - u₂ ζ
      have hD_z0 : D z₀ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr h_init
      have hD_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => D ζ idx) Ω_z :=
        fun idx => (hu₁_holo idx).sub (hu₂_holo idx)
      have hD_ode : ∀ ζ ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          deriv (fun w => D w idx) ζ = ((M_z ζ).mulVec (D ζ)) idx := by
        intro ζ hζ idx
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => u₁ w idx) (((M_z ζ).mulVec (u₁ ζ) + c_z ζ) idx) ζ := by
          rw [← hu₁_ode ζ hζ idx]
          exact ((hu₁_holo idx ζ hζ).differentiableAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun w => u₂ w idx) (((M_z ζ).mulVec (u₂ ζ) + c_z ζ) idx) ζ := by
          rw [← hu₂_ode ζ hζ idx]
          exact ((hu₂_holo idx ζ hζ).differentiableAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds hζ)).hasDerivAt
        have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w => D w idx)
            ((((M_z ζ).mulVec (u₁ ζ) + c_z ζ) idx) - (((M_z ζ).mulVec (u₂ ζ) + c_z ζ) idx)) ζ :=
          hd1.sub hd2
        rw [hd_sub.deriv]
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, D, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub]
        rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => trapPDE_seg z₀ z t
      have hγ_mem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ t ∈ Ω_z :=
        fun t ht => hΩ_z_conv hz₀ hz (by linarith [ht.2]) ht.1 (by ring)
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := by unfold γ trapPDE_seg; fun_prop
      let μM : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖
      have hμM_cont : ContinuousOn μM (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
          continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ =>
            ((hM_cont i j).comp hγ_cont.continuousOn hγ_mem).norm))
      obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hμM_cont
      set L := max L₀ 0
      have hL_nonneg : 0 ≤ L := le_max_right L₀ 0
      have hM_le : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ v : ι → ℂ, ‖(M_z (γ t)).mulVec v‖ ≤ L * ‖v‖ := by
        intro t ht v
        rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL_nonneg (norm_nonneg v))]
        intro i
        have h1 : ‖(M_z (γ t)).mulVec v i‖ ≤ (∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖) * ‖v‖ := by
          calc ‖(M_z (γ t)).mulVec v i‖
              ≤ ∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j * v j‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ = ∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖ * ‖v j‖ := by simp only [norm_mul]
            _ ≤ ∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖ * ‖v‖ :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_le_pi_norm v j) (norm_nonneg _))
            _ = (∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖) * ‖v‖ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        have h2 : ∑ j : ι, ‖M_z (γ t) i j‖ ≤ μM t :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
        have h3 : μM t ≤ L := by
          have hnorm := hL₀ t ht
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
          exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hnorm.trans (le_max_left L₀ 0))
        exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h2.trans h3) (norm_nonneg v))
      have hD_γ_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => D (γ t)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun idx => (hD_holo idx).continuousOn.comp hγ_cont.continuousOn hγ_mem)
      obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hD_γ_cont
      set C_D := max C₀ 0
      have hCD_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_D := le_max_right C₀ 0
      have hD_ftc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ idx : ι,
          D (γ t) idx = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, (z - z₀) * ((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx) := by
        intro t ht idx
        have huIcc : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) t = Set.Icc 0 t := Set.uIcc_of_le ht.1
        have hderiv_s : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) t,
            HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => D (γ τ) idx)
              ((z - z₀) * ((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx)) s := by
          intro s hs
          rw [huIcc] at hs
          have hs_1 : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
          have hd_w : HasDerivAt (fun w => D w idx) (((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s))) idx) (γ s) := by
            rw [← hD_ode (γ s) (hγ_mem s hs_1) idx]
            exact ((hD_holo idx (γ s) (hγ_mem s hs_1)).differentiableAt (hΩ_z.mem_nhds (hγ_mem s hs_1))).hasDerivAt
          have hd_γ : HasDerivAt γ (z - z₀) s := by
            have h_eq : γ = fun τ : ℝ => z₀ + (τ : ℂ) * (z - z₀) := by
              ext τ
              simp only [γ, trapPDE_seg, Complex.real_smul]
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [h_eq]
            have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ)) 1 s := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt
            have h2 := (h1.mul_const (z - z₀)).const_add z₀
            rw [one_mul] at h2
            exact h2
          have hsc : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => D (γ τ) idx)
              ((z - z₀) • (((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s))) idx)) s := HasDerivAt.scomp s hd_w hd_γ
          simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hsc
        have hint_cont : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => (z - z₀) * ((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx))
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t) := by
          have hsub : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t ⊆ Set.Icc 0 1 := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
          refine continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
          exact ((hM_cont idx j).comp hγ_cont.continuousOn (hsub.trans hγ_mem)).mul
            ((hD_holo j).continuousOn.comp hγ_cont.continuousOn (hsub.trans hγ_mem))
        have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv_s
          (hint_cont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.1)
        have h0 : D (γ 0) idx = 0 := by simp [γ, trapPDE_seg, hD_z0]
        rw [hftc, h0, sub_zero]
      set K := ‖z - z₀‖ * L
      have hK_nonneg : 0 ≤ K := by positivity
      have hD_pow : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖D (γ t)‖ ≤ C_D * ((K * t) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero =>
          intro t ht
          simpa only [pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, div_one, mul_one] using
            (hC₀ t ht).trans (le_max_left C₀ 0)
        | succ n ih =>
          intro t ht
          have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_D * ((K * t) ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
            have := ht.1; positivity
          rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
          intro idx
          rw [hD_ftc t ht idx]
          set C_n := C_D * K ^ (n + 1) / (n.factorial : ℝ)
          have h_le : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, (z - z₀) * ((M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx)‖ ≤
              ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, C_n * s ^ n := by
            refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le ht.1 ?_
              (((continuous_pow n).const_mul C_n).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
            have hs_1 : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_of_lt hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩
            rw [norm_mul]
            have h1 : ‖(M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx‖ ≤ L * ‖D (γ s)‖ :=
              (norm_le_pi_norm _ idx).trans (hM_le s hs_1 _)
            have h2 := ih s hs_1
            calc ‖z - z₀‖ * ‖(M_z (γ s)).mulVec (D (γ s)) idx‖
                ≤ ‖z - z₀‖ * (L * (C_D * ((K * s) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)))) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hL_nonneg)) (norm_nonneg _)
              _ = C_n * s ^ n := by
                  simp only [C_n, K, mul_pow]
                  ring
          have h_eval : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, C_n * s ^ n) =
              C_D * ((K * t) ^ (n + 1) / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
            have hfac : ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
              rw [Nat.factorial_succ n]
              push_cast
              rfl
            rw [hfac]
            simp only [C_n, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), sub_zero, mul_pow]
            push_cast
            field_simp
          exact h_le.trans_eq h_eval
      have hDz_le : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖D z‖ ≤ C_D * (K ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
        intro n
        have h1 := hD_pow n 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
        simpa [γ, trapPDE_seg] using h1
      have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C_D * (K ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial K).mul_left C_D).tendsto_atTop_zero
      have hDz_nonpos : ‖D z‖ ≤ 0 := ge_of_tendsto' h_lim hDz_le
      have hDz_zero : D z = 0 := norm_le_zero_iff.mp hDz_nonpos
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hDz_zero

  
  
  
  have hq₁_trap : (a₁, δ₁) ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀ := by
    refine ⟨hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_lt, ?_⟩
    have hmul : C₀ * δ₁ < C₀ * δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ₁_lt hC₀
    dsimp only
    linarith
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  have hp₁ : p₁ ∈ U_ode := hcov (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap

  obtain ⟨W₀, V₀, hW₀_open, hp₁_W₀, _hW₀_sub, hV₀_holo, hV₀_taylor, hV₀_pde⟩ :
      ∃ (W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V₀ : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        IsOpen W₀ ∧ p₁ ∈ W₀ ∧ W₀ ⊆ U_ode ∧
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => V₀ p idx) W₀) ∧
        (∀ idx : ι, taylor2D (fun p => V₀ p idx) p₁ = V_formal idx) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W₀, ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivA (fun q => V₀ q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c_a p) idx ∧
          pderivD (fun q => V₀ q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c_δ p) idx) := by
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_ode p₁ hp₁
    let Ω_a : Set ℂ := Metric.ball p₁.1 r₀
    let Ω_δ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball p₁.2 r₀
    let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Ω_a ×ˢ Ω_δ
    have hW₀_sub : W₀ ⊆ U_ode := (ball_prod_same p₁.1 p₁.2 r₀).trans_subset hball
    have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hW₀_pre : IsPreconnected W₀ :=
      ((convex_ball p₁.1 r₀).prod (convex_ball p₁.2 r₀)).isPreconnected
    have hp₁_a : p₁.1 ∈ Ω_a := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀
    have hp₁_δ : p₁.2 ∈ Ω_δ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀
    have hp₁_W₀ : p₁ ∈ W₀ := ⟨hp₁_a, hp₁_δ⟩

    obtain ⟨V_base, hV_base_holo, hV_base_init, hV_base_ode⟩ :=
      hODE.solve_param_A ι Ω_a Ω_δ Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁.1 r₀) Metric.isOpen_ball
        p₁.1 hp₁_a M_a c_a (fun _ idx => MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (V_formal idx))
        (fun idx j => (hMa_holo idx j).mono hW₀_sub)
        (fun idx => (hca_holo idx).mono hW₀_sub)
        (fun idx => differentiableOn_const _)
    let v_top : ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun a => V_base (a, p₁.2)
    have hv_top_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun a => v_top a idx) Ω_a :=
      fun idx => (hV_base_holo idx).comp
        (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const p₁.2)).differentiableOn
        (fun a ha => ⟨ha, hp₁_δ⟩)
    obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀_holo, hV₀_init, hV₀_ode_δ⟩ :=
      hODE.solve_param_D ι Ω_a Ω_δ Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁.2 r₀)
        p₁.2 hp₁_δ M_δ c_δ v_top
        (fun idx j => (hMδ_holo idx j).mono hW₀_sub)
        (fun idx => (hcδ_holo idx).mono hW₀_sub)
        hv_top_holo

    have hV₀_p₁ : ∀ idx : ι, V₀ p₁ idx = MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (V_formal idx) := by
      intro idx
      have h1 : V₀ (p₁.1, p₁.2) = v_top p₁.1 := hV₀_init p₁.1 hp₁_a
      have h2 : V_base (p₁.1, p₁.2) = fun i => MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (V_formal i) :=
        hV_base_init p₁.2 hp₁_δ
      exact congr_fun (h1.trans h2) idx
    have hV₀_slice_a : ∀ a ∈ Ω_a, ∀ idx : ι,
        pderivA (fun q => V₀ q idx) (a, p₁.2) =
          ((M_a (a, p₁.2)).mulVec (V₀ (a, p₁.2)) + c_a (a, p₁.2)) idx := by
      intro a ha idx
      have hev : (fun z => V₀ (z, p₁.2) idx) =ᶠ[nhds a] (fun z => V_base (z, p₁.2) idx) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ha)
          (fun z hz => congr_fun (hV₀_init z hz) idx)
      change deriv (fun z => V₀ (z, p₁.2) idx) a = _
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      have hode := hV_base_ode a ha p₁.2 hp₁_δ idx
      change deriv (fun z => V_base (z, p₁.2) idx) a = _ at hode
      rw [hode, hV₀_init a ha]
    have h_iterY_congr : ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ a ∈ Ω_a, f₁ (a, p₁.2) = f₂ (a, p₁.2)) →
        ∀ α : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ Ω_a, iterDerivY α f₁ (a, p₁.2) = iterDerivY α f₂ (a, p₁.2) := by
      intro f₁ f₂ hfg α
      induction α with
      | zero => exact hfg
      | succ α ih =>
        intro a ha
        change deriv (fun y' => iterDerivY α f₁ (y', p₁.2)) a =
          deriv (fun y' => iterDerivY α f₂ (y', p₁.2)) a
        exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ha)
          (fun y' hy' => ih y' hy')).deriv_eq
    have h_taylor_slice : ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ a ∈ Ω_a, f₁ (a, p₁.2) = f₂ (a, p₁.2)) →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 1 = 0 →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f₁ p₁) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f₂ p₁) := by
      intro f₁ f₂ hfg d hd1
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
      unfold taylor2D iterDerivYT
      rw [hd1]
      change iterDerivY (d 0) f₁ (p₁.1, p₁.2) / _ = iterDerivY (d 0) f₂ (p₁.1, p₁.2) / _
      rw [h_iterY_congr hfg (d 0) p₁.1 hp₁_a]

    let T : ι → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun idx => taylor2D (fun p => V₀ p idx) p₁
    have h_taylor_lin : ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j) W₀) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c p idx) W₀) →
        ∀ idx : ι,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ((M p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c p) idx) W₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => ((M p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c p) idx) p₁ =
            (∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M p idx j) p₁ * T j) +
              taylor2D (fun p => c p idx) p₁ := by
      intro M c hM_W hc_W idx
      have hsum : ∀ s : Finset ι,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∑ j ∈ s, M p idx j * V₀ p j) W₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => ∑ j ∈ s, M p idx j * V₀ p j) p₁ =
            ∑ j ∈ s, taylor2D (fun p => M p idx j) p₁ * T j := by
        intro s
        induction s using Finset.induction_on with
        | empty =>
          refine ⟨differentiableOn_const 0, ?_⟩
          simpa using (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hp₁_W₀).1 0
        | @insert j₀ s hj₀ ih =>
          have h_eq : (fun p => ∑ j ∈ insert j₀ s, M p idx j * V₀ p j) =
              (fun p => M p idx j₀ * V₀ p j₀ + ∑ j ∈ s, M p idx j * V₀ p j) := by
            ext p; exact Finset.sum_insert hj₀
          have hterm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j₀ * V₀ p j₀) W₀ :=
            (hM_W idx j₀).mul (hV₀_holo j₀)
          rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_insert hj₀]
          refine ⟨hterm_holo.add ih.1, ?_⟩
          rw [((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hp₁_W₀).2 hterm_holo ih.1).1,
            ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hp₁_W₀).2 (hM_W idx j₀) (hV₀_holo j₀)).2.2, ih.2]
      have h_rhs_eq : (fun p => ((M p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c p) idx) =
          (fun p => (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ, M p idx j * V₀ p j) + c p idx) := rfl
      rw [h_rhs_eq]
      refine ⟨(hsum Finset.univ).1.add (hc_W idx), ?_⟩
      rw [((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hp₁_W₀).2 (hsum Finset.univ).1 (hc_W idx)).1,
        (hsum Finset.univ).2]

    have hMa_lin := h_taylor_lin M_a c_a
      (fun idx j => (hMa_holo idx j).mono hW₀_sub) (fun idx => (hca_holo idx).mono hW₀_sub)
    have hMδ_lin := h_taylor_lin M_δ c_δ
      (fun idx j => (hMδ_holo idx j).mono hW₀_sub) (fun idx => (hcδ_holo idx).mono hW₀_sub)

    have hT_derivD : ∀ idx : ι,
        mvDerivD (T idx) =
          (∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * T j) +
            taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁ := by
      intro idx
      rw [((hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hW₀_open hp₁_W₀ (hV₀_holo idx))).2, ← (hMδ_lin idx).2]
      exact hKit.taylor2D_congr hW₀_open hp₁_W₀ (fun p hp => hV₀_ode_δ p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 idx)

    have hT_derivA_slice : ∀ idx : ι, ∀ d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d' 1 = 0 →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA (T idx)) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
            ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * T j) +
              taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁) := by
      intro idx d' hd'1
      rw [((hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hW₀_open hp₁_W₀ (hV₀_holo idx))).1, ← (hMa_lin idx).2]
      exact h_taylor_slice (fun a ha => hV₀_slice_a a ha idx) d' hd'1

    have h_horiz : ∀ α : ℕ, ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 = α → d 1 = 0 → ∀ idx : ι,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
      intro α
      induction α using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h α ih =>
        rcases α with _ | α'
        · intro d hd0 hd1 idx
          have hd_zero : d = 0 := by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simpa using hd0
            · simpa using hd1
          subst hd_zero
          have hT0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (T idx) = V₀ p₁ idx := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            simp [T, taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
          rw [hT0, hV₀_p₁ idx]
        · intro d hd0 hd1 idx
          let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 α'
          have hd'0 : d' 0 = α' := by simp [d']
          have hd'1 : d' 1 = 0 := by simp [d']
          have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 0 1 = d := by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simp [d', hd0]
            · simp [d', hd1]
          have h_lhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA (T idx)) =
              ((α' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            unfold mvDerivA
            rw [hd'0, hd'_add]
          have h_rhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA (V_formal idx)) =
              ((α' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            unfold mvDerivA
            rw [hd'0, hd'_add]
          have h_series_eq :
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
                ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * T j) +
                  taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
                ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_a p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j) +
                  taylor2D (fun p => c_a p idx) p₁) := by
            simp only [map_add, map_sum, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
            congr 1
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun uv huv => ?_))
            have huv_eq : uv.1 + uv.2 = d' := by simpa using huv
            have hv0 : uv.1 0 + uv.2 0 = α' := by
              have := congr_arg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => f 0) huv_eq
              simpa [hd'0] using this
            have hv1 : uv.1 1 + uv.2 1 = 0 := by
              have := congr_arg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => f 1) huv_eq
              simpa [hd'1] using this
            rw [ih (uv.2 0) (by omega) uv.2 rfl (by omega) j]
          have h_both : ((α' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) =
              ((α' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
            rw [← h_lhs, hT_derivA_slice idx d' hd'1, h_series_eq, ← hformal_a idx, h_rhs]
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero α')) h_both

    have h_vert : ∀ β : ℕ, ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 1 = β → ∀ idx : ι,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
      intro β
      induction β using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h β ih =>
        rcases β with _ | β'
        · intro d hd1 idx
          exact h_horiz (d 0) d rfl hd1 idx
        · intro d hd1 idx
          let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 (d 0) + Finsupp.single 1 β'
          have hd'1 : d' 1 = β' := by simp [d']
          have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 1 1 = d := by
            ext i
            fin_cases i
            · simp [d']
            · simp [d', hd1]
          have h_lhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivD (T idx)) =
              ((β' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            unfold mvDerivD
            rw [hd'1, hd'_add]
          have h_rhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivD (V_formal idx)) =
              ((β' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            unfold mvDerivD
            rw [hd'1, hd'_add]
          have h_series_eq :
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
                ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * T j) +
                  taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
                ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p => M_δ p idx j) p₁ * V_formal j) +
                  taylor2D (fun p => c_δ p idx) p₁) := by
            simp only [map_add, map_sum, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
            congr 1
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun uv huv => ?_))
            have huv_eq : uv.1 + uv.2 = d' := by simpa using huv
            have hv1 : uv.1 1 + uv.2 1 = β' := by
              have := congr_arg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => f 1) huv_eq
              simpa [hd'1] using this
            rw [ih (uv.2 1) (by omega) uv.2 rfl j]
          have h_both : ((β' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T idx) =
              ((β' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V_formal idx) := by
            rw [← h_lhs, hT_derivD idx, h_series_eq, ← hformal_δ idx, h_rhs]
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero β')) h_both

    have hT_eq : ∀ idx : ι, T idx = V_formal idx :=
      fun idx => MvPowerSeries.ext (fun d => h_vert (d 1) d rfl idx)

    have hV₀_ode_a : ∀ p ∈ W₀, ∀ idx : ι,
        pderivA (fun q => V₀ q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V₀ p) + c_a p) idx := by
      intro p hp idx
      let R_a : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
        pderivA (fun p' => V₀ p' idx) q - ((M_a q).mulVec (V₀ q) + c_a q) idx
      have hRa_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_a W₀ :=
        (hKit.pderiv_holo hW₀_open (hV₀_holo idx)).1.sub (hMa_lin idx).1
      have hRa_taylor : taylor2D R_a p₁ = 0 := by
        change taylor2D (fun q => pderivA (fun p' => V₀ p' idx) q -
          ((M_a q).mulVec (V₀ q) + c_a q) idx) p₁ = 0
        rw [((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hp₁_W₀).2
          (hKit.pderiv_holo hW₀_open (hV₀_holo idx)).1 (hMa_lin idx).1).2.1,
          ← (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hW₀_open hp₁_W₀ (hV₀_holo idx)).1,
          (hMa_lin idx).2]
        change mvDerivA (T idx) -
          ((∑ j : ι, taylor2D (fun p' => M_a p' idx j) p₁ * T j) +
            taylor2D (fun p' => c_a p' idx) p₁) = 0
        simp only [hT_eq, hformal_a idx, p₁, sub_self]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hKit.eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero hW₀_open hW₀_pre hp₁_W₀ hRa_holo hRa_taylor p hp)

    exact ⟨W₀, V₀, hW₀_open, hp₁_W₀, hW₀_sub, hV₀_holo, hT_eq,
      fun p hp idx => ⟨hV₀_ode_a p hp idx, hV₀_ode_δ p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 idx⟩⟩

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨V_ode, V, W_eq, hV_ode_open, hV_ode_pre, hV_ode_sub, hV_ode_cov,
      hV_holo, hWeq_open, hp₁_Weq, _hWeq_sub, hWeq_eq, hV_pde⟩ :
      ∃ (V_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (V : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (W_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen V_ode ∧ IsPreconnected V_ode ∧ V_ode ⊆ U_ode ∧
        (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_ode) ∧
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => V p idx) V_ode) ∧
        IsOpen W_eq ∧ p₁ ∈ W_eq ∧ W_eq ⊆ V_ode ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W_eq, V p = V₀ p) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ V_ode, ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivA (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V p) + c_a p) idx ∧
          pderivD (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (V p) + c_δ p) idx) := by
    have h_crect_open : ∀ (x_lo x_hi η : ℝ), IsOpen (trapCrect x_lo x_hi η) := by
      intro x_lo x_hi η
      exact (isOpen_Ioi.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        ((isOpen_Iio.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
          (isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)))

    have h_crect_conv : ∀ (x_lo x_hi η : ℝ), Convex ℝ (trapCrect x_lo x_hi η) := by
      intro x_lo x_hi η z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      rcases hz₁ with ⟨h1_lo, h1_hi, h1_im⟩
      rcases hz₂ with ⟨h2_lo, h2_hi, h2_im⟩
      rw [abs_lt] at h1_im h2_im
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1; linarith
        · have hc : a * (x_lo - η) + b * (x_lo - η) = x_lo - η := by linear_combination (x_lo - η) * hab
          linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_lo ha_pos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h2_lo) hb]
      · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1; linarith
        · have hc : a * (x_hi + η) + b * (x_hi + η) = x_hi + η := by linear_combination (x_hi + η) * hab
          linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_hi ha_pos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h2_hi) hb]
      · rw [abs_lt]
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1; constructor <;> linarith
        · have hc1 : a * (-η) + b * (-η) = -η := by linear_combination (-η) * hab
          have hc2 : a * η + b * η = η := by linear_combination η * hab
          constructor
          · linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_im.1 ha_pos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h2_im.1) hb]
          · linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1_im.2 ha_pos, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h2_im.2) hb]

    have h_crect_real : ∀ {x_lo x_hi η x : ℝ}, 0 < η → x ∈ Set.Icc x_lo x_hi →
        (x : ℂ) ∈ trapCrect x_lo x_hi η := by
      intro x_lo x_hi η x hη hx
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp; linarith [hx.1]
      · simp; linarith [hx.2]
      · simp [hη]

    have h_crect_mono : ∀ {x₁ x₂ x₁' x₂' η η' : ℝ},
        x₁ ≤ x₁' → x₂' ≤ x₂ → η' ≤ η →
        trapCrect x₁' x₂' η' ⊆ trapCrect x₁ x₂ η := by
      intro x₁ x₂ x₁' x₂' η η' h1 h2 hη z hz
      exact ⟨by linarith [hz.1], by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2]⟩

    have h_norm_sub_real : ∀ (z : ℂ) (x : ℝ), ‖z - (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ |z.re - x| + |z.im| := by
      intro z x
      have h_decomp : z - (x : ℂ) = ((z.re - x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      rw [h_decomp]
      calc ‖((z.re - x : ℝ) : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖
          ≤ ‖((z.re - x : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖(z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |z.re - x| + |z.im| := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
              Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]

    have h_thicken_box : ∀ {x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi : ℝ},
        x_lo ≤ x_hi → y_lo ≤ y_hi →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc x_lo x_hi, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi, ((x : ℂ), (y : ℂ)) ∈ U_ode) →
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ trapCrect x_lo x_hi η ×ˢ trapCrect y_lo y_hi η ⊆ U_ode := by
      intro x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi hx_le hy_le hbox
      let emb : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))
      have hemb_cont : Continuous emb :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd)
      let K_ℂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := emb '' (Set.Icc x_lo x_hi ×ˢ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi)
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K_ℂ := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hemb_cont
      have hK_sub : K_ℂ ⊆ U_ode := by
        rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨hx, hy⟩, rfl⟩
        exact hbox x hx y hy
      obtain ⟨δ_th, hδ_th, hth_sub⟩ := hK_comp.exists_thickening_subset_open hU_ode hK_sub
      refine ⟨δ_th / 2, half_pos hδ_th, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨z, w⟩ ⟨hz, hw⟩
      apply hth_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
      let x_cl := max x_lo (min x_hi z.re)
      let y_cl := max y_lo (min y_hi w.re)
      have hx_cl_mem : x_cl ∈ Set.Icc x_lo x_hi :=
        ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hx_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
      have hy_cl_mem : y_cl ∈ Set.Icc y_lo y_hi :=
        ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hy_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩
      have hx_cl_dist : |z.re - x_cl| < δ_th / 2 := by
        by_cases h1 : x_hi ≤ z.re
        · have : x_cl = x_hi := by simp [x_cl, min_eq_left h1, max_eq_right hx_le]
          rw [this, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
        · by_cases h2 : z.re ≤ x_lo
          · have : x_cl = x_lo := by simp [x_cl, min_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h1)), max_eq_left h2]
            rw [this, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
          · have : x_cl = z.re := by
              simp [x_cl, min_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h1)), max_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h2))]
            rw [this, sub_self, abs_zero]
            exact half_pos hδ_th
      have hy_cl_dist : |w.re - y_cl| < δ_th / 2 := by
        by_cases h1 : y_hi ≤ w.re
        · have : y_cl = y_hi := by simp [y_cl, min_eq_left h1, max_eq_right hy_le]
          rw [this, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1]
        · by_cases h2 : w.re ≤ y_lo
          · have : y_cl = y_lo := by simp [y_cl, min_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h1)), max_eq_left h2]
            rw [this, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1]
          · have : y_cl = w.re := by
              simp [y_cl, min_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h1)), max_eq_right (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h2))]
            rw [this, sub_self, abs_zero]
            exact half_pos hδ_th
      refine ⟨((x_cl : ℂ), (y_cl : ℂ)), ⟨(x_cl, y_cl), ⟨hx_cl_mem, hy_cl_mem⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      constructor
      · rw [dist_eq_norm]
        linarith [h_norm_sub_real z x_cl, hz.2.2]
      · rw [dist_eq_norm]
        linarith [h_norm_sub_real w y_cl, hw.2.2]

    let v_init : ι → ℂ := V₀ p₁
    have h_chart_agree :
        ∀ (C₁ C₂ : TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init)
          {p : ℂ × ℂ},
          p ∈ C₁.R_a ×ˢ C₁.R_δ → p ∈ C₂.R_a ×ˢ C₂.R_δ → C₁.W p = C₂.W p := by
      intro C₁ C₂ ⟨a_star, δ_star_pt⟩ hp₁_c hp₂_c
      let Rδ_12 := C₁.R_δ_spine ∩ C₂.R_δ_spine
      have hRδ12_open : IsOpen Rδ_12 := C₁.hRδ_sp_open.inter C₂.hRδ_sp_open
      have hRδ12_conv : Convex ℝ Rδ_12 := C₁.hRδ_sp_conv.inter C₂.hRδ_sp_conv
      have hδ₁_12 : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ Rδ_12 := ⟨C₁.hδ₁_mem, C₂.hδ₁_mem⟩
      have hδ_pt_12 : δ_star_pt ∈ Rδ_12 := ⟨C₁.hRδ_sub_sp hp₁_c.2, C₂.hRδ_sub_sp hp₂_c.2⟩
      have hMδ_sp_cont : ∀ idx j : ι, ContinuousOn (fun δ => M_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ) idx j) Rδ_12 :=
        fun idx j => (hMδ_holo idx j).continuousOn.comp
          (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
          (fun δ hδ => C₁.hsp_sub_U δ hδ.1)
      have hγ_eq : C₁.γ δ_star_pt = C₂.γ δ_star_pt :=
        hODE.unique_1D ι Rδ_12 hRδ12_open hRδ12_conv (δ₁ : ℂ) hδ₁_12
          (fun δ => M_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)) (fun δ => c_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)) C₁.γ C₂.γ
          hMδ_sp_cont
          (fun idx => (C₁.hγ_holo idx).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
          (fun idx => (C₂.hγ_holo idx).mono Set.inter_subset_right)
          (C₁.hγ_init.trans C₂.hγ_init.symm)
          (fun δ hδ idx => C₁.hγ_ode δ hδ.1 idx)
          (fun δ hδ idx => C₂.hγ_ode δ hδ.2 idx)
          δ_star_pt hδ_pt_12
      let Ra_12 := C₁.R_a ∩ C₂.R_a
      have hRa12_open : IsOpen Ra_12 := C₁.hRa_open.inter C₂.hRa_open
      have hRa12_conv : Convex ℝ Ra_12 := C₁.hRa_conv.inter C₂.hRa_conv
      have ha₁_12 : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ Ra_12 := ⟨C₁.ha₁_mem, C₂.ha₁_mem⟩
      have ha_pt_12 : a_star ∈ Ra_12 := ⟨hp₁_c.1, hp₂_c.1⟩
      have hMa_sw_cont : ∀ idx j : ι, ContinuousOn (fun a => M_a (a, δ_star_pt) idx j) Ra_12 :=
        fun idx j => (hMa_holo idx j).continuousOn.comp
          (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
          (fun a ha => C₁.hrect_sub_U ⟨ha.1, hp₁_c.2⟩)
      exact hODE.unique_1D ι Ra_12 hRa12_open hRa12_conv (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_12
        (fun a => M_a (a, δ_star_pt)) (fun a => c_a (a, δ_star_pt))
        (fun a => C₁.W (a, δ_star_pt)) (fun a => C₂.W (a, δ_star_pt))
        hMa_sw_cont
        (fun idx => (C₁.hW_holo idx).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn
          (fun a ha => ⟨ha.1, hp₁_c.2⟩))
        (fun idx => (C₂.hW_holo idx).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn
          (fun a ha => ⟨ha.2, hp₂_c.2⟩))
        ((C₁.hW_spine δ_star_pt hp₁_c.2).trans (hγ_eq.trans (C₂.hW_spine δ_star_pt hp₂_c.2).symm))
        (fun a ha idx => C₁.hW_pde_a (a, δ_star_pt) ⟨ha.1, hp₁_c.2⟩ idx)
        (fun a ha idx => C₂.hW_pde_a (a, δ_star_pt) ⟨ha.2, hp₂_c.2⟩ idx)
        a_star ha_pt_12

    obtain ⟨r_w, hr_w, hball_W₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW₀_open p₁ hp₁_W₀
    set r_seed := r_w / 2
    have hr_seed : 0 < r_seed := half_pos hr_w
    have hseed_sub_W₀ : trapCrect a₁ a₁ r_seed ×ˢ trapCrect δ₁ δ₁ r_seed ⊆ W₀ := by
      rintro ⟨z, w⟩ ⟨hz, hw⟩
      apply hball_W₀
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      have hz_re : |z.re - a₁| < r_seed := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2.1]
      have hw_re : |w.re - δ₁| < r_seed := by
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hw.1, hw.2.1]
      constructor
      · rw [dist_eq_norm]
        have := h_norm_sub_real z a₁
        change ‖z - (a₁ : ℂ)‖ < r_w
        have : r_seed = r_w / 2 := rfl
        linarith [hz.2.2]
      · rw [dist_eq_norm]
        have := h_norm_sub_real w δ₁
        change ‖w - (δ₁ : ℂ)‖ < r_w
        have : r_seed = r_w / 2 := rfl
        linarith [hw.2.2]

    have h_local_pderiv : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hU : IsOpen U) {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ q ∈ U, f₁ q = f₂ q) →
        ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA f₁ p = pderivA f₂ p ∧ pderivD f₁ p = pderivD f₂ p := by
      intro U hU f₁ f₂ hfg p hp
      constructor
      · have h_open_a : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, p.2) ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (h_open_a.mem_nhds hp) (fun z hz => hfg (z, p.2) hz)).deriv_eq
      · have h_open_d : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (p.1, z) ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (h_open_d.mem_nhds hp) (fun z hz => hfg (p.1, z) hz)).deriv_eq

    let Trap := ↥(webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀)
    have h_charts_exist : ∀ q : Trap,
        ∃ (C_sp C_sw : TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init)
          (O_seed : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
          p₁ ∈ C_sp.R_a ×ˢ C_sp.R_δ ∧
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (q.1.2 : ℂ)) ∈ (C_sp.R_a ×ˢ C_sp.R_δ) ∩ (C_sw.R_a ×ˢ C_sw.R_δ) ∧
          ((q.1.1 : ℂ), (q.1.2 : ℂ)) ∈ C_sw.R_a ×ˢ C_sw.R_δ ∧
          IsOpen O_seed ∧ p₁ ∈ O_seed ∧ O_seed ⊆ C_sp.R_a ×ˢ C_sp.R_δ ∧
          (∀ p ∈ O_seed, C_sp.W p = V₀ p) := by
      rintro ⟨⟨a_q, δ_q⟩, hδq_pos, hδq_lt, haq_abs⟩
      have h_sp_box : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a₁ a₁, ∀ δ ∈ Set.Icc (min δ₁ δ_q) (max δ₁ δ_q),
          ((x : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) ∈ U_ode := by
        intro x hx δ hδ
        have hx_eq : x = a₁ := le_antisymm hx.2 hx.1
        rw [hx_eq]
        refine hcov (a₁, δ) ?_
        have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := (lt_min hδ₁_pos hδq_pos).trans_le hδ.1
        have hδ_lt : δ < δ_star := hδ.2.trans_lt (max_lt hδ₁_lt hδq_lt)
        refine ⟨hδ_pos, hδ_lt, ?_⟩
        have hmul : C₀ * δ < C₀ * δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ_lt hC₀
        dsimp only
        linarith
      obtain ⟨η_sp_raw, hη_sp_raw, hQ_sp_raw⟩ :=
        h_thicken_box le_rfl (min_le_max) h_sp_box
      set η_sp := min η_sp_raw r_seed
      have hη_sp : 0 < η_sp := lt_min hη_sp_raw hr_seed
      let Ra_sp := trapCrect a₁ a₁ η_sp
      let Rδ_sp := trapCrect (min δ₁ δ_q) (max δ₁ δ_q) η_sp
      have hQ_sp_sub : Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp ⊆ U_ode :=
        (Set.prod_mono
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))).trans hQ_sp_raw
      have ha₁_Ra_sp : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ Ra_sp := h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
      have hδ₁_Rδ_sp : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ Rδ_sp := h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
      have hδq_Rδ_sp : (δ_q : ℂ) ∈ Rδ_sp := h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
      let O_seed := Ra_sp ×ˢ trapCrect δ₁ δ₁ η_sp
      have hO_seed_open : IsOpen O_seed := (h_crect_open _ _ _).prod (h_crect_open _ _ _)
      have hp₁_O_seed : p₁ ∈ O_seed := ⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩⟩
      have hO_seed_sub_W₀ : O_seed ⊆ W₀ :=
        (Set.prod_mono
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))).trans hseed_sub_W₀
      have hO_seed_sub_Qsp : O_seed ⊆ Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp :=
        Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl (h_crect_mono (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl)
      have hv₀_sp_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun a => V₀ (a, (δ₁ : ℂ)) idx) Ra_sp :=
        fun idx => (hV₀_holo idx).comp
          (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn
          (fun a ha => hO_seed_sub_W₀ ⟨ha, h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩⟩)
      obtain ⟨V_sp, hV_sp_holo, hV_sp_init, hV_sp_ode_δ⟩ :=
        hODE.solve_param_D ι Ra_sp Rδ_sp
          (h_crect_open _ _ _) (h_crect_open _ _ _) (h_crect_conv _ _ _)
          (δ₁ : ℂ) hδ₁_Rδ_sp M_δ c_δ (fun a => V₀ (a, (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun idx j => (hMδ_holo idx j).mono hQ_sp_sub)
          (fun idx => (hcδ_holo idx).mono hQ_sp_sub)
          hv₀_sp_holo
      have hV_sp_eq_V₀ : ∀ p ∈ O_seed, V_sp p = V₀ p := by
        rintro ⟨a, δ⟩ ⟨ha, hδ⟩
        have hδ_in_sp : trapCrect δ₁ δ₁ η_sp ⊆ Rδ_sp :=
          h_crect_mono (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl
        exact hODE.unique_1D ι (trapCrect δ₁ δ₁ η_sp)
          (h_crect_open _ _ _) (h_crect_conv _ _ _)
          (δ₁ : ℂ) (h_crect_real hη_sp ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩)
          (fun ζ => M_δ (a, ζ)) (fun ζ => c_δ (a, ζ))
          (fun ζ => V_sp (a, ζ)) (fun ζ => V₀ (a, ζ))
          (fun idx j => (hMδ_holo idx j).continuousOn.comp
            (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
            (fun ζ hζ => hQ_sp_sub ⟨ha, hδ_in_sp hζ⟩))
          (fun idx => (hV_sp_holo idx).comp
            ((differentiable_const a).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun ζ hζ => ⟨ha, hδ_in_sp hζ⟩))
          (fun idx => (hV₀_holo idx).comp
            ((differentiable_const a).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun ζ hζ => hO_seed_sub_W₀ ⟨ha, hζ⟩))
          (hV_sp_init a ha)
          (fun ζ hζ idx => hV_sp_ode_δ a ha ζ (hδ_in_sp hζ) idx)
          (fun ζ hζ idx => (hV₀_pde (a, ζ) (hO_seed_sub_W₀ ⟨ha, hζ⟩) idx).2)
          δ hδ
      have hV_sp_pde_a : ∀ p ∈ Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp, ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivA (fun q => V_sp q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V_sp p) + c_a p) idx := by
        intro p hp idx
        let R_res : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
          pderivA (fun p' => V_sp p' idx) q - ((M_a q).mulVec (V_sp q) + c_a q) idx
        have hQ_open : IsOpen (Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp) := (h_crect_open _ _ _).prod (h_crect_open _ _ _)
        have hQ_pre : IsPreconnected (Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp) :=
          ((h_crect_conv _ _ _).prod (h_crect_conv _ _ _)).isPreconnected
        have hR_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_res (Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp) := by
          refine (hKit.pderiv_holo hQ_open (hV_sp_holo idx)).1.sub ?_
          intro q hq
          refine DifferentiableWithinAt.add ?_ ((hca_holo idx).mono hQ_sp_sub q hq)
          exact DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
            ((hMa_holo idx j).mono hQ_sp_sub q hq).mul (hV_sp_holo j q hq))
        have hR_zero_seed : ∀ q ∈ O_seed, R_res q = 0 := by
          intro q hq
          have hpderiv_eq := (h_local_pderiv hO_seed_open (fun p' hp' => congr_fun (hV_sp_eq_V₀ p' hp') idx) q hq).1
          simp only [R_res, hpderiv_eq, hV_sp_eq_V₀ q hq, (hV₀_pde q (hO_seed_sub_W₀ hq) idx).1, sub_self]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp
          (hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hQ_open hQ_pre hO_seed_open ⟨p₁, hp₁_O_seed⟩
            hO_seed_sub_Qsp hR_holo hR_zero_seed p hp)

      have h_sw_box : ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc (min a₁ a_q) (max a₁ a_q), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc δ_q δ_q,
          ((a : ℂ), (y : ℂ)) ∈ U_ode := by
        intro a ha y hy
        have hy_eq : y = δ_q := le_antisymm hy.2 hy.1
        rw [hy_eq]
        refine hcov (a, δ_q) ?_
        refine ⟨hδq_pos, hδq_lt, ?_⟩
        have hmul : C₀ * δ_q < C₀ * δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδq_lt hC₀
        have ha₁_at_q : |a₁ - a₀| < R - C₀ * δ_q := by linarith
        have haq_at_q : |a_q - a₀| < R - C₀ * δ_q := haq_abs
        rw [abs_lt] at ha₁_at_q haq_at_q ⊢
        have hmin : min a₁ a_q ≤ a := ha.1
        have hmax : a ≤ max a₁ a_q := ha.2
        dsimp only
        constructor
        · rcases min_cases a₁ a_q with ⟨h_eq, _⟩ | ⟨h_eq, _⟩ <;> linarith
        · rcases max_cases a₁ a_q with ⟨h_eq, _⟩ | ⟨h_eq, _⟩ <;> linarith
      obtain ⟨η_sw_raw, hη_sw_raw, hQ_sw_raw⟩ :=
        h_thicken_box (min_le_max) le_rfl h_sw_box
      set η_q := min η_sw_raw η_sp
      have hη_q : 0 < η_q := lt_min hη_sw_raw hη_sp
      let Ra_sw := trapCrect (min a₁ a_q) (max a₁ a_q) η_q
      let Rδ_sw := trapCrect δ_q δ_q η_q
      have hQ_sw_sub : Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw ⊆ U_ode :=
        (Set.prod_mono
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))
          (h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))).trans hQ_sw_raw
      have hRδ_sw_sub_sp : Rδ_sw ⊆ Rδ_sp :=
        h_crect_mono (min_le_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      have ha₁_Ra_sw : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ Ra_sw := h_crect_real hη_q ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
      have haq_Ra_sw : (a_q : ℂ) ∈ Ra_sw := h_crect_real hη_q ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
      have hδq_Rδ_sw : (δ_q : ℂ) ∈ Rδ_sw := h_crect_real hη_q ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
      let γ_sp : ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun δ => V_sp ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)
      have hγ_sp_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun δ => γ_sp δ idx) Rδ_sp :=
        fun idx => (hV_sp_holo idx).comp
          ((differentiable_const (a₁ : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
          (fun δ hδ => ⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, hδ⟩)
      obtain ⟨V_sw, hV_sw_holo, hV_sw_init, hV_sw_ode_a⟩ :=
        hODE.solve_param_A ι Ra_sw Rδ_sw
          (h_crect_open _ _ _) (h_crect_conv _ _ _) (h_crect_open _ _ _)
          (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_Ra_sw M_a c_a γ_sp
          (fun idx j => (hMa_holo idx j).mono hQ_sw_sub)
          (fun idx => (hca_holo idx).mono hQ_sw_sub)
          (fun idx => (hγ_sp_holo idx).mono hRδ_sw_sub_sp)
      let O_neck := trapCrect a₁ a₁ η_q ×ˢ Rδ_sw
      have hO_neck_open : IsOpen O_neck := (h_crect_open _ _ _).prod (h_crect_open _ _ _)
      have hpt_neck : ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ_q : ℂ)) ∈ O_neck :=
        ⟨h_crect_real hη_q ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩, hδq_Rδ_sw⟩
      have hRa_q_sub_sp : trapCrect a₁ a₁ η_q ⊆ Ra_sp :=
        h_crect_mono le_rfl le_rfl (min_le_right _ _)
      have hRa_q_sub_sw : trapCrect a₁ a₁ η_q ⊆ Ra_sw :=
        h_crect_mono (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl
      have hO_neck_sub_Qsp : O_neck ⊆ Ra_sp ×ˢ Rδ_sp := Set.prod_mono hRa_q_sub_sp hRδ_sw_sub_sp
      have hO_neck_sub_Qsw : O_neck ⊆ Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw := Set.prod_mono hRa_q_sub_sw Subset.rfl
      have hV_sw_eq_sp : ∀ p ∈ O_neck, V_sw p = V_sp p := by
        rintro ⟨a, δ⟩ ⟨ha, hδ⟩
        exact hODE.unique_1D ι (trapCrect a₁ a₁ η_q)
          (h_crect_open _ _ _) (h_crect_conv _ _ _)
          (a₁ : ℂ) (h_crect_real hη_q ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩)
          (fun ζ => M_a (ζ, δ)) (fun ζ => c_a (ζ, δ))
          (fun ζ => V_sw (ζ, δ)) (fun ζ => V_sp (ζ, δ))
          (fun idx j => (hMa_holo idx j).continuousOn.comp
            (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun ζ hζ => hQ_sw_sub ⟨hRa_q_sub_sw hζ, hδ⟩))
          (fun idx => (hV_sw_holo idx).comp
            (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const δ)).differentiableOn
            (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hRa_q_sub_sw hζ, hδ⟩))
          (fun idx => (hV_sp_holo idx).comp
            (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const δ)).differentiableOn
            (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hRa_q_sub_sp hζ, hRδ_sw_sub_sp hδ⟩))
          (hV_sw_init δ hδ)
          (fun ζ hζ idx => hV_sw_ode_a ζ (hRa_q_sub_sw hζ) δ hδ idx)
          (fun ζ hζ idx => hV_sp_pde_a (ζ, δ) ⟨hRa_q_sub_sp hζ, hRδ_sw_sub_sp hδ⟩ idx)
          a ha
      have hV_sw_pde_δ : ∀ p ∈ Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw, ∀ idx : ι,
          pderivD (fun q => V_sw q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (V_sw p) + c_δ p) idx := by
        intro p hp idx
        let R_res : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
          pderivD (fun p' => V_sw p' idx) q - ((M_δ q).mulVec (V_sw q) + c_δ q) idx
        have hQ_open : IsOpen (Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw) := (h_crect_open _ _ _).prod (h_crect_open _ _ _)
        have hQ_pre : IsPreconnected (Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw) :=
          ((h_crect_conv _ _ _).prod (h_crect_conv _ _ _)).isPreconnected
        have hR_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_res (Ra_sw ×ˢ Rδ_sw) := by
          refine (hKit.pderiv_holo hQ_open (hV_sw_holo idx)).2.sub ?_
          intro q hq
          refine DifferentiableWithinAt.add ?_ ((hcδ_holo idx).mono hQ_sw_sub q hq)
          exact DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
            ((hMδ_holo idx j).mono hQ_sw_sub q hq).mul (hV_sw_holo j q hq))
        have hR_zero_neck : ∀ q ∈ O_neck, R_res q = 0 := by
          intro q hq
          have hpderiv_eq := (h_local_pderiv hO_neck_open (fun p' hp' => congr_fun (hV_sw_eq_sp p' hp') idx) q hq).2
          have hq_sp := hO_neck_sub_Qsp hq
          simp only [R_res, hpderiv_eq, hV_sw_eq_sp q hq, hV_sp_ode_δ q.1 hq_sp.1 q.2 hq_sp.2 idx, sub_self]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp
          (hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hQ_open hQ_pre hO_neck_open
            ⟨((a₁ : ℂ), (δ_q : ℂ)), hpt_neck⟩ hO_neck_sub_Qsw hR_holo hR_zero_neck p hp)

      let C_sp : TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init := {
        R_a := Ra_sp
        R_δ := Rδ_sp
        R_δ_spine := Rδ_sp
        γ := γ_sp
        W := V_sp
        hRa_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRa_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        hRδ_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRδ_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        hRδ_sp_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRδ_sp_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        ha₁_mem := ha₁_Ra_sp
        hδ₁_mem := hδ₁_Rδ_sp
        hRδ_sub_sp := Subset.rfl
        hsp_sub_U := fun δ hδ => hQ_sp_sub ⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, hδ⟩
        hrect_sub_U := hQ_sp_sub
        hγ_holo := hγ_sp_holo
        hγ_init := hV_sp_init (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_Ra_sp
        hγ_ode := fun δ hδ idx => hV_sp_ode_δ (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_Ra_sp δ hδ idx
        hW_holo := hV_sp_holo
        hW_spine := fun _ _ => rfl
        hW_pde_a := hV_sp_pde_a
        hW_pde_δ := fun p hp idx => hV_sp_ode_δ p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 idx
      }
      let C_sw : TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init := {
        R_a := Ra_sw
        R_δ := Rδ_sw
        R_δ_spine := Rδ_sp
        γ := γ_sp
        W := V_sw
        hRa_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRa_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        hRδ_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRδ_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        hRδ_sp_open := h_crect_open _ _ _
        hRδ_sp_conv := h_crect_conv _ _ _
        ha₁_mem := ha₁_Ra_sw
        hδ₁_mem := hδ₁_Rδ_sp
        hRδ_sub_sp := hRδ_sw_sub_sp
        hsp_sub_U := fun δ hδ => hQ_sp_sub ⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, hδ⟩
        hrect_sub_U := hQ_sw_sub
        hγ_holo := hγ_sp_holo
        hγ_init := hV_sp_init (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_Ra_sp
        hγ_ode := fun δ hδ idx => hV_sp_ode_δ (a₁ : ℂ) ha₁_Ra_sp δ hδ idx
        hW_holo := hV_sw_holo
        hW_spine := fun δ hδ => hV_sw_init δ hδ
        hW_pde_a := fun p hp idx => hV_sw_ode_a p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2 idx
        hW_pde_δ := hV_sw_pde_δ
      }
      exact ⟨C_sp, C_sw, O_seed, ⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, hδ₁_Rδ_sp⟩,
        ⟨⟨ha₁_Ra_sp, hδq_Rδ_sp⟩, ⟨ha₁_Ra_sw, hδq_Rδ_sw⟩⟩,
        ⟨haq_Ra_sw, hδq_Rδ_sw⟩,
        hO_seed_open, hp₁_O_seed, hO_seed_sub_Qsp, hV_sp_eq_V₀⟩

    let C_sp_fn : Trap → TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init :=
      fun q => Classical.choose (h_charts_exist q)
    let C_sw_fn : Trap → TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init :=
      fun q => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_charts_exist q))
    let O_seed_fn : Trap → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      fun q => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_charts_exist q)))
    have h_spec : ∀ q : Trap,
        p₁ ∈ (C_sp_fn q).R_a ×ˢ (C_sp_fn q).R_δ ∧
        ((a₁ : ℂ), (q.1.2 : ℂ)) ∈
          ((C_sp_fn q).R_a ×ˢ (C_sp_fn q).R_δ) ∩ ((C_sw_fn q).R_a ×ˢ (C_sw_fn q).R_δ) ∧
        ((q.1.1 : ℂ), (q.1.2 : ℂ)) ∈ (C_sw_fn q).R_a ×ˢ (C_sw_fn q).R_δ ∧
        IsOpen (O_seed_fn q) ∧ p₁ ∈ O_seed_fn q ∧
        O_seed_fn q ⊆ (C_sp_fn q).R_a ×ˢ (C_sp_fn q).R_δ ∧
        (∀ p ∈ O_seed_fn q, (C_sp_fn q).W p = V₀ p) :=
      fun q => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_charts_exist q)))

    let chartFn : Trap × Bool → TrapPDE_AnchoredChart a₁ δ₁ U_ode M_a M_δ c_a c_δ v_init :=
      fun c => if c.2 then C_sw_fn c.1 else C_sp_fn c.1
    let U_chart : Trap × Bool → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      fun c => (chartFn c).R_a ×ˢ (chartFn c).R_δ
    let V_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ c : Trap × Bool, U_chart c

    have hU_chart_open : ∀ c : Trap × Bool, IsOpen (U_chart c) :=
      fun c => (chartFn c).hRa_open.prod (chartFn c).hRδ_open
    have hV_ode_open : IsOpen V_ode := isOpen_iUnion hU_chart_open
    have hV_ode_sub : V_ode ⊆ U_ode :=
      Set.iUnion_subset (fun c => (chartFn c).hrect_sub_U)

    let q₁ : Trap := ⟨(a₁, δ₁), hq₁_trap⟩

    have hV_ode_eq_L : V_ode = ⋃ q : Trap, (U_chart (q, false) ∪ U_chart (q, true)) := by
      ext p
      simp only [V_ode, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_union, Prod.exists, Bool.exists_bool]
    have hV_ode_pre : IsPreconnected V_ode := by
      rw [hV_ode_eq_L]
      refine isPreconnected_iUnion ⟨p₁, Set.mem_iInter.mpr (fun q => Or.inl (h_spec q).1)⟩ (fun q => ?_)
      have hsp_pre : IsPreconnected (U_chart (q, false)) :=
        ((C_sp_fn q).hRa_conv.prod (C_sp_fn q).hRδ_conv).isPreconnected
      have hsw_pre : IsPreconnected (U_chart (q, true)) :=
        ((C_sw_fn q).hRa_conv.prod (C_sw_fn q).hRδ_conv).isPreconnected
      exact IsPreconnected.union ((a₁ : ℂ), (q.1.2 : ℂ))
        (h_spec q).2.1.1 (h_spec q).2.1.2 hsp_pre hsw_pre

    have hV_ode_cov : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_ode := by
      intro q hq
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(⟨q, hq⟩, true), (h_spec ⟨q, hq⟩).2.2.1⟩

    classical
    let V : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ) := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ V_ode then (chartFn (Classical.choose (Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp))).W p else 0

    have hV_eq_chart : ∀ (c : Trap × Bool) {p : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ U_chart c → V p = (chartFn c).W p := by
      intro c p hp
      have hp_V : p ∈ V_ode := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨c, hp⟩
      simp only [V, hp_V, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact h_chart_agree _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp_V)) hp

    have hV_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => V p idx) V_ode := by
      intro idx p hp
      obtain ⟨c, hp_c⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
      have hev : (fun q => V q idx) =ᶠ[nhds p] (fun q => (chartFn c).W q idx) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hU_chart_open c).mem_nhds hp_c)
          (fun q hq => congr_fun (hV_eq_chart c hq) idx)
      exact (hev.differentiableAt_iff.mpr
        (((chartFn c).hW_holo idx p hp_c).differentiableAt ((hU_chart_open c).mem_nhds hp_c))).differentiableWithinAt

    have hV_pde : ∀ p ∈ V_ode, ∀ idx : ι,
        pderivA (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (V p) + c_a p) idx ∧
        pderivD (fun q => V q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (V p) + c_δ p) idx := by
      intro p hp idx
      obtain ⟨c, hp_c⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
      have hpderiv := h_local_pderiv (hU_chart_open c)
        (fun q hq => congr_fun (hV_eq_chart c hq) idx) p hp_c
      rw [hpderiv.1, hpderiv.2, hV_eq_chart c hp_c]
      exact ⟨(chartFn c).hW_pde_a p hp_c idx, (chartFn c).hW_pde_δ p hp_c idx⟩

    let W_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := O_seed_fn q₁
    have hWeq_open : IsOpen W_eq := (h_spec q₁).2.2.2.1
    have hp₁_Weq : p₁ ∈ W_eq := (h_spec q₁).2.2.2.2.1
    have hWeq_sub_chart : W_eq ⊆ U_chart (q₁, false) := (h_spec q₁).2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hWeq_sub_Vode : W_eq ⊆ V_ode :=
      fun p hp => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(q₁, false), hWeq_sub_chart hp⟩
    have hWeq_eq : ∀ p ∈ W_eq, V p = V₀ p := by
      intro p hp
      exact (hV_eq_chart (q₁, false) (hWeq_sub_chart hp)).trans ((h_spec q₁).2.2.2.2.2.2 p hp)

    exact ⟨V_ode, V, W_eq, hV_ode_open, hV_ode_pre, hV_ode_sub, hV_ode_cov,
      hV_holo, hWeq_open, hp₁_Weq, hWeq_sub_Vode, hWeq_eq, hV_pde⟩

  
  
  
  refine ⟨V_ode, V, hV_ode_open, hV_ode_pre, hV_ode_sub, hV_ode_cov, hV_holo, ?_, hV_pde⟩
  intro idx
  have hcongr : taylor2D (fun p => V p idx) p₁ = taylor2D (fun p => V₀ p idx) p₁ :=
    hKit.taylor2D_congr hWeq_open hp₁_Weq (fun p hp => congr_fun (hWeq_eq p hp) idx)
  exact hcongr.trans (hV₀_taylor idx)

trapezoid_linear_pde_continuation.definitions:
noncomputable def trapPDE_seg (z₀ z : ℂ) (s : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (1 - s) • z₀ + s • z

noncomputable def trapPDE_picardIter {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (z₀ : ℂ) (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) :
    ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  | 0, p => v₀ p.1
  | n + 1, p => fun idx =>
      v₀ p.1 idx +
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (p.2 - z₀) *
            (((M (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)).mulVec
                (trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ n (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)) +
              c (p.1, trapPDE_seg z₀ p.2 s)) idx)

noncomputable def trapPDE_picardSol {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (z₀ : ℂ) (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ))
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) (idx : ι) : ℂ :=
  v₀ p.1 idx +
    ∑' n : ℕ,
      (trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ (n + 1) p idx -
        trapPDE_picardIter z₀ M c v₀ n p idx)

structure TrapPDE_ODEKit : Prop where
  solve_param_D :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_par Ω_z : Set ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω_par → IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => v₀ w idx) Ω_par) →
        ∃ u : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ),
          (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_par ×ˢ Ω_z)) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (w, z₀) = v₀ w) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
            pderivD (fun q => u q idx) (w, z) =
              ((M (w, z)).mulVec (u (w, z)) + c (w, z)) idx)
  solve_param_A :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_z Ω_par : Set ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z → IsOpen Ω_par →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (v₀ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => M p idx j) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c p idx) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => v₀ w idx) Ω_par) →
        ∃ u : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ),
          (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => u p idx) (Ω_z ×ˢ Ω_par)) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Ω_par, u (z₀, w) = v₀ w) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ w ∈ Ω_par, ∀ idx : ι,
            pderivA (fun q => u q idx) (z, w) =
              ((M (z, w)).mulVec (u (z, w)) + c (z, w)) idx)
  unique_1D :
    ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      (Ω_z : Set ℂ), IsOpen Ω_z → Convex ℝ Ω_z →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ), z₀ ∈ Ω_z →
      ∀ (M_z : ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (c_z : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)) (u₁ u₂ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)),
        (∀ idx j : ι, ContinuousOn (fun z => M_z z idx j) Ω_z) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u₁ z idx) Ω_z) →
        (∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => u₂ z idx) Ω_z) →
        u₁ z₀ = u₂ z₀ →
        (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          deriv (fun ζ => u₁ ζ idx) z = ((M_z z).mulVec (u₁ z) + c_z z) idx) →
        (∀ z ∈ Ω_z, ∀ idx : ι,
          deriv (fun ζ => u₂ ζ idx) z = ((M_z z).mulVec (u₂ z) + c_z z) idx) →
        ∀ z ∈ Ω_z, u₁ z = u₂ z

def trapCrect (x_lo x_hi η : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | x_lo - η < z.re ∧ z.re < x_hi + η ∧ |z.im| < η }

structure TrapPDE_AnchoredChart {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (U_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (M_a M_δ : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (c_a c_δ : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ))
    (v_init : ι → ℂ) where
  R_a : Set ℂ
  R_δ : Set ℂ
  R_δ_spine : Set ℂ
  γ : ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  W : ℂ × ℂ → (ι → ℂ)
  hRa_open : IsOpen R_a
  hRa_conv : Convex ℝ R_a
  hRδ_open : IsOpen R_δ
  hRδ_conv : Convex ℝ R_δ
  hRδ_sp_open : IsOpen R_δ_spine
  hRδ_sp_conv : Convex ℝ R_δ_spine
  ha₁_mem : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ R_a
  hδ₁_mem : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ R_δ_spine
  hRδ_sub_sp : R_δ ⊆ R_δ_spine
  hsp_sub_U : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ_spine, ((a₁ : ℂ), δ) ∈ U_ode
  hrect_sub_U : R_a ×ˢ R_δ ⊆ U_ode
  hγ_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun δ => γ δ idx) R_δ_spine
  hγ_init : γ (δ₁ : ℂ) = v_init
  hγ_ode : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ_spine, ∀ idx : ι,
    deriv (fun ζ => γ ζ idx) δ =
      ((M_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)).mulVec (γ δ) + c_δ ((a₁ : ℂ), δ)) idx
  hW_holo : ∀ idx : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => W p idx) (R_a ×ˢ R_δ)
  hW_spine : ∀ δ ∈ R_δ, W ((a₁ : ℂ), δ) = γ δ
