  hW_pde_a : ∀ p ∈ R_a ×ˢ R_δ, ∀ idx : ι,
    pderivA (fun q => W q idx) p = ((M_a p).mulVec (W p) + c_a p) idx
  hW_pde_δ : ∀ p ∈ R_a ×ˢ R_δ, ∀ idx : ι,
    pderivD (fun q => W q idx) p = ((M_δ p).mulVec (W p) + c_δ p) idx

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hKit : Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit)
    (a₀ R δ_star C₀ : ℝ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hδ_star : 0 < δ_star) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
    (hC₀δ : C₀ * δ_star < R / 2)
    (U₀ V_ode : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hU₀ : IsOpen U₀) (hV_ode : IsOpen V_ode)
    (hV_sub : V_ode ⊆ U₀)
    (hU₀_cov : ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀)
    (hV_cov : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_ode)
    (ψ F₀ : Fin m → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hψ_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ψ i) U₀)
    (hF₀_holo : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F₀ i) V_ode)
    (hψ_base : ∀ i : Fin m, ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star,
      (ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).im = 0 ∧
      |(ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re - q.1| ≤ C₀ * q.2 ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ (pderivA (ψ i) ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re)
    (hcross : ∀ i : Fin m, ∀ p ∈ V_ode,
      pderivD (ψ i) p * pderivA (F₀ i) p = pderivA (ψ i) p * pderivD (F₀ i) p) :
    ∃ (W_ψ : Set ℂ) (V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W_ψ ∧ IsPreconnected W_ψ ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ) ∧
      IsOpen V_plus ∧ IsPreconnected V_plus ∧ V_plus ⊆ V_ode ∧
      (∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) W_ψ) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ V_plus,
        (∀ i : Fin m, ψ i p ∈ W_ψ) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin m, g i (ψ i p) = F₀ i p))

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hm
  let _ := hU₀
  let _ := hU₀_cov
  
  have exists_preconn_nhd :
      ∀ {E : Type} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {S U : Set E},
        IsPreconnected S → IsOpen U → S ⊆ U →
        ∃ V : Set E, IsOpen V ∧ IsPreconnected V ∧ S ⊆ V ∧ V ⊆ U := by
    intro E _ _ S U hS hU hSU
    choose r hr_pos hr_sub using fun x : S => Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x.1 (hSU x.2)
    let V : Set E := ⋃ x : S, Metric.ball (x : E) (r x)
    have hSV : S ⊆ V := by
      intro y hy
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos ⟨y, hy⟩)⟩
    refine ⟨V, isOpen_iUnion (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball), ?_, hSV, Set.iUnion_subset hr_sub⟩
    intro u v hu hv hVuv ⟨y₁, hy₁V, hy₁u⟩ ⟨y₂, hy₂V, hy₂v⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy₁V with ⟨x₁, hy₁B⟩
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy₂V with ⟨x₂, hy₂B⟩
    by_contra h_disj
    have hx_not_both :
        ∀ x : S, ¬ ((Metric.ball (x : E) (r x) ∩ u).Nonempty ∧
          (Metric.ball (x : E) (r x) ∩ v).Nonempty) := by
      intro x ⟨hbu, hbv⟩
      have hBx_sub : Metric.ball (x : E) (r x) ⊆ V :=
        Set.subset_iUnion (fun y : S => Metric.ball (y : E) (r y)) x
      obtain ⟨z, hzB, hzuv⟩ :=
        (convex_ball (x : E) (r x)).isPreconnected u v hu hv (hBx_sub.trans hVuv) hbu hbv
      exact h_disj ⟨z, hBx_sub hzB, hzuv⟩
    have hx₁_mem_V : (x₁ : E) ∈ V := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos x₁)⟩
    have hx₂_mem_V : (x₂ : E) ∈ V := Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x₂, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos x₂)⟩
    have hx₁_u : (x₁ : E) ∈ u := by
      rcases hVuv hx₁_mem_V with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact False.elim
          (hx_not_both x₁ ⟨⟨y₁, hy₁B, hy₁u⟩, ⟨x₁.1, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos x₁), h⟩⟩)
    have hx₂_v : (x₂ : E) ∈ v := by
      rcases hVuv hx₂_mem_V with h | h
      · exact False.elim
          (hx_not_both x₂ ⟨⟨x₂.1, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_pos x₂), h⟩, ⟨y₂, hy₂B, hy₂v⟩⟩)
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨z, hzS, hzuv⟩ :=
      hS u v hu hv (hSV.trans hVuv) ⟨x₁.1, x₁.2, hx₁_u⟩ ⟨x₂.1, x₂.2, hx₂_v⟩
    exact h_disj ⟨z, hSV hzS, hzuv⟩
  
  let rectC : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun c rx ry => { z : ℂ | |z.re - c| < rx ∧ |z.im| < ry }
  have hrect_open_conv :
      ∀ (c rx ry : ℝ), IsOpen (rectC c rx ry) ∧ Convex ℝ (rectC c rx ry) := by
    intro c rx ry
    have h_eq :

    rintro w ⟨hw_W0, hw_pre⟩
    have hψ_ι : ψ i (ι₀ w) = w := (hWn_inv i 0 w hw_W0).2.1
    have hsp := hΩ_sp_prop i n (ι₀ w) hw_pre
    calc
      g_n i n w = g_n i n (ψ i (ι₀ w)) := by rw [hψ_ι]
      _ = F₀ i (ι₀ w) := hsp.2.1
      _ = g_n i 0 (ψ i (ι₀ w)) := hsp.2.2.symm
      _ = g_n i 0 w := by rw [hψ_ι]
  have hg_compat :
      ∀ (i : Fin m) (k n : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ W_n i k ∩ W_n i n, g_n i k w = g_n i n w := by
    intro i k n
    let W_kn : Set ℂ := W_n i k ∩ W_n i n
    have hWkn_open : IsOpen W_kn := (hWn_open i k).inter (hWn_open i n)
    have hWkn_pre : IsPreconnected W_kn := ((hWn_conv i k).inter (hWn_conv i n)).isPreconnected
    have hw₀_Wkn : w₀ i ∈ W_kn := ⟨hw₀_mem i k, hw₀_mem i n⟩
    have hgk_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (g_n i k) W_kn :=
      ((hg_n_holo i k).mono Set.inter_subset_left).analyticOnNhd hWkn_open
    have hgn_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (g_n i n) W_kn :=
      ((hg_n_holo i n).mono Set.inter_subset_right).analyticOnNhd hWkn_open
    exact hgk_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hgn_ana hWkn_pre hw₀_Wkn
      ((hg_ev_zero i k).trans (hg_ev_zero i n).symm)
  
  let U_i : Fin m → Set ℂ := fun i => ⋃ n : ℕ, W_n i n
  have hUi_open : ∀ i : Fin m, IsOpen (U_i i) := fun i =>
    isOpen_iUnion (fun n => hWn_open i n)
  classical
  let g : Fin m → ℂ → ℂ := fun i w =>
    if hw : ∃ n : ℕ, w ∈ W_n i n then g_n i (Classical.choose hw) w else 0
  have hg_eq_on_Wn : ∀ (i : Fin m) (n : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ W_n i n, g i w = g_n i n w := by
    intro i n w hw
    have hex : ∃ k : ℕ, w ∈ W_n i k := ⟨n, hw⟩
    dsimp [g]
    simp only [hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact hg_compat i (Classical.choose hex) n w ⟨Classical.choose_spec hex, hw⟩
  have hg_holo_Ui : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) (U_i i) := by
    intro i w hw
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hw with ⟨n, hwn⟩
    have hev : g i =ᶠ[nhds w] g_n i n :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hWn_open i n).mem_nhds hwn) (fun y hy => hg_eq_on_Wn i n y hy)
    exact (((hg_n_holo i n).differentiableAt ((hWn_open i n).mem_nhds hwn)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      hev).differentiableWithinAt
  have hUi_cov : ∀ (i : Fin m) (x : ℝ), |x - a₀| < R → (x : ℂ) ∈ U_i i := by
    intro i x hx
    have hgap : 0 < R - |x - a₀| := sub_pos.mpr hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (3 * (C₀ * δ₀) / (R - |x - a₀|))
    have hn1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have h_lt1 : 3 * (C₀ * δ₀) / (R - |x - a₀|) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h_mul : 3 * (C₀ * δ₀) < (R - |x - a₀|) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      linarith [(div_lt_iff₀ hgap).mp h_lt1]
    have h_3C : 3 * (C₀ * δ_n n) < R - |x - a₀| := by
      have h_eq : 3 * (C₀ * δ_n n) = 3 * (C₀ * δ₀) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        dsimp [δ_n]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, div_lt_iff₀ hn1_pos]
      exact h_mul
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.ofReal_re]
      dsimp [R'_n]
      linarith [hρ_pos i n]
    · simp [hρ_pos i n]
  
  let U_all : Set ℂ := ⋂ i : Fin m, U_i i
  have hUall_open : IsOpen U_all := isOpen_iInter_of_finite hUi_open
  let I_ℂ : Set ℂ := Complex.ofReal '' Set.Ioo (a₀ - R) (a₀ + R)
  have hI_pre : IsPreconnected I_ℂ :=
    (convex_Ioo (a₀ - R) (a₀ + R)).isPreconnected.image _ Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn
  have hI_sub : I_ℂ ⊆ U_all := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine Set.mem_iInter.mpr (fun i => hUi_cov i x ?_)
    rw [abs_lt]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hx.1], by linarith [hx.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨W_ψ, hW_open, hW_pre, hI_W, hW_Uall⟩ := exists_preconn_nhd hI_pre hUall_open hI_sub
  have hW_cov : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_lt := abs_lt.mp hx
    exact hI_W ⟨x, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩
  have hg_holo_W : ∀ i : Fin m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) W_ψ := fun i =>
    (hg_holo_Ui i).mono (hW_Uall.trans (Set.iInter_subset _ i))
  
  have htrap_conv : Convex ℝ (webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀) := by
    intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂ ht₁₂
    by_cases ht₁_zero : t₁ = 0
    · have ht₂_one : t₂ = 1 := by linarith
      simpa [ht₁_zero, ht₂_one] using hq₂
    · have ht₁_pos : 0 < t₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne ht₁ (Ne.symm ht₁_zero)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
        exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos ht₁_pos hq₁.1) (mul_nonneg ht₂ (le_of_lt hq₂.1))
      · simp only [Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
        have h1 : t₁ * q₁.2 < t₁ * δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq₁.2.1 ht₁_pos
        have h2 : t₂ * q₂.2 ≤ t₂ * δ_star := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq₂.2.1) ht₂
        calc
          t₁ * q₁.2 + t₂ * q₂.2 < t₁ * δ_star + t₂ * δ_star := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
          _ = (t₁ + t₂) * δ_star := by ring
          _ = δ_star := by rw [ht₁₂, one_mul]
      · simp only [Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.snd_add, smul_eq_mul]
        have h_rew : (t₁ * q₁.1 + t₂ * q₂.1) - a₀ = t₁ * (q₁.1 - a₀) + t₂ * (q₂.1 - a₀) := by
          linear_combination a₀ * ht₁₂
        rw [h_rew]
        have h_tri := abs_add_le (t₁ * (q₁.1 - a₀)) (t₂ * (q₂.1 - a₀))
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht₁, abs_of_nonneg ht₂] at h_tri
        have h1 : t₁ * |q₁.1 - a₀| < t₁ * (R - C₀ * q₁.2) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq₁.2.2 ht₁_pos
        have h2 : t₂ * |q₂.1 - a₀| ≤ t₂ * (R - C₀ * q₂.2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq₂.2.2) ht₂
        calc
          |t₁ * (q₁.1 - a₀) + t₂ * (q₂.1 - a₀)| ≤ t₁ * |q₁.1 - a₀| + t₂ * |q₂.1 - a₀| := h_tri
          _ < t₁ * (R - C₀ * q₁.2) + t₂ * (R - C₀ * q₂.2) := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
          _ = (t₁ + t₂) * R - C₀ * (t₁ * q₁.2 + t₂ * q₂.2) := by ring
          _ = R - C₀ * (t₁ * q₁.2 + t₂ * q₂.2) := by rw [ht₁₂, one_mul]
  let T_ℂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))) '' webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀
  have hT_pre : IsPreconnected T_ℂ :=
    htrap_conv.isPreconnected.image _
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd)).continuousOn
  let U_good : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V_ode ∩ ⋂ i : Fin m, (V_ode ∩ ψ i ⁻¹' W_ψ)
  have hUgood_open : IsOpen U_good :=
    hV_ode.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun i =>
      ((hψ_holo i).mono hV_sub).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hV_ode hW_open))
  have hT_sub : T_ℂ ⊆ U_good := by
    rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hV_cov q hq, Set.mem_iInter.mpr (fun i => ⟨hV_cov q hq, ?_⟩)⟩
    have hq_base : q ∈ webBaseClosure a₀ R δ_star := by
      refine ⟨le_of_lt hq.1, hq.2.1, ?_⟩
      have hCq : 0 < C₀ * q.2 := mul_pos hC₀ hq.1
      linarith [hq.2.2]
    have hb := hψ_base i q hq_base
    have hψ_real :
        ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) = (((ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp
      · simpa using hb.1
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hψ_real]
    refine hW_cov _ ?_
    have h_tri := abs_sub_le (ψ i ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))).re q.1 a₀
    linarith [hb.2.1, hq.2.2]
  obtain ⟨V_plus, hVp_open, hVp_pre, hT_Vp, hVp_Ugood⟩ :=
    exists_preconn_nhd hT_pre hUgood_open hT_sub
  have hVp_sub : V_plus ⊆ V_ode := hVp_Ugood.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  have hVp_cov : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid a₀ R δ_star C₀, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus :=
    fun q hq => hT_Vp ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  have hVp_maps : ∀ p ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin m, ψ i p ∈ W_ψ := fun p hp i =>
    ((Set.mem_iInter.mp (hVp_Ugood hp).2) i).2
  
  have hp0_Vp : ((a₀ : ℂ), (δ_n 0 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus := by
    rw [hδn_zero]
    refine hVp_cov (a₀, δ₀) ⟨hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_lt, ?_⟩
    simp only [sub_self, abs_zero]
    linarith
  have hVp_eq : ∀ i : Fin m, ∀ p ∈ V_plus, g i (ψ i p) = F₀ i p := by
    intro i p hp
    let V_ov : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V_plus ∩ Ω_sp i 0
    have hVov_open : IsOpen V_ov := hVp_open.inter (hΩ_sp_open i 0)
    have hVov_ne : V_ov.Nonempty := ⟨((a₀ : ℂ), (δ_n 0 : ℂ)), hp0_Vp, hp0_Ω_sp i 0⟩
    let H_i : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => g i (ψ i q) - F₀ i q
    have hHi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_i V_plus :=
      ((hg_holo_W i).comp ((hψ_holo i).mono (hVp_sub.trans hV_sub))
        (fun q hq => hVp_maps q hq i)).sub ((hF₀_holo i).mono hVp_sub)
    have hHi_ov : ∀ q ∈ V_ov, H_i q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hsp := hΩ_sp_prop i 0 q hq.2
      dsimp [H_i]
      rw [hg_eq_on_Wn i 0 (ψ i q) hsp.1.2, hsp.2.2, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp
      (hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hVp_open hVp_pre hVov_open hVov_ne
        Set.inter_subset_left hHi_holo hHi_ov p hp)
  exact ⟨W_ψ, V_plus, g, hW_open, hW_pre, hW_cov, hVp_open, hVp_pre, hVp_sub,
    hVp_cov, hg_holo_W, fun p hp => ⟨fun i => hVp_maps p hp i, fun i => hVp_eq i p hp⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) :
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * collarBaseS hDet) ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * collarBaseS hDet) ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      collarWidthX C hDet (-t) = collarWidthX C hDet t) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      collarWidthL C hDet (-t) = collarWidthL C hDet t) ∧
    LowerSemicontinuousOn (collarWidthX C hDet) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet)) ∧
    LowerSemicontinuousOn (collarWidthL C hDet) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet)) ∧
    ∃ (L_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR (collarBaseR hDet) (collarWidthL C hDet)))
      (X_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR (collarBaseR hDet) (collarWidthX C hDet))),
      (∀ i : Fin 2,
        MeroAgreesHolo (L_mero i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * collarBaseS hDet ∧ ‖p.2‖ < collarBaseR hDet }) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2,
        MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * collarBaseS hDet ∧ ‖p.2‖ < collarBaseR hDet })

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hDerivConjStrip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ) →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z) := by
    intro σ f hf hconj
    have hOpen : IsOpen (horizStrip σ) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hConjMem : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ, starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro w hw
      change |(starRingEnd ℂ w).im| < σ
      rw [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
      exact hw
    intro z hz
    have hd : HasDerivAt f (deriv f z) z :=
      (hf.differentiableAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hd_conj : HasDerivAt (starRingEnd ℂ ∘ f ∘ starRingEnd ℂ)
        (starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z)) (starRingEnd ℂ z) :=
      hd.conj_conj
    have hev : f =ᶠ[nhds (starRingEnd ℂ z)] (starRingEnd ℂ ∘ f ∘ starRingEnd ℂ) := by
      filter_upwards [hOpen.mem_nhds (hConjMem z hz)] with w hw
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hconj w hw, Complex.conj_conj]
    exact (hd_conj.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).deriv

  have hEqZeroConv2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) →
      ∀ q ∈ W, f q = 0 := by
    intro W V hW hW_conv hV ⟨p₀, hp₀V⟩ hVW f hf hfV q hqW
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun lam => p₀ + lam • (q - p₀)
    have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ :=
      (differentiable_const p₀).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - p₀))
    have hU_open : IsOpen (Φ ⁻¹' W) := hW.preimage hΦ_diff.continuous
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ (Φ ⁻¹' W) := by
      intro lam₁ hlam₁ lam₂ hlam₂ a b ha hb hab
      have hmem : a • Φ lam₁ + b • Φ lam₂ ∈ W := hW_conv hlam₁ hlam₂ ha hb hab
      have hab_C : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have heq : Φ (a • lam₁ + b • lam₂) = a • Φ lam₁ + b • Φ lam₂ := by
        ext <;> simp only [Φ, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
          Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        · linear_combination -p₀.1 * hab_C
        · linear_combination -p₀.2 * hab_C
      change Φ (a • lam₁ + b • lam₂) ∈ W
      rwa [heq]
    have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' W := by
      change Φ 0 ∈ W
      simpa [Φ] using hVW hp₀V
    have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' W := by
      change Φ 1 ∈ W
      simpa [Φ] using hqW
    have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ Φ) (Φ ⁻¹' W) :=
      (hf.comp hΦ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)).analyticOnNhd hU_open
    have hg_ev : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have hpre : Φ ⁻¹' V ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
        hΦ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by simpa [Φ] using hV.mem_nhds hp₀V)
      filter_upwards [hpre] with lam hlam
      exact hfV (Φ lam) hlam
    have hres :=
      hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hU_conv.isPreconnected h0 hg_ev h1
    simpa [Φ] using hres

  have hHoloStarStar : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => star (g (star q))) (star ⁻¹' U) := by
    intro U hU g hg p hp
    have hd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (star p)) (star p) :=
      (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hss := hd.star_star
    rw [star_star] at hss
    exact hss.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  
  let holoToMero2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hW : IsOpen W) {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f W), MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W} hW {f} hf =>
      let rad_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p hp) else 1
      have hrad_pos : ∀ p ∈ W, 0 < rad_fn p := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad_fn]
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p hp)).1
      have hball_sub : ∀ p ∈ W, Metric.ball p (rad_fn p) ⊆ W := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad_fn]
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p hp)).2
      { rad := rad_fn
        num := fun _ => f
        den := fun _ _ => 1
        rad_pos := hrad_pos
        ball_sub := hball_sub
        num_holo := fun p hp => hf.mono (hball_sub p hp)
        den_holo := fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad_pos p hp), one_ne_zero⟩
        compat := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl }

  have holoToMero2D_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hW : IsOpen W) (hU : IsOpen U)
      (hUW : U ⊆ W) {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f W),
      MeroAgreesHolo (holoToMero2D hW hf) f U := by
    intro W U hW hU hUW f hf
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r_U, hr_U, hball_U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp
    have hrad_p : 0 < (holoToMero2D hW hf).rad p :=
      (holoToMero2D hW hf).rad_pos p (hUW hp)
    refine ⟨min r_U ((holoToMero2D hW hf).rad p), lt_min hr_U hrad_p,
      min_le_right _ _,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hball_U,
      fun q _ => (mul_one (f q)).symm⟩

  have meroAgreesHolo_mono : ∀ {W U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M : MeroOn2D W} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M f U → IsOpen U' → U' ⊆ U → MeroAgreesHolo M f U' := by
    intro W U U' M f ⟨hUW, hloc⟩ hU' hsub
    refine ⟨hsub.trans hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁_le, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := hloc p (hsub hp)
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, (min_le_left _ _).trans hr₁_le,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hr₂_sub,
      fun q hq => hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)⟩

  let meroRestrict : ∀ {W W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : MeroOn2D W) (hW' : IsOpen W')
      (hsub : W' ⊆ W), MeroOn2D W' :=
    fun {W W'} M hW' hsub =>
      let rad' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ W' then
          min (M.rad p) (Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW' p hp))
        else 1
      have hrad'_pos : ∀ p ∈ W', 0 < rad' p := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad']
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact lt_min (M.rad_pos p (hsub hp))
          (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW' p hp)).1
      have hrad'_le : ∀ p ∈ W', rad' p ≤ M.rad p := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad']
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact min_le_left _ _
      have hball'_sub : ∀ p ∈ W', Metric.ball p (rad' p) ⊆ W' := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad']
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans
          (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW' p hp)).2
      { rad := rad'
        num := M.num
        den := M.den
        rad_pos := hrad'_pos
        ball_sub := hball'_sub
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          (M.num_holo p (hsub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
        den_holo := fun p hp =>
          (M.den_holo p (hsub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
        den_ne_zero := by
          intro p hp
          by_contra h_all
          push_neg at h_all
          have hzero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (M.rad p), M.den p q = 0 :=
            hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (M.rad p))
              Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad'_pos p hp)⟩
              (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
              (M.den_holo p (hsub hp)) h_all
          obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hne⟩ := M.den_ne_zero p (hsub hp)
          exact hne (hzero q₀ hq₀)
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
          M.compat p₁ (hsub hp₁) p₂ (hsub hp₂) q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p₁ hp₁) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p₂ hp₂) hq.2⟩ }

  have meroRestrict_agrees : ∀ {W W' U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : MeroOn2D W)
      (hW' : IsOpen W') (hsub : W' ⊆ W) {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M f U → IsOpen U' → U' ⊆ U → U' ⊆ W' →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroRestrict M hW' hsub) f U' := by
    intro W W' U U' M hW' hsub f ⟨_, hloc⟩ hU' hsubU hsubW'
    refine ⟨hsubW', fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, _, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := hloc p (hsubU hp)
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU' p hp
    have hrad' : 0 < (meroRestrict M hW' hsub).rad p :=
      (meroRestrict M hW' hsub).rad_pos p (hsubW' hp)
    refine ⟨min r₁ (min r₂ ((meroRestrict M hW' hsub).rad p)),
      lt_min hr₁ (lt_min hr₂ hrad'),
      (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _),
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))).trans hr₂_sub,
      fun q hq => hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)⟩

  have hCancelDen : ∀ {W O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) {p : ℂ × ℂ} (hp : p ∈ W),
      IsOpen O → O ⊆ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) →
      ∀ {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn h O →
      (∀ z ∈ O, h z * F.den p z = 0) → ∀ z ∈ O, h z = 0 := by
    intro W O F p hp hO hO_sub h hh_cont hmul z₀ hz₀
    by_contra hz₀_ne
    have hh_at : ContinuousAt h z₀ := hh_cont.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have hpos : 0 < ‖h z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz₀_ne
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hclose⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hh_at ‖h z₀‖ hpos
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hballO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO z₀ hz₀
    let r₀ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ₂
    have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
    have hr₀_sub_O : Metric.ball z₀ r₀ ⊆ O :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hballO
    have hden_zero_r₀ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₀, F.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_ne : h z ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzz
        have hlt := hclose (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _))
        rw [hzz, dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg] at hlt
        exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul z (hr₀_sub_O hz))).resolve_left hz_ne
    have hden_all : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p (F.rad p), F.den p z = 0 :=
      hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F.rad p))
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀⟩
        (hr₀_sub_O.trans hO_sub) (F.den_holo p hp) hden_zero_r₀
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hne⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p hp
    exact hne (hden_all q₀ hq₀)

  have hMeroEqOfHolo : ∀ {W₁ W₂ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
      {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen V₀ → MeroAgreesHolo F₁ f V₀ → MeroAgreesHolo F₂ f V₀ →
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ := by
    intro W₁ W₂ V₀ F₁ F₂ f _ ⟨hsub₁, hloc₁⟩ ⟨hsub₂, hloc₂⟩
    refine ⟨Set.subset_inter hsub₁ hsub₂, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁_le, _, heq₁⟩ := hloc₁ p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂_le, _, heq₂⟩ := hloc₂ p hp
    let R : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    let r₀ : ℝ := min r₁ r₂
    have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hr₁ hr₂
    have hr₀_le : r₀ ≤ R := min_le_min hr₁_le hr₂_le
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p R) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p (hsub₁ hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p (hsub₂ hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₂.num_holo p (hsub₂ hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p (hsub₁ hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hΔ_r₀ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₀, Δ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 := heq₁ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
      have h2 := heq₂ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)
      dsimp only [Δ]
      rw [h1, h2]
      ring
    have hΔ_R : Δ q = 0 :=
      hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p R)
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀⟩
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀_le) hΔ_holo hΔ_r₀ q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hΔ_R

  have hMeroEqConn : ∀ {W₁ W₂ V V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
      V ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ → IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V →
      IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ V →
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ V V₀ F₁ F₂ hVW hV_open hV_conn _ hV₀_ne hV₀_sub hEq₀
    refine ⟨hVW, ?_⟩
    let R : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z
    have hR_pos : ∀ p ∈ V, 0 < R p := fun p hp =>
      lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p (hVW hp).1) (F₂.rad_pos p (hVW hp).2)
    have hΔ_holo : ∀ p ∈ V, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Δ p) (Metric.ball p (R p)) := fun p hp =>
      (((F₁.num_holo p (hVW hp).1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p (hVW hp).2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₂.num_holo p (hVW hp).2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p (hVW hp).1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    let A₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ V | ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p (R p), Δ p z = 0 }
    let A₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V \ A₀
    have hTransfer : ∀ {p p' : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ A₀ → p' ∈ V →
        (Metric.ball p (R p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (R p')).Nonempty → p' ∈ A₀ := by
      intro p p' ⟨hpV, hp0⟩ hp'V hne
      refine ⟨hp'V, ?_⟩
      let O : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p (R p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (R p')
      have hO_open : IsOpen O := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hO_sub1 : O ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₁.rad p) :=
        Set.inter_subset_left.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      have hO_sub2 : O ⊆ Metric.ball p (F₂.rad p) :=
        Set.inter_subset_left.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      have hmul_eq : ∀ z ∈ O, (Δ p' z * F₁.den p z) * F₂.den p z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hc1 : F₁.num p z * F₁.den p' z = F₁.num p' z * F₁.den p z :=
          F₁.compat p (hVW hpV).1 p' (hVW hp'V).1 z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2⟩
        have hc2 : F₂.num p z * F₂.den p' z = F₂.num p' z * F₂.den p z :=
          F₂.compat p (hVW hpV).2 p' (hVW hp'V).2 z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.2⟩
        have hd0 : Δ p z = 0 := hp0 z hz.1
        dsimp only [Δ] at hd0 ⊢
        linear_combination -F₂.den p' z * F₂.den p z * hc1 +
          F₁.den p' z * F₁.den p z * hc2 +
          F₁.den p' z * F₂.den p' z * hd0
      have hcont1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => Δ p' z * F₁.den p z) O :=
        (((hΔ_holo p' hp'V).mono Set.inter_subset_right).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p (hVW hpV).1).mono hO_sub1)).continuousOn
      have hstep1 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ p' z * F₁.den p z = 0 :=
        hCancelDen F₂ (hVW hpV).2 hO_open hO_sub2 hcont1 hmul_eq
      have hcont2 : ContinuousOn (Δ p') O :=
        ((hΔ_holo p' hp'V).mono Set.inter_subset_right).continuousOn
      have hstep2 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ p' z = 0 :=
        hCancelDen F₁ (hVW hpV).1 hO_open hO_sub1 hcont2 hstep1
      exact hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p' (R p'))
        hO_open hne Set.inter_subset_right (hΔ_holo p' hp'V) hstep2
    have hA₀_open : IsOpen A₀ := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V, hball_V⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p hp.1
      refine ⟨min r_V (R p), lt_min hr_V (hR_pos p hp.1), fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'V : p' ∈ V := hball_V (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp')
      have hp'_in : p' ∈ Metric.ball p (R p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (R p') :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp', Metric.mem_ball_self (hR_pos p' hp'V)⟩
      exact hTransfer hp hp'V ⟨p', hp'_in⟩
    have hA₁_open : IsOpen A₁ := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p ⟨hpV, hp_not⟩
      obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V, hball_V⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p hpV
      refine ⟨min r_V (R p), lt_min hr_V (hR_pos p hpV), fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'V : p' ∈ V := hball_V (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp')
      refine ⟨hp'V, fun hp'0 => hp_not ?_⟩
      have hp'_in : p' ∈ Metric.ball p' (R p') ∩ Metric.ball p (R p) :=
        ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hR_pos p' hp'V), Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp'⟩
      exact hTransfer hp'0 hpV ⟨p', hp'_in⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint A₀ A₁ := Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ h0 h1 => h1.2 h0)
    have hcov : V ⊆ A₀ ∪ A₁ := fun p hp => by
      by_cases h0 : p ∈ A₀
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hp, h0⟩
    have hV₀_A₀ : V₀ ⊆ A₀ :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hV₀_sub hp, fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hEq₀.2 p hp z hz)⟩
    rcases hV_conn.subset_or_subset hA₀_open hA₁_open hdisj hcov with hsub0 | hsub1
    · intro p hp z hz
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((hsub0 hp).2 z hz)
    · obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hV₀_ne
      exact False.elim ((hsub1 (hV₀_sub hv₀)).2 (hV₀_A₀ hv₀))

  have hCompatOfEq : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ (W₁ ∩ W₂) →
      ∀ {p₁ p₂ q : ℂ × ℂ}, p₁ ∈ W₁ → p₂ ∈ W₂ →
      q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (F₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (F₂.rad p₂) →
      F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₂ q = F₂.num p₂ q * F₁.den p₁ q := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ hEq p₁ p₂ q hp₁ hp₂ hq
    have hqW : q ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ := ⟨F₁.ball_sub p₁ hp₁ hq.1, F₂.ball_sub p₂ hp₂ hq.2⟩
    let Rq : ℝ := min (F₁.rad q) (F₂.rad q)
    have hRq_pos : 0 < Rq := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos q hqW.1) (F₂.rad_pos q hqW.2)
    let Oq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (Metric.ball p₁ (F₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (F₂.rad p₂)) ∩ Metric.ball q Rq
    have hOq_open : IsOpen Oq :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hq_mem : q ∈ Oq := ⟨hq, Metric.mem_ball_self hRq_pos⟩
    have hOq_sub1 : Oq ⊆ Metric.ball q (F₁.rad q) :=
      Set.inter_subset_right.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
    have hOq_sub2 : Oq ⊆ Metric.ball q (F₂.rad q) :=
      Set.inter_subset_right.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
    let h_diff : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun z => F₁.num p₁ z * F₂.den p₂ z - F₂.num p₂ z * F₁.den p₁ z
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_diff Oq :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Set.inter_subset_left)).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Set.inter_subset_right))).sub
      (((F₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂).mono (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Set.inter_subset_right)).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁).mono (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Set.inter_subset_left)))
    have hmul_eq : ∀ z ∈ Oq, (h_diff z * F₁.den q z) * F₂.den q z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hc1 : F₁.num p₁ z * F₁.den q z = F₁.num q z * F₁.den p₁ z :=
        F₁.compat p₁ hp₁ q hqW.1 z ⟨hz.1.1, hOq_sub1 hz⟩
      have hc2 : F₂.num p₂ z * F₂.den q z = F₂.num q z * F₂.den p₂ z :=
        F₂.compat p₂ hp₂ q hqW.2 z ⟨hz.1.2, hOq_sub2 hz⟩
      have hc0 : F₁.num q z * F₂.den q z = F₂.num q z * F₁.den q z :=
        hEq.2 q hqW z hz.2
      dsimp only [h_diff]
      linear_combination F₂.den p₂ z * F₂.den q z * hc1 -
        F₁.den p₁ z * F₁.den q z * hc2 +
        F₁.den p₁ z * F₂.den p₂ z * hc0
    have hcont1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => h_diff z * F₁.den q z) Oq :=
      (hh_holo.mul ((F₁.den_holo q hqW.1).mono hOq_sub1)).continuousOn
    have hstep1 : ∀ z ∈ Oq, h_diff z * F₁.den q z = 0 :=
      hCancelDen F₂ hqW.2 hOq_open hOq_sub2 hcont1 hmul_eq
    have hstep2 : ∀ z ∈ Oq, h_diff z = 0 :=
      hCancelDen F₁ hqW.1 hOq_open hOq_sub1 hh_holo.continuousOn hstep1
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hstep2 q hq_mem)

  
  let s_base : ℝ := collarBaseS hDet
  let r_base : ℝ := collarBaseR hDet
  let B : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base
  let U_base2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }

  have hs_pos : 0 < s_base := hDet.s_det_pos
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_base := lt_min hDet.r_det_pos (half_pos Real.pi_pos)
  have hr_le_det : r_base ≤ hDet.r_det := min_le_left _ _
  have hs_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4 := hDet.s_det_le_s₁
  have hr_lt_s4 : r_base < s_base / 4 := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_s_det
  have hr_lt_r₁_half : r_base < C.r₁ / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_r₁
  have hr₁_pos : 0 < C.r₁ := C.r₁_pos
  have hs₁_pos : 0 < C.s₁ := lt_trans C.r₁_pos C.r₁_lt_s₁

  have hU_base2_open : IsOpen U_base2 :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)

  have hBaseSubDet : U_base2 ⊆
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨hp.1, by linarith [hp.2, hr_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩

  let F_L : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i
  let F_X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i

  have hFL_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_L i) U_base2 :=
    fun i => (hDet.dualLine_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet
  have hFX_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_X i) U_base2 :=
    fun i => (hDet.impact_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet

  have hShiftTheta : ∀ {y t c : ℂ}, |y.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < r_base → ‖c‖ ≤ ‖t‖ →
      glancingTheta C (y + c) (-t) = glancingTheta C (y + c) t ∧
      glancingTheta C (y + c) t ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) ∧
      glancingTheta C (starRingEnd ℂ (y + c)) (starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingTheta C (y + c) t) := by
    intro y t c hy ht hc
    have him_c : |c.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := (Complex.abs_im_le_norm c).trans hc
    have him_yc : |(y + c).im| < C.s₁ := by
      rw [Complex.add_im]
      linarith [abs_add_le y.im c.im]
    have ht_r₁ : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith
    have hU_mem : C.U (y + c, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) :=
      C.U_maps_to (y + c) t (by linarith) ht_r₁
    refine ⟨?_, C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to (C.U (y + c, t)) hU_mem, ?_⟩
    · unfold glancingTheta
      rw [C.U_even (y + c) t (by linarith) ht_r₁]
    · unfold glancingTheta
      rw [C.U_conj (y + c) t (by linarith) ht_r₁, C.ϕ_ℂ_conj (C.U (y + c, t)) hU_mem]

  have hMidStrip : ∀ {z₁ z₂ : ℂ},
      z₁ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) → z₂ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) →
      (z₁ + z₂) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
    intro z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂
    change |((z₁ + z₂) / 2).im| < 2 * C.s_h
    have him : ((z₁ + z₂) / 2).im = (z₁.im + z₂.im) / 2 := by simp [Complex.add_im]
    rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have h1 : |z₁.im| < 2 * C.s_h := hz₁
    have h2 : |z₂.im| < 2 * C.s_h := hz₂
    linarith [abs_add_le z₁.im z₂.im]

  have hDerivHConj : ∀ μ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h),
      deriv C.h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ μ) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ μ) :=
    hDerivConjStrip (2 * C.s_h) C.h_ℂ C.h_ℂ_holo C.h_ℂ_conj

  have hFX_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2, F_X i (p.1, -p.2) = F_X i p := by
    intro i ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    have hhalf : ‖t / 2‖ ≤ ‖t‖ := by
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      linarith [norm_nonneg t]
    have h_m : glancingTheta C (y + -(t / 2)) (-t) = glancingTheta C (y + -(t / 2)) t :=
      (hShiftTheta hy ht (by rwa [norm_neg] : ‖-(t / 2)‖ ≤ ‖t‖)).1
    have h_p : glancingTheta C (y + (t / 2)) (-t) = glancingTheta C (y + (t / 2)) t :=
      (hShiftTheta hy ht hhalf).1
    have hmid : glancingMidAngle C y (-t) = glancingMidAngle C y t := by
      unfold glancingMidAngle
      have ha : y - (-t) / 2 = y + (t / 2) := by ring
      have hb : y + (-t) / 2 = y + -(t / 2) := by ring
      have hc : y - t / 2 = y + -(t / 2) := by ring
      rw [ha, hb, hc, h_p, h_m, add_comm]
    dsimp only [F_X, glancingImpact]
    rw [hmid]

  have hFL_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2, F_L i (p.1, -p.2) = F_L i p := by
    intro i ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    have h0 : glancingTheta C y (-t) = glancingTheta C y t := by
      simpa using (hShiftTheta hy ht (by simp : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖t‖)).1
    have hm : glancingTheta C (y - t) (-t) = glancingTheta C (y - t) t := by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using (hShiftTheta hy ht (by rw [norm_neg])).1
    have hoff : glancingOffset C y (-t) = glancingOffset C y t := by
      have hstat := C.glancing_stationary y t (by linarith) (by linarith)
      unfold glancingOffset
      have h_yn : y + -t = y - t := by ring
      rw [h_yn, h0, hm]
      set θ_m : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y - t) t
      set θ_0 : ℂ := glancingTheta C y t
      set θ_p : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y + t) t
      have hact : -supportAction1_ℂ C.h_ℂ θ_0 θ_m = supportAction2_ℂ C.h_ℂ θ_m θ_0 := by
        unfold supportAction1_ℂ supportAction2_ℂ
        have h1 : (θ_0 + θ_m) / 2 = (θ_m + θ_0) / 2 := by ring
        have h2 : (θ_m - θ_0) / 2 = -((θ_0 - θ_m) / 2) := by ring
        rw [h1, h2, Complex.sin_neg, Complex.cos_neg]
        ring
      rw [hact]
      exact hstat.symm
    dsimp only [F_L, glancingDualLine]
    rw [h0, hoff]

  have hFX_conj : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2,
      F_X i (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (F_X i p) := by
    intro i ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    have hhalf : ‖t / 2‖ ≤ ‖t‖ := by
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      linarith [norm_nonneg t]
    obtain ⟨_, hm_strip, hm_conj⟩ := hShiftTheta hy ht (by rwa [norm_neg] : ‖-(t / 2)‖ ≤ ‖t‖)
    obtain ⟨_, hp_strip, hp_conj⟩ := hShiftTheta hy ht hhalf
    have hμ_strip : glancingMidAngle C y t ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      unfold glancingMidAngle
      have hc : y - t / 2 = y + -(t / 2) := by ring
      rw [hc]
      exact hMidStrip hm_strip hp_strip
    have hμ_conj : glancingMidAngle C (starRingEnd ℂ y) (starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingMidAngle C y t) := by
      unfold glancingMidAngle
      have ha : starRingEnd ℂ y - starRingEnd ℂ t / 2 = starRingEnd ℂ (y + -(t / 2)) := by
        simp [sub_eq_add_neg, map_ofNat]
      have hb : starRingEnd ℂ y + starRingEnd ℂ t / 2 = starRingEnd ℂ (y + t / 2) := by
        simp [map_ofNat]
      have hc : y - t / 2 = y + -(t / 2) := by ring
      rw [ha, hb, hc, hm_conj, hp_conj]
      simp [map_ofNat]
    revert i
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · dsimp only [F_X, glancingImpact]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hμ_conj,
        C.h_ℂ_conj _ hμ_strip, hDerivHConj _ hμ_strip,
        Complex.cos_conj, Complex.sin_conj, map_sub, map_add, map_mul]

  have hFL_conj : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2,
      F_L i (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (F_L i p) := by
    intro i ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨_, h0_strip, h0_conj⟩ := hShiftTheta hy ht (by simp : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖t‖)
    obtain ⟨_, hp_strip, hp_conj⟩ := hShiftTheta hy ht (le_rfl : ‖t‖ ≤ ‖t‖)
    simp only [add_zero] at h0_strip h0_conj
    set θ_0 : ℂ := glancingTheta C y t
    set θ_p : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y + t) t
    have hμ_strip : (θ_0 + θ_p) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := hMidStrip h0_strip hp_strip
    have hoff_conj : glancingOffset C (starRingEnd ℂ y) (starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingOffset C y t) := by
      unfold glancingOffset supportAction1_ℂ
      have hy_add : starRingEnd ℂ y + starRingEnd ℂ t = starRingEnd ℂ (y + t) := by simp
      rw [hy_add, h0_conj, hp_conj]
      have hm : (starRingEnd ℂ θ_0 + starRingEnd ℂ θ_p) / 2 =
          starRingEnd ℂ ((θ_0 + θ_p) / 2) := by simp [map_ofNat]
      have hd : (starRingEnd ℂ θ_p - starRingEnd ℂ θ_0) / 2 =
          starRingEnd ℂ ((θ_p - θ_0) / 2) := by simp [map_ofNat]
      rw [hm, hd, C.h_ℂ_conj _ hμ_strip, hDerivHConj _ hμ_strip,
        Complex.sin_conj, Complex.cos_conj]
      simp [θ_0, θ_p]
    revert i
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · dsimp only [F_L, glancingDualLine]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, h0_conj, hoff_conj,
        Complex.cos_conj, Complex.sin_conj, map_div₀, θ_0]

  
  let cyl (a c : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { y' : ℂ | a < y'.im ∧ y'.im < c } ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ
  have hCylOpen : ∀ a c : ℝ, ∀ t_c : ℂ, ∀ δ : ℝ, IsOpen (cyl a c t_c δ) :=
    fun a c t_c δ =>
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hBaseCylEq : ∀ (t_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ),
      ({ y' : ℂ | |y'.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ) = cyl (-s_base) s_base t_c δ := by
    intro t_c δ
    ext ⟨y', t'⟩
    simp [cyl, abs_lt]
  have hU_base2_eq : U_base2 = cyl (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base := by
    ext ⟨y', t'⟩
    simp only [U_base2, cyl, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_prod, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, ht⟩
      have habs := abs_lt.mp hy
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith [habs.1], habs.2⟩, ht⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ht⟩
      exact ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, h2⟩, ht⟩

  have hEngine : ∀ (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_init i) U_base2) →
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2, F_init i (p.1, -p.2) = F_init i p) →
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base2,
        F_init i (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (F_init i p)) →
      let h_F := meroStripWidth s_base r_base F_init
      (∀ t ∈ B, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) ≤ h_F t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ B, h_F (-t) = h_F t) ∧
      LowerSemicontinuousOn h_F B ∧
      ∃ M_F : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_F),
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M_F i) (F_init i) U_base2 := by
    intro F_init hF_holo hF_even hF_conj
    let h_F : ℂ → ENNReal := meroStripWidth s_base r_base F_init

    
    have hWitnessBall : ∀ {t₀ : ℂ} {b δ : ℝ},
        s_base < b → 0 < δ → Metric.ball t₀ δ ⊆ B →
        ∀ (G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-s_base) b t₀ δ)),
        (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (F_init i)
          ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t₀ δ)) →
        ∀ t' ∈ Metric.ball t₀ δ, ENNReal.ofReal b ≤ h_F t' := by
      intro t₀ b δ hb hδ hballB G hG t' ht'
      let δ' : ℝ := δ - dist t' t₀
      have hδ' : 0 < δ' := sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp ht')
      have hsub_ball : Metric.ball t' δ' ⊆ Metric.ball t₀ δ := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
        linarith [dist_triangle w t' t₀]
      have hsub_cyl : cyl (-s_base) b t' δ' ⊆ cyl (-s_base) b t₀ δ :=
        fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hsub_ball hp.2⟩
      let G' : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-s_base) b t' δ') :=
        fun i => meroRestrict (G i) (hCylOpen (-s_base) b t' δ') hsub_cyl
      have hG'_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G' i) (F_init i)
          ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t' δ') := by
        intro i
        have hOpen_base : IsOpen ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t' δ') := by
          rw [hBaseCylEq]
          exact hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base t' δ'
        refine meroRestrict_agrees (G i) (hCylOpen (-s_base) b t' δ') hsub_cyl (hG i)
          hOpen_base (fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hsub_ball hp.2⟩) ?_
        intro p hp
        have habs := abs_lt.mp (show |p.1.im| < s_base from hp.1)
        exact ⟨⟨habs.1, lt_trans habs.2 hb⟩, hp.2⟩
      have hwit : IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t' b :=
        ⟨hb, δ', hδ', hsub_ball.trans hballB, G', hG'_agrees⟩
      exact le_sSup ⟨b, hwit, rfl⟩

    
    have h_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ B, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) ≤ h_F t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < r_base := by simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
      let δ : ℝ := r_base - ‖t‖
      have hδ : 0 < δ := sub_pos.mpr ht_norm
      have hballB : Metric.ball t δ ⊆ B := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        have hdist : ‖w - t‖ < δ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hw
        calc ‖w‖ = ‖(w - t) + t‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖w - t‖ + ‖t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < δ + ‖t‖ := by linarith
          _ = r_base := sub_add_cancel _ _
      have hW₀_sub : cyl (-s_base) (2 * s_base) t δ ⊆ U_base2 := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hp.1.1, hs_pos], hp.1.2⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hballB hp.2
      let G₀ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-s_base) (2 * s_base) t δ) :=
        fun i => holoToMero2D (hCylOpen (-s_base) (2 * s_base) t δ) ((hF_holo i).mono hW₀_sub)
      have hG₀_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G₀ i) (F_init i)
          ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ) := by
        intro i
        have hOpen_base : IsOpen ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ) := by
          rw [hBaseCylEq]
          exact hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base t δ
        refine holoToMero2D_agrees (hCylOpen (-s_base) (2 * s_base) t δ) hOpen_base ?_
          ((hF_holo i).mono hW₀_sub)
        intro p hp
        have habs := abs_lt.mp (show |p.1.im| < s_base from hp.1)
        exact ⟨⟨habs.1, by linarith [habs.2, hs_pos]⟩, hp.2⟩
      have hwit : IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t (2 * s_base) :=
        ⟨by linarith, δ, hδ, hballB, G₀, hG₀_agrees⟩
      exact le_sSup ⟨2 * s_base, hwit, rfl⟩

    
    have h_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_F B := by
      rw [lowerSemicontinuousOn_iff_preimage_Ioi]
      intro c_val
      let u : Set ℂ := B ∩ h_F ⁻¹' Set.Ioi c_val
      refine ⟨u, ?_, by ext z; simp [u]⟩
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      rintro t₀ ⟨_, hc_lt⟩
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi] at hc_lt
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨b, ⟨hb, δ, hδ, hballB, G, hG⟩, rfl⟩, hc_lt_b⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.mp hc_lt
      refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun t' ht' => ⟨hballB ht', ?_⟩⟩
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hc_lt_b (hWitnessBall hb hδ hballB G hG t' ht')

    
    have h_even : ∀ t ∈ B, h_F (-t) = h_F t := by
      let ι : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, -p.2)
      have hι_inv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ι (ι p) = p := fun p => by ext <;> simp [ι]
      have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι := differentiable_fst.prodMk differentiable_snd.neg
      have hι_dist : ∀ p q : ℂ × ℂ, dist (ι p) (ι q) = dist p q := by
        intro p q
        simp [ι, Prod.dist_eq, dist_neg_neg]
      have hWitNeg : ∀ (t : ℂ) (b : ℝ),
          IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t b →
          IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init (-t) b := by
        rintro t b ⟨hb, δ, hδ, hballB, G, hG⟩
        have hball_neg_iff : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ Metric.ball (-t) δ ↔ -w ∈ Metric.ball t δ := by
          intro w
          simp only [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hd : dist (-w) t = dist w (-t) := by simpa using dist_neg_neg w (-t)
          rw [hd]
        have hballB_neg : Metric.ball (-t) δ ⊆ B := by
          intro w hw
          have hnw : -w ∈ B := hballB ((hball_neg_iff w).mp hw)
          simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hnw
        have hmem_cyl : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            p ∈ cyl (-s_base) b (-t) δ ↔ ι p ∈ cyl (-s_base) b t δ := by
          intro p
          simp only [cyl, ι, Set.mem_prod, hball_neg_iff]
        let G_neg : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-s_base) b (-t) δ) := fun i =>
          { rad := fun p => (G i).rad (ι p)
            num := fun p q => (G i).num (ι p) (ι q)
            den := fun p q => (G i).den (ι p) (ι q)
            rad_pos := fun p hp => (G i).rad_pos (ι p) ((hmem_cyl p).mp hp)
            ball_sub := fun p hp q hq => by
              have hιq : ι q ∈ Metric.ball (ι p) ((G i).rad (ι p)) := by
                rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq
              exact (hmem_cyl q).mpr ((G i).ball_sub (ι p) ((hmem_cyl p).mp hp) hιq)
            num_holo := fun p hp =>
              ((G i).num_holo (ι p) ((hmem_cyl p).mp hp)).comp hι_diff.differentiableOn
                (fun q hq => by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq)
            den_holo := fun p hp =>
              ((G i).den_holo (ι p) ((hmem_cyl p).mp hp)).comp hι_diff.differentiableOn
                (fun q hq => by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq)
            den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
              obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hne⟩ := (G i).den_ne_zero (ι p) ((hmem_cyl p).mp hp)
              refine ⟨ι q₀, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← hι_dist, hι_inv]
                exact hq₀
              · simpa [hι_inv] using hne
            compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
              (G i).compat (ι p₁) ((hmem_cyl p₁).mp hp₁) (ι p₂) ((hmem_cyl p₂).mp hp₂) (ι q)
                ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq.1,
                 by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq.2⟩ }
        refine ⟨hb, δ, hδ, hballB_neg, G_neg, fun i => ?_⟩
        refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨⟨(abs_lt.mp hp.1).1, lt_trans (abs_lt.mp hp.1).2 hb⟩, hp.2⟩,
          fun p hp => ?_⟩
        have hιp_base : ι p ∈ { y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ :=
          ⟨hp.1, (hball_neg_iff p.2).mp hp.2⟩
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := (hG i).2 (ι p) hιp_base
        refine ⟨r, hr, hr_le, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_⟩
        · have hιq : ι q ∈ Metric.ball (ι p) r := by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq
          have hmem := hr_sub hιq
          exact ⟨hmem.1, (hball_neg_iff q.2).mpr hmem.2⟩
        · have hιq : ι q ∈ Metric.ball (ι p) r := by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hι_dist]; exact hq
          have hmem := hr_sub hιq
          have hq_base2 : q ∈ U_base2 := by
            have hq1_im : |q.1.im| < s_base := hmem.1
            refine ⟨by linarith [hq1_im, hs_pos], ?_⟩
            have hq2B : q.2 ∈ B := hballB_neg ((hball_neg_iff q.2).mpr hmem.2)
            simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq2B
          have heq := hr_eq (ι q) hιq
          have hF_eq : F_init i (ι q) = F_init i q := hF_even i q hq_base2
          rw [hF_eq] at heq
          exact heq
      intro t _
      have hset : { x : ENNReal | ∃ b : ℝ,
            IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init (-t) b ∧ x = ENNReal.ofReal b } =
          { x : ENNReal | ∃ b : ℝ,
            IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init t b ∧ x = ENNReal.ofReal b } := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨b, hw, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨b, by simpa using hWitNeg (-t) b hw, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨b, hw, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨b, hWitNeg t b hw, rfl⟩
      dsimp only [h_F, meroStripWidth]
      rw [hset]

    
    let T_F : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR r_base h_F
    have hdist_star : ∀ p q : ℂ × ℂ, dist (star p) (star q) = dist p q := by
      intro p q
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← star_sub, norm_star]
    have hdist_conj_C : ∀ z w : ℂ,
        dist (starRingEnd ℂ z) (starRingEnd ℂ w) = dist z w := by
      intro z w
      simp only [← Complex.star_def, dist_eq_norm, ← star_sub, norm_star]
    have hF_star : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ U_base2, F_init i (star q) = star (F_init i q) := by
      intro i q hq
      simp only [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def]
      exact hF_conj i q hq

    have hU_base2_sub_TF : U_base2 ⊆ T_F := by
      rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
      have habs := abs_lt.mp hy
      have htB : t ∈ B := by simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
      have hctB : starRingEnd ℂ t ∈ B := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using ht
      refine ⟨ht, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
          ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith [habs.1]))
          (h_ge_two (starRingEnd ℂ t) hctB)
      · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
          ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mpr habs.2)
          (h_ge_two t htB)

    let ChartPkg : Type := Σ (a : ℝ) (c : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ), MeroOn2D (cyl a c t_c δ)

    have hChart : ∀ (i : Fin 2), ∀ p ∈ T_F, ∃ S : ChartPkg,
        S.1 ≤ -s_base ∧ s_base ≤ S.2.1 ∧ 0 < S.2.2.2.1 ∧
        p ∈ cyl S.1 S.2.1 S.2.2.1 S.2.2.2.1 ∧
        cyl S.1 S.2.1 S.2.2.1 S.2.2.2.1 ⊆ T_F ∧
        MeroAgreesHolo S.2.2.2.2 (F_init i) (cyl (-s_base) s_base S.2.2.1 S.2.2.2.1) ∧
        (|p.1.im| < 2 * s_base →
          Metric.ball p (S.2.2.2.2.rad p) ⊆ U_base2 ∧
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (S.2.2.2.2.rad p),
            S.2.2.2.2.num p q = F_init i q * S.2.2.2.2.den p q) := by
      intro i ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨ht_norm, h_low, h_high⟩
      by_cases h1 : |y.im| < 2 * s_base
      · 
        have hf_cyl : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_init i) (cyl (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base) := by
          rw [← hU_base2_eq]; exact hF_holo i
        let M₀ : MeroOn2D (cyl (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base) :=
          holoToMero2D (hCylOpen (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base) hf_cyl
        have hp_cyl : (y, t) ∈ cyl (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base := by
          rw [← hU_base2_eq]; exact ⟨h1, ht_norm⟩
        refine ⟨⟨-2 * s_base, 2 * s_base, 0, r_base, M₀⟩,
          by linarith, by linarith, hr_pos, hp_cyl,
          by rw [← hU_base2_eq]; exact hU_base2_sub_TF,
          holoToMero2D_agrees (hCylOpen (-2 * s_base) (2 * s_base) 0 r_base)
            (hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base 0 r_base)
            (fun q hq => ⟨⟨by linarith [hq.1.1], by linarith [hq.1.2]⟩, hq.2⟩) hf_cyl,
          fun _ => ⟨by rw [hU_base2_eq]; exact M₀.ball_sub (y, t) hp_cyl,
            fun q _ => (mul_one (F_init i q)).symm⟩⟩
      · by_cases h2 : 0 ≤ y.im
        · 
          obtain ⟨x, ⟨b_p, ⟨hb_p, δ_p, hδ_p, hballB, G_p, hG_p⟩, rfl⟩, hy_lt_b⟩ :=
            lt_sSup_iff.mp h_high
          have hb_pos : 0 < b_p := lt_trans hs_pos hb_p
          have hy_lt : y.im < b_p := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hb_pos).mp hy_lt_b
          refine ⟨⟨-s_base, b_p, t, δ_p, G_p i⟩,
            le_rfl, le_of_lt hb_p, hδ_p,
            ⟨⟨by linarith, hy_lt⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_p⟩,
            ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd h h1⟩
          · rintro ⟨y', t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy'1, hy'2⟩, ht'⟩
            have ht'B : t' ∈ B := hballB ht'
            have ht'_norm : ‖t'‖ < r_base := by
              simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht'B
            have hct'B : starRingEnd ℂ t' ∈ B := by
              simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using ht'_norm
            refine ⟨ht'_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
            · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
                ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith))
                (h_ge_two (starRingEnd ℂ t') hct'B)
            · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
                ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hb_pos).mpr hy'2)
                (hWitnessBall hb_p hδ_p hballB G_p hG_p t' ht')
          · rw [← hBaseCylEq]
            exact hG_p i
        · 
          have hy_neg : y.im < 0 := not_le.mp h2
          obtain ⟨x, ⟨b_p, ⟨hb_p, δ_p, hδ_p, hballB, G_p, hG_p⟩, rfl⟩, hny_lt_b⟩ :=
            lt_sSup_iff.mp h_low
          have hb_pos : 0 < b_p := lt_trans hs_pos hb_p
          have hny_lt : -y.im < b_p := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hb_pos).mp hny_lt_b
          have hball_conj_iff : ∀ w : ℂ,
              w ∈ Metric.ball t δ_p ↔ starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ Metric.ball (starRingEnd ℂ t) δ_p := by
            intro w
            simp only [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_conj_C]
          have hmem_low : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ,
              q ∈ cyl (-b_p) s_base t δ_p ↔ star q ∈ cyl (-s_base) b_p (starRingEnd ℂ t) δ_p := by
            rintro ⟨y', t'⟩
            simp only [cyl, Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
              Complex.conj_im, ← hball_conj_iff]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨⟨h_a, h_b⟩, ht'⟩
              exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ht'⟩
            · rintro ⟨⟨h_a, h_b⟩, ht'⟩
              exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ht'⟩
          let G_low : MeroOn2D (cyl (-b_p) s_base t δ_p) :=
            { rad := fun q => (G_p i).rad (star q)
              num := fun q z => star ((G_p i).num (star q) (star z))
              den := fun q z => star ((G_p i).den (star q) (star z))
              rad_pos := fun q hq => (G_p i).rad_pos (star q) ((hmem_low q).mp hq)
              ball_sub := fun q hq z hz => by
                have hsz : star z ∈ Metric.ball (star q) ((G_p i).rad (star q)) := by
                  rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz
                exact (hmem_low z).mpr ((G_p i).ball_sub (star q) ((hmem_low q).mp hq) hsz)
              num_holo := fun q hq =>
                (hHoloStarStar Metric.isOpen_ball
                  ((G_p i).num_holo (star q) ((hmem_low q).mp hq))).mono
                  (fun z hz => by change star z ∈ Metric.ball _ _; rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz)
              den_holo := fun q hq =>
                (hHoloStarStar Metric.isOpen_ball
                  ((G_p i).den_holo (star q) ((hmem_low q).mp hq))).mono
                  (fun z hz => by change star z ∈ Metric.ball _ _; rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz)
              den_ne_zero := fun q hq => by
                obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hne⟩ := (G_p i).den_ne_zero (star q) ((hmem_low q).mp hq)
                refine ⟨star z₀, ?_, ?_⟩
                · rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← hdist_star, star_star]
                  exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hz₀
                · rw [star_star]
                  exact star_ne_zero.mpr hne
              compat := fun q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ z hz => by
                have hc := (G_p i).compat (star q₁) ((hmem_low q₁).mp hq₁)
                  (star q₂) ((hmem_low q₂).mp hq₂) (star z)
                  ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz.1,
                   by rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz.2⟩
                have hsc := congr_arg star hc
                simpa only [star_mul, mul_comm] using hsc }
          refine ⟨⟨-b_p, s_base, t, δ_p, G_low⟩,
            by linarith, le_rfl, hδ_p,
            ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_p⟩,
            ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd h h1⟩
          · rintro ⟨y', t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy'1, hy'2⟩, ht'⟩
            have hct' : starRingEnd ℂ t' ∈ Metric.ball (starRingEnd ℂ t) δ_p :=
              (hball_conj_iff t').mp ht'
            have hct'B : starRingEnd ℂ t' ∈ B := hballB hct'
            have ht'_norm : ‖t'‖ < r_base := by
              simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using hct'B
            have ht'B : t' ∈ B := by simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht'_norm
            refine ⟨ht'_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
            · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
                ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hb_pos).mpr (by linarith))
                (hWitnessBall hb_p hδ_p hballB G_p hG_p (starRingEnd ℂ t') hct')
            · exact lt_of_lt_of_le
                ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith))
                (h_ge_two t' ht'B)
          · refine ⟨fun q hq => ⟨⟨lt_trans (neg_lt_neg hb_p) hq.1.1, hq.1.2⟩, hq.2⟩,
              fun q hq => ?_⟩
            have hsq_base : star q ∈ { y' : ℂ | |y'.im| < s_base } ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (starRingEnd ℂ t) δ_p := by
              refine ⟨?_, (hball_conj_iff q.2).mp hq.2⟩
              simp only [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
                Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
              exact abs_lt.mpr hq.1
            obtain ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := (hG_p i).2 (star q) hsq_base
            refine ⟨r, hr, hr_le, fun z hz => ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
            · have hsz : star z ∈ Metric.ball (star q) r := by
                rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz
              have hmem := hr_sub hsz
              have habs : |z.1.im| < s_base := by
                simpa [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hmem.1
              exact ⟨abs_lt.mp habs, (hball_conj_iff z.2).mpr hmem.2⟩
            · have hsz : star z ∈ Metric.ball (star q) r := by
                rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]; exact hz
              have hmem := hr_sub hsz
              have hz_im : |z.1.im| < s_base := by
                simpa [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hmem.1
              have hz_base2 : z ∈ U_base2 := by
                refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
                have hczB : starRingEnd ℂ z.2 ∈ B := hballB hmem.2
                simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using hczB
              have heq := congr_arg star (hr_eq (star z) hsz)
              rw [star_mul, mul_comm, hF_star i z hz_base2, star_star] at heq
              exact heq

    let pick (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (hp : p ∈ T_F) : ChartPkg :=
      Classical.choose (hChart i p hp)
    have pick_spec (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (hp : p ∈ T_F) :=
      Classical.choose_spec (hChart i p hp)

    let M_F : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D T_F := fun i =>
      let rad_i : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ T_F then (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.rad p else 1
      let num_i : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ T_F then (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.num p else fun _ => 0
      let den_i : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ T_F then (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.den p else fun _ => 1
      { rad := rad_i
        num := num_i
        den := den_i
        rad_pos := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp only [rad_i]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.rad_pos p (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.1
        ball_sub := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp only [rad_i]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact ((pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.ball_sub p (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.1).trans
            (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.2.1
        num_holo := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp only [rad_i, num_i]
          rw [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hp]
          exact (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.num_holo p (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.1
        den_holo := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp only [rad_i, den_i]
          rw [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hp]
          exact (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.den_holo p (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.1
        den_ne_zero := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp only [rad_i, den_i]
          rw [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hp]
          exact (pick i p hp).2.2.2.2.den_ne_zero p (pick_spec i p hp).2.2.2.1
        compat := by
          intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
          simp only [rad_i, num_i, den_i, dif_pos hp₁, dif_pos hp₂] at hq ⊢
          set S₁ := pick i p₁ hp₁
          set S₂ := pick i p₂ hp₂
          obtain ⟨ha₁, hc₁, _, hp₁U, _, hAg₁, _⟩ := pick_spec i p₁ hp₁
          obtain ⟨ha₂, hc₂, _, hp₂U, _, hAg₂, _⟩ := pick_spec i p₂ hp₂
          let U₁ := cyl S₁.1 S₁.2.1 S₁.2.2.1 S₁.2.2.2.1
          let U₂ := cyl S₂.1 S₂.2.1 S₂.2.2.1 S₂.2.2.2.1
          let D₁₂ := Metric.ball S₁.2.2.1 S₁.2.2.2.1 ∩ Metric.ball S₂.2.2.1 S₂.2.2.2.1
          have hqU₁ : q ∈ U₁ := S₁.2.2.2.2.ball_sub p₁ hp₁U hq.1
          have hqU₂ : q ∈ U₂ := S₂.2.2.2.2.ball_sub p₂ hp₂U hq.2
          have hqD₁₂ : q.2 ∈ D₁₂ := ⟨hqU₁.2, hqU₂.2⟩
          have hV_eq : U₁ ∩ U₂ =
              { y' : ℂ | max S₁.1 S₂.1 < y'.im ∧ y'.im < min S₁.2.1 S₂.2.1 } ×ˢ D₁₂ := by
            ext ⟨y', t'⟩
            simp only [U₁, U₂, cyl, D₁₂, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
              max_lt_iff, lt_min_iff]
            tauto
          have hV_open : IsOpen (U₁ ∩ U₂) :=
            (hCylOpen S₁.1 S₁.2.1 S₁.2.2.1 S₁.2.2.2.1).inter
              (hCylOpen S₂.1 S₂.2.1 S₂.2.2.1 S₂.2.2.2.1)
          have hV_conv : Convex ℝ (U₁ ∩ U₂) := by
            rw [hV_eq]
            have hpre : { y' : ℂ | max S₁.1 S₂.1 < y'.im ∧ y'.im < min S₁.2.1 S₂.2.1 } =
                Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (max S₁.1 S₂.1) (min S₁.2.1 S₂.2.1) := rfl
            rw [hpre]
            exact ((convex_Ioo _ _).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod
              ((convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_ball _ _))
          let V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { y' : ℂ | -s_base < y'.im ∧ y'.im < s_base } ×ˢ D₁₂
          have hV₀_open : IsOpen V₀ :=
            ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
              (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
          have hV₀_ne : V₀.Nonempty :=
            ⟨((0 : ℂ), q.2), ⟨⟨by simp [hs_pos], by simp [hs_pos]⟩, hqD₁₂⟩⟩
          have hV₀_sub : V₀ ⊆ U₁ ∩ U₂ := by
            rw [hV_eq]
            rintro ⟨y', t'⟩ ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ht'⟩
            exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (max_le ha₁ ha₂) h1,
              lt_of_lt_of_le h2 (le_min hc₁ hc₂)⟩, ht'⟩
          have hAg₁_V₀ : MeroAgreesHolo S₁.2.2.2.2 (F_init i) V₀ :=
            meroAgreesHolo_mono hAg₁ hV₀_open (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.1⟩)
          have hAg₂_V₀ : MeroAgreesHolo S₂.2.2.2.2 (F_init i) V₀ :=
            meroAgreesHolo_mono hAg₂ hV₀_open (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.2⟩)
          have hEq_V₀ : MeroEqOn S₁.2.2.2.2 S₂.2.2.2.2 V₀ :=
            hMeroEqOfHolo S₁.2.2.2.2 S₂.2.2.2.2 hV₀_open hAg₁_V₀ hAg₂_V₀
          have hEq_V : MeroEqOn S₁.2.2.2.2 S₂.2.2.2.2 (U₁ ∩ U₂) :=
            hMeroEqConn S₁.2.2.2.2 S₂.2.2.2.2 Subset.rfl hV_open hV_conv.isPreconnected
              hV₀_open hV₀_ne hV₀_sub hEq_V₀
          exact hCompatOfEq S₁.2.2.2.2 S₂.2.2.2.2 hEq_V hp₁U hp₂U hq }

    refine ⟨h_ge_two, h_even, h_lsc, M_F, fun i => ⟨hU_base2_sub_TF, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
    have hpTF : p ∈ T_F := hU_base2_sub_TF hp
    obtain ⟨hball_U, heq_U⟩ := (pick_spec i p hpTF).2.2.2.2.2.2 hp.1
    have hrad_pos : 0 < (M_F i).rad p := (M_F i).rad_pos p hpTF
    have hrad_eq : (M_F i).rad p = (pick i p hpTF).2.2.2.2.rad p := by
      simp only [M_F, dif_pos hpTF]
    have hnum_eq : (M_F i).num p = (pick i p hpTF).2.2.2.2.num p := by
      simp only [M_F, dif_pos hpTF]
    have hden_eq : (M_F i).den p = (pick i p hpTF).2.2.2.2.den p := by
      simp only [M_F, dif_pos hpTF]
    refine ⟨(M_F i).rad p, hrad_pos, le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hrad_eq]; exact hball_U
    · intro q hq
      rw [hrad_eq] at hq
      rw [hnum_eq, hden_eq]
      exact heq_U q hq

  
  obtain ⟨hX_ge, hX_even, hX_lsc, X_mero, hX_agrees⟩ :=
    hEngine F_X hFX_holo hFX_even hFX_conj
  obtain ⟨hL_ge, hL_even, hL_lsc, L_mero, hL_agrees⟩ :=
    hEngine F_L hFL_holo hFL_even hFL_conj
  exact ⟨hX_ge, hL_ge, hX_even, hL_even, hX_lsc, hL_lsc, L_mero, X_mero, hL_agrees, hX_agrees⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C)
    (h_X_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * collarBaseS hDet) ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t)
    (h_L_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * collarBaseS hDet) ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t)
    (h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      collarWidthX C hDet (-t) = collarWidthX C hDet t)
    (h_L_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      collarWidthL C hDet (-t) = collarWidthL C hDet t) :
    ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (collarBaseR hDet),
      collarWidthL C hDet t = collarWidthX C hDet t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2)

(Ω : Set Plane)

    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let s_base : ℝ := collarBaseS hDet
  let r_base : ℝ := collarBaseR hDet
  let B : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base
  let S_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  let S_two : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  let F_L : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c
  let F_X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c
  let cramerDen (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
    F 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) -
      F 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)
  let cramerNum (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
    if i = 0 then
      F 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) - F 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)
    else
      F 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) - F 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)
  let reflNum (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
    let pm0 := F 0 (p.1 - 3 * p.2 / 2, p.2)
    let pm1 := F 1 (p.1 - 3 * p.2 / 2, p.2)
    let p00 := F 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)
    let p01 := F 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)
    let w0 := p01 - pm1
    let w1 := pm0 - p00
    let n0 := iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) p
    let n1 := -iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) p
    let wn := w0 * n0 + w1 * n1
    let nn := n0 * n0 + n1 * n1
    if i = 0 then (wn + wn) * n0 - nn * w0 else (wn + wn) * n1 - nn * w1
  let reflDen (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
    reflNum F 0 p * F 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) +
      reflNum F 1 p * F 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)

  
  have hPartialYHolo : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivY 1 f) W := by
    intro W hW f hf p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hR₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := R₀ / 4
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r) ⊆ W :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [r]; linarith)) hR₀_sub
    have hf_cont_cb : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r)) :=
      (hf.mono hcb_sub).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨M, hM_bound⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (3 * r)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf_cont_cb
    let M' : ℝ := max M 0
    have hM'_nonneg : 0 ≤ M' := le_max_right _ _
    have hM'_le : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r), ‖f q‖ ≤ M' :=
      fun q hq => le_trans (hM_bound q hq) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hfderiv_bound : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r), ‖fderiv ℂ f q‖ ≤ 2 * M' / r := by
      intro q hq
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
      by_cases hv : v = 0
      · simp [hv]
      · have hv_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
        let ρ : ℝ := (r / 2) / ‖v‖
        have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := div_pos (half_pos hr) hv_pos
        let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => f (q + z • v)
        have hg_maps : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ, q + z • v ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r) := by
          intro z hz
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hq ⊢
          have hzv : ‖z • v‖ ≤ r / 2 := by
            rw [norm_smul]
            calc ‖z‖ * ‖v‖ ≤ ρ * ‖v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz (le_of_lt hv_pos)
              _ = r / 2 := div_mul_cancel₀ (r / 2) (ne_of_gt hv_pos)
          calc dist (q + z • v) p₀ = ‖(q - p₀) + z • v‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖q - p₀‖ + ‖z • v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = dist q p₀ + ‖z • v‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
            _ ≤ 2 * r + r / 2 := by linarith
            _ ≤ 3 * r := by linarith
        have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ) := by
          intro z hz
          have hqzv : DifferentiableAt ℂ f (q + z • v) :=
            hf.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hcb_sub (hg_maps z hz)))
          have haff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => q + w • v) z :=
            (differentiableAt_const q).add (differentiableAt_id.smul_const v)
          exact (hqzv.comp z haff).differentiableWithinAt
        have hg_deriv0 : deriv g 0 = (fderiv ℂ f q) v := by
          have hq_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ f q :=
            hf.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hcb_sub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith) hq)))
          have haff : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => q + w • v) v 0 := by
            simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const v).const_add q
          have hq_at0 : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℂ f q) (q + (0 : ℂ) • v) := by
            simpa using hq_diff.hasFDerivAt
          exact (hq_at0.comp_hasDerivAt 0 haff).deriv
        have h_est := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρ_pos
          (hg_diff.mono Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall).diffContOnCl
          (fun z hz => hM'_le _ (hg_maps z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
        rw [hg_deriv0] at h_est
        calc ‖(fderiv ℂ f q) v‖ ≤ M' / ρ := h_est
          _ = 2 * M' / r * ‖v‖ := by dsimp [ρ]; field_simp
    let w0 : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap 0 r
    let cwt : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => deriv w0 θ * (w0 θ ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hw0_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖w0 θ‖ = r := fun θ => by
      simp [w0, circleMap, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)]
    have hw0_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, w0 θ ≠ 0 := fun θ h0 => by
      have := hw0_norm θ; rw [h0, norm_zero] at this; linarith
    have hcwt_cont : Continuous cwt := by
      have hd : deriv w0 = fun θ => circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I := by
        ext θ; exact (hasDerivAt_circleMap 0 r θ).deriv
      dsimp [cwt]
      rw [hd]
      refine ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const).mul ?_
      exact Continuous.inv₀ ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).pow 2) (fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hw0_ne θ))
    have hcwt_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖cwt θ‖ = r⁻¹ := by
      intro θ
      have hd : deriv w0 θ = w0 θ * Complex.I := (hasDerivAt_circleMap 0 r θ).deriv
      dsimp [cwt]
      rw [hd, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, hw0_norm θ]
      field_simp
    let shiftPt : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun θ p => (p.1 + w0 θ, p.2)
    have hshift_mem_cb2 : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2),
        shiftPt θ p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) := by
      intro θ p hp
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq]
      have hp1 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp
      have hp2 : dist p.2 p₀.2 < r / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp
      refine max_le ?_ (by linarith)
      calc dist (p.1 + w0 θ) p₀.1 = ‖(p.1 - p₀.1) + w0 θ‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖p.1 - p₀.1‖ + ‖w0 θ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = dist p.1 p₀.1 + r := by rw [dist_eq_norm, hw0_norm θ]
        _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
    let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => cwt θ * f (shiftPt θ p)
    have h_eq_int : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2),
        iterDerivY 1 f p = (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ := by
      intro p hp
      have h_slice_open : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' => f (y', p.2)) (Metric.ball p.1 (3 * r / 2)) := by
        intro y' hy'
        have hy'W : (y', p.2) ∈ W := by
          refine hcb_sub ?_
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy' hp
          have hp1 : dist p.1 p₀.1 < r / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp
          have hp2 : dist p.2 p₀.2 < r / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq]
          refine max_le ?_ (by linarith)
          calc dist y' p₀.1 ≤ dist y' p.1 + dist p.1 p₀.1 := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ 3 * r / 2 + r / 2 := by linarith
            _ ≤ 3 * r := by linarith
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy'W)).comp y'
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hcderiv := Complex.cderiv_eq_deriv Metric.isOpen_ball h_slice_open hr
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
      change deriv (fun y' => f (y', p.2)) p.1 = _
      rw [← hcderiv]
      unfold Complex.cderiv circleIntegral
      simp only [circleMap_sub_center, smul_eq_mul]
      congr 1
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      have hd1 : deriv (circleMap p.1 r) θ = circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I :=
        (hasDerivAt_circleMap p.1 r θ).deriv
      have hd0 : deriv w0 θ = circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I :=
        (hasDerivAt_circleMap 0 r θ).deriv
      dsimp only [F, cwt, shiftPt]
      rw [hd1, hd0]
      dsimp only [w0, circleMap]
      simp only [zero_add]
      ring
    let F' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
      fun p θ => cwt θ • fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p)
    have hF_hasFDeriv : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2), ∀ θ : ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p := by
      intro p hp θ
      have hmem : shiftPt θ p ∈ W :=
        hcb_sub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith) (hshift_mem_cb2 θ p hp))
      have hf_at : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p)) (shiftPt θ p) :=
        (hf.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
      have hsh_at : HasFDerivAt (shiftPt θ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ℂ × ℂ)) p := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 + w0 θ) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ) p := by
          simpa using (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).hasFDerivAt.add_const (w0 θ)
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) p :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ).hasFDerivAt
        exact h1.prodMk h2
      exact (hf_at.comp p hsh_at).const_smul (cwt θ)
    have hF_cont_θ : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2), Continuous (F p) := by
      intro p hp
      refine hcwt_cont.mul ?_
      have hsh_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => shiftPt θ p) :=
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_circleMap 0 r)).prodMk continuous_const
      exact hf_cont_cb.comp_continuous hsh_cont (fun θ =>
        Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith) (hshift_mem_cb2 θ p hp))
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      have h_decomp : F' p₀ = fun θ =>
          (cwt θ * (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (1, 0)) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
          (cwt θ * (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (0, 1)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ := by
        funext θ
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun q => ?_)
        rcases q with ⟨u, v⟩
        have huv : (u, v) = u • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by ext <;> simp
        change cwt θ * (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (u, v) =
          cwt θ * (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (1, 0) * u +
          cwt θ * (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (0, 1) * v
        rw [huv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_decomp]
      have h_dir_meas : ∀ v : ℂ × ℂ, ‖v‖ = 1 →
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
            (fun θ : ℝ => (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) v)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        intro v hv1
        let stepℝ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (r / 4) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
        let step : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (stepℝ n : ℂ)
        have hstepℝ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto stepℝ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        have hstep_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto step Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hstepℝ_tendsto
        have hstep_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, step n ≠ 0 := by
          intro n
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero (by positivity) (by positivity))
        have hstep_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖step n‖ ≤ r / 4 := by
          intro n
          dsimp [step, stepℝ]
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          exact div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
        let g_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ :=
          fun n θ => (step n)⁻¹ * (f (shiftPt θ p₀ + step n • v) - f (shiftPt θ p₀))
        have hg_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (g_seq n) := by
          intro n
          refine continuous_const.mul (Continuous.sub ?_ ?_)
          · have h_in : ∀ θ : ℝ, shiftPt θ p₀ + step n • v ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r) := by
              intro θ
              have hbase := hshift_mem_cb2 θ p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr))
              rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hbase ⊢
              calc dist (shiftPt θ p₀ + step n • v) p₀
                  = ‖(shiftPt θ p₀ - p₀) + step n • v‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; ring_nf
