                _ ≤ ‖shiftPt θ p₀ - p₀‖ + ‖step n • v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
                _ = dist (shiftPt θ p₀) p₀ + ‖step n‖ * ‖v‖ := by rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_smul]
                _ ≤ 2 * r + (r / 4) * 1 := by rw [hv1]; linarith [hstep_norm n]
                _ ≤ 3 * r := by linarith
            have hc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => shiftPt θ p₀ + step n • v) :=
              ((continuous_const.add (continuous_circleMap 0 r)).prodMk continuous_const).add continuous_const
            exact hf_cont_cb.comp_continuous hc h_in
          · have h_in : ∀ θ : ℝ, shiftPt θ p₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * r) :=
              fun θ => Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
                (hshift_mem_cb2 θ p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr)))
            have hc : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => shiftPt θ p₀) :=
              (continuous_const.add (continuous_circleMap 0 r)).prodMk continuous_const
            exact hf_cont_cb.comp_continuous hc h_in
        refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
          (fun n => (hg_cont n).aestronglyMeasurable) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => ?_)
        have hmem : shiftPt θ p₀ ∈ W :=
          hcb_sub (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
            (hshift_mem_cb2 θ p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr))))
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => f (shiftPt θ p₀ + z • v))
            ((fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) v) 0 := by
          have hf_at : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℂ f (shiftPt θ p₀)) (shiftPt θ p₀ + (0 : ℂ) • v) := by
            simpa using (hf.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
          have haff : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => shiftPt θ p₀ + z • v) v 0 := by
            simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const v).const_add (shiftPt θ p₀)
          exact hf_at.comp_hasDerivAt 0 haff
        have htend := hd1.tendsto_slope_zero.comp
          (tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ hstep_tendsto
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => hstep_ne n))
        simpa only [g_seq, Function.comp_def, slope_def_field, sub_zero, zero_add, zero_smul,
          add_zero, smul_eq_mul] using htend
      have hm1 := hcwt_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (h_dir_meas (1, 0) (by simp))
      have hm2 := hcwt_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (h_dir_meas (0, 1) (by simp))
      exact (hm1.smul_const _).add (hm2.smul_const _)
    have hF'_bound : ∀ᵐ θ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, θ ∈ Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r / 2), ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ r⁻¹ * (2 * M' / r) := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ p hp => ?_)
      dsimp [F']
      rw [norm_smul, hcwt_norm θ]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfderiv_bound _ (hshift_mem_cb2 θ p hp)) (by positivity)
    have h_int_diff := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ (half_pos hr))
      (Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ (half_pos hr))
        (fun p hp => (hF_cont_θ p hp).aestronglyMeasurable))
      ((hF_cont_θ p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr))).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      hF'_meas
      hF'_bound
      intervalIntegrable_const
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ p hp => hF_hasFDeriv p hp θ))
    have h_diff_int : DifferentiableAt ℂ
        (fun p => (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ) p₀ :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).mul h_int_diff.differentiableAt
    have h_ev_eq : iterDerivY 1 f =ᶠ[nhds p₀]
        (fun p => (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ (half_pos hr)) h_eq_int
    exact (h_diff_int.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev_eq).differentiableWithinAt

  
  have hs_eq_det : s_base = hDet.s_det := rfl
  have hs_pos : 0 < s_base := hDet.s_det_pos
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_base := lt_min hDet.r_det_pos (half_pos Real.pi_pos)
  have hr_le_det : r_base ≤ hDet.r_det := min_le_left _ _
  have hs_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4 := hDet.s_det_le_s₁
  have hr_lt_s4 : r_base < s_base / 4 := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_s_det
  have hr_lt_r₁_half : r_base < C.r₁ / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hr_le_det hDet.r_det_lt_r₁
  have hr₁_pos : 0 < C.r₁ := C.r₁_pos
  have hs₁_pos : 0 < C.s₁ := lt_trans C.r₁_pos C.r₁_lt_s₁

  have hBaseSubDet : S_two ⊆
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } :=
    fun _ hp => ⟨hp.1, by linarith [hp.2, hr_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
  have hFL_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_L i) S_two :=
    fun i => (hDet.dualLine_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet
  have hFX_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_X i) S_two :=
    fun i => (hDet.impact_holo i).mono hBaseSubDet

  have hEdgeId : ∀ (y_c t : ℂ), |y_c.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < r_base →
      let P_m := glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t
      let P_p := glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t
      let Λ := glancingDualLine C y_c t
      let Δ := P_m 0 * P_p 1 - P_m 1 * P_p 0
      (P_m 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C y_c t) +
        P_m 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C y_c t) = glancingOffset C y_c t) ∧
      (P_p 0 * Complex.cos (glancingTheta C y_c t) +
        P_p 1 * Complex.sin (glancingTheta C y_c t) = glancingOffset C y_c t) ∧
      (P_m 0 * Λ 0 + P_m 1 * Λ 1 = 1) ∧
      (P_p 0 * Λ 0 + P_p 1 * Λ 1 = 1) ∧
      (Δ * Λ 0 = P_p 1 - P_m 1) ∧
      (Δ * Λ 1 = P_m 0 - P_p 0) := by
    intro y_c t hy_c ht
    dsimp only
    have hy_s₁ : |y_c.im| < C.s₁ := by linarith
    have ht_r₁ : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith
    have hp_nz : glancingOffset C y_c t ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero y_c t (by linarith [hs_eq_det]) (by linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    set θ_m : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y_c - t) t
    set θ_0 : ℂ := glancingTheta C y_c t
    set θ_p : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y_c + t) t
    have hproj_p : glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos θ_0 +
        glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin θ_0 = glancingOffset C y_c t := by
      have hmid_p : glancingMidAngle C (y_c + t / 2) t = (θ_0 + θ_p) / 2 := by
        unfold glancingMidAngle
        have h1 : y_c + t / 2 - t / 2 = y_c := by ring
        have h2 : y_c + t / 2 + t / 2 = y_c + t := by ring
        rw [h1, h2]
      simp only [glancingImpact, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      rw [hmid_p]
      unfold glancingOffset supportAction1_ℂ
      have h_ang : (θ_0 + θ_p) / 2 - θ_0 = (θ_p - θ_0) / 2 := by ring
      have hc := Complex.cos_sub ((θ_0 + θ_p) / 2) θ_0
      have hs := Complex.sin_sub ((θ_0 + θ_p) / 2) θ_0
      rw [h_ang] at hc hs
      linear_combination C.h_ℂ ((θ_0 + θ_p) / 2) * hc.symm -
        deriv C.h_ℂ ((θ_0 + θ_p) / 2) * hs.symm
    have hproj_m : glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos θ_0 +
        glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin θ_0 = glancingOffset C y_c t := by
      have hmid_m : glancingMidAngle C (y_c - t / 2) t = (θ_m + θ_0) / 2 := by
        unfold glancingMidAngle
        have h1 : y_c - t / 2 - t / 2 = y_c - t := by ring
        have h2 : y_c - t / 2 + t / 2 = y_c := by ring
        rw [h1, h2]
      simp only [glancingImpact, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      rw [hmid_m]
      have hstat : glancingOffset C y_c t = supportAction2_ℂ C.h_ℂ θ_m θ_0 :=
        C.glancing_stationary y_c t hy_s₁ ht_r₁
      rw [hstat]
      unfold supportAction2_ℂ
      have h_ang : (θ_m + θ_0) / 2 - θ_0 = -((θ_0 - θ_m) / 2) := by ring
      have hc := Complex.cos_sub ((θ_m + θ_0) / 2) θ_0
      have hs := Complex.sin_sub ((θ_m + θ_0) / 2) θ_0
      rw [h_ang, Complex.cos_neg] at hc
      rw [h_ang, Complex.sin_neg] at hs
      linear_combination C.h_ℂ ((θ_m + θ_0) / 2) * hc.symm -
        deriv C.h_ℂ ((θ_m + θ_0) / 2) * hs.symm
    have hinc_m : glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 0 * glancingDualLine C y_c t 0 +
        glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 1 * glancingDualLine C y_c t 1 = 1 := by
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      calc glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 0 * (Complex.cos θ_0 / glancingOffset C y_c t) +
            glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 1 * (Complex.sin θ_0 / glancingOffset C y_c t)
          = (glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos θ_0 +
              glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin θ_0) / glancingOffset C y_c t := by ring
        _ = glancingOffset C y_c t / glancingOffset C y_c t := by rw [hproj_m]
        _ = 1 := div_self hp_nz
    have hinc_p : glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 0 * glancingDualLine C y_c t 0 +
        glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 1 * glancingDualLine C y_c t 1 = 1 := by
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      calc glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 0 * (Complex.cos θ_0 / glancingOffset C y_c t) +
            glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 1 * (Complex.sin θ_0 / glancingOffset C y_c t)
          = (glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 0 * Complex.cos θ_0 +
              glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 1 * Complex.sin θ_0) / glancingOffset C y_c t := by ring
        _ = glancingOffset C y_c t / glancingOffset C y_c t := by rw [hproj_p]
        _ = 1 := div_self hp_nz
    refine ⟨hproj_m, hproj_p, hinc_m, hinc_p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 1 * hinc_m -
        glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 1 * hinc_p
    · linear_combination -glancingImpact C (y_c + t / 2) t 0 * hinc_m +
        glancingImpact C (y_c - t / 2) t 0 * hinc_p

  have hs1_eq : ∀ p ∈ S_base, ∀ i : Fin 2, cramerNum F_L i p = F_X i p * cramerDen F_L p := by
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    have ht_im : |t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
    have hym_im : |(y - t / 2).im| < 2 * s_base := by
      have : (y - t / 2).im = y.im - t.im / 2 := by simp
      rw [this]
      linarith [abs_sub (y.im) (t.im / 2), abs_div (t.im) (2 : ℝ),
        abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have hyp_im : |(y + t / 2).im| < 2 * s_base := by
      have : (y + t / 2).im = y.im + t.im / 2 := by simp
      rw [this]
      linarith [abs_add_le (y.im) (t.im / 2), abs_div (t.im) (2 : ℝ),
        abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have h1 := (hEdgeId (y - t / 2) t hym_im ht).2.2.2.1
    have h2 := (hEdgeId (y + t / 2) t hyp_im ht).2.2.1
    have hy1 : y - t / 2 + t / 2 = y := by ring
    have hy2 : y + t / 2 - t / 2 = y := by ring
    rw [hy1] at h1
    rw [hy2] at h2
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [cramerNum, cramerDen, F_L, F_X, ↓reduceIte]
      linear_combination -glancingDualLine C (y - t / 2) t 1 * h2 +
        glancingDualLine C (y + t / 2) t 1 * h1
    · dsimp only [cramerNum, cramerDen, F_L, F_X]
      rw [if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)]
      linear_combination -glancingDualLine C (y + t / 2) t 0 * h1 +
        glancingDualLine C (y - t / 2) t 0 * h2

  have hTheta_real : ∀ (x t : ℝ), |t| < C.r₁ →
      glancingTheta C (x : ℂ) (t : ℂ) = ((C.ϕ (C.U ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x t ht
    have hconj := C.U_conj (x : ℂ) (t : ℂ) (by simp; linarith)
      (by simpa [Complex.norm_real] using ht)
    simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
    have him : (C.U ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
    have hU_eq : C.U ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = (((C.U ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [him]
    unfold glancingTheta
    rw [hU_eq]
    exact C.ϕ_ℂ_real _

  have hOpen_sh : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hderiv_h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv hOpen_sh
  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℝ C.h := C.h_smooth.differentiable (by decide)
  have hh'_diff : Differentiable ℝ (deriv C.h) :=
    (C.h_smooth.of_le (m := ((1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) (by decide)).deriv'.differentiable_one

  have hderiv_h_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, deriv C.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ) = ((deriv C.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    have hmem : (θ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      change |(θ : ℂ).im| < 2 * C.s_h
      simp [C.s_h_pos]
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) (deriv C.h_ℂ (θ : ℂ)) θ :=
      ((C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hmem)).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) ((deriv C.h θ : ℝ) : ℂ) θ := by
      have heq : (fun x : ℝ => C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) = (fun x : ℝ => ((C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
        funext C.h_ℂ_real
      rw [heq]
      exact (hh_diff θ).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp
    exact hd1.unique hd2

  have hderiv2_h_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ : ℂ) = ((deriv (deriv C.h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro θ
    have hmem : (θ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      change |(θ : ℂ).im| < 2 * C.s_h
      simp [C.s_h_pos]
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => deriv C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ : ℂ)) θ :=
      ((hderiv_h_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hmem)).hasDerivAt).comp_ofReal
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => deriv C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) ((deriv (deriv C.h) θ : ℝ) : ℂ) θ := by
      have heq : (fun x : ℝ => deriv C.h_ℂ (x : ℂ)) = (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv C.h x : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
        funext hderiv_h_real
      rw [heq]
      exact (hh'_diff θ).hasDerivAt.ofReal_comp
    exact hd1.unique hd2

  let t₀ : ℝ := r_base / 2
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := half_pos hr_pos
  have ht₀_lt_r : t₀ < r_base := half_lt_self hr_pos
  have ht₀_lt_r₁ : t₀ < C.r₁ := by linarith
  have ht₀_abs_r₁ : |t₀| < C.r₁ := by rw [abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]; exact ht₀_lt_r₁
  let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))
  have hp₀_mem : p₀ ∈ S_base := by
    refine ⟨by simp [p₀, hs_pos], ?_⟩
    simp only [p₀, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]
    exact ht₀_lt_r

  have hs1_nz : ∃ q₀ ∈ S_base, cramerDen F_L q₀ ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨p₀, hp₀_mem, ?_⟩
    set off_p : ℂ := glancingOffset C ((t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)
    set off_m : ℂ := glancingOffset C (-(t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)
    have hp_pos_nz : off_p ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero ((t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [hDet.s_det_pos])
        (by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]; linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    have hp_neg_nz : off_m ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero (-(t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [hDet.s_det_pos])
        (by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]; linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    have h_th_p : glancingTheta C ((t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        ((C.ϕ (C.U (((t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have : (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this, hTheta_real (t₀ / 2) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
    have h_th_m : glancingTheta C (-(t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        ((C.ϕ (C.U (((-t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have : -(t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((-t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this, hTheta_real (-t₀ / 2) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
    set ϑ_p : ℝ := C.ϕ (C.U (((t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
    set ϑ_m : ℝ := C.ϕ (C.U (((-t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
    have hstep := C.U_real_step_pos (-t₀ / 2) t₀ ht₀_pos ht₀_lt_r₁
    have h_sum_t₀ : ((-t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t₀ : ℂ) = ((t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_sum_t₀] at hstep
    have hdiff_pos : 0 < ϑ_p - ϑ_m := hstep.2.1
    have hdiff_lt_pi : ϑ_p - ϑ_m < Real.pi := hstep.2.2
    have hsin_pos : 0 < Real.sin (ϑ_p - ϑ_m) := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hdiff_pos hdiff_lt_pi
    intro hzero
    have hprod_zero : cramerDen F_L p₀ * (off_p * off_m) = 0 := by
      rw [hzero, zero_mul]
    have hprod_eq : cramerDen F_L p₀ * (off_p * off_m) =
        ((-Real.sin (ϑ_p - ϑ_m) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have ha : p₀.1 + p₀.2 / 2 = (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 := by simp [p₀]
      have hb : p₀.1 - p₀.2 / 2 = -(t₀ : ℂ) / 2 := by simp [p₀]; ring
      have hp2 : p₀.2 = (t₀ : ℂ) := rfl
      dsimp only [cramerDen, F_L]
      rw [ha, hb, hp2]
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      change (Complex.cos (glancingTheta C ((t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)) / off_p *
          (Complex.sin (glancingTheta C (-(t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)) / off_m) -
        Complex.sin (glancingTheta C ((t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)) / off_p *
          (Complex.cos (glancingTheta C (-(t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)) / off_m)) *
        (off_p * off_m) = _
      rw [h_th_p, h_th_m, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
        ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
      field_simp [hp_pos_nz, hp_neg_nz]
      rw [Real.sin_sub]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hprod_eq] at hprod_zero
    have hsin_zero : -Real.sin (ϑ_p - ϑ_m) = 0 := Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hprod_zero
    linarith

  have hReflFormula : ∀ (y t : ℂ), (y, t) ∈ S_base →
      let ψ_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun y' => glancingMidAngle C (y' - t / 2) t
      let ψ₀ : ℂ := ψ_fn y
      let D_P : ℂ := F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) * F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) -
        F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) * F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t)
      let p_m1 : ℂ := glancingOffset C (y - t) t
      let p_0 : ℂ := glancingOffset C y t
      let κ : ℂ := (C.h_ℂ ψ₀ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) ψ₀) * deriv ψ_fn y
      DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_fn y ∧
      reflDen F_X (y, t) = (D_P / p_m1) * κ ^ 2 * p_0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, reflNum F_X i (y, t) = F_L i (y, t) * reflDen F_X (y, t)) := by
    intro y t hp_S
    have hy : |y.im| < s_base := hp_S.1
    have ht : ‖t‖ < r_base := hp_S.2
    dsimp only
    have ht_im : |t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
    have hy_sub_t : |(y - t).im| < 2 * s_base := by
      have : (y - t).im = y.im - t.im := by simp
      rw [this]
      linarith [abs_sub y.im t.im]
    have hEdge_m1 := hEdgeId (y - t) t hy_sub_t ht
    have h_arg1 : y - t - t / 2 = y - 3 * t / 2 := by ring
    have h_arg2 : y - t + t / 2 = y - t / 2 := by ring
    have hp_m1_nz : glancingOffset C (y - t) t ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero (y - t) t (by linarith [hs_eq_det]) (by linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    have hp_0_nz : glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero y t (by linarith [hs_eq_det]) (by linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    let D_P : ℂ := F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) * F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) -
      F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) * F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t)
    let p_m1 : ℂ := glancingOffset C (y - t) t
    let p_0 : ℂ := glancingOffset C y t
    let θ_m1 : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y - t) t
    let θ_0 : ℂ := glancingTheta C y t
    have hw0_eq : F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) - F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) =
        (D_P / p_m1) * Complex.cos θ_m1 := by
      have h := hEdge_m1.2.2.2.2.1
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero] at h
      rw [h_arg1, h_arg2] at h
      change F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) - F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) = (D_P / p_m1) * Complex.cos θ_m1
      dsimp only [D_P, F_X, p_m1, θ_m1]
      rw [← h]; ring
    have hw1_eq : F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) - F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t) =
        (D_P / p_m1) * Complex.sin θ_m1 := by
      have h := hEdge_m1.2.2.2.2.2
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero] at h
      rw [h_arg1, h_arg2] at h
      change F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t) - F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t) = (D_P / p_m1) * Complex.sin θ_m1
      dsimp only [D_P, F_X, p_m1, θ_m1]
      rw [← h]; ring
    let ψ_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun y' => glancingMidAngle C (y' - t / 2) t
    have hTh_diffAt : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| < C.s₁ → DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' => glancingTheta C y' t) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hU_open : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * C.s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < C.r₁ } :=
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
          continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
      have hU_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' => C.U (y', t)) z :=
        (C.U_holo.differentiableAt (hU_open.mem_nhds ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)).comp z
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t))
      have hU_strip : C.U (z, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) :=
        C.U_maps_to z t (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hOpen_s₀ : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s₀)) :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
      exact (C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_s₀.mem_nhds hU_strip)).comp z hU_at
    have hψ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_fn y := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' => glancingTheta C (y' - t / 2 - t / 2) t) y := by
        have hsub : |(y - t / 2 - t / 2).im| < C.s₁ := by
          have : y - t / 2 - t / 2 = y - t := by ring
          rw [this]; linarith
        have haff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => y' - t / 2 - t / 2) y :=
          (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const _)).sub (differentiableAt_const _)
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ ((fun y' => glancingTheta C y' t) ∘ (fun y' : ℂ => y' - t / 2 - t / 2)) y
        exact (hTh_diffAt _ hsub).comp y haff
      have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' => glancingTheta C (y' - t / 2 + t / 2) t) y := by
        have hsub : |(y - t / 2 + t / 2).im| < C.s₁ := by
          have : y - t / 2 + t / 2 = y := by ring
          rw [this]; linarith
        have haff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => y' - t / 2 + t / 2) y :=
          (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const _)).add (differentiableAt_const _)
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ ((fun y' => glancingTheta C y' t) ∘ (fun y' : ℂ => y' - t / 2 + t / 2)) y
        exact (hTh_diffAt _ hsub).comp y haff
      exact (h1.add h2).div_const 2
    let ψ₀ : ℂ := ψ_fn y
    have hψ₀_eq : ψ₀ = (θ_m1 + θ_0) / 2 := by
      dsimp only [ψ₀, ψ_fn, glancingMidAngle, θ_m1, θ_0]
      have h1 : y - t / 2 - t / 2 = y - t := by ring
      have h2 : y - t / 2 + t / 2 = y := by ring
      rw [h1, h2]
    have hψ₀_strip : ψ₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      have hm_strip : θ_m1 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
        C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (C.U_maps_to (y - t) t (by linarith) (by linarith))
      have h0_strip : θ_0 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
        C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (C.U_maps_to y t (by linarith) (by linarith))
      rw [hψ₀_eq]
      change |((θ_m1 + θ_0) / 2).im| < 2 * C.s_h
      have him : ((θ_m1 + θ_0) / 2).im = (θ_m1.im + θ_0.im) / 2 := by simp
      rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      have h1 : |θ_m1.im| < 2 * C.s_h := hm_strip
      have h2 : |θ_0.im| < 2 * C.s_h := h0_strip
      linarith [abs_add_le θ_m1.im θ_0.im]
    let κ : ℂ := (C.h_ℂ ψ₀ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) ψ₀) * deriv ψ_fn y
    have hd_h : HasDerivAt (fun y' => C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y')) (deriv C.h_ℂ ψ₀ * deriv ψ_fn y) y := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hψ₀_strip)).hasDerivAt.comp y hψ_diff.hasDerivAt
    have hd_dh : HasDerivAt (fun y' => deriv C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y'))
        (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) ψ₀ * deriv ψ_fn y) y := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (hderiv_h_holo.differentiableAt (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hψ₀_strip)).hasDerivAt.comp y hψ_diff.hasDerivAt
    have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun y' => Complex.cos (ψ_fn y')) (-Complex.sin ψ₀ * deriv ψ_fn y) y := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos ψ₀).comp y hψ_diff.hasDerivAt
    have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun y' => Complex.sin (ψ_fn y')) (Complex.cos ψ₀ * deriv ψ_fn y) y := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin ψ₀).comp y hψ_diff.hasDerivAt
    have hn0_eq : iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t) =
        κ * Complex.cos ψ₀ := by
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun y' =>
          C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.sin (ψ_fn y') + deriv C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.cos (ψ_fn y'))
          (κ * Complex.cos ψ₀) y := by
        convert (hd_h.mul hd_sin).add (hd_dh.mul hd_cos) using 1
        dsimp [κ, ψ₀]; ring
      have hfn_eq : (fun y' => F_X 1 (y' - t / 2, t)) = (fun y' =>
          C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.sin (ψ_fn y') + deriv C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.cos (ψ_fn y')) := by
        ext y'
        simp [F_X, glancingImpact, ψ_fn]
      change deriv (fun y' => F_X 1 (y' - t / 2, t)) y = _
      rw [hfn_eq]
      exact hd1.deriv
    have hn1_eq : -iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t) =
        κ * Complex.sin ψ₀ := by
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt (fun y' =>
          C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.cos (ψ_fn y') - deriv C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.sin (ψ_fn y'))
          (-(κ * Complex.sin ψ₀)) y := by
        convert (hd_h.mul hd_cos).sub (hd_dh.mul hd_sin) using 1
        dsimp [κ, ψ₀]; ring
      have hfn_eq : (fun y' => F_X 0 (y' - t / 2, t)) = (fun y' =>
          C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.cos (ψ_fn y') - deriv C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn y') * Complex.sin (ψ_fn y')) := by
        ext y'
        simp [F_X, glancingImpact, ψ_fn]
      change -deriv (fun y' => F_X 0 (y' - t / 2, t)) y = _
      rw [hfn_eq, hd0.deriv, neg_neg]
    have hθ_rel : θ_0 = (ψ₀ + ψ₀) - θ_m1 := by rw [hψ₀_eq]; ring
    let c_w : ℂ := D_P / p_m1
    have hNum0 : reflNum F_X 0 (y, t) = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0 := by
      change (let pm0 := F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t)
        let pm1 := F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t)
        let p00 := F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t)
        let p01 := F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t)
        let w0 := p01 - pm1
        let w1 := pm0 - p00
        let n0 := iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t)
        let n1 := -iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t)
        let wn := w0 * n0 + w1 * n1
        let nn := n0 * n0 + n1 * n1
        (wn + wn) * n0 - nn * w0) = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0
      dsimp only
      rw [hw0_eq, hw1_eq, hn0_eq, hn1_eq, hθ_rel, Complex.cos_sub, Complex.cos_add, Complex.sin_add]
      ring
    have hNum1 : reflNum F_X 1 (y, t) = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0 := by
      change (let pm0 := F_X 0 (y - 3 * t / 2, t)
        let pm1 := F_X 1 (y - 3 * t / 2, t)
        let p00 := F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t)
        let p01 := F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t)
        let w0 := p01 - pm1
        let w1 := pm0 - p00
        let n0 := iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t)
        let n1 := -iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) (y, t)
        let wn := w0 * n0 + w1 * n1
        let nn := n0 * n0 + n1 * n1
        (wn + wn) * n1 - nn * w1) = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0
      dsimp only
      rw [hw0_eq, hw1_eq, hn0_eq, hn1_eq, hθ_rel, Complex.sin_sub, Complex.sin_add, Complex.cos_add]
      ring
    have hproj_0 : F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t) * Complex.cos θ_0 +
        F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) * Complex.sin θ_0 = p_0 :=
      (hEdgeId y t (by linarith) ht).1
    have hDen : reflDen F_X (y, t) = c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0 := by
      dsimp only [reflDen]
      rw [hNum0, hNum1]
      calc c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0 * F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t) +
            c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0 * F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t)
          = c_w * κ ^ 2 *
              (F_X 0 (y - t / 2, t) * Complex.cos θ_0 + F_X 1 (y - t / 2, t) * Complex.sin θ_0) := by ring
        _ = c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0 := by rw [hproj_0]
    have hp0_ne : p_0 ≠ 0 := hp_0_nz
    refine ⟨hψ_diff, hDen, Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hNum0, hDen]
      simp only [F_L, glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      change c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0 = (Complex.cos θ_0 / p_0) * (c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0)
      symm
      calc (Complex.cos θ_0 / p_0) * (c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0)
          = (c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0) * p_0 / p_0 := by ring
        _ = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ_0 := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hp0_ne
    · rw [hNum1, hDen]
      simp only [F_L, glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      change c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0 = (Complex.sin θ_0 / p_0) * (c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0)
      symm
      calc (Complex.sin θ_0 / p_0) * (c_w * κ ^ 2 * p_0)
          = (c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0) * p_0 / p_0 := by ring
        _ = c_w * κ ^ 2 * Complex.sin θ_0 := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hp0_ne

  have hs2_eq : ∀ p ∈ S_base, ∀ i : Fin 2, reflNum F_X i p = F_L i p * reflDen F_X p :=
    fun ⟨y, t⟩ hp i => (hReflFormula y t hp).2.2 i

  have hs2_nz : ∃ q₀ ∈ S_base, reflDen F_X q₀ ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨p₀, hp₀_mem, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hψ_diff0, hDen0, _⟩ := hReflFormula 0 (t₀ : ℂ) hp₀_mem
    change reflDen F_X (0, (t₀ : ℂ)) ≠ 0
    rw [hDen0]
    have hp_m1_nz : glancingOffset C ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ)) (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ)) (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [hDet.s_det_pos])
        (by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]; linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    have hp_0_nz : glancingOffset C 0 (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      hDet.offset_ne_zero 0 (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [hDet.s_det_pos])
        (by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]; linarith [hDet.r_det_pos])
    have hDP_nz : F_X 0 ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
        F_X 1 ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) -
      F_X 1 ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
        F_X 0 ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
      set ϑ_m2 : ℝ := C.ϕ (C.U (((-2 * t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
      set ϑ_m1 : ℝ := C.ϕ (C.U (((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
      set ϑ_0 : ℝ := C.ϕ (C.U ((0 : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
      set ψ_m : ℝ := (ϑ_m2 + ϑ_m1) / 2
      set ψ_p : ℝ := (ϑ_m1 + ϑ_0) / 2
      have hmid_m : glancingMidAngle C ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) = (ψ_m : ℂ) := by
        unfold glancingMidAngle
        have h1 : (0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((-2 * t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        have h2 : (0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h1, h2, hTheta_real (-2 * t₀) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁, hTheta_real (-t₀) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
        dsimp [ψ_m, ϑ_m2, ϑ_m1]; push_cast; ring
      have hmid_p : glancingMidAngle C ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ) = (ψ_p : ℂ) := by
        unfold glancingMidAngle
        have h1 : (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        have h2 : (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h1, h2, hTheta_real (-t₀) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁, hTheta_real 0 t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero]
        dsimp [ψ_p, ϑ_m1, ϑ_0]; push_cast; ring
      let P_ℝ (ψ : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ :=
        ![C.h ψ * Real.cos ψ - deriv C.h ψ * Real.sin ψ,
          C.h ψ * Real.sin ψ + deriv C.h ψ * Real.cos ψ]
      have hImp_m : ∀ i : Fin 2,
          F_X i ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) = (P_ℝ ψ_m i : ℂ) := by
        refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
        · simp only [F_X, glancingImpact, P_ℝ, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
            hmid_m, C.h_ℂ_real, hderiv_h_real, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
          push_cast; rfl
      have hImp_p : ∀ i : Fin 2,
          F_X i ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) = (P_ℝ ψ_p i : ℂ) := by
        refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
        · simp only [F_X, glancingImpact, P_ℝ, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
            hmid_p, C.h_ℂ_real, hderiv_h_real, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
          push_cast; rfl
      have hEdge_real := hEdgeId ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ)) (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [hs_pos])
        (by simp [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt ht₀_pos)]; exact ht₀_lt_r)
      have ha1 : (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = (0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 := by ring
      have ha2 : (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 := by ring
      have ha3 : (0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) = ((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have hpm_proj := hEdge_real.1
      have hpp_proj := hEdge_real.2.1
      rw [ha1] at hpm_proj
      rw [ha2] at hpp_proj
      have hth_m1_eq : glancingTheta C ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ)) (t₀ : ℂ) = (ϑ_m1 : ℂ) := by
        rw [ha3, hTheta_real (-t₀) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
      let p_real : ℝ := P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * Real.cos ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * Real.sin ϑ_m1
      have hp_cast : (p_real : ℂ) = glancingOffset C ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ)) (t₀ : ℂ) := by
        rw [← hpm_proj, hth_m1_eq]
        change (p_real : ℂ) = F_X 0 ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.cos (ϑ_m1 : ℂ) +
          F_X 1 ((0 : ℂ) - 3 * (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.sin (ϑ_m1 : ℂ)
        rw [hImp_m 0, hImp_m 1]
        simp only [p_real, Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]
      have hp_real_nz : p_real ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hp_m1_nz (by rw [← hp_cast, h0, Complex.ofReal_zero])
      have hpp_real : P_ℝ ψ_p 0 * Real.cos ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_p 1 * Real.sin ϑ_m1 = p_real := by
        apply Complex.ofReal_injective
        rw [hp_cast, ← hpp_proj, hth_m1_eq]
        change ↑(P_ℝ ψ_p 0 * Real.cos ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_p 1 * Real.sin ϑ_m1) =
          F_X 0 ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.cos (ϑ_m1 : ℂ) +
          F_X 1 ((0 : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2, (t₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.sin (ϑ_m1 : ℂ)
        rw [hImp_p 0, hImp_p 1]
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]
      let F_mono : ℝ → ℝ := fun ψ => C.h ψ * Real.sin (ψ - ϑ_m1) + deriv C.h ψ * Real.cos (ψ - ϑ_m1)
      have hF_proj : ∀ ψ : ℝ, -P_ℝ ψ 0 * Real.sin ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ 1 * Real.cos ϑ_m1 = F_mono ψ := by
        intro ψ
        simp only [P_ℝ, F_mono, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_sub]
        ring
      have hΔ_factor : P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * P_ℝ ψ_p 1 - P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * P_ℝ ψ_p 0 =
          p_real * (F_mono ψ_p - F_mono ψ_m) := by
        rw [← hF_proj ψ_p, ← hF_proj ψ_m]
        have hcs_r : Real.cos ϑ_m1 ^ 2 + Real.sin ϑ_m1 ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq ϑ_m1
        have hm_r : P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * Real.cos ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * Real.sin ϑ_m1 = p_real := rfl
        linear_combination -(P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * P_ℝ ψ_p 1 - P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * P_ℝ ψ_p 0) * hcs_r +
          (-P_ℝ ψ_p 0 * Real.sin ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_p 1 * Real.cos ϑ_m1) * hm_r -
          (-P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * Real.sin ϑ_m1 + P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * Real.cos ϑ_m1) * hpp_real
      have hF_deriv : ∀ ψ : ℝ,
          HasDerivAt F_mono ((C.h ψ + deriv (deriv C.h) ψ) * Real.cos (ψ - ϑ_m1)) ψ := by
        intro ψ
        have h1 := (hh_diff ψ).hasDerivAt
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin (u - ϑ_m1)) (Real.cos (ψ - ϑ_m1)) ψ := by
          simpa [Function.comp_def] using
            (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (ψ - ϑ_m1)).comp ψ ((hasDerivAt_id ψ).sub_const ϑ_m1)
        have h3 := (hh'_diff ψ).hasDerivAt
        have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.cos (u - ϑ_m1)) (-Real.sin (ψ - ϑ_m1)) ψ := by
          simpa [Function.comp_def] using
            (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (ψ - ϑ_m1)).comp ψ ((hasDerivAt_id ψ).sub_const ϑ_m1)
        convert (h1.mul h2).add (h3.mul h4) using 1
        ring
      have hF_cont : Continuous F_mono :=
        Differentiable.continuous (fun ψ => (hF_deriv ψ).differentiableAt)
      have hstep1 := C.U_real_step_pos (-2 * t₀) t₀ ht₀_pos ht₀_lt_r₁
      have hstep2 := C.U_real_step_pos (-t₀) t₀ ht₀_pos ht₀_lt_r₁
      have hs1_eq_pt : ((-2 * t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t₀ : ℂ) = ((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have hs2_eq_pt : ((-t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t₀ : ℂ) = (0 : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hs1_eq_pt] at hstep1
      rw [hs2_eq_pt] at hstep2
      have h1_pos : 0 < ϑ_m1 - ϑ_m2 := hstep1.2.1
      have h1_lt : ϑ_m1 - ϑ_m2 < Real.pi := hstep1.2.2
      have h2_pos : 0 < ϑ_0 - ϑ_m1 := hstep2.2.1
      have h2_lt : ϑ_0 - ϑ_m1 < Real.pi := hstep2.2.2
      have hψm_lt_ψp : ψ_m < ψ_p := by dsimp [ψ_m, ψ_p]; linarith
      have hF_mono : StrictMonoOn F_mono (Set.Icc ψ_m ψ_p) :=
        strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc ψ_m ψ_p) hF_cont.continuousOn (fun ψ hψ => by
          have hψ_icc := interior_subset hψ
          rw [(hF_deriv ψ).deriv]
          refine mul_pos (C.r_pos ψ) (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
          · dsimp [ψ_m] at hψ_icc; linarith [hψ_icc.1]
          · dsimp [ψ_p] at hψ_icc; linarith [hψ_icc.2])
      have hF_lt : F_mono ψ_m < F_mono ψ_p :=
        hF_mono ⟨le_rfl, hψm_lt_ψp.le⟩ ⟨hψm_lt_ψp.le, le_rfl⟩ hψm_lt_ψp
      rw [hImp_m 0, hImp_p 1, hImp_m 1, hImp_p 0]
      have hcast_eq : (P_ℝ ψ_m 0 : ℂ) * (P_ℝ ψ_p 1 : ℂ) - (P_ℝ ψ_m 1 : ℂ) * (P_ℝ ψ_p 0 : ℂ) =
          ((P_ℝ ψ_m 0 * P_ℝ ψ_p 1 - P_ℝ ψ_m 1 * P_ℝ ψ_p 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [hcast_eq, hΔ_factor]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hp_real_nz (sub_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hF_lt)))
    let ψ_fn0 : ℂ → ℂ := fun y' => glancingMidAngle C (y' - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2) (t₀ : ℂ)
    let u_ℝ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (C.U ((x : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
    let ψ_ℝ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (C.ϕ (u_ℝ (x - t₀)) + C.ϕ (u_ℝ x)) / 2
    have hψ_real_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, ψ_fn0 (x : ℂ) = (ψ_ℝ x : ℂ) := by
      intro x
      dsimp only [ψ_fn0, ψ_ℝ, u_ℝ, glancingMidAngle]
      have h1 : (x : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = ((x - t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      have h2 : (x : ℂ) - (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 = (x : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [h1, h2, hTheta_real (x - t₀) t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁, hTheta_real x t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁]
      push_cast; ring
    have hcurv_nz : C.h_ℂ (ψ_fn0 0) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (ψ_fn0 0) ≠ 0 := by
      have h0_eq : ψ_fn0 0 = (ψ_ℝ 0 : ℂ) := by simpa using hψ_real_eq 0
      rw [h0_eq, C.h_ℂ_real, hderiv2_h_real, ← Complex.ofReal_add]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (C.r_pos (ψ_ℝ 0)))
    have hdψ_nz : deriv ψ_fn0 0 ≠ 0 := by
      have hu_deriv : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt u_ℝ (deriv u_ℝ z) z ∧ 0 < deriv u_ℝ z := by
        intro z
        have hpos := C.U_real_deriv_pos z t₀ ht₀_abs_r₁
        exact ⟨(differentiableAt_of_deriv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hpos)).hasDerivAt, hpos⟩
      have hϕ_diff : Differentiable ℝ C.ϕ := C.ϕ_smooth.differentiable (by decide)
      have hu_sub : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => u_ℝ (x - t₀)) (deriv u_ℝ (0 - t₀) * 1) 0 := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using
          (hu_deriv (0 - t₀)).1.comp 0 ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).sub_const t₀)
      have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => C.ϕ (u_ℝ (x - t₀)))
          (deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ (0 - t₀)) * (deriv u_ℝ (0 - t₀) * 1)) 0 := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hϕ_diff _).hasDerivAt.comp 0 hu_sub
      have hd_id : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => C.ϕ (u_ℝ x))
          (deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ 0) * deriv u_ℝ 0) 0 := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (hϕ_diff _).hasDerivAt.comp 0 (hu_deriv 0).1
      have hd_ψℝ : HasDerivAt ψ_ℝ
          ((deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ (0 - t₀)) * (deriv u_ℝ (0 - t₀) * 1) +
            deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ 0) * deriv u_ℝ 0) / 2) 0 :=
        (hd_sub.add hd_id).div_const 2
      have hd_val_pos : 0 < (deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ (0 - t₀)) * (deriv u_ℝ (0 - t₀) * 1) +
          deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ 0) * deriv u_ℝ 0) / 2 := by
        have hp1 := C.ϕ_deriv_pos (u_ℝ (0 - t₀))
        have hp2 := (hu_deriv (0 - t₀)).2
        have hp3 := C.ϕ_deriv_pos (u_ℝ 0)
        have hp4 := (hu_deriv 0).2
        positivity
      have hd_c1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ψ_fn0 (x : ℂ)) (deriv ψ_fn0 0) 0 := by
        simpa using hψ_diff0.hasDerivAt.comp_ofReal
      have hd_c2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ψ_fn0 (x : ℂ))
          ((((deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ (0 - t₀)) * (deriv u_ℝ (0 - t₀) * 1) +
            deriv C.ϕ (u_ℝ 0) * deriv u_ℝ 0) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) 0 := by
        have heq : (fun x : ℝ => ψ_fn0 (x : ℂ)) = (fun x : ℝ => (ψ_ℝ x : ℂ)) :=
          funext hψ_real_eq
        rw [heq]
        exact hd_ψℝ.ofReal_comp
      rw [hd_c1.unique hd_c2]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hd_val_pos)
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hDP_nz hp_m1_nz)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 (mul_ne_zero hcurv_nz hdψ_nz))) hp_0_nz

  
  let cyl (a c : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { y : ℂ | a < y.im ∧ y.im < c } ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ

  have hCylOpen : ∀ a c : ℝ, ∀ t_c : ℂ, ∀ δ : ℝ, IsOpen (cyl a c t_c δ) :=
    fun a c t_c δ =>
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball

  have hCylConv : ∀ a c : ℝ, ∀ t_c : ℂ, ∀ δ : ℝ, Convex ℝ (cyl a c t_c δ) :=
    fun a c t_c δ =>
      ((convex_Ioo a c).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod (convex_ball t_c δ)

  have hCylPreconn : ∀ a c : ℝ, ∀ t_c : ℂ, ∀ δ : ℝ, IsPreconnected (cyl a c t_c δ) :=
    fun a c t_c δ => (hCylConv a c t_c δ).isPreconnected

  have hCylNonempty : ∀ {a c : ℝ} {t_c : ℂ} {δ : ℝ}, a < c → 0 < δ → (cyl a c t_c δ).Nonempty := by
    intro a c t_c δ hac hδ
    refine ⟨((((a + c) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t_c), ?_, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  have hBaseCylEq : ∀ (t_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ),
      ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ) = cyl (-s_base) s_base t_c δ := by
    intro t_c δ; ext ⟨y, t'⟩; simp [cyl, abs_lt]

  have hS_base_eq : S_base = cyl (-s_base) s_base 0 r_base := by
    ext ⟨y, t'⟩
    simp [S_base, cyl, abs_lt, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]

  have hEqZeroConv2D : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) →
      ∀ q ∈ W, f q = 0 := by
    intro W V hW hW_conv hV ⟨q_base, hq_baseV⟩ hVW f hf hfV q hqW
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun lam => q_base + lam • (q - q_base)
    have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ :=
      (differentiable_const q_base).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - q_base))
    have hU_open : IsOpen (Φ ⁻¹' W) := hW.preimage hΦ_diff.continuous
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ (Φ ⁻¹' W) := by
      intro lam₁ hlam₁ lam₂ hlam₂ a b ha hb hab
      have hmem : a • Φ lam₁ + b • Φ lam₂ ∈ W := hW_conv hlam₁ hlam₂ ha hb hab
      have hab_C : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have heq : Φ (a • lam₁ + b • lam₂) = a • Φ lam₁ + b • Φ lam₂ := by
        ext <;> simp only [Φ, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
          Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        · linear_combination -q_base.1 * hab_C
        · linear_combination -q_base.2 * hab_C
      change Φ (a • lam₁ + b • lam₂) ∈ W
      rwa [heq]
    have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' W := by change Φ 0 ∈ W; simpa [Φ] using hVW hq_baseV
    have h1 : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' W := by change Φ 1 ∈ W; simpa [Φ] using hqW
    have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ Φ) (Φ ⁻¹' W) :=
      (hf.comp hΦ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)).analyticOnNhd hU_open
    have hg_ev : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have hpre : Φ ⁻¹' V ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
        hΦ_diff.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by simpa [Φ] using hV.mem_nhds hq_baseV)
      filter_upwards [hpre] with lam hlam
      exact hfV (Φ lam) hlam
    have hres :=
      hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hU_conv.isPreconnected h0 hg_ev h1
    simpa [Φ] using hres

  have hBallShrunkNZ : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ} {r r' : ℝ} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < r' → r' ≤ r → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball p r) →
      (∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, g q ≠ 0) → ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r', g q ≠ 0 := by
    intro p r r' g hr' hr'_le hg ⟨q₀, hq₀, hnz⟩
    by_contra h_all
    push_neg at h_all
    exact hnz (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr'⟩ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr'_le) hg h_all q₀ hq₀)

  have hBallMulNZ : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ} {r : ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ (Metric.ball p r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ (Metric.ball p r) →
      (∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, g₁ q ≠ 0) → (∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, g₂ q ≠ 0) →
      ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, g₁ q * g₂ q ≠ 0 := by
    intro p r g₁ g₂ _ hg₁ hg₂ ⟨q₁, hq₁, hnz₁⟩ ⟨q₂, hq₂, hnz₂⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousAt g₁ q₁ :=
      hg₁.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq₁)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hclose⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont ‖g₁ q₁‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hnz₁)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hsub_ball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp Metric.isOpen_ball q₁ hq₁
    let δ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ₂
    have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
    have hsub : Metric.ball q₁ δ ⊆ Metric.ball p r :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hsub_ball
    have hg₂_ex : ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ δ, g₂ q ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      exact hnz₂ (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨q₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩ hsub hg₂ h_all q₂ hq₂)
    obtain ⟨q_star, hq_star, hnz_star⟩ := hg₂_ex
    refine ⟨q_star, hsub hq_star, mul_ne_zero ?_ hnz_star⟩
    intro hz1
    have hlt := hclose (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq_star) (min_le_left _ _))
    rw [hz1, dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg] at hlt
    exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

  have hCancelDenOnBall : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ} {r : ℝ} {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen O → O.Nonempty → O ⊆ Metric.ball p r →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball p r) → DifferentiableOn ℂ d (Metric.ball p r) →
      (∃ z ∈ Metric.ball p r, d z ≠ 0) →
      (∀ z ∈ O, g z * d z = 0) → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r, g z = 0 := by
    intro p r O g d hO hO_ne hO_sub hg hd ⟨z_d, hz_d, hd_nz⟩ hmul
    have hd_ex_O : ∃ z₀ ∈ O, d z₀ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      exact hd_nz (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) hO hO_ne hO_sub hd h_all z_d hz_d)
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀O, hdz₀⟩ := hd_ex_O
    have hd_cont : ContinuousAt d z₀ :=
      hd.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hO_sub hz₀O))
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hclose⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hd_cont ‖d z₀‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hdz₀)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hballO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO z₀ hz₀O
    let δ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ₂
    have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
    have hball_sub_O : Metric.ball z₀ δ ⊆ O :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hballO
    have hg_zero_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ, g z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hdz_ne : d z ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        have hlt := hclose (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _))
        rw [hzero, dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg] at hlt
        exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul z (hball_sub_O hz))).resolve_right hdz_ne
    exact hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩ (hball_sub_O.trans hO_sub) hg hg_zero_ball

  let meroAdd : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W} M₁ M₂ =>
      { rad := fun p => min (M₁.rad p) (M₂.rad p)
        num := fun p q => M₁.num p q * M₂.den p q + M₂.num p q * M₁.den p q
        den := fun p q => M₁.den p q * M₂.den p q
        rad_pos := fun p hp => lt_min (M₁.rad_pos p hp) (M₂.rad_pos p hp)
        ball_sub := fun p hp =>
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans (M₁.ball_sub p hp)
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          (((M₁.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((M₂.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).add
          (((M₂.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
            ((M₁.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
        den_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((M₁.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((M₂.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          have hr_min : 0 < min (M₁.rad p) (M₂.rad p) := lt_min (M₁.rad_pos p hp) (M₂.rad_pos p hp)
          exact hBallMulNZ hr_min
            ((M₁.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))
            ((M₂.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_left _ _) (M₁.den_holo p hp) (M₁.den_ne_zero p hp))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_right _ _) (M₂.den_holo p hp) (M₂.den_ne_zero p hp))
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          have h1 := M₁.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2⟩
          have h2 := M₂.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.2⟩
          linear_combination M₂.den p₁ q * M₂.den p₂ q * h1 + M₁.den p₁ q * M₁.den p₂ q * h2 }

  have meroAdd_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M₁ M₂ : MeroOn2D W} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M₁ f₁ U → MeroAgreesHolo M₂ f₂ U →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroAdd M₁ M₂) (fun q => f₁ q + f₂ q) U := by
    intro W U M₁ M₂ f₁ f₂ ⟨hUW, h₁⟩ ⟨_, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁_le, hr₁_sub, heq₁⟩ := h₁ p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂_le, _, heq₂⟩ := h₂ p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, min_le_min hr₁_le hr₂_le,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hr₁_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    dsimp only [meroAdd]
    rw [heq₁ q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq),
      heq₂ q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)]
    ring

  let meroNeg : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W} M =>
      { rad := M.rad
        num := fun p q => -M.num p q
        den := M.den
        rad_pos := M.rad_pos
        ball_sub := M.ball_sub
        num_holo := fun p hp => (M.num_holo p hp).neg
        den_holo := M.den_holo
        den_ne_zero := M.den_ne_zero
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          have h := M.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
          linear_combination -h }

  have meroNeg_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M : MeroOn2D W} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M f U → MeroAgreesHolo (meroNeg M) (fun q => -f q) U := by
    intro W U M f ⟨hUW, hloc⟩
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, heq⟩ := hloc p hp
    refine ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    dsimp only [meroNeg]
    rw [heq q hq]
    ring

  let meroSub : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun M₁ M₂ => meroAdd M₁ (meroNeg M₂)

  have meroSub_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M₁ M₂ : MeroOn2D W} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M₁ f₁ U → MeroAgreesHolo M₂ f₂ U →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroSub M₁ M₂) (fun q => f₁ q - f₂ q) U := by
    intro W U M₁ M₂ f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
    have h := meroAdd_agrees h₁ (meroNeg_agrees h₂)
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using h

  let meroMul : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W} M₁ M₂ =>
      { rad := fun p => min (M₁.rad p) (M₂.rad p)
        num := fun p q => M₁.num p q * M₂.num p q
        den := fun p q => M₁.den p q * M₂.den p q
        rad_pos := fun p hp => lt_min (M₁.rad_pos p hp) (M₂.rad_pos p hp)
        ball_sub := fun p hp =>
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans (M₁.ball_sub p hp)
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((M₁.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((M₂.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
        den_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((M₁.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((M₂.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          have hr_min : 0 < min (M₁.rad p) (M₂.rad p) := lt_min (M₁.rad_pos p hp) (M₂.rad_pos p hp)
          exact hBallMulNZ hr_min
            ((M₁.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))
            ((M₂.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_left _ _) (M₁.den_holo p hp) (M₁.den_ne_zero p hp))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_right _ _) (M₂.den_holo p hp) (M₂.den_ne_zero p hp))
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          have h1 := M₁.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2⟩
          have h2 := M₂.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.2⟩
          linear_combination M₂.num p₁ q * M₂.den p₂ q * h1 + M₁.num p₂ q * M₁.den p₁ q * h2 }

  have meroMul_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M₁ M₂ : MeroOn2D W} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M₁ f₁ U → MeroAgreesHolo M₂ f₂ U →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroMul M₁ M₂) (fun q => f₁ q * f₂ q) U := by
    intro W U M₁ M₂ f₁ f₂ ⟨hUW, h₁⟩ ⟨_, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁_le, hr₁_sub, heq₁⟩ := h₁ p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂_le, _, heq₂⟩ := h₂ p hp
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁ hr₂, min_le_min hr₁_le hr₂_le,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hr₁_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    dsimp only [meroMul]
    rw [heq₁ q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq),
      heq₂ q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)]
    ring

  let shiftMap (α : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ := (p.1 + (α : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)
  have hShiftDiff : ∀ α : ℝ, Differentiable ℂ (shiftMap α) := fun α =>
    (differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const (α : ℂ)).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
      differentiable_snd
  have hShiftInv : ∀ (α : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ), shiftMap (-α) (shiftMap α p) = p := by
    intro α ⟨y, t'⟩
    apply Prod.ext <;> simp [shiftMap]

  let meroPullbackShift : ∀ {W W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (α : ℝ), IsOpen W →
      (∀ p ∈ W, shiftMap α p ∈ W') → MeroOn2D W' → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W W'} α hW hMaps M =>
      let O_fn : ℂ × ℂ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        fun p => W ∩ (shiftMap α) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (shiftMap α p) (M.rad (shiftMap α p))
      have hO_mem : ∀ p ∈ W, IsOpen (O_fn p) ∧ p ∈ O_fn p := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨hW.inter (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (hShiftDiff α).continuous),
          hp, Metric.mem_ball_self (M.rad_pos _ (hMaps p hp))⟩
      let rad_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ :=
        fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then
          Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hO_mem p hp).1 p (hO_mem p hp).2)
        else 1
      have hrad_spec : ∀ p ∈ W, 0 < rad_fn p ∧ Metric.ball p (rad_fn p) ⊆ O_fn p := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp only [rad_fn]
        rw [dif_pos hp]
        exact Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hO_mem p hp).1 p (hO_mem p hp).2)
      { rad := rad_fn
        num := fun p q => M.num (shiftMap α p) (shiftMap α q)
        den := fun p q => M.den (shiftMap α p) (shiftMap α q)
        rad_pos := fun p hp => (hrad_spec p hp).1
        ball_sub := fun p hp q hq => ((hrad_spec p hp).2 hq).1
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          (M.num_holo _ (hMaps p hp)).comp (hShiftDiff α).differentiableOn
            (fun q hq => ((hrad_spec p hp).2 hq).2)
        den_holo := fun p hp =>
          (M.den_holo _ (hMaps p hp)).comp (hShiftDiff α).differentiableOn
            (fun q hq => ((hrad_spec p hp).2 hq).2)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          by_contra h_all
          push_neg at h_all
          let V_img : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (shiftMap (-α)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball p (rad_fn p)
          have hV_open : IsOpen V_img :=
            Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (hShiftDiff (-α)).continuous
          have hV_ne : V_img.Nonempty := by
            refine ⟨shiftMap α p, ?_⟩
            show shiftMap (-α) (shiftMap α p) ∈ Metric.ball p (rad_fn p)
            rw [hShiftInv]
            exact Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad_spec p hp).1
          have hV_sub : V_img ⊆ Metric.ball (shiftMap α p) (M.rad (shiftMap α p)) := by
            intro z hz
            have hinv : shiftMap α (shiftMap (-α) z) = z := by
              simpa using hShiftInv (-α) z
            rw [← hinv]
            exact ((hrad_spec p hp).2 hz).2
          have hV_zero : ∀ z ∈ V_img, M.den (shiftMap α p) z = 0 := by
            intro z hz
            have hinv : shiftMap α (shiftMap (-α) z) = z := by
              simpa using hShiftInv (-α) z
            rw [← hinv]
            exact h_all (shiftMap (-α) z) hz
          obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hnz⟩ := M.den_ne_zero (shiftMap α p) (hMaps p hp)
          exact hnz (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) hV_open hV_ne hV_sub
            (M.den_holo _ (hMaps p hp)) hV_zero q₀ hq₀)
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
          M.compat (shiftMap α p₁) (hMaps p₁ hp₁) (shiftMap α p₂) (hMaps p₂ hp₂) (shiftMap α q)
            ⟨((hrad_spec p₁ hp₁).2 hq.1).2, ((hrad_spec p₂ hp₂).2 hq.2).2⟩ }

  have meroPullbackShift_agrees : ∀ {W W' U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (α : ℝ) (hW : IsOpen W)
      (hMaps : ∀ p ∈ W, shiftMap α p ∈ W') {M : MeroOn2D W'} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M f U' → IsOpen U → U ⊆ W → (∀ p ∈ U, shiftMap α p ∈ U') →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroPullbackShift α hW hMaps M) (fun q => f (shiftMap α q)) U := by
    intro W W' U U' α hW hMaps M f ⟨_, hloc⟩ hU hUW hUMaps
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r', hr', _, _, heq'⟩ := hloc (shiftMap α p) (hUMaps p hp)
    have hO_open : IsOpen (U ∩ (shiftMap α) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (shiftMap α p) r') :=
      hU.inter (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (hShiftDiff α).continuous)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO_open p ⟨hp, Metric.mem_ball_self hr'⟩
    let M_pb := meroPullbackShift α hW hMaps M
    have hrad_pos : 0 < M_pb.rad p := M_pb.rad_pos p (hUW hp)
    refine ⟨min r₁ (M_pb.rad p), lt_min hr₁ hrad_pos, min_le_right _ _,
      fun q hq => (hr₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)).1,
      fun q hq => heq' (shiftMap α q) (hr₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)).2⟩

  have hIterY_congr : ∀ {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen O → (∀ r ∈ O, g₁ r = g₂ r) → ∀ q ∈ O, iterDerivY 1 g₁ q = iterDerivY 1 g₂ q := by
    intro O g₁ g₂ hO heq ⟨y, t'⟩ hq
    have h_ev : (fun y' : ℂ => g₁ (y', t')) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun y' : ℂ => g₂ (y', t')) := by
      have h_pre : (fun y' : ℂ => (y', t')) ⁻¹' O ∈ nhds y :=
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hO.mem_nhds hq)
      filter_upwards [h_pre] with y' hy'
      exact heq (y', t') hy'
    exact h_ev.deriv_eq

  have hIterY_mul : ∀ {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen O → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ O → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ O →
      ∀ q ∈ O, iterDerivY 1 (fun r => g₁ r * g₂ r) q =
        iterDerivY 1 g₁ q * g₂ q + g₁ q * iterDerivY 1 g₂ q := by
    intro O g₁ g₂ hO hg₁ hg₂ ⟨y, t'⟩ hq
    have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℂ => g₁ (y', t')) (iterDerivY 1 g₁ (y, t')) y :=
      ((hg₁.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hq)).comp y
        (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t'))).hasDerivAt
    have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℂ => g₂ (y', t')) (iterDerivY 1 g₂ (y, t')) y :=
      ((hg₂.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hq)).comp y
        (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t'))).hasDerivAt
    exact (hd₁.mul hd₂).deriv

  let meroDerivY : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroOn2D W → MeroOn2D W :=
    fun {W} M =>
      { rad := M.rad
        num := fun p q => iterDerivY 1 (M.num p) q * M.den p q - M.num p q * iterDerivY 1 (M.den p) q
        den := fun p q => M.den p q * M.den p q
        rad_pos := M.rad_pos
        ball_sub := M.ball_sub
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((hPartialYHolo Metric.isOpen_ball (M.num_holo p hp)).mul (M.den_holo p hp)).sub
            ((M.num_holo p hp).mul (hPartialYHolo Metric.isOpen_ball (M.den_holo p hp)))
        den_holo := fun p hp => (M.den_holo p hp).mul (M.den_holo p hp)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          obtain ⟨q, hq, hnz⟩ := M.den_ne_zero p hp
          exact ⟨q, hq, mul_ne_zero hnz hnz⟩
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          let O := Metric.ball p₁ (M.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (M.rad p₂)
          have hO : IsOpen O := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
          have h_eq_all : ∀ r ∈ O, M.num p₁ r * M.den p₂ r = M.num p₂ r * M.den p₁ r :=
            fun r hr => M.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ r hr
          have h_eq : M.num p₁ q * M.den p₂ q = M.num p₂ q * M.den p₁ q := h_eq_all q hq
          have h_d := hIterY_congr hO h_eq_all q hq
          rw [hIterY_mul hO ((M.num_holo p₁ hp₁).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
              ((M.den_holo p₂ hp₂).mono Set.inter_subset_right) q hq,
            hIterY_mul hO ((M.num_holo p₂ hp₂).mono Set.inter_subset_right)
              ((M.den_holo p₁ hp₁).mono Set.inter_subset_left) q hq] at h_d
          linear_combination M.den p₁ q * M.den p₂ q * h_d -
            (iterDerivY 1 (M.den p₁) q * M.den p₂ q + M.den p₁ q * iterDerivY 1 (M.den p₂) q) * h_eq }

  have meroDerivY_agrees : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {M : MeroOn2D W} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      MeroAgreesHolo M f U → IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroDerivY M) (iterDerivY 1 f) U := by
    intro W U M f ⟨hUW, hloc⟩ _ hf
    refine ⟨hUW, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, heq⟩ := hloc p hp
    refine ⟨r, hr, hr_le, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have h_d := hIterY_congr Metric.isOpen_ball heq q hq
    rw [hIterY_mul Metric.isOpen_ball (hf.mono hr_sub)
      ((M.den_holo p (hUW hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le)) q hq] at h_d
    dsimp only [meroDerivY]
    rw [h_d, heq q hq]
    ring

  have meroDiv_exists : ∀ {W U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (N D : MeroOn2D W)
      {n₀ d₀ f_target : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsPreconnected W →
      MeroAgreesHolo N n₀ U → MeroAgreesHolo D d₀ U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ d₀ U →
      (∃ q₀ ∈ U, d₀ q₀ ≠ 0) →
      (∀ q ∈ U, n₀ q = f_target q * d₀ q) →
      ∃ Q : MeroOn2D W, MeroAgreesHolo Q f_target U := by
    intro W U N D n₀ d₀ f_target hW_preconn hN_ag hD_ag hd₀_holo ⟨q₀, hq₀U, hd₀_nz⟩ hcross
    let Z_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ W | ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D.rad p), D.num p q ≠ 0 }
    let Z_zero : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ W | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D.rad p), D.num p q = 0 }
    let O_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ p ∈ Z_plus, Metric.ball p (D.rad p)
    let O_zero : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ p ∈ Z_zero, Metric.ball p (D.rad p)
    have hO_plus_open : IsOpen O_plus := isOpen_biUnion (fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hO_zero_open : IsOpen O_zero := isOpen_biUnion (fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have h_disj : Disjoint O_plus O_zero := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx_plus hx_zero
      obtain ⟨p₁, ⟨hp₁W, q₁, hq₁, hnz₁⟩, hx₁⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx_plus
      obtain ⟨p₂, ⟨hp₂W, hzero₂⟩, hx₂⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx_zero
      let O_ov := Metric.ball p₁ (D.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (D.rad p₂)
      have hmul : ∀ z ∈ O_ov, D.num p₁ z * D.den p₂ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        rw [D.compat p₁ hp₁W p₂ hp₂W z hz, hzero₂ z hz.2, zero_mul]
      have hd₂_ex : ∃ z₀ ∈ O_ov, D.den p₂ z₀ ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_all
        push_neg at h_all
        obtain ⟨z_d, hz_d, hdz_nz⟩ := D.den_ne_zero p₂ hp₂W
        exact hdz_nz (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _)
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ Set.inter_subset_right
          (D.den_holo p₂ hp₂W) h_all z_d hz_d)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀O, hdz₀⟩ := hd₂_ex
      have hd₂_cont : ContinuousAt (D.den p₂) z₀ :=
        (D.den_holo p₂ hp₂W).continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz₀O.2)
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hclose⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hd₂_cont ‖D.den p₂ z₀‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hdz₀)
      obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hballO⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) z₀ hz₀O
      let δ := min δ₁ δ₂
      have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
      have hball_sub_O : Metric.ball z₀ δ ⊆ O_ov :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hballO
      have hnum₁_zero_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ, D.num p₁ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hdz_ne : D.den p₂ z ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          have hlt := hclose (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _))
          rw [h0, dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg] at hlt
          exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul z (hball_sub_O hz))).resolve_right hdz_ne
      exact hnz₁ (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩ (hball_sub_O.trans Set.inter_subset_left)
        (D.num_holo p₁ hp₁W) hnum₁_zero_ball q₁ hq₁)
    have h_cov : W ⊆ O_plus ∪ O_zero := by
      intro p hpW
      by_cases hex : ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D.rad p), D.num p q ≠ 0
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpW, hex⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (D.rad_pos p hpW)⟩)
      · push_neg at hex
        exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpW, hex⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (D.rad_pos p hpW)⟩)
    have hq₀_plus : q₀ ∈ O_plus := by
      have hq₀W : q₀ ∈ W := hD_ag.1 hq₀U
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀_le, hr₀_sub, heq₀⟩ := hD_ag.2 q₀ hq₀U
      have hprod_nz := hBallMulNZ hr₀ (hd₀_holo.mono hr₀_sub)
        ((D.den_holo q₀ hq₀W).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀_le))
        ⟨q₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀, hd₀_nz⟩
        (hBallShrunkNZ hr₀ hr₀_le (D.den_holo q₀ hq₀W) (D.den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀W))
      obtain ⟨q_nz, hq_nz, hmul_nz⟩ := hprod_nz
      have hnum_nz : D.num q₀ q_nz ≠ 0 := by rw [heq₀ q_nz hq_nz]; exact hmul_nz
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨q₀, ⟨hq₀W, q_nz, Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀_le hq_nz, hnum_nz⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self (D.rad_pos q₀ hq₀W)⟩
    have hW_sub_plus : W ⊆ O_plus := by
      rcases hW_preconn.subset_or_subset hO_plus_open hO_zero_open h_disj h_cov with h1 | h2
      · exact h1
      · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp h_disj hq₀_plus (h2 (hD_ag.1 hq₀U)))
    have hD_num_nz : ∀ p ∈ W, ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D.rad p), D.num p q ≠ 0 := by
      intro p hpW
      by_contra h_none
      push_neg at h_none
      have hp_zero : p ∈ O_zero :=
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpW, h_none⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (D.rad_pos p hpW)⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h_disj (hW_sub_plus hpW) hp_zero
    let Q : MeroOn2D W :=
      { rad := fun p => min (N.rad p) (D.rad p)
        num := fun p q => N.num p q * D.den p q
        den := fun p q => N.den p q * D.num p q
        rad_pos := fun p hp => lt_min (N.rad_pos p hp) (D.rad_pos p hp)
        ball_sub := fun p hp =>
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans (N.ball_sub p hp)
        num_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((N.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((D.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
        den_holo := fun p hp =>
          ((N.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((D.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          have hr_min : 0 < min (N.rad p) (D.rad p) := lt_min (N.rad_pos p hp) (D.rad_pos p hp)
          exact hBallMulNZ hr_min
            ((N.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)))
            ((D.num_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_left _ _) (N.den_holo p hp) (N.den_ne_zero p hp))
            (hBallShrunkNZ hr_min (min_le_right _ _) (D.num_holo p hp) (hD_num_nz p hp))
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          have hN := N.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2⟩
          have hD := D.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.1,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.2⟩
          linear_combination D.den p₁ q * D.num p₂ q * hN - N.num p₂ q * N.den p₁ q * hD }
    refine ⟨Q, hN_ag.1, fun p hpU => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨rN, hrN, hrN_le, hrN_sub, heqN⟩ := hN_ag.2 p hpU
    obtain ⟨rD, hrD, hrD_le, _, heqD⟩ := hD_ag.2 p hpU
    refine ⟨min rN rD, lt_min hrN hrD, min_le_min hrN_le hrD_le,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hrN_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hqU : q ∈ U := hrN_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
    dsimp only [Q]
    rw [heqN q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq),
      heqD q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq), hcross q hqU]
    ring

  have hPropagateHolo : ∀ {W U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : MeroOn2D W) {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → U ⊆ W →
      V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → MeroAgreesHolo M f V →
      ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (M.rad p) ∩ U, M.num p q = f q * M.den p q := by
    intro W U V M f hU_open hU_preconn hUW ⟨v₀, hv₀V⟩ hVU hf_holo hAgV
    let r_U : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ U then
        min (M.rad p) (Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p hp))
      else 1
    have hr_U_spec : ∀ p ∈ U, 0 < r_U p ∧ r_U p ≤ M.rad p ∧ Metric.ball p (r_U p) ⊆ U := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only [r_U]
      rw [dif_pos hp]
      have hc := Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p hp)
      exact ⟨lt_min (M.rad_pos p (hUW hp)) hc.1, min_le_left _ _,
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hc.2⟩
    let E_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ U | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_U p), M.num p q = f q * M.den p q }
    let E_ne : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ U | ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_U p), M.num p q ≠ f q * M.den p q }
    let O_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ p ∈ E_eq, Metric.ball p (r_U p)
    let O_ne : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ p ∈ E_ne, Metric.ball p (r_U p)
    have hO_eq_open : IsOpen O_eq := isOpen_biUnion (fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hO_ne_open : IsOpen O_ne := isOpen_biUnion (fun _ _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have h_disj : Disjoint O_eq O_ne := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx_eq hx_ne
      obtain ⟨p₁, ⟨hp₁U, heq₁⟩, hx₁⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx_eq
      obtain ⟨p₂, ⟨hp₂U, q₂, hq₂, hne₂⟩, hx₂⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx_ne
      let O_ov := Metric.ball p₁ (r_U p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (r_U p₂)
      have hmul : ∀ z ∈ O_ov, (M.num p₂ z - f z * M.den p₂ z) * M.den p₁ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hc := M.compat p₁ (hUW hp₁U) p₂ (hUW hp₂U) z
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₁ hp₁U).2.1 hz.1,
           Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₂ hp₂U).2.1 hz.2⟩
        have h1 := heq₁ z hz.1
        linear_combination -hc + M.den p₂ z * h1
      have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => M.num p₂ z - f z * M.den p₂ z)
          (Metric.ball p₂ (r_U p₂)) :=
        ((M.num_holo p₂ (hUW hp₂U)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₂ hp₂U).2.1)).sub
          ((hf_holo.mono (hr_U_spec p₂ hp₂U).2.2).mul
            ((M.den_holo p₂ (hUW hp₂U)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₂ hp₂U).2.1)))
      have hd₁_ex : ∃ z₀ ∈ O_ov, M.den p₁ z₀ ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_all
        push_neg at h_all
        obtain ⟨z_d, hz_d, hdz_nz⟩ := M.den_ne_zero p₁ (hUW hp₁U)
        exact hdz_nz (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _)
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
          (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₁ hp₁U).2.1))
          (M.den_holo p₁ (hUW hp₁U)) h_all z_d hz_d)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀O, hdz₀⟩ := hd₁_ex
      have hd₁_cont : ContinuousAt (M.den p₁) z₀ :=
        (M.den_holo p₁ (hUW hp₁U)).continuousOn.continuousAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec p₁ hp₁U).2.1 hz₀O.1))
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hclose⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hd₁_cont ‖M.den p₁ z₀‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hdz₀)
      obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hballO⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) z₀ hz₀O
      let δ := min δ₁ δ₂
      have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
      have hball_sub_O : Metric.ball z₀ δ ⊆ O_ov :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hballO
      have hzero_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ, M.num p₂ z - f z * M.den p₂ z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hdz_ne : M.den p₁ z ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          have hlt := hclose (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) (min_le_left _ _))
          rw [h0, dist_eq_norm, zero_sub, norm_neg] at hlt
          exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul z (hball_sub_O hz))).resolve_right hdz_ne
      have hzero_all := hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩ (hball_sub_O.trans Set.inter_subset_right)
        hdiff_holo hzero_ball q₂ hq₂
      exact hne₂ (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero_all)
    have h_cov : U ⊆ O_eq ∪ O_ne := by
      intro p hpU
      by_cases hall : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_U p), M.num p q = f q * M.den p q
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpU, hall⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_U_spec p hpU).1⟩)
      · push_neg at hall
        exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpU, hall⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_U_spec p hpU).1⟩)
    have hv₀_eq : v₀ ∈ O_eq := by
      have hv₀U : v₀ ∈ U := hVU hv₀V
      obtain ⟨r_v, hr_v, _, _, heq_v⟩ := hAgV.2 v₀ hv₀V
      let r_min := min r_v (r_U v₀)
      have hr_min : 0 < r_min := lt_min hr_v (hr_U_spec v₀ hv₀U).1
      have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => M.num v₀ z - f z * M.den v₀ z)
          (Metric.ball v₀ (r_U v₀)) :=
        ((M.num_holo v₀ (hUW hv₀U)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec v₀ hv₀U).2.1)).sub
          ((hf_holo.mono (hr_U_spec v₀ hv₀U).2.2).mul
            ((M.den_holo v₀ (hUW hv₀U)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec v₀ hv₀U).2.1)))
      have hzero_small : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball v₀ r_min, M.num v₀ z - f z * M.den v₀ z = 0 :=
        fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (heq_v z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz))
      have hall : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball v₀ (r_U v₀), M.num v₀ q = f q * M.den v₀ q := fun q hq =>
        sub_eq_zero.mp (hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) Metric.isOpen_ball
          ⟨v₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_min⟩ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
          hdiff_holo hzero_small q hq)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨v₀, ⟨hv₀U, hall⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_U_spec v₀ hv₀U).1⟩
    have hU_sub_eq : U ⊆ O_eq := by
      rcases hU_preconn.subset_or_subset hO_eq_open hO_ne_open h_disj h_cov with h1 | h2
      · exact h1
      · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp h_disj hv₀_eq (h2 (hVU hv₀V)))
    have hE_eq_all : ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_U p), M.num p q = f q * M.den p q := by
      intro p hpU
      by_contra h_not
      push_neg at h_not
      have hp_ne : p ∈ O_ne :=
        Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, ⟨hpU, h_not⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_U_spec p hpU).1⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h_disj (hU_sub_eq hpU) hp_ne
    intro p hpW q ⟨hq_ball, hqU⟩
    let ρ_q := min (r_U q) (M.rad p - dist q p)
    have hρ_q : 0 < ρ_q := lt_min (hr_U_spec q hqU).1 (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq_ball))
    have hsub_p : Metric.ball q ρ_q ⊆ Metric.ball p (M.rad p) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
      have hz2 : dist z q < M.rad p - dist q p := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
      linarith [dist_triangle z q p]
    have hsub_q : Metric.ball q ρ_q ⊆ Metric.ball q (r_U q) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
    have hmul : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball q ρ_q, (M.num p z - f z * M.den p z) * M.den q z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hc := M.compat p hpW q (hUW hqU) z
        ⟨hsub_p hz, Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec q hqU).2.1 (hsub_q hz)⟩
      have hq_eq := hE_eq_all q hqU z (hsub_q hz)
      linear_combination hc + M.den p z * hq_eq
    have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => M.num p z - f z * M.den p z)
        (Metric.ball q ρ_q) :=
      ((M.num_holo p hpW).mono hsub_p).sub
        ((hf_holo.mono (hsub_q.trans (hr_U_spec q hqU).2.2)).mul ((M.den_holo p hpW).mono hsub_p))
    have hdq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (M.den q) (Metric.ball q ρ_q) :=
      (M.den_holo q (hUW hqU)).mono (hsub_q.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_U_spec q hqU).2.1))
    have hdq_nz : ∃ z ∈ Metric.ball q ρ_q, M.den q z ≠ 0 :=
      hBallShrunkNZ hρ_q ((min_le_left _ _).trans (hr_U_spec q hqU).2.1)
        (M.den_holo q (hUW hqU)) (M.den_ne_zero q (hUW hqU))
    have hzero := hCancelDenOnBall Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_q⟩
      Subset.rfl hdiff_holo hdq_holo hdq_nz hmul q (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_q)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzero

  have hGlueLower : ∀ (F_init : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) {t : ℂ} {b δ : ℝ},
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_init i) S_two) →
      s_base < b → 0 < δ → Metric.ball t δ ⊆ B →
      ∀ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-s_base) b t δ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (F_init i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)) →
      ∃ G_ext : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (cyl (-2 * s_base) b t δ),
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G_ext i) (F_init i)
          (cyl (-2 * s_base) (min b (2 * s_base)) t δ) := by
    intro F_init t b δ hF_holo hb hδ hδ_sub G hG
    let b_h : ℝ := min b (2 * s_base)
    have hb_h_gt : s_base < b_h := lt_min hb (by linarith)
    let W_up := cyl (-s_base) b t δ
    let W_ext := cyl (-2 * s_base) b t δ
    let W_holo := cyl (-2 * s_base) b_h t δ
    let W_ov := cyl (-s_base) b_h t δ
    have hWholo_open : IsOpen W_holo := hCylOpen (-2 * s_base) b_h t δ
    have hWholo_sub_two : W_holo ⊆ S_two := by
      rintro ⟨y, t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ht'⟩
      have hb_h_le : b_h ≤ 2 * s_base := min_le_right _ _
      refine ⟨abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, lt_of_lt_of_le hy2 hb_h_le⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hδ_sub ht'
    have hWholo_sub_ext : W_holo ⊆ W_ext :=
      fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hExt_not_holo : ∀ p ∈ W_ext, p ∉ W_holo → p ∈ W_up := by
      rintro ⟨y, t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ht'⟩ hnot
      have hge : b_h ≤ y.im := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact hnot ⟨⟨hy1, not_le.mp hlt⟩, ht'⟩
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hb_h_gt, hs_pos], hy2⟩, ht'⟩
    have hOv_prop : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ W_up,
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((G i).rad p) ∩ W_holo,
          (G i).num p q = F_init i q * (G i).den p q := by
      intro i p hp q ⟨hq_ball, hq_holo⟩
      have hq_up : q ∈ W_up := (G i).ball_sub p hp hq_ball
      have hq_ov : q ∈ W_ov := ⟨⟨hq_up.1.1, hq_holo.1.2⟩, hq_up.2⟩
      have hG_cyl : MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (F_init i) (cyl (-s_base) s_base t δ) := by
        rw [← hBaseCylEq]; exact hG i
      exact hPropagateHolo (G i) (hCylOpen (-s_base) b_h t δ) (hCylPreconn (-s_base) b_h t δ)
        (fun r hr => ⟨⟨hr.1.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hr.1.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩, hr.2⟩)
        (hCylNonempty (by linarith) hδ)
        (fun r hr => ⟨⟨hr.1.1, lt_trans hr.1.2 hb_h_gt⟩, hr.2⟩)
        ((hF_holo i).mono (fun r hr => hWholo_sub_two ⟨⟨by linarith [hr.1.1, hs_pos], hr.1.2⟩, hr.2⟩))
        hG_cyl p hp q ⟨hq_ball, hq_ov⟩
    let r_holo : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ W_holo then Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWholo_open p hp) else 1
    have hr_holo_spec : ∀ p ∈ W_holo, 0 < r_holo p ∧ Metric.ball p (r_holo p) ⊆ W_holo := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp only [r_holo]
      rw [dif_pos hp]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWholo_open p hp)
    let G_ext : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W_ext := fun i =>
      { rad := fun p => if p ∈ W_holo then r_holo p else (G i).rad p
        num := fun p => if p ∈ W_holo then F_init i else (G i).num p
        den := fun p => if p ∈ W_holo then (fun _ => 1) else (G i).den p
        rad_pos := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hph : p ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos hph]; exact (hr_holo_spec p hph).1
          · simp only [if_neg hph]; exact (G i).rad_pos p (hExt_not_holo p hp hph)
        ball_sub := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hph : p ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos hph]; exact ((hr_holo_spec p hph).2).trans hWholo_sub_ext
          · simp only [if_neg hph]
            exact ((G i).ball_sub p (hExt_not_holo p hp hph)).trans
              (fun q hq => ⟨⟨by linarith [hq.1.1, hs_pos], hq.1.2⟩, hq.2⟩)
        num_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hph : p ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos hph]
            exact (hF_holo i).mono (((hr_holo_spec p hph).2).trans hWholo_sub_two)
          · simp only [if_neg hph]; exact (G i).num_holo p (hExt_not_holo p hp hph)
        den_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hph : p ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos hph]; exact differentiableOn_const 1
          · simp only [if_neg hph]; exact (G i).den_holo p (hExt_not_holo p hp hph)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hph : p ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos hph]
            exact ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_holo_spec p hph).1, one_ne_zero⟩
          · simp only [if_neg hph]; exact (G i).den_ne_zero p (hExt_not_holo p hp hph)
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          by_cases h1 : p₁ ∈ W_holo <;> by_cases h2 : p₂ ∈ W_holo
          · simp only [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
