          · simp only [if_pos h1, if_neg h2] at hq ⊢
            have hq_holo : q ∈ W_holo := (hr_holo_spec p₁ h1).2 hq.1
            rw [hOv_prop i p₂ (hExt_not_holo p₂ hp₂ h2) q ⟨hq.2, hq_holo⟩, mul_one]
          · simp only [if_neg h1, if_pos h2] at hq ⊢
            have hq_holo : q ∈ W_holo := (hr_holo_spec p₂ h2).2 hq.2
            rw [hOv_prop i p₁ (hExt_not_holo p₁ hp₁ h1) q ⟨hq.1, hq_holo⟩, mul_one]
          · simp only [if_neg h1, if_neg h2] at hq ⊢
            exact (G i).compat p₁ (hExt_not_holo p₁ hp₁ h1) p₂ (hExt_not_holo p₂ hp₂ h2) q hq }
    refine ⟨G_ext, fun i => ⟨hWholo_sub_ext, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
    have hp_holo : p ∈ W_holo := hp
    refine ⟨r_holo p, (hr_holo_spec p hp_holo).1, ?_, (hr_holo_spec p hp_holo).2, fun q _ => ?_⟩
    · simp only [G_ext, if_pos hp_holo, le_refl]
    · simp only [G_ext, if_pos hp_holo, mul_one]

  have hNonzeroOnSubCyl : ∀ {t : ℂ} {δ₁ : ℝ} {d₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < δ₁ → Metric.ball t δ₁ ⊆ B →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ d₀ S_base → (∃ q_nz ∈ S_base, d₀ q_nz ≠ 0) →
      ∃ q₀ ∈ cyl (-s_base) s_base t δ₁, d₀ q₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro t δ₁ d₀ hδ₁ hsub hd₀ ⟨q_nz, hq_nz, hnz⟩
    by_contra h_all
    push_neg at h_all
    have hS_open : IsOpen S_base := by rw [hS_base_eq]; exact hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base 0 r_base
    have hS_conv : Convex ℝ S_base := by rw [hS_base_eq]; exact hCylConv (-s_base) s_base 0 r_base
    have hU_sub : cyl (-s_base) s_base t δ₁ ⊆ S_base := by
      rw [hS_base_eq]; exact fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hsub hp.2⟩
    exact hnz (hEqZeroConv2D hS_open hS_conv (hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base t δ₁)
      (hCylNonempty (by linarith) hδ₁) hU_sub hd₀ h_all q_nz hq_nz)

  have hShiftSBaseToTwo : ∀ (α : ℝ), |α| ≤ 3 / 2 → ∀ p ∈ S_base, shiftMap α p ∈ S_two := by
    rintro α hα ⟨y, t'⟩ ⟨hy, ht'⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ht'⟩
    change |(y + (α : ℂ) * t').im| < 2 * s_base
    have him : (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im = y.im + α * t'.im := by simp
    have ht'_im : |t'.im| < s_base / 4 := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm t') (lt_trans ht' hr_lt_s4)
    have hmul : |α * t'.im| ≤ (3 / 2) * (s_base / 4) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hα (le_of_lt ht'_im) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    rw [him]
    linarith [abs_add_le y.im (α * t'.im)]

  let cramerDenL : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := cramerDen F_L
  have hCramerDenHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ cramerDenL S_base := by
    have h_p : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) S_base := by
      intro i
      have heq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) =
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (shiftMap (1 / 2) p)) := by
        ext p; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hFL_holo i).comp (hShiftDiff (1 / 2)).differentiableOn
        (hShiftSBaseToTwo (1 / 2) (by norm_num))
    have h_m : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) S_base := by
      intro i
      have heq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) =
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_L i (shiftMap (-1 / 2) p)) := by
        ext p; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hFL_holo i).comp (hShiftDiff (-1 / 2)).differentiableOn
        (hShiftSBaseToTwo (-1 / 2) (by norm_num))
    exact ((h_p 0).mul (h_m 1)).sub ((h_p 1).mul (h_m 0))

  let reflNumX : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := reflNum F_X
  let reflDenX : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := reflDen F_X
  have hReflDenHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ reflDenX S_base := by
    have hS_open : IsOpen S_base := by rw [hS_base_eq]; exact hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base 0 r_base
    have h_m : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) S_base := by
      intro i
      have heq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) =
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (shiftMap (-1 / 2) p)) := by
        ext p; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hFX_holo i).comp (hShiftDiff (-1 / 2)).differentiableOn
        (hShiftSBaseToTwo (-1 / 2) (by norm_num))
    have h_m3 : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (p.1 - 3 * p.2 / 2, p.2)) S_base := by
      intro i
      have heq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (p.1 - 3 * p.2 / 2, p.2)) =
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => F_X i (shiftMap (-3 / 2) p)) := by
        ext p; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hFX_holo i).comp (hShiftDiff (-3 / 2)).differentiableOn
        (hShiftSBaseToTwo (-3 / 2) (by norm_num))
    have hn0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) p) S_base :=
      hPartialYHolo hS_open (h_m 1)
    have hn1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => -iterDerivY 1 (fun q => F_X 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) p) S_base :=
      (hPartialYHolo hS_open (h_m 0)).neg
    have hw0 := (h_m 1).sub (h_m3 1)
    have hw1 := (h_m3 0).sub (h_m 0)
    have hwn := (hw0.mul hn0).add (hw1.mul hn1)
    have hnn := (hn0.mul hn0).add (hn1.mul hn1)
    have hnum0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (reflNumX 0) S_base :=
      ((hwn.add hwn).mul hn0).sub (hnn.mul hw0)
    have hnum1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (reflNumX 1) S_base :=
      ((hwn.add hwn).mul hn1).sub (hnn.mul hw1)
    exact (hnum0.mul (h_m 0)).add (hnum1.mul (h_m 1))

  
  have hL_to_X : ∀ t ∈ B, ∀ b b₁ : ℝ,
      IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_L t b →
      s_base < b₁ → b₁ < b - |t.im| / 2 →
      IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_X t b₁ := by
    rintro t _ b b₁ ⟨hb, δ, hδ, hδ_sub, G_L, hGL_ag⟩ hb₁_lo hb₁_hi
    obtain ⟨G_ext, hGext_ag⟩ := hGlueLower F_L hFL_holo hb hδ hδ_sub G_L hGL_ag
    let Δ : ℝ := b - |t.im| / 2 - b₁
    have hΔ : 0 < Δ := by dsimp [Δ]; linarith
    let δ₁ : ℝ := min δ Δ
    have hδ₁ : 0 < δ₁ := lt_min hδ hΔ
    have hδ₁_sub : Metric.ball t δ₁ ⊆ B :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hδ_sub
    let W₁ := cyl (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁
    let U₀ := cyl (-s_base) s_base t δ₁
    have hW₁_open : IsOpen W₁ := hCylOpen (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁
    have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base t δ₁
    have hU₀_sub_W₁ : U₀ ⊆ W₁ := fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1.1, lt_trans hp.1.2 hb₁_lo⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hU₀_sub_S : U₀ ⊆ S_base := by
      rw [hS_base_eq]; exact fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hδ₁_sub hp.2⟩
    have hShiftW₁ : ∀ (α : ℝ), (α = 1 / 2 ∨ α = -1 / 2) →
        ∀ p ∈ W₁, shiftMap α p ∈ cyl (-2 * s_base) b t δ := by
      rintro α hα ⟨y, t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ht'⟩
      refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) ht'⟩
      have ht'B : ‖t'‖ < r_base := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hδ₁_sub ht'
      have ht'_im_s : |t'.im| < s_base / 4 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm t') (lt_trans ht'B hr_lt_s4)
      have ht'_s_bounds := abs_lt.mp ht'_im_s
      have hdiff_im : |t'.im - t.im| < Δ := by
        have h1 : |(t' - t).im| ≤ ‖t' - t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t' - t)
        have h2 : ‖t' - t‖ < Δ := by
          have hd : dist t' t < δ₁ := Metric.mem_ball.mp ht'
          rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _)
        simpa using lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
      have hdiff_bounds := abs_lt.mp hdiff_im
      have ht_abs1 : -|t.im| ≤ t.im := neg_abs_le t.im
      have ht_abs2 : t.im ≤ |t.im| := le_abs_self t.im
      change -2 * s_base < (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im ∧ (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im < b
      have him : (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im = y.im + α * t'.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      rcases hα with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨by linarith, by dsimp [Δ] at hdiff_bounds; linarith⟩
    have hShiftU₀ : ∀ (α : ℝ), (α = 1 / 2 ∨ α = -1 / 2) →
        ∀ p ∈ U₀, shiftMap α p ∈ cyl (-2 * s_base) (min b (2 * s_base)) t δ := by
      rintro α hα p hp
      have hw := hShiftW₁ α hα p (hU₀_sub_W₁ hp)
      refine ⟨⟨hw.1.1, lt_min hw.1.2 ?_⟩, hw.2⟩
      have ht'B : ‖p.2‖ < r_base := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hδ₁_sub hp.2
      have ht'_im_s := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2) (lt_trans ht'B hr_lt_s4))
      have him : (shiftMap α p).1.im = p.1.im + α * p.2.im := by simp [shiftMap]
      rw [him]
      rcases hα with rfl | rfl <;> linarith [hp.1.2]
    let L_p : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W₁ := fun c =>
      meroPullbackShift (1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl)) (G_ext c)
    let L_m : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W₁ := fun c =>
      meroPullbackShift (-1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-1 / 2) (Or.inr rfl)) (G_ext c)
    have hLp_ag : ∀ c : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (L_p c) (fun q => F_L c (q.1 + q.2 / 2, q.2)) U₀ := by
      intro c
      have h := meroPullbackShift_agrees (1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl))
        (hGext_ag c) hU₀_open hU₀_sub_W₁ (hShiftU₀ (1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl))
      have heq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_L c (shiftMap (1 / 2) q)) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_L c (q.1 + q.2 / 2, q.2)) := by
        ext q; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rwa [heq] at h
    have hLm_ag : ∀ c : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (L_m c) (fun q => F_L c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) U₀ := by
      intro c
      have h := meroPullbackShift_agrees (-1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-1 / 2) (Or.inr rfl))
        (hGext_ag c) hU₀_open hU₀_sub_W₁ (hShiftU₀ (-1 / 2) (Or.inr rfl))
      have heq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_L c (shiftMap (-1 / 2) q)) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_L c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) := by
        ext q; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rwa [heq] at h
    let D_mero : MeroOn2D W₁ := meroSub (meroMul (L_p 0) (L_m 1)) (meroMul (L_p 1) (L_m 0))
    have hD_ag : MeroAgreesHolo D_mero cramerDenL U₀ :=
      meroSub_agrees (meroMul_agrees (hLp_ag 0) (hLm_ag 1)) (meroMul_agrees (hLp_ag 1) (hLm_ag 0))
    let N_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W₁ :=
      ![meroSub (L_m 1) (L_p 1), meroSub (L_p 0) (L_m 0)]
    have hCr_nz_U₀ : ∃ q₀ ∈ U₀, cramerDenL q₀ ≠ 0 :=
      hNonzeroOnSubCyl hδ₁ hδ₁_sub hCramerDenHolo hs1_nz
    have hDiv_i : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ Q_i : MeroOn2D W₁, MeroAgreesHolo Q_i (F_X i) U₀ := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact meroDiv_exists (N_mero 0) D_mero (hCylPreconn (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁)
          (meroSub_agrees (hLm_ag 1) (hLp_ag 1)) hD_ag (hCramerDenHolo.mono hU₀_sub_S) hCr_nz_U₀
          (fun q hq => by simpa [cramerNum, cramerDenL] using hs1_eq q (hU₀_sub_S hq) 0)
      · exact meroDiv_exists (N_mero 1) D_mero (hCylPreconn (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁)
          (meroSub_agrees (hLp_ag 0) (hLm_ag 0)) hD_ag (hCramerDenHolo.mono hU₀_sub_S) hCr_nz_U₀
          (fun q hq => by simpa [cramerNum, cramerDenL] using hs1_eq q (hU₀_sub_S hq) 1)
    refine ⟨hb₁_lo, δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁_sub, fun i => Classical.choose (hDiv_i i), fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [hBaseCylEq]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hDiv_i i)

  have hX_to_L_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ B, 0 ≤ t.im → ∀ b' b₁ : ℝ,
      IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_X t b' →
      s_base < b₁ → b₁ < b' + t.im / 2 →
      IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_L t b₁ := by
    rintro t _ ht_im b' b₁ ⟨hb', δ, hδ, hδ_sub, G_X, hGX_ag⟩ hb₁_lo hb₁_hi
    obtain ⟨G_ext, hGext_ag⟩ := hGlueLower F_X hFX_holo hb' hδ hδ_sub G_X hGX_ag
    let Δ : ℝ := b' + t.im / 2 - b₁
    have hΔ : 0 < Δ := by dsimp [Δ]; linarith
    let δ₁ : ℝ := min δ (Δ / 2)
    have hδ₁ : 0 < δ₁ := lt_min hδ (half_pos hΔ)
    have hδ₁_sub : Metric.ball t δ₁ ⊆ B :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hδ_sub
    let W₁ := cyl (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁
    let U₀ := cyl (-s_base) s_base t δ₁
    have hW₁_open : IsOpen W₁ := hCylOpen (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁
    have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := hCylOpen (-s_base) s_base t δ₁
    have hU₀_sub_W₁ : U₀ ⊆ W₁ := fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1.1, lt_trans hp.1.2 hb₁_lo⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hU₀_sub_S : U₀ ⊆ S_base := by
      rw [hS_base_eq]; exact fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, hδ₁_sub hp.2⟩
    have hShiftW₁ : ∀ (α : ℝ), (α = -1 / 2 ∨ α = -3 / 2) →
        ∀ p ∈ W₁, shiftMap α p ∈ cyl (-2 * s_base) b' t δ := by
      rintro α hα ⟨y, t'⟩ ⟨⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ht'⟩
      refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) ht'⟩
      have ht'B : ‖t'‖ < r_base := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hδ₁_sub ht'
      have ht'_s_bounds := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm t') (lt_trans ht'B hr_lt_s4))
      have hdiff_im : |t'.im - t.im| < Δ / 2 := by
        have h1 : |(t' - t).im| ≤ ‖t' - t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t' - t)
        have h2 : ‖t' - t‖ < Δ / 2 := by
          have hd : dist t' t < δ₁ := Metric.mem_ball.mp ht'
          rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _)
        simpa using lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
      have hdiff_bounds := abs_lt.mp hdiff_im
      change -2 * s_base < (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im ∧ (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im < b'
      have him : (y + (α : ℂ) * t').im = y.im + α * t'.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      rcases hα with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨by linarith, by dsimp [Δ] at hdiff_bounds; linarith⟩
    have hShiftU₀ : ∀ (α : ℝ), (α = -1 / 2 ∨ α = -3 / 2) →
        ∀ p ∈ U₀, shiftMap α p ∈ cyl (-2 * s_base) (min b' (2 * s_base)) t δ := by
      rintro α hα p hp
      have hw := hShiftW₁ α hα p (hU₀_sub_W₁ hp)
      refine ⟨⟨hw.1.1, lt_min hw.1.2 ?_⟩, hw.2⟩
      have ht'B : ‖p.2‖ < r_base := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hδ₁_sub hp.2
      have ht'_im_s := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2) (lt_trans ht'B hr_lt_s4))
      have him : (shiftMap α p).1.im = p.1.im + α * p.2.im := by simp [shiftMap]
      rw [him]
      rcases hα with rfl | rfl <;> linarith [hp.1.2]
    let P_0 : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W₁ := fun c =>
      meroPullbackShift (-1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl)) (G_ext c)
    let P_m : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D W₁ := fun c =>
      meroPullbackShift (-3 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-3 / 2) (Or.inr rfl)) (G_ext c)
    have hP0_ag : ∀ c : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (P_0 c) (fun q => F_X c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) U₀ := by
      intro c
      have h := meroPullbackShift_agrees (-1 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl))
        (hGext_ag c) hU₀_open hU₀_sub_W₁ (hShiftU₀ (-1 / 2) (Or.inl rfl))
      have heq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (shiftMap (-1 / 2) q)) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) := by
        ext q; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rwa [heq] at h
    have hPm_ag : ∀ c : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (P_m c) (fun q => F_X c (q.1 - 3 * q.2 / 2, q.2)) U₀ := by
      intro c
      have h := meroPullbackShift_agrees (-3 / 2) hW₁_open (hShiftW₁ (-3 / 2) (Or.inr rfl))
        (hGext_ag c) hU₀_open hU₀_sub_W₁ (hShiftU₀ (-3 / 2) (Or.inr rfl))
      have heq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (shiftMap (-3 / 2) q)) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (q.1 - 3 * q.2 / 2, q.2)) := by
        ext q; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rwa [heq] at h
    have hP0_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) U₀ := by
      intro c
      have heq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => F_X c (shiftMap (-1 / 2) q)) := by
        ext q; congr 1; ext <;> simp [shiftMap]; ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hFX_holo c).comp (hShiftDiff (-1 / 2)).differentiableOn
        (fun q hq => hShiftSBaseToTwo (-1 / 2) (by norm_num) q (hU₀_sub_S hq))
    let W0_m := meroSub (P_0 1) (P_m 1)
    let W1_m := meroSub (P_m 0) (P_0 0)
    let N0_m := meroDerivY (P_0 1)
    let N1_m := meroNeg (meroDerivY (P_0 0))
    let WN_m := meroAdd (meroMul W0_m N0_m) (meroMul W1_m N1_m)
    let NN_m := meroAdd (meroMul N0_m N0_m) (meroMul N1_m N1_m)
    let Num0_m := meroSub (meroMul (meroAdd WN_m WN_m) N0_m) (meroMul NN_m W0_m)
    let Num1_m := meroSub (meroMul (meroAdd WN_m WN_m) N1_m) (meroMul NN_m W1_m)
    let Den_m := meroAdd (meroMul Num0_m (P_0 0)) (meroMul Num1_m (P_0 1))
    have hW0_ag := meroSub_agrees (hP0_ag 1) (hPm_ag 1)
    have hW1_ag := meroSub_agrees (hPm_ag 0) (hP0_ag 0)
    have hN0_ag := meroDerivY_agrees (hP0_ag 1) hU₀_open (hP0_holo 1)
    have hN1_ag := meroNeg_agrees (meroDerivY_agrees (hP0_ag 0) hU₀_open (hP0_holo 0))
    have hWN_ag := meroAdd_agrees (meroMul_agrees hW0_ag hN0_ag) (meroMul_agrees hW1_ag hN1_ag)
    have hNN_ag := meroAdd_agrees (meroMul_agrees hN0_ag hN0_ag) (meroMul_agrees hN1_ag hN1_ag)
    have hNum0_ag : MeroAgreesHolo Num0_m (reflNumX 0) U₀ :=
      meroSub_agrees (meroMul_agrees (meroAdd_agrees hWN_ag hWN_ag) hN0_ag)
        (meroMul_agrees hNN_ag hW0_ag)
    have hNum1_ag : MeroAgreesHolo Num1_m (reflNumX 1) U₀ :=
      meroSub_agrees (meroMul_agrees (meroAdd_agrees hWN_ag hWN_ag) hN1_ag)
        (meroMul_agrees hNN_ag hW1_ag)
    have hDen_ag : MeroAgreesHolo Den_m reflDenX U₀ :=
      meroAdd_agrees (meroMul_agrees hNum0_ag (hP0_ag 0)) (meroMul_agrees hNum1_ag (hP0_ag 1))
    have hRefl_nz_U₀ : ∃ q₀ ∈ U₀, reflDenX q₀ ≠ 0 :=
      hNonzeroOnSubCyl hδ₁ hδ₁_sub hReflDenHolo hs2_nz
    have hDiv_i : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ Q_i : MeroOn2D W₁, MeroAgreesHolo Q_i (F_L i) U₀ := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact meroDiv_exists Num0_m Den_m (hCylPreconn (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁)
          hNum0_ag hDen_ag (hReflDenHolo.mono hU₀_sub_S) hRefl_nz_U₀
          (fun q hq => hs2_eq q (hU₀_sub_S hq) 0)
      · exact meroDiv_exists Num1_m Den_m (hCylPreconn (-s_base) b₁ t δ₁)
          hNum1_ag hDen_ag (hReflDenHolo.mono hU₀_sub_S) hRefl_nz_U₀
          (fun q hq => hs2_eq q (hU₀_sub_S hq) 1)
    refine ⟨hb₁_lo, δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁_sub, fun i => Classical.choose (hDiv_i i), fun i => ?_⟩
    rw [hBaseCylEq]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hDiv_i i)

  
  have hFwd : ∀ t ∈ B,
      collarWidthL C hDet t ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2) := by
    intro t ht
    refine sSup_le ?_
    rintro _ ⟨b, hbwit, rfl⟩
    by_cases hlow : b - |t.im| / 2 ≤ 2 * s_base
    · calc ENNReal.ofReal b
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base + |t.im| / 2) :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2) :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2) := by
            gcongr; exact h_X_ge_two t ht
    · push_neg at hlow
      refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add (fun ε hε _ => ?_)
      let ε' : ℝ := min (ε : ℝ) (b - |t.im| / 2 - 2 * s_base)
      have hε'_pos : 0 < ε' := lt_min (by exact_mod_cast hε) (by linarith)
      let b₁ : ℝ := b - |t.im| / 2 - ε'
      have hb₁_ge : 2 * s_base ≤ b₁ := by
        dsimp [b₁, ε']; linarith [min_le_right (ε : ℝ) (b - |t.im| / 2 - 2 * s_base)]
      have hb₁_lo : s_base < b₁ := by linarith
      have hb₁_hi : b₁ < b - |t.im| / 2 := by dsimp [b₁]; linarith
      have hwit₁ := hL_to_X t ht b b₁ hbwit hb₁_lo hb₁_hi
      have hle_X : ENNReal.ofReal b₁ ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t :=
        le_sSup ⟨b₁, hwit₁, rfl⟩
      have hb_le : b ≤ b₁ + |t.im| / 2 + (ε : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [b₁, ε']; linarith [min_le_left (ε : ℝ) (b - |t.im| / 2 - 2 * s_base)]
      have h_abs_nonneg : 0 ≤ |t.im| / 2 := by positivity
      calc ENNReal.ofReal b
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b₁ + |t.im| / 2 + (ε : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hb_le
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal b₁ + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2) + (ε : ENNReal) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith) (NNReal.coe_nonneg ε),
              ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith) h_abs_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
        _ ≤ collarWidthX C hDet t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2) + (ε : ENNReal) := by
            gcongr

  have hBack_nonneg : ∀ t ∈ B, 0 ≤ t.im →
      collarWidthX C hDet t + ENNReal.ofReal (t.im / 2) ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t := by
    intro t ht ht_im
    let S_set : Set ENNReal :=
      { x : ENNReal | ∃ b' : ℝ, IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_X t b' ∧ x = ENNReal.ofReal b' }
    have hS_ne : S_set.Nonempty := by
      by_contra hempty
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hempty
      have h0 : collarWidthX C hDet t = 0 := by
        change sSup S_set = 0; rw [hempty, sSup_empty, ENNReal.bot_eq_zero]
      have hpos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by positivity)
      have hle := h_X_ge_two t ht
      rw [h0] at hle
      exact not_lt_of_ge hle hpos
    change sSup S_set + ENNReal.ofReal (t.im / 2) ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t
    rw [ENNReal.sSup_add hS_ne]
    refine iSup₂_le ?_
    rintro _ ⟨b', hb'wit, rfl⟩
    have hb'_pos : 0 < b' := lt_trans hs_pos hb'wit.1
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (le_of_lt hb'_pos) (by positivity)]
    by_cases hlow : b' + t.im / 2 ≤ 2 * s_base
    · exact le_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hlow) (h_L_ge_two t ht)
    · push_neg at hlow
      refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add (fun ε hε _ => ?_)
      let ε' : ℝ := min (ε : ℝ) (b' + t.im / 2 - 2 * s_base)
      have hε'_pos : 0 < ε' := lt_min (by exact_mod_cast hε) (by linarith)
      let b₁ : ℝ := b' + t.im / 2 - ε'
      have hb₁_ge : 2 * s_base ≤ b₁ := by
        dsimp [b₁, ε']; linarith [min_le_right (ε : ℝ) (b' + t.im / 2 - 2 * s_base)]
      have hb₁_lo : s_base < b₁ := by linarith
      have hb₁_hi : b₁ < b' + t.im / 2 := by dsimp [b₁]; linarith
      have hwit₁ := hX_to_L_nonneg t ht ht_im b' b₁ hb'wit hb₁_lo hb₁_hi
      have hle_L : ENNReal.ofReal b₁ ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t :=
        le_sSup ⟨b₁, hwit₁, rfl⟩
      have hb_le : b' + t.im / 2 ≤ b₁ + (ε : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [b₁, ε']; linarith [min_le_left (ε : ℝ) (b' + t.im / 2 - 2 * s_base)]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (b' + t.im / 2)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b₁ + (ε : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hb_le
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal b₁ + (ε : ENNReal) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith) (NNReal.coe_nonneg ε),
              ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
        _ ≤ collarWidthL C hDet t + (ε : ENNReal) := by
            gcongr

  intro t ht
  refine le_antisymm (hFwd t ht) ?_
  by_cases ht_im : 0 ≤ t.im
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht_im]
    exact hBack_nonneg t ht ht_im
  · push_neg at ht_im
    have hnt_mem : -t ∈ B := by
      simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
    have hnt_im : 0 ≤ (-t).im := by simp; linarith
    have habs : |t.im| = (-t).im := by rw [abs_of_neg ht_im, Complex.neg_im]
    rw [← h_X_even t ht, ← h_L_even t ht, habs]
    exact hBack_nonneg (-t) hnt_mem hnt_im

by
  intro R_Φ Φ hR_Φ hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hΦ_deriv q hq_cont hq_per hq_lt
  let h_F : ℂ → ENNReal := meroStripWidth s_base r_base F_init
  let I_q : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self]
    linarith
  have hΦ0_mem : Φ 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base := hΦ_maps 0 h0_mem
  by_cases hIq : I_q ≤ 2 * s_base
  · exact le_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hIq) (h_ge_two (Φ 0) hΦ0_mem)
  · have hIq_gt : 2 * s_base < I_q := lt_of_not_ge hIq
    obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hCollar⟩ :=
      lsc_annular_collar_and_disk_inversion s_base r_base R_Φ hs hr hR_Φ
        h_F h_ge_two h_lsc Φ hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hΦ_deriv q hq_cont hq_per hq_lt
    obtain ⟨g, hg_holo, hg_bdry, hg_mean⟩ :=
      fourier_holomorphic_majorant_poly q η₀ hq_cont hq_per (fun θ => (hq_lt θ).1) hη₀
    have hg0_gt : 2 * s_base < (g 0).im := lt_of_lt_of_le hIq_gt hg_mean
    obtain ⟨d_w, d_ζ, δ_t, ψ, ⟨hd_w, hd_w_lt⟩, ⟨hd_ζ, hd_ζ_lt_one, hd_ζ_lt_R⟩,
      hAnn_maps, ⟨hδ_t, hδ_t_sub⟩, ⟨hψ_holo, _, hψ_deriv⟩, hψ_props⟩ :=
      hCollar g hg_holo hg_bdry
    have hWit : IsCollarHeightWitness s_base r_base F_init (Φ 0)
        ((g 0).im + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) :=
      multi_slab_disk_continuation_ascent
        mero2d_sheaf_pullback_toolkit hDisk
        s_base r_base R_Φ d_w d_ζ δ_t hs hd_w hd_w_lt hd_ζ hd_ζ_lt_one hd_ζ_lt_R hδ_t
        F_init hF_holo (meroTubeENNR r_base h_F) M_F hM_agrees
        Φ ψ g hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hΦ_deriv hg_holo hg0_gt hAnn_maps
        hδ_t_sub hψ_holo hψ_deriv hψ_props
    have hle_real : I_q ≤ (g 0).im + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := by linarith
    exact le_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle_real)
      (le_sSup ⟨(g 0).im + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w, hWit, rfl⟩)

holomorphic_disk_supermean.definitions:
def IsTriangularHoloMap (W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsOpen W₁ ∧
  ∃ (U_v : Set ℂ) (h φ : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U_v ∧ IsPreconnected U_v ∧
    (∀ p ∈ W₁, p.2 ∈ U_v ∧ Υ p = (p.1 + h p.2, φ p.2)) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ h U_v ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ φ U_v ∧
    ∃ v₀ ∈ U_v, deriv φ v₀ ≠ 0

structure Mero2DPullbackGluingToolkit : Prop where
  ofHolo : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
    ∃ H : MeroOn2D U, MeroAgreesHolo H f U ∧
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen V → V ⊆ U →
        (MeroAgreesHolo F f V ↔ MeroEqOn F H V)
  eqOn_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U
  eqOn_mono : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V
  eqOn_trans : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U
  eqOn_of_isPreconnected : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (V V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ V →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V
  restrictOpen : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → ∃ G : MeroOn2D V, MeroEqOn G F V
  glueCover : ∀ {ι : Type} (U : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (G : ∀ α, MeroOn2D (U α)),
    (∀ α, IsOpen (U α)) → IsOpen W → W ⊆ (⋃ α, U α) →
    (∀ α β, MeroEqOn (G α) (G β) (U α ∩ U β)) →
    ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, ∀ α, MeroEqOn F (G α) (W ∩ U α)
  glueBinary : ∀ {U₁ U₂ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
    IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
    ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, MeroEqOn F G₁ (W ∩ U₁) ∧ MeroEqOn F G₂ (W ∩ U₂)
  triangular_mono : ∀ {W₁ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen U → U ⊆ W₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ
  eqOn_iff_pullback_id : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U ↔ MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ id U
  pullback_mono : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    V ⊆ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ V
  eqOn_pullback_left : ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ →
    MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F Υ U
  pullback_exists : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (F : MeroOn2D W₂),
    IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ W₁ W₂ →
    ∃ G : MeroOn2D W₁, MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ W₁
  pullback_right_eqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
    (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ U V₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G F₁ Υ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOnPullback G F₂ Υ U
  pullback_comp : ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F : MeroOn2D W₃)
    (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U₁ Υ₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap U₂ Υ₂ →
    Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U₁ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₂ Υ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ₂ U₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F (Υ₂ ∘ Υ₁) U₁
  pullback_congr_eqOn : ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
    (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ₁ → (∀ p ∈ U, Υ₁ p = Υ₂ p) → Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U V₂ →
    MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₁ Υ₁ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F₂ Υ₂ U →
    MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U

by
  
  have h_conformal :
      ∀ (η_arc : ℝ), 0 < η_arc → η_arc < Real.pi / 2 →
        ∃ δ_z : ℝ, 0 < δ_z ∧
          ∀ z_star : ℂ, ‖z_star‖ < δ_z → 0 < z_star.im →
            ∃ Ψ : ℂ → ℂ,

              deriv Ψ 0 ≠ 0 ∧
              (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖Ψ z‖ < 1) ∧
              ContinuousOn
                (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Ψ ((p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
                (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc η_arc (2 * Real.pi - η_arc)) ∧
              (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc η_arc (2 * Real.pi - η_arc),
                (Ψ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im = 0 ∧
                |(Ψ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re| < 1) ∧
              Set.InjOn (fun θ : ℝ => (Ψ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re)
                (Set.Ioo η_arc (2 * Real.pi - η_arc)) := by
    clear hs hr h_F h_ge h_lsc h_disk_supermean s_base r_base
    have h_cayley_re : ∀ z : ℂ, ((1 + z) / (1 - z)).re = (1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2) / ‖1 - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro z
      rw [Complex.div_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← add_div]
      have hnum : (1 + z).re * (1 - z).re + (1 + z).im * (1 - z).im = 1 - Complex.normSq z := by
        simp [Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
      rw [hnum, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    have h_cayley_im : ∀ z : ℂ, ((1 + z) / (1 - z)).im = 2 * z.im / ‖1 - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro z
      rw [Complex.div_im, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← sub_div]
      have hnum : (1 + z).im * (1 - z).re - (1 + z).re * (1 - z).im = 2 * z.im := by
        simp; ring
      rw [hnum]
    have h_mobius_lt_one : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s + 1 ≠ 0 ∧ ‖(s - 1) / (s + 1)‖ < 1 := by
      intro s hs_re
      have hs1_re : 0 < (s + 1).re := by simp; linarith
      have hs1_ne : s + 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; rw [h0] at hs1_re; norm_num at hs1_re
      refine ⟨hs1_ne, ?_⟩
      have hs1_pos : 0 < ‖s + 1‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hs1_ne
      rw [norm_div, div_lt_one hs1_pos]
      have hsq : ‖s - 1‖ ^ 2 < ‖s + 1‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
        simp [Complex.normSq_apply]
        linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s - 1), hs1_pos]
    let S_quad : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      Complex.exp (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log w + ((Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have h_squad_sq : ∀ w : ℂ, w ≠ 0 → (S_quad w) ^ 2 = Complex.I * w := by
      intro w hw
      dsimp [S_quad]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add]
      have harg :
          (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log w + ((Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
            (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log w + ((Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
            Complex.log w + ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [harg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hw, Complex.exp_mul_I]
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
      simp [mul_comm]
    have h_squad_re_pos : ∀ w : ℂ, 0 < w.re → 0 < (S_quad w).re := by
      intro w hw_re
      have hw_arg : |w.arg| < Real.pi / 2 :=
        Complex.abs_arg_lt_pi_div_two_iff.mpr (Or.inl hw_re)
      rw [abs_lt] at hw_arg
      dsimp [S_quad]
      rw [Complex.exp_re]
      have him :
          (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log w + ((Real.pi / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im =
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * w.arg + Real.pi / 4 := by
        simp [Complex.log_im]
      rw [him]
      exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
        (Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩)
    intro η_arc hη_pos hη_lt
    have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos η_arc :=
      Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], hη_lt⟩
    have hcos_lt_one : Real.cos η_arc < 1 := by
      have h := Real.cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (le_refl (0 : ℝ))
        (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) hη_pos
      simpa using h
    let c_η : ℝ := 1 - Real.cos η_arc
    have hc_pos : 0 < c_η := sub_pos.mpr hcos_lt_one
    have hc_lt_one : c_η < 1 := by dsimp [c_η]; linarith
    let δ_z : ℝ := min (1 / 4 : ℝ) (c_η ^ 2 / 128)
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_z := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨δ_z, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro z_star hz_norm hz_im
    have hz_lt_quarter : ‖z_star‖ < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_norm (min_le_left _ _)
    have hz_lt_c : ‖z_star‖ < c_η ^ 2 / 128 := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_norm (min_le_right _ _)
    have h1z_norm : 3 / 4 < ‖(1 : ℂ) - z_star‖ := by
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) z_star

      linarith
    have h1z_ne : (1 : ℂ) - z_star ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, norm_zero] at h1z_norm; linarith
    let s_star : ℂ := (1 + z_star) / (1 - z_star)

      dsimp [s_star]
      rw [h_cayley_im]

      ring
    have hα_pos : 0 < α := by

    have hw_diff : ‖w_star - (-Complex.I)‖ < c_η ^ 2 / 16 := by

        have htri : ‖s_star + 1‖ ≤ ‖s_star - 1‖ + ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ := by

          rw [heq]
          exact norm_add_le _ _
        rw [Complex.norm_ofNat] at htri
        linarith
      have hw_fac : w_star - (-Complex.I) = -Complex.I * ((s_star - 1) * (s_star + 1)) := by
        dsimp [w_star]; ring
      have hw_norm_eq : ‖w_star - (-Complex.I)‖ = ‖s_star - 1‖ * ‖s_star + 1‖ := by
        rw [hw_fac, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, norm_mul]
      calc ‖w_star - (-Complex.I)‖
          = ‖s_star - 1‖ * ‖s_star + 1‖ := hw_norm_eq
        _ ≤ ((8 / 3 : ℝ) * ‖z_star‖) * (8 / 3 : ℝ) := by

        Complex.re_le_norm _

      linarith
    have hγ_lt : γ < -(3 / 4 : ℝ) := by

        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, hθ_Icc, ?_⟩
        change 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ
        have hm1 : 1 / Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have hmul := (div_lt_iff₀ hd_pos).mp hm1
        linarith
    have h_target_lt :
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi - 3 * η_arc) < MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ m : ℕ, C_exh m) := by
      rw [hC_iUnion, hvol_O]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
    have htend := MeasureTheory.tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hC_mono
    have hev := htend.eventually (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds h_target_lt)
    obtain ⟨n, hn_gt⟩ := hev.exists
    dsimp [Function.comp] at hn_gt
    let K : Set ℝ := C_exh (2 * n + 1)
    let χ₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
      min 1 (max 0 ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1))
    have hχ₀_cont : Continuous χ₀ :=
      continuous_const.min (continuous_const.max
        ((continuous_const.mul (Metric.continuous_infDist_pt O_θᶜ)).sub continuous_const))
    have hχ₀_end : χ₀ 0 = χ₀ (0 + 2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hd0 : Metric.infDist (0 : ℝ) O_θᶜ = 0 :=
        Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem h0_mem_compl
      have hd2 : Metric.infDist (2 * Real.pi) O_θᶜ = 0 := by
        simpa using Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem h2pi_mem_compl
      simp [χ₀, hd0, hd2]
    have : Fact (0 < 2 * Real.pi) := ⟨Real.two_pi_pos⟩
    let χ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
      AddCircle.liftIco (2 * Real.pi) 0 χ₀ (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
    have hχ_cont : Continuous χ :=
      (AddCircle.liftIco_continuous hχ₀_end hχ₀_cont.continuousOn).comp
        QuotientAddGroup.continuous_mk
    have hχ_per : Function.Periodic χ (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro θ
      change AddCircle.liftIco (2 * Real.pi) 0 χ₀
          ((θ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =
        AddCircle.liftIco (2 * Real.pi) 0 χ₀ (θ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))
      rw [AddCircle.coe_add_period]
    have hχ_Ico : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), χ θ = χ₀ θ := by
      intro θ hθ
      dsimp [χ]
      have hθ' : θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 2 * Real.pi) := by simpa using hθ
      exact AddCircle.liftIco_coe_apply hθ'
    have hχ_bounds : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ θ ∧ χ θ ≤ 1 := by
      intro θ
      obtain ⟨y, hy_mem, hy_eq⟩ := hχ_per.exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos θ
      rw [hy_eq, hχ_Ico y hy_mem]
      dsimp [χ₀]
      exact ⟨le_min (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _), min_le_left _ _⟩
    have hχ_supp : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), 0 < χ θ → θ ∈ K := by
      intro θ hθ hpos
      rw [hχ_Ico θ hθ] at hpos
      dsimp [χ₀] at hpos
      have hmax : 0 < max 0 ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (min_le_right _ _)
      have hgt : 0 < (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1 := by
        rcases max_choice 0 ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1) with h0 | h1
        · rw [h0] at hmax; linarith
        · rwa [h1] at hmax
      have hd_ge : 1 / (((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ := by
        push_cast
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith
      have hd_pos : 0 < Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hd_ge
      have hθ_O : θ ∈ O_θ := by
        have hnot := (hcompl_closed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos hcompl_ne).mpr hd_pos
        simpa using hnot
      exact ⟨Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hO_sub hθ_O), hd_ge⟩
    have hχ_one_on_Cn : ∀ θ ∈ C_exh n, χ θ = 1 := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hθ_O : θ ∈ O_θ := hC_sub_O n hθ
      have hθ_J : θ ∈ J := hO_sub hθ_O
      have hθ_Ico : θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) :=
        ⟨by linarith [hθ_J.1], by linarith [hθ_J.2]⟩
      rw [hχ_Ico θ hθ_Ico]
      dsimp [χ₀]
      have hge2 : 2 ≤ (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ := by
        calc (2 : ℝ)
            = (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
              field_simp [show (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 by positivity]
          _ ≤ (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ := by
              gcongr; exact hθ.2
      have hmax : max 0 ((2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1) =
          (2 * (n : ℝ) + 2) * Metric.infDist θ O_θᶜ - 1 :=
        max_eq_right (by linarith)
      rw [hmax]
      exact min_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hχ_int : 2 * Real.pi - 3 * η_arc ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ θ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (le_of_lt Real.two_pi_pos)]
      have hCn_sub_Ioc : C_exh n ⊆ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro θ hθ
        have hJ := hO_sub (hC_sub_O n hθ)
        exact ⟨by linarith [hJ.1], by linarith [hJ.2]⟩
      have hmono_set : ∫ θ in C_exh n, χ θ ≤ ∫ θ in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), χ θ :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set
          (hχ_cont.integrableOn_Ioc)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ => (hχ_bounds θ).1))
          (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ hCn_sub_Ioc)
      have heq_const : ∫ θ in C_exh n, χ θ = ∫ _θ in C_exh n, (1 : ℝ) :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (hC_compact n).measurableSet
          (fun θ hθ => hχ_one_on_Cn θ hθ)
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] at heq_const
      have hCn_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume (C_exh n) ≠ ⊤ := by
        have hle : MeasureTheory.volume (C_exh n) ≤ MeasureTheory.volume O_θ :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_mono (hC_sub_O n)
        rw [hvol_O] at hle
        exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hle
      have htoReal : 2 * Real.pi - 3 * η_arc ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume (C_exh n)).toReal := by
        have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hCn_ne_top (le_of_lt hn_gt)
        rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith)] at h
      linarith
    exact ⟨K, χ, hC_compact (2 * n + 1), hC_sub_O (2 * n + 1), hχ_cont, hχ_per, hχ_bounds,
      hχ_supp, hχ_int⟩

  
  have h_radial :
      ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (K : Set ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (M₁ M₂ : ℝ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, F z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base) →
        deriv F 0 ≠ 0 →
        IsCompact K →
        ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F ((p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ K) →
        (∀ θ ∈ K, F (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base) →
        (∀ θ ∈ K, ENNReal.ofReal M₁ < h_F (F (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))) →
        Continuous χ →
        Function.Periodic χ (2 * Real.pi) →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ χ θ ∧ χ θ ≤ 1) →
        (∀ θ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), 0 < χ θ → θ ∈ K) →
        0 ≤ M₂ →
        M₂ < M₁ →
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₂ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ θ)) ≤
          h_F (F 0) := by
    clear h_conformal h_cutoff
    intro F K χ M₁ M₂ hF_holo hF_maps hF_deriv hK_compact hF_cont hK_maps hK_gt
      hχ_cont hχ_per hχ_bounds hχ_supp hM₂_nonneg hM₂_lt
    obtain ⟨V_lsc, hV_open, hV_eq⟩ :=
      lowerSemicontinuousOn_iff_preimage_Ioi.mp h_lsc (ENNReal.ofReal M₁)
    let U₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base ∩ h_F ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (ENNReal.ofReal M₁)
    have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ := by
      change IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base ∩ h_F ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (ENNReal.ofReal M₁))
      rw [hV_eq]
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hV_open
    let P : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ K
    let g_rad : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => F ((p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))
    obtain ⟨W_open_set, hW_open, hW_eq⟩ := continuousOn_iff'.mp hF_cont U₁ hU₁_open
    have h1K_sub : ({(1 : ℝ)} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ K ⊆ W_open_set := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : p.1 = 1 := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp.1
      have hpP : p ∈ P := ⟨⟨by rw [hp1]; norm_num, by rw [hp1]⟩, hp.2⟩
      have hpU : p ∈ g_rad ⁻¹' U₁ := by
        change F ((p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₁
        rw [hp1, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
        exact ⟨hK_maps p.2 hp.2, hK_gt p.2 hp.2⟩
      have hp_inter : p ∈ g_rad ⁻¹' U₁ ∩ P := ⟨hpU, hpP⟩
      rw [hW_eq] at hp_inter
      exact hp_inter.1
    obtain ⟨V_β, V_θ, hVβ_open, _hVθ_open, h1_sub, hK_sub, hprod_sub⟩ :=
      generalized_tube_lemma isCompact_singleton hK_compact hW_open h1K_sub
    have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ V_β := h1_sub (Set.mem_singleton 1)
    obtain ⟨δ_β, hδ_β_pos, hball_β⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVβ_open 1 h1_mem
    let β : ℝ := 1 - min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2)
    have hβ_pos : 0 < β := by
      have : min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      dsimp [β]; linarith
    have hβ_lt_one : β < 1 := by
      have : 0 < min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) := lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      dsimp [β]; linarith
    have hβ_mem : β ∈ V_β := by
      apply hball_β
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
      have hmin_pos : 0 < min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) := lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have hmin_le : min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) ≤ δ_β / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      have habs : |β - 1| = min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) := by
        have : β - 1 = -min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ_β / 2) := by dsimp [β]; ring
        rw [this, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hmin_pos]
      linarith
    have hβ_K_gt : ∀ θ ∈ K,
        ENNReal.ofReal M₁ < h_F (F ((β : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hp_W : (β, θ) ∈ W_open_set ∩ P :=
        ⟨hprod_sub ⟨hβ_mem, hK_sub hθ⟩, ⟨⟨le_of_lt hβ_pos, le_of_lt hβ_lt_one⟩, hθ⟩⟩
      rw [← hW_eq] at hp_W
      exact hp_W.1.2
    let R_Φ : ℝ := 1 / β
    let Φ_β : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => F ((β : ℂ) * ζ)
    have hR_gt_one : 1 < R_Φ := (one_lt_div hβ_pos).mpr hβ_lt_one
    have hscale_maps : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, (β : ℂ) * ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ ⊢
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hβ_pos)]
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ hβ_pos
      dsimp [R_Φ] at hmul
      rwa [mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt hβ_pos)] at hmul
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ_β (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) :=
      hF_holo.comp (((differentiable_const (β : ℂ)).mul differentiable_id).differentiableOn)
        hscale_maps
    have hΦ_maps : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ_β ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base :=
      fun ζ hζ => hF_maps _ (hscale_maps ζ hζ)
    have hΦ_deriv : deriv Φ_β 0 ≠ 0 := by
      have hF_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ F 0 :=
        hF_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 zero_lt_one)
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (β : ℂ) * ζ) (β : ℂ) 0 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul (β : ℂ)
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt Φ_β (deriv F 0 * (β : ℂ)) 0 := by
        have hF_d : HasDerivAt F (deriv F 0) ((β : ℂ) * 0) := by
          simpa using hF_diff0.hasDerivAt
        exact hF_d.comp 0 hlin
      rw [hcomp.deriv]
      exact mul_ne_zero hF_deriv (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hβ_pos))
    let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => M₂ * χ θ
    have hq_cont : Continuous q := continuous_const.mul hχ_cont
    have hq_per : Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) := fun θ => by
      dsimp [q]; rw [hχ_per θ]
    have hq_lt : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_F (Φ_β (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) := by
      have hIco_lt : ∀ θ₀ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          0 ≤ q θ₀ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (q θ₀) < h_F (Φ_β (Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) := by
        intro θ₀ hθ₀
        refine ⟨mul_nonneg hM₂_nonneg (hχ_bounds θ₀).1, ?_⟩
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hχ_bounds θ₀).1 with hχ0 | hχ_pos
        · have hq0 : q θ₀ = 0 := by dsimp [q]; rw [← hχ0, mul_zero]
          rw [hq0, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
          have hexp_mem : Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
            exact hR_gt_one
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith))
            (h_ge _ (hΦ_maps _ hexp_mem))
        · have hθ₀_K : θ₀ ∈ K := hχ_supp θ₀ hθ₀ hχ_pos
          have hq_le : q θ₀ ≤ M₂ := by
            dsimp [q]
            calc M₂ * χ θ₀ ≤ M₂ * 1 := by gcongr; exact (hχ_bounds θ₀).2
              _ = M₂ := mul_one M₂
          have hq_lt_M₁ : ENNReal.ofReal (q θ₀) < ENNReal.ofReal M₁ :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (lt_of_le_of_lt hM₂_nonneg hM₂_lt)).mpr
              (lt_of_le_of_lt hq_le hM₂_lt)
          exact lt_trans hq_lt_M₁ (hβ_K_gt θ₀ hθ₀_K)
      intro θ
      have hper_exp : Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))
          (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro t
        push_cast
        rw [add_mul, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
      let g_pair : ℝ → ℝ × ℂ := fun t => (q t, Φ_β (Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      have hg_per : Function.Periodic g_pair (2 * Real.pi) := fun t => by
        have hexp_t : Complex.exp (((t + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
            Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := hper_exp t
        dsimp [g_pair]
        rw [hq_per t, hexp_t]
      obtain ⟨θ₀, hθ₀_mem, hθ₀_eq⟩ := hg_per.exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos θ
      have hq_eq : q θ = q θ₀ := congr_arg Prod.fst hθ₀_eq
      have hΦ_eq : Φ_β (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
          Φ_β (Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := congr_arg Prod.snd hθ₀_eq
      rw [hq_eq, hΦ_eq]
      exact hIco_lt θ₀ hθ₀_mem
    have hres := h_disk_supermean R_Φ Φ_β hR_gt_one hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hΦ_deriv q hq_cont hq_per hq_lt
    have hint_eq : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) =
        M₂ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ θ) := by
      dsimp [q]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      ring
    have hΦ0 : Φ_β 0 = F 0 := by simp [Φ_β]
    rwa [hint_eq, hΦ0] at hres

  
  have h_equator :
      ∀ (t₀_c : ℂ) (ρ L : ℝ),
        0 < ρ →
        ‖t₀_c‖ + ρ < r_base →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, Real.sin θ ≠ 0 →
          ENNReal.ofReal L ≤ h_F (t₀_c + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
        ENNReal.ofReal L ≤ h_F t₀_c := by
    clear h_conformal h_cutoff h_radial h_lsc
    intro t₀_c ρ L hρ ht₀_ρ h_circle
    rcases le_or_gt L 0 with hL_nonpos | hL_pos
    · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr hL_nonpos]; exact zero_le
    by_cases htop : h_F t₀_c = ⊤
    · rw [htop]; exact le_top
    let y : ℝ := (h_F t₀_c).toReal
    have hy_nonneg : 0 ≤ y := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hy_eq : ENNReal.ofReal y = h_F t₀_c := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal htop
    by_contra hnot_le
    have hy_lt_L : y < L := by
      by_contra hge
      exact hnot_le (hy_eq ▸ ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (not_lt.mp hge))
    let c : ℝ := (y + L) / 2
    have hc_pos : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    have hy_lt_c : y < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    have hc_lt_L : c < L := by dsimp [c]; linarith
    let ε : ℝ := (L - c) / 2
    have hLmε : L - ε = (L + c) / 2 := by dsimp [ε]; ring
    have hLmε_pos : 0 < L - ε := by linarith
    have hLmε_lt_L : L - ε < L := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
    let δ_θ : ℝ := min (Real.pi / 8) (Real.pi * (L - c) / (4 * (L + c)))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_θ :=
      lt_min (by linarith [Real.pi_pos]) (div_pos (mul_pos Real.pi_pos (by linarith)) (by linarith))
    have hδ_le_pi8 : δ_θ ≤ Real.pi / 8 := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ_le_rat : δ_θ ≤ Real.pi * (L - c) / (4 * (L + c)) := min_le_right _ _
    let η_sin : ℝ := Real.sin δ_θ
    have hη_sin_pos : 0 < η_sin :=
      Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hδ_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => min 1 (|Real.sin θ| / η_sin)
    let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => (L - ε) * ψ θ
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ :=
      continuous_const.min ((continuous_abs.comp Real.continuous_sin).div_const η_sin)
    have hq_cont : Continuous q := continuous_const.mul hψ_cont
    have hq_per : Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) := fun θ => by
      dsimp [q, ψ]; rw [Real.sin_periodic θ]
    let R_Φ : ℝ := (r_base - ‖t₀_c‖) / ρ
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => t₀_c + (ρ : ℂ) * ζ
    have hR_gt_one : 1 < R_Φ := (one_lt_div hρ).mpr (by linarith)
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) :=
      ((differentiable_const t₀_c).add
        ((differentiable_const (ρ : ℂ)).mul differentiable_id)).differentiableOn
    have hΦ_maps : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ ⊢
      have hζ_mul : ρ * ‖ζ‖ < r_base - ‖t₀_c‖ := by
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ hρ
        dsimp [R_Φ] at hmul
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hρ)] at hmul

            (fun θ hθ => ⟨⟨by norm_num, le_refl 1⟩, Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hθ⟩)
        exact hcomp.congr (fun θ _ => by simp [Function.comp, γ_arc])
      have hO_eq_pre : O_θ = J ∩ γ_arc ⁻¹' U₁ := by
        ext θ
        simp only [O_θ, U₁, γ_arc, Set.mem_sep_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
          Set.mem_Ioi]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hθJ, hgt⟩
          exact ⟨hθJ, (hbdry_eq_Ioo θ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hθJ)).2.2, hgt⟩
        · rintro ⟨hθJ, _, hgt⟩
          exact ⟨hθJ, hgt⟩
      rw [hO_eq_pre]
      exact hγ_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_Ioo hU₁_open
    have hO_cnt : (J \ O_θ).Countable := by
      have hg_inj : Function.Injective (J.domRestrict x_bdry) :=
        Set.injOn_iff_injective.mp hx_inj
      have hcnt_sub : ((J.domRestrict x_bdry) ⁻¹' E_cnt).Countable :=
        hE_cnt.preimage hg_inj
      have hcnt_img : (((J.domRestrict x_bdry) ⁻¹' E_cnt).image Subtype.val).Countable :=
        hcnt_sub.image Subtype.val
      refine hcnt_img.mono ?_
      intro θ hθ
      have hθJ : θ ∈ J := hθ.1
      obtain ⟨hFeq, hx_Ioo, _⟩ := hbdry_eq_Ioo θ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hθJ)
      have hx_mem_E : x_bdry θ ∈ E_cnt := by
        by_contra hx_not_E
        have hge_M := hM_ae (x_bdry θ) ⟨hx_Ioo, hx_not_E⟩
        rw [← hFeq] at hge_M
        have hlt_M : ENNReal.ofReal (M - ε) < ENNReal.ofReal M :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hM_pos).mpr (by linarith)
        exact hθ.2 ⟨hθJ, lt_of_lt_of_le hlt_M hge_M⟩
      exact ⟨⟨θ, hθJ⟩, hx_mem_E, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨K, χ, hK_compact, hK_sub_O, hχ_cont, hχ_per, hχ_bounds, hχ_supp, hχ_int⟩ :=
      h_cutoff η_arc hη_pos hη_lt O_θ hO_open hO_sub hO_cnt
    have hK_sub_Icc : K ⊆ Set.Icc η_arc (2 * Real.pi - η_arc) :=
      fun _ h => Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hO_sub (hK_sub_O h))
    have hrad := h_radial F K χ (M - ε) (M - 2 * ε) hF_holo hF_maps hF_deriv hK_compact
      (hF_cont.mono (Set.prod_mono_right hK_sub_Icc))
      (fun θ hθ => (hbdry_eq_Ioo θ (hK_sub_Icc hθ)).2.2)
      (fun θ hθ => (hK_sub_O hθ).2)
      hχ_cont hχ_per hχ_bounds hχ_supp
      (le_of_lt hMm2ε_pos) (by linarith)
    rw [hF0] at hrad
    have hL_le : L ≤ (M - 2 * ε) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ θ) := by
      dsimp [L]
      have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt Real.two_pi_pos)
      gcongr
    exact le_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hL_le) hrad
  have heq_res := h_equator (t₀ : ℂ) ρ L hρ_pos ht₀_ρ hcircle_L
  rw [← hy₀_eq] at heq_res
  have hL_le_y₀ : L ≤ y₀ := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hy₀_nonneg).mp heq_res
  linarith

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Nonempty (LineGlancingChartData C B k)

proof.tactics:
by
  let a₀ : ℝ := C.ϕ 0
  have h_part12 : ∃ (R₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℂ × ℂ) (ℂ × ℂ)),
      0 < R₀ ∧ 0 < δ₀ ∧
      (↑e : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) =
        (fun p => (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
          glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2)) ∧
      (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀) ⊆ e.target) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
        e.symm q ∈ lineChainBox C B k) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ e.symm
        (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartAlpha C k e.symm r)
          (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k,
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
          lineChartPsi C k e.symm i q ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ a δ : ℝ,
        ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀) →
          (lineChartAlpha C k e.symm r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀),
        lineChartAlpha C k e.symm r (z, 0) = z ∧
        deriv (fun w : ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k e.symm r (z, w)) 0 = ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
        (∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
          lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
            (fun s => lineChartAlpha C k e.symm s q) r = 0) ∧
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (lineChartAction C k e.symm) q =
          glancingOffset C ((e.symm q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (e.symm q).2) (e.symm q).2 -
            glancingOffset C (e.symm q).1 (e.symm q).2 ∧
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (lineChartAction C k e.symm) q =
          glancingOffset C ((e.symm q).1 + (k : ℂ) * (e.symm q).2) (e.symm q).2) := by
    let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := lineChainBox C B k
    have hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hk_ge2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hk_ne : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
    have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := by
      refine IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_
      · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
          continuous_const
      · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    have h00_W₀ : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W₀ := by
      simp [W₀, lineChainBox, B.s_det_pos, div_pos B.r_det_pos hk_pos]
    have h_shift_bounds : ∀ p ∈ W₀, ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k + 1 →
        |(p.1 + (j : ℂ) * p.2).im| < (11 / 8 : ℝ) * B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / 2 := by
      intro p hp j hj
      have hmul_k : (k : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det := (lt_div_iff₀' hk_pos).mp hp.2
      have hp2_nn : 0 ≤ ‖p.2‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hp2_lt : ‖p.2‖ < B.r_det / 2 := by
        have h2le : 2 * ‖p.2‖ ≤ (k : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk_ge2 hp2_nn
        linarith
      have hj_le : (j : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hj
      have hj_im : |((j : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖p.2‖ := by
        calc |((j : ℂ) * p.2).im|
            ≤ ‖(j : ℂ) * p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ = (j : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
          _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖p.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hj_le hp2_nn
      refine ⟨?_, hp2_lt⟩
      rw [Complex.add_im]
      have htri : |p.1.im + ((j : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |((j : ℂ) * p.2).im| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      have hmul_kp1 : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖p.2‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * B.r_det := by
        have : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖p.2‖ = (k : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ + ‖p.2‖ := by ring
        linarith
      linarith [hp.1, B.r_det_lt_s_det]
    let Θ_sh : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun j p => glancingTheta C (p.1 + (j : ℂ) * p.2) p.2
    have hΘ_sh_holo : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k + 1 → DifferentiableOn ℂ (Θ_sh j) W₀ := by
      intro j hj
      have haff : Differentiable ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + (j : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)) :=
        (differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const (j : ℂ)).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
          differentiable_snd
      change DifferentiableOn ℂ
        ((fun q : ℂ × ℂ => glancingTheta C q.1 q.2) ∘
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + (j : ℂ) * p.2, p.2))) W₀
      refine B.theta_holo.comp haff.differentiableOn ?_
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨him, hnm⟩ := h_shift_bounds p hp j hj
      exact ⟨by linarith [B.s_det_pos], by linarith [B.r_det_pos]⟩
    let Φ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingTheta C p.1 p.2
    let Φ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2
    let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (Φ₁ p, Φ₂ p)
    have hΦ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₁ W₀ := by
      simpa [Φ₁, Θ_sh] using hΘ_sh_holo 0 (by omega)
    have hΦ₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ₂ W₀ := (hΘ_sh_holo k (by omega)).sub hΦ₁_holo
    have h_fderiv_2d : ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W₀ → ∀ p ∈ W₀,
        HasFDerivAt f
          ((iterDerivYT 1 0 f p) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
            (iterDerivYT 0 1 f p) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) p := by
      intro f hf p hp
      have hf_at : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℂ f p) p :=
        (hf.differentiableAt (hW₀_open.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt
      have hin1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, p.2)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) p.1 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id p.1).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
          (hasDerivAt_const p.1 p.2).hasFDerivAt).hasDerivAt
      have hin2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (p.1, w)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) p.2 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_const p.2 p.1).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
          (hasDerivAt_id p.2).hasFDerivAt).hasDerivAt
      have hd1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 f p = (fderiv ℂ f p) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) :=
        (hf_at.comp_hasDerivAt p.1 hin1).deriv
      have hd2 : iterDerivYT 0 1 f p = (fderiv ℂ f p) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) :=
        (hf_at.comp_hasDerivAt p.2 hin2).deriv
      convert hf_at using 1
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have hv : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by ext <;> simp
      conv_rhs => rw [hv]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, ← hd1, ← hd2]
      simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    let a₁₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 Φ₁
    let a₁₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 0 1 Φ₁
    let a₂₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 Φ₂
    let a₂₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 0 1 Φ₂
    let Δ_Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => a₁₁ p * a₂₂ p - a₁₂ p * a₂₁ p
    let E₁₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ)
    let E₁₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)
    let E₂₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ)
    let E₂₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ)
    let L_Φ : ℂ × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) := fun p =>
      a₁₁ p • E₁₁ + a₁₂ p • E₁₂ + a₂₁ p • E₂₁ + a₂₂ p • E₂₂
    have hΦ_fderiv : ∀ p ∈ W₀, HasFDerivAt Φ (L_Φ p) p := by
      intro p hp
      have h1 := h_fderiv_2d hΦ₁_holo p hp
      have h2 := h_fderiv_2d hΦ₂_holo p hp
      convert h1.prodMk h2 using 1
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      ext <;> simp [L_Φ, E₁₁, E₁₂, E₂₁, E₂₂, a₁₁, a₁₂, a₂₁, a₂₂]
    have ha₁₁_cont : ContinuousOn a₁₁ W₀ := (B.iterDerivYT_holo hW₀_open hΦ₁_holo 1 0).continuousOn
    have ha₁₂_cont : ContinuousOn a₁₂ W₀ := (B.iterDerivYT_holo hW₀_open hΦ₁_holo 0 1).continuousOn
    have ha₂₁_cont : ContinuousOn a₂₁ W₀ := (B.iterDerivYT_holo hW₀_open hΦ₂_holo 1 0).continuousOn
    have ha₂₂_cont : ContinuousOn a₂₂ W₀ := (B.iterDerivYT_holo hW₀_open hΦ₂_holo 0 1).continuousOn
    have hL_Φ_cont : ContinuousOn L_Φ W₀ :=
      (((ha₁₁_cont.smul continuousOn_const).add (ha₁₂_cont.smul continuousOn_const)).add
        (ha₂₁_cont.smul continuousOn_const)).add (ha₂₂_cont.smul continuousOn_const)
    have hΔ_cont : ContinuousOn Δ_Φ W₀ :=
      (ha₁₁_cont.mul ha₂₂_cont).sub (ha₁₂_cont.mul ha₂₁_cont)
    have hΦ_strict : ∀ p ∈ W₀, HasStrictFDerivAt Φ (L_Φ p) p := by
      intro p hp
      exact hasStrictFDerivAt_of_hasFDerivAt_of_continuousAt
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW₀_open.mem_nhds hp) hΦ_fderiv)
        (hL_Φ_cont.continuousAt (hW₀_open.mem_nhds hp))
    let cramerEquiv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, Δ_Φ p ≠ 0 → (ℂ × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) := fun p hΔ =>
      let adj_Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        a₂₂ p • E₁₁ + (-a₁₂ p) • E₁₂ + (-a₂₁ p) • E₂₁ + a₁₁ p • E₂₂
      let L_inv : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) := (Δ_Φ p)⁻¹ • adj_Φ
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse (L_Φ p) L_inv
        (fun v => by
          have h1 : adj_Φ (L_Φ p v) = Δ_Φ p • v := by
            ext <;> simp [L_Φ, adj_Φ, E₁₁, E₁₂, E₂₁, E₂₂, Δ_Φ] <;> ring
          change ((Δ_Φ p)⁻¹ • adj_Φ) (L_Φ p v) = v
          rw [_root_.smul_apply, h1, inv_smul_smul₀ hΔ])
        (fun w => by
          have h1 : L_Φ p (adj_Φ w) = Δ_Φ p • w := by
            ext <;> simp [L_Φ, adj_Φ, E₁₁, E₁₂, E₂₁, E₂₂, Δ_Φ] <;> ring
          change L_Φ p (((Δ_Φ p)⁻¹ • adj_Φ) w) = w
          rw [_root_.smul_apply, map_smul, h1, inv_smul_smul₀ hΔ])
    have hΘ_partials_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < B.s_det →
        a₁₁ (y, 0) = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ y ∧ a₁₂ (y, 0) = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_W₀ : (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W₀ := ⟨hy, by simp [div_pos B.r_det_pos hk_pos]⟩
      have hy_2s₁ : |y.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by linarith [B.s_det_le_s₁, B.s_det_pos]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => glancingTheta C y' 0) y = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ y
        have hopen_s1 : IsOpen { y' : ℂ | |y'.im| < 2 * C.s₁ } :=
          isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
        have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => glancingTheta C y' 0) =ᶠ[nhds y] C.ϕ_ℂ :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen_s1.mem_nhds hy_2s₁)
            (fun y' hy' => by simp [glancingTheta, C.U_zero y' hy'])
        exact hev.deriv_eq
      · change deriv (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, t)) 0 = 0
        set d := deriv (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, t)) 0
        have hd_at : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, t)) d 0 := by
          have hdiff2d : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ₁ (y, 0) :=
            hΦ₁_holo.differentiableAt (hW₀_open.mem_nhds hy_W₀)
          exact (hdiff2d.comp 0 ((differentiableAt_const y).prodMk differentiableAt_id)).hasDerivAt
        have hd_neg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, -t)) (-d) 0 := by
          have hd_at_neg0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, t)) d (-(0 : ℂ)) := by simpa using hd_at
          have hd_neg_raw := HasDerivAt.comp (0 : ℂ) hd_at_neg0 (hasDerivAt_neg (0 : ℂ))
          exact hd_neg_raw.congr_deriv (by ring)
        have hev_even : (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, -t)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun t : ℂ => Φ₁ (y, t)) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self C.r₁_pos))
            (fun t ht => by
              have ht' : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
              simp [Φ₁, glancingTheta, C.U_even y t hy_2s₁ ht'])
        have hd_eq : d = -d := hd_at.unique (hd_neg.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_even.symm)
        have h2d : (2 : ℂ) * d = 0 := by linear_combination hd_eq
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2d).resolve_left two_ne_zero
    have hΔ_00_ne : Δ_Φ (0, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      have hp0 := hΘ_partials_zero 0 (by simpa using B.s_det_pos)
      have h0_strip0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := by simp [horizStrip, C.s₀_pos]
      have hlam_ne : deriv C.ϕ_ℂ 0 ≠ 0 := C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero 0 h0_strip0
      have ha₂₁_0 : a₂₁ (0, 0) = 0 := by
        change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => Φ₁ (y' + (k : ℂ) * 0, 0) - Φ₁ (y', 0)) 0 = 0
        simp
      have ha₂₂_0 : a₂₂ (0, 0) = (k : ℂ) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ 0 := by
        obtain ⟨γ₀, hγ₀⟩ : ∃ γ₀ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ, γ₀ = fun t => ((0 : ℂ) + (k : ℂ) * t, t) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hf1 : HasFDerivAt Φ₁
            ((deriv C.ϕ_ℂ 0) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ +
              (0 : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) (γ₀ 0) := by
          have h := h_fderiv_2d hΦ₁_holo (0, 0) h00_W₀
          rw [show iterDerivYT 1 0 Φ₁ (0, 0) = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ 0 from hp0.1,
            show iterDerivYT 0 1 Φ₁ (0, 0) = 0 from hp0.2] at h
          simpa [hγ₀] using h
        have hlin : HasDerivAt γ₀ ((k : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) 0 := by

            _ < 1 / (2 * (k : ℝ)) + 1 / (2 * (k : ℝ)) := add_lt_add (h4 i) (h4 j)
            _ = 1 / (k : ℝ) := by ring
        have h_lb : 1 / (k : ℝ) ≤ ‖c_fn i - c_fn j‖ := by
          have hdiff_eq : c_fn i - c_fn j = ((((i.1 : ℝ) - (j.1 : ℝ)) / (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            dsimp [c_fn]
            push_cast
            field_simp [hk_ne]
            ring
          rw [hdiff_eq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ))]
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij_val with hlt | hgt
          · have hij_le : i.1 + 1 ≤ j.1 := hlt
            have hij_R : (i.1 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (j.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hij_le
            rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
            linarith
          · have hji_le : j.1 + 1 ≤ i.1 := hgt
            have hji_R : (j.1 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hji_le
            rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
            linarith
        linarith
      · have hH_smul : H_mat q_c = (q.2 : ℂ) • H_div q_c := by
          ext r s
          rw [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          exact ((h_divZero_props (hH_holo r s) (hH_zero r s)).2.1 q_c hqU₀).symm
        change (H_mat q_c).det ≠ 0
        rw [hH_smul, Matrix.det_smul]
        exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hq2_ne) h5
  obtain ⟨R, δ_star, hR_pos, hR_le, hδ_pos, hδ_le, h2δ_lt, hWebBase, hTrapNondeg⟩ := h_part3
  let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)
  let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_star)
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hU_sub_U₀ : U ⊆ U₀ :=
    Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
  let V_W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := e.source ∩ e ⁻¹' U
  let Φ_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p =>
    (glancingTheta C p.1 p.2,
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 - glancingTheta C p.1 p.2)
  have he_app : ∀ x : ℂ × ℂ, Φ_map x = e x := fun x => congr_fun he_coe.symm x
  have hΨ_maps_V_W : ∀ q ∈ U, e.symm q ∈ V_W := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_tgt : q ∈ e.target := hU₀_tgt (hU_sub_U₀ hq)
    refine ⟨e.map_target hq_tgt, ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm q) ∈ U
    rwa [e.right_inv hq_tgt]
  refine ⟨{
    a₀ := a₀
    R := R
    δ_star := δ_star
    C₀ := 2
    a₀_eq := rfl
    R_pos := hR_pos
    δ_star_pos := hδ_pos
    C₀_pos := by norm_num
    C₀_δ_star_lt := h2δ_lt
    V_W := V_W
    Ψ := e.symm
    V_W_open := e.isOpen_inter_preimage hU_open
    V_W_nonempty := by
      have hq0_U : ((a₀ : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U :=
        ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity), Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)⟩
      exact ⟨e.symm ((a₀ : ℂ), 0), hΨ_maps_V_W ((a₀ : ℂ), 0) hq0_U⟩
    V_W_sub := by
      intro p ⟨hp_src, hp_U⟩
      have hp_eq : e.symm (e p) = p := e.left_inv hp_src
      rw [← hp_eq]
      exact hΨ_maps_W₀ (e p) (hU_sub_U₀ hp_U)
    Ψ_holo := hΨ_holo.mono hU_sub_U₀
    Ψ_maps_V_W := hΨ_maps_V_W
    Φ_left_inv := by
      intro q hq
      have hΦ_eq : Φ_map (e.symm q) = q := by
        rw [he_app]
        exact e.right_inv (hU₀_tgt (hU_sub_U₀ hq))
      exact ⟨congr_arg Prod.fst hΦ_eq, congr_arg Prod.snd hΦ_eq⟩
    Φ_right_inv := by
      intro p ⟨hp_src, hp_U⟩
      have hp_U' : Φ_map p ∈ U := by
        rw [he_app]
        exact hp_U
      refine ⟨hp_U', ?_⟩
      change e.symm (Φ_map p) = p
      rw [he_app]
      exact e.left_inv hp_src
    α_endpoints := by
      intro q hq
      have hΦ_eq : Φ_map (e.symm q) = q := by
        rw [he_app]
        exact e.right_inv (hU₀_tgt (hU_sub_U₀ hq))
      have h1 : (Φ_map (e.symm q)).1 = q.1 := congr_arg Prod.fst hΦ_eq
      have h2 : (Φ_map (e.symm q)).2 = q.2 := congr_arg Prod.snd hΦ_eq
      refine ⟨by simpa [lineChartAlpha, Φ_map] using h1, ?_⟩
      have hsum : (Φ_map (e.symm q)).1 + (Φ_map (e.symm q)).2 = q.1 + q.2 := by rw [h1, h2]
      dsimp [Φ_map] at hsum
      simpa [lineChartAlpha] using hsum
    α_holo := fun r => (hα_holo r).mono hU_sub_U₀
    ψ_maps_strip := fun i q hq => hψ_maps_strip i q (hU_sub_U₀ hq)
    stationary_on_chart := fun q hq => (h_stat_and_partials q (hU_sub_U₀ hq)).1
    action_deriv_a := fun q hq => (h_stat_and_partials q (hU_sub_U₀ hq)).2.1
    action_deriv_d := fun q hq => (h_stat_and_partials q (hU_sub_U₀ hq)).2.2
    α_at_zero := by
      intro r a ha
      have ha_ball : (a : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs]
        linarith
      exact hα_zero_and_slope r (a : ℂ) ha_ball
    ψ_web_base := hWebBase
    trapezoid_nondeg := hTrapNondeg
  }⟩

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (hAlg : AlgebraicLiftingToolkit)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4))
    (hδ₁ : δ₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 G.δ_star) :
    Nonempty (LineCoreEliminationData C B k G a₁ δ₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hTay : LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit :=
    line_core_taylor2d_toolkit (@B.iterDerivYT_holo)
  have hSub : LineCoreSubfieldSeriesToolkit :=
    line_core_subfield_series_toolkit
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let K_end : Subfield ℂ := lineCoreEndpointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  let coreTuple : Fin (lineCoreCard k) → ℂ := lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁
  let F_val : Subfield ℂ := Subfield.closure ((K_end : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  obtain ⟨hAlgOverPt, hActPos⟩ :=
    line_core_endpoint_radical_and_action_taylor Ω C B k hk G hAlg hTay hSub a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
  obtain ⟨hJetsMem, hAngMem⟩ :=
    line_core_vandermonde_jet_and_angle_elimination Ω C B k hk G hTay hSub a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
      K_end hActPos
  have h_rad_mem : ∀ r : Fin 6, lineCoreRadicals C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ r ∈ K_end :=
    fun r => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r, rfl⟩)
  have hHalfMem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) ∈ F_val ∧
      Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) ∈ F_val := by
    intro r
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (LineCoreIdx k)
    constructor
    · have h_eq : coreTuple (e (Sum.inl (r, false))) = Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) := by
        change lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ (e (Sum.inl (r, false))) = _
        unfold lineCoreTuple
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inl (r, false)), rfl⟩)
    · have h_eq : coreTuple (e (Sum.inl (r, true))) = Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) := by
        change lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ (e (Sum.inl (r, true))) = _
        unfold lineCoreTuple
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inl (r, true)), rfl⟩)
  have hCoreSub :
      Set.range coreTuple ⊆
        { z : ℂ |
          (∃ r : Fin (k + 1),
            z = Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) ∨
            z = Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2)) ∨
          (∃ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
            z = iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁)) } := by
    rintro z ⟨idx, rfl⟩
    change lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ idx ∈ _
    unfold lineCoreTuple
    rcases h_symm : (Fintype.equivFin (LineCoreIdx k)).symm idx with ⟨r, b⟩ | ⟨i, m⟩
    · cases b
      · exact Or.inl ⟨r, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨r, Or.inr rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, (m : ℕ), rfl⟩
  have h2_mem : (2 : ℂ) ∈ F_val := by
    rw [← one_add_one_eq_two]
    exact F_val.add_mem F_val.one_mem F_val.one_mem
  have hFullMem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁) ∈ F_val ∧
      Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁) ∈ F_val := by
    intro r
    have h_two : G.α_fn r p₁ = 2 * (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) := by ring
    constructor
    · rw [h_two, Complex.cos_two_mul']
      exact F_val.sub_mem (F_val.pow_mem (hHalfMem r).1 2) (F_val.pow_mem (hHalfMem r).2 2)
    · rw [h_two, Complex.sin_two_mul]
      exact F_val.mul_mem (F_val.mul_mem h2_mem (hHalfMem r).2) (hHalfMem r).1
  have hStepMem : ∀ i : Fin k,
      Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val ∧
      Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val := by
    intro i
    have h_dfn : G.d_fn i p₁ = G.α_fn i.succ p₁ / 2 - G.α_fn i.castSucc p₁ / 2 := by
      change (G.α_fn i.succ p₁ - G.α_fn i.castSucc p₁) / 2 = _
      exact sub_div _ _ _
    constructor
    · rw [h_dfn, Complex.cos_sub]
      exact F_val.add_mem
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).1 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).1)
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).2 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).2)
    · rw [h_dfn, Complex.sin_sub]
      exact F_val.sub_mem
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).2 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).1)
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).1 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).2)
  have hActValMem : G.A_line p₁ ∈ F_val := by
    change (∑ i : Fin k, 2 * C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) * Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁)) ∈ F_val
    refine F_val.sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    have hh0 : C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val := by
      simpa using hJetsMem i 0
    exact F_val.mul_mem (F_val.mul_mem h2_mem hh0) (hStepMem i).2
  have hDualMem : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      glancingDualLine C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + (j : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 ι ∈ F_val := by
    intro j _hj0 hjk ι
    let q₁ : ℂ × ℂ := G.Ψ p₁
    let i_j : Fin k := ⟨j, hjk⟩
    have hθ₁ : glancingTheta C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2 = G.α_fn i_j.castSucc p₁ := rfl
    have hθ₂ : glancingTheta C ((q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) + q₁.2) q₁.2 = G.α_fn i_j.succ p₁ := by
      have h_arg : (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) + q₁.2 = q₁.1 + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * q₁.2 := by
        push_cast
        ring
      change glancingTheta C ((q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) + q₁.2) q₁.2 =
        glancingTheta C (q₁.1 + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2
      rw [h_arg]
    have hOffMem : glancingOffset C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2 ∈ F_val := by
      unfold glancingOffset supportAction1_ℂ
      rw [hθ₁, hθ₂]
      change -(deriv C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_j p₁) * Complex.sin (G.d_fn i_j p₁) -
        C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_j p₁) * Complex.cos (G.d_fn i_j p₁)) ∈ F_val
      have hh0 : C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_j p₁) ∈ F_val := by
        simpa using hJetsMem i_j 0
      have hh1 : deriv C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_j p₁) ∈ F_val := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hJetsMem i_j 1
      exact F_val.neg_mem (F_val.sub_mem
        (F_val.mul_mem hh1 (hStepMem i_j).2)
        (F_val.mul_mem hh0 (hStepMem i_j).1))
    fin_cases ι
    · change Complex.cos (glancingTheta C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2) /
          glancingOffset C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2 ∈ F_val
      rw [hθ₁]
      exact F_val.div_mem (hFullMem i_j.castSucc).1 hOffMem
    · change Complex.sin (glancingTheta C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2) /
          glancingOffset C (q₁.1 + (j : ℂ) * q₁.2) q₁.2 ∈ F_val
      rw [hθ₁]
      exact F_val.div_mem (hFullMem i_j.castSucc).2 hOffMem
  exact ⟨{
    K_end := K_end
    N_core := lineCoreCard k
    coreTuple := coreTuple
    K_end_alg_over_pt := hAlgOverPt
    cos_half_zero_mem := by simpa [lineCoreRadicals] using h_rad_mem 2
    sin_half_zero_mem := by simpa [lineCoreRadicals] using h_rad_mem 3
    cos_half_last_mem := by simpa [lineCoreRadicals] using h_rad_mem 4
    sin_half_last_mem := by simpa [lineCoreRadicals] using h_rad_mem 5
    action_pos_taylor_mem := hActPos
    action_val_mem := hActValMem
    half_angles_mem := hHalfMem
    support_jets_mem := hJetsMem
    angle_taylor_mem := hAngMem
    core_entries_subset := hCoreSub
    dualLine_mem_F_val := hDualMem
  }⟩

line_core_vandermonde_elimination.definitions:
noncomputable def lineCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivA (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) S

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivD (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) S

noncomputable def lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def lineCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def lineCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

structure LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit : Prop where
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  centeredTaylor2D_fst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0
  centeredTaylor2D_snd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  deriv_taylor2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ ∧
      lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
      taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
        lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀)

structure LineCoreSubfieldSeriesToolkit : Prop where
  C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c)
  X_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s)
  add_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S + T)
  sub_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T)
  mul_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T)

    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin 6 → ℂ :=
