noncomputable def lineCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivA (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) S

noncomputable def lineCoreDerivD (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) S

noncomputable def lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def lineCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def lineCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

structure LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit : Prop where
  iterDerivYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  centeredTaylor2D_fst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0
  centeredTaylor2D_snd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  deriv_taylor2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ ∧
      lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
      taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
        lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hJet : LineArcJetAndTaylorToolkit := line_arc_jet_and_taylor_toolkit
  obtain ⟨D_form⟩ :=
    line_arc_formal_recentered_system Ω C B k hk G a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁ E hAlg hJet hNonAlg
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hq₁_trap : (a₁, δ₁) ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀ := by
    refine ⟨hδ₁.1, hδ₁.2, ?_⟩
    have ha₁_abs : |a₁ - G.a₀| < G.R / 4 :=
      abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ha₁.1], by linarith [ha₁.2]⟩
    have hCδ : G.C₀ * δ₁ < G.C₀ * G.δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ₁.2 G.C₀_pos
    linarith [G.C₀_δ_star_lt, G.R_pos]
  have htrap_sub_U₀ : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
      ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀ := by
    intro q hq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hpos : 0 < G.C₀ * q.2 := mul_pos G.C₀_pos hq.1
      linarith [hq.2.2, G.R_pos]
    · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hq.1]
      linarith [hq.2.1, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hp₁_U₀ : p₁ ∈ U₀ := htrap_sub_U₀ (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap
  let W₀ : Set ℂ := horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hW₀_conv : Convex ℝ W₀ := by
    intro z hz w hw a b ha hb hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp_all
    · change |(a • z + b • w).im| < 2 * C.s_h
      have him : (a • z + b • w).im = a * z.im + b * w.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      calc |a * z.im + b * w.im|
          ≤ |a * z.im| + |b * w.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |z.im| + b * |w.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ < a * (2 * C.s_h) + b * (2 * C.s_h) := by
            have h1 : a * |z.im| < a * (2 * C.s_h) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz ha_pos
            have h2 : b * |w.im| ≤ b * (2 * C.s_h) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hw) hb
            linarith
        _ = 2 * C.s_h := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
  have hW₀_preconn : IsPreconnected W₀ := hW₀_conv.isPreconnected
  have hh'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ) W₀ := C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv hW₀_open
  have hh''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) W₀ := hh'_holo.deriv hW₀_open
  have hinv2_U₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (2 : ℂ)⁻¹) U₀ :=
    differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹
  have hψ_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.ψ_fn i) U₀ := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.castSucc
    have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.succ
    exact ((h1.add h2).mul hinv2_U₀).congr fun q _ => by
      change (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q + lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) / 2 = _
      exact div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
  have hd_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.d_fn i) U₀ := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.succ
    have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.castSucc
    exact ((h1.sub h2).mul hinv2_U₀).congr fun q _ => by
      change (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q - lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) / 2 = _
      exact div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
  have hH_entry_cont : ∀ r s : Fin (k - 1),
      ContinuousOn
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
            (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
        U₀ := by
    intro r s
    have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
            (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
        U₀ := by
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have hh_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_L q)) U₀ :=
        C.h_ℂ_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_L) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_L)
      have hh'_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_L q)) U₀ :=
        hh'_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_L) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_L)
      have hh''_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (G.ψ_fn i_L q)) U₀ :=
        hh''_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_L) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_L)
      have hh_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_R q)) U₀ :=
        C.h_ℂ_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_R) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_R)
      have hh'_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i_R q)) U₀ :=
        hh'_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_R) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_R)
      have hh''_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (G.ψ_fn i_R q)) U₀ :=
        hh''_holo.comp (hψ_holo i_R) (G.ψ_maps_strip i_R)
      have hsin_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i_L q)) U₀ :=
        Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (hd_holo i_L)
      have hcos_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i_L q)) U₀ :=
        Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn (hd_holo i_L)
      have hsin_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i_R q)) U₀ :=
        Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (hd_holo i_R)
      have hcos_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i_R q)) U₀ :=
        Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn (hd_holo i_R)
      unfold lineInteriorHess
      dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact (((((hh''_L.sub hh_L).mul hinv2_U₀).mul hsin_L).add (hh'_L.mul hcos_L)).add
          ((((hh''_R.sub hh_R).mul hinv2_U₀).mul hsin_R).sub (hh'_R.mul hcos_R))).congr
          fun q _ => by
            dsimp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, i_L, i_R,
              LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn, LineGlancingChartData.d_fn,
              lineChartPsi, lineChartHalfStep]
            ring
      · exact (((hh_R.add hh''_R).mul hinv2_U₀).mul hsin_R).congr fun q _ => by
          dsimp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, i_R,
            LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn, LineGlancingChartData.d_fn,
            lineChartPsi, lineChartHalfStep]
          ring
      · exact (((hh_L.add hh''_L).mul hinv2_U₀).mul hsin_L).congr fun q _ => by
          dsimp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, i_L,
            LineGlancingChartData.ψ_fn, LineGlancingChartData.d_fn,
            lineChartPsi, lineChartHalfStep]
          ring
      · exact differentiableOn_const 0
    exact h_holo.continuousOn
  let hessDet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q)).det
  have hhessDet_cont : ContinuousOn hessDet U₀ := by
    have hfun : hessDet = fun q =>
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k - 1)),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            ∏ i : Fin (k - 1),
              lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
                (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) (σ i) i := by
      ext q
      simp only [hessDet, Matrix.det_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun σ _ =>
      continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_prod _ fun i _ => hH_entry_cont (σ i) i)
  let U_hess : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U₀ ∩ hessDet ⁻¹' ({0}ᶜ)
  have hU_hess_open : IsOpen U_hess :=
    hhessDet_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU₀_open isOpen_compl_singleton
  let V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := connectedComponentIn U_hess p₁
  have hTrap_conv : Convex ℝ (webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀) := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp_all
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : 0 < a * x.2 := mul_pos ha_pos hx.1
        have h2 : 0 ≤ b * y.2 := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt hy.1)
        change 0 < a * x.2 + b * y.2
        linarith
      · have h1 : a * x.2 < a * G.δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx.2.1 ha_pos
        have h2 : b * y.2 ≤ b * G.δ_star := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy.2.1) hb
        change a * x.2 + b * y.2 < G.δ_star
        calc a * x.2 + b * y.2
            < a * G.δ_star + b * G.δ_star := by linarith
          _ = G.δ_star := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      · change |(a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀| < G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2)
        have hsplit : (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀ = a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀) := by
          calc (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀
              = (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - (a + b) * G.a₀ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀) := by ring
        rw [hsplit]
        calc |a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀)|
            ≤ |a * (x.1 - G.a₀)| + |b * (y.1 - G.a₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |x.1 - G.a₀| + b * |y.1 - G.a₀| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          _ < a * (G.R - G.C₀ * x.2) + b * (G.R - G.C₀ * y.2) := by
              have h1 : a * |x.1 - G.a₀| < a * (G.R - G.C₀ * x.2) :=
                mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx.2.2 ha_pos
              have h2 : b * |y.1 - G.a₀| ≤ b * (G.R - G.C₀ * y.2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy.2.2) hb
              linarith
          _ = G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2) := by
              calc a * (G.R - G.C₀ * x.2) + b * (G.R - G.C₀ * y.2)
                  = (a + b) * G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2) := by ring
                _ = G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have hTrap_mem_V₀ : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
      ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V₀ := by
    let emb : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ))
    have hemb_cont : Continuous emb :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd)
    have himg_preconn : IsPreconnected (emb '' webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀) :=
      hTrap_conv.isPreconnected.image emb hemb_cont.continuousOn
    have hp₁_mem_img : p₁ ∈ emb '' webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀ :=
      ⟨(a₁, δ₁), hq₁_trap, rfl⟩
    have himg_sub : emb '' webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀ ⊆ U_hess := by
      rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨htrap_sub_U₀ q hq, (G.trapezoid_nondeg q hq).2.2⟩
    have hsub := himg_preconn.subset_connectedComponentIn hp₁_mem_img himg_sub
    intro q hq
    exact hsub ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  let p₀ : ℕ := D_form.p - 1
  have hp₀ : p₀ + 1 = D_form.p := Nat.sub_add_cancel D_form.p_pos
  let S_base : LineArcStepAnalyticData C B k G a₁ δ₁ D_form p₀ :=
    { W_ψ := W₀
      V_plus := V₀
      g := fun _ _ _ => 0
      β := fun _ _ _ => 0
      W_ψ_open := hW₀_open
      W_ψ_preconn := hW₀_preconn
      W_ψ_sub_strip := Subset.rfl
      real_mem_W_ψ := fun x _ => by simp [W₀, horizStrip, C.s_h_pos]
      base_ψ_mem := fun i => G.ψ_maps_strip i p₁ hp₁_U₀
      V_plus_open := hU_hess_open.connectedComponentIn
      V_plus_preconn := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
      V_plus_sub := (connectedComponentIn_subset U_hess p₁).trans Set.inter_subset_left
      trapezoid_mem_V_plus := hTrap_mem_V₀
      ψ_maps_W_ψ := fun q hq i =>
        G.ψ_maps_strip i q ((connectedComponentIn_subset U_hess p₁ hq).1)
      hess_det_ne_zero := fun q hq => (connectedComponentIn_subset U_hess p₁ hq).2
      g_holo := fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const 0
      g_lt_p := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
      g_taylor := by
        intro i l hl1
        have hl_lt : (l : ℕ) < D_form.p := by omega
        rw [(D_form.vanish_lt_p (l : ℕ) hl1 hl_lt).1 i]
        ext n
        simp only [lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero]
        rcases n with _ | n
        · simp
        · rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
          simp
      β_holo := fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const 0
      β_zero := fun _ _ => rfl
      β_endpoints := fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      β_taylor := by
        intro l r hl1
        have hl_lt : (l : ℕ) < D_form.p := by omega
        rw [(D_form.vanish_lt_p (l : ℕ) hl1 hl_lt).2.1 r, hJet.taylor2D_const, map_zero]
      grad_jet_zero := by
        intro q _ r l hl1 _
        rcases l with _ | l
        · omega
        · have hfn :
              (fun ε : ℂ =>
                lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport (J := p₀) C.h_ℂ (fun _ _ _ => 0) ε)
                  (lineArcPertSupportDeriv (J := p₀) C.h_ℂ (fun _ _ _ => 0) ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (J := p₀) (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun _ _ => 0) ε) r) =
              fun _ : ℂ =>
                lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
                  (fun s => G.α_fn s q) r := by
            ext ε
            congr 1
            · ext i z; simp [lineArcPertSupport]
            · ext i z; simp [lineArcPertSupportDeriv]
            · ext s; simp [lineArcPertAngles]
          rw [lineArcEpsJet, hfn, iteratedDeriv_const]
          simp
      action_jet_const := by
        intro q _ l hl1
        have hl_lt : (l : ℕ) < D_form.p := by omega
        rw [(D_form.vanish_lt_p (l : ℕ) hl1 hl_lt).2.2]
        rcases hln : (l : ℕ) with _ | m
        · omega
        · have hfn :
              (fun ε : ℂ =>
                lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport (J := p₀) C.h_ℂ (fun _ _ _ => 0) ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (J := p₀) (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun _ _ => 0) ε)) =
              fun _ : ℂ => lineChainAction (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun s => G.α_fn s q) := by
            ext ε
            congr 1
            · ext i z; simp [lineArcPertSupport]
            · ext s; simp [lineArcPertAngles]
          rw [lineArcEpsJet, hfn, iteratedDeriv_const]
          simp }
  obtain ⟨S_lead_raw, _⟩ :=
    line_arc_single_step_web_continuation Ω C B k hk G a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁ hJet hWeb
      D_form p₀ (by omega) S_base
  let S_p : LineArcStepAnalyticData C B k G a₁ δ₁ D_form D_form.p := hp₀ ▸ S_lead_raw
  let W_lead : Set ℂ := S_p.W_ψ
  let g_lead : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => S_p.g i (Fin.last D_form.p)
  let tower : ∀ m : ℕ,
      { S : LineArcStepAnalyticData C B k G a₁ δ₁ D_form (D_form.p + m) //
        ∀ i : Fin k, S.g i ⟨D_form.p, by omega⟩ = g_lead i } :=
    fun m =>
      Nat.rec
        (motive := fun m =>
          { S : LineArcStepAnalyticData C B k G a₁ δ₁ D_form (D_form.p + m) //
            ∀ i : Fin k, S.g i ⟨D_form.p, by omega⟩ = g_lead i })
        ⟨S_p, fun _ => rfl⟩
        (fun m ih =>
          let h_step := line_arc_single_step_web_continuation Ω C B k hk G a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
            hJet hWeb D_form (D_form.p + m) (by omega) ih.1
          let S_next := Classical.choose h_step
          have h_eq := Classical.choose_spec h_step
          ⟨S_next, fun i => (h_eq i ⟨D_form.p, by omega⟩).trans (ih.2 i)⟩)
        m
  have h_models : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R) (G.a₀ + G.R),
      Nonempty (LineTruncatedCoalescingModel k D_form.p (D_form.p + m) a C.h_ℂ
        (fun i => g_lead i (a : ℂ))) := by
    intro m a ha
    let S_m := (tower m).1
    have hg_m := (tower m).2
    have ha_abs : |a - G.a₀| < G.R := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ha.1], by linarith [ha.2]⟩
    let δ₀ : ℝ := min G.δ_star ((G.R - |a - G.a₀|) / G.C₀)
    have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ :=
      lt_min G.δ_star_pos (div_pos (by linarith) G.C₀_pos)
    have h_mem_V : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) ∈ S_m.V_plus := by
      intro δ hδ
      apply S_m.trapezoid_mem_V_plus (a, δ)
      refine ⟨hδ.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hδ.2 (min_le_left _ _), ?_⟩
      have hlt : δ < (G.R - |a - G.a₀|) / G.C₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ.2 (min_le_right _ _)
      have hmul : δ * G.C₀ < G.R - |a - G.a₀| := (lt_div_iff₀ G.C₀_pos).mp hlt
      linarith
    refine ⟨{
      W_n := S_m.W_ψ
      W_n_open := S_m.W_ψ_open
      a_mem := S_m.real_mem_W_ψ a ha_abs
      h_holo := C.h_ℂ_holo.mono S_m.W_ψ_sub_strip
      g := S_m.g
      g_holo := S_m.g_holo
      g_lt_p := fun i l hl z _ => S_m.g_lt_p i l hl z
      g_at_p := fun i _ => congr_fun (hg_m i) (a : ℂ)
      K := fun l => D_form.K_seq (l : ℕ)
      δ₀ := δ₀
      δ₀_pos := hδ₀_pos
      α₀ := fun δ r => G.α_fn r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))
      β := fun l δ r => S_m.β l r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))
      β_zero := fun δ r => S_m.β_zero r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))
      α₀_endpoints := fun δ hδ =>
        G.α_endpoints ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (S_m.V_plus_sub (h_mem_V δ hδ))
      β_endpoints := fun l δ => S_m.β_endpoints l ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))
      α₀_tendsto := by
        intro r
        have ha0_U₀ : ((a : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀ := by
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq,
              ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            linarith [G.R_pos]
          · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_zero]
            linarith [G.δ_star_pos]
        let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => G.α_fn r ((a : ℂ), z)
        have hφ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ φ 0 :=
          ((G.α_holo r).differentiableAt (hU₀_open.mem_nhds ha0_U₀)).comp 0
            ((differentiableAt_const (a : ℂ)).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
        have hφ_deriv : HasDerivAt φ (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)) 0 :=
          (G.α_at_zero r a ha_abs).2 ▸ hφ_diff.hasDerivAt
        have h_slope := hφ_deriv.tendsto_slope_zero
        have h_ofReal : Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (δ : ℂ))
            (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) :=
          tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _
            (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) :
              Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (δ : ℂ)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (0 : ℂ)))
            (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun δ (hδ : 0 < δ) =>
              Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hδ)))
        refine (h_slope.comp h_ofReal).congr fun δ => ?_
        dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, φ]
        have h0 : G.α_fn r ((a : ℂ), 0) = (a : ℂ) := (G.α_at_zero r a ha_abs).1
        rw [zero_add, h0, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_eq_div]
      α₀_maps_W_n := fun δ hδ i => S_m.ψ_maps_W_ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ) i
      α₀_stat := fun δ hδ r =>
        G.stationary_on_chart ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (S_m.V_plus_sub (h_mem_V δ hδ)) r
      grad_jet_zero := by
        intro δ hδ r l hl1 hlJ
        have h_div := S_m.grad_jet_zero ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ) r l hl1 hlJ
        unfold lineArcEpsJet at h_div
        have h_fac : (l.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero l)
        exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h_div).resolve_right h_fac
      action_jet_const := fun δ hδ l hl1 =>
        S_m.action_jet_const ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ) l hl1
    }⟩
  refine ⟨{
    p := D_form.p
    p_pos := D_form.p_pos
    f_lead := fun i => D_form.f_full i D_form.p
    i₀ := D_form.i₀
    f_lead_i₀_ne_zero := D_form.f_lead_ne_zero
    W_lead := W_lead
    W_lead_open := S_p.W_ψ_open
    W_lead_preconn := S_p.W_ψ_preconn
    real_mem_W_lead := S_p.real_mem_W_ψ
    g_lead := g_lead
    g_lead_holo := fun i => S_p.g_holo i (Fin.last D_form.p)
    g_lead_taylor := by
      intro i
      refine ⟨S_p.base_ψ_mem i, fun n => ?_⟩
      have ht := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff n)
        (S_p.g_taylor i (Fin.last D_form.p) D_form.p_pos)
      simpa [lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, g_lead] using ht
    trunc_models := by
      intro J hJp a ha
      have hJ_eq : D_form.p + (J - D_form.p) = J := Nat.add_sub_of_le hJp
      exact hJ_eq ▸ h_models (J - D_form.p) a ha
  }⟩

line_formal_arc_web_continuation.definitions:
noncomputable abbrev lineArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def lineArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupport {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupportDeriv {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z

noncomputable def lineArcPertAngles {k J : ℕ} (α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (s : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
  α₀ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m s

noncomputable def lineArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def lineArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def lineArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def lineArcPsSin0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.sin 0

noncomputable def lineArcPsCos0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.cos 0

noncomputable def lineArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def lineArcFormalMid2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.castSucc + β_seq l i.succ) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.succ - β_seq l i.castSucc) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalSin2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) +
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalCos2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) -
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalAction2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    2 * lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i

noncomputable def lineArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_L) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R -
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_R) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R

noncomputable def lineArcTruncSupport {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun i l => if l ≤ J then f_full i l else 0

noncomputable def lineArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure LineArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  epsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
    {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g₁ : Fin k → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g₂ : Fin k → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg₁ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₂ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₁0 : ∀ i z, g₁ i 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ i z, g₂ i 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_eq : ∀ i (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ i ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ i m z)
    {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
    (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),
    lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε)) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε) r)
  epsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q =>
        lineArcEpsJet m
          (fun ε =>
            lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
      V ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
        V
  epsJet_succ_split : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg_top : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top i) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),
    let g_ext : Fin k → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => Fin.snoc (g i) (g_top i)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε)) +
      (∑ i : Fin k, 2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) α₀ r *
          β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
            α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  taylor2D_epsJet_eq : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    let sin_d0 := fun i => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let cos_d0 := fun i => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i l =>
      if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l s =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (α₀ s) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
      else 0
    taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
        p₁ =
      lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
          p₁ =
        lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq r)

structure LineArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  K_seq : ℕ → ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i 0 = lineArcHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full i₀ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ i : Fin k, f_full i l = 0) ∧ (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧ K_seq l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalAction2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport J f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
      ∑ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (G.w_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
          compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (J + 1))
            (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (K_seq (J + 1))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
              (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure LineArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : LineArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_strip : W_ψ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  base_ψ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i q ∈ W_ψ
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun s => G.α_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g i l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i l) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full i (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    lineArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertSupportDeriv C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      D_form.K_seq (l : ℕ)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable abbrev lineArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def lineArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupport {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * g i m z

noncomputable def lineArcPertSupportDeriv {k J : ℕ} (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ z + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * deriv (g i m) z

noncomputable def lineArcPertAngles {k J : ℕ} (α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (s : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
  α₀ s + ∑ m : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (m : ℕ) * β m s

noncomputable def lineArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def lineArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def lineArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def lineArcPsSin0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.sin 0

noncomputable def lineArcPsCos0 : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  lineArcHoloTaylor1D Complex.cos 0

noncomputable def lineArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def lineArcFormalMid2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.castSucc + β_seq l i.succ) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  lineArcPack2D1D (fun l => (β_seq l i.succ - β_seq l i.castSucc) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineArcFormalSin2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) +
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalCos2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) -
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i)) *
      lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i)

noncomputable def lineArcFormalAction2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    2 * lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i

noncomputable def lineArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_L) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_L) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_L +
    lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R l))
      (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R -
    lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i_R) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i_R) *
      lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i_R

noncomputable def lineArcTruncSupport {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun i l => if l ≤ J then f_full i l else 0

noncomputable def lineArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure LineArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (lineArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  epsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
    {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g₁ : Fin k → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g₂ : Fin k → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg₁ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₂ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ i m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₁0 : ∀ i z, g₁ i 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ i z, g₂ i 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_eq : ∀ i (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ i ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ i m z)
    {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
    (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),
    lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet l
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε)) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε) r)
  epsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q =>
        lineArcEpsJet m
          (fun ε =>
            lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
      V ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
        V
  epsJet_succ_split : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg_top : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top i) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),
    let g_ext : Fin k → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => Fin.snoc (g i) (g_top i)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε)) =
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε)) +
      (∑ i : Fin k, 2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) α₀ r *
          β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε) r) =
        lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
            α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  taylor2D_epsJet_eq : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
    {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
    {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
    (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
    let sin_d0 := fun i => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let cos_d0 := fun i => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i l =>
      if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l s =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (α₀ s) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
      else 0
    taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
        p₁ =
      lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
          p₁ =
        lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq r)

structure LineArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  i₀ : Fin k
  f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  K_seq : ℕ → ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i 0 = lineArcHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full i₀ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ i : Fin k, f_full i l = 0) ∧ (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧ K_seq l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalAction2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport J f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
      ∑ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (G.w_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
          compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (J + 1))
            (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (K_seq (J + 1))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))))
          (lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) f_full)
          (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
              (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure LineArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : LineArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_strip : W_ψ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  base_ψ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ψ_fn i q ∈ W_ψ
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
      (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun s => G.α_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ
  g_lt_p : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g i l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i l) (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full i (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    lineArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertSupportDeriv C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  action_jet_const : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    lineArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      D_form.K_seq (l : ℕ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let c_ext : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ :=
    lineCoalescingFormalSeq k (h_ℂ (a : ℂ) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (a : ℂ)) f_p
  have hP1 :
      (lineCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      ((∀ d : ℕ,
          ∑ i : Fin k,
            f_p i * (c_ext d i.succ - c_ext d i.castSucc) = 0) →
        ∀ i : Fin k, f_p i = 0) := by
    let r_a : ℂ := h_ℂ (a : ℂ) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (a : ℂ)
    have h_sqrt := hAlg.sqrt_power_sum_zero
    have hk_ne : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k ≠ 0)
    have hT_det : ∀ m : ℕ, (lineCoalescingTridiag m).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro m
      let L_m : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ := fun r t =>
        if r.1 = t.1 then 1
        else if r.1 = t.1 + 1 then -(((t.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((t.1 : ℂ) + 2))
        else 0
      let U_m : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ := fun t s =>
        if t.1 = s.1 then ((t.1 : ℂ) + 2) / ((t.1 : ℂ) + 1)
        else if s.1 = t.1 + 1 then -1
        else 0
      have hL_tri : L_m.IsLowerTriangular := by
        intro r t hrt
        have hlt : r.1 < t.1 := hrt
        dsimp only [L_m]
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      have hU_tri : U_m.IsUpperTriangular := by
        intro t s hst
        have hlt : s.1 < t.1 := hst
        dsimp only [U_m]
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      have hLU : L_m * U_m = lineCoalescingTridiag m := by
        ext r s
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
        by_cases hr0 : r.1 = 0
        · rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single r]
          · dsimp only [L_m, U_m, lineCoalescingTridiag]
            rw [if_pos rfl, one_mul, hr0]
            by_cases hs0 : s.1 = 0
            · simp [hs0]
            · have h0s : ¬ (0 = s.1) := fun h => hs0 h.symm
              by_cases hs1 : s.1 = 1
              · simp [hs1]
              · have hs01 : ¬ (s.1 = 0 + 1) := by omega
                have h0s1 : ¬ (0 = s.1 + 1) := by omega
                simp [h0s, hs01, h0s1]
          · intro t htr
            have ht_ne : t.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => htr (Fin.ext (h.trans hr0.symm))
            dsimp only [L_m]
            split_ifs <;> first | omega | ring
        · let r_prev : Fin m := ⟨r.1 - 1, by omega⟩
          have hr_ne_prev : r ≠ r_prev := by
            intro h
            have := congr_arg Fin.val h
            dsimp [r_prev] at this
            omega
          rw [Fintype.sum_eq_add r r_prev hr_ne_prev]
          · have h_rp1 : ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
              exact_mod_cast (by omega : r_prev.1 + 1 ≠ 0)
            have h_rp2 : ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by
              exact_mod_cast (by omega : r_prev.1 + 2 ≠ 0)
            have hr_eq : (r.1 : ℂ) = (r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1 := by
              dsimp [r_prev]
              exact_mod_cast (by omega : r.1 = r.1 - 1 + 1)
            have hL_rr : L_m r r = 1 := by simp [L_m]
            have hL_rp : L_m r r_prev = -(((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2)) := by
              dsimp only [L_m]
              rw [if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
            rw [hL_rr, hL_rp]
            by_cases hsr : r.1 = s.1
            · have h1 : U_m r s = ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 3) / ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2) := by
                dsimp only [U_m]
                rw [if_pos hsr, hr_eq]
                ring
              have h2 : U_m r_prev s = -1 := by
                dsimp only [U_m]
                rw [if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
              have h3 : lineCoalescingTridiag m r s = 2 := by simp [lineCoalescingTridiag, hsr]
              rw [h1, h2, h3]
              field_simp
              ring
            · by_cases hs_succ : s.1 = r.1 + 1
              · have h1 : U_m r s = -1 := by
                  dsimp only [U_m]
                  rw [if_neg hsr, if_pos hs_succ]
                have h2 : U_m r_prev s = 0 := by
                  dsimp only [U_m]
                  rw [if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
                have h3 : lineCoalescingTridiag m r s = -1 := by
                  dsimp only [lineCoalescingTridiag]
                  rw [if_neg hsr, if_pos (Or.inl hs_succ)]
                rw [h1, h2, h3]
                ring
              · by_cases hr_succ : r.1 = s.1 + 1
                · have h1 : U_m r s = 0 := by
                    dsimp only [U_m]
                    rw [if_neg hsr, if_neg hs_succ]
                  have h2 : U_m r_prev s = ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2) / ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1) := by
                    dsimp only [U_m]
                    rw [if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
                  have h3 : lineCoalescingTridiag m r s = -1 := by
                    dsimp only [lineCoalescingTridiag]
                    rw [if_neg hsr, if_pos (Or.inr hr_succ)]
                  rw [h1, h2, h3]
                  field_simp
                  ring
                · have h1 : U_m r s = 0 := by
                    dsimp only [U_m]
                    rw [if_neg hsr, if_neg hs_succ]
                  have h2 : U_m r_prev s = 0 := by
                    dsimp only [U_m]
                    rw [if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
                  have h3 : lineCoalescingTridiag m r s = 0 := by
                    dsimp only [lineCoalescingTridiag]
                    rw [if_neg hsr, if_neg (by omega)]
                  rw [h1, h2, h3]
                  ring
          · intro t ⟨ht1, ht2⟩
            have ht_ne1 : r.1 ≠ t.1 := fun h => ht1 (Fin.ext h.symm)
            have ht_ne2 : r.1 ≠ t.1 + 1 := by
              intro h
              apply ht2
              apply Fin.ext
              dsimp [r_prev]
              omega
            dsimp only [L_m]
            rw [if_neg ht_ne1, if_neg ht_ne2, zero_mul]
      rw [← hLU, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular L_m hL_tri,
        Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hU_tri]
      refine mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_
      · rw [Finset.prod_eq_one]
        · exact one_ne_zero
        · intro i _
          simp [L_m]
      · rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
        intro i _
        simp only [U_m, ↓reduceIte]
        exact div_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : i.1 + 2 ≠ 0))
          (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : i.1 + 1 ≠ 0))
    refine ⟨hT_det (k - 1), ?_⟩
    intro h_sum_zero
    have hc_zero_d : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), c_ext 0 s = ((s.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) := by
      intro s
      dsimp [c_ext]
      rw [lineCoalescingFormalSeq]
    let A₀ : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
      (-(r_a / (4 * (k : ℂ)))) • lineCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)
    have hA₀_det : A₀.det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_smul]
      refine mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ?_) (hT_det (k - 1))
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero hr_ne (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hk_ne))
    let z_ps : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
      PowerSeries.mk fun d => c_ext d i.succ - c_ext d i.castSucc
    have hz_coeff : ∀ (i : Fin k) (d : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff d (z_ps i) = c_ext d i.succ - c_ext d i.castSucc :=
      fun i d => PowerSeries.coeff_mk d _
    have hz_const : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (z_ps i) = 1 / (k : ℂ) := by
      intro i
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hz_coeff, hc_zero_d, hc_zero_d]
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      ring
    have hz_sum : ∑ i : Fin k, z_ps i = 1 := by
      ext d
      rw [map_sum]
      have h_tel : ∀ (m : ℕ) (_hmk : m ≤ k),
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
            (if hj : j < k then
              c_ext d ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩ - c_ext d ⟨j, by omega⟩
            else 0) =
            c_ext d ⟨m, by omega⟩ - c_ext d ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
        intro m hmk
        induction m with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m ih =>
          have hlt : m < k := by omega
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih (by omega), hlt, ↓reduceDIte]
          ring
      have h_fin_eq : ∑ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff d (z_ps i) =
          c_ext d ⟨k, by omega⟩ - c_ext d ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
        rw [← h_tel k le_rfl, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [dif_pos i.2, hz_coeff]
        rfl
      rw [h_fin_eq]
      cases d with
      | zero =>
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_one, hc_zero_d, hc_zero_d]
        simp [div_self hk_ne]
      | succ q =>
        have h1 : PowerSeries.coeff (q + 1) (1 : PowerSeries ℂ) = 0 := by
          rw [← map_one PowerSeries.C, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
          simp
        rw [h1]
        dsimp [c_ext]
        rw [lineCoalescingFormalSeq]
        simp
    let Λ_ps : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
      -PowerSeries.C (r_a / 8) * (z_ps i) ^ 2 + PowerSeries.C (f_p i) * PowerSeries.X
    have hΛ_step : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        Λ_ps ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ = Λ_ps ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
      intro r
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      ext d
      rw [map_zero, map_sub]
      cases d with
      | zero =>
        simp only [Λ_ps, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_add, map_neg, map_mul,
          map_pow, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, hz_const]
        ring
      | succ q =>
        have h_sq_coeff : ∀ i : Fin k,
            PowerSeries.coeff (q + 1) ((z_ps i) ^ 2) =
              (2 / (k : ℂ)) * (c_ext (q + 1) i.succ - c_ext (q + 1) i.castSucc) +
                ∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (q + 1),
                  (c_ext a i.succ - c_ext a i.castSucc) *
                    (c_ext (q + 1 - a) i.succ - c_ext (q + 1 - a) i.castSucc) := by
          intro i
          rw [sq, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
            Finset.sum_range_succ]
          have h_split : Finset.range (q + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ico 1 (q + 1)) := by

      have he_pos : 1 ≤ e_pos := by dsimp [e_pos]; rw [h2m3]; nlinarith
      have h_pos_pow : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => C_rhs * (τ : ℂ) ^ e_pos) φ (nhds 0) := by
        have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ^ e_pos = 0 := zero_pow (by omega)
        have hp0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ) ^ e_pos) φ (nhds 0) := by
          simpa [h0] using hτ_to_0.pow e_pos
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := C_rhs)).mul hp0
      have h_pos_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => C_rhs * (τ : ℂ) ^ e_pos) φ (nhds L_lim) := by
        refine hRHS_tendsto_L.congr' (hτ_ev.mono fun τ ⟨hτ_pos, _⟩ => ?_)
        dsimp only
        have hτ3p_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p) ≠ 0 :=
          pow_ne_zero (3 * p) (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ_pos))
        have hexp : 2 * l₀ = e_pos + 3 * p := by
          dsimp [l₀, e_pos]; rw [h2m3]; dsimp [m]; ring
        rw [hexp, pow_add, mul_assoc ((τ : ℂ) ^ e_pos), mul_inv_cancel₀ hτ3p_ne, mul_one]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_pos_lim h_pos_pow
  dsimp [L_lim] at hL_zero
  rw [hf_term2_deriv] at hL_zero
  have hfac_ne : ((l₀ - 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
  have h1 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hL_zero).resolve_left hp_ne
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hfac_ne

line_coalescing_cubic_variational_zero.definitions:
def lineCoalescingTridiag (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 ∨ r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

def lineCoalescingIntVtx {k : ℕ} (s : Fin (k - 1)) : Fin (k + 1) :=
  ⟨s.1 + 1, Nat.add_lt_add_right (lt_of_lt_of_le s.2 (Nat.sub_le k 1)) 1⟩

noncomputable def lineCoalescingDslopeIter (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => F
  | n + 1 => dslope (lineCoalescingDslopeIter F z₀ n) z₀

noncomputable def lineCoalescingFormalSeq (k : ℕ) (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin k → ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ
  | 0 => fun s => ((s.1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  | q + 1 =>
      let prev : Fin (q + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ :=
        fun m =>
          have _ := m.2
          lineCoalescingFormalSeq k r_a f_p m.1
      let Δ : Fin (q + 1) → Fin k → ℂ :=
        fun m i => prev m i.succ - prev m i.castSucc
      let quad : Fin k → ℂ :=
        fun i =>
          ∑ a ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 (q + 1)).attach,
            Δ ⟨a.1, (Finset.mem_Ico.mp a.2).2⟩ i *
              Δ ⟨q + 1 - a.1, by have := Finset.mem_Ico.mp a.2; omega⟩ i
      let rhs : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ :=
        fun r =>
          if hk : 2 ≤ k then
            -(r_a / 8) *
                (quad ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
                  quad ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) +
              (if q = 0 then
                f_p ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
                  f_p ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
              else 0)
          else 0
      let A₀ : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
        (-(r_a / (4 * (k : ℂ)))) • lineCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)
      let sol : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ := (A₀.det)⁻¹ • A₀.cramer (-rhs)
      fun s =>
        if _hs0 : s.1 = 0 then 0
        else if _hsk : s.1 < k then sol ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩
        else 0
