proof.tactics:
by
  have isOpen_puncBall : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen { w : ℂ | 0 < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < r } :=
    fun r => (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have analytic_ne_zero_ball :
      ∀ (φ : ℂ → ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ φ 0 → φ 0 ≠ 0 →
        ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < r → AnalyticAt ℂ φ z ∧ φ z ≠ 0 := by
    intro φ hφ_ana hφ_ne
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (hφ_ana.eventually_analyticAt.and (hφ_ana.continuousAt.eventually_ne hφ_ne))
    exact ⟨r, hr_pos, fun z hz => hr z (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hz)⟩
  
  let f_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => -Complex.I * ((n : ℂ) + z * deriv G.u_a z / G.u_a z)
  let g_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Complex.I * (G.c : ℂ) * G.u_a z / (f_tilde z) ^ 2
  let g_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => -Complex.I * (G.c : ℂ) / (G.u_a z * (f_tilde z) ^ 2)
  have hf_tilde_zero : f_tilde 0 = -Complex.I * (n : ℂ) := by
    simp [f_tilde]
  have hn_ne : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
  have hc_ne : (G.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt G.c_pos)
  have hf_tilde_0_ne : f_tilde 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hf_tilde_zero]
    exact mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero) hn_ne
  have hf_tilde_0_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ f_tilde 0 := by
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => -Complex.I) 0 := analyticAt_const
    have h2 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (n : ℂ)) 0 := analyticAt_const
    have h3 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z * deriv G.u_a z) 0 :=
      analyticAt_id.mul G.u_a_analytic.deriv
    exact h1.mul (h2.add (h3.div G.u_a_analytic G.u_a_ne_zero))
  have hg_plus_0_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_plus 0 := by
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => Complex.I * (G.c : ℂ)) 0 := analyticAt_const
    exact (h1.mul G.u_a_analytic).div (hf_tilde_0_ana.pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hf_tilde_0_ne)
  have hg_plus_0_ne : g_plus 0 ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hc_ne) G.u_a_ne_zero)
      (pow_ne_zero 2 hf_tilde_0_ne)
  have hg_minus_0_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_minus 0 := by
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => -Complex.I * (G.c : ℂ)) 0 := analyticAt_const
    exact h1.div (G.u_a_analytic.mul (hf_tilde_0_ana.pow 2))
      (mul_ne_zero G.u_a_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hf_tilde_0_ne))
  have hg_minus_0_ne : g_minus 0 ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero) hc_ne)
      (mul_ne_zero G.u_a_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hf_tilde_0_ne))
  obtain ⟨r_ua, hr_ua_pos, hr_ua⟩ := analytic_ne_zero_ball G.u_a G.u_a_analytic G.u_a_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨r_ft, hr_ft_pos, hr_ft⟩ := analytic_ne_zero_ball f_tilde hf_tilde_0_ana hf_tilde_0_ne
  obtain ⟨r_gp, hr_gp_pos, hr_gp⟩ := analytic_ne_zero_ball g_plus hg_plus_0_ana hg_plus_0_ne
  obtain ⟨r_gm, hr_gm_pos, hr_gm⟩ := analytic_ne_zero_ball g_minus hg_minus_0_ana hg_minus_0_ne
  let δ_a : ℝ := min G.δ₀ (min (min r_ua r_ft) (min r_gp r_gm))
  have hδ_a_pos : 0 < δ_a :=
    lt_min G.δ₀_pos (lt_min (lt_min hr_ua_pos hr_ft_pos) (lt_min hr_gp_pos hr_gm_pos))
  have hδ_a_le : δ_a ≤ G.δ₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have hu_a_ball_a : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_a → AnalyticAt ℂ G.u_a z ∧ G.u_a z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => hr_ua z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
  have hf_tilde_ball_a : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_a → AnalyticAt ℂ f_tilde z ∧ f_tilde z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => hr_ft z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
  have hg_plus_ball_a : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_a → AnalyticAt ℂ g_plus z ∧ g_plus z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => hr_gp z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
  have hg_minus_ball_a : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_a → AnalyticAt ℂ g_minus z ∧ g_minus z ≠ 0 :=
    fun z hz => hr_gm z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
  have hf_exp_a : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ_a → G.f_loc z = z⁻¹ * f_tilde z := by
    intro z hz_pos hz_lt
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hz_pos
    have hz_δ₀ : ‖z‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ_a_le
    have hu_z := hu_a_ball_a z hz_lt
    have hu_ne : G.u_a z ≠ 0 := hu_z.2
    have h_eq_nhds : G.a_loc =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => w ^ n * G.u_a w :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_puncBall δ_a).mem_nhds ⟨hz_pos, hz_lt⟩)
        (fun w hw => G.a_eq w hw.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2 hδ_a_le))
    have h_deriv_prod :
        deriv G.a_loc z = (n : ℂ) * z ^ (n - 1) * G.u_a z + z ^ n * deriv G.u_a z := by
      rw [h_eq_nhds.deriv_eq]
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pow n z).mul hu_z.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).deriv
    have h_da :
        Complex.I * G.f_loc z * (z ^ n * G.u_a z) =
          (n : ℂ) * z ^ (n - 1) * G.u_a z + z ^ n * deriv G.u_a z := by
      rw [← G.a_eq z hz_pos hz_δ₀, ← (G.reg_on_punctured z hz_pos hz_δ₀).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
        h_deriv_prod]
    have hzn : z * z ^ (n - 1) = z ^ n := by
      rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
    have h_mul_z :
        (Complex.I * (z * G.f_loc z) * G.u_a z) * z ^ n =
          ((n : ℂ) * G.u_a z + z * deriv G.u_a z) * z ^ n := by
      calc
        (Complex.I * (z * G.f_loc z) * G.u_a z) * z ^ n
            = z * (Complex.I * G.f_loc z * (z ^ n * G.u_a z)) := by ring
        _ = z * ((n : ℂ) * z ^ (n - 1) * G.u_a z + z ^ n * deriv G.u_a z) := by rw [h_da]
        _ = (n : ℂ) * (z * z ^ (n - 1)) * G.u_a z + (z * deriv G.u_a z) * z ^ n := by ring
        _ = ((n : ℂ) * G.u_a z + z * deriv G.u_a z) * z ^ n := by rw [hzn]; ring
    have h_canc : Complex.I * (z * G.f_loc z) * G.u_a z = (n : ℂ) * G.u_a z + z * deriv G.u_a z :=
      mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero n hz_ne) h_mul_z
    have h_zf : z * G.f_loc z * G.u_a z = f_tilde z * G.u_a z := by
      dsimp [f_tilde]
      have h_div : ((n : ℂ) + z * deriv G.u_a z / G.u_a z) * G.u_a z =
          (n : ℂ) * G.u_a z + z * deriv G.u_a z := by
        rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu_ne]
      calc
        z * G.f_loc z * G.u_a z
            = -Complex.I * (Complex.I * (z * G.f_loc z) * G.u_a z) := by
                rw [show -Complex.I * (Complex.I * (z * G.f_loc z) * G.u_a z) =
                  -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * (z * G.f_loc z * G.u_a z) by ring,
                  Complex.I_mul_I]
                ring
        _ = -Complex.I * ((n : ℂ) * G.u_a z + z * deriv G.u_a z) := by rw [h_canc]
        _ = -Complex.I * (((n : ℂ) + z * deriv G.u_a z / G.u_a z) * G.u_a z) := by rw [h_div]
        _ = -Complex.I * ((n : ℂ) + z * deriv G.u_a z / G.u_a z) * G.u_a z := by ring
    have h_zf' : z * G.f_loc z = f_tilde z := mul_right_cancel₀ hu_ne h_zf
    calc
      G.f_loc z = z⁻¹ * (z * G.f_loc z) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hz_ne]
      _ = z⁻¹ * f_tilde z := by rw [h_zf']
  have hZ_deriv_a : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ_a →
      deriv G.Z_loc z = z ^ ((n : ℤ) + 2) * g_plus z := by
    intro z hz_pos hz_lt
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hz_pos
    have hz_δ₀ : ‖z‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ_a_le
    have hf_ne : f_tilde z ≠ 0 := (hf_tilde_ball_a z hz_lt).2
    rw [(G.reg_on_punctured z hz_pos hz_δ₀).2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
      G.a_eq z hz_pos hz_δ₀, hf_exp_a z hz_pos hz_lt,
      show (n : ℤ) + 2 = ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, zpow_natCast, pow_add]
    dsimp [g_plus]
    field_simp [hz_ne, hf_ne]
  have hW_deriv_a : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ_a →
      deriv G.W_loc z = z ^ ((2 : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) * g_minus z := by
    intro z hz_pos hz_lt
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hz_pos
    have hz_δ₀ : ‖z‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt hδ_a_le
    have hu_ne : G.u_a z ≠ 0 := (hu_a_ball_a z hz_lt).2
    have hf_ne : f_tilde z ≠ 0 := (hf_tilde_ball_a z hz_lt).2
    rw [(G.reg_on_punctured z hz_pos hz_δ₀).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
      G.a_eq z hz_pos hz_δ₀, hf_exp_a z hz_pos hz_lt,
      zpow_sub₀ hz_ne, show (2 : ℤ) = ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) by rfl, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    dsimp [g_minus]
    field_simp [hz_ne, pow_ne_zero n hz_ne, hu_ne, hf_ne]
  
  have mero_prim_helper :
      ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℤ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
        MeromorphicAt F 0 →
        (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ_a → AnalyticAt ℂ g z ∧ g z ≠ 0) →
        (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ_a → deriv F z = z ^ d * g z) →
        d ≠ -1 ∧ ∃ (F₀ : ℂ) (u_F : ℂ → ℂ) (r_F : ℝ),
          0 < r_F ∧ r_F ≤ δ_a ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < r_F → AnalyticAt ℂ u_F z ∧ u_F z ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < r_F → F z - F₀ = z ^ (d + 1) * u_F z) := by
    intro F d g hF hg_ball hderiv
    have hg0 := hg_ball 0 (by simpa using hδ_a_pos)
    have h_dF_eq_punc : deriv F =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ] fun z => (z - 0) ^ d • g z := by
      rw [eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_iff]
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hδ_a_pos] with z hz hz_ne
      have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne
      have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < δ_a := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hz
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hderiv z hz_pos hz_lt
    have h_ord_dF : meromorphicOrderAt (deriv F) 0 = (d : WithTop ℤ) :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hF.deriv).mpr ⟨g, hg0.1, hg0.2, h_dF_eq_punc⟩
    cases h_ord_F : meromorphicOrderAt F 0 with
    | top =>
      have h_ev0 : F =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ] 0 := meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp h_ord_F
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp h_ev0)
      let ρ : ℝ := min r₀ δ_a
      have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := lt_min hr₀_pos hδ_a_pos
      let z_s : ℂ := ((ρ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hz_s_norm : ‖z_s‖ = ρ / 2 := by
        simp [z_s, Complex.norm_real, le_of_lt hρ_pos]
      have hz_s_pos : 0 < ‖z_s‖ := by rw [hz_s_norm]; linarith
      have hz_s_lt_ρ : ‖z_s‖ < ρ := by rw [hz_s_norm]; linarith
      have hz_s_lt_a : ‖z_s‖ < δ_a := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_s_lt_ρ (min_le_right _ _)
      have hF_nhds : F =ᶠ[nhds z_s] fun _ : ℂ => 0 := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_puncBall ρ).mem_nhds ⟨hz_s_pos, hz_s_lt_ρ⟩) ?_
        intro w hw
        exact hr₀ w (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using lt_of_lt_of_le hw.2 (min_le_left _ _))
          (norm_pos_iff.mp hw.1)
      have hdF_zero : deriv F z_s = 0 := by
        rw [hF_nhds.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      have hdF_ne : deriv F z_s ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hderiv z_s hz_s_pos hz_s_lt_a]
        exact mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero d (norm_pos_iff.mp hz_s_pos))
          (hg_ball z_s hz_s_lt_a).2
      exact absurd hdF_zero hdF_ne
    | coe m =>
      obtain ⟨h, hh_ana, hh_ne, hh_eq⟩ := (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hF).mp h_ord_F
      obtain ⟨r_h, hr_h_pos, hr_h⟩ := analytic_ne_zero_ball h hh_ana hh_ne
      obtain ⟨r_eq, hr_eq_pos, hr_eq⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hh_eq)
      let r₁ : ℝ := min δ_a (min r_h r_eq)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hδ_a_pos (lt_min hr_h_pos hr_eq_pos)
      have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ δ_a := min_le_left _ _
      have hh_ball₁ : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < r₁ → AnalyticAt ℂ h z ∧ h z ≠ 0 :=
        fun z hz => hr_h z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
      have hF_eq₁ : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < r₁ → F z = z ^ m * h z := by
        intro z hz_pos hz_lt
        have hz_eq := hr_eq z
          (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using
            lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
          (norm_pos_iff.mp hz_pos)
        simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hz_eq
      by_cases hm : m < 0
      · let h_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (m : ℂ) * h z + z * deriv h z
        have hh_tilde_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ h_tilde 0 :=
          (analyticAt_const.mul hh_ana).add (analyticAt_id.mul hh_ana.deriv)
        have hh_tilde_ne : h_tilde 0 ≠ 0 := by
          dsimp [h_tilde]
          simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
          exact mul_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)) hh_ne
        have hdF_eq_m : deriv F =ᶠ[nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ] fun z => (z - 0) ^ (m - 1) • h_tilde z := by
          rw [eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_iff]
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr₁_pos] with z hz hz_ne
          have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne
          have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < r₁ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hz
          have h_nhds : F =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => w ^ m * h w :=
            Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_puncBall r₁).mem_nhds ⟨hz_pos, hz_lt⟩)
              (fun w hw => hF_eq₁ w hw.1 hw.2)
          have h_der : deriv F z = (m : ℂ) * z ^ (m - 1) * h z + z ^ m * deriv h z := by
            rw [h_nhds.deriv_eq]
            exact ((hasDerivAt_zpow m z (Or.inl hz_ne)).mul

            = (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc 1 z - diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc 1 z) *
                (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc 1 z + diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc 1 z) := by ring
        _ = (Complex.I * G.f_loc z) *
              (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc 1 z + diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc 1 z) := by rw [h_sub1]
        _ = Complex.I *
              (G.f_loc z * (diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc 1 z + diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc 1 z)) := by ring
        _ = Complex.I * (-2 * deriv G.f_loc z) := by rw [h_sum1]
        _ = -2 * Complex.I * deriv G.f_loc z := by ring
    have hA2_B2 :
        diffQuotCoeff G.Z_loc 2 z - diffQuotCoeff G.W_loc 2 z = -Complex.I * deriv G.f_loc z := by
      rw [hA2_eq, hB2_eq]
      linear_combination (1 / 3 : ℂ) * h_deriv_diff + (2 / 3 : ℂ) * h_sq_diff
    have hA0 := hA0_eq z hz_pos hz_lt
    have hB0 := hB0_eq z hz_pos hz_lt
    dsimp [reflDiffCoeff]
    rw [hA0, hB0]
    linear_combination (h_minus ^ 2 + h_plus ^ 2) * hA2_B2 - (h_minus * h_plus) * h_sq_diff
  have hrefl_deg3 :
      ∀ z h_minus h_plus : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
        reflDiffCoeff G 3 0 z * h_minus ^ 3 +
          reflDiffCoeff G 2 1 z * h_minus ^ 2 * h_plus +
          reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus ^ 2 +
          reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * h_plus ^ 3 =
          (h_plus - h_minus) *
            (reflDiffCoeff G 0 3 z * (h_plus ^ 2 + h_plus * h_minus + h_minus ^ 2) +
              reflDiffCoeff G 1 2 z * h_minus * h_plus) := by
    intro z h_minus h_plus _ _
    dsimp [reflDiffCoeff]
    ring
  exact ⟨{
    ne_three := hne_three
    Z₀ := Z₀
    W₀ := W₀
    u_Z := u_Z
    u_W := u_W
    f_tilde := f_tilde
    δ₁ := δ₁
    δ₁_pos := hδ₁_pos
    δ₁_le := hδ₁_le
    u_Z_ball := hu_Z_ball
    u_W_ball := hu_W_ball
    f_tilde_ball := hf_tilde_ball
    f_tilde_zero := hf_tilde_zero
    f_expansion := hf_expansion
    Z_expansion := hZ_expansion
    W_expansion := hW_expansion
    deriv_Z_ne_zero := hderiv_Z_ne
    deriv_W_ne_zero := hderiv_W_ne
    refl_coeff_analytic := hrefl_analytic
    refl_coeff_mero_order := hrefl_mero_order
    refl_deg0 := hrefl_deg0
    refl_deg1 := hrefl_deg1
    refl_deg2 := hrefl_deg2
    refl_deg3 := hrefl_deg3
  }⟩

by
  let _ := hn
  
  have hpderiv_and_iter :
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},

    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst

    have hπ₂_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₂ q = q.2 := fun _ => rfl

    have hπ₂_norm : ‖π₂‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₂ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₂_apply] using norm_snd_le q)
    have hparam_int_holo : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (r B : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
        (F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ) (F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)),

        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ B) →
        (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      intro p₀ r B hr c g F F' hrep hcont hmeas hbnd hfderiv
      have hint : HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ)
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F' p₀ θ) p₀ :=
        intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr)
          (by filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr] with p hp
              exact (hcont p hp).aestronglyMeasurable)
          ((hcont p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          hmeas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hbnd θ p hp)
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hfderiv θ p hp)
      exact (hint.differentiableAt.const_mul c).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr) hrep)
    have hPartialA : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf p₀ hp₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      let y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
      let t₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
      obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀
      let r : ℝ := R₀ / 4
      have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
      have hr_eq : 4 * r = R₀ := by dsimp [r]; ring
      have hp_ball : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r → dist p.1 y₀ < r ∧ dist p.2 t₀ < r := by
        intro p hp

      have hmem_U : ∀ y t : ℂ, dist y y₀ < 3 * r → dist t t₀ < 3 * r → (y, t) ∈ U := by

        apply hball_R₀
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]

        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hsliceA_diff : ∀ t : ℂ, dist t t₀ < 3 * r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f (z, t)) (Metric.ball y₀ (3 * r)) := by
        intro t ht z hz
        have hzw : (z, t) ∈ U := hmem_U z t (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) ht
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzw)).comp z
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hsliceD_diff : ∀ z : ℂ, dist z y₀ < 3 * r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => f (z, w)) (Metric.ball t₀ (3 * r)) := by
        intro z hz w hw
        have hzw : (z, w) ∈ U := hmem_U z w hz (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw)
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzw)).comp w
          ((differentiableAt_const z).prodMk differentiableAt_id)).differentiableWithinAt
      let K₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * r)
      have hK₂_compact : IsCompact K₂ :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall y₀ (2 * r)).prod
          (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall t₀ (2 * r))
      have hK₂_sub : K₂ ⊆ U := by
        intro q hq
        exact hmem_U q.1 q.2
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1) (by linarith))
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2) (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK₂_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub)
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have hM_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r), ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * r),

        fun z hz w hw => (hM₀ (z, w) ⟨hz, hw⟩).trans (le_max_left M₀ 0)
      have hderivD_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball t₀ r,

        intro z hz t ht
        have hz3 : dist z y₀ < 3 * r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hz) (by linarith)
        have hsub_cl : Metric.closedBall t r ⊆ Metric.closedBall t₀ (2 * r) := by

          have ht' : dist t t₀ < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp ht

        have hsub_open : Metric.closedBall t r ⊆ Metric.ball t₀ (3 * r) := fun w hw =>
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hsub_cl hw)) (by linarith))

        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr hdcc
          (fun w hw => hM_bnd z hz w (hsub_cl (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)))
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap y₀ (2 * r)
      have hγ_norm_sub : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖γ θ - y₀‖ = 2 * r := by
        intro θ
        rw [circleMap_sub_center, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos (mul_pos zero_lt_two hr)]
      have hγ_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ (2 * r) := by
        intro θ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hγ_norm_sub θ]
      have hγ_deriv_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖deriv γ θ‖ = 2 * r := by
        intro θ
        rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, norm_circleMap_zero, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          abs_of_pos (mul_pos zero_lt_two hr)]
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := continuous_circleMap y₀ (2 * r)
      have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := by
        have h_eq : deriv γ = fun θ => circleMap 0 (2 * r) θ * Complex.I := by
          ext θ; exact deriv_circleMap y₀ (2 * r) θ
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (continuous_circleMap 0 (2 * r)).mul continuous_const
      have hp_sep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, r < ‖γ θ - p.1‖ := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp1 : ‖p.1 - y₀‖ < r := dist_eq_norm p.1 y₀ ▸ (hp_ball hp).1
        have htri : ‖γ θ - y₀‖ ≤ ‖γ θ - p.1‖ + ‖p.1 - y₀‖ := by
          simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (γ θ - p.1) (p.1 - y₀)
        linarith [hγ_norm_sub θ]
      let c_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => deriv γ θ * ((γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹)
      let d_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => f (γ θ, p.2)
      let F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => c_fn p θ * d_fn p θ
      let c' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p θ =>

      let d' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p θ =>

      let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p θ =>

      have hF_rep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r,

        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp_ball hp
        have hcauchy :=

        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
        simp only [F, c_fn, d_fn, γ, smul_eq_mul, sq, mul_inv, mul_assoc]
      have hF_cont : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p) := by

      have hF_fderiv : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r,
          HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p := by
        intro θ p hp
        obtain ⟨_, hp2⟩ := hp_ball hp
        have hne : γ θ - p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => by
          have := hp_sep p hp θ; rw [h0, norm_zero] at this; linarith
        have hu : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => γ θ - q.1) (-π₁) p := by

          simp [hπ₁_apply, inv_pow]
        have hinv2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (γ θ - q.1)⁻¹ * (γ θ - q.1)⁻¹)
            ((2 * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 3) • π₁) p := by
          refine (hinv.mul hinv).congr_fderiv ?_
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ?_
          change (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ * ((γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 2 * v₁) +
              (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ * ((γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 2 * v₁) =
            (2 * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 3) * v₁

        have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun q => c_fn q θ) (c' p θ) p :=
          (hinv2.const_mul (deriv γ θ)).congr_fderiv (smul_smul _ _ π₁)
        have hslice_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) p.2 :=
          (hsliceD_diff (γ θ) (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hγ_mem θ)) (by linarith)))

        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun q => d_fn q θ) (d' p θ) p := by
          refine (hslice_at.hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p π₂.hasFDerivAt).congr_fderiv ?_
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ?_
          simp [d', hπ₂_apply, mul_comm]
        exact hc.mul hd
      have hg₀_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) t₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        let h_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)

        have hh_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < r := fun n => by

          have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n

        have hh_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n ≠ 0 := fun n =>
          Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hh_pos n))
        have hq_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous
            (fun θ : ℝ => (h_seq n)⁻¹ • (f (γ θ, t₀ + h_seq n) - f (γ θ, t₀))) := by
          intro n

                (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hγ_mem θ)) (by linarith)) ht_in)

                (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hγ_mem θ)) (by linarith))
                (by rw [dist_self]; linarith))
          exact (hf1.sub hf0).const_smul (h_seq n)⁻¹
        have hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
          rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
          refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hh_ne⟩
          have hreal : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
              (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
          simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_zero] using
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hreal
        refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
          (fun n => (hq_cont n).aestronglyMeasurable)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => ?_)
        have hslice_t₀ : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) t₀ :=
          (hsliceD_diff (γ θ)
            (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hγ_mem θ)) (by linarith)))
            |>.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)))
        exact (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hslice_t₀.hasDerivAt).comp hh_tendsto
      have hF'₀_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        have hp₀_mem : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
        have hne₀ : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ - p₀.1 ≠ 0 := fun θ h0 => by
          have := hp_sep p₀ hp₀_mem θ; rw [h0, norm_zero] at this; linarith
        have hc_cont₀ : Continuous (c_fn p₀) :=

    have hdeg_single : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

      intro ι d; fin_cases ι <;> (simp [e]; omega)
    have hmv_add : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ + Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ + mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ
      ext d
      rw [map_add, hmv_coeff, hmv_coeff, hmv_coeff, map_add, mul_add]
    have hmv_mul_left : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ d
      let S₁ := (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι)).filter (fun p => p.1 ι ≠ 0)
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      have hbij :
          (∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff q.1 (mvDeriv ι Φ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff q.2 Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ S₁,
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by

        · intro q hq
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
          refine ⟨by rw [← hq]; exact add_right_comm q.1 (e ι) q.2, ?_⟩
          simp [e]

          exact ⟨add_right_cancel heq.1, heq.2⟩

          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp

          dsimp only at hp_ne

            simp only [e, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
            split_ifs with h
            · subst h; omega
            · omega
          refine ⟨(p₁ - e ι, p₂), ?_, Prod.ext hsub_add rfl⟩

          calc (p₁ - e ι + p₂) + e ι = (p₁ - e ι + e ι) + p₂ := add_right_comm _ _ _
            _ = p₁ + p₂ := by rw [hsub_add]
            _ = d + e ι := hp_sum
        · intro q _
          rw [hmv_coeff]
          have hcoord : (q.1 + e ι) ι = q.1 ι + 1 := by simp [e]
          dsimp only
          rw [hcoord, mul_assoc]
      rw [hbij]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
      intro p hp hnot
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_and, not_not] at hnot
      simp [hnot hp]
    have hmv_mul : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ * Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ
      ext d
      rw [map_add, hmv_mul_left ι Φ Ψ d, mul_comm Φ (mvDeriv ι Ψ), hmv_mul_left ι Ψ Φ d]
      have hswap :
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Ψ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Φ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        refine Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro p hp
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
          rw [add_comm, hp]
        · rintro ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ _ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ _ heq

        · rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp

          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
          rw [add_comm, hp]

      rw [hswap, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, hmv_coeff, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have hcoord : p.1 ι + p.2 ι = d ι + 1 := by
        have hc := congr_arg (fun x => x ι) hp
        simpa [e, Finsupp.add_apply] using hc
      have hcast : ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hcoord
      rw [← hcast]
      ring
    have hmv_one : ∀ ι : Fin 2, mvDeriv ι 1 = 0 := by
      intro ι
      ext d
      have hne : d + e ι ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hc := congr_arg (fun x => x ι) h0
        simp [e] at hc
      rw [hmv_coeff, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one]
      simp [hne]
    have hmv_pow : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (k : ℕ),

      intro ι Ψ k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [pow_succ Ψ (k + 1), hmv_mul, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ,
          mul_comm (Ψ ^ (k + 1)) (mvDeriv ι Ψ)]
        have hcast : ((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast, add_smul, one_smul]
    have hpow_vanish : ∀ {Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 + d 1 < m → MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ m) = 0 := by
      intro Ψ hΨ0 m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro d hd; omega
      | succ m ih =>
        intro d hd
        rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_
        intro p hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        by_cases hp2 : p.2 = 0
        · rw [hp2, hΨ0, mul_zero]
        · have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
            have hne0 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 ≠ 0 := mt (hdeg_zero_iff p.2).mpr hp2
            omega
          have hsum_deg := hdeg_add p.1 p.2
          rw [hp] at hsum_deg
          rw [ih p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]
    have hmv_comp : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        mvDeriv ι (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
          mvDeriv ι Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ := by
      intro ι f Ψ hΨ0
      ext d
      let N : ℕ := d 0 + d 1
      have hdeg_e : (d + e ι) 0 + (d + e ι) 1 = N + 1 := hdeg_single ι d
      have hlhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ)) =
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 2),
            PowerSeries.coeff m f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (Ψ ^ m)) := by
        rw [hmv_coeff, hcomp_coeff, hdeg_e, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
        rw [hmv_coeff]
        ring
      rw [hlhs, Finset.sum_range_succ']

        rw [pow_zero, hmv_one ι, map_zero, mul_zero]
      rw [hterm0, add_zero]
      have hstep_sum :
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (Ψ ^ (k + 1)))) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
            ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,

                (PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative f) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (Ψ ^ k)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro k _
        rw [hmv_pow ι Ψ k, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,

        push_cast
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => by ring)
      rw [hstep_sum, Finset.sum_comm, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro p hp
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hcomp_coeff]
      congr 1
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_
      · intro k hk
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        have hsum_deg := hdeg_add p.1 p.2
        rw [hp] at hsum_deg
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk ⊢
        omega
      · intro k _ hk_not
        rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk_not
        rw [hpow_vanish hΨ0 k p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
    have hmv_leib : ∀ Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
        mvDerivA (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ + mvDerivA Ψ ∧
        mvDerivD (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ + mvDerivD Ψ ∧
        mvDerivA (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivA Ψ ∧
        mvDerivD (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivD Ψ :=
      fun Φ Ψ => ⟨hmv_add 0 Φ Ψ, hmv_add 1 Φ Ψ, hmv_mul 0 Φ Ψ, hmv_mul 1 Φ Ψ⟩
    have hmv_comp_AD : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        mvDerivA (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
          mvDerivA Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ ∧

          mvDerivD Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ :=
      fun f Ψ hΨ0 => ⟨hmv_comp 0 f Ψ hΨ0, hmv_comp 1 f Ψ hΨ0⟩
    let e₀ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := e 0
    let e₁ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := e 1
    have hmvA_coeff : ∀ (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivA Φ) =
          ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e₀) Φ := fun _ _ => rfl
    have hmvD_coeff : ∀ (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivD Φ) =
          ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e₁) Φ := fun _ _ => rfl

        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ q ∈ U,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => f (z, q.2)) q.1 ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => f (q.1, w)) q.2 := by
      intro U hU f hf q hq
      have hfq : DifferentiableAt ℂ f q := hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)
      exact ⟨hfq.comp q.1 (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const q.2)),
        hfq.comp q.2 ((differentiableAt_const q.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)⟩
    have hmv_taylor : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
          mvDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
          mvDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf
      constructor
      · ext d
        rw [hmvA_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
        have hd0 : (d + e₀) 0 = d 0 + 1 := by simp [e₀, e]
        have hd1 : (d + e₀) 1 = d 1 := by simp [e₀, e]
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).1, Nat.factorial_succ (d 0), Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc : ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have hf0 : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have hf1 : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp
      · ext d
        rw [hmvD_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
        have hd0 : (d + e₁) 0 = d 0 := by simp [e₁, e]
        have hd1 : (d + e₁) 1 = d 1 + 1 := by simp [e₁, e]
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).2, Nat.factorial_succ (d 1), Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc : ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have hf0 : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have hf1 : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)

    have hcoeff_step : ∀ {Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {N : ℕ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 →
        (∀ d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d' 0 + d' 1 = N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA Ψ) ∧

      intro Φ Ψ N d hd heq
      by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0

        have hd'_add : d' + e₁ = d := by

          simp only [d', e₁, e, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply]

        have hne : ((d' 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne hD
      · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := d - e₀
        have hd'_add : d' + e₀ = d := by
          ext i
          simp only [d', e₀, e, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply]
          (fin_cases i <;> simp); omega
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by
          have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hd'_add
          simp only [e₀, e, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hsum
          have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hA := (heq d' hd'_deg).1
        rw [hmvA_coeff, hmvA_coeff, hd'_add] at hA
        have hne : ((d' 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne hA

        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =

        intro N

      intro f g hf hg
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl

      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →

        exact ⟨hz, Metric.mem_ball_self G.δ₀_pos⟩
      exact (hholo.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 G.δ₀_pos)).meromorphicAt
    have hd_mero : ∀ a : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (d_slice a) 0 := by
      intro a
      have hiter := hiterYT_holo hB_open G.D_ZW_holo 0 a
      have hholo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (d_slice a) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀) := by
        refine (hiter.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (0 : ℂ))).differentiableOn ?_).div_const _
        intro z hz
        exact ⟨hz, Metric.mem_ball_self G.δ₀_pos⟩
      exact (hholo.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 G.δ₀_pos)).meromorphicAt
    let ι₁ : ℕ → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := fun k => Finsupp.single 1 k
    have hcoeff_mul_ι₁ : ∀ (A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (K : ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ K) (A * B) =
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ a) A * MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (K - a)) B := by
      intro A B K
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      symm
      refine Finset.sum_bij (fun a _ => (ι₁ a, ι₁ (K - a))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro a ha
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
        dsimp only [ι₁]
        rw [← Finsupp.single_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp ha)]
      · intro a₁ _ a₂ _ heq
        have h1 := congr_arg (fun p => p.1 1) heq
        simpa [ι₁] using h1
      · rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        have hc0 : p₁ 0 + p₂ 0 = 0 := by
          simpa [ι₁, Finsupp.add_apply] using congr_arg (fun x => x 0) hp
        have hc1 : p₁ 1 + p₂ 1 = K := by
          simpa [ι₁, Finsupp.add_apply] using congr_arg (fun x => x 1) hp
        refine ⟨p₁ 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
        ext1
        · ext i
          fin_cases i
          · simp [ι₁]; omega
          · simp [ι₁]
        · ext i
          fin_cases i
          · simp [ι₁]; omega
          · simp [ι₁]; omega
      · intro a _; rfl
    let seqPow : (ℕ → ℂ) → ℕ → (ℕ → ℂ) := fun c =>
      Nat.rec (fun k => if k = 0 then 1 else 0)
        (fun _ prev k => ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), prev a * c (k - a))
    have seqPow_zero : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ), seqPow c 0 k = if k = 0 then 1 else 0 :=
      fun _ _ => rfl
    have seqPow_succ : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (m k : ℕ),
        seqPow c (m + 1) k = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), seqPow c m a * c (k - a) :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have hpow_ι₁ : ∀ {Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {c : ℕ → ℂ},
        (∀ k : ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ k) Ψ = c k) →
        ∀ (m k : ℕ), MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ k) (Ψ ^ m) = seqPow c m k := by
      intro Ψ c hc m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro k
        rw [pow_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one, seqPow_zero]
        have hiff : ι₁ k = 0 ↔ k = 0 := by
          constructor
          · intro h
            simpa [ι₁] using congr_arg (fun x => x 1) h
          · rintro rfl
            simp [ι₁]
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · subst hk; simp [ι₁]
        · have hne : ι₁ k ≠ 0 := mt hiff.mp hk
          simp [hk, hne]
      | succ m ih =>
        intro k
        rw [pow_succ, hcoeff_mul_ι₁, seqPow_succ]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
        rw [ih a, hc (k - a)]
    have hseqPow_vanish : ∀ {c : ℕ → ℂ}, c 0 = 0 → c 1 = 0 →
        ∀ (m k : ℕ), k < 2 * m → seqPow c m k = 0 := by
      intro c hc0 hc1 m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro k hk; omega
      | succ m ih =>
        intro k hk
        rw [seqPow_succ]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_
        intro a ha
        by_cases hka : k - a ≤ 1
        · have hcase : k - a = 0 ∨ k - a = 1 := by omega
          rcases hcase with h | h <;> simp [h, hc0, hc1]
        · rw [ih a (by omega), zero_mul]
    have hseqPow_trunc : ∀ {c₁ c₂ : ℕ → ℂ} {N : ℕ},
        c₁ 0 = 0 → c₁ 1 = 0 → c₂ 0 = 0 → c₂ 1 = 0 →
        (∀ k : ℕ, k < N → c₁ k = c₂ k) →
        (∀ m k : ℕ, k < N → seqPow c₁ m k = seqPow c₂ m k) ∧
        (∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → seqPow c₁ m N = seqPow c₂ m N) := by
      intro c₁ c₂ N hc₁0 hc₁1 hc₂0 hc₂1 hagree
      have hlt : ∀ m k : ℕ, k < N → seqPow c₁ m k = seqPow c₂ m k := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro k _; rfl
        | succ m ih =>
          intro k hk
          rw [seqPow_succ, seqPow_succ]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha => ?_)
          rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
          rw [ih a (by omega), hagree (k - a) (by omega)]
      refine ⟨hlt, ?_⟩
      intro m hm2
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m' : ℕ, m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      have hm'1 : 1 ≤ m' := by omega
      rw [seqPow_succ, seqPow_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a ha => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
      by_cases ha2 : a < 2
      · rw [hseqPow_vanish hc₁0 hc₁1 m' a (by omega),
            hseqPow_vanish hc₂0 hc₂1 m' a (by omega), zero_mul, zero_mul]
      · by_cases hNa2 : N - a < 2
        · have hcase : N - a = 0 ∨ N - a = 1 := by omega
          rcases hcase with h | h <;> simp [h, hc₁0, hc₁1, hc₂0, hc₂1]
        · rw [hlt m' a (by omega), hagree (N - a) (by omega)]
    intro j
    induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h j ih =>
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        have hfn : v_jet 0 = fun _ => 0 := funext hv_jet_zero
        rw [hfn]
        exact analyticAt_const.meromorphicAt
      · have hj_pos : 1 ≤ j := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj0
        let c_lt : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) := fun k =>
          if k < 2 * j then (if Even k then v_jet (k / 2) else 0) else 0
        have hc_lt_mero : ∀ k : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (c_lt k) 0 := by
          intro k
          dsimp only [c_lt]
          split_ifs with hk heven
          · have hk_div : 2 * (k / 2) = k := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (even_iff_two_dvd.mp heven)
            exact ih (k / 2) (by omega)
          · exact (analyticAt_const : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) 0).meromorphicAt
          · exact (analyticAt_const : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) 0).meromorphicAt
        let sp_lt : ℕ → ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) := fun m k z => seqPow (fun r => c_lt r z) m k
        have hsp_lt_mero : ∀ m k : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (sp_lt m k) 0 := by
          intro m
          induction m with
          | zero =>
            intro k
            have hfn : sp_lt 0 k = fun _ => if k = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := rfl
            rw [hfn]
            exact analyticAt_const.meromorphicAt
          | succ m ihm =>
            intro k
            have hfn : sp_lt (m + 1) k =
                ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), sp_lt m a * c_lt (k - a) := by
              ext z
              simp [sp_lt, seqPow_succ]
            rw [hfn]
            exact MeromorphicAt.sum fun a _ => (ihm a).mul (hc_lt_mero (k - a))
        let z_coeff : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) := fun m z => iteratedDeriv m Z_ext z / (m.factorial : ℂ)
        have hz_coeff_mero : ∀ m : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (z_coeff m) 0 := by
          intro m
          have hfn : z_coeff m = fun z => ((deriv^[m] Z_ext) z) * ((m.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹ := by
            ext z
            simp [z_coeff, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, div_eq_mul_inv]
          rw [hfn]
          exact ((hZ_ext_ana0.iterated_deriv m).mul analyticAt_const).meromorphicAt
        let T_lt : ℕ → (ℂ → ℂ) := fun K =>
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), z_coeff m * sp_lt m K
        have hT_lt_mero : ∀ K : ℕ, MeromorphicAt (T_lt K) 0 :=
          fun K => MeromorphicAt.sum fun m _ => (hz_coeff_mero m).mul (hsp_lt_mero m K)
        let F_cand : ℂ → ℂ :=
          (n_slice (2 * j) - ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1), d_slice a * T_lt (2 * j - a)) /
            (d_slice 0 * deriv Z_ext)
        have hF_cand_mero : MeromorphicAt F_cand 0 := by
          dsimp only [F_cand]
          refine ((hn_mero (2 * j)).sub
            (MeromorphicAt.sum fun a _ => (hd_mero a).mul (hT_lt_mero (2 * j - a)))).div ?_
          exact (hd_mero 0).mul hZ_ext_ana0.deriv.meromorphicAt
        refine hF_cand_mero.congr ?_
        rw [eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_iff]
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) S.δ₁_pos] with z₀ hz₀_ball hz₀_ne
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz₀_ball
        rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz₀_ne
        have hz₀_pos : 0 < ‖z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz₀_ne
        have hz₀_δ₀ : ‖z₀‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz₀_ball S.δ₁_le
        obtain ⟨_, r_Z, hr_Z_pos, hz_ball_punc, h2rZ_lt_δ₀, hv_holo, hv_props, hv_zero, hv_jets⟩ :=
          h_z_lift z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_ball
        let v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := v_loc z₀
        let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_Z) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_Z)
        have hW_open : IsOpen W := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hp₀_W : (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W :=
          ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (mul_pos zero_lt_two hr_Z_pos),
           Metric.mem_ball_self (mul_pos zero_lt_two hr_Z_pos)⟩
        have hW_sub_B : W ⊆ B_δ₀ := by
          rintro ⟨z, t⟩ ⟨hz, ht⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at ht
          exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le (hz_ball_punc z hz).2 S.δ₁_le),
            Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_trans ht h2rZ_lt_δ₀)⟩
        have hv_maps_ball : ∀ p ∈ W, v p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.δ₁ := by
          rintro ⟨z, t⟩ ⟨hz, ht⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at ht
          exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using (hv_props z t hz ht).2.1)
        have hNZ_eq_W : ∀ p ∈ W, G.N_Z p = G.D_ZW p * Z_ext (v p) := by
          rintro ⟨z, t⟩ ⟨hz, ht⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at ht
          obtain ⟨hv_pos, hv_lt, hD_ne, _, hZ_div⟩ := hv_props z t hz ht
          rw [← hZ_ext_eq (v (z, t)) hv_pos hv_lt]
          have := (div_eq_iff hD_ne).mp hZ_div
          linear_combination this
        let Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D v (z₀, 0)
        have hv_z₀ : v (z₀, 0) = z₀ := hv_zero z₀ (by simpa using mul_pos zero_lt_two hr_Z_pos)
        have hZ_comp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Z_ext (v p)) W :=
          hZ_ext_holo.comp hv_holo hv_maps_ball
        have htaylor_id : taylor2D G.N_Z (z₀, 0) =
            taylor2D G.D_ZW (z₀, 0) * compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D Z_ext z₀) Ψ := by
          have hv_W : DifferentiableOn ℂ v W := hv_holo
          rw [htaylor2D_congr hW_open hp₀_W hNZ_eq_W,
              htaylor2D_mul hW_open hp₀_W (G.D_ZW_holo.mono hW_sub_B) hZ_comp_holo,
              htaylor2D_comp_1D hW_open Metric.isOpen_ball hp₀_W hv_W hZ_ext_holo hv_maps_ball,
              hv_z₀]
        have htaylor_ι₁ : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ k) (taylor2D f (z₀, 0)) =
              iterDerivYT 0 k f (z₀, 0) / (k.factorial : ℂ) := by
          intro f k
          change iterDerivYT ((ι₁ k) 0) ((ι₁ k) 1) f (z₀, 0) /
            ((((ι₁ k) 0).factorial : ℂ) * (((ι₁ k) 1).factorial : ℂ)) = _
          simp [ι₁]
        have hcomp_ι₁ : ∀ (g : PowerSeries ℂ) (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (K : ℕ),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ K) (compPowerSeries2D g Φ) =
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
                PowerSeries.coeff m g * MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ K) (Φ ^ m) := by
          intro g Φ K
          change ∑ m ∈ Finset.range ((ι₁ K) 0 + (ι₁ K) 1 + 1), _ = _
          simp [ι₁]
        let c_full : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => if Even k then v_jet (k / 2) z₀ else 0
        have hΨ_ι₁ : ∀ k : ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ k) Ψ = c_full k := by
          intro k
          change MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ k) (taylor2D (fun p => v p - v (z₀, 0)) (z₀, 0)) = _
          rw [htaylor_ι₁]
          have hiter : iterDerivYT 0 k (fun p => v p - v (z₀, 0)) (z₀, 0) =
              iteratedDeriv k (fun t => v (z₀, t) - z₀) 0 := by
            rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, hv_z₀]
            rfl
          rw [hiter]
          exact hv_jets z₀ (by simpa using (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r_Z)) k
        have hc_full0 : c_full 0 = 0 := by simp [c_full, hv_jet_zero z₀]
        have hc_full1 : c_full 1 = 0 := by simp [c_full]
        have hc_lt0 : c_lt 0 z₀ = 0 := by
          dsimp only [c_lt]
          split_ifs <;> simp [hv_jet_zero z₀]
        have hc_lt1 : c_lt 1 z₀ = 0 := by
          dsimp only [c_lt]
          split_ifs with h1 h2
          · exfalso; exact Nat.not_even_one h2
          · rfl
          · rfl
        have hc_agree : ∀ k : ℕ, k < 2 * j → c_full k = c_lt k z₀ := by
          intro k hk
          dsimp only [c_full, c_lt]
          simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte]
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        obtain ⟨hsp_lt_eq, hsp_ge2_eq⟩ :=
          hseqPow_trunc (N := 2 * j) hc_full0 hc_full1 hc_lt0 hc_lt1 hc_agree
        let Φ_comp : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D Z_ext z₀) Ψ
        have hΦ_comp_lt : ∀ K : ℕ, K < 2 * j →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ K) Φ_comp = T_lt K z₀ := by
          intro K hK
          dsimp only [Φ_comp, T_lt]
          rw [hcomp_ι₁]
          simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.mul_apply, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
            z_coeff, sp_lt]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          rw [hpow_ι₁ hΨ_ι₁ m K, hsp_lt_eq m K hK]
        have hΦ_comp_2j :
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j)) Φ_comp =
              deriv Z_ext z₀ * v_jet j z₀ + T_lt (2 * j) z₀ := by
          have hdiff : MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j)) Φ_comp - T_lt (2 * j) z₀ =
              deriv Z_ext z₀ * v_jet j z₀ := by
            dsimp only [Φ_comp, T_lt]
            rw [hcomp_ι₁]
            simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.mul_apply, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
              z_coeff, sp_lt]
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            have hsingle :
                (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1),
                  (iteratedDeriv m Z_ext z₀ / (m.factorial : ℂ) *
                      MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j)) (Ψ ^ m) -
                    iteratedDeriv m Z_ext z₀ / (m.factorial : ℂ) *
                      seqPow (fun r => c_lt r z₀) m (2 * j))) =
                iteratedDeriv 1 Z_ext z₀ / ((1 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j)) (Ψ ^ 1) -
                iteratedDeriv 1 Z_ext z₀ / ((1 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) *
                  seqPow (fun r => c_lt r z₀) 1 (2 * j) := by
              refine Finset.sum_eq_single 1 ?_ ?_
              · intro m _ hm1
                rw [hpow_ι₁ hΨ_ι₁ m (2 * j)]
                by_cases hm0 : m = 0
                · subst hm0
                  change iteratedDeriv 0 Z_ext z₀ / ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) *
                      (if 2 * j = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) -
                    iteratedDeriv 0 Z_ext z₀ / ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) *
                      (if 2 * j = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = 0
                  exact sub_self _
                · rw [hsp_ge2_eq m (by omega), sub_self]
              · intro hnot
                exfalso
                exact hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
            rw [hsingle, pow_one, hΨ_ι₁ (2 * j)]
            have hsp1 : seqPow (fun r => c_lt r z₀) 1 (2 * j) = c_lt (2 * j) z₀ := by
              change ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1),
                seqPow (fun r => c_lt r z₀) 0 a * c_lt (2 * j - a) z₀ = c_lt (2 * j) z₀
              refine (Finset.sum_eq_single 0 ?_ ?_).trans ?_
              · intro a _ ha0
                simp only [seqPow_zero, ha0, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
              · intro hnot
                exfalso
                exact hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
              · simp [seqPow_zero]
            have hclt_2j : c_lt (2 * j) z₀ = 0 := by
              dsimp only [c_lt]
              simp only [lt_irrefl (2 * j), ↓reduceIte]
              rfl
            have hcfull_2j : c_full (2 * j) = v_jet j z₀ := by
              dsimp only [c_full]
              simp only [even_two_mul j, ↓reduceIte]
              have : (2 * j) / 2 = j := by omega
              rw [this]
            rw [hsp1, hclt_2j, hcfull_2j, iteratedDeriv_one]
            simp
          linear_combination hdiff
        have hprod_2j := congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j))) htaylor_id
        rw [htaylor_ι₁ G.N_Z (2 * j), hcoeff_mul_ι₁] at hprod_2j
        have hsum_split :
            (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ a) (taylor2D G.D_ZW (z₀, 0)) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff (ι₁ (2 * j - a)) Φ_comp) -
            (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1), d_slice a z₀ * T_lt (2 * j - a) z₀) =
            (d_slice 0 z₀ * deriv Z_ext z₀) * v_jet j z₀ := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          refine (Finset.sum_eq_single 0 ?_ ?_).trans ?_
          · intro a ha ha0
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
            rw [htaylor_ι₁ G.D_ZW a, hΦ_comp_lt (2 * j - a) (by omega)]
            dsimp only [d_slice]
            ring
          · intro hnot
            exfalso
            exact hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
          · rw [htaylor_ι₁ G.D_ZW 0, Nat.sub_zero, hΦ_comp_2j]
            dsimp only [d_slice]
            ring
        have hlin : n_slice (2 * j) z₀ -
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (2 * j + 1), d_slice a z₀ * T_lt (2 * j - a) z₀ =
            (d_slice 0 z₀ * deriv Z_ext z₀) * v_jet j z₀ := by
          dsimp only [n_slice]
          linear_combination hprod_2j + hsum_split
        have hd0_eq : d_slice 0 z₀ = G.D_ZW (z₀, 0) := by
          dsimp only [d_slice]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        have hden_ne : d_slice 0 z₀ * deriv Z_ext z₀ ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hd0_eq, hZ_ext_deriv_eq z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_ball]
          exact mul_ne_zero
            (G.D_ZW_slice_ne_zero z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_δ₀)
            (S.deriv_Z_ne_zero z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_ball)
        change F_cand z₀ = v_jet j z₀
        dsimp only [F_cand]
        simp only [Pi.div_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [hlin, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hden_ne]
  exact ⟨{
    v_jet := v_jet
    v_jet_zero := hv_jet_zero
    v_jet_analytic := fun j z hz0 hz1 => (h_z_lift z hz0 hz1).1 j
    v_jet_mero := h_mero
    local_lift := h_w_refl
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (S : ZeroSliceCenterData G)

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hn
  
  have h_part1 : ∀ (N : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ), 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < S.δ₁ →
      PowerSeries.coeff N (rp_reflPolySeries G N L.v_jet z₀) = 0 := by
    intro N z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt
    have h_pow_vanish : ∀ (r m : ℕ) {Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ},
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 → m < r → PowerSeries.coeff m (Ψ ^ r) = 0 := by
      intro r
      induction r with
      | zero => intro m _ _ hm; omega
      | succ r ih =>
        intro m Ψ hΨ0 hm
        rw [pow_succ, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro p hp
        have hp_sum : p.1 + p.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        cases hp2 : p.2 with
        | zero => simp [hΨ0]
        | succ b => rw [ih p.1 hΨ0 (by omega), zero_mul]
    have h_t1d_const : ∀ (z₁ c : ℂ), holoTaylor1D (fun _ => c) z₁ = PowerSeries.C c := by
      intro z₁ c
      ext m
      simp only [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C, iteratedDeriv_const]
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · subst hm; simp
      · simp [hm]
    have h_t1d_alg : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {z₁ : ℂ}, z₁ ∈ V →
        ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z + g z) z₁ = holoTaylor1D f z₁ + holoTaylor1D g z₁ ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z - g z) z₁ = holoTaylor1D f z₁ - holoTaylor1D g z₁ ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z * g z) z₁ = holoTaylor1D f z₁ * holoTaylor1D g z₁ := by
      intro V hV z₁ hz₁ f g hf hg
      have hf_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ f z₁ := hf.analyticAt (hV.mem_nhds hz₁)
      have hg_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g z₁ := hg.analyticAt (hV.mem_nhds hz₁)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · ext m
        simp only [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_add]
        have h_add := iteratedDeriv_add (n := m) (hf_ana.contDiffAt) (hg_ana.contDiffAt)
        change iteratedDeriv m (f + g) z₁ / (m.factorial : ℂ) = _
        rw [h_add, add_div]
      · ext m
        simp only [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sub]
        have h_sub := iteratedDeriv_sub (n := m) (hf_ana.contDiffAt) (hg_ana.contDiffAt)
        change iteratedDeriv m (f - g) z₁ / (m.factorial : ℂ) = _
        rw [h_sub, sub_div]
      · ext m
        simp only [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        have h_mul := iteratedDeriv_mul (n := m) (hf_ana.contDiffAt) (hg_ana.contDiffAt)
        change iteratedDeriv m (f * g) z₁ / (m.factorial : ℂ) = _
        rw [h_mul, Finset.sum_div, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        symm
        refine Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => p.1) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro p hp
          have := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
          exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
        · intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ h_eq
          have h1 := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp₁
          have h2 := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp₂
          ext <;> omega
        · intro i hi
          have hi_lt := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
          exact ⟨(i, m - i), Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩

          have hp_sum : p.1 + p.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
          have hp_sub : m - p.1 = p.2 := by omega
          rw [hp_sub]
          simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

              (m.factorial : ℂ) := by

            rw [hp_sub] at this

          have hp1_ne : (p.1.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero p.1)
          have hp2_ne : (p.2.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero p.2)

          rw [← h_fac]

    have h_holo_sum : ∀ {V : Set ℂ} {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) V) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, F i z) V := by
      intro V ι s F hF
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | @insert a s ha ih =>

        rw [h_fn]
        exact (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
          (ih (fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))
    have h_t1d_pow : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {z₁ : ℂ}, z₁ ∈ V →

      intro V hV z₁ hz₁ f hf k

      | zero => simpa using h_t1d_const z₁ 1
      | succ k ih =>

        simp only [pow_succ]
        rw [(h_t1d_alg hV hz₁ (fun z => (f z) ^ k) f hk_holo hf).2.2, ih]
    have h_t1d_sum : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {z₁ : ℂ}, z₁ ∈ V →
        ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) V) →
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, F i z) z₁ = ∑ i ∈ s, holoTaylor1D (F i) z₁ := by
      intro V hV z₁ hz₁ ι s F hF
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simpa using h_t1d_const z₁ 0
      | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have h_fn : (fun z => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, F i z) =
            (fun z => F a z + ∑ i ∈ s, F i z) := by ext z; simp [Finset.sum_insert ha]
        rw [h_fn, Finset.sum_insert ha]
        have hs_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, F i z) V :=
          h_holo_sum s F (fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

          (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) hs_holo).1,
          ih (fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))]
    have h_t1d_sub_self : ∀ (w₁ : ℂ), holoTaylor1D (fun w => w - w₁) w₁ = PowerSeries.X := by
      intro w₁
      ext m
      simp only [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_X]
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      | succ m =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
        have hd : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w - w₁) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
          ext w; simpa using deriv_sub_const (f := id) w₁
        rw [hd, iteratedDeriv_const]
        cases m with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m => simp
    have h_iterDslope_holo : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {w₁ : ℂ}, w₁ ∈ W →
        ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → ∀ k : ℕ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (rp_iterDslope w₁ g k) W := by
      intro W hW w₁ hw₁ g hg k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact hg
      | succ k ih =>
        exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hW.mem_nhds hw₁)).mpr ih
    have h_iterDslope_exp : ∀ (w₁ : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (K : ℕ) (w : ℂ),
        g w = (∑ r ∈ Finset.range K, rp_iterDslope w₁ g r w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ r) +
          (w - w₁) ^ K * rp_iterDslope w₁ g K w := by
      intro w₁ g K w
      induction K with
      | zero => simp [rp_iterDslope]
      | succ K ih =>
        have h_step : rp_iterDslope w₁ g K w =
            rp_iterDslope w₁ g K w₁ + (w - w₁) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (K + 1) w := by
          have hs := sub_smul_dslope (rp_iterDslope w₁ g K) w₁ w
          simp only [rp_iterDslope, smul_eq_mul] at hs ⊢
          linear_combination -hs
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, h_step]
        ring
    have h_iterDslope_eq_coeff : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {w₁ : ℂ}, w₁ ∈ W →
        ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → ∀ r : ℕ,
          rp_iterDslope w₁ g r w₁ = PowerSeries.coeff r (holoTaylor1D g w₁) := by
      intro W hW w₁ hw₁ g hg r
      have h_fn : g = fun w =>
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) +
            (w - w₁) ^ (r + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (r + 1) w :=
        funext (h_iterDslope_exp w₁ g (r + 1))
      have h_sub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => w - w₁) W :=
        differentiableOn_id.sub (differentiableOn_const w₁)
      have h_sum_holo : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) W :=
        fun k _ => (differentiableOn_const _).mul (h_sub_holo.pow k)
      have h_rem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ (r + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (r + 1) w) W :=
        (h_sub_holo.pow (r + 1)).mul (h_iterDslope_holo hW hw₁ hg (r + 1))
      have h_sum_all_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) W := by
        have : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => ∑ k ∈ s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) W := by
          intro s
          induction s using Finset.induction_on with
          | empty => simpa using differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ)
          | @insert a s ha ihs =>
            have h_eq : (fun w => ∑ k ∈ insert a s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) =
                (fun w => rp_iterDslope w₁ g a w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ a +
                  ∑ k ∈ s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) := by
              ext w; simp [Finset.sum_insert ha]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (h_sub_holo.pow a)).add ihs
        exact this _
      have ht_eq : holoTaylor1D g w₁ =
          holoTaylor1D (fun w => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (w - w₁) ^ k) w₁ +
            holoTaylor1D (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ (r + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (r + 1) w) w₁ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h_fn]
        exact (h_t1d_alg hW hw₁ _ _ h_sum_all_holo h_rem_holo).1
      have h_c := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff r) ht_eq
      rw [map_add] at h_c
      have h_rem0 : PowerSeries.coeff r
          (holoTaylor1D (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ (r + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (r + 1) w) w₁) = 0 := by
        rw [(h_t1d_alg hW hw₁ (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ (r + 1)) (rp_iterDslope w₁ g (r + 1))
          (h_sub_holo.pow (r + 1)) (h_iterDslope_holo hW hw₁ hg (r + 1))).2.2,
          h_t1d_pow hW hw₁ (fun w => w - w₁) h_sub_holo (r + 1), h_t1d_sub_self w₁, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro p hp
        have hp_sum := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [h_pow_vanish (r + 1) p.1 (by simp) (by omega), zero_mul]
      rw [h_rem0, add_zero, h_t1d_sum hW hw₁ _ _ h_sum_holo, map_sum] at h_c
      rw [h_c, Finset.sum_eq_single r]
      · rw [(h_t1d_alg hW hw₁ (fun _ => rp_iterDslope w₁ g r w₁) (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ r)
          (differentiableOn_const _) (h_sub_holo.pow r)).2.2,
          h_t1d_const, h_t1d_pow hW hw₁ (fun w => w - w₁) h_sub_holo r, h_t1d_sub_self w₁,
          PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_self, mul_one]
      · intro k _ hkr
        rw [(h_t1d_alg hW hw₁ (fun _ => rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁) (fun w => (w - w₁) ^ k)
          (differentiableOn_const _) (h_sub_holo.pow k)).2.2,
          h_t1d_const, h_t1d_pow hW hw₁ (fun w => w - w₁) h_sub_holo k, h_t1d_sub_self w₁,
          PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => absurd h hkr.symm),
          mul_zero]
      · intro hr_not
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) hr_not
    have h_t1d_comp : ∀ {V W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ∀ {z₁ : ℂ}, z₁ ∈ V →
        ∀ (ψ g : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
          (∀ z ∈ V, ψ z ∈ W) →
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => g (ψ z)) z₁ =
            rp_substPS (holoTaylor1D g (ψ z₁)) (holoTaylor1D (fun z => ψ z - ψ z₁) z₁) := by
      intro V W hV hW z₁ hz₁ ψ g hψ hg hmaps
      let w₁ := ψ z₁
      have hw₁ : w₁ ∈ W := hmaps z₁ hz₁
      ext m
      have h_fn : (fun z => g (ψ z)) = fun z =>
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) +
            (ψ z - w₁) ^ (m + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z) :=
        funext fun z => h_iterDslope_exp w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)
      have hψ_sub : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ψ z - w₁) V :=
        hψ.sub (differentiableOn_const w₁)
      have h_term_holo : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) V :=
        fun k _ => (differentiableOn_const _).mul (hψ_sub.pow k)
      have h_sum_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) V := by
        have : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∑ k ∈ s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) V := by
          intro s
          induction s using Finset.induction_on with
          | empty => simpa using differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ)
          | @insert a s ha ihs =>
            have h_eq : (fun z => ∑ k ∈ insert a s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) =
                (fun z => rp_iterDslope w₁ g a w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ a +
                  ∑ k ∈ s, rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) := by
              ext z; simp [Finset.sum_insert ha]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hψ_sub.pow a)).add ihs
        exact this _
      have hR_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)) V :=
        (h_iterDslope_holo hW hw₁ hg (m + 1)).comp hψ hmaps
      have h_rem_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z => (ψ z - w₁) ^ (m + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)) V :=
        (hψ_sub.pow (m + 1)).mul hR_comp
      have ht_eq : holoTaylor1D (fun z => g (ψ z)) z₁ =
          holoTaylor1D (fun z => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁ * (ψ z - w₁) ^ k) z₁ +
            holoTaylor1D (fun z => (ψ z - w₁) ^ (m + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)) z₁ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h_fn]
        exact (h_t1d_alg hV hz₁ _ _ h_sum_holo h_rem_holo).1
      rw [ht_eq, map_add]
      have hΨ0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 (holoTaylor1D (fun z => ψ z - w₁) z₁) = 0 := by
        simp [holoTaylor1D, iteratedDeriv_zero, w₁]
      have h_rem0 : PowerSeries.coeff m
          (holoTaylor1D (fun z => (ψ z - w₁) ^ (m + 1) * rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)) z₁) = 0 := by
        rw [(h_t1d_alg hV hz₁ (fun z => (ψ z - w₁) ^ (m + 1))
          (fun z => rp_iterDslope w₁ g (m + 1) (ψ z)) (hψ_sub.pow (m + 1)) hR_comp).2.2,
          h_t1d_pow hV hz₁ (fun z => ψ z - w₁) hψ_sub (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro p hp
        have hp_sum := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [h_pow_vanish (m + 1) p.1 hΨ0 (by omega), zero_mul]
      rw [h_rem0, add_zero, h_t1d_sum hV hz₁ _ _ h_term_holo, map_sum]
      simp only [rp_substPS, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [(h_t1d_alg hV hz₁ (fun _ => rp_iterDslope w₁ g k w₁) (fun z => (ψ z - w₁) ^ k)
        (differentiableOn_const _) (hψ_sub.pow k)).2.2,
        h_t1d_const, h_t1d_pow hV hz₁ (fun z => ψ z - w₁) hψ_sub k, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
        h_iterDslope_eq_coeff hW hw₁ hg k]
    have h_subst_range_ext : ∀ (f Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ) (m M : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 → m ≤ M →
        PowerSeries.coeff m (rp_substPS f Ψ) =
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), PowerSeries.coeff r f * PowerSeries.coeff m (Ψ ^ r) := by
      intro f Ψ m M hΨ0 hmM
      simp only [rp_substPS, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_
      intro r _ hr_not
      have hmr : m < r := by simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hr_not; omega
      rw [h_pow_vanish r m hΨ0 hmr, mul_zero]
    have h_subst_sub : ∀ (f₁ f₂ Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ),
        rp_substPS (f₁ - f₂) Ψ = rp_substPS f₁ Ψ - rp_substPS f₂ Ψ := by
      intro f₁ f₂ Ψ; ext m; simp [rp_substPS, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have h_subst_C_mul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ),
        rp_substPS (PowerSeries.C c * f) Ψ = PowerSeries.C c * rp_substPS f Ψ := by
      intro c f Ψ; ext m; simp [rp_substPS, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    have h_subst_mul : ∀ (f₁ f₂ Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ),
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        rp_substPS (f₁ * f₂) Ψ = rp_substPS f₁ Ψ * rp_substPS f₂ Ψ := by
      intro f₁ f₂ Ψ hΨ0
      ext m
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      have h_rhs1 : ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
            PowerSeries.coeff p.1 (rp_substPS f₁ Ψ) * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 (rp_substPS f₂ Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
            (∑ r₁ ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff r₁ f₁ * PowerSeries.coeff p.1 (Ψ ^ r₁)) *
            (∑ r₂ ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff r₂ f₂ * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 (Ψ ^ r₂)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        have hp_sum := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [h_subst_range_ext f₁ Ψ p.1 m hΨ0 (by omega),
            h_subst_range_ext f₂ Ψ p.2 m hΨ0 (by omega)]
      rw [h_rhs1]

reflection_parity_laurent_pole_bound.definitions:
noncomputable def rp_iterDslope (w₁ : ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  | 0 => g
  | k + 1 => dslope (rp_iterDslope w₁ g k) w₁

noncomputable def rp_substPS (f Ψ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff r f * PowerSeries.coeff m (Ψ ^ r)

noncomputable def rp_jetVSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    if m % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ m then u (m / 2) z else 0

noncomputable def rp_jetHPlusSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    (if m = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) +
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
        if p.1 % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2 then
          iteratedDeriv p.2 (u (p.1 / 2)) z / (p.2.factorial : ℂ)
        else 0

noncomputable def rp_jetHMinusSeries (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    (if m = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) +
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m,
        if p.1 % 2 = 0 ∧ 2 ≤ p.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2 then
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (p.2 + 1) * (iteratedDeriv p.2 (u (p.1 / 2)) z / (p.2.factorial : ℂ))
        else 0

noncomputable def rp_reflPolySeries {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n)
    (N : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
      rp_substPS (holoTaylor1D (reflDiffCoeff G k.1 k.2) z) (rp_jetVSeries u z) *
        (rp_jetHMinusSeries u z) ^ k.1 * (rp_jetHPlusSeries u z) ^ k.2

def rp_truncJet (u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (j i : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  if 1 ≤ i ∧ i < j then u i else fun _ => 0

def rp_VanishesToOrderPS (M : ℕ) (P : PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, m < M → PowerSeries.coeff m P = 0

def rp_HasPSLaurentWeight (w : ℤ) (Ψ : ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ β : ℕ,
    MeromorphicAt (fun z => PowerSeries.coeff β (Ψ z)) 0 ∧
      ((w - (β : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤
        meromorphicOrderAt (fun z => PowerSeries.coeff β (Ψ z)) 0

signature.statement:
