proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hn
  
  
  
  have h2d_partials :
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
          iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
          pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
          pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p) := by
    let _ : Module ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) := NormedSpace.toModule
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.snd
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_apply : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, π₁ p = p.1 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₂_apply : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, π₂ p = p.2 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₁_norm : ‖π₁‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₁ zero_le_one fun p => by
        rw [one_mul, hπ₁_apply, Prod.norm_def]
        exact le_max_left _ _
    have hπ₂_norm : ‖π₂‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₂ zero_le_one fun p => by
        rw [one_mul, hπ₂_apply, Prod.norm_def]
        exact le_max_right _ _

    have hparam_int_holo :
        ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (r B_const : ℝ), 0 < r →
        ∀ (c₀ : ℂ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ)
          (F' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)),
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, g p = c₀ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ) →
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p)) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) →
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ B_const) →
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      intro p₀ r B_const hr c₀ g F F' hg_eq hF_cont hF'_meas hF'_bnd hF_fd
      have hs_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ r ∈ nhds p₀ :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
      have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F p)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
        exact (hF_cont p hp).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF₀_int : IntervalIntegrable (F p₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (hF_cont p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have hbnd_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => B_const) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        intervalIntegrable_const
      have h_int_fd := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (𝕜 := ℂ) hs_nhds hF_meas hF₀_int hF'_meas
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hF'_bnd p hp θ)
        hbnd_int
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hF_fd p hp θ)
      have hg_ev : g =ᶠ[nhds p₀] fun p => c₀ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ := by
        filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
        exact hg_eq p hp
      exact ((h_int_fd.const_mul c₀).congr_of_eventuallyEq hg_ev).differentiableAt

    have hPartialA : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf p₀ hp₀
      refine DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt ?_
      obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀, hball_U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀
      set a₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
      set b₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
      let r : ℝ := R₀ / 4
      have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
      have h_in_U : ∀ z w : ℂ, ‖z - a₀‖ < 4 * r → ‖w - b₀‖ < 4 * r → (z, w) ∈ U := by
        intro z w hz hw
        apply hball_U
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        have h4r : 4 * r = R₀ := by dsimp [r]; ring
        exact ⟨by simpa [dist_eq_norm, a₀, h4r] using hz,
          by simpa [dist_eq_norm, b₀, h4r] using hw⟩
      let K : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall a₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall b₀ (2 * r)
      have hK_compact : IsCompact K :=
        (isCompact_closedBall a₀ (2 * r)).prod (isCompact_closedBall b₀ (2 * r))
      have hK_sub : K ⊆ U := by
        intro q hq
        have h1 : ‖q.1 - a₀‖ ≤ 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1
        have h2 : ‖q.2 - b₀‖ ≤ 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2
        exact h_in_U q.1 q.2 (by linarith) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
      have hM_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall a₀ (2 * r), ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall b₀ (2 * r),
          ‖f (z, w)‖ ≤ M :=
        fun z hz w hw => le_trans (hM₀ (z, w) ⟨hz, hw⟩) (le_max_left _ _)

      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap a₀ (2 * r)
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := continuous_circleMap a₀ (2 * r)
      have hγ_sphere : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ ∈ Metric.sphere a₀ (2 * r) :=
        circleMap_mem_sphere a₀ (by positivity)
      have hγ_closed : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ ∈ Metric.closedBall a₀ (2 * r) :=
        fun θ => Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (hγ_sphere θ)
      have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := by
        have hfn : deriv γ = fun θ => circleMap 0 (2 * r) θ * Complex.I :=
          funext (deriv_circleMap a₀ (2 * r))
        rw [hfn]
        exact (continuous_circleMap 0 (2 * r)).mul continuous_const
      have hγ_deriv_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖deriv γ θ‖ = 2 * r := by
        intro θ
        rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, norm_circleMap_zero]
        exact abs_of_pos (by positivity)

      have h_sep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, r < ‖γ θ - p.1‖ ∧ γ θ - p.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp1 : ‖p.1 - a₀‖ < r := by
          have hlt := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
          rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hlt
          simpa [dist_eq_norm, a₀] using hlt.1
        have hsph : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
        have htri : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ ≤ ‖γ θ - p.1‖ + ‖p.1 - a₀‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (γ θ - p.1) (p.1 - a₀)
        have hgt : r < ‖γ θ - p.1‖ := by linarith
        exact ⟨hgt, norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_trans hr hgt)⟩

      have h_derivD_bnd : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball b₀ r,
          DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) w ∧
          ‖deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) w‖ ≤ M / r := by
        intro θ w hw
        have hw_lt : ‖w - b₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
        have h_slice_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) (Metric.ball b₀ (3 * r)) := by
          have h_emb : Differentiable ℂ (fun w' : ℂ => (γ θ, w')) :=
            (differentiable_const (γ θ)).prodMk differentiable_id
          have h_maps : ∀ w' ∈ Metric.ball b₀ (3 * r), (γ θ, w') ∈ U := by
            intro w' hw'
            have h1 : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
            have h2 : ‖w' - b₀‖ < 3 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw'
            exact h_in_U (γ θ) w' (by linarith) (by linarith)
          exact hf.comp h_emb.differentiableOn h_maps
        have hw_in3 : w ∈ Metric.ball b₀ (3 * r) :=
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (by linarith : ‖w - b₀‖ < 3 * r))
        have hd_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) w :=
          h_slice_diff.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw_in3)
        have hsub_cb : Metric.closedBall w r ⊆ Metric.ball b₀ (3 * r) := by
          intro w' hw'
          have hd1 : ‖w' - w‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hw'
          have htri : ‖w' - b₀‖ ≤ ‖w' - w‖ + ‖w - b₀‖ := by
            simpa using norm_add_le (w' - w) (w - b₀)
          exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr
            (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (by linarith : ‖w' - b₀‖ < 3 * r))
        have hsub_cb2 : Metric.sphere w r ⊆ Metric.closedBall b₀ (2 * r) := by
          intro w' hw'
          have hd1 : ‖w' - w‖ = r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hw'
          have htri : ‖w' - b₀‖ ≤ ‖w' - w‖ + ‖w - b₀‖ := by
            simpa using norm_add_le (w' - w) (w - b₀)
          exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
            (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (by linarith : ‖w' - b₀‖ ≤ 2 * r))
        have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) (Metric.ball w r) :=
          (h_slice_diff.mono (Set.Subset.trans closure_ball_subset_closedBall hsub_cb)).diffContOnCl
        have hbnd_sph : ∀ w' ∈ Metric.sphere w r, ‖f (γ θ, w')‖ ≤ M :=
          fun w' hw' => hM_bnd (γ θ) (hγ_closed θ) w' (hsub_cb2 hw')
        exact ⟨hd_at, Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr h_dc hbnd_sph⟩

      let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ :=
        fun p θ => (deriv γ θ * ((γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ))) * f (γ θ, p.2)
      let F' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun p θ =>
          (deriv γ θ * (2 : ℂ) * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) * f (γ θ, p.2)) • π₁ +
          ((deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2) • π₂

      have hpA_rep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r,
          pderivA f p = (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_lt := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp_lt
        have hp1 : ‖p.1 - a₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm, a₀] using hp_lt.1
        have hp2 : ‖p.2 - b₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm, b₀] using hp_lt.2
        have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => f (ζ, p.2)) (Metric.ball a₀ (3 * r)) := by
          have h_emb : Differentiable ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => (ζ, p.2)) :=
            differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const p.2)
          have h_maps : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball a₀ (3 * r), (ζ, p.2) ∈ U := by
            intro ζ hζ
            have h1 : ‖ζ - a₀‖ < 3 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hζ
            exact h_in_U ζ p.2 (by linarith) (by linarith)
          exact hf.comp h_emb.differentiableOn h_maps
        have hp1_in2 : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball a₀ (2 * r) :=
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (by linarith : ‖p.1 - a₀‖ < 2 * r))
        have hcauchy :=
          Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
            Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)) hg_diff hp1_in2
        dsimp only [pderivA]
        rw [← hcauchy, smul_eq_mul]
        congr 1
        dsimp only [circleIntegral, γ, F]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
        simp only [smul_eq_mul]
        have hzpow2 : ((γ θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ) := by
          change ((γ θ - p.1) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹ = (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)
          rw [← _root_.zpow_neg]
          rfl
        rw [hzpow2, mul_assoc]

      have hF_cont : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p) := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_lt := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp_lt
        have hp2 : ‖p.2 - b₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm, b₀] using hp_lt.2
        have h_sub_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) := by
          have hfn : (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) =
              fun θ : ℝ => (((γ θ - p.1) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
            ext θ
            change (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ) = ((γ θ - p.1) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹
            rw [← _root_.zpow_neg]; rfl
          rw [hfn]
          exact ((hγ_cont.sub continuous_const).pow 2).inv₀
            fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (h_sep p hp θ).2
        have hf_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => f (γ θ, p.2)) :=
          hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hγ_cont.prodMk continuous_const) fun θ => by
            have h1 : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
            exact h_in_U (γ θ) p.2 (by linarith) (by linarith)
        exact (hγ_deriv_cont.mul h_sub_cont).mul hf_cont

      have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        have hp₀_in : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
        have h_derD_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
            (fun θ : ℝ => deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) b₀)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
          let δ_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          have hδ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := fun n => by positivity
          have hδ_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖δ_seq n‖ < r := by
            intro n
            simp only [δ_seq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hδ_pos n)]
            have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
            exact div_lt_self hr h2
          have hδ_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, δ_seq n ≠ 0 :=
            fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hδ_pos n))
          have hδ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δ_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
            rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
            refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
              Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr (hδ_ne n)⟩
            have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
                Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) :=
              tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
                (Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
                  (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds))
            have h_comp := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
            exact h_comp
          let q_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ :=
            fun n θ => (δ_seq n)⁻¹ * (f (γ θ, b₀ + δ_seq n) - f (γ θ, b₀))
          have hq_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (q_seq n) := by
            intro n
            have hf1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => f (γ θ, b₀ + δ_seq n)) :=
              hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hγ_cont.prodMk continuous_const) fun θ => by
                have h1 : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
                have h2 : ‖(b₀ + δ_seq n) - b₀‖ < r := by simpa using hδ_lt n
                exact h_in_U (γ θ) (b₀ + δ_seq n) (by linarith) (by linarith)
            have hf0 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => f (γ θ, b₀)) :=
              hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hγ_cont.prodMk continuous_const) fun θ => by
                have h1 : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
                have h2 : ‖b₀ - b₀‖ = 0 := by simp
                exact h_in_U (γ θ) b₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)
            exact continuous_const.mul (hf1.sub hf0)
          refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
            (fun n => (hq_cont n).aestronglyMeasurable)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => ?_)
          have hd_b₀ := (h_derivD_bnd θ b₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).1.hasDerivAt
          have h_slope := (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hd_b₀).comp hδ_tendsto
          exact h_slope.congr fun n => by simp [q_seq, smul_eq_mul]
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            (deriv γ θ * (2 : ℂ) * (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) * f (γ θ, p₀.2)) • π₁) := by
          have h_zpow3 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ)) := by
            have hfn : (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ)) =
                fun θ : ℝ => (((γ θ - p₀.1) ^ 3)⁻¹) := by
              ext θ
              change (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) = ((γ θ - p₀.1) ^ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹
              rw [← _root_.zpow_neg]; rfl
            rw [hfn]
            exact ((hγ_cont.sub continuous_const).pow 3).inv₀
              fun θ => pow_ne_zero 3 (h_sep p₀ hp₀_in θ).2
          have hf0 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => f (γ θ, p₀.2)) :=
            hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hγ_cont.prodMk continuous_const) fun θ => by
              have h1 : ‖γ θ - a₀‖ = 2 * r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hγ_sphere θ
              have h2 : ‖p₀.2 - b₀‖ = 0 := by simp [b₀]
              exact h_in_U (γ θ) p₀.2 (by linarith) (by linarith)
          exact (((hγ_deriv_cont.mul continuous_const).mul h_zpow3).mul hf0).smul continuous_const
        have hc2_coef : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) := by
          have h_zpow2 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) := by
            have hfn : (fun θ : ℝ => (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) =
                fun θ : ℝ => (((γ θ - p₀.1) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
              ext θ
              change (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ) = ((γ θ - p₀.1) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹
              rw [← _root_.zpow_neg]; rfl
            rw [hfn]
            exact ((hγ_cont.sub continuous_const).pow 2).inv₀
              fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (h_sep p₀ hp₀_in θ).2
          exact hγ_deriv_cont.mul h_zpow2
        have h_smul_cont : Continuous (fun c : ℂ => c • π₂) :=
          continuous_id.smul continuous_const
        have hm2 : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
            (fun θ : ℝ => ((deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p₀.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
              deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) b₀) • π₂)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) :=
          h_smul_cont.comp_aestronglyMeasurable
            (hc2_coef.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_derD_meas)
        exact hc1.aestronglyMeasurable.add hm2

      let B_const : ℝ := (2 * r) * 2 * (r⁻¹ ^ 3) * M + (2 * r) * (r⁻¹ ^ 2) * (M / r)
      have hF'_bnd : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ B_const := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp_lt := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp_lt
        have hp2_lt : ‖p.2 - b₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm, b₀] using hp_lt.2
        have hp2_in : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball b₀ r :=
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hp2_lt)
        have hp2_cb : p.2 ∈ Metric.closedBall b₀ (2 * r) :=
          Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
            (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (by linarith : ‖p.2 - b₀‖ ≤ 2 * r))
        have hsep : r ≤ ‖γ θ - p.1‖ := le_of_lt (h_sep p hp θ).1
        have hinv_le : ‖γ θ - p.1‖⁻¹ ≤ r⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hr hsep
        have hzpow3_le : ‖(γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ)‖ ≤ r⁻¹ ^ 3 := by
          change ‖((γ θ - p.1) ^ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹‖ ≤ r⁻¹ ^ 3
          rw [norm_inv, zpow_natCast, norm_pow, ← inv_pow]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hinv_le 3
        have hzpow2_le : ‖(γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)‖ ≤ r⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
          change ‖((γ θ - p.1) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ))⁻¹‖ ≤ r⁻¹ ^ 2
          rw [norm_inv, zpow_natCast, norm_pow, ← inv_pow]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hinv_le 2
        have hf_le : ‖f (γ θ, p.2)‖ ≤ M := hM_bnd (γ θ) (hγ_closed θ) p.2 hp2_cb
        have hdf_le : ‖deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2‖ ≤ M / r :=
          (h_derivD_bnd θ p.2 hp2_in).2
        dsimp only [F', B_const]
        have hterm1 : ‖(deriv γ θ * (2 : ℂ) * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) * f (γ θ, p.2)) • π₁‖ ≤
            (2 * r) * 2 * (r⁻¹ ^ 3) * M := by
          rw [norm_smul]
          calc ‖deriv γ θ * (2 : ℂ) * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) * f (γ θ, p.2)‖ * ‖π₁‖
              ≤ ‖deriv γ θ * (2 : ℂ) * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ) * f (γ θ, p.2)‖ * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hπ₁_norm (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = 2 * r * 2 * ‖(γ θ - p.1) ^ (-3 : ℤ)‖ * ‖f (γ θ, p.2)‖ := by
                rw [mul_one, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, hγ_deriv_norm θ, Complex.norm_ofNat]
            _ ≤ (2 * r) * 2 * (r⁻¹ ^ 3) * M := by gcongr
        have hterm2 : ‖((deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) *
            deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2) • π₂‖ ≤ (2 * r) * (r⁻¹ ^ 2) * (M / r) := by
          rw [norm_smul]
          have hMr : 0 ≤ M / r := div_nonneg hM_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)
          calc ‖(deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2‖ * ‖π₂‖
              ≤ ‖(deriv γ θ * (γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)) * deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2‖ * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hπ₂_norm (norm_nonneg _)
            _ = 2 * r * ‖(γ θ - p.1) ^ (-2 : ℤ)‖ * ‖deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2‖ := by
                rw [mul_one, norm_mul, norm_mul, hγ_deriv_norm θ]
            _ ≤ (2 * r) * (r⁻¹ ^ 2) * (M / r) := by gcongr
        exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add hterm1 hterm2)

      have hF_fd : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp_lt := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp_lt
        have hp2_in : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball b₀ r :=
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa [dist_eq_norm, b₀] using hp_lt.2)
        have hu_ne : γ θ - p.1 ≠ 0 := (h_sep p hp θ).2
        have hu_fd : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => γ θ - q.1) (-π₁) p := by
          have hraw := (hasFDerivAt_const (γ θ) p).sub π₁.hasFDerivAt
          have h0 : (0 : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) - π₁ = -π₁ := zero_sub π₁
          exact h0 ▸ hraw
        have hzpow_fd :=
          (hasDerivAt_zpow (-2 : ℤ) (γ θ - p.1) (Or.inl hu_ne)).comp_hasFDerivAt p hu_fd
        have h1_fd := hzpow_fd.const_mul (deriv γ θ)
        have h2_fd : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => f (γ θ, q.2))
            (deriv (fun w' => f (γ θ, w')) p.2 • π₂) p :=
          (h_derivD_bnd θ p.2 hp2_in).1.hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p π₂.hasFDerivAt
        refine (h1_fd.mul h2_fd).congr_fderiv ?_
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro v
        simp only [F', _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.neg_apply,
          hπ₁_apply, hπ₂_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        norm_num
        ring

      exact hparam_int_holo p₀ r B_const hr (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ (pderivA f) F F'
        hpA_rep hF_cont hF'_meas hF'_bnd hF_fd

    have hpderiv_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf
      refine ⟨hPartialA hU hf, ?_⟩
      let σ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℂ ℂ ℂ
      have hσ_open : IsOpen (σ ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage σ.continuous
      have hfσ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f ∘ σ) (σ ⁻¹' U) :=
        hf.comp σ.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
      exact (hPartialA hσ_open hfσ).comp σ.differentiable.differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => by simpa [σ] using hp)

    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ q ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt g (π₁.smulRight (pderivA g q) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD g q)) q := by
      intro U hU g hg q hq
      have hL : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q :=
        (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have h_line1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => g (q + s • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))))
          ((fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0)) 0 := by
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => q + s • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) (1, 0) 0 := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))).const_add q
        have hL0 : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (q + (0 : ℂ) • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) := by
          simpa using hL
        exact hL0.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℂ) hγ
      have h_line2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => g (q + s • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))))
          ((fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1)) 0 := by
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => q + s • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) (0, 1) 0 := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))).const_add q
        have hL0 : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (q + (0 : ℂ) • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) := by
          simpa using hL
        exact hL0.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℂ) hγ
      have hpA_eq : (fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0) = pderivA g q := by
        rw [← h_line1.deriv]
        have hfn : (fun s : ℂ => g (q + s • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))) =
            fun s : ℂ => g (q.1 + s, q.2) := by
          ext s; congr 1; ext <;> simp
        rw [hfn]
        simpa [pderivA] using deriv_comp_const_add (fun z => g (z, q.2)) q.1 0
      have hpD_eq : (fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1) = pderivD g q := by
        rw [← h_line2.deriv]
        have hfn : (fun s : ℂ => g (q + s • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))) =
            fun s : ℂ => g (q.1, q.2 + s) := by
          ext s; congr 1; ext <;> simp
        rw [hfn]
        simpa [pderivD] using deriv_comp_const_add (fun w => g (q.1, w)) q.2 0
      refine hL.congr_fderiv ?_
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      rintro ⟨u, v⟩
      have huv : (u, v) = u • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by ext <;> simp
      conv_lhs => rw [huv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
      simp [hπ₁_apply, hπ₂_apply, hpA_eq, hpD_eq, smul_eq_mul]

    have hpderiv_comm : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (pderivD f) p = pderivD (pderivA f) p := by
      intro U hU f hf p hp
      obtain ⟨hfA, hfD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hf
      let f' : ℂ × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun q => π₁.smulRight (pderivA f q) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD f q)
      have hf'_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p, HasFDerivAt f (f' q) q := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hp] with q hq
        exact hfderiv_decomp hU hf q hq
      let S₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁
      let S₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂
      let L_A : ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        π₁.smulRight (pderivA (pderivA f) p) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD (pderivA f) p)
      let L_D : ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        π₁.smulRight (pderivA (pderivD f) p) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD (pderivD f) p)
      have hLA : HasFDerivAt (pderivA f) L_A p := hfderiv_decomp hU hfA p hp
      have hLD : HasFDerivAt (pderivD f) L_D p := hfderiv_decomp hU hfD p hp
      have hf'' : HasFDerivAt f' (S₁.comp L_A + S₂.comp L_D) p :=
        (S₁.hasFDerivAt.comp p hLA).add (S₂.hasFDerivAt.comp p hLD)
      have hsymm :=
        second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually hf'_ev hf''
          ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))
      simpa [S₁, S₂, L_A, L_D, hπ₁_apply, hπ₂_apply] using hsymm

    have hiter1D_congr : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ z ∈ V, g₁ z = g₂ z) → ∀ (β : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ V,
        ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₁) z = ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₂) z := by
      intro V hV g₁ g₂ hfg β
      induction β with
      | zero => intro z hz; exact hfg z hz
      | succ β ih =>
        intro z hz
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
        filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact ih w hw
    have hiterY_stepA : ∀ (α : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        iterDerivY (α + 1) f = iterDerivY α (pderivA f) := by
      intro α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro _; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        intro f
        ext p
        change pderivA (iterDerivY (α + 1) f) p = pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivA f)) p
        rw [ih f]
    have hstep1_uncond : ∀ (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p := by
      intro α β f p
      simp only [iterDerivYT, hiterY_stepA α f]
    have hstep4_uncond : ∀ (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p := by
      intro α β f p
      simp only [pderivD, iterDerivYT, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    have hiterY_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivY α f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => exact hf
      | succ α ih => exact (hpderiv_holo hU ih).1
    have hiterYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf α β
      induction β with
      | zero => exact hiterY_holo hU hf α
      | succ β ih =>
        have h_eq : iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f = pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) := by
          ext p; exact (hstep4_uncond α β f p).symm
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hpderiv_holo hU ih).2
    have hiterY_commD : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ q ∈ U,
        iterDerivY α (pderivD f) q = pderivD (iterDerivY α f) q := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro _ _; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        intro q hq
        change pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) q = pderivD (pderivA (iterDerivY α f)) q
        have hcongrA : pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) q =
            pderivA (pderivD (iterDerivY α f)) q := by
          refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
          have hopen_y : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, q.2) ∈ U} :=
            hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          filter_upwards [hopen_y.mem_nhds hq] with z hz
          exact ih (z, q.2) hz
        rw [hcongrA]
        exact hpderiv_comm hU (hiterY_holo hU hf α) q hq
    have hiterYT_step : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
          iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
          pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
          pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p := by
      intro U hU f hf α β p hp
      refine ⟨hstep1_uncond α β f p, ?_, ?_, hstep4_uncond α β f p⟩
      · have hopen_t : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p.1, t') ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have hcongr := hiter1D_congr hopen_t
          (fun t' ht' => hiterY_commD hU hf α (p.1, t') ht') β p.2 hp
        dsimp only [iterDerivYT] at hcongr ⊢
        rw [hcongr]
        exact Function.iterate_succ_apply (fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g) β
          (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f (p.1, t')) ▸ rfl
      · revert p
        induction β with
        | zero => intro _ _; rfl
        | succ β ih =>
          intro p hp
          have h_eq : iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f = pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) := by
            ext q; exact (hstep4_uncond α β f q).symm
          rw [h_eq, hpderiv_comm hU (hiterYT_holo hU hf α β) p hp]
          have hcongrD : pderivD (pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f)) p =
              pderivD (iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f) p := by
            refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
            have hopen_t : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p.1, t') ∈ U} :=
              hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
            filter_upwards [hopen_t.mem_nhds hp] with t' ht'
            exact ih (p.1, t') ht'
          rw [hcongrD, hstep4_uncond (α + 1) β f p]
    exact ⟨hpderiv_holo, hiterYT_holo, hiterYT_step⟩
  
  
  
  have h_fac_ne : ∀ k : ℕ, (k.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    fun k => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  have h_ana_cd : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f z → ∀ k : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℂ k f z :=
    fun hf k => hf.contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have h_iter_zero : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℂ), iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) x = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro x; rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
      have hd : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by
        ext w; exact deriv_const w (0 : ℂ)
      rw [hd]
      exact ih x
  have h_iter_const : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c x : ℂ),
      iteratedDeriv k (fun _ : ℂ => c) x = if k = 0 then c else 0 := by
    intro k c x
    cases k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
      have hd : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => c) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by
        ext w; exact deriv_const w c
      rw [hd]
      exact h_iter_zero k x
  have h_scale_deriv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z lam0 : ℂ),
      iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => g (z * lam)) lam0 = z ^ k * iteratedDeriv k g (z * lam0) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro g z lam0; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro g z lam0
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have hfn : iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => g (z * lam)) =
          fun lam => z ^ k * iteratedDeriv k g (z * lam) := by
        ext lam; exact ih g z lam
      rw [hfn, deriv_const_mul_field, deriv_comp_mul_left, pow_succ]
      ring
  have h_vanish_ev : ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 →
      (∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k g 0 = 0) → g =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
    intro g hg h0
    have hps := hg.hasFPowerSeriesAt
    have hps0 : FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ
        (fun k => iteratedDeriv k g 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      ext k
      simp [FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars, h0 k]
    rw [hps0] at hps
    exact hps.eventually_eq_zero
  have ht1_coeff : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff k (holoTaylor1D g 0) = iteratedDeriv k g 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) :=
    fun g k => PowerSeries.coeff_mk k _
  have ht1_congr : ∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ}, f =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] g →
      holoTaylor1D f 0 = holoTaylor1D g 0 := by
    intro f g hfg
    ext k
    rw [ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff, hfg.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
  have ht1_const : ∀ (c : ℂ), holoTaylor1D (fun _ => c) 0 = PowerSeries.C c := by
    intro c
    ext k
    rw [ht1_coeff, PowerSeries.coeff_C, h_iter_const]
    split_ifs with hk
    · subst hk; simp
    · simp
  have ht1_id : holoTaylor1D (fun z : ℂ => z) 0 = PowerSeries.X := by
    ext k
    rw [ht1_coeff, PowerSeries.coeff_X]
    cases k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k =>
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
        have hd : deriv (fun z : ℂ => z) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
          ext z; exact deriv_id z
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hd, h_iter_const (k + 1) 1 0]
        simp
  have ht1_add : ∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 →
      holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z + g z) 0 = holoTaylor1D f 0 + holoTaylor1D g 0 := by
    intro f g hf hg
    ext k
    rw [map_add, ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff,
      iteratedDeriv_fun_add (h_ana_cd hf k) (h_ana_cd hg k), add_div]
  have ht1_mul : ∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 →
      holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z * g z) 0 = holoTaylor1D f 0 * holoTaylor1D g 0 := by
    intro f g hf hg
    ext k
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
      ht1_coeff, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (h_ana_cd hf k) (h_ana_cd hg k), Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    rw [ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff]
    have hle : i ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    have hchoose : ((k.choose i : ℂ) * (i.factorial : ℂ) * ((k - i).factorial : ℂ)) =
        (k.factorial : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hle
    have hfi := h_fac_ne i
    have hfk := h_fac_ne k
    have hfki := h_fac_ne (k - i)
    field_simp
    rw [← hchoose]
    ring
  have ht1_sub : ∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 →
      holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z - g z) 0 = holoTaylor1D f 0 - holoTaylor1D g 0 := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hneg : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => (-1 : ℂ) * g z) 0 := analyticAt_const.mul hg
    have hfn : (fun z => f z - g z) = (fun z => f z + (-1 : ℂ) * g z) := by
      ext z; ring
    rw [hfn, ht1_add hf hneg,
      ht1_mul (f := fun _ => (-1 : ℂ)) (g := g) analyticAt_const hg,
      ht1_const (-1), map_neg, map_one]
    ring

  
  
  
  
  have h_parts_2_to_4 :
      ∃ (U_germ : ℂ → ℂ) (r_U : ℝ),
        0 < r_U ∧
        AnalyticAt ℂ U_germ 0 ∧
        U_germ 0 = 1 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ U_germ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U, U_germ w ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U, U_germ w - w * deriv U_germ w ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) (b : ℤ) (u_Q : ℂ → ℂ),
          AnalyticAt ℂ u_Q 0 → u_Q 0 ≠ 0 →
          (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
            MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q = z ^ b * u_Q z) →
          ∃ (P_rat Q_rat : Polynomial ℂ) (R_Q : ℝ),
            Q_rat ≠ 0 ∧ r_U⁻¹ < R_Q ∧
            ∀ w : ℂ, R_Q < ‖w‖ →
              Q_rat.eval w ≠ 0 ∧ (w * U_germ w⁻¹) ^ b * Q_rat.eval w = P_rat.eval w) ∧
        (∀ (P₀ : ℂ → ℂ) (b : ℤ) (u_Q : ℂ → ℂ),
          AnalyticAt ℂ u_Q 0 →
          (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, P₀ z = z ^ b * u_Q z) →
          ∀ β : ℕ, ∃ (E_β : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ_β : ℝ),
            0 < ρ_β ∧ ρ_β ≤ S.δ₁ ∧
            AnalyticAt ℂ E_β 0 ∧
            E_β 0 = u_Q 0 * (iteratedDeriv β (fun w => (U_germ w) ^ b) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ)) ∧
            ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
              0 < r →
              DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) →
              (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) →
              (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ k : ℕ,
                iteratedDeriv k (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
                  if Even k then L.v_jet (k / 2) z else 0) →
              ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ρ_β →
                iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) =
                  z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) * E_β z) := by
    have ht1_pow : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → ∀ m : ℕ,
        holoTaylor1D (fun z => f z ^ m) 0 = (holoTaylor1D f 0) ^ m := by
      intro f hf m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        simpa using ht1_const 1
      | succ m ih =>
        have hfm : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => f z ^ m) 0 := hf.pow m
        have hfn : (fun z => f z ^ (m + 1)) = (fun z => f z ^ m * f z) := by
          ext z; exact pow_succ (f z) m
        rw [hfn, ht1_mul hfm hf, ih, pow_succ]
    have ht1_zpow : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ}, AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → f 0 = 1 →
        ∀ (u : (PowerSeries ℂ)ˣ), (↑u : PowerSeries ℂ) = holoTaylor1D f 0 →
        ∀ b : ℤ, holoTaylor1D (fun z => (f z) ^ b) 0 = (↑(u ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
      intro f hf hf0 u hu b
      have hf_ne0 : f 0 ≠ 0 := by rw [hf0]; exact one_ne_zero
      cases b with
      | ofNat m =>
        have hfn : (fun z => (f z) ^ (Int.ofNat m)) = (fun z => f z ^ m) := by
          ext z; simp
        have hu_m : (↑(u ^ (Int.ofNat m)) : PowerSeries ℂ) = (↑u : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m := by
          change (↑(u ^ m) : PowerSeries ℂ) = (↑u : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m
          exact Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val u m
        rw [hfn, ht1_pow hf m, ← hu, hu_m]
      | negSucc m =>
        have hf_ev_ne : ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : ℂ), f z ≠ 0 := hf.continuousAt.eventually_ne hf_ne0
        have hmul_one : (fun z => f z ^ (m + 1) * (f z) ^ (Int.negSucc m)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
            (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hf_ev_ne] with z hz
          change f z ^ (m + 1) * (f z ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ = 1
          exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero (m + 1) hz)
        have h_ana_pos : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => f z ^ (m + 1)) 0 := hf.pow (m + 1)
        have h_ana_neg : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => (f z) ^ (Int.negSucc m)) 0 :=
          hf.fun_zpow hf_ne0
        have h1 : (↑(u ^ (m + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ) *
            holoTaylor1D (fun z => (f z) ^ (Int.negSucc m)) 0 = 1 := by
          rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hu, ← ht1_pow hf (m + 1),
            ← ht1_mul h_ana_pos h_ana_neg, ht1_congr hmul_one, ht1_const 1, map_one]
        have h2 : (↑(u ^ (m + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ) *
            (↑(u ^ (Int.negSucc m)) : PowerSeries ℂ) = 1 := by
          rw [← Units.val_mul]
          have hexp : u ^ (m + 1) * u ^ (Int.negSucc m) = 1 := by
            change u ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) * u ^ (Int.negSucc m) = 1
            rw [← _root_.zpow_add]
            have hz : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + Int.negSucc m = 0 := by omega
            rw [hz, zpow_zero]
          rw [hexp, Units.val_one]
        exact (u ^ (m + 1)).isUnit.mul_left_cancel (h1.trans h2.symm)
    have ht1_poly : ∀ (P : Polynomial ℂ),
        holoTaylor1D (fun z => P.eval z) 0 = (↑P : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
      intro P
      have h_poly_ana : ∀ Q : Polynomial ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Q.eval z) 0 :=
        fun Q => (Polynomial.differentiable Q).differentiableOn.analyticAt Filter.univ_mem
      refine Polynomial.induction_on' P ?_ ?_
      · intro P₁ P₂ h₁ h₂
        have hfn : (fun z => (P₁ + P₂).eval z) = (fun z => P₁.eval z + P₂.eval z) := by
          ext z; exact Polynomial.eval_add
        rw [hfn, ht1_add (h_poly_ana P₁) (h_poly_ana P₂), h₁, h₂, Polynomial.coe_add]
      · intro k a
        rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, Polynomial.coe_mul, Polynomial.coe_C,
          Polynomial.coe_pow, Polynomial.coe_X]
        have hzk : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ k) 0 := analyticAt_id.pow k
        have hfn : (fun z => (Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ k).eval z) =
            (fun z => a * z ^ k) := by
          ext z; simp
        rw [hfn, ht1_mul (f := fun _ => a) analyticAt_const hzk, ht1_const a,
          ht1_pow (f := fun w => w) analyticAt_id k, ht1_id]

    let u_raw : PowerSeries ℂ :=
      PowerSeries.mk (fun k => if k = 0 then 1 else if Even k then B.w_jet (k / 2) 0 else 0)
    have hu_raw_c0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u_raw = 1 := by
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      simp
    have hu_raw_unit : IsUnit u_raw := by
      rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hu_raw_c0]
      exact isUnit_one
    let u_fps : (PowerSeries ℂ)ˣ := hu_raw_unit.unit
    have hu_fps_val : (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) = u_raw := IsUnit.unit_spec hu_raw_unit
    have hu_fps_c0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) = 1 := by
      rw [hu_fps_val, hu_raw_c0]

    have h_comp_jet : ∀ (M : ℕ) (Φ η₁ η₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
        AnalyticAt ℂ η₁ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ η₂ 0 →
        (∀ k < M, iteratedDeriv k η₁ 0 = iteratedDeriv k η₂ 0) →
        AnalyticAt ℂ Φ (η₁ 0) →
        ∀ k < M, iteratedDeriv k (fun w => Φ (η₁ w)) 0 =
          iteratedDeriv k (fun w => Φ (η₂ w)) 0 := by
      intro M
      induction M with
      | zero =>
        intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ k hk; omega
      | succ M ih =>
        intro Φ η₁ η₂ hη₁ hη₂ heq hΦ k hk
        have h0 : η₁ 0 = η₂ 0 := heq 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ M)
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          simp [h0]
        | succ m =>
          have hm : m < M := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk
          have hΦ₂ : AnalyticAt ℂ Φ (η₂ 0) := h0 ▸ hΦ
          have h_deriv_comp : ∀ (η : ℂ → ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ η 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ Φ (η 0) →
              iteratedDeriv (m + 1) (fun w => Φ (η w)) 0 =
                ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
                  (m.choose j : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j (fun w => deriv Φ (η w)) 0 *
                    iteratedDeriv (m - j + 1) η 0 := by
            intro η hη hΦη
            have hev : deriv (fun w => Φ (η w)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
                fun w => deriv Φ (η w) * deriv η w := by
              filter_upwards [hη.eventually_analyticAt,
                hη.continuousAt.eventually hΦη.eventually_analyticAt] with w hw_η hw_Φ
              exact deriv_comp w hw_Φ.differentiableAt hw_η.differentiableAt
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m]
            have h1_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w => deriv Φ (η w)) 0 := hΦη.deriv.fun_comp hη
            have h2_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (deriv η) 0 := hη.deriv
            rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (h_ana_cd h1_ana m) (h_ana_cd h2_ana m)]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          rw [h_deriv_comp η₁ hη₁ hΦ, h_deriv_comp η₂ hη₂ hΦ₂]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
          have hj_lt : j < M := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) hm
          have h1 := ih (deriv Φ) η₁ η₂ hη₁ hη₂ (fun r hr => heq r (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hr))
            hΦ.deriv j hj_lt
          have h2 := heq (m - j + 1) (by omega)
          rw [h1, h2]

    have h_fps_trunc_zpow : ∀ (M : ℕ) (u₁ u₂ : (PowerSeries ℂ)ˣ),
        (∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k (↑u₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) =
          PowerSeries.coeff k (↑u₂ : PowerSeries ℂ)) →
        ∀ (b : ℤ), ∀ k < M,
          PowerSeries.coeff k (↑(u₁ ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) =
            PowerSeries.coeff k (↑(u₂ ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
      intro M u₁ u₂ hu_eq
      have hmul_trunc : ∀ (f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
          (∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k f₁ = PowerSeries.coeff k f₂) →
          (∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k g₁ = PowerSeries.coeff k g₂) →
          ∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k (f₁ * g₁) = PowerSeries.coeff k (f₂ * g₂) := by
        intro f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg k hk
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rw [hf p.1 (by omega), hg p.2 (by omega)]
      have hpow_trunc : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ k < M,
          PowerSeries.coeff k ((↑u₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m) =
            PowerSeries.coeff k ((↑u₂ : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro k _; simp
        | succ m ih =>
          intro k hk
          rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
          exact hmul_trunc _ _ _ _ ih hu_eq k hk
      have hcancel_trunc : ∀ (A g₁ g₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
          PowerSeries.coeff 0 A ≠ 0 →
          (∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k (A * g₁) = PowerSeries.coeff k (A * g₂)) →
          ∀ k < M, PowerSeries.coeff k g₁ = PowerSeries.coeff k g₂ := by
        intro A g₁ g₂ hA0 hAg k
        induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
        | h k ih =>
          intro hk
          have hdiff : PowerSeries.coeff k (A * (g₁ - g₂)) = 0 := by
            rw [mul_sub, map_sub, hAg k hk, sub_self]
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul] at hdiff
          have hsingle :
              (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k,
                PowerSeries.coeff p.1 A * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 (g₁ - g₂)) =
              PowerSeries.coeff 0 A * PowerSeries.coeff k (g₁ - g₂) := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_single (0, k) ?_ ?_
            · intro p hp hp_ne
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
              have hp2_lt : p.2 < k := by
                by_cases hp1 : p.1 = 0
                · exfalso; apply hp_ne; ext <;> (simp [hp1]; try omega)
                · omega
              have h0 := ih p.2 hp2_lt (lt_trans hp2_lt hk)
              rw [map_sub, h0, sub_self, mul_zero]
            · intro hnot
              exfalso
              exact hnot (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (zero_add k))
          rw [hsingle] at hdiff
          have hc0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hdiff).resolve_left hA0
          rw [map_sub] at hc0
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc0
      intro b
      cases b with
      | ofNat m =>
        intro k hk
        change PowerSeries.coeff k (↑(u₁ ^ m) : PowerSeries ℂ) =
          PowerSeries.coeff k (↑(u₂ ^ m) : PowerSeries ℂ)
        rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
        exact hpow_trunc m k hk
      | negSucc m =>
        let A₁ : PowerSeries ℂ := (↑u₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ (m + 1)
        let A₂ : PowerSeries ℂ := (↑u₂ : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ (m + 1)
        let B₁ : PowerSeries ℂ := (↑(u₁ ^ (Int.negSucc m)) : PowerSeries ℂ)
        let B₂ : PowerSeries ℂ := (↑(u₂ ^ (Int.negSucc m)) : PowerSeries ℂ)
        have hAB₁ : A₁ * B₁ = 1 := by
          change (↑(u₁ ^ (m + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ) * B₁ = 1
          rw [← Units.val_mul]
          have hexp : u₁ ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) * u₁ ^ (Int.negSucc m) = 1 := by
            rw [← _root_.zpow_add]
            have : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + Int.negSucc m = 0 := by omega
            rw [this, zpow_zero]
          exact congr_arg Units.val hexp
        have hAB₂ : A₂ * B₂ = 1 := by
          change (↑(u₂ ^ (m + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ) * B₂ = 1
          rw [← Units.val_mul]
          have hexp : u₂ ^ (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) * u₂ ^ (Int.negSucc m) = 1 := by
            rw [← _root_.zpow_add]
            have : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + Int.negSucc m = 0 := by omega
            rw [this, zpow_zero]
          exact congr_arg Units.val hexp
        have hA₁_c0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 A₁ ≠ 0 := by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
          have hu_unit : IsUnit A₁ := u₁.isUnit.pow (m + 1)
          exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff).mp hu_unit)
        refine hcancel_trunc A₁ B₁ B₂ hA₁_c0 ?_
        intro k hk
        have h12 := hmul_trunc A₁ A₂ B₂ B₂ (hpow_trunc (m + 1)) (fun _ _ => rfl) k hk
        rw [hAB₁, h12, hAB₂]

    have h_w_unif : ∀ J : ℕ, ∃ (r_w M_w : ℝ), 0 < r_w ∧ 1 ≤ M_w ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ J →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (B.w_jet j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_w)) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w, ‖B.w_jet j z‖ ≤ M_w) ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < r_w →
            L.v_jet j z = z ^ ((1 : ℤ) - 2 * (j : ℤ)) * B.w_jet j z) := by
      intro J
      induction J with
      | zero =>
        exact ⟨1, 1, one_pos, le_rfl, fun j hj1 hj0 => by omega⟩
      | succ J ih =>
        obtain ⟨r₀, M₀, hr₀, hM₀, h₀⟩ := ih
        have hw_ana := B.w_jet_analytic (J + 1)
        obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a, h_ana_ball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hw_ana.eventually_analyticAt
        have h_cont_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : ℂ),
            ‖B.w_jet (J + 1) z - B.w_jet (J + 1) 0‖ < 1 := by
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hw_ana.continuousAt.tendsto 1 one_pos
        obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b, h_bnd_ball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_cont_ev
        have hv_ev := eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp (B.v_jet_eq (J + 1) (by omega))
        obtain ⟨r_c, hr_c, h_v_ball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hv_ev
        let r₁ : ℝ := min r₀ (min (r_a / 2) (min r_b r_c))
        let M₁ : ℝ := max M₀ (‖B.w_jet (J + 1) 0‖ + 1)
        have hr₁ : 0 < r₁ := by positivity
        have hM₁ : 1 ≤ M₁ := le_trans hM₀ (le_max_left _ _)
        refine ⟨r₁, M₁, hr₁, hM₁, ?_⟩
        intro j hj1 hj_le
        have hr₁_le_r₀ : r₁ ≤ r₀ := min_le_left _ _
        by_cases hjJ : j ≤ J
        · obtain ⟨hd, hb, hv⟩ := h₀ j hj1 hjJ
          refine ⟨hd.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)), ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro z hz
            exact le_trans (hb z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le_r₀ hz)) (le_max_left _ _)
          · intro z hz0 hzr
            exact hv z hz0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hzr hr₁_le_r₀)
        · have hj_eq : j = J + 1 := by omega
          subst hj_eq
          have hr₁_ra : 2 * r₁ ≤ r_a := by
            have : r₁ ≤ r_a / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
            linarith
          have hr₁_rb : r₁ ≤ r_b :=
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
          have hr₁_rc : r₁ ≤ r_c :=

            (by simp)
        exact h1.mul h2
      have hP_ev : (fun lam => z ^ (-b) * P₀ (v (z, z * lam))) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
          (fun lam => Φ_z (η₁ lam)) := by
        have hv_cont : ContinuousAt (fun lam : ℂ => v (z, z * lam)) 0 :=
          (hv_z_ana.fun_comp_of_eq (analyticAt_const.mul analyticAt_id) (mul_zero z)).continuousAt
        have hv0_eq : v (z, z * (0 : ℂ)) = z := by simp [hv_zero z hz_ball]
        have hv_ne0 : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ), v (z, z * lam) ≠ 0 :=
          hv_cont.eventually_ne (by rw [hv0_eq]; exact hz_ne)
        have hz_rP : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_P := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : ‖z‖ < 2 * ρ_β) hρ_le_rP
        have hv_in_rP : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ), v (z, z * lam) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_P := by
          have h0_mem : (fun lam : ℂ => v (z, z * lam)) 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_P := by
            simpa [hv_zero z hz_ball] using hz_rP
          exact hv_cont.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)
        filter_upwards [hv_ne0, hv_in_rP] with lam hv_ne hv_in
        have hP_val := hP_ball hv_in (fun h => hv_ne (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h))
        have hv_split : v (z, z * lam) = z * (1 + η₁ lam) := by
          dsimp only [η₁]
          have : z * z⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hz_ne
          calc v (z, z * lam) = z + z * z⁻¹ * (v (z, z * lam) - z) := by rw [this]; ring
            _ = z * (1 + z⁻¹ * (v (z, z * lam) - z)) := by ring
        have hv_split' : z * (1 + η₁ lam) = z + z * η₁ lam := by ring
        rw [hP_val, hv_split, mul_zpow, hv_split']
        dsimp only [Φ_z]
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hz_ne, neg_add_cancel, zpow_zero, one_mul]
      have hH_z : (fun lam => Φ_z (η₂ lam)) = (fun lam => H_J (z, lam)) := rfl
      have h_jet_eq : iteratedDeriv β (fun lam => z ^ (-b) * P₀ (v (z, z * lam))) 0 =
          iteratedDeriv β (fun lam => H_J (z, lam)) 0 := by
        rw [hP_ev.iteratedDeriv_eq β, ← hH_z]
        exact h_comp_jet (2 * J + 2) Φ_z η₁ η₂ hη₁_ana hη₂_ana hη_jets hΦ_z_ana β hβ_lt
      have hP_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => P₀ (v (z, z * lam))) 0 := by
        have hfn_ev : (fun lam => P₀ (v (z, z * lam))) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
            (fun lam => z ^ b * Φ_z (η₁ lam)) := by
          filter_upwards [hP_ev] with lam hlam
          rw [← hlam, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hz_ne, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero, one_mul]
        exact (analyticAt_const.mul (hΦ_z_ana.fun_comp hη₁_ana)).congr hfn_ev.symm
      have h_lhs_unscale : iteratedDeriv β (fun lam => z ^ (-b) * P₀ (v (z, z * lam))) 0 =
          z ^ (-b) * (z ^ β * iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0) := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul (z ^ (-b)) (h_ana_cd hP_ana β),
          h_scale_deriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) z 0, mul_zero]
      have hE_z_def : iteratedDeriv β (fun lam => H_J (z, lam)) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) = E_β z := by
        dsimp only [E_β, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
      rw [h_lhs_unscale] at h_jet_eq
      have h_div := congr_arg (fun x => z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) * (x / (β.factorial : ℂ))) h_jet_eq
      rw [hE_z_def] at h_div
      rw [← h_div]
      have h_zpow_cancel : z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) * z ^ (-b) * z ^ β = 1 := by
        rw [← zpow_natCast z β, ← zpow_add₀ hz_ne, ← zpow_add₀ hz_ne]
        have : b - (β : ℤ) + (-b) + (β : ℤ) = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, zpow_zero]
      calc iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ)
          = (z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) * z ^ (-b) * z ^ β) *
              (iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ)) := by
            rw [h_zpow_cancel, one_mul]
        _ = z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) *
              (z ^ (-b) * (z ^ β * iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0) /
                (β.factorial : ℂ)) := by
            ring

    have h_dslope_factor : ∀ (M : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
        AnalyticAt ℂ f 0 → (∀ m < M, iteratedDeriv m f 0 = 0) →
        ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ F 0 ∧
          F 0 = iteratedDeriv M f 0 / (M.factorial : ℂ) ∧
          ∀ z : ℂ, f z = z ^ M * F z := by
      intro M
      induction M with
      | zero =>
        intro f hf _
        exact ⟨f, hf, by simp, fun z => by simp⟩
      | succ M ih =>
        intro f hf hvan
        let g : ℂ → ℂ := dslope f 0
        obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hf_ball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hf.eventually_analyticAt
        have hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
          fun z hz => (hf_ball hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
          (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ))).mpr hf_diff
        have hg_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g 0 :=
          hg_diff.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ))
        have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := hvan 0 (Nat.zero_lt_succ M)
        have hfg : ∀ z : ℂ, f z = z * g z := by
          intro z
          have hds := sub_smul_dslope f 0 z
          simpa [g, hf0] using hds.symm
        have h_iter_rel : ∀ r : ℕ,
            iteratedDeriv (r + 1) f 0 = ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv r g 0 := by
          intro r
          have hid_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (r + 1) (fun w : ℂ => w) 0 := contDiffAt_id
          have hfn : f = fun z => (fun w => w) z * g z := funext hfg
          rw [hfn, iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hid_cd (h_ana_cd hg_ana (r + 1))]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 1]
          · have h1 : iteratedDeriv 1 (fun w : ℂ => w) 0 = 1 := by simp
            rw [h1, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
            ring
          · intro j _ hj1
            by_cases hj0 : j = 0
            · subst hj0; simp
            · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = k + 2 := ⟨j - 2, by omega⟩
              have hd : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
                ext w; exact deriv_id w
              rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hd, h_iter_const (k + 1) 1 0]
              simp
          · intro hnot
            exfalso
            exact hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.one_lt_succ_succ r))
        have hg_van : ∀ r < M, iteratedDeriv r g 0 = 0 := by
          intro r hr
          have hfr := hvan (r + 1) (Nat.succ_lt_succ hr)
          rw [h_iter_rel r] at hfr
          have hne : ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero r)
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hfr).resolve_left hne
        obtain ⟨F, hF_ana, hF0, hFg⟩ := ih g hg_ana hg_van
        refine ⟨F, hF_ana, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hF0, h_iter_rel M, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
          have hne : ((M + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero M)
          exact (mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne).symm
        · intro z
          rw [hfg z, hFg z, pow_succ']
          ring

    have h_s3 : ∀ (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) (b : ℤ) (u_Q : ℂ → ℂ),
        AnalyticAt ℂ u_Q 0 → u_Q 0 ≠ 0 →
        (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
          MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q = z ^ b * u_Q z) →
        ∃ (A_tilde B_tilde : Polynomial ℂ),
          B_tilde.eval 0 ≠ 0 ∧
          (↑B_tilde : PowerSeries ℂ) * (PowerSeries.C (u_Q 0) * ↑(u_fps ^ b)) = ↑A_tilde := by
      intro Q b u_Q hu_Q hc_Q hQ_ev
      set c_Q : ℂ := u_Q 0
      let P₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc s, G.W_loc s] Q
      have h_scaled := h_s2 P₀ b u_Q hu_Q hQ_ev
      let d_Q : ℕ := Q.totalDegree
      have hm_deg : ∀ m ∈ Q.support, m 0 + m 1 ≤ d_Q := by
        intro m hm
        have hle := MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hm
        have hsum : (m.sum fun _ e => e) = m 0 + m 1 := by
          rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl), Fin.sum_univ_two]
        omega
      let D_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (G.D_ZW p) ^ d_Q
      let M_Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
        ∑ m ∈ Q.support,
          Q.coeff m * (G.N_Z p) ^ (m 0) * (G.N_W p) ^ (m 1) *
            (G.D_ZW p) ^ (d_Q - (m 0 + m 1))
      let W_G : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀
      have hW_G_open : IsOpen W_G := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hD_tilde_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_tilde W_G := G.D_ZW_holo.pow d_Q
      have hM_Q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ M_Q W_G := by
        dsimp only [M_Q]
        refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun m _ => ?_
        exact (((differentiableOn_const (Q.coeff m)).mul (G.N_Z_holo.pow (m 0))).mul
          (G.N_W_holo.pow (m 1))).mul (G.D_ZW_holo.pow (d_Q - (m 0 + m 1)))
      have hM_Q_clear : ∀ (p : ℂ × ℂ) (Z W : ℂ),
          G.D_ZW p ≠ 0 → G.N_Z p / G.D_ZW p = Z → G.N_W p / G.D_ZW p = W →
          M_Q p = D_tilde p * MvPolynomial.eval ![Z, W] Q := by
        intro p Z W hD hZ hW
        have hNZ : G.N_Z p = Z * G.D_ZW p := (div_eq_iff hD).mp hZ
        have hNW : G.N_W p = W * G.D_ZW p := (div_eq_iff hD).mp hW
        rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq', Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_two]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, D_tilde]
        rw [hNZ, hNW, mul_pow, mul_pow]
        have hexp : m 0 + m 1 + (d_Q - (m 0 + m 1)) = d_Q := Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hm_deg m hm)
        calc Q.coeff m * (Z ^ m 0 * G.D_ZW p ^ m 0) * (W ^ m 1 * G.D_ZW p ^ m 1) *
                G.D_ZW p ^ (d_Q - (m 0 + m 1))
            = Q.coeff m * (Z ^ m 0 * W ^ m 1) *
                (G.D_ZW p ^ m 0 * G.D_ZW p ^ m 1 * G.D_ZW p ^ (d_Q - (m 0 + m 1))) := by ring
          _ = Q.coeff m * (Z ^ m 0 * W ^ m 1) * G.D_ZW p ^ d_Q := by
            rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, hexp]
          _ = G.D_ZW p ^ d_Q * (Q.coeff m * (Z ^ m 0 * W ^ m 1)) := by ring
      let D_slice : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun β z => iterDerivYT 0 β D_tilde (z, 0) / (β.factorial : ℂ)
      let M_slice : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun β z => iterDerivYT 0 β M_Q (z, 0) / (β.factorial : ℂ)
      have h_emb0 : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, (0 : ℂ))) :=
        differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)
      have h_maps0 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀, (z, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W_G :=
        fun z hz => ⟨hz, Metric.mem_ball_self G.δ₀_pos⟩
      have hD_slice_diff : ∀ β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_slice β) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀) :=
        fun β => ((h2d_partials.2.1 hW_G_open hD_tilde_holo 0 β).comp
          h_emb0.differentiableOn h_maps0).div_const (β.factorial : ℂ)
      have hM_slice_diff : ∀ β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_slice β) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀) :=
        fun β => ((h2d_partials.2.1 hW_G_open hM_Q_holo 0 β).comp
          h_emb0.differentiableOn h_maps0).div_const (β.factorial : ℂ)
      have hD_slice_ana : ∀ β : ℕ, AnalyticAt ℂ (D_slice β) 0 :=
        fun β => (hD_slice_diff β).analyticAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self G.δ₀_pos))
      have hM_slice_ana : ∀ β : ℕ, AnalyticAt ℂ (M_slice β) 0 :=
        fun β => (hM_slice_diff β).analyticAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self G.δ₀_pos))
      let E_fn : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun β => Classical.choose (h_scaled β)
      let ρ_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun β => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled β))
      have hE_spec : ∀ β : ℕ,
          0 < ρ_fn β ∧ ρ_fn β ≤ S.δ₁ ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (E_fn β) 0 ∧
          E_fn β 0 = c_Q * PowerSeries.coeff β (↑(u_fps ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) ∧
          ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            0 < r →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) →
            (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) →
            (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ k : ℕ,
              iteratedDeriv k (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
                if Even k then L.v_jet (k / 2) z else 0) →
            ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ρ_fn β →
              iteratedDeriv β (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) =
                z ^ (b - (β : ℤ)) * E_fn β z :=
        fun β => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled β))
      let ρ_cum : ℕ → ℝ := Nat.rec (ρ_fn 0) (fun k acc => min acc (ρ_fn (k + 1)))
      have hρ_cum_pos : ∀ β : ℕ, 0 < ρ_cum β := by
        intro β; induction β with
        | zero => exact (hE_spec 0).1
        | succ β ih => exact lt_min ih (hE_spec (β + 1)).1
      have hρ_cum_le_fn : ∀ β k : ℕ, k ≤ β → ρ_cum β ≤ ρ_fn k := by
        intro β
        induction β with
        | zero =>
          intro k hk
          rw [show k = 0 by omega]
          exact le_rfl
        | succ β ih =>
          intro k hk
          by_cases hkβ : k ≤ β
          · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (ih k hkβ)
          · have : k = β + 1 := by omega
            subst this; exact min_le_right _ _
      have hρ_cum_le_δ₁ : ∀ β : ℕ, ρ_cum β ≤ S.δ₁ :=
        fun β => le_trans (hρ_cum_le_fn β 0 (Nat.zero_le β)) (hE_spec 0).2.1
      have hM_conv : ∀ β : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ρ_cum β →
          M_slice β z = ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal β,
            D_slice p.1 z * (z ^ (b - (p.2 : ℤ)) * E_fn p.2 z) := by
        intro β z hz_pos hz_lt
        have hz_δ₁ : ‖z‖ < S.δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (hρ_cum_le_δ₁ β)
        have hz_δ₀ : ‖z‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz_δ₁ S.δ₁_le
        obtain ⟨r, v, hr, _, h2r_δ₀, hv_holo, hv_props, hv_zero, hv_jet, _⟩ :=
          L.local_lift z hz_pos hz_δ₁
        have h_emb_z : Differentiable ℂ (fun t : ℂ => (z, t)) :=
          (differentiable_const z).prodMk differentiable_id
        have h_maps_z : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r), (z, t) ∈ W_G :=
          fun t ht => ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using hz_δ₀),
            Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt h2r_δ₀) ht⟩
        have hDt_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => D_tilde (z, t)) 0 :=
          (hD_tilde_holo.comp h_emb_z.differentiableOn h_maps_z).analyticAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)))
        have hMt_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => M_Q (z, t)) 0 :=
          (hM_Q_holo.comp h_emb_z.differentiableOn h_maps_z).analyticAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)))
        have hPt_eq : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r),
            M_Q (z, t) = D_tilde (z, t) * P₀ (v (z, t)) ∧ D_tilde (z, t) ≠ 0 := by
          intro t ht
          have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < 2 * r := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp ht
          have hz_self : ‖z - z‖ < 2 * r := by simp; positivity
          obtain ⟨_, _, hD_ne, _, hZ_eq, hW_eq⟩ := hv_props z t hz_self ht_norm
          exact ⟨hM_Q_clear (z, t) (G.Z_loc (v (z, t))) (G.W_loc (v (z, t))) hD_ne hZ_eq hW_eq,
            pow_ne_zero d_Q hD_ne⟩
        have hPt_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => P₀ (v (z, t))) 0 := by
          have h_quot : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t => M_Q (z, t) / D_tilde (z, t))
              (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) :=
            ((hM_Q_holo.comp h_emb_z.differentiableOn h_maps_z).div
              (hD_tilde_holo.comp h_emb_z.differentiableOn h_maps_z)
              (fun t ht => (hPt_eq t ht).2))
          have h_ana_q := h_quot.analyticAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)))
          refine h_ana_q.congr ?_
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
            (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r))] with t ht
          obtain ⟨hm_eq, hd_ne⟩ := hPt_eq t ht
          rw [hm_eq, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hd_ne]
        have hM_ev : (fun t => M_Q (z, t)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
            (fun t => D_tilde (z, t) * P₀ (v (z, t))) := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
            (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r))] with t ht
          exact (hPt_eq t ht).1
        have h_t1 := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff β) (ht1_congr hM_ev)
        rw [ht1_mul hDt_ana hPt_ana, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, ht1_coeff] at h_t1
        have hM_sl : M_slice β z = iteratedDeriv β (fun t => M_Q (z, t)) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) := by
          dsimp only [M_slice, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
        rw [hM_sl, h_t1]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rw [ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff]
        have hD_sl : iteratedDeriv p.1 (fun t => D_tilde (z, t)) 0 / (p.1.factorial : ℂ) =
            D_slice p.1 z := by
          dsimp only [D_slice, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
        have hP_sl := (hE_spec p.2).2.2.2.2 z r v hr hv_holo hv_zero hv_jet z
          (by simp; positivity) hz_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (hρ_cum_le_fn β p.2 (by omega)))
        rw [hD_sl, hP_sl]
      have hS_D_ne : ∃ k : ℕ, ∃ β ≤ k, iteratedDeriv (k - β) (D_slice β) 0 ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h_all
        simp only [not_exists, not_and, not_ne_iff] at h_all
        have hD0_van : ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k (D_slice 0) 0 = 0 := by
          intro k
          simpa using h_all k 0 (Nat.zero_le k)
        have hD0_ev : D_slice 0 =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := h_vanish_ev (hD_slice_ana 0) hD0_van
        have hD0_nhd : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (D_slice 0) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀) :=
          (hD_slice_diff 0).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
        let z_star : ℂ := ((G.δ₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
        have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z_star‖ := by
          simp only [z_star, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (half_pos G.δ₀_pos)]
          exact half_pos G.δ₀_pos
        have hz_lt : ‖z_star‖ < G.δ₀ := by
          simp only [z_star, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (half_pos G.δ₀_pos)]

        change (↑(u_fps ^ m_plus) : PowerSeries ℂ) = (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m_plus
        exact Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val u_fps m_plus
      have h_rhs := h_eq_plus
      rw [hu_m] at h_rhs
      have h_both : ((↑B_plus : PowerSeries ℂ) * PowerSeries.C c_plus) * (V_fps ^ m_plus) =
          ((↑B_plus : PowerSeries ℂ) * PowerSeries.C c_plus) *
            ((↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ m_plus) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, h_t1, ← h_rhs, mul_assoc]
      have h_unit : IsUnit ((↑B_plus : PowerSeries ℂ) * PowerSeries.C c_plus) := by
        rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, map_mul,
          ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, Polynomial.coeff_coe,
          Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C]
        exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hB_plus_0 hc_plus)
      exact h_unit.mul_left_cancel h_both
    have hV_eq_u : V_fps = (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
      have hgeom := geom_sum₂_mul V_fps (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) m_plus
      rw [hV_pow_eq, sub_self] at hgeom
      have hsum_unit : IsUnit (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m_plus,
          V_fps ^ i * (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ (m_plus - 1 - i)) := by
        rw [PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, map_sum]
        have hsum_val : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m_plus,
            PowerSeries.constantCoeff (V_fps ^ i * (↑u_fps : PowerSeries ℂ) ^ (m_plus - 1 - i))) =
            (m_plus : ℂ) := by
          calc _ = ∑ _ ∈ Finset.range m_plus, (1 : ℂ) := by
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
                rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, hV_c0, hu_fps_c0, one_pow, one_pow, mul_one]
            _ = (m_plus : ℂ) := by simp
        rw [hsum_val]
        exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm_plus_ne
      have h0 := hsum_unit.mul_left_cancel (hgeom.trans (mul_zero _).symm)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    have hU_zpow_taylor : ∀ b : ℤ,
        holoTaylor1D (fun w => (U_germ w) ^ b) 0 = (↑(u_fps ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) :=
      fun b => ht1_zpow hU_ana hU_zero u_fps hV_eq_u.symm b
    have hU_coeff : ∀ (b : ℤ) (β : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff β (↑(u_fps ^ b) : PowerSeries ℂ) =
          iteratedDeriv β (fun w => (U_germ w) ^ b) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) := by
      intro b β
      rw [← hU_zpow_taylor b, ht1_coeff]

    have h_der_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w => U_germ w - w * deriv U_germ w) 0 :=
      hU_ana.sub (analyticAt_id.mul hU_ana.deriv)
    have h_der_0 : U_germ 0 - (0 : ℂ) * deriv U_germ 0 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hU_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero]; exact one_ne_zero
    have hU_ev_all : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ),
        AnalyticAt ℂ U_germ w ∧ U_germ w ≠ 0 ∧ U_germ w - w * deriv U_germ w ≠ 0 :=
      hU_ana.eventually_analyticAt.and
        ((hU_ana.continuousAt.eventually_ne (by rw [hU_zero]; exact one_ne_zero)).and
          (h_der_ana.continuousAt.eventually_ne h_der_0))
    obtain ⟨r_U, hr_U, hr_U_ball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU_ev_all
    have hU_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_germ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U) :=

    have hU_ne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U, U_germ w ≠ 0 :=

    have hU_der_ne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U, U_germ w - w * deriv U_germ w ≠ 0 :=
