    let revPoly : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ → Polynomial ℂ :=
      fun N P => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), Polynomial.monomial (N - k) (P.coeff k)
    have h_rev_top : ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℂ), (revPoly N P).coeff N = P.eval 0 := by
      intro N P
      simp only [revPoly, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
      · simp [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
      · intro k hk hk_ne
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
        have hne : N - k ≠ N := by omega
        simp [hne]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ N))).elim
    have h_rev_eval : ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℂ), P.natDegree ≤ N →
        ∀ w : ℂ, w ≠ 0 → (revPoly N P).eval w = w ^ N * P.eval w⁻¹ := by
      intro N P hdeg w hw
      simp only [revPoly, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_monomial]
      rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hdeg), Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
      have hkle : k ≤ N := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have hN_split : N = (N - k) + k := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hkle).symm
      conv_rhs => rw [hN_split, pow_add]
      have hwinv : w ^ k * (w⁻¹) ^ k = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hw, one_pow]
      calc P.coeff k * w ^ (N - k)
          = P.coeff k * w ^ (N - k) * (w ^ k * (w⁻¹) ^ k) := by rw [hwinv, mul_one]
        _ = (w ^ (N - k) * w ^ k) * (P.coeff k * (w⁻¹) ^ k) := by ring

    refine ⟨U_germ, r_U, hr_U, hU_ana, hU_zero, hU_diff, hU_ne, hU_der_ne, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro Q b u_Q hu_Q hc_Q hQ_ev
      obtain ⟨A_tilde, B_tilde, hB0, h_eq⟩ := h_s3 Q b u_Q hu_Q hc_Q hQ_ev
      set c_Q : ℂ := u_Q 0
      let g_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => B_tilde.eval lam * (c_Q * (U_germ lam) ^ b) - A_tilde.eval lam
      have hA_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => A_tilde.eval lam) 0 :=
        (Polynomial.differentiable A_tilde).differentiableOn.analyticAt Filter.univ_mem
      have hB_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => B_tilde.eval lam) 0 :=
        (Polynomial.differentiable B_tilde).differentiableOn.analyticAt Filter.univ_mem
      have hUb_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ b) 0 :=
        hU_ana.fun_zpow (by rw [hU_zero]; exact one_ne_zero)
      have hg_Q_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_Q 0 :=
        (hB_ana.mul (analyticAt_const.mul hUb_ana)).sub hA_ana
      have hg_Q_t1 : holoTaylor1D g_Q 0 = 0 := by
        dsimp only [g_Q]
        have hcUb_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => c_Q * (U_germ lam) ^ b) 0 :=
          analyticAt_const.mul hUb_ana
        have hBcUb_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => B_tilde.eval lam * (c_Q * (U_germ lam) ^ b)) 0 :=
          hB_ana.mul hcUb_ana
        rw [ht1_sub hBcUb_ana hA_ana, ht1_mul hB_ana hcUb_ana, ht1_poly B_tilde,
          ht1_mul (f := fun _ => c_Q) analyticAt_const hUb_ana, ht1_const c_Q, hU_zpow_taylor b,
          ht1_poly A_tilde, h_eq, sub_self]
      have hg_Q_van : ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k g_Q 0 = 0 := by
        intro k
        have hc := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff k) hg_Q_t1
        rw [ht1_coeff, map_zero] at hc
        exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc).resolve_right (h_fac_ne k)
      have hg_Q_ev : g_Q =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := h_vanish_ev hg_Q_ana hg_Q_van
      have hB_ne_ev : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ), B_tilde.eval lam ≠ 0 :=
        hB_ana.continuousAt.eventually_ne hB0
      obtain ⟨r_Q0, hr_Q0, h_ball_Q0⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hg_Q_ev.and hB_ne_ev)
      let r_Q_loc : ℝ := min r_U r_Q0
      have hr_Q_loc : 0 < r_Q_loc := lt_min hr_U hr_Q0
      let R_Q : ℝ := max (r_U⁻¹ + 1) (r_Q_loc⁻¹)
      have hR_Q_gt : r_U⁻¹ < R_Q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
      let N : ℕ := max A_tilde.natDegree B_tilde.natDegree
      let B_star : Polynomial ℂ := revPoly N B_tilde
      let A_star : Polynomial ℂ := revPoly N A_tilde
      have hB_star_ne : B_star ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hc := congr_arg (fun P : Polynomial ℂ => P.coeff N) h0
        simp only [Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
        rw [h_rev_top N B_tilde] at hc
        exact hB0 hc
      have hw_props : ∀ w : ℂ, R_Q < ‖w‖ →
          w ≠ 0 ∧ B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ ≠ 0 ∧
          B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (c_Q * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ b) = A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ := by
        intro w hw
        have hR_Q_pos : 0 < R_Q := lt_trans (inv_pos.mpr hr_U) hR_Q_gt
        have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_trans hR_Q_pos hw
        have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hw_pos
        have hwinv_lt : ‖w⁻¹‖ < r_Q_loc := by
          rw [norm_inv]
          exact inv_lt_of_inv_lt₀ hr_Q_loc (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hw)
        have hwinv_in : w⁻¹ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_Q0 :=
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by
            rw [dist_zero_right]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hwinv_lt (min_le_right _ _))
        obtain ⟨hg0, hB_ne⟩ := h_ball_Q0 hwinv_in
        exact ⟨hw_ne, hB_ne, sub_eq_zero.mp hg0⟩
      cases b with
      | ofNat k =>
        let Q_rat : Polynomial ℂ := B_star
        let P_rat : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.C c_Q⁻¹ * Polynomial.X ^ k * A_star
        refine ⟨P_rat, Q_rat, R_Q, hB_star_ne, hR_Q_gt, ?_⟩
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hw_ne, hBw_ne, hBA⟩ := hw_props w hw
        have hQ_eval : Q_rat.eval w = w ^ N * B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ :=
          h_rev_eval N B_tilde (le_max_right _ _) w hw_ne
        have hA_eval : A_star.eval w = w ^ N * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ :=
          h_rev_eval N A_tilde (le_max_left _ _) w hw_ne
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hQ_eval]
          exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero N hw_ne) hBw_ne
        · simp only [P_rat, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow,
            Polynomial.eval_X, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
          rw [hQ_eval, hA_eval, zpow_natCast, mul_pow]
          have h1 : B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ k = c_Q⁻¹ * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ := by
            have hBA' : c_Q * (B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ k) = A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ := by
              simpa [zpow_natCast, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hBA
            rw [← hBA', inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc_Q]
          calc w ^ k * U_germ w⁻¹ ^ k * (w ^ N * B_tilde.eval w⁻¹)
              = w ^ k * (w ^ N * (B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * U_germ w⁻¹ ^ k)) := by ring
            _ = w ^ k * (w ^ N * (c_Q⁻¹ * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹)) := by rw [h1]
            _ = c_Q⁻¹ * w ^ k * (w ^ N * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹) := by ring
      | negSucc k =>
        let Q_rat : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.X ^ (k + 1) * B_star
        let P_rat : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.C c_Q⁻¹ * A_star
        have hQ_rat_ne : Q_rat ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero (k + 1) Polynomial.X_ne_zero) hB_star_ne
        refine ⟨P_rat, Q_rat, R_Q, hQ_rat_ne, hR_Q_gt, ?_⟩
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hw_ne, hBw_ne, hBA⟩ := hw_props w hw
        have hQ_eval : B_star.eval w = w ^ N * B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ :=
          h_rev_eval N B_tilde (le_max_right _ _) w hw_ne
        have hA_eval : A_star.eval w = w ^ N * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ :=
          h_rev_eval N A_tilde (le_max_left _ _) w hw_ne
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [Q_rat, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, hQ_eval]
          exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero (k + 1) hw_ne) (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero N hw_ne) hBw_ne)
        · simp only [Q_rat, P_rat, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
            Polynomial.eval_C, hQ_eval, hA_eval]
          rw [mul_zpow]
          have hw_cancel : w ^ (Int.negSucc k) * w ^ (k + 1) = 1 :=
            inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero (k + 1) hw_ne)
          have h1 : B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ (Int.negSucc k) =
              c_Q⁻¹ * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ := by
            have hBA' : c_Q * (B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ (Int.negSucc k)) =
                A_tilde.eval w⁻¹ := by
              linear_combination hBA
            rw [← hBA', inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc_Q]
          calc w ^ (Int.negSucc k) * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ (Int.negSucc k) *
                (w ^ (k + 1) * (w ^ N * B_tilde.eval w⁻¹))
              = (w ^ (Int.negSucc k) * w ^ (k + 1)) *
                  (w ^ N * (B_tilde.eval w⁻¹ * (U_germ w⁻¹) ^ (Int.negSucc k))) := by ring
            _ = 1 * (w ^ N * (c_Q⁻¹ * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹)) := by rw [hw_cancel, h1]
            _ = c_Q⁻¹ * (w ^ N * A_tilde.eval w⁻¹) := by ring
    · intro P₀ b u_Q hu_Q hP₀ β
      obtain ⟨E_β, ρ_β, hρ_pos, hρ_le, hE_ana, hE0, hE_jet⟩ := h_s2 P₀ b u_Q hu_Q hP₀ β
      rw [hU_coeff b β] at hE0
      exact ⟨E_β, ρ_β, hρ_pos, hρ_le, hE_ana, hE0, hE_jet⟩

  obtain ⟨U_germ, r_U, hr_U, hU_ana, hU_zero, hU_diff, hU_ne, hU_der_ne,
    h_poly_rat, h_scaled_gen⟩ := h_parts_2_to_4

  have hu_Z_0 := S.u_Z_ball 0 (by simpa using S.δ₁_pos)
  have hu_W_0 := S.u_W_ball 0 (by simpa using S.δ₁_pos)
  have hZ_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      G.Z_loc z - S.Z₀ = z ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) * S.u_Z z := by
    rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff]
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) S.δ₁_pos] with z hz hz_ne
    have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hz_ne)
    have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < S.δ₁ := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
    rw [S.Z_expansion z hz_pos hz_lt, ← zpow_natCast z (n + 3), Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hW_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      G.W_loc z - S.W₀ = z ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) * S.u_W z := by
    rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff]
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) S.δ₁_pos] with z hz hz_ne
    have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hz_ne)
    have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < S.δ₁ := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
    exact S.W_expansion z hz_pos hz_lt
  have h_scaled_Z := h_scaled_gen (fun z => G.Z_loc z - S.Z₀) ((n : ℤ) + 3) S.u_Z hu_Z_0.1 hZ_ev
  have h_scaled_W := h_scaled_gen (fun z => G.W_loc z - S.W₀) (3 - (n : ℤ)) S.u_W hu_W_0.1 hW_ev

  
  
  
  let ξ : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => s * U_germ s⁻¹
  have h_refl_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, r_U⁻¹ + 1 < ‖w‖ →
      ((3 - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) *
        ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) =
      (((n : ℤ) + 3 : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        (ξ w) ^ (2 * (((n : ℤ) + 3) - (3 - (n : ℤ)))) *
        ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ))) *
        ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ))) := by
    have h_dir_deriv_1 : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ (σ : ℂ) {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → ∀ {z₀ t₀ : ℂ}, (z₀, t₀) ∈ W →
        deriv (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * s, t₀ + s)) 0 =
          σ * pderivA F (z₀, t₀) + pderivD F (z₀, t₀) := by
      intro W hW σ F hF z₀ t₀ hp₀
      let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (z₀, t₀)
      have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F p₀ := hF.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp₀)
      have h_line : ∀ v : ℂ × ℂ,
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => F (p₀ + s • v)) ((fderiv ℂ F p₀) v) 0 := by
        intro v
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => p₀ + s • v) v 0 := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).smul_const v).const_add p₀
        have hF_fd : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℂ F p₀) (p₀ + (0 : ℂ) • v) := by
          simpa using hF_at.hasFDerivAt
        exact hF_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℂ) hγ
      have h_fn1 : (fun s : ℂ => F (p₀ + s • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))) =
          (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + s, t₀)) := by
        ext s; congr 1; ext <;> simp [p₀]
      have hd1 : deriv (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + s, t₀)) 0 = pderivA F p₀ := by
        have := deriv_comp_const_add (fun z => F (z, t₀)) z₀ 0
        simpa [pderivA, p₀] using this
      have hf1 : (fderiv ℂ F p₀) (1, 0) = pderivA F p₀ := by
        rw [← (h_line (1, 0)).deriv, h_fn1, hd1]
      have h_fn2 : (fun s : ℂ => F (p₀ + s • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))) =
          (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀, t₀ + s)) := by
        ext s; congr 1; ext <;> simp [p₀]
      have hd2 : deriv (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀, t₀ + s)) 0 = pderivD F p₀ := by
        have := deriv_comp_const_add (fun t => F (z₀, t)) t₀ 0
        simpa [pderivD, p₀] using this
      have hf2 : (fderiv ℂ F p₀) (0, 1) = pderivD F p₀ := by
        rw [← (h_line (0, 1)).deriv, h_fn2, hd2]
      have hv_eq : (σ, (1 : ℂ)) = σ • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        ext <;> simp
      have h_fn3 : (fun s : ℂ => F (p₀ + s • (σ, (1 : ℂ)))) =
          (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * s, t₀ + s)) := by
        ext s; congr 1; ext <;> simp [p₀, mul_comm]
      rw [← h_fn3, (h_line (σ, 1)).deriv, hv_eq, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hf1, hf2]

    have h_dir_iter : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ (σ : ℂ) (β : ℕ) {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → ∀ {z₀ t₀ : ℂ}, (z₀, t₀) ∈ W →
        iteratedDeriv β (fun t : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)) 0 =
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
            (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β - m) F (z₀, t₀) := by
      intro W hW σ β
      induction β with
      | zero =>
        intro F _ z₀ t₀ _
        simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ β ih =>
        intro F hF z₀ t₀ hp₀
        let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun t => (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)
        have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
          ((differentiable_const z₀).add ((differentiable_const σ).mul differentiable_id)).prodMk
            ((differentiable_const t₀).add differentiable_id)
        have hγ0 : γ 0 = (z₀, t₀) := by simp [γ]
        have h_open_pre : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' W) := hW.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
        have h0_pre : (0 : ℂ) ∈ γ ⁻¹' W := by change γ 0 ∈ W; rwa [hγ0]
        obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball_pre⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp h_open_pre 0 h0_pre
        obtain ⟨hFA, hFD⟩ := h2d_partials.1 hW hF
        have hFA_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => pderivA F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)) 0 :=
          (hFA.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun t ht => hball_pre ht)).analyticAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hε))
        have hFD_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => pderivD F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)) 0 :=
          (hFD.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun t ht => hball_pre ht)).analyticAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hε))
        have hev_deriv : deriv (fun t : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
            fun t => σ * pderivA F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t) + pderivD F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t) := by
          filter_upwards [h_open_pre.mem_nhds h0_pre] with t ht
          have h_shift : deriv (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * s, t₀ + s)) t =
              deriv (fun u : ℂ => F ((z₀ + σ * t) + σ * u, (t₀ + t) + u)) 0 := by
            have h1 := deriv_comp_const_add (fun s : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * s, t₀ + s)) t 0
            rw [add_zero] at h1
            rw [← h1]
            congr 1
            ext u
            congr 1
            ext <;> (dsimp; ring)
          rw [h_shift]
          exact h_dir_deriv_1 hW σ hF ht
        have hσFA_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ β (fun t => σ * pderivA F (z₀ + σ * t, t₀ + t)) 0 :=
          h_ana_cd (analyticAt_const.mul hFA_ana) β
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hev_deriv.iteratedDeriv_eq β,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_add hσFA_cd (h_ana_cd hFD_ana β),
          iteratedDeriv_const_mul σ (h_ana_cd hFA_ana β),
          ih hFA hp₀, ih hFD hp₀, Finset.mul_sum]
        have h_sumA :
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
              σ * ((β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β - m) (pderivA F) (z₀, t₀))) =
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.range β,
              (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ (m + 1) * iterDerivYT (m + 1) (β - m) F (z₀, t₀)) +
              σ ^ (β + 1) * iterDerivYT (β + 1) 0 F (z₀, t₀) := by
          have h1 :
              (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
                σ * ((β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β - m) (pderivA F) (z₀, t₀))) =
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
                (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ (m + 1) * iterDerivYT (m + 1) (β - m) F (z₀, t₀) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
            rw [← (h2d_partials.2.2 hW hF m (β - m) (z₀, t₀) hp₀).1, pow_succ]
            ring
          rw [h1, Finset.sum_range_succ]
          simp
        have h_sumD :
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
              (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β - m) (pderivD F) (z₀, t₀)) =
            iterDerivYT 0 (β + 1) F (z₀, t₀) +
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range β,
                (β.choose (m + 1) : ℂ) * σ ^ (m + 1) * iterDerivYT (m + 1) (β - m) F (z₀, t₀) := by
          have h1 :
              (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
                (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β - m) (pderivD F) (z₀, t₀)) =
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
                (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ m * iterDerivYT m (β + 1 - m) F (z₀, t₀) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
            have hm_le : m ≤ β := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
            rw [← (h2d_partials.2.2 hW hF m (β - m) (z₀, t₀) hp₀).2.1]
            have hsub : β - m + 1 = β + 1 - m := by omega
            rw [hsub]
          rw [h1, Finset.sum_range_succ']
          simp [add_comm]
        rw [h_sumA, h_sumD]
        conv_rhs =>
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ]
        simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero,
          Nat.choose_self, Nat.sub_self, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub]
        have h_mid :
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.range β,
              (β.choose m : ℂ) * σ ^ (m + 1) * iterDerivYT (m + 1) (β - m) F (z₀, t₀)) +
            (∑ m ∈ Finset.range β,
              (β.choose (m + 1) : ℂ) * σ ^ (m + 1) * iterDerivYT (m + 1) (β - m) F (z₀, t₀)) =
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range β,
              ((β + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℂ) * σ ^ (k + 1) * iterDerivYT (k + 1) (β - k) F (z₀, t₀) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
          rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ β k]
          push_cast
          ring
        linear_combination h_mid

    have h_slice_iter_raw : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → ∀ (m k : ℕ) {z₀ : ℂ}, (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W →
        iteratedDeriv m (fun z => iterDerivYT 0 k F (z, 0)) z₀ = iterDerivYT m k F (z₀, 0) := by
      intro W hW F hF m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro k z₀ _; rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        intro k z₀ hz₀
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hopen_z : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W} :=
          hW.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        have hev : iteratedDeriv m (fun z' => iterDerivYT 0 k F (z', 0)) =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
            fun z => iterDerivYT m k F (z, 0) := by
          filter_upwards [hopen_z.mem_nhds hz₀] with z hz
          exact ih k hz
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (h2d_partials.2.2 hW hF m k (z₀, 0) hz₀).2.2.1

    have h_dir_taylor_coeff : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ (σ : ℂ) (β : ℕ) {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W →
        iteratedDeriv β (fun t : ℂ => F (z₀ + σ * t, t)) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) =
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (β + 1),
            (σ ^ m / (m.factorial : ℂ)) *
              iteratedDeriv m (fun z => iterDerivYT 0 (β - m) F (z, 0) /
                (((β - m).factorial : ℂ))) z₀ := by
      intro W hW σ β F hF z₀ hz₀
      have h1 := h_dir_iter hW σ β hF hz₀
      simp only [zero_add] at h1
      rw [h1, Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
      have hm_le : m ≤ β := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_div_const, h_slice_iter_raw hW hF m (β - m) hz₀]
      have hchoose : ((β.choose m : ℂ) * (m.factorial : ℂ) * (((β - m).factorial : ℂ))) =
          (β.factorial : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hm_le
      have hfm := h_fac_ne m
      have hfβ := h_fac_ne β
      have hfβm := h_fac_ne (β - m)
      field_simp
      rw [← hchoose]
      ring

    have h_pderivA_taylor_coeff : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ (β : ℕ) {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W →
        iteratedDeriv β (fun t : ℂ => pderivA F (z₀, t)) 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) =
          iteratedDeriv 1 (fun z => iterDerivYT 0 β F (z, 0) / (β.factorial : ℂ)) z₀ := by
      intro W hW β F hF z₀ hz₀
      have h1 : iteratedDeriv β (fun t : ℂ => pderivA F (z₀, t)) 0 =
          iterDerivYT 0 β (pderivA F) (z₀, 0) := by
        dsimp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
      rw [h1, ← (h2d_partials.2.2 hW hF 0 β (z₀, 0) hz₀).1]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_div_const, h_slice_iter_raw hW hF 1 β hz₀]

    let zpowFalling (a : ℤ) : ℕ → ℂ :=
      Nat.rec 1 (fun m acc => acc * ((a - (m : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ))
    have h_zpow_iter : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : ℤ) (z : ℂ), z ≠ 0 →
        iteratedDeriv m (fun w : ℂ => w ^ a) z = zpowFalling a m * z ^ (a - (m : ℤ)) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro a z _; simp [zpowFalling]
      | succ m ih =>
        intro a z hz
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv m (fun w : ℂ => w ^ a) =ᶠ[nhds z]
            fun w => zpowFalling a m * w ^ (a - (m : ℤ)) := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
          exact ih a w hw
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const_mul_field,
          (hasDerivAt_zpow (a - (m : ℤ)) z (Or.inl hz)).deriv]
        dsimp only [zpowFalling]
        have hexp : a - (m : ℤ) - 1 = a - ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [hexp]
        ring

    let jetDerivOp (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (m.choose i : ℂ) * zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) i * z ^ (m - i) *
          iteratedDeriv (m - i) (E k) z

    have h_jet_deriv_eval : ∀ {U_z : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U_z → (∀ w ∈ U_z, w ≠ 0) →
        ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k m : ℕ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (E k) U_z →
        (∀ w ∈ U_z, c k w = w ^ (D - (k : ℤ)) * E k w) →
        ∀ z ∈ U_z, iteratedDeriv m (c k) z =
          z ^ (D - ((k + m : ℕ) : ℤ)) * jetDerivOp D E k m z := by
      intro U_z hU_z h_nz D E c k m hEk hc_eq z hz
      have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := h_nz z hz
      have hev : c k =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => w ^ (D - (k : ℤ)) * E k w := by
        filter_upwards [hU_z.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact hc_eq w hw
      have hw_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ (D - (k : ℤ))) z :=
        analyticAt_id.fun_zpow hz_ne
      have hE_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (E k) z := hEk.analyticAt (hU_z.mem_nhds hz)
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq m,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (h_ana_cd hw_ana m) (h_ana_cd hE_ana m)]
      dsimp only [jetDerivOp]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
      have hi_le : i ≤ m := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
      rw [h_zpow_iter i (D - (k : ℤ)) z hz_ne]
      have hexp : z ^ (D - ((k + m : ℕ) : ℤ)) * z ^ (m - i) =
          z ^ (D - (k : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) := by
        rw [← zpow_natCast z (m - i), ← zpow_add₀ hz_ne]
        congr 1
        omega
      calc (m.choose i : ℂ) * (zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) i * z ^ (D - (k : ℤ) - (i : ℤ))) *
              iteratedDeriv (m - i) (E k) z
          = z ^ (D - (k : ℤ) - (i : ℤ)) *
              ((m.choose i : ℂ) * zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) i *
                iteratedDeriv (m - i) (E k) z) := by ring
        _ = (z ^ (D - ((k + m : ℕ) : ℤ)) * z ^ (m - i)) *
              ((m.choose i : ℂ) * zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) i *
                iteratedDeriv (m - i) (E k) z) := by rw [hexp]
        _ = z ^ (D - ((k + m : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
              ((m.choose i : ℂ) * zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) i * z ^ (m - i) *
                iteratedDeriv (m - i) (E k) z) := by ring

    have h_jet_deriv_at_zero : ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k m : ℕ),
        jetDerivOp D E k m 0 = zpowFalling (D - (k : ℤ)) m * E k 0 := by
      intro D E k m
      dsimp only [jetDerivOp]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
      · simp
      · intro i hi hi_ne
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
        have hpos : m - i ≠ 0 := by omega
        rw [zero_pow hpos, mul_zero, zero_mul]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m))).elim

    have h_jet_deriv_const_one : ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k m : ℕ),
        jetDerivOp D (fun r _ => E r 0) k m 1 = jetDerivOp D E k m 0 := by
      intro D E k m
      rw [h_jet_deriv_at_zero]
      dsimp only [jetDerivOp]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
      · simp
      · intro i hi hi_ne
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
        have hpos : m - i ≠ 0 := by omega
        rw [h_iter_const (m - i) (E k 0) 1]
        simp [hpos]
      · intro hnot
        exact (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m))).elim

    let shiftSymb (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (σ : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (σ ^ m / (m.factorial : ℂ)) * jetDerivOp D E (k - m) m z
    let diff1Symb (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      shiftSymb D E 0 k z - shiftSymb D E (-1) k z
    let diff2Symb (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      shiftSymb D E 1 k z - shiftSymb D E 0 k z
    let derSymb (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      jetDerivOp D E k 1 z
    let convSeq (P Q : ℕ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ :=
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal k, P p.1 * Q p.2
    let ReflSymb (D₁ : ℤ) (E₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (D₂ : ℤ) (E₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
      convSeq
        (convSeq (fun j => diff1Symb D₁ E₁ j z) (fun j => diff2Symb D₁ E₁ j z))
        (convSeq (fun j => derSymb D₂ E₂ j z) (fun j => derSymb D₂ E₂ j z)) k

    have h_refl_symb_const_one : ∀ (D₁ : ℤ) (E₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (D₂ : ℤ) (E₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (β : ℕ),
        ReflSymb D₁ (fun r _ => E₁ r 0) D₂ (fun r _ => E₂ r 0) β 1 =
          ReflSymb D₁ E₁ D₂ E₂ β 0 := by
      intro D₁ E₁ D₂ E₂ β
      have h_sh : ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (σ : ℂ) (j : ℕ),
          shiftSymb D (fun r _ => E r 0) σ j 1 = shiftSymb D E σ j 0 := by
        intro D E σ j
        dsimp only [shiftSymb]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        rw [h_jet_deriv_const_one]
      have hd1 : ∀ j, diff1Symb D₁ (fun r _ => E₁ r 0) j 1 = diff1Symb D₁ E₁ j 0 :=
        fun j => by dsimp only [diff1Symb]; rw [h_sh, h_sh]
      have hd2 : ∀ j, diff2Symb D₁ (fun r _ => E₁ r 0) j 1 = diff2Symb D₁ E₁ j 0 :=
        fun j => by dsimp only [diff2Symb]; rw [h_sh, h_sh]
      have hdr : ∀ j, derSymb D₂ (fun r _ => E₂ r 0) j 1 = derSymb D₂ E₂ j 0 :=
        fun j => h_jet_deriv_const_one D₂ E₂ j 1
      simp only [ReflSymb, convSeq, hd1, hd2, hdr]

    have h_refl_symb_cont : ∀ (D₁ : ℤ) (E₁ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (D₂ : ℤ) (E₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (β : ℕ),
        (∀ k ≤ β, AnalyticAt ℂ (E₁ k) 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (E₂ k) 0) →
        ContinuousAt (fun z => ReflSymb D₁ E₁ D₂ E₂ β z) 0 := by
      intro D₁ E₁ D₂ E₂ β hE_ana
      have h_cont_sum : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ i ∈ s, ContinuousAt (f i) 0) → ContinuousAt (fun z => ∑ i ∈ s, f i z) 0 := by
        intro α s f hf
        classical
        induction s using Finset.induction_on with
        | empty => simpa using (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) 0)
        | @insert a s ha ih =>
          have hfn : (fun z => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, f i z) =
              fun z => f a z + ∑ i ∈ s, f i z := by
            ext z; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
          rw [hfn]
          exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
            (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
      have h_jet_cont : ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (k m : ℕ),
          AnalyticAt ℂ (E k) 0 → ContinuousAt (fun z => jetDerivOp D E k m z) 0 := by
        intro D E k m hEk
        dsimp only [jetDerivOp]
        refine h_cont_sum _ _ fun i _ => ?_
        rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
        exact ((continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow (m - i))).mul
          (hEk.iterated_deriv (m - i)).continuousAt)
      have h_sh_cont : ∀ (D : ℤ) (E : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (σ : ℂ),
          (∀ k ≤ β, AnalyticAt ℂ (E k) 0) →
          ∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (fun z => shiftSymb D E σ k z) 0 := by
        intro D E σ hEa k hk
        dsimp only [shiftSymb]
        refine h_cont_sum _ _ fun m _ => ?_
        exact continuousAt_const.mul (h_jet_cont D E (k - m) m (hEa (k - m) (by omega)))
      have h_conv_cont : ∀ (P Q : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (P k) 0) → (∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (Q k) 0) →
          ∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (fun z => convSeq (fun j => P j z) (fun j => Q j z) k) 0 := by
        intro P Q hP hQ k hk
        dsimp only [convSeq]
        refine h_cont_sum _ _ fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        exact (hP p.1 (by omega)).mul (hQ p.2 (by omega))
      have hE1 : ∀ k ≤ β, AnalyticAt ℂ (E₁ k) 0 := fun k hk => (hE_ana k hk).1
      have hE2 : ∀ k ≤ β, AnalyticAt ℂ (E₂ k) 0 := fun k hk => (hE_ana k hk).2
      have hd1_c : ∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (fun z => diff1Symb D₁ E₁ k z) 0 :=
        fun k hk => (h_sh_cont D₁ E₁ 0 hE1 k hk).sub (h_sh_cont D₁ E₁ (-1) hE1 k hk)
      have hd2_c : ∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (fun z => diff2Symb D₁ E₁ k z) 0 :=
        fun k hk => (h_sh_cont D₁ E₁ 1 hE1 k hk).sub (h_sh_cont D₁ E₁ 0 hE1 k hk)
      have hdr_c : ∀ k ≤ β, ContinuousAt (fun z => derSymb D₂ E₂ k z) 0 :=
        fun k hk => h_jet_cont D₂ E₂ k 1 (hE2 k hk)
      exact h_conv_cont _ _ (h_conv_cont _ _ hd1_c hd2_c) (h_conv_cont _ _ hdr_c hdr_c) β le_rfl

    have h_taylor_mul_scaled : ∀ {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (A₁ A₂ : ℤ) (P₁ P₂ : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ),
        z ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ g₁ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ g₂ 0 →
        (∀ k ≤ N, iteratedDeriv k g₁ 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) = z ^ (A₁ - (k : ℤ)) * P₁ k) →
        (∀ k ≤ N, iteratedDeriv k g₂ 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) = z ^ (A₂ - (k : ℤ)) * P₂ k) →
        AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t => g₁ t * g₂ t) 0 ∧
          ∀ k ≤ N, iteratedDeriv k (fun t => g₁ t * g₂ t) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
            z ^ ((A₁ + A₂) - (k : ℤ)) * convSeq P₁ P₂ k := by
      intro g₁ g₂ z A₁ A₂ P₁ P₂ N hz hg₁ hg₂ h₁ h₂
      refine ⟨hg₁.mul hg₂, ?_⟩
      intro k hk

      dsimp only [convSeq]

    have h_univ_symbol : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)

      intro z₀ r F₁ F₂ D₁ D₂ E₁ E₂ β hr h_nz hF₁ hF₂ hD_sum hE_slices
      let U_z : Set ℂ := Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r)
      let W_loc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_z ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)
      have hU_z_open : IsOpen U_z := Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hW_loc_open : IsOpen W_loc := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hz₀_in : z₀ ∈ U_z := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
      have hp₀_in : (z₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ W_loc := ⟨hz₀_in, Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)⟩
      have hz₀_ne : z₀ ≠ 0 := h_nz z₀ hz₀_in
      have h_shift_ana_and_jet : ∀ (σ : ℂ), ‖σ‖ ≤ 1 →

            z₀ ^ (D₁ - (k : ℤ)) * shiftSymb D₁ E₁ σ k z₀ := by

          refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith)⟩
          rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul]

            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))

        dsimp only [shiftSymb]
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
        have hm_le : m ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
        have h_ev := h_jet_deriv_eval hU_z_open h_nz D₁ E₁
          (fun j w => iterDerivYT 0 j F₁ (w, 0) / (j.factorial : ℂ)) (k - m) m
          (hE_slices (k - m) (by omega)).1 (hE_slices (k - m) (by omega)).2.2.1 z₀ hz₀_in
        rw [h_ev]
        have hkm : k - m + m = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_le
        rw [hkm]
        ring
      obtain ⟨hF1_0_ana, hF1_0_jet⟩ := h_shift_ana_and_jet 0 (by simp)
      obtain ⟨hF1_m1_ana, hF1_m1_jet⟩ := h_shift_ana_and_jet (-1) (by simp)

      let g_d1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => F₁ (z₀, t) - F₁ (z₀ - t, t)
      let g_d2 : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => F₁ (z₀ + t, t) - F₁ (z₀, t)
      let g_dr : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => pderivA F₂ (z₀, t)

      have hg_d1_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_d1 0 := by

      have hg_d2_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_d2 0 := by

      have hg_d1_jet : ∀ k ≤ β,

          ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff, hF1_0_jet k hk, hF1_m1_jet k hk]
        dsimp only [diff1Symb]
        ring
      have hg_d2_jet : ∀ k ≤ β,
          iteratedDeriv k g_d2 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
            z₀ ^ (D₁ - (k : ℤ)) * diff2Symb D₁ E₁ k z₀ := by
        intro k hk
        rw [← ht1_coeff g_d2 k, hg_d2_eq, ht1_sub hF1_p1_ana hF1_0_ana, map_sub,
          ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff, hF1_p1_jet k hk, hF1_0_jet k hk]
        dsimp only [diff2Symb]
        ring
      have hg_dr_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g_dr 0 := by
        have hF₂A := (h2d_partials.1 hW_loc_open hF₂).1
        have h_emb : Differentiable ℂ (fun t : ℂ => (z₀, t)) :=
          (differentiable_const z₀).prodMk differentiable_id
        have h_maps : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r), (z₀, t) ∈ W_loc :=
          fun t ht => ⟨hz₀_in, ht⟩
        exact (hF₂A.comp h_emb.differentiableOn h_maps).analyticAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)))
      have hg_dr_jet : ∀ k ≤ β,
          iteratedDeriv k g_dr 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
            z₀ ^ ((D₂ - 1) - (k : ℤ)) * derSymb D₂ E₂ k z₀ := by
        intro k hk
        dsimp only [g_dr]
        rw [h_pderivA_taylor_coeff hW_loc_open k hF₂ hp₀_in]
        have h_ev := h_jet_deriv_eval hU_z_open h_nz D₂ E₂
          (fun j w => iterDerivYT 0 j F₂ (w, 0) / (j.factorial : ℂ)) k 1
          (hE_slices k hk).2.1 (hE_slices k hk).2.2.2 z₀ hz₀_in
        rw [h_ev]

        rw [hexp]
      obtain ⟨hg_12_ana, hg_12_jet⟩ := h_taylor_mul_scaled D₁ D₁
        (fun k => diff1Symb D₁ E₁ k z₀) (fun k => diff2Symb D₁ E₁ k z₀) β
        hz₀_ne hg_d1_ana hg_d2_ana hg_d1_jet hg_d2_jet
      obtain ⟨hg_33_ana, hg_33_jet⟩ := h_taylor_mul_scaled (D₂ - 1) (D₂ - 1)
        (fun k => derSymb D₂ E₂ k z₀) (fun k => derSymb D₂ E₂ k z₀) β

      obtain ⟨_, hg_all_jet⟩ := h_taylor_mul_scaled (D₁ + D₁) ((D₂ - 1) + (D₂ - 1))

      have h_fn_eq : (fun t =>

            (pderivA F₂ (z₀, t)) ^ 2) =

        ext t; dsimp only [g_d1, g_d2, g_dr]; ring

    set D_plus : ℤ := (n : ℤ) + 3

    have hD_sum_R : (D_minus + D_minus) + ((D_plus - 1) + (D_plus - 1)) = 10 := by
      dsimp only [D_plus, D_minus]; ring

    let Ω_U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := {p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_U * ‖p.1‖}
    have hΩ_U_open : IsOpen Ω_U :=
      (isOpen_ne.preimage continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd)
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_norm.comp continuous_fst)))
    have hΩ_U_div_mem : ∀ p ∈ Ω_U, p.2 / p.1 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_div]
      exact (div_lt_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hp.1)).mpr hp.2
    let F_mod (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ) : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p => c * p.1 ^ D * (U_germ (p.2 / p.1)) ^ D
    have hF_mod_holo : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_mod c D) Ω_U := by
      intro c D
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 ^ D) Ω_U :=
        differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.zpow (Or.inl fun p hp => hp.1)

        rw [hfn]
        exact differentiable_snd.differentiableOn.mul
          (differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.zpow (Or.inl fun p hp => hp.1))

        hU_diff.comp h_div hΩ_U_div_mem

      exact ((differentiableOn_const c).mul h1).mul h2_zpow

    let F_mod_p := F_mod c_plus D_plus
    let F_mod_m := F_mod c_minus D_minus
    let r_D : ℝ := r_U / (1 + r_U)

      (F_mod_p (1, lam) - F_mod_p (1 - lam, lam)) *
        (F_mod_p (1 + lam, lam) - F_mod_p (1, lam)) *
        (pderivA F_mod_m (1, lam)) ^ 2
    let RHS_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam =>
      (F_mod_m (1, lam) - F_mod_m (1 - lam, lam)) *
        (F_mod_m (1 + lam, lam) - F_mod_m (1, lam)) *
        (pderivA F_mod_p (1, lam)) ^ 2

    have h_maps_D_mod : ∀ (σ : ℂ), (σ = 0 ∨ σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
        ∀ lam ∈ D_mod, (1 + σ * lam, lam) ∈ Ω_U := by
      intro σ hσ lam hlam
      have hlam_lt : ‖lam‖ < r_D := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hlam
      have h1_rU : 0 < 1 + r_U := by linarith
      have hlam_mul : ‖lam‖ * (1 + r_U) < r_U := (lt_div_iff₀ h1_rU).mp hlam_lt
      have hlam_lt_1 : ‖lam‖ < 1 := by nlinarith
      have hσ_le : ‖σ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rcases hσ with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp
      have h_sub_norm : 1 - ‖lam‖ ≤ ‖1 + σ * lam‖ := by
        have htri : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖1 + σ * lam‖ + ‖-(σ * lam)‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (1 + σ * lam) (-(σ * lam))
        rw [norm_one, norm_neg, norm_mul] at htri
        have hσ_lam : ‖σ‖ * ‖lam‖ ≤ 1 * ‖lam‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ_le (norm_nonneg _)
        linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h0
        dsimp only at h0
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at h_sub_norm
        linarith
      · calc ‖lam‖ < r_U * (1 - ‖lam‖) := by linarith
          _ ≤ r_U * ‖1 + σ * lam‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sub_norm (le_of_lt hr_U)

    have h_mod_holo_pair : DifferentiableOn ℂ LHS_mod D_mod ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ RHS_mod D_mod := by
      have h_side : ∀ (c₁ : ℂ) (D₁ : ℤ) (c₂ : ℂ) (D₂ : ℤ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun lam =>
            (F_mod c₁ D₁ (1, lam) - F_mod c₁ D₁ (1 - lam, lam)) *
              (F_mod c₁ D₁ (1 + lam, lam) - F_mod c₁ D₁ (1, lam)) *
              (pderivA (F_mod c₂ D₂) (1, lam)) ^ 2) D_mod := by
        intro c₁ D₁ c₂ D₂
        have hf₁ := hF_mod_holo c₁ D₁
        have hf₂A := (h2d_partials.1 hΩ_U_open (hF_mod_holo c₂ D₂)).1
        have hm0 : Differentiable ℂ (fun lam : ℂ => ((1 : ℂ), lam)) :=
          (differentiable_const 1).prodMk differentiable_id
        have hmp : Differentiable ℂ (fun lam : ℂ => (1 + lam, lam)) :=
          ((differentiable_const 1).add differentiable_id).prodMk differentiable_id
        have hmm : Differentiable ℂ (fun lam : ℂ => (1 - lam, lam)) :=
          ((differentiable_const 1).sub differentiable_id).prodMk differentiable_id
        have h0_in : ∀ lam ∈ D_mod, ((1 : ℂ), lam) ∈ Ω_U := by

        have hp_in : ∀ lam ∈ D_mod, (1 + lam, lam) ∈ Ω_U := by

        have hm_in : ∀ lam ∈ D_mod, (1 - lam, lam) ∈ Ω_U := by
          intro lam hlam
          simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h_maps_D_mod (-1) (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)) lam hlam
        exact (((hf₁.comp hm0.differentiableOn h0_in).sub
            (hf₁.comp hmm.differentiableOn hm_in)).mul
          ((hf₁.comp hmp.differentiableOn hp_in).sub
            (hf₁.comp hm0.differentiableOn h0_in))).mul
          ((hf₂A.comp hm0.differentiableOn h0_in).pow 2)
      exact ⟨h_side c_plus D_plus c_minus D_minus, h_side c_minus D_minus c_plus D_plus⟩

    let E_Z : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k => Classical.choose (h_scaled_Z k)
    let ρ_Z : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled_Z k))
    have hEZ_spec : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ρ_Z k ∧ ρ_Z k ≤ S.δ₁ ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (E_Z k) 0 ∧
        E_Z k 0 = c_plus *
          (iteratedDeriv k (fun w => (U_germ w) ^ D_plus) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ)) ∧
        ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

          DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) →
          (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) →
          (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ j : ℕ,
            iteratedDeriv j (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (j.factorial : ℂ) =
              if Even j then L.v_jet (j / 2) z else 0) →
          ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ρ_Z k →
            iteratedDeriv k (fun t => G.Z_loc (v (z, t)) - S.Z₀) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
              z ^ (D_plus - (k : ℤ)) * E_Z k z :=
      fun k => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled_Z k))
    let E_W : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k => Classical.choose (h_scaled_W k)
    let ρ_W : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled_W k))
    have hEW_spec : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ρ_W k ∧ ρ_W k ≤ S.δ₁ ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (E_W k) 0 ∧
        E_W k 0 = c_minus *
          (iteratedDeriv k (fun w => (U_germ w) ^ D_minus) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ)) ∧
        ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ v (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) →
          (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → v (z, 0) = z) →
          (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → ∀ j : ℕ,
            iteratedDeriv j (fun t => v (z, t) - z) 0 / (j.factorial : ℂ) =
              if Even j then L.v_jet (j / 2) z else 0) →
          ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < 2 * r → 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ρ_W k →
            iteratedDeriv k (fun t => G.W_loc (v (z, t)) - S.W₀) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
              z ^ (D_minus - (k : ℤ)) * E_W k z :=
      fun k => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_scaled_W k))

    have h_unif_EW : ∀ β : ℕ, ∃ ρ_star : ℝ, 0 < ρ_star ∧ ρ_star ≤ S.δ₁ ∧
        ∀ k ≤ β, ρ_star ≤ ρ_Z k ∧ ρ_star ≤ ρ_W k ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_Z k) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_W k) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star) := by
      intro β
      induction β with
      | zero =>
        obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a, ha_ball⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hEZ_spec 0).2.2.1.eventually_analyticAt
        obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b, hb_ball⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hEW_spec 0).2.2.1.eventually_analyticAt
        let ρ₀ : ℝ := min (min (ρ_Z 0) (ρ_W 0)) (min r_a r_b)
        have hρZ0 := (hEZ_spec 0).1
        have hρW0 := (hEW_spec 0).1
        refine ⟨ρ₀, by positivity,
          le_trans (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (hEZ_spec 0).2.1, ?_⟩
        intro k hk
        rw [show k = 0 by omega]
        refine ⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
          le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _), ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz
          exact (ha_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball
            (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
            hz)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        · intro z hz
          exact (hb_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball
            (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
            hz)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      | succ β ih =>
        obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hρ₀_le, h₀⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a, ha_ball⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hEZ_spec (β + 1)).2.2.1.eventually_analyticAt
        obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b, hb_ball⟩ :=
          Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hEW_spec (β + 1)).2.2.1.eventually_analyticAt
        let ρ₁ : ℝ := min ρ₀ (min (min (ρ_Z (β + 1)) (ρ_W (β + 1))) (min r_a r_b))
        have hρZ1 := (hEZ_spec (β + 1)).1
        have hρW1 := (hEW_spec (β + 1)).1
        refine ⟨ρ₁, by positivity, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hρ₀_le, ?_⟩
        intro k hk
        by_cases hkβ : k ≤ β
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h₀ k hkβ
          have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ :=
            Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
          exact ⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1, le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h2,
            h3.mono hsub, h4.mono hsub⟩
        · rw [show k = β + 1 by omega]
          refine ⟨le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)),
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)), ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro z hz
            exact (ha_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball
              (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
              hz)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          · intro z hz
            exact (hb_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball
              (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
              hz)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    have h_mod_jets_eq : ∀ β : ℕ, iteratedDeriv β LHS_mod 0 = iteratedDeriv β RHS_mod 0 := by
      intro β
      suffices hdiv : iteratedDeriv β LHS_mod 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) =
          iteratedDeriv β RHS_mod 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) by
        exact (div_left_inj' (h_fac_ne β)).mp hdiv
      let r_mod : ℝ := min (1 / 4) (r_U / 4)
      have hr_mod : 0 < r_mod := by positivity
      have h_mod_ball_nz : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (2 * r_mod), w ≠ 0 := by
        intro w hw h0
        have hlt : ‖w - 1‖ < 2 * r_mod := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
        have hle : 2 * r_mod ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          have : r_mod ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_left _ _
          linarith
        rw [h0] at hlt
        norm_num at hlt
        linarith
      have h_mod_sub_Ω :
          Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (2 * r_mod) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_mod) ⊆ Ω_U := by
        intro p hp
        have hp1 : ‖p.1 - 1‖ < 2 * r_mod := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1
        have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_mod := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2
        have hr1 : 2 * r_mod ≤ 1 / 2 := by have : r_mod ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_left _ _; linarith
        have hr2 : 2 * r_mod ≤ r_U / 2 := by have : r_mod ≤ r_U / 4 := min_le_right _ _; linarith
        have hnorm1 : 1 / 2 < ‖p.1‖ := by
          have htri : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖p.1‖ + ‖1 - p.1‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le p.1 (1 - p.1)
          rw [norm_one, norm_sub_rev] at htri
          linarith
        exact ⟨h_mod_ball_nz p.1 hp.1, by nlinarith⟩
      have h_mod_slice : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (2 * r_mod),
            iterDerivYT 0 k (F_mod c D) (w, 0) / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
              w ^ (D - (k : ℤ)) *
                (c * (iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ))) := by
        intro c D k w hw
        have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := h_mod_ball_nz w hw
        dsimp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
        have hfn : (fun t' : ℂ => F_mod c D (w, t')) =
            fun t' : ℂ => (c * w ^ D) * (U_germ (w⁻¹ * t')) ^ D := by
          ext t'
          dsimp only [F_mod]
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm t' w⁻¹]
        have hU_sc_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun t' : ℂ => (U_germ (w⁻¹ * t')) ^ D) 0 := by
          have hUb_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) 0 :=
            hU_ana.fun_zpow (by rw [hU_zero]; exact one_ne_zero)
          exact hUb_ana.fun_comp_of_eq (analyticAt_const.mul analyticAt_id) (mul_zero w⁻¹)
        rw [hfn, iteratedDeriv_const_mul (c * w ^ D) (h_ana_cd hU_sc_ana k),
          h_scale_deriv k (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) w⁻¹ 0, mul_zero]
        have hexp : w ^ D * (w⁻¹) ^ k = w ^ (D - (k : ℤ)) := by
          rw [inv_pow, ← _root_.zpow_neg_one, ← zpow_natCast w k, ← _root_.zpow_mul,
            ← zpow_add₀ hw_ne]
          congr 1
          ring
        calc c * w ^ D * ((w⁻¹) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) 0) /
                (k.factorial : ℂ)
            = (w ^ D * (w⁻¹) ^ k) *
                (c * (iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ))) := by
              ring
          _ = w ^ (D - (k : ℤ)) *
                (c * (iteratedDeriv k (fun lam => (U_germ lam) ^ D) 0 / (k.factorial : ℂ))) := by
              rw [hexp]
      have hL_mod_eval := h_univ_symbol 1 r_mod F_mod_p F_mod_m D_plus D_minus
        (fun k _ => E_Z k 0) (fun k _ => E_W k 0) β hr_mod h_mod_ball_nz
        ((hF_mod_holo c_plus D_plus).mono h_mod_sub_Ω)
        ((hF_mod_holo c_minus D_minus).mono h_mod_sub_Ω) hD_sum_L
        (fun k _ => ⟨differentiableOn_const _, differentiableOn_const _,
          fun w hw => by rw [(hEZ_spec k).2.2.2.1]; exact h_mod_slice c_plus D_plus k w hw,
          fun w hw => by rw [(hEW_spec k).2.2.2.1]; exact h_mod_slice c_minus D_minus k w hw⟩)
      have hR_mod_eval := h_univ_symbol 1 r_mod F_mod_m F_mod_p D_minus D_plus
        (fun k _ => E_W k 0) (fun k _ => E_Z k 0) β hr_mod h_mod_ball_nz
        ((hF_mod_holo c_minus D_minus).mono h_mod_sub_Ω)
        ((hF_mod_holo c_plus D_plus).mono h_mod_sub_Ω) hD_sum_R
        (fun k _ => ⟨differentiableOn_const _, differentiableOn_const _,
          fun w hw => by rw [(hEW_spec k).2.2.2.1]; exact h_mod_slice c_minus D_minus k w hw,
          fun w hw => by rw [(hEZ_spec k).2.2.2.1]; exact h_mod_slice c_plus D_plus k w hw⟩)
      simp only [_root_.one_zpow, one_mul, h_refl_symb_const_one] at hL_mod_eval hR_mod_eval
      change iteratedDeriv β LHS_mod 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) = _ at hL_mod_eval
      change iteratedDeriv β RHS_mod 0 / (β.factorial : ℂ) = _ at hR_mod_eval
      rw [hL_mod_eval, hR_mod_eval]

      obtain ⟨ρ_star, hρ_star, hρ_star_le, hEW_unif⟩ := h_unif_EW β
      have h_symb_punc : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < ρ_star →
          ReflSymb D_plus E_Z D_minus E_W β z₀ = ReflSymb D_minus E_W D_plus E_Z β z₀ := by
        intro z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_lt
        have hz₀_ne : z₀ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hz₀_pos
        have hz₀_δ₁ : ‖z₀‖ < S.δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz₀_lt hρ_star_le
        have hz₀_δ₀ : ‖z₀‖ < G.δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz₀_δ₁ S.δ₁_le
        obtain ⟨r_L, v, hr_L, hv_ball, h2rL_δ₀, hv_holo, hv_props, hv_zero, hv_jet, _⟩ :=
          L.local_lift z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_δ₁
        obtain ⟨r_iso, hr_iso, hiso⟩ := G.iso_reflect_punc z₀ hz₀_pos hz₀_δ₀
        let r₁ : ℝ := min r_L (min (r_iso / 2) ((ρ_star - ‖z₀‖) / 4))
        have hr₁ : 0 < r₁ := by
          have : 0 < ρ_star - ‖z₀‖ := sub_pos.mpr hz₀_lt
          positivity
        have hr₁_le_rL : r₁ ≤ r_L := min_le_left _ _
        have h2r₁_lt_riso : 2 * r₁ ≤ r_iso := by
          have : r₁ ≤ r_iso / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
          linarith
        have h_sub_ρ : Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_lt : ‖w - z₀‖ < 2 * r₁ := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
          have hr_gap : 2 * r₁ ≤ (ρ_star - ‖z₀‖) / 2 := by
            have : r₁ ≤ (ρ_star - ‖z₀‖) / 4 :=
              le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
            linarith
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          have htri : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w - z₀‖ + ‖z₀‖ := by simpa using norm_add_le (w - z₀) z₀
          linarith
        have h_ball_nz : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁), w ≠ 0 := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_lt : ‖w - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw) (by linarith)
          exact norm_pos_iff.mp (hv_ball w hw_lt).1
        let W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r₁)
        have hW₁_sub_G : W₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.δ₀ := by
          intro p hp
          have hp1 : ‖p.1 - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1) (by linarith)
          have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2) (by linarith)
          exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le (hv_ball p.1 hp1).2 S.δ₁_le),
            Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_trans hp2 h2rL_δ₀)⟩
        let F_p : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => G.Z_loc (v p) - S.Z₀
        let F_m : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => G.W_loc (v p) - S.W₀
        have hD_W₁ : ∀ p ∈ W₁, G.D_ZW p ≠ 0 := by
          intro p hp
          have hp1 : ‖p.1 - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1) (by linarith)
          have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2) (by linarith)
          exact (hv_props p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2).2.2.1
        have hD_inv_W₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (G.D_ZW p)⁻¹) W₁ := by
          have hfn : (fun p => (G.D_ZW p)⁻¹) = fun p => (G.D_ZW p) ^ (-1 : ℤ) := by
            ext p; exact (_root_.zpow_neg_one (G.D_ZW p)).symm
          rw [hfn]
          exact (G.D_ZW_holo.mono hW₁_sub_G).zpow (Or.inl hD_W₁)
        have hFp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_p W₁ := by
          have h_div : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G.N_Z p / G.D_ZW p) W₁ := by
            have hfn : (fun p => G.N_Z p / G.D_ZW p) = fun p => G.N_Z p * (G.D_ZW p)⁻¹ := by
              ext p; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
            rw [hfn]
            exact (G.N_Z_holo.mono hW₁_sub_G).mul hD_inv_W₁
          have h_quot : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G.N_Z p / G.D_ZW p - S.Z₀) W₁ :=
            h_div.sub (differentiableOn_const S.Z₀)
          refine h_quot.congr fun p hp => ?_
          have hp1 : ‖p.1 - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1) (by linarith)
          have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2) (by linarith)
          dsimp only [F_p]
          rw [(hv_props p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2).2.2.2.2.1]
        have hFm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_m W₁ := by
          have h_div : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G.N_W p / G.D_ZW p) W₁ := by
            have hfn : (fun p => G.N_W p / G.D_ZW p) = fun p => G.N_W p * (G.D_ZW p)⁻¹ := by
              ext p; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
            rw [hfn]
            exact (G.N_W_holo.mono hW₁_sub_G).mul hD_inv_W₁
          have h_quot : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G.N_W p / G.D_ZW p - S.W₀) W₁ :=
            h_div.sub (differentiableOn_const S.W₀)
          refine h_quot.congr fun p hp => ?_
          have hp1 : ‖p.1 - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1) (by linarith)
          have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_L :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2) (by linarith)
          dsimp only [F_m]
          rw [(hv_props p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2).2.2.2.2.2]
        have h_slices_ZW : ∀ k ≤ β,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_Z k) (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁)) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_W k) (Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁)) ∧
            (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁),
              iterDerivYT 0 k F_p (w, 0) / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
                w ^ (D_plus - (k : ℤ)) * E_Z k w) ∧
            (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r₁),
              iterDerivYT 0 k F_m (w, 0) / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
                w ^ (D_minus - (k : ℤ)) * E_W k w) := by
          intro k hk
          obtain ⟨hρZ_k, hρW_k, hEZ_d, hEW_d⟩ := hEW_unif k hk
          refine ⟨hEZ_d.mono h_sub_ρ, hEW_d.mono h_sub_ρ, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro w hw
            have hw_rL : ‖w - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw) (by linarith)
            have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_ball_nz w hw)
            have hw_ρZ : ‖w‖ < ρ_Z k :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp (h_sub_ρ hw)) hρZ_k
            dsimp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, F_p]
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
            exact (hEZ_spec k).2.2.2.2 z₀ r_L v hr_L hv_holo hv_zero hv_jet w hw_rL hw_pos hw_ρZ
          · intro w hw
            have hw_rL : ‖w - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw) (by linarith)
            have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_ball_nz w hw)
            have hw_ρW : ‖w‖ < ρ_W k :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp (h_sub_ρ hw)) hρW_k
            dsimp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, F_m]
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
            exact (hEW_spec k).2.2.2.2 z₀ r_L v hr_L hv_holo hv_zero hv_jet w hw_rL hw_pos hw_ρW
        have h_lhs_z₀ := h_univ_symbol z₀ r₁ F_p F_m D_plus D_minus E_Z E_W β
          hr₁ h_ball_nz hFp_holo hFm_holo hD_sum_L h_slices_ZW
        have h_rhs_z₀ := h_univ_symbol z₀ r₁ F_m F_p D_minus D_plus E_W E_Z β
          hr₁ h_ball_nz hFm_holo hFp_holo hD_sum_R
          (fun k hk => ⟨(h_slices_ZW k hk).2.1, (h_slices_ZW k hk).1,
            (h_slices_ZW k hk).2.2.2, (h_slices_ZW k hk).2.2.1⟩)
        have h_refl_ev :
            (fun t => (F_p (z₀, t) - F_p (z₀ - t, t)) *
              (F_p (z₀ + t, t) - F_p (z₀, t)) * (pderivA F_m (z₀, t)) ^ 2) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
            (fun t => (F_m (z₀, t) - F_m (z₀ - t, t)) *
              (F_m (z₀ + t, t) - F_m (z₀, t)) * (pderivA F_p (z₀, t)) ^ 2) := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr₁] with t ht
          have ht_lt : ‖t‖ < r₁ := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp ht
          have ht_2rL : ‖t‖ < 2 * r_L := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lt (by linarith)
          have ht_riso : ‖t‖ < r_iso := lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lt (by linarith)
          have hz0_self_rL : ‖z₀ - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L := by simp; positivity
          have hzm_rL : ‖(z₀ - t) - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L := by simpa using ht_2rL
          have hzp_rL : ‖(z₀ + t) - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L := by simpa using ht_2rL
          have hZ0 := (hv_props z₀ t hz0_self_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.1
          have hZm := (hv_props (z₀ - t) t hzm_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.1
          have hZp := (hv_props (z₀ + t) t hzp_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.1
          have hW0 := (hv_props z₀ t hz0_self_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.2
          have hWm := (hv_props (z₀ - t) t hzm_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.2
          have hWp := (hv_props (z₀ + t) t hzp_rL ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.2
          have h_derZ : pderivA F_p (z₀, t) =
              deriv (fun z' => G.N_Z (z', t) / G.D_ZW (z', t)) z₀ := by
            have hev_z : (fun z' => F_p (z', t)) =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
                fun z' => G.N_Z (z', t) / G.D_ZW (z', t) - S.Z₀ := by
              filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r_L)] with z' hz'
              have hz'_lt : ‖z' - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz'
              dsimp only [F_p]
              rw [(hv_props z' t hz'_lt ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.1]
            dsimp only [pderivA]
            rw [hev_z.deriv_eq, deriv_sub_const]
          have h_derW : pderivA F_m (z₀, t) =
              deriv (fun z' => G.N_W (z', t) / G.D_ZW (z', t)) z₀ := by
            have hev_z : (fun z' => F_m (z', t)) =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
                fun z' => G.N_W (z', t) / G.D_ZW (z', t) - S.W₀ := by
              filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r_L)] with z' hz'
              have hz'_lt : ‖z' - z₀‖ < 2 * r_L := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz'
              dsimp only [F_m]
              rw [(hv_props z' t hz'_lt ht_2rL).2.2.2.2.2]
            dsimp only [pderivA]
            rw [hev_z.deriv_eq, deriv_sub_const]
          have hiso_eq := (hiso z₀ t (by simp; positivity) ht_riso).2.2.2
          have hdZ1 : F_p (z₀, t) - F_p (z₀ - t, t) =
              G.N_Z (z₀, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀, t) - G.N_Z (z₀ - t, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀ - t, t) := by
            dsimp only [F_p]; rw [← hZ0, ← hZm]; ring
          have hdZ2 : F_p (z₀ + t, t) - F_p (z₀, t) =
              G.N_Z (z₀ + t, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀ + t, t) - G.N_Z (z₀, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀, t) := by
            dsimp only [F_p]; rw [← hZp, ← hZ0]; ring
          have hdW1 : F_m (z₀, t) - F_m (z₀ - t, t) =
              G.N_W (z₀, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀, t) - G.N_W (z₀ - t, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀ - t, t) := by
            dsimp only [F_m]; rw [← hW0, ← hWm]; ring
          have hdW2 : F_m (z₀ + t, t) - F_m (z₀, t) =
              G.N_W (z₀ + t, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀ + t, t) - G.N_W (z₀, t) / G.D_ZW (z₀, t) := by
            dsimp only [F_m]; rw [← hWp, ← hW0]; ring
          rw [hdZ1, hdZ2, hdW1, hdW2, h_derZ, h_derW]
          exact hiso_eq
        have h_iter_eq :
            z₀ ^ ((10 : ℤ) - (β : ℤ)) * ReflSymb D_plus E_Z D_minus E_W β z₀ =
            z₀ ^ ((10 : ℤ) - (β : ℤ)) * ReflSymb D_minus E_W D_plus E_Z β z₀ := by
          rw [← h_lhs_z₀, ← h_rhs_z₀, h_refl_ev.iteratedDeriv_eq β]
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hz₀_ne) h_iter_eq

      have hev_punc :
          (fun z => ReflSymb D_plus E_Z D_minus E_W β z) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ]
          (fun z => ReflSymb D_minus E_W D_plus E_Z β z) := by
        rw [eventuallyEq_nhdsWithin_iff]
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hρ_star] with z hz hz_ne
        have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (fun h => hz_ne (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr h))
        have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < ρ_star := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
        exact h_symb_punc z hz_pos hz_lt
      have hcL := h_refl_symb_cont D_plus E_Z D_minus E_W β
        (fun k _ => ⟨(hEZ_spec k).2.2.1, (hEW_spec k).2.2.1⟩)
      have hcR := h_refl_symb_cont D_minus E_W D_plus E_Z β
        (fun k _ => ⟨(hEW_spec k).2.2.1, (hEZ_spec k).2.2.1⟩)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hcL.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
        (hcR.continuousWithinAt.tendsto.congr' hev_punc.symm)

    have h_mod_eq_on_D : ∀ lam ∈ D_mod, LHS_mod lam = RHS_mod lam := by
      let diff_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => LHS_mod lam - RHS_mod lam
      have h_diff_nhd : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ diff_mod D_mod :=
        (h_mod_holo_pair.1.sub h_mod_holo_pair.2).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h0_in : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_mod := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_D
      have h_diff_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ diff_mod 0 := h_diff_nhd 0 h0_in
      have hL_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ LHS_mod 0 :=
        (h_mod_holo_pair.1.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball) 0 h0_in
      have hR_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ RHS_mod 0 :=
        (h_mod_holo_pair.2.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball) 0 h0_in
      have h_van : ∀ k : ℕ, iteratedDeriv k diff_mod 0 = 0 := by
        intro k
        have hc := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff k) (ht1_sub hL_ana0 hR_ana0)
        change PowerSeries.coeff k (holoTaylor1D diff_mod 0) = _ at hc
        rw [ht1_coeff, map_sub, ht1_coeff, ht1_coeff, h_mod_jets_eq k, sub_self] at hc
        exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc).resolve_right (h_fac_ne k)
      have h_ev0 : diff_mod =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := h_vanish_ev h_diff_ana0 h_van
      intro lam hlam
      have h0 := h_diff_nhd.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r_D).isPreconnected h0_in h_ev0 hlam
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

    have h_pderivA_mod : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ), ∀ lam ∈ D_mod,
        pderivA (F_mod c D) (1, lam) =
          c * (D : ℂ) * (U_germ lam) ^ (D - 1) * (U_germ lam - lam * deriv U_germ lam) := by
      intro c D lam hlam
      have hlam_rU : lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U := by
        have hlt : ‖lam‖ < r_D := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hlam
        have hrD_lt : r_D < r_U := by
          dsimp only [r_D]
          exact div_lt_self hr_U (by linarith)
        exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_trans hlt hrD_lt)
      have h1_in : ((1 : ℂ), lam) ∈ Ω_U := by
        simpa using h_maps_D_mod 0 (Or.inl rfl) lam hlam
      have hopen_z : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, lam) ∈ Ω_U} :=
        hΩ_U_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z * U_germ (lam * z⁻¹)
      have hev_fn : (fun z => F_mod c D (z, lam)) =ᶠ[nhds (1 : ℂ)]
          fun z => c * (φ z) ^ D := by
        filter_upwards [hopen_z.mem_nhds h1_in] with z hz
        dsimp only [F_mod, φ]
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_zpow, ← mul_assoc]
      have hφ_1 : φ 1 = U_germ lam := by simp [φ]
      have hφ_1_ne : φ 1 ≠ 0 := by rw [hφ_1]; exact hU_ne lam hlam_rU
      have hU_der_lam : HasDerivAt U_germ (deriv U_germ lam) lam :=
        (hU_diff.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hlam_rU)).hasDerivAt
      have h_inner_der : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => lam * z⁻¹) (-lam) 1 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_inv (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℂ) ≠ 0)).const_mul lam
      have h_Ucomp_der : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => U_germ (lam * z⁻¹))
          (deriv U_germ lam * (-lam)) 1 := by
        have hU_der_1 : HasDerivAt U_germ (deriv U_germ lam) (lam * (1 : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
          simpa using hU_der_lam
        exact HasDerivAt.comp (1 : ℂ) hU_der_1 h_inner_der
      have hφ_der : HasDerivAt φ (U_germ lam - lam * deriv U_germ lam) 1 := by
        have hraw : HasDerivAt φ
            (1 * U_germ (lam * (1 : ℂ)⁻¹) + (1 : ℂ) * (deriv U_germ lam * (-lam))) 1 :=
          (hasDerivAt_id (1 : ℂ)).mul h_Ucomp_der
        have hval : 1 * U_germ (lam * (1 : ℂ)⁻¹) + (1 : ℂ) * (deriv U_germ lam * (-lam)) =
            U_germ lam - lam * deriv U_germ lam := by
          simp; ring
        exact hval ▸ hraw
      have hzpow_der : HasDerivAt (fun z => (φ z) ^ D)
          (((D : ℂ) * (φ 1) ^ (D - 1)) * (U_germ lam - lam * deriv U_germ lam)) 1 :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (1 : ℂ) (hasDerivAt_zpow D (φ 1) (Or.inl hφ_1_ne)) hφ_der
      dsimp only [pderivA]
      rw [hev_fn.deriv_eq, (hzpow_der.const_mul c).deriv, hφ_1]
      ring

    intro w hw
    have hrU_inv_pos : 0 < r_U⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hr_U
    have hw_gt_1 : 1 < ‖w‖ := by linarith
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
    let lam : ℂ := w⁻¹
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hw_ne
    have hlam_in_D : lam ∈ D_mod := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_inv]
      have hrD_inv : r_D⁻¹ = r_U⁻¹ + 1 := by
        dsimp only [r_D]
        have hrU_ne : r_U ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hr_U
        field_simp
      exact inv_lt_of_inv_lt₀ hr_D (by rwa [hrD_inv])
    have hlam_in_rU : lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U := by
      have hlt : ‖lam‖ < r_D := by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hlam_in_D
      have hrD_lt : r_D < r_U := div_lt_self hr_U (by linarith)
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using lt_trans hlt hrD_lt)
    have hwp1_ne : w + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hw_eq : w = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0
      rw [hw_eq, norm_neg, norm_one] at hw_gt_1
      linarith
    have hwm1_ne : w - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hw_eq : w = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
      rw [hw_eq, norm_one] at hw_gt_1
      linarith

    have h1_p_lam : 1 + lam = (w + 1) * lam := by
      dsimp only [lam]
      rw [add_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hw_ne, one_mul]
    have h1_m_lam : 1 - lam = (w - 1) * lam := by
      dsimp only [lam]
      rw [sub_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hw_ne, one_mul]
    have hdiv_p : lam / (1 + lam) = (w + 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [h1_p_lam]
      apply (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hwp1_ne hlam_ne)).mpr
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwp1_ne, one_mul]
    have hdiv_m : lam / (1 - lam) = (w - 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [h1_m_lam]
      apply (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hwm1_ne hlam_ne)).mpr
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwm1_ne, one_mul]
    have hU_lam : U_germ lam = lam * ξ w := by
      dsimp only [ξ, lam]
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw_ne, one_mul]
    have hFp_1 : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ), F_mod c D (1, lam) = c * lam ^ D * (ξ w) ^ D := by
      intro c D
      dsimp only [F_mod]
      rw [_root_.one_zpow, mul_one, div_one, hU_lam, mul_zpow, ← mul_assoc]
    have hF_eval_p : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ),
        F_mod c D (1 + lam, lam) = c * lam ^ D * (ξ (w + 1)) ^ D := by
      intro c D
      dsimp only [F_mod, ξ]
      rw [hdiv_p, h1_p_lam, mul_zpow (w + 1) lam D, mul_zpow (w + 1) (U_germ (w + 1)⁻¹) D]
      ring
    have hF_eval_m : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ),
        F_mod c D (1 - lam, lam) = c * lam ^ D * (ξ (w - 1)) ^ D := by
      intro c D
      dsimp only [F_mod, ξ]
      rw [hdiv_m, h1_m_lam, mul_zpow (w - 1) lam D, mul_zpow (w - 1) (U_germ (w - 1)⁻¹) D]
      ring
    set δ_U : ℂ := U_germ lam - lam * deriv U_germ lam
    have hδ_U_ne : δ_U ≠ 0 := hU_der_ne lam hlam_in_rU
    have hpA_eval : ∀ (c : ℂ) (D : ℤ),
        pderivA (F_mod c D) (1, lam) = c * (D : ℂ) * lam ^ (D - 1) * (ξ w) ^ (D - 1) * δ_U := by
      intro c D
      have h1 : pderivA (F_mod c D) (1, lam) = c * (D : ℂ) * (U_germ lam) ^ (D - 1) * δ_U :=
        h_pderivA_mod c D lam hlam_in_D
      rw [h1, hU_lam, mul_zpow]
      ring
    have hξw_ne : ξ w ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hw_ne (hU_ne lam hlam_in_rU)
    have h_side_eval : ∀ (c₁ : ℂ) (D₁ : ℤ) (c₂ : ℂ) (D₂ : ℤ),
        (D₁ + D₁) + ((D₂ - 1) + (D₂ - 1)) = 10 →
        (F_mod c₁ D₁ (1, lam) - F_mod c₁ D₁ (1 - lam, lam)) *
          (F_mod c₁ D₁ (1 + lam, lam) - F_mod c₁ D₁ (1, lam)) *
          (pderivA (F_mod c₂ D₂) (1, lam)) ^ 2 =
        (-c₁ ^ 2 * c₂ ^ 2 * lam ^ (10 : ℤ) * δ_U ^ 2) *
          ((ξ w) ^ (2 * (D₂ - 1)) * ((D₂ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
            ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ D₁ - (ξ w) ^ D₁) * ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ D₁ - (ξ w) ^ D₁))) := by
      intro c₁ D₁ c₂ D₂ hsum
      rw [hFp_1, hF_eval_m, hF_eval_p, hpA_eval]
      have hlam_pow : (lam ^ D₁ * lam ^ D₁) * (lam ^ (D₂ - 1) * lam ^ (D₂ - 1)) =
          lam ^ (10 : ℤ) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ hlam_ne, ← zpow_add₀ hlam_ne, ← zpow_add₀ hlam_ne, hsum]
      have hξ_pow : (ξ w) ^ (D₂ - 1) * (ξ w) ^ (D₂ - 1) = (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D₂ - 1)) := by
        rw [← zpow_add₀ hξw_ne]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc (c₁ * lam ^ D₁ * ξ w ^ D₁ - c₁ * lam ^ D₁ * ξ (w - 1) ^ D₁) *
              (c₁ * lam ^ D₁ * ξ (w + 1) ^ D₁ - c₁ * lam ^ D₁ * ξ w ^ D₁) *
              (c₂ * (D₂ : ℂ) * lam ^ (D₂ - 1) * ξ w ^ (D₂ - 1) * δ_U) ^ 2
          = (-c₁ ^ 2 * c₂ ^ 2 *
              ((lam ^ D₁ * lam ^ D₁) * (lam ^ (D₂ - 1) * lam ^ (D₂ - 1))) * δ_U ^ 2) *
              ((ξ w ^ (D₂ - 1) * ξ w ^ (D₂ - 1)) * ((D₂ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
                (ξ (w + 1) ^ D₁ - ξ w ^ D₁) * (ξ (w - 1) ^ D₁ - ξ w ^ D₁))) := by ring
        _ = (-c₁ ^ 2 * c₂ ^ 2 * lam ^ (10 : ℤ) * δ_U ^ 2) *
              ((ξ w) ^ (2 * (D₂ - 1)) * ((D₂ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
                ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ D₁ - (ξ w) ^ D₁) * ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ D₁ - (ξ w) ^ D₁))) := by
            rw [hlam_pow, hξ_pow]

    have h_eq_LR := h_mod_eq_on_D lam hlam_in_D
    dsimp only [LHS_mod, RHS_mod, F_mod_p, F_mod_m] at h_eq_LR
    rw [h_side_eval c_plus D_plus c_minus D_minus hD_sum_L,
      h_side_eval c_minus D_minus c_plus D_plus hD_sum_R] at h_eq_LR
    have hξ_split : (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D_plus - 1)) =
        (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D_minus - 1)) * (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D_plus - D_minus)) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hξw_ne]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hξ_split] at h_eq_LR
    let K_pre : ℂ :=
      (-c_plus ^ 2 * c_minus ^ 2 * lam ^ (10 : ℤ) * δ_U ^ 2) * (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D_minus - 1))
    have hK_ne : K_pre ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp only [K_pre]
      refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (zpow_ne_zero _ hξw_ne)
      refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (pow_ne_zero 2 hδ_U_ne)
      refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (zpow_ne_zero _ hlam_ne)
      exact mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_plus_ne)) (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_minus_ne)
    have h_factored :
        K_pre * ((D_minus : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ D_plus - (ξ w) ^ D_plus) *
          ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ D_plus - (ξ w) ^ D_plus)) =
        K_pre * ((D_plus : ℂ) ^ 2 * (ξ w) ^ (2 * (D_plus - D_minus)) *
          ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ D_minus - (ξ w) ^ D_minus) *
          ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ D_minus - (ξ w) ^ D_minus)) := by
      dsimp only [K_pre]
      linear_combination h_eq_LR
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hK_ne h_factored

  
  
  
  have hR₀_pos : 0 < r_U⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hr_U
  exact ⟨{
    ne_three := S.ne_three
    Z₀ := S.Z₀
    W₀ := S.W₀
    u_Z := S.u_Z
    u_W := S.u_W
    δ₁ := S.δ₁
    δ₁_pos := S.δ₁_pos
    δ₁_le := S.δ₁_le
    u_Z_analytic := hu_Z_0.1
    u_W_analytic := hu_W_0.1
    u_Z_ne_zero := hu_Z_0.2
    u_W_ne_zero := hu_W_0.2
    Z_expansion := S.Z_expansion
    W_expansion := S.W_expansion
    R₀ := r_U⁻¹
    R₀_pos := hR₀_pos
    U_germ := U_germ
    U_germ_analytic := hU_ana
    U_germ_zero := hU_zero
    ξ := ξ
    ξ_def := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_trans hR₀_pos hw)
      have hwinv_lt : ‖w⁻¹‖ < r_U := by
        rw [norm_inv]
        exact inv_lt_of_inv_lt₀ hr_U hw
      have hwinv_in : w⁻¹ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_U :=
        Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using hwinv_lt)
      exact ⟨rfl, mul_ne_zero hw_ne (hU_ne w⁻¹ hwinv_in)⟩
    poly_power_rational := h_poly_rat
    profile_reflection_eq := h_refl_eq
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C)
    (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ : ℝ)
    (ht₀ : |t₀| < W.r_base)
    (hhL : W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁)
    (hε_pos : 0 < ε)
    (hε_lt : ε < W.s_base)
    (hδ_pos : 0 < δ)
    (hδ_le : δ ≤ ε)
    (hPatch : HasRealWallPatch W t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ) :
    ∃ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star ∧ |t₀| + 2 * δ_star < W.r_base ∧
      ∀ t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ_star) (t₀ + δ_star),
        Irrational (t₁ / (2 * Real.pi)) →
        Nonempty (FullBandPolyData W H₁ (ε / 16) t₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B_cr⟩ := base_collar_and_cramer_data Ω C
  have ht₀_ball : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht₀
  have hX_ge : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) :=
    W.h_X_ge_two (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball
  have hL_eq_X : W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) := by
    simpa using W.h_L_eq (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball
  have hhX : W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ := by
    rw [← hL_eq_X, hhL]
  have h2s_pos : 0 < 2 * W.s_base := by
    linarith [W.s_base_pos]
  have hH₁_pos : 0 < H₁ := by
    by_contra h_not_pos
    have h_le : H₁ ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h_not_pos
    have h0 : ENNReal.ofReal H₁ = 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr h_le
    have hpos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr h2s_pos
    rw [hhX, h0] at hX_ge
    exact not_lt_of_ge hX_ge hpos
  have h2s_le_H₁ : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₁ := by
    rw [hhX] at hX_ge
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₁_pos)).mp hX_ge
  have hthr_lt : ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < ENNReal.ofReal H₁ :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₁_pos).mpr (by linarith)
  have hev_X : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (t₀ : ℂ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base),
      ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_X t :=
    W.h_X_lsc (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball (ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32))
      (show ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) by rwa [hhX])
  rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq ht₀_ball] at hev_X
  obtain ⟨r_X, hr_X_pos, hr_X_bound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_X
  have hev_L : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (t₀ : ℂ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base),
      ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_L t :=
    W.h_L_lsc (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball (ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32))
      (show ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) by rwa [hhL])
  rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq ht₀_ball] at hev_L
  obtain ⟨r_L, hr_L_pos, hr_L_bound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_L
  let δ_star : ℝ := min (δ / 2) (min ((W.r_base - |t₀|) / 4) (min r_X r_L / 4))
  have hδ_star_pos : 0 < δ_star := by
    refine lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith) ?_)
    exact div_pos (lt_min hr_X_pos hr_L_pos) (by norm_num)
  have hδ_star_le_δ : 2 * δ_star ≤ δ := by
    have h1 : δ_star ≤ δ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have hδ_star_lt_base : |t₀| + 2 * δ_star < W.r_base := by
    have h1 : δ_star ≤ (W.r_base - |t₀|) / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have h2δ_lt_rX : 2 * δ_star < r_X := by
    have h1 : δ_star ≤ min r_X r_L / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 : min r_X r_L ≤ r_X := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have h2δ_lt_rL : 2 * δ_star < r_L := by
    have h1 : δ_star ≤ min r_X r_L / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 : min r_X r_L ≤ r_L := min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  have hLSC : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
      ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_X t ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < W.h_L t := by
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hr_X_bound t (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt h2δ_lt_rX) ht),
      hr_L_bound t (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt h2δ_lt_rL) ht)⟩
  refine ⟨δ_star, hδ_star_pos, hδ_star_lt_base, ?_⟩
  intro t₁ ht₁ ht₁_irr
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ε / 16 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨cov_L⟩ := irrational_enclosing_slab_cover x₀ 0 t₁ (ε / 16) ht₁_irr hρ_pos
  obtain ⟨cov_X⟩ := irrational_enclosing_slab_cover x₀ (-t₁ / 2) t₁ (ε / 16) ht₁_irr hρ_pos
  obtain ⟨is_point, ⟨S⟩⟩ :=
    glued_sheared_slab_endpoints Ω C hDet B_cr W t₀ x₀ H₁ ε δ δ_star t₁
      hδ_star_lt_base hε_pos hε_lt h2s_le_H₁ hδ_le hδ_star_pos hδ_star_le_δ
      ht₁ hLSC hPatch cov_L cov_X
  exact sheared_slab_band_poly_clearing Ω C hDet B_cr W H₁ ε t₁
    hε_pos hε_lt h2s_le_H₁ is_point S

structure IrrShiftSlabCover (x₀ θ₀ t₁ ρ : ℝ) where
  N_slab : ℕ
  N_slab_pos : 1 ≤ N_slab
  x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  a_step : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  b_step : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  p_per : Fin N_slab → ℤ
  q_per : Fin N_slab → ℤ
  step_bounds : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, 1 ≤ a_step α ∧ 2 ≤ b_step α
  covers_period : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    ∃ α : Fin N_slab, |x - x_c α| < ρ
  back_approx : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    |(x_c α + θ₀ - (a_step α : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (p_per α : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ
  fwd_approx : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    |(x_c α + θ₀ + (b_step α : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (q_per α : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ

def bandUnshearedSlab (s_base H₁ ε x_c t₁ r₁ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_c| < ε / 16 ∧
    -s_base / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < H₁ + 3 * ε / 16 ∧
    ‖p.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < r₁ }

def bandShearedSlab (s_base H₁ ε x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ | (q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) ∈ bandUnshearedSlab s_base H₁ ε x_c t₁ r₁ }

def bandShearedBaseBox (s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ |
    |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).re - x_c| < ε / 16 ∧
    |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).im| < s_base / 2 ∧
    ‖q.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < r₁ }

noncomputable def bandBaseEndpointFn {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (is_point : Bool) (y t : ℂ) (i : Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if is_point then glancingImpact C y t i else glancingDualLine C y t i

structure ShearedSlabEndpointPkg {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (H₁ ε t₁ : ℝ) (is_point : Bool) where
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  ball_sub_base : Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base
  h_L_lower : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁, ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 16) < W.h_L t
  N_slab : ℕ
  N_slab_pos : 1 ≤ N_slab
  x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  k_span : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  j_idx : Fin N_slab → ℕ
  s_minus : Fin N_slab → ℝ
  idx_bounds : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    2 ≤ k_span α ∧ 0 < j_idx α ∧
    (if is_point then j_idx α ≤ k_span α else j_idx α < k_span α) ∧
    s_minus α + (if is_point then (j_idx α : ℝ) - 1 / 2 else (j_idx α : ℝ)) = 0
  shift_small : ∀ α : Fin N_slab,
    (|s_minus α| + (k_span α : ℝ)) * r₁ < W.s_base / 4
  covers_period : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    ∃ α : Fin N_slab, |x - x_c α| < ε / 16
  E_left : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, Fin 2 →
    MeroOn2D (bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁)
  E_right : ∀ α : Fin N_slab, Fin 2 →
    MeroOn2D (bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁)
  left_agrees_base : ∀ (α : Fin N_slab) (i : Fin 2),
    MeroAgreesHolo (E_left α i)
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point q.1 q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁ ε)
  right_agrees_base : ∀ (α : Fin N_slab) (i : Fin 2),
    MeroAgreesHolo (E_right α i)
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (q.1 + (k_span α : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base (x_c α) (s_minus α) t₁ r₁ ε)

        (B_poly.ρ_y β) (B_poly.ρ_t β) (B_poly.ρ_pos β).1 (B_poly.ρ_pos β).2.1
        (B_poly.H_exc β) (B_poly.exc_holo β) (B_poly.exc_ne_zero β)
  choose E_weier hE_weier_cnt hE_weier_slice using h_weier_all
  let E_rat : Set ℝ := Set.range (fun q : ℚ => (q : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))
  let E_bad : Set ℝ := E_rat ∪ ⋃ β : Fin B_poly.N_cov, E_weier β
  have hE_bad_cnt : E_bad.Countable :=
    (Set.countable_range _).union (Set.countable_iUnion hE_weier_cnt)
  refine ⟨E_bad, hE_bad_cnt, fun t₂ ht₂ => ?_⟩
  by_cases h_ge : ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + η) ≤ W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ)
  · exact Or.inl h_ge
  · right
    have h_lt : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) < ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + η) := lt_of_not_ge h_ge
    have ht₂_abs_sub : |t₂ - t₁| < B_poly.r₁ / 2 :=
      abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht₂.1.1], by linarith [ht₂.1.2]⟩
    have ht₂_dist : dist (t₂ : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) = |t₂ - t₁| := by
      rw [Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have ht₂_cball : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (B_poly.r₁ / 2) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, ht₂_dist]
      exact le_of_lt ht₂_abs_sub
    have ht₂_r₁_ball : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) B_poly.r₁ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, ht₂_dist]

      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht₂_ball
    have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
    have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
    have ht₂_not_rat : t₂ ∉ E_rat := fun h => ht₂.2 (Or.inl h)
    have ht₂_irr : Irrational (t₂ / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
      rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      apply ht₂_not_rat
      refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      rw [hq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h2pi_ne]

      ne_of_lt (lt_trans h_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)

    have hhL : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂ :=

    have hX_ge : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_X (t₂ : ℂ) :=
      W.h_X_ge_two (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball
    have hL_eq_X : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = W.h_X (t₂ : ℂ) := by
      simpa using W.h_L_eq (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball
    have h2s_pos : 0 < 2 * W.s_base := by linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    have hH₂_ge_enn : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H₂ := by
