    have hH₁_sub_lt : ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - η) < ENNReal.ofReal H₂ := by
      rw [← hhL]
      exact B_poly.h_L_lower (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_r₁_ball
    have hH₂_lt_H₁_add : ENNReal.ofReal H₂ < ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ + η) := by
      rw [← hhL]
      exact h_lt
    have hH₁_add_pos : 0 < H₁ + η :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (lt_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hH₂_pos) hH₂_lt_H₁_add)
    have hH₂_Icc : H₂ ∈ Set.Icc (H₁ - η) (H₁ + η) :=
      ⟨(ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₂_pos)).mp (le_of_lt hH₁_sub_lt),
       (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₁_add_pos)).mp (le_of_lt hH₂_lt_H₁_add)⟩
    have h_mod_Icc : ∀ y : ℝ,
        y - 2 * Real.pi * (⌊y / (2 * Real.pi)⌋ : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro y
      have hk_le : (⌊y / (2 * Real.pi)⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y / (2 * Real.pi) :=
        Int.floor_le (y / (2 * Real.pi))
      have hk_lt : y / (2 * Real.pi) < (⌊y / (2 * Real.pi)⌋ : ℝ) + 1 :=
        Int.lt_floor_add_one (y / (2 * Real.pi))
      have h1 : 2 * Real.pi * (⌊y / (2 * Real.pi)⌋ : ℝ) ≤ y := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk_le (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h2pi_ne] at hmul
      have h2 : y < 2 * Real.pi * ((⌊y / (2 * Real.pi)⌋ : ℝ) + 1) := by
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hk_lt h2pi_pos
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h2pi_ne] at hmul
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let E_sing : Set ℝ := { x : ℝ | ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x }
    let ι_H : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hι_inj : Function.Injective ι_H := by
      intro x₁ x₂ hx
      exact Complex.ofReal_injective (add_right_cancel hx)
    let S_zeros : Set ℂ :=
      ⋃ β : Fin B_poly.N_cov,
        { y : ℂ |
          y ∈ Metric.closedBall (B_poly.y_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_y β / 4) ∧
          (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (B_poly.τ_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_t β / 4) ∧
          B_poly.H_exc β (y, (t₂ : ℂ)) = 0 }
    have hS_zeros_fin : S_zeros.Finite := by
      refine Set.finite_iUnion (fun β => ?_)
      by_cases hβ : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (B_poly.τ_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_t β / 4)
      · have ht₂_not_w : t₂ ∉ E_weier β :=
          fun hw => ht₂.2 (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨β, hw⟩))
        exact ((hE_weier_slice β t₂ ht₂_not_w hβ).1).subset
          (fun y hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.2⟩)
      · exact Set.finite_empty.subset (fun y hy => False.elim (hβ hy.2.1))
    have hSing_sub_pre : E_sing ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ⊆ ι_H ⁻¹' S_zeros := by
      intro x ⟨hx_sing, hx_Icc⟩
      obtain ⟨β, hy_β, ht_β⟩ := B_poly.covers_band x H₂ (t₂ : ℂ) hx_Icc hH₂_Icc ht₂_cball
      have h_zero : B_poly.H_exc β (ι_H x, (t₂ : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        by_contra h_nz
        exact hx_sing
          ((punctured_graph_monodromy_dichotomy Ω C hDet W hPer hRectCont
              H₁ η t₁ t₂ H₂ B_poly β ht₂_mem ht_β hhL hH₂_ge).1 x hy_β h_nz)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨β, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy_β, ht_β, h_zero⟩
    have hFin_sing : (E_sing ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Finite :=
      (hS_zeros_fin.preimage hι_inj.injOn).subset hSing_sub_pre
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hWallObst t₂ H₂ ht₂_mem hhL
    let A_align : Set ℤ := { j : ℤ | ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂) }
    let k_fn : ℤ → ℤ := fun j => ⌊(x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂) / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let mod2pi : ℤ → ℝ := fun j => (x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂) - 2 * Real.pi * (k_fn j : ℝ)
    have h_mod2pi_inj : Function.Injective mod2pi := by
      intro j₁ j₂ h_eq
      by_contra h_ne
      have h_lin : ((j₁ : ℝ) - (j₂ : ℝ)) * t₂ =
          ((k_fn j₁ : ℝ) - (k_fn j₂ : ℝ)) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        dsimp only [mod2pi] at h_eq
        linarith
      have hdj_ne : (j₁ : ℝ) - (j₂ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← Int.cast_sub]
        exact Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne)
      apply ht₂_irr
      refine ⟨((k_fn j₁ - k_fn j₂ : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((j₁ - j₂ : ℤ) : ℚ), ?_⟩
      push_cast
      exact (div_eq_div_iff hdj_ne h2pi_ne).mpr (by linarith [h_lin])
    have hA_sub_pre : A_align ⊆ mod2pi ⁻¹' (E_sing ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
      intro j hj
      refine ⟨?_, h_mod_Icc (x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂)⟩
      intro h_reg
      have h_eq_x : mod2pi j + 2 * Real.pi * (k_fn j : ℝ) = x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂ := by
        dsimp only [mod2pi]
        ring
      have h_reg_shift : WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x₀ + (j : ℝ) * t₂) := by
        rw [← h_eq_x]
        exact (hWallPer t₂ H₂ (mod2pi j) (k_fn j)).mpr h_reg
      exact hj h_reg_shift
    have hA_fin : A_align.Finite :=
      (hFin_sing.preimage h_mod2pi_inj.injOn).subset hA_sub_pre
    let F_align : Finset ℤ := hA_fin.toFinset
    have h0_mem_A : (0 : ℤ) ∈ A_align := by
      simpa [A_align] using hx₀
    have hF_ne : F_align.Nonempty := ⟨0, hA_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr h0_mem_A⟩
    let j_min : ℤ := F_align.min' hF_ne
    let x_star : ℝ := x₀ + ((j_min - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * t₂
    let K : ℕ := F_align.sup (fun m : ℤ => (m - j_min + 1).natAbs)
    have h_unaligned : ∀ q : ℤ, (q ≤ 0 ∨ K < q.natAbs) →
        WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + (q : ℝ) * t₂) := by
      intro q hq
      by_contra h_not_reg
      let m : ℤ := j_min - 1 + q
      have hm_eq : x_star + (q : ℝ) * t₂ = x₀ + (m : ℝ) * t₂ := by
        dsimp only [x_star, m]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hm_A : m ∈ A_align := by
        change ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x₀ + (m : ℝ) * t₂)
        rwa [← hm_eq]
      have hm_F : m ∈ F_align := hA_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hm_A
      rcases hq with hq_le | hq_gt
      · have hj_le : j_min ≤ m := Finset.min'_le F_align m hm_F
        dsimp only [m] at hj_le
        omega
      · have h_sup : (m - j_min + 1).natAbs ≤ K :=
          Finset.le_sup (f := fun n : ℤ => (n - j_min + 1).natAbs) hm_F
        have h_sub : m - j_min + 1 = q := by
          dsimp only [m]
          omega
        rw [h_sub] at h_sup
        omega
    have hj_min_A : j_min ∈ A_align :=
      hA_fin.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.min'_mem F_align hF_ne)
    have h_not_reg_one : ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + t₂) := by
      have h1_eq : x_star + t₂ = x₀ + (j_min : ℝ) * t₂ := by
        dsimp only [x_star]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h1_eq]
      exact hj_min_A
    let k_shift : ℤ := ⌊(x_star + t₂) / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x_mod : ℝ := x_star + t₂ - 2 * Real.pi * (k_shift : ℝ)
    have hx_mod_Icc : x_mod ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) :=
      h_mod_Icc (x_star + t₂)
    obtain ⟨β, hy_mod_β, ht₂_β⟩ :=
      B_poly.covers_band x_mod H₂ (t₂ : ℂ) hx_mod_Icc hH₂_Icc ht₂_cball
    have ht₂_not_w : t₂ ∉ E_weier β :=
      fun hw => ht₂.2 (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨β, hw⟩))
    have hSlice : IsIsolatedGraphSlicedAt (B_poly.y_c β) (B_poly.τ_c β)
        (B_poly.ρ_y β) (B_poly.ρ_t β) (B_poly.H_exc β) t₂ :=
      hE_weier_slice β t₂ ht₂_not_w ht₂_β
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_lt, hLoop⟩ :=
      (punctured_graph_monodromy_dichotomy Ω C hDet W hPer hRectCont
          H₁ η t₁ t₂ H₂ B_poly β ht₂_mem ht₂_β hhL hH₂_ge).2
        x_star k_shift hSlice hy_mod_β h_not_reg_one
    exact ⟨{
      t₂_mem := ht₂_mem
      t₂_irr := ht₂_irr
      H₂ := H₂
      h_L_eq_H₂ := hhL
      H₂_ge := hH₂_ge
      x_star := x_star
      K := K
      unaligned_wall_reg := h_unaligned
      ρ₀ := ρ₀
      ρ₀_pos := hρ₀_pos
      ρ₀_lt := hρ₀_lt
      loop_branch_one := hLoop
    }⟩

def IsIsolatedGraphSlicedAt (y_c τ_c : ℂ) (ρ_y ρ_t : ℝ) (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (t₂ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.closedBall y_c (3 * ρ_y / 4) ∧ H (y, (t₂ : ℂ)) = 0 }).Finite ∧
  ∀ y_star ∈ Metric.ball y_c (3 * ρ_y / 4),
    ∃ (r_u r_t : ℝ) (z : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_u ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ z (Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t) ∧
      z (t₂ : ℂ) = y_star ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t,
        (z t + u, t) ∈ Metric.ball y_c ρ_y ×ˢ Metric.ball τ_c ρ_t ∧
        (u ≠ 0 → H (z t + u, t) ≠ 0)

def SeparableRectRootContProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (t_c : ℂ) (r_t : ℝ) (D : ℕ),
    a₁ < a₂ → b₁ < b₂ → 0 < r_t → 1 ≤ D →
    let R_w : Set ℂ := { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ }
    let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_w ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c r_t
    ∀ (A : Fin (D + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ d : Fin (D + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (A d) U) →
      (∀ q ∈ U,
        A (Fin.last D) q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin D, (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) →
      ((∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
          IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ U → q₀ ∈ V →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ V →
          (∀ q ∈ V, ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (g₁ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
          (∀ q ∈ V, ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (g₂ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
          g₁ q₀ = g₂ q₀ →
          ∀ q ∈ V, g₁ q = g₂ q) ∧
        (∀ (a₁' a₂' b₁' b₂' : ℝ) (w₀ z₀ : ℂ),
          a₁ < a₁' → a₁' < a₂' → a₂' < a₂ →
          b₁ < b₁' → b₁' < b₂' → b₂' < b₂ →
          a₁' < w₀.re → w₀.re < a₂' → b₁' < w₀.im → w₀.im < b₂' →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d (w₀, t_c) * z₀ ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          let R_w' : Set ℂ := { w : ℂ | a₁' < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂' ∧ b₁' < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂' }
          ∃ (δ_t : ℝ) (Λ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            0 < δ_t ∧ δ_t ≤ r_t ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ Λ (R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ_t) ∧
            Λ (w₀, t_c) = z₀ ∧
            ∀ q ∈ R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c δ_t,
              ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * (Λ q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0))

def DualLineTubePeriodicProp {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : ℤ) (i : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
    p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L →
    let shift_k : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun q => (q.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ), q.2)
    shift_k p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (shift_k p))),
      (W.L_mero i).num (shift_k p) (shift_k q) * (W.L_mero i).den p q =
        (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (shift_k p) (shift_k q)

def HasLoopBranchDefectAt {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ H₂ x_star : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2 ∧
    ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ →
      ∃ (δ_w δ_loop : ℝ) (Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_w ∧ δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < δ_loop ∧
        Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
        let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
        let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
        let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
              w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) } ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
        p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L ∧
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip) ∧
        (∃ r_att : ℝ, 0 < r_att ∧
          ∀ w t : ℂ, ‖w - w_start‖ < r_att → ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < r_att →
            (w, t) ∈ LoopStrip ∧
            ∀ ι : Fin 2,
              (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
              (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) =
                Λ_loop ι (w, t) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t)) ∧
        (∃ ι : Fin 2,
          ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
              Λ_loop ι (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι p)

  have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ_refl U_ann := by
    have h_sum : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (D + 1)),

    exact h_sum Finset.univ
  have hU_ann_open : IsOpen U_ann := by
    refine Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    · exact isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  have hA_t_preconn : IsPreconnected A_t := by
    let φ_pol : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (x.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (x.2 : ℂ))
    let S_pol : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
      Set.Ioo (Ann.t_near / 2) (3 * Ann.t_near / 2) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)
    have hS_preconn : IsPreconnected S_pol :=
      ((convex_Ioo (Ann.t_near / 2) (3 * Ann.t_near / 2)).prod convex_univ).isPreconnected
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ_pol :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd)))
    have h_img : φ_pol '' S_pol = A_t := by
      ext t
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨r, θ⟩, ⟨⟨hr1, hr2⟩, -⟩, rfl⟩
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := by linarith [Ann.t_near_pos]
        have hnorm : ‖φ_pol (r, θ)‖ = r := by
          dsimp [φ_pol]
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos,
            Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal, mul_one]
        exact ⟨by simpa only [hnorm] using hr1, by simpa only [hnorm] using hr2⟩
      · intro ⟨ht1, ht2⟩
        refine ⟨(‖t‖, t.arg), ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
        dsimp [φ_pol]
        rw [mul_comm Complex.I (t.arg : ℂ)]
        exact Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I t
    rw [← h_img]
    exact hS_preconn.image φ_pol hφ_cont.continuousOn
  have hU_ann_preconn : IsPreconnected U_ann :=
    (convex_ball (Ann.y_ann : ℂ) Ann.δ_y).isPreconnected.prod hA_t_preconn
  have hΦ_zero_ann : ∀ q ∈ U_ann, Φ_refl q = 0 :=
    hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_ann_open hU_ann_preconn
      Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr Ann.r_match_pos)
      hB_minus_sub hΦ_holo hΦ_zero_B_minus
  have hOnBPlus_Qrefl :
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((Ann.y_ann : ℂ), (Ann.t_near : ℂ)) Ann.r_match,
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) (Q_refl d) *
            (Ann.M_even ι_star q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 :=
    fun q hq => hΦ_zero_ann q (Ann.match_ball_sub hq)
  have hReflShift :
      ∀ q ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) (Q_refl d) *
            (dualLineShift C 1 ι_star q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 :=
    (Br.poly_transfer M D ι_star Q_refl).mpr
      ((Ann.poly_transfer M D ι_star Q_refl).mpr hOnBPlus_Qrefl)
  have hp_neg : (p.1, -p.2) ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx := hDom_neg p hp
  have h_at_neg := hReflShift (p.1, -p.2) hp_neg
  have h_sub_im : |(p.1 - p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det := by
    rcases hp with ⟨hp1, _, hp3⟩
    have hp3_mul : |p.2.im| * (2 * J_bound) < W.s_base := (lt_div_iff₀ h2J_pos).mp hp3
    have h4_le : 4 * |p.2.im| ≤ |p.2.im| * (2 * J_bound) := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg p.2.im]
    have hp3_quarter : |p.2.im| < W.s_base / 4 := by linarith
    have h_tri : |(p.1 - p.2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| := by
      rw [Complex.sub_im, sub_eq_add_neg]
      simpa only [abs_neg] using abs_add_le p.1.im (-p.2.im)
    linarith [W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos]
  have h_dual_neg :
      dualLineShift C 1 ι_star (p.1, -p.2) = glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star := by
    change glancingDualLine C (p.1 + ((1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (-p.2)) (-p.2) ι_star =
      glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star
    have h_arg : p.1 + ((1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (-p.2) = p.1 - p.2 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_arg]
    exact B_col.dualLine_even (p.1 - p.2) p.2 h_sub_im (hDom_t p hp) ι_star
  have h_sum_eq :
      (∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (p.1, -p.2)) (Q_refl d) *
          (dualLineShift C 1 ι_star (p.1, -p.2)) ^ (d : ℕ)) =
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) *
          (glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
    have h_eval_back :
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (p.1, -p.2)) (Q_refl d) =
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (Q d) := by
      have h1 := hEvalRefl (p.1, -p.2) hp_neg (Q d)
      simpa only [neg_neg, Prod.mk.eta] using h1.symm
    rw [h_eval_back, h_dual_neg]
  rw [← h_sum_eq]
  exact h_at_neg

loop_involution_polynomial_reflection.definitions:
noncomputable def dualLineShift {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (q : ℤ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + (q : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 ι

noncomputable def homIntersect (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, p => F 1 p - E 1 p
  | 1, p => E 0 p - F 0 p
  | 2, p => E 0 p * F 1 p - E 1 p * F 0 p

noncomputable def homRankOneDet (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  W 0 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) -
  W 1 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) +
  W 2 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p)

noncomputable def homReflectOut (E : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let T₀ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p - W 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let T₁ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p - W 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let N₀ := T₁
    let N₁ := -T₀
    let dotLN := E 0 p * N₀ + E 1 p * N₁
    let dotNN := N₀ * N₀ + N₁ * N₁
    2 * dotLN * (if ι = 0 then N₀ else N₁) - dotNN * E ι p

noncomputable def homReflectRes (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let W := homIntersect E F
    let V := homReflectOut E W
    W 2 p * V ι p - (V 0 p * W 0 p + V 1 p * W 1 p) * F ι p

def symCollarDom (s_b r_b : ℝ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }

structure BaseCollarBilliardData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  dualLine_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det → ‖t‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, glancingDualLine C y (-t) ι = glancingDualLine C y t ι
  symJet_neg_t : ∀ {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (neg_idx : Fin N_idx → Fin N_idx)
      (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, q_idx (neg_idx a) = -q_idx a) →
    ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx,
      |(p.1 + (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧
      |(p.1 - (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det) →
    ∀ v : SymJetVar N_idx M,
      symJetEnv C q_idx M (p.1, -p.2) v =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ v.2.2.2.1 *
          symJetEnv C q_idx M p (neg_idx v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2)
  primary_rank_one : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0
  primary_reflect : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0
  primary_w2_ne_zero : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_not_isotropic_line : ∀ (r : ℝ) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
    0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_step_distinct : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0 ∨
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0
  envelope_quad_factor : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
    ∃ (r_s r_env : ℝ) (s_minus s_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Q_inc : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_env ∧ r_env ≤ r_s ∧ r_s < min (hDet.s_det / 4) (hDet.r_det / 4) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_minus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_plus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
        s_minus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        s_plus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_minus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_plus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s,
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
          Q_inc s p ≠ 0 ∧
          dualLineShift C 0 0 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 0 +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 1 - 1 =
            (s - s_minus p) * (s - s_plus p) * Q_inc s p) ∧
      (∀ (B : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen B → B ⊆ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F ι) B) →
        (∀ q ∈ B,
          let W := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F
          W 2 q ≠ 0 ∧
          W 0 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 0 ∧
          W 1 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 1 ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) F ι q = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ B, ∀ ι : Fin 2, F ι q = dualLineShift C 1 ι q)

structure PuncturedGlancingBridgeData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) where
  y₀ : ℝ
  r_y : ℝ
  r_t : ℝ
  t_end : ℝ
  r_end : ℝ
  r_y_pos : 0 < r_y
  r_t_pos : 0 < r_t
  t_end_pos : 0 < t_end
  t_end_lt : t_end < 3 * r_t / 4
  r_end_pos : 0 < r_end
  bidisk_sub_dom :
    Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx
  ball_end_sub :
    Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end ⊆
      Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) (3 * r_y / 4) ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * r_t / 4 }
  D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ
  D_det_pos : ∀ ι : Fin 2, 1 ≤ D_det ι
  A_coeff : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  m_t : ℕ
  H_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  coeff_holo : ∀ ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_coeff ι d)
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_tilde
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
    H_tilde p ≠ 0
  lead_dvd : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ G_div : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G_div
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
      p.2 ^ m_t * H_tilde p = A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p * G_div p
  separable_punc : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t \ {0}),
      A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_coeff ι d.succ p * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  M₁_end : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M₁_end_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁_end ι) (Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end)
  M₁_end_solves : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * (M₁_end ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  M₁_ne_primary : ∃ ι_def : Fin 2, ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    M₁_end ι_def p ≠ dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p
  fwd_rank_one :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end) p = 0
  fwd_reflect :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end ι p = 0
  rev_w2_zero :
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  rev_iso_line : ∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  rev_prev_eq :
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  poly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (dualLineShift C 1 ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0)

structure CompactAnnulusEvenData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx) where
  y_ann : ℝ
  δ_y : ℝ
  t_near : ℝ
  r_match : ℝ
  δ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y
  t_near_pos : 0 < t_near
  r_match_pos : 0 < r_match
  ann_sub_dom :
    Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
      { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 } ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx
  match_ball_sub :
    Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match ⊆
      Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 }
  M_even : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M_even_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_even ι)
      (Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 })
  M_even_symm : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 },
      M_even ι (p.1, -p.2) = M_even ι p

and_nodes.definitions_block:
noncomputable def dualLineShift {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (q : ℤ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + (q : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 ι

noncomputable def homIntersect (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  | 0, p => F 1 p - E 1 p
  | 1, p => E 0 p - F 0 p
  | 2, p => E 0 p * F 1 p - E 1 p * F 0 p

noncomputable def homRankOneDet (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  W 0 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) -
  W 1 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 2) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p) +
  W 2 p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 1) p -
    iterDerivYT 0 1 (W 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p)

noncomputable def homReflectOut (E : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (W : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let T₀ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 0) p - W 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let T₁ := W 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 1) p - W 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W 2) p
    let N₀ := T₁
    let N₁ := -T₀
    let dotLN := E 0 p * N₀ + E 1 p * N₁
    let dotNN := N₀ * N₀ + N₁ * N₁
    2 * dotLN * (if ι = 0 then N₀ else N₁) - dotNN * E ι p

noncomputable def homReflectRes (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let W := homIntersect E F
    let V := homReflectOut E W
    W 2 p * V ι p - (V 0 p * W 0 p + V 1 p * W 1 p) * F ι p

def symCollarDom (s_b r_b : ℝ) {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  let J_bound : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound) }

structure BaseCollarBilliardData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  dualLine_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det → ‖t‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, glancingDualLine C y (-t) ι = glancingDualLine C y t ι
  symJet_neg_t : ∀ {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (neg_idx : Fin N_idx → Fin N_idx)
      (M : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx, q_idx (neg_idx a) = -q_idx a) →
    ‖p.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det →
    (∀ a : Fin N_idx,
      |(p.1 + (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧
      |(p.1 - (q_idx a : ℂ) * p.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det) →
    ∀ v : SymJetVar N_idx M,
      symJetEnv C q_idx M (p.1, -p.2) v =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ v.2.2.2.1 *
          symJetEnv C q_idx M p (neg_idx v.1, v.2.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2)
  primary_rank_one : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0
  primary_reflect : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
    ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0
  primary_w2_ne_zero : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_not_isotropic_line : ∀ (r : ℝ) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
    0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p ≠ 0
  primary_step_distinct : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) →
    ∃ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < r ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r ∧ p.2.im = 0 ∧
      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)
      let W₀ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
      W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0 ∨
      W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p ≠ 0
  envelope_quad_factor : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
    ∃ (r_s r_env : ℝ) (s_minus s_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Q_inc : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_env ∧ r_env ≤ r_s ∧ r_s < min (hDet.s_det / 4) (hDet.r_det / 4) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_minus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_plus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
        s_minus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        s_plus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_minus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_plus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s,
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
          Q_inc s p ≠ 0 ∧
          dualLineShift C 0 0 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 0 +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 1 - 1 =
            (s - s_minus p) * (s - s_plus p) * Q_inc s p) ∧
      (∀ (B : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen B → B ⊆ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F ι) B) →
        (∀ q ∈ B,
          let W := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F
          W 2 q ≠ 0 ∧
          W 0 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 0 ∧
          W 1 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 1 ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) F ι q = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ B, ∀ ι : Fin 2, F ι q = dualLineShift C 1 ι q)

structure PuncturedGlancingBridgeData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) where
  y₀ : ℝ

  r_t : ℝ
  t_end : ℝ
  r_end : ℝ

  r_t_pos : 0 < r_t
  t_end_pos : 0 < t_end
  t_end_lt : t_end < 3 * r_t / 4
  r_end_pos : 0 < r_end
  bidisk_sub_dom :
    Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx
  ball_end_sub :
    Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end ⊆
      Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) (3 * r_y / 4) ×ˢ
        { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * r_t / 4 }
  D_det : Fin 2 → ℕ
  D_det_pos : ∀ ι : Fin 2, 1 ≤ D_det ι
  A_coeff : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  m_t : ℕ
  H_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  coeff_holo : ∀ ι d,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_coeff ι d)
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ H_tilde
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
  H_tilde_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
    H_tilde p ≠ 0
  lead_dvd : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ G_div : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ G_div
      (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
      p.2 ^ m_t * H_tilde p = A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p * G_div p
  separable_punc : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t \ {0}),
      A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) p ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z : ℂ,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
        ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι),
          (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_coeff ι d.succ p * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0
  M₁_end : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M₁_end_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁_end ι) (Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end)
  M₁_end_solves : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * (M₁_end ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  M₁_ne_primary : ∃ ι_def : Fin 2, ∃ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
    M₁_end ι_def p ≠ dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p
  fwd_rank_one :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1)) p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end) p = 0
  fwd_reflect :
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det →
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) ι p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end ι p = 0
  rev_w2_zero :
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 2 p = 0
  rev_iso_line : ∀ s_iso c_star : ℂ,
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y₀ : ℂ), (t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 1 p -
        c_star * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end 2 p = 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 0 p +
        s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C 1) 1 p -

  rev_prev_eq :

      let W₁ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) M₁_end

      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,

              = ‖deriv γ θ * (2 * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 3)‖ * ‖π₁‖ := norm_smul _ _
            _ ≤ ‖deriv γ θ * (2 * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 3)‖ * 1 := by gcongr
            _ = 2 * r * (2 * ‖(γ θ - p.1)⁻¹‖ ^ 3) := by
                rw [mul_one, norm_mul, norm_mul, hγ_deriv_norm θ, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_pow]
            _ ≤ 2 * r * (2 * (r⁻¹ ^ 3)) := by gcongr
        have hd'_le : ‖d' p θ‖ ≤ M / r := by
          dsimp only [d']
          calc ‖deriv (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) p.2 • π₂‖
              = ‖deriv (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) p.2‖ * ‖π₂‖ := norm_smul _ _
            _ ≤ (M / r) * 1 := by
                gcongr; exact hderivD_bnd (γ θ) (hγ_mem θ) p.2 (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hp2)
            _ = M / r := mul_one _
        calc ‖F' p θ‖
            ≤ ‖c_fn p θ • d' p θ‖ + ‖d_fn p θ • c' p θ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖c_fn p θ‖ * ‖d' p θ‖ + ‖d_fn p θ‖ * ‖c' p θ‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul (c_fn p θ) (d' p θ), norm_smul (d_fn p θ) (c' p θ)]
          _ ≤ B_const := by
              dsimp only [B_const]
              have : 0 ≤ M / r := div_nonneg hM_nonneg (le_of_lt hr)
              gcongr
      have t0 := hparam_int_holo p₀ r B_const hr (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ (pderivA f) F_int F'
      exact t0 hF_rep hF_cont hF'₀_meas hF'_bnd hF_fderiv
    have hpderiv_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf
      refine ⟨hPartialA hU hf, ?_⟩
      let τ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℂ ℂ ℂ
      have hfτ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f ∘ τ) (τ ⁻¹' U) :=
        hf.comp τ.differentiable.differentiableOn (Set.mapsTo_preimage τ U)
      have hpAτ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA (f ∘ τ)) (τ ⁻¹' U) :=
        hPartialA (hU.preimage τ.continuous) hfτ
      exact hpAτ.comp τ.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun p hp => by simpa [τ] using hp)
    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ q ∈ U,
        HasFDerivAt g (π₁.smulRight (pderivA g q) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD g q)) q := by
      intro U hU g hg q hq
      have hL : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q := (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hinj1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) (1, 0) q.1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
      have hinj2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) (0, 1) q.2 :=
        (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
      have hpA_eq : pderivA g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0) :=
        (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) q.1 hL hinj1).deriv
      have hpD_eq : pderivD g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1) :=
        (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) q.2 hL hinj2).deriv
      refine hL.congr_fderiv ?_
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨u, v⟩ => ?_
      have huv : (u, v) = u • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by simp
      conv_lhs => rw [huv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
      simp [π₁, π₂, hpA_eq, hpD_eq, smul_eq_mul]
    have hpderiv_comm : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (pderivD f) p = pderivD (pderivA f) p := by
      intro U hU f hf p hp
      obtain ⟨hfA, hfD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hf
      let f' : ℂ × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun q => π₁.smulRight (pderivA f q) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD f q)
      have hf'_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p, HasFDerivAt f (f' q) q := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hp] with q hq; exact hfderiv_decomp hU hf q hq
      let S₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁
      let S₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂
      let L_A : ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        π₁.smulRight (pderivA (pderivA f) p) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD (pderivA f) p)
      let L_D : ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        π₁.smulRight (pderivA (pderivD f) p) + π₂.smulRight (pderivD (pderivD f) p)
      have hf'' : HasFDerivAt f' (S₁.comp L_A + S₂.comp L_D) p :=
        (S₁.hasFDerivAt.comp p (hfderiv_decomp hU hfA p hp)).add
          (S₂.hasFDerivAt.comp p (hfderiv_decomp hU hfD p hp))
      simpa [S₁, S₂, L_A, L_D, π₁, π₂] using
        second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually hf'_ev hf'' ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))
    have hiter1D_congr : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ z ∈ V, g₁ z = g₂ z) → ∀ (β : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ V,
        ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₁) z = ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₂) z := by
      intro V hV g₁ g₂ hfg β
      induction β with
      | zero => intro z hz; exact hfg z hz
      | succ β ih =>
        intro z hz
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
        filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hz] with w hw; exact ih w hw
    have hiterY_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U, iterDerivY α f₁ p = iterDerivY α f₂ p := by
      intro U hU f₁ f₂ hff α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro p hp; exact hff p hp
      | succ α ih =>
        intro p hp
        simp only [iterDerivY]
        refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
        filter_upwards [(hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hp] with y' hy'
        exact ih (y', p.2) hy'
    have htaylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f₁ f₂ hff
      ext d; simp only [taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]; congr 1
      exact hiter1D_congr (hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
        (fun t' ht' => hiterY_congr hU hff (d 0) (p₀.1, t') ht') (d 1) p₀.2 hp₀
    have hiterY_stepA : ∀ (α : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), iterDerivY (α + 1) f = iterDerivY α (pderivA f) := by
      intro α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro f; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        intro f; ext p
        change pderivA (iterDerivY (α + 1) f) p = pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivA f)) p
        rw [ih f]
    have hstep1_uncond : ∀ (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p :=
      fun α β f p => by simp only [iterDerivYT, hiterY_stepA α f]
    have hstep4_uncond : ∀ (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p :=
      fun α β f p => by simp only [pderivD, iterDerivYT, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    have hiterY_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivY α f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => exact hf
      | succ α ih => exact (hpderiv_holo hU ih).1
    have hiterYT_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf α β
      induction β with
      | zero => exact hiterY_holo hU hf α
      | succ β ih =>
        have h_eq : iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f = pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) := by
          ext p; exact (hstep4_uncond α β f p).symm
        rw [h_eq]; exact (hpderiv_holo hU ih).2
    have hiterY_commD : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ q ∈ U,
        iterDerivY α (pderivD f) q = pderivD (iterDerivY α f) q := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro q _; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        intro q hq
        change pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) q = pderivD (pderivA (iterDerivY α f)) q
        have hcongrA : pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) q = pderivA (pderivD (iterDerivY α f)) q := by
          refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
          filter_upwards [(hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq] with z hz
          exact ih (z, q.2) hz
        rw [hcongrA]; exact hpderiv_comm hU (hiterY_holo hU hf α) q hq
    have hiterYT_step : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
          iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p ∧
          pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p ∧
          pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) p = iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p := by
      intro U hU f hf α β p hp
      refine ⟨hstep1_uncond α β f p, ?_, ?_, hstep4_uncond α β f p⟩
      · have hcongr := hiter1D_congr (hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))

        dsimp only [iterDerivYT] at hcongr ⊢
        rw [hcongr]
        exact Function.iterate_succ_apply (fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g) β

        induction β with
        | zero => intro p _; rfl
        | succ β ih =>
          intro p hp
          have h_eq : iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f = pderivD (iterDerivYT α β f) := by
            ext q; exact (hstep4_uncond α β f q).symm
          rw [h_eq, hpderiv_comm hU (hiterYT_holo hU hf α β) p hp]
          have hcongrD : pderivD (pderivA (iterDerivYT α β f)) p =
              pderivD (iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f) p := by
            refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq ?_
            filter_upwards [(hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hp] with t' ht'
            exact ih (p.1, t') ht'
          rw [hcongrD, hstep4_uncond (α + 1) β f p]
    have heqOn_preconn : ∀ {W V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0 := by
      intro W V hW hW_conn hV hV_ne hVW f hf hfV
      let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        {p ∈ W | ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ Metric.ball p ρ ⊆ W ∧ ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p ρ, f q = 0}
      let U₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := W \ closure U₀
      have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        intro p ⟨_, ρ, hρ, hballW, hzero⟩
        refine ⟨ρ / 2, by positivity, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
        have hsub : Metric.ball p' (ρ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball p ρ := fun q hq => by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp' hq ⊢; linarith [dist_triangle q p' p]
        exact ⟨hballW (hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity))),
          ρ / 2, by positivity, Set.Subset.trans hsub hballW, fun q hq => hzero q (hsub hq)⟩
      have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ := hW.sdiff isClosed_closure
      have hdisj : Disjoint U₀ U₁ :=
        Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ hp₀ hp₁ => hp₁.2 (subset_closure hp₀))
      have hV_sub_U₀ : V ⊆ U₀ := fun v hv => by
        obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hvball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV v hv
        exact ⟨hVW hv, ρ, hρ, Set.Subset.trans hvball hVW, fun q hq => hfV q (hvball hq)⟩
      have hW_cov : W ⊆ U₀ ∪ U₁ := by
        intro pstar hpstar
        by_cases hcl : pstar ∈ closure U₀
        · left
          obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW pstar hpstar
          set ρ : ℝ := R₀ / 2
          have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by positivity
          have hball_2ρ : Metric.ball pstar (2 * ρ) ⊆ W := (show 2 * ρ = R₀ by dsimp [ρ]; ring).symm ▸ hball_R₀
          obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁_U₀, hdist_p₁⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hcl (ρ / 2) (by positivity)
          rcases hp₁_U₀ with ⟨_, η, hη_pos, _, hzero_p₁⟩
          refine ⟨hpstar, ρ / 2, by positivity,
            fun z hz => hball_2ρ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hz])), ?_⟩
          intro q hq
          have hqp₁ : ‖q - p₁‖ ≤ ρ := by
            rw [← dist_eq_norm]; linarith [dist_triangle q pstar p₁, Metric.mem_ball.mp hq]
          have hp₁pstar : ‖p₁ - pstar‖ < ρ / 2 := by rwa [← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]
          let Φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => p₁ + z • (q - p₁)
          let B₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)
          have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ := (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - p₁)).const_add p₁
          have hΦ_maps : ∀ z ∈ B₀, Φ z ∈ W := by
            intro z hz
            apply hball_2ρ
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
            have hz_norm : ‖z‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := le_of_lt (by simpa [B₀] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hz)
            have hmul : ‖z‖ * ‖q - p₁‖ ≤ (3 / 2) * ρ :=
              mul_le_mul hz_norm hqp₁ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
            have heq : Φ z - pstar = (p₁ - pstar) + z • (q - p₁) := by dsimp only [Φ]; abel
            calc ‖Φ z - pstar‖ = ‖(p₁ - pstar) + z • (q - p₁)‖ := by rw [heq]
              _ ≤ ‖p₁ - pstar‖ + ‖z • (q - p₁)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ = ‖p₁ - pstar‖ + ‖z‖ * ‖q - p₁‖ := by rw [norm_smul]
              _ < 2 * ρ := by linarith
          have hfΦ_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ Φ) B₀ :=
            (hf.comp hΦ_diff.differentiableOn hΦ_maps).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
          have hfΦ_ev : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
            have h0_in : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₁ η := by
              change Φ 0 ∈ Metric.ball p₁ η; simpa [Φ] using Metric.mem_ball_self (x := p₁) hη_pos
            filter_upwards [(Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hΦ_diff.continuous).mem_nhds h0_in] with z hz
            exact hzero_p₁ (Φ z) hz
          have h0_B₀ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)
          have h1_B₀ : (1 : ℂ) ∈ B₀ := by simp [B₀]; norm_num
          have hzero_1 := hfΦ_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)).isPreconnected h0_B₀ hfΦ_ev h1_B₀
          simpa [Φ] using hzero_1
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hpstar, hcl⟩
      rcases hW_conn.subset_or_subset hU₀_open hU₁_open hdisj hW_cov with hsub₀ | hsub₁
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨_, ρ, hρ, _, hzero⟩ := hsub₀ hp
        exact hzero p (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)
      · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hV_ne
        exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (hV_sub_U₀ hv) (hsub₁ (hVW hv)))
    have heqOn_taylor0 : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ W →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → taylor2D f p₀ = 0 → ∀ p ∈ W, f p = 0 := by
      intro W hW hW_conn p₀ hp₀ f hf htaylor0
      have hvanish_1D : ∀ {z₀ : ℂ} {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball z₀ r) →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ((fun h : ℂ → ℂ => deriv h)^[n] g) z₀ = 0) →
          ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r, g z = 0 := by
        intro z₀ r hr g hg hderiv0
        have hana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Metric.ball z₀ r) := hg.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
        have hps := (hana z₀ hz₀).hasFPowerSeriesAt
        have hps0 : FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ
            (fun n => iteratedDeriv n g z₀ / (n.factorial : ℂ)) = 0 := by
          ext n; simp [FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate, hderiv0 n]
        rw [hps0] at hps
        exact hana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          (convex_ball z₀ r).isPreconnected hz₀ hps.eventually_eq_zero
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hballW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
      have hmem_W : ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀.1 r, ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₀.2 r, (z₁, z₂) ∈ W := by
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂
        apply hballW; rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mp hz₁, Metric.mem_ball.mp hz₂⟩
      have hiterYT_zero : ∀ α β : ℕ, iterDerivYT α β f p₀ = 0 := by
        intro α β
        let d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 α + Finsupp.single 1 β
        have hd0 : d 0 = α := by simp [d]
        have hd1 : d 1 = β := by simp [d]
        have hcoeff : taylor2D f p₀ d = 0 := by rw [htaylor0]; rfl
        dsimp only [taylor2D] at hcoeff; rw [hd0, hd1] at hcoeff
        have hfac : ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ)) ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr α.factorial_ne_zero)
            (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr β.factorial_ne_zero)
        exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hcoeff).resolve_right hfac
      have hiterY_slice_zero : ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball p₀.2 r, iterDerivY α f (p₀.1, z₂) = 0 := by
        intro α
        refine hvanish_1D hr ?_ (fun β => hiterYT_zero α β)
        intro z₂ hz₂
        have hmem : (p₀.1, z₂) ∈ W := hmem_W p₀.1 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr) z₂ hz₂
        exact (((hiterY_holo hW hf α).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hmem)).comp z₂
          ((differentiableAt_const p₀.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)).differentiableWithinAt
      have hiterY_eq_iterate : ∀ (α : ℕ) (z₁ z₂ : ℂ),
          ((fun h : ℂ → ℂ => deriv h)^[α] (fun y => f (y, z₂))) z₁ = iterDerivY α f (z₁, z₂) := by
        intro α
        induction α with
        | zero => intro z₁ z₂; rfl
        | succ α ih =>
          intro z₁ z₂
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
          have hfn : ((fun h : ℂ → ℂ => deriv h)^[α] (fun y => f (y, z₂))) =
              (fun y => iterDerivY α f (y, z₂)) := by ext y; exact ih y z₂
          rw [hfn]; rfl
      have hball_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, f q = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hq

        change (fun y => f (y, q.2)) q.1 = 0
        refine hvanish_1D (g := fun y => f (y, q.2)) hr ?_ ?_ q.1 (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hq1)
        · intro z₁ hz₁
          have hmem : (z₁, q.2) ∈ W := hmem_W z₁ hz₁ q.2 (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hq2)

        · intro α; rw [hiterY_eq_iterate α p₀.1 q.2]
          exact hiterY_slice_zero α q.2 (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hq2)
      exact heqOn_preconn hW hW_conn Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩ hballW hf hball_zero
    let e : Fin 2 → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := fun ι => Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)
    let mvDeriv : Fin 2 → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun ι Φ d => ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e ι) Φ
    have hmv_coeff : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ) =
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e ι) Φ := fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have hmv_add : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ + Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ + mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ; ext d; rw [map_add, hmv_coeff, hmv_coeff, hmv_coeff, map_add, mul_add]
    have hmv_mul_left : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ d
      let S₁ := (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι)).filter (fun p => p.1 ι ≠ 0)
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      have hbij :
          (∑ q ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff q.1 (mvDeriv ι Φ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff q.2 Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ S₁, ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        refine Finset.sum_bij (fun q _ => (q.1 + e ι, q.2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro q hq
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
          exact ⟨by rw [← hq]; exact add_right_comm q.1 (e ι) q.2, by simp [e]⟩
        · rintro ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ _ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ _ heq
          simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at heq ⊢
          exact ⟨add_right_cancel heq.1, heq.2⟩
        · rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
          rcases hp with ⟨hp_sum, hp_ne⟩
          dsimp only at hp_ne
          have hsub_add : p₁ - e ι + e ι = p₁ := by
            ext k; simp only [e, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
            split_ifs with h
            · subst h; omega
            · omega
          refine ⟨(p₁ - e ι, p₂), ?_, Prod.ext hsub_add rfl⟩
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
          apply add_right_cancel (b := e ι)
          calc (p₁ - e ι + p₂) + e ι = (p₁ - e ι + e ι) + p₂ := add_right_comm _ _ _
            _ = d + e ι := by rw [hsub_add, hp_sum]
        · intro q _
          rw [hmv_coeff]; have hcoord : (q.1 + e ι) ι = q.1 ι + 1 := by simp [e]
          dsimp only; rw [hcoord, mul_assoc]
      rw [hbij]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (fun p hp hnot => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_and, not_not] at hnot
      simp [hnot hp]
    have hmv_mul : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ * Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ; ext d
      rw [map_add, hmv_mul_left ι Φ Ψ d, mul_comm Φ (mvDeriv ι Ψ), hmv_mul_left ι Ψ Φ d]
      have hswap :
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Ψ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Φ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e ι),
            ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        refine Finset.sum_bij (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1)) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => by ring)
        · intro p hp; rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢; rw [add_comm, hp]
        · rintro ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ _ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ _ heq; simpa [Prod.mk.injEq, and_comm] using heq
        · rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ hp; refine ⟨(p₂, p₁), ?_, rfl⟩
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢; rw [add_comm, hp]
      rw [hswap, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, hmv_coeff, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p hp => ?_)
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have hcoord : p.1 ι + p.2 ι = d ι + 1 := by
        have hc := congr_arg (fun x => x ι) hp; simpa [e, Finsupp.add_apply] using hc
      have hcast : ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hcoord
      rw [← hcast]; ring
    have hmv_leib : ∀ Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
        mvDerivA (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ + mvDerivA Ψ ∧
        mvDerivD (Φ + Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ + mvDerivD Ψ ∧
        mvDerivA (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivA Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivA Ψ ∧
        mvDerivD (Φ * Ψ) = mvDerivD Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDerivD Ψ :=
      fun Φ Ψ => ⟨hmv_add 0 Φ Ψ, hmv_add 1 Φ Ψ, hmv_mul 0 Φ Ψ, hmv_mul 1 Φ Ψ⟩
    let e₀ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 (1 : ℕ)
    let e₁ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 1 (1 : ℕ)
    have htaylor_coeff : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀) =
          iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have hmvA_coeff : ∀ (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivA Φ) =
          ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e₀) Φ := fun _ _ => rfl
    have hmvD_coeff : ∀ (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivD Φ) =
          ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + e₁) Φ := fun _ _ => rfl
    have hdeg_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 + d 1 = 0 := by
      intro d; constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · intro h; ext i; fin_cases i <;> (simp; omega)
    have hslice_at : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ q ∈ U,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => f (z, q.2)) q.1 ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => f (q.1, w)) q.2 := by
      intro U hU f hf q hq
      have hfq : DifferentiableAt ℂ f q := hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)
      exact ⟨hfq.comp q.1 (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const q.2)),
        hfq.comp q.2 ((differentiableAt_const q.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)⟩
    have hmv_taylor : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →

          mvDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
          mvDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf; constructor
      · ext d; rw [hmvA_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
        have hd0 : (d + e₀) 0 = d 0 + 1 := by simp [e₀]
        have hd1 : (d + e₀) 1 = d 1 := by simp [e₀]
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).1, Nat.factorial_succ (d 0), Nat.cast_mul]
        have : ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp
      · ext d; rw [hmvD_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
        have hd0 : (d + e₁) 0 = d 0 := by simp [e₁]
        have hd1 : (d + e₁) 1 = d 1 + 1 := by simp [e₁]
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).2.1, Nat.factorial_succ (d 1), Nat.cast_mul]
        have : ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp
    have hcoeff_step : ∀ {Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {N : ℕ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 →
        (∀ d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d' 0 + d' 1 = N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivA Ψ) ∧
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivD Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivD Ψ)) →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d Φ = MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ := by
      intro Φ Ψ N d hd heq
      by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0
      · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := d - e₁
        have hd'_add : d' + e₁ = d := by
          ext i; simp only [d', e₁, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply]
          (fin_cases i <;> simp); omega
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by
          have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hd'_add
          simp only [e₁, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hsum
          have : (Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 0 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hD := (heq d' hd'_deg).2
        rw [hmvD_coeff, hmvD_coeff, hd'_add] at hD
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)) hD
      · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := d - e₀
        have hd'_add : d' + e₀ = d := by
          ext i; simp only [d', e₀, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.tsub_apply]
          (fin_cases i <;> simp); omega
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by
          have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hd'_add
          simp only [e₀, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hsum
          have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hA := (heq d' hd'_deg).1
        rw [hmvA_coeff, hmvA_coeff, hd'_add] at hA
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)) hA
    have htaylor_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
      intro p₀ c
      have hiter0 : ∀ (β : ℕ), ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ))) = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro β; induction β with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ β ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]; ext z; exact deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
      have hiterY_const : ∀ (α : ℕ), iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro α; induction α with
        | zero => ext p; exact deriv_const p.1 c
        | succ α ih =>
          ext p; change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) (y', p.2)) p.1 = 0
          rw [ih]; exact deriv_const p.1 (0 : ℂ)
      ext d; rw [htaylor_coeff, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      by_cases hd : d = 0
      · subst hd; simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (fun h => (hd h).elim)]
        by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0
        · have hd1 : d 1 ≠ 0 := fun hd1_0 => hd ((hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega))
          obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hd1
          rw [hd0, hβ]; simp only [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          have hdc : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => c) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by ext z; exact deriv_const z c
          rw [hdc, hiter0 β]; simp
        · obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hd0
          rw [hα]; simp only [iterDerivYT, hiterY_const α, hiter0 (d 1)]; simp
    have htaylor_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N; induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0; rw [map_add, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) (fun d' hd' => ?_)
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p + g p) U := by convert hf.add hg using 1
            have hpA_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivA (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivA f q + pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivD (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivD f q + pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpA_add,
                (hmv_leib _ _).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1]
              exact ih (hpderiv_holo hU hf).1 (hpderiv_holo hU hg).1 d' (le_of_eq hd')
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpD_add,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2]
              exact ih (hpderiv_holo hU hf).2 (hpderiv_holo hU hg).2 d' (le_of_eq hd')
      intro f g hf hg; ext d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    have htaylor_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N; induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul,
            ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff, htaylor_coeff]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) (fun d' hd' => ?_)
            obtain ⟨hfA, hfD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hf
            obtain ⟨hgA, hgD⟩ := hpderiv_holo hU hg
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * g p) U := by convert hf.mul hg using 1
            have hfAg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivA f p * g p) U := by convert hfA.mul hg using 1
            have hfgA : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivA g p) U := by convert hf.mul hgA using 1
            have hfDg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivD f p * g p) U := by convert hfD.mul hg using 1
            have hfgD : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivD g p) U := by convert hf.mul hgD using 1
            have hpA_mul : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivA (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivA f q * g q + f q * pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD_mul : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivD (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivD f q * g q + f q * pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpA_mul,
                htaylor_add hU hp₀ hfAg hfgA,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.2.1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfA hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgA d' (le_of_eq hd')]
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpD_mul,
                htaylor_add hU hp₀ hfDg hfgD,
                (hmv_leib _ _).2.2.2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfD hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgD d' (le_of_eq hd')]
      intro f g hf hg; ext d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    have htaylor_alg : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        (∀ c : ℂ, taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
        (∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀

  have h_even_0 : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (t : ℂ), ‖t‖ < hDet.r_det → F 0 ι (0, -t) = F 0 ι (0, t) := by

  have hpderivD_0 : ∀ ι : Fin 2, pderivD (F 0 ι) (0, 0) = 0 := by

    let κ_star : ℂ := pderivA (F 0 ι_star) (0, 0)

  have h_shear_pderiv : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},

    have hL10 : L (1, 0) = pderivA f (σ m p) := by
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, (σ m p).2)) (1, 0) (σ m p).1 :=

      have hd := (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
        (f := fun z : ℂ => (z, (σ m p).2)) (σ m p).1 hL hc).deriv

      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ((σ m p).1, w)) (0, 1) (σ m p).2 :=

      have hd := (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
