        simpa only [h_env_eq] using hQw_ne
    · obtain ⟨M₁, D₁, _hD₁, Q₁, _Disc₁, hQ₁_eq, ⟨yw, tw, hyw, htw, hQw_ne, _⟩, _⟩ :=
        hDet.line_determination b_nat (by dsimp [b_nat]; omega) (K + 1) (by omega) (by dsimp [b_nat]; omega) ι
      have h_b1 : m + ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = m + b_z - 1 := by dsimp [b_z, b_nat]; ring
      rw [← h_b1]
      refine h_base_to_alg ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ι ⟨W_det_b, M₁, D₁, Q₁, hW_det_open, hW_det_00, ?_, ?_⟩ m
      · intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
        have h1 := hQ₁_eq p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2
        simpa only [h_env_eq, F, Int.cast_natCast] using h1
      · refine ⟨(yw, tw), ⟨hyw, htw⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa only [h_env_eq] using hQw_ne

  
  have hReflStep : ∀ (M_star D_star : ℕ)
      (Q_star : Fin (D_star + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M_star) ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      (∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
        MvPolynomial.aeval (lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star) (Q_star d) *
          (taylor2D (F (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star) (0, 0)) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
      (∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
        MvPolynomial.aeval (lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star) (Q_star d) *
          (taylor2D (F (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ι_star) (0, 0)) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) := by
    intro M_star D_star Q_star n h_root_n
    let U_n : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := W B_z ∩ W (B_z + b_z) ∩ W (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ))
    have hUn_open : IsOpen U_n :=
      ((hW_open B_z).inter (hW_open (B_z + b_z))).inter (hW_open (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)))
    have hUn_pre : IsPreconnected U_n :=
      (((hW_conv B_z).inter (hW_conv (B_z + b_z))).inter (hW_conv (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)))).isPreconnected
    have hUn_00 : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_n :=
      ⟨⟨hW_00 B_z, hW_00 (B_z + b_z)⟩, hW_00 (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ))⟩
    have henv_B : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, V ⊆ W B_z → V ⊆ W (B_z + b_z) →
        ∀ v : LineJetVar M_star,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) p v) V := by
      intro V hV1 hV2 v
      dsimp only [lineJetEnv]
      split_ifs
      · exact (k_iterYT_holo (hW_open _) (hF_holo B_z v.2.1) _ _).mono hV1
      · exact (k_iterYT_holo (hW_open _) (hF_holo (B_z + b_z) v.2.1) _ _).mono hV2
    have h_env_B_tay : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, V ⊆ W B_z → V ⊆ W (B_z + b_z) →
        IsOpen V → ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ V →
        ∀ R_poly : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M_star) ℂ,
          taylor2D (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) p) R_poly) (0, 0) =
            MvPolynomial.aeval (lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star) R_poly := by
      intro V hV1 hV2 hV hV0 R_poly
      rw [h_taylor_eval hV hV0 _ (henv_B hV1 hV2) R_poly]
      have hf_eq : (fun v => taylor2D (fun p => lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) p v) (0, 0)) =
          lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star := by
        funext v; dsimp only [lineJetEnv, lineJetTay]; split_ifs <;> rfl
      rw [hf_eq]
    let G_n : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) p) (Q_star d) *
          (F (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ)
    have hGn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_n U_n := by
      refine h_holo_sum Finset.univ _ (fun d _ => ?_)
      exact h_holo_mul
        (h_eval_holo hUn_open _ (henv_B (fun _ hp => hp.1.1) (fun _ hp => hp.1.2)) (Q_star d))
        (h_holo_pow ((hF_holo (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star).mono (fun _ hp => hp.2)) (d : ℕ))
    have hGn_tay : taylor2D G_n (0, 0) = 0 := by
      rw [h_taylor_sum_pow hUn_open hUn_00 _ _
        (fun d => h_eval_holo hUn_open _ (henv_B (fun _ hp => hp.1.1) (fun _ hp => hp.1.2)) (Q_star d))
        ((hF_holo _ _).mono (fun _ hp => hp.2))]
      simpa only [h_env_B_tay (fun _ hp => hp.1.1) (fun _ hp => hp.1.2) hUn_open hUn_00] using h_root_n
    have hGn_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_n, G_n p = 0 :=
      k_eqOn_taylor0 hUn_open hUn_pre hUn_00 hGn_holo hGn_tay
    let q_idx_n : Fin 4 → ℤ :=
      ![B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ), -(B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)),
        B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ), -(B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ))]
    have hsym_n : ∀ a : Fin 4, (q_idx_n a ≤ 0 ∨ K < (q_idx_n a).natAbs) ∧
        ∃ b' : Fin 4, q_idx_n b' = -q_idx_n a := by
      intro a
      fin_cases a <;> dsimp only
      · refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, 1, by simp [q_idx_n]⟩
        change K < (q_idx_n 0).natAbs
        have hq0 : q_idx_n 0 = ((K + 3 + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          simp [q_idx_n, B_z, B_nat]
        rw [hq0, Int.natAbs_natCast]; omega
      · refine ⟨Or.inl ?_, 0, by simp [q_idx_n]⟩
        dsimp [q_idx_n, B_z, B_nat]; omega
      · refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, 3, by simp [q_idx_n]⟩
        change K < (q_idx_n 2).natAbs
        have hq2 : q_idx_n 2 = ((K + 3 + (K + 2) + 2 * n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          simp [q_idx_n, B_z, B_nat, b_z, b_nat]
        rw [hq2, Int.natAbs_natCast]; omega
      · refine ⟨Or.inl ?_, 2, by simp [q_idx_n]⟩
        dsimp [q_idx_n, B_z, B_nat, b_z, b_nat]; omega
    let emb_n : LineJetVar (2 * M_star) → SymJetVar 4 (2 * M_star) :=
      fun v => (if v.1 = 0 then 0 else 2, v.2.1, v.2.2.1, v.2.2.2)
    let Q_tilde : Fin (D_star + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar 4 (2 * M_star)) ℂ :=
      fun d => MvPolynomial.rename emb_n (MvPolynomial.bind₁ (Ψ (2 * (n : ℤ)) M_star) (Q_star d))
    have h_ren_n : ∀ (p : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin (D_star + 1)),
        p ∈ W (B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) → p ∈ W (B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) →
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) (Q_tilde d) =
          MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) (σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) p)) (Q_star d) := by
      intro p d hp0 hp2
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
      have h_comp_env : (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) ∘ emb_n =
          lineJetEnv (2 * M_star) (F (B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ))) (F (B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ))) p := by
        funext v
        dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, emb_n, symJetEnv, lineJetEnv, F]
        split_ifs with hv <;> simp [q_idx_n]
      rw [h_comp_env]
      exact h_bind₁_shear (2 * (n : ℤ)) B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star (Q_star d) hp0 hp2
    let J_bound_n : ℝ := ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin 4 => (q_idx_n a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2
    let V_dom_n : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_b / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_b ∧ |p.2.im| < s_b / (2 * J_bound_n) }
    obtain ⟨hVdn_open, hVdn_pre, hVdn_00, hVdn_sub⟩ := hVdom_props q_idx_n
    have h_q_le : ∀ a : Fin 4, ((q_idx_n a).natAbs : ℝ) ≤ J_bound_n := by
      intro a
      have h1 : (q_idx_n a).natAbs ≤ Finset.univ.sup fun b' : Fin 4 => (q_idx_n b').natAbs :=
        Finset.le_sup (f := fun b' : Fin 4 => (q_idx_n b').natAbs) (Finset.mem_univ a)
      have h2 : ((q_idx_n a).natAbs : ℝ) ≤
          ((Finset.univ.sup fun b' : Fin 4 => (q_idx_n b').natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
      dsimp [J_bound_n]; linarith
    have h_holo_Vdn : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) (Q_tilde d) *
            (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ)) V_dom_n := by
      refine h_holo_sum Finset.univ _ (fun d _ => ?_)
      have h_env_v : ∀ v : SymJetVar 4 (2 * M_star),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p v) V_dom_n := fun v =>
        (k_iterYT_holo (hW_open _) (hF_holo (q_idx_n v.1) v.2.1) _ _).mono
          (hVdn_sub _ (h_q_le v.1))
      have hF1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) V_dom_n := by
        have h1_eq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) = F 1 ι_star := by
          funext p; simp [F]
        rw [h1_eq]
        have h1_le : ((1 : ℤ).natAbs : ℝ) ≤ J_bound_n := by
          have h0_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin 4 => (q_idx_n a).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
            Nat.cast_nonneg _
          dsimp [J_bound_n]; norm_num; linarith
        exact (hF_holo 1 ι_star).mono (hVdn_sub 1 h1_le)
      exact h_holo_mul (h_eval_holo hVdn_open _ h_env_v (Q_tilde d)) (h_holo_pow hF1 (d : ℕ))
    let V_ov : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := V_dom_n ∩ ((σ (2 * (n : ℤ))) ⁻¹' U_n)
    have hVov_open : IsOpen V_ov := hVdn_open.inter (hUn_open.preimage (hσ_cont _))
    have hVov_00 : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ V_ov := by
      refine ⟨hVdn_00, ?_⟩
      change σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) (0, 0) ∈ U_n
      have h0 : σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) (0, 0) = (0, 0) := by ext <;> simp [σ]
      rw [h0]; exact hUn_00
    have h_on_Vov : ∀ p ∈ V_ov,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) (Q_tilde d) *
            (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
      intro p ⟨hp_vd, hp_un⟩
      have hp0 : p ∈ W (B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) := hVdn_sub _ (h_q_le 0) hp_vd
      have hp2 : p ∈ W (B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) := hVdn_sub _ (h_q_le 2) hp_vd
      have hF1_eq : glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star =
          F (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star (σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) p) := by
        have hc := congr_fun (hF_comp (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) (2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star) p
        have h_add : (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) + 2 * (n : ℤ) = 1 := by ring
        rw [h_add] at hc
        simpa [F] using hc.symm
      have h_eq :
          (∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) (Q_tilde d) *
              (glancingDualLine C (p.1 + p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ)) =
          G_n (σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) p) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
        rw [h_ren_n p d hp0 hp2, hF1_eq]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hGn_zero _ hp_un
    have h_on_Vdn := k_eqOn_preconn hVdn_open hVdn_pre
      hVov_open ⟨(0, 0), hVov_00⟩ Set.inter_subset_left h_holo_Vdn h_on_Vov
    have h_refl_n := hRefl 4 (2 * M_star) D_star q_idx_n ι_star Q_tilde hsym_n h_on_Vdn
    let U_next : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      W B_z ∩ W (B_z + b_z) ∩ W (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∩
        ((σ (-(2 * (n : ℤ)))) ⁻¹' V_dom_n)
    have hUnext_open : IsOpen U_next :=
      (((hW_open B_z).inter (hW_open (B_z + b_z))).inter
        (hW_open (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))).inter (hVdn_open.preimage (hσ_cont _))
    have hUnext_00 : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_next := by
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hW_00 B_z, hW_00 (B_z + b_z)⟩, hW_00 _⟩, ?_⟩
      change σ (-(2 * (n : ℤ))) (0, 0) ∈ V_dom_n
      have h0 : σ (-(2 * (n : ℤ))) (0, 0) = (0, 0) := by ext <;> simp [σ]
      rw [h0]; exact hVdn_00
    have hGnext_zero : ∀ q ∈ U_next,
        ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) q) (Q_star d) *
            (F (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ι_star q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
      intro q ⟨_, hq_pre⟩
      let p : ℂ × ℂ := σ (-(2 * (n : ℤ))) q
      have hp_vd : p ∈ V_dom_n := hq_pre
      have hr := h_refl_n p hp_vd
      have hp0 : p ∈ W (B_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) := hVdn_sub _ (h_q_le 0) hp_vd
      have hp2 : p ∈ W (B_z + b_z + 2 * (n : ℤ)) := hVdn_sub _ (h_q_le 2) hp_vd
      have hFm1_eq : glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star =
          F (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ι_star q := by
        have hc := congr_fun (hF_comp (-1) (-(2 * (n : ℤ))) ι_star) q
        have h_add : (-1 : ℤ) + -(2 * (n : ℤ)) = 1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_add] at hc
        simpa [p, F, sub_eq_add_neg] using hc
      have h_eq :
          (∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M_star (F B_z) (F (B_z + b_z)) q) (Q_star d) *
              (F (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ι_star q) ^ (d : ℕ)) =
          ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx_n (2 * M_star) p) (Q_tilde d) *
              (glancingDualLine C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 ι_star) ^ (d : ℕ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
        rw [h_ren_n p d hp0 hp2, show σ (2 * (n : ℤ)) p = q from hσ_inv (2 * (n : ℤ)) q, hFm1_eq]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hr
    have hsub1 : U_next ⊆ W B_z := fun _ hq => hq.1.1.1
    have hsub2 : U_next ⊆ W (B_z + b_z) := fun _ hq => hq.1.1.2
    have hsub3 : U_next ⊆ W (1 - 2 * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := fun _ hq => hq.1.2
    have h_sum0 : taylor2D (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) (0, 0) = 0 := by
      simpa using (k_taylor_alg isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ _)).1 0
    have h_congr := k_taylor2D_congr hUnext_open hUnext_00 hGnext_zero
    rw [h_sum0] at h_congr
    rw [h_taylor_sum_pow hUnext_open hUnext_00 _ _
      (fun d => h_eval_holo hUnext_open _ (henv_B hsub1 hsub2) (Q_star d))
      ((hF_holo _ _).mono hsub3)] at h_congr
    simpa only [h_env_B_tay hsub1 hsub2 hUnext_open hUnext_00] using h_congr

  
  have : IsDomain (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
  have h_mvA_const : ∀ c : ℂ, mvDerivA (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) c) = 0 := by
    intro c
    funext d
    have hne : d + Finsupp.single 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h0 0
      simp at this
    change ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 0 1) (algebraMap ℂ _ c) = 0
    simp [MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, hne]
  have h_mvD_const : ∀ c : ℂ, mvDerivD (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) c) = 0 := by
    intro c
    funext d
    have hne : d + Finsupp.single 1 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h0 1
      simp at this
    change ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1) (algebraMap ℂ _ c) = 0
    simp [MvPowerSeries.algebraMap_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, hne]
  have h_jet_step : ∀ (j : ℤ) (ι : Fin 2) (α β : ℕ),
      mvDerivA (taylor2D (iterDerivYT α β (F j ι)) (0, 0)) =
        taylor2D (iterDerivYT (α + 1) β (F j ι)) (0, 0) ∧
      mvDerivD (taylor2D (iterDerivYT α β (F j ι)) (0, 0)) =
        taylor2D (iterDerivYT α (β + 1) (F j ι)) (0, 0) := by
    intro j ι α β
    have h_it_holo := k_iterYT_holo (hW_open j) (hF_holo j ι) α β
    obtain ⟨hmA, hmD⟩ := k_mv_taylor (hW_open j) (hW_00 j) h_it_holo
    constructor
    · rw [hmA]
      exact k_taylor2D_congr (hW_open j) (hW_00 j) (fun p hp =>
        (k_iterYT_step (hW_open j) (hF_holo j ι) α β p hp).2.2.1)
    · rw [hmD]
      exact k_taylor2D_congr (hW_open j) (hW_00 j) (fun p hp =>
        (k_iterYT_step (hW_open j) (hF_holo j ι) α β p hp).2.2.2)
  have h_deriv_alg : ∀ (D : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ Φ Ψ, D (Φ + Ψ) = D Φ + D Ψ) →
      (∀ Φ Ψ, D (Φ * Ψ) = D Φ * Ψ + Φ * D Ψ) →
      (∀ c : ℂ, D (algebraMap ℂ (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) c) = 0) →
      (∀ (I : Set ℤ), ∀ Φ ∈ jetSet I, D Φ ∈ jetSet I) →
      ∀ (I : Set ℤ) (x : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) x → IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (D x) := by
    intro D hD_add hD_mul hD_const hD_jet I x hx
    let A := jetAlg I
    have : IsDomain ↥A := Subalgebra.isDomain A
    have hD0 : D 0 = 0 := by simpa using hD_const 0
    have hD_mem : ∀ a ∈ A, D a ∈ A := by
      intro a ha
      refine Algebra.adjoin_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
      · intro y hy; exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (hD_jet I y hy)
      · intro r; rw [hD_const r]; exact A.zero_mem
      · intro y₁ y₂ _ _ ih₁ ih₂; rw [hD_add]; exact A.add_mem ih₁ ih₂
      · intro y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ ih₁ ih₂; rw [hD_mul]; exact A.add_mem (A.mul_mem ih₁ hy₂) (A.mul_mem hy₁ ih₂)
    have hD_sum : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (g : α → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        D (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ i ∈ s, D (g i) := by
      intro α s g
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp [hD0]
      | insert a s ha ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert ha, hD_add, ih]
    have hD_pow : ∀ (z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (n : ℕ),
        D (z ^ n) = (n : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * z ^ (n - 1) * D z := by
      have hD1 : D 1 = 0 := by simpa only [map_one] using hD_const 1
      intro z n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp [hD1]
      | succ k ih =>
        cases k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m =>
          rw [pow_succ z (m + 1), hD_mul, ih]
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
          push_cast
          ring
    classical
    let Pred : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
      ∃ P : Polynomial ↥A, P ≠ 0 ∧ P.natDegree = n ∧ Polynomial.aeval x P = 0
    obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀_ne, hP₀_ev⟩ := id hx
    have h_ex : ∃ n : ℕ, Pred n := ⟨P₀.natDegree, P₀, hP₀_ne, rfl, hP₀_ev⟩
    let N := Nat.find h_ex
    obtain ⟨P, hP_ne, hP_deg, hP_ev⟩ := Nat.find_spec h_ex
    change P.natDegree = N at hP_deg
    have hN_ne : N ≠ 0 := by
      intro hN0
      have hP_C := Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero (hP_deg.trans hN0)
      rw [hP_C, Polynomial.aeval_C] at hP_ev
      apply hP_ne
      rw [hP_C]
      have hc0 : P.coeff 0 = 0 := Subtype.ext hP_ev
      simp [hc0]
    let P' : Polynomial ↥A := Polynomial.derivative P
    have hP'_ne : P' ≠ 0 := by
      intro hP'0
      have h_coeff := congr_arg (fun Q : Polynomial ↥A => Q.coeff (N - 1)) hP'0
      simp only [P', Polynomial.coeff_derivative, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at h_coeff
      have hN1 : N - 1 + 1 = N := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN_ne)
      have hN_cast : ((N - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ↥A) = (N : ↥A) := by
        calc
          ((N - 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ↥A) = (((N - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ↥A) := by push_cast; rfl
          _ = (N : ↥A) := by rw [hN1]
      rw [hN1, hN_cast] at h_coeff
      have h_lead : P.coeff N ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hP_deg]
        exact Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hP_ne
      have hN_ne_A : (N : ↥A) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        let φ : ↥A →+* ℂ :=
          (@MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (Fin 2) ℂ _).comp A.val.toRingHom
        have h_c0 := congr_arg φ h0
        simp only [map_natCast, map_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h_c0
        exact hN_ne h_c0
      exact mul_ne_zero h_lead hN_ne_A h_coeff
    have hP'_deg_lt : P'.natDegree < N := by
      rw [← hP_deg]
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_lt (by rw [hP_deg]; exact hN_ne)
    let u : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := Polynomial.aeval x P'
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro hu0
      exact Nat.find_min h_ex hP'_deg_lt ⟨P', hP'_ne, rfl, hu0⟩
    let v : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), D (P.coeff i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * x ^ i
    have hu_eq : u = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        (P.coeff i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * (i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * x ^ (i - 1) := by
      have hP_sum := Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow P
      rw [hP_deg] at hP_sum
      conv_lhs => rw [show u = Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.derivative P) from rfl, hP_sum]
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Polynomial.derivative_C_mul, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow, map_mul, map_mul,
        map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X]
      simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Subalgebra.smul_def, mul_assoc]
    have huv_rel : u * D x + v = 0 := by
      have h_ev_sum : Polynomial.aeval x P =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (P.coeff i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * x ^ i := by
        rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range, hP_deg]
        rfl
      have hD_ev : D (Polynomial.aeval x P) = 0 := by rw [hP_ev, hD0]
      rw [h_ev_sum, hD_sum] at hD_ev
      have h_expand : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), D ((P.coeff i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) * x ^ i)) =
          v + u * D x := by
        rw [hu_eq, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [hD_mul, hD_pow]
        ring
      rw [h_expand, add_comm] at hD_ev
      exact hD_ev
    let S' : Set (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) := insert x (jetSet I)
    let B_alg : Subalgebra ℂ (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) := Algebra.adjoin ℂ S'
    have hAB : A ≤ B_alg := Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.subset_insert x (jetSet I))
    have hx_B : x ∈ B_alg := Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert x (jetSet I))
    have hu_B : u ∈ B_alg := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
      refine B_alg.sum_mem (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Subalgebra.smul_def]
      exact B_alg.mul_mem (hAB (P'.coeff i).2) (B_alg.pow_mem hx_B i)
    have hv_B : v ∈ B_alg := by
      refine B_alg.sum_mem (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact B_alg.mul_mem (hAB (hD_mem _ (P.coeff i).2)) (B_alg.pow_mem hx_B i)
    have hDx_B : IsAlgebraic ↥B_alg (D x) := by
      let L_poly : Polynomial ↥B_alg :=
        Polynomial.C ⟨u, hu_B⟩ * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C ⟨v, hv_B⟩
      refine ⟨L_poly, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hL0
        have hc1 := congr_arg (fun Q : Polynomial ↥B_alg => Q.coeff 1) hL0
        simp [L_poly] at hc1
        exact hu_ne (congr_arg Subtype.val hc1)
      · simp [L_poly]
        exact huv_rel
    refine IsAlgebraic.adjoin_of_forall_isAlgebraic ?_ hDx_B
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨hz_in, hz_not⟩
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz_in with rfl | hz_jet
    · exact hx
    · exact False.elim (hz_not hz_jet)
  have h_mvA_alg : ∀ (I : Set ℤ) (x : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) x → IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (mvDerivA x) := by
    refine h_deriv_alg mvDerivA
      (fun Φ Ψ => (k_mv_leib Φ Ψ).1)
      (fun Φ Ψ => (k_mv_leib Φ Ψ).2.2.1)
      h_mvA_const ?_
    rintro I _ ⟨j, hj, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j, hj, ι, α + 1, β, (h_jet_step j ι α β).1⟩
  have h_mvD_alg : ∀ (I : Set ℤ) (x : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) x → IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (mvDerivD x) := by
    refine h_deriv_alg mvDerivD
      (fun Φ Ψ => (k_mv_leib Φ Ψ).2.1)
      (fun Φ Ψ => (k_mv_leib Φ Ψ).2.2.2)
      h_mvD_const ?_
    rintro I _ ⟨j, hj, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨j, hj, ι, α, β + 1, (h_jet_step j ι α β).2⟩
  have h_iter00 : ∀ f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, iterDerivYT 0 0 f = f := by
    intro f; funext ⟨y, t⟩; rfl
  have h_all_jets_alg : ∀ (I : Set ℤ) (q : ℤ) (ι : Fin 2),
      IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (taylor2D (F q ι) (0, 0)) →
      ∀ α β : ℕ, IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (taylor2D (iterDerivYT α β (F q ι)) (0, 0)) := by
    intro I q ι h0 α
    have hα : IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg I) (taylor2D (iterDerivYT α 0 (F q ι)) (0, 0)) := by
      induction α with
      | zero => simpa [h_iter00] using h0
      | succ a iha => rw [← (h_jet_step q ι a 0).1]; exact h_mvA_alg I _ iha
    intro β
    induction β with
    | zero => exact hα
    | succ c ihc => rw [← (h_jet_step q ι α c).2]; exact h_mvD_alg I _ ihc
  let J : ℕ → Set ℤ := fun r =>
    { q : ℤ | ∃ s ≤ r, q = B_z - (s : ℤ) ∨ q = B_z + b_z - (s : ℤ) }
  have h_tower_step : ∀ (r : ℕ) (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg (J (r + 1))) a → IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg (J r)) a := by
    intro r a ha
    let m : ℤ := B_z - (r : ℤ)
    have h_pair_sub : ({m, m + b_z} : Set ℤ) ⊆ J r := by
      intro q hq
      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨r, le_rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨r, le_rfl, Or.inr (by dsimp [m]; ring)⟩
    have h_alg_le : jetAlg {m, m + b_z} ≤ jetAlg (J r) := by
      refine Algebra.adjoin_mono ?_
      rintro _ ⟨j, hj, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨j, h_pair_sub hj, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
    refine IsAlgebraic.adjoin_of_forall_isAlgebraic ?_ ha
    intro Φ hΦ
    rcases hΦ with ⟨⟨q, hq1, ι, α, β, rfl⟩, hnot⟩
    rcases hq1 with ⟨s, hs, hq_eq⟩
    have hs_eq : s = r + 1 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hs_le : s ≤ r := by omega
      exact hnot ⟨q, ⟨s, hs_le, hq_eq⟩, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
    subst hs_eq
    rcases hq_eq with rfl | rfl
    · have hq_m : B_z - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = m - 1 := by dsimp [m]; ring
      rw [hq_m]
      exact h_all_jets_alg (J r) (m - 1) ι
        (IsAlgebraic.tower_top_of_subalgebra_le h_alg_le (hStep m ι).1) α β
    · have hq_mb : B_z + b_z - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = m + b_z - 1 := by dsimp [m]; ring
      rw [hq_mb]
      exact h_all_jets_alg (J r) (m + b_z - 1) ι
        (IsAlgebraic.tower_top_of_subalgebra_le h_alg_le (hStep m ι).2) α β
  have h_tower_all : ∀ (r : ℕ) (a : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg (J r)) a → IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg (J 0)) a := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro a ha; exact ha
    | succ r ih => intro a ha; exact ih a (h_tower_step r a ha)
  have h1_mem_J : (1 : ℤ) ∈ J (K + 2) := by
    refine ⟨K + 2, le_rfl, Or.inl ?_⟩
    dsimp [B_z, B_nat]; omega
  have hx_mem : taylor2D (F 1 ι_star) (0, 0) ∈ jetAlg (J (K + 2)) := by
    apply Algebra.subset_adjoin
    exact ⟨1, h1_mem_J, ι_star, 0, 0, by rw [h_iter00]⟩
  have : IsDomain ↥(jetAlg (J (K + 2))) := Subalgebra.isDomain (jetAlg (J (K + 2)))
  have hx_alg_top : IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg (J (K + 2))) (taylor2D (F 1 ι_star) (0, 0)) := by
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ⟨taylor2D (F 1 ι_star) (0, 0), hx_mem⟩,
      Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _, ?_⟩
    simp
  have hx_alg_0 := h_tower_all (K + 2) _ hx_alg_top
  have hJ0 : J 0 = {B_z, B_z + b_z} := by
    ext q
    simp only [J, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Nat.le_zero, exists_eq_left, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero,
      Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hAlg1 : IsAlgebraic ↥(jetAlg {B_z, B_z + b_z}) (taylor2D (F 1 ι_star) (0, 0)) := by
    dsimp only [jetAlg, jetSet] at hx_alg_0 ⊢
    rwa [hJ0] at hx_alg_0

  
  obtain ⟨P_star, hP_ne, hP_aeval⟩ := hAlg1
  let D_star : ℕ := P_star.natDegree
  let A_top := jetAlg {B_z, B_z + b_z}
  let P_R : Polynomial (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    P_star.map (algebraMap (↥A_top) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ))
  have hPR_ne : P_R ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hP_ne
    have h0' : P_star.map (algebraMap (↥A_top) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)) =
        (0 : Polynomial ↥A_top).map (algebraMap (↥A_top) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)) := by
      simpa [P_R] using h0
    exact Polynomial.map_injective _ Subtype.val_injective h0'
  have hPR_deg : P_R.natDegree ≤ D_star := Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
  let gen : (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun w =>
      if w.1 = 0 then
        taylor2D (iterDerivYT w.2.2.1 w.2.2.2 (F B_z w.2.1)) (0, 0)
      else
        taylor2D (iterDerivYT w.2.2.1 w.2.2.2 (F (B_z + b_z) w.2.1)) (0, 0)
  have h_jet_range : jetSet {B_z, B_z + b_z} = Set.range gen := by
    ext Φ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, ι, α, β, rfl⟩
      rcases hj with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨(0, ι, α, β), by simp [gen]⟩
      · exact ⟨(1, ι, α, β), by simp [gen]⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
      dsimp only [gen]
      split_ifs with hw
      · exact ⟨B_z, Or.inl rfl, w.2.1, w.2.2.1, w.2.2.2, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨B_z + b_z, Or.inr rfl, w.2.1, w.2.2.1, w.2.2.2, rfl⟩
  have h_coeff_range : ∀ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
      ∃ R : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) ℂ,
        MvPolynomial.aeval gen R = P_R.coeff (d : ℕ) := by
    intro d
    have h_mem : P_R.coeff (d : ℕ) ∈ A_top := by
      simp only [P_R, Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact (P_star.coeff (d : ℕ)).2
    have h_adjoin_eq : A_top = (MvPolynomial.aeval gen).range := by
      dsimp only [A_top, jetAlg]
      rw [h_jet_range]
      exact Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval ℂ gen
    rw [h_adjoin_eq] at h_mem
    exact h_mem
  choose R_d hR_d using h_coeff_range
  classical
  let wMax : (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) → ℕ := fun w => max w.2.2.1 w.2.2.2
  let cMax : ((Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) →₀ ℕ) → ℕ := fun c => c.support.sup wMax
  let dMax : Fin (D_star + 1) → ℕ := fun d => (R_d d).support.sup cMax
  let M_star : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup dMax
  let truncVar : (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × ℕ × ℕ) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M_star) ℂ :=
    fun w =>
      if h : w.2.2.1 ≤ M_star ∧ w.2.2.2 ≤ M_star then
        MvPolynomial.X (w.1, w.2.1, ⟨w.2.2.1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h.1⟩, ⟨w.2.2.2, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h.2⟩)
      else 0
  let Q_star : Fin (D_star + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M_star) ℂ :=
    fun d => MvPolynomial.bind₁ truncVar (R_d d)
  have hQ_star_eq : ∀ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
      MvPolynomial.aeval (lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star) (Q_star d) = P_R.coeff (d : ℕ) := by
    intro d
    dsimp only [Q_star]
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_bind₁, ← hR_d d]
    change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℂ _) _ (R_d d) =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℂ _) gen (R_d d)
    refine MvPolynomial.eval₂_congr _ _ _ (fun {w c} hwc hcoeff => ?_)
    have hc_supp : c ∈ (R_d d).support := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff
    have hmax_le : wMax w ≤ M_star := by
      calc
        wMax w ≤ cMax c := Finset.le_sup (f := wMax) hwc
        _ ≤ dMax d := Finset.le_sup (f := cMax) hc_supp
        _ ≤ M_star := Finset.le_sup (f := dMax) (Finset.mem_univ d)
    have h_le : w.2.2.1 ≤ M_star ∧ w.2.2.2 ≤ M_star :=
      ⟨le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hmax_le, le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hmax_le⟩
    have htrunc : truncVar w =
        MvPolynomial.X (w.1, w.2.1, ⟨w.2.2.1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_le.1⟩, ⟨w.2.2.2, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h_le.2⟩) := by
      simp [truncVar, h_le]
    simp only [htrunc, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, lineJetTay, gen]
  have hPR_eval : ∀ z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      Polynomial.eval z P_R =
        ∑ d : Fin (D_star + 1),
          MvPolynomial.aeval (lineJetTay B_z (B_z + b_z) M_star) (Q_star d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) := by
    intro z
    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hPR_deg), ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
    rw [hQ_star_eq d]
  let z_seq : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun n => taylor2D (F (1 - 2 * (n : ℤ)) ι_star) (0, 0)
  have hz_root : ∀ n : ℕ, P_R.IsRoot (z_seq n) := by
    intro n
    change Polynomial.eval (z_seq n) P_R = 0
    rw [hPR_eval]
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [← hPR_eval]
      have hz0 : z_seq 0 = taylor2D (F 1 ι_star) (0, 0) := by simp [z_seq]
      rw [hz0]
      dsimp only [P_R]
      rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def]
      exact hP_aeval
    | succ n ih =>
      exact hReflStep M_star D_star Q_star n ih
  let S_roots : Finset (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    (Finset.range (D_star + 1)).image z_seq
  have hS_sub : S_roots.val ⊆ P_R.roots := by
    rw [Multiset.subset_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ S_roots := hx
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx' with ⟨n, _, rfl⟩
    exact (Polynomial.mem_roots hPR_ne).mpr (hz_root n)
  have h_card_le : S_roots.card ≤ P_R.natDegree :=
    Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots hS_sub
  have h_card_eq : S_roots.card = D_star + 1 := by
    dsimp only [S_roots]
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ h_inj, Finset.card_range]
  omega

proof.tactics:
by
  have hOpen : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have deriv_conj_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ) →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (f z)) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, deriv f (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z) := by
    intro σ f hf_holo hf_conj z hz
    have hconj_mem : ∀ {w : ℂ}, w ∈ horizStrip σ → starRingEnd ℂ w ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro w hw
      change |(starRingEnd ℂ w).im| < σ
      change |w.im| < σ at hw
      simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hw
    have hda : HasDerivAt f (deriv f z) z :=
      (hf_holo.differentiableAt ((hOpen σ).mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hda_conj : HasDerivAt f (starRingEnd ℂ (deriv f z)) (starRingEnd ℂ z) := by
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero]
      have hconj_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [map_zero] using
            (Complex.continuous_conj.tendsto (0 : ℂ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h hh
          simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hh ⊢
          exact (map_ne_zero (starRingEnd ℂ)).mpr hh
      have h_lim := (Complex.continuous_conj.tendsto (deriv f z)).comp
        ((hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hda).comp hconj_tendsto)
      refine h_lim.congr' ?_
      have hnhds : {h : ℂ | starRingEnd ℂ z + h ∈ horizStrip σ} ∈
          nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ := by
        apply nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        have hcont : Continuous (fun h : ℂ => starRingEnd ℂ z + h) :=
          continuous_const.add continuous_id
        exact hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          ((hOpen σ).mem_nhds (by simpa using hconj_mem hz))
      filter_upwards [hnhds] with h hh
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def]
      have hz_add : z + starRingEnd ℂ h ∈ horizStrip σ := by
        have h1 := hconj_mem hh
        simpa only [map_add, Complex.conj_conj] using h1

              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_G * shjCompConst p B) * B := hProd.2 m hm z hz
          _ = M_G * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * max B 0 * shjCompConst p B) := by
                rw [max_eq_left hB]
                ring
          _ ≤ M_G * shjCompConst (p + 1) B :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right 1 _) hM_G
  have h_comp_diff_bound :
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' M_G ΔG B Δf : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G₁ G₂ f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V →
        Convex ℝ V →
        0 ≤ M_G →
        0 ≤ ΔG →
        0 ≤ B →
        0 ≤ Δf →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ V →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ V →
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) w‖ ≤ ΔG) →
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G₂ w‖ ≤ M_G) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip σ') →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip σ') →
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₁ z ∈ V) →
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f₂ z ∈ V) →
        (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ ≤ B) →
        (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ ≤ B) →
        IsStripBounded p σ' Δf (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) →
        IsStripBounded p σ' (shjCompConst p B * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_G * Δf))
          (fun z => G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₂ z)) := by
    intro p σ' M_G ΔG B Δf V G₁ G₂ f₁ f₂
      hV_open hV_conv hM_G hΔG hB _hΔf hG₁ hG₂ hG_diff hG₂_bnd
      hf₁_diff hf₂_diff hf₁_maps hf₂_maps hf₁_bnd hf₂_bnd hdf_diff
    have hTerm1 : IsStripBounded p σ' (ΔG * shjCompConst p B)
        (fun z => G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₁ z)) :=
      h_comp_bound p σ' ΔG B V (fun ζ => G₁ ζ - G₂ ζ) f₁
        hV_open hΔG hB (hG₁.sub hG₂) hG_diff hf₁_diff hf₁_maps hf₁_bnd
    let φ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun t z => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * f₂ z + (t : ℂ) * f₁ z
    let F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun t z => deriv G₂ (φ t z)
    have hφ_maps : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', φ t z ∈ V := by
      intro t ht z hz
      have hsmul : ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * f₂ z + (t : ℂ) * f₁ z =
          (1 - t) • f₂ z + t • f₁ z := by
        simp [Complex.real_smul]
      dsimp [φ]
      rw [hsmul]
      exact hV_conv (hf₂_maps z hz) (hf₁_maps z hz) (by linarith [ht.2]) ht.1 (by ring)
    have hφ_diff : ∀ t : ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (φ t) (horizStrip σ') := fun t =>
      (hf₂_diff.const_mul _).add (hf₁_diff.const_mul _)
    have hφ_bnd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖iteratedDeriv j (φ t) z‖ ≤ B := by
      intro t ht j hj1 hjp z hz
      have hc2 : ContDiffAt ℂ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun w => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * f₂ w) z :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (hContDiffAt hf₂_diff hz j)
      have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℂ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun w => (t : ℂ) * f₁ w) z :=
        contDiffAt_const.mul (hContDiffAt hf₁_diff hz j)
      dsimp [φ]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hc2 hc1,
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ (hContDiffAt hf₂_diff hz j),
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ (hContDiffAt hf₁_diff hz j)]
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
      have ht1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith [ht.2]
      calc
        ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j f₂ z + (t : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖
            ≤ ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ +
                ‖(t : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |1 - t| * ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ + |t| * ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ := by
              simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ = (1 - t) * ‖iteratedDeriv j f₂ z‖ + t * ‖iteratedDeriv j f₁ z‖ := by
              rw [abs_of_nonneg ht1, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
        _ ≤ (1 - t) * B + t * B :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf₂_bnd j hj1 hjp z hz) ht1)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf₁_bnd j hj1 hjp z hz) ht0)
        _ = B := by ring
    have hF_strip : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        IsStripBounded p σ' (M_G * shjCompConst p B) (F t) := by
      intro t ht
      apply h_comp_bound p σ' M_G B V (deriv G₂) (φ t) hV_open hM_G hB
        (hG₂.deriv hV_open)
      · intro j hj w hw
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
        exact hG₂_bnd (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) w hw
      · exact hφ_diff t
      · exact hφ_maps t ht
      · exact hφ_bnd t ht
    have hF_cont : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ContinuousOn (fun t => F t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro z hz
      have hφ_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => φ t z) := by
        dsimp [φ]
        fun_prop
      exact (hG₂.deriv hV_open).continuousOn.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn
        (fun t ht => hφ_maps t ht z hz)
    have hCompNonneg : 0 ≤ M_G * shjCompConst p B :=
      mul_nonneg hM_G (le_trans zero_le_one (hOneLeComp p B))
    have hIntBnd : IsStripBounded p σ' (M_G * shjCompConst p B)
        (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) :=
      (h_param_int_bound p σ' (M_G * shjCompConst p B) F hCompNonneg hF_cont hF_strip).1
    have hTerm2 : IsStripBounded p σ'
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * Δf * (M_G * shjCompConst p B))
        (fun z => (f₁ z - f₂ z) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) :=
      h_bounded_mul hdf_diff hIntBnd
    have hSum := h_bounded_add hTerm1 hTerm2
    have hConstEq : ΔG * shjCompConst p B + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * Δf * (M_G * shjCompConst p B) =
        shjCompConst p B * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_G * Δf) := by ring
    rw [hConstEq] at hSum
    refine hBndCongr hSum ?_
    intro z hz
    have hFTC : (f₁ z - f₂ z) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) = G₂ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₂ z) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have hDeriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => G₂ (φ s z)) ((f₁ z - f₂ z) * F t z) t := by
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
        have hφ_eq : (fun s : ℝ => φ s z) = (fun s : ℝ => f₂ z + (s : ℂ) * (f₁ z - f₂ z)) := by
          ext s
          dsimp [φ]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hφ_da : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => φ s z) (f₁ z - f₂ z) t := by
          rw [hφ_eq]
          simpa using
            (((hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp).mul_const (f₁ z - f₂ z)).const_add (f₂ z)
        have hG2_da : HasDerivAt G₂ (F t z) (φ t z) :=
          (hG₂.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds (hφ_maps t ht z hz))).hasDerivAt
        have hsc : HasDerivAt (G₂ ∘ fun s : ℝ => φ s z) ((f₁ z - f₂ z) • F t z) t :=
          hG2_da.scomp t hφ_da
        rwa [smul_eq_mul] at hsc
      have hIntF : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (f₁ z - f₂ z) * F t z)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
        apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
        exact continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont z hz)
      have hSub := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hDeriv hIntF
      have hφ1 : φ 1 z = f₁ z := by dsimp [φ]; norm_num
      have hφ0 : φ 0 z = f₂ z := by dsimp [φ]; norm_num
      rw [hSub, hφ1, hφ0]
    rw [hFTC]
    ring
  
  let V_inv : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (3 / 4)
  have hV_inv_ne : ∀ w ∈ V_inv, w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖w‖⁻¹ ≤ 4 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_lt : ‖w - 1‖ < 3 / 4 := by
      simpa only [V_inv, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hw
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖1 - w‖ + ‖w‖ := by
      simpa using norm_add_le (1 - w) w
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at h1
    have hw_gt : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < ‖w‖ := by linarith
    refine ⟨norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith), ?_⟩
    have hinv := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4) (le_of_lt hw_gt)
    norm_num at hinv
    exact hinv
  have hInvDiffOn : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w⁻¹) V_inv :=
    fun w hw => (differentiableAt_inv (hV_inv_ne w hw).1).differentiableWithinAt
  have hInvIter : ∀ (j : ℕ) {w : ℂ}, w ≠ 0 →
      iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ⁻¹) w =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (j.factorial : ℂ) * (w ^ (j + 1))⁻¹ := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro w _hw
      simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro w hw
      have h_ev : iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ⁻¹) =ᶠ[nhds w]
          (fun ζ : ℂ => (-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (j.factorial : ℂ) * (ζ ^ (j + 1))⁻¹) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hw) (fun ζ hζ => ih hζ)
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, h_ev.deriv_eq]
      have hpow_ne : w ^ (j + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero (j + 1) hw
      have hda_inv : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (ζ ^ (j + 1))⁻¹)
          (-(((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * w ^ j) / (w ^ (j + 1)) ^ 2) w :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow (j + 1) w).inv hpow_ne
      have hda := hda_inv.const_mul ((-1 : ℂ) ^ j * (j.factorial : ℂ))
      rw [hda.deriv, Nat.factorial_succ]
      have hw_pow2 : w ^ (j + 2) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero (j + 2) hw
      field_simp [hw, hpow_ne, hw_pow2]
      push_cast
      ring
  have hInvBnd : ∀ (p j : ℕ), j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ w ∈ V_inv,
      ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ⁻¹) w‖ ≤
        ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2) := by
    intro p j hj w hw
    obtain ⟨hw_ne, hw_inv⟩ := hV_inv_ne w hw
    rw [hInvIter j hw_ne, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      Complex.norm_natCast, norm_inv, norm_pow, ← inv_pow]
    have hfac : (j.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.factorial_le hj)
    have hpow1 : (‖w‖⁻¹) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg w)) hw_inv (j + 1)
    have hpow2 : (4 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2) :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj)
    exact mul_le_mul hfac (le_trans hpow1 hpow2)
      (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg w)) _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hMapsVinv : ∀ {σ' : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', g z ∈ V_inv := by
    intro σ' g hg z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    linarith [hg z hz]
  have h_holo_inv : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g : ℝ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      0 ≤ M_g →
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M_g g →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ'
        ((((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g)
        (fun z => (g z)⁻¹) := by
    intro p σ' M_g g hM_g hg hg_half
    have hM_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2) := by positivity
    have hBnd := h_comp_bound p σ' (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) M_g
      V_inv (fun w => w⁻¹) g Metric.isOpen_ball hM_inv_nonneg hM_g hInvDiffOn
      (fun j hj w hw => hInvBnd p j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj) w hw)
      hg.1.1 (hMapsVinv hg_half) (fun j _hj1 hjp z hz => hg.1.2 j hjp z hz)
    refine ⟨hBnd, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      dsimp only
      rw [hg.2.1 z hz]
    · intro z hz
      dsimp only
      rw [hg.2.2 z hz, map_inv₀]
  have h_bounded_inv_diff : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_g Δg : ℝ} {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      0 ≤ M_g →
      0 ≤ Δg →
      IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₁ →
      IsStripBounded p σ' M_g g₂ →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₁ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖g₂ z - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      IsStripBounded p σ' Δg (fun z => g₁ z - g₂ z) →
      IsStripBounded p σ'
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g * Δg)
        (fun z => (g₁ z)⁻¹ - (g₂ z)⁻¹) := by
    intro p σ' M_g Δg g₁ g₂ hM_g hΔg hg₁ hg₂ hg₁_half hg₂_half hdg
    have hM_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2) := by positivity
    have hZeroBnd : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ w ∈ V_inv,
        ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ⁻¹ - ζ⁻¹) w‖ ≤ (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro j _hj w _hw
      have h0 : (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ⁻¹ - ζ⁻¹) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
        funext fun ζ => sub_self ζ⁻¹
      rw [h0, iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hCompDiff := h_comp_diff_bound p σ'
      (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) 0 M_g Δg V_inv
      (fun w => w⁻¹) (fun w => w⁻¹) g₁ g₂
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball (1 : ℂ) (3 / 4))
      hM_inv_nonneg le_rfl hM_g hΔg hInvDiffOn hInvDiffOn
      hZeroBnd (hInvBnd p) hg₁.1 hg₂.1
      (hMapsVinv hg₁_half) (hMapsVinv hg₂_half)
      (fun j _hj1 hjp z hz => hg₁.2 j hjp z hz)
      (fun j _hj1 hjp z hz => hg₂.2 j hjp z hz)
      hdg
    have hEqConst :
        shjCompConst p M_g *
          (0 + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * Δg) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) *
          shjCompConst p M_g * Δg := by ring
    rw [hEqConst] at hCompDiff
    exact hCompDiff
  exact {
    vert_strip_maps_to := h_vert_strip_maps_to
    stripExt_iteratedDeriv_props := h_stripExt_iteratedDeriv_props
    stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le := h_stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le
    real_iteratedDeriv_eq := h_real_iteratedDeriv_eq

    holo_const_real := h_holo_const_real

    holo_mono := h_holo_mono
    bounded_add := h_bounded_add
    holo_add := h_holo_add
    bounded_sub := h_bounded_sub
    holo_sub := h_holo_sub
    bounded_neg := h_bounded_neg
    holo_neg := h_holo_neg
    bounded_const_mul := h_bounded_const_mul
    holo_real_mul := h_holo_real_mul
    bounded_mul := h_bounded_mul
    holo_mul := h_holo_mul
    bounded_mul_diff := h_bounded_mul_diff
    holo_inv := h_holo_inv
    bounded_inv_diff := h_bounded_inv_diff
    exp_ball_bound := h_exp_ball_bound
    sin_ball_bound := h_sin_ball_bound

by
  have hOpen : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ) := by
    intro σ

  have hRealMem : ∀ {σ : ℝ} (r : ℝ), 0 < σ → (r : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ r hσ

    simpa using hσ

      X₀ ∈ horizStrip σ →
      X₀ + y ∈ horizStrip σ →
      Complex.exp (W (X₀ + y) - W X₀) =

      have hc2 : ContinuousOn D₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (hIter hW 2).continuousOn.comp hZ_cont.continuousOn hZ_maps

      X₀ ∈ horizStrip σ →

                    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * w_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * w_z ^ 2 +
                      2 * T₀ ^ 2 * w_z ^ 3 + T₀ ^ 3 * w_z ^ 4))) := by
      dsimp [z_exp, w_z, v_z, c₂]
      ring
    have hz_exp_eq : z_exp = z₀ := hz₀_eq.symm
    rw [hz_exp_eq] at hPolyJet
    have hA₀_sq : A₀ ^ 2 = Complex.exp (2 * W X₀) := by
      dsimp [A₀]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add, two_mul]
    rw [hActInt]
    unfold aCanon_C bPoint_C
    change (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (T₀ * z₀) ^ 2 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * α₀ * (T₀ * z₀) ^ 3 +
        c₂ * (T₀ * z₀) ^ 4 + (T₀ * z₀) ^ 5 * rI_C W X₀ (T₀ * z₀) =
      T₀ ^ 2 *
        ((1 / 8 : ℂ) + ((7 * β₀ - 8 * α₀ ^ 2 - Complex.exp (2 * W X₀)) / 384) * T₀ ^ 2 +
          T₀ ^ 3 *
            ((((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_z + (α₀ / 8) * v_z + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * v_z ^ 2) -
                ((3 * α₀ / 8) * v_z + (3 * α₀ / 4) * w_z ^ 2 +
                  (α₀ / 2) * T₀ * w_z ^ 3) +
                c₂ *
                  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * w_z + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * T₀ * w_z ^ 2 +
                    2 * T₀ ^ 2 * w_z ^ 3 + T₀ ^ 3 * w_z ^ 4)) +
              z₀ ^ 5 * rI_C W X₀ (T₀ * z₀)))
    rw [← hA₀_sq]
    linear_combination hPolyJet
  refine {
    midStepOp_C_fixed_iff := hMidIff
    real_midpoint_and_action_eq := ?_
  }
  intro σ w W X_r T_r z_r hσ hw hW hW_real hFix
  have hw_cont : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hW0 : ∀ r : ℝ, W (r : ℂ) = (w r : ℂ) := by
    intro r
    have h0 := hW_real 0 (by omega) r
    simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h0
  have hXr_mem : (X_r : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := hRealMem X_r hσ
  have hXTr_mem : (X_r : ℂ) + (T_r : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    simpa [← Complex.ofReal_add] using hRealMem (X_r + T_r) hσ
  have hXTzr_mem : (X_r : ℂ) + (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    simpa [← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_add] using hRealMem (X_r + T_r * z_r) hσ
  have hMidInt :
      (z_r : ℂ) *
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ))) =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
          (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ))) :=
    (hMidIff σ W (X_r : ℂ) (T_r : ℂ) (z_r : ℂ) hσ hW hXr_mem hXTr_mem hXTzr_mem).mp hFix
  have hPhiDeriv : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ w) (Real.exp (w z)) z := by
    intro z
    unfold primPhi_ℝ
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      ((Real.continuous_exp.comp hw_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 z)
      ((Real.continuous_exp.comp hw_cont).stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _)
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp hw_cont).continuousAt
  have hPhiDiff : Differentiable ℝ (primPhi_ℝ w) :=
    fun z => (hPhiDeriv z).differentiableAt
  have hPhiStrict : StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ w) := by
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro z
    rw [(hPhiDeriv z).deriv]
    exact Real.exp_pos (w z)
  have hPhiInj : Function.Injective (primPhi_ℝ w) := hPhiStrict.injective
  have hPhiSeg : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      primPhi_ℝ w (a + b) - primPhi_ℝ w a =
        Real.exp (w a) * b * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (a + s * b) - w a) := by
    intro a b
    have hd : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ w (a + t * b))
          ((Real.exp (w a) * b) * Real.exp (w (a + s * b) - w a)) s := by
      intro s _
      have hin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a + t * b) b s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const b).const_add a
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ w (a + t * b))
          (Real.exp (w (a + s * b)) * b) s := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using (hPhiDeriv (a + s * b)).comp s hin
      have hexp : (Real.exp (w a) * b) * Real.exp (w (a + s * b) - w a) =
          Real.exp (w (a + s * b)) * b := by
        have h1 : Real.exp (w a) * Real.exp (w (a + s * b) - w a) = Real.exp (w (a + s * b)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
        linear_combination b * h1
      rwa [hexp]
    have hcont : Continuous
        (fun s : ℝ => (Real.exp (w a) * b) * Real.exp (w (a + s * b) - w a)) :=
      continuous_const.mul
        (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
            continuous_const))
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
    simpa using hFTC.symm
  have hIntCoerce : ∀ b : ℝ,
      (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ))) =
        ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + s * b) - w X_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro b
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    dsimp only
    have harg : (X_r : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * (b : ℂ) = ((X_r + s * b : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [harg, hW0 (X_r + s * b), hW0 X_r]
    norm_cast
  have hMidRealInt :
      z_r * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + θ * (T_r * z_r)) - w X_r)) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + v * T_r) - w X_r)) := by
    have hL :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ))) =
          ((∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + θ * (T_r * z_r)) - w X_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hassoc :
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ))) =
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              Complex.exp (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * ((T_r * z_r : ℝ) : ℂ)) - W (X_r : ℂ)) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro θ _
        dsimp only
        have heq : (θ : ℂ) * (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ) = (θ : ℂ) * ((T_r * z_r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [heq]
      rw [hassoc, hIntCoerce (T_r * z_r)]
    have hR := hIntCoerce T_r
    have hc := hMidInt
    rw [hL, hR] at hc
    exact Complex.ofReal_inj.mp (by push_cast; simpa using hc)
  have hPhiMid :
      (primPhi_ℝ w X_r + primPhi_ℝ w (X_r + T_r)) / 2 = primPhi_ℝ w (X_r + T_r * z_r) := by
    have h1 := hPhiSeg X_r (T_r * z_r)
    have h2 := hPhiSeg X_r T_r
    have hmul := congrArg (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (w X_r) * T_r * u) hMidRealInt
    linarith
  have hMidEq : midpoint_ℝ w X_r (X_r + T_r) = X_r + T_r * z_r := by
    unfold midpoint_ℝ
    rw [hPhiMid]
    exact Function.leftInverse_invFun hPhiInj (X_r + T_r * z_r)
  refine ⟨hMidEq, ?_⟩
  intro hmFac
  let H_r : ℝ := T_r * z_r
  have hActReal :
      normAction1_ℝ w X_r (X_r + T_r) =
        H_r *
          (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            (Real.exp (w X_r))⁻¹ *
              Real.sin
                (Real.exp (w X_r) * (τ * H_r) *
                  (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + s * (τ * H_r)) - w X_r))) *
              Real.exp (-2 * (w (X_r + τ * H_r) - w X_r))) := by
    unfold normAction1_ℝ
    rw [hMidEq]
    let g_act : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
      Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X_r) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)
    have hg_cont : Continuous g_act :=
      (Real.continuous_sin.comp (hPhiDiff.continuous.sub continuous_const)).mul
        (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul hw_cont))
    let f_aff : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => X_r + τ * H_r
    have hf_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt f_aff H_r τ := by
      intro τ _
      simpa [f_aff] using ((hasDerivAt_id τ).mul_const H_r).const_add X_r
    have hSubInt :
        (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, H_r • (g_act ∘ f_aff) τ) =
          ∫ z in f_aff 0..f_aff 1, g_act z :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_smul_comp hf_deriv continuousOn_const hg_cont
    have hf0 : f_aff 0 = X_r := by dsimp [f_aff]; ring
    have hf1 : f_aff 1 = X_r + T_r * z_r := by dsimp [f_aff, H_r]; ring
    rw [hf0, hf1] at hSubInt
    change Real.exp (w X_r) * (∫ z in X_r..(X_r + T_r * z_r), g_act z) = _
    rw [← hSubInt]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (Real.exp (w X_r)) H_r,
      mul_assoc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro τ _
    dsimp [g_act, f_aff]
    rw [hPhiSeg X_r (τ * H_r)]
    have hexp_id :
        Real.exp (w X_r) * Real.exp (-2 * w (X_r + τ * H_r)) =
          (Real.exp (w X_r))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-2 * (w (X_r + τ * H_r) - w X_r)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    linear_combination
      Real.sin
        (Real.exp (w X_r) * (τ * H_r) *
          ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + s * (τ * H_r)) - w X_r)) * hexp_id
  have hActBridge :
      ((normAction1_ℝ w X_r (X_r + T_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)) *
          (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            (Complex.exp (W (X_r : ℂ)))⁻¹ *
              Complex.sin
                (Complex.exp (W (X_r : ℂ)) * ((τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ))) *
                  (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
                    Complex.exp
                      (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * ((τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)))) -
                        W (X_r : ℂ)))) *
              Complex.exp
                (-2 * (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ))) - W (X_r : ℂ)))) := by
    rw [hActReal, Complex.ofReal_mul]
    have hHr : ((H_r : ℝ) : ℂ) = (T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ) := by dsimp [H_r]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [hHr, ← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro τ _
    dsimp only
    have hIn :
        ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (X_r + s * (τ * H_r)) - w X_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.exp
              (W ((X_r : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * ((τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)))) -
                W (X_r : ℂ)) := by
      rw [← hIntCoerce (τ * H_r)]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      dsimp only
      have heq : (s : ℂ) * ((τ * H_r : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (s : ℂ) * ((τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ))) := by
        dsimp [H_r]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [heq]
    have hArgτ : (X_r : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * ((T_r : ℂ) * (z_r : ℂ)) =
        ((X_r + τ * H_r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [H_r]
      push_cast
      ring
    push_cast
    rw [hIn, hArgτ, hW0 (X_r + τ * H_r), hW0 X_r, hHr]
  exact hActBridge.trans (hJetAlg hW hXr_mem hXTr_mem hXTzr_mem hMidInt hmFac)

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  let p : ℕ := m + 2
  let r₀ : ℕ := m + 15
  let slopeMoment : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun W X Y =>
    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (θ : ℂ) * expSlope_C W X ((θ : ℂ) * Y)
  let midMOp : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun W X T ζ =>
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * slopeMoment W X T -
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ) ^ 2 * slopeMoment W X (T * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ζ))
  have hMidStepFact : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X T ζ : ℂ),
      midStepOp_C W X T ζ = T * midMOp W X T ζ := by
    intro W X T ζ
    simp only [midStepOp_C, midMOp, slopeMoment, mul_assoc]
  
  have hStripOpen : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    have hEq : horizStrip H = Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext s; simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
    rw [hEq]
    exact isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  have hStripConvex : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    have hEq : horizStrip H = Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext s; simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
  have hStripPer : ∀ (H : ℝ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(z + 2 * Real.pi).im| < H
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    have him : (z + 2 * Real.pi).im = z.im := by simp
    rwa [him]
  have hStripConj : ∀ (H : ℝ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip H → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < H
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    rwa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg]
  have hBoundedCongr : ∀ {p₀ : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f z = g z) →
      IsStripBounded p₀ σ' M g →
      IsStripBounded p₀ σ' M f := by
    intro p₀ σ' M f g hEq hg
    refine ⟨hg.1.congr hEq, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z hz
    have hEv : f =ᶠ[nhds z] g :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hStripOpen σ').mem_nhds hz) hEq
    rw [hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
    exact hg.2 k hk z hz
  have hShjPos : ∀ (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 0 < shjCompConst k B := by
    intro k B
    have h1 : 1 ≤ shjCompConst k B := by
      cases k with
      | zero => exact le_rfl
      | succ k' => exact le_max_left 1 _
    linarith
  have hShiftDerivBnd : ∀ (p₀ : ℕ) (σ' ρ M_g : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsStripBounded p₀ σ' M_g g →
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p₀ → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun w => w + (ρ : ℂ) + g w) z‖ ≤ 1 + M_g := by
    intro p₀ σ' ρ M_g g hg j hj1 hj2 z hz
    cases j with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
      have hAff_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun w : ℂ => w + (ρ : ℂ)) z :=
        (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffAt
      have hg_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g z :=
        (hg.1.contDiffOn (hStripOpen σ')).contDiffAt ((hStripOpen σ').mem_nhds hz)
      have hEqAdd : iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun w => w + (ρ : ℂ) + g w) z =
          iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun w => w + (ρ : ℂ)) z + iteratedDeriv (k + 1) g z :=
        iteratedDeriv_fun_add hAff_cd hg_cd
      have hDerivAff : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w + (ρ : ℂ)) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
        ext w; simp
      have hAffBnd : ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun w : ℂ => w + (ρ : ℂ)) z‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hDerivAff, iteratedDeriv_const]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      calc
        ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun w => w + (ρ : ℂ) + g w) z‖
            ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun w => w + (ρ : ℂ)) z‖ + ‖iteratedDeriv (k + 1) g z‖ := by
              rw [hEqAdd]; exact norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 1 + M_g := add_le_add hAffBnd (hg.2 (k + 1) hj2 z hz)
  
  have hPertBounds : ∀ (p₀ q : ℕ) (σ' α c_T : ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℂ → ℂ),
      4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
      IsStripJetPerturb p₀ σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
      IsStripJetPerturb p₀ σ' α ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' 1 e_X ∧
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' 1 τ_T ∧
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' (7 / (q : ℝ)) (fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T z) := by
    intro p₀ q σ' α c_T e_X τ_T hq hc_T he hτ
    have hq_real : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hInv_le : (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by positivity) zero_lt_one]
      linarith
    have he_raw : IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X :=
      ⟨⟨he.1, he.2.2.2.2⟩, he.2.1, he.2.2.1⟩
    have hτ_raw : IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T :=
      ⟨⟨hτ.1, hτ.2.2.2.2⟩, hτ.2.1, hτ.2.2.1⟩
    have hT_raw : IsStripHoloSymBounded p₀ σ' (|c_T| + (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹)
        (fun z => (c_T : ℂ) + τ_T z) :=
      hCalc.holo_add (hCalc.holo_const_real p₀ σ' c_T) hτ_raw
    have hT_le : |c_T| + (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 7 / (q : ℝ) := by
      have hpi := Real.pi_lt_d2
      have hInv_eq : (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by ring
      have hSum : 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ≤ 7 / (q : ℝ) := by
        rw [← add_div]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hq_pos)
      linarith
    exact ⟨hCalc.holo_mono hInv_le he_raw,
      hCalc.holo_mono hInv_le hτ_raw,
      hCalc.holo_mono hT_le hT_raw⟩
  have hEvalMaps : ∀ (p₀ q : ℕ) (σ σ' α ρ c_T C_0 K_mid c u_0 : ℝ) (e_X τ_T ζ : ℂ → ℂ),
      1 ≤ p₀ → 4 ≤ q → 0 < σ → 0 < σ' → α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 16) →
      0 ≤ C_0 → 28 * C_0 ≤ K_mid →

    obtain ⟨he_b, _, hT_7q⟩ := hPertBounds p q σ' α c_T e_X τ_T hq_four hc_T he hτ
    obtain ⟨hMaps, _, _, _, hZetaC0, hZetaFix⟩ :=
      hZetaSharpCore σ σ' α ρ c_T q w W e_X τ_T hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hw hW he hτ
    let X : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z + (ρ : ℂ) + e_X z

    have hHalf : IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' (1 / 2) (fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℂ)) := by

      intro x

      have hRealSymImZero : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ),

      have hX_re : ((X (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) = X (x : ℂ) := by

      have hT_re : ((T (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) = T (x : ℂ) := by

      have hW_real_deriv : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 → ∀ r : ℝ,

      have hFix_r : (z_r : ℂ) - (1 / 2 : ℂ) =
          midStepOp_C W ((X (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) ((T (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) ((z_r : ℂ) - (1 / 2 : ℂ)) := by

        _ ≤ C_mid_C := by
          dsimp [C_mid_C]

  · 
    intro σ σ' α ρ Δe Δτ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂
      hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hde hdτ
    dsimp only
    let c_T : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)

    have hc_T : |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hc_T_nn]
    have hq_seven : 7 ≤ q := le_trans hNmid_ge_seven hq

    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by

    have hq_ne : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
    obtain ⟨hΔW_nn, _⟩ := hCalc.stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le r₀ σ M₁ w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ hσ.1 hW₁ hW₂
    obtain ⟨_, _, hT₁_7q⟩ := hPertBounds p q σ' α c_T e_X₁ τ_T₁ hq_four hc_T he₁ hτ₁
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hZeta₂_C0, _⟩ :=
      hZetaSharpCore σ σ' α ρ c_T q w₂ W₂ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hw₂ hW₂ he₂ hτ₂
    have hZetaLip := hZetaLipSharp σ σ' α ρ c_T Δe Δτ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂
      hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hde hdτ

    have hDispDiff :
        (fun ζ => (μ₁ ζ - (X₁ ζ + T₁ ζ / 2)) - (μ₂ ζ - (X₂ ζ + T₂ ζ / 2))) =

      dsimp [S_mid]; exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg hΔe (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hq_pos) hΔτ)) hΔW_nn
    calc
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k

            dsimp [S_mid]; field_simp [hq_ne]

  · 
    intro σ σ' α ρ c_T q w W e_X τ_T hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hw hW he hτ

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hStrip_open : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hStrip_convex : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    have hEq : horizStrip H = Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext z
      simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
  have hStrip_sym : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip H →
      z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H ∧ starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z hz
    change |z.im| < H at hz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change |(z + 2 * Real.pi).im| < H
      simpa using hz
    · change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < H
      simpa using hz
  have hBnd_congr : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsStripBounded p σ' M f → (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', g z = f z) →
      IsStripBounded p σ' M g := by
    intro p σ' M f g hf hgf
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr hgf, ?_⟩
    intro k hk z hz
    have hEv : g =ᶠ[nhds z] f :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hStrip_open σ').mem_nhds hz) hgf
    rw [hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq]
    exact hf.2 k hk z hz
  have hHolo_congr : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f → (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', g z = f z) →
      IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M g := by
    intro p σ' M f g hf hgf
    refine ⟨hBnd_congr hf.1 hgf, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hz
      rw [hgf (z + 2 * Real.pi) (hStrip_sym hz).1, hgf z hz, hf.2.1 z hz]
    · intro z hz
      rw [hgf (starRingEnd ℂ z) (hStrip_sym hz).2, hgf z hz, hf.2.2 z hz]
  have hPair_congr : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M L Δ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M L Δ f₁ f₂ →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', g₁ z = f₁ z) →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', g₂ z = f₂ z) →
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M L Δ g₁ g₂ := by
    intro p σ' M L Δ f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg₁ hg₂
    refine ⟨hf.1, hf.2.1, hf.2.2.1, hHolo_congr hf.2.2.2.1 hg₁, hHolo_congr hf.2.2.2.2.1 hg₂, ?_⟩
    exact hBnd_congr hf.2.2.2.2.2 (fun z hz => by simp [hg₁ z hz, hg₂ z hz])
  have hCont_rSinc : Continuous rSinc_C := by
    have hInner : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℝ =>
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.sin (((s * p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * p.1)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      fun_prop
    have hOuter : Continuous (fun u : ℂ =>
        ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (r : ℂ) ^ 3 *
            (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.sin (((s * r : ℝ) : ℂ) * u))) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      have h1 : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℝ => (p.2 : ℂ) ^ 3) := by fun_prop
      exact h1.mul hInner
    exact continuous_const.mul hOuter
  have hCompConst_pos : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ shjCompConst p B := by
    intro p B
    cases p with
    | zero => simp [shjCompConst]
    | succ k =>
      simp only [shjCompConst]
      exact le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left 1 _)
  have hPair_const_real : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' c Δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Δ →
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' |c| 0 Δ (fun _ => (c : ℂ)) (fun _ => (c : ℂ)) := by
    intro p σ' c Δ hΔ
    refine ⟨abs_nonneg c, le_rfl, hΔ, hCalc.holo_const_real p σ' c, hCalc.holo_const_real p σ' c, ?_⟩
    have h0 := hCalc.bounded_const p σ' (0 : ℂ)
    rw [norm_zero, ← zero_mul Δ] at h0
    exact hBnd_congr h0 (fun _ _ => sub_self _)
  have hPair_mono : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M₁ M₂ L₁ L₂ Δ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      M₁ ≤ M₂ → L₁ ≤ L₂ → sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M₁ L₁ Δ f₁ f₂ →
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M₂ L₂ Δ f₁ f₂ := by
    intro p σ' M₁ M₂ L₁ L₂ Δ f₁ f₂ hM hL hf
    refine ⟨le_trans hf.1 hM, le_trans hf.2.1 hL, hf.2.2.1,
      hCalc.holo_mono hM hf.2.2.2.1, hCalc.holo_mono hM hf.2.2.2.2.1,
      hCalc.bounded_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL hf.2.2.1) hf.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  have hPair_add : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f L_f M_g L_g Δ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M_f L_f Δ f₁ f₂ →
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M_g L_g Δ g₁ g₂ →
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' (M_f + M_g) (L_f + L_g) Δ
        (fun z => f₁ z + g₁ z) (fun z => f₂ z + g₂ z) := by
    intro p σ' M_f L_f M_g L_g Δ f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf hg
    refine ⟨add_nonneg hf.1 hg.1, add_nonneg hf.2.1 hg.2.1, hf.2.2.1,
      hCalc.holo_add hf.2.2.2.1 hg.2.2.2.1, hCalc.holo_add hf.2.2.2.2.1 hg.2.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have hDiff := hCalc.bounded_add hf.2.2.2.2.2 hg.2.2.2.2.2
    rw [← add_mul] at hDiff
    exact hBnd_congr hDiff (fun _ _ => by ring)
  have hPair_sub : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' M_f L_f M_g L_g Δ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      sjcHoloLipPair p σ' M_f L_f Δ f₁ f₂ →

    have hZero_a : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' 1 0 Δ_a (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
      hPair_mono (by norm_num) le_rfl (hPair_const_real p σ' 0 Δ_a hΔa_nn)
    have hSeg0 : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        X₁ z + (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧ X₂ z + (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨by simpa using (hSeg₁ 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩ z hz).1,
        by simpa using (hSeg₂ 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩ z hz).1⟩
    have hw0_a : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' _ _ Δ_a
        (fun z => W₁ (X₁ z)) (fun z => W₂ (X₂ z)) :=
      hPair_congr (hEvalGen Δ_a le_rfl 0 _ _ hZero_a hSeg0 0 (by omega))
        (fun _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ => by simp)
    have hw1_a : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' _ _ Δ_a
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv 1 W₁ (X₁ z)) (fun z => iteratedDeriv 1 W₂ (X₂ z)) :=
      hPair_congr (hEvalGen Δ_a le_rfl 0 _ _ hZero_a hSeg0 1 (by omega))
        (fun _ _ => by simp only [add_zero]) (fun _ _ => by simp only [add_zero])
    have hw2_a : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' _ _ Δ_a
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv 2 W₁ (X₁ z)) (fun z => iteratedDeriv 2 W₂ (X₂ z)) :=
      hPair_congr (hEvalGen Δ_a le_rfl 0 _ _ hZero_a hSeg0 2 (by omega))
        (fun _ _ => by simp only [add_zero]) (fun _ _ => by simp only [add_zero])
    have h2W_a : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' _ _ Δ_a
        (fun z => 2 * W₁ (X₁ z)) (fun z => 2 * W₂ (X₂ z)) :=
      hPair_congr (hPair_real_mul 2 hw0_a)
        (fun _ _ => by push_cast; ring) (fun _ _ => by push_cast; ring)
    have hexp2W := hPair_exp h2W_a
    have ha_raw := hPair_real_mul (1 / 384 : ℝ)
      (hPair_sub
        (hPair_sub (hPair_real_mul 7 hw2_a) (hPair_real_mul 8 (hPair_pow 2 hw1_a)))
        hexp2W)
    have ha_pair : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' _ _ Δ_a
        (fun z => aCanon_C W₁ (X₁ z)) (fun z => aCanon_C W₂ (X₂ z)) :=
      hPair_congr ha_raw
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp [aCanon_C]; push_cast; ring)
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp [aCanon_C]; push_cast; ring)

    
    have hT_diff : IsStripBounded p σ' (1 * Δ_b) (fun z => T₁ z - T₂ z) :=
      hBnd_congr
        (hCalc.bounded_mono (by linarith) ⟨hτ₁.1.sub hτ₂.1, hdτ⟩)
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp [T₁, T₂]; ring)
    have hT_pair : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' 1 1 Δ_b T₁ T₂ :=
      ⟨zero_le_one, zero_le_one, hΔb_nn, hT₁_1, hT₂_1, hT_diff⟩
    have hz₀_diff : IsStripBounded p σ' (1 * Δ_b) (fun z => z₀₁ z - z₀₂ z) :=
      hBnd_congr
        (hCalc.bounded_mono (by linarith) hdζ)
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp [z₀₁, z₀₂]; ring)
    have hz₀_pair : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' 1 1 Δ_b z₀₁ z₀₂ :=
      ⟨zero_le_one, zero_le_one, hΔb_nn, hz₀₁_1, hz₀₂_1, hz₀_diff⟩
    have hH_diff : IsStripBounded p σ' ((2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ p) * Δ_b)
        (fun z => T₁ z * z₀₁ z - T₂ z * z₀₂ z) := by
      have hm := hCalc.bounded_mul_diff hT₁_1.1 hz₀₂_1.1 hT_diff hz₀_diff
      have hEq : (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (1 * (1 * Δ_b) + (1 * Δ_b) * 1) =
          (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ p) * Δ_b := by ring
      rwa [hEq] at hm
    have hH_pair : sjcHoloLipPair p σ' 1 (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ p) Δ_b
        (fun z => T₁ z * z₀₁ z) (fun z => T₂ z * z₀₂ z) :=
      ⟨zero_le_one, by positivity, hΔb_nn, hH₁_1, hH₂_1, hH_diff⟩
    have hAdm : sjcAdmissibleEval m M₁ σ σ' Δ_b w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X₁ T₁ z₀₁ X₂ T₂ z₀₂ :=
      ⟨hσ.1, hσ', hΔb_nn, hW₁, hW₂, hT_pair, hz₀_pair, hH_pair,
        fun c hc z hz => ⟨⟨(hSeg₁ c hc z hz).1, (hSeg₂ c hc z hz).1⟩,
          ⟨(hSeg₁ c hc z hz).2, (hSeg₂ c hc z hz).2⟩⟩,
        hEvalGen Δ_b (by linarith),
        fun z hz => ⟨hmClose₁ z hz, hmClose₂ z hz⟩⟩
    exact ⟨ha_pair, hAdm⟩

  obtain ⟨M_a, L_a, hFourthAdm⟩ := h_fourth_and_adm

  
  let C_jet_raw : ℝ := max 1 (max (max M_a L_a) (max M_b L_b))
  have hC_pos : 0 < C_jet_raw := lt_max_of_lt_left zero_lt_one
  have hMa_le : M_a ≤ C_jet_raw :=
    le_trans (le_max_left M_a L_a) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right 1 _))
  have hLa_le : L_a ≤ C_jet_raw :=
    le_trans (le_max_right M_a L_a) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right 1 _))
  have hMb_le : M_b ≤ C_jet_raw :=
    le_trans (le_max_left M_b L_b) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 1 _))
  have hLb_le : L_b ≤ C_jet_raw :=
    le_trans (le_max_right M_b L_b) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right 1 _))

  refine ⟨{
    C_jet_raw := C_jet_raw
    K_jet := K_jet
    N_jet := N_jet
    C_jet_raw_pos := hC_pos
    K_jet_pos := hKj_pos
    N_jet_ge_four := hNj_ge
    jet_comp_props := ?_
    jet_comp_lip := ?_
  }⟩
  · 
    intro σ σ' α ρ c_T q w W e_X τ_T ζ hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T _ hW he hτ hζ
    have hZeroBnd : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ') →
        IsStripBounded (m + 2) σ' 0 (fun w => f w - f w) := by
      intro f _
      have h0 := hCalc.bounded_const (m + 2) σ' (0 : ℂ)
      rw [norm_zero] at h0
      exact hBnd_congr h0 (fun _ _ => sub_self _)
    obtain ⟨ha_diag, hAdm_diag⟩ :=
      hFourthAdm σ σ' α ρ c_T 0 0 0 q w w W W e_X τ_T ζ e_X τ_T ζ
        hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl hW hW he hτ he hτ hζ hζ
        (fun k hk z hz => (hZeroBnd e_X he.1).2 k hk z hz)
        (fun k hk z hz => (hZeroBnd τ_T hτ.1).2 k hk z hz)
        (hZeroBnd ζ hζ.1.1)
    have hb_diag := hbPoint σ σ' _ w w W W _ _ _ _ _ _ hAdm_diag
    refine ⟨?_, hCalc.holo_mono hMa_le ha_diag.2.2.2.1,
      hCalc.holo_mono hMb_le hb_diag.2.2.2.1⟩
    intro z hz hEqZero
    have hmClose := (hAdm_diag.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 z hz).1
    dsimp only at hmClose
    rw [hEqZero] at hmClose
    norm_num at hmClose
  · 
    intro σ σ' α ρ c_T Δe Δτ Δζ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ ζ₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ ζ₂
      hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hΔe hΔτ hΔζ _ _ hW₁ hW₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hζ₁ hζ₂ hde hdτ hdζ
    obtain ⟨ha_pair, hAdm⟩ :=
      hFourthAdm σ σ' α ρ c_T Δe Δτ Δζ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ ζ₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ ζ₂
        hσ hq hα hσ' hσ'_le hc_T hΔe hΔτ hΔζ hW₁ hW₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hζ₁ hζ₂ hde hdτ hdζ
    have hb_pair := hbPoint σ σ' _ w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ _ _ _ _ _ _ hAdm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk z hz
      exact le_trans (ha_pair.2.2.2.2.2.2 k hk z hz)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLa_le ha_pair.2.2.1)
    · intro k hk z hz
      exact le_trans (hb_pair.2.2.2.2.2.2 k hk z hz)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLb_le hb_pair.2.2.1)

strip_jet_composition_and_lipschitz.definitions:
def sjcHoloLipPair (p : ℕ) (σ' M L Δ : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ 0 ≤ Δ ∧
  IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f₁ ∧
  IsStripHoloSymBounded p σ' M f₂ ∧
  IsStripBounded p σ' (L * Δ) (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z)

noncomputable def sjcPowM (p : ℕ) (M : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | d + 1 => (2 : ℝ) ^ p * sjcPowM p M d * M

noncomputable def sjcPowL (p : ℕ) (M L : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 0
  | d + 1 => (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (sjcPowM p M d * L + sjcPowL p M L d * M)

noncomputable def sjcInvM (p : ℕ) (M_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ) ^ (p + 2)) * shjCompConst p M_g

noncomputable def sjcInvL (p : ℕ) (M_g L_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * sjcInvM p M_g * L_g

noncomputable def sjcDivM (p : ℕ) (M_f M_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_f * sjcInvM p M_g

noncomputable def sjcDivL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f M_g L_g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_f * sjcInvL p M_g L_g + L_f * sjcInvM p M_g)

noncomputable def sjcExpM (p : ℕ) (M_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (M_f + 1) * shjCompConst p M_f

noncomputable def sjcExpL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  shjCompConst p M_f * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * Real.exp (M_f + 1) * L_f)

noncomputable def sjcSincM (p : ℕ) (M_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sjcExpM p M_f

noncomputable def sjcSincL (p : ℕ) (M_f L_f : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sjcExpL p M_f L_f

def sjcAdmissibleEval (m : ℕ) (M₁ σ σ' Δ : ℝ)
    (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ X₁ T₁ z₀₁ X₂ T₂ z₀₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  0 < σ ∧ 0 < σ' ∧ 0 ≤ Δ ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ ∧
  IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 1 Δ T₁ T₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 1 Δ z₀₁ z₀₂ ∧
  sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 2)) Δ
    (fun z => T₁ z * z₀₁ z) (fun z => T₂ z * z₀₂ z) ∧
  (∀ c ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    (X₁ z + (c : ℂ) * T₁ z ∈ horizStrip σ ∧ X₂ z + (c : ℂ) * T₂ z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
    (X₁ z + (c : ℂ) * (T₁ z * z₀₁ z) ∈ horizStrip σ ∧
      X₂ z + (c : ℂ) * (T₂ z * z₀₂ z) ∈ horizStrip σ)) ∧
  (∀ (L_y : ℝ) (y₁ y₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
    sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ' 1 L_y Δ y₁ y₂ →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', X₁ z + y₁ z ∈ horizStrip σ ∧ X₂ z + y₂ z ∈ horizStrip σ) →
    ∀ d : ℕ, d ≤ 3 →
      sjcHoloLipPair (m + 2) σ'
        (M₁ * shjCompConst (m + 2) 3)
        (shjCompConst (m + 2) 3 * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 2) * M₁ * (1 + L_y)))
        Δ
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₁ (X₁ z + y₁ z))
        (fun z => iteratedDeriv d W₂ (X₂ z + y₂ z))) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
    ‖mFactor_C W₁ (X₁ z) (T₁ z) (z₀₁ z) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
    ‖mFactor_C W₂ (X₂ z) (T₂ z) (z₀₂ z) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2)

signature.name: real_primPhi_and_action_taylor
signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
