proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hM₁
  have hPhi_deriv : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ w) (Real.exp (w z)) z := by
    intro w hw z
    have hf : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => Real.exp (w ζ)) :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp hw.2.1.continuous
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 z)
      (hf.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds z))
      hf.continuousAt

  have hPhi_strictMono : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      StrictMono (primPhi_ℝ w) := by
    intro w hw
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro z
    rw [(hPhi_deriv w hw z).deriv]
    exact Real.exp_pos (w z)

  have hPhi_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (primPhi_ℝ w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hcast : ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = ((m + 15 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := by norm_cast
    rw [hcast, contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
    refine ⟨fun z => (hPhi_deriv w hw z).differentiableAt, by simp, ?_⟩
    have hderiv_eq : deriv (primPhi_ℝ w) = fun z => Real.exp (w z) :=
      funext fun z => (hPhi_deriv w hw z).deriv
    rw [hderiv_eq]
    exact Real.contDiff_exp.comp hw.2.1

  have hPhi_surj : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      Function.Surjective (primPhi_ℝ w) := by
    intro w hw y
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => Real.exp (w ζ)) :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp hw.2.1.continuous
    have hw_lower : ∀ ζ : ℝ, Real.exp (-M₁) ≤ Real.exp (w ζ) := by
      intro ζ
      have h0 := hw.2.2 0 (Nat.zero_le _) ζ
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_of_abs_le h0)
    let R : ℝ := |y| * Real.exp M₁
    have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg y) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos M₁))
    have hR_prod : R * Real.exp (-M₁) = |y| := by
      dsimp [R]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have hUpper : |y| ≤ primPhi_ℝ w R := by
      have hmono_int : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..R, Real.exp (-M₁)) ≤
          ∫ ζ in (0 : ℝ)..R, Real.exp (w ζ) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hR_nonneg intervalIntegrable_const
          (hf_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 R) (fun ζ _ => hw_lower ζ)
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hmono_int
      rwa [hR_prod] at hmono_int
    have hLower : primPhi_ℝ w (-R) ≤ -|y| := by
      have hmono_int : (∫ _ in (-R)..(0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-M₁)) ≤
          ∫ ζ in (-R)..(0 : ℝ), Real.exp (w ζ) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (neg_nonpos.mpr hR_nonneg) intervalIntegrable_const
          (hf_cont.intervalIntegrable (-R) 0) (fun ζ _ => hw_lower ζ)
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, zero_sub, neg_neg, smul_eq_mul] at hmono_int
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm 0 (-R)] at hmono_int
      change R * Real.exp (-M₁) ≤ -primPhi_ℝ w (-R) at hmono_int
      rw [hR_prod] at hmono_int
      linarith
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Set.Icc (primPhi_ℝ w (-R)) (primPhi_ℝ w R) :=
      ⟨le_trans hLower (neg_abs_le y), le_trans (le_abs_self y) hUpper⟩
    obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -R ≤ R)
      (hPhi_contDiff w hw).continuous.continuousOn hy_mem
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩

  have hPhi_rightInv : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ y : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ w (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) y) = y :=
    fun w hw => Function.rightInverse_invFun (hPhi_surj w hw)

  have hMid_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ X Y : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ w (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) = (primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2 :=
    fun w hw X Y => hPhi_rightInv w hw ((primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2)

  have hInv_contDiff : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 16 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w)) := by
    intro w hw
    let Φ_homeo : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ :=
      ((hPhi_strictMono w hw).orderIsoOfSurjective (primPhi_ℝ w) (hPhi_surj w hw)).toHomeomorph
    have hInvEq : Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) = Φ_homeo.symm := by
      funext y
      apply (hPhi_strictMono w hw).injective
      rw [hPhi_rightInv w hw y]
      exact (Φ_homeo.apply_symm_apply y).symm
    rw [hInvEq]
    exact Φ_homeo.contDiff_symm_deriv (fun x => Real.exp_ne_zero (w x))
      (hPhi_deriv w hw) (hPhi_contDiff w hw)

  have hInv_deriv : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w))
        (Real.exp (-w (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) y))) y := by
    intro w hw y
    set ψ := Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w)
    have hψ_diff : Differentiable ℝ ψ :=
      (hInv_contDiff w hw).differentiable (by simp)
    have hd : HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ y) y := (hψ_diff y).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun y' => primPhi_ℝ w (ψ y'))
        (Real.exp (w (ψ y)) * deriv ψ y) y :=
      (hPhi_deriv w hw (ψ y)).comp y hd
    have hid_eq : (fun y' => primPhi_ℝ w (ψ y')) = id := funext (hPhi_rightInv w hw)
    rw [hid_eq] at hcomp
    have hmul : Real.exp (w (ψ y)) * deriv ψ y = 1 := hcomp.unique (hasDerivAt_id y)
    have hval : deriv ψ y = Real.exp (-w (ψ y)) := by
      calc deriv ψ y
          = Real.exp (-w (ψ y)) * (Real.exp (w (ψ y)) * deriv ψ y) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
        _ = Real.exp (-w (ψ y)) := by rw [hmul, mul_one]
    rwa [hval] at hd

  have hMid_diag_per : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ X Y : ℝ, midpoint_ℝ w (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) =
        midpoint_ℝ w X Y + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro w hw X Y
    have hPhi_quasi : ∀ z : ℝ,
        primPhi_ℝ w (z + 2 * Real.pi) = primPhi_ℝ w z + primPhi_ℝ w (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro z
      have hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) z,
          HasDerivAt (fun t' : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ w (t' + 2 * Real.pi) - primPhi_ℝ w t') 0 t := by
        intro t _
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun t' : ℝ => t' + 2 * Real.pi) 1 t :=
          (hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (2 * Real.pi)
        have hd1_raw := HasDerivAt.comp t (hPhi_deriv w hw (t + 2 * Real.pi)) hlin
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t' : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ w (t' + 2 * Real.pi))
            (Real.exp (w t)) t := by
          refine hd1_raw.congr_deriv ?_
          rw [mul_one, hw.1 t]
        exact (hd1.sub (hPhi_deriv w hw t)).congr_deriv (sub_self _)
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd
        (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (0 : ℝ)))
      have h0 : primPhi_ℝ w 0 = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_zero, zero_add, h0, sub_zero] at hftc
      linarith
    apply (hPhi_strictMono w hw).injective
    rw [hMid_eq w hw (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi),
      hPhi_quasi X, hPhi_quasi Y, hPhi_quasi (midpoint_ℝ w X Y), hMid_eq w hw X Y]
    ring

  have hDiff_bound : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
      0 ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ m + 15 → ∀ z : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv j (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) z| ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ := by
    intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro r ⟨j, _, y, _, rfl⟩
      exact abs_nonneg _
    · intro j hj z
      have hBdd : BddAbove { r : ℝ | ∃ i ≤ m + 15, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          r = |iteratedDeriv i (w₁ - w₂) y| } := by
        refine ⟨2 * M₁, ?_⟩
        rintro r ⟨i, hi, y, _, rfl⟩
        have hc1 : ContDiffAt ℝ (i : WithTop ℕ∞) w₁ y :=
          (hw₁.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt
        have hc2 : ContDiffAt ℝ (i : WithTop ℕ∞) w₂ y :=
          (hw₂.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt
        change |iteratedDeriv i (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) y| ≤ 2 * M₁
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hc1 hc2]
        calc |iteratedDeriv i w₁ y - iteratedDeriv i w₂ y|
            ≤ |iteratedDeriv i w₁ y| + |iteratedDeriv i w₂ y| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ M₁ + M₁ := add_le_add (hw₁.2.2 i hi y) (hw₂.2.2 i hi y)
          _ = 2 * M₁ := by ring
      have hper_diff : (fun y => (w₁ - w₂) (y + 2 * Real.pi)) = w₁ - w₂ := by
        funext y
        simp [Pi.sub_apply, hw₁.1 y, hw₂.1 y]
      have hper_j : Function.Periodic (iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro y
        have hcomp := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_add_const j (w₁ - w₂) (2 * Real.pi)) y
        rw [hper_diff] at hcomp
        exact hcomp.symm
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hzy⟩ := hper_j.exists_mem_Ico₀ Real.two_pi_pos z
      change |iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂) z| ≤ realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂
      rw [hzy]
      exact le_csSup hBdd ⟨j, hj, y, Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hy, rfl⟩

  have hUnitInt : ∀ (F F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2) →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F' p.1 p.2) →
      (∀ u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u' => F u' s) (F' u s) u) →
      Continuous (fun u => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, F u s) ∧
      ∀ u₀ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, F u s)
        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' u₀ s) u₀ := by
    intro F F' hF hF' hd
    refine ⟨intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := F) hF 0 1, ?_⟩
    intro u₀
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall u₀ 1 ×ˢ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall u₀ 1).prod isCompact_uIcc
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF'.continuousOn
    exact (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds u₀ zero_lt_one)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u =>
        (hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (hF'.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs u hu =>
        hB (u, s) ⟨hu, Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hs⟩)
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := B))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s _ u _ => hd u s)).2

  have hSinc : ∀ z : ℝ, Real.sin z = z * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (r * z) := by
    intro z
    have hd : ∀ r ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ => Real.sin (r' * z)) (z * Real.cos (r * z)) r := by
      intro r _
      exact (((hasDerivAt_id r).mul_const z).sin).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
    have hcont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => z * Real.cos (r * z)) := by fun_prop
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero] at hftc
    exact hftc.symm

  have hAction_factor : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ X T : ℝ, normAction1_ℝ w X (X + T) =
        T ^ 2 * (1 / 8 + realJetA w X * T ^ 2 + T ^ 3 * realJetB w X T) := by
    intro w hw X T
    have hw_c4 : ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w := hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hw_c0 : Continuous w := hw.2.1.continuous
    have hw_c1 : Continuous (iteratedDeriv 1 w) := hw_c4.continuous_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num)
    have hw_c2 : Continuous (iteratedDeriv 2 w) := hw_c4.continuous_iteratedDeriv 2 (by norm_num)
    have hw_c3 : Continuous (iteratedDeriv 3 w) := hw_c4.continuous_iteratedDeriv 3 (by norm_num)
    have hw_d0 : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (iteratedDeriv 1 w z) z := by
      intro z
      have h := (hw_c4.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 0 (by norm_num) z).hasDerivAt
      rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero] at h
    have hw_d1 : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv 1 w) (iteratedDeriv 2 w z) z := by
      intro z
      have h := (hw_c4.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 1 (by norm_num) z).hasDerivAt
      rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h
    have hw_d2 : ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv 2 w) (iteratedDeriv 3 w z) z := by
      intro z
      have h := (hw_c4.differentiable_iteratedDeriv 2 (by norm_num) z).hasDerivAt
      rwa [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at h

    
    let μ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => midpoint_ℝ w X (X + u)
    have hμ0 : μ 0 = X := by
      apply (hPhi_strictMono w hw).injective
      dsimp [μ]
      rw [hMid_eq w hw X (X + 0), add_zero]
      ring
    have hμ_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt μ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w (μ u))) u := by
      intro u
      let y_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun u' => (primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w (X + u')) / 2
      have hy : HasDerivAt y_fn ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u))) u := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u' => primPhi_ℝ w (X + u')) (Real.exp (w (X + u)) * 1) u :=
          (hPhi_deriv w hw (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)
        have h2 := ((hasDerivAt_const u (primPhi_ℝ w X)).add h1).div_const 2
        convert h2 using 1
        ring
      have hcomp := (hInv_deriv w hw (y_fn u)).comp u hy
      change HasDerivAt μ (Real.exp (-w (μ u)) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u)))) u at hcomp
      convert hcomp using 1
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.exp_add]
      ring
    have hμ_cont : Continuous μ :=
      Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hμ_deriv u).differentiableAt

    
    let ψ₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0
    have hPhi_diff : ∀ u : ℝ,
        primPhi_ℝ w (X + u) - primPhi_ℝ w X = u * Real.exp (w X) * realActG w X u 0 := by
      intro u
      have hd : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => primPhi_ℝ w (X + s' * u))
            ((u * Real.exp (w X)) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)) s := by
        intro s _
        have h1 := (hPhi_deriv w hw (X + s * u)).comp s
          (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const u).const_add X)
        refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
        have hexp : Real.exp (w (X + s * u)) =
            Real.exp (w X) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
        rw [hexp]
        ring
      have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ =>
          (u * Real.exp (w X)) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)) := by fun_prop
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd
        (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at hftc
      exact hftc.symm
    have hPsi_prim : ∀ u : ℝ, ψ₀ u = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (primPhi_ℝ w (X + u) - primPhi_ℝ w X) := by
      intro u
      dsimp [ψ₀]
      rw [hPhi_diff u]
      ring
    have hPsi_mid : ∀ u : ℝ, primPhi_ℝ w (μ u) - primPhi_ℝ w X = ψ₀ u := by
      intro u
      dsimp [μ]
      rw [hMid_eq w hw X (X + u), hPsi_prim u]
      ring

    
    let g_act : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => normAction1_ℝ w X (X + u)
    have hg0 : g_act 0 = 0 := by
      change Real.exp (w X) * (∫ z in X..(μ 0),
        Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) = 0
      rw [hμ0, intervalIntegral.integral_same, mul_zero]
    have hg_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt g_act (u * realActionH0 w X u) u := by
      intro u
      let F_act : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
        Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)
      have hF_cont : Continuous F_act := by
        have hPc := (hPhi_contDiff w hw).continuous
        fun_prop
      have hInt_d : HasDerivAt (fun z' => ∫ z in X..z', F_act z) (F_act (μ u)) (μ u) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
          (hF_cont.intervalIntegrable X (μ u))
          (hF_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds (μ u)))
          hF_cont.continuousAt
      have hcomp := (hInt_d.comp u (hμ_deriv u)).const_mul (Real.exp (w X))
      change HasDerivAt g_act
        (Real.exp (w X) * (F_act (μ u) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w (μ u))))) u
        at hcomp
      convert hcomp using 1
      dsimp [F_act, realActionH0, realActE, realActS]
      change u * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w (μ u)) *
          realActG w X u 0 * (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.cos (r * ψ₀ u)))) =
        Real.exp (w X) * ((Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w (μ u) - primPhi_ℝ w X) *
          Real.exp (-2 * w (μ u))) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w (μ u))))
      rw [hPsi_mid u, hSinc (ψ₀ u)]
      dsimp [ψ₀]
      have hexp_comb : Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w (μ u)) =
          Real.exp (w X) * Real.exp (w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w (μ u)) *
            Real.exp (w (X + u) - w (μ u)) := by
        simp only [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hexp_comb]
      ring

    
    let μ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u) - w (μ u))
    let μ₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => μ₁ u * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₁ u)
    let μ₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      μ₂ u * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₁ u) +
        μ₁ u * (iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) - iteratedDeriv 2 w (μ u) * (μ₁ u) ^ 2 -
          iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₂ u)
    let L₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => 2 * w X + w (X + u) - 3 * w (μ u)
    let L₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₁ u
    let L₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 2 w (μ u) * (μ₁ u) ^ 2 -
        3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₂ u
    let L₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + u) - 3 * iteratedDeriv 3 w (μ u) * (μ₁ u) ^ 3 -
        9 * iteratedDeriv 2 w (μ u) * μ₁ u * μ₂ u - 3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₃ u

    have hE_derivs : ∀ u : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 0) (realActE w X u 1) u ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 1) (realActE w X u 2) u ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 2) (realActE w X u 3) u := by
      intro u
      have hw0_u : HasDerivAt (fun u' => w (X + u')) (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)) u :=
        ((hw_d0 (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw1_u : HasDerivAt (fun u' => iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u'))
          (iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)) u :=
        ((hw_d1 (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw2_u : HasDerivAt (fun u' => iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u'))
          (iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + u)) u :=
        ((hw_d2 (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw0_μ : HasDerivAt (fun u' => w (μ u')) (iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u) * μ₁ u) u :=
        (hw_d0 (μ u)).comp u (hμ_deriv u)
      have hw1_μ : HasDerivAt (fun u' => iteratedDeriv 1 w (μ u'))
          (iteratedDeriv 2 w (μ u) * μ₁ u) u :=
        (hw_d1 (μ u)).comp u (hμ_deriv u)
      have hw2_μ : HasDerivAt (fun u' => iteratedDeriv 2 w (μ u'))
          (iteratedDeriv 3 w (μ u) * μ₁ u) u :=
        (hw_d2 (μ u)).comp u (hμ_deriv u)
      have hμ₁_d : HasDerivAt μ₁ (μ₂ u) u :=
        ((hw0_u.sub hw0_μ).exp.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [μ₁, μ₂]; ring)
      have hμ₂_d : HasDerivAt μ₂ (μ₃ u) u :=
        (hμ₁_d.mul (hw1_u.sub (hw1_μ.mul hμ₁_d))).congr_deriv (by dsimp [μ₂, μ₃]; ring)
      have hL₀_d : HasDerivAt L₀ (L₁ u) u :=
        (((hasDerivAt_const u (2 * w X)).add hw0_u).sub (hw0_μ.const_mul 3)).congr_deriv
          (by dsimp [L₁]; ring)
      have hL₁_d : HasDerivAt L₁ (L₂ u) u :=
        (hw1_u.sub ((hw1_μ.const_mul 3).mul hμ₁_d)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [L₂]; ring)
      have hL₂_d : HasDerivAt L₂ (L₃ u) u := by
        have hμ₁_sq : HasDerivAt (fun u' => (μ₁ u') ^ 2) (2 * μ₁ u * μ₂ u) u :=
          (hμ₁_d.pow 2).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
        exact ((hw2_u.sub ((hw2_μ.const_mul 3).mul hμ₁_sq)).sub
          ((hw1_μ.const_mul 3).mul hμ₂_d)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [L₃]; ring)
      have hE0_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 0) (realActE w X u 1) u := by
        change HasDerivAt (fun u' => Real.exp (L₀ u')) (L₁ u * Real.exp (L₀ u)) u
        exact hL₀_d.exp.congr_deriv (by ring)
      have hE1_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 1) (realActE w X u 2) u := by
        change HasDerivAt (fun u' => L₁ u' * Real.exp (L₀ u'))
          ((L₂ u + (L₁ u) ^ 2) * Real.exp (L₀ u)) u
        exact (hL₁_d.mul hL₀_d.exp).congr_deriv (by ring)
      have hE2_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActE w X u' 2) (realActE w X u 3) u := by
        change HasDerivAt (fun u' => (L₂ u' + (L₁ u') ^ 2) * Real.exp (L₀ u'))
          ((L₃ u + 3 * L₁ u * L₂ u + (L₁ u) ^ 3) * Real.exp (L₀ u)) u
        have hL₁_sq : HasDerivAt (fun u' => (L₁ u') ^ 2) (2 * L₁ u * L₂ u) u :=
          (hL₁_d.pow 2).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
        exact ((hL₂_d.add hL₁_sq).mul hL₀_d.exp).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
      exact ⟨hE0_d, hE1_d, hE2_d⟩

    have hE0_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActE w X u 0) :=
      Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hE_derivs u).1.differentiableAt
    have hE3_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActE w X u 3) := by
      change Continuous (fun u => (L₃ u + 3 * L₁ u * L₂ u + (L₁ u) ^ 3) * Real.exp (L₀ u))
      dsimp [L₀, L₁, L₂, L₃, μ₃, μ₂, μ₁]
      fun_prop

    
    let gI₀ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u s => Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X)
    let gI₁ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u s =>
      s * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
    let gI₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u s =>
      s ^ 2 * ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))
    let gI₃ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u s =>
      s ^ 3 * ((iteratedDeriv 3 w (X + s * u) +
        3 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) +
        (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u)) ^ 3) * Real.exp (w (X + s * u) - w X))

    have hgI0_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => gI₀ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [gI₀]; fun_prop
    have hgI1_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => gI₁ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [gI₁]; fun_prop
    have hgI2_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => gI₂ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [gI₂]; fun_prop
    have hgI3_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => gI₃ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [gI₃]; fun_prop

    have hG0_pack := hUnitInt gI₀ gI₁ hgI0_cont hgI1_cont (by
      intro u s
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun u' => X + s * u') s u :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul s).const_add X).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw0 := ((hw_d0 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin).sub_const (w X)
      exact hw0.exp.congr_deriv (by dsimp [gI₁]; ring))
    have hG1_pack := hUnitInt gI₁ gI₂ hgI1_cont hgI2_cont (by
      intro u s
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun u' => X + s * u') s u :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul s).const_add X).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw0 := ((hw_d0 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin).sub_const (w X)
      have hw1 := (hw_d1 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin
      exact ((hw1.mul hw0.exp).const_mul s).congr_deriv (by dsimp [gI₂]; ring))
    have hG2_pack := hUnitInt gI₂ gI₃ hgI2_cont hgI3_cont (by
      intro u s
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun u' => X + s * u') s u :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul s).const_add X).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw0 := ((hw_d0 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin).sub_const (w X)
      have hw1 := (hw_d1 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin
      have hw2 := (hw_d2 (X + s * u)).comp u hlin
      have hw1_sq : HasDerivAt (fun u' => (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u')) ^ 2)
          (2 * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * u) * (iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * u) * s)) u :=
        (hw1.pow 2).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
      exact (((hw2.add hw1_sq).mul hw0.exp).const_mul (s ^ 2)).congr_deriv
        (by dsimp [gI₃]; ring))
    have hG0_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActG w X u 0) := hG0_pack.1
    have hG3_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActG w X u 3) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := gI₃) hgI3_cont 0 1

    
    let sI₀ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z r => Real.cos (r * z)
    let sI₁ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z r => -(r * Real.sin (r * z))
    let sI₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z r => -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * z))
    let sI₃ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun z r => r ^ 3 * Real.sin (r * z)
    have hsI0_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sI₀ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [sI₀]; fun_prop
    have hsI1_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sI₁ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [sI₁]; fun_prop
    have hsI2_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sI₂ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [sI₂]; fun_prop
    have hsI3_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sI₃ p.1 p.2) := by dsimp [sI₃]; fun_prop

    have hsc0_pack := hUnitInt sI₀ sI₁ hsI0_cont hsI1_cont (by
      intro z r
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun z' => r * z') r z :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul r).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      exact hlin.cos.congr_deriv (by dsimp [sI₁]; ring))
    have hsc1_pack := hUnitInt sI₁ sI₂ hsI1_cont hsI2_cont (by
      intro z r
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun z' => r * z') r z :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul r).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      exact ((hlin.sin.const_mul r).neg).congr_deriv (by dsimp [sI₂]; ring))
    have hsc2_pack := hUnitInt sI₂ sI₃ hsI2_cont hsI3_cont (by
      intro z r
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun z' => r * z') r z :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul r).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      exact ((hlin.cos.const_mul (r ^ 2)).neg).congr_deriv (by dsimp [sI₃]; ring))
    let sc₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, sI₀ z r
    let sc₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, sI₁ z r
    let sc₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, sI₂ z r
    let sc₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, sI₃ z r
    have hsc3_cont : Continuous sc₃ :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := sI₃) hsI3_cont 0 1

    let ψ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (w (X + u))
    let ψ₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u) * Real.exp (w (X + u))
    let ψ₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)) ^ 2) *
        Real.exp (w (X + u))

    have hS_derivs : ∀ u : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 0) (realActS w X u 1) u ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 1) (realActS w X u 2) u ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 2) (realActS w X u 3) u := by
      intro u
      have hw0_u : HasDerivAt (fun u' => w (X + u')) (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u)) u :=
        ((hw_d0 (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hw1_u : HasDerivAt (fun u' => iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + u'))
          (iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + u)) u :=
        ((hw_d1 (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
      have hψ₀_d : HasDerivAt ψ₀ (ψ₁ u) u := by
        have hprim_eq : ψ₀ = fun u' => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (primPhi_ℝ w (X + u') - primPhi_ℝ w X) :=
          funext hPsi_prim
        rw [hprim_eq]
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun u' => primPhi_ℝ w (X + u')) (Real.exp (w (X + u))) u :=
          ((hPhi_deriv w hw (X + u)).comp u ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add X)).congr_deriv (mul_one _)
        exact (hp.sub_const (primPhi_ℝ w X)).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      have hψ₁_d : HasDerivAt ψ₁ (ψ₂ u) u :=
        (hw0_u.exp.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [ψ₂]; ring)
      have hψ₂_d : HasDerivAt ψ₂ (ψ₃ u) u :=
        (((hw1_u.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).mul hw0_u.exp)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [ψ₃]; ring)
      have hS0_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 0) (realActS w X u 1) u :=
        (hsc0_pack.2 (ψ₀ u)).comp u hψ₀_d
      have hS1_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 1) (realActS w X u 2) u := by
        change HasDerivAt (fun u' => sc₁ (ψ₀ u') * ψ₁ u')
          (sc₂ (ψ₀ u) * (ψ₁ u) ^ 2 + sc₁ (ψ₀ u) * ψ₂ u) u
        exact (((hsc1_pack.2 (ψ₀ u)).comp u hψ₀_d).mul hψ₁_d).congr_deriv
          (by dsimp [sc₁, sc₂]; ring)
      have hS2_d : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActS w X u' 2) (realActS w X u 3) u := by
        change HasDerivAt (fun u' => sc₂ (ψ₀ u') * (ψ₁ u') ^ 2 + sc₁ (ψ₀ u') * ψ₂ u')
          (sc₃ (ψ₀ u) * (ψ₁ u) ^ 3 + 3 * sc₂ (ψ₀ u) * ψ₁ u * ψ₂ u + sc₁ (ψ₀ u) * ψ₃ u) u
        have hψ₁_sq : HasDerivAt (fun u' => (ψ₁ u') ^ 2) (2 * ψ₁ u * ψ₂ u) u :=
          (hψ₁_d.pow 2).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
        exact ((((hsc2_pack.2 (ψ₀ u)).comp u hψ₀_d).mul hψ₁_sq).add
          (((hsc1_pack.2 (ψ₀ u)).comp u hψ₀_d).mul hψ₂_d)).congr_deriv
          (by dsimp [sc₁, sc₂, sc₃]; ring)
      exact ⟨hS0_d, hS1_d, hS2_d⟩

    have hS0_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActS w X u 0) :=
      Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hS_derivs u).1.differentiableAt
    have hS3_cont : Continuous (fun u => realActS w X u 3) := by
      have hψ₀_cont : Continuous ψ₀ := by dsimp [ψ₀]; fun_prop
      have hsc1_c : Continuous sc₁ := hsc1_pack.1
      have hsc2_c : Continuous sc₂ := hsc2_pack.1
      change Continuous (fun u =>
        sc₃ (ψ₀ u) * (ψ₁ u) ^ 3 + 3 * sc₂ (ψ₀ u) * ψ₁ u * ψ₂ u + sc₁ (ψ₀ u) * ψ₃ u)
      dsimp [ψ₁, ψ₂, ψ₃]
      fun_prop

    
    have hE0_0 : realActE w X 0 0 = 1 := by
      change Real.exp (2 * w X + w (X + 0) - 3 * w (μ 0)) = 1
      rw [add_zero, hμ0]
      have hz : 2 * w X + w X - 3 * w X = 0 := by ring
      rw [hz, Real.exp_zero]
    have hE1_0 : realActE w X 0 1 = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w X := by
      change L₁ 0 * Real.exp (L₀ 0) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w X
      dsimp [L₀, L₁, μ₁]
      rw [add_zero, hμ0, sub_self, Real.exp_zero]
      have hz : 2 * w X + w X - 3 * w X = 0 := by ring
      rw [hz, Real.exp_zero]
      ring
    have hE2_0 : realActE w X 0 2 =
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 2 w X - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2 := by
      change (L₂ 0 + (L₁ 0) ^ 2) * Real.exp (L₀ 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 2 w X - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2
      dsimp [L₀, L₁, L₂, μ₂, μ₁]
      rw [add_zero, hμ0, sub_self, Real.exp_zero]
      have hz : 2 * w X + w X - 3 * w X = 0 := by ring
      rw [hz, Real.exp_zero]
      ring
    have hG0_0 : realActG w X 0 0 = 1 := by
      dsimp [realActG]
      simp
    have hG1_0 : realActG w X 0 1 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv 1 w X := by
      dsimp [realActG]
      have heq : (fun s : ℝ =>
          s * (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * 0) * Real.exp (w (X + s * 0) - w X))) =
          fun s : ℝ => iteratedDeriv 1 w X * s ^ 1 := by
        funext s
        simp [mul_comm]
      rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
      ring
    have hG2_0 : realActG w X 0 2 =
        (1 / 3 : ℝ) * (iteratedDeriv 2 w X + (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [realActG]
      have heq : (fun s : ℝ =>
          s ^ 2 * ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (X + s * 0) + (iteratedDeriv 1 w (X + s * 0)) ^ 2) *
            Real.exp (w (X + s * 0) - w X))) =
          fun s : ℝ => (iteratedDeriv 2 w X + (iteratedDeriv 1 w X) ^ 2) * s ^ 2 := by
        funext s
        simp [mul_comm]
      rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
      ring
    have hψ₀_0 : ψ₀ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [ψ₀]
      ring
    have hS0_0 : realActS w X 0 0 = 1 := by
      change sc₀ (ψ₀ 0) = 1
      rw [hψ₀_0]
      dsimp [sc₀, sI₀]
      simp
    have hS1_0 : realActS w X 0 1 = 0 := by
      change sc₁ (ψ₀ 0) * ψ₁ 0 = 0
      rw [hψ₀_0]
      dsimp [sc₁, sI₁]
      simp
    have hS2_0 : realActS w X 0 2 = -(1 / 12 : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * w X) := by
      change sc₂ (ψ₀ 0) * (ψ₁ 0) ^ 2 + sc₁ (ψ₀ 0) * ψ₂ 0 = -(1 / 12 : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * w X)
      rw [hψ₀_0]
      have hsc1_0 : sc₁ 0 = 0 := by dsimp [sc₁, sI₁]; simp
      have hsc2_0 : sc₂ 0 = -(1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [sc₂, sI₂]
        have heq : (fun r : ℝ => -(r ^ 2 * Real.cos (r * 0))) = fun r : ℝ => (-1 : ℝ) * r ^ 2 := by
          funext r
          simp
        rw [heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
        norm_num
      have hψ1_sq0 : (ψ₁ 0) ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * w X) := by
        dsimp [ψ₁]
        rw [add_zero, mul_pow, sq (Real.exp (w X)), ← Real.exp_add, ← two_mul]
        ring
      rw [hsc1_0, hsc2_0, hψ1_sq0]
      ring

    
    let H₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => realActionH0 w X u
    let H₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (realActE w X u 1 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 0 +
        realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 1 * realActS w X u 0 +
        realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 1)
    let H₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u =>
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (realActE w X u 2 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 0 +
        realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 2 * realActS w X u 0 +
        realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 2 +
        2 * (realActE w X u 1 * realActG w X u 1 * realActS w X u 0 +
          realActE w X u 1 * realActG w X u 0 * realActS w X u 1 +
          realActE w X u 0 * realActG w X u 1 * realActS w X u 1))
    let H₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => realActionH3 w X u

    have hH_derivs : ∀ u : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt H₀ (H₁ u) u ∧
        HasDerivAt H₁ (H₂ u) u ∧
        HasDerivAt H₂ (H₃ u) u := by
      intro u
      obtain ⟨hE0, hE1, hE2⟩ := hE_derivs u
      have hG0 : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActG w X u' 0) (realActG w X u 1) u := hG0_pack.2 u
      have hG1 : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActG w X u' 1) (realActG w X u 2) u := hG1_pack.2 u
      have hG2 : HasDerivAt (fun u' => realActG w X u' 2) (realActG w X u 3) u := hG2_pack.2 u
      obtain ⟨hS0, hS1, hS2⟩ := hS_derivs u
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt H₀ (H₁ u) u :=
        (((hE0.mul hG0).mul hS0).const_mul (1 / 4 : ℝ)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [H₁]; ring)
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt H₁ (H₂ u) u := by
        have t1 := (hE1.mul hG0).mul hS0
        have t2 := (hE0.mul hG1).mul hS0
        have t3 := (hE0.mul hG0).mul hS1
        exact (((t1.add t2).add t3).const_mul (1 / 4 : ℝ)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [H₂]; ring)
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt H₂ (H₃ u) u := by
        have t1 := (hE2.mul hG0).mul hS0
        have t2 := (hE0.mul hG2).mul hS0
        have t3 := (hE0.mul hG0).mul hS2
        have t4 := (hE1.mul hG1).mul hS0
        have t5 := (hE1.mul hG0).mul hS1
        have t6 := (hE0.mul hG1).mul hS1
        exact ((((t1.add t2).add t3).add (((t4.add t5).add t6).const_mul 2)).const_mul
          (1 / 4 : ℝ)).congr_deriv (by dsimp [H₃, realActionH3]; ring)
      exact ⟨hd0, hd1, hd2⟩

    have hH0_cont : Continuous H₀ := by dsimp [H₀, realActionH0]; fun_prop
    have hH3_cont : Continuous H₃ := by
      have hE1_c : Continuous (fun u => realActE w X u 1) :=
        Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hE_derivs u).2.1.differentiableAt
      have hE2_c : Continuous (fun u => realActE w X u 2) :=
        Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hE_derivs u).2.2.differentiableAt
      have hG1_c : Continuous (fun u => realActG w X u 1) := hG1_pack.1
      have hG2_c : Continuous (fun u => realActG w X u 2) := hG2_pack.1
      have hS1_c : Continuous (fun u => realActS w X u 1) :=
        Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hS_derivs u).2.1.differentiableAt
      have hS2_c : Continuous (fun u => realActS w X u 2) :=
        Differentiable.continuous fun u => (hS_derivs u).2.2.differentiableAt
      dsimp [H₃, realActionH3]
      fun_prop

    have hH0_0 : H₀ 0 = 1 / 4 := by
      dsimp [H₀, realActionH0]
      rw [hE0_0, hG0_0, hS0_0]
      ring
    have hH1_0 : H₁ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [H₁]
      rw [hE0_0, hE1_0, hG0_0, hG1_0, hS0_0, hS1_0]
      ring
    have hH2_0 : H₂ 0 = 8 * realJetA w X := by
      dsimp [H₂, realJetA]
      rw [hE0_0, hE1_0, hE2_0, hG0_0, hG1_0, hG2_0, hS0_0, hS1_0, hS2_0]
      ring

    
    have hH0_taylor : ∀ y : ℝ,
        H₀ y = 1 / 4 + 4 * realJetA w X * y ^ 2 +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ 3 * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * y) := by
      intro y
      let T_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ =>
        H₀ (τ * y) + (1 - τ) * y * H₁ (τ * y) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - τ) ^ 2 * y ^ 2 * H₂ (τ * y)
      have hT_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt T_fn ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ 3 * ((1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * y))) τ := by
        intro τ _
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => τ' * y) y τ :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id τ).mul_const y).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
        obtain ⟨hd0, hd1, hd2⟩ := hH_derivs (τ * y)
        have h1_raw := HasDerivAt.comp τ hd0 hlin
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => H₀ (τ' * y)) (H₁ (τ * y) * y) τ := h1_raw
        have hc1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => (1 - τ') * y) (-y) τ :=
          (((hasDerivAt_const τ (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id τ)).mul_const y).congr_deriv
            (by ring)
        have h2_raw := hc1.mul (HasDerivAt.comp τ hd1 hlin)
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => (1 - τ') * y * H₁ (τ' * y))
            (-y * H₁ (τ * y) + (1 - τ) * y * (H₂ (τ * y) * y)) τ := h2_raw
        have hc2 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - τ') ^ 2 * y ^ 2)
            (-(1 - τ) * y ^ 2) τ :=
          (((((hasDerivAt_const τ (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id τ)).pow 2).const_mul
            (1 / 2 : ℝ)).mul_const (y ^ 2)).congr_deriv (by dsimp; ring)
        have h3_raw := hc2.mul (HasDerivAt.comp τ hd2 hlin)
        have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun τ' => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - τ') ^ 2 * y ^ 2 * H₂ (τ' * y))
            (-(1 - τ) * y ^ 2 * H₂ (τ * y) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - τ) ^ 2 * y ^ 2 * (H₃ (τ * y) * y)) τ := h3_raw
        exact ((h1.add h2).add h3).congr_deriv (by ring)
      have hrem_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ =>
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y ^ 3 * ((1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * y))) := by fun_prop
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hT_deriv
        (hrem_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
      have hT1 : T_fn 1 = H₀ y := by
        dsimp [T_fn]
        rw [one_mul]
        ring
      have hT0 : T_fn 0 = 1 / 4 + 4 * realJetA w X * y ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [T_fn]
        rw [zero_mul, hH0_0, hH1_0, hH2_0]
        ring
      linarith

    
    have hg_rescaled : normAction1_ℝ w X (X + T) =
        T ^ 2 * ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..1, r * H₀ (r * T) := by
      have hd : ∀ r ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ => g_act (r' * T)) (T ^ 2 * (r * H₀ (r * T))) r := by
        intro r _
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun r' => r' * T) T r :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id r).mul_const T).congr_deriv (one_mul _)
        have hc_raw := HasDerivAt.comp r (hg_deriv (r * T)) hlin
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ => g_act (r' * T))
            ((r * T * realActionH0 w X (r * T)) * T) r := hc_raw
        exact hc.congr_deriv (by change _ = T ^ 2 * (r * realActionH0 w X (r * T)); ring)
      have hcont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => T ^ 2 * (r * H₀ (r * T))) := by fun_prop
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hd
        (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, hg0, sub_zero] at hftc
      exact hftc.symm

    
    let rem_r : ℝ → ℝ := fun r =>
      r ^ 4 * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * r * T)
    have hrem_r_cont : Continuous rem_r := by
      have hinner : Continuous (fun r : ℝ =>
          ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * r * T)) :=
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          (f := fun r τ => (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * r * T)) (by fun_prop) 0 1
      dsimp [rem_r]
      fun_prop
    have hint_eq : (fun r : ℝ => r * H₀ (r * T)) = fun r : ℝ =>
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * r ^ 1 + (4 * realJetA w X * T ^ 2) * r ^ 3) +
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ 3) * rem_r r := by
      funext r
      rw [hH0_taylor (r * T)]
      have hassoc : (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * (r * T))) =
          ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - τ) ^ 2 * H₃ (τ * r * T) := by
        congr 1
        funext τ
        rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [hassoc]
      dsimp [rem_r]
      ring
    have h12_cont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ =>
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r ^ 1 + (4 * realJetA w X * T ^ 2) * r ^ 3) := by fun_prop
    have h3_cont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * T ^ 3) * rem_r r) := by fun_prop
    have h1_cont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r ^ 1) := by fun_prop
    have h2_cont : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => (4 * realJetA w X * T ^ 2) * r ^ 3) := by fun_prop
    rw [hg_rescaled, hint_eq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (h12_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (h3_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (h1_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      (h2_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    rw [integral_pow, integral_pow]
    dsimp [realJetB, rem_r, H₃]
    ring

  exact ⟨{
    primPhi_hasDerivAt := hPhi_deriv
    primPhi_strictMono := hPhi_strictMono
    primPhi_contDiff := hPhi_contDiff
    invPrimPhi_contDiff := hInv_contDiff
    invPrimPhi_hasDerivAt := hInv_deriv
    midpoint_eq := hMid_eq
    midpoint_diag_periodic := hMid_diag_per
    action_factor := hAction_factor
    diff_global_bound := hDiff_bound
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_compConst_ge_one : ∀ (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ rmdCompConst k B := by
    intro k B
    induction k with
    | zero => simp [rmdCompConst]
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [rmdCompConst]
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B) := le_max_left _ _
      nlinarith

  have h_iter_add : ∀ (d j : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d g) = iteratedDeriv (j + d) g := by
    intro d j g
    induction j with
    | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, Nat.succ_add, iteratedDeriv_succ]

  have h_contDiff_iter : ∀ (d n : ℕ) (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ((n + d : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
      ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv d g) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro n g hg
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hg
    | succ d ih =>
      intro n g hg
      have hg' : ContDiff ℝ ((n + 1 + d : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g := by
        convert hg using 2
        omega
      have hd : ContDiff ℝ (((n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) (iteratedDeriv d g) :=
        ih (n + 1) g hg'
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      exact (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hd).2.2

  have h_slice_contDiff : ∀ (k n : ℕ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      k ≤ n → ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) F →
      ContDiff ℝ ((n - k : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F (q.1, y)) q.2) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro n F _ hF
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hF
    | succ k ih =>
      intro n F hk hF
      let f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun q y => F (q.1, y)
      have h_uncurry : ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry f) :=
        hF.comp ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)
      have h_fderiv : ContDiff ℝ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (fderiv ℝ (f q) q.2) (1 : ℝ)) :=
        h_uncurry.fderiv_apply contDiff_snd contDiff_const (by norm_cast; omega)
      let F₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => deriv (fun y => F (q.1, y)) q.2
      have hF₁ : ContDiff ℝ ((n - 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) F₁ := by
        have hEq : F₁ = fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (fderiv ℝ (f q) q.2) (1 : ℝ) := by
          funext q
          exact (fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv (f := f q) (x := q.2)).symm
        rwa [hEq]
      have h_step := ih (n - 1) F₁ (by omega) hF₁
      have hEq2 : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv (k + 1) (fun y => F (q.1, y)) q.2) =
          (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F₁ (q.1, y)) q.2) := by
        funext q
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
      rw [hEq2]
      convert h_step using 2
      omega

  have h_jet_const : ∀ (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ), rmdJetBnd k |c| (fun _ => c) := by
    intro k c
    refine ⟨contDiff_const, abs_nonneg c, ?_⟩
    intro j _ x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
    split_ifs <;> simp [abs_nonneg]

  have h_jet_mono : ∀ {k' k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      k' ≤ k → B₁ ≤ B₂ → rmdJetBnd k B₁ f → rmdJetBnd k' B₂ f := by
    intro k' k B₁ B₂ f hk hB ⟨hf, hB₁, hbnd⟩
    refine ⟨hf.of_le (by norm_cast), le_trans hB₁ hB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    exact le_trans (hbnd j (le_trans hj hk) x) hB

  have h_deriv_of_jet : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k B f → rmdDerivBnd k B f := by
    intro k B f ⟨hf, hB, hbnd⟩
    exact ⟨hf, hB, fun j _ hj x => hbnd j hj x⟩

  have h_deriv_mono : ∀ {k' k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      k' ≤ k → B₁ ≤ B₂ → rmdDerivBnd k B₁ f → rmdDerivBnd k' B₂ f := by
    intro k' k B₁ B₂ f hk hB ⟨hf, hB₁, hbnd⟩
    refine ⟨hf.of_le (by norm_cast), le_trans hB₁ hB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj1 hj x
    exact le_trans (hbnd j hj1 (le_trans hj hk) x) hB

  have h_deriv_add : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdDerivBnd k B₁ f → rmdDerivBnd k B₂ g →
      rmdDerivBnd k (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x) := by
    intro k B₁ B₂ f g ⟨hf, hB₁, hbf⟩ ⟨hg, hB₂, hbg⟩
    refine ⟨hf.add hg, add_nonneg hB₁ hB₂, ?_⟩
    intro j hj1 hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)
      ((hg.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)]
    exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hbf j hj1 hj x) (hbg j hj1 hj x))

  have h_deriv_const_mul : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdDerivBnd k B f → rmdDerivBnd k (|c| * B) (fun x => c * f x) := by
    intro k B c f ⟨hf, hB, hbf⟩
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hf, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj1 hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul c ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt), abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbf j hj1 hj x) (abs_nonneg c)

  have h_jet_of_deriv : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdDerivBnd (k + 1) B f → rmdJetBnd k B (deriv f) := by
    intro k B f ⟨hf, hB, hbnd⟩
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ (((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) f := hf
    refine ⟨(contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hf').2.2, hB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
    exact hbnd (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega) x

  have h_jet_add : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k B₁ f → rmdJetBnd k B₂ g →
      rmdJetBnd k (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x) := by
    intro k B₁ B₂ f g ⟨hf, hB₁, hbf⟩ ⟨hg, hB₂, hbg⟩
    refine ⟨hf.add hg, add_nonneg hB₁ hB₂, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)
      ((hg.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)]
    exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hbf j hj x) (hbg j hj x))

  have h_jet_sub : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k B₁ f → rmdJetBnd k B₂ g →
      rmdJetBnd k (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x - g x) := by
    intro k B₁ B₂ f g ⟨hf, hB₁, hbf⟩ ⟨hg, hB₂, hbg⟩
    refine ⟨hf.sub hg, add_nonneg hB₁ hB₂, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)
      ((hg.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)]
    exact le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add (hbf j hj x) (hbg j hj x))

  have h_jet_const_mul : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B : ℝ} (c : ℝ) {f : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k B f → rmdJetBnd k (|c| * B) (fun x => c * f x) := by
    intro k B c f ⟨hf, hB, hbf⟩
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul hf, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg c) hB, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul c ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt), abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbf j hj x) (abs_nonneg c)

  have h_jet_mul : ∀ {k : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k B₁ f → rmdJetBnd k B₂ g →
      rmdJetBnd k ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x) := by
    intro k B₁ B₂ f g ⟨hf, hB₁, hbf⟩ ⟨hg, hB₂, hbg⟩
    refine ⟨hf.mul hg, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul ((hf.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)
      ((hg.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)]
    calc
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i f x * iteratedDeriv (j - i) g x|
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), |(j.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i f x * iteratedDeriv (j - i) g x| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ) * B₁ * B₂ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        have hi_le : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        have h1 := hbf i (le_trans hi_le hj) x
        have h2 := hbg (j - i) (le_trans (Nat.sub_le j i) hj) x
        have h12 : |iteratedDeriv i f x| * |iteratedDeriv (j - i) g x| ≤ B₁ * B₂ :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB₁
        calc
          (j.choose i : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv i f x| * |iteratedDeriv (j - i) g x|
              = (j.choose i : ℝ) * (|iteratedDeriv i f x| * |iteratedDeriv (j - i) g x|) := by ring
          _ ≤ (j.choose i : ℝ) * (B₁ * B₂) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h12 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          _ = (j.choose i : ℝ) * B₁ * B₂ := by ring
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ)) * B₁ * B₂ := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ j * B₁ * B₂ := by
        have hsum : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (j.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ j := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose j
        rw [hsum]
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₁ * B₂ := by
        have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ j ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k :=
          pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hj
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hB₁) hB₂

  have h_jet_mul_diff : ∀ {k : ℕ} {M_f M_g L_f L_g : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ},
      rmdJetBnd k M_f f₂ → rmdJetBnd k M_g g₁ →
      rmdJetBnd k L_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
      rmdJetBnd k L_g (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) →
      rmdJetBnd k ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * (L_f * M_g + M_f * L_g))
        (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x) := by
    intro k M_f M_g L_f L_g f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hf₂ hg₁ hdf hdg
    have hEq : (fun x => f₁ x * g₁ x - f₂ x * g₂ x) =
        (fun x => (f₁ x - f₂ x) * g₁ x + f₂ x * (g₁ x - g₂ x)) := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [hEq]
    have h1 := h_jet_mul hdf hg₁
    have h2 := h_jet_mul hf₂ hdg
    have h12 := h_jet_add h1 h2
    exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by linarith) h12

  have h_unit_int_raw : ∀ (k : ℕ) (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) G →
      ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ,
        iteratedDeriv j (fun y : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, y)) x =
          ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv j (fun y => G (s, y)) x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro G hG
      have hswap : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun (x s : ℝ) => G (s, x))) :=
        hG.continuous.comp continuous_swap
      have hcont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) :=
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hswap 0 1
      refine ⟨contDiff_zero.mpr hcont, ?_⟩
      intro j hj x
      have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hj
      subst hj0
      simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro G hG
      let G₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => deriv (fun y => G (q.1, y)) q.2
      have hG₁ : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) G₁ := by
        simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using h_slice_contDiff 1 (k + 1) G (by omega) hG
      have h_hasDeriv : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x))
            (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G₁ (s, x₀)) x₀ := by
        intro x₀
        have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Metric.closedBall x₀ 1) :=
          isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_closedBall x₀ 1)
        obtain ⟨B_loc, hB_loc⟩ :=
          hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hG₁.continuous.continuousOn
        have hsub_s : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
          exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
        have h_ne0 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
        have h_res :=
          (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
            (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := 0) (b := 1)
            (F := fun x s => G (s, x)) (F' := fun x s => G₁ (s, x))
            (x₀ := x₀) (s := Metric.ball x₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => B_loc)
            (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ zero_lt_one)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
              (hG.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable)
            ((hG.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
            (hG₁.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs x hx =>
              hB_loc (s, x) ⟨hsub_s hs, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩)
            (intervalIntegrable_const)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s _ x _ => by
              have h_slice : ContDiff ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => G (s, y)) :=
                hG.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
              exact (h_slice.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt)).2
        exact h_res
      have h_deriv_eq : deriv (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G₁ (s, x)) := by
        funext x₀
        exact (h_hasDeriv x₀).deriv
      obtain ⟨h_cd_G₁, h_iter_G₁⟩ := ih G₁ hG₁
      have h_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) :=
        fun x₀ => (h_hasDeriv x₀).differentiableAt
      have h_cd : ContDiff ℝ (((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1))
          (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) := by
        rw [contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
        refine ⟨h_diff, by simp, ?_⟩
        rwa [h_deriv_eq]
      refine ⟨h_cd, ?_⟩
      intro j hj x
      cases j with
      | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      | succ j' =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', h_deriv_eq, h_iter_G₁ j' (by omega) x]
        congr 1
        funext s
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']

  have h_jet_unit_int : ∀ {k : ℕ} {M : ℝ} {G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ},
      ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) G →
      0 ≤ M →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rmdJetBnd k M (fun x => G (s, x))) →
      rmdJetBnd k M (fun x : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G (s, x)) := by
    intro k M G hG hM hGs
    obtain ⟨hcd, hiter⟩ := h_unit_int_raw k G hG
    refine ⟨hcd, hM, ?_⟩
    intro j hj x
    rw [hiter j hj x]
    have hsub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hbnd : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, iteratedDeriv j (fun y => G (s, y)) x‖ ≤ M * |(1 : ℝ) - 0| :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const fun s hs =>
        (hGs s (hsub hs)).2.2 j hj x
    simpa using hbnd

  have h_jet_comp_on : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (M_g B : ℝ) (g f : ℝ → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
      0 ≤ M_g →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ z ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv j g z| ≤ M_g) →
      rmdDerivBnd k B f →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f x ∈ S) →
      rmdJetBnd k (M_g * rmdCompConst k B) (fun x => g (f x)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro S M_g B g f hg hMg hgbnd hf hfS
      refine ⟨hg.comp hf.1, by simp [rmdCompConst]; exact hMg, ?_⟩
      intro j hj x
      have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hj
      subst hj0
      simpa [rmdCompConst, iteratedDeriv_zero] using hgbnd 0 le_rfl (f x) (hfS x)
    | succ k ih =>
      intro S M_g B g f hg hMg hgbnd hf hfS
      have hB : 0 ≤ B := hf.2.1
      have hC_ge : 1 ≤ rmdCompConst (k + 1) B := h_compConst_ge_one (k + 1) B
      refine ⟨hg.comp hf.1, mul_nonneg hMg (le_trans zero_le_one hC_ge), ?_⟩
      intro j hj x
      cases j with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        calc
          |g (f x)| ≤ M_g := by simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hgbnd 0 (by omega) (f x) (hfS x)
          _ = M_g * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ M_g * rmdCompConst (k + 1) B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC_ge hMg
      | succ j' =>
        have h_ne0 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
        have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg.differentiable h_ne0
        have hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.1.differentiable h_ne0
        have h_deriv_comp : deriv (fun y => g (f y)) = fun y => deriv g (f y) * deriv f y := by
          funext y
          exact deriv_comp y hg_diff.differentiableAt hf_diff.differentiableAt
        have hg' : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv g) :=
          (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp (hg : ContDiff ℝ (((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) g)).2.2
        have hgbnd' : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ k → ∀ z ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv r (deriv g) z| ≤ M_g := by
          intro r hr z hz
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          exact hgbnd (r + 1) (by omega) z hz
        have h_gf' := ih S M_g B (deriv g) f hg' hMg hgbnd'
          (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hf) hfS
        have h_f' : rmdJetBnd k B (deriv f) := h_jet_of_deriv hf
        have h_prod := h_jet_mul h_gf' h_f'
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', h_deriv_comp]
        calc
          |iteratedDeriv j' (fun y => deriv g (f y) * deriv f y) x|
              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (M_g * rmdCompConst k B) * B := h_prod.2.2 j' (by omega) x
          _ = M_g * (((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B) * rmdCompConst k B) := by ring
          _ ≤ M_g * (max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B) * rmdCompConst k B) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hMg
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
                (le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one k B))
          _ = M_g * rmdCompConst (k + 1) B := by simp [rmdCompConst]

  have h_jet_comp_diff_on : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ) (L_g B Δ_f : ℝ) (g f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      Convex ℝ S →
      ContDiff ℝ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
      0 ≤ L_g →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ k → ∀ z ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv (r + 1) g z| ≤ L_g) →
      rmdDerivBnd k B f₁ →
      rmdDerivBnd k B f₂ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f₁ x ∈ S ∧ f₂ x ∈ S) →
      rmdJetBnd k Δ_f (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) →
      rmdJetBnd k ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * L_g * rmdCompConst k B * Δ_f)
        (fun x => g (f₁ x) - g (f₂ x)) := by
    intro k S L_g B Δ_f g f₁ f₂ hS hg hLg hgbnd hf₁ hf₂ hfS hdf
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := hf₁.2.1
    have h_ne0 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
    have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg.differentiable h_ne0
    have hg' : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv g) :=
      (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp (hg : ContDiff ℝ (((k : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1)) g)).2.2
    have hEq : (fun x => g (f₁ x) - g (f₂ x)) =
        (fun x => (f₁ x - f₂ x) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv g (f₂ x + s * (f₁ x - f₂ x))) := by
      funext x
      have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_unitInterval_deriv_eq_sub
        (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := g) (f' := deriv g) (z₀ := f₂ x) (z₁ := f₁ x - f₂ x)
        ((hg'.continuous.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).continuousOn)
        (fun s _ => (hg_diff (f₂ x + s • (f₁ x - f₂ x))).hasDerivAt)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel] at h_ftc
      exact h_ftc.symm
    rw [hEq]
    let G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => deriv g (f₂ q.2 + q.1 * (f₁ q.2 - f₂ q.2))
    have hG_cd : ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) G :=
      hg'.comp ((hf₂.1.comp contDiff_snd).add
        (contDiff_fst.mul ((hf₁.1.sub hf₂.1).comp contDiff_snd)))
    have hGs : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        rmdJetBnd k (L_g * rmdCompConst k B) (fun x => G (s, x)) := by
      intro s hs
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := hs.1
      have hs1 : 0 ≤ 1 - s := sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2
      let γ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => f₂ x + s * (f₁ x - f₂ x)
      have hγ_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, γ x = (1 - s) * f₂ x + s * f₁ x := fun x => by ring
      have hγ_S : ∀ x : ℝ, γ x ∈ S := by
        intro x
        rw [hγ_eq x]
        exact hS (hfS x).2 (hfS x).1 hs1 hs0 (by ring)
      have hγ_bnd : rmdDerivBnd k B γ := by
        refine ⟨hf₂.1.add (contDiff_const.mul (hf₁.1.sub hf₂.1)), hB, ?_⟩
        intro j hj1 hj x
        have hEqγ : γ = fun y => (1 - s) * f₂ y + s * f₁ y := funext hγ_eq
        rw [hEqγ, iteratedDeriv_fun_add
          (((contDiff_const.mul hf₂.1).of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)
          (((contDiff_const.mul hf₁.1).of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt),
          iteratedDeriv_const_mul (1 - s) ((hf₂.1.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt),
          iteratedDeriv_const_mul s ((hf₁.1.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt)]
        calc
          |(1 - s) * iteratedDeriv j f₂ x + s * iteratedDeriv j f₁ x|
              ≤ |(1 - s) * iteratedDeriv j f₂ x| + |s * iteratedDeriv j f₁ x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = (1 - s) * |iteratedDeriv j f₂ x| + s * |iteratedDeriv j f₁ x| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs1, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
          _ ≤ (1 - s) * B + s * B :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf₂.2.2 j hj1 hj x) hs1)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf₁.2.2 j hj1 hj x) hs0)
          _ = B := by ring
      have hgbnd' : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ k → ∀ z ∈ S, |iteratedDeriv r (deriv g) z| ≤ L_g := by
        intro r hr z hz
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
        exact hgbnd r hr z hz
      exact h_jet_comp_on k S L_g B (deriv g) γ hg' hLg hgbnd' hγ_bnd hγ_S
    have h_int := h_jet_unit_int hG_cd
      (mul_nonneg hLg (le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one k B))) hGs
    have h_prod := h_jet_mul hdf h_int
    exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by linarith) h_prod

  have h_ftc_unit1 : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous g' → (∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s) →
      g 1 - g 0 = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, g' s := by
    intro g g' hg' hd
    exact (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hd s)
      (hg'.intervalIntegrable 0 1)).symm

  have h_symm_taylor2 : ∀ (F F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ℝ),
      Continuous F₂ →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (F₁ ξ) ξ) →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F₁ (F₂ ξ) ξ) →
      F h + F (-h) - 2 * F 0 =
        h ^ 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * (F₂ (s * h) + F₂ (-(s * h))) := by
    intro F F₁ F₂ h hF₂_cont hF₁ hF₂
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
      F (s * h) + F (-(s * h)) + (1 - s) * h * (F₁ (s * h) - F₁ (-(s * h)))
    let ψ' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
      h ^ 2 * ((1 - s) * (F₂ (s * h) + F₂ (-(s * h))))
    have hψ_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt ψ (ψ' s) s := by
      intro s
      have hs_pos : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * h) h s := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const h
      have hs_neg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -(t * h)) (-h) s := hs_pos.neg
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F (t * h)) (F₁ (s * h) * h) s :=
        (hF₁ (s * h)).comp s hs_pos
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F (-(t * h))) (F₁ (-(s * h)) * (-h)) s :=
        (hF₁ (-(s * h))).comp s hs_neg
      have hd3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) * h) ((0 - 1) * h) s :=
        ((hasDerivAt_const s (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id s)).mul_const h
      have hd4a : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F₁ (t * h)) (F₂ (s * h) * h) s :=
        (hF₂ (s * h)).comp s hs_pos
      have hd4b : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => F₁ (-(t * h))) (F₂ (-(s * h)) * (-h)) s :=
        (hF₂ (-(s * h))).comp s hs_neg
      have htot := (hd1.add hd2).add (hd3.mul (hd4a.sub hd4b))
      convert htot using 1
      dsimp [ψ']
      ring
    have hψ'_cont : Continuous ψ' :=
      continuous_const.mul ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
        ((hF₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)).add
          (hF₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).neg)))
    have h_int := h_ftc_unit1 ψ ψ' hψ'_cont hψ_deriv
    have h_eval : ψ 1 - ψ 0 = F h + F (-h) - 2 * F 0 := by
      dsimp [ψ]
      simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, neg_zero, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero]
      ring
    rw [← h_eval, h_int]
    dsimp [ψ']
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (h ^ 2) _

  have hw_deriv_props : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      Continuous w ∧ Continuous (deriv w) ∧ Continuous (iteratedDeriv 2 w) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (deriv w z) z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (deriv w) (iteratedDeriv 2 w z) z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, |w z| ≤ M₁ ∧ |deriv w z| ≤ M₁ ∧ |iteratedDeriv 2 w z| ≤ M₁) := by
    intro w hw
    have hd0_cd : ContDiff ℝ (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) w :=
      hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hd1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv w) := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_contDiff_iter 1 1 w (hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
    have hd2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (0 : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv 2 w) :=
      h_contDiff_iter 2 0 w (hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
    have hd2_eq : deriv (deriv w) = iteratedDeriv 2 w := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
    refine ⟨hd0_cd.continuous, hd1_cd.continuous, hd2_cd.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z
      exact (hd0_cd.differentiable (by decide)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    · intro z
      rw [← hd2_eq]
      exact (hd1_cd.differentiable (by decide)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    · intro z
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, hw.2.2 2 (by omega) z⟩
      · simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hw.2.2 0 (by omega) z
      · simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hw.2.2 1 (by omega) z

  have h_primPhi_shift_eq : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ (M₀ ξ : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-w M₀) * (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + ξ) - primPhi_ℝ w M₀) =
          ξ * rmdK0 w M₀ ξ := by
    intro w hw M₀ ξ
    obtain ⟨hw_cont, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hw_deriv_props w hw
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (-w M₀) * primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + s * ξ)
    let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ξ * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ) - w M₀)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s := by
      intro s
      have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t * ξ) (0 + 1 * ξ) s :=
        (hasDerivAt_const s M₀).add ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const ξ)
      have hcomp := ((H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w hw (M₀ + s * ξ)).comp s hs).const_mul
        (Real.exp (-w M₀))
      convert hcomp using 1
      dsimp [g']
      have hexp : Real.exp (-w M₀) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ)) =
          Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ) - w M₀) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      calc
        ξ * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ) - w M₀)
            = (Real.exp (-w M₀) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ))) * ξ := by rw [hexp]; ring
        _ = Real.exp (-w M₀) * (Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * ξ)) * (0 + 1 * ξ)) := by ring
    have hg'_cont : Continuous g' :=
      continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
          continuous_const))
    have hint := h_ftc_unit1 g g' hg'_cont hg_deriv
    have heval : g 1 - g 0 = Real.exp (-w M₀) * (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + ξ) - primPhi_ℝ w M₀) := by
      dsimp [g]; simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]; ring
    rw [← heval, hint]
    dsimp [g', rmdK0]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul ξ _

  have h_c0_identity : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ (M₀ h d : ℝ),
        primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + d) = (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ - h) + primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + h)) / 2 →
        d * rmdK0 w M₀ d = h ^ 2 * rmdKsym w M₀ h := by
    intro w hw M₀ h d hmid
    obtain ⟨hw_cont, hw1_cont, _, hw_hd, _, _⟩ := hw_deriv_props w hw
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.exp (-w M₀) * primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + ξ)
    let F₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)
    let F₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => deriv w (M₀ + ξ) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)
    have hF₁_hd : ∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (F₁ ξ) ξ := by
      intro ξ
      have hsh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t) (0 + 1) ξ :=
        (hasDerivAt_const ξ M₀).add (hasDerivAt_id ξ)
      have hc := ((H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w hw (M₀ + ξ)).comp ξ hsh).const_mul
        (Real.exp (-w M₀))
      convert hc using 1
      dsimp [F₁]
      have hexp : Real.exp (-w M₀) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ)) = Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      linarith
    have hF₂_hd : ∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F₁ (F₂ ξ) ξ := by
      intro ξ
      have hsh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t) (0 + 1) ξ :=
        (hasDerivAt_const ξ M₀).add (hasDerivAt_id ξ)
      have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (M₀ + t) - w M₀) (deriv w (M₀ + ξ) * (0 + 1) - 0) ξ :=
        ((hw_hd (M₀ + ξ)).comp ξ hsh).sub (hasDerivAt_const ξ (w M₀))
      convert hsub.exp using 1
      dsimp [F₂]
      ring
    have hF₂_cont : Continuous F₂ :=
      (hw1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).mul
        (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const))
    have hsym := h_symm_taylor2 F F₁ F₂ h hF₂_cont hF₁_hd hF₂_hd
    have h_lhs : d * rmdK0 w M₀ d = (F h + F (-h) - 2 * F 0) / 2 := by
      rw [← h_primPhi_shift_eq w hw M₀ d]
      dsimp [F]
      have hsub_eq : M₀ + -h = M₀ - h := by ring
      rw [hmid, hsub_eq, add_zero]
      ring
    rw [h_lhs, hsym]
    dsimp [rmdKsym, F₂]
    have h_int_eq :
        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
          (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
           deriv w (M₀ + -(s * h)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + -(s * h)) - w M₀))) =
        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
          (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
           deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))) := rfl
    rw [h_int_eq]
    ring

  have h_qual_and_ode : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x + ρ + e_X x
      let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_T + τ_T x
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => realMidpointDispU w X T p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ u_param : ℝ, Function.Periodic (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ u_param x : ℝ,
        deriv (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param) x =
          rmdOdeRhs w (X x + u_param * T x / 2) (u_param * T x / 2)
            (realMidpointDispU w X T u_param x)
            (deriv (fun y => X y + u_param * T y / 2) x)
            (deriv (fun y => u_param * T y / 2) x)) := by
    intro q ρ c_T w e_X τ_T hw he_X hτ_T X T
    have hΦ_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (primPhi_ℝ w) :=
      (H_base.primPhi_contDiff w hw).of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hΨ_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w)) :=
      (H_base.invPrimPhi_contDiff w hw).of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hX_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) X :=
      (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).add he_X.2.1
    have hT_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) T :=
      contDiff_const.add hτ_T.2.1
    have hX_2d : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => X p.2) :=
      hX_cd.comp contDiff_snd
    have hT_2d : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => T p.2) :=
      hT_cd.comp contDiff_snd
    have hJoint : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => realMidpointDispU w X T p.1 p.2) := by
      have h_avg : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            (primPhi_ℝ w (X p.2) + primPhi_ℝ w (X p.2 + p.1 * T p.2)) / 2) :=
        ((hΦ_cd.comp hX_2d).add (hΦ_cd.comp (hX_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hT_2d)))).div_const 2
      have h_lin : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => X p.2 + p.1 * T p.2 / 2) :=
        hX_2d.add ((contDiff_fst.mul hT_2d).div_const 2)
      exact (hΨ_cd.comp h_avg).sub h_lin
    refine ⟨hJoint, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u_param x
      simp only [realMidpointDispU]
      have hXp : X (x + 2 * Real.pi) = X x + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [X]; rw [he_X.1 x]; ring
      have hTp : T (x + 2 * Real.pi) = T x := by
        dsimp [T]; rw [hτ_T.1 x]
      have hYp : X (x + 2 * Real.pi) + u_param * T (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
          (X x + u_param * T x) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        rw [hXp, hTp]; ring
      rw [hYp, hXp, hTp, H_base.midpoint_diag_periodic w hw (X x) (X x + u_param * T x)]
      ring
    · intro u_param x
      obtain ⟨hw_cont, hw1_cont, hw2_cont, hw_hd, hw1_hd, _⟩ := hw_deriv_props w hw
      let h_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => u_param * T y / 2
      let M₀_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => X y + u_param * T y / 2
      let d_fn : ℝ → ℝ := realMidpointDispU w X T u_param
      have h_ne0 : ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
      have hh_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) h_fn :=
        (contDiff_const.mul hT_cd).div_const 2
      have hM₀_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) M₀_fn :=
        hX_cd.add hh_cd
      have hd_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) d_fn :=
        hJoint.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
      have hh_hd : HasDerivAt h_fn (deriv h_fn x) x :=
        (hh_cd.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hM₀_hd : HasDerivAt M₀_fn (deriv M₀_fn x) x :=
        (hM₀_cd.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hd_hd : HasDerivAt d_fn (deriv d_fn x) x :=
        (hd_cd.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h_sum_hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => M₀_fn y + d_fn y) (deriv M₀_fn x + deriv d_fn x) x :=
        hM₀_hd.add hd_hd
      have h_sub_hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => M₀_fn y - h_fn y) (deriv M₀_fn x - deriv h_fn x) x :=
        hM₀_hd.sub hh_hd
      have h_add_hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => M₀_fn y + h_fn y) (deriv M₀_fn x + deriv h_fn x) x :=
        hM₀_hd.add hh_hd
      have h_lhs_hd : HasDerivAt (fun y => primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y + d_fn y))
          (Real.exp (w (M₀_fn x + d_fn x)) * (deriv M₀_fn x + deriv d_fn x)) x :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := primPhi_ℝ w) x
          (H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w hw (M₀_fn x + d_fn x)) h_sum_hd
      have h_rhs_hd : HasDerivAt
          (fun y => (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y - h_fn y) + primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y + h_fn y)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ))
          ((Real.exp (w (M₀_fn x - h_fn x)) * (deriv M₀_fn x - deriv h_fn x) +
            Real.exp (w (M₀_fn x + h_fn x)) * (deriv M₀_fn x + deriv h_fn x)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ)) x :=
        ((HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := primPhi_ℝ w) x
            (H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w hw (M₀_fn x - h_fn x)) h_sub_hd).add
          (HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := primPhi_ℝ w) x
            (H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w hw (M₀_fn x + h_fn x)) h_add_hd)).mul_const
          (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      have h_fn_eq : (fun y => primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y + d_fn y)) =
          (fun y => (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y - h_fn y) + primPhi_ℝ w (M₀_fn y + h_fn y)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
        funext y
        have h1 : M₀_fn y + d_fn y = midpoint_ℝ w (X y) (X y + u_param * T y) := by
          dsimp [M₀_fn, d_fn, realMidpointDispU]; ring
        have h2 : M₀_fn y - h_fn y = X y := by dsimp [M₀_fn, h_fn]; ring
        have h3 : M₀_fn y + h_fn y = X y + u_param * T y := by dsimp [M₀_fn, h_fn]; ring
        rw [h1, h2, h3, H_base.midpoint_eq w hw (X y) (X y + u_param * T y)]
        ring
      rw [h_fn_eq] at h_lhs_hd
      have h_eq_deriv := h_lhs_hd.unique h_rhs_hd
      set M₀ := M₀_fn x
      set h := h_fn x
      set d := d_fn x
      set M₀' := deriv M₀_fn x
      set h' := deriv h_fn x
      set Ed := Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + d))
      have h_mul_exp : M₀' + deriv d_fn x =
          Ed * ((Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) + Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 * M₀' +
            (Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 * h') := by
        have hexp_inv : Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + d)) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
        have hexp_p : Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + h)) =
            Ed * Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) := by
          dsimp [Ed]; rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have hexp_m : Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - h)) =
            Ed * Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀) := by
          dsimp [Ed]; rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have hmul := congrArg (fun v => Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * v) h_eq_deriv
        calc
          M₀' + deriv d_fn x
              = (Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + d))) * (M₀' + deriv d_fn x) := by
                rw [hexp_inv, one_mul]
          _ = Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * (Real.exp (w (M₀ + d)) * (M₀' + deriv d_fn x)) := by ring
          _ = Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) *
                ((Real.exp (w (M₀ - h)) * (M₀' - h') +
                  Real.exp (w (M₀ + h)) * (M₀' + h')) * (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := hmul
          _ = ((Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - h))) * (M₀' - h') +
                (Real.exp (-w (M₀ + d)) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + h))) * (M₀' + h')) / 2 := by ring
          _ = Ed * ((Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) + Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 * M₀' +
                (Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 * h') := by
                rw [hexp_m, hexp_p]; ring
      have h_piece2 : (Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) + Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀) - 2) / 2 =
          h ^ 2 * rmdK2 w M₀ h := by
        let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)
        let G₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => deriv w (M₀ + ξ) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)
        let G₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
          (iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ + ξ) + (deriv w (M₀ + ξ)) ^ 2) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)
        have hG₁_hd : ∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (G₁ ξ) ξ := by
          intro ξ
          have hsh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t) (0 + 1) ξ :=
            (hasDerivAt_const ξ M₀).add (hasDerivAt_id ξ)
          have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (M₀ + t) - w M₀)
              (deriv w (M₀ + ξ) * (0 + 1) - 0) ξ :=
            ((hw_hd (M₀ + ξ)).comp ξ hsh).sub (hasDerivAt_const ξ (w M₀))
          convert hsub.exp using 1; dsimp [G₁]; ring
        have hG₂_hd : ∀ ξ : ℝ, HasDerivAt G₁ (G₂ ξ) ξ := by
          intro ξ
          have hsh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t) (0 + 1) ξ :=
            (hasDerivAt_const ξ M₀).add (hasDerivAt_id ξ)
          have hd_w1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => deriv w (M₀ + t))
              (iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ + ξ) * (0 + 1)) ξ :=
            (hw1_hd (M₀ + ξ)).comp ξ hsh
          have hprod := hd_w1.mul (hG₁_hd ξ)
          convert hprod using 1; dsimp [G, G₁, G₂]; ring
        have hG₂_cont : Continuous G₂ :=
          (((hw2_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).add
            ((hw1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).pow 2)).mul
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp
              ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).sub continuous_const)))
        have hsym := h_symm_taylor2 G G₁ G₂ h hG₂_cont hG₁_hd hG₂_hd
        have hG0 : G 0 = 1 := by dsimp [G]; simp
        have hGm : G (-h) = Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀) := rfl
        rw [hG0, hGm] at hsym
        have h_int_eq :
            (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * (G₂ (s * h) + G₂ (-(s * h)))) =
            (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
              ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ + s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ + s * h)) ^ 2) *
                 Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
               (iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ - s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ - s * h)) ^ 2) *
                 Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))) := rfl
        rw [h_int_eq] at hsym
        dsimp [rmdK2]
        linarith
      have h_piece_lin : Ed - 1 = d * rmdKlin w M₀ d := by
        let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + s * d))
        let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (-d) * (deriv w (M₀ + s * d) * Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + s * d)))
        have hg_hd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s := by
          intro s
          have hsh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t * d) (0 + 1 * d) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s M₀).add ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const d)
          have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w M₀ - w (M₀ + t * d))
              (0 - deriv w (M₀ + s * d) * (0 + 1 * d)) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s (w M₀)).sub ((hw_hd (M₀ + s * d)).comp s hsh)
          convert hsub.exp using 1; dsimp [g']; ring
        have hg'_cont : Continuous g' :=
          continuous_const.mul
            ((hw1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
              (Real.continuous_exp.comp
                (continuous_const.sub
                  (hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))))))
        have hint := h_ftc_unit1 g g' hg'_cont hg_hd
        have heval : g 1 - g 0 = Ed - 1 := by
          dsimp [g, Ed]; simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_self, Real.exp_zero]
        rw [← heval, hint]
        dsimp [g', rmdKlin]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (-d)]
        ring
      have h_piece1 : (Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 =
          h * rmdK1 w M₀ h := by
        let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))
        let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
          (h / 2) * (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
            deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))
        have hg_hd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s := by
          intro s
          have hsh_p : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ + t * h) (0 + 1 * h) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s M₀).add ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const h)
          have hsh_m : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀ - t * h) (0 - 1 * h) s :=
