            (hasDerivAt_const s M₀).sub ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const h)
          have hsub_p : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (M₀ + t * h) - w M₀)
              (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * (0 + 1 * h) - 0) s :=
            ((hw_hd (M₀ + s * h)).comp s hsh_p).sub (hasDerivAt_const s (w M₀))
          have hsub_m : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (M₀ - t * h) - w M₀)
              (deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * (0 - 1 * h) - 0) s :=
            ((hw_hd (M₀ - s * h)).comp s hsh_m).sub (hasDerivAt_const s (w M₀))
          convert (hsub_p.exp.sub hsub_m.exp).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) using 1
          dsimp [g']; ring
        have hg'_cont : Continuous g' :=
          continuous_const.mul
            (((hw1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
              (Real.continuous_exp.comp
                ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                  continuous_const))).add
            ((hw1_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
              (Real.continuous_exp.comp
                ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                  continuous_const))))
        have hint := h_ftc_unit1 g g' hg'_cont hg_hd
        have heval : g 1 - g 0 =
            (Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2 := by
          dsimp [g]; simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_zero, sub_self]; ring
        rw [← heval, hint]
        dsimp [g', rmdK1]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (h / 2)]
        ring
      dsimp [rmdOdeRhs]
      have h_rearr : deriv d_fn x =
          (Ed * ((Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) + Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀) - 2) / 2) +
            (Ed - 1)) * M₀' +
          Ed * ((Real.exp (w (M₀ + h) - w M₀) - Real.exp (w (M₀ - h) - w M₀)) / 2) * h' := by
        linarith [h_mul_exp]
      rw [h_rearr, h_piece2, h_piece_lin, h_piece1]
      ring

  let C₀_mid : ℝ := 21 * M₁ * Real.exp (4 * M₁)
  have hC₀_pos : 0 < C₀_mid := by positivity

  have h_rmdK0_lower : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ (M₀ d : ℝ), Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤ rmdK0 w M₀ d := by
    intro w hw M₀ d
    obtain ⟨hw_cont, _, _, _, _, hw_bnd⟩ := hw_deriv_props w hw
    have h_const_int : (∫ _s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) = Real.exp (-2 * M₁) := by simp
    rw [← h_const_int]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one intervalIntegrable_const
    · exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((hw_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
          continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · intro s _
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have h1 := (hw_bnd (M₀ + s * d)).1; have h2 := (hw_bnd M₀).1
      rw [abs_le] at h1 h2; linarith

  have h_rmdKsym_upper : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      ∀ (M₀ h : ℝ), |rmdKsym w M₀ h| ≤ M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁) := by
    intro w hw M₀ h
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hw_bnd⟩ := hw_deriv_props w hw
    dsimp [rmdKsym]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
    have hsub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]; exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hbnd : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
        (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
         deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))‖ ≤
        (2 * M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * |(1 : ℝ) - 0| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hsub hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - s)]
      have h_term : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
          |deriv w (M₀ + ξ) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀)| ≤ M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁) := by
        intro ξ
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        have hw1 := (hw_bnd (M₀ + ξ)).2.1
        have hw0a := (hw_bnd (M₀ + ξ)).1; have hw0b := (hw_bnd M₀).1
        rw [abs_le] at hw0a hw0b
        have hexp : Real.exp (w (M₀ + ξ) - w M₀) ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        exact mul_le_mul hw1 hexp (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (le_of_lt hM₁)
      have hp := h_term (s * h)
      have hm_eq : M₀ - s * h = M₀ + -(s * h) := by ring
      have hm := h_term (-(s * h))
      rw [← hm_eq] at hm
      have hsum : |deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
          deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀)| ≤
          2 * M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁) :=
        le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
      have h1s : 1 - s ≤ 1 := by linarith
      calc
        (1 - s) * |deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
            deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀)|
            ≤ 1 * (2 * M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) :=
          mul_le_mul h1s hsum (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 2 * M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁) := one_mul _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hbnd
    have hbnd' : |∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
        (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
         deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))| ≤
        2 * M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁) := by simpa using hbnd
    linarith

  have h_step_h_bounds : ∀ (q : ℕ) (c_T u_param : ℝ) (τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
      4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) → u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        |u_param * (c_T + τ_T x) / 2| ≤ 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) ∧
        (u_param * (c_T + τ_T x) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro q c_T u_param τ_T hq hc_T hu hτ_T x
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
    have hpi : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
    have hτ0 : |τ_T x| ≤ (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hτ_T.2.2 0 (by omega) x
    have hτ0' : |τ_T x| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by
      calc
        |τ_T x| ≤ (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ := hτ0
        _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by field_simp
    have hT_abs : |c_T + τ_T x| ≤ 9 / (q : ℝ) := by
      calc
        |c_T + τ_T x| ≤ |c_T| + |τ_T x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) + (1 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := add_le_add hc_T hτ0'
        _ = (2 * Real.pi + 1 / 4) / (q : ℝ) := by ring
        _ ≤ 9 / (q : ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hq_pos)
    have hu_abs : |u_param| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu.1]; exact hu.2
    have hh_abs : |u_param * (c_T + τ_T x) / 2| ≤ 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      calc
        |u_param| * |c_T + τ_T x| / 2 ≤ 1 * (9 / (q : ℝ)) / 2 := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num)
          exact mul_le_mul hu_abs hT_abs (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by ring
    refine ⟨hh_abs, ?_⟩
    have hsq : (u_param * (c_T + τ_T x) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hh_abs 2
    calc
      (u_param * (c_T + τ_T x) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) ^ 2 := hsq
      _ = (81 / 4 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ 21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)

  have h_c0_single : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T u_param : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
      4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) → u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          |realMidpointDispU w (fun y => y + ρ + e_X y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T y) u_param x| ≤
          C₀_mid := by
    intro q ρ c_T u_param w e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu hw _he_X hτ_T x
    set X_x := x + ρ + e_X x
    set T_x := c_T + τ_T x
    set h := u_param * T_x / 2
    set M₀ := X_x + h
    set d := realMidpointDispU w (fun y => y + ρ + e_X y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T y) u_param x
    have hmid : primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + d) = (primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ - h) + primPhi_ℝ w (M₀ + h)) / 2 := by
      have h1 : M₀ + d = midpoint_ℝ w X_x (X_x + u_param * T_x) := by
        dsimp [M₀, h, d, realMidpointDispU]; ring
      have h2 : M₀ - h = X_x := by dsimp [M₀, h]; ring
      have h3 : M₀ + h = X_x + u_param * T_x := by dsimp [M₀, h]; ring
      rw [h1, h2, h3]; exact H_base.midpoint_eq w hw X_x (X_x + u_param * T_x)
    have hid := h_c0_identity w hw M₀ h d hmid
    have hK0_ge := h_rmdK0_lower w hw M₀ d
    have hK0_pos : 0 < rmdK0 w M₀ d := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hK0_ge
    have hKsym_le := h_rmdKsym_upper w hw M₀ h
    have hh2_le := (h_step_h_bounds q c_T u_param τ_T hq hc_T hu hτ_T x).2
    have h_abs_id : |d| * rmdK0 w M₀ d = h ^ 2 * |rmdKsym w M₀ h| := by
      have := congrArg _root_.abs hid
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hK0_pos, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg h)] at this
    have h_d_exp : |d| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤ (21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) := by
      calc
        |d| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤ |d| * rmdK0 w M₀ d :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK0_ge (abs_nonneg d)
        _ = h ^ 2 * |rmdKsym w M₀ h| := h_abs_id
        _ ≤ (21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) :=
          mul_le_mul hh2_le hKsym_le (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have hq2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
      positivity
    have hexp_cancel : Real.exp (-2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) = 1 := by
      have h0 : -2 * M₁ + 2 * M₁ = 0 := by ring
      rw [← Real.exp_add, h0, Real.exp_zero]
    have hexp_4 : Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) = Real.exp (4 * M₁) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    calc
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d|
          = ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * (|d| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) := by
            calc
              (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d| = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d| * (Real.exp (-2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) := by
                rw [hexp_cancel, mul_one]
              _ = ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * (|d| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * ((21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_d_exp (by positivity)
      _ = 21 * M₁ * (Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
          ring
      _ = C₀_mid := by
          rw [hexp_4, div_self (ne_of_gt hq2_pos), mul_one]

  let L₀_mid : ℝ :=
    Real.exp (4 * M₁) * (5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid)
  have hL₀_pos : 0 < L₀_mid := by positivity

  have h_c0_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T Δe Δτ u_param : ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ)
      (e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) → u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      0 ≤ Δe → 0 ≤ Δτ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁ →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁ →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂ →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂ →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun z => e_X₁ z - e_X₂ z) y| ≤ Δe) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ y : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun z => τ_T₁ z - τ_T₂ z) y| ≤ Δτ) →
      ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          |realMidpointDispU w₁ (fun y => y + ρ + e_X₁ y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T₁ y) u_param x -
           realMidpointDispU w₂ (fun y => y + ρ + e_X₂ y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T₂ y) u_param x| ≤
          L₀_mid * (Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) := by
    intro q ρ c_T Δe Δτ u_param w₁ w₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂
      hq hc_T hu hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ he_X₁ hτ_T₁ he_X₂ hτ_T₂ hde hdτ x
    obtain ⟨hw₁_cont, _, _, hw₁_hd, hw₁_1_hd, hw₁_bnd⟩ := hw_deriv_props w₁ hw₁
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hw₂_bnd⟩ := hw_deriv_props w₂ hw₂
    obtain ⟨hDw_nonneg, hDw_bnd⟩ := H_base.diff_global_bound w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    set Δw := realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂
    set Λ := Δe + (q : ℝ) * Δτ + Δw
    have hq_ge4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hq2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hΛ_nonneg : 0 ≤ Λ := by positivity
    have hw_pt_lip : ∀ z₁ z₂ : ℝ, |w₁ z₁ - w₂ z₂| ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| + Δw := by
      intro z₁ z₂
      have h1 : |w₁ z₁ - w₁ z₂| ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
            (𝕜 := ℝ) (s := Set.univ) (f := w₁) (C := M₁)
            (fun z _ => (hw₁_hd z).differentiableAt)
            (fun z _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (hw₁_bnd z).2.1)
            convex_univ trivial trivial
      have h2 : |w₁ z₂ - w₂ z₂| ≤ Δw := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hDw_bnd 0 (by omega) z₂
      calc
        |w₁ z₁ - w₂ z₂| = |(w₁ z₁ - w₁ z₂) + (w₁ z₂ - w₂ z₂)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |w₁ z₁ - w₁ z₂| + |w₁ z₂ - w₂ z₂| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| + Δw := add_le_add h1 h2
    have hw1_pt_lip : ∀ z₁ z₂ : ℝ, |deriv w₁ z₁ - deriv w₂ z₂| ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| + Δw := by
      intro z₁ z₂
      have hd2_eq : deriv (deriv w₁) = iteratedDeriv 2 w₁ := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
      have h1 : |deriv w₁ z₁ - deriv w₁ z₂| ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
            (𝕜 := ℝ) (s := Set.univ) (f := deriv w₁) (C := M₁)
            (fun z _ => (hw₁_1_hd z).differentiableAt)
            (fun z _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hd2_eq]; exact (hw₁_bnd z).2.2)
            convex_univ trivial trivial
      have h2 : |deriv w₁ z₂ - deriv w₂ z₂| ≤ Δw := by
        have hsub : deriv (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) z₂ = deriv w₁ z₂ - deriv w₂ z₂ := by
          have hw2_hd := (hw_deriv_props w₂ hw₂).2.2.2.1 z₂
          exact ((hw₁_hd z₂).sub hw2_hd).deriv
        have hb := hDw_bnd 1 (by omega) z₂
        rwa [iteratedDeriv_one, hsub] at hb
      calc
        |deriv w₁ z₁ - deriv w₂ z₂|
            = |(deriv w₁ z₁ - deriv w₁ z₂) + (deriv w₁ z₂ - deriv w₂ z₂)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |deriv w₁ z₁ - deriv w₁ z₂| + |deriv w₁ z₂ - deriv w₂ z₂| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ M₁ * |z₁ - z₂| + Δw := add_le_add h1 h2
    have hexp_pt_lip : ∀ u₁ u₂ : ℝ,
        u₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) →
        u₂ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) →
        |Real.exp u₁ - Real.exp u₂| ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) * |u₁ - u₂| := by
      intro u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (𝕜 := ℝ) (s := Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁)) (f := Real.exp) (C := Real.exp (2 * M₁))
          (fun u _ => Real.differentiableAt_exp)
          (fun u hu => by
            rw [Real.deriv_exp, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos u)]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hu.2)
          (convex_Icc _ _) hu₂ hu₁

    set X₁_x := x + ρ + e_X₁ x
    set T₁_x := c_T + τ_T₁ x
    set h₁ := u_param * T₁_x / 2
    set M₀₁ := X₁_x + h₁
    set d₁ := realMidpointDispU w₁ (fun y => y + ρ + e_X₁ y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T₁ y) u_param x
    set X₂_x := x + ρ + e_X₂ x
    set T₂_x := c_T + τ_T₂ x
    set h₂ := u_param * T₂_x / 2
    set M₀₂ := X₂_x + h₂
    set d₂ := realMidpointDispU w₂ (fun y => y + ρ + e_X₂ y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T₂ y) u_param x

    have hid₁ : d₁ * rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₁ = h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ := by
      apply h_c0_identity w₁ hw₁ M₀₁ h₁ d₁
      have ha : M₀₁ + d₁ = midpoint_ℝ w₁ X₁_x (X₁_x + u_param * T₁_x) := by
        dsimp [M₀₁, h₁, d₁, realMidpointDispU]; ring
      have hb : M₀₁ - h₁ = X₁_x := by dsimp [M₀₁, h₁]; ring
      have hc : M₀₁ + h₁ = X₁_x + u_param * T₁_x := by dsimp [M₀₁, h₁]; ring
      rw [ha, hb, hc]; exact H_base.midpoint_eq w₁ hw₁ _ _
    have hid₂ : d₂ * rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂ = h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂ := by
      apply h_c0_identity w₂ hw₂ M₀₂ h₂ d₂
      have ha : M₀₂ + d₂ = midpoint_ℝ w₂ X₂_x (X₂_x + u_param * T₂_x) := by
        dsimp [M₀₂, h₂, d₂, realMidpointDispU]; ring
      have hb : M₀₂ - h₂ = X₂_x := by dsimp [M₀₂, h₂]; ring
      have hc : M₀₂ + h₂ = X₂_x + u_param * T₂_x := by dsimp [M₀₂, h₂]; ring
      rw [ha, hb, hc]; exact H_base.midpoint_eq w₂ hw₂ _ _
    let K_seg : ℝ := ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂)) - w₁ M₀₁)
    have h_seg_eq : (d₁ - d₂) * K_seg =
        (h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂) -
          d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂) := by
      have h_ftc_seg :
          Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₁) - primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂)) =
            (d₁ - d₂) * K_seg := by
        let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂))
        let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (d₁ - d₂) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂)) - w₁ M₀₁)
        have hg_hd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' s) s := by
          intro s
          have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => M₀₁ + d₂ + t * (d₁ - d₂)) (0 + 1 * (d₁ - d₂)) s :=
            (hasDerivAt_const s (M₀₁ + d₂)).add ((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const (d₁ - d₂))
          have hc := ((H_base.primPhi_hasDerivAt w₁ hw₁ _).comp s hs).const_mul (Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁))
          convert hc using 1; dsimp [g']
          have hexp : Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂))) =
              Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂)) - w₁ M₀₁) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          calc
            (d₁ - d₂) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂)) - w₁ M₀₁)
                = (Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂)))) * (d₁ - d₂) := by
                  rw [hexp]; ring
            _ = Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂))) * (0 + 1 * (d₁ - d₂))) := by
                  ring
        have hg'_cont : Continuous g' :=
          continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp
            ((hw₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
              continuous_const))
        have hint := h_ftc_unit1 g g' hg'_cont hg_hd
        have heval : g 1 - g 0 =
            Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₁) - primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂)) := by
          dsimp [g]
          have h1 : M₀₁ + d₂ + 1 * (d₁ - d₂) = M₀₁ + d₁ := by ring
          have h0 : M₀₁ + d₂ + 0 * (d₁ - d₂) = M₀₁ + d₂ := by ring
          rw [h1, h0]; ring
        rw [← heval, hint]
        dsimp [g', K_seg]
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (d₁ - d₂) _
      have h_split_phi :
          Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₁) - primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂)) =
            Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₁) - primPhi_ℝ w₁ M₀₁) -
              Real.exp (-w₁ M₀₁) * (primPhi_ℝ w₁ (M₀₁ + d₂) - primPhi_ℝ w₁ M₀₁) := by ring
      rw [← h_ftc_seg, h_split_phi, h_primPhi_shift_eq w₁ hw₁ M₀₁ d₁,
        h_primPhi_shift_eq w₁ hw₁ M₀₁ d₂, hid₁]
      linarith [hid₂]

    have hKseg_ge : Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤ K_seg := by
      have h_const_int : (∫ _s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) = Real.exp (-2 * M₁) := by simp
      rw [← h_const_int]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one intervalIntegrable_const
      · exact (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          ((hw₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
            continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
      · intro s _
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have h1 := (hw₁_bnd (M₀₁ + d₂ + s * (d₁ - d₂))).1
        have h2 := (hw₁_bnd M₀₁).1
        rw [abs_le] at h1 h2; linarith
    have hKseg_pos : 0 < K_seg := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hKseg_ge

    have hde0 : |e_X₁ x - e_X₂ x| ≤ Δe := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hde 0 (by omega) x
    have hdτ0 : |τ_T₁ x - τ_T₂ x| ≤ Δτ := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hdτ 0 (by omega) x
    have hu_abs : |u_param| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu.1]; exact hu.2
    have hh_diff : |h₁ - h₂| ≤ Δτ / 2 := by
      have hEq : h₁ - h₂ = u_param * (τ_T₁ x - τ_T₂ x) / 2 := by dsimp [h₁, h₂, T₁_x, T₂_x]; ring
      rw [hEq, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      calc
        |u_param| * |τ_T₁ x - τ_T₂ x| / 2 ≤ 1 * Δτ / 2 := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num)
          exact mul_le_mul hu_abs hdτ0 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = Δτ / 2 := by ring
    have hM₀_diff : |M₀₁ - M₀₂| ≤ Δe + Δτ / 2 := by
      have hEq : M₀₁ - M₀₂ = (e_X₁ x - e_X₂ x) + (h₁ - h₂) := by dsimp [M₀₁, M₀₂, X₁_x, X₂_x]; ring
      rw [hEq]
      exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add hde0 hh_diff)
    have h_q_dtau : Δτ ≤ (q : ℝ) * Δτ := by nlinarith
    have hM₀_le_Λ : |M₀₁ - M₀₂| ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
    have h_M₀_sh_le_Λ : ∀ (s : ℝ), s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        |(M₀₁ + s * h₁) - (M₀₂ + s * h₂)| ≤ Λ ∧
        |(M₀₁ - s * h₁) - (M₀₂ - s * h₂)| ≤ Λ := by
      intro s hs
      have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
      have hsh : |s * (h₁ - h₂)| ≤ Δτ / 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        calc
          |s| * |h₁ - h₂| ≤ 1 * (Δτ / 2) := mul_le_mul hs_abs hh_diff (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = Δτ / 2 := one_mul _
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hEq : (M₀₁ + s * h₁) - (M₀₂ + s * h₂) = (M₀₁ - M₀₂) + s * (h₁ - h₂) := by ring
        rw [hEq]
        have := le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add hM₀_diff hsh)
        dsimp [Λ]; linarith
      · have hEq : (M₀₁ - s * h₁) - (M₀₂ - s * h₂) = (M₀₁ - M₀₂) - s * (h₁ - h₂) := by ring
        rw [hEq]
        have := le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add hM₀_diff hsh)
        dsimp [Λ]; linarith
    obtain ⟨hh₁_abs, _⟩ := h_step_h_bounds q c_T u_param τ_T₁ hq hc_T hu hτ_T₁ x
    obtain ⟨hh₂_abs, hh₂_sq⟩ := h_step_h_bounds q c_T u_param τ_T₂ hq hc_T hu hτ_T₂ x
    have hh_sq_diff : |h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2| ≤ (5 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ := by
      have hEq : h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2 = (h₁ - h₂) * (h₁ + h₂) := by ring
      have hsum : |h₁ + h₂| ≤ 9 / (q : ℝ) := by
        calc
          |h₁ + h₂| ≤ |h₁| + |h₂| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) + 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := add_le_add hh₁_abs hh₂_abs
          _ = 9 / (q : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [hEq, abs_mul]
      calc
        |h₁ - h₂| * |h₁ + h₂| ≤ (Δτ / 2) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul hh_diff hsum (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = (9 / 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((q : ℝ) * Δτ) := by field_simp
        _ ≤ (5 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((q : ℝ) * Δτ) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (5 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
          dsimp [Λ]; linarith

    have hK0_diff : |rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂| ≤
        2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by
      dsimp [rmdK0]
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          ((hw₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
            continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
      have hw₂_cont := (hw_deriv_props w₂ hw₂).1
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        (Real.continuous_exp.comp
          ((hw₂_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
            continuous_const)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ)
        (f := fun s => Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁) -
          Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂))
        (fun s _ => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          have hu₁ : w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) := by
            have ha := (hw₁_bnd (M₀₁ + s * d₂)).1; have hb := (hw₁_bnd M₀₁).1
            rw [abs_le] at ha hb; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          have hu₂ : w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) := by
            have ha := (hw₂_bnd (M₀₂ + s * d₂)).1; have hb := (hw₂_bnd M₀₂).1
            rw [abs_le] at ha hb; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          have h_arg : |(w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂)| ≤
              2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ := by
            have hEq : (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂) =
                (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂)) - (w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂) := by ring
            have h1 := hw_pt_lip (M₀₁ + s * d₂) (M₀₂ + s * d₂)
            have h1_eq : (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - (M₀₂ + s * d₂) = M₀₁ - M₀₂ := by ring
            rw [h1_eq] at h1
            have h2 := hw_pt_lip M₀₁ M₀₂
            have hΔw_le : Δw ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
            rw [hEq]
            calc
              |(w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂)) - (w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂)|
                  ≤ |w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂)| + |w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂| := abs_sub _ _
              _ ≤ (M₁ * |M₀₁ - M₀₂| + Δw) + (M₁ * |M₀₁ - M₀₂| + Δw) := add_le_add h1 h2
              _ ≤ (M₁ * Λ + Λ) + (M₁ * Λ + Λ) := by nlinarith
              _ = 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ := by ring
          calc
            |Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂)|
                ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) *
                    |(w₁ (M₀₁ + s * d₂) - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * d₂) - w₂ M₀₂)| :=
              hexp_pt_lip _ _ hu₁ hu₂
            _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) * (2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_arg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
            _ = 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by ring)
      simpa using hb

    have hKsym_diff : |rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂| ≤
        (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by
      obtain ⟨_, hw₁_1_cont, _, _, _, _⟩ := hw_deriv_props w₁ hw₁
      obtain ⟨hw₂_cont, hw₂_1_cont, _, _, _, _⟩ := hw_deriv_props w₂ hw₂
      dsimp [rmdKsym]
      rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
      let f₁_int : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (1 - s) *
        (deriv w₁ (M₀₁ + s * h₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * h₁) - w₁ M₀₁) +
         deriv w₁ (M₀₁ - s * h₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ - s * h₁) - w₁ M₀₁))
      let f₂_int : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => (1 - s) *
        (deriv w₂ (M₀₂ + s * h₂) * Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * h₂) - w₂ M₀₂) +
         deriv w₂ (M₀₂ - s * h₂) * Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ - s * h₂) - w₂ M₀₂))
      have hf₁_cont : Continuous f₁_int :=
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
          (((hw₁_1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp
              ((hw₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                continuous_const))).add
          ((hw₁_1_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp
              ((hw₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                continuous_const))))
      have hf₂_cont : Continuous f₂_int :=
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
          (((hw₂_1_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp
              ((hw₂_cont.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                continuous_const))).add
          ((hw₂_1_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp
              ((hw₂_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).sub
                continuous_const))))
      change (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |(∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, f₁_int s) - (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, f₂_int s)| ≤ _
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hf₁_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
        (hf₂_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 1), ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_pt_branch : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : ℝ), |y₁ - y₂| ≤ Λ →
          |deriv w₁ y₁ * Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) -
            deriv w₂ y₂ * Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)| ≤
          (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by
        intro y₁ y₂ hy
        have hΔw_le : Δw ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
        have h_dw : |deriv w₁ y₁ - deriv w₂ y₂| ≤ (M₁ + 1) * Λ := by
          have h1 := hw1_pt_lip y₁ y₂; nlinarith
        have hu₁ : w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) := by
          have ha := (hw₁_bnd y₁).1; have hb := (hw₁_bnd M₀₁).1
          rw [abs_le] at ha hb; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hu₂ : w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) := by
          have ha := (hw₂_bnd y₂).1; have hb := (hw₂_bnd M₀₂).1
          rw [abs_le] at ha hb; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h_exp : |Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)| ≤
            2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by
          have hEq : (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂) =
              (w₁ y₁ - w₂ y₂) - (w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂) := by ring
          have h1 := hw_pt_lip y₁ y₂
          have h2 := hw_pt_lip M₀₁ M₀₂
          have h_arg : |(w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)| ≤ 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ := by
            rw [hEq]
            calc
              |(w₁ y₁ - w₂ y₂) - (w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂)|
                  ≤ |w₁ y₁ - w₂ y₂| + |w₁ M₀₁ - w₂ M₀₂| := abs_sub _ _
              _ ≤ (M₁ * |y₁ - y₂| + Δw) + (M₁ * |M₀₁ - M₀₂| + Δw) := add_le_add h1 h2
              _ ≤ 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ := by nlinarith
          calc
            |Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)|
                ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) * |(w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)| :=
              hexp_pt_lip _ _ hu₁ hu₂
            _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) * (2 * (M₁ + 1) * Λ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_arg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
            _ = 2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by ring
        have h_split : deriv w₁ y₁ * Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) -
            deriv w₂ y₂ * Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂) =
            (deriv w₁ y₁ - deriv w₂ y₂) * Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) +
              deriv w₂ y₂ * (Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)) := by ring
        have hexp1_le : |Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁)| ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) := by
          rw [abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hu₁.2
        have hdw2_le : |deriv w₂ y₂| ≤ M₁ := (hw₂_bnd y₂).2.1
        rw [h_split]
        calc
          |(deriv w₁ y₁ - deriv w₂ y₂) * Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) +
              deriv w₂ y₂ * (Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂))|
              ≤ |(deriv w₁ y₁ - deriv w₂ y₂) * Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁)| +
                |deriv w₂ y₂ * (Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂))| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |deriv w₁ y₁ - deriv w₂ y₂| * |Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁)| +
                |deriv w₂ y₂| * |Real.exp (w₁ y₁ - w₁ M₀₁) - Real.exp (w₂ y₂ - w₂ M₀₂)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ ((M₁ + 1) * Λ) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) +
                M₁ * (2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul h_dw hexp1_le (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul hdw2_le h_exp (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hM₁))
          _ = (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ := by ring
      have hsub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]; exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
      have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := 2 * ((2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ))
        (f := fun s => f₁_int s - f₂_int s)
        (fun s hs => by
          have hsI := hsub hs
          obtain ⟨hsh_p, hsh_m⟩ := h_M₀_sh_le_Λ s hsI
          have hp := h_pt_branch (M₀₁ + s * h₁) (M₀₂ + s * h₂) hsh_p
          have hm := h_pt_branch (M₀₁ - s * h₁) (M₀₂ - s * h₂) hsh_m
          have hEq : f₁_int s - f₂_int s = (1 - s) *
              ((deriv w₁ (M₀₁ + s * h₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ + s * h₁) - w₁ M₀₁) -
                deriv w₂ (M₀₂ + s * h₂) * Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ + s * h₂) - w₂ M₀₂)) +
               (deriv w₁ (M₀₁ - s * h₁) * Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁ - s * h₁) - w₁ M₀₁) -
                deriv w₂ (M₀₂ - s * h₂) * Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂ - s * h₂) - w₂ M₀₂))) := by
            dsimp [f₁_int, f₂_int]; ring
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hEq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hsI.2] : 0 ≤ 1 - s)]
          have h1s : 1 - s ≤ 1 := by linarith [hsI.1]
          have hsum := le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add hp hm)
          calc
            (1 - s) * |_ + _| ≤ 1 * (2 * ((2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ)) := by
              apply mul_le_mul h1s _ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
              linarith
            _ = 2 * ((2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) := one_mul _)
      have hb' : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, f₁_int s - f₂_int s‖ ≤
          2 * ((2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) := by simpa using hb
      linarith

    have hd₂_le : |d₂| ≤ C₀_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hc0 := h_c0_single q ρ c_T u_param w₂ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hq hc_T hu hw₂ he_X₂ hτ_T₂ x
      exact (le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr hc0
    have hKsym₁_le := h_rmdKsym_upper w₁ hw₁ M₀₁ h₁
    have h_rhs_le :
        |(h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂) -
          d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂)| ≤
        ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid) *
          Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h_part1 : |h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂| ≤
          ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1)) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have hEq : h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂ =
            (h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2) * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ +
              h₂ ^ 2 * (rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂) := by ring
        rw [hEq]
        calc
          |(h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2) * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ +
              h₂ ^ 2 * (rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂)|
              ≤ |(h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2) * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁| +
                |h₂ ^ 2 * (rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |h₁ ^ 2 - h₂ ^ 2| * |rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁| +
                h₂ ^ 2 * |rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg h₂)]
          _ ≤ ((5 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ) * (M₁ * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) +
                (21 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hh_sq_diff hKsym₁_le (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul hh₂_sq hKsym_diff (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1)) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) /
                (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_part2 : |d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂)| ≤
          (2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        calc
          |d₂| * |rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂|
              ≤ (C₀_mid / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * (2 * (M₁ + 1) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) :=
            mul_le_mul hd₂_le hK0_diff (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      calc
        |(h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂) -
            d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂)|
            ≤ |h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂| +
              |d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂)| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1)) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 +
              (2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
          add_le_add h_part1 h_part2
        _ = ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid) *
              Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_abs_seg : |d₁ - d₂| * K_seg =
        |(h₁ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₁ M₀₁ h₁ - h₂ ^ 2 * rmdKsym w₂ M₀₂ h₂) -
          d₂ * (rmdK0 w₁ M₀₁ d₂ - rmdK0 w₂ M₀₂ d₂)| := by
      have := congrArg _root_.abs h_seg_eq
      rwa [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hKseg_pos] at this
    have h_d_diff_exp : |d₁ - d₂| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤
        ((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid) *
          Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        |d₁ - d₂| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁) ≤ |d₁ - d₂| * K_seg :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hKseg_ge (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ _ := by rw [h_abs_seg]; exact h_rhs_le
    have hexp_cancel : Real.exp (-2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) = 1 := by
      have h0 : -2 * M₁ + 2 * M₁ = 0 := by ring
      rw [← Real.exp_add, h0, Real.exp_zero]
    have hexp_4 : Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁) = Real.exp (4 * M₁) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    calc
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d₁ - d₂|
          = ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * (|d₁ - d₂| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) := by
            calc
              (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d₁ - d₂|
                  = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |d₁ - d₂| * (Real.exp (-2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) := by
                rw [hexp_cancel, mul_one]
              _ = ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) * (|d₁ - d₂| * Real.exp (-2 * M₁)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) *
            (((5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid) *
              Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Λ) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_d_diff_exp (by positivity)
      _ = (Real.exp (2 * M₁) * Real.exp (2 * M₁)) *
            (5 * M₁ + 21 * (2 * M₁ ^ 2 + 3 * M₁ + 1) + 2 * (M₁ + 1) * C₀_mid) * Λ *
            ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = L₀_mid * Λ := by
          rw [hexp_4, div_self (ne_of_gt hq2_pos), mul_one]

  have h_w_single : ∀ {r d_obs : ℕ} {B_Y : ℝ} {w Y : ℝ → ℝ},
      r ≤ m + 1 → d_obs ≤ 2 →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      rmdDerivBnd r B_Y Y →
      rmdJetBnd r (M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y) (fun y => iteratedDeriv d_obs w (Y y)) := by
    intro r d_obs B_Y w Y hr hd_obs hw hY
    have hg_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv d_obs w) :=
      h_contDiff_iter d_obs r w (hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
    have hg_bnd : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ r → ∀ z ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
        |iteratedDeriv j (iteratedDeriv d_obs w) z| ≤ M₁ := by
      intro j hj z _
      rw [h_iter_add d_obs j w]
      exact hw.2.2 (j + d_obs) (by omega) z
    exact h_jet_comp_on r Set.univ M₁ B_Y (iteratedDeriv d_obs w) Y
      hg_cd (le_of_lt hM₁) hg_bnd hY (fun _ => trivial)

  have h_iter_exp : ∀ j : ℕ, iteratedDeriv j Real.exp = Real.exp := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => simp [iteratedDeriv_zero]
    | succ j ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, Real.deriv_exp]

  have h_exp_w_single : ∀ {r : ℕ} {B_Y : ℝ} {w A B : ℝ → ℝ},
      r ≤ m + 1 →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      rmdDerivBnd r B_Y A →
      rmdDerivBnd r B_Y B →
      rmdJetBnd r
        (Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y))
        (fun y => Real.exp (w (A y) - w (B y))) := by
    intro r B_Y w A B hr hw hA hB
    have hwA : rmdJetBnd r (M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y) (fun y => w (A y)) := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 0 ≤ 2) hw hA
    have hwB : rmdJetBnd r (M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y) (fun y => w (B y)) := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 0 ≤ 2) hw hB
    have hU : rmdJetBnd r (2 * M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y) (fun y => w (A y) - w (B y)) :=
      h_jet_mono le_rfl (by linarith) (h_jet_sub hwA hwB)
    have hU_mem : ∀ y : ℝ, w (A y) - w (B y) ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁) := by
      intro y
      have h1 : |w (A y)| ≤ M₁ := by simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hw.2.2 0 (by omega) (A y)
      have h2 : |w (B y)| ≤ M₁ := by simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hw.2.2 0 (by omega) (B y)
      rw [abs_le] at h1 h2
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hexp_bnd : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ r → ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁),
        |iteratedDeriv j Real.exp z| ≤ Real.exp (2 * M₁) := by
      intro j _ z hz
      rw [h_iter_exp j, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos z)]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hz.2
    exact h_jet_comp_on r (Set.Icc (-2 * M₁) (2 * M₁)) (Real.exp (2 * M₁))
      (2 * M₁ * rmdCompConst r B_Y) Real.exp (fun y => w (A y) - w (B y))
      (Real.contDiff_exp) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) hexp_bnd (h_deriv_of_jet hU) hU_mem

  have h_M₀_h_jets : ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T u_param : ℝ) (e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
      4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) → u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y + ρ + e_X y
      let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => c_T + τ_T y
      let h_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => u_param * T y / 2
      let M₀_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => X y + u_param * T y / 2
      rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) 2 M₀_fn ∧
      rmdJetBnd (m + 1) 2 (deriv M₀_fn) ∧
      rmdJetBnd (m + 2) (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) h_fn ∧
      rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) h_fn ∧
      rmdJetBnd (m + 1) (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) (deriv h_fn) := by
    intro q ρ c_T u_param e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu he_X hτ_T X T h_fn M₀_fn
    have hq_ge4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have h4q_le1 : (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have hu_abs : |u_param| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu.1]; exact hu.2
    have he_jet : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X :=
      ⟨he_X.2.1, by positivity, he_X.2.2⟩
    have hτ_jet : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T :=
      ⟨hτ_T.2.1, by positivity, hτ_T.2.2⟩
    have hh_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) h_fn :=
      (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.add hτ_T.2.1)).div_const 2
    have hh_deriv_bnd : rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) h_fn := by
      have hEq : h_fn = fun y => (u_param * c_T / 2) + (u_param / 2) * τ_T y := by
        funext y; dsimp [h_fn, T]; ring
      refine ⟨hh_cd, by positivity, ?_⟩
      intro j hj1 hj y
      have h_lin := h_jet_const_mul (u_param / 2) hτ_jet
      rw [hEq, iteratedDeriv_fun_add contDiffAt_const ((h_lin.1.of_le (by norm_cast)).contDiffAt),
        iteratedDeriv_const]
      have hj_ne0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [hj_ne0, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
      calc
        |iteratedDeriv j (fun z => (u_param / 2) * τ_T z) y|
            ≤ |u_param / 2| * (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ := h_lin.2.2 j hj y
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
          linarith
        _ = 1 / (8 * (q : ℝ)) := by field_simp; ring
    have hh_jet : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) h_fn := by
      refine ⟨hh_cd, by positivity, ?_⟩
      intro j hj y
      cases j with
      | zero =>
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using (h_step_h_bounds q c_T u_param τ_T hq hc_T hu hτ_T y).1
      | succ j' =>
        have h1 := hh_deriv_bnd.2.2 (j' + 1) (by omega) hj y
        have h_le : 1 / (8 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 9 / (2 * (q : ℝ)) := by
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          linarith

    have h_id_deriv : rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) 1 (fun y : ℝ => y + ρ) := by
      refine ⟨contDiff_id.add contDiff_const, zero_le_one, ?_⟩
      intro j hj1 _ y
      cases j with
      | zero => omega
      | succ j' =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
        have hd_eq : deriv (fun z : ℝ => z + ρ) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
          funext z
          have hd_z : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y + ρ) (1 + 0) z :=
            (hasDerivAt_id z).add (hasDerivAt_const z ρ)
          simpa only [add_zero] using hd_z.deriv
        rw [hd_eq, iteratedDeriv_const]
        split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hM₀_deriv : rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) 2 M₀_fn := by
      have hEq : M₀_fn = fun y => ((y + ρ) + e_X y) + h_fn y := by
        funext y; dsimp [M₀_fn, X, h_fn]
      rw [hEq]
      have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_add h_id_deriv (h_deriv_of_jet he_jet)) hh_deriv_bnd
      have h8q_le : 1 / (8 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 32 := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
        linarith
      exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by linarith) hsum
    exact ⟨hM₀_deriv, h_jet_of_deriv hM₀_deriv, hh_jet, hh_deriv_bnd, h_jet_of_deriv hh_deriv_bnd⟩

  have h_single_kernels : ∀ (r : ℕ) (C_r : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T u_param : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
      r ≤ m + 1 → 0 < C_r → 4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) →
      u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
      IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
      let X : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y + ρ + e_X y
      let T : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => c_T + τ_T y
      let h_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => u_param * T y / 2
      let M₀_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => X y + u_param * T y / 2
      let d_fn : ℝ → ℝ := realMidpointDispU w X T u_param
      let B_r := 3 + C_r / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_r
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      rmdJetBnd r (C_r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) d_fn →
      rmdJetBnd r M_E (fun y => Real.exp (w (M₀_fn y) - w (M₀_fn y + d_fn y))) ∧
      rmdJetBnd r M_K1 (fun y => rmdKlin w (M₀_fn y) (d_fn y)) ∧
      rmdJetBnd r M_K1 (fun y => rmdK1 w (M₀_fn y) (h_fn y)) ∧
      rmdJetBnd r M_K2 (fun y => rmdK2 w (M₀_fn y) (h_fn y)) := by
    intro r C_r q ρ c_T u_param w e_X τ_T hr hCr hq hc_T hu hw he_X hτ_T
      X T h_fn M₀_fn d_fn B_r K_c M_E M_K1 M_K2 hd_r
    obtain ⟨hM₀_d, _, _, hh_d, _⟩ := h_M₀_h_jets q ρ c_T u_param e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu he_X hτ_T
    have hq_ge4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hq2_ge16 : (16 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hh_d1 : rmdDerivBnd r 1 h_fn := by
      have h8q_le1 : 1 / (8 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
      exact h_deriv_mono (by omega) h8q_le1 hh_d
    have hd_d_sub : rmdDerivBnd r (C_r / 16) d_fn := by
      have h_le : C_r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ C_r / 16 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hCr) (by norm_num) hq2_ge16
      exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl h_le (h_deriv_of_jet hd_r)
    have hM₀_B : rmdDerivBnd r B_r M₀_fn :=
      h_deriv_mono (by omega) (by dsimp [B_r]; linarith) hM₀_d
    have hM₀_sd_B : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rmdDerivBnd r B_r (fun y => M₀_fn y + s * d_fn y) := by
      intro s hs
      have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
      have hsd := h_deriv_const_mul s hd_d_sub
      have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_d) hsd
      exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_r]; nlinarith) hsum
    have hM₀_sh_B : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        rmdDerivBnd r B_r (fun y => M₀_fn y + s * h_fn y) ∧
        rmdDerivBnd r B_r (fun y => M₀_fn y - s * h_fn y) := by
      intro s hs
      have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hsh := h_deriv_const_mul s hh_d1
        have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_d) hsh
        exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_r]; nlinarith) hsum
      · have hEq : (fun y => M₀_fn y - s * h_fn y) = fun y => M₀_fn y + (-s) * h_fn y := by
          funext y; ring
        rw [hEq]
        have hsh := h_deriv_const_mul (-s) hh_d1
        have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_d) hsh
        rw [abs_neg] at hsum
        exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_r]; nlinarith) hsum
    have hw0_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) w := hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hw1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv w) := by
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using
        h_contDiff_iter 1 r w (hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
    have hw2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv 2 w) :=
      h_contDiff_iter 2 r w (hw.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
    have hM₀_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => M₀_fn p.2) :=
      (hM₀_B.1).comp contDiff_snd
    have hh_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => h_fn p.2) :=
      (hh_d1.1).comp contDiff_snd
    have hd_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => d_fn p.2) :=
      (hd_r.1).comp contDiff_snd
    have hKc_pos : 0 ≤ K_c := le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one r B_r)
    have hME_pos : 0 ≤ M_E :=

    have hEd : rmdJetBnd r M_E (fun y => Real.exp (w (M₀_fn y) - w (M₀_fn y + d_fn y))) := by

    have hKlin : rmdJetBnd r M_K1 (fun y => rmdKlin w (M₀_fn y) (d_fn y)) := by

        deriv w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * d_fn p.2) *
          Real.exp (w (M₀_fn p.2) - w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * d_fn p.2))
      have hG_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) G_lin :=
        (hw1_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hd_2d))).mul
          ((hw0_cd.comp hM₀_2d).sub (hw0_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hd_2d)))).exp
      have hGs : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rmdJetBnd r M_K1 (fun y => G_lin (s, y)) := by
        intro s hs
        have h_dw : rmdJetBnd r (M₁ * K_c) (fun y => deriv w (M₀_fn y + s * d_fn y)) := by
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hw (hM₀_sd_B s hs)
        have h_ex := h_exp_w_single hr hw hM₀_B (hM₀_sd_B s hs)
        exact h_jet_mul h_dw h_ex
      have h_int := h_jet_unit_int hG_cd (by dsimp [M_K1]; positivity) hGs
      have hEq : (fun y => rmdKlin w (M₀_fn y) (d_fn y)) =
          fun y => (-1 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, G_lin (s, y) := by
        funext y; dsimp [rmdKlin, G_lin]; ring
      rw [hEq]
      exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by simp) (h_jet_const_mul (-1 : ℝ) h_int)
    have hK1 : rmdJetBnd r M_K1 (fun y => rmdK1 w (M₀_fn y) (h_fn y)) := by
      let G_k1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>
        deriv w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * h_fn p.2) *
          Real.exp (w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * h_fn p.2) - w (M₀_fn p.2)) +
        deriv w (M₀_fn p.2 - p.1 * h_fn p.2) *
          Real.exp (w (M₀_fn p.2 - p.1 * h_fn p.2) - w (M₀_fn p.2))
      have hG_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) G_k1 :=
        ((hw1_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))).mul
          ((hw0_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))).sub (hw0_cd.comp hM₀_2d)).exp).add
        ((hw1_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.sub (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))).mul
          ((hw0_cd.comp (hM₀_2d.sub (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))).sub (hw0_cd.comp hM₀_2d)).exp)
      have hGs : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rmdJetBnd r (2 * M_K1) (fun y => G_k1 (s, y)) := by
        intro s hs
        obtain ⟨hsh_p, hsh_m⟩ := hM₀_sh_B s hs
        have h_p := h_jet_mul
          (by simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hw hsh_p)
          (h_exp_w_single hr hw hsh_p hM₀_B)
        have h_m := h_jet_mul
          (by simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hw hsh_m)
          (h_exp_w_single hr hw hsh_m hM₀_B)
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [M_K1]; linarith) (h_jet_add h_p h_m)
      have h_int := h_jet_unit_int hG_cd (by dsimp [M_K1]; positivity) hGs
      exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by norm_num; linarith) (h_jet_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) h_int)
    have hK2 : rmdJetBnd r M_K2 (fun y => rmdK2 w (M₀_fn y) (h_fn y)) := by
      let G_k2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => (1 - p.1) *
        (((iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * h_fn p.2) +
            (deriv w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * h_fn p.2)) ^ 2) *
           Real.exp (w (M₀_fn p.2 + p.1 * h_fn p.2) - w (M₀_fn p.2))) +
         ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀_fn p.2 - p.1 * h_fn p.2) +
            (deriv w (M₀_fn p.2 - p.1 * h_fn p.2)) ^ 2) *
           Real.exp (w (M₀_fn p.2 - p.1 * h_fn p.2) - w (M₀_fn p.2))))
      have h_branch_cd : ∀ (Y_2d : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) Y_2d →

        intro Y_2d hY
        exact ((hw2_cd.comp hY).add ((hw1_cd.comp hY).pow 2)).mul
          ((hw0_cd.comp hY).sub (hw0_cd.comp hM₀_2d)).exp
      have hG_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) G_k2 :=
        (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst).mul
          ((h_branch_cd _ (hM₀_2d.add (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))).add
            (h_branch_cd _ (hM₀_2d.sub (contDiff_fst.mul hh_2d))))
      have hGs : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, rmdJetBnd r (2 * M_K2) (fun y => G_k2 (s, y)) := by
        intro s hs
        obtain ⟨hsh_p, hsh_m⟩ := hM₀_sh_B s hs
        have h_br : ∀ {Y : ℝ → ℝ}, rmdDerivBnd r B_r Y →
            rmdJetBnd r M_K2 (fun y =>
              (iteratedDeriv 2 w (Y y) + (deriv w (Y y)) ^ 2) * Real.exp (w (Y y) - w (M₀_fn y))) := by
          intro Y hY
          have hw2Y := h_w_single hr (le_rfl : 2 ≤ 2) hw hY
          have hw1Y : rmdJetBnd r (M₁ * K_c) (fun y => deriv w (Y y)) := by
            simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_w_single hr (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hw hY
          have hw1_sq : rmdJetBnd r ((2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c))
              (fun y => (deriv w (Y y)) ^ 2) := by
            have hsq_eq : (fun y => (deriv w (Y y)) ^ 2) = fun y => deriv w (Y y) * deriv w (Y y) := by
              funext y; ring
            rw [hsq_eq]; exact h_jet_mul hw1Y hw1Y
          exact h_jet_mul (h_jet_add hw2Y hw1_sq) (h_exp_w_single hr hw hY hM₀_B)
        have hsum := h_jet_add (h_br hsh_p) (h_br hsh_m)
        have h1s : |1 - s| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2])]; linarith [hs.1]
        have hM_K2_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_K2 := by dsimp [M_K2]; positivity
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by nlinarith) (h_jet_const_mul (1 - s) hsum)
      have h_int := h_jet_unit_int hG_cd (by dsimp [M_K2]; positivity) hGs
      exact h_jet_mono le_rfl (by norm_num; linarith) (h_jet_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ) h_int)
    exact ⟨hEd, hKlin, hK1, hK2⟩

  have h_single_seq_pos : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < rmdSingleSeq M₁ C₀_mid r := by
    intro r

  have h_single_ind : ∀ (r : ℕ), r ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ (q : ℕ) (ρ c_T u_param : ℝ) (w e_X τ_T : ℝ → ℝ),
        4 ≤ q → |c_T| ≤ 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) → u_param ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
        IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X →
        IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T →
        rmdJetBnd r (rmdSingleSeq M₁ C₀_mid r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
          (realMidpointDispU w (fun y => y + ρ + e_X y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T y) u_param) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro _ q ρ c_T u_param w e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu hw he_X hτ_T
      have hq2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
        positivity
      obtain ⟨hJoint, _, _⟩ := h_qual_and_ode q ρ c_T w e_X τ_T hw he_X hτ_T
      have hd_cd : ContDiff ℝ (0 : WithTop ℕ∞)
          (realMidpointDispU w (fun y => y + ρ + e_X y) (fun y => c_T + τ_T y) u_param) :=
        (hJoint.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).of_le (by norm_cast)
      refine ⟨hd_cd, by simp [rmdSingleSeq]; positivity, ?_⟩
      intro j hj x
      have hj0 : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hj
      subst hj0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, rmdSingleSeq]
      exact (le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr
        (h_c0_single q ρ c_T u_param w e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu hw he_X hτ_T x)
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr1 q ρ c_T u_param w e_X τ_T hq hc_T hu hw he_X hτ_T
      have hr : r ≤ m + 1 := by omega
      have hq2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < q)
        positivity
      set X : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y + ρ + e_X y

  have h_w_diff : ∀ {r d_obs : ℕ} {B_Y κ Λ : ℝ} {w₁ w₂ Y₁ Y₂ : ℝ → ℝ},

      have hq2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have hq2_ge16 : (16 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hDw_nonneg := (H_base.diff_global_bound w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂).1
      have hΛ_nonneg : 0 ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; positivity
      have hΔw_le_Λ : realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂ ≤ Λ := by
        have hqdt : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * Δτ := by positivity
        dsimp [Λ]; linarith
      set h₁_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => u_param * T₁ y / 2
      set M₀₁_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => X₁ y + u_param * T₁ y / 2
      set d₁_fn : ℝ → ℝ := realMidpointDispU w₁ X₁ T₁ u_param
      set h₂_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => u_param * T₂ y / 2
      set M₀₂_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => X₂ y + u_param * T₂ y / 2
      set d₂_fn : ℝ → ℝ := realMidpointDispU w₂ X₂ T₂ u_param
      set L_r := rmdLipSeq M₁ C_single L₀_mid r
      have hLr_pos : 0 < L_r := h_lip_seq_pos r
      have hd_diff_r : rmdJetBnd r (L_r * Λ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => d₁_fn y - d₂_fn y) :=
        ih (by omega) q ρ c_T Δe Δτ u_param w₁ w₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂
          hq hc_T hu hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ he_X₁ hτ_T₁ he_X₂ hτ_T₂ hde hdτ
      obtain ⟨hJoint₁, _, hOde₁⟩ := h_qual_and_ode q ρ c_T w₁ e_X₁ τ_T₁ hw₁ he_X₁ hτ_T₁
      obtain ⟨hJoint₂, _, hOde₂⟩ := h_qual_and_ode q ρ c_T w₂ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hw₂ he_X₂ hτ_T₂
      have hd₁_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) d₁_fn :=
        hJoint₁.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
      have hd₂_cd : ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) d₂_fn :=
        hJoint₂.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

      have hd₁_single : rmdJetBnd r (C_single / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) d₁_fn :=
        h_jet_mono (by omega) le_rfl
          (h_single_ind (m + 2) le_rfl q ρ c_T u_param w₁ e_X₁ τ_T₁ hq hc_T hu hw₁ he_X₁ hτ_T₁)
      have hd₂_single : rmdJetBnd r (C_single / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) d₂_fn :=
        h_jet_mono (by omega) le_rfl
          (h_single_ind (m + 2) le_rfl q ρ c_T u_param w₂ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hq hc_T hu hw₂ he_X₂ hτ_T₂)
      obtain ⟨hEd₁, hKlin₁, hK1₁, hK2₁⟩ :=
        h_single_kernels r C_single q ρ c_T u_param w₁ e_X₁ τ_T₁
          hr hC_single_pos hq hc_T hu hw₁ he_X₁ hτ_T₁ hd₁_single
      obtain ⟨hEd₂, hKlin₂, hK1₂, hK2₂⟩ :=
        h_single_kernels r C_single q ρ c_T u_param w₂ e_X₂ τ_T₂
          hr hC_single_pos hq hc_T hu hw₂ he_X₂ hτ_T₂ hd₂_single
      obtain ⟨hM₀₁_d, hM₀₁'_m1, hh₁_m2, hh₁_d, hh₁'_m1⟩ :=
        h_M₀_h_jets q ρ c_T u_param e_X₁ τ_T₁ hq hc_T hu he_X₁ hτ_T₁
      obtain ⟨hM₀₂_d, hM₀₂'_m1, hh₂_m2, hh₂_d, hh₂'_m1⟩ :=
        h_M₀_h_jets q ρ c_T u_param e_X₂ τ_T₂ hq hc_T hu he_X₂ hτ_T₂

      let B_star := 3 + C_single / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_star
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      let M_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K2
      let M_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K1
      let M_P12 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) * M_EdK2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * C_single * M_K1
      let κ_r := 1 + L_r / 16
      let D_w := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M₁ * K_c * κ_r + K_c
      let D_E := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c) * (2 * D_w)
      let D_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * M_E + (M₁ * K_c) * D_E)
      let D_w2 := D_w + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * (M₁ * K_c) + (M₁ * K_c) * D_w)
      let D_K2 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w2 * M_E + (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * D_E)
      let D_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K2 + M_E * D_K2)
      let D_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K1 + M_E * D_K1)
      let D_P12 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK2 + 21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK2) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (L_r * M_K1 + C_single * D_K1)
      let L_step :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_P12 * 2 + M_P12 * 1) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK1)

      have h_curve_B : ∀ {w_i e_Xi τ_Ti : ℝ → ℝ},
          rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) 2 (fun y => (y + ρ + e_Xi y) + u_param * (c_T + τ_Ti y) / 2) →
          rmdDerivBnd (m + 2) (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) (fun y => u_param * (c_T + τ_Ti y) / 2) →
          rmdJetBnd r (C_single / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (realMidpointDispU w_i (fun y => y + ρ + e_Xi y) (fun y => c_T + τ_Ti y) u_param) →
          let h_i := fun y => u_param * (c_T + τ_Ti y) / 2
          let M₀_i := fun y => (y + ρ + e_Xi y) + u_param * (c_T + τ_Ti y) / 2
          let d_i := realMidpointDispU w_i (fun y => y + ρ + e_Xi y) (fun y => c_T + τ_Ti y) u_param
          rmdDerivBnd r B_star M₀_i ∧
          (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            rmdDerivBnd r B_star (fun y => M₀_i y + s * d_i y) ∧
            rmdDerivBnd r B_star (fun y => M₀_i y + s * h_i y) ∧
            rmdDerivBnd r B_star (fun y => M₀_i y - s * h_i y)) := by
        intro w_i e_Xi τ_Ti hM₀_i hh_i hd_i h_i M₀_i d_i
        have hh_i1 : rmdDerivBnd r 1 h_i := by
          have h8q : 1 / (8 * (q : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
          exact h_deriv_mono (by omega) h8q hh_i
        have hd_i16 : rmdDerivBnd r (C_single / 16) d_i := by
          have hle : C_single / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ C_single / 16 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hC_single_pos) (by norm_num) hq2_ge16
          exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl hle (h_deriv_of_jet hd_i)
        refine ⟨h_deriv_mono (by omega) (by dsimp [B_star]; linarith) hM₀_i, ?_⟩
        intro s hs
        have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_i)
            (h_deriv_const_mul s hd_i16)
          exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_star]; nlinarith) hsum
        · have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_i)
            (h_deriv_const_mul s hh_i1)
          exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_star]; nlinarith) hsum
        · have hEq : (fun y => M₀_i y - s * h_i y) = fun y => M₀_i y + (-s) * h_i y := by
            funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hsum := h_deriv_add (h_deriv_mono (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_i)
            (h_deriv_const_mul (-s) hh_i1)
          rw [abs_neg] at hsum
          exact h_deriv_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [B_star]; nlinarith) hsum

      obtain ⟨hM₀₁_B, h_curves₁⟩ := h_curve_B hM₀₁_d hh₁_d hd₁_single
      obtain ⟨hM₀₂_B, h_curves₂⟩ := h_curve_B hM₀₂_d hh₂_d hd₂_single

      have hde_m2 : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) Δe (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) :=
        ⟨he_X₁.2.1.sub he_X₂.2.1, hΔe, hde⟩
      have hdτ_m2 : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) Δτ (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) :=
        ⟨hτ_T₁.2.1.sub hτ_T₂.2.1, hΔτ, hdτ⟩
      have hu_abs : |u_param| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu.1]; exact hu.2
      have hh_diff_m2 : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) (Δτ / 2) (fun y => h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) := by
        have hEq : (fun y => h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) =
            fun y => (u_param / 2) * (τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) := by
          funext y; dsimp [h₁_fn, h₂_fn, T₁, T₂]; ring
        rw [hEq]
        have hm := h_jet_const_mul (u_param / 2) hdτ_m2
        have hle : |u_param / 2| * Δτ ≤ Δτ / 2 := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
          nlinarith
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle hm
      have hM₀_diff_m2 : rmdJetBnd (m + 2) (Δe + Δτ / 2) (fun y => M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) := by
        have hEq : (fun y => M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) =
            fun y => (e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) + (h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) := by
          funext y; dsimp [M₀₁_fn, M₀₂_fn, X₁, X₂]; ring
        rw [hEq]
        exact h_jet_add hde_m2 hh_diff_m2
      have h_q_dtau : Δτ ≤ (q : ℝ) * Δτ := by nlinarith
      have hM₀'_diff_r : rmdJetBnd r (1 * Λ) (fun y => deriv M₀₁_fn y - deriv M₀₂_fn y) := by
        have hd_sub : (fun y => deriv M₀₁_fn y - deriv M₀₂_fn y) =
            deriv (fun y => M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) := by
          funext y
          have h_ne0 : ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
          have hd1 := (hM₀₁_d.1.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := y)
          have hd2 := (hM₀₂_d.1.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := y)
          exact (hd1.sub hd2).deriv.symm
        rw [hd_sub]
        have hm1 := h_jet_of_deriv (h_deriv_of_jet hM₀_diff_m2)
        exact h_jet_mono hr (by dsimp [Λ]; linarith) hm1
      have hh'_diff_r : rmdJetBnd r (Δτ / 2) (fun y => deriv h₁_fn y - deriv h₂_fn y) := by
        have hd_sub : (fun y => deriv h₁_fn y - deriv h₂_fn y) =
            deriv (fun y => h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) := by
          funext y
          have h_ne0 : ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
          have hd1 := (hh₁_m2.1.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := y)
          have hd2 := (hh₂_m2.1.differentiable h_ne0).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (x := y)
          exact (hd1.sub hd2).deriv.symm
        rw [hd_sub]
        exact h_jet_mono hr le_rfl (h_jet_of_deriv (h_deriv_of_jet hh_diff_m2))

      have hM₀_diff_κ : rmdJetBnd r (κ_r * Λ) (fun y => M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) := by
        have hle : Δe + Δτ / 2 ≤ κ_r * Λ := by
          have : 1 * Λ ≤ κ_r * Λ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [κ_r]; linarith) hΛ_nonneg
          have : Δe + Δτ / 2 ≤ 1 * Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
          linarith
        exact h_jet_mono (by omega) hle hM₀_diff_m2
      have hd_diff_16 : rmdJetBnd r ((L_r / 16) * Λ) (fun y => d₁_fn y - d₂_fn y) := by
        have hle : L_r * Λ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (L_r / 16) * Λ := by
          have h1 : L_r * Λ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ L_r * Λ / 16 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by norm_num) hq2_ge16
          linarith
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle hd_diff_r
      have hM₀_sd_diff_κ : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          rmdJetBnd r (κ_r * Λ) (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y + s * d₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y + s * d₂_fn y)) := by
        intro s hs
        have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
        have hEq : (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y + s * d₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y + s * d₂_fn y)) =
            fun y => (M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) + s * (d₁_fn y - d₂_fn y) := by funext y; ring
        rw [hEq]
        have hsum := h_jet_add (h_jet_mono (by omega) (by dsimp [Λ]; linarith : Δe + Δτ / 2 ≤ Λ) hM₀_diff_m2)
          (h_jet_const_mul s hd_diff_16)
        have hle : Λ + |s| * ((L_r / 16) * Λ) ≤ κ_r * Λ := by
          have : |s| * ((L_r / 16) * Λ) ≤ 1 * ((L_r / 16) * Λ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_abs (by positivity)
          dsimp [κ_r]; linarith
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle hsum
      have hM₀_sh_diff_κ : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          rmdJetBnd r (κ_r * Λ) (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y + s * h₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y + s * h₂_fn y)) ∧
          rmdJetBnd r (κ_r * Λ) (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y - s * h₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y - s * h₂_fn y)) := by
        intro s hs
        have hs_abs : |s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2
        have h_one_le_κ : Λ ≤ κ_r * Λ := by
          have : 1 * Λ ≤ κ_r * Λ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [κ_r]; linarith) hΛ_nonneg
          linarith
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have hEq : (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y + s * h₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y + s * h₂_fn y)) =
              fun y => (M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) + s * (h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hsum := h_jet_add (h_jet_mono (k' := r) (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_diff_m2)
            (h_jet_const_mul s (h_jet_mono (k' := r) (by omega) le_rfl hh_diff_m2))
          have hle : (Δe + Δτ / 2) + |s| * (Δτ / 2) ≤ κ_r * Λ := by
            have : |s| * (Δτ / 2) ≤ 1 * (Δτ / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_abs (by positivity)
            have : Δe + Δτ ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
            linarith
          exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle hsum
        · have hEq : (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y - s * h₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y - s * h₂_fn y)) =
              fun y => (M₀₁_fn y - M₀₂_fn y) - s * (h₁_fn y - h₂_fn y) := by funext y; ring
          rw [hEq]
          have hsum := h_jet_sub (h_jet_mono (k' := r) (by omega) le_rfl hM₀_diff_m2)
            (h_jet_const_mul s (h_jet_mono (k' := r) (by omega) le_rfl hh_diff_m2))
          have hle : (Δe + Δτ / 2) + |s| * (Δτ / 2) ≤ κ_r * Λ := by
            have : |s| * (Δτ / 2) ≤ 1 * (Δτ / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_abs (by positivity)
            have : Δe + Δτ ≤ Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
            linarith
          exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle hsum

      have hw₁_0_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) w₁ := hw₁.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
      have hw₁_1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv w₁) := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_contDiff_iter 1 r w₁ (hw₁.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
      have hw₁_2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv 2 w₁) :=
        h_contDiff_iter 2 r w₁ (hw₁.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
      have hw₂_0_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) w₂ := hw₂.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)
      have hw₂_1_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv w₂) := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using h_contDiff_iter 1 r w₂ (hw₂.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
      have hw₂_2_cd : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv 2 w₂) :=
        h_contDiff_iter 2 r w₂ (hw₂.2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega))
      have hM₀₁_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => M₀₁_fn p.2) :=
        hM₀₁_B.1.comp contDiff_snd
      have hh₁_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => h₁_fn p.2) :=
        (hh₁_m2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)).comp contDiff_snd
      have hd₁_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => d₁_fn p.2) :=
        hd₁_single.1.comp contDiff_snd
      have hM₀₂_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => M₀₂_fn p.2) :=
        hM₀₂_B.1.comp contDiff_snd
      have hh₂_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => h₂_fn p.2) :=
        (hh₂_m2.1.of_le (by norm_cast; omega)).comp contDiff_snd
      have hd₂_2d : ContDiff ℝ (r : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => d₂_fn p.2) :=
        hd₂_single.1.comp contDiff_snd

      have hKc_pos : 0 ≤ K_c := le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one r B_star)
      have hME_pos : 0 ≤ M_E :=
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
          (le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one r (2 * M₁ * K_c)))
      have hDw_pos : 0 ≤ D_w := by dsimp [D_w, κ_r]; positivity
      have hDE_pos : 0 ≤ D_E := by
        have := h_compConst_ge_one r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
        dsimp [D_E]; positivity
      have hDK1_pos : 0 ≤ D_K1 := by dsimp [D_K1]; positivity
      have hDK2_pos : 0 ≤ D_K2 := by dsimp [D_K2, D_w2]; positivity

      have hEd_diff : rmdJetBnd r (D_E * Λ)
          (fun y => Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) - w₁ (M₀₁_fn y + d₁_fn y)) -
            Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) - w₂ (M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y))) := by
        have hd1_B : rmdDerivBnd r B_star (fun y => M₀₁_fn y + d₁_fn y) := by
          simpa using (h_curves₁ 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
        have hd2_B : rmdDerivBnd r B_star (fun y => M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y) := by
          simpa using (h_curves₂ 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
        have hd12_diff : rmdJetBnd r (κ_r * Λ)
            (fun y => (M₀₁_fn y + d₁_fn y) - (M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y)) := by
          simpa using hM₀_sd_diff_κ 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
        exact h_exp_w_diff hr hΛ_nonneg hw₁ hw₂ hΔw_le_Λ
          hM₀₁_B hd1_B hM₀₂_B hd2_B hM₀_diff_κ hd12_diff

      have hKlin_diff : rmdJetBnd r (D_K1 * Λ)
          (fun y => rmdKlin w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) (d₁_fn y) - rmdKlin w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) (d₂_fn y)) := by
        let G₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p =>

        have hle : (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) * (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) ≤
            (2 : ℝ) ^ r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have : (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) * (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) =
              ((9 / 16 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
          rw [this]
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
          have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ r := by positivity
          linarith
        exact h_jet_mono le_rfl hle (h_jet_mul hh₂_r hh₂'_r)
      have hh_sq_diff_r : rmdJetBnd r ((5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ)

        rw [hEq]

        have hm := h_jet_mul (h_jet_mono (by omega) le_rfl hh_diff_m2) hsum_h
        have hle : (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (Δτ / 2) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) ≤

      have hhh'_diff_r : rmdJetBnd r ((3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ)

        have hm := h_jet_mul_diff hh₂_r hh₁'_r

        have hle : (2 : ℝ) ^ r * ((Δτ / 2) * (1 / (8 * (q : ℝ))) + (9 / (2 * (q : ℝ))) * (Δτ / 2)) ≤

          rw [h1]

            linarith

      have h_EdK2_1 : rmdJetBnd r M_EdK2

      have h_EdK2_diff : rmdJetBnd r (D_EdK2 * Λ)

        h_jet_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [D_EdK2]; linarith)
          (h_jet_mul_diff hEd₂ hK2₁ hEd_diff hK2_diff)
      have h_EdK1_diff : rmdJetBnd r (D_EdK1 * Λ)
          (fun y => Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) - w₁ (M₀₁_fn y + d₁_fn y)) * rmdK1 w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) (h₁_fn y) -
            Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) - w₂ (M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y)) * rmdK1 w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) (h₂_fn y)) :=
        h_jet_mono le_rfl (by dsimp [D_EdK1]; linarith)

      have h_t1a_diff := h_jet_mul_diff hh₂_sq_r h_EdK2_1 hh_sq_diff_r h_EdK2_diff
      have h_t1b_diff := h_jet_mul_diff hd₂_single hKlin₁ hd_diff_r hKlin_diff
      let P₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
        h₁_fn y ^ 2 * (Real.exp (w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) - w₁ (M₀₁_fn y + d₁_fn y)) * rmdK2 w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) (h₁_fn y)) +
        d₁_fn y * rmdKlin w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) (d₁_fn y)
      let P₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
        h₂_fn y ^ 2 * (Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) - w₂ (M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y)) * rmdK2 w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) (h₂_fn y)) +

      have hP_diff : rmdJetBnd r (D_P12 * Λ / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun y => P₁ y - P₂ y) := by

             h₂_fn y ^ 2 * (Real.exp (w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) - w₂ (M₀₂_fn y + d₂_fn y)) * rmdK2 w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) (h₂_fn y))) +
            (d₁_fn y * rmdKlin w₁ (M₀₁_fn y) (d₁_fn y) - d₂_fn y * rmdKlin w₂ (M₀₂_fn y) (d₂_fn y)) := by
          funext y; dsimp [P₁, P₂]; ring
        rw [hEq_fn]
        have hsum := h_jet_add h_t1a_diff h_t1b_diff
        have hEq_b :
            (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (((5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * Λ) * M_EdK2 +

      have hM₀₁'_r : rmdJetBnd r 2 (deriv M₀₁_fn) := h_jet_mono hr le_rfl hM₀₁'_m1
      have h_main1 := h_jet_mul_diff hP₂_bnd hM₀₁'_r hP_diff hM₀'_diff_r
      have h_main2 := h_jet_mul_diff hh₂h₂'_r h_EdK1_1 hhh'_diff_r h_EdK1_diff

  let C_lip : ℝ := rmdLipSeq M₁ C_single L₀_mid (m + 2)
  have hC_lip_pos : 0 < C_lip := h_lip_seq_pos (m + 2)
  let C_mid_R : ℝ := max C_single C_lip

  · intro q ρ c_T w e_X τ_T hq hc_T hw he_X hτ_T

real_midpoint_disp_jet_bounds.definitions:
noncomputable def rmdCompConst : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | k + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * B) * rmdCompConst k B

def rmdJetBnd (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B

def rmdDerivBnd (k : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiff ℝ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧
  0 ≤ B ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B

noncomputable def rmdK0 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * d) - w M₀)

noncomputable def rmdKsym (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
    (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdK1 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (deriv w (M₀ + s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     deriv w (M₀ - s * h) * Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdK2 (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) *
    ((iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ + s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ + s * h)) ^ 2) *
       Real.exp (w (M₀ + s * h) - w M₀) +
     (iteratedDeriv 2 w (M₀ - s * h) + (deriv w (M₀ - s * h)) ^ 2) *
       Real.exp (w (M₀ - s * h) - w M₀))

noncomputable def rmdKlin (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv w (M₀ + s * d) * Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + s * d))

noncomputable def rmdOdeRhs (w : ℝ → ℝ) (M₀ h d M₀' h' : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let Ed := Real.exp (w M₀ - w (M₀ + d))
  (h ^ 2 * (Ed * rmdK2 w M₀ h) + d * rmdKlin w M₀ d) * M₀' +
    (h * h') * (Ed * rmdK1 w M₀ h)

noncomputable def rmdSingleSeq (M₁ C₀ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => C₀
  | r + 1 =>
      let C_r := rmdSingleSeq M₁ C₀ r
      let B_r := 3 + C_r / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_r
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      let M_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K2
      let M_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K1
      let C_step :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ r * (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) * M_EdK2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * C_r * M_K1) * 2 +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK1
      max C_r C_step

noncomputable def rmdLipSeq (M₁ C_single L₀ : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => L₀
  | r + 1 =>
      let L_r := rmdLipSeq M₁ C_single L₀ r
      let B_star := 3 + C_single / 16
      let K_c := rmdCompConst r B_star
      let M_E := Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c)
      let M_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * M_E
      let M_K2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * M_E
      let M_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K2
      let M_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_E * M_K1
      let M_P12 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r) * M_EdK2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * C_single * M_K1
      let κ_r := 1 + L_r / 16
      let D_w := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M₁ * K_c * κ_r + K_c
      let D_E := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * Real.exp (2 * M₁) * rmdCompConst r (2 * M₁ * K_c) * (2 * D_w)
      let D_K1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * M_E + (M₁ * K_c) * D_E)
      let D_w2 := D_w + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w * (M₁ * K_c) + (M₁ * K_c) * D_w)
      let D_K2 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_w2 * M_E + (M₁ * K_c + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (M₁ * K_c) * (M₁ * K_c)) * D_E)
      let D_EdK2 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K2 + M_E * D_K2)
      let D_EdK1 := (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_E * M_K1 + M_E * D_K1)
      let D_P12 :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK2 + 21 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK2) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (L_r * M_K1 + C_single * D_K1)
      let L_step :=
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (D_P12 * 2 + M_P12 * 1) +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ r * (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ r * M_EdK1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ r * D_EdK1)
      max L_r L_step
