proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hTK : RjCalcToolkit_rajcb := by
    have h_compConst_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ rjCompConst_rajcb p B := by
      intro p B
      induction p with
      | zero => exact le_rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        simp only [rjCompConst_rajcb]
        exact one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (le_max_left _ _) ih
    have h_compConst_max_zero : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ),
        rjCompConst_rajcb p (max B 0) = rjCompConst_rajcb p B := by
      intro p B
      induction p with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        simp only [rjCompConst_rajcb, max_assoc, max_self, ih]
    have h_congr : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
        {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, F₁ a x = F₂ a x) →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₂ := by
      intro α _ S p B F₁ F₂ hEq hF
      have hFun : ∀ a ∈ S, F₂ a = F₁ a := fun a ha => funext fun x => (hEq a ha x).symm
      refine ⟨fun a ha => hFun a ha ▸ hF.1 a ha, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        refine (hF.2.1 k hk).congr ?_
        intro q hq
        dsimp only
        rw [hFun q.1 hq.1]
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [hFun a ha]
        exact hF.2.2 a ha k hk x
    have h_congr_inner : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
        {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, Φ₁ a x = Φ₂ a x) →
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂ := by
      intro α _ S p B Φ₁ Φ₂ hEq hΦ
      have hFun : ∀ a ∈ S, Φ₂ a = Φ₁ a := fun a ha => funext fun x => (hEq a ha x).symm
      refine ⟨fun a ha => hFun a ha ▸ hΦ.1 a ha, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        refine (hΦ.2.1 k hk).congr ?_
        intro q hq
        dsimp only
        rw [hFun q.1 hq.1]
      · intro a ha j hj1 hjp x
        rw [hFun a ha]
        exact hΦ.2.2 a ha j hj1 hjp x
    have h_mono : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
        {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        B₁ ≤ B₂ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F := by
      intro α _ S p B₁ B₂ F hB hF
      exact ⟨hF.1, hF.2.1, fun a ha k hk x => le_trans (hF.2.2 a ha k hk x) hB⟩
    have h_param_const : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
        {c : α → ℝ},
        0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ B) →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a _ => c a) := by
      intro α _ S p B c hB hc hcb
      refine ⟨fun _ _ => contDiff_const, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k _
        cases k with
        | zero =>
          have h0 : ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => c q.1) (S ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
            hc.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun q hq => hq.1)
          exact h0.congr (fun q _ => by simp)
        | succ n =>
          exact (continuousOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr
            (fun q _ => by simp [iteratedDeriv_const])
      · intro a ha k _ x
        cases k with
        | zero => simpa using hcb a ha
        | succ n => simp [iteratedDeriv_const, hB]
    have h_add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
        {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x + F₂ a x) := by
      intro α _ S p B₁ B₂ F₁ F₂ hF₁ hF₂
      have hId : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F₁ a y + F₂ a y) x =
            iteratedDeriv k (F₁ a) x + iteratedDeriv k (F₂ a) x := by
        intro a ha k hk x
        exact iteratedDeriv_fun_add
          ((hF₁.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
          ((hF₂.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
      refine ⟨fun a ha => (hF₁.1 a ha).add (hF₂.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exact ((hF₁.2.1 k hk).add (hF₂.2.1 k hk)).congr (fun q hq => hId q.1 hq.1 k hk q.2)
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [hId a ha k hk x]
        exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (hF₁.2.2 a ha k hk x) (hF₂.2.2 a ha k hk x))
    have h_sub : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
        {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x - F₂ a x) := by
      intro α _ S p B₁ B₂ F₁ F₂ hF₁ hF₂
      have hId : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F₁ a y - F₂ a y) x =
            iteratedDeriv k (F₁ a) x - iteratedDeriv k (F₂ a) x := by
        intro a ha k hk x
        exact iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
          ((hF₁.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
          ((hF₂.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
      refine ⟨fun a ha => (hF₁.1 a ha).sub (hF₂.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exact ((hF₁.2.1 k hk).sub (hF₂.2.1 k hk)).congr (fun q hq => hId q.1 hq.1 k hk q.2)
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [hId a ha k hk x]
        exact le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add (hF₁.2.2 a ha k hk x) (hF₂.2.2 a ha k hk x))
    have h_neg : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
        {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a x => -F a x) := by
      intro α _ S p B F hF
      refine ⟨fun a ha => (hF.1 a ha).neg, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exact (hF.2.1 k hk).neg.congr (fun q _ => iteratedDeriv_fun_neg k (F q.1) q.2)
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_neg, abs_neg]
        exact hF.2.2 a ha k hk x
    have h_param_mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {C B : ℝ}
        {c : α → ℝ} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ C) →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (C * B) (fun a x => c a * F a x) := by
      intro α _ S p C B c F hC _ hc hcb hF
      have hId : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => c a * F a y) x = c a * iteratedDeriv k (F a) x := by
        intro a ha k hk x
        exact iteratedDeriv_const_mul (c a) ((hF.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
      refine ⟨fun a ha => contDiff_const.mul (hF.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        have hc' : ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => c q.1) (S ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
          hc.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun q hq => hq.1)
        exact (hc'.mul (hF.2.1 k hk)).congr (fun q hq => hId q.1 hq.1 k hk q.2)
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [hId a ha k hk x, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hcb a ha) (hF.2.2 a ha k hk x) (abs_nonneg _) hC
    have h_mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
        {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        0 ≤ B₁ → 0 ≤ B₂ →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x * F₂ a x) := by
      intro α _ S p B₁ B₂ F₁ F₂ hB₁ hB₂ hF₁ hF₂
      have hId : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => F₁ a y * F₂ a y) x =
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (F₁ a) x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) (F₂ a) x := by
        intro a ha k hk x
        exact iteratedDeriv_fun_mul
          ((hF₁.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
          ((hF₂.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
      refine ⟨fun a ha => (hF₁.1 a ha).mul (hF₂.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        have hSumCont : ContinuousOn
            (fun q : α × ℝ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
              (k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (F₁ q.1) q.2 *
                iteratedDeriv (k - i) (F₂ q.1) q.2)
            (S ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
          apply continuousOn_finsetSum
          intro i hi
          have hi_le : i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) hk
          have hki_le : k - i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk
          exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hF₁.2.1 i hi_le)).mul (hF₂.2.1 (k - i) hki_le)
        exact hSumCont.congr (fun q hq => hId q.1 hq.1 k hk q.2)
      · intro a ha k hk x
        rw [hId a ha k hk x]
        calc |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                (k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (F₁ a) x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) (F₂ a) x|
            ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
                |(k.choose i : ℝ) * iteratedDeriv i (F₁ a) x * iteratedDeriv (k - i) (F₂ a) x| :=
              Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ) * (B₁ * B₂) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro i hi
              have hi_le : i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) hk
              have hki_le : k - i ≤ p := le_trans (Nat.sub_le k i) hk
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _), mul_assoc]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul (hF₁.2.2 a ha i hi_le x) (hF₂.2.2 a ha (k - i) hki_le x)
                  (abs_nonneg _) hB₁)
                (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) * (B₁ * B₂) := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₁ * B₂ := by
              have hchoose : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (k.choose i : ℝ)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
                exact_mod_cast Nat.sum_range_choose k
              rw [hchoose, mul_assoc]
          _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂ := by
              have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p :=
                pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk
              have hBB : 0 ≤ B₁ * B₂ := mul_nonneg hB₁ hB₂
              nlinarith
    have h_pullback : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
        {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb T p B (fun b x => F (φ b) x) := by
      intro α β _ _ S T p B φ F hφ hMaps hF
      refine ⟨fun b hb => hF.1 (φ b) (hMaps hb), ?_,
        fun b hb k hk x => hF.2.2 (φ b) (hMaps hb) k hk x⟩
      intro k hk
      exact (hF.2.1 k hk).comp (hφ.prodMap continuousOn_id) (fun q hq => ⟨hMaps hq.1, trivial⟩)
    have h_pullback_inner : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
        {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb T p B (fun b x => Φ (φ b) x) := by
      intro α β _ _ S T p B φ Φ hφ hMaps hΦ
      refine ⟨fun b hb => hΦ.1 (φ b) (hMaps hb), ?_,
        fun b hb j hj1 hjp x => hΦ.2.2 (φ b) (hMaps hb) j hj1 hjp x⟩
      intro k hk
      exact (hΦ.2.1 k hk).comp (hφ.prodMap continuousOn_id) (fun q hq => ⟨hMaps hq.1, trivial⟩)
    have h_inner_of_bounded : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
        {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B F := by
      intro α _ S p B F hF
      exact ⟨hF.1, hF.2.1, fun a ha j _ hjp x => hF.2.2 a ha j hjp x⟩
    have h_inner_add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
        {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₁ Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₂ Φ₂ →
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => Φ₁ a x + Φ₂ a x) := by
      intro α _ S p B₁ B₂ Φ₁ Φ₂ hΦ₁ hΦ₂
      have hId : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k ≤ p, ∀ x : ℝ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y => Φ₁ a y + Φ₂ a y) x =
            iteratedDeriv k (Φ₁ a) x + iteratedDeriv k (Φ₂ a) x := by
        intro a ha k hk x
        exact iteratedDeriv_fun_add
          ((hΦ₁.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
          ((hΦ₂.1 a ha).contDiffAt.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))
      refine ⟨fun a ha => (hΦ₁.1 a ha).add (hΦ₂.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        exact ((hΦ₁.2.1 k hk).add (hΦ₂.2.1 k hk)).congr (fun q hq => hId q.1 hq.1 k hk q.2)
      · intro a ha j hj1 hjp x
        rw [hId a ha j hjp x]
        exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _)
          (add_le_add (hΦ₁.2.2 a ha j hj1 hjp x) (hΦ₂.2.2 a ha j hj1 hjp x))
    have h_comp_bound : ∀ (p : ℕ) {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {M_g B : ℝ}
        {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
        ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
        IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
        0 ≤ M_g →
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j g (Φ a x)| ≤ M_g) →
        IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb p B) (fun a x => g (Φ a x)) := by
      intro p
      induction p with
      | zero =>
        intro α _ S M_g B g Φ hg hΦ _ hMg
        refine ⟨fun a ha => hg.comp (hΦ.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro k hk
          have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
          subst hk0
          exact (hg.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hΦ.2.1 0 le_rfl)).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
        · intro a ha k hk x
          have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
          subst hk0
          simpa [rjCompConst_rajcb] using hMg 0 le_rfl a ha x
      | succ n ih =>
        intro α _ S M_g B g Φ hg hΦ hMg_nn hMg
        have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := hg.differentiable (by simp)
        have hdg : ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv g) :=
          (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp hg).2.2
        have hΦ_n : IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S n B Φ :=
          ⟨fun a ha => (hΦ.1 a ha).of_le (by norm_cast; omega),
           fun k hk => hΦ.2.1 k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk),
           fun a ha j hj1 hjn x => hΦ.2.2 a ha j hj1 (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjn) x⟩
        have hMg_dg : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ,
            |iteratedDeriv j (deriv g) (Φ a x)| ≤ M_g := by
          intro j hj a ha x
          rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          exact hMg (j + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hj) a ha x
        have hIH := ih hdg hΦ_n hMg_nn hMg_dg
        have hΨ : IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S n (max B 0) (fun a x => deriv (Φ a) x) := by
          refine ⟨fun a ha => (contDiff_succ_iff_deriv.mp (hΦ.1 a ha)).2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro i hi
            refine (hΦ.2.1 (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ hi)).congr ?_
            intro q _
            dsimp only
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
          · intro a ha i hi x
            rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
            exact le_trans (hΦ.2.2 a ha (i + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _))
              (Nat.succ_le_succ hi) x) (le_max_left _ _)
        have hMul := h_mul
          (mul_nonneg hMg_nn (le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one n B)))
          (le_max_right B 0) hIH hΨ
        have hDerivEq : ∀ a ∈ S, deriv (fun y => g (Φ a y)) =
            fun y => deriv g (Φ a y) * deriv (Φ a) y := by
          intro a ha
          ext y
          exact deriv_comp y hg_diff.differentiableAt
            ((hΦ.1 a ha).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
        have hDerivJet : IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S n
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb n B) * max B 0)
            (fun a x => deriv (fun y => g (Φ a y)) x) :=
          h_congr (fun a ha x => (congrFun (hDerivEq a ha) x).symm) hMul
        refine ⟨fun a ha => hg.comp (hΦ.1 a ha), ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro k hk
          cases k with
          | zero =>
            exact (hg.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hΦ.2.1 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
          | succ i =>
            have hi : i ≤ n := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
            refine (hDerivJet.2.1 i hi).congr ?_
            intro q _
            dsimp only
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
        · intro a ha k hk x
          cases k with
          | zero =>
            have h0 := hMg 0 (Nat.zero_le _) a ha x
            have hge1 := h_compConst_ge_one (n + 1) B
            calc |iteratedDeriv 0 (fun y => g (Φ a y)) x|
                ≤ M_g := h0
              _ = M_g * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
              _ ≤ M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb (n + 1) B :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge1 hMg_nn
          | succ i =>
            have hi : i ≤ n := Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hk
            rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
            have hb := hDerivJet.2.2 a ha i hi x
            have hle_fac : (2 : ℝ) ^ n * max B 0 ≤
                max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (max B 0 + 1)) := by
              apply le_trans _ (le_max_right 1 _)
              have h2n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) h2n
            have hC_nn : 0 ≤ rjCompConst_rajcb n B :=
              le_trans zero_le_one (h_compConst_ge_one n B)
            calc |iteratedDeriv i (deriv (fun y => g (Φ a y))) x|
                ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb n B) * max B 0 := hb
              _ = M_g * (((2 : ℝ) ^ n * max B 0) * rjCompConst_rajcb n B) := by ring
              _ ≤ M_g * (max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (max B 0 + 1)) * rjCompConst_rajcb n B) :=

        hw₁ := hw, hw₂ := hw, he₁ := he, hτ₁ := hτ, he₂ := he, hτ₂ := hτ,
        hde := fun k _ x => hZeroDiff e_X k x,
        hdτ := fun k _ x => hZeroDiff τ_T k x
      }
      have hJA := (hA J0).2.2.1
      have hJB := (hB J0).2.2.1
      have hX_qp : ∀ x : ℝ, (x + 2 * Real.pi) + ρ + e_X (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
          (x + ρ + e_X x) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        intro x; rw [he.1 x]; ring
      have hT_per : ∀ x : ℝ, sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T (x + 2 * Real.pi) =
          sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)) + τ_T x := by
        intro x; rw [hτ.1 x]
      refine ⟨⟨?_, hJA.1 () trivial, fun k hk x => le_trans (hJA.2.2 () trivial k hk x) hBA_le⟩,
        ⟨?_, hJB.1 () trivial, fun k hk x => le_trans (hJB.2.2 () trivial k hk x) hBB_le⟩⟩
      · intro x; dsimp only; rw [hX_qp x, (hPeriodic w (x + ρ + e_X x) 0 hw).1]
      · intro x; dsimp only; rw [hX_qp x, hT_per x, (hPeriodic w (x + ρ + e_X x) _ hw).2]
    · intro q ρ sgn Δe Δτ w₁ w₂ e_X₁ τ_T₁ e_X₂ τ_T₂ hq hsgn hΔe hΔτ hw₁ hw₂ he₁ hτ₁ he₂ hτ₂ hde hdτ
      let J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀ := {
        q := q, ρ := ρ, sgn := sgn, Δe := Δe, Δτ := Δτ,
        w₁ := w₁, w₂ := w₂, e_X₁ := e_X₁, τ_T₁ := τ_T₁, e_X₂ := e_X₂, τ_T₂ := τ_T₂,
        hq := hq, hsgn := hsgn, hΔe := hΔe, hΔτ := hΔτ,
        hw₁ := hw₁, hw₂ := hw₂, he₁ := he₁, hτ₁ := hτ₁, he₂ := he₂, hτ₂ := hτ₂,
        hde := hde, hdτ := hdτ
      }
      have hJA_lip := (hA J).2.2.2.2
      have hJB_lip := (hB J).2.2.2.2
      refine ⟨fun k hk x => ?_, fun k hk x => ?_⟩
      · exact le_trans (hJA_lip.2.2 () trivial k hk x)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLA_le (hΔA1 J))
      · exact le_trans (hJB_lip.2.2 () trivial k hk x)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLB_le (hΔB1 J))
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨B₀_jet, L₀_jet, hB₀_pos, hL₀_pos, hPtBounds⟩ := hPt
  obtain ⟨C_jet_R, N_jet, hC_pos, hN_ge4, hJetProps, hJetLip⟩ := hJet
  exact ⟨{
    C_jet_R := C_jet_R
    B₀_jet := B₀_jet
    L₀_jet := L₀_jet
    N_jet := N_jet
    C_jet_R_pos := hC_pos
    B₀_jet_pos := hB₀_pos
    L₀_jet_pos := hL₀_pos
    N_jet_ge_four := hN_ge4
    jet_pt_bounds := hPtBounds
    jet_props := hJetProps
    jet_lip := hJetLip
  }⟩

real_action_jet_comp_bounds.definitions:
noncomputable def rjCompConst_rajcb : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, B => max 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ n * (max B 0 + 1)) * rjCompConst_rajcb n B

def IsParamJetBounded_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (F : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (F a)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (F q.1) q.2) (S ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (F a) x| ≤ B)

def IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ a ∈ S, ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) (Φ a)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : α × ℝ => iteratedDeriv k (Φ q.1) q.2) (S ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∧
  (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j (Φ a) x| ≤ B)

def IsParamJetPair_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ)
    (Δ B L : ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₁ ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₂ ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (L * Δ) (fun a x => F₁ a x - F₂ a x)

def IsParamInnerPair_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α) (p : ℕ)
    (Δ B L : ℝ) (Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
  IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ ∧
  IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂ ∧
  IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (L * Δ) (fun a x => Φ₁ a x - Φ₂ a x)

structure JetTwoInput_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ) where
  q : ℕ
  ρ : ℝ
  sgn : ℝ
  Δe : ℝ
  Δτ : ℝ
  w₁ : ℝ → ℝ
  w₂ : ℝ → ℝ
  e_X₁ : ℝ → ℝ
  τ_T₁ : ℝ → ℝ
  e_X₂ : ℝ → ℝ
  τ_T₂ : ℝ → ℝ
  hq : N₀ ≤ q
  hsgn : sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1
  hΔe : 0 ≤ Δe
  hΔτ : 0 ≤ Δτ
  hw₁ : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁
  hw₂ : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂
  he₁ : IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₁
  hτ₁ : IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₁
  he₂ : IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) e_X₂
  hτ₂ : IsRealJetPerturb (m + 2) ((4 * (q : ℝ))⁻¹) τ_T₂
  hde : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => e_X₁ y - e_X₂ y) x| ≤ Δe
  hdτ : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k (fun y => τ_T₁ y - τ_T₂ y) x| ≤ Δτ

noncomputable def JetTwoInput_rajcb.X₁ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ} {N₀ : ℕ}
    (J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x + J.ρ + J.e_X₁ x

noncomputable def JetTwoInput_rajcb.X₂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ} {N₀ : ℕ}
    (J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x + J.ρ + J.e_X₂ x

noncomputable def JetTwoInput_rajcb.T₁ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ} {N₀ : ℕ}
    (J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  J.sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (J.q : ℝ)) + J.τ_T₁ x

noncomputable def JetTwoInput_rajcb.T₂ {m : ℕ} {M₁ : ℝ} {N₀ : ℕ}
    (J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  J.sgn * (2 * Real.pi / (J.q : ℝ)) + J.τ_T₂ x

def HasUniformJetPair_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
    {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (Δ_fn : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀ → ℝ)
    (F₁ F₂ : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀ → α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B L : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
    ∀ J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀,
      IsParamJetPair_rajcb S (m + 2) (Δ_fn J) B L (F₁ J) (F₂ J)

def HasUniformInnerPair_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
    {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (Δ_fn : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀ → ℝ)
    (Φ₁ Φ₂ : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀ → α → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B L : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
    ∀ J : JetTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ N₀,
      IsParamInnerPair_rajcb S (m + 2) (Δ_fn J) B L (Φ₁ J) (Φ₂ J)

structure RjCalcToolkit_rajcb : Prop where
  compConst_ge_one : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ rjCompConst_rajcb p B
  compConst_max_zero : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), rjCompConst_rajcb p (max B 0) = rjCompConst_rajcb p B
  congr : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, F₁ a x = F₂ a x) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F₂
  congr_inner : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, Φ₁ a x = Φ₂ a x) →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂
  mono : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    B₁ ≤ B₂ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F
  param_const : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
      {c : α → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ B) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a _ => c a)
  add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x + F₂ a x)
  sub : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x - F₂ a x)
  neg : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a x => -F a x)
  param_mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {C B : ℝ}
      {c : α → ℝ} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ B → ContinuousOn c S → (∀ a ∈ S, |c a| ≤ C) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (C * B) (fun a x => c a * F a x)
  mul : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {F₁ F₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B₁ → 0 ≤ B₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₁ F₁ → IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B₂ F₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * B₁ * B₂) (fun a x => F₁ a x * F₂ a x)
  pullback : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
      {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb T p B (fun b x => F (φ b) x)
  pullback_inner : ∀ {α β : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β]
      {S : Set α} {T : Set β} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ} {φ : β → α} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContinuousOn φ T → Set.MapsTo φ T S →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb T p B (fun b x => Φ (φ b) x)
  inner_of_bounded : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B F → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B F
  inner_add : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : ℝ}
      {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₁ Φ₁ → IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B₂ Φ₂ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p (B₁ + B₂) (fun a x => Φ₁ a x + Φ₂ a x)
  comp_bound : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {M_g B : ℝ}
      {g : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ →
    0 ≤ M_g →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv j g (Φ a x)| ≤ M_g) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb p B) (fun a x => g (Φ a x))
  param_integral : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} {p : ℕ} {B : ℝ}
      {F : (α × ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ},
    0 ≤ B →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb (S ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) p B F →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p B (fun a x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F (a, t) x)
  comp_diff_bound : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set α} (p : ℕ) {M_g Δg B ΔΦ : ℝ}
      {g₁ g₂ : ℝ → ℝ} {Φ₁ Φ₂ : α → ℝ → ℝ},
    ContDiff ℝ ((p + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) g₁ →
    ContDiff ℝ (p : WithTop ℕ∞) g₂ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₁ →
    IsParamUnboundedInner_rajcb S p B Φ₂ →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p ΔΦ (fun a x => Φ₁ a x - Φ₂ a x) →
    0 ≤ M_g → 0 ≤ Δg → 0 ≤ ΔΦ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ p + 1 → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j g₁ (Φ₂ a x + s * (Φ₁ a x - Φ₂ a x))| ≤ M_g) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ x : ℝ,
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun y => g₁ y - g₂ y) (Φ₂ a x)| ≤ Δg) →
    IsParamJetBounded_rajcb S p
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * (M_g * rjCompConst_rajcb p B) * ΔΦ + Δg * rjCompConst_rajcb p B)
      (fun a x => g₁ (Φ₁ a x) - g₂ (Φ₂ a x))

structure PtTwoInput_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  w : ℝ → ℝ
  X₁ : ℝ
  X₂ : ℝ
  T₁ : ℝ
  T₂ : ℝ
  hw : IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w
  hT₁ : |T₁| ≤ 2
  hT₂ : |T₂| ≤ 2

def IsParamScalarPair_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (δ B L : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
  ContinuousOn f₁ S ∧
  ContinuousOn f₂ S ∧
  ∀ a ∈ S, |f₁ a| ≤ B ∧ |f₂ a| ≤ B ∧ |f₁ a - f₂ a| ≤ L * δ

def IsParamScalarInner_rajcb {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (δ L : ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ : α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ L ∧
  ContinuousOn φ₁ S ∧
  ContinuousOn φ₂ S ∧
  ∀ a ∈ S, |φ₁ a - φ₂ a| ≤ L * δ

def HasUniformScalarPair_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (δ_fn : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ → ℝ)
    (f₁ f₂ : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ → α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ B L : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧
    ∀ P : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁,
      IsParamScalarPair_rajcb S (δ_fn P) B L (f₁ P) (f₂ P)

def HasUniformScalarInner_rajcb (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (S : Set α)
    (δ_fn : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ → ℝ)
    (φ₁ φ₂ : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁ → α → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧
    ∀ P : PtTwoInput_rajcb m M₁,
      IsParamScalarInner_rajcb S (δ_fn P) L (φ₁ P) (φ₂ P)

proof.tactics:
by
  let B₀ : ℝ := H_jet.B₀_jet
  have hB₀ : 0 < B₀ := H_jet.B₀_jet_pos
  let L₀ : ℝ := H_jet.L₀_jet
  have hL₀ : 0 < L₀ := H_jet.L₀_jet_pos
  let C_sec : ℝ := 200000 * B₀
  let C_den : ℝ := 1 + 972 * B₀ + 2916 * L₀
  let C_num : ℝ := 65610 * B₀ + 236196 * L₀
  let K_step : ℝ := C_sec * C_den + C_num
  let C_tot : ℝ := 2 * K_step
  let N_uniq : ℕ := max 5 (max (Nat.ceil (2592 * B₀) + 1) (Nat.ceil (2 * C_tot) + 1))
  refine ⟨N_uniq, le_trans (by norm_num : 4 ≤ 5) (le_max_left 5 _), ?_⟩
  intro q w hq hw x X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂
  have hC_sec_pos : 0 < C_sec := by dsimp [C_sec]; positivity
  have hC_den_pos : 0 < C_den := by dsimp [C_den]; positivity
  have hC_num_pos : 0 < C_num := by dsimp [C_num]; positivity
  have hK_step_pos : 0 < K_step := by dsimp [K_step]; positivity
  have hC_tot_pos : 0 < C_tot := by dsimp [C_tot]; positivity
  have hq5_nat : 5 ≤ q := le_trans (le_max_left 5 _) hq
  have hq_pos_nat : 0 < q := by omega
  have hq5 : (5 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq5_nat
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hq_nz : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  have hq2_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hq2_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hq_le_q2 : (q : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hB₀_q2 : 2592 * B₀ ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : Nat.ceil (2592 * B₀) + 1 ≤ q :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right 5 _)) hq
    have h2 : Nat.ceil (2592 * B₀) ≤ q := by omega
    have h3 : (Nat.ceil (2592 * B₀) : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h2
    exact le_trans (Nat.le_ceil (2592 * B₀)) (le_trans h3 hq_le_q2)
  have hCtot_q2 : 2 * C_tot ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by

    obtain ⟨ha₂_bnd, _, _, _⟩ :=

        have h2 : (2916 / (q : ℝ) ^ 3) * (L₀ * ((q : ℝ) * M)) =

    have h_term1 : |(t₂ - s₂) * (D₁ - D₂)| ≤ ((C_sec * C_den) / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * M := by

    have h_b_term : ∀ σ u₁ u₂ : ℝ, |σ| = 1 →

        |u₁ - u₂| ≤ M →
        |u₁ ^ 5 * realJetB w y₁ (σ * u₁) - u₂ ^ 5 * realJetB w y₂ (σ * u₂)| ≤

        have h_m : |u₁ - u₂| *
            (u₁ ^ 4 + u₁ ^ 3 * u₂ + u₁ ^ 2 * u₂ ^ 2 + u₁ * u₂ ^ 3 + u₂ ^ 4) ≤

      have h_alg : ((32805 / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) * M) * B₀ +

    simp only [one_mul] at h_N_t

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_s1 : Nonempty (PointLocalGraphData C) := by
    let θ₀ : ℝ := C.ϕ 0
    have h_quad : ∃ rotIdx : Fin 4, 1 / 2 < -Real.sin (θ₀ + pointRotAngleR rotIdx) := by
      by_contra h_none
      push_neg at h_none
      have h0 := h_none ⟨0, by decide⟩
      have h1 := h_none ⟨1, by decide⟩
      have h2 := h_none ⟨2, by decide⟩
      have h3 := h_none ⟨3, by decide⟩
      have e0 : -Real.sin (θ₀ + pointRotAngleR ⟨0, by decide⟩) = -Real.sin θ₀ := by
        simp [pointRotAngleR]
      have e1 : -Real.sin (θ₀ + pointRotAngleR ⟨1, by decide⟩) = Real.sin θ₀ := by
        simp [pointRotAngleR, Real.sin_add_pi]
      have e2 : -Real.sin (θ₀ + pointRotAngleR ⟨2, by decide⟩) = Real.cos θ₀ := by
        change -Real.sin (θ₀ + -Real.pi / 2) = Real.cos θ₀
        rw [show θ₀ + -Real.pi / 2 = θ₀ - Real.pi / 2 by ring, Real.sin_sub,
          Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
        ring
      have e3 : -Real.sin (θ₀ + pointRotAngleR ⟨3, by decide⟩) = -Real.cos θ₀ := by
        change -Real.sin (θ₀ + Real.pi / 2) = -Real.cos θ₀
        rw [Real.sin_add_pi_div_two]
      rw [e0] at h0; rw [e1] at h1; rw [e2] at h2; rw [e3] at h3
      have hsq := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ₀
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨rotIdx, h_sin_base⟩ := h_quad
    have h_rot_tan_all : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (θ : ℂ),
        rotCoordX r ![-Complex.sin θ, Complex.cos θ] =
          -Complex.sin (θ + pointRotAngle r) ∧
        rotCoordY r ![-Complex.sin θ, Complex.cos θ] =
          Complex.cos (θ + pointRotAngle r) := by
      intro r θ
      fin_cases r
      · simp [rotCoordX, rotCoordY, pointRotAngle, pointRotAngleR]
      · simp [rotCoordX, rotCoordY, pointRotAngle, pointRotAngleR,
          Complex.sin_add, Complex.cos_add]
      · simp only [rotCoordX, rotCoordY, pointRotAngle, pointRotAngleR,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
        push_cast
        rw [show θ + -↑Real.pi / 2 = θ - Real.pi / 2 by ring,
          Complex.sin_sub, Complex.cos_sub, Complex.sin_pi_div_two, Complex.cos_pi_div_two]
        constructor <;> ring
      · simp only [rotCoordX, rotCoordY, pointRotAngle, pointRotAngleR,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
        push_cast
        rw [Complex.sin_add, Complex.cos_add, Complex.sin_pi_div_two, Complex.cos_pi_div_two]
        constructor <;> ring
    let S_h : Set ℂ := horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
    have hSh_open : IsOpen S_h :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have h_real_mem_Sh : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ S_h := by
      intro x; simp [S_h, horizStrip, C.s_h_pos]
    have hh'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ) S_h := C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv hSh_open
    have hh''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) S_h := hh'_holo.deriv hSh_open
    let r_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun θ => C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ
    have hr_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ r_ℂ S_h := C.h_ℂ_holo.add hh''_holo
    have h_supp_deriv0 : ∀ θ ∈ S_h,
        HasDerivAt (fun w => pointSupportCurve C w 0) (r_ℂ θ * (-Complex.sin θ)) θ := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hd_h : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ θ) θ :=
        (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hSh_open.mem_nhds hθ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_h' : HasDerivAt (deriv C.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ) θ :=
        (hh'_holo.differentiableAt (hSh_open.mem_nhds hθ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd := (hd_h.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos θ)).sub (hd_h'.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin θ))
      exact hd.congr_deriv (by change _ = (C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ) * _; ring)
    have h_supp_deriv1 : ∀ θ ∈ S_h,
        HasDerivAt (fun w => pointSupportCurve C w 1) (r_ℂ θ * Complex.cos θ) θ := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hd_h : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ θ) θ :=
        (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (hSh_open.mem_nhds hθ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_h' : HasDerivAt (deriv C.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ) θ :=
        (hh'_holo.differentiableAt (hSh_open.mem_nhds hθ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd := (hd_h.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin θ)).add (hd_h'.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos θ))
      exact hd.congr_deriv (by change _ = (C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ) * _; ring)
    have hXY_deriv_all : ∀ (r : Fin 4), ∀ θ ∈ S_h,
        HasDerivAt (fun w => rotCoordX r (pointSupportCurve C w))
          (r_ℂ θ * (-Complex.sin (θ + pointRotAngle r))) θ ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun w => rotCoordY r (pointSupportCurve C w))
          (r_ℂ θ * Complex.cos (θ + pointRotAngle r)) θ := by
      intro r θ hθ

point_glancing_chart_and_symplectic.definitions:
noncomputable def pointRotAngleR (rotIdx : Fin 4) : ℝ :=
  match rotIdx with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => 0
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => Real.pi
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => -Real.pi / 2
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => Real.pi / 2

noncomputable def pointRotAngle (rotIdx : Fin 4) : ℂ :=
  (pointRotAngleR rotIdx : ℂ)

noncomputable def pointSupportCurve {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (θ : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.cos θ - deriv C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.sin θ,
    C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.sin θ + deriv C.h_ℂ θ * Complex.cos θ]

noncomputable def pointPhiMap {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (k : ℕ)
    (rotIdx : Fin 4) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (pointChartACoord C rotIdx p,
    pointChartBCoord C k rotIdx p - pointChartACoord C rotIdx p)

noncomputable def pointChartEll {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) {k : ℕ}
    (Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := (Ψ q).1
  let t := (Ψ q).2
  let P_curr := glancingImpact C (y + ((i : ℕ) : ℂ) * t) t
  let P_next := glancingImpact C (y + (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t) t
  let Θ_i := glancingTheta C (y + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * t) t
  (-(P_next 0 - P_curr 0)) * Complex.sin Θ_i + (P_next 1 - P_curr 1) * Complex.cos Θ_i

noncomputable def pointTridiagMat (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then -1
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

noncomputable def pointDivZero (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, iterDerivYT 0 1 F (q.1, (τ : ℂ) * q.2)

structure PointLocalGraphData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) where
  rotIdx : Fin 4
  a₀ : ℝ
  ρ_x : ℝ
  ρ_x_pos : 0 < ρ_x
  sin_rot_base_gt : 1 / 2 < -Real.sin (C.ϕ 0 + pointRotAngleR rotIdx)
  a₀_eq : (a₀ : ℂ) = rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (C.ϕ 0 : ℂ))
  W_θ : Set ℂ
  W_θ_open : IsOpen W_θ
  θ₀_mem_W_θ : ((C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ W_θ
  W_θ_sub_strip : W_θ ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  θ_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x)
  θ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ θ_inv (Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x)
  θ_inv_base : θ_inv (a₀ : ℂ) = ((C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  θ_inv_maps : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x, θ_inv z ∈ W_θ
  θ_left_inv : ∀ θ ∈ W_θ,
    rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x ∧
    θ_inv (rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ)) = θ ∧
    rotCoordY rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ) =
      F (rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C θ))
  θ_right_inv : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    rotCoordX rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (θ_inv z)) = z ∧
    rotCoordY rotIdx (pointSupportCurve C (θ_inv z)) = F z
  W_θ_nondeg : ∀ θ ∈ W_θ,
    1 / 4 < (-Complex.sin (θ + pointRotAngle rotIdx)).re ∧
    C.h_ℂ θ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ ≠ 0
  F_deriv_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    deriv F z =
      Complex.cos (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx) /
        (-Complex.sin (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx))
  F_deriv2_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x,
    deriv (deriv F) z =
      1 / ((C.h_ℂ (θ_inv z) + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) (θ_inv z)) *
        (-Complex.sin (θ_inv z + pointRotAngle rotIdx)) ^ 3)
  F_real : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - a₀| < ρ_x →
    (x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (a₀ : ℂ) ρ_x ∧
    (F (x : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
    deriv (deriv F) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ v_x : ℝ, deriv F (x : ℂ) = (v_x : ℂ)

  R₀ : ℝ

  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀

    (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀))
  Ψ_maps_V₀ :

    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun q' => (Ψ q').1) q *
          iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun q' => (Ψ q').2) q -
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun q' => (Ψ q').1) q *
          iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun q' => (Ψ q').2) q =
        (pointChartDetAB C k G_gr.rotIdx (Ψ q))⁻¹
  x_holo_maps : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∈ G_gr.W_θ ∧
      pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) G_gr.ρ_x ∧
      G_gr.θ_inv (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q) =
        glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∧
      rotCoordY G_gr.rotIdx
        (glancingImpact C ((Ψ q).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2) =
        G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q)
  Θ_edge_holo_maps : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q => glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 ∈ G_gr.W_θ
  ℓ_holo_vec : ∀ i : Fin k,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (pointChartEll C Ψ i)
      (Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀)) ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀),
      (pointChartEll C Ψ i q) ^ 2 =
        pointEdgeSq (fun _ => G_gr.F) (fun r => pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r q) i ∧
      pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.succ q -
          pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.castSucc q =
        pointChartEll C Ψ i q *
          (-Complex.sin
            (glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 +
              pointRotAngle G_gr.rotIdx)) ∧
      G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.succ q) -
          G_gr.F (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ i.castSucc q) =
        pointChartEll C Ψ i q *
          Complex.cos
            (glancingTheta C ((Ψ q).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ q).2) (Ψ q).2 +
              pointRotAngle G_gr.rotIdx)
  real_slice : ∀ a δ : ℝ,
    ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) ∈
      Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ₀) →
    (Ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).1.im = 0 ∧
    (Ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).2.im = 0 ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, (pointChartEll C Ψ i ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ))).im = 0)
  zero_slice : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀),
    (Ψ (z, 0)).2 = 0 ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r (z, 0) = z) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      glancingMidAngle C ((Ψ (z, 0)).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (Ψ (z, 0)).2) (Ψ (z, 0)).2 =
        G_gr.θ_inv z) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k,
      glancingTheta C ((Ψ (z, 0)).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ (z, 0)).2)
        (Ψ (z, 0)).2 = G_gr.θ_inv z) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin k, pointChartEll C Ψ i (z, 0) = 0)
  x_deriv_d_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (G_gr.a₀ : ℂ) (2 * R₀),
    deriv (fun w : ℂ => pointChartX C k G_gr.rotIdx Ψ r (z, w)) 0 =
      ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  base_derivs_at_a₀ :
    let r₀ : ℝ := C.h (C.ϕ 0) + deriv (deriv C.h) (C.ϕ 0)
    let s₀ : ℝ := -Real.sin (C.ϕ 0 + pointRotAngleR G_gr.rotIdx)
    Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), 0) = (0, 0) ∧
    deriv (fun w : ℂ => (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2) 0 =
      1 / ((k : ℂ) * ((r₀ * s₀ * deriv C.ϕ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin k,
      deriv (fun w : ℂ =>
        glancingTheta C
          ((Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).1 + (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2)
          (Ψ ((G_gr.a₀ : ℂ), w)).2) 0 =
        (((i : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 / 2) / ((k : ℂ) * ((r₀ * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))

    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hKit : Holo2DAndTaylorToolkit := holo_2d_and_taylor_toolkit
  have hSer : PointCoreSeriesToolkit := point_core_comp2d_and_subfield_toolkit hKit
  obtain ⟨hEndJets, hMixedAct⟩ :=
    point_core_endpoint_jets_and_mixed_action Ω C B k hk G hKit hSer a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
  let K_pt : Subfield ℂ := pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  let coreTuple : Fin (pointCoreCard k) → ℂ := pointCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁
  let F_val : Subfield ℂ :=
    Subfield.closure (((K_pt : Subfield ℂ) : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range coreTuple)
  obtain ⟨hGraphJets, hAbscissaTay, hActionTay⟩ :=
    point_core_vandermonde_jet_and_abscissa_elimination Ω C B k hk G hKit hSer a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁
      K_pt hEndJets hMixedAct
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)
  have hp₁_x_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), G.x_fn r p₁ ∈ F_val := by
    intro r
    apply Subfield.subset_closure
    refine Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inl r), ?_⟩
    dsimp only [coreTuple, pointCoreTuple, e, p₁]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hp₁_ℓ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, G.ℓ_fn i p₁ ∈ F_val := by
    intro i
    apply Subfield.subset_closure
    refine Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)), ?_⟩
    dsimp only [coreTuple, pointCoreTuple, e, p₁]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hcore_sub :
      Set.range coreTuple ⊆
        { z : ℂ |
          (∃ r : Fin (k + 1), z = G.x_fn r p₁) ∨
          (∃ i : Fin k, z = G.ℓ_fn i p₁) ∨
          (∃ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ),
            z = iteratedDeriv m G.F (G.x_fn r p₁)) } := by
    rintro z ⟨idx, rfl⟩
    dsimp only [coreTuple, pointCoreTuple, p₁]
    rcases (Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)).symm idx with r | (i | ⟨r, m⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨r, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, (m : ℕ), rfl⟩)
  have hunrot_eq : ∀ (rot : Fin 4) (P : Fin 2 → ℂ) (c : Fin 2),
      unrotPoint rot (rotCoordX rot P) (rotCoordY rot P) c = P c := by
    intro rot P c
    fin_cases rot <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [unrotPoint, rotCoordX, rotCoordY]
  have hunrot_mem : ∀ (rot : Fin 4) {x Y : ℂ},
      x ∈ F_val → Y ∈ F_val → ∀ c : Fin 2, unrotPoint rot x Y c ∈ F_val := by
    intro rot x Y hx hY c
    fin_cases rot <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [unrotPoint, hx, hY, F_val.neg_mem]
  have ha₁_U : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_a := by
    rw [PointGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [ha₁.1, ha₁.2, G.R_pos]
  have hδ₁_U : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_d := by
    rw [PointGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ₁.1]
    linarith [hδ₁.2, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hp₁_mem : p₁ ∈ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d := ⟨ha₁_U, hδ₁_U⟩
  have hImpact_mem : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (c : Fin 2),
      glancingImpact C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 c ∈ F_val := by
    intro r c
    let P_r : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
      glancingImpact C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2
    have hx_r : rotCoordX G.rotIdx P_r ∈ F_val := hp₁_x_mem r
    have hY_eq : rotCoordY G.rotIdx P_r = iteratedDeriv 0 G.F (G.x_fn r p₁) := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact ((G.x_holo_maps r).2 p₁ hp₁_mem).2
    have hY_r : rotCoordY G.rotIdx P_r ∈ F_val := by
      rw [hY_eq]
      exact hGraphJets r 0
    change P_r c ∈ F_val
    rw [← hunrot_eq G.rotIdx P_r c]
    exact hunrot_mem G.rotIdx hx_r hY_r c
  have htrap : (a₁, δ₁) ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀ := by
    refine ⟨hδ₁.1, hδ₁.2, ?_⟩
    have habs : |a₁ - G.a₀| < G.R / 4 := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ha₁.1], by linarith [ha₁.2]⟩
    have hmul : G.C₀ * δ₁ < G.C₀ * G.δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ₁.2 G.C₀_pos
    linarith [G.C₀_δ_star_lt, G.R_pos]
  rcases G.trapezoid_nondeg (a₁, δ₁) htrap with ⟨hy₁_im, ht₁_im, ht₁_pos, ht₁_lt_div, _⟩
  let y₁ : ℝ := (G.Ψ p₁).1.re
  let t₁ : ℝ := (G.Ψ p₁).2.re
  have hy₁_eq : (G.Ψ p₁).1 = (y₁ : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · rfl
    · simpa using hy₁_im
  have ht₁_eq : (G.Ψ p₁).2 = (t₁ : ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · rfl
    · simpa using ht₁_im
  have ht₁_lt_r : t₁ < B.r_det := by
    have hk1_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
      linarith
    have hdiv_le : B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ B.r_det :=
      div_le_self (le_of_lt B.r_det_pos) hk1_ge1
    linarith
  have hdual_mem : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      glancingDualLine C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 ι ∈ F_val := by
    intro j hj0 hjk ι
    let x_j : ℝ := y₁ + ((j : ℝ) - 1 / 2) * t₁
    have hx_j_eq : (x_j : ℂ) = (G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * (G.Ψ p₁).2 := by
      rw [hy₁_eq, ht₁_eq]
      dsimp only [x_j]
      push_cast
      ring
    let r_minus : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
    let r_plus : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨j, by omega⟩
    have hshift_minus :
        (x_j : ℂ) - (t₁ : ℂ) / 2 = (G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r_minus : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2 := by
      rw [hx_j_eq, ht₁_eq]
      have hj_sub : (((r_minus : ℕ) : ℂ)) = (j : ℂ) - 1 := by
        change ((j - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = (j : ℂ) - 1
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hj0), Nat.cast_one]
      rw [hj_sub]
      ring
    have hshift_plus :
        (x_j : ℂ) + (t₁ : ℂ) / 2 = (G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r_plus : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2 := by
      rw [hx_j_eq, ht₁_eq]
      change (G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * (t₁ : ℂ) + (t₁ : ℂ) / 2 =
        (G.Ψ p₁).1 + (j : ℂ) * (t₁ : ℂ)
      ring
    let P_minus : Fin 2 → ℂ := glancingImpact C ((x_j : ℂ) - (t₁ : ℂ) / 2) (t₁ : ℂ)
    let P_plus : Fin 2 → ℂ := glancingImpact C ((x_j : ℂ) + (t₁ : ℂ) / 2) (t₁ : ℂ)
    have hPm_eq :
        P_minus = glancingImpact C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r_minus : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 := by
      dsimp only [P_minus]
      rw [hshift_minus, ht₁_eq]
    have hPp_eq :
        P_plus = glancingImpact C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + ((r_plus : ℕ) : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 := by
      dsimp only [P_plus]
      rw [hshift_plus, ht₁_eq]
    have hPm_mem : ∀ c : Fin 2, P_minus c ∈ F_val := by
      intro c
      rw [hPm_eq]
      exact hImpact_mem r_minus c
    have hPp_mem : ∀ c : Fin 2, P_plus c ∈ F_val := by
      intro c
      rw [hPp_eq]
      exact hImpact_mem r_plus c
    let Δ : ℂ := P_minus 0 * P_plus 1 - P_minus 1 * P_plus 0
    have hΔ_mem : Δ ∈ F_val :=
      F_val.sub_mem (F_val.mul_mem (hPm_mem 0) (hPp_mem 1))
        (F_val.mul_mem (hPm_mem 1) (hPp_mem 0))
    have hΔ_re_pos : 0 < Δ.re := (B.real_chord_pos x_j t₁ ht₁_pos ht₁_lt_r).2.2.1
    have hΔ_ne : Δ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hΔ0
      rw [hΔ0, Complex.zero_re] at hΔ_re_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hΔ_re_pos
    have him_lt : |(x_j : ℂ).im| < B.s_det + B.r_det := by
      rw [Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero]
      exact add_pos B.s_det_pos B.r_det_pos
    have hnorm_t₁ : ‖(t₁ : ℂ)‖ < B.r_det := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₁_pos]
      exact ht₁_lt_r
    have hcramer := (B.cramer_edge_identities (x_j : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) him_lt hnorm_t₁).2
    rw [← hx_j_eq, ht₁_eq]
    fin_cases ι
    · have h0 : glancingDualLine C (x_j : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) 0 = (P_plus 1 - P_minus 1) / Δ := by
        apply eq_div_of_mul_eq hΔ_ne
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact hcramer.1
      change glancingDualLine C (x_j : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) 0 ∈ F_val
      rw [h0]
      exact F_val.div_mem (F_val.sub_mem (hPp_mem 1) (hPm_mem 1)) hΔ_mem
    · have h1 : glancingDualLine C (x_j : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) 1 = (P_minus 0 - P_plus 0) / Δ := by
        apply eq_div_of_mul_eq hΔ_ne
        rw [mul_comm]
        exact hcramer.2
      change glancingDualLine C (x_j : ℂ) (t₁ : ℂ) 1 ∈ F_val
      rw [h1]
      exact F_val.div_mem (F_val.sub_mem (hPm_mem 0) (hPp_mem 0)) hΔ_mem
  exact ⟨{
    N_core := pointCoreCard k
    coreTuple := coreTuple
    endpoint_graph_jets_mem_K_pt := hEndJets
    action_mixed_ab_mem_K_pt := hMixedAct
    abscissa_mem_F_val := hp₁_x_mem
    chord_len_mem_F_val := hp₁_ℓ_mem
    graph_jets_mem_F_val := hGraphJets
    abscissa_ab_taylor_mem_F_val := hAbscissaTay
    action_ab_taylor_mem_F_val := hActionTay
    core_entries_subset := hcore_sub
    dualLine_mem_F_val := hdual_mem
  }⟩

point_core_mixed_vandermonde_elimination.definitions:
noncomputable def pointCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def pointCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def pointCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def pointCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

noncomputable def pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (sqrt1p u)⁻¹

abbrev PointCoreIdx (k : ℕ) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin (k + 1)) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin (k + 1) × Fin (max 2 k + 1)))

noncomputable def pointCoreCard (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (PointCoreIdx k)

noncomputable def pointCoreTuple {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin (pointCoreCard k) → ℂ :=
  fun idx =>
    match (Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)).symm idx with
    | Sum.inl r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (r, m)) =>
        iteratedDeriv (m : ℕ) G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))

structure PointCoreSeriesToolkit : Prop where
  centeredTaylor2D_fst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0
  centeredTaylor2D_snd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
    IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
      taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
        pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
          (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀)
  C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c)
  X_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), pointCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s)
  add_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S + T)
  sub_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T)
  mul_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T)
  mvDerivA_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivA S)
  mvDerivD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivD S)
  comp1D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {f : PowerSeries ℂ} {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    (∀ n : ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff n f ∈ L) → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L U → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (compPowerSeries2D f U)
  comp2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L F → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
    pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₁ → pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₂ →

noncomputable def pointCoreIdx2D (a b : ℕ) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
  Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]

noncomputable def pointCoreComp2D (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)

def pointCoreCoeffsIn (L : Subfield ℂ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L

def pointCoreVanishesBelow (N : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = 0

noncomputable def pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (sqrt1p u)⁻¹

abbrev PointCoreIdx (k : ℕ) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin (k + 1)) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin (k + 1) × Fin (max 2 k + 1)))

noncomputable def pointCoreCard (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (PointCoreIdx k)

noncomputable def pointCoreTuple {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) : Fin (pointCoreCard k) → ℂ :=
  fun idx =>
    match (Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)).symm idx with
    | Sum.inl r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (r, m)) =>
        iteratedDeriv (m : ℕ) G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))

        have h_last_mem : (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) ∈ S_m.W_ψ := by
          have hmem := S_m.ψ_maps_W_ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) hq_V (Fin.last k)
          have hval : G.ψ_web (Fin.last k) ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) = (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) := by
            dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.ψ_web, pointChartPsiWeb, Fin.val_last]
            split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
          exact hval ▸ hmem
        refine ⟨h_last_mem, fun r => ?_⟩
        by_cases hr0 : r.1 = 0
        · have hr_eq : r = 0 := Fin.ext hr0
          rw [hr_eq]
          dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.x_fn]
          rw [(G.x_endpoints ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) hq_U₀).1]
          exact S_m.real_mem_W_ψ a ha_abs
        · by_cases hrk : r.1 = k
          · have hr_eq : r = Fin.last k := Fin.ext hrk
            rw [hr_eq]
            dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.x_fn]
            rw [(G.x_endpoints ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) hq_U₀).2]
            exact h_last_mem
          · have hr_lt : r.1 - 1 < k - 1 := by have := r.2; omega
            let r_web : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨r.1 - 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
            have hmem := S_m.ψ_maps_W_ψ ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) hq_V r_web
            have hval : G.ψ_web r_web ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) = G.x_fn r ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) := by
              dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.ψ_web, pointChartPsiWeb, r_web]
              rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true hr_lt)]
              congr 1
              ext
              dsimp only
              omega
            exact hval ▸ hmem
      ℓ₀_pos := fun δ hδ i =>
        ⟨((G.trapezoid_nondeg (a, δ) (h_trap δ hδ)).2.2.2.2.2.1 i).1,
         ((G.trapezoid_nondeg (a, δ) (h_trap δ hδ)).2.2.2.2.2.1 i).2,
         (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).2 ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (S_m.V_plus_sub (h_mem_V δ hδ))⟩
      x₀_stat := fun δ hδ r =>
        G.stationary_on_nondeg ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (S_m.V_plus_sub (h_mem_V δ hδ))
          (S_m.chord_ne_zero ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ)) r
      grad_jet_zero := by
        intro δ hδ r l hl1 hlJ
        have h_div := S_m.grad_jet_zero ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ) r l hl1 hlJ
        unfold pointArcEpsJet at h_div
        have h_fac : (l.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero l)
        exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h_div).resolve_right h_fac
      len_jet_split := fun δ hδ l hl1 =>
        S_m.len_jet_split ((a : ℂ), (δ : ℂ)) (h_mem_V δ hδ) l hl1
    }⟩
  refine ⟨{
    p := D_form.p
    p_pos := D_form.p_pos
    f_lead := fun r => D_form.f_full r D_form.p
    r₀ := D_form.r₀
    f_lead_r₀_ne_zero := D_form.f_lead_ne_zero
    W_lead := W_lead
    W_lead_open := S_p.W_ψ_open
    W_lead_preconn := S_p.W_ψ_preconn
    real_mem_W_lead := S_p.real_mem_W_ψ
    g_lead := g_lead
    g_lead_endpoints := S_p.g_endpoints (Fin.last D_form.p)
    g_lead_holo := fun r => S_p.g_holo r (Fin.last D_form.p)
    g_lead_taylor := by
      intro r
      have hp₁_Vp : p₁ ∈ S_p.V_plus := S_p.trapezoid_mem_V_plus (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap
      let r_web : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have hmem_web := S_p.ψ_maps_W_ψ p₁ hp₁_Vp r_web
      have hval_web : G.ψ_web r_web p₁ =
          G.x_fn ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ p₁ := by
        dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.ψ_web, pointChartPsiWeb, r_web]
        rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true r.2)]
      refine ⟨hval_web ▸ hmem_web, fun n => ?_⟩
      have ht := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff n)
        (S_p.g_taylor ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ (Fin.last D_form.p) D_form.p_pos)
      simpa [pointArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, g_lead] using ht
    trunc_models := by
      intro J hJp a ha
      have hJ_eq : D_form.p + (J - D_form.p) = J := Nat.add_sub_of_le hJp
      exact hJ_eq ▸ h_models (J - D_form.p) a ha
  }⟩

def PointArcIterHoloProp : Prop :=
  ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) W

noncomputable abbrev pointArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def pointArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def pointArcInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraph {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g r q z

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraphDeriv {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g r q) z

noncomputable def pointArcPertAbscissa {k J : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
  x₀ r + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q r

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D (S Φ₀ Φ₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 a + Finsupp.single 1 b) S *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Φ₀ ^ a * Φ₁ ^ b)

noncomputable def pointArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def pointArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def pointArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def pointArcPsSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D sqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcPsInvSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D pointArcInvSqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcPack2D1D (fun l => β_seq l r)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDx2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc)) +
    (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ - pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDy2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.succ) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ) -
    pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.castSucc) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i) ^ 2 + (pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D x_star f_seq β_seq i -
      MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2))) *
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)⁻¹))

noncomputable def pointArcFormalLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (ℓ_star i)) *
      pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p
        (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i)⁻¹)) *
    pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p
      (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_L +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_L *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L.succ l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_L.succ)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_L -
    (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_R +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_R *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R.castSucc l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_R.castSucc)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_R

noncomputable def pointArcTruncGraph {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun r l => if l ≤ J then f_full r l else 0

noncomputable def pointArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure PointArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
        compPowerSeries2D (pointArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)
  taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U U' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → IsOpen U' →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {φ₀ φ₁ F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ φ₀ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ φ₁ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U' →
      (∀ p ∈ U, (φ₀ p, φ₁ p) ∈ U') →
      taylor2D (fun p => F (φ₀ p, φ₁ p)) p₀ =
        pointArcComp2D (taylor2D F (φ₀ p₀, φ₁ p₀))
          (centeredTaylor2D φ₀ p₀) (centeredTaylor2D φ₁ p₀)
  psSqrt1p_laws :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsSqrt1p = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1 ∧
    pointArcPsSqrt1p ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.X ∧
    pointArcPsSqrt1p * pointArcPsInvSqrt1p = 1
  epsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
    {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g₁ : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    {g₂ : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg₁ : ∀ r m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ r m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₂ : ∀ r m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ r m) W_ψ)
    (_hg₁0 : ∀ r z, g₁ r 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ r z, g₂ r 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_eq : ∀ r (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ r ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ r m z)
    {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ} (_hℓ_ne : ∀ i, ℓ₀ i ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, x₀ r ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) x₀ i)
    {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
    (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),

  epsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)

    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0) {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hℓ₀ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ₀ i) V) (_hℓ_ne : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, ℓ₀ i q ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (x₀ r) V)
    (_hx_maps : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ r, x₀ r q ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => x₀ r q) i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ r q, β 0 r q = 0),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q =>
        pointArcEpsJet m
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelChainLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
              (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε)))
      V ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q =>
          pointArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε) r))
        V
  epsJet_succ_split : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hg : ∀ r l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ)
    (_hg_top : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top r) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0)
    (_hg_top_end : ∀ z, g_top 0 z = 0 ∧ g_top (Fin.last k) z = 0)
    {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ} (_hℓ_ne : ∀ i, ℓ₀ i ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, x₀ r ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) x₀ i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
    (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),
    let g_ext : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun r => Fin.snoc (g r) (g_top r)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
            (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_ext ε)) =
      pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
        (fun ε =>
          pointRelChainLen ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
            (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β ε)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        ((F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) - F (x₀ ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) /
            ℓ₀ ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
          (F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 2, by have := r.2; omega⟩) - F (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) /
            ℓ₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) *
          g_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ (x₀ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)) +
      (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
        pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) x₀ r *
          β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g_ext ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_ext ε) r) =
        pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ₀ (pointArcPertGraph F g_ext ε)
              (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g_ext ε) (pointArcPertAbscissa x₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          pointInteriorHess ℓ₀ F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) x₀ r s *
            β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  taylor2D_epsJet_eq : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
    (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (_hF : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W_ψ)
    {g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ r l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ)
    (_hg0 : ∀ r z, g r 0 z = 0) {ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hℓ₀ : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ₀ i) V) (_hℓ_ne : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, ℓ₀ i q ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (_hx₀ : ∀ r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (x₀ r) V)
    (_hx_maps : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ r, x₀ r q ∈ W_ψ)
    (_hℓ_sq : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i, (ℓ₀ i q) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (fun r => x₀ r q) i)
    {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
    (_hβ : ∀ l r, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ r q, β 0 r q = 0),
    let ℓ_star := fun i => ℓ₀ i p₁
    let x_star := fun r => x₀ r p₁
    let f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun r l =>
      if l = 0 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D F (x_star r)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r ⟨l, hl⟩) (x_star r)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l r =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (x₀ r) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ r) p₁
      else 0
    taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          pointArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε =>
              pointRelChainLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε)))
        p₁ =
      pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq) ∧
    ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            pointArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                  (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g ε)
                  (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε) r))
          p₁ =
        pointArcSlice2D1D m (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq r)

structure PointArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  U_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  V_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    f_full r 0 = pointArcHoloTaylor1D G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  f_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → f_full 0 l = 0 ∧ f_full (Fin.last k) l = 0
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.x_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_full r l = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧
    U_formal l = 0 ∧ V_formal l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    ∑ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (G.w_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        compPowerSeries2D
          (if h : r.1 < k - 1 then f_full ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ (J + 1)
           else if r.1 = k - 1 then U_formal (J + 1)
           else V_formal (J + 1))
          (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      -pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalLen2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph J f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun u => G.x_fn u ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
              (fun u => G.x_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure PointArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : PointArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_W_F : W_ψ ⊆ G.W_F
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), G.ψ_web r q ∈ W_ψ
  chord_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
      (fun s => G.x_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g r l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r l) (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full r (l : ℕ)
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_ψ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_ψ
  UV_lt_p : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, U_split l z = 0 ∧ V_split l z = 0
  UV_taylor : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (U_split l) (a₁ : ℂ) = D_form.U_formal (l : ℕ) ∧
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (V_split l) ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.V_formal (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    pointArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertGraphDeriv G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelChainLen (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      U_split l q.1 + V_split l (q.1 + q.2)
