def PointArcIterHoloProp : Prop :=
  ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) W

noncomputable abbrev pointArcHoloTaylor1D : (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  holoTaylor1D

noncomputable def pointArcEpsJet (m : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iteratedDeriv m F 0 / (m.factorial : ℂ)

noncomputable def pointArcInvSqrt1p (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.log (1 + u) / 2)

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraph {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g r q z

noncomputable def pointArcPertGraphDeriv {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g r q) z

noncomputable def pointArcPertAbscissa {k J : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : ℂ :=
  x₀ r + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β q r

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D (S Φ₀ Φ₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d =>
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 a + Finsupp.single 1 b) S *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Φ₀ ^ a * Φ₁ ^ b)

noncomputable def pointArcPack2D1D (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l))

noncomputable def pointArcSlice2D1D (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun d => PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S)

noncomputable def pointArcComp2D1D (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d =>
    PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
      PowerSeries.coeff m
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)))

noncomputable def pointArcCompConst2D1D (φ : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) Z

noncomputable def pointArcPsSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D sqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcPsInvSqrt1p : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcHoloTaylor1D pointArcInvSqrt1p 0

noncomputable def pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcPack2D1D (fun l => β_seq l r)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDx2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (x_star i.succ - x_star i.castSucc)) +
    (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ - pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalDy2D1D {k : ℕ}
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.succ) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.succ) -
    pointArcComp2D1D (f_seq i.castSucc) (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D {k : ℕ} (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i) ^ 2 + (pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  (pointArcFormalEdgeSq2D1D x_star f_seq β_seq i -
      MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2))) *
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)⁻¹))

noncomputable def pointArcFormalLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (ℓ_star i)) *
      pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p
        (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i)⁻¹)) *
    pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p
      (pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i)

noncomputable def pointArcFormalGrad2D1D {k : ℕ} (ℓ_star : Fin k → ℂ)
    (x_star : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_L +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_L *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_L.succ l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_L.succ)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_L -
    (pointArcFormalDx2D1D x_star β_seq i_R +
      pointArcFormalDy2D1D f_seq β_seq i_R *
        pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i_R.castSucc l))
          (pointArcFormalAbscissa2D1D β_seq i_R.castSucc)) *
      pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_seq β_seq i_R

noncomputable def pointArcTruncGraph {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
  fun r l => if l ≤ J then f_full r l else 0

noncomputable def pointArcTruncBeta {k : ℕ} (J : ℕ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun l r => if l ≤ J then β_full l r else 0

structure PointArcJetAndTaylorToolkit : Prop where
  taylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c
  taylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
    centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1
  taylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀
  taylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
    ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
      taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀
  taylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
    ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
      taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =

structure PointArcFormalDeformationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) where
  p : ℕ
  p_pos : 1 ≤ p
  r₀ : Fin (k - 1)
  f_full : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  U_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  V_formal : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ
  β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ
  f_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
    f_full r 0 = pointArcHoloTaylor1D G.F (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
  f_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → f_full 0 l = 0 ∧ f_full (Fin.last k) l = 0
  β_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full 0 r = centeredTaylor2D (G.x_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  β_endpoints : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → β_full l 0 = 0 ∧ β_full l (Fin.last k) = 0
  f_lead_ne_zero : f_full ⟨r₀.1 + 1, by have := r₀.2; omega⟩ p ≠ 0
  vanish_lt_p : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p →
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_full r l = 0) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧
    U_formal l = 0 ∧ V_formal l = 0
  formal_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
    ∑ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (G.w_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        compPowerSeries2D
          (if h : r.1 < k - 1 then f_full ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩ (J + 1)
           else if r.1 = k - 1 then U_formal (J + 1)
           else V_formal (J + 1))
          (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_web r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) =
      -pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalLen2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun r => G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph J f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full))
  formal_hess_step : ∀ J : ℕ, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D
          (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (fun u => G.x_fn u ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)))
          (pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) f_full)
          (pointArcTruncBeta J β_full)
          r) +
      ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
              (fun u => G.x_fn u q) r s)
          ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) *
        β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0

structure PointArcStepAnalyticData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C) (k : ℕ) (G : PointGlancingChartData C B k)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ) (D_form : PointArcFormalDeformationData C B k G a₁ δ₁) (J : ℕ) where
  W_ψ : Set ℂ
  V_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  U_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  V_split : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ
  β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  W_ψ_open : IsOpen W_ψ
  W_ψ_preconn : IsPreconnected W_ψ
  W_ψ_sub_W_F : W_ψ ⊆ G.W_F
  real_mem_W_ψ : ∀ x : ℝ, |x - G.a₀| < G.R → (x : ℂ) ∈ W_ψ
  V_plus_open : IsOpen V_plus
  V_plus_preconn : IsPreconnected V_plus
  V_plus_sub : V_plus ⊆ G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  trapezoid_mem_V_plus : ∀ q ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀,
    ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ V_plus
  ψ_maps_W_ψ : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), G.ψ_web r q ∈ W_ψ
  chord_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ i : Fin k, G.ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0
  hess_det_ne_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus,
    (pointInteriorHess (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) G.F (deriv G.F) (deriv (deriv G.F))
      (fun s => G.x_fn s q)).det ≠ 0
  g_holo : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g r l) W_ψ
  g_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0
  g_lt_p : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, g r l z = 0
  g_taylor : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r l) (G.x_fn r ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) = D_form.f_full r (l : ℕ)
  UV_holo : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (U_split l) W_ψ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_split l) W_ψ
  UV_lt_p : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), (l : ℕ) < D_form.p → ∀ z : ℂ, U_split l z = 0 ∧ V_split l z = 0
  UV_taylor : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (U_split l) (a₁ : ℂ) = D_form.U_formal (l : ℕ) ∧
    pointArcHoloTaylor1D (V_split l) ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.V_formal (l : ℕ)
  β_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l r) V_plus
  β_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β 0 r q = 0
  β_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β l 0 q = 0 ∧ β l (Fin.last k) q = 0
  β_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    taylor2D (β l r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ)) = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r
  grad_jet_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ J →
    pointArcEpsJet l
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertGraphDeriv G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε) r) = 0
  len_jet_split : ∀ q ∈ V_plus, ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
    pointArcEpsJet (l : ℕ)
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelChainLen (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (pointArcPertGraph G.F g ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β m s q) ε)) =
      U_split l q.1 + V_split l (q.1 + q.2)

      dsimp only [u_tr_ps, u_trunc_fn]
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single m]
      · simp
      · intro b _ hbm
        simp [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Ne.symm hbm]
      · intro hm_not
        exact False.elim (hm_not (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm))
    dsimp only [z_tr_J, z_full, pointCoalescingStep, pointCoalescingExtend]
    simp only [map_sub]
    congr 1 <;> split_ifs <;> simp [hu_agree]
  have hz_X_pow_dvd : ∀ (S : PowerSeries ℂ) (m : ℕ), m < d + 2 →
      PowerSeries.coeff m (PowerSeries.X ^ (d + 2) * S) = 0 := by
    intro S m hm
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hj_ne : j ≠ d + 2 :=
      ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) hm)
    simp [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, hj_ne]
  have hz_inv_agree : ∀ i : Fin k,
      PowerSeries.coeff (d - 1) ((z_tr_J i)⁻¹) = PowerSeries.coeff (d - 1) ((z_full i)⁻¹) := by
    intro i
    have htr_const : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (z_tr_J i) ≠ 0 := by
      have h_eq : z_tr_J i =
          ((pointCoalescingStep (u_trunc_fn (d + 2)) i : Polynomial ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
        dsimp only [z_tr_J, pointCoalescingStep, pointCoalescingExtend, u_tr_ps]
        rw [Polynomial.coe_sub]
        congr 1 <;> split_ifs <;> simp [Polynomial.coe_zero, Polynomial.coe_one]
      rw [h_eq, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, Polynomial.coeff_coe,
        Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hZ_poly_at0 (d + 2) (by omega) i]
      exact one_div_ne_zero hk_ne
    have hfull_const : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (z_full i) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, ← hz_agree i 0 (by omega),
        PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
      exact htr_const
    let R_rem : PowerSeries ℂ :=
      PowerSeries.mk (fun j => PowerSeries.coeff (j + (d + 2)) (z_full i - z_tr_J i))
    have hdiff : z_full i - z_tr_J i = PowerSeries.X ^ (d + 2) * R_rem := by
      ext m
      by_cases hm : m < d + 2
      · rw [hz_X_pow_dvd R_rem m hm, map_sub, hz_agree i m hm, sub_self]
      · have hle : d + 2 ≤ m := not_lt.mp hm
        have hm_eq : m = (m - (d + 2)) + (d + 2) := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hle).symm
        rw [hm_eq, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul]
        simp [R_rem]
    have hinv_diff : (z_tr_J i)⁻¹ - (z_full i)⁻¹ =
        PowerSeries.X ^ (d + 2) * ((z_full i)⁻¹ * R_rem * (z_tr_J i)⁻¹) := by
      calc (z_tr_J i)⁻¹ - (z_full i)⁻¹
          = ((z_full i)⁻¹ * z_full i) * (z_tr_J i)⁻¹ -
              (z_full i)⁻¹ * (z_tr_J i * (z_tr_J i)⁻¹) := by
              rw [PowerSeries.inv_mul_cancel _ hfull_const,
                PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ htr_const, one_mul, mul_one]
        _ = (z_full i)⁻¹ * (z_full i - z_tr_J i) * (z_tr_J i)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ = PowerSeries.X ^ (d + 2) * ((z_full i)⁻¹ * R_rem * (z_tr_J i)⁻¹) := by
            rw [hdiff]; ring
    have hc := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff (d - 1)) hinv_diff
    rw [map_sub, hz_X_pow_dvd _ (d - 1) (by omega)] at hc
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc
  have hD_eq : PowerSeries.coeff d (pointFormalDerivSeries r_a f_p F_formal.u_ps) =
      PowerSeries.coeff d D_tr := by
    dsimp only [D_tr, pointFormalDerivSeries]
    rw [map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    congr 1
    · rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, map_neg, map_neg, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
      change -((r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.coeff d (z_full i)) =
        -((r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.coeff d (z_tr_J i))
      rw [hz_agree i d (by omega)]
    · have hd1 : d = (d - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hd).symm
      calc PowerSeries.coeff d
            (PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) * PowerSeries.X * (z_full i)⁻¹)
          = (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 *
              PowerSeries.coeff ((d - 1) + 1) (PowerSeries.X ^ 1 * (z_full i)⁻¹) := by
              rw [mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, pow_one, ← hd1]
        _ = (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.coeff (d - 1) ((z_full i)⁻¹) := by
              rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul]
        _ = (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.coeff (d - 1) ((z_tr_J i)⁻¹) := by
              rw [hz_inv_agree i]
        _ = PowerSeries.coeff d
              (PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) * PowerSeries.X *
                (z_tr_J i)⁻¹) := by
              rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul (z_tr_J i)⁻¹ 1 (d - 1), pow_one, ← hd1,
                ← PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [hD_eq, hD_tr_zero]

point_coalescing_length_variational_zero.definitions:
def pointCoalescingTridiag (m : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    if r.1 = s.1 then 2
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 ∨ r.1 = s.1 + 1 then -1
    else 0

def pointCoalescingExtend {R : Type*} [Zero R] [One R] {k : ℕ}
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → R) (s : Fin (k + 1)) : R :=
  if hs0 : s.1 = 0 then 0
  else if hs : s.1 < k then u ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩
  else 1

def pointCoalescingStep {R : Type*} [Ring R] {k : ℕ}
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → R) (i : Fin k) : R :=
  pointCoalescingExtend u i.succ - pointCoalescingExtend u i.castSucc

noncomputable def pointFormalEdgeLambda {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (z : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  -PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8) * (z i) ^ 2 -
    PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X -
    PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointFormalDerivSeries {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (u : Fin (k - 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let z := pointCoalescingStep u
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    (-PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * z i +
      PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) * PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹)

structure PointCoalescingFormalData (k : ℕ) (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) where
  tridiag_det_ne : (pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).det ≠ 0
  u_ps : Fin (k - 1) → PowerSeries ℂ
  const_eq : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (u_ps r) = ((r.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
  coeff_rec : ∀ (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
    let u_trunc : Fin (k - 1) → Polynomial ℂ := fun s =>
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range q, Polynomial.C (PowerSeries.coeff m (u_ps s)) * Polynomial.X ^ m
    let z_trunc : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
      ((pointCoalescingStep u_trunc i : Polynomial ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ)
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    ((-(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ)))) • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).mulVec
        (fun s => PowerSeries.coeff q (u_ps s)) r +
      PowerSeries.coeff q
        (pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc i_L -
          pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc i_R) = 0
  zero_of_higher_deriv_vanish :
    (∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → PowerSeries.coeff d (pointFormalDerivSeries r_a f_p u_ps) = 0) →
      ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), f_p r = 0

noncomputable def pointLimEdgeLambda {k : ℕ} (r_a : ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (w : ℂ) (Z : Fin k → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : ℂ :=
  -(r_a ^ 2 / 8) * (Z i) ^ 2 -
    (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * w -
    ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * w ^ 2 * ((Z i) ^ 2)⁻¹

noncomputable def pointCoalescingTermII {k J : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ε : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let F_pert : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    ((F_pert i.succ (x_vec i.succ) - F_pert i.castSucc (x_vec i.castSucc)) /
        pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base F_pert x_vec i) *
      ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
        if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
          ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
            (g i.succ q (x_vec i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_vec i.castSucc))
        else 0

subgoal_signatures.name: point_coalescing_uniform_limits
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(k p J : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpJ : p ≤ J)
    (a v_a : ℝ) (W : Set ℂ) (hW_open : IsOpen W) (ha_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W)
    (hv_a : deriv F (a : ℂ) = (v_a : ℂ))
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (hf_end : f_p 0 = 0 ∧ f_p (Fin.last k) = 0)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hg_holo : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g m l) W)
    (hg_end : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0)
    (hg_lt_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W, g m l z = 0)
    (hg_at_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (hpJ' : p < J + 1), g m ⟨p, hpJ'⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p m)
    (δ₀ : ℝ) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀)
    (x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ)
    (hx₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0)
    (hℓ₀_pos : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k,
      0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i) :
    let r_a : ℂ := deriv (deriv F) (a : ℂ)
    let g_a_pow : ℂ := ((Real.sqrt (1 + v_a ^ 2) : ℂ) ^ 3)
    ((∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun δ : ℝ =>
          ((δ : ℂ)⁻¹) • pointInteriorHess (ℓ₀ δ) F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) (x₀ δ))
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0))
        (nhds ((-(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ) * g_a_pow))) • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)))) ∧
    (∀ (L_max : ℕ) (u₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
        (b_hat : ℕ → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (b_lim : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
        ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ (τ ^ p) r = (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * u₀ τ r) →
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => u₀ τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))) →
      (∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => b_hat m τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (b_lim m r))) →
      let U_fam : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        u₀ τ r + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_hat m τ r
      let U_lim : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun e r =>
        ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_lim m r
      let Z_lim : ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun e i =>
        U_lim e i.succ - U_lim e i.castSucc
      let x_τ : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * U_fam τ e r
      let ε_τ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e => (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e
      ∃ ρ_e : ℝ, 0 < ρ_e ∧
        (∀ e ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e, ∀ i : Fin k, Z_lim e i ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
          let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
          let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
          let F_grad : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e =>
            ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ *
              pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p))
                (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
                (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z)
                (x_τ τ e) r
          (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_grad τ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
          TendstoUniformlyOn F_grad
            (fun e =>
              g_a_pow⁻¹ *
                (pointLimEdgeLambda r_a f_p (e ^ p) (Z_lim e) i_L -
                  pointLimEdgeLambda r_a f_p (e ^ p) (Z_lim e) i_R))
            (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
        (let F_term2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e =>
          (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p))⁻¹ *
            pointCoalescingTermII p (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) F g (x_τ τ e) (ε_τ τ e)
         (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
           DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_term2 τ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
         TendstoUniformlyOn F_term2
           (fun e =>
             g_a_pow⁻¹ * (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) *
               ∑ i : Fin k,
                 (-(r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i +
                   (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 * e ^ p * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹))
           (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)))

subgoal_signatures.name: point_model_jet_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(k p J : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (M : PointTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a F f_p)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) M.δ₀) :

  have hC_N_pos : 0 < C_N := by positivity

  have hC_N_lip_pos : 0 < C_N_lip := by positivity

  have hOpen : ∀ σ' : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ') := fun σ' =>

                    iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun y : ℂ => (1 : ℂ) + g y) z *

                      iteratedDeriv (m' + 1 - (j + 1)) h z‖ :=

                  have hj1_le_p : j + 1 ≤ p := by omega
                  have hsub_lt : m' + 1 - (j + 1) < m' + 1 := by omega
                  have hsub_le_m : m' + 1 - (j + 1) ≤ m' := by omega
                  have hsub_le_p : m' + 1 - (j + 1) ≤ p := by omega
                  have h1g_deriv :

                        iteratedDeriv (j + 1) g z := by

                          (hContDiffAt (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)) hz (j + 1))

                      ‖iteratedDeriv (j + 1) g z‖ *

    · intro z hz
      dsimp only [h]
      rw [hg.2.1 z hz]
    · intro z hz

            have hp := pow_le_pow_right₀ hC_mul_ge_one hk
            linarith

          C_mul * (Δτ * (9 / (q : ℝ)) + (9 / (q : ℝ)) * Δτ) ≤ 18 * C_mul * Δ_base := by
        have hEq :
            C_mul * (Δτ * (9 / (q : ℝ)) + (9 / (q : ℝ)) * Δτ) =
              18 * C_mul * (Δ_star / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
          dsimp only [Δτ]
          field_simp [hq_nz_R]
          ring
        rw [hEq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔq4_le_base (by positivity)
      have ht2_diff :
          IsStripBounded p σ' (18 * C_mul * Δ_base) (fun z => (t₁ z) ^ 2 - (t₂ z) ^ 2) :=
        hBnd_congr
          (hBnd_mono hsq_le
            (hBnd_mul_sub (hCJet_toBnd ht₂_cjet) (hCJet_toBnd ht₁_cjet) ht_diff ht_diff))
          (fun _ _ => by dsimp only [t₁, t₂, τ_plus₁, τ_plus₂]; ring)
      have hs2_diff :
          IsStripBounded p σ' (18 * C_mul * Δ_base) (fun z => (s₁ z) ^ 2 - (s₂ z) ^ 2) :=
        hBnd_congr
          (hBnd_mono hsq_le
            (hBnd_mul_sub (hCJet_toBnd hs₂_cjet) (hCJet_toBnd hs₁_cjet) hs_diff hs_diff))
          (fun _ _ => by dsimp only [s₁, s₂, τ_step₁, τ_step₂]; ring)
      have hts2_diff :
          IsStripBounded p σ' (36 * C_mul * Δ_base)
            (fun z => ((t₁ z) ^ 2 + (s₁ z) ^ 2) - ((t₂ z) ^ 2 + (s₂ z) ^ 2)) := by
        have h1 := hBnd_add ht2_diff hs2_diff
        have hEq : 18 * C_mul * Δ_base + 18 * C_mul * Δ_base = 36 * C_mul * Δ_base := by ring
        rw [hEq] at h1
        exact hBnd_congr h1 (fun _ _ => by ring)
      have hts2_2 :
          IsStripBounded p σ' (162 * C_mul) (fun z => (t₂ z) ^ 2 + (s₂ z) ^ 2) := by
        have hsum := hBnd_add
          (hBnd_mul (hCJet_toBnd ht₂_cjet) (hCJet_toBnd ht₂_cjet))
          (hBnd_mul (hCJet_toBnd hs₂_cjet) (hCJet_toBnd hs₂_cjet))
        refine hBnd_congr (hBnd_mono ?_ hsum)
          (fun _ _ => by dsimp only [t₂, s₂, τ_plus₂, τ_step₂]; ring)
        have hEq :
            C_mul * (9 / (q : ℝ)) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) +
              C_mul * (9 / (q : ℝ)) * (9 / (q : ℝ)) =
              (162 * C_mul) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [hq_nz_R]
          ring
        rw [hEq]
        exact div_le_self (by positivity) hq_sq_ge_one
      have hprod_diff := hBnd_mul_sub hts2_2 (hCJet_toBnd ha₁_cjet) hts2_diff ha_diff
      refine hBnd_congr (hBnd_mono ?_ (hBnd_real_mul 8 hprod_diff))
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp only [g2₁, g2₂, a₁, a₂, ρ]; ring)
      rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 8)]
      have hEq :
          8 * (C_mul * ((36 * C_mul * Δ_base) * J_C.C_jet_C +
            (162 * C_mul) * (J_C.C_jet_C * Δ_base))) =
            C_g2_lip * Δ_base := by
        dsimp only [C_g2_lip]
        ring
      linarith
    have hQ_diff :
        IsStripBounded p σ' (C_Q_lip * Δ_base) (fun z => Q₁ z - Q₂ z) := by
      obtain ⟨_, hinv1₂⟩ := hCJet_inv_one_add σ' g1₂ hg1₂_cjet
      obtain ⟨_, hinv2₁⟩ := hCJet_inv_one_add σ' g2₁ hg2₁_cjet
      have hinv1_diff := hBnd_inv_one_add_sub hg1₁_cjet hg1₂_cjet hg1_diff
      have hinv2_diff := hBnd_inv_one_add_sub hg2₁_cjet hg2₂_cjet hg2_diff
      have hprod :=
        hBnd_mul_sub (hCJet_toBnd hinv1₂) (hCJet_toBnd hinv2₁) hinv1_diff hinv2_diff
      refine hBnd_mono ?_ hprod
      have hEq :
          C_mul * ((C_inv_lip * Δ_base) * C_inv + C_inv * (C_inv_lip * (C_g2_lip * Δ_base))) =
            C_Q_lip * Δ_base := by
        dsimp only [C_Q_lip]
        ring
      linarith
    
    have hNQ_diff :
        IsStripBounded p σ' (C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5))
          (fun z => N₁ z * Q₁ z - N₂ z * Q₂ z) := by
      have h1 := hBnd_mul_sub (hCJet_toBnd hN₂_cjet) (hCJet_toBnd hQ₁_cjet) hN_diff hQ_diff
      refine hBnd_mono ?_ h1
      have hEq :
          C_mul *
              ((C_N_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)) * (C_mul * C_inv ^ 2) +
                (C_N / (q : ℝ) ^ 5) * (C_Q_lip * Δ_base)) =
            C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5) := by
        dsimp only [C_force_lip]
        field_simp [hq_nz_R]
      linarith
    have hForce_diff :
        IsStripBounded p σ'
          (C_force_lip * (Δ_star / (q : ℝ) ^ 6 + Δ_W / (q : ℝ) ^ 4))
          (fun ζ =>
            stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W₁ d₁ j ζ - stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W₂ d₂ j ζ) := by
      have hScaled := hBnd_real_mul (-(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi)) hNQ_diff
      have hBnd_le :
          |-(2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi)| * (C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)) ≤
            C_force_lip * (Δ_star / (q : ℝ) ^ 6 + Δ_W / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
        have h2qpi_pos : 0 < 2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi := by positivity
        rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos h2qpi_pos]
        have h2qpi_le_q : 2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi ≤ (q : ℝ) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hpi_pos]
          nlinarith [Real.two_le_pi]
        have hRHS_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5) := by positivity
        calc
          (2 * (q : ℝ) / Real.pi) * (C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5))
            ≤ (q : ℝ) * (C_force_lip * (Δ_base / (q : ℝ) ^ 5)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2qpi_le_q hRHS_nonneg
          _ = C_force_lip * (Δ_star / (q : ℝ) ^ 6 + Δ_W / (q : ℝ) ^ 4) := by
              dsimp only [Δ_base]
              field_simp [hq_nz_R]
      refine hBnd_congr (hBnd_mono hBnd_le hScaled) ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [(hDenom₁ z hz).2, (hDenom₂ z hz).2]
      dsimp only [N₁, N₂, Q₁, Q₂, t₁, t₂, s₁, s₂, g1₁, g1₂, g2₁, g2₂,
        a₁, a₂, b_plus₁, b_plus₂, b_minus₁, b_minus₂,
        τ_plus₁, τ_plus₂, τ_step₁, τ_step₂, τ_minus₁, τ_minus₂, ρ]
      ring
    exact hForce_diff.2

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁)
    (hDir : StripDirichletInvProp)
    (F_bd : StripForcingBoundData m M₁ J_C)
    (R_strip K_strip σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hR_pos : 0 < R_strip)
    (hR_force : 4 * F_bd.C_force ≤ R_strip)
    (hR_lip : 4 * F_bd.C_force_lip ≤ R_strip)
    (hK_eval : 6 * R_strip + J_C.K_eval ≤ K_strip)
    (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hq_force : F_bd.N_force ≤ q)
    (hq_R : 16 * R_strip ≤ (q : ℝ))
    (hq_lip : 8 * F_bd.C_force_lip ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hKq : K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1) :
    let σ_mesh := (1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ_mesh R_strip (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W) ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W (j + 2) z -
          2 * stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W (j + 1) z +
          stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W j z =
          stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W) j z) ∧
    (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ => stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₁ j ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
            (fun ζ =>
              (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₁ (j + 1) ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₁ j ζ) -
                (stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₂ (j + 1) ζ - stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₂ j ζ)) z‖ ≤
          R_strip * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂))

signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁)
    (hDir : StripDirichletInvProp)

    (hσ : σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)

    (hq_lip : 8 * F_bd.C_force_lip ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2)

    (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →

      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro σ_mesh
  have hq4 : 4 ≤ q := le_trans F_bd.N_force_ge_four hq_force
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by omega
  have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
  have hq_sq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
  have hq_cube_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_pos hq_pos 3
  have hq4_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 4 := pow_pos hq_pos 4
  have hq_ne : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  have hσ_mesh_pos : 0 < σ_mesh := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hKq) hσ.1
  have hσ_nonneg : 0 ≤ σ := le_of_lt hσ.1
  have hσ_mesh_le : σ_mesh ≤ (1 - (6 * R_strip + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ := by
    change (1 - K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ ≤ (1 - (6 * R_strip + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    have hK_div : (6 * R_strip + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ K_strip / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hK_eval (le_of_lt hq_sq_pos)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hσ_nonneg
  have hU_open : IsOpen (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hU_per : ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh → z + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh := by
    intro z hz
    change |z.im| < σ_mesh at hz
    change |(z + 2 * Real.pi).im| < σ_mesh
    have him : (z + (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im = z.im := by simp
    simpa [him] using hz
  have hU_conj : ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh → starRingEnd ℂ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh := by
    intro z hz
    change |z.im| < σ_mesh at hz
    change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < σ_mesh
    simpa [Complex.conj_im, abs_neg] using hz
  have hSub_iter : ∀ {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip σ_mesh) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (horizStrip σ_mesh) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh →
        iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => f ζ - g ζ) z =
          iteratedDeriv k f z - iteratedDeriv k g z := by
    intro f g hf hg k z hz
    exact iteratedDeriv_fun_sub
      ((hf.contDiffOn (n := (k : WithTop ℕ∞)) hU_open).contDiffAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz))
      ((hg.contDiffOn (n := (k : WithTop ℕ∞)) hU_open).contDiffAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz))
  have hBall_mono : ∀ {R₁ R₂ : ℝ} (hR : R₁ ≤ R₂) {u : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ},
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ_mesh R₁ u →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ_mesh R₂ u := by
    intro R₁ R₂ hR u hu
    refine ⟨hu.1, hu.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hu.2.2.1 j hj
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, fun k hk z hz => le_trans (h4 k hk z hz) hR⟩
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      exact le_trans (hu.2.2.2 j hj k hk z hz) hR
  have hDiffSup_nonneg : ∀ (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ), 0 ≤ stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂ := by
    intro W₁ W₂
    apply Real.sSup_nonneg
    rintro r ⟨j, _, ζ, _, rfl⟩
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have hDiffSup_self : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ), stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W W = 0 := by
    intro W
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Real.sSup_le
      · rintro r ⟨j, _, ζ, _, rfl⟩
        rw [sub_self]
        change ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) ζ‖ ≤ 0
        rw [iteratedDeriv_const]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · exact le_rfl
    · exact hDiffSup_nonneg W W
  have hWeierstrass : ∀ (g : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (C₀ : ℝ),
      (∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g n) (horizStrip σ_mesh)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, ‖g (n + 1) z - g n z‖ ≤ C₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) →
      let g_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => g n z)
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g_lim (horizStrip σ_mesh) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (g n) z) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (iteratedDeriv k g_lim z)) := by
    intro g C₀ hg_holo hg_step g_lim
    have hStepDist :
        ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, ∀ n : ℕ, dist (g n z) (g (n + 1) z) ≤ C₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro z hz n
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hg_step n z hz
    have hPt : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g n z) Filter.atTop (nhds (g_lim z)) := by
      intro z hz
      exact
        (cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2 : ℝ) C₀ (by norm_num) (hStepDist z hz)).tendsto_limUnder
    have hTail : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh, ∀ n : ℕ,
        dist (g_lim z) (g n z) ≤ (2 * C₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro z hz n
      rw [dist_comm]
      have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2 : ℝ) C₀ (by norm_num)
        (hStepDist z hz) (hPt z hz) n
      calc
        dist (g n z) (g_lim z) ≤ C₀ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2) := hd
        _ = (2 * C₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
    have hZero :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 * C₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
          (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (2 * C₀)
    have hUnif : TendstoUniformlyOn g g_lim Filter.atTop (horizStrip σ_mesh) := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      filter_upwards [hZero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with n hn z hz
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hTail z hz n) hn
    have hLoc : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn g g_lim Filter.atTop (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
      hUnif.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
    have hHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_lim (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
      hLoc.differentiableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg_holo) hU_open
    have hInd : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv k (g n)) (horizStrip σ_mesh)) ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n => iteratedDeriv k (g n)) (iteratedDeriv k g_lim)
          Filter.atTop (horizStrip σ_mesh) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        exact ⟨hg_holo, hLoc⟩
      | succ k ih =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        refine ⟨fun n => (ih.1 n).deriv hU_open, ?_⟩
        simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
          ih.2.deriv (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ih.1) hU_open
    exact ⟨hHolo, fun k z hz => (hInd k).2.tendsto_at hz⟩
  have hStep_ball : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
      ∀ (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ_mesh R_strip d →
        IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ_mesh (R_strip / 2) (stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d) := by
    intro w W hw hW d hd
    have hMf_nonneg : 0 ≤ F_bd.C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
      div_nonneg (le_of_lt F_bd.C_force_pos) (le_of_lt hq4_pos)
    have hf_bnd : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
        IsStripCJetBounded (m + 2) σ_mesh (F_bd.C_force / (q : ℝ) ^ 4)
          (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d (j + 1)) := by
      intro j hj
      have hEq : stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d (j + 1) = stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j := by
        simp [stripMeshForcing_ℂ, hj]
      rw [hEq]

          (le_div_iff₀' hq_sq_pos).mpr hb
        calc
          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d (m' + 1) r ζ - d m' r ζ) z‖
            ≤ ((R_strip / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m') / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := hb'
          _ = (R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by ring
      have hDist := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2 : ℝ) (R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
        (by norm_num) hConsec (hd_star_tend r hr k z hz) n
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm,
        ← hSub_iter (hd_star_holo r hr) ((hd_iter_ball n).2.2.1 r hr).1 k hz] at hDist
      have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDist (le_of_lt hq_sq_pos)
      calc
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d_star r ζ - d n r ζ) z‖
          ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2)) := hMul
        _ = R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
          field_simp [hq_ne]
          ring
    have hd_star_tail_step : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ r : ℕ, r < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
        ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d_star (r + 1) ζ - d_star r ζ) - (d n (r + 1) ζ - d n r ζ)) z‖ ≤
            R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n r hr k hk z hz
      have hr_le : r ≤ q := le_of_lt hr
      have hr1_le : r + 1 ≤ q := hr
      have hStepHolo : ∀ m' : ℕ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d m' (r + 1) ζ - d m' r ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
        fun m' => ((hd_iter_ball m').2.2.1 (r + 1) hr1_le).1.sub
          ((hd_iter_ball m').2.2.1 r hr_le).1
      have hStarStepHolo :
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d_star (r + 1) ζ - d_star r ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
        (hd_star_holo (r + 1) hr1_le).sub (hd_star_holo r hr_le)
      have hConsec : ∀ m' : ℕ,
          dist (iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d m' (r + 1) ζ - d m' r ζ) z)
            (iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d (m' + 1) (r + 1) ζ - d (m' + 1) r ζ) z) ≤
            (R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by
        intro m'
        rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, ← hSub_iter (hStepHolo (m' + 1)) (hStepHolo m') k hz]
        have hb := (hd_iter_step m').2 r hr k hk z hz
        have hb' :
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d (m' + 1) (r + 1) ζ - d (m' + 1) r ζ) -
                (d m' (r + 1) ζ - d m' r ζ)) z‖ ≤
            ((R_strip / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m') / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
          (le_div_iff₀' hq_cube_pos).mpr hb
        calc
          ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d (m' + 1) (r + 1) ζ - d (m' + 1) r ζ) -
                (d m' (r + 1) ζ - d m' r ζ)) z‖
            ≤ ((R_strip / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m') / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := hb'
          _ = (R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m' := by ring
      have hDist := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2 : ℝ) (R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3))
        (by norm_num) hConsec (hd_star_step_tend r hr k z hz) n
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, ← hSub_iter hStarStepHolo (hStepHolo n) k hz] at hDist
      have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDist (le_of_lt hq_cube_pos)
      calc
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d_star (r + 1) ζ - d_star r ζ) - (d n (r + 1) ζ - d n r ζ)) z‖
          ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ((R_strip / (2 * (q : ℝ) ^ 3)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2)) := hMul
        _ = R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
          field_simp [hq_ne]
          ring
    have hFixed : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        d_star r z = stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d_star r z := by
      intro r hr z hz
      have hStepConv :
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => d (n + 1) r z) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d_star r z)) := by
        rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
        have hBnd : ∀ n : ℕ,
            ‖d (n + 1) r z - stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d_star r z‖ ≤
              (R_strip / (4 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
          intro n
          have hLip0 :=
            (hStep_lip w w W W hw hw hW hW d_star (d n) (R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
              hd_star_ball (hd_iter_ball n) (by positivity)
              (hd_star_tail_d n) (hd_star_tail_step n)).1 r hr 0 (Nat.zero_le _) z hz
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, hDiffSup_self W, mul_zero, add_zero] at hLip0
          have hStepEq : stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W (d n) r z = d (n + 1) r z := rfl
          rw [hStepEq, norm_sub_rev] at hLip0
          have hDiv : ‖d (n + 1) r z - stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d_star r z‖ ≤
              ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * (R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
            (le_div_iff₀' hq_sq_pos).mpr hLip0
          calc
            ‖d (n + 1) r z - stripMeshStep_ℂ J_C q W d_star r z‖
              ≤ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * (R_strip * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := hDiv
            _ = (R_strip / (4 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
        have hZero :
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (R_strip / (4 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa only [mul_zero] using
            (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
              (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (R_strip / (4 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2))
        exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hBnd hZero
      have hShiftConv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => d (n + 1) r z) Filter.atTop (nhds (d_star r z)) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr
          (by simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hd_star_tend r hr 0 z hz)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hShiftConv hStepConv
    have hSecDiff : ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
        d_star (j + 2) z - 2 * d_star (j + 1) z + d_star j z =
          stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d_star j z := by
      intro j hj z hz
      rw [hFixed (j + 2) (by omega) z hz, hFixed (j + 1) (by omega) z hz,
        hFixed j (by omega) z hz]
      have hId := (hDir.diff_identities q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d_star) hq1).2 j hj z
      change dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d_star) (j + 2) z -
          2 * dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d_star) (j + 1) z +
          dirichletInv_ℂ q (stripMeshForcing_ℂ J_C q W d_star) j z =
        stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d_star j z
      rw [hId]
      simp [stripMeshForcing_ℂ, hj]
    exact ⟨hd_iter_ball, hd_star_ball, hd_star_tend, hSecDiff⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w W hw hW
    obtain ⟨_, hd_ball, _, hSecDiff⟩ := hSingle w W hw hW
    exact ⟨hd_ball, hSecDiff⟩
  · intro w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂
    obtain ⟨hd₁_iter, hd₁_ball, hd₁_tend, _⟩ := hSingle w₁ W₁ hw₁ hW₁
    obtain ⟨hd₂_iter, hd₂_ball, hd₂_tend, _⟩ := hSingle w₂ W₂ hw₂ hW₂
    let d₁ : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W₁
    let d₂ : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripMeshIter_ℂ J_C q W₂
    let d₁_star : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₁
    let d₂_star : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := stripCanonDisp_ℂ J_C q W₂
    let Δ_W : ℝ := stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂
    have hΔW_nonneg : 0 ≤ Δ_W := hDiffSup_nonneg W₁ W₂
    have hRΔ_nonneg : 0 ≤ R_strip * Δ_W := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hR_pos) hΔW_nonneg
    have hIterLip : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁ n j ζ - d₂ n j ζ) z‖ ≤ R_strip * Δ_W) ∧
        (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_mesh,
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d₁ n (j + 1) ζ - d₁ n j ζ) - (d₂ n (j + 1) ζ - d₂ n j ζ)) z‖ ≤
            R_strip * Δ_W) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro j _ k _ z _
          have hZeroFn : (fun ζ : ℂ => d₁ 0 j ζ - d₂ 0 j ζ) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
            ext ζ
            simp [d₁, d₂, stripMeshIter_ℂ]
          rw [hZeroFn, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp [hRΔ_nonneg]
        · intro j _ k _ z _
          have hZeroFn :
              (fun ζ : ℂ => (d₁ 0 (j + 1) ζ - d₁ 0 j ζ) - (d₂ 0 (j + 1) ζ - d₂ 0 j ζ)) =
                (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
            ext ζ
            simp [d₁, d₂, stripMeshIter_ℂ]
          rw [hZeroFn, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp [hRΔ_nonneg]
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ :=
          hStep_lip w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ hw₁ hw₂ hW₁ hW₂ (d₁ n) (d₂ n) (R_strip * Δ_W)
            (hd₁_iter n) (hd₂_iter n) hRΔ_nonneg ih.1 ih.2
        have hContract :
            (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (R_strip * Δ_W) + 2 * F_bd.C_force_lip * Δ_W ≤ R_strip * Δ_W := by
          have hCoeff : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * R_strip + 2 * F_bd.C_force_lip ≤ R_strip := by linarith
          calc
            (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (R_strip * Δ_W) + 2 * F_bd.C_force_lip * Δ_W
              = ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * R_strip + 2 * F_bd.C_force_lip) * Δ_W := by ring
            _ ≤ R_strip * Δ_W := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCoeff hΔW_nonneg
        exact ⟨fun j hj k hk z hz => le_trans (h1 j hj k hk z hz) hContract,
          fun j hj k hk z hz => le_trans (h2 j hj k hk z hz) hContract⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      have hLimSub :
          iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁_star j ζ - d₂_star j ζ) z =
            iteratedDeriv k (d₁_star j) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₂_star j) z :=
        hSub_iter (hd₁_ball.2.2.1 j hj).1 (hd₂_ball.2.2.1 j hj).1 k hz
      have hSeqSub : ∀ n : ℕ,
          iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁ n j ζ - d₂ n j ζ) z =
            iteratedDeriv k (d₁ n j) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₂ n j) z :=
        fun n => hSub_iter ((hd₁_iter n).2.2.1 j hj).1 ((hd₂_iter n).2.2.1 j hj).1 k hz
      have hConv :
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun n => (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁ n j ζ - d₂ n j ζ) z‖)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => d₁_star j ζ - d₂_star j ζ) z‖)) := by
        simp only [hLimSub, hSeqSub]
        exact ((hd₁_tend j hj k z hz).sub (hd₂_tend j hj k z hz)).norm.const_mul ((q : ℝ) ^ 2)
      exact le_of_tendsto' hConv (fun n => (hIterLip n).1 j hj k hk z hz)
    · intro j hj k hk z hz
      have hj_le : j ≤ q := le_of_lt hj
      have hj1_le : j + 1 ≤ q := hj
      have hStarHolo₁ :
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d₁_star (j + 1) ζ - d₁_star j ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
        (hd₁_ball.2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1.sub (hd₁_ball.2.2.1 j hj_le).1
      have hStarHolo₂ :
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d₂_star (j + 1) ζ - d₂_star j ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
        (hd₂_ball.2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1.sub (hd₂_ball.2.2.1 j hj_le).1
      have hLimSub :
          iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d₁_star (j + 1) ζ - d₁_star j ζ) -
                (d₂_star (j + 1) ζ - d₂_star j ζ)) z =
            (iteratedDeriv k (d₁_star (j + 1)) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₁_star j) z) -
              (iteratedDeriv k (d₂_star (j + 1)) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₂_star j) z) := by
        rw [hSub_iter hStarHolo₁ hStarHolo₂ k hz,
          hSub_iter (hd₁_ball.2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1 (hd₁_ball.2.2.1 j hj_le).1 k hz,
          hSub_iter (hd₂_ball.2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1 (hd₂_ball.2.2.1 j hj_le).1 k hz]
      have hSeqSub : ∀ n : ℕ,
          iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ => (d₁ n (j + 1) ζ - d₁ n j ζ) - (d₂ n (j + 1) ζ - d₂ n j ζ)) z =
            (iteratedDeriv k (d₁ n (j + 1)) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₁ n j) z) -
              (iteratedDeriv k (d₂ n (j + 1)) z - iteratedDeriv k (d₂ n j) z) := by
        intro n
        have hSeqHolo₁ :
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d₁ n (j + 1) ζ - d₁ n j ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
          ((hd₁_iter n).2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1.sub ((hd₁_iter n).2.2.1 j hj_le).1
        have hSeqHolo₂ :
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => d₂ n (j + 1) ζ - d₂ n j ζ) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
          ((hd₂_iter n).2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1.sub ((hd₂_iter n).2.2.1 j hj_le).1
        rw [hSub_iter hSeqHolo₁ hSeqHolo₂ k hz,
          hSub_iter ((hd₁_iter n).2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1 ((hd₁_iter n).2.2.1 j hj_le).1 k hz,
          hSub_iter ((hd₂_iter n).2.2.1 (j + 1) hj1_le).1 ((hd₂_iter n).2.2.1 j hj_le).1 k hz]
      have hConv :
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun n =>
              (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
                ‖iteratedDeriv k
                  (fun ζ => (d₁ n (j + 1) ζ - d₁ n j ζ) - (d₂ n (j + 1) ζ - d₂ n j ζ)) z‖)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds
              ((q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
                ‖iteratedDeriv k
                  (fun ζ => (d₁_star (j + 1) ζ - d₁_star j ζ) -
                    (d₂_star (j + 1) ζ - d₂_star j ζ)) z‖)) := by
        simp only [hLimSub, hSeqSub]
        exact (((hd₁_tend (j + 1) hj1_le k z hz).sub (hd₁_tend j hj_le k z hz)).sub
          ((hd₂_tend (j + 1) hj1_le k z hz).sub
            (hd₂_tend j hj_le k z hz))).norm.const_mul ((q : ℝ) ^ 3)
      exact le_of_tendsto' hConv (fun n => (hIterLip n).2 j hj k hk z hz)

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (H : ℝ) (f₁ g₁ f₂ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < H →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (horizStrip H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ (horizStrip H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ (horizStrip H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ (horizStrip H) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f₁ x = g₁ x) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, f₂ x = g₂ x) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip H,
        iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => f₁ ζ - f₂ ζ) z =
          iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => g₁ ζ - g₂ ζ) z) ∧
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ)
      (R_sys : RealMeshSystemPart m M₁)
      (J_C : StripHolomorphicJetData m M₁)
      (F_bd : StripForcingBoundData m M₁ J_C)
      (σ σ' R : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      0 < R →
      R_sys.N_real ≤ q →
      F_bd.N_force ≤ q →
      16 * R ≤ (q : ℝ) →
      0 < σ' →
      σ' ≤ (1 - (6 * R + J_C.K_eval) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ →
      IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
      IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
      IsStripMeshDispBall (m + 2) q σ' R d →
      (∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        d (j + 2) x - 2 * d (j + 1) x + d j x = stripForcingAt_ℂ J_C q W d j x) →
      ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (x : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + d j x =
          (realMesh q w x j : ℂ))

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro H f₁ g₁ f₂ g₂ hH hf₁ hg₁ hf₂ hg₂ hfg₁ hfg₂ k z hz
    have hOpen : IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hStrip_eq : horizStrip H = Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext s
      change |s.im| < H ↔ -H < s.im ∧ s.im < H
      exact abs_lt
    have hConv : Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
      rw [hStrip_eq]
      exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
    have hPreconn : IsPreconnected (horizStrip H) := hConv.isPreconnected
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
      change |(0 : ℂ).im| < H
      simpa using hH
    let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => f₁ ζ - f₂ ζ
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => g₁ ζ - g₂ ζ
    have hF_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (horizStrip H) := hf₁.sub hf₂
    have hG_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip H) := hg₁.sub hg₂
    have hF_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (horizStrip H) := hF_diff.analyticOnNhd hOpen
    have hG_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (horizStrip H) := hG_diff.analyticOnNhd hOpen
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
    let z_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (x_seq n : ℂ)
    have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) :=
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hz_tendsto0 : Filter.Tendsto z_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa [z_seq, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hx_tendsto
    have hz_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, z_seq n ∈ ({(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := by
      intro n
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, z_seq, x_seq, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero]
      exact one_div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (Nat.cast_add_one_pos n))
    have hz_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto z_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hz_tendsto0, Filter.Eventually.of_forall hz_ne⟩
    have hFG_seq : ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, F (z_seq n) = G (z_seq n) :=
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => by
        dsimp only [F, G, z_seq]
        rw [hfg₁ (x_seq n), hfg₂ (x_seq n)]).frequently
    have hFreq : ∃ᶠ ζ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, F ζ = G ζ :=
      hz_tendsto.frequently hFG_seq
    have hEqOn : Set.EqOn F G (horizStrip H) :=
      hF_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hG_ana hPreconn h0_mem hFreq
    have hEvEq : F =ᶠ[nhds z] G :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen.mem_nhds hz) hEqOn
    exact hEvEq.iteratedDeriv_eq k
  · intro m M₁ R_sys J_C F_bd σ σ' R q w W d hσ hR hq_real hq_force hq_R hσ'_pos hσ'_le hw hW hd hSec j hj x
    have hq4 : 4 ≤ q := le_trans F_bd.N_force_ge_four hq_force
    have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < q by omega)
    have hq_ne_R : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
    have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ q by omega)
    have hq_sq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
    have hq_cube_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_pos hq_pos 3
    have hR_le_q : R ≤ (q : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hq_le_sq : (q : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hR_le_sq : R ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := le_trans hR_le_q hq_le_sq
    have hx_mem : (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ' := by
      change |(x : ℂ).im| < σ'
      simpa using hσ'_pos
    have hd_real : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q → ((d r (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) = d r (x : ℂ) := by
      intro r hr
      have hconj := (hd.2.2.1 r hr).2.2.1 (x : ℂ) hx_mem
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp hconj.symm
    have hd_pos_bnd : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ q → |(d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      intro r hr
      have hb0 := (hd.2.2.1 r hr).2.2.2 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (x : ℂ) hx_mem
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hb0
      have hre_le : |(d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤ ‖d r (x : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
      have hmul : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |(d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |(d r (x : ℂ)).re|
            ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖d r (x : ℂ)‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hre_le (le_of_lt hq_sq_pos)
          _ ≤ R := hb0
          _ ≤ (q : ℝ) := hR_le_q
          _ = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by field_simp [hq_ne_R]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hq_sq_pos
    have hd_step_bnd : ∀ r : ℕ, r < q →
        |(d (r + 1) (x : ℂ)).re - (d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      intro r hr
      have hbs := hd.2.2.2 r hr 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (x : ℂ) hx_mem
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at hbs
      have hre_le : |(d (r + 1) (x : ℂ)).re - (d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤
          ‖d (r + 1) (x : ℂ) - d r (x : ℂ)‖ := by
        rw [← Complex.sub_re]
        exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
      have hmul :
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * |(d (r + 1) (x : ℂ)).re - (d r (x : ℂ)).re| ≤
            (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * |(d (r + 1) (x : ℂ)).re - (d r (x : ℂ)).re|
            ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * ‖d (r + 1) (x : ℂ) - d r (x : ℂ)‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hre_le (le_of_lt hq_cube_pos)
          _ ≤ R := hbs
          _ ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := hR_le_sq
          _ = (q : ℝ) ^ 3 * (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by field_simp [hq_ne_R]
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hq_cube_pos
    let X_raw : ℕ → ℝ := fun r =>
      x + 2 * Real.pi * (r : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + (d r (x : ℂ)).re
    let X_cand : ℕ → ℝ := fun r => if r ≤ q then X_raw r else 0
    have hCand : IsCandidateRealMesh q x X_cand := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h0_le : 0 ≤ q := Nat.zero_le q
        have hd0 : d 0 (x : ℂ) = 0 := (hd.1 (x : ℂ)).1
        simp [X_cand, X_raw, h0_le, hd0]
      · have hdq : d q (x : ℂ) = 0 := (hd.1 (x : ℂ)).2
        have hdiv : 2 * Real.pi * (q : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) = 2 * Real.pi :=
          mul_div_cancel_right₀ (2 * Real.pi) hq_ne_R
        simp [X_cand, X_raw, hdq, hdiv]
      · intro r hr
        have hsub : X_cand r - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (r : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)) = (d r (x : ℂ)).re := by
          simp only [X_cand, X_raw, hr, ↓reduceIte]
          ring
        rw [hsub]
        exact hd_pos_bnd r hr
      · intro r hr
        have hr_le : r ≤ q := le_of_lt hr
        have hr1_le : r + 1 ≤ q := hr
        have hsub :
            (X_cand (r + 1) - X_cand r) - 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) =
              (d (r + 1) (x : ℂ)).re - (d r (x : ℂ)).re := by
          simp only [X_cand, X_raw, hr_le, hr1_le, ↓reduceIte]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hq_ne_R]
          ring
        rw [hsub]
        exact hd_step_bnd r hr
      · intro r hr
        have hnot : ¬ r ≤ q := not_le.mpr hr
        simp [X_cand, hnot]
    have hStatCand : IsStationaryRealMesh q w x X_cand := by
      refine ⟨hCand, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      have hi0 : i ≤ q := by omega
      have hi1 : i + 1 ≤ q := by omega
      have hi2 : i + 2 ≤ q := by omega
      have hStat_i :=
        F_bd.real_stationary_of_sec_diff σ σ' R q w W d
          hσ hR hq_force hq_R hσ'_pos hσ'_le hw hW hd i x hi (hSec i hi x)
      simpa only [X_cand, hi0, hi1, hi2, ↓reduceIte] using hStat_i
    have hUniq : HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w := (R_sys.real_mesh_props q w hq_real hw).1
    have hRealMesh_eq : realMesh q w x = Classical.choose (hUniq.2.2.2 x).exists := by
      simp [realMesh, hUniq]
    have hStatReal : IsStationaryRealMesh q w x (realMesh q w x) := by
      rw [hRealMesh_eq]
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hUniq.2.2.2 x).exists
    have hEqMesh : X_cand = realMesh q w x := (hUniq.2.2.2 x).unique hStatCand hStatReal
    have hEq_j : X_raw j = realMesh q w x j := by
      have h := congrFun hEqMesh j
      simpa [X_cand, hj] using h
    calc
      (x : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + d j x
        = (x : ℂ) + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((d j (x : ℂ)).re : ℂ) := by
          rw [hd_real j hj]
      _ = ((x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) + (d j (x : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          simp only [Complex.ofReal_add]
      _ = (X_raw j : ℂ) := rfl
      _ = (realMesh q w x j : ℂ) := congrArg Complex.ofReal hEq_j
