signature.name: line_core_taylor2d_toolkit
signature.statement:
(hIterHolo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT α β f) U) :
    LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hIdx0 : ∀ a b : ℕ, (lineCoreIdx2D a b) 0 = a := by
    intro a b
    change Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]) 0 = a
    rw [Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hIdx1 : ∀ a b : ℕ, (lineCoreIdx2D a b) 1 = b := by
    intro a b
    change Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b]) 1 = b
    rw [Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hIdx_zero : lineCoreIdx2D 0 0 = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hIdx0 0 0
    · exact hIdx1 0 0
  have hIdx_e0 : lineCoreIdx2D 1 0 = Finsupp.single 0 1 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [hIdx0]
    · simp [hIdx1]
  have hIdx_e1 : lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 = Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [hIdx0]
    · simp [hIdx1]
  have hIdx_add_e0 : ∀ a b : ℕ, lineCoreIdx2D a b + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0 = lineCoreIdx2D (a + 1) b := by
    intro a b
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [hIdx0]
    · simp [hIdx1]
  have hIdx_add_e1 : ∀ a b : ℕ, lineCoreIdx2D a b + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 = lineCoreIdx2D a (b + 1) := by
    intro a b
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [hIdx0]
    · simp [hIdx1]
  have hd_eq_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0 := by
    intro d
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
  have hd_deg_add_single : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      ((d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0 +
        ((d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 = d 0 + d 1 + 1 := by
    intro ι d
    fin_cases ι <;> simp <;> omega

  let mvDeriv : Fin 2 → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun ι S d => ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) S
  have coeff_taylor2D : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀) =
        iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_mvDeriv : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι S) =
        ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) S :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_derivA : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreDerivA S) =
        ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) S :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_derivD : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreDerivD S) =
        ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) S :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_comp1D : ∀ (F₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D F₁ U) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff n F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U ^ n) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_comp2D : ∀ (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂) =
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  have mvDeriv_zero_eq : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, mvDeriv 0 S = lineCoreDerivA S := by
    intro S
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_derivA, hIdx_e0]
  have mvDeriv_one_eq : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, mvDeriv 1 S = lineCoreDerivD S := by
    intro S
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_derivD, hIdx_e1]

  
  have hIter1D_congr : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ z ∈ V, g₁ z = g₂ z) → ∀ (β : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z ∈ V →
        ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₁) z = ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] g₂) z := by
    intro V hV g₁ g₂ hg β
    induction β with
    | zero => intro z hz; exact hg z hz
    | succ β ih =>
        intro z hz
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hz) (fun w hw => ih hw)).deriv_eq
  have hIterY_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → ∀ (α : ℕ) {p : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ U →
        iterDerivY α f₁ p = iterDerivY α f₂ p := by
    intro U hU f₁ f₂ hf α
    induction α with
    | zero => intro p hp; exact hf p hp
    | succ α ih =>
        intro p hp
        change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f₁ (y', p.2)) p.1 =
          deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f₂ (y', p.2)) p.1
        have hVy : IsOpen {y' : ℂ | (y', p.2) ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVy.mem_nhds hp) (fun y' hy' => ih hy')).deriv_eq
  have hCongr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f₁ f₂ hf
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
    have hVt : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p₀.1, t') ∈ U} :=
      hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f₁ p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f₂ p₀ :=
      hIter1D_congr hVt (fun t' ht' => hIterY_congr hU hf (d 0) ht') (d 1) hp₀
    rw [hYT]

  have hIterY_succ : ∀ (α : ℕ) (h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      iterDerivY (α + 1) h = iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 h) := by
    intro α h
    induction α with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ α ih =>
        funext p
        change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (α + 1) h (y', p.2)) p.1 =
          deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 h) (y', p.2)) p.1
        rw [ih]
  have hIter1D_zero : ∀ β : ℕ,
      (fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
    intro β
    induction β with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ β ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        have hd0 : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
          funext fun z => deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
        rw [hd0, ih]
  have hIter1D_const : ∀ (c : ℂ) (β : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
      ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ : ℂ => c)) z = if β = 0 then c else 0 := by
    intro c β z
    cases β with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ β =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        have hdc : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => c) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
          funext fun w => deriv_const w c
        rw [hdc, hIter1D_zero β]
        simp
  have hIter1D_sub_self : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (β : ℕ),
      ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun t' : ℂ => t' - z₀)) z₀ = if β = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
    intro z₀ β
    cases β with
    | zero => simp
    | succ β =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        have hd1 : deriv (fun t' : ℂ => t' - z₀) = (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
          funext fun w => ((hasDerivAt_id w).sub_const z₀).deriv
        rw [hd1, hIter1D_const 1 β z₀]
        cases β <;> simp
  have hIterY_zero : ∀ α : ℕ, iterDerivY α (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ => 0) := by
    intro α
    induction α with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ α ih =>
        funext p
        change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α (fun _ => 0) (y', p.2)) p.1 = 0
        rw [ih]
        exact deriv_const p.1 (0 : ℂ)
  have hIterY_const : ∀ (c : ℂ) (α : ℕ),
      iterDerivY α (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) = fun _ => if α = 0 then c else 0 := by
    intro c α
    cases α with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ α =>
        rw [hIterY_succ α]
        have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) = (fun _ => 0) :=
          funext fun q => deriv_const q.1 c
        rw [h1, hIterY_zero α]
        simp

  have hConst : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
    intro p₀ c
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
    have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun _ => c) p₀ =
        if d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0 then c else 0 := by
      unfold iterDerivYT
      rw [hIterY_const c (d 0), hIter1D_const _ (d 1) p₀.2]
      by_cases h0 : d 0 = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : d 1 = 0 <;> simp [h0, h1]
    rw [hYT]
    by_cases hd : d = 0
    · rcases (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mp hd with ⟨h0, h1⟩
      rw [h0, h1]
      simp [hd]
    · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0) := fun h => hd ((hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr h)
      simp [hd, hnot]

  have hFst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 := by
    intro p₀
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) p₀) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 0)
    rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
    have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) = (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
      funext fun q => ((hasDerivAt_id q.1).sub_const p₀.1).deriv
    have hslice : (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) (p₀.1, t')) =
        (fun _ : ℂ => if d 0 = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) := by
      cases h0 : d 0 with
      | zero => funext t'; simp [iterDerivY]
      | succ m =>
          rw [hIterY_succ m, h1, hIterY_const 1 m]
          funext t'
          cases m <;> simp
    have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) p₀ =
        if d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
      unfold iterDerivYT
      rw [hslice, hIter1D_const _ (d 1) p₀.2]
      by_cases h0 : d 0 = 1 <;> by_cases h1' : d 1 = 0 <;> simp [h0, h1']
    have hsingle : d = Finsupp.single 0 1 ↔ d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0 := by
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · rintro ⟨hd0, hd1⟩
        apply Finsupp.ext
        intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [hd0, hd1]
    rw [hYT]
    by_cases hs : d = Finsupp.single 0 1
    · rcases hsingle.mp hs with ⟨hd0, hd1⟩
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      simp [hs]
    · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0) := fun h => hs (hsingle.mpr h)
      simp [hs, hnot]

  have hSnd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
    intro p₀
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) p₀) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 1)
    rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
    have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) = (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
      funext fun q => deriv_const q.1 (q.2 - p₀.2)
    have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) p₀ =
        if d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
      cases h0 : d 0 with
      | zero =>
          unfold iterDerivYT iterDerivY
          rw [hIter1D_sub_self p₀.2 (d 1)]
          by_cases h1' : d 1 = 1 <;> simp [h1']
      | succ m =>
          unfold iterDerivYT
          rw [hIterY_succ m, h1, hIterY_zero m, hIter1D_const 0 (d 1) p₀.2]
          simp
    have hsingle : d = Finsupp.single 1 1 ↔ d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1 := by
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · rintro ⟨hd0, hd1⟩
        apply Finsupp.ext
        intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [hd0, hd1]
    rw [hYT]
    by_cases hs : d = Finsupp.single 1 1
    · rcases hsingle.mp hs with ⟨hd0, hd1⟩
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      simp [hs]
    · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1) := fun h => hs (hsingle.mpr h)
      simp [hs, hnot]

  
  let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.fst, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_fst }
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.snd, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_snd }
  let pderiv2D : Fin 2 → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
    fun ι f => if ι = 0 then iterDerivYT 1 0 f else iterDerivYT 0 1 f
  let sliceCurve : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun ι q z => if ι = 0 then (z, q.2) else (q.1, z)
  let sliceBase : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun ι q => if ι = 0 then q.1 else q.2
  let sliceVec : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun ι => if ι = 0 then (1, 0) else (0, 1)

  have hpderiv2D_eq_slice : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      pderiv2D ι h q = deriv (fun z : ℂ => h (sliceCurve ι q z)) (sliceBase ι q) := by
    intro ι h q
    fin_cases ι <;> rfl
  have hslice_eval : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := by
    intro ι q
    fin_cases ι <;> simp [sliceCurve, sliceBase]
  have hslice_hasDerivAt : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      HasDerivAt (sliceCurve ι q) (sliceVec ι) (sliceBase ι q) := by
    intro ι q
    fin_cases ι
    · exact (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
    · exact (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
  have hasDerivAt_pderiv2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ (ι : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
        HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (sliceCurve ι q z)) (pderiv2D ι g q) (sliceBase ι q) ∧
          fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι) = pderiv2D ι g q := by
    intro U hU g hg ι q hq
    have hq_eq : sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := hslice_eval ι q
    have hg_fd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) := by
      rw [hq_eq]
      exact (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (sliceCurve ι q z))
        (fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι)) (sliceBase ι q) :=
      hg_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) (hslice_hasDerivAt ι q)
    have heq : fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι) = pderiv2D ι g q := by
      rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
      exact hd.deriv.symm
    exact ⟨heq ▸ hd, heq⟩

  have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ {w : ℂ × ℂ}, w ∈ U →
        fderiv ℂ g w = π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 g w) + π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 g w) := by
    intro U hU g hg w hw
    have h1 : fderiv ℂ g w (1, 0) = iterDerivYT 1 0 g w :=
      (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg 0 hw).2
    have h2 : fderiv ℂ g w (0, 1) = iterDerivYT 0 1 g w :=
      (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg 1 hw).2
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    have hv : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      apply Prod.ext <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h1, h2]
    simp [π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]

  have hClairaut : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) q = iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) q := by
    intro U hU f hf q hq
    let S₁ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁
    let S₂ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂
    let fA := iterDerivYT 1 0 f
    let fD := iterDerivYT 0 1 f
    let f' : ℂ × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun w => S₁ (fA w) + S₂ (fD w)
    have hf_ev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds q, HasFDerivAt f (f' w) w := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hq] with w hw
      have hd := (hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hw)).hasFDerivAt
      rw [hfderiv_decomp hU hf hw] at hd
      exact hd
    have hfA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ fA U := hIterHolo hU hf 1 0
    have hfD_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ fD U := hIterHolo hU hf 0 1
    have hfA_fd : HasFDerivAt fA (fderiv ℂ fA q) q :=
      (hfA_holo.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
    have hfD_fd : HasFDerivAt fD (fderiv ℂ fD q) q :=
      (hfD_holo.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
    let f'' : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      S₁.comp (fderiv ℂ fA q) + S₂.comp (fderiv ℂ fD q)
    have hf'' : HasFDerivAt f' f'' q :=
      (S₁.hasFDerivAt.comp q hfA_fd).add (S₂.hasFDerivAt.comp q hfD_fd)
    have hsymm := second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually hf_ev hf'' (1, 0) (0, 1)
    have heval1 : (f'' (1, 0)) (0, 1) = iterDerivYT 1 0 fD q := by
      have hD_decomp := hfderiv_decomp hU hfD_holo hq
      simp [f'', S₁, S₂, π₁, π₂, hD_decomp]
    have heval2 : (f'' (0, 1)) (1, 0) = iterDerivYT 0 1 fA q := by
      have hA_decomp := hfderiv_decomp hU hfA_holo hq
      simp [f'', S₁, S₂, π₁, π₂, hA_decomp]
    rw [← heval1, ← heval2]
    exact hsymm

  have hCommY_D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ (α : ℕ) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
        iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 0 1 g) q = iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivY α g) q := by
    intro U hU α
    induction α with
    | zero => intro g _ q _; rfl
    | succ α ih =>
        intro g hg q hq
        rw [hIterY_succ α (iterDerivYT 0 1 g)]
        have hcongrY : iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 g)) q =
            iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 g)) q :=
          hIterY_congr hU (fun w hw => hClairaut hU hg hw) α hq
        rw [hcongrY, ih (hIterHolo hU hg 1 0) hq, ← hIterY_succ α g]

  have hDeriv : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ ∧
        lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf
    constructor
    · apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      rw [coeff_derivA, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
      have hd0 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) 0 = d 0 + 1 := by simp [hIdx0]
      have hd1 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) 1 = d 1 := by simp [hIdx1]
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0 + 1) (d 1) f p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ := by
        change ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0 + 1) f (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2 =
          ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2
        rw [hIterY_succ (d 0) f]
      rw [hYT, Nat.factorial_succ (d 0), Nat.cast_mul]
      have hne : ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero (d 0))
      rw [mul_assoc (((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)), ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
    · apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      rw [coeff_derivD, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
      have hd0 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) 0 = d 0 := by simp [hIdx0]
      have hd1 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) 1 = d 1 + 1 := by simp [hIdx1]
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      have hVt : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p₀.1, t') ∈ U} :=
        hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1 + 1) f p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀ := by
        change ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1 + 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) f (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2 =
          ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
        exact (hIter1D_congr hVt (fun t' ht' => hCommY_D hU (d 0) hf ht') (d 1) hp₀).symm
      rw [hYT, Nat.factorial_succ (d 1), Nat.cast_mul]
      have hne : ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero (d 1))
      have hcomm : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * (((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) =
          ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
      rw [hcomm, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]

  have hpderiv2D_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf ι
    fin_cases ι
    · exact hIterHolo hU hf 1 0
    · exact hIterHolo hU hf 0 1
  have hmvDeriv_taylor2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        mvDeriv ι (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderiv2D ι f) p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf ι
    fin_cases ι
    · dsimp; rw [mvDeriv_zero_eq]; exact (hDeriv hU hp₀ hf).1
    · dsimp; rw [mvDeriv_one_eq]; exact (hDeriv hU hp₀ hf).2

  
  have hmvDeriv_add : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      mvDeriv ι (Φ + Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ + mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
    intro ι Φ Ψ
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [map_add, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, map_add, mul_add]

  have hmvLeibniz_half : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)),
          (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
    intro ι Φ Ψ d
    let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)
    let S₁ := (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e)).filter
      (fun p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => p.1 ι ≠ 0)
    have hsub :
        (∑ p ∈ S₁, ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      intro p hp hnot
      have hp0 : p.1 ι = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hp, hne⟩)
      simp [hp0]
    rw [← hsub, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun q _ => (q.1 + e, q.2)) (fun p _ => (p.1 - e, p.2))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro q hq
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
      refine ⟨by rw [add_right_comm, hq], ?_⟩
      simp [e]
    · intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
      have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp.1 0
      have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp.1 1
      have hp_ne : p.1 ι ≠ 0 := hp.2
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro k
      fin_cases ι <;> fin_cases k <;>
        dsimp [e] at hp0 hp1 hp_ne ⊢ <;>
        simp at hp0 hp1 hp_ne ⊢ <;>
        omega
    · intro q _
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Finsupp.ext
        intro k
        simp only [Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
        omega
      · rfl
    · intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hp
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Finsupp.ext
        intro k
        have hp_ne : p.1 ι ≠ 0 := hp.2
        fin_cases ι <;> fin_cases k <;>
          dsimp [e] at hp_ne ⊢ <;>
          simp at hp_ne ⊢ <;>
          omega
      · rfl
    · intro q _
      rw [coeff_mvDeriv]
      have hqi : (q.1 + e) ι = q.1 ι + 1 := by simp [e]
      rw [hqi]

  have hmvDeriv_mul : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      mvDeriv ι (Φ * Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
    intro ι Φ Ψ
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)
    have hsecond : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      rw [mul_comm Φ (mvDeriv ι Ψ), hmvLeibniz_half ι Ψ Φ d]
      refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun p _ => p.swap) (fun p _ => p.swap) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro p hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
        simpa [add_comm] using hp
      · intro p hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
        simpa [add_comm] using hp
      · intro p _; cases p; rfl
      · intro p _; cases p; rfl
      · intro p _; simp; ring
    rw [map_add, hmvLeibniz_half ι Φ Ψ d, hsecond, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      coeff_mvDeriv, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hsum_i : p.1 ι + p.2 ι = d ι + 1 := by
      have hi := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp ι
      simpa [e] using hi
    have hcast : ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← hsum_i]
      push_cast
      rfl
    rw [hcast]
    ring

  have hmvDeriv_one : ∀ ι : Fin 2, mvDeriv ι 1 = 0 := by
    intro ι
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [coeff_mvDeriv, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one]
    have hne : d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hi := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h0 ι
      simp at hi
    simp [hne]

  have hmvDeriv_pow_succ : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (W : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (k : ℕ),
      mvDeriv ι (W ^ (k + 1)) = MvPowerSeries.C ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (W ^ k * mvDeriv ι W) := by
    intro ι W k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        simp [pow_one, pow_zero, map_one]
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [pow_succ W (k + 1), hmvDeriv_mul, ih, pow_succ W k]
        have hC : (MvPowerSeries.C ((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) =
            MvPowerSeries.C ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 := by
          push_cast
          rw [map_add, map_one]
        rw [hC]
        ring

  have hVanish_zero : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, lineCoreVanishesBelow 0 S := by
    intro S d hd
    omega
  have hVanish_one : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → lineCoreVanishesBelow 1 U := by
    intro U hU d hd
    have hd0 : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    rw [hd0, hU]
  have hVanish_mul : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      lineCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₂ B →
        lineCoreVanishesBelow (N₁ + N₂) (A * B) := by
    intro N₁ N₂ A B hA hB d hd
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
    have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
    by_cases hlt : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < N₁
    · rw [hA p.1 hlt, zero_mul]
    · have hlt2 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 < N₂ := by omega
      rw [hB p.2 hlt2, mul_zero]
  have hVanish_mul_right : ∀ {M : ℕ} {A : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} (B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      lineCoreVanishesBelow M A → lineCoreVanishesBelow M (A * B) := by
    intro M A B hA
    simpa using hVanish_mul hA (hVanish_zero B)
  have hVanish_pow : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, lineCoreVanishesBelow n (U ^ n) := by
    intro U hU n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hVanish_zero _
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact hVanish_mul ih (hVanish_one hU)

  have hmvDeriv_comp1D : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (F₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
        mvDeriv ι (compPowerSeries2D F₁ U) =
          compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative F₁) U * mvDeriv ι U := by
    intro ι F₁ U hU
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    let N := d 0 + d 1
    rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_comp1D, hd_deg_add_single ι d]
    change ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff n F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U ^ n)) = _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          (PowerSeries.coeff n F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U ^ n)) =
        PowerSeries.coeff n F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U ^ n)) := by
      intro n
      rw [coeff_mvDeriv]
      ring
    simp_rw [hterm]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have hz0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U ^ 0)) = 0 := by
      rw [pow_zero, hmvDeriv_one ι, map_zero, mul_zero]
    rw [hz0, add_zero]
    have hsucc : ∀ k : ℕ,
        PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U ^ (k + 1))) =
          PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative F₁) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U ^ k * mvDeriv ι U) := by
      intro k
      rw [hmvDeriv_pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
      push_cast
      ring
    simp_rw [hsucc, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
    have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
    have hMp_le : p.1 0 + p.1 1 + 1 ≤ N + 1 := by omega
    rw [coeff_comp1D, Finset.sum_mul]
    symm
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hMp_le) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro k _ hk_not
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk_not
      have hk_gt : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < k := by omega
      rw [hVanish_pow hU k p.1 hk_gt, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      ring

  have hmvDeriv_comp2D_half : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (G V₁ V₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₂ = 0 → ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) G *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ a) * V₂ ^ b)) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D (lineCoreDerivA G) V₁ V₂ * mvDeriv ι V₁) := by
    intro ι G V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ d
    let N := d 0 + d 1
    change (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + 1),
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + 1),
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) G *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ a) * V₂ ^ b)) = _
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have ha0 : (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + 1),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 0 b) G *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ 0) * V₂ ^ b)) = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
      rw [pow_zero, hmvDeriv_one ι, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
    rw [ha0, add_zero]
    have ha_step : ∀ a' ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
        (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 + 1),
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D (a' + 1) b) G *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ (a' + 1)) * V₂ ^ b)) =
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a' b) (lineCoreDerivA G) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ b) * mvDeriv ι V₁) := by
      intro a' _
      have hterm_b : ∀ b : ℕ,
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D (a' + 1) b) G *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ (a' + 1)) * V₂ ^ b) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a' b) (lineCoreDerivA G) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ b) * mvDeriv ι V₁) := by
        intro b
        have hpow_rearr : mvDeriv ι (V₁ ^ (a' + 1)) * V₂ ^ b =
            MvPowerSeries.C ((a' + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ b) * mvDeriv ι V₁) := by
          rw [hmvDeriv_pow_succ]
          ring
        rw [hpow_rearr, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, coeff_derivA, hIdx0, hIdx_add_e0]
        ring
      simp_rw [hterm_b]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hb_top : MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ (N + 1)) * mvDeriv ι V₁) = 0 := by
        have hv : lineCoreVanishesBelow (a' + (N + 1))
            ((V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ (N + 1)) * mvDeriv ι V₁) :=
          hVanish_mul_right _ (hVanish_mul (hVanish_pow hV₁ a') (hVanish_pow hV₂ (N + 1)))
        exact hv d (by omega)
      rw [hb_top, mul_zero, add_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl ha_step]
    have hexp_d : ∀ X : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (X * mvDeriv ι V₁) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 X * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (mvDeriv ι V₁) :=
      fun X => MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul d X (mvDeriv ι V₁)
    simp_rw [hexp_d, Finset.mul_sum]
    conv_lhs =>
      arg 2
      ext a'
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
    have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
    have hMp_le : p.1 0 + p.1 1 + 1 ≤ N + 1 := by omega
    rw [coeff_comp2D]
    have houter :
        (∑ a' ∈ Finset.range (p.1 0 + p.1 1 + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a' b) (lineCoreDerivA G) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ b) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (mvDeriv ι V₁))) =
        ∑ a' ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a' b) (lineCoreDerivA G) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (V₁ ^ a' * V₂ ^ b) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (mvDeriv ι V₁)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hMp_le)
      intro a' _ ha'_not
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha'_not
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
      have hv := hVanish_mul (hVanish_pow hV₁ a') (hVanish_pow hV₂ b) p.1 (by omega)
      rw [hv, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    rw [← houter, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    symm
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hMp_le) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro b _ hb_not
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hb_not
      have hv := hVanish_mul (hVanish_pow hV₁ a') (hVanish_pow hV₂ b) p.1 (by omega)
      rw [hv, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      ring

  have hmvDeriv_comp2D : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
      {U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
        mvDeriv ι (lineCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂) =
          lineCoreComp2D (lineCoreDerivA F) U₁ U₂ * mvDeriv ι U₁ +
            lineCoreComp2D (lineCoreDerivD F) U₁ U₂ * mvDeriv ι U₂ := by
    intro ι F U₁ U₂ hU₁ hU₂
    let swapIdx : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun S m => MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D (m 1) (m 0)) S
    have coeff_swap : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (a b : ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D b a) (swapIdx S) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) S := by
      intro S a b
      change MvPowerSeries.coeff
        (lineCoreIdx2D ((lineCoreIdx2D b a) 1) ((lineCoreIdx2D b a) 0)) S = _
      rw [hIdx0, hIdx1]
    have hderiv_swap : ∀ (a b : ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D b a) (lineCoreDerivA (swapIdx F)) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) (lineCoreDerivD F) := by
      intro a b
      rw [coeff_derivA, coeff_derivD, hIdx0, hIdx1, hIdx_add_e0, hIdx_add_e1, coeff_swap]
    have hcomp_swap : lineCoreComp2D (lineCoreDerivA (swapIdx F)) U₂ U₁ =
        lineCoreComp2D (lineCoreDerivD F) U₁ U₂ := by
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      rw [coeff_comp2D, coeff_comp2D, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      rw [hderiv_swap a b, mul_comm (U₂ ^ b) (U₁ ^ a)]
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    rw [map_add, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_comp2D, hd_deg_add_single ι d]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have hsplit : ∀ a b : ℕ,
        ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
          (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U₁ ^ a) * U₂ ^ b) +
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * mvDeriv ι (U₂ ^ b)) := by
      intro a b
      have hc : ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b)) := rfl
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm (((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)), mul_assoc, hc, hmvDeriv_mul, map_add,
        mul_add]
    simp_rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [hmvDeriv_comp2D_half ι F U₁ U₂ hU₁ hU₂ d]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hswap_sum :
        (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D a b) F *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * mvDeriv ι (U₂ ^ b))) =
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D b a) (swapIdx F) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (U₂ ^ b) * U₁ ^ a) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_swap F a b, mul_comm (U₁ ^ a) (mvDeriv ι (U₂ ^ b))]
    rw [hswap_sum, hmvDeriv_comp2D_half ι (swapIdx F) U₂ U₁ hU₂ hU₁ d, hcomp_swap]

  
  have coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq : ∀ {N : ℕ} {Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
      d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 →
      (∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d' 0 + d' 1 = N →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv ι Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv ι Ψ)) →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d Φ = MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ := by
    intro N Φ Ψ d hd hstep
    cases h0 : d 0 with
    | zero =>
        have hd1 : d 1 = N + 1 := by omega
        let d' := lineCoreIdx2D 0 N
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by simp [d', hIdx0, hIdx1]
        have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 1 1 = d := by
          apply Finsupp.ext
          intro i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [d', hIdx0, hIdx1, h0, hd1]
        have heq := hstep 1 d' hd'_deg
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, hd'_add] at heq
        have hd'1 : d' 1 = N := hIdx1 0 N
        rw [hd'1] at heq
        have hne : ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero N)
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne heq
    | succ m =>
        let d' := lineCoreIdx2D m (d 1)
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by simp [d', hIdx0, hIdx1]; omega
        have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 0 1 = d := by
          apply Finsupp.ext
          intro i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [d', hIdx0, hIdx1, h0]
        have heq := hstep 0 d' hd'_deg
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, hd'_add] at heq
        have hd'0 : d' 0 = m := hIdx0 m (d 1)
        rw [hd'0] at heq
        have hne : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero m)
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne heq

  have hDiff_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p + g p) U :=
    fun hf hg => hf.add hg
  have hDiff_sub : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p - g p) U :=
    fun hf hg => hf.sub hg
  have hDiff_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * g p) U :=
    fun hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have coeff_zero_mul : ∀ A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (A * B) = MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 A * MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 B := by
    intro A B
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    have hant : Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) = {(0, 0)} := by
      ext p
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal, Finset.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro hp
        have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
        have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
        simp at h0 h1
        exact Prod.ext ((hd_eq_zero_iff p.1).mpr ⟨h0.1, h1.1⟩)
          ((hd_eq_zero_iff p.2).mpr ⟨h0.2, h1.2⟩)
      · rintro rfl; simp
    rw [hant, Finset.sum_singleton]

  have hTaylor_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀
    have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
          have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
          rw [map_add, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, hd0, hd1]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
            have hp_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => f p + g p) q =
                pderiv2D ι f q + pderiv2D ι g q := by
              intro q hq
              rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
              exact ((hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hf ι hq).1.add
                (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg ι hq).1).deriv
            rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_add hf hg) ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_add,
              hmvDeriv_add, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hf ι, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg ι]
            exact ih (hpderiv2D_holo hU hf ι) (hpderiv2D_holo hU hg ι) d' (by omega)
    intro f g hf hg
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl

  have hTaylor_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀
    have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          subst hd_zero
          rw [coeff_zero_mul, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
            have hp_mul : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => f p * g p) q =
                pderiv2D ι f q * g q + f q * pderiv2D ι g q := by
              intro q hq
              rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
              have hmul_at : HasDerivAt
                  (fun z : ℂ => f (sliceCurve ι q z) * g (sliceCurve ι q z))
                  (pderiv2D ι f q * g (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) +
                    f (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) * pderiv2D ι g q)
                  (sliceBase ι q) :=
                (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hf ι hq).1.mul (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg ι hq).1
              rw [hslice_eval ι q] at hmul_at
              exact hmul_at.deriv
            have hf' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι f) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hf ι
            have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι g) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hg ι
            rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hf hg) ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_mul,
              hTaylor_add hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hf' hg) (hDiff_mul hf hg'),
              hmvDeriv_mul, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hf ι, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg ι,
              map_add, map_add,
              ih hf' hg d' (by omega), ih hf hg' d' (by omega)]
    intro f g hf hg
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl

  have hRing : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
        taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
        taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
        taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hTaylor_add hU hp₀ hf hg, ?_, hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hf hg⟩
    have hsub_eq : (fun p => f p - g p) = (fun p => f p + (-1 : ℂ) * g p) := by
      funext p; ring
    rw [hsub_eq, hTaylor_add hU hp₀ hf (hDiff_mul (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg),
      hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg, hConst p₀ (-1 : ℂ),
      map_neg, map_one]
    ring

  have hCentered_coeff_zero : ∀ (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = 0 := by
    intro ψ p₀
    change MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = 0
    rw [coeff_taylor2D]
    simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  have hmvDeriv_centered : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        mvDeriv ι (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = taylor2D (pderiv2D ι ψ) p₀ := by
    intro U hU p₀ hp₀ ψ hψ ι
    change mvDeriv ι (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
    rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_sub hψ (differentiableOn_const (ψ p₀))) ι]
    refine hCongr hU hp₀ fun q hq => ?_
    rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hψ ι hq).1.sub_const (ψ p₀)).deriv

  have hComp1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
      IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
        taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
          compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) := by
    intro U W_ψ hU hW_ψ p₀ hp₀ ψ g₀ hψ hg₀ hmaps
    have hderiv_1D : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
        PowerSeries.derivative (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g z₀) =
          lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (deriv g) z₀ := by
      intro g z₀
      apply PowerSeries.ext
      intro n
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
      unfold lineCoreHoloTaylor1D
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_succ',
        Nat.factorial_succ n, Nat.cast_mul]
      have hne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
      have hcast_n : ((n : ℂ) + 1) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      have hcomm : (iteratedDeriv n (deriv g) z₀ / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (n.factorial : ℂ))) *
          ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
          ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (iteratedDeriv n (deriv g) z₀) /
            (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (n.factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
      rw [hcast_n, hcomm, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
    let U_ψ := centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀
    have hUψ_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U_ψ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero ψ p₀
    have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) U_ψ) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
          intro g _ d hd
          have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          subst hd_zero
          rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_comp1D]
          simp [lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ N ih =>
          intro g hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hg d hle
          · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
            have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) W_ψ := hg.deriv hW_ψ
            have hg_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (ψ p)) U :=
              hg.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hg'_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => deriv g (ψ p)) U :=
              hg'.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hp_comp : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => g (ψ p)) q =
                deriv g (ψ q) * pderiv2D ι ψ q := by
              intro q hq
              rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
              have hψ_at := (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hψ ι hq).1
              have hg_at : HasDerivAt g (deriv g (ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))))
                  (ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))) := by
                rw [hslice_eval ι q]
                exact (hg.differentiableAt (hW_ψ.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))).hasDerivAt
              have hcomp_at := hg_at.comp (sliceBase ι q) hψ_at
              rw [hslice_eval ι q] at hcomp_at
              exact hcomp_at.deriv
            rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg_comp ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_comp,
              hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hg'_comp (hpderiv2D_holo hU hψ ι),
              hmvDeriv_comp1D ι _ hUψ_zero, hderiv_1D, hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hψ ι,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
            rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
            have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
            have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
            rw [ih hg' r.1 (by omega)]
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hg₀ d le_rfl

  have hComp2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
        taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
          lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
            (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
            (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀) := by
    intro U V hU hV p₀ hp₀ Ψ f₀ hΨ hf₀ hmaps
    let Ψ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).1
    let Ψ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).2
    have hΨ₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₁ U := π₁.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
    have hΨ₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₂ U := π₂.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
    let U₁ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₁ p₀
    let U₂ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₂ p₀
    have hU₁_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero Ψ₁ p₀
    have hU₂_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero Ψ₂ p₀
    have hp_comp2D : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
        ∀ (ι : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
          pderiv2D ι (fun p => g (Ψ p)) q =
            iterDerivYT 1 0 g (Ψ q) * pderiv2D ι Ψ₁ q +
              iterDerivYT 0 1 g (Ψ q) * pderiv2D ι Ψ₂ q := by
      intro g hg ι q hq
      have hq_eq : sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := hslice_eval ι q
      have hΨ_fd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℂ Ψ q) (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) := by
        rw [hq_eq]
        exact (hΨ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hΨ_slice : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ (sliceCurve ι q z))
          (fderiv ℂ Ψ q (sliceVec ι)) (sliceBase ι q) :=
        hΨ_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) (hslice_hasDerivAt ι q)
      let vΨ := fderiv ℂ Ψ q (sliceVec ι)
      have hvΨ1 : vΨ.1 = pderiv2D ι Ψ₁ q := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₁ (sliceCurve ι q z)) (π₁ vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
          π₁.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
        rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
        exact h1.deriv.symm
      have hvΨ2 : vΨ.2 = pderiv2D ι Ψ₂ q := by
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₂ (sliceCurve ι q z)) (π₂ vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
          π₂.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
        rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
        exact h2.deriv.symm
      have hg_fd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (Ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))) := by
        rw [hq_eq]
        exact (hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))).hasFDerivAt
      have hcomp_at : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (Ψ (sliceCurve ι q z)))
          (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q) vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
        hg_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
      rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice, hcomp_at.deriv, hfderiv_decomp hV hg (hmaps q hq)]
      simp [π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hvΨ1, hvΨ2]
      ring
    have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (Ψ p)) p₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
          intro g _ d hd
          have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          subst hd_zero
          rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_comp2D]
          simp [hIdx_zero, coeff_taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ N ih =>
          intro g hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hg d hle
          · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
            let gA := iterDerivYT 1 0 g
            let gD := iterDerivYT 0 1 g
            have hgA : DifferentiableOn ℂ gA V := hIterHolo hV hg 1 0
            have hgD : DifferentiableOn ℂ gD V := hIterHolo hV hg 0 1
            have hg_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (Ψ p)) U :=
              hg.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hgA_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => gA (Ψ p)) U :=
              hgA.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hgD_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => gD (Ψ p)) U :=
              hgD.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
            have hΨ₁' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι Ψ₁) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hΨ₁ ι
            have hΨ₂' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι Ψ₂) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hΨ₂ ι
            rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg_comp ι,
              hCongr hU hp₀ (fun q hq => hp_comp2D hg ι hq),
              hTaylor_add hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hgA_comp hΨ₁') (hDiff_mul hgD_comp hΨ₂'),
              hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hgA_comp hΨ₁',
              hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hgD_comp hΨ₂',
              hmvDeriv_comp2D ι _ hU₁_zero hU₂_zero,
              (hDeriv hV (hmaps p₀ hp₀) hg).1,
              (hDeriv hV (hmaps p₀ hp₀) hg).2,
              hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hΨ₁ ι,
              hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hΨ₂ ι,
              map_add, map_add,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
            congr 1
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
              have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
              have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
              rw [ih hgA r.1 (by omega)]
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
              have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
              have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
              rw [ih hgD r.1 (by omega)]
    apply MvPowerSeries.ext
    intro d
    exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf₀ d le_rfl

  exact {
    iterDerivYT_holo := hIterHolo
    taylor2D_congr := hCongr
    taylor2D_const := hConst
    centeredTaylor2D_fst := hFst
    centeredTaylor2D_snd := hSnd
    taylor2D_ring := hRing
    deriv_taylor2D := hDeriv
    taylor2D_comp_1D := hComp1D
    taylor2D_comp_2D := hComp2D
  }

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_idx0 : ∀ a b : ℕ, (lineCoreIdx2D a b) 0 = a := by
    intro a b
    change (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (lineCoreIdx2D a b)) 0 = a
    rw [lineCoreIdx2D, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have h_idx1 : ∀ a b : ℕ, (lineCoreIdx2D a b) 1 = b := by
    intro a b
    change (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (lineCoreIdx2D a b)) 1 = b
    rw [lineCoreIdx2D, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have h_idx_eta : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, lineCoreIdx2D (d 0) (d 1) = d := by
    intro d
    ext i
    revert i
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact h_idx0 (d 0) (d 1)
    · exact h_idx1 (d 0) (d 1)
  have h_idx_zero : lineCoreIdx2D 0 0 = 0 := h_idx_eta 0
  have h_eq_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 + d 1 = 0 := by
    intro d
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      rfl
    · intro hd
      have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
      have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [← h_idx_eta d, hd0, hd1, h_idx_zero]
  have h_single_add : ∀ a b : ℕ,
      Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b = lineCoreIdx2D a b := by
    intro a b
    ext i
    revert i
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [h_idx0]
    · simp [h_idx1]
  have h_single0 : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 = lineCoreIdx2D 1 0 := by
    simpa using h_single_add 1 0
  have h_single1 : Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) 1 = lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 := by
    simpa using h_single_add 0 1
  have h_antidiag : ∀ {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} {p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)},
      p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d →
      p.1 + p.2 = d ∧ (p.1 0 + p.1 1) + (p.2 0 + p.2 1) = d 0 + d 1 := by
    intro d p hp
    have heq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    have h0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, heq]
    have h1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, heq]
    exact ⟨heq, by omega⟩

  
  have h_vanish_zero : ∀ A : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, lineCoreVanishesBelow 0 A := by
    intro A d hd
    omega
  have h_vanish_mono : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      N₁ ≤ N₂ → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₂ A → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A := by
    intro N₁ N₂ A hle hA d hd
    exact hA d (lt_of_lt_of_le hd hle)
  have h_vanish_add : ∀ {N : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      lineCoreVanishesBelow N A → lineCoreVanishesBelow N B →
      lineCoreVanishesBelow N (A + B) := by
    intro N A B hA hB d hd
    rw [map_add, hA d hd, hB d hd, add_zero]
  have h_vanishesBelow_mul : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      lineCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A → lineCoreVanishesBelow N₂ B →
      lineCoreVanishesBelow (N₁ + N₂) (A * B) := by
    intro N₁ N₂ A B hA hB d hd
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    have hdeg := (h_antidiag hp).2
    by_cases h1 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < N₁
    · rw [hA p.1 h1, zero_mul]
    · have h2 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 < N₂ := by omega
      rw [hB p.2 h2, mul_zero]
  have h_vanish_one : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → lineCoreVanishesBelow 1 U := by
    intro U hU d hd
    have hd0 : d = 0 := (h_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
    rw [hd0, hU]
  have h_vanish_pow : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → ∀ m : ℕ, lineCoreVanishesBelow m (U ^ m) := by
    intro U hU m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact h_vanish_zero (U ^ 0)
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact h_vanishesBelow_mul ih (h_vanish_one hU)
  have h_pow_diff_gen : ∀ {N m : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N → 1 ≤ m → ∀ {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 A = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 B = 0 →
      lineCoreVanishesBelow N (A - B) → lineCoreVanishesBelow (N + m - 1) (A ^ m - B ^ m) := by
    intro N m hN hm A B hA hB hAB
    induction m with
    | zero => omega
    | succ m ih =>
      by_cases hm0 : m = 0
      · subst hm0
        simpa using hAB
      · have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by omega
        have h_id : A ^ (m + 1) - B ^ (m + 1) = (A ^ m - B ^ m) * A + B ^ m * (A - B) := by ring
        have h_eq1 : (N + m - 1) + 1 = N + (m + 1) - 1 := by omega
        have h_eq2 : m + N = N + (m + 1) - 1 := by omega
        rw [h_id]
        refine h_vanish_add ?_ ?_
        · rw [← h_eq1]
          exact h_vanishesBelow_mul (ih hm1) (h_vanish_one hA)
        · rw [← h_eq2]
          exact h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanish_pow hB m) hAB
  have h_coeff_mul_right : ∀ {G η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
      lineCoreVanishesBelow (d 0 + d 1) η →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (G * η) = MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d η := by
    intro G η d hη
    have h0d_mem : ((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d) ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d :=
      Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (zero_add d)
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ h0d_mem]

          change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Ψ₁ +
            MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Ψ₂ = 1
          rw [← h_lin_deg1 he0_deg1 hΦ₁0, hC₀, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, h_single0_e0]
          simp
        · rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Ψ₁ +
            MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Ψ₂ = 0
          rw [← h_lin_deg1 he1_deg1 hΦ₁0, hC₀, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, h_single0_e0]
          simp [he0_ne_e1.symm]
      · refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Ψ₁ +
            MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Ψ₂ = 0
          rw [← h_lin_deg1 he0_deg1 hΦ₂0, hC₁, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, h_single1_e1]
          simp [he0_ne_e1]
        · rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Ψ₁ +
            MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Ψ₂ = 1
          rw [← h_lin_deg1 he1_deg1 hΦ₂0, hC₁, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, h_single1_e1]
          simp
    have hJ_det : J_Φ.det ≠ 0 := by
      have hdet_one : J_Φ.det * J_Ψ.det = 1 := by
        rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hJ_mul, Matrix.det_one]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet_one
    have hJ_mem : ∀ r s : Fin 2, J_Φ r s ∈ L := by
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨hΦ₁L e₀, hΦ₁L e₁⟩
      · exact Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨hΦ₂L e₀, hΦ₂L e₁⟩
    have h_ind : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 = N →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ ∈ L ∧ MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ ∈ L := by
      intro N
      induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h N ih =>
        intro d hd
        by_cases hN0 : N = 0
        · have hd0 : d = 0 := (h_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          rw [hd0, hΨ₁0, hΨ₂0]
          exact ⟨L.zero_mem, L.zero_mem⟩
        · have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by omega
          let V₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
            fun u => if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₁ else 0
          let V₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
            fun u => if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₂ else 0
          have h0_lt_N : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0 + (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 < N := by simp; omega
          have hV₁0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₁ = 0 := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0 + (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 < N then
              MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₁ else 0) = 0
            rw [if_pos h0_lt_N, hΨ₁0]
          have hV₂0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₂ = 0 := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0 + (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 < N then
              MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₂ else 0) = 0
            rw [if_pos h0_lt_N, hΨ₂0]
          have hdV₁ : MvPowerSeries.coeff d V₁ = 0 := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if d 0 + d 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ else 0) = 0
            simp [hd]
          have hdV₂ : MvPowerSeries.coeff d V₂ = 0 := by
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if d 0 + d 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ else 0) = 0
            simp [hd]
          have hΨV₁ : lineCoreVanishesBelow (d 0 + d 1) (Ψ₁ - V₁) := by
            intro u hu
            rw [map_sub, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₁ -
              (if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₁ else 0) = 0
            rw [if_pos (hd ▸ hu), sub_self]
          have hΨV₂ : lineCoreVanishesBelow (d 0 + d 1) (Ψ₂ - V₂) := by
            intro u hu
            rw [map_sub, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₂ -
              (if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₂ else 0) = 0
            rw [if_pos (hd ▸ hu), sub_self]
          have hV₁L : lineCoreCoeffsIn L V₁ := by
            intro u
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₁ else 0) ∈ L
            split_ifs with hu
            · exact (ih (u 0 + u 1) hu u rfl).1
            · exact L.zero_mem
          have hV₂L : lineCoreCoeffsIn L V₂ := by
            intro u
            rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
            change (if u 0 + u 1 < N then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₂ else 0) ∈ L
            split_ifs with hu
            · exact (ih (u 0 + u 1) hu u rfl).2
            · exact L.zero_mem
          let x_vec : Fin 2 → ℂ := fun r =>
            if r = 0 then MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ else MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂
          let b_vec : Fin 2 → ℂ := fun r =>
            if r = 0 then
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 0) -
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D Φ₁ V₁ V₂)
            else
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 1) -
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D Φ₂ V₁ V₂)
          have hb_mem : ∀ r : Fin 2, b_vec r ∈ L := by
            refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · exact L.sub_mem (h_X_mem L 0 d) (h_comp2D_mem L hΦ₁L hV₁0 hV₂0 hV₁L hV₂L d)
            · exact L.sub_mem (h_X_mem L 1 d) (h_comp2D_mem L hΦ₂L hV₁0 hV₂0 hV₁L hV₂L d)
          have h_sys : J_Φ.mulVec x_vec = b_vec := by
            ext r
            revert r
            refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ +
                MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ =
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 0) -
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D Φ₁ V₁ V₂)
              have hsp := h_comp2D_split (Φ := Φ₁) (hd ▸ hN1) hΦ₁0 hΨ₁0 hΨ₂0 hV₁0 hV₂0
                hΨV₁ hΨV₂ hdV₁ hdV₂
              rw [hC₀] at hsp
              linear_combination -hsp
            · rw [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
              change MvPowerSeries.coeff e₀ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ +
                MvPowerSeries.coeff e₁ Φ₂ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ =
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 1) -
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D Φ₂ V₁ V₂)
              have hsp := h_comp2D_split (Φ := Φ₂) (hd ▸ hN1) hΦ₂0 hΨ₁0 hΨ₂0 hV₁0 hV₂0
                hΨV₁ hΨV₂ hdV₁ hdV₂
              rw [hC₁] at hsp
              linear_combination -hsp
          have hx_mem := h_mulVec_mem L hJ_mem hJ_det hb_mem h_sys
          exact ⟨hx_mem 0, hx_mem 1⟩
    exact ⟨fun d => (h_ind (d 0 + d 1) d rfl).1, fun d => (h_ind (d 0 + d 1) d rfl).2⟩

  exact {
    C_mem := h_C_mem
    X_mem := h_X_mem
    add_mem := h_add_mem
    sub_mem := h_sub_mem
    mul_mem := h_mul_mem
    derivA_mem := h_derivA_mem
    derivD_mem := h_derivD_mem
    comp1D_mem := h_comp1D_mem
    comp2D_mem := h_comp2D_mem
    pos_of_deriv_mem := h_pos_of_deriv_mem
    inv_mem := h_inv_mem
    sqrt_mem := h_sqrt_mem
    mulVec_mem := h_mulVec_mem
    inv2D_mem := h_inv2D_mem
    coeff_comp1D_pert := h_coeff_comp1D_pert
    coeff_mul_pert := h_coeff_mul_pert
    vanishesBelow_mul := h_vanishesBelow_mul
    vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor := h_vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor
    coeff_pow_linear := h_coeff_pow_linear
  }

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hAlg
  have test_part1_alg : ∀ (K_pt : Subfield ℂ) (rad : Fin 6 → ℂ),
      (∀ r : Fin 6, IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (rad r)) →
      let K_end := Subfield.closure ((K_pt : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range rad)
      ∀ z : ℂ, IsAlgebraic (↥K_end) z → IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) z := by
    intro K_pt rad hrad_alg K_end
    have hK_le : K_pt ≤ K_end := fun w hw => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hw)
    let L_alg : Subfield ℂ :=
      { carrier := { w : ℂ | IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) w }
        mul_mem' := fun ha hb => IsAlgebraic.mul ha hb
        one_mem' := isAlgebraic_one
        add_mem' := fun ha hb => IsAlgebraic.add ha hb
        zero_mem' := isAlgebraic_zero
        neg_mem' := fun ha => IsAlgebraic.neg ha
        inv_mem' := fun _ ha => IsAlgebraic.inv ha }
    have hKend_le_Lalg : K_end ≤ L_alg := by
      apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
      rintro w (hwK | ⟨r, rfl⟩)
      · exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (⟨w, hwK⟩ : ↥K_pt)
      · exact hrad_alg r
    let _ : Algebra (↥K_pt) (↥K_end) := (Subfield.inclusion hK_le).toAlgebra
    have _ : IsScalarTower (↥K_pt) (↥K_end) ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
    have _ : Algebra.IsIntegral (↥K_pt) (↥K_end) := by
      refine Algebra.IsIntegral.mk fun y => ?_
      have hy_alg_C : IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (algebraMap (↥K_end) ℂ y) := hKend_le_Lalg y.2
      have hy_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) y :=
        (isAlgebraic_algebraMap_iff (R := ↥K_pt) (S := ↥K_end) (A := ℂ) (a := y)
          Subtype.val_injective).mp hy_alg_C
      exact isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mp hy_alg
    intro z hz
    exact isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mpr
      (isIntegral_trans (R := ↥K_pt) (A := ↥K_end) z (isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.mp hz))
  have test_part1_rad : ∀ (K_pt : Subfield ℂ) (l0 l1 p_val θ : ℂ),
      p_val ≠ 0 →
      l0 = Complex.cos θ / p_val →
      l1 = Complex.sin θ / p_val →
      l0 ∈ K_pt → l1 ∈ K_pt →
      IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) p_val ∧
      IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (Complex.cos (θ / 2)) ∧
      IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (Complex.sin (θ / 2)) := by
    intro K_pt l0 l1 p_val θ hp_ne hl0 hl1 hl0_mem hl1_mem
    let M : ℂ := l0 ^ 2 + l1 ^ 2
    have hM_mem : M ∈ K_pt := K_pt.add_mem (K_pt.pow_mem hl0_mem 2) (K_pt.pow_mem hl1_mem 2)
    have hl0p : l0 * p_val = Complex.cos θ := by rw [hl0, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp_ne]
    have hl1p : l1 * p_val = Complex.sin θ := by rw [hl1, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp_ne]
    have hMp2 : M * p_val ^ 2 = 1 := by
      calc M * p_val ^ 2
          = (l0 * p_val) ^ 2 + (l1 * p_val) ^ 2 := by dsimp [M]; ring
        _ = Complex.cos θ ^ 2 + Complex.sin θ ^ 2 := by rw [hl0p, hl1p]
        _ = 1 := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := by
      intro hM0
      rw [hM0, zero_mul] at hMp2
      exact zero_ne_one hMp2
    have hp_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) p_val := by
      let P : Polynomial (↥K_pt) := Polynomial.C ⟨M, hM_mem⟩ * Polynomial.X ^ 2 - 1
      refine ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hP0
        have hc0 : P.coeff 0 = 0 := by rw [hP0, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
        have hc : P.coeff 0 = -1 := by simp [P, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
        rw [hc] at hc0
        exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero hc0
      · simp only [P, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X]
        change M * p_val ^ 2 - 1 = 0
        rw [hMp2, sub_self]
    have h4_mem : (4 : ℂ) ∈ K_pt := natCast_mem K_pt 4
    have h4M_mem : 4 * M ∈ K_pt := K_pt.mul_mem h4_mem hM_mem
    have hb_mem : M - l0 ^ 2 ∈ K_pt := K_pt.sub_mem hM_mem (K_pt.pow_mem hl0_mem 2)
    let a_Q : ↥K_pt := ⟨4 * M, h4M_mem⟩
    let b_Q : ↥K_pt := ⟨M - l0 ^ 2, hb_mem⟩
    let Q : Polynomial (↥K_pt) :=
      Polynomial.C a_Q * Polynomial.X ^ 4 - Polynomial.C a_Q * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C b_Q
    have hQ_ne : Q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hQ0
      have hc0 : Q.coeff 4 = 0 := by rw [hQ0, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
      have hc : Q.coeff 4 = a_Q := by simp [Q, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
      rw [hc] at hc0
      have ha_ne : (a_Q : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hM_ne
      exact ha_ne (congr_arg Subtype.val hc0)
    have hM_cos_sq : M * Complex.cos θ ^ 2 = l0 ^ 2 := by
      calc M * Complex.cos θ ^ 2
          = M * (l0 * p_val) ^ 2 := by rw [hl0p]
        _ = l0 ^ 2 * (M * p_val ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = l0 ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [hMp2]
        _ = l0 ^ 2 := mul_one _
    have h_root_of_sq : ∀ u : ℂ, (2 * u ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 = Complex.cos θ ^ 2 →
        IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) u := by
      intro u hu
      refine ⟨Q, hQ_ne, ?_⟩
      simp only [Q, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X]
      change (4 * M) * u ^ 4 - (4 * M) * u ^ 2 + (M - l0 ^ 2) = 0
      calc (4 * M) * u ^ 4 - (4 * M) * u ^ 2 + (M - l0 ^ 2)
          = M * (2 * u ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 - l0 ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = M * Complex.cos θ ^ 2 - l0 ^ 2 := by rw [hu]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hM_cos_sq, sub_self]
    have h_cos_dbl : 2 * Complex.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1 = Complex.cos θ := by
      calc 2 * Complex.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1
          = Complex.cos (2 * (θ / 2)) := (Complex.cos_two_mul (θ / 2)).symm
        _ = Complex.cos θ := by congr 1; ring
    have h_cos_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (Complex.cos (θ / 2)) :=
      h_root_of_sq (Complex.cos (θ / 2)) (by rw [h_cos_dbl])
    have h_sin_alg : IsAlgebraic (↥K_pt) (Complex.sin (θ / 2)) := by
      apply h_root_of_sq (Complex.sin (θ / 2))
      have hcs := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ / 2)
      have h_sin_dbl : 2 * Complex.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1 = -Complex.cos θ := by
        linear_combination 2 * hcs - h_cos_dbl
      rw [h_sin_dbl, neg_sq]
    exact ⟨hp_alg, h_cos_alg, h_sin_alg⟩
  have iterDerivYT_zero_zero : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      iterDerivYT 0 0 f p = f p := by
    intro f p
    simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  have coeff_zero_taylor2D : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D f p₀) = f p₀ := by
    intro f p₀
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
    simp [taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  have coeff_zero_centeredTaylor2D : ∀ (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = 0 := by
    intro ψ p₀
    unfold centeredTaylor2D
    rw [coeff_zero_taylor2D, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨K_pt, hK_pt⟩ : ∃ K : Subfield ℂ, K = linePointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K_end, hK_end⟩ : ∃ K : Subfield ℂ, K = lineCoreEndpointField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hK_pt, ← hK_end]
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let q₁ : ℂ × ℂ := G.Ψ p₁
  let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := lineChainBox C B k
  let rad : Fin 6 → ℂ := lineCoreRadicals C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  have hKend_eq_closure : K_end = Subfield.closure ((K_pt : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range rad) := by
    rw [hK_end, lineCoreEndpointField, ← hK_pt]
  have hK_le : K_pt ≤ K_end := by
    rw [hKend_eq_closure]
    exact fun w hw => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hw)
  have hrad_mem : ∀ r : Fin 6, rad r ∈ K_end := by
    rw [hKend_eq_closure]
    exact fun r => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r, rfl⟩)
  have hjet_mem_Kpt : ∀ v : LineJetAll, lineJetFnAll C k v q₁ ∈ K_pt := by
    intro v
    rw [hK_pt]
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨v, rfl⟩)
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
  have hp₁_a : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_a := by
    rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [ha₁.1, ha₁.2, G.R_pos]
  have hp₁_d : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_d := by
    rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ₁.1]
    linarith [hδ₁.2, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hp₁ : p₁ ∈ U := ⟨hp₁_a, hp₁_d⟩
  have hΨ_maps_W₀ : ∀ p ∈ U, G.Ψ p ∈ W₀ :=
    fun p hp => G.V_W_sub (G.Ψ_maps_V_W p hp)
  have hq₁ : q₁ ∈ W₀ := hΨ_maps_W₀ p₁ hp₁
  let shift_k : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)
  have hshift_diff : Differentiable ℂ shift_k :=
