  have hp₀_q₁_mem : p₀_fn q₁ ∈ K_end := hrad_mem 0
  have hp_k_q₁_mem : p_k_fn q₁ ∈ K_end := hrad_mem 1
  obtain ⟨hp₀_tay_mem, hΘ₀_ctay_mem⟩ :=
    h_end_series Λ₀ p₀_fn Θ₀_fn hΛ₀_holo hΛ₀_tay_mem hp₀_holo hp₀_ne hp₀_q₁_mem hΘ₀_holo
      (fun q _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨hp_k_tay_mem, hΘ_k_ctay_mem⟩ :=
    h_end_series Λ_k p_k_fn Θ_k_fn hΛ_k_holo hΛ_k_tay_mem hp_k_holo hp_k_ne hp_k_q₁_mem hΘ_k_holo
      (fun q _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
  
  let f₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => Θ₀_fn q - Θ₀_fn q₁
  let f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => (Θ_k_fn q - Θ₀_fn q) - (Θ_k_fn q₁ - Θ₀_fn q₁)
  have hf₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ W₀ := hΘ₀_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)
  have hf₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ W₀ :=
    (hΘ_k_holo.sub hΘ₀_holo).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
  let Φ₁_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := taylor2D f₁ q₁
  let Φ₂_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := taylor2D f₂ q₁
  let Ψ₁_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (G.Ψ p).1) p₁
  let Ψ₂_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (G.Ψ p).2) p₁
  have hΦ₂_eq : Φ₂_ser = centeredTaylor2D Θ_k_fn q₁ - centeredTaylor2D Θ₀_fn q₁ := by
    change taylor2D f₂ q₁ =
      taylor2D (fun q => Θ_k_fn q - Θ_k_fn q₁) q₁ -
        taylor2D (fun q => Θ₀_fn q - Θ₀_fn q₁) q₁
    rw [← (hTay.taylor2D_ring hW₀_open hq₁
      (hΘ_k_holo.sub_const (Θ_k_fn q₁))
      (hΘ₀_holo.sub_const (Θ₀_fn q₁))).2.1]
    exact hTay.taylor2D_congr hW₀_open hq₁ fun q _ => by dsimp [f₂]; ring
  have hΦ₁_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end Φ₁_ser := hΘ₀_ctay_mem
  have hΦ₂_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end Φ₂_ser := by
    rw [hΦ₂_eq]
    exact hSub.sub_mem K_end hΘ_k_ctay_mem hΘ₀_ctay_mem
  have hΦ₁_c0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₁_ser = 0 := coeff_zero_centeredTaylor2D Θ₀_fn q₁
  have hΦ₂_c0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₂_ser = 0 :=
    coeff_zero_centeredTaylor2D (fun q => Θ_k_fn q - Θ₀_fn q) q₁
  have hΨ₁_c0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₁_ser = 0 :=
    coeff_zero_centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (G.Ψ p).1) p₁
  have hΨ₂_c0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₂_ser = 0 :=
    coeff_zero_centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (G.Ψ p).2) p₁
  have hcomp_Φ₁ : lineCoreComp2D Φ₁_ser Ψ₁_ser Ψ₂_ser = MvPowerSeries.X 0 := by
    have hcomp := hTay.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_open hW₀_open hp₁ G.Ψ_holo hf₁_holo hΨ_maps_W₀
    change taylor2D (fun p => f₁ (G.Ψ p)) p₁ = lineCoreComp2D Φ₁_ser Ψ₁_ser Ψ₂_ser at hcomp
    rw [← hcomp, ← hTay.centeredTaylor2D_fst p₁]
    refine hTay.taylor2D_congr hU_open hp₁ fun p hp => ?_
    change glancingTheta C (G.Ψ p).1 (G.Ψ p).2 - glancingTheta C (G.Ψ p₁).1 (G.Ψ p₁).2 =
      p.1 - p₁.1
    rw [(G.Φ_left_inv p hp).1, (G.Φ_left_inv p₁ hp₁).1]
  have hcomp_Φ₂ : lineCoreComp2D Φ₂_ser Ψ₁_ser Ψ₂_ser = MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
    have hcomp := hTay.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_open hW₀_open hp₁ G.Ψ_holo hf₂_holo hΨ_maps_W₀
    change taylor2D (fun p => f₂ (G.Ψ p)) p₁ = lineCoreComp2D Φ₂_ser Ψ₁_ser Ψ₂_ser at hcomp
    rw [← hcomp, ← hTay.centeredTaylor2D_snd p₁]
    refine hTay.taylor2D_congr hU_open hp₁ fun p hp => ?_
    change (glancingTheta C ((G.Ψ p).1 + (k : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p).2) (G.Ψ p).2 -
        glancingTheta C (G.Ψ p).1 (G.Ψ p).2) -
      (glancingTheta C ((G.Ψ p₁).1 + (k : ℂ) * (G.Ψ p₁).2) (G.Ψ p₁).2 -
        glancingTheta C (G.Ψ p₁).1 (G.Ψ p₁).2) = p.2 - p₁.2
    rw [(G.Φ_left_inv p hp).2, (G.Φ_left_inv p₁ hp₁).2]
  obtain ⟨hΨ₁_mem, hΨ₂_mem⟩ :=
    hSub.inv2D_mem K_end hΦ₁_c0 hΦ₂_c0 hΨ₁_c0 hΨ₂_c0 hΦ₁_mem hΦ₂_mem hcomp_Φ₁ hcomp_Φ₂
  
  have hp₀_Ψ_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end (taylor2D (fun p => p₀_fn (G.Ψ p)) p₁) := by
    rw [hTay.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_open hW₀_open hp₁ G.Ψ_holo hp₀_holo hΨ_maps_W₀]
    exact hSub.comp2D_mem K_end hp₀_tay_mem hΨ₁_c0 hΨ₂_c0 hΨ₁_mem hΨ₂_mem
  have hpk_Ψ_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end (taylor2D (fun p => p_k_fn (G.Ψ p)) p₁) := by
    rw [hTay.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_open hW₀_open hp₁ G.Ψ_holo hp_k_holo hΨ_maps_W₀]
    exact hSub.comp2D_mem K_end hp_k_tay_mem hΨ₁_c0 hΨ₂_c0 hΨ₁_mem hΨ₂_mem
  have hp₀_Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => p₀_fn (G.Ψ p)) U := by
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ (p₀_fn ∘ G.Ψ) U
    exact hp₀_holo.comp G.Ψ_holo hΨ_maps_W₀
  have hpk_Ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => p_k_fn (G.Ψ p)) U := by
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ (p_k_fn ∘ G.Ψ) U
    exact hp_k_holo.comp G.Ψ_holo hΨ_maps_W₀
  have hA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.A_line U := by
    let term : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i q =>
      2 * C.h_ℂ (lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i q) * Complex.sin (lineChartHalfStep C k G.Ψ i q)
    have hterm_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (term i) U := by
      intro i
      have hψ_eq : lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i =
          fun q => (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q +
            lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
        ext q
        simp [lineChartPsi, lineChainMid, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i) U := by
        rw [hψ_eq]
        exact ((G.α_holo i.castSucc).add (G.α_holo i.succ)).mul_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹
      have hh_ψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => C.h_ℂ (lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i q)) U := by
        change DifferentiableOn ℂ (C.h_ℂ ∘ lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i) U
        exact C.h_ℂ_holo.comp hψ_holo (G.ψ_maps_strip i)
      have hd_eq : lineChartHalfStep C k G.Ψ i =
          fun q => (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q -
            lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
        ext q
        simp [lineChartHalfStep, lineChainHalfStep, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (lineChartHalfStep C k G.Ψ i) U := by
        rw [hd_eq]
        exact ((G.α_holo i.succ).sub (G.α_holo i.castSucc)).mul_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹
      have hterm_eq : term i = fun q =>
          (2 * C.h_ℂ (lineChartPsi C k G.Ψ i q)) *
            Complex.sin (lineChartHalfStep C k G.Ψ i q) := rfl
      rw [hterm_eq]
      exact (hh_ψ_holo.const_mul 2).fun_mul hd_holo.csin
    have hA_eq : G.A_line = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, term i := by
      ext q
      exact (Finset.sum_apply q Finset.univ term).symm
    rw [hA_eq]
    exact DifferentiableOn.sum fun i _ => hterm_holo i
  have hderivA_A : lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D G.A_line p₁) =
      taylor2D (fun p => p_k_fn (G.Ψ p)) p₁ - taylor2D (fun p => p₀_fn (G.Ψ p)) p₁ := by
    rw [(hTay.deriv_taylor2D hU_open hp₁ hA_holo).1,
      ← (hTay.taylor2D_ring hU_open hp₁ hpk_Ψ_holo hp₀_Ψ_holo).2.1]
    exact hTay.taylor2D_congr hU_open hp₁ G.action_deriv_a
  have hderivD_A : lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D G.A_line p₁) =
      taylor2D (fun p => p_k_fn (G.Ψ p)) p₁ := by
    rw [(hTay.deriv_taylor2D hU_open hp₁ hA_holo).2]
    exact hTay.taylor2D_congr hU_open hp₁ G.action_deriv_d
  have hderivA_A_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end (lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D G.A_line p₁)) := by
    rw [hderivA_A]
    exact hSub.sub_mem K_end hpk_Ψ_mem hp₀_Ψ_mem
  have hderivD_A_mem : lineCoreCoeffsIn K_end (lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D G.A_line p₁)) := by
    rw [hderivD_A]
    exact hpk_Ψ_mem
  exact ⟨hAlgOverPt, hSub.pos_of_deriv_mem K_end hderivA_A_mem hderivD_A_mem⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (hTay : LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit)
    (hSub : LineCoreSubfieldSeriesToolkit)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ)
    (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (G.a₀ - G.R / 4) (G.a₀ + G.R / 4))
    (hδ₁ : δ₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 G.δ_star)
    (K_base : Subfield ℂ)
    (hActionPos : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d ≠ 0 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_line ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈ K_base) :
    (∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
      iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
        Subfield.closure ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁))) ∧
    (∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
        Subfield.closure ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁)))

(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (G : LineGlancingChartData C B k)
    (hTay : LineCoreTaylor2DToolkit)
    (hSub : LineCoreSubfieldSeriesToolkit)
    (a₁ δ₁ : ℝ)

    (K_base : Subfield ℂ)

      iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈

proof.tactics:
by
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let F_val : Subfield ℂ :=
    Subfield.closure ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁))
  let h_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i => lineCoreHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁)
  let S_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i => lineCoreHoloTaylor1D Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁)
  let C_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i => lineCoreHoloTaylor1D Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁)
  let s_d : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁)
  let c_d : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁)
  let α_ser : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun r => centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn r) p₁
  have h_idx2D : ∀ a b : ℕ, lineCoreIdx2D a b 0 = a ∧ lineCoreIdx2D a b 1 = b :=
    fun a b => by simp [lineCoreIdx2D]
  have h2_mem : (2 : ℂ) ∈ F_val := by
    rw [← one_add_one_eq_two]
    exact F_val.add_mem F_val.one_mem F_val.one_mem
  have h_half_mem : (1 / 2 : ℂ) ∈ F_val := F_val.div_mem F_val.one_mem h2_mem
  have h_nat_mem : ∀ m : ℕ, (m : ℂ) ∈ F_val := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp [F_val.zero_mem]
    | succ m ih => push_cast; exact F_val.add_mem ih F_val.one_mem
  
  have hHalfMem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) ∈ F_val ∧
      Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) ∈ F_val := by
    intro r
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (LineCoreIdx k)
    constructor
    · have h_eq : lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ (e (Sum.inl (r, false))) =
          Complex.cos (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) := by
        unfold lineCoreTuple
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inl (r, false)), rfl⟩)
    · have h_eq : lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ (e (Sum.inl (r, true))) =
          Complex.sin (G.α_fn r p₁ / 2) := by
        unfold lineCoreTuple
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨e (Sum.inl (r, true)), rfl⟩)
  have h_sd_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, s_d i ∈ F_val ∧ c_d i ∈ F_val := by
    intro i
    have h_dfn : G.d_fn i p₁ = G.α_fn i.succ p₁ / 2 - G.α_fn i.castSucc p₁ / 2 := by
      change (G.α_fn i.succ p₁ - G.α_fn i.castSucc p₁) / 2 = _
      exact sub_div _ _ _
    constructor
    · change Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val
      rw [h_dfn, Complex.sin_sub]
      exact F_val.sub_mem
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).2 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).1)
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).1 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).2)
    · change Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val
      rw [h_dfn, Complex.cos_sub]
      exact F_val.add_mem
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).1 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).1)
        (F_val.mul_mem (hHalfMem i.succ).2 (hHalfMem i.castSucc).2)
  have hCoreJets : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ), m ≤ max 2 k →
      PowerSeries.coeff m (h_ser i) ∈ F_val := by
    intro i m hm
    let e := Fintype.equivFin (LineCoreIdx k)
    let idx := e (Sum.inr (i, ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm⟩))
    have h_eq : lineCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁ idx = iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) := by
      unfold lineCoreTuple
      rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    have h_iter_mem : iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val := by
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨idx, rfl⟩)
    change PowerSeries.coeff m (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁)) ∈ F_val
    rw [lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact F_val.div_mem h_iter_mem (h_nat_mem m.factorial)
  
  have h_deriv_taylor1D : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
      PowerSeries.derivative (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g z₀) =
        lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (deriv g) z₀ := by
    intro g z₀
    ext n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
    simp only [lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ']
    have hn1 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
    have hnf : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
    field_simp
  have hS_c0 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (S_ser i) = s_d i := by
    intro i; simp [S_ser, s_d, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D]
  have hS_c1 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 1 (S_ser i) = c_d i := by
    intro i; simp [S_ser, c_d, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, Complex.deriv_sin]
  have hC_c0 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (C_ser i) = c_d i := by
    intro i; simp [C_ser, c_d, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D]
  have hC_c1 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 1 (C_ser i) = -s_d i := by
    intro i; simp [C_ser, s_d, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, Complex.deriv_cos]
  have hS_deriv : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.derivative (S_ser i) = C_ser i := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [S_ser, C_ser]
    rw [h_deriv_taylor1D, Complex.deriv_sin]
  have h_deriv_cos_eq : deriv Complex.cos = -Complex.sin :=
    funext fun _ => Complex.deriv_cos
  have hSC_mem : ∀ (i : Fin k) (n : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff n (S_ser i) ∈ F_val ∧ PowerSeries.coeff n (C_ser i) ∈ F_val := by
    intro i
    have h_iter : ∀ n : ℕ,
        iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val ∧
        iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁) ∈ F_val := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_sd_mem i
      | succ n ih =>
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', Complex.deriv_sin, iteratedDeriv_succ', h_deriv_cos_eq,
            iteratedDeriv_neg]
          exact ⟨ih.2, F_val.neg_mem ih.1⟩
    intro n
    dsimp only [S_ser, C_ser]
    rw [lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact ⟨F_val.div_mem (h_iter n).1 (h_nat_mem n.factorial),
      F_val.div_mem (h_iter n).2 (h_nat_mem n.factorial)⟩
  
  have h_coeff0_comp : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (V : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (compPowerSeries2D f V) = PowerSeries.coeff 0 f := by
    intro f V
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
    simp [compPowerSeries2D]
  have h_comp_trunc1D : ∀ (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (V : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 + d 1 ≤ K →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (lcJetTrunc1D K f) V) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f V) := by
    intro K f V d hd
    simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, compPowerSeries2D]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
    have hmK : m ≤ K := by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hm; omega
    simp [lcJetTrunc1D, hmK]
  have h_comp_deriv_trunc1D : ∀ (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (V : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
      (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 + d 1 ≤ K →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (lcJetTrunc1D (K + 1) f)) V) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) V) := by
    intro K f V d hd
    simp only [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, compPowerSeries2D]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
    have hmK : m + 1 ≤ K + 1 := by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hm; omega
    simp [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, lcJetTrunc1D, hmK]
  have h_vb_zero : ∀ X : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, lineCoreVanishesBelow 0 X :=
    fun _ _ hd => absurd hd (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  have h_vb_add : ∀ {N : ℕ} {X Y : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

          let H_mat := lcJetFormalHess h_ser s_d c_d

            have h1R := hCoreJets ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ 1 (by omega)
            have h2R := F_val.mul_mem h2_mem

            have hcL := (h_sd_mem ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩).2

            have h_entry_split : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1),

                  (if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then U_val * x_vec s else 0) +
                  (if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then L_val * x_vec s else 0) := by
              intro s

                ⟨fun h => (congr_arg Fin.val h).symm, fun h => Fin.ext h.symm⟩

  have hVandStep : ∀ (M : ℕ), max 2 k < M →

        · intro i hi
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
          exact ⟨⟨i.1 - 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext (by dsimp; omega)⟩
        · intro r _; rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, h_sum1, h_sum2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
      dsimp only [lcJetGrad2D, E_plus_low, E_minus_low]
      rw [add_mul]
    have h_grad_low_vb : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_trunc r) := by
      intro r
      have h_diff_vb : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1)
          (lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_ser r -
            lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_trunc r) := by
        have h_prod_vb : ∀ (A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
            lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (A₁ - A₂) →
            lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (B₁ - B₂) →
            lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (A₁ * B₁ - A₂ * B₂) := by
          intro A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ hA hB
          have h_id : A₁ * B₁ - A₂ * B₂ = (A₁ - A₂) * B₁ + A₂ * (B₁ - B₂) := by ring
          rw [h_id]
          have h1 : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) ((A₁ - A₂) * B₁) := by
            simpa using hSub.vanishesBelow_mul hA (h_vb_zero B₁)
          have h2 : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (A₂ * (B₁ - B₂)) := by
            simpa using hSub.vanishesBelow_mul (h_vb_zero A₂) hB
          exact h_vb_add h1 h2
        have h_mid_vb : ∀ i : Fin k,
            lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (lcJetMid2D α_ser i - lcJetMid2D α_trunc i) := by
          intro i
          have h_eq : lcJetMid2D α_ser i - lcJetMid2D α_trunc i = lcJetMid2D Δ i := by
            ext u; simp only [lcJetMid2D, Δ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_add, map_sub]; ring
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_vb_C_mul _ (h_vb_add (hΔ_vb i.castSucc) (hΔ_vb i.succ))
        have h_step_vb : ∀ i : Fin k,
            lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1)
              (lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i - lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i) := by
          intro i
          have h_eq : lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i - lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i =
              lcJetHalfStep2D Δ i := by
            ext u
            simp only [lcJetHalfStep2D, Δ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_sub]
            ring
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_vb_C_mul _ (h_vb_sub (hΔ_vb i.succ) (hΔ_vb i.castSucc))
        let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
        let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
        have h_rew :
            lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_ser r -
              lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_trunc r =
            ((compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (h_low i_L)) (lcJetMid2D α_ser i_L) *
                compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i_L) -
              compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (h_low i_L)) (lcJetMid2D α_trunc i_L) *
                compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i_L)) +
             (compPowerSeries2D (h_low i_L) (lcJetMid2D α_ser i_L) *
                compPowerSeries2D (C_ser i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i_L) -
              compPowerSeries2D (h_low i_L) (lcJetMid2D α_trunc i_L) *
                compPowerSeries2D (C_ser i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i_L))) +
            ((compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (h_low i_R)) (lcJetMid2D α_ser i_R) *
                compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i_R) -
              compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (h_low i_R)) (lcJetMid2D α_trunc i_R) *
                compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i_R)) -
             (compPowerSeries2D (h_low i_R) (lcJetMid2D α_ser i_R) *
                compPowerSeries2D (C_ser i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_ser i_R) -
              compPowerSeries2D (h_low i_R) (lcJetMid2D α_trunc i_R) *
                compPowerSeries2D (C_ser i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D α_trunc i_R))) := by
          unfold lcJetGrad2D lcJetEdgePlus2D lcJetEdgeMinus2D
          dsimp only
          ring
        rw [h_rew]
        exact h_vb_add
          (h_vb_add
            (h_prod_vb _ _ _ _ (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_mid_vb i_L))
              (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_step_vb i_L)))
            (h_prod_vb _ _ _ _ (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_mid_vb i_L))
              (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_step_vb i_L))))
          (h_vb_sub
            (h_prod_vb _ _ _ _ (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_mid_vb i_R))
              (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_step_vb i_R)))
            (h_prod_vb _ _ _ _ (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_mid_vb i_R))
              (h_vb_comp_sub _ _ _ _ (h_step_vb i_R))))
      have h_ser_vb : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_ser r) := by
        intro u hu
        have h_prod_eq : ∀ (A₁ A₂ B_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
            (∀ w : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, w 0 + w 1 < M - 1 →
              MvPowerSeries.coeff w A₁ = MvPowerSeries.coeff w A₂) →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff u (A₁ * B_ser) = MvPowerSeries.coeff u (A₂ * B_ser) := by
          intro A₁ A₂ B_ser hA
          have hvbA : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) (A₁ - A₂) := by
            intro w hw; rw [map_sub, hA w hw, sub_self]
          have hvbP : lineCoreVanishesBelow (M - 1) ((A₁ - A₂) * B_ser) := by
            simpa using hSub.vanishesBelow_mul hvbA (h_vb_zero B_ser)
          have h0 := hvbP u hu
          rw [sub_mul, map_sub] at h0
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
        have h_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff u (lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_ser r) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff u (lcJetGrad2D h_ser S_ser C_ser α_ser r) := by
          unfold lcJetGrad2D lcJetEdgePlus2D lcJetEdgeMinus2D
          simp only [map_add, map_sub]
          have hM1 : (M - 2) + 1 = M - 1 := by omega
          congr 1
          · congr 1
            · exact h_prod_eq _ _ _ (fun w hw => by
                dsimp only [h_low]
                rw [← hM1]
                exact h_comp_deriv_trunc1D (M - 2) (h_ser _) _ w (by omega))
            · exact h_prod_eq _ _ _ (fun w hw =>
                h_comp_trunc1D (M - 1) (h_ser _) _ w (by omega))
          · congr 1
            · exact h_prod_eq _ _ _ (fun w hw => by
                dsimp only [h_low]
                rw [← hM1]
                exact h_comp_deriv_trunc1D (M - 2) (h_ser _) _ w (by omega))
            · exact h_prod_eq _ _ _ (fun w hw =>
                h_comp_trunc1D (M - 1) (h_ser _) _ w (by omega))
        rw [h_eq, hGrad_tay r, map_zero]
      intro u hu
      have h1 := h_ser_vb u hu
      have h2 := h_diff_vb u hu
      rw [map_sub] at h2
      linear_combination h1 - h2
    have h_env_cancel : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 = M →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_ser) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_trunc) := by
      intro d hdM
      have h_rem_sum : MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_ser - lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_trunc -
            ∑ i : Fin k, (E_plus_low i * Δ i.succ + E_minus_low i * Δ i.castSucc)) = 0 := by
        unfold lcJetAction2D
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, map_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => h_edge_taylor i d (by omega)
      have h_grad_sum : MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
            lcJetGrad2D h_low S_ser C_ser α_trunc r *
              Δ ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
        have hvb := hSub.vanishesBelow_mul (h_grad_low_vb r)
          (hΔ_vb ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
        exact hvb d (by omega)
      rw [h_sbp] at h_rem_sum
      simp only [map_sub] at h_rem_sum
      linear_combination h_rem_sum + h_grad_sum
    
    let ψ_a : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) (ψ_ser i)
    let ψ_d : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) (ψ_ser i)
    let ρ : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => ψ_d i / ψ_a i
    have hψ_ad_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, ψ_a i ∈ F_val ∧ ψ_d i ∈ F_val := by
      intro i
      have h10 : lineCoreIdx2D 1 0 0 + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0 1 ≤ M - 2 := by
        rw [(h_idx2D 1 0).1, (h_idx2D 1 0).2]; omega
      have h01 : lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 0 + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 1 ≤ M - 2 := by
        rw [(h_idx2D 0 1).1, (h_idx2D 0 1).2]; omega
      dsimp only [ψ_a, ψ_d, ψ_ser, lcJetMid2D]
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_add, map_add]
      exact ⟨F_val.mul_mem h_half_mem
          (F_val.add_mem (hAngLow i.castSucc _ h10) (hAngLow i.succ _ h10)),
        F_val.mul_mem h_half_mem
          (F_val.add_mem (hAngLow i.castSucc _ h01) (hAngLow i.succ _ h01))⟩
    have hρ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, ρ i ∈ F_val :=
      fun i => F_val.div_mem (hψ_ad_mem i).2 (hψ_ad_mem i).1
    let V_mat : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ := (Matrix.vandermonde ρ)ᵀ
    let x_jet : Fin k → ℂ :=
      fun i => 2 * s_d i * (ψ_a i) ^ M * PowerSeries.coeff M (h_ser i)
    let d_idx : Fin k → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := fun ν => lineCoreIdx2D (M - ν.1) ν.1
    let b_jet : Fin k → ℂ := fun ν =>
      (MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (lcJetAction2D h_ser S_ser α_ser) -
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_trunc)) /
        (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ)
    have hV_mem : ∀ ν i : Fin k, V_mat ν i ∈ F_val := by
      intro ν i
      change (ρ i) ^ ν.1 ∈ F_val
      exact F_val.pow_mem (hρ_mem i) ν.1
    have hV_det : V_mat.det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
      exact Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hρ_inj
    have hb_jet_mem : ∀ ν : Fin k, b_jet ν ∈ F_val := by
      intro ν
      have hd_deg : d_idx ν 0 + d_idx ν 1 = M := by
        dsimp only [d_idx]
        rw [(h_idx2D _ _).1, (h_idx2D _ _).2]
        have := ν.2; omega
      have hd_ne : d_idx ν ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        rw [h0] at hd_deg
        simp at hd_deg
        omega
      exact F_val.div_mem
        (F_val.sub_mem (hActF (d_idx ν) hd_ne) (h_act_tr_mem (d_idx ν)))
        (h_nat_mem (M.choose ν.1))
    have hVx_eq : V_mat.mulVec x_jet = b_jet := by
      ext ν
      have hν_le : ν.1 ≤ M := by have := ν.2; omega
      have hd_deg : d_idx ν 0 + d_idx ν 1 = M := by
        dsimp only [d_idx]
        rw [(h_idx2D _ _).1, (h_idx2D _ _).2]
        omega
      have hchoose_ne : (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos hν_le))
      have h_pow_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) ((ψ_ser i) ^ M) =
            (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ) * (ψ_a i) ^ M * (ρ i) ^ ν.1 := by
        intro i
        rw [hSub.coeff_pow_linear (by omega : 1 ≤ M) hν_le (hψ_c0 i)]
        have h_pow_split : (ψ_a i) ^ M = (ψ_a i) ^ (M - ν.1) * (ψ_a i) ^ ν.1 := by
          rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hν_le]
        have hψa_pow_ne : (ψ_a i) ^ ν.1 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero ν.1 (hψa_ne i)
        have h_rho_pow : (ψ_a i) ^ ν.1 * (ρ i) ^ ν.1 = (ψ_d i) ^ ν.1 := by
          dsimp only [ρ]
          rw [div_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hψa_pow_ne]
        rw [h_pow_split]
        dsimp only [ψ_a, ψ_d] at h_rho_pow ⊢
        calc (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) (ψ_ser i)) ^ (M - ν.1) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) (ψ_ser i)) ^ ν.1
            = (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) (ψ_ser i)) ^ (M - ν.1) *
              ((MvPowerSeries.coeff (lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) (ψ_ser i)) ^ ν.1 * (ρ i) ^ ν.1) := by
              rw [h_rho_pow]
          _ = _ := by ring
      have h_sum_eq :
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (lcJetAction2D h_ser S_ser α_ser) -
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (lcJetAction2D h_low S_ser α_trunc) =
          (M.choose ν.1 : ℂ) * (V_mat.mulVec x_jet) ν := by
        rw [h_act_split (d_idx ν) hd_deg, h_env_cancel (d_idx ν) hd_deg, add_sub_cancel_left]
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, V_mat, Matrix.transpose_apply,
          Matrix.vandermonde_apply, x_jet, Finset.mul_sum, h_pow_eq]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        ring
      dsimp only [b_jet]
      rw [h_sum_eq, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hchoose_ne]
    have hx_jet_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, x_jet i ∈ F_val :=
      hSub.mulVec_mem F_val hV_mem hV_det hb_jet_mem hVx_eq
    intro i
    let denom : ℂ := 2 * s_d i * (ψ_a i) ^ M
    have hdenom_mem : denom ∈ F_val :=
      F_val.mul_mem (F_val.mul_mem h2_mem (h_sd_mem i).1) (F_val.pow_mem (hψ_ad_mem i).1 M)
    have hdenom_ne : denom ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (h_sd_ne i)) (pow_ne_zero M (hψa_ne i))
    have h_div : x_jet i / denom = PowerSeries.coeff M (h_ser i) :=
      mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hdenom_ne
    rw [← h_div]
    exact F_val.div_mem (hx_jet_mem i) hdenom_mem
  
  have hAllCoeff : ∀ (M : ℕ) (i : Fin k), PowerSeries.coeff M (h_ser i) ∈ F_val := by
    intro M
    induction M using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h M ih =>
        by_cases hM : M ≤ max 2 k
        · exact fun i => hCoreJets i M hM
        · exact hVandStep M (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hM) (fun i m hm => ih m hm i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i m
    have hm_coeff : iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) / (m.factorial : ℂ) ∈ F_val := by
      simpa [h_ser, lineCoreHoloTaylor1D] using hAllCoeff m i
    have hmf_ne : (m.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
    have h_eq : iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) / (m.factorial : ℂ) * (m.factorial : ℂ) =
        iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hmf_ne
    rw [← h_eq]
    exact F_val.mul_mem hm_coeff (h_nat_mem m.factorial)
  · intro r d
    exact hStatRec (d 0 + d 1) (fun i m _ => hAllCoeff m i) r d le_rfl

line_core_vandermonde_jet_and_angle_elim.definitions:
noncomputable def lcJetMid2D {k : ℕ}
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (β i.castSucc + β i.succ)

noncomputable def lcJetHalfStep2D {k : ℕ}
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (β i.succ - β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def lcJetAction2D {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser S_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (2 : ℂ) *
      compPowerSeries2D (h_ser i) (lcJetMid2D β i) *
      compPowerSeries2D (S_ser i) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i)

noncomputable def lcJetEdgePlus2D
    (h_i S_i C_i : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (ψ_i d_i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative h_i) ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D S_i d_i +
    compPowerSeries2D h_i ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D C_i d_i

noncomputable def lcJetEdgeMinus2D
    (h_i S_i C_i : PowerSeries ℂ)
    (ψ_i d_i : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative h_i) ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D S_i d_i -
    compPowerSeries2D h_i ψ_i * compPowerSeries2D C_i d_i

noncomputable def lcJetGrad2D {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser S_ser C_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  lcJetEdgePlus2D (h_ser i_L) (S_ser i_L) (C_ser i_L)
      (lcJetMid2D β i_L) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i_L) +
    lcJetEdgeMinus2D (h_ser i_R) (S_ser i_R) (C_ser i_R)
      (lcJetMid2D β i_R) (lcJetHalfStep2D β i_R)

noncomputable def lcJetFormalHess {k : ℕ}
    (h_ser : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (s_d c_d : Fin k → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let h0_L := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (h_ser i_L)
    let h1_L := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (h_ser i_L)
    let h2_L := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (h_ser i_L)
    let h0_R := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (h_ser i_R)
    let h1_R := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (h_ser i_R)
    let h2_R := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (h_ser i_R)
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      ((h2_L - h0_L) / 2 * s_d i_L + h1_L * c_d i_L) +
        ((h2_R - h0_R) / 2 * s_d i_R - h1_R * c_d i_R)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      (h0_R + h2_R) / 2 * s_d i_R
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      (h0_L + h2_L) / 2 * s_d i_L
    else
      0

noncomputable def lcJetTrunc1D (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m => if m ≤ K then PowerSeries.coeff m f else 0

noncomputable def lcJetTruncAngles {k : ℕ} (N₀ : ℕ)
    (α : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun u =>
    if r.1 = 0 ∨ r.1 = k then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (α r)
    else if u 0 + u 1 < N₀ then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (α r)
    else 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hOpenStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hConvStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H
    have hEq : horizStrip H = Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      ext s
      change |s.im| < H ↔ -H < Complex.imLm s ∧ Complex.imLm s < H
      rw [Complex.imLm_coe, abs_lt]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (convex_Ioo (-H) H).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
  have hMemTauSeg : ∀ (σ τ c : ℝ) (z H : ℂ),
      τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) →
      z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
      z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
      z + (c : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ τ c z H _hτ hc hA hB'
    have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - τ - c := by linarith [hc.2]
    have hb : 0 ≤ c + τ := by linarith [hc.1]
    have hab : (1 - τ - c) + (c + τ) = 1 := by ring
    have hmem := hConvStrip σ hA hB' ha hb hab
    have hlin :

    have hMC_nn : 0 ≤ M_G * skrCompConst p B :=
      mul_nonneg hM_G (le_trans zero_le_one (hOneLeComp p B))
    have hIntBnd : IsSkrStripBnd p σ' (M_G * skrCompConst p B)
        (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) :=
      (hParamIntBndAny p σ' (M_G * skrCompConst p B) F hMC_nn hF_cont hF_bnd).1
    have hTerm₂_int : IsSkrStripBnd p σ' ((2 : ℝ) ^ p * Δf * (M_G * skrCompConst p B))
        (fun z => (f₁ z - f₂ z) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z) :=
      hBndMul hdf_diff hIntBnd
    have hFTC : Set.EqOn
        (fun z => G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₂ z))
        (fun z => (G₁ (f₁ z) - G₂ (f₁ z)) +
          (f₁ z - f₂ z) * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F t z)
        (horizStrip σ') := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp only
      have hSeg : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => G₂ (φ s z)) ((f₁ z - f₂ z) * F t z) t := by
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
        have hφ_eq : (fun s : ℝ => φ s z) =
            (fun s : ℝ => f₂ z + (s : ℂ) * (f₁ z - f₂ z)) := by
          ext s; dsimp [φ]; push_cast; ring
        have hφ_at : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => φ s z) (f₁ z - f₂ z) t := by
          rw [hφ_eq]
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) t :=
            (hasDerivAt_id t).ofReal_comp
          have hmul : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ) * (f₁ z - f₂ z)) (f₁ z - f₂ z) t := by
            simpa only [one_mul] using h1.mul_const (f₁ z - f₂ z)
          exact hmul.const_add (f₂ z)
        have hG₂_at : HasDerivAt G₂ (deriv G₂ (φ t z)) (φ t z) :=
          (hG₂.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds (hφ_maps t ht z hz))).hasDerivAt
        have hcomp := hG₂_at.scomp t hφ_at
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, smul_eq_mul, F] using hcomp
      have hIntegrable :
          IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (f₁ z - f₂ z) * F t z)
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont z hz)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
      have hint_eq := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hSeg hIntegrable
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hint_eq
      have hφ1 : φ 1 z = f₁ z := by simp [φ]
      have hφ0 : φ 0 z = f₂ z := by simp [φ]
      rw [hφ1, hφ0] at hint_eq
      rw [hint_eq]
      ring
    have hSum := hBndAdd hTerm₁ hTerm₂_int
    have hConstEq :
        ΔG * skrCompConst p B + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * Δf * (M_G * skrCompConst p B) =
          skrCompConst p B * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ p * M_G * Δf) := by ring
    rw [hConstEq] at hSum
    exact hBndCongr hSum hFTC
  have hCompParamCont : ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ' : ℝ) (V : Set ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen V →
      0 < σ' →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
      (∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (f α) (horizStrip σ') ∧ ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', f α z ∈ V) →
      (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv r (f α) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ p → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ContinuousOn (fun α => iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ => G (f α ζ)) z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro p
    induction p with
    | zero =>
      intro σ' V G f _hV_open _hσ' hG hf_holo hf_cont k hk z hz
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      exact hG.continuousOn.comp (hf_cont 0 le_rfl z hz)
        (fun α hα => (hf_holo α hα).2 z hz)
    | succ p ih =>
      intro σ' V G f hV_open hσ' hG hf_holo hf_cont k hk z hz
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero]
        exact hG.continuousOn.comp (hf_cont 0 (Nat.zero_le _) z hz)
          (fun α hα => (hf_holo α hα).2 z hz)
      | succ m =>
        have hm : m ≤ p := Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.mp hk
        have hSumCont :
            ContinuousOn
              (fun α : ℝ =>
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
                  (m.choose i : ℂ) *
                    iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => deriv G (f α ζ)) z *
                    iteratedDeriv (m - i + 1) (f α) z)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          refine continuousOn_finsetSum (Finset.range (m + 1)) ?_
          intro i hi
          have him : i ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
          have hip : i ≤ p := le_trans him hm
          have hmip : m - i + 1 ≤ p + 1 := by omega
          have h1 : ContinuousOn
              (fun α => iteratedDeriv i (fun ζ => deriv G (f α ζ)) z)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            ih σ' V (deriv G) f hV_open hσ' (hG.deriv hV_open) hf_holo
              (fun r hr w hw => hf_cont r (Nat.le_succ_of_le hr) w hw) i hip z hz
          have h2 : ContinuousOn
              (fun α => iteratedDeriv (m - i + 1) (f α) z)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            hf_cont (m - i + 1) hmip z hz
          exact (continuousOn_const.mul h1).mul h2
        refine hSumCont.congr ?_
        intro α hα
        dsimp only
        have hEqDeriv : Set.EqOn
            (deriv (fun ζ => G (f α ζ)))
            (fun ζ => deriv G (f α ζ) * deriv (f α) ζ)
            (horizStrip σ') := by
          intro ζ hζ
          have hG_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ G (f α ζ) :=
            hG.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds ((hf_holo α hα).2 ζ hζ))
          have hf_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (f α) ζ :=
            (hf_holo α hα).1.differentiableAt ((hOpenStrip σ').mem_nhds hζ)
          exact (hG_at.hasDerivAt.comp ζ hf_at.hasDerivAt).deriv
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ',
          (hEqDeriv.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hOpenStrip σ').mem_nhds hz)).iteratedDeriv_eq m]
        have hc₁ : ContDiffAt ℂ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => deriv G (f α ζ)) z :=
          hContDiffAt m ((hG.deriv hV_open).comp (hf_holo α hα).1 (hf_holo α hα).2) hz
        have hc₂ : ContDiffAt ℂ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (deriv (f α)) z :=
          hContDiffAt m ((hf_holo α hα).1.deriv (hOpenStrip σ')) hz
        rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hc₁ hc₂]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro i _hi
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ']
  exact {
    horizStrip_open_convex := fun H => ⟨hOpenStrip H, hConvStrip H⟩
    mem_horizStrip_of_tau_seg := hMemTauSeg
    stripExt_deriv_props := hStripExtDeriv
    stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le := hStripDiffSup
    bnd_const := hBndConst
    bnd_mono := hBndMono
    bnd_add := hBndAdd
    bnd_sub := hBndSub
    bnd_neg := hBndNeg
    bnd_const_mul := hBndConstMul
    bnd_mul := hBndMul
    bnd_mul_diff := hBndMulDiff
    exp_ball_bnd := hExpBall
    cos_ball_bnd := hCosBall
    sin_ball_bnd := hSinBall
    comp_bnd := hCompBnd
    comp_diff_bnd := hCompDiffBnd
    comp_param_cont := hCompParamCont
    param_int_bnd := fun p σ' B F _hσ' hB hCont hF =>
      hParamIntBndAny p σ' B F hB hCont hF
    param_int_cont := hParamIntCont
  }

proof.tactics:
by
  have huIcc01 : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
  have hIntSub1 : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ),
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (1 - x)) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x := by
    intro f
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left]
    norm_num
  have hDeltaSwap : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ),
      deltaPhi_ℂ W ζ₁ ζ₂ = -deltaPhi_ℂ W ζ₂ ζ₁ := by
    intro W ζ₁ ζ₂
    unfold deltaPhi_ℂ
    have hInt :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁)))) =
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (ζ₂ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₁ - ζ₂))) := by
      rw [← hIntSub1 (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.exp (W (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁))))]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hInt]
    ring
  have hPlusEqMinus : ∀ (W : ℂ → ℂ) (Y μ z : ℂ),
      cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z = cellKernelMinus_ℂ W Y μ z := by
    intro W Y μ z
    unfold cellKernelPlus_ℂ cellKernelMinus_ℂ
    have hCos : Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W z Y) = Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W Y z) := by
      rw [hDeltaSwap W z Y, Complex.cos_neg]
    have hBeta :
        (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)) Y) *
              Complex.exp (-2 * W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)))) =
          -∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W Y (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) *
              Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) := by
      rw [← hIntSub1 (fun β : ℝ =>
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ)) Y) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (μ + (β : ℂ) * (z - μ))))]
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun β _ => ?_)
      have hpt : μ + ((1 - β : ℝ) : ℂ) * (z - μ) = z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hpt, hDeltaSwap W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z)) Y, Complex.sin_neg, neg_mul]
    rw [hCos, hBeta]
    ring
  have hStripOpen : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ) := by
    intro σ
    exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hStripConv : ∀ σ : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip σ) := by
    intro σ
    have hEq : horizStrip σ = (Complex.imLm : ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-σ) σ := by
      ext s
      simp [horizStrip, abs_lt]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (convex_Ioo (-σ) σ).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
  have hStripChord : ∀ (σ : ℝ) {ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ} {t : ℝ},
      ζ₁ ∈ horizStrip σ → ζ₂ ∈ horizStrip σ → t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      ζ₁ + (t : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ ζ₁ ζ₂ t h₁ h₂ ht
    have hmem := (hStripConv σ) h₁ h₂ (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) ht.1 (by ring)
    have hsmul : (1 - t) • ζ₁ + t • ζ₂ = ζ₁ + (t : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁) := by
      rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul]
      push_cast
      ring
    rwa [hsmul] at hmem
  have hStripTauSeg : ∀ (σ τ c : ℝ) {z H : ℂ},
      c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) →
      z - (τ : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
      z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ →
      z + (c : ℂ) * H ∈ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ τ c z H hc hX hμ
    have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - τ - c := by linarith [hc.2]
    have hb : 0 ≤ c + τ := by linarith [hc.1]
    have hab : (1 - τ - c) + (c + τ) = 1 := by ring
    have hmem := (hStripConv σ) hX hμ ha hb hab
    have hsmul :
        (1 - τ - c) • (z - (τ : ℂ) * H) + (c + τ) • (z + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) =
          z + (c : ℂ) * H := by
      rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.real_smul]
      push_cast
      ring
    rwa [hsmul] at hmem
  have hDiagPeriodic : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (z + 2 * Real.pi) = W z) →
      ∀ X Y μ z : ℂ,
        X ∈ horizStrip σ → Y ∈ horizStrip σ → μ ∈ horizStrip σ → z ∈ horizStrip σ →
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (X + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X μ z ∧
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W (Y + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
          cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y μ z := by
    intro σ W _ hW_per X Y μ z hX hY hμ hz
    have hDeltaPer : ∀ {ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ},
        ζ₁ ∈ horizStrip σ → ζ₂ ∈ horizStrip σ →
        deltaPhi_ℂ W (ζ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) (ζ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) = deltaPhi_ℂ W ζ₁ ζ₂ := by
      intro ζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₁ hζ₂
      unfold deltaPhi_ℂ
      have hdiff : (ζ₂ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) - (ζ₁ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) = ζ₂ - ζ₁ := by ring
      rw [hdiff]
      congr 1
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ hθ => ?_)
      rw [huIcc01] at hθ
      have hw_mem : ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁) ∈ horizStrip σ := hStripChord σ hζ₁ hζ₂ hθ
      have hpt : (ζ₁ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁) =
          (ζ₁ + (θ : ℂ) * (ζ₂ - ζ₁)) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [hpt, hW_per _ hw_mem]
    have hMinusPer : ∀ {A : ℂ}, A ∈ horizStrip σ →
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (A + 2 * Real.pi) (μ + 2 * Real.pi) (z + 2 * Real.pi) =
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W A μ z := by
      intro A hA
      unfold cellKernelMinus_ℂ
      have hdiff : (μ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) - (z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) = μ - z := by ring
      rw [hDeltaPer hA hz, hW_per z hz, hdiff]
      congr 1
      congr 1
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun β hβ => ?_)
      rw [huIcc01] at hβ
      have hw_mem : z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z) ∈ horizStrip σ := hStripChord σ hz hμ hβ
      have hpt : (z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z) =
          (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z)) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
      rw [hpt, hDeltaPer hA hw_mem, hW_per _ hw_mem]
    refine ⟨hMinusPer hX, ?_⟩
    rw [hPlusEqMinus, hPlusEqMinus]
    exact hMinusPer hY
  have hRescaleFTC : ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ}, Continuous f → ∀ (a b : ℝ),
      (b - a) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (a + t * (b - a))) = ∫ ζ in a..b, f ζ := by
    intro f hf a b
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ∫ ζ in a..u, f ζ
    have hF_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (f u) u := fun u =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (hf.intervalIntegrable a u)
        (hf.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds u))
        hf.continuousAt
    have hComp : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (a + s * (b - a))) (f (a + t * (b - a)) * (b - a)) t := by
      intro t _
      have hAff : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a + s * (b - a)) (b - a) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (b - a)).const_add a
      exact (hF_deriv (a + t * (b - a))).comp t hAff
    have hCont' : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => f (a + s * (b - a)) * (b - a)) :=
      (hf.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).mul continuous_const
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hComp (hCont'.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const] at hFTC
    have hb1 : a + (1 : ℝ) * (b - a) = b := by ring
    have ha0 : a + (0 : ℝ) * (b - a) = a := by ring
    have hFa : F a = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
    rw [hb1, ha0, hFa, sub_zero] at hFTC
    linarith
  have hRealEq : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < σ →
      ContDiff ℝ (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) w →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x) →
      ∀ X Y z : ℝ,
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W X (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X Y z ∧
        cellKernelPlus_ℂ W Y (midpoint_ℝ w X Y) z = cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X Y z := by
    intro σ w W _ hw _ hW_real X Y z
    have hw_cont : Continuous w := hw.continuous
    have hf_exp_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => Real.exp (w ζ)) :=
      Real.continuous_exp.comp hw_cont
    have hPrimDeriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt (primPhi_ℝ w) (Real.exp (w u)) u := fun u =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (hf_exp_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 u)
        (hf_exp_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds u))
        hf_exp_cont.continuousAt
    have hPrimCont : Continuous (primPhi_ℝ w) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun u => (hPrimDeriv u).continuousAt)
    have hPrimDiff : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        (∫ ζ in a..b, Real.exp (w ζ)) = primPhi_ℝ w b - primPhi_ℝ w a := fun a b =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun u _ => hPrimDeriv u) (hf_exp_cont.intervalIntegrable a b)
    have hDeltaReal : ∀ a b : ℝ,
        deltaPhi_ℂ W (a : ℂ) (b : ℂ) = ((primPhi_ℝ w b - primPhi_ℝ w a : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro a b
      unfold deltaPhi_ℂ
      have hInt :
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              Complex.exp (W ((a : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * ((b : ℂ) - (a : ℂ))))) =
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((Real.exp (w (a + θ * (b - a))) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
        have hpt : (a : ℂ) + (θ : ℂ) * ((b : ℂ) - (a : ℂ)) = ((a + θ * (b - a) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [hpt, hW_real, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
      rw [hInt, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
      rw [← hPrimDiff a b, ← hRescaleFTC hf_exp_cont a b]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hMinusReal : ∀ A B : ℝ,
        cellKernelMinus_ℂ W (A : ℂ) ((midpoint_ℝ w A B : ℝ) : ℂ) (z : ℂ) =
          ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w A B z : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro A B
      set μ : ℝ := midpoint_ℝ w A B
      let g_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w A) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)
      have hg_cont : Continuous g_R :=
        (Real.continuous_sin.comp (hPrimCont.sub continuous_const)).mul
          (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul hw_cont))
      unfold cellKernelMinus_ℂ cellKernelMinus_ℝ
      have hBetaInt :
          (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (A : ℂ) ((z : ℂ) + (β : ℂ) * ((μ : ℂ) - (z : ℂ)))) *
                Complex.exp (-2 * W ((z : ℂ) + (β : ℂ) * ((μ : ℂ) - (z : ℂ))))) =
            ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((g_R (z + β * (μ - z)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun β _ => ?_)
        have hpt : (z : ℂ) + (β : ℂ) * ((μ : ℂ) - (z : ℂ)) = ((z + β * (μ - z) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        dsimp only [g_R]
        rw [hpt, hDeltaReal A (z + β * (μ - z)), hW_real]
        have hexp : (-2 : ℂ) * (w (z + β * (μ - z)) : ℂ) =
            ((-2 * w (z + β * (μ - z)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [hexp, ← Complex.ofReal_sin, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
      rw [hDeltaReal A z, hW_real z, hBetaInt, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
      have hFTC_g : (∫ ζ in z..μ, g_R ζ) = (μ - z) * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, g_R (z + β * (μ - z)) :=
        (hRescaleFTC hg_cont z μ).symm
      change _ =
        ((2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w A)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z) -

      calc 2 * (u₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 2 + u₁ ^ 2 * skrRCos2 u₁)) * ew_inv ^ 2
          = (ew * ew_inv) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * H ^ 2 * (1 + H * rI₁) ^ 2 +
              2 * H ^ 4 * (τ : ℂ) ^ 4 * ew ^ 2 * I₁ ^ 4 * skrRCos2 u₁) := by
                dsimp only [u₁, I₁]; ring
        _ = (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * H ^ 2 +
              H ^ 3 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 *
                (2 * H * (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ew ^ 2 * I₁ ^ 4 * skrRCos2 u₁ + (I₁ + 1) * rI₁)) := by
                rw [hew_mul]; dsimp only [I₁]; ring
    
    let γ_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun β => τ + β * (1 - τ)
    let sw₂ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun β θ => skrSlopeW W z (θ * γ_fn β - τ) H
    let rI₂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun β => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, sw₂ β θ * skrExp1 (H * sw₂ β θ)
    have hc₂_mem : ∀ {β θ : ℝ},
        β ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        θ * γ_fn β - τ ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) := by
      intro β θ hβ hθ
      have hγ0 : 0 ≤ γ_fn β := by dsimp only [γ_fn]; nlinarith [hτ.1, hτ.2, hβ.1]
      have hγ1 : γ_fn β ≤ 1 := by dsimp only [γ_fn]; nlinarith [hτ.2, hβ.2]
      refine ⟨by nlinarith [hθ.1, hγ0], by nlinarith [hθ.2, hγ0, hγ1]⟩
    have hc_b_mem : ∀ {β : ℝ},
        β ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → β * (1 - τ) ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) := by
      intro β hβ
      refine ⟨by nlinarith [hτ.1, hτ.2, hβ.1], by nlinarith [hτ.2, hβ.2]⟩
    have hsw₂_uncurry_cont :
        ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sw₂ p.1 p.2 * skrExp1 (H * sw₂ p.1 p.2))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      have hsw₂_c : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => sw₂ p.1 p.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
        have hAff : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 * (τ + p.1 * (1 - τ)) - τ) :=
          (continuous_snd.mul (continuous_const.add (continuous_fst.mul continuous_const))).sub
            continuous_const
        exact hSlopeCont.comp hAff.continuousOn (fun p hp => hc₂_mem hp.1 hp.2)
      exact hsw₂_c.mul (hCont_skrExp1.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul hsw₂_c))
    have hrI₂_cont : ContinuousOn rI₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hContOn_int01 hsw₂_uncurry_cont
    have hRem2_cont : ContinuousOn (fun β : ℝ => skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      have hγ_c : ContinuousOn (fun β : ℝ => (γ_fn β : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).continuousOn
      have hI₂_c : ContinuousOn (fun β : ℝ => 1 + H * rI₂ β) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul hrI₂_cont)
      have hu₂_c : ContinuousOn (fun β : ℝ => (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        ((hγ_c.mul continuousOn_const).mul continuousOn_const).mul hI₂_c
      have hrs_c : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β)) ^ 2 *
            skrRSinc ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β)))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (((hγ_c.mul continuousOn_const).mul hI₂_c).pow 2).mul
          (hCont_skrRSinc.comp_continuousOn hu₂_c)
      have hS₂_c : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => 1 + H ^ 2 * (((γ_fn β : ℂ) * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β)) ^ 2 *
            skrRSinc ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β))))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul hrs_c)
      have hswb_c : ContinuousOn (fun β : ℝ => -2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.mul
          (hSlopeCont.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).continuousOn
            (fun _ hβ => hc_b_mem hβ))
      have hrE₂_c : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => (-2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H) *
            skrExp1 (H * (-2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H)))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hswb_c.mul (hCont_skrExp1.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul hswb_c))
      have hE₂_c : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => 1 + H * ((-2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H) *
            skrExp1 (H * (-2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H))))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul hrE₂_c)
      have hH_rs_c : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => H * (((γ_fn β : ℂ) * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β)) ^ 2 *
            skrRSinc ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β))))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.mul hrs_c
      exact hγ_c.mul
        ((((hrI₂_cont.mul hS₂_c).mul hE₂_c).add (hH_rs_c.mul hE₂_c)).add hrE₂_c)
    have hBetaIntegrand : ∀ {β : ℝ}, β ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z))) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z))) =
          H * ew * ew_inv ^ 2 * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) + H * skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z) := by
      intro β hβ
      set w_β : ℂ := z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z)
      have hw_β_eq : w_β = z + ((β * (1 - τ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H := by
        dsimp only [w_β, μ_pt]; push_cast; ring
      have hDelta2 : deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt w_β = (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β) := by
        unfold deltaPhi_ℂ
        have hdiff : w_β - X_pt = (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H := by
          rw [hw_β_eq]; dsimp only [X_pt, γ_fn]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hdiff]
        have hg₂_cont : ContinuousOn (fun θ : ℝ => sw₂ β θ * skrExp1 (H * sw₂ β θ))
            (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          rw [huIcc01]
          exact hsw₂_uncurry_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
            (fun _ hθ => ⟨hβ, hθ⟩)
        have hInt :
            (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (X_pt + (θ : ℂ) * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H)))) =
              ew * (1 + H * rI₂ β) := by
          have hCongr :
              (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (W (X_pt + (θ : ℂ) * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H)))) =
                ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, ew * (1 + H * (sw₂ β θ * skrExp1 (H * sw₂ β θ))) := by
            refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ hθ => ?_)
            rw [huIcc01] at hθ
            have hpt : X_pt + (θ : ℂ) * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H) =
                z + ((θ * γ_fn β - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H := by
              dsimp only [X_pt]; push_cast; ring
            dsimp only [sw₂]
            have hexp1 := hExpSlope (1 : ℂ) (hc₂_mem hβ hθ)
            simp only [one_mul] at hexp1
            rw [hpt, hexp1]
          rw [hCongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
            intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
              (hg₂_cont.const_mul H).intervalIntegrable,
            intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          simp only [sub_zero, one_smul]
          rfl
        rw [hInt]
        ring
      let I₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rI₂ β
      let u₂ : ℂ := (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * I₂
      let rs : ℂ := ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * ew * I₂) ^ 2 * skrRSinc u₂
      let S₂ : ℂ := 1 + H ^ 2 * rs
      let sw_b : ℂ := -2 * skrSlopeW W z (β * (1 - τ)) H
      let rE₂ : ℂ := sw_b * skrExp1 (H * sw_b)
      let E₂ : ℂ := 1 + H * rE₂
      have hSin2 : Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt w_β) = (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * I₂ * S₂ := by
        rw [hDelta2]
        change Complex.sin u₂ = (γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * I₂ * S₂
        rw [hTay_sin u₂, hTay_skrSinc u₂]
        dsimp only [u₂, S₂, rs]
        ring
      have hExp2 : Complex.exp (-2 * W w_β) = ew_inv ^ 2 * E₂ := by
        rw [hw_β_eq, hExpSlope (-2 : ℂ) (hc_b_mem hβ), hew_inv_sq]
      rw [hSin2, hExp2]
      change ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * H * ew * I₂ * S₂) * (ew_inv ^ 2 * E₂) =
        H * ew * ew_inv ^ 2 *
          ((γ_fn β : ℂ) + H * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) * (rI₂ β * S₂ * E₂ + H * rs * E₂ + rE₂)))
      dsimp only [I₂, S₂, E₂]
      ring
    have hInt_γ : (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, (γ_fn β : ℂ)) = (((1 + τ) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
      have hDeriv : ∀ β ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => τ * s + (1 - τ) * (s ^ 2 / 2)) (γ_fn β) β := by
        intro β _
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => τ * s) (τ * 1) β := (hasDerivAt_id β).const_mul τ
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (1 - τ) * (s ^ 2 / 2))
            ((1 - τ) * (((2 : ℝ) * β ^ (2 - 1)) / 2)) β :=
          ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 β).div_const 2).const_mul (1 - τ)
        convert h1.add h2 using 1
        dsimp only [γ_fn]
        ring
      have hCont : Continuous γ_fn :=
        continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)
      have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hDeriv (hCont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [hFTC]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hTerm2 :
        Complex.exp (W z) * (μ_pt - z) *
          (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z))) *
              Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z)))) =
          (((1 - τ) * ((1 + τ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 +
            H ^ 3 * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z) := by
      have hCongr :
          (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z))) *
                Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z)))) =
            ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
              H * ew * ew_inv ^ 2 * ((γ_fn β : ℂ) + H * skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun β hβ => ?_)
        rw [huIcc01] at hβ
        exact hBetaIntegrand hβ
      have hγ_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun β : ℝ => (γ_fn β : ℂ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.mul continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable 0 1
      have hRem2_int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun β : ℝ => H * skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
        refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
        rw [huIcc01]
        exact continuousOn_const.mul hRem2_cont
      rw [hCongr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add hγ_int hRem2_int,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hInt_γ]
      have hμ_diff : μ_pt - z = ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H := by dsimp only [μ_pt]; ring
      rw [hμ_diff]
      change ew * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) *
        (H * ew * ew_inv ^ 2 *
          ((((1 + τ) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + H * ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z)) = _
      set J₂ : ℂ := ∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1, skrKerRem2Integrand W τ β H z
      calc ew * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H) *
            (H * ew * ew_inv ^ 2 * ((((1 + τ) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + H * J₂))
          = (ew * ew_inv) ^ 2 *
              ((((1 - τ) * ((1 + τ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 +
                H ^ 3 * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * J₂)) := by
                push_cast; ring
        _ = (((1 - τ) * ((1 + τ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * H ^ 2 +
              H ^ 3 * (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * J₂) := by
                rw [hew_mul]; ring
    change 2 * (1 - Complex.cos (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt z)) * Complex.exp (-2 * W z) -
        Complex.exp (W z) * (μ_pt - z) *
          (∫ β in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W X_pt (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z))) *
              Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ_pt - z)))) = _
    rw [hTerm1, hTerm2]
    unfold skrKerRem
    push_cast
    ring
  exact ⟨hPlusEqMinus, hRealEq, hDiagPeriodic, hFactorEq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S)
    (hCalc : SkrCalcToolkit) :
    Nonempty (SkrHalfStepSystem m M S H_inv)

signature.name: strip_half_step_comp_system
signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (S : StationaryMeshSystem m (M + 1))
    (H_inv : StripHalfCellInvSystem m M S)
    (hCalc : SkrCalcToolkit) :
    Nonempty (SkrHalfStepSystem m M S H_inv)

proof.tactics:
by
  let N_step : ℕ := max H_inv.N_inv (Nat.ceil H_inv.C_inv + 4)
  let C_step : ℝ :=
    skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv) + 1
  have hComp_ge_one : 1 ≤ skrCompConst m 2 := by
    cases m with
    | zero => exact le_rfl
    | succ p => exact le_max_left _ _
  have hComp_pos : 0 < skrCompConst m 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hComp_ge_one
  have hR_pos : 0 < S.R_mesh := S.R_mesh_pos
  have hCinv_pos : 0 < H_inv.C_inv := H_inv.C_inv_pos
  have h2m_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ m := pow_pos (by norm_num) m
  have hFactor_ge_one : 1 ≤ 1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv := by
    have hmul : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h2m_pos) (le_of_lt hCinv_pos)
    linarith
  have hProd_pos :
      0 < skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv) :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hComp_pos (by linarith)) (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hFactor_ge_one)
  have hC_step_pos : 0 < C_step := by
    dsimp [C_step]
    linarith
  have hSingle_le_C_step : (2 * S.R_mesh) * skrCompConst m 2 ≤ C_step := by
    have h1 :
        (2 * S.R_mesh) * skrCompConst m 2 ≤
          skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv) := by
      have hcomm :
          (2 * S.R_mesh) * skrCompConst m 2 = skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * 1 := by
        ring
      rw [hcomm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFactor_ge_one
        (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hComp_pos) (by linarith))
    dsimp [C_step]
    linarith
  have hNormHalf : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [norm_div, norm_one, Complex.norm_ofNat]
  have hOuterSingle :
      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        1 ≤ (q : ℝ) →
        IsStripMeshExt m (M + 1) S σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ →
        ∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
          let σ_mesh := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
          IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (fun ξ => (μ_ℂ j ξ - X_ℂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
          IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh (2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2)
            (fun ξ => (X_ℂ (j + 1) ξ - μ_ℂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    intro σ q w W X_ℂ μ_ℂ hq_ge_one hMesh j hj
    dsimp only
    let σ_mesh : ℝ := (1 - S.K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ
    have hq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hq_ge_one
    have hq_sq_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
    have hq2_le_q3 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
      calc (q : ℝ) ^ 2 = (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (q : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_ge_one (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by ring
    have hXj_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
      (hMesh.2.1 j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)).1
    have hXj1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ (j + 1)) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
      (hMesh.2.1 (j + 1) hj).1
    have hμj_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip σ_mesh) :=
      (hMesh.2.2 j hj).1
    let Δu : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ =>
      (X_ℂ (j + 1) ξ - X_ℂ j ξ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let m_disp : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ =>
      μ_ℂ j ξ - (X_ℂ j ξ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ξ - X_ℂ j ξ) / 2)
    let B₀ : ℝ := S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    have hB₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ := div_nonneg (le_of_lt hR_pos) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hΔu_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh B₀ Δu := by
      refine ⟨(hXj1_holo.sub hXj_holo).sub_const _, ?_⟩
      intro k hk z hz
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hq_sq_pos, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq2_le_q3 (norm_nonneg _))
        ((hMesh.2.2 j hj).2.2.2.2.2.1 k hk z hz)
    have hm_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh B₀ m_disp := by
      refine ⟨hμj_holo.sub (hXj_holo.add ((hXj1_holo.sub hXj_holo).div_const (2 : ℂ))), ?_⟩
      intro k hk z hz
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hq_sq_pos, mul_comm]
      exact (hMesh.2.2 j hj).2.2.2.2.2.2 k hk z hz
    have hHalf_Δu : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh (‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ * B₀)
        (fun ξ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu ξ) :=
      hCalc.bnd_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ) hB₀_nonneg hΔu_bnd
    have hB_le : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ * B₀ + B₀ ≤ 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hNormHalf]
      have h2B₀ : 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 * B₀ := by
        dsimp [B₀]
        ring
      rw [h2B₀]
      linarith
    have hEq_m :
        (fun ξ : ℂ => (μ_ℂ j ξ - X_ℂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun ξ : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu ξ + m_disp ξ) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [Δu, m_disp]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hEq_p :
        (fun ξ : ℂ => (X_ℂ (j + 1) ξ - μ_ℂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun ξ : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu ξ - m_disp ξ) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [Δu, m_disp]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hEq_m, hEq_p]
    exact ⟨hCalc.bnd_mono hB_le (hCalc.bnd_add hHalf_Δu hm_bnd),

      refine ⟨(hμj₁_holo.sub (hXj₁_holo.add ((hXj1₁_holo.sub hXj₁_holo).div_const (2 : ℂ)))).sub
        (hμj₂_holo.sub (hXj₂_holo.add ((hXj1₂_holo.sub hXj₂_holo).div_const (2 : ℂ)))), ?_⟩
      intro r hr w' hw'
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hq_sq_pos, mul_comm]
      exact hMeshLip.2.2 j hj r hr w' hw'
    have hHalf_Δu_diff : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh (‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ * B_Δ)
        (fun ξ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu_diff ξ) :=
      hCalc.bnd_const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ) hB_Δ_nonneg hΔu_diff_bnd
    let ΔG : ℝ := 2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    have hΔG_nonneg : 0 ≤ ΔG :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hΔW_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hB_Δ_le : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ * B_Δ + B_Δ ≤ ΔG := by
      rw [hNormHalf]
      have h2B : ΔG = 2 * B_Δ := by
        dsimp [ΔG, B_Δ]
        ring
      rw [h2B]
      linarith
    let g_m₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => (μ_ℂ₁ j ξ - X_ℂ₁ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let g_m₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => (μ_ℂ₂ j ξ - X_ℂ₂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let g_p₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ξ - μ_ℂ₁ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let g_p₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ξ - μ_ℂ₂ j ξ) - ((Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hEq_gm_diff :
        (fun ξ : ℂ => g_m₁ ξ - g_m₂ ξ) =
          (fun ξ : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu_diff ξ + m_diff ξ) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [g_m₁, g_m₂, Δu_diff, m_diff]
      ring
    have hEq_gp_diff :
        (fun ξ : ℂ => g_p₁ ξ - g_p₂ ξ) =
          (fun ξ : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Δu_diff ξ - m_diff ξ) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [g_p₁, g_p₂, Δu_diff, m_diff]
      ring
    have hgm_diff_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh ΔG (fun ξ => g_m₁ ξ - g_m₂ ξ) := by
      rw [hEq_gm_diff]
      exact hCalc.bnd_mono hB_Δ_le (hCalc.bnd_add hHalf_Δu_diff hm_diff_bnd)
    have hgp_diff_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd (m + 2) σ_mesh ΔG (fun ξ => g_p₁ ξ - g_p₂ ξ) := by
      rw [hEq_gp_diff]
      exact hCalc.bnd_mono hB_Δ_le (hCalc.bnd_sub hHalf_Δu_diff hm_diff_bnd)
    obtain ⟨hgm₁_bnd, hgp₁_bnd⟩ := hOuterSingle σ q w₁ W₁ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ hq_ge_one hMesh₁ j hj
    obtain ⟨hgm₂_bnd, hgp₂_bnd⟩ := hOuterSingle σ q w₂ W₂ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ hq_ge_one hMesh₂ j hj
    obtain ⟨hxm₁_holo, hxp₁_holo, hMaps₁, _, _, _, hInvBnd₁⟩ := (hInv₁ j hj).1 α hα
    obtain ⟨hxm₂_holo, hxp₂_holo, hMaps₂, _, _, _, hInvBnd₂⟩ := (hInv₂ j hj).1 α hα
    have hxm₁_deriv :
        ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ‖iteratedDeriv r (xInvMinus₁ j α) z‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro r hr1 hrm z hz
      exact hInnerDerivBnd σ_inv q (xInvMinus₁ j α) _ hq_sq_pos hCinv_div_le hxm₁_holo
        (fun r' hr' w' hw' => (hInvBnd₁ r' hr' w' hw').1) r hr1 (by omega) z hz
    have hxm₂_deriv :
        ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ‖iteratedDeriv r (xInvMinus₂ j α) z‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro r hr1 hrm z hz
      exact hInnerDerivBnd σ_inv q (xInvMinus₂ j α) _ hq_sq_pos hCinv_div_le hxm₂_holo
        (fun r' hr' w' hw' => (hInvBnd₂ r' hr' w' hw').1) r hr1 (by omega) z hz
    have hxp₁_deriv :
        ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ‖iteratedDeriv r (xInvPlus₁ j α) z‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro r hr1 hrm z hz
      exact hInnerDerivBnd σ_inv q (xInvPlus₁ j α) _ hq_sq_pos hCinv_div_le hxp₁_holo
        (fun r' hr' w' hw' => (hInvBnd₁ r' hr' w' hw').2) r hr1 (by omega) z hz
    have hxp₂_deriv :
        ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ_inv,
          ‖iteratedDeriv r (xInvPlus₂ j α) z‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro r hr1 hrm z hz
      exact hInnerDerivBnd σ_inv q (xInvPlus₂ j α) _ hq_sq_pos hCinv_div_le hxp₂_holo
        (fun r' hr' w' hw' => (hInvBnd₂ r' hr' w' hw').2) r hr1 (by omega) z hz
    have hInvLip := H_inv.inv_lip σ q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂
      xInvMinus₁ xInvPlus₁ xInvMinus₂ xInvPlus₂ hσ hNinv_le_q hKinv_lt
      ⟨hw₁, hW₁, hMesh₁, hInv₁⟩ ⟨hw₂, hW₂, hMesh₂, hInv₂⟩ j hj α hα
    let Δf : ℝ := H_inv.C_inv * ΔW / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    have hΔf_nonneg : 0 ≤ Δf :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hCinv_pos) hΔW_nonneg) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hxm_diff_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd m σ_inv Δf
        (fun z => xInvMinus₁ j α z - xInvMinus₂ j α z) := by
      refine ⟨hxm₁_holo.sub hxm₂_holo, ?_⟩
      intro r hr z hz
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hq_sq_pos, mul_comm]
      exact (hInvLip r (by omega) z hz).1
    have hxp_diff_bnd : IsSkrStripBnd m σ_inv Δf
        (fun z => xInvPlus₁ j α z - xInvPlus₂ j α z) := by
      refine ⟨hxp₁_holo.sub hxp₂_holo, ?_⟩
      intro r hr z hz
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hq_sq_pos, mul_comm]
      exact (hInvLip r (by omega) z hz).2
    let M_G : ℝ := 2 * S.R_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
    have hMG_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_G := div_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hCompDiff_m := hCalc.comp_diff_bnd m σ_inv M_G ΔG 2 Δf (horizStrip σ_mesh)
      g_m₁ g_m₂ (xInvMinus₁ j α) (xInvMinus₂ j α)
      hOpen_mesh hConv_mesh hMG_nonneg hΔG_nonneg (by norm_num) hΔf_nonneg
      hgm₁_bnd.1 hgm₂_bnd.1
      (fun r hr w' hw' => hgm_diff_bnd.2 r (by omega) w' hw')
      (fun r hr w' hw' => hgm₂_bnd.2 r (by omega) w' hw')
      hxm₁_holo hxm₂_holo
      (fun z hz => (hMaps₁ z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hMaps₂ z hz).1)
      hxm₁_deriv hxm₂_deriv hxm_diff_bnd
    have hCompDiff_p := hCalc.comp_diff_bnd m σ_inv M_G ΔG 2 Δf (horizStrip σ_mesh)
      g_p₁ g_p₂ (xInvPlus₁ j α) (xInvPlus₂ j α)
      hOpen_mesh hConv_mesh hMG_nonneg hΔG_nonneg (by norm_num) hΔf_nonneg
      hgp₁_bnd.1 hgp₂_bnd.1
      (fun r hr w' hw' => hgp_diff_bnd.2 r (by omega) w' hw')
      (fun r hr w' hw' => hgp₂_bnd.2 r (by omega) w' hw')
      hxp₁_holo hxp₂_holo
      (fun z hz => (hMaps₁ z hz).2) (fun z hz => (hMaps₂ z hz).2)
      hxp₁_deriv hxp₂_deriv hxp_diff_bnd
    have hΔf_le : Δf ≤ H_inv.C_inv * ΔW :=
      div_le_self (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hCinv_pos) hΔW_nonneg) hq_sq_ge_one
    have hLipScale :
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (skrCompConst m 2 * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * M_G * Δf)) ≤ C_step * ΔW := by
      have hqΔG : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ΔG = 2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW := by
        dsimp [ΔG]
        rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq_sq_pos)]
      have hqMG : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * M_G = 2 * S.R_mesh := by
        dsimp [M_G]
        rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hq_sq_pos)]
      have hExpand :
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (skrCompConst m 2 * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * M_G * Δf)) =
            skrCompConst m 2 *
              (2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * Δf) := by
        calc (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * (skrCompConst m 2 * (ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * M_G * Δf))
            = skrCompConst m 2 *
                ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ΔG + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * M_G) * Δf) := by ring
          _ = skrCompConst m 2 *
                (2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * Δf) := by
                rw [hqΔG, hqMG]
      rw [hExpand]
      have hStep1 :
          skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * Δf) ≤
            skrCompConst m 2 *
              (2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (H_inv.C_inv * ΔW)) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt hComp_pos)
        have hmul :
            (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * Δf ≤
              (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (H_inv.C_inv * ΔW) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔf_le
            (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt h2m_pos) (by linarith))
        linarith
      have hStep2 :
          skrCompConst m 2 *
              (2 * S.R_mesh * ΔW + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (H_inv.C_inv * ΔW)) =
            (skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv)) * ΔW := by
        ring
      have hStep3 :
          (skrCompConst m 2 * (2 * S.R_mesh) * (1 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * H_inv.C_inv)) * ΔW ≤
            C_step * ΔW := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hΔW_nonneg
        dsimp [C_step]
        linarith
      exact le_trans hStep1 (by rw [hStep2]; exact hStep3)
    intro k hk z hz
    have hfn_m :
        (fun ζ : ℂ =>
          (μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₁ j (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ)) -
            (μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ) - X_ℂ₂ j (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ))) =
          (fun ζ : ℂ => g_m₁ (xInvMinus₁ j α ζ) - g_m₂ (xInvMinus₂ j α ζ)) := by
      ext ζ
      dsimp [g_m₁, g_m₂]
      ring
    have hfn_p :
        (fun ζ : ℂ =>
          (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₁ j (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ)) -
            (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ) - μ_ℂ₂ j (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ))) =
          (fun ζ : ℂ => g_p₁ (xInvPlus₁ j α ζ) - g_p₂ (xInvPlus₂ j α ζ)) := by
      ext ζ
      dsimp [g_p₁, g_p₂]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hfn_m]
      exact le_trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCompDiff_m.2 k hk z hz) (sq_nonneg _))
        hLipScale
    · rw [hfn_p]
      exact le_trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCompDiff_p.2 k hk z hz) (sq_nonneg _))
        hLipScale
