signature.statement:
(m : ℕ) (M B_H : ℝ)
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hM : 0 < M) (hBH : 0 < B_H)
    (hCalc : SkrCalcToolkit) (hPt : SkrPointwiseProp) :
    Nonempty (SkrReducedKernelSystem m M B_H)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hStripSub : ∀ {σ' σ : ℝ}, σ' ≤ σ → horizStrip σ' ⊆ horizStrip σ := by
    intro σ' σ hle z hz
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz hle
  have hZeroMem : ∀ {σ' : ℝ}, 0 < σ' → (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ' := by
    intro σ' hσ'
    change |(0 : ℂ).im| < σ'
    simpa using hσ'
  have hBndPt : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} {f : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', ‖f z‖ ≤ B := by
    intro p σ' B f hf z hz
    simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hf.2 0 (Nat.zero_le p) z hz
  have hBndCongr : ∀ {p : ℕ} {σ' B : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → ℂ},
      Set.EqOn f g (horizStrip σ') → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B f → IsSkrStripBnd p σ' B g := by
    intro p σ' B f g hEq hf
    have hOpen : IsOpen (horizStrip σ') := (hCalc.horizStrip_open_convex σ').1
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun z hz => (hEq hz).symm), ?_⟩
    intro k hk z hz
    have hEv : g =ᶠ[nhds z] f := hEq.symm.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOpen.mem_nhds hz)
    rw [hEv.iteratedDeriv_eq k]
    exact hf.2 k hk z hz
  have hCompConstGeOne : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 1 ≤ skrCompConst p B := by
    intro p B
    cases p with
    | zero => simp [skrCompConst]
    | succ p' => exact le_max_left _ _
  have hCompConstNonneg : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ skrCompConst p B :=
    fun p B => le_trans zero_le_one (hCompConstGeOne p B)
  have hIdDerivLe : ∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℂ), 1 ≤ j → ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ) z‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro j z hj
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', deriv_id'', iteratedDeriv_const]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hShiftDerivLe : ∀ {σ' a : ℝ} {H : ℂ → ℂ},
      |a| ≤ 1 → IsSkrStripBnd m σ' 1 H →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => ζ + (a : ℂ) * H ζ) (horizStrip σ') ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ => ζ + (a : ℂ) * H ζ) z‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro σ' a H ha hH
    have hOpen : IsOpen (horizStrip σ') := (hCalc.horizStrip_open_convex σ').1
    refine ⟨differentiableOn_id.add ((differentiableOn_const (a : ℂ)).mul hH.1), ?_⟩
    intro j hj1 hjm z hz
    have hcdId : ContDiffAt ℂ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ) z := contDiffAt_id
    have hcdH : ContDiffAt ℂ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) H z :=
      (hH.1.contDiffOn hOpen).contDiffAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hz)
    have hcdMul : ContDiffAt ℂ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun ζ => (a : ℂ) * H ζ) z :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul hcdH
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add hcdId hcdMul, iteratedDeriv_const_mul (a : ℂ) hcdH]
    have h1 := hIdDerivLe j z hj1
    have h2 := hH.2 j hjm z hz
    have ha_norm : ‖(a : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha
    calc ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ) z + (a : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j H z‖
        ≤ ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ) z‖ + ‖(a : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv j H z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖iteratedDeriv j (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ) z‖ + ‖(a : ℂ)‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv j H z‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 * 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (iteratedDeriv j H z)]
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  have hTauSeg : ∀ {τ c η : ℝ},
      τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) → η ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      |c| ≤ 1 ∧ η * c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) ∧ |η * c| ≤ 1 := by
    intro τ c η hτ hc hη
    have hc_abs : |c| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.2, hc.1], by linarith [hτ.1, hc.2]⟩
    have hηc_mem : η * c ∈ Set.Icc (-τ) (1 - τ) := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 c with hc0 | hc0
      · exact ⟨by nlinarith [hτ.1, hη.1], by nlinarith [hη.2, hc.2]⟩
      · exact ⟨by nlinarith [hc.1, hη.2], by nlinarith [hη.1, hτ.2]⟩
    have hηc_abs : |η * c| ≤ 1 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hτ.2, hηc_mem.1], by linarith [hτ.1, hηc_mem.2]⟩
    exact ⟨hc_abs, hηc_mem, hηc_abs⟩
  have hNormInt01 : ∀ {C : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℂ},
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖f t‖ ≤ C) → ‖∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t‖ ≤ C := by
    intro C f hf
    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (C := C)
      (f := f) (fun t ht => by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
        exact hf t ⟨le_of_lt ht.1, ht.2⟩)
    simpa using h
  have hParamIntSub : ∀ {σ' L : ℝ} {F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < σ' → 0 ≤ L →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ContinuousOn (fun t => F₁ t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t => F₂ t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IsSkrStripBnd m σ' L (fun z => F₁ t z - F₂ t z)) →
      IsSkrStripBnd m σ' L
        (fun z => (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F₁ t z) - (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F₂ t z)) := by
    intro σ' L F₁ F₂ hσ' hL hCont hDiff
    have hInt := (hCalc.param_int_bnd m σ' L (fun t z => F₁ t z - F₂ t z) hσ' hL
      (fun z hz => (hCont z hz).1.sub (hCont z hz).2) hDiff).1
    refine hBndCongr (fun z hz => ?_) hInt
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => F₁ t z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hCont z hz).1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => F₂ t z) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hCont z hz).2.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2

  
  
  
  let PairBnd (σ' Δ B L : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
    IsSkrStripBnd m σ' B f₁ ∧
    IsSkrStripBnd m σ' B f₂ ∧
    IsSkrStripBnd m σ' (L * Δ) (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z)
  have hPairCongr : ∀ {σ' Δ B L : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      Set.EqOn f₁ g₁ (horizStrip σ') → Set.EqOn f₂ g₂ (horizStrip σ') →
      PairBnd σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ → PairBnd σ' Δ B L g₁ g₂ := by
    intro σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hEq1 hEq2 hP
    exact ⟨hBndCongr hEq1 hP.1, hBndCongr hEq2 hP.2.1,
      hBndCongr (fun z hz => by simp [hEq1 hz, hEq2 hz]) hP.2.2⟩
  have hPairConst : ∀ {σ' Δ : ℝ} (c : ℂ),
      PairBnd σ' Δ ‖c‖ 0 (fun _ => c) (fun _ => c) := by
    intro σ' Δ c
    refine ⟨hCalc.bnd_const m σ' c, hCalc.bnd_const m σ' c, ?_⟩
    have h0 : IsSkrStripBnd m σ' ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) := hCalc.bnd_const m σ' 0
    rw [norm_zero, ← zero_mul Δ] at h0
    exact hBndCongr (fun _ _ => by simp) h0
  have hPairConstMul : ∀ {σ' Δ C B L : ℝ} {c₁ c₂ : ℂ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      c₁ = c₂ → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ L → 0 ≤ Δ → ‖c₁‖ ≤ C →
      PairBnd σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ →
      PairBnd σ' Δ (C * B) (C * L) (fun z => c₁ * f₁ z) (fun z => c₂ * f₂ z) := by
    intro σ' Δ C B L c₁ c₂ f₁ f₂ hc_eq hC hB hL hΔ hc_le hP
    subst hc_eq
    refine ⟨hCalc.bnd_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_le hB) (hCalc.bnd_const_mul c₁ hB hP.1),
      hCalc.bnd_mono (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_le hB) (hCalc.bnd_const_mul c₁ hB hP.2.1), ?_⟩
    have h1 := hCalc.bnd_const_mul c₁ (mul_nonneg hL hΔ) hP.2.2
    have h2 : ‖c₁‖ * (L * Δ) ≤ (C * L) * Δ := by
      calc ‖c₁‖ * (L * Δ) ≤ C * (L * Δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_le (mul_nonneg hL hΔ)
        _ = (C * L) * Δ := (mul_assoc C L Δ).symm
    exact hBndCongr (fun _ _ => by dsimp only; ring) (hCalc.bnd_mono h2 h1)
  have hPairNeg : ∀ {σ' Δ B L : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      PairBnd σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ → PairBnd σ' Δ B L (fun z => -f₁ z) (fun z => -f₂ z) := by
    intro σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ hP
    refine ⟨hCalc.bnd_neg hP.1, hCalc.bnd_neg hP.2.1, ?_⟩
    exact hBndCongr (fun _ _ => by ring) (hCalc.bnd_neg hP.2.2)
  have hPairAdd : ∀ {σ' Δ B₁ L₁ B₂ L₂ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

  have hPairSub : ∀ {σ' Δ B₁ L₁ B₂ L₂ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      PairBnd σ' Δ B₁ L₁ f₁ f₂ → PairBnd σ' Δ B₂ L₂ g₁ g₂ →
      PairBnd σ' Δ (B₁ + B₂) (L₁ + L₂) (fun z => f₁ z - g₁ z) (fun z => f₂ z - g₂ z) := by
    intro σ' Δ B₁ L₁ B₂ L₂ f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hPf hPg
    refine ⟨hCalc.bnd_sub hPf.1 hPg.1, hCalc.bnd_sub hPf.2.1 hPg.2.1, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hCalc.bnd_sub hPf.2.2 hPg.2.2

  have hPairMul : ∀ {σ' Δ B₁ L₁ B₂ L₂ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},
      PairBnd σ' Δ B₁ L₁ f₁ f₂ → PairBnd σ' Δ B₂ L₂ g₁ g₂ →
      PairBnd σ' Δ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B₁ * B₂) ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B₁ * L₂ + L₁ * B₂))

    intro σ' Δ B₁ L₁ B₂ L₂ f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ hPf hPg
    refine ⟨hCalc.bnd_mul hPf.1 hPg.1, hCalc.bnd_mul hPf.2.1 hPg.2.1, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hCalc.bnd_mul_diff hPf.1 hPg.2.1 hPf.2.2 hPg.2.2
    have hEq : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B₁ * (L₂ * Δ) + (L₁ * Δ) * B₂) =

  have hPairSq : ∀ {σ' Δ B L : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

      PairBnd σ' Δ ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B * B) ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B * L + L * B))
        (fun z => f₁ z ^ 2) (fun z => f₂ z ^ 2) := by
    intro σ' Δ B L f₁ f₂ hP

  have hPairPow4 : ∀ {σ' Δ B L : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

  have hPairInt : ∀ {σ' Δ B L : ℝ} {F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < σ' → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ L → 0 ≤ Δ →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ContinuousOn (fun t => F₁ t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun t => F₂ t z) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, PairBnd σ' Δ B L (F₁ t) (F₂ t)) →
      PairBnd σ' Δ B L
        (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F₁ t z)
        (fun z => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F₂ t z) := by
    intro σ' Δ B L F₁ F₂ hσ' hB hL hΔ hCont hF
    exact ⟨(hCalc.param_int_bnd m σ' B F₁ hσ' hB (fun z hz => (hCont z hz).1)

  have hExp1Cos2BndAndCont : ∀ (R₀ : ℝ) (v_fn : ℝ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ R₀ → ContinuousOn v_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖v_fn x‖ ≤ R₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖skrExp1 (v_fn x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (R₀ + 1) ∧
        ‖skrCos2 (v_fn x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (R₀ + 1)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => skrExp1 (v_fn x)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => skrCos2 (v_fn x)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro R₀ v_fn hR₀ hv_cont hv_bnd
    let R : ℝ := R₀ + 1
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
    have hExpBall := hCalc.exp_ball_bnd R hR_pos
    have hCosBall := hCalc.cos_ball_bnd R hR_pos
    have hInBall : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (t : ℂ) * v_fn x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
      intro x hx t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      have h1 : t * ‖v_fn x‖ ≤ 1 * R₀ := by
        nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, hv_bnd x hx, norm_nonneg (v_fn x)]
      linarith
    have hPtExp : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * v_fn x)‖ ≤ Real.exp R := by
      intro x hx t ht
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hExpBall.2 0 _ (hInBall x hx t ht)
    have hPtCos : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v_fn x)‖ ≤ Real.exp R := by
      intro x hx t ht
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2])]
      have hc : ‖Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v_fn x)‖ ≤ Real.exp R := by
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hCosBall.2 0 _ (hInBall x hx t ht)
      nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, hc, norm_nonneg (Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v_fn x))]
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ⟨hNormInt01 (hPtExp x hx), hNormInt01 (hPtCos x hx)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hCalc.param_int_cont (Real.exp R) (fun x s => Complex.exp ((s : ℂ) * v_fn x))
        (Real.exp_nonneg R)
        (fun x _ => Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const))
        (fun s _ => Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul hv_cont))
        hPtExp
    · exact hCalc.param_int_cont (Real.exp R)
        (fun x t => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v_fn x))
        (Real.exp_nonneg R)
        (fun x _ => (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.mul
          (Complex.continuous_cos.comp_continuousOn
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)))
        (fun t _ => continuousOn_const.mul
          (Complex.continuous_cos.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul hv_cont)))
        hPtCos
  have hRSincCont : ∀ (R₀ : ℝ) (u_fn : ℝ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ R₀ → ContinuousOn u_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖u_fn x‖ ≤ R₀) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => skrRSinc (u_fn x)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro R₀ u_fn hR₀ hu_cont hu_bnd
    refine ContinuousOn.neg ?_
    refine hCalc.param_int_cont (Real.exp (R₀ + 1))
      (fun x t => (t : ℂ) ^ 2 * skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u_fn x))
      (Real.exp_nonneg _) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hc := (hExp1Cos2BndAndCont R₀ (fun t => (t : ℂ) * u_fn x) hR₀
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)
        (fun t ht => by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
          nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, hu_bnd x hx, norm_nonneg (u_fn x)])).2.2
      exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.pow 2).mul hc
    · intro t ht
      have hc := (hExp1Cos2BndAndCont R₀ (fun x => (t : ℂ) * u_fn x) hR₀
        (continuousOn_const.mul hu_cont)
        (fun x hx => by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
          nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, hu_bnd x hx, norm_nonneg (u_fn x)])).2.2
      exact continuousOn_const.mul hc
    · intro x hx t ht
      have hb := ((hExp1Cos2BndAndCont R₀ (fun _ => (t : ℂ) * u_fn x) hR₀ continuousOn_const
        (fun _ _ => by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
          nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, hu_bnd x hx, norm_nonneg (u_fn x)])).1 0
        ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩).2
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]
      nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (R₀ + 1), norm_nonneg (skrCos2 ((t : ℂ) * u_fn x))]

  
  have hEntPair : ∀ (B L : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ L →
      ∃ (B_ent L_ent : ℝ), 0 ≤ B_ent ∧ 0 ≤ L_ent ∧
        ∀ (σ' Δ : ℝ) (u₁ u₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < σ' → 0 ≤ Δ → PairBnd σ' Δ B L u₁ u₂ →
          PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent (fun z => skrExp1 (u₁ z)) (fun z => skrExp1 (u₂ z)) ∧
          PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent (fun z => skrRCos2 (u₁ z)) (fun z => skrRCos2 (u₂ z)) ∧
          PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent (fun z => skrRSinc (u₁ z)) (fun z => skrRSinc (u₂ z)) := by
    intro B L hB hL
    let R : ℝ := B + 1
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by linarith
    let B_ent : ℝ := Real.exp R * skrCompConst m B
    let L_ent : ℝ := skrCompConst m B * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp R * L)
    have hBent_nn : 0 ≤ B_ent := mul_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg R) (hCompConstNonneg m B)
    have hLent_nn : 0 ≤ L_ent := by
      refine mul_nonneg (hCompConstNonneg m B) ?_
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.exp_nonneg R)) hL
    refine ⟨B_ent, L_ent, hBent_nn, hLent_nn, ?_⟩
    intro σ' Δ u₁ u₂ hσ' hΔ hPu
    let V : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hV_conv : Convex ℝ V := convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R
    have hScalePair : ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        PairBnd σ' Δ B L (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₁ z) (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₂ z) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', (t : ℂ) * u₁ z ∈ V ∧ (t : ℂ) * u₂ z ∈ V) := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
        exact ht.2
      have hP_t := hPairConstMul (C := 1) rfl zero_le_one hB hL hΔ ht_norm hPu
      rw [one_mul, one_mul] at hP_t
      refine ⟨hP_t, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have hu1 := hBndPt hP_t.1 z hz
      have hu2 := hBndPt hP_t.2.1 z hz
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith),
        Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith)⟩
    have hCompZeroDiff : ∀ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G V →
        (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ V, ‖iteratedDeriv j G w‖ ≤ Real.exp R) →
        ∀ {t : ℝ}, t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
          PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent
            (fun z => G ((t : ℂ) * u₁ z)) (fun z => G ((t : ℂ) * u₂ z)) := by
      intro G hG_holo hG_bnd t ht
      obtain ⟨hPt, hMem⟩ := hScalePair ht
      have h1 := hCalc.comp_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) B V G (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₁ z)
        hV_open (Real.exp_nonneg R) hB hG_holo (fun j _ w hw => hG_bnd j w hw)
        hPt.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem z hz).1) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPt.1.2 j hjm z hz)
      have h2 := hCalc.comp_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) B V G (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₂ z)
        hV_open (Real.exp_nonneg R) hB hG_holo (fun j _ w hw => hG_bnd j w hw)
        hPt.2.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem z hz).2) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPt.2.1.2 j hjm z hz)
      have hDiff := hCalc.comp_diff_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) 0 B (L * Δ) V G G
        (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₁ z) (fun z => (t : ℂ) * u₂ z)
        hV_open hV_conv (Real.exp_nonneg R) le_rfl hB (mul_nonneg hL hΔ) hG_holo hG_holo
        (fun j _ w _ => by simp [sub_self])
        (fun j _ w hw => hG_bnd j w hw)
        hPt.1.1 hPt.2.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hMem z hz).2)
        (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPt.1.2 j hjm z hz) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPt.2.1.2 j hjm z hz)
        hPt.2.2
      have hL_eq : skrCompConst m B * (0 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp R * (L * Δ)) = L_ent * Δ := by
        dsimp [L_ent]; ring
      rw [hL_eq] at hDiff
      exact ⟨h1, h2, hDiff⟩
    have hExpBall := hCalc.exp_ball_bnd R hR_pos
    have hCosBall := hCalc.cos_ball_bnd R hR_pos
    have hExp1P : PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent
        (fun z => skrExp1 (u₁ z)) (fun z => skrExp1 (u₂ z)) := by
      refine hPairInt hσ' hBent_nn hLent_nn hΔ (fun z _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
        (fun s hs => hCompZeroDiff Complex.exp hExpBall.1 hExpBall.2 hs)
      · exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)
      · exact Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)
    
    have hCos2Gen : ∀ {v₁ v₂ : ℂ → ℂ}, PairBnd σ' Δ B L v₁ v₂ →
        PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent (fun z => skrCos2 (v₁ z)) (fun z => skrCos2 (v₂ z)) := by
      intro v₁ v₂ hPv
      have hCosStep : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          PairBnd σ' Δ B_ent L_ent
            (fun z => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v₁ z))
            (fun z => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.cos ((t : ℂ) * v₂ z)) := by
        intro t ht
        have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]; exact ht.2
        have hPv_t := hPairConstMul (C := 1) rfl zero_le_one hB hL hΔ ht_norm hPv
        rw [one_mul, one_mul] at hPv_t
        have hMem_t : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ', (t : ℂ) * v₁ z ∈ V ∧ (t : ℂ) * v₂ z ∈ V := by
          intro z hz
          have hv1 := hBndPt hPv_t.1 z hz
          have hv2 := hBndPt hPv_t.2.1 z hz
          exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith),
            Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith)⟩
        have hc1 := hCalc.comp_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) B V Complex.cos (fun z => (t : ℂ) * v₁ z)
          hV_open (Real.exp_nonneg R) hB hCosBall.1 (fun j _ w hw => hCosBall.2 j w hw)
          hPv_t.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem_t z hz).1) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPv_t.1.2 j hjm z hz)
        have hc2 := hCalc.comp_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) B V Complex.cos (fun z => (t : ℂ) * v₂ z)
          hV_open (Real.exp_nonneg R) hB hCosBall.1 (fun j _ w hw => hCosBall.2 j w hw)
          hPv_t.2.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem_t z hz).2) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPv_t.2.1.2 j hjm z hz)
        have hcDiff := hCalc.comp_diff_bnd m σ' (Real.exp R) 0 B (L * Δ) V Complex.cos Complex.cos
          (fun z => (t : ℂ) * v₁ z) (fun z => (t : ℂ) * v₂ z)
          hV_open hV_conv (Real.exp_nonneg R) le_rfl hB (mul_nonneg hL hΔ) hCosBall.1 hCosBall.1
          (fun j _ w _ => by simp [sub_self])
          (fun j _ w hw => hCosBall.2 j w hw)
          hPv_t.1.1 hPv_t.2.1.1 (fun z hz => (hMem_t z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hMem_t z hz).2)
          (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPv_t.1.2 j hjm z hz) (fun j _ hjm z hz => hPv_t.2.1.2 j hjm z hz)
          hPv_t.2.2
        have hL_eq : skrCompConst m B * (0 + (2 : ℝ) ^ m * Real.exp R * (L * Δ)) = L_ent * Δ := by
          dsimp [L_ent]; ring
        rw [hL_eq] at hcDiff
        have h1t_norm : ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2])]
          linarith [ht.1]
        have hScaled := hPairConstMul (C := 1) rfl zero_le_one hBent_nn hLent_nn hΔ h1t_norm
          ⟨hc1, hc2, hcDiff⟩
        simpa [one_mul] using hScaled
      refine hPairInt hσ' hBent_nn hLent_nn hΔ (fun z _ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩) hCosStep
      · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.mul
          (Complex.continuous_cos.comp_continuousOn
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const))
      · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.mul

      refine hParamCongr (fun α _ ζ _ => ?_) (hParamMul hSin_β hExp_β)
      dsimp only
      have hpt : ζ + (β : ℂ) * ((ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ) - ζ) =

      rw [hpt, hpt2]

    have hBetaContAt : ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ',
        ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ =>
            let μ := z + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α z
            Complex.sin (deltaPhi_ℂ W (z - (τ_fn α : ℂ) * H_fam α z) (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))) *
              Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ - z))))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro α hα z hz
      let X₀ := z - (τ_fn α : ℂ) * H_fam α z
      let μ₀ := z + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α z
      have hMemSeg : ∀ β ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          X₀ + (θ : ℂ) * ((z + (β : ℂ) * (μ₀ - z)) - X₀) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
        intro β hβ θ hθ
        have hc_val : X₀ + (θ : ℂ) * ((z + (β : ℂ) * (μ₀ - z)) - X₀) =
            z + ((θ * (τ_fn α + β * (1 - τ_fn α)) - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α z := by
          dsimp [X₀, μ₀]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hc_val]
        have hγ0 : 0 ≤ τ_fn α + β * (1 - τ_fn α) :=

        have hγ1 : τ_fn α + β * (1 - τ_fn α) ≤ 1 :=

        exact hCalc.mem_horizStrip_of_tau_seg σ (τ_fn α)

          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by

        · intro β hβ
          refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (hW.1.continuousOn.comp ?_
            (fun θ hθ => hMemSeg β hβ θ hθ))

        · intro θ hθ
          refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (hW.1.continuousOn.comp ?_
            (fun β hβ => hMemSeg β hβ θ hθ))
          exact continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul
            ((continuousOn_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)).sub

        · intro β hβ θ hθ
          rw [Complex.norm_exp]
          refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_trans (Complex.re_le_norm _) ?_)
          simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hW.2.2.2.2 0 (by omega) _ (hMemSeg β hβ θ hθ)
      have hD_cont : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => deltaPhi_ℂ W X₀ (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ₀ - z))) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=

          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)).sub

      have hExp_cont : ContinuousOn
          (fun β : ℝ => Complex.exp (-2 * W (z + (β : ℂ) * (μ₀ - z)))) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
        refine Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul
          (hW.1.continuousOn.comp ?_ ?_))
        · exact continuousOn_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)

    have hBetaIntP := hParamInt hBbetaInt_nn hBetaSlice hBetaContAt
    have hMuSubZ : ParamBndAt ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * 1 * 1)
        (fun α ζ => (ζ + ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ) * H_fam α ζ) - ζ) := by
      refine hParamCongr (fun _ _ _ _ => (add_sub_cancel_left _ _).symm) ?_
      exact hParamMul
        (hParamAlphaScalar 1 (fun α => ((1 - τ_fn α : ℝ) : ℂ)) zero_le_one
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.sub hτ_cont))

    have hExpW0 : ParamBndAt B_pExp1 (fun _ ζ => Complex.exp (W ζ)) :=

    have hKerParam := hParamSub hTerm1 hTerm2

  · intro σ σ' sgn τ ΔH_scaled q w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ H₁ H₂
      hσ hσ' hσ'σ hq hsgn hΔH_nn _ _ hW₁ hW₂ hτ hH₁_holo hH₂_holo hSeg hPert hLipH
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨hq_pos, hq_ge1, _, hH₁_step, hH₁_one, _⟩ :=
      hStepNorm hq hsgn hH₁_holo (fun k hk z hz => (hPert k hk z hz).1)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hH₂_step, hH₂_one, _⟩ :=
      hStepNorm hq hsgn hH₂_holo (fun k hk z hz => (hPert k hk z hz).2)
    have hq_le_q2 : (q : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hq2_ge1 : 1 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hq2_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hq_pos
    have hq3_pos : 0 < (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := pow_pos hq_pos 3
    let ΔW : ℝ := stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂
    have hΔW_nn : 0 ≤ ΔW :=
      (hCalc.stripDiffSup_nonneg_and_le (m + 15) σ M w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ hσ.1 hW₁ hW₂).1
    let Δ_tot : ℝ := ΔH_scaled + ΔW
    have hΔtot_nn : 0 ≤ Δ_tot := add_nonneg hΔH_nn hΔW_nn
    have hHdiff_q2 : IsSkrStripBnd m σ' (ΔH_scaled / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun ζ => H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) :=
      ⟨hH₁_holo.sub hH₂_holo, fun k hk z hz => (le_div_iff₀' hq2_pos).mpr (hLipH k hk z hz)⟩
    have hHdiff_tot_q2 : IsSkrStripBnd m σ' (Δ_tot / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) (fun ζ => H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) :=
      hCalc.bnd_mono (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [Δ_tot]; linarith) (le_of_lt hq2_pos))

    have hHdiff_unscaled : IsSkrStripBnd m σ' ΔH_scaled (fun ζ => H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) :=
      hCalc.bnd_mono (div_le_self hΔH_nn hq2_ge1) hHdiff_q2
    obtain ⟨hR1_bnd, _, hRdiff_bnd⟩ :=
      hRemPair σ σ' τ ΔH_scaled w₁ w₂ W₁ W₂ H₁ H₂
        hσ.1 hσ' hσ'σ hΔH_nn hτ hW₁ hW₂ hH₁_one hH₂_one hSeg hHdiff_unscaled
    let c₀ : ℂ := (((3 / 2 : ℝ) * τ ^ 2 - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hc₀_norm : ‖c₀‖ ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [c₀]

    have hHsum : IsSkrStripBnd m σ' ((2 * B_step) / (q : ℝ)) (fun ζ => H₁ ζ + H₂ ζ) := by
      have hs := hCalc.bnd_add hH₁_step hH₂_step
      have heq : B_step / (q : ℝ) + B_step / (q : ℝ) = (2 * B_step) / (q : ℝ) := by ring

    have hS1_prod := hCalc.bnd_mul hHdiff_tot_q2 hHsum
    have hS1_nn : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (Δ_tot / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((2 * B_step) / (q : ℝ)) := by
      positivity
    have hS1 := hCalc.bnd_mono
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₀_norm hS1_nn)
      (hCalc.bnd_const_mul c₀ hS1_nn hS1_prod)
    
    have hHH_le : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B_step / (q : ℝ)) * (B_step / (q : ℝ)) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_step ^ 2) / (q : ℝ) := by
      have heq : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B_step / (q : ℝ)) * (B_step / (q : ℝ)) =
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_step ^ 2) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hq_pos hq_le_q2
    have hH11 := hCalc.bnd_mono hHH_le (hCalc.bnd_mul hH₁_step hH₁_step)
    have hH12 := hCalc.bnd_mono hHH_le (hCalc.bnd_mul hH₁_step hH₂_step)
    have hH22 := hCalc.bnd_mono hHH_le (hCalc.bnd_mul hH₂_step hH₂_step)
    have hHquadSum := hCalc.bnd_add (hCalc.bnd_add hH11 hH12) hH22
    have hS2 := hCalc.bnd_mul (hCalc.bnd_mul hHdiff_tot_q2 hHquadSum) hR1_bnd
    
    have hS3 := hCalc.bnd_mul (hCalc.bnd_mul (hCalc.bnd_mul hH₂_step hH₂_step) hH₂_step) hRdiff_bnd
    have hAll := hCalc.bnd_add (hCalc.bnd_add hS1 hS2) hS3
    have hAll_eq :
        (1 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (Δ_tot / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * ((2 * B_step) / (q : ℝ))) +
          (2 : ℝ) ^ m *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (Δ_tot / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) *
              (((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_step ^ 2) / (q : ℝ) +
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_step ^ 2) / (q : ℝ) +
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * B_step ^ 2) / (q : ℝ))) *
            M_rem) +
          (2 : ℝ) ^ m *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * (B_step / (q : ℝ)) * (B_step / (q : ℝ))) *
              (B_step / (q : ℝ))) *
            (L_rem * Δ_tot) =
        (C_lip * Δ_tot) / (q : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
      dsimp [C_lip]
      have h3m : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 * m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        rw [show 3 * m = m + m + m by omega, pow_add, pow_add]
      rw [h3m]
      ring
    rw [hAll_eq] at hAll
    have hEqDiff : Set.EqOn
        (fun ζ =>
          (c₀ * ((H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) * (H₁ ζ + H₂ ζ)) +
            (((H₁ ζ - H₂ ζ) * (H₁ ζ * H₁ ζ + H₁ ζ * H₂ ζ + H₂ ζ * H₂ ζ)) *
              skrKerRem W₁ τ (H₁ ζ) ζ)) +
          (((H₂ ζ * H₂ ζ) * H₂ ζ) * (skrKerRem W₁ τ (H₁ ζ) ζ - skrKerRem W₂ τ (H₂ ζ) ζ)))
        (fun ζ =>
          cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₁ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) ζ -
            cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₂ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) ζ)
        (horizStrip σ') := by
      intro ζ hζ
      dsimp only
      have hf1 := hPt.factor_eq σ τ W₁ (H₁ ζ) ζ hσ.1 hW₁.1 hτ
        (hStripSub hσ'σ hζ) (hSeg ζ hζ).1 (hSeg ζ hζ).2.1
      have hf2 := hPt.factor_eq σ τ W₂ (H₂ ζ) ζ hσ.1 hW₂.1 hτ
        (hStripSub hσ'σ hζ) (hSeg ζ hζ).2.2.1 (hSeg ζ hζ).2.2.2
      rw [hf1, hf2]
      dsimp [c₀]
      ring
    have hDiffBnd := hBndCongr hEqDiff hAll
    intro k hk z hz
    have hk_le := hDiffBnd.2 k hk z hz
    have h1 : (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        ‖iteratedDeriv k
          (fun ζ =>
            cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₁ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₁ ζ) ζ -
              cellKernelMinus_ℂ W₂ (ζ - (τ : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) (ζ + ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * H₂ ζ) ζ)
          z‖ ≤ C_lip * Δ_tot :=
      (le_div_iff₀' hq3_pos).mp hk_le
    have hClip_le : C_lip ≤ C_red := by
      have : C_lip ≤ max C_asymp C_lip := le_max_right _ _
      dsimp [C_red]; linarith
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hClip_le hΔtot_nn)

by
  
  
  
  have hPartA :
      (∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c) ∧
      (∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →

          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) ∧
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
        ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},

          taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
            compPowerSeries2D (lineArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀)) := by
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=

    have hparam_int_holo : ∀ {S : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {x₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ}
        {F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ} {B_val : ℝ},
        IsOpen S → x₀ ∈ S →
        (∀ x ∈ S, Continuous (F x)) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ∀ x ∈ S, ‖F' x t‖ ≤ B_val) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ∀ x ∈ S, HasFDerivAt (fun y => F y t) (F' x t) x) →

      have hB_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => B_val) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        intervalIntegrable_const
      exact (intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
        hS_nhds hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas

        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF'_deriv)).differentiableAt

    have hpderivA_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf p₀ hp₀

      let R : ℝ := r / 2

      have hmem_U : ∀ z w : ℂ, dist z p₀.1 < 3 * R / 2 → dist w p₀.2 < 3 * R / 2 → (z, w) ∈ U := by
        intro z w hz hw
        apply hball_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
        exact max_lt (by dsimp only; linarith) (by dsimp only; linarith)
      let K : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall p₀.1 R ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (R / 2)

        rintro ⟨z, w⟩ ⟨hz, hw⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz hw
        exact hmem_U z w (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K :=
        (isCompact_closedBall p₀.1 R).prod (isCompact_closedBall p₀.2 (R / 2))
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have hf_le_M : ∀ q ∈ K, ‖f q‖ ≤ M := fun q hq => (hM₀ q hq).trans (le_max_left M₀ 0)
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap p₀.1 R
      have hγ_mem_cb : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.1 R := by
        intro θ
        exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere p₀.1 hR_pos.le θ)
      have hγ_dist : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ B, R / 2 ≤ ‖γ θ - x.1‖ := by
        intro θ x hx
        have hx1 : ‖x.1 - p₀.1‖ < R / 4 := by
          have hlt : dist x p₀ < R / 4 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hx
          rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hlt
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hlt
        have hγ_norm : ‖γ θ - p₀.1‖ = R := by
          simpa [γ, circleMap, abs_of_pos hR_pos] using norm_circleMap_zero R θ
        have htri : ‖γ θ - p₀.1‖ ≤ ‖γ θ - x.1‖ + ‖x.1 - p₀.1‖ := by
          simpa using norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (γ θ) x.1 p₀.1
        linarith
      have hγ_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ B, γ θ - x.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ x hx h0
        have hle := hγ_dist θ x hx
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at hle
        linarith
