          ((hasDerivAt_id p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const p.1 p.2))
      let ev10 : ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ (1, 0)
      let ev01 : ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ (0, 1)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => pderivA f (p.1, w)) (fderiv ℂ g' p (0, 1) (1, 0)) p.2 := by
        have hc := ev10.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt p.2 hDA
        simpa [Function.comp_def, ev10, g', π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply] using hc
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => pderivD f (z, p.2)) (fderiv ℂ g' p (1, 0) (0, 1)) p.1 := by
        have hc := ev01.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt p.1 hAD
        simpa [Function.comp_def, ev01, g', π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply] using hc
      change deriv (fun z => pderivD f (z, p.2)) p.1 = deriv (fun w => pderivA f (p.1, w)) p.2
      rw [h2.deriv, h1.deriv, hsymm]

    have hiterY_step_A : ∀ (α : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        iterDerivY (α + 1) f = iterDerivY α (pderivA f) := by
      intro α f
      induction α with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        ext p
        change deriv (fun y' => iterDerivY (α + 1) f (y', p.2)) p.1 =
          deriv (fun y' => iterDerivY α (pderivA f) (y', p.2)) p.1
        rw [ih]

    have hiterY_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ α : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivY α f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => exact hf
      | succ α ih => exact hpderivA_holo hU ih

    have hiterY_pderivD : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivY α (pderivD f) p = pderivD (iterDerivY α f) p := by
      intro U hU f hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro _ _; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        intro p hp
        change pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) p = pderivD (pderivA (iterDerivY α f)) p
        have hev : (fun z => iterDerivY α (pderivD f) (z, p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
            (fun z => pderivD (iterDerivY α f) (z, p.2)) := by
          have hopen_slice : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, p.2) ∈ U} :=
            hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen_slice.mem_nhds hp) fun z hz => ih (z, p.2) hz
        have hcongr : pderivA (iterDerivY α (pderivD f)) p =
            pderivA (pderivD (iterDerivY α f)) p := hev.deriv_eq
        rw [hcongr]
        exact hpderiv_comm hU (hiterY_holo hU hf α) p hp

    have hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv : ∀ (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        iterDerivYT α β f p = iteratedDeriv β (fun t' => iterDerivY α f (p.1, t')) p.2 := by
      intro α β f p
      rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
      rfl

    have hiterYT_step : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ (α β : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U,
          iterDerivYT (α + 1) β f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivA f) p ∧
          iterDerivYT α (β + 1) f p = iterDerivYT α β (pderivD f) p := by
      intro U hU f hf α β p hp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [iterDerivYT, hiterY_step_A]
      · rw [hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv, iteratedDeriv_succ']
        have hopen_slice : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p.1, t') ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have hev : deriv (fun t' => iterDerivY α f (p.1, t')) =ᶠ[nhds p.2]
            (fun t' => iterDerivY α (pderivD f) (p.1, t')) := by
          refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen_slice.mem_nhds hp) fun t' ht' => ?_
          exact (hiterY_pderivD hU hf α (p.1, t') ht').symm
        exact hev.iteratedDeriv_eq β

    have coeff_taylor2D : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀) =
          iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl

    have hdeg_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 + d 1 = 0 := by
      intro d
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · intro h; ext i; fin_cases i <;> (simp; omega)

    have htaylor2D_const : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
      intro p₀ c
      have hiterY_const : ∀ α : ℕ, iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro α
        induction α with
        | zero => ext p; exact deriv_const p.1 c
        | succ α ih =>
          ext p
          change deriv (fun y' => iterDerivY (α + 1) (fun _ => c) (y', p.2)) p.1 = 0
          rw [ih]
          exact deriv_const p.1 (0 : ℂ)
      ext d
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv]
      by_cases hd : d = 0
      · subst hd; simp [iterDerivY]
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hd h).elim]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (d 0) with hd0 | hd0_pos
        · have hd1_ne : d 1 ≠ 0 := fun hd1 => hd ((hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega))
          rw [hd0]
          change iteratedDeriv (d 1) (fun _ : ℂ => c) p₀.2 / _ = 0
          rw [iteratedDeriv_const, ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hd1_ne h).elim, zero_div]
        · obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hd0_pos)
          rw [hα, hiterY_const α, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp

    have htaylor2D_linear_coords : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 ∧
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
      intro p₀
      let f₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 - p₀.1
      let f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.2 - p₀.2
      have hf₁_1 : iterDerivY 1 f₁ = fun _ => 1 := by
        ext q
        change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => y' - p₀.1) q.1 = 1
        rw [deriv_sub_const, deriv_id'']
      have hf₁_2 : ∀ a : ℕ, iterDerivY (a + 2) f₁ = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro a
        induction a with
        | zero =>
          ext q
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY 1 f₁ (y', q.2)) q.1 = 0
          rw [hf₁_1]; exact deriv_const q.1 (1 : ℂ)
        | succ a ih =>
          ext q
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (a + 2) f₁ (y', q.2)) q.1 = 0
          rw [ih]; exact deriv_const q.1 (0 : ℂ)
      have hf₂_1 : ∀ a : ℕ, iterDerivY (a + 1) f₂ = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro a
        induction a with
        | zero =>
          ext q
          change deriv (fun _ : ℂ => q.2 - p₀.2) q.1 = 0
          exact deriv_const q.1 (q.2 - p₀.2)
        | succ a ih =>
          ext q
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (a + 1) f₂ (y', q.2)) q.1 = 0
          rw [ih]; exact deriv_const q.1 (0 : ℂ)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · ext d
        change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f₁ p₀) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 0)
        rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv]
        have hsingle0 : d = Finsupp.single 0 1 ↔ d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0 := by
          rw [Finsupp.ext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two]
          simp
        rcases d0_cases : d 0 with _ | _ | a
        · have h0 : (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY 0 f₁ (p₀.1, t')) = fun _ => 0 := by
            ext t'; simp [iterDerivY, f₁]
          rw [h0, iteratedDeriv_const]
          have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle0]; omega
          rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hfalse h).elim]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        · rw [hf₁_1, iteratedDeriv_const]
          rcases d1_cases : d 1 with _ | b
          · have htrue : d = Finsupp.single 0 1 := hsingle0.mpr ⟨d0_cases, d1_cases⟩
            simp [htrue]
          · have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle0]; omega
            simp [hfalse]
        · rw [hf₁_2 a, iteratedDeriv_const]
          have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle0]; omega
          rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hfalse h).elim]
          split_ifs <;> simp
      · ext d
        change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f₂ p₀) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 1)
        rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv]
        have hsingle1 : d = Finsupp.single 1 1 ↔ d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1 := by
          rw [Finsupp.ext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_two]
          simp
        rcases d0_cases : d 0 with _ | a
        · have h0 : (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY 0 f₂ (p₀.1, t')) = fun t' => t' - p₀.2 := rfl
          rw [h0]
          rcases d1_cases : d 1 with _ | _ | b
          · have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle1]; omega
            simp [hfalse]
          · have htrue : d = Finsupp.single 1 1 := hsingle1.mpr ⟨d0_cases, d1_cases⟩
            rw [ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h htrue).elim, iteratedDeriv_one,
              deriv_sub_const, deriv_id'']
            norm_num
          · have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle1]; omega
            have hd_lin : deriv (fun t' : ℂ => t' - p₀.2) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
              ext t'; rw [deriv_sub_const, deriv_id'']
            rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hfalse h).elim, iteratedDeriv_succ', hd_lin,
              iteratedDeriv_const]
            simp
        · rw [hf₂_1 a, iteratedDeriv_const]
          have hfalse : d ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by rw [ne_eq, hsingle1]; omega
          rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hfalse h).elim]
          split_ifs <;> simp

    have htaylor2D_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f₁ f₂ hfg
      have hiterY_eq : ∀ (α : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U, iterDerivY α f₁ p = iterDerivY α f₂ p := by
        intro α
        induction α with
        | zero => exact hfg
        | succ α ih =>
          intro p hp
          have hopen_slice : IsOpen {y' : ℂ | (y', p.2) ∈ U} :=
            hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          have hev : (fun y' => iterDerivY α f₁ (y', p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
              (fun y' => iterDerivY α f₂ (y', p.2)) :=
            Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen_slice.mem_nhds hp) fun y' hy' => ih (y', p.2) hy'
          exact hev.deriv_eq
      ext d
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv, hiterYT_eq_iteratedDeriv]
      have hopen_slice : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p₀.1, t') ∈ U} :=
        hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hev : (fun t' => iterDerivY (d 0) f₁ (p₀.1, t')) =ᶠ[nhds p₀.2]
          (fun t' => iterDerivY (d 0) f₂ (p₀.1, t')) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen_slice.mem_nhds hp₀) fun t' ht' =>
          hiterY_eq (d 0) (p₀.1, t') ht'
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq (d 1)]

    let mvDeriv (ι : Fin 2) (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun d => ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) Φ
    have coeff_mvDeriv : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ) =
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) Φ :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have coeff_comp1D : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n) :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl

    have hmv_add : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ + Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ + mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ
      ext d
      rw [map_add, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, map_add, mul_add]

    have hmv_mul_half : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ d
      let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι 1
      change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      let S_pos := (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e)).filter (fun p => p.1 ι ≠ 0)
      have hsum_filter :
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ S_pos,
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        symm
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun p hp hnot => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_and, Classical.not_not] at hnot
        rw [hnot hp, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul]
      rw [hsum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_bij'
        (fun q _ => (q.1 + e, q.2))
        (fun p _ => (p.1 - e, p.2))
        ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro q hq
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
        refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
          calc (q.1 + e) + q.2 = (q.1 + q.2) + e := by abel
            _ = d + e := by rw [hq]
        · simp [e]
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨hp_ant, hp_ne⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp_ant ⊢
        ext j
        have hj := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp_ant j
        fin_cases j <;> fin_cases ι <;> simp [e] at hj hp_ne ⊢ <;> omega
      · intro q _
        ext j <;> simp [e]
      · intro p hp
        obtain ⟨_, hp_ne⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
        ext j
        · fin_cases j <;> fin_cases ι <;> simp [e] at hp_ne ⊢ <;> omega
        · rfl
      · intro q _
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv]
        have hcoord : (q.1 + e) ι = q.1 ι + 1 := by simp [e]
        rw [hcoord]

    have hmv_mul : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ * Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ
      ext d
      let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι 1
      rw [map_add, hmv_mul_half ι Φ Ψ d, mul_comm Φ (mvDeriv ι Ψ), hmv_mul_half ι Ψ Φ d,
        coeff_mvDeriv, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      change (∑ x ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (MvPowerSeries.coeff x.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff x.2 Ψ)) =
        (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ) +
        (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
          ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Ψ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Φ)
      have hswap :
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
            ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Ψ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Φ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
            ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        refine Finset.sum_bij' (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1)) (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1))
          ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) ?_
        · intro p hp
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
          rw [add_comm]; exact hp
        · intro p hp
          rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢
          rw [add_comm]; exact hp
        · intro p _; ring
      rw [hswap, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have hc : p.1 ι + p.2 ι = d ι + 1 := by
        have hj := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp ι
        simpa [e] using hj
      have hcast : ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) + ((p.2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hc
      rw [← hcast]
      ring

    have hmv_one : ∀ ι : Fin 2, mvDeriv ι 1 = 0 := by
      intro ι
      ext m
      have hne : m + Finsupp.single ι 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hc := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h0 ι
        simp at hc
      rw [coeff_mvDeriv, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one,
        ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim, mul_zero]

    have hmv_pow : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (k : ℕ),
        mvDeriv ι (Ψ ^ (k + 1)) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) • (mvDeriv ι Ψ * Ψ ^ k) := by
      intro ι Ψ k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [pow_succ Ψ (k + 1), hmv_mul, ih, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, ← pow_succ,
          mul_comm (Ψ ^ (k + 1)) (mvDeriv ι Ψ)]
        have hcast : ((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast, add_smul, one_smul]

    have hpow_vanish : ∀ {Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 + d 1 < n → MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n) = 0 := by
      intro Ψ hΨ0 n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro _ hd; omega
      | succ n ih =>
        intro d hd
        rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        by_cases hp2 : p.2 = 0
        · rw [hp2, hΨ0, mul_zero]
        · have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
            have := mt (hdeg_zero_iff p.2).mpr hp2
            omega
          have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
          have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
          rw [ih p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]

    have hmv_comp1D : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
        mvDeriv ι (compPowerSeries2D f Ψ) =
          mvDeriv ι Ψ * compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) Ψ := by
      intro ι f Ψ hΨ0
      ext d
      have hdeg_e : (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) 0 + (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) 1 =
          d 0 + d 1 + 1 := by
        fin_cases ι <;> simp <;> omega
      rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_comp1D, hdeg_e, Finset.mul_sum]
      have hlhs :
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
            ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              (PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (Ψ ^ n))) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (Ψ ^ n)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv]; ring
      rw [hlhs, Finset.sum_range_succ', pow_zero, hmv_one ι, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero,
        mul_zero, add_zero]
      have hstep :
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι (Ψ ^ (k + 1)))) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
            ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (mvDeriv ι Ψ) *
                (PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative f) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (Ψ ^ k)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        rw [hmv_pow ι Ψ k, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
          PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
        push_cast
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
      rw [hstep, Finset.sum_comm, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, coeff_comp1D]
      congr 1
      symm
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
      have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) fun k _ hk_not => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk_not
      rw [hpow_vanish hΨ0 k p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]

    have hmv_taylor : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
          mvDeriv 0 (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivA f) p₀ ∧
          mvDeriv 1 (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderivD f) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf
      constructor
      · ext d
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
        have hd0 : (d + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 0 = d 0 + 1 := by simp
        have hd1 : (d + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = d 1 := by simp
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).1, Nat.factorial_succ (d 0),
          Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc : ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have hf0 : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have hf1 : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp
      · ext d
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
        have hd0 : (d + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 0 = d 0 := by simp
        have hd1 : (d + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = d 1 + 1 := by simp
        rw [hd0, hd1, (hiterYT_step hU hf (d 0) (d 1) p₀ hp₀).2, Nat.factorial_succ (d 1),
          Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc : ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
        have hf0 : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have hf1 : ((d 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp

    have hcoeff_step : ∀ {Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {N : ℕ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 →
        (∀ d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d' 0 + d' 1 = N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv 0 Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv 0 Ψ) ∧
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv 1 Φ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDeriv 1 Ψ)) →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d Φ = MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ := by
      intro Φ Ψ N d hd heq
      by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0
      · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := d - Finsupp.single 1 1
        have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 1 1 = d := by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [d'] <;> omega
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by
          have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hd'_add
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hsum
          have : (Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 0 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hD := (heq d' hd'_deg).2
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, hd'_add] at hD
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)) hD
      · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := d - Finsupp.single 0 1
        have hd'_add : d' + Finsupp.single 0 1 = d := by
          ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [d'] <;> omega
        have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 = N := by
          have hsum := congr_arg (fun x : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => x 0 + x 1) hd'_add
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hsum
          have : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℕ)) 1 = 0 := by simp
          omega
        have hA := (heq d' hd'_deg).1
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, hd'_add] at hA
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)) hA

    have hslice_at : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ q ∈ U,
          DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => f (z, q.2)) q.1 ∧
          DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => f (q.1, w)) q.2 := by
      intro U hU f hf q hq
      have hfq : DifferentiableAt ℂ f q := hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)
      exact ⟨hfq.comp q.1 (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const q.2)),
        hfq.comp q.2 ((differentiableAt_const q.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)⟩

    have htaylor2D_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [map_add, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) fun d' hd' => ?_
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p + g p) U := hf.add hg
            have hpA : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivA (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivA f q + pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivD (fun p => f p + g p) q = pderivD f q + pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_add (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpA, hmv_add,
                (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1]
              exact ih (hpderivA_holo hU hf) (hpderivA_holo hU hg) d' (le_of_eq hd')
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpD, hmv_add,
                (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2]
              exact ih (hpderivD_holo hU hf) (hpderivD_holo hU hg) d' (le_of_eq hd')
      intro f g hf hg
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl

    have htaylor2D_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro f g _ _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul,
            ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro f g hf hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hf hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) fun d' hd' => ?_
            have hfA := hpderivA_holo hU hf
            have hfD := hpderivD_holo hU hf
            have hgA := hpderivA_holo hU hg
            have hgD := hpderivD_holo hU hg
            have hfg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * g p) U := hf.mul hg
            have hpA : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivA (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivA f q * g q + f q * pderivA g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).1 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).1
            have hpD : ∀ q ∈ U,
                pderivD (fun p => f p * g p) q = pderivD f q * g q + f q * pderivD g q :=
              fun q hq => deriv_mul (hslice_at hU hf q hq).2 (hslice_at hU hg q hq).2
            have hfAg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivA f p * g p) U := hfA.mul hg
            have hfgA : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivA g p) U := hf.mul hgA
            have hfDg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivD f p * g p) U := hfD.mul hg
            have hfgD : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p * pderivD g p) U := hf.mul hgD
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).1, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpA,
                htaylor2D_add hU hp₀ hfAg hfgA,
                hmv_mul, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).1, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).1,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfA hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgA d' (le_of_eq hd')]
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hfg).2, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpD,
                htaylor2D_add hU hp₀ hfDg hfgD,
                hmv_mul, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hf).2, (hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hg).2,
                map_add, map_add, ih hfD hg d' (le_of_eq hd'), ih hf hgD d' (le_of_eq hd')]
      intro f g hf hg
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl

    have htaylor2D_ring : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f g hf hg
      refine ⟨htaylor2D_add hU hp₀ hf hg, ?_, htaylor2D_mul hU hp₀ hf hg⟩
      have hneg_g : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (-1 : ℂ)) p * g p) U :=
        (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)).mul hg
      have hsub_fn : (fun p => f p - g p) =
          (fun p => f p + (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (-1 : ℂ)) p * g p) := by
        ext p; ring
      rw [hsub_fn, htaylor2D_add hU hp₀ hf hneg_g,
        htaylor2D_mul hU hp₀ (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg, htaylor2D_const p₀ (-1),
        map_neg, map_one]
      ring

    have htaylor2D_comp_1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → IsOpen W →
        ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U → ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W) →
          taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
            compPowerSeries2D (lineArcHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) := by
      intro U W hU hW p₀ hp₀ ψ g₀ hψ hg₀ hmaps
      let Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀
      have hΨ0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 := by
        change MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = 0
        rw [coeff_taylor2D]
        simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      have hΨ_sub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) U :=
        hψ.sub (differentiableOn_const (ψ p₀))
      have hΨ_dA : mvDeriv 0 Ψ = taylor2D (pderivA ψ) p₀ := by
        change mvDeriv 0 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
        rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hΨ_sub_holo).1]
        exact htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ fun q _ => deriv_sub_const (f := fun z => ψ (z, q.2)) (ψ p₀)
      have hΨ_dD : mvDeriv 1 Ψ = taylor2D (pderivD ψ) p₀ := by
        change mvDeriv 1 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
        rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hΨ_sub_holo).2]
        exact htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ fun q _ => deriv_sub_const (f := fun w => ψ (q.1, w)) (ψ p₀)
      have hderiv_holo1D : ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ),
          PowerSeries.derivative (holoTaylor1D h w₀) = holoTaylor1D (deriv h) w₀ := by
        intro h w₀
        ext n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_succ',
          Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc1 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
        have hc2 : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
        push_cast
        field_simp
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
          intro g _ d hd
          have hd0 : d = 0 := (hdeg_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
          subst hd0
          rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_comp1D]
          simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY, holoTaylor1D]
        | succ N ih =>
          intro g hg d hd
          by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
          · exact ih hg d hle
          · refine hcoeff_step (N := N) (by omega) fun d' hd' => ?_
            have hψA := hpderivA_holo hU hψ
            have hψD := hpderivD_holo hU hψ
            have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) W := hg.deriv hW
            have hgψ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (ψ p)) U := hg.comp hψ fun p hp => hmaps p hp
            have hg'ψ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => deriv g (ψ p)) U :=
              hg'.comp hψ fun p hp => hmaps p hp
            have hpA : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivA (fun p => g (ψ p)) q = pderivA ψ q * deriv g (ψ q) := by
              intro q hq
              have hgat : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (ψ q) := hg.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))
              simpa [pderivA, Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
                deriv_comp q.1 hgat (hslice_at hU hψ q hq).1
            have hpD : ∀ q ∈ U, pderivD (fun p => g (ψ p)) q = pderivD ψ q * deriv g (ψ q) := by
              intro q hq
              have hgat : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (ψ q) := hg.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))
              simpa [pderivD, Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
                deriv_comp q.2 hgat (hslice_at hU hψ q hq).2
            have hdeg_le_right : ∀ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d', r.2 0 + r.2 1 ≤ N := by
              intro r hr
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
              have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
              have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
              simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
              omega
            constructor
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hgψ).1, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpA,
                htaylor2D_mul hU hp₀ hψA hg'ψ,
                hmv_comp1D 0 (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ hΨ0, hΨ_dA, hderiv_holo1D g (ψ p₀),
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => by rw [ih hg' r.2 (hdeg_le_right r hr)]
            · rw [(hmv_taylor hU hp₀ hgψ).2, htaylor2D_congr hU hp₀ hpD,
                htaylor2D_mul hU hp₀ hψD hg'ψ,
                hmv_comp1D 1 (holoTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) Ψ hΨ0, hΨ_dD, hderiv_holo1D g (ψ p₀),
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => by rw [ih hg' r.2 (hdeg_le_right r hr)]
      ext d
      exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hg₀ d le_rfl

    exact ⟨htaylor2D_const, htaylor2D_linear_coords, htaylor2D_congr, htaylor2D_ring, htaylor2D_comp_1D⟩

  rcases hPartA with
    ⟨htaylor2D_const, htaylor2D_linear_coords, htaylor2D_congr, htaylor2D_ring, htaylor2D_comp_1D⟩

  
  
  
  let polyShift : ∀ {J : ℕ}, (Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun c => ∑ l : Fin _, PowerSeries.C (c l) * PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ)
  let polyComp : PowerSeries ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun φ Z => PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff n φ * PowerSeries.coeff m (Z ^ n)
  let polyMidShift : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun β i => polyShift (fun l => (β l i.castSucc + β l i.succ) / 2)
  let polyHalfStepShift : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun β i => polyShift (fun l => (β l i.succ - β l i.castSucc) / 2)
  let polySup : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) →
      (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun h_ℂ g α₀ β i =>
      polyComp (holoTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i) +
        ∑ l : Fin _, PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i)
  let polySupDeriv : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) →
      (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun h_ℂ g α₀ β i =>
      polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv h_ℂ) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i) +
        ∑ l : Fin _, PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i)
  let polySin : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) →
      Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun α₀ β i => polyComp (holoTaylor1D Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i))
      (polyHalfStepShift β i)
  let polyCos : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) →
      Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun α₀ β i => polyComp (holoTaylor1D Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i))
      (polyHalfStepShift β i)
  let polyAct : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) →
      (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun h_ℂ g α₀ β => ∑ i : Fin _, 2 * polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i * polySin α₀ β i
  let polyGrad : ∀ {k J : ℕ}, (ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) →
      (Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) → Fin (k - 1) → PowerSeries ℂ :=
    fun {k _} h_ℂ g α₀ β r =>
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      polySupDeriv h_ℂ g α₀ β i_L * polySin α₀ β i_L +
        polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i_L * polyCos α₀ β i_L +
        polySupDeriv h_ℂ g α₀ β i_R * polySin α₀ β i_R -
        polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i_R * polyCos α₀ β i_R

  have coeff_polyComp : ∀ (φ Z : PowerSeries ℂ) (m : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff m (polyComp φ Z) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), PowerSeries.coeff n φ * PowerSeries.coeff m (Z ^ n) :=
    fun _ _ m => PowerSeries.coeff_mk m _

  have coeff_polyShift : ∀ {J : ℕ} (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff n (polyShift c) = if hn : n < J + 1 then c ⟨n, hn⟩ else 0 := by
    intro J c n
    dsimp only [polyShift]
    rw [map_sum]
    have hterm : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
        PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.C (c l) * PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ)) =
          if n = (l : ℕ) then c l else 0 := by
      intro l
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    simp_rw [hterm]
    split_ifs with hn
    · refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨n, hn⟩ : Fin (J + 1)) ?_ ?_).trans (by simp)
      · intro l _ hl_ne
        have hne : n ≠ (l : ℕ) := fun heq => hl_ne (Fin.ext heq.symm)
        exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
      · intro hnot
        exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _))
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
      have hne : n ≠ (l : ℕ) := by have := l.2; omega
      exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim

  have hepsJet_poly : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
      {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
      {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
      {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
      {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0),
        lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m (polyAct h_ℂ g α₀ β) ∧
        ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
          lineArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε) r) =
            PowerSeries.coeff m (polyGrad h_ℂ g α₀ β r) := by
    let HoloAtZero (F : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
      ∃ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ F U
    have hHolo_contDiffAt : ∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → ∀ n : WithTop ℕ∞, ContDiffAt ℂ n F 0 := by
      rintro F ⟨U, hU, h0, hF⟩ n
      exact (hF.analyticAt (hU.mem_nhds h0)).contDiffAt
    have hHolo_const : ∀ c : ℂ, HoloAtZero (fun _ => c) :=
      fun c => ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ 0, differentiableOn_const c⟩
    have hHolo_id : HoloAtZero (fun ε : ℂ => ε) :=
      ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ 0, differentiableOn_id⟩
    have hHolo_add : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => F ε + G ε) := by
      rintro F G ⟨U₁, hU₁, h0₁, hF⟩ ⟨U₂, hU₂, h0₂, hG⟩
      exact ⟨U₁ ∩ U₂, hU₁.inter hU₂, ⟨h0₁, h0₂⟩,
        (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left).add (hG.mono Set.inter_subset_right)⟩
    have hHolo_sub : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => F ε - G ε) := by
      rintro F G ⟨U₁, hU₁, h0₁, hF⟩ ⟨U₂, hU₂, h0₂, hG⟩
      exact ⟨U₁ ∩ U₂, hU₁.inter hU₂, ⟨h0₁, h0₂⟩,
        (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left).sub (hG.mono Set.inter_subset_right)⟩
    have hHolo_mul : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => F ε * G ε) := by
      rintro F G ⟨U₁, hU₁, h0₁, hF⟩ ⟨U₂, hU₂, h0₂, hG⟩
      exact ⟨U₁ ∩ U₂, hU₁.inter hU₂, ⟨h0₁, h0₂⟩,
        (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left).mul (hG.mono Set.inter_subset_right)⟩

    have hTay1D_const : ∀ (c z₀ : ℂ), holoTaylor1D (fun _ => c) z₀ = PowerSeries.C c := by
      intro c z₀
      ext n
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C, iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs with hn
      · subst hn; simp
      · simp
    have hTay1D_id : holoTaylor1D (fun ε : ℂ => ε) 0 = PowerSeries.X := by
      ext n
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_X]
      rcases n with _ | _ | k
      · simp
      · rw [ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h rfl).elim, iteratedDeriv_one, deriv_id'']; norm_num
      · rw [ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (by omega), iteratedDeriv_succ', deriv_id'', iteratedDeriv_const]
        simp
    have hTay1D_add : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => F ε + G ε) 0 = holoTaylor1D F 0 + holoTaylor1D G 0 := by
      intro F G hF hG
      ext n
      rw [map_add, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
        PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_add (hHolo_contDiffAt hF n) (hHolo_contDiffAt hG n), add_div]
    have hTay1D_sub : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => F ε - G ε) 0 = holoTaylor1D F 0 - holoTaylor1D G 0 := by
      intro F G hF hG
      ext n
      rw [map_sub, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
        PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_sub (hHolo_contDiffAt hF n) (hHolo_contDiffAt hG n), sub_div]
    have hTay1D_mul : ∀ {F G : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → HoloAtZero G →
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => F ε * G ε) 0 = holoTaylor1D F 0 * holoTaylor1D G 0 := by
      intro F G hF hG
      ext m
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
          (fun a b => PowerSeries.coeff a (holoTaylor1D F 0) *
            PowerSeries.coeff b (holoTaylor1D G 0)) m,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_mul (hHolo_contDiffAt hF m) (hHolo_contDiffAt hG m), Finset.sum_div]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff] at ha
      rw [holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      have hfac_nat := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial ha
      have hfac : ((m.choose a : ℂ) * (a.factorial : ℂ) * ((m - a).factorial : ℂ)) =
          (m.factorial : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac_nat
      have hc_ne : (m.choose a : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos ha))
      have ha_ne : (a.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero a)
      have hb_ne : ((m - a).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      rw [← hfac]
      field_simp
    have hTay1D_pow : ∀ {F : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero F → ∀ n : ℕ,
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => F ε ^ n) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => F ε ^ n) 0 = (holoTaylor1D F 0) ^ n := by
      intro F hF n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨hHolo_const 1, ?_⟩
        simpa using hTay1D_const 1 0
      | succ n ih =>
        have hfn : (fun ε => F ε ^ (n + 1)) = (fun ε => F ε ^ n * F ε) := by
          ext ε; exact pow_succ (F ε) n
        rw [hfn, pow_succ]
        exact ⟨hHolo_mul ih.1 hF, (hTay1D_mul ih.1 hF).trans (by rw [ih.2])⟩
    have hTay1D_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, HoloAtZero (F i)) →
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ s, F i ε) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ s, F i ε) 0 = ∑ i ∈ s, holoTaylor1D (F i) 0 := by
      intro ι s F hF
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        refine ⟨hHolo_const 0, ?_⟩
        simpa using hTay1D_const 0 0
      | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have hF_a : HoloAtZero (F a) := hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have hF_s := ih (fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
        have hfn : (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, F i ε) =
            (fun ε => F a ε + ∑ i ∈ s, F i ε) := by
          ext ε; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
        rw [hfn, Finset.sum_insert ha]
        exact ⟨hHolo_add hF_a hF_s.1, (hTay1D_add hF_a hF_s.1).trans (by rw [hF_s.2])⟩

    let iterDslope (z₀ : ℂ) (n : ℕ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
      ((fun f : ℂ → ℂ => dslope f z₀)^[n]) G
    have hiterDslope_holo : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
          ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDslope z₀ n G) W := by
      intro W hW z₀ hz₀ G hG n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact hG
      | succ n ih =>
        have hstep : iterDslope z₀ (n + 1) G = dslope (iterDslope z₀ n G) z₀ :=
          Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ n G
        rw [hstep]
        exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)).mpr ih

    have hdslope_step_deriv : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → ∀ k : ℕ,
          iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f z₀ =
            ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv k (dslope f z₀) z₀ := by
      intro W hW z₀ hz₀ f hf k
      have hf_eq : f = fun z => f z₀ + (z - z₀) * dslope f z₀ z := by
        ext z
        have h := sub_smul_dslope f z₀ z
        rw [smul_eq_mul] at h
        linear_combination -h
      have hd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope f z₀) W :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)).mpr hf
      have hd_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k + 1 : ℕ) (dslope f z₀) z₀ :=
        (hd_holo.analyticAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)).contDiffAt
      have hlin_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k + 1 : ℕ) (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) z₀ :=
        contDiffAt_id.sub contDiffAt_const
      have hmul_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k + 1 : ℕ) (fun z : ℂ => (z - z₀) * dslope f z₀ z) z₀ :=
        hlin_cd.mul hd_cd
      conv_lhs => rw [hf_eq]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_add contDiffAt_const hmul_cd, iteratedDeriv_const,
        ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (Nat.succ_ne_zero k h).elim, zero_add,
        iteratedDeriv_fun_mul hlin_cd hd_cd]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 1 ?_ ?_]
      · rw [Nat.choose_one_right, iteratedDeriv_one, deriv_sub_const, deriv_id'',
          Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_one]
      · intro a _ ha_ne
        rcases a with _ | _ | b
        · simp
        · exact False.elim (ha_ne rfl)
        · have hd_sub : deriv (fun z : ℂ => z - z₀) = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := by
            ext z; rw [deriv_sub_const, deriv_id'']
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', hd_sub, iteratedDeriv_const]
          simp
      · intro hnot
        exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))

    have hiterDslope_val : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
          iterDslope z₀ n G z₀ = PowerSeries.coeff n (holoTaylor1D G z₀) := by
      intro W hW z₀ hz₀ n
      have hind : ∀ (n : ℕ) {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
          iteratedDeriv n G z₀ = (n.factorial : ℂ) * iterDslope z₀ n G z₀ := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => intro G _; simp [iterDslope]
        | succ n ih =>
          intro G hG
          have hd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope G z₀) W :=
            (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hW.mem_nhds hz₀)).mpr hG
          have hshift : iterDslope z₀ (n + 1) G = iterDslope z₀ n (dslope G z₀) :=
            Function.iterate_succ_apply _ n G
          rw [hdslope_step_deriv hW hz₀ hG n, ih hd_holo, hshift, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
            mul_assoc]
      intro G hG
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hind n hG,
        mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n))]

    have hiterDslope_expand : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ) (M : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
        G z = (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), iterDslope z₀ n G z₀ * (z - z₀) ^ n) +
          (z - z₀) ^ (M + 1) * iterDslope z₀ (M + 1) G z := by
      intro z₀ G M z
      induction M with
      | zero =>
        have h := sub_smul_dslope G z₀ z
        rw [smul_eq_mul] at h
        dsimp only [iterDslope]
        simp only [Nat.zero_add, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_zero, mul_one, pow_one,
          Function.iterate_zero_apply, Function.iterate_one]
        linear_combination -h
      | succ M ih =>
        have hstep := sub_smul_dslope (iterDslope z₀ (M + 1) G) z₀ z
        rw [smul_eq_mul] at hstep
        have hsucc : iterDslope z₀ (M + 1 + 1) G z = dslope (iterDslope z₀ (M + 1) G) z₀ z :=
          congr_fun (Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ (M + 1) G) z
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ (z - z₀) (M + 1), hsucc]
        linear_combination ih - (z - z₀) ^ (M + 1) * hstep

    have hTay1D_comp : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {z₀ : ℂ}, z₀ ∈ W →
        ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
        ∀ {z_tilde : ℂ → ℂ}, HoloAtZero z_tilde → z_tilde 0 = 0 →
          HoloAtZero (fun ε => G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)) ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun ε => G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)) 0 =
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D G z₀) (holoTaylor1D z_tilde 0) := by
      intro W hW z₀ hz₀ G hG z_tilde hz_holo hz0
      obtain ⟨U_z, hU_z, h0_z, hz_diff⟩ := hz_holo
      have hz_h0 : HoloAtZero z_tilde := ⟨U_z, hU_z, h0_z, hz_diff⟩
      let U' : Set ℂ := U_z ∩ (fun ε => z₀ + z_tilde ε) ⁻¹' W
      have hshift_cont : ContinuousOn (fun ε => z₀ + z_tilde ε) U_z :=
        continuousOn_const.add hz_diff.continuousOn
      have hU'_open : IsOpen U' := hshift_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU_z hW
      have h0_U' : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U' := ⟨h0_z, by simp [hz0, hz₀]⟩
      have hcomp_holo : HoloAtZero (fun ε => G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)) :=
        ⟨U', hU'_open, h0_U',
          hG.comp (differentiableOn_const z₀ |>.add (hz_diff.mono Set.inter_subset_left))
            fun _ hε => hε.2⟩
      refine ⟨hcomp_holo, ?_⟩
      ext m
      rw [coeff_polyComp]
      have hd_z : HoloAtZero (dslope z_tilde 0) :=
        ⟨U_z, hU_z, h0_z, (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hU_z.mem_nhds h0_z)).mpr hz_diff⟩
      have hrem_comp_holo : HoloAtZero (fun ε => iterDslope z₀ (m + 1) G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)) :=
        ⟨U', hU'_open, h0_U',
          (hiterDslope_holo hW hz₀ hG (m + 1)).comp
            (differentiableOn_const z₀ |>.add (hz_diff.mono Set.inter_subset_left))
            fun _ hε => hε.2⟩
      let Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε =>
        (dslope z_tilde 0 ε) ^ (m + 1) * iterDslope z₀ (m + 1) G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)
      have hQ_holo : HoloAtZero Q := hHolo_mul (hTay1D_pow hd_z (m + 1)).1 hrem_comp_holo
      have hfn_eq : (fun ε => G (z₀ + z_tilde ε)) =
          fun ε =>
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
              PowerSeries.coeff n (holoTaylor1D G z₀) * (z_tilde ε) ^ n) +
            ε ^ (m + 1) * Q ε := by
        ext ε
        have hexp := hiterDslope_expand z₀ G m (z₀ + z_tilde ε)
        have hsub : (z₀ + z_tilde ε) - z₀ = z_tilde ε := add_sub_cancel_left z₀ (z_tilde ε)
        rw [hsub] at hexp
        have hpow_fac : (z_tilde ε) ^ (m + 1) = ε ^ (m + 1) * (dslope z_tilde 0 ε) ^ (m + 1) := by
          have hs := sub_smul_dslope z_tilde 0 ε
          rw [sub_zero, hz0, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hs
          rw [← hs, mul_pow]
        rw [hexp]
        congr 1
        · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
          rw [hiterDslope_val hW hz₀ n hG]
        · dsimp only [Q]
          rw [hpow_fac, mul_assoc]
      have hsum_part := hTay1D_sum (Finset.range (m + 1))
        (fun n ε => PowerSeries.coeff n (holoTaylor1D G z₀) * (z_tilde ε) ^ n)
        (fun n _ => hHolo_mul (hHolo_const _) (hTay1D_pow hz_h0 n).1)
      have hrem_part_holo : HoloAtZero (fun ε => ε ^ (m + 1) * Q ε) :=
        hHolo_mul (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (m + 1)).1 hQ_holo
      rw [hfn_eq, hTay1D_add hsum_part.1 hrem_part_holo, map_add, hsum_part.2,
        hTay1D_mul (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (m + 1)).1 hQ_holo,
        (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (m + 1)).2, hTay1D_id,
        PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (by omega), add_zero, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      rw [hTay1D_mul (hHolo_const _) (hTay1D_pow hz_h0 n).1,
        hTay1D_const, (hTay1D_pow hz_h0 n).2,
        PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]

    intro k J m W_ψ hW h_ℂ hh g hg α₀ hmid β hβ0
    have hshift_eval : ∀ (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ), c 0 = 0 →
        HoloAtZero (fun ε : ℂ => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), c l * ε ^ (l : ℕ)) ∧
        (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), c l * (0 : ℂ) ^ (l : ℕ)) = 0 ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε : ℂ => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), c l * ε ^ (l : ℕ)) 0 = polyShift c := by
      intro c hc0
      have hs := hTay1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
        (fun (l : Fin (J + 1)) (ε : ℂ) => c l * ε ^ (l : ℕ))
        (fun l _ => hHolo_mul (hHolo_const (c l)) (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (l : ℕ)).1)
      refine ⟨hs.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; simp [hc0]
        · have hne : (l : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl0 (Fin.ext h0)
          rw [zero_pow hne, mul_zero]
      · rw [hs.2]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
        rw [hTay1D_mul (hHolo_const (c l)) (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (l : ℕ)).1,
          hTay1D_const, (hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (l : ℕ)).2, hTay1D_id]
    let pertAng : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := lineArcPertAngles α₀ β
    let ψ_tilde : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ := fun i ε =>
      ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), ((β l i.castSucc + β l i.succ) / 2) * ε ^ (l : ℕ)
    let d_tilde : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ := fun i ε =>
      ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), ((β l i.succ - β l i.castSucc) / 2) * ε ^ (l : ℕ)
    have hmid_eq : ∀ (i : Fin k) (ε : ℂ),
        lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i = lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε := by
      intro i ε
      dsimp only [lineChainMid, pertAng, lineArcPertAngles, ψ_tilde]
      rw [add_add_add_comm, add_div, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
    have hd_eq : ∀ (i : Fin k) (ε : ℂ),
        lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i = lineChainHalfStep α₀ i + d_tilde i ε := by
      intro i ε
      dsimp only [lineChainHalfStep, pertAng, lineArcPertAngles, d_tilde]
      have hsub : (α₀ i.succ + ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (l : ℕ) * β l i.succ) -
          (α₀ i.castSucc + ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (l : ℕ) * β l i.castSucc) =
          (α₀ i.succ - α₀ i.castSucc) +
            ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), (ε ^ (l : ℕ) * β l i.succ - ε ^ (l : ℕ) * β l i.castSucc) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; ring
      rw [hsub, add_div, Finset.sum_div]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by ring
    have hψ_props : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (ψ_tilde i) ∧ ψ_tilde i 0 = 0 ∧
        holoTaylor1D (ψ_tilde i) 0 = polyMidShift β i :=
      fun i => hshift_eval _ (by simp [hβ0])
    have hd_props : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (d_tilde i) ∧ d_tilde i 0 = 0 ∧
        holoTaylor1D (d_tilde i) 0 = polyHalfStepShift β i :=
      fun i => hshift_eval _ (by simp [hβ0])
    have hsup_eval : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i)) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i)) 0 =
          polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hmid_eq i, lineArcPertSupport]
      have hc0 := hTay1D_comp hW (hmid i) hh (hψ_props i).1 (hψ_props i).2.1
      have hcs : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
          HoloAtZero (fun ε => ε ^ (l : ℕ) * g i l (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε)) ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun ε => ε ^ (l : ℕ) * g i l (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε)) 0 =
            PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i) := by
        intro l
        have hcl := hTay1D_comp hW (hmid i) (hg i l) (hψ_props i).1 (hψ_props i).2.1
        have hp := hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (l : ℕ)
        refine ⟨hHolo_mul hp.1 hcl.1, ?_⟩
        rw [hTay1D_mul hp.1 hcl.1, hp.2, hTay1D_id, hcl.2, (hψ_props i).2.2]
      have hsum := hTay1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
        (fun (l : Fin (J + 1)) ε => ε ^ (l : ℕ) * g i l (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε))
        (fun l _ => (hcs l).1)
      refine ⟨hHolo_add hc0.1 hsum.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hTay1D_add hc0.1 hsum.1, hc0.2, (hψ_props i).2.2, hsum.2]
      dsimp only [polySup]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => (hcs l).2
    have hsupDeriv_eval : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i)) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i)) 0 =
          polySupDeriv h_ℂ g α₀ β i := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hmid_eq i, lineArcPertSupportDeriv]
      have hc0 := hTay1D_comp hW (hmid i) (hh.deriv hW) (hψ_props i).1 (hψ_props i).2.1
      have hcs : ∀ l : Fin (J + 1),
          HoloAtZero (fun ε => ε ^ (l : ℕ) * deriv (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε)) ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun ε => ε ^ (l : ℕ) * deriv (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε)) 0 =
            PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β i) := by
        intro l
        have hcl := hTay1D_comp hW (hmid i) ((hg i l).deriv hW) (hψ_props i).1 (hψ_props i).2.1
        have hp := hTay1D_pow hHolo_id (l : ℕ)
        refine ⟨hHolo_mul hp.1 hcl.1, ?_⟩
        rw [hTay1D_mul hp.1 hcl.1, hp.2, hTay1D_id, hcl.2, (hψ_props i).2.2]
      have hsum := hTay1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
        (fun (l : Fin (J + 1)) ε =>
          ε ^ (l : ℕ) * deriv (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i + ψ_tilde i ε))
        (fun l _ => (hcs l).1)
      refine ⟨hHolo_add hc0.1 hsum.1, ?_⟩
      rw [hTay1D_add hc0.1 hsum.1, hc0.2, (hψ_props i).2.2, hsum.2]
      dsimp only [polySupDeriv]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => (hcs l).2
    have hsin_eval : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) 0 =
          polySin α₀ β i := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hd_eq i]
      have hc := hTay1D_comp isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i))
        Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableOn (hd_props i).1 (hd_props i).2.1
      exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.trans (by rw [(hd_props i).2.2])⟩
    have hcos_eval : ∀ i : Fin k,
        HoloAtZero (fun ε => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) ∧
        holoTaylor1D (fun ε => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) 0 =
          polyCos α₀ β i := by
      intro i
      simp_rw [hd_eq i]
      have hc := hTay1D_comp isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i))
        Complex.differentiable_cos.differentiableOn (hd_props i).1 (hd_props i).2.1
      exact ⟨hc.1, hc.2.trans (by rw [(hd_props i).2.2])⟩
    have hjet_eq_coeff : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ,
        lineArcEpsJet m F = PowerSeries.coeff m (holoTaylor1D F 0) := by
      intro F
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hjet_eq_coeff]
      unfold lineChainAction
      have hterms : ∀ i : Fin k,
          HoloAtZero (fun ε =>
            2 * lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i) *
              Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) ∧
          holoTaylor1D (fun ε =>
            2 * lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i) *
              Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i)) 0 =
            2 * polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i * polySin α₀ β i := by
        intro i
        have hm1 := hHolo_mul (hHolo_const 2) (hsup_eval i).1
        refine ⟨hHolo_mul hm1 (hsin_eval i).1, ?_⟩
        rw [hTay1D_mul hm1 (hsin_eval i).1, hTay1D_mul (hHolo_const 2) (hsup_eval i).1,
          hTay1D_const, (hsup_eval i).2, (hsin_eval i).2]
        have hC2 : (PowerSeries.C (2 : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ) = 2 := map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2
        rw [hC2]
      have hsum := hTay1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))
        (fun i ε => 2 * lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε i (lineChainMid (pertAng ε) i) *
          Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (pertAng ε) i))
        (fun i _ => (hterms i).1)
      rw [hsum.2]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hterms i).2
    · intro r
      rw [hjet_eq_coeff]
      unfold lineInteriorGrad
      dsimp only
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have ht1_holo := hHolo_mul (hsupDeriv_eval i_L).1 (hsin_eval i_L).1
      have ht2_holo := hHolo_mul (hsup_eval i_L).1 (hcos_eval i_L).1
      have ht3_holo := hHolo_mul (hsupDeriv_eval i_R).1 (hsin_eval i_R).1
      have ht4_holo := hHolo_mul (hsup_eval i_R).1 (hcos_eval i_R).1
      have h12_holo := hHolo_add ht1_holo ht2_holo
      have h123_holo := hHolo_add h12_holo ht3_holo
      rw [hTay1D_sub h123_holo ht4_holo, hTay1D_add h12_holo ht3_holo,
        hTay1D_add ht1_holo ht2_holo,
        hTay1D_mul (hsupDeriv_eval i_L).1 (hsin_eval i_L).1,
        hTay1D_mul (hsup_eval i_L).1 (hcos_eval i_L).1,
        hTay1D_mul (hsupDeriv_eval i_R).1 (hsin_eval i_R).1,
        hTay1D_mul (hsup_eval i_R).1 (hcos_eval i_R).1,
        (hsupDeriv_eval i_L).2, (hsin_eval i_L).2,
        (hsup_eval i_L).2, (hcos_eval i_L).2,
        (hsupDeriv_eval i_R).2, (hsin_eval i_R).2,
        (hsup_eval i_R).2, (hcos_eval i_R).2]

  
  
  
  let PsEqUpTo (L : ℕ) (P Q : PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
    ∀ n ≤ L, PowerSeries.coeff n P = PowerSeries.coeff n Q
  have hEq_add : ∀ {L : ℕ} {P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ : PowerSeries ℂ},
      PsEqUpTo L P₁ P₂ → PsEqUpTo L Q₁ Q₂ → PsEqUpTo L (P₁ + Q₁) (P₂ + Q₂) :=
    fun hP hQ n hn => by rw [map_add, map_add, hP n hn, hQ n hn]
  have hEq_sub : ∀ {L : ℕ} {P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ : PowerSeries ℂ},
      PsEqUpTo L P₁ P₂ → PsEqUpTo L Q₁ Q₂ → PsEqUpTo L (P₁ - Q₁) (P₂ - Q₂) :=
    fun hP hQ n hn => by rw [map_sub, map_sub, hP n hn, hQ n hn]
  have hEq_mul : ∀ {L : ℕ} {P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ : PowerSeries ℂ},
      PsEqUpTo L P₁ P₂ → PsEqUpTo L Q₁ Q₂ → PsEqUpTo L (P₁ * Q₁) (P₂ * Q₂) := by
    intro L P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ hP hQ n hn
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    rw [hP p.1 (by omega), hQ p.2 (by omega)]
  have hEq_pow : ∀ {L : ℕ} {Z₁ Z₂ : PowerSeries ℂ},
      PsEqUpTo L Z₁ Z₂ → ∀ a : ℕ, PsEqUpTo L (Z₁ ^ a) (Z₂ ^ a) := by
    intro L Z₁ Z₂ hZ a
    induction a with
    | zero => intro _ _; rfl
    | succ a ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
      exact hEq_mul ih hZ
  have hEq_comp : ∀ {L : ℕ} (φ₁ φ₂ : PowerSeries ℂ) {Z₁ Z₂ : PowerSeries ℂ},
      φ₁ = φ₂ → PsEqUpTo L Z₁ Z₂ → PsEqUpTo L (polyComp φ₁ Z₁) (polyComp φ₂ Z₂) := by
    intro L φ₁ φ₂ Z₁ Z₂ hφ hZ n hn
    subst hφ
    rw [coeff_polyComp, coeff_polyComp]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [hEq_pow hZ a n hn]

  have hepsJet_trunc_eq : ∀ {k J₁ J₂ l : ℕ} (_hJ : J₁ ≤ J₂) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J₁)
      {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
      {g₁ : Fin k → Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g₂ : Fin k → Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ}
      (_hg₁ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₁ i m) W_ψ)
      (_hg₂ : ∀ i m, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g₂ i m) W_ψ)
      (_hg₁0 : ∀ i z, g₁ i 0 z = 0) (_hg₂0 : ∀ i z, g₂ i 0 z = 0)
      (_hg_eq : ∀ i (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, g₂ i ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = g₁ i m z)
      {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
      {β₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
      (_hβ₁0 : ∀ s, β₁ 0 s = 0) (_hβ₂0 : ∀ s, β₂ 0 s = 0)
      (_hβ_eq : ∀ (m : Fin (J₁ + 1)) s, β₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ s = β₁ m s),
      lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε)) =
        lineArcEpsJet l
          (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε)) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineArcEpsJet l
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₂ ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₂ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₂ ε) r) =
          lineArcEpsJet l
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g₁ ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g₁ ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β₁ ε) r) := by
    intro k J₁ J₂ l hJ _hl1 hlJ W_ψ hW h_ℂ hh g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ _ _ hg_eq α₀ hmid β₁ β₂ hβ₁0 hβ₂0 hβ_eq
    have hev₂ := hepsJet_poly l hW hh hg₂ hmid hβ₂0
    have hev₁ := hepsJet_poly l hW hh hg₁ hmid hβ₁0
    have hshift_eq : ∀ (c₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ) (c₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ),
        (∀ m : Fin (J₁ + 1), c₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ = c₁ m) →
        PsEqUpTo l (polyShift c₂) (polyShift c₁) := by
      intro c₁ c₂ hc n hn
      rw [coeff_polyShift, coeff_polyShift]
      split_ifs with h2 h1
      · exact hc ⟨n, h1⟩
      · omega
      · omega
      · rfl
    have hmid_shift : ∀ i : Fin k, PsEqUpTo l (polyMidShift β₂ i) (polyMidShift β₁ i) :=
      fun i => hshift_eq _ _ fun m => by simp [hβ_eq m]
    have hd_shift : ∀ i : Fin k, PsEqUpTo l (polyHalfStepShift β₂ i) (polyHalfStepShift β₁ i) :=
      fun i => hshift_eq _ _ fun m => by simp [hβ_eq m]
    have hpert_sum : ∀ (i : Fin k) (F₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (F₂ : Fin (J₂ + 1) → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ m : Fin (J₁ + 1), ∀ z ∈ W_ψ, F₂ ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ z = F₁ m z) →
        PsEqUpTo l
          (∑ m : Fin (J₂ + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (m : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (F₂ m) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β₂ i))
          (∑ m : Fin (J₁ + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (m : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (F₁ m) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (polyMidShift β₁ i)) := by
      intro i F₁ F₂ hF_eq n hn
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      simp_rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
      rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_bij'
        (fun m hm => ⟨m.1, by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2; omega⟩)
        (fun m _ => ⟨m.1, by omega⟩)
        ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro m hm
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2⟩
      · intro m hm
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2⟩
      · intro _ _; ext; rfl
      · intro _ _; ext; rfl
      · intro m hm
        let m₁ : Fin (J₁ + 1) := ⟨m.1, by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2; omega⟩
        have hTay_eq : holoTaylor1D (F₂ m) (lineChainMid α₀ i) =
            holoTaylor1D (F₁ m₁) (lineChainMid α₀ i) := by
          ext a
          rw [holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
          have hev : F₂ m =ᶠ[nhds (lineChainMid α₀ i)] F₁ m₁ :=
            Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds (hmid i)) (hF_eq m₁)
          rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq a]
        exact hEq_comp _ _ hTay_eq (hmid_shift i) (n - m.1) (by omega)
    have hsup_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo l (polySup h_ℂ g₂ α₀ β₂ i) (polySup h_ℂ g₁ α₀ β₁ i) :=
      fun i => hEq_add (hEq_comp _ _ rfl (hmid_shift i)) (hpert_sum i (g₁ i) (g₂ i) (hg_eq i))
    have hsupD_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo l (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g₂ α₀ β₂ i) (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g₁ α₀ β₁ i) := by
      intro i
      refine hEq_add (hEq_comp _ _ rfl (hmid_shift i))
        (hpert_sum i (fun m => deriv (g₁ i m)) (fun m => deriv (g₂ i m)) ?_)
      intro m z hz
      have hev : g₂ i ⟨m.1, by omega⟩ =ᶠ[nhds z] g₁ i m :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hz) (hg_eq i m)
      exact hev.deriv_eq
    have hsin_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, PsEqUpTo l (polySin α₀ β₂ i) (polySin α₀ β₁ i) :=
      fun i => hEq_comp _ _ rfl (hd_shift i)
    have hcos_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, PsEqUpTo l (polyCos α₀ β₂ i) (polyCos α₀ β₁ i) :=
      fun i => hEq_comp _ _ rfl (hd_shift i)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hev₂.1, hev₁.1]
      dsimp only [polyAct]
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      exact hEq_mul (hEq_mul (fun _ _ => rfl) (hsup_eq i)) (hsin_eq i) l le_rfl
    · intro r
      rw [hev₂.2 r, hev₁.2 r]
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      exact hEq_sub
        (hEq_add (hEq_add (hEq_mul (hsupD_eq i_L) (hsin_eq i_L))
          (hEq_mul (hsup_eq i_L) (hcos_eq i_L)))
          (hEq_mul (hsupD_eq i_R) (hsin_eq i_R)))
        (hEq_mul (hsup_eq i_R) (hcos_eq i_R)) l le_rfl

  have hDiffOn_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (s : Finset ι)
      (f : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) V) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, f i q) V := by
    intro ι V s f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hfn : (fun q => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, f i q) =
          (fun q => f a q + ∑ i ∈ s, f i q) := by
        ext q; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [hfn]
      exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
        (ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

  have hepsJet_holo : ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}

      {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)

      (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
      {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),

        (fun q =>

    let PsHoloOn (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
      ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q)) V
    have hPsHolo_add : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHoloOn V P → PsHoloOn V Q → PsHoloOn V (fun q => P q + Q q) :=
      fun hP hQ n => ((hP n).add (hQ n)).congr fun _ _ => map_add _ _ _
    have hPsHolo_sub : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHoloOn V P → PsHoloOn V Q → PsHoloOn V (fun q => P q - Q q) :=
      fun hP hQ n => ((hP n).sub (hQ n)).congr fun _ _ => map_sub _ _ _
    have hPsHolo_mul : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHoloOn V P → PsHoloOn V Q → PsHoloOn V (fun q => P q * Q q) := by
      intro V P Q hP hQ n
      have hsum : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => ∑ u ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n,
            PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q) * PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q)) V :=
        hDiffOn_sum (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n) _
          fun u _ => (hP u.1).mul (hQ u.2)
      exact hsum.congr fun q _ => PowerSeries.coeff_mul n (P q) (Q q)
    have hPsHolo_pow : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Z : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHoloOn V Z → ∀ a : ℕ, PsHoloOn V (fun q => Z q ^ a) := by
      intro V Z hZ a
      induction a with
      | zero => exact fun n => differentiableOn_const (PowerSeries.coeff n 1)
      | succ a ih =>
        have hfn : (fun q => Z q ^ (a + 1)) = (fun q => Z q ^ a * Z q) :=
          funext fun q => pow_succ (Z q) a
        rw [hfn]
        exact hPsHolo_mul ih hZ
    have hPsHolo_X_pow_mul : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (l : ℕ) {P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHoloOn V P → PsHoloOn V (fun q => PowerSeries.X ^ l * P q) := by
      intro V l P hP n
      by_cases hln : l ≤ n
      · exact (hP (n - l)).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h hln).elim]
      · exact (differentiableOn_const 0).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hln h).elim]
    have hPsHolo_sum : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι)
        (P : ι → ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, PsHoloOn V (P i)) → PsHoloOn V (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, P i q) := by
      intro V ι s P hP n
      have hs : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, PowerSeries.coeff n (P i q)) V :=
        hDiffOn_sum s (fun i q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P i q)) fun i hi => hP i hi n
      exact hs.congr fun q _ => map_sum (PowerSeries.coeff n) (fun i => P i q) s
    have hPsHolo_shift : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {J : ℕ} (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c l) V) →
        PsHoloOn V (fun q => polyShift (fun l => c l q)) := by
      intro V J c hc n
      by_cases hn : n < J + 1
      · exact (hc ⟨n, hn⟩).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_pos hn]
      · exact (differentiableOn_const 0).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_neg hn]
    have hiter1D_holo : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G W → ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n G) W := by
      intro W hW G hG n
      induction n with
      | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hG
      | succ n ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact ih.deriv hW
    have hPsHolo_comp : ∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W →
        ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
        ∀ {z₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀ V → (∀ q ∈ V, z₀ q ∈ W) →
        ∀ {Z : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ}, PsHoloOn V Z →
          PsHoloOn V (fun q => polyComp (holoTaylor1D G (z₀ q)) (Z q)) := by
      intro V W hW G hG z₀ hz₀ hmaps Z hZ n
      have hs : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (iteratedDeriv a G (z₀ q) * ((a.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹) *
              PowerSeries.coeff n (Z q ^ a)) V := by
        refine hDiffOn_sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) _ fun a _ => ?_
        have hGa : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => iteratedDeriv a G (z₀ q)) V :=
          (hiter1D_holo hW hG a).comp hz₀ fun q hq => hmaps q hq
        exact (hGa.mul (differentiableOn_const _)).mul (hPsHolo_pow hZ a n)
      refine hs.congr fun q _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_polyComp]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, div_eq_mul_inv]

    intro k J m W_ψ V hW _hV h_ℂ hh g hg _hg0 α₀ hα₀ hmid β hβ hβ0
    have hmid_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) V := by
      intro i
      exact (((hα₀ i.castSucc).add (hα₀ i.succ)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => (div_eq_mul_inv _ 2)
    have hd_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i) V := by
      intro i
      exact (((hα₀ i.succ).sub (hα₀ i.castSucc)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => (div_eq_mul_inv _ 2)
    have hZmid_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, PsHoloOn V (fun q => polyMidShift (fun l s => β l s q) i) := by
      intro i
      refine hPsHolo_shift _ fun l => ?_
      exact (((hβ l i.castSucc).add (hβ l i.succ)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => (div_eq_mul_inv _ 2)
    have hZd_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, PsHoloOn V (fun q => polyHalfStepShift (fun l s => β l s q) i) := by
      intro i
      refine hPsHolo_shift _ fun l => ?_
      exact (((hβ l i.succ).sub (hβ l i.castSucc)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr

    have hsup_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,

      refine hPsHolo_add
        (hPsHolo_comp hW hh (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i) (hZmid_holo i))
        (hPsHolo_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
          (fun l q => PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
              (polyMidShift (fun l s => β l s q) i))
          fun l _ =>
            hPsHolo_X_pow_mul (l : ℕ)
              (hPsHolo_comp hW (hg i l) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i) (hZmid_holo i)))
    have hsupD_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsHoloOn V (fun q => polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) := by
      intro i
      refine hPsHolo_add
        (hPsHolo_comp hW (hh.deriv hW) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i) (hZmid_holo i))
        (hPsHolo_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
          (fun l q => PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
              (polyMidShift (fun l s => β l s q) i))
          fun l _ =>
            hPsHolo_X_pow_mul (l : ℕ)
              (hPsHolo_comp hW ((hg i l).deriv hW) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i)
                (hZmid_holo i)))
    have hsin_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsHoloOn V (fun q => polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) :=
      fun i => hPsHolo_comp isOpen_univ Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableOn
        (hd_holo i) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (hZd_holo i)
    have hcos_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsHoloOn V (fun q => polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) :=

    have hact_holo : PsHoloOn V
        (fun q => polyAct h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q)) :=
      hPsHolo_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))
        (fun i q => 2 * polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i *
          polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i)
        fun i _ => hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_mul hconst2_holo (hsup_holo i)) (hsin_holo i)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hact_holo m).congr fun q hq =>
        (hepsJet_poly m hW hh hg (hmid q hq) (fun s => hβ0 s q)).1
    · intro r
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩

              (hPsHolo_mul (hsup_holo i_L) (hcos_holo i_L)))
            (hPsHolo_mul (hsupD_holo i_R) (hsin_holo i_R)))
          (hPsHolo_mul (hsup_holo i_R) (hcos_holo i_R))
      exact (hgrad_holo m).congr fun q hq =>
        (hepsJet_poly m hW hh hg (hmid q hq) (fun s => hβ0 s q)).2 r

  
  
  
  have hepsJet_succ_split :
      ∀ {k J : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ)
      {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
      {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} {g_top : Fin k → ℂ → ℂ}
      (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
      (_hg_top : ∀ i, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_top i) W_ψ)
      (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
      (_hmid : ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid α₀ i ∈ W_ψ)
      {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ} {β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}
      (_hβ0 : ∀ s, β 0 s = 0) (_hβ_top_end : β_top 0 = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) = 0),

      let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
      let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε)) =

          (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β ε)) +
        (∑ i : Fin k, 2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i)) +
        (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
          lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) α₀ r *
            β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_ext ε) r) =
          lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g_ext ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g_ext ε) (lineArcPertAngles α₀ β_zero_top ε) r) +
          ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
              α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ := by
    intro k J hk W_ψ hW h_ℂ hh g g_top hg hg_top hg0 α₀ hmid β β_top hβ0 hβ_top_end
    dsimp only
    let g_ext : Fin k → Fin (J + 1 + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => Fin.snoc (g i) (g_top i)
    let β_ext : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β β_top
    let β_zero_top : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := Fin.snoc β (fun _ => 0)
    have hg_ext_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1 + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_ext i l) W_ψ := by
      intro i l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l
      · dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hg_top i
      · intro m; dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hg i m
    have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = (0 : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc := rfl
