    have hβ_ext0 : ∀ s, β_ext 0 s = 0 := by
      intro s; dsimp only [β_ext]; rw [h0_eq, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hβ0 s
    have hβ_z0 : ∀ s, β_zero_top 0 s = 0 := by
      intro s; dsimp only [β_zero_top]; rw [h0_eq, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hβ0 s
    let M : ℕ := J + 1
    have hM_def : M = J + 1 := rfl
    have hev_ext := hepsJet_poly M hW hh hg_ext_holo hmid hβ_ext0
    have hev_base := hepsJet_poly M hW hh hg hmid hβ0
    have hev_ztop := hepsJet_poly M hW hh hg_ext_holo hmid hβ_z0

    have hshift_snoc : ∀ (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) (c_top : ℂ),
        polyShift (Fin.snoc c c_top) = polyShift c + PowerSeries.C c_top * PowerSeries.X ^ M := by
      intro c c_top
      dsimp only [polyShift]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.snoc_last]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl

    have hcomp_pert : ∀ (φ Z : PowerSeries ℂ) (c : ℂ),
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 Z = 0 →
        PsEqUpTo J (polyComp φ (Z + PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) (polyComp φ Z) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polyComp φ Z) = PowerSeries.coeff 0 φ ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polyComp φ (Z + PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polyComp φ Z) + PowerSeries.coeff 1 φ * c := by
      intro φ Z c hZ0
      let W : PowerSeries ℂ := PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X ^ M
      have hW_lt : ∀ n ≤ J, PowerSeries.coeff n W = 0 := by
        intro n hn
        dsimp only [W]
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow,
          ite_eq_right_iff.mpr (by omega), mul_zero]
      have hZW_eq : PsEqUpTo J (Z + W) Z := fun n hn => by rw [map_add, hW_lt n hn, add_zero]
      refine ⟨hEq_comp φ φ rfl hZW_eq, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [coeff_polyComp, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_zero,
          PowerSeries.coeff_one, ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h rfl).elim, mul_one]
      · have hXdvdZ : PowerSeries.X ∣ Z :=
          PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mpr (by rwa [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff])
        have hXdvdW : PowerSeries.X ^ M ∣ W := ⟨PowerSeries.C c, mul_comm _ _⟩
        have hpow_ge2 : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → PowerSeries.coeff M ((Z + W) ^ n) = PowerSeries.coeff M (Z ^ n) := by
          intro n hn2
          rw [add_pow Z W n, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one,
            Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, map_add, map_sum]
          have hsum0 : (∑ a ∈ Finset.range n,
              PowerSeries.coeff M (Z ^ a * W ^ (n - a) * (n.choose a : PowerSeries ℂ))) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha => ?_
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
            have hd1 : PowerSeries.X ^ a ∣ Z ^ a := pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hXdvdZ a
            have hd2 : PowerSeries.X ^ (M * (n - a)) ∣ W ^ (n - a) := by
              rw [pow_mul]; exact pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hXdvdW (n - a)
            have hd_tot : PowerSeries.X ^ (a + M * (n - a)) ∣
                Z ^ a * W ^ (n - a) * (n.choose a : PowerSeries ℂ) := by
              rw [pow_add]; exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (mul_dvd_mul hd1 hd2) _
            have hM_lt : M < a + M * (n - a) := by
              have hM_pos : 1 ≤ M := Nat.succ_pos J
              rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha_pos
              · rw [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add]
                nlinarith
              · have h1 : 1 ≤ n - a := by omega
                have h2 : M * 1 ≤ M * (n - a) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M h1
                linarith
            exact PowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff.mp hd_tot M hM_lt
          rw [hsum0, zero_add]
        have hdiff : PowerSeries.coeff M (polyComp φ (Z + W)) - PowerSeries.coeff M (polyComp φ Z) =
            PowerSeries.coeff 1 φ * c := by
          rw [coeff_polyComp, coeff_polyComp, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          simp_rw [← mul_sub]
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 1 ?_ ?_]
          · have hWM : PowerSeries.coeff M W = c := by
              dsimp only [W]
              rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow,
                ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h rfl).elim, mul_one]
            rw [pow_one, pow_one, map_add, add_sub_cancel_left, hWM]
          · intro n _ hne1
            rcases n with _ | _ | m'
            · rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, sub_self, mul_zero]
            · exact False.elim (hne1 rfl)
            · rw [hpow_ge2 (m' + 2) (by omega), sub_self, mul_zero]
          · intro hnot
            exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
        linear_combination hdiff

    have hmul_pert : ∀ {P₁ P₀ Q₁ Q₀ : PowerSeries ℂ} {dp dq : ℂ},
        PsEqUpTo J P₁ P₀ → PsEqUpTo J Q₁ Q₀ →
        PowerSeries.coeff M P₁ = PowerSeries.coeff M P₀ + dp →
        PowerSeries.coeff M Q₁ = PowerSeries.coeff M Q₀ + dq →
        PowerSeries.coeff M (P₁ * Q₁) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (P₀ * Q₀) + dp * PowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₀ +
            PowerSeries.coeff 0 P₀ * dq := by
      intro P₁ P₀ Q₁ Q₀ dp dq hP hQ hPM hQM
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
          (fun a b => PowerSeries.coeff a P₁ * PowerSeries.coeff b Q₁) M,
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
          (fun a b => PowerSeries.coeff a P₀ * PowerSeries.coeff b Q₀) M]
      have hsplit_M : ∀ f : ℕ → ℂ,
          (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (M + 1), f a) =
            f 0 + (∑ b ∈ Finset.range J, f (b + 1)) + f M := by
        intro f
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        have hsub : (∑ a ∈ Finset.range M, f a) = (∑ b ∈ Finset.range J, f (b + 1)) + f 0 :=
          Finset.sum_range_succ' f J
        rw [hsub]
        ring
      rw [hsplit_M (fun a => PowerSeries.coeff a P₁ * PowerSeries.coeff (M - a) Q₁),
        hsplit_M (fun a => PowerSeries.coeff a P₀ * PowerSeries.coeff (M - a) Q₀)]
      have hmid_sum :
          (∑ b ∈ Finset.range J,
            PowerSeries.coeff (b + 1) P₁ * PowerSeries.coeff (M - (b + 1)) Q₁) =
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range J,
            PowerSeries.coeff (b + 1) P₀ * PowerSeries.coeff (M - (b + 1)) Q₀ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hb
        have hb1 : b + 1 ≤ J := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hb
        have hb2 : M - (b + 1) ≤ J := by change (J + 1) - (b + 1) ≤ J; omega
        rw [hP (b + 1) hb1, hQ (M - (b + 1)) hb2]
      have hM_sub : M - M = 0 := Nat.sub_self M
      have hP0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 P₁ = PowerSeries.coeff 0 P₀ := hP 0 (Nat.zero_le J)
      have hQ0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₁ = PowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₀ := hQ 0 (Nat.zero_le J)
      rw [hmid_sum, Nat.sub_zero, hM_sub, hP0, hQ0, hPM, hQM]
      ring

    have hTay0 : ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ), PowerSeries.coeff 0 (holoTaylor1D F z₀) = F z₀ := by
      intro F z₀; simp [holoTaylor1D]
    have hTay1 : ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ), PowerSeries.coeff 1 (holoTaylor1D F z₀) = deriv F z₀ := by
      intro F z₀; simp [holoTaylor1D, iteratedDeriv_one]
    have hComp_zero : ∀ Z : PowerSeries ℂ, polyComp 0 Z = 0 := by
      intro Z; ext n; simp [coeff_polyComp]
    have hholo_zero : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, holoTaylor1D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) z₀ = 0 := by
      intro z₀; ext n; rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
      split_ifs <;> simp

    let Z_mid : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i => polyMidShift β i
    let Z_d : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i => polyHalfStepShift β i
    let ψ_top : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => (β_top i.castSucc + β_top i.succ) / 2
    let d_top : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => (β_top i.succ - β_top i.castSucc) / 2
    have hZmid0 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (Z_mid i) = 0 := by
      intro i; dsimp only [Z_mid, polyMidShift]; rw [coeff_polyShift]; simp [hβ0]
    have hZd0 : ∀ i : Fin k, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (Z_d i) = 0 := by
      intro i; dsimp only [Z_d, polyHalfStepShift]; rw [coeff_polyShift]; simp [hβ0]
    have hmid_ext_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
        polyMidShift β_ext i = Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polyMidShift, β_ext, Z_mid, ψ_top]
      rw [← hshift_snoc]
      congr 1; ext l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l <;> simp
    have hmid_ztop_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, polyMidShift β_zero_top i = Z_mid i := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polyMidShift, β_zero_top, Z_mid]
      have h := hshift_snoc (fun l => (β l i.castSucc + β l i.succ) / 2) 0
      rw [map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
      rw [← h]
      congr 1; ext l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l <;> simp
    have hd_ext_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
        polyHalfStepShift β_ext i = Z_d i + PowerSeries.C (d_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polyHalfStepShift, β_ext, Z_d, d_top]
      rw [← hshift_snoc]
      congr 1; ext l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l <;> simp
    have hd_ztop_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, polyHalfStepShift β_zero_top i = Z_d i := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polyHalfStepShift, β_zero_top, Z_d]
      have h := hshift_snoc (fun l => (β l i.succ - β l i.castSucc) / 2) 0
      rw [map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
      rw [← h]
      congr 1; ext l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l <;> simp

    have hpert_inv : ∀ (i : Fin k) (F : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ),
        F 0 = (fun _ => 0) →
        PsEqUpTo M
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (F l) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M))
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (F l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (F l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) = 0 := by
      intro i F hF0
      refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_sum, map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; rw [hF0, hholo_zero, hComp_zero, hComp_zero]
        · have hl_pos : 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) := by
            have : (l : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl0 (Fin.ext h0)
            omega
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul']
          split_ifs with hln
          · exact (hcomp_pert _ (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i) (hZmid0 i)).1 (n - (l : ℕ)) (by omega)
          · rfl
      · rw [map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => ?_
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; rw [hF0, hholo_zero, hComp_zero, mul_zero, map_zero]
        · have hl_pos : 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) := by
            have : (l : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl0 (Fin.ext h0)
            omega
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega)]

    have hsin_pert : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo J (polySin α₀ β_ext i) (polySin α₀ β i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polySin α₀ β i) = Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β_ext i) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β i) +
            Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * d_top i := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polySin]
      rw [hd_ext_eq i]
      have hp := hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)) (Z_d i) (d_top i)
        (hZd0 i)
      refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1.trans (hTay0 _ _), ?_⟩
      rw [hp.2.2, hTay1, Complex.deriv_sin]

    have hcos_pert : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo J (polyCos α₀ β_ext i) (polyCos α₀ β i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polyCos α₀ β i) = Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β_ext i) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β i) -
            Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * d_top i := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polyCos]
      rw [hd_ext_eq i]
      have hp := hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)) (Z_d i) (d_top i)
        (hZd0 i)
      refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1.trans (hTay0 _ _), ?_⟩
      rw [hp.2.2, hTay1, Complex.deriv_cos]
      ring

    have hsup_pert_act : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo J (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) (polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i) = h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i) +
            deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * ψ_top i + g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i) := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [polySup]
      rw [hmid_ext_eq i, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
      have hcast_sum :
          (∑ l : Fin M, PowerSeries.X ^ (l.castSucc : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_ext i l.castSucc) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) =
          ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
        dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
      have hlast_term :
          PowerSeries.X ^ (Fin.last M : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_ext i (Fin.last M)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) =
          PowerSeries.X ^ M *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) := by
        dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_last]; rfl
      rw [hcast_sum, hlast_term]
      have hc0 := hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i) (hZmid0 i)
      have hpi := hpert_inv i (g i) (funext (hg0 i))
      refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hc0.1 n hn, hpi.1 n (Nat.le_succ_of_le hn),
          PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn)), add_zero]
      · rw [map_add, hc0.2.1, hTay0, hpi.2, add_zero]
      · have htop_M :
            PowerSeries.coeff M (PowerSeries.X ^ M *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
                (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) =
            g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i) := by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos le_rfl,
            Nat.sub_self,
            (hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i)
              (hZmid0 i)).1 0 (Nat.zero_le J),
            (hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i)
              (hZmid0 i)).2.1,
            hTay0]
        rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hc0.2.2, hTay1, hpi.1 M le_rfl, htop_M]
        ring

    have hsup_pert_grad : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo J (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) = h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) +
            deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * ψ_top i := by
      intro i
      have hbase_eq : polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i =
          polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i +
            PowerSeries.X ^ M * polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) := by
        have hsum_split :
            (∑ l : Fin (M + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_ext i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) =
            (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) +
            PowerSeries.X ^ M * polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) := by
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
          congr 1
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
            dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
          · dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_last]; rfl
        dsimp only [polySup]
        rw [hmid_ztop_eq i, hsum_split]
        exact (add_assoc _ _ _).symm
      have hact := hsup_pert_act i
      refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · conv_rhs =>
          rw [hbase_eq, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
            if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn)), add_zero]
        exact hact.1 n hn
      · rw [hbase_eq, map_add, hact.2.1, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.succ_pos J)), add_zero]
      · conv_rhs =>
          arg 1
          rw [hbase_eq, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
            if_pos le_rfl, Nat.sub_self,
            (hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D (g_top i) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i)
              (hZmid0 i)).2.1,
            hTay0]
        rw [hact.2.2]
        ring

    have hsupD_pert_grad : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsEqUpTo J (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) =
          deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) ∧
        PowerSeries.coeff M (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i) +
            deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (lineChainMid α₀ i) * ψ_top i := by
      intro i
      have hext_eq : polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i =
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv h_ℂ) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
            (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) +
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) +
          PowerSeries.X ^ M *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_top i)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
              (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) := by
        have hsum_split :
            (∑ l : Fin (M + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_ext i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
                (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) =
            (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
                (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M)) +
            PowerSeries.X ^ M *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_top i)) (lineChainMid α₀ i))
                (Z_mid i + PowerSeries.C (ψ_top i) * PowerSeries.X ^ M) := by
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
          congr 1
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
            dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
          · dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_last]; rfl
        dsimp only [polySupDeriv]
        rw [hmid_ext_eq i, hsum_split, ← add_assoc]
      have hz_eq : polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i =
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv h_ℂ) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) +
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) +
          PowerSeries.X ^ M *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_top i)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) := by
        have hsum_split :
            (∑ l : Fin (M + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_ext i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) =
            (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)) +
            PowerSeries.X ^ M *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_top i)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) := by
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
          congr 1
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
            dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
          · dsimp only [g_ext]; rw [Fin.snoc_last]; rfl
        dsimp only [polySupDeriv]
        rw [hmid_ztop_eq i, hsum_split, ← add_assoc]
      rw [hext_eq, hz_eq]
      have hdg0 : deriv (g i 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
        have h0fn : g i 0 = fun _ => 0 := funext (hg0 i)
        rw [h0fn]; ext z; exact deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
      have hc0 := hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D (deriv h_ℂ) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i) (ψ_top i)
        (hZmid0 i)
      have hpi := hpert_inv i (fun l => deriv (g i l)) hdg0
      have hctop := hcomp_pert (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g_top i)) (lineChainMid α₀ i)) (Z_mid i)
        (ψ_top i) (hZmid0 i)
      refine ⟨fun n hn => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hc0.1 n hn, hpi.1 n (Nat.le_succ_of_le hn),
          PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn)),
          if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))]
      · rw [map_add, map_add, hc0.2.1, hTay0, hpi.2, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          if_neg (not_le.mpr (Nat.succ_pos J)), add_zero, add_zero]
      · rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hc0.2.2, hTay1, hpi.1 M le_rfl,
          PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul',
          if_pos le_rfl, if_pos le_rfl, Nat.sub_self,
          hctop.1 0 (Nat.zero_le J)]
        ring

    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hev_ext.1, hev_base.1]
      dsimp only [polyAct]
      rw [map_sum, map_sum]
      have hterm_split : ∀ i : Fin k,
          PowerSeries.coeff M (2 * polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i * polySin α₀ β_ext i) =
            PowerSeries.coeff M (2 * polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i * polySin α₀ β i) +
              2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) * g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i) +
              ((deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) -
                  h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)) *
                  β_top i.castSucc +
                (deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) +
                  h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)) *
                  β_top i.succ) := by
        intro i
        have htwo_mul : ∀ P : PowerSeries ℂ, ∀ n : ℕ,
            PowerSeries.coeff n (2 * P) = 2 * PowerSeries.coeff n P := by
          intro P n
          have hC2 : (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) = PowerSeries.C 2 := (map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2).symm
          rw [hC2, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
        have h2sup_eq : PsEqUpTo J (2 * polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) (2 * polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i) :=
          fun n hn => by rw [htwo_mul, htwo_mul, (hsup_pert_act i).1 n hn]
        have h2sup_M : PowerSeries.coeff M (2 * polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i) =
            PowerSeries.coeff M (2 * polySup h_ℂ g α₀ β i) +
              2 * (deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * ψ_top i + g_top i (lineChainMid α₀ i)) := by
          rw [htwo_mul, htwo_mul, (hsup_pert_act i).2.2]; ring
        have hm := hmul_pert h2sup_eq (hsin_pert i).1 h2sup_M (hsin_pert i).2.2
        rw [hm, htwo_mul _ 0, (hsup_pert_act i).2.1, (hsin_pert i).2.1]
        dsimp only [ψ_top, d_top]
        ring
      simp_rw [hterm_split, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      let A : Fin k → ℂ := fun i =>
        deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) -
          h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)
      let B_seg : Fin k → ℂ := fun i =>
        deriv h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i) +
          h_ℂ (lineChainMid α₀ i) * Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i)
      change (∑ i : Fin k, A i * β_top i.castSucc) + (∑ i : Fin k, B_seg i * β_top i.succ) = _
      have hsum_cast : (∑ i : Fin k, A i * β_top i.castSucc) =
          ∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
            A ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ * β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
        let S_pos := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => 1 ≤ i.1)
        have hfilt : (∑ i : Fin k, A i * β_top i.castSucc) =
            ∑ i ∈ S_pos, A i * β_top i.castSucc := by
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun i _ hi_not => ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi_not
          have hi0 : i.castSucc = 0 := Fin.ext (by
            have : ¬ 1 ≤ i.1 := fun h => hi_not ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, h⟩
            change i.1 = 0; omega)
          rw [hi0, hβ_top_end.1, mul_zero]
        rw [hfilt]
        refine Finset.sum_bij'
          (fun i hi => ⟨i.1 - 1, by have := i.2; have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; omega⟩)
          (fun r _ => ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
          (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
          (fun r _ => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by dsimp; omega⟩)
          (fun i hi => Fin.ext (by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; dsimp; omega))
          (fun r _ => Fin.ext (by dsimp))
          (fun i hi => by
            have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
            have hi_eq : (⟨i.1 - 1 + 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩ : Fin k) = i :=
              Fin.ext (by dsimp; omega)
            have hc_eq : (⟨i.1 - 1 + 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = i.castSucc :=
              Fin.ext (by dsimp; omega)
            rw [hi_eq, hc_eq])
      have hsum_succ : (∑ i : Fin k, B_seg i * β_top i.succ) =
          ∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
            B_seg ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ * β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
        let S_lt := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => i.1 < k - 1)
        have hfilt : (∑ i : Fin k, B_seg i * β_top i.succ) =
            ∑ i ∈ S_lt, B_seg i * β_top i.succ := by
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun i _ hi_not => ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi_not
          have hilast : i.succ = Fin.last k := Fin.ext (by
            have : ¬ i.1 < k - 1 := fun h => hi_not ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, h⟩
            have := i.2
            change i.1 + 1 = k; omega)
          rw [hilast, hβ_top_end.2, mul_zero]
        rw [hfilt]
        refine Finset.sum_bij'
          (fun i hi => ⟨i.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩)
          (fun r _ => ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
          (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
          (fun r _ => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, r.2⟩)
          (fun _ _ => Fin.ext rfl)
          (fun _ _ => Fin.ext rfl)
          (fun _ _ => rfl)
      rw [hsum_cast, hsum_succ, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
      unfold lineInteriorGrad
      dsimp only [A, B_seg]
      ring

    · intro r
      rw [hev_ext.2 r, hev_ztop.2 r]
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let v₀ : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let v₁ : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let v₂ : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨r.1 + 2, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have hsin_zL : polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_L = polySin α₀ β i_L := by
        dsimp only [polySin]; rw [hd_ztop_eq i_L]
      have hcos_zL : polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_L = polyCos α₀ β i_L := by
        dsimp only [polyCos]; rw [hd_ztop_eq i_L]
      have hsin_zR : polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_R = polySin α₀ β i_R := by
        dsimp only [polySin]; rw [hd_ztop_eq i_R]
      have hcos_zR : polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_R = polyCos α₀ β i_R := by
        dsimp only [polyCos]; rw [hd_ztop_eq i_R]
      have hsin_pL : PsEqUpTo J (polySin α₀ β_ext i_L) (polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_L) := by
        rw [hsin_zL]; exact (hsin_pert i_L).1
      have hsin_ML : PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β_ext i_L) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_L) +
            Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_L) * d_top i_L := by
        rw [hsin_zL]; exact (hsin_pert i_L).2.2
      have hcos_pL : PsEqUpTo J (polyCos α₀ β_ext i_L) (polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_L) := by
        rw [hcos_zL]; exact (hcos_pert i_L).1
      have hcos_ML : PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β_ext i_L) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_L) +
            (-Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_L) * d_top i_L) := by
        rw [hcos_zL, (hcos_pert i_L).2.2]; ring
      have hsin_pR : PsEqUpTo J (polySin α₀ β_ext i_R) (polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_R) := by
        rw [hsin_zR]; exact (hsin_pert i_R).1
      have hsin_MR : PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β_ext i_R) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_R) +
            Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_R) * d_top i_R := by
        rw [hsin_zR]; exact (hsin_pert i_R).2.2
      have hcos_pR : PsEqUpTo J (polyCos α₀ β_ext i_R) (polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_R) := by
        rw [hcos_zR]; exact (hcos_pert i_R).1
      have hcos_MR : PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β_ext i_R) =
          PowerSeries.coeff M (polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_R) +
            (-Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_R) * d_top i_R) := by
        rw [hcos_zR, (hcos_pert i_R).2.2]; ring
      have hp1 := hmul_pert (hsupD_pert_grad i_L).1 hsin_pL (hsupD_pert_grad i_L).2.2 hsin_ML
      have hp2 := hmul_pert (hsup_pert_grad i_L).1 hcos_pL (hsup_pert_grad i_L).2.2 hcos_ML
      have hp3 := hmul_pert (hsupD_pert_grad i_R).1 hsin_pR (hsupD_pert_grad i_R).2.2 hsin_MR
      have hp4 := hmul_pert (hsup_pert_grad i_R).1 hcos_pR (hsup_pert_grad i_R).2.2 hcos_MR
      dsimp only [polyGrad]
      change PowerSeries.coeff M
          (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i_L * polySin α₀ β_ext i_L +
            polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i_L * polyCos α₀ β_ext i_L +
            polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i_R * polySin α₀ β_ext i_R -
            polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_ext i_R * polyCos α₀ β_ext i_R) =
        PowerSeries.coeff M
          (polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i_L * polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_L +
            polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i_L * polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_L +
            polySupDeriv h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i_R * polySin α₀ β_zero_top i_R -
            polySup h_ℂ g_ext α₀ β_zero_top i_R * polyCos α₀ β_zero_top i_R) + _
      rw [map_sub, map_add, map_add, map_sub, map_add, map_add, hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4,
        (hsupD_pert_grad i_L).2.1, (hsup_pert_grad i_L).2.1,
        (hsupD_pert_grad i_R).2.1, (hsup_pert_grad i_R).2.1,
        hsin_zL, hcos_zL, hsin_zR, hcos_zR,
        (hsin_pert i_L).2.1, (hcos_pert i_L).2.1,
        (hsin_pert i_R).2.1, (hcos_pert i_R).2.1]
      let ψ_L := lineChainMid α₀ i_L
      let d_L := lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_L
      let ψ_R := lineChainMid α₀ i_R
      let d_R := lineChainHalfStep α₀ i_R
      let H_diag : ℂ :=
        ((deriv (deriv h_ℂ) ψ_L - h_ℂ ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L +
          deriv h_ℂ ψ_L * Complex.cos d_L) +
        ((deriv (deriv h_ℂ) ψ_R - h_ℂ ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R -
          deriv h_ℂ ψ_R * Complex.cos d_R)
      let H_sup : ℂ := (h_ℂ ψ_R + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) ψ_R) / 2 * Complex.sin d_R
      let H_sub : ℂ := (h_ℂ ψ_L + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) ψ_L) / 2 * Complex.sin d_L
      have hhess_sum :
          (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
              α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩) =
          H_diag * β_top v₁ + H_sup * β_top v₂ + H_sub * β_top v₀ := by
        have hsplit : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1),
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv (deriv h_ℂ))
              α₀ r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ =
            (if r.1 = s.1 then H_diag * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) +
            (if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then H_sup * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) +
            (if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then H_sub * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) := by
          intro s
          unfold lineInteriorHess
          dsimp only [H_diag, H_sup, H_sub, ψ_L, d_L, ψ_R, d_R, i_L, i_R]
          split_ifs <;> try omega
          all_goals ring
        simp_rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        have hs1 :
            (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
              if r.1 = s.1 then H_diag * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) =
            H_diag * β_top v₁ := by
          refine (Finset.sum_eq_single r ?_ ?_).trans (by simp [v₁])
          · intro s _ hs_ne
            have hne : r.1 ≠ s.1 := fun heq => hs_ne (Fin.ext heq.symm)
            exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
          · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ r))
        have hs2 :
            (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
              if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then H_sup * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) =
            H_sup * β_top v₂ := by
          by_cases hlt : r.1 + 1 < k - 1
          · refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨r.1 + 1, hlt⟩ : Fin (k - 1)) ?_ ?_).trans (by simp [v₂])
            · intro s _ hs_ne
              have hne : s.1 ≠ r.1 + 1 := fun heq => hs_ne (Fin.ext heq)
              exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
            · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _))
          · have hzero : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
                if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then H_sup * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) = 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => ?_
              have hne : s.1 ≠ r.1 + 1 := by have := s.2; omega
              exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
            have hv2_last : v₂ = Fin.last k := Fin.ext (by have := r.2; dsimp [v₂]; omega)
            rw [hzero, hv2_last, hβ_top_end.2, mul_zero]
        have hs3 :
            (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
              if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then H_sub * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) =
            H_sub * β_top v₀ := by
          by_cases hpos : 0 < r.1
          · refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨r.1 - 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ : Fin (k - 1)) ?_ ?_).trans ?_
            · intro s _ hs_ne
              have hne : r.1 ≠ s.1 + 1 := fun heq => hs_ne (Fin.ext (by dsimp; omega))
              exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
            · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _))
            · have heq : r.1 = r.1 - 1 + 1 := by omega
              have hv0 : (⟨r.1 - 1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = v₀ :=
                Fin.ext (by dsimp [v₀]; omega)
              rw [ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h heq).elim, hv0]
          · have hzero : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
                if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then H_sub * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ else 0) = 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => ?_
              have hne : r.1 ≠ s.1 + 1 := by omega
              exact ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hne h).elim
            have hv0_zero : v₀ = 0 := Fin.ext (by dsimp [v₀]; omega)
            rw [hzero, hv0_zero, hβ_top_end.1, mul_zero]
        rw [hs1, hs2, hs3]
      rw [hhess_sum]
      have hcL : i_L.castSucc = v₀ := rfl
      have hsL : i_L.succ = v₁ := rfl
      have hcR : i_R.castSucc = v₁ := rfl
      have hsR : i_R.succ = v₂ := rfl
      dsimp only [ψ_top, d_top, H_diag, H_sup, H_sub, ψ_L, d_L, ψ_R, d_R]
      rw [hcL, hsL, hcR, hsR]
      ring

  
  
  
  have coeff_pack2D1D : ∀ (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcPack2D1D F) =
        PowerSeries.mk (fun l => MvPowerSeries.coeff d (F l)) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have coeff_slice2D1D : ∀ (l : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcSlice2D1D l S) =
        PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have slice_pack2D1D : ∀ (l : ℕ) (F : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      lineArcSlice2D1D l (lineArcPack2D1D F) = F l := by
    intro l F; ext d; rw [coeff_slice2D1D, coeff_pack2D1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

  let embedBase (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
    fun d => PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff d U)
  have coeff_embedBase : ∀ (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (embedBase U) = PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff d U) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have embedBase_pow : ∀ (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (b : ℕ),
      (embedBase U) ^ b = embedBase (U ^ b) := by
    intro U b
    induction b with
    | zero =>
      ext d
      rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, coeff_embedBase, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    | succ b ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]
      refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun d => ?_
      rw [coeff_embedBase, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_embedBase, coeff_embedBase, map_mul]

  have htaylor2D_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ},
      IsOpen V → p₁ ∈ V → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) V) →
      taylor2D (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, f i q) p₁ = ∑ i ∈ s, taylor2D (f i) p₁ := by
    intro ι V p₁ hV hp₁ s f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa using htaylor2D_const p₁ 0
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hfn : (fun q => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, f i q) =
          (fun q => f a q + ∑ i ∈ s, f i q) := by
        ext q; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      have hs_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, f i q) V :=
        hDiffOn_sum s f fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      rw [hfn, Finset.sum_insert ha,
        (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) hs_holo).1,
        ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)]

  have htaylor2D_epsJet_eq :
      ∀ {k J : ℕ} (m : ℕ) {W_ψ : Set ℂ} {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ}
      (_hW : IsOpen W_ψ) (_hV : IsOpen V) (_hp₁ : p₁ ∈ V)
      {h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ} (_hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ W_ψ)
      {g : Fin k → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ} (_hg : ∀ i l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i l) W_ψ)
      (_hg0 : ∀ i z, g i 0 z = 0) {α₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      (_hα₀ : ∀ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (α₀ s) V)
      (_hmid : ∀ q ∈ V, ∀ i : Fin k, lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i ∈ W_ψ)
      {β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      (_hβ : ∀ l s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (β l s) V) (_hβ0 : ∀ s q, β 0 s q = 0),
      let sin_d0 := fun i => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      let cos_d0 := fun i => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      let f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i l =>
        if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
        else if hl : l < J + 1 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
        else 0
      let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l s =>
        if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (α₀ s) p₁
        else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
        else 0
      taylor2D
          (fun q =>
            lineArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε =>
                lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                  (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε)))
          p₁ =
        lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D
            (fun q =>
              lineArcEpsJet m
                (fun ε =>
                  lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
                    (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
                    (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r))
            p₁ =
          lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq r) := by
    intro k J m W_ψ V p₁ hW hV hp₁ h_ℂ hh g hg hg0 α₀ hα₀ hmid β hβ hβ0
    dsimp only
    let sin_d0 := fun i => Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let cos_d0 := fun i => Complex.cos (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
    let f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i l =>
      if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)
      else 0
    let β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l s =>
      if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (α₀ s) p₁
      else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
      else 0

    let PsHolo (P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
      ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q)) V
    let T2D1D (P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
      lineArcPack2D1D (fun n => taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q)) p₁)
    have coeff_T2D1D : ∀ (P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff n (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (T2D1D P)) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q)) p₁) := by
      intro P d n
      dsimp only [T2D1D]
      rw [coeff_pack2D1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

    have hiter1D_holo : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G W → ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n G) W := by
      intro W hW_open G hG n
      induction n with
      | zero => simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using hG
      | succ n ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact ih.deriv hW_open

    have hPsHolo_const : ∀ φ : PowerSeries ℂ, PsHolo (fun _ => φ) :=
      fun φ n => differentiableOn_const (PowerSeries.coeff n φ)
    have hPsHolo_add : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → PsHolo (fun q => P q + Q q) :=
      fun hP hQ n => ((hP n).add (hQ n)).congr fun _ _ => map_add _ _ _
    have hPsHolo_sub : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → PsHolo (fun q => P q - Q q) :=
      fun hP hQ n => ((hP n).sub (hQ n)).congr fun _ _ => map_sub _ _ _
    have hPsHolo_mul : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → PsHolo (fun q => P q * Q q) := by
      intro P Q hP hQ n
      have hsum := hDiffOn_sum (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n)
        (fun u q => PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q) * PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q))
        fun u _ => (hP u.1).mul (hQ u.2)
      exact hsum.congr fun q _ => PowerSeries.coeff_mul n (P q) (Q q)
    have hPsHolo_pow : ∀ {Z : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ}, PsHolo Z → ∀ a : ℕ, PsHolo (fun q => Z q ^ a) := by
      intro Z hZ a
      induction a with
      | zero => exact hPsHolo_const 1
      | succ a ih =>
        have hfn : (fun q => Z q ^ (a + 1)) = (fun q => Z q ^ a * Z q) :=
          funext fun q => pow_succ (Z q) a
        rw [hfn]; exact hPsHolo_mul ih hZ
    have hPsHolo_X_pow_mul : ∀ (l : ℕ) {P : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo (fun q => PowerSeries.X ^ l * P q) := by
      intro l P hP n
      by_cases hln : l ≤ n
      · exact (hP (n - l)).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_left_iff.mpr fun h => (h hln).elim]
      · exact (differentiableOn_const 0).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', ite_eq_right_iff.mpr fun h => (hln h).elim]
    have hPsHolo_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, PsHolo (P i)) → PsHolo (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, P i q) := by
      intro ι s P hP n
      exact (hDiffOn_sum s (fun i q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P i q))
        fun i hi => hP i hi n).congr fun q _ => map_sum _ _ _
    have hPsHolo_shift : ∀ (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c l) V) → PsHolo (fun q => polyShift (fun l => c l q)) := by
      intro c hc n
      by_cases hn : n < J + 1
      · exact (hc ⟨n, hn⟩).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_pos hn]
      · exact (differentiableOn_const 0).congr fun q _ => by
          rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_neg hn]
    have hPsHolo_comp : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W → ∀ {G : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ G W →
        ∀ {z₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀ V → (∀ q ∈ V, z₀ q ∈ W) →
        ∀ {Z : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ}, PsHolo Z →
          PsHolo (fun q => polyComp (holoTaylor1D G (z₀ q)) (Z q)) := by
      intro W hW_open G hG z₀ hz₀ hmaps Z hZ n
      have hs := hDiffOn_sum (Finset.range (n + 1))
        (fun a q => (iteratedDeriv a G (z₀ q) * ((a.factorial : ℂ))⁻¹) *
          PowerSeries.coeff n (Z q ^ a))
        fun a _ => (((hiter1D_holo hW_open hG a).comp hz₀ fun q hq => hmaps q hq).mul
          (differentiableOn_const _)).mul (hPsHolo_pow hZ a n)
      refine hs.congr fun q _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_polyComp]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, div_eq_mul_inv]

    have hT2D1D_const : ∀ c : ℂ,
        T2D1D (fun _ => PowerSeries.C c) = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C c) := by
      intro c; ext d n
      rw [coeff_T2D1D, htaylor2D_const, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hT2D1D_add : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → T2D1D (fun q => P q + Q q) = T2D1D P + T2D1D Q := by
      intro P Q hP hQ; ext d n
      rw [map_add, map_add, coeff_T2D1D, coeff_T2D1D, coeff_T2D1D]
      have hfn : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q + Q q)) =
          (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q) + PowerSeries.coeff n (Q q)) :=
        funext fun _ => map_add _ _ _
      rw [hfn, (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hP n) (hQ n)).1, map_add]
    have hT2D1D_sub : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → T2D1D (fun q => P q - Q q) = T2D1D P - T2D1D Q := by
      intro P Q hP hQ; ext d n
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, coeff_T2D1D, coeff_T2D1D, coeff_T2D1D]
      have hfn : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q - Q q)) =
          (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q) - PowerSeries.coeff n (Q q)) :=
        funext fun _ => map_sub _ _ _
      rw [hfn, (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hP n) (hQ n)).2.1, map_sub]
    have hT2D1D_mul : ∀ {P Q : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ},
        PsHolo P → PsHolo Q → T2D1D (fun q => P q * Q q) = T2D1D P * T2D1D Q := by
      intro P Q hP hQ; ext d n
      rw [coeff_T2D1D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
      have hfn : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff n (P q * Q q)) =
          fun q => ∑ u ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n,
            PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q) * PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q) :=
        funext fun q => PowerSeries.coeff_mul n (P q) (Q q)
      rw [hfn, htaylor2D_sum hV hp₁ (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n)
        (fun u q => PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q) * PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q))
        (fun u _ => (hP u.1).mul (hQ u.2)), map_sum]
      have hexp_lhs : ∀ u ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n,
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q) * PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q)) p₁) =
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff u.1 (P q)) p₁) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff u.2 (Q q)) p₁) := by
        intro u _
        rw [(htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hP u.1) (hQ u.2)).2.2, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hexp_lhs, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_T2D1D, coeff_T2D1D]
    have hT2D1D_pow : ∀ {Z : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ}, PsHolo Z → ∀ a : ℕ,
        T2D1D (fun q => Z q ^ a) = (T2D1D Z) ^ a := by
      intro Z hZ a
      induction a with
      | zero => simpa using hT2D1D_const 1
      | succ a ih =>
        have hfn : (fun q => Z q ^ (a + 1)) = (fun q => Z q ^ a * Z q) :=
          funext fun q => pow_succ (Z q) a
        rw [hfn, pow_succ, hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_pow hZ a) hZ, ih]
    have hT2D1D_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, PsHolo (P i)) → T2D1D (fun q => ∑ i ∈ s, P i q) = ∑ i ∈ s, T2D1D (P i) := by
      intro ι s P hP
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simpa using hT2D1D_const 0
      | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have hfn : (fun q => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, P i q) =
            (fun q => P a q + ∑ i ∈ s, P i q) :=
          funext fun _ => Finset.sum_insert ha
        have hs_holo := hPsHolo_sum s P fun i hi => hP i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
        rw [hfn, Finset.sum_insert ha,
          hT2D1D_add (hP a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)) hs_holo,
          ih fun i hi => hP i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)]

    have hdeg_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 + d 1 = 0 := by
      intro d
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · intro h; ext i; fin_cases i <;> (simp; omega)

    have hpow2D_vanish : ∀ {Z₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Z₀ = 0 →
        ∀ (b : ℕ) (r : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), r 0 + r 1 < b → MvPowerSeries.coeff r (Z₀ ^ b) = 0 := by
      intro Z₀ hZ0 b
      induction b with
      | zero => intro _ hr; omega
      | succ b ih =>
        intro r hr
        rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        by_cases hp2 : p.2 = 0
        · rw [hp2, hZ0, mul_zero]
        · have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
            have := mt (hdeg_zero_iff p.2).mpr hp2
            omega
          have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0
          have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
          simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at h0 h1
          rw [ih p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]

    have hpowPert_vanish : ∀ {Zp : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        (∀ r : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff r Zp) = 0) →
        ∀ (a : ℕ) (r : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m' : ℕ), m' < a →
          PowerSeries.coeff m' (MvPowerSeries.coeff r (Zp ^ a)) = 0 := by
      intro Zp hZp0 a
      induction a with
      | zero => intro _ _ hm; omega
      | succ a ih =>
        intro r m' hm
        rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p _ => ?_
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun u hu => ?_
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hu
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos u.2 with hu2_0 | hu2_pos
        · rw [hu2_0, hZp0 p.2, mul_zero]
        · rw [ih p.1 u.1 (by omega), zero_mul]

    have hiter_add : ∀ (b a : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
        iteratedDeriv b (iteratedDeriv a f) = iteratedDeriv (a + b) f := by
      intro b a f
      induction b with
      | zero => simp
      | succ b ih => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, Nat.add_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ]

    
    have hMasterComp : ∀ {W : Set ℂ}, IsOpen W →
        ∀ {z₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀ V → (∀ q ∈ V, z₀ q ∈ W) →
        ∀ (G : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ), (∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G l) W) →
          (∀ l, J + 1 ≤ l → G l = fun _ => 0) →
        ∀ (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (c l) V) → (∀ q, c 0 q = 0) →
          let z_star := z₀ p₁
          let g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun l => holoTaylor1D (G l) z_star
          let Z_seq : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l =>
            if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D z₀ p₁
            else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (c ⟨l, hl⟩) p₁
            else 0
          T2D1D (fun q =>
            ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G (l : ℕ)) (z₀ q)) (polyShift (fun u => c u q))) =
            lineArcComp2D1D g_seq (lineArcPack2D1D Z_seq) := by
      intro W hW_open z₀ hz₀ hmaps G hG_holo hG_vanish c hc_holo hc0
      dsimp only
      let z_star := z₀ p₁
      let g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun l => holoTaylor1D (G l) z_star
      let Z₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D z₀ p₁
      let Z_seq : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l =>
        if l = 0 then Z₀
        else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (c ⟨l, hl⟩) p₁
        else 0
      let Z_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun q => polyShift (fun u => c u q)
      have hZt_holo : PsHolo Z_tilde := hPsHolo_shift c hc_holo
      let Z_pert := T2D1D Z_tilde
      have hZ0_coeff0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Z₀ = 0 := by
        change iterDerivYT 0 0 (fun p => z₀ p - z₀ p₁) p₁ / _ = 0
        simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      have hZpert_coeff0 : ∀ r : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff r Z_pert) = 0 := by
        intro r
        rw [coeff_T2D1D]
        have hfn0 : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff 0 (Z_tilde q)) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext q; dsimp only [Z_tilde]; rw [coeff_polyShift]; simp [hc0 q]
        rw [hfn0, htaylor2D_const, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero]
      have hZpack_eq : lineArcPack2D1D Z_seq = embedBase Z₀ + Z_pert := by
        ext d l
        rw [coeff_pack2D1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_add, map_add, coeff_embedBase, coeff_T2D1D]
        dsimp only [Z_seq, Z_tilde]
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0
          have hfn0 : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff 0 (polyShift (fun u => c u q))) = fun _ => 0 := by
            ext q; rw [coeff_polyShift]; simp [hc0 q]
          rw [if_pos rfl, hfn0, htaylor2D_const, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero,
            add_zero, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C]
        · rw [if_neg hl0, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg hl0, zero_add]
          by_cases hlt : l < J + 1
          · have hfn : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff l (polyShift (fun u => c u q))) = c ⟨l, hlt⟩ := by
              ext q; rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_pos hlt]
            rw [dif_pos hlt, hfn]
          · have hfn : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff l (polyShift (fun u => c u q))) = fun _ => 0 := by
              ext q; rw [coeff_polyShift, dif_neg hlt]
            rw [dif_neg hlt, hfn, htaylor2D_const, map_zero, map_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero]

      rw [hZpack_eq]
      ext d m'
      let D : ℕ := d 0 + d 1
      have hrhs_step1 :
          PowerSeries.coeff m'
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (lineArcComp2D1D g_seq (embedBase Z₀ + Z_pert))) =
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
              ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
                ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
                  (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                    MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                  PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a)) := by
        have hdef_comp : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcComp2D1D g_seq (embedBase Z₀ + Z_pert)) =
            PowerSeries.mk (fun m => PowerSeries.coeff m
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) *
                    (embedBase Z₀ + Z_pert) ^ n))) := rfl
        rw [hdef_comp, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sum, map_sum]
        let Term (a b : ℕ) : ℂ :=
          ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
              (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
              PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))
        have hn_expand : ∀ n : ℕ,
            PowerSeries.coeff m'
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                (MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) *
                  (embedBase Z₀ + Z_pert) ^ n)) =
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Term a (n - a) := by
          intro n
          let γ_n : PowerSeries ℂ := PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, add_comm (embedBase Z₀) Z_pert, add_pow Z_pert (embedBase Z₀) n,
            map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff] at ha
          have hab : a + (n - a) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le ha
          have hcast_choose :
              (Z_pert ^ a * (embedBase Z₀) ^ (n - a) *
                (n.choose a : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ))) =
              MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (n.choose a : ℂ)) *
                (Z_pert ^ a * embedBase (Z₀ ^ (n - a))) := by
            rw [embedBase_pow, ← map_natCast MvPowerSeries.C (n.choose a),
              ← map_natCast PowerSeries.C (n.choose a), mul_comm]
          rw [hcast_choose, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
            Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, map_sum]
          dsimp only [Term]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
          rw [coeff_embedBase]
          have hps_rearr :
              γ_n * (PowerSeries.C (n.choose a : ℂ) *
                (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a) *
                  PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ (n - a))))) =
              PowerSeries.C ((n.choose a : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ (n - a))) *
                (γ_n * MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a)) := by
            rw [map_mul]; ring
          rw [hps_rearr, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
            Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
              (fun l u => PowerSeries.coeff l γ_n *
                PowerSeries.coeff u (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))) m',
            Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
          dsimp only [γ_n]
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hab]
          ring
        simp_rw [hn_expand]
        rw [Finset.sum_sigma']
        let S₁ := (Finset.range (D + m' + 1)).sigma (fun n => Finset.range (n + 1))
        let S₂ := Finset.range (m' + 1) ×ˢ Finset.range (D + 1)
        let f_emb : ℕ × ℕ → Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ := fun p => ⟨p.1 + p.2, p.1⟩
        have hsub : S₂.image f_emb ⊆ S₁ := by
          intro x hx
          rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
          rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_range] at hab
          rw [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_range]
          dsimp only [f_emb]
          exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        have hvanish_outside : ∀ x ∈ S₁, x ∉ S₂.image f_emb → Term x.2 (x.1 - x.2) = 0 := by
          intro x hx hnot
          rw [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_range] at hx
          by_cases h_in : x.2 ≤ m' ∧ x.1 - x.2 ≤ D
          · exfalso
            apply hnot
            refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(x.2, x.1 - x.2), ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_range]
              exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
            · rcases x with ⟨n_x, a_x⟩
              dsimp only [f_emb] at hx ⊢
              exact congr_arg (fun u => (⟨u, a_x⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ)) (by omega)
          · rw [not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at h_in
            dsimp only [Term]
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r hr => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l hl => ?_
            rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at hl
            have hr0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
            have hr1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
            simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at hr0 hr1
            rcases h_in with ha_gt | hb_gt
            · rw [hpowPert_vanish hZpert_coeff0 x.2 r.1 (m' - l) (by omega), mul_zero]
            · rw [hpow2D_vanish hZ0_coeff0 (x.1 - x.2) r.2 (by omega), mul_zero, zero_mul]
        have hinj : Set.InjOn f_emb ↑S₂ := by
          rintro ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ _ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩ _ heq
          have h1 : a₁ + b₁ = a₂ + b₂ := congr_arg Sigma.fst heq
          have h2 : a₁ = a₂ := by
            have := Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp heq
            exact eq_of_heq this.2
          subst h2
          exact Prod.ext rfl (Nat.add_left_cancel h1)
        rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub hvanish_outside, Finset.sum_image hinj]
        have hbody : ∀ p ∈ S₂, Term (f_emb p).2 ((f_emb p).1 - (f_emb p).2) = Term p.1 p.2 := by
          rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _; dsimp [f_emb]; rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hbody, Finset.sum_product]

      have hb_match : ∀ (l a : ℕ) (r₂ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), r₂ 0 + r₂ 1 ≤ D →
          (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
            ((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff r₂ (Z₀ ^ b)) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff r₂
            (taylor2D (fun q => iteratedDeriv a (G l) (z₀ q) / (a.factorial : ℂ)) p₁) := by
        intro l a r₂ hr₂
        let H_la : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => iteratedDeriv a (G l) z / (a.factorial : ℂ)
        have hH_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_la W :=
          (hiter1D_holo hW_open (hG_holo l) a).div_const (a.factorial : ℂ)
        have hcomp_eq := htaylor2D_comp_1D hV hW_open hp₁ hz₀ hH_holo hmaps
        change _ = MvPowerSeries.coeff r₂ (taylor2D (fun q => H_la (z₀ q)) p₁)
        rw [hcomp_eq]
        change _ = ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r₂ 0 + r₂ 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff b (holoTaylor1D H_la z_star) * MvPowerSeries.coeff r₂ (Z₀ ^ b)
        symm
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hr₂)) ?_).trans ?_
        · intro b _ hb_not
          rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hb_not
          rw [hpow2D_vanish hZ0_coeff0 b r₂ (by omega), mul_zero]
        · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          congr 1
          dsimp only [holoTaylor1D, H_la, g_seq]
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_div_const,
            hiter_add b a (G l)]
          have hfac_nat : (a + b).choose a * b.factorial * a.factorial = (a + b).factorial := by
            have h := Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial b a
            rwa [Nat.add_comm b a] at h
          have hfac : ((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * (b.factorial : ℂ) * (a.factorial : ℂ) =
              ((a + b).factorial : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac_nat
          have ha_ne : (a.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero a)
          have hb_ne : (b.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero b)
          have hc_ne : ((a + b).choose a : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
            Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_add_right a b)))
          rw [← hfac]
          field_simp

      rw [hrhs_step1]
      conv_rhs =>
        arg 2; ext a; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        arg 2; ext r; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      conv_rhs =>
        arg 2; ext a; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have hl_term : ∀ l ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
          (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
            ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
              ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
                (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (taylor2D (fun q =>
              PowerSeries.coeff m' (PowerSeries.X ^ l *
                polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) (Z_tilde q))) p₁) := by
        intro l hl
        rw [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff] at hl
        have ha_shrink :
            (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1),
              ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
                ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
                  (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                    MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                  PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))) =
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m' - l + 1),
              ∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
                ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
                  (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                    MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                  PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a)) := by
          symm
          refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) fun a _ ha_not => ?_
          rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at ha_not
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
          rw [hpowPert_vanish hZpert_coeff0 a r.1 (m' - l) (by omega), mul_zero]
        rw [ha_shrink]
        have ha_eval : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (m' - l + 1),
            (∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
              ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
                (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (taylor2D (fun q =>
                PowerSeries.coeff a (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) *
                  PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (Z_tilde q ^ a)) p₁) := by
          intro a _
          have hr_eval : ∀ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
              (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
                (((a + b).choose a : ℂ) * PowerSeries.coeff (a + b) (g_seq l) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (Z₀ ^ b)) *
                PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (Z_pert ^ a))) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1
                (taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (Z_tilde q ^ a)) p₁) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2
                (taylor2D (fun q => iteratedDeriv a (G l) (z₀ q) / (a.factorial : ℂ)) p₁) := by
            intro r hr
            rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
            have hr0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
            have hr1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
            simp only [Finsupp.add_apply] at hr0 hr1
            rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hb_match l a r.2 (by omega)]
            have hZa : Z_pert ^ a = T2D1D (fun q => Z_tilde q ^ a) := (hT2D1D_pow hZt_holo a).symm
            rw [hZa, coeff_T2D1D, mul_comm]
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hr_eval, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
          have hZa_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (Z_tilde q ^ a)) V :=
            hPsHolo_pow hZt_holo a (m' - l)
          have hcomp_a : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => iteratedDeriv a (G l) (z₀ q)) V :=
            (hiter1D_holo hW_open (hG_holo l) a).comp hz₀ fun q hq => hmaps q hq
          have hHa_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun q => iteratedDeriv a (G l) (z₀ q) / (a.factorial : ℂ)) V :=
            (hcomp_a.mul (differentiableOn_const ((a.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹))).congr
              fun _ _ => (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
          rw [← (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hZa_holo hHa_holo).2.2]
          congr 1
          refine htaylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q _ => ?_
          unfold holoTaylor1D
          rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, mul_comm]
        have hterm_holo : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (m' - l + 1),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff a (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) *
                PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (Z_tilde q ^ a)) V := by
          intro a _
          have hcomp_a : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => iteratedDeriv a (G l) (z₀ q)) V :=
            (hiter1D_holo hW_open (hG_holo l) a).comp hz₀ fun q hq => hmaps q hq
          have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff a (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q))) V :=
            (hcomp_a.mul (differentiableOn_const ((a.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹))).congr
              fun q _ => by
                unfold holoTaylor1D
                rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, div_eq_mul_inv]
                rfl
          exact h1.mul (hPsHolo_pow hZt_holo a (m' - l))
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl ha_eval, ← map_sum,
          ← htaylor2D_sum hV hp₁ (Finset.range (m' - l + 1))
            (fun a q => PowerSeries.coeff a (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) *
              PowerSeries.coeff (m' - l) (Z_tilde q ^ a))
            hterm_holo]
        congr 1
        refine htaylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q _ => ?_
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos hl, coeff_polyComp]

      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hl_term, ← map_sum]
      let t_fn : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun l =>
        taylor2D (fun q =>
          PowerSeries.coeff m' (PowerSeries.X ^ l *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) (Z_tilde q))) p₁
      have ht_gt_m : ∀ l : ℕ, m' < l → t_fn l = 0 := by
        intro l hgt
        dsimp only [t_fn]
        have hfn0 : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m' (PowerSeries.X ^ l *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) (Z_tilde q))) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext q; rw [PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega)]
        rw [hfn0, htaylor2D_const, map_zero]
      have ht_gt_J : ∀ l : ℕ, J + 1 ≤ l → t_fn l = 0 := by
        intro l hge
        dsimp only [t_fn]
        have hfn0 : (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m' (PowerSeries.X ^ l *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G l) (z₀ q)) (Z_tilde q))) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext q
          rw [hG_vanish l hge]
          have h0 : holoTaylor1D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (z₀ q) = 0 := by
            ext u; rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
            split_ifs <;> simp
          have hc0' : polyComp 0 (Z_tilde q) = 0 := by ext u; simp [coeff_polyComp]
          rw [h0, hc0', mul_zero, map_zero]
        rw [hfn0, htaylor2D_const, map_zero]
      let N_max : ℕ := max (m' + 1) (J + 1)
      have hsum_m_to_max : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1), t_fn l = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N_max, t_fn l := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (le_max_left _ _)) fun l _ hl_not => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hl_not
        exact ht_gt_m l hl_not
      have hsum_J_to_max : ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (J + 1), t_fn l = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N_max, t_fn l := by
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (le_max_right _ _)) fun l _ hl_not => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hl_not
        exact ht_gt_J l hl_not
      change _ = MvPowerSeries.coeff d (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (m' + 1), t_fn l)
      rw [hsum_m_to_max, ← hsum_J_to_max]
      rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range t_fn (J + 1)]
      have hsum_T := hT2D1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
        (fun (l : Fin (J + 1)) q => PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G (l : ℕ)) (z₀ q)) (Z_tilde q))
        fun l _ => hPsHolo_X_pow_mul (l : ℕ)
          (hPsHolo_comp hW_open (hG_holo (l : ℕ)) hz₀ hmaps hZt_holo)
      rw [hsum_T, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [coeff_T2D1D]

    have hinv2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ)) V :=
      differentiableOn_const (1 / 2 : ℂ)
    have hmid_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) V := by
      intro i
      exact (((hα₀ i.castSucc).add (hα₀ i.succ)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
    have hd_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i) V := by
      intro i
      exact (((hα₀ i.succ).sub (hα₀ i.castSucc)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
    have hc_mid_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (β l i.castSucc q + β l i.succ q) / 2) V := by
      intro i l
      exact (((hβ l i.castSucc).add (hβ l i.succ)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
    have hc_d_holo : ∀ (i : Fin k) (l : Fin (J + 1)),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (β l i.succ q - β l i.castSucc q) / 2) V := by
      intro i l
      exact (((hβ l i.succ).sub (hβ l i.castSucc)).mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)).congr
        fun q _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ 2

    have hmid_centered : ∀ i : Fin k,
        centeredTaylor2D (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) p₁ =
          (centeredTaylor2D (α₀ i.castSucc) p₁ + centeredTaylor2D (α₀ i.succ) p₁) *
            MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
      intro i
      let u₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => α₀ i.castSucc q - α₀ i.castSucc p₁
      let u₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => α₀ i.succ q - α₀ i.succ p₁
      have hu₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ u₁ V := (hα₀ i.castSucc).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hu₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ u₂ V := (hα₀ i.succ).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hu12 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => u₁ q + u₂ q) V := hu₁.add hu₂
      have hfn : (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i - lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i) =
          fun q => (u₁ q + u₂ q) * (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
        ext q; dsimp only [lineChainMid, u₁, u₂]; ring
      change taylor2D (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i - lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i) p₁ = _
      rw [hfn, (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hu12 hinv2_holo).2.2,
        (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hu₁ hu₂).1, htaylor2D_const]
      rfl

    have hd_centered : ∀ i : Fin k,
        centeredTaylor2D (fun q => lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i -
          lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i) p₁ =
          (centeredTaylor2D (α₀ i.succ) p₁ - centeredTaylor2D (α₀ i.castSucc) p₁) *
            MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
      intro i
      let u₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => α₀ i.succ q - α₀ i.succ p₁
      let u₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => α₀ i.castSucc q - α₀ i.castSucc p₁
      have hu₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ u₁ V := (hα₀ i.succ).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hu₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ u₂ V := (hα₀ i.castSucc).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hu12 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => u₁ q - u₂ q) V := hu₁.sub hu₂
      have hfn : (fun q => (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i -
            lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i) -
            (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i - lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)) =
          fun q => (u₁ q - u₂ q) * (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
        ext q; dsimp only [lineChainHalfStep, u₁, u₂]; ring
      change taylor2D _ p₁ = _
      rw [hfn, (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hu12 hinv2_holo).2.2,
        (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hu₁ hu₂).2.1, htaylor2D_const]
      rfl

    have hT_sup : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsHolo (fun q => polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) ∧
        T2D1D (fun q => polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          lineArcComp2D1D (f_seq i) (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i) := by
      intro i
      let G_i : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun l =>
        if l = 0 then h_ℂ else if hl : l < J + 1 then g i ⟨l, hl⟩ else fun _ => 0
      have hGi_holo : ∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_i l) W_ψ := by
        intro l; dsimp only [G_i]; split_ifs
        · exact hh
        · exact hg i _
        · exact differentiableOn_const 0
      have hGi_van : ∀ l, J + 1 ≤ l → G_i l = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro l hl; dsimp only [G_i]; rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]
      have hPs_sup : PsHolo (fun q => polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) :=
        hPsHolo_add
          (hPsHolo_comp hW hh (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i)
            (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_mid_holo i)))
          (hPsHolo_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
            (fun l q => PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (g i l) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
                (polyMidShift (fun l s => β l s q) i))
            fun l _ => hPsHolo_X_pow_mul (l : ℕ)
              (hPsHolo_comp hW (hg i l) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i)
                (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_mid_holo i))))
      refine ⟨hPs_sup, ?_⟩
      have hm_eq := hMasterComp hW (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i) G_i hGi_holo hGi_van
        (fun l q => (β l i.castSucc q + β l i.succ q) / 2) (hc_mid_holo i)
        (fun q => by simp [hβ0])
      have hlhs_eq : (fun q => polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          fun q => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G_i (l : ℕ)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
              (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.castSucc q + β u i.succ q) / 2)) := by
        ext q n
        dsimp only [polySup, polyMidShift]
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        have hg0_fn : g i 0 = fun _ => 0 := funext (hg0 i)
        have h0_tay : holoTaylor1D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) = 0 := by
          ext u; rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        have h0_comp : polyComp 0 (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.castSucc q + β u i.succ q) / 2)) = 0 := by
          ext u; simp [coeff_polyComp]
        have hG0 : G_i ((0 : Fin (J + 1)) : ℕ) = h_ℂ := rfl
        have hGs : ∀ m_idx : Fin J, G_i (m_idx.succ : ℕ) = g i m_idx.succ := by
          intro m_idx; dsimp only [G_i]; rw [if_neg (by simp), dif_pos m_idx.succ.2]
        rw [hg0_fn, h0_tay, h0_comp, mul_zero, zero_add, hG0]
        simp_rw [hGs]
        simp
      have hgseq_eq : (fun l => holoTaylor1D (G_i l) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)) =
          f_seq i := by
        ext l n; dsimp only [G_i, f_seq, lineArcHoloTaylor1D]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp
      have hZseq_eq :
          lineArcPack2D1D (fun l =>
            if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) p₁
            else if hl : l < J + 1 then
              taylor2D (fun q => (β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.succ q) / 2) p₁
            else 0) =
          lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i := by
        unfold lineArcFormalMid2D1D
        apply congr_arg lineArcPack2D1D; funext l
        dsimp only [β_seq]
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; simp [hmid_centered i]
        · by_cases hlt : l < J + 1
          · simp only [hl0, hlt, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
            have hβ_sum : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun q => β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) V :=
              (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc).add (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ)
            have hfn : (fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) / 2) =
                fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) * (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
              ext q; ring
            rw [hfn,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hβ_sum hinv2_holo).2.2,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc) (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ)).1,
              htaylor2D_const]
          · simp [hl0, hlt]
      rw [hlhs_eq, hm_eq, hgseq_eq, hZseq_eq]

    have hT_supD : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PsHolo (fun q => polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) ∧
        T2D1D (fun q => polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          lineArcComp2D1D (fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i l))
            (lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i) := by
      intro i
      let G'_i : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun l =>
        if l = 0 then deriv h_ℂ
        else if hl : l < J + 1 then deriv (g i ⟨l, hl⟩)
        else fun _ => 0
      have hG'i_holo : ∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G'_i l) W_ψ := by
        intro l; dsimp only [G'_i]; split_ifs
        · exact hh.deriv hW
        · exact (hg i _).deriv hW
        · exact differentiableOn_const 0
      have hG'i_van : ∀ l, J + 1 ≤ l → G'_i l = fun _ => 0 := by
        intro l hl; dsimp only [G'_i]; rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]
      have hPs_supD : PsHolo (fun q => polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) :=
        hPsHolo_add
          (hPsHolo_comp hW (hh.deriv hW) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i)
            (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_mid_holo i)))
          (hPsHolo_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
            (fun l q => PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
              polyComp (holoTaylor1D (deriv (g i l)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
                (polyMidShift (fun l s => β l s q) i))
            fun l _ => hPsHolo_X_pow_mul (l : ℕ)
              (hPsHolo_comp hW ((hg i l).deriv hW) (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i)
                (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_mid_holo i))))
      refine ⟨hPs_supD, ?_⟩
      have hm_eq := hMasterComp hW (hmid_holo i) (fun q hq => hmid q hq i) G'_i hG'i_holo hG'i_van
        (fun l q => (β l i.castSucc q + β l i.succ q) / 2) (hc_mid_holo i)
        (fun q => by simp [hβ0])
      have hlhs_eq : (fun q => polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          fun q => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G'_i (l : ℕ)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i))
              (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.castSucc q + β u i.succ q) / 2)) := by
        ext q n
        dsimp only [polySupDeriv, polyMidShift]
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        have hdg0_fn : deriv (g i 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
          have h0fn : g i 0 = fun _ => 0 := funext (hg0 i)
          rw [h0fn]; ext z; exact deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
        have h0_tay : holoTaylor1D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) = 0 := by
          ext u; rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        have h0_comp : polyComp 0 (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.castSucc q + β u i.succ q) / 2)) = 0 := by
          ext u; simp [coeff_polyComp]
