        have hG0 : G'_i ((0 : Fin (J + 1)) : ℕ) = deriv h_ℂ := rfl
        have hGs : ∀ m_idx : Fin J, G'_i (m_idx.succ : ℕ) = deriv (g i m_idx.succ) := by
          intro m_idx; dsimp only [G'_i]; rw [if_neg (by simp), dif_pos m_idx.succ.2]
        rw [hdg0_fn, h0_tay, h0_comp, mul_zero, zero_add, hG0]
        simp_rw [hGs]
        simp
      have hderiv_tay : ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
          holoTaylor1D (deriv F) z₀ = PowerSeries.derivative (holoTaylor1D F z₀) := by
        intro F z₀; ext n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_succ',
          Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
        have hc1 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
        have hc2 : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
        push_cast; field_simp
      have hgseq_eq : (fun l => holoTaylor1D (G'_i l) (lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i)) =
          fun l => PowerSeries.derivative (f_seq i l) := by
        ext l n; dsimp only [G'_i, f_seq, lineArcHoloTaylor1D]
        split_ifs
        · rw [hderiv_tay]
        · rw [hderiv_tay]
        · rw [map_zero, map_zero, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp
      have hZseq_eq :
          lineArcPack2D1D (fun l =>
            if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (fun q => lineChainMid (fun s => α₀ s q) i) p₁
            else if hl : l < J + 1 then
              taylor2D (fun q => (β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.succ q) / 2) p₁
            else 0) =
          lineArcFormalMid2D1D β_seq i := by
        unfold lineArcFormalMid2D1D
        apply congr_arg lineArcPack2D1D; funext l
        dsimp only [β_seq]
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; simp [hmid_centered i]
        · by_cases hlt : l < J + 1
          · simp only [hl0, hlt, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
            have hβ_sum : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun q => β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) V :=
              (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc).add (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ)
            have hfn : (fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) / 2) =
                fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q + β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q) * (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
              ext q; ring
            rw [hfn,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hβ_sum hinv2_holo).2.2,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc) (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ)).1,
              htaylor2D_const]
          · simp [hl0, hlt]
      rw [hlhs_eq, hm_eq, hgseq_eq, hZseq_eq]

    have hcomp_lin : ∀ (a b : ℂ) (φ₁ φ₂ Z : PowerSeries ℂ),
        polyComp (PowerSeries.C a * φ₁ + PowerSeries.C b * φ₂) Z =
          PowerSeries.C a * polyComp φ₁ Z + PowerSeries.C b * polyComp φ₂ Z := by
      intro a b φ₁ φ₂ Z; ext n
      rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
        coeff_polyComp, coeff_polyComp, coeff_polyComp,
        Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
      rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]; ring

    have hT_trig : ∀ i : Fin k,
        (PsHolo (fun q => polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) ∧
         T2D1D (fun q => polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
           lineArcFormalSin2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i) ∧
        (PsHolo (fun q => polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) ∧
         T2D1D (fun q => polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
           lineArcFormalCos2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 β_seq i) := by
      intro i
      let d_star := lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s p₁) i
      let z₀_d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i - d_star
      have hz₀_d_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀_d V := (hd_holo i).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hz₀_d_p₁ : z₀_d p₁ = 0 := sub_self d_star
      let G_cos : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun l => if l = 0 then Complex.cos else fun _ => 0
      let G_sin : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun l => if l = 0 then Complex.sin else fun _ => 0
      have hGcos_holo : ∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_cos l) Set.univ := by
        intro l; dsimp only [G_cos]; split_ifs
        · exact Complex.differentiable_cos.differentiableOn
        · exact differentiableOn_const 0
      have hGsin_holo : ∀ l, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_sin l) Set.univ := by
        intro l; dsimp only [G_sin]; split_ifs
        · exact Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableOn
        · exact differentiableOn_const 0
      have hGcos_van : ∀ l, J + 1 ≤ l → G_cos l = fun _ => 0 :=
        fun l hl => if_neg (by omega)
      have hGsin_van : ∀ l, J + 1 ≤ l → G_sin l = fun _ => 0 :=
        fun l hl => if_neg (by omega)
      have hm_cos := hMasterComp isOpen_univ hz₀_d_holo (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
        G_cos hGcos_holo hGcos_van
        (fun l q => (β l i.succ q - β l i.castSucc q) / 2) (hc_d_holo i)
        (fun q => by simp [hβ0])
      have hm_sin := hMasterComp isOpen_univ hz₀_d_holo (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
        G_sin hGsin_holo hGsin_van
        (fun l q => (β l i.succ q - β l i.castSucc q) / 2) (hc_d_holo i)
        (fun q => by simp [hβ0])
      have hZseq_d :
          lineArcPack2D1D (fun l =>
            if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D z₀_d p₁
            else if hl : l < J + 1 then
              taylor2D (fun q => (β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.succ q - β ⟨l, hl⟩ i.castSucc q) / 2) p₁
            else 0) =
          lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i := by
        unfold lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D
        apply congr_arg lineArcPack2D1D; funext l
        dsimp only [β_seq]
        by_cases hl0 : l = 0
        · subst hl0; simp [z₀_d, d_star, hd_centered i]
        · by_cases hlt : l < J + 1
          · simp only [hl0, hlt, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
            have hβ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun q => β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q - β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q) V :=
              (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ).sub (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc)
            have hfn : (fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q - β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q) / 2) =
                fun q => (β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ q - β ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc q) * (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
              ext q; ring
            rw [hfn,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ hβ_diff hinv2_holo).2.2,
              (htaylor2D_ring hV hp₁ (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.succ) (hβ ⟨l, hlt⟩ i.castSucc)).2.1,
              htaylor2D_const]
          · simp [hl0, hlt]
      have hsum_single0 : ∀ (F0 : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
          (∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (if (l : ℕ) = 0 then F0 else fun _ => 0) (z₀_d q))
              (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.succ q - β u i.castSucc q) / 2))) =
          polyComp (holoTaylor1D F0 (z₀_d q)) (polyHalfStepShift (fun l s => β l s q) i) := by
        intro F0 q
        refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (J + 1)) ?_ ?_).trans (by simp [polyHalfStepShift])
        · intro l _ hl_ne
          have hne : (l : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hl_ne (Fin.ext h0)
          rw [if_neg hne]
          have h0 : holoTaylor1D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (z₀_d q) = 0 := by
            ext u; rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_zero, iteratedDeriv_const]
            split_ifs <;> simp
          have hc0' : polyComp 0 (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.succ q - β u i.castSucc q) / 2)) = 0 := by
            ext u; simp [coeff_polyComp]
          rw [h0, hc0', mul_zero]
        · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ 0))
      have hgseq_cos : (fun l => holoTaylor1D (G_cos l) (z₀_d p₁)) =
          fun l => if l = 0 then lineArcPsCos0 else 0 := by
        ext l n; rw [hz₀_d_p₁]; dsimp only [G_cos, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · rw [map_zero, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp
      have hgseq_sin : (fun l => holoTaylor1D (G_sin l) (z₀_d p₁)) =
          fun l => if l = 0 then lineArcPsSin0 else 0 := by
        ext l n; rw [hz₀_d_p₁]; dsimp only [G_sin, lineArcPsSin0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · rw [map_zero, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_const]
          split_ifs <;> simp

      let P_cos : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun q =>
        polyComp (holoTaylor1D Complex.cos (z₀_d q)) (polyHalfStepShift (fun l s => β l s q) i)
      let P_sin : ℂ × ℂ → PowerSeries ℂ := fun q =>
        polyComp (holoTaylor1D Complex.sin (z₀_d q)) (polyHalfStepShift (fun l s => β l s q) i)
      have hPcos_holo : PsHolo P_cos :=
        hPsHolo_comp isOpen_univ Complex.differentiable_cos.differentiableOn hz₀_d_holo
          (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_d_holo i))
      have hPsin_holo : PsHolo P_sin :=
        hPsHolo_comp isOpen_univ Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableOn hz₀_d_holo
          (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (hPsHolo_shift _ (hc_d_holo i))
      have hT_Pcos : T2D1D P_cos =
          lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) := by
        have hfn : (fun q => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G_cos (l : ℕ)) (z₀_d q))
              (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.succ q - β u i.castSucc q) / 2))) = P_cos :=
          funext (hsum_single0 Complex.cos)
        rw [← hfn, hm_cos, hgseq_cos, hZseq_d]; rfl
      have hT_Psin : T2D1D P_sin =
          lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (lineArcFormalHalfStep2D1D β_seq i) := by
        have hfn : (fun q => ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
            polyComp (holoTaylor1D (G_sin (l : ℕ)) (z₀_d q))
              (polyShift (fun u => (β u i.succ q - β u i.castSucc q) / 2))) = P_sin :=
          funext (hsum_single0 Complex.sin)
        rw [← hfn, hm_sin, hgseq_sin, hZseq_d]; rfl

      have hsin_shift_tay : ∀ w : ℂ,
          holoTaylor1D Complex.sin (d_star + w) =
            PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * holoTaylor1D Complex.cos w +
              PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * holoTaylor1D Complex.sin w := by
        intro w; ext n
        rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
          holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        have hshift := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add n Complex.sin d_star) w
        have hadd_fn : (fun z => Complex.sin (d_star + z)) =
            fun z => sin_d0 i * Complex.cos z + cos_d0 i * Complex.sin z :=
          funext fun z => Complex.sin_add d_star z
        have hcos_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (n : ℕ) Complex.cos w :=
          (Complex.differentiable_cos.analyticAt w).contDiffAt
        have hsin_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (n : ℕ) Complex.sin w :=
          (Complex.differentiable_sin.analyticAt w).contDiffAt
        rw [← hshift, hadd_fn,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_add (contDiffAt_const.mul hcos_cd) (contDiffAt_const.mul hsin_cd),
          iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ hcos_cd, iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ hsin_cd]
        ring
      have hcos_shift_tay : ∀ w : ℂ,
          holoTaylor1D Complex.cos (d_star + w) =
            PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * holoTaylor1D Complex.cos w +
              PowerSeries.C (-sin_d0 i) * holoTaylor1D Complex.sin w := by
        intro w; ext n
        rw [map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
          holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        have hshift := congr_fun (iteratedDeriv_comp_const_add n Complex.cos d_star) w
        have hadd_fn : (fun z => Complex.cos (d_star + z)) =
            fun z => cos_d0 i * Complex.cos z + (-sin_d0 i) * Complex.sin z := by
          ext z; rw [Complex.cos_add]; dsimp only [sin_d0, cos_d0, d_star]; ring
        have hcos_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (n : ℕ) Complex.cos w :=
          (Complex.differentiable_cos.analyticAt w).contDiffAt
        have hsin_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (n : ℕ) Complex.sin w :=
          (Complex.differentiable_sin.analyticAt w).contDiffAt
        rw [← hshift, hadd_fn,
          iteratedDeriv_fun_add (contDiffAt_const.mul hcos_cd) (contDiffAt_const.mul hsin_cd),
          iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ hcos_cd, iteratedDeriv_const_mul _ hsin_cd]
        ring

      have hpolySin_eq : (fun q => polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          fun q => PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * P_cos q + PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * P_sin q := by
        ext q n
        dsimp only [polySin, P_cos, P_sin]
        have hw : lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i = d_star + z₀_d q := by
          dsimp only [z₀_d]; ring
        rw [hw, hsin_shift_tay, hcomp_lin]
      have hpolyCos_eq : (fun q => polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i) =
          fun q => PowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * P_cos q - PowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * P_sin q := by
        ext q n
        dsimp only [polyCos, P_cos, P_sin]
        have hw : lineChainHalfStep (fun s => α₀ s q) i = d_star + z₀_d q := by
          dsimp only [z₀_d]; ring
        rw [hw, hcos_shift_tay, hcomp_lin, map_neg, neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg]

      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [hpolySin_eq]
        exact hPsHolo_add (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo)
          (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo)
      · rw [hpolySin_eq,
          hT2D1D_add (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo)
            (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo),
          hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo,
          hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo,
          hT2D1D_const, hT2D1D_const, hT_Pcos, hT_Psin]
        rfl
      · rw [hpolyCos_eq]
        exact hPsHolo_sub (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo)
          (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo)
      · rw [hpolyCos_eq,
          hT2D1D_sub (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo)
            (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo),
          hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPcos_holo,
          hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_const _) hPsin_holo,
          hT2D1D_const, hT2D1D_const, hT_Pcos, hT_Psin]
        rfl

    have hT_two : T2D1D (fun _ => (2 : PowerSeries ℂ)) = 2 := by
      have hC2 : (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) = PowerSeries.C 2 := (map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2).symm
      rw [hC2, hT2D1D_const, map_ofNat, map_ofNat]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcongr :
          taylor2D (fun q => lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε => lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε))) p₁ =
          lineArcSlice2D1D m
            (T2D1D (fun q => polyAct h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q))) := by
        dsimp only [T2D1D]
        rw [slice_pack2D1D]
        exact htaylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q hq =>
          (hepsJet_poly m hW hh hg (hmid q hq) (fun s => hβ0 s q)).1
      rw [hcongr]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [polyAct, lineArcFormalAction2D1D]
      rw [hT2D1D_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))
        (fun i q => 2 * polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i *
          polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i)
        fun i _ => hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const 2) (hT_sup i).1) (hT_trig i).1.1]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_const 2) (hT_sup i).1) (hT_trig i).1.1,
        hT2D1D_mul (hPsHolo_const 2) (hT_sup i).1,
        hT_two, (hT_sup i).2, (hT_trig i).1.2]
    · intro r
      have hcongr :
          taylor2D (fun q => lineArcEpsJet m
            (fun ε => lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertSupportDeriv h_ℂ g ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) ε) r)) p₁ =
          lineArcSlice2D1D m
            (T2D1D (fun q => polyGrad h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) r)) := by
        dsimp only [T2D1D]
        rw [slice_pack2D1D]
        exact htaylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q hq =>
          (hepsJet_poly m hW hh hg (hmid q hq) (fun s => hβ0 s q)).2 r
      rw [hcongr]
      congr 1
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have hm1 := hPsHolo_mul (hT_supD i_L).1 (hT_trig i_L).1.1
      have hm2 := hPsHolo_mul (hT_sup i_L).1 (hT_trig i_L).2.1
      have hm3 := hPsHolo_mul (hT_supD i_R).1 (hT_trig i_R).1.1
      have hm4 := hPsHolo_mul (hT_sup i_R).1 (hT_trig i_R).2.1
      dsimp only [polyGrad, lineArcFormalGrad2D1D]
      change T2D1D (fun q =>
          polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_L *
            polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_L +
          polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_L *
            polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_L +
          polySupDeriv h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_R *
            polySin (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_R -
          polySup h_ℂ g (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_R *
            polyCos (fun s => α₀ s q) (fun l s => β l s q) i_R) = _
      rw [hT2D1D_sub (hPsHolo_add (hPsHolo_add hm1 hm2) hm3) hm4,
        hT2D1D_add (hPsHolo_add hm1 hm2) hm3,
        hT2D1D_add hm1 hm2,
        hT2D1D_mul (hT_supD i_L).1 (hT_trig i_L).1.1,
        hT2D1D_mul (hT_sup i_L).1 (hT_trig i_L).2.1,
        hT2D1D_mul (hT_supD i_R).1 (hT_trig i_R).1.1,
        hT2D1D_mul (hT_sup i_R).1 (hT_trig i_R).2.1,
        (hT_supD i_L).2, (hT_trig i_L).1.2,
        (hT_sup i_L).2, (hT_trig i_L).2.2,
        (hT_supD i_R).2, (hT_trig i_R).1.2,
        (hT_sup i_R).2, (hT_trig i_R).2.2]

  exact {
    taylor2D_const := htaylor2D_const
    taylor2D_linear_coords := htaylor2D_linear_coords
    taylor2D_congr := htaylor2D_congr
    taylor2D_ring := htaylor2D_ring
    taylor2D_comp_1D := htaylor2D_comp_1D
    epsJet_trunc_eq := hepsJet_trunc_eq
    epsJet_holo := hepsJet_holo
    epsJet_succ_split := hepsJet_succ_split
    taylor2D_epsJet_eq := htaylor2D_epsJet_eq
  }

proof.tactics:
by
  have hSub : LineRecSubSeriesToolkit := by
    clear hNonAlg hJet hAlg E hδ₁ ha₁ δ₁ a₁ G hk k B C Ω
    have hC : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c) := by
      intro L c hc d
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      split_ifs
      · exact hc
      · exact L.zero_mem
    have hX : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s) := by
      intro L s d
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
      split_ifs
      · exact L.one_mem
      · exact L.zero_mem
    have hAdd : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S + T) := by
      intro L S T hS hT d
      rw [map_add]
      exact L.add_mem (hS d) (hT d)
    have hSub_m : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T) := by
      intro L S T hS hT d
      rw [map_sub]
      exact L.sub_mem (hS d) (hT d)
    have hMul : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T) := by
      intro L S T hS hT d
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      exact L.sum_mem fun p _ => L.mul_mem (hS p.1) (hT p.2)
    have hPow : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} (n : ℕ),
        lineCoreCoeffsIn L U → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (U ^ n) := by
      intro L U n hU
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        rw [pow_zero, ← map_one (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin 2))]
        exact hC L L.one_mem
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact hMul L ih hU
    refine
      { C_mem := @hC
        X_mem := hX
        add_mem := @hAdd
        sub_mem := @hSub_m
        mul_mem := @hMul
        comp1D_mem := ?_ }
    intro L f U hf _ hU d
    change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
      PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U ^ n)) ∈ L
    exact L.sum_mem fun n _ => L.mul_mem (hf n) (hPow L n hU d)
  have hTrig : LineRecFormalTrigToolkit := by
    clear hSub hNonAlg hJet hAlg E hδ₁ ha₁ δ₁ a₁ G hk k B C Ω
    have h_deriv_cos : deriv Complex.cos = -Complex.sin :=
      funext fun _ => Complex.deriv_cos
    have h_iter_sin : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) Complex.sin 0 = iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 := by
      intro n
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', Complex.deriv_sin]
    have h_iter_cos : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv (n + 1) Complex.cos 0 = -iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 := by
      intro n
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', h_deriv_cos, iteratedDeriv_neg]
    have h_iter_mem : ∀ (K : Subfield ℂ) (n : ℕ),
        iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 ∈ K ∧ iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 ∈ K := by
      intro K n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Complex.sin_zero, Complex.cos_zero]
        exact ⟨K.zero_mem, K.one_mem⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [h_iter_sin, h_iter_cos]
        exact ⟨ih.2, K.neg_mem ih.1⟩
    have h_trig_mem : ∀ (K : Subfield ℂ) (n : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsSin0 ∈ K ∧ PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsCos0 ∈ K := by
      intro K n
      simp only [lineArcPsSin0, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      exact ⟨K.div_mem (h_iter_mem K n).1 (natCast_mem K n.factorial),
        K.div_mem (h_iter_mem K n).2 (natCast_mem K n.factorial)⟩
    have h_trig_deriv :
        PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsSin0 = lineArcPsCos0 ∧
        PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsCos0 = -lineArcPsSin0 := by
      constructor
      · ext n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
        simp only [lineArcPsSin0, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        rw [h_iter_sin, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        have hne : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm (iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0), mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
      · ext n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, map_neg]
        simp only [lineArcPsSin0, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        rw [h_iter_cos, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        have hne : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_comm (-iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0),
          mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne, neg_div]
    have h_euler_iter : ∀ n : ℕ,
        iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 + Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 = Complex.I ^ n ∧
        iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 - Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 = (-Complex.I) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [h_iter_sin, h_iter_cos, pow_succ', pow_succ', ← ih.1, ← ih.2]
        have hIsq : Complex.I ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
        constructor
        · calc -iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 + Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0
              = Complex.I ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 +
                  Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 := by rw [hIsq]; ring
            _ = Complex.I *
                  (iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 + Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0) := by ring
        · calc -iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 - Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0
              = Complex.I ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 -
                  Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 := by rw [hIsq]; ring
            _ = -Complex.I *
                  (iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 - Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0) := by ring
    have h_cos_euler :
        lineArcPsCos0 =
          PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
            (lineRecPsExpScale Complex.I + lineRecPsExpScale (-Complex.I)) := by
      ext n
      simp only [lineArcPsCos0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, lineRecPsExpScale,
        PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      rw [← (h_euler_iter n).1, ← (h_euler_iter n).2]
      ring
    have h_sin_euler :
        lineArcPsSin0 =
          PowerSeries.C (-Complex.I / 2) *
            (lineRecPsExpScale Complex.I - lineRecPsExpScale (-Complex.I)) := by
      ext n
      simp only [lineArcPsSin0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, lineRecPsExpScale,
        PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      rw [← (h_euler_iter n).1, ← (h_euler_iter n).2]
      calc iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 / (n.factorial : ℂ)
          = (-(Complex.I ^ 2)) * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0 / (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
              rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        _ = -Complex.I / 2 *
              ((iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 + Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0) /
                  (n.factorial : ℂ) -
                (iteratedDeriv n Complex.cos 0 - Complex.I * iteratedDeriv n Complex.sin 0) /
                  (n.factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
    have h_exp_pos :
        lineRecPsExpScale Complex.I =
          lineArcPsCos0 + PowerSeries.C Complex.I * lineArcPsSin0 := by
      ext n
      simp only [lineRecPsExpScale, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcPsSin0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
        map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      rw [← (h_euler_iter n).1]
      ring
    have h_exp_neg :
        lineRecPsExpScale (-Complex.I) =
          lineArcPsCos0 - PowerSeries.C Complex.I * lineArcPsSin0 := by
      ext n
      simp only [lineRecPsExpScale, lineArcPsCos0, lineArcPsSin0, lineArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D,
        map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      rw [← (h_euler_iter n).2]
      ring
    have h_mk_ite : ∀ a : ℂ,
        (PowerSeries.mk fun l => if l = 0 then a else 0) = PowerSeries.C a := by
      intro a
      ext l
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
    have h_compConst_eq : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ))
        (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcCompConst2D1D φ Z)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ)) * Z ^ n)) := by
      intro φ Z d m
      have h_cmk : PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcCompConst2D1D φ Z)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                MvPowerSeries.C
                  (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then φ else 0)) * Z ^ n)) :=
        PowerSeries.coeff_mk m (fun m' =>
          PowerSeries.coeff m'
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m' + 1),
                MvPowerSeries.C
                  (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then φ else 0)) * Z ^ n)))
      rw [h_cmk]
      congr 2
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      have h1 : (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then φ else 0)) =
          PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ) := by
        rw [← h_mk_ite]
        congr 1; ext l; split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h1]
    have h_compConst_add : ∀ (φ₁ φ₂ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
        lineArcCompConst2D1D (φ₁ + φ₂) Z =
          lineArcCompConst2D1D φ₁ Z + lineArcCompConst2D1D φ₂ Z := by
      intro φ₁ φ₂ Z
      ext d m
      rw [map_add (MvPowerSeries.coeff d), map_add (PowerSeries.coeff m),
        h_compConst_eq, h_compConst_eq, h_compConst_eq,
        ← map_add (PowerSeries.coeff m), ← map_add (MvPowerSeries.coeff d),
        ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 2
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, add_mul]
    have h_compConst_sub : ∀ (φ₁ φ₂ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
        lineArcCompConst2D1D (φ₁ - φ₂) Z =
          lineArcCompConst2D1D φ₁ Z - lineArcCompConst2D1D φ₂ Z := by
      intro φ₁ φ₂ Z
      ext d m
      rw [map_sub (MvPowerSeries.coeff d), map_sub (PowerSeries.coeff m),
        h_compConst_eq, h_compConst_eq, h_compConst_eq,
        ← map_sub (PowerSeries.coeff m), ← map_sub (MvPowerSeries.coeff d),
        ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      congr 2
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, sub_mul]
    have h_compConst_smul : ∀ (a : ℂ) (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
        lineArcCompConst2D1D (PowerSeries.C a * φ) Z =
          MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C a) * lineArcCompConst2D1D φ Z := by
      intro a φ Z
      ext d m
      rw [h_compConst_eq, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, h_compConst_eq]
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 2
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, map_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h_vb_zero : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ), lineRecVanishesBelow 0 S := by
      intro S d m h; omega
    have h_vb_one_iff : ∀ Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ),
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Z) = 0 → lineRecVanishesBelow 1 Z := by
      intro Z hZ d m hlt
      have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
      have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
      have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      have hd : d = 0 := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hd0, hd1]
      rw [hd, hm0]; exact hZ
    have h_vb_add : ∀ {k : ℕ} {X Y : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        lineRecVanishesBelow k X → lineRecVanishesBelow k Y → lineRecVanishesBelow k (X + Y) := by
      intro k X Y hX hY d m hlt
      rw [map_add (MvPowerSeries.coeff d), map_add (PowerSeries.coeff m),
        hX d m hlt, hY d m hlt, add_zero]
    have h_vb_mul : ∀ {a b : ℕ} {X Y : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        lineRecVanishesBelow a X → lineRecVanishesBelow b Y →
          lineRecVanishesBelow (a + b) (X * Y) := by
      intro a b X Y hX hY d m hlt
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro q hq
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
      have hd0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← hp]; rfl
      have hd1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← hp]; rfl
      by_cases h1 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 + q.1 < a
      · rw [hX p.1 q.1 h1, zero_mul]
      · have h2 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 + q.2 < b := by omega
        rw [hY p.2 q.2 h2, mul_zero]
    have h_vb_pow : ∀ {Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)} (n : ℕ),
        lineRecVanishesBelow 1 Z → lineRecVanishesBelow n (Z ^ n) := by
      intro Z n hZ
      induction n with
      | zero => exact h_vb_zero _
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact h_vb_mul ih hZ
    have h_compConst_range : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ))
        (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m N : ℕ),
        lineRecVanishesBelow 1 Z → d 0 + d 1 + m ≤ N →
        PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcCompConst2D1D φ Z)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ)) * Z ^ n)) := by
      intro φ Z d m N hZ hN
      rw [h_compConst_eq, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
      intro n hn_big hn_small
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn_big hn_small
      have h_term : lineRecVanishesBelow (0 + n)
          (MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ)) * Z ^ n) :=
        h_vb_mul (h_vb_zero _) (h_vb_pow n hZ)
      exact h_term d m (by omega)
    have h_box_diag : ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ),
        (∀ i j : ℕ, N < i + j → G i j = 0) →
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), G i j) =
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), G i (s - i) := by
      have h_tri : ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ),
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - i + 1), G i j) =
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), G i (s - i) := by
        intro N G
        induction N with
        | zero => simp
        | succ N ih =>
          rw [Finset.sum_range_succ (f := fun i => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 - i + 1), G i j)]
          have h_split :
              (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 - i + 1), G i j) =
                (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - i + 1), G i j) +
                  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), G i (N + 1 - i) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
            have h_eq : N + 1 - i = N - i + 1 := by omega
            rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ]
          have h_top : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1 - (N + 1) + 1), G (N + 1) j) =
              G (N + 1) (N + 1 - (N + 1)) := by simp
          rw [h_split, h_top, ih, add_assoc, ← Finset.sum_range_succ,
            ← Finset.sum_range_succ (f := fun s => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), G i (s - i))]
      intro N G hG
      rw [← h_tri N G]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
      intro j hj_big hj_small
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj_big hj_small
      exact hG i j (by omega)
    have h_exp_add : ∀ (c : ℂ) (Z₁ Z₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
        lineRecVanishesBelow 1 Z₁ → lineRecVanishesBelow 1 Z₂ →
        lineArcCompConst2D1D (lineRecPsExpScale c) (Z₁ + Z₂) =
          lineArcCompConst2D1D (lineRecPsExpScale c) Z₁ *
            lineArcCompConst2D1D (lineRecPsExpScale c) Z₂ := by
      intro c Z₁ Z₂ hZ₁ hZ₂
      ext d m
      let N := d 0 + d 1 + m
      let S₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff i (lineRecPsExpScale c))) * Z₁ ^ i
      let S₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff j (lineRecPsExpScale c))) * Z₂ ^ j
      have h_prod_eq :
          PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d

      exact ⟨map_add Φ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, map_sub Φ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, map_mul Φ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
    have h_lift_sum : ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
        {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, g i ∈ F) →
        lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ i ∈ s, lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (g i) := by
      intro F Φ ι s g hg
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp [h_lift_zero]
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        have haF : g a ∈ F := hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have hsF : ∀ i ∈ s, g i ∈ F := fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
        have hsumF : (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ∈ F := F.sum_mem hsF
        rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha,
          (h_lift_ring_F F Φ _ _ haF hsumF).1, ih hsF]
    have h_lift_props : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
        (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
        (∀ y : ↥F, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ)) →
        (∀ z : ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ z) = z) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ K, lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x = PowerSeries.C x) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F,
          lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x + y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x + lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
          lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x - y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x - lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
          lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x * y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x * lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y) := by
      intro K F Φ hKF hΦK hΦc
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun x hx y hy => h_lift_ring_F F Φ x y hx hy⟩
      · intro z
        unfold lineRecLiftArcFn
        split_ifs with hz
        · exact hΦc ⟨z, hz⟩
        · exact PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C z
      · intro x hx
        unfold lineRecLiftArcFn
        rw [dif_pos (hKF hx)]
        exact hΦK x hx
    have h_liftMv_ring : ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ),
        (∀ c : ℂ, lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (MvPowerSeries.C c) =
          MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ c)) ∧
        (∀ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
          (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ ∈ F) →
          (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ ∈ F) →
          lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ + Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ + lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
          lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ - Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ - lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
          lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ * Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ * lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂) := by
      intro F Φ
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro c
        ext d m
        change PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.C c))) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ c)))
        rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
        split_ifs
        · rfl
        · rw [h_lift_zero]
      · intro Ψ₁ Ψ₂ h₁ h₂
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · ext d m
          change PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ₁ + Ψ₂))) =
            PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁) +
              lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂))
          rw [map_add, (h_lift_ring_F F Φ _ _ (h₁ d) (h₂ d)).1]
        · ext d m
          change PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ₁ - Ψ₂))) =
            PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁) -
              lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂))
          rw [map_sub, (h_lift_ring_F F Φ _ _ (h₁ d) (h₂ d)).2.1]
        · ext d m
          change PowerSeries.coeff m (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ₁ * Ψ₂))) =
            PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ * lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂))
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
            h_lift_sum F Φ (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d)
              (fun p => MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Ψ₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ₂)
              (fun p _ => F.mul_mem (h₁ p.1) (h₂ p.2))]
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro p _
          exact (h_lift_ring_F F Φ _ _ (h₁ p.1) (h₂ p.2)).2.2
    have h_pow_mem_lift : ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
        (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (n : ℕ),
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
        (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n) ∈ F) ∧
          lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ ^ n) = (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) ^ n := by
      intro F Φ Ψ n hΨ
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro d
          rw [pow_zero, ← map_one (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin 2)), MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
          split_ifs
          · exact F.one_mem
          · exact F.zero_mem
        · rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, ← map_one (MvPowerSeries.C (σ := Fin 2)),
            (h_liftMv_ring F Φ).1 1, h_lift_one, map_one]
      | succ n ih =>
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · intro d
          rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
          exact F.sum_mem fun p _ => F.mul_mem (ih.1 p.1) (hΨ p.2)
        · rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ((h_liftMv_ring F Φ).2 (Ψ ^ n) Ψ ih.1 hΨ).2.2, ih.2]
    have h_mv_pow_vanish : ∀ (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (n : ℕ),

        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 < n → MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n) = 0 := by
      intro Ψ n hΨ0
      induction n with
      | zero => intro d h; omega
      | succ n ih =>
        intro d hd
        rw [pow_succ, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro p hp
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        by_cases hp2 : p.2 = 0
        · rw [hp2, hΨ0, mul_zero]
        · have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
            by_contra h0
            apply hp2
            ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> omega
          have hd0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← hp]; rfl
          have hd1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← hp]; rfl
          rw [ih p.1 (by omega), zero_mul]
    have h_ps_pow_vanish : ∀ (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (r l : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff Δ = 0 → l < r →
        PowerSeries.coeff l (Δ ^ r) = 0 := by
      intro Δ r
      induction r with
      | zero => intro l _ h; omega
      | succ r ih =>
        intro l hΔ hl
        rw [pow_succ, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro q hq
        rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
        by_cases hq2 : q.2 = 0
        · rw [hq2, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hΔ, mul_zero]
        · rw [ih q.1 hΔ (by omega), zero_mul]
    have h_lift_comp_const : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
        (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
        ∀ (g : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),

          MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →

            lineArcCompConst2D1D g (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) := by
      intro K F Φ hKF hΦK g Ψ hg hΨ0 hΨF
      have h_mk_ite : ∀ a : ℂ,
          (PowerSeries.mk fun l => if l = 0 then a else 0) = PowerSeries.C a := by
        intro a; ext l; rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
      ext d m
      have h_c1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (compPowerSeries2D g Ψ)) =
          lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
              PowerSeries.coeff n g * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n)) := rfl
      have h_c2 : PowerSeries.coeff m
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineArcCompConst2D1D g (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ))) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                MvPowerSeries.C
                  (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then g else 0)) *
                  (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) ^ n)) :=
        PowerSeries.coeff_mk m (fun m' =>
          PowerSeries.coeff m'
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m' + 1),
                MvPowerSeries.C
                  (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then g else 0)) *
                  (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) ^ n)))
      rw [h_c1, h_c2]
      have h_lhs : lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
              PowerSeries.coeff n g * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n)) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
            PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n g) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) ^ n) := by
        rw [h_lift_sum F Φ (Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1))
          (fun n => PowerSeries.coeff n g * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n))
          (fun n _ => F.mul_mem (hKF (hg n)) ((h_pow_mem_lift F Φ Ψ n hΨF).1 d))]
        have h_sub : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
              lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (PowerSeries.coeff n g * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n))) =
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
              PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n g) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ) ^ n) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro n _
          rw [(h_lift_ring_F F Φ _ _ (hKF (hg n)) ((h_pow_mem_lift F Φ Ψ n hΨF).1 d)).2.2]
          have hg_eq : lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (PowerSeries.coeff n g) =
              PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n g) := by
            unfold lineRecLiftArcFn; rw [dif_pos (hKF (hg n))]; exact hΦK _ (hg n)
          rw [hg_eq, ← (h_pow_mem_lift F Φ Ψ n hΨF).2]; rfl
        rw [h_sub]
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega))
        intro n hn_big hn_small
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn_big hn_small
        rw [← (h_pow_mem_lift F Φ Ψ n hΨF).2]
        change PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n g) *
          lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Ψ ^ n)) = 0
        rw [h_mv_pow_vanish Ψ n hΨ0 d (by omega), h_lift_zero, mul_zero]
      rw [h_lhs]
      congr 1
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _
      have h1 : (PowerSeries.mk fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then g else 0)) =
          PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n g) := by
        rw [← h_mk_ite]; congr 1; ext l; split_ifs <;> simp
      rw [h1, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]

      have hd1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← hp]; rfl

    have h_box_diag : ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ),

        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), G i j) =
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (s + 1), G i (s - i) := by

      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi

      intro j hj_big hj_small

    rw [(hLiftMv_ring _ _ (hSub.add_mem E.F_val (hSub.add_mem E.F_val hm1 hm2) hm3) hm4).2.1,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ (hSub.add_mem E.F_val hm1 hm2) hm3).1,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ hm1 hm2).1,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ (h_formal_h_lift i_L).2.1 (h_formal_sincos_lift i_L).1).2.2,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ (h_formal_h_lift i_L).1 (h_formal_sincos_lift i_L).2.1).2.2,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ (h_formal_h_lift i_R).2.1 (h_formal_sincos_lift i_R).1).2.2,
      (hLiftMv_ring _ _ (h_formal_h_lift i_R).1 (h_formal_sincos_lift i_R).2.1).2.2,
      (h_formal_h_lift i_L).2.2.1, (h_formal_h_lift i_L).2.2.2,
      (h_formal_h_lift i_R).2.2.1, (h_formal_h_lift i_R).2.2.2,
      (h_formal_sincos_lift i_L).2.2.1, (h_formal_sincos_lift i_L).2.2.2,
      (h_formal_sincos_lift i_R).2.2.1, (h_formal_sincos_lift i_R).2.2.2]
  have hβ0_c0 : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β_full 0 r) = 0 :=
    fun r => h_ctay_c0 _
  have hβ_end_succ : ∀ J : ℕ, β_full (J + 1) 0 = 0 ∧ β_full (J + 1) (Fin.last k) = 0 :=
    fun J => hβ_end (J + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le J))
  have h_web_step : ∀ J : ℕ,
      lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0
            (lineArcTruncSupport J f_full) (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
        ∑ i : Fin k,
          taylor2D (G.w_fn i) p₁ *
            compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (J + 1)) (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) p₁) =
        MvPowerSeries.C (K_seq (J + 1)) := by
    intro J
    have h_top : lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
        (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_full β_full) =
        MvPowerSeries.C (K_seq (J + 1)) := by
      rw [h_action_lifted]
      ext d
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      change PowerSeries.coeff (J + 1)
        (lineRecLiftArcFn E.F_val Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_line p₁))) = _
      split_ifs with hd
      · subst hd
        rw [h_tay_c0]
      · rw [hLift_K _ (E.action_pos_taylor_mem d hd), PowerSeries.coeff_C,
          if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero J)]
    have h_sp := hSplit.action_top_split hk sin_d0 cos_d0 f_full β_full hβ0_c0 hβ_end_succ J
    rw [h_top] at h_sp
    have h_grad_sum0 :
        (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
          lineRecGrad0 sin_d0 cos_d0 (fun i => f_full i 0) (β_full 0) r *
            β_full (J + 1) ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro r _
      rw [h_grad0_zero r, zero_mul]
    rw [h_grad_sum0, add_zero] at h_sp
    rw [h_sp]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [h_tay_w i, h_ctay_ψ i]
  have h_hess_step : ∀ (J : ℕ) (r : Fin (k - 1)),
      lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0
            (lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) f_full) (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          taylor2D
            (fun q =>
              lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
                (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s)
            p₁ *
          β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0 := by
    intro J r
    have h_sp := hSplit.grad_top_split hk sin_d0 cos_d0 f_full β_full hβ0_c0 hβ_end_succ J r
    rw [h_grad_lifted r] at h_sp
    have h_slice0 : lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1) 0 = 0 := by
      ext d; change PowerSeries.coeff (J + 1) (MvPowerSeries.coeff d 0) = 0; simp
    rw [h_slice0] at h_sp
    symm
    rw [h_sp]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    rw [h_tay_hess r s]
  let H_tay : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    fun r s =>
      taylor2D
        (fun q =>
          lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
            (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s) p₁
  have h_H_det_unit : IsUnit H_tay.det := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, RingHom.map_det]
    have h_mat_eq : (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff).mapMatrix H_tay =
        lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
          (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u p₁) := by
      ext r s
      change MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (H_tay r s) = _
      rw [← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, h_tay_c0]
    rw [h_mat_eq]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (G.trapezoid_nondeg (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap).2.2
  have h_hess_inj : ∀ v : Fin (k - 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ r : Fin (k - 1), ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_tay r s * v s = 0) →
      ∀ s : Fin (k - 1), v s = 0 := by
    intro v hv s
    have h_mv : H_tay.mulVec v = 0 := by
      funext r; exact hv r
    have h_adj : (H_tay.adjugate * H_tay).mulVec v = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h_mv, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul] at h_adj
    have h_smul_s := congr_fun h_adj s
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply] at h_smul_s
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s] at h_smul_s
    · simp only [↓reduceIte, mul_one] at h_smul_s
      exact h_H_det_unit.mul_left_cancel (by rw [mul_zero]; exact h_smul_s)
    · intro t _ hne
      rw [if_neg hne.symm, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ s))
  have h_sub_vanish : ∀ M : ℕ,
      (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i m = 0) →
      ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l ≤ M →
        (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧ K_seq l = 0 := by
    intro M hfM
    induction M with
    | zero => intro l hl1 hl0; omega
    | succ M ih =>
      have hfM' : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ M → ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i m = 0 :=
        fun m hm1 hmM => hfM m hm1 (by omega)
      have h_prev := ih hfM'
      intro l hl1 hl_le
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hl_le with hlt | rfl
      · exact h_prev l hl1 (by omega)
      · have hf_tr_M1 : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m →
            lineArcTruncSupport (M + 1) f_full i m = 0 := by
          intro i m hm1
          unfold lineArcTruncSupport
          split_ifs with hm_le
          · exact hfM m hm1 hm_le i
          · rfl
        have hf_tr_M : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m →
            lineArcTruncSupport M f_full i m = 0 := by
          intro i m hm1
          unfold lineArcTruncSupport
          split_ifs with hm_le
          · exact hfM' m hm1 hm_le i
          · rfl
        have hβ_tr_M : ∀ (m : ℕ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ m →
            lineArcTruncBeta M β_full m r = 0 := by
          intro m r hm1
          unfold lineArcTruncBeta
          split_ifs with hm_le
          · exact (h_prev m hm1 hm_le).1 r
          · rfl
        have h_int0 : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1),
            β_full (M + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ = 0 := by
          apply h_hess_inj
          intro r
          have hh := h_hess_step M r
          rw [(hSplit.slice_pos_zero_of_pos_zero sin_d0 cos_d0 _ _ (M + 1)
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le M)) hf_tr_M1 hβ_tr_M).2 r, zero_add] at hh
          exact hh
        have hβ_all0 : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full (M + 1) r = 0 := by
          intro r
          by_cases hr0 : r.1 = 0
          · have hreq : r = 0 := Fin.ext hr0
            rw [hreq]; exact (hβ_end_succ M).1
          · by_cases hrl : r.1 = k
            · have hreq : r = Fin.last k := Fin.ext hrl
              rw [hreq]; exact (hβ_end_succ M).2
            · let s : Fin (k - 1) := ⟨r.1 - 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
              have hreq : r = ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ := by
                ext; dsimp [s]; omega
              rw [hreq]; exact h_int0 s
        have hK0 : K_seq (M + 1) = 0 := by
          have hw := h_web_step M
          rw [(hSplit.slice_pos_zero_of_pos_zero sin_d0 cos_d0 _ _ (M + 1)
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le M)) hf_tr_M hβ_tr_M).1, zero_add] at hw
          have h_fsum0 : (∑ i : Fin k,
              taylor2D (G.w_fn i) p₁ *
                compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (M + 1)) (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) p₁)) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro i _
            rw [hfM (M + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le M)) le_rfl i]
            have h_c0 : compPowerSeries2D 0 (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) p₁) = 0 := by
              ext d
              change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
                PowerSeries.coeff n 0 * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (_ ^ n)) = 0
              simp
            rw [h_c0, mul_zero]
          rw [h_fsum0] at hw
          have hc := congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0) hw.symm
          rwa [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, map_zero] at hc
        exact ⟨hβ_all0, hK0⟩
  have h_exists_p : ∃ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p ∧ ∃ i : Fin k, f_full i p ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h_none
    have h_all_f0 : ∀ (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i l = 0 := by
      intro l hl i
      by_contra hne
      exact h_none ⟨l, hl, i, hne⟩
    have h_all_β0 : ∀ (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0 := by
      intro l hl r
      exact (h_sub_vanish l (fun m hm1 _ => h_all_f0 m hm1) l hl le_rfl).1 r
    have hΔα_all0 : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), Δα r = 0 := by
      intro r
      ext l
      rcases l with _ | m
      · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hΔα_const0 r, map_zero]
      · have hb : PowerSeries.coeff (m + 1) (Δα r) = 0 :=
          congr_fun (h_all_β0 (m + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m)) r) 0
        rw [map_zero, hb]
    have hθ_all0 : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), θ r = 0 := by
      intro r
      have h2θ : (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) * θ r = 0 := hΔα_all0 r
      have h_half : PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) = 1 := by
        have h2 : (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) = PowerSeries.C (2 : ℂ) := by rw [map_ofNat]
        rw [h2, ← map_mul]; norm_num
      calc θ r = (PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (2 : PowerSeries ℂ)) * θ r := by
            rw [h_half, one_mul]
        _ = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((2 : PowerSeries ℂ) * θ r) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h2θ, mul_zero]
    have hCS_const : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        C_ser r = PowerSeries.C (c_star r) ∧ S_ser r = PowerSeries.C (s_star r) := by
      intro r
      exact ((hTrig.circle_lift _ _ _ _ (hc_sq r) (hCS_sq r)
        (hLift_const _) (hLift_const _)).2.2.2).mp (hθ_all0 r)
    have hΔψ_all0 : ∀ i : Fin k, Δψ i = 0 := by
      intro i; simp [Δψ, hΔα_all0]
    have hA_const : ∀ (i : Fin k) (m : ℕ),
        A_jet i m = PowerSeries.C (iteratedDeriv m C.h_ℂ (G.ψ_fn i p₁)) := by
      intro i m
      have h_seq0 : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → lineRecJetSeq (A_jet i) 0 l = 0 := by
        intro l hl
        have h_eq : lineRecJetSeq (A_jet i) 0 l = f_full i l := by
          dsimp only [f_full]; rw [hΔψ_all0 i]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_all_f0 l hl i
      rw [hLift.jetSeq_eq_C_of_zero_shift (A_jet i) h_seq0 m, hLift_const]
    have hr₀_mem : E.coreTuple r₀ ∈ E.F_val :=
      Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨r₀, rfl⟩)
    have h_lift_r₀ : lineRecLiftArcFn E.F_val Φ (E.coreTuple r₀) =
        PowerSeries.C (E.coreTuple r₀) := by
      have h_mem_core := E.core_entries_subset ⟨r₀, rfl⟩
      rcases h_mem_core with ⟨r, hr_cs | hr_sn⟩ | ⟨i, m, him⟩
      · rw [hr_cs]; exact (hCS_const r).1
      · rw [hr_sn]; exact (hCS_const r).2
      · rw [him]; exact hA_const i m
    unfold lineRecLiftArcFn at h_lift_r₀
    rw [dif_pos hr₀_mem] at h_lift_r₀
    exact hr₀_ne h_lift_r₀
  classical
  let p_min : ℕ := Nat.find h_exists_p
  have hp_spec : 1 ≤ p_min ∧ ∃ i : Fin k, f_full i p_min ≠ 0 := Nat.find_spec h_exists_p
  let i₀ : Fin k := Classical.choose hp_spec.2
  have hi₀_ne : f_full i₀ p_min ≠ 0 := Classical.choose_spec hp_spec.2
  have h_vanish_lt : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < p_min →
      (∀ i : Fin k, f_full i l = 0) ∧ (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), β_full l r = 0) ∧ K_seq l = 0 := by
    have hf_lt : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ p_min - 1 → ∀ i : Fin k, f_full i m = 0 := by
      intro m hm1 hm_le i
      have hm_lt : m < p_min := by have := hp_spec.1; omega
      have hnot := Nat.find_min h_exists_p hm_lt
      by_contra hne
      exact hnot ⟨hm1, i, hne⟩
    intro l hl1 hlt
    have hl_le : l ≤ p_min - 1 := by omega
    exact ⟨hf_lt l hl1 hl_le, (h_sub_vanish (p_min - 1) hf_lt l hl1 hl_le).1,
      (h_sub_vanish (p_min - 1) hf_lt l hl1 hl_le).2⟩
  exact ⟨{
    p := p_min
    p_pos := hp_spec.1
    i₀ := i₀
    f_full := f_full
    β_full := β_full
    K_seq := K_seq
    f_zero := hf_zero
    β_zero := hβ_zero
    β_endpoints := hβ_end
    f_lead_ne_zero := hi₀_ne
    vanish_lt_p := h_vanish_lt
    formal_web_step := h_web_step
    formal_hess_step := h_hess_step
  }⟩

line_arc_formal_recentered_system.definitions:
noncomputable def lineRecPsExpScale (c : ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n => c ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsExp1D (c : ℂ) (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D (lineRecPsExpScale c) (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsCos (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecPsSin (θ : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (MvPowerSeries.C θ))

noncomputable def lineRecCircleAngle (c₀ s₀ : ℂ) (C S : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let u := PowerSeries.C c₀ * C + PowerSeries.C s₀ * S
  let v := PowerSeries.C c₀ * S - PowerSeries.C s₀ * C
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    match n with
    | 0 => 0
    | m + 1 =>
        PowerSeries.coeff m (u * PowerSeries.derivative v - v * PowerSeries.derivative u) /
          ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ))

def lineRecVanishesBelow (k : ℕ) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
    PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) = 0

open Classical in
noncomputable def lineRecLiftArcFn (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  if hz : z ∈ F then Φ ⟨z, hz⟩ else PowerSeries.C z

noncomputable def lineRecLiftMv2D (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ)
    (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  fun d => lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ)

noncomputable def lineRecJetSeq (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (l : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n =>
    PowerSeries.coeff l
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (l + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (1 / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * (r.factorial : ℂ))) * A (n + r) * (-Δ) ^ r))

noncomputable def lineRecIota0 :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.map PowerSeries.C

noncomputable def lineRecXeps (j : ℕ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.X ^ j)

def lineRecEqMod (j : ℕ) (S₁ S₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ≤ j, lineArcSlice2D1D l S₁ = lineArcSlice2D1D l S₂

def lineRecIsEpsConst (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) = 0

noncomputable def lineRecMid0 {k : ℕ}
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (β₀ i.castSucc + β₀ i.succ) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineRecHalfStep0 {k : ℕ}
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (β₀ i.succ - β₀ i.castSucc) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)

noncomputable def lineRecSin0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsCos0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i) +
    MvPowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsSin0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i)

noncomputable def lineRecCos0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (cos_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsCos0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i) -
    MvPowerSeries.C (sin_d0 i) * compPowerSeries2D lineArcPsSin0 (lineRecHalfStep0 β₀ i)

noncomputable def lineRecGrad0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L) *
      lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L +
    compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_L) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L) *
      lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L +
    compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R) *
      lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R -
    compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_R) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R) *
      lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R

noncomputable def lineRecHess0 {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f₀ : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ) (β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (r s : Fin (k - 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let H_L := compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_L) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H'_L := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H''_L := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_L)))
    (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_L)
  let H_R := compPowerSeries2D (f₀ i_R) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let H'_R := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)) (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let H''_R := compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ i_R)))
    (lineRecMid0 β₀ i_R)
  let S_L := lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L
  let C_L := lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_L
  let S_R := lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R
  let C_R := lineRecCos0 sin_d0 cos_d0 β₀ i_R
  if r.1 = s.1 then
    ((H''_L - H_L) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_L + H'_L * C_L) +
      ((H''_R - H_R) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_R - H'_R * C_R)
  else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
    (H_R + H''_R) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_R
  else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
    (H_L + H''_L) * MvPowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * S_L
  else
    0

structure LineRecFormalTrigToolkit : Prop where
  trig_coeff_mem : ∀ (K : Subfield ℂ) (n : ℕ),
    PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsSin0 ∈ K ∧ PowerSeries.coeff n lineArcPsCos0 ∈ K
  trig_deriv :
    PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsSin0 = lineArcPsCos0 ∧
    PowerSeries.derivative lineArcPsCos0 = -lineArcPsSin0
  circle_lift : ∀ (c₀ s₀ : ℂ) (C S : PowerSeries ℂ),
    c₀ ^ 2 + s₀ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C ^ 2 + S ^ 2 = 1 →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C = c₀ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S = s₀ →
    let θ := lineRecCircleAngle c₀ s₀ C S
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff θ = 0 ∧
    C = PowerSeries.C c₀ * lineRecPsCos θ - PowerSeries.C s₀ * lineRecPsSin θ ∧
    S = PowerSeries.C s₀ * lineRecPsCos θ + PowerSeries.C c₀ * lineRecPsSin θ ∧
    (θ = 0 ↔ C = PowerSeries.C c₀ ∧ S = PowerSeries.C s₀)
  half_step_diff : ∀ (c₁ s₁ c₂ s₂ : ℂ) (C₁ S₁ C₂ S₂ : PowerSeries ℂ),
    c₁ ^ 2 + s₁ ^ 2 = 1 →
    c₂ ^ 2 + s₂ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C₁ ^ 2 + S₁ ^ 2 = 1 →
    C₂ ^ 2 + S₂ ^ 2 = 1 →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C₁ = c₁ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S₁ = s₁ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff C₂ = c₂ →
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff S₂ = s₂ →
    let θ₁ := lineRecCircleAngle c₁ s₁ C₁ S₁
    let θ₂ := lineRecCircleAngle c₂ s₂ C₂ S₂
    S₂ * C₁ - C₂ * S₁ =
      PowerSeries.C (s₂ * c₁ - c₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsCos (θ₂ - θ₁) +
        PowerSeries.C (c₂ * c₁ + s₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsSin (θ₂ - θ₁) ∧
    C₂ * C₁ + S₂ * S₁ =
      PowerSeries.C (c₂ * c₁ + s₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsCos (θ₂ - θ₁) -
        PowerSeries.C (s₂ * c₁ - c₂ * s₁) * lineRecPsSin (θ₂ - θ₁)
  comp_trig_add_2D1D : ∀ (w : PowerSeries ℂ) (B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff w = 0 →
    MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 B = 0 →
    lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 (MvPowerSeries.C w + B) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsCos w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 B -
        MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsSin w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 B ∧
    lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 (MvPowerSeries.C w + B) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsSin w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsCos0 B +
        MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecPsCos w) * lineArcCompConst2D1D lineArcPsSin0 B

structure LineRecFormalLiftToolkit : Prop where
  jetSeq_zero : ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (n : ℕ),
    PowerSeries.coeff n (lineRecJetSeq A Δ 0) =
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (A n) / (n.factorial : ℂ)
  jetSeq_deriv : ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (l : ℕ),
    PowerSeries.derivative (lineRecJetSeq A Δ l) = lineRecJetSeq (fun m => A (m + 1)) Δ l
  jetSeq_eq_C_of_zero_shift : ∀ (A : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → lineRecJetSeq A 0 l = 0) →
    ∀ m : ℕ, A m = PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (A m))
  liftArcFn_props : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
    (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
    (∀ y : ↥F, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (Φ y) = (y : ℂ)) →
    (∀ z : ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ z) = z) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ K, lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x = PowerSeries.C x) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F,
      lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x + y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x + lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
      lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x - y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x - lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y ∧
      lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (x * y) = lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ x * lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ y)
  liftMv2D_ring : ∀ (F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ),
    (∀ c : ℂ, lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (MvPowerSeries.C c) =
      MvPowerSeries.C (lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ c)) ∧
    (∀ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ,
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁ ∈ F) →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ + Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ + lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ - Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ - lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂ ∧
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (Ψ₁ * Ψ₂) = lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₁ * lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ₂)
  liftMv2D_comp_const : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
    (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
    ∀ (g : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ n, PowerSeries.coeff n g ∈ K) →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ (compPowerSeries2D g Ψ) =
        lineArcCompConst2D1D g (lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ)
  liftMv2D_comp_recenter : ∀ (K F : Subfield ℂ) (Φ : ↥F →+* PowerSeries ℂ) (hKF : K ≤ F),
    (∀ (x : ℂ) (hx : x ∈ K), Φ ⟨x, hKF hx⟩ = PowerSeries.C x) →
    ∀ (H_star : ℕ → ℂ) (Δ : PowerSeries ℂ) (Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ m, H_star m ∈ F) →
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff Δ = 0 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ = 0 →
      (∀ d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ ∈ F) →
      lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ
          (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.mk (fun n => H_star n / (n.factorial : ℂ))) Ψ) =
        lineArcComp2D1D
          (lineRecJetSeq (fun m => lineRecLiftArcFn F Φ (H_star m)) Δ)
          (MvPowerSeries.C Δ + lineRecLiftMv2D F Φ Ψ)

structure LineRecTopSplitToolkit : Prop where
  action_top_split : ∀ {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β_full 0 r) = 0) →
    (∀ J : ℕ, β_full (J + 1) 0 = 0 ∧ β_full (J + 1) (Fin.last k) = 0) →
    ∀ J : ℕ,
      lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1) (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_full β_full) =
        lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0
            (lineArcTruncSupport J f_full) (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full)) +
        (∑ i : Fin k,
          (2 * lineRecSin0 sin_d0 cos_d0 (β_full 0) i) *
            compPowerSeries2D (f_full i (J + 1)) (lineRecMid0 (β_full 0) i)) +
        ∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
          lineRecGrad0 sin_d0 cos_d0 (fun i => f_full i 0) (β_full 0) r *
            β_full (J + 1) ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  grad_top_split : ∀ {k : ℕ} (_hk : 2 ≤ k) (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_full : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_full : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
    (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β_full 0 r) = 0) →
    (∀ J : ℕ, β_full (J + 1) 0 = 0 ∧ β_full (J + 1) (Fin.last k) = 0) →
    ∀ (J : ℕ) (r : Fin (k - 1)),
      lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1) (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_full β_full r) =
        lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0
            (lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) f_full) (lineArcTruncBeta J β_full) r) +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
          lineRecHess0 sin_d0 cos_d0 (fun i => f_full i 0) (β_full 0) r s *
            β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  slice_pos_zero_of_pos_zero : ∀ {k : ℕ} (sin_d0 cos_d0 : Fin k → ℂ)
    (f_seq : Fin k → ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β_seq : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (m : ℕ),
    1 ≤ m →
    (∀ (i : Fin k) (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ l → f_seq i l = 0) →
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ l → β_seq l r = 0) →
    lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalAction2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq) = 0 ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineArcSlice2D1D m (lineArcFormalGrad2D1D sin_d0 cos_d0 f_seq β_seq r) = 0

structure LineRecSubSeriesToolkit : Prop where
  C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c)
  X_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) (s : Fin 2), lineCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.X s)
  add_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S + T)
  sub_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S - T)
  mul_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L S → lineCoreCoeffsIn L T → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T)
  comp1D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {f : PowerSeries ℂ} {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
    (∀ n : ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff n f ∈ L) → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
    lineCoreCoeffsIn L U → lineCoreCoeffsIn L (compPowerSeries2D f U)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have ha₁_abs : |a₁ - G.a₀| < G.R / 4 :=
    abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ha₁.1], by linarith [ha₁.2]⟩
  have ha₁_trap_bound : |a₁ - G.a₀| < G.R - G.C₀ * G.δ_star := by
    linarith [G.C₀_δ_star_lt, G.R_pos]
  have hq₁_trap : (a₁, δ₁) ∈ webTrapezoid G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star G.C₀ := by
    refine ⟨hδ₁.1, hδ₁.2, ?_⟩
    have hCδ : G.C₀ * δ₁ < G.C₀ * G.δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ₁.2 G.C₀_pos
    linarith
  have hp₁_S : p₁ ∈ S.V_plus := S.trapezoid_mem_V_plus (a₁, δ₁) hq₁_trap
  have hU₀_base : ∀ q ∈ webBaseClosure G.a₀ G.R G.δ_star, ((q.1 : ℂ), (q.2 : ℂ)) ∈ U₀ := by
    intro q hq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith [hq.2.2, G.R_pos]
    · rw [LineGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hq.1]
      linarith [hq.2.1, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hinv2_U₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (2 : ℂ)⁻¹) U₀ :=
    differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹
  have hψ_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.ψ_fn i) U₀ := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.castSucc
    have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.succ
    exact ((h1.add h2).mul hinv2_U₀).congr fun q _ => by
      change (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q + lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) / 2 = _
      exact div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
  have hd_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.d_fn i) U₀ := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.succ
    have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) U₀ :=
      G.α_holo i.castSucc
    exact ((h1.sub h2).mul hinv2_U₀).congr fun q _ => by
      change (lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.succ q - lineChartAlpha C k G.Ψ i.castSucc q) / 2 = _
      exact div_eq_mul_inv _ 2
  have hw_holo_U₀ : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.w_fn i) U₀ := by
    intro i
    exact ((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul
      (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (hd_holo i))).congr fun _ _ => rfl

  
  have hh_S : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.h_ℂ S.W_ψ := C.h_ℂ_holo.mono S.W_ψ_sub_strip
  have hg0_S : ∀ (i : Fin k) (z : ℂ), S.g i 0 z = 0 :=
    fun i z => S.g_lt_p i 0 (by have := D_form.p_pos; simp; omega) z
  have hα_S : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.α_fn s) S.V_plus :=
    fun s => (G.α_holo s).mono S.V_plus_sub
  let B_act : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
    lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
      (fun ε =>
        lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ S.g ε)
          (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => S.β m s q) ε))
  let B_rhs : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => D_form.K_seq (J + 1) - B_act q
  have hB_act_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ B_act S.V_plus :=
    (hJet.epsJet_holo (J + 1) S.W_ψ_open S.V_plus_open hh_S S.g_holo hg0_S
      hα_S S.ψ_maps_W_ψ S.β_holo S.β_zero).1
  have hB_rhs_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ B_rhs S.V_plus :=
    (differentiableOn_const (D_form.K_seq (J + 1))).sub hB_act_holo
  have hB_act_taylor :
      taylor2D B_act p₁ =
        lineArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (lineArcFormalAction2D1D
            (fun i => Complex.sin (G.d_fn i p₁))
            (fun i => Complex.cos (G.d_fn i p₁))
            (lineArcTruncSupport J D_form.f_full)
            (lineArcTruncBeta J D_form.β_full)) := by
    have ht := (hJet.taylor2D_epsJet_eq (J + 1) S.W_ψ_open S.V_plus_open hp₁_S
      hh_S S.g_holo hg0_S hα_S S.ψ_maps_W_ψ S.β_holo S.β_zero).1
    have hf_eq :
        (fun (i : Fin k) (l : ℕ) =>
          if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => G.α_fn s p₁) i)
          else if hl : l < J + 1 then
            lineArcHoloTaylor1D (S.g i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => G.α_fn s p₁) i)
          else 0) = lineArcTruncSupport J D_form.f_full := by
      funext i l
      unfold lineArcTruncSupport
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.zero_le]
        exact (D_form.f_zero i).symm
      · by_cases hl : l < J + 1
        · have hl_le : l ≤ J := by omega
          have hl_ge1 : 1 ≤ (⟨l, hl⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).1 := by simp; omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hl, ↓reduceDIte, hl_le]
          exact S.g_taylor i ⟨l, hl⟩ hl_ge1
        · have hl_nle : ¬ l ≤ J := by omega
          simp [hl0, hl, hl_nle]
    have hβ_eq :
        (fun (l : ℕ) (s : Fin (k + 1)) =>
          if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn s) p₁
          else if hl : l < J + 1 then taylor2D (S.β ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
          else 0) = lineArcTruncBeta J D_form.β_full := by
      funext l s
      unfold lineArcTruncBeta
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.zero_le]
        exact (D_form.β_zero s).symm
      · by_cases hl : l < J + 1
        · have hl_le : l ≤ J := by omega
          have hl_ge1 : 1 ≤ (⟨l, hl⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).1 := by simp; omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hl, ↓reduceDIte, hl_le]
          exact S.β_taylor ⟨l, hl⟩ s hl_ge1
        · have hl_nle : ¬ l ≤ J := by omega
          simp [hl0, hl, hl_nle]
    rw [hf_eq, hβ_eq] at ht
    exact ht
  have h_web_formal :
      ∑ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (G.w_fn i) p₁ *
          compPowerSeries2D (D_form.f_full i (J + 1)) (centeredTaylor2D (G.ψ_fn i) p₁) =
        taylor2D B_rhs p₁ := by
    have hsub : taylor2D B_rhs p₁ =
        MvPowerSeries.C (D_form.K_seq (J + 1)) - taylor2D B_act p₁ := by
      rw [(hJet.taylor2D_ring S.V_plus_open hp₁_S

    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab

    · simp_all
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h1 : 0 < a * x.2 := mul_pos ha_pos hx.1
        have h2 : 0 ≤ b * y.2 := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt hy.1)
        change 0 < a * x.2 + b * y.2

      · have h1 : a * x.2 < a * G.δ_star := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx.2.1 ha_pos
        have h2 : b * y.2 ≤ b * G.δ_star := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy.2.1) hb
        change a * x.2 + b * y.2 < G.δ_star
        calc a * x.2 + b * y.2
            < a * G.δ_star + b * G.δ_star := by linarith
          _ = G.δ_star := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      · change |(a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀| < G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2)
        have hsplit : (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀ = a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀) := by
          calc (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - G.a₀
              = (a * x.1 + b * y.1) - (a + b) * G.a₀ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀) := by ring
        rw [hsplit]
        calc |a * (x.1 - G.a₀) + b * (y.1 - G.a₀)|
            ≤ |a * (x.1 - G.a₀)| + |b * (y.1 - G.a₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |x.1 - G.a₀| + b * |y.1 - G.a₀| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
          _ < a * (G.R - G.C₀ * x.2) + b * (G.R - G.C₀ * y.2) := by

          _ = G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2) := by

                _ = G.R - G.C₀ * (a * x.2 + b * y.2) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
