    fun q hq => S.hess_det_ne_zero q (hV_plus'_sub_S hq)

  let β_formal : Fin (k - 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun s => D_form.β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  have h_hess_formal : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_stat q r s) p₁ * β_formal s = 0 := by
    intro r
    have ht := (hJet.taylor2D_epsJet_eq (J + 1) hW_ψ'_open hV_plus'_open hp₁_V'
      hh_W' hg'_holo hg'_zero hα_V' hψ_maps_W_ψ' hβ_zt_holo hβ_zt_zero).2 r
    have hf_eq :
        (fun (i : Fin k) (l : ℕ) =>
          if l = 0 then lineArcHoloTaylor1D C.h_ℂ (lineChainMid (fun s => G.α_fn s p₁) i)
          else if hl : l < J + 1 + 1 then
            lineArcHoloTaylor1D (g' i ⟨l, hl⟩) (lineChainMid (fun s => G.α_fn s p₁) i)
          else 0) = lineArcTruncSupport (J + 1) D_form.f_full := by
      funext i l
      unfold lineArcTruncSupport
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.zero_le]
        exact (D_form.f_zero i).symm
      · by_cases hl : l < J + 1 + 1
        · have hl_le : l ≤ J + 1 := by omega
          have hl_ge1 : 1 ≤ (⟨l, hl⟩ : Fin (J + 1 + 1)).1 := by simp; omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hl, ↓reduceDIte, hl_le]
          exact hg'_taylor i ⟨l, hl⟩ hl_ge1
        · have hl_nle : ¬ l ≤ J + 1 := by omega
          simp [hl0, hl, hl_nle]
    have hβ_eq :
        (fun (l : ℕ) (s : Fin (k + 1)) =>
          if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (G.α_fn s) p₁
          else if hl : l < J + 1 + 1 then taylor2D (β_zero_top ⟨l, hl⟩ s) p₁
          else 0) = lineArcTruncBeta J D_form.β_full := by
      funext l s
      unfold lineArcTruncBeta
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simp only [↓reduceIte, Nat.zero_le]
        exact (D_form.β_zero s).symm
      · by_cases hlJ : l < J + 1
        · have hl : l < J + 1 + 1 := by omega
          have hl_le : l ≤ J := by omega
          have hfin : (⟨l, hl⟩ : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = (⟨l, hlJ⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc :=
            Fin.ext rfl
          have hl_ge1 : 1 ≤ (⟨l, hlJ⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).1 := by simp; omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hl, ↓reduceDIte, hl_le, hfin, hβ_zt_cast]
          exact S.β_taylor ⟨l, hlJ⟩ s hl_ge1
        · by_cases hl : l < J + 1 + 1
          · have hl_nle : ¬ l ≤ J := by omega
            have hfin : (⟨l, hl⟩ : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = Fin.last (J + 1) := by
              ext; simp; omega
            simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hl, ↓reduceDIte, hl_nle, hfin, hβ_zt_last]
            rw [hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
          · have hl_nle : ¬ l ≤ J := by omega
            simp [hl0, hl, hl_nle]
    rw [hf_eq, hβ_eq] at ht
    change taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ = _ at ht
    rw [ht]
    exact D_form.formal_hess_step J r

  have hM_det_holo : ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ),
      (∀ r s : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => M q r s) V_plus') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (M q).det) V_plus' := by
    intro M hM
    have hprod : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k - 1))) (s : Finset (Fin (k - 1))),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∏ i ∈ s, M q (σ i) i) V_plus' := by
      intro σ s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        exact ((hM (σ a) a).mul ih).congr fun q _ => Finset.prod_insert ha
    have hdet_eq : (fun q => (M q).det) = fun q =>
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k - 1)),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin (k - 1), M q (σ i) i := by
      ext q
      simp only [Matrix.det_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hdet_eq]
    exact DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun σ _ =>
      (differentiableOn_const _).mul (hprod σ Finset.univ)

  let β_int : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun u q =>
    -((H_stat q).det)⁻¹ * ((H_stat q).cramer (R_grad q)) u
  have hβ_int_holo : ∀ u : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β_int u) V_plus' := by
    intro u
    have hdet_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => -((H_stat q).det)⁻¹) V_plus' :=
      ((hM_det_holo H_stat hH_holo).inv hH_det_ne).neg
    have hcramer : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ((H_stat q).cramer (R_grad q)) u) V_plus' := by
      have hfn : (fun q => ((H_stat q).cramer (R_grad q)) u) =
          fun q => ((H_stat q).updateCol u (R_grad q)).det := by
        ext q
        exact Matrix.cramer_apply (H_stat q) (R_grad q) u
      rw [hfn]
      apply hM_det_holo
      intro r s
      by_cases hsu : s = u
      · subst hsu
        exact (hR_holo r).congr fun q _ => by simp
      · exact (hH_holo r s).congr fun q _ => by simp [hsu]
    exact hdet_inv.mul hcramer
  have hβ_int_solve : ∀ q ∈ V_plus', ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      R_grad q r + ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_stat q r s * β_int s q = 0 := by
    intro q hq r
    have hβ_eq_smul : (fun s => β_int s q) = (-((H_stat q).det)⁻¹) • (H_stat q).cramer (R_grad q) := by
      ext s
      simp [β_int]
    have hsum : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_stat q r s * β_int s q) =
        ((H_stat q).mulVec (fun s => β_int s q)) r := rfl
    rw [hsum, hβ_eq_smul, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_cramer]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    calc R_grad q r + -((H_stat q).det)⁻¹ * ((H_stat q).det * R_grad q r)
        = R_grad q r - (((H_stat q).det)⁻¹ * (H_stat q).det) * R_grad q r := by ring
      _ = R_grad q r - 1 * R_grad q r := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hH_det_ne q hq)]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  have htaylor_sum : ∀ (s_set : Finset (Fin (k - 1))) (F : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ u ∈ s_set, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F u) V_plus') →
      taylor2D (fun q => ∑ u ∈ s_set, F u q) p₁ = ∑ u ∈ s_set, taylor2D (F u) p₁ := by
    intro s_set F hF
    induction s_set using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      rw [hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
    | insert a s_set ha ih =>
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F a) V_plus' := hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s_set)
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ u ∈ s_set, F u q) V_plus' :=
        DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun u hu => hF u (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu)
      have hcongr : taylor2D (fun q => ∑ u ∈ insert a s_set, F u q) p₁ =
          taylor2D (fun q => F a q + ∑ u ∈ s_set, F u q) p₁ :=
        hJet.taylor2D_congr hV_plus'_open hp₁_V' fun q _ => Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [hcongr, (hJet.taylor2D_ring hV_plus'_open hp₁_V' h1 h2).1,
        ih (fun u hu => hF u (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hu)), Finset.sum_insert ha]
  have hβ_int_taylor : ∀ u : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (β_int u) p₁ = β_formal u := by
    have h_int_series : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
          ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_stat q r s) p₁ * taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ = 0 := by
      intro r
      have h0 : taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r + ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_stat q r s * β_int s q) p₁ =
          taylor2D (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) p₁ :=
        hJet.taylor2D_congr hV_plus'_open hp₁_V' fun q hq => hβ_int_solve q hq r
      have hsum_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_stat q r s * β_int s q) V_plus' :=
        DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun s _ => (hH_holo r s).mul (hβ_int_holo s)
      rw [hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero,
        (hJet.taylor2D_ring hV_plus'_open hp₁_V' (hR_holo r) hsum_holo).1,
        htaylor_sum Finset.univ (fun s q => H_stat q r s * β_int s q)
          (fun s _ => (hH_holo r s).mul (hβ_int_holo s))] at h0
      rw [← h0]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
      exact ((hJet.taylor2D_ring hV_plus'_open hp₁_V' (hH_holo r s) (hβ_int_holo s)).2.2).symm
    let M_ps : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
      fun r s => taylor2D (fun q => H_stat q r s) p₁
    let Δ : Fin (k - 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun s => taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ - β_formal s
    have hMΔ : M_ps.mulVec Δ = 0 := by
      funext r
      change ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), M_ps r s * (taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ - β_formal s) = 0
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have h1 := h_int_series r
      have h2 := h_hess_formal r
      change taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), M_ps r s * taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ = 0 at h1
      change taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), M_ps r s * β_formal s = 0 at h2
      have hdiff := congr_arg₂ (· - ·) h1 h2
      simpa [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using hdiff
    have hadj : (M_ps.adjugate * M_ps).mulVec Δ = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hMΔ, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec] at hadj
    have hmap_det : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff M_ps.det = (H_stat p₁).det := by
      rw [RingHom.map_det]
      congr 1
      ext r s
      rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
      change iterDerivYT ((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0) ((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1) (fun q => H_stat q r s) p₁ /
        ((((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0).factorial : ℂ) * (((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1).factorial : ℂ)) =
        H_stat p₁ r s
      simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    have hdet_unit : IsUnit M_ps.det := by
      rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, hmap_det]
      exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hH_det_ne p₁ hp₁_V')
    intro u
    have hu : Δ u * M_ps.det = 0 := by
      have h1 : (M_ps.det • Δ) u = 0 := congr_fun hadj u
      simpa [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h1
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((hdet_unit.mul_left_eq_zero).mp hu)

  
  let β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun s q =>
    if hs : 0 < s.1 ∧ s.1 < k then β_int ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩ q else 0
  have hβ_top_end : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, β_top 0 q = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) q = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [β_top]
  have hβ_top_succ : ∀ (u : Fin (k - 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      β_top ⟨u.1 + 1, by have := u.2; omega⟩ q = β_int u q := by
    intro u q
    have hs : 0 < u.1 + 1 ∧ u.1 + 1 < k := by have := u.2; omega
    dsimp only [β_top]
    split_ifs
    rfl
  have hβ_top_holo : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β_top s) V_plus' := by
    intro s
    by_cases hs : 0 < s.1 ∧ s.1 < k
    · exact (hβ_int_holo ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩).congr fun q _ => by dsimp only [β_top]; split_ifs; rfl
    · exact (differentiableOn_const 0).congr fun q _ => by dsimp only [β_top]; split_ifs; rfl
  have hβ_top_taylor : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), taylor2D (β_top s) p₁ = D_form.β_full (J + 1) s := by
    intro s
    by_cases hs : 0 < s.1 ∧ s.1 < k
    · have hfn : β_top s = β_int ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩ :=
        funext fun q => by dsimp only [β_top]; split_ifs; rfl
      rw [hfn, hβ_int_taylor ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩]
      dsimp only [β_formal]
      congr 1
      ext
      dsimp only
      omega
    · have hfn : β_top s = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) :=
        funext fun q => by dsimp only [β_top]; split_ifs; rfl
      rw [hfn, hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
      have hs_cases : s = 0 ∨ s = Fin.last k := by
        have := s.2
        rcases (by omega : s.1 = 0 ∨ s.1 = k) with h0 | hk'
        · left; ext; exact h0
        · right; ext; exact hk'
      rcases hs_cases with rfl | rfl
      · exact ((D_form.β_endpoints (J + 1) (by omega)).1).symm
      · exact ((D_form.β_endpoints (J + 1) (by omega)).2).symm

  let β' : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := Fin.snoc S.β β_top
  have hβ'_cast : ∀ (m : Fin (J + 1)) (s : Fin (k + 1)), β' m.castSucc s = S.β m s := by
    intro m s
    exact congr_fun (Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) β_top S.β m) s
  have hβ'_last : ∀ s : Fin (k + 1), β' (Fin.last (J + 1)) s = β_top s := by
    intro s
    exact congr_fun (Fin.snoc_last (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) β_top S.β) s
  have hβ'_holo : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (β' l r) V_plus' := by
    intro l r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l
    · rw [hβ'_last r]
      exact hβ_top_holo r
    · intro m
      rw [hβ'_cast m r]
      exact (S.β_holo m r).mono hV_plus'_sub_S
  have hβ'_zero : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ), β' 0 r q = 0 := by
    intro r q
    rw [← Fin.castSucc_zero, hβ'_cast]
    exact S.β_zero r q
  have hβ'_endpoints : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      β' l 0 q = 0 ∧ β' l (Fin.last k) q = 0 := by
    intro l q
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l
    · rw [hβ'_last 0, hβ'_last (Fin.last k)]
      exact hβ_top_end q
    · intro m
      rw [hβ'_cast m 0, hβ'_cast m (Fin.last k)]
      exact S.β_endpoints m q
  have hβ'_taylor : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) (r : Fin (k + 1)), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
      taylor2D (β' l r) p₁ = D_form.β_full (l : ℕ) r := by
    intro l r
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l
    · intro _
      rw [hβ'_last r, Fin.val_last]
      exact hβ_top_taylor r
    · intro m hl
      rw [hβ'_cast m r, Fin.val_castSucc]
      exact S.β_taylor m r (by simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc] using hl)

  have h_top_jets : ∀ q ∈ V_plus',
      lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
          (fun ε =>
            lineChainAction (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g' ε)
              (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β' m s q) ε)) =
        D_form.K_seq (J + 1) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
        lineArcEpsJet (J + 1)
            (fun ε =>
              lineInteriorGrad (lineArcPertSupport C.h_ℂ g' ε)
                (lineArcPertSupportDeriv C.h_ℂ g' ε)
                (lineArcPertAngles (fun s => G.α_fn s q) (fun m s => β' m s q) ε) r) = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hβ'_pt : (fun m s => β' m s q) =
        Fin.snoc (fun m s => S.β m s q) (fun s => β_top s q) := by
      funext m s
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m
      · rw [hβ'_last s, Fin.snoc_last (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)]
      · intro m₀
        rw [hβ'_cast m₀ s, Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)]
    have hβ_zt_pt : (fun m s => β_zero_top m s q) =
        Fin.snoc (fun m s => S.β m s q) (fun _ => 0) := by
      funext m s
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m
      · rw [hβ_zt_last s, Fin.snoc_last (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)]
      · intro m₀
        rw [hβ_zt_cast m₀ s, Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)]
    have hsplit := hJet.epsJet_succ_split (g := S.g) (g_top := g_new)
      (α₀ := fun s => G.α_fn s q)
      (β := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β_top := fun s => β_top s q)
      hk hW_ψ'_open hh_W'
      (fun i m => (S.g_holo i m).mono hW_ψ'_sub_S)
      (fun i => (hg_new_holo i).mono hW_ψ'_sub_new)
      hg0_S (hψ_maps_W_ψ' q hq) (fun s => S.β_zero s q) (hβ_top_end q)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hβ'_pt, hsplit.1]
      have hstat_zero :
          (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
            lineInteriorGrad (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
              (fun s => G.α_fn s q) r *
              β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ q) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
        rw [G.stationary_on_chart q (hV_plus'_sub_U₀ hq) r, zero_mul]
      have hweb_q := (hg_new_eq q (hV_plus'_sub_new hq)).2
      change ∑ i : Fin k, G.w_fn i q * g_new i (G.ψ_fn i q) =
        D_form.K_seq (J + 1) - B_act q at hweb_q
      have hsum_w :
          (∑ i : Fin k,
            2 * Complex.sin (lineChainHalfStep (fun s => G.α_fn s q) i) *
              g_new i (lineChainMid (fun s => G.α_fn s q) i)) =
          ∑ i : Fin k, G.w_fn i q * g_new i (G.ψ_fn i q) := rfl
      rw [hstat_zero, add_zero, hsum_w, hweb_q]
      change B_act q + (D_form.K_seq (J + 1) - B_act q) = D_form.K_seq (J + 1)
      exact add_sub_cancel _ _
    · intro r
      rw [hβ'_pt]
      rw [hsplit.2 r, ← hβ_zt_pt]
      have hsum_hess :
          (∑ s : Fin (k - 1),
            lineInteriorHess (fun _ => C.h_ℂ) (fun _ => deriv C.h_ℂ)
              (fun _ => deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ)) (fun u => G.α_fn u q) r s *
              β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ q) =
          ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_stat q r s * β_int s q := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
        rw [hβ_top_succ s q]
      rw [hsum_hess]
      exact hβ_int_solve q hq r

  refine ⟨{
    W_ψ := W_ψ'
    V_plus := V_plus'
    g := g'
    β := β'
    W_ψ_open := hW_ψ'_open
    W_ψ_preconn := hW_ψ'_preconn
    W_ψ_sub_strip := hW_ψ'_sub_strip
    real_mem_W_ψ := hW_ψ'_real
    base_ψ_mem := hbase_ψ_mem'
    V_plus_open := hV_plus'_open
    V_plus_preconn := hV_plus'_preconn
    V_plus_sub := hV_plus'_sub_U₀
    trapezoid_mem_V_plus := hTrap_mem_V_plus'
    ψ_maps_W_ψ := hψ_maps_W_ψ'
    hess_det_ne_zero := hH_det_ne
    g_holo := hg'_holo
    g_lt_p := hg'_lt_p
    g_taylor := hg'_taylor
    β_holo := hβ'_holo
    β_zero := hβ'_zero
    β_endpoints := hβ'_endpoints
    β_taylor := hβ'_taylor
    grad_jet_zero := by
      intro q hq r l hl1 hlJ1
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlJ1 with rfl | hl_lt
      · exact (h_top_jets q hq).2 r
      · have hlJ : l ≤ J := by omega
        have htrunc := (hJet.epsJet_trunc_eq (J₁ := J) (J₂ := J + 1)
          (g₁ := S.g) (g₂ := g') (α₀ := fun s => G.α_fn s q)
          (β₁ := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β₂ := fun m s => β' m s q)
          (Nat.le_succ J) hl1 hlJ hW_ψ'_open hh_W'
          (fun i m => (S.g_holo i m).mono hW_ψ'_sub_S) hg'_holo hg0_S hg'_zero
          (fun i m z _ => congr_fun (hg'_cast i m) z)
          (hψ_maps_W_ψ' q hq)
          (fun s => S.β_zero s q) (fun s => hβ'_zero s q)
          (fun m s => congr_fun (hβ'_cast m s) q)).2 r
        rw [htrunc]
        exact S.grad_jet_zero q (hV_plus'_sub_S hq) r l hl1 hlJ
    action_jet_const := by
      intro q hq l
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ l
      · intro _
        rw [Fin.val_last]
        exact (h_top_jets q hq).1
      · intro m hl1
        rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at hl1 ⊢
        have hmJ : (m : ℕ) ≤ J := Nat.le_of_lt_succ m.2
        have htrunc := (hJet.epsJet_trunc_eq (J₁ := J) (J₂ := J + 1)
          (g₁ := S.g) (g₂ := g') (α₀ := fun s => G.α_fn s q)
          (β₁ := fun m₀ s => S.β m₀ s q) (β₂ := fun m₀ s => β' m₀ s q)
          (Nat.le_succ J) hl1 hmJ hW_ψ'_open hh_W'
          (fun i m₀ => (S.g_holo i m₀).mono hW_ψ'_sub_S) hg'_holo hg0_S hg'_zero
          (fun i m₀ z _ => congr_fun (hg'_cast i m₀) z)
          (hψ_maps_W_ψ' q hq)
          (fun s => S.β_zero s q) (fun s => hβ'_zero s q)
          (fun m₀ s => congr_fun (hβ'_cast m₀ s) q)).1
        rw [htrunc]
        exact S.action_jet_const q (hV_plus'_sub_S hq) m hl1
  }, hg'_cast⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hidx_zero : ∀ a b : ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D a b 0 = a := by
    intro a b
    change (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b])) 0 = a
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hidx_one : ∀ a b : ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D a b 1 = b := by
    intro a b
    change (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm ![a, b])) 1 = b
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hidx_eta : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D (d 0) (d 1) = d := by
    intro d
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hidx_zero (d 0) (d 1)
    · exact hidx_one (d 0) (d 1)
  have hidx_00 : pointCoreIdx2D 0 0 = 0 := by
    simpa using hidx_eta 0
  have hd_eq_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 + d 1 = 0 := by
    intro d
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; rfl
    · intro h
      rw [← hidx_eta d]
      have h0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
      have h1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0, h1, hidx_00]
  have hidx_10 : pointCoreIdx2D 1 0 = Finsupp.single 0 1 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hidx_zero, hidx_one]
  have hidx_01 : pointCoreIdx2D 0 1 = Finsupp.single 1 1 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hidx_zero, hidx_one]
  have hidx_add_e0 : ∀ a b : ℕ,
      pointCoreIdx2D a b + Finsupp.single 0 1 = pointCoreIdx2D (a + 1) b := by
    intro a b; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hidx_zero, hidx_one]
  have hidx_add_e1 : ∀ a b : ℕ,
      pointCoreIdx2D a b + Finsupp.single 1 1 = pointCoreIdx2D a (b + 1) := by
    intro a b; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hidx_zero, hidx_one]
  have hantidiag_deg : ∀ {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} {p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)},
      p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d →
      (p.1 0 + p.1 1) + (p.2 0 + p.2 1) = d 0 + d 1 := by
    intro d p hp
    have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    have h0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by simpa using congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 0) hp_eq
    have h1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by simpa using congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 1) hp_eq
    omega
  have hcoeff_raw : ∀ (S : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = S d := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hcoeff_taylor2D : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀) =
        iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hcoeff_mvA : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivA S) =
        ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 0 1) S :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have hcoeff_mvD : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDerivD S) =
        ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1) S :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have hcoeff_comp1D : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f U) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff n f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U ^ n) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hcoeff_comp2D : ∀ (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂) =
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

  
  
  
  have h_vanishesBelow_zero : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, pointCoreVanishesBelow 0 S := by
    intro S d hd; omega
  have h_vanishesBelow_mono : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      N₁ ≤ N₂ → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₂ S → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₁ S := by
    intro N₁ N₂ S hle hS d hd
    exact hS d (lt_of_lt_of_le hd hle)
  have h_vanishesBelow_add : ∀ {N : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreVanishesBelow N A → pointCoreVanishesBelow N B →
      pointCoreVanishesBelow N (A + B) := by
    intro N A B hA hB d hd
    rw [map_add, hA d hd, hB d hd, add_zero]
  have h_vanishesBelow_mul : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreVanishesBelow N₁ A → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₂ B →
      pointCoreVanishesBelow (N₁ + N₂) (A * B) := by
    intro N₁ N₂ A B hA hB d hd
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    have hdeg := hantidiag_deg hp
    by_cases h1 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < N₁
    · rw [hA p.1 h1, zero_mul]
    · have h2 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 < N₂ := by omega
      rw [hB p.2 h2, mul_zero]
  have h_vanishesBelow_one : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → pointCoreVanishesBelow 1 U := by
    intro U hU0 d hd
    have hd0 : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
    rw [hd0, hU0]
  have h_vanishesBelow_pow : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 → ∀ m : ℕ, pointCoreVanishesBelow m (U ^ m) := by
    intro U hU0 m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact h_vanishesBelow_zero _
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact h_vanishesBelow_mul ih (h_vanishesBelow_one hU0)
  have h_coeff_mul_of_vanishesBelow :
      ∀ {n : ℕ} (A : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) {Δ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = n → pointCoreVanishesBelow n Δ →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (A * Δ) = MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 A * MvPowerSeries.coeff d Δ := by
    intro n A Δ d hd hΔ
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_single (0, d) ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp hp_ne
      have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      have hp1_ne : p.1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hp1
        apply hp_ne
        ext : 1
        · exact hp1
        · simpa [hp1] using hp_eq
      have hp1_pos : 1 ≤ p.1 0 + p.1 1 := by
        have hne0 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 ≠ 0 := mt (hd_eq_zero_iff p.1).mpr hp1_ne
        omega
      have hdeg := hantidiag_deg hp
      have hp2_lt : p.2 0 + p.2 1 < n := by omega
      rw [hΔ p.2 hp2_lt, mul_zero]
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (zero_add d)))
  have h_coeff_mul_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ {P P₀ Q Q₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}
      {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
      d 0 + d 1 = n → pointCoreVanishesBelow n (P - P₀) → pointCoreVanishesBelow n (Q - Q₀) →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P * Q) - MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P₀ * Q₀) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Q₀ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P - P₀) +
          MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 P₀ * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (Q - Q₀) := by
    intro n hn P P₀ Q Q₀ d hd hP hQ
    have hring : P * Q - P₀ * Q₀ =
        Q₀ * (P - P₀) + P₀ * (Q - Q₀) + (P - P₀) * (Q - Q₀) := by ring
    have hrem0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((P - P₀) * (Q - Q₀)) = 0 :=
      h_vanishesBelow_mul hP hQ d (by omega)
    rw [← map_sub, hring, map_add, map_add, hrem0, add_zero,
      h_coeff_mul_of_vanishesBelow Q₀ hd hP, h_coeff_mul_of_vanishesBelow P₀ hd hQ]
  have h_vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor : ∀ {N₀ : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N₀ → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
      {U₀ η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → pointCoreVanishesBelow N₀ η →
      pointCoreVanishesBelow (2 * N₀)
        (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η) - compPowerSeries2D f U₀ -
          compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀ * η) := by
    intro N₀ hN₀ f U₀ η hU₀ hη
    have hpow_diff : ∀ k : ℕ, pointCoreVanishesBelow N₀ ((U₀ + η) ^ (k + 1) - U₀ ^ (k + 1)) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have h0 : (U₀ + η) ^ 1 - U₀ ^ 1 = η := by ring
        rw [h0]; exact hη
      | succ k ih =>
        have hstep : (U₀ + η) ^ (k + 2) - U₀ ^ (k + 2) =
            ((U₀ + η) ^ (k + 1) - U₀ ^ (k + 1)) * (U₀ + η) + U₀ ^ (k + 1) * η := by ring
        rw [hstep]
        refine h_vanishesBelow_add ?_ ?_
        · simpa using h_vanishesBelow_mul ih (h_vanishesBelow_zero (U₀ + η))
        · simpa using h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_zero (U₀ ^ (k + 1))) hη
    let R : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun k => (U₀ + η) ^ (k + 1) - U₀ ^ (k + 1) -
        MvPowerSeries.C ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (U₀ ^ k * η)
    have hR_van : ∀ k : ℕ, pointCoreVanishesBelow (2 * N₀) (R k) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        have hR0 : R 0 = 0 := by
          dsimp only [R]
          norm_num
        rw [hR0]
        intro d _; exact MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero d
      | succ k ih =>
        have hR_step : R (k + 1) =
            U₀ * R k + η * ((U₀ + η) ^ (k + 1) - U₀ ^ (k + 1)) := by
          dsimp only [R]
          have hcast : (((k + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
          rw [hcast, map_add, map_one]
          ring
        rw [hR_step]
        refine h_vanishesBelow_add ?_ ?_
        · simpa using h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_zero U₀) ih
        · rw [two_mul]
          exact h_vanishesBelow_mul hη (hpow_diff k)
    intro d hd
    set M := d 0 + d 1 with hM_def
    have hderiv_mul :
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀ * η) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M,
            PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) f *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.C ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (U₀ ^ k * η)) := by
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      have h_ext :
          (∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 η) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
              PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative f) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (U₀ ^ k)) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 η := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        rw [hcoeff_comp1D]
        congr 1
        have hp_le : p.1 0 + p.1 1 ≤ M := by
          have := hantidiag_deg hp; omega
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_
        intro k hk_hi hk_lo
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk_lo
        have hk_gt : p.1 0 + p.1 1 < k := by omega
        rw [h_vanishesBelow_pow hU₀ k p.1 hk_gt, mul_zero]
      rw [h_ext]
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h_reasm :
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
            ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d,
              PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative f) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 (U₀ ^ k) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 η) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff k (PowerSeries.derivative f) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₀ ^ k * η) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
        ring
      rw [h_reasm, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have htop : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₀ ^ M * η) = 0 :=
        h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_pow hU₀ M) hη d (by omega)
      rw [htop, mul_zero, add_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hcomp_diff :
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η)) -
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f U₀) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M,
          PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) f *
            (MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((U₀ + η) ^ (k + 1)) - MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₀ ^ (k + 1))) := by
      rw [hcoeff_comp1D, hcoeff_comp1D, ← hM_def, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_range_succ']
      simp only [pow_zero, sub_self, add_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hcomp_diff, hderiv_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    have hRk_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (R k) = 0 := hR_van k d hd
    dsimp only [R] at hRk_zero
    rw [map_sub, map_sub] at hRk_zero
    linear_combination PowerSeries.coeff (k + 1) f * hRk_zero
  have h_coeff_comp1D_pert : ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ)
      {U₀ η : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
      d 0 + d 1 = n → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 → pointCoreVanishesBelow n η →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f (U₀ + η)) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D f U₀) +
          PowerSeries.coeff 1 f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d η := by
    intro n hn f U₀ η d hd hU₀ hη
    have htay := h_vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor hn f hU₀ hη d (by omega)
    rw [map_sub, map_sub] at htay
    have hlead :
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative f) U₀ * η) =
          PowerSeries.coeff 1 f * MvPowerSeries.coeff d η := by
      rw [h_coeff_mul_of_vanishesBelow _ hd hη, hcoeff_comp1D]
      simp [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
    rw [hlead] at htay
    linear_combination htay
  have h_vanishesBelow_pow_sub :
      ∀ {n m : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → 1 ≤ m → ∀ {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 A = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 B = 0 →
        pointCoreVanishesBelow n (A - B) →
        pointCoreVanishesBelow (n + m - 1) (A ^ m - B ^ m) := by
    intro n m hn hm A B hA0 hB0 hAB
    have haux : ∀ k : ℕ, pointCoreVanishesBelow (n + k) (A ^ (k + 1) - B ^ (k + 1)) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simpa using hAB
      | succ k ih =>
        have hstep : A ^ (k + 2) - B ^ (k + 2) =
            (A ^ (k + 1) - B ^ (k + 1)) * A + B ^ (k + 1) * (A - B) := by ring
        rw [hstep]
        refine h_vanishesBelow_add ?_ ?_
        · simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h_vanishesBelow_mul ih (h_vanishesBelow_one hA0)
        · exact h_vanishesBelow_mono (by omega)
            (h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_pow hB0 (k + 1)) hAB)
    have h1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    have h2 : n + (m - 1) = n + m - 1 := by omega
    simpa [h1, h2] using haux (m - 1)
  have h_coeff_pow_linear : ∀ {M ν : ℕ}, 1 ≤ M → ν ≤ M → ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D (M - ν) ν) (U ^ M) =
        (M.choose ν : ℂ) * (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0) U) ^ (M - ν) *
          (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1) U) ^ ν := by
    intro M ν hM hν U hU0
    let c10 : ℂ := MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0) U
    let c01 : ℂ := MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1) U
    let A : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := MvPowerSeries.C c10 * MvPowerSeries.X 0
    let B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := MvPowerSeries.C c01 * MvPowerSeries.X 1
    let L₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := B + A
    have hL₁_0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 L₁ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [L₁, A, B]
      rw [map_add, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
      simp [Finsupp.ext_iff]
    have hUL₁ : pointCoreVanishesBelow 2 (U - L₁) := by
      intro u hu
      rw [map_sub]
      dsimp only [L₁, A, B]
      rw [map_add, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, ← hidx_10, ← hidx_01]
      have hcases : (u 0 = 0 ∧ u 1 = 0) ∨ (u 0 = 1 ∧ u 1 = 0) ∨ (u 0 = 0 ∧ u 1 = 1) := by omega
      rcases hcases with ⟨hu0, hu1⟩ | ⟨hu0, hu1⟩ | ⟨hu0, hu1⟩
      · have hu_eq : u = 0 := by rw [← hidx_eta u, hu0, hu1, hidx_00]
        subst hu_eq
        have hne01 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ pointCoreIdx2D 0 1 := by
          intro h; have := congr_arg (fun d => d 1) h; simp [hidx_one] at this
        have hne10 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ pointCoreIdx2D 1 0 := by
          intro h; have := congr_arg (fun d => d 0) h; simp [hidx_zero] at this
        simp [hU0, hne01, hne10]
      · have hu_eq : u = pointCoreIdx2D 1 0 := by rw [← hidx_eta u, hu0, hu1]
        subst hu_eq
        have hne : pointCoreIdx2D 1 0 ≠ pointCoreIdx2D 0 1 := by
          intro h; have := congr_arg (fun d => d 0) h; simp [hidx_zero] at this
        simp [hne, c10]
      · have hu_eq : u = pointCoreIdx2D 0 1 := by rw [← hidx_eta u, hu0, hu1]
        subst hu_eq
        have hne : pointCoreIdx2D 0 1 ≠ pointCoreIdx2D 1 0 := by
          intro h; have := congr_arg (fun d => d 0) h; simp [hidx_zero] at this
        simp [hne, c01]
    let dν : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := pointCoreIdx2D (M - ν) ν
    have hdν_deg : dν 0 + dν 1 < 2 + M - 1 := by
      dsimp only [dν]; rw [hidx_zero, hidx_one]; omega
    have hdiff0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff dν (U ^ M - L₁ ^ M) = 0 :=
      h_vanishesBelow_pow_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ 2) hM hU0 hL₁_0 hUL₁ dν hdν_deg
    have hUM_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff dν (U ^ M) = MvPowerSeries.coeff dν ((B + A) ^ M) :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp (by rwa [map_sub] at hdiff0)
    change MvPowerSeries.coeff dν (U ^ M) = (M.choose ν : ℂ) * c10 ^ (M - ν) * c01 ^ ν
    rw [hUM_eq, add_pow, map_sum]
    refine (Finset.sum_eq_single ν ?_ ?_).trans ?_
    · intro j hj hj_ne
      have hterm :
          B ^ j * A ^ (M - j) * (M.choose j : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) =
            MvPowerSeries.C ((M.choose j : ℂ) * c10 ^ (M - j) * c01 ^ j) *
              ((MvPowerSeries.X 0) ^ (M - j) * (MvPowerSeries.X 1) ^ j) := by
        dsimp only [A, B]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← map_pow MvPowerSeries.C c01 j,
          ← map_pow MvPowerSeries.C c10 (M - j), ← map_natCast MvPowerSeries.C (M.choose j)]
        have hC :
            (MvPowerSeries.C ((M.choose j : ℂ) * c10 ^ (M - j) * c01 ^ j) :
              MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) =
            MvPowerSeries.C (M.choose j : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.C (c10 ^ (M - j)) *
              MvPowerSeries.C (c01 ^ j) := by
          rw [map_mul, map_mul]
        rw [hC]
        ring
      rw [hterm, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq, MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq,
        MvPowerSeries.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial]
      have hne_idx : dν ≠ Finsupp.single 0 (M - j) + Finsupp.single 1 j := by
        intro heq
        have h1 := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 1) heq
        simp [dν, hidx_one] at h1
        exact hj_ne h1.symm
      simp only [hne_idx, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
    · intro hnot
      exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
    · have hterm :
          B ^ ν * A ^ (M - ν) * (M.choose ν : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) =
            MvPowerSeries.C ((M.choose ν : ℂ) * c10 ^ (M - ν) * c01 ^ ν) *
              ((MvPowerSeries.X 0) ^ (M - ν) * (MvPowerSeries.X 1) ^ ν) := by
        dsimp only [A, B]
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← map_pow MvPowerSeries.C c01 ν,
          ← map_pow MvPowerSeries.C c10 (M - ν), ← map_natCast MvPowerSeries.C (M.choose ν)]
        have hC :
            (MvPowerSeries.C ((M.choose ν : ℂ) * c10 ^ (M - ν) * c01 ^ ν) :
              MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) =
            MvPowerSeries.C (M.choose ν : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.C (c10 ^ (M - ν)) *
              MvPowerSeries.C (c01 ^ ν) := by
          rw [map_mul, map_mul]
        rw [hC]
        ring
      rw [hterm, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq, MvPowerSeries.X_pow_eq,
        MvPowerSeries.monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial]
      have heq_idx : dν = Finsupp.single 0 (M - ν) + Finsupp.single 1 ν := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [dν, hidx_zero, hidx_one]
      simp only [heq_idx, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]

  
  
  
  have h_C_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {c : ℂ}, c ∈ L → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (MvPowerSeries.C c) := by

      pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S * T) := by
    intro L S T hS hT d

  have h_pow_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L U → ∀ n : ℕ, pointCoreCoeffsIn L (U ^ n) := by
    intro L U hU n

    | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, ← map_one MvPowerSeries.C]
      exact h_C_mem L L.one_mem
    | succ n ih =>

  have h_mvDerivA_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

    intro L S hS d
    rw [hcoeff_mvA]

  have h_mvDerivD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},

    intro L S hS d
    rw [hcoeff_mvD]

  have h_comp1D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {f : PowerSeries ℂ} {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      (∀ n : ℕ, PowerSeries.coeff n f ∈ L) → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L U → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (compPowerSeries2D f U) := by
    intro L f U hf _ hU d

  have h_comp2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L F → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₁ → pointCoreCoeffsIn L U₂ →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L (pointCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂) := by
    intro L F U₁ U₂ hF _ _ hU₁ hU₂ d
    rw [hcoeff_comp2D]
    exact L.sum_mem fun a _ => L.sum_mem fun b _ =>
      L.mul_mem (hF _) (h_mul_mem L (h_pow_mem L hU₁ a) (h_pow_mem L hU₂ b) d)
  have h_mixed_of_derivAD_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L (mvDerivD (mvDerivA S)) →
      ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L := by
    intro L S hAD d hd0 hd1
    let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := pointCoreIdx2D (d 0 - 1) (d 1 - 1)
    have hmem : MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (mvDerivD (mvDerivA S)) ∈ L := hAD d'
    rw [hcoeff_mvD, hcoeff_mvA] at hmem
    have hd'_1 : d' 1 + 1 = d 1 := by dsimp [d']; rw [hidx_one]; omega
    have hd'_0 : ((d' + Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0) + 1 = d 0 := by
      rw [Finsupp.add_apply]; dsimp [d']; rw [hidx_zero]; simp; omega
    have hd'_eq : d' + Finsupp.single 1 1 + Finsupp.single 0 1 = d := by
      rw [← hidx_eta d]
      dsimp [d']
      rw [hidx_add_e1, hidx_add_e0, show d 0 - 1 + 1 = d 0 by omega,
        show d 1 - 1 + 1 = d 1 by omega]
    rw [hd'_1, hd'_0, hd'_eq, ← mul_assoc] at hmem
    let c : ℂ := ((d 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d 0 : ℕ) : ℂ)
    have hc_mem : c ∈ L := L.mul_mem (natCast_mem L (d 1)) (natCast_mem L (d 0))
    have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
    have hdiv : MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = (c * MvPowerSeries.coeff d S) / c :=
      (mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc_ne).symm
    rw [hdiv]
    exact L.div_mem hmem hc_mem
  have h_inv_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      S * T = 1 → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L S := by
    intro L S T hST hT
    have h0_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S * MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 T = 1 := by
      have hc := congr_arg MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff hST
      rw [map_mul, map_one, ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply,
        ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at hc
      exact hc
    let t₀ : ℂ := MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 T
    have ht₀_ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h0_eq
    have hs₀_mem : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ∈ L := by
      have hs₀_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S = t₀⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h0_eq
      rw [hs₀_eq]
      exact L.inv_mem (hT 0)
    have hcum : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
        intro d hd
        have hd0 : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
        rw [hd0]; exact hs₀_mem
      | succ N ih =>
        intro d hd
        by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
        · exact ih d hle
        · have hd_deg : d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 := by omega
          have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0; rw [h0] at hd_deg; simp at hd_deg
          have hd_prod : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (S * T) = 0 := by
            rw [hST, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one]
            simp only [hd_ne, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul] at hd_prod
          let A_d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d
          have hmem_d0 : (d, (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)) ∈ A_d :=
            Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (add_zero d)
          rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase A_d _ hmem_d0] at hd_prod
          let rem : ℂ :=
            ∑ p ∈ A_d.erase (d, 0), MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 S * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 T
          have hrem_mem : rem ∈ L := by
            refine L.sum_mem fun p hp => ?_
            rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hp with ⟨hp_ne, hp_in⟩
            have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp_in
            have hp2_ne : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
              intro hp2
              apply hp_ne
              ext : 1
              · simpa [hp2] using hp_eq
              · exact hp2
            have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
              have := mt (hd_eq_zero_iff p.2).mpr hp2_ne
              omega
            have hdeg := hantidiag_deg hp_in
            exact L.mul_mem (ih p.1 (by omega)) (hT p.2)
          have hS_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = (-rem) / t₀ := by
            apply eq_div_of_mul_eq ht₀_ne
            linear_combination hd_prod
          rw [hS_eq]
          exact L.div_mem (L.neg_mem hrem_mem) (hT 0)
    intro d
    exact hcum (d 0 + d 1) d le_rfl
  have h_sqrt_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      S ^ 2 = T → pointCoreCoeffsIn L T → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ∈ L →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S ≠ 0 → pointCoreCoeffsIn L S := by
    intro L S T hS2 hT hs₀_mem hs₀_ne
    have hSS : S * S = T := by simpa [sq] using hS2
    let s₀ : ℂ := MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S
    have h2s₀_mem : s₀ + s₀ ∈ L := L.add_mem hs₀_mem hs₀_mem
    have h2s₀_ne : s₀ + s₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← two_mul]
      exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hs₀_ne
    have hcum : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N → MvPowerSeries.coeff d S ∈ L := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
        intro d hd
        have hd0 : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
        rw [hd0]; exact hs₀_mem
      | succ N ih =>
        intro d hd
        by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
        · exact ih d hle
        · have hd_deg : d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 := by omega
          have hd_ne : d ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0; rw [h0] at hd_deg; simp at hd_deg
          let A_d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d
          have hmem_d0 : (d, (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)) ∈ A_d :=
            Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (add_zero d)
          have h0d_ne_d0 : ((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d) ≠ (d, 0) := by
            intro heq
            exact hd_ne (congr_arg Prod.fst heq).symm
          have hmem_0d : ((0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d) ∈ A_d.erase (d, 0) :=
            Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h0d_ne_d0,
              Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (zero_add d)⟩
          have hd_T : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (S * S) = MvPowerSeries.coeff d T :=
            congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) hSS
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, ← Finset.add_sum_erase A_d _ hmem_d0,
            ← Finset.add_sum_erase (A_d.erase (d, 0)) _ hmem_0d] at hd_T
          let rem : ℂ :=
            ∑ p ∈ (A_d.erase (d, 0)).erase (0, d),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 S * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 S
          have hrem_mem : rem ∈ L := by
            refine L.sum_mem fun p hp => ?_
            rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hp with ⟨hp_ne0d, hp1⟩
            rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hp1 with ⟨hp_ned0, hp_in⟩
            have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp_in
            have hp1_ne : p.1 ≠ 0 := by
              intro h0; apply hp_ne0d; ext : 1; exact h0; simpa [h0] using hp_eq
            have hp2_ne : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
              intro h0; apply hp_ned0; ext : 1; simpa [h0] using hp_eq; exact h0
            have hp1_pos : 1 ≤ p.1 0 + p.1 1 := by
              have := mt (hd_eq_zero_iff p.1).mpr hp1_ne; omega
            have hp2_pos : 1 ≤ p.2 0 + p.2 1 := by
              have := mt (hd_eq_zero_iff p.2).mpr hp2_ne; omega
            have hdeg := hantidiag_deg hp_in
            exact L.mul_mem (ih p.1 (by omega)) (ih p.2 (by omega))
          have hS_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff d S = (MvPowerSeries.coeff d T - rem) / (s₀ + s₀) := by
            apply eq_div_of_mul_eq h2s₀_ne
            linear_combination hd_T
          rw [hS_eq]
          exact L.div_mem (L.sub_mem (hT d) hrem_mem) h2s₀_mem
    intro d
    exact hcum (d 0 + d 1) d le_rfl

  
  
  
  have h_mulVec_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
      {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} {x b : ι → ℂ},
      (∀ r s : ι, A r s ∈ L) → A.det ≠ 0 → (∀ r : ι, b r ∈ L) → A.mulVec x = b →
      ∀ r : ι, x r ∈ L := by
    intro L ι _ _ A x b hA hdet hb hAx r
    let A_L : Matrix ι ι ↥L := fun i j => ⟨A i j, hA i j⟩
    have hmapA : L.subtype.mapMatrix A_L = A := by ext i j; rfl
    have hadj_eq : L.subtype.mapMatrix A_L.adjugate = A.adjugate := by
      rw [RingHom.map_adjugate, hmapA]
    have hdet_eq : (L.subtype A_L.det : ℂ) = A.det := by
      rw [RingHom.map_det, hmapA]
    have hadj_mem : ∀ i j : ι, A.adjugate i j ∈ L := by
      intro i j
      rw [← hadj_eq]
      exact (A_L.adjugate i j).2
    have hdet_mem : A.det ∈ L := by
      rw [← hdet_eq]
      exact A_L.det.2
    have hvec : A.adjugate.mulVec b = A.det • x := by
      rw [← hAx, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.adjugate_mul, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hr_eq : ∑ s : ι, A.adjugate r s * b s = A.det * x r :=
      congr_fun hvec r
    have hnum_mem : ∑ s : ι, A.adjugate r s * b s ∈ L :=
      L.sum_mem fun s _ => L.mul_mem (hadj_mem r s) (hb s)
    have hxr : x r = (∑ s : ι, A.adjugate r s * b s) / A.det := by
      apply eq_div_of_mul_eq hdet
      linear_combination -hr_eq
    rw [hxr]
    exact L.div_mem hnum_mem hdet_mem
  have h_coeff_comp2D_pert :
      ∀ {n : ℕ}, 1 ≤ n → ∀ {G U₁ U₂ V₁ V₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = n →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₂ = 0 →
        pointCoreVanishesBelow n (U₁ - V₁) → pointCoreVanishesBelow n (U₂ - V₂) →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointCoreComp2D G U₁ U₂) -
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointCoreComp2D G V₁ V₂) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ - V₁) +
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₂ - V₂) := by
    intro n hn G U₁ U₂ V₁ V₂ d hd hU₁0 hU₂0 hV₁0 hV₂0 hΔ₁ hΔ₂
    have hmonom_zero : ∀ a b : ℕ, 2 ≤ a + b →
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b - V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b) = 0 := by
      intro a b hab
      have hsplit : U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b - V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b =
          (U₁ ^ a - V₁ ^ a) * U₂ ^ b + V₁ ^ a * (U₂ ^ b - V₂ ^ b) := by ring
      rw [hsplit, map_add]
      have ht1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((U₁ ^ a - V₁ ^ a) * U₂ ^ b) = 0 := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha_pos
        · simp
        · exact h_vanishesBelow_mul
            (h_vanishesBelow_pow_sub hn ha_pos hU₁0 hV₁0 hΔ₁)
            (h_vanishesBelow_pow hU₂0 b) d (by omega)
      have ht2 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V₁ ^ a * (U₂ ^ b - V₂ ^ b)) = 0 := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb_pos
        · simp
        · exact h_vanishesBelow_mul
            (h_vanishesBelow_pow hV₁0 a)
            (h_vanishesBelow_pow_sub hn hb_pos hU₂0 hV₂0 hΔ₂) d (by omega)
      rw [ht1, ht2, add_zero]
    rw [hcoeff_comp2D, hcoeff_comp2D, hd, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    have hsub_inner :
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) -
           ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b))) =
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range 2,
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range 2,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b - V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b) := by
      have hstep1 :
          (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) -
             ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b))) =
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.range 2,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b - V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        have hcongr :
            (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) -
               MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G * MvPowerSeries.coeff d (V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b))) =
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) G *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b - V₁ ^ a * V₂ ^ b) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [map_sub, mul_sub]
        rw [hcongr]
        refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_).symm
        intro b _ hb_not
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hb_not
        rw [hmonom_zero a b (by omega), mul_zero]
      rw [hstep1]
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_).symm
      intro a _ ha_not
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha_not
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro b _
      rw [hmonom_zero a b (by omega), mul_zero]
    rw [hsub_inner]
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add]
    have h11 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ 1 * U₂ ^ 1 - V₁ ^ 1 * V₂ ^ 1) = 0 :=

  have h_inv2D_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {Φ₁ Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Φ₂ = 0 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Ψ₂ = 0 →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₁ → pointCoreCoeffsIn L Φ₂ →
      pointCoreComp2D Φ₁ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 →
      pointCoreComp2D Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L Ψ₁ ∧ pointCoreCoeffsIn L Ψ₂ := by
    intro L Φ₁ Φ₂ Ψ₁ Ψ₂ hΦ₁0 hΦ₂0 hΨ₁0 hΨ₂0 hΦ₁L hΦ₂L hComp₀ hComp₁
    let idxU : Fin 2 → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := ![pointCoreIdx2D 1 0, pointCoreIdx2D 0 1]

    let Ψv : Fin 2 → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := ![Ψ₁, Ψ₂]

      intro r; fin_cases r <;> assumption

      intro r; fin_cases r <;> assumption
    have hComp_r : ∀ r : Fin 2, pointCoreComp2D (Φv r) Ψ₁ Ψ₂ = MvPowerSeries.X r := by
      intro r; fin_cases r <;> assumption

        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 G = 0 → pointCoreComp2D G 0 0 = 0 := by
      intro G hG0
      ext d
      rw [hcoeff_comp2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro a _
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro b _
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha_pos
      · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb_pos
        · rw [hidx_00, hG0, zero_mul]
        · rw [zero_pow (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hb_pos), mul_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero, mul_zero]
      · rw [zero_pow (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp ha_pos), zero_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero, mul_zero]
    have hJΦ_mem : ∀ r c : Fin 2, JΦ r c ∈ L := fun r c => hΦvL r (idxU c)
    have hJ_mul : JΦ * JΨ = 1 := by
      ext r s
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hd_deg : (idxU s) 0 + (idxU s) 1 = 1 := by
        fin_cases s <;> simp [idxU, hidx_zero, hidx_one]
      have hpert := h_coeff_comp2D_pert (le_rfl : 1 ≤ 1) (G := Φv r)
        (U₁ := Ψ₁) (U₂ := Ψ₂) (V₁ := 0) (V₂ := 0) hd_deg
        hΨ₁0 hΨ₂0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero 0) (MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero 0)
        (by simpa using h_vanishesBelow_one hΨ₁0)
        (by simpa using h_vanishesBelow_one hΨ₂0)
      rw [hComp_r r, hcomp_zero_zero (Φv r) (hΦv0 r), MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero,
        sub_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero] at hpert
      change JΦ r 0 * JΨ 0 s + JΦ r 1 * JΨ 1 s = (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) r s
      dsimp only [JΦ, JΨ, idxU, Ψv]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      rw [← hpert]
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>

      | succ N ih =>
        intro d hd
        by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
        · exact ih d hle
        · have hd_deg : d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 := by omega
          let V₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
            fun u => if u 0 + u 1 < N + 1 then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₁ else 0
          let V₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
            fun u => if u 0 + u 1 < N + 1 then MvPowerSeries.coeff u Ψ₂ else 0
          have hV₁0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₁ = 0 := by
            rw [hcoeff_raw]; simp [hΨ₁0]
          have hV₂0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 V₂ = 0 := by
            rw [hcoeff_raw]; simp [hΨ₂0]
          have hV₁L : pointCoreCoeffsIn L V₁ := by
            intro u; rw [hcoeff_raw]
            split_ifs with hu
            · exact (ih u (by omega)).1
            · exact L.zero_mem
          have hV₂L : pointCoreCoeffsIn L V₂ := by
            intro u; rw [hcoeff_raw]
            split_ifs with hu
            · exact (ih u (by omega)).2
            · exact L.zero_mem
          have hΔ₁ : pointCoreVanishesBelow (N + 1) (Ψ₁ - V₁) := by
            intro u hu
            rw [map_sub, hcoeff_raw]
            simp only [hu, ↓reduceIte, sub_self]
          have hΔ₂ : pointCoreVanishesBelow (N + 1) (Ψ₂ - V₂) := by
            intro u hu
            rw [map_sub, hcoeff_raw]
            simp only [hu, ↓reduceIte, sub_self]
          have hnot_lt : ¬ (d 0 + d 1 < N + 1) := by omega
          have hV₁_d : MvPowerSeries.coeff d V₁ = 0 := by
            rw [hcoeff_raw]; simp only [hnot_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          have hV₂_d : MvPowerSeries.coeff d V₂ = 0 := by
            rw [hcoeff_raw]; simp only [hnot_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          let x_d : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₁, MvPowerSeries.coeff d Ψ₂]
          let b_d : Fin 2 → ℂ := fun r =>
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X r) -
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointCoreComp2D (Φv r) V₁ V₂)
          have hb_mem : ∀ r : Fin 2, b_d r ∈ L := fun r =>
            L.sub_mem (h_X_mem L r d) (h_comp2D_mem L (hΦvL r) hV₁0 hV₂0 hV₁L hV₂L d)
          have hJ_sys : JΦ.mulVec x_d = b_d := by
            ext r
            rw [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
            have hpert := h_coeff_comp2D_pert (by omega : 1 ≤ N + 1) (G := Φv r)
              hd_deg hΨ₁0 hΨ₂0 hV₁0 hV₂0 hΔ₁ hΔ₂
            rw [hComp_r r, map_sub, map_sub, hV₁_d, hV₂_d, sub_zero, sub_zero] at hpert
            dsimp only [JΦ, idxU, x_d, b_d]
            simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
            exact hpert.symm
          have hx_mem := h_mulVec_mem L hJΦ_mem hJΦ_det hb_mem hJ_sys
          exact ⟨hx_mem 0, hx_mem 1⟩
    exact ⟨fun d => (hcum (d 0 + d 1) d le_rfl).1, fun d => (hcum (d 0 + d 1) d le_rfl).2⟩

        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (p.2 0 + p.2 1 + 1),
            ((a + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * C (a + 1) b * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (A ^ a * B ^ b) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_).symm
      intro b _ hb_not
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hb_not
      have hv : MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (A ^ a * B ^ b) = 0 :=
        h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_pow hA0 a) (h_vanishesBelow_pow hB0 b) p.2 (by omega)
      rw [hv, mul_zero]
    rw [hshrink_b]
    refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_).symm
    intro a _ ha_not
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha_not
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b _
    have hv : MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 (A ^ a * B ^ b) = 0 :=
      h_vanishesBelow_mul (h_vanishesBelow_pow hA0 a) (h_vanishesBelow_pow hB0 b) p.2 (by omega)
    rw [hv, mul_zero]

  have hmvDeriv_comp2D :
      ∀ (𝒟 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (ι : Fin 2),
        (∀ S d, MvPowerSeries.coeff d (𝒟 S) =
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) S) →
        (∀ Φ Ψ, 𝒟 (Φ + Ψ) = 𝒟 Φ + 𝒟 Ψ) →
        (∀ Φ Ψ, 𝒟 (Φ * Ψ) = 𝒟 Φ * Ψ + Φ * 𝒟 Ψ) →
        ∀ (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
          MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 → MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 →
          𝒟 (pointCoreComp2D F U₁ U₂) =
            𝒟 U₁ * pointCoreComp2D (mvDerivA F) U₁ U₂ +
              𝒟 U₂ * pointCoreComp2D (mvDerivD F) U₁ U₂ := by
    intro 𝒟 ι h𝒟_coeff h𝒟_add h𝒟_mul F U₁ U₂ hU₁0 hU₂0
    ext d
    have hd_shift_deg :
        ((d + Finsupp.single ι 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0) +
          ((d + Finsupp.single ι 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1) = d 0 + d 1 + 1 := by
      rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
      fin_cases ι <;> simp <;> omega
    rw [h𝒟_coeff, hcoeff_comp2D, hd_shift_deg, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hsplit :
        (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1 + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D x b) F *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U₁ ^ x * U₂ ^ b)) =
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (𝒟 (U₁ ^ a) * U₂ ^ b)) +
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * 𝒟 (U₂ ^ b))) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      have hprod :
          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U₁ ^ a * U₂ ^ b) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (𝒟 (U₁ ^ a) * U₂ ^ b) +
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * 𝒟 (U₂ ^ b)) := by
        rw [← h𝒟_coeff, h𝒟_mul, map_add]
      linear_combination MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F * hprod
    rw [hsplit, map_add]
    congr 1
    · rw [hsum_double_deriv_left 𝒟 ι h𝒟_coeff h𝒟_add h𝒟_mul
        (fun a b => MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F) hU₁0 hU₂0 d]
      congr 2
      ext u
      rw [hcoeff_raw, hcoeff_comp2D]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      rw [hcoeff_mvA, hidx_zero, hidx_add_e0]
    · have hswap :
          (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
            ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₁ ^ a * 𝒟 (U₂ ^ b))) =
          ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 2),
              MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d (𝒟 (U₂ ^ b) * U₁ ^ a) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        rw [mul_comm (U₁ ^ a) (𝒟 (U₂ ^ b))]
      rw [hswap, hsum_double_deriv_left 𝒟 ι h𝒟_coeff h𝒟_add h𝒟_mul
        (fun b a => MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D a b) F) hU₂0 hU₁0 d]
      congr 2
      ext u
      rw [hcoeff_raw, hcoeff_comp2D, Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      rw [hcoeff_mvD, hidx_one, hidx_add_e1, mul_comm (U₂ ^ b) (U₁ ^ a)]

  have h_taylor2D_comp_2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
      ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
        taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
          pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
            (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
            (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀) := by
    intro U V hU hV p₀ hp₀ Ψ f hΨ hf hmaps
    let Ψ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).1
    let Ψ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).2
    let U₁ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₁ p₀
    let U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₂ p₀
    have hΨ₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₁ U := differentiable_fst.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
    have hΨ₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₂ U := differentiable_snd.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
    have hU₁0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [U₁, centeredTaylor2D]
      rw [hcoeff_taylor2D]
      simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    have hU₂0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [U₂, centeredTaylor2D]
      rw [hcoeff_taylor2D]
      simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    have hmvU₁ : mvDerivA U₁ = taylor2D (pderivA Ψ₁) p₀ ∧
        mvDerivD U₁ = taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₁) p₀ := by
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Ψ₁ p - Ψ₁ p₀) U :=
        hΨ₁.sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hr := hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU hp₀ hdiff
      have hpA : pderivA (fun p => Ψ₁ p - Ψ₁ p₀) = pderivA Ψ₁ := by
        funext p; exact deriv_sub_const (Ψ₁ p₀)
      have hpD : pderivD (fun p => Ψ₁ p - Ψ₁ p₀) = pderivD Ψ₁ := by
        funext p; exact deriv_sub_const (Ψ₁ p₀)
      simpa [U₁, centeredTaylor2D, hpA, hpD] using hr
    have hmvU₂ : mvDerivA U₂ = taylor2D (pderivA Ψ₂) p₀ ∧
        mvDerivD U₂ = taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₂) p₀ := by
      have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Ψ₂ p - Ψ₂ p₀) U :=
        hΨ₂.sub (differentiableOn_const _)
      have hr := hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU hp₀ hdiff
      have hpA : pderivA (fun p => Ψ₂ p - Ψ₂ p₀) = pderivA Ψ₂ := by
        funext p; exact deriv_sub_const (Ψ₂ p₀)
      have hpD : pderivD (fun p => Ψ₂ p - Ψ₂ p₀) = pderivD Ψ₂ := by
        funext p; exact deriv_sub_const (Ψ₂ p₀)
      simpa [U₂, centeredTaylor2D, hpA, hpD] using hr
    have hslice_chain : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V → ∀ q ∈ U,
        pderivA (fun p => g (Ψ p)) q =
          pderivA Ψ₁ q * pderivA g (Ψ q) + pderivA Ψ₂ q * pderivD g (Ψ q) ∧
        pderivD (fun p => g (Ψ p)) q =
          pderivD Ψ₁ q * pderivA g (Ψ q) + pderivD Ψ₂ q * pderivD g (Ψ q) := by
      intro g hg q hq
      have hq_nhds : U ∈ nhds q := hU.mem_nhds hq
      have hΨq_nhds : V ∈ nhds (Ψ q) := hV.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq)
      have hLg : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (Ψ q) :=
        (hg.differentiableAt hΨq_nhds).hasFDerivAt
      have hLg_10 : (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (1, 0) = pderivA g (Ψ q) := by
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, (Ψ q).2)) (1, 0) (Ψ q).1 :=
          (hasDerivAt_id (Ψ q).1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const (Ψ q).1 (Ψ q).2)
        have hLg' : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) ((fun z : ℂ => (z, (Ψ q).2)) (Ψ q).1) := by
          simpa using hLg
        exact (hLg'.comp_hasDerivAt (Ψ q).1 hγ).deriv.symm
      have hLg_01 : (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (0, 1) = pderivD g (Ψ q) := by
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ((Ψ q).1, w)) (0, 1) (Ψ q).2 :=
          (hasDerivAt_const (Ψ q).2 (Ψ q).1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id (Ψ q).2)
        have hLg' : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) ((fun w : ℂ => ((Ψ q).1, w)) (Ψ q).2) := by
          simpa using hLg
        exact (hLg'.comp_hasDerivAt (Ψ q).2 hγ).deriv.symm
      have hLg_eval : ∀ u v : ℂ,
          (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (u, v) = u * pderivA g (Ψ q) + v * pderivD g (Ψ q) := by
        intro u v
        have hdecomp : ((u, v) : ℂ × ℂ) = u • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
          ext <;> simp
        rw [hdecomp, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hLg_10, hLg_01, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      have hγA : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) (1, 0) q.1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
      have hγD : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) (0, 1) q.2 :=
        (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
      have hΨ₁A : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₁ (z, q.2)) (pderivA Ψ₁ q) q.1 := by
        have hF : HasFDerivAt Ψ₁ (fderiv ℂ Ψ₁ ((fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) q.1))
            ((fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) q.1) := by
          simpa using (hΨ₁.differentiableAt hq_nhds).hasFDerivAt
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hγA).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hΨ₂A : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₂ (z, q.2)) (pderivA Ψ₂ q) q.1 := by
        have hF : HasFDerivAt Ψ₂ (fderiv ℂ Ψ₂ ((fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) q.1))
            ((fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) q.1) := by
          simpa using (hΨ₂.differentiableAt hq_nhds).hasFDerivAt
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hγA).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hΨ₁D : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Ψ₁ (q.1, w)) (pderivD Ψ₁ q) q.2 := by
        have hF : HasFDerivAt Ψ₁ (fderiv ℂ Ψ₁ ((fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) q.2))
            ((fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) q.2) := by
          simpa using (hΨ₁.differentiableAt hq_nhds).hasFDerivAt
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hγD).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hΨ₂D : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Ψ₂ (q.1, w)) (pderivD Ψ₂ q) q.2 := by
        have hF : HasFDerivAt Ψ₂ (fderiv ℂ Ψ₂ ((fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) q.2))
            ((fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) q.2) := by
          simpa using (hΨ₂.differentiableAt hq_nhds).hasFDerivAt
        exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hγD).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      constructor
      · have hΨA : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ (z, q.2)) (pderivA Ψ₁ q, pderivA Ψ₂ q) q.1 :=
          hΨ₁A.prodMk hΨ₂A
        have hLg_A : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) ((fun z : ℂ => Ψ (z, q.2)) q.1) := by
          simpa using hLg
        have hcompA := (hLg_A.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hΨA).deriv
        rw [hLg_eval] at hcompA
        exact hcompA
      · have hΨD : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Ψ (q.1, w)) (pderivD Ψ₁ q, pderivD Ψ₂ q) q.2 :=
          hΨ₁D.prodMk hΨ₂D
        have hLg_D : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) ((fun w : ℂ => Ψ (q.1, w)) q.2) := by
          simpa using hLg
        have hcompD := (hLg_D.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hΨD).deriv
        rw [hLg_eval] at hcompD
        exact hcompD
    have hcum : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
        ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (Ψ p)) p₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
        intro g _ d hd
        have hd0 : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr (by omega)
        subst hd0
        rw [hcoeff_taylor2D, hcoeff_comp2D]
        simp [hidx_00, hcoeff_taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
      | succ N ih =>
        intro g hg d hd
        by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
        · exact ih hg d hle
        · have hd_deg : d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 := by omega
          rcases hKit.pderiv_holo hV hg with ⟨hgA, hgD⟩
          rcases hKit.pderiv_holo hU hΨ₁ with ⟨hΨ₁A, hΨ₁D⟩
          rcases hKit.pderiv_holo hU hΨ₂ with ⟨hΨ₂A, hΨ₂D⟩
          have hgΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (Ψ p)) U := hg.comp hΨ hmaps
          have hgAΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivA g (Ψ p)) U := hgA.comp hΨ hmaps
          have hgDΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => pderivD g (Ψ p)) U := hgD.comp hΨ hmaps
          have hΨp₀ : Ψ p₀ ∈ V := hmaps p₀ hp₀
          rcases hKit.mvDeriv_rules.1 with hmv_rules
          by_cases hd0_pos : 1 ≤ d 0
          · let d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := pointCoreIdx2D (d 0 - 1) (d 1)
            have hd'_deg : d' 0 + d' 1 ≤ N := by
              dsimp [d']; rw [hidx_zero, hidx_one]; omega
            have hd'_shift : d' + Finsupp.single 0 1 = d := by
              rw [← hidx_eta d]; dsimp [d']; rw [hidx_add_e0]; congr 1; omega
            have hmult_ne : (((d' 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
            apply mul_left_cancel₀ hmult_ne
            rw [← hd'_shift, ← hcoeff_mvA, ← hcoeff_mvA]
            have hLHS :
                mvDerivA (taylor2D (fun p => g (Ψ p)) p₀) =
                  taylor2D (pderivA Ψ₁) p₀ * taylor2D (fun p => pderivA g (Ψ p)) p₀ +
                    taylor2D (pderivA Ψ₂) p₀ * taylor2D (fun p => pderivD g (Ψ p)) p₀ := by
              rw [(hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU hp₀ hgΨ_holo).1,
                hKit.taylor2D_congr hU hp₀ (fun q hq => (hslice_chain hg q hq).1),
                ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₀).2
                  (f := fun q => pderivA Ψ₁ q * pderivA g (Ψ q))
                  (g := fun q => pderivA Ψ₂ q * pderivD g (Ψ q))
                  (hΨ₁A.mul hgAΨ_holo) (hΨ₂A.mul hgDΨ_holo)).1,

                ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₀).2 hΨ₂A hgDΨ_holo).2.2]
            have hRHS :
                mvDerivA (pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂) =

              rw [hmvDeriv_comp2D mvDerivA 0 hcoeff_mvA

                  (fun Φ Ψ => (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.1 Φ Ψ).2.2.1)
                  (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂ hU₁0 hU₂0,

            have hmult_ne : (((d' 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
            apply mul_left_cancel₀ hmult_ne
            rw [← hd'_shift, ← hcoeff_mvD, ← hcoeff_mvD]
            have hLHS :
                mvDerivD (taylor2D (fun p => g (Ψ p)) p₀) =
                  taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₁) p₀ * taylor2D (fun p => pderivA g (Ψ p)) p₀ +
                    taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₂) p₀ * taylor2D (fun p => pderivD g (Ψ p)) p₀ := by
              rw [(hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU hp₀ hgΨ_holo).2,
                hKit.taylor2D_congr hU hp₀ (fun q hq => (hslice_chain hg q hq).2),
                ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₀).2
                  (f := fun q => pderivD Ψ₁ q * pderivA g (Ψ q))
                  (g := fun q => pderivD Ψ₂ q * pderivD g (Ψ q))
                  (hΨ₁D.mul hgAΨ_holo) (hΨ₂D.mul hgDΨ_holo)).1,
                ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₀).2 hΨ₁D hgAΨ_holo).2.2,
                ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hU hp₀).2 hΨ₂D hgDΨ_holo).2.2]
            have hRHS :
                mvDerivD (pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂) =
                  taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₁) p₀ * pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D (pderivA g) (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂ +
                    taylor2D (pderivD Ψ₂) p₀ * pointCoreComp2D (taylor2D (pderivD g) (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂ := by
              rw [hmvDeriv_comp2D mvDerivD 1 hcoeff_mvD
                  (fun Φ Ψ => (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.1 Φ Ψ).2.1)
                  (fun Φ Ψ => (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.1 Φ Ψ).2.2.2)
                  (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂ hU₁0 hU₂0,
                hmvU₁.2, hmvU₂.2,
                (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hV hΨp₀ hg).1,
                (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hV hΨp₀ hg).2]
            rw [hLHS, hRHS, map_add, map_add, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
            congr 1
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
              have hr2 : r.2 0 + r.2 1 ≤ N := by
                have := hantidiag_deg hr; omega
              rw [ih hgA r.2 hr2]
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
              have hr2 : r.2 0 + r.2 1 ≤ N := by
                have := hantidiag_deg hr; omega
              rw [ih hgD r.2 hr2]
    ext d
    exact hcum (d 0 + d 1) hf d le_rfl

  
  
  
  exact {
    centeredTaylor2D_fst := h_centered_fst
    centeredTaylor2D_snd := h_centered_snd
    taylor2D_comp_2D := h_taylor2D_comp_2D
    C_mem := h_C_mem
    X_mem := h_X_mem
    add_mem := h_add_mem
    sub_mem := h_sub_mem
    mul_mem := h_mul_mem
    mvDerivA_mem := h_mvDerivA_mem
    mvDerivD_mem := h_mvDerivD_mem
    comp1D_mem := h_comp1D_mem
    comp2D_mem := h_comp2D_mem
    mixed_of_derivAD_mem := h_mixed_of_derivAD_mem
    inv_mem := h_inv_mem
    sqrt_mem := h_sqrt_mem
    mulVec_mem := h_mulVec_mem
    inv2D_mem := h_inv2D_mem
    coeff_comp1D_pert := h_coeff_comp1D_pert
    coeff_mul_pert := h_coeff_mul_pert
    vanishesBelow_mul := h_vanishesBelow_mul
    vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor := h_vanishesBelow_comp1D_taylor
    coeff_pow_linear := h_coeff_pow_linear
  }
