proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hk
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let p₁_ab : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let σ_ab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q_ab => (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)
  let U : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := G.U_a ×ˢ G.U_d
  let U_ab : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := σ_ab ⁻¹' U
  let Ψ_ab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q_ab => G.Ψ (σ_ab q_ab)
  let q₁ : ℂ × ℂ := G.Ψ p₁
  let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := pointChainBox C B k
  let K_pt : Subfield ℂ := pointBaseField C k G.Ψ a₁ δ₁
  have hσ_p₁ : σ_ab p₁_ab = p₁ := Prod.ext rfl (add_sub_cancel_left (a₁ : ℂ) (δ₁ : ℂ))
  have hΨ_p₁ : Ψ_ab p₁_ab = q₁ := congr_arg G.Ψ hσ_p₁
  have hU_open : IsOpen U := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hσ_diff : Differentiable ℂ σ_ab :=
    differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.sub differentiable_fst)
  have hU_ab_open : IsOpen U_ab := hU_open.preimage hσ_diff.continuous
  have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
  have ha₁_U : (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_a := by
    rw [PointGlancingChartData.U_a, Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [ha₁.1, ha₁.2, G.R_pos]
  have hδ₁_U : (δ₁ : ℂ) ∈ G.U_d := by
    rw [PointGlancingChartData.U_d, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ₁.1]
    linarith [hδ₁.2, G.δ_star_pos]
  have hp₁ : p₁ ∈ U := ⟨ha₁_U, hδ₁_U⟩
  have hp₁_ab : p₁_ab ∈ U_ab := by
    change σ_ab p₁_ab ∈ U
    rw [hσ_p₁]
    exact hp₁
  have hΨ_ab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ_ab U_ab :=
    G.Ψ_holo.comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)
  have hΨ_ab_maps_VW : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, Ψ_ab q_ab ∈ G.V_W :=
    fun _ h => G.Ψ_maps_V_W _ h
  have hΨ_ab_maps_W₀ : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, Ψ_ab q_ab ∈ W₀ :=
    fun q_ab h => G.V_W_sub (hΨ_ab_maps_VW q_ab h)
  have hq₁_VW : q₁ ∈ G.V_W := G.Ψ_maps_V_W p₁ hp₁
  have hq₁ : q₁ ∈ W₀ := G.V_W_sub hq₁_VW
  let P₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c
  let P_k : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c
  let A_2d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => C.A q.2
  have hk1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hk1_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    linarith
  have hShift_maps : ∀ (c_sh : ℝ), 0 ≤ c_sh → c_sh ≤ (k : ℝ) →
      Set.MapsTo (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (c_sh : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) W₀
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * B.r_det } := by
    intro c_sh hc0 hck q hq
    have hq2_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖q.2‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h_im_le : |((c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖q.2‖ := by
      calc |((c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im|
          ≤ ‖(c_sh : ℂ) * q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = |c_sh| * ‖q.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ = c_sh * ‖q.2‖ := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hc0]
        _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖q.2‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hq2_nonneg
    have h_mul_lt : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖q.2‖ < B.r_det := (lt_div_iff₀' hk1_pos).mp hq.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have him_eq : (q.1 + (c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im = q.1.im + ((c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im :=
        Complex.add_im _ _
      rw [him_eq]
      have htri : |q.1.im + ((c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ |q.1.im| + |((c_sh : ℂ) * q.2).im| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      linarith [hq.1, B.r_det_lt_s_det, B.s_det_pos]
    · have hdiv_le : B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ B.r_det :=
        div_le_self (le_of_lt B.r_det_pos) hk1_ge1
      linarith [hq.2, B.r_det_pos]
  have hW₀_sub : W₀ ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * B.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * B.r_det } := by
    intro q hq
    simpa using hShift_maps 0 le_rfl (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hq
  have hP₀_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (P₀ c) W₀ :=
    fun c => (B.impact_holo c).mono hW₀_sub
  have hPk_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (P_k c) W₀ := by
    intro c
    have haff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + ((k : ℝ) : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) :=
      (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const _ |>.mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
        differentiable_snd
    have hcast : P_k c =
        ((fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 c) ∘
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + ((k : ℝ) : ℂ) * q.2, q.2))) := by
      ext q
      simp [P_k]
    rw [hcast]
    exact (B.impact_holo c).comp haff.differentiableOn
      (hShift_maps (k : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg k) le_rfl)
  have hW₀_maps_A : Set.MapsTo Prod.snd W₀ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.r₁) := by
    intro q hq
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hdiv_le : B.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ B.r_det :=
      div_le_self (le_of_lt B.r_det_pos) hk1_ge1
    linarith [hq.2, B.r_det_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
  have hA_2d_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A_2d W₀ :=
    C.A_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn hW₀_maps_A
  have hP₀_mem : ∀ c : Fin 2, pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (P₀ c) q₁) := by
    intro c d
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
    dsimp only [taylor2D]
    have hnum : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (P₀ c) q₁ ∈ K_pt := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact Or.inr ⟨Sum.inl ((0 : Fin 2), c, d 0, d 1), rfl⟩
    have hden : (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) ∈ K_pt :=
      K_pt.mul_mem (natCast_mem K_pt _) (natCast_mem K_pt _)
    exact K_pt.div_mem hnum hden
  have hPk_mem : ∀ c : Fin 2, pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (P_k c) q₁) := by
    intro c d
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
    dsimp only [taylor2D]
    have hnum : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (P_k c) q₁ ∈ K_pt := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact Or.inr ⟨Sum.inl ((1 : Fin 2), c, d 0, d 1), rfl⟩
    have hden : (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) ∈ K_pt :=
      K_pt.mul_mem (natCast_mem K_pt _) (natCast_mem K_pt _)
    exact K_pt.div_mem hnum hden
  have h_neg : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g W₀ →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D g q₁) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => -g q) W₀ ∧
        pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q => -g q) q₁) := by
    intro g hg_holo hg_mem
    refine ⟨hg_holo.neg, ?_⟩
    have hcongr : taylor2D (fun q => -g q) q₁ = taylor2D (fun q => (0 : ℂ) - g q) q₁ :=
      hKit.taylor2D_congr hW₀_open hq₁ (fun q _ => (zero_sub (g q)).symm)
    have hsub :=
      ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).2 (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ)) hg_holo).2.1
    have hconst := (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).1 (0 : ℂ)
    rw [hcongr, hsub, hconst]
    exact hSer.sub_mem K_pt (hSer.C_mem K_pt K_pt.zero_mem) hg_mem
  have h_rot_pair : ∀ (rot : Fin 4) (P : ℂ × ℂ → Fin 2 → ℂ),
      (∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => P q c) W₀) →
      (∀ c : Fin 2, pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q => P q c) q₁)) →
      (DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => rotCoordX rot (P q)) W₀ ∧
        pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q => rotCoordX rot (P q)) q₁)) ∧
      (DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => rotCoordY rot (P q)) W₀ ∧
        pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q => rotCoordY rot (P q)) q₁)) := by
    intro rot P hP_holo hP_mem
    fin_cases rot
    · exact ⟨⟨hP_holo 0, hP_mem 0⟩, ⟨hP_holo 1, hP_mem 1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨h_neg (hP_holo 0) (hP_mem 0), h_neg (hP_holo 1) (hP_mem 1)⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨hP_holo 1, hP_mem 1⟩, h_neg (hP_holo 0) (hP_mem 0)⟩
    · exact ⟨h_neg (hP_holo 1) (hP_mem 1), ⟨hP_holo 0, hP_mem 0⟩⟩
  let Y₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => rotCoordY G.rotIdx (glancingImpact C q.1 q.2)
  let Y_k : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => rotCoordY G.rotIdx (glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2)
  have hrot₀ := h_rot_pair G.rotIdx (fun q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2) hP₀_holo hP₀_mem
  have ha_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.a_coord W₀ := hrot₀.1.1
  have ha_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D G.a_coord q₁) := hrot₀.1.2
  have hY₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀ W₀ := hrot₀.2.1
  have hY₀_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D Y₀ q₁) := hrot₀.2.2
  have hrotk :=
    h_rot_pair G.rotIdx (fun q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2) hPk_holo hPk_mem
  have hb_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.b_coord W₀ := hrotk.1.1
  have hb_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D G.b_coord q₁) := hrotk.1.2
  have hYk_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Y_k W₀ := hrotk.2.1
  have hYk_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D Y_k q₁) := hrotk.2.2
  let Φ₁_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D G.a_coord q₁
  let Φ₂_ser : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D G.b_coord q₁
  let Ψ_ab_1 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).1) p₁_ab
  let Ψ_ab_2 : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).2) p₁_ab
  have h_cent_zero : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (centeredTaylor2D g p₀) = 0 := by
    intro g p₀
    simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, centeredTaylor2D, taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  have h_cent_mem : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g W₀ →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D g q₁) →
      pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (centeredTaylor2D g q₁) := by
    intro g hg_holo hg_mem
    have hg0_eq : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D g q₁) = g q₁ := by
      simp [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    have hg_q₁_mem : g q₁ ∈ K_pt := hg0_eq ▸ hg_mem 0
    have hsub :=
      ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).2 hg_holo (differentiableOn_const (g q₁))).2.1
    have hconst := (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).1 (g q₁)
    dsimp only [centeredTaylor2D]
    rw [hsub, hconst]
    exact hSer.sub_mem K_pt hg_mem (hSer.C_mem K_pt hg_q₁_mem)
  have hΦ₁_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt Φ₁_ser := h_cent_mem ha_holo ha_mem
  have hΦ₂_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt Φ₂_ser := h_cent_mem hb_holo hb_mem
  have ha_left : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.1 :=
    fun q_ab hq_ab => (G.Φ_left_inv (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab).1
  have hb_left : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.2 := by
    intro q_ab hq_ab
    have h1 : G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.1 := ha_left q_ab hq_ab
    have h2 : G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.2 - q_ab.1 :=
      (G.Φ_left_inv (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab).2
    calc G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab)
        = (G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab)) + G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) :=
          (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
      _ = (q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) + q_ab.1 := by rw [h2, h1]
      _ = q_ab.2 := sub_add_cancel _ _
  have ha_q₁ : G.a_coord q₁ = p₁_ab.1 := by
    rw [← hΨ_p₁]
    exact ha_left p₁_ab hp₁_ab
  have hb_q₁ : G.b_coord q₁ = p₁_ab.2 := by
    rw [← hΨ_p₁]
    exact hb_left p₁_ab hp₁_ab
  have hcomp_Φ₁ : pointCoreComp2D Φ₁_ser Ψ_ab_1 Ψ_ab_2 = MvPowerSeries.X 0 := by
    have hc := hSer.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_ab_open hW₀_open hp₁_ab hΨ_ab_holo
      (ha_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const (G.a_coord q₁))) hΨ_ab_maps_W₀
    rw [hΨ_p₁] at hc
    change taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.a_coord q₁) p₁_ab =
      pointCoreComp2D Φ₁_ser Ψ_ab_1 Ψ_ab_2 at hc
    rw [← hc]
    have hcongr : taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.a_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.a_coord q₁) p₁_ab =
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₁_ab :=
      hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab_open hp₁_ab (fun q_ab hq_ab => by
        rw [ha_left q_ab hq_ab, ha_q₁])
    rw [hcongr, hSer.centeredTaylor2D_fst p₁_ab]
  have hcomp_Φ₂ : pointCoreComp2D Φ₂_ser Ψ_ab_1 Ψ_ab_2 = MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
    have hc := hSer.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_ab_open hW₀_open hp₁_ab hΨ_ab_holo
      (hb_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const (G.b_coord q₁))) hΨ_ab_maps_W₀
    rw [hΨ_p₁] at hc
    change taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.b_coord q₁) p₁_ab =
      pointCoreComp2D Φ₂_ser Ψ_ab_1 Ψ_ab_2 at hc
    rw [← hc]
    have hcongr : taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.b_coord (Ψ_ab q_ab) - G.b_coord q₁) p₁_ab =
        centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₁_ab :=
      hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab_open hp₁_ab (fun q_ab hq_ab => by
        rw [hb_left q_ab hq_ab, hb_q₁])
    rw [hcongr, hSer.centeredTaylor2D_snd p₁_ab]
  obtain ⟨hΨ1_mem, hΨ2_mem⟩ :=
    hSer.inv2D_mem K_pt
      (h_cent_zero G.a_coord q₁) (h_cent_zero G.b_coord q₁)
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).1) p₁_ab)
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).2) p₁_ab)
      hΦ₁_mem hΦ₂_mem hcomp_Φ₁ hcomp_Φ₂
  have h_coeff_comp_X : ∀ (f : PowerSeries ℂ) (s : Fin 2) (m : ℕ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff (Finsupp.single s m)
        (compPowerSeries2D f (MvPowerSeries.X s)) = PowerSeries.coeff m f := by
    intro f s m
    let d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single s m
    change ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
        PowerSeries.coeff n f *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) ^ n) =
      PowerSeries.coeff m f
    have hsum :
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff n f *
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((MvPowerSeries.X s : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) ^ n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          if m = n then PowerSeries.coeff n f else 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]
      by_cases hmn : m = n
      · subst hmn
        simp [d]
      · have hne : d ≠ Finsupp.single s n := fun h => hmn ((Finsupp.single_injective s) h)
        simp [hmn, hne]
    rw [hsum, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    have hm : m ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1) := by
      fin_cases s <;> simp [d]
    simp [hm]
  have hSa_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q_ab => Y₀ (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab) := by
    have hc := hSer.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_ab_open hW₀_open hp₁_ab hΨ_ab_holo hY₀_holo hΨ_ab_maps_W₀
    rw [hΨ_p₁] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact hSer.comp2D_mem K_pt hY₀_mem
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).1) p₁_ab)
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).2) p₁_ab)
      hΨ1_mem hΨ2_mem
  have hSb_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q_ab => Y_k (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab) := by
    have hc := hSer.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_ab_open hW₀_open hp₁_ab hΨ_ab_holo hYk_holo hΨ_ab_maps_W₀
    rw [hΨ_p₁] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact hSer.comp2D_mem K_pt hYk_mem
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).1) p₁_ab)
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).2) p₁_ab)
      hΨ1_mem hΨ2_mem
  have hY₀_graph : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, q_ab.1 ∈ G.W_F ∧ Y₀ (Ψ_ab q_ab) = G.F q_ab.1 := by
    intro q_ab hq_ab
    have hx0 : pointChartX C k G.rotIdx G.Ψ 0 (σ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.1 :=
      (G.x_endpoints (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab).1
    obtain ⟨hmem, hY⟩ := (G.x_holo_maps 0).2 (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab
    rw [hx0] at hmem hY
    refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
    simpa [Y₀, Ψ_ab] using hY
  have hYk_graph : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab, q_ab.2 ∈ G.W_F ∧ Y_k (Ψ_ab q_ab) = G.F q_ab.2 := by
    intro q_ab hq_ab
    have hxk : pointChartX C k G.rotIdx G.Ψ (Fin.last k) (σ_ab q_ab) = q_ab.2 := by
      have h := (G.x_endpoints (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab).2
      dsimp only [σ_ab] at h
      rw [add_sub_cancel] at h
      exact h
    obtain ⟨hmem, hY⟩ := (G.x_holo_maps (Fin.last k)).2 (σ_ab q_ab) hq_ab
    rw [hxk] at hmem hY
    refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
    simpa [Y_k, Ψ_ab, Fin.val_last] using hY
  have hSa_eq : taylor2D (fun q_ab => Y₀ (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
      compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D G.F (a₁ : ℂ)) (MvPowerSeries.X 0) := by
    rw [hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab_open hp₁_ab (fun q_ab hq_ab => (hY₀_graph q_ab hq_ab).2)]
    have hc := hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab_open G.W_F_open hp₁_ab
      differentiable_fst.differentiableOn G.F_holo (fun q_ab hq_ab => (hY₀_graph q_ab hq_ab).1)
    rw [hSer.centeredTaylor2D_fst p₁_ab] at hc
    exact hc
  have hSb_eq : taylor2D (fun q_ab => Y_k (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
      compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D G.F ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) (MvPowerSeries.X 1) := by
    rw [hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab_open hp₁_ab (fun q_ab hq_ab => (hYk_graph q_ab hq_ab).2)]
    have hc := hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab_open G.W_F_open hp₁_ab
      differentiable_snd.differentiableOn G.F_holo (fun q_ab hq_ab => (hYk_graph q_ab hq_ab).1)
    rw [hSer.centeredTaylor2D_snd p₁_ab] at hc
    exact hc
  have hEndJets : ∀ m : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv m G.F (a₁ : ℂ) ∈ K_pt ∧
      iteratedDeriv m G.F ((a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ)) ∈ K_pt := by
    intro m
    have hfac_mem : (m.factorial : ℂ) ∈ K_pt := natCast_mem K_pt m.factorial
    have hfac_ne : (m.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hm0 := hSa_mem (Finsupp.single 0 m)
      rw [hSa_eq, h_coeff_comp_X, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk] at hm0
      have hmul := K_pt.mul_mem hm0 hfac_mem
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfac_ne] at hmul
    · have hm1 := hSb_mem (Finsupp.single 1 m)
      rw [hSb_eq, h_coeff_comp_X, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk] at hm1
      have hmul := K_pt.mul_mem hm1 hfac_mem
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfac_ne] at hmul
  have hA_2d_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D A_2d q₁) := by
    have hc := hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hW₀_open Metric.isOpen_ball hq₁
      differentiable_snd.differentiableOn C.A_holo (fun q hq => hW₀_maps_A hq)
    rw [hSer.centeredTaylor2D_snd q₁] at hc
    change taylor2D A_2d q₁ =
      compPowerSeries2D (holoTaylor1D C.A q₁.2) (MvPowerSeries.X 1) at hc
    rw [hc]
    refine hSer.comp1D_mem K_pt ?_ (MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_X 1) (hSer.X_mem K_pt 1)
    intro n
    rw [holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_eq_iterate]
    have hnum : (deriv^[n] C.A) q₁.2 ∈ K_pt := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact Or.inr ⟨Sum.inr n, rfl⟩
    exact K_pt.div_mem hnum (natCast_mem K_pt n.factorial)
  obtain ⟨hpAa_holo, hpDa_holo⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hW₀_open ha_holo
  obtain ⟨hpAb_holo, hpDb_holo⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hW₀_open hb_holo
  have hp1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => pderivA G.a_coord q * pderivD G.b_coord q) W₀ :=
    hpAa_holo.mul hpDb_holo
  have hp2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => pderivD G.a_coord q * pderivA G.b_coord q) W₀ :=
    hpDa_holo.mul hpAb_holo
  have hdet_eq : G.det_ab = fun q =>
      pderivA G.a_coord q * pderivD G.b_coord q -
        pderivD G.a_coord q * pderivA G.b_coord q := rfl
  have hdet_holo_W₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.det_ab W₀ := by
    rw [hdet_eq]
    exact hp1_holo.sub hp2_holo
  have hdet_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.det_ab G.V_W :=
    hdet_holo_W₀.mono G.V_W_sub
  have hdet_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D G.det_ab q₁) := by
    have h1 := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).2 hp1_holo hp2_holo).2.1
    have h2 := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).2 hpAa_holo hpDb_holo).2.2
    have h3 := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW₀_open hq₁).2 hpDa_holo hpAb_holo).2.2
    obtain ⟨hmAa, hmDa⟩ := hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hW₀_open hq₁ ha_holo
    obtain ⟨hmAb, hmDb⟩ := hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hW₀_open hq₁ hb_holo
    change pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt
      (taylor2D (fun q => pderivA G.a_coord q * pderivD G.b_coord q -
        pderivD G.a_coord q * pderivA G.b_coord q) q₁)
    rw [h1, h2, h3, ← hmAa, ← hmDa, ← hmAb, ← hmDb]
    exact hSer.sub_mem K_pt
      (hSer.mul_mem K_pt (hSer.mvDerivA_mem K_pt ha_mem) (hSer.mvDerivD_mem K_pt hb_mem))
      (hSer.mul_mem K_pt (hSer.mvDerivD_mem K_pt ha_mem) (hSer.mvDerivA_mem K_pt hb_mem))
  have hdet_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (G.det_ab q)⁻¹) G.V_W :=
    hdet_holo.fun_inv G.det_ab_ne_zero
  have hdet_inv_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q => (G.det_ab q)⁻¹) q₁) := by
    refine hSer.inv_mem K_pt ?_ hdet_mem
    have hmul :=
      ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra G.V_W_open hq₁_VW).2 hdet_inv_holo hdet_holo).2.2
    rw [← hmul,
      hKit.taylor2D_congr G.V_W_open hq₁_VW (fun q hq => inv_mul_cancel₀ (G.det_ab_ne_zero q hq)),
      (hKit.taylor2D_algebra G.V_W_open hq₁_VW).1 (1 : ℂ), map_one]
  let quotFn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => C.A q.2 / G.det_ab q
  have hquot_eq : quotFn = fun q => A_2d q * (G.det_ab q)⁻¹ := by
    funext q
    exact div_eq_mul_inv (C.A q.2) (G.det_ab q)
  have hquot_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ quotFn G.V_W := by
    rw [hquot_eq]
    exact (hA_2d_holo.mono G.V_W_sub).mul hdet_inv_holo
  have hquot_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D quotFn q₁) := by
    rw [hquot_eq,
      ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra G.V_W_open hq₁_VW).2 (hA_2d_holo.mono G.V_W_sub) hdet_inv_holo).2.2]
    exact hSer.mul_mem K_pt hA_2d_mem hdet_inv_mem
  have hquot_pull_mem : pointCoreCoeffsIn K_pt (taylor2D (fun q_ab => quotFn (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab) := by
    have hc := hSer.taylor2D_comp_2D hU_ab_open G.V_W_open hp₁_ab hΨ_ab_holo hquot_holo hΨ_ab_maps_VW
    rw [hΨ_p₁] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact hSer.comp2D_mem K_pt hquot_mem
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).1) p₁_ab)
      (h_cent_zero (fun q_ab => (Ψ_ab q_ab).2) p₁_ab)
      hΨ1_mem hΨ2_mem
  have hA_pt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.A_point U :=
    DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun i _ => (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).1
  have hA_ab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G.A_point_ab U_ab :=
    hA_pt_holo.comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)
  have hpA_ab_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA G.A_point_ab) U_ab :=
    (hKit.pderiv_holo hU_ab_open hA_ab_holo).1
  have hderivAD_eq :
      mvDerivD (mvDerivA (taylor2D G.A_point_ab p₁_ab)) =
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => quotFn (Ψ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab := by
    rw [(hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU_ab_open hp₁_ab hA_ab_holo).1,
      (hKit.mvDeriv_rules.2 hU_ab_open hp₁_ab hpA_ab_holo).2]
    exact hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab_open hp₁_ab (fun q_ab hq_ab =>
      G.symplectic_mixed_deriv q_ab hq_ab)
  have hMixedAct : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, 1 ≤ d 0 → 1 ≤ d 1 →
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab p₁_ab) ∈ K_pt := by
    refine hSer.mixed_of_derivAD_mem K_pt ?_
    rw [hderivAD_eq]
    exact hquot_pull_mem
  exact ⟨hEndJets, hMixedAct⟩

          ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
        Subfield.closure
          ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (pointCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁))) ∧
    (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D G.A_point_ab ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))) ∈
        Subfield.closure
          ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (pointCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁)))

proof.tactics:
by
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let p₁_ab : ℂ × ℂ := ((a₁ : ℂ), (a₁ : ℂ) + (δ₁ : ℂ))
  let σ_ab : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q_ab => (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)
  let F_val : Subfield ℂ :=
    Subfield.closure ((K_base : Set ℂ) ∪ Set.range (pointCoreTuple C B k G a₁ δ₁))
  let x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun r => G.x_fn r p₁
  let ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => G.ℓ_fn i p₁
  let S_ser : PowerSeries ℂ := holoTaylor1D sqrt1p 0
  let I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ := holoTaylor1D pointCoreInvSqrt1p 0
  let F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ := fun r => holoTaylor1D G.F (x_base r)
  let β_ser : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun r => centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)) p₁_ab
  
  have h_idx2D : ∀ a b : ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D a b 0 = a ∧ pointCoreIdx2D a b 1 = b :=
    fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have h_idx_single0 : ∀ m : ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D m 0 = Finsupp.single 0 m := fun m =>
    Finsupp.ext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr
      ⟨by simp [(h_idx2D m 0).1], by simp [(h_idx2D m 0).2]⟩)
  have h_idx_single1 : ∀ m : ℕ, pointCoreIdx2D 0 m = Finsupp.single 1 m := fun m =>
    Finsupp.ext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr
      ⟨by simp [(h_idx2D 0 m).1], by simp [(h_idx2D 0 m).2]⟩)
  have h_deg0_eq : ∀ u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, u 0 + u 1 ≤ 0 → u = 0 := fun u hu =>
    Finsupp.ext (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨by simp; omega, by simp; omega⟩)
  have hC2_ps : (MvPowerSeries.C (2 : ℂ) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = 2 := by
    rw [show (2 : ℂ) = 1 + 1 by norm_num, map_add, map_one]
    norm_num
  have h_sq_mem : ∀ (L : Subfield ℂ) {S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
      pointCoreCoeffsIn L S → pointCoreCoeffsIn L (S ^ 2) := by
    intro L S hS
    rw [sq]; exact hSer.mul_mem L hS hS
  have hX_10_0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0)
      (MvPowerSeries.X (0 : Fin 2) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, if_pos (h_idx_single0 1)]
  have hX_10_1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0)
      (MvPowerSeries.X (1 : Fin 2) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = 0 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, if_neg]
    intro h; have h0 := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 0) h
    simp [(h_idx2D 1 0).1] at h0
  have hX_01_0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1)
      (MvPowerSeries.X (0 : Fin 2) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = 0 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, if_neg]
    intro h; have h1 := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 1) h
    simp [(h_idx2D 0 1).2] at h1
  have hX_01_1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1)
      (MvPowerSeries.X (1 : Fin 2) : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_X, if_pos (h_idx_single1 1)]
  have h_tay_const : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ},
      IsOpen W → p₀ ∈ W → ∀ c : ℂ, taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
    intro W p₀ hW hp₀ c
    exact (hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW hp₀).1 c
  have h_tay_add : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ},
      IsOpen W → p₀ ∈ W → ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
      taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
    intro W p₀ hW hp₀ f g hf hg
    exact ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hW hp₀).2 hf hg).1
  have h_tay_sub : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ},

        ((((G.ℓ_holo_sq i).1.mono Set.inter_subset_left).continuousOn).isOpen_inter_preimage
          (hVu_open i) Metric.isOpen_ball)
        ((hL₂_holo i).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (hVu_open i) Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hp₁_Vc : ∀ i : Fin k, p₁ ∈ V_close i := by
      intro i
      have hpos : 0 < ‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2 := half_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr (hℓ_ne i))
      refine ⟨⟨hp₁_Vu i, Metric.mem_ball_self hpos⟩, ⟨hp₁_Vu i, ?_⟩⟩
      change L₂_fn i p₁ ∈ Metric.ball (ℓ_base i) (‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2)
      rw [hL₂_p₁ i]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hpos
    have hVc_eq : ∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ q ∈ V_close i,
        G.ℓ_fn i q = L₂_fn i q ∧ G.ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0 ∧ u_fn i q ∈ B₀ := by
      intro i q hq
      have h1 : ‖G.ℓ_fn i q - ℓ_base i‖ < ‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2 := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq.1.2
      have h2 : ‖L₂_fn i q - ℓ_base i‖ < ‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2 := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq.2.2
      have hsq := hL₂_sq i q hq.1.1
      have hsum_ne : G.ℓ_fn i q + L₂_fn i q ≠ 0 := by
        intro hsum0
        have hpos : 0 < ‖ℓ_base i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hℓ_ne i)
        have htri : ‖(2 : ℂ) * ℓ_base i‖ < ‖ℓ_base i‖ := by
          have hid : (2 : ℂ) * ℓ_base i =
              (ℓ_base i - G.ℓ_fn i q) + (ℓ_base i - L₂_fn i q) := by
            calc (2 : ℂ) * ℓ_base i
                = (2 : ℂ) * ℓ_base i - (G.ℓ_fn i q + L₂_fn i q) := by rw [hsum0, sub_zero]
              _ = (ℓ_base i - G.ℓ_fn i q) + (ℓ_base i - L₂_fn i q) := by ring
          rw [hid]
          calc ‖(ℓ_base i - G.ℓ_fn i q) + (ℓ_base i - L₂_fn i q)‖
              ≤ ‖ℓ_base i - G.ℓ_fn i q‖ + ‖ℓ_base i - L₂_fn i q‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖G.ℓ_fn i q - ℓ_base i‖ + ‖L₂_fn i q - ℓ_base i‖ := by
                rw [norm_sub_rev (ℓ_base i), norm_sub_rev (ℓ_base i)]
            _ < ‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2 + ‖ℓ_base i‖ / 2 := add_lt_add h1 h2
            _ = ‖ℓ_base i‖ := add_halves _
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat] at htri
        linarith
      have hprod0 : (G.ℓ_fn i q - L₂_fn i q) * (G.ℓ_fn i q + L₂_fn i q) = 0 := by
        linear_combination -hsq
      have heq : G.ℓ_fn i q = L₂_fn i q :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hprod0).resolve_right hsum_ne)
      exact ⟨heq, heq.symm ▸ mul_ne_zero (hℓ_ne i) (h_sqrt_ne _), hq.1.1.2⟩
    let V₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_chart ∩ ⋂ i : Fin k, V_close i
    have hV₁_open : IsOpen V₁ := hU_chart_open.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hVc_open)
    have hp₁_V₁ : p₁ ∈ V₁ := ⟨hp₁_U, Set.mem_iInter.mpr hp₁_Vc⟩
    let U_ab₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := σ_ab ⁻¹' V₁
    have hU_ab₁_open : IsOpen U_ab₁ := hV₁_open.preimage hσ_diff.continuous
    have hp₁_ab_V₁ : p₁_ab ∈ U_ab₁ := by
      change σ_ab p₁_ab ∈ V₁; rw [hσ_p₁]; exact hp₁_V₁
    have hU_ab₁_sub : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab₁, σ_ab q_ab ∈ U_chart := fun _ hq => hq.1
    
    have hx_ab_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab)) U_ab₁ :=
      fun r => ((G.x_holo_maps r).1).comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn hU_ab₁_sub
    have hFx_ab_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => G.F (G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab))) U_ab₁ :=
      fun r => (hFx_holo r).comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn hU_ab₁_sub
    have hF'x_ab_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => deriv G.F (G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab))) U_ab₁ :=
      fun r => (hF'x_holo r).comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn hU_ab₁_sub
    have hu_ab_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)) U_ab₁ :=
      fun i => (hu_holo i).comp hσ_diff.differentiableOn hU_ab₁_sub
    have hu_ab_maps : ∀ (i : Fin k), ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab₁, u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab) ∈ B₀ :=
      fun i q_ab hq => (hVc_eq i (σ_ab q_ab) (Set.mem_iInter.mp hq.2 i)).2.2
    have hx_tay : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
          MvPowerSeries.C (x_base r) + β_ser r := by
      intro r
      have h_id : taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
          taylor2D (fun q_ab => x_base r +
            (G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) - G.x_fn r (p₁_ab.1, p₁_ab.2 - p₁_ab.1)))
            p₁_ab :=
        hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ (fun q_ab _ => by
          dsimp only [x_base, σ_ab]
          have h1 : (p₁_ab.1, p₁_ab.2 - p₁_ab.1) = p₁ := hσ_p₁
          rw [h1]; ring)
      rw [h_id,
        h_tay_add hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
          (hd_const U_ab₁ (x_base r))
          (hd_sub (hx_ab_holo r) (hd_const U_ab₁ (G.x_fn r (p₁_ab.1, p₁_ab.2 - p₁_ab.1)))),
        h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁]
      rfl
    have hDX_tay : ∀ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab) - G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
          pcJetEdgeDX x_base β_ser i := by
      intro i
      rw [h_tay_sub hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
        (hx_ab_holo i.succ) (hx_ab_holo i.castSucc), hx_tay, hx_tay]
      unfold pcJetEdgeDX
      rw [map_sub]
      ring
    have hFx_tay : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => G.F (G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab))) p₁_ab =
          compPowerSeries2D (F_ser r) (β_ser r) := by
      intro r
      have h1 := hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab₁_open G.W_F_open hp₁_ab_V₁
        (hx_ab_holo r) G.F_holo (fun q_ab hq => ((G.x_holo_maps r).2 _ (hU_ab₁_sub q_ab hq)).1)
      have hp : G.x_fn r (σ_ab p₁_ab) = x_base r := by rw [hσ_p₁]
      rw [hp] at h1
      exact h1
    have hF'x_tay : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => deriv G.F (G.x_fn r (σ_ab q_ab))) p₁_ab =
          compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (F_ser r)) (β_ser r) := by
      intro r
      have h1 := hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab₁_open G.W_F_open hp₁_ab_V₁
        (hx_ab_holo r) (G.F_holo.deriv G.W_F_open)
        (fun q_ab hq => ((G.x_holo_maps r).2 _ (hU_ab₁_sub q_ab hq)).1)
      have hp : G.x_fn r (σ_ab p₁_ab) = x_base r := by rw [hσ_p₁]
      rw [hp, ← h_deriv_holoTaylor1D G.F (x_base r)] at h1
      exact h1
    have hDY_tay : ∀ i : Fin k,
        taylor2D (fun q_ab =>
          G.F (G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab)) - G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab))) p₁_ab =
          pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β_ser i := by
      intro i
      rw [h_tay_sub hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
        (hFx_ab_holo i.succ) (hFx_ab_holo i.castSucc), hFx_tay, hFx_tay]
      rfl
    have hu_cent_tay : ∀ i : Fin k,
        centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
          pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β_ser i := by
      intro i
      have h_cent : centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab =
          taylor2D (fun q_ab => u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)) p₁_ab :=
        hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ (fun q_ab _ => by
          change u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab) - u_fn i (σ_ab p₁_ab) = u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)
          rw [hσ_p₁, hu_p₁ i, sub_zero])
      rw [h_cent]
      dsimp only [u_fn, pointEdgeSq]
      have hdx_h := hd_sub (hx_ab_holo i.succ) (hx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
      have hdy_h := hd_sub (hFx_ab_holo i.succ) (hFx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
      have h_sq_tay : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_ab₁ →
          taylor2D (fun q_ab => (g q_ab) ^ 2) p₁_ab = (taylor2D g p₁_ab) ^ 2 := by
        intro g hg
        simp only [sq]
        exact h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ hg hg
      rw [h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
            (hd_const U_ab₁ (((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)⁻¹))
            (hd_sub (hd_add (hd_sq hdx_h) (hd_sq hdy_h)) (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2))),
          h_tay_sub hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
            (hd_add (hd_sq hdx_h) (hd_sq hdy_h)) (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)),
          h_tay_add hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ (hd_sq hdx_h) (hd_sq hdy_h),
          h_sq_tay hdx_h, h_sq_tay hdy_h,
          h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁,
          h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁,
          hDX_tay i, hDY_tay i]
      rfl
    have h_taylor2D_sum : ∀ (s : Finset (Fin k)) (g : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) U_ab₁) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => ∑ i ∈ s, g i q_ab) U_ab₁ ∧
        taylor2D (fun q_ab => ∑ i ∈ s, g i q_ab) p₁_ab =
          ∑ i ∈ s, taylor2D (g i) p₁_ab := by
      intro s g hg
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
          refine ⟨by simpa using differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ), ?_⟩
          simpa using h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ 0
      | @insert a s ha ih =>
          have hga := hg a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
          obtain ⟨hs_holo, hs_tay⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hg i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
          refine ⟨(hga.add hs_holo).congr (fun q_ab _ => Finset.sum_insert ha), ?_⟩
          simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
          rw [h_tay_add hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ hga hs_holo, hs_tay]
    constructor
    · 
      have h_congr : taylor2D G.A_point_ab p₁_ab =
          taylor2D (fun q_ab => ∑ i : Fin k, ℓ_base i * sqrt1p (u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab))) p₁_ab :=
        hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ (fun q_ab hq => by
          dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.A_point_ab, pointChartActionAB, pointChartAction]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          exact (hVc_eq i (σ_ab q_ab) (Set.mem_iInter.mp hq.2 i)).1)
      have h_term_holo : ∀ i : Fin k,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q_ab => ℓ_base i * sqrt1p (u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab))) U_ab₁ :=
        fun i => hd_mul (hd_const U_ab₁ (ℓ_base i))
          (hd_comp1 h_sqrt_holo (hu_ab_holo i) (hu_ab_maps i))
      rw [h_congr, (h_taylor2D_sum Finset.univ
        (fun i q_ab => ℓ_base i * sqrt1p (u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab)))
        (fun i _ => h_term_holo i)).2]
      unfold pcJetAction2D
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
            (hd_const U_ab₁ (ℓ_base i))
            (hd_comp1 h_sqrt_holo (hu_ab_holo i) (hu_ab_maps i)),
          h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁,
          hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab₁_open hB₀_open hp₁_ab_V₁
            (hu_ab_holo i) h_sqrt_holo (hu_ab_maps i),
          hσ_p₁, hu_p₁ i, hu_cent_tay i]
    · 
      intro r
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let eSucc_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i q_ab =>
        (ℓ_base i)⁻¹ *
          ((G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab) - G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab)) +
            (G.F (G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab)) - G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab))) *
              deriv G.F (G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab))) *
          pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab))
      let eCast_fn : Fin k → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i q_ab =>
        (ℓ_base i)⁻¹ *
          ((G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab) - G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab)) +
            (G.F (G.x_fn i.succ (σ_ab q_ab)) - G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab))) *
              deriv G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc (σ_ab q_ab))) *
          pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u_fn i (σ_ab q_ab))
      have heSucc_tay : ∀ i : Fin k,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (eSucc_fn i) U_ab₁ ∧
          taylor2D (eSucc_fn i) p₁_ab = pcJetEdgeTermSucc x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β_ser i := by
        intro i
        have hdx := hd_sub (hx_ab_holo i.succ) (hx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
        have hdy := hd_sub (hFx_ab_holo i.succ) (hFx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
        have hnum := hd_add hdx (hd_mul hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.succ))
        have hinv := hd_comp1 h_invSqrt_holo (hu_ab_holo i) (hu_ab_maps i)
        refine ⟨hd_mul (hd_mul (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum) hinv, ?_⟩
        dsimp only [eSucc_fn]
        rw [h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hd_mul (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum) hinv,
            h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum,
            h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁,
            h_tay_add hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              hdx (hd_mul hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.succ)),
            h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.succ),
            hDX_tay i, hDY_tay i, hF'x_tay i.succ,
            hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab₁_open hB₀_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hu_ab_holo i) h_invSqrt_holo (hu_ab_maps i),
            hσ_p₁, hu_p₁ i, hu_cent_tay i]
        rfl
      have heCast_tay : ∀ i : Fin k,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (eCast_fn i) U_ab₁ ∧
          taylor2D (eCast_fn i) p₁_ab = pcJetEdgeTermCast x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β_ser i := by
        intro i
        have hdx := hd_sub (hx_ab_holo i.succ) (hx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
        have hdy := hd_sub (hFx_ab_holo i.succ) (hFx_ab_holo i.castSucc)
        have hnum := hd_add hdx (hd_mul hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.castSucc))
        have hinv := hd_comp1 h_invSqrt_holo (hu_ab_holo i) (hu_ab_maps i)
        refine ⟨hd_mul (hd_mul (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum) hinv, ?_⟩
        dsimp only [eCast_fn]
        rw [h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hd_mul (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum) hinv,
            h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hd_const U_ab₁ ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹)) hnum,
            h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁,
            h_tay_add hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              hdx (hd_mul hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.castSucc)),
            h_tay_mul hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              hdy (hF'x_ab_holo i.castSucc),
            hDX_tay i, hDY_tay i, hF'x_tay i.castSucc,
            hKit.taylor2D_comp_1D hU_ab₁_open hB₀_open hp₁_ab_V₁
              (hu_ab_holo i) h_invSqrt_holo (hu_ab_maps i),
            hσ_p₁, hu_p₁ i, hu_cent_tay i]
        rfl
      have h_pt_zero : ∀ q_ab ∈ U_ab₁, eSucc_fn i_L q_ab - eCast_fn i_R q_ab = 0 := by
        intro q_ab hq
        let q := σ_ab q_ab
        have hq_U : q ∈ U_chart := hq.1
        have hq_ℓ_ne : ∀ i : Fin k, G.ℓ_fn i q ≠ 0 :=
          fun i => (hVc_eq i q (Set.mem_iInter.mp hq.2 i)).2.1
        have hstat := G.stationary_on_nondeg q hq_U hq_ℓ_ne r
        have h_rel_eq : ∀ i : Fin k,
            pointRelEdgeLen (fun j => G.ℓ_fn j q) (fun _ => G.F)
              (fun s => pointChartX C k G.rotIdx G.Ψ s q) i =
            ℓ_base i * sqrt1p (u_fn i q) := by
          intro i
          unfold pointRelEdgeLen
          rw [← (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).2 q hq_U, sub_self, zero_div, h_sqrt_zero, mul_one]
          exact (hVc_eq i q (Set.mem_iInter.mp hq.2 i)).1
        dsimp only [pointRelInteriorGrad] at hstat
        rw [h_rel_eq i_L, h_rel_eq i_R] at hstat
        have h_div_eq : ∀ (N_val : ℂ) (i : Fin k),
            N_val / (ℓ_base i * sqrt1p (u_fn i q)) =
              (ℓ_base i)⁻¹ * N_val * pointCoreInvSqrt1p (u_fn i q) := by
          intro N_val i
          unfold pointCoreInvSqrt1p
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
          ring
        rw [h_div_eq _ i_L, h_div_eq _ i_R] at hstat
        exact hstat
      unfold pcJetGrad2D
      dsimp only
      rw [← (heSucc_tay i_L).2, ← (heCast_tay i_R).2,
        ← h_tay_sub hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁
          (heSucc_tay i_L).1 (heCast_tay i_R).1,
        hKit.taylor2D_congr hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁ h_pt_zero,
        h_tay_const hU_ab₁_open hp₁_ab_V₁, map_zero]
  rcases hAction_and_Grad with ⟨hAction_tay, hGrad_tay⟩
  
  let e_core := Fintype.equivFin (PointCoreIdx k)
  have hx_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x_base r ∈ F_val := by
    intro r
    apply Subfield.subset_closure
    refine Or.inr ⟨e_core (Sum.inl r), ?_⟩
    dsimp only [pointCoreTuple, e_core, x_base, p₁]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hℓ_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_base i ∈ F_val := by
    intro i
    apply Subfield.subset_closure
    refine Or.inr ⟨e_core (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)), ?_⟩
    dsimp only [pointCoreTuple, e_core, ℓ_base, p₁]
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hCoreJets : ∀ (r : Fin (k + 1)) (m : ℕ), m ≤ max 2 k →
      PowerSeries.coeff m (F_ser r) ∈ F_val := by
    intro r m hm
    have hit_mem : iteratedDeriv m G.F (x_base r) ∈ F_val := by
      apply Subfield.subset_closure

        have h_rho_pow : (x_a_int s) ^ ν.1 * (ρ_hat s) ^ ν.1 = (x_b_int s) ^ ν.1 := by
          dsimp only [ρ_hat]
          rw [div_pow, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hxa_pow_ne]
        rw [h_xa_split, h_xb_split]
        dsimp only [x_a_int, x_b_int] at h_rho_pow ⊢
        calc (M.choose μ : ℂ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0)
                (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩)) ^ (M - μ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1)
                (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩) *

                (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩)) ^ ν.1)
            = (M.choose μ : ℂ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0)
                (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩)) ^ (M - μ) *
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 0 1)
                (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩) *
               ((MvPowerSeries.coeff (pointCoreIdx2D 1 0)
                  (β_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩)) ^ ν.1 * (ρ_hat s) ^ ν.1)) := by
              rw [h_rho_pow]
          _ = _ := by ring
      have h_tel :
          (∑ i : Fin k, γ_edge i * (T_jet i.succ - T_jet i.castSucc)) =
          (M.choose μ : ℂ) * (V_mat.mulVec z_jet) ν := by
        have h_mul_sub : (∑ i : Fin k, γ_edge i * (T_jet i.succ - T_jet i.castSucc)) =
            ∑ i : Fin k, (γ_edge i * T_jet i.succ - γ_edge i * T_jet i.castSucc) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_sub _ _ _
        rw [h_mul_sub, h_sbp γ_edge γ_edge T_jet hT_zero hT_last]
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, V_mat, Matrix.transpose_apply,

        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
        dsimp only [pcJetVertexWeight, γ_edge]
        ring
      have h_diff_eq :
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (pcJetAction2D x_base ℓ_base S_ser F_ser β_ser) -
            MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (pcJetAction2D x_base ℓ_base S_ser F_low β_trunc) =
          (M.choose μ : ℂ) * (V_mat.mulVec z_jet) ν := by
        rw [h_act_split (d_idx ν) hd_deg, h_env_cancel (d_idx ν) hd_deg, add_sub_cancel_left]
        exact h_tel
      symm
      change (MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (pcJetAction2D x_base ℓ_base S_ser F_ser β_ser) -
          MvPowerSeries.coeff (d_idx ν) (pcJetAction2D x_base ℓ_base S_ser F_low β_trunc)) /
          (M.choose μ : ℂ) = (V_mat.mulVec z_jet) ν
      rw [h_diff_eq, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hchoose_ne]
    have hz_jet_mem : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1), z_jet s ∈ F_val :=
      hSer.mulVec_mem F_val hV_mem hV_det hb_jet_mem hVz_eq
    intro r

    · have heq : r = 0 := Fin.ext hr0
      rw [heq]; exact (hEndCoeff M).1
    · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ r.2) with hr_lt | hrk
      · let s : Fin (k - 1) := ⟨r.1 - 1, by omega⟩
        have h_idx : (⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = r := by

        have hdenom_mem : denom ∈ F_val :=

            (hx_ab_mem s).2

        have h_div : z_jet s / denom =
            PowerSeries.coeff M (F_ser ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩) :=
          mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hdenom_ne

        exact F_val.div_mem (hz_jet_mem s) hdenom_mem
      · have heq : r = Fin.last k := Fin.ext hrk
        rw [heq]; exact (hEndCoeff M).2
  
  have hAllCoeff : ∀ (M : ℕ) (r : Fin (k + 1)), PowerSeries.coeff M (F_ser r) ∈ F_val := by
    intro M
    induction M using Nat.strong_induction_on with

        · exact fun r => hCoreJets r M hM
        · exact hVandStep M (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hM) (fun r m hm => ih m hm r)
  have hAllAbs : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), pointCoreCoeffsIn F_val (β_ser r) :=
    fun r d => hStatRec (d 0 + d 1) (fun r' m _ => hAllCoeff m r') r d le_rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r m
    have hm_coeff : iteratedDeriv m G.F (x_base r) / (m.factorial : ℂ) ∈ F_val := by

        iteratedDeriv m G.F (x_base r) := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hmf_ne
    change iteratedDeriv m G.F (x_base r) ∈ F_val

      hSer.sub_mem F_val
        (hSer.comp1D_mem F_val (fun m => hAllCoeff m i.succ) (hβ_c0 i.succ) (hAllAbs i.succ))

    have hU_m : pointCoreCoeffsIn F_val (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β_ser i) :=
      hSer.mul_mem F_val (hSer.C_mem F_val (F_val.inv_mem hℓ2_mem))
        (hSer.sub_mem F_val
          (hSer.add_mem F_val (h_sq_mem F_val hDX_m) (h_sq_mem F_val hDY_m))

    exact hSer.mul_mem F_val (hSer.C_mem F_val (hℓ_mem i))

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeDX {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (x_base i.succ - x_base i.castSucc) + (β i.succ - β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeDY {k : ℕ} (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  compPowerSeries2D (F_ser i.succ) (β i.succ) -
    compPowerSeries2D (F_ser i.castSucc) (β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeU {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C (((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
    ((pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i) ^ 2 + (pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i) ^ 2 -
      MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2))

noncomputable def pcJetAction2D {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (S_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    MvPowerSeries.C (ℓ_base i) *
      compPowerSeries2D S_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetNumSucc {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i +
    pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i *
      compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (F_ser i.succ)) (β i.succ)

noncomputable def pcJetNumCast {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  pcJetEdgeDX x_base β i +
    pcJetEdgeDY F_ser β i *
      compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (F_ser i.castSucc)) (β i.castSucc)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeTermSucc {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹) *
    pcJetNumSucc x_base F_ser β i *
    compPowerSeries2D I_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetEdgeTermCast {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (i : Fin k) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPowerSeries.C ((ℓ_base i)⁻¹) *
    pcJetNumCast x_base F_ser β i *
    compPowerSeries2D I_ser (pcJetEdgeU x_base ℓ_base F_ser β i)

noncomputable def pcJetGrad2D {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (I_ser : PowerSeries ℂ) (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  pcJetEdgeTermSucc x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β i_L -
    pcJetEdgeTermCast x_base ℓ_base I_ser F_ser β i_R

noncomputable def pcJetVertexWeight {k : ℕ} (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) (s : Fin (k - 1)) : ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨s.1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
  (PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)) /
      ℓ_base i_L -
    (PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)) /
      ℓ_base i_R

noncomputable def pcJetFormalHess {k : ℕ} (x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ)
    (F_ser : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ :=
  fun r s =>
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let Δx_L := x_base i_L.succ - x_base i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let F1_L_succ := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_L.succ)
    let F1_L_cast := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_L.castSucc)
    let F2_L_succ := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (F_ser i_L.succ)
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F1_L_succ
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * F1_L_cast
    let Δx_R := x_base i_R.succ - x_base i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.succ) - PowerSeries.coeff 0 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let F1_R_cast := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let F1_R_succ := PowerSeries.coeff 1 (F_ser i_R.succ)
    let F2_R_cast := 2 * PowerSeries.coeff 2 (F_ser i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F1_R_cast
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * F1_R_succ
    if r.1 = s.1 then
      (((1 + F1_L_succ ^ 2 + ΔY_L * F2_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 - n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
        (((1 + F1_R_cast ^ 2 - ΔY_R * F2_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 - n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F1_R_succ * F1_R_cast) * L_R ^ 2 + n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then
      ((-1 - F1_L_cast * F1_L_succ) * L_L ^ 2 + n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3
    else
      0

noncomputable def pcJetTrunc1D (K : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m => if m ≤ K then PowerSeries.coeff m f else 0

noncomputable def pcJetTruncAbscissas {k : ℕ} (N₀ : ℕ)
    (β : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun u =>
    if r.1 = 0 ∨ r.1 = k then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (β r)
    else if u 0 + u 1 < N₀ then MvPowerSeries.coeff u (β r)
    else 0

    have hIdx_e1 : lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 = Finsupp.single 1 1 := by

    have hIdx_add_e1 : ∀ a b : ℕ, lineCoreIdx2D a b + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1 = lineCoreIdx2D a (b + 1) := by
      intro a b; apply Finsupp.ext; intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hIdx0, hIdx1]
    have hd_eq_zero_iff : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d = 0 ↔ d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0 := by
      intro d

      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩; apply Finsupp.ext; intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
    have hd_deg_add_single : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

          ((d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 = d 0 + d 1 + 1 := by
      intro ι d; fin_cases ι <;> simp <;> omega
    let mvDeriv : Fin 2 → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
      fun ι S d => ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) S
    have coeff_taylor2D : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀) =
          iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f p₀ / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
      fun _ _ _ => rfl
    have coeff_mvDeriv : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

          ((d ι + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)) S :=

    have coeff_derivA : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

    have coeff_derivD : ∀ (S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

          ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) S :=

    have coeff_comp1D : ∀ (F₁ : PowerSeries ℂ) (U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

    have coeff_comp2D : ∀ (F U₁ U₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),

    have mvDeriv_zero_eq : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, mvDeriv 0 S = lineCoreDerivA S := by

    have mvDeriv_one_eq : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, mvDeriv 1 S = lineCoreDerivD S := by

    have hIter1D_congr : ∀ {V : Set ℂ}, IsOpen V → ∀ {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

      | succ β ih =>

    have hIterY_congr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},

      intro U hU f₁ f₂ hf α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro p hp; exact hf p hp
      | succ α ih =>
          intro p hp
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f₁ (y', p.2)) p.1 =
            deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f₂ (y', p.2)) p.1
          have hVy : IsOpen {y' : ℂ | (y', p.2) ∈ U} :=
            hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          exact (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVy.mem_nhds hp) (fun y' hy' => ih hy')).deriv_eq
    have hCongr : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, (∀ p ∈ U, f₁ p = f₂ p) → taylor2D f₁ p₀ = taylor2D f₂ p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f₁ f₂ hf
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
      have hVt : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p₀.1, t') ∈ U} :=
        hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f₁ p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) f₂ p₀ :=
        hIter1D_congr hVt (fun t' ht' => hIterY_congr hU hf (d 0) ht') (d 1) hp₀
      rw [hYT]
    have hIterY_succ : ∀ (α : ℕ) (h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        iterDerivY (α + 1) h = iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 h) := by
      intro α h
      induction α with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ α ih =>
          funext p
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY (α + 1) h (y', p.2)) p.1 =
            deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 h) (y', p.2)) p.1
          rw [ih]
    have hIter1D_zero : ∀ β : ℕ,
        (fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
      intro β
      induction β with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ β ih =>
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          have hd0 : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
            funext fun z => deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
          rw [hd0, ih]
    have hIter1D_const : ∀ (c : ℂ) (β : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
        ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ : ℂ => c)) z = if β = 0 then c else 0 := by
      intro c β z
      cases β with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ β =>
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          have hdc : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => c) = (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
            funext fun w => deriv_const w c
          rw [hdc, hIter1D_zero β]; simp
    have hIter1D_sub_self : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (β : ℕ),
        ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun t' : ℂ => t' - z₀)) z₀ = if β = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
      intro z₀ β
      cases β with
      | zero => simp
      | succ β =>
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          have hd1 : deriv (fun t' : ℂ => t' - z₀) = (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
            funext fun w => ((hasDerivAt_id w).sub_const z₀).deriv
          rw [hd1, hIter1D_const 1 β z₀]; cases β <;> simp
    have hIterY_zero : ∀ α : ℕ, iterDerivY α (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = (fun _ => 0) := by
      intro α
      induction α with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ α ih =>
          funext p
          change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY α (fun _ => 0) (y', p.2)) p.1 = 0
          rw [ih]; exact deriv_const p.1 (0 : ℂ)
    have hIterY_const : ∀ (c : ℂ) (α : ℕ),
        iterDerivY α (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) = fun _ => if α = 0 then c else 0 := by
      intro c α
      cases α with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ α =>
          rw [hIterY_succ α]
          have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) = (fun _ => 0) :=
            funext fun q => deriv_const q.1 c
          rw [h1, hIterY_zero α]; simp
    have hConst : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c : ℂ), taylor2D (fun _ => c) p₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
      intro p₀ c
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun _ => c) p₀ =
          if d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0 then c else 0 := by
        unfold iterDerivYT
        rw [hIterY_const c (d 0), hIter1D_const _ (d 1) p₀.2]
        by_cases h0 : d 0 = 0 <;> by_cases h1 : d 1 = 0 <;> simp [h0, h1]
      rw [hYT]
      by_cases hd : d = 0
      · rcases (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mp hd with ⟨h0, h1⟩; rw [h0, h1]; simp [hd]
      · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0) := fun h => hd ((hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr h)
        simp [hd, hnot]
    have hFst : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 := by
      intro p₀
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) p₀) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 0)
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
      have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) = (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
        funext fun q => ((hasDerivAt_id q.1).sub_const p₀.1).deriv
      have hslice : (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) (p₀.1, t')) =
          (fun _ : ℂ => if d 0 = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) := by
        cases h0 : d 0 with
        | zero => funext t'; simp [iterDerivY]
        | succ m =>
            rw [hIterY_succ m, h1, hIterY_const 1 m]; funext t'; cases m <;> simp
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 - p₀.1) p₀ =
          if d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
        unfold iterDerivYT
        rw [hslice, hIter1D_const _ (d 1) p₀.2]
        by_cases h0 : d 0 = 1 <;> by_cases h1' : d 1 = 0 <;> simp [h0, h1']
      have hsingle : d = Finsupp.single 0 1 ↔ d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0 := by
        constructor
        · rintro rfl; simp
        · rintro ⟨hd0, hd1⟩; apply Finsupp.ext; intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hd0, hd1]
      rw [hYT]
      by_cases hs : d = Finsupp.single 0 1
      · rcases hsingle.mp hs with ⟨hd0, hd1⟩; rw [hd0, hd1]; simp [hs]
      · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 1 ∧ d 1 = 0) := fun h => hs (hsingle.mpr h)
        simp [hs, hnot]
    have hSnd : ∀ p₀ : ℂ × ℂ, centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₀ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
      intro p₀
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext
      intro d
      change MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) p₀) =
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (MvPowerSeries.X 1)
      rw [coeff_taylor2D, MvPowerSeries.coeff_X]
      have h1 : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) = (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
        funext fun q => deriv_const q.1 (q.2 - p₀.2)
      have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 - p₀.2) p₀ =
          if d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
        cases h0 : d 0 with
        | zero =>
            unfold iterDerivYT iterDerivY
            rw [hIter1D_sub_self p₀.2 (d 1)]
            by_cases h1' : d 1 = 1 <;> simp [h1']
        | succ m =>
            unfold iterDerivYT
            rw [hIterY_succ m, h1, hIterY_zero m, hIter1D_const 0 (d 1) p₀.2]; simp
      have hsingle : d = Finsupp.single 1 1 ↔ d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1 := by
        constructor
        · rintro rfl; simp
        · rintro ⟨hd0, hd1⟩; apply Finsupp.ext; intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hd0, hd1]
      rw [hYT]
      by_cases hs : d = Finsupp.single 1 1
      · rcases hsingle.mp hs with ⟨hd0, hd1⟩; rw [hd0, hd1]; simp [hs]
      · have hnot : ¬ (d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 1) := fun h => hs (hsingle.mpr h)
        simp [hs, hnot]
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.fst, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.snd, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    let pderiv2D : Fin 2 → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun ι f => if ι = 0 then iterDerivYT 1 0 f else iterDerivYT 0 1 f
    let sliceCurve : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun ι q z => if ι = 0 then (z, q.2) else (q.1, z)
    let sliceBase : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun ι q => if ι = 0 then q.1 else q.2
    let sliceVec : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun ι => if ι = 0 then (1, 0) else (0, 1)
    have hpderiv2D_eq_slice : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
        pderiv2D ι h q = deriv (fun z : ℂ => h (sliceCurve ι q z)) (sliceBase ι q) := by
      intro ι h q; fin_cases ι <;> rfl
    have hslice_eval : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
        sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := by
      intro ι q; fin_cases ι <;> simp [sliceCurve, sliceBase]
    have hslice_hasDerivAt : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
        HasDerivAt (sliceCurve ι q) (sliceVec ι) (sliceBase ι q) := by
      intro ι q; fin_cases ι
      · exact (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
      · exact (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
    have hasDerivAt_pderiv2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ (ι : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
          HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (sliceCurve ι q z)) (pderiv2D ι g q) (sliceBase ι q) ∧
            fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι) = pderiv2D ι g q := by
      intro U hU g hg ι q hq
      have hq_eq : sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := hslice_eval ι q
      have hg_fd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) := by
        rw [hq_eq]
        exact (hg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hd : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (sliceCurve ι q z))
          (fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι)) (sliceBase ι q) :=
        hg_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) (hslice_hasDerivAt ι q)
      have heq : fderiv ℂ g q (sliceVec ι) = pderiv2D ι g q := by
        rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]; exact hd.deriv.symm
      exact ⟨heq ▸ hd, heq⟩
    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ {w : ℂ × ℂ}, w ∈ U →
          fderiv ℂ g w = π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 g w) + π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 g w) := by
      intro U hU g hg w hw
      have h1 : fderiv ℂ g w (1, 0) = iterDerivYT 1 0 g w := (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg 0 hw).2
      have h2 : fderiv ℂ g w (0, 1) = iterDerivYT 0 1 g w := (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg 1 hw).2
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have hv : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        apply Prod.ext <;> simp
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h1, h2]
      simp [π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]
    have hClairaut : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
          iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) q = iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) q := by
      intro U hU f hf q hq
      let S₁ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁
      let S₂ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂
      let fA := iterDerivYT 1 0 f
      let fD := iterDerivYT 0 1 f
      let f' : ℂ × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun w => S₁ (fA w) + S₂ (fD w)
      have hf_ev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds q, HasFDerivAt f (f' w) w := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hq] with w hw
        have hd := (hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hw)).hasFDerivAt
        rw [hfderiv_decomp hU hf hw] at hd
        exact hd
      have hfA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ fA U := hIter hU hf 1 0
      have hfD_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ fD U := hIter hU hf 0 1
      have hfA_fd : HasFDerivAt fA (fderiv ℂ fA q) q :=
        (hfA_holo.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hfD_fd : HasFDerivAt fD (fderiv ℂ fD q) q :=
        (hfD_holo.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      let f'' : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        S₁.comp (fderiv ℂ fA q) + S₂.comp (fderiv ℂ fD q)
      have hf'' : HasFDerivAt f' f'' q :=
        (S₁.hasFDerivAt.comp q hfA_fd).add (S₂.hasFDerivAt.comp q hfD_fd)
      have hsymm := second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually hf_ev hf'' (1, 0) (0, 1)
      have heval1 : (f'' (1, 0)) (0, 1) = iterDerivYT 1 0 fD q := by
        have hD_decomp := hfderiv_decomp hU hfD_holo hq
        simp [f'', S₁, S₂, π₁, π₂, hD_decomp]
      have heval2 : (f'' (0, 1)) (1, 0) = iterDerivYT 0 1 fA q := by
        have hA_decomp := hfderiv_decomp hU hfA_holo hq
        simp [f'', S₁, S₂, π₁, π₂, hA_decomp]
      rw [← heval1, ← heval2]; exact hsymm
    have hCommY_D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ (α : ℕ) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
          iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 0 1 g) q = iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivY α g) q := by
      intro U hU α
      induction α with
      | zero => intro g _ q _; rfl
      | succ α ih =>
          intro g hg q hq
          rw [hIterY_succ α (iterDerivYT 0 1 g)]
          have hcongrY : iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 g)) q =
              iterDerivY α (iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 g)) q :=
            hIterY_congr hU (fun w hw => hClairaut hU hg hw) α hq
          rw [hcongrY, ih (hIter hU hg 1 0) hq, ← hIterY_succ α g]
    have hDeriv : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
          lineCoreDerivA (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ ∧
          lineCoreDerivD (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf
      constructor
      · apply MvPowerSeries.ext
        intro d
        rw [coeff_derivA, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
        have hd0 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) 0 = d 0 + 1 := by simp [hIdx0]
        have hd1 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 1 0) 1 = d 1 := by simp [hIdx1]
        rw [hd0, hd1]
        have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0 + 1) (d 1) f p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) p₀ := by
          change ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0 + 1) f (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2 =
            ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (iterDerivYT 1 0 f) (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2
          rw [hIterY_succ (d 0) f]
        rw [hYT, Nat.factorial_succ (d 0), Nat.cast_mul]
        have hne : ((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero (d 0))
        rw [mul_assoc (((d 0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)), ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
      · apply MvPowerSeries.ext
        intro d
        rw [coeff_derivD, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
        have hd0 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) 0 = d 0 := by simp [hIdx0]
        have hd1 : (d + lineCoreIdx2D 0 1) 1 = d 1 + 1 := by simp [hIdx1]
        rw [hd0, hd1]
        have hVt : IsOpen {t' : ℂ | (p₀.1, t') ∈ U} :=
          hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have hYT : iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1 + 1) f p₀ = iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) p₀ := by
          change ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1 + 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) f (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2 =
            ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[d 1] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY (d 0) (iterDerivYT 0 1 f) (p₀.1, t'))) p₀.2
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
          exact (hIter1D_congr hVt (fun t' ht' => hCommY_D hU (d 0) hf ht') (d 1) hp₀).symm
        rw [hYT, Nat.factorial_succ (d 1), Nat.cast_mul]
        have hne : ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero (d 1))
        have hcomm : ((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * (((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) =
            ((d 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
        rw [hcomm, ← mul_div_assoc, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
    have hpderiv2D_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf ι; fin_cases ι
      · exact hIter hU hf 1 0
      · exact hIter hU hf 0 1
    have hmvDeriv_taylor2D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          mvDeriv ι (taylor2D f p₀) = taylor2D (pderiv2D ι f) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f hf ι; fin_cases ι
      · dsimp; rw [mvDeriv_zero_eq]; exact (hDeriv hU hp₀ hf).1
      · dsimp; rw [mvDeriv_one_eq]; exact (hDeriv hU hp₀ hf).2
    have hmvDeriv_add : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ + Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ + mvDeriv ι Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ; apply MvPowerSeries.ext; intro d
      rw [map_add, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, coeff_mvDeriv, map_add, mul_add]
    have hmvLeibniz_half : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d (mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)),
            (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
      intro ι Φ Ψ d
      let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)
      let S₁ := (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e)).filter
        (fun p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => p.1 ι ≠ 0)
      have hsub :
          (∑ p ∈ S₁, ((p.1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ) =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
            (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).1 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)

        · apply Finsupp.ext; intro k; simp only [Finsupp.tsub_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]; omega

      · intro p hp

        · rfl
      · intro q _
        rw [coeff_mvDeriv]
        have hqi : (q.1 + e) ι = q.1 ι + 1 := by simp [e]
        rw [hqi]
    have hmvDeriv_mul : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        mvDeriv ι (Φ * Ψ) = mvDeriv ι Φ * Ψ + Φ * mvDeriv ι Ψ := by

      let e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single ι (1 : ℕ)

          ∑ p ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal (d + e),
            (((p : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).2 ι : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff p.1 Φ * MvPowerSeries.coeff p.2 Ψ := by
        rw [mul_comm Φ (mvDeriv ι Ψ), hmvLeibniz_half ι Ψ Φ d]

        · intro p hp; rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp ⊢; simpa [add_comm] using hp
        · intro p _; cases p; rfl
        · intro p _; cases p; rfl
        · intro p _; simp; ring
      rw [map_add, hmvLeibniz_half ι Φ Ψ d, hsecond, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,

      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      have hsum_i : p.1 ι + p.2 ι = d ι + 1 := by
        have hi := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp ι; simpa [e] using hi

    have hVanish_zero : ∀ S : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ, lineCoreVanishesBelow 0 S :=

      have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,

            (PowerSeries.coeff n F₁ * MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single ι 1) (U ^ n)) =

      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
      rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hp

        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk_not
        rw [hVanish_pow hU k p.1 (by omega), mul_zero, zero_mul]
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
    have hmvDeriv_comp2D_half : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (G V₁ V₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),

      · intro b _ hb_not
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hb_not

    have hmvDeriv_comp2D : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ)

    have coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq : ∀ {N : ℕ} {Φ Ψ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ} {d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ},
        d 0 + d 1 = N + 1 →
        (∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d' 0 + d' 1 = N →
