          have h0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 0; have h1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hp 1
          simp at h0 h1
          exact Prod.ext ((hd_eq_zero_iff p.1).mpr ⟨h0.1, h1.1⟩)
            ((hd_eq_zero_iff p.2).mpr ⟨h0.2, h1.2⟩)
        · rintro rfl; simp
      rw [hant, Finset.sum_singleton]
    have hTaylor_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
            intro f g _ _ d hd
            have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
            have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
            rw [map_add, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, hd0, hd1]
            simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
            intro f g hf hg d hd
            by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
            · exact ih hf hg d hle
            · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
              have hp_add : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => f p + g p) q =
                  pderiv2D ι f q + pderiv2D ι g q := by
                intro q hq; rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
                exact ((hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hf ι hq).1.add
                  (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg ι hq).1).deriv
              rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_add hf hg) ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_add,
                hmvDeriv_add, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hf ι, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg ι]
              exact ih (hpderiv2D_holo hU hf ι) (hpderiv2D_holo hU hg ι) d' (by omega)
      intro f g hf hg; apply MvPowerSeries.ext; intro d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    have hTaylor_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
            intro f g _ _ d hd
            have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
            subst hd_zero
            rw [coeff_zero_mul, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D, coeff_taylor2D]
            simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
            intro f g hf hg d hd
            by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
            · exact ih hf hg d hle
            · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
              have hp_mul : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => f p * g p) q =
                  pderiv2D ι f q * g q + f q * pderiv2D ι g q := by
                intro q hq; rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
                have hmul_at := (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hf ι hq).1.mul
                  (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hg ι hq).1
                rw [hslice_eval ι q] at hmul_at
                exact hmul_at.deriv
              have hf' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι f) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hf ι
              have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι g) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hg ι
              rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hf hg) ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_mul,
                hTaylor_add hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hf' hg) (hDiff_mul hf hg'),
                hmvDeriv_mul, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hf ι, hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg ι,
                map_add, map_add, ih hf' hg d' (by omega), ih hf hg' d' (by omega)]
      intro f g hf hg; apply MvPowerSeries.ext; intro d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf hg d le_rfl
    have hRing : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          taylor2D (fun p => f p + g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ + taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p - g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ - taylor2D g p₀ ∧
          taylor2D (fun p => f p * g p) p₀ = taylor2D f p₀ * taylor2D g p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ f g hf hg
      refine ⟨hTaylor_add hU hp₀ hf hg, ?_, hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hf hg⟩
      have hsub_eq : (fun p => f p - g p) = (fun p => f p + (-1 : ℂ) * g p) := by funext p; ring
      rw [hsub_eq, hTaylor_add hU hp₀ hf (hDiff_mul (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg),
        hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ (differentiableOn_const (-1 : ℂ)) hg, hConst p₀ (-1 : ℂ),
        map_neg, map_one]
      ring
    have hCentered_coeff_zero : ∀ (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = 0 := by
      intro ψ p₀
      change MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = 0
      rw [coeff_taylor2D]; simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    have hmvDeriv_centered : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          mvDeriv ι (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = taylor2D (pderiv2D ι ψ) p₀ := by
      intro U hU p₀ hp₀ ψ hψ ι
      change mvDeriv ι (taylor2D (fun p => ψ p - ψ p₀) p₀) = _
      rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ (hDiff_sub hψ (differentiableOn_const (ψ p₀))) ι]
      refine hCongr hU hp₀ fun q hq => ?_
      rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
      exact ((hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hψ ι hq).1.sub_const (ψ p₀)).deriv
    have hComp1D : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {W_ψ : Set ℂ},
        IsOpen U → IsOpen W_ψ → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {g : ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ → (∀ p ∈ U, ψ p ∈ W_ψ) →
          taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀ =
            compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) := by
      intro U W_ψ hU hW_ψ p₀ hp₀ ψ g₀ hψ hg₀ hmaps
      have hderiv_1D : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
          PowerSeries.derivative (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g z₀) =
            lineCoreHoloTaylor1D (deriv g) z₀ := by
        intro g z₀; apply PowerSeries.ext; intro n
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
        unfold lineCoreHoloTaylor1D
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, iteratedDeriv_succ',
          Nat.factorial_succ n, Nat.cast_mul]
        have hne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
        have hcast_n : ((n : ℂ) + 1) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
        have hcomm : (iteratedDeriv n (deriv g) z₀ / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (n.factorial : ℂ))) *
            ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
            ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (iteratedDeriv n (deriv g) z₀) /
              (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (n.factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
        rw [hcast_n, hcomm, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hne]
      let U_ψ := centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀
      have hUψ_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U_ψ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero ψ p₀
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_ψ →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (ψ p)) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (lineCoreHoloTaylor1D g (ψ p₀)) U_ψ) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
            intro g _ d hd
            have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
            subst hd_zero
            rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_comp1D]
            simp [lineCoreHoloTaylor1D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
            intro g hg d hd
            by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
            · exact ih hg d hle
            · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
              have hg' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) W_ψ := hg.deriv hW_ψ
              have hg_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (ψ p)) U :=
                hg.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
              have hg'_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => deriv g (ψ p)) U :=
                hg'.comp hψ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
              have hp_comp : ∀ q ∈ U, pderiv2D ι (fun p => g (ψ p)) q =
                  deriv g (ψ q) * pderiv2D ι ψ q := by
                intro q hq; rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]
                have hψ_at := (hasDerivAt_pderiv2D hU hψ ι hq).1
                have hg_at : HasDerivAt g (deriv g (ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))))
                    (ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))) := by
                  rw [hslice_eval ι q]
                  exact (hg.differentiableAt (hW_ψ.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))).hasDerivAt
                have hcomp_at := hg_at.comp (sliceBase ι q) hψ_at
                rw [hslice_eval ι q] at hcomp_at
                exact hcomp_at.deriv
              rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg_comp ι, hCongr hU hp₀ hp_comp,
                hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hg'_comp (hpderiv2D_holo hU hψ ι),
                hmvDeriv_comp1D ι _ hUψ_zero, hderiv_1D, hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hψ ι,
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
              have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
              have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
              rw [ih hg' r.1 (by omega)]
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext; intro d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hg₀ d le_rfl
    have hComp2D : ∀ {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ U →
        ∀ {Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f V → (∀ p ∈ U, Ψ p ∈ V) →
          taylor2D (fun p => f (Ψ p)) p₀ =
            lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D f (Ψ p₀))
              (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).1) p₀)
              (centeredTaylor2D (fun p => (Ψ p).2) p₀) := by
      intro U V hU hV p₀ hp₀ Ψ f₀ hΨ hf₀ hmaps
      let Ψ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).1
      let Ψ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (Ψ p).2
      have hΨ₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₁ U := π₁.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
      have hΨ₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ₂ U := π₂.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hΨ
      let U₁ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₁ p₀
      let U₂ := centeredTaylor2D Ψ₂ p₀
      have hU₁_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₁ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero Ψ₁ p₀
      have hU₂_zero : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₂ = 0 := hCentered_coeff_zero Ψ₂ p₀
      have hp_comp2D : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
          ∀ (ι : Fin 2) {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ U →
            pderiv2D ι (fun p => g (Ψ p)) q =
              iterDerivYT 1 0 g (Ψ q) * pderiv2D ι Ψ₁ q +
                iterDerivYT 0 1 g (Ψ q) * pderiv2D ι Ψ₂ q := by
        intro g hg ι q hq
        have hq_eq : sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q) = q := hslice_eval ι q
        have hΨ_fd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℂ Ψ q) (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q)) := by
          rw [hq_eq]; exact (hΨ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
        have hΨ_slice : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ (sliceCurve ι q z))
            (fderiv ℂ Ψ q (sliceVec ι)) (sliceBase ι q) :=
          hΨ_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) (hslice_hasDerivAt ι q)
        let vΨ := fderiv ℂ Ψ q (sliceVec ι)
        have hvΨ1 : vΨ.1 = pderiv2D ι Ψ₁ q := by
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₁ (sliceCurve ι q z)) (π₁ vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
            π₁.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
          rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]; exact h1.deriv.symm
        have hvΨ2 : vΨ.2 = pderiv2D ι Ψ₂ q := by
          have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Ψ₂ (sliceCurve ι q z)) (π₂ vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
            π₂.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
          rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice]; exact h2.deriv.symm
        have hg_fd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q)) (Ψ (sliceCurve ι q (sliceBase ι q))) := by
          rw [hq_eq]; exact (hg.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps q hq))).hasFDerivAt
        have hcomp_at : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g (Ψ (sliceCurve ι q z)))
            (fderiv ℂ g (Ψ q) vΨ) (sliceBase ι q) :=
          hg_fd.comp_hasDerivAt (sliceBase ι q) hΨ_slice
        rw [hpderiv2D_eq_slice, hcomp_at.deriv, hfderiv_decomp hV hg (hmaps q hq)]
        simp [π₁, π₂, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hvΨ1, hvΨ2]; ring
      have hind : ∀ (N : ℕ) {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g V →
          ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, d 0 + d 1 ≤ N →
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D (fun p => g (Ψ p)) p₀) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d (lineCoreComp2D (taylor2D g (Ψ p₀)) U₁ U₂) := by
        intro N
        induction N with
        | zero =>
            intro g _ d hd
            have hd_zero : d = 0 := (hd_eq_zero_iff d).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
            subst hd_zero
            rw [coeff_taylor2D, coeff_comp2D]
            simp [hIdx_zero, coeff_taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
        | succ N ih =>
            intro g hg d hd
            by_cases hle : d 0 + d 1 ≤ N
            · exact ih hg d hle
            · refine coeff_eq_of_mvDeriv_eq (N := N) (by omega) fun ι d' hd' => ?_
              let gA := iterDerivYT 1 0 g
              let gD := iterDerivYT 0 1 g
              have hgA : DifferentiableOn ℂ gA V := hIter hV hg 1 0
              have hgD : DifferentiableOn ℂ gD V := hIter hV hg 0 1
              have hg_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (Ψ p)) U :=
                hg.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
              have hgA_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => gA (Ψ p)) U :=
                hgA.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
              have hgD_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => gD (Ψ p)) U :=
                hgD.comp hΨ (fun p hp => hmaps p hp)
              have hΨ₁' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι Ψ₁) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hΨ₁ ι
              have hΨ₂' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderiv2D ι Ψ₂) U := hpderiv2D_holo hU hΨ₂ ι
              rw [hmvDeriv_taylor2D hU hp₀ hg_comp ι,
                hCongr hU hp₀ (fun q hq => hp_comp2D hg ι hq),
                hTaylor_add hU hp₀ (hDiff_mul hgA_comp hΨ₁') (hDiff_mul hgD_comp hΨ₂'),
                hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hgA_comp hΨ₁',
                hTaylor_mul hU hp₀ hgD_comp hΨ₂',
                hmvDeriv_comp2D ι _ hU₁_zero hU₂_zero,
                (hDeriv hV (hmaps p₀ hp₀) hg).1,
                (hDeriv hV (hmaps p₀ hp₀) hg).2,
                hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hΨ₁ ι,
                hmvDeriv_centered hU hp₀ hΨ₂ ι,
                map_add, map_add,
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul,
                MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
              congr 1
              · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
                rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
                have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
                have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
                rw [ih hgA r.1 (by omega)]
              · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr => ?_
                rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal] at hr
                have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = d' 0 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 0
                have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = d' 1 := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp hr 1
                rw [ih hgD r.1 (by omega)]
      apply MvPowerSeries.ext; intro d; exact hind (d 0 + d 1) hf₀ d le_rfl
    exact {
      iterDerivYT_holo := hIter
      taylor2D_congr := hCongr
      taylor2D_const := hConst
      centeredTaylor2D_fst := hFst
      centeredTaylor2D_snd := hSnd
      taylor2D_ring := hRing
      deriv_taylor2D := hDeriv
      taylor2D_comp_1D := hComp1D
      taylor2D_comp_2D := hComp2D
    }
  
  have hShift_coeff : ∀ {J : ℕ} (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff n (pointArcPolyShift c) = if h : n < J + 1 then c ⟨n, h⟩ else 0 := by
    intro J c n
    simp only [pointArcPolyShift, map_sum, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow]
    by_cases h : n < J + 1
    · rw [dite_cond_eq_true (eq_true h), Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨n, h⟩]
      · simp
      · intro b _ hb
        have hne : n ≠ (b : ℕ) := fun heq => hb (Fin.ext heq.symm)
        simp [hne]
      · intro hmem; exact False.elim (hmem (Finset.mem_univ _))
    · rw [dite_cond_eq_false (eq_false h)]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro b _
      have hne : n ≠ (b : ℕ) := by have := b.2; omega
      simp [hne]
  have hIterDeriv_add : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      iteratedDeriv (a + b) f = iteratedDeriv a (iteratedDeriv b f) := by
    intro a b f
    induction a with
    | zero => simp
    | succ a ih =>
        rw [Nat.succ_add, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
  have hIterDeriv_holoOn : ∀ {W : Set ℂ} (hW : IsOpen W) {G : ℂ → ℂ}
      (hG : DifferentiableOn ℂ G W) (n : ℕ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (iteratedDeriv n G) W := by
    intro W hW G hG n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using hG
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        exact ih.deriv hW
  
  have hHolo_contDiff : ∀ {H : ℂ → ℂ}, paJetHoloAtZero H → ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiffAt ℂ n H 0 := by
    rintro H ⟨⟨U, hU, h0, hH⟩⟩ n

  have hTay1D_congr_nhds : ∀ {H₁ H₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {z₀ : ℂ},

    intro H₁ H₂ z₀ hev

  have hTay1D_congr : ∀ {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → (0 : ℂ) ∈ U → ∀ {H₁ H₂ : ℂ → ℂ},

      have hT_pow : ∀ {P : (ℂ × ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ},

      have hMv_vanish_pow : ∀ {U : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U = 0 →

          dsimp only [W_i, pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D]
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul, map_sub,
            PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul, map_sub,
            ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hQi_c00]
          simp
        have hWhom := hCompConst2D1D_hom hWi_van
        have hne_star : ℓ_star i ≠ 0 := hℓ_ne p₁ hp₁ i
        have hne_star_sq : (ℓ_star i) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hne_star
        have hS_sq : S_i ^ 2 = Q_i := by
          have hsq_w : (pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p W_i) ^ 2 = 1 + W_i := by
            rw [sq, ← hWhom.2.2.2, ← sq, hPsLaws.2.2.1, hWhom.2.2.1, hWhom.1, hWhom.2.1]
          calc S_i ^ 2
              = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)) *
                  (pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p W_i) ^ 2 := by
                  dsimp only [S_i]; rw [mul_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_pow]
            _ = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)) * (1 + W_i) := by rw [hsq_w]
            _ = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)) +
                  (Q_i - MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C ((ℓ_star i) ^ 2))) *
                  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (((ℓ_star i) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ℓ_star i) ^ 2)) := by
                  dsimp only [W_i, pointArcFormalEdgeRel2D1D]
                  rw [mul_add, mul_one, mul_comm (MvPowerSeries.C _), mul_assoc,
                    ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
            _ = Q_i := by
                  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hne_star_sq, map_one, map_one, mul_one, add_sub_cancel]
        have hS_inv : S_i * I_i = 1 := by
          have hpr_w : pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p W_i *
              pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p W_i = 1 := by
            rw [← hWhom.2.2.2, hPsLaws.2.2.2, hWhom.1]
          calc S_i * I_i
              = MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (ℓ_star i * (ℓ_star i)⁻¹)) *
                  (pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsSqrt1p W_i *
                    pointArcCompConst2D1D pointArcPsInvSqrt1p W_i) := by
                  dsimp only [S_i, I_i, pointArcFormalInvEdgeLen2D1D]
                  rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
            _ = 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hne_star, map_one, map_one, hpr_w, mul_one]
        have hS_c00 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 S_i) = ℓ_star i := by
          dsimp only [S_i]
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
            pointArcCompConst2D1D, hComp2D1D_coeff]
          have h00 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 0 + (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) 1 + 0 + 1 = 1 := rfl
          rw [h00, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_zero, mul_one,
            MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, if_pos rfl,
            PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, hPsLaws.1, mul_one]
        have hprod_zero : (M_i - S_i) * (M_i + S_i) = 0 := by
          calc (M_i - S_i) * (M_i + S_i)
              = M_i ^ 2 - S_i ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm, ← sq_sub_sq]
            _ = Q_i - Q_i := by rw [hM_sq, hS_sq]
            _ = 0 := sub_self Q_i
        have hUnit_sum : IsUnit (M_i + S_i) := by
          rw [@MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) _,
            PowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, isUnit_iff_ne_zero,
            ← MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff,
            map_add, map_add, hM_c00, hS_c00]
          have h2 : ℓ_star i + ℓ_star i = 2 * ℓ_star i := by ring
          rw [h2]
          exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hne_star
        have hMS : M_i = S_i := sub_eq_zero.mp (hUnit_sum.mul_left_eq_zero.mp hprod_zero)
        have hNI : N_i = I_i := by
          calc N_i = N_i * 1 := (mul_one N_i).symm
            _ = N_i * (S_i * I_i) := by rw [← hS_inv]
            _ = (M_i * N_i) * I_i := by rw [← hMS, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm N_i M_i]
            _ = 1 * I_i := by rw [hM_inv]
            _ = I_i := one_mul I_i
        exact ⟨hMS, hNI⟩
      
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · have hcongr : taylor2D
            (fun q => pointArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε => pointRelChainLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε))) p₁ =
            taylor2D
              (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m
                (pointArcPolyLen (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) F g
                  (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q))) p₁ :=
          hLC.taylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q hq =>
            (hEval_poly m hW hF hg hg0 (hℓ_ne q hq) (hx_maps q hq) (hℓ_sq q hq)
              fun s => hβ0 s q).1
        rw [hcongr, ← hT_slice]
        refine congr_arg (pointArcSlice2D1D m) ?_
        dsimp only [pointArcPolyLen, pointArcFormalLen2D1D]
        rw [hT_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))
          (fun i q => PowerSeries.C (ℓ₀ i q) *
            pointArcPolyComp pointArcPsSqrt1p (pointArcPolyEdgeRel (fun j => ℓ₀ j q) F g
              (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) i))
          fun i _ => hph.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hEdge_match i).1
      · intro r
        have hcongr : taylor2D
            (fun q => pointArcEpsJet m
              (fun ε => pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) (pointArcPertGraph F g ε)
                (pointArcPertGraphDeriv F g ε)
                (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) ε) r)) p₁ =
            taylor2D
              (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m
                (pointArcPolyGrad (fun i => ℓ₀ i q) F g
                  (fun r => x₀ r q) (fun l r => β l r q) r)) p₁ :=
          hLC.taylor2D_congr hV hp₁ fun q hq =>
            (hEval_poly m hW hF hg hg0 (hℓ_ne q hq) (hx_maps q hq) (hℓ_sq q hq)
              fun s => hβ0 s q).2 r
        rw [hcongr, ← hT_slice]
        refine congr_arg (pointArcSlice2D1D m) ?_
        let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
        let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
        dsimp only [pointArcPolyGrad, pointArcFormalGrad2D1D, i_L, i_R]
        rw [hT_sub
            (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_add (hph.2.2.1 i_L) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_L) (hph.2.1 i_L.succ)))
              (hph.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i_L))
            (hPsHolo_mul (hPsHolo_add (hph.2.2.1 i_R) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_R) (hph.2.1 i_R.castSucc)))
              (hph.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i_R)),
          hT_mul (hPsHolo_add (hph.2.2.1 i_L) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_L) (hph.2.1 i_L.succ)))
            (hph.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i_L),
          hT_mul (hPsHolo_add (hph.2.2.1 i_R) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_R) (hph.2.1 i_R.castSucc)))
            (hph.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 i_R),
          hT_add (hph.2.2.1 i_L) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_L) (hph.2.1 i_L.succ)),
          hT_add (hph.2.2.1 i_R) (hPsHolo_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_R) (hph.2.1 i_R.castSucc)),
          hT_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_L) (hph.2.1 i_L.succ),
          hT_mul (hph.2.2.2.1 i_R) (hph.2.1 i_R.castSucc),
          hT_dx i_L, hT_dx i_R, hT_dy i_L, hT_dy i_R,
          hT_graphDeriv i_L.succ, hT_graphDeriv i_R.castSucc,
          (hEdge_match i_L).2, (hEdge_match i_R).2]
  }

point_arc_jet_and_taylor_toolkit.definitions:
structure paJetHoloAtZero (H : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  out : ∃ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ (0 : ℂ) ∈ U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ H U

def paJetPsEqUpTo (l : ℕ) (P Q : PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n ≤ l, PowerSeries.coeff n P = PowerSeries.coeff n Q

structure paJetPsHoloOn (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (P : (ℂ × ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ) : Prop where
  out : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m (P q)) V

def paJetVanish2D1D (k : ℕ) (W : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
    PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d W) = 0

noncomputable def paJetT2D1D (p₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (P : (ℂ × ℂ) → PowerSeries ℂ) :
    MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) :=
  pointArcPack2D1D (fun m => taylor2D (fun q => PowerSeries.coeff m (P q)) p₁)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyShift {J : ℕ} (c : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ l : Fin (J + 1), PowerSeries.C (c l) * PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyComp (φ Z : PowerSeries ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.mk fun m =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      PowerSeries.coeff n φ * PowerSeries.coeff m (Z ^ n)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGraph {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D F (x₀ r)) (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l r)) +
    ∑ l : Fin (J + 1),
      PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
        pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g r l) (x₀ r))
          (pointArcPolyShift (fun q => β q r))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGraphDeriv {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k + 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (deriv F) (x₀ r)) (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l r)) +
    ∑ l : Fin (J + 1),
      PowerSeries.X ^ (l : ℕ) *
        pointArcPolyComp (pointArcHoloTaylor1D (deriv (g r l)) (x₀ r))
          (pointArcPolyShift (fun q => β q r))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyDx {k J : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.C (x₀ i.succ - x₀ i.castSucc) +
    (pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l i.succ) - pointArcPolyShift (fun l => β l i.castSucc))

noncomputable def pointArcPolyDy {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  pointArcPolyGraph F g x₀ β i.succ - pointArcPolyGraph F g x₀ β i.castSucc

noncomputable def pointArcPolyEdgeSq {k J : ℕ} (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i) ^ 2 + (pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i) ^ 2

noncomputable def pointArcPolyEdgeRel {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  (pointArcPolyEdgeSq F g x₀ β i - PowerSeries.C ((ℓ₀ i) ^ 2)) *
    PowerSeries.C (((ℓ₀ i) ^ 2)⁻¹)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyLen {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  ∑ i : Fin k,
    PowerSeries.C (ℓ₀ i) *
      pointArcPolyComp pointArcPsSqrt1p (pointArcPolyEdgeRel ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  PowerSeries.C ((ℓ₀ i)⁻¹) *
    pointArcPolyComp pointArcPsInvSqrt1p (pointArcPolyEdgeRel ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i)

noncomputable def pointArcPolyGrad {k J : ℕ} (ℓ₀ : Fin k → ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ) (x₀ : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (β : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (r : Fin (k - 1)) : PowerSeries ℂ :=
  let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
  (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i_L +
      pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i_L * pointArcPolyGraphDeriv F g x₀ β i_L.succ) *
      pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i_L -
    (pointArcPolyDx x₀ β i_R +
      pointArcPolyDy F g x₀ β i_R * pointArcPolyGraphDeriv F g x₀ β i_R.castSucc) *
      pointArcPolyInvEdgeLen ℓ₀ F g x₀ β i_R

proof.tactics:
by
  have hLaws : PointRecPsSqrtLawsProp := hJet.psSqrt1p_laws
  have hSqrt : PointRecSqrtSplitToolkit := by
    clear Ω C B k hk G a₁ δ₁ ha₁ hδ₁ E hAlg hJet hNonAlg
    rcases hLaws with ⟨hS0, hI0, hS_sq, hSI⟩
    let S := pointArcPsSqrt1p
    let I := pointArcPsInvSqrt1p
    have hIS : I * S = 1 := mul_comm S I ▸ hSI
    have hd_pair : PowerSeries.derivative S = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I ∧
        PowerSeries.derivative I = PowerSeries.C (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * I ^ 3 := by
      have hSS : S * S = 1 + PowerSeries.X := by simpa [S, sq] using hS_sq
      have hdSS := congr_arg (fun f : PowerSeries ℂ => PowerSeries.derivative f) hSS
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, map_add, PowerSeries.derivative_one, PowerSeries.derivative_X,
        zero_add] at hdSS
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hdSS
      have hc2 : PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) + PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) = 1 := by
        rw [← map_add]; norm_num
      have hdS : PowerSeries.derivative S = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I := by
        calc PowerSeries.derivative S
            = (PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) + PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)) *
                (I * S) * PowerSeries.derivative S := by
                rw [hc2, hIS, one_mul, one_mul]
          _ = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I *
                (S * PowerSeries.derivative S + S * PowerSeries.derivative S) := by ring
          _ = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I * 1 := by rw [hdSS]
          _ = PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I := mul_one _
      have hdSI : PowerSeries.derivative (S * I) = PowerSeries.derivative (1 : PowerSeries ℂ) :=
        congr_arg (fun f : PowerSeries ℂ => PowerSeries.derivative f) hSI
      rw [Derivation.leibniz, PowerSeries.derivative_one] at hdSI
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hdSI
      have hc_neg : -PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) = PowerSeries.C (-1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
        rw [← map_neg]; norm_num
      have hdI : PowerSeries.derivative I = PowerSeries.C (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * I ^ 3 := by
        calc PowerSeries.derivative I
            = (I * S) * PowerSeries.derivative I := by rw [hIS, one_mul]
          _ = I * (S * PowerSeries.derivative I + I * PowerSeries.derivative S) -
                I ^ 2 * PowerSeries.derivative S := by ring
          _ = I * 0 - I ^ 2 * (PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ) * I) := by rw [hdSI, hdS]
          _ = (-PowerSeries.C (1 / 2 : ℂ)) * I ^ 3 := by ring
          _ = PowerSeries.C (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * I ^ 3 := by rw [hc_neg]
      exact ⟨hdS, hdI⟩
    let VanishesBelow : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) → Prop :=
      fun k Z => ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
        PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Z) = 0
    have hVB_one : ∀ {Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 Z) = 0 → VanishesBelow 1 Z := by
      intro Z hZ0 d m hlt
      have hd0 : d 0 = 0 := by omega
      have hd1 : d 1 = 0 := by omega
      have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      have hd_eq : d = 0 := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact hd0
        · exact hd1
      subst hd_eq hm0
      exact hZ0
    have hVB_mul : ∀ {a b : ℕ} {X Y : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        VanishesBelow a X → VanishesBelow b Y → VanishesBelow (a + b) (X * Y) := by
      intro a b X Y hX hY d m hlt
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro p hp
      have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
      have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro q hq
      have hq_eq : q.1 + q.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
      by_cases h1 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 + q.1 < a
      · rw [hX p.1 q.1 h1, zero_mul]
      · have h2 : p.2 0 + p.2 1 + q.2 < b := by omega
        rw [hY p.2 q.2 h2, mul_zero]
    have hVB_pow : ∀ {Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        VanishesBelow 1 Z → ∀ n : ℕ, VanishesBelow n (Z ^ n) := by
      intro Z hZ n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro d m hlt; omega
      | succ n ih =>
          rw [pow_succ]
          exact hVB_mul ih hZ
    have hmk_const : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) (n : ℕ),
        PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (if l = 0 then φ else 0)) =
          PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ) := by
      intro φ n
      ext l
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hComp_trunc : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) {Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        VanishesBelow 1 Z → ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m M : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m ≤ M →

      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hMod_mul_vanish : ∀ {j : ℕ} (A T : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)),
        VanishesEps j T → ModEq j (A * T) (ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A) * T) := by
      intro j A T hT
      have hA0 : VanishesEps 1 (A - ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A)) := by
        intro l hl
        have hl0 : l = 0 := by omega
        subst hl0; ext d
        rw [map_zero]
        change PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (A - ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A))) = 0
        rw [map_sub, map_sub]
        have h0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A)) =
            PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff d A)) := rfl
        rw [h0, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, sub_self]
      have hprod : VanishesEps (j + 1) ((A - ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A)) * T) := by
        simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 j] using hVE_mul hA0 hT
      have heq : (A - ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A)) * T =
          A * T - ι₀ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 A) * T := sub_mul _ _ _
      rwa [heq] at hprod
    have hSlice_top_extract : ∀ {j : ℕ} {A B : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)}
        {Δ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        ModEq j A (B + X_ε ^ j * ι₀ Δ) →
        pointArcSlice2D1D j A = pointArcSlice2D1D j B + Δ := by
      intro j A B Δ hMod
      ext d
      have hd := congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) (hMod j (Nat.lt_succ_self j))
      rw [map_zero] at hd
      change PowerSeries.coeff j (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (A - (B + X_ε ^ j * ι₀ Δ))) = 0 at hd
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, map_add, map_add] at hd
      rw [map_add]
      change PowerSeries.coeff j (MvPowerSeries.coeff d A) =
        PowerSeries.coeff j (MvPowerSeries.coeff d B) + MvPowerSeries.coeff d Δ
      rw [hd]
      apply congr_arg₂ (· + ·) rfl
      dsimp only [X_ε]
      rw [← map_pow, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
      have h0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (ι₀ Δ) = PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Δ) := rfl
      rw [h0]
      simpa [zero_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C] using
        PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul (PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Δ)) j 0
    let VanishesBelow : ℕ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ) → Prop :=
      fun k Z => ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m < k →
        PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d Z) = 0
    have hVB_of_slice0 : ∀ {Z : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) = 0 → VanishesBelow 1 Z := by
      intro Z hZ0 d m hlt
      have hd_eq : d = 0 := by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp <;> omega
      have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      subst hd_eq hm0
      exact hZ0
    have hVB_mul : ∀ {a b X Y}, VanishesBelow a X → VanishesBelow b Y →
        VanishesBelow (a + b) (X * Y) := by
      intro a b X Y hX hY d m hlt
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro p hp
      have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
      have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro q hq
      have hq_eq : q.1 + q.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
      by_cases h1 : p.1 0 + p.1 1 + q.1 < a
      · rw [hX p.1 q.1 h1, zero_mul]
      · rw [hY p.2 q.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
    have hVB_pow : ∀ {Z}, VanishesBelow 1 Z → ∀ n, VanishesBelow n (Z ^ n) := by
      intro Z hZ n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro d m h; omega
      | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact hVB_mul ih hZ
    have hVB2D_pow : ∀ {U₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 + d 1 < n → MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₀ ^ n) = 0 := by
      intro U₀ hU0 n d hlt
      have hZ0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 (ι₀ U₀)) = 0 := by
        change PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀)) = 0
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, hU0]
      have hZ : VanishesBelow 1 (ι₀ U₀) := hVB_of_slice0 hZ0
      have hpow := hVB_pow hZ n d 0 (by omega)
      rw [← hι_pow] at hpow
      have h0 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (ι₀ (U₀ ^ n)) =
          PowerSeries.C (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (U₀ ^ n)) := rfl
      rw [h0, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl] at hpow
      exact hpow
    have hComp2D1D_trunc : ∀ (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) {Z},
        VanishesBelow 1 Z → ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (m M : ℕ), d 0 + d 1 + m ≤ M →
        PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g_seq Z)) =
          PowerSeries.coeff m (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
              MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) * Z ^ n)) := by
      intro g_seq Z hZ d m M hle
      have hdef : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g_seq Z) =
          PowerSeries.mk (fun m' =>
            PowerSeries.coeff m'
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m' + 1),
                  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq l))) *
                    Z ^ n))) := rfl
      rw [hdef, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_
      intro n _ hndm
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hndm
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro q hq
      have hq_eq : q.1 + q.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
      rw [hVB_pow hZ n d q.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
    have hslice0_comp2D1D : ∀ (g_seq : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ) {Z},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) = 0 →
        pointArcSlice2D1D 0 (pointArcComp2D1D g_seq Z) =
          compPowerSeries2D (g_seq 0) (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) := by
      intro g_seq Z hZ0; ext d
      change PowerSeries.coeff 0 (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g_seq Z)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1),
          PowerSeries.coeff n (g_seq 0) * MvPowerSeries.coeff d ((pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) ^ n)
      rw [hComp2D1D_trunc g_seq (hVB_of_slice0 hZ0) d 0 (d 0 + d 1) (by omega),
        map_sum, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n _
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, map_mul,
        ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, ← hslice0_pow]
      rfl
    have hslice0_compConst : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) {Z},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) = 0 →
        pointArcSlice2D1D 0 (pointArcCompConst2D1D φ Z) =
          compPowerSeries2D φ (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z) := by
      intro φ Z hZ0
      exact hslice0_comp2D1D (fun l => if l = 0 then φ else 0) hZ0
    have hcomp2D_mul : ∀ (A B : PowerSeries ℂ) {U₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 →
        compPowerSeries2D (A * B) U₀ = compPowerSeries2D A U₀ * compPowerSeries2D B U₀ := by
      intro A B U₀ hU0
      ext d
      let N := d 0 + d 1
      have htrunc2D : ∀ (φ : PowerSeries ℂ) (d' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d' 0 + d' 1 ≤ N →
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d' (compPowerSeries2D φ U₀) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d'
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ) * U₀ ^ n) := by
        intro φ d' hd'
        change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d' 0 + d' 1 + 1), _) = _
        rw [map_sum]
        simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)) ?_
        intro n _ hnd'
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hnd'
        rw [hVB2D_pow hU0 n d' (by omega), mul_zero]
      let P : PowerSeries ℂ → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun φ =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n φ) * U₀ ^ n
      have hmul_P : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D A U₀ * compPowerSeries2D B U₀) =
          MvPowerSeries.coeff d (P A * P B) := by
        rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro p hp
        have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = d := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        have hp0 : p.1 0 + p.2 0 = d 0 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
        have hp1 : p.1 1 + p.2 1 = d 1 := by rw [← Finsupp.add_apply, hp_eq]
        rw [htrunc2D A p.1 (by omega), htrunc2D B p.2 (by omega)]
      rw [hmul_P, htrunc2D (A * B) d le_rfl]
      dsimp only [P]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]; simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      have hprod_term : ∀ a b : ℕ,
          (MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff a A) * U₀ ^ a) *
            (MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff b B) * U₀ ^ b) =
          MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff a A * PowerSeries.coeff b B) * U₀ ^ (a + b) := by
        intro a b; rw [pow_add, map_mul]; ring
      simp_rw [hprod_term]; rw [map_sum]; simp_rw [map_sum]
      let term : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun a b =>
        MvPowerSeries.coeff d
          (MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff a A * PowerSeries.coeff b B) * U₀ ^ (a + b))
      symm
      calc (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), term a b)
          = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if n = a + b then term a b else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro b _
            rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
            split_ifs with hmem
            · rfl
            · rw [Finset.mem_range] at hmem
              dsimp only [term]
              rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, hVB2D_pow hU0 (a + b) d (by omega), mul_zero]
        _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
              ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if n = a + b then term a b else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a _; exact Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
              ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if n = a + b then term a b else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), term a (n - a) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n hn
            have hn_le : n ≤ N := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
            have hinner : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
                (∑ b ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), if n = a + b then term a b else 0) =
                  if a ≤ n then term a (n - a) else 0 := by
              intro a _
              split_ifs with han
              · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n - a)]
                · rw [if_pos (by omega)]
                · intro b _ _; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
                · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
              · apply Finset.sum_eq_zero; intro b _; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
            rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner, ← Finset.sum_filter]
            have hfilt : (Finset.range (N + 1)).filter (fun a => a ≤ n) = Finset.range (n + 1) := by
              ext a; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; omega
            rw [hfilt]
        _ = _ := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n _
            rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
              Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
                (fun a b => PowerSeries.coeff a A * PowerSeries.coeff b B) n,
              MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
            have han : a + (n - a) = n := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp ha; omega
            dsimp only [term]; rw [han, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
    have hcomp2D_C : ∀ (c : ℂ) (U₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ),
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.C c) U₀ = MvPowerSeries.C c := by
      intro c U₀; ext d
      change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + 1), _) = _
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
      · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl, pow_zero, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C, MvPowerSeries.coeff_one]
        split_ifs <;> simp
      · intro n _ hn0; rw [PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg hn0, zero_mul]
      · intro h0; exact False.elim (h0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)))
    have hcomp2D_SI : ∀ {U₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ}, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 U₀ = 0 →

      intro U₀ hU0
      rw [← hcomp2D_mul S I hU0, hSI, ← map_one PowerSeries.C, hcomp2D_C, map_one]
    have hMod_comp_trunc_seq : ∀ {j : ℕ} (g₁ g₂ : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
        {Z₁ Z₂ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        (∀ l ≤ j, g₁ l = g₂ l) → ModEq j Z₁ Z₂ →
        ModEq j (pointArcComp2D1D g₁ Z₁) (pointArcComp2D1D g₂ Z₂) := by
      intro j g₁ g₂ Z₁ Z₂ hg hZ
      have hstep1 : ModEq j (pointArcComp2D1D g₁ Z₁) (pointArcComp2D1D g₂ Z₁) := by
        intro l hl
        rw [hSlice_zero_iff]; intro d
        rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        have hd1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g₁ Z₁) =
            PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
              PowerSeries.coeff m
                (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                  (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₁ l'))) *
                      Z₁ ^ n))) := rfl
        have hd2 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g₂ Z₁) =
            PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
              PowerSeries.coeff m
                (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                  (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                    MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l'))) *
                      Z₁ ^ n))) := rfl
        rw [hd1, hd2, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
          map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n _
        rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
          PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro q hq
        have hq_eq : q.1 + q.2 = l := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hg q.1 (by omega)]
      refine hMod_trans hstep1 ?_
      intro l hl
      rw [hSlice_zero_iff]; intro d
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
      have hd1 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g₂ Z₁) =
          PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
            PowerSeries.coeff m
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l'))) *
                    Z₁ ^ n))) := rfl
      have hd2 : MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcComp2D1D g₂ Z₂) =
          PowerSeries.mk (fun m =>
            PowerSeries.coeff m
              (MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + m + 1),
                  MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l'))) *
                    Z₂ ^ n))) := rfl
      rw [hd1, hd2, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      have hpow_Z : ∀ n : ℕ, ModEq j (Z₁ ^ n) (Z₂ ^ n) := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => simpa using hMod_refl j 1
        | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact hMod_mul ih hZ
      have hsum_mod : ModEq j
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + l + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l'))) * Z₁ ^ n)
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (d 0 + d 1 + l + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.mk (fun l' => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l'))) * Z₂ ^ n) :=
        hMod_sum j _ _ _ fun n _ => hMod_mul (hMod_refl j _) (hpow_Z n)
      have hsub := (hSlice_zero_iff l _).mp (hsum_mod l hl) d
      rwa [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hsub
    have hMod_comp_graph_pert : ∀ {J : ℕ} (f_u : ℕ → PowerSeries ℂ)
        {Z₀ : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ)},
        MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z₀) = 0 →
        ModEq (J + 1)
          (pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l ≤ J + 1 then f_u l else 0) Z₀)
          (pointArcComp2D1D (fun l => if l ≤ J then f_u l else 0) Z₀ +
            X_ε ^ (J + 1) * ι₀ (compPowerSeries2D (f_u (J + 1)) (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z₀))) := by
      intro J f_u Z₀ hZ0
      let j := J + 1
      let g₁ := fun l => if l ≤ j then f_u l else 0
      let g₂ := fun l => if l ≤ J then f_u l else 0
      have hmk_split : ∀ n : ℕ,
          PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₁ l)) =
            PowerSeries.mk (fun l => PowerSeries.coeff n (g₂ l)) +
              PowerSeries.X ^ j * PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n (f_u j)) := by
        intro n; ext l
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_add, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        dsimp only [g₁, g₂]
        by_cases hlj : l = j
        · subst hlj
          have hXpow := PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n (f_u j))) j 0
          rw [zero_add, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_pos rfl] at hXpow
          rw [if_pos le_rfl, if_neg (by omega), map_zero, zero_add, hXpow]
        · have hX0 : PowerSeries.coeff l
              (PowerSeries.X ^ j * PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n (f_u j))) = 0 := by
            rw [mul_comm, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_neg hlj]
          rw [hX0, add_zero]
          by_cases hlJ : l ≤ J
          · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos hlJ]
          · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hlJ]
      intro l hl
      rw [hSlice_zero_iff]; intro d
      have hl_le : l ≤ j := by omega
      let M := d 0 + d 1 + j
      have hVB : VanishesBelow 1 Z₀ := hVB_of_slice0 hZ0
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, map_add, map_add,
        hComp2D1D_trunc g₁ hVB d l M (by omega),
        hComp2D1D_trunc g₂ hVB d l M (by omega)]
      simp_rw [hmk_split, map_add, add_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, map_add, map_add]
      apply congr_arg₂ (· + ·) rfl
      have hterm_eq :
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.X ^ j * PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n (f_u j))) *
              Z₀ ^ n) =
          X_ε ^ j * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (M + 1),
            MvPowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.C (PowerSeries.coeff n (f_u j))) * Z₀ ^ n := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n _
        dsimp only [X_ε]
        rw [map_mul, ← map_pow, mul_assoc]
      rw [hterm_eq]
      have hXj_coeff : ∀ W : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) (PowerSeries ℂ),
          PowerSeries.coeff l (MvPowerSeries.coeff d (X_ε ^ j * W)) =
            if l = j then MvPowerSeries.coeff d (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 W) else 0 := by
        intro W
        by_cases hlj : l = j
        · subst hlj
          rw [if_pos rfl]
          dsimp only [X_ε]
          rw [← map_pow, MvPowerSeries.coeff_C_mul]
          have hx := PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul (MvPowerSeries.coeff d W) j 0
          rw [zero_add] at hx
          exact hx
        · rw [if_neg hlj]
          have hve := hVE_mul_any W (hVE_X_pow j) l (by omega)
          exact congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) hve
      rw [hXj_coeff, hXj_coeff]
      split_ifs with hlj
      · have hsl_ι : MvPowerSeries.coeff d
            (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 (ι₀ (compPowerSeries2D (f_u j) (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z₀)))) =
            MvPowerSeries.coeff d (compPowerSeries2D (f_u j) (pointArcSlice2D1D 0 Z₀)) := by
          change PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.C _) = _

              refine L.neg_mem (L.sum_mem fun x _ => ?_)
              exact L.mul_mem (hS_mem (x + 1)) (ih (m - x) (by omega))
    exact ⟨hS_mem, hI_mem⟩

  have hHoloTaylor_deriv : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
      pointArcHoloTaylor1D (deriv g) z₀ =
        PowerSeries.derivative (pointArcHoloTaylor1D g z₀) := by
    intro g z₀
    ext n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
    simp only [pointArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ', Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hn1 : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
    field_simp [hn1]
  have hHoloTaylor_const : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (pointArcHoloTaylor1D g z₀) = g z₀ := by
    intro g z₀
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
    simp [pointArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D]
  have htay_coeff0 : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D f p₀) = f p₀ := by
    intro f p₀
    change taylor2D f p₀ 0 = f p₀
    simp [taylor2D, iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
  have hcent_coeff0 : ∀ (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (centeredTaylor2D ψ p₀) = 0 := by
    intro ψ p₀
    rw [centeredTaylor2D, htay_coeff0, sub_self]

  
  have hDiff_add : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f q + g q) U := fun hf hg => hf.add hg
  have hDiff_sub : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f q - g q) U := fun hf hg => hf.sub hg
  have hDiff_mul : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f q * g q) U := fun hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have hDiff_sq : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (f q) ^ 2) U := fun hf => hf.pow 2
  have hDiff_cube : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (f q) ^ 3) U := fun hf => hf.pow 3

  
  let f₀ : Fin (k + 1) → PowerSeries ℂ := fun r => pointArcHoloTaylor1D G.F (x_star r)
  let β₀ : Fin (k + 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun r => centeredTaylor2D (G.x_fn r) p₁
  have hβ₀_coeff0 : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (β₀ r) = 0 :=
    fun r => hcent_coeff0 (G.x_fn r) p₁
  have hcent_fst : centeredTaylor2D Prod.fst p₁ = MvPowerSeries.X 0 :=
    (hJet.taylor2D_linear_coords p₁).1
  have hcent_snd : centeredTaylor2D Prod.snd p₁ = MvPowerSeries.X 1 :=
    (hJet.taylor2D_linear_coords p₁).2
  have hcent_sum : centeredTaylor2D (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 + q.2) p₁ =
      MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
    change taylor2D (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + q.2) - (p₁.1 + p₁.2)) p₁ = _
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU₀_open hp₁_U₀
      (f₂ := fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 - p₁.1) + (q.2 - p₁.2)) (fun q _ => by ring)]
    rw [(hJet.taylor2D_ring hU₀_open hp₁_U₀
      (hDiff_sub differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (differentiableOn_const _))
      (hDiff_sub differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (differentiableOn_const _))).1]
    exact congr_arg₂ (· + ·) hcent_fst hcent_snd
  have hβ₀_0 : β₀ 0 = MvPowerSeries.X 0 := by
    dsimp only [β₀, centeredTaylor2D]
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU₀_open hp₁_U₀ (f₂ := fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 - p₁.1)
      (fun q hq => by
        simp only [PointGlancingChartData.x_fn, (G.x_endpoints q hq).1,
          (G.x_endpoints p₁ hp₁_U₀).1])]
    exact hcent_fst
  have hβ₀_last : β₀ (Fin.last k) = MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1 := by
    dsimp only [β₀, centeredTaylor2D]
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU₀_open hp₁_U₀
      (f₂ := fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + q.2) - (p₁.1 + p₁.2))
      (fun q hq => by
        simp only [PointGlancingChartData.x_fn, (G.x_endpoints q hq).2,
          (G.x_endpoints p₁ hp₁_U₀).2])]
    exact hcent_sum
  have htay_x : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (G.x_fn r) p₁ = MvPowerSeries.C (x_star r) + β₀ r := by
    intro r
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU₀_open hp₁_U₀
      (f₂ := fun q => x_star r + (G.x_fn r q - x_star r)) (fun q _ => by ring)]
    rw [(hJet.taylor2D_ring hU₀_open hp₁_U₀ (differentiableOn_const _)
      (hDiff_sub (G.x_holo_maps r).1 (differentiableOn_const _))).1,
      hJet.taylor2D_const]
    rfl
  let U_ab : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (fun q_ab : ℂ × ℂ => (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)) ⁻¹' U₀
  have h_unsh_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q_ab : ℂ × ℂ => (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)) :=
    differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.sub differentiable_fst)
  have hU_ab_open : IsOpen U_ab := hU₀_open.preimage h_unsh_diff.continuous
  have h_sh_maps : ∀ q ∈ U₀, (q.1, q.1 + q.2) ∈ U_ab := by
    intro q hq; change (q.1, (q.1 + q.2) - q.1) ∈ U₀; simpa using hq
  have hp_ab_unsh : (p_ab.1, p_ab.2 - p_ab.1) = p₁ := by
    ext <;> simp [p_ab, p₁]
  have hβ₀_mem : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), CoeffsIn F_val (β₀ r) := by
    intro r
    let F_cent : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q_ab =>
      G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1) - G.x_fn r (p_ab.1, p_ab.2 - p_ab.1)
    have hF_cent_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_cent U_ab :=
      hDiff_sub ((G.x_holo_maps r).1.comp h_unsh_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h))
        (differentiableOn_const _)
    have hβ_eq : β₀ r = pointArcComp2D
        (centeredTaylor2D (fun q_ab => G.x_fn r (q_ab.1, q_ab.2 - q_ab.1)) p_ab)
        (MvPowerSeries.X 0) (MvPowerSeries.X 0 + MvPowerSeries.X 1) := by
      dsimp only [β₀, centeredTaylor2D]
      rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU₀_open hp₁_U₀
        (f₂ := fun q => F_cent (q.1, q.1 + q.2))
        (fun q _ => by dsimp [F_cent]; rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hp_ab_unsh])]
      have hc := hJet.taylor2D_comp_2D hU₀_open hU_ab_open hp₁_U₀
        differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
        (hDiff_add differentiable_fst.differentiableOn differentiable_snd.differentiableOn)
        hF_cent_holo h_sh_maps
      rw [hcent_fst, hcent_sum] at hc
      exact hc
    rw [hβ_eq]
    exact hCI_comp2D F_val (E.abscissa_ab_taylor_mem_F_val r)
      (hCI_X F_val 0) (hCI_add F_val (hCI_X F_val 0) (hCI_X F_val 1))

  have hF'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv G.F) G.W_F := G.F_holo.deriv G.W_F_open
  have hF''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv G.F)) G.W_F := hF'_holo.deriv G.W_F_open
  have hx_maps : ∀ q ∈ U₀, ∀ u : Fin (k + 1), G.x_fn u q ∈ G.W_F :=
    fun q hq u => ((G.x_holo_maps u).2 q hq).1
  have htay_F : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn u q)) p₁ = compPowerSeries2D (f₀ u) (β₀ u) :=
    fun u => hJet.taylor2D_comp_1D hU₀_open G.W_F_open hp₁_U₀
      (G.x_holo_maps u).1 G.F_holo (fun q hq => hx_maps q hq u)
  have htay_F' : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => deriv G.F (G.x_fn u q)) p₁ =
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ u)) (β₀ u) := by
    intro u
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_comp_1D hU₀_open G.W_F_open hp₁_U₀
      (G.x_holo_maps u).1 hF'_holo (fun q hq => hx_maps q hq u), hHoloTaylor_deriv]
  have htay_F'' : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => deriv (deriv G.F) (G.x_fn u q)) p₁ =
        compPowerSeries2D (PowerSeries.derivative (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ u))) (β₀ u) := by
    intro u
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_comp_1D hU₀_open G.W_F_open hp₁_U₀
      (G.x_holo_maps u).1 hF''_holo (fun q hq => hx_maps q hq u),
      hHoloTaylor_deriv, hHoloTaylor_deriv]

  
  have hx_holo_ell : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.x_fn u) U_ell :=
    fun u => (G.x_holo_maps u).1.mono hU_ell_sub
  have hFx_holo_ell : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn u q)) U_ell :=
    fun u => G.F_holo.comp (hx_holo_ell u) (fun q hq => hx_maps q (hU_ell_sub hq) u)
  have hF'x_holo_ell : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv G.F (G.x_fn u q)) U_ell :=
    fun u => hF'_holo.comp (hx_holo_ell u) (fun q hq => hx_maps q (hU_ell_sub hq) u)
  have hF''x_holo_ell : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv (deriv G.F) (G.x_fn u q)) U_ell :=
    fun u => hF''_holo.comp (hx_holo_ell u) (fun q hq => hx_maps q (hU_ell_sub hq) u)
  have hℓ_holo_ell : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G.ℓ_fn i) U_ell :=
    fun i => (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).1.mono hU_ell_sub
  have hℓ_inv_holo_ell : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (G.ℓ_fn i q)⁻¹) U_ell :=
    fun i => (hℓ_holo_ell i).inv (fun q hq => hℓ_ne_on q hq i)
  have htay_add_ell : ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U_ell → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_ell →
      taylor2D (fun q => f q + g q) p₁ = taylor2D f p₁ + taylor2D g p₁ :=
    fun hf hg => (hJet.taylor2D_ring hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell hf hg).1
  have htay_sub_ell : ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U_ell → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_ell →
      taylor2D (fun q => f q - g q) p₁ = taylor2D f p₁ - taylor2D g p₁ :=
    fun hf hg => (hJet.taylor2D_ring hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell hf hg).2.1
  have htay_mul_ell : ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U_ell → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_ell →
      taylor2D (fun q => f q * g q) p₁ = taylor2D f p₁ * taylor2D g p₁ :=
    fun hf hg => (hJet.taylor2D_ring hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell hf hg).2.2
  have htay_sq_ell : ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U_ell →
      taylor2D (fun q => (f q) ^ 2) p₁ = (taylor2D f p₁) ^ 2 := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell (f₂ := fun q => f q * f q)
      (fun q _ => sq (f q)), htay_mul_ell hf hf, ← sq]
  have htay_cube_ell : ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U_ell →
      taylor2D (fun q => (f q) ^ 3) p₁ = (taylor2D f p₁) ^ 3 := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell (f₂ := fun q => (f q) ^ 2 * f q)
      (fun q _ => pow_succ (f q) 2), htay_mul_ell (hDiff_sq hf) hf, htay_sq_ell hf, ← pow_succ]
  have htay_Dx : ∀ i : Fin k,
      taylor2D (fun q => G.x_fn i.succ q - G.x_fn i.castSucc q) p₁ =
        pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i := by
    intro i
    rw [htay_sub_ell (hx_holo_ell i.succ) (hx_holo_ell i.castSucc),
      htay_x i.succ, htay_x i.castSucc]
    dsimp only [pointRecDx0]
    rw [map_sub]
    ring
  have htay_Dy : ∀ i : Fin k,
      taylor2D (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn i.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc q)) p₁ =
        pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i := by
    intro i
    rw [htay_sub_ell (hFx_holo_ell i.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i.castSucc),
      htay_F i.succ, htay_F i.castSucc]
    rfl

  let L_tay : Fin k → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ := fun i => taylor2D (G.ℓ_fn i) p₁
  let L_inv_tay : Fin k → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun i => taylor2D (fun q => (G.ℓ_fn i q)⁻¹) p₁
  have hL_tay_sq : ∀ i : Fin k, (L_tay i) ^ 2 = pointRecEdgeSq0 x_star f₀ β₀ i := by
    intro i
    rw [← htay_sq_ell (hℓ_holo_ell i),
      hJet.taylor2D_congr hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell
        (f₂ := fun q => (G.x_fn i.succ q - G.x_fn i.castSucc q) ^ 2 +
          (G.F (G.x_fn i.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i.castSucc q)) ^ 2)
        (fun q hq => (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).2 q (hU_ell_sub hq)),
      htay_add_ell (hDiff_sq (hDiff_sub (hx_holo_ell i.succ) (hx_holo_ell i.castSucc)))
        (hDiff_sq (hDiff_sub (hFx_holo_ell i.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i.castSucc))),
      htay_sq_ell (hDiff_sub (hx_holo_ell i.succ) (hx_holo_ell i.castSucc)),
      htay_sq_ell (hDiff_sub (hFx_holo_ell i.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i.castSucc)),
      htay_Dx i, htay_Dy i]
    rfl
  have hL_inv_mul : ∀ i : Fin k, L_inv_tay i * L_tay i = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [← htay_mul_ell (hℓ_inv_holo_ell i) (hℓ_holo_ell i),
      hJet.taylor2D_congr hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell (f₂ := fun _ => (1 : ℂ))
        (fun q hq => inv_mul_cancel₀ (hℓ_ne_on q hq i)),
      hJet.taylor2D_const, map_one]
  have hL_tay_c0 : ∀ i : Fin k, MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (L_tay i) = ℓ_star i :=
    fun i => htay_coeff0 (G.ℓ_fn i) p₁
  have hL_tay_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, L_tay i = pointRecLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i := by
    intro i
    exact (hSqrt.unit_sqrt_2D (ℓ_star i) (pointRecEdgeSq0 x_star f₀ β₀ i)
      (L_tay i) (L_inv_tay i) (hℓ_star_ne i) (hL_tay_sq i) (hL_inv_mul i) (hL_tay_c0 i)).2.1
  have hL_inv_tay_eq : ∀ i : Fin k, L_inv_tay i = pointRecInvLen0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i := by
    intro i
    exact (hSqrt.unit_sqrt_2D (ℓ_star i) (pointRecEdgeSq0 x_star f₀ β₀ i)
      (L_tay i) (L_inv_tay i) (hℓ_star_ne i) (hL_tay_sq i) (hL_inv_mul i) (hL_tay_c0 i)).2.2

  
  have hf₀_mem : ∀ (u : Fin (k + 1)) (n : ℕ), PowerSeries.coeff n (f₀ u) ∈ F_val := by
    intro u n
    simp only [f₀, pointArcHoloTaylor1D, holoTaylor1D, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact F_val.div_mem (E.graph_jets_mem_F_val u n) (hNat_mem F_val n.factorial)
  have hf₀'_mem : ∀ (u : Fin (k + 1)) (n : ℕ),
      PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.derivative (f₀ u)) ∈ F_val := by
    intro u n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative]
    exact F_val.mul_mem (hf₀_mem u (n + 1))
      (F_val.add_mem (hNat_mem F_val n) F_val.one_mem)
  have hDx0_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (pointRecDx0 x_star β₀ i) := by
    intro i
    exact hCI_add F_val
      (hCI_C F_val (F_val.sub_mem (E.abscissa_mem_F_val i.succ) (E.abscissa_mem_F_val i.castSucc)))
      (hCI_sub F_val (hβ₀_mem i.succ) (hβ₀_mem i.castSucc))
  have hDy0_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (pointRecDy0 f₀ β₀ i) := by
    intro i
    exact hCI_sub F_val
      (hCI_comp1D F_val (hf₀_mem i.succ) (hβ₀_mem i.succ))
      (hCI_comp1D F_val (hf₀_mem i.castSucc) (hβ₀_mem i.castSucc))
  have hEdgeSq0_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (pointRecEdgeSq0 x_star f₀ β₀ i) :=
    fun i => hCI_add F_val (hCI_pow F_val 2 (hDx0_mem i)) (hCI_pow F_val 2 (hDy0_mem i))
  have hEdgeRel0_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (pointRecEdgeRel0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ i) := by
    intro i
    exact hCI_mul F_val
      (hCI_sub F_val (hEdgeSq0_mem i)
        (hCI_C F_val (F_val.pow_mem (E.chord_len_mem_F_val i) 2)))
      (hCI_C F_val (F_val.inv_mem (F_val.pow_mem (E.chord_len_mem_F_val i) 2)))
  have hL_tay_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (L_tay i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hL_tay_eq i]
    exact hCI_mul F_val (hCI_C F_val (E.chord_len_mem_F_val i))
      (hCI_comp1D F_val (hPsSqrt_mem F_val).1 (hEdgeRel0_mem i))
  have hL_inv_tay_mem : ∀ i : Fin k, CoeffsIn F_val (L_inv_tay i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hL_inv_tay_eq i]
    exact hCI_mul F_val (hCI_C F_val (F_val.inv_mem (E.chord_len_mem_F_val i)))
      (hCI_comp1D F_val (hPsSqrt_mem F_val).2 (hEdgeRel0_mem i))

  
  have hRelEdgeLen_eq : ∀ q ∈ U_ell, ∀ i : Fin k,
      pointRelEdgeLen (fun j => G.ℓ_fn j q) (fun _ => G.F) (fun s => G.x_fn s q) i =
        G.ℓ_fn i q := by
    intro q hq i
    dsimp only [pointRelEdgeLen]
    rw [← (G.ℓ_holo_sq i).2 q (hU_ell_sub hq), sub_self, zero_div]
    simp [sqrt1p]
  have htay_w_web : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (G.w_web r) p₁ =
        if h : r.1 < k - 1 then pointRecWeight0 ℓ_star x_star f₀ β₀ ⟨r.1, h⟩ else -1 := by
    intro r
    by_cases hr : r.1 < k - 1
    · rw [dif_pos hr]
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by omega⟩
      have hw_eq : ∀ q ∈ U_ell, G.w_web r q =
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_L.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q)) * (G.ℓ_fn i_L q)⁻¹ -
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_R.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q)) * (G.ℓ_fn i_R q)⁻¹ := by
        intro q _
        dsimp only [PointGlancingChartData.w_web, pointChartWWeb, PointGlancingChartData.x_fn,
          i_L, i_R]
        rw [dif_pos hr, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
        rfl
      rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hU_ell_open hp₁_U_ell hw_eq,
        htay_sub_ell
          (hDiff_mul (hDiff_sub (hFx_holo_ell i_L.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i_L.castSucc))
            (hℓ_inv_holo_ell i_L))
          (hDiff_mul (hDiff_sub (hFx_holo_ell i_R.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i_R.castSucc))
            (hℓ_inv_holo_ell i_R)),
        htay_mul_ell (hDiff_sub (hFx_holo_ell i_L.succ) (hFx_holo_ell i_L.castSucc))
          (hℓ_inv_holo_ell i_L),

                (hDiff_sq (hℓ_holo_ell i_L)))
              (hDiff_mul (hn_holo i_L i_L.succ) (hn_holo i_L i_L.castSucc))

            htay_add_ell

                (hDiff_sq (hℓ_holo_ell i_L)))
              (hDiff_mul (hn_holo i_L i_L.succ) (hn_holo i_L i_L.castSucc)),

      | cons a s ha ih =>

          refine ⟨hCI_add F_val (hL_tay_mem a) ih.1, ?_⟩

  have hFormalGrad_zero : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      pointArcFormalGrad2D1D ℓ_star x_star f_full β_full r = 0 := by
    intro r
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    have hterm_mem : ∀ (i : Fin k) (u : Fin (k + 1)),
        CoeffsIn F_val

    have hterm_lift : ∀ (i : Fin k) (u : Fin (k + 1)),
