  have hdet_ne' : ∀ q ∈ V_plus', (H_pt q).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun q hq => S.hess_det_ne_zero q (hV'_sub_S hq)

  have hH_pt_holo : ∀ r s : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => H_pt q r s) V_plus' := by
    intro r s
    have hF'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv G.F) G.W_F := G.F_holo.deriv G.W_F_open
    have hF''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv G.F)) G.W_F := hF'_holo.deriv G.W_F_open
    have hx_maps_WF : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1), Set.MapsTo (G.x_fn u) V_plus' G.W_F :=
      fun u _ hq => ((G.x_holo_maps u).2 _ (hV'_sub_U₀ hq)).1
    have hFx : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn u q)) V_plus' :=
      fun u => G.F_holo.comp (hx_holo' u) (hx_maps_WF u)
    have hF'x : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv G.F (G.x_fn u q)) V_plus' :=
      fun u => hF'_holo.comp (hx_holo' u) (hx_maps_WF u)
    have hF''x : ∀ u : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => deriv (deriv G.F) (G.x_fn u q)) V_plus' :=
      fun u => hF''_holo.comp (hx_holo' u) (hx_maps_WF u)
    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    have hdiv3 : ∀ {num : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (i : Fin k),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ num V_plus' →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => num q / (G.ℓ_fn i q) ^ 3) V_plus' := by
      intro num i hnum
      have hinv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ((G.ℓ_fn i q) ^ 3)⁻¹) V_plus' :=
        ((hℓ_holo' i).pow 3).inv (fun q hq => pow_ne_zero 3 (hℓ_ne' q hq i))
      exact (hnum.mul hinv).congr (fun q _ => div_eq_mul_inv (num q) ((G.ℓ_fn i q) ^ 3))
    have hΔx_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G.x_fn i_L.succ q - G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q) V_plus' :=
      (hx_holo' i_L.succ).sub (hx_holo' i_L.castSucc)
    have hΔY_L : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn i_L.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q)) V_plus' :=
      (hFx i_L.succ).sub (hFx i_L.castSucc)
    have hn_L_succ : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => (G.x_fn i_L.succ q - G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q) +
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_L.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q)) *
            deriv G.F (G.x_fn i_L.succ q)) V_plus' :=
      hΔx_L.add (hΔY_L.mul (hF'x i_L.succ))
    have hn_L_cast : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => (G.x_fn i_L.succ q - G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q) +
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_L.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q)) *
            deriv G.F (G.x_fn i_L.castSucc q)) V_plus' :=
      hΔx_L.add (hΔY_L.mul (hF'x i_L.castSucc))
    have hΔx_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => G.x_fn i_R.succ q - G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q) V_plus' :=
      (hx_holo' i_R.succ).sub (hx_holo' i_R.castSucc)
    have hΔY_R : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => G.F (G.x_fn i_R.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q)) V_plus' :=
      (hFx i_R.succ).sub (hFx i_R.castSucc)
    have hn_R_cast : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => (G.x_fn i_R.succ q - G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q) +
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_R.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q)) *
            deriv G.F (G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q)) V_plus' :=
      hΔx_R.add (hΔY_R.mul (hF'x i_R.castSucc))
    have hn_R_succ : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => (G.x_fn i_R.succ q - G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q) +
          (G.F (G.x_fn i_R.succ q) - G.F (G.x_fn i_R.castSucc q)) *
            deriv G.F (G.x_fn i_R.succ q)) V_plus' :=
      hΔx_R.add (hΔY_R.mul (hF'x i_R.succ))
    dsimp only [H_pt, pointInteriorHess]
    split_ifs
    · refine DifferentiableOn.add (hdiv3 i_L ?_) (hdiv3 i_R ?_)
      · exact ((((differentiableOn_const 1).add ((hF'x i_L.succ).pow 2)).add
          (hΔY_L.mul (hF''x i_L.succ))).mul ((hℓ_holo' i_L).pow 2)).sub (hn_L_succ.pow 2)
      · exact ((((differentiableOn_const 1).add ((hF'x i_R.castSucc).pow 2)).sub
          (hΔY_R.mul (hF''x i_R.castSucc))).mul ((hℓ_holo' i_R).pow 2)).sub (hn_R_cast.pow 2)
    · refine hdiv3 i_R ?_
      exact (((differentiableOn_const (-1)).sub ((hF'x i_R.succ).mul (hF'x i_R.castSucc))).mul
        ((hℓ_holo' i_R).pow 2)).add (hn_R_cast.mul hn_R_succ)
    · refine hdiv3 i_L ?_
      exact (((differentiableOn_const (-1)).sub ((hF'x i_L.castSucc).mul (hF'x i_L.succ))).mul
        ((hℓ_holo' i_L).pow 2)).add (hn_L_succ.mul hn_L_cast)
    · exact differentiableOn_const 0

  let R_grad : ℂ × ℂ → Fin (k - 1) → ℂ := fun q r =>
    pointArcEpsJet (J + 1)
      (fun ε =>
        pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q)
          (pointArcPertGraph G.F g' ε)
          (pointArcPertGraphDeriv G.F g' ε)
          (pointArcPertAbscissa (fun s => G.x_fn s q) (fun m s => β_zero_top m s q) ε) r)

  have hR_grad_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => R_grad q r) V_plus' :=
    (hJet.epsJet_holo (ℓ₀ := G.ℓ_fn) (x₀ := G.x_fn) (β := β_zero_top) (J + 1)
      hW'_open hV'_open (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF) hg'_holo hg'0
      hℓ_holo' hℓ_ne' hx_holo' hx_maps_W' hℓ_sq' hβ_zt_holo hβ_zt_0).2

  let β_form_int : Fin (k - 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun s => D_form.β_full (J + 1) ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩

  have hformal_hess : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_pt q r s) p₁ * β_form_int s = 0 := by
    intro r
    have ht := (hJet.taylor2D_epsJet_eq (ℓ₀ := G.ℓ_fn) (x₀ := G.x_fn) (β := β_zero_top) (J + 1)
      hW'_open hV'_open hp₁_Vp' (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF) hg'_holo hg'0
      hℓ_holo' hℓ_ne' hx_holo' hx_maps_W' hℓ_sq' hβ_zt_holo hβ_zt_0).2 r
    have hf_seq_eq :
        (fun (u : Fin (k + 1)) (l : ℕ) =>
          if l = 0 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D G.F (G.x_fn u p₁)
          else if hl : l < J + 1 + 1 then pointArcHoloTaylor1D (g' u ⟨l, hl⟩) (G.x_fn u p₁)
          else 0) =
        pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) D_form.f_full := by
      funext u l
      dsimp only [pointArcTruncGraph]
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simpa using (D_form.f_zero u).symm
      · by_cases hlJ1 : l ≤ J + 1
        · have hlJ2 : l < J + 1 + 1 := by omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hlJ2, ↓reduceDIte, hlJ1]
          exact hg'_taylor u ⟨l, hlJ2⟩ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hl0)
        · have hlJ2 : ¬ l < J + 1 + 1 := by omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hlJ2, ↓reduceDIte, hlJ1]
    have hβ_seq_eq :
        (fun (l : ℕ) (u : Fin (k + 1)) =>
          if l = 0 then centeredTaylor2D (G.x_fn u) p₁
          else if hl : l < J + 1 + 1 then taylor2D (β_zero_top ⟨l, hl⟩ u) p₁
          else 0) =
        pointArcTruncBeta J D_form.β_full := by
      funext l u
      dsimp only [pointArcTruncBeta]
      by_cases hl0 : l = 0
      · subst hl0
        simpa using (D_form.β_zero u).symm
      · by_cases hlJ : l ≤ J
        · have hlJ1 : l < J + 1 := by omega
          have hlJ2 : l < J + 1 + 1 := by omega
          simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hlJ2, ↓reduceDIte, hlJ]
          have hcast : (⟨l, hlJ2⟩ : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) =
              (⟨l, hlJ1⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc := by
            ext; rfl
          have hzt : β_zero_top (⟨l, hlJ1⟩ : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc = S.β ⟨l, hlJ1⟩ :=
            Fin.snoc_castSucc (α := fun _ => Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
              (fun _ _ => 0) S.β ⟨l, hlJ1⟩
          rw [hcast, hzt]
          exact S.β_taylor ⟨l, hlJ1⟩ u (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hl0)
        · by_cases hlJ2 : l < J + 1 + 1
          · simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hlJ2, ↓reduceDIte, hlJ]
            have hlast : (⟨l, hlJ2⟩ : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = Fin.last (J + 1) := by
              ext; dsimp [Fin.val_last]; omega
            rw [hlast]
            have hzt : β_zero_top (Fin.last (J + 1)) u = fun _ => 0 := by
              simp [β_zero_top, Fin.snoc_last]
            rw [hzt, hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
          · simp only [hl0, ↓reduceIte, hlJ2, ↓reduceDIte, hlJ]
    have hR_tay : taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ =
        pointArcSlice2D1D (J + 1)
          (pointArcFormalGrad2D1D
            (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i p₁)
            (fun u => G.x_fn u p₁)
            (pointArcTruncGraph (J + 1) D_form.f_full)
            (pointArcTruncBeta J D_form.β_full) r) := by
      simpa only [R_grad, hf_seq_eq, hβ_seq_eq] using ht
    rw [hR_tay]
    exact D_form.formal_hess_step J r

  
  have hprod_holo : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ a ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∏ a ∈ s, f a q) V_plus' := by
    intro α s f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus' := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∏ b ∈ s, f b q) V_plus' :=
          ih (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
        exact (h1.mul h2).congr (fun q _ => Finset.prod_insert ha)

  have hsum_holo : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ a ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ a ∈ s, f a q) V_plus' := by
    intro α s f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus' := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ b ∈ s, f b q) V_plus' :=
          ih (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
        exact (h1.add h2).congr (fun q _ => Finset.sum_insert ha)

  have hdet_holo : ∀ (M : ℂ × ℂ → Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ),
      (∀ i j : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => M q i j) V_plus') →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (M q).det) V_plus' := by
    intro M hM
    have hfun : (fun q => (M q).det) = fun q =>
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (k - 1)),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin (k - 1), M q (σ i) i := by
      ext q
      simp only [Matrix.det_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    exact hsum_holo Finset.univ
      (fun σ q => ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin (k - 1), M q (σ i) i)
      fun σ _ =>
        (differentiableOn_const _).mul
          (hprod_holo Finset.univ (fun i q => M q (σ i) i) fun i _ => hM (σ i) i)

  let β_int : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun u q => -((H_pt q).det)⁻¹ * ((H_pt q).cramer (R_grad q)) u

  have hβ_int_holo : ∀ u : Fin (k - 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β_int u) V_plus' := by
    intro u
    have hinv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => -((H_pt q).det)⁻¹) V_plus' :=
      ((hdet_holo H_pt hH_pt_holo).inv hdet_ne').neg
    have hcram : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ((H_pt q).cramer (R_grad q)) u) V_plus' := by
      have hfn : (fun q => ((H_pt q).cramer (R_grad q)) u) =
          fun q => ((H_pt q).updateCol u (R_grad q)).det := by
        ext q
        exact Matrix.cramer_apply (H_pt q) (R_grad q) u
      rw [hfn]
      refine hdet_holo (fun q => (H_pt q).updateCol u (R_grad q)) fun i j => ?_
      by_cases hju : j = u
      · subst hju
        simpa [Matrix.updateCol_apply] using hR_grad_holo i
      · simpa [Matrix.updateCol_apply, hju] using hH_pt_holo i j
    exact hinv.mul hcram

  have hβ_int_solve : ∀ q ∈ V_plus', ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      R_grad q r + ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_int s q = 0 := by
    intro q hq r
    have hmv : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_int s q) =
        ((H_pt q).mulVec ((-(H_pt q).det⁻¹) • (H_pt q).cramer (R_grad q))) r := by
      rfl
    rw [hmv, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_cramer]
    dsimp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdet : (H_pt q).det ≠ 0 := hdet_ne' q hq
    calc R_grad q r + -(H_pt q).det⁻¹ * ((H_pt q).det * R_grad q r)
        = R_grad q r - ((H_pt q).det⁻¹ * (H_pt q).det) * R_grad q r := by ring
      _ = R_grad q r - 1 * R_grad q r := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet]
      _ = 0 := by ring

  have htaylor2D_sum : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ a ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus') →
      taylor2D (fun q => ∑ a ∈ s, f a q) p₁ = ∑ a ∈ s, taylor2D (f a) p₁ := by
    intro α s f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
        rw [hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
        have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f a) V_plus' := hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
        have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ b ∈ s, f b q) V_plus' :=
          hsum_holo s f (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
        have hfn : (fun q => ∑ b ∈ insert a s, f b q) =
            fun q => f a q + ∑ b ∈ s, f b q := by
          ext q; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
        rw [hfn, (hJet.taylor2D_ring hV'_open hp₁_Vp' h1 h2).1,
          ih (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb)), Finset.sum_insert ha]

  have hβ_int_ps_eq : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
      taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r) p₁ +
        ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_pt q r s) p₁ * taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ = 0 := by
    intro r
    have hzero : taylor2D (fun q => R_grad q r + ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_int s q) p₁ =
        0 := by
      rw [hJet.taylor2D_congr hV'_open hp₁_Vp' (fun q hq => hβ_int_solve q hq r),
        hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
    have hsum_h : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_int s q) V_plus' :=
      hsum_holo Finset.univ (fun s => fun q => H_pt q r s * β_int s q)
        (fun s _ => (hH_pt_holo r s).mul (hβ_int_holo s))
    rw [(hJet.taylor2D_ring hV'_open hp₁_Vp' (hR_grad_holo r) hsum_h).1,
      htaylor2D_sum Finset.univ (fun s => fun q => H_pt q r s * β_int s q)
        (fun s _ => (hH_pt_holo r s).mul (hβ_int_holo s))] at hzero
    have hmul_eq :
        (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_pt q r s * β_int s q) p₁) =
          ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (fun q => H_pt q r s) p₁ * taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ =>
        (hJet.taylor2D_ring hV'_open hp₁_Vp' (hH_pt_holo r s) (hβ_int_holo s)).2.2
    rwa [hmul_eq] at hzero

  let M_ps : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ) :=
    fun r s => taylor2D (fun q => H_pt q r s) p₁
  let Δ_ps : Fin (k - 1) → MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ :=
    fun s => taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ - β_form_int s

  have hM_Δ : M_ps.mulVec Δ_ps = 0 := by
    funext r
    change (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), M_ps r s * (taylor2D (β_int s) p₁ - β_form_int s)) = 0
    simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    linear_combination (hβ_int_ps_eq r) - (hformal_hess r)

  have hadj_zero : M_ps.det • Δ_ps = 0 := by
    calc M_ps.det • Δ_ps
        = (M_ps.det •
            (1 : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) (MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) ℂ))).mulVec Δ_ps := by
            rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      _ = (M_ps.adjugate * M_ps).mulVec Δ_ps := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul]
      _ = M_ps.adjugate.mulVec (M_ps.mulVec Δ_ps) := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      _ = M_ps.adjugate.mulVec 0 := by rw [hM_Δ]
      _ = 0 := Matrix.mulVec_zero _

  have hdet_ps_unit : IsUnit M_ps.det := by
    rw [MvPowerSeries.isUnit_iff_constantCoeff, RingHom.map_det]
    have hmap_eq : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff.mapMatrix M_ps = H_pt p₁ := by
      ext r s
      rw [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply]
      change iterDerivYT 0 0 (fun q => H_pt q r s) p₁ /
          (((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) * ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ)) = H_pt p₁ r s
      simp [iterDerivYT, iterDerivY]
    rw [hmap_eq]
    exact (hdet_ne' p₁ hp₁_Vp').isUnit

  have hβ_int_taylor : ∀ u : Fin (k - 1), taylor2D (β_int u) p₁ = β_form_int u := by
    intro u
    have hmul0 : M_ps.det * Δ_ps u = 0 := congr_fun hadj_zero u
    rw [mul_comm] at hmul0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hdet_ps_unit.mul_left_eq_zero.mp hmul0)

  
  let β_top : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun s =>
    if h : 0 < s.1 ∧ s.1 < k then β_int ⟨s.1 - 1, by omega⟩ else fun _ => 0
  let β' : Fin (J + 1 + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := Fin.snoc S.β β_top

  have hβ_top_holo : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (β_top r) V_plus' := by
    intro r
    dsimp only [β_top]
    split_ifs
    · exact hβ_int_holo _
    · exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have hβ_top_end : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, β_top 0 q = 0 ∧ β_top (Fin.last k) q = 0 := by
    intro q
    dsimp only [β_top, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_last]
    constructor <;> (split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega)
  have hβ_top_int : ∀ (u : Fin (k - 1)) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      β_top ⟨u.1 + 1, by have := u.2; omega⟩ q = β_int u q := by
    intro u q
    have hu : 0 < u.1 + 1 ∧ u.1 + 1 < k := by have := u.2; omega
    simp only [β_top, hu.1, hu.2, and_self, ↓reduceDIte]
    congr 2
  have hβ_top_taylor : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
      taylor2D (β_top r) p₁ = D_form.β_full (J + 1) r := by
    intro r
    dsimp only [β_top]
    split_ifs with hr
    · rw [hβ_int_taylor ⟨r.1 - 1, by omega⟩]
      dsimp only [β_form_int]
      congr 1
      ext
      dsimp only
      omega
    · rw [hJet.taylor2D_const p₁ 0, map_zero]
      by_cases hr0 : r.1 = 0
      · have hr_eq : r = 0 := Fin.ext hr0
        rw [hr_eq, (D_form.β_endpoints (J + 1) (by omega)).1]
      · have hrk : r.1 = k := by have := r.2; omega
        have hr_eq : r = Fin.last k := Fin.ext hrk
        rw [hr_eq, (D_form.β_endpoints (J + 1) (by omega)).2]

  refine ⟨{
    W_ψ := W_ψ'
    V_plus := V_plus'
    g := g'
    U_split := U_split'
    V_split := V_split'
    β := β'
    W_ψ_open := hW'_open
    W_ψ_preconn := hW'_preconn
    W_ψ_sub_W_F := hW'_sub_WF
    real_mem_W_ψ := hW'_real
    V_plus_open := hV'_open
    V_plus_preconn := hV'_preconn
    V_plus_sub := hV'_sub_U₀
    trapezoid_mem_V_plus := hV'_trap
    ψ_maps_W_ψ := hψ_maps_W'
    chord_ne_zero := hℓ_ne'
    hess_det_ne_zero := hdet_ne'
    g_holo := hg'_holo
    g_endpoints := hg'_endpoints
    g_lt_p := hg'_lt_p
    g_taylor := hg'_taylor
    UV_holo := hUV'_holo
    UV_lt_p := hUV'_lt_p
    UV_taylor := hUV'_taylor
    β_holo := by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_
      · intro r
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_last] using hβ_top_holo r
      · intro m r
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc] using (S.β_holo m r).mono hV'_sub_S
    β_zero := by
      intro r q
      have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = (0 : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc := rfl
      rw [h0_eq]
      simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc] using S.β_zero r q
    β_endpoints := by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_
      · intro q
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_last] using hβ_top_end q
      · intro m q
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc] using S.β_endpoints m q
    β_taylor := by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_
      · intro r _
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_last, Fin.val_last] using hβ_top_taylor r
      · intro m r hm
        simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc] using
          S.β_taylor m r (by simpa using hm)
    grad_jet_zero := by
      intro q hq r l hl1 hlJ1
      have hβ'_pt : (fun m s => β' m s q) =
          Fin.snoc (fun m s => S.β m s q) (fun s => β_top s q) := by
        funext m s
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m <;> simp [β', Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      have hβ_zt_pt : (fun m s => β_zero_top m s q) =
          Fin.snoc (fun m s => S.β m s q) (fun _ => 0) := by
        funext m s
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m <;> simp [β_zero_top, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      by_cases hlJ : l ≤ J
      · have htrunc :=
          (hJet.epsJet_trunc_eq
            (ℓ₀ := fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (x₀ := fun s => G.x_fn s q)
            (β₁ := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β₂ := fun m s => β' m s q)
            (Nat.le_succ J) hl1 hlJ hW'_open (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF)
            (fun u m => (S.g_holo u m).mono hW'_sub_S) hg'_holo hg0_S hg'0
            (fun u m z _ => by
              change g' u m.castSucc z = S.g u m z
              simp [g', Fin.snoc_castSucc])
            (hℓ_ne' q hq) (hx_maps_W' q hq) (hℓ_sq' q hq)
            (fun s => S.β_zero s q)
            (fun s => by
              have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = (0 : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc := rfl
              rw [h0_eq]
              simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc] using S.β_zero s q)
            (fun m s => by
              change β' m.castSucc s q = S.β m s q
              simp [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc])).2 r
        rw [htrunc]
        exact S.grad_jet_zero q (hV'_sub_S hq) r l hl1 hlJ
      · obtain rfl : l = J + 1 := by omega
        have hsplit :=
          (hJet.epsJet_succ_split
            (ℓ₀ := fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (x₀ := fun s => G.x_fn s q)
            (β := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β_top := fun s => β_top s q)
            hk hW'_open (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF)
            (fun u m => (S.g_holo u m).mono hW'_sub_S)
            (fun u => (hg_top_holo u).mono hW'_sub_new)
            hg0_S hg_top_end (hℓ_ne' q hq) (hx_maps_W' q hq) (hℓ_sq' q hq)
            (fun s => S.β_zero s q) (hβ_top_end q)).2 r
        rw [hβ'_pt, hsplit, ← hβ_zt_pt]
        have hsum_eq :
            (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ q) =
              ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_int s q :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => by rw [hβ_top_int s q]
        change R_grad q r +
            ∑ s : Fin (k - 1), H_pt q r s * β_top ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩ q = 0
        rw [hsum_eq]
        exact hβ_int_solve q hq r
    len_jet_split := by
      intro q hq
      have hβ'_pt : (fun m s => β' m s q) =
          Fin.snoc (fun m s => S.β m s q) (fun s => β_top s q) := by
        funext m s
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ m <;> simp [β', Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_
      · intro _
        have hsplit :=
          (hJet.epsJet_succ_split
            (ℓ₀ := fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (x₀ := fun s => G.x_fn s q)
            (β := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β_top := fun s => β_top s q)
            hk hW'_open (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF)
            (fun u m => (S.g_holo u m).mono hW'_sub_S)
            (fun u => (hg_top_holo u).mono hW'_sub_new)
            hg0_S hg_top_end (hℓ_ne' q hq) (hx_maps_W' q hq) (hℓ_sq' q hq)
            (fun s => S.β_zero s q) (hβ_top_end q)).1
        simp only [Fin.val_last, U_split', V_split', Fin.snoc_last]
        rw [hβ'_pt, hsplit]
        have hstat_zero :
            (∑ r : Fin (k - 1),
              pointRelInteriorGrad (fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (fun _ => G.F) (fun _ => deriv G.F)
                (fun s => G.x_fn s q) r *
                β_top ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ q) = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_
          rw [G.stationary_on_nondeg q (hV'_sub_U₀ hq) (hℓ_ne' q hq) r, zero_mul]
        rw [hstat_zero, add_zero]
        exact hweb_split q (hV'_sub_new hq)
      · intro m hm
        have hm1 : 1 ≤ (m : ℕ) := by simpa using hm
        have hmJ : (m : ℕ) ≤ J := by have := m.2; omega
        have htrunc :=
          (hJet.epsJet_trunc_eq
            (ℓ₀ := fun i => G.ℓ_fn i q) (x₀ := fun s => G.x_fn s q)
            (β₁ := fun m s => S.β m s q) (β₂ := fun m s => β' m s q)
            (Nat.le_succ J) hm1 hmJ hW'_open (G.F_holo.mono hW'_sub_WF)
            (fun u m => (S.g_holo u m).mono hW'_sub_S) hg'_holo hg0_S hg'0
            (fun u m z _ => by
              change g' u m.castSucc z = S.g u m z
              simp [g', Fin.snoc_castSucc])
            (hℓ_ne' q hq) (hx_maps_W' q hq) (hℓ_sq' q hq)
            (fun s => S.β_zero s q)
            (fun s => by
              have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (J + 1 + 1)) = (0 : Fin (J + 1)).castSucc := rfl
              rw [h0_eq]
              simpa [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc] using S.β_zero s q)
            (fun m s => by
              change β' m.castSucc s q = S.β m s q
              simp [β', Fin.snoc_castSucc])).1
        simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, U_split', V_split', Fin.snoc_castSucc]
        rw [htrunc]
        exact S.len_jet_split q (hV'_sub_S hq) m hm1
  }, by
    intro r m
    change g' r m.castSucc = S.g r m
    simp [g', Fin.snoc_castSucc]⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let T : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by positivity
  have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
  have : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨hT_pos⟩
  let q_ℂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => (q θ : ℂ)
  have hq_ℂ_cont : Continuous q_ℂ := Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hq_cont
  have hq_ℂ_per : Function.Periodic q_ℂ T := hq_per.comp Complex.ofReal
  let q_lift : AddCircle T → ℂ := hq_ℂ_per.lift
  have hq_lift_coe : ∀ θ : ℝ, q_lift (θ : AddCircle T) = (q θ : ℂ) :=
    fun θ => hq_ℂ_per.lift_coe θ
  have hq_lift_cont : Continuous q_lift := by
    rw [Topology.IsQuotientMap.continuous_iff
      (QuotientAddGroup.isQuotientMap_mk (N := AddSubgroup.zmultiples T))]
    have hcomp : q_lift ∘ QuotientAddGroup.mk = q_ℂ := funext hq_lift_coe
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hq_ℂ_cont
  let Q_𝕋 : C(AddCircle T, ℂ) := ⟨q_lift, hq_lift_cont⟩
  let S_span : Submodule ℂ C(AddCircle T, ℂ) := Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (@fourier T))
  have hQ_mem_cl : Q_𝕋 ∈ closure (S_span : Set C(AddCircle T, ℂ)) := by
    rw [← Submodule.topologicalClosure_coe]
    change Q_𝕋 ∈ S_span.topologicalClosure
    rw [span_fourier_closure_eq_top]
    trivial
  have hη4_pos : 0 < η₀ / 4 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨P_𝕋, hP_mem, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hQ_mem_cl (η₀ / 4) hη4_pos
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hdist
  obtain ⟨c, hc_eq⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hP_mem
  have hP_eval : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      P_𝕋 (θ : AddCircle T) =
        ∑ n ∈ c.support, c n * Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    intro θ
    rw [← hc_eq]
    change (∑ n ∈ c.support, c n • @fourier T n) (θ : AddCircle T) = _
    rw [ContinuousMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    rw [ContinuousMap.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, fourier_coe_apply]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    have hpi_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
    have hT_ℂ : (T : ℂ) = 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by simp [T]
    rw [hT_ℂ]
    field_simp [hpi_ne]
  have h_approx : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      |q θ - ∑ n ∈ c.support, (c n * Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re| <
        η₀ / 4 := by
    intro θ
    have h_pt_norm : ‖(Q_𝕋 - P_𝕋) (θ : AddCircle T)‖ < η₀ / 4 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm (Q_𝕋 - P_𝕋) (θ : AddCircle T)) hdist
    have h_re_le : |((Q_𝕋 - P_𝕋) (θ : AddCircle T)).re| ≤ ‖(Q_𝕋 - P_𝕋) (θ : AddCircle T)‖ :=
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    have h_re_eq : ((Q_𝕋 - P_𝕋) (θ : AddCircle T)).re =
        q θ - ∑ n ∈ c.support, (c n * Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re := by
      rw [ContinuousMap.sub_apply]
      change (q_lift (θ : AddCircle T) - P_𝕋 (θ : AddCircle T)).re = _
      rw [hq_lift_coe θ, hP_eval θ, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.re_sum]
    rw [← h_re_eq]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_re_le h_pt_norm
  let α : ℤ → ℂ := fun n =>
    if 0 ≤ n then Complex.I * c n else Complex.I * starRingEnd ℂ (c n)
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
    Complex.I * ((η₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ∑ n ∈ c.support, α n * ζ ^ n.natAbs
  have hg_holo : Differentiable ℂ g := by
    refine (differentiable_const _).add ?_
    refine Differentiable.fun_sum fun n _ => ?_
    exact (Differentiable.fun_pow differentiable_id n.natAbs).const_mul (α n)
  have hI_mul_im : ∀ z : ℂ, (Complex.I * z).im = z.re := by
    intro z
    simp [Complex.mul_im]
  have h_term_im : ∀ (θ : ℝ) (n : ℤ),
      (α n * (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ n.natAbs).im =
        (c n * Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re := by
    intro θ n
    set ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    set m : ℕ := n.natAbs
    by_cases hn : 0 ≤ n
    · have hα : α n = Complex.I * c n := by simp [α, hn]
      have hm_int : (m : ℤ) = n := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hn
      have hm_cast : (m : ℂ) = (n : ℂ) := by
        rw [← hm_int, Int.cast_natCast]
      have hζm : ζ ^ m = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, hm_cast]
      rw [hα, mul_assoc, hI_mul_im, hζm]
    · have hα : α n = Complex.I * starRingEnd ℂ (c n) := by simp [α, hn]
      have hn_le : n ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hn
      have hm_int : (m : ℤ) = -n := Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos hn_le
      have hn_int : n = -(m : ℤ) := by omega
      have hm_cast : (n : ℂ) = -(m : ℂ) := by
        rw [hn_int, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
      have hconj_ζm : starRingEnd ℂ (ζ ^ m) = Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
        rw [map_pow]
        have hconj_ζ : starRingEnd ℂ ζ = Complex.exp (-((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
          dsimp [ζ]
          rw [← Complex.exp_conj, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I, mul_neg]
        rw [hconj_ζ, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, hm_cast]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hα, mul_assoc, hI_mul_im, ← Complex.conj_re (starRingEnd ℂ (c n) * ζ ^ m),
        map_mul, Complex.conj_conj, hconj_ζm]
  have hg_im_circle : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im =
        η₀ / 2 + ∑ n ∈ c.support, (c n * Complex.exp ((n : ℂ) * ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re := by
    intro θ
    dsimp [g]
    rw [hI_mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.im_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => h_term_im θ n
  have hg_bdry : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      0 < (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ∧
      (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im < q θ + η₀ := by
    intro θ
    have h_abs := abs_lt.mp (h_approx θ)
    have hq0 := hq_nonneg θ
    rw [hg_im_circle θ]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hq_le_im : ∀ θ : ℝ, q θ ≤ (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im := by
    intro θ
    have h_abs := abs_lt.mp (h_approx θ)
    rw [hg_im_circle θ]
    linarith
  let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hγ_cont : Continuous γ :=
    Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
  have h_monom_int : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, (γ θ) ^ m) = (T : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ m := by
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst hm
      simp [T]
    · rw [zero_pow hm, mul_zero]
      have h_integrand : ∀ θ : ℝ, (γ θ) ^ m = Complex.exp (((m : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (θ : ℂ)) := by
        intro θ
        dsimp [γ]
        rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
        congr 1
        ring
      simp_rw [h_integrand]
      have hwm_ne : (m : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hm) Complex.I_ne_zero
      rw [integral_exp_mul_complex]
      have hexp_T : Complex.exp (((m : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (T : ℂ)) = 1 := by
        have harg : ((m : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (T : ℂ) =
            (m : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          simp [T]
          ring
        rw [harg, Complex.exp_nat_mul, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, one_pow]
      rw [hexp_T, Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, sub_self, zero_div]
      exact hwm_ne
  have hg_int : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, g (γ θ)) = (T : ℂ) * g 0 := by
    dsimp [g]
    have hint_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => Complex.I * ((η₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 T := continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hint_term : ∀ n ∈ c.support,
        IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => α n * (γ θ) ^ n.natAbs) MeasureTheory.volume 0 T :=
      fun n _ => (continuous_const.mul (hγ_cont.pow n.natAbs)).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hint_sum : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ c.support, α n * (γ θ) ^ n.natAbs)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 T :=
      (continuous_finsetSum c.support fun n _ =>
        continuous_const.mul (hγ_cont.pow n.natAbs)).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hint_const hint_sum]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, Complex.real_smul]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hint_term]
    have hsum_eq : (∑ n ∈ c.support, ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, α n * (γ θ) ^ n.natAbs) =
        (T : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ c.support, α n * (0 : ℂ) ^ n.natAbs := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, h_monom_int n.natAbs]
      ring
    rw [hsum_eq, ← mul_add]
  have hg_im_int : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, (g (γ θ)).im) = T * (g 0).im := by
    have hint_g : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => g (γ θ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 T :=
      (hg_holo.continuous.comp hγ_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hcomm := ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm Complex.imCLM hint_g
    change (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, (g (γ θ)).im) = ((∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, g (γ θ))).im at hcomm
    rw [hcomm, hg_int, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  have hg_mean : T⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, q θ) ≤ (g 0).im := by
    have hint_q : IntervalIntegrable q MeasureTheory.volume 0 T :=
      hq_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hint_im : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (g (γ θ)).im) MeasureTheory.volume 0 T :=
      (Complex.continuous_im.comp (hg_holo.continuous.comp hγ_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hmono : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, q θ) ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..T, (g (γ θ)).im :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (le_of_lt hT_pos) hint_q hint_im
        (fun θ _ => hq_le_im θ)
    rw [hg_im_int] at hmono
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hT_pos))
    rwa [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hT_ne] at hmul
  exact ⟨g, hg_holo, hg_bdry, hg_mean⟩

    (hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ))
    (hΦ_maps : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, Φ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
    (hΦ_deriv : deriv Φ 0 ≠ 0)
    (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hq_cont : Continuous q)
    (hq_per : Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi))
    (hq_lt : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_F (Φ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))) :
    ∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧
      ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ,
        Differentiable ℂ g →
        (∀ θ : ℝ,
          0 < (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ∧
          (g (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im < q θ + η₀) →
        ∃ (d_w d_ζ δ_t : ℝ) (ψ : ℂ → ℂ),
          (0 < d_w ∧ d_w < s_base) ∧
          (0 < d_ζ ∧ d_ζ < 1 ∧ 1 + d_ζ < R_Φ) ∧
          (∀ (x₀ lam : ℝ), 0 ≤ lam → lam ≤ 1 →
            ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w,
            ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 - d_ζ < ‖ζ‖ → ‖ζ‖ < 1 + d_ζ →
              ((x₀ : ℂ) + (lam : ℂ) * g ζ + w, Φ ζ) ∈ meroTubeENNR r_base h_F) ∧
          (0 < δ_t ∧ Metric.ball (Φ 0) δ_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base) ∧
          (DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball (Φ 0) δ_t) ∧
            ψ (Φ 0) = 0 ∧ deriv ψ (Φ 0) ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ t' ∈ Metric.ball (Φ 0) δ_t,
            ψ t' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ) ∧
            Φ (ψ t') = t' ∧
            ‖g (ψ t') - g 0‖ < d_w / 4)

        (∀ x ∈ V ∩ C, f x = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ C, f q = 0 := by

    let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => p₁ + z • (q - p₁)
    have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
      (differentiable_const p₁).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (q - p₁))
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := hγ_diff.continuous

      show γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ C
      have hγ_comb : γ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • γ z₁ + b • γ z₂ := by
        dsimp [γ]

              = (a + b) • p₁ + (a • z₁) • (q - p₁) + (b • z₂) • (q - p₁) := by
                  rw [hab, one_smul, add_smul, add_assoc]
          _ = a • p₁ + b • p₁ + a • (z₁ • (q - p₁)) + b • (z₂ • (q - p₁)) := by
                  rw [add_smul, smul_assoc, smul_assoc]
          _ = a • (p₁ + z₁ • (q - p₁)) + b • (p₁ + z₂ • (q - p₁)) := by
                  simp only [smul_add]
                  abel
      rw [hγ_comb]
      exact hC_conv hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ V_z := by
      show γ 0 ∈ C
      simpa [γ] using hp₁C
