      show γ 1 ∈ C
      simpa [γ] using hq
    have hfg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ γ) V_z :=
      (hf.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)).analyticOnNhd hVz_open
    have hfg_ev : (f ∘ γ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have h_nhds : γ ⁻¹' (V ∩ C) ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := by
        apply ((hV_open.inter hC_open).preimage hγ_cont).mem_nhds
        show γ 0 ∈ V ∩ C
        simpa [γ] using (⟨hp₁V, hp₁C⟩ : p₁ ∈ V ∩ C)
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem h_nhds (fun z hz => hfV (γ z) hz)
    have h_eq := hfg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hVz_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem hfg_ev h1_mem
    simpa [Function.comp, γ] using h_eq

  have exists_ne_zero_of_convex_2D :
      ∀ {B V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen B → Convex ℝ B → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B, g q₀ ≠ 0) → IsOpen V → (V ∩ B).Nonempty →
        ∃ x₁ ∈ V ∩ B, g x₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro B V g hB_open hB_conv hg ⟨q₀, hq₀B, hq₀_ne⟩ hV_open hVB_ne
    by_contra h_all
    have h_zero : ∀ x ∈ V ∩ B, g x = 0 :=
      fun x hx => Classical.not_not.mp (fun hne => h_all ⟨x, hx, hne⟩)
    exact hq₀_ne (eqOn_zero_of_convex_2D hB_open hB_conv hg hV_open hVB_ne h_zero q₀ hq₀B)

  have cancel_holo_of_convex_2D :
      ∀ {C B V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen C → Convex ℝ C → DifferentiableOn ℂ h C →
        IsOpen B → Convex ℝ B → DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
        (∃ q₀ ∈ B, g q₀ ≠ 0) →
        IsOpen V → ((V ∩ C) ∩ B).Nonempty →
        (∀ x ∈ (V ∩ C) ∩ B, h x * g x = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ C, h q = 0 := by
    intro C B V h g hC_open hC_conv hh hB_open hB_conv hg hg_nz hV_open hVCB_ne hprod
    obtain ⟨x₁, ⟨⟨hx₁V, hx₁C⟩, hx₁B⟩, hx₁_ne⟩ :=
      exists_ne_zero_of_convex_2D hB_open hB_conv hg hg_nz (hV_open.inter hC_open) hVCB_ne
    have hcont : ContinuousAt g x₁ :=
      hg.continuousOn.continuousAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hx₁B)
    have h_nhds : (V ∩ B) ∩ g ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ ∈ nhds x₁ :=
      Filter.inter_mem ((hV_open.inter hB_open).mem_nhds ⟨hx₁V, hx₁B⟩)
        (hcont.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hx₁_ne))
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    have hh_sub : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₁ η₁ ∩ C, h x = 0 := by
      rintro x ⟨hx_ball, hxC⟩
      have hx_mem := hη₁_sub hx_ball
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod x ⟨⟨hx_mem.1.1, hxC⟩, hx_mem.1.2⟩) with hh0 | hg0
      · exact hh0
      · exact False.elim (hx_mem.2 hg0)
    exact eqOn_zero_of_convex_2D hC_open hC_conv hh Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hη₁, hx₁C⟩ hh_sub

  have triangular_holo :
      ∀ {W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ},
        IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ W₁ := by
    rintro W₁ Υ ⟨_, U_v, h, φ, _, _, hΥ_eq, hh_holo, hφ_holo, _⟩
    have hfst_add : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1 + h p.2) W₁ :=
      differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.add
        (hh_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (fun p hp => (hΥ_eq p hp).1))
    have hsnd_φ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => φ p.2) W₁ :=
      hφ_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn (fun p hp => (hΥ_eq p hp).1)
    exact (hfst_add.prodMk hsnd_φ).congr (fun p hp => (hΥ_eq p hp).2)

  have triangular_image_contains_ball :
      ∀ {W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {p : ℂ × ℂ} {r_p : ℝ},
        IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → p ∈ W₁ → 0 < r_p → Metric.ball p r_p ⊆ W₁ →
        ∃ p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p r_p, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
          Metric.ball (Υ p₁) ε ⊆ Υ '' Metric.ball p r_p := by
    rintro W₁ Υ p r_p ⟨_, U_v, h, φ, hUv_open, hUv_pre, hΥ_eq, hh_holo, hφ_holo,
      v₀, hv₀_mem, hv₀_deriv⟩ hp hr_p hBp
    have hslice_Uv : Metric.ball p.2 r_p ⊆ U_v := by
      intro v hv
      have hpair_ball : (p.1, v) ∈ Metric.ball p r_p := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
        exact max_lt (by simpa using hr_p) (Metric.mem_ball.mp hv)
      exact (hΥ_eq (p.1, v) (hBp hpair_ball)).1
    have hex_v₁ : ∃ v₁ ∈ Metric.ball p.2 r_p, deriv φ v₁ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_all
      have h_zero : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball p.2 r_p, deriv φ v = 0 :=
        fun v hv => Classical.not_not.mp (fun hne => h_all ⟨v, hv, hne⟩)
      have hφ'_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (deriv φ) U_v :=
        (hφ_holo.deriv hUv_open).analyticOnNhd hUv_open
      have hφ'_ev : deriv φ =ᶠ[nhds p.2] 0 :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p.2 hr_p) h_zero
      exact hv₀_deriv (hφ'_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hUv_pre (hΥ_eq p hp).1 hφ'_ev hv₀_mem)
    obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁_ball, hv₁_ne⟩ := hex_v₁
    have hv₁_Uv : v₁ ∈ U_v := hslice_Uv hv₁_ball
    have hcont_h : ContinuousAt h v₁ :=
      hh_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hUv_open.mem_nhds hv₁_Uv)
    have h_nhds_v₁ :
        Metric.ball p.2 r_p ∩ h ⁻¹' Metric.ball (h v₁) (r_p / 2) ∈ nhds v₁ :=
      Filter.inter_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv₁_ball)
        (hcont_h.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (h v₁) (half_pos hr_p)))
    obtain ⟨δ_v, hδ_v, hδ_v_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_v₁
    have hφ_map_eq : Filter.map φ (nhds v₁) = nhds (φ v₁) :=
      ((hφ_holo.analyticAt (hUv_open.mem_nhds hv₁_Uv)).hasStrictDerivAt).map_nhds_eq hv₁_ne
    have h_img_nhds : φ '' Metric.ball v₁ δ_v ∈ nhds (φ v₁) := by
      rw [← hφ_map_eq]
      exact Filter.image_mem_map (Metric.ball_mem_nhds v₁ hδ_v)
    obtain ⟨ε_v, hε_v, hε_v_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_img_nhds
    let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := (p.1, v₁)
    have hp₁_ball : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p r_p := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
      exact max_lt (by simpa [p₁] using hr_p) (Metric.mem_ball.mp hv₁_ball)
    let ε : ℝ := min (r_p / 2) ε_v
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := lt_min (half_pos hr_p) hε_v
    refine ⟨p₁, hp₁_ball, ε, hε_pos, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨w, t⟩ hwt
    have hΥp₁ : Υ p₁ = (p.1 + h v₁, φ v₁) := (hΥ_eq p₁ (hBp hp₁_ball)).2
    rw [hΥp₁, Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hwt
    have hw_dist : dist w (p.1 + h v₁) < r_p / 2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hwt.1 (min_le_left _ _)
    have ht_ball : t ∈ Metric.ball (φ v₁) ε_v :=
      Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hwt.2 (min_le_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨v, hv_δ, hφv⟩ := hε_v_sub ht_ball
    have hv_mem := hδ_v_sub hv_δ
    have hv_ball : v ∈ Metric.ball p.2 r_p := hv_mem.1
    have hhv_dist : dist (h v) (h v₁) < r_p / 2 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hv_mem.2
    let q : ℂ × ℂ := (w - h v, v)
    have hq_ball : q ∈ Metric.ball p r_p := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Metric.mem_ball.mp hv_ball⟩
      dsimp [q]
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at hw_dist hhv_dist ⊢
      have h_decomp : w - h v - p.1 = (w - (p.1 + h v₁)) + (h v₁ - h v) := by ring
      have hhv_norm : ‖h v₁ - h v‖ = ‖h v - h v₁‖ := norm_sub_rev (h v₁) (h v)
      calc
        ‖w - h v - p.1‖ = ‖(w - (p.1 + h v₁)) + (h v₁ - h v)‖ := by rw [h_decomp]
        _ ≤ ‖w - (p.1 + h v₁)‖ + ‖h v₁ - h v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖w - (p.1 + h v₁)‖ + ‖h v - h v₁‖ := by rw [hhv_norm]
        _ < r_p := by linarith
    refine ⟨q, hq_ball, ?_⟩
    rw [(hΥ_eq q (hBp hq_ball)).2]
    dsimp [q]
    rw [sub_add_cancel, hφv]

  have triangular_pullback_ne_zero :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {p q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r R₂ : ℝ}
        {D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ → p ∈ U → 0 < r → Metric.ball p r ⊆ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ D (Metric.ball q₀ R₂) →
        (∃ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball q₀ R₂, D z₀ ≠ 0) →
        Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball q₀ R₂) →
        ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, D (Υ q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro U Υ p q₀ r R₂ D hTri hp hr hBr_U hD ⟨z₀, hz₀B, hz₀_ne⟩ hMaps
    by_contra h_all
    have h_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, D (Υ q) = 0 :=
      fun q hq => Classical.not_not.mp (fun hne => h_all ⟨q, hq, hne⟩)
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁_ball, ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ :=
      triangular_image_contains_ball hTri hp hr hBr_U
    have hD_ball_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (Υ p₁) ε ∩ Metric.ball q₀ R₂, D y = 0 := by
      rintro y ⟨hy_ε, _⟩
      obtain ⟨q, hq_ball, rfl⟩ := hε_sub hy_ε
      exact h_zero q hq_ball
    have hΥp₁_mem : Υ p₁ ∈ Metric.ball (Υ p₁) ε ∩ Metric.ball q₀ R₂ :=
      ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hε_pos, hMaps hp₁_ball⟩
    exact hz₀_ne (eqOn_zero_of_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ R₂) hD
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨Υ p₁, hΥp₁_mem⟩ hD_ball_zero z₀ hz₀B)

  have cancel_pullback_ball_2D :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {p q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r R₁ R₂ : ℝ}
        {Δ D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ → p ∈ U → 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ → Metric.ball p r ⊆ U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p R₁) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ D (Metric.ball q₀ R₂) →
        (∃ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball q₀ R₂, D z₀ ≠ 0) →
        Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball q₀ R₂) →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, Δ q * D (Υ q) = 0) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p R₁, Δ q = 0 := by
    intro U Υ p q₀ r R₁ R₂ Δ D hTri hp hr hrR₁ hBr_U hΔ hD hD_nz hMaps hprod
    have hDΥ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => D (Υ q)) (Metric.ball p r) :=
      hD.comp ((triangular_holo hTri).mono hBr_U) hMaps
    have hDΥ_nz : ∃ q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p r, D (Υ q₁) ≠ 0 :=
      triangular_pullback_ne_zero hTri hp hr hBr_U hD hD_nz hMaps
    have hp_R₁ : p ∈ Metric.ball p R₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_of_lt_of_le hr hrR₁)
    have hp_r : p ∈ Metric.ball p r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    exact cancel_holo_of_convex_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p R₁) hΔ
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) hDΥ_holo hDΥ_nz
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, ⟨hp_r, hp_R₁⟩, hp_r⟩
      (fun q hq => hprod q hq.2)

  have fn_ofHolo : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      ∃ H : MeroOn2D U, MeroAgreesHolo H f U ∧
        ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
          IsOpen V → V ⊆ U →
          (MeroAgreesHolo F f V ↔ MeroEqOn F H V) := by
    classical
    intro U f hU hf
    let r_U : ∀ p ∈ U, ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp)
    have hr_U : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ U), 0 < r_U p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_U p hp) ⊆ U :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp)
    let H : MeroOn2D U := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ U then r_U p hp else 1
      num := fun _ => f
      den := fun _ _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (hr_U p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (hr_U p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact hf.mono (hr_U p hp).2
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 1
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_U p hp).1, one_ne_zero⟩
      compat := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
    }
    refine ⟨H, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨Set.Subset.rfl, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      refine ⟨r_U p hp, (hr_U p hp).1, ?_, (hr_U p hp).2, fun q _ => (mul_one (f q)).symm⟩
      simp only [H, hp, ↓reduceDIte, le_rfl]
    · intro W F V hV hVU
      constructor
      · intro hAg
        refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hAg.1 hp, hVU hp⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩
        have hpW : p ∈ W := hAg.1 hp
        have hpU : p ∈ U := hVU hp
        obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, _, _, hr₀_eq⟩ := hAg.2 p hp
        let R : ℝ := min (F.rad p) (H.rad p)
        have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_min (F.rad_pos p hpW) (H.rad_pos p hpU)
        let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => F.num p q * H.den p q - H.num p q * F.den p q
        have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p R) :=
          (((F.num_holo p hpW).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
            ((H.den_holo p hpU).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
          (((H.num_holo p hpU).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
            ((F.den_holo p hpW).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
        have hΔ_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r₀ ∩ Metric.ball p R, Δ q = 0 := by
          rintro q ⟨hq₀, _⟩
          dsimp [Δ, H]
          rw [mul_one, hr₀_eq q hq₀, sub_self]
        intro q hq
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_of_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p R)
          hΔ_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
          ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos⟩ hΔ_sub q hq)
      · intro hEq
        refine ⟨fun p hp => (hEq.1 hp).1, fun p hp => ?_⟩
        have hpW : p ∈ W := (hEq.1 hp).1
        have hpU : p ∈ U := (hEq.1 hp).2
        obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV p hp
        let r : ℝ := min r_V (min (F.rad p) (H.rad p))
        have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
          lt_min hr_V_pos (lt_min (F.rad_pos p hpW) (H.rad_pos p hpU))
        refine ⟨r, hr_pos, le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
          Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr_V_sub, ?_⟩
        intro q hq
        have h_eq := hEq.2 p hp q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
        simpa [H] using h_eq

  have fn_eqOn_symm :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U h
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h.1 hp).2, (h.1 hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [min_comm] at hq
    exact (h.2 p hp q hq).symm

  have fn_eqOn_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U V hVU h
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU h.1, fun p hp => h.2 p (hVU hp)⟩

  have fn_eqOn_trans :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃)
        (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ F₁ F₂ F₃ U h₁₂ h₂₃
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h₁₂.1 hp).1, (h₂₃.1 hp).2⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (h₁₂.1 hp).1
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (h₁₂.1 hp).2
    have hp₃ : p ∈ W₃ := (h₂₃.1 hp).2
    let r₁₃ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₃.rad p)
    let r₁₂₃ : ℝ := min r₁₃ (F₂.rad p)
    have hr₁₃ : 0 < r₁₃ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₃.rad_pos p hp₃)
    have hr₁₂₃ : 0 < r₁₂₃ := lt_min hr₁₃ (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => F₁.num p q * F₃.den p q - F₃.num p q * F₁.den p q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r₁₃) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₃.den_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₃.num_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hprod_zero :
        ∀ q ∈ (Metric.ball p r₁₂₃ ∩ Metric.ball p r₁₃) ∩ Metric.ball p (F₂.rad p),
          Δ q * F₂.den p q = 0 := by
      rintro q ⟨⟨hq, _⟩, _⟩
      have hq₁₂ : q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)) hq
      have hq₂₃ : q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hq
      have e₁₂ := h₁₂.2 p hp q hq₁₂
      have e₂₃ := h₂₃.2 p hp q hq₂₃
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination F₃.den p q * e₁₂ + F₁.den p q * e₂₃
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (cancel_holo_of_convex_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r₁₃) hΔ_holo
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F₂.rad p)) (F₂.den_holo p hp₂) (F₂.den_ne_zero p hp₂)
      Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨p, ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁₂₃, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁₃⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)⟩
      hprod_zero q hq)

  have meroEq_step :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        {p₀ p₁ : ℂ × ℂ},
        p₀ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ → p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        (Metric.ball p₀ (min (F₁.rad p₀) (F₂.rad p₀)) ∩
          Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁))).Nonempty →
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (min (F₁.rad p₀) (F₂.rad p₀)),
          F₁.num p₀ q * F₂.den p₀ q = F₂.num p₀ q * F₁.den p₀ q) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)),
          F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q = F₂.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₁ q := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ p₀ p₁ hp₀ hp₁ ⟨q_ov, hq_ov₀, hq_ov₁⟩ hEq₀
    let r₀ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p₀) (F₂.rad p₀)
    let r₁ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)
    let O : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r₀ ∩ Metric.ball p₁ r₁
    have hO_open : IsOpen O := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hO_conv : Convex ℝ O := (convex_ball p₀ r₀).inter (convex_ball p₁ r₁)
    have hq_ov_O : q_ov ∈ O := ⟨hq_ov₀, hq_ov₁⟩
    let Δ₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun q => F₁.num p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q - F₂.num p₁ q * F₁.den p₁ q
    have hΔ₁_holo_B₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₁ (Metric.ball p₁ r₁) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((F₂.num_holo p₁ hp₁.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hΔ₁_mul_holo_O : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Δ₁ q * F₁.den p₀ q) O :=
      (hΔ₁_holo_B₁.mono Set.inter_subset_right).mul
        ((F₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1).mono
          (fun _ hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1))
    have hprod₂ : ∀ q ∈ (O ∩ O) ∩ Metric.ball p₀ (F₂.rad p₀),
        (Δ₁ q * F₁.den p₀ q) * F₂.den p₀ q = 0 := by
      rintro q ⟨⟨hqO, _⟩, _⟩
      have c₁ := F₁.compat p₁ hp₁.1 p₀ hp₀.1 q
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hqO.2,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hqO.1⟩
      have c₂ := F₂.compat p₁ hp₁.2 p₀ hp₀.2 q
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hqO.2,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hqO.1⟩
      have e₀ := hEq₀ q hqO.1
      dsimp [Δ₁]
      linear_combination
        F₂.den p₁ q * F₂.den p₀ q * c₁ -
        F₁.den p₁ q * F₁.den p₀ q * c₂ +
        F₁.den p₁ q * F₂.den p₁ q * e₀
    have hprod₁ : ∀ q ∈ O, Δ₁ q * F₁.den p₀ q = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_convex_2D hO_open hO_conv hΔ₁_mul_holo_O
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (F₂.rad p₀))
        (F₂.den_holo p₀ hp₀.2) (F₂.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.2)
        hO_open ⟨q_ov, ⟨hq_ov_O, hq_ov_O⟩, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq_ov₀⟩
        hprod₂
    have hΔ₁_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁, Δ₁ q = 0 :=
      cancel_holo_of_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₁ r₁) hΔ₁_holo_B₁
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p₀ (F₁.rad p₀))
        (F₁.den_holo p₀ hp₀.1) (F₁.den_ne_zero p₀ hp₀.1)
        hO_open ⟨q_ov, ⟨hq_ov_O, hq_ov₁⟩, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq_ov₀⟩
        (fun q hq => hprod₁ q hq.1.1)
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ₁_zero q hq)

  have fn_eqOn_of_isPreconnected :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (V V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ V →
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ V V₀ _hV_open hV_pre hV_sub _hV₀_open ⟨p_init, hp_init⟩ hV₀_sub hEq₀
    let Ω_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)),
          F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q }
    have hΩ_open : IsOpen Ω_eq := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      rintro p₀ ⟨hp₀_W, hp₀_eq⟩
      let r₀ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p₀) (F₂.rad p₀)
      have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.1) (F₂.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.2)
      refine ⟨r₀, hr₀, ?_⟩
      intro p₁ hp₁_ball
      have hp₁_W : p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ :=
        ⟨F₁.ball_sub p₀ hp₀_W.1 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp₁_ball),
          F₂.ball_sub p₀ hp₀_W.2 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp₁_ball)⟩
      have hr₁ : 0 < min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁) :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_W.1) (F₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_W.2)
      exact ⟨hp₁_W, meroEq_step F₁ F₂ hp₀_W hp₁_W
        ⟨p₁, hp₁_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁⟩ hp₀_eq⟩
    have hΩ_ne : (V ∩ Ω_eq).Nonempty :=
      ⟨p_init, hV₀_sub hp_init, hV_sub (hV₀_sub hp_init), hEq₀.2 p_init hp_init⟩
    have hΩ_cl : closure Ω_eq ∩ V ⊆ Ω_eq := by
      rintro p₁ ⟨hp₁_cl, hp₁_V⟩
      have hp₁_W : p₁ ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ := hV_sub hp₁_V
      let r₁ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p₁) (F₂.rad p₁)
      have hr₁ : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_W.1) (F₂.rad_pos p₁ hp₁_W.2)
      obtain ⟨p₀, ⟨hp₀_W, hp₀_eq⟩, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp₁_cl r₁ hr₁
      have hr₀ : 0 < min (F₁.rad p₀) (F₂.rad p₀) :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.1) (F₂.rad_pos p₀ hp₀_W.2)
      have hp₀_B₁ : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        exact hdist
      exact ⟨hp₁_W, meroEq_step F₁ F₂ hp₀_W hp₁_W
        ⟨p₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀, hp₀_B₁⟩ hp₀_eq⟩
    have hV_Ω : V ⊆ Ω_eq :=
      hV_pre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hΩ_open hΩ_ne hΩ_cl
    exact ⟨hV_sub, fun p hp => (hV_Ω hp).2⟩

  have fn_restrictOpen :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → ∃ G : MeroOn2D V, MeroEqOn G F V := by
    classical
    intro W F V hV hVW
    let r_V : ∀ p ∈ V, ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV p hp)
    have hr_V : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ V), 0 < r_V p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_V p hp) ⊆ V :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV p hp)
    let G : MeroOn2D V := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ V then min (F.rad p) (r_V p hp) else 1
      num := F.num
      den := F.den
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact lt_min (F.rad_pos p (hVW hp)) (hr_V p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hr_V p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.num_holo p (hVW hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.den_holo p (hVW hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        have hr_clamp : 0 < min (F.rad p) (r_V p hp) :=
          lt_min (F.rad_pos p (hVW hp)) (hr_V p hp).1
        obtain ⟨x₁, ⟨hx₁_clamp, _⟩, hx₁_ne⟩ :=
          exists_ne_zero_of_convex_2D
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F.rad p))
            (F.den_holo p (hVW hp)) (F.den_ne_zero p (hVW hp))
            Metric.isOpen_ball
            ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_clamp, Metric.mem_ball_self (F.rad_pos p (hVW hp))⟩
        exact ⟨x₁, hx₁_clamp, hx₁_ne⟩
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
        simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceDIte] at hq
        exact F.compat p₁ (hVW hp₁) p₂ (hVW hp₂) q
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.1,
            Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2⟩
    }
    exact ⟨G, ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hp, hVW hp⟩, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩⟩

  have fn_glueCover :
      ∀ {ι : Type} (U : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
        (G : ∀ α, MeroOn2D (U α)),
        (∀ α, IsOpen (U α)) → IsOpen W → W ⊆ (⋃ α, U α) →
        (∀ α β, MeroEqOn (G α) (G β) (U α ∩ U β)) →
        ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, ∀ α, MeroEqOn F (G α) (W ∩ U α) := by
    classical
    intro ι U W G _hU_open hW_open hW_cov hcompat
    let idx : ∀ p ∈ W, ι := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hW_cov hp))
    have hidx : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W), p ∈ U (idx p hp) :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hW_cov hp))
    let r_W : ∀ p ∈ W, ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open p hp)
    have hr_W : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W), 0 < r_W p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_W p hp) ⊆ W :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open p hp)
    let F : MeroOn2D W := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then min ((G (idx p hp)).rad p) (r_W p hp) else 1
      num := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then (G (idx p hp)).num p else fun _ => 0
      den := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W then (G (idx p hp)).den p else fun _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact lt_min ((G (idx p hp)).rad_pos p (hidx p hp)) (hr_W p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hr_W p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact ((G (idx p hp)).num_holo p (hidx p hp)).mono
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact ((G (idx p hp)).den_holo p (hidx p hp)).mono
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        let α_p : ι := idx p hp
        let r_clamp : ℝ := min ((G α_p).rad p) (r_W p hp)
        have hr_clamp : 0 < r_clamp :=
          lt_min ((G α_p).rad_pos p (hidx p hp)) (hr_W p hp).1
        obtain ⟨x₁, ⟨hx₁_clamp, _⟩, hx₁_ne⟩ :=
          exists_ne_zero_of_convex_2D
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p ((G α_p).rad p))
            ((G α_p).den_holo p (hidx p hp)) ((G α_p).den_ne_zero p (hidx p hp))
            Metric.isOpen_ball
            ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_clamp,
              Metric.mem_ball_self ((G α_p).rad_pos p (hidx p hp))⟩
        exact ⟨x₁, hx₁_clamp, hx₁_ne⟩
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q₀ hq₀ => by
        simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceDIte] at hq₀ ⊢
        let α₁ : ι := idx p₁ hp₁
        let α₂ : ι := idx p₂ hp₂
        have hα₁ : p₁ ∈ U α₁ := hidx p₁ hp₁
        have hα₂ : p₂ ∈ U α₂ := hidx p₂ hp₂
        have hq₀_B₁ : q₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ((G α₁).rad p₁) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq₀.1
        have hq₀_B₂ : q₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₂ ((G α₂).rad p₂) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq₀.2
        have hq₀_1 : q₀ ∈ U α₁ := (G α₁).ball_sub p₁ hα₁ hq₀_B₁
        have hq₀_2 : q₀ ∈ U α₂ := (G α₂).ball_sub p₂ hα₂ hq₀_B₂
        let r_q : ℝ := min ((G α₁).rad q₀) ((G α₂).rad q₀)
        have hr_q : 0 < r_q := lt_min ((G α₁).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_1) ((G α₂).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_2)
        let C : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          (Metric.ball p₁ ((G α₁).rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ ((G α₂).rad p₂)) ∩
            Metric.ball q₀ r_q
        have hC_open : IsOpen C :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hC_conv : Convex ℝ C :=
          ((convex_ball p₁ ((G α₁).rad p₁)).inter (convex_ball p₂ ((G α₂).rad p₂))).inter
            (convex_ball q₀ r_q)
        have hq₀_C : q₀ ∈ C := ⟨⟨hq₀_B₁, hq₀_B₂⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_q⟩
        let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun x => (G α₁).num p₁ x * (G α₂).den p₂ x - (G α₂).num p₂ x * (G α₁).den p₁ x
        have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ C :=
          ((((G α₁).num_holo p₁ hα₁).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.1)).mul
            (((G α₂).den_holo p₂ hα₂).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.2))).sub
          ((((G α₂).num_holo p₂ hα₂).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.2)).mul
            (((G α₁).den_holo p₁ hα₁).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1.1)))
        have hΔ_mul_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => Δ x * (G α₁).den q₀ x) C :=
          hΔ_holo.mul (((G α₁).den_holo q₀ hq₀_1).mono
            (fun _ hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx.2))
        have hprod₂ : ∀ x ∈ (C ∩ C) ∩ Metric.ball q₀ ((G α₂).rad q₀),
            (Δ x * (G α₁).den q₀ x) * (G α₂).den q₀ x = 0 := by
          rintro x ⟨⟨hx, _⟩, _⟩
          have c₁ := (G α₁).compat p₁ hα₁ q₀ hq₀_1 x
            ⟨hx.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx.2⟩
          have c₂ := (G α₂).compat p₂ hα₂ q₀ hq₀_2 x
            ⟨hx.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx.2⟩
          have e₁₂ := (hcompat α₁ α₂).2 q₀ ⟨hq₀_1, hq₀_2⟩ x hx.2
          dsimp [Δ]
          linear_combination
            (G α₂).den p₂ x * (G α₂).den q₀ x * c₁ -
            (G α₁).den p₁ x * (G α₁).den q₀ x * c₂ +
            (G α₁).den p₁ x * (G α₂).den p₂ x * e₁₂
        have hprod₁ : ∀ x ∈ C, Δ x * (G α₁).den q₀ x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_of_convex_2D hC_open hC_conv hΔ_mul_holo
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ ((G α₂).rad q₀))
            ((G α₂).den_holo q₀ hq₀_2) ((G α₂).den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀_2)
            hC_open ⟨q₀, ⟨hq₀_C, hq₀_C⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self ((G α₂).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_2)⟩
            hprod₂
        have hΔ_zero : ∀ x ∈ C, Δ x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_of_convex_2D hC_open hC_conv hΔ_holo
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ ((G α₁).rad q₀))
            ((G α₁).den_holo q₀ hq₀_1) ((G α₁).den_ne_zero q₀ hq₀_1)
            hC_open ⟨q₀, ⟨hq₀_C, hq₀_C⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self ((G α₁).rad_pos q₀ hq₀_1)⟩
            (fun x hx => hprod₁ x hx.1.1)
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_zero q₀ hq₀_C)
    }
    refine ⟨F, fun α => ⟨Set.Subset.rfl, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩⟩
    have hpW : p ∈ W := hp.1
    simp only [F, hpW, ↓reduceDIte] at hq ⊢
    have hq_compat : q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((G (idx p hpW)).rad p) ((G α).rad p)) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball
        (le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)) hq
    exact (hcompat (idx p hpW) α).2 p ⟨hidx p hpW, hp.2⟩ q hq_compat

  have fn_glueBinary :
      ∀ {U₁ U₂ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
        IsOpen U₁ → IsOpen U₂ → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) →
        ∃ F : MeroOn2D W, MeroEqOn F G₁ (W ∩ U₁) ∧ MeroEqOn F G₂ (W ∩ U₂) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ W G₁ G₂ hU₁ hU₂ hW hcov hEq₁₂
    let U_fam : Bool → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun b => cond b U₁ U₂
    let G_fam : ∀ b : Bool, MeroOn2D (U_fam b)
      | true => G₁
      | false => G₂
    have hU_open : ∀ b : Bool, IsOpen (U_fam b) := fun b => by
      cases b
      · exact hU₂
      · exact hU₁
    have hW_cov : W ⊆ ⋃ b : Bool, U_fam b := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hcov hp with hp₁ | hp₂
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨true, hp₁⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨false, hp₂⟩
    have hcompat : ∀ b₁ b₂ : Bool, MeroEqOn (G_fam b₁) (G_fam b₂) (U_fam b₁ ∩ U_fam b₂) := by
      intro b₁ b₂
      cases b₁ <;> cases b₂
      · exact ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
      · simpa [U_fam, G_fam, Set.inter_comm] using fn_eqOn_symm G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) hEq₁₂
      · simpa [U_fam, G_fam] using hEq₁₂
      · exact ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := fn_glueCover U_fam W G_fam hU_open hW hW_cov hcompat
    exact ⟨F, hF true, hF false⟩

  have fn_triangular_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
        IsOpen U → U ⊆ W₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ := by
    rintro W₁ U Υ hU hUW₁ ⟨_, U_v, h, φ, hUv_open, hUv_pre, hΥ_eq, hh_holo, hφ_holo, hv₀⟩
    exact ⟨hU, U_v, h, φ, hUv_open, hUv_pre, fun p hp => hΥ_eq p (hUW₁ hp),
      hh_holo, hφ_holo, hv₀⟩

  have fn_eqOn_iff_pullback_id :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
        (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U ↔ MeroEqOnPullback F₁ F₂ id U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ U
    constructor
    · intro hEq
      refine ⟨fun p hp => (hEq.1 hp).1, fun p hp => (hEq.1 hp).2, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (hEq.1 hp).1
      have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (hEq.1 hp).2
      refine ⟨min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p),
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂),
        min_le_left _ _,
        fun q hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq,
        fun q hq => hEq.2 p hp q hq⟩
    · intro hPb
      refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hPb.1 hp, hPb.2.1 hp⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := hPb.1 hp
      have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := hPb.2.1 hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, _, _, hr_eq⟩ := hPb.2.2 p hp
      let R : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
      let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q - F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q
      have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p R) :=
        (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
          ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
      have hΔ_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r ∩ Metric.ball p R, Δ q = 0 := by
        rintro q ⟨hq_r, _⟩
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hr_eq q hq_r)
      intro q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_of_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p R)
        hΔ_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos⟩ hΔ_sub q hq)

  have fn_pullback_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
        (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) {U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        V ⊆ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ G F Υ U V hVU hPb
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU hPb.1, hPb.2.1.mono_left hVU, fun p hp => hPb.2.2 p (hVU hp)⟩

  have fn_eqOn_pullback_left :
      ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F : MeroOn2D W₂)
        (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ →
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F Υ U := by
    intro W₁ W₁' W₂ G₁ G₂ F Υ U hTri hEq hPb
    have hΥ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ U := triangular_holo hTri
    refine ⟨fun p hp => (hEq.1 hp).1, hPb.2.1, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpW₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (hEq.1 hp).1
    have hpW₁' : p ∈ W₁' := (hEq.1 hp).2
    have hΥp_W₂ : Υ p ∈ W₂ := hPb.2.1 hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, _, hr₂_maps, hr₂_eq⟩ := hPb.2.2 p hp
    obtain ⟨r_U, hr_U_pos, hr_U_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hTri.1 p hp
    let r : ℝ := min (min (G₁.rad p) (G₂.rad p)) (min r₂ r_U)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
      lt_min (lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p hpW₁) (G₂.rad_pos p hpW₁')) (lt_min hr₂_pos hr_U_pos)
    have hr_le_G₁ : r ≤ G₁.rad p := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_le_G₂ : r ≤ G₂.rad p := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr_le_r₂ : r ≤ r₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_sub_U : Metric.ball p r ⊆ U :=
      Set.Subset.trans
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hr_U_sub
    have hr_maps : Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ p) (F.rad (Υ p))) :=
      hr₂_maps.mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₂)
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le_G₁, hr_maps, ?_⟩
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun q => G₁.num p q * F.den (Υ p) (Υ q) - F.num (Υ p) (Υ q) * G₁.den p q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G₁)).mul
        ((F.den_holo (Υ p) hΥp_W₂).comp (hΥ_holo.mono hr_sub_U) hr_maps)).sub
      (((F.num_holo (Υ p) hΥp_W₂).comp (hΥ_holo.mono hr_sub_U) hr_maps).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G₁)))
    have hprod_zero :
        ∀ q ∈ (Metric.ball p r ∩ Metric.ball p r) ∩ Metric.ball p (G₂.rad p),
          Δ q * G₂.den p q = 0 := by
      rintro q ⟨⟨hq, _⟩, _⟩
      have e₁₂ := hEq.2 p hp q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
      have e₂F := hr₂_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₂ hq)
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination F.den (Υ p) (Υ q) * e₁₂ + G₁.den p q * e₂F
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (cancel_holo_of_convex_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r) hΔ_holo
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (G₂.rad p))
      (G₂.den_holo p hpW₁') (G₂.den_ne_zero p hpW₁')
      Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨p, ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self (G₂.rad_pos p hpW₁')⟩
      hprod_zero q hq)

  have fn_pullback_exists :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (F : MeroOn2D W₂),
        IsTriangularHoloMap W₁ Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ W₁ W₂ →
        ∃ G : MeroOn2D W₁, MeroEqOnPullback G F Υ W₁ := by
    classical
    intro W₁ W₂ Υ F hTri hMaps
    have hW₁_open : IsOpen W₁ := hTri.1
    have hΥ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ W₁ := triangular_holo hTri
    have h_nhds_pb : ∀ p ∈ W₁,
        ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ W₁ ∩ Υ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Υ p) (F.rad (Υ p)) := by
      intro p hp
      have hcont : ContinuousAt Υ p := hΥ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW₁_open.mem_nhds hp)
      have h_mem : W₁ ∩ Υ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Υ p) (F.rad (Υ p)) ∈ nhds p :=
        Filter.inter_mem (hW₁_open.mem_nhds hp)
          (hcont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (Υ p) (F.rad_pos (Υ p) (hMaps hp))))
      exact Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_mem
    let r_pb : ∀ p ∈ W₁, ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (h_nhds_pb p hp)
    have hr_pb : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W₁),
        0 < r_pb p hp ∧
          Metric.ball p (r_pb p hp) ⊆ W₁ ∩ Υ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Υ p) (F.rad (Υ p)) :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (h_nhds_pb p hp)
    let G : MeroOn2D W₁ := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W₁ then r_pb p hp else 1
      num := fun p q => F.num (Υ p) (Υ q)
      den := fun p q => F.den (Υ p) (Υ q)
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (hr_pb p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).1
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.num_holo (Υ p) (hMaps hp)).comp
          (hΥ_holo.mono (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).1))
          (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).2)
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact (F.den_holo (Υ p) (hMaps hp)).comp
          (hΥ_holo.mono (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).1))
          (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).2)
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [hp, ↓reduceDIte]
        exact triangular_pullback_ne_zero hTri hp (hr_pb p hp).1
          (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).1)
          (F.den_holo (Υ p) (hMaps hp)) (F.den_ne_zero (Υ p) (hMaps hp))
          (fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).2)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
        simp only [hp₁, hp₂, ↓reduceDIte] at hq
        exact F.compat (Υ p₁) (hMaps hp₁) (Υ p₂) (hMaps hp₂) (Υ q)
          ⟨((hr_pb p₁ hp₁).2 hq.1).2, ((hr_pb p₂ hp₂).2 hq.2).2⟩
    }
    refine ⟨G, Set.Subset.rfl, hMaps, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨r_pb p hp, (hr_pb p hp).1, ?_, fun q hq => ((hr_pb p hp).2 hq).2, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    simp only [G, hp, ↓reduceDIte, le_rfl]

  have fn_pullback_right_eqOn :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (G : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
        (Υ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ → Set.MapsTo Υ U V₂ →
        MeroEqOnPullback G F₁ Υ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOnPullback G F₂ Υ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₂' G F₁ F₂ Υ U V₂ hTri hMapsV₂ hPb hEq
    have hU_open : IsOpen U := hTri.1
    have hΥ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ U := triangular_holo hTri
    refine ⟨hPb.1, fun p hp => (hEq.1 (hMapsV₂ hp)).2, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpW₁ : p ∈ W₁ := hPb.1 hp
    have hΥp_V₂ : Υ p ∈ V₂ := hMapsV₂ hp
    have hΥp_W₂ : Υ p ∈ W₂ := (hEq.1 hΥp_V₂).1
    have hΥp_W₂' : Υ p ∈ W₂' := (hEq.1 hΥp_V₂).2
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, hr₁_maps, hr₁_eq⟩ := hPb.2.2 p hp
    let R₂ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad (Υ p)) (F₂.rad (Υ p))
    have hR₂_pos : 0 < R₂ := lt_min (F₁.rad_pos (Υ p) hΥp_W₂) (F₂.rad_pos (Υ p) hΥp_W₂')
    have hcont : ContinuousAt Υ p := hΥ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hp)
    have h_nhds : U ∩ Υ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Υ p) R₂ ∈ nhds p :=
      Filter.inter_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds hp)
        (hcont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (Υ p) hR₂_pos))
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    let r : ℝ := min r₁ r₀
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr₁_pos hr₀_pos
    have hr_le_G : r ≤ G.rad p := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₁_le
    have hr_sub_U : Metric.ball p r ⊆ U :=
      fun q hq => (hr₀_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).1
    have hr_maps_R₂ : Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ p) R₂) :=
      fun q hq => (hr₀_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).2
    have hr_maps_F₂ : Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ p) (F₂.rad (Υ p))) :=
      hr_maps_R₂.mono_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
    have hr_maps_F₁ : Set.MapsTo Υ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ p) (F₁.rad (Υ p))) :=
      hr₁_maps.mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le_G, hr_maps_F₂, ?_⟩
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun q => G.num p q * F₂.den (Υ p) (Υ q) - F₂.num (Υ p) (Υ q) * G.den p q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (((G.num_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G)).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo (Υ p) hΥp_W₂').comp (hΥ_holo.mono hr_sub_U) hr_maps_F₂)).sub
      (((F₂.num_holo (Υ p) hΥp_W₂').comp (hΥ_holo.mono hr_sub_U) hr_maps_F₂).mul
        ((G.den_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G)))
    have hprod_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, Δ q * F₁.den (Υ p) (Υ q) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have e_G1 := hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
      have e_12 := hEq.2 (Υ p) hΥp_V₂ (Υ q) (hr_maps_R₂ hq)
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination F₂.den (Υ p) (Υ q) * e_G1 + G.den p q * e_12
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (cancel_pullback_ball_2D hTri hp hr_pos le_rfl hr_sub_U
      hΔ_holo (F₁.den_holo (Υ p) hΥp_W₂) (F₁.den_ne_zero (Υ p) hΥp_W₂)
      hr_maps_F₁ hprod_zero q hq)

  have fn_pullback_comp :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F : MeroOn2D W₃)
        (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsTriangularHoloMap U₁ Υ₁ → IsTriangularHoloMap U₂ Υ₂ →
        Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U₁ U₂ →
        MeroEqOnPullback G₁ G₂ Υ₁ U₁ → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F Υ₂ U₂ →
        MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F (Υ₂ ∘ Υ₁) U₁ := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ G₁ G₂ F Υ₁ Υ₂ U₁ U₂ hTri₁ hTri₂ hMaps₁₂ hPb₁ hPb₂
    have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ := hTri₁.1
    have hU₂_open : IsOpen U₂ := hTri₂.1
    have hΥ₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ₁ U₁ := triangular_holo hTri₁
    have hΥ₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Υ₂ U₂ := triangular_holo hTri₂
    refine ⟨hPb₁.1, hPb₂.2.1.comp hMaps₁₂, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpW₁ : p ∈ W₁ := hPb₁.1 hp
    have hΥ₁p_U₂ : Υ₁ p ∈ U₂ := hMaps₁₂ hp
    have hΥ₁p_W₂ : Υ₁ p ∈ W₂ := hPb₁.2.1 hp
    have hΥ₂₁p_W₃ : Υ₂ (Υ₁ p) ∈ W₃ := hPb₂.2.1 hΥ₁p_U₂
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, hr₁_maps, hr₁_eq⟩ := hPb₁.2.2 p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, _, hr₂_maps, hr₂_eq⟩ := hPb₂.2.2 (Υ₁ p) hΥ₁p_U₂
    have hcont₁ : ContinuousAt Υ₁ p := hΥ₁_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU₁_open.mem_nhds hp)
    have h_nhds :
        U₁ ∩ Υ₁ ⁻¹' (U₂ ∩ Metric.ball (Υ₁ p) r₂) ∈ nhds p :=
      Filter.inter_mem (hU₁_open.mem_nhds hp)
        (hcont₁.preimage_mem_nhds
          ((hU₂_open.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
            ⟨hΥ₁p_U₂, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₂_pos⟩))
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    let r : ℝ := min r₁ r₀
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr₁_pos hr₀_pos
    have hr_le_G₁ : r ≤ G₁.rad p := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₁_le
    have hr_sub_U₁ : Metric.ball p r ⊆ U₁ :=
      fun q hq => (hr₀_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).1
    have hr_maps_U₂ : Set.MapsTo Υ₁ (Metric.ball p r) U₂ :=
      fun q hq => (hr₀_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).2.1
    have hr_maps_r₂ : Set.MapsTo Υ₁ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ₁ p) r₂) :=
      fun q hq => (hr₀_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).2.2
    have hr_maps_comp :
        Set.MapsTo (Υ₂ ∘ Υ₁) (Metric.ball p r)
          (Metric.ball (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) (F.rad (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)))) :=
      hr₂_maps.comp hr_maps_r₂
    have hr_maps_G₂ :
        Set.MapsTo Υ₁ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ₁ p) (G₂.rad (Υ₁ p))) :=
      hr₁_maps.mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le_G₁, hr_maps_comp, ?_⟩
    have hcomp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (Υ₂ ∘ Υ₁) (Metric.ball p r) :=
      hΥ₂_holo.comp (hΥ₁_holo.mono hr_sub_U₁) hr_maps_U₂
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun q =>
        G₁.num p q * F.den (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) (Υ₂ (Υ₁ q)) -
          F.num (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) (Υ₂ (Υ₁ q)) * G₁.den p q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G₁)).mul
        ((F.den_holo (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) hΥ₂₁p_W₃).comp hcomp_holo hr_maps_comp)).sub
      (((F.num_holo (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) hΥ₂₁p_W₃).comp hcomp_holo hr_maps_comp).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G₁)))
    have hprod_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, Δ q * G₂.den (Υ₁ p) (Υ₁ q) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have e₁ := hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq)
      have e₂ := hr₂_eq (Υ₁ q) (hr_maps_r₂ hq)
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination F.den (Υ₂ (Υ₁ p)) (Υ₂ (Υ₁ q)) * e₁ + G₁.den p q * e₂
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (cancel_pullback_ball_2D hTri₁ hp hr_pos le_rfl hr_sub_U₁
      hΔ_holo (G₂.den_holo (Υ₁ p) hΥ₁p_W₂) (G₂.den_ne_zero (Υ₁ p) hΥ₁p_W₂)
      hr_maps_G₂ hprod_zero q hq)

  have fn_pullback_congr_eqOn :
      ∀ {W₁ W₁' W₂ W₂' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        (G₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D W₁') (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₂) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂')
        (Υ₁ Υ₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (U V₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsTriangularHoloMap U Υ₁ → (∀ p ∈ U, Υ₁ p = Υ₂ p) → Set.MapsTo Υ₁ U V₂ →
        MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₁ Υ₁ U → MeroEqOnPullback G₂ F₂ Υ₂ U →
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₂ → MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ U := by
    intro W₁ W₁' W₂ W₂' G₁ G₂ F₁ F₂ Υ₁ Υ₂ U V₂ hTri₁ hCongr hMapsV₂ hPb₁ hPb₂ hEqF
    have hPb₁' : MeroEqOnPullback G₁ F₂ Υ₁ U :=
      fn_pullback_right_eqOn G₁ F₁ F₂ Υ₁ U V₂ hTri₁ hMapsV₂ hPb₁ hEqF
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hPb₁.1 hp, hPb₂.1 hp⟩, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hpW₁ : p ∈ W₁ := hPb₁.1 hp
    have hpW₁' : p ∈ W₁' := hPb₂.1 hp
    have hΥ₁p_W₂' : Υ₁ p ∈ W₂' := hPb₁'.2.1 hp
    let R : ℝ := min (G₁.rad p) (G₂.rad p)
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p hpW₁) (G₂.rad_pos p hpW₁')
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, _, hr₁_maps, hr₁_eq⟩ := hPb₁'.2.2 p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, _, _, hr₂_eq⟩ := hPb₂.2.2 p hp
    obtain ⟨r_U, hr_U_pos, hr_U_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hTri₁.1 p hp
    let r : ℝ := min R (min r₁ (min r₂ r_U))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
      lt_min hR_pos (lt_min hr₁_pos (lt_min hr₂_pos hr_U_pos))
    have hr_le_R : r ≤ R := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_le_r₁ : r ≤ r₁ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_le_r₂ : r ≤ r₂ :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hr_sub_U : Metric.ball p r ⊆ U :=
      Set.Subset.trans
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
        hr_U_sub
    have hr_maps_F₂ :
        Set.MapsTo Υ₁ (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.ball (Υ₁ p) (F₂.rad (Υ₁ p))) :=
      hr₁_maps.mono_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₁)
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => G₁.num p q * G₂.den p q - G₂.num p q * G₁.den p q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p R) :=
      (((G₁.num_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((G₂.den_holo p hpW₁').mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
      (((G₂.num_holo p hpW₁').mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
        ((G₁.den_holo p hpW₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hprod_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, Δ q * F₂.den (Υ₁ p) (Υ₁ q) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have e₁ := hr₁_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₁ hq)
      have e₂_raw := hr₂_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_r₂ hq)
      rw [← hCongr p hp, ← hCongr q (hr_sub_U hq)] at e₂_raw
      dsimp [Δ]
      linear_combination G₂.den p q * e₁ - G₁.den p q * e₂_raw
    intro q hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (cancel_pullback_ball_2D hTri₁ hp hr_pos hr_le_R hr_sub_U
      hΔ_holo (F₂.den_holo (Υ₁ p) hΥ₁p_W₂') (F₂.den_ne_zero (Υ₁ p) hΥ₁p_W₂')
      hr_maps_F₂ hprod_zero q hq)

  exact {
    ofHolo := fn_ofHolo
    eqOn_symm := fn_eqOn_symm
    eqOn_mono := fn_eqOn_mono
    eqOn_trans := fn_eqOn_trans
    eqOn_of_isPreconnected := fn_eqOn_of_isPreconnected
    restrictOpen := fn_restrictOpen
    glueCover := fn_glueCover
    glueBinary := fn_glueBinary
    triangular_mono := fn_triangular_mono
    eqOn_iff_pullback_id := fn_eqOn_iff_pullback_id
    pullback_mono := fn_pullback_mono
    eqOn_pullback_left := fn_eqOn_pullback_left
    pullback_exists := fn_pullback_exists
    pullback_right_eqOn := fn_pullback_right_eqOn
    pullback_comp := fn_pullback_comp
    pullback_congr_eqOn := fn_pullback_congr_eqOn
  }
