proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hs
  
  let a₀ : ℝ := (g 0).im
  have ha₀_pos : 0 < a₀ := by linarith
  let B_w : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_w
  let B_w2 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d_w / 2)
  let D_ζ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ)
  let C_ζ : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ)
  let A_ζ : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | 1 - d_ζ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < 1 + d_ζ }
  let B_t : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (Φ 0) δ_t
  let U_base2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }

  have h0_mem_Dζ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_ζ := Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)
  have h0_mem_Cζ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ C_ζ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h0_mem_Dζ
  have h0_mem_RΦ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ := Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)
  have hDζ_sub_RΦ : D_ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hd_ζ_lt_R)
  have hAζ_sub_Dζ : A_ζ ⊆ D_ζ := fun ζ hζ => by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hζ.2
  have hBw2_sub_Bw : B_w2 ⊆ B_w := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)

  obtain ⟨ζ_max, _, hζ_max⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ)).exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, h0_mem_Cζ⟩
      (continuous_norm.comp hg_holo.continuous).continuousOn
  let M_g : ℝ := ‖g ζ_max‖
  have hg_le : ∀ ζ ∈ C_ζ, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M_g := isMaxOn_iff.mp hζ_max
  have hg0_le : a₀ ≤ M_g :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_abs_self a₀) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (g 0))) (hg_le 0 h0_mem_Cζ)
  have hMg_pos : 0 < M_g := lt_of_lt_of_le ha₀_pos hg0_le

  obtain ⟨K, hK_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * M_g / d_w)
  have hK_real_pos : 0 < (K : ℝ) := lt_trans (div_pos (by linarith) hd_w) hK_gt
  have hK_ne : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hK_real_pos
  have hK_pos : 1 ≤ K := by
    have : 0 < K := Nat.cast_pos.mp hK_real_pos
    omega
  let Δ : ℝ := 1 / (K : ℝ)
  have hΔ_pos : 0 < Δ := one_div_pos.mpr hK_real_pos
  have hMg_step : Δ * M_g < d_w / 2 := by
    have h1 : 2 * M_g < (K : ℝ) * d_w := (div_lt_iff₀ hd_w).mp hK_gt
    have h2 : Δ * (2 * M_g) < Δ * ((K : ℝ) * d_w) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 hΔ_pos
    have h3 : Δ * ((K : ℝ) * d_w) = d_w := by
      calc Δ * ((K : ℝ) * d_w) = (Δ * (K : ℝ)) * d_w := by ring
        _ = 1 * d_w := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel hK_ne]
        _ = d_w := one_mul d_w
    have h4 : Δ * (2 * M_g) = 2 * (Δ * M_g) := by ring
    linarith
  have hStep_lt : ∀ ζ ∈ D_ζ, ‖(Δ : ℂ) * g ζ‖ < d_w / 2 := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hΔ_pos)]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg_le ζ (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hζ)) (le_of_lt hΔ_pos))
      hMg_step
  have hstep_a₀ : Δ * a₀ < d_w / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg0_le (le_of_lt hΔ_pos)) hMg_step
  have hstep_a₀_pos : 0 < Δ * a₀ := mul_pos hΔ_pos ha₀_pos

  
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun x₀ lam p => (p.1 + ((x₀ : ℂ) + (lam : ℂ) * g p.2), Φ p.2)
  let S_shift : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun c p => (p.1 + (c : ℂ) * g p.2, p.2)
  let T_horiz : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun c p => (p.1 + (c : ℂ), p.2)
  let Ω_map : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun x₀ lam p => (p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2), ψ p.2)
  let U_chart : ℝ → ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun x₀ lam => { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ B_t ∧ ‖p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ < d_w }
  let Hslab_slab : ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun c => { y : ℂ | |y.im - c| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w } ×ˢ B_t
  let V_mid : ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun c => { y : ℂ | |y.im - c| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w } ×ˢ B_t

  have meroEqOn_refl : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      U ⊆ W → MeroEqOn F F U := by
    intro W F U hU
    exact ⟨Set.subset_inter hU hU, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩

  have meroEqOn_of_cover : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
      {ι : Type} {V : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      (∀ p ∈ U, ∃ α, p ∈ V α) → (∀ α, MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ (V α)) → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ ι V U hcov hEq
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ?_, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨α, hpα⟩ := hcov p hp
      exact (hEq α).1 hpα
    · obtain ⟨α, hpα⟩ := hcov p hp
      exact (hEq α).2 p hpα q hq

  have hOpen_Aζ : IsOpen A_ζ :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have h1_mem_Aζ : (1 : ℂ) ∈ A_ζ := by
    show 1 - d_ζ < ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ∧ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ < 1 + d_ζ
    rw [norm_one]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hOpen_base2 : IsOpen U_base2 :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hOpen_Hslab : ∀ c : ℝ, IsOpen (Hslab_slab c) := fun c =>
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.sub continuous_const))
      continuous_const).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hOpen_Vmid : ∀ c : ℝ, IsOpen (V_mid c) := fun c =>
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.sub continuous_const))
      continuous_const).prod Metric.isOpen_ball

  have hOpen_chart_r : ∀ (x₀ lam r : ℝ),
      IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ B_t ∧ ‖p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ < r } := by
    intro x₀ lam r
    let f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)
    have hf_cont : ContinuousOn f (Set.univ ×ˢ B_t) := by
      have hψ_comp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ψ p.2) (Set.univ ×ˢ B_t) :=
        hψ_holo.continuousOn.comp continuousOn_snd (fun _ hp => hp.2)
      have hg_comp : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => g (ψ p.2)) (Set.univ ×ˢ B_t) :=
        hg_holo.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψ_comp
      exact (continuousOn_fst.sub continuousOn_const).sub (continuousOn_const.mul hg_comp)
    have hOpen_inter : IsOpen ((Set.univ ×ˢ B_t) ∩ f ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      hf_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_univ.prod Metric.isOpen_ball) Metric.isOpen_ball
    convert hOpen_inter using 1
    ext p
    simp [f, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]

  have hTri_Ψ : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (x₀ lam : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → (∀ p ∈ U, p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) →
      IsTriangularHoloMap U (Ψ x₀ lam) := by
    intro U x₀ lam hU hsub
    refine ⟨hU, Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ, fun ζ => (x₀ : ℂ) + (lam : ℂ) * g ζ, Φ,
      Metric.isOpen_ball, (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ).isPreconnected,
      fun p hp => ⟨hsub p hp, rfl⟩,
      (differentiableOn_const _).add ((hg_holo.const_mul _).differentiableOn),
      hΦ_holo, 0, h0_mem_RΦ, hΦ_deriv⟩

  have hTri_shift : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (c : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → IsTriangularHoloMap U (S_shift c) := by
    intro U c hU
    refine ⟨hU, Set.univ, fun ζ => (c : ℂ) * g ζ, id,
      isOpen_univ, isPreconnected_univ,
      fun p _ => ⟨trivial, rfl⟩,
      (hg_holo.const_mul _).differentiableOn,
      differentiableOn_id, 0, trivial, by simp⟩

  have hTri_horiz : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (c : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → IsTriangularHoloMap U (T_horiz c) := by
    intro U c hU
    refine ⟨hU, Set.univ, fun _ => (c : ℂ), id,
      isOpen_univ, isPreconnected_univ,
      fun p _ => ⟨trivial, rfl⟩,
      differentiableOn_const _,
      differentiableOn_id, 0, trivial, by simp⟩

  have hTri_id : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → IsTriangularHoloMap U id := by
    intro U hU
    refine ⟨hU, Set.univ, fun _ => 0, id,
      isOpen_univ, isPreconnected_univ,
      fun p _ => ⟨trivial, Prod.ext (add_zero p.1).symm rfl⟩,
      differentiableOn_const _,
      differentiableOn_id, 0, trivial, by simp⟩

  have hTri_Ω : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (x₀ lam : ℝ),
      IsOpen U → (∀ p ∈ U, p.2 ∈ B_t) →
      IsTriangularHoloMap U (Ω_map x₀ lam) := by
    intro U x₀ lam hU hsub
    have hgψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t' => g (ψ t')) B_t :=
      hg_holo.comp_differentiableOn hψ_holo
    refine ⟨hU, B_t, fun t' => -(x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ t'), ψ,
      Metric.isOpen_ball, (convex_ball (Φ 0) δ_t).isPreconnected,
      fun p hp => ⟨hsub p hp, Prod.ext (by simp [Ω_map]; ring) rfl⟩,
      (differentiableOn_const _).sub (hgψ_holo.const_mul _),
      hψ_holo, Φ 0, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t, hψ_deriv⟩

  have hCover_helper : ∀ (lam r : ℝ), |lam| ≤ 1 → ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      |p.1.im - lam * a₀| < r → p.2 ∈ B_t →
      ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ‖p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ < r + d_w / 4 := by
    intro lam r hlam p hp_im hp_t
    refine ⟨p.1.re - ((lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)).re, ?_⟩
    set z : ℂ := p.1 - ((p.1.re - ((lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)
    have hz_re : z.re = 0 := by simp [z]
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = |z.im| := (Complex.abs_im_eq_norm.mpr hz_re).symm
    have hz_im : z.im = (p.1.im - lam * a₀) - lam * (g (ψ p.2) - g 0).im := by
      simp [z, a₀]; ring
    have hdiff_lt : ‖g (ψ p.2) - g 0‖ < d_w / 4 := (hψ_props p.2 hp_t).2.2
    have him_le : |(g (ψ p.2) - g 0).im| ≤ ‖g (ψ p.2) - g 0‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    have hmul_le : |lam * (g (ψ p.2) - g 0).im| ≤ |(g (ψ p.2) - g 0).im| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hlam
    have habs_le : |z.im| ≤ |p.1.im - lam * a₀| + |lam * (g (ψ p.2) - g 0).im| := by
      rw [hz_im]
      exact abs_sub _ _
    rw [hz_norm]
    linarith

  
  let W_final : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < a₀ + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w } ×ˢ B_t
  let W_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ B_t

  have hComp : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∃ G_i : MeroOn2D W_final, MeroAgreesHolo G_i (F_init i) W_base := by
    intro i
    let f_init := F_init i
    let M := M_F i
    have hf_holo := hF_holo i
    have hM_ag := hM_agrees i
    have hBase_sub : U_base2 ⊆ W_tube := hM_ag.1

    
    have hAscent : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ K →
        ∃ G : ℕ → MeroOn2D (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ),
          MeroEqOnPullback (G 0) M (Ψ x₀ 0) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n →
            MeroEqOnPullback (G k) M (Ψ x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ)) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k < n →
            MeroEqOnPullback (G (k + 1)) (G k) (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ)) := by
      intro x₀ n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro _
        have hMaps0 : Set.MapsTo (Ψ x₀ 0) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) W_tube := by
          intro p hp
          apply hBase_sub
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · have hw : ‖p.1‖ < d_w := by simpa [B_w, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1
            have him : |(p.1 + ((x₀ : ℂ) + ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * g p.2)).im| = |p.1.im| := by simp
            rw [him]
            linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1]
          · have hΦp : Φ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base := hΦ_maps p.2 (hDζ_sub_RΦ hp.2)
            simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hΦp
        obtain ⟨G₀, hG₀⟩ := hKit.pullback_exists (Ψ x₀ 0) M
          (hTri_Ψ x₀ 0 (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball) (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ hp.2))
          hMaps0
        refine ⟨fun _ => G₀, hG₀, ?_, fun k hk => by omega⟩
        intro k hk
        have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
        subst hk0
        have h0_div : (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) = 0 := by simp
        rw [h0_div]
        exact hKit.pullback_mono G₀ M (Ψ x₀ 0) (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl hAζ_sub_Dζ) hG₀
      | succ n ih =>
        intro hn1
        obtain ⟨G_prev, hG0, hGann, hGstep⟩ := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn1)
        let lam_n : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
        let lam_n1 : ℝ := ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
        have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam_n1 := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hK_real_pos)
        have hlam1 : lam_n1 ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hK_real_pos).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn1)

        have hMaps_shift : Set.MapsTo (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) := by
          intro p hp
          refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          have hw : ‖p.1‖ < d_w / 2 := by simpa [B_w2, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1
          calc ‖p.1 + (Δ : ℂ) * g p.2‖
              ≤ ‖p.1‖ + ‖(Δ : ℂ) * g p.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ < d_w / 2 + d_w / 2 := add_lt_add hw (hStep_lt p.2 hp.2)
            _ = d_w := by ring
        obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ := hKit.pullback_exists (S_shift Δ) (G_prev n)
          (hTri_shift Δ (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)) hMaps_shift

        have hMaps_col : Set.MapsTo (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ) W_tube := by
          intro p hp
          have hcomm : p.1 + ((x₀ : ℂ) + (lam_n1 : ℂ) * g p.2) =
              (x₀ : ℂ) + (lam_n1 : ℂ) * g p.2 + p.1 := by ring
          show (p.1 + ((x₀ : ℂ) + (lam_n1 : ℂ) * g p.2), Φ p.2) ∈ W_tube
          rw [hcomm]
          exact hAnn_maps x₀ lam_n1 hlam0 hlam1 p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2.1 hp.2.2
        obtain ⟨F_col, hF_col⟩ := hKit.pullback_exists (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) M
          (hTri_Ψ x₀ lam_n1 (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
            (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
          hMaps_col

        have hMaps_shift_A : Set.MapsTo (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ) := by
          intro p hp
          exact ⟨(hMaps_shift ⟨hp.1, hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2⟩).1, hp.2⟩
        have hF₀_comp : MeroEqOnPullback F₀ M (Ψ x₀ lam_n ∘ S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
          hKit.pullback_comp F₀ (G_prev n) M (S_shift Δ) (Ψ x₀ lam_n)
            (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ)
            (hTri_shift Δ (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ))
            (hTri_Ψ x₀ lam_n (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
              (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
            hMaps_shift_A
            (hKit.pullback_mono F₀ (G_prev n) (S_shift Δ)
              (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl hAζ_sub_Dζ) hF₀)
            (hGann n (le_refl n))
        have hF_col_sub : MeroEqOnPullback F_col M (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
          hKit.pullback_mono F_col M (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (Set.prod_mono hBw2_sub_Bw Subset.rfl) hF_col
        have hΨ_eq : ∀ p ∈ B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ, Ψ x₀ lam_n1 p = (Ψ x₀ lam_n ∘ S_shift Δ) p := by
          intro p _
          have hlam_add : lam_n1 = lam_n + Δ := by
            simp only [lam_n1, lam_n, Δ]
            push_cast
            ring
          ext
          · simp only [Ψ, S_shift, Function.comp_apply, hlam_add]
            push_cast
            ring
          · rfl
        have hEq_col_0 : MeroEqOn F_col F₀ (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
          hKit.pullback_congr_eqOn F_col F₀ M M (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (Ψ x₀ lam_n ∘ S_shift Δ)
            (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) W_tube
            (hTri_Ψ x₀ lam_n1 (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
              (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
            hΨ_eq hF_col_sub.2.1 hF_col_sub hF₀_comp (meroEqOn_refl M Subset.rfl)

        obtain ⟨G_next, hG_next_col⟩ :=
          hDisk d_w (1 - d_ζ) (1 + d_ζ) 0 (d_w / 2)
            hd_w (by linarith) (by linarith) (half_pos hd_w) hBw2_sub_Bw F_col F₀ hEq_col_0

        have hG_next_ann : MeroEqOnPullback G_next M (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
          hKit.eqOn_pullback_left G_next F_col M (Ψ x₀ lam_n1) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ)
            (hTri_Ψ x₀ lam_n1 (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
              (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
            hG_next_col hF_col

        have hG_next_F0_A : MeroEqOn G_next F₀ (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
          hKit.eqOn_trans G_next F_col F₀ (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ)
            (hKit.eqOn_mono G_next F_col (Set.prod_mono hBw2_sub_Bw Subset.rfl) hG_next_col)
            hEq_col_0
        have hG_next_F0 : MeroEqOn G_next F₀ (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
          hKit.eqOn_of_isPreconnected G_next F₀ (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) (B_w2 ×ˢ A_ζ)
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
            ((convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (d_w / 2)).prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ))).isPreconnected
            (Set.subset_inter (Set.prod_mono hBw2_sub_Bw Subset.rfl) Subset.rfl)
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
            ⟨((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hd_w), h1_mem_Aζ⟩
            (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl hAζ_sub_Dζ)
            hG_next_F0_A
        have hG_next_step : MeroEqOnPullback G_next (G_prev n) (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
          hKit.eqOn_pullback_left G_next F₀ (G_prev n) (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ)
            (hTri_shift Δ (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball))
            hG_next_F0 hF₀

        refine ⟨fun k => if k ≤ n then G_prev k else G_next, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · dsimp only
          split_ifs
          · exact hG0
          · omega
        · intro k hk
          dsimp only
          split_ifs with hkn
          · exact hGann k hkn
          · have hkeq : k = n + 1 := by omega
            rw [hkeq]
            exact hG_next_ann
        · intro k hk
          dsimp only
          split_ifs with h1 h2
          · exact hGstep k (by omega)
          · omega
          · have hkeq : k = n := by omega
            rw [hkeq]
            exact hG_next_step
          · omega

    let G_x : ℝ → ℕ → MeroOn2D (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
      fun x₀ => Classical.choose (hAscent x₀ K (le_refl K))
    have hGx_0 : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, MeroEqOnPullback (G_x x₀ 0) M (Ψ x₀ 0) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
      fun x₀ => (Classical.choose_spec (hAscent x₀ K (le_refl K))).1
    have hGx_ann : ∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), k ≤ K →
        MeroEqOnPullback (G_x x₀ k) M (Ψ x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
      fun x₀ => (Classical.choose_spec (hAscent x₀ K (le_refl K))).2.1
    have hGx_step : ∀ (x₀ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), k < K →
        MeroEqOnPullback (G_x x₀ (k + 1)) (G_x x₀ k) (S_shift Δ) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
      fun x₀ => (Classical.choose_spec (hAscent x₀ K (le_refl K))).2.2

    
    have hHoriz : ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ K →
        ∃ S_k : MeroOn2D (Hslab_slab (((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀)),
          ∀ x₀ : ℝ, MeroEqOnPullback S_k (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)))
            (Hslab_slab (((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))) := by
      intro k hk
      let lam : ℝ := (k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
      have hlam_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hK_real_pos)
      have hlam_le_one : lam ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hK_real_pos).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      have hlam_abs : |lam| ≤ 1 := by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hlam_nonneg]

      have hChart_pb : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          ∃ H : MeroOn2D (U_chart x₀ lam),
            MeroEqOnPullback H (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam) (U_chart x₀ lam) := by
        intro x₀
        refine hKit.pullback_exists (Ω_map x₀ lam) (G_x x₀ k)
          (hTri_Ω x₀ lam (hOpen_chart_r x₀ lam d_w) (fun _ hp => hp.1)) ?_
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨?_, (hψ_props p.2 hp.1).1⟩
        simpa [B_w, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
      let H_chart : ∀ x₀ : ℝ, MeroOn2D (U_chart x₀ lam) :=
        fun x₀ => Classical.choose (hChart_pb x₀)
      have hH_chart : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          MeroEqOnPullback (H_chart x₀) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam) (U_chart x₀ lam) :=
        fun x₀ => Classical.choose_spec (hChart_pb x₀)

      have hCompat : ∀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
          MeroEqOn (H_chart x₁) (H_chart x₂) (U_chart x₁ lam ∩ U_chart x₂ lam) := by
        intro x₁ x₂
        let U₁₂ := U_chart x₁ lam ∩ U_chart x₂ lam
        by_cases hne : U₁₂.Nonempty
        · obtain ⟨p_star, hp1, hp2⟩ := hne
          let B₁₂ : Set ℂ := B_w ∩ Metric.ball ((x₂ - x₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) d_w
          have hOpen_B12 : IsOpen B₁₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
          have hConv_B12 : Convex ℝ B₁₂ := (convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_ball _ _)
          have hB12_sub_Bw : B₁₂ ⊆ B_w := Set.inter_subset_left

          let w_star : ℂ := p_star.1 - (x₁ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p_star.2)
          have hw_star : w_star ∈ B₁₂ := by
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
            · simpa [B_w, w_star, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp1.2
            · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
              have hrew : w_star - ((x₂ - x₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
                  p_star.1 - (x₂ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p_star.2) := by
                simp only [w_star]
                push_cast
                ring
              rw [hrew]
              exact hp2.2

          have hMaps_T12_D : Set.MapsTo (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) := by
            intro q hq
            refine ⟨?_, hq.2⟩
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
            have hq_dist : ‖q.1 - ((x₂ - x₁ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < d_w := by
              simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq.1.2
            have hrew : q.1 + ((x₁ - x₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) = q.1 - ((x₂ - x₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              push_cast
              ring
            dsimp only [T_horiz]
            rwa [hrew]
          have hMaps_T12_A : Set.MapsTo (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
            fun q hq => ⟨(hMaps_T12_D ⟨hq.1, hAζ_sub_Dζ hq.2⟩).1, hq.2⟩

          obtain ⟨G₁₂, hG₁₂⟩ := hKit.pullback_exists (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (G_x x₂ k)
            (hTri_horiz (x₁ - x₂) (hOpen_B12.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)) hMaps_T12_D
          have hG12_comp : MeroEqOnPullback G₁₂ M (Ψ x₂ lam ∘ T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
            hKit.pullback_comp G₁₂ (G_x x₂ k) M (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (Ψ x₂ lam)
              (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) (B_w ×ˢ A_ζ)
              (hTri_horiz (x₁ - x₂) (hOpen_B12.prod hOpen_Aζ))
              (hTri_Ψ x₂ lam (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hOpen_Aζ)
                (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
              hMaps_T12_A
              (hKit.pullback_mono G₁₂ (G_x x₂ k) (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂))
                (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl hAζ_sub_Dζ) hG₁₂)
              (hGx_ann x₂ k hk)
          have hGx1_sub : MeroEqOnPullback (G_x x₁ k) M (Ψ x₁ lam) (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
            hKit.pullback_mono (G_x x₁ k) M (Ψ x₁ lam)
              (Set.prod_mono hB12_sub_Bw Subset.rfl) (hGx_ann x₁ k hk)
          have hΨ_T12 : ∀ q ∈ B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ, Ψ x₁ lam q = (Ψ x₂ lam ∘ T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) q := by
            intro q _
            ext
            · simp only [Ψ, T_horiz, Function.comp_apply]
              push_cast
              ring
            · rfl
          have hEq_B12_A : MeroEqOn (G_x x₁ k) G₁₂ (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) :=
            hKit.pullback_congr_eqOn (G_x x₁ k) G₁₂ M M
              (Ψ x₁ lam) (Ψ x₂ lam ∘ T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ) W_tube
              (hTri_Ψ x₁ lam (hOpen_B12.prod hOpen_Aζ)
                (fun p hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ (hAζ_sub_Dζ hp.2)))
              hΨ_T12 hGx1_sub.2.1 hGx1_sub hG12_comp (meroEqOn_refl M Subset.rfl)
          have hEq_B12_D : MeroEqOn (G_x x₁ k) G₁₂ (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
            hKit.eqOn_of_isPreconnected (G_x x₁ k) G₁₂ (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ) (B₁₂ ×ˢ A_ζ)
              (hOpen_B12.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
              (hConv_B12.prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (1 + d_ζ))).isPreconnected
              (Set.subset_inter (Set.prod_mono hB12_sub_Bw Subset.rfl) Subset.rfl)
              (hOpen_B12.prod hOpen_Aζ)
              ⟨(w_star, (1 : ℂ)), hw_star, h1_mem_Aζ⟩
              (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl hAζ_sub_Dζ)
              hEq_B12_A
          have hPb_12 : MeroEqOnPullback (G_x x₁ k) (G_x x₂ k) (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ) :=
            hKit.eqOn_pullback_left (G_x x₁ k) G₁₂ (G_x x₂ k) (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ)
              (hTri_horiz (x₁ - x₂) (hOpen_B12.prod Metric.isOpen_ball))
              hEq_B12_D hG₁₂

          have hOpen_U12 : IsOpen U₁₂ :=
            (hOpen_chart_r x₁ lam d_w).inter (hOpen_chart_r x₂ lam d_w)
          have hMaps_U12 : Set.MapsTo (Ω_map x₁ lam) U₁₂ (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ) := by
            intro p hp
            refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, (hψ_props p.2 hp.1.1).1⟩
            · simpa [B_w, Ω_map, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1.2
            · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
              have hrew : (p.1 - (x₁ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)) - ((x₂ - x₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
                  p.1 - (x₂ : ℂ) - (lam : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2) := by
                push_cast
                ring
              dsimp only [Ω_map]
              rw [hrew]
              exact hp.2.2
          have hH1_comp : MeroEqOnPullback (H_chart x₁) (G_x x₂ k)
              (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂) ∘ Ω_map x₁ lam) U₁₂ :=
            hKit.pullback_comp (H_chart x₁) (G_x x₁ k) (G_x x₂ k)
              (Ω_map x₁ lam) (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂)) U₁₂ (B₁₂ ×ˢ D_ζ)
              (hTri_Ω x₁ lam hOpen_U12 (fun _ hp => hp.1.1))
              (hTri_horiz (x₁ - x₂) (hOpen_B12.prod Metric.isOpen_ball))
              hMaps_U12
              (hKit.pullback_mono (H_chart x₁) (G_x x₁ k) (Ω_map x₁ lam)
                Set.inter_subset_left (hH_chart x₁))
              hPb_12
          have hH2_sub : MeroEqOnPullback (H_chart x₂) (G_x x₂ k) (Ω_map x₂ lam) U₁₂ :=
            hKit.pullback_mono (H_chart x₂) (G_x x₂ k) (Ω_map x₂ lam)
              Set.inter_subset_right (hH_chart x₂)
          have hΩ_eq : ∀ p ∈ U₁₂, (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂) ∘ Ω_map x₁ lam) p = Ω_map x₂ lam p := by
            intro p _
            ext
            · simp only [T_horiz, Ω_map, Function.comp_apply]
              push_cast
              ring
            · rfl
          exact hKit.eqOn_symm (H_chart x₂) (H_chart x₁) U₁₂
            (hKit.pullback_congr_eqOn (H_chart x₂) (H_chart x₁) (G_x x₂ k) (G_x x₂ k)
              (Ω_map x₂ lam) (T_horiz (x₁ - x₂) ∘ Ω_map x₁ lam) U₁₂ (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ)
              (hTri_Ω x₂ lam hOpen_U12 (fun _ hp => hp.2.1))
              (fun p hp => (hΩ_eq p hp).symm)
              hH2_sub.2.1 hH2_sub hH1_comp (meroEqOn_refl (G_x x₂ k) Subset.rfl))
        · have hEmpty : U₁₂ = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
          change MeroEqOn (H_chart x₁) (H_chart x₂) U₁₂
          rw [hEmpty]
          exact ⟨Set.empty_subset _, fun _ hp => False.elim hp⟩

      have hCover_Hslab : Hslab_slab (lam * a₀) ⊆ ⋃ x₀ : ℝ, U_chart x₀ lam := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hCover_helper lam ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) hlam_abs p hp.1 hp.2
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x₀, hp.2, by linarith⟩

      obtain ⟨S_k, hS_k⟩ := hKit.glueCover (fun x₀ : ℝ => U_chart x₀ lam) (Hslab_slab (lam * a₀))
        H_chart (fun x₀ => hOpen_chart_r x₀ lam d_w) (hOpen_Hslab (lam * a₀)) hCover_Hslab hCompat
      refine ⟨S_k, fun x₀ => ?_⟩
      exact hKit.eqOn_pullback_left S_k (H_chart x₀) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam)
        (Hslab_slab (lam * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam)
        (hTri_Ω x₀ lam ((hOpen_Hslab (lam * a₀)).inter (hOpen_chart_r x₀ lam d_w))
          (fun _ hp => hp.2.1))
        (hS_k x₀)
        (hKit.pullback_mono (H_chart x₀) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam)
          Set.inter_subset_right (hH_chart x₀))

    let S_slab : ∀ (k : ℕ), k ≤ K → MeroOn2D (Hslab_slab (((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀)) :=
      fun k hk => Classical.choose (hHoriz k hk)
    have hS_slab : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ K) (x₀ : ℝ),
        MeroEqOnPullback (S_slab k hk) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)))
          (Hslab_slab (((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ))) :=
      fun k hk => Classical.choose_spec (hHoriz k hk)

    
    have hBaseBridge : MeroAgreesHolo (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) f_init
        (Hslab_slab ((((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀)) := by
      let lam₀ : ℝ := ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
      have hlam₀ : lam₀ = 0 := by simp [lam₀]
      have hHslab0_sub : Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀) ⊆ U_base2 := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have him : |p.1.im - lam₀ * a₀| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1
          rw [hlam₀, zero_mul, sub_zero] at him
          linarith
        · have ht : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base := hδ_t_sub hp.2
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
      obtain ⟨H_base2, _, hBase2_iff⟩ := hKit.ofHolo U_base2 f_init hOpen_base2 hf_holo
      have hH_eq_M : MeroEqOn H_base2 M U_base2 :=
        hKit.eqOn_symm M H_base2 U_base2
          ((hBase2_iff W_tube M U_base2 hOpen_base2 Subset.rfl).mp hM_ag)

      have hChart_eq : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          MeroEqOn H_base2 (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K))
            (Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam₀) := by
        intro x₀
        let W_x₀ := Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam₀
        have hOpen_Wx : IsOpen W_x₀ :=
          (hOpen_Hslab (lam₀ * a₀)).inter (hOpen_chart_r x₀ lam₀ d_w)
        have hWx_sub : W_x₀ ⊆ U_base2 := Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left hHslab0_sub
        have hId_pb : MeroEqOnPullback H_base2 H_base2 id W_x₀ :=
          (hKit.eqOn_iff_pullback_id H_base2 H_base2 W_x₀).mp (meroEqOn_refl H_base2 hWx_sub)
        have hMaps_Ω : Set.MapsTo (Ω_map x₀ lam₀) W_x₀ (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ) := by
          intro p hp
          refine ⟨?_, (hψ_props p.2 hp.2.1).1⟩
          simpa [B_w, Ω_map, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2.2
        have hS0_comp : MeroEqOnPullback (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) M
            (Ψ x₀ 0 ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₀) W_x₀ :=
          hKit.pullback_comp (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) (G_x x₀ 0) M
            (Ω_map x₀ lam₀) (Ψ x₀ 0) W_x₀ (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ)
            (hTri_Ω x₀ lam₀ hOpen_Wx (fun _ hp => hp.2.1))
            (hTri_Ψ x₀ 0 (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
              (fun _ hp => hDζ_sub_RΦ hp.2))
            hMaps_Ω
            (hS_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K) x₀)
            (hGx_0 x₀)
        have hId_eq : ∀ p ∈ W_x₀, id p = (Ψ x₀ 0 ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₀) p := by
          intro p hp
          ext
          · simp only [id, Ψ, Ω_map, Function.comp_apply, hlam₀]
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [id, Ψ, Ω_map, Function.comp_apply]
            exact ((hψ_props p.2 hp.2.1).2.1).symm
        exact hKit.pullback_congr_eqOn H_base2 (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) H_base2 M
          id (Ψ x₀ 0 ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₀) W_x₀ U_base2
          (hTri_id hOpen_Wx) hId_eq (fun _ hp => hWx_sub hp) hId_pb hS0_comp hH_eq_M

      have hCover_0 : ∀ p ∈ Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀), ∃ x₀ : ℝ, p ∈ Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam₀ := by
        intro p hp
        have hlam0_abs : |lam₀| ≤ 1 := by rw [hlam₀]; norm_num
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hCover_helper lam₀ ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) hlam0_abs p hp.1 hp.2
        exact ⟨x₀, hp, hp.2, by linarith⟩
      have hEq_Hslab0 : MeroEqOn (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) H_base2 (Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀)) :=
        hKit.eqOn_symm H_base2 (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) (Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀))
          (meroEqOn_of_cover H_base2 (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) hCover_0 hChart_eq)
      exact (hBase2_iff (Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀)) (S_slab 0 (Nat.zero_le K)) (Hslab_slab (lam₀ * a₀))
        (hOpen_Hslab (lam₀ * a₀)) hHslab0_sub).mpr hEq_Hslab0

    have hAdjBridge : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < K),
        MeroEqOn (S_slab k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)) (S_slab (k + 1) (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk))
          (V_mid ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀)) := by
      intro k hk
      let hk_le := Nat.le_of_lt hk
      let hk_succ := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk
      let lam₁ : ℝ := (k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
      let lam₂ : ℝ := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)
      have hlam_add : lam₂ = lam₁ + Δ := by
        simp only [lam₁, lam₂, Δ]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hlam2_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam₂ := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hK_real_pos)
      have hlam2_le_one : lam₂ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hK_real_pos).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk_succ)
      have hlam2_abs : |lam₂| ≤ 1 := by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hlam2_nonneg]

      let V_chart : ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun x₀ =>
        V_mid (lam₂ * a₀) ∩
          { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ B_t ∧ ‖p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam₂ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ < d_w / 2 }

      have hV_eq : ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          MeroEqOn (S_slab k hk_le) (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ) (V_chart x₀) := by
        intro x₀
        have hOpen_Vx : IsOpen (V_chart x₀) :=
          (hOpen_Vmid (lam₂ * a₀)).inter (hOpen_chart_r x₀ lam₂ (d_w / 2))
        have hSub₂ : V_chart x₀ ⊆ Hslab_slab (lam₂ * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam₂ := by
          intro p hp
          have hp_im : |p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1.1
          exact ⟨⟨show |p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w by linarith, hp.1.2⟩,
            hp.2.1, by linarith [hp.2.2]⟩
        have hSub₁ : V_chart x₀ ⊆ Hslab_slab (lam₁ * a₀) ∩ U_chart x₀ lam₁ := by
          intro p hp
          have hp_im : |p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1.1
          refine ⟨⟨?_, hp.1.2⟩, hp.2.1, ?_⟩
          · show |p.1.im - lam₁ * a₀| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w
            have hrew : p.1.im - lam₁ * a₀ = (p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀) + Δ * a₀ := by
              rw [hlam_add]; ring
            rw [hrew]
            have habs : |(p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀) + Δ * a₀| ≤ |p.1.im - lam₂ * a₀| + |Δ * a₀| :=
              abs_add_le _ _
            rw [abs_of_pos hstep_a₀_pos] at habs
            linarith
          · have hrew : p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam₁ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2) =
                (p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam₂ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)) + (Δ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2) := by
              rw [hlam_add]
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [hrew]
            calc ‖(p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam₂ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)) + (Δ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖
                ≤ ‖p.1 - (x₀ : ℂ) - (lam₂ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ + ‖(Δ : ℂ) * g (ψ p.2)‖ :=
                  norm_add_le _ _
              _ < d_w / 2 + d_w / 2 :=
                  add_lt_add hp.2.2 (hStep_lt (ψ p.2) (hψ_props p.2 hp.2.1).1)
              _ = d_w := by ring
        have hMaps_V : Set.MapsTo (Ω_map x₀ lam₂) (V_chart x₀) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ) := by
          intro p hp
          refine ⟨?_, (hψ_props p.2 hp.2.1).1⟩
          simpa [B_w2, Ω_map, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2.2
        have hS1_sub : MeroEqOnPullback (S_slab k hk_le) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam₁) (V_chart x₀) :=
          hKit.pullback_mono (S_slab k hk_le) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam₁)
            hSub₁ (hS_slab k hk_le x₀)
        have hS2_comp : MeroEqOnPullback (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ) (G_x x₀ k)
            (S_shift Δ ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₂) (V_chart x₀) :=
          hKit.pullback_comp (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ) (G_x x₀ (k + 1)) (G_x x₀ k)
            (Ω_map x₀ lam₂) (S_shift Δ) (V_chart x₀) (B_w2 ×ˢ D_ζ)
            (hTri_Ω x₀ lam₂ hOpen_Vx (fun _ hp => hp.2.1))
            (hTri_shift Δ (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball))
            hMaps_V
            (hKit.pullback_mono (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ) (G_x x₀ (k + 1)) (Ω_map x₀ lam₂)
              hSub₂ (hS_slab (k + 1) hk_succ x₀))
            (hGx_step x₀ k hk)
        have hShift_Ω : ∀ p ∈ V_chart x₀, Ω_map x₀ lam₁ p = (S_shift Δ ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₂) p := by
          intro p _
          ext
          · simp only [Ω_map, S_shift, Function.comp_apply, hlam_add]
            push_cast
            ring
          · rfl
        exact hKit.pullback_congr_eqOn (S_slab k hk_le) (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ)
          (G_x x₀ k) (G_x x₀ k) (Ω_map x₀ lam₁) (S_shift Δ ∘ Ω_map x₀ lam₂)
          (V_chart x₀) (B_w ×ˢ D_ζ)
          (hTri_Ω x₀ lam₁ hOpen_Vx (fun _ hp => hp.2.1))
          hShift_Ω hS1_sub.2.1 hS1_sub hS2_comp
          (meroEqOn_refl (G_x x₀ k) Subset.rfl)

      have hCover_V : ∀ p ∈ V_mid (lam₂ * a₀), ∃ x₀ : ℝ, p ∈ V_chart x₀ := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hCover_helper lam₂ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) hlam2_abs p hp.1 hp.2
        exact ⟨x₀, hp, hp.2, by linarith⟩
      exact meroEqOn_of_cover (S_slab k hk_le) (S_slab (k + 1) hk_succ) hCover_V hV_eq

    
    let c_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((k : ℝ) / (K : ℝ)) * a₀
    let W_strip : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun k =>
      { y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < max s_base (c_fn k + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) } ×ˢ B_t

    have hOpen_strip : ∀ L U : ℝ, IsOpen ({ y : ℂ | L < y.im ∧ y.im < U } ×ˢ B_t) :=
      fun L U =>
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hConv_strip : ∀ L U : ℝ, Convex ℝ ({ y : ℂ | L < y.im ∧ y.im < U } ×ˢ B_t) :=
      fun L U =>
        ((convex_Ioo L U).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).prod
          (convex_ball (Φ 0) δ_t)
    have hConv_Hslab : ∀ c : ℝ, Convex ℝ (Hslab_slab c) := by
      intro c
      have hEq : Hslab_slab c =
          { y : ℂ | c - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w < y.im ∧ y.im < c + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w } ×ˢ B_t := by
        ext p
        change |p.1.im - c| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w ∧ p.2 ∈ B_t ↔
          (c - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < c + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) ∧ p.2 ∈ B_t
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> intro ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h2⟩
      rw [hEq]
      exact hConv_strip _ _

    have hc_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ c_fn m := fun m =>
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (le_of_lt hK_real_pos)) (le_of_lt ha₀_pos)
    have hHslab_sub_W : ∀ m : ℕ, Hslab_slab (c_fn m) ⊆ W_strip m := by
      intro m p hp
      have hp1 : |p.1.im - c_fn m| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1
      obtain ⟨hlow, hhigh⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp1
      have hcm := hc_nonneg m
      refine ⟨⟨by linarith, lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hW_mono : ∀ {m₁ m₂ : ℕ}, m₁ ≤ m₂ → W_strip m₁ ⊆ W_strip m₂ := by
      intro m₁ m₂ hm p hp
      have hcm : c_fn m₁ ≤ c_fn m₂ := by
        simp only [c_fn]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hm) (le_of_lt hK_real_pos))
          (le_of_lt ha₀_pos)
      refine ⟨⟨hp.1.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1.2 (max_le_max_left s_base (by linarith))⟩, hp.2⟩

    have hW0_sub_base2 : W_strip 0 ⊆ U_base2 := by
      intro p hp
      have hc0 : c_fn 0 = 0 := by simp [c_fn]
      have hmax0 : max s_base (c_fn 0 + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) = s_base := by
        rw [hc0, zero_add]
        exact max_eq_left (by linarith)
      have him_lt : p.1.im < s_base := by simpa [W_strip, hmax0] using hp.1.2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [abs_lt]
        exact ⟨by linarith [hp.1.1], by linarith⟩
      · have ht : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base := hδ_t_sub hp.2
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht

    obtain ⟨E₀, _, hE₀_iff⟩ :=
      hKit.ofHolo (W_strip 0) f_init (hOpen_strip _ _) (hf_holo.mono hW0_sub_base2)

    have hVert : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ hk : k ≤ K,
        ∃ E_k : MeroOn2D (W_strip k),
          MeroEqOn E_k E₀ (W_strip 0) ∧
          MeroEqOn E_k (S_slab k hk) (Hslab_slab (c_fn k)) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro hk
        refine ⟨E₀, meroEqOn_refl E₀ Subset.rfl, ?_⟩
        exact hKit.eqOn_symm (S_slab 0 hk) E₀ (Hslab_slab (c_fn 0))
          ((hE₀_iff (Hslab_slab (c_fn 0)) (S_slab 0 hk) (Hslab_slab (c_fn 0))
            (hOpen_Hslab (c_fn 0)) (hHslab_sub_W 0)).mp hBaseBridge)
      | succ k ih =>
        intro hk1
        have hk_lt : k < K := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk1
        have hk_le : k ≤ K := Nat.le_of_lt hk_lt
        obtain ⟨E_k, hEk_0, hEk_S⟩ := ih hk_le

        have hc_diff : c_fn (k + 1) - c_fn k = Δ * a₀ := by
          simp only [c_fn, Δ]
          push_cast
          ring

        have hUnion : W_strip (k + 1) ⊆ W_strip k ∪ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1)) := by
          intro p hp
          by_cases hlt : p.1.im < max s_base (c_fn k + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w)
          · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hp.1.1, hlt⟩, hp.2⟩
          · right
            have hge : max s_base (c_fn k + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w) ≤ p.1.im := not_lt.mp hlt
            obtain ⟨hs_le, hck_le⟩ := max_le_iff.mp hge
            have hupper : p.1.im < c_fn (k + 1) + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := by
              rcases lt_max_iff.mp hp.1.2 with h1 | h2
              · linarith
              · exact h2
            refine ⟨show |p.1.im - c_fn (k + 1)| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w from
              abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hp.2⟩

        have hV_sub_inter : V_mid (c_fn (k + 1)) ⊆ W_strip k ∩ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1)) := by
          intro p hp
          have hp1 : |p.1.im - c_fn (k + 1)| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp1
          have hp_Hslabk1 : p ∈ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1)) :=
            ⟨show |p.1.im - c_fn (k + 1)| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w from
              abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hp.2⟩
          have hp_Hslabk : p ∈ Hslab_slab (c_fn k) :=
            ⟨show |p.1.im - c_fn k| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w from
              abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hp.2⟩
          exact ⟨hHslab_sub_W k hp_Hslabk, hp_Hslabk1⟩

        have hV_nonempty : (V_mid (c_fn (k + 1))).Nonempty := by
          refine ⟨(((c_fn (k + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, Φ 0), ?_, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t⟩
          show |(((c_fn (k + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im - c_fn (k + 1)| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w
          simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im,
            Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re]
          norm_num
          linarith

        have hV_sub_Hslabk : V_mid (c_fn (k + 1)) ⊆ Hslab_slab (c_fn k) := by
          intro p hp
          have hp1 : |p.1.im - c_fn (k + 1)| < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w := hp.1
          obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp1
          exact ⟨show |p.1.im - c_fn k| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) * d_w from
            abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hp.2⟩

        have hEq_V : MeroEqOn E_k (S_slab (k + 1) hk1) (V_mid (c_fn (k + 1))) :=
          hKit.eqOn_trans E_k (S_slab k hk_le) (S_slab (k + 1) hk1) (V_mid (c_fn (k + 1)))
            (hKit.eqOn_mono E_k (S_slab k hk_le) hV_sub_Hslabk hEk_S)
            (hAdjBridge k hk_lt)

        have hEq_inter : MeroEqOn E_k (S_slab (k + 1) hk1)
            (W_strip k ∩ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1))) :=
          hKit.eqOn_of_isPreconnected E_k (S_slab (k + 1) hk1)
            (W_strip k ∩ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1))) (V_mid (c_fn (k + 1)))
            ((hOpen_strip _ _).inter (hOpen_Hslab _))
            ((hConv_strip _ _).inter (hConv_Hslab _)).isPreconnected
            Subset.rfl
            (hOpen_Vmid _)
            hV_nonempty
            hV_sub_inter
            hEq_V

        obtain ⟨E_next, hEnext_W, hEnext_Hslab⟩ :=
          hKit.glueBinary E_k (S_slab (k + 1) hk1)
            (hOpen_strip _ _) (hOpen_Hslab _) (hOpen_strip _ _) hUnion hEq_inter

        refine ⟨E_next, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have h0_sub : W_strip 0 ⊆ W_strip (k + 1) ∩ W_strip k :=
            Set.subset_inter (hW_mono (Nat.zero_le _)) (hW_mono (Nat.zero_le _))
          exact hKit.eqOn_trans E_next E_k E₀ (W_strip 0)
            (hKit.eqOn_mono E_next E_k h0_sub hEnext_W) hEk_0
        · have hHslab_sub : Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1)) ⊆ W_strip (k + 1) ∩ Hslab_slab (c_fn (k + 1)) :=
            Set.subset_inter (hHslab_sub_W (k + 1)) Subset.rfl
          exact hKit.eqOn_mono E_next (S_slab (k + 1) hk1) hHslab_sub hEnext_Hslab

    obtain ⟨E_K, hEK_0, _⟩ := hVert K (le_refl K)
    have hcK : c_fn K = a₀ := by
      simp only [c_fn, div_self hK_ne, one_mul]
    have hWfinal_sub : W_final ⊆ W_strip K := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨⟨hp.1.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1.2 ?_⟩, hp.2⟩
      rw [hcK]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    obtain ⟨G_final, hG_final⟩ := hKit.restrictOpen E_K W_final (hOpen_strip _ _) hWfinal_sub

    have hOpen_Wbase : IsOpen W_base :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).prod
        Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hWbase_sub_W0 : W_base ⊆ W_strip 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : |p.1.im| < s_base := hp.1
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp1
      exact ⟨⟨h1, lt_of_lt_of_le h2 (le_max_left _ _)⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hWbase_sub_Wfinal : W_base ⊆ W_final := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : |p.1.im| < s_base := hp.1
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp1
      exact ⟨⟨h1, by linarith⟩, hp.2⟩

    have hGfinal_E0 : MeroEqOn G_final E₀ W_base :=
      hKit.eqOn_trans G_final E_K E₀ W_base
        (hKit.eqOn_mono G_final E_K hWbase_sub_Wfinal hG_final)
        (hKit.eqOn_mono E_K E₀ hWbase_sub_W0 hEK_0)

    exact ⟨G_final,
      (hE₀_iff W_final G_final W_base hOpen_Wbase hWbase_sub_W0).mpr hGfinal_E0⟩

  refine ⟨by linarith, δ_t, hδ_t, hδ_t_sub, fun i => Classical.choose (hComp i),
    fun i => Classical.choose_spec (hComp i)⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hCyc
  have hDiff := hCyc.1 S.partial_y_holo
  have hCyclic := hCyc.2.2
  have hC_quad_pos : 0 < S.C_quad := S.C_quad_pos
  let C_pre : ℝ := 114 + S.C_quad
  let C_z : ℝ := 192 * C_pre
  have hC_pre_gt : 114 < C_pre := by dsimp [C_pre]; linarith
  have hC_pre_pos : 0 < C_pre := by linarith
  have hC_z_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_z := by dsimp [C_z]; linarith
  refine ⟨C_z, hC_z_ge_one, ?_⟩
  intro s d δ ε η_slice N l q U U_star
    hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hε0 hε1
    hη_slice0 hη_slice_adm hN hU hRes hl1 hq2 hqN
    t₀ ht₀_lt hU_star Q η_tot

  
  have hη_adm_pos : 0 < S.η_adm := S.η_adm_pos
  have hη_adm_le32 : S.η_adm ≤ 1 / 32 := S.η_adm_le_inv32
  have hη_adm_s₀ : S.η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4 := S.η_adm_le_quarter_s₀
  have hs_act_s₀ : S.s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2 := S.s_act_le_half_s₀
  have hd_act_lt1 : S.d_act < 1 := S.d_act_lt_one

  have hs6_pos : 0 < s - 6 * δ := by linarith
  have hs11_2_pos : 0 < s - (11 / 2 : ℝ) * δ := by linarith
  have hs21_4_pos : 0 < s - (21 / 4 : ℝ) * δ := by linarith
  have hs5_pos : 0 < s - 5 * δ := by linarith
  have hs5_le_act : s - 5 * δ ≤ S.s_act := by linarith

  set Y5 : Set ℂ := horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)
  set Y21_4 : Set ℂ := horizStrip (s - (21 / 4 : ℝ) * δ)
  set Y11_2 : Set ℂ := horizStrip (s - (11 / 2 : ℝ) * δ)
  set Y6 : Set ℂ := horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)
  set B4 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)

  have hstrip_mono : ∀ {σ₁ σ₂ : ℝ}, σ₁ ≤ σ₂ → horizStrip σ₁ ⊆ horizStrip σ₂ := by
    intro σ₁ σ₂ hle z hz
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz hle
  have hY6_sub_Y11_2 : Y6 ⊆ Y11_2 := hstrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hY11_2_sub_Y21_4 : Y11_2 ⊆ Y21_4 := hstrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hY21_4_sub_Y5 : Y21_4 ⊆ Y5 := hstrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hY6_sub_Y5 : Y6 ⊆ Y5 := hstrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hY5_sub_s : Y5 ⊆ horizStrip s := hstrip_mono (by linarith)

  have isOpen_horizStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hstrip_add_real : ∀ {H : ℝ} {w : ℂ}, w ∈ horizStrip H → ∀ x : ℝ,
      w + (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H w hw x
    have hw' : |w.im| < H := hw
    change |(w + (x : ℂ)).im| < H
    simpa using hw'
  have hstrip_shift_2pi : ∀ {H : ℝ} {w : ℂ}, w ∈ horizStrip H →
      w + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H w hw
    change |(w + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im| < H
    have him : (w + (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im = w.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    exact hw

  
  have slice_fst_holo :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {S_y : Set ℂ} {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (t_fixed : ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W →
        (∀ z ∈ S_y, (z, t_fixed) ∈ W) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => F (z, t_fixed)) S_y := by
    intro W S_y F t_fixed hF hmaps
    exact DifferentiableOn.comp hF
      (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t_fixed)).differentiableOn hmaps

  have slice_snd_holo :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {S_t : Set ℂ} {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (y_fixed : ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W →
        (∀ t ∈ S_t, (y_fixed, t) ∈ W) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => F (y_fixed, t)) S_t := by
    intro W S_t F y_fixed hF hmaps
    exact DifferentiableOn.comp hF
      ((differentiable_const y_fixed).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn hmaps

  have partial_t_slice_holo :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {S_y : Set ℂ} {F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (t_fixed : ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F W →
        (∀ z ∈ S_y, (z, t_fixed) ∈ W) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => F (z, t')) t_fixed) S_y := by
    intro W S_y F t_fixed hW_open hF hmaps
    exact slice_fst_holo t_fixed (S.partial_t_holo W F hW_open hF) hmaps

  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by omega
  have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (q : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hq_ne : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := by
    change 0 < (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
    positivity
  have ht₀_C_ne : (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt ht₀_pos)
  have hqt₀_eq : (q : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ) := by
    change (q : ℝ) * ((2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)) = 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)
    field_simp [hq_ne]
  have ht₀_lt_one : t₀ < 1 := by linarith
  have hq_le_N : (q : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hqN
  have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  have hδ_inv_pos : 0 < δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hδ0
  have hQ_ge_one : 1 ≤ Q := by
    change 1 ≤ 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
    linarith
  have hQ_nonneg : 0 ≤ Q := by linarith
  have hδ_inv_le_Q : δ⁻¹ ≤ Q := by
    change δ⁻¹ ≤ 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
    linarith
  have hδ_inv_sq_le : (δ⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ_inv_pos) hδ_inv_le_Q 2
  have hQ_sq_ge_one : 1 ≤ Q ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hQ_ge_one
  have hqt₀_le_Q : (q : ℝ) * t₀ ≤ Q := by
    have hqt₀_le_q : (q : ℝ) * t₀ ≤ (q : ℝ) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt ht₀_lt_one) (le_of_lt hq_pos)
    change (q : ℝ) * t₀ ≤ 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
    linarith
  have hqt₀_sq_le : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 := by
    have hpow : ((q : ℝ) * t₀) ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hqt₀_le_Q 2
    calc
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 = ((q : ℝ) * t₀) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ Q ^ 2 := hpow
  have hη_tot_pos : 0 < η_tot := by
    change 0 < ε + η_slice
    linarith
  have hη_tot_nonneg : 0 ≤ η_tot := le_of_lt hη_tot_pos
  have hη_slice_le_one : η_slice ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hη_slice_sq_le : η_slice ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 * η_slice := by
    have hsq : η_slice ^ 2 ≤ 1 * η_slice := by nlinarith
    exact le_trans hsq (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ_sq_ge_one hη_slice0)

  have hδ4_pos : 0 < δ / 4 := by positivity
  have ht₀_mem_B4 : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ B4 := Metric.mem_ball_self hδ4_pos
  have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t₀ := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
  have ht₀_norm_lt_d_act : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ < S.d_act := by
    rw [ht₀_norm]
    linarith
  have ht₀_add_δ4_le : t₀ + δ / 4 ≤ S.d_act := by linarith
  have hB4_bounds : ∀ t ∈ B4, ‖t‖ < d ∧ |t.im| < δ / 4 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht
    have htri : ‖t‖ ≤ ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add t (t₀ : ℂ)
    have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < d := by linarith
    have him_eq : t.im = (t - (t₀ : ℂ)).im := by simp
    have ht_im : |t.im| < δ / 4 := by
      rw [him_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t - (t₀ : ℂ))) ht
    exact ⟨ht_norm, ht_im⟩
  have hB4_sub_d_act : B4 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.d_act := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hB4_bounds t ht).1 hd_act
  have hY5B4_sub_dom : ∀ {ν : ℝ}, 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ 1 → Y5 ×ˢ B4 ⊆ glancingDomain ν s d := by
    intro ν hν0 hν1 p hp
    obtain ⟨ht_norm, ht_im⟩ := hB4_bounds p.2 hp.2
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
    have hy_im : |p.1.im| < s - 5 * δ := hp.1
    have hν_im : ν * |p.2.im| ≤ δ / 4 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg p.2.im]
    linarith
  have hY5B4_sub_dom0 : Y5 ×ˢ B4 ⊆ glancingDomain 0 s d :=
    hY5B4_sub_dom (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hY5B4_sub_dom_half : Y5 ×ˢ B4 ⊆ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d :=
    hY5B4_sub_dom (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hY5B4_sub_dom1 : Y5 ×ˢ B4 ⊆ glancingDomain 1 s d :=
    hY5B4_sub_dom (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have isOpen_glancingDomain0 : IsOpen (glancingDomain 0 s d) :=
    IsOpen.inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        (continuous_const.sub
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)))))

  
  have glancingResidualOp_slice_eq :
      ∀ (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        (∀ z : ℂ, U₁ (z, t) = U₂ (z, t)) →
        glancingResidualOp B U₁ (y, t) = glancingResidualOp B U₂ (y, t) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ y t h
    have hfun : (fun z : ℂ => U₁ (z, t)) = (fun z : ℂ => U₂ (z, t)) := funext h
    have hAp : glancingAvgPlus U₁ y t = glancingAvgPlus U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgPlus]; simp only [hfun]
    have hAm : glancingAvgMinus U₁ y t = glancingAvgMinus U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgMinus]; simp only [hfun]
    have hC : glancingSecondAvg U₁ y t = glancingSecondAvg U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingSecondAvg]; simp only [hfun]
    dsimp only [glancingResidualOp]
    rw [hAp, hAm, hC, h y]
    simp only [hfun]

  have glancingLinCoeff_slice_eq :
      ∀ (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        (∀ z : ℂ, U₁ (z, t) = U₂ (z, t)) →
        glancingLinCoeff B U₁ (y, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U₂ (y, t) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ y t h
    have hW : glancingPhaseSlope B U₁ y t = glancingPhaseSlope B U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingPhaseSlope]; simp only [h]
    dsimp only [glancingLinCoeff]
    rw [hW]
    simp only [h]

  have glancingDiffOp_slice_eq :
      ∀ (V₁ V₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        (∀ z : ℂ, V₁ (z, t) = V₂ (z, t)) →
        glancingDiffOp V₁ (y, t) = glancingDiffOp V₂ (y, t) := by
    intro V₁ V₂ y t h
    have hfun : (fun z : ℂ => V₁ (z, t)) = (fun z : ℂ => V₂ (z, t)) := funext h
    dsimp only [glancingDiffOp]
    simp only [hfun]

  have glancingResidualOp_congr_strip :
      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
        |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, U₁ (z, t) = U₂ (z, t)) →
        glancingResidualOp B U₁ (y, t) = glancingResidualOp B U₂ (y, t) := by
    intro σ U₁ U₂ y t hyim h
    have hd1 : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ,
        deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₁ (y', t)) w = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₂ (y', t)) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => U₁ (y', t)) =ᶠ[nhds w] (fun y' : ℂ => U₂ (y', t)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip σ).mem_nhds hw) h
      exact hev.deriv_eq
    have hd2 : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip σ,
        deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₁ (y', t))) w =
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₂ (y', t))) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hev : deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₁ (y', t)) =ᶠ[nhds w]
          deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₂ (y', t)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip σ).mem_nhds hw) hd1
      exact hev.deriv_eq
    have hy_mem : y ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      change |y.im| < σ
      linarith [abs_nonneg t.im]
    have hAp : glancingAvgPlus U₁ y t = glancingAvgPlus U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgPlus]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun lam hlam => hd1 _ ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      change |(y + (lam : ℂ) * t).im| < σ
      have him : (y + (lam : ℂ) * t).im = y.im + lam * t.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      have hle : |y.im + lam * t.im| ≤ |y.im| + |lam| * |t.im| := by
        simpa [abs_mul] using abs_add_le y.im (lam * t.im)
      have hlam_abs : |lam| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hlam.1], hlam.2⟩
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg t.im]
    have hAm : glancingAvgMinus U₁ y t = glancingAvgMinus U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgMinus]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun lam hlam => hd1 _ ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      change |(y - (lam : ℂ) * t).im| < σ
      have him : (y - (lam : ℂ) * t).im = y.im + (-lam) * t.im := by simp; ring
      rw [him]
      have hle : |y.im + (-lam) * t.im| ≤ |y.im| + |-lam| * |t.im| := by
        simpa [abs_mul] using abs_add_le y.im ((-lam) * t.im)
      have hlam_abs : |-lam| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_neg]
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hlam.1], hlam.2⟩
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg t.im]
    have hC : glancingSecondAvg U₁ y t = glancingSecondAvg U₂ y t := by
      dsimp only [glancingSecondAvg]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun lam hlam => ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at hlam
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun μ hμ => hd2 _ ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith [hlam.1] : -lam ≤ lam)] at hμ

    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun μ : ℝ => deriv f (w + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) * (t₀ : ℂ))
        (Set.uIcc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by

    have h1 : w + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = w + (t₀ : ℂ) / 2 := by push_cast; ring

          _ = ‖(1 - Up (y, t)) + Up (y, t)‖ := by rw [← hsum]

        _ = Up (y, t) := deriv_add_const (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))

              (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
        (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) at hex
    rw [hg_eq] at hex
    exact hex

  
  have hU_dot_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_dot Y5 :=
    partial_t_slice_holo (t₀ : ℂ) isOpen_glancingDomain0 hU.1
      fun w hw => hY5B4_sub_dom0 ⟨hw, ht₀_mem_B4⟩

  have hU_dot_per : ∀ w ∈ Y5, U_dot (w + 2 * Real.pi) = U_dot w := by
    intro w hw
    have hev : (fun t : ℂ => U (w + 2 * Real.pi, t)) =ᶠ[nhds (t₀ : ℂ)]
        (fun t : ℂ => U (w, t) + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (t₀ : ℂ) hδ4_pos) fun t ht =>
        hU.2.1 w t (hY5B4_sub_dom0 ⟨hw, ht⟩)
    dsimp [U_dot]
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_add_const]

  have hz₀_holo5 : DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀ Y5 :=
    (hU_dot_holo.mul (hU_star_deriv_holo.inv hU_star_deriv_ne)).congr fun w _ =>
      div_eq_mul_inv (U_dot w) (deriv U_star w)
  have hz₀_holo6 : DifferentiableOn ℂ z₀ Y6 := hz₀_holo5.mono hY6_sub_Y5

  have hz₀_per5 : ∀ w ∈ Y5, z₀ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = z₀ w := by
    intro w hw
    dsimp [z₀]
    rw [hU_dot_per w hw, hU_star_deriv_per w hw]

  have hg_init_holo5 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_init Y5 :=
    ha_star_holo.mul
      ((glancingDiffOp_real_slice_holo (s - 5 * δ) z₀ hz₀_holo5).add
        (differentiableOn_const ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
  have hg_init_holo6 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_init Y6 := hg_init_holo5.mono hY6_sub_Y5

  have hg_init_per5 : ∀ w ∈ Y5, g_init (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g_init w := by
    intro w hw
    dsimp [g_init]
    rw [ha_star_per w hw,
      glancingDiffOp_real_slice_per (s - 5 * δ) z₀ hz₀_holo5 hz₀_per5 w hw]
  have hg_init_per6 : ∀ w ∈ Y6, g_init (w + 2 * Real.pi) = g_init w :=
    fun w hw => hg_init_per5 w (hY6_sub_Y5 hw)

  have hE_dot_per : ∀ y ∈ Y6, E_dot (y + 2 * Real.pi) = E_dot y := by
    intro y hy
    have hy_2pi : y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Y6 := hstrip_shift_2pi hy
    rw [hE_dot_eq (y + 2 * Real.pi) hy_2pi, hE_dot_eq y hy]
    exact glancingDiffOp_real_slice_per (s - 6 * δ) g_init hg_init_holo6 hg_init_per6 y hy

  
  obtain ⟨hDiff_add, hSolve_cyc⟩ :=
    hCyclic (s - 6 * δ) t₀ M_dot l q a_star E_dot g_init
      hs6_pos ht₀_pos hM_dot_nonneg hl1 hq1 hqt₀_eq

  have ha_star_holo6 : DifferentiableOn ℂ a_star Y6 := ha_star_holo.mono hY6_sub_Y5

  obtain ⟨z, hz_holo, hz_per, hz_norm_raw, hz_eq⟩ :=
    hSolve_cyc
      ha_star_holo6
      hE_dot_holo
      hg_init_holo6
      (fun y hy => ⟨ha_star_per y (hY6_sub_Y5 hy), ha_star_bnd y (hY6_sub_Y5 hy)⟩)
      (fun y hy => ⟨hE_dot_per y hy, hE_dot_bnd y hy⟩)
      hg_init_per6
      hE_dot_eq

  refine ⟨z, hz_holo, hz_per, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    have hraw := hz_norm_raw y hy
    have hmul : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot ≤ Q ^ 2 * M_dot :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqt₀_sq_le hM_dot_nonneg
    calc
      ‖z y‖ ≤ 24 * ((q : ℝ) ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 * M_dot) := by linarith
      _ ≤ 24 * (Q ^ 2 * M_dot) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul (by norm_num)
      _ = C_z * Q ^ 5 * η_tot := by dsimp [C_z, M_dot]; ring
  · intro y hy
    let g_z : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => a_star w * glancingDiffOp (fun r => z r.1) (w, (t₀ : ℂ))
    let g_comb : ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun w => a_star w * (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z₀ r.1 + z r.1) (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹)
    have hg_z_holo6 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_z Y6 :=
      ha_star_holo6.mul (glancingDiffOp_real_slice_holo (s - 6 * δ) z hz_holo)
    have hg_comb_eq : ∀ w ∈ Y6, g_comb w = g_init w + g_z w := by
      intro w hw
      dsimp [g_comb, g_init, g_z]
      rw [hDiff_add z₀ z hz₀_holo6 hz_holo w hw]
      ring
    change glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_comb p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0
    calc
      glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_comb p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ))
          = glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_init p.1 + g_z p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) :=
        glancingDiffOp_congr_real_slice (s - 6 * δ) g_comb (fun w => g_init w + g_z w) y hy
          hg_comb_eq
      _ = glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_init p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) +
            glancingDiffOp (fun p => g_z p.1) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) :=
        hDiff_add g_init g_z hg_init_holo6 hg_z_holo6 y hy
      _ = E_dot y + (-E_dot y) := by
        rw [← hE_dot_eq y hy, hz_eq y hy]
      _ = 0 := add_neg_cancel (E_dot y)
