proof.tactics:
by
  intro hCyc s d δ η_slice M_z t₀ l q U U_star z
    hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hη_slice0 hM_z0
    hU ht₀_pos ht₀_lt ht₀_eq hU_star hz_holo hz_per_bnd
    Q₀ ρ_jet U_tilde W_plus g_plus H_plus hρ_adm
  have isOpen_horizStrip : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ) :=
    fun _ => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have horizStrip_mono : ∀ {σ₁ σ₂ : ℝ}, σ₁ ≤ σ₂ → horizStrip σ₁ ⊆ horizStrip σ₂ :=
    fun h _ hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hz h
  have isOpen_glancingDomain : ∀ ν : ℝ, IsOpen (glancingDomain ν s d) :=
    fun _ =>
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
          (continuous_const.sub
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)))))
  have hη_adm_pos : 0 < S.η_adm := S.η_adm_pos
  have hη_adm_le32 : S.η_adm ≤ 1 / 32 := S.η_adm_le_inv32
  have hd_lt_one : d < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hd_act S.d_act_lt_one
  have hδ_inv_pos : 0 < δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hδ0
  have hQ₀_gt_one : 1 < Q₀ := by change 1 < 1 + δ⁻¹; linarith
  have hδ_inv_le_Q₀ : δ⁻¹ ≤ Q₀ := by change δ⁻¹ ≤ 1 + δ⁻¹; linarith
  have hQ₀_le_sq : Q₀ ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have h_one_le_Q₀_sq : 1 ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hδ_inv_le_Q₀_sq : δ⁻¹ ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 := le_trans hδ_inv_le_Q₀ hQ₀_le_sq
  have hδ_inv_sq_le : (δ⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hδ_inv_pos) hδ_inv_le_Q₀ 2
  have hMz_term_nonneg : 0 ≤ 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z := by positivity
  have hρ_jet_nonneg : 0 ≤ ρ_jet := by
    change 0 ≤ η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
    linarith
  have hη_slice_adm8 : η_slice ≤ S.η_adm / 8 := by
    have hle : η_slice ≤ ρ_jet := by
      change η_slice ≤ η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
      linarith
    exact le_trans hle hρ_adm
  let B_4 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)
  let B_8 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)
  have hB8_sub_B4 : B_8 ⊆ B_4 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have ht₀_mem_B8 : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ B_8 := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
  have ht₀_mem_B4 : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ B_4 := hB8_sub_B4 ht₀_mem_B8
  have ht_B4_bounds : ∀ t ∈ B_4,
      ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖t‖ < d ∧ |t.im| < δ / 4 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht
    have ht_diff_le1 : ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t₀ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < d := by
      have htri : ‖t‖ ≤ ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add t (t₀ : ℂ)
      linarith
    have ht_im : |t.im| < δ / 4 := by
      have him : t.im = (t - (t₀ : ℂ)).im := by simp
      rw [him]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t - (t₀ : ℂ))) ht
    exact ⟨ht_diff_le1, ht_norm, ht_im⟩
  have hsub_D0 : horizStrip s ×ˢ B_4 ⊆ glancingDomain 0 s d := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, ht_norm, _⟩ := ht_B4_bounds p.2 hp.2
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
    have hy : |p.1.im| < s := hp.1
    linarith
  have hsub_Dhalf : horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ B_4 ⊆ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, ht_norm, ht_im⟩ := ht_B4_bounds p.2 hp.2
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
    have hy : |p.1.im| < s - 8 * δ := hp.1
    linarith
  have hsub_D1 : horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_4 ⊆ glancingDomain 1 s d := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, ht_norm, ht_im⟩ := ht_B4_bounds p.2 hp.2
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_⟩
    have hy : |p.1.im| < s - 9 * δ := hp.1
    linarith
  have hU_adm : IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d S.η_adm U := by
    refine ⟨hU.1, hU.2.1, hU.2.2.1, hU.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro k hk y t hyt
    exact le_trans (hU.2.2.2.2 k hk y t hyt) (by linarith)
  let Up : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1
  have hUp_holo_D0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Up (glancingDomain 0 s d) :=
    S.partial_y_holo (glancingDomain 0 s d) U (isOpen_glancingDomain 0) hU.1
  have hU_slice_holo : ∀ {t : ℂ}, ‖t‖ < d →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (horizStrip s) := by
    intro t ht_norm
    exact hU.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)).differentiableOn
      (fun y' hy' => ⟨ht_norm, by have h : |y'.im| < s := hy'; linarith⟩)
  have hUp_sub_one_le : ∀ {y t : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip s → ‖t‖ < d →
      ‖Up (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 3 * S.η_adm / 4 := by
    intro y t hy ht_norm
    have hu_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) y :=
      (hU_slice_holo ht_norm).differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip s).mem_nhds hy)
    have hderiv : deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') y = Up (y, t) - 1 :=
      (hu_at.hasDerivAt.sub (hasDerivAt_id y)).deriv
    have h1 := hU.2.2.2.2 1 (by omega) y t
      ⟨ht_norm, by have h : |y.im| < s := hy; linarith⟩
    rwa [iteratedDeriv_one, hderiv] at h1
  have hUp_lower : ∀ {y t : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip s → ‖t‖ < d →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ‖Up (y, t)‖ ∧ Up (y, t) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y t hy ht_norm
    have hsub := hUp_sub_one_le hy ht_norm
    have htri : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖Up (y, t)‖ + ‖Up (y, t) - 1‖ :=
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) = ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_one.symm
        _ = ‖Up (y, t) - (Up (y, t) - 1)‖ := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ ‖Up (y, t)‖ + ‖Up (y, t) - 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    have hge : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ‖Up (y, t)‖ := by linarith
    exact ⟨hge, norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)⟩
  have hUp_per : ∀ {y t : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip s → ‖t‖ < d →
      Up (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = Up (y, t) := by
    intro y t hy ht_norm
    let u_t : ℂ → ℂ := fun y' => U (y', t)
    have hev : (fun ζ : ℂ => u_t (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
        (fun ζ : ℂ => u_t ζ + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip s).mem_nhds hy)
        (fun ζ hζ => hU.2.1 ζ t ⟨ht_norm, by have h : |ζ.im| < s := hζ; linarith⟩)
    have h1 := hev.deriv_eq
    rw [deriv_comp_add_const, deriv_add_const] at h1
    exact h1
  rcases hU_star with ⟨hU_star_holo, hU_star_sym, hU_star_jet_raw, _⟩
  let Δ₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => U_star y - U (y, (t₀ : ℂ))
  have hΔ₀_jet : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ),
      ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₀ y‖ ≤ η_slice := by
    intro k hk y hy
    have hraw := hU_star_jet_raw k hk y hy
    rwa [← ht₀_eq] at hraw
  have ht₀_norm_lt_d : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ < d := (ht_B4_bounds (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_mem_B4).2.1
  have hY5_sub_s : horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip s := horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hu₀_holo5 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', (t₀ : ℂ))) (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) :=
    (hU_slice_holo ht₀_norm_lt_d).mono hY5_sub_s
  have hΔ₀_holo5 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₀ (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) :=
    hU_star_holo.sub hu₀_holo5
  have hΔ₀_per5 : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) → Δ₀ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = Δ₀ y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := (hU_star_sym y hy).1
    have h2 := hU.2.1 y (t₀ : ℂ) ⟨ht₀_norm_lt_d, by have h : |y.im| < s := hY5_sub_s hy; linarith⟩
    dsimp [Δ₀]
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  have hdU_star_holo5 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv U_star) (horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)) :=
    hU_star_holo.deriv (isOpen_horizStrip (s - 5 * δ))
  have hdU_star_per5 : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) →
      deriv U_star (y + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv U_star y := by
    intro y hy
    have hev : (fun ζ : ℂ => U_star (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
        (fun ζ : ℂ => U_star ζ + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)).mem_nhds hy)
        (fun ζ hζ => (hU_star_sym ζ hζ).1)
    have h1 := hev.deriv_eq
    rw [deriv_comp_add_const, deriv_add_const] at h1
    exact h1
  have hdU_star_bnd5 : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) →
      ‖deriv U_star y‖ ≤ 5 / 4 := by
    intro y hy
    have hUs_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ U_star y :=
      hU_star_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)).mem_nhds hy)
    have hu₀_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', (t₀ : ℂ))) y :=
      hu₀_holo5.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip (s - 5 * δ)).mem_nhds hy)
    have hdΔ₀ : deriv Δ₀ y = deriv U_star y - Up (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) :=
      (hUs_at.hasDerivAt.sub hu₀_at.hasDerivAt).deriv
    have hdecomp : deriv U_star y = (1 + (Up (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1)) + deriv Δ₀ y := by
      rw [hdΔ₀]; ring
    have h1 := hUp_sub_one_le (hY5_sub_s hy) ht₀_norm_lt_d
    have h2 : ‖deriv Δ₀ y‖ ≤ η_slice := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one]
      exact hΔ₀_jet 1 (by omega) y hy
    have htri1 : ‖deriv U_star y‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) + (Up (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1)‖ + ‖deriv Δ₀ y‖ := by
      rw [hdecomp]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have htri2 : ‖(1 : ℂ) + (Up (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1)‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖Up (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) - 1‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    rw [norm_one] at htri2
    linarith
  let Δ₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => deriv U_star y * z y
  have hY6_sub_Y5 : horizStrip (s - 6 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) :=
    horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hΔ₁_holo6 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₁ (horizStrip (s - 6 * δ)) :=
    (hdU_star_holo5.mono hY6_sub_Y5).mul hz_holo
  have hΔ₁_per6 : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ) → Δ₁ (y + 2 * Real.pi) = Δ₁ y := by
    intro y hy
    dsimp [Δ₁]
    rw [hdU_star_per5 (hY6_sub_Y5 hy), (hz_per_bnd y hy).1]
  have hΔ₁_bnd6 : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ) → ‖Δ₁ y‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z := by
    intro y hy
    dsimp [Δ₁]
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hdU_star_bnd5 (hY6_sub_Y5 hy)) (hz_per_bnd y hy).2 (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
  have hΔ₁_jet7 : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ),
      ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ ≤ 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z := by
    intro k hk w hw
    have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall w (δ / 2) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
      change |ζ.im| < s - 6 * δ
      have him_eq : ζ.im = w.im + (ζ - w).im := by simp
      have htri : |ζ.im| ≤ |w.im| + |(ζ - w).im| := by
        rw [him_eq]
        exact abs_add_le w.im (ζ - w).im
      have him_le : |(ζ - w).im| ≤ ‖ζ - w‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ - w)
      have hw_im : |w.im| < s - 7 * δ := hw
      linarith
    have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ Δ₁ (Metric.ball w (δ / 2)) :=
      hΔ₁_holo6.diffContOnCl_ball hcb_sub
    have hcauchy : ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ ≤
        (k.factorial : ℝ) * ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z) / (δ / 2) ^ k :=
      Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le k (by positivity) hdc
        (fun ζ hζ => hΔ₁_bnd6 (hcb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)))
    interval_cases k
    · have h0 : ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z) / (δ / 2) ^ 0 =
          (5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z := by norm_num
      rw [h0] at hcauchy
      have hmul : 1 * M_z ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_one_le_Q₀_sq hM_z0
      linarith
    · have h1 : ((1 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z) / (δ / 2) ^ 1 =
          (5 / 2 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹ * M_z := by
        rw [show ((1 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) = 1 by norm_num, pow_one,
          div_eq_mul_inv, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
      rw [h1] at hcauchy
      have hmul : δ⁻¹ * M_z ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ_inv_le_Q₀_sq hM_z0
      linarith
    · have h2 : ((2 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * M_z) / (δ / 2) ^ 2 =
          10 * (δ⁻¹) ^ 2 * M_z := by
        rw [show ((2 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) = 2 by norm_num, div_pow,
          div_eq_mul_inv, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
        ring
      rw [h2] at hcauchy
      have hmul : (δ⁻¹) ^ 2 * M_z ≤ Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ_inv_sq_le hM_z0
      linarith
  let δU : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Δ₀ p.1 + (p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) * Δ₁ p.1
  have hU_tilde_eq : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, U_tilde p = U p + δU p := by
    intro p
    dsimp [U_tilde, glancingAffineCand, δU, Δ₀, Δ₁]
    ring
  have hW_plus_eq : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, W_plus p = δU p / Up p := fun _ => rfl
  have hY7_sub_Y6 : horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 6 * δ) :=
    horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hY7_sub_Y5 : horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 5 * δ) :=
    le_trans hY7_sub_Y6 hY6_sub_Y5
  have hY7_sub_s : horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip s :=
    le_trans hY7_sub_Y5 hY5_sub_s
  have hY7B4_sub_D0 : horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4 ⊆ glancingDomain 0 s d :=
    fun p hp => hsub_D0 ⟨hY7_sub_s hp.1, hp.2⟩
  have hΔ₀_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₀ (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ)) :=
    hΔ₀_holo5.mono hY7_sub_Y5
  have hΔ₁_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₁ (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ)) :=
    hΔ₁_holo6.mono hY7_sub_Y6
  have hδU_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ δU (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    (hΔ₀_holo7.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1)).add
      (((differentiable_snd.sub (differentiable_const (t₀ : ℂ))).differentiableOn).mul
        (hΔ₁_holo7.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1)))
  have hU_tilde_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_tilde (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    ((hU.1.mono hY7B4_sub_D0).add hδU_holo7).congr (fun p _ => hU_tilde_eq p)
  have hUp_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ Up (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    hUp_holo_D0.mono hY7B4_sub_D0
  have hUp_ne7 : ∀ p ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4, Up p ≠ 0 :=
    fun p hp => (hUp_lower (hY7_sub_s hp.1) (ht_B4_bounds p.2 hp.2).2.1).2
  have hW_plus_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    (hδU_holo7.mul (hUp_holo7.inv hUp_ne7)).congr (fun _ _ => (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm)
  have hU_tilde_jet7 : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_4,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w‖ ≤ ρ_jet ∧
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') w‖ ≤ 7 * S.η_adm / 8 := by
    intro k hk w hw t ht
    obtain ⟨ht_diff_le1, ht_norm, _⟩ := ht_B4_bounds t ht
    have hfun1 : (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) =
        (fun y' : ℂ => Δ₀ y' + (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) * Δ₁ y') := by
      funext y'
      rw [hU_tilde_eq (y', t)]
      dsimp [δU]
      ring
    have hnhds7 := (isOpen_horizStrip (s - 7 * δ)).mem_nhds hw
    have hΔ₀_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) Δ₀ w :=
      (hΔ₀_holo7.contDiffOn (isOpen_horizStrip (s - 7 * δ))).contDiffAt hnhds7
    have hΔ₁_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) Δ₁ w :=
      (hΔ₁_holo7.contDiffOn (isOpen_horizStrip (s - 7 * δ))).contDiffAt hnhds7
    have hmul_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y' : ℂ => (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) * Δ₁ y') w :=
      contDiffAt_const.mul hΔ₁_cd
    have h_part1 : ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w‖ ≤ ρ_jet := by
      rw [hfun1, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hΔ₀_cd hmul_cd,
        iteratedDeriv_const_mul (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) hΔ₁_cd]
      have htri : ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₀ w + (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) * iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ ≤
          ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₀ w‖ + ‖(t - (t₀ : ℂ)) * iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_mul] at htri
      have hb0 : ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₀ w‖ ≤ η_slice := hΔ₀_jet k hk w (hY7_sub_Y5 hw)
      have hb1 : ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ ≤ 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z := hΔ₁_jet7 k hk w hw
      have hprod : ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ * ‖iteratedDeriv k Δ₁ w‖ ≤ 1 * (10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z) :=
        mul_le_mul ht_diff_le1 hb1 (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      change _ ≤ η_slice + 10 * Q₀ ^ 2 * M_z
      linarith
    have hfun2 : (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') =
        (fun y' : ℂ => (U (y', t) - y') + (U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t))) := by
      funext y'; ring
    have hu_id_holo7 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') (horizStrip (s - 7 * δ)) :=
      ((hU_slice_holo ht_norm).mono hY7_sub_s).sub differentiableOn_id
    have hu_id_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') w :=
      (hu_id_holo7.contDiffOn (isOpen_horizStrip (s - 7 * δ))).contDiffAt hnhds7
    have hδu_cd : ContDiffAt ℂ (k : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w := by
      rw [hfun1]
      exact hΔ₀_cd.add hmul_cd
    have h_part2 :
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - y') w‖ ≤ 7 * S.η_adm / 8 := by
      rw [hfun2, iteratedDeriv_fun_add hu_id_cd hδu_cd]
      have htri := norm_add_le
        (iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') w)
        (iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_tilde (y', t) - U (y', t)) w)
      have hu_bnd := hU.2.2.2.2 k (by omega) w t (hY7B4_sub_D0 ⟨hw, ht⟩)
      linarith
    exact ⟨h_part1, h_part2⟩
  have hW_plus_bnd7 : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_4,
      ‖W_plus (w, t)‖ ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet := by
    intro w hw t ht
    have hδu_bnd : ‖δU (w, t)‖ ≤ ρ_jet := by
      have h0 := (hU_tilde_jet7 0 (by omega) w hw t ht).1
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
      have heq : U_tilde (w, t) - U (w, t) = δU (w, t) := by
        rw [hU_tilde_eq (w, t)]; ring
      rwa [heq] at h0
    have hUp_ge : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ‖Up (w, t)‖ :=
      (hUp_lower (hY7_sub_s hw) (ht_B4_bounds t ht).2.1).1
    have hUp_pos : 0 < ‖Up (w, t)‖ := by linarith
    rw [hW_plus_eq (w, t), norm_div, div_le_iff₀ hUp_pos]
    nlinarith
  have hW_plus_per7 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_4,
      W_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_plus (y, t) := by
    intro y hy t ht
    have ht_norm := (ht_B4_bounds t ht).2.1
    rw [hW_plus_eq (y + 2 * Real.pi, t), hW_plus_eq (y, t)]
    dsimp [δU]
    rw [hΔ₀_per5 (hY7_sub_Y5 hy), hΔ₁_per6 (hY7_sub_Y6 hy), hUp_per (hY7_sub_s hy) ht_norm]
  have hY8_sub_Y7 : horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) :=
    horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hW_plus_holo8 : DifferentiableOn ℂ W_plus (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ B_8) :=
    hW_plus_holo7.mono (fun _ hp => ⟨hY8_sub_Y7 hp.1, hB8_sub_B4 hp.2⟩)
  have hW_plus_per8 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_8,
      W_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_plus (y, t) :=
    fun y hy t ht => hW_plus_per7 y (hY8_sub_Y7 hy) t (hB8_sub_B4 ht)
  have hDiff := hCyc.1 S.partial_y_holo
  obtain ⟨hdW_holo8_4, hdW_props8_4⟩ :=
    hDiff (s - 7 * δ) (s - 8 * δ) t₀ (δ / 4) ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) W_plus
      (by linarith) (by positivity) (by linarith) (by positivity) hW_plus_holo7
      (fun y hy t ht => ⟨hW_plus_per7 y hy t ht, hW_plus_bnd7 y hy t ht⟩)
  have hdW_bnd8_4 : ∀ {y t : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) → t ∈ B_4 →
      ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet := by
    intro y t hy ht
    calc
      ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖
          ≤ 4 * ((s - 7 * δ) - (s - 8 * δ))⁻¹ * ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) :=
            (hdW_props8_4 y hy t ht).2
      _ = (16 / 3 : ℝ) * (δ⁻¹ * ρ_jet) := by
            rw [show (s - 7 * δ) - (s - 8 * δ) = δ by ring]; ring
      _ ≤ (16 / 3 : ℝ) * (Q₀ * ρ_jet) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ_inv_le_Q₀ hρ_jet_nonneg) (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ 6 * (Q₀ * ρ_jet) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num)
              (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hρ_jet_nonneg)
      _ = 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet := by ring
  obtain ⟨ha_holo_dom, ha_props_dom⟩ :=
    S.linCoeff_props s d U hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hU_adm
  have ha_holo8_4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    ha_holo_dom.mono hsub_Dhalf
  have ha_per_bnd8_4 : ∀ {y t : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) → t ∈ B_4 →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      ‖glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro y t hy ht
    obtain ⟨ha_per, _, _, ha_near⟩ := ha_props_dom y t (hsub_Dhalf ⟨hy, ht⟩)
    refine ⟨ha_per, ?_⟩
    set a := glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)
    have htri : 4 * ‖a‖ ≤ ‖4 * a - 1‖ + 1 :=
      calc
        4 * ‖a‖ = ‖(4 : ℂ)‖ * ‖a‖ := by norm_num
        _ = ‖(4 : ℂ) * a‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
        _ = ‖(4 * a - 1) + 1‖ := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ ‖4 * a - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖4 * a - 1‖ + 1 := by rw [norm_one]
    linarith
  have hg_plus_holo8_4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_plus (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    ha_holo8_4.mul hdW_holo8_4
  have hg_plus_props8_4 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_4,
      g_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_plus (y, t) ∧
      ‖g_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet := by
    intro y hy t ht
    obtain ⟨ha_per, ha_le1⟩ := ha_per_bnd8_4 hy ht
    have hdW_per := (hdW_props8_4 y hy t ht).1
    have hdW_le := hdW_bnd8_4 hy ht
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [g_plus]
      rw [ha_per, hdW_per]
    · dsimp [g_plus]
      rw [norm_mul]
      calc
        ‖glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)‖ * ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖
            ≤ 1 * (6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet) :=
              mul_le_mul ha_le1 hdW_le (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
        _ = 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet := one_mul _
  have hY9_sub_Y8 : horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) :=
    horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hg_plus_holo9 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_plus (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_8) :=
    hg_plus_holo8_4.mono (fun _ hp => ⟨hY9_sub_Y8 hp.1, hB8_sub_B4 hp.2⟩)
  have hg_plus_bounds9 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ B_8,
      g_plus (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_plus (y, t) ∧
      ‖g_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet ∧
      ‖glancingDiffOp W_plus (y, t)‖ ≤ 6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet := by
    intro y hy t ht
    obtain ⟨hg_per, hg_le⟩ := hg_plus_props8_4 y (hY9_sub_Y8 hy) t (hB8_sub_B4 ht)
    exact ⟨hg_per, hg_le, hdW_bnd8_4 (hY9_sub_Y8 hy) (hB8_sub_B4 ht)⟩
  obtain ⟨hdg_holo9_4, _⟩ :=
    hDiff (s - 8 * δ) (s - 9 * δ) t₀ (δ / 4) (6 * Q₀ * ρ_jet) g_plus
      (by linarith) (by positivity) (by linarith) (by positivity) hg_plus_holo8_4
      hg_plus_props8_4
  have hE_holo9_4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    (S.E_op_props s d U hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hU_adm).1.mono hsub_D1
  have hH_plus_holo9_4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    hE_holo9_4.add hdg_holo9_4
  have hY10_sub_Y9 : horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ⊆ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) :=
    horizStrip_mono (by linarith)
  have hH_plus_holo10_8 : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_plus (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ B_8) :=
    hH_plus_holo9_4.mono (fun _ hp => ⟨hY10_sub_Y9 hp.1, hB8_sub_B4 hp.2⟩)
  have hdtH_holo9_4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => H_plus (p.1, t')) p.2)
      (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) :=
    S.partial_t_holo (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ B_4) H_plus
      ((isOpen_horizStrip (s - 9 * δ)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball) hH_plus_holo9_4
  have hH_plus_dt_holo10 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun y : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ))
      (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) :=
    (hdtH_holo9_4.comp
      (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (t₀ : ℂ))).differentiableOn
      (fun _ hy => ⟨hY10_sub_Y9 hy, ht₀_mem_B4⟩)).congr (fun _ _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨hU_tilde_holo7, hW_plus_holo7, hU_tilde_jet7, hW_plus_bnd7,
    hW_plus_holo8, hW_plus_per8, hg_plus_holo9, hg_plus_bounds9,
    hH_plus_holo9_4, hH_plus_holo10_8, hH_plus_dt_holo10⟩

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s d δ ε η_slice ρ_jet t₀ l q U U_star z
    hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hδ0 hδ_lt hε0 _hη_slice0 hρ_jet0 hρ_jet_adm
    hU hRes ht₀_pos ht₀_lt ht₀_eq hU_star _hz_holo hz_cancel
    U_tilde W_plus g_plus H_plus
    hU_tilde_holo7 hW_plus_holo7 hU_tilde_jet7 hW_plus_bnd7 hH_plus_holo9_4
    Q₀ M_quad_raw

  have isOpen_horizStrip : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip σ) := fun σ =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const

  have glancingDiffOp_slice : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w τ : ℂ),
      (fun z' : ℂ => f₁ (z', τ)) = (fun z' : ℂ => f₂ (z', τ)) →
      glancingDiffOp f₁ (w, τ) = glancingDiffOp f₂ (w, τ) := by
    intro f₁ f₂ w τ h
    dsimp only [glancingDiffOp]
    rw [h]

  have glancingResidualOp_slice : ∀ (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w τ : ℂ),
      (fun z' : ℂ => U₁ (z', τ)) = (fun z' : ℂ => U₂ (z', τ)) →
      glancingResidualOp B U₁ (w, τ) = glancingResidualOp B U₂ (w, τ) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ w τ h
    have h0 : U₁ (w, τ) = U₂ (w, τ) := congr_fun h w
    have h1 : deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₁ (y', τ)) w = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U₂ (y', τ)) w := by
      rw [h]
    have hAp : glancingAvgPlus U₁ w τ = glancingAvgPlus U₂ w τ := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgPlus]; rw [h]
    have hAm : glancingAvgMinus U₁ w τ = glancingAvgMinus U₂ w τ := by
      dsimp only [glancingAvgMinus]; rw [h]
    have hCpm : glancingSecondAvg U₁ w τ = glancingSecondAvg U₂ w τ := by
      dsimp only [glancingSecondAvg]; rw [h]
    dsimp only [glancingResidualOp]
    rw [h0, h1, hAp, hAm, hCpm]

  have glancingLinCoeff_slice : ∀ (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w τ : ℂ),
      (fun z' : ℂ => U₁ (z', τ)) = (fun z' : ℂ => U₂ (z', τ)) →
      glancingLinCoeff B U₁ (w, τ) = glancingLinCoeff B U₂ (w, τ) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ w τ h
    have hm : U₁ (w - τ / 2, τ) = U₂ (w - τ / 2, τ) := congr_fun h (w - τ / 2)
    have hp : U₁ (w + τ / 2, τ) = U₂ (w + τ / 2, τ) := congr_fun h (w + τ / 2)
    have hW : glancingPhaseSlope B U₁ w τ = glancingPhaseSlope B U₂ w τ := by
      dsimp only [glancingPhaseSlope]
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro μ _
      dsimp only
      rw [congr_fun h (w + (μ : ℂ) * τ), h]
    dsimp only [glancingLinCoeff]
    rw [hm, hp, hW, h]

  have glancingDiffOp_congr_real_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ),
      w ∈ horizStrip σ →
      (∀ z' ∈ horizStrip σ, f₁ (z', (t₀ : ℂ)) = f₂ (z', (t₀ : ℂ))) →
      glancingDiffOp f₁ (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) = glancingDiffOp f₂ (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
    intro σ f₁ f₂ w hw hf
    dsimp only [glancingDiffOp]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro μ _
    have hζ : w + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      change |(w + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)).im| < σ
      have him : (w + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)).im = w.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      exact hw
    have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => f₁ (y', (t₀ : ℂ))) =ᶠ[nhds (w + (μ : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))]
        (fun y' : ℂ => f₂ (y', (t₀ : ℂ))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_horizStrip σ).mem_nhds hζ) (fun z' hz' => hf z' hz')
    exact hev.deriv_eq

  have glancingResidualOp_congr_strip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (w τ : ℂ) (U₁ U₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      |w.im| + |τ.im| < σ →
      (∀ z' ∈ horizStrip σ, U₁ (z', τ) = U₂ (z', τ)) →
      glancingResidualOp B U₁ (w, τ) = glancingResidualOp B U₂ (w, τ) := by
    intro σ w τ U₁ U₂ hwτ hUeq
    have h_shift : ∀ c : ℝ, |c| ≤ 1 → w + (c : ℂ) * τ ∈ horizStrip σ := by
      intro c hc
      change |(w + (c : ℂ) * τ).im| < σ
      have him : (w + (c : ℂ) * τ).im = w.im + c * τ.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      have h1 := neg_abs_le w.im
      have h2 := le_abs_self w.im
      have h3 := neg_abs_le (c * τ.im)
      have h4 := le_abs_self (c * τ.im)
      have h5 : |c * τ.im| ≤ |τ.im| := by

        lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z' - y)) hz'
      have hy_im : |y.im| < s - 10 * δ := hy10
      have hz'_im_eq : z'.im = y.im + (z' - y).im := by simp
      have hz'_im9 : |z'.im| < s - 9 * δ := by
        rw [hz'_im_eq]
        have h1 := neg_abs_le y.im
        have h2 := le_abs_self y.im
        have h3 := neg_abs_le (z' - y).im
        have h4 := le_abs_self (z' - y).im
        exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ⟨ht_norm_d, ?_⟩⟩
      · change |z'.im| < s - 7 * δ
        linarith
      · linarith

    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball y δ) := by
      have hE_holo_dom := (S.E_op_props s d U hs0 hs_act hd0 hd_act hd_half hU_adm).1
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z' : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (z', t))
          (Metric.ball y δ) :=
        hE_holo_dom.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)).differentiableOn
          (fun z' hz' => (hball_y_mem z' hz').2)
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z' : ℂ => W_plus (z', t)) (Metric.ball y δ) :=
        hW_plus_holo7.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)).differentiableOn
          (fun z' hz' => ⟨(hball_y_mem z' hz').1, ht⟩)

    have hΦ_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ Φ (Metric.ball y (δ / 2)) :=
      hΦ_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))

    have hΦ_sphere : ∀ z' ∈ Metric.sphere y (δ / 2),
        ‖Φ z'‖ ≤ ε * ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet) := by
      intro z' hz'_sp
      have hz'_ball : z' ∈ Metric.ball y δ :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz'_sp)
      obtain ⟨hz'7, hzt_dom1⟩ := hball_y_mem z' hz'_ball
      dsimp only [Φ]
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hRes (z', t) hzt_dom1) (hW_plus_bnd7 z' hz'7 t ht)
        (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hε0)

    have hΦ_deriv_raw : ‖deriv Φ y‖ ≤ (ε * ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet)) / (δ / 2) :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity) hΦ_dc hΦ_sphere

    have hΦ_deriv_le : ‖deriv Φ y‖ ≤ 3 * Q₀ * ε * ρ_jet := by
      have hdiv_eq : (ε * ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet)) / (δ / 2) =
          ((8 / 3 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹) * (ε * ρ_jet) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ0]
        ring
      have hcoeff : (8 / 3 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹ ≤ 3 * Q₀ := by
        change (8 / 3 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹ ≤ 3 * (1 + δ⁻¹)
        linarith
      have hmul_le : ((8 / 3 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹) * (ε * ρ_jet) ≤ (3 * Q₀) * (ε * ρ_jet) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff (by positivity)
      calc
        ‖deriv Φ y‖ ≤ (ε * ((4 / 3 : ℝ) * ρ_jet)) / (δ / 2) := hΦ_deriv_raw
        _ = ((8 / 3 : ℝ) * δ⁻¹) * (ε * ρ_jet) := hdiv_eq
        _ ≤ (3 * Q₀) * (ε * ρ_jet) := hmul_le
        _ = 3 * Q₀ * ε * ρ_jet := by ring

    have htri : ‖K_err (y, t)‖ ≤ ‖K_err (y, t) - deriv Φ y‖ + ‖deriv Φ y‖ :=
      norm_le_norm_sub_add (K_err (y, t)) (deriv Φ y)
    dsimp only [M_K]
    linarith

  
  intro y hy10
  have hy9 : y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) := by
    change |y.im| < s - 9 * δ
    have h10 : |y.im| < s - 10 * δ := hy10
    linarith
  have hy8 : y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) := by
    change |y.im| < s - 8 * δ
    have h10 : |y.im| < s - 10 * δ := hy10
    linarith
  have hy7 : y ∈ horizStrip (s - 7 * δ) := by
    change |y.im| < s - 7 * δ

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hH_eq_neg_K : H_plus (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = -K_err (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
      dsimp only [K_err]

    have h1_le_8Q₀ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * Q₀ := by linarith
    have hMK_le_raw : M_K ≤ M_quad_raw := by
      calc
        M_K = 1 * M_K := by ring
        _ ≤ (8 * Q₀) * M_K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1_le_8Q₀ hM_K_nonneg
        _ = M_quad_raw := rfl
    rw [hH_eq_neg_K, norm_neg]
    exact le_trans (hK_err_bound y hy10 (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_mem_B4) hMK_le_raw
  · 
    have hEt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_tilde (y, t))
        (Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) :=
      hE_tilde_holo8.comp ((differentiable_const y).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun t ht => ⟨hy8, ht⟩)
    have hHt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t))
        (Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) :=
      hH_plus_holo9_4.comp ((differentiable_const y).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun t ht => ⟨hy9, ht⟩)
    have hKt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => K_err (y, t))
        (Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4)) :=
      hK_err_holo9.comp ((differentiable_const y).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun t ht => ⟨hy9, ht⟩)
    have hEt_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_tilde (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) :=
      hEt_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (t₀ : ℂ) (by positivity))
    have hHt_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) :=
      hHt_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (t₀ : ℂ) (by positivity))
    have hK_deriv_eq :
        deriv (fun t : ℂ => K_err (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
          -deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) := by
      have hd_sub_K :
          deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_tilde (y, t) - H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
            deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_tilde (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) -
              deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) :=
        deriv_sub hEt_diff hHt_diff
      change deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_tilde (y, t) - H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        -deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)
      rw [hd_sub_K, hE_tilde_dt_zero8 y hy8, zero_sub]
    have hH_deriv_norm :
        ‖deriv (fun t : ℂ => H_plus (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)‖ =
          ‖deriv (fun t : ℂ => K_err (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [hK_deriv_eq, norm_neg]
    have hKt_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun t : ℂ => K_err (y, t)) (Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) :=
      hKt_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
    have hKt_sphere : ∀ t ∈ Metric.sphere (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8), ‖K_err (y, t)‖ ≤ M_K := by
      intro t ht_sp
      have ht_B4 : t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 4) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall ht_sp)
      exact hK_err_bound y hy10 t ht_B4
    have hKt_deriv_raw :
        ‖deriv (fun t : ℂ => K_err (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_K / (δ / 8) :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity) hKt_dc hKt_sphere
    have hdiv_eq : M_K / (δ / 8) = (8 * δ⁻¹) * M_K := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ0]
    have h8_le : 8 * δ⁻¹ ≤ 8 * Q₀ := by

      linarith
    rw [hH_deriv_norm]
    calc

      _ = (8 * δ⁻¹) * M_K := hdiv_eq

      _ = M_quad_raw := rfl

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpderiv_holo :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD f) U := by
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.snd
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₁ q = q.1 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₂_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₂ q = q.2 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₁_norm : ‖π₁‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₁ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₁_apply] using norm_fst_le q)
    have hπ₂_norm : ‖π₂‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₂ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₂_apply] using norm_snd_le q)
    have hparam_int_holo :
        ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (r B : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℂ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
          (F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ) (F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)),
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, g p = c * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ) →
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p)) →
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) →
          (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ‖F' p θ‖ ≤ B) →
          (∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F q θ) (F' p θ) p) →
          DifferentiableAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      intro p₀ r B hr c g F F' hrep hcont hmeas hbnd hfderiv
      have hint : HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ)
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F' p₀ θ) p₀ :=
        intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr)
          (by filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr] with p hp
              exact (hcont p hp).aestronglyMeasurable)
          ((hcont p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          hmeas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hbnd θ p hp)
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ p hp => hfderiv θ p hp)
      exact (hint.differentiableAt.const_mul c).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr) hrep)
    have hPartialA :
        ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
          DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA f) U := by
      intro U hU f hf p₀ hp₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀
      let r : ℝ := R₀ / 4
      have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
      have hp_ball : ∀ {p : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r →
          dist p.1 p₀.1 < r ∧ dist p.2 p₀.2 < r := by
        intro p hp
        rwa [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp
      have hmem_U : ∀ y t : ℂ, dist y p₀.1 < 3 * r → dist t p₀.2 < 3 * r → (y, t) ∈ U := by
        intro y t hy ht
        apply hball_R₀
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        have h4r : 4 * r = R₀ := by dsimp [r]; ring
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hsliceA : ∀ t : ℂ, dist t p₀.2 < 3 * r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => f (z, t)) (Metric.ball p₀.1 (3 * r)) := by
        intro t ht z hz
        have hzt : (z, t) ∈ U := hmem_U z t (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) ht
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzt)).comp z
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hsliceD : ∀ z : ℂ, dist z p₀.1 < 3 * r →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => f (z, w)) (Metric.ball p₀.2 (3 * r)) := by
        intro z hz w hw
        have hzw : (z, w) ∈ U := hmem_U z w hz (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw)
        exact ((hf.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzw)).comp w
          ((differentiableAt_const z).prodMk differentiableAt_id)).differentiableWithinAt
      let K₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall p₀.1 (2 * r) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * r)
      have hK₂_compact : IsCompact K₂ :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall p₀.1 (2 * r)).prod
          (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall p₀.2 (2 * r))
      have hK₂_sub : K₂ ⊆ U := by
        intro q hq
        exact hmem_U q.1 q.2
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1) (by linarith))
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2) (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK₂_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf.continuousOn.mono hK₂_sub)
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right M₀ 0
      have hM_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.1 (2 * r), ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * r),
          ‖f (z, w)‖ ≤ M :=
        fun z hz w hw => (hM₀ (z, w) ⟨hz, hw⟩).trans (le_max_left M₀ 0)
      have hderivD_bnd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.1 (2 * r), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball p₀.2 r,
          ‖deriv (fun w => f (z, w)) t‖ ≤ M / r := by
        intro z hz t ht
        have hz3 : dist z p₀.1 < 3 * r :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hz) (by linarith)
        have hsub_cl : Metric.closedBall t r ⊆ Metric.closedBall p₀.2 (2 * r) := by
          intro w hw
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hw ⊢
          linarith [dist_triangle w t p₀.2, Metric.mem_ball.mp ht]
        have hsub_open : Metric.closedBall t r ⊆ Metric.ball p₀.2 (3 * r) := fun w hw =>
          Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp (hsub_cl hw)) (by linarith))
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
          ((hsliceD z hz3).diffContOnCl_ball hsub_open)
          (fun w hw => hM_bnd z hz w (hsub_cl (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)))
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap p₀.1 (2 * r)
      have hγ_norm_sub : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖γ θ - p₀.1‖ = 2 * r := by
        intro θ
        rw [circleMap_sub_center, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      have hγ_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀.1 (2 * r) := by
        intro θ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hγ_norm_sub θ]
      have hγ_deriv_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖deriv γ θ‖ = 2 * r := by
        intro θ
        rw [deriv_circleMap, norm_mul, norm_circleMap_zero, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := continuous_circleMap p₀.1 (2 * r)
      have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := by
        have h_eq : deriv γ = fun θ => circleMap 0 (2 * r) θ * Complex.I := by
          ext θ; exact deriv_circleMap p₀.1 (2 * r) θ
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (continuous_circleMap 0 (2 * r)).mul continuous_const
      have hp_sep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ∀ θ : ℝ, r < ‖γ θ - p.1‖ := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp1 : ‖p.1 - p₀.1‖ < r := dist_eq_norm p.1 p₀.1 ▸ (hp_ball hp).1
        have htri : ‖γ θ - p₀.1‖ ≤ ‖γ θ - p.1‖ + ‖p.1 - p₀.1‖ := by
          simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le (γ θ - p.1) (p.1 - p₀.1)
        linarith [hγ_norm_sub θ]
      let c_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => deriv γ θ * ((γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ * (γ θ - p.1)⁻¹)
      let d_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => f (γ θ, p.2)
      let F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => c_fn p θ * d_fn p θ
      let c' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun p θ => (deriv γ θ * (2 * ((γ θ - p.1)⁻¹ ^ 3))) • π₁
      let d' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun p θ => (deriv (fun w => f (γ θ, w)) p.2) • π₂
      let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun p θ => c_fn p θ • d' p θ + d_fn p θ • c' p θ
      have hF_rep : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r,
          pderivA f p = (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F p θ := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp_ball hp
        have hcauchy :=
          Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
            Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith : 2 * r < 3 * r))
            (hsliceA p.2 (by linarith))
            (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith : dist p.1 p₀.1 < 2 * r))
        rw [pderivA, ← hcauchy, circleIntegral, smul_eq_mul]
        congr 1
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
        simp only [F, c_fn, d_fn, γ, smul_eq_mul, sq, mul_inv, mul_assoc]
      have hF_cont : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, Continuous (F p) := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨_, hp2⟩ := hp_ball hp
        have hne : ∀ θ : ℝ, γ θ - p.1 ≠ 0 := fun θ h0 => by
          have := hp_sep p hp θ; rw [h0, norm_zero] at this; linarith
        have hc_cont : Continuous (c_fn p) :=
          hγ_deriv_cont.mul (((hγ_cont.sub continuous_const).inv₀ hne).mul
            ((hγ_cont.sub continuous_const).inv₀ hne))
        have hd_cont : Continuous (d_fn p) :=
          hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (hγ_cont.prodMk continuous_const) fun θ =>
            hmem_U (γ θ) p.2

  have hStrict2D : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      ∀ q_s ∈ U, HasStrictFDerivAt g (S₁ (pderivA g q_s) + S₂ (pderivD g q_s)) q_s := by
    intro g hg q_s hq_s
    have hpA_cont : ContinuousAt (pderivA g) q_s := hpderivA_contAt hU_open hg hq_s
    have hpD_cont : ContinuousAt (pderivD g) q_s := by
      have hW'_open : IsOpen (τ_swap ⁻¹' U) := hU_open.preimage τ_swap.continuous
      have hg_swap : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g ∘ τ_swap) (τ_swap ⁻¹' U) :=
        hg.comp τ_swap.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
      have hqs_swap : τ_swap q_s ∈ τ_swap ⁻¹' U := by
        change (q_s.1, q_s.2) ∈ U
        exact hq_s
      exact (hpderivA_contAt hW'_open hg_swap hqs_swap).comp τ_swap.continuous.continuousAt

        (hg.differentiableAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt

        simpa [j₂] using (j₂.hasDerivAt (x := q.2)).add_const (q.1, (0 : ℂ))
      have hpA : pderivA g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (q.1, q.2) := hgd
        exact (h1.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hι₁).deriv
      have hpD : pderivD g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1) := by
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) (q.1, q.2) := hgd
        exact (h2.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hι₂).deriv

        intro u; ext <;> simp
      have h_eq : fderiv ℂ g q = S₁ (pderivA g q) + S₂ (pderivD g q) := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun u => ?_)
        conv_lhs => rw [hu_decomp u]
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, ← hpA, ← hpD]
        simp [S₁, S₂, π₁, π₂]
      rwa [← h_eq]

      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds hq_s) hfderiv_on
    have h_cont : ContinuousAt (fun q => S₁ (pderivA g q) + S₂ (pderivD g q)) q_s :=
      (S₁.continuous.continuousAt.comp hpA_cont).add
        (S₂.continuous.continuousAt.comp hpD_cont)
    exact hasStrictFDerivAt_of_hasFDerivAt_of_continuousAt h_ev h_cont
  
  let p_q : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.fst
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_fst }
  let p_z : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.snd
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_snd }
  let ι₀_CLM : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=

          map_add' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp)
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp) }

  let P_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun q z => ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), A d q * z ^ (d : ℕ)
  let Pz_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun q z => ∑ d : Fin D, (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ)
  let Φ_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ := fun x => (x.1, P_fn x.1 x.2)
  have hΦ_strict : ∀ q₀ ∈ U, ∀ z₀ : ℂ, Pz_fn q₀ z₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ),
        HasStrictFDerivAt Φ_fn (L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) (q₀, z₀) := by
    intro q₀ hq₀ z₀ hlam₀
    let L_A : Fin (D + 1) → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      fun d => S₁ (pderivA (A d) q₀) + S₂ (pderivD (A d) q₀)
    let L_q : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), (z₀ ^ (d : ℕ)) • L_A d
    let lam₀ : ℂ := Pz_fn q₀ z₀
    let L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.mk
        { toFun := fun x => (x.1, L_q x.1 + lam₀ * x.2)
          invFun := fun y => (y.1, lam₀⁻¹ * (y.2 - L_q y.1))
          left_inv := fun ⟨u, w⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [add_sub_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hlam₀])
          right_inv := fun ⟨u, v⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hlam₀, add_sub_cancel])
          map_add' := fun ⟨u₁, w₁⟩ ⟨u₂, w₂⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [map_add]; ring)
          map_smul' := fun c ⟨u, w⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by
              change L_q (c • u) + lam₀ * (c * w) = c * (L_q u + lam₀ * w)
              rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
              ring) }
        (continuous_fst.prodMk
          ((L_q.continuous.comp continuous_fst).add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))
        (continuous_fst.prodMk
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_snd.sub (L_q.continuous.comp continuous_fst))))
    have h_term : ∀ d : Fin (D + 1),
        HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => A d x.1 * x.2 ^ (d : ℕ))

            (z₀ ^ (d : ℕ)) • ((L_A d).comp p_q))
          (q₀, z₀) := by
      intro d
      have h1 : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => A d x.1)
          ((L_A d).comp p_q) (q₀, z₀) :=
        (hStrict2D (A d) (hA_holo d) q₀ hq₀).comp (q₀, z₀) (p_q.hasStrictFDerivAt (x := (q₀, z₀)))
      have h2 : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => x.2 ^ (d : ℕ))
          ((((d : ℕ) : ℂ) * z₀ ^ ((d : ℕ) - 1)) • p_z) (q₀, z₀) :=
        (hasStrictDerivAt_pow (d : ℕ) z₀).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt
          (q₀, z₀) (p_z.hasStrictFDerivAt (x := (q₀, z₀)))
      exact h1.mul h2
    have hP_sum : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => P_fn x.1 x.2)
        (∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          ((A d q₀) • ((((d : ℕ) : ℂ) * z₀ ^ ((d : ℕ) - 1)) • p_z) +
            (z₀ ^ (d : ℕ)) • ((L_A d).comp p_q)))
        (q₀, z₀) := by
      have h_fn : (∑ d : Fin (D + 1), fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => A d x.1 * x.2 ^ (d : ℕ)) =
          (fun x => P_fn x.1 x.2) := by
        ext x; simp [P_fn]
      rw [← h_fn]
      exact HasStrictFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun d _ => h_term d)
    have hΦ_raw := (p_q.hasStrictFDerivAt (x := (q₀, z₀))).prodMk hP_sum
    refine ⟨L_Φ, ?_⟩
    convert hΦ_raw using 1
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun ⟨u, w⟩ => ?_)
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    change L_q u + lam₀ * w = _
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, _root_.sum_apply,
      _root_.add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, L_q, smul_eq_mul]
    change (∑ x : Fin (D + 1), z₀ ^ (x : ℕ) * (L_A x) u) + lam₀ * w =

      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

        Nat.add_sub_cancel, lam₀, Pz_fn, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_w_sum]
    ring
  have hLoc_sheet : ∀ q_s ∈ U, ∀ z_s : ℂ, P_fn q_s z_s = 0 →
      ∃ (δ_q δ_z : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_q ∧ 0 < δ_z ∧
        Metric.ball q_s δ_q ⊆ U ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ρ (Metric.ball q_s δ_q) ∧
        ρ q_s = z_s ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q_s δ_q, ρ q ∈ Metric.ball z_s δ_z ∧ P_fn q (ρ q) = 0) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q_s δ_q, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z_s δ_z, P_fn q z = 0 → z = ρ q) := by
    intro q_s hq_s z_s hz_s

  have hUniq : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),

                Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (y_ss : ℂ) * Complex.I) η ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c η := by
              refine rectB_sub_bidisk x y_ss _ _ _ _
                (le_max_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _) ?_ (min_le_right _ _)
              rw [← hβ₁_succ]; exact le_max_right _ _
            exact ⟨σ, fun _ => ⟨hσ_holo.mono hQ_sub, hσ_pt, fun q hq => hσ_sol q (hQ_sub hq)⟩⟩
          · exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun h => False.elim (hx h)⟩
        choose σ_famB hσ_famB using h_lift_xB
        have hy_ss_in_B : β₁_seq (m + 1) < y_ss ∧ y_ss < β₂'' := by
          refine ⟨?_, lt_min (by linarith [hw₀_im₂]) (by linarith)⟩
          rw [← hβ₁_succ]; exact max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have h_σ_eq_HT : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a₁' a₂',
            ∀ q ∈ Q_famB x ∩ rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)),
              σ_famB x q = H_T q := by
          intro x hx
          have hp_Qx : (((x : ℂ) + (y_ss : ℂ) * Complex.I, t_c) : ℂ × ℂ) ∈ Q_famB x :=
            ⟨⟨by rw [(h_re_im x y_ss).1]; exact max_lt hx.1 (by linarith),
              by rw [(h_re_im x y_ss).1]; exact lt_min hx.2 (by linarith),
              by rw [(h_re_im x y_ss).2]; exact hy_ss_in_B.1,
              by rw [(h_re_im x y_ss).2]; exact hy_ss_in_B.2⟩,
             Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
          exact hUniq (Q_famB x ∩ rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)))
            (σ_famB x) H_T ((x : ℂ) + (y_ss : ℂ) * Complex.I, t_c)
            (isOpen_inter_rectB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) (isPreconn_inter_rectB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
            (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_right
              (rectB_sub_U _ _ _ _ le_rfl le_rfl (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
            ⟨hp_Qx, h_pt_VT x hx⟩
            ((hσ_famB x hx).1.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
            (hHT_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
            (fun q hq => (hσ_famB x hx).2.2 q hq.1)
            (fun q hq => hHT_sol q hq.2)
            (hσ_famB x hx).2.1
        have h_compat_B : ∀ x₁ ∈ Set.Ioo a₁' a₂', ∀ x₂ ∈ Set.Ioo a₁' a₂',
            ∀ q ∈ Q_famB x₁ ∩ Q_famB x₂, σ_famB x₁ q = σ_famB x₂ q := by
          intro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ q hq
          let x_q : ℝ := q.1.re
          let pt_q : ℂ × ℂ := ((x_q : ℂ) + (y_ss : ℂ) * Complex.I, t_c)
          have hpt_re : pt_q.1.re = x_q := by simp [pt_q]
          have hpt_im : pt_q.1.im = y_ss := by simp [pt_q]
          have hp_Q₁ : pt_q ∈ Q_famB x₁ :=
            ⟨⟨by rw [hpt_re]; exact hq.1.1.1,
              by rw [hpt_re]; exact hq.1.1.2.1,
              by rw [hpt_im]; exact hy_ss_in_B.1,
              by rw [hpt_im]; exact hy_ss_in_B.2⟩,
             Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
          have hp_Q₂ : pt_q ∈ Q_famB x₂ :=
            ⟨⟨by rw [hpt_re]; exact hq.2.1.1,
              by rw [hpt_re]; exact hq.2.1.2.1,
              by rw [hpt_im]; exact hy_ss_in_B.1,
              by rw [hpt_im]; exact hy_ss_in_B.2⟩,
             Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
          have hx_q_Ioo : x_q ∈ Set.Ioo a₁' a₂' :=
            ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hq.1.1.1,
             lt_of_lt_of_le hq.1.1.2.1 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
          have hp_VT : pt_q ∈ rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)) := h_pt_VT x_q hx_q_Ioo
          have hp_eq : σ_famB x₁ pt_q = σ_famB x₂ pt_q :=
            (h_σ_eq_HT x₁ hx₁ pt_q ⟨hp_Q₁, hp_VT⟩).trans
              (h_σ_eq_HT x₂ hx₂ pt_q ⟨hp_Q₂, hp_VT⟩).symm
          exact hUniq (Q_famB x₁ ∩ Q_famB x₂) (σ_famB x₁) (σ_famB x₂) pt_q
            (isOpen_inter_rectB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) (isPreconn_inter_rectB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
            (Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left
              (rectB_sub_U _ _ _ _ (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
                (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
            ⟨hp_Q₁, hp_Q₂⟩
            ((hσ_famB x₁ hx₁).1.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
            ((hσ_famB x₂ hx₂).1.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
            (fun q' hq' => (hσ_famB x₁ hx₁).2.2 q' hq'.1)
            (fun q' hq' => (hσ_famB x₂ hx₂).2.2 q' hq'.2)
            hp_eq q hq
        obtain ⟨Sig_B, hSig_B_holo, hSig_B_eq, hSig_B_sol⟩ :=
          glue_family (Set.Ioo a₁' a₂') Q_famB σ_famB
            (fun x _ => isOpen_rectB _ _ _ _)
            (fun x hx => (hσ_famB x hx).1)
            (fun x hx => (hσ_famB x hx).2.2)
            h_compat_B
        have h_iUnion_B : (⋃ x ∈ Set.Ioo a₁' a₂', Q_famB x) =
            rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq (m + 1)) β₂'' := by
          ext ⟨w, t⟩
          constructor
          · intro hq
            obtain ⟨x, _, ⟨⟨hw₁, hw₂, hw₃, hw₄⟩, ht⟩⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hq
            exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hw₁,
              lt_of_lt_of_le hw₂ (min_le_left _ _), hw₃, hw₄⟩, ht⟩
          · rintro ⟨⟨hw₁, hw₂, hw₃, hw₄⟩, ht⟩
            exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨w.re, ⟨hw₁, hw₂⟩,
              ⟨⟨max_lt hw₁ (by linarith), lt_min hw₂ (by linarith), hw₃, hw₄⟩, ht⟩⟩
        rw [h_iUnion_B] at hSig_B_holo hSig_B_sol
        have h_agree_B : ∀ q ∈ rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq (m + 1)) β₂'' ∩
            rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)), Sig_B q = H_T q := by
          intro q ⟨hq_SB, hq_VT⟩
          rw [← h_iUnion_B] at hq_SB
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hq_Qx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hq_SB
          rw [hSig_B_eq x hx q hq_Qx]
          exact h_σ_eq_HT x hx q ⟨hq_Qx, hq_VT⟩
        obtain ⟨H_next, hHn_holo, _, hHn_2, hHn_sol⟩ :=
          paste_two (rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq (m + 1)) β₂'')
            (rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1))) Sig_B H_T
            (isOpen_rectB _ _ _ _) (isOpen_rectB _ _ _ _)
            hSig_B_holo hHT_holo hSig_B_sol hHT_sol h_agree_B
        have h_ord₁ : β₁_seq (m + 1) ≤ β₁_seq m := by
          dsimp [β₁_seq]; push_cast; exact max_le_max le_rfl (by linarith)
        have h_ord₂ : β₁_seq m < β₂'' := by
          rw [hβ₁m_eq]; dsimp [β₂'', y_ss]
          exact lt_min (by linarith [hw₀_im₂]) (by linarith)
        have h_ord₃ : β₂'' ≤ β₂_seq (m + 1) := by
          dsimp [β₂'', β₂_seq, y_ss]; push_cast; exact min_le_min le_rfl (by linarith)
        have h_unB : rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq (m + 1)) β₂'' ∪
            rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)) =
            rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq (m + 1)) (β₂_seq (m + 1)) :=
          rectB_union_y _ _ _ _ _ _ h_ord₁ h_ord₂ h_ord₃
        rw [h_unB] at hHn_holo hHn_sol
        have hw₀_VT : (w₀, t_c) ∈ rectB a₁' a₂' (β₁_seq m) (β₂_seq (m + 1)) :=
          ⟨⟨hw₀_re₁, hw₀_re₂, (hy₀_β m).1, (hy₀_β (m + 1)).2⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos⟩
        exact ⟨H_next, hHn_holo, (hHn_2 (w₀, t_c) hw₀_VT).trans hHT_pt, hHn_sol⟩
  obtain ⟨N_y, hN_y⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (b₂' - y₀) (y₀ - b₁') / s)
  have hN_y_mul : max (b₂' - y₀) (y₀ - b₁') < (N_y : ℝ) * s :=
    (div_lt_iff₀ hs_pos).mp hN_y
  have hβ₁_Ny : β₁_seq N_y = b₁' :=
    max_eq_left (by linarith [le_max_right (b₂' - y₀) (y₀ - b₁')])
  have hβ₂_Ny : β₂_seq N_y = b₂' :=
    min_eq_left (by linarith [le_max_left (b₂' - y₀) (y₀ - b₁')])
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ_holo, hΛ_pt, hΛ_sol⟩ := hVert N_y
  rw [hβ₁_Ny, hβ₂_Ny] at hΛ_holo hΛ_sol
  exact ⟨η, Λ, hη_pos, hη_le_rt, hΛ_holo, hΛ_pt, hΛ_sol⟩

(Ω : Set Plane)

    (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)

    (hRectCont : SeparableRectRootContProp)
    (H₁ η t₁ t₂ H₂ : ℝ)
    (B_poly : FullBandPolyData W H₁ η t₁)
    (β : Fin B_poly.N_cov)
    (ht₂_mem : |t₂| < W.r_base)
    (ht₂_β : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (B_poly.τ_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_t β / 4))
    (hhL : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂)
    (hH₂_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₂) :
    (∀ x_mod : ℝ,
      (x_mod : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ Metric.ball (B_poly.y_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_y β / 4) →
      B_poly.H_exc β ((x_mod : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₂ : ℂ)) ≠ 0 →
      WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x_mod) ∧
    (∀ (x_star : ℝ) (k_shift : ℤ),
      IsIsolatedGraphSlicedAt (B_poly.y_c β) (B_poly.τ_c β)
        (B_poly.ρ_y β) (B_poly.ρ_t β) (B_poly.H_exc β) t₂ →
      ((x_star + t₂ - 2 * Real.pi * (k_shift : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
        Metric.ball (B_poly.y_c β) (3 * B_poly.ρ_y β / 4) →
      ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + t₂) →
      HasLoopBranchDefectAt W t₂ H₂ x_star)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have eqOn_zero_convex_2D : ∀ {W_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W_dom → Convex ℝ W_dom →
      ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W_dom →
      ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ W_dom → (∀ᶠ q in nhds p₀, f q = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ W_dom, f p = 0 := by
    intro W_dom hW_open hW_conv f hf_holo p₀ hp₀ hf_ev p hp
    let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun ζ => (p₀.1 + ζ * (p.1 - p₀.1), p₀.2 + ζ * (p.2 - p₀.2))
    have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
      (differentiable_const p₀.1 |>.add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _))).prodMk
        (differentiable_const p₀.2 |>.add (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
    let W₁ : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' W_dom
    have hW₁_open : IsOpen W₁ := hW_open.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
    have hW₁_conv : Convex ℝ W₁ := by
      intro ζ₁ hζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₂ a b ha hb hab
      have habC : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have haff : γ (a • ζ₁ + b • ζ₂) = a • γ ζ₁ + b • γ ζ₂ := by
        ext <;> simp only [γ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
          Complex.real_smul]
        · calc p₀.1 + (↑a * ζ₁ + ↑b * ζ₂) * (p.1 - p₀.1)
              = ((↑a + ↑b) * p₀.1) + (↑a * ζ₁ + ↑b * ζ₂) * (p.1 - p₀.1) := by rw [habC, one_mul]
            _ = ↑a * (p₀.1 + ζ₁ * (p.1 - p₀.1)) + ↑b * (p₀.1 + ζ₂ * (p.1 - p₀.1)) := by ring
        · calc p₀.2 + (↑a * ζ₁ + ↑b * ζ₂) * (p.2 - p₀.2)
              = ((↑a + ↑b) * p₀.2) + (↑a * ζ₁ + ↑b * ζ₂) * (p.2 - p₀.2) := by rw [habC, one_mul]
            _ = ↑a * (p₀.2 + ζ₁ * (p.2 - p₀.2)) + ↑b * (p₀.2 + ζ₂ * (p.2 - p₀.2)) := by ring
      change γ (a • ζ₁ + b • ζ₂) ∈ W_dom
      rw [haff]
      exact hW_conv hζ₁ hζ₂ ha hb hab
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ W₁ := by simpa [W₁, γ] using hp₀
    have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ W₁ := by
      change (p₀.1 + 1 * (p.1 - p₀.1), p₀.2 + 1 * (p.2 - p₀.2)) ∈ W_dom
      simpa using hp
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (f ∘ γ) W₁ :=
      hf_holo.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)
    have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ γ) W₁ := hg_holo.analyticOnNhd hW₁_open
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₀ := by ext <;> simp [γ]
    have hg_ev : (f ∘ γ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      have h_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto γ (nhds (0 : ℂ)) (nhds p₀) := by
        rw [← hγ0]
        exact hγ_diff.continuous.continuousAt
      exact h_tendsto.eventually hf_ev
    have h1 := AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hg_ana hW₁_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem hg_ev h1_mem
    simpa [γ] using h1

  have cancel_holo_convex_2D : ∀ {W_dom V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W_dom → Convex ℝ W_dom →
      IsOpen V → V ⊆ W_dom →
      ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, ContinuousOn f V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W_dom →
      (∃ q_nz ∈ W_dom, g q_nz ≠ 0) → (∀ q ∈ V, f q * g q = 0) →
      ∀ q ∈ V, f q = 0 := by
    intro W_dom V hW_open hW_conv hV_open hVW f g hf_cont hg_holo hg_nz hprod q₁ hq₁
    by_contra hfq₁
    obtain ⟨q_nz, hq_nz_W, hg_q_nz⟩ := hg_nz
    have hf_contAt : ContinuousAt f q₁ := (hf_cont q₁ hq₁).continuousAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq₁)
    have hg_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁, g q = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hV_open.mem_nhds hq₁, hf_contAt.eventually_ne hfq₁] with q hqV hfq
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod q hqV)).resolve_left hfq
    exact hg_q_nz (eqOn_zero_convex_2D hW_open hW_conv hg_holo (hVW hq₁) hg_ev q_nz hq_nz_W)

  have finset_prod_eq_zero_convex_2D : ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen V → Convex ℝ V → ∀ {p₀ : ℂ × ℂ}, p₀ ∈ V →
      ∀ (S : Finset α) (h : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ m ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (h m) V) →
        (∀ q ∈ V, (∏ m ∈ S, h m q) = 0) →
        ∃ m₀ ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ V, h m₀ q = 0 := by
    intro α _ V hV_open hV_conv p₀ hp₀ S h hh_holo hprod
    have hprod_diff : ∀ (T : Finset α),
        (∀ m ∈ T, DifferentiableOn ℂ (h m) V) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∏ m ∈ T, h m q) V := by
      intro T hT
      induction T using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
      | @insert b T hb ihT =>
        have hb_holo := hT b (Finset.mem_insert_self b T)
        have hT_holo := ihT (fun m hm => hT m (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm))
        have heq : (fun q => ∏ m ∈ insert b T, h m q) =
            fun q => h b q * ∏ m ∈ T, h m q := by
          ext q; exact Finset.prod_insert hb
        rw [heq]
        exact hb_holo.mul hT_holo
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      exfalso
      have h1 := hprod p₀ hp₀
      simp at h1
    | @insert a S ha ih =>
      by_cases ha_zero : ∀ q ∈ V, h a q = 0
      · exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_insert_self a S, ha_zero⟩
      · push Not at ha_zero
        have hS_holo : ∀ m ∈ S, DifferentiableOn ℂ (h m) V :=
          fun m hm => hh_holo m (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm)
        have hprod_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q => ∏ m ∈ S, h m q) V :=
          (hprod_diff S hS_holo).continuousOn
        have hS_zero : ∀ q ∈ V, (∏ m ∈ S, h m q) = 0 := by
          refine cancel_holo_convex_2D hV_open hV_conv hV_open Set.Subset.rfl hprod_cont
            (hh_holo a (Finset.mem_insert_self a S)) ha_zero (fun q hq => ?_)
          have hq0 := hprod q hq
          rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, mul_comm] at hq0
          exact hq0
        obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hm₀_zero⟩ := ih hS_holo hS_zero
        exact ⟨m₀, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hm₀, hm₀_zero⟩

  have isOpen_and_convex_rect : ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ),
      IsOpen { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ } ∧
      Convex ℝ { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ } := by
    intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂
    have heq : { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ } =
        (Complex.reLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a₁ a₂) ∩ (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo b₁ b₂) := by
      ext w
      simp [Set.mem_Ioo, and_assoc]
    rw [heq]
    refine ⟨(isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
        (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im),
      ((convex_Ioo a₁ a₂).linear_preimage Complex.reLm).inter

        ∑ d : Fin D, (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * c d.succ * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) →

      ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ P.roots.toFinset ↔ ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), c d * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by

      simp [hne]

    · rw [Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup, IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hdeg]
    · simp [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP_ne, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, heval]

  have hH₂_pos : 0 < H₂ := by linarith
  have ht₂_ball : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht₂_mem
  have hρ_y_pos : 0 < B_poly.ρ_y β := (B_poly.ρ_pos β).1
  have hρ_t_pos : 0 < B_poly.ρ_t β := (B_poly.ρ_pos β).2.1
  have ht₂_β_full : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (B_poly.τ_c β) (B_poly.ρ_t β) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht₂_β
  have hexp_half_pi : Complex.exp (((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Complex.I := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using Complex.exp_pi_div_two_mul_I
  have hexp_half_lt_two : Real.exp (1 / 2) < 2 := by
    have h1 : Real.exp (1 / 2) * Real.exp (1 / 2) = Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    have h2 : Real.exp 1 < 3 := lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num)
    have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (1 / 2) := Real.exp_pos _
    nlinarith

  
  have h_mem_tube : ∀ (y t : ℂ), t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base →
      0 < y.im → ENNReal.ofReal y.im < W.h_L t →
      (y, t) ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L := by
    intro y t ht hy_pos hy_lt
    refine ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht, ?_, hy_lt⟩
    have h0 : ENNReal.ofReal (-y.im) = 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (by linarith)
    have ht_conj : starRingEnd ℂ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_conj] using ht
    have hpos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hge1 : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t) :=
      W.h_X_ge_two _ ht_conj
    have hge2 : W.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t) ≤ W.h_L (starRingEnd ℂ t) := by
      rw [W.h_L_eq _ ht_conj]
      exact le_self_add
    rw [h0]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (le_trans hge1 hge2)

  have h_lsc_ball : ∀ (M δ₀ : ℝ), M < H₂ → 0 < δ₀ →
      ∃ δ_t : ℝ, 0 < δ_t ∧ δ_t ≤ δ₀ ∧
        Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t, ENNReal.ofReal M < W.h_L t := by
    intro M δ₀ hM hδ₀
    have hM_lt : ENNReal.ofReal M < W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) := by
      rw [hhL]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₂_pos).mpr hM
    have hlsc := W.h_L_lsc (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball (ENNReal.ofReal M) hM_lt
    rw [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht₂_ball)] at hlsc
    obtain ⟨r_lsc, hr_lsc_pos, hr_lsc⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hlsc
    let δ_t : ℝ := min δ₀ (min r_lsc (W.r_base - |t₂|))
    have hδ_t_pos : 0 < δ_t := lt_min hδ₀ (lt_min hr_lsc_pos (by linarith))
    refine ⟨δ_t, hδ_t_pos, min_le_left _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at ht ⊢
      have hle : δ_t ≤ W.r_base - |t₂| := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hdist0 : dist (t₂ : ℂ) 0 = |t₂| := by
        simp [dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc dist t 0 ≤ dist t (t₂ : ℂ) + dist (t₂ : ℂ) 0 := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < W.r_base := by rw [hdist0]; linarith
    · intro t ht
      exact hr_lsc t (Metric.ball_subset_ball
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) ht)

  
  let U_β : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (B_poly.y_c β) (B_poly.ρ_y β) ×ˢ
    Metric.ball (B_poly.τ_c β) (B_poly.ρ_t β)
  have hU_β_open : IsOpen U_β := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  let sh_C : ℤ → ℂ := fun k => ((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let τ_neg : ℤ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun k q => (q.1 - sh_C k, q.2)

  have hSeedUp : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (k_shift : ℤ) (p_seed : ℂ × ℂ),
      p_seed ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L →
      τ_neg k_shift p_seed ∈ U_β →
      B_poly.H_exc β (τ_neg k_shift p_seed) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (r_seed : ℝ) (ρ_seed : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_seed ∧ r_seed ≤ (W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ρ_seed (Metric.ball p_seed r_seed) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r_seed,
          τ_neg k_shift q ∈ U_β ∧
          B_poly.H_exc β (τ_neg k_shift q) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∑ d : Fin (B_poly.deg β ι + 1),
            B_poly.C_coeff β ι d (τ_neg k_shift q) * (ρ_seed q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 ∧
          (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed q = ρ_seed q * (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed q := by
    intro ι k_shift p_seed hp_tube hp0'_β hp0'_exc
    let p₀' : ℂ × ℂ := τ_neg k_shift p_seed
    have hτ_dist : ∀ q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ, dist (τ_neg k_shift q₁) (τ_neg k_shift q₂) = dist q₁ q₂ := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq]
      simp only [τ_neg, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_right]
    have hτ_diff : Differentiable ℂ (τ_neg k_shift) :=
      (differentiable_fst.sub_const _).prodMk differentiable_snd
    have hper_neg := hPer (-k_shift) ι p_seed hp_tube
    have hpt_eq : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ,
        (q.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * ((-k_shift : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ), q.2) = τ_neg k_shift q := by
      intro q
      ext <;> simp [τ_neg, sh_C]
      ring
    dsimp only at hper_neg
    simp only [hpt_eq] at hper_neg
    obtain ⟨hp₀'_tube, hper_eq⟩ := hper_neg
    obtain ⟨r_p, hr_p_pos, hr_p_le, hr_p_sub, hr_p_sol⟩ :=
      B_poly.primary_solves β ι p₀' ⟨hp0'_β, hp₀'_tube⟩
    have hexc_contAt : ContinuousAt (B_poly.H_exc β) p₀' :=
      ((B_poly.exc_holo β).continuousOn p₀' hp0'_β).continuousAt (hU_β_open.mem_nhds hp0'_β)
    obtain ⟨r_exc, hr_exc_pos, hr_exc⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (by filter_upwards [hU_β_open.mem_nhds hp0'_β, hexc_contAt.eventually_ne hp0'_exc]
            with q h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
    have hrad_seed_pos : 0 < (W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed := (W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p_seed hp_tube
    let r₁ : ℝ := min r_exc (min r_p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed))
    have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hr_exc_pos (lt_min hr_p_pos hrad_seed_pos)
    let D : ℕ := B_poly.deg β ι
    have hD_pos : 1 ≤ D := B_poly.deg_pos β ι
    let N : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed
    let Δ_den : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed
    let N₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (W.L_mero ι).num p₀'
    let D₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (W.L_mero ι).den p₀'
    let C_sh : Fin (D + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun d q => B_poly.C_coeff β ι d (τ_neg k_shift q)
    have hτ_ball_r₁ : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₁,
        τ_neg k_shift q ∈ U_β ∧ B_poly.H_exc β (τ_neg k_shift q) ≠ 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hdist : dist (τ_neg k_shift q) p₀' < r_exc := by
        rw [hτ_dist]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) (min_le_left _ _)
      exact hr_exc _ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist)
    have h_homog : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₁,
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) = 0 := by
      let f_hom : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))
      have hf_cont : ContinuousOn f_hom (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) := by
        have hf_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_hom (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) := by
          have hsub_seed : Metric.ball p_seed r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball p_seed ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed) :=
            Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
          have hN_h : DifferentiableOn ℂ N (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) :=
            ((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p_seed hp_tube).mono hsub_seed
          have hΔ_h : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_den (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) :=
            ((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p_seed hp_tube).mono hsub_seed
          have hC_h : ∀ d : Fin (D + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_sh d) (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) :=
            fun d => (B_poly.coeff_holo β ι d).comp hτ_diff.differentiableOn
              (fun q hq => (hτ_ball_r₁ q hq).1)
          have hsum_d : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin (D + 1))),
              DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∑ d ∈ S,
                C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)))
                (Metric.ball p_seed r₁) := by
            intro S
            induction S using Finset.induction_on with
            | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
            | @insert d S hd ih =>
              have heq : (fun q => ∑ m ∈ insert d S,
                  C_sh m q * (N q) ^ (m : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (m : ℕ))) =
                fun q => (C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) +
                  ∑ m ∈ S, C_sh m q * (N q) ^ (m : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (m : ℕ)) := by
                ext q; exact Finset.sum_insert hd
              rw [heq]
              exact (((hC_h d).mul (hN_h.pow _)).mul (hΔ_h.pow _)).add ih
          exact hsum_d Finset.univ
        exact hf_diff.continuousOn
      let r₀' : ℝ := (W.L_mero ι).rad p₀'
      have hr₀'_pos : 0 < r₀' := (W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p₀' hp₀'_tube
      have hr₁_le_r₀' : r₁ ≤ r₀' :=
        le_trans (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hr_p_le
      let g_den : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ D
      have hg_den_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_den (Metric.ball p_seed r₀') := by
        refine (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p₀' hp₀'_tube).comp hτ_diff.differentiableOn ?_).pow D
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, hτ_dist]
        exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
      have hg_den_nz : ∃ q_nz ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₀', g_den q_nz ≠ 0 := by
        obtain ⟨q_nz', hq_nz'_mem, hq_nz'_ne⟩ := (W.L_mero ι).den_ne_zero p₀' hp₀'_tube
        let q_nz : ℂ × ℂ := (q_nz'.1 + sh_C k_shift, q_nz'.2)
        have hτ_q : τ_neg k_shift q_nz = q_nz' := by ext <;> simp [τ_neg, q_nz]
        have hq_mem : q_nz ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₀' := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← hτ_dist, hτ_q]
          exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq_nz'_mem
        exact ⟨q_nz, hq_mem, by dsimp [g_den]; rw [hτ_q]; exact pow_ne_zero D hq_nz'_ne⟩
      refine cancel_holo_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p_seed r₀')
        Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le_r₀') hf_cont hg_den_holo hg_den_nz ?_
      intro q hq
      have hq_min : q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed (min ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed) r₀') := by
        refine Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_min ?_ hr₁_le_r₀') hq
        exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hcross : N₀ (τ_neg k_shift q) * Δ_den q = N q * D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q) :=
        hper_eq q hq_min
      have hτ_rp : τ_neg k_shift q ∈ Metric.ball p₀' r_p := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, hτ_dist]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hsol0 := hr_p_sol (τ_neg k_shift q) hτ_rp
      dsimp only [f_hom, g_den, C_sh, N, Δ_den, N₀, D₀] at hcross hsol0 ⊢
      calc (∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
              B_poly.C_coeff β ι d (τ_neg k_shift q) *
                (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) *
            (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ D
          = ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
              B_poly.C_coeff β ι d (τ_neg k_shift q) *
                ((N q * D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (d : ℕ) *
                  (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) * (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
            have hd_add : (d : ℕ) + (D - (d : ℕ)) = D := by have := d.isLt; omega
            have hpow_D : (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ D =
                (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (d : ℕ) * (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) := by
              rw [← pow_add, hd_add]
            rw [hpow_D, mul_pow]
            ring
        _ = (Δ_den q) ^ D * ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
              B_poly.C_coeff β ι d (τ_neg k_shift q) *
                (N₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (d : ℕ) *
                (D₀ (τ_neg k_shift q)) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
            rw [← hcross, mul_pow]
            have hd_add : (d : ℕ) + (D - (d : ℕ)) = D := by have := d.isLt; omega
            have hpow_Δ : (Δ_den q) ^ D =
                (Δ_den q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) := by
              rw [← pow_add, hd_add]
            rw [hpow_Δ]
            ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hsol0, mul_zero]
    have hC_sh_sep : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₁,
        C_sh (Fin.last D) q ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin D, (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * C_sh d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0 :=
      fun q hq => B_poly.separable_at β ι (τ_neg k_shift q)
        (hτ_ball_r₁ q hq).1 (hτ_ball_r₁ q hq).2
    let P_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → Polynomial ℂ := fun q =>
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), Polynomial.C (C_sh d q) * Polynomial.X ^ (d : ℕ)
    let S₀ : Finset ℂ := (P_fn p_seed).roots.toFinset
    have hS₀_props := poly_simple_roots_card D (fun d => C_sh d p_seed)
      (hC_sh_sep p_seed (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos)).1
      (hC_sh_sep p_seed (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos)).2
    have hS₀_card : S₀.card = D := hS₀_props.1
    let ε : ℝ := r₁ / 4
    have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
    let y_s : ℂ := p_seed.1
    let t_s : ℂ := p_seed.2
    let R_w : Set ℂ :=
      { w : ℂ | y_s.re - ε < w.re ∧ w.re < y_s.re + ε ∧
          y_s.im - ε < w.im ∧ w.im < y_s.im + ε }
    let R_w' : Set ℂ :=
      { w : ℂ | y_s.re - ε / 2 < w.re ∧ w.re < y_s.re + ε / 2 ∧
          y_s.im - ε / 2 < w.im ∧ w.im < y_s.im + ε / 2 }
    have hRw'_open : IsOpen R_w' :=
      (isOpen_and_convex_rect (y_s.re - ε / 2) (y_s.re + ε / 2)
        (y_s.im - ε / 2) (y_s.im + ε / 2)).1
    have hy_s_Rw' : y_s ∈ R_w' := ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hrect_sub_r₁ : R_w ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s ε ⊆ Metric.ball p_seed r₁ := by
      intro q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, lt_trans (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.2) (by dsimp [ε]; linarith)⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have hre : |(q.1 - y_s).re| < ε := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by simp; linarith [hq.1.1], by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.1]⟩
      have him : |(q.1 - y_s).im| < ε := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.1], by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩
      have hn := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (q.1 - y_s)
      dsimp only [y_s, ε] at hn hre him ⊢
      linarith
    have hC_sh_holo : ∀ d : Fin (D + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (C_sh d) (R_w ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s ε) :=
      fun d => (B_poly.coeff_holo β ι d).comp hτ_diff.differentiableOn
        (fun q hq => (hτ_ball_r₁ q (hrect_sub_r₁ hq)).1)
    have hex_sheet : ∀ z : ↥S₀, ∃ (δ_z : ℝ) (ρ_z : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_z ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ ρ_z (R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s δ_z) ∧
        ρ_z p_seed = (z : ℂ) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s δ_z,
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * (ρ_z q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
      intro z
      have hz_root : ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d (y_s, t_s) * (z : ℂ) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
        simpa [y_s, t_s] using (hS₀_props.2 z.1).mp z.2
      obtain ⟨δ_z, ρ_z, hδ_z_pos, _, hρ_z_holo, hρ_z_val, hρ_z_root⟩ :=
        (hRectCont (y_s.re - ε) (y_s.re + ε) (y_s.im - ε) (y_s.im + ε) t_s ε D
          (by linarith) (by linarith) hε_pos hD_pos C_sh hC_sh_holo
          (fun q hq => hC_sh_sep q (hrect_sub_r₁ hq))).2
          (y_s.re - ε / 2) (y_s.re + ε / 2) (y_s.im - ε / 2) (y_s.im + ε / 2) y_s z.1
          (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
          hz_root
      exact ⟨δ_z, ρ_z, hδ_z_pos, hρ_z_holo, by simpa [y_s, t_s] using hρ_z_val, hρ_z_root⟩
    choose δ_z ρ_z hδ_z_pos hρ_z_holo hρ_z_val hρ_z_root using hex_sheet
    have hev_dom : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_seed, ∀ z : ↥S₀, q ∈ R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s (δ_z z) := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      intro z
      exact (hRw'_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
        ⟨hy_s_Rw', Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z)⟩
    have hev_sep : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_seed,
        ∀ pair : ↥S₀ × ↥S₀, pair.1 ≠ pair.2 → ρ_z pair.1 q ≠ ρ_z pair.2 q := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      rintro ⟨z₁, z₂⟩
      by_cases hne : z₁ = z₂
      · subst hne
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ h => False.elim (h rfl))
      · have hval_ne : ρ_z z₁ p_seed - ρ_z z₂ p_seed ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hρ_z_val z₁, hρ_z_val z₂]
          exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hEq => hne (Subtype.ext hEq))
        have hc1 : ContinuousAt (ρ_z z₁) p_seed :=
          ((hρ_z_holo z₁).continuousOn p_seed
            ⟨hy_s_Rw', Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₁)⟩).continuousAt
            ((hRw'_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
              ⟨hy_s_Rw', Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₁)⟩)
        have hc2 : ContinuousAt (ρ_z z₂) p_seed :=
          ((hρ_z_holo z₂).continuousOn p_seed
            ⟨hy_s_Rw', Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₂)⟩).continuousAt
            ((hRw'_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
              ⟨hy_s_Rw', Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₂)⟩)
        filter_upwards [(hc1.sub hc2).eventually_ne hval_ne] with q hq _
          using sub_ne_zero.mp hq
    obtain ⟨r_nb, hr_nb_pos, hr_nb⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hev_dom.and hev_sep)
    let r_seed : ℝ := min r₁ r_nb
    have hr_seed_pos : 0 < r_seed := lt_min hr₁_pos hr_nb_pos
    have hB0_prod_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r_seed,
        (∏ z : ↥S₀, (N q - ρ_z z q * Δ_den q)) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq_r₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₁ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
      have hq_nb := hr_nb q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
      by_cases hden_ne : Δ_den q = 0
      · have hhom := h_homog q hq_r₁
        rw [hden_ne] at hhom
        have hlast_eq : (∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) =
            C_sh (Fin.last D) q * (N q) ^ D := by
          refine (Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last D) (fun d _ hd => ?_)
            (fun h => False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ _)))).trans ?_
          · have hsub_ne : D - (d : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
              have hlt : (d : ℕ) < D :=
                lt_of_le_of_ne (Fin.is_le d) (fun hEq => hd (Fin.ext hEq))
              omega
            rw [zero_pow hsub_ne, mul_zero]
          · simp
        rw [hlast_eq] at hhom
        have hN_zero : N q = 0 :=
