          eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero ((mul_eq_zero.mp hhom).resolve_left (hC_sh_sep q hq_r₁).1)
        have hS₀_ne : S₀.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hS₀_card]; omega)
        obtain ⟨z_any, hz_any⟩ := hS₀_ne
        refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (⟨z_any, hz_any⟩ : ↥S₀)) ?_
        rw [hN_zero, hden_ne, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      · let w_val : ℂ := N q / Δ_den q
        have hw_mul : w_val * Δ_den q = N q := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden_ne
        have hw_root : ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * w_val ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
          have hhom := h_homog q hq_r₁
          have hfac : (∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * (N q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) =
              (∑ d : Fin (D + 1), C_sh d q * w_val ^ (d : ℕ)) * (Δ_den q) ^ D := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
            have hd_add : (d : ℕ) + (D - (d : ℕ)) = D := by have := d.isLt; omega
            have hpow_Δ : (Δ_den q) ^ D =
                (Δ_den q) ^ (d : ℕ) * (Δ_den q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) := by
              rw [← pow_add, hd_add]
            rw [← hw_mul, mul_pow, hpow_Δ]
            ring
          rw [hfac] at hhom
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hhom).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero D hden_ne)
        have hPq_props := poly_simple_roots_card D (fun d => C_sh d q)
          (hC_sh_sep q hq_r₁).1 (hC_sh_sep q hq_r₁).2
        let img_q : Finset ℂ := Finset.univ.image (fun z : ↥S₀ => ρ_z z q)
        have himg_sub : img_q ⊆ (P_fn q).roots.toFinset := by
          intro ζ hζ
          obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hζ
          exact (hPq_props.2 _).mpr (hρ_z_root z q (hq_nb.1 z))
        have himg_card : img_q.card = D := by
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn]
          · rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe, hS₀_card]
          · intro z₁ _ z₂ _ heq
            by_contra hne
            exact hq_nb.2 (z₁, z₂) hne heq
        have himg_eq : img_q = (P_fn q).roots.toFinset :=
          Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le himg_sub (by rw [himg_card, hPq_props.1])
        have hw_in_img : w_val ∈ img_q := by
          rw [himg_eq]
          exact (hPq_props.2 w_val).mpr hw_root
        obtain ⟨z₀, _, hz₀_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw_in_img
        refine Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ z₀) ?_
        rw [hz₀_eq, hw_mul, sub_self]
    have hfac_holo : ∀ z ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ↥S₀),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => N q - ρ_z z q * Δ_den q) (Metric.ball p_seed r_seed) := by
      intro z _
      have hsub_seed : Metric.ball p_seed r_seed ⊆ Metric.ball p_seed ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
      have hsub_z : Metric.ball p_seed r_seed ⊆ R_w' ×ˢ Metric.ball t_s (δ_z z) :=
        fun q hq => (hr_nb q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).1 z
      exact (((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p_seed hp_tube).mono hsub_seed).sub
        (((hρ_z_holo z).mono hsub_z).mul (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p_seed hp_tube).mono hsub_seed))
    obtain ⟨z_win, _, hz_win_eq⟩ := finset_prod_eq_zero_convex_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p_seed r_seed) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_seed_pos)
      Finset.univ (fun z q => N q - ρ_z z q * Δ_den q) hfac_holo hB0_prod_zero
    refine ⟨r_seed, ρ_z z_win, hr_seed_pos,
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)),
      (hρ_z_holo z_win).mono (fun q hq =>
        (hr_nb q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)).1 z_win),
      fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq_r₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r₁ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq
    have hq_nb := hr_nb q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq)
    exact ⟨(hτ_ball_r₁ q hq_r₁).1, (hτ_ball_r₁ q hq_r₁).2,
      hρ_z_root z_win q (hq_nb.1 z_win), sub_eq_zero.mp (hz_win_eq q hq)⟩

  
  have hWallBuild : ∀ (x δ_x δ_t₀ : ℝ) (y_seed : ℂ) (N_q D_q : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ_x → δ_x < W.s_base → 0 < δ_t₀ →
      let y_wall : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let U_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_wall δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t₀
      let p_seed : ℂ × ℂ := (y_seed, (t₂ : ℂ))
      y_seed ∈ Metric.ball y_wall δ_x →
      y_seed.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_q ι) U_box ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_q ι) U_box) →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, D_q ι p_seed ≠ 0) →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_seed,
        (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed q * D_q ι q = N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed q) →
      WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x := by
    intro x δ_x δ_t₀ y_seed N_q D_q hδ_x_pos hδ_x_lt hδ_t₀_pos
      y_wall U_box p_seed hy_seed_ball hy_seed_im hND_holo hD_nz hGerm
    obtain ⟨δ_t, hδ_t_pos, hδ_t_le, hδ_t_sub, hδ_t_hL⟩ :=
      h_lsc_ball (H₂ - δ_x / 4) δ_t₀ (by linarith) hδ_t₀_pos
    let U_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_wall δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t
    have hU_reg_sub : U_reg ⊆ U_box := Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_t_le)
    have hU_reg_open : IsOpen U_reg := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hU_reg_conv : Convex ℝ U_reg := (convex_ball y_wall δ_x).prod (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)
    have hp_seed_reg : p_seed ∈ U_reg := ⟨hy_seed_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_pos⟩
    let rad_reg : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => min (δ_x - dist p.1 y_wall) (δ_t - dist p.2 (t₂ : ℂ))
    have hrad_reg_pos : ∀ p ∈ U_reg, 0 < rad_reg p := fun p hp =>
      lt_min (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.1)) (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hp.2))
    have hrad_reg_sub : ∀ p ∈ U_reg, Metric.ball p (rad_reg p) ⊆ U_reg := by
      intro p hp q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hq
      have h1 : dist q.1 p.1 < δ_x - dist p.1 y_wall :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hq.1 (min_le_left _ _)
      have h2 : dist q.2 p.2 < δ_t - dist p.2 (t₂ : ℂ) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hq.2 (min_le_right _ _)
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [dist_triangle q.1 p.1 y_wall]),
        Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [dist_triangle q.2 p.2 (t₂ : ℂ)])⟩
    let G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D U_reg := fun ι =>
      { rad := rad_reg
        num := fun _ => N_q ι
        den := fun _ => D_q ι
        rad_pos := hrad_reg_pos
        ball_sub := hrad_reg_sub
        num_holo := fun p hp => ((hND_holo ι).1.mono hU_reg_sub).mono (hrad_reg_sub p hp)
        den_holo := fun p hp => ((hND_holo ι).2.mono hU_reg_sub).mono (hrad_reg_sub p hp)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          by_contra h_all_zero
          push Not at h_all_zero
          have hev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p, D_q ι q = 0 := by
            filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
              (Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad_reg_pos p hp))] with q hq using h_all_zero q hq
          exact hD_nz ι (eqOn_zero_convex_2D hU_reg_open hU_reg_conv
            ((hND_holo ι).2.mono hU_reg_sub) hp hev p_seed hp_seed_reg)
        compat := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl }
    let U_low : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball y_wall δ_x ∧ y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t
    have hU_low_open : IsOpen U_low :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod
        Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hU_low_conv : Convex ℝ U_low := by
      have him_conv : Convex ℝ { y : ℂ | y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } :=
        (convex_Iio (H₂ - δ_x / 2)).linear_preimage Complex.imLm
      exact ((convex_ball y_wall δ_x).inter him_conv).prod (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)
    have hp_seed_low : p_seed ∈ U_low := ⟨⟨hy_seed_ball, hy_seed_im⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_pos⟩
    have hU_low_sub : U_low ⊆ U_reg ∩ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨⟨hp.1.1, hp.2⟩, h_mem_tube p.1 p.2 (hδ_t_sub hp.2) ?_ ?_⟩
      · have hdist : ‖p.1 - y_wall‖ < δ_x := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1.1
        have him_diff : |(p.1 - y_wall).im| ≤ ‖p.1 - y_wall‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        have hy_wall_im : y_wall.im = H₂ := by simp [y_wall]
        have habs : |p.1.im - H₂| < δ_x := by simpa [hy_wall_im] using lt_of_le_of_lt him_diff hdist
        linarith [(abs_lt.mp habs).1]
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith [hp.1.2])) (hδ_t_hL p.2 hp.2)
    refine ⟨δ_x, δ_t, G, hδ_x_pos, hδ_t_pos, hδ_t_sub, fun ι => ⟨hU_low_sub, ?_⟩⟩
    let r_min : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => min ((G ι).rad p) ((W.L_mero ι).rad p)
    have hr_min_pos : ∀ p ∈ U_low, 0 < r_min p := fun p hp =>
      lt_min (hrad_reg_pos p (hU_low_sub hp).1) ((W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p (hU_low_sub hp).2)
    let S_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p ∈ U_low | ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (r_min p),
          N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p q = (W.L_mero ι).num p q * D_q ι q }
    have h_step_eq : ∀ {p p' : ℂ × ℂ}, p ∈ S_eq → p' ∈ U_low →
        (Metric.ball p (r_min p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (r_min p')).Nonempty → p' ∈ S_eq := by
      intro p p' hp_S hp'_low ⟨q₀, hq₀_p, hq₀_p'⟩
      refine ⟨hp'_low, ?_⟩
      let B_p' : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p' (r_min p')
      let V_ov : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p (r_min p) ∩ B_p'
      have hB_p'_sub_reg : B_p' ⊆ U_reg :=
        Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
          (hrad_reg_sub p' (hU_low_sub hp'_low).1)
      have hB_p'_sub_mero : B_p' ⊆ Metric.ball p' ((W.L_mero ι).rad p') :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      let diff_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
        N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p' q - (W.L_mero ι).num p' q * D_q ι q
      have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ diff_fn B_p' :=
        ((((hND_holo ι).1.mono hU_reg_sub).mono hB_p'_sub_reg).mul
          (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p' (hU_low_sub hp'_low).2).mono hB_p'_sub_mero)).sub
        ((((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p' (hU_low_sub hp'_low).2).mono hB_p'_sub_mero).mul
          (((hND_holo ι).2.mono hU_reg_sub).mono hB_p'_sub_reg))
      have hV_sub_p : V_ov ⊆ Metric.ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p) :=
        Subset.trans inter_subset_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
      have hV_zero : ∀ q ∈ V_ov, diff_fn q = 0 := by
        refine cancel_holo_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p))
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball) hV_sub_p
          (hdiff_holo.continuousOn.mono inter_subset_right)
          ((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p (hU_low_sub hp_S.1).2)
          ((W.L_mero ι).den_ne_zero p (hU_low_sub hp_S.1).2) (fun q hq => ?_)
        have h1 : N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p q = (W.L_mero ι).num p q * D_q ι q :=
          hp_S.2 q hq.1
        have h2 : (W.L_mero ι).num p q * (W.L_mero ι).den p' q =
            (W.L_mero ι).num p' q * (W.L_mero ι).den p q :=
          (W.L_mero ι).compat p (hU_low_sub hp_S.1).2 p' (hU_low_sub hp'_low).2 q
            ⟨hV_sub_p hq, hB_p'_sub_mero hq.2⟩
        dsimp only [diff_fn]
        calc (N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p' q - (W.L_mero ι).num p' q * D_q ι q) *
              (W.L_mero ι).den p q
            = (N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p q) * (W.L_mero ι).den p' q -
                ((W.L_mero ι).num p' q * (W.L_mero ι).den p q) * D_q ι q := by ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [h1, ← h2]; ring
      have hev_q₀ : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀, diff_fn q = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [(Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds ⟨hq₀_p, hq₀_p'⟩]
          with q hq using hV_zero q hq
      intro q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p' (r_min p'))
        hdiff_holo hq₀_p' hev_q₀ q hq)
    have hp_seed_S : p_seed ∈ S_eq := by
      refine ⟨hp_seed_low, ?_⟩
      let B_s : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p_seed (r_min p_seed)
      have hB_s_reg : B_s ⊆ U_reg :=
        Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
          (hrad_reg_sub p_seed hp_seed_reg)
      have hB_s_mero : B_s ⊆ Metric.ball p_seed ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      let diff_s : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
        N_q ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed q - (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed q * D_q ι q
      have hdiff_s_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ diff_s B_s :=
        ((((hND_holo ι).1.mono hU_reg_sub).mono hB_s_reg).mul
          (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p_seed (hU_low_sub hp_seed_low).2).mono hB_s_mero)).sub
        ((((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p_seed (hU_low_sub hp_seed_low).2).mono hB_s_mero).mul
          (((hND_holo ι).2.mono hU_reg_sub).mono hB_s_reg))
      have hev_s : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p_seed, diff_s q = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hGerm ι] with q hq using sub_eq_zero.mpr hq.symm
      intro q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p_seed (r_min p_seed))
        hdiff_s_holo (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_min_pos p_seed hp_seed_low)) hev_s q hq)
    have hS_open : IsOpen S_eq := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨r_low, hr_low_pos, hr_low_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_low_open p hp.1
      refine ⟨min r_low (r_min p), lt_min hr_low_pos (hr_min_pos p hp.1), fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'_low : p' ∈ U_low :=
        hr_low_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp')
      have hp'_in_p : p' ∈ Metric.ball p (r_min p) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp'
      exact h_step_eq hp hp'_low ⟨p', hp'_in_p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_min_pos p' hp'_low)⟩
    have hS_cl : closure S_eq ∩ U_low ⊆ S_eq := by
      rintro p' ⟨hp'_cl, hp'_low⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hp_S, hdist⟩ :=
        Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hp'_cl (r_min p') (hr_min_pos p' hp'_low)
      rw [dist_comm] at hdist
      exact h_step_eq hp_S hp'_low
        ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_min_pos p hp_S.1), Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist⟩
    have hAll : U_low ⊆ S_eq :=
      hU_low_conv.isPreconnected.subset_of_closure_inter_subset
        hS_open ⟨p_seed, hp_seed_low, hp_seed_S⟩ hS_cl
    intro p hp q hq
    exact (hAll hp).2 q hq

  
  have hLoopTransfer : ∀ (x_star r_u r_t ρ₀ δ_t_ann : ℝ) (z₁ : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_u → 0 < r_t → 0 < ρ₀ → ρ₀ < W.s_base / 2 → 2 * ρ₀ ≤ r_u →
      0 < δ_t_ann → δ_t_ann ≤ r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ z₁ (Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t) →
      z₁ (t₂ : ℂ) = (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ) →
      let D : Fin 2 → ℕ := fun ι => B_poly.deg β ι
      ∀ (a : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Fin (D ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ (ι : Fin 2) (d : Fin (D ι + 1)),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (a ι d) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t)) →
        (∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u, u ≠ 0 →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t,
            a ι (Fin.last (D ι)) (u, t) ≠ 0 ∧
            ∀ z : ℂ,
              ∑ d : Fin (D ι + 1), a ι d (u, t) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
              ∑ d : Fin (D ι),
                (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * a ι d.succ (u, t) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) →
        let R_ann : Set ℂ :=
          { w : ℂ | Real.log (ρ₀ / 2) < w.re ∧ w.re < Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8) ∧
              -Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16 < w.im ∧ w.im < 3 * Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16 }
        let w_seed : ℂ := (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8) : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        ∀ (Λ_ann : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_ann ι) (R_ann ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann)) →
          (∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ q ∈ R_ann ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann,
            ∑ d : Fin (D ι + 1), a ι d (Complex.exp q.1, q.2) * (Λ_ann ι q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) →
          (∀ ι : Fin 2,
            let p_seed : ℂ × ℂ := (z₁ (t₂ : ℂ) + Complex.exp w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ))
            ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)),
              (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed (z₁ q.2 + Complex.exp q.1, q.2) =
                Λ_ann ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed (z₁ q.2 + Complex.exp q.1, q.2)) →
          (∃ ι : Fin 2,
            ¬ ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)),
                Λ_ann ι (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) = Λ_ann ι q) →
          HasLoopBranchDefectAt W t₂ H₂ x_star := by
    intro x_star r_u r_t ρ₀ δ_t_ann z₁ hr_u hr_t hρ₀_pos hρ₀_lt hρ₀_ru
      hδ_ann_pos hδ_ann_le hz₁_holo hz₁_val D a ha_holo ha_sep R_ann w_seed
      Λ_ann hΛ_holo hΛ_root hΛ_att ⟨ι_star, h_mono_ne⟩
    have hpi_gt3 : (3 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
    refine ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_lt, fun ρ hρ_pos hρ_lt => ?_⟩
    let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let w_start : ℂ := (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (y_star - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I + (t₂ : ℂ), (t₂ : ℂ))
    have hexp_w_start : Complex.exp w_start = -(ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      dsimp only [w_start]
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_neg, ← Complex.ofReal_exp,
        Real.exp_log hρ_pos, hexp_half_pi, Complex.inv_I]
      ring
    have hp₀_im : p₀.1.im = H₂ - ρ := by simp [p₀, y_star]
    have hp₀_tube : p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L := by
      refine h_mem_tube p₀.1 (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball (by rw [hp₀_im]; linarith) ?_
      rw [hhL, hp₀_im]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₂_pos).mpr (by linarith)

    
    let α_lo : ℝ := min (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8)) - 1 / 4
    let α_hi : ℝ := max (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8)) + 1 / 4
    let R_out : Set ℂ :=
      { w' : ℂ | α_lo - 1 / 4 < w'.re ∧ w'.re < α_hi + 1 / 4 ∧
          -Real.pi < w'.im ∧ w'.im < 2 * Real.pi }
    let R_in : Set ℂ :=
      { w' : ℂ | α_lo < w'.re ∧ w'.re < α_hi ∧
          -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4 < w'.im ∧ w'.im < 3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4 }
    have hlog_max_lt : max (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8)) < Real.log ρ₀ :=
      max_lt (Real.log_lt_log hρ_pos hρ_lt) (Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hRout_exp_ball : ∀ w' ∈ R_out, Complex.exp w' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u := by
      intro w' hw'
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_exp]
      have hre_lt : w'.re < Real.log ρ₀ + 1 / 2 := by
        dsimp only [R_out, α_hi] at hw'
        linarith [hw'.2.1, hlog_max_lt]
      have hexp_lt : Real.exp w'.re < Real.exp (Real.log ρ₀ + 1 / 2) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hre_lt
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hρ₀_pos] at hexp_lt
      nlinarith [hexp_half_lt_two, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_ru]
    have hw_seed_R_ann : w_seed ∈ R_ann := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [w_seed] using Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
      · simpa [w_seed] using Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)
      · simp [w_seed]; linarith
      · simp [w_seed]; linarith
    have hex_ρ : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ (δ_ι : ℝ) (Λ_ι : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_ι ∧ δ_ι ≤ δ_t_ann ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Λ_ι (R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι) ∧
        Λ_ι (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) = Λ_ann ι (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι,
          ∑ d : Fin (D ι + 1), a ι d (Complex.exp q.1, q.2) * (Λ_ι q) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι, Λ_ι q = Λ_ann ι q) := by
      intro ι
      let A_exp : Fin (D ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun d q => a ι d (Complex.exp q.1, q.2)
      have hA_holo : ∀ d : Fin (D ι + 1),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_exp d) (R_out ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann) := by
        intro d
        have hmap : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (Complex.exp q.1, q.2)) :=
          (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp differentiable_fst).prodMk differentiable_snd
        exact (ha_holo ι d).comp hmap.differentiableOn
          (fun q hq => ⟨hRout_exp_ball q.1 hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ann_le hq.2⟩)
      have hA_sep : ∀ q ∈ R_out ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann,
          A_exp (Fin.last (D ι)) q ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ z : ℂ,
            ∑ d : Fin (D ι + 1), A_exp d q * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
            ∑ d : Fin (D ι),
              (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_exp d.succ q * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0 :=
        fun q hq => ha_sep ι (Complex.exp q.1) (hRout_exp_ball q.1 hq.1)
          (Complex.exp_ne_zero q.1) q.2 (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ann_le hq.2)
      have hα_lt : α_lo < α_hi := by
        dsimp [α_lo, α_hi]
        linarith [min_le_max (a := Real.log ρ) (b := Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      have hseed_re1 : α_lo < w_seed.re := by
        simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [α_lo]
        linarith [min_le_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      have hseed_re2 : w_seed.re < α_hi := by
        simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [α_hi]
        linarith [le_max_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      have hrect := hRectCont (α_lo - 1 / 4) (α_hi + 1 / 4) (-Real.pi) (2 * Real.pi)
        (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann (D ι) (by linarith) (by linarith) hδ_ann_pos (B_poly.deg_pos β ι)
        A_exp hA_holo hA_sep
      obtain ⟨δ_ι, Λ_ι, hδ_ι_pos, hδ_ι_le, hΛ_ι_holo, hΛ_ι_val, hΛ_ι_root⟩ :=
        hrect.2 α_lo α_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4)
          w_seed (Λ_ann ι (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)))
          (by linarith) hα_lt (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
          hseed_re1 hseed_re2 (by simp [w_seed]; linarith) (by simp [w_seed]; linarith)
          (hΛ_root ι (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ⟨hw_seed_R_ann, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_ann_pos⟩)
      have hov_open : IsOpen ((R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι) :=
        ((isOpen_and_convex_rect α_lo α_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4)).1.inter
          (isOpen_and_convex_rect (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)) (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8))
            (-Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16)).1).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hov_conv : Convex ℝ ((R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι) :=
        ((isOpen_and_convex_rect α_lo α_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4)).2.inter
          (isOpen_and_convex_rect (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)) (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8))
            (-Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16)).2).prod
          (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι)
      have hov_sub : (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι ⊆
          R_out ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann :=
        Set.prod_mono
          (fun w hw => ⟨by linarith [hw.1.1], by linarith [hw.1.2.1],
            by linarith [hw.1.2.2.1, hpi_gt3], by linarith [hw.1.2.2.2, hpi_gt3]⟩)
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ι_le)
      have hseed_ov : (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι :=
        ⟨⟨⟨hseed_re1, hseed_re2, by simp [w_seed]; linarith, by simp [w_seed]; linarith⟩,
          hw_seed_R_ann⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_ι_pos⟩
      have hov_eq : ∀ q ∈ (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ι, Λ_ι q = Λ_ann ι q :=
        hrect.1 _ Λ_ι (Λ_ann ι) (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) hov_open hov_conv.isPreconnected hov_sub
          hseed_ov
          (hΛ_ι_holo.mono (Set.prod_mono inter_subset_left Subset.rfl))
          ((hΛ_holo ι).mono (Set.prod_mono inter_subset_right (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ι_le)))
          (fun q hq => hΛ_ι_root q ⟨hq.1.1, hq.2⟩)
          (fun q hq => hΛ_root ι q ⟨hq.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ι_le hq.2⟩)
          hΛ_ι_val
      exact ⟨δ_ι, Λ_ι, hδ_ι_pos, hδ_ι_le, hΛ_ι_holo, hΛ_ι_val, hΛ_ι_root, hov_eq⟩
    choose δ_ι Λ_ρ hδ_ι_pos hδ_ι_le hΛ_ρ_holo _ _ hΛ_ρ_ov using hex_ρ
    let δ_ρ : ℝ := min (δ_ι 0) (δ_ι 1)
    have hδ_ρ_pos : 0 < δ_ρ := lt_min (hδ_ι_pos 0) (hδ_ι_pos 1)
    have hδ_ρ_le_ι : ∀ ι : Fin 2, δ_ρ ≤ δ_ι ι := fun ι => by
      fin_cases ι
      · exact min_le_left _ _
      · exact min_le_right _ _
    have hδ_ρ_le_rt : δ_ρ ≤ r_t := le_trans (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hδ_ι_le 0)) hδ_ann_le

    
    have h_mono_start : ¬ ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
        Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) = Λ_ρ ι_star q := by
      intro h_per_start
      let R_bot_ρ : Set ℂ :=
        { w' : ℂ | α_lo < w'.re ∧ w'.re < α_hi ∧
            -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4 < w'.im ∧ w'.im < -Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4 }
      let S_bot_ρ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_bot_ρ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ρ
      have hR_bot_oc := isOpen_and_convex_rect α_lo α_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4) (-Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4)
      have hS_open : IsOpen S_bot_ρ := hR_bot_oc.1.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hS_conv : Convex ℝ S_bot_ρ := hR_bot_oc.2.prod (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ρ)
      have hw_start_S : (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ S_bot_ρ := by
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, by simp [w_start]; linarith, by simp [w_start]; linarith⟩,
          Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_ρ_pos⟩
        · simp only [w_start, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
          dsimp [α_lo]; linarith [min_le_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
        · simp only [w_start, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
          dsimp [α_hi]; linarith [le_max_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      have hS_sub1 : S_bot_ρ ⊆ R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι_star) :=
        Set.prod_mono
          (fun w hw => ⟨hw.1, hw.2.1, hw.2.2.1, by linarith [hw.2.2.2, hpi_gt3]⟩)
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι_star))
      have hS_sub2 : ∀ q ∈ S_bot_ρ,
          (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) ∈ R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι_star) := by
        intro q hq
        exact ⟨⟨by simpa using hq.1.1, by simpa using hq.1.2.1,
          by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.1, hpi_gt3], by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι_star) hq.2⟩
      have hdiff_per : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) - Λ_ρ ι_star q)
          S_bot_ρ := by
        have hsh : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2)) :=
          (differentiable_fst.add_const _).prodMk differentiable_snd
        exact ((hΛ_ρ_holo ι_star).comp hsh.differentiableOn hS_sub2).sub
          ((hΛ_ρ_holo ι_star).mono hS_sub1)
      have hev_start : ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
          Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) - Λ_ρ ι_star q = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [h_per_start] with q hq using sub_eq_zero.mpr hq
      have hper_all : ∀ q ∈ S_bot_ρ,
          Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) = Λ_ρ ι_star q := fun q hq =>
        sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_convex_2D hS_open hS_conv hdiff_per hw_start_S hev_start q hq)
      let R_seed_nb : Set ℂ :=
        { w' : ℂ | max α_lo (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)) < w'.re ∧
            w'.re < min α_hi (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8)) ∧
            -Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16 < w'.im ∧ w'.im < -Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16 }
      have hR_nb_open := (isOpen_and_convex_rect (max α_lo (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)))
        (min α_hi (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8))) (-Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16) (-Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16)).1
      have hw_seed_nb : (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ R_seed_nb ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_ρ := by
        refine ⟨⟨max_lt ?_ hw_seed_R_ann.1, lt_min ?_ hw_seed_R_ann.2.1,
          by simp [w_seed]; linarith, by simp [w_seed]; linarith⟩,
          Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_ρ_pos⟩
        · simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
          dsimp [α_lo]; linarith [min_le_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
        · simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
          dsimp [α_hi]; linarith [le_max_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      apply h_mono_ne
      filter_upwards [(hR_nb_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hw_seed_nb] with q hq
      have hq_ov1 : q ∈ (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι_star) :=
        ⟨⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hq.1.1,
           lt_of_lt_of_le hq.1.2.1 (min_le_left _ _),
           by linarith [hq.1.2.2.1], by linarith [hq.1.2.2.2, hpi_gt3]⟩,
          ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hq.1.1,
           lt_of_lt_of_le hq.1.2.1 (min_le_right _ _),
           hq.1.2.2.1, by linarith [hq.1.2.2.2, hpi_gt3]⟩⟩,
         Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι_star) hq.2⟩
      have hq_ov2 : (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) ∈
          (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι_star) :=
        ⟨⟨⟨by simpa using hq_ov1.1.1.1, by simpa using hq_ov1.1.1.2.1,
           by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.1, hpi_gt3], by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩,
          ⟨by simpa using hq_ov1.1.2.1, by simpa using hq_ov1.1.2.2.1,
           by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.1, hpi_gt3], by simp; linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩⟩,
         Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι_star) hq.2⟩
      have hq_S : q ∈ S_bot_ρ :=
        ⟨⟨hq_ov1.1.1.1, hq_ov1.1.1.2.1, by linarith [hq.1.2.2.1], by linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩, hq.2⟩
      rw [← hΛ_ρ_ov ι_star _ hq_ov2, ← hΛ_ρ_ov ι_star _ hq_ov1]
      exact hper_all q hq_S

    
    let β_lo : ℝ := min (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8)) - 1 / 16
    let β_hi : ℝ := max (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8)) + 1 / 16
    let c_gap : ℝ := Real.exp β_lo / 2
    have hc_gap_pos : 0 < c_gap := by dsimp [c_gap]; positivity
    obtain ⟨δ_lsc, hδ_lsc_pos, hδ_lsc_le, hδ_lsc_sub, hδ_lsc_hL⟩ :=
      h_lsc_ball (H₂ - c_gap / 2) δ_ρ (by linarith) hδ_ρ_pos
    have hz₁_cont_t₂ : ContinuousAt z₁ (t₂ : ℂ) :=
      (hz₁_holo.continuousOn (t₂ : ℂ) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t)).continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t))
    obtain ⟨r_z₁, hr_z₁_pos, hr_z₁⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (hz₁_cont_t₂.tendsto.eventually
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
          (Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_min (by positivity : 0 < c_gap / 2) (by linarith : 0 < W.s_base / 2)))))
    let δ_t' : ℝ := min δ_lsc r_z₁
    have hδ_t'_pos : 0 < δ_t' := lt_min hδ_lsc_pos hr_z₁_pos
    let R_tube : Set ℂ :=
      { w' : ℂ | β_lo < w'.re ∧ w'.re < β_hi ∧
          -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8 < w'.im ∧ w'.im < -Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8 }
    let S_tube : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_tube ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t'
    have hR_tube_oc := isOpen_and_convex_rect β_lo β_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (-Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8)
    have hS_tube_open : IsOpen S_tube := hR_tube_oc.1.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hS_tube_conv : Convex ℝ S_tube := hR_tube_oc.2.prod (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t')
    let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (z₁ q.2 + Complex.exp q.1, q.2)
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ S_tube := by
      have hz₁_sub : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => z₁ q.2) S_tube :=
        hz₁_holo.comp differentiableOn_snd
          (fun q hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball
            (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans hδ_lsc_le hδ_ρ_le_rt)) hq.2)
      exact (hz₁_sub.add (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp differentiable_fst).differentiableOn).prodMk
        differentiableOn_snd
    have hΦ_maps : ∀ q ∈ S_tube, Φ q ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L := by
      intro q hq
      have ht_lsc : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_lsc :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq.2
      have ht_z₁ : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_z₁ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hq.2
      have hz₁_dist : ‖z₁ q.2 - z₁ (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < min (c_gap / 2) (W.s_base / 2) := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hr_z₁ q.2 ht_z₁
      have hz₁_im_diff : |((z₁ q.2).im - H₂)| ≤ ‖z₁ q.2 - z₁ (t₂ : ℂ)‖ := by
        have : (z₁ (t₂ : ℂ)).im = H₂ := by rw [hz₁_val]; simp
        simpa [this] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z₁ q.2 - z₁ (t₂ : ℂ))
      let η_im : ℝ := q.1.im + Real.pi / 2
      have hη_abs : |η_im| < 1 / 8 :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by dsimp [η_im]; linarith [hq.1.2.2.1], by dsimp [η_im]; linarith [hq.1.2.2.2]⟩
      have hcos_η : 1 / 2 < Real.cos η_im := by
        have h1 : 1 - η_im ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.cos η_im := Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos
        have hb := abs_lt.mp hη_abs
        nlinarith [hb.1, hb.2]
      have hexp_im : (Complex.exp q.1).im = -Real.exp q.1.re * Real.cos η_im := by
        rw [Complex.exp_im]
        have hq_im : q.1.im = η_im - Real.pi / 2 := by dsimp [η_im]; ring
        rw [hq_im, Real.sin_sub, Real.sin_pi_div_two, Real.cos_pi_div_two]
        ring
      have hexp_gt : Real.exp β_lo < Real.exp q.1.re := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hq.1.1
      have hexp_lt : Real.exp q.1.re < W.s_base := by
        have hre_lt : q.1.re < Real.log ρ₀ + 1 / 2 := by
          dsimp only [S_tube, R_tube, β_hi] at hq
          linarith [hq.1.2.1, hlog_max_lt]
        have h1 := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hre_lt
        rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hρ₀_pos] at h1
        nlinarith [hexp_half_lt_two, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_lt]
      have hexp_im_hi : (Complex.exp q.1).im < -c_gap := by
        rw [hexp_im]
        dsimp [c_gap]
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos β_lo, Real.exp_pos q.1.re]
      have hexp_im_lo : -W.s_base < (Complex.exp q.1).im := by
        rw [hexp_im]
        have hcos_le : Real.cos η_im ≤ 1 := Real.cos_le_one η_im
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos q.1.re]
      have hΦ_im : (Φ q).1.im = (z₁ q.2).im + (Complex.exp q.1).im := by simp [Φ]
      have hz₁_c : |(z₁ q.2).im - H₂| < c_gap / 2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hz₁_im_diff (lt_of_lt_of_le hz₁_dist (min_le_left _ _))
      have hz₁_s : |(z₁ q.2).im - H₂| < W.s_base / 2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt hz₁_im_diff (lt_of_lt_of_le hz₁_dist (min_le_right _ _))
      refine h_mem_tube (Φ q).1 q.2 (hδ_lsc_sub ht_lsc) ?_ ?_
      · rw [hΦ_im]; linarith [(abs_lt.mp hz₁_s).1]
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_) (hδ_lsc_hL q.2 ht_lsc)
        rw [hΦ_im]; linarith [(abs_lt.mp hz₁_c).2]

    have hden_comp_nz : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
        p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L →
        ∀ q₀ ∈ S_tube, ∀ η_b : ℝ, 0 < η_b →
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η_b, Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p)) →
          ¬ (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η_b, (W.L_mero ι).den p (Φ q) = 0) := by
      intro ι p hp q₀ hq₀ η_b hη_pos hΦ_ball h_all_zero
      let u₀ : ℂ := Complex.exp q₀.1
      have hu₀_ne : u₀ ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero q₀.1
      let ξ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => q₀.1 + Complex.log (u / u₀)
      have hξ_u₀ : ξ u₀ = q₀.1 := by simp [ξ, div_self hu₀_ne, Complex.log_one]
      have hdiv_slit : u₀ / u₀ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
        rw [div_self hu₀_ne]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane
      have hξ_cont : ContinuousAt ξ u₀ :=
        continuousAt_const.add ((continuousAt_id.div_const u₀).clog hdiv_slit)
      let r₀ : ℂ × ℂ := Φ q₀
      have hr₀_ball : r₀ ∈ Metric.ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p) :=
        hΦ_ball q₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)
      have ht₀_rt : q₀.2 ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans hδ_lsc_le hδ_ρ_le_rt)) hq₀.2
      have hz₁_cont_q₀ : ContinuousAt z₁ q₀.2 :=
        (hz₁_holo.continuousOn q₀.2 ht₀_rt).continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht₀_rt)
      let sub_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun r => r.1 - z₁ r.2
      have hsub_r₀ : sub_fn r₀ = u₀ := by simp [sub_fn, r₀, Φ, u₀]
      have hz₁_cont_r₀ : ContinuousAt z₁ r₀.2 := by simpa [r₀, Φ] using hz₁_cont_q₀
      have hsub_cont : ContinuousAt sub_fn r₀ :=
        continuousAt_fst.sub (ContinuousAt.comp (x := r₀) hz₁_cont_r₀ continuousAt_snd)
      let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun r => (ξ (sub_fn r), r.2)
      have hΨ_r₀ : Ψ r₀ = q₀ := by ext <;> simp [Ψ, hsub_r₀, hξ_u₀, r₀, Φ]
      have hΨ_cont : ContinuousAt Ψ r₀ := by
        have hξ_r₀ : ContinuousAt ξ (sub_fn r₀) := by rwa [hsub_r₀]
        exact (ContinuousAt.comp (x := r₀) hξ_r₀ hsub_cont).prodMk continuousAt_snd
      have hev_Ψ_ball : ∀ᶠ r in nhds r₀, Ψ r ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η_b := by
        have htend := hΨ_cont.tendsto
        rw [hΨ_r₀] at htend
        exact htend.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))
      have hev_slit : ∀ᶠ r in nhds r₀, sub_fn r / u₀ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
        have htend := (hsub_cont.div_const u₀).tendsto
        rw [hsub_r₀] at htend
        exact htend.eventually (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds hdiv_slit)
      have hev_den0 : ∀ᶠ r in nhds r₀, (W.L_mero ι).den p r = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hev_Ψ_ball, hev_slit] with r hr_ball hr_slit
        have h_right_inv : Φ (Ψ r) = r := by
          have hne : sub_fn r / u₀ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hr_slit
          have hexp_ξ : Complex.exp (ξ (sub_fn r)) = sub_fn r := by
            dsimp only [ξ]
            rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hne]
            exact mul_div_cancel₀ (sub_fn r) hu₀_ne
          ext
          · simp [Φ, Ψ, hexp_ξ, sub_fn]
          · simp [Φ, Ψ]
        rw [← h_right_inv]
        exact h_all_zero (Ψ r) hr_ball
      obtain ⟨q_nz, hq_nz_mem, hq_nz_ne⟩ := (W.L_mero ι).den_ne_zero p hp
      exact hq_nz_ne (eqOn_zero_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p))
        ((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p hp) hr₀_ball hev_den0 q_nz hq_nz_mem)

    have hw_start_tube : (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ S_tube := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, by simp [w_start]; linarith, by simp [w_start]; linarith⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t'_pos⟩
      · simp only [w_start, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [β_lo]; linarith [min_le_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      · simp only [w_start, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [β_hi]; linarith [le_max_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
    have hw_seed_tube : (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ S_tube := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, by simp [w_seed]; linarith, by simp [w_seed]; linarith⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t'_pos⟩
      · simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [β_lo]; linarith [min_le_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      · simp only [w_seed, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero]
        dsimp [β_hi]; linarith [le_max_right (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
    have hS_tube_sub_Rin : ∀ ι : Fin 2, S_tube ⊆ R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι) :=
      fun ι => Set.prod_mono
        (fun w hw => by
          dsimp only [R_tube, R_in, α_lo, β_lo, α_hi, β_hi] at hw ⊢
          exact ⟨by linarith [hw.1], by linarith [hw.2.1],
            by linarith [hw.2.2.1], by linarith [hw.2.2.2, hpi_gt3]⟩)
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans hδ_lsc_le (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι))))
    have hΦ_w_start : Φ (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) = p₀ := by
      ext
      · simp only [Φ, hz₁_val, hexp_w_start, p₀, y_star]; ring
      · rfl

    have h_att_p₀ : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ η_p₀ : ℝ, 0 < η_p₀ ∧
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) η_p₀,
          Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) ∧
          (W.L_mero ι).num p₀ (Φ q) = Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p₀ (Φ q) := by
      intro ι
      let S_att : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { q₀ ∈ S_tube | ∃ p ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L, ∃ η_b : ℝ, 0 < η_b ∧
            Metric.ball q₀ η_b ⊆ S_tube ∧
            (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η_b, Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((W.L_mero ι).rad p)) ∧
            (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η_b,
              (W.L_mero ι).num p (Φ q) = Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p (Φ q)) }
      have h_transfer_chart : ∀ {q₁ : ℂ × ℂ} {p₁ : ℂ × ℂ} {η₁ : ℝ},
          q₁ ∈ S_tube → p₁ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L → 0 < η₁ →
          Metric.ball q₁ η₁ ⊆ S_tube →
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ η₁, Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₁)) →
          (S_att ∩ Metric.ball q₁ η₁).Nonempty →
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ η₁,
            (W.L_mero ι).num p₁ (Φ q) = Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p₁ (Φ q) := by
        intro q₁ p₁ η₁ _ hp₁_tube _ hball₁_sub hΦ₁ ⟨q₀, hq₀_att, hq₀_in₁⟩
        obtain ⟨_, p', hp'_tube, η₀, hη₀_pos, _, hΦ₀, heq₀⟩ := hq₀_att
        let r_v : ℝ := min η₀ (η₁ - dist q₀ q₁)
        have hr_v_pos : 0 < r_v := lt_min hη₀_pos (sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₀_in₁))
        have hsub_0 : Metric.ball q₀ r_v ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ η₀ :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
        have hsub_1 : Metric.ball q₀ r_v ⊆ Metric.ball q₁ η₁ := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
          have : dist q q₀ < η₁ - dist q₀ q₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hq (min_le_right _ _)
          linarith [dist_triangle q q₀ q₁]
        let diff₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
          (W.L_mero ι).num p₁ (Φ q) - Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p₁ (Φ q)
        have hdiff₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ diff₁ (Metric.ball q₁ η₁) :=
          (((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p₁ hp₁_tube).comp (hΦ_holo.mono hball₁_sub) hΦ₁).sub
            (((hΛ_ρ_holo ι).mono (Subset.trans hball₁_sub (hS_tube_sub_Rin ι))).mul
              (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p₁ hp₁_tube).comp (hΦ_holo.mono hball₁_sub) hΦ₁))
        have hdiff₁_v : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_v, diff₁ q = 0 := by
          intro q_chk hq_chk
          by_contra hne0
          have hcontAt : ContinuousAt diff₁ q_chk :=
            (hdiff₁_holo.continuousOn q_chk (hsub_1 hq_chk)).continuousAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hsub_1 hq_chk))
          obtain ⟨ε_c, hε_c_pos, hε_c⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
            (by filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq_chk,
                  hcontAt.eventually_ne hne0] with q h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
          refine hden_comp_nz ι p' hp'_tube q_chk (hball₁_sub (hsub_1 hq_chk)) ε_c hε_c_pos
            (fun q hq => hΦ₀ q (hsub_0 (hε_c q hq).1)) (fun q hq => ?_)
          have hq_0 : q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η₀ := hsub_0 (hε_c q hq).1
          have hq_1 : q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ η₁ := hsub_1 (hε_c q hq).1
          have hcompat := (W.L_mero ι).compat p' hp'_tube p₁ hp₁_tube (Φ q)
            ⟨hΦ₀ q hq_0, hΦ₁ q hq_1⟩
          have hprod0 : diff₁ q * (W.L_mero ι).den p' (Φ q) = 0 := by
            dsimp only [diff₁]
            calc ((W.L_mero ι).num p₁ (Φ q) - Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p₁ (Φ q)) *
                  (W.L_mero ι).den p' (Φ q)
                = (W.L_mero ι).num p₁ (Φ q) * (W.L_mero ι).den p' (Φ q) -
                    (Λ_ρ ι q * (W.L_mero ι).den p' (Φ q)) * (W.L_mero ι).den p₁ (Φ q) := by ring
              _ = 0 := by rw [← hcompat, heq₀ q hq_0, sub_self]
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod0).resolve_left (hε_c q hq).2
        have hev_v : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀, diff₁ q = 0 := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v_pos)]
            with q hq using hdiff₁_v q hq
        intro q hq
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eqOn_zero_convex_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₁ η₁)
          hdiff₁_holo hq₀_in₁ hev_v q hq)
      have hS_att_open : IsOpen S_att := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        rintro q₀ ⟨_, p, hp, η_b, hη, hsub, hΦ_b, heq_b⟩
        refine ⟨η_b, hη, fun q₁ hq₁ => ?_⟩
        let η' : ℝ := η_b - dist q₁ q₀
        have hη' : 0 < η' := sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₁)
        have hsub' : Metric.ball q₁ η' ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ η_b := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
          linarith [dist_triangle q q₁ q₀]
        exact ⟨hsub hq₁, p, hp, η', hη', Subset.trans hsub' hsub,
          fun q hq => hΦ_b q (hsub' hq), fun q hq => heq_b q (hsub' hq)⟩
      have hseed_in_att : (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ S_att := by
        let p_seed : ℂ × ℂ := Φ (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ))
        have hp_seed_tube : p_seed ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L :=
          hΦ_maps (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) hw_seed_tube
        have hΦ_cont_s : ContinuousAt Φ (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
          (hΦ_holo.continuousOn _ hw_seed_tube).continuousAt (hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hw_seed_tube)
        have hev_rad : ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed ((W.L_mero ι).rad p_seed) :=
          hΦ_cont_s.tendsto.eventually
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
              (Metric.mem_ball_self ((W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p_seed hp_seed_tube)))
        have hR_ov_nb : (R_in ∩ R_ann) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι) ∈
            nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) := by
          have ho1 := (isOpen_and_convex_rect α_lo α_hi (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 4)
            (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 4)).1
          have ho2 := (isOpen_and_convex_rect (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)) (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8))
            (-Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16)).1
          exact ((ho1.inter ho2).prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
            ⟨⟨(hS_tube_sub_Rin ι hw_seed_tube).1, hw_seed_R_ann⟩,
             Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_ι_pos ι)⟩
        obtain ⟨η_s, hη_s_pos, hη_s⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
          (by filter_upwards [hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hw_seed_tube, hev_rad, hΛ_att ι, hR_ov_nb]
                with q h1 h2 h3 h4 using And.intro h1 (And.intro h2 (And.intro h3 h4)))
        refine ⟨hw_seed_tube, p_seed, hp_seed_tube, η_s, hη_s_pos,
          fun q hq => (hη_s q hq).1, fun q hq => (hη_s q hq).2.1, fun q hq => ?_⟩
        rw [hΛ_ρ_ov ι q (hη_s q hq).2.2.2]
        exact (hη_s q hq).2.2.1
      have hS_att_cl : closure S_att ∩ S_tube ⊆ S_att := by
        rintro q₁ ⟨hq₁_cl, hq₁_tube⟩
        let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := Φ q₁
        have hp₁_tube : p₁ ∈ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L := hΦ_maps q₁ hq₁_tube
        have hΦ_cont₁ : ContinuousAt Φ q₁ :=
          (hΦ_holo.continuousOn q₁ hq₁_tube).continuousAt (hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hq₁_tube)
        have hev_rad₁ : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁, Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₁) :=
          hΦ_cont₁.tendsto.eventually
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
              (Metric.mem_ball_self ((W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p₁ hp₁_tube)))
        obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
          (by filter_upwards [hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hq₁_tube, hev_rad₁]
                with q h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
        obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_att, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hq₁_cl η₁ hη₁_pos
        rw [dist_comm] at hdist
        refine ⟨hq₁_tube, p₁, hp₁_tube, η₁, hη₁_pos,
          fun q hq => (hη₁ q hq).1, fun q hq => (hη₁ q hq).2, ?_⟩
        exact h_transfer_chart hq₁_tube hp₁_tube hη₁_pos
          (fun q hq => (hη₁ q hq).1) (fun q hq => (hη₁ q hq).2)
          ⟨q₀, hq₀_att, Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdist⟩
      have hAll_att : S_tube ⊆ S_att :=
        hS_tube_conv.isPreconnected.subset_of_closure_inter_subset
          hS_att_open ⟨(w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)), hw_seed_tube, hseed_in_att⟩ hS_att_cl
      have hw_start_att : (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ S_att := hAll_att hw_start_tube
      have hΦ_cont_st : ContinuousAt Φ (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
        (hΦ_holo.continuousOn _ hw_start_tube).continuousAt (hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hw_start_tube)
      have hev_rad_p₀ : ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
          Φ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ((W.L_mero ι).rad p₀) := by
        have htend := hΦ_cont_st.tendsto
        rw [hΦ_w_start] at htend
        exact htend.eventually
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
            (Metric.mem_ball_self ((W.L_mero ι).rad_pos p₀ hp₀_tube)))
      obtain ⟨η_p₀, hη_p₀_pos, hη_p₀⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
        (by filter_upwards [hS_tube_open.mem_nhds hw_start_tube, hev_rad_p₀]
              with q h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
      refine ⟨η_p₀, hη_p₀_pos, fun q hq => ⟨(hη_p₀ q hq).2, ?_⟩⟩
      exact h_transfer_chart hw_start_tube hp₀_tube hη_p₀_pos
        (fun r hr => (hη_p₀ r hr).1) (fun r hr => (hη_p₀ r hr).2)
        ⟨(w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)), hw_start_att, Metric.mem_ball_self hη_p₀_pos⟩ q hq
    choose η_p₀ hη_p₀_pos hη_p₀_att using h_att_p₀

    
    let δ_w : ℝ := 1 / 16
    let Δ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => (y_star + t) - z₁ t
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t) :=
      ((differentiable_const y_star).add differentiable_id).differentiableOn.sub hz₁_holo
    have hΔ_t₂ : Δ (t₂ : ℂ) = 0 := by simp [Δ, hz₁_val, y_star]
    have hlog_cont1 : ContinuousAt Complex.log (1 : ℂ) :=
      continuousAt_clog Complex.one_mem_slitPlane
    have hlog_tend1 : Filter.Tendsto Complex.log (nhds (1 : ℂ)) (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      have ht := hlog_cont1.tendsto
      rwa [Complex.log_one] at ht
    obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁_pos, hε₁⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (by filter_upwards [Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds Complex.one_mem_slitPlane,
            hlog_tend1.eventually
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32)))]
            with z h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
    let ε_log : ℝ := min ε₁ (1 / 3)
    have hε_log_pos : 0 < ε_log := lt_min hε₁_pos (by norm_num)
    have hΔ_cont : ContinuousAt Δ (t₂ : ℂ) :=
      (hΔ_holo.continuousOn (t₂ : ℂ) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t)).continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t))
    have hΔ_tend : Filter.Tendsto Δ (nhds (t₂ : ℂ)) (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      have ht := hΔ_cont.tendsto
      rwa [hΔ_t₂] at ht
    have hpos_rΔ : 0 < ρ * ε_log / 3 := div_pos (mul_pos hρ_pos hε_log_pos) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨r_Δ, hr_Δ_pos, hr_Δ⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (hΔ_tend.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hpos_rΔ)))
    let δ_loop : ℝ := min δ_t' r_Δ
    have hδ_loop_pos : 0 < δ_loop := lt_min hδ_t'_pos hr_Δ_pos
    have hδ_loop_sub_base : Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base :=
      Subset.trans
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
        hδ_lsc_sub
    let R_loop : Set ℂ :=
      { w : ℂ | |w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
          w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8) }
    let LoopStrip : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_loop ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop
    have hR_loop_open : IsOpen R_loop := by
      have heq : R_loop =
          { w : ℂ | Real.log ρ - δ_w < w.re ∧ w.re < Real.log ρ + δ_w ∧
              -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8 < w.im ∧ w.im < 3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8 } := by
        ext w
        change (|w.re - Real.log ρ| < δ_w ∧
            w.im ∈ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8)) ↔
          (Real.log ρ - δ_w < w.re ∧ w.re < Real.log ρ + δ_w ∧
            -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 8 < w.im ∧ w.im < 3 * Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 8)
        simp only [Set.mem_Ioo, abs_sub_lt_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, h3, h4⟩
        · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h3, h4⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact (isOpen_and_convex_rect _ _ _ _).1
    have hLoop_open : IsOpen LoopStrip := hR_loop_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hw_start_Loop : (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ LoopStrip := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_loop_pos⟩
      · simp [w_start, δ_w]
      · simp [w_start]; linarith
      · simp [w_start]; linarith
    have hexp_bound_strip : ∀ (w : ℂ) (t : ℂ),
        |w.re - Real.log ρ| < 1 / 16 → t ∈ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop →
        ‖Complex.exp (-w) * Δ t‖ < ε_log := by
      intro w t hw_re ht_loop
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
      simp only [Complex.neg_re]
      have hΔ_lt : ‖Δ t‖ < ρ * ε_log / 3 := by
        have := hr_Δ t (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) ht_loop)
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using this
      have hw_lo : Real.log ρ - 1 / 16 < w.re := by linarith [(abs_lt.mp hw_re).1]
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (-w.re) < Real.exp (-Real.log ρ + 1 / 16) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by simp; linarith)
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg (Real.log ρ), Real.exp_log hρ_pos] at hexp_le
      have hexp_116 : Real.exp (1 / 16) < 3 := by
        have : Real.exp (1 / 16) < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num)
        exact lt_trans this (lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num))
      have hprod1 : Real.exp (-w.re) * ‖Δ t‖ ≤
          (ρ⁻¹ * Real.exp (1 / 16)) * (ρ * ε_log / 3) :=
        mul_le_mul (le_of_lt hexp_le) (le_of_lt hΔ_lt) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have hsimpl : (ρ⁻¹ * Real.exp (1 / 16)) * (ρ * ε_log / 3) =
          ε_log * (Real.exp (1 / 16) / 3) := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hρ_pos]
      rw [hsimpl] at hprod1
      nlinarith [hε_log_pos, hexp_116]

    let ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 + Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)
    have hψ_holo_maps : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ LoopStrip ∧
        ∀ p ∈ LoopStrip,
          (∀ ι : Fin 2, (ψ p, p.2) ∈ R_in ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_ι ι)) ∧
          z₁ p.2 + Complex.exp (ψ p) = y_star + Complex.exp p.1 + p.2 := by
      have hinner_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => 1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2) LoopStrip := by
        have hΔ_sub : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => Δ p.2) LoopStrip :=
          hΔ_holo.comp differentiableOn_snd
            (fun p hp => Metric.ball_subset_ball
              (le_trans (min_le_left _ _)
                (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans hδ_lsc_le hδ_ρ_le_rt))) hp.2)
        exact (differentiableOn_const 1).add
          (((Complex.differentiable_exp.comp differentiable_fst.neg).differentiableOn).mul hΔ_sub)
      have hinner_slit : ∀ p ∈ LoopStrip,
          (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2) ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧
          ‖Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)‖ < 1 / 32 := by
        intro p hp
        have hlt : dist (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2) 1 < ε₁ := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hexp_bound_strip p.1 p.2 hp.1.1 hp.2) (min_le_left _ _)
        have h1 := hε₁ _ (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hlt)
        exact ⟨h1.1, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using h1.2⟩
      refine ⟨differentiableOn_fst.add (hinner_holo.clog (fun p hp => (hinner_slit p hp).1)),
        fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have hlog_lt : ‖Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)‖ < 1 / 32 :=
        (hinner_slit p hp).2
      have hre_log : |(Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).re| < 1 / 32 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hlog_lt
      have him_log : |(Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).im| < 1 / 32 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hlog_lt
      have hp_re := abs_lt.mp hp.1.1
      dsimp only [δ_w] at hp_re
      refine ⟨fun ι => ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have hre : (ψ p).re = p.1.re + (Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).re := by
          simp [ψ]
        rw [hre]; dsimp [α_lo]
        linarith [hp_re.1, (abs_lt.mp hre_log).1,
          min_le_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      · have hre : (ψ p).re = p.1.re + (Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).re := by
          simp [ψ]
        rw [hre]; dsimp [α_hi]
        linarith [hp_re.2, (abs_lt.mp hre_log).2,
          le_max_left (Real.log ρ) (Real.log (5 * ρ₀ / 8))]
      · have him : (ψ p).im = p.1.im + (Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).im := by
          simp [ψ]
        rw [him]; linarith [hp.1.2.1, (abs_lt.mp him_log).1]
      · have him : (ψ p).im = p.1.im + (Complex.log (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)).im := by
          simp [ψ]
        rw [him]; linarith [hp.1.2.2, (abs_lt.mp him_log).2]
      · exact Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_trans (min_le_left _ _)
            (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans hδ_lsc_le (hδ_ρ_le_ι ι)))) hp.2
      · have hne : 1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2 ≠ 0 :=
          Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hinner_slit p hp).1
        have hexp_mul : Complex.exp p.1 * Complex.exp (-p.1) = 1 := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero]
        dsimp only [ψ]
        rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hne]
        calc z₁ p.2 + Complex.exp p.1 * (1 + Complex.exp (-p.1) * Δ p.2)
            = z₁ p.2 + Complex.exp p.1 + (Complex.exp p.1 * Complex.exp (-p.1)) * Δ p.2 := by ring
          _ = z₁ p.2 + Complex.exp p.1 + ((y_star + p.2) - z₁ p.2) := by rw [hexp_mul, one_mul]
          _ = y_star + Complex.exp p.1 + p.2 := by ring

    let Λ_loop : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => Λ_ρ ι (ψ p, p.2)
    have hΛ_loop_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Λ_loop ι) LoopStrip :=
      fun ι => (hΛ_ρ_holo ι).comp (hψ_holo_maps.1.prodMk differentiableOn_snd)
        (fun p hp => (hψ_holo_maps.2 p hp).1 ι)
    have hψ_at_start : (ψ (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)), (t₂ : ℂ)) = (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) := by
      ext
      · simp [ψ, hΔ_t₂, Complex.log_one]
      · rfl
    have hΨ_fwd_cont : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (ψ p, p.2)) (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
      ((hψ_holo_maps.1.continuousOn _ hw_start_Loop).continuousAt
        (hLoop_open.mem_nhds hw_start_Loop)).prodMk continuousAt_snd
    let η_att : ℝ := min (η_p₀ 0) (η_p₀ 1)
    have hη_att_pos : 0 < η_att := lt_min (hη_p₀_pos 0) (hη_p₀_pos 1)
    have hev_att : ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
        p ∈ LoopStrip ∧ (ψ p, p.2) ∈ Metric.ball (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) η_att := by
      have htend := hΨ_fwd_cont.tendsto
      rw [hψ_at_start] at htend
      filter_upwards [hLoop_open.mem_nhds hw_start_Loop,
        htend.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_att_pos))]
        with p h1 h2 using ⟨h1, h2⟩
    obtain ⟨r_att, hr_att_pos, hr_att⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_att

    
    have h_loop_mono_ne : ¬ ∀ᶠ p in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
        Λ_loop ι_star (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, p.2) = Λ_loop ι_star p := by
      intro h_per_loop
      let ψ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => q.1 + Complex.log (1 - Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2)
      let Ψ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (ψ_inv q, q.2)
      have hΨ_inv_start : Ψ_inv (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) = (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) := by
        ext
        · simp [Ψ_inv, ψ_inv, hΔ_t₂, Complex.log_one]
        · rfl
      have hinner_inv_cont : ContinuousAt
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => 1 - Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2) (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
        continuousAt_const.sub
          ((ContinuousAt.comp (x := (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)))
              Complex.continuous_exp.continuousAt continuousAt_fst.neg).mul
            (ContinuousAt.comp (x := (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ))) hΔ_cont continuousAt_snd))
      have hinner_inv_val :
          (1 - Complex.exp (-(w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)).1) * Δ (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)).2) = 1 := by
        simp [hΔ_t₂]
      have hΨ_inv_cont : ContinuousAt Ψ_inv (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
        (continuousAt_fst.add
          (hinner_inv_cont.clog (by rw [hinner_inv_val]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane))).prodMk
          continuousAt_snd
      have hev_pull : ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)),
          Λ_loop ι_star ((Ψ_inv q).1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, (Ψ_inv q).2) =
            Λ_loop ι_star (Ψ_inv q) := by
        have htend := hΨ_inv_cont.tendsto
        rw [hΨ_inv_start] at htend
        exact htend.eventually h_per_loop
      let R_inv_nb : Set ℂ :=
        { w' : ℂ | Real.log ρ - 1 / 32 < w'.re ∧ w'.re < Real.log ρ + 1 / 32 ∧
            -Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 16 < w'.im ∧ w'.im < -Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 16 }
      have hR_inv_open := (isOpen_and_convex_rect (Real.log ρ - 1 / 32) (Real.log ρ + 1 / 32)
        (-Real.pi / 2 - 1 / 16) (-Real.pi / 2 + 1 / 16)).1
      have hw_start_inv_nb : (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ R_inv_nb ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_loop := by
        refine ⟨⟨by simp [w_start], by simp [w_start],
          by simp [w_start]; linarith, by simp [w_start]; linarith⟩,
          Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_loop_pos⟩
      apply h_mono_start
      filter_upwards [hev_pull,
        (hR_inv_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hw_start_inv_nb] with q hq_eq hq_nb
      have hq_re : |q.1.re - Real.log ρ| < 1 / 16 :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hq_nb.1.1], by linarith [hq_nb.1.2.1]⟩
      have hu_lt : ‖Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2‖ < ε_log :=
        hexp_bound_strip q.1 q.2 hq_re hq_nb.2
      have hu_lt_third : ‖Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2‖ < 1 / 3 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hu_lt (min_le_right _ _)
      let ζ : ℂ := 1 - Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2
      have hζ_re : 0 < ζ.re := by
        have hre_le : |(Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2).re| ≤ ‖Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2‖ :=
          Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        have hζ_eq : ζ.re = 1 - (Complex.exp (-q.1) * Δ q.2).re := by simp [ζ]
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hre_le).2]
      have hζ_slit : ζ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hζ_re)
      have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hζ_slit
      have hζ_arg : ζ.arg ≠ Real.pi := Complex.slitPlane_arg_ne_pi hζ_slit
      have hψ_right_inv : ψ (Ψ_inv q) = q.1 := by
        have hexp_inv : Complex.exp (ψ_inv q) = Complex.exp q.1 * ζ := by
          dsimp only [ψ_inv]
          rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hζ_ne]
        have hΔ_fac : Δ q.2 = Complex.exp q.1 * (1 - ζ) := by
          have hexp_mul : Complex.exp q.1 * Complex.exp (-q.1) = 1 := by
            rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero]
          calc Δ q.2 = (Complex.exp q.1 * Complex.exp (-q.1)) * Δ q.2 := by rw [hexp_mul, one_mul]
            _ = Complex.exp q.1 * (1 - ζ) := by dsimp only [ζ]; ring
        have hinner_eq : 1 + Complex.exp (-(ψ_inv q)) * Δ q.2 = ζ⁻¹ := by
          rw [Complex.exp_neg, hexp_inv, hΔ_fac]
          have hexp_ne : Complex.exp q.1 ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero q.1
          field_simp [hexp_ne, hζ_ne]
          ring
        dsimp only [ψ, Ψ_inv]
        rw [hinner_eq, Complex.log_inv ζ hζ_arg]
        dsimp only [ψ_inv]
        change q.1 + Complex.log ζ + -Complex.log ζ = q.1
        ring
      have hψ_per : ∀ (z t : ℂ), ψ (z + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, t) =
          ψ (z, t) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I := by
        intro z t
        have hexp_neg_per : Complex.exp (-(z + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)) = Complex.exp (-z) := by
          have hper0 : Complex.exp (-(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1 := by
            rw [Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, inv_one]
          rw [neg_add, Complex.exp_add, hper0, mul_one]
        dsimp only [ψ]
        rw [hexp_neg_per]
        ring
      have hlhs : Λ_loop ι_star ((Ψ_inv q).1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, (Ψ_inv q).2) =
          Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) := by
        dsimp only [Λ_loop]
        rw [hψ_per]
        change Λ_ρ ι_star (ψ (Ψ_inv q) + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) = _
        rw [hψ_right_inv]
      have hrhs : Λ_loop ι_star (Ψ_inv q) = Λ_ρ ι_star q := by
        dsimp only [Λ_loop]
        change Λ_ρ ι_star (ψ (Ψ_inv q), q.2) = Λ_ρ ι_star (q.1, q.2)
        rw [hψ_right_inv]
      rw [hlhs, hrhs] at hq_eq
      exact hq_eq

    refine ⟨δ_w, δ_loop, Λ_loop, by norm_num, by norm_num, hδ_loop_pos, hδ_loop_sub_base,
      hp₀_tube, hΛ_loop_holo, ⟨r_att, hr_att_pos, ?_⟩, ⟨ι_star, h_loop_mono_ne⟩⟩
    intro w t hw_att ht_att
    have hp_ball : (w, t) ∈ Metric.ball (w_start, (t₂ : ℂ)) r_att := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨by rwa [dist_eq_norm], by rwa [dist_eq_norm]⟩
    obtain ⟨hwt_Loop, hψ_ball⟩ := hr_att (w, t) hp_ball
    refine ⟨hwt_Loop, fun ι => ?_⟩
    have hη_le : η_att ≤ η_p₀ ι := by
      fin_cases ι
      · exact min_le_left _ _
      · exact min_le_right _ _
    have hatt_ι := hη_p₀_att ι (ψ (w, t), t) (Metric.ball_subset_ball hη_le hψ_ball)
    have hΦ_eq : Φ (ψ (w, t), t) = (y_star + Complex.exp w + t, t) := by
      ext
      · exact (hψ_holo_maps.2 (w, t) hwt_Loop).2
      · rfl
    rw [hΦ_eq] at hatt_ι
    exact hatt_ι

      have hR_ann_open := (isOpen_and_convex_rect (Real.log (ρ₀ / 2)) (Real.log (7 * ρ₀ / 8))
        (-Real.pi / 2 - 3 / 16) (3 * Real.pi / 2 + 3 / 16)).1
      have hΦ_s_cont : ContinuousAt Φ_s (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) :=
        (hΦ_s_holo.continuousOn _ hw_seed_ann).continuousAt
          ((hR_ann_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hw_seed_ann)
      have hev_Φ_ball : ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)), Φ_s q ∈ Metric.ball p_seed r_s :=
        hΦ_s_cont.tendsto.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_s_pos))
      obtain ⟨r_att_s, hr_att_s_pos, hr_att_s⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
        (by filter_upwards [(hR_ann_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hw_seed_ann, hev_Φ_ball]
              with q h1 h2 using And.intro h1 h2)
      have hB_sub_out : Metric.ball (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) r_att_s ⊆
          R_ann_out ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) r_t := by
        intro q hq
        have hq_ann := (hr_att_s q hq).1
        refine ⟨⟨lt_trans (Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)) hq_ann.1.1,
          lt_trans hq_ann.1.2.1 (Real.log_lt_log (by linarith) (by linarith)),
          by linarith [hq_ann.1.2.2.1], by linarith [hq_ann.1.2.2.2]⟩,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_ι_le hq_ann.2⟩
      have heq_att_s : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) r_att_s,
          Λ_ι q = ρ_s (Φ_s q) := by
        refine hrect.1 (Metric.ball (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) r_att_s) Λ_ι (fun q => ρ_s (Φ_s q))
          (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) r_att_s).isPreconnected hB_sub_out
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_att_s_pos)
          (hΛ_ι_holo.mono (fun q hq => (hr_att_s q hq).1))
          (hρ_s_holo.comp (hΦ_s_holo.mono (fun q hq => (hr_att_s q hq).1))
            (fun q hq => (hr_att_s q hq).2))
          (fun q hq => hΛ_ι_root q (hr_att_s q hq).1)
          (fun q hq => by
            have h1 := (hρ_s_props (Φ_s q) (hr_att_s q hq).2).2.2.1
            have hτ_eq : τ_neg k_shift (Φ_s q) = (z_mod q.2 + Complex.exp q.1, q.2) := by
              ext
              · simp [τ_neg, Φ_s, z₁]; ring
              · rfl
            rw [hτ_eq] at h1
            exact h1)
          hΛ_ι_val
      refine ⟨δ_ι, Λ_ι, hδ_ι_pos, hδ_ι_le, hΛ_ι_holo, hΛ_ι_root, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_att_s_pos)] with q hq
      rw [heq_att_s q hq]
      exact (hρ_s_props (Φ_s q) (hr_att_s q hq).2).2.2.2
    choose δ_ann Λ_ann hδ_ann_pos hδ_ann_le hΛ_ann_holo hΛ_ann_root hΛ_ann_att using hex_ann
    let δ_t_ann : ℝ := min (δ_ann 0) (δ_ann 1)
    have hδ_t_ann_pos : 0 < δ_t_ann := lt_min (hδ_ann_pos 0) (hδ_ann_pos 1)
    have hδ_t_ann_le : δ_t_ann ≤ r_t := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hδ_ann_le 0)
    have hδ_t_ann_le_ι : ∀ ι : Fin 2, δ_t_ann ≤ δ_ann ι := fun ι => by
      fin_cases ι
      · exact min_le_left _ _
      · exact min_le_right _ _

    
    have h_mono_ne : ∃ ι : Fin 2,
        ¬ ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            Λ_ann ι (q.1 + 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I, q.2) = Λ_ann ι q := by
      by_contra h_all_triv
      push Not at h_all_triv
      have hex_N : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ N_ι : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ N_ι
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (13 * ρ₀ / 16) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann) ∧
          ∀ᶠ q in nhds (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)),
            N_ι (Complex.exp q.1, q.2) =
              a ι (Fin.last (D ι)) (Complex.exp q.1, q.2) * Λ_ann ι q := by
        intro ι
        exact hCauchy ρ₀ δ_t_ann (t₂ : ℂ) (D ι) hρ₀_pos hδ_t_ann_pos (B_poly.deg_pos β ι)
          (a ι)
          (fun d => (ha_holo ι d).mono
            (Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hρ₀_lt_ru))
              (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_t_ann_le)))
          (fun u hu hu_ne t ht => ha_sep ι u
            (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hρ₀_lt_ru) hu) hu_ne t
            (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_t_ann_le ht))
          (Λ_ann ι)
          ((hΛ_ann_holo ι).mono
            (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_t_ann_le_ι ι))))
          (fun q hq => hΛ_ann_root ι q
            ⟨hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_t_ann_le_ι ι) hq.2⟩)
          (h_all_triv ι)
      choose N_fn hN_fn_holo hN_fn_germ using hex_N
      let δ_x : ℝ := 3 * ρ₀ / 4
      have hδ_x_pos : 0 < δ_x := by dsimp [δ_x]; linarith
      have hδ_x_lt : δ_x < W.s_base := by dsimp [δ_x]; linarith
      have hz₁_cont_t₂ : ContinuousAt z₁ (t₂ : ℂ) :=
        (hz₁_holo.continuousOn (t₂ : ℂ) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t_pos)).continuousAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t_pos))
      have hzt_wall : Filter.Tendsto z₁ (nhds (t₂ : ℂ)) (nhds y_wall) := by
        have ht := hz₁_cont_t₂.tendsto
        rwa [hz₁_val_wall] at ht
      obtain ⟨r_z_close, hr_z_close_pos, hr_z_close⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
        (hzt_wall.eventually
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
            (Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith : 0 < ρ₀ / 16))))
      let δ_t₀ : ℝ := min δ_t_ann r_z_close
      have hδ_t₀_pos : 0 < δ_t₀ := lt_min hδ_t_ann_pos hr_z_close_pos
      let U_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_wall δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t₀
      have hsub_maps : ∀ p ∈ U_box,
          (p.1 - z₁ p.2, p.2) ∈
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (13 * ρ₀ / 16) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_ann := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨?_, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp.2⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        have h1 : ‖p.1 - y_wall‖ < 3 * ρ₀ / 4 := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, δ_x] using hp.1
        have h2 : ‖z₁ p.2 - y_wall‖ < ρ₀ / 16 := by
          have := hr_z_close p.2 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp.2)
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using this
        have htri : ‖p.1 - z₁ p.2‖ ≤ ‖p.1 - y_wall‖ + ‖y_wall - z₁ p.2‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (p.1 - y_wall) (y_wall - z₁ p.2)
        rw [norm_sub_rev y_wall (z₁ p.2)] at htri
        linarith
      let N_q : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => N_fn ι (p.1 - z₁ p.2, p.2)
      let D_q : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => a ι (Fin.last (D ι)) (p.1 - z₁ p.2, p.2)
      have hsub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - z₁ p.2, p.2)) U_box :=
        (differentiableOn_fst.sub
          (hz₁_holo.comp differentiableOn_snd
            (fun _ hp => Metric.ball_subset_ball
              (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hδ_t_ann_le) hp.2))).prodMk differentiableOn_snd
      let y_seed : ℂ := p_seed.1
      have hp_seed_eq : (y_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) = p_seed := rfl
      have hy_seed_ball : y_seed ∈ Metric.ball y_wall δ_x := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hsub : y_seed - y_wall = Complex.exp w_seed := by
          simp [y_seed, p_seed, hz₁_val_wall]
        rw [hsub, hexp_w_seed, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I,
          mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        dsimp [δ_x]; linarith
      have hy_seed_im : y_seed.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 := by
        simp [y_seed, p_seed, hz₁_val_wall, y_wall, hexp_w_seed, δ_x]
        linarith
      have hDq_nz : ∀ ι : Fin 2, D_q ι p_seed ≠ 0 := by
        intro ι
        have hsub_seed : p_seed.1 - z₁ p_seed.2 = Complex.exp w_seed := by simp [p_seed]
        dsimp only [D_q]
        rw [hsub_seed]
        exact (ha_sep ι (Complex.exp w_seed) hexp_seed_ball
          (Complex.exp_ne_zero w_seed) (t₂ : ℂ) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_t_pos)).1
      have hGerm : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ᶠ r in nhds p_seed,
          (W.L_mero ι).num p_seed r * D_q ι r = N_q ι r * (W.L_mero ι).den p_seed r := by
        intro ι
        let Ξ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
          fun r => (Complex.log (Complex.I * (r.1 - z₁ r.2)) -
            ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, r.2)
        have hiu_seed : Complex.I * (p_seed.1 - z₁ p_seed.2) = ((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          have hsub : p_seed.1 - z₁ p_seed.2 = -((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            simp [p_seed, hexp_w_seed]
          rw [hsub]
          calc Complex.I * (-((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              = -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * ((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by ring
            _ = ((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp
        have h58_slit : ((5 * ρ₀ / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
          Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by simp; linarith))
        have hΞ_seed : Ξ p_seed = (w_seed, (t₂ : ℂ)) := by
          ext
          · dsimp only [Ξ, w_seed]
            rw [hiu_seed, ← Complex.ofReal_log (by linarith)]
          · rfl
        have hiu_cont : ContinuousAt (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => Complex.I * (r.1 - z₁ r.2)) p_seed :=
          continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_fst.sub
            (ContinuousAt.comp (x := p_seed) hz₁_cont_t₂ continuousAt_snd))
        have hΞ_cont : ContinuousAt Ξ p_seed :=
          ((hiu_cont.clog (by rw [hiu_seed]; exact h58_slit)).sub continuousAt_const).prodMk
            continuousAt_snd
        have hev_slit : ∀ᶠ r in nhds p_seed,
            Complex.I * (r.1 - z₁ r.2) ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
          hiu_cont.tendsto.eventually
            (by rw [hiu_seed]; exact Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.mem_nhds h58_slit)
        have htend_Ξ := hΞ_cont.tendsto
        rw [hΞ_seed] at htend_Ξ
        filter_upwards [hev_slit, htend_Ξ.eventually (hΛ_ann_att ι),
          htend_Ξ.eventually (hN_fn_germ ι)] with r hr_slit hr_att hr_N
        have hne : Complex.I * (r.1 - z₁ r.2) ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hr_slit
        have hexp_Ξ : Complex.exp (Ξ r).1 = r.1 - z₁ r.2 := by
          dsimp only [Ξ]
          rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log hne,
            hexp_half_pi]
          calc (Complex.I * (r.1 - z₁ r.2)) * Complex.I⁻¹
              = (Complex.I * Complex.I⁻¹) * (r.1 - z₁ r.2) := by ring
            _ = r.1 - z₁ r.2 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero, one_mul]
        have hr_pair : (z₁ (Ξ r).2 + Complex.exp (Ξ r).1, (Ξ r).2) = r := by
          ext
          · dsimp only [Ξ]; rw [hexp_Ξ]; ring
          · rfl
        have hr_sub : (Complex.exp (Ξ r).1, (Ξ r).2) = (r.1 - z₁ r.2, r.2) := by
          ext
          · exact hexp_Ξ
          · rfl
        rw [hr_pair] at hr_att
        rw [hr_sub] at hr_N
        dsimp only [N_q, D_q]
        rw [hr_att, hr_N]
        ring
      have hReg : WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x_star + t₂) :=
        hWallBuild (x_star + t₂) δ_x δ_t₀ y_seed N_q D_q
          hδ_x_pos hδ_x_lt hδ_t₀_pos hy_seed_ball hy_seed_im
          (fun ι => ⟨(hN_fn_holo ι).comp hsub_holo hsub_maps,
            (ha_holo ι (Fin.last (D ι))).comp hsub_holo
              (fun p hp => ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (hsub_maps p hp).1,
                Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_t_ann_le (hsub_maps p hp).2⟩)⟩)
          hDq_nz hGerm
      exact h_not_reg hReg

    exact hLoopTransfer x_star r_u r_t ρ₀ δ_t_ann z₁
      hr_u_pos hr_t_pos hρ₀_pos hρ₀_lt hρ₀_ru hδ_t_ann_pos hδ_t_ann_le
      hz₁_holo hz₁_val_star a ha_holo ha_sep Λ_ann
      (fun ι => (hΛ_ann_holo ι).mono
        (Set.prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_t_ann_le_ι ι))))
      (fun ι q hq => hΛ_ann_root ι q ⟨hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_t_ann_le_ι ι) hq.2⟩)
      hΛ_ann_att h_mono_ne

(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)

    (∀ (t₂ H₂ x : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
      WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) ↔ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x) ∧
