proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hEqZeroConv2D :
      ∀ {W_conv V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
        IsOpen W_conv → Convex ℝ W_conv →
        IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ W_conv →
        ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ f W_conv →
          (∀ p ∈ V, f p = 0) → ∀ q ∈ W_conv, f q = 0 := by
    intro W_conv V hW_open hW_conv hV_open hV_ne hV_sub f hf hfV q hqW
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀V⟩ := hV_ne
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (p₀.1 + z * (q.1 - p₀.1), p₀.2 + z * (q.2 - p₀.2))
    have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ :=
      ((differentiable_const p₀.1).add (differentiable_id.mul_const (q.1 - p₀.1))).prodMk
        ((differentiable_const p₀.2).add (differentiable_id.mul_const (q.2 - p₀.2)))
    let U_z : Set ℂ := Φ ⁻¹' W_conv
    have hU_open : IsOpen U_z := hW_open.preimage hΦ_diff.continuous
    have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = p₀ := by ext <;> simp [Φ]
    have hΦ1 : Φ 1 = q := by ext <;> simp [Φ]
    have h0_V : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Φ ⁻¹' V := by simpa [Set.mem_preimage, hΦ0] using hp₀V
    have h0_U : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := hV_sub h0_V
    have h1_U : (1 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := by simpa [U_z, Set.mem_preimage, hΦ1] using hqW
    have hU_conv : Convex ℝ U_z := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
      have hab_C : (a : ℂ) + (b : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hab
      have h_aff : a • Φ z₁ + b • Φ z₂ = Φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) := by
        ext <;> simp [Φ, Complex.real_smul]
        · linear_combination p₀.1 * hab_C
        · linear_combination p₀.2 * hab_C
      change Φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ W_conv
      rw [← h_aff]
      exact hW_conv hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
    have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (f ∘ Φ) U_z :=
      (hf.comp hΦ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ h => h)).analyticOnNhd hU_open
    have hg_ev : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hV_open.preimage hΦ_diff.continuous).mem_nhds h0_V)
        (fun z hz => hfV (Φ z) hz)
    have h_eq := hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      hU_conv.isPreconnected h0_U hg_ev h1_U
    simpa [Function.comp, hΦ1] using h_eq

  have hCancelDen :
      ∀ {W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W₀) {p : ℂ × ℂ} (hp : p ∈ W₀)
        {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (hO_open : IsOpen O)
        (hO_sub : O ⊆ Metric.ball p (F.rad p))
        {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (hh_cont : ContinuousOn h O)
        (h_prod : ∀ z ∈ O, h z * F.den p z = 0),
        ∀ z ∈ O, h z = 0 := by
    intro W₀ F p hp O hO_open hO_sub h hh_cont h_prod z₀ hz₀O
    by_contra hz₀_ne
    have h_nhds : O ∩ { z : ℂ × ℂ | h z ≠ 0 } ∈ nhds z₀ :=
      Filter.inter_mem (hO_open.mem_nhds hz₀O)
        ((hh_cont.continuousAt (hO_open.mem_nhds hz₀O)).preimage_mem_nhds
          (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz₀_ne))
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    have h_den_zero_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₀, F.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_mem := hr₀_sub hz
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (h_prod z hz_mem.1) with hh0 | hden0
      · exact False.elim (hz_mem.2 hh0)
      · exact hden0
    have h_den_zero_all : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (F.rad p), F.den p q = 0 :=
      hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F.rad p))
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨z₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos⟩
        (fun z hz => hO_sub (hr₀_sub hz).1)
        (F.den_holo p hp) h_den_zero_ball
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_mem, hq₀_ne⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p hp
    exact hq₀_ne (h_den_zero_all q₀ hq₀_mem)

  have hRestrictOpen :
      ∀ {W₀ W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : MeroOn2D W₀),
        IsOpen W' → W' ⊆ W₀ → ∃ M' : MeroOn2D W', MeroEqOn M' M W' := by
    intro W₀ W' M hW'_open hsub
    classical
    let r_open : ∀ p ∈ W', ℝ := fun p hp =>
      Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW'_open p hp)
    have hr_spec : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W'),
        0 < r_open p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_open p hp) ⊆ W' :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW'_open p hp)
    let rad' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      if hp : p ∈ W' then min (M.rad p) (r_open p hp) else 1
    have hrad'_pos : ∀ p ∈ W', 0 < rad' p := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [rad', dif_pos hp]
      exact lt_min (M.rad_pos p (hsub hp)) (hr_spec p hp).1
    have hrad'_le : ∀ p ∈ W', rad' p ≤ M.rad p := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [rad', dif_pos hp]
      exact min_le_left _ _
    let M' : MeroOn2D W' := {
      rad := rad'
      num := M.num
      den := M.den
      rad_pos := hrad'_pos
      ball_sub := fun p hp => by
        simp only [rad', dif_pos hp]
        exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hr_spec p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp =>
        (M.num_holo p (hsub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
      den_holo := fun p hp =>
        (M.den_holo p (hsub hp)).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        by_contra h_all_zero
        push_neg at h_all_zero
        have h_zero_big : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (M.rad p), M.den p q = 0 :=
          hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (M.rad p))
            Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hrad'_pos p hp)⟩
            (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p hp))
            (M.den_holo p (hsub hp)) h_all_zero
        obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_mem, hq₀_ne⟩ := M.den_ne_zero p (hsub hp)
        exact hq₀_ne (h_zero_big q₀ hq₀_mem)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
        M.compat p₁ (hsub hp₁) p₂ (hsub hp₂) q
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p₁ hp₁) hq.1,
           Metric.ball_subset_ball (hrad'_le p₂ hp₂) hq.2⟩
    }
    exact ⟨M', ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hp, hsub hp⟩, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩⟩

  have meroEqOn_symm :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U F₁ F₂ h
    exact ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h.1 hp).2, (h.1 hp).1⟩,
      fun p hp q hq => (h.2 p hp q (by rwa [min_comm])).symm⟩

  have meroEqOn_mono :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
        V ⊆ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ U V F₁ F₂ hVU h
    exact ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU h.1, fun p hp => h.2 p (hVU hp)⟩

  have meroEqOn_trans :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ W₃ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
        {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂} {F₃ : MeroOn2D W₃},
        MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ U → MeroEqOn F₂ F₃ U → MeroEqOn F₁ F₃ U := by
    intro W₁ W₂ W₃ U F₁ F₂ F₃ h₁₂ h₂₃
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(h₁₂.1 hp).1, (h₂₃.1 hp).2⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := (h₁₂.1 hp).1
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := (h₁₂.1 hp).2
    have hp₃ : p ∈ W₃ := (h₂₃.1 hp).2
    let r₁₃ : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₃.rad p)
    let r₁₂₃ : ℝ := min r₁₃ (F₂.rad p)
    have hr₁₂₃_pos : 0 < r₁₂₃ :=
      lt_min (lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p hp₁) (F₃.rad_pos p hp₃)) (F₂.rad_pos p hp₂)
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F₁.num p z * F₃.den p z - F₃.num p z * F₁.den p z
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r₁₃) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₃.den_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F₃.num_holo p hp₃).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have h_prod_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₁₂₃, Δ z * F₂.den p z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz₁₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (min_le_right _ _)) hz
      have hz₂₃ : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₂.rad p) (F₃.rad p)) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_min (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hz
      have e₁₂ := h₁₂.2 p hp z hz₁₂
      have e₂₃ := h₂₃.2 p hp z hz₂₃
      dsimp only [Δ]
      linear_combination F₃.den p z * e₁₂ + F₁.den p z * e₂₃
    have hΔ_zero_small : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₁₂₃, Δ z = 0 :=
      hCancelDen F₂ hp₂ Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        (hΔ_holo.continuousOn.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))) h_prod_zero
    have hΔ_zero_all : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r₁₃, Δ z = 0 :=
      hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r₁₃)
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁₂₃_pos⟩
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hΔ_holo hΔ_zero_small
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_zero_all q hq)

  have hMeroEqOfHolo :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
        {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        MeroAgreesHolo F₁ f V₀ → MeroAgreesHolo F₂ f V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ := by
    intro W₁ W₂ V₀ F₁ F₂ f h₁ h₂
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨h₁.1 hp, h₂.1 hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ W₁ := h₁.1 hp
    have hp₂ : p ∈ W₂ := h₂.1 hp
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, _, hr₁_eq⟩ := h₁.2 p hp
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, _, hr₂_eq⟩ := h₂.2 p hp
    let r_big : ℝ := min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    let r_sm : ℝ := min r₁ r₂
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball p r_big) :=
      (((F₁.num_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hp₂).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p hp₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hΔ_sm : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r_sm, Δ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have e₁ := hr₁_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
      have e₂ := hr₂_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)
      dsimp only [Δ]
      rw [e₁, e₂]
      ring
    have hΔ_all : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r_big, Δ z = 0 :=
      hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p r_big)
        Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos)⟩
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_min hr₁_le hr₂_le)) hΔ_holo hΔ_sm
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_all q hq)

  have hMeroEqConn :
      ∀ {W₁ W₂ V V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂},
        IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ →
        V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ V → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V₀ → MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ V := by
    intro W₁ W₂ V V₀ F₁ F₂ hV_open hV_pre hV_sub hV₀_ne hV₀_sub hEq₀
    let r_min : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)
    let Δ : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ :=
      fun p z => F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z - F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z
    have hΔ_holo : ∀ p ∈ V, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Δ p) (Metric.ball p (r_min p)) := by
      intro p hpV
      have hpW := hV_sub hpV
      exact (((F₁.num_holo p hpW.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))).mul
        ((F₂.den_holo p hpW.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)))).sub
        (((F₂.num_holo p hpW.2).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))).mul
          ((F₁.den_holo p hpW.1).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))))
    let A₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | p ∈ V ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p (r_min p), Δ p z = 0 }
    let A₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | p ∈ V ∧ ¬ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p (r_min p), Δ p z = 0 }
    have hProp : ∀ p ∈ A₀, ∀ p' ∈ V,
        (Metric.ball p (r_min p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (r_min p')).Nonempty → p' ∈ A₀ := by
      intro p hpA₀ p' hp'V hO_ne
      let O : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p (r_min p) ∩ Metric.ball p' (r_min p')
      have hO_open : IsOpen O := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hpW := hV_sub hpA₀.1
      have hp'W := hV_sub hp'V
      have h_prod : ∀ z ∈ O, (Δ p' z * F₁.den p z) * F₂.den p z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have e₀ : F₁.num p z * F₂.den p z = F₂.num p z * F₁.den p z :=
          sub_eq_zero.mp (hpA₀.2 z hz.1)
        have c₁ : F₁.num p' z * F₁.den p z = F₁.num p z * F₁.den p' z :=
          F₁.compat p' hp'W.1 p hpW.1 z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.1⟩
        have c₂ : F₂.num p' z * F₂.den p z = F₂.num p z * F₂.den p' z :=
          F₂.compat p' hp'W.2 p hpW.2 z
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.2,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.1⟩
        dsimp only [Δ]
        linear_combination
          F₂.den p' z * F₂.den p z * c₁ -
          F₁.den p' z * F₁.den p z * c₂ +
          F₁.den p' z * F₂.den p' z * e₀
      have h_step1 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ p' z * F₁.den p z = 0 :=
        hCancelDen F₂ hpW.2 hO_open
          (fun z hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.1)
          (((hΔ_holo p' hp'V).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.2)).mul
            ((F₁.den_holo p hpW.1).continuousOn.mono
              (fun _ hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.1)))
          h_prod
      have h_step2 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ p' z = 0 :=
        hCancelDen F₁ hpW.1 hO_open
          (fun z hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.1)
          ((hΔ_holo p' hp'V).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.2))
          h_step1
      exact ⟨hp'V, hEqZeroConv2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p' (r_min p'))
        hO_open hO_ne (fun _ hz => hz.2) (hΔ_holo p' hp'V) h_step2⟩
    have hA₀_open : IsOpen A₀ := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨ρ_V, hρ_V_pos, hρ_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p hp.1
      have hr_p : 0 < r_min p :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p (hV_sub hp.1).1) (F₂.rad_pos p (hV_sub hp.1).2)
      refine ⟨min ρ_V (r_min p), lt_min hρ_V_pos hr_p, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'V : p' ∈ V := hρ_V_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp')
      have hr_p' : 0 < r_min p' :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p' (hV_sub hp'V).1) (F₂.rad_pos p' (hV_sub hp'V).2)
      exact hProp p hp p' hp'V
        ⟨p', Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp', Metric.mem_ball_self hr_p'⟩
    have hA₁_open : IsOpen A₁ := by
      rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨ρ_V, hρ_V_pos, hρ_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p hp.1
      have hr_p : 0 < r_min p :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p (hV_sub hp.1).1) (F₂.rad_pos p (hV_sub hp.1).2)
      refine ⟨min ρ_V (r_min p), lt_min hρ_V_pos hr_p, fun p' hp' => ?_⟩
      have hp'V : p' ∈ V := hρ_V_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp')
      have hr_p' : 0 < r_min p' :=
        lt_min (F₁.rad_pos p' (hV_sub hp'V).1) (F₂.rad_pos p' (hV_sub hp'V).2)
      refine ⟨hp'V, fun hp'_zero => hp.2 ?_⟩
      exact (hProp p' ⟨hp'V, hp'_zero⟩ p hp.1
        ⟨p', Metric.mem_ball_self hr_p', Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hp'⟩).2
    refine ⟨hV_sub, fun p hpV q hq => ?_⟩
    have hpA₀ : p ∈ A₀ := by
      by_contra hp_not
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀V₀⟩ := hV₀_ne
      have hp₀V : p₀ ∈ V := hV₀_sub hp₀V₀
      have hp₀A₀ : p₀ ∈ V ∩ A₀ :=
        ⟨hp₀V, hp₀V, fun z hz => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hEq₀.2 p₀ hp₀V₀ z hz)⟩
      have hpA₁ : p ∈ V ∩ A₁ :=
        ⟨hpV, hpV, fun h_all => hp_not ⟨hpV, h_all⟩⟩
      have h_cov : V ⊆ A₀ ∪ A₁ := by
        intro w hw
        by_cases hw_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball w (r_min w), Δ w z = 0
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hw, hw_zero⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hw, hw_zero⟩
      obtain ⟨w, _, hwA₀, hwA₁⟩ := hV_pre A₀ A₁ hA₀_open hA₁_open h_cov ⟨p₀, hp₀A₀⟩ ⟨p, hpA₁⟩
      exact hwA₁.2 hwA₀.2
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hpA₀.2 q hq)

  
  let τ_shift : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun c q => (q.1 + (c : ℂ), q.2)
  have hτ_diff : ∀ c : ℝ, Differentiable ℂ (τ_shift c) :=
    fun c => (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const (c : ℂ))).prodMk differentiable_snd
  have hτ_neg_right : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ), τ_shift c (τ_shift (-c) q) = q := by
    intro c q
    ext
    · simp [τ_shift, Complex.ofReal_neg]
    · rfl
  have hτ_dist : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q p : ℂ × ℂ), dist (τ_shift c q) (τ_shift c p) = dist q p := by
    intro c q p
    simp only [τ_shift, Prod.dist_eq, dist_add_right]
  have hτ_ball : ∀ (c : ℝ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ),
      τ_shift c q ∈ Metric.ball (τ_shift c p) r ↔ q ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
    intro c p q r
    simp only [Metric.mem_ball, hτ_dist]

  let meroPullbackShift :
      ∀ {W₀ W₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (c : ℝ),
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W₁ ↔ τ_shift c p ∈ W₀) →
        MeroOn2D W₀ → MeroOn2D W₁ :=
    fun c hIff M => {
      rad := fun p => M.rad (τ_shift c p)
      num := fun p q => M.num (τ_shift c p) (τ_shift c q)
      den := fun p q => M.den (τ_shift c p) (τ_shift c q)
      rad_pos := fun p hp => M.rad_pos (τ_shift c p) ((hIff p).mp hp)
      ball_sub := fun p hp q hq =>
        (hIff q).mpr (M.ball_sub (τ_shift c p) ((hIff p).mp hp) ((hτ_ball c p q _).mpr hq))
      num_holo := fun p hp =>
        (M.num_holo (τ_shift c p) ((hIff p).mp hp)).comp (hτ_diff c).differentiableOn
          (fun q hq => (hτ_ball c p q _).mpr hq)
      den_holo := fun p hp =>
        (M.den_holo (τ_shift c p) ((hIff p).mp hp)).comp (hτ_diff c).differentiableOn
          (fun q hq => (hτ_ball c p q _).mpr hq)
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_ball, hq₀_ne⟩ := M.den_ne_zero (τ_shift c p) ((hIff p).mp hp)
        refine ⟨τ_shift (-c) q₀, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (hτ_ball c p (τ_shift (-c) q₀) _).mp (by rwa [hτ_neg_right])
        · rwa [hτ_neg_right]
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
        M.compat (τ_shift c p₁) ((hIff p₁).mp hp₁) (τ_shift c p₂) ((hIff p₂).mp hp₂)
          (τ_shift c q)
          ⟨(hτ_ball c p₁ q _).mpr hq.1, (hτ_ball c p₂ q _).mpr hq.2⟩
    }

  
  have hGlueFamily :
      ∀ {ι : Type} (W_fam : ι → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (W_ext : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
        (G : ∀ j : ι, MeroOn2D (W_fam j)),
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W_ext ↔ ∃ j : ι, p ∈ W_fam j) →
        (∀ j₁ j₂ : ι, MeroEqOn (G j₁) (G j₂) (W_fam j₁ ∩ W_fam j₂)) →
        ∃ F_glued : MeroOn2D W_ext, ∀ j : ι, MeroEqOn F_glued (G j) (W_fam j) := by
    intro ι W_fam W_ext G hcov hcompat
    classical
    let idx : ∀ p ∈ W_ext, ι := fun p hp => Classical.choose ((hcov p).mp hp)
    have hidx : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ W_ext), p ∈ W_fam (idx p hp) :=
      fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec ((hcov p).mp hp)
    let F_glued : MeroOn2D W_ext := {
      rad := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W_ext then (G (idx p hp)).rad p else 1
      num := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W_ext then (G (idx p hp)).num p else fun _ => 0
      den := fun p => if hp : p ∈ W_ext then (G (idx p hp)).den p else fun _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).rad_pos p (hidx p hp)
      ball_sub := fun p hp q hq => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp] at hq
        exact (hcov q).mpr ⟨idx p hp, (G (idx p hp)).ball_sub p (hidx p hp) hq⟩
      num_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).num_holo p (hidx p hp)
      den_holo := fun p hp => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).den_holo p (hidx p hp)
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp]
        exact (G (idx p hp)).den_ne_zero p (hidx p hp)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q₀ hq₀ => by
        simp only [dif_pos hp₁, dif_pos hp₂] at hq₀ ⊢
        let j₁ : ι := idx p₁ hp₁
        let j₂ : ι := idx p₂ hp₂
        have hp₁_mem : p₁ ∈ W_fam j₁ := hidx p₁ hp₁
        have hp₂_mem : p₂ ∈ W_fam j₂ := hidx p₂ hp₂
        have hq₀₁ : q₀ ∈ W_fam j₁ := (G j₁).ball_sub p₁ hp₁_mem hq₀.1
        have hq₀₂ : q₀ ∈ W_fam j₂ := (G j₂).ball_sub p₂ hp₂_mem hq₀.2
        let r_q : ℝ := min ((G j₁).rad q₀) ((G j₂).rad q₀)
        have hr_q_pos : 0 < r_q :=
          lt_min ((G j₁).rad_pos q₀ hq₀₁) ((G j₂).rad_pos q₀ hq₀₂)
        let O : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
          (Metric.ball p₁ ((G j₁).rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ ((G j₂).rad p₂)) ∩
            Metric.ball q₀ r_q
        have hO_open : IsOpen O :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hq₀_O : q₀ ∈ O := ⟨hq₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_q_pos⟩
        let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
          (G j₁).num p₁ z * (G j₂).den p₂ z - (G j₂).num p₂ z * (G j₁).den p₁ z
        have hΔ_cont : ContinuousOn Δ O :=
          ((((G j₁).num_holo p₁ hp₁_mem).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1.1)).mul
            (((G j₂).den_holo p₂ hp₂_mem).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1.2))).sub
            ((((G j₂).num_holo p₂ hp₂_mem).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1.2)).mul
              (((G j₁).den_holo p₁ hp₁_mem).continuousOn.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1.1)))
        have h_prod : ∀ z ∈ O, (Δ z * (G j₁).den q₀ z) * (G j₂).den q₀ z = 0 := by
          intro z hz
          have c₁ := (G j₁).compat p₁ hp₁_mem q₀ hq₀₁ z
            ⟨hz.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2⟩
          have c₂ := (G j₂).compat p₂ hp₂_mem q₀ hq₀₂ z
            ⟨hz.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.2⟩
          have e₁₂ := (hcompat j₁ j₂).2 q₀ ⟨hq₀₁, hq₀₂⟩ z hz.2
          dsimp only [Δ]
          linear_combination
            (G j₂).den p₂ z * (G j₂).den q₀ z * c₁ -
            (G j₁).den p₁ z * (G j₁).den q₀ z * c₂ +
            (G j₁).den p₁ z * (G j₂).den p₂ z * e₁₂
        have h_step1 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ z * (G j₁).den q₀ z = 0 :=
          hCancelDen (G j₂) hq₀₂ hO_open
            (fun _ hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz.2)
            (hΔ_cont.mul
              (((G j₁).den_holo q₀ hq₀₁).continuousOn.mono
                (fun _ hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2)))
            h_prod
        have h_step2 : ∀ z ∈ O, Δ z = 0 :=
          hCancelDen (G j₁) hq₀₁ hO_open
            (fun _ hz => Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz.2)
            hΔ_cont h_step1
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_step2 q₀ hq₀_O)
    }
    refine ⟨F_glued, fun j => ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(hcov p).mpr ⟨j, hp⟩, hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩⟩
    have hp_ext : p ∈ W_ext := (hcov p).mpr ⟨j, hp⟩
    dsimp only [F_glued] at hq ⊢
    simp only [dif_pos hp_ext] at hq ⊢
    exact (hcompat (idx p hp_ext) j).2 p ⟨hidx p hp_ext, hp⟩ q hq

  
  
  
  let U_base2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * W.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base }
  let T_L : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L

  have hDualPerStep :
      ∀ p ∈ U_base2, ∀ i : Fin 2,
        glancingDualLine C (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi) p.2 i = glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i := by
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy_im, ht_norm⟩ i
    dsimp only at hy_im ht_norm ⊢
    have ht_r₁ : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith [ht_norm, W.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
    have hTheta_step : ∀ y' : ℂ, |y'.im| < C.s₁ →
        glancingTheta C (y' + 2 * Real.pi) t = glancingTheta C y' t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
        glancingTheta C y' t ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      intro y' hy'
      have hy'_2s₁ : |y'.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by linarith [hy', C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
      have hy'_sum : |y'.im| < C.s₁ + C.r₁ := by linarith [hy', C.r₁_pos]
      have hU_mem : C.U (y', t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := C.U_maps_to y' t hy'_sum ht_r₁
      have hU_per : C.U (y' + 2 * Real.pi, t) = C.U (y', t) + 2 * Real.pi :=
        C.U_quasiperiodic y' t hy'_2s₁ ht_r₁
      have hϕ_per : C.ϕ_ℂ (C.U (y', t) + 2 * Real.pi) = C.ϕ_ℂ (C.U (y', t)) + 2 * Real.pi :=
        C.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic (C.U (y', t)) hU_mem
      refine ⟨?_, C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to (C.U (y', t)) hU_mem⟩
      dsimp only [glancingTheta]
      rw [hU_per, hϕ_per]
    have hy_s₁ : |y.im| < C.s₁ := by
      linarith [hy_im, W.s_base_le_s₁, W.s_base_pos]
    have hyt_s₁ : |(y + t).im| < C.s₁ := by
      have h_add : |(y + t).im| ≤ |y.im| + |t.im| := by
        simpa [Complex.add_im] using abs_add_le y.im t.im
      have ht_im : |t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
      linarith [h_add, ht_im, hy_im, ht_norm, W.r_base_lt_s_base, W.s_base_le_s₁, W.s_base_pos]
    obtain ⟨hθ₁_per, hθ₁_mem⟩ := hTheta_step y hy_s₁
    obtain ⟨hθ₂_per, hθ₂_mem⟩ := hTheta_step (y + t) hyt_s₁
    let θ₁ : ℂ := glancingTheta C y t
    let θ₂ : ℂ := glancingTheta C (y + t) t
    let μ : ℂ := (θ₁ + θ₂) / 2
    have hμ_mem : μ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
      change |μ.im| < 2 * C.s_h
      have hμ_im : μ.im = (θ₁.im + θ₂.im) / 2 := by simp [μ, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h₁ : |θ₁.im| < 2 * C.s_h := hθ₁_mem
      have h₂ : |θ₂.im| < 2 * C.s_h := hθ₂_mem
      rw [hμ_im, abs_lt]
      rw [abs_lt] at h₁ h₂
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hStrip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hh_ev : (fun w : ℂ => C.h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds μ] C.h_ℂ :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hStrip_open.mem_nhds hμ_mem)
        (fun w hw => C.h_ℂ_periodic w hw)
    have hderiv_per : deriv C.h_ℂ (μ + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv C.h_ℂ μ := by
      have h1 := hh_ev.deriv_eq
      rwa [deriv_comp_add_const C.h_ℂ (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) μ] at h1
    have hh_per : C.h_ℂ (μ + 2 * Real.pi) = C.h_ℂ μ := C.h_ℂ_periodic μ hμ_mem
    have hOff_per : glancingOffset C (y + 2 * Real.pi) t = glancingOffset C y t := by
      have hyt_shift : (y + 2 * Real.pi) + t = (y + t) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      have h_mid : ((θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) + (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = μ + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp only [μ]
        ring
      have h_diff : ((θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) - (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2 = (θ₂ - θ₁) / 2 := by ring
      dsimp only [glancingOffset, supportAction1_ℂ]
      rw [hyt_shift, hθ₁_per, hθ₂_per]
      change -(deriv C.h_ℂ (((θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) + (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2) *
          Complex.sin (((θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) - (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2) -
        C.h_ℂ (((θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) + (θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2) *
          Complex.cos (((θ₂ + 2 * Real.pi) - (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi)) / 2)) =
        -(deriv C.h_ℂ μ * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) -
          C.h_ℂ μ * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2))
      rw [h_mid, h_diff, hderiv_per, hh_per]
    revert i
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [glancingDualLine]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, hθ₁_per, hOff_per]
      change Complex.cos (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) / glancingOffset C y t =
        Complex.cos θ₁ / glancingOffset C y t
      rw [Complex.cos_add_two_pi]
    · dsimp only [glancingDualLine]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, hθ₁_per, hOff_per]
      change Complex.sin (θ₁ + 2 * Real.pi) / glancingOffset C y t =
        Complex.sin θ₁ / glancingOffset C y t
      rw [Complex.sin_add_two_pi]

  have hDualPerInt :
      ∀ (k : ℤ), ∀ p ∈ U_base2, ∀ i : Fin 2,
        glancingDualLine C (p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) p.2 i =
          glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i := by
    intro k
    refine Int.induction_on k ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p _ i
      simp
    · intro n ih p hp i
      have h_add :
          p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            (p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast
        ring
      have hp_shift : (p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ), p.2) ∈ U_base2 := by
        simpa [U_base2] using hp
      rw [h_add, hDualPerStep _ hp_shift i, ih p hp i]
    · intro n ih p hp i
      let y_prev : ℂ := p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have h_step : y_prev + 2 * Real.pi = p.1 + ((2 * Real.pi * -(n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp only [y_prev]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hp_prev : (y_prev, p.2) ∈ U_base2 := by
        simpa [U_base2, y_prev] using hp
      have h1 := hDualPerStep (y_prev, p.2) hp_prev i
      dsimp only at h1
      rw [h_step] at h1
      have h_ih := ih p hp i
      simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at h_ih ⊢
      change glancingDualLine C y_prev p.2 i = glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i
      rw [← h1, h_ih]

  
  have hTL_open : IsOpen T_L :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr (fun p hp =>
      ⟨(W.L_mero 0).rad p, (W.L_mero 0).rad_pos p hp, (W.L_mero 0).ball_sub p hp⟩)
  have hBase_sub_TL : U_base2 ⊆ T_L := (W.L_agrees_two 0).1
  have hBase_eq_prod :
      U_base2 =
        (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-2 * W.s_base) (2 * W.s_base)) ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
    ext p
    simp only [U_base2, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_preimage, Complex.imLm_coe,
      Set.mem_Ioo, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    rw [abs_lt]
    simp [neg_mul]
  have hBase_pre : IsPreconnected U_base2 := by
    rw [hBase_eq_prod]
    exact (((convex_Ioo (-2 * W.s_base) (2 * W.s_base)).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod
      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base)).isPreconnected
  have h0_mem_base : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_base2 := by
    simp [U_base2, W.s_base_pos, W.r_base_pos]

  have hhL_ge_two :
      ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < W.r_base →
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_L t ∧ 0 < W.h_L t := by
    intro t ht
    have ht_ball : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht
    have hX := W.h_X_ge_two t ht_ball
    have hL := W.h_L_eq t ht_ball
    have h_ge : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_L t := by
      rw [hL]
      exact le_trans hX le_self_add
    have h_pos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith [W.s_base_pos])
    exact ⟨h_ge, lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos h_ge⟩

  let γ_seg : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun p α => ((p.1.re : ℂ) + ((α * p.1.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, p.2)
  have hγ_cont : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, Continuous (γ_seg p) := by
    intro p
    exact (continuous_const.add
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)).mul
        continuous_const)).prodMk continuous_const
  have hγ_zero_mem : ∀ p ∈ T_L, γ_seg p 0 ∈ U_base2 := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨?_, hp.1⟩
    simp [γ_seg, W.s_base_pos]
  have hγ_one : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, γ_seg p 1 = p := by
    intro p
    ext
    · simpa [γ_seg] using Complex.re_add_im p.1
    · rfl
  have hγ_mem_TL : ∀ p ∈ T_L, ∀ α ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ_seg p α ∈ T_L := by
    intro p hp α hα
    have ht_conj : ‖starRingEnd ℂ p.2‖ < W.r_base := by
      simpa [Complex.norm_conj] using hp.1
    have h_im : (γ_seg p α).1.im = α * p.1.im := by simp [γ_seg]
    refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_im]
      have h_neg : -(α * p.1.im) = α * (-p.1.im) := by ring
      rw [h_neg]
      rcases le_or_gt (-p.1.im) 0 with h_le | h_gt
      · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hα.1 h_le)]
        exact (hhL_ge_two _ ht_conj).2
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt
          (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by nlinarith [hα.2, h_gt])) hp.2.1
    · rw [h_im]
      rcases le_or_gt p.1.im 0 with h_le | h_gt
      · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hα.1 h_le)]
        exact (hhL_ge_two _ hp.1).2
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt
          (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by nlinarith [hα.2, h_gt])) hp.2.2

  have hTL_pre : IsPreconnected T_L := by
    have hRayHelper :
        ∀ {u' v' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
          IsOpen u' → IsOpen v' → T_L ⊆ u' ∪ v' →
          ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ u' → ∀ p ∈ T_L, p ∈ v' →
          (T_L ∩ (u' ∩ v')).Nonempty := by
      intro u' v' hu' hv' hcov h0_u' p hp_TL hp_v'
      by_contra h_empty
      have hBase_u' : U_base2 ⊆ u' := by
        intro q hq_base
        by_contra hq_not_u'
        have hq_v' : q ∈ v' :=
          (hcov (hBase_sub_TL hq_base)).resolve_left hq_not_u'
        obtain ⟨w, hw_base, hw_uv⟩ :=
          hBase_pre u' v' hu' hv' (Set.Subset.trans hBase_sub_TL hcov)
            ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), h0_mem_base, h0_u'⟩ ⟨q, hq_base, hq_v'⟩
        exact h_empty ⟨w, hBase_sub_TL hw_base, hw_uv⟩
      let S_p : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := γ_seg p '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
      have hSp_sub : S_p ⊆ T_L := by
        rintro _ ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩
        exact hγ_mem_TL p hp_TL α hα
      have hSp_pre : IsPreconnected S_p :=
        (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).isPreconnected.image (γ_seg p) (hγ_cont p).continuousOn
      have h0_Sp : γ_seg p 0 ∈ S_p ∩ u' :=
        ⟨⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, rfl⟩, hBase_u' (hγ_zero_mem p hp_TL)⟩
      have h1_Sp : p ∈ S_p ∩ v' :=
        ⟨⟨1, ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩, hγ_one p⟩, hp_v'⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw_Sp, hw_uv⟩ :=
        hSp_pre u' v' hu' hv' (Set.Subset.trans hSp_sub hcov)
          ⟨γ_seg p 0, h0_Sp⟩ ⟨p, h1_Sp⟩
      exact h_empty ⟨w, hSp_sub hw_Sp, hw_uv⟩
    intro u v hu hv hcov ⟨p_u, hp_u_TL, hp_u⟩ ⟨p_v, hp_v_TL, hp_v⟩
    rcases hcov (hBase_sub_TL h0_mem_base) with h0_u | h0_v
    · exact hRayHelper hu hv hcov h0_u p_v hp_v_TL hp_v
    · obtain ⟨w, hw_TL, hw_v, hw_u⟩ :=
        hRayHelper hv hu (by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hcov) h0_v p_u hp_u_TL hp_u
      exact ⟨w, hw_TL, hw_u, hw_v⟩

  
  
  
  have hPer : DualLineTubePeriodicProp W := by
    intro k i
    let c : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)
    have hIff_TL : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, q ∈ T_L ↔ τ_shift c q ∈ T_L := by
      intro q
      simp [T_L, meroTubeENNR, τ_shift]
    let F_sh : MeroOn2D T_L := meroPullbackShift c hIff_TL (W.L_mero i)
    have hF_sh_agrees :
        MeroAgreesHolo F_sh (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i) U_base2 := by
      refine ⟨hBase_sub_TL, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have hτp : τ_shift c p ∈ U_base2 := by simpa [U_base2, τ_shift] using hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := (W.L_agrees_two i).2 (τ_shift c p) hτp
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro q hq
        have hτq : τ_shift c q ∈ U_base2 := hr_sub ((hτ_ball c p q r).mpr hq)
        simpa [U_base2, τ_shift] using hτq
      · intro q hq
        have hτq_ball : τ_shift c q ∈ Metric.ball (τ_shift c p) r :=
          (hτ_ball c p q r).mpr hq
        have hq_base : q ∈ U_base2 := by
          have hτq : τ_shift c q ∈ U_base2 := hr_sub hτq_ball
          simpa [U_base2, τ_shift] using hτq
        have h1 := hr_eq (τ_shift c q) hτq_ball
        have h2 := hDualPerInt k q hq_base i
        dsimp only [F_sh, meroPullbackShift, τ_shift] at h1 ⊢
        dsimp only [c] at h1 ⊢
        rwa [h2] at h1
    have hEq_base : MeroEqOn (W.L_mero i) F_sh U_base2 :=
      hMeroEqOfHolo (W.L_agrees_two i) hF_sh_agrees
    have hEq_TL : MeroEqOn (W.L_mero i) F_sh T_L :=
      hMeroEqConn hTL_open hTL_pre (fun p hp => ⟨hp, hp⟩)
        ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), h0_mem_base⟩ hBase_sub_TL hEq_base
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨(hIff_TL p).mp hp, fun q hq => (hEq_TL.2 p hp q hq).symm⟩

  have hShiftWallChart :
      ∀ (t₂ H₂ x δ_x δ_t : ℝ) (k : ℤ)
        (G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
          (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)),
        (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (G i) (W.L_mero i)
          ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ∧
              y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t)) →
        ∃ G' : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
            (Metric.ball (((x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ
              Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t),
          ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (G' i) (W.L_mero i)
            ({ y : ℂ |
                y ∈ Metric.ball
                  (((x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ∧
                y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t) := by
    intro t₂ H₂ x δ_x δ_t k G hEq
    let c : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)
    let x' : ℝ := x + c
    have hy_dist : ∀ y : ℂ,
        dist (y + ((-c : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          dist y ((x' : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      intro y
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [x']
      push_cast
      ring
    have hIff_box :
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          p ∈ Metric.ball ((x' : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t ↔
            τ_shift (-c) p ∈
              Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t := by
      intro p
      simp only [Set.mem_prod, Metric.mem_ball, τ_shift, hy_dist]
    have hIff_TL_neg : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ T_L ↔ τ_shift (-c) p ∈ T_L := by
      intro p
      simp [T_L, meroTubeENNR, τ_shift]
    let G' : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        (Metric.ball ((x' : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t) :=
      fun i => meroPullbackShift (-c) hIff_box (G i)
    refine ⟨G', fun i => ?_⟩
    let O_x' : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball ((x' : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ∧
          y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t
    let L_sh : MeroOn2D T_L := meroPullbackShift (-c) hIff_TL_neg (W.L_mero i)
    have hOx'_sub : ∀ p ∈ O_x',
        τ_shift (-c) p ∈
          ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_x ∧
              y.im < H₂ - δ_x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t) := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hp.2⟩
      · dsimp only [τ_shift]
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, hy_dist]
        exact hp.1.1
      · simpa [τ_shift] using hp.1.2
    have hOx'_TL : O_x' ⊆ T_L := by
      intro p hp
      exact (hIff_TL_neg p).mpr (((hEq i).1 (hOx'_sub p hp)).2)
    have hEq₁ : MeroEqOn (G' i) L_sh O_x' := by
      refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1.1, hp.2⟩, hOx'_TL hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
      exact (hEq i).2 (τ_shift (-c) p) (hOx'_sub p hp) (τ_shift (-c) q)
        ((hτ_ball (-c) p q _).mpr hq)
    have hEq₂ : MeroEqOn L_sh (W.L_mero i) T_L := by
      refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨hp, hp⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
      have h_neg_c : 2 * Real.pi * ((-k : ℤ) : ℝ) = -c := by
        dsimp only [c]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h_per := (hPer (-k) i p hp).2 q
      dsimp only [L_sh, meroPullbackShift, τ_shift] at hq ⊢
      rw [h_neg_c] at h_per
      exact h_per (by rwa [min_comm])
    exact meroEqOn_trans hEq₁ (meroEqOn_mono hOx'_TL hEq₂)

  have hWallShift :
      ∀ (t₂ H₂ x : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
        WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x → WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) := by
    rintro t₂ H₂ x k ⟨δ_x, δ_t, G, hδ_x, hδ_t, hDt_sub, hEq⟩
    obtain ⟨G', hEq'⟩ := hShiftWallChart t₂ H₂ x δ_x δ_t k G hEq
    exact ⟨δ_x, δ_t, G', hδ_x, hδ_t, hDt_sub, hEq'⟩

  have hWallPer :
      ∀ (t₂ H₂ x : ℝ) (k : ℤ),
        WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ (x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) ↔ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x := by
    intro t₂ H₂ x k
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, hWallShift t₂ H₂ x k⟩
    have h_back := hWallShift t₂ H₂ (x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) (-k) h
    have h_cancel :
        (x + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) + 2 * Real.pi * ((-k : ℤ) : ℝ) = x := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rwa [h_cancel] at h_back

  
  
  
  
  have hWallObst :
      ∀ t₂ H₂ : ℝ,
        |t₂| < W.r_base →
        W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₂ →
        ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ¬ WallRegAt W t₂ H₂ x₀ := by
    intro t₂ H₂ ht₂ hhL
    by_contra h_no_obst
    push_neg at h_no_obst
    have ht₂_ball : (t₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ht₂
    have h2s_pos : 0 < 2 * W.s_base := by linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    have hH₂_ge_enn : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H₂ := by
      have hX := W.h_X_ge_two (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball
      have hL : W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) = W.h_X (t₂ : ℂ) := by
        simpa using W.h_L_eq (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball
      rwa [← hhL, hL]
    have hH₂_pos : 0 < H₂ :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr h2s_pos) hH₂_ge_enn)
    have hH₂_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₂ :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₂_pos)).mp hH₂_ge_enn

    
    choose δ_x δ_t G_raw hδ_x_pos hδ_t_pos _ hG_raw_eq using h_no_obst
    have hδ_x_le : ∀ x : ℝ, δ_x x ≤ 2 * H₂ := by
      intro x
      by_contra h_not_le
      have h_gt : 2 * H₂ < δ_x x := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
      let d : ℝ := δ_x x / 2 + H₂
      have hd_pos : 0 < d := by dsimp only [d]; linarith
      have hd_lt_δ : d < δ_x x := by dsimp only [d]; linarith
      let y_star : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + ((H₂ - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hy_ball : y_star ∈ Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x x) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_sub : y_star - ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ((-d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          dsimp only [y_star]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_neg, abs_of_pos hd_pos]
        exact hd_lt_δ
      have hy_im_lt : y_star.im < H₂ - δ_x x / 2 := by
        have hy_im_eq : y_star.im = H₂ - d := by simp [y_star]
        rw [hy_im_eq]
        dsimp only [d]
        linarith
      have hp_mem :
          (y_star, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈
            ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x x) ∧
                y.im < H₂ - δ_x x / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_t x)) :=
        ⟨⟨hy_ball, hy_im_lt⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_t_pos x)⟩
      have hp_TL : (y_star, (t₂ : ℂ)) ∈ T_L := ((hG_raw_eq x 0).1 hp_mem).2
      have h_bot : ENNReal.ofReal (-y_star.im) < W.h_L (starRingEnd ℂ (t₂ : ℂ)) := hp_TL.2.1
      have h_neg_im : -y_star.im = d - H₂ := by
        simp [y_star]
      rw [h_neg_im, Complex.conj_ofReal, hhL] at h_bot
      have hd_sub_lt : d - H₂ < H₂ := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₂_pos).mp h_bot
      dsimp only [d] at hd_sub_lt
      linarith

    
    let K_per : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    obtain ⟨S_pts, _, hS_cov⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.elim_nhds_subcover
        (fun x => Set.Ioo (x - 3 * δ_x x / 5) (x + 3 * δ_x x / 5))
        (fun x _ => isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨by linarith [hδ_x_pos x], by linarith [hδ_x_pos x]⟩)
    have h0_K : (0 : ℝ) ∈ K_per := ⟨le_rfl, le_of_lt Real.two_pi_pos⟩
    have hS_ne : S_pts.Nonempty := by
      have h0_mem := hS_cov h0_K
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp h0_mem with ⟨x₀, hx₀_S, _⟩
      exact ⟨x₀, hx₀_S⟩
    let δ_min : ℝ := S_pts.inf' hS_ne δ_x
    let δ_t_cov : ℝ := S_pts.inf' hS_ne δ_t
    have hδ_min_pos : 0 < δ_min := (Finset.lt_inf'_iff hS_ne).mpr (fun x _ => hδ_x_pos x)
    have hδ_t_cov_pos : 0 < δ_t_cov := (Finset.lt_inf'_iff hS_ne).mpr (fun x _ => hδ_t_pos x)
    let ε_top : ℝ := min δ_min W.s_base / 8
    let b : ℝ := H₂ + δ_min / 2
    have hε_top_pos : 0 < ε_top := div_pos (lt_min hδ_min_pos W.s_base_pos) (by norm_num)
    have hε_le_δ : ε_top ≤ δ_min / 8 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
    have hε_le_s : ε_top ≤ W.s_base / 8 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
    have hH₂_sub_gt_s : W.s_base < H₂ - ε_top := by
      linarith [hH₂_ge, hε_le_s, W.s_base_pos]
    have hH₂_sub_pos : 0 < H₂ - ε_top := by linarith [W.s_base_pos, hH₂_sub_gt_s]

    have h_lsc_ev :
        ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (t₂ : ℂ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base),
          ENNReal.ofReal (H₂ - ε_top) < W.h_L t := by
      apply W.h_L_lsc (t₂ : ℂ) ht₂_ball
      rw [hhL]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₂_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    rw [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq ht₂_ball, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at h_lsc_ev
    obtain ⟨δ_t_lsc, hδ_t_lsc_pos, hδ_t_lsc⟩ := h_lsc_ev
    let δ_t_star : ℝ := min δ_t_cov (min δ_t_lsc (W.r_base - |t₂|))
    have hδ_t_star_pos : 0 < δ_t_star :=
      lt_min hδ_t_cov_pos (lt_min hδ_t_lsc_pos (by linarith))
    let D_t : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_star
    have hDt_sub_base : D_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have ht_dist : ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ < W.r_base - |t₂| := by
        have h1 : dist t (t₂ : ℂ) < δ_t_star := ht
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have ht₂_norm : ‖(t₂ : ℂ)‖ = |t₂| := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_tri : ‖t‖ ≤ ‖t - (t₂ : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t₂ : ℂ)‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add t (t₂ : ℂ)
      linarith

    let Y_low : Set ℂ := Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-W.s_base) (H₂ - ε_top)
    let S_low : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Y_low ×ˢ D_t
    have hS_low_open : IsOpen S_low :=
      (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hS_low_conv : Convex ℝ S_low :=
      ((convex_Ioo (-W.s_base) (H₂ - ε_top)).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod
        (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_star)
    have hS_low_sub_TL : S_low ⊆ T_L := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_im : -W.s_base < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < H₂ - ε_top := hp.1
      have ht_norm : ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hDt_sub_base hp.2
      have ht_conj : ‖starRingEnd ℂ p.2‖ < W.r_base := by
        simpa [Complex.norm_conj] using ht_norm
      refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_lt : ENNReal.ofReal (-p.1.im) < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff h2s_pos).mpr (by linarith [hp_im.1, W.s_base_pos])
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lt (hhL_ge_two _ ht_conj).1
      · have h_lt : ENNReal.ofReal p.1.im < ENNReal.ofReal (H₂ - ε_top) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₂_sub_pos).mpr hp_im.2
        have h_dist : dist p.2 (t₂ : ℂ) < δ_t_lsc :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
        exact lt_trans h_lt (hδ_t_lsc h_dist)
    have hG_low_ex : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ M' : MeroOn2D S_low, MeroEqOn M' (W.L_mero i) S_low :=
      fun i => hRestrictOpen (W.L_mero i) hS_low_open hS_low_sub_TL
    choose G_low hG_low_eq using hG_low_ex

    
    let x_uk : ↥S_pts → ℤ → ℝ := fun u k => u.1 + 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)
    let a_u : ↥S_pts → ℝ := fun u => max (-W.s_base) (H₂ - 4 * δ_x u.1 / 5)
    let Y_rect : ↥S_pts → ℤ → Set ℂ := fun u k =>
      (Complex.reLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (x_uk u k - 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5) (x_uk u k + 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5)) ∩
        (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (a_u u) b)
    let U_rect : ↥S_pts → ℤ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun u k => Y_rect u k ×ˢ D_t
    have hU_rect_open : ∀ u k, IsOpen (U_rect u k) :=
      fun _ _ =>
        ((isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
          (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_im)).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hU_rect_conv : ∀ u k, Convex ℝ (U_rect u k) :=
      fun u k =>
        (((convex_Ioo (x_uk u k - 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5) (x_uk u k + 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5)).linear_preimage
            Complex.reLm).inter
          ((convex_Ioo (a_u u) b).linear_preimage Complex.imLm)).prod
          (convex_ball (t₂ : ℂ) δ_t_star)
    have hδ_min_le : ∀ u : ↥S_pts, δ_min ≤ δ_x u.1 := fun u => Finset.inf'_le δ_x u.2
    have hδ_t_cov_le : ∀ u : ↥S_pts, δ_t_cov ≤ δ_t u.1 := fun u => Finset.inf'_le δ_t u.2
    have ha_lt_half : ∀ u : ↥S_pts, a_u u < H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2 := by
      intro u
      exact max_lt (by linarith [W.s_base_pos, hδ_x_le u.1]) (by linarith [hδ_x_pos u.1])
    have hhalf_lt_top : ∀ u : ↥S_pts, H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2 < H₂ - ε_top := by
      intro u
      linarith [hε_le_δ, hδ_min_le u, hδ_x_pos u.1]
    have hY_rect_ball :
        ∀ (u : ↥S_pts) (k : ℤ),
          Y_rect u k ⊆ Metric.ball (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x u.1) := by
      intro u k y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
      have hre : (y - (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re = y.re - x_uk u k := by
        simp
      have him : (y - (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = y.im - H₂ := by
        simp
      rw [hre, him]
      have hx1 : x_uk u k - 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5 < y.re := hy.1.1
      have hx2 : y.re < x_uk u k + 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5 := hy.1.2
      have hy1 : H₂ - 4 * δ_x u.1 / 5 < y.im := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy.2.1
      have hy2 : y.im < H₂ + 4 * δ_x u.1 / 5 := by
        have hb_le : b < H₂ + 4 * δ_x u.1 / 5 := by
          dsimp only [b]
          linarith [hδ_min_le u, hδ_x_pos u.1]
        exact lt_trans hy.2.2 hb_le
      exact (Real.sqrt_lt' (hδ_x_pos u.1)).mpr (by nlinarith)

    have hG_sh_ex :
        ∀ (u : ↥S_pts) (k : ℤ),
          ∃ G_sh : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
              (Metric.ball (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x u.1) ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_t u.1)),
            ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (G_sh i) (W.L_mero i)
              ({ y : ℂ |
                  y ∈ Metric.ball (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x u.1) ∧
                  y.im < H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_t u.1)) :=
      fun u k => hShiftWallChart t₂ H₂ u.1 (δ_x u.1) (δ_t u.1) k (G_raw u.1) (hG_raw_eq u.1)
    choose G_sh hG_sh_eq using hG_sh_ex

    have hU_rect_sub_sh :
        ∀ (u : ↥S_pts) (k : ℤ),
          U_rect u k ⊆
            Metric.ball (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x u.1) ×ˢ
              Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_t u.1) :=
      fun u k p hp =>
        ⟨hY_rect_ball u k hp.1,
         Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hδ_t_cov_le u)) hp.2⟩

    have hG_rect_ex :
        ∀ (u : ↥S_pts) (k : ℤ) (i : Fin 2),
          ∃ M' : MeroOn2D (U_rect u k), MeroEqOn M' (G_sh u k i) (U_rect u k) :=
      fun u k i => hRestrictOpen (G_sh u k i) (hU_rect_open u k) (hU_rect_sub_sh u k)
    choose G_rect hG_rect_sh using hG_rect_ex

    have hEq_rect_low :
        ∀ (u : ↥S_pts) (k : ℤ) (i : Fin 2),
          MeroEqOn (G_rect u k i) (G_low i) (U_rect u k ∩ S_low) := by
      intro u k i
      let V_seed : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        ((Complex.reLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (x_uk u k - 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5) (x_uk u k + 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5)) ∩
          (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (a_u u) (H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2))) ×ˢ D_t
      have hV_seed_sub : V_seed ⊆ U_rect u k ∩ S_low := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨⟨⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2.1, ?_⟩, hp.2⟩, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hp.2⟩⟩
        · dsimp only [b]
          linarith [hp.1.2.2, hδ_x_pos u.1, hδ_min_pos]
        · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp.1.2.1
        · exact lt_trans hp.1.2.2 (hhalf_lt_top u)
      have hV_seed_ne : V_seed.Nonempty := by
        let y_mid : ℂ :=
          (x_uk u k : ℂ) + (((a_u u + (H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2)) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        refine ⟨(y_mid, (t₂ : ℂ)), ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_star_pos⟩⟩
        · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Complex.reLm_coe, Set.mem_Ioo, y_mid,
            Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
            Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero]
          exact ⟨by linarith [hδ_x_pos u.1], by linarith [hδ_x_pos u.1]⟩
        · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Complex.imLm_coe, Set.mem_Ioo, y_mid,
            Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
          exact ⟨by linarith [ha_lt_half u], by linarith [ha_lt_half u]⟩
      have hV_seed_sh :
          V_seed ⊆
            { y : ℂ |
                y ∈ Metric.ball (((x_uk u k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (H₂ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (δ_x u.1) ∧
                y.im < H₂ - δ_x u.1 / 2 } ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₂ : ℂ) (δ_t u.1) := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_inter := hV_seed_sub hp
        exact ⟨⟨hY_rect_ball u k hp_inter.1.1, hp.1.2.2⟩,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (hδ_t_cov_le u)) hp.2⟩
      have hEq_seed : MeroEqOn (G_rect u k i) (G_low i) V_seed :=
        meroEqOn_trans
          (meroEqOn_trans
            (meroEqOn_mono (fun p hp => (hV_seed_sub hp).1) (hG_rect_sh u k i))
            (meroEqOn_mono hV_seed_sh (hG_sh_eq u k i)))
          (meroEqOn_symm (meroEqOn_mono (fun p hp => (hV_seed_sub hp).2) (hG_low_eq i)))
      exact hMeroEqConn
        ((hU_rect_open u k).inter hS_low_open)
        ((hU_rect_conv u k).inter hS_low_conv).isPreconnected
        (fun p hp => hp) hV_seed_ne hV_seed_sub hEq_seed

    
    let W_ext : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { y : ℂ | -W.s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ D_t
    let Idx : Type := Option (↥S_pts × ℤ)
    let W_fam : Idx → Set (ℂ × ℂ)
      | none => S_low
      | some uk => U_rect uk.1 uk.2
    let G_fam : Fin 2 → ∀ j : Idx, MeroOn2D (W_fam j)
      | i, none => G_low i
      | i, some uk => G_rect uk.1 uk.2 i

    have hW_cov : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W_ext ↔ ∃ j : Idx, p ∈ W_fam j := by
      intro p
      constructor
      · intro hp
        by_cases him : p.1.im < H₂ - ε_top
        · exact ⟨none, ⟨⟨hp.1.1, him⟩, hp.2⟩⟩
        · have him_ge : H₂ - ε_top ≤ p.1.im := le_of_not_gt him
          have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
          have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
          let k : ℤ := ⌊p.1.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
          let r_mod : ℝ := p.1.re - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)
          have hr_mod_K : r_mod ∈ K_per := by
            have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ p.1.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
            have hk_lt : p.1.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
            have h1 : 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) ≤ p.1.re := by
              have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk_le (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
              rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h2pi_ne] at hmul
            have h2 : p.1.re < 2 * Real.pi * ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
              have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hk_lt h2pi_pos
              rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ h2pi_ne] at hmul
            exact ⟨by dsimp only [r_mod]; linarith, by dsimp only [r_mod]; linarith⟩
          rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS_cov hr_mod_K) with ⟨x, hx_S, hx_Ioo⟩
          let u : ↥S_pts := ⟨x, hx_S⟩
          refine ⟨some (u, k), ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hp.2⟩⟩
          · change x_uk u k - 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5 < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_uk u k + 3 * δ_x u.1 / 5
            refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> dsimp only [x_uk, u, r_mod] at hx_Ioo ⊢ <;>
              linarith [hx_Ioo.1, hx_Ioo.2]
          · exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_trans (ha_lt_half u) (hhalf_lt_top u)) him_ge, hp.1.2⟩
      · rintro ⟨(_ | ⟨u, k⟩), hp⟩
        · have hp_im : -W.s_base < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < H₂ - ε_top := hp.1
          exact ⟨⟨hp_im.1, by dsimp only [b]; linarith [hp_im.2, hε_top_pos, hδ_min_pos]⟩, hp.2⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp.1.2.1, hp.1.2.2⟩, hp.2⟩

    have hG_compat :
        ∀ (i : Fin 2) (j₁ j₂ : Idx),
          MeroEqOn (G_fam i j₁) (G_fam i j₂) (W_fam j₁ ∩ W_fam j₂) := by
      intro i j₁ j₂
      cases j₁ with
      | none =>
        cases j₂ with
        | none => exact ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
        | some uk =>
          exact meroEqOn_mono
            (show S_low ∩ U_rect uk.1 uk.2 ⊆ U_rect uk.1 uk.2 ∩ S_low from fun _ hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩)
            (meroEqOn_symm (hEq_rect_low uk.1 uk.2 i))
      | some uk₁ =>
        cases j₂ with
        | none => exact hEq_rect_low uk₁.1 uk₁.2 i
        | some uk₂ =>
          let u₁ := uk₁.1
          let k₁ := uk₁.2
          let u₂ := uk₂.1
          let k₂ := uk₂.2
          let I₁ : Set ℝ :=
            Set.Ioo (x_uk u₁ k₁ - 3 * δ_x u₁.1 / 5) (x_uk u₁ k₁ + 3 * δ_x u₁.1 / 5)
          let I₂ : Set ℝ :=
            Set.Ioo (x_uk u₂ k₂ - 3 * δ_x u₂.1 / 5) (x_uk u₂ k₂ + 3 * δ_x u₂.1 / 5)
          by_cases hI_ne : (I₁ ∩ I₂).Nonempty
          · obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀₁, hr₀₂⟩ := hI_ne
            let V₁₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (U_rect u₁ k₁ ∩ U_rect u₂ k₂) ∩ S_low
            have ha₁₂_lt : max (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂) < H₂ - ε_top :=
              max_lt (lt_trans (ha_lt_half u₁) (hhalf_lt_top u₁))
                (lt_trans (ha_lt_half u₂) (hhalf_lt_top u₂))
            have hV₁₂_ne : V₁₂.Nonempty := by
              let y_wit : ℂ :=
                (r₀ : ℂ) +
                  (((max (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂) + (H₂ - ε_top)) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
              have hy_re : y_wit.re = r₀ := by simp [y_wit]
              have hy_im : y_wit.im = (max (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂) + (H₂ - ε_top)) / 2 := by
                simp [y_wit]
              refine ⟨(y_wit, (t₂ : ℂ)), ⟨⟨⟨?_, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_star_pos⟩,
                ⟨?_, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_star_pos⟩⟩,
                ⟨?_, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t_star_pos⟩⟩⟩
              · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
                · simpa [I₁, Set.mem_preimage, Complex.reLm_coe, hy_re] using hr₀₁
                · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Complex.imLm_coe, Set.mem_Ioo, hy_im]
                  exact ⟨by linarith [le_max_left (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂), ha₁₂_lt],
                    by dsimp only [b]; linarith [ha₁₂_lt, hε_top_pos, hδ_min_pos]⟩
              · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
                · simpa [I₂, Set.mem_preimage, Complex.reLm_coe, hy_re] using hr₀₂
                · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Complex.imLm_coe, Set.mem_Ioo, hy_im]
                  exact ⟨by linarith [le_max_right (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂), ha₁₂_lt],
                    by dsimp only [b]; linarith [ha₁₂_lt, hε_top_pos, hδ_min_pos]⟩
              · simp only [Y_low, Set.mem_preimage, Complex.imLm_coe, Set.mem_Ioo, hy_im]
                have h_ge_s : -W.s_base ≤ max (a_u u₁) (a_u u₂) :=
                  le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
                exact ⟨by linarith [h_ge_s, ha₁₂_lt], by linarith [ha₁₂_lt]⟩
            have hEq_V₁₂ : MeroEqOn (G_rect u₁ k₁ i) (G_rect u₂ k₂ i) V₁₂ :=
              meroEqOn_trans
                (meroEqOn_mono
                  (show V₁₂ ⊆ U_rect u₁ k₁ ∩ S_low from fun _ hp => ⟨hp.1.1, hp.2⟩)
                  (hEq_rect_low u₁ k₁ i))
                (meroEqOn_symm
                  (meroEqOn_mono
                    (show V₁₂ ⊆ U_rect u₂ k₂ ∩ S_low from fun _ hp => ⟨hp.1.2, hp.2⟩)
                    (hEq_rect_low u₂ k₂ i)))
            exact hMeroEqConn
              ((hU_rect_open u₁ k₁).inter (hU_rect_open u₂ k₂))
              ((hU_rect_conv u₁ k₁).inter (hU_rect_conv u₂ k₂)).isPreconnected
              (fun _ hp => hp) hV₁₂_ne (fun _ hp => hp.1) hEq_V₁₂
          · refine ⟨fun _ hp => hp, fun p hp _ _ => ?_⟩
            exact False.elim (hI_ne ⟨p.1.re, hp.1.1.1, hp.2.1.1⟩)

    have hG_ext_ex :
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D W_ext, ∀ j : Idx, MeroEqOn F_ext (G_fam i j) (W_fam j) :=
      fun i => hGlueFamily W_fam W_ext (G_fam i) hW_cov (hG_compat i)
    choose G_ext hG_ext_eq using hG_ext_ex

    
    let S_base_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { y : ℂ | |y.im| < W.s_base } ×ˢ D_t
    have hS_base_open : IsOpen S_base_t :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).prod
        Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hS_base_sub_low : S_base_t ⊆ S_low := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : |p.1.im| < W.s_base := hp.1
      have him := abs_lt.mp hp1
      exact ⟨⟨him.1, lt_trans him.2 hH₂_sub_gt_s⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hS_base_sub_ext : S_base_t ⊆ W_ext := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1 : |p.1.im| < W.s_base := hp.1
      have him := abs_lt.mp hp1
      exact ⟨⟨him.1, by dsimp only [b]; linarith [him.2, hH₂_ge, W.s_base_pos, hδ_min_pos]⟩, hp.2⟩
    have hG_ext_agrees :
        ∀ i : Fin 2,
          MeroAgreesHolo (G_ext i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i) S_base_t := by
      intro i
      have hEq_base_t : MeroEqOn (G_ext i) (W.L_mero i) S_base_t :=
        meroEqOn_mono hS_base_sub_low
          (meroEqOn_trans (hG_ext_eq i none) (hG_low_eq i))
      have hf_cont_det :
          ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i) U_base2 :=
        (hDet.dualLine_holo i).continuousOn.mono (fun p hp =>
          ⟨by linarith [hp.1, W.s_base_le_det],
           by linarith [hp.2, W.r_base_le_det, W.r_base_pos]⟩)
      refine ⟨hS_base_sub_ext, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have hp1 : |p.1.im| < W.s_base := hp.1
      have hp_ext : p ∈ W_ext := hS_base_sub_ext hp
      have hp_base2 : p ∈ U_base2 :=
        ⟨by linarith [hp1, W.s_base_pos],
         by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hDt_sub_base hp.2⟩
      have hp_TL : p ∈ T_L := hBase_sub_TL hp_base2
      obtain ⟨r_S, hr_S_pos, hr_S_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS_base_open p hp
      obtain ⟨r_L, hr_L_pos, hr_L_le, hr_L_sub, hr_L_eq⟩ := (W.L_agrees_two i).2 p hp_base2
      let r : ℝ := min (min ((G_ext i).rad p) r_S) r_L
      have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
        lt_min (lt_min ((G_ext i).rad_pos p hp_ext) hr_S_pos) hr_L_pos
      have hr_le_G : r ≤ (G_ext i).rad p :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hr_le_S : r ≤ r_S :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hr_le_L : r ≤ r_L := min_le_right _ _
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le_G,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_S) hr_S_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have h_prod :
          ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball p r,
            ((G_ext i).num p z - glancingDualLine C z.1 z.2 i * (G_ext i).den p z) *
              (W.L_mero i).den p z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_min : z ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((G_ext i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad p)) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_min hr_le_G (le_trans hr_le_L hr_L_le)) hz
        have e₁ := hEq_base_t.2 p hp z hz_min
        have e₂ := hr_L_eq z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_L hz)
        dsimp only at e₂
        rw [sub_mul, e₁, e₂]
        ring
      have h_diff_cont :
          ContinuousOn
            (fun z : ℂ × ℂ =>
              (G_ext i).num p z - glancingDualLine C z.1 z.2 i * (G_ext i).den p z)
            (Metric.ball p r) :=
        (((G_ext i).num_holo p hp_ext).continuousOn.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G)).sub
          ((hf_cont_det.mono (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_L) hr_L_sub)).mul
            (((G_ext i).den_holo p hp_ext).continuousOn.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le_G)))
      have h_zero :=
        hCancelDen (W.L_mero i) hp_TL Metric.isOpen_ball
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans hr_le_L hr_L_le))
          h_diff_cont h_prod q hq
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_zero

    have hb_gt_s : W.s_base < b := by
      dsimp only [b]
      linarith [hH₂_ge, W.s_base_pos, hδ_min_pos]
    have hb_le_enn : ENNReal.ofReal b ≤ W.h_L (t₂ : ℂ) :=
      W.h_L_maximal (t₂ : ℂ) b δ_t_star ht₂_ball hb_gt_s hδ_t_star_pos
        hDt_sub_base G_ext hG_ext_agrees
    rw [hhL] at hb_le_enn
    have hb_le : b ≤ H₂ := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₂_pos)).mp hb_le_enn
    dsimp only [b] at hb_le
    linarith

  exact ⟨hPer, hWallPer, hWallObst⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (r_a : ℂ) (hr_ne : r_a ≠ 0)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (hf_end : f_p 0 = 0 ∧ f_p (Fin.last k) = 0)
    (hAlg : AlgebraicLiftingToolkit) :
    Nonempty (PointCoalescingFormalData k r_a f_p)

signature.name: point_variational_formal_series_zero
signature.statement:
(k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (r_a : ℂ) (hr_ne : r_a ≠ 0)
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (hf_end : f_p 0 = 0 ∧ f_p (Fin.last k) = 0)
    (hAlg : AlgebraicLiftingToolkit) :
    Nonempty (PointCoalescingFormalData k r_a f_p)

proof.tactics:
by
  have htridiag_det : ∀ m : ℕ, (pointCoalescingTridiag m).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro m
    let L_mat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ := fun r t =>
      if r.1 = t.1 then 1
      else if r.1 = t.1 + 1 then -(((t.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((t.1 : ℂ) + 2))
      else 0
    let U_mat : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ := fun t s =>
      if t.1 = s.1 then ((t.1 : ℂ) + 2) / ((t.1 : ℂ) + 1)
      else if s.1 = t.1 + 1 then -1
      else 0
    have hL_tri : L_mat.BlockTriangular OrderDual.toDual := by
      intro r t hrt
      have hlt : r.1 < t.1 := hrt
      dsimp only [L_mat]
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have hU_tri : U_mat.BlockTriangular id := by
      intro t s hst
      have hlt : s.1 < t.1 := hst
      dsimp only [U_mat]
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have hLU : L_mat * U_mat = pointCoalescingTridiag m := by
      ext r s
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
      have hsplit : ∀ t : Fin m,
          L_mat r t * U_mat t s =
            (if t = r then U_mat t s else 0) +
              (if r.1 = t.1 + 1 then -(((t.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((t.1 : ℂ) + 2)) * U_mat t s else 0) := by
        intro t
        dsimp only [L_mat]
        by_cases htr : t = r
        · subst htr
          rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl, if_neg (by omega), one_mul, add_zero]
        · have hne_val : r.1 ≠ t.1 := fun h => htr (Fin.ext h.symm)
          rw [if_neg hne_val, if_neg htr, zero_add]
          split_ifs <;> ring
      simp_rw [hsplit]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ r]
      simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hr0 : r.1 = 0
      · have hsum2 :
            (∑ x : Fin m,
              if r.1 = x.1 + 1 then -(((x.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((x.1 : ℂ) + 2)) * U_mat x s else 0) = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro x _
          rw [if_neg (by omega)]
        rw [hsum2, add_zero]
        dsimp only [U_mat, pointCoalescingTridiag]
        by_cases hs0 : s.1 = 0
        · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega), hr0]; push_cast; norm_num
        · by_cases hs1 : s.1 = 1
          · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
          · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      · let r_prev : Fin m := ⟨r.1 - 1, by omega⟩
        have hsum2 :
            (∑ x : Fin m,
              if r.1 = x.1 + 1 then -(((x.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((x.1 : ℂ) + 2)) * U_mat x s else 0) =
            -(((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1) / ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2)) * U_mat r_prev s := by
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r_prev]
          · rw [if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)]
          · intro x _ hxr
            rw [if_neg (fun heq => hxr (Fin.ext (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega)))]
          · intro hnot
            exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ r_prev))
        rw [hsum2]
        have hp1_ne : ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : r_prev.1 + 1 ≠ 0)
        have hp2_ne : ((r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : r_prev.1 + 2 ≠ 0)
        have hr_cast : (r.1 : ℂ) = (r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1 := by
          have hr_nat : r.1 = r_prev.1 + 1 := by dsimp [r_prev]; omega
          exact_mod_cast hr_nat
        dsimp only [U_mat, pointCoalescingTridiag]
        by_cases hrs : r.1 = s.1
        · rw [if_pos hrs, if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega),
            if_pos hrs, hr_cast]
          have hden_eq : (r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 1 + 1 = (r_prev.1 : ℂ) + 2 := by ring
          rw [hden_eq]
          field_simp [hp2_ne]
          ring
        · by_cases hsr1 : s.1 = r.1 + 1
          · rw [if_neg hrs, if_pos hsr1, if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega),
              if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_neg hrs, if_pos (Or.inl hsr1)]
            ring
          · by_cases hrs1 : r.1 = s.1 + 1
            · rw [if_neg hrs, if_neg hsr1, if_pos (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega),
                if_neg hrs, if_pos (Or.inr hrs1)]
              field_simp [hp1_ne, hp2_ne]
              ring
            · rw [if_neg hrs, if_neg hsr1, if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega),
                if_neg (by dsimp [r_prev]; omega), if_neg hrs,
                if_neg (not_or.mpr ⟨hsr1, hrs1⟩)]
              ring
    rw [← hLU, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular L_mat hL_tri,
      Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular hU_tri]
    refine mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_
    · rw [Finset.prod_eq_one]
      · exact one_ne_zero
      · intro i _; simp [L_mat]
    · rw [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
      intro i _
      dsimp only [U_mat]
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact div_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : i.1 + 2 ≠ 0))
        (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : i.1 + 1 ≠ 0))
  have hk_ne : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
  have htridiag_ne : (pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)).det ≠ 0 := htridiag_det (k - 1)
  let c_H : ℂ := -(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ)))
  have hc_H_ne : c_H ≠ 0 :=
    neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hr_ne) (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hk_ne))
  let A₀ : Matrix (Fin (k - 1)) (Fin (k - 1)) ℂ := c_H • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)
  have hA₀_det : A₀.det ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp only [A₀]
    rw [Matrix.det_smul]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hc_H_ne) htridiag_ne

  let stepFn : ∀ (q : ℕ), (∀ m < q, Fin (k - 1) → ℂ) → (Fin (k - 1) → ℂ) :=
    fun q ih =>
      if _hq0 : q = 0 then
        fun r => ((r.1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)
      else
        let u_trunc_ih : Fin (k - 1) → Polynomial ℂ := fun s =>
          ∑ m ∈ (Finset.range q).attach,
            Polynomial.C (ih m.1 (Finset.mem_range.mp m.2) s) * Polynomial.X ^ m.1
        let z_trunc_ih : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
          ((pointCoalescingStep u_trunc_ih i : Polynomial ℂ) : PowerSeries ℂ)
        let rhs_ih : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ := fun r =>
          PowerSeries.coeff q
            (pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc_ih ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ -
              pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z_trunc_ih ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
