    intro i
    have h1 : D (z i * (z i)⁻¹) = 0 := by rw [hz_mul_inv i, D.map_one_eq_zero]
    rw [D.leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h1
    calc D ((z i)⁻¹)
        = ((z i)⁻¹ * z i) * D ((z i)⁻¹) := by rw [hz_inv_mul i, one_mul]
      _ = (z i)⁻¹ * (z i * D ((z i)⁻¹) + (z i)⁻¹ * D (z i)) -
            ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 * D (z i) := by ring
      _ = -(((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 * D (z i)) := by rw [h1, mul_zero, zero_sub]
  have hD_z_sum : (∑ i : Fin k, D (z i)) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_sum D, hz_sum, D.map_one_eq_zero]

  let G_term : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
    -PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24) * (z i) ^ 3 -
      PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X * z i +
      PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹
  let G_ser : PowerSeries ℂ := ∑ i : Fin k, G_term i
  let D_term : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
    -PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * z i +
      PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) * PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹
  let D_ser : PowerSeries ℂ := pointFormalDerivSeries r_a f_p u_ps

  have hc_ra8 : PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8) = 3 * PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24) := by
    rw [← map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 3, ← map_mul]
    congr 1; ring
  have hc_fp2 : ∀ i : Fin k,
      PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2) =
        2 * PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro i
    rw [← map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2, ← map_mul]
    congr 1; ring

  have hD_G_term : ∀ i : Fin k,
      D (G_term i) = pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z i * D (z i) + D_term i := by
    intro i
    have hG_rw : G_term i =
        PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / 24)) * (z i) ^ 3 +
          PowerSeries.C (-(r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2)) * (PowerSeries.X * z i) +
          PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * (PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹) := by
      dsimp only [G_term]
      rw [map_neg, map_neg]
      ring
    rw [hG_rw, map_add, map_add, hD_C_mul, hD_C_mul, hD_C_mul, hD_pow3,
      D.leibniz PowerSeries.X (z i), D.leibniz (PowerSeries.X ^ 2) ((z i)⁻¹),
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hD_X, hD_X2, hD_inv i,
      map_neg, map_neg]
    dsimp only [pointFormalEdgeLambda, D_term]
    rw [hc_ra8, hc_fp2 i]
    ring

  have hDG : D G_ser = D_ser := by
    dsimp only [G_ser, D_ser, pointFormalDerivSeries]
    rw [map_sum]
    calc ∑ i : Fin k, D (G_term i)
        = ∑ i : Fin k, (Λ * D (z i) + D_term i) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            rw [hD_G_term i, hΛ_eq i]
      _ = Λ * (∑ i : Fin k, D (z i)) + ∑ i : Fin k, D_term i := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin k, D_term i := by rw [hD_z_sum, mul_zero, zero_add]

  have hΛ_homog : Λ = 3 * G_ser - 2 * PowerSeries.X * D_ser := by
    have hterm_homog : ∀ i : Fin k,
        pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z i * z i =
          3 * G_term i - 2 * PowerSeries.X * D_term i := by
      intro i
      have hz_inv2_mul : ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 * z i = (z i)⁻¹ := by
        calc ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 * z i
            = (z i)⁻¹ * ((z i)⁻¹ * z i) := by ring
          _ = (z i)⁻¹ := by rw [hz_inv_mul i, mul_one]
      dsimp only [pointFormalEdgeLambda, G_term, D_term]
      rw [hc_ra8, hc_fp2 i]
      calc (- (3 * PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24)) * z i ^ 2 -
              PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X -
              PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) *
                PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹ ^ 2) * z i
          = - (3 * PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24)) * z i ^ 3 -
              PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X * z i -
              PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) *
                PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 * z i) := by ring
        _ = 3 * (-PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24) * z i ^ 3 -
                PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X * z i +
                PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) *
                  PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹) -
              2 * PowerSeries.X *
                (-PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * z i +
                  2 * PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) *
                    PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹) := by
            rw [hz_inv2_mul]; ring
    calc Λ = Λ * 1 := (mul_one Λ).symm
      _ = Λ * ∑ i : Fin k, z i := by rw [← hz_sum]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin k, pointFormalEdgeLambda r_a f_p z i * z i := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hΛ_eq i]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin k, (3 * G_term i - 2 * PowerSeries.X * D_term i) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hterm_homog i
      _ = 3 * G_ser - 2 * PowerSeries.X * D_ser := by
            dsimp only [G_ser, D_ser, pointFormalDerivSeries]
            rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]

  let g₁ : ℂ := PowerSeries.constantCoeff D_ser
  have hD_eq : D_ser = PowerSeries.C g₁ := by
    ext m
    rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | hm
    · simp [g₁]
    · rw [h_vanish m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm), PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg hm]
  let G₀ : ℂ := -(r_a ^ 2 / (24 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))
  have hG_const : PowerSeries.constantCoeff G_ser = G₀ := by
    dsimp only [G_ser, G_term, G₀]
    rw [map_sum]
    have hterm0 : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff
          (-PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 24) * (z i) ^ 3 -
            PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X * z i +
            PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹) =
          -(r_a ^ 2 / 24) * (1 / (k : ℂ)) ^ 3 := by
      intro i
      simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_neg, map_pow,
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, hz_const i]
      ring
    simp_rw [hterm0]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp [hk_ne]
  have hG_eq : G_ser = PowerSeries.C G₀ + PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X := by
    ext m
    rcases m with _ | _ | n
    · simp [hG_const]
    · have h0 := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff 0) (hDG.trans hD_eq)
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative] at h0
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one, PowerSeries.coeff_C, ↓reduceIte] at h0
      simp [PowerSeries.coeff_C, h0]
    · have hn := congr_arg (PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1)) (hDG.trans hD_eq)
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_C, if_neg (by omega)] at hn
      have hn_ne : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (n + 1) + 1 ≠ 0)
      have hc0 : PowerSeries.coeff (n + 2) G_ser = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hn).resolve_right hn_ne
      simp [hc0]
  have hΛ_lin :
      Λ = PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) + PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X := by
    rw [hΛ_homog, hG_eq, hD_eq]
    have h3 : (3 : PowerSeries ℂ) = PowerSeries.C 3 := (map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 3).symm
    have h2 : (2 : PowerSeries ℂ) = PowerSeries.C 2 := (map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2).symm
    have h3G0 : PowerSeries.C 3 * PowerSeries.C G₀ =
        PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) := by
      rw [← map_mul]
      congr 1
      dsimp only [G₀]
      ring
    have h3sub2 : PowerSeries.C (3 : ℂ) - PowerSeries.C 2 = 1 := by
      rw [← map_sub]
      norm_num
    calc 3 * (PowerSeries.C G₀ + PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X) -
          2 * PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C g₁
        = PowerSeries.C 3 * PowerSeries.C G₀ +
            (PowerSeries.C 3 - PowerSeries.C 2) * (PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X) := by
            rw [h3, h2]; ring
      _ = PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) +
            PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X := by
            rw [h3G0, h3sub2, one_mul]

  let α_i : Fin k → ℂ := fun i =>
    2 * (k : ℂ) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a
  let S_plus : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
    PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ) * z i + PowerSeries.C (α_i i) * PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹
  let S_minus : Fin k → PowerSeries ℂ := fun i =>
    PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ) * z i - PowerSeries.C (α_i i) * PowerSeries.X * (z i)⁻¹
  let μ : ℂ := -(8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 / r_a ^ 2)
  have hμ_ne : μ ≠ 0 :=
    neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hk_ne))
      (pow_ne_zero 2 hr_ne))
  let c_plus : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => μ * (g₁ + r_a * f_p i.castSucc)
  let c_minus : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => μ * (g₁ + r_a * f_p i.succ)

  have hS_const : ∀ i : Fin k,
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (S_plus i) = 1 ∧ PowerSeries.constantCoeff (S_minus i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [S_plus, S_minus]
    simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_C,
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff_X, hz_const i, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_zero]
    exact ⟨mul_one_div_cancel hk_ne, mul_one_div_cancel hk_ne⟩

  have h_quad_base : ∀ i : Fin k,
      (PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (z i) ^ 2 +
          (PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2 =
        1 + PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
          PowerSeries.X := by
    intro i
    have hmul := congr_arg (fun T => PowerSeries.C μ * T) ((hΛ_eq i).trans hΛ_lin)
    dsimp only [pointFormalEdgeLambda] at hmul
    have hc1 : -PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8) = (PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← map_neg, ← map_mul, ← map_pow]
      congr 1; dsimp only [μ]; field_simp [hr_ne]
    have hc2 : -PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) =
        PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) := by
      rw [← map_neg, ← map_mul]
      congr 1; dsimp only [μ]; field_simp [hr_ne]; ring
    have hc3 : -PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) =
        (PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← map_neg, ← map_mul, ← map_pow]
      congr 1; dsimp only [μ, α_i]; field_simp [hr_ne]; ring
    have hc4 : PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_one PowerSeries.C]
      congr 1; dsimp only [μ]; field_simp [hr_ne, hk_ne]
    have hL : PowerSeries.C μ *
        (-PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8) * z i ^ 2 -
          PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * PowerSeries.X -
          PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2) *
            PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹ ^ 2) =
        (-PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (r_a ^ 2 / 8)) * z i ^ 2 +
          (-PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2)) *
            PowerSeries.X +
          (-PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C ((f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 / 2)) *
            PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * (z i)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring
    have hR : PowerSeries.C μ *
        (PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) + PowerSeries.C g₁ * PowerSeries.X) =
        PowerSeries.C μ * PowerSeries.C (-(r_a ^ 2 / (8 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2))) +
          PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁) * PowerSeries.X := by
      rw [mul_add]
      congr 1
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    rw [hL, hR, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4] at hmul
    calc (PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (z i) ^ 2 +
            (PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2
        = (1 + PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁) * PowerSeries.X) -
            PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
              PowerSeries.X := by linear_combination hmul
      _ = 1 + (PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁) -
            PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a)) *
              PowerSeries.X := by ring
      _ = 1 + PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
            PowerSeries.X := by rw [← map_sub]

  have hS_sq : ∀ i : Fin k,
      (S_plus i) ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c_plus i) * PowerSeries.X ∧
      (S_minus i) ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c_minus i) * PowerSeries.X := by
    intro i
    have hcross : 2 * PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ) * PowerSeries.C (α_i i) =
        PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) := by
      rw [← map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
      congr 1; dsimp only [α_i]; field_simp [hr_ne]; ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hc_eq :
          (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) +
            4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a = c_plus i := by
        dsimp only [c_plus, μ]
        field_simp [hr_ne]
        ring
      calc (S_plus i) ^ 2
          = ((PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (z i) ^ 2 +
              (PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2) +
              (2 * PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ) * PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) * PowerSeries.X *
                (z i * (z i)⁻¹) := by
              dsimp only [S_plus]; ring
        _ = (1 + PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
              PowerSeries.X) +
              PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
                PowerSeries.X := by
              rw [h_quad_base i, hcross, hz_mul_inv i, mul_one]
        _ = 1 + (PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) +
              PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a)) *
                PowerSeries.X := by ring
        _ = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c_plus i) * PowerSeries.X := by
              rw [← map_add, hc_eq]
    · have hc_eq :
          (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) -
            4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a = c_minus i := by
        dsimp only [c_minus, μ]
        field_simp [hr_ne]
        ring
      calc (S_minus i) ^ 2
          = ((PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (z i) ^ 2 +
              (PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) ^ 2 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * ((z i)⁻¹) ^ 2) -
              (2 * PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ) * PowerSeries.C (α_i i)) * PowerSeries.X *
                (z i * (z i)⁻¹) := by
              dsimp only [S_minus]; ring
        _ = (1 + PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
              PowerSeries.X) -
              PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) *
                PowerSeries.X := by
              rw [h_quad_base i, hcross, hz_mul_inv i, mul_one]
        _ = 1 + (PowerSeries.C (μ * g₁ - 4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / r_a) -
              PowerSeries.C (4 * (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) / r_a)) *
                PowerSeries.X := by ring
        _ = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c_minus i) * PowerSeries.X := by
              rw [← map_sub, hc_eq]

  let S_all : Fin (k + k) → PowerSeries ℂ := fun idx =>
    Sum.elim S_plus S_minus (finSumFinEquiv.symm idx)
  let c_all : Fin (k + k) → ℂ := fun idx =>
    Sum.elim c_plus c_minus (finSumFinEquiv.symm idx)
  have hS_all_prop : ∀ idx : Fin (k + k),
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (S_all idx) = 1 ∧
      (S_all idx) ^ 2 = 1 + PowerSeries.C (c_all idx) * PowerSeries.X := by
    intro idx
    dsimp only [S_all, c_all]
    rcases finSumFinEquiv.symm idx with i | i
    · exact ⟨(hS_const i).1, (hS_sq i).1⟩
    · exact ⟨(hS_const i).2, (hS_sq i).2⟩
  have hS_all_sum : (∑ idx : Fin (k + k), S_all idx) = PowerSeries.C ((k + k : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
    have heq : (∑ idx : Fin (k + k), S_all idx) =
        ∑ x : Fin k ⊕ Fin k, Sum.elim S_plus S_minus x :=
      Fintype.sum_equiv finSumFinEquiv.symm S_all (Sum.elim S_plus S_minus) (fun _ => rfl)
    rw [heq, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hpair : ∀ i : Fin k, S_plus i + S_minus i = (2 * PowerSeries.C (k : ℂ)) * z i := by
      intro i; dsimp only [S_plus, S_minus]; ring
    simp_rw [hpair]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hz_sum, mul_one, ← map_ofNat PowerSeries.C 2, ← map_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

  have hc_all_zero : ∀ idx : Fin (k + k), c_all idx = 0 :=
    hAlg.sqrt_power_sum_zero (k + k) c_all S_all hS_all_prop hS_all_sum
  have hc_plus_zero : ∀ i : Fin k, g₁ + r_a * f_p i.castSucc = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := hc_all_zero (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl i))
    dsimp only [c_all] at h
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hμ_ne
  have hc_minus_zero : ∀ i : Fin k, g₁ + r_a * f_p i.succ = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := hc_all_zero (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr i))
    dsimp only [c_all] at h
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hμ_ne
  have hg₁_zero : g₁ = 0 := by
    have h0 := hc_plus_zero ⟨0, by omega⟩
    have hcast0 : (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin k).castSucc = 0 := rfl
    rw [hcast0, hf_end.1, mul_zero, add_zero] at h0
    exact h0
  intro r
  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ r
  · exact hf_end.1
  · intro i
    have hi := hc_minus_zero i
    rw [hg₁_zero, zero_add] at hi
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_left hr_ne

informal_problem.statement:
(k p J : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpJ : p ≤ J)
    (a v_a : ℝ) (W : Set ℂ) (hW_open : IsOpen W) (ha_mem : (a : ℂ) ∈ W)
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W)
    (hv_a : deriv F (a : ℂ) = (v_a : ℂ))
    (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (hf_end : f_p 0 = 0 ∧ f_p (Fin.last k) = 0)
    (g : Fin (k + 1) → Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ)
    (hg_holo : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (g m l) W)
    (hg_end : ∀ (l : Fin (J + 1)) (z : ℂ), g 0 l z = 0 ∧ g (Fin.last k) l z = 0)
    (hg_lt_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (l : Fin (J + 1)), (l : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W, g m l z = 0)
    (hg_at_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (hpJ' : p < J + 1), g m ⟨p, hpJ'⟩ (a : ℂ) = f_p m)
    (δ₀ : ℝ) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀)
    (x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ)
    (hx₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0)
    (hℓ₀_pos : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ i : Fin k,
      0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i) :
    let r_a : ℂ := deriv (deriv F) (a : ℂ)
    let g_a_pow : ℂ := ((Real.sqrt (1 + v_a ^ 2) : ℂ) ^ 3)
    ((∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun δ : ℝ =>
          ((δ : ℂ)⁻¹) • pointInteriorHess (ℓ₀ δ) F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) (x₀ δ))
        (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0))
        (nhds ((-(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ) * g_a_pow))) • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)))) ∧
    (∀ (L_max : ℕ) (u₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
        (b_hat : ℕ → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (b_lim : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
        ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ (τ ^ p) r = (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * u₀ τ r) →
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => u₀ τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))) →
      (∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => b_hat m τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (b_lim m r))) →
      let U_fam : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        u₀ τ r + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_hat m τ r
      let U_lim : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun e r =>
        ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_lim m r
      let Z_lim : ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun e i =>
        U_lim e i.succ - U_lim e i.castSucc
      let x_τ : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * U_fam τ e r
      let ε_τ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e => (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e
      ∃ ρ_e : ℝ, 0 < ρ_e ∧
        (∀ e ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e, ∀ i : Fin k, Z_lim e i ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
          let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
          let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
          let F_grad : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e =>
            ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ *
              pointRelInteriorGrad (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p))
                (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z)
                (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z)
                (x_τ τ e) r
          (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_grad τ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
          TendstoUniformlyOn F_grad
            (fun e =>
              g_a_pow⁻¹ *
                (pointLimEdgeLambda r_a f_p (e ^ p) (Z_lim e) i_L -
                  pointLimEdgeLambda r_a f_p (e ^ p) (Z_lim e) i_R))
            (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
        (let F_term2 : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e =>
          (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p))⁻¹ *
            pointCoalescingTermII p (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) F g (x_τ τ e) (ε_τ τ e)
         (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
           DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_term2 τ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)) ∧
         TendstoUniformlyOn F_term2
           (fun e =>
             g_a_pow⁻¹ * (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) *
               ∑ i : Fin k,
                 (-(r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i +
                   (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 * e ^ p * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹))
           (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e)))

    (x₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (ℓ₀ : ℝ → Fin k → ℂ)
    (hx₀_real : ∀ δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), (x₀ δ r).im = 0)

      0 < (ℓ₀ δ i).re ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i).im = 0 ∧ (ℓ₀ δ i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) (x₀ δ) i) :

          ((δ : ℂ)⁻¹) • pointInteriorHess (ℓ₀ δ) F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) (x₀ δ))

        (nhds ((-(r_a ^ 2 / (4 * (k : ℂ) * g_a_pow))) • pointCoalescingTridiag (k - 1)))) ∧
    (∀ (L_max : ℕ) (u₀ : ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
        (b_hat : ℕ → ℝ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (b_lim : ℕ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
        ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x₀ (τ ^ p) r = (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * u₀ τ r) →
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => u₀ τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)))) →
      (∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => b_hat m τ r)
          (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (b_lim m r))) →
      let U_fam : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        u₀ τ r + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_hat m τ r
      let U_lim : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun e r =>
        ((r : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L_max, e ^ m * b_lim m r
      let Z_lim : ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun e i =>
        U_lim e i.succ - U_lim e i.castSucc
      let x_τ : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e r =>
        (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * U_fam τ e r
      let ε_τ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e => (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e
      ∃ ρ_e : ℝ, 0 < ρ_e ∧
        (∀ e ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_e, ∀ i : Fin k, Z_lim e i ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ r : Fin (k - 1),
          let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro r_a g_a_pow
  let φ : Filter ℝ := nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0)
  let g_a : ℝ := 1 + v_a ^ 2
  have hg_a_pos : 0 < g_a := by dsimp [g_a]; positivity
  have hg_a_C_ne : (g_a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hg_a_pos)
  let s_a : ℝ := Real.sqrt g_a
  have hs_a_pos : 0 < s_a := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hg_a_pos
  have hs_a_sq : s_a ^ 2 = g_a := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hg_a_pos)
  have hs_a_C_ne : (s_a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hs_a_pos)
  have hs_a_C_sq : (s_a : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1 + (v_a : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ((s_a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((1 + v_a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := congr_arg _ hs_a_sq
    simpa [Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_add] using h1
  have hg_a_pow_eq : g_a_pow = (s_a : ℂ) ^ 3 := rfl
  have hg_a_pow_ne : g_a_pow ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hs_a_C_ne
  have hk_R_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk_ne : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨R_W, hR_W_pos, hR_W_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW_open (a : ℂ) ha_mem
  let ρ_a : ℝ := R_W / 3
  have hρ_a_pos : 0 < ρ_a := by dsimp [ρ_a]; linarith
  have hball_sub_W : Metric.ball (a : ℂ) (2 * ρ_a) ⊆ W := by
    intro w hw
    apply hR_W_sub
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
    dsimp [ρ_a] at hw
    linarith
  have hball1_sub_W : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a, z ∈ W :=
    fun z hz => hball_sub_W (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz)
  have hF'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv F) W := hF_holo.deriv hW_open
  have hF''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv F)) W := hF'_holo.deriv hW_open
  have hF'_cont_a : ContinuousAt (deriv F) (a : ℂ) :=
    hF'_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)
  have hF''_cont_a : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv F)) (a : ℂ) :=
    hF''_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)
  have hdslope_F'_cont : ContinuousAt (dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ)) (a : ℂ) := by
    have hd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ)) W :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)).mpr hF'_holo
    exact hd_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)
  have hdslope_F'_eq : ∀ z : ℂ,
      deriv F z - (v_a : ℂ) = (z - (a : ℂ)) * dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ) z := by
    intro z
    have h := sub_smul_dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ) z
    rw [smul_eq_mul, hv_a] at h
    exact h.symm

  have h_ray_mem_W : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a, ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a,
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, z + (t : ℂ) * d ∈ W := by
    intro z hz d hd t ht
    apply hball_sub_W
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq] at hz ⊢
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hd
    have ht_abs : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩
    have h1 : ‖(z + (t : ℂ) * d) - (a : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖z - (a : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t : ℂ) * d‖ := by
      simpa [add_sub_right_comm] using norm_add_le (z - (a : ℂ)) ((t : ℂ) * d)
    have h2 : ‖(t : ℂ) * d‖ ≤ ‖d‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg d]
    linarith

  have htaylor2_eq : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a, ∀ d ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a,
      F (z + d) - F z - d * deriv F z = d ^ 2 * pculTaylorRem2 F z d := by
    intro z hz d hd
    let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
      F (z + (t : ℂ) * d) + ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * d * deriv F (z + (t : ℂ) * d)
    let Φ' : ℝ → ℂ := fun t =>
      d ^ 2 * (((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d))
    have hΦ_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt Φ (Φ' t) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have hmem : z + (t : ℂ) * d ∈ W := h_ray_mem_W z hz d hd t ht
      have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F (z + (t : ℂ) * d) :=
        hF_holo.differentiableAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hmem)
      have hF'_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d) :=
        hF'_holo.differentiableAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hmem)
      have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => z + w * d) d (t : ℂ) := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul_const d).const_add z
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (z + (s : ℂ) * d))
          (deriv F (z + (t : ℂ) * d) * d) t := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using (hF_at.hasDerivAt.comp (t : ℂ) hlin).comp_ofReal
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => deriv F (z + (s : ℂ) * d))
          (deriv (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d) * d) t := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using (hF'_at.hasDerivAt.comp (t : ℂ) hlin).comp_ofReal
      have hd_coef : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ) * d) (-d) t := by
        have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((1 - s : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-1 : ℂ) t := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).ofReal_comp
        simpa using hc.mul_const d
      have hd_comb := hd1.add (hd_coef.mul hd2)
      refine hd_comb.congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [Φ']
      ring
    have hΦ'_cont : ContinuousOn Φ' (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      have hγ_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + (t : ℂ) * d) :=
        continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
      have hF''_comp : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hF''_holo.continuousOn.comp hγ_cont.continuousOn (h_ray_mem_W z hz d hd)
      have h1mt : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (h1mt.mul hF''_comp)
    have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hΦ_deriv hΦ'_cont.intervalIntegrable
    dsimp only [Φ'] at hint
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hint
    have hΦ1 : Φ 1 = F (z + d) := by simp [Φ]
    have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = F z + d * deriv F z := by simp [Φ]
    rw [hΦ1, hΦ0] at hint
    dsimp [pculTaylorRem2]
    linear_combination -hint

  have htaylorRem2_at_zero : pculTaylorRem2 F (a : ℂ) 0 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a := by
    dsimp [pculTaylorRem2]
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
    let ψ : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => ((s - s ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * r_a
    have hψ_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt ψ (((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * r_a) t := by
      intro t _
      have hr : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s - s ^ 2 / 2) (1 - t) t := by
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s ^ 2 / 2) t t := by
          simpa [pow_one] using ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const 2)
        exact (hasDerivAt_id t).sub h2
      exact hr.ofReal_comp.mul_const r_a
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * r_a) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul continuous_const
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hψ_deriv
      (h_cont.continuousOn.intervalIntegrable)]
    dsimp [ψ]
    norm_num

  have htaylorRem2_cont :
      ContinuousAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => pculTaylorRem2 F q.1 q.2) ((a : ℂ), 0) := by
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ_F, hδ_F_pos, hδ_F⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hF''_cont_a (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨min ρ_a (δ_F / 2), lt_min hρ_a_pos (half_pos hδ_F_pos), ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hq
    have hz_lt : dist q.1 (a : ℂ) < min ρ_a (δ_F / 2) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hq
    have hd_lt : dist q.2 (0 : ℂ) < min ρ_a (δ_F / 2) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hq
    have hz_ball : q.1 ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a :=
      Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (min_le_left _ _))
    have hd_ball : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a :=
      Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hd_lt (min_le_left _ _))
    have hz_δ : ‖q.1 - (a : ℂ)‖ < δ_F / 2 := by
      simpa [Complex.dist_eq] using lt_of_lt_of_le hz_lt (min_le_right _ _)
    have hd_δ : ‖q.2‖ < δ_F / 2 := by
      simpa [dist_zero_right] using lt_of_lt_of_le hd_lt (min_le_right _ _)
    have h1_cont : ContinuousOn
        (fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) (q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2))
        (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      have hγ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) :=
        continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
      exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn).mul
        (hF''_holo.continuousOn.comp hγ.continuousOn (h_ray_mem_W q.1 hz_ball q.2 hd_ball))
    have h0_cont : ContinuousOn
        (fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) ((a : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * 0))
        (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      have h0_eq :
          (fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) ((a : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * 0)) =
          fun t : ℝ => ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * r_a := by
        funext t; simp [r_a]
      rw [h0_eq]
      exact ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul
        continuous_const).continuousOn
    rw [Complex.dist_eq]
    dsimp only [pculTaylorRem2]
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1_cont.intervalIntegrable h0_cont.intervalIntegrable]
    have h_bnd : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) (q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) -
          ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) ((a : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * 0)‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, ← mul_sub]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2] : 0 ≤ 1 - t)]
      have ht_abs : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩
      have hw_dist : dist (q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) (a : ℂ) < δ_F := by
        rw [Complex.dist_eq]
        have htri : ‖(q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) - (a : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖q.1 - (a : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t : ℂ) * q.2‖ := by
          simpa [add_sub_right_comm] using norm_add_le (q.1 - (a : ℂ)) ((t : ℂ) * q.2)
        have hmul : ‖(t : ℂ) * q.2‖ ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg q.2]
        linarith
      have hF''_lt : ‖deriv (deriv F) (q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) - r_a‖ < ε / 2 := by
        simpa [Complex.dist_eq, r_a] using hδ_F hw_dist
      have h1mt_le : 1 - t ≤ 1 := by linarith [ht.1]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (deriv (deriv F) (q.1 + (t : ℂ) * q.2) - r_a)]
    have hint_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_bnd
    have hlen : |(1 : ℝ) - 0| = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [hlen, mul_one] at hint_le
    linarith

  have h_sqrt1p_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ sqrt1p (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2)) := by
    intro u hu
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hu
    have hu_re : 0 < (1 + u).re := by
      have habs : |u.re| ≤ ‖u‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm u
      have hre : -‖u‖ ≤ u.re := (abs_le.mp habs).1
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have hslit : 1 + u ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hu_re)
    have hlog : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Complex.log (1 + z)) u :=
      ((differentiableAt_const (1 : ℂ)).add differentiableAt_id).clog hslit
    exact Complex.differentiableAt_exp.comp u (hlog.div_const 2)

  have h_sqrt1p_sq : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2), (sqrt1p u) ^ 2 = 1 + u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hu
    have hu_ne : 1 + u ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hre0 : (1 + u).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
      have habs : |u.re| ≤ ‖u‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm u
      have hre : -‖u‖ ≤ u.re := (abs_le.mp habs).1
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re] at hre0
      linarith
    dsimp [sqrt1p]
    rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add, add_halves, Complex.exp_log hu_ne]

  have h_sqrt1p_zero : sqrt1p 0 = 1 := by simp [sqrt1p]
  have h_sqrt1p_cont0 : ContinuousAt sqrt1p 0 :=
    h_sqrt1p_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)))
  have h_sqrt1p_re_ev : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (sqrt1p u).re := by
    have hre_cont : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℂ => (sqrt1p u).re) 0 :=
      Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp h_sqrt1p_cont0
    have h0 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (sqrt1p 0).re := by rw [h_sqrt1p_zero]; norm_num
    exact hre_cont.eventually (lt_mem_nhds h0)
  obtain ⟨r_sq, hr_sq_pos, hr_sq⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_sqrt1p_re_ev
  let δ_sq : ℝ := min (1 / 4) r_sq
  have hδ_sq_pos : 0 < δ_sq := lt_min (by norm_num) hr_sq_pos
  have hδ_sq_lt_half : δ_sq < 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
  have h_sqrt1p_ball : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_sq,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (sqrt1p u).re ∧ (sqrt1p u) ^ 2 = 1 + u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_r : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sq :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu
    have hu_half : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ_sq_lt_half) hu
    exact ⟨hr_sq hu_r, h_sqrt1p_sq u hu_half⟩

  have heq_of_sq_re_pos : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℂ,
      w₁ ^ 2 = w₂ ^ 2 → 0 < w₁.re → 0 < w₂.re → w₁ = w₂ := by
    intro w₁ w₂ hsq h1 h2
    have hmul : (w₁ - w₂) * (w₁ + w₂) = 0 := by linear_combination hsq
    have hsum_ne : w₁ + w₂ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hre : (w₁ + w₂).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
      rw [Complex.add_re] at hre
      linarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right hsum_ne)

  let u_m_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun m => (m ^ 2 - (v_a : ℂ) ^ 2) / (g_a : ℂ)
  have hu_m_diff : Differentiable ℂ u_m_fn :=
    ((differentiable_id.pow 2).sub (differentiable_const _)).div_const _
  have hu_m_va : u_m_fn (v_a : ℂ) = 0 := by simp [u_m_fn]
  have hσ_at_va : pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) = (s_a : ℂ) := by
    change (s_a : ℂ) * sqrt1p (u_m_fn (v_a : ℂ)) = (s_a : ℂ)
    rw [hu_m_va, h_sqrt1p_zero, mul_one]
  obtain ⟨r_m1, hr_m1_pos, hr_m1⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hu_m_diff.continuous.continuousAt (x := (v_a : ℂ))) δ_sq hδ_sq_pos
  have hu_m_ball : ∀ m ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) r_m1, u_m_fn m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_sq := by
    intro m hm
    have hd := hr_m1 (Metric.mem_ball.mp hm)
    rwa [hu_m_va, ← Metric.mem_ball] at hd
  have hσ_holo_r1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pculSlopeSpeed v_a) (Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) r_m1) := by
    intro m hm
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hum_half : u_m_fn m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ_sq_lt_half) (hu_m_ball m hm)
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ sqrt1p (u_m_fn m) :=
      h_sqrt1p_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hum_half)
    exact (h1.comp m (hu_m_diff m)).const_mul (s_a : ℂ)
  have hσ_cont_va : ContinuousAt (pculSlopeSpeed v_a) (v_a : ℂ) :=
    hσ_holo_r1.continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_m1_pos))
  have hσ_fst_cont : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1) ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
    ContinuousAt.comp (g := pculSlopeSpeed v_a) (f := Prod.fst) hσ_cont_va continuousAt_fst
  have hσ_snd_cont : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2) ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
    ContinuousAt.comp (g := pculSlopeSpeed v_a) (f := Prod.snd) hσ_cont_va continuousAt_snd
  have hpsi_den_cont : ContinuousAt
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => 1 + q.1 * q.2 + pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2 * pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1)
      ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
    (continuousAt_const.add (continuousAt_fst.mul continuousAt_snd)).add
      (hσ_snd_cont.mul hσ_fst_cont)
  have hpsi_den_va :
      1 + (v_a : ℂ) * (v_a : ℂ) + pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) * pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) =
      2 * (s_a : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hσ_at_va]
    linear_combination -hs_a_C_sq
  have hpsi_den_va_ne : (2 : ℂ) * (s_a : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hs_a_C_ne)
  obtain ⟨r_m2, hr_m2_pos, hr_m2⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hpsi_den_cont.eventually_ne (hpsi_den_va.symm ▸ hpsi_den_va_ne))
  obtain ⟨r_m3, hr_m3_pos, hr_m3⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hσ_cont_va (s_a / 4) (by linarith)
  let ρ_m : ℝ := min r_m1 (min r_m2 r_m3)
  have hρ_m_pos : 0 < ρ_m := lt_min hr_m1_pos (lt_min hr_m2_pos hr_m3_pos)
  have hσ_props : ∀ m ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m,
      s_a / 2 < (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m).re ∧
      pculSlopeSpeed v_a m ≠ 0 ∧
      (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m) ^ 2 = 1 + m ^ 2 := by
    intro m hm
    have hm1 : m ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) r_m1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hm
    rcases h_sqrt1p_ball (u_m_fn m) (hu_m_ball m hm1) with ⟨hre, hsq⟩
    have hσ_re : s_a / 2 < (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m).re := by
      change s_a / 2 < ((s_a : ℂ) * sqrt1p (u_m_fn m)).re
      rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
      nlinarith
    have hσ_ne : pculSlopeSpeed v_a m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
      linarith
    have hσ_sq : (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m) ^ 2 = 1 + m ^ 2 := by
      change ((s_a : ℂ) * sqrt1p (u_m_fn m)) ^ 2 = 1 + m ^ 2
      rw [mul_pow, hsq]
      dsimp [u_m_fn]
      have hg_eq : (g_a : ℂ) = (s_a : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [g_a]; push_cast; exact hs_a_C_sq.symm
      rw [hg_eq]
      have hs2_ne : (s_a : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hs_a_C_ne
      field_simp [hs2_ne]
      linear_combination hs_a_C_sq
    exact ⟨hσ_re, hσ_ne, hσ_sq⟩

  have hgamma_quot_eq : ∀ m₁ ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m, ∀ m₂ ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m,
      m₁ / pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₁ - m₂ / pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₂ =
        (m₁ - m₂) * pculGammaQuot v_a m₁ m₂ := by
    intro m₁ hm₁ m₂ hm₂
    rcases hσ_props m₁ hm₁ with ⟨hre1, hne1, hsq1⟩
    rcases hσ_props m₂ hm₂ with ⟨hre2, hne2, hsq2⟩
    have hsum_ne : pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₁ + pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₂ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : (pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₁ + pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₂).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
      rw [Complex.add_re] at this
      linarith
    dsimp [pculGammaQuot]
    field_simp [hne1, hne2, hsum_ne]
    linear_combination m₁ * hsq2 - m₂ * hsq1

  have hgamma_quot_va : pculGammaQuot v_a (v_a : ℂ) (v_a : ℂ) = g_a_pow⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [pculGammaQuot]
    rw [hσ_at_va, hg_a_pow_eq]
    have hnum : 1 - (v_a : ℂ) * (v_a : ℂ) + (s_a : ℂ) * (s_a : ℂ) = 2 := by
      linear_combination hs_a_C_sq
    rw [hnum]
    field_simp [hs_a_C_ne]
    ring

  have hgamma_quot_cont :
      ContinuousAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => pculGammaQuot v_a q.1 q.2) ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) := by
    have hnum : ContinuousAt
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => 1 - q.1 * q.2 + pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1 * pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2)
        ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
      (continuousAt_const.sub (continuousAt_fst.mul continuousAt_snd)).add
        (hσ_fst_cont.mul hσ_snd_cont)
    have hden : ContinuousAt
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
          pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1 * pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2 *
            (pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1 + pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2))
        ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
      (hσ_fst_cont.mul hσ_snd_cont).mul (hσ_fst_cont.add hσ_snd_cont)
    have hden_ne :
        pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) * pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) *
          (pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) + pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hσ_at_va]
      have h2 : (s_a : ℂ) + (s_a : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have : ((s_a : ℂ) + (s_a : ℂ)).re = 0 := by rw [h0]; simp
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at this
        linarith
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hs_a_C_ne hs_a_C_ne) h2
    exact hnum.div hden hden_ne

  have hpsi_quad_eq : ∀ μ ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m, ∀ m ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m,
      (1 + μ * m) / pculSlopeSpeed v_a m - pculSlopeSpeed v_a μ =
        -(m - μ) ^ 2 * pculPsiQuadQuot v_a μ m := by
    intro μ hμ m hm
    rcases hσ_props μ hμ with ⟨_, _, hsq_μ⟩
    rcases hσ_props m hm with ⟨_, hne_m, hsq_m⟩
    have hpair_r2 : (μ, m) ∈ Metric.ball ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) r_m2 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
      have h1 : dist μ (v_a : ℂ) < r_m2 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hμ)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have h2 : dist m (v_a : ℂ) < r_m2 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hm)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      exact max_lt h1 h2
    have hden_ne : 1 + μ * m + pculSlopeSpeed v_a m * pculSlopeSpeed v_a μ ≠ 0 := hr_m2 hpair_r2
    dsimp [pculPsiQuadQuot]
    field_simp [hne_m, hden_ne]
    linear_combination -(pculSlopeSpeed v_a μ) ^ 2 * hsq_m - (1 + m ^ 2) * hsq_μ

  have hpsi_quad_va : pculPsiQuadQuot v_a (v_a : ℂ) (v_a : ℂ) = (2 * g_a_pow)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [pculPsiQuadQuot]
    rw [hpsi_den_va, hσ_at_va, hg_a_pow_eq]
    congr 1
    ring

  have hpsi_quad_cont :
      ContinuousAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => pculPsiQuadQuot v_a q.1 q.2) ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) := by
    have hden : ContinuousAt
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
          pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2 *
            (1 + q.1 * q.2 + pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.2 * pculSlopeSpeed v_a q.1))
        ((v_a : ℂ), (v_a : ℂ)) :=
      hσ_snd_cont.mul hpsi_den_cont
    have hden_ne :
        pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) *
          (1 + (v_a : ℂ) * (v_a : ℂ) +
            pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ) * pculSlopeSpeed v_a (v_a : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hpsi_den_va, hσ_at_va]
      exact mul_ne_zero hs_a_C_ne hpsi_den_va_ne
    exact hden.inv₀ hden_ne

  have h_rem2_tendsto : ∀ {z_fn d_fn : ℝ → ℂ},
      Filter.Tendsto z_fn φ (nhds (a : ℂ)) →
      Filter.Tendsto d_fn φ (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => pculTaylorRem2 F (z_fn δ) (d_fn δ))
        φ (nhds ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a)) := by
    intro z_fn d_fn hz hd
    have hc := htaylorRem2_cont.tendsto.comp (hz.prodMk_nhds hd)
    rwa [htaylorRem2_at_zero] at hc

  have h_gamma_tendsto : ∀ {m₁_fn m₂_fn : ℝ → ℂ},
      Filter.Tendsto m₁_fn φ (nhds (v_a : ℂ)) →
      Filter.Tendsto m₂_fn φ (nhds (v_a : ℂ)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => pculGammaQuot v_a (m₁_fn δ) (m₂_fn δ))
        φ (nhds g_a_pow⁻¹) := by
    intro m₁_fn m₂_fn hm1 hm2
    have hc := hgamma_quot_cont.tendsto.comp (hm1.prodMk_nhds hm2)
    rwa [hgamma_quot_va] at hc

  have h_fin_telescope : ∀ (k' : ℕ) (Φ : Fin (k' + 1) → ℂ),
      (∑ i : Fin k', (Φ i.succ - Φ i.castSucc)) = Φ (Fin.last k') - Φ 0 := by
    intro k'
    induction k' with
    | zero => intro Φ; simp [Fin.last]
    | succ m ih =>
        intro Φ
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
        simp only [Fin.succ_castSucc, Fin.succ_last]
        rw [ih (fun s => Φ s.castSucc)]
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero]
        ring

  
  
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩

  
  
  
  · intro hx₀_tendsto
    have hδ_pos_ev : ∀ᶠ δ in φ, 0 < δ := eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun _ h => h
    have hδ_lt_ev : ∀ᶠ δ in φ, δ < δ₀ :=
      (continuous_id.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds |>.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ₀)
    have hδ_Ioo_ev : ∀ᶠ δ in φ, δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀ :=
      (hδ_pos_ev.and hδ_lt_ev).mono fun _ h => h
    have hδ_C_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (δ : ℂ)) φ (nhds 0) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hx₀_lim_a : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => x₀ δ r) φ (nhds (a : ℂ)) := by
      intro r
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun δ : ℝ => (a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ) * ((x₀ δ r - (a : ℂ)) / (δ : ℂ))) φ (nhds (a : ℂ)) := by
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hδ_C_zero.mul (hx₀_tendsto r))
      refine h1.congr' (hδ_pos_ev.mono fun δ hδ => ?_)
      have hne : (δ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hδ)
      dsimp only
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hne]

        field_simp [hℓL_ne, hℓR_ne]; ring

        exact inv_anti₀ hc (h_lb e he)

    
    have hτ_pos_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, 0 < τ := eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun _ h => h
    have hτ_R_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => τ ^ p) φ (nhds 0) := by
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ^ p = 0 := zero_pow (by omega)
      simpa [h0] using ((continuous_pow p).tendsto (0 : ℝ)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hτ_C_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ)) φ (nhds 0) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hτ_pow_zero : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => (τ : ℂ) ^ m) φ (nhds 0) := by
      intro m hm
      simpa [Function.comp_def, zero_pow hm] using
        ((continuous_pow m).tendsto (0 : ℂ)).comp hτ_C_zero
    have hτp_Ioo_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, τ ^ p ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ₀ := by
      have hpos : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, 0 < τ ^ p := hτ_pos_ev.mono fun τ hτ => pow_pos hτ p
      have hlt : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, τ ^ p < δ₀ := hτ_R_zero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ₀)
      exact (hpos.and hlt).mono fun _ h => h

    have hℓ₀_tau_sq_lim : ∀ i : Fin k,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ * (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p) i) ^ 2)
          φ (nhds ((g_a : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
      intro i
      let z₀_τ : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => u₀ τ i.succ - u₀ τ i.castSucc
      have hz₀_lim : Filter.Tendsto z₀_τ φ (nhds (1 / (k : ℂ))) := by
        have hsub := (hu₀_lim i.succ).sub (hu₀_lim i.castSucc)
        have h_eq : (((i.succ : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)) - (((i.castSucc : ℕ) : ℂ) / (k : ℂ)) =
            1 / (k : ℂ) := by
          simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]; ring
        rwa [h_eq] at hsub
      have hz₀_ne_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, z₀_τ τ ≠ 0 :=
        hz₀_lim.eventually_ne (one_div_ne_zero hk_ne)
      have hx₀_tau_lim : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => x₀ (τ ^ p) r) φ (nhds (a : ℂ)) := by
        intro r
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => (a : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) ^ p * u₀ τ r) φ (nhds (a : ℂ)) := by
          simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add ((hτ_pow_zero p (by omega)).mul (hu₀_lim r))
        exact h1.congr' (hx₀_u₀.mono fun τ hτ => (hτ r).symm)
      let d₀_τ : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ - x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc
      have hd₀_zero : Filter.Tendsto d₀_τ φ (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [d₀_τ] using (hx₀_tau_lim i.succ).sub (hx₀_tau_lim i.castSucc)
      have hxb_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a :=
        (hx₀_tau_lim i.castSucc).eventually
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_a_pos))
      have hdb_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, d₀_τ τ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a :=
        hd₀_zero.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_a_pos))
      have hm_base_lim : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => (F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) / d₀_τ τ)
          φ (nhds (v_a : ℂ)) := by
        have hF'_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => deriv F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc))
            φ (nhds (v_a : ℂ)) := by
          rw [← hv_a]; exact hF'_cont_a.tendsto.comp (hx₀_tau_lim i.castSucc)
        have hrem_lim := h_rem2_tendsto (hx₀_tau_lim i.castSucc) hd₀_zero
        have hcomb : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun τ : ℝ =>
              deriv F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) +
                d₀_τ τ * pculTaylorRem2 F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) (d₀_τ τ))
            φ (nhds (v_a : ℂ)) := by
          simpa using hF'_lim.add (hd₀_zero.mul hrem_lim)
        refine hcomb.congr'
          ((hτ_pos_ev.and (hx₀_u₀.and (hz₀_ne_ev.and (hxb_ev.and hdb_ev)))).mono
            fun τ ⟨hτ, hxu, hz_ne, hxb, hdb⟩ => ?_)
        have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
          pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
        have hd_eq : d₀_τ τ = (τ : ℂ) ^ p * z₀_τ τ := by
          dsimp [d₀_τ, z₀_τ]; rw [hxu i.succ, hxu i.castSucc]; ring
        have hd_ne : d₀_τ τ ≠ 0 := hd_eq ▸ mul_ne_zero hτp_ne hz_ne
        have hadd : x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc + d₀_τ τ = x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ := by dsimp [d₀_τ]; ring
        have ht := htaylor2_eq (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) hxb (d₀_τ τ) hdb
        rw [hadd] at ht
        have hnum : F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) =
            d₀_τ τ * deriv F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) +
              (d₀_τ τ) ^ 2 * pculTaylorRem2 F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc) (d₀_τ τ) := by
          linear_combination ht
        dsimp only
        rw [hnum]
        field_simp [hd_ne]
      have hprod := (hz₀_lim.pow 2).mul ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℂ))).add (hm_base_lim.pow 2))
      have hlim_eq : (1 / (k : ℂ)) ^ 2 * (1 + (v_a : ℂ) ^ 2) = (g_a : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [g_a]; push_cast; ring
      rw [hlim_eq] at hprod
      refine hprod.congr'
        ((hτ_pos_ev.and (hτp_Ioo_ev.and (hx₀_u₀.and hz₀_ne_ev))).mono
          fun τ ⟨hτ, hτ_mem, hxu, hz_ne⟩ => ?_)
      have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero p hτ_ne
      have hd_eq : d₀_τ τ = (τ : ℂ) ^ p * z₀_τ τ := by
        dsimp [d₀_τ, z₀_τ]; rw [hxu i.succ, hxu i.castSucc]; ring
      have hd_ne : d₀_τ τ ≠ 0 := hd_eq ▸ mul_ne_zero hτp_ne hz_ne
      have hℓ_sq := (hℓ₀_pos (τ ^ p) hτ_mem i).2.2
      have h2p : (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) = ((τ : ℂ) ^ p) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm]
      dsimp only [pointEdgeSq] at hℓ_sq ⊢
      change (z₀_τ τ) ^ 2 * (1 + ((F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) / d₀_τ τ) ^ 2) =
        ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ * (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p) i) ^ 2
      rw [hℓ_sq, h2p]
      change (z₀_τ τ) ^ 2 * (1 + ((F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) / d₀_τ τ) ^ 2) =
        (((τ : ℂ) ^ p) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((d₀_τ τ) ^ 2 + (F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) ^ 2)
      have h1 : (z₀_τ τ) ^ 2 *
            (1 + ((F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) / d₀_τ τ) ^ 2) =
          (z₀_τ τ) ^ 2 / (d₀_τ τ) ^ 2 *
            ((d₀_τ τ) ^ 2 + (F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.succ) - F (x₀ (τ ^ p) i.castSucc)) ^ 2) := by
        field_simp [hd_ne]
      rw [h1, hd_eq]
      field_simp [hτp_ne, hz_ne]

    
    have hU_unif : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => U_fam τ e r) (fun e => U_lim e r) := by
      intro r
      exact u_add (u_param (hu₀_lim r))
        (u_sum (Finset.Icc 1 L_max)
          (fun m τ e => e ^ m * b_hat m τ r)
          (fun m e => e ^ m * b_lim m r)
          fun m hm => u_mul (u_pow_e m) (u_param (hb_lim m hm r)))
    let Z_fam : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i => U_fam τ e i.succ - U_fam τ e i.castSucc
    have hZ_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => Z_fam τ e i) (fun e => Z_lim e i) :=
      fun i => u_sub (hU_unif i.succ) (hU_unif i.castSucc)
    have hZ_inv_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => (Z_fam τ e i)⁻¹) (fun e => (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) :=
      fun i => u_inv (hZ_unif i) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 7 / (8 * (k : ℝ)))
        (fun e he => (hZ_lim_props e he i).2.1)
    have hx_unif : ∀ r : Fin (k + 1),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => x_τ τ e r) (fun _ => (a : ℂ)) := by
      intro r
      simpa using u_add (u_const (a : ℂ))
        (u_mul (u_param (hτ_pow_zero p (by omega))) (hU_unif r))
    let Δx_τ : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i => x_τ τ e i.succ - x_τ τ e i.castSucc
    have hΔx_eq : ∀ τ e i, Δx_τ τ e i = (τ : ℂ) ^ p * Z_fam τ e i := by
      intro τ e i; dsimp [Δx_τ, x_τ, Z_fam]; ring
    have hΔx_unif : ∀ i : Fin k, PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => Δx_τ τ e i) (fun _ => 0) := by
      intro i
      simpa using u_sub (hx_unif i.succ) (hx_unif i.castSucc)

    have hx_in_ball_ev : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, ∀ e ∈ D,
        (∀ r : Fin (k + 1), x_τ τ e r ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k,
          Δx_τ τ e i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a ∧
          -Δx_τ τ e i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a ∧
          Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0) := by
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, ∀ r : Fin (k + 1), ∀ e ∈ D, x_τ τ e r ∈ Metric.ball (a : ℂ) ρ_a := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro r
        refine (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hx_unif r).1 ρ_a hρ_a_pos).mono fun τ hτ e he => ?_
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
        exact hτ e he
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ τ in φ, ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ e ∈ D,
          Δx_τ τ e i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a ∧
          -Δx_τ τ e i ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_a ∧
          Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro i
        have hd1 := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hΔx_unif i).1 ρ_a hρ_a_pos
        have hd2 := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hZ_unif i).1
          (1 / (4 * (k : ℝ))) (by positivity)
        refine (hd1.and hd2).mono fun τ ⟨ht1, ht2⟩ e he => ?_
        have h_dx : ‖Δx_τ τ e i‖ < ρ_a := by
          have := ht1 e he
          simpa [Complex.dist_eq] using this
        refine ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using h_dx,
          by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using h_dx, ?_⟩
        intro hZ0
        have h_diff := ht2 e he
        rw [Complex.dist_eq, hZ0, sub_zero] at h_diff
        have h_lb := (hZ_lim_props e he i).2.1
        have hk_pos8 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (8 * (k : ℝ)) := by positivity
        have hk_id1 : 1 / (4 * (k : ℝ)) = 2 * (1 / (8 * (k : ℝ))) := by ring
        have hk_id2 : 7 / (8 * (k : ℝ)) = 7 * (1 / (8 * (k : ℝ))) := by ring
        linarith
      exact (h1.and h2).mono fun τ ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ e he =>
        ⟨fun r => ha1 r e he, fun i => ha2 i e he⟩

    
    have hg'_holo : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (g m q)) W :=
      fun m q => (hg_holo m q).deriv hW_open
    have hg'_lt_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)), (q : ℕ) < p →
        ∀ z ∈ W, deriv (g m q) z = 0 := by
      intro m q hqp z hz
      have hev : g m q =ᶠ[nhds z] fun _ => (0 : ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds hz) (hg_lt_p m q hqp)
      simpa using hev.deriv_eq
    have hg_val_unif : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => g m q (x_τ τ e m)) (fun _ => g m q (a : ℂ)) :=
      fun m q => u_comp_pt
        ((hg_holo m q).continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)) (hx_unif m)
    have hg'_val_unif : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m)) (fun _ => deriv (g m q) (a : ℂ)) :=
      fun m q => u_comp_pt
        ((hg'_holo m q).continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds ha_mem)) (hx_unif m)

    have hpJ' : p < J + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hpJ
    let q_p : Fin (J + 1) := ⟨p, hpJ'⟩

    let P_g : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i =>
      ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ *
        ((∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
            (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) *
              (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))) /
          Δx_τ τ e i)
    have hPg_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => P_g τ e i)
          (fun e => e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) := by
      intro i
      let P_term : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun q τ e =>
        if (q : ℕ) < p then 0
        else
          (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) * e ^ (q : ℕ) *
            (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) *
            (Z_fam τ e i)⁻¹
      let P_lim : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun q e =>
        if q = q_p then e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ else 0
      have hterm_unif : ∀ q : Fin (J + 1), PculUnifBdd φ D (P_term q) (P_lim q) := by
        intro q
        by_cases hqp : (q : ℕ) < p
        · have hneq : q ≠ q_p := fun h => by subst h; simp [q_p] at hqp
          simpa [P_term, P_lim, hqp, hneq] using u_const 0
        · by_cases hq_eq : q = q_p
          · subst hq_eq
            have hg_s : g i.succ q_p (a : ℂ) = f_p i.succ := hg_at_p i.succ hpJ'
            have hg_c : g i.castSucc q_p (a : ℂ) = f_p i.castSucc := hg_at_p i.castSucc hpJ'
            have hg_diff_u : PculUnifBdd φ D
                (fun τ e => g i.succ q_p (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q_p (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
                (fun _ => f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) := by
              rw [← hg_s, ← hg_c]
              exact u_sub (hg_val_unif i.succ q_p) (hg_val_unif i.castSucc q_p)
            have hu := u_mul (u_mul (u_pow_e p) hg_diff_u) (hZ_inv_unif i)
            have hPlim_eq : P_lim q_p =
                fun e => e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ := by
              funext e; simp [P_lim]
            rw [hPlim_eq]
            refine u_congr hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
            dsimp [P_term, q_p]
            simp
          · have hgt : p < (q : ℕ) :=
              lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hqp) fun h => hq_eq (Fin.ext h.symm)
            have hexp_ne : 2 * ((q : ℕ) - p) ≠ 0 := by omega
            have hu := u_mul
              (u_mul
                (u_mul (u_param (hτ_pow_zero _ hexp_ne)) (u_pow_e (q : ℕ)))
                (u_sub (hg_val_unif i.succ q) (hg_val_unif i.castSucc q)))
              (hZ_inv_unif i)
            have hlim0 : (fun e : ℂ =>
                (0 : ℂ) * e ^ (q : ℕ) *
                  (g i.succ q (a : ℂ) - g i.castSucc q (a : ℂ)) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) =
                P_lim q := by
              funext e; simp [P_lim, hq_eq]
            rw [hlim0] at hu
            refine u_congr hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
            simp [P_term, hqp]
      have hsum_u := u_sum Finset.univ P_term P_lim (fun q _ => hterm_unif q)
      have hsum_lim_eq : (fun e : ℂ => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), P_lim q e) =
          fun e => e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ := by
        funext e
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q_p]
        · simp [P_lim]
        · intro q _ hq; simp [P_lim, hq]
        · intro h; exact False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ q_p))
      rw [hsum_lim_eq] at hsum_u
      refine u_congr hsum_u ((hτ_pos_ev.and hx_in_ball_ev).mono fun τ ⟨hτ, hball⟩ e he => ?_)
      rcases hball e he with ⟨hxb, hdx_b⟩
      have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero p hτ_ne
      have hZ_ne : Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0 := (hdx_b i).2.2
      dsimp only [P_g]
      rw [hΔx_eq, div_eq_mul_inv, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
      dsimp only [P_term, ε_τ]
      by_cases hqp : (q : ℕ) < p
      · have hs0 : g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) = 0 :=
          hg_lt_p i.succ q hqp _ (hball1_sub_W _ (hxb i.succ))
        have hc0 : g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) = 0 :=
          hg_lt_p i.castSucc q hqp _ (hball1_sub_W _ (hxb i.castSucc))
        simp [hqp, hs0, hc0]
      · simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte]
        have hle : p ≤ (q : ℕ) := not_lt.mp hqp
        have hpow_id : ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e) ^ (q : ℕ) =
            (τ : ℂ) ^ p * (τ : ℂ) ^ p * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) * e ^ (q : ℕ) := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          congr 1
          rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [hpow_id]
        field_simp [hτp_ne, hZ_ne]

    let D_g : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e m =>
      ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m)

        if (q : ℕ) < p then 0
        else (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * (q : ℕ) - p) * e ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m)
      have hterm_u : ∀ q : Fin (J + 1), PculUnifBdd φ D (D_term q) (fun _ => 0) := by
        intro q
        by_cases hqp : (q : ℕ) < p
        · simpa [D_term, hqp] using u_const 0
        · have hexp_ne : 2 * (q : ℕ) - p ≠ 0 := by omega
          have hu := u_mul
            (u_mul (u_param (hτ_pow_zero _ hexp_ne)) (u_pow_e (q : ℕ)))
            (hg'_val_unif m q)
          have h0 : (fun e : ℂ => (0 : ℂ) * e ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) (a : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
            funext e; simp
          rw [h0] at hu
          refine u_congr hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
          simp [D_term, hqp]
      have hsum_u := u_sum Finset.univ D_term (fun _ _ => 0) (fun q _ => hterm_u q)
      have h0 : (fun _ : ℂ => ∑ _q : Fin (J + 1), (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by funext _; simp
      rw [h0] at hsum_u
      refine u_congr hsum_u ((hτ_pos_ev.and hx_in_ball_ev).mono fun τ ⟨hτ, hball⟩ e he => ?_)
      rcases hball e he with ⟨hxb, _⟩
      have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero p hτ_ne
      dsimp only [D_g]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
      dsimp only [D_term, ε_τ]
      by_cases hqp : (q : ℕ) < p
      · have hd0 : deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m) = 0 := hg'_lt_p m q hqp _ (hball1_sub_W _ (hxb m))
        simp [hqp, hd0]
      · simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte]
        have hpow_id : ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e) ^ (q : ℕ) =
            (τ : ℂ) ^ p * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * (q : ℕ) - p) * e ^ (q : ℕ) := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
          congr 1
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
        rw [hpow_id]
        field_simp [hτp_ne]

    let E_var : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i =>
      (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ *
        ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
          if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
            ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ e) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
              (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
          else 0
    have hE_var_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => E_var τ e i)
          (fun e => (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc)) := by
      intro i
      let E_term : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun q τ e =>
        if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
          ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) * e ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
            (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
        else 0
      let E_lim : Fin (J + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun q e =>
        if q = q_p then (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) else 0
      have hterm_u : ∀ q : Fin (J + 1), PculUnifBdd φ D (E_term q) (E_lim q) := by
        intro q
        by_cases hle : p ≤ (q : ℕ)
        · by_cases hq_eq : q = q_p
          · subst hq_eq
            have hg_s : g i.succ q_p (a : ℂ) = f_p i.succ := hg_at_p i.succ hpJ'
            have hg_c : g i.castSucc q_p (a : ℂ) = f_p i.castSucc := hg_at_p i.castSucc hpJ'
            have hg_diff_u : PculUnifBdd φ D
                (fun τ e => g i.succ q_p (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q_p (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
                (fun _ => f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) := by
              rw [← hg_s, ← hg_c]
              exact u_sub (hg_val_unif i.succ q_p) (hg_val_unif i.castSucc q_p)
            have hu := u_mul (u_mul (u_const (p : ℂ)) (u_pow_e (p - 1))) hg_diff_u
            have hElim_eq : E_lim q_p =
                fun e => (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) := by
              funext e; simp [E_lim]
            rw [hElim_eq]
            refine u_congr hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
            dsimp [E_term, q_p]
            simp
          · have hgt : p < (q : ℕ) :=
              lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h => hq_eq (Fin.ext h.symm)
            have hexp_ne : 2 * ((q : ℕ) - p) ≠ 0 := by omega
            have hu := u_mul
              (u_mul
                (u_mul (u_const ((q : ℕ) : ℂ)) (u_param (hτ_pow_zero _ hexp_ne)))
                (u_pow_e ((q : ℕ) - 1)))
              (u_sub (hg_val_unif i.succ q) (hg_val_unif i.castSucc q))
            have h0 : (fun e : ℂ =>
                ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * 0 * e ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                  (g i.succ q (a : ℂ) - g i.castSucc q (a : ℂ))) = E_lim q := by
              funext e; simp [E_lim, hq_eq]
            rw [h0] at hu
            refine u_congr hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
            simp [E_term, hle]
        · have hneq : q ≠ q_p := fun h => by subst h; simp [q_p] at hle
          simpa [E_term, E_lim, hle, hneq] using u_const 0
      have hsum_u := u_sum Finset.univ E_term E_lim (fun q _ => hterm_u q)
      have hsum_lim_eq : (fun e : ℂ => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), E_lim q e) =
          fun e => (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) := by
        funext e
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q_p]
        · simp [E_lim]
        · intro q _ hq; simp [E_lim, hq]
        · intro h; exact False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ q_p))
      rw [hsum_lim_eq] at hsum_u
      refine u_congr hsum_u (hτ_pos_ev.mono fun τ hτ e _ => ?_)
      have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
      have h2p_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hτ_ne
      dsimp only [E_var]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
      dsimp only [E_term, ε_τ]
      split_ifs with hle
      · have hpow_id : (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * (((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1)) =
            (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) * e ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
          congr 2
          omega
        calc ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) * e ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
              (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
            = ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * ((q : ℕ) - p)) *
                e ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1)) * ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) *
              (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) := by
                field_simp [h2p_ne]
          _ = (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ *
              (((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * e) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))) := by
                rw [← hpow_id]; ring
      · simp

    
    let F_pert : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e m z =>
      F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g m q z
    let F'_pert : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun τ e m z =>
      deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) z
    let m_edge : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i =>
      (F_pert τ e i.succ (x_τ τ e i.succ) - F_pert τ e i.castSucc (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) /
        Δx_τ τ e i
    let μ_vtx : ℝ → ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun τ e m => F'_pert τ e m (x_τ τ e m)

    have hμ_defect_va : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (μ_vtx τ e m - (v_a : ℂ)))
          (fun e => r_a * U_lim e m) := by
      intro m
      have hd_u : PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ) (x_τ τ e m))
          (fun _ => r_a) := by
        have hd_a : dslope (deriv F) (a : ℂ) (a : ℂ) = r_a := dslope_same (deriv F) (a : ℂ)
        rw [← hd_a]
        exact u_comp_pt hdslope_F'_cont (hx_unif m)
      have hcomb := u_add (u_mul hd_u (hU_unif m)) (hDg_unif m)
      have hlim_eq : (fun e : ℂ => r_a * U_lim e m + 0) = fun e => r_a * U_lim e m := by
        funext e; ring
      rw [hlim_eq] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb (hτ_pos_ev.mono fun τ hτ e _ => ?_)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
      dsimp only [μ_vtx, F'_pert, D_g]
      have hsub : deriv F (x_τ τ e m) +
            (∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m)) - (v_a : ℂ) =
          (deriv F (x_τ τ e m) - (v_a : ℂ)) +
            ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (g m q) (x_τ τ e m) := by ring
      rw [hsub, hdslope_F'_eq (x_τ τ e m)]
      have hx_sub : x_τ τ e m - (a : ℂ) = (τ : ℂ) ^ p * U_fam τ e m := by dsimp [x_τ]; ring
      rw [hx_sub]
      field_simp [hτp_ne]

    have hdefect_cast : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i - μ_vtx τ e i.castSucc))
          (fun e =>
            (r_a / 2) * Z_lim e i + e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) := by
      intro i
      have hrem_u : PculUnifBdd φ D
          (fun τ e => pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) (Δx_τ τ e i))
          (fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a) := by
        rw [← htaylorRem2_at_zero]
        exact u_comp_pt2 htaylorRem2_cont (hx_unif i.castSucc) (hΔx_unif i)
      have hcomb := u_sub (u_add (u_mul hrem_u (hZ_unif i)) (hPg_unif i)) (hDg_unif i.castSucc)
      have hlim_eq :
          (fun e : ℂ =>
            (1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a * Z_lim e i +
              e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ - 0) =
          fun e =>
            (r_a / 2) * Z_lim e i + e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ := by
        funext e; ring
      rw [hlim_eq] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb ((hτ_pos_ev.and hx_in_ball_ev).mono fun τ ⟨hτ, hball⟩ e he => ?_)
      rcases hball e he with ⟨hxb, hdx_b⟩
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
      have hZ_ne : Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0 := (hdx_b i).2.2
      have hdx_ne : Δx_τ τ e i ≠ 0 := (hΔx_eq τ e i) ▸ mul_ne_zero hτp_ne hZ_ne
      have hadd : x_τ τ e i.castSucc + Δx_τ τ e i = x_τ τ e i.succ := by dsimp [Δx_τ]; ring
      have ht := htaylor2_eq (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) (hxb i.castSucc) (Δx_τ τ e i) (hdx_b i).1
      rw [hadd] at ht
      have hF_diff : F (x_τ τ e i.succ) - F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) =
          Δx_τ τ e i * deriv F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) +
            (Δx_τ τ e i) ^ 2 * pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) (Δx_τ τ e i) := by
        linear_combination ht
      dsimp only [m_edge, μ_vtx, F_pert, F'_pert, P_g, D_g]
      have hnum_split :
          (F (x_τ τ e i.succ) + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ)) -
            (F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) +
              ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) =
          (F (x_τ τ e i.succ) - F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) +
            ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
              (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) *
                (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) := by
        simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        ring
      rw [hnum_split, hF_diff]
      have hdx_val := hΔx_eq τ e i
      field_simp [hτp_ne, hdx_ne]
      linear_combination
        pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) (Δx_τ τ e i) * Δx_τ τ e i * hdx_val.symm

    have hdefect_succ : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i - μ_vtx τ e i.succ))
          (fun e =>
            -(r_a / 2) * Z_lim e i + e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) := by
      intro i
      have hneg_dx : PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => -Δx_τ τ e i) (fun _ => 0) := by
        simpa using u_neg (hΔx_unif i)
      have hrem_u : PculUnifBdd φ D
          (fun τ e => pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.succ) (-Δx_τ τ e i))
          (fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a) := by
        rw [← htaylorRem2_at_zero]
        exact u_comp_pt2 htaylorRem2_cont (hx_unif i.succ) hneg_dx
      have hcomb := u_sub (u_add (u_neg (u_mul hrem_u (hZ_unif i))) (hPg_unif i)) (hDg_unif i.succ)
      have hlim_eq :
          (fun e : ℂ =>
            -((1 / 2 : ℂ) * r_a * Z_lim e i) +
              e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ - 0) =
          fun e =>
            -(r_a / 2) * Z_lim e i + e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ := by
        funext e; ring
      rw [hlim_eq] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb ((hτ_pos_ev.and hx_in_ball_ev).mono fun τ ⟨hτ, hball⟩ e he => ?_)
      rcases hball e he with ⟨hxb, hdx_b⟩
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
      have hZ_ne : Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0 := (hdx_b i).2.2
      have hdx_ne : Δx_τ τ e i ≠ 0 := (hΔx_eq τ e i) ▸ mul_ne_zero hτp_ne hZ_ne
      have hadd : x_τ τ e i.succ + (-Δx_τ τ e i) = x_τ τ e i.castSucc := by dsimp [Δx_τ]; ring
      have ht := htaylor2_eq (x_τ τ e i.succ) (hxb i.succ) (-Δx_τ τ e i) (hdx_b i).2.1
      rw [hadd] at ht
      have hF_diff : F (x_τ τ e i.succ) - F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) =
          Δx_τ τ e i * deriv F (x_τ τ e i.succ) -
            (Δx_τ τ e i) ^ 2 * pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.succ) (-Δx_τ τ e i) := by
        linear_combination -ht
      dsimp only [m_edge, μ_vtx, F_pert, F'_pert, P_g, D_g]
      have hnum_split :
          (F (x_τ τ e i.succ) + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ)) -
            (F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc) +
              ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) * g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) =
          (F (x_τ τ e i.succ) - F (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) +
            ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
              (ε_τ τ e) ^ (q : ℕ) *
                (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) := by
        simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        ring
      rw [hnum_split, hF_diff]
      have hdx_val := hΔx_eq τ e i
      field_simp [hτp_ne, hdx_ne]
      linear_combination
        -pculTaylorRem2 F (x_τ τ e i.succ) (-Δx_τ τ e i) * Δx_τ τ e i * hdx_val.symm

    have hdefect_va : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i - (v_a : ℂ)))
          (fun e =>
            (r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) +
              e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) := by
      intro i
      have hcomb := u_add (hdefect_cast i) (hμ_defect_va i.castSucc)
      have hlim_eq :
          (fun e : ℂ =>
            ((r_a / 2) * Z_lim e i + e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) +
              r_a * U_lim e i.castSucc) =
          fun e =>
            (r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) +
              e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹ := by
        funext e; dsimp [Z_lim]; ring
      rw [hlim_eq] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ e _ => ?_)
      ring

    have hμ_unif : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => μ_vtx τ e m) (fun _ => (v_a : ℂ)) := by
      intro m
      have hcomb := u_add (u_const (v_a : ℂ))
        (u_mul (u_param (hτ_pow_zero p (by omega))) (hμ_defect_va m))
      have h0 : (fun e : ℂ => (v_a : ℂ) + 0 * (r_a * U_lim e m)) = fun _ => (v_a : ℂ) := by
        funext e; ring
      rw [h0] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb (hτ_pos_ev.mono fun τ hτ e _ => ?_)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
      rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hτp_ne]
      ring

    have hm_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => m_edge τ e i) (fun _ => (v_a : ℂ)) := by
      intro i
      have hcomb := u_add (u_const (v_a : ℂ))
        (u_mul (u_param (hτ_pow_zero p (by omega))) (hdefect_va i))
      have h0 : (fun e : ℂ =>
          (v_a : ℂ) + 0 *
            ((r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) +
              e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹)) =
          fun _ => (v_a : ℂ) := by
        funext e; ring
      rw [h0] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb (hτ_pos_ev.mono fun τ hτ e _ => ?_)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero p (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ))
      rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hτp_ne]
      ring

    
    let u_edge : ℝ → ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun τ e i =>
      (pointEdgeSq (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i - (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p) i) ^ 2) / (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p) i) ^ 2
    have hu_edge_unif : ∀ i : Fin k,
        PculUnifBdd φ D (fun τ e => u_edge τ e i)
          (fun e => (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Z_lim e i) ^ 2 - 1) := by
      intro i
      have hinv_base : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => (((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ * (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p) i) ^ 2)⁻¹)
          φ (nhds (((g_a : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) :=
        (hℓ₀_tau_sq_lim i).inv₀ (div_ne_zero hg_a_C_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 hk_ne))
      have hcomb := u_sub
        (u_mul
          (u_mul (u_mul (hZ_unif i) (hZ_unif i))
            (u_add (u_const 1) (u_mul (hm_unif i) (hm_unif i))))
          (u_param hinv_base))
        (u_const 1)
      have hlim_eq :
          (fun e : ℂ =>
            Z_lim e i * Z_lim e i * (1 + (v_a : ℂ) * (v_a : ℂ)) *
                (((g_a : ℂ) / (k : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹) - 1) =
          fun e => (k : ℂ) ^ 2 * (Z_lim e i) ^ 2 - 1 := by
        funext e
        have hga : 1 + (v_a : ℂ) * (v_a : ℂ) = (g_a : ℂ) := by dsimp [g_a]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hga]
        field_simp [hg_a_C_ne, hk_ne]
      rw [hlim_eq] at hcomb
      refine u_congr hcomb
        ((hτ_pos_ev.and (hτp_Ioo_ev.and hx_in_ball_ev)).mono
          fun τ ⟨hτ, hτ_mem, hball⟩ e he => ?_)
      rcases hball e he with ⟨_, hdx_b⟩
      have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
      have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero p hτ_ne
      have h2p_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hτ_ne
      have hZ_ne : Z_fam τ e i ≠ 0 := (hdx_b i).2.2
      have hdx_ne : Δx_τ τ e i ≠ 0 := (hΔx_eq τ e i) ▸ mul_ne_zero hτp_ne hZ_ne
