            (((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i_R - μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ) *
                (((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i_R - μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ))) *
              pculPsiQuadQuot v_a (μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ) (m_edge τ e i_R) =
            ((τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p))⁻¹ *
              (((x_τ τ e i_L.succ - x_τ τ e i_L.castSucc) +
                  (F_pert τ e i_L.succ (x_τ τ e i_L.succ) -
                      F_pert τ e i_L.castSucc (x_τ τ e i_L.castSucc)) *
                    μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ) /
                pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i_L -
              ((x_τ τ e i_R.succ - x_τ τ e i_R.castSucc) +
                  (F_pert τ e i_R.succ (x_τ τ e i_R.succ) -
                      F_pert τ e i_R.castSucc (x_τ τ e i_R.castSucc)) *
                    μ_vtx τ e i_R.castSucc) /
                pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i_R)
          rw [hLL_eq, hLR_eq]
          have hfracL_eq :
              ((x_τ τ e i_L.succ - x_τ τ e i_L.castSucc) +
                  (F_pert τ e i_L.succ (x_τ τ e i_L.succ) -
                      F_pert τ e i_L.castSucc (x_τ τ e i_L.castSucc)) *
                    μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ) /
                (Δx_τ τ e i_L * pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_L)) =
              (1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_L) /
                pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_L) := by
            dsimp only [m_edge, Δx_τ] at hdxL_ne ⊢
            field_simp [hdxL_ne, hσL_ne]
          have hfracR_eq :
              ((x_τ τ e i_R.succ - x_τ τ e i_R.castSucc) +
                  (F_pert τ e i_R.succ (x_τ τ e i_R.succ) -
                      F_pert τ e i_R.castSucc (x_τ τ e i_R.castSucc)) *
                    μ_vtx τ e i_R.castSucc) /
                (Δx_τ τ e i_R * pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_R)) =
              (1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_R) /
                pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_R) := by
            have hμ_eq : μ_vtx τ e i_R.castSucc = μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ := by rw [h_shared]
            rw [hμ_eq]
            dsimp only [m_edge, Δx_τ] at hdxR_ne ⊢
            field_simp [hdxR_ne, hσR_ne]
          rw [hfracL_eq, hfracR_eq, h2p]
          have hsub_psi :
              (1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_L) /
                  pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_L) -
                (1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_R) /
                  pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_R) =
              ((1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_L) /
                  pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_L) -
                pculSlopeSpeed v_a (μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ)) -
              ((1 + μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ * m_edge τ e i_R) /
                  pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i_R) -
                pculSlopeSpeed v_a (μ_vtx τ e i_L.succ)) := by ring
          rw [hsub_psi, hqL, hqR]
          field_simp [hτp_ne]
          ring

    
    · intro F_term2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        refine hev_master.mono fun τ ⟨_, hF_d, hL_d, hpt⟩ e he => ?_
        have hsum_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun z =>
              ∑ i : Fin k,
                ((F_pert τ z i.succ (x_τ τ z i.succ) -
                    F_pert τ z i.castSucc (x_τ τ z i.castSucc)) /
                  pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ z) (x_τ τ z) i) *
                ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
                  if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
                    ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ z) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                      (g i.succ q (x_τ τ z i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ z i.castSucc))
                  else 0) D := by
          intro z hz
          refine (h_diff_sum Finset.univ
            (fun i w =>
              ((F_pert τ w i.succ (x_τ τ w i.succ) -
                  F_pert τ w i.castSucc (x_τ τ w i.castSucc)) /
                pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ w) (x_τ τ w) i) *
              ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
                if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
                  ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ w) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                    (g i.succ q (x_τ τ w i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ w i.castSucc))
                else 0)
            fun i _ => ?_).differentiableWithinAt
          have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun w =>
                ((F_pert τ w i.succ (x_τ τ w i.succ) -
                    F_pert τ w i.castSucc (x_τ τ w i.castSucc)) /
                  pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ w) (x_τ τ w) i) *
                ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
                  if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
                    ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ w) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                      (g i.succ q (x_τ τ w i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ w i.castSucc))
                  else 0) D :=
            (((hF_d i.succ).1.sub (hF_d i.castSucc).1).div (hL_d i).1
              (fun w hw => ((hpt w hw).2 i).2.2.1)).mul (hL_d i).2
          exact h1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
        exact (hsum_d.const_mul ((τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p))⁻¹)) e he
      · 
        have hgamma_edge_u : ∀ i : Fin k,
            PculUnifBdd φ D
              (fun τ e => pculGammaQuot v_a (m_edge τ e i) (v_a : ℂ))
              (fun _ => g_a_pow⁻¹) := by
          intro i
          rw [← hgamma_quot_va]
          exact u_comp_pt2 hgamma_quot_cont (hm_unif i) (u_const (v_a : ℂ))
        have hcomb := u_sum Finset.univ
          (fun i τ e =>
            ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i - (v_a : ℂ)) *
              pculGammaQuot v_a (m_edge τ e i) (v_a : ℂ) * E_var τ e i)
          (fun i e =>
            ((r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) +
                e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) *
              g_a_pow⁻¹ *
              ((p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc)))
          fun i _ => u_mul (u_mul (hdefect_va i) (hgamma_edge_u i)) (hE_var_unif i)
        have h_unif := (u_congr (B := F_term2) hcomb
          (hev_master.mono fun τ ⟨hτ, _, _, hpt⟩ e he => ?_)).1
        · refine h_unif.congr_right fun e _ => ?_
          have hsbp :
              (∑ i : Fin k,
                (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) +
                ∑ i : Fin k,
                  (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) * Z_lim e i) = 0 := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            have h_id :
                (∑ i : Fin k,
                  ((U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) +
                    (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) * Z_lim e i)) =
                2 * ∑ i : Fin k, (U_lim e i.succ * f_p i.succ - U_lim e i.castSucc * f_p i.castSucc) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
              dsimp [Z_lim]; ring
            rw [h_id, h_fin_telescope k (fun m => U_lim e m * f_p m), hf_end.1, hf_end.2]
            ring
          have hsum1 :
              (∑ i : Fin k,
                (r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) *
                  (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc)) =
              ∑ i : Fin k, -(r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i := by
            have hlin := congr_arg (fun w => (r_a / 2) * w) hsbp
            simp only [mul_add, mul_zero, Finset.mul_sum] at hlin
            have hA :
                (∑ i : Fin k,
                  (r_a / 2) *
                    ((U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc))) =
                ∑ i : Fin k,
                  (r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) *
                    (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
            have hB :
                (∑ i : Fin k, (r_a / 2) * ((f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) * Z_lim e i)) =
                ∑ i : Fin k, (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i :=
              Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
            rw [hA, hB] at hlin
            have hneg :
                -(∑ i : Fin k, (r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i) =
                ∑ i : Fin k, -(r_a * (f_p i.succ + f_p i.castSucc) / 2) * Z_lim e i := by
              rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
              exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => by ring
            linear_combination hlin + hneg
          have hrew :
              (∑ i : Fin k,
                ((r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) +
                    e ^ p * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) *
                  g_a_pow⁻¹ *
                  ((p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) * (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc))) =
              g_a_pow⁻¹ * (p : ℂ) * e ^ (p - 1) *
                ((∑ i : Fin k,
                    (r_a / 2) * (U_lim e i.succ + U_lim e i.castSucc) *
                      (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc)) +
                  ∑ i : Fin k,
                    (f_p i.succ - f_p i.castSucc) ^ 2 * e ^ p * (Z_lim e i)⁻¹) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            ring
          dsimp only
          rw [hrew, hsum1, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        · rcases hpt e he with ⟨_, hm_pt⟩
          have hτ_ne : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hτ)
          have hτp_ne : (τ : ℂ) ^ p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero p hτ_ne
          have h3p : (τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p) = (τ : ℂ) ^ p * (τ : ℂ) ^ (2 * p) := by
            rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
          have hva_ball : (v_a : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (v_a : ℂ) ρ_m := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_m_pos
          have h_tel_zero :
              (∑ i : Fin k, ((v_a : ℂ) / (s_a : ℂ)) * E_var τ e i) = 0 := by
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
            dsimp only [E_var]
            rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm]
            have hinner :
                (∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
                  ∑ i : Fin k,
                    if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
                      ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ e) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                        (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
                    else 0) = 0 := by
              apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
              intro q _
              by_cases hle : p ≤ (q : ℕ)
              · simp only [hle, ↓reduceIte, ← Finset.mul_sum]
                rw [h_fin_telescope k (fun m => g m q (x_τ τ e m)),
                  (hg_end q _).1, (hg_end q _).2, sub_zero, mul_zero]
              · simp [hle]
            rw [hinner, mul_zero, mul_zero]
          dsimp only [F_term2, pointCoalescingTermII]
          have hF_split :
              (τ : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((τ : ℂ) ^ (3 * p))⁻¹ *
                (∑ i : Fin k,
                  ((F_pert τ e i.succ (x_τ τ e i.succ) -
                      F_pert τ e i.castSucc (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) /
                    pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i) *
                  ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
                    if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then
                      ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * (ε_τ τ e) ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
                        (g i.succ q (x_τ τ e i.succ) - g i.castSucc q (x_τ τ e i.castSucc))
                    else 0) =
              ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin k,
                ((F_pert τ e i.succ (x_τ τ e i.succ) -
                    F_pert τ e i.castSucc (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) /
                  pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i) * E_var τ e i := by
            rw [h3p, _root_.mul_inv_rev, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            dsimp only [E_var]
            ring
          change (∑ i : Fin k,
              ((τ : ℂ) ^ p)⁻¹ * (m_edge τ e i - (v_a : ℂ)) *
                pculGammaQuot v_a (m_edge τ e i) (v_a : ℂ) * E_var τ e i) = _
          rw [hF_split]
          have hsum_rw :
              (∑ i : Fin k,
                ((F_pert τ e i.succ (x_τ τ e i.succ) -
                    F_pert τ e i.castSucc (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) /
                  pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i) * E_var τ e i) =
              (∑ i : Fin k, ((v_a : ℂ) / (s_a : ℂ)) * E_var τ e i) +
                ∑ i : Fin k,
                  (m_edge τ e i - (v_a : ℂ)) *
                    pculGammaQuot v_a (m_edge τ e i) (v_a : ℂ) * E_var τ e i := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            rcases hm_pt i with ⟨hdx_ne, hm_b, _, hL_eq⟩
            have hσ_ne : pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i) ≠ 0 := (hσ_props _ hm_b).2.1
            have hdiv :
                (F_pert τ e i.succ (x_τ τ e i.succ) -
                    F_pert τ e i.castSucc (x_τ τ e i.castSucc)) /
                  pointRelEdgeLen (ℓ₀ (τ ^ p)) (F_pert τ e) (x_τ τ e) i =
                m_edge τ e i / pculSlopeSpeed v_a (m_edge τ e i) := by
              rw [hL_eq]
              dsimp only [m_edge, Δx_τ] at hdx_ne ⊢
              field_simp [hdx_ne, hσ_ne]
            have hgq := hgamma_quot_eq (m_edge τ e i) hm_b (v_a : ℂ) hva_ball
            rw [hσ_at_va] at hgq
            rw [hdiv]
            linear_combination E_var τ e i * hgq
          rw [hsum_rw, h_tel_zero, zero_add, Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          ring

point_coalescing_uniform_limits.definitions:
noncomputable def pculTaylorRem2 (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z d : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1 - t : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv (deriv F) (z + (t : ℂ) * d)

noncomputable def pculSlopeSpeed (v_a : ℝ) (m : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sqrt (1 + v_a ^ 2) : ℂ) *
    sqrt1p ((m ^ 2 - (v_a : ℂ) ^ 2) / ((1 + v_a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

noncomputable def pculGammaQuot (v_a : ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let σ₁ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₁
  let σ₂ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m₂
  (1 - m₁ * m₂ + σ₁ * σ₂) / (σ₁ * σ₂ * (σ₁ + σ₂))

noncomputable def pculPsiQuadQuot (v_a : ℝ) (μ m : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let σ_m := pculSlopeSpeed v_a m
  let σ_μ := pculSlopeSpeed v_a μ
  (σ_m * (1 + μ * m + σ_m * σ_μ))⁻¹

def PculUnifBdd (φ : Filter ℝ) (D : Set ℂ) (F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  TendstoUniformlyOn F f φ D ∧ ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ e ∈ D, ‖f e‖ ≤ M

informal_problem.statement:
(k p J : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (a : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (f_p : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ)
    (M : PointTruncatedCoalescingModel k p J a F f_p)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : δ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) M.δ₀) :
    (∀ (l : ℕ) (_hl1 : 1 ≤ l) (_hlJ : l ≤ J) (r : Fin (k - 1)),
      (l.factorial : ℂ) *
          ((pointInteriorHess (M.ℓ₀ δ) F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) (M.x₀ δ)).mulVec
            (fun s : Fin (k - 1) =>
              M.β ⟨l, by omega⟩ δ ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩) r) +
        iteratedDeriv l
          (fun ε : ℂ =>
            pointRelInteriorGrad (M.ℓ₀ δ)
              (fun m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q z)
              (fun m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) z)
              (fun m =>
                M.x₀ δ m +
                  ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => (q : ℕ) < l),
                    ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.β q δ m)
              r)
          0 = 0) ∧
    (∀ l : Fin (J + 1), 1 ≤ (l : ℕ) →
      iteratedDeriv ((l : ℕ) - 1)
        (fun ε : ℂ =>
          pointCoalescingTermII p (M.ℓ₀ δ) F M.g
            (fun m => M.x₀ δ m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.β q δ m)
            ε)
        0 =
      ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) * (M.U_split l (a : ℂ) + M.V_split l ((a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ))))

by
  let W : Set ℂ := M.W_n
  have hW_open : IsOpen W := M.W_n_open
  let x_base : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := M.x₀ δ
  let ℓ_base : Fin k → ℂ := M.ℓ₀ δ
  let β_vec : Fin (J + 1) → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun q m => M.β q δ m
  have hx_mem : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), x_base m ∈ W := (M.x₀_maps_W_n δ hδ).2
  have hℓ_sq : ∀ i : Fin k, (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 = pointEdgeSq (fun _ => F) x_base i :=
    fun i => (M.ℓ₀_pos δ hδ i).2.2
  have hℓ_ne : ∀ i : Fin k, ℓ_base i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i h0
    have hre : 0 < (ℓ_base i).re := (M.ℓ₀_pos δ hδ i).1
    rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
  have hg_lt_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)), (q : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W, M.g m q z = 0 :=
    M.g_lt_p
  have hg'_lt_p : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
      (q : ℕ) < p → ∀ z ∈ W, deriv (M.g m q) z = 0 := by
    intro m q hqp z hz
    have hev : M.g m q =ᶠ[nhds z] fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds hz) fun w hw => hg_lt_p m q hqp w hw
    simpa using hev.deriv_eq
  have h0_lt_p : ((0 : Fin (J + 1)) : ℕ) < p := by simp; omega
  have hg_zero : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W, M.g m 0 z = 0 :=
    fun m z hz => hg_lt_p m 0 h0_lt_p z hz
  have hg'_zero : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)), ∀ z ∈ W, deriv (M.g m 0) z = 0 :=
    fun m z hz => hg'_lt_p m 0 h0_lt_p z hz
  have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F W := M.F_holo
  have hF'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv F) W := hF_holo.deriv hW_open
  have hF''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv F)) W := hF'_holo.deriv hW_open
  have hg_holo : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)), DifferentiableOn ℂ (M.g m q) W :=
    M.g_holo
  have hg'_holo : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (M.g m q)) W :=
    fun m q => (hg_holo m q).deriv hW_open
  have hβ_zero : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), β_vec 0 m = 0 := M.β_zero δ
  have hβ_end : ∀ q : Fin (J + 1), β_vec q 0 = 0 ∧ β_vec q (Fin.last k) = 0 :=
    fun q => M.β_endpoints q δ

  let B_half : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2)
  have hB_half_open : IsOpen B_half := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have h0_B_half : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B_half := Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num)
  have h_sqrt1p_zero : sqrt1p 0 = 1 := by simp [sqrt1p]
  have h_sqrt1p_ne : ∀ u : ℂ, sqrt1p u ≠ 0 := fun _ => Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have h_sqrt1p_deriv : ∀ u ∈ B_half, HasDerivAt sqrt1p ((2 * sqrt1p u)⁻¹) u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hu
    have hre : 0 < (1 + u).re := by
      have habs : |u.re| ≤ ‖u‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm u
      have h1 : -‖u‖ ≤ u.re := (abs_le.mp habs).1
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have hslit : 1 + u ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hre)
    have h1u_ne : 1 + u ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hslit
    have hsq : (sqrt1p u) ^ 2 = 1 + u := by
      dsimp only [sqrt1p]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add, add_halves, Complex.exp_log h1u_ne]
    have hd_add : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => 1 + z) 1 u :=
      (hasDerivAt_id u).const_add (1 : ℂ)
    have hd_log : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.log (1 + z) / 2) ((1 / (1 + u)) / 2) u :=
      (hd_add.clog hslit).div_const 2
    have hd_exp : HasDerivAt sqrt1p (sqrt1p u * ((1 / (1 + u)) / 2)) u := hd_log.cexp
    convert hd_exp using 1
    rw [← hsq]
    field_simp [h_sqrt1p_ne u]
  have h_sqrt1p_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ sqrt1p B_half :=
    fun u hu => (h_sqrt1p_deriv u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have h_sqrt1p_deriv0 : deriv sqrt1p 0 = (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
    simpa [h_sqrt1p_zero] using (h_sqrt1p_deriv 0 h0_B_half).deriv

  let F_pert : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun ε m z => F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q z
  let F'_pert : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun ε m z => deriv F z + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) z
  let x_full : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ :=
    fun ε m => x_base m + ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m

  have hF_pert_zero : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), ∀ z ∈ W, F_pert 0 m z = F z := by
    intro m z hz
    dsimp only [F_pert]
    suffices hsum : (∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (0 : ℂ) ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q z) = 0 by simp [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro q _
    by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
    · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
      rw [hq, hg_zero m z hz, mul_zero]
    · rw [zero_pow hq0, zero_mul]
  have hF'_pert_zero : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), ∀ z ∈ W, F'_pert 0 m z = deriv F z := by
    intro m z hz
    dsimp only [F'_pert]
    suffices hsum : (∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (0 : ℂ) ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) z) = 0 by simp [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro q _
    by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
    · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
      rw [hq, hg'_zero m z hz, mul_zero]
    · rw [zero_pow hq0, zero_mul]
  have hx_full_zero : x_full 0 = x_base := by
    funext m
    dsimp only [x_full]
    suffices hsum : (∑ q : Fin (J + 1), (0 : ℂ) ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m) = 0 by simp [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro q _
    by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
    · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
      rw [hq, hβ_zero m, mul_zero]
    · rw [zero_pow hq0, zero_mul]
  have hx_full_diff : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), Differentiable ℂ (fun ε => x_full ε m) := by
    intro m
    exact (differentiable_const (x_base m)).add
      (Differentiable.fun_sum fun q _ => (differentiable_id.pow (q : ℕ)).mul_const (β_vec q m))

  have hEdgeSq_at0 : ∀ {x_fn : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}, x_fn 0 = x_base →
      ∀ i : Fin k, pointEdgeSq (F_pert 0) (x_fn 0) i = (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 := by
    intro x_fn hx0 i
    rw [hx0, hℓ_sq i]
    simp only [pointEdgeSq, hF_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _)]
  have hEdgeLen_at0 : ∀ {x_fn : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ}, x_fn 0 = x_base →
      ∀ i : Fin k, pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert 0) (x_fn 0) i = ℓ_base i := by
    intro x_fn hx0 i
    simp only [pointRelEdgeLen, hEdgeSq_at0 hx0 i, sub_self, zero_div, h_sqrt1p_zero, mul_one]
  have hEdgeLen_base : ∀ i : Fin k, pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (fun _ => F) x_base i = ℓ_base i := by
    intro i
    simp only [pointRelEdgeLen, ← hℓ_sq i, sub_self, zero_div, h_sqrt1p_zero, mul_one]
  have hEdgeLen_ne : ∀ (ε : ℂ) (x_vec : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin k),
      pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) x_vec i ≠ 0 :=
    fun _ _ i => mul_ne_zero (hℓ_ne i) (h_sqrt1p_ne _)

  have h_germ_ev : ∀ (x_fn : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ),
      (∀ m : Fin (k + 1), Differentiable ℂ (fun ε => x_fn ε m)) →
      x_fn 0 = x_base →
      ∀ᶠ ε in nhds (0 : ℂ),
        (∀ m : Fin (k + 1), x_fn ε m ∈ W) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin k,
          (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_fn ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈ B_half) := by
    intro x_fn hx_diff hx0
    have hx_ev : ∀ᶠ ε in nhds (0 : ℂ), ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), x_fn ε m ∈ W := by
      refine Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun m => ?_
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun ε => x_fn ε m) 0 := (hx_diff m).continuous.continuousAt
      have hm0 : x_fn 0 m ∈ W := by rw [hx0]; exact hx_mem m
      exact hcont.eventually (hW_open.mem_nhds hm0)
    have hY_cont : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), ContinuousAt (fun ε => F_pert ε m (x_fn ε m)) 0 := by
      intro m
      have hx_c : ContinuousAt (fun ε => x_fn ε m) 0 := (hx_diff m).continuous.continuousAt
      have hF_c : ContinuousAt F (x_fn 0 m) := by
        rw [hx0]
        exact hF_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds (hx_mem m))
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun ε => F (x_fn ε m)) 0 := ContinuousAt.comp hF_c hx_c
      have h_cont_sum : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (J + 1)),
          ContinuousAt (fun ε => ∑ q ∈ s, ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_fn ε m)) 0 := by
        intro s
        classical
        induction s using Finset.induction_on with
        | empty => simpa using continuousAt_const
        | @insert q s hq ih =>
            have hg_c : ContinuousAt (M.g m q) (x_fn 0 m) := by
              rw [hx0]
              exact (hg_holo m q).continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds (hx_mem m))
            have hq_c : ContinuousAt (fun ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_fn ε m)) 0 :=
              (continuous_pow (q : ℕ) |>.continuousAt).mul (ContinuousAt.comp hg_c hx_c)
            have h_eq : (fun ε => ∑ j ∈ insert q s, ε ^ (j : ℕ) * M.g m j (x_fn ε m)) =
                fun ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_fn ε m) +
                  ∑ j ∈ s, ε ^ (j : ℕ) * M.g m j (x_fn ε m) :=
              funext fun _ => Finset.sum_insert hq
            rw [h_eq]
            exact hq_c.add ih
      exact h1.add (h_cont_sum Finset.univ)
    have hu_ev : ∀ᶠ ε in nhds (0 : ℂ), ∀ i : Fin k,
        (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_fn ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈ B_half := by
      refine Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => ?_
      have hdx_c : ContinuousAt (fun ε => (x_fn ε i.succ - x_fn ε i.castSucc) ^ 2) 0 :=
        (((hx_diff i.succ).continuous.continuousAt.sub
          (hx_diff i.castSucc).continuous.continuousAt).pow 2)
      have hdy_c : ContinuousAt
          (fun ε => (F_pert ε i.succ (x_fn ε i.succ) -
            F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_fn ε i.castSucc)) ^ 2) 0 :=
        ((hY_cont i.succ).sub (hY_cont i.castSucc)).pow 2
      have hu_c : ContinuousAt
          (fun ε => (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_fn ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) 0 :=
        ((hdx_c.add hdy_c).sub continuousAt_const).div_const _
      have hu0 : (pointEdgeSq (F_pert 0) (x_fn 0) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈ B_half := by
        simpa [hEdgeSq_at0 hx0 i] using h0_B_half
      exact hu_c.eventually (hB_half_open.mem_nhds hu0)
    exact hx_ev.and hu_ev

  have h_id_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (d : ℕ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, AnalyticAt ℂ (f i) 0) →
      (AnalyticAt ℂ (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ε) 0 ∧
        iteratedDeriv d (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ε) 0 = ∑ i ∈ s, iteratedDeriv d (f i) 0) := by
    intro ι s f d hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        refine ⟨analyticAt_const, ?_⟩
        simp
    | @insert b s hb ih =>
        have hb_an : AnalyticAt ℂ (f b) 0 := hf b (Finset.mem_insert_self b s)
        have hs := ih fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
        have h_eq : (fun ε => ∑ i ∈ insert b s, f i ε) = (f b + fun ε => ∑ i ∈ s, f i ε) :=
          funext fun ε => Finset.sum_insert hb
        rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_insert hb]
        exact ⟨hb_an.add hs.1,
          (iteratedDeriv_add hb_an.contDiffAt hs.1.contDiffAt).trans (by rw [hs.2])⟩

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro l hl1 hlJ r
    let x_lt : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ :=
      fun ε m =>
        x_base m +
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => (q : ℕ) < l),
            ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m
    have hx_lt_zero : x_lt 0 = x_base := by
      funext m
      dsimp only [x_lt]
      suffices hsum :
          (∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => (q : ℕ) < l),
            (0 : ℂ) ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m) = 0 by simp [hsum]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro q _
      by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
      · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
        rw [hq, hβ_zero m, mul_zero]
      · rw [zero_pow hq0, zero_mul]
    have hx_lt_diff : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), Differentiable ℂ (fun ε => x_lt ε m) := by
      intro m
      exact (differentiable_const (x_base m)).add
        (Differentiable.fun_sum fun q _ => (differentiable_id.pow (q : ℕ)).mul_const (β_vec q m))

    obtain ⟨η, hη, hU₀_spec⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      ((h_germ_ev x_full hx_full_diff hx_full_zero).and
        (h_germ_ev x_lt hx_lt_diff hx_lt_zero))
    let U₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) η
    have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h0_U₀ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hη
    have hU₀_nhds : U₀ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := hU₀_open.mem_nhds h0_U₀

    let JetDiff : (ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ → Prop := fun A B c =>
      DifferentiableOn ℂ A U₀ ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ B U₀ ∧
      ∃ Ψ : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ U₀ ∧
        ∀ ε ∈ U₀, A ε - B ε = c * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * Ψ ε

    have jd_eq0 : ∀ {A B : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ}, JetDiff A B c → A 0 = B 0 := by
      rintro A B c ⟨_, _, Ψ, _, hΨ⟩
      have h0 := hΨ 0 h0_U₀
      rw [zero_pow (by omega : l ≠ 0), zero_pow (by omega : l + 1 ≠ 0),
        mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at h0
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    have jd_refl : ∀ {A : ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ A U₀ → JetDiff A A 0 := by
      intro A hA
      exact ⟨hA, hA, fun _ => 0, differentiableOn_const 0, fun ε _ => by simp⟩
    have jd_zero_both : ∀ {A B : ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ ε ∈ U₀, A ε = 0) → (∀ ε ∈ U₀, B ε = 0) → JetDiff A B 0 := by
      intro A B hA0 hB0
      refine ⟨(differentiableOn_const 0).congr (fun ε hε => hA0 ε hε),
        (differentiableOn_const 0).congr (fun ε hε => hB0 ε hε),
        fun _ => 0, differentiableOn_const 0, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      simp [hA0 ε hε, hB0 ε hε]
    have jd_add : ∀ {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {c₁ c₂ : ℂ},
        JetDiff A₁ B₁ c₁ → JetDiff A₂ B₂ c₂ →
        JetDiff (fun ε => A₁ ε + A₂ ε) (fun ε => B₁ ε + B₂ ε) (c₁ + c₂) := by
      rintro A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ c₁ c₂ ⟨hA₁, hB₁, Ψ₁, hΨ₁, heq₁⟩ ⟨hA₂, hB₂, Ψ₂, hΨ₂, heq₂⟩
      refine ⟨hA₁.add hA₂, hB₁.add hB₂, fun ε => Ψ₁ ε + Ψ₂ ε, hΨ₁.add hΨ₂, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      linear_combination heq₁ ε hε + heq₂ ε hε
    have jd_sub : ∀ {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {c₁ c₂ : ℂ},
        JetDiff A₁ B₁ c₁ → JetDiff A₂ B₂ c₂ →
        JetDiff (fun ε => A₁ ε - A₂ ε) (fun ε => B₁ ε - B₂ ε) (c₁ - c₂) := by
      rintro A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ c₁ c₂ ⟨hA₁, hB₁, Ψ₁, hΨ₁, heq₁⟩ ⟨hA₂, hB₂, Ψ₂, hΨ₂, heq₂⟩
      refine ⟨hA₁.sub hA₂, hB₁.sub hB₂, fun ε => Ψ₁ ε - Ψ₂ ε, hΨ₁.sub hΨ₂, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      linear_combination heq₁ ε hε - heq₂ ε hε
    have jd_const_mul : ∀ (k₀ : ℂ) {A B : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ},
        JetDiff A B c → JetDiff (fun ε => k₀ * A ε) (fun ε => k₀ * B ε) (k₀ * c) := by
      rintro k₀ A B c ⟨hA, hB, Ψ, hΨ, heq⟩
      refine ⟨hA.const_mul k₀, hB.const_mul k₀, fun ε => k₀ * Ψ ε, hΨ.const_mul k₀,
        fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      linear_combination k₀ * heq ε hε
    have jd_sum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (A B : ι → ℂ → ℂ) (c : ι → ℂ),
        (∀ q ∈ s, JetDiff (A q) (B q) (c q)) →
        JetDiff (fun ε => ∑ q ∈ s, A q ε) (fun ε => ∑ q ∈ s, B q ε) (∑ q ∈ s, c q) := by
      intro ι s A B c hq
      classical
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simpa using jd_refl (differentiableOn_const 0)
      | @insert b s hb ih =>
          have hA_eq : (fun ε => ∑ q ∈ insert b s, A q ε) =
              fun ε => A b ε + ∑ q ∈ s, A q ε := funext fun _ => Finset.sum_insert hb
          have hB_eq : (fun ε => ∑ q ∈ insert b s, B q ε) =
              fun ε => B b ε + ∑ q ∈ s, B q ε := funext fun _ => Finset.sum_insert hb
          rw [hA_eq, hB_eq, Finset.sum_insert hb]
          exact jd_add (hq b (Finset.mem_insert_self b s))
            (ih fun q hqs => hq q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hqs))
    have jd_mul : ∀ {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {c₁ c₂ : ℂ},
        JetDiff A₁ B₁ c₁ → JetDiff A₂ B₂ c₂ →
        JetDiff (fun ε => A₁ ε * A₂ ε) (fun ε => B₁ ε * B₂ ε) (c₁ * B₂ 0 + B₁ 0 * c₂) := by
      rintro A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ c₁ c₂ ⟨hA₁, hB₁, Ψ₁, hΨ₁, heq₁⟩ ⟨hA₂, hB₂, Ψ₂, hΨ₂, heq₂⟩
      let D₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope B₁ 0
      let D₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope B₂ 0
      have hD₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ D₁ U₀ := (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hU₀_nhds).mpr hB₁
      have hD₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ D₂ U₀ := (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hU₀_nhds).mpr hB₂
      let R₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => c₁ + ε * Ψ₁ ε
      let R₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => c₂ + ε * Ψ₂ ε
      have hR₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ R₁ U₀ :=
        (differentiableOn_const c₁).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hΨ₁)
      have hR₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ R₂ U₀ :=
        (differentiableOn_const c₂).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hΨ₂)
      refine ⟨hA₁.mul hA₂, hB₁.mul hB₂,
        fun ε => Ψ₁ ε * B₂ 0 + R₁ ε * D₂ ε + B₁ 0 * Ψ₂ ε + D₁ ε * R₂ ε +
          ε ^ (l - 1) * (R₁ ε * R₂ ε),
        ((((hΨ₁.mul_const (B₂ 0)).add (hR₁.mul hD₂)).add (hΨ₂.const_mul (B₁ 0))).add
          (hD₁.mul hR₂)).add ((differentiableOn_id.pow (l - 1)).mul (hR₁.mul hR₂)),
        fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      have hB₁_eq : B₁ ε = B₁ 0 + ε * D₁ ε := by
        have hs := sub_smul_dslope B₁ 0 ε
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hs
        linear_combination -hs
      have hB₂_eq : B₂ ε = B₂ 0 + ε * D₂ ε := by
        have hs := sub_smul_dslope B₂ 0 ε
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hs
        linear_combination -hs
      have hA₁_eq : A₁ ε = (B₁ 0 + ε * D₁ ε) + ε ^ l * R₁ ε := by
        have h1 := heq₁ ε hε
        dsimp only [R₁]
        rw [pow_succ ε l] at h1
        linear_combination h1 + hB₁_eq
      have hA₂_eq : A₂ ε = (B₂ 0 + ε * D₂ ε) + ε ^ l * R₂ ε := by
        have h2 := heq₂ ε hε
        dsimp only [R₂]
        rw [pow_succ ε l] at h2
        linear_combination h2 + hB₂_eq
      have hpow2 : ε ^ l * ε ^ l = ε ^ (l + 1) * ε ^ (l - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
        congr 1
        omega
      calc A₁ ε * A₂ ε - B₁ ε * B₂ ε
          = ((B₁ 0 + ε * D₁ ε) + ε ^ l * R₁ ε) * ((B₂ 0 + ε * D₂ ε) + ε ^ l * R₂ ε) -
              (B₁ 0 + ε * D₁ ε) * (B₂ 0 + ε * D₂ ε) := by
              rw [hA₁_eq, hA₂_eq, ← hB₁_eq, ← hB₂_eq]
        _ = ε ^ l * (R₁ ε * (B₂ 0 + ε * D₂ ε) + (B₁ 0 + ε * D₁ ε) * R₂ ε) +
              (ε ^ l * ε ^ l) * (R₁ ε * R₂ ε) := by ring
        _ = (c₁ * B₂ 0 + B₁ 0 * c₂) * ε ^ l +
              ε ^ (l + 1) *
                (Ψ₁ ε * B₂ 0 + R₁ ε * D₂ ε + B₁ 0 * Ψ₂ ε + D₁ ε * R₂ ε +
                  ε ^ (l - 1) * (R₁ ε * R₂ ε)) := by
              rw [hpow2, pow_succ ε l]
              dsimp only [R₁, R₂]
              ring
    have jd_inv : ∀ {A B : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ},
        JetDiff A B c → (∀ ε ∈ U₀, A ε ≠ 0 ∧ B ε ≠ 0) →
        JetDiff (fun ε => (A ε)⁻¹) (fun ε => (B ε)⁻¹) (-c / (B 0) ^ 2) := by
      rintro A B c hAB hne
      have hAB0 : A 0 = B 0 := jd_eq0 hAB
      rcases hAB with ⟨hA, hB, Ψ, hΨ, heq⟩
      have hA_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => (A ε)⁻¹) U₀ :=
        hA.inv fun ε hε => (hne ε hε).1
      have hB_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => (B ε)⁻¹) U₀ :=
        hB.inv fun ε hε => (hne ε hε).2
      let Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => (A ε)⁻¹ * (B ε)⁻¹
      have hQ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q U₀ := hA_inv.mul hB_inv
      let D_Q : ℂ → ℂ := dslope Q 0
      have hDQ : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_Q U₀ := (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hU₀_nhds).mpr hQ
      refine ⟨hA_inv, hB_inv, fun ε => -c * D_Q ε - Ψ ε * Q ε,
        (hDQ.const_mul (-c)).sub (hΨ.mul hQ), fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      have hA_ne : A ε ≠ 0 := (hne ε hε).1
      have hB_ne : B ε ≠ 0 := (hne ε hε).2
      have hB0_ne : B 0 ≠ 0 := (hne 0 h0_U₀).2
      have hdiff : (A ε)⁻¹ - (B ε)⁻¹ = -(A ε - B ε) * Q ε := by
        dsimp only [Q]
        field_simp [hA_ne, hB_ne]
        ring
      have hQ_eq : Q ε = Q 0 + ε * D_Q ε := by
        have hs := sub_smul_dslope Q 0 ε
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hs
        linear_combination -hs
      have hQ0 : -c * Q 0 = -c / (B 0) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp only [Q]
        rw [hAB0]
        field_simp [hB0_ne]
      rw [hdiff, heq ε hε]
      calc -(c * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * Ψ ε) * Q ε
          = -(c * ε ^ l) * (Q 0 + ε * D_Q ε) - ε ^ (l + 1) * Ψ ε * Q ε := by
              rw [← hQ_eq]; ring
        _ = (-c * Q 0) * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * (-c * D_Q ε - Ψ ε * Q ε) := by
              rw [pow_succ ε l]; ring
        _ = (-c / (B 0) ^ 2) * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * (-c * D_Q ε - Ψ ε * Q ε) := by
              rw [hQ0]
    have jd_comp : ∀ {V : Set ℂ} (_hV_open : IsOpen V) {Φ A B : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ V → JetDiff A B c → (∀ ε ∈ U₀, A ε ∈ V ∧ B ε ∈ V) →
        JetDiff (fun ε => Φ (A ε)) (fun ε => Φ (B ε)) (deriv Φ (B 0) * c) := by
      intro V hV_open Φ A B c hΦ hAB hmaps
      let z₀ : ℂ := B 0
      have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ V := (hmaps 0 h0_U₀).2
      have hV_nhds : V ∈ nhds z₀ := hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀
      let G : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := lineCoalescingDslopeIter Φ z₀
      have hG_holo : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G n) V := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => exact hΦ
        | succ n ih => exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hV_nhds).mpr ih
      have hG_taylor : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ),
          Φ z = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, G j z₀ * (z - z₀) ^ j) + (z - z₀) ^ m * G m z := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro z; simp [G, lineCoalescingDslopeIter]
        | succ m ih =>
            intro z
            have hs := sub_smul_dslope (G m) z₀ z
            simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hs
            have hGm : G m z = G m z₀ + (z - z₀) * G (m + 1) z := by
              change G m z = G m z₀ + (z - z₀) * dslope (G m) z₀ z
              linear_combination -hs
            rw [ih z, hGm, Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
            ring
      let U_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => A ε - z₀
      let V_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => B ε - z₀
      have hUV : JetDiff U_fn V_fn c := by
        simpa using jd_sub hAB (jd_refl (differentiableOn_const z₀))
      have hV0 : V_fn 0 = 0 := sub_self (B 0)
      have hUV_pow : ∀ j : ℕ,
          JetDiff (fun ε => (U_fn ε) ^ j) (fun ε => (V_fn ε) ^ j) (if j = 1 then c else 0) := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => simpa using jd_refl (differentiableOn_const 1)
        | succ j ih =>
            cases j with
            | zero => simpa using hUV
            | succ m =>
                have h_u : (fun ε => (U_fn ε) ^ (m + 2)) =
                    fun ε => (U_fn ε) ^ (m + 1) * U_fn ε := funext fun ε => pow_succ (U_fn ε) (m + 1)
                have h_v : (fun ε => (V_fn ε) ^ (m + 2)) =
                    fun ε => (V_fn ε) ^ (m + 1) * V_fn ε := funext fun ε => pow_succ (V_fn ε) (m + 1)
                rw [h_u, h_v]
                have hmul := jd_mul ih hUV
                have hc0 : (if m + 1 = 1 then c else 0) * V_fn 0 + (V_fn 0) ^ (m + 1) * c = 0 := by
                  rw [hV0, mul_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), zero_mul, add_zero]
                rw [hc0] at hmul
                simpa using hmul
      have h_poly : JetDiff
          (fun ε => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), G j z₀ * (U_fn ε) ^ j)
          (fun ε => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), G j z₀ * (V_fn ε) ^ j)
          (deriv Φ z₀ * c) := by
        have hsum := jd_sum (Finset.range (l + 1))
          (fun j ε => G j z₀ * (U_fn ε) ^ j)
          (fun j ε => G j z₀ * (V_fn ε) ^ j)
          (fun j => G j z₀ * (if j = 1 then c else 0))
          (fun j _ => jd_const_mul (G j z₀) (hUV_pow j))
        have hc_eq : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), G j z₀ * (if j = 1 then c else 0)) =
            deriv Φ z₀ * c := by
          have hite : ∀ j : ℕ, G j z₀ * (if j = 1 then c else 0) =
              if j = 1 then G 1 z₀ * c else 0 := by
            intro j; split_ifs with hj <;> simp [hj]
          simp_rw [hite, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_range]
          have h1_lt : 1 < l + 1 := by omega
          simp only [h1_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          have hd : G 1 z₀ = deriv Φ z₀ := dslope_same Φ z₀
          rw [hd]
        rw [hc_eq] at hsum
        exact hsum
      have h_tail : JetDiff
          (fun ε => (U_fn ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (A ε))
          (fun ε => (V_fn ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (B ε)) 0 := by
        rcases hUV with ⟨hU_d, hV_d, Ψ_u, hΨ_u, heq_u⟩
        let D_V : ℂ → ℂ := dslope V_fn 0
        have hDV : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_V U₀ := (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hU₀_nhds).mpr hV_d
        let D_U : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => D_V ε + ε ^ (l - 1) * (c + ε * Ψ_u ε)
        have hDU : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_U U₀ :=
          hDV.add ((differentiableOn_id.pow (l - 1)).mul
            ((differentiableOn_const c).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hΨ_u)))
        have hGA : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => G (l + 1) (A ε)) U₀ :=
          (hG_holo (l + 1)).comp hAB.1 fun ε hε => (hmaps ε hε).1
        have hGB : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => G (l + 1) (B ε)) U₀ :=
          (hG_holo (l + 1)).comp hAB.2.1 fun ε hε => (hmaps ε hε).2
        refine ⟨(hU_d.pow (l + 1)).mul hGA, (hV_d.pow (l + 1)).mul hGB,
          fun ε => (D_U ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (A ε) - (D_V ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (B ε),
          ((hDU.pow (l + 1)).mul hGA).sub ((hDV.pow (l + 1)).mul hGB),
          fun ε hε => ?_⟩
        have hV_eq : V_fn ε = ε * D_V ε := by
          have hs := sub_smul_dslope V_fn 0 ε
          simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hV0] at hs
          exact hs.symm
        have hU_eq : U_fn ε = ε * D_U ε := by
          have h1 := heq_u ε hε
          have hpow1 : ε * ε ^ (l - 1) = ε ^ l := by
            rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hl1]
          calc U_fn ε = V_fn ε + (U_fn ε - V_fn ε) := by ring
            _ = ε * D_V ε + (c * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * Ψ_u ε) := by rw [h1, hV_eq]
            _ = ε * (D_V ε + ε ^ (l - 1) * (c + ε * Ψ_u ε)) := by
                  rw [pow_succ ε l, ← hpow1]; ring
        dsimp only
        rw [hU_eq, hV_eq, mul_pow, mul_pow]
        ring
      have h_comb := jd_add h_poly h_tail
      rw [add_zero] at h_comb
      have hA_t : (fun ε => Φ (A ε)) =
          fun ε => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), G j z₀ * (U_fn ε) ^ j) +
            (U_fn ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (A ε) :=
        funext fun ε => hG_taylor (l + 1) (A ε)
      have hB_t : (fun ε => Φ (B ε)) =
          fun ε => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), G j z₀ * (V_fn ε) ^ j) +
            (V_fn ε) ^ (l + 1) * G (l + 1) (B ε) :=
        funext fun ε => hG_taylor (l + 1) (B ε)
      rw [hA_t, hB_t]
      exact h_comb
    have jd_deriv : ∀ {A B : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ},
        JetDiff A B c → iteratedDeriv l A 0 = iteratedDeriv l B 0 + (l.factorial : ℂ) * c := by
      rintro A B c ⟨_, hB, Ψ, hΨ, heq⟩
      have hB_an : AnalyticAt ℂ B 0 := hB.analyticAt hU₀_nhds
      have hΨ_an : AnalyticAt ℂ Ψ 0 := hΨ.analyticAt hU₀_nhds
      have hpow_l_an : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ l) 0 := analyticAt_id.pow l
      have hpow_l1_an : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ (l + 1)) 0 := analyticAt_id.pow (l + 1)
      let f1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε => c * ε ^ l
      let f2 : ℂ → ℂ := (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ (l + 1)) * Ψ
      have hf1_an : AnalyticAt ℂ f1 0 := analyticAt_const.mul hpow_l_an
      have hf2_an : AnalyticAt ℂ f2 0 := hpow_l1_an.mul hΨ_an
      have hf12_an : AnalyticAt ℂ (f1 + f2) 0 := hf1_an.add hf2_an
      have hev : A =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (B + (f1 + f2)) := by
        refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hU₀_nhds fun ε hε => ?_
        have h := heq ε hε
        change A ε = B ε + (c * ε ^ l + ε ^ (l + 1) * Ψ ε)
        linear_combination h
      rw [hev.iteratedDeriv_eq l,
        iteratedDeriv_add hB_an.contDiffAt hf12_an.contDiffAt,
        iteratedDeriv_add hf1_an.contDiffAt hf2_an.contDiffAt]
      dsimp only [f1, f2]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul c hpow_l_an.contDiffAt,
        iteratedDeriv_pow l l, Nat.descFactorial_self l, Nat.sub_self l, pow_zero, mul_one,
        iteratedDeriv_mul hpow_l1_an.contDiffAt hΨ_an.contDiffAt]
      have hrem0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (l + 1),
          (l.choose i : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv i (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ (l + 1)) 0 *
            iteratedDeriv (l - i) Ψ 0) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro i hi
        have hi_lt : i < l + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
        rw [iteratedDeriv_pow (l + 1) i, zero_pow (by omega : l + 1 - i ≠ 0)]
        ring
      rw [hrem0, add_zero, mul_comm c]

    
    let l_fin : Fin (J + 1) := ⟨l, by omega⟩
    let v : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := β_vec l_fin
    have hx_jd : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        JetDiff (fun ε => x_full ε m) (fun ε => x_lt ε m) (v m) := by
      intro m
      let S_gt : Finset (Fin (J + 1)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => l < (q : ℕ))
      refine ⟨(hx_full_diff m).differentiableOn, (hx_lt_diff m).differentiableOn,
        fun ε => ∑ q ∈ S_gt, ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - (l + 1)) * β_vec q m,
        DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun q _ =>
          (differentiableOn_id.pow ((q : ℕ) - (l + 1))).mul_const (β_vec q m),
        fun ε _ => ?_⟩
      have h_part := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
        (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => (q : ℕ) < l) (fun q => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m)
      have h_sub : x_full ε m - x_lt ε m =
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => ¬ (q : ℕ) < l),
            ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m := by
        dsimp only [x_full, x_lt]
        linear_combination -h_part
      have h_filt_eq : Finset.univ.filter (fun q : Fin (J + 1) => ¬ (q : ℕ) < l) =
          insert l_fin S_gt := by
        ext q
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
          Fin.ext_iff, S_gt, l_fin]
        omega
      have h_not_mem : l_fin ∉ S_gt := by
        simp [S_gt, l_fin]
      rw [h_sub, h_filt_eq, Finset.sum_insert h_not_mem]
      have h_l_term : ε ^ (l_fin : ℕ) * β_vec l_fin m = v m * ε ^ l := by
        dsimp only [l_fin, v]
        ring
      have h_gt_sum : (∑ q ∈ S_gt, ε ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m) =
          ε ^ (l + 1) * ∑ q ∈ S_gt, ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - (l + 1)) * β_vec q m := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => ?_
        have hql : l + 1 ≤ (q : ℕ) := by
          have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
          omega
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hql]
      rw [h_l_term, h_gt_sum]

    have hx_maps : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), ∀ ε ∈ U₀, x_full ε m ∈ W ∧ x_lt ε m ∈ W :=
      fun m ε hε => ⟨(hU₀_spec ε hε).1.1 m, (hU₀_spec ε hε).2.1 m⟩
    have hu_maps : ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ ε ∈ U₀,
        (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈ B_half ∧
        (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈ B_half :=
      fun i ε hε => ⟨(hU₀_spec ε hε).1.2 i, (hU₀_spec ε hε).2.2 i⟩

    have hY_jd : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        JetDiff (fun ε => F_pert ε m (x_full ε m)) (fun ε => F_pert ε m (x_lt ε m))
          (deriv F (x_base m) * v m) := by
      intro m
      have h0_lt : x_lt 0 m = x_base m := congr_fun hx_lt_zero m
      have hF_c := jd_comp hW_open hF_holo (hx_jd m) (hx_maps m)
      rw [h0_lt] at hF_c
      have hg_s : JetDiff
          (fun ε => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full ε m))
          (fun ε => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_lt ε m)) 0 := by
        have hs := jd_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
          (fun (q : Fin (J + 1)) ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full ε m))
          (fun (q : Fin (J + 1)) ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_lt ε m))
          (fun _ => 0) ?_
        · simpa using hs
        · intro q _
          by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
          · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
            rw [hq]
            exact jd_zero_both
              (fun ε hε => by simp [hg_zero m _ (hx_maps m ε hε).1])
              (fun ε hε => by simp [hg_zero m _ (hx_maps m ε hε).2])
          · have hpow_jd := jd_refl (differentiableOn_id.pow (q : ℕ) :
              DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ (q : ℕ)) U₀)
            have hg_c := jd_comp hW_open (hg_holo m q) (hx_jd m) (hx_maps m)
            have hm_jd := jd_mul hpow_jd hg_c
            simpa [zero_pow hq0] using hm_jd
      simpa [F_pert] using jd_add hF_c hg_s

    have hY'_jd : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        JetDiff (fun ε => F'_pert ε m (x_full ε m)) (fun ε => F'_pert ε m (x_lt ε m))
          (deriv (deriv F) (x_base m) * v m) := by
      intro m
      have h0_lt : x_lt 0 m = x_base m := congr_fun hx_lt_zero m
      have hF'_c := jd_comp hW_open hF'_holo (hx_jd m) (hx_maps m)
      rw [h0_lt] at hF'_c
      have hg'_s : JetDiff
          (fun ε => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) (x_full ε m))
          (fun ε => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) (x_lt ε m)) 0 := by
        have hs := jd_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1)))
          (fun (q : Fin (J + 1)) ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) (x_full ε m))
          (fun (q : Fin (J + 1)) ε => ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) (x_lt ε m))
          (fun _ => 0) ?_
        · simpa using hs
        · intro q _
          by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
          · have hq : q = 0 := Fin.ext hq0
            rw [hq]
            exact jd_zero_both
              (fun ε hε => by simp [hg'_zero m _ (hx_maps m ε hε).1])
              (fun ε hε => by simp [hg'_zero m _ (hx_maps m ε hε).2])
          · have hpow_jd := jd_refl (differentiableOn_id.pow (q : ℕ) :
              DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε : ℂ => ε ^ (q : ℕ)) U₀)
            have hg'_c := jd_comp hW_open (hg'_holo m q) (hx_jd m) (hx_maps m)
            have hm_jd := jd_mul hpow_jd hg'_c
            simpa [zero_pow hq0] using hm_jd
      simpa [F'_pert] using jd_add hF'_c hg'_s

    have hLinv_jd : ∀ i : Fin k,
        let Δx₀ := x_base i.succ - x_base i.castSucc
        let ΔY₀ := F (x_base i.succ) - F (x_base i.castSucc)
        let n_succ := Δx₀ + ΔY₀ * deriv F (x_base i.succ)
        let n_cast := Δx₀ + ΔY₀ * deriv F (x_base i.castSucc)
        JetDiff
          (fun ε => (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i)⁻¹)
          (fun ε => (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i)⁻¹)
          (-(n_succ * v i.succ - n_cast * v i.castSucc) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 3) := by
      intro i
      dsimp only
      let Δx₀ := x_base i.succ - x_base i.castSucc
      let ΔY₀ := F (x_base i.succ) - F (x_base i.castSucc)
      let n_succ := Δx₀ + ΔY₀ * deriv F (x_base i.succ)
      let n_cast := Δx₀ + ΔY₀ * deriv F (x_base i.castSucc)
      have hdx := jd_sub (hx_jd i.succ) (hx_jd i.castSucc)
      have hdy := jd_sub (hY_jd i.succ) (hY_jd i.castSucc)
      have hdx0 : x_lt 0 i.succ - x_lt 0 i.castSucc = Δx₀ := by simp [hx_lt_zero, Δx₀]
      have hdy0 : F_pert 0 i.succ (x_lt 0 i.succ) - F_pert 0 i.castSucc (x_lt 0 i.castSucc) =
          ΔY₀ := by
        simp [hx_lt_zero, hF_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _), ΔY₀]
      have hsq : JetDiff
          (fun ε => pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i)
          (fun ε => pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i)
          (2 * (n_succ * v i.succ - n_cast * v i.castSucc)) := by
        have h1 := jd_add (jd_mul hdx hdx) (jd_mul hdy hdy)
        rw [hdx0, hdy0] at h1
        have hfn_f : (fun ε => pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i) =
            fun ε => (x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc) *
                (x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc) +
              (F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) *
                (F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) -
                  F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) :=
          funext fun _ => by simp [pointEdgeSq, sq]
        have hfn_l : (fun ε => pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i) =
            fun ε => (x_lt ε i.succ - x_lt ε i.castSucc) *
                (x_lt ε i.succ - x_lt ε i.castSucc) +
              (F_pert ε i.succ (x_lt ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_lt ε i.castSucc)) *
                (F_pert ε i.succ (x_lt ε i.succ) -
                  F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_lt ε i.castSucc)) :=
          funext fun _ => by simp [pointEdgeSq, sq]
        rw [hfn_f, hfn_l]
        convert h1 using 1
        dsimp only [n_succ, n_cast]
        ring
      have hu_jd : JetDiff
          (fun ε => (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
          (fun ε => (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
          (((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (2 * (n_succ * v i.succ - n_cast * v i.castSucc))) := by
        have hsub := jd_sub hsq (jd_refl (differentiableOn_const ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)))
        rw [sub_zero] at hsub
        have hmul := jd_const_mul (((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)⁻¹) hsub
        simpa only [div_eq_inv_mul] using hmul
      have hsqrt_jd := jd_comp hB_half_open h_sqrt1p_holo hu_jd (hu_maps i)
      have hu0 : (pointEdgeSq (F_pert 0) (x_lt 0) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        simp [hEdgeSq_at0 hx_lt_zero i]
      rw [hu0, h_sqrt1p_deriv0] at hsqrt_jd
      have hL_jd : JetDiff
          (fun ε => pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i)
          (fun ε => pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i)
          ((n_succ * v i.succ - n_cast * v i.castSucc) / ℓ_base i) := by
        have hm := jd_const_mul (ℓ_base i) hsqrt_jd
        dsimp only [pointRelEdgeLen]
        convert hm using 1
        field_simp [hℓ_ne i]
      have hinv := jd_inv hL_jd fun ε _ => ⟨hEdgeLen_ne ε _ i, hEdgeLen_ne ε _ i⟩
      rw [hEdgeLen_at0 hx_lt_zero i] at hinv
      convert hinv using 1
      field_simp [hℓ_ne i]
      ring

    let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
    have hi_mid : i_L.succ = i_R.castSucc := by ext; dsimp [i_L, i_R]
    let Δx_L := x_base i_L.succ - x_base i_L.castSucc
    let ΔY_L := F (x_base i_L.succ) - F (x_base i_L.castSucc)
    let L_L := ℓ_base i_L
    let n_L_succ := Δx_L + ΔY_L * deriv F (x_base i_L.succ)
    let n_L_cast := Δx_L + ΔY_L * deriv F (x_base i_L.castSucc)
    let Δx_R := x_base i_R.succ - x_base i_R.castSucc
    let ΔY_R := F (x_base i_R.succ) - F (x_base i_R.castSucc)
    let L_R := ℓ_base i_R
    let n_R_cast := Δx_R + ΔY_R * deriv F (x_base i_R.castSucc)
    let n_R_succ := Δx_R + ΔY_R * deriv F (x_base i_R.succ)

    let D_diag : ℂ :=
      (((1 + deriv F (x_base i_L.succ) ^ 2 + ΔY_L * deriv (deriv F) (x_base i_L.succ)) *
          L_L ^ 2 - n_L_succ ^ 2) / L_L ^ 3) +
      (((1 + deriv F (x_base i_R.castSucc) ^ 2 - ΔY_R * deriv (deriv F) (x_base i_R.castSucc)) *
          L_R ^ 2 - n_R_cast ^ 2) / L_R ^ 3)
    let U_sup : ℂ :=
      ((-1 - deriv F (x_base i_R.succ) * deriv F (x_base i_R.castSucc)) * L_R ^ 2 +
        n_R_cast * n_R_succ) / L_R ^ 3
    let L_sub : ℂ :=
      ((-1 - deriv F (x_base i_L.castSucc) * deriv F (x_base i_L.succ)) * L_L ^ 2 +
        n_L_succ * n_L_cast) / L_L ^ 3

    have hGrad_jd : JetDiff
        (fun ε => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_full ε) r)
        (fun ε => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_lt ε) r)
        (D_diag * v i_L.succ + U_sup * v i_R.succ + L_sub * v i_L.castSucc) := by
      have hNL := jd_add (jd_sub (hx_jd i_L.succ) (hx_jd i_L.castSucc))
        (jd_mul (jd_sub (hY_jd i_L.succ) (hY_jd i_L.castSucc)) (hY'_jd i_L.succ))
      have hNR := jd_add (jd_sub (hx_jd i_R.succ) (hx_jd i_R.castSucc))
        (jd_mul (jd_sub (hY_jd i_R.succ) (hY_jd i_R.castSucc)) (hY'_jd i_R.castSucc))
      have hEL := jd_mul hNL (hLinv_jd i_L)
      have hER := jd_mul hNR (hLinv_jd i_R)
      have hG := jd_sub hEL hER
      rw [hEdgeLen_at0 hx_lt_zero, hEdgeLen_at0 hx_lt_zero] at hG
      simp only [hx_lt_zero, hF_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _), hF'_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _)] at hG
      have hfn_f : (fun ε => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_full ε) r) =
          fun ε =>
            ((x_full ε i_L.succ - x_full ε i_L.castSucc) +
                (F_pert ε i_L.succ (x_full ε i_L.succ) -
                    F_pert ε i_L.castSucc (x_full ε i_L.castSucc)) *
                  F'_pert ε i_L.succ (x_full ε i_L.succ)) *
              (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i_L)⁻¹ -
            ((x_full ε i_R.succ - x_full ε i_R.castSucc) +
                (F_pert ε i_R.succ (x_full ε i_R.succ) -
                    F_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_full ε i_R.castSucc)) *
                  F'_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_full ε i_R.castSucc)) *
              (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i_R)⁻¹ :=
        funext fun _ => by simp only [pointRelInteriorGrad, div_eq_mul_inv, i_L, i_R]
      have hfn_l : (fun ε => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_lt ε) r) =
          fun ε =>
            ((x_lt ε i_L.succ - x_lt ε i_L.castSucc) +
                (F_pert ε i_L.succ (x_lt ε i_L.succ) -
                    F_pert ε i_L.castSucc (x_lt ε i_L.castSucc)) *
                  F'_pert ε i_L.succ (x_lt ε i_L.succ)) *
              (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i_L)⁻¹ -
            ((x_lt ε i_R.succ - x_lt ε i_R.castSucc) +
                (F_pert ε i_R.succ (x_lt ε i_R.succ) -
                    F_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_lt ε i_R.castSucc)) *
                  F'_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_lt ε i_R.castSucc)) *
              (pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_lt ε) i_R)⁻¹ :=
        funext fun _ => by simp only [pointRelInteriorGrad, div_eq_mul_inv, i_L, i_R]
      rw [hfn_f, hfn_l]
      convert hG using 1
      dsimp only [D_diag, U_sup, L_sub, L_L, L_R, n_L_succ, n_L_cast, n_R_cast, n_R_succ,
        Δx_L, ΔY_L, Δx_R, ΔY_R]
      rw [← hi_mid]
      have hLL_ne : ℓ_base i_L ≠ 0 := hℓ_ne i_L
      have hLR_ne : ℓ_base i_R ≠ 0 := hℓ_ne i_R
      field_simp [hLL_ne, hLR_ne]
      ring

    let v_int : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ := fun s => v ⟨s.1 + 1, by have := s.2; omega⟩
    have h_mv_eq :
        (pointInteriorHess ℓ_base F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) x_base).mulVec v_int r =
          D_diag * v i_L.succ + U_sup * v i_R.succ + L_sub * v i_L.castSucc := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      have h_entry : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1),
          pointInteriorHess ℓ_base F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) x_base r s * v_int s =
            (if s = r then D_diag * v_int s else 0) +
            (if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then U_sup * v_int s else 0) +
            (if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then L_sub * v_int s else 0) := by
        intro s
        dsimp only [pointInteriorHess]
        change (if r.1 = s.1 then D_diag else if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then U_sup
          else if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then L_sub else 0) * v_int s = _
        by_cases h1 : s = r
        · have hv : r.1 = s.1 := congr_arg Fin.val h1.symm
          have hn2 : ¬ (s.1 = r.1 + 1) := by rw [hv]; omega
          have hn3 : ¬ (r.1 = s.1 + 1) := by rw [hv]; omega
          simp only [eq_true hv, eq_true h1, eq_false hn2, eq_false hn3, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
        · have hv : ¬ (r.1 = s.1) := fun h => h1 (Fin.ext h.symm)
          by_cases h2 : s.1 = r.1 + 1
          · have hn3 : ¬ (r.1 = s.1 + 1) := by rw [h2]; omega
            simp only [eq_false hv, eq_false h1, eq_true h2, eq_false hn3, ↓reduceIte,
              zero_add, add_zero]
          · by_cases h3 : r.1 = s.1 + 1
            · simp only [eq_false hv, eq_false h1, eq_false h2, eq_true h3, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
            · simp only [eq_false hv, eq_false h1, eq_false h2, eq_false h3, ↓reduceIte,
                zero_mul, add_zero]
      simp_rw [h_entry, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      have hs1 : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), if s = r then D_diag * v_int s else 0) =
          D_diag * v i_L.succ := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
        rfl
      have hs2 : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then U_sup * v_int s else 0) =
          U_sup * v i_R.succ := by
        by_cases hlt : r.1 + 1 < k - 1
        · let s_next : Fin (k - 1) := ⟨r.1 + 1, hlt⟩
          have hiff : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1), (s.1 = r.1 + 1) ↔ (s = s_next) :=
            fun s => ⟨fun h => Fin.ext h, fun h => congr_arg Fin.val h⟩
          simp_rw [hiff]
          rw [Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
          rfl
        · have hsum0 : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), if s.1 = r.1 + 1 then U_sup * v_int s else 0) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro s _
            have hs_ne : s.1 ≠ r.1 + 1 := by have := s.2; omega
            simp [hs_ne]
          have hiR_last : i_R.succ = Fin.last k := by
            ext; dsimp [i_R]; have := r.2; omega
          rw [hsum0, hiR_last]
          dsimp only [v]
          rw [(hβ_end l_fin).2, mul_zero]
      have hs3 : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then L_sub * v_int s else 0) =
          L_sub * v i_L.castSucc := by
        by_cases hpos : 0 < r.1
        · let s_prev : Fin (k - 1) := ⟨r.1 - 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
          have hiff : ∀ s : Fin (k - 1), (r.1 = s.1 + 1) ↔ (s = s_prev) := by
            intro s
            constructor
            · intro h; ext; dsimp [s_prev]; omega
            · intro h; subst h; dsimp [s_prev]; omega
          simp_rw [hiff]
          rw [Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
          have hv_eq : v_int s_prev = v i_L.castSucc := by
            dsimp only [v_int]
            congr 1
            ext
            dsimp [s_prev, i_L]
            omega
          rw [hv_eq]
        · have hsum0 : (∑ s : Fin (k - 1), if r.1 = s.1 + 1 then L_sub * v_int s else 0) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro s _
            have hr_ne : r.1 ≠ s.1 + 1 := by omega
            simp [hr_ne]
          have hiL_zero : i_L.castSucc = 0 := by
            ext; dsimp [i_L]; omega
          rw [hsum0, hiL_zero]
          dsimp only [v]
          rw [(hβ_end l_fin).1, mul_zero]
      rw [hs1, hs2, hs3]

    rw [← h_mv_eq] at hGrad_jd
    have h_der := jd_deriv hGrad_jd
    have h_zero := M.grad_jet_zero δ hδ r l hl1 hlJ
    change iteratedDeriv l
      (fun ε : ℂ => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_full ε) r) 0 = 0 at h_zero
    rw [h_zero] at h_der
    change (l.factorial : ℂ) *
        ((pointInteriorHess ℓ_base F (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F)) x_base).mulVec v_int r) +
      iteratedDeriv l
        (fun ε : ℂ => pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_lt ε) r) 0 = 0
    linear_combination -h_der

  · 
    intro l hl1
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hU₁_spec⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (h_germ_ev x_full hx_full_diff hx_full_zero)
    let U₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) η₁
    have hU₁_open : IsOpen U₁ := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h0_U₁ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self hη₁
    have hU₁_nhds : U₁ ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) := hU₁_open.mem_nhds h0_U₁

    let x_dot : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun ε m =>
      ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
        if (q : ℕ) = 0 then 0 else ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) * β_vec q m
    let G_dot : ℂ → Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun ε m =>
      ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
        if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) * M.g m q (x_full ε m) else 0
    let L_edge : ℂ → Fin k → ℂ := fun ε i =>
      pointRelEdgeLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i
    let L_chain : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε =>
      pointRelChainLen ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (x_full ε)
    let TermII : ℂ → ℂ := fun ε =>
      pointCoalescingTermII p ℓ_base F M.g (x_full ε) ε
    let Φ_grad : Fin (k - 1) → ℂ → ℂ := fun r ε =>
      pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (F_pert ε) (F'_pert ε) (x_full ε) r

    have hxdot_end0 : ∀ ε : ℂ, x_dot ε 0 = 0 := by
      intro ε
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro q _
      split_ifs <;> simp [(hβ_end q).1]
    have hxdot_endk : ∀ ε : ℂ, x_dot ε (Fin.last k) = 0 := by
      intro ε
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro q _
      split_ifs <;> simp [(hβ_end q).2]

    have hx_hasDeriv : ∀ (m : Fin (k + 1)) (ε : ℂ),
        HasDerivAt (fun w => x_full w m) (x_dot ε m) ε := by
      intro m ε
      have hsum : HasDerivAt
          (∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1))),
            fun w : ℂ => w ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m) (x_dot ε m) ε := by
        refine HasDerivAt.sum fun q _ => ?_
        by_cases hq0 : (q : ℕ) = 0
        · simp only [hq0, pow_zero, one_mul, ↓reduceIte]
          exact hasDerivAt_const ε (β_vec q m)
        · simp only [hq0, ↓reduceIte]
          exact (hasDerivAt_pow (q : ℕ) ε).mul_const (β_vec q m)
      have hsum_fn : (∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1))),
          fun w : ℂ => w ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m) =
          fun w : ℂ => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), w ^ (q : ℕ) * β_vec q m :=
        funext fun w => Finset.sum_apply w Finset.univ _
      rw [hsum_fn] at hsum
      exact hsum.const_add (x_base m)

    have hY_hasDeriv : ∀ ε ∈ U₁, ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        HasDerivAt (fun w => F_pert w m (x_full w m))
          (F'_pert ε m (x_full ε m) * x_dot ε m + G_dot ε m) ε := by
      intro ε hε m
      have hx_in : x_full ε m ∈ W := (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 m
      have hF_d : HasDerivAt (fun w => F (x_full w m))
          (deriv F (x_full ε m) * x_dot ε m) ε :=
        HasDerivAt.comp ε
          ((hF_holo.differentiableAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hx_in)).hasDerivAt)
          (hx_hasDeriv m ε)
      have hg_d : HasDerivAt
          (∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1))),
            fun w : ℂ => w ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full w m))
          (∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1))),
            ((if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) * M.g m q (x_full ε m)
              else 0) +
              (ε ^ (q : ℕ) * deriv (M.g m q) (x_full ε m)) * x_dot ε m)) ε := by
        refine HasDerivAt.sum fun q _ => ?_
        by_cases hqp : p ≤ (q : ℕ)
        · simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte]
          have hg_q : HasDerivAt (fun w => M.g m q (x_full w m))
              (deriv (M.g m q) (x_full ε m) * x_dot ε m) ε :=
            HasDerivAt.comp ε
              (((hg_holo m q).differentiableAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hx_in)).hasDerivAt)
              (hx_hasDeriv m ε)
          convert (hasDerivAt_pow (q : ℕ) ε).mul hg_q using 1
          ring
        · have hlt : (q : ℕ) < p := lt_of_not_ge hqp
          simp only [hqp, ↓reduceIte, zero_add, hg'_lt_p m q hlt _ hx_in, mul_zero, zero_mul]
          have hev0 : (fun w : ℂ => w ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full w m)) =ᶠ[nhds ε]
              fun _ => (0 : ℂ) :=
            Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU₁_open.mem_nhds hε) fun w hw => by
              rw [hg_lt_p m q hlt _ ((hU₁_spec w hw).1 m), mul_zero]
          exact (hasDerivAt_const ε (0 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev0
      have hg_fn : (∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (J + 1))),
          fun w : ℂ => w ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full w m)) =
          fun w : ℂ => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1), w ^ (q : ℕ) * M.g m q (x_full w m) :=
        funext fun w => Finset.sum_apply w Finset.univ _
      rw [hg_fn] at hg_d
      convert hF_d.add hg_d using 1
      dsimp only [F'_pert, G_dot]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

    have hL_hasDeriv : ∀ ε ∈ U₁, ∀ i : Fin k,
        let Δx_ε := x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc
        let ΔY_ε := F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)
        let v_edge := (Δx_ε + ΔY_ε * F'_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ)) / L_edge ε i
        let u_edge := (Δx_ε + ΔY_ε * F'_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) / L_edge ε i
        HasDerivAt (fun w => L_edge w i)
          ((ΔY_ε / L_edge ε i) * (G_dot ε i.succ - G_dot ε i.castSucc) +
            (v_edge * x_dot ε i.succ - u_edge * x_dot ε i.castSucc)) ε := by
      intro ε hε i
      dsimp only
      let Δx_ε := x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc
      let ΔY_ε := F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)
      let Δx_dot := x_dot ε i.succ - x_dot ε i.castSucc
      let ΔY_dot :=
        (F'_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) * x_dot ε i.succ + G_dot ε i.succ) -
          (F'_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc) * x_dot ε i.castSucc + G_dot ε i.castSucc)
      have hdx_d : HasDerivAt (fun w => x_full w i.succ - x_full w i.castSucc) Δx_dot ε :=
        (hx_hasDeriv i.succ ε).sub (hx_hasDeriv i.castSucc ε)
      have hdy_d : HasDerivAt
          (fun w => F_pert w i.succ (x_full w i.succ) - F_pert w i.castSucc (x_full w i.castSucc))
          ΔY_dot ε :=
        (hY_hasDeriv ε hε i.succ).sub (hY_hasDeriv ε hε i.castSucc)
      have hsq_d : HasDerivAt (fun w => pointEdgeSq (F_pert w) (x_full w) i)
          (2 * Δx_ε * Δx_dot + 2 * ΔY_ε * ΔY_dot) ε := by
        have hfn : (fun w => pointEdgeSq (F_pert w) (x_full w) i) =
            fun w => (x_full w i.succ - x_full w i.castSucc) *
                (x_full w i.succ - x_full w i.castSucc) +
              (F_pert w i.succ (x_full w i.succ) - F_pert w i.castSucc (x_full w i.castSucc)) *
                (F_pert w i.succ (x_full w i.succ) -
                  F_pert w i.castSucc (x_full w i.castSucc)) :=
          funext fun _ => by simp [pointEdgeSq, sq]
        rw [hfn]
        convert (hdx_d.mul hdx_d).add (hdy_d.mul hdy_d) using 1
        dsimp only [Δx_ε, ΔY_ε]
        ring
      have hu_d : HasDerivAt
          (fun w => (pointEdgeSq (F_pert w) (x_full w) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
          ((2 * Δx_ε * Δx_dot + 2 * ΔY_ε * ΔY_dot) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) ε :=
        (hsq_d.sub_const ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)).div_const ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
      have hu_in : (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2 ∈
          B_half := (hU₁_spec ε hε).2 i
      have hL_raw := ((HasDerivAt.comp ε (h_sqrt1p_deriv _ hu_in) hu_d).const_mul (ℓ_base i))
      change HasDerivAt (fun w => L_edge w i) _ ε at hL_raw
      convert hL_raw using 1
      dsimp only [L_edge, pointRelEdgeLen, Δx_dot, ΔY_dot]
      have h1 := hℓ_ne i
      have h2 := h_sqrt1p_ne
        ((pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
      field_simp [h1, h2]
      ring

    have hChain_deriv_ev : deriv L_chain =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)]
        fun ε => TermII ε +
          ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hU₁_nhds fun ε hε => ?_
      let v_edge : Fin k → ℂ := fun i =>
        ((x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc) +
          (F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) *
            F'_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ)) / L_edge ε i
      let u_edge : Fin k → ℂ := fun i =>
        ((x_full ε i.succ - x_full ε i.castSucc) +
          (F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) *
            F'_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) / L_edge ε i
      have hsum_d : HasDerivAt (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)), fun w => L_edge w i)
          (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)),
            (((F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) - F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) /
                L_edge ε i) * (G_dot ε i.succ - G_dot ε i.castSucc) +
              (v_edge i * x_dot ε i.succ - u_edge i * x_dot ε i.castSucc))) ε :=
        HasDerivAt.sum fun i _ => hL_hasDeriv ε hε i
      have hsum_fn : (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)), fun w => L_edge w i) = L_chain :=
        funext fun w => Finset.sum_apply w Finset.univ _
      rw [hsum_fn] at hsum_d
      rw [hsum_d.deriv, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      congr 1
      · dsimp only [TermII, pointCoalescingTermII, L_edge, F_pert, G_dot]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        congr 1
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
        split_ifs <;> ring
      · rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        have hv_sum : (∑ i : Fin k, v_edge i * x_dot ε i.succ) =
            ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), v_edge ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ *
              x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
          have h_filt : (∑ i : Fin k, v_edge i * x_dot ε i.succ) =
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => i.1 < k - 1),
                v_edge i * x_dot ε i.succ := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
              (fun i : Fin k => i.1 < k - 1)]
            suffices h0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => ¬ i.1 < k - 1),
                v_edge i * x_dot ε i.succ) = 0 by rw [h0, add_zero]
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro i hi
            have hi_last : i.succ = Fin.last k := by
              rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
              ext; dsimp; have := i.2; omega
            rw [hi_last, hxdot_endk ε, mul_zero]
          rw [h_filt]
          refine Finset.sum_bij'
            (fun i hi => ⟨i.1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩)
            (fun r _ => ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
            (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
            (fun r _ => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, r.2⟩)
            (fun _ _ => by ext; rfl)
            (fun _ _ => by ext; rfl)
            (fun i _ => rfl)
        have hu_sum : (∑ i : Fin k, u_edge i * x_dot ε i.castSucc) =
            ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), u_edge ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ *
              x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩ := by
          have h_filt : (∑ i : Fin k, u_edge i * x_dot ε i.castSucc) =
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => 0 < i.1),
                u_edge i * x_dot ε i.castSucc := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
              (fun i : Fin k => 0 < i.1)]
            suffices h0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => ¬ 0 < i.1),
                u_edge i * x_dot ε i.castSucc) = 0 by rw [h0, add_zero]
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro i hi
            have hi0 : i.castSucc = 0 := by
              rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
              ext; dsimp; omega
            rw [hi0, hxdot_end0 ε, mul_zero]
          rw [h_filt]
          refine Finset.sum_bij'
            (fun i hi => ⟨i.1 - 1, by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; have := i.2; omega⟩)
            (fun r _ => ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩)
            (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
            (fun r _ => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by dsimp; omega⟩)
            (fun i hi => by ext; have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; dsimp; omega)
            (fun _ _ => by ext; simp)
            (fun i hi => by
              have h1 : (⟨(⟨i.1 - 1, by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; have := i.2; omega⟩ :
                  Fin (k - 1)).1 + 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩ : Fin k) = i := by
                ext; have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; dsimp; omega
              have h2 : (⟨(⟨i.1 - 1, by have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; have := i.2; omega⟩ :
                  Fin (k - 1)).1 + 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) = i.castSucc := by
                ext; have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2; dsimp; omega
              rw [h1, h2])
        rw [hv_sum, hu_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
        dsimp only [Φ_grad, pointRelInteriorGrad, v_edge, u_edge, L_edge]
        ring

    
    have hx_U₁_holo : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => x_full ε m) U₁ :=
      fun m => (hx_full_diff m).differentiableOn
    have hY_U₁_holo : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => F_pert ε m (x_full ε m)) U₁ := by
      intro m
      refine (hF_holo.comp (hx_U₁_holo m) fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 m).add ?_
      refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun q _ => (differentiableOn_id.pow (q : ℕ)).mul ?_
      exact (hg_holo m q).comp (hx_U₁_holo m) fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 m
    have hY'_U₁_holo : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => F'_pert ε m (x_full ε m)) U₁ := by
      intro m
      refine (hF'_holo.comp (hx_U₁_holo m) fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 m).add ?_
      refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun q _ => (differentiableOn_id.pow (q : ℕ)).mul ?_
      exact (hg'_holo m q).comp (hx_U₁_holo m) fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 m
    have hL_U₁_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => L_edge ε i) U₁ := by
      intro i
      have hsq : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i) U₁ :=
        (((hx_U₁_holo i.succ).sub (hx_U₁_holo i.castSucc)).pow 2).add
          (((hY_U₁_holo i.succ).sub (hY_U₁_holo i.castSucc)).pow 2)
      have hu : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun ε => (pointEdgeSq (F_pert ε) (x_full ε) i - (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) / (ℓ_base i) ^ 2) U₁ :=
        (hsq.sub_const ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)).div_const ((ℓ_base i) ^ 2)
      exact (h_sqrt1p_holo.comp hu fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).2 i).const_mul (ℓ_base i)
    have hLinv_U₁_holo : ∀ i : Fin k, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ε => (L_edge ε i)⁻¹) U₁ :=
      fun i => (hL_U₁_holo i).inv fun ε _ => hEdgeLen_ne ε _ i

    have hTermII_an : AnalyticAt ℂ TermII 0 := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticAt ?_ hU₁_nhds
      dsimp only [TermII, pointCoalescingTermII]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun i _ => ?_
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun ε => (F_pert ε i.succ (x_full ε i.succ) -
            F_pert ε i.castSucc (x_full ε i.castSucc)) * (L_edge ε i)⁻¹) U₁ :=
        ((hY_U₁_holo i.succ).sub (hY_U₁_holo i.castSucc)).mul (hLinv_U₁_holo i)
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun ε => ∑ q : Fin (J + 1),
            if p ≤ (q : ℕ) then ((q : ℕ) : ℂ) * ε ^ ((q : ℕ) - 1) *
              (M.g i.succ q (x_full ε i.succ) - M.g i.castSucc q (x_full ε i.castSucc))
            else 0) U₁ := by
        refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun q _ => ?_
        split_ifs
        · exact ((differentiableOn_id.pow ((q : ℕ) - 1)).const_mul ((q : ℕ) : ℂ)).mul
            (((hg_holo i.succ q).comp (hx_U₁_holo i.succ) fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 i.succ).sub
              ((hg_holo i.castSucc q).comp (hx_U₁_holo i.castSucc)
                fun ε hε => (hU₁_spec ε hε).1 i.castSucc))
        · exact differentiableOn_const 0
      exact h1.mul h2

    have hΦ_an : ∀ r : Fin (k - 1), AnalyticAt ℂ (Φ_grad r) 0 := by
      intro r
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticAt ?_ hU₁_nhds
      let i_L : Fin k := ⟨r.1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      let i_R : Fin k := ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun ε => ((x_full ε i_L.succ - x_full ε i_L.castSucc) +
            (F_pert ε i_L.succ (x_full ε i_L.succ) - F_pert ε i_L.castSucc (x_full ε i_L.castSucc)) *
              F'_pert ε i_L.succ (x_full ε i_L.succ)) * (L_edge ε i_L)⁻¹) U₁ :=
        (((hx_U₁_holo i_L.succ).sub (hx_U₁_holo i_L.castSucc)).add
          (((hY_U₁_holo i_L.succ).sub (hY_U₁_holo i_L.castSucc)).mul (hY'_U₁_holo i_L.succ))).mul
          (hLinv_U₁_holo i_L)
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun ε => ((x_full ε i_R.succ - x_full ε i_R.castSucc) +
            (F_pert ε i_R.succ (x_full ε i_R.succ) - F_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_full ε i_R.castSucc)) *
              F'_pert ε i_R.castSucc (x_full ε i_R.castSucc)) * (L_edge ε i_R)⁻¹) U₁ :=
        (((hx_U₁_holo i_R.succ).sub (hx_U₁_holo i_R.castSucc)).add
          (((hY_U₁_holo i_R.succ).sub (hY_U₁_holo i_R.castSucc)).mul
            (hY'_U₁_holo i_R.castSucc))).mul
          (hLinv_U₁_holo i_R)
      dsimp only [Φ_grad, pointRelInteriorGrad]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact h1.sub h2

    have hxdot_an : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1), AnalyticAt ℂ (fun ε => x_dot ε m) 0 := by
      intro m
      refine (h_id_sum Finset.univ _ 0 fun q _ => ?_).1
      split_ifs
      · exact analyticAt_const
      · exact (analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_id.pow ((q : ℕ) - 1))).mul analyticAt_const

    let q₀ : ℕ := (l : ℕ) - 1
    have h_int_sum_an_zero :
        AnalyticAt ℂ
          (fun ε => ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) 0 ∧
        iteratedDeriv q₀
          (fun ε => ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) 0 =
          0 := by
      have hs := h_id_sum Finset.univ
        (fun r ε => Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) q₀
        (fun r _ => (hΦ_an r).mul (hxdot_an _))
      refine ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans ?_⟩
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro r _
      have hmul_eq : (fun ε => Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) =
          (Φ_grad r * fun ε => x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) := rfl
      rw [hmul_eq, iteratedDeriv_mul (hΦ_an r).contDiffAt (hxdot_an _).contDiffAt]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j hj
      have hj_le : j ≤ q₀ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
      have hΦ_j0 : iteratedDeriv j (Φ_grad r) 0 = 0 := by
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst hj0
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
          dsimp only [Φ_grad, pointRelInteriorGrad]
          rw [hEdgeLen_at0 hx_full_zero, hEdgeLen_at0 hx_full_zero]
          simp only [hx_full_zero, hF_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _), hF'_pert_zero _ _ (hx_mem _)]
          have hstat : pointRelInteriorGrad ℓ_base (fun _ => F) (fun _ => deriv F) x_base r = 0 :=
            M.x₀_stat δ hδ r
          simpa only [pointRelInteriorGrad, hEdgeLen_base] using hstat
        · have hj1 : 1 ≤ j := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj0
          have hjJ : j ≤ J := by have := l.2; omega
          exact M.grad_jet_zero δ hδ r j hj1 hjJ
      rw [hΦ_j0, mul_zero, zero_mul]

    have h_t2_eq_chain : iteratedDeriv q₀ TermII 0 = iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ) L_chain 0 := by
      have h1 := hChain_deriv_ev.iteratedDeriv_eq q₀
      have h_add : (fun ε => TermII ε +
          ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) =
          (TermII + fun ε =>
            ∑ r : Fin (k - 1), Φ_grad r ε * x_dot ε ⟨r.1 + 1, by have := r.2; omega⟩) := rfl
      rw [h_add, iteratedDeriv_add hTermII_an.contDiffAt h_int_sum_an_zero.1.contDiffAt,
        h_int_sum_an_zero.2, add_zero] at h1
      have hq₀_add : q₀ + 1 = (l : ℕ) := Nat.sub_add_cancel hl1
      rw [← hq₀_add, iteratedDeriv_succ', h1]

    have h_split := M.len_jet_split δ hδ l hl1
    change iteratedDeriv (l : ℕ) L_chain 0 / ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) =
      M.U_split l (a : ℂ) + M.V_split l ((a : ℂ) + (δ : ℂ)) at h_split
    have hfac_ne : ((l : ℕ).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (l : ℕ))
    change iteratedDeriv q₀ TermII 0 = _
    rw [h_t2_eq_chain, (div_eq_iff hfac_ne).mp h_split, mul_comm]
