proof.tactics:
by
  let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
  have h_slice_fderiv :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ h W → ∀ q ∈ W,
          HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, q.2)) (iterDerivYT 1 0 h q) q.1 ∧
          HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (q.1, w)) (iterDerivYT 0 1 h q) q.2 ∧
          HasFDerivAt h
            (π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 h q) +
              π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 h q)) q := by
    intro W h hW hh q hq
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ h q := hh.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hq)
    have hf : HasFDerivAt h (fderiv ℂ h q) q := hdiff.hasFDerivAt
    have hι₁ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) q.1 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
    have hι₂ : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) q.2 :=
      (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
    have hd₁_raw : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, q.2)) ((fderiv ℂ h q) (1, 0)) q.1 :=
      hf.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hι₁
    have hd₂_raw : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (q.1, w)) ((fderiv ℂ h q) (0, 1)) q.2 :=
      hf.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hι₂
    have heq₁ : (fderiv ℂ h q) (1, 0) = iterDerivYT 1 0 h q := hd₁_raw.deriv.symm
    have heq₂ : (fderiv ℂ h q) (0, 1) = iterDerivYT 0 1 h q := hd₂_raw.deriv.symm
    have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, q.2)) (iterDerivYT 1 0 h q) q.1 :=
      heq₁ ▸ hd₁_raw
    have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (q.1, w)) (iterDerivYT 0 1 h q) q.2 :=
      heq₂ ▸ hd₂_raw
    have hf_eq :
        fderiv ℂ h q =
          π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 h q) +
            π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 h q) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have hv : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        ext <;> simp
      calc
        (fderiv ℂ h q) v
            = (fderiv ℂ h q) (v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) := by
              rw [← hv]
        _ = v.1 • (fderiv ℂ h q) (1, 0) + v.2 • (fderiv ℂ h q) (0, 1) := by
              rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        _ = v.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 h q + v.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 h q := by
              rw [heq₁, heq₂, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        _ = (π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 h q) +
              π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 h q)) v := by
              rfl
    exact ⟨hd₁, hd₂, hf_eq ▸ hf⟩
  have h_const_of_zero_partials :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ h W →
        (∀ q ∈ W, iterDerivYT 1 0 h q = 0 ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 h q = 0) →
        ∀ q₁ ∈ W, ∀ q₂ ∈ W, h q₁ = h q₂ := by
    intro W h hW hPre hh hZero q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂
    have hf_zero : Set.EqOn (fderiv ℂ h) 0 W := by
      intro q hq
      have hfd := (h_slice_fderiv hW hh q hq).2.2.fderiv
      rw [hfd, (hZero q hq).1, (hZero q hq).2]
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      simp
    exact hW.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero hPre hh hf_zero hq₁ hq₂
  have h_poincare :
      ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (P Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (c₀ : ℂ),
        IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → q₀ ∈ W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ P W → DifferentiableOn ℂ Q W →
        (∀ q ∈ W, iterDerivYT 0 1 P q = iterDerivYT 1 0 Q q) →
        ∃ F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ F W ∧
          F q₀ = c₀ ∧
          (∀ q ∈ W, iterDerivYT 1 0 F q = P q ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 F q = Q q) := by
    intro W P Q q₀ c₀ hW_open hW_conv hq₀ hP hQ hClosed
    let S₁ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁
    let S₂ := ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂
    let α_form : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun q => S₁ (P q) + S₂ (Q q)
    have hα_R : ∀ a ∈ W,
        HasFDerivAt (𝕜 := ℝ) α_form
          ((S₁.comp (π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 P a) +
              π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 P a)) +
            S₂.comp (π₁.smulRight (iterDerivYT 1 0 Q a) +
              π₂.smulRight (iterDerivYT 0 1 Q a))).restrictScalars ℝ) a := by
      intro a ha
      have hPa := (h_slice_fderiv hW_open hP a ha).2.2
      have hQa := (h_slice_fderiv hW_open hQ a ha).2.2
      exact ((S₁.hasFDerivAt.comp a hPa).add (S₂.hasFDerivAt.comp a hQa)).restrictScalars ℝ
    have hα_diff : DifferentiableOn ℝ α_form W :=
      fun a ha => (hα_R a ha).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hα_symm : ∀ a ∈ W, ∀ x y : ℂ × ℂ,
        ((fderiv ℝ α_form a) x) y = ((fderiv ℝ α_form a) y) x := by
      intro a ha x y
      rw [(hα_R a ha).fderiv]
      change y.1 * (x.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 P a + x.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 P a) +
          y.2 * (x.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 Q a + x.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 Q a) =
        x.1 * (y.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 P a + y.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 P a) +
          x.2 * (y.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 Q a + y.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 Q a)
      rw [hClosed a ha]
      ring
    obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ :=
      hW_conv.exists_forall_hasFDerivAt_of_fderiv_symmetric hW_open hα_diff hα_symm
    let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => F₀ q + (c₀ - F₀ q₀)
    have hF_fderiv : ∀ q ∈ W, HasFDerivAt F (α_form q) q :=
      fun q hq => (hF₀ q hq).add_const (c₀ - F₀ q₀)
    refine ⟨F, fun q hq => (hF_fderiv q hq).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
      add_sub_cancel (F₀ q₀) c₀, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    have hι₁ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) q.1 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
    have hι₂ : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) q.2 :=
      (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
    have hd₁ : iterDerivYT 1 0 F q = (α_form q) (1, 0) :=
      ((hF_fderiv q hq).comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hι₁).deriv
    have hd₂ : iterDerivYT 0 1 F q = (α_form q) (0, 1) :=
      ((hF_fderiv q hq).comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hι₂).deriv
    constructor
    · rw [hd₁]
      change (1 : ℂ) * P q + (0 : ℂ) * Q q = P q
      ring
    · rw [hd₂]
      change (0 : ℂ) * P q + (1 : ℂ) * Q q = Q q
      ring
  let P₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q / (6 * Reg.G_6 q)
  let Q₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q / (6 * Reg.G_6 q)
  have hGy_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6) Reg.U_reg :=
    (Reg.iterDerivYT_holo Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo).1
  have hGt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6) Reg.U_reg :=
    (Reg.iterDerivYT_holo Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo).2.1
  have h6G_nz : ∀ q ∈ Reg.U_reg, 6 * Reg.G_6 q ≠ 0 :=
    fun q hq => mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Reg.G_6_ne_zero q hq)
  have h6G_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => (6 * Reg.G_6 q)⁻¹) Reg.U_reg :=
    ((differentiableOn_const (6 : ℂ)).mul Reg.G_6_holo).inv h6G_nz
  have hP₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P₀ Reg.U_reg := by
    have h_eq : P₀ = fun q => iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q * (6 * Reg.G_6 q)⁻¹ :=
      funext fun q => div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hGy_holo.mul h6G_inv_holo
  have hQ₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q₀ Reg.U_reg := by
    have h_eq : Q₀ = fun q => iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q * (6 * Reg.G_6 q)⁻¹ :=
      funext fun q => div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hGt_holo.mul h6G_inv_holo
  have hPQ₀_closed : ∀ q ∈ Reg.U_reg, iterDerivYT 0 1 P₀ q = iterDerivYT 1 0 Q₀ q := by
    intro q hq
    have hd_Gy_t := (h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open hGy_holo q hq).2.1
    have hd_G_t := ((h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo q hq).2.1).const_mul (6 : ℂ)
    have hd_P₀_t :
        iterDerivYT 0 1 P₀ q =
          (iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6) q * (6 * Reg.G_6 q) -
            iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q * (6 * iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q)) /
            (6 * Reg.G_6 q) ^ 2 :=
      (hd_Gy_t.div hd_G_t (h6G_nz q hq)).deriv
    have hd_Gt_y := (h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open hGt_holo q hq).1
    have hd_G_y := ((h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo q hq).1).const_mul (6 : ℂ)
    have hd_Q₀_y :
        iterDerivYT 1 0 Q₀ q =
          (iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6) q * (6 * Reg.G_6 q) -
            iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q * (6 * iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q)) /
            (6 * Reg.G_6 q) ^ 2 :=
      (hd_Gt_y.div hd_G_y (h6G_nz q hq)).deriv
    rw [hd_P₀_t, hd_Q₀_y, Reg.iterDerivYT_comm Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo q hq]
    ring
  have h_exp_ansatz :
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ) (L : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → W ⊆ Reg.U_reg → q₀ ∈ W →
        w₀ ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q₀ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ L W → L q₀ = 0 →
        (∀ q ∈ W, iterDerivYT 1 0 L q = P₀ q ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 L q = Q₀ q) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => w₀ * Complex.exp (L q)) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => Reg.R_ratio q * (w₀ * Complex.exp (L q))) W ∧
        w₀ * Complex.exp (L q₀) = w₀ ∧
        (∀ q ∈ W, (w₀ * Complex.exp (L q)) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ W,
          iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun z => w₀ * Complex.exp (L z)) q =
            iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun z => Reg.R_ratio z * (w₀ * Complex.exp (L z))) q) := by
    intro W q₀ w₀ L hW_open hW_pre hW_sub hq₀ hw₀ hL_holo hL_zero hL_ode
    let g_y : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => w₀ * Complex.exp (L q)
    let g_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => Reg.R_ratio q * g_y q
    have hg_y_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_y W :=
      (differentiableOn_const w₀).mul hL_holo.cexp
    have hg_t_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_t W :=
      (Reg.R_ratio_holo.mono hW_sub).mul hg_y_holo
    have hg_y_q₀ : g_y q₀ = w₀ := by
      simp [g_y, hL_zero]
    have hg_y_partials : ∀ q ∈ W,
        HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2)) (g_y q * P₀ q) q.1 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w)) (g_y q * Q₀ q) q.2 := by
      intro q hq
      have hLy : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => L (z, q.2)) (P₀ q) q.1 := by
        rw [← (hL_ode q hq).1]
        exact (h_slice_fderiv hW_open hL_holo q hq).1
      have hLt : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => L (q.1, w)) (Q₀ q) q.2 := by
        rw [← (hL_ode q hq).2]
        exact (h_slice_fderiv hW_open hL_holo q hq).2.1
      have hgy_y : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2)) (w₀ * (Complex.exp (L q) * P₀ q)) q.1 :=
        hLy.cexp.const_mul w₀
      have hgy_t : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w)) (w₀ * (Complex.exp (L q) * Q₀ q)) q.2 :=
        hLt.cexp.const_mul w₀
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · convert hgy_y using 1; dsimp [g_y]; ring
      · convert hgy_t using 1; dsimp [g_y]; ring
    have hg_y_pow6 : ∀ q ∈ W, g_y q ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q := by
      let η : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => g_y q ^ 6 / Reg.G_6 q
      have hη_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ η W := by
        have h_eq : η = fun q => g_y q ^ 6 * (Reg.G_6 q)⁻¹ :=
          funext fun q => div_eq_mul_inv _ _
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hg_y_holo.pow 6).mul
          ((Reg.G_6_holo.mono hW_sub).inv (fun z hz => Reg.G_6_ne_zero z (hW_sub hz)))
      have hη_partials : ∀ q ∈ W,
          iterDerivYT 1 0 η q = 0 ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 η q = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        have hGq_nz : Reg.G_6 q ≠ 0 := Reg.G_6_ne_zero q (hW_sub hq)
        have hG_slice := h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open Reg.G_6_holo q (hW_sub hq)
        have hgy_slice := hg_y_partials q hq
        have hd_pow_y :
            HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2) ^ 6)
              ((6 : ℕ) * g_y q ^ (6 - 1) * (g_y q * P₀ q)) q.1 :=
          hgy_slice.1.pow 6
        have hd_pow_t :
            HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w) ^ 6)
              ((6 : ℕ) * g_y q ^ (6 - 1) * (g_y q * Q₀ q)) q.2 :=
          hgy_slice.2.pow 6
        have hd_η_y := (hd_pow_y.div hG_slice.1 hGq_nz).deriv
        have hd_η_t := (hd_pow_t.div hG_slice.2.1 hGq_nz).deriv
        constructor
        · change deriv (fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2) ^ 6 / Reg.G_6 (z, q.2)) q.1 = 0
          rw [show (fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2) ^ 6 / Reg.G_6 (z, q.2)) =
              ((fun z : ℂ => g_y (z, q.2) ^ 6) / (fun z : ℂ => Reg.G_6 (z, q.2))) from rfl,
            hd_η_y]
          dsimp [P₀]
          field_simp [hGq_nz]
          ring
        · change deriv (fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w) ^ 6 / Reg.G_6 (q.1, w)) q.2 = 0
          rw [show (fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w) ^ 6 / Reg.G_6 (q.1, w)) =
              ((fun w : ℂ => g_y (q.1, w) ^ 6) / (fun w : ℂ => Reg.G_6 (q.1, w))) from rfl,
            hd_η_t]
          dsimp [Q₀]
          field_simp [hGq_nz]
          ring
      intro q hq
      have hη_eq : η q = η q₀ :=
        h_const_of_zero_partials hW_open hW_pre hη_holo hη_partials q hq q₀ hq₀
      have hη_q₀ : η q₀ = 1 := by
        dsimp [η]
        rw [hg_y_q₀, hw₀, div_self (Reg.G_6_ne_zero q₀ (hW_sub hq₀))]
      exact (div_eq_one_iff_eq (Reg.G_6_ne_zero q (hW_sub hq))).mp (hη_eq.trans hη_q₀)
    have hg_compat : ∀ q ∈ W,
        iterDerivYT 0 1 g_y q = iterDerivYT 1 0 g_t q := by
      intro q hq
      have hGq_nz : Reg.G_6 q ≠ 0 := Reg.G_6_ne_zero q (hW_sub hq)
      have hd_gy_t : iterDerivYT 0 1 g_y q = g_y q * Q₀ q :=
        (hg_y_partials q hq).2.deriv
      have hR_y := (h_slice_fderiv Reg.U_reg_open Reg.R_ratio_holo q (hW_sub hq)).1
      have hd_gt_y :
          iterDerivYT 1 0 g_t q =
            iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.R_ratio q * g_y q + Reg.R_ratio q * (g_y q * P₀ q) :=
        (hR_y.mul (hg_y_partials q hq).1).deriv
      have hComp_q := Reg.compat_eq q (hW_sub hq)
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      rw [hd_gy_t, hd_gt_y]
      dsimp [P₀, Q₀]
      have h_alg :
          g_y q * (iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q / (6 * Reg.G_6 q)) -
            (iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.R_ratio q * g_y q +
              Reg.R_ratio q * (g_y q * (iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q / (6 * Reg.G_6 q)))) =
          g_y q * (iterDerivYT 0 1 Reg.G_6 q - Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.G_6 q -
            6 * Reg.G_6 q * iterDerivYT 1 0 Reg.R_ratio q) / (6 * Reg.G_6 q) := by
        field_simp [hGq_nz]
        ring
      rw [h_alg, hComp_q, mul_zero, zero_div]
    exact ⟨hg_y_holo, hg_t_holo, hg_y_q₀, hg_y_pow6, hg_compat⟩
  have h_overlap_unique :
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (𝔰₁ 𝔰₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → W ⊆ Reg.U_reg → q₀ ∈ W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₁ W → DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₂ W →
        (∀ q ∈ W, (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₁ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q) →
        (∀ q ∈ W, (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₂ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q) →
        𝔰₁ q₀ = 𝔰₂ q₀ →
        iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q₀ = iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q₀ →
        ∀ q ∈ W, 𝔰₁ q = 𝔰₂ q := by
    intro W q₀ 𝔰₁ 𝔰₂ hW_open hW_pre hW_sub hq₀ hHolo₁ hHolo₂ hODE₁ hODE₂ hVal_eq hDeriv_eq
    let g₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁
    let g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂
    have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ W := (Reg.iterDerivYT_holo hW_open hHolo₁).1
    have hg₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ W := (Reg.iterDerivYT_holo hW_open hHolo₂).1
    have hg₁_nz : ∀ q ∈ W, g₁ q ≠ 0 := by
      intro q hq h0
      apply Reg.G_6_ne_zero q (hW_sub hq)
      rw [← (hODE₁ q hq).1]
      change g₁ q ^ 6 = 0
      rw [h0]
      norm_num
    let ξ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => g₂ q / g₁ q
    have hξ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ξ W := by
      have h_eq : ξ = fun q => g₂ q * (g₁ q)⁻¹ :=
        funext fun q => div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hg₂_holo.mul (hg₁_holo.inv hg₁_nz)
    have hξ_pow6 : ∀ q ∈ W, ξ q ^ 6 = 1 := by
      intro q hq
      dsimp [ξ]
      rw [div_pow, (hODE₂ q hq).1, (hODE₁ q hq).1, div_self (Reg.G_6_ne_zero q (hW_sub hq))]
    have hξ_partials : ∀ q ∈ W,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 ξ q = 0 ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 ξ q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hξ_slice := h_slice_fderiv hW_open hξ_holo q hq
      have hξ5_nz : ξ q ^ 5 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h5
        have h1 := hξ_pow6 q hq
        have h6 : ξ q ^ 6 = ξ q ^ 5 * ξ q := by ring
        rw [h6, h5, zero_mul] at h1
        exact zero_ne_one h1
      have hVy_mem : {z : ℂ | (z, q.2) ∈ W} ∈ nhds q.1 :=
        (hW_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hq
      have hev_y : (fun z : ℂ => ξ (z, q.2) ^ 6) =ᶠ[nhds q.1] (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hVy_mem (fun z hz => hξ_pow6 (z, q.2) hz)
      have hpow_y : ((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ξ q ^ (6 - 1) * iterDerivYT 1 0 ξ q = 0 := by
        have hd := (hξ_slice.1.pow 6).deriv
        change deriv (fun z : ℂ => ξ (z, q.2) ^ 6) q.1 = _ at hd
        rw [hev_y.deriv_eq, deriv_const] at hd
        exact hd.symm
      have hVt_mem : {w : ℂ | (q.1, w) ∈ W} ∈ nhds q.2 :=
        (hW_open.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hq
      have hev_t : (fun w : ℂ => ξ (q.1, w) ^ 6) =ᶠ[nhds q.2] (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hVt_mem (fun w hw => hξ_pow6 (q.1, w) hw)
      have hpow_t : ((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ξ q ^ (6 - 1) * iterDerivYT 0 1 ξ q = 0 := by
        have hd := (hξ_slice.2.1.pow 6).deriv
        change deriv (fun w : ℂ => ξ (q.1, w) ^ 6) q.2 = _ at hd
        rw [hev_t.deriv_eq, deriv_const] at hd
        exact hd.symm
      have h6ξ5_nz : ((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ξ q ^ (6 - 1) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hξ5_nz
      exact ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp hpow_y).resolve_left h6ξ5_nz,
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hpow_t).resolve_left h6ξ5_nz⟩
    have hg_eq : ∀ q ∈ W, g₂ q = g₁ q := by
      intro q hq
      have hξ_eq : ξ q = ξ q₀ :=
        h_const_of_zero_partials hW_open hW_pre hξ_holo hξ_partials q hq q₀ hq₀
      have hξ_q₀ : ξ q₀ = 1 := by
        dsimp [ξ, g₁, g₂]
        rw [← hDeriv_eq, div_self (hg₁_nz q₀ hq₀)]
      exact (div_eq_one_iff_eq (hg₁_nz q hq)).mp (hξ_eq.trans hξ_q₀)
    let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => 𝔰₂ q - 𝔰₁ q
    have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ W := hHolo₂.sub hHolo₁
    have hΔ_partials : ∀ q ∈ W,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 Δ q = 0 ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 Δ q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      have hs₁ := h_slice_fderiv hW_open hHolo₁ q hq
      have hs₂ := h_slice_fderiv hW_open hHolo₂ q hq
      have hdy : iterDerivYT 1 0 Δ q = g₂ q - g₁ q :=
        (hs₂.1.sub hs₁.1).deriv
      have hdt : iterDerivYT 0 1 Δ q =
          iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₂ q - iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₁ q :=
        (hs₂.2.1.sub hs₁.2.1).deriv
      constructor
      · rw [hdy, hg_eq q hq, sub_self]
      · rw [hdt, (hODE₂ q hq).2, (hODE₁ q hq).2]
        change Reg.R_ratio q * g₂ q - Reg.R_ratio q * g₁ q = 0
        rw [hg_eq q hq, sub_self]
    intro q hq
    have hΔ_eq : Δ q = Δ q₀ :=
      h_const_of_zero_partials hW_open hW_pre hΔ_holo hΔ_partials q hq q₀ hq₀
    have hΔ_q₀ : Δ q₀ = 0 := by
      dsimp [Δ]
      rw [hVal_eq, sub_self]
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (hΔ_eq.trans hΔ_q₀)).symm
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨{
      c_zero := hc0
      ρ_zero := hρ0
      balls_valid := hValid
      overlaps_nonempty := hOverlap
      𝔰 := fun _ => K.𝔰_init
      𝔰_zero_eq := fun _ _ => rfl
      𝔰_holo := by
        intro k
        rw [Fin.eq_zero k, hc0, hρ0]
        exact K.𝔰_init_holo.mono (fun p hp => (Reg.ball_origin_sub hp).2)
      𝔰_ode := by
        intro k q hq
        rw [Fin.eq_zero k, hc0, hρ0] at hq
        exact Reg.init_ode q hq
      𝔰_overlap_eq := fun k => Fin.elim0 k
    }⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    let c' : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ := fun j => c j.castSucc
    let ρ' : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ := fun j => ρ j.castSucc
    have hc0' : c' 0 = ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa [c'] using hc0
    have hρ0' : ρ' 0 = Reg.r_origin := by
      simpa [ρ'] using hρ0
    have hValid' : ∀ j : Fin (N + 1), 0 < ρ' j ∧ Metric.ball (c' j) (ρ' j) ⊆ Reg.U_reg :=
      fun j => hValid j.castSucc
    have hOverlap' : ∀ j : Fin N,
        (Metric.ball (c' j.castSucc) (ρ' j.castSucc) ∩
          Metric.ball (c' j.succ) (ρ' j.succ)).Nonempty := by
      intro j
      have hov := hOverlap j.castSucc
      rwa [Fin.succ_castSucc] at hov
    obtain ⟨S_prev⟩ := ih c' ρ' hc0' hρ0' hValid' hOverlap'
    let k_N : Fin (N + 1) := Fin.last N
    let k_last : Fin (N + 2) := Fin.last (N + 1)
    have h_succ_kN : k_N.succ = k_last := Fin.succ_last N
    have hov_last_raw := hOverlap k_N
    rw [h_succ_kN] at hov_last_raw
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_prev, hq₀_last⟩ := hov_last_raw
    let B_prev : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (c k_N.castSucc) (ρ k_N.castSucc)
    let B_last : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (c k_last) (ρ k_last)
    have hSub_last : B_last ⊆ Reg.U_reg := (hValid k_last).2
    let w₀ : ℂ := iterDerivYT 1 0 (S_prev.𝔰 k_N) q₀
    let c_val : ℂ := S_prev.𝔰 k_N q₀
    have hw₀ : w₀ ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q₀ := (S_prev.𝔰_ode k_N q₀ hq₀_prev).1
    obtain ⟨L, hL_holo, hL_zero, hL_ode⟩ :=
      h_poincare P₀ Q₀ q₀ 0 Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) hq₀_last
        (hP₀_holo.mono hSub_last) (hQ₀_holo.mono hSub_last)
        (fun q hq => hPQ₀_closed q (hSub_last hq))
    obtain ⟨hg_y_holo, hg_t_holo, hg_y_q₀, hg_y_pow6, hg_compat⟩ :=
      h_exp_ansatz B_last q₀ w₀ L Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
        hSub_last hq₀_last hw₀ hL_holo hL_zero hL_ode
    obtain ⟨𝔰_last, h𝔰_last_holo, h𝔰_last_val, h𝔰_last_ode_raw⟩ :=
      h_poincare (fun q => w₀ * Complex.exp (L q))
        (fun q => Reg.R_ratio q * (w₀ * Complex.exp (L q)))
        q₀ c_val Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) hq₀_last
        hg_y_holo hg_t_holo hg_compat
    have h𝔰_last_ode : ∀ q ∈ B_last,
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰_last q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
        iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰_last q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰_last q := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h𝔰_last_ode_raw q hq
      exact ⟨by rw [h1]; exact hg_y_pow6 q hq, by rw [h1, h2]⟩
    have h_ov_last : ∀ q ∈ B_prev ∩ B_last, S_prev.𝔰 k_N q = 𝔰_last q := by
      apply h_overlap_unique (B_prev ∩ B_last) q₀ (S_prev.𝔰 k_N) 𝔰_last
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
        ((convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
        (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSub_last)
        ⟨hq₀_prev, hq₀_last⟩
        ((S_prev.𝔰_holo k_N).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (h𝔰_last_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
        (fun q hq => S_prev.𝔰_ode k_N q hq.1)
        (fun q hq => h𝔰_last_ode q hq.2)
        h𝔰_last_val.symm
      rw [(h𝔰_last_ode_raw q₀ hq₀_last).1, hg_y_q₀]
    let 𝔰_ext : Fin (N + 2) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := Fin.lastCases 𝔰_last S_prev.𝔰
    refine ⟨{
      c_zero := hc0
      ρ_zero := hρ0
      balls_valid := hValid
      overlaps_nonempty := hOverlap
      𝔰 := 𝔰_ext
      𝔰_zero_eq := by
        intro q hq
        have h0_eq : (0 : Fin (N + 2)) = (0 : Fin (N + 1)).castSucc := Fin.castSucc_zero.symm
        rw [h0_eq] at hq ⊢
        simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using S_prev.𝔰_zero_eq q hq
      𝔰_holo := by
        intro k
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
        · simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_last] using h𝔰_last_holo
        · intro j
          simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using S_prev.𝔰_holo j
      𝔰_ode := by
        intro k
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
        · intro q hq
          simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_last] using h𝔰_last_ode q hq
        · intro j q hq
          simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using S_prev.𝔰_ode j q hq
      𝔰_overlap_eq := by
        intro k
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ k
        · intro q hq
          rw [h_succ_kN] at hq ⊢
          simpa only [𝔰_ext, k_last, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_last] using
            h_ov_last q hq
        · intro j q hq
          rw [Fin.succ_castSucc] at hq ⊢
          simpa only [𝔰_ext, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using S_prev.𝔰_overlap_eq j q hq
    }⟩

(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (N : ℕ) (c : Fin (N + 1) → ℂ × ℂ) (ρ : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.fst
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_fst }
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.snd
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_snd }
  let ι₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun z => (z, 0)
          map_add' := fun z₁ z₂ => by ext <;> simp
          map_smul' := fun c z => by ext <;> simp }
      cont := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
  let ι₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun z => (0, z)
          map_add' := fun z₁ z₂ => by ext <;> simp
          map_smul' := fun c z => by ext <;> simp }
      cont := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id }
  
  have h_strip_open : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_strip_conv : ∀ H : ℝ, Convex ℝ (horizStrip H) := by
    intro H s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |(a • s₁ + b • s₂).im| < H
    change |s₁.im| < H at hs₁
    change |s₂.im| < H at hs₂
    have him : (a • s₁ + b • s₂).im = a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im := by
      simp [Complex.real_smul]
    rw [him]
    have htri : |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im| ≤ a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by
      calc |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im|
          = ‖a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖a * s₁.im‖ + ‖b * s₂.im‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |a * s₁.im| + |b * s₂.im| := by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ = a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · subst ha0
      have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      subst hb1
      linarith
    · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
      have h1 : a * |s₁.im| < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hs₁ ha_pos
      have h2 : b * |s₂.im| ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hs₂) hb
      have hsum : a * H + b * H = H := by linear_combination H * hab
      linarith
  have h_base_le : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ M.h_X 0 :=
    M.h_X_ge 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos)
  have h_base_sub_DH : horizStrip M.s_base ⊆ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
    intro s hs
    change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0
    change |s.im| < M.s_base at hs
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff M.s_base_pos).mpr hs) h_base_le
  have h0_DH : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) :=
    h_base_sub_DH (by show |(0 : ℂ).im| < M.s_base; simpa using M.s_base_pos)
  have h_finite_wall : M.h_X 0 ≠ ⊤ →
      0 < (M.h_X 0).toReal ∧
      M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal (M.h_X 0).toReal ∧
      horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) = horizStrip (M.h_X 0).toReal := by
    intro hTop
    have h_eq : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal (M.h_X 0).toReal :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hTop).symm
    have h_pos : 0 < (M.h_X 0).toReal := by
      have h_s_pos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos
      have h_h_pos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal (M.h_X 0).toReal :=
        h_eq ▸ lt_of_lt_of_le h_s_pos h_base_le
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp h_h_pos
    refine ⟨h_pos, h_eq, ?_⟩
    ext s
    change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < (M.h_X 0).toReal
    conv_lhs => rw [h_eq]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff h_pos
  have hDH_open_conv :
      IsOpen (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧ Convex ℝ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) := by
    by_cases hTop : M.h_X 0 = ⊤
    · have h_univ : horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) = Set.univ := by
        ext s
        simp [horizStripENNR, hTop, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top]
      rw [h_univ]
      exact ⟨isOpen_univ, convex_univ⟩
    · rw [(h_finite_wall hTop).2.2]
      exact ⟨h_strip_open _, h_strip_conv _⟩
  
  have h_nonvanishing_preconn :
      ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W → Convex ℝ W → DifferentiableOn ℂ h W →
        IsOpen { q ∈ W | h q ≠ 0 } ∧ IsPreconnected { q ∈ W | h q ≠ 0 } := by
    intro W h hW_open hW_conv hh_holo
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro q ⟨hqW, hqnz⟩
      have hcont : ContinuousAt h q := hh_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW_open.mem_nhds hqW)
      exact Filter.Eventually.and (hW_open.mem_nhds hqW) (hcont.eventually_ne hqnz)
    · intro U V hU hV hUV ⟨p₁, ⟨hp₁W, hp₁nz⟩, hp₁U⟩ ⟨p₂, ⟨hp₂W, hp₂nz⟩, hp₂V⟩
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z =>
        p₁ + ι₁ (z * (p₂.1 - p₁.1)) + ι₂ (z * (p₂.2 - p₁.2))
      have hφ_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, φ z = (p₁.1 + z * (p₂.1 - p₁.1), p₁.2 + z * (p₂.2 - p₁.2)) := by
        intro z
        ext <;> simp [φ, ι₁, ι₂]
      have hφ_diff : Differentiable ℂ φ :=
        ((differentiable_const p₁).add
          (ι₁.differentiable.comp (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))).add
          (ι₂.differentiable.comp (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const _)))
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = p₁ := by rw [hφ_eq]; ext <;> simp
      have hφ1 : φ 1 = p₂ := by rw [hφ_eq]; ext <;> simp
      let D : Set ℂ := φ ⁻¹' W
      have hD_open : IsOpen D := hW_open.preimage hφ_diff.continuous
      have h0D : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D := by show φ 0 ∈ W; rwa [hφ0]
      have h1D : (1 : ℂ) ∈ D := by show φ 1 ∈ W; rwa [hφ1]
      have hD_conv : Convex ℝ D := by
        intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
        show φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) ∈ W
        have hφ_aff : φ (a • z₁ + b • z₂) = a • φ z₁ + b • φ z₂ := by
          rw [hφ_eq, hφ_eq, hφ_eq]
          ext <;> simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, Complex.real_smul]
          · calc p₁.1 + (↑a * z₁ + ↑b * z₂) * (p₂.1 - p₁.1)
                = ((↑a + ↑b : ℂ)) * p₁.1 + (↑a * z₁ + ↑b * z₂) * (p₂.1 - p₁.1) := by
                    rw [← Complex.ofReal_add, hab, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
              _ = ↑a * (p₁.1 + z₁ * (p₂.1 - p₁.1)) + ↑b * (p₁.1 + z₂ * (p₂.1 - p₁.1)) := by ring
          · calc p₁.2 + (↑a * z₁ + ↑b * z₂) * (p₂.2 - p₁.2)
                = ((↑a + ↑b : ℂ)) * p₁.2 + (↑a * z₁ + ↑b * z₂) * (p₂.2 - p₁.2) := by
                    rw [← Complex.ofReal_add, hab, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
              _ = ↑a * (p₁.2 + z₁ * (p₂.2 - p₁.2)) + ↑b * (p₁.2 + z₂ * (p₂.2 - p₁.2)) := by ring
        rw [hφ_aff]
        exact hW_conv hz₁ hz₂ ha hb hab
      let S₀ : Set ℂ := Complex.ofReal '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
      have hS₀_comp : IsCompact S₀ := isCompact_Icc.image Complex.continuous_ofReal
      have hS₀_sub : S₀ ⊆ D := by
        rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
        have ht_eq : (t : ℂ) = (1 - t) • (0 : ℂ) + t • (1 : ℂ) := by
          simp [Complex.real_smul]
        rw [ht_eq]
        exact hD_conv h0D h1D (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) ht.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 t)
      obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_sub⟩ := hS₀_comp.exists_thickening_subset_open hD_open hS₀_sub
      let δ₁ : ℝ := δ₀ / 2
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := half_pos hδ₀_pos
      let K_rect : Set ℂ := Complex.reProdIm (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (-δ₁) δ₁)
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K_rect := isCompact_Icc.reProdIm isCompact_Icc
      have hK_sub : K_rect ⊆ D := by
        intro w hw
        apply hδ₀_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
        refine ⟨(w.re : ℂ), ⟨w.re, hw.1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        have hw_diff : w - (w.re : ℂ) = (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          have := Complex.re_add_im w
          linear_combination -this
        rw [dist_eq_norm, hw_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have him_le : |w.im| ≤ δ₀ / 2 := abs_le.mpr hw.2
        linarith
      let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => h (φ z)
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g D :=
        hh_holo.comp hφ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)
      have hg_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g D := hg_holo.analyticOnNhd hD_open
      have hg0 : g 0 ≠ 0 := by show h (φ 0) ≠ 0; rwa [hφ0]
      have hg1 : g 1 ≠ 0 := by show h (φ 1) ≠ 0; rwa [hφ1]
      obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a_pos, hr_a_nz⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
          ((hg_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD_open.mem_nhds h0D)).eventually_ne hg0)
      obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b_pos, hr_b_nz⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
          ((hg_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD_open.mem_nhds h1D)).eventually_ne hg1)
      have h_iso : ∀ w ∈ K_rect, ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball w r, z ≠ w → g z ≠ 0 := by
        intro w hw
        rcases (hg_ana w (hK_sub hw)).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hzero | hnz
        · exfalso
          exact hg0 (hg_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            hD_conv.isPreconnected (hK_sub hw) hzero h0D)
        · rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball] at hnz
          obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_prop⟩ := hnz
          exact ⟨r, hr_pos, fun z hz hzw => hr_prop z hz hzw⟩
      classical
      let r_iso : ∀ w : K_rect, ℝ := fun w => (h_iso w.1 w.2).choose
      have hr_iso_spec : ∀ w : K_rect,
          0 < r_iso w ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball w.1 (r_iso w), z ≠ w.1 → g z ≠ 0 :=
        fun w => (h_iso w.1 w.2).choose_spec
      obtain ⟨t_fin, ht_cover⟩ := hK_comp.elim_finite_subcover
        (fun w : K_rect => Metric.ball w.1 (r_iso w))
        (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
        (fun w hw => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_iso_spec ⟨w, hw⟩).1⟩)
      let Z_K : Set ℂ := { w ∈ K_rect | g w = 0 }
      have hZK_fin : Z_K.Finite := by
        refine ((t_fin.finite_toSet).image (fun w : K_rect => w.1)).subset ?_
        rintro z ⟨hzK, hgz⟩
        have hz_cov := ht_cover hzK
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz_cov
        obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hz_ball⟩ := hz_cov
        refine ⟨w, hw_mem, ?_⟩
        by_contra hne
        exact (hr_iso_spec w).2 z hz_ball (Ne.symm hne) hgz
      let δ : ℝ := min δ₁ (min r_a r_b)
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁_pos (lt_min hr_a_pos hr_b_pos)
      have hδ_le_δ₁ : δ ≤ δ₁ := min_le_left _ _
      have hδ_le_ra : δ ≤ r_a := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
      have hδ_le_rb : δ ≤ r_b := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
      obtain ⟨η, hη_Ioo, hη_not_im⟩ :=
        ((Set.Ioo_infinite (by linarith : -δ < δ)).sdiff (hZK_fin.image Complex.im)).nonempty
      have hη_abs : |η| < δ := abs_lt.mpr hη_Ioo
      let γ_ℂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun s =>
        if s ≤ 1 / 3 then ((3 * s * η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        else if s ≤ 2 / 3 then ((3 * s - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I
        else (1 : ℂ) + (((3 - 3 * s) * η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hγℂ_cont : Continuous γ_ℂ := by
        refine Continuous.if_le ?_ ?_ continuous_id continuous_const ?_
        · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
            ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).mul continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
        · refine Continuous.if_le ?_ ?_ continuous_id continuous_const ?_
          · exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
              ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).sub continuous_const)).add continuous_const
          · exact continuous_const.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
              ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul continuous_const)).mul
              continuous_const)
          · intro s hs
            subst hs
            norm_num
        · intro s hs
          subst hs
          norm_num
      have hγℂ_0 : γ_ℂ 0 = 0 := by norm_num [γ_ℂ]
      have hγℂ_1 : γ_ℂ 1 = 1 := by norm_num [γ_ℂ]
      have hγℂ_valid : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ_ℂ s ∈ K_rect ∧ g (γ_ℂ s) ≠ 0 := by
        intro s ⟨hs0, hs1⟩
        show γ_ℂ s ∈ Complex.reProdIm (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (-δ₁) δ₁) ∧
          h (φ (γ_ℂ s)) ≠ 0

    intro U 𝔰 q_star hU_open h𝔰_holo hgy_holo hgt_holo hq_star hgy_ne

          K.f (𝔰 q) ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰 q) i := by
    intro c_b ρ_b 𝔰 q₀ r₀ hρ_b hB_sub h𝔰_holo h𝔰_deriv_ne hq₀_B hr₀ hseed_sub hseed_prop
    let B : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball c_b ρ_b
    have h_conf : ∀ q₁ ∈ B, 𝔰 q₁ ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
      intro q₁ hq₁_B
      by_cases hTop : M.h_X 0 = ⊤
      · show ENNReal.ofReal |(𝔰 q₁).im| < M.h_X 0
        rw [hTop]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
      · obtain ⟨hH₀_pos, hH₀_eq, hDH_eq⟩ := h_finite_wall hTop
        let H₀ : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
        rw [hDH_eq]
        change |(𝔰 q₁).im| < H₀
        by_contra h_not_lt
        have hq₁_ge : H₀ ≤ |(𝔰 q₁).im| := not_lt.mp h_not_lt
        have hq₀_lt : |(𝔰 q₀).im| < H₀ := by
          have hq₀_in := (hseed_prop q₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀)).1
          rwa [hDH_eq] at hq₀_in
        obtain ⟨q_star, hq_star_B, h_im_eq, h_tube_gen⟩ :=
          h_first_exit_tube B 𝔰 H₀ q₀ q₁ Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball c_b ρ_b)
            h𝔰_holo.continuousOn hq₀_B hq₁_B hq₀_lt hq₁_ge
        have h_partials := Reg.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball h𝔰_holo
        obtain ⟨r_src, ε, ψ, hr_src, hε, h_src_sub, hψ_slice, hψ_left⟩ :=
          h_shear_inv B 𝔰 q_star Metric.isOpen_ball h𝔰_holo h_partials.1 h_partials.2.1
            hq_star_B (h𝔰_deriv_ne q_star hq_star_B)
        obtain ⟨q_δ, T_δ, η_δ, hη_δ, hqδ_src, hsδ_ball, htδ_ball,
            hT_open, hT_conv, hT_sub_B, hT_im, hball0_T, hballδ_T⟩ :=
          h_tube_gen r_src ε hr_src hε
        let r_seed : ℝ := min r₀ η_δ
        have hr_seed_pos : 0 < r_seed := lt_min hr₀ hη_δ
        have hseed_T : Metric.ball q₀ r_seed ⊆ T_δ :=
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right r₀ η_δ)).trans hball0_T
        have hseed_r₀ : Metric.ball q₀ r_seed ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ r₀ :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r₀ η_δ)
        have hT_DH : ∀ p ∈ T_δ, 𝔰 p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
          intro p hp
          rw [hDH_eq]
          exact hT_im p hp
        have hT_impact := h_prop_convex T_δ 𝔰 q₀ r_seed hT_open hT_conv
          (hT_sub_B.trans hB_sub) (h𝔰_holo.mono hT_sub_B) hT_DH
          (fun p hp => h𝔰_deriv_ne p (hT_sub_B hp)) hr_seed_pos hseed_T
          (fun q hq => ⟨(hseed_prop q (hseed_r₀ hq)).2.1, (hseed_prop q (hseed_r₀ hq)).2.2⟩)
        let s_star : ℂ := 𝔰 q_star
        let x_star : ℝ := s_star.re
        let sgn : ℝ := if s_star.im = H₀ then 1 else -1
        have hsgn_cases : sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1 := by
          dsimp only [sgn]
          split_ifs <;> simp
        have hs_star_eq : s_star = (x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          have him_cases : s_star.im = H₀ ∨ s_star.im = -H₀ :=
            (abs_eq (le_of_lt hH₀_pos)).mp h_im_eq
          have him_val : sgn * H₀ = s_star.im := by
            rcases him_cases with h_pos | h_neg
            · simp [sgn, h_pos]
            · have h_neg_ne : -H₀ ≠ H₀ := by linarith
              simp [sgn, h_neg, h_neg_ne]
          rw [him_val]
          exact (Complex.re_add_im s_star).symm
        obtain ⟨hψ_z_holo, hψ_z_inv⟩ := hψ_slice q_δ.2 htδ_ball
        let φ_z : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => ((0 : ℂ), q_δ.2) + ι₁ (ψ (z, q_δ.2))
        have hφz_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, φ_z z = (ψ (z, q_δ.2), q_δ.2) :=
          fun z => by ext <;> simp [φ_z, ι₁]
        have hφz_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ_z (Metric.ball s_star ε) :=
          (differentiableOn_const ((0 : ℂ), q_δ.2)).add
            (ι₁.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hψ_z_holo)
        have hφz_Ureg : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s_star ε, φ_z z ∈ Reg.U_reg := by
          intro z hz
          rw [hφz_eq]
          exact hB_sub (h_src_sub (hψ_z_inv z hz).1)
        let g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun i z => Reg.X_true i (φ_z z)
        have hg_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
            MeromorphicOn (g i)
              (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) := by
          intro i
          rw [← hs_star_eq]
          have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g i) (Metric.ball s_star ε) :=
            (Reg.X_true_holo i).comp hφz_holo hφz_Ureg
          exact (hg_holo.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball).meromorphicOn
        let s_δ : ℂ := 𝔰 q_δ
        have hsδ_strip : s_δ ∈ horizStrip H₀ :=
          hT_im q_δ (hballδ_T (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_δ))
        have hφz_sδ : φ_z s_δ = q_δ := by
          rw [hφz_eq, hψ_left q_δ hqδ_src]
        have hφz_contAt : ContinuousAt φ_z s_δ :=
          hφz_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hsδ_ball)
        have h_ov_nhds : ∀ᶠ z in nhds s_δ,
            z ∈ Metric.ball s_star ε ∧ z ∈ horizStrip H₀ ∧ φ_z z ∈ Metric.ball q_δ η_δ := by
          refine Filter.Eventually.and (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hsδ_ball)
            (Filter.Eventually.and ((h_strip_open H₀).mem_nhds hsδ_strip) ?_)
          have h_ball_nhds : Metric.ball q_δ η_δ ∈ nhds (φ_z s_δ) := by
            rw [hφz_sδ]
            exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds q_δ hη_δ
          exact hφz_contAt.eventually h_ball_nhds
        obtain ⟨ρ_ov, hρ_ov_pos, hρ_ov_spec⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp h_ov_nhds
        let V_overlap : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_δ ρ_ov
        refine K.no_1d_patch_Γ H₀ x_star sgn ε hH₀_eq hsgn_cases hε
          ⟨g, hg_mero 0, hg_mero 1, V_overlap, Metric.isOpen_ball,
            ⟨s_δ, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_ov_pos⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz
          rw [← hs_star_eq]
          exact ⟨(hρ_ov_spec z hz).1, (hρ_ov_spec z hz).2.1⟩
        · intro i z hz
          have hz_ball_s : z ∈ Metric.ball s_star ε := (hρ_ov_spec z hz).1
          have hφz_T : φ_z z ∈ T_δ := hballδ_T (hρ_ov_spec z hz).2.2
          have hX_eq := (hT_impact (φ_z z) hφz_T).2 i
          have h𝔰_φz : 𝔰 (φ_z z) = z := by
            rw [hφz_eq]
            exact (hψ_z_inv z hz_ball_s).2
          show Reg.X_true i (φ_z z) = K.Γ z i
          rw [hX_eq, h𝔰_φz]
    have h_full := h_prop_convex B 𝔰 q₀ r₀ Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball c_b ρ_b)
      hB_sub h𝔰_holo h_conf h𝔰_deriv_ne hr₀ hseed_sub
      (fun q hq => ⟨(hseed_prop q hq).2.1, (hseed_prop q hq).2.2⟩)
    exact fun q hq => ⟨h_conf q hq, (h_full q hq).1, (h_full q hq).2⟩
  
  have h_chain_deriv_ne : ∀ (k : Fin (N + 1)), ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k),
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (S.𝔰 k) q ≠ 0 := by
    intro k q hq hzero
    apply Reg.G_6_ne_zero q ((S.balls_valid k).2 hq)
    rw [← (S.𝔰_ode k q hq).1, hzero]
    norm_num
  intro k
  refine Fin.induction ?_ ?_ k
  · intro q hq
    have hq_orig : q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin := by
      rwa [← S.c_zero, ← S.ρ_zero]
    have h_sub := Reg.ball_origin_sub hq_orig
    have h_s0_eq : S.𝔰 0 q = K.𝔰_init q := S.𝔰_zero_eq q hq
    have h_in_base : K.𝔰_init q ∈ horizStrip M.s_base := by
      have hpair : K.𝔰_init q = K.𝔰_init (q.1, q.2) := by rw [Prod.mk.eta]
      rw [hpair]
      exact K.𝔰_init_maps_to q.1 q.2 h_sub.2.1 h_sub.2.2
    rw [h_s0_eq]
    exact ⟨h_base_sub_DH h_in_base, K.f_base_ne_zero _ h_in_base,
      Reg.X_true_origin_eq q hq_orig⟩
  · intro m ih
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_prev, hq₀_next⟩ := S.overlaps_nonempty m
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
        q₀ ⟨hq₀_prev, hq₀_next⟩
    have h_seed_next : ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r₀,
        S.𝔰 m.succ q' ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        K.f (S.𝔰 m.succ q') ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q' = K.Γ (S.𝔰 m.succ q') i := by
      intro q' hq'
      have h_eq : S.𝔰 m.castSucc q' = S.𝔰 m.succ q' := S.𝔰_overlap_eq m q' (hr₀_sub hq')
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact ih q' (hr₀_sub hq').1
    exact h_ball_step (c m.succ) (ρ m.succ) (S.𝔰 m.succ) q₀ r₀
      (S.balls_valid m.succ).1 (S.balls_valid m.succ).2
      (S.𝔰_holo m.succ) (h_chain_deriv_ne m.succ)
      hq₀_next hr₀_pos (fun q' hq' => (hr₀_sub hq').2) h_seed_next

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (p : ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ) (𝔰₁ 𝔰₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (hSub : Metric.ball p r ⊆ Reg.U_reg)
    (hHolo₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₁ (Metric.ball p r))
    (hHolo₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰₂ (Metric.ball p r))
    (hODE₁ : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
      (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
      iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₁ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₁ q)
    (hODE₂ : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
      (iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 q ∧
      iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰₂ q = Reg.R_ratio q * iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰₂ q)
    (hLift₁ : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
      𝔰₁ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      K.f (𝔰₁ q) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰₁ q) i)
    (hLift₂ : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r,
      𝔰₂ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      K.f (𝔰₂ q) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰₂ q) i) :
    ∃ (ζ b s₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ),
      ζ ^ 6 = 1 ∧
      0 < δ ∧
      𝔰₂ p = ζ * 𝔰₁ p + b ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ,
        s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        ζ * s + b ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
        K.f s ≠ 0 ∧
        K.f (ζ * s + b) ≠ 0 ∧
        K.Γ (ζ * s + b) = K.Γ s

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases p with ⟨y_p, t_p⟩
  let U_y : Set ℂ := Metric.ball y_p r
  have hy_p : y_p ∈ U_y := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
  let ι_p : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun y => (y, t_p)
  have h_in : ∀ y ∈ U_y, (y, t_p) ∈ Metric.ball (y_p, t_p) r := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    exact max_lt hy (by simp [hr])
  have h_maps : Set.MapsTo ι_p U_y (Metric.ball (y_p, t_p) r) := fun y hy => h_in y hy
  have hHolo_ι : DifferentiableOn ℂ ι_p U_y :=
    differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const t_p)
  let h₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => 𝔰₁ (y, t_p)
  let h₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => 𝔰₂ (y, t_p)
  have hHolo_h₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₁ U_y := hHolo₁.comp hHolo_ι h_maps
  have hHolo_h₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₂ U_y := hHolo₂.comp hHolo_ι h_maps
  have h1_pow6 : ∀ y ∈ U_y, (deriv h₁ y) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 (y, t_p) :=
    fun y hy => (hODE₁ (y, t_p) (h_in y hy)).1
  have h2_pow6 : ∀ y ∈ U_y, (deriv h₂ y) ^ 6 = Reg.G_6 (y, t_p) :=
    fun y hy => (hODE₂ (y, t_p) (h_in y hy)).1
  have hG6_nz : ∀ y ∈ U_y, Reg.G_6 (y, t_p) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => Reg.G_6_ne_zero (y, t_p) (hSub (h_in y hy))
  have h1_nz : ∀ y ∈ U_y, deriv h₁ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    have h6 := h1_pow6 y hy
    rw [h0, zero_pow (by norm_num)] at h6
    exact hG6_nz y hy h6.symm
  let η : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => deriv h₂ y / deriv h₁ y
  have hHolo_η : DifferentiableOn ℂ η U_y :=
    (hHolo_h₂.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).div (hHolo_h₁.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball) h1_nz
  have hη6 : ∀ y ∈ U_y, η y ^ 6 = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    dsimp [η]
    rw [div_pow, h2_pow6 y hy, h1_pow6 y hy, div_self (hG6_nz y hy)]
  have hη_nz : ∀ y ∈ U_y, η y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    have h6 := hη6 y hy
    rw [h0, zero_pow (by norm_num)] at h6
    exact zero_ne_one h6
  have hη_deriv : Set.EqOn (deriv η) 0 U_y := by
    intro y hy
    have h_nhds : U_y ∈ nhds y := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => η z ^ 6) (((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * η y ^ 5 * deriv η y) y :=
      (hHolo_η.hasDerivAt h_nhds).fun_pow 6
    have hev : (fun z => η z ^ 6) =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem h_nhds (fun z hz => hη6 z hz)
    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => η z ^ 6) 0 y :=
      hev.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr (hasDerivAt_const y (1 : ℂ))
    have hu : ((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * η y ^ 5 * deriv η y = 0 := hd1.unique hd2
    have hc_nz : ((6 : ℕ) : ℂ) * η y ^ 5 ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 5 (hη_nz y hy))
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hu).resolve_left hc_nz
  have hU_pre : IsPreconnected U_y := (convex_ball y_p r).isPreconnected
  let ζ : ℂ := η y_p
  have hζ6 : ζ ^ 6 = 1 := hη6 y_p hy_p
  have hη_const : ∀ y ∈ U_y, η y = ζ :=
    fun y hy => Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hU_pre hHolo_η hη_deriv hy hy_p
  have hd_rel : ∀ y ∈ U_y, deriv h₂ y = ζ * deriv h₁ y :=
    fun y hy => (div_eq_iff (h1_nz y hy)).mp (hη_const y hy)
  let Δ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => h₂ y - ζ * h₁ y
  have hHolo_Δ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ U_y := hHolo_h₂.sub (hHolo_h₁.const_mul ζ)
  have hΔ_deriv : Set.EqOn (deriv Δ) 0 U_y := by
    intro y hy
    have h_nhds : U_y ∈ nhds y := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy
    have hd : HasDerivAt Δ (deriv h₂ y - ζ * deriv h₁ y) y :=
      (hHolo_h₂.hasDerivAt h_nhds).sub ((hHolo_h₁.hasDerivAt h_nhds).const_mul ζ)
    change deriv Δ y = 0
    rw [hd.deriv, hd_rel y hy, sub_self]
  let b : ℂ := Δ y_p
  have hΔ_const : ∀ y ∈ U_y, Δ y = b :=
    fun y hy => Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hU_pre hHolo_Δ hΔ_deriv hy hy_p
  have hh_aff : ∀ y ∈ U_y, h₂ y = ζ * h₁ y + b := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hΔ_const y hy
    dsimp [Δ] at h
    linear_combination h
  have hp_aff : 𝔰₂ (y_p, t_p) = ζ * 𝔰₁ (y_p, t_p) + b := hh_aff y_p hy_p
  have h_strict : HasStrictDerivAt h₁ (deriv h₁ y_p) y_p :=
    (hHolo_h₁.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y_p hr)).hasStrictDerivAt
  have h_nz_p : deriv h₁ y_p ≠ 0 := h1_nz y_p hy_p
  let s₀ : ℂ := h₁ y_p
  let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := h_strict.localInverse h₁ (deriv h₁ y_p) y_p h_nz_p
  have hψ_base : ψ s₀ = y_p := (h_strict.eventually_left_inverse h_nz_p).self_of_nhds
  have hψ_cont : ContinuousAt ψ s₀ := (h_strict.to_localInverse h_nz_p).hasDerivAt.continuousAt
  have hψ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto ψ (nhds s₀) (nhds y_p) := by
    rw [← hψ_base]
    exact hψ_cont.tendsto
  have hψ_ev_mem : ∀ᶠ s in nhds s₀, ψ s ∈ U_y :=
    hψ_tendsto.eventually_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y_p hr)
  have hψ_ev_inv : ∀ᶠ s in nhds s₀, h₁ (ψ s) = s := h_strict.eventually_right_inverse h_nz_p
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball_ψ⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hψ_ev_mem.and hψ_ev_inv)
  refine ⟨ζ, b, s₀, δ, hζ6, hδ, hp_aff, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hψ_mem, hψ_eq⟩ := hball_ψ s hs
  let q_s : ℂ × ℂ := (ψ s, t_p)
  have hq_s : q_s ∈ Metric.ball (y_p, t_p) r := h_in (ψ s) hψ_mem
  have hs₁_eq : 𝔰₁ q_s = s := hψ_eq
  have hs₂_eq : 𝔰₂ q_s = ζ * s + b := by
    change h₂ (ψ s) = ζ * s + b
    rw [hh_aff (ψ s) hψ_mem, hψ_eq]
  obtain ⟨hL₁_strip, hL₁_f, hL₁_Γ⟩ := hLift₁ q_s hq_s
  obtain ⟨hL₂_strip, hL₂_f, hL₂_Γ⟩ := hLift₂ q_s hq_s
  rw [hs₁_eq] at hL₁_strip hL₁_f hL₁_Γ
  rw [hs₂_eq] at hL₂_strip hL₂_f hL₂_Γ
  exact ⟨hL₁_strip, hL₂_strip, hL₁_f, hL₂_f,
    funext fun i => (hL₂_Γ i).symm.trans (hL₁_Γ i)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (ζ b s₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hζ : ζ ^ 6 = 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hDom : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ,
      s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      ζ * s + b ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      K.f s ≠ 0 ∧
      K.f (ζ * s + b) ≠ 0 ∧
      K.Γ (ζ * s + b) = K.Γ s) :
    ζ = 1 ∧ ∃ k : ℤ, b = (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)

signature.name: curve_affine_symmetry_trivial
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (ζ b s₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hζ : ζ ^ 6 = 1)
    (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hDom : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ,
      s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      ζ * s + b ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
      K.f s ≠ 0 ∧
      K.f (ζ * s + b) ≠ 0 ∧
      K.Γ (ζ * s + b) = K.Γ s) :
    ζ = 1 ∧ ∃ k : ℤ, b = (k : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)

proof.tactics:
by
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)
  let D_ov : Set ℂ := {z : ℂ | z ∈ D_H ∧ ζ * z + b ∈ D_H}
  have hs₀_ball : s₀ ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ := Metric.mem_ball_self hδ
  have hs₀_ov : s₀ ∈ D_ov := ⟨(hDom s₀ hs₀_ball).1, (hDom s₀ hs₀_ball).2.1⟩
  have h_base_le : ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base ≤ M.h_X 0 :=
    M.h_X_ge 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self M.r_base_pos)
  have h_real_mem : ∀ y : ℝ, (y : ℂ) ∈ D_H := by
    intro y
    change ENNReal.ofReal |(y : ℂ).im| < M.h_X 0
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos) h_base_le
  have h_f_real_ne : ∀ y : ℝ, K.f (y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hfy
    have hpos := (K.f_real_pos y).1
    rw [hfy, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  have h_real_root : ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 6 = 1 → z.im = 0 → z = 1 ∨ z = -1 := by
    intro z hz6 hzim
    let r : ℝ := z.re
    have hz_eq : z = (r : ℂ) := Complex.ext rfl hzim
    have hr6 : r ^ 6 = 1 := by
      rw [hz_eq] at hz6
      exact_mod_cast hz6
    have hfac : (r - 1) * (r + 1) * (r ^ 4 + r ^ 2 + 1) = 0 := by
      calc (r - 1) * (r + 1) * (r ^ 4 + r ^ 2 + 1) = r ^ 6 - 1 := by ring
        _ = 0 := by linarith
    have hpos4 : r ^ 4 + r ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r ^ 2), sq_nonneg r])
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hfac).resolve_right hpos4) with hr1 | hr_neg1
    · left
      have hr : r = 1 := by linarith
      simp [hz_eq, hr]
    · right
      have hr : r = -1 := by linarith
      simp [hz_eq, hr]
  have hH_open_strip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) := fun H =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hDH_open_conv : IsOpen D_H ∧ Convex ℝ D_H := by
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLtTop
    · have hUniv : D_H = Set.univ := by
        ext s
        simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, hTop]
      rw [hUniv]
      exact ⟨isOpen_univ, convex_univ⟩
    · let H₀ : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH₀_eq : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLtTop)).symm
      have hH₀_pos : 0 < H₀ := by
        by_contra h_le
        push_neg at h_le
        have h0 : M.h_X 0 = 0 := by rw [hH₀_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr h_le]
        have hs_pos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (h0 ▸ h_base_le)) hs_pos
      have hStrip : D_H = horizStrip H₀ := by
        ext s
        change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H₀
        rw [hH₀_eq]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₀_pos
      rw [hStrip]
      refine ⟨hH_open_strip H₀, ?_⟩
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu12
      change |(u₁ • z₁ + u₂ • z₂).im| < H₀
      have hz₁' : |z₁.im| < H₀ := hz₁
      have hz₂' : |z₂.im| < H₀ := hz₂
      have him : (u₁ • z₁ + u₂ • z₂).im = u₁ * z₁.im + u₂ * z₂.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu₁ with rfl | hu₁_pos
      · have hu₂_eq : u₂ = 1 := by linarith
        rw [hu₂_eq]
        simpa using hz₂'
      · obtain ⟨hz₁_l, hz₁_u⟩ := abs_lt.mp hz₁'
        obtain ⟨hz₂_l, hz₂_u⟩ := abs_lt.mp hz₂'
        have h_low1 : 0 < u₁ * (z₁.im + H₀) := mul_pos hu₁_pos (by linarith)
        have h_low2 : 0 ≤ u₂ * (z₂.im + H₀) := mul_nonneg hu₂ (by linarith)
        have h_up1 : 0 < u₁ * (H₀ - z₁.im) := mul_pos hu₁_pos (by linarith)
        have h_up2 : 0 ≤ u₂ * (H₀ - z₂.im) := mul_nonneg hu₂ (by linarith)
        have hid_l : u₁ * z₁.im + u₂ * z₂.im + H₀ =
            u₁ * (z₁.im + H₀) + u₂ * (z₂.im + H₀) := by linear_combination H₀ * hu12.symm
        have hid_u : H₀ - (u₁ * z₁.im + u₂ * z₂.im) =
            u₁ * (H₀ - z₁.im) + u₂ * (H₀ - z₂.im) := by linear_combination H₀ * hu12.symm
        exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_aff_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w + b) := by fun_prop
  have hDov_open : IsOpen D_ov :=
    hDH_open_conv.1.inter (hDH_open_conv.1.preimage h_aff_diff.continuous)
  have hDov_conv : Convex ℝ D_ov := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu12
    refine ⟨hDH_open_conv.2 hz₁.1 hz₂.1 hu₁ hu₂ hu12, ?_⟩
    have h_aff_comb : ζ * (u₁ • z₁ + u₂ • z₂) + b =
        u₁ • (ζ * z₁ + b) + u₂ • (ζ * z₂ + b) := by
      have hu12_c : (u₁ : ℂ) + (u₂ : ℂ) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hu12
      simp only [Complex.real_smul]
      linear_combination -b * hu12_c
    rw [h_aff_comb]
    exact hDH_open_conv.2 hz₁.2 hz₂.2 hu₁ hu₂ hu12
  have hDov_pre : IsPreconnected D_ov := hDov_conv.isPreconnected
  have hΓ_mero_i : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (fun w => K.Γ w i) D_H := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact K.Γ_mero.1
    · exact K.Γ_mero.2
  have hΓ_reg_i : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ s ∈ D_H, K.f s ≠ 0 →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => K.Γ w i) s := by
    intro i s hs hfs
    fin_cases i
    · exact (K.Γ_reg_holo s hs hfs).1
    · exact (K.Γ_reg_holo s hs hfs).2
  have hΓ_ext : ∀ z ∈ D_ov, K.f z ≠ 0 → K.f (ζ * z + b) ≠ 0 →
      K.Γ (ζ * z + b) = K.Γ z := by
    intro z hz hfz hfζz
    funext i
    let d_fn : ℂ → ℂ := ((fun w => K.Γ w i) ∘ (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w + b)) - (fun w => K.Γ w i)
    have hd_mero : MeromorphicOn d_fn D_ov := by
      intro w hw
      exact (MeromorphicAt.comp_analyticAt (f := fun u => K.Γ u i) (g := fun u => ζ * u + b)
        (hΓ_mero_i i (ζ * w + b) hw.2) (h_aff_diff.analyticAt w)).sub (hΓ_mero_i i w hw.1)
    have hd_ball : ∀ᶠ w in nhds s₀, d_fn w = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδ] with w hw
      simp [d_fn, (hDom w hw).2.2.2.2]
    have h_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt d_fn s₀ = ⊤ :=
      meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mpr (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_eventually_nhds hd_ball)
    have h_ord_z : meromorphicOrderAt d_fn z = ⊤ := by
      by_contra h_ne
      exact hd_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected
        hDov_pre hz hs₀_ov h_ne h_ord_s₀
    have hev_z : ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ, d_fn w = 0 :=
      meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp h_ord_z
    have hd_diff_z : DifferentiableAt ℂ d_fn z :=
      ((hΓ_reg_i i (ζ * z + b) hz.2 hfζz).comp z (h_aff_diff z)).sub
        (hΓ_reg_i i z hz.1 hfz)
    have hd_zero : d_fn z = 0 :=
      tendsto_nhds_unique (hd_diff_z.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
        (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hev_z.mono fun _ hw => hw.symm))
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hd_zero
  have h_real_params : ζ.im = 0 ∧ b.im = 0 := by
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLtTop
    · have hMem : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ D_H := by
        intro s
        simp [D_H, horizStripENNR, hTop]
      have hDH_univ : D_H = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hMem
      have ha_diff : Differentiable ℂ K.a :=
        differentiableOn_univ.mp (hDH_univ ▸ K.a_holo)
      have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr C.c_pos.ne'
      have ha_sq_ball : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ,
          (K.a (ζ * s + b)) ^ 2 - (K.a s) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        intro s hs
        have hs_nhds : Metric.ball s₀ δ ∈ nhds s := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs
        have hev₀ : (fun w => K.Γ (ζ * w + b) 0) =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun w => K.Γ w 0) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hs_nhds (fun w hw => congrFun (hDom w hw).2.2.2.2 0)
        have hev₁ : (fun w => K.Γ (ζ * w + b) 1) =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun w => K.Γ w 1) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hs_nhds (fun w hw => congrFun (hDom w hw).2.2.2.2 1)
        have hf₁ : K.f s ≠ 0 := (hDom s hs).2.2.1
        have hf₂ : K.f (ζ * s + b) ≠ 0 := (hDom s hs).2.2.2.1
        have h_aff_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w + b) ζ s := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul ζ).add_const b
        have hd₀ : deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 0) (ζ * s + b) * ζ = deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 0) s := by
          have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w => K.Γ (ζ * w + b) 0)
              (deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 0) (ζ * s + b) * ζ) s :=
            HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := fun w => K.Γ w 0) (h := fun w => ζ * w + b) s
              ((K.Γ_reg_holo (ζ * s + b) (hMem _) hf₂).1).hasDerivAt h_aff_hd
          exact hcomp.deriv.symm.trans hev₀.deriv_eq
        have hd₁ : deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 1) (ζ * s + b) * ζ = deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 1) s := by
          have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w => K.Γ (ζ * w + b) 1)
              (deriv (fun w => K.Γ w 1) (ζ * s + b) * ζ) s :=
            HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := fun w => K.Γ w 1) (h := fun w => ζ * w + b) s
              ((K.Γ_reg_holo (ζ * s + b) (hMem _) hf₂).2).hasDerivAt h_aff_hd
          exact hcomp.deriv.symm.trans hev₁.deriv_eq
        rw [K.Γ_deriv₀ (ζ * s + b) (hMem _) hf₂, K.Γ_deriv₀ s (hMem s) hf₁] at hd₀
        rw [K.Γ_deriv₁ (ζ * s + b) (hMem _) hf₂, K.Γ_deriv₁ s (hMem s) hf₁] at hd₁
        let f₁ := K.f s
        let f₂ := K.f (ζ * s + b)
        let ϕ₁ := K.ϕ s
        let ϕ₂ := K.ϕ (ζ * s + b)
        let a₁ := K.a s
        let a₂ := K.a (ζ * s + b)
        have hS : ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₂ = f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₁ := by
          have hmul : (C.c : ℂ) *
              (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₂ - f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₁) = 0 := by
            dsimp [f₁, f₂, ϕ₁, ϕ₂]
            linear_combination -hd₀
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hc_ne)
        have hC : ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₂ = f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₁ := by
          have hmul : (C.c : ℂ) *
              (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₂ - f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₁) = 0 := by
            dsimp [f₁, f₂, ϕ₁, ϕ₂]
            linear_combination hd₁
          exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hc_ne)
        have h_f4 : ζ ^ 2 * (f₂⁻¹) ^ 4 = (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 := by
          calc ζ ^ 2 * (f₂⁻¹) ^ 4
              = ζ ^ 2 * (f₂⁻¹) ^ 4 * (Complex.cos ϕ₂ ^ 2 + Complex.sin ϕ₂ ^ 2) := by
                  rw [Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
            _ = (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₂) ^ 2 +
                  (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₂) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = (f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₁) ^ 2 +
                  (f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₁) ^ 2 := by rw [hC, hS]
            _ = (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * (Complex.cos ϕ₁ ^ 2 + Complex.sin ϕ₁ ^ 2) := by ring
            _ = (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 := by rw [Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
        have h_fa : ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₂ = f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₁ := by
          have ha₁_eq : Complex.cos ϕ₁ + Complex.sin ϕ₁ * Complex.I = a₁ := by
            dsimp [ϕ₁, a₁]
            rw [Complex.cos_add_sin_I, mul_comm, K.exp_ϕ s (hMem s)]
          have ha₂_eq : Complex.cos ϕ₂ + Complex.sin ϕ₂ * Complex.I = a₂ := by
            dsimp [ϕ₂, a₂]
            rw [Complex.cos_add_sin_I, mul_comm, K.exp_ϕ (ζ * s + b) (hMem _)]
          calc ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₂
              = (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₂) +
                  (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₂) * Complex.I := by
                  rw [← ha₂_eq]; ring
            _ = (f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos ϕ₁) +
                  (f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin ϕ₁) * Complex.I := by rw [hC, hS]
            _ = f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₁ := by rw [← ha₁_eq]; ring
        have h_sq_mul : (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * (a₂ ^ 2 - a₁ ^ 2) = 0 := by
          have h1 : (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * a₂ ^ 2 = (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * a₁ ^ 2 := by
            calc (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * a₂ ^ 2
                = (ζ ^ 2 * (f₂⁻¹) ^ 4) * a₂ ^ 2 := by rw [h_f4]
              _ = (ζ * f₂⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₂) ^ 2 := by ring
              _ = (f₁⁻¹ ^ 2 * a₁) ^ 2 := by rw [h_fa]
              _ = (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 * a₁ ^ 2 := by ring
          linear_combination h1
        have hf₁_inv4 : (f₁⁻¹) ^ 4 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 4 (inv_ne_zero hf₁)
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_sq_mul).resolve_left hf₁_inv4
      let H_sq : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (K.a (ζ * z + b)) ^ 2 - (K.a z) ^ 2
      have hH_diff : Differentiable ℂ H_sq := by
        dsimp [H_sq]
        fun_prop
      have hH_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H_sq Set.univ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr hH_diff.differentiableOn
      have hH_ev : H_sq =ᶠ[nhds s₀] 0 :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδ) ha_sq_ball
      have hH_univ : ∀ z : ℂ, (K.a (ζ * z + b)) ^ 2 - (K.a z) ^ 2 = 0 := fun z =>
        hH_anal.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          isPreconnected_univ (Set.mem_univ s₀) hH_ev (Set.mem_univ z)
      have h_sigma : ∃ σ : ℂ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, K.a (ζ * z + b) = σ * K.a z := by
        let h_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => K.a (ζ * z + b) - K.a z
        let h_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => K.a (ζ * z + b) + K.a z
        by_cases h_all : ∀ z : ℂ, h_minus z = 0
        · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, fun z => ?_⟩
          have hz := sub_eq_zero.mp (h_all z)
          simpa using hz
        · push_neg at h_all
          obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := h_all
          have hm_diff : Differentiable ℂ h_minus := by dsimp [h_minus]; fun_prop
          have hp_diff : Differentiable ℂ h_plus := by dsimp [h_plus]; fun_prop
          have hp_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h_plus Set.univ :=
            (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr hp_diff.differentiableOn
          have hp_ev : h_plus =ᶠ[nhds z₁] 0 := by
            filter_upwards [hm_diff.continuous.continuousAt.eventually_ne hz₁] with z hz_ne
            have hprod : h_minus z * h_plus z = 0 := by
              dsimp [h_minus, h_plus]
              linear_combination hH_univ z
            exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left hz_ne
          refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, fun z => ?_⟩
          have hz0 : h_plus z = 0 :=
            hp_anal.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
              isPreconnected_univ (Set.mem_univ z₁) hp_ev (Set.mem_univ z)
          dsimp [h_plus] at hz0
          linear_combination hz0
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσ_eq⟩ := h_sigma
      have ha_conj_inv : ∀ w : ℂ, K.a (starRingEnd ℂ w) = (starRingEnd ℂ (K.a w))⁻¹ := by
        intro w
        have hexp1 := K.exp_ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ w) (hMem _)
        have hexp2 := K.exp_ϕ w (hMem w)
        have hconj := K.ϕ_conj w (hMem w)
        have harg : Complex.I * K.ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ w) =
            starRingEnd ℂ (-(Complex.I * K.ϕ w)) := by
          rw [hconj, map_neg, map_mul, Complex.conj_I]
          ring
        rw [← hexp1, harg, Complex.exp_conj, Complex.exp_neg, hexp2, map_inv₀]
      by_contra h_not_real
      have h_period_tau : ∃ τ : ℂ, τ.im ≠ 0 ∧ Function.Periodic K.a τ := by
        by_cases hζ_im : ζ.im = 0
        · have hb_im : b.im ≠ 0 := fun hb0 => h_not_real ⟨hζ_im, hb0⟩
          rcases h_real_root ζ hζ hζ_im with rfl | rfl
          · refine ⟨2 * b, by simp [hb_im], fun z => ?_⟩
            have h1 : K.a (z + 2 * b) = σ * K.a (z + b) := by
              have h := hσ_eq (z + b)
              have h_eq : 1 * (z + b) + b = z + 2 * b := by ring
              rwa [h_eq] at h
            have h2 : K.a (z + b) = σ * K.a z := by simpa using hσ_eq z
            rw [h1, h2]
            rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> ring
          · refine ⟨b - starRingEnd ℂ b, ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
            · have him : (b - starRingEnd ℂ b).im = 2 * b.im := by
                simp
                ring
              rw [him]
              exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hb_im
            · have h_bar : ∀ u : ℂ, K.a (-u + starRingEnd ℂ b) = σ * K.a u := by
                intro u
                have h_arg_u : -u + starRingEnd ℂ b =
                    starRingEnd ℂ ((-1) * starRingEnd ℂ u + b) := by
                  simp [Complex.conj_conj]
                rw [h_arg_u, ha_conj_inv, hσ_eq (starRingEnd ℂ u)]
                rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;>
                  simp [ha_conj_inv, Complex.conj_conj]
              have h_step : z + (b - starRingEnd ℂ b) =
                  (-1) * (-z + starRingEnd ℂ b) + b := by ring
              rw [h_step, hσ_eq (-z + starRingEnd ℂ b), h_bar z]
              rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> simp
        · have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := by
            rintro rfl
            norm_num at hζ
          let τ : ℂ := ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ
          refine ⟨τ, ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
          · have him : τ.im = (2 * Real.pi) * ζ.im := by simp [τ]
            rw [him]
            exact mul_ne_zero Real.two_pi_pos.ne' hζ_im
          · let s : ℂ := ζ⁻¹ * (z - b)
            have hs1 : ζ * s + b = z := by
              dsimp [s]
              field_simp [hζ_ne]
              ring
            have hs2 : ζ * (s + 2 * Real.pi) + b = z + τ := by
              dsimp [s, τ]
              push_cast
              field_simp [hζ_ne]
              ring
            rw [← hs2, hσ_eq (s + 2 * Real.pi), K.a_periodic s (hMem s), ← hσ_eq s, hs1]
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ_im, hper_τ⟩ := h_period_tau
      have hper_2pi : Function.Periodic K.a (2 * Real.pi) := fun z => K.a_periodic z (hMem z)
      let R_fund : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi + |τ.im|
      have h_range_sub : Set.range K.a ⊆ K.a '' Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_fund := by
        rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
        let k_fl : ℤ := ⌊z.im / τ.im⌋
        let z₁ : ℂ := z - (k_fl : ℂ) * τ
        let m_fl : ℤ := ⌊z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        let z₂ : ℂ := z₁ - (m_fl : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi)
        refine ⟨z₂, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          let u : ℝ := z.im / τ.im - (k_fl : ℝ)
          let v : ℝ := z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi) - (m_fl : ℝ)
          have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := sub_nonneg.mpr (Int.floor_le (z.im / τ.im))
          have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := by
            have hlt : z.im / τ.im < (k_fl : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (z.im / τ.im)
            change z.im / τ.im - (k_fl : ℝ) ≤ 1
            linarith
          have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := sub_nonneg.mpr (Int.floor_le (z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi)))
          have hv1 : v ≤ 1 := by
            have hlt : z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (m_fl : ℝ) + 1 :=
              Int.lt_floor_add_one (z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi))
            change z₁.re / (2 * Real.pi) - (m_fl : ℝ) ≤ 1
            linarith
          have hz₂_im : z₂.im = u * τ.im := by
            have h1 : z₂.im = z.im - (k_fl : ℝ) * τ.im := by simp [z₂, z₁]
            rw [h1]
            dsimp [u]
            field_simp [hτ_im]
          have hz₂_re : z₂.re = v * (2 * Real.pi) := by
            have h1 : z₂.re = z₁.re - (m_fl : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by simp [z₂]
            rw [h1]
            dsimp [v]
            field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
          have him_le : |z₂.im| ≤ |τ.im| := by
            rw [hz₂_im, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg τ.im]
          have hre_le : |z₂.re| ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
            rw [hz₂_re, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hv0, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos]
            nlinarith [Real.two_pi_pos]
          exact le_trans (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im z₂) (by dsimp [R_fund]; linarith)
        · have hz_eq1 : z = z₁ + (k_fl : ℂ) * τ := by dsimp [z₁]; ring
          have hz_eq2 : z₁ = z₂ + (m_fl : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by dsimp [z₂]; ring
          rw [hz_eq1, hper_τ.int_mul k_fl z₁, hz_eq2, hper_2pi.int_mul m_fl z₂]
      have h_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range K.a) :=
        ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_fund).image ha_diff.continuous).isBounded.subset
          h_range_sub
      obtain ⟨c_a, hc_a⟩ := ha_diff.exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded h_bdd
      have h_deriv_zero : deriv K.a 0 = 0 := by
        have h_eq_fn : K.a = fun _ : ℂ => c_a := funext hc_a
        rw [h_eq_fn, deriv_const]
      have h_deriv_ne : deriv K.a 0 ≠ 0 := by
        rw [K.deriv_a 0 (hMem 0)]
        have hf0 : K.f ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := h_f_real_ne 0
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero] at hf0
        exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hf0) (K.a_ne_zero 0 (hMem 0))
      exact h_deriv_ne h_deriv_zero
    · let H₀ : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH₀_eq : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLtTop)).symm
      have hH₀_pos : 0 < H₀ := by
        by_contra h_le
        push_neg at h_le
        have h0 : M.h_X 0 = 0 := by rw [hH₀_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mpr h_le]
        have hs_pos : (0 : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal M.s_base :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr M.s_base_pos
        exact (not_lt_of_ge (h0 ▸ h_base_le)) hs_pos
      have hStrip : D_H = horizStrip H₀ := by
        ext s
        change ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < M.h_X 0 ↔ |s.im| < H₀
        rw [hH₀_eq]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₀_pos
      by_contra h_not_real
      have h_edge_witness : ∃ x_star sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) ∧
          ζ * ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b ∈ horizStrip H₀ := by
        by_cases hζ_im : ζ.im = 0
        · have hb_im : b.im ≠ 0 := fun hb0 => h_not_real ⟨hζ_im, hb0⟩
          have hs₀_H : |s₀.im| < H₀ := by
            have hm := hs₀_ov.1
            rwa [hStrip] at hm
          have hζs₀_H : |(ζ * s₀ + b).im| < H₀ := by
            have hm := hs₀_ov.2
            rwa [hStrip] at hm
          rcases h_real_root ζ hζ hζ_im with rfl | rfl
          · simp only [ one_mul, Complex.add_im] at hζs₀_H
            have hb_lt : -2 * H₀ < b.im ∧ b.im < 2 * H₀ :=
              ⟨by linarith [abs_lt.mp hs₀_H, abs_lt.mp hζs₀_H],
               by linarith [abs_lt.mp hs₀_H, abs_lt.mp hζs₀_H]⟩
            by_cases hb_pos : 0 < b.im
            · refine ⟨0, -1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
              change |(1 * (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((-1) * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im| < H₀
              simp only [one_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_add, Complex.add_im,
                Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
                Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
              exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            · have hb_neg : b.im < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hb_pos) hb_im
              refine ⟨0, 1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
              change |(1 * (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((1 * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im| < H₀
              simp only [one_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_add, Complex.add_im,
                Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
                Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
              exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          · simp only [neg_one_mul, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im] at hζs₀_H
            have hb_lt : -2 * H₀ < b.im ∧ b.im < 2 * H₀ :=
              ⟨by linarith [abs_lt.mp hs₀_H, abs_lt.mp hζs₀_H],
               by linarith [abs_lt.mp hs₀_H, abs_lt.mp hζs₀_H]⟩
            by_cases hb_pos : 0 < b.im
            · refine ⟨0, 1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
              change |((-1) * (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((1 * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im| < H₀
              simp only [neg_one_mul, one_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_add,
                Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
                Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
              exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            · have hb_neg : b.im < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hb_pos) hb_im
              refine ⟨0, -1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
              change |((-1) * (((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((-1) * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im| < H₀
              simp only [neg_one_mul, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_add,
                Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
                Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
              exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        · let x_star : ℝ := -(ζ.re * H₀ + b.im) / ζ.im
          refine ⟨x_star, 1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
          change |(ζ * ((x_star : ℂ) + ((1 * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im| < H₀
          have him0 : (ζ * ((x_star : ℂ) + ((1 * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + b).im = 0 := by
            simp only [x_star, one_mul, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
              Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
            field_simp [hζ_im]
            ring
          rw [him0, abs_zero]
          exact hH₀_pos
      obtain ⟨x_star, sgn, hsgn, hs_edge_mem⟩ := h_edge_witness
      let s_edge : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hB_maps⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp ((hH_open_strip H₀).preimage h_aff_diff.continuous) s_edge hs_edge_mem
      let B_edge : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge ε
      let g_patch : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => (fun w => K.Γ w i) ∘ (fun w : ℂ => ζ * w + b)
      have hg_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (g_patch i) B_edge := by
        intro i z hz
        have hmem_z : ζ * z + b ∈ D_H := by
          rw [hStrip]
          exact hB_maps hz
        exact MeromorphicAt.comp_analyticAt (f := fun u => K.Γ u i) (g := fun u => ζ * u + b)
          (hΓ_mero_i i (ζ * z + b) hmem_z) (h_aff_diff.analyticAt z)
      let W : Set ℂ := B_edge ∩ horizStrip H₀
      have hW_open : IsOpen W := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (hH_open_strip H₀)
      have hW_sub : W ⊆ D_ov := by
        intro z hz
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hStrip]; exact hz.2
        · rw [hStrip]; exact hB_maps hz.1
      let δ₁ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (H₀ / 2)
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := lt_min (half_pos hε) (half_pos hH₀_pos)
      have hδ₁_lt_ε : δ₁ < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hε)
      have hδ₁_lt_H : δ₁ < H₀ := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (half_lt_self hH₀_pos)
      have hsgn_abs : |sgn| = 1 := by
        rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      let z_in : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * (H₀ - δ₁) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hz_in_W : z_in ∈ W := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          have hdiff : z_in - s_edge = ((-sgn * δ₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            dsimp [z_in, s_edge]
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [hdiff]
          simp only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
            abs_neg, hsgn_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos hδ₁_pos]
          exact hδ₁_lt_ε
        · change |z_in.im| < H₀
          have him : z_in.im = sgn * (H₀ - δ₁) := by simp [z_in]
          rw [him, abs_mul, hsgn_abs, one_mul, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hδ₁_lt_H)]
          linarith
      let h_prod : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => K.f z * K.f (ζ * z + b)
      have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_prod D_ov := by
        intro z hz
        exact ((K.f_holo z hz.1).mono (fun w hw => hw.1)).mul
          ((K.f_holo (ζ * z + b) hz.2).comp z
            (h_aff_diff.differentiableOn z hz) (fun w hw => hw.2))
      let V_overlap : Set ℂ := W ∩ h_prod ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
      have hV_open : IsOpen V_overlap :=
        (hh_holo.continuousOn.mono hW_sub).isOpen_inter_preimage hW_open isOpen_compl_singleton
      have hV_ne : V_overlap.Nonempty := by
        by_contra hV_empty
        rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hV_empty
        have hh_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h_prod D_ov :=
          (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hDov_open).mpr hh_holo
        have hh_ev : h_prod =ᶠ[nhds z_in] 0 := by
          filter_upwards [hW_open.mem_nhds hz_in_W] with z hzW
          by_contra h_nz
          have hzV : z ∈ V_overlap := ⟨hzW, h_nz⟩
          rw [hV_empty] at hzV
          exact hzV
        have hh_s₀ : h_prod s₀ = 0 :=
          hh_anal.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            hDov_pre (hW_sub hz_in_W) hh_ev hs₀_ov
        exact mul_ne_zero (hDom s₀ hs₀_ball).2.2.1 (hDom s₀ hs₀_ball).2.2.2.1 hh_s₀
      have hV_eq : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g_patch i z = K.Γ z i := by
        intro i z hz
        have hz_nz : K.f z * K.f (ζ * z + b) ≠ 0 := hz.2
        have hfz : K.f z ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hz_nz
        have hfζz : K.f (ζ * z + b) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hz_nz
        exact congrFun (hΓ_ext z (hW_sub hz.1) hfz hfζz) i
      exact K.no_1d_patch_Γ H₀ x_star sgn ε hH₀_eq hsgn hε
        ⟨g_patch, hg_mero 0, hg_mero 1, V_overlap, hV_open, hV_ne,
          Set.inter_subset_left, hV_eq⟩
  let b₀ : ℝ := b.re
  have hb_eq : b = (b₀ : ℂ) := Complex.ext rfl h_real_params.2
  rcases h_real_root ζ hζ h_real_params.1 with hζ1 | hζ_neg1
  · refine ⟨hζ1, ?_⟩
    have h0_ov : ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ D_ov := by
      refine ⟨h_real_mem 0, ?_⟩
      rw [hζ1, hb_eq]
      simpa using h_real_mem b₀
    have h_aff0 : ζ * ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) + b = (b₀ : ℂ) := by
      simp [hζ1, hb_eq]
    have hΓ_b₀ : K.Γ (b₀ : ℂ) = K.Γ ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have h1 := hΓ_ext ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) h0_ov (h_f_real_ne 0)
        (by rw [h_aff0]; exact h_f_real_ne b₀)
      rwa [h_aff0] at h1
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.Γ_real_simple b₀ 0 hΓ_b₀
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have hb₀_k : b₀ = (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by linarith
    rw [hb_eq, hb₀_k]
    push_cast
    ring
  · exfalso
    let x_q : ℝ := b₀ / 2 + Real.pi / 2
    let y_q : ℝ := b₀ / 2 - Real.pi / 2
    have h_aff_q : ζ * (x_q : ℂ) + b = (y_q : ℂ) := by
      rw [hζ_neg1, hb_eq]
      dsimp [x_q, y_q]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hx_ov : (x_q : ℂ) ∈ D_ov := ⟨h_real_mem x_q, by rw [h_aff_q]; exact h_real_mem y_q⟩
    have hΓ_q : K.Γ (y_q : ℂ) = K.Γ (x_q : ℂ) := by
      have h1 := hΓ_ext (x_q : ℂ) hx_ov (h_f_real_ne x_q)
        (by rw [h_aff_q]; exact h_f_real_ne y_q)
      rwa [h_aff_q] at h1
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.Γ_real_simple y_q x_q hΓ_q
    have h_odd_pi : ((2 * k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi = 0 := by
      dsimp [x_q, y_q] at hk
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_odd_zero : ((2 * k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp h_odd_pi).resolve_right Real.pi_ne_zero
    have h_int_zero : 2 * k + 1 = 0 := Int.cast_eq_zero.mp h_odd_zero
    omega
