signature.statement:
(x₀ θ₀ t₁ ρ : ℝ)
    (ht₁_irr : Irrational (t₁ / (2 * Real.pi)))
    (hρ_pos : 0 < ρ) :
    Nonempty (IrrShiftSlabCover x₀ θ₀ t₁ ρ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have : Fact (0 < 2 * Real.pi) := ⟨Real.two_pi_pos⟩
  have h_dense_z : DenseRange (fun z : ℤ => z • (t₁ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) :=
    AddCircle.denseRange_zsmul_coe_iff.mpr ht₁_irr
  have h_dense_n : DenseRange (fun m : ℕ => m • (t₁ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi))) :=
    denseRange_zsmul_iff_nsmul.mp h_dense_z
  have h_approx : ∀ c : ℝ, ∃ (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      |((m : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) - c| < ρ := by
    intro c
    let U : Set ℝ := Set.Ioo (c - ρ) (c + ρ)
    have hU_open : IsOpen (((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) '' U) :=
      QuotientAddGroup.isOpenMap_coe U isOpen_Ioo
    have hU_ne : (((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) '' U).Nonempty :=
      ⟨(c : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)), ⟨c, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h_dense_n.exists_mem_open hU_open hU_ne
    rcases hm with ⟨y, ⟨hy_lo, hy_hi⟩, hy_eq⟩
    have h_zero : (((m : ℝ) * t₁ - y : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) = 0 := by
      rw [AddCircle.coe_sub, sub_eq_zero]
      have h_nsmul : (((m : ℝ) * t₁ : ℝ) : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) =
          m • (t₁ : AddCircle (2 * Real.pi)) := by
        rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
      rw [h_nsmul]
      exact hy_eq.symm
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff (2 * Real.pi)).mp h_zero
    rw [zsmul_eq_mul] at hk
    refine ⟨m, k, ?_⟩
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have h_fwd_ex : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ (b : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      2 ≤ b ∧ |(z + θ₀ + (b : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (q : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨m, k, hmk⟩ := h_approx (x₀ - z - θ₀ - 2 * t₁)
    refine ⟨m + 2, k, Nat.le_add_left 2 m, ?_⟩
    have heq : (z + θ₀ + ((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) - x₀ =
        ((m : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) - (x₀ - z - θ₀ - 2 * t₁) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rwa [heq]
  have h_back_ex : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ (a : ℕ) (p : ℤ),
      1 ≤ a ∧ |(z + θ₀ - (a : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (p : ℝ)) - x₀| < ρ := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨m, k, hmk⟩ := h_approx (z + θ₀ - t₁ - x₀)
    refine ⟨m + 1, -k, Nat.le_add_left 1 m, ?_⟩
    have heq : (z + θ₀ - ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * ((-k : ℤ) : ℝ)) - x₀ =
        -(((m : ℝ) * t₁ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)) - (z + θ₀ - t₁ - x₀)) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_neg]
    exact hmk
  let δ_g : ℝ := ρ / 2
  have hδg_pos : 0 < δ_g := half_pos hρ_pos
  let N_slab : ℕ := ⌊(2 * Real.pi) / δ_g⌋₊ + 1
  let x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ := fun α => (α.1 : ℝ) * δ_g
  choose b_fn q_fn hb_ge h_fwd using fun α : Fin N_slab => h_fwd_ex (x_c α)
  choose a_fn p_fn ha_ge h_back using fun α : Fin N_slab => h_back_ex (x_c α)
  refine ⟨{
    N_slab := N_slab
    N_slab_pos := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
    x_c := x_c
    a_step := a_fn
    b_step := b_fn
    p_per := p_fn
    q_per := q_fn
    step_bounds := fun α => ⟨ha_ge α, hb_ge α⟩
    covers_period := ?_
    back_approx := h_back
    fwd_approx := h_fwd
  }⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x / δ_g := div_nonneg hx.1 hδg_pos.le
  have hx_le : x / δ_g ≤ (2 * Real.pi) / δ_g := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hx.2 hδg_pos.le
  let j : ℕ := ⌊x / δ_g⌋₊
  have hj_lt : j < N_slab := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.floor_mono hx_le)
  refine ⟨⟨j, hj_lt⟩, ?_⟩
  have h_lo : (j : ℝ) * δ_g ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hδg_pos).mp (Nat.floor_le hx0)
  have h_hi : x < ((j : ℝ) + 1) * δ_g := (div_lt_iff₀ hδg_pos).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (x / δ_g))
  rw [add_mul, one_mul] at h_hi
  have hδg_eq : δ_g = ρ / 2 := rfl
  change |x - (j : ℝ) * δ_g| < ρ
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hOpen_sh : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hDeriv_h_per : ∀ μ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h),
      deriv C.h_ℂ (μ + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv C.h_ℂ μ := by
    intro μ hμ
    have hev : (fun ζ : ℂ => C.h_ℂ (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds μ] C.h_ℂ :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hOpen_sh.mem_nhds hμ) (fun ζ hζ => C.h_ℂ_periodic ζ hζ)
    calc deriv C.h_ℂ (μ + 2 * Real.pi)
        = deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => C.h_ℂ (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)) μ :=
          (deriv_comp_add_const C.h_ℂ (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) μ).symm
      _ = deriv C.h_ℂ μ := hev.deriv_eq
  have hMid_sh : ∀ α β : ℂ, α ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) → β ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) →
      (α + β) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
    intro α β hα hβ
    simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hα hβ ⊢
    have h_im : ((α + β) / 2).im = (α.im + β.im) / 2 := by simp [add_div]
    rw [h_im, abs_lt]
    rw [abs_lt] at hα hβ
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hTheta_shift : ∀ (w t : ℂ) (c : ℝ),
      |w.im| < 2 * W.s_base → ‖t‖ < W.r_base → |c| ≤ 1 →
      glancingTheta C (w + (c : ℂ) * t) t ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) ∧
      glancingTheta C ((w + (c : ℂ) * t) + 2 * Real.pi) t =
        glancingTheta C (w + (c : ℂ) * t) t + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro w t c hw ht hc
    set z : ℂ := w + (c : ℂ) * t
    have hzim_eq : z.im = w.im + c * t.im := by simp [z]
    have hct_le : |c * t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := by
      calc |c * t.im| = |c| * |t.im| := abs_mul c t.im
        _ ≤ 1 * |t.im| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |t.im| := one_mul _
        _ ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
    have hzim_lt_sum : |z.im| < 2 * W.s_base + W.r_base := by
      rw [hzim_eq, abs_lt]
      rw [abs_lt] at hw
      have hct' := abs_le.mp hct_le
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hzim_s1r1 : |z.im| < C.s₁ + C.r₁ := by
      linarith [W.s_base_le_s₁, W.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
    have hzim_2s1 : |z.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by
      linarith [W.s_base_le_s₁, W.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
    have ht_r1 : ‖t‖ < C.r₁ := by
      linarith [W.r_base_lt_r₁, C.r₁_pos]
    have hU_mem : C.U (z, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) :=
      C.U_maps_to z t hzim_s1r1 ht_r1
    refine ⟨C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to (C.U (z, t)) hU_mem, ?_⟩
    dsimp [glancingTheta]
    rw [C.U_quasiperiodic z t hzim_2s1 ht_r1, C.ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic (C.U (z, t)) hU_mem]
  have hBase_per_step : ∀ (is_point : Bool) (w t : ℂ) (i : Fin 2),
      |w.im| < 2 * W.s_base → ‖t‖ < W.r_base →
      bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (w + 2 * Real.pi) t i =
        bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point w t i := by
    intro is_point w t i hw ht
    cases is_point
    · have h0 := hTheta_shift w t 0 hw ht (by norm_num)
      have h1 := hTheta_shift w t 1 hw ht (by norm_num)
      have hz0 : w + ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * t = w := by simp
      have hz1 : w + ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * t = w + t := by simp
      rw [hz0] at h0
      rw [hz1] at h1
      have hz1_per : (w + 2 * Real.pi) + t = (w + t) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      set θ₀ := glancingTheta C w t
      set θ₁ := glancingTheta C (w + t) t
      have hμ_mem : (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := hMid_sh θ₀ θ₁ h0.1 h1.1
      have hOff : glancingOffset C (w + 2 * Real.pi) t = glancingOffset C w t := by
        dsimp [glancingOffset, supportAction1_ℂ]
        rw [hz1_per, h0.2, h1.2]
        have h_avg : (θ₀ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) + (θ₁ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) / 2 =
            (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
        have h_dif : (θ₁ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) - (θ₀ + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) / 2 =
            (θ₁ - θ₀) / 2 := by ring
        rw [h_avg, h_dif, hDeriv_h_per _ hμ_mem, C.h_ℂ_periodic _ hμ_mem]
      revert i
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [bandBaseEndpointFn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, glancingDualLine,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, h0.2, hOff, Complex.cos_add_two_pi]
        rfl
      · simp only [bandBaseEndpointFn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, glancingDualLine,
          Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, h0.2, hOff, Complex.sin_add_two_pi]
        rfl
    · have hm := hTheta_shift w t (-1 / 2) hw ht (by norm_num)
      have hp := hTheta_shift w t (1 / 2) hw ht (by norm_num)
      have hzm : w + ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * t = w - t / 2 := by push_cast; ring
      have hzp : w + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * t = w + t / 2 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hzm] at hm
      rw [hzp] at hp
      have hzm_per : (w + 2 * Real.pi) - t / 2 = (w - t / 2) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      have hzp_per : (w + 2 * Real.pi) + t / 2 = (w + t / 2) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      have hMid_mem : glancingMidAngle C w t ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
        hMid_sh _ _ hm.1 hp.1
      have hMid_per : glancingMidAngle C (w + 2 * Real.pi) t =
          glancingMidAngle C w t + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [glancingMidAngle]
        rw [hzm_per, hzp_per, hm.2, hp.2]
        ring
      revert i
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [bandBaseEndpointFn, ↓reduceIte, glancingImpact, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
          hMid_per, C.h_ℂ_periodic _ hMid_mem, hDeriv_h_per _ hMid_mem,
          Complex.cos_add_two_pi, Complex.sin_add_two_pi]
      · simp only [bandBaseEndpointFn, ↓reduceIte, glancingImpact, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons, hMid_per, C.h_ℂ_periodic _ hMid_mem, hDeriv_h_per _ hMid_mem,
          Complex.cos_add_two_pi, Complex.sin_add_two_pi]
  have hBase_per_nat : ∀ (is_point : Bool) (t : ℂ) (i : Fin 2), ‖t‖ < W.r_base →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : ℂ), |w.im| < 2 * W.s_base →
        bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ)) t i =
          bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point w t i := by
    intro is_point t i ht n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro w _
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro w hw
      have h_split : w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
          (w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ)) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      have hw' : |(w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ)).im| < 2 * W.s_base := by
        have him : (w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ)).im = w.im := by simp
        rwa [him]
      rw [h_split, hBase_per_step is_point _ t i hw' ht, ih w hw]
  have hBase_per_int : ∀ (is_point : Bool) (w t : ℂ) (i : Fin 2) (m : ℤ),
      |w.im| < 2 * W.s_base → ‖t‖ < W.r_base →
      bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (w - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (m : ℂ)) t i =
        bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point w t i := by
    intro is_point w t i m hw ht
    cases m with
    | ofNat n =>
      have h_cast : w - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((Int.ofNat n : ℤ) : ℂ) =
          w - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ) := by
        simp
      rw [h_cast]
      set w' : ℂ := w - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ)
      have hw' : |w'.im| < 2 * W.s_base := by
        have him : w'.im = w.im := by simp [w']
        rwa [him]
      have h_eq : w' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (n : ℂ) = w := by dsimp [w']; ring
      have h_step := hBase_per_nat is_point t i ht n w' hw'
      rw [h_eq] at h_step
      exact h_step.symm
    | negSucc n =>
      have h_eq : w - 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((Int.negSucc n : ℤ) : ℂ) =
          w + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hBase_per_nat is_point t i ht (n + 1) w hw

  
  have cancel_holo_ball : ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ} {η R : ℝ} {h d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      0 < η → η ≤ R →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball q η) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ d (Metric.ball q R) →
      (∃ z₀ ∈ Metric.ball q R, d z₀ ≠ 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q η, h x * d x = 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q η, h x = 0 := by
    intro q η R h d hη hηR hh hd hd_nz hprod
    have hex_sub : ∃ x₁ ∈ Metric.ball q η, d x₁ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hz₀_ne⟩ := hd_nz
      exact hz₀_ne (B_cr.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q R).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨q, Metric.mem_ball_self hη⟩ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hηR) hd h_all z₀ hz₀)
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₁_ne⟩ := hex_sub
    have hd_cont : ContinuousAt d x₁ :=
      hd.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball hηR hx₁))
    have h_nhds : Metric.ball q η ∩ d ⁻¹' ({0}ᶜ) ∈ nhds x₁ :=
      Filter.inter_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx₁)
        (hd_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hx₁_ne))
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ_pos, hρ_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds
    have h_zero_ρ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₁ ρ, h x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hx_mem := hρ_sub hx
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod x hx_mem.1)).resolve_right hx_mem.2
    exact B_cr.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q η).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨x₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pos⟩ (fun x hx => (hρ_sub hx).1) hh h_zero_ρ

  let affineShear (a b : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
    (q.1 + (a : ℂ) * q.2 + (b : ℂ), q.2)
  have hAff_inv_left : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      affineShear (-a) (-b) (affineShear a b q) = q := by
    intro a b q
    ext <;> dsimp [affineShear] <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hAff_inv_right : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      affineShear a b (affineShear (-a) (-b) p) = p := by
    intro a b p
    ext <;> dsimp [affineShear] <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hAff_diff : ∀ (a b : ℝ), Differentiable ℂ (affineShear a b) := by
    intro a b
    exact ((differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_snd.const_mul (a : ℂ))).add
      (differentiable_const (b : ℂ))).prodMk differentiable_snd
  have hAff_dist : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ),
      dist (affineShear a b q₁) (affineShear a b q₂) ≤ (1 + |a|) * dist q₁ q₂ := by
    intro a b q₁ q₂
    have hd1 : ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hd2 : ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      dsimp [affineShear]
      have h_sub : (q₁.1 + (a : ℂ) * q₁.2 + (b : ℂ)) - (q₂.1 + (a : ℂ) * q₂.2 + (b : ℂ)) =
          (q₁.1 - q₂.1) + (a : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2) := by ring
      rw [h_sub]
      calc ‖(q₁.1 - q₂.1) + (a : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2)‖
          ≤ ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + ‖(a : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + |a| * ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ + |a| * dist q₁ q₂ :=
            add_le_add hd1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2 (abs_nonneg a))
        _ = (1 + |a|) * dist q₁ q₂ := by ring
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      dsimp [affineShear]
      calc ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := hd2
        _ ≤ (1 + |a|) * dist q₁ q₂ := by
            nlinarith [abs_nonneg a, dist_nonneg (x := q₁) (y := q₂)]
  have hAff_maps_ball : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (r R : ℝ),
      r ≤ R / (1 + |a|) → q ∈ Metric.ball p r →
      affineShear a b q ∈ Metric.ball (affineShear a b p) R := by
    intro a b p q r R hr hq
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
    have h1a : 0 < 1 + |a| := by linarith [abs_nonneg a]
    calc dist (affineShear a b q) (affineShear a b p)
        ≤ (1 + |a|) * dist q p := hAff_dist a b q p
      _ < (1 + |a|) * r := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq h1a
      _ ≤ (1 + |a|) * (R / (1 + |a|)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (le_of_lt h1a)
      _ = R := mul_div_cancel₀ R (ne_of_gt h1a)

  let meroPullbackAffine : ∀ (a b : ℝ) {U W_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      IsOpen U → (∀ p ∈ U, affineShear a b p ∈ W_dom) → MeroOn2D W_dom → MeroOn2D U :=
    fun a b {U W_dom} hU hMaps F =>
      let r_U : ∀ p ∈ U, ℝ := fun p hp => Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp)
      have hr_U : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ U), 0 < r_U p hp ∧ Metric.ball p (r_U p hp) ⊆ U :=
        fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp)
      let rad_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
        if hp : p ∈ U then min (r_U p hp) (F.rad (affineShear a b p) / (1 + |a|)) else 1
      { rad := rad_fn
        num := fun p q => F.num (affineShear a b p) (affineShear a b q)
        den := fun p q => F.den (affineShear a b p) (affineShear a b q)
        rad_pos := fun p hp => by
          dsimp only [rad_fn]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact lt_min (hr_U p hp).1
            (div_pos (F.rad_pos _ (hMaps p hp)) (by linarith [abs_nonneg a]))
        ball_sub := fun p hp => by
          dsimp only [rad_fn]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) (hr_U p hp).2
        num_holo := fun p hp => by
          dsimp only [rad_fn]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact (F.num_holo _ (hMaps p hp)).comp (hAff_diff a b).differentiableOn
            (fun q hq => hAff_maps_ball a b p q _ _ (min_le_right _ _) hq)
        den_holo := fun p hp => by
          dsimp only [rad_fn]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          exact (F.den_holo _ (hMaps p hp)).comp (hAff_diff a b).differentiableOn
            (fun q hq => hAff_maps_ball a b p q _ _ (min_le_right _ _) hq)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          dsimp only [rad_fn]
          rw [dif_pos hp]
          set rad_p := min (r_U p hp) (F.rad (affineShear a b p) / (1 + |a|))
          have hrad_pos : 0 < rad_p := lt_min (hr_U p hp).1
            (div_pos (F.rad_pos _ (hMaps p hp)) (by linarith [abs_nonneg a]))
          have h1a_ge : 1 ≤ 1 + |a| := by linarith [abs_nonneg a]
          have h1a_pos : 0 < 1 + |a| := by linarith [abs_nonneg a]
          by_contra h_all
          push_neg at h_all
          set η' := rad_p / (1 + |a|)
          have hη'_pos : 0 < η' := div_pos hrad_pos h1a_pos
          have hη'_le_rad : η' ≤ rad_p := div_le_self (le_of_lt hrad_pos) h1a_ge
          have hrad_le_F : rad_p ≤ F.rad (affineShear a b p) :=
            le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
              (div_le_self (le_of_lt (F.rad_pos _ (hMaps p hp))) h1a_ge)
          have h_zero_B' : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (affineShear a b p) η',
              F.den (affineShear a b p) w = 0 := by
            intro w hw
            set q := affineShear (-a) (-b) w
            have hq_ball : q ∈ Metric.ball p rad_p := by
              have h_map := hAff_maps_ball (-a) (-b) (affineShear a b p) w η' rad_p
                (by rw [abs_neg]) hw
              rwa [hAff_inv_left a b p] at h_map
            have h_eq := h_all q hq_ball
            rwa [hAff_inv_right a b w] at h_eq
          obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hw₀_ne⟩ := F.den_ne_zero (affineShear a b p) (hMaps p hp)
          exact hw₀_ne (B_cr.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball
            ⟨affineShear a b p, Metric.mem_ball_self hη'_pos⟩
            (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans hη'_le_rad hrad_le_F))
            (F.den_holo _ (hMaps p hp)) h_zero_B' w₀ hw₀)
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          have hq₁ : affineShear a b q ∈
              Metric.ball (affineShear a b p₁) (F.rad (affineShear a b p₁)) := by
            have h1 := hq.1
            dsimp only [rad_fn] at h1
            rw [dif_pos hp₁] at h1
            exact hAff_maps_ball a b p₁ q _ _ (min_le_right _ _) h1
          have hq₂ : affineShear a b q ∈
              Metric.ball (affineShear a b p₂) (F.rad (affineShear a b p₂)) := by
            have h2 := hq.2
            dsimp only [rad_fn] at h2
            rw [dif_pos hp₂] at h2
            exact hAff_maps_ball a b p₂ q _ _ (min_le_right _ _) h2
          exact F.compat _ (hMaps p₁ hp₁) _ (hMaps p₂ hp₂) _ ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ }

  have hMeroEq_symm : ∀ {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁} {F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂}
      {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ O → MeroEqOn F₂ F₁ O := by
    intro W₁ W₂ F₁ F₂ O hEq
    refine ⟨fun p hp => ⟨(hEq.1 hp).2, (hEq.1 hp).1⟩, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [min_comm] at hq
    exact (hEq.2 p hp q hq).symm

  have hPullback_eqOn : ∀ (a b : ℝ) {U₁ U₂ W₁ W₂ O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (hU₁ : IsOpen U₁) (hU₂ : IsOpen U₂)
      (hMaps₁ : ∀ p ∈ U₁, affineShear a b p ∈ W₁)
      (hMaps₂ : ∀ p ∈ U₂, affineShear a b p ∈ W₂)
      (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂),
      MeroEqOn F₁ F₂ O →
      (∀ p ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂, affineShear a b p ∈ O) →
      MeroEqOn (meroPullbackAffine a b hU₁ hMaps₁ F₁)
        (meroPullbackAffine a b hU₂ hMaps₂ F₂) (U₁ ∩ U₂) := by
    intro a b U₁ U₂ W₁ W₂ O hU₁ hU₂ hMaps₁ hMaps₂ F₁ F₂ hEqF hMapsO
    let G₁ := meroPullbackAffine a b hU₁ hMaps₁ F₁
    let G₂ := meroPullbackAffine a b hU₂ hMaps₂ F₂
    refine ⟨fun p hp => hp, fun p hp q hq => ?_⟩
    have hrad₁ : G₁.rad p ≤ F₁.rad (affineShear a b p) / (1 + |a|) := by
      change (if h : p ∈ U₁ then _ else 1) ≤ _
      rw [dif_pos hp.1]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    have hrad₂ : G₂.rad p ≤ F₂.rad (affineShear a b p) / (1 + |a|) := by
      change (if h : p ∈ U₂ then _ else 1) ≤ _
      rw [dif_pos hp.2]
      exact min_le_right _ _
    have hq₁ : affineShear a b q ∈
        Metric.ball (affineShear a b p) (F₁.rad (affineShear a b p)) :=
      hAff_maps_ball a b p q _ _ (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hrad₁) hq
    have hq₂ : affineShear a b q ∈
        Metric.ball (affineShear a b p) (F₂.rad (affineShear a b p)) :=
      hAff_maps_ball a b p q _ _ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) hrad₂) hq
    have hq_min : affineShear a b q ∈ Metric.ball (affineShear a b p)
        (min (F₁.rad (affineShear a b p)) (F₂.rad (affineShear a b p))) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, lt_min_iff]
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₁, Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₂⟩
    exact hEqF.2 (affineShear a b p) (hMapsO p hp) (affineShear a b q) hq_min

  have hPullback_agreesHolo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) {U₁ W_dom W_base V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (hU₁ : IsOpen U₁) (hMaps₁ : ∀ p ∈ U₁, affineShear a b p ∈ W_dom)
      (F₁ : MeroOn2D W_dom) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      MeroAgreesHolo F₁ f W_base →
      IsOpen V → V ⊆ U₁ → (∀ p ∈ V, affineShear a b p ∈ W_base) →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroPullbackAffine a b hU₁ hMaps₁ F₁)
        (fun q => f (affineShear a b q)) V := by
    intro a b U₁ W_dom W_base V hU₁ hMaps₁ F₁ f hAg hV_open hVU₁ hMapsV
    let G₁ := meroPullbackAffine a b hU₁ hMaps₁ F₁
    refine ⟨hVU₁, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, _, _, hr₀_eq⟩ := hAg.2 (affineShear a b p) (hMapsV p hp)
    obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open p hp
    have h1a_pos : 0 < 1 + |a| := by linarith [abs_nonneg a]
    set r := min (G₁.rad p) (min r_V (r₀ / (1 + |a|)))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
      lt_min (G₁.rad_pos p (hVU₁ hp)) (lt_min hr_V_pos (div_pos hr₀_pos h1a_pos))
    have hr_le_rad : r ≤ G₁.rad p := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_sub_V : Metric.ball p r ⊆ V :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))) hr_V_sub
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le_rad, hr_sub_V, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    have hq_r₀ : affineShear a b q ∈ Metric.ball (affineShear a b p) r₀ :=
      hAff_maps_ball a b p q r r₀
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hq
    exact hr₀_eq (affineShear a b q) hq_r₀

  let meroGlueOnSlab : ∀ {U₁ U₂ Ω_slab : Set (ℂ × ℂ)},
      U₁ ⊆ Ω_slab → U₂ ⊆ Ω_slab → Ω_slab ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ →
      ∀ (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂),
        MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂) → MeroOn2D Ω_slab :=
    fun {U₁ U₂ Ω_slab} hsub₁ hsub₂ hcov G₁ G₂ hEq =>
      have h_compat_mixed : ∀ p₁ ∈ U₁, ∀ p₂ ∈ U₂,
          ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂),
            G₁.num p₁ q * G₂.den p₂ q = G₂.num p₂ q * G₁.den p₁ q := by
        intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
        have hq₁ : q ∈ U₁ := G₁.ball_sub p₁ hp₁ hq.1
        have hq₂ : q ∈ U₂ := G₂.ball_sub p₂ hp₂ hq.2
        set r_q := min (G₁.rad q) (G₂.rad q)
        have hr_q : 0 < r_q := lt_min (G₁.rad_pos q hq₁) (G₂.rad_pos q hq₂)
        let O_q := (Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂)) ∩ Metric.ball q r_q
        have hO_open : IsOpen O_q :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
        obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀_pos, hη₀_sub⟩ :=
          Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO_open q ⟨hq, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_q⟩
        set η := min η₀ r_q
        have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min hη₀_pos hr_q
        have hη_sub : Metric.ball q η ⊆ O_q :=
          Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hη₀_sub
        have hη_le_1 : η ≤ G₁.rad q := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
        have hη_le_2 : η ≤ G₂.rad q := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        let Δ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun x => G₁.num p₁ x * G₂.den p₂ x - G₂.num p₂ x * G₁.den p₁ x
        have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ (Metric.ball q η) := by
          have hsub_p1 : Metric.ball q η ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ (G₁.rad p₁) :=
            fun x hx => (hη_sub hx).1.1
          have hsub_p2 : Metric.ball q η ⊆ Metric.ball p₂ (G₂.rad p₂) :=
            fun x hx => (hη_sub hx).1.2
          exact (((G₁.num_holo p₁ hp₁).mono hsub_p1).mul
            ((G₂.den_holo p₂ hp₂).mono hsub_p2)).sub
            (((G₂.num_holo p₂ hp₂).mono hsub_p2).mul
              ((G₁.den_holo p₁ hp₁).mono hsub_p1))
        have hΔd1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => Δ x * G₁.den q x) (Metric.ball q η) :=
          hΔ_holo.mul ((G₁.den_holo q hq₁).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hη_le_1))
        have h_prod_zero : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q η,
            (Δ x * G₁.den q x) * G₂.den q x = 0 := by
          intro x hx
          have hx_O := hη_sub hx
          have c₁ := G₁.compat p₁ hp₁ q hq₁ x
            ⟨hx_O.1.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx_O.2⟩
          have c₂ := G₂.compat p₂ hp₂ q hq₂ x
            ⟨hx_O.1.2, Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx_O.2⟩
          have e₁₂ := hEq.2 q ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩ x hx_O.2
          dsimp only [Δ]
          linear_combination G₂.den p₂ x * G₂.den q x * c₁ -
            G₁.den p₁ x * G₁.den q x * c₂ +
            G₁.den p₁ x * G₂.den p₂ x * e₁₂
        have h_step1 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q η, Δ x * G₁.den q x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_ball hη_pos hη_le_2 hΔd1_holo (G₂.den_holo q hq₂)
            (G₂.den_ne_zero q hq₂) h_prod_zero
        have h_step2 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q η, Δ x = 0 :=
          cancel_holo_ball hη_pos hη_le_1 hΔ_holo (G₁.den_holo q hq₁)
            (G₁.den_ne_zero q hq₁) h_step1
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_step2 q (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))
      { rad := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.rad p else G₂.rad p
        num := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.num p else G₂.num p
        den := fun p => if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.den p else G₂.den p
        rad_pos := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₁.rad_pos p hp₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₂.rad_pos p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
        ball_sub := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact Set.Subset.trans (G₁.ball_sub p hp₁) hsub₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
            exact Set.Subset.trans (G₂.ball_sub p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)) hsub₂
        num_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₁.num_holo p hp₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₂.num_holo p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
        den_holo := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₁.den_holo p hp₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₂.den_holo p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
        den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
          by_cases hp₁ : p ∈ U₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₁.den_ne_zero p hp₁
          · simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]; exact G₂.den_ne_zero p ((hcov hp).resolve_left hp₁)
        compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
          by_cases h1 : p₁ ∈ U₁ <;> by_cases h2 : p₂ ∈ U₁
          · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
            exact G₁.compat p₁ h1 p₂ h2 q hq
          · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
            exact h_compat_mixed p₁ h1 p₂ ((hcov hp₂).resolve_left h2) q hq
          · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
            exact (h_compat_mixed p₂ h2 p₁ ((hcov hp₁).resolve_left h1) q ⟨hq.2, hq.1⟩).symm
          · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte] at hq ⊢
            exact G₂.compat p₁ ((hcov hp₁).resolve_left h1) p₂ ((hcov hp₂).resolve_left h2) q hq }

  have hGlue_agreesHolo_left : ∀ {U₁ U₂ Ω_slab V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (hsub₁ : U₁ ⊆ Ω_slab) (hsub₂ : U₂ ⊆ Ω_slab) (hcov : Ω_slab ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂)
      (G₁ : MeroOn2D U₁) (G₂ : MeroOn2D U₂) (hEq : MeroEqOn G₁ G₂ (U₁ ∩ U₂))
      (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      V ⊆ U₁ → MeroAgreesHolo G₁ f V →
      MeroAgreesHolo (meroGlueOnSlab hsub₁ hsub₂ hcov G₁ G₂ hEq) f V := by
    intro U₁ U₂ Ω_slab V hsub₁ hsub₂ hcov G₁ G₂ hEq f hVU₁ hAg
    refine ⟨Set.Subset.trans hVU₁ hsub₁, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have hp₁ : p ∈ U₁ := hVU₁ hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hAg.2 p hp
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, ?_, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    · change r ≤ if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.rad p else G₂.rad p
      rw [if_pos hp₁]
      exact hr_le
    · change (if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.num p else G₂.num p) q =
        f q * (if p ∈ U₁ then G₁.den p else G₂.den p) q
      simp only [hp₁, ↓reduceIte]
      exact hr_eq q hq

  have hMeroAgrees_congr : ∀ {W_dom V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W_dom)
      (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      MeroAgreesHolo F f₁ V → (∀ q ∈ V, f₁ q = f₂ q) → MeroAgreesHolo F f₂ V := by
    intro W_dom V F f₁ f₂ hAg hfg
    refine ⟨hAg.1, fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hAg.2 p hp
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
    rw [← hfg q (hr_sub hq)]
    exact hr_eq q hq

  
  let U_per : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * W.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base }
  let P_ε : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
      ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε }
  let O_δ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
      |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
      ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }

  let buildShearedSlabPkg : ∀ (is_point : Bool)
      (h_W : ℂ → ENNReal)
      (F_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR W.r_base h_W))
      (_hhW_ge_two : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base,
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ h_W z)
      (_hhW_lsc : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (2 * δ_star),
        ENNReal.ofReal (H₁ - ε / 32) < h_W z)
      (_hF_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        MeroAgreesHolo (F_mero i) (fun p => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point p.1 p.2 i) U_per)
      (g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D P_ε)
      (_hg : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (F_mero i) O_δ)
      (_cov : IrrShiftSlabCover x₀ (if is_point then -t₁ / 2 else 0) t₁ (ε / 16)),
      ShearedSlabEndpointPkg W H₁ ε t₁ is_point :=
    fun is_point h_W F_mero hhW_ge_two hhW_lsc hF_agrees g hg cov =>
      let c_mode : ℝ := if is_point then -1 / 2 else 0
      let θ₀ : ℝ := if is_point then -t₁ / 2 else 0
      have hθ₀_eq : θ₀ = c_mode * t₁ := by
        cases is_point <;> simp [θ₀, c_mode] <;> ring
      let N_slab : ℕ := cov.N_slab
      let x_c : Fin N_slab → ℝ := cov.x_c
      let k_span : Fin N_slab → ℕ := fun α => cov.a_step α + cov.b_step α
      let j_idx : Fin N_slab → ℕ := fun α =>
        if is_point then cov.a_step α + 1 else cov.a_step α
      let s_minus : Fin N_slab → ℝ := fun α => c_mode - (cov.a_step α : ℝ)
      let M_nat : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup k_span
      let M_sh : ℝ := (M_nat : ℝ) + 2
      have hM_sh_ge : 2 ≤ M_sh := by
        dsimp [M_sh]
        have hM_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M_nat : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M_nat
        linarith
      let η_sh : ℝ := min (ε / 32) (W.s_base / 4)
      have hη_pos : 0 < η_sh := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith [W.s_base_pos])
      have ht₁_abs : |t₁ - t₀| < δ_star :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht₁_mem.1], by linarith [ht₁_mem.2]⟩
      let r₁ : ℝ := min ((2 * δ_star - |t₁ - t₀|) / 2) (η_sh / (4 * M_sh))
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ :=
        lt_min (by linarith) (div_pos hη_pos (by linarith))
      have ht_in_2δ : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁,
          t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (2 * δ_star) := by
        intro t ht
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at ht ⊢

        N_slab := N_slab
        N_slab_pos := cov.N_slab_pos
        x_c := x_c
        k_span := k_span
        j_idx := j_idx
        s_minus := s_minus
        idx_bounds := fun α => by
          obtain ⟨ha_ge, hb_ge⟩ := cov.step_bounds α
          cases is_point
          · dsimp [k_span, j_idx, s_minus, c_mode]
            refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
            simp
          · dsimp [k_span, j_idx, s_minus, c_mode]
            refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
            push_cast
            ring
        shift_small := fun α =>
          lt_of_lt_of_le (h_shift_eta α) (min_le_right _ _)
        covers_period := cov.covers_period
        E_left := fun α => (pkg_left α).1
        E_right := fun α => (pkg_right α).1
        left_agrees_base := fun α i =>
          hMeroAgrees_congr _ _ _ ((pkg_left α).2 i) (fun q _ => by simp)
        right_agrees_base := fun α i =>
          hMeroAgrees_congr _ _ _ ((pkg_right α).2 i) (fun q _ => by simp) }

  
  rcases hPatch with ⟨g, hg⟩ | ⟨g, hg⟩
  · exact ⟨true, ⟨buildShearedSlabPkg true W.h_X W.X_mero W.h_X_ge_two
      (fun z hz => (hLSC z hz).1) W.X_agrees_two g hg cov_X⟩⟩
  · have h_L_ge_two : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base,
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_L z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [W.h_L_eq z hz]
      exact le_trans (W.h_X_ge_two z hz) le_self_add
    exact ⟨false, ⟨buildShearedSlabPkg false W.h_L W.L_mero h_L_ge_two
      (fun z hz => (hLSC z hz).2) W.L_agrees_two g hg cov_L⟩⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_pow_holo : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f q ^ n) U := by
    intro U f hf n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) = (fun q => f q ^ 0) := by
        ext q
        simp
      rw [← h0]
      exact differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)
    | succ n ih =>
      have hs : (fun q => f q ^ (n + 1)) = (fun q => f q ^ n * f q) := by
        ext q
        exact pow_succ (f q) n
      rw [hs]
      exact ih.mul hf
  have h_prod_holo : ∀ {ι_p : Type} {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (s : Finset ι_p) (F : ι_p → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F i) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ∏ i ∈ s, F i q) U := by
    classical
    intro ι_p U s F hF
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.prod_empty]
      exact differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)
    | @insert a s' ha ih =>
      have h_eq : (fun q => ∏ i ∈ insert a s', F i q) =
          (fun q => F a q * ∏ i ∈ s', F i q) := by
        ext q
        exact Finset.prod_insert ha
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s')).mul
        (ih (fun i hi => hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))
  have h_mvpoly_holo : ∀ {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      (env_fn : ℂ × ℂ → σ → ℂ) (P : MvPolynomial σ ℂ),
      (∀ v : σ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => env_fn q v) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (env_fn q) P) U := by
    intro σ _ U env_fn P henv
    have h_eq : (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (env_fn q) P) =
        (fun q => ∑ m ∈ P.support, P.coeff m * ∏ v : σ, (env_fn q v) ^ (m v)) := by
      ext q
      exact MvPolynomial.eval_eq' (env_fn q) P
    rw [h_eq]
    refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun m _ => ?_)
    exact (h_prod_holo Finset.univ (fun v q => (env_fn q v) ^ (m v))
      (fun v _ => h_pow_holo (henv v) (m v))).const_mul (P.coeff m)
  have h_iter1D_holo : ∀ {U_A : Set ℂ} {A : ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen U_A → DifferentiableOn ℂ A U_A →
      ∀ β : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDeriv1D β A) U_A := by
    intro U_A A hUA hA β
    induction β with
    | zero => exact hA
    | succ β ih =>
      have h_eq : iterDeriv1D (β + 1) A = deriv (iterDeriv1D β A) := by
        ext t
        rw [iterDeriv1D, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        rfl
      rw [h_eq]
      exact ih.deriv hUA
  have h_mul_nz : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen U → ContinuousOn f U →
      (∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U → ∃ q ∈ V, f q ≠ 0) →
      (∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U → ∃ q ∈ V, h q ≠ 0) →
      ∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ U → ∃ q ∈ V, f q * h q ≠ 0 := by
    intro U f h hU hf_cont hf_nz hh_nz V hV hV_ne hVU
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hfq₁⟩ := hf_nz V hV hV_ne hVU
    have h_ev_f : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁, f q ≠ 0 :=
      (hf_cont.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds (hVU hq₁_mem))).eventually_ne hfq₁
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁, q ∈ V ∧ f q ≠ 0 :=
      Filter.eventually_and.mpr ⟨hV.mem_nhds hq₁_mem, h_ev_f⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_sub⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp h_ev
    obtain ⟨q₂, hq₂_ball, hhq₂⟩ := hh_nz (Metric.ball q₁ δ) Metric.isOpen_ball
      ⟨q₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos⟩ (fun q hq => hVU (hδ_sub q hq).1)
    exact ⟨q₂, (hδ_sub q₂ hq₂_ball).1, mul_ne_zero (hδ_sub q₂ hq₂_ball).2 hhq₂⟩
  have h_shear_dist : ∀ (σ_r : ℝ) (q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ),
      dist (q₁.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q₁.2, q₁.2) (q₂.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q₂.2, q₂.2) ≤
        (1 + |σ_r|) * dist q₁ q₂ := by
    intro σ_r q₁ q₂
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have h_sub : (q₁.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q₁.2) - (q₂.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q₂.2) =
          (q₁.1 - q₂.1) + (σ_r : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2) := by ring
      rw [h_sub]
      have hd₁ : ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm, Prod.dist_eq]
        exact le_max_left _ _
      have hd₂ : ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm, Prod.dist_eq]
        exact le_max_right _ _
      calc ‖(q₁.1 - q₂.1) + (σ_r : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2)‖
          ≤ ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + ‖(σ_r : ℂ) * (q₁.2 - q₂.2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + |σ_r| * ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ dist q₁ q₂ + |σ_r| * dist q₁ q₂ :=
            add_le_add hd₁ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd₂ (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = (1 + |σ_r|) * dist q₁ q₂ := by ring
    · have hd₂ : dist q₁.2 q₂.2 ≤ dist q₁ q₂ := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq]
        exact le_max_right _ _
      have h0 : 0 ≤ |σ_r| * dist q₁ q₂ := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) dist_nonneg
      linarith
  have h_shear_ball : ∀ (σ_r r R : ℝ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ),
      q ∈ Metric.ball p r → (1 + |σ_r|) * r ≤ R →
      (q.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) ∈
        Metric.ball (p.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) R := by
    intro σ_r r R p q hq hrR
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
    have h_pos : 0 < 1 + |σ_r| := by linarith [abs_nonneg σ_r]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_shear_dist σ_r q p)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq h_pos) hrR)
  have h_unsheared_open : ∀ x_c : ℝ,
      IsOpen (bandUnshearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε x_c t₁ S.r₁) := by
    intro x_c
    have h1 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.re - x_c| < ε / 16 } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp
        ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | -W.s_base / 2 < p.1.im } :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1.im < H₁ + 3 * ε / 16 } :=
      isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst) continuous_const
    have h4 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < S.r₁ } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))

  
  have h_s2 : ∀ (α : Fin S.N_slab) (ι : Fin 2),
      Nonempty (SsbpcBaseDetPkg C W.s_base (S.x_c α) (S.s_minus α) t₁ S.r₁ ε
        (S.k_span α) is_point ι) := by
    intro α ι
    let k := S.k_span α
    let j := S.j_idx α
    let x_c := S.x_c α
    let s_minus := S.s_minus α
    obtain ⟨hk, hj, hj_bnd, hs_eq⟩ := S.idx_bounds α
    have hshift := S.shift_small α
    let s_tgt : ℝ := if is_point then (j : ℝ) - 1 / 2 else (j : ℝ)
    have hj_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj
    have hk_ge_two : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hs_tgt_bounds : 0 < s_tgt ∧ s_tgt ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
      cases is_point
      · dsimp [s_tgt] at *
        have hjk : (j : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj_bnd
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · dsimp [s_tgt] at *
        have hjk : (j : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hj_bnd
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hs_sum : s_minus + s_tgt = 0 := hs_eq
    let W_small : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < hDet.s_det ∧ ‖q.2‖ < hDet.r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) }
    have hW_small_open : IsOpen W_small :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
    have hW_small_ne : W_small.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), ?_⟩
      dsimp [W_small]
      simp only [abs_zero, norm_zero]
      exact ⟨hDet.s_det_pos, div_pos hDet.r_det_pos (by linarith)⟩
    have h_unified :
        ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
          (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ)
          (Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
          (∀ q ∈ W_small,
            ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
              MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q) (Q d) *
                (glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (s_tgt : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
          (∃ q_w : ℂ × ℂ, |q_w.1.im| < hDet.s_det ∧ ‖q_w.2‖ < hDet.r_det / (k : ℝ) ∧
            MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q_w) (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
            MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q_w) Disc ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
            MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
            MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
            ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
            ∑ d : Fin D,
              (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0) := by
      cases is_point
      · dsimp [s_tgt] at hj_bnd ⊢
        obtain ⟨M, D, hD, Q₀, Disc₀, h_sol, ⟨y_w, t_w, hy_w, ht_w, hQ_w, hDisc_w⟩, h_sep⟩ :=
          hDet.line_determination k hk j hj hj_bnd ι
        have h_env_eq : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ,
            (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k false q) ∘ Sum.inl =
              lineJetEnv M
                (fun c r => glancingDualLine C r.1 r.2 c)
                (fun c r => glancingDualLine C (r.1 + (k : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 c) q := by
          intro q
          ext v
          rfl
        refine ⟨M, D, hD, fun d => MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl (Q₀ d),
          MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl Disc₀, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro q hq
          have ht_lt : ‖q.2‖ < hDet.r_det / (k : ℝ) :=
            lt_trans hq.2 (div_lt_div_of_pos_left hDet.r_det_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
          simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_rename, h_env_eq q, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
            h_sol q.1 q.2 hq.1 ht_lt
        · refine ⟨(y_w, t_w), hy_w, ht_w, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_rename, h_env_eq (y_w, t_w)] using hQ_w
          · simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_rename, h_env_eq (y_w, t_w)] using hDisc_w
        · intro env z hQ_nz hD_nz h_root
          simp only [MvPolynomial.eval_rename] at hQ_nz hD_nz h_root ⊢
          exact h_sep (env ∘ Sum.inl) z hQ_nz hD_nz h_root
      · dsimp [s_tgt] at hj_bnd ⊢
        obtain ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, h_sol, ⟨y_w, t_w, hy_w, ht_w, hQ_w, hDisc_w⟩, h_sep⟩ :=
          hDet.point_determination k hk j hj hj_bnd ι
        have h_cast : (((j : ℝ) - 1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (j : ℂ) - 1 / 2 := by
          push_cast
          ring
        refine ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, ?_, ?_, h_sep⟩
        · intro q hq
          rw [h_cast]
          exact h_sol q.1 q.2 hq.1 hq.2
        · refine ⟨(y_w, t_w), hy_w, ?_, hQ_w, hDisc_w⟩
          exact lt_trans ht_w (div_lt_div_of_pos_left hDet.r_det_pos (by linarith) (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨M, D, hD, Q, Disc, h_sol_small, ⟨q_w, hqw_im, hqw_t, hqw_Q, hqw_Disc⟩, h_sep⟩ :=
      h_unified
    let V_tilde : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { q : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖q.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det ∧
        |q.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧
        |(q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧
        |(q.1 + (s_tgt : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det }
    have hV_open : IsOpen V_tilde := by
      have h1 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
      have h2 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
          continuous_const
      have h3 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |(q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp
          (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))) continuous_const
      have h4 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |(q.1 + (s_tgt : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp
          (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))) continuous_const
      exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
    have h_im_conv : ∀ (σ_r C_b : ℝ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (a b : ℝ),
        0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 →
        |(p.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * p.2).im| < C_b →
        |(q.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q.2).im| < C_b →
        |((a • p + b • q).1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * (a • p + b • q).2).im| < C_b := by
      intro σ_r C_b p q a b ha hb hab hp hq
      have h_eq : ((a • p + b • q).1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * (a • p + b • q).2).im =
          a • (p.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * p.2).im + b • (q.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q.2).im := by
        simp [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Complex.real_smul, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, abs_lt]
      rw [abs_lt] at hp hq
      exact convex_Ioo (-C_b) C_b hp hq ha hb hab
    have hV_conv : Convex ℝ V_tilde := by
      intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_ball : a • p.2 + b • q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * hDet.r_det) :=
          convex_ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * hDet.r_det)
            (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1)
            (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq.1) ha hb hab
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using h_ball
      · simpa using h_im_conv 0 (2 * hDet.s_det) p q a b ha hb hab
          (by simpa using hp.2.1) (by simpa using hq.2.1)
      · simpa [Complex.ofReal_natCast] using
          h_im_conv (k : ℝ) (2 * hDet.s_det) p q a b ha hb hab
            (by simpa [Complex.ofReal_natCast] using hp.2.2.1)
            (by simpa [Complex.ofReal_natCast] using hq.2.2.1)
      · exact h_im_conv s_tgt (2 * hDet.s_det) p q a b ha hb hab hp.2.2.2 hq.2.2.2
    have h_line_sub : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ,
        |q.1.im| < hDet.s_det → ‖q.2‖ < hDet.r_det / (k : ℝ) → q ∈ V_tilde := by
      intro q hq_im hq_t
      have hk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by linarith
      have ht_lt_r : ‖q.2‖ < hDet.r_det := by
        have h1 : hDet.r_det / (k : ℝ) ≤ hDet.r_det / 1 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hDet.r_det_pos) zero_lt_one (by linarith)
        linarith
      have h_shift_im : ∀ σ_r : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ_r → σ_r ≤ (k : ℝ) →
          |(q.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q.2).im| < 2 * hDet.s_det := by
        intro σ_r hσ0 hσk
        have him : (q.1 + (σ_r : ℂ) * q.2).im = q.1.im + σ_r * q.2.im := by
          simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]

      rcases h_or with h_sub_z | h_sub_nz
      · exact h_sub_z
      · exfalso
        have h_emp : p_base ∈ Ω_tube ∩ (V_zero ∩ V_nz) :=
          ⟨hp_base_tube,
            Set.mem_biUnion hp_base_Z (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_t_spec p_base hp_base_tube).1),
            h_sub_nz hp_base_tube⟩
        rw [h_disj] at h_emp
        exact h_emp
    have hp_tgt_tube : p_tgt ∈ Ω_tube := ⟨hU_β_sub hp_tgt.1, hp_tgt.2⟩
    have hp_tgt_Z : p_tgt ∈ Z_t := by
      by_contra h_nZ
      have h_emp : p_tgt ∈ Ω_tube ∩ (V_zero ∩ V_nz) :=
        ⟨hp_tgt_tube, hΩ_sub_Vz hp_tgt_tube,
          Set.mem_biUnion ⟨hp_tgt_tube, h_nZ⟩
            (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_t_spec p_tgt hp_tgt_tube).1)⟩
      rw [h_disj] at h_emp
      exact h_emp
    obtain ⟨hr_t_pos, _, hr_t_L, hr_t_s⟩ := hr_t_spec p_tgt hp_tgt_tube
    obtain ⟨r_u, hr_u_pos, hr_u_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_β_open p_tgt hp_tgt.1
    let r_p := min r_u (r_t p_tgt)
    have hr_p_pos : 0 < r_p := lt_min hr_u_pos hr_t_pos
    have hr_p_L : r_p ≤ (W.L_mero ι).rad p_tgt := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) hr_t_L
    have hr_p_U : Metric.ball p_tgt r_p ⊆ U_β :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr_u_sub
    have hr_p_bt : Metric.ball p_tgt r_p ⊆ Metric.ball p_tgt (r_t p_tgt) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    refine ⟨r_p, hr_p_pos, hr_p_L, hr_p_U, ?_⟩
    let tgt_sum : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        N_sh d p_sh_b (L_s q) * ((W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q) ^ (d : ℕ) *
          ((W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ))
    have htgt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ tgt_sum (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun d _ => ?_)
      have hN_c : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => N_sh d p_sh_b (L_s q)) (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) :=
        (hN_holo d p_sh_b hp_sh_b).comp hL_s_diff.differentiableOn
          (fun q hq => hU_β_map q (hr_p_U hq))
      have h_num : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ((W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q) ^ (d : ℕ))
          (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) :=
        h_pow_holo (((W.L_mero ι).num_holo p_tgt hp_tgt.2).mono
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_L)) (d : ℕ)
      have h_den : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ((W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q) ^ (D - (d : ℕ)))
          (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) :=
        h_pow_holo (((W.L_mero ι).den_holo p_tgt hp_tgt.2).mono
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_L)) (D - (d : ℕ))
      exact (hN_c.mul h_num).mul h_den
    have hp_tgt_sh : L_s p_tgt ∈ Ω_sh := hL_s_maps p_tgt hp_tgt_tube.1
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hq₁_D_nz⟩ := hD_pull_nz hp_tgt_sh
      (fun q hq => h_shear_ball s_minus (r_t p_tgt) (r_sh (L_s p_tgt)) p_tgt q
        (hr_p_bt hq) hr_t_s)
      (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_tgt, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_p_pos⟩
      Set.Subset.rfl
    have hD_tgt_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q => D_sh (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q))
        (Metric.ball p_tgt r_p) :=
      ((hD_holo (L_s p_tgt) hp_tgt_sh).comp hL_s_diff.differentiableOn
        (fun q hq => h_shear_ball s_minus (r_t p_tgt) (r_sh (L_s p_tgt)) p_tgt q
          (hr_p_bt hq) hr_t_s)).continuousOn
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₁,
        q ∈ Metric.ball p_tgt r_p ∧ D_sh (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q) ≠ 0 :=
      Filter.eventually_and.mpr ⟨Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq₁_mem,
        (hD_tgt_cont.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq₁_mem)).eventually_ne hq₁_D_nz⟩
    obtain ⟨δ_p, hδ_p_pos, hδ_p_sub⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp h_ev
    have htgt_zero_sub : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ δ_p, tgt_sum q = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hq_rp, hD_q_nz⟩ := hδ_p_sub q hq
      have h_mul_eq : tgt_sum q * D_sh (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q) =
          Res p_tgt q * D_sh p_sh_b (L_s q) := by
        dsimp [tgt_sum, Res]
        rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
        have hc := hCompat d p_sh_b hp_sh_b (L_s p_tgt) hp_tgt_sh (L_s q)
          ⟨hU_β_map q (hr_p_U hq_rp),
            h_shear_ball s_minus (r_t p_tgt) (r_sh (L_s p_tgt)) p_tgt q
              (hr_p_bt hq_rp) hr_t_s⟩
        calc N_sh d p_sh_b (L_s q) * (W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q ^ (d : ℕ) *
              (W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) * D_sh (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q)
            = (N_sh d p_sh_b (L_s q) * D_sh (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q)) *
              ((W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q ^ (d : ℕ) *
                (W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) := by ring
          _ = (N_sh d (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q) * D_sh p_sh_b (L_s q)) *
              ((W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q ^ (d : ℕ) *
                (W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q ^ (D - (d : ℕ))) := by rw [hc]
          _ = N_sh d (L_s p_tgt) (L_s q) * (W.L_mero ι).num p_tgt q ^ (d : ℕ) *
              (W.L_mero ι).den p_tgt q ^ (D - (d : ℕ)) * D_sh p_sh_b (L_s q) := by ring
      rw [hp_tgt_Z.2 q (hr_p_bt hq_rp), zero_mul] at h_mul_eq
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_mul_eq).resolve_right hD_q_nz
    exact B_cr.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_p_pos⟩
      (fun q hq => (hδ_p_sub q hq).1) htgt_holo htgt_zero_sub

  
  have h_s5 : ∀ (r_chart : Fin S.N_slab → ℂ × ℂ → ℝ),
      (∀ α : Fin S.N_slab,
        ∀ q_sh ∈ bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (S.x_c α) (S.s_minus α) t₁ S.r₁,
          0 < r_chart α q_sh) →
      Nonempty (SsbpcBandChartBidiskCover W.s_base H₁ ε t₁ S.r₁ S.N_slab
        S.x_c S.s_minus r_chart) := by
    intro r_chart hr_chart_pos
    let mk_y : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u => (u.1 : ℂ) + (u.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let K_y : Set ℂ :=
      mk_y '' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (H₁ - ε / 16) (H₁ + ε / 16))
    let K_band : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := K_y ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (S.r₁ / 2)
    have hmk_cont : Continuous mk_y :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K_band :=
      ((isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hmk_cont).prod
        (isCompact_closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (S.r₁ / 2))
    have h_pt_slab : ∀ pt : ↥K_band,
        ∃ α : Fin S.N_slab,
          pt.1 ∈ bandUnshearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (S.x_c α) t₁ S.r₁ := by
      intro pt
      rcases pt with ⟨⟨y, τ⟩, ⟨⟨⟨x, y_im⟩, ⟨hx, hy_im⟩, hy_eq⟩, hτ⟩⟩
      dsimp only at hx hy_im hy_eq hτ
      obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := S.covers_period x hx
      refine ⟨α, ?_⟩
      have hy_re : y.re = x := by rw [← hy_eq]; simp [mk_y]
      have hy_i : y.im = y_im := by rw [← hy_eq]; simp [mk_y]
      have hτ_lt : ‖τ - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < S.r₁ := by
        have h_le : ‖τ - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ S.r₁ / 2 := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hτ
        linarith [S.r₁_pos]
      exact ⟨by simpa [hy_re] using hα,
        by dsimp only; rw [hy_i]; linarith [hy_im.1, hH₁_ge, hε_lt, W.s_base_pos],
        by dsimp only; rw [hy_i]; linarith [hy_im.2, hε_pos],
        hτ_lt⟩
    let α_pt : ↥K_band → Fin S.N_slab := fun pt => Classical.choose (h_pt_slab pt)
    have hα_pt_mem : ∀ pt : ↥K_band,
        pt.1 ∈ bandUnshearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (S.x_c (α_pt pt)) t₁ S.r₁ :=
      fun pt => Classical.choose_spec (h_pt_slab pt)
    have h_pt_rΩ : ∀ pt : ↥K_band, ∃ r : ℝ,
        0 < r ∧ Metric.ball pt.1 r ⊆
          bandUnshearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (S.x_c (α_pt pt)) t₁ S.r₁ :=
      fun pt => Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (h_unsheared_open (S.x_c (α_pt pt))) pt.1 (hα_pt_mem pt)
    let rΩ_pt : ↥K_band → ℝ := fun pt => Classical.choose (h_pt_rΩ pt)
    have hrΩ_spec : ∀ pt : ↥K_band,
        0 < rΩ_pt pt ∧ Metric.ball pt.1 (rΩ_pt pt) ⊆
          bandUnshearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε (S.x_c (α_pt pt)) t₁ S.r₁ :=
      fun pt => Classical.choose_spec (h_pt_rΩ pt)
    let p_sh_pt : ↥K_band → ℂ × ℂ := fun pt =>
      (pt.1.1 + (S.s_minus (α_pt pt) : ℂ) * pt.1.2, pt.1.2)
    have hp_sh_mem : ∀ pt : ↥K_band,
        p_sh_pt pt ∈ bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε
          (S.x_c (α_pt pt)) (S.s_minus (α_pt pt)) t₁ S.r₁ := by
      intro pt
      dsimp [bandShearedSlab, p_sh_pt]
      convert hα_pt_mem pt using 1
      ext <;> simp
    let ρ_pt : ↥K_band → ℝ := fun pt =>
      min (S.r₁ / 4)
        (min (rΩ_pt pt)
          (r_chart (α_pt pt) (p_sh_pt pt) / (1 + |S.s_minus (α_pt pt)|)))
    have hρ_pt_pos : ∀ pt : ↥K_band, 0 < ρ_pt pt := by
      intro pt
      refine lt_min (by linarith [S.r₁_pos]) (lt_min (hrΩ_spec pt).1 ?_)
      exact div_pos (hr_chart_pos (α_pt pt) (p_sh_pt pt) (hp_sh_mem pt))
        (by linarith [abs_nonneg (S.s_minus (α_pt pt))])
    obtain ⟨T_fin, hT_cov⟩ := hK_compact.elim_finite_subcover
      (fun pt : ↥K_band => Metric.ball pt.1 (3 * ρ_pt pt / 4))
      (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
      (fun p hp => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩,
        Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith [hρ_pt_pos ⟨p, hp⟩])⟩)
    let e := T_fin.equivFin.symm
    refine ⟨{
      N_cov := T_fin.card
      α_of := fun β => α_pt (e β).1
      y_c := fun β => (e β).1.1.1
      τ_c := fun β => (e β).1.1.2
      ρ := fun β => ρ_pt (e β).1
      ρ_pos := fun β => by
        let pt := (e β).1
        refine ⟨hρ_pt_pos pt, ?_⟩
        intro τ hτ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hτ ⊢
        change dist τ pt.1.2 < ρ_pt pt at hτ
        have h1 : ρ_pt pt ≤ S.r₁ / 4 := min_le_left _ _
        have h2 : dist pt.1.2 (t₁ : ℂ) ≤ S.r₁ / 2 :=
          Metric.mem_closedBall.mp pt.2.2
        linarith [dist_triangle τ pt.1.2 (t₁ : ℂ), S.r₁_pos]
      covers_band := fun x y_im t hx hy_im ht => by
        let p : ℂ × ℂ := ((x : ℂ) + (y_im : ℂ) * Complex.I, t)
        have hp_K : p ∈ K_band := ⟨⟨(x, y_im), ⟨hx, hy_im⟩, rfl⟩, ht⟩
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hT_cov hp_K) with ⟨pt, hpt_T, hp_ball⟩
        let β : Fin T_fin.card := T_fin.equivFin ⟨pt, hpt_T⟩
        have heβ : e β = ⟨pt, hpt_T⟩ := T_fin.equivFin.symm_apply_apply ⟨pt, hpt_T⟩
        rw [← ball_prod_same] at hp_ball
        refine ⟨β, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [heβ] using hp_ball.1
        · simpa only [heβ] using hp_ball.2
      center_in_sheared := fun β => hp_sh_mem (e β).1
      bidisk_in_unsheared := fun β => by
        let pt := (e β).1
        rw [ball_prod_same]
        exact Set.Subset.trans
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
          (hrΩ_spec pt).2
      sheared_in_chart_ball := fun β => by
        dsimp only
        let pt := (e β).1
        intro q hq
        rw [ball_prod_same] at hq
        have h1s_pos : 0 < 1 + |S.s_minus (α_pt pt)| :=
          by linarith [abs_nonneg (S.s_minus (α_pt pt))]
        have h_le : ρ_pt pt ≤
            r_chart (α_pt pt) (p_sh_pt pt) / (1 + |S.s_minus (α_pt pt)|) :=
          le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
        have h_mul : (1 + |S.s_minus (α_pt pt)|) * ρ_pt pt ≤
            r_chart (α_pt pt) (p_sh_pt pt) := by
          have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le (le_of_lt h1s_pos)
          rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt h1s_pos)] at hm
        exact h_shear_ball (S.s_minus (α_pt pt)) (ρ_pt pt)
          (r_chart (α_pt pt) (p_sh_pt pt)) pt.1 q hq h_mul
    }⟩

  
  let detPkg : ∀ (α : Fin S.N_slab) (ι : Fin 2),
      SsbpcBaseDetPkg C W.s_base (S.x_c α) (S.s_minus α) t₁ S.r₁ ε (S.k_span α) is_point ι :=
    fun α ι => Classical.choice (h_s2 α ι)
  have hClear : ∀ α : Fin S.N_slab,
      SsbpcMeroJetClearedProp
        (bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base (S.x_c α) (S.s_minus α) t₁ S.r₁ ε)
        (S.E_left α) (S.E_right α)
        (fun i q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point q.1 q.2 i)
        (fun i q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (q.1 + (S.k_span α : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 i)
        C.A := by
    intro α
    let x_c := S.x_c α
    let s_minus := S.s_minus α
    let Ω_sh := bandShearedSlab W.s_base H₁ ε x_c s_minus t₁ S.r₁
    let B_sh := bandShearedBaseBox W.s_base x_c s_minus t₁ S.r₁ ε
    have h_inv_cont : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) :=
      (continuous_fst.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)).prodMk continuous_snd
    have hΩ_sh_open : IsOpen Ω_sh := (h_unsheared_open x_c).preimage h_inv_cont
    have hΩ_sh_conv : Convex ℝ Ω_sh := by
      intro q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ a b ha hb hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h_re : ((a • q₁ + b • q₂).1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * (a • q₁ + b • q₂).2).re - x_c =
            a • ((q₁.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₁.2).re - x_c) +
            b • ((q₂.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₂.2).re - x_c) := by
          simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
            Complex.real_smul, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_re,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
          calc a * q₁.1.re + b * q₂.1.re - s_minus * (a * q₁.2.re + b * q₂.2.re) - x_c
              = a * q₁.1.re + b * q₂.1.re - s_minus * (a * q₁.2.re + b * q₂.2.re) -
                  (a + b) * x_c := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (q₁.1.re - s_minus * q₁.2.re - x_c) +
                  b * (q₂.1.re - s_minus * q₂.2.re - x_c) := by ring
        dsimp only
        rw [h_re, abs_lt]
        exact convex_Ioo (-(ε / 16)) (ε / 16) (abs_lt.mp hq₁.1) (abs_lt.mp hq₂.1) ha hb hab
      · have h_im : ((a • q₁ + b • q₂).1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * (a • q₁ + b • q₂).2).im =
            a • (q₁.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₁.2).im + b • (q₂.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₂.2).im := by
          simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
            Complex.real_smul, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        dsimp only
        rw [h_im]
        exact (convex_Ioo (-W.s_base / 2) (H₁ + 3 * ε / 16)
          ⟨hq₁.2.1, hq₁.2.2.1⟩ ⟨hq₂.2.1, hq₂.2.2.1⟩ ha hb hab).1
      · have h_im : ((a • q₁ + b • q₂).1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * (a • q₁ + b • q₂).2).im =
            a • (q₁.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₁.2).im + b • (q₂.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q₂.2).im := by
          simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
            Complex.real_smul, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        dsimp only
        rw [h_im]
        exact (convex_Ioo (-W.s_base / 2) (H₁ + 3 * ε / 16)
          ⟨hq₁.2.1, hq₁.2.2.1⟩ ⟨hq₂.2.1, hq₂.2.2.1⟩ ha hb hab).2
      · have h_b : a • q₁.2 + b • q₂.2 ∈ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) S.r₁ :=
          convex_ball (t₁ : ℂ) S.r₁
            (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq₁.2.2.2)
            (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq₂.2.2.2) ha hb hab
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using h_b
    have hB_sh_open : IsOpen B_sh := by
      have h_y : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2) :=
        continuous_fst.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)
      have h1 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).re - x_c| < ε / 16 } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp h_y).sub continuous_const))
          continuous_const
      have h2 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | |(q.1 - (s_minus : ℂ) * q.2).im| < W.s_base / 2 } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp h_y)) continuous_const
      have h3 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2 - (t₁ : ℂ)‖ < S.r₁ } :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const
      exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
    have hB_sh_ne : B_sh.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨((x_c : ℂ) + (s_minus : ℂ) * (t₁ : ℂ), (t₁ : ℂ)), ?_⟩
      dsimp [B_sh, bandShearedBaseBox]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, sub_self, abs_zero, norm_zero]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith [W.s_base_pos], S.r₁_pos⟩
    have hB_sh_sub : B_sh ⊆ Ω_sh := by
      intro q ⟨hq_re, hq_im, hq_t⟩

          N_sh d p_sh_base (L_α α q) * (glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
        rw [h_fac, (detPkg α ι).base_solves q hLq_base, mul_zero]
      exact h_s4 (S.x_c α) (S.s_minus α) ι D_i (r_chart α) N_sh D_sh
        (hClear α).rad_pos
        (fun d q_sh hq_sh => (hClear α).cleared_holo M_i R_i ((detPkg α ι).Q d) q_sh hq_sh)
        (fun q_sh hq_sh => h_pow_holo
          (h_pow_holo ((hClear α).denProd_holo q_sh hq_sh) (2 * M_i + 1)) R_i)
        (fun q_sh hq_sh V hV hV_ne hV_sub => by
          obtain ⟨w, hwV, hw_nz⟩ := (hClear α).denProd_ne_zero q_sh hq_sh V hV hV_ne hV_sub
          exact ⟨w, hwV, pow_ne_zero R_i (pow_ne_zero (2 * M_i + 1) hw_nz)⟩)
        (fun d p_sh1 hp_sh1 p_sh2 hp_sh2 w hw =>
          (hClear α).chart_compat M_i R_i ((detPkg α ι).Q d)
            (Finset.le_sup (f := fun d' => ssbpcPolyDeg ((detPkg α ι).Q d')) (Finset.mem_univ d))
            p_sh1 hp_sh1 p_sh2 hp_sh2 w hw)
        hBaseZero
        (p_sh_of β) (cov.center_in_sheared β)
        (Metric.ball (cov.y_c β) (cov.ρ β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (cov.τ_c β) (cov.ρ β))
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
        (cov.bidisk_in_unsheared β)
        (cov.sheared_in_chart_ball β)
        p hp
  }⟩

sheared_slab_band_poly_clearing.definitions:
noncomputable def ssbpcBaseJetEnv {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M k : ℕ) (is_point : Bool) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : PointJetVar M → ℂ :=
  pointJetEnv M
    (fun i r => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point r.1 r.2 i)
    (fun i r => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (r.1 + (k : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 i)
    C.A q

structure SsbpcBaseDetPkg {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (is_point : Bool) (ι : Fin 2) where
  M : ℕ
  D : ℕ
  D_pos : 1 ≤ D
  Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ
  Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ
  base_left_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point q.1 q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε)
  base_right_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q => bandBaseEndpointFn C is_point (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 i)
      (bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε)
  base_solves : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
    (p.1 + (s_minus : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
      MvPolynomial.eval
        (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point (p.1 + (s_minus : ℂ) * p.2, p.2))
        (Q d) *
      (glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0
  lead_ne_zero_on_base : ∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty →
    V₀ ⊆ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q) (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0
  disc_ne_zero_on_base : ∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty →
    V₀ ⊆ bandShearedBaseBox s_base x_c s_minus t₁ r₁ ε →
    ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (ssbpcBaseJetEnv C M k is_point q) Disc ≠ 0
  univ_separable : ∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
    MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
    MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
    ∑ d : Fin D,
      (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0

noncomputable def ssbpcQuotNumY (D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, N => N
  | m + 1, N => fun q =>
      pderivA (ssbpcQuotNumY D m N) q * D q -
        ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ssbpcQuotNumY D m N q * pderivA D q

noncomputable def ssbpcQuotNumYT (D : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℕ) : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, N => ssbpcQuotNumY D a N
  | m + 1, N => fun q =>
      pderivD (ssbpcQuotNumYT D a m N) q * D q -
        ((a + m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ssbpcQuotNumYT D a m N q * pderivD D q

noncomputable def ssbpcPolyDeg {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℂ) : ℕ :=
  P.support.sup (fun m => ∑ v : σ, m v)

noncomputable def ssbpcHomogEval {σ : Type} [Fintype σ] (R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial σ ℂ)
    (M_num : σ → ℂ) (D_den : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ m ∈ P.support,
    P.coeff m * (∏ v : σ, (M_num v) ^ (m v)) * D_den ^ (R - ∑ v : σ, m v)

noncomputable def ssbpcPairChartRad {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℝ :=
  min (min ((E₀ 0).rad p) ((E₀ 1).rad p)) (min ((E₁ 0).rad p) ((E₁ 1).rad p))

noncomputable def ssbpcPairNum {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if ci.1 = 0 then (E₀ ci.2).num p q else (E₁ ci.2).num p q

noncomputable def ssbpcPairDen {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) (ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  if ci.1 = 0 then (E₀ ci.2).den p q else (E₁ ci.2).den p q

noncomputable def ssbpcPairDenProd {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∏ ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2, ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q ci

noncomputable def ssbpcClearedJetEnv {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M : ℕ)
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : PointJetVar M → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      let ci : Fin 2 × Fin 2 := (v.1, v.2.1)
      ssbpcQuotNumYT (fun r => ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p r ci) v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
          (fun r => ssbpcPairNum E₀ E₁ p r ci) q *
        (ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q ci) ^ ((2 * M + 1) - (v.2.2.1.1 + v.2.2.2.1 + 1)) *
        ∏ cj ∈ Finset.univ.erase ci, (ssbpcPairDen E₀ E₁ p q cj) ^ (2 * M + 1)
  | Sum.inr β =>
      iterDeriv1D β.1 A q.2 * (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)

noncomputable def ssbpcClearedPoly {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (M R : ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ) (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom)
    (A : ℂ → ℂ) (p q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ssbpcHomogEval R P (ssbpcClearedJetEnv M E₀ E₁ A p q)
    ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1))

structure SsbpcMeroJetClearedProp {Ω_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (B_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D Ω_dom) (g₀ g₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (A : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  rad_pos : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, 0 < ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p ∧
    Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) ⊆ Ω_dom
  denProd_holo : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p)
      (Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p))
  denProd_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) →
    ∃ q ∈ V, ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q ≠ 0
  cleared_holo : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p)
        (Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p))
  eval_at_reg : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p),
      ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q ≠ 0 →
      let D_com := (ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)
      let env : PointJetVar M → ℂ := fun v => ssbpcClearedJetEnv M E₀ E₁ A p q v / D_com
      ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q = D_com ^ R * MvPolynomial.eval env P
  chart_compat : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p₁ ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ p₂ ∈ Ω_dom,
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p₁) ∩
          Metric.ball p₂ (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p₂),
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p₁ q *
          ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p₂ q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R =
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p₂ q *
          ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p₁ q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R
  agrees_on_base : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    ∀ p ∈ B_base, ∃ r_ag : ℝ,
      0 < r_ag ∧ r_ag ≤ ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p ∧ Metric.ball p r_ag ⊆ B_base ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r_ag,
        ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q =
          MvPolynomial.eval (pointJetEnv M g₀ g₁ A q) P *
            ((ssbpcPairDenProd E₀ E₁ p q) ^ (2 * M + 1)) ^ R
  cleared_ne_zero_of_base : ∀ (M R : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
    ssbpcPolyDeg P ≤ R →
    (∀ V₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V₀ → V₀.Nonempty → V₀ ⊆ B_base →
      ∃ q ∈ V₀, MvPolynomial.eval (pointJetEnv M g₀ g₁ A q) P ≠ 0) →
    ∀ p ∈ Ω_dom, ∀ V : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ Metric.ball p (ssbpcPairChartRad E₀ E₁ p) →
      ∃ q ∈ V, ssbpcClearedPoly M R P E₀ E₁ A p q ≠ 0

structure SsbpcBandChartBidiskCover (s_base H₁ ε t₁ r₁ : ℝ) (N_slab : ℕ)
    (x_c s_minus : Fin N_slab → ℝ)
    (r_chart : Fin N_slab → ℂ × ℂ → ℝ) where
  N_cov : ℕ
  α_of : Fin N_cov → Fin N_slab
  y_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  τ_c : Fin N_cov → ℂ
  ρ : Fin N_cov → ℝ
  ρ_pos : ∀ β : Fin N_cov, 0 < ρ β ∧
    Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β) ⊆ Metric.ball (t₁ : ℂ) r₁
  covers_band : ∀ (x y_im : ℝ) (t : ℂ),
    x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
    y_im ∈ Set.Icc (H₁ - ε / 16) (H₁ + ε / 16) →
    t ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₁ : ℂ) (r₁ / 2) →
    ∃ β : Fin N_cov,
      ((x : ℂ) + (y_im : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (3 * ρ β / 4) ∧
      t ∈ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (3 * ρ β / 4)
  center_in_sheared : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    ((y_c β) + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * (τ_c β), τ_c β) ∈
      bandShearedSlab s_base H₁ ε (x_c (α_of β)) (s_minus (α_of β)) t₁ r₁
  bidisk_in_unsheared : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β) ⊆
      bandUnshearedSlab s_base H₁ ε (x_c (α_of β)) t₁ r₁
  sheared_in_chart_ball : ∀ β : Fin N_cov,
    let p_sh := ((y_c β) + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * (τ_c β), τ_c β)
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (y_c β) (ρ β) ×ˢ Metric.ball (τ_c β) (ρ β),
      (q.1 + (s_minus (α_of β) : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) ∈
        Metric.ball p_sh (r_chart (α_of β) p_sh)
