proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := (Ω, hDet)
  
  
  
  have h_part1 :
      2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀ ∧
      ∃ (g_nf : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ) (s₀ : ℂ) (r_reg : ℝ),
        (∀ i : Fin 2,
          MeromorphicOn (g_nf i) (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2,
          ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩ horizStrip H₀,
            g_nf i z = Z₀.Γ_slice z i) ∧
        0 < r_reg ∧
        Metric.ball s₀ r_reg ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩ horizStrip H₀ ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_reg, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ Z₀.E_disc) := by
    have h2s_pos : 0 < 2 * W.s_base := by linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    have h_ge_two : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ W.h_X 0 :=
      W.h_X_ge_two 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self W.r_base_pos)
    have h_ge_ofReal : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * W.s_base) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal H₀ := hHX ▸ h_ge_two
    have hH₀_ennr_pos : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal H₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr h2s_pos) h_ge_ofReal
    have hH₀_pos : 0 < H₀ := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp hH₀_ennr_pos
    have hH₀_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀ :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_of_lt hH₀_pos)).mp h_ge_ofReal
    have hstrip_iff : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ↔ s ∈ horizStrip H₀ := by
      intro s
      dsimp [horizStripENNR, horizStrip]
      rw [hHX, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₀_pos]

    let s_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let B_plus : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_star ε
    have hg_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2,
        MeromorphicOn (g i) (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) :=
      Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨hg0, hg1⟩

    have h_upper : ∃ (g₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ) (V₁ : Set ℂ),
        (∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (g₁ i) B_plus) ∧
        IsOpen V₁ ∧ V₁.Nonempty ∧
        V₁ ⊆ B_plus ∩ horizStrip H₀ ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V₁, g₁ i z = Z₀.Γ_slice z i) := by
      rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl
      · have h1 : ((1 * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) = (H₀ : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        refine ⟨g, V_overlap, ?_, hVopen, hVne, ?_, hg_eq⟩
        · intro i; simpa [B_plus, s_star, h1] using hg_mero i
        · simpa [B_plus, s_star, h1] using hVsub
      · let conj := starRingEnd ℂ
        let s_minus : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (((-1 : ℝ) * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        have hconj_star : conj s_star = s_minus := by
          dsimp [conj, s_star, s_minus]
          simp [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
        have hdist_conj : ∀ a b : ℂ, dist (conj a) (conj b) = dist a b := by
          intro a b
          rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub, Complex.norm_conj]
        have hdist_star : ∀ z : ℂ, dist (conj z) s_minus = dist z s_star := by
          intro z
          rw [← hconj_star, hdist_conj]
        let g₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun i z => conj (g i (conj z))
        have hg₁_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (g₁ i) B_plus := by
          intro i z₀ hz₀
          have hw₀ : conj z₀ ∈ Metric.ball s_minus ε := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_star]
            exact hz₀
          obtain ⟨n, u, hu_an, hu_ev⟩ :=
            MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mp (hg_mero i (conj z₀) hw₀)
          obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_an⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hu_an.eventually_analyticAt
          let u_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := ⇑conj ∘ u ∘ ⇑conj
          have hu_tilde_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ u_tilde (Metric.ball z₀ r₂) := by
            intro z hz
            have hcz : dist (conj z) (conj z₀) < r₂ := by
              rw [hdist_conj]; exact hz
            have hu_hd := (hr₂_an hcz).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
            have hcc := hu_hd.conj_conj
            rw [Complex.conj_conj] at hcc
            exact hcc.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          have hu_tilde_an : AnalyticAt ℂ u_tilde z₀ :=
            hu_tilde_holo.analyticAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₂_pos))
          obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_eq⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hu_ev
          refine MeromorphicAt.iff_eventuallyEq_zpow_smul_analyticAt.mpr ⟨n, u_tilde, hu_tilde_an, ?_⟩
          refine Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, ?_⟩
          rintro z ⟨hz_lt, hz_ne⟩
          have hcz_lt : conj z ∈ Metric.ball (conj z₀) r₁ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist_conj]; exact hz_lt
          have hcz_ne : conj z ≠ conj z₀ := by
            intro heq
            apply hz_ne
            have h1 := congrArg conj heq
            simpa [conj, Complex.conj_conj] using h1
          have hgz : g i (conj z) = (conj z - conj z₀) ^ n • u (conj z) :=
            hr₁_eq ⟨hcz_lt, hcz_ne⟩
          dsimp [g₁, u_tilde, Function.comp]
          change conj (g i (conj z)) = (z - z₀) ^ n • conj (u (conj z))
          rw [hgz]
          simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_zpow₀, map_sub, conj, Complex.conj_conj]
        obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀_V⟩ := hVne
        have hp₀_sub := hVsub hp₀_V
        have hp₀_strip : p₀ ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) := (hstrip_iff p₀).mpr hp₀_sub.2
        obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hVopen p₀ hp₀_V
        have hconj_both : ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin p₀ {p₀}ᶜ,
            ∀ i : Fin 2, Z₀.Γ_slice (conj w) i = conj (Z₀.Γ_slice w i) := by
          filter_upwards [Z₀.Γ_conj_nhdsNE p₀ hp₀_strip 0,
            Z₀.Γ_conj_nhdsNE p₀ hp₀_strip 1] with w hw0 hw1 i
          fin_cases i
          · exact hw0
          · exact hw1
        obtain ⟨r_c, hr_c_pos, hr_c_eq⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hconj_both
        let r : ℝ := min r_V r_c
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr_V_pos hr_c_pos
        let p₁ : ℂ := p₀ + ((r / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let V₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (conj p₁) (r / 2)
        have hV₁_open : IsOpen V₁ := Metric.isOpen_ball
        have hV₁_ne : V₁.Nonempty := ⟨conj p₁, Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hr_pos)⟩
        have hp₁_dist : dist p₁ p₀ = r / 2 := by
          dsimp [p₁]
          rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (half_pos hr_pos))]
        have hV₁_w : ∀ z ∈ V₁,
            conj z ∈ V_overlap ∧ conj z ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r_c ∧ conj z ≠ p₀ := by
          intro z hz
          have hwp₁ : dist (conj z) p₁ < r / 2 := by
            have h1 : dist (conj z) (conj (conj p₁)) < r / 2 := by
              rwa [hdist_conj]
            simpa [conj, Complex.conj_conj] using h1
          have hwp₀ : dist (conj z) p₀ < r := by
            calc
              dist (conj z) p₀ ≤ dist (conj z) p₁ + dist p₁ p₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
              _ < r / 2 + r / 2 := by rw [hp₁_dist]; linarith
              _ = r := add_halves r
          have hw_ne : conj z ≠ p₀ := by
            intro heq
            rw [heq, dist_comm, hp₁_dist] at hwp₁
            exact lt_irrefl _ hwp₁
          exact ⟨hr_V_sub (lt_of_lt_of_le hwp₀ (min_le_left _ _)),
            lt_of_lt_of_le hwp₀ (min_le_right _ _), hw_ne⟩
        refine ⟨g₁, V₁, hg₁_mero, hV₁_open, hV₁_ne, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro z hz
          obtain ⟨hw_V, _, _⟩ := hV₁_w z hz
          have hw_sub := hVsub hw_V
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [Metric.mem_ball, ← hdist_star]
            exact hw_sub.1
          · dsimp [horizStrip] at hw_sub ⊢
            have him : (conj z).im = -z.im := Complex.conj_im z
            have habs : |(conj z).im| = |z.im| := by rw [him, abs_neg]
            rw [← habs]
            exact hw_sub.2
        · intro i z hz
          obtain ⟨hw_V, hw_rc, hw_ne⟩ := hV₁_w z hz
          have hc_slice : Z₀.Γ_slice (conj (conj z)) i = conj (Z₀.Γ_slice (conj z) i) :=
            hr_c_eq ⟨hw_rc, hw_ne⟩ i
          dsimp [g₁]
          rw [hg_eq i (conj z) hw_V, ← hc_slice]
          dsimp [conj]
          rw [Complex.conj_conj]

    obtain ⟨g₁, V₁, hg₁_mero, hV₁_open, hV₁_ne, hV₁_sub, hg₁_eq⟩ := h_upper

    let g_nf : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun i => toMeromorphicNFOn (g₁ i) B_plus
    have hg_nf_nf : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicNFOn (g_nf i) B_plus :=
      fun i => meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn (g₁ i) B_plus
    have hg_nf_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeromorphicOn (g_nf i) B_plus :=
      fun i => (hg_nf_nf i).meromorphicOn

    let U_int : Set ℂ := B_plus ∩ horizStrip H₀
    have hstrip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip H₀) :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hU_int_open : IsOpen U_int := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hstrip_open
    have hstrip_conv : Convex ℝ (horizStrip H₀) := by
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      change |x.im| < H₀ at hx
      change |y.im| < H₀ at hy
      change |(a • x + b • y).im| < H₀
      have him : (a • x + b • y).im = a * x.im + b * y.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      calc
        |a * x.im + b * y.im| ≤ |a * x.im| + |b * y.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |x.im| + b * |y.im| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ < a * H₀ + b * H₀ := by
          by_cases ha0 : a = 0
          · subst ha0
            have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
            subst hb1; linarith
          · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
            have h1 : a * |x.im| < a * H₀ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx ha_pos
            have h2 : b * |y.im| ≤ b * H₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy) hb
            linarith
        _ = H₀ := by linear_combination H₀ * hab
    have hU_int_pre : IsPreconnected U_int :=
      ((convex_ball s_star ε).inter hstrip_conv).isPreconnected

    obtain ⟨z_v, hz_v_V₁⟩ := hV₁_ne
    have hz_v_U : z_v ∈ U_int := hV₁_sub hz_v_V₁

    have hg_nf_eq_slice : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ U_int, g_nf i z = Z₀.Γ_slice z i := by
      intro i z hz
      let γ_i : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Z₀.Γ_slice w i
      have hγ_nf : MeromorphicNFOn γ_i (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) := by
        dsimp [γ_i]; fin_cases i
        · exact Z₀.Γ_nf.1
        · exact Z₀.Γ_nf.2
      have hγ_mero : MeromorphicOn γ_i (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) := by
        dsimp [γ_i]; fin_cases i
        · exact Z₀.Γ_mero.1
        · exact Z₀.Γ_mero.2
      have hd_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun w => g_nf i w - γ_i w) U_int :=
        MeromorphicOn.sub (fun w hw => hg_nf_mero i w hw.1)
          (fun w hw => hγ_mero w ((hstrip_iff w).mpr hw.2))
      have hd_top_zv : meromorphicOrderAt (fun w => g_nf i w - γ_i w) z_v = ⊤ := by
        rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff]
        have hev1 : g_nf i =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z_v {z_v}ᶜ] g₁ i :=
          (hg₁_mero i).toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_self_on_nhdsNE hz_v_U.1
        have hev2 : g₁ i =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z_v {z_v}ᶜ] γ_i :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hV₁_open.mem_nhds hz_v_V₁))
            (hg₁_eq i)
        filter_upwards [hev1, hev2] with w hw1 hw2
        rw [hw1, hw2, sub_self]
      have hd_top_z : meromorphicOrderAt (fun w => g_nf i w - γ_i w) z = ⊤ := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hd_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hU_int_pre
          hz hz_v_U hne hd_top_zv
      have hev_punc : g_nf i =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] γ_i := by
        filter_upwards [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp hd_top_z] with w hw
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hw
      have hnf1 : MeromorphicNFAt (g_nf i) z := hg_nf_nf i hz.1
      have hnf2 : MeromorphicNFAt γ_i z := hγ_nf ((hstrip_iff z).mpr hz.2)
      exact ((MeromorphicNFAt.eventuallyEq_nhdsNE_iff_eventuallyEq_nhds hnf1 hnf2).mp
        hev_punc).eq_of_nhds

    obtain ⟨r_u, hr_u_pos, hr_u_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_int_open z_v hz_v_U
    obtain ⟨r_e, hr_e_pos, _, hr_e_noE⟩ :=
      Z₀.E_disc_isolated z_v ((hstrip_iff z_v).mpr hz_v_U.2)
    let r_m : ℝ := min r_u r_e
    have hr_m_pos : 0 < r_m := lt_min hr_u_pos hr_e_pos
    let s₀ : ℂ := z_v + ((r_m / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hs₀_dist : dist s₀ z_v = r_m / 2 := by
      dsimp [s₀]
      rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (half_pos hr_m_pos))]
    have hs₀_ru : s₀ ∈ Metric.ball z_v r_u := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, hs₀_dist]
      linarith [min_le_left r_u r_e]
    have hs₀_re : s₀ ∈ Metric.ball z_v r_e := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, hs₀_dist]
      linarith [min_le_right r_u r_e]
    have hs₀_ne_zv : s₀ ≠ z_v := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, dist_self] at hs₀_dist
      linarith
    have hs₀_U : s₀ ∈ U_int := hr_u_sub hs₀_ru
    have hs₀_noE : s₀ ∉ Z₀.E_disc := hr_e_noE s₀ hs₀_re hs₀_ne_zv
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, r_s, _, hr_s_pos, _, hr_s_reg, _⟩ :=
      Z₀.slice_reg s₀ ((hstrip_iff s₀).mpr hs₀_U.2) hs₀_noE
    obtain ⟨r_u2, hr_u2_pos, hr_u2_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_int_open s₀ hs₀_U
    let r_reg : ℝ := min r_s r_u2
    have hr_reg_pos : 0 < r_reg := lt_min hr_s_pos hr_u2_pos

    refine ⟨hH₀_ge, g_nf, s₀, r_reg, hg_nf_mero, hg_nf_eq_slice, hr_reg_pos,
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) hr_u2_sub,
      fun z hz => hr_s_reg z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)⟩

  obtain ⟨hH₀_ge, g_nf, s₀, r_reg, hg_nf_mero, hg_nf_eq_slice, hr_reg_pos,
    hB_reg_sub_int, hB_reg_slice⟩ := h_part1

  
  
  
  have hreg : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_reg,
      AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 0) z ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 1) z ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ Z₀.a_mero z ∧
      AnalyticAt ℂ Z₀.f_mero z ∧
      Z₀.a_mero z ≠ 0 ∧
      Z₀.f_mero z ≠ 0 ∧
      deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z =
        Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * Z₀.a_mero z / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2 ∧
      deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z =
        -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) / (Z₀.a_mero z * (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) ∧
      deriv Z₀.a_mero z = Complex.I * Z₀.f_mero z * Z₀.a_mero z := by
    have hg_holo_reg : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf i) (Metric.ball s₀ r_reg) := by
      intro i w hw
      have hγ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u => Z₀.Γ_slice u i) (Metric.ball s₀ r_reg) := by
        intro u hu
        obtain ⟨hu_st, hu_noE⟩ := hB_reg_slice u hu
        fin_cases i
        · exact (Z₀.slice_reg u hu_st hu_noE).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        · exact (Z₀.slice_reg u hu_st hu_noE).2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      exact (hγ_holo.congr (fun u hu => hg_nf_eq_slice i u (hB_reg_sub_int hu))) w hw
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hz_st, hz_noE⟩ := hB_reg_slice z hz
    obtain ⟨_, _, ha_an, hf_an, ha_nz, hf_nz, hdZ_sl, hdW_sl, hda_sl, _⟩ :=
      Z₀.slice_reg z hz_st hz_noE
    have hev0 : g_nf 0 =ᶠ[nhds z] fun u => Z₀.Γ_slice u 0 :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
        (fun u hu => hg_nf_eq_slice 0 u (hB_reg_sub_int hu))
    have hev1 : g_nf 1 =ᶠ[nhds z] fun u => Z₀.Γ_slice u 1 :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
        (fun u hu => hg_nf_eq_slice 1 u (hB_reg_sub_int hu))
    refine ⟨(hg_holo_reg 0).analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz),
      (hg_holo_reg 1).analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz),
      ha_an, hf_an, ha_nz, hf_nz, ?_, ?_, hda_sl⟩
    · rw [hev0.deriv_eq, hev1.deriv_eq, hdZ_sl]
    · rw [hev0.deriv_eq, hev1.deriv_eq, hdW_sl]

  
  
  
  have h_part2 :
      ∃ (x_edge R_1 : ℝ) (a_g f_g : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < R_1 ∧
        Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1 ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 2,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf i)
            (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1)) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ a_g
          (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f_g
          (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1, a_g z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1, f_g z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1,
          g_nf 0 z * deriv (g_nf 1) z - g_nf 1 z * deriv (g_nf 0) z ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1,
          (deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 =
            Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * a_g z) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1,
          (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * a_g z * (f_g z) ^ 2 =
            -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1,
          deriv a_g z = Complex.I * f_g z * a_g z) := by
    have hc : 0 < C.c := C.c_pos
    have hB_reg_sub : Metric.ball s₀ r_reg ⊆
        Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε :=
      Set.Subset.trans hB_reg_sub_int Set.inter_subset_left
    let a_mero := Z₀.a_mero
    let f_mero := Z₀.f_mero
    let s_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let B_plus : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_star ε
    let B_reg : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s₀ r_reg
    have hs_star_mem : s_star ∈ B_plus := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
    have hs₀_B_reg : s₀ ∈ B_reg := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_reg_pos
    have hs₀_B_plus : s₀ ∈ B_plus := hB_reg_sub hs₀_B_reg
    have hB_plus_pre : IsPreconnected B_plus := (convex_ball s_star ε).isPreconnected
    have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hc)
    have hIc_ne : Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero hc_ne

    let dZ_g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z
    let dW_g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z
    let A2_g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((0 : ℂ) - dZ_g z) / dW_g z
    let f_g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv A2_g z / ((2 * Complex.I) * A2_g z)
    let a_g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (dZ_g z * (f_g z) ^ 2) / (Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ))
    let W_sup : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g_nf 0 z * deriv (g_nf 1) z - g_nf 1 z * deriv (g_nf 0) z
    let R_W : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => dW_g z * a_g z * (f_g z) ^ 2 + Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ)
    let R_a : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => deriv a_g z - Complex.I * f_g z * a_g z

    have hd0_mero : MeromorphicOn (deriv (g_nf 0)) B_plus := (hg_nf_mero 0).deriv
    have hd1_mero : MeromorphicOn (deriv (g_nf 1)) B_plus := (hg_nf_mero 1).deriv
    have hdZ_mero : MeromorphicOn dZ_g B_plus :=
      hd0_mero.add ((MeromorphicOn.const Complex.I).mul hd1_mero)
    have hdW_mero : MeromorphicOn dW_g B_plus :=
      hd0_mero.sub ((MeromorphicOn.const Complex.I).mul hd1_mero)
    have hA2_mero : MeromorphicOn A2_g B_plus :=
      ((MeromorphicOn.const (0 : ℂ)).sub hdZ_mero).div hdW_mero
    have hf_mero : MeromorphicOn f_g B_plus :=
      hA2_mero.deriv.div ((MeromorphicOn.const (2 * Complex.I)).mul hA2_mero)
    have ha_mero : MeromorphicOn a_g B_plus :=
      (hdZ_mero.mul (hf_mero.pow 2)).div (MeromorphicOn.const (Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ)))
    have hWsup_mero : MeromorphicOn W_sup B_plus :=
      ((hg_nf_mero 0).mul hd1_mero).sub ((hg_nf_mero 1).mul hd0_mero)
    have hRW_mero : MeromorphicOn R_W B_plus :=
      ((hdW_mero.mul ha_mero).mul (hf_mero.pow 2)).add
        (MeromorphicOn.const (Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ)))
    have hRa_mero : MeromorphicOn R_a B_plus :=
      ha_mero.deriv.sub (((MeromorphicOn.const Complex.I).mul hf_mero).mul ha_mero)

    have hA2_eq_B_reg : ∀ z ∈ B_reg, A2_g z = (a_mero z) ^ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, ha_nz, hf_nz, hdZ_eq, hdW_eq, _⟩ := hreg z hz
      dsimp [A2_g, dZ_g, dW_g, a_mero, f_mero]
      rw [hdZ_eq, hdW_eq]
      have hI : Complex.I ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
      field_simp [hc_ne, hI, ha_nz, hf_nz]
      ring

    have hf_eq_B_reg : ∀ z ∈ B_reg, f_g z = f_mero z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, ha_an, _, ha_nz, _, _, _, hda_eq⟩ := hreg z hz
      have hev : A2_g =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => (a_mero w) ^ 2 :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz) hA2_eq_B_reg
      have ha_hd : HasDerivAt a_mero (Complex.I * f_mero z * a_mero z) z := by
        have h1 := ha_an.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
        rwa [hda_eq] at h1
      have hsq_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w => (a_mero w) ^ 2)
          (2 * Complex.I * f_mero z * (a_mero z) ^ 2) z :=
        (ha_hd.pow 2).congr_deriv (by push_cast; ring)
      have hdA2 : deriv A2_g z = 2 * Complex.I * f_mero z * (a_mero z) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, hsq_hd.deriv]
      dsimp [f_g, a_mero, f_mero] at hdA2 ⊢
      rw [hdA2, hA2_eq_B_reg z hz]
      dsimp [a_mero]
      have hI : Complex.I ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
      field_simp [hI, ha_nz]

    have ha_eq_B_reg : ∀ z ∈ B_reg, a_g z = a_mero z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hf_nz, hdZ_eq, _, _⟩ := hreg z hz
      dsimp [a_g, dZ_g]
      rw [hdZ_eq, hf_eq_B_reg z hz]
      dsimp [a_mero, f_mero]
      have hI : Complex.I ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
      field_simp [hc_ne, hI, hf_nz]

    have hRW_zero_B_reg : ∀ z ∈ B_reg, R_W z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, ha_nz, hf_nz, _, hdW_eq, _⟩ := hreg z hz
      dsimp [R_W, dW_g]
      rw [hdW_eq, ha_eq_B_reg z hz, hf_eq_B_reg z hz]
      dsimp [a_mero, f_mero]
      field_simp [ha_nz, hf_nz]
      ring

    have hRa_zero_B_reg : ∀ z ∈ B_reg, R_a z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hda_eq⟩ := hreg z hz
      have hev : a_g =ᶠ[nhds z] a_mero :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz) ha_eq_B_reg
      dsimp [R_a]
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      dsimp [a_mero]
      rw [hda_eq, hf_eq_B_reg z hz, ha_eq_B_reg z hz]
      dsimp [a_mero, f_mero]
      exact sub_self _

    have ha_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt a_g s₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (ha_mero s₀ hs₀_B_plus)]
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B_reg)) ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [ha_eq_B_reg z hz]
      exact (hreg z hz).2.2.2.2.1

    have hf_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt f_g s₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero (hf_mero s₀ hs₀_B_plus)]
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B_reg)) ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [hf_eq_B_reg z hz]
      exact (hreg z hz).2.2.2.2.2.1

    have hRW_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt R_W s₀ = ⊤ := by
      rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff]
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B_reg)) hRW_zero_B_reg

    have hRa_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt R_a s₀ = ⊤ := by
      rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff]
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B_reg)) hRa_zero_B_reg

    have hWsup_ord_s₀ : meromorphicOrderAt W_sup s₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      have hev_punc : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s₀ {s₀}ᶜ, W_sup z = 0 :=
        meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp htop
      have hg0_holo_reg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 0) B_reg :=
        fun z hz => (hreg z hz).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hg1_holo_reg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 1) B_reg :=
        fun z hz => (hreg z hz).2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hW_holo_reg : DifferentiableOn ℂ W_sup B_reg :=
        (hg0_holo_reg.mul (hg1_holo_reg.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball)).sub
          (hg1_holo_reg.mul (hg0_holo_reg.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball))
      have hW_cont_s₀ : ContinuousAt W_sup s₀ :=
        hW_holo_reg.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B_reg)
      have hWs₀_zero : W_sup s₀ = 0 :=
        tendsto_nhds_unique hW_cont_s₀.continuousWithinAt
          (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hev_punc.mono fun _ hz => hz.symm))
      obtain ⟨r_w, hr_w_pos, hr_w_zero⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hev_punc
      let r₀ : ℝ := min r_w r_reg
      have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hr_w_pos hr_reg_pos
      let B₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s₀ r₀
      have hB₀_sub_reg : B₀ ⊆ B_reg := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      have hs₀_B₀ : s₀ ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos
      have hW_zero_B₀ : ∀ z ∈ B₀, W_sup z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        by_cases hzs : z = s₀
        · subst hzs; exact hWs₀_zero
        · exact hr_w_zero ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz, hzs⟩
      have hf_holo_B₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_mero B₀ :=
        fun z hz => (hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)).2.2.2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      obtain ⟨ϕ_raw, hϕ_raw⟩ := hf_holo_B₀.isExactOn_ball
      let ϕ₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
        ϕ_raw z - ϕ_raw s₀ - Complex.I * Complex.log (a_mero s₀)
      have hϕ₀_hd : ∀ z ∈ B₀, HasDerivAt ϕ₀ (f_mero z) z := by
        intro z hz
        exact ((hϕ_raw z hz).sub_const (ϕ_raw s₀)).sub_const
          (Complex.I * Complex.log (a_mero s₀))
      let Q₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => a_mero z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ₀ z)
      have hQ₀_hd : ∀ z ∈ B₀, HasDerivAt Q₀ 0 z := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨_, _, ha_an, _, _, _, _, _, hda⟩ := hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)
        have ha_hd : HasDerivAt a_mero (Complex.I * f_mero z * a_mero z) z := by
          have h1 := ha_an.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
          rwa [hda] at h1
        have hexp_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ₀ w))
            (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) * (-Complex.I * f_mero z)) z :=
          (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * ϕ₀ z)).comp z
            ((hϕ₀_hd z hz).const_mul (-Complex.I))
        exact (ha_hd.mul hexp_hd).congr_deriv (by ring)
      have ha_exp_B₀ : ∀ z ∈ B₀, a_mero z = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) := by
        intro z hz
        have hQ₀_s₀ : Q₀ s₀ = 1 := by
          have harg : -Complex.I * ϕ₀ s₀ = -Complex.log (a_mero s₀) := by
            dsimp [ϕ₀]; ring_nf; simp [Complex.I_sq]
          have ha_s₀_ne := (hreg s₀ hs₀_B_reg).2.2.2.2.1
          dsimp [Q₀]
          rw [harg, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log ha_s₀_ne]
          exact mul_inv_cancel₀ ha_s₀_ne
        have hQc : Q₀ z = 1 := by
          rw [IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero Metric.isOpen_ball
            (convex_ball s₀ r₀).isPreconnected
            (fun w hw => (hQ₀_hd w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
            (fun w hw => (hQ₀_hd w hw).deriv) hz hs₀_B₀, hQ₀_s₀]
        dsimp [Q₀] at hQc
        calc
          a_mero z = a_mero z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) := by
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]; simp
          _ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) := by rw [hQc, one_mul]
      have hg_deriv_B₀ : ∀ z ∈ B₀,
          deriv (g_nf 0) z = -(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) / (f_mero z) ^ 2 ∧
          deriv (g_nf 1) z = (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) / (f_mero z) ^ 2 := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hf_nz, hdZ, hdW, _⟩ := hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)
        dsimp [a_mero, f_mero] at ha_exp_B₀ ⊢
        rw [ha_exp_B₀ z hz] at hdZ hdW
        have hexp_p : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) =
            Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) + Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I := by
          rw [mul_comm, Complex.exp_mul_I]
        have hexp_n : (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z))⁻¹ =
            Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) - Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_neg]
          have h1 : -(Complex.I * ϕ₀ z) = (-ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I := by ring
          rw [h1, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg]
          ring
        have hdW' : deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z =
            -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ₀ z))⁻¹ / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2 := by
          rw [hdW]; ring
        rw [hexp_p] at hdZ
        rw [hexp_n] at hdW'
        constructor
        · have hsum : 2 * deriv (g_nf 0) z =
              2 * (-(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by
            calc
              2 * deriv (g_nf 0) z =
                  (deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) +
                  (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) := by ring
              _ = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) + Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I) /
                    (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2 +
                  (-Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) - Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I) /
                    (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by rw [hdZ, hdW']
              _ = 2 * Complex.I ^ 2 * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2 := by ring
              _ = 2 * (-(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by
                rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ two_ne_zero hsum
        · have h2I : (2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero
          have hdiff : (2 * Complex.I) * deriv (g_nf 1) z =
              (2 * Complex.I) * ((C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by
            calc
              (2 * Complex.I) * deriv (g_nf 1) z =
                  (deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) -
                  (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) := by ring
              _ = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) + Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I) /
                    (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2 -
                  (-Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) - Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) * Complex.I) /
                    (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by rw [hdZ, hdW']
              _ = (2 * Complex.I) * ((C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) / (Z₀.f_mero z) ^ 2) := by ring
          exact mul_left_cancel₀ h2I hdiff
      let H₀_sup : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
        g_nf 0 z * Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z) + g_nf 1 z * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z)
      let T₀_sup : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
        -g_nf 0 z * Complex.sin (ϕ₀ z) + g_nf 1 z * Complex.cos (ϕ₀ z)
      have hH₀_zero : ∀ z ∈ B₀, H₀_sup z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₀ z hz
        have hf_nz : f_mero z ≠ 0 := (hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)).2.2.2.2.2.1
        have hcf_ne : (C.c : ℂ) / (f_mero z) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
          div_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 hf_nz)
        have hWeq : W_sup z = ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_mero z) ^ 2) * H₀_sup z := by
          dsimp [W_sup, H₀_sup]; rw [hd0, hd1]; ring
        rw [hW_zero_B₀ z hz] at hWeq
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hWeq.symm).resolve_left hcf_ne
      have hT₀_zero : ∀ z ∈ B₀, T₀_sup z = 0 := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₀ z hz
        have hg0_hd := (hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)).1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
        have hg1_hd := (hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)).2.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
        have hc_hd := (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (ϕ₀ z)).comp z (hϕ₀_hd z hz)
        have hs_hd := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (ϕ₀ z)).comp z (hϕ₀_hd z hz)
        have hH_hd : HasDerivAt H₀_sup (f_mero z * T₀_sup z) z := by
          refine ((hg0_hd.mul hc_hd).add (hg1_hd.mul hs_hd)).congr_deriv ?_
          dsimp [T₀_sup]; rw [hd0, hd1]; ring
        have hev : H₀_sup =ᶠ[nhds z] fun _ => (0 : ℂ) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz) hH₀_zero
        have h0 : f_mero z * T₀_sup z = 0 := by
          rw [← hH_hd.deriv, hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left (hreg z (hB₀_sub_reg hz)).2.2.2.2.2.1
      obtain ⟨hd0_s, hd1_s⟩ := hg_deriv_B₀ s₀ hs₀_B₀
      have hg0_hd := (hreg s₀ hs₀_B_reg).1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hg1_hd := (hreg s₀ hs₀_B_reg).2.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hc_hd := (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (ϕ₀ s₀)).comp s₀ (hϕ₀_hd s₀ hs₀_B₀)
      have hs_hd := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (ϕ₀ s₀)).comp s₀ (hϕ₀_hd s₀ hs₀_B₀)
      have hT_hd : HasDerivAt T₀_sup ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_mero s₀) ^ 2) s₀ := by
        refine (((hg0_hd.neg).mul hs_hd).add (hg1_hd.mul hc_hd)).congr_deriv ?_
        have hHz := hH₀_zero s₀ hs₀_B₀
        dsimp [H₀_sup] at hHz
        dsimp only [Function.comp, Pi.neg_apply]
        rw [hd0_s, hd1_s]
        linear_combination
          ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_mero s₀) ^ 2) * Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (ϕ₀ s₀) -
            f_mero s₀ * hHz
      have hevT : T₀_sup =ᶠ[nhds s₀] fun _ => (0 : ℂ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₀_B₀) hT₀_zero
      have hcf_zero : (C.c : ℂ) / (f_mero s₀) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [← hT_hd.deriv, hevT.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      exact div_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 (hreg s₀ hs₀_B_reg).2.2.2.2.2.1) hcf_zero

    have ha_ord_star : meromorphicOrderAt a_g s_star ≠ ⊤ :=
      ha_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hB_plus_pre
        hs₀_B_plus hs_star_mem ha_ord_s₀
    have hf_ord_star : meromorphicOrderAt f_g s_star ≠ ⊤ :=
      hf_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hB_plus_pre
        hs₀_B_plus hs_star_mem hf_ord_s₀
    have hWsup_ord_star : meromorphicOrderAt W_sup s_star ≠ ⊤ :=
      hWsup_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hB_plus_pre
        hs₀_B_plus hs_star_mem hWsup_ord_s₀
    have hRW_ord_all : ∀ z ∈ B_plus, meromorphicOrderAt R_W z = ⊤ := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra hne
      exact hRW_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hB_plus_pre
        hz hs₀_B_plus hne hRW_ord_s₀
    have hRa_ord_all : ∀ z ∈ B_plus, meromorphicOrderAt R_a z = ⊤ := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra hne
      exact hRa_mero.meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_of_isPreconnected hB_plus_pre
        hz hs₀_B_plus hne hRa_ord_s₀

    have hev_punc_all : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s_star {s_star}ᶜ,
        AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 0) z ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 1) z ∧
        AnalyticAt ℂ a_g z ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ f_g z ∧
        a_g z ≠ 0 ∧ f_g z ≠ 0 ∧ W_sup z ≠ 0 := by
      have h1 := (hg_nf_mero 0 s_star hs_star_mem).eventually_analyticAt
      have h2 := (hg_nf_mero 1 s_star hs_star_mem).eventually_analyticAt
      have h3 := (ha_mero s_star hs_star_mem).eventually_analyticAt
      have h4 := (hf_mero s_star hs_star_mem).eventually_analyticAt
      have h5 := (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero
        (ha_mero s_star hs_star_mem)).mp ha_ord_star
      have h6 := (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero
        (hf_mero s_star hs_star_mem)).mp hf_ord_star
      have h7 := (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff_eventually_ne_zero
        (hWsup_mero s_star hs_star_mem)).mp hWsup_ord_star
      filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7] with z hz1 hz2 hz3 hz4 hz5 hz6 hz7
      exact ⟨hz1, hz2, hz3, hz4, hz5, hz6, hz7⟩

    obtain ⟨r_p, hr_p_pos, hr_p_prop⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hev_punc_all
    let r_punc : ℝ := min r_p (ε / 2)
    have hr_punc_pos : 0 < r_punc := lt_min hr_p_pos (half_pos hε)
    have hr_punc_le_rp : r_punc ≤ r_p := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_punc_le_eps : r_punc ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_right _ _

    let x_edge : ℝ := x_star + r_punc / 2
    let s_edge : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hs_edge_diff : s_edge - s_star = ((r_punc / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [s_edge, s_star, x_edge]; push_cast; ring
    have hs_edge_dist : dist s_edge s_star = r_punc / 2 := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hs_edge_diff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    have hs_edge_lt_rp : s_edge ∈ Metric.ball s_star r_p := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith
    have hs_edge_ne_star : s_edge ≠ s_star := by
      intro heq
      rw [heq, dist_self] at hs_edge_dist
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hg0_an_e, hg1_an_e, ha_an_e, hf_an_e, ha_ne_e, hf_ne_e, hW_ne_e⟩ :=
      hr_p_prop ⟨hs_edge_lt_rp, hs_edge_ne_star⟩

    have hev_an_edge : ∀ᶠ z in nhds s_edge,
        AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 0) z ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ (g_nf 1) z ∧
        AnalyticAt ℂ a_g z ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ f_g z ∧
        a_g z ≠ 0 ∧ f_g z ≠ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hg0_an_e.eventually_analyticAt, hg1_an_e.eventually_analyticAt,
        ha_an_e.eventually_analyticAt, hf_an_e.eventually_analyticAt,
        ha_an_e.continuousAt.eventually_ne ha_ne_e,
        hf_an_e.continuousAt.eventually_ne hf_ne_e] with z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩

    obtain ⟨r_a, hr_a_pos, hr_a_prop⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev_an_edge
    have hg0_holo_ra : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 0) (Metric.ball s_edge r_a) :=
      fun z hz => (hr_a_prop hz).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hg1_holo_ra : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 1) (Metric.ball s_edge r_a) :=
      fun z hz => (hr_a_prop hz).2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hW_holo_ra : DifferentiableOn ℂ W_sup (Metric.ball s_edge r_a) :=
      (hg0_holo_ra.mul (hg1_holo_ra.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball)).sub
        (hg1_holo_ra.mul (hg0_holo_ra.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball))
    have hW_cont_e : ContinuousAt W_sup s_edge :=
      hW_holo_ra.continuousOn.continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_a_pos))
    obtain ⟨r_W, hr_W_pos, hr_W_ne⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hW_cont_e.eventually_ne hW_ne_e)

    let R_1 : ℝ := min r_a (min r_W (ε / 2))
    have hR_1_pos : 0 < R_1 := lt_min hr_a_pos (lt_min hr_W_pos (half_pos hε))
    have hR_1_le_ra : R_1 ≤ r_a := min_le_left _ _
    have hR_1_le_rW : R_1 ≤ r_W := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hR_1_le_eps : R_1 ≤ ε / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)

    let B_init : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge R_1
    have hB_init_sub_ra : B_init ⊆ Metric.ball s_edge r_a := Metric.ball_subset_ball hR_1_le_ra
    have hB_init_sub_plus : B_init ⊆ B_plus := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
      calc
        dist z s_star ≤ dist z s_edge + dist s_edge s_star := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < R_1 + r_punc / 2 := by rw [hs_edge_dist]; linarith
        _ ≤ ε / 2 + (ε / 2) / 2 := by linarith
        _ < ε := by linarith

    have hg0_holo_init : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 0) B_init := hg0_holo_ra.mono hB_init_sub_ra
    have hg1_holo_init : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_nf 1) B_init := hg1_holo_ra.mono hB_init_sub_ra
    have ha_holo_init : DifferentiableOn ℂ a_g B_init :=
      fun z hz => (hr_a_prop (hB_init_sub_ra hz)).2.2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hf_holo_init : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_g B_init :=
      fun z hz => (hr_a_prop (hB_init_sub_ra hz)).2.2.2.1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have ha_ne_init : ∀ z ∈ B_init, a_g z ≠ 0 :=
      fun z hz => (hr_a_prop (hB_init_sub_ra hz)).2.2.2.2.1
    have hf_ne_init : ∀ z ∈ B_init, f_g z ≠ 0 :=

    have hW_ne_init : ∀ z ∈ B_init, W_sup z ≠ 0 :=

    have hiso_Z_init : ∀ z ∈ B_init,

      dsimp [R_W, dW_g] at hRW_z
      linear_combination hRW_z

    have hRa_holo_init : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_a B_init :=
      (ha_holo_init.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).sub
        (((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul hf_holo_init).mul ha_holo_init)
    have hderiv_a_init : ∀ z ∈ B_init, deriv a_g z = Complex.I * f_g z * a_g z := by
      intro z hz
      have hcont : ContinuousAt R_a z :=
        hRa_holo_init.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
      have hev0 : ∀ᶠ w in nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ, R_a w = 0 :=
        meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp (hRa_ord_all z (hB_init_sub_plus hz))
      have hRa_z : R_a z = 0 :=
        tendsto_nhds_unique hcont.continuousWithinAt
          (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hev0.mono fun _ hw => hw.symm))
      dsimp [R_a] at hRa_z
      linear_combination hRa_z

    refine ⟨x_edge, R_1, a_g, f_g, hR_1_pos, hB_init_sub_plus,
      Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨hg0_holo_init, hg1_holo_init⟩,
      ha_holo_init, hf_holo_init, ha_ne_init, hf_ne_init, hW_ne_init,
      hiso_Z_init, hiso_W_init, hderiv_a_init⟩

  obtain ⟨x_edge, R_1, a_g, f_g, hR1, hB_init_sub_plus, hg_holo, ha_holo, hf_holo,
    ha_ne, hf_ne, hW_ne, hiso_Z, hiso_W, hderiv_a⟩ := h_part2

  
  
  
  have h_part3 :
      ∃ (R_0 : ℝ) (ϕ_loc : ℂ → ℂ) (U_θ : Set ℂ) (ϕ_inv h_loc τ_proj : ℂ → ℂ)
        (U_τ : Set ℂ) (τ_inv : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < R_0 ∧ R_0 < W.s_base / 2 ∧ 2 * R_0 ≤ R_1 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_loc
          (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          deriv ϕ_loc z ≠ 0) ∧
        IsOpen U_θ ∧
        Set.MapsTo ϕ_loc
          (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0)) U_θ ∧
        (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
          IsOpen (ϕ_loc '' Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) r)) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_inv U_θ ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          ϕ_inv (ϕ_loc z) = z) ∧
        (∀ θ ∈ U_θ,
          ϕ_inv θ ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ∧
          ϕ_loc (ϕ_inv θ) = θ) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ h_loc U_θ ∧
        (∀ θ ∈ U_θ, h_loc θ ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          g_nf 0 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) -
            deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) ∧
          g_nf 1 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) +
            deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          deriv (g_nf 0) z = -(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) / (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 2 ∧
          deriv (g_nf 1) z = (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) / (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          (h_loc (ϕ_loc z) + deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z)) * (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ)) ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ,
          τ_proj z =
            -g_nf 0 z * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) +
              g_nf 1 z * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          deriv τ_proj z ≠ 0) ∧
        IsOpen U_τ ∧
        Set.MapsTo τ_proj
          (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0)) U_τ ∧
        (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
          IsOpen (τ_proj '' Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) r)) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ τ_inv U_τ ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0),
          τ_inv (τ_proj z) = z) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ U_τ,
          τ_inv w ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ∧
          τ_proj (τ_inv w) = w) := by
    have hc : 0 < C.c := C.c_pos
    have hs_base : 0 < W.s_base := W.s_base_pos
    let s_edge : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let B₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge R_1
    have hs_edge_B₁ : s_edge ∈ B₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self hR1
    have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hc)

    obtain ⟨ϕ_raw, hϕ_raw⟩ := hf_holo.isExactOn_ball
    let ϕ_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      ϕ_raw z - ϕ_raw s_edge - Complex.I * Complex.log (a_g s_edge)
    have hϕ_hasDeriv : ∀ z ∈ B₁, HasDerivAt ϕ_loc (f_g z) z := by
      intro z hz
      exact ((hϕ_raw z hz).sub_const (ϕ_raw s_edge)).sub_const
        (Complex.I * Complex.log (a_g s_edge))
    have hϕ_holo_B₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_loc B₁ :=
      fun z hz => (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hϕ_deriv_B₁ : ∀ z ∈ B₁, deriv ϕ_loc z = f_g z :=
      fun z hz => (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz).deriv

    let Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => a_g z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z)
    have hQ_hasDeriv : ∀ z ∈ B₁, HasDerivAt Q 0 z := by
      intro z hz
      have ha_at : HasDerivAt a_g (Complex.I * f_g z * a_g z) z := by
        have h1 := (ha_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
        rwa [hderiv_a z hz] at h1
      have hexp_at : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc w))
          (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) * (-Complex.I * f_g z)) z :=
        (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z)).comp z
          ((hϕ_hasDeriv z hz).const_mul (-Complex.I))
      exact (ha_at.mul hexp_at).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have hQ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q B₁ :=
      fun z hz => (hQ_hasDeriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hQ_deriv_zero : Set.EqOn (deriv Q) 0 B₁ :=
      fun z hz => (hQ_hasDeriv z hz).deriv
    have hQ_s_edge : Q s_edge = 1 := by
      have hlog_arg : -Complex.I * ϕ_loc s_edge = -Complex.log (a_g s_edge) := by
        dsimp [ϕ_loc]
        ring_nf
        simp [Complex.I_sq]
      dsimp [Q]
      rw [hlog_arg, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log (ha_ne s_edge hs_edge_B₁)]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (ha_ne s_edge hs_edge_B₁)
    have ha_eq_exp : ∀ z ∈ B₁, a_g z = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by
      intro z hz
      have hQc : Q z = 1 := by
        rw [IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball s_edge R_1).isPreconnected hQ_holo hQ_deriv_zero hz hs_edge_B₁,
          hQ_s_edge]
      dsimp [Q] at hQc
      calc
        a_g z = a_g z * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
          simp
        _ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by rw [hQc, one_mul]

    have hg_hasDeriv : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ B₁, HasDerivAt (g_nf i) (deriv (g_nf i) z) z :=
      fun i z hz => ((hg_holo i).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).hasDerivAt
    have hg_deriv_B₁ : ∀ z ∈ B₁,
        deriv (g_nf 0) z = -(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) / (f_g z) ^ 2 ∧
        deriv (g_nf 1) z = (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) / (f_g z) ^ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      have hf2_ne : (f_g z) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (hf_ne z hz)
      have hexp_pos : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) =
          Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) + Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I := by
        rw [mul_comm, Complex.exp_mul_I]
      have hexp_neg : Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) =
          Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) - Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I := by
        have h1 : -Complex.I * ϕ_loc z = (-ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I := by ring
        rw [h1, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg]
        ring
      have hZ := hiso_Z z hz
      rw [ha_eq_exp z hz] at hZ
      have hW := hiso_W z hz
      rw [ha_eq_exp z hz] at hW
      have hW' : (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 =
          -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by
        calc
          (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2
            = (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 *
                Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by
              have he1 : Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) = 1 := by
                rw [← Complex.exp_add]; simp
              calc
                (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2
                  = (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 *
                      (Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z)) := by
                    rw [he1, mul_one]
                _ = _ := by ring
          _ = -Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * ϕ_loc z) := by rw [hW]
      rw [hexp_pos] at hZ
      rw [hexp_neg] at hW'
      have h0_eq : deriv (g_nf 0) z * (f_g z) ^ 2 = -(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) := by
        have hsum : 2 * (deriv (g_nf 0) z * (f_g z) ^ 2) =
            2 * (-(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z)) := by
          calc
            2 * (deriv (g_nf 0) z * (f_g z) ^ 2)
              = (deriv (g_nf 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 +
                (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) + Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I) +
                (-Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) - Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I)) := by
              rw [hZ, hW']
            _ = 2 * Complex.I ^ 2 * (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) := by ring
            _ = 2 * (-(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z)) := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ two_ne_zero hsum
      have h1_eq : deriv (g_nf 1) z * (f_g z) ^ 2 = (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) := by
        have h2I_ne : (2 : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero
        have hdiff : (2 * Complex.I) * (deriv (g_nf 1) z * (f_g z) ^ 2) =
            (2 * Complex.I) * ((C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z)) := by
          calc

                (deriv (g_nf 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (g_nf 1) z) * (f_g z) ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) + Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I) -
                (-Complex.I * (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) - Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.I)) := by
              rw [hZ, hW']
            _ = (2 * Complex.I) * ((C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z)) := by ring
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ h2I_ne hdiff
      exact ⟨eq_div_iff hf2_ne |>.mpr h0_eq, eq_div_iff hf2_ne |>.mpr h1_eq⟩

    let θ₀ : ℂ := ϕ_loc s_edge
    let τ_proj : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      -g_nf 0 z * Complex.sin θ₀ + g_nf 1 z * Complex.cos θ₀
    have hτ_hasDeriv_B₁ : ∀ z ∈ B₁,

      intro z hz

        ((hg_hasDeriv 1 z hz).mul_const (Complex.cos θ₀))
    have hτ_holo_B₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ τ_proj B₁ :=
      fun z hz => (hτ_hasDeriv_B₁ z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hτ_deriv_s_edge : deriv τ_proj s_edge ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(hτ_hasDeriv_B₁ s_edge hs_edge_B₁).deriv]
      obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₁ s_edge hs_edge_B₁
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      have hcalc : -(-(C.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin θ₀ / (f_g s_edge) ^ 2) * Complex.sin θ₀ +
          (C.c : ℂ) * Complex.cos θ₀ / (f_g s_edge) ^ 2 * Complex.cos θ₀ =
          (C.c : ℂ) / (f_g s_edge) ^ 2 * (Complex.sin θ₀ ^ 2 + Complex.cos θ₀ ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [θ₀]; ring
      rw [hcalc, Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]
      exact div_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 (hf_ne s_edge hs_edge_B₁))
    have hτ_deriv_cont : ContinuousAt (deriv τ_proj) s_edge :=
      (hτ_holo_B₁.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).continuousOn.continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_edge_B₁)
    obtain ⟨r_τ, hr_τ_pos, hr_τ_ne⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hτ_deriv_cont.eventually_ne hτ_deriv_s_edge)

    have hϕ_strict : HasStrictDerivAt ϕ_loc (deriv ϕ_loc s_edge) s_edge :=
      (hϕ_holo_B₁.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_edge_B₁)).hasStrictDerivAt
    have hϕ_deriv_s_edge : deriv ϕ_loc s_edge ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hϕ_deriv_B₁ s_edge hs_edge_B₁]
      exact hf_ne s_edge hs_edge_B₁
    have hϕ_fderiv := hϕ_strict.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hϕ_deriv_s_edge
    let e_ϕ := HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph ϕ_loc hϕ_fderiv
    have he_ϕ_coe : (e_ϕ : ℂ → ℂ) = ϕ_loc :=
      HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hϕ_fderiv
    have hs_edge_e_ϕ : s_edge ∈ e_ϕ.source :=
      HasStrictFDerivAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hϕ_fderiv
    obtain ⟨r_ϕ_src, hr_ϕ_src_pos, hr_ϕ_src_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp e_ϕ.open_source s_edge hs_edge_e_ϕ

    have hτ_strict : HasStrictDerivAt τ_proj (deriv τ_proj s_edge) s_edge :=
      (hτ_holo_B₁.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_edge_B₁)).hasStrictDerivAt
    have hτ_fderiv := hτ_strict.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hτ_deriv_s_edge
    let e_τ := HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph τ_proj hτ_fderiv
    have he_τ_coe : (e_τ : ℂ → ℂ) = τ_proj :=
      HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hτ_fderiv
    have hs_edge_e_τ : s_edge ∈ e_τ.source :=
      HasStrictFDerivAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hτ_fderiv
    obtain ⟨r_τ_src, hr_τ_src_pos, hr_τ_src_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp e_τ.open_source s_edge hs_edge_e_τ

    let R_min : ℝ := min R_1 (min r_τ (min r_ϕ_src (min r_τ_src W.s_base)))
    have hR_min_pos : 0 < R_min :=
      lt_min hR1 (lt_min hr_τ_pos (lt_min hr_ϕ_src_pos (lt_min hr_τ_src_pos hs_base)))
    let R_0 : ℝ := R_min / 4
    have hR_0_pos : 0 < R_0 := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith
    have hR_min_le_R1 : R_min ≤ R_1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hR_min_le_rτ : R_min ≤ r_τ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hR_min_le_rϕ : R_min ≤ r_ϕ_src :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hR_min_le_rτs : R_min ≤ r_τ_src :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hR_min_le_sb : R_min ≤ W.s_base :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
    have hR_0_lt_sb : R_0 < W.s_base / 2 := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith
    have h2R_0_le_R1 : 2 * R_0 ≤ R_1 := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith
    have h2R_0_le_rτ : 2 * R_0 ≤ r_τ := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith
    have h2R_0_le_rϕ : 2 * R_0 ≤ r_ϕ_src := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith
    have h2R_0_le_rτs : 2 * R_0 ≤ r_τ_src := by dsimp [R_0]; linarith

    let B₂ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)
    have hB₂_sub_B₁ : B₂ ⊆ B₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball h2R_0_le_R1
    have hB₂_sub_eϕ : B₂ ⊆ e_ϕ.source :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball h2R_0_le_rϕ) hr_ϕ_src_sub
    have hB₂_sub_eτ : B₂ ⊆ e_τ.source :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball h2R_0_le_rτs) hr_τ_src_sub

    let U_θ : Set ℂ := ϕ_loc '' B₂
    let ϕ_inv : ℂ → ℂ := e_ϕ.symm
    let U_τ : Set ℂ := τ_proj '' B₂
    let τ_inv : ℂ → ℂ := e_τ.symm

    have hU_θ_open : IsOpen U_θ := by
      dsimp [U_θ]; rw [← he_ϕ_coe]
      exact e_ϕ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball hB₂_sub_eϕ
    have hϕ_open_img : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
        IsOpen (ϕ_loc '' Metric.ball s_edge r) := by
      intro r _ hr_le
      rw [← he_ϕ_coe]
      exact e_ϕ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le) hB₂_sub_eϕ)
    have hϕ_left_inv : ∀ z ∈ B₂, ϕ_inv (ϕ_loc z) = z := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp [ϕ_inv]
      rw [← he_ϕ_coe]
      exact e_ϕ.left_inv (hB₂_sub_eϕ hz)
    have hϕ_right_inv : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, ϕ_inv θ ∈ B₂ ∧ ϕ_loc (ϕ_inv θ) = θ := by
      rintro θ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [hϕ_left_inv z hz]
      exact ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    have hϕ_inv_hasDeriv : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ,
        HasDerivAt ϕ_inv (f_g (ϕ_inv θ))⁻¹ θ := by
      rintro θ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hz_B₁ : z ∈ B₁ := hB₂_sub_B₁ hz
      have hz_src : z ∈ e_ϕ.source := hB₂_sub_eϕ hz
      have hθ_tgt : e_ϕ z ∈ e_ϕ.target := e_ϕ.map_source hz_src
      rw [he_ϕ_coe] at hθ_tgt
      have hsymm_z : e_ϕ.symm (ϕ_loc z) = z := hϕ_left_inv z hz
      have hd_at : HasDerivAt (e_ϕ : ℂ → ℂ) (f_g z) (e_ϕ.symm (ϕ_loc z)) := by
        rw [he_ϕ_coe, hsymm_z]
        exact hϕ_hasDeriv z hz_B₁
      have hinv_d := e_ϕ.hasDerivAt_symm hθ_tgt (hf_ne z hz_B₁) hd_at
      dsimp [ϕ_inv]
      rwa [hsymm_z]
    have hϕ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_inv U_θ :=
      fun θ hθ => (hϕ_inv_hasDeriv θ hθ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    have hτ_deriv_ne_B₂ : ∀ z ∈ B₂, deriv τ_proj z ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      exact hr_τ_ne (Metric.ball_subset_ball h2R_0_le_rτ hz)
    have hU_τ_open : IsOpen U_τ := by
      dsimp [U_τ]; rw [← he_τ_coe]
      exact e_τ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball hB₂_sub_eτ
    have hτ_open_img : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 * R_0 →
        IsOpen (τ_proj '' Metric.ball s_edge r) := by
      intro r _ hr_le
      rw [← he_τ_coe]
      exact e_τ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le) hB₂_sub_eτ)
    have hτ_left_inv : ∀ z ∈ B₂, τ_inv (τ_proj z) = z := by
      intro z hz
      dsimp [τ_inv]
      rw [← he_τ_coe]
      exact e_τ.left_inv (hB₂_sub_eτ hz)
    have hτ_right_inv : ∀ w ∈ U_τ, τ_inv w ∈ B₂ ∧ τ_proj (τ_inv w) = w := by
      rintro w ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [hτ_left_inv z hz]
      exact ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    have hτ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ τ_inv U_τ := by
      rintro w ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hz_B₁ : z ∈ B₁ := hB₂_sub_B₁ hz
      have hz_src : z ∈ e_τ.source := hB₂_sub_eτ hz
      have hw_tgt : e_τ z ∈ e_τ.target := e_τ.map_source hz_src
      rw [he_τ_coe] at hw_tgt
      have hsymm_z : e_τ.symm (τ_proj z) = z := hτ_left_inv z hz
      have hd_at : HasDerivAt (e_τ : ℂ → ℂ) (deriv τ_proj z) (e_τ.symm (τ_proj z)) := by
        rw [he_τ_coe, hsymm_z]
        exact (hτ_holo_B₁.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz_B₁)).hasDerivAt
      exact (e_τ.hasDerivAt_symm hw_tgt (hτ_deriv_ne_B₂ z hz) hd_at).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    let H_sup : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      g_nf 0 z * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) + g_nf 1 z * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z)
    let T_sup : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      -g_nf 0 z * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) + g_nf 1 z * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z)
    let h_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun θ => H_sup (ϕ_inv θ)

    have hH_hasDeriv : ∀ z ∈ B₁, HasDerivAt H_sup (f_g z * T_sup z) z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₁ z hz
      have hc_at := (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (ϕ_loc z)).comp z (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz)
      have hs_at := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (ϕ_loc z)).comp z (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz)
      refine (((hg_hasDeriv 0 z hz).mul hc_at).add ((hg_hasDeriv 1 z hz).mul hs_at)).congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [T_sup]
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      ring
    have hT_hasDeriv : ∀ z ∈ B₁,
        HasDerivAt T_sup ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_g z) ^ 2 - f_g z * H_sup z) z := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₁ z hz
      have hc_at := (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (ϕ_loc z)).comp z (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz)
      have hs_at := (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (ϕ_loc z)).comp z (hϕ_hasDeriv z hz)
      refine ((((hg_hasDeriv 0 z hz).neg).mul hs_at).add
        ((hg_hasDeriv 1 z hz).mul hc_at)).congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [H_sup]
      rw [hd0, hd1]
      linear_combination ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_g z) ^ 2) * Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (ϕ_loc z)

    have hH_ne_B₁ : ∀ z ∈ B₁, H_sup z ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz hHz
      obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hg_deriv_B₁ z hz
      have hW : g_nf 0 z * deriv (g_nf 1) z - g_nf 1 z * deriv (g_nf 0) z =
          ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_g z) ^ 2) * H_sup z := by
        dsimp [H_sup]
        rw [hd0, hd1]
        ring
      rw [hHz, mul_zero] at hW
      exact hW_ne z hz hW

    have hh_loc_hasDeriv : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, HasDerivAt h_loc (T_sup (ϕ_inv θ)) θ := by
      intro θ hθ
      have hz_B₂ : ϕ_inv θ ∈ B₂ := (hϕ_right_inv θ hθ).1
      have hz_B₁ : ϕ_inv θ ∈ B₁ := hB₂_sub_B₁ hz_B₂
      refine ((hH_hasDeriv (ϕ_inv θ) hz_B₁).comp θ (hϕ_inv_hasDeriv θ hθ)).congr_deriv ?_
      have hne := hf_ne (ϕ_inv θ) hz_B₁
      field_simp [hne]

    have hh_loc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_loc U_θ :=
      fun θ hθ => (hh_loc_hasDeriv θ hθ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hh_loc_ne : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, h_loc θ ≠ 0 :=
      fun θ hθ => hH_ne_B₁ (ϕ_inv θ) (hB₂_sub_B₁ (hϕ_right_inv θ hθ).1)
    have hh_loc_deriv_eq : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, deriv h_loc θ = T_sup (ϕ_inv θ) :=
      fun θ hθ => (hh_loc_hasDeriv θ hθ).deriv

    have hg_support_eq : ∀ z ∈ B₂,
        g_nf 0 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) -
          deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) ∧
        g_nf 1 z = h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.sin (ϕ_loc z) +
          deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) * Complex.cos (ϕ_loc z) := by
      intro z hz
      have hθ : ϕ_loc z ∈ U_θ := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hl : h_loc (ϕ_loc z) = H_sup z := by
        dsimp [h_loc]; rw [hϕ_left_inv z hz]
      have hd : deriv h_loc (ϕ_loc z) = T_sup z := by
        rw [hh_loc_deriv_eq (ϕ_loc z) hθ, hϕ_left_inv z hz]
      rw [hl, hd]
      dsimp [H_sup, T_sup]
      constructor
      · linear_combination -(g_nf 0 z) * Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (ϕ_loc z)
      · linear_combination -(g_nf 1 z) * Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (ϕ_loc z)

    have hlazutkin : ∀ z ∈ B₂,
        (h_loc (ϕ_loc z) + deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z)) * (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ) := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_B₁ : z ∈ B₁ := hB₂_sub_B₁ hz
      have hθ : ϕ_loc z ∈ U_θ := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hl : h_loc (ϕ_loc z) = H_sup z := by
        dsimp [h_loc]; rw [hϕ_left_inv z hz]
      have hev : deriv h_loc =ᶠ[nhds (ϕ_loc z)] fun θ => T_sup (ϕ_inv θ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_θ_open.mem_nhds hθ) hh_loc_deriv_eq
      have hd2_comp : HasDerivAt (fun θ => T_sup (ϕ_inv θ))
          (((C.c : ℂ) / (f_g z) ^ 2 - f_g z * H_sup z) * (f_g z)⁻¹) (ϕ_loc z) := by
        have h1 := (hT_hasDeriv (ϕ_inv (ϕ_loc z)) (by rw [hϕ_left_inv z hz]; exact hz_B₁)).comp
          (ϕ_loc z) (hϕ_inv_hasDeriv (ϕ_loc z) hθ)
        rwa [hϕ_left_inv z hz] at h1
      have hd2 : deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z) =
          ((C.c : ℂ) / (f_g z) ^ 2 - f_g z * H_sup z) * (f_g z)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, hd2_comp.deriv]
      rw [hl, hd2, hϕ_deriv_B₁ z hz_B₁]
      have hf_z_ne : f_g z ≠ 0 := hf_ne z hz_B₁
      field_simp [hf_z_ne]
      ring

    refine ⟨R_0, ϕ_loc, U_θ, ϕ_inv, h_loc, τ_proj, U_τ, τ_inv,
      hR_0_pos, hR_0_lt_sb, h2R_0_le_R1,
      hϕ_holo_B₁.mono hB₂_sub_B₁,
      fun z hz => by rw [hϕ_deriv_B₁ z (hB₂_sub_B₁ hz)]; exact hf_ne z (hB₂_sub_B₁ hz),
      hU_θ_open,
      fun z hz => ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩,
      hϕ_open_img,
      hϕ_inv_holo,
      hϕ_left_inv,
      hϕ_right_inv,
      hh_loc_holo,
      hh_loc_ne,
      hg_support_eq,
      fun z hz => by
        rw [hϕ_deriv_B₁ z (hB₂_sub_B₁ hz)]
        exact hg_deriv_B₁ z (hB₂_sub_B₁ hz),
      hlazutkin,
      fun _ => rfl,
      hτ_deriv_ne_B₂,
      hU_τ_open,
      fun z hz => ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩,
      hτ_open_img,
      hτ_inv_holo,
      hτ_left_inv,
      hτ_right_inv⟩

  obtain ⟨R_0, ϕ_loc, U_θ, ϕ_inv, h_loc, τ_proj, U_τ, τ_inv,
    hR_0_pos, hR_0_lt_sb, h2R_0_le_R1,
    hϕ_loc_holo, hϕ_deriv_ne_zero, hU_θ_open, hϕ_maps_to, hϕ_open_image,
    hϕ_inv_holo, hϕ_left_inv, hϕ_right_inv,
    hh_loc_holo, hh_loc_ne_zero, hg_nf_support_eq, hg_nf_deriv_eq, hlazutkin_ode,
    hτ_def, hτ_deriv_ne_zero, hU_τ_open, hτ_maps_to, hτ_open_image,
    hτ_inv_holo, hτ_left_inv, hτ_right_inv⟩ := h_part3

  have hB₂_sub_R1 :
      Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (2 * R_0) ⊆
        Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (H₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) R_1 :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball h2R_0_le_R1

  exact ⟨{
    x_edge := x_edge
    R_0 := R_0
    H₀_ge := hH₀_ge
    R_0_pos := hR_0_pos
    R_0_lt := hR_0_lt_sb
    g_nf := g_nf
    ϕ_loc := ϕ_loc
    U_θ := U_θ
    ϕ_inv := ϕ_inv
    h_loc := h_loc
    τ_proj := τ_proj
    U_τ := U_τ
    τ_inv := τ_inv
    g_nf_holo := fun i => (hg_holo i).mono hB₂_sub_R1
    g_nf_eq_slice := fun i z hz =>
      hg_nf_eq_slice i z ⟨hB_init_sub_plus (hB₂_sub_R1 hz.1), hz.2⟩
    ϕ_loc_holo := hϕ_loc_holo
    ϕ_deriv_ne_zero := hϕ_deriv_ne_zero
    U_θ_open := hU_θ_open
    ϕ_maps_to := hϕ_maps_to
    ϕ_open_image := hϕ_open_image
    ϕ_inv_holo := hϕ_inv_holo
    ϕ_left_inv := hϕ_left_inv
    ϕ_right_inv := hϕ_right_inv
    h_loc_holo := hh_loc_holo
    h_loc_ne_zero := hh_loc_ne_zero
    g_nf_support_eq := hg_nf_support_eq
    g_nf_deriv_eq := hg_nf_deriv_eq
    lazutkin_ode := hlazutkin_ode
    τ_def := hτ_def
    τ_deriv_ne_zero := hτ_deriv_ne_zero
    U_τ_open := hU_τ_open
    τ_maps_to := hτ_maps_to
    τ_open_image := hτ_open_image
    τ_inv_holo := hτ_inv_holo
    τ_left_inv := hτ_left_inv
    τ_right_inv := hτ_right_inv
  }⟩

(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B_cramer : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (s_edge : ℂ)
    (R_0 : ℝ)
    (hR0 : 0 < R_0)
    (ϕ_loc h_loc : ℂ → ℂ)
    (U_θ : Set ℂ)
    (hUθ_open : IsOpen U_θ)
    (hϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_loc (Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)))
    (hϕ_deriv_ne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0), deriv ϕ_loc z ≠ 0)
    (hϕ_maps : Set.MapsTo ϕ_loc (Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)) U_θ)
    (hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_loc U_θ)
    (hh_ne : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, h_loc θ ≠ 0)
    (hlaz : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0),
      (h_loc (ϕ_loc z) + deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z)) * (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ)) :
    Nonempty (CubicStepSuccessorData C.c s_edge R_0 ϕ_loc h_loc)

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (B_cramer : BaseCollarAndCramerData C)
    (s_edge : ℂ)
    (R_0 : ℝ)
    (hR0 : 0 < R_0)
    (ϕ_loc h_loc : ℂ → ℂ)
    (U_θ : Set ℂ)
    (hUθ_open : IsOpen U_θ)
    (hϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_loc (Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)))
    (hϕ_deriv_ne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0), deriv ϕ_loc z ≠ 0)
    (hϕ_maps : Set.MapsTo ϕ_loc (Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)) U_θ)
    (hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_loc U_θ)
    (hh_ne : ∀ θ ∈ U_θ, h_loc θ ≠ 0)
    (hlaz : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0),
      (h_loc (ϕ_loc z) + deriv (deriv h_loc) (ϕ_loc z)) * (deriv ϕ_loc z) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ)) :
    Nonempty (CubicStepSuccessorData C.c s_edge R_0 ϕ_loc h_loc)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let _ := hϕ_deriv_ne
  have hc_pos : 0 < C.c := C.c_pos
  have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hc_pos)
  let B_2 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge (2 * R_0)
  let B_32 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * R_0)
  let B_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s_edge R_0
  have hB1_sub_B32 : B_1 ⊆ B_32 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hB32_sub_B2 : B_32 ⊆ B_2 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hB1_sub_B2 : B_1 ⊆ B_2 := hB1_sub_B32.trans hB32_sub_B2
  let f : ℂ → ℂ := deriv ϕ_loc
  have hf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f B_2 := hϕ_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hf'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv f) B_2 := hf_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hh'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv h_loc) U_θ := hh_holo.deriv hUθ_open
  have hh''_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (deriv h_loc)) U_θ := hh'_holo.deriv hUθ_open
  let r_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun θ => h_loc θ + deriv (deriv h_loc) θ
  have hr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ r_loc U_θ := by exact hh_holo.add hh''_holo
  
  let p1 : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    @ContinuousLinearMap.mk ℂ ℂ _ _ (RingHom.id ℂ) (ℂ × ℂ) _ _ ℂ _ _
      NormedSpace.toModule NormedSpace.toModule
      { toFun := Prod.fst, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      continuous_fst
  let p2 : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    @ContinuousLinearMap.mk ℂ ℂ _ _ (RingHom.id ℂ) (ℂ × ℂ) _ _ ℂ _ _
      NormedSpace.toModule NormedSpace.toModule
      { toFun := Prod.snd, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      continuous_snd
  have h_partials : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun z => g (z, p.2)) p.1) W ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun z => g (p.1, z)) p.2) W := by
    intro W hW g hg
    exact ⟨B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW hg 1 0, B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW hg 0 1⟩
  have h_fderiv_partials : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W → ∀ {G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G W → ∀ {q : ℂ × ℂ}, q ∈ W →
      HasFDerivAt G
        (p1.smulRight (deriv (fun z : ℂ => G (z, q.2)) q.1) +
          p2.smulRight (deriv (fun z : ℂ => G (q.1, z)) q.2)) q := by
    intro W hW G hG q hq
    have hf_at : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℂ G q) q :=
      (hG.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => G (z, q.2)) ((fderiv ℂ G q) (1, 0)) q.1 :=
      hf_at.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 ((hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2))
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => G (q.1, z)) ((fderiv ℂ G q) (0, 1)) q.2 :=
      hf_at.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 ((hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2))
    refine hf_at.congr_fderiv (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨dv, du⟩ => ?_)
    rw [h1.deriv, h2.deriv]
    have hdecomp : (dv, du) = dv • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + du • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    simp [p1, p2]
  
  let W_dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball s_edge ((7 / 4 : ℝ) * R_0) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R_0 / 4)
  have hWdom_open : IsOpen W_dom := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hWdom_mem_B2 : ∀ p ∈ W_dom, p.1 ∈ B_2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 ∈ B_2 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp1 : ‖p.1 - s_edge‖ < (7 / 4 : ℝ) * R_0 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < R_0 / 4 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith), Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    calc
      ‖p.1 + p.2 - s_edge‖ = ‖(p.1 - s_edge) + p.2‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖p.1 - s_edge‖ + ‖p.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ < 2 * R_0 := by linarith
  let μ_mid : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (ϕ_loc p.1 + ϕ_loc (p.1 + p.2)) / 2
  let δ_ang : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (ϕ_loc (p.1 + p.2) - ϕ_loc p.1) / 2
  have hϕ_fst_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ϕ_loc p.1) W_dom := by
    exact hϕ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn fun p hp => (hWdom_mem_B2 p hp).1
  have hϕ_sum_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ϕ_loc (p.1 + p.2)) W_dom := by
    exact hϕ_holo.comp (differentiable_fst.add differentiable_snd).differentiableOn
      fun p hp => (hWdom_mem_B2 p hp).2
  have hμ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ μ_mid W_dom := by
    rw [show μ_mid = fun p => (ϕ_loc p.1 + ϕ_loc (p.1 + p.2)) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ from
      funext fun _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ _]

          _ ≤ ‖a_fn p - a_fn p₀‖ * ‖d‖ + ‖b_fn p - b_fn p₀‖ * ‖d‖ := by gcongr
          _ = (‖a_fn p - a_fn p₀‖ + ‖b_fn p - b_fn p₀‖) * ‖d‖ := by ring
      linarith
    have hb_ne : b_fn p₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hb0
      have hE_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => E_sq (q₀.1, z)) u₀ :=
        ((hE_holo.mono hΩsq_sub_Ω1).differentiableAt (hΩsq_open.mem_nhds hp₀_mem)).comp u₀
          ((differentiableAt_const q₀.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      have hb_eq : b_fn p₀ = 1 + deriv (fun z => E_sq (q₀.1, z)) u₀ :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id u₀).add hE_diff0.hasDerivAt).deriv
      have hle := hE_deriv_le q₀.1 hq₀.1 u₀ hp₀_mem.2
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) = ‖-(1 : ℂ)‖ := by simp
          _ = ‖deriv (fun z => E_sq (q₀.1, z)) u₀‖ := by
                congr 1; linear_combination hb_eq - hb0
          _ ≤ 1 / 4 := hle
      norm_num at h1
    let M_inv : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      @ContinuousLinearMap.mk ℂ ℂ _ _ (RingHom.id ℂ) (ℂ × ℂ) _ _ (ℂ × ℂ) _ _
        NormedSpace.toModule NormedSpace.toModule
        { toFun := fun d => (d.1, (b_fn p₀)⁻¹ * (d.2 - a_fn p₀ * d.1))
          map_add' := fun x y => by
            ext
            · rfl
            · simp; ring
          map_smul' := fun c x => by
            ext
            · rfl
            · simp; ring }
        (continuous_fst.prodMk
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_snd.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst))))
    let e_Ψ : (ℂ × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse (L_tri (a_fn p₀) (b_fn p₀)) M_inv
        (fun d => by
          ext
          · rfl
          · change (b_fn p₀)⁻¹ * ((a_fn p₀ * d.1 + b_fn p₀ * d.2) - a_fn p₀ * d.1) = d.2
            field_simp [hb_ne]; ring)
        (fun d => by
          ext
          · rfl
          · change a_fn p₀ * d.1 + b_fn p₀ * ((b_fn p₀)⁻¹ * (d.2 - a_fn p₀ * d.1)) = d.2
            field_simp [hb_ne]; ring)
    have hStrict : HasStrictFDerivAt Ψ (e_Ψ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ)) p₀ :=
      hasStrictFDerivAt_of_hasFDerivAt_of_continuousAt
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩsq_open.mem_nhds hp₀_mem) hΨ_fderiv) hL_cont
    let φ := hStrict.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Ψ
    have hp₀_src : p₀ ∈ φ.source := hStrict.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    have hφ_p₀ : φ p₀ = q₀ := by
      rw [HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe, hΨ_p₀]
    have hq₀_tgt : q₀ ∈ φ.target := hφ_p₀ ▸ φ.map_source hp₀_src
    have hsymm_fderiv : HasFDerivAt φ.symm (e_Ψ.symm : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ)) q₀ :=
      φ.hasFDerivAt_symm hq₀_tgt (by
        rw [← hφ_p₀, φ.left_inv hp₀_src, HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe]
        exact hStrict.hasFDerivAt)
    have hsymm_cont : ContinuousAt φ.symm q₀ := hsymm_fderiv.differentiableAt.continuousAt
    have hsymm_q₀ : φ.symm q₀ = p₀ := by rw [← hφ_p₀, φ.left_inv hp₀_src]
    have hev_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (φ.symm q).2) =ᶠ[nhds q₀] U_inv := by
      have hmem1 : W_inv ∈ nhds q₀ := hWinv_open.mem_nhds hq₀
      have hmem2 : φ.target ∈ nhds q₀ := φ.open_target.mem_nhds hq₀_tgt
      have hmem3 : φ.symm ⁻¹' Ω_sq ∈ nhds q₀ :=
        hsymm_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (hsymm_q₀.symm ▸ hΩsq_open.mem_nhds hp₀_mem)
      filter_upwards [hmem1, hmem2, hmem3] with q hqW hqt hqΩ
      have hright : Ψ (φ.symm q) = q := by
        simpa [φ, HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe] using φ.right_inv hqt
      have h1 : (φ.symm q).1 = q.1 := by simpa [Ψ] using congr_arg Prod.fst hright
      have h2 : Φ_sq (q.1, (φ.symm q).2) = q.2 := by
        have hsnd : Φ_sq (φ.symm q) = q.2 := by simpa [Ψ] using congr_arg Prod.snd hright
        rwa [← Prod.eta (φ.symm q), h1] at hsnd
      exact hU_unique q.1 q.2 (φ.symm q).2 hqW hqΩ.2 h2
    exact (p2.differentiableAt.comp q₀ hsymm_fderiv.differentiableAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      hev_eq.symm
  
  let δ_rec : ℝ := r_1 / 3
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_rec := by positivity
  have hδ_lt_r1 : δ_rec < r_1 := by dsimp [δ_rec]; linarith
  have hδ_lt_r0 : δ_rec < r_0 := lt_trans hδ_lt_r1 hr1_lt_r0
  have hδ_lt_R0 : δ_rec < R_0 := by linarith
  let C_rec : ℝ := 9 * M_C + 1
  have hC_pos : 0 < C_rec := by linarith
  let G_succ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => U_inv (p.1, -Φ_sq (p.1, -p.2))
  let W_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec
  have hB1_sub_B98 : B_1 ⊆ B_98 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have h_neg_maps_Ωsq : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, -p.2)) W_rec Ω_sq := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨hB1_sub_B98 hp.1, ?_⟩
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < δ_rec := by simpa using hp.2
    simpa using lt_trans hp2 hδ_lt_r1
  have h_arg_maps_Winv : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, -Φ_sq (p.1, -p.2))) W_rec W_inv := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨hB1_sub_B98 hp.1, ?_⟩
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < δ_rec := by simpa using hp.2
    have hΦ_le := (hΦ_norm p.1 (hB1_sub_B98 hp.1) (-p.2) (h_neg_maps_Ωsq hp).2).2
    simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_neg] at hΦ_le ⊢
    calc
      ‖Φ_sq (p.1, -p.2)‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ := hΦ_le
      _ < (5 / 4 : ℝ) * (r_1 / 3) := by dsimp [δ_rec] at hp2; linarith
      _ < r_1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_succ W_rec := by
    have hΦ_neg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => -Φ_sq (p.1, -p.2)) W_rec := by
      exact ((hΦ_holo.mono hΩsq_sub_Ω1).comp
        (differentiable_fst.prodMk differentiable_snd.neg).differentiableOn h_neg_maps_Ωsq).neg
    exact hU_holo.comp (differentiable_fst.differentiableOn.prodMk hΦ_neg) h_arg_maps_Winv
  have hG_cubic : ∀ V Δ : ℂ, V ∈ B_1 → Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_rec →
      ‖G_succ (V, Δ) - Δ‖ ≤ C_rec * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 := by
    intro V Δ hV hΔ
    have hp_rec : (V, Δ) ∈ W_rec := ⟨hV, hΔ⟩
    have hq_inv : (V, -Φ_sq (V, -Δ)) ∈ W_inv := h_arg_maps_Winv hp_rec
    let u : ℂ := G_succ (V, Δ)
    have hu_r1 : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1 := hU_mem _ hq_inv
    have hΦ_u : Φ_sq (V, u) = -Φ_sq (V, -Δ) := hU_spec _ hq_inv
    have hV_98 : V ∈ B_98 := hB1_sub_B98 hV
    have hnegΔ_r1 : -Δ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1 := (h_neg_maps_Ωsq hp_rec).2
    have hu_le_2Δ : ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖Δ‖ := by
      have h1 := (hΦ_norm V hV_98 u hu_r1).1
      have h2 := (hΦ_norm V hV_98 (-Δ) hnegΔ_r1).2
      rw [hΦ_u, norm_neg] at h1
      rw [norm_neg] at h2
      linarith [norm_nonneg Δ]
    have hu3_le : ‖u‖ ^ 3 ≤ 8 * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 := by
      calc
        ‖u‖ ^ 3 ≤ (2 * ‖Δ‖) ^ 3 := by gcongr
        _ = 8 * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 := by ring
    have hCu_le : ‖C_tilde (V, u)‖ ≤ M_C :=
      le_trans (hMC0 ⟨(V, u), hΩsq_sub_KC ⟨hV_98, hu_r1⟩, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hCΔ_le : ‖C_tilde (V, -Δ)‖ ≤ M_C :=
      le_trans (hMC0 ⟨(V, -Δ), hΩsq_sub_KC ⟨hV_98, hnegΔ_r1⟩, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hdiff : u - Δ = Δ ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, -Δ) - u ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, u) := by
      have hexp : u + u ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, u) = -(-Δ + (-Δ) ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, -Δ)) := hΦ_u
      linear_combination hexp
    rw [hdiff]
    calc
      ‖Δ ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, -Δ) - u ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, u)‖
          ≤ ‖Δ ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, -Δ)‖ + ‖u ^ 3 * C_tilde (V, u)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 * ‖C_tilde (V, -Δ)‖ + ‖u‖ ^ 3 * ‖C_tilde (V, u)‖ := by simp
      _ ≤ ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 * M_C + (8 * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3) * M_C := by gcongr
      _ = 9 * M_C * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ C_rec * ‖Δ‖ ^ 3 := by dsimp [C_rec]; nlinarith [pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg Δ) 3]
  let L_line : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p =>
    (if i = 0 then Complex.cos (ϕ_loc p.1) else Complex.sin (ϕ_loc p.1)) / D_act p
  have hWrec_sub_W0 : W_rec ⊆ W_0 :=
    Set.prod_mono hB1_sub_B32 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ_lt_r0))
  have hL_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_line i) W_rec := by
    intro i
    have hϕ_rec : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ϕ_loc p.1) W_rec := by
      exact hϕ_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn fun p hp => hB1_sub_B2 hp.1
    have hD_rec : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_act W_rec :=
      hD_holo_WA.mono (hWrec_sub_W0.trans hW0_sub_WA)
    have hD_ne_rec : ∀ p ∈ W_rec, D_act p ≠ 0 :=
      fun p hp => hDen_ne p.1 hp.1 p.2 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ_lt_r0) hp.2)
    have hDinv_rec : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (D_act p)⁻¹) W_rec :=
      hD_rec.inv hD_ne_rec
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · rw [show L_line i = fun p : ℂ × ℂ => Complex.cos (ϕ_loc p.1) * (D_act p)⁻¹ from
        funext fun _ => by simp [L_line, hi, div_eq_mul_inv]]
      exact (Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn hϕ_rec).mul hDinv_rec
    · rw [show L_line i = fun p : ℂ × ℂ => Complex.sin (ϕ_loc p.1) * (D_act p)⁻¹ from
        funext fun _ => by simp [L_line, hi, div_eq_mul_inv]]
      exact (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn hϕ_rec).mul hDinv_rec
  refine ⟨{
    δ_rec := δ_rec
    C_rec := C_rec
    δ_rec_pos := hδ_pos
    δ_rec_lt := hδ_lt_R0
    C_rec_pos := hC_pos
    G_succ := G_succ
    L_line := L_line
    G_succ_holo := hG_holo
    G_succ_cubic := hG_cubic
    L_line_holo := hL_holo
    L_line_eq := fun V Δ _ _ => ⟨rfl, by simp [L_line, D_act]⟩
    forward_step_unique := fun V Δ_m Δ_p hV hΔm hΔp hguard hstat => by
      rcases hguard with h_nonback | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have hne : Δ_p ≠ -Δ_m := fun heq => h_nonback (by linear_combination heq)
        have hF_eq : F_norm (V, Δ_p) = F_norm (V, -Δ_m) := hSwap V Δ_m Δ_p hV hstat
        have hV_32 : V ∈ B_32 := hB1_sub_B32 hV
        have hV_54 : V ∈ B_54 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hV
        have hV_98 : V ∈ B_98 := hB1_sub_B98 hV
        have hΔp_r1 : Δ_p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1 :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ_lt_r1) hΔp
        have hΔm_r1 : -Δ_m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1 :=
          (@h_neg_maps_Ωsq (V, Δ_m) ⟨hV, hΔm⟩).2
        have hr1_le_η1 : r_1 ≤ η_1 := by linarith
        have hΔp_η1 : Δ_p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) η_1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr1_le_η1 hΔp_r1
        have hΔm_η1 : -Δ_m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) η_1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr1_le_η1 hΔm_r1
        have hΔp_r0 : Δ_p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_0 :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hr1_lt_r0) hΔp_r1
        have hΔm_r0 : -Δ_m ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_0 :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hr1_lt_r0) hΔm_r1
        have hsq_eq : Φ_sq (V, Δ_p) ^ 2 = Φ_sq (V, -Δ_m) ^ 2 := by
          rw [hΦ_sq_eq V hV_54 Δ_p hΔp_η1, ← hF_fac V hV_32 Δ_p hΔp_r0, hF_eq,
            hF_fac V hV_32 (-Δ_m) hΔm_r0, ← hΦ_sq_eq V hV_54 (-Δ_m) hΔm_η1]
        rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hsq_eq with hpos | hneg
        · exact False.elim (hne (hΦ_inj V hV_98 Δ_p hΔp_r1 (-Δ_m) hΔm_r1 hpos))
        · exact hU_unique V (-Φ_sq (V, -Δ_m)) Δ_p (@h_arg_maps_Winv (V, Δ_m) ⟨hV, hΔm⟩) hΔp_r1 hneg
      · have h0 := hG_cubic V 0 hV (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos)
        simp only [sub_zero, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
          zero_pow, mul_zero] at h0
        exact (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h0 (norm_nonneg _))).symm
  }⟩
