proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have h_den_nz_sub : ∀ {W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W') {p : ℂ × ℂ} (hp : p ∈ W')
      {q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η),
      Metric.ball q₀ η ⊆ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) →
      ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, F.den p q ≠ 0 := by
    intro W' F p hp q₀ η hη hsub
    by_contra h_none
    have h_all : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, F.den p q = 0 :=
      fun q hq => Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => h_none ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
    obtain ⟨q_nz, hq_nz_mem, hq_nz⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p hp
    exact hq_nz (B_cramer.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball p (F.rad p)).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hη⟩ hsub
      (F.den_holo p hp) h_all q_nz hq_nz_mem)
  have h_cancel_den : ∀ {W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W') {p : ℂ × ℂ} (hp : p ∈ W')
      {q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
      (hsub : Metric.ball q₀ η ⊆ Metric.ball p (F.rad p))
      {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball q₀ η)),
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, g q * F.den p q = 0) →
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ η, g q = 0 := by
    intro W' F p hp q₀ η hη hsub g hg hmul
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hq₁_ne⟩ := h_den_nz_sub F hp hη hsub
    have h_cont : ContinuousAt (F.den p) q₁ :=
      (F.den_holo p hp).continuousOn.continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hsub hq₁_mem))
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_ne⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (h_cont.eventually_ne hq₁_ne)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp Metric.isOpen_ball q₁ hq₁_mem
    let δ := min δ₁ δ₂
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ₂_pos
    have hδ_sub : Metric.ball q₁ δ ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ η :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) hδ₂_sub
    have hg_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ δ, g q = 0 := fun q hq =>
      (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul q (hδ_sub hq))).resolve_right
        (hδ₁_ne q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hq))
    exact B_cramer.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball q₀ η).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_pos⟩ hδ_sub hg hg_zero
  have h_prod_den_nz : ∀ {W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F G : MeroOn2D W') {p : ℂ × ℂ} (hp : p ∈ W'),
      ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F.rad p) (G.rad p)), F.den p q * G.den p q ≠ 0 := by
    intro W' F G p hp
    let r := min (F.rad p) (G.rad p)
    have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (F.rad_pos p hp) (G.rad_pos p hp)
    by_contra h_none
    have h_all : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, F.den p q * G.den p q = 0 :=
      fun q hq => Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => h_none ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
    have hF_zero : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, F.den p q = 0 :=
      h_cancel_den G hp hr (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        ((F.den_holo p hp).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))) h_all
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁_mem, hq₁_ne⟩ :=
      h_den_nz_sub F hp hr (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
    exact hq₁_ne (hF_zero q₁ hq₁_mem)
  have h_agrees_eq_at : ∀ {W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W') {U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}
      {f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
      MeroAgreesHolo F f₁ U₁ → MeroAgreesHolo F f₂ U₂ →
      ∀ p ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂, f₁ p = f₂ p := by
    intro W' F U₁ U₂ f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ hA₁ hA₂ p hp
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, hr₁_sub, hr₁_eq⟩ := hA₁.2 p hp.1
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, hr₂_sub, hr₂_eq⟩ := hA₂.2 p hp.2
    let r := min r₁ r₂
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos
    have hr_sub_F : Metric.ball p r ⊆ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hr₁_le)
    have hdiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => f₁ q - f₂ q) (Metric.ball p r) :=
      (hf₁.mono (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr₁_sub)).sub
        (hf₂.mono (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) hr₂_sub))

        have hdLHS := (h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p₁ hp₁) hq.1).mul
          (h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p₂ hp₂) hq.2)
        have hdRHS := (h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p₂ hp₂) hq.2).mul
          (h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p₁ hp₁) hq.1)
        have h_deriv : iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.num p₁) q * F.den p₂ q +
            F.num p₁ q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.den p₂) q =
            iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.num p₂) q * F.den p₁ q +
            F.num p₂ q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.den p₁) q := by
          rw [← hdLHS.deriv, ← hdRHS.deriv]

        have h₀ := F.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq

          (F.den p₁ q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.den p₂) q +

    }, fun U f hU hf hAF => ⟨hAF.1, fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hAF.2 p hp
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hpW : p ∈ W' := hAF.1 hp
      have hqF : q ∈ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le hq
      have h_nhds : (fun y' : ℂ => (y', q.2)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball p r ∈ nhds q.1 :=

      have hev : (fun y' : ℂ => F.num p (y', q.2)) =ᶠ[nhds q.1]
          (fun y' : ℂ => f (y', q.2) * F.den p (y', q.2)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem h_nhds fun y' hy' => hr_eq (y', q.2) hy'
      have hdL := h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p hpW) hqF
      have hdR := (h_slice_y_hasDeriv hU hf (hr_sub hq)).mul
        (h_slice_y_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p hpW) hqF)
      have h_deriv : iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.num p) q =
          iterDerivYT 1 0 f q * F.den p q + f q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.den p) q := by
        rw [← hdL.deriv, ← hdR.deriv]
        exact hev.deriv_eq
      have h₀ := hr_eq q hq
      linear_combination F.den p q * h_deriv - iterDerivYT 1 0 (F.den p) q * h₀⟩⟩
  have h_derivT : ∀ {W' : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W'),

    intro W' F
    refine ⟨{
      rad := F.rad
      num := fun p q =>
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.num p) q * F.den p q - F.num p q * iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.den p) q
      den := fun p q => (F.den p q) ^ 2
      rad_pos := F.rad_pos
      ball_sub := F.ball_sub

        ((B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p hp) 0 1).mul
          (F.den_holo p hp)).sub

        obtain ⟨q, hq, hnz⟩ := F.den_ne_zero p hp

      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
        have hB₁₂ : IsOpen (Metric.ball p₁ (F.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (F.rad p₂)) :=

            (Metric.ball p₁ (F.rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (F.rad p₂)) ∈ nhds q.2 :=
          (hB₁₂.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hq
        have hev : (fun t' : ℂ => F.num p₁ (q.1, t') * F.den p₂ (q.1, t')) =ᶠ[nhds q.2]
            (fun t' : ℂ => F.num p₂ (q.1, t') * F.den p₁ (q.1, t')) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem h_nhds fun t' ht' => F.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ (q.1, t') ht'
        have hdLHS := (h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p₁ hp₁) hq.1).mul
          (h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p₂ hp₂) hq.2)
        have hdRHS := (h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p₂ hp₂) hq.2).mul
          (h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p₁ hp₁) hq.1)
        have h_deriv : iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.num p₁) q * F.den p₂ q +

            iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.num p₂) q * F.den p₁ q +
            F.num p₂ q * iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.den p₁) q := by
          rw [← hdLHS.deriv, ← hdRHS.deriv]
          exact hev.deriv_eq
        have h₀ := F.compat p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
        linear_combination F.den p₁ q * F.den p₂ q * h_deriv -
          (F.den p₁ q * iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.den p₂) q +
            iterDerivYT 0 1 (F.den p₁) q * F.den p₂ q) * h₀
    }, fun U f hU hf hAF => ⟨hAF.1, fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hAF.2 p hp
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      have hpW : p ∈ W' := hAF.1 hp
      have hqF : q ∈ Metric.ball p (F.rad p) := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_le hq
      have h_nhds : (fun t' : ℂ => (q.1, t')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball p r ∈ nhds q.2 :=
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hq
      have hev : (fun t' : ℂ => F.num p (q.1, t')) =ᶠ[nhds q.2]
          (fun t' : ℂ => f (q.1, t') * F.den p (q.1, t')) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem h_nhds fun t' ht' => hr_eq (q.1, t') ht'
      have hdL := h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.num_holo p hpW) hqF
      have hdR := (h_slice_t_hasDeriv hU hf (hr_sub hq)).mul
        (h_slice_t_hasDeriv Metric.isOpen_ball (F.den_holo p hpW) hqF)

        rw [← hdL.deriv, ← hdR.deriv]

  have h2s_pos : 0 < 2 * W.s_base := by linarith [W.s_base_pos]

  have hH₀_ge : 2 * W.s_base ≤ H₀ :=

  have h_im_div : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b / 2| ≤ |a| + |b| / 2 := fun a b =>

  have h_im_add : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a + b / 2| ≤ |a| + |b| / 2 := fun a b =>

  let T_L : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_L
  let T_X : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X
  have hTL_open : IsOpen T_L :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr fun p hp =>
      ⟨(W.L_mero 0).rad p, (W.L_mero 0).rad_pos p hp, (W.L_mero 0).ball_sub p hp⟩
  have hTL_even : ∀ p ∈ T_L, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ T_L := fun p hp => by
    refine ⟨by simpa using hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_conj_mem : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
        simp [Metric.mem_ball, hp.1]
      rw [map_neg, W.h_L_even (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) h_conj_mem]
      exact hp.2.1
    · have hp2_mem : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hp.1
      rw [W.h_L_even p.2 hp2_mem]
      exact hp.2.2
  have hTL_preconn : IsPreconnected T_L := by
    let T_base2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * W.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base }
    have hT_base2_sub : T_base2 ⊆ T_L := (W.L_agrees_two 0).1
    have hT_base2_eq : T_base2 =
        (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-(2 * W.s_base)) (2 * W.s_base)) ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by
      ext p; simp [T_base2, abs_lt, Metric.mem_ball]
    have hT_base2_pre : IsPreconnected T_base2 := by
      rw [hT_base2_eq]
      exact (((convex_Ioo _ _).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
    let γ_fn (p : ℂ × ℂ) (τ : ℝ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
      ((p.1.re : ℂ) + ((τ * p.1.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, p.2)
    refine isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mpr fun U V hU hV hcov hdisj => ?_
    have h_not_both : ∀ q, q ∈ T_L → q ∈ U → q ∈ V → False := fun q hqT hqU hqV =>
      Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mp hdisj q ⟨hqT, hqU, hqV⟩
    by_cases hTU : (T_L ∩ U).Nonempty
    · left
      obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁T, hp₁U⟩ := hTU
      have h_seg : ∀ p ∈ T_L,
          Continuous (γ_fn p) ∧ γ_fn p 0 ∈ T_base2 ∧ γ_fn p 1 = p ∧
            γ_fn p '' Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆ T_L := by
        intro p hp
        have hγ_cont : Continuous (γ_fn p) :=
          (continuous_const.add
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)).mul
              continuous_const)).prodMk continuous_const
        have hγ0 : γ_fn p 0 ∈ T_base2 := by
          simp [γ_fn, T_base2, h2s_pos, hp.1]
        have hγ1 : γ_fn p 1 = p := by
          ext1
          · simp [γ_fn, Complex.re_add_im]
          · rfl
        have h0_TL : γ_fn p 0 ∈ T_L := hT_base2_sub hγ0
        have h0_pos_conj : ENNReal.ofReal 0 < W.h_L (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) := by
          simpa [γ_fn] using h0_TL.2.1
        have h0_pos : ENNReal.ofReal 0 < W.h_L p.2 := by
          simpa [γ_fn] using h0_TL.2.2
        refine ⟨hγ_cont, hγ0, hγ1, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨τ, ⟨hτ0, hτ1⟩, rfl⟩
        have him : (γ_fn p τ).1.im = τ * p.1.im := by simp [γ_fn]
        refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [him]
          by_cases hy : 0 ≤ p.1.im
          · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (by nlinarith), ← ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
            exact h0_pos_conj
          · have hy' : p.1.im < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by nlinarith)) hp.2.1
        · rw [him]
          by_cases hy : 0 ≤ p.1.im
          · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by nlinarith)) hp.2.2
          · have hy' : p.1.im < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (by nlinarith), ← ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
            exact h0_pos
      have h_seg_in_U : ∀ p ∈ T_L,
          ((γ_fn p '' Set.Icc 0 1) ∩ U).Nonempty → γ_fn p '' Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆ U := by
        intro p hp hne
        obtain ⟨hγ_cont, _, _, hγ_sub⟩ := h_seg p hp
        have hI_pre : IsPreconnected (γ_fn p '' Set.Icc 0 1) :=

        have hI_disj : (γ_fn p '' Set.Icc 0 1) ∩ (U ∩ V) = ∅ :=
          Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr fun q ⟨hqI, hqU, hqV⟩ =>

        rcases isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hI_pre U V hU hV
          (Set.Subset.trans hγ_sub hcov) hI_disj with hIU | hIV
        · exact hIU
        · obtain ⟨q, hqI, hqU⟩ := hne
          exact False.elim (h_not_both q (hγ_sub hqI) hqU (hIV hqI))
      obtain ⟨_, hγ₁0, hγ₁1, _⟩ := h_seg p₁ hp₁T
      have hp₁_seg_U : γ_fn p₁ '' Set.Icc 0 1 ⊆ U :=
        h_seg_in_U p₁ hp₁T ⟨p₁, ⟨1, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, hγ₁1⟩, hp₁U⟩
      have hγ₁0_U : γ_fn p₁ 0 ∈ T_base2 ∩ U :=
        ⟨hγ₁0, hp₁_seg_U ⟨0, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, rfl⟩⟩
      have hB_disj : T_base2 ∩ (U ∩ V) = ∅ :=
        Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr fun q ⟨hqB, hqU, hqV⟩ =>

      have hT_base2_U : T_base2 ⊆ U := by
        rcases isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hT_base2_pre U V hU hV
          (Set.Subset.trans hT_base2_sub hcov) hB_disj with hBU | hBV
        · exact hBU
        · exact False.elim (h_not_both _ (hT_base2_sub hγ₁0_U.1) hγ₁0_U.2 (hBV hγ₁0_U.1))
      intro p₂ hp₂T

      have hp₂_seg_U := h_seg_in_U p₂ hp₂T
        ⟨_, ⟨0, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, rfl⟩, hT_base2_U hγ₂0⟩
      exact hp₂_seg_U ⟨1, ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩, hγ₂1⟩
    · right
      intro p hpT
      rcases hcov hpT with hpU | hpV
      · exact False.elim (hTU ⟨p, hpT, hpU⟩)
      · exact hpV

    rw [hΩ₁_eq]

  have hΩ₁_maps : ∀ p ∈ Ω₁, ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2) ∈ T_X ∧ (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2) ∈ T_L := by
    intro p ⟨hp_lo, hp_hi, hp_t⟩ c hc

    have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht_r
    have ht_conj_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base := by

    have ht_X_lsc : ENNReal.ofReal H_sub < W.h_X p.2 :=
      hδ_lsc_X p.2 (by simp [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith [hδ_lsc_X_pos])
    have h_shift_im : |(c * p.2).im| ≤ (1 / 2) * δ_lsc := by
      calc |(c * p.2).im| ≤ ‖c * p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _

        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * δ_lsc := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg c, norm_nonneg p.2]
    have h_im_hi : (p.1 + c * p.2).im < H_sub := by
      have h_le := (abs_le.mp h_shift_im).2
      simp only [Complex.add_im]
      dsimp only [H_sub]
      linarith
    have h_im_lo : -(p.1 + c * p.2).im < 2 * W.s_base := by
      have h_le := (abs_le.mp h_shift_im).1
      simp only [Complex.add_im]
      linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    have h_top_X : ENNReal.ofReal (p.1 + c * p.2).im < W.h_X p.2 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_lt h_im_hi)) ht_X_lsc
    have h_bot_X : ENNReal.ofReal (-(p.1 + c * p.2).im) < W.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff h2s_pos).mpr h_im_lo)
        (W.h_X_ge_two _ ht_conj_ball)
    have hX_le_L : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) W.r_base, W.h_X z ≤ W.h_L z := fun z hz => by
      rw [W.h_L_eq z hz]; exact le_self_add
    exact ⟨⟨ht_r, h_bot_X, h_top_X⟩,
      ⟨ht_r, lt_of_lt_of_le h_bot_X (hX_le_L _ ht_conj_ball),
        lt_of_lt_of_le h_top_X (hX_le_L _ ht_ball)⟩⟩

  
  let ρ_Ω (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℝ :=
    if hp : p ∈ Ω₁ then Classical.choose (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ₁_open p hp) else 1
  have hρ_Ω : ∀ p ∈ Ω₁, 0 < ρ_Ω p ∧ Metric.ball p (ρ_Ω p) ⊆ Ω₁ := fun p hp => by
    simp only [ρ_Ω, hp, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact ⟨(Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ₁_open p hp)).1,
      (Classical.choose_spec (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ₁_open p hp)).2⟩
  have h_const : ∀ c : ℂ, ∃ M : MeroOn2D Ω₁,
      ∀ U : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen U → U ⊆ Ω₁ → MeroAgreesHolo M (fun _ => c) U := by
    intro c
    refine ⟨{
      rad := ρ_Ω
      num := fun _ _ => c
      den := fun _ _ => 1
      rad_pos := fun p hp => (hρ_Ω p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp => (hρ_Ω p hp).2
      num_holo := fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const c
      den_holo := fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const 1
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => ⟨p, Metric.mem_ball_self (hρ_Ω p hp).1, one_ne_zero⟩
      compat := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => by ring
    }, fun U hU hUΩ => ⟨hUΩ, fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p hp
      exact ⟨min r (ρ_Ω p), lt_min hr_pos (hρ_Ω p (hUΩ hp)).1, min_le_right _ _,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hr_sub,
        fun _ _ => by dsimp only; ring⟩⟩⟩
  have h_shear_dist : ∀ (c : ℂ), ‖c‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ q p : ℂ × ℂ,
      dist (q.1 + c * q.2, q.2) (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2) ≤ 2 * dist q p := by
    intro c hc q p
    have hd1 : ‖q.1 - p.1‖ ≤ dist q p := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact le_max_left _ _
    have hd2 : ‖q.2 - p.2‖ ≤ dist q p := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact le_max_right _ _
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_le_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have heq : (q.1 + c * q.2) - (p.1 + c * p.2) = (q.1 - p.1) + c * (q.2 - p.2) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      calc ‖(q.1 - p.1) + c * (q.2 - p.2)‖
          ≤ ‖q.1 - p.1‖ + ‖c * (q.2 - p.2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖q.1 - p.1‖ + ‖c‖ * ‖q.2 - p.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
        _ ≤ dist q p + 1 * dist q p := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (q.2 - p.2)]
        _ = 2 * dist q p := by ring
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith [dist_nonneg (x := q) (y := p)]
  have h_pullback : ∀ (c : ℂ), ‖c‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ {T : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (G : MeroOn2D T),
      (∀ p ∈ Ω₁, (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2) ∈ T) →
      ∃ M : MeroOn2D Ω₁, ∀ (U V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen V → V ⊆ Ω₁ → (∀ p ∈ V, (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2) ∈ U) →
        MeroAgreesHolo G g U →
        MeroAgreesHolo M (fun p => g (p.1 + c * p.2, p.2)) V := by
    intro c hc T G hMaps
    let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1 + c * q.2, q.2)
    have hΦ_holo : ∀ S : Set (ℂ × ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ S := fun S =>
      (differentiableOn_fst.add ((differentiableOn_const c).mul differentiableOn_snd)).prodMk
        differentiableOn_snd
    refine ⟨{
      rad := fun p => min (G.rad (Φ p) / 2) (ρ_Ω p)
      num := fun p q => G.num (Φ p) (Φ q)
      den := fun p q => G.den (Φ p) (Φ q)
      rad_pos := fun p hp =>
        lt_min (half_pos (G.rad_pos (Φ p) (hMaps p hp))) (hρ_Ω p hp).1
      ball_sub := fun p hp =>
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hρ_Ω p hp).2
      num_holo := fun p hp =>
        (G.num_holo (Φ p) (hMaps p hp)).comp (hΦ_holo _) fun q hq => by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hq' := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
          have hle : min (G.rad (Φ p) / 2) (ρ_Ω p) ≤ G.rad (Φ p) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
          linarith [h_shear_dist c hc q p]
      den_holo := fun p hp =>
        (G.den_holo (Φ p) (hMaps p hp)).comp (hΦ_holo _) fun q hq => by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hq' := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
          have hle : min (G.rad (Φ p) / 2) (ρ_Ω p) ≤ G.rad (Φ p) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
          linarith [h_shear_dist c hc q p]
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        let rad_p := min (G.rad (Φ p) / 2) (ρ_Ω p)
        have hrad_pos : 0 < rad_p :=
          lt_min (half_pos (G.rad_pos (Φ p) (hMaps p hp))) (hρ_Ω p hp).1
        have hsub : Metric.ball (Φ p) (rad_p / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (Φ p) (G.rad (Φ p)) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by
            have : rad_p ≤ G.rad (Φ p) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
            linarith [G.rad_pos (Φ p) (hMaps p hp)])
        obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_ne⟩ :=
          h_den_nz_sub G (hMaps p hp) (half_pos hrad_pos) hsub
        let q : ℂ × ℂ := (w.1 + (-c) * w.2, w.2)
        have hΦq : Φ q = w := by ext1 <;> simp [Φ, q]
        have hp_inv : (Φ p).1 + (-c) * (Φ p).2 = p.1 := by simp [Φ]
        have hq_mem : q ∈ Metric.ball p rad_p := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hd := h_shear_dist (-c) (by simpa using hc) w (Φ p)
          have hpeq : ((Φ p).1 + (-c) * (Φ p).2, (Φ p).2) = p := Prod.ext hp_inv rfl
          rw [hpeq] at hd
          linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hw_mem]
        exact ⟨q, hq_mem, by rw [hΦq]; exact hw_ne⟩
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq => by
        apply G.compat (Φ p₁) (hMaps p₁ hp₁) (Φ p₂) (hMaps p₂ hp₂) (Φ q)
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hle : min (G.rad (Φ p₁) / 2) (ρ_Ω p₁) ≤ G.rad (Φ p₁) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
          linarith [h_shear_dist c hc q p₁, Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1]
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          have hle : min (G.rad (Φ p₂) / 2) (ρ_Ω p₂) ≤ G.rad (Φ p₂) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
          linarith [h_shear_dist c hc q p₂, Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.2]
    }, fun U V g hV hVΩ hVU hAG => ⟨hVΩ, fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r_U, hr_U_pos, hr_U_le, _, hr_U_eq⟩ := hAG.2 (Φ p) (hVU p hp)
      obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV p hp
      let rad_p := min (G.rad (Φ p) / 2) (ρ_Ω p)
      have hrad_pos : 0 < rad_p :=
        lt_min (half_pos (G.rad_pos (Φ p) (hMaps p (hVΩ hp)))) (hρ_Ω p (hVΩ hp)).1
      let r := min rad_p (min (r_U / 2) r_V)
      refine ⟨r, lt_min hrad_pos (lt_min (half_pos hr_U_pos) hr_V_pos), min_le_left _ _,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hr_V_sub,
        fun q hq => ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      apply hr_U_eq (Φ q)
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have hle : r ≤ r_U / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      linarith [h_shear_dist c hc q p, Metric.mem_ball.mp hq]⟩⟩

  
  let s_seed : ℝ := min W.s_base B_cramer.s_det
  let r_seed : ℝ := min W.r_base B_cramer.r_det
  have hs_seed_pos : 0 < s_seed := lt_min W.s_base_pos B_cramer.s_det_pos
  have hr_seed_pos : 0 < r_seed := lt_min W.r_base_pos B_cramer.r_det_pos
  let U_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_seed ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_seed }
  have hU_base_open : IsOpen U_base :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hU_base_ne : U_base.Nonempty := ⟨(0, 0), by simp [U_base, hs_seed_pos, hr_seed_pos]⟩
  have hU_base_sub_W2 : U_base ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * W.s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < W.r_base } :=
    fun p hp => ⟨by linarith [hp.1, min_le_left W.s_base B_cramer.s_det, W.s_base_pos],
      lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hU_base_sub_det2 :
      U_base ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * B_cramer.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * B_cramer.r_det } :=
    fun p hp => ⟨by linarith [hp.1, min_le_right W.s_base B_cramer.s_det, B_cramer.s_det_pos],
      by linarith [hp.2, min_le_right W.r_base B_cramer.r_det, B_cramer.r_det_pos]⟩
  have hU_base_sub_TL : U_base ⊆ T_L := Set.Subset.trans hU_base_sub_W2 (W.L_agrees_two 0).1

  let F_L : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i
  let F_X : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i
  have hFL_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_L i) U_base :=
    fun i => (B_cramer.dualLine_holo i).mono hU_base_sub_det2
  have hFX_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_X i) U_base :=
    fun i => (B_cramer.impact_holo i).mono hU_base_sub_det2
  have hFL_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (F_L i) U_base :=
    fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.L_mero i) hU_base_open hU_base_sub_W2 (W.L_agrees_two i)
  have hFX_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (F_X i) U_base :=
    fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.X_mero i) hU_base_open hU_base_sub_W2 (W.X_agrees_two i)

  have hFL_even_base : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_base, F_L i (p.1, -p.2) = F_L i p := by
    intro i p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩
    have hy_s₁ : |p.1.im| < C.s₁ := by
      have := min_le_left W.s_base B_cramer.s_det
      dsimp only [s_seed] at hp_im
      linarith [W.s_base_le_s₁, W.s_base_pos]
    have ht_r₁ : ‖p.2‖ < C.r₁ := by
      have := min_le_left W.r_base B_cramer.r_det
      dsimp only [r_seed] at hp_t
      linarith [W.r_base_lt_r₁, W.r_base_pos]
    have hy_2s₁ : |p.1.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by linarith [C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
    have hym_2s₁ : |(p.1 + (-p.2)).im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 + (-p.2)).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| := by
        simpa [Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_im, sub_eq_add_neg] using abs_sub p.1.im p.2.im
      linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
    have hθ₀ : glancingTheta C p.1 (-p.2) = glancingTheta C p.1 p.2 := by
      simp [glancingTheta, C.U_even p.1 p.2 hy_2s₁ ht_r₁]
    have hθ_m : glancingTheta C (p.1 + (-p.2)) (-p.2) = glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2) p.2 := by
      have hU := C.U_even (p.1 + (-p.2)) p.2 hym_2s₁ ht_r₁
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg] at hU ⊢
      simp [glancingTheta, hU]
    have h_act_swap : ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℂ, -supportAction1_ℂ C.h_ℂ θ₀ θ₁ = supportAction2_ℂ C.h_ℂ θ₁ θ₀ := by
      intro θ₀ θ₁
      unfold supportAction1_ℂ supportAction2_ℂ
      have hmid : (θ₀ + θ₁) / 2 = (θ₁ + θ₀) / 2 := by ring
      have hdiff : (θ₁ - θ₀) / 2 = -((θ₀ - θ₁) / 2) := by ring
      rw [hmid, hdiff, Complex.sin_neg, Complex.cos_neg]
      ring
    have hoff : glancingOffset C p.1 (-p.2) = glancingOffset C p.1 p.2 := by
      unfold glancingOffset
      rw [hθ₀, hθ_m, h_act_swap]
      exact (C.glancing_stationary p.1 p.2 hy_s₁ ht_r₁).symm
    fin_cases i <;> simp [F_L, glancingDualLine, hθ₀, hoff]

  
  have h_negT_dist : ∀ q p : ℂ × ℂ, dist (q.1, -q.2) (p.1, -p.2) = dist q p := fun q p => by
    simp [Prod.dist_eq, dist_neg_neg]
  have h_negT_mero : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ F_neg : MeroOn2D T_L,
      (∀ p, F_neg.rad p = (W.L_mero i).rad (p.1, -p.2)) ∧
      (∀ p q, F_neg.num p q = (W.L_mero i).num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2)) ∧
      (∀ p q, F_neg.den p q = (W.L_mero i).den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2)) ∧
      ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ p ∈ U, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ U) → MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) f U →
        MeroAgreesHolo F_neg (fun p => f (p.1, -p.2)) U := by
    intro i
    let F := W.L_mero i
    have hI_holo : ∀ S : Set (ℂ × ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1, -q.2)) S :=
      fun _ => differentiableOn_fst.prodMk differentiableOn_snd.neg
    refine ⟨{
      rad := fun p => F.rad (p.1, -p.2)
      num := fun p q => F.num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2)
      den := fun p q => F.den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2)
      rad_pos := fun p hp => F.rad_pos (p.1, -p.2) (hTL_even p hp)
      ball_sub := fun p hp q hq => by
        have hq' : (q.1, -q.2) ∈ Metric.ball (p.1, -p.2) (F.rad (p.1, -p.2)) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
        simpa using hTL_even (q.1, -q.2) (F.ball_sub (p.1, -p.2) (hTL_even p hp) hq')
      num_holo := fun p hp =>
        (F.num_holo (p.1, -p.2) (hTL_even p hp)).comp (hI_holo _) fun q hq => by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
      den_holo := fun p hp =>
        (F.den_holo (p.1, -p.2) (hTL_even p hp)).comp (hI_holo _) fun q hq => by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
      den_ne_zero := fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hnz⟩ := F.den_ne_zero (p.1, -p.2) (hTL_even p hp)
        refine ⟨(q.1, -q.2), ?_, by simpa using hnz⟩
        have hd := h_negT_dist q (p.1, -p.2)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
        simpa using (hd.trans_lt hq)
      compat := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq =>
        F.compat (p₁.1, -p₁.2) (hTL_even p₁ hp₁) (p₂.1, -p₂.2) (hTL_even p₂ hp₂) (q.1, -q.2)
          ⟨by rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.1,
           by rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq.2⟩
    }, fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun U f hU_sym hAF => ⟨hAF.1, fun p hp => by
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hAF.2 (p.1, -p.2) (hU_sym p hp)
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      · have hq' : (q.1, -q.2) ∈ Metric.ball (p.1, -p.2) r := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
        simpa using hU_sym (q.1, -q.2) (hr_sub hq')
      · dsimp only
        exact hr_eq (q.1, -q.2) (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, h_negT_dist]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hq)⟩⟩

  have hL_even_diff : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ D_even : MeroOn2D T_L,
      (∀ p ∈ T_L, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D_even.rad p), D_even.num p q = 0) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ T_L,
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min ((W.L_mero i).rad p) ((W.L_mero i).rad (p.1, -p.2))),
          (W.L_mero i).num p q * (W.L_mero i).den (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) =
            (W.L_mero i).num (p.1, -p.2) (q.1, -q.2) * (W.L_mero i).den p q) ∧
      ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ p ∈ U, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ U) → MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) g U →
        MeroAgreesHolo D_even (fun p => g p - g (p.1, -p.2)) U := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨F_neg, hF_neg_rad, hF_neg_num, hF_neg_den, hF_neg_ag⟩ := h_negT_mero i
    obtain ⟨D_even, hD_rad, hD_num, hD_ag⟩ := h_sub (W.L_mero i) F_neg
    have hU_sym : ∀ p ∈ U_base, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ U_base := fun p hp => ⟨hp.1, by simpa using hp.2⟩
    have hD_base_ag : MeroAgreesHolo D_even (fun p => F_L i p - F_L i (p.1, -p.2)) U_base :=
      hD_ag U_base (F_L i) (fun p => F_L i (p.1, -p.2)) (hFL_agrees i)
        (hF_neg_ag U_base (F_L i) hU_sym (hFL_agrees i))
    have hD_num_zero : ∀ p ∈ T_L, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (D_even.rad p), D_even.num p q = 0 := by
      refine h_mero_zero_preconn D_even hTL_open hTL_preconn Set.Subset.rfl
        hU_base_open hU_base_ne hU_base_sub_TL fun p hp => ?_
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hD_base_ag.2 p hp
      refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      rw [hr_eq q hq]
      dsimp only
      rw [hFL_even_base i q (hr_sub hq), sub_self, zero_mul]
    refine ⟨D_even, hD_num_zero, fun p hp q hq => ?_,
      fun U g hUs hAg => hD_ag U g (fun p => g (p.1, -p.2)) hAg (hF_neg_ag U g hUs hAg)⟩
    have hq' : q ∈ Metric.ball p (D_even.rad p) := by
      rwa [hD_rad, hF_neg_rad]
    have hz := hD_num_zero p hp q hq'
    rw [hD_num, hF_neg_num, hF_neg_den] at hz
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

  
  let s_B : ℝ := (1 / 2) * min s_seed (min (W.s_base / 2) (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256))
  let r_B : ℝ := (1 / 2) * min δ_lsc (min r_seed s_seed)
  have hs_B_pos : 0 < s_B := by
    have hmin : 0 < min s_seed (min (W.s_base / 2) (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256)) :=
      lt_min hs_seed_pos (lt_min (half_pos W.s_base_pos) (by linarith [hR0_pos]))
    dsimp only [s_B]; linarith
  have hr_B_pos : 0 < r_B := by
    have hmin : 0 < min δ_lsc (min r_seed s_seed) :=
      lt_min hδ_lsc_pos (lt_min hr_seed_pos hs_seed_pos)
    dsimp only [r_B]; linarith
  let B_base : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_B ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_B }
  have hB_base_open : IsOpen B_base :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hB_base_ne : B_base.Nonempty := ⟨(0, 0), by simp [B_base, hs_B_pos, hr_B_pos]⟩
  have hB_base_sub_Ω₁ : B_base ⊆ Ω₁ := fun p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩ => by
    have hs₁ : s_B ≤ (1 / 2) * (W.s_base / 2) := by
      have hle := le_trans (min_le_right s_seed (min (W.s_base / 2) (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256)))
        (min_le_left _ _)
      dsimp only [s_B]; linarith
    have hs₂ : s_B ≤ (1 / 2) * (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256) := by
      have hle := le_trans (min_le_right s_seed (min (W.s_base / 2) (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256)))
        (min_le_right _ _)
      dsimp only [s_B]; linarith
    have hr₁ : r_B ≤ δ_lsc / 2 := by
      have hle := min_le_left δ_lsc (min r_seed s_seed)
      dsimp only [r_B]; linarith
    obtain ⟨h_lo, h_hi⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp_im
    exact ⟨by linarith [W.s_base_pos], by linarith [hR0_pos], by linarith [hδ_lsc_pos]⟩
  have hB_base_shifts_U : ∀ p ∈ B_base,
      p ∈ U_base ∧ (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ U_base ∧ (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ U_base := by
    intro p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩
    have hs_le : s_B ≤ s_seed / 2 := by
      have hle := min_le_left s_seed (min (W.s_base / 2) (H₀ - 3 * R_0 / 256))
      dsimp only [s_B]; linarith
    have hr_le_r : r_B ≤ r_seed / 2 := by
      have hle := le_trans (min_le_right δ_lsc (min r_seed s_seed)) (min_le_left _ _)
      dsimp only [r_B]; linarith
    have hr_le_s : r_B ≤ s_seed / 2 := by
      have hle := le_trans (min_le_right δ_lsc (min r_seed s_seed)) (min_le_right _ _)
      dsimp only [r_B]; linarith
    have ht_seed : ‖p.2‖ < r_seed := by linarith [hr_seed_pos]
    have him_m : |(p.1 - p.2 / 2).im| < s_seed := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 - p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
        simpa [Complex.sub_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_div p.1.im p.2.im
      linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2]
    have him_p : |(p.1 + p.2 / 2).im| < s_seed := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 + p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
        simpa [Complex.add_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_add p.1.im p.2.im
      linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2]
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hs_seed_pos], ht_seed⟩, ⟨him_m, ht_seed⟩, ⟨him_p, ht_seed⟩⟩

  have hB_base_inc : ∀ p ∈ B_base,
      (F_L 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 0 p + F_L 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 1 p - 1 = 0) ∧
      (F_L 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 0 p + F_L 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 1 p - 1 = 0) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨_, hmU, hpU⟩ := hB_base_shifts_U p hp
    have hs_det : s_seed ≤ B_cramer.s_det := min_le_right _ _
    have hr_det : r_seed ≤ B_cramer.r_det := min_le_right _ _
    have hc_m := (B_cramer.cramer_edge_identities (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2
      (by linarith [hmU.1, B_cramer.r_det_pos]) (lt_of_lt_of_le hmU.2 hr_det)).1.2
    have hc_p := (B_cramer.cramer_edge_identities (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2
      (by linarith [hpU.1, B_cramer.r_det_pos]) (lt_of_lt_of_le hpU.2 hr_det)).1.1
    have heq_m : (p.1 - p.2 / 2) + p.2 / 2 = p.1 := by ring
    have heq_p : (p.1 + p.2 / 2) - p.2 / 2 = p.1 := by ring
    rw [heq_m] at hc_m
    rw [heq_p] at hc_p
    exact ⟨by dsimp [F_L, F_X]; linear_combination hc_m,
      by dsimp [F_L, F_X]; linear_combination hc_p⟩

  
  have h_strip_h_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_sup_deriv : ∀ μ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h),
      HasDerivAt (fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 0)
        (-(C.h_ℂ μ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) μ) * Complex.sin μ) μ ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 1)
        ((C.h_ℂ μ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) μ) * Complex.cos μ) μ := by
    intro μ hμ
    have hh : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ μ) μ :=
      (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt (h_strip_h_open.mem_nhds hμ)).hasDerivAt
    have hh' : HasDerivAt (deriv C.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) μ) μ :=
      ((C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv h_strip_h_open).differentiableAt (h_strip_h_open.mem_nhds hμ)).hasDerivAt
    exact ⟨((hh.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos μ)).sub (hh'.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin μ))).congr_deriv
        (by ring),
      ((hh.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin μ)).add (hh'.mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos μ))).congr_deriv
        (by ring)⟩

  let μ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingMidAngle C p.1 p.2
  have h_div2_holo : ∀ S : Set (ℂ × ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 / 2) S :=
    fun _ => (((differentiableOn_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).mul differentiableOn_snd).congr
      fun _ _ => by dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
  have hμ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ μ_fn U_base := by
    have h_sh_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) U_base :=
      (differentiableOn_fst.sub (h_div2_holo U_base)).prodMk differentiableOn_snd
    have h_sh_p : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) U_base :=
      (differentiableOn_fst.add (h_div2_holo U_base)).prodMk differentiableOn_snd
    have hθ_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2) U_base :=
      B_cramer.theta_holo.comp h_sh_m fun p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩ => by
        have hs_det : s_seed ≤ B_cramer.s_det := min_le_right _ _
        have hr_det : r_seed ≤ B_cramer.r_det := min_le_right _ _
        have h1 : |(p.1 - p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
          simpa [Complex.sub_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_div p.1.im p.2.im
        refine ⟨by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2, B_cramer.r_det_lt_s_det, B_cramer.s_det_pos],
          by linarith [B_cramer.r_det_pos]⟩
    have hθ_p : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) U_base :=
      B_cramer.theta_holo.comp h_sh_p fun p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩ => by
        have hs_det : s_seed ≤ B_cramer.s_det := min_le_right _ _
        have hr_det : r_seed ≤ B_cramer.r_det := min_le_right _ _
        have h1 : |(p.1 + p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
          simpa [Complex.add_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_add p.1.im p.2.im
        refine ⟨by linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2, B_cramer.r_det_lt_s_det, B_cramer.s_det_pos],
          by linarith [B_cramer.r_det_pos]⟩
    exact (((differentiableOn_const (2⁻¹ : ℂ)).mul (hθ_m.add hθ_p)).congr
      fun _ _ => by dsimp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.add_apply, μ_fn, glancingMidAngle]; ring)
  have hμ_maps : ∀ p ∈ U_base, μ_fn p ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := by
    intro p ⟨hp_im, hp_t⟩
    have hs₁ : s_seed ≤ C.s₁ / 4 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) W.s_base_le_s₁
    have hr₁ : r_seed < C.r₁ / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) W.r_base_lt_r₁
    have ht_r₁ : ‖p.2‖ < C.r₁ := by linarith [C.r₁_pos]
    have hm_im : |(p.1 - p.2 / 2).im| < C.s₁ + C.r₁ := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 - p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
        simpa [Complex.sub_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_div p.1.im p.2.im
      linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2]
    have hp_im' : |(p.1 + p.2 / 2).im| < C.s₁ + C.r₁ := by
      have h1 : |(p.1 + p.2 / 2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 := by
        simpa [Complex.add_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im] using h_im_add p.1.im p.2.im
      linarith [Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2]
    have hθ_m : glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
      C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (C.U_maps_to _ _ hm_im ht_r₁)
    have hθ_p : glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2 ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
      C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to _ (C.U_maps_to _ _ hp_im' ht_r₁)
    dsimp only [horizStrip, μ_fn, glancingMidAngle] at hθ_m hθ_p ⊢
    change |((glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 +
      glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) / 2).im| < 2 * C.s_h
    change |(glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2).im| < 2 * C.s_h at hθ_m
    change |(glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2).im| < 2 * C.s_h at hθ_p
    have h_avg : |((glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 +
        glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) / 2).im| ≤
        (|(glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2).im| +
          |(glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2).im|) / 2 := by
      simp only [Complex.div_ofNat_im, Complex.add_im]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (abs_add_le _ _) (by norm_num)
    linarith

  have hFX_partials : ∀ p ∈ B_base,
      let μ := μ_fn p
      let r_μ := C.h_ℂ μ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) μ
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) p = -(r_μ * iterDerivYT 1 0 μ_fn p) * Complex.sin μ ∧
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) p = (r_μ * iterDerivYT 1 0 μ_fn p) * Complex.cos μ ∧
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_X 0) p = -(r_μ * iterDerivYT 0 1 μ_fn p) * Complex.sin μ ∧
      iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_X 1) p = (r_μ * iterDerivYT 0 1 μ_fn p) * Complex.cos μ := by
    intro p hp
    have hpU : p ∈ U_base := (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).1
    obtain ⟨hd_sup0, hd_sup1⟩ := h_sup_deriv (μ_fn p) (hμ_maps p hpU)
    have hd_μ_y := h_slice_y_hasDeriv hU_base_open hμ_holo hpU
    have hd_μ_t := h_slice_t_hasDeriv hU_base_open hμ_holo hpU
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change deriv ((fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 0) ∘ (fun y' => μ_fn (y', p.2))) p.1 = _
      rw [(hd_sup0.comp p.1 hd_μ_y).deriv]; ring
    · change deriv ((fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 1) ∘ (fun y' => μ_fn (y', p.2))) p.1 = _
      rw [(hd_sup1.comp p.1 hd_μ_y).deriv]; ring
    · change deriv ((fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 0) ∘ (fun t' => μ_fn (p.1, t'))) p.2 = _
      rw [(hd_sup0.comp p.2 hd_μ_t).deriv]; ring
    · change deriv ((fun θ => pointSupportCurve C θ 1) ∘ (fun t' => μ_fn (p.1, t'))) p.2 = _
      rw [(hd_sup1.comp p.2 hd_μ_t).deriv]; ring

  have hB_base_rank : ∀ p ∈ B_base,
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_X 1) p -
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_X 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, ht0, ht1⟩ := hFX_partials p hp
    rw [hy0, hy1, ht0, ht1]
    ring

  have hB_base_refl : ∀ p ∈ B_base, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      let W_vec := polyReflectVec (fun j => F_L j (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2))
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) p) (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) p)
      F_L i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * (W_vec 0 * F_X 0 p + W_vec 1 * F_X 1 p) - W_vec i = 0 := by
    intro p hp i
    obtain ⟨_, hmU, hpU⟩ := hB_base_shifts_U p hp
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, _, _⟩ := hFX_partials p hp
    have h_inc_p : F_L 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 0 p +
        F_L 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * F_X 1 p = 1 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp (hB_base_inc p hp).2
    have hp_m_ne : glancingOffset C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ≠ 0 :=
      B_cramer.offset_ne_zero (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2
        (hU_base_sub_det2 hmU).1 (hU_base_sub_det2 hmU).2
    have hp_p_ne : glancingOffset C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2 ≠ 0 :=
      B_cramer.offset_ne_zero (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2
        (hU_base_sub_det2 hpU).1 (hU_base_sub_det2 hpU).2
    let θ_m := glancingTheta C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2
    let θ_p := glancingTheta C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2
    let μ := μ_fn p
    let δ := (θ_p - θ_m) / 2
    have hθ_m_eq : θ_m = μ - δ := by simp [μ, μ_fn, glancingMidAngle, θ_m, θ_p, δ]; ring
    have hθ_p_eq : θ_p = μ + δ := by simp [μ, μ_fn, glancingMidAngle, θ_m, θ_p, δ]; ring
    let lam := (C.h_ℂ μ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) μ) * iterDerivYT 1 0 μ_fn p
    let c_μ := Complex.cos μ
    let s_μ := Complex.sin μ
    let c_δ := Complex.cos δ
    let s_δ := Complex.sin δ
    let p_m := glancingOffset C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2
    let p_p := glancingOffset C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2
    let W_vec := polyReflectVec (fun j => F_L j (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2))
      (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) p) (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) p)
    have hLm0 : F_L 0 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) = (c_μ * c_δ + s_μ * s_δ) / p_m := by
      change Complex.cos θ_m / p_m = _
      rw [hθ_m_eq, Complex.cos_sub]
    have hLm1 : F_L 1 (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) = (s_μ * c_δ - c_μ * s_δ) / p_m := by
      change Complex.sin θ_m / p_m = _
      rw [hθ_m_eq, Complex.sin_sub]
    have hLp0 : F_L 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) = (c_μ * c_δ - s_μ * s_δ) / p_p := by
      change Complex.cos θ_p / p_p = _
      rw [hθ_p_eq, Complex.cos_add]
    have hLp1 : F_L 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) = (s_μ * c_δ + c_μ * s_δ) / p_p := by
      change Complex.sin θ_p / p_p = _
      rw [hθ_p_eq, Complex.sin_add]
    let κ := lam ^ 2 * (c_μ ^ 2 + s_μ ^ 2) * p_p / p_m
    have hy0' : iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) p = -lam * s_μ := hy0
    have hy1' : iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) p = lam * c_μ := hy1
    have hp_p_inv : p_p * p_p⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hp_p_ne
    have hW0 : W_vec 0 = κ * F_L 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) := by
      dsimp only [W_vec, polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, κ]
      rw [hy0', hy1', hLm0, hLm1, hLp0]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination -(lam ^ 2 * (c_μ ^ 2 + s_μ ^ 2) * (c_μ * c_δ - s_μ * s_δ) * p_m⁻¹) * hp_p_inv
    have hW1 : W_vec 1 = κ * F_L 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) := by
      dsimp only [W_vec, polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, κ]
      rw [hy0', hy1', hLm0, hLm1, hLp1]
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      linear_combination -(lam ^ 2 * (c_μ ^ 2 + s_μ ^ 2) * (s_μ * c_δ + c_μ * s_δ) * p_m⁻¹) * hp_p_inv
    change F_L i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * (W_vec 0 * F_X 0 p + W_vec 1 * F_X 1 p) - W_vec i = 0
    have hdot : W_vec 0 * F_X 0 p + W_vec 1 * F_X 1 p = κ := by
      rw [hW0, hW1]
      linear_combination κ * h_inc_p
    rw [hdot]
    fin_cases i
    · change F_L 0 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * κ - W_vec 0 = 0
      rw [hW0]; ring
    · change F_L 1 (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) * κ - W_vec 1 = 0
      rw [hW1]; ring

  
  
  
  let D_H : Set ℂ := horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  have h_mem_DH : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| < H₀ → z ∈ D_H := fun z hz => by
    change ENNReal.ofReal |z.im| < W.h_X 0
    rw [hHX]
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₀_pos).mpr hz

  let I_x : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (x_edge - 5 * R_0 / 8) (x_edge + 5 * R_0 / 8)
  let I_y : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (H₀ - R_0 / 16) (H₀ - R_0 / 32)
  let rectMap : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun q => (q.1 : ℂ) + (q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have h_rect_cont : Continuous rectMap :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
  let K_wide : Set ℂ := rectMap '' (I_x ×ˢ I_y)
  have hK_compact : IsCompact K_wide := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image h_rect_cont
  have hK_sub_DH : K_wide ⊆ D_H := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨_, hy₁, hy₂⟩, rfl⟩
    apply h_mem_DH
    simp only [rectMap, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    rw [abs_lt]
    exact ⟨by linarith [h4R_lt_H₀, hR0_pos], by linarith [hR0_pos]⟩

  let IsJointGood (z : ℂ) : Prop :=
    z ∈ D_H ∧ z ∉ Z₀.E_disc ∧
    ∃ (r_z : ℝ) (L_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_z ∧
      Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z ⊆ T_L ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (z, (0 : ℂ)) r_z))

  have h_iso_at : ∀ s ∈ D_H, ∃ r > 0, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → IsJointGood z := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_sub, hr₁_E⟩ := Z₀.E_disc_isolated s hs
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, _, hr₂_L⟩ := Z₀.L_slice_holo_isolated s hs
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos, fun z hz hzs => ?_⟩
    have hz₁ : z ∈ Metric.ball s r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
    have hz₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball s r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz
    exact ⟨hr₁_sub hz₁, hr₁_E z hz₁ hzs, hr₂_L z hz₂ hzs⟩

  let r_iso (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
    if hs : s ∈ D_H then Classical.choose (h_iso_at s hs) else 0
  obtain ⟨t_bad, ht_bad_cov⟩ :
      ∃ t_bad : Finset ℂ, K_wide ⊆ ⋃ s ∈ t_bad, Metric.ball s (r_iso s) := by
    refine hK_compact.elim_finite_subcover (fun s : ℂ => Metric.ball s (r_iso s))
      (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) fun s hs => ?_
    have hsD : s ∈ D_H := hK_sub_DH hs
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_iso s := by
      simp only [r_iso, hsD, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (h_iso_at s hsD)).1
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨s, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos⟩

  obtain ⟨y_row, hy_row_mem, hy_row_not_im⟩ :
      ∃ y_row ∈ Set.Ioo (H₀ - R_0 / 16) (H₀ - R_0 / 32),
        y_row ∉ t_bad.image Complex.im :=
    (Set.Ioo_infinite (by linarith [hR0_pos])).exists_notMem_finset (t_bad.image Complex.im)

  let s_pt (x : ↥I_x) : ℂ := (x.1 : ℂ) + (y_row : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hs_pt_good : ∀ x : ↥I_x, IsJointGood (s_pt x) := by
    intro x
    have hsK : s_pt x ∈ K_wide :=
      ⟨(x.1, y_row), ⟨x.2, le_of_lt hy_row_mem.1, le_of_lt hy_row_mem.2⟩, rfl⟩
    have hcov := ht_bad_cov hsK
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at hcov
    obtain ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_ball⟩ := hcov
    have hs_ne : s_pt x ≠ s := fun heq => by
      apply hy_row_not_im
      have him : (s_pt x).im = y_row := by simp [s_pt]
      rw [← him, heq]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem Complex.im hs_mem
    by_cases hsD : s ∈ D_H
    · simp only [r_iso, hsD, ↓reduceDIte] at hs_ball
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (h_iso_at s hsD)).2 (s_pt x) hs_ball hs_ne
    · simp only [r_iso, hsD, ↓reduceDIte, Metric.ball_zero] at hs_ball
      exact False.elim hs_ball

  have h_chart_at : ∀ x : ↥I_x, ∃ (r : ℝ) (L_loc X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) r)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) r)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_loc i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) r)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) r)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (s_pt x) r, X_loc i (z, 0) = Z₀.Γ_slice z i) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨hsD, hsE, r_L, L_loc, hr_L_pos, _, hL_holo, hL_ag⟩ := hs_pt_good x
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, r_X, X_loc, hr_X_pos, _, _, hX_holo, hX_ag, hX_sl⟩ :=
      Z₀.slice_reg (s_pt x) hsD hsE
    let r := min r_L r_X
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min hr_L_pos hr_X_pos
    exact ⟨r, L_loc, X_loc, hr_pos,
      fun i => (hL_holo i).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)),
      fun i => (hX_holo i).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)),
      fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.L_mero i) Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) (hL_ag i),
      fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.X_mero i) Metric.isOpen_ball
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) (hX_ag i),
      fun i z hz => hX_sl i z (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)⟩

  let r_row (x : ↥I_x) : ℝ := Classical.choose (h_chart_at x)
  let L_loc_row (x : ↥I_x) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_chart_at x))
  let X_loc_row (x : ↥I_x) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_chart_at x)))
  have h_row_spec : ∀ x : ↥I_x,
      0 < r_row x ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_loc_row x i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) (r_row x))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc_row x i) (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) (r_row x))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_loc_row x i)
        (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) (r_row x))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc_row x i)
        (Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) (r_row x))) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (s_pt x) (r_row x),
        X_loc_row x i (z, 0) = Z₀.Γ_slice z i) :=
    fun x => Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_chart_at x)))

  let B_row (x : ↥I_x) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (s_pt x, (0 : ℂ)) (r_row x)
  let U_row : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := ⋃ x : ↥I_x, B_row x
  have hU_row_open : IsOpen U_row := isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball

  let L_slab : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p =>
    if hp : ∃ x : ↥I_x, p ∈ B_row x then L_loc_row (Classical.choose hp) i p else 0
  let X_slab : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun i p =>
    if hp : ∃ x : ↥I_x, p ∈ B_row x then X_loc_row (Classical.choose hp) i p else 0

  have hL_slab_eq_on : ∀ (x : ↥I_x) (i : Fin 2), ∀ q ∈ B_row x,
      L_slab i q = L_loc_row x i q := by
    intro x i q hq
    have hex : ∃ x' : ↥I_x, q ∈ B_row x' := ⟨x, hq⟩
    simp only [L_slab, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    let x' := Classical.choose hex
    have hq' : q ∈ B_row x' := Classical.choose_spec hex
    exact h_agrees_eq_at (W.L_mero i)
      ((h_row_spec x').2.1 i) ((h_row_spec x).2.1 i)
      ((h_row_spec x').2.2.2.1 i) ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.1 i) q ⟨hq', hq⟩
  have hX_slab_eq_on : ∀ (x : ↥I_x) (i : Fin 2), ∀ q ∈ B_row x,
      X_slab i q = X_loc_row x i q := by
    intro x i q hq
    have hex : ∃ x' : ↥I_x, q ∈ B_row x' := ⟨x, hq⟩
    simp only [X_slab, hex, ↓reduceDIte]
    let x' := Classical.choose hex
    have hq' : q ∈ B_row x' := Classical.choose_spec hex
    exact h_agrees_eq_at (W.X_mero i)
      ((h_row_spec x').2.2.1 i) ((h_row_spec x).2.2.1 i)
      ((h_row_spec x').2.2.2.2.1 i) ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.2.1 i) q ⟨hq', hq⟩

  have hL_row_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_slab i) U_row := by
    intro i p hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
    have hcongr : DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_slab i) (B_row x) :=
      ((h_row_spec x).2.1 i).congr (hL_slab_eq_on x i)
    exact (hcongr.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hX_row_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_slab i) U_row := by
    intro i p hp
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
    have hcongr : DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_slab i) (B_row x) :=
      ((h_row_spec x).2.2.1 i).congr (hX_slab_eq_on x i)
    exact (hcongr.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hL_row_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_slab i) U_row := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
        exact ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.1 i).1 hx,
      fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
        obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.1 i).2 p hx
        refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le,
          Set.Subset.trans hr_sub (Set.subset_iUnion B_row x), fun q hq => ?_⟩
        rw [hL_slab_eq_on x i q (hr_sub hq)]
        exact hr_eq q hq⟩
  have hX_row_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_slab i) U_row := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
        exact ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.2.1 i).1 hx,
      fun p hp => by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
        obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := ((h_row_spec x).2.2.2.2.1 i).2 p hx
        refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le,
          Set.Subset.trans hr_sub (Set.subset_iUnion B_row x), fun q hq => ?_⟩
        rw [hX_slab_eq_on x i q (hr_sub hq)]
        exact hr_eq q hq⟩
  have hX_row_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_row →
      ∀ i : Fin 2, X_slab i (y, 0) = Z₀.Γ_slice y i := by
    intro y hy i
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    rw [hX_slab_eq_on x i (y, 0) hx]
    apply (h_row_spec x).2.2.2.2.2 i y
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hx
    simpa [Prod.dist_eq] using h1

  
  let segMap : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun x => ((x : ℂ) + (y_row : ℂ) * Complex.I, (0 : ℂ))
  have h_seg_cont : Continuous segMap :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const
  let I_seg : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := segMap '' I_x
  have hI_seg_compact : IsCompact I_seg := isCompact_Icc.image h_seg_cont
  have hI_seg_sub : I_seg ⊆ U_row := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (h_row_spec ⟨x, hx⟩).1⟩
  obtain ⟨ε_th, hε_th_pos, hε_th_sub⟩ :=
    hI_seg_compact.exists_thickening_subset_open hU_row_open hI_seg_sub

  let δ_slab : ℝ := (1 / 2) * min (R_0 / 256) (ε_th / 4)
  let δ_t0 : ℝ := min (ε_th / 8) (δ_lsc / 8)
  have hδ_slab_pos : 0 < δ_slab := by
    have hmin : 0 < min (R_0 / 256) (ε_th / 4) := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    dsimp only [δ_slab]; linarith
  have hδ_slab_lt_R : δ_slab < R_0 / 256 := by
    have hle := min_le_left (R_0 / 256) (ε_th / 4)
    dsimp only [δ_slab]; linarith [hR0_pos]
  have hδ_slab_le_th : 4 * δ_slab ≤ ε_th / 2 := by
    have hle := min_le_right (R_0 / 256) (ε_th / 4)
    dsimp only [δ_slab]; linarith
  have hδ_slab_lt_gap : y_row + 4 * δ_slab < H₀ - R_0 / 64 := by
    linarith [hy_row_mem.2, hδ_slab_lt_R]
  have hδ_t0_pos : 0 < δ_t0 := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)

  let W_wide : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := slabBoxWide x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t0
  have hW_wide_open : IsOpen W_wide := by
    have h1 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + 4 * δ_slab } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub
        continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im - y_row| < 4 * δ_slab } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst).sub
        continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < 4 * δ_t0 } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have hW_wide_sub_row : W_wide ⊆ U_row := by
    intro p ⟨hp_re, hp_im, hp_t⟩
    apply hε_th_sub
    rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
    have hx_mem : p.1.re ∈ I_x := by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp_re
      exact ⟨by linarith [hδ_slab_lt_R, hR0_pos], by linarith [hδ_slab_lt_R, hR0_pos]⟩
    refine ⟨segMap p.1.re, ⟨p.1.re, hx_mem, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have hdiff : p.1 - ((p.1.re : ℂ) + (y_row : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          ((p.1.im - y_row : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      rw [hdiff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith [hε_th_pos]
    · rw [dist_zero_right]
      have hle : δ_t0 ≤ ε_th / 8 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith [hε_th_pos]
  have hW_wide_sub_Ω₁ : W_wide ⊆ Ω₁ := by
    intro p ⟨_, hp_im, hp_t⟩
    obtain ⟨h_im1, h_im2⟩ := abs_lt.mp hp_im
    have ht_le : δ_t0 ≤ δ_lsc / 8 := min_le_right _ _
    exact ⟨by linarith [hy_row_mem.1, hδ_slab_lt_R, hH₀_ge, hR0_lt, hR0_pos, W.s_base_pos],
      by linarith [hy_row_mem.2, hδ_slab_lt_R, hR0_pos],
      by linarith [hδ_lsc_pos]⟩

  have hL_slab_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L_slab i) W_wide :=
    fun i => (hL_row_holo i).mono hW_wide_sub_row
  have hX_slab_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_slab i) W_wide :=
    fun i => (hX_row_holo i).mono hW_wide_sub_row
  have hL_slab_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.L_mero i) (L_slab i) W_wide :=
    fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.L_mero i) hW_wide_open hW_wide_sub_row (hL_row_agrees i)
  have hX_slab_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_slab i) W_wide :=
    fun i => h_agrees_mono (W.X_mero i) hW_wide_open hW_wide_sub_row (hX_row_agrees i)

  have hL_slab_even : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_wide →
      L_slab i (y, -t) = L_slab i (y, t) := by
    intro i y t hyt
    obtain ⟨D_even, hD_zero, _, hD_ag⟩ := hL_even_diff i
    have hW_sym : ∀ p ∈ W_wide, (p.1, -p.2) ∈ W_wide :=
      fun p ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨h1, h2, by simpa using h3⟩
    have hW_sub_TL : W_wide ⊆ T_L := fun p hp =>
      (by simpa using (hΩ₁_maps p (hW_wide_sub_Ω₁ hp) 0 (by norm_num)).2)
    have h_diff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => L_slab i p - L_slab i (p.1, -p.2)) W_wide :=
      (hL_slab_holo i).sub ((hL_slab_holo i).comp
        (differentiableOn_fst.prodMk differentiableOn_snd.neg) hW_sym)
    have hz := h_holo_zero_of_num_zero D_even h_diff_holo
      (hD_ag W_wide (L_slab i) hW_sym (hL_slab_agrees i))
      (fun p hp => hD_zero p (hW_sub_TL hp)) (y, t) hyt
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm

  
  
  
  let HasMeroBridge (W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f_b f_s : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
    ∃ M : MeroOn2D Ω₁, MeroAgreesHolo M f_b B_base ∧ MeroAgreesHolo M f_s W_t
  have h_br_const : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen W_t → W_t ⊆ Ω₁ → ∀ c : ℂ,
      HasMeroBridge W_t (fun _ => c) (fun _ => c) := by
    intro W_t hWt hWtΩ c
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_const c
    exact ⟨M, hM B_base hB_base_open hB_base_sub_Ω₁, hM W_t hWt hWtΩ⟩
  have h_br_add : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      HasMeroBridge W_t f₁ g₁ → HasMeroBridge W_t f₂ g₂ →
      HasMeroBridge W_t (fun p => f₁ p + f₂ p) (fun p => g₁ p + g₂ p) := by
    rintro W_t f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ ⟨M₁, h₁b, h₁s⟩ ⟨M₂, h₂b, h₂s⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_add M₁ M₂
    exact ⟨M, hM B_base f₁ f₂ h₁b h₂b, hM W_t g₁ g₂ h₁s h₂s⟩
  have h_br_sub : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      HasMeroBridge W_t f₁ g₁ → HasMeroBridge W_t f₂ g₂ →
      HasMeroBridge W_t (fun p => f₁ p - f₂ p) (fun p => g₁ p - g₂ p) := by
    rintro W_t f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ ⟨M₁, h₁b, h₁s⟩ ⟨M₂, h₂b, h₂s⟩
    obtain ⟨M, _, _, hM⟩ := h_sub M₁ M₂
    exact ⟨M, hM B_base f₁ f₂ h₁b h₂b, hM W_t g₁ g₂ h₁s h₂s⟩
  have h_br_mul : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      HasMeroBridge W_t f₁ g₁ → HasMeroBridge W_t f₂ g₂ →
      HasMeroBridge W_t (fun p => f₁ p * f₂ p) (fun p => g₁ p * g₂ p) := by
    rintro W_t f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ ⟨M₁, h₁b, h₁s⟩ ⟨M₂, h₂b, h₂s⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_mul M₁ M₂
    exact ⟨M, hM B_base f₁ f₂ h₁b h₂b, hM W_t g₁ g₂ h₁s h₂s⟩
  have h_br_neg : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      HasMeroBridge W_t f g → HasMeroBridge W_t (fun p => -f p) (fun p => -g p) := by
    rintro W_t f g ⟨M₁, h₁b, h₁s⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_neg M₁
    exact ⟨M, hM B_base f h₁b, hM W_t g h₁s⟩
  have h_br_vanish : ∀ {W_t : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f_b f_s : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f_s W_t → HasMeroBridge W_t f_b f_s →
      (∀ p ∈ B_base, f_b p = 0) → ∀ p ∈ W_t, f_s p = 0 := by
    rintro W_t f_b f_s hfs_holo ⟨M, hMb, hMs⟩ hfb_zero
    have hnum_zero : ∀ p ∈ Ω₁, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (M.rad p), M.num p q = 0 := by
      refine h_mero_zero_preconn M hΩ₁_open hΩ₁_preconn Set.Subset.rfl
        hB_base_open hB_base_ne hB_base_sub_Ω₁ fun p hp => ?_
      obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, hr_sub, hr_eq⟩ := hMb.2 p hp
      exact ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_le, fun q hq => by rw [hr_eq q hq, hfb_zero q (hr_sub hq), zero_mul]⟩
    exact h_holo_zero_of_num_zero M hfs_holo hMs (fun p hp => hnum_zero p (hMs.1 hp))

  
  have hM_X : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasMeroBridge W_wide (F_X i) (X_slab i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_pullback 0 (by norm_num) (W.X_mero i) fun p hp =>
      (hΩ₁_maps p hp 0 (by norm_num)).1
    have hp0 : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, (q.1 + (0 : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) = q :=
      fun q => Prod.ext (by simp) rfl
    have hB := hM U_base B_base (F_X i) hB_base_open hB_base_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hp0]; exact (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).1) (hFX_agrees i)
    have hW := hM W_wide W_wide (X_slab i) hW_wide_open hW_wide_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hp0]; exact hp) (hX_slab_agrees i)
    simp only [hp0] at hB hW
    exact ⟨M, hB, hW⟩
  have hM_dY_X : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      HasMeroBridge W_wide (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X i)) (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab i)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀b, hM₀w⟩ := hM_X i
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_derivY M₀
    exact ⟨M,
      hM B_base (F_X i) hB_base_open
        ((hFX_holo i).mono fun p hp => (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).1) hM₀b,
      hM W_wide (X_slab i) hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo i) hM₀w⟩
  have hM_dT_X : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      HasMeroBridge W_wide (iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_X i)) (iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab i)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀b, hM₀w⟩ := hM_X i
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_derivT M₀
    exact ⟨M,
      hM B_base (F_X i) hB_base_open
        ((hFX_holo i).mono fun p hp => (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).1) hM₀b,
      hM W_wide (X_slab i) hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo i) hM₀w⟩

  
  have hslab_rank_one : ∀ p ∈ W_wide,
      iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 1) p =
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1) p := by
    have h_br := h_br_sub (h_br_mul (hM_dY_X 0) (hM_dT_X 1)) (h_br_mul (hM_dT_X 0) (hM_dY_X 1))
    have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 1) p -
          iterDerivYT 0 1 (X_slab 0) p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1) p) W_wide :=
      ((B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo 0) 1 0).mul
        (B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo 1) 0 1)).sub
      ((B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo 0) 0 1).mul
        (B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo 1) 1 0))
    intro p hp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (h_br_vanish h_holo h_br hB_base_rank p hp)

  
  let W_shift : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | p ∈ W_wide ∧ (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ W_wide ∧ (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ W_wide }
  have hW_shift_open : IsOpen W_shift := by
    have h2 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ W_wide } :=
      hW_wide_open.preimage
        ((continuous_fst.sub (continuous_snd.div_const (2 : ℂ))).prodMk continuous_snd)
    have h3 : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2) ∈ W_wide } :=
      hW_wide_open.preimage
        ((continuous_fst.add (continuous_snd.div_const (2 : ℂ))).prodMk continuous_snd)
    exact hW_wide_open.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have hW_shift_sub_W : W_shift ⊆ W_wide := fun _ hp => hp.1
  have hW_shift_sub_Ω₁ : W_shift ⊆ Ω₁ := Set.Subset.trans hW_shift_sub_W hW_wide_sub_Ω₁

  have h_br_mono_shift : ∀ {f_b f_s : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      HasMeroBridge W_wide f_b f_s → HasMeroBridge W_shift f_b f_s := by
    rintro f_b f_s ⟨M, hMb, hMw⟩
    exact ⟨M, hMb, h_agrees_mono M hW_shift_open hW_shift_sub_W hMw⟩

  have hM_Lm : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasMeroBridge W_shift
      (fun p => F_L i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) (fun p => L_slab i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) := by
    intro i
    have hc_half : ‖(-1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_pullback (-1 / 2) (by linarith) (W.L_mero i) fun p hp =>
      (hΩ₁_maps p hp (-1 / 2) hc_half).2
    have hpm : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, (q.1 + (-1 / 2 : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) = (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) :=
      fun q => Prod.ext (by ring) rfl
    have hB := hM U_base B_base (F_L i) hB_base_open hB_base_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hpm]; exact (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).2.1) (hFL_agrees i)
    have hW := hM W_wide W_shift (L_slab i) hW_shift_open hW_shift_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hpm]; exact hp.2.1) (hL_slab_agrees i)
    simp only [hpm] at hB hW
    exact ⟨M, hB, hW⟩
  have hM_Lp : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasMeroBridge W_shift
      (fun p => F_L i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) (fun p => L_slab i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) := by
    intro i
    have hc_half : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h_pullback (1 / 2) (by linarith) (W.L_mero i) fun p hp =>
      (hΩ₁_maps p hp (1 / 2) hc_half).2
    have hpp : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, (q.1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * q.2, q.2) = (q.1 + q.2 / 2, q.2) :=
      fun q => Prod.ext (by ring) rfl
    have hB := hM U_base B_base (F_L i) hB_base_open hB_base_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hpp]; exact (hB_base_shifts_U p hp).2.2) (hFL_agrees i)
    have hW := hM W_wide W_shift (L_slab i) hW_shift_open hW_shift_sub_Ω₁
      (fun p hp => by rw [hpp]; exact hp.2.2) (hL_slab_agrees i)
    simp only [hpp] at hB hW
    exact ⟨M, hB, hW⟩

  have hLm_holo_sh : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => L_slab i (p.1 - p.2 / 2, p.2)) W_shift :=
    fun i => (hL_slab_holo i).comp
      ((differentiableOn_fst.sub (h_div2_holo W_shift)).prodMk differentiableOn_snd)
      fun _ hp => hp.2.1
  have hLp_holo_sh : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => L_slab i (p.1 + p.2 / 2, p.2)) W_shift :=
    fun i => (hL_slab_holo i).comp
      ((differentiableOn_fst.add (h_div2_holo W_shift)).prodMk differentiableOn_snd)
      fun _ hp => hp.2.2
  have hX_holo_sh : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_slab i) W_shift :=
    fun i => (hX_slab_holo i).mono hW_shift_sub_W
  have hdYX_holo_sh : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab i)) W_shift :=
    fun i => (B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW_wide_open (hX_slab_holo i) 1 0).mono hW_shift_sub_W

  have hslab_inc : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_wide → (y - t / 2, t) ∈ W_wide →
      (y + t / 2, t) ∈ W_wide →
      (L_slab 0 (y - t / 2, t) * X_slab 0 (y, t) +
        L_slab 1 (y - t / 2, t) * X_slab 1 (y, t) = 1) ∧
      (L_slab 0 (y + t / 2, t) * X_slab 0 (y, t) +
        L_slab 1 (y + t / 2, t) * X_slab 1 (y, t) = 1) := by
    have hX0_sh := h_br_mono_shift (hM_X 0)
    have hX1_sh := h_br_mono_shift (hM_X 1)
    have h1_sh := h_br_const hW_shift_open hW_shift_sub_Ω₁ 1
    have h_br_m := h_br_sub (h_br_add (h_br_mul (hM_Lm 0) hX0_sh) (h_br_mul (hM_Lm 1) hX1_sh)) h1_sh
    have h_br_p := h_br_sub (h_br_add (h_br_mul (hM_Lp 0) hX0_sh) (h_br_mul (hM_Lp 1) hX1_sh)) h1_sh
    have h_holo_m := (((hLm_holo_sh 0).mul (hX_holo_sh 0)).add
      ((hLm_holo_sh 1).mul (hX_holo_sh 1))).sub (differentiableOn_const 1)
    have h_holo_p := (((hLp_holo_sh 0).mul (hX_holo_sh 0)).add
      ((hLp_holo_sh 1).mul (hX_holo_sh 1))).sub (differentiableOn_const 1)
    intro y t h0 hm hp
    have hmem : (y, t) ∈ W_shift := ⟨h0, hm, hp⟩
    exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (h_br_vanish h_holo_m h_br_m (fun q hq => (hB_base_inc q hq).1) (y, t) hmem),
      sub_eq_zero.mp (h_br_vanish h_holo_p h_br_p (fun q hq => (hB_base_inc q hq).2) (y, t) hmem)⟩

  have hslab_refl : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ W_wide → (y - t / 2, t) ∈ W_wide →
      (y + t / 2, t) ∈ W_wide → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      let W_vec := polyReflectVec (fun j => L_slab j (y - t / 2, t))
        (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1) (y, t)) (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) (y, t))
      L_slab i (y + t / 2, t) * (W_vec 0 * X_slab 0 (y, t) + W_vec 1 * X_slab 1 (y, t)) =
        W_vec i := by
    have hX0_sh := h_br_mono_shift (hM_X 0)
    have hX1_sh := h_br_mono_shift (hM_X 1)
    have hN0 := h_br_mono_shift (hM_dY_X 1)
    have hN1 := h_br_neg (h_br_mono_shift (hM_dY_X 0))
    have h2 := h_br_const hW_shift_open hW_shift_sub_Ω₁ 2
    have hdotLN := h_br_add (h_br_mul (hM_Lm 0) hN0) (h_br_mul (hM_Lm 1) hN1)
    have hdotNN := h_br_add (h_br_mul hN0 hN0) (h_br_mul hN1 hN1)
    have hW0_br := h_br_sub (h_br_mul (h_br_mul h2 hdotLN) hN0) (h_br_mul hdotNN (hM_Lm 0))
    have hW1_br := h_br_sub (h_br_mul (h_br_mul h2 hdotLN) hN1) (h_br_mul hdotNN (hM_Lm 1))
    have hWX_br := h_br_add (h_br_mul hW0_br hX0_sh) (h_br_mul hW1_br hX1_sh)
    have hN0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 1)) W_shift := hdYX_holo_sh 1
    have hN1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => -iterDerivYT 1 0 (X_slab 0) p) W_shift :=
      (hdYX_holo_sh 0).neg
    have hdotLN_holo := ((hLm_holo_sh 0).mul hN0_holo).add ((hLm_holo_sh 1).mul hN1_holo)
    have hdotNN_holo := (hN0_holo.mul hN0_holo).add (hN1_holo.mul hN1_holo)
    have hW0_holo := (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdotLN_holo).mul hN0_holo).sub
      (hdotNN_holo.mul (hLm_holo_sh 0))
    have hW1_holo := (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdotLN_holo).mul hN1_holo).sub
      (hdotNN_holo.mul (hLm_holo_sh 1))
    have hWX_holo := (hW0_holo.mul (hX_holo_sh 0)).add (hW1_holo.mul (hX_holo_sh 1))
    intro y t h0 hm hp i
    have hmem : (y, t) ∈ W_shift := ⟨h0, hm, hp⟩
    rcases (by fin_cases i <;> simp : i = 0 ∨ i = 1) with rfl | rfl
    · have h_br0 := h_br_sub (h_br_mul (hM_Lp 0) hWX_br) hW0_br
      have h_holo0 := ((hLp_holo_sh 0).mul hWX_holo).sub hW0_holo
      have h_b0 : ∀ q ∈ B_base,
          F_L 0 (q.1 + q.2 / 2, q.2) *
            (((2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q -
              (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) * F_X 0 q) +
             ((2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) -
              (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) * F_X 1 q)) -
          (2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
              F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
              iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q -
            (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
              (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
              F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        have hb := hB_base_refl q hq 0
        dsimp only [polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hb
        simpa only [sq] using hb
      have hz := h_br_vanish h_holo0 h_br0 h_b0 (y, t) hmem
      dsimp only [polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      simp only [sq]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
    · have h_br1 := h_br_sub (h_br_mul (hM_Lp 1) hWX_br) hW1_br
      have h_holo1 := ((hLp_holo_sh 1).mul hWX_holo).sub hW1_holo
      have h_b1 : ∀ q ∈ B_base,
          F_L 1 (q.1 + q.2 / 2, q.2) *
            (((2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q -
              (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) * F_X 0 q) +
             ((2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) -
              (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
                (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
                F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) * F_X 1 q)) -
          (2 * (F_L 0 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
              F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
              (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) -
            (iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 1) q +
              (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q) * (-iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_X 0) q)) *
              F_L 1 (q.1 - q.2 / 2, q.2)) = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        have hb := hB_base_refl q hq 1
        dsimp only [polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hb
        simpa only [sq] using hb
      have hz := h_br_vanish h_holo1 h_br1 h_b1 (y, t) hmem
      dsimp only [polyReflectVec, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      simp only [sq]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

  exact ⟨{
    y_row := y_row
    δ_slab := δ_slab
    δ_t0 := δ_t0
    y_row_bounds := hy_row_mem
    δ_slab_pos := hδ_slab_pos
    δ_slab_lt_R := hδ_slab_lt_R
    δ_slab_lt_gap := hδ_slab_lt_gap
    δ_t0_pos := hδ_t0_pos
    L_slab := L_slab
    X_slab := X_slab
    L_slab_holo := hL_slab_holo
    X_slab_holo := hX_slab_holo
    L_slab_agrees := hL_slab_agrees
    X_slab_zero := fun y hy i => hX_row_zero y (hW_wide_sub_row hy) i
    L_slab_even := hL_slab_even
    slab_incidence := hslab_inc
    slab_rank_one := hslab_rank_one
    slab_reflection := hslab_refl
    L_mero_even := fun i p hp => ⟨hTL_even p hp, (Classical.choose_spec (hL_even_diff i)).2.1 p hp⟩
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hHX
  have h_dy : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      iterDerivYT 1 0 f p = deriv (fun y' : ℂ => f (y', p.2)) p.1 := fun _ _ => rfl
  have h_dt : ∀ (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      iterDerivYT 0 1 f p = deriv (fun t' : ℂ => f (p.1, t')) p.2 := fun _ _ => rfl
  
  have h_quad_bound : ∀ {h : ℂ → ℂ} {R r M : ℝ},
      0 < r → r < R →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
      h 0 = 0 → deriv h 0 = 0 →
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ‖h w‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ t ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r, ‖h t‖ ≤ (M / r ^ 2) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro h R r M hr hrR hh h0 hd0 hsph
    have h0_mem : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_trans hr hrR))
    have hh1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope h 0) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope h0_mem).mpr hh
    have hh2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope (dslope h 0) 0) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope h0_mem).mpr hh1
    have hh1_zero : dslope h 0 0 = 0 := by rw [dslope_same, hd0]
    have hfac : ∀ z : ℂ, h z = z ^ 2 * dslope (dslope h 0) 0 z := by
      intro z
      have e1 := sub_smul_dslope h 0 z
      have e2 := sub_smul_dslope (dslope h 0) 0 z
      simp only [sub_zero, h0, hh1_zero, smul_eq_mul] at e1 e2
      linear_combination -e1 - z * e2
    have hcl_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrR

        H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, 0) * E.g_nf 0 y + H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, 0) * E.g_nf 1 y = 1 := by
      have h_inc := H_slab.slab_incidence y 0 hy0_W0
        (by simpa using hy0_W0) (by simpa using hy0_W0)
      have h1 := h_inc.1
      simp only [zero_div, sub_zero] at h1

    obtain ⟨ρ3, hρ3_pos, hρ3_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (h_rowBox_open 4) y hy

    have hρ_lt_t0 : ρ < 4 * δ_t0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith [H_slab.δ_t0_pos])
    have hball2ρ_sub : Metric.ball y (2 * ρ) ⊆ rowBox 4 :=
      Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [min_le_left (ρ3 / 3) (2 * δ_t0)]))

    have hcl_t_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (ρ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (4 * δ_t0) :=

    let K_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      Metric.closedBall y ((3 / 2) * ρ) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (ρ / 2)

      rw [hW0_eq]; exact Set.prod_mono hcl_y_sub hcl_t_sub
    let dom_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun q =>
      ‖H_slab.X_slab 0 q‖ + ‖H_slab.X_slab 1 q‖ +

    have hdom_cont : ContinuousOn dom_fn W_0 :=
      ((((H_slab.X_slab_holo 0).continuousOn.norm).add
        ((H_slab.X_slab_holo 1).continuousOn.norm)).add
        ((B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW0_open (H_slab.X_slab_holo 0) 1 0).continuousOn.norm)).add
        ((B_cramer.iterDerivYT_holo hW0_open (H_slab.X_slab_holo 1) 1 0).continuousOn.norm)

    set B : ℝ := max B₀ 0
    have h_diff_quad : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (t : ℂ), ‖t‖ ≤ ρ / 2 →

          t * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t)‖ ≤
          (((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro i t ht_le
      have ht_cl : t ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (ρ / 2) := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using ht_le
      have ht_W : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (4 * δ_t0) := hcl_t_sub ht_cl
      let g_u : ℂ → ℂ := fun u =>
        H_slab.X_slab i (y + u, t) - H_slab.X_slab i (y - u, t) -
          2 * u * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t)
      have hXi_z_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => H_slab.X_slab i (z, t)) (rowBox 4) :=
        (H_slab.X_slab_holo i).comp (by fun_prop)
          (fun z hz => by change (z, t) ∈ W_0; rw [hW0_eq]; exact ⟨hz, ht_W⟩)
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_u (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ρ)) := by
        have h_pos_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ρ), y + u ∈ rowBox 4 := by

        have h_neg_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ρ), y - u ∈ rowBox 4 := by

          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          have h_eq : (y - u) - y = -u := by ring
          rw [h_eq, norm_neg]

          (hXi_z_holo.comp (by fun_prop) h_neg_sub)).sub
          (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul differentiableOn_id).mul

      have hgd0 : deriv g_u 0 = 0 := by
        have hXi_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => H_slab.X_slab i (z, t)) y :=

            (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_add y

            rw [add_zero]; exact hXi_at.hasDerivAt

          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => y - u) (-1) 0 :=
            (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_sub y

            rw [sub_zero]; exact hXi_at.hasDerivAt

            deriv (fun z => H_slab.X_slab i (z, t)) y * (-1) -
            ((2 : ℂ) * 1) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t) = 0 := by

        exact hd_all.deriv
      have hsph_g : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) ρ, ‖g_u w‖ ≤ (2 + 2 * ρ) * B := by

          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]

              norm_nonneg (iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 0) (y + w, t)),

        have hb_m : ‖H_slab.X_slab i (y - w, t)‖ ≤ B := by

            le_trans (hB₀ ⟨(y - w, t), hyw_m, rfl⟩) (le_max_left B₀ 0)
          fin_cases i <;> dsimp [dom_fn] at hd_le ⊢ <;>
            linarith [norm_nonneg (H_slab.X_slab 0 (y - w, t)),
              norm_nonneg (H_slab.X_slab 1 (y - w, t)),
              norm_nonneg (iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 0) (y - w, t)),
              norm_nonneg (iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 1) (y - w, t))]
        have hb_d : ‖iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t)‖ ≤ B := by
          have hd_le : dom_fn (y, t) ≤ B :=
            le_trans (hB₀ ⟨(y, t), hy_0, rfl⟩) (le_max_left B₀ 0)
          fin_cases i <;> dsimp [dom_fn] at hd_le ⊢ <;>

              norm_nonneg (iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 0) (y, t)),
              norm_nonneg (iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 1) (y, t))]
        calc ‖g_u w‖
            ≤ ‖H_slab.X_slab i (y + w, t) - H_slab.X_slab i (y - w, t)‖ +

          _ ≤ ‖H_slab.X_slab i (y + w, t)‖ + ‖H_slab.X_slab i (y - w, t)‖ +

              have h1 := norm_sub_le (H_slab.X_slab i (y + w, t)) (H_slab.X_slab i (y - w, t))
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
              linarith
