              rw [hnw]
              nlinarith [hb_p, hb_m, hb_d, hρ_pos]
          _ = (2 + 2 * ρ) * B := by ring
      have hu_mem : t / 2 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
        linarith
      have hq := h_quad_bound hρ_pos (by linarith) hg_holo hg0 hgd0 hsph_g (t / 2) hu_mem
      have hgu_eq : g_u (t / 2) =
          H_slab.X_slab i (y + t / 2, t) - H_slab.X_slab i (y - t / 2, t) -
            t * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t) := by
        dsimp [g_u]; ring
      rw [hgu_eq, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat] at hq
      calc ‖H_slab.X_slab i (y + t / 2, t) - H_slab.X_slab i (y - t / 2, t) -
            t * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, t)‖

        _ = (((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    let tan_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t =>
      H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 0) (y, t) +
        H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 1) (y, t)
    have htan_bound : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ ≤ ρ / 2 → t ≠ 0 →

            (((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ := by
      intro t ht_le ht_ne
      have ht_W : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (4 * δ_t0) :=
        hcl_t_sub (by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using ht_le)
      have h_shift_in : ∀ s : ℂ, ‖s‖ ≤ ρ → (y + s, t) ∈ W_0 := by
        intro s hs
        rw [hW0_eq]
        refine ⟨hball2ρ_sub ?_, ht_W⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
        linarith
      have hyt_W0 : (y, t) ∈ W_0 := by simpa using h_shift_in 0 (by simp [hρ_pos.le])
      have hy_hp_W0 : (y + t / 2, t) ∈ W_0 :=
        h_shift_in (t / 2) (by rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith)
      have hy_hm_W0 : (y - t / 2, t) ∈ W_0 := by
        have h := h_shift_in (-(t / 2)) (by rw [norm_neg, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith)
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
      have hy_p_W0 : (y + t, t) ∈ W_0 := h_shift_in t (by linarith)
      have hy_m_W0 : (y - t, t) ∈ W_0 := by
        have h := h_shift_in (-t) (by rw [norm_neg]; linarith)
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
      have hinc_p := (H_slab.slab_incidence (y + t / 2) t hy_hp_W0
        (by convert hyt_W0 using 2; ring) (by convert hy_p_W0 using 2; ring)).1
      have hinc_m := (H_slab.slab_incidence (y - t / 2) t hy_hm_W0
        (by convert hy_m_W0 using 2; ring) (by convert hyt_W0 using 2; ring)).2
      have h_sub_p : y + t / 2 - t / 2 = y := by ring
      have h_add_m : y - t / 2 + t / 2 = y := by ring
      rw [h_sub_p] at hinc_p
      rw [h_add_m] at hinc_m
      let r0 := H_slab.X_slab 0 (y + t / 2, t) - H_slab.X_slab 0 (y - t / 2, t) -
        t * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 0) (y, t)
      let r1 := H_slab.X_slab 1 (y + t / 2, t) - H_slab.X_slab 1 (y - t / 2, t) -
        t * iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab 1) (y, t)
      have h_id : t * tan_fn t = -(H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t) * r0 + H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t) * r1) := by
        dsimp [tan_fn, r0, r1]
        linear_combination hinc_p - hinc_m
      have h_norm_prod : ‖t‖ * ‖tan_fn t‖ ≤
          ‖t‖ * ((‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t)‖ + ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t)‖) *
            (((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖) := by
        rw [← norm_mul, h_id, norm_neg]
        calc ‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t) * r0 + H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t) * r1‖
            ≤ ‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t) * r0‖ + ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t) * r1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t)‖ * ‖r0‖ + ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t)‖ * ‖r1‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ ‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t)‖ * ((((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ ^ 2) +
                ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t)‖ * ((((2 + 2 * ρ) * B) / (4 * ρ ^ 2)) * ‖t‖ ^ 2) :=

          _ = ‖t‖ * ((‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t)‖ + ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t)‖) *

    have htan0 : tan_fn 0 = 0 := by
      have hL_cont : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousAt (fun t => H_slab.L_slab i (y, t)) 0 := by

        intro i

        ((((hL_cont 0).norm.add (hL_cont 1).norm).mul continuousAt_const).mul

      let seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => (((ρ / 2) / ((k : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)

        · simp only [seq, ne_eq, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]; exact hpos.ne'

          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h0v : (‖H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, 0)‖ + ‖H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, 0)‖) *

        (le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto h1 h2

    have hdX_zero : ∀ i : Fin 2, iterDerivYT 1 0 (H_slab.X_slab i) (y, 0) = deriv (E.g_nf i) y := by
      intro i
      rw [h_dy]

    dsimp [tan_fn] at htan0
    rw [hdX_zero 0, hdX_zero 1, (E.g_nf_deriv_eq y hy_B2).1, (E.g_nf_deriv_eq y hy_B2).2] at htan0
    have hc_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr C.c_pos.ne'

      rw [hdiff_m] at hc_sub hs_sub
      dsimp [supportAction1_ℂ]
      rw [← hθ_half]
      linear_combination -hmul - E.h_loc θ_imp * hc_sub + deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * hs_sub
    have hpp_eq : p_p = supportAction2_ℂ E.h_loc Θ_m Θ_p := by
      rw [hLp0, hLp1, hX0, hX1] at hinc_p
      have hmul :
          Complex.cos Θ_p * (E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.cos θ_imp -
            deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.sin θ_imp) +
          Complex.sin Θ_p * (E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.sin θ_imp +
            deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.cos θ_imp) = p_p := by
        linear_combination p_p * hinc_p -
          (Complex.cos Θ_p * (E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.cos θ_imp -
            deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.sin θ_imp) +
            Complex.sin Θ_p * (E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.sin θ_imp +
              deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * Complex.cos θ_imp)) *
            mul_inv_cancel₀ hpp_ne
      have hdiff_p : θ_imp - Θ_p = -((Θ_p - Θ_m) / 2) := by rw [hθ_half]; ring
      have hc_sub := Complex.cos_sub θ_imp Θ_p
      have hs_sub := Complex.sin_sub θ_imp Θ_p
      rw [hdiff_p, Complex.cos_neg] at hc_sub
      rw [hdiff_p, Complex.sin_neg] at hs_sub
      dsimp [supportAction2_ℂ]
      rw [← hθ_half]
      linear_combination -hmul - E.h_loc θ_imp * hc_sub + deriv E.h_loc θ_imp * hs_sub
    exact ⟨hmid, hpm_eq, hpp_eq⟩
  
  set δ_t : ℝ := min δ_t_off (min (1 / (16 * C_init)) (S_rec.δ_rec / 8))
  have hδ_t_pos : 0 < δ_t :=
    lt_min hδ_t_off_pos (lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith [S_rec.δ_rec_pos]))
  have hδ_t_le_off : δ_t ≤ δ_t_off := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_t_le_C : δ_t ≤ 1 / (16 * C_init) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_t_le_rec : δ_t ≤ S_rec.δ_rec / 8 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hδ_t_le_t2 : δ_t ≤ δ_t2 := le_trans hδ_t_le_off (le_trans hδ_t_off_le12 hδ_12_le2)
  have hδ_t_le_slab : δ_t ≤ δ_slab / 4 := le_trans hδ_t_le_off (le_trans hδ_t_off_le12 hδ_12_les)
  have hslabBox_eq : slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t = slabBoxP 2 (2 * δ_t) := by
    ext ⟨y, t⟩
    simp only [slabBox, slabBoxP, rowBox, Set.mem_prod, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact and_assoc.symm
  have hslabBox_sub_3_off : slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t ⊆ slabBoxP 3 (2 * δ_t_off) := by
    rw [hslabBox_eq]
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨⟨hy_re, hy_im⟩, ht⟩
    refine ⟨⟨by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos], by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos]⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht
  have hslabBox_sub_3_t2 : slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t ⊆ slabBoxP 3 (2 * δ_t2) := by
    refine Set.Subset.trans hslabBox_sub_3_off ?_
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy, ht⟩
    exact ⟨hy, Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [le_trans hδ_t_off_le12 hδ_12_le2]) ht⟩
  have hslabBox_sub_W2 : slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t ⊆ W_2 := by
    refine Set.Subset.trans hslabBox_sub_3_t2 ?_
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨⟨hy_re, hy_im⟩, ht⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos], by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos]⟩,
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht⟩
  have hV_quad_box : ∀ p ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t,
      ‖V_slab p - p.1‖ ≤ C_init * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 :=
    fun p hp => hV_quad_three p (hslabBox_sub_3_t2 hp)
  have h_half_shift_in_3 : ∀ y t : ℂ,
      (y, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
      (y + t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxP 3 (2 * δ_t_off) ∧
      (y - t / 2, t) ∈ slabBoxP 3 (2 * δ_t_off) := by
    intro y t hyt
    rw [hslabBox_eq] at hyt
    rcases hyt with ⟨⟨hy_re, hy_im⟩, ht⟩
    have ht_lt : ‖t‖ < 2 * δ_t := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht
    have htr : |(t / 2).re| ≤ ‖t‖ / 2 := by
      calc |(t / 2).re| ≤ ‖t / 2‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        _ = ‖t‖ / 2 := by rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    have hti : |(t / 2).im| ≤ ‖t‖ / 2 := by
      calc |(t / 2).im| ≤ ‖t / 2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ = ‖t‖ / 2 := by rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    rcases abs_lt.mp hy_re with ⟨hr1, hr2⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp hy_im with ⟨hi1, hi2⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp htr with ⟨htr1, htr2⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hti with ⟨hti1, hti2⟩
    have ht_off : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * δ_t_off) :=

    refine ⟨⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ht_off⟩, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ht_off⟩⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_re]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_im]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · simp only [Complex.sub_re]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · simp only [Complex.sub_im]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_step_err : ∀ p q : ℂ,
      (p, q - p) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
      (q, q - p) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t →
      ‖(V_slab (q, q - p) - V_slab (p, q - p)) - (q - p)‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖q - p‖ ∧
      ‖V_slab (q, q - p) - V_slab (p, q - p)‖ < S_rec.δ_rec := by
    intro p q hp hq
    set t : ℂ := q - p
    have ht_lt : ‖t‖ < 2 * δ_t := by
      rw [hslabBox_eq] at hp; simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hp.2
    have hCt_le : C_init * ‖t‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      have h1 : C_init * (2 * δ_t) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
        have h2 : C_init * (1 / (16 * C_init)) = 1 / 16 := by field_simp [hC_init_pos.ne']
        nlinarith [hδ_t_le_C, hC_init_pos]
      nlinarith [hC_init_pos]
    have h_id : (V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)) - t =
        (V_slab (q, t) - q) - (V_slab (p, t) - p) := by dsimp [t]; ring
    have herr : ‖(V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)) - t‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖t‖ := by
      rw [h_id]
      calc ‖(V_slab (q, t) - q) - (V_slab (p, t) - p)‖
          ≤ ‖V_slab (q, t) - q‖ + ‖V_slab (p, t) - p‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2 + C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2 :=
            add_le_add (hV_quad_box (q, t) hq) (hV_quad_box (p, t) hp)
        _ = 2 * (C_init * ‖t‖) * ‖t‖ := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖t‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg t]
    have hrec_lt : ‖V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)‖ < S_rec.δ_rec := by
      calc ‖V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)‖
          = ‖((V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)) - t) + t‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖(V_slab (q, t) - V_slab (p, t)) - t‖ + ‖t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (5 / 4) * ‖t‖ := by linarith
        _ < S_rec.δ_rec := by linarith [S_rec.δ_rec_pos]

  refine ⟨{
    δ_t := δ_t
    C_init := C_init
    δ_t_pos := hδ_t_pos
    C_init_pos := hC_init_pos
    V_slab := V_slab
    V_slab_holo := hV_holo.mono hslabBox_sub_W2
    V_slab_quad := hV_quad_box
    slab_recurrence := fun y t hym hy hyp => by
      have hV0_ball : V_slab (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball s_edge R_0 :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [E.R_0_pos])
          (hV_props (y, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hy)).1
      have h_sub_m : y - (y - t) = t := by ring
      have h_sub_p : (y + t) - y = t := by ring
      have herr_m_pair := h_step_err (y - t) y (by rwa [h_sub_m]) (by rwa [h_sub_m])
      have herr_p_pair := h_step_err y (y + t) (by rwa [h_sub_p]) (by rwa [h_sub_p])
      rw [h_sub_m] at herr_m_pair
      rw [h_sub_p] at herr_p_pair
      set V₀ : ℂ := V_slab (y, t)
      set Δ_m : ℂ := V_slab (y, t) - V_slab (y - t, t)
      set Δ_p : ℂ := V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)
      refine ⟨hV0_ball, herr_m_pair.2, herr_p_pair.2, ?_⟩
      have hnonback : Δ_p + Δ_m ≠ 0 ∨ (Δ_m = 0 ∧ Δ_p = 0) := by
        by_cases ht0 : t = 0
        · right
          dsimp [Δ_m, Δ_p]
          simp [ht0]
        · left
          intro hsum0
          have ht_pos : 0 < ‖t‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ht0
          have h2t_eq : (2 : ℂ) * t = (Δ_p + Δ_m) - ((Δ_p - t) + (Δ_m - t)) := by ring
          have h2t_norm : 2 * ‖t‖ ≤ ‖Δ_p + Δ_m‖ + ‖Δ_p - t‖ + ‖Δ_m - t‖ := by
            calc 2 * ‖t‖ = ‖(2 : ℂ) * t‖ := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
              _ = ‖(Δ_p + Δ_m) - ((Δ_p - t) + (Δ_m - t))‖ := by rw [h2t_eq]
              _ ≤ ‖Δ_p + Δ_m‖ + ‖(Δ_p - t) + (Δ_m - t)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
              _ ≤ ‖Δ_p + Δ_m‖ + ‖Δ_p - t‖ + ‖Δ_m - t‖ := by
                  linarith [norm_add_le (Δ_p - t) (Δ_m - t)]
          rw [hsum0, norm_zero] at h2t_norm
          linarith [herr_p_pair.1, herr_m_pair.1]
      obtain ⟨h_hp_3, h_hm_3⟩ := h_half_shift_in_3 y t hy
      have hoff_p := (h_refl_offsets (y + t / 2) t h_hp_3).2.1
      have hoff_m := (h_refl_offsets (y - t / 2) t h_hm_3).2.2
      have h_id1 : y + t / 2 - t / 2 = y := by ring
      have h_id2 : y + t / 2 + t / 2 = y + t := by ring
      have h_id3 : y - t / 2 - t / 2 = y - t := by ring
      have h_id4 : y - t / 2 + t / 2 = y := by ring
      rw [h_id1, h_id2] at hoff_p
      rw [h_id3, h_id4] at hoff_m
      have hΘ_0 : Θ_slab (y, t) = E.ϕ_loc V₀ :=
        ((hV_props (y, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hy)).2.2.1).symm
      have hΘ_p_eq : Θ_slab (y + t, t) = E.ϕ_loc (V₀ + Δ_p) := by
        have hv : V₀ + Δ_p = V_slab (y + t, t) := by dsimp [V₀, Δ_p]; ring
        rw [hv]
        exact ((hV_props (y + t, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hyp)).2.2.1).symm
      have hΘ_m_eq : Θ_slab (y - t, t) = E.ϕ_loc (V₀ - Δ_m) := by
        have hv : V₀ - Δ_m = V_slab (y - t, t) := by dsimp [V₀, Δ_m]; ring
        rw [hv]
        exact ((hV_props (y - t, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hym)).2.2.1).symm
      rw [hΘ_0, hΘ_p_eq] at hoff_p
      rw [hΘ_m_eq, hΘ_0] at hoff_m
      have hact_eq :
          -supportAction1_ℂ E.h_loc (E.ϕ_loc V₀) (E.ϕ_loc (V₀ + Δ_p)) =
            supportAction2_ℂ E.h_loc (E.ϕ_loc (V₀ - Δ_m)) (E.ϕ_loc V₀) := by
        rw [← hoff_p, ← hoff_m]
      exact S_rec.forward_step_unique V₀ Δ_m Δ_p hV0_ball
        (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using herr_m_pair.2)
        (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using herr_p_pair.2)

    slab_agrees_L := fun i => by
      let U_in : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          |p.1.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + δ_slab ∧
          |p.1.im - y_row| < δ_slab ∧
          ‖p.2‖ < δ_t }
      have hU_in_eq : U_in = slabBoxP 1 δ_t := by
        ext ⟨y, t⟩
        change (|y.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + δ_slab ∧ |y.im - y_row| < δ_slab ∧ ‖t‖ < δ_t) ↔
          (|y.re - x_edge| < R_0 / 2 + 1 * δ_slab ∧ |y.im - y_row| < 1 * δ_slab) ∧

        rw [one_mul, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]

      have hU_in_open : IsOpen U_in := by rw [hU_in_eq]; exact h_slabBoxP_open 1 δ_t

        rw [hU_in_eq, hslabBox_eq]
        rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨⟨hy_re, hy_im⟩, ht⟩
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos], by linarith [H_slab.δ_slab_pos]⟩,
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht⟩
      have hU_in_sub_W0 : U_in ⊆ W_0 :=
        Set.Subset.trans hU_in_sub_box (Set.Subset.trans hslabBox_sub_W2 hW2_sub_W0)
      have hL_eq_on_in : ∀ q ∈ U_in,
          H_slab.L_slab i q = S_rec.L_line i (V_slab q, V_slab (q.1 + q.2, q.2) - V_slab q) := by
        rintro ⟨y, t⟩ hq
        have hq_box : (y, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t := hU_in_sub_box hq
        have hq_shift_box : (y + t, t) ∈ slabBox x_edge R_0 y_row δ_slab δ_t := by
          rcases hq with ⟨hy_re, hy_im, ht⟩
          rw [hslabBox_eq]
          have htr : |t.re| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm t
          have hti : |t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
          rcases abs_lt.mp hy_re with ⟨hr1, hr2⟩
          rcases abs_lt.mp hy_im with ⟨hi1, hi2⟩
          rcases abs_le.mp htr with ⟨htr1, htr2⟩
          rcases abs_le.mp hti with ⟨hti1, hti2⟩
          refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by simpa using (by linarith : ‖t‖ < 2 * δ_t))⟩
          · simp only [Complex.add_re]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
          · simp only [Complex.add_im]; exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h_sub_p : (y + t) - y = t := by ring
        have hΔp_lt : ‖V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)‖ < S_rec.δ_rec := by
          have hp := (h_step_err y (y + t) (by rwa [h_sub_p]) (by rwa [h_sub_p])).2
          rwa [h_sub_p] at hp
        have hV0_ball : V_slab (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball s_edge R_0 :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [E.R_0_pos])
            (hV_props (y, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hq_box)).1
        obtain ⟨h_hp_3, _⟩ := h_half_shift_in_3 y t hq_box
        have hoff_p := (h_refl_offsets (y + t / 2) t h_hp_3).2.1
        have h_id1 : y + t / 2 - t / 2 = y := by ring
        have h_id2 : y + t / 2 + t / 2 = y + t := by ring
        rw [h_id1, h_id2] at hoff_p
        have hΘ_0 : Θ_slab (y, t) = E.ϕ_loc (V_slab (y, t)) :=
          ((hV_props (y, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hq_box)).2.2.1).symm
        have hΘ_p : Θ_slab (y + t, t) =
            E.ϕ_loc (V_slab (y, t) + (V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t))) := by
          have hv : V_slab (y, t) + (V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t)) = V_slab (y + t, t) := by
            ring
          rw [hv]
          exact ((hV_props (y + t, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hq_shift_box)).2.2.1).symm
        rw [hΘ_0, hΘ_p] at hoff_p
        have hpol := hL_polar (y, t) (hslabBox_sub_W2 hq_box)
        have hLline := S_rec.L_line_eq (V_slab (y, t)) (V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t))
          hV0_ball (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hΔp_lt)
        fin_cases i
        · change H_slab.L_slab 0 (y, t) =
            S_rec.L_line 0 (V_slab (y, t), V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t))
          rw [hpol.2.1, hΘ_0, hoff_p, hLline.1]
        · change H_slab.L_slab 1 (y, t) =
            S_rec.L_line 1 (V_slab (y, t), V_slab (y + t, t) - V_slab (y, t))
          rw [hpol.2.2, hΘ_0, hoff_p, hLline.2]
      obtain ⟨hSubTube, hLocal⟩ := H_slab.L_slab_agrees i
      refine ⟨Set.Subset.trans hU_in_sub_W0 hSubTube, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_in_open p hp
      obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_le, _, hr₂_eq⟩ := hLocal p (hU_in_sub_W0 hp)
      refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, lt_min hr₁_pos hr₂_pos, le_trans (min_le_right r₁ r₂) hr₂_le,
        Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r₁ r₂)) hr₁_sub, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      rw [hr₂_eq q (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right r₁ r₂) hq),
        hL_eq_on_in q (hr₁_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r₁ r₂) hq))]
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have hs₁_pos : 0 < C.s₁ := lt_trans C.r₁_pos C.r₁_lt_s₁
  have hs₀_pos : 0 < C.s₀ := C.s₀_pos
  have hsh_pos : 0 < C.s_h := C.s_h_pos
  have hr₁_pos : 0 < C.r₁ := C.r₁_pos
  have hs_det_pos : 0 < hDet.s_det := hDet.s_det_pos
  have hr_det_pos : 0 < hDet.r_det := hDet.r_det_pos
  have hs_det_s₁ : hDet.s_det ≤ C.s₁ / 4 := hDet.s_det_le_s₁
  have hs_det_s₀ : hDet.s_det ≤ C.s₀ / 2 := hDet.s_det_le_s₀
  have hr_lt_s4 : hDet.r_det < hDet.s_det / 4 := hDet.r_det_lt_s_det
  have hr_lt_r₁ : hDet.r_det < C.r₁ / 2 := hDet.r_det_lt_r₁
  have h_open_strip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun H => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_mid_strip : ∀ {H : ℝ} {z₁ z₂ : ℂ},
      z₁ ∈ horizStrip H → z₂ ∈ horizStrip H → (z₁ + z₂) / 2 ∈ horizStrip H := by
    intro H z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂
    change |((z₁ + z₂) / 2).im| < H
    have him : ((z₁ + z₂) / 2).im = (z₁.im + z₂.im) / 2 := by simp [Complex.add_im]
    rw [him, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

        0 < r_env ∧ r_env ≤ r_s ∧ r_s < min (hDet.s_det / 4) (hDet.r_det / 4) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_minus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_plus (Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
          s_minus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
          s_plus p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s ∧
          glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_minus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∧
          glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_plus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2) ∧
        (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_s,
          ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env,
            Q_inc s p ≠ 0 ∧
            dualLineShift C 0 0 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 0 +
              dualLineShift C 0 1 p * glancingBoundaryCurve C s 1 - 1 =
              (s - s_minus p) * (s - s_plus p) * Q_inc s p) ∧
        (∀ (B : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen B → B ⊆ Metric.ball (x₀ : ℂ) r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env →
          (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F ι) B) →
          (∀ q ∈ B,
            let W := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F
            W 2 q ≠ 0 ∧
            W 0 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 0 ∧
            W 1 q = W 2 q * glancingImpact C (q.1 + q.2 / 2) q.2 1 ∧
            ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) F ι q = 0) →
          ∀ q ∈ B, ∀ ι : Fin 2, F ι q = dualLineShift C 1 ι q) := by
    intro x₀
    let z₀ : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ)
    let θ₀ : ℂ := C.ϕ_ℂ z₀
    let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (z₀, 0)
    have hz₀_strip : z₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := by
      change |z₀.im| < 2 * C.s₀; simp [z₀, hs₀_pos]
    have hθ₀_strip : θ₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) := C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to z₀ hz₀_strip
    have hc_ϕ_ne : deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀ ≠ 0 := C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero z₀ hz₀_strip
    
    have hStrict0 : HasStrictDerivAt C.ϕ_ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) z₀ :=
      (C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.analyticAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hz₀_strip)).hasStrictDerivAt
    let e_oph := hStrict0.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv hc_ϕ_ne
    let φ_oph := e_oph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph C.ϕ_ℂ
    let ϕ_inv : ℂ → ℂ := φ_oph.symm
    have hcoe : (φ_oph : ℂ → ℂ) = C.ϕ_ℂ := e_oph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
    have hz₀_src : z₀ ∈ φ_oph.source := e_oph.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    obtain ⟨r_inv, hr_inv_pos, hr_inv_sub⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (φ_oph.open_source.inter (h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)))
        z₀ ⟨hz₀_src, hz₀_strip⟩
    have hθ₀_tgt : θ₀ ∈ φ_oph.target := by
      dsimp [θ₀]; rw [← hcoe]; exact φ_oph.map_source hz₀_src
    have hleft0 : ϕ_inv θ₀ = z₀ := by
      dsimp [ϕ_inv, θ₀]; rw [← hcoe]; exact φ_oph.left_inv hz₀_src
    have hcont_inv : ContinuousAt ϕ_inv θ₀ :=
      φ_oph.continuousOn_symm.continuousAt (φ_oph.open_target.mem_nhds hθ₀_tgt)
    obtain ⟨δ_θ, hδ_θ_pos, hδ_θ_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (Filter.inter_mem (φ_oph.open_target.mem_nhds hθ₀_tgt)
        (hcont_inv.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hleft0]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ hr_inv_pos)))
    have hϕ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_inv (Metric.ball θ₀ δ_θ) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hw_tgt, hw_pre⟩ := hδ_θ_sub hw
      have hs_strip : ϕ_inv w ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := (hr_inv_sub hw_pre).2
      have hStrict_s : HasStrictDerivAt φ_oph (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ (ϕ_inv w)) (ϕ_inv w) := by
        rw [hcoe]
        exact (C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.analyticAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hs_strip)).hasStrictDerivAt
      exact (φ_oph.hasStrictDerivAt_symm hw_tgt
        (C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero _ hs_strip) hStrict_s).hasDerivAt.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hϕ_inv_right : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball θ₀ δ_θ,
        ϕ_inv w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r_inv ∧ C.ϕ_ℂ (ϕ_inv w) = w := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hw_tgt, hw_pre⟩ := hδ_θ_sub hw
      refine ⟨hw_pre, ?_⟩
      rw [← hcoe]; exact φ_oph.right_inv hw_tgt
    have hϕ_inv_left : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r_inv, ϕ_inv (C.ϕ_ℂ y) = y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [← hcoe]; exact φ_oph.left_inv (hr_inv_sub hy).1
    have hp₀_wide : p₀ ∈ D_wide := ⟨by simp [p₀, z₀, hs_det_pos], by simp [p₀, hr_det_pos]⟩
    have hTheta_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * C.s₁ → glancingTheta C y 0 = C.ϕ_ℂ y := by
      intro y hy; unfold glancingTheta; rw [C.U_zero y hy]
    have hψ_at_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * hDet.s_det →
        ψ_minus (y, 0) = C.ϕ_ℂ y ∧ ψ_plus (y, 0) = C.ϕ_ℂ y := by
      intro y hy
      have hy2 : |y.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hψ_minus_eq (y, 0)]; simp [hTheta_zero y hy2]
      · rw [hψ_plus_eq (y, 0)]; simp [hTheta_zero y hy2]
    have hψ_p₀ : ψ_minus p₀ = θ₀ ∧ ψ_plus p₀ = θ₀ :=
      hψ_at_zero z₀ (by simp [z₀, hs_det_pos])
    have hψ_m_cont : ContinuousAt ψ_minus p₀ :=
      hψ_minus_holo.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD_wide_open.mem_nhds hp₀_wide)
    have hψ_p_cont : ContinuousAt ψ_plus p₀ :=
      hψ_plus_holo.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD_wide_open.mem_nhds hp₀_wide)
    obtain ⟨δ_ψ, hδ_ψ_pos, hδ_ψ_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (Filter.inter_mem
        (hψ_m_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hψ_p₀.1]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds θ₀ hδ_θ_pos))
        (hψ_p_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hψ_p₀.2]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds θ₀ hδ_θ_pos)))
    let r_0 : ℝ := min (min r_inv δ_ψ) (min (hDet.s_det / 4) (hDet.r_det / 4))
    have hr_0_pos : 0 < r_0 :=
      lt_min (lt_min hr_inv_pos hδ_ψ_pos) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
    have hr_0_inv : r_0 ≤ r_inv := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_0_δψ : r_0 ≤ δ_ψ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr_0_s : r_0 ≤ hDet.s_det / 4 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_0_r : r_0 ≤ hDet.r_det / 4 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    let D_0 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₀ r_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_0
    have hD_0_sub_wide : D_0 ⊆ D_wide := by
      intro p hp
      have hy_im : |p.1.im| < r_0 := by
        have h1 : |p.1.im - z₀.im| ≤ ‖p.1 - z₀‖ := by
          simpa only [Complex.sub_im] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (p.1 - z₀)
        have hz₀_im : z₀.im = 0 := by simp [z₀]
        have hball : ‖p.1 - z₀‖ < r_0 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1
        rw [hz₀_im, sub_zero] at h1
        linarith
      have ht_norm : ‖p.2‖ < r_0 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hD_0_maps_θ : ∀ p ∈ D_0,
        ψ_minus p ∈ Metric.ball θ₀ δ_θ ∧ ψ_plus p ∈ Metric.ball θ₀ δ_θ := by
      intro p hp
      apply hδ_ψ_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 hr_0_δψ, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 hr_0_δψ⟩
    let s_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => ϕ_inv (ψ_minus p)
    let s_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => ϕ_inv (ψ_plus p)
    have hs_minus_holo_D0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_minus D_0 :=
      hϕ_inv_holo.comp (hψ_minus_holo.1.mono hD_0_sub_wide) (fun p hp => (hD_0_maps_θ p hp).1)
    have hs_plus_holo_D0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_plus D_0 :=
      hϕ_inv_holo.comp (hψ_plus_holo.1.mono hD_0_sub_wide) (fun p hp => (hD_0_maps_θ p hp).2)
    have hs_curve_D0 : ∀ p ∈ D_0,
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_minus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 - p.2 / 2) p.2 ∧
        glancingBoundaryCurve C (s_plus p) = glancingImpact C (p.1 + p.2 / 2) p.2 := by
      intro p hp
      have hm_eq : C.ϕ_ℂ (s_minus p) = ψ_minus p := (hϕ_inv_right _ (hD_0_maps_θ p hp).1).2
      have hp_eq : C.ϕ_ℂ (s_plus p) = ψ_plus p := (hϕ_inv_right _ (hD_0_maps_θ p hp).2).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold glancingBoundaryCurve glancingImpact; rw [hm_eq]
      · unfold glancingBoundaryCurve glancingImpact; rw [hp_eq]
    have hs_at_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r_0, s_minus (y, 0) = y ∧ s_plus (y, 0) = y := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_im : |y.im| < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * hDet.s_det :=
        (@hD_0_sub_wide (y, 0) ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_0_pos⟩).1
      obtain ⟨hm0, hp0⟩ := hψ_at_zero y hy_im
      have hy_inv : y ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r_inv := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_0_inv hy
      exact ⟨by dsimp [s_minus]; rw [hm0, hϕ_inv_left y hy_inv],
        by dsimp [s_plus]; rw [hp0, hϕ_inv_left y hy_inv]⟩
    
    let Θ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => glancingTheta C q.1 q.2
    have hp₀_Dθ : p₀ ∈ D_θ := ⟨by simp [p₀, z₀, hs_det_pos], by simp [p₀, hr_det_pos]⟩
    have hpderiv_Θ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA Θ_fn) D_θ :=
      (hKit.pderiv_holo hD_θ_open hTheta_holo.1).1
    have hpderiv_Θ_p₀ : pderivA Θ_fn p₀ = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀ := by
      unfold pderivA
      dsimp only [p₀, Θ_fn]
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
      have hz₀_2s₁ : z₀ ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₁) := by
        change |z₀.im| < 2 * C.s₁; simp [z₀, hs₁_pos]
      filter_upwards [(h_open_strip (2 * C.s₁)).mem_nhds hz₀_2s₁] with w hw

    have hc_ϕ_pos : 0 < ‖deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hc_ϕ_ne
    have hcont_pderiv_Θ : ContinuousAt (pderivA Θ_fn) p₀ :=
      hpderiv_Θ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD_θ_open.mem_nhds hp₀_Dθ)
    obtain ⟨δ_Θ, hδ_Θ_pos, hδ_Θ_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (Filter.inter_mem (hD_θ_open.mem_nhds hp₀_Dθ)
        (hcont_pderiv_Θ.preimage_mem_nhds
          (by rw [hpderiv_Θ_p₀]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) (half_pos hc_ϕ_pos))))
    let r_1 : ℝ := min (r_0 / 2) (δ_Θ / 3)
    have hr_1_pos : 0 < r_1 := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hr_1_le_half : r_1 ≤ r_0 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_1_le_δΘ : 3 * r_1 ≤ δ_Θ := by
      have : r_1 ≤ δ_Θ / 3 := min_le_right _ _; linarith
    let D_1 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₀ r_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_1
    have hD_1_sub_D0 : D_1 ⊆ D_0 :=
      Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
    have hs_sep_D1 : ∀ p ∈ D_1, p.2 ≠ 0 → s_plus p ≠ s_minus p := by
      rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨hy_b, ht_b⟩ ht_ne heq
      have hψ_eq : ψ_plus (y, t) = ψ_minus (y, t) := by
        have h1 := (hϕ_inv_right _ (hD_0_maps_θ (y, t) (hD_1_sub_D0 ⟨hy_b, ht_b⟩)).2).2
        have h2 := (hϕ_inv_right _ (hD_0_maps_θ (y, t) (hD_1_sub_D0 ⟨hy_b, ht_b⟩)).1).2
        have hcon := congrArg C.ϕ_ℂ heq

        rw [h1, h2] at hcon
        exact hcon
      rw [hψ_plus_eq (y, t), hψ_minus_eq (y, t)] at hψ_eq
      have hΘ_eq : Θ_fn (y + t, t) = Θ_fn (y - t, t) := by
        dsimp only [Θ_fn]; linear_combination 2 * hψ_eq
      let f_t : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Θ_fn (w, t) - deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀ * w
      have hw_in_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_1), (w, t) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ δ_Θ := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        have ht_r1 : dist t 0 < r_1 := ht_b
        exact ⟨by linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hw], by linarith⟩
      have hf_diff : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_1),
          HasDerivAt f_t (pderivA Θ_fn (w, t) - deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) w := by
        intro w hw
        have hwt_Dθ : (w, t) ∈ D_θ := (hδ_Θ_sub (hw_in_ball w hw)).1
        have hΘ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Θ_fn (w, t) :=
          hTheta_holo.1.differentiableAt (hD_θ_open.mem_nhds hwt_Dθ)
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w' : ℂ => Θ_fn (w', t)) (pderivA Θ_fn (w, t)) w :=
          (hSliceHasDeriv hΘ_at).1
        have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun w' : ℂ => deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀ * w') (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) w := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id w).const_mul (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀)
        exact h1.sub h2
      have hf_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_1), ‖deriv f_t w‖ ≤ ‖deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀‖ / 2 := by
        intro w hw

        have hlt : dist (pderivA Θ_fn (w, t)) (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) < ‖deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀‖ / 2 :=

        rw [dist_eq_norm] at hlt
        exact le_of_lt hlt
      have hym_mem : y - t ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hy_n : ‖y - z₀‖ < r_1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy_b
        have ht_n : ‖t‖ < r_1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht_b
        rw [show y - t - z₀ = (y - z₀) - t by ring]
        linarith [norm_sub_le (y - z₀) t]
      have hyp_mem : y + t ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r_1) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hy_n : ‖y - z₀‖ < r_1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy_b
        have ht_n : ‖t‖ < r_1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht_b
        rw [show y + t - z₀ = (y - z₀) + t by ring]
        linarith [norm_add_le (y - z₀) t]
      have hmvt := (convex_ball z₀ (2 * r_1)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun w hw => (hf_diff w hw).differentiableAt) hf_bnd hym_mem hyp_mem
      have hft_diff : f_t (y + t) - f_t (y - t) = -(2 : ℂ) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀ * t := by
        dsimp [f_t]; rw [hΘ_eq]; ring
      have harg_diff : (y + t) - (y - t) = (2 : ℂ) * t := by ring
      rw [hft_diff, harg_diff, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat,
        norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat] at hmvt
      have ht_pos_n : 0 < ‖t‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ht_ne
      nlinarith [mul_pos hc_ϕ_pos ht_pos_n]
    
    let g_inc : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun w p => dualLineShift C 0 0 p * Γ w 0 + dualLineShift C 0 1 p * Γ w 1 - 1
    have hg_d1 : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀),

          (dualLineShift C 0 0 p * deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) w +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) w) w := by
      intro p w hw
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Γ z 0) (deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) w) w :=
        ((hΓ_holo 0).differentiableAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Γ z 1) (deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) w) w :=
        ((hΓ_holo 1).differentiableAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      exact ((hd0.const_mul (dualLineShift C 0 0 p)).add
        (hd1.const_mul (dualLineShift C 0 1 p))).sub_const 1
    have hg_d2 : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀),
        deriv (deriv (fun z => g_inc z p)) w =
          dualLineShift C 0 0 p * deriv (deriv (fun z => Γ z 0)) w +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * deriv (deriv (fun z => Γ z 1)) w := by
      intro p w hw
      have hev : deriv (fun z => g_inc z p) =ᶠ[nhds w]
          (fun z => dualLineShift C 0 0 p * deriv (fun u => Γ u 0) z +
            dualLineShift C 0 1 p * deriv (fun u => Γ u 1) z) := by
        filter_upwards [(h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hw] with z hz
        exact (hg_d1 p z hz).deriv
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt (deriv (fun u => Γ u 0)) (deriv (deriv (fun u => Γ u 0)) w) w :=
        ((hΓ_d1_holo 0).differentiableAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (deriv (fun u => Γ u 1)) (deriv (deriv (fun u => Γ u 1)) w) w :=
        ((hΓ_d1_holo 1).differentiableAt ((h_open_strip (2 * C.s₀)).mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      exact ((hd0.const_mul (dualLineShift C 0 0 p)).add
        (hd1.const_mul (dualLineShift C 0 1 p))).deriv
    have hg_d1_diag_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀), |y.im| < 2 * C.s₁ →
        deriv (fun z => g_inc z (y, 0)) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy_s₀ hy_2s₁
      rw [(hg_d1 (y, 0) y hy_s₀).deriv]
      obtain ⟨hd0, hd1⟩ := hΓ_deriv y hy_s₀
      rw [hd0.deriv, hd1.deriv]
      simp only [dualLineShift, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, glancingDualLine,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hTheta_zero y hy_2s₁]
      ring
    have hoff_z₀ : glancingOffset C z₀ 0 = (C.h (C.ϕ x₀) : ℂ) := by
      have hθ : glancingTheta C z₀ 0 = (C.ϕ x₀ : ℂ) := by
        rw [hTheta_zero z₀ (by simp [z₀, hs₁_pos])]
        exact C.ϕ_ℂ_real x₀
      unfold glancingOffset supportAction1_ℂ
      simp [z₀, hθ, C.h_ℂ_real]
    have hh_z₀_ne : (C.h (C.ϕ x₀) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (C.h_pos (C.ϕ x₀)).ne'
    have hr_θ₀_ne : r_ℂ θ₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro hr0
      have hnorm := C.lazutkin_norm_ℂ z₀ hz₀_strip
      change r_ℂ θ₀ * (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ z₀) ^ 3 = (C.c : ℂ) at hnorm
      rw [hr0, zero_mul] at hnorm

              simpa using
                (((hasDerivAt_id u).ofReal_comp.mul_const (z - s_minus p)).const_add (s_minus p))
            have h2 : HasDerivAt hp_fn (deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)))
                (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)) :=
              (hhp_holo.differentiableAt
                (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hseg z hz u hu))).hasDerivAt
            simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using
              (h2.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt u h1
          have hint_f : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun u : ℝ => deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)))
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
            (hd1_holo.continuousOn.comp
              (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).continuousOn
              (hseg z hz)).intervalIntegrable
          have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
            (hint_f.const_mul (z - s_minus p))
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
          simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero,
            add_sub_cancel] at hftc
          rw [dslope_of_ne hp_fn hne, slope_def_field, ← hftc,
            mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)]
      have hg1_lip : ∀ z ∈ B_s,
          ‖dslope hp_fn (s_minus p) z - dslope hp_fn (s_minus p) (s_plus p)‖ ≤
            (‖c₀‖ / 2) * ‖z - s_plus p‖ := by
        intro z hz
        rw [hg1_int z hz, hg1_int (s_plus p) hsp_Bs]
        have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u : ℝ => deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)))
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
          (hd1_holo.continuousOn.comp
            (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).continuousOn
            (hseg z hz)).intervalIntegrable
        have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun u : ℝ => deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (s_plus p - s_minus p)))
            MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
          (hd1_holo.continuousOn.comp
            (continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).continuousOn
            (hseg (s_plus p) hsp_Bs)).intervalIntegrable
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint1 hint2]
        have hbound : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            ‖deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)) -
              deriv hp_fn (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (s_plus p - s_minus p))‖ ≤
              (‖c₀‖ / 2) * ‖z - s_plus p‖ := by
          intro u hu
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hu
          have hu_mem : u ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
            rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]; exact ⟨le_of_lt hu.1, hu.2⟩
          have hmvt := (convex_ball z₀ r_s).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
            (fun w hw => hd1_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw))
            hhp_d2_bnd (hseg (s_plus p) hsp_Bs u hu_mem) (hseg z hz u hu_mem)
          have hnorm_diff :
              ‖(s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)) -
                (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (s_plus p - s_minus p))‖ =
                u * ‖z - s_plus p‖ := by
            rw [show (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (z - s_minus p)) -
                (s_minus p + (u : ℂ) * (s_plus p - s_minus p)) = (u : ℂ) * (z - s_plus p) by ring,
              norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hu.1]
          rw [hnorm_diff] at hmvt
          have hu_le : u * ‖z - s_plus p‖ ≤ 1 * ‖z - s_plus p‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu.2 (norm_nonneg _)
          exact le_trans hmvt (by nlinarith [hM_nonneg])
        have hint_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
        simpa using hint_le
      have hQ_tilde_le : ‖dslope (dslope hp_fn (s_minus p)) (s_plus p) s‖ ≤ ‖c₀‖ / 2 := by
        by_cases hne : s = s_plus p
        · rw [hne, dslope_same]
          refine norm_deriv_le_of_lip' hM_nonneg ?_
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hsp_Bs] with z hz
          exact hg1_lip z hz
        · rw [dslope_of_ne _ hne, slope_def_field, norm_div]
          exact (div_le_iff₀ (norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne))).mpr (hg1_lip s hs)
      have hQ_ne : Q_inc s p ≠ 0 := by
        intro hQ0
        have heq_neg : dslope (dslope hp_fn (s_minus p)) (s_plus p) s = -c₀ :=
          eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hQ0
        rw [heq_neg, norm_neg] at hQ_tilde_le
        linarith [hc₀_pos]
      exact ⟨hQ_ne, hfactor⟩
    · 
      intro B F hB_open hB_sub hF_holo hHyp q hq ι
      have hB_wide : B ⊆ D_wide := hB_sub.trans (hD_env_sub_D0.trans hD_0_sub_wide)
      have hq_env : q ∈ D_env := hB_sub hq
      have hq_wide : q ∈ D_wide := hB_wide hq
      obtain ⟨hW2_ne, hW0_fac, hW1_fac, hRes0⟩ := hHyp q hq
      have hReflect := (hUnifiedReflect B F hB_open hB_wide hF_holo
        (fun q' hq' => ⟨(hHyp q' hq').2.1, (hHyp q' hq').2.2.1⟩) q hq).2 ι
      rw [hRes0 ι] at hReflect
      obtain ⟨_, hr_ψ_ne, hdψ_ne⟩ := hD_env_δ3 q hq_env
      obtain ⟨hb0, hb1, _, hbt⟩ := hD_wide_bounds q hq_wide
      have hp₀_ne : glancingOffset C q.1 q.2 ≠ 0 := hDet.offset_ne_zero q.1 q.2 hb0 hbt
      have hp₁_ne : glancingOffset C (q.1 + q.2) q.2 ≠ 0 :=
        hDet.offset_ne_zero (q.1 + q.2) q.2 hb1 hbt
      have hpref_ne :
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F 2 q *
            ((homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F 2 q ^ 2 * r_ℂ (ψ_plus q) *
                iterDerivYT 1 0 ψ_plus q) ^ 2 *
              glancingOffset C (q.1 + q.2) q.2 / glancingOffset C q.1 q.2) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero hW2_ne
          (div_ne_zero
            (mul_ne_zero
              (pow_ne_zero 2 (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hW2_ne) hr_ψ_ne) hdψ_ne))
              hp₁_ne)
            hp₀_ne)
      have hsub_zero : dualLineShift C 1 ι q - F ι q = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hReflect.symm).resolve_left hpref_ne
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hsub_zero).symm
  exact ⟨{
    dualLine_even := hDualLineEven
    symJet_neg_t := fun q_idx neg_idx M p hneg ht hsh v =>
      hSymJetNegT q_idx neg_idx M p hneg ht hsh v
    primary_rank_one := hPrimaryRankOne
    primary_reflect := hPrimaryReflect
    primary_w2_ne_zero := hPrimaryW2
    primary_not_isotropic_line := hPrimaryNotIso
    primary_step_distinct := hPrimaryStep
    envelope_quad_factor := hEnvelopeQuadFactor
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have hK_cont : ZeroAvoidingRootContKit :=
    zero_avoiding_preconnected_and_root_detour hKit
  obtain ⟨E_base⟩ :=
    endpoint_jet_clearing_and_glancing_bidisk Ω C hDet W hKit D_wall.K N_idx q_idx
  obtain ⟨Top⟩ :=
    wall_loop_top_branch_and_monodromy_transfer Ω C hDet W hKit t₂ D_wall N_idx q_idx
      hq_unaligned hK_cont
  obtain ⟨Vert⟩ :=
    vertical_chart_chain_ascent_descent Ω C hDet W hKit t₂ D_wall.H₂ D_wall.x_star
      D_wall.K N_idx q_idx D_wall.t₂_mem D_wall.h_L_eq_H₂ D_wall.H₂_ge hK_cont E_base
      Top.ρ Top.r_anchor Top.H_top_guard Top.ρ_pos Top.ρ_lt Top.r_anchor_pos
      Top.anchor_in_chart Top.guard_holo Top.guard_witness Top.guard_den_ne_zero
  have hM₁_top_solves :
      ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        ∀ p ∈ { p ∈ Metric.ball (wallAnchorPt D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ Top.ρ t₂) Top.r_anchor |
                  Top.H_top_guard p ≠ 0 },
          ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι)
                (wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ Top.ρ t₂ 0)
                (wallAnchorField W D_wall.x_star D_wall.H₂ Top.ρ t₂
                  (wallBridgeB D_wall.K : ℤ)) p)
              (E_base.Q_det ι d) *
            (Top.M₁_top ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 :=
    fun ι => Top.loop_root_transfer (E_base.M_det ι) (E_base.D_det ι) ι (E_base.Q_det ι)
      (Vert.primary_solves_at_anchor ι)
  obtain ⟨V_init, r_end, M₁_end, hV_init_open, hV_init_ne, hV_init_sub, hr_end_pos,
      hball_end_sub, hM₁_end_holo, hM₁_end_solves, hM₁_ne_primary,
      hDesc_rk, hDesc_rf, hDesc_w2, hDesc_iso, hDesc_prev, hDesc_poly⟩ :=
    Vert.descend_branch Top.M₁_top Top.M₁_top_holo hM₁_top_solves Top.M₁_top_ne_primary
  let S_sym : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs
  let J_sym : ℝ := (S_sym : ℝ) + 2
  let S_all : ℕ := (wallAllShifts D_wall.K q_idx).sup (fun q : ℤ => q.natAbs)
  have hJ_sym_eq : J_sym = (S_sym : ℝ) + 2 := rfl
  have hS_sym_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (S_sym : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg S_sym
  have hJ_sym_ge_two : (2 : ℝ) ≤ J_sym := by linarith
  have h2J_sym_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * J_sym := by linarith
  have hS_le : S_sym ≤ S_all := by
    refine Finset.sup_le (fun a _ => ?_)
    have hmem_un : q_idx a ∈ wallUnalignedShifts D_wall.K q_idx :=
      Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_idx (Finset.mem_univ a))
    have hmem_all : q_idx a ∈ wallAllShifts D_wall.K q_idx :=
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hmem_un
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun q : ℤ => q.natAbs) hmem_all
  have hJ_le : J_sym ≤ wallAllJBound D_wall.K q_idx := by
    have hcast : (S_sym : ℝ) ≤ (S_all : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hS_le
    change (S_sym : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (S_all : ℝ) + 2
    linarith
  have h2J_all_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * wallAllJBound D_wall.K q_idx := by linarith
  have hUni_sub_sym :
      wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base D_wall.K q_idx ⊆
        symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩
    refine ⟨hp1, hp2, lt_of_lt_of_le hp3 ?_⟩
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt W.s_base_pos) h2J_sym_pos (by linarith)
  have hU_uni_open : IsOpen (wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base D_wall.K q_idx) := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ (IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const
  have hU_uni_ne : (wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base D_wall.K q_idx).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), ?_⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.zero_im, abs_zero]
      linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    · simpa only [norm_zero] using W.r_base_pos
    · simp only [Complex.zero_im, abs_zero]
      exact div_pos W.s_base_pos h2J_all_pos
  have hU_sym_open : IsOpen (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ (IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const
  have h_lin_lt : ∀ (x y M : ℝ), |x| < M → |y| < M →
      ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → |a * x + b * y| < M := by
    intro x y M hx hy a b ha hb hab
    have htri : |a * x + b * y| ≤ a * |x| + b * |y| := by
      calc |a * x + b * y| ≤ |a * x| + |b * y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |x| + b * |y| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp only [zero_add] at hab
      subst hab
      linarith
    · have h1 : a * |x| < a * M := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx ha_pos
      have h2 : b * |y| ≤ b * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hy) hb
      have h3 : a * M + b * M = M := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      linarith
  have hU_sym_convex : Convex ℝ (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩
    rcases hq with ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have him : (a • p + b • q).1.im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im := by
        change (a • p.1 + b • q.1).im = a * p.1.im + b * q.1.im
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him]
      exact h_lin_lt p.1.im q.1.im (W.s_base / 2) hp1 hq1 a b ha hb hab
    · change ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ < W.r_base
      have htri : ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
        calc ‖a • p.2 + b • q.2‖ ≤ ‖a • p.2‖ + ‖b • q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = a * ‖p.2‖ + b * ‖q.2‖ := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp only [zero_add] at hab
        subst hab
        linarith
      · have h1 : a * ‖p.2‖ < a * W.r_base := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp2 ha_pos
        have h2 : b * ‖q.2‖ ≤ b * W.r_base := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq2) hb
        have h3 : a * W.r_base + b * W.r_base = W.r_base := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
        linarith
    · have him : (a • p + b • q).2.im = a * p.2.im + b * q.2.im := by
        change (a • p.2 + b • q.2).im = a * p.2.im + b * q.2.im
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him]
      exact h_lin_lt p.2.im q.2.im (W.s_base / (2 * J_sym)) hp3 hq3 a b ha hb hab
  have hU_sym_preconn : IsPreconnected (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) :=
    hU_sym_convex.isPreconnected
  have hDual_holo_sym : ∀ (q : ℤ), |(q : ℝ)| ≤ J_sym → ∀ c : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C q c)
        (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro q hq_le c
    have hAff_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q : ℂ) * r.2, r.2)) :=
      (differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const _).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
        differentiable_snd
    have hAff_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q : ℂ) * r.2, r.2))
        (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)
        { w : ℂ × ℂ | |w.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖w.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } := by
      intro r ⟨hr1, hr2, hr3⟩
      have hr3_mul : |r.2.im| * (2 * J_sym) < W.s_base :=
        (lt_div_iff₀ h2J_sym_pos).mp hr3
      have hJ_im : J_sym * |r.2.im| < W.s_base / 2 := by linarith
      have hq_im : |((q : ℂ) * r.2).im| < W.s_base / 2 := by
        have him_eq : ((q : ℂ) * r.2).im = (q : ℝ) * r.2.im := by
          simp [Complex.mul_im]
        rw [him_eq, abs_mul]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq_le (abs_nonneg _)) hJ_im
      have h_add : |(r.1 + (q : ℂ) * r.2).im| ≤ |r.1.im| + |((q : ℂ) * r.2).im| := by
        simpa only [Complex.add_im] using abs_add_le r.1.im ((q : ℂ) * r.2).im
      exact ⟨by linarith [W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos],
        by linarith [W.r_base_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ
      ((fun w : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C w.1 w.2 c) ∘
        (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q : ℂ) * r.2, r.2)))
      (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)
    exact (hDet.dualLine_holo c).comp hAff_diff.differentiableOn hAff_maps
  have hDual0_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C 0 c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) :=
    fun c => hDual_holo_sym 0 (by norm_num; linarith) c
  have hDual1_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C 1 c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) :=
    fun c => hDual_holo_sym 1 (by norm_num; linarith) c
  have hDualNeg1_holo : ∀ c : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C (-1) c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) :=
    fun c => hDual_holo_sym (-1) (by norm_num; linarith) c
  have hHomInt_holo : ∀ {E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      (∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (E c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)) →
      (∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)) →
      ∀ k : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (homIntersect E F k) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro E F hE hF k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (hF 1).sub (hE 1)
    · exact (hE 0).sub (hF 0)
    · exact ((hE 0).mul (hF 1)).sub ((hE 1).mul (hF 0))
  have hJet_holo_sym : ∀ (M : ℕ) (v : SymJetVar N_idx M),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => symJetEnv C q_idx M q v)
        (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro M v
    have hv_nat : (q_idx v.1).natAbs ≤ S_sym :=
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun b : Fin N_idx => (q_idx b).natAbs) (Finset.mem_univ v.1)
    have hv_cast : (((q_idx v.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (S_sym : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hv_nat
    have hv_abs : |(q_idx v.1 : ℝ)| = (((q_idx v.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rcases Int.natAbs_eq (q_idx v.1) with h | h
      · have hR := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) h
        rw [Int.cast_natCast] at hR
        rw [hR, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
      · have hR := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) h
        rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at hR
        rw [hR, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
    have hv_le : |(q_idx v.1 : ℝ)| ≤ J_sym := by linarith
    exact hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hU_sym_open (hDual_holo_sym (q_idx v.1) hv_le v.2.1)
      v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
  have hEval_holo_sym : ∀ (M : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
