proof.tactics:
by
  have hSepCont : SeparableRectRootContProp := separable_poly_rect_root_continuation
  obtain ⟨B_cr⟩ := base_collar_and_cramer_data Ω C
  obtain ⟨G⟩ :=
    puiseux_log_cover_and_removable_germ Ω C hDet W hKit hSepCont t₂ D_wall N_idx q_idx B_col Br
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := wronskian_tau_reduction_and_regular_slice Ω C hDet W hKit t₂ D_wall N_idx q_idx Br G
  obtain ⟨T⟩ :=
    rank_one_arc_factorization_and_transversality Ω C hDet W hKit B_cr t₂ D_wall N_idx q_idx
      B_col Br G R

  
  let s₀ : ℂ := (T.y₂ : ℂ)
  let q₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (s₀, (0 : ℂ))
  let U_col : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Br.r_t
  have hU_col_open : IsOpen U_col := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have h_ball_s_yp : Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp :=
    Set.Subset.trans T.ball_y₂_s_sub R.ball_y₁_sub
  have h_ball_s_ry : Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y :=
    Set.Subset.trans h_ball_s_yp (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [G.r_yp_le, Br.r_y_pos]))
  have hU_col_sub_dom : U_col ⊆ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx :=
    Set.Subset.trans (Set.prod_mono h_ball_s_ry Set.Subset.rfl) Br.bidisk_sub_dom
  have hDom_bounds : ∀ q ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx,
      |q.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖q.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det := by
    intro q hq
    exact ⟨by linarith [hq.1, W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos],
      by linarith [hq.2.1, W.r_base_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
  let L₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := dualLineShift C 0
  have hL₀_eq : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (q : ℂ × ℂ), L₀ ι q = glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 ι := by
    intro ι q
    change glancingDualLine C (q.1 + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 ι = glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 ι
    have h0 : q.1 + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * q.2 = q.1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h0]
  have hL₀_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L₀ ι) U_col := by
    intro ι
    have hfn : L₀ ι = fun q : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 ι := by
      ext q; exact hL₀_eq ι q
    rw [hfn]
    exact (hDet.dualLine_holo ι).mono (fun q hq => hDom_bounds q (hU_col_sub_dom hq))
  have hL₀_even : ∀ q ∈ U_col, ∀ ι : Fin 2, L₀ ι (q.1, -q.2) = L₀ ι q := by
    intro q hq ι
    rw [hL₀_eq, hL₀_eq]
    have hb := hDom_bounds q (hU_col_sub_dom hq)
    exact B_col.dualLine_even q.1 q.2 hb.1 hb.2 ι
  have hq₀_mem_U_col : q₀ ∈ U_col :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self T.δ_s_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self Br.r_t_pos⟩
  have hL₀_sq_ne_zero : (L₀ 0 q₀) ^ 2 + (L₀ 1 q₀) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hL₀_eq, hL₀_eq]
    have hs₀_im : |s₀.im| < 2 * W.s_base := by
      simp only [s₀, Complex.ofReal_im, abs_zero]
      linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    have h0_norm : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ < 2 * W.r_base := by
      rw [norm_zero]; linarith [W.r_base_pos]
    have hoff_ne : glancingOffset C s₀ 0 ≠ 0 := W.offset_ne_zero s₀ 0 hs₀_im h0_norm
    have hcs : Complex.cos (glancingTheta C s₀ 0) ^ 2 +
        Complex.sin (glancingTheta C s₀ 0) ^ 2 = 1 :=
      Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (glancingTheta C s₀ 0)
    have hsum :
        (glancingDualLine C s₀ 0 0) ^ 2 + (glancingDualLine C s₀ 0 1) ^ 2 =
          (glancingOffset C s₀ 0 ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      field_simp [hoff_ne]
      exact hcs
    rw [hsum]
    exact inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hoff_ne)

  
  let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.fst
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_fst }
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.snd
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_snd }
  let j₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun z => (z, 0)
          map_add' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp)
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp) }
      cont := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
  let j₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun z => (0, z)
          map_add' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext (by simp) rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext (by simp) rfl }
      cont := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id }
  have hStrict2D : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_col →
      ∀ q_s ∈ U_col,
        HasStrictFDerivAt g (pderivA g q_s • π₁ + pderivD g q_s • π₂) q_s := by
    intro g hg q_s hq_s
    obtain ⟨hpA_holo, hpD_holo⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hU_col_open hg
    have hpA_cont : ContinuousAt (pderivA g) q_s :=
      hpA_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU_col_open.mem_nhds hq_s)
    have hpD_cont : ContinuousAt (pderivD g) q_s :=
      hpD_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU_col_open.mem_nhds hq_s)
    have hfderiv_on : ∀ q ∈ U_col,
        HasFDerivAt g (pderivA g q • π₁ + pderivD g q • π₂) q := by
      intro q hq
      have hgd : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q :=
        (hg.differentiableAt (hU_col_open.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hι₁ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) (1, 0) q.1 := by
        simpa [j₁] using (j₁.hasDerivAt (x := q.1)).add_const ((0 : ℂ), q.2)
      have hι₂ : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (q.1, z)) (0, 1) q.2 := by
        simpa [j₂] using (j₂.hasDerivAt (x := q.2)).add_const (q.1, (0 : ℂ))
      have hpA : pderivA g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0) :=
        (hgd.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hι₁).deriv
      have hpD : pderivD g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1) :=
        (hgd.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hι₂).deriv
      have hu_decomp : ∀ u : ℂ × ℂ,
          u = u.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + u.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        intro u
        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
        · change u.1 = u.1 * 1 + u.2 * 0; ring
        · change u.2 = u.1 * 0 + u.2 * 1; ring
      have h_eq : fderiv ℂ g q = pderivA g q • π₁ + pderivD g q • π₂ := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun u => ?_)
        conv_lhs => rw [hu_decomp u]
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, ← hpA, ← hpD]
        change u.1 * pderivA g q + u.2 * pderivD g q =
          pderivA g q * u.1 + pderivD g q * u.2
        ring
      rwa [← h_eq]
    have h_ev : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q_s, HasFDerivAt g (pderivA g q • π₁ + pderivD g q • π₂) q :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_col_open.mem_nhds hq_s) hfderiv_on
    have h_cont : ContinuousAt (fun q => pderivA g q • π₁ + pderivD g q • π₂) q_s :=
      (hpA_cont.smul continuousAt_const).add (hpD_cont.smul continuousAt_const)
    exact hasStrictFDerivAt_of_hasFDerivAt_of_continuousAt h_ev h_cont

  let p_q : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.fst
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_fst }
  let p_z : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := Prod.snd
          map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
      cont := continuous_snd }
  let ι₀_CLM : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
    { toLinearMap :=
        { toFun := fun q => (q, 0)
          map_add' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp)
          map_smul' := fun _ _ => Prod.ext rfl (by simp) }
      cont := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
  let F_inc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun q s => L₀ 0 q * T.Z_zero 0 s + L₀ 1 q * T.Z_zero 1 s - 1
  let Fz_inc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun q s => L₀ 0 q * deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s + L₀ 1 q * deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s
  let Φ_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ := fun x => (x.1, F_inc x.1 x.2)
  have hZ_zero_deriv_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (T.Z_zero ι)) (Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) :=
    fun ι => (T.Z_zero_holo ι).deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hΦ_strict : ∀ q ∈ U_col, ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s, Fz_inc q s ≠ 0 →
      ∃ L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ),
        HasStrictFDerivAt Φ_fn (L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) (q, s) := by
    intro q hq s hs hlam
    let dL₀ : Fin 2 → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      fun ι => pderivA (L₀ ι) q • π₁ + pderivD (L₀ ι) q • π₂
    let L_q : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := T.Z_zero 0 s • dL₀ 0 + T.Z_zero 1 s • dL₀ 1
    let lam : ℂ := Fz_inc q s
    let L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.mk
        { toFun := fun x => (x.1, L_q x.1 + lam * x.2)
          invFun := fun y => (y.1, lam⁻¹ * (y.2 - L_q y.1))
          left_inv := fun ⟨u, w⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [add_sub_cancel_left, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hlam])
          right_inv := fun ⟨u, v⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hlam, add_sub_cancel])
          map_add' := fun ⟨u₁, w₁⟩ ⟨u₂, w₂⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by dsimp; rw [map_add]; ring)
          map_smul' := fun c ⟨u, w⟩ =>
            Prod.ext rfl (by
              change L_q (c • u) + lam * (c * w) = c * (L_q u + lam * w)
              rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
              ring) }
        (continuous_fst.prodMk
          ((L_q.continuous.comp continuous_fst).add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)))
        (continuous_fst.prodMk
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_snd.sub (L_q.continuous.comp continuous_fst))))
    have hL_st : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => L₀ ι x.1)
          ((dL₀ ι).comp p_q) (q, s) :=
      fun ι => (hStrict2D (L₀ ι) (hL₀_holo ι) q hq).comp (q, s) (p_q.hasStrictFDerivAt)
    have hZ_st : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        HasStrictFDerivAt (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => T.Z_zero ι x.2)
          (deriv (T.Z_zero ι) s • p_z) (q, s) := fun ι =>
      (((T.Z_zero_holo ι).analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs)).hasStrictDerivAt).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt
        (q, s) p_z.hasStrictFDerivAt
    have hF_st :=
      (((hL_st 0).mul (hZ_st 0)).add ((hL_st 1).mul (hZ_st 1))).sub
        (hasStrictFDerivAt_const (1 : ℂ) (q, s))
    have hΦ_raw := (p_q.hasStrictFDerivAt (x := (q, s))).prodMk hF_st
    have h_clm_eq :
        p_q.prod
          ((L₀ 0 q • (deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s • p_z) + T.Z_zero 0 s • ((dL₀ 0).comp p_q) +
            (L₀ 1 q • (deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s • p_z) + T.Z_zero 1 s • ((dL₀ 1).comp p_q))) - 0) =
        (L_Φ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun ⟨u, w⟩ => ?_)
      refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
      change (L₀ 0 q * (deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s * w) + T.Z_zero 0 s * dL₀ 0 u +
        (L₀ 1 q * (deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s * w) + T.Z_zero 1 s * dL₀ 1 u)) - 0 =
        (T.Z_zero 0 s * dL₀ 0 u + T.Z_zero 1 s * dL₀ 1 u) +
          (L₀ 0 q * deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s + L₀ 1 q * deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s) * w
      ring
    refine ⟨L_Φ, ?_⟩
    rw [← h_clm_eq]
    exact hΦ_raw

  have hs₀_mem : s₀ ∈ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s := Metric.mem_ball_self T.δ_s_pos
  have hF_q₀s₀ : F_inc q₀ s₀ = 0 := by
    dsimp [F_inc, L₀, q₀, s₀]
    rw [T.Z_zero_incidence_zero (T.y₂ : ℂ) hs₀_mem, sub_self]
  have hFz_q₀s₀ : Fz_inc q₀ s₀ ≠ 0 := T.Z_zero_transverse_at
  obtain ⟨L_Φ₀, hf₀⟩ := hΦ_strict q₀ hq₀_mem_U_col s₀ hs₀_mem hFz_q₀s₀
  have hΦ_pt₀ : Φ_fn (q₀, s₀) = (q₀, 0) := Prod.ext rfl hF_q₀s₀
  obtain ⟨e, he_coe, hx_src, hy_tgt⟩ :
      ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ),
        (e : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) = Φ_fn ∧
        (q₀, s₀) ∈ e.source ∧
        (q₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ e.target :=
    ⟨hf₀.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Φ_fn,
     hf₀.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe,
     hf₀.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source,
     hΦ_pt₀ ▸ hf₀.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target⟩
  have he_symm_pt : e.symm (q₀, 0) = (q₀, s₀) := by
    have h_eq : e (q₀, s₀) = (q₀, 0) := by rw [he_coe]; exact hΦ_pt₀
    rw [← h_eq]
    exact e.left_inv hx_src
  have hFz_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => Fz_inc x.1 x.2)
      (U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) := by
    have hL0c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => L₀ 0 x.1) (U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) :=
      (hL₀_holo 0).continuousOn.comp continuousOn_fst (fun _ hx => hx.1)
    have hL1c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => L₀ 1 x.1) (U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) :=
      (hL₀_holo 1).continuousOn.comp continuousOn_fst (fun _ hx => hx.1)
    have hZ0c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => deriv (T.Z_zero 0) x.2)
        (U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) :=
      (hZ_zero_deriv_holo 0).continuousOn.comp continuousOn_snd (fun _ hx => hx.2)
    have hZ1c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => deriv (T.Z_zero 1) x.2)
        (U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) :=
      (hZ_zero_deriv_holo 1).continuousOn.comp continuousOn_snd (fun _ hx => hx.2)
    exact (hL0c.mul hZ0c).add (hL1c.mul hZ1c)
  let O_src : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
    ((U_col ×ˢ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s) ∩ (fun x => Fz_inc x.1 x.2) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) ∩ e.source
  have hO_src_open : IsOpen O_src :=
    (hFz_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage (hU_col_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
      isOpen_compl_singleton).inter e.open_source
  obtain ⟨δ_src, hδ_src_pos, hδ_src_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO_src_open (q₀, s₀) ⟨⟨⟨hq₀_mem_U_col, hs₀_mem⟩, hFz_q₀s₀⟩, hx_src⟩
  let δ'_s : ℝ := min δ_src T.δ_s
  have hδ'_s_pos : 0 < δ'_s := lt_min hδ_src_pos T.δ_s_pos
  have hδ'_s_le : δ'_s ≤ T.δ_s := min_le_right _ _
  have hδ'_s_sub : Metric.ball (q₀, s₀) δ'_s ⊆ O_src :=
    Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)) hδ_src_sub
  have h_tgt_nhds : e.target ∩ e.symm ⁻¹' Metric.ball (q₀, s₀) δ'_s ∈ nhds (q₀, (0 : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.inter_mem (e.open_target.mem_nhds hy_tgt)
      ((e.continuousAt_symm hy_tgt).preimage_mem_nhds
        (he_symm_pt.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds (q₀, s₀) hδ'_s_pos))
  have h_q_nhds :
      (ι₀_CLM ⁻¹' (e.target ∩ e.symm ⁻¹' Metric.ball (q₀, s₀) δ'_s)) ∩
        Metric.ball q₀ δ'_s ∈ nhds q₀ :=
    Filter.inter_mem (ι₀_CLM.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds h_tgt_nhds)
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds q₀ hδ'_s_pos)
  obtain ⟨δ_q_raw, hδ_q_raw_pos, hδ_q_raw_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_q_nhds
  let δ_tr : ℝ := min δ_q_raw (min T.δ₂ (Br.r_t / 2))
  have hδ_tr_pos : 0 < δ_tr :=
    lt_min hδ_q_raw_pos (lt_min T.δ₂_pos (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos]))
  let B_tr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₀ δ_tr ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_tr
  have hB_tr_eq_ball : B_tr = Metric.ball q₀ δ_tr := ball_prod_same s₀ 0 δ_tr
  have hB_tr_open : IsOpen B_tr := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hB_tr_sub_U_col : B_tr ⊆ U_col := by
    refine Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_) (Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_)
    · exact le_trans (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) T.δ₂_le_s
    · have : δ_tr ≤ Br.r_t / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      linarith [Br.r_t_pos]
  let s_trans : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => p_z (e.symm (ι₀_CLM q))
  have hs_trans_props : ∀ q ∈ B_tr,
      e.symm (ι₀_CLM q) = (q, s_trans q) ∧
      s_trans q ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ'_s ∧
      F_inc q (s_trans q) = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_raw : q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ δ_q_raw :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hB_tr_eq_ball ▸ hq)
    obtain ⟨⟨hq_tgt, hq_symm_ball⟩, _⟩ := hδ_q_raw_sub hq_raw
    have h_rinv : Φ_fn (e.symm (ι₀_CLM q)) = ι₀_CLM q := by
      rw [← he_coe]
      exact e.right_inv hq_tgt
    have h_fst : (e.symm (ι₀_CLM q)).1 = q := congr_arg Prod.fst h_rinv
    have h_snd : F_inc (e.symm (ι₀_CLM q)).1 (s_trans q) = 0 := congr_arg Prod.snd h_rinv
    rw [h_fst] at h_snd
    rw [← ball_prod_same] at hq_symm_ball
    exact ⟨Prod.ext h_fst rfl, hq_symm_ball.2, h_snd⟩
  have hs_trans_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_trans B_tr := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_raw : q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ δ_q_raw :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hB_tr_eq_ball ▸ hq)
    obtain ⟨⟨hq_tgt, hq_symm_ball⟩, _⟩ := hδ_q_raw_sub hq_raw
    obtain ⟨he_symm_eq, _, _⟩ := hs_trans_props q hq
    have h_in_O : (q, s_trans q) ∈ O_src := hδ'_s_sub (he_symm_eq ▸ hq_symm_ball)
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hq_U, hs_U⟩, hFz_ne⟩, _⟩ := h_in_O
    obtain ⟨L_eqv, hf_q⟩ := hΦ_strict q hq_U (s_trans q) hs_U hFz_ne
    have hf_e : HasStrictFDerivAt e
        (L_eqv : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) (e.symm (ι₀_CLM q)) := by
      rwa [he_coe, he_symm_eq]
    have h_symm_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ e.symm (ι₀_CLM q) :=
      (e.hasStrictFDerivAt_symm hq_tgt hf_e).differentiableAt
    exact ((p_z.differentiableAt.comp (ι₀_CLM q) h_symm_diff).comp
      q ι₀_CLM.differentiableAt).differentiableWithinAt
  have hs_trans_q₀ : s_trans q₀ = s₀ := by
    change (e.symm (q₀, 0)).2 = s₀
    rw [he_symm_pt]
  have hs_trans_uniq : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ'_s,
      F_inc q s = 0 → s = s_trans q := by
    intro q hq s hs_ball hs_sol
    have hq_raw : q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ δ_q_raw :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hB_tr_eq_ball ▸ hq)
    have hq_b : q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ δ'_s := (hδ_q_raw_sub hq_raw).2
    have hqs_ball : (q, s) ∈ Metric.ball (q₀, s₀) δ'_s := by
      rw [← ball_prod_same]
      exact ⟨hq_b, hs_ball⟩
    have hqs_src : (q, s) ∈ e.source := (hδ'_s_sub hqs_ball).2
    have he_qs : e (q, s) = ι₀_CLM q := by
      rw [he_coe]
      exact Prod.ext rfl hs_sol
    have h_linv : e.symm (e (q, s)) = (q, s) := e.left_inv hqs_src
    rw [he_qs] at h_linv
    exact (congr_arg Prod.snd h_linv).symm

  
  have hB_tr_neg : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, (q.1, -q.2) ∈ B_tr := by
    intro q hq
    exact ⟨hq.1, by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_neg] using hq.2⟩
  have hs_trans_even : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, s_trans (q.1, -q.2) = s_trans q := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_neg : (q.1, -q.2) ∈ B_tr := hB_tr_neg q hq
    obtain ⟨_, hs_mem, hF_sol⟩ := hs_trans_props q hq
    have hF_neg : F_inc (q.1, -q.2) (s_trans q) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [F_inc] at hF_sol ⊢
      rw [hL₀_even q (hB_tr_sub_U_col hq) 0, hL₀_even q (hB_tr_sub_U_col hq) 1]
      exact hF_sol
    exact (hs_trans_uniq (q.1, -q.2) hq_neg (s_trans q) hs_mem hF_neg).symm

  have hd_ne_zero : G.d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt G.d_pos
  have h0_pow_d : (0 : ℂ) ^ G.d = 0 := zero_pow hd_ne_zero
  let powMap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, p.2 ^ G.d)
  have hpowMap_cont : Continuous powMap :=
    continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.pow G.d)
  have hq₀_in_B₂ : q₀ ∈ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T.δ₂ :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self T.δ₂_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self T.δ₂_pos⟩
  have hσ_cont_q₀ : ContinuousAt T.σ q₀ :=
    T.σ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hq₀_in_B₂)
  have hσ_q₀ : T.σ q₀ = s₀ := T.σ_at_zero s₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self T.δ₂_pos)
  have hpow_q₀ : powMap q₀ = q₀ := Prod.ext rfl h0_pow_d
  have hq₀_B_tr : q₀ ∈ B_tr :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_tr_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_tr_pos⟩
  have hτ_nhds :
      (Metric.ball s₀ T.δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T.δ₂) ∩
        powMap ⁻¹' B_tr ∩ T.σ ⁻¹' Metric.ball s₀ δ'_s ∈ nhds q₀ :=
    Filter.inter_mem
      (Filter.inter_mem
        ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hq₀_in_B₂)
        (hpowMap_cont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hpow_q₀.symm ▸ hB_tr_open.mem_nhds hq₀_B_tr)))
      (hσ_cont_q₀.preimage_mem_nhds (hσ_q₀.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδ'_s_pos))
  obtain ⟨δ_τ_raw, hδ_τ_raw_pos, hδ_τ_raw_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hτ_nhds
  let δ_τ2 : ℝ := min δ_τ_raw T.δ₂
  have hδ_τ2_pos : 0 < δ_τ2 := lt_min hδ_τ_raw_pos T.δ₂_pos
  let B_τ2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₀ δ_τ2 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_τ2
  have hB_τ2_sub_raw : B_τ2 ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ δ_τ_raw := by
    dsimp only [B_τ2, q₀]
    rw [ball_prod_same]
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
  have hB_τ2_sub_B₂ : B_τ2 ⊆ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T.δ₂ :=
    fun p hp => ((hδ_τ_raw_sub (hB_τ2_sub_raw hp)).1).1
  have hB_τ2_sub_B₁ : B_τ2 ⊆ Metric.ball (R.y₁ : ℂ) R.ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.ρ₁ := by
    intro p hp
    have hp₂ := hB_τ2_sub_B₂ hp
    exact ⟨T.ball_y₂_s_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball T.δ₂_le_s hp₂.1),
      Metric.ball_subset_ball T.δ₂_le_ρ₁ hp₂.2⟩
  have hB_τ2_pow_tr : ∀ p ∈ B_τ2, powMap p ∈ B_tr :=
    fun p hp => ((hδ_τ_raw_sub (hB_τ2_sub_raw hp)).1).2
  have hσ_eq_s_trans : ∀ p ∈ B_τ2, T.σ p = s_trans (powMap p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hσ_mem : T.σ p ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ'_s := (hδ_τ_raw_sub (hB_τ2_sub_raw hp)).2
    have hp₂ := hB_τ2_sub_B₂ hp
    have hp₁ := hB_τ2_sub_B₁ hp
    have hinc := R.Z_incidence p hp₁
    have hF_σ : F_inc (powMap p) (T.σ p) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [F_inc, powMap, L₀]
      rw [← T.Z_eq_comp_σ 0 p hp₂, ← T.Z_eq_comp_σ 1 p hp₂]
      change puisDualLine0 C G.d 0 p * R.Z 0 p + puisDualLine0 C G.d 1 p * R.Z 1 p - 1 = 0
      rw [hinc, sub_self]
    exact hs_trans_uniq (powMap p) (hB_τ2_pow_tr p hp) (T.σ p) hσ_mem hF_σ

  
  let X_tr : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι q => T.Z_zero ι (s_trans q)
  let T_tr : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι q => deriv (T.Z_zero ι) (s_trans q)
  let N_tr0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => T_tr 1 q
  let N_tr1 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => -T_tr 0 q
  let V_tr : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι q =>
    2 * (L₀ 0 q * N_tr0 q + L₀ 1 q * N_tr1 q) * (if ι = 0 then N_tr0 q else N_tr1 q) -
      (N_tr0 q * N_tr0 q + N_tr1 q * N_tr1 q) * L₀ ι q
  let D_tr : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => V_tr 0 q * X_tr 0 q + V_tr 1 q * X_tr 1 q
  have hs_trans_maps_s : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, s_trans q ∈ Metric.ball s₀ T.δ_s :=
    fun q hq => Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ'_s_le (hs_trans_props q hq).2.1
  have hX_tr_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_tr ι) B_tr :=
    fun ι => (T.Z_zero_holo ι).comp hs_trans_holo hs_trans_maps_s
  have hT_tr_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (T_tr ι) B_tr :=
    fun ι => (hZ_zero_deriv_holo ι).comp hs_trans_holo hs_trans_maps_s
  have hV_tr_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (V_tr ι) B_tr := by
    intro ι
    have hL₀_B : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (L₀ j) B_tr :=
      fun j => (hL₀_holo j).mono hB_tr_sub_U_col
    have hN0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tr0 B_tr := hT_tr_holo 1
    have hN1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_tr1 B_tr := (hT_tr_holo 0).neg
    have hdotLN : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => L₀ 0 q * N_tr0 q + L₀ 1 q * N_tr1 q) B_tr :=
      ((hL₀_B 0).mul hN0).add ((hL₀_B 1).mul hN1)
    have hdotNN : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => N_tr0 q * N_tr0 q + N_tr1 q * N_tr1 q) B_tr :=
      (hN0.mul hN0).add (hN1.mul hN1)
    have hNι : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => if ι = 0 then N_tr0 q else N_tr1 q) B_tr := by
      fin_cases ι <;> simp [hN0, hN1]
    exact (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdotLN).mul hNι).sub (hdotNN.mul (hL₀_B ι))
  have hD_tr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_tr B_tr :=
    ((hV_tr_holo 0).mul (hX_tr_holo 0)).add ((hV_tr_holo 1).mul (hX_tr_holo 1))
  have hV_tr_even : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, ∀ ι : Fin 2, V_tr ι (q.1, -q.2) = V_tr ι q := by
    intro q hq ι
    dsimp only [V_tr, N_tr0, N_tr1, T_tr]
    rw [hs_trans_even q hq, hL₀_even q (hB_tr_sub_U_col hq) 0,
      hL₀_even q (hB_tr_sub_U_col hq) 1, hL₀_even q (hB_tr_sub_U_col hq) ι]
  have hD_tr_even : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, D_tr (q.1, -q.2) = D_tr q := by
    intro q hq
    dsimp only [D_tr, X_tr]
    rw [hV_tr_even q hq 0, hV_tr_even q hq 1, hs_trans_even q hq]

  let W₁_puis : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C G.d) G.M_puis
  have hB_τ2_punc_sub_G : ∀ p ∈ B_τ2, p.2 ≠ 0 →
      p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0}) := by
    intro p hp hp2
    have hp₁ := hB_τ2_sub_B₁ hp
    exact ⟨R.ball_y₁_sub hp₁.1, ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball R.ρ₁_le_τ hp₁.2, hp2⟩⟩
  have hW₁_rel : ∀ q ∈ B_τ2, q.2 ≠ 0 →
      W₁_puis 2 q ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ ι : Fin 2, W₁_puis ι.castSucc q = W₁_puis 2 q * T.Z_zero ι (T.σ q) := by
    intro q hq hq2
    have hq₁ := hB_τ2_sub_B₁ hq
    have hq₂ := hB_τ2_sub_B₂ hq
    have hpeq := R.W_tilde_puis_eq q hq₁ hq2
    have hW2_tilde_ne : R.W_tilde 2 q ≠ 0 := R.W_tilde_two_ne_zero q hq₁
    have hpow_m_ne : q.2 ^ R.m_star ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero R.m_star hq2
    have hpow_K_ne : q.2 ^ G.K_p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero G.K_p hq2
    have hW1_2_ne : W₁_puis 2 q ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hmul := hpeq 2
      change q.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 q = q.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis 2 q at hmul
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hmul
      exact mul_ne_zero hpow_m_ne hW2_tilde_ne hmul
    refine ⟨hW1_2_ne, fun ι => ?_⟩
    have hmul_ι : q.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde ι.castSucc q =
        q.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis ι.castSucc q := hpeq ι.castSucc
    have hmul_2 : q.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 q = q.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis 2 q := hpeq 2
    have hZ_eq : R.Z ι q = R.W_tilde ι.castSucc q / R.W_tilde 2 q := R.Z_eq ι q hq₁
    have hW_tilde_ι : R.W_tilde ι.castSucc q = R.W_tilde 2 q * R.Z ι q := by
      rw [hZ_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hW2_tilde_ne]
    rw [hW_tilde_ι] at hmul_ι
    have h_scaled :
        q.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis ι.castSucc q =
          q.2 ^ G.K_p * (W₁_puis 2 q * T.Z_zero ι (T.σ q)) := by
      rw [← T.Z_eq_comp_σ ι q hq₂, ← hmul_ι,
        show q.2 ^ R.m_star * (R.W_tilde 2 q * R.Z ι q) =
          (q.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 q) * R.Z ι q by ring,
        hmul_2]
      ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hpow_K_ne h_scaled

  have hpuisDual0_holo_G : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (puisDualLine0 C G.d ι)
        (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ) := by
    intro ι
    have hfn : puisDualLine0 C G.d ι =
        (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C w.1 w.2 ι) ∘ powMap := by
      ext p
      change L₀ ι (powMap p) = glancingDualLine C p.1 (p.2 ^ G.d) ι
      exact hL₀_eq ι (powMap p)
    rw [hfn]
    have hpow_diff : Differentiable ℂ powMap :=
      differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.pow G.d)
    refine (hDet.dualLine_holo ι).comp hpow_diff.differentiableOn ?_
    intro p hp
    apply hDom_bounds
    apply Br.bidisk_sub_dom
    refine ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [G.r_yp_le, Br.r_y_pos]) hp.1, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_pow]
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < G.r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
    have hpow_lt : ‖p.2‖ ^ G.d < G.r_τ ^ G.d :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ hp2 (norm_nonneg _) hd_ne_zero
    linarith [G.r_τ_pow_lt, Br.r_t_pos]

  have hReflect_eq : ∀ p ∈ B_τ2, p.2 ≠ 0 → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      D_tr (powMap p) * G.M_puis ι p = V_tr ι (powMap p) := by
    intro p hp hp2 ι
    have hp_G := hB_τ2_punc_sub_G p hp hp2
    have hW₁_2_holo_y : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => W₁_puis 2 (y', p.2)) p.1 := by
      let U_punc := Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0})
      have hUp_open : IsOpen U_punc :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
      have hW2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₁_puis 2) U_punc :=
        (((hpuisDual0_holo_G 0).mono (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left)).mul
          (G.M_puis_holo 1)).sub
        (((hpuisDual0_holo_G 1).mono (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left)).mul
          (G.M_puis_holo 0))
      have hemb : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (y', p.2)) p.1 :=
        differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2)
      exact (hW2_holo.differentiableAt (hUp_open.mem_nhds hp_G)).comp p.1 hemb
    have hT_ι : ∀ j : Fin 2,
        W₁_puis 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis j.castSucc) p -
          W₁_puis j.castSucc p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 2) p =
          ((W₁_puis 2 p) ^ 2 * pderivA T.σ p) * T_tr j (powMap p) := by
      intro j
      have hp₂ := hB_τ2_sub_B₂ hp
      have hσ_y_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => T.σ (y', p.2)) p.1 := by
        have hemb : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y' : ℂ => (y', p.2)) p.1 :=
          differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2)
        exact (T.σ_holo.differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hp₂)).comp p.1 hemb
      have hσ_y_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℂ => T.σ (y', p.2)) (pderivA T.σ p) p.1 :=
        hσ_y_diff.hasDerivAt
      have hZ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (T.Z_zero j) (T.σ p) :=
        (T.Z_zero_holo j).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (T.σ_maps_to p hp₂))
      have hcomp_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℂ => T.Z_zero j (T.σ (y', p.2)))
          (deriv (T.Z_zero j) (T.σ p) * pderivA T.σ p) p.1 :=
        hZ_diff.hasDerivAt.comp p.1 hσ_y_deriv
      have hprod_deriv : HasDerivAt
          (fun y' : ℂ => W₁_puis 2 (y', p.2) * T.Z_zero j (T.σ (y', p.2)))
          (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 2) p * T.Z_zero j (T.σ p) +
            W₁_puis 2 p * (deriv (T.Z_zero j) (T.σ p) * pderivA T.σ p)) p.1 :=
        hW₁_2_holo_y.hasDerivAt.mul hcomp_deriv
      have hev_eq : (fun y' : ℂ => W₁_puis j.castSucc (y', p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
          (fun y' : ℂ => W₁_puis 2 (y', p.2) * T.Z_zero j (T.σ (y', p.2))) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp.1] with y' hy'
        exact (hW₁_rel (y', p.2) ⟨hy', hp.2⟩ hp2).2 j
      have hder_idx : iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis j.castSucc) p =
          iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 2) p * T.Z_zero j (T.σ p) +
            W₁_puis 2 p * (deriv (T.Z_zero j) (T.σ p) * pderivA T.σ p) :=
        (hprod_deriv.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_eq).deriv
      have hval_idx : W₁_puis j.castSucc p = W₁_puis 2 p * T.Z_zero j (T.σ p) :=
        (hW₁_rel p hp hp2).2 j
      rw [hder_idx, hval_idx]
      dsimp only [T_tr]
      rw [← hσ_eq_s_trans p hp]
      ring
    have hT0 : W₁_puis 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 0) p -
        W₁_puis 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 2) p =
        ((W₁_puis 2 p) ^ 2 * pderivA T.σ p) * T_tr 0 (powMap p) := hT_ι 0
    have hT1 : W₁_puis 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 1) p -
        W₁_puis 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W₁_puis 2) p =
        ((W₁_puis 2 p) ^ 2 * pderivA T.σ p) * T_tr 1 (powMap p) := hT_ι 1
    have h1_ne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
    obtain ⟨hW1_2_ne, hW1_vals⟩ := hW₁_rel p hp hp2
    have hW1_0 : W₁_puis 0 p = W₁_puis 2 p * X_tr 0 (powMap p) := by
      have h0 := hW1_vals 0
      change W₁_puis 0 p = W₁_puis 2 p * T.Z_zero 0 (T.σ p) at h0
      simpa only [X_tr, ← hσ_eq_s_trans p hp] using h0
    have hW1_1 : W₁_puis 1 p = W₁_puis 2 p * X_tr 1 (powMap p) := by
      have h1 := hW1_vals 1
      change W₁_puis 1 p = W₁_puis 2 p * T.Z_zero 1 (T.σ p) at h1
      simpa only [X_tr, ← hσ_eq_s_trans p hp] using h1
    have hres0 := G.puis_reflect p hp_G ι
    let μ : ℂ := (W₁_puis 2 p) ^ 2 * pderivA T.σ p
    have hμ_ne : μ ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hW1_2_ne) (T.σ_pderivA_ne_zero p (hB_τ2_sub_B₂ hp))
    have hfactor : homReflectRes (puisDualLine0 C G.d) G.M_puis ι p =
        W₁_puis 2 p * μ ^ 2 * (V_tr ι (powMap p) - D_tr (powMap p) * G.M_puis ι p) := by
      change W₁_puis 2 p * homReflectOut (puisDualLine0 C G.d) W₁_puis ι p -
          (homReflectOut (puisDualLine0 C G.d) W₁_puis 0 p * W₁_puis 0 p +
            homReflectOut (puisDualLine0 C G.d) W₁_puis 1 p * W₁_puis 1 p) *
            G.M_puis ι p =
        W₁_puis 2 p * μ ^ 2 * (V_tr ι (powMap p) - D_tr (powMap p) * G.M_puis ι p)
      dsimp only [homReflectOut]
      rw [hT0, hT1, hW1_0, hW1_1]
      dsimp only [V_tr, D_tr, N_tr0, N_tr1, puisDualLine0, L₀, powMap, μ]
      fin_cases ι
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, ↓reduceIte, h1_ne]
        ring
      · simp only [Fin.mk_one, ↓reduceIte, h1_ne]
        ring
    rw [hfactor] at hres0
    have hnz : W₁_puis 2 p * μ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hW1_2_ne (pow_ne_zero 2 hμ_ne)
    have hsub := (mul_eq_zero.mp hres0).resolve_left hnz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hsub).symm

  
  let δ_y2 : ℝ := min δ_tr δ_τ2 / 2
  have hδ_y2_pos : 0 < δ_y2 := by positivity
  let δ_t2 : ℝ := min δ_tr ((δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d) / 2
  have hδ_t2_pos : 0 < δ_t2 := by
    have h1 : 0 < (δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d := pow_pos (by linarith) G.d
    exact div_pos (lt_min hδ_tr_pos h1) (by norm_num)
  let B_tr2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₀ δ_y2 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t2
  have hB_tr2_open : IsOpen B_tr2 := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hB_tr2_sub_B_tr : B_tr2 ⊆ B_tr := by
    refine Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_) (Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_)
    · have : min δ_tr δ_τ2 ≤ δ_tr := min_le_left _ _
      dsimp only [δ_y2]; linarith
    · have : min δ_tr ((δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d) ≤ δ_tr := min_le_left _ _
      dsimp only [δ_t2]; linarith
  have hq₀_B_tr2 : q₀ ∈ B_tr2 :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_y2_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t2_pos⟩

  have hD_tr_exists_nz : ∃ q_star ∈ B_tr2, D_tr q_star ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hAllZero
    have hAllZero' : ∀ q ∈ B_tr2, D_tr q = 0 :=
      fun q hq => by_contra fun hne => hAllZero ⟨q, hq, hne⟩
    have hB_tr_preconn : IsPreconnected B_tr :=
      (convex_ball s₀ δ_tr).isPreconnected.prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ_tr).isPreconnected
    have hZero_B_tr : ∀ q ∈ B_tr, D_tr q = 0 :=
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hB_tr_open hB_tr_preconn
        hB_tr2_open ⟨q₀, hq₀_B_tr2⟩ hB_tr2_sub_B_tr hD_tr_holo hAllZero'
    let τ_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((δ_τ2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hτ_seq_props : ∀ n : ℕ, (s₀, τ_seq n) ∈ B_τ2 ∧ τ_seq n ≠ 0 := by
      intro n
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have hr_pos : 0 < δ_τ2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := div_pos hδ_τ2_pos hn_pos
      have hr_le : δ_τ2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ δ_τ2 / 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hδ_τ2_pos.le (by positivity)
          (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
      refine ⟨⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_τ2_pos, ?_⟩, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr_pos.ne'⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      change ‖((δ_τ2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < δ_τ2
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
      linarith
    have hτ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto τ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hreal : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => δ_τ2 / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have hden : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden
      simpa [τ_seq, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hreal
    have hpow_seq_tendsto :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => powMap (s₀, τ_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds q₀) := by
      have hp_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (τ_seq n) ^ G.d) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa only [h0_pow_d] using hτ_tendsto.pow G.d
      exact tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds hp_t
    have hV_q₀_zero : ∀ ι : Fin 2, V_tr ι q₀ = 0 := by
      intro ι
      have hV_cont : ContinuousAt (V_tr ι) q₀ :=
        (hV_tr_holo ι).continuousOn.continuousAt (hB_tr_open.mem_nhds hq₀_B_tr)
      have h_lim1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => V_tr ι (powMap (s₀, τ_seq n)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (V_tr ι q₀)) :=
        hV_cont.tendsto.comp hpow_seq_tendsto
      have h_all0 : (fun n : ℕ => V_tr ι (powMap (s₀, τ_seq n))) = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext n
        obtain ⟨hp_in, hp_nz⟩ := hτ_seq_props n
        rw [← hReflect_eq (s₀, τ_seq n) hp_in hp_nz ι,
          hZero_B_tr (powMap (s₀, τ_seq n)) (hB_τ2_pow_tr _ hp_in), zero_mul]
      rw [h_all0] at h_lim1
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lim1 tendsto_const_nhds
    have hV_norm_id :
        (V_tr 0 q₀) ^ 2 + (V_tr 1 q₀) ^ 2 =
          ((deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s₀) ^ 2 + (deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s₀) ^ 2) ^ 2 *
            ((L₀ 0 q₀) ^ 2 + (L₀ 1 q₀) ^ 2) := by
      have h1_ne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
      dsimp only [V_tr, N_tr0, N_tr1, T_tr]
      simp only [↓reduceIte, h1_ne, hs_trans_q₀]
      ring
    have hLHS_zero : (V_tr 0 q₀) ^ 2 + (V_tr 1 q₀) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [hV_q₀_zero 0, hV_q₀_zero 1]; ring
    have hRHS_ne :
        ((deriv (T.Z_zero 0) s₀) ^ 2 + (deriv (T.Z_zero 1) s₀) ^ 2) ^ 2 *
          ((L₀ 0 q₀) ^ 2 + (L₀ 1 q₀) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 T.Z_zero_nonisotropic_at) hL₀_sq_ne_zero
    exact hRHS_ne (hV_norm_id ▸ hLHS_zero)

  obtain ⟨⟨y_star, t_star⟩, ⟨hy_star, ht_star⟩, hD_star_nz⟩ := hD_tr_exists_nz
  have hex_y_ann :
      ∃ y_ann ∈ Set.Ioo (T.y₂ - δ_y2 / 2) (T.y₂ + δ_y2 / 2),
        D_tr ((y_ann : ℂ), t_star) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hAllRealZero
    have hAllRealZero' :
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (T.y₂ - δ_y2 / 2) (T.y₂ + δ_y2 / 2), D_tr ((x : ℂ), t_star) = 0 :=
      fun x hx => by_contra fun hne => hAllRealZero ⟨x, hx, hne⟩
    let f_y : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => D_tr (y, t_star)
    have hf_y_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_y (Metric.ball s₀ δ_y2) := by
      have hemb : Differentiable ℂ (fun y : ℂ => (y, t_star)) :=
        differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t_star)
      exact (hD_tr_holo.mono hB_tr2_sub_B_tr).comp hemb.differentiableOn
        (fun y hy => ⟨hy, ht_star⟩)
    have hf_y_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f_y (Metric.ball s₀ δ_y2) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hf_y_holo
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => T.y₂ + δ_y2 / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have hx_seq_mem : ∀ n : ℕ,
        x_seq n ∈ Set.Ioo (T.y₂ - δ_y2 / 2) (T.y₂ + δ_y2 / 2) ∧ (x_seq n : ℂ) ≠ s₀ := by
      intro n
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have hd_pos : 0 < δ_y2 / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := div_pos hδ_y2_pos hn_pos
      have hd_le : δ_y2 / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ δ_y2 / 4 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hδ_y2_pos.le (by positivity)
          (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
      refine ⟨⟨by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith, by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      intro heq
      have hre := congr_arg Complex.re heq
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, s₀] at hre
      dsimp [x_seq] at hre
      linarith
    have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (x_seq n : ℂ))
        Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin s₀ {s₀}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hx_seq_mem n).2)⟩
      have hreal : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds T.y₂) := by
        have hden : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        simpa [x_seq] using Filter.Tendsto.const_add T.y₂ (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden)
      exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto T.y₂).comp hreal
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin s₀ {s₀}ᶜ, f_y z = 0 :=
      hx_tendsto.frequently ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun n => hAllRealZero' (x_seq n) (hx_seq_mem n).1)).frequently)
    have hzero_all := hf_y_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      (convex_ball s₀ δ_y2).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_y2_pos) h_freq hy_star
    exact hD_star_nz hzero_all

  obtain ⟨y_ann, hy_ann_Ioo, hD_y_ann_nz⟩ := hex_y_ann
  have hy_ann_abs : |y_ann - T.y₂| < δ_y2 / 2 :=
    abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hy_ann_Ioo.1], by linarith [hy_ann_Ioo.2]⟩
  have hy_ann_ball : (y_ann : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball s₀ δ_y2 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hnorm : ‖(y_ann : ℂ) - s₀‖ = |y_ann - T.y₂| := by
      dsimp [s₀]
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [hnorm]
    linarith

  let g_t : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => D_tr ((y_ann : ℂ), t)
  have hg_t_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_t (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t2) := by
    have hemb : Differentiable ℂ (fun t : ℂ => ((y_ann : ℂ), t)) :=
      (differentiable_const (y_ann : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id
    exact (hD_tr_holo.mono hB_tr2_sub_B_tr).comp hemb.differentiableOn
      (fun t ht => ⟨hy_ann_ball, ht⟩)
  have hg_t_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g_t (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t2) :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hg_t_holo
  have hg_t_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ g_t 0 := hg_t_ana 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t2_pos)
  have hg_t_ev_nz : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, g_t t ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hg_t_ana0.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hev0 | hev_nz
    · exfalso
      have h0_star := hg_t_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ_t2).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_t2_pos) hev0 ht_star
      exact hD_y_ann_nz h0_star
    · exact hev_nz
  obtain ⟨δ_c0, hδ_c0_pos, hδ_c0_nz⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hg_t_ev_nz)
  let δ_clean : ℝ := min δ_c0 (min δ_t2 (Br.r_t / 2))
  have hδ_clean_pos : 0 < δ_clean :=
    lt_min hδ_c0_pos (lt_min hδ_t2_pos (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos]))
  let t_near : ℝ := δ_clean / 2
  have ht_near_pos : 0 < t_near := by dsimp [t_near]; linarith

  let K_t : Set ℂ := { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 ≤ ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ ≤ 3 * t_near / 2 }
  have hK_t_compact : IsCompact K_t := by
    refine IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset
      (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (3 * t_near / 2))
      ((isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
        (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)) ?_
    intro t ht
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using ht.2
  let K_ann : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := {(y_ann : ℂ)} ×ˢ K_t
  have hK_ann_compact : IsCompact K_ann := isCompact_singleton.prod hK_t_compact
  let O_nz : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B_tr2 ∩ D_tr ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
  have hO_nz_open : IsOpen O_nz :=
    (hD_tr_holo.mono hB_tr2_sub_B_tr).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage
      hB_tr2_open isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hK_ann_sub_O : K_ann ⊆ O_nz := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2_lo, hp2_hi⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp1
    have hp2_lt_clean : ‖p.2‖ < δ_clean := by dsimp [t_near] at hp2_hi; linarith
    have hp2_lt_t2 : ‖p.2‖ < δ_t2 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_lt_clean (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hp2_lt_c0 : ‖p.2‖ < δ_c0 := lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_lt_clean (min_le_left _ _)
    have hp2_ne0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0, norm_zero] at hp2_lo; linarith
    refine ⟨⟨hp1 ▸ hy_ann_ball, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp2_lt_t2⟩, ?_⟩
    change D_tr (p.1, p.2) ≠ 0
    rw [hp1]
    exact hδ_c0_nz (by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hp2_lt_c0) hp2_ne0
  obtain ⟨ε_th, hε_th_pos, hε_th_sub⟩ :=
    hK_ann_compact.exists_thickening_subset_open hO_nz_open hK_ann_sub_O

  let δ_y : ℝ := min ε_th (δ_y2 / 2)
  have hδ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y := lt_min hε_th_pos (by linarith)
  let r_match : ℝ := min δ_y (t_near / 4)
  have hr_match_pos : 0 < r_match := lt_min hδ_y_pos (by linarith)
  let A_t : Set ℂ := { t : ℂ | t_near / 2 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 }
  let U_ann : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (y_ann : ℂ) δ_y ×ˢ A_t
  let M_even : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => V_tr ι p / D_tr p

  have hU_ann_sub_O : U_ann ⊆ O_nz := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2_lo, hp2_hi⟩
    apply hε_th_sub
    rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
    refine ⟨((y_ann : ℂ), p.2), ⟨rfl, le_of_lt hp2_lo, le_of_lt hp2_hi⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self]
    have hd1 : dist p.1 (y_ann : ℂ) < ε_th :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hp1) (min_le_left _ _)
    exact max_lt hd1 hε_th_pos
  have hU_ann_sub_B_tr : U_ann ⊆ B_tr :=
    fun p hp => hB_tr2_sub_B_tr (hU_ann_sub_O hp).1
  have hU_ann_D_nz : ∀ p ∈ U_ann, D_tr p ≠ 0 :=
    fun p hp => (hU_ann_sub_O hp).2
  have hann_sub_dom : U_ann ⊆ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx := by
    intro p hp
    apply Br.bidisk_sub_dom
    have hp_B2 : p ∈ B_tr2 := (hU_ann_sub_O hp).1
    refine ⟨h_ball_s_ry (Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_ hp_B2.1), ?_⟩
    · have h1 : δ_y2 ≤ δ_tr / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num)
      have h2 : δ_tr ≤ T.δ₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      linarith [T.δ₂_le_s, hδ_tr_pos]
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have hp2_hi : ‖p.2‖ < 3 * t_near / 2 := hp.2.2
      have h_clean_rt : δ_clean ≤ Br.r_t / 2 :=
        le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      dsimp [t_near] at hp2_hi
      linarith [Br.r_t_pos]
  have hmatch_ball_sub :
      Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match ⊆ U_ann := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 (min_le_left _ _)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hd2 : ‖p.2 - (t_near : ℂ)‖ < t_near / 4 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (min_le_right _ _)
      have htn_norm : ‖(t_near : ℂ)‖ = t_near := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht_near_pos]
      have htri : ‖(t_near : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ + ‖(t_near : ℂ) - p.2‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le p.2 ((t_near : ℂ) - p.2)
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at hd2
      linarith
    · have hd2 : ‖p.2 - (t_near : ℂ)‖ < t_near / 4 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (min_le_right _ _)
      have htn_norm : ‖(t_near : ℂ)‖ = t_near := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht_near_pos]
      have htri : ‖p.2‖ ≤ ‖p.2 - (t_near : ℂ)‖ + ‖(t_near : ℂ)‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (p.2 - (t_near : ℂ)) (t_near : ℂ)
      linarith
  have hM_even_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_even ι) U_ann := by
    intro ι
    have hfn : M_even ι = fun p => V_tr ι p * (D_tr p)⁻¹ := by
      ext p; exact div_eq_mul_inv (V_tr ι p) (D_tr p)
    rw [hfn]
    exact ((hV_tr_holo ι).mono hU_ann_sub_B_tr).mul
      ((hD_tr_holo.mono hU_ann_sub_B_tr).fun_inv hU_ann_D_nz)
  have hM_even_symm : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_ann, M_even ι (p.1, -p.2) = M_even ι p := by
    intro ι p hp
    dsimp only [M_even]
    rw [hV_tr_even p (hU_ann_sub_B_tr hp) ι, hD_tr_even p (hU_ann_sub_B_tr hp)]

  
  have hpoly_transfer : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ↔
    (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match,
      ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff d) *
          (M_even ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) := by
    let τ_near : ℝ := t_near ^ ((G.d : ℝ)⁻¹)
    have hτ_near_pos : 0 < τ_near := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ht_near_pos _
    have hd_cast_ne : (G.d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd_ne_zero
    have hτ_near_pow : τ_near ^ G.d = t_near := by
      dsimp only [τ_near]
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ht_near_pos.le,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hd_cast_ne, Real.rpow_one]
    have hτ_near_lt : τ_near < δ_τ2 / 2 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hge : δ_τ2 / 2 ≤ τ_near := not_lt.mp hnot
      have hpow_le : (δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d ≤ τ_near ^ G.d :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hge G.d
      rw [hτ_near_pow] at hpow_le
      have ht_lt : t_near < δ_t2 := by
        have : δ_clean ≤ δ_t2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
        dsimp [t_near]; linarith
      have ht2_lt : δ_t2 < (δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d := by
        have h1 : 0 < (δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d := pow_pos (by linarith) G.d
        have h2 : min δ_tr ((δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d) ≤ (δ_τ2 / 2) ^ G.d := min_le_right _ _
        dsimp [δ_t2]; linarith
      linarith
    let V_τ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      (Metric.ball s₀ δ_τ2 ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_τ2 \ {0})) ∩
        powMap ⁻¹' Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match
    have hV_τ_open : IsOpen V_τ :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)).inter
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hpowMap_cont)
    have hq_near_mem : ((y_ann : ℂ), (τ_near : ℂ)) ∈ V_τ := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hτ_near_pos.ne'⟩, ?_⟩
      · refine Metric.ball_subset_ball ?_ hy_ann_ball
        have : min δ_tr δ_τ2 ≤ δ_τ2 := min_le_right _ _
        dsimp [δ_y2]; linarith
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hτ_near_pos]
        linarith
      · change ((y_ann : ℂ), (τ_near : ℂ) ^ G.d) ∈
          Metric.ball ((y_ann : ℂ), (t_near : ℂ)) r_match
        have hp_eq : ((τ_near : ℂ) ^ G.d) = (t_near : ℂ) := by
          rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, hτ_near_pow]
        rw [hp_eq]
        exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr_match_pos
    exact G.puis_poly_transfer y_ann t_near r_match M_even ht_near_pos hr_match_pos
      (Set.Subset.trans hmatch_ball_sub hann_sub_dom)
      (fun ι => (hM_even_holo ι).mono hmatch_ball_sub)
      ⟨V_τ, hV_τ_open, ⟨((y_ann : ℂ), (τ_near : ℂ)), hq_near_mem⟩,
        fun q hq => hB_τ2_punc_sub_G q ⟨hq.1.1, hq.1.2.1⟩ hq.1.2.2,
        fun q hq => ⟨hq.2, fun ι => by
          have hD_nz : D_tr (powMap q) ≠ 0 := hU_ann_D_nz (powMap q) (hmatch_ball_sub hq.2)
          have href := hReflect_eq q ⟨hq.1.1, hq.1.2.1⟩ hq.1.2.2 ι
          dsimp only [M_even, powMap] at href ⊢
          exact (eq_div_iff hD_nz).mpr (by rw [mul_comm]; exact href)⟩⟩

  exact ⟨{
    y_ann := y_ann
    δ_y := δ_y
    t_near := t_near
    r_match := r_match
    δ_y_pos := hδ_y_pos
    t_near_pos := ht_near_pos
    r_match_pos := hr_match_pos
    ann_sub_dom := hann_sub_dom
    match_ball_sub := hmatch_ball_sub
    M_even := M_even
    M_even_holo := hM_even_holo
    M_even_symm := hM_even_symm
    poly_transfer := hpoly_transfer
  }⟩

puiseux_wronskian_compact_annulus_evenne.definitions:
noncomputable def puisDualLine0 {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (d : ℕ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p => dualLineShift C 0 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d)

structure PuiseuxCoverGermData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx) where
  d : ℕ
  d_pos : 1 ≤ d
  r_yp : ℝ
  r_τ : ℝ
  K_p : ℕ
  r_yp_pos : 0 < r_yp
  r_yp_le : r_yp ≤ Br.r_y / 2
  r_τ_pos : 0 < r_τ
  r_τ_pow_lt : r_τ ^ d < Br.r_t / 2
  M_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  N_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  M_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_puis ι)
      (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}))
  N_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_puis ι)
      (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)
  N_puis_eq : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
      p.2 ≠ 0 → N_puis ι p = p.2 ^ K_p * M_puis ι p
  puis_rank_one :
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis) p = 0
  puis_reflect :
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis ι p = 0
  not_w2_zero :
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0
  not_iso_line : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 0 p +
          s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 1 p -
          c_star * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0
  not_prev_eq : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        let W₁ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis
        let W₀ : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k q =>
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0) k (q.1, q.2 ^ d)
        W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
        W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  not_primary : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι p = dualLineShift C 1 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d)
  puis_poly_transfer : ∀ (y_m t_m r_m : ℝ) (M_cand : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t_m → 0 < r_m →
    Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_cand ι) (Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m)) →
    (∃ V_τ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_τ ∧ V_τ.Nonempty ∧
      V_τ ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ V_τ, (q.1, q.2 ^ d) ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ∧
        ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι q = M_cand ι (q.1, q.2 ^ d))) →
    ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end,
        ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0) ↔
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m,
        ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0)

structure RegularAffineIntersectionData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet)
    (t₂ : ℝ) (D_wall : AlignedWallDefectData W t₂)
    {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ)
    (Br : PuncturedGlancingBridgeData W t₂ D_wall q_idx)
    (G : PuiseuxCoverGermData W t₂ D_wall q_idx Br) where
  y₁ : ℝ
  ρ₁ : ℝ
  m_star : ℕ
  ρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁

  d : ℕ

  M_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ

    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,

  puis_rank_one :
    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),

    ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),

    ¬ ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0

    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →

    (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 0 p +
          s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 1 p -
          c_star * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0
  not_prev_eq : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
        let W₁ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis
        let W₀ : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k q =>
          homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0) k (q.1, q.2 ^ d)
        W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
        W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0
  not_primary : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
    IsOpen V → V.Nonempty →
    V ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) →
    ¬ ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι p = dualLineShift C 1 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d)
  puis_poly_transfer : ∀ (y_m t_m r_m : ℝ) (M_cand : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t_m → 0 < r_m →
    Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ⊆
      symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx →
    (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_cand ι) (Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m)) →
    (∃ V_τ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_τ ∧ V_τ.Nonempty ∧

    ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)

      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end,

            (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0) ↔
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m,
        ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0)

by

    intro s

    rw [hTop]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hStripUniv : horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hMem
  have h_a_ent : Differentiable ℂ K.a := differentiableOn_univ.mp (hStripUniv ▸ K.a_holo)
  have h_f_ent : Differentiable ℂ K.f := differentiableOn_univ.mp (hStripUniv ▸ K.f_holo)
  have h_a_per : Function.Periodic K.a (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := fun s => K.a_periodic s (hMem s)
  have h_f_per : Function.Periodic K.f (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := fun s => K.f_periodic s (hMem s)
  have h_Γ_per : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℂ), K.f s ≠ 0 →
      K.Γ (s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = K.Γ s := by
    intro k
    refine Int.induction_on k ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s _

    · intro m ih s hfs
      have hfm : K.f (s + ((m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [h_f_per.int_mul (m : ℤ) s]
        exact hfs
      have hstep : s + (((m : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
          (s + ((m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hstep, K.Γ_periodic _ (hMem _) hfm, ih s hfs]
    · intro m ih s hfs
      set s' : ℂ := s + ((-(m : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
      have hfs' : K.f s' ≠ 0 := by
        dsimp [s']
        rw [h_f_per.int_mul (-(m : ℤ) - 1) s]
        exact hfs
      have hstep : s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) = s + ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
        dsimp [s']
        push_cast
        ring
      calc
        K.Γ s' = K.Γ (s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := (K.Γ_periodic s' (hMem s') hfs').symm
        _ = K.Γ (s + ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) := by rw [hstep]
        _ = K.Γ s := ih s hfs
  let σ₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -Complex.I * Complex.log w
  let A_hol : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => K.a (σ₀ w)
  let F_hol : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => K.f (σ₀ w)
  let G_hol : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun ι w => K.Γ (σ₀ w) ι
  have h_bridge : ∀ s : ℂ,
      A_hol (Complex.exp (Complex.I * s)) = K.a s ∧
      F_hol (Complex.exp (Complex.I * s)) = K.f s ∧
      (K.f s ≠ 0 → ∀ ι : Fin 2, G_hol ι (Complex.exp (Complex.I * s)) = K.Γ s ι) := by
    intro s

    have hw : w ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hIσ : Complex.I * σ₀ w = Complex.log w := by
      dsimp [σ₀]
