      rw [hIσ, Complex.exp_log hw]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp hexp_eq
    have hσ_eq : σ₀ w = s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
      linear_combination hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [A_hol]
      rw [hσ_eq]
      exact h_a_per.int_mul k s
    · dsimp [F_hol]
      rw [hσ_eq]
      exact h_f_per.int_mul k s
    · intro hfs ι
      dsimp [G_hol]
      rw [hσ_eq, h_Γ_per k s hfs]
  have h_A_ne : ∀ w : ℂ, w ≠ 0 → A_hol w ≠ 0 := fun w _ => K.a_ne_zero (σ₀ w) (hMem _)
  have h_c_ne : (C.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt C.c_pos)
  have h_descent : ∀ w_star : ℂ, w_star ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt A_hol (F_hol w_star * A_hol w_star / w_star) w_star ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℂ F_hol w_star ∧
      (F_hol w_star ≠ 0 →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℂ (G_hol ι) w_star) ∧
        deriv (G_hol 0) w_star + Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) w_star =
          (C.c : ℂ) * A_hol w_star / (w_star * F_hol w_star ^ 2) ∧
        deriv (G_hol 0) w_star - Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) w_star =
          -(C.c : ℂ) / (w_star * A_hol w_star * F_hol w_star ^ 2)) := by
    intro w_star hw_star
    have hr_pos : 0 < ‖w_star‖ / 2 := half_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw_star)
    let s_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => σ₀ w_star - Complex.I * Complex.log (w / w_star)
    have hs_loc_at : s_loc w_star = σ₀ w_star := by
      simp [s_loc, div_self hw_star, Complex.log_one]
    have h_ball_slit : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_star (‖w_star‖ / 2),
        w / w_star ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧ w ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw_ball
      have hdist : ‖w - w_star‖ < ‖w_star‖ / 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hw_ball
      have hquot : ‖w / w_star - 1‖ < 1 / 2 := by
        have h1 : w / w_star - 1 = (w - w_star) / w_star := by field_simp [hw_star]
        rw [h1, norm_div]
        have hw_norm_pos : 0 < ‖w_star‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw_star
        rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hw_norm_pos (by norm_num)]
        linarith
      have hre_sub : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < (w / w_star - 1).re := by
        have habs : |(w / w_star - 1).re| ≤ ‖w / w_star - 1‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        linarith [neg_abs_le (w / w_star - 1).re]
      have hre_pos : 0 < (w / w_star).re := by
        have hre_eq : (w / w_star - 1).re = (w / w_star).re - 1 := by simp
        linarith
      refine ⟨Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hre_pos), ?_⟩
      intro hw0
      rw [hw0, zero_div, Complex.zero_re] at hre_pos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre_pos
    have hs_loc_deriv : HasDerivAt s_loc (-Complex.I / w_star) w_star := by
      have h_slit_at : w_star / w_star ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
        (h_ball_slit w_star (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos)).1
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => w / w_star) (1 / w_star) w_star := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id w_star).div_const w_star
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun w => Complex.log (w / w_star))
          ((1 / w_star) / (w_star / w_star)) w_star := hd1.clog h_slit_at
      have hd3 : HasDerivAt s_loc (0 - Complex.I * ((1 / w_star) / (w_star / w_star))) w_star :=
        (hasDerivAt_const w_star (σ₀ w_star)).sub (hd2.const_mul Complex.I)
      convert hd3 using 1
      field_simp [hw_star]
      ring
    have h_exp_loc : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_star (‖w_star‖ / 2),
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * s_loc w) = w := by
      intro w hw_ball
      obtain ⟨_, hw_ne⟩ := h_ball_slit w hw_ball
      have hdiv_ne : w / w_star ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hw_ne hw_star
      have h_arg : Complex.I * s_loc w = Complex.log w_star + Complex.log (w / w_star) := by
        dsimp [s_loc, σ₀]
        calc
          Complex.I * (-Complex.I * Complex.log w_star - Complex.I * Complex.log (w / w_star)) =
              -(Complex.I ^ 2) * Complex.log w_star - Complex.I ^ 2 * Complex.log (w / w_star) := by ring
          _ = Complex.log w_star + Complex.log (w / w_star) := by simp [Complex.I_sq]
      rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hw_star, Complex.exp_log hdiv_ne]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ w hw_star
    have h_ev_ball : Metric.ball w_star (‖w_star‖ / 2) ∈ nhds w_star :=
      Metric.ball_mem_nhds w_star hr_pos
    have hA_ev : A_hol =ᶠ[nhds w_star] fun w => K.a (s_loc w) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_ball] with w hw_ball
      have := (h_bridge (s_loc w)).1
      rwa [h_exp_loc w hw_ball] at this
    have hF_ev : F_hol =ᶠ[nhds w_star] fun w => K.f (s_loc w) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_ball] with w hw_ball
      have := (h_bridge (s_loc w)).2.1
      rwa [h_exp_loc w hw_ball] at this
    have hA_deriv : HasDerivAt A_hol (F_hol w_star * A_hol w_star / w_star) w_star := by
      have hd_a : HasDerivAt K.a (Complex.I * K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star)) (s_loc w_star) := by
        rw [hs_loc_at]
        have := (h_a_ent (σ₀ w_star)).hasDerivAt
        rwa [K.deriv_a (σ₀ w_star) (hMem _)] at this
      have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun w => K.a (s_loc w))
          ((Complex.I * K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star)) * (-Complex.I / w_star)) w_star :=
        hd_a.comp w_star hs_loc_deriv
      have h_alg : (Complex.I * K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star)) * (-Complex.I / w_star) =
          F_hol w_star * A_hol w_star / w_star := by
        dsimp [F_hol, A_hol]
        calc
          (Complex.I * K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star)) * (-Complex.I / w_star) =
              -(Complex.I ^ 2) * (K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star)) / w_star := by ring
          _ = K.f (σ₀ w_star) * K.a (σ₀ w_star) / w_star := by simp [Complex.I_sq]
      rw [h_alg] at hd_comp
      exact hd_comp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hA_ev
    have hF_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ F_hol w_star := by
      have hd_f : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => K.f (s_loc w)) w_star :=
        (h_f_ent (s_loc w_star)).comp w_star hs_loc_deriv.differentiableAt
      exact hd_f.congr_of_eventuallyEq hF_ev
    refine ⟨hA_deriv, hF_diff, ?_⟩
    intro hFw
    have hF_ev_ne : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w_star, F_hol w ≠ 0 :=
      hF_diff.continuousAt.eventually_ne hFw
    have hG_ev : ∀ ι : Fin 2, G_hol ι =ᶠ[nhds w_star] fun w => K.Γ (s_loc w) ι := by
      intro ι
      filter_upwards [h_ev_ball, hF_ev_ne] with w hw_ball hw_F
      have hfs_ne : K.f (s_loc w) ≠ 0 := by
        have h1 := (h_bridge (s_loc w)).2.1
        rw [h_exp_loc w hw_ball] at h1
        rwa [← h1]
      have h2 := (h_bridge (s_loc w)).2.2 hfs_ne ι
      rwa [h_exp_loc w hw_ball] at h2
    have hfs_star : K.f (σ₀ w_star) ≠ 0 := hFw
    obtain ⟨hΓ0_diff, hΓ1_diff⟩ := K.Γ_reg_holo (σ₀ w_star) (hMem _) hfs_star
    have hdG0 : HasDerivAt (G_hol 0)
        ((-C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
          (-Complex.I / w_star)) w_star := by
      have hd0 : HasDerivAt (fun z => K.Γ z 0)
          (-C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) (s_loc w_star) := by
        rw [hs_loc_at]
        have h := hΓ0_diff.hasDerivAt
        rwa [K.Γ_deriv₀ (σ₀ w_star) (hMem _) hfs_star] at h
      exact (hd0.comp w_star hs_loc_deriv).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hG_ev 0)
    have hdG1 : HasDerivAt (G_hol 1)
        ((C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
          (-Complex.I / w_star)) w_star := by
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => K.Γ z 1)
          (C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) (s_loc w_star) := by
        rw [hs_loc_at]
        have h := hΓ1_diff.hasDerivAt
        rwa [K.Γ_deriv₁ (σ₀ w_star) (hMem _) hfs_star] at h
      exact (hd1.comp w_star hs_loc_deriv).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hG_ev 1)
    have hG_diff : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℂ (G_hol ι) w_star := by
      intro ι
      fin_cases ι
      · exact hdG0.differentiableAt
      · exact hdG1.differentiableAt
    have hexp_θ : Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) + Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) =
        A_hol w_star := by
      dsimp [A_hol]
      rw [← K.exp_ϕ (σ₀ w_star) (hMem _), mul_comm Complex.I (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)), Complex.exp_mul_I]
      ring
    have hexp_neg_θ : A_hol w_star *
        (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) - Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) = 1 := by
      rw [← hexp_θ]
      calc
        (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) + Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) - Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) =
          Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) ^ 2 -
            Complex.I ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) ^ 2 + Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) ^ 2 := by
          simp [Complex.I_sq]
        _ = 1 := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq _
    have hAw_ne : A_hol w_star ≠ 0 := h_A_ne w_star hw_star
    refine ⟨hG_diff, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hdG0.deriv, hdG1.deriv]
      dsimp [F_hol]
      have hnum : (-↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (-Complex.I / w_star) +
          Complex.I * ((↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (-Complex.I / w_star)) =
          (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) + Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
        calc
          (-↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
              (-Complex.I / w_star) +
            Complex.I * ((↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
              (-Complex.I / w_star)) =
            (C.c : ℂ) * (-(Complex.I ^ 2) * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) +
              Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
            ring
          _ = (C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) +
              Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
            simp [Complex.I_sq]
      rw [hnum, hexp_θ]
      field_simp [hw_star, hfs_star]
    · rw [hdG0.deriv, hdG1.deriv]
      dsimp [F_hol]
      have hnum : (-↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (-Complex.I / w_star) -
          Complex.I * ((↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (-Complex.I / w_star)) =
          -(C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) - Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
            (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
        calc
          (-↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
              (-Complex.I / w_star) -
            Complex.I * ((↑C.c * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) *
              (-Complex.I / w_star)) =
            -(C.c : ℂ) * (-(Complex.I ^ 2) * Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) -
              Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
            ring
          _ = -(C.c : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) -
              Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star))) * (K.f (σ₀ w_star))⁻¹ ^ 2 / w_star := by
            simp [Complex.I_sq]
      have h_inv_cos : Complex.cos (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) - Complex.I * Complex.sin (K.ϕ (σ₀ w_star)) =
          (A_hol w_star)⁻¹ := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hAw_ne
        rw [hexp_neg_θ, mul_inv_cancel₀ hAw_ne]
      rw [hnum, h_inv_cos]
      field_simp [hw_star, hAw_ne, hfs_star]

  
  let R_sl : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun ι u => n ι u / d ι u
  have h_slice_G : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀},
      v_sl u ≠ 0 ∧ F_hol (v_sl u) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ ι : Fin 2, d ι u ≠ 0 ∧ R_sl ι u = G_hol ι (v_sl u) := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨s, hexp, hfs, hnd⟩ := h_slice u hu
    have hv_ne : v_sl u ≠ 0 := by rw [← hexp]; exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hF_ne : F_hol (v_sl u) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hexp, (h_bridge s).2.1]
      exact hfs
    refine ⟨hv_ne, hF_ne, ?_⟩
    intro ι
    obtain ⟨hd_ne, hn_eq⟩ := hnd ι
    refine ⟨hd_ne, ?_⟩
    dsimp [R_sl]
    rw [hn_eq, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hd_ne, ← hexp, (h_bridge s).2.2 hfs ι]
  have hR_mero : ∀ ι : Fin 2, MeromorphicAt (R_sl ι) u₀ := by
    intro ι
    have hn_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ (n ι) u₀ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo ι).1 u₀
        (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
    have hd_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ (d ι) u₀ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo ι).2 u₀
        (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
    exact hn_anal.meromorphicAt.div hd_anal.meromorphicAt

  have h_ball_nhdsNE : ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r →
      Metric.ball u₀ r \ {u₀} ∈ nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Set.sdiff_eq]
    exact Filter.inter_mem (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds u₀ hr)) self_mem_nhdsWithin
  have h_unpack_nhdsNE : ∀ {P : ℂ → Prop},
      (∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, P u) →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r \ {u₀}, P u := by
    intro P hP
    rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball] at hP
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := hP
    exact ⟨r, hr, fun u hu => hball u hu.1 hu.2⟩

  
  have hv_mero : MeromorphicAt v_sl u₀ := by
    by_contra hNotMero
    have h_dense : ∀ (w₀ : ℂ) (ε r₁ : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < r₁ → r₁ ≤ δ →
        ∃ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₁ \ {u₀}, ‖v_sl u - w₀‖ < ε := by
      intro w₀ ε r₁ hε hr₁ hr₁_le
      by_contra h_no
      have h_no' : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₁ \ {u₀}, ε ≤ ‖v_sl u - w₀‖ := by
        intro u hu
        by_contra hlt
        exact h_no ⟨u, hu, lt_of_not_ge hlt⟩
      let B₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball u₀ r₁ \ {u₀}
      have hB₁_sub : B₁ ⊆ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} :=
        Set.sdiff_subset_sdiff_left (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le)
      let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (v_sl u - w₀)⁻¹
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g B₁ := by
        refine DifferentiableOn.inv ((hv_holo.mono hB₁_sub).sub_const w₀) ?_
        intro u hu
        have hge : ε ≤ ‖v_sl u - w₀‖ := h_no' u hu
        exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun heq => by rw [heq, sub_self, norm_zero] at hge; linarith)
      have hg_bdd : BddAbove ((norm ∘ g) '' B₁) := by
        refine ⟨ε⁻¹, ?_⟩
        rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, g, norm_inv]
        exact inv_anti₀ hε (h_no' u hu)
      have h_rem := Complex.differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_bddAbove
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds u₀ hr₁) hg_holo hg_bdd
      set g_ext : ℂ → ℂ := Function.update g u₀ ((nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ).limUnder g)
      have hg_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ g_ext u₀ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr h_rem u₀
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁)
      have hv_rec_mero : MeromorphicAt (fun u => w₀ + (g_ext u)⁻¹) u₀ :=
        (analyticAt_const.meromorphicAt).add (hg_anal.meromorphicAt.inv)
      have hv_ev_eq : (fun u => w₀ + (g_ext u)⁻¹) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ] v_sl := by
        filter_upwards [h_ball_nhdsNE hr₁] with u hu
        have hu_ne : u ≠ u₀ := hu.2
        simp only [g_ext, Function.update_of_ne hu_ne, g, inv_inv, add_sub_cancel]
      exact hNotMero (hv_rec_mero.congr hv_ev_eq)
    let w₁ : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ))
    let w₂ : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * (Real.pi : ℂ))
    have hw₁_ne : w₁ ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hw₂_ne : w₂ ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hf0_ne : K.f ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos := (K.f_real_pos 0).1
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    have hfπ_ne : K.f (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos := (K.f_real_pos Real.pi).1
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    have hFw₁ : F_hol w₁ ≠ 0 := by
      have h1 : F_hol w₁ = K.f ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) := (h_bridge ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)).2.1
      rwa [h1]
    have hFw₂ : F_hol w₂ ≠ 0 := by
      have h2 : F_hol w₂ = K.f (Real.pi : ℂ) := (h_bridge (Real.pi : ℂ)).2.1
      rwa [h2]
    have hG_diff_val : ∃ ι : Fin 2, G_hol ι w₁ ≠ G_hol ι w₂ := by
      by_contra h_eq_all
      have hΓ_eq : K.Γ ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) = K.Γ (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
        ext ι
        have h1 : G_hol ι w₁ = K.Γ ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) ι :=
          (h_bridge ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ)).2.2 hf0_ne ι
        have h2 : G_hol ι w₂ = K.Γ (Real.pi : ℂ) ι :=
          (h_bridge (Real.pi : ℂ)).2.2 hfπ_ne ι
        have heq_ι : G_hol ι w₁ = G_hol ι w₂ := by
          by_contra hne
          exact h_eq_all ⟨ι, hne⟩
        rw [← h1, ← h2]
        exact heq_ι
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := K.Γ_real_simple 0 Real.pi hΓ_eq
      have hpi_ne : (Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
      have hk_eq : (2 * k : ℝ) = -1 := by
        apply mul_right_cancel₀ hpi_ne
        linarith
      have hk_int : (2 * k : ℤ) = -1 := by exact_mod_cast hk_eq
      omega
    obtain ⟨ι, hG_ne⟩ := hG_diff_val
    have hG_cont₁ : ContinuousAt (G_hol ι) w₁ :=
      ((h_descent w₁ hw₁_ne).2.2 hFw₁).1 ι |>.continuousAt
    have hG_cont₂ : ContinuousAt (G_hol ι) w₂ :=
      ((h_descent w₂ hw₂_ne).2.2 hFw₂).1 ι |>.continuousAt
    rcases lt_or_ge (meromorphicOrderAt (R_sl ι) u₀) 0 with h_neg | h_nonneg
    · have h_cob := tendsto_cobounded_of_meromorphicOrderAt_neg h_neg
      rw [← tendsto_norm_atTop_iff_cobounded] at h_cob
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, h_gt⟩ := h_unpack_nhdsNE (h_cob.eventually_gt_atTop (‖G_hol ι w₁‖ + 1))
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, h_cont_ε⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hG_cont₁ 1 one_pos
      let r₁ : ℝ := min (δ / 2) (r₀ / 2)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (half_pos hδ) (half_pos hr₀)
      have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ δ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨u, hu_B₁, hu_close⟩ := h_dense w₁ ε r₁ hε hr₁_pos hr₁_le
      have hu_B : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le hu_B₁.1, hu_B₁.2⟩
      have hu_B₀ : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₀ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)) hu_B₁.1, hu_B₁.2⟩
      have hR_eq : R_sl ι u = G_hol ι (v_sl u) := (h_slice_G u hu_B).2.2 ι |>.2
      have h_big : ‖G_hol ι w₁‖ + 1 < ‖R_sl ι u‖ := h_gt u hu_B₀
      have h_small : ‖G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w₁‖ < 1 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using h_cont_ε (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hu_close)
      have h_tri : ‖R_sl ι u‖ ≤ ‖G_hol ι w₁‖ + ‖G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w₁‖ := by
        rw [hR_eq]
        simpa using norm_add_le (G_hol ι w₁) (G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w₁)
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨c_lim, hc_lim⟩ := tendsto_nhds_of_meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg (hR_mero ι) h_nonneg
      let D : ℝ := ‖G_hol ι w₁ - G_hol ι w₂‖
      have hD_pos : 0 < D := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hG_ne)
      have h_pick : ∃ w_star : ℂ, ContinuousAt (G_hol ι) w_star ∧ D / 2 ≤ ‖c_lim - G_hol ι w_star‖ := by
        by_cases h1 : D / 2 ≤ ‖c_lim - G_hol ι w₁‖
        · exact ⟨w₁, hG_cont₁, h1⟩
        · refine ⟨w₂, hG_cont₂, ?_⟩
          have h_tri : D ≤ ‖G_hol ι w₁ - c_lim‖ + ‖c_lim - G_hol ι w₂‖ := by
            dsimp [D]
            calc
              ‖G_hol ι w₁ - G_hol ι w₂‖ = ‖(G_hol ι w₁ - c_lim) + (c_lim - G_hol ι w₂)‖ := by
                congr 1; ring
              _ ≤ ‖G_hol ι w₁ - c_lim‖ + ‖c_lim - G_hol ι w₂‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at h_tri
          linarith
      obtain ⟨w_star, hw_cont, hw_far⟩ := h_pick
      obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, h_c_close⟩ :=
        h_unpack_nhdsNE (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hc_lim (D / 4) (by linarith))
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, h_G_close⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hw_cont (D / 4) (by linarith)
      let r₁ : ℝ := min (δ / 2) (r₀ / 2)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (half_pos hδ) (half_pos hr₀)
      have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ δ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨u, hu_B₁, hu_close⟩ := h_dense w_star ε r₁ hε hr₁_pos hr₁_le
      have hu_B : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le hu_B₁.1, hu_B₁.2⟩
      have hu_B₀ : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₀ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)) hu_B₁.1, hu_B₁.2⟩
      have hR_eq : R_sl ι u = G_hol ι (v_sl u) := (h_slice_G u hu_B).2.2 ι |>.2
      have h1 : ‖R_sl ι u - c_lim‖ < D / 4 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using h_c_close u hu_B₀
      have h2 : ‖G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w_star‖ < D / 4 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using h_G_close (by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hu_close)
      have h_sub_add : c_lim - G_hol ι w_star = c_lim - R_sl ι u + (R_sl ι u - G_hol ι w_star) := by
        ring
      have h_tri' : ‖c_lim - G_hol ι w_star‖ ≤
          ‖R_sl ι u - c_lim‖ + ‖G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w_star‖ := by
        rw [h_sub_add]
        calc
          ‖c_lim - R_sl ι u + (R_sl ι u - G_hol ι w_star)‖ ≤
              ‖c_lim - R_sl ι u‖ + ‖R_sl ι u - G_hol ι w_star‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖R_sl ι u - c_lim‖ + ‖G_hol ι (v_sl u) - G_hol ι w_star‖ := by
            rw [norm_sub_rev, hR_eq]
      linarith

  
  have hB_mem_nhdsNE : Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} ∈ nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ := h_ball_nhdsNE hδ
  have hv_ord_ne_top : meromorphicOrderAt v_sl u₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h_top
    have hv_zero := meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp h_top
    have h_false : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, False := by
      filter_upwards [hv_zero, hB_mem_nhdsNE] with u hu0 huB
      exact (h_slice_G u huB).1 hu0
    exact h_false.exists.choose_spec
  by_cases hv_ord_zero : meromorphicOrderAt v_sl u₀ = 0
  · exact tendsto_ne_zero_of_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero hv_mero hv_ord_zero
  · exfalso
    set k : ℤ := (meromorphicOrderAt v_sl u₀).untop₀
    have hk_ne : k ≠ 0 := by
      intro hk0
      apply hv_ord_zero
      rw [← WithTop.coe_untop₀_of_ne_top hv_ord_ne_top]
      exact congrArg (fun m : ℤ => (m : WithTop ℤ)) hk0
    obtain ⟨h, hh_anal, hh_nz, hv_fac⟩ := (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff hv_mero).mp hv_ord_ne_top
    have hv_fac' : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, v_sl u = (u - u₀) ^ k * h u := by
      filter_upwards [hv_fac] with u hu
      simpa [k, smul_eq_mul] using hu
    
    let W₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (deriv (n 0) u * d 0 u - n 0 u * deriv (d 0) u) * (d 1 u) ^ 2
    let W₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (deriv (n 1) u * d 1 u - n 1 u * deriv (d 1) u) * (d 0 u) ^ 2
    let W_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => W₀ u + Complex.I * W₁ u
    let W_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => W₀ u - Complex.I * W₁ u
    let M_A : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (A_hol (v_sl u)) ^ 2
    have hW_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ W_plus u₀ ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ W_minus u₀ := by
      have hn0 : AnalyticAt ℂ (n 0) u₀ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo 0).1 u₀
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      have hd0 : AnalyticAt ℂ (d 0) u₀ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo 0).2 u₀
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      have hn1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (n 1) u₀ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo 1).1 u₀
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      have hd1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (d 1) u₀ :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr (hnd_holo 1).2 u₀
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      have hW0 : AnalyticAt ℂ W₀ u₀ :=
        ((hn0.deriv.mul hd0).sub (hn0.mul hd0.deriv)).mul (hd1.pow 2)
      have hW1 : AnalyticAt ℂ W₁ u₀ :=
        ((hn1.deriv.mul hd1).sub (hn1.mul hd1.deriv)).mul (hd0.pow 2)
      exact ⟨hW0.add (analyticAt_const.mul hW1), hW0.sub (analyticAt_const.mul hW1)⟩
    have hB_open : IsOpen (Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
    have hW_rel : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀},
        W_plus u = -M_A u * W_minus u ∧ (deriv v_sl u ≠ 0 → W_minus u ≠ 0) := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨hv_ne, hF_ne, hR_all⟩ := h_slice_G u hu
      obtain ⟨hd0_ne, _⟩ := hR_all 0
      obtain ⟨hd1_ne, _⟩ := hR_all 1
      obtain ⟨hG_diff, hG_p, hG_m⟩ := (h_descent (v_sl u) hv_ne).2.2 hF_ne
      have hv_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ v_sl u := hv_holo.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hu)
      have h_dR : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          deriv (n ι) u * d ι u - n ι u * deriv (d ι) u =
            deriv (G_hol ι) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u * (d ι u) ^ 2 := by
        intro ι
        have h_ev : n ι =ᶠ[nhds u] fun z => G_hol ι (v_sl z) * d ι z := by
          filter_upwards [hB_open.mem_nhds hu] with z hz
          obtain ⟨hdz_ne, hRz⟩ := (h_slice_G z hz).2.2 ι
          dsimp [R_sl] at hRz
          rw [← hRz, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdz_ne]
        have hd_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ (d ι) u :=
          (hnd_holo ι).2.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu.1)
        have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z => G_hol ι (v_sl z))
            (deriv (G_hol ι) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u) u :=
          (hG_diff ι).hasDerivAt.comp u hv_diff.hasDerivAt
        have hd_prod : HasDerivAt (fun z => G_hol ι (v_sl z) * d ι z)
            (deriv (G_hol ι) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u * d ι u +
              G_hol ι (v_sl u) * deriv (d ι) u) u :=
          hd_comp.mul hd_d.hasDerivAt
        have hn_deriv : deriv (n ι) u =
            deriv (G_hol ι) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u * d ι u +
              G_hol ι (v_sl u) * deriv (d ι) u :=
          (hd_prod.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).deriv
        have hn_val : n ι u = G_hol ι (v_sl u) * d ι u := by
          obtain ⟨hdu_ne, hRu⟩ := hR_all ι
          dsimp [R_sl] at hRu
          rw [← hRu, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdu_ne]
        rw [hn_deriv, hn_val]
        ring
      have hW0_eq : W₀ u = deriv (G_hol 0) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u * (d 0 u) ^ 2 * (d 1 u) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [W₀]
        rw [h_dR 0]
      have hW1_eq : W₁ u = deriv (G_hol 1) (v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u * (d 1 u) ^ 2 * (d 0 u) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [W₁]
        rw [h_dR 1]
      have hWp_eq : W_plus u =
          (deriv (G_hol 0) (v_sl u) + Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) (v_sl u)) *
            deriv v_sl u * (d 0 u) ^ 2 * (d 1 u) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [W_plus]
        rw [hW0_eq, hW1_eq]
        ring
      have hWm_eq : W_minus u =
          (deriv (G_hol 0) (v_sl u) - Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) (v_sl u)) *
            deriv v_sl u * (d 0 u) ^ 2 * (d 1 u) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [W_minus]
        rw [hW0_eq, hW1_eq]
        ring
      have h_gp_rel : deriv (G_hol 0) (v_sl u) + Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) (v_sl u) =
          -M_A u * (deriv (G_hol 0) (v_sl u) - Complex.I * deriv (G_hol 1) (v_sl u)) := by
        dsimp [M_A]
        rw [hG_p, hG_m]
        have hAu_ne : A_hol (v_sl u) ≠ 0 := h_A_ne (v_sl u) hv_ne
        field_simp [hv_ne, hAu_ne, hF_ne]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hWp_eq, hWm_eq, h_gp_rel]
        ring
      · intro hdv_ne
        rw [hWm_eq, hG_m]
        have hAu_ne : A_hol (v_sl u) ≠ 0 := h_A_ne (v_sl u) hv_ne
        have h1 : -(C.c : ℂ) / (v_sl u * A_hol (v_sl u) * F_hol (v_sl u) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
          div_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr h_c_ne)
            (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hv_ne hAu_ne) (pow_ne_zero 2 hF_ne))
        exact mul_ne_zero
          (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h1 hdv_ne) (pow_ne_zero 2 hd0_ne))
          (pow_ne_zero 2 hd1_ne)

    
    let K_den : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (k : ℂ) + (u - u₀) * (deriv h u / h u)
    have hK_den_cont : ContinuousAt K_den u₀ := by
      refine continuousAt_const.add ((continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).mul ?_)
      exact hh_anal.deriv.continuousAt.div hh_anal.continuousAt hh_nz
    have hK_den_u0 : K_den u₀ = (k : ℂ) := by simp [K_den]
    have hK_den_ne0 : K_den u₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hK_den_u0]
      exact Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr hk_ne
    have h_ev_v : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ,
        (u - u₀) * (deriv v_sl u / v_sl u) = K_den u ∧ K_den u ≠ 0 ∧ W_minus u ≠ 0 := by
      have h_nhds_h : ∀ᶠ u in nhds u₀, AnalyticAt ℂ h u ∧ h u ≠ 0 ∧ K_den u ≠ 0 :=
        hh_anal.eventually_analyticAt.and
          ((hh_anal.continuousAt.eventually_ne hh_nz).and
            (hK_den_cont.eventually_ne hK_den_ne0))
      rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball] at h_nhds_h
      obtain ⟨r_h, hr_h, h_ball_h⟩ := h_nhds_h
      obtain ⟨r_f, hr_f, h_ball_f⟩ := h_unpack_nhdsNE hv_fac'
      let r₁ : ℝ := min δ (min r_h r_f)
      have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min hδ (lt_min hr_h hr_f)
      have hB₁_open : IsOpen (Metric.ball u₀ r₁ \ {u₀}) :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
      filter_upwards [h_ball_nhdsNE hr₁_pos] with u hu
      have hu_ne : u ≠ u₀ := hu.2
      have hsub_ne : u - u₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hu_ne
      have hu_rh : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_h :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hu.1
      have hu_B : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hu.1, hu_ne⟩
      obtain ⟨hhu_anal, hhu_ne, hKu_ne⟩ := h_ball_h u hu_rh
      have hv_ev_u : v_sl =ᶠ[nhds u] fun z => (z - u₀) ^ k * h z := by
        filter_upwards [hB₁_open.mem_nhds hu] with z hz
        have hz_rf : z ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_f \ {u₀} :=
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hz.1, hz.2⟩
        exact h_ball_f z hz_rf
      have hd_zpow : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ k)
          ((k : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (k - 1)) u := by
        have h1 := (hasDerivAt_zpow k (u - u₀) (Or.inl hsub_ne)).comp u
          ((hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const u₀)
        change HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ k) _ u at h1
        rwa [mul_one] at h1
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ k * h z)
          ((k : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (k - 1) * h u + (u - u₀) ^ k * deriv h u) u :=
        hd_zpow.mul hhu_anal.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hv_deriv : deriv v_sl u =
          (k : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (k - 1) * h u + (u - u₀) ^ k * deriv h u :=
        (hd_prod.congr_of_eventuallyEq hv_ev_u).deriv
      have hv_val : v_sl u = (u - u₀) ^ k * h u := hv_ev_u.self_of_nhds
      have h_zpow_ne : (u - u₀) ^ k ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero k hsub_ne
      have h_zpow_mul : (u - u₀) * (u - u₀) ^ (k - 1) = (u - u₀) ^ k := by
        rw [← zpow_one_add₀ hsub_ne]
        congr 1
        omega
      have h_logd : (u - u₀) * (deriv v_sl u / v_sl u) = K_den u := by
        dsimp [K_den]
        rw [hv_deriv, hv_val]
        field_simp [h_zpow_ne, hhu_ne]
        linear_combination (k : ℂ) * h u * h_zpow_mul
      have hdv_ne : deriv v_sl u ≠ 0 := by
        intro hdv0
        rw [hdv0, zero_div, mul_zero] at h_logd
        exact hKu_ne h_logd.symm
      exact ⟨h_logd, hKu_ne, (hW_rel u hu_B).2 hdv_ne⟩

    
    have hMA_mero : MeromorphicAt M_A u₀ := by
      have h_ratio_mero : MeromorphicAt (fun u => -W_plus u / W_minus u) u₀ :=
        (hW_anal.1.meromorphicAt.neg).div hW_anal.2.meromorphicAt
      refine h_ratio_mero.congr ?_
      filter_upwards [hB_mem_nhdsNE, h_ev_v] with u huB ⟨_, _, hWm_ne⟩
      have hrel := (hW_rel u huB).1
      rw [hrel]
      field_simp [hWm_ne]
    have hMA_ord_ne_top : meromorphicOrderAt M_A u₀ ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h_top
      have hMA_zero := meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff.mp h_top
      have h_false : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, False := by
        filter_upwards [hMA_zero, hB_mem_nhdsNE] with u hu0 huB
        have hv_ne := (h_slice_G u huB).1
        exact pow_ne_zero 2 (h_A_ne (v_sl u) hv_ne) hu0
      exact h_false.exists.choose_spec
    set m_A : ℤ := (meromorphicOrderAt M_A u₀).untop₀
    obtain ⟨g_A, hgA_anal, hgA_nz, hMA_fac⟩ :=
      (meromorphicOrderAt_ne_top_iff hMA_mero).mp hMA_ord_ne_top
    have hMA_fac' : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, M_A u = (u - u₀) ^ m_A * g_A u := by
      filter_upwards [hMA_fac] with u hu
      simpa [m_A, smul_eq_mul] using hu
    let M_num : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (m_A : ℂ) + (u - u₀) * (deriv g_A u / g_A u)
    let R_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => M_num u / (2 * K_den u)
    have hR_lim_cont : ContinuousAt R_lim u₀ := by
      have hnum_cont : ContinuousAt M_num u₀ :=
        continuousAt_const.add ((continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).mul
          (hgA_anal.deriv.continuousAt.div hgA_anal.continuousAt hgA_nz))
      exact hnum_cont.div (continuousAt_const.mul hK_den_cont)
        (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hK_den_ne0)
    have h_ev_F_eq : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, F_hol (v_sl u) = R_lim u := by
      have h_nhds_gA : ∀ᶠ u in nhds u₀, AnalyticAt ℂ g_A u ∧ g_A u ≠ 0 :=
        hgA_anal.eventually_analyticAt.and (hgA_anal.continuousAt.eventually_ne hgA_nz)
      rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball] at h_nhds_gA
      obtain ⟨r_g, hr_g, h_ball_g⟩ := h_nhds_gA
      obtain ⟨r_mf, hr_mf, h_ball_mf⟩ := h_unpack_nhdsNE hMA_fac'
      obtain ⟨r_ev, hr_ev, h_ball_ev⟩ := h_unpack_nhdsNE h_ev_v
      let r₂ : ℝ := min δ (min r_g (min r_mf r_ev))
      have hr₂_pos : 0 < r₂ := lt_min hδ (lt_min hr_g (lt_min hr_mf hr_ev))
      have hB₂_open : IsOpen (Metric.ball u₀ r₂ \ {u₀}) :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
      filter_upwards [h_ball_nhdsNE hr₂_pos] with u hu
      have hu_ne : u ≠ u₀ := hu.2
      have hsub_ne : u - u₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hu_ne
      have hu_B : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ δ \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hu.1, hu_ne⟩
      have hu_rg : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_g :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hu.1
      have hu_ev : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_ev \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))) hu.1,
          hu_ne⟩
      obtain ⟨hgAu_anal, hgAu_ne⟩ := h_ball_g u hu_rg
      obtain ⟨h_logd_v, hKu_ne, _⟩ := h_ball_ev u hu_ev
      have hMA_ev_u : M_A =ᶠ[nhds u] fun z => (z - u₀) ^ m_A * g_A z := by
        filter_upwards [hB₂_open.mem_nhds hu] with z hz
        have hz_mf : z ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_mf \ {u₀} :=
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball
            (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))) hz.1,
            hz.2⟩
        exact h_ball_mf z hz_mf
      have hd_zpow : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ m_A)
          ((m_A : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (m_A - 1)) u := by
        have h1 := (hasDerivAt_zpow m_A (u - u₀) (Or.inl hsub_ne)).comp u
          ((hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const u₀)
        change HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ m_A) _ u at h1
        rwa [mul_one] at h1
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z - u₀) ^ m_A * g_A z)
          ((m_A : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (m_A - 1) * g_A u + (u - u₀) ^ m_A * deriv g_A u) u :=
        hd_zpow.mul hgAu_anal.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hMA_deriv₁ : deriv M_A u =
          (m_A : ℂ) * (u - u₀) ^ (m_A - 1) * g_A u + (u - u₀) ^ m_A * deriv g_A u :=
        (hd_prod.congr_of_eventuallyEq hMA_ev_u).deriv
      have hMA_val : M_A u = (u - u₀) ^ m_A * g_A u := hMA_ev_u.self_of_nhds
      have h_zpow_ne : (u - u₀) ^ m_A ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero m_A hsub_ne
      have h_zpow_mul : (u - u₀) * (u - u₀) ^ (m_A - 1) = (u - u₀) ^ m_A := by
        rw [← zpow_one_add₀ hsub_ne]
        congr 1
        omega
      have h_logd_MA₁ : (u - u₀) * (deriv M_A u / M_A u) = M_num u := by
        dsimp [M_num]
        rw [hMA_deriv₁, hMA_val]
        field_simp [h_zpow_ne, hgAu_ne]
        linear_combination (m_A : ℂ) * g_A u * h_zpow_mul
      
      have hv_ne : v_sl u ≠ 0 := (h_slice_G u hu_B).1
      have hv_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ v_sl u := hv_holo.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hu_B)
      have hd_A_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z => A_hol (v_sl z))
          ((F_hol (v_sl u) * A_hol (v_sl u) / v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u) u :=
        (h_descent (v_sl u) hv_ne).1.comp u hv_diff.hasDerivAt
      have hd_MA₂ : HasDerivAt M_A
          (2 * A_hol (v_sl u) *
            ((F_hol (v_sl u) * A_hol (v_sl u) / v_sl u) * deriv v_sl u)) u := by
        have hsq : M_A = fun z => A_hol (v_sl z) * A_hol (v_sl z) := by
          ext z; dsimp [M_A]; ring
        rw [hsq]
        convert hd_A_comp.mul hd_A_comp using 1
        ring
      have hAu_ne : A_hol (v_sl u) ≠ 0 := h_A_ne (v_sl u) hv_ne
      have h_logd_MA₂ : (u - u₀) * (deriv M_A u / M_A u) =
          2 * F_hol (v_sl u) * ((u - u₀) * (deriv v_sl u / v_sl u)) := by
        rw [hd_MA₂.deriv]
        dsimp [M_A]
        field_simp [hAu_ne, hv_ne]
      rw [h_logd_MA₁, h_logd_v] at h_logd_MA₂
      dsimp [R_lim]
      have h2K_ne : 2 * K_den u ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hKu_ne
      rw [eq_div_iff h2K_ne, h_logd_MA₂]
      ring

    
    let M₀ : ℝ := ‖R_lim u₀‖ + 1
    have h_R_bdd_nhds : ∀ᶠ u in nhds u₀, ‖R_lim u‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ h u ≠ 0 := by
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ u in nhds u₀, dist (R_lim u) (R_lim u₀) < 1 :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff'.mp hR_lim_cont 1 one_pos
      filter_upwards [h1, hh_anal.continuousAt.eventually_ne hh_nz] with u hu_dist hhu_ne
      refine ⟨?_, hhu_ne⟩
      have h_tri : ‖R_lim u‖ ≤ ‖R_lim u₀‖ + ‖R_lim u - R_lim u₀‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (R_lim u₀) (R_lim u - R_lim u₀)
      have h_lt : ‖R_lim u - R_lim u₀‖ < 1 := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hu_dist
      dsimp [M₀]
      linarith
    have h_comb : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ,
        ‖F_hol (v_sl u)‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ v_sl u = (u - u₀) ^ k * h u ∧ h u ≠ 0 := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_F_eq, hv_fac', nhdsWithin_le_nhds h_R_bdd_nhds] with u hFeq hv_eq ⟨hRb, hhu⟩
      rw [hFeq]
      exact ⟨hRb, hv_eq, hhu⟩
    obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b, h_ball_b⟩ := h_unpack_nhdsNE h_comb
    let r₂' : ℝ := min δ r_b
    have hr₂'_pos : 0 < r₂' := lt_min hδ hr_b

    
    let m : ℕ := k.natAbs
    have hm_pos : 0 < m := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hk_ne
    let h₁ : ℂ → ℂ := if 0 < k then h else fun u => (h u)⁻¹
    have hh₁_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ h₁ u₀ := by
      dsimp [h₁]
      split_ifs
      · exact hh_anal
      · exact hh_anal.inv hh_nz
    let V : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (u - u₀) ^ m * h₁ u
    have hV_anal : AnalyticAt ℂ V u₀ :=
      ((analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).pow m).mul hh₁_anal
    have hV_u0 : V u₀ = 0 := by
      simp [V, zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hm_pos)]
    have hV_on_ball : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₂' \ {u₀},
        V u ≠ 0 ∧ (if 0 < k then V u = v_sl u else V u = (v_sl u)⁻¹) := by
      intro u hu
      have hu_rb : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_b \ {u₀} :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu.1, hu.2⟩
      obtain ⟨_, hv_eq, hhu_ne⟩ := h_ball_b u hu_rb
      have hsub_ne : u - u₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hu.2
      by_cases hk_pos : 0 < k
      · have hk_m : k = (m : ℤ) := (Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hk_pos)).symm
        have hVu : V u = v_sl u := by
          simp only [V, h₁, hk_pos, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [hv_eq, hk_m, zpow_natCast]
        simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m hsub_ne) (by simp [h₁, hk_pos, hhu_ne]), hVu⟩
      · have hk_neg : k < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hk_pos) hk_ne
        have hk_m : k = -(m : ℤ) := by
          have : (m : ℤ) = -k := Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hk_neg)
          omega
        have hVu : V u = (v_sl u)⁻¹ := by
          simp only [V, h₁, hk_pos, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [hv_eq, hk_m, _root_.zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, mul_inv, inv_inv]
        simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m hsub_ne) (by simp [h₁, hk_pos, hhu_ne]), hVu⟩
    have hV_not_const : ¬ (∀ᶠ u in nhds u₀, V u = V u₀) := by
      intro h_const
      rw [hV_u0] at h_const
      have h_false : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin u₀ {u₀}ᶜ, False := by
        filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds h_const, h_ball_nhdsNE hr₂'_pos] with u hu0 huB
        exact (hV_on_ball u huB).1 hu0
      exact h_false.exists.choose_spec
    have hV_open_nhds : nhds (0 : ℂ) ≤ Filter.map V (nhds u₀) := by
      have := (hV_anal.eventually_constant_or_nhds_le_map_nhds).resolve_left hV_not_const
      rwa [hV_u0] at this
    have h_img_nhds : V '' Metric.ball u₀ r₂' ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
      hV_open_nhds (Filter.image_mem_map (Metric.ball_mem_nhds u₀ hr₂'_pos))
    obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃_pos, hr₃_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_img_nhds

    
    let Y₀ : ℝ := max 1 (-Real.log (r₃ / 2))
    have hr₃_half_pos : 0 < r₃ / 2 := half_pos hr₃_pos
    have hf_halfplanes : ∀ s : ℂ, Y₀ < |s.im| → ‖K.f s‖ ≤ M₀ := by
      have h_one_side :
          if 0 < k then ∀ s : ℂ, Y₀ < s.im → ‖K.f s‖ ≤ M₀
          else ∀ s : ℂ, s.im < -Y₀ → ‖K.f s‖ ≤ M₀ := by
        split_ifs with hk_pos
        · intro s hs_im
          let z : ℂ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * s)
          have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
          have hz_norm : ‖z‖ < r₃ := by
            have hre : (Complex.I * s).re = -s.im := by simp
            rw [Complex.norm_exp, hre]
            have hlt : -s.im < Real.log (r₃ / 2) := by
              have : -Real.log (r₃ / 2) ≤ Y₀ := le_max_right _ _
              linarith
            calc
              Real.exp (-s.im) < Real.exp (Real.log (r₃ / 2)) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlt
              _ = r₃ / 2 := Real.exp_log hr₃_half_pos
              _ < r₃ := half_lt_self hr₃_pos
          have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₃ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hz_norm
          obtain ⟨u, hu_ball, hVu_eq⟩ := hr₃_sub hz_mem
          have hu_ne : u ≠ u₀ := by
            intro hu0
            rw [hu0, hV_u0] at hVu_eq
            exact hz_ne hVu_eq.symm
          have hu_B₂ : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₂' \ {u₀} := ⟨hu_ball, hu_ne⟩
          have hv_eq_z : v_sl u = z := by
            have h2 := (hV_on_ball u hu_B₂).2
            simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h2
            exact h2.symm.trans hVu_eq
          have hu_rb : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_b \ {u₀} :=
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu_ball, hu_ne⟩
          have hFb : ‖F_hol (v_sl u)‖ ≤ M₀ := (h_ball_b u hu_rb).1
          rw [hv_eq_z] at hFb
          have hFs : F_hol z = K.f s := (h_bridge s).2.1
          rwa [hFs] at hFb
        · intro s hs_im
          let z : ℂ := Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * s))
          have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
          have hz_norm : ‖z‖ < r₃ := by
            have hre : (-(Complex.I * s)).re = s.im := by simp
            rw [Complex.norm_exp, hre]
            have hlt : s.im < Real.log (r₃ / 2) := by
              have : -Real.log (r₃ / 2) ≤ Y₀ := le_max_right _ _
              linarith
            calc
              Real.exp s.im < Real.exp (Real.log (r₃ / 2)) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hlt
              _ = r₃ / 2 := Real.exp_log hr₃_half_pos
              _ < r₃ := half_lt_self hr₃_pos
          have hz_mem : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₃ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hz_norm
          obtain ⟨u, hu_ball, hVu_eq⟩ := hr₃_sub hz_mem
          have hu_ne : u ≠ u₀ := by
            intro hu0
            rw [hu0, hV_u0] at hVu_eq
            exact hz_ne hVu_eq.symm
          have hu_B₂ : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r₂' \ {u₀} := ⟨hu_ball, hu_ne⟩
          have hv_inv_eq : (v_sl u)⁻¹ = z := by
            have h2 := (hV_on_ball u hu_B₂).2
            simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h2
            exact h2.symm.trans hVu_eq
          have hv_eq_exp : v_sl u = Complex.exp (Complex.I * s) := by
            rw [← inv_inv (v_sl u), hv_inv_eq]
            dsimp [z]
            rw [Complex.exp_neg, inv_inv]
          have hu_rb : u ∈ Metric.ball u₀ r_b \ {u₀} :=
            ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu_ball, hu_ne⟩
          have hFb : ‖F_hol (v_sl u)‖ ≤ M₀ := (h_ball_b u hu_rb).1
          rw [hv_eq_exp, (h_bridge s).2.1] at hFb
          exact hFb
      intro s hs_abs
      rcases lt_abs.mp hs_abs with hs_pos | hs_neg
      · by_cases hk_pos : 0 < k
        · simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h_one_side
          exact h_one_side s hs_pos
        · simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h_one_side
          have h_conj_im : (starRingEnd ℂ s).im < -Y₀ := by
            simp only [Complex.conj_im]
            linarith
          have h1 := h_one_side (starRingEnd ℂ s) h_conj_im
          rw [K.f_conj s (hMem s), Complex.norm_conj] at h1
          exact h1
      · by_cases hk_pos : 0 < k
        · simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h_one_side
          have h_conj_im : Y₀ < (starRingEnd ℂ s).im := by
            simp only [Complex.conj_im]
            linarith
          have h1 := h_one_side (starRingEnd ℂ s) h_conj_im
          rw [K.f_conj s (hMem s), Complex.norm_conj] at h1
          exact h1
        · simp only [hk_pos, ↓reduceIte] at h_one_side
          exact h_one_side s (by linarith)

    
    let R_box : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi + Y₀
    have hR_box_nonneg : 0 ≤ R_box := by
      dsimp [R_box, Y₀]
      linarith [Real.pi_pos, le_max_left 1 (-Real.log (r₃ / 2))]
    obtain ⟨s_max, _, hs_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_box).exists_isMaxOn
      ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR_box_nonneg⟩
      (continuous_norm.comp h_f_ent.continuous).continuousOn
    let M_all : ℝ := max M₀ ‖K.f s_max‖
    have hf_bdd_all : ∀ s : ℂ, ‖K.f s‖ ≤ M_all := by
      intro s
      by_cases hs_out : Y₀ < |s.im|
      · exact le_trans (hf_halfplanes s hs_out) (le_max_left _ _)
      · have hs_in : |s.im| ≤ Y₀ := not_lt.mp hs_out
        let q : ℤ := ⌊s.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        let s₀ : ℂ := s - (q : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
        have h_twopi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
        have hs₀_re_nonneg : 0 ≤ s₀.re := by
          have hle : (q : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ s.re :=
            (le_div_iff₀ h_twopi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le _)
          have hre : s₀.re = s.re - (q : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by simp [s₀]
          linarith
        have hs₀_re_lt : s₀.re < 2 * Real.pi := by
          have hlt : s.re < ((q : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi) :=
            (div_lt_iff₀ h_twopi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
          have hre : s₀.re = s.re - (q : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by simp [s₀]
          linarith
        have hs₀_im : s₀.im = s.im := by simp [s₀]
        have hs₀_norm : ‖s₀‖ ≤ R_box := by
          calc
            ‖s₀‖ ≤ |s₀.re| + |s₀.im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im s₀
            _ = s₀.re + |s.im| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs₀_re_nonneg, hs₀_im]
            _ ≤ 2 * Real.pi + Y₀ := by linarith
        have hs₀_mem : s₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_box := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hs₀_norm
        have hfs_eq : K.f s₀ = K.f s := h_f_per.sub_int_mul_eq q
        have hle_max : ‖K.f s₀‖ ≤ ‖K.f s_max‖ := hs_max hs₀_mem
        rw [hfs_eq] at hle_max
        exact le_trans hle_max (le_max_right _ _)
    have hf_range_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range K.f) :=
      isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr ⟨M_all, by rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩; exact hf_bdd_all s⟩
    obtain ⟨c_const, hc_const⟩ := h_f_ent.exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded hf_range_bdd
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_ne⟩ := K.f_nonconstant
    have h_fn_const : K.f = fun _ => c_const := funext hc_const
    rw [h_fn_const, deriv_const] at hx₀_ne
    exact hx₀_ne rfl

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_slice_circle : ∀ (p₀ q₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ) (B_chart : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ B_chart (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) →
      B_chart p₀ = 0 →
      q₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (r₀ / 2) →
      B_chart q₁ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (ρ₁ δ_p : ℝ),
        0 < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < δ_p ∧ δ_p ≤ r₀ / 8 ∧
        (∀ u : ℂ, 0 < ‖u‖ → ‖u‖ ≤ ρ₁ → B_chart (p₀ + u • (q₁ - p₀)) ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ δ_p,
          (∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2), p + u • (q₁ - p₀) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₀) ∧
          (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) ρ₁, B_chart (p + ζ • (q₁ - p₀)) ≠ 0) ∧
          { u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ | B_chart (p + u • (q₁ - p₀)) = 0 } ⊆
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ ∧
          { u ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ | B_chart (p + u • (q₁ - p₀)) = 0 }.Finite := by
    intro p₀ q₁ r₀ B_chart _hr₀ hB_holo hBp₀ hq₁_mem hq₁_nz
    set e₁ : ℂ × ℂ := q₁ - p₀
    have he₁_nz : e₁ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hq₁_nz
      rw [sub_eq_zero.mp h, hBp₀]
    have he₁_pos : 0 < ‖e₁‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr he₁_nz
    have he₁_lt : ‖e₁‖ < r₀ / 2 := by simpa [e₁, dist_eq_norm] using hq₁_mem
    let b : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => B_chart (p₀ + u • e₁)
    have hb_maps :
        Set.MapsTo (fun u : ℂ => p₀ + u • e₁) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) (Metric.ball p₀ r₀) := by
      intro u hu
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul]
      have hu_lt : ‖u‖ < 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hu
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg u]
    have hb_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) :=
      hB_holo.comp ((differentiable_id.smul_const e₁).const_add p₀).differentiableOn hb_maps
    have hb_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ b (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hb_holo
    have hb_ev_ne : ∀ᶠ u in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, b u ≠ 0 := by
      rcases (hb_anal 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_two)).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero
        with h_zero | h_ne
      · exfalso
        have h_eq := hb_anal.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 2).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_two) h_zero
        have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2 := by norm_num [Metric.mem_ball]
        have hb1 : b 1 = 0 := h_eq h1_mem
        have hb1_eq : b 1 = B_chart q₁ := by simp [b, e₁]
        exact hq₁_nz (hb1_eq ▸ hb1)
      · exact h_ne
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hb_ev_ne
    let ρ₁ : ℝ := min (ε₀ / 2) (1 / 2)
    have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ := lt_min (half_pos hε₀_pos) (by norm_num)
    have hρ₁_le : ρ₁ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _

          exact hB_reg _ (h_in_r₀ u hu_ball32) hB_nz
        exact hPuncLim p₀ p e₁ u_star δ_star hp₀ hδ_star_pos hRad_star hReg_star
      exact ⟨hVp_eval p hp_inter Z_p hZ_sub hZ_fin hSubU (fun u hu => (hPunc_both u hu).1),
        hVm_eval p hp_inter Z_p hZ_sub hZ_fin hSubU (fun u hu => (hPunc_both u hu).2)⟩
  let V_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) v_p
  let V_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Filter.limUnder (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) v_m
  have hNeBot : ∀ q ∈ T_mero, (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg).NeBot :=
    fun q hq => mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp (hLocal q hq).1
  have hChartEq : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero, ∃ (δ₀ : ℝ) (Vp Vm : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ₀ ∧ Metric.ball p₀ δ₀ ⊆ T_mero ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Vp (Metric.ball p₀ δ₀) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Vm (Metric.ball p₀ δ₀) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ δ₀,
        V_plus q = Vp q ∧ V_minus q = Vm q ∧
        Filter.Tendsto v_p (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (V_plus q)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto v_m (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (V_minus q)) := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨δ₀, Vp, Vm, hδ₀, hball_T, hVp_holo, hVm_holo, hAgree⟩ := (hLocal p₀ hp₀).2
    refine ⟨δ₀, Vp, Vm, hδ₀, hball_T, hVp_holo, hVm_holo, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    haveI : (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg).NeBot := hNeBot q (hball_T hq)
    have hq_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ δ₀ ∈ nhds q := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq
    have hVp_tend : Filter.Tendsto Vp (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (Vp q)) :=
      ((hVp_holo.differentiableAt hq_nhds).continuousAt).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hVm_tend : Filter.Tendsto Vm (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (Vm q)) :=
      ((hVm_holo.differentiableAt hq_nhds).continuousAt).tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h_inter_mem : Metric.ball p₀ δ₀ ∩ Reg.U_reg ∈ nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg :=
      Filter.inter_mem (nhdsWithin_le_nhds hq_nhds) self_mem_nhdsWithin
    have h_ev_p : Vp =ᶠ[nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg] v_p := by
      filter_upwards [h_inter_mem] with x hx using (hAgree x hx).1
    have h_ev_m : Vm =ᶠ[nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg] v_m := by
      filter_upwards [h_inter_mem] with x hx using (hAgree x hx).2
    have hvp_tend : Filter.Tendsto v_p (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (Vp q)) :=
      hVp_tend.congr' h_ev_p
    have hvm_tend : Filter.Tendsto v_m (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg) (nhds (Vm q)) :=
      hVm_tend.congr' h_ev_m
    have hVp_eq : V_plus q = Vp q := hvp_tend.limUnder_eq
    have hVm_eq : V_minus q = Vm q := hvm_tend.limUnder_eq
    exact ⟨hVp_eq, hVm_eq, hVp_eq ▸ hvp_tend, hVm_eq ▸ hvm_tend⟩
  have hVp_holo_T : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_plus T_mero := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨δ₀, Vp, _, hδ₀, _, hVp_holo, _, hEq⟩ := hChartEq p₀ hp₀
    have h_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ δ₀ ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hδ₀
    have h_ev : V_plus =ᶠ[nhds p₀] Vp := by
      filter_upwards [h_nhds] with q hq using (hEq q hq).1
    exact ((hVp_holo.differentiableAt h_nhds).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
  have hVm_holo_T : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_minus T_mero := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨δ₀, _, Vm, hδ₀, _, _, hVm_holo, hEq⟩ := hChartEq p₀ hp₀
    have h_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ δ₀ ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hδ₀
    have h_ev : V_minus =ᶠ[nhds p₀] Vm := by
      filter_upwards [h_nhds] with q hq using (hEq q hq).2.1
    exact ((hVm_holo.differentiableAt h_nhds).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
  have hTend_T : ∀ p ∈ T_mero,
      Filter.Tendsto v_p (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) (nhds (V_plus p)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto v_m (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) (nhds (V_minus p)) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨δ₀, _, _, hδ₀, _, _, _, hEq⟩ := hChartEq p hp
    exact (hEq p (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀)).2.2
  have hVp_reg_eq : ∀ p ∈ Reg.U_reg, V_plus p = ExpLift.v p := by
    intro p hp
    haveI : (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg).NeBot := hNeBot p (Reg.U_reg_sub hp)
    have h_cont : Filter.Tendsto v_p (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) (nhds (v_p p)) :=
      ((hv_p_holo.differentiableAt (Reg.U_reg_open.mem_nhds hp)).continuousAt).tendsto.mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    exact h_cont.limUnder_eq
  have hV_mul_one : ∀ p ∈ T_mero, V_plus p * V_minus p = 1 := by
    intro p hp
    haveI : (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg).NeBot := hNeBot p hp
    obtain ⟨ht_p, ht_m⟩ := hTend_T p hp
    have ht_mul : Filter.Tendsto (fun q => v_p q * v_m q)
        (nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg) (nhds (V_plus p * V_minus p)) :=
      ht_p.mul ht_m
    have h_ev_one : (fun q => v_p q * v_m q) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin p Reg.U_reg] (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with q hq
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (ExpLift.v_ne_zero q hq)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique ht_mul (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h_ev_one.symm)
  have hV_wall_strict : ∀ H₀ : ℝ, M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ →
      0 < H₀ ∧ ∀ p ∈ T_mero, ‖V_plus p‖ < Real.exp H₀ ∧ ‖V_minus p‖ < Real.exp H₀ := by
    intro H₀ hH₀
    obtain ⟨hH₀_pos, hBdd_reg⟩ := hWallReg H₀ hH₀
    refine ⟨hH₀_pos, ?_⟩
    have hLe_T : ∀ q ∈ T_mero, ‖V_plus q‖ ≤ Real.exp H₀ ∧ ‖V_minus q‖ ≤ Real.exp H₀ := by
      intro q hq
      haveI : (nhdsWithin q Reg.U_reg).NeBot := hNeBot q hq
      obtain ⟨ht_p, ht_m⟩ := hTend_T q hq
      refine ⟨le_of_tendsto ht_p.norm ?_, le_of_tendsto ht_m.norm ?_⟩
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx using (hBdd_reg x hx).1
      · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx using (hBdd_reg x hx).2
    let o : ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
    have ho_ball : o ∈ Metric.ball o Reg.r_origin := Metric.mem_ball_self Reg.r_origin_pos
    have ho_reg : o ∈ Reg.U_reg := (Reg.ball_origin_sub ho_ball).1
    have ho_T : o ∈ T_mero := Reg.U_reg_sub ho_reg
    have h_init_0 : K.𝔰_init o = 0 := K.𝔰_init_zero 0 (by simp [K.s_init_pos])
    have hVp_o : V_plus o = 1 := by
      rw [hVp_reg_eq o ho_reg, ExpLift.v_origin_eq o ho_ball, h_init_0]
      simp
    have hVm_o : V_minus o = 1 := by
      have hmul := hV_mul_one o ho_T
      rw [hVp_o, one_mul] at hmul
      exact hmul
    have h1_lt_exp : 1 < Real.exp H₀ := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hH₀_pos
    have h_strict_of_holo : ∀ (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F T_mero →
        (∀ q ∈ T_mero, ‖F q‖ ≤ Real.exp H₀) →
        F o = 1 →
        ∀ p ∈ T_mero, ‖F p‖ < Real.exp H₀ := by
      intro F hF_holo hF_le hFo p hp
      apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hF_le p hp)
      intro h_eq
      have h_max : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ F) T_mero p := by
        rw [isMaxOn_iff]
        intro q hq
        simpa [Function.comp_apply, h_eq] using hF_le q hq
      have h_const := Complex.norm_eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn
        Reg.T_mero_preconnected Reg.T_mero_open hF_holo hp h_max ho_T
      have hFo_norm : ‖F o‖ = Real.exp H₀ := by
        simpa [Function.comp_apply, h_eq] using h_const
      rw [hFo, norm_one] at hFo_norm
      exact ne_of_lt h1_lt_exp hFo_norm
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨h_strict_of_holo V_plus hVp_holo_T (fun q hq => (hLe_T q hq).1) hVp_o p hp,
      h_strict_of_holo V_minus hVm_holo_T (fun q hq => (hLe_T q hq).2) hVm_o p hp⟩
  exact ⟨{
    V_plus := V_plus
    V_minus := V_minus
    V_plus_holo := hVp_holo_T
    V_minus_holo := hVm_holo_T
    V_mul_one := hV_mul_one
    V_plus_reg_eq := hVp_reg_eq
    V_wall_strict := hV_wall_strict
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (ExpLift : RegularExponentialLiftData C M K Reg)
    (VExt : GlobalExponentialExtensionData C M K Reg ExpLift) :
    ∃ 𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_raw p) = VExt.V_plus p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
        𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin,
        𝔰_raw q = K.𝔰_init q)

signature.name: vertical_poincare_logarithmic_lift
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set Plane)
    (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C)
    (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (Reg : RegularCollarLocusData C M K)
    (ExpLift : RegularExponentialLiftData C M K Reg)
    (VExt : GlobalExponentialExtensionData C M K Reg ExpLift) :
    ∃ 𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
        Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_raw p) = VExt.V_plus p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
        𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin,
        𝔰_raw q = K.𝔰_init q)

proof.tactics:
by
  let T_mero : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X
  let B_orig : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) Reg.r_origin
  
  have h_slice : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ h W → ∀ p ∈ W,
        HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, p.2)) (iterDerivYT 1 0 h p) p.1 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (p.1, w)) (iterDerivYT 0 1 h p) p.2 ∧
        ∀ v_dir : ℂ × ℂ,
          fderiv ℂ h p v_dir = v_dir.1 * iterDerivYT 1 0 h p + v_dir.2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 h p := by
    intro W h hW hh p hp
    have hf : HasFDerivAt h (fderiv ℂ h p) p :=
      (hh.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hy_raw : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, p.2)) (fderiv ℂ h p ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) p.1 :=
      hf.comp_hasDerivAt p.1 ((hasDerivAt_id p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const p.1 p.2))
    have ht_raw : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (p.1, w)) (fderiv ℂ h p ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) p.2 :=
      hf.comp_hasDerivAt p.2 ((hasDerivAt_const p.2 p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id p.2))
    have hy_eq : iterDerivYT 1 0 h p = fderiv ℂ h p ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) := hy_raw.deriv
    have ht_eq : iterDerivYT 0 1 h p = fderiv ℂ h p ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := ht_raw.deriv
    have hy_d : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => h (z, p.2)) (iterDerivYT 1 0 h p) p.1 := by
      rwa [← hy_eq] at hy_raw
    have ht_d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => h (p.1, w)) (iterDerivYT 0 1 h p) p.2 := by
      rwa [← ht_eq] at ht_raw
    refine ⟨hy_d, ht_d, fun v_dir => ?_⟩
    have hv : v_dir = v_dir.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v_dir.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, ← hy_eq, ← ht_eq]
  have h_const_zero : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      IsOpen W → IsPreconnected W → DifferentiableOn ℂ h W →
      (∀ q ∈ W, iterDerivYT 1 0 h q = 0 ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 h q = 0) →
      ∀ {q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ}, q₁ ∈ W → q₂ ∈ W → h q₁ = h q₂ := by
    intro W h hW hPre hh hZero q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂
    have hf0 : Set.EqOn (fderiv ℂ h) 0 W := by
      intro q hq
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v_dir
      rw [(h_slice hW hh q hq).2.2 v_dir, (hZero q hq).1, (hZero q hq).2]
      simp
    exact hW.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero hPre hh hf0 hq₁ hq₂
  
  let η_y : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => -Complex.I * VExt.V_minus p * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p
  let η_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => -Complex.I * VExt.V_minus p * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p
  have hVp_partials := Reg.iterDerivYT_holo Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_plus_holo
  have hVy_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus) T_mero := hVp_partials.1
  have hVt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus) T_mero := hVp_partials.2.1
  have hηy_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ η_y T_mero :=
    ((differentiableOn_const (-Complex.I)).mul VExt.V_minus_holo).mul hVy_holo
  have hηt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ η_t T_mero :=
    ((differentiableOn_const (-Complex.I)).mul VExt.V_minus_holo).mul hVt_holo
  have hη_closed : ∀ p ∈ T_mero, iterDerivYT 0 1 η_y p = iterDerivYT 1 0 η_t p := by
    intro p hp
    have h_mul_t_ev : ((fun w : ℂ => VExt.V_plus (p.1, w)) *
        (fun w : ℂ => VExt.V_minus (p.1, w))) =ᶠ[nhds p.2] (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [(Reg.T_mero_open.preimage
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hp] with w hw
      exact VExt.V_mul_one (p.1, w) hw
    have h_mul_y_ev : ((fun z : ℂ => VExt.V_plus (z, p.2)) *
        (fun z : ℂ => VExt.V_minus (z, p.2))) =ᶠ[nhds p.1] (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) := by
      filter_upwards [(Reg.T_mero_open.preimage
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hp] with z hz
      exact VExt.V_mul_one (z, p.2) hz
    have hVp_y := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_plus_holo p hp).1
    have hVp_t := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_plus_holo p hp).2.1
    have hVm_y := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_minus_holo p hp).1
    have hVm_t := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_minus_holo p hp).2.1
    have h_prod_t : iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p +
        VExt.V_plus p * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p = 0 :=
      (hVp_t.mul hVm_t).unique ((hasDerivAt_const p.2 (1 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_mul_t_ev)
    have h_prod_y : iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p +
        VExt.V_plus p * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p = 0 :=
      (hVp_y.mul hVm_y).unique ((hasDerivAt_const p.1 (1 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_mul_y_ev)
    have hmul_p : VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p = 1 := VExt.V_mul_one p hp
    have hVm_t_eq :
        iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p = -(VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p := by
      calc iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p
          = (VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p := by
              rw [hmul_p, one_mul]
        _ = VExt.V_minus p * (iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p +
              VExt.V_plus p * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p) -
            (VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p := by ring
        _ = -(VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p := by rw [h_prod_t]; ring
    have hVm_y_eq :
        iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p = -(VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p := by
      calc iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p
          = (VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p := by
              rw [hmul_p, one_mul]
        _ = VExt.V_minus p * (iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p * VExt.V_minus p +
              VExt.V_plus p * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p) -
            (VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p := by ring
        _ = -(VExt.V_minus p) ^ 2 * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p := by rw [h_prod_y]; ring
    have hVy_t := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open hVy_holo p hp).2.1
    have hVt_y := (h_slice Reg.T_mero_open hVt_holo p hp).1
    have hηy_t_eq : iterDerivYT 0 1 η_y p =
        (-Complex.I * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus p +
          (-Complex.I * VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 0 1 (iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_plus) p :=
      ((hVm_t.const_mul (-Complex.I)).mul hVy_t).deriv
    have hηt_y_eq : iterDerivYT 1 0 η_t p =
        (-Complex.I * iterDerivYT 1 0 VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus p +
          (-Complex.I * VExt.V_minus p) * iterDerivYT 1 0 (iterDerivYT 0 1 VExt.V_plus) p :=
      ((hVm_y.const_mul (-Complex.I)).mul hVt_y).deriv
    have hcomm := Reg.iterDerivYT_comm Reg.T_mero_open VExt.V_plus_holo p hp
    rw [hηy_t_eq, hηt_y_eq, hVm_t_eq, hVm_y_eq, hcomm]
    ring
  have hOrig_T : B_orig ⊆ T_mero := fun q hq => Reg.U_reg_sub (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).1
  have hOrig_init : B_orig ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init } :=
    fun q hq => (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).2
  have h_sinit_orig_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ K.𝔰_init B_orig := K.𝔰_init_holo.mono hOrig_init
  have hVp_orig_eq : ∀ q ∈ B_orig, VExt.V_plus q = Complex.exp (Complex.I * K.𝔰_init q) :=
    fun q hq => (VExt.V_plus_reg_eq q (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).1).trans (ExpLift.v_origin_eq q hq)
  have hη_orig : ∀ q ∈ B_orig,
      η_y q = iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q ∧ η_t q = iterDerivYT 0 1 K.𝔰_init q := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_T : q ∈ T_mero := hOrig_T hq
    have hmul_q : VExt.V_plus q * VExt.V_minus q = 1 := VExt.V_mul_one q hq_T
    have h_sy := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball h_sinit_orig_holo q hq).1
    have h_st := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball h_sinit_orig_holo q hq).2.1
    have h_ey : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * K.𝔰_init (z, q.2)))
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * K.𝔰_init q) * (Complex.I * iterDerivYT 1 0 K.𝔰_init q)) q.1 :=

      p ∈ W_of p hp ∧
      W_of p hp ⊆ T_mero ∧
      (∀ q ∈ W_of p hp, ((q.1.re : ℂ), q.2) ∈ W_of p hp ∩ B_base) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_of p hp) (W_of p hp) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ W_of p hp,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (F_of p hp) q = η_y q ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 (F_of p hp) q = η_t q) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ W_of p hp ∩ B_base, F_of p hp q = 𝔰_base q) :=
    fun p hp => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_charts p hp))
  have h_overlap : ∀ p₁ (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ T_mero) p₂ (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ T_mero),
      ∀ q ∈ W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂, F_of p₁ hp₁ q = F_of p₂ hp₂ q := by
    intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ q hq
    have hs₁ := h_spec p₁ hp₁
    have hs₂ := h_spec p₂ hp₂
    let q_re : ℂ × ℂ := ((q.1.re : ℂ), q.2)
    have hq_re₁ := hs₁.2.2.2.2.1 q hq.1
    have hq_re₂ := hs₂.2.2.2.2.1 q hq.2
    have hq_re_int : q_re ∈ W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂ := ⟨hq_re₁.1, hq_re₂.1⟩
    have hInt_open : IsOpen (W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂) := hs₁.1.inter hs₂.1
    have hInt_pre : IsPreconnected (W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂) :=
      (hs₁.2.1.inter hs₂.2.1).isPreconnected
    have hDiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => F_of p₁ hp₁ x - F_of p₂ hp₂ x)
        (W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂) :=
      (hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.1.mono Set.inter_subset_left).sub
        (hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.1.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
    have hDiff_zero : ∀ x ∈ W_of p₁ hp₁ ∩ W_of p₂ hp₂,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun z => F_of p₁ hp₁ z - F_of p₂ hp₂ z) x = 0 ∧
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun z => F_of p₁ hp₁ z - F_of p₂ hp₂ z) x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1_y := (h_slice hs₁.1 hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.1).1
      have h1_t := (h_slice hs₁.1 hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.1).2.1
      have h2_y := (h_slice hs₂.1 hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.2).1
      have h2_t := (h_slice hs₂.1 hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.2).2.1
      refine ⟨(h1_y.sub h2_y).deriv.trans ?_, (h1_t.sub h2_t).deriv.trans ?_⟩
      · rw [(hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.1).1, (hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.2).1, sub_self]
      · rw [(hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.1).2, (hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 x hx.2).2, sub_self]
    have h_eq := h_const_zero hInt_open hInt_pre hDiff_holo hDiff_zero hq hq_re_int
    rw [hs₁.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 q_re hq_re₁, hs₂.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 q_re hq_re₂, sub_self] at h_eq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
  classical
  let 𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => if hp : p ∈ T_mero then F_of p hp p else 0
  have h_local_eq : ∀ p₀ (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ T_mero), ∀ q ∈ W_of p₀ hp₀,
      𝔰_raw q = F_of p₀ hp₀ q := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ q hq_W
    have hs₀ := h_spec p₀ hp₀
    have hq_T : q ∈ T_mero := hs₀.2.2.2.1 hq_W
    have h_dif : 𝔰_raw q = F_of q hq_T q := by simp [𝔰_raw, hq_T]
    rw [h_dif]
    exact h_overlap q hq_T p₀ hp₀ q ⟨(h_spec q hq_T).2.2.1, hq_W⟩
  have hHolo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰_raw T_mero := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    have hs₀ := h_spec p₀ hp₀
    have h_ev : 𝔰_raw =ᶠ[nhds p₀] F_of p₀ hp₀ := by
      filter_upwards [hs₀.1.mem_nhds hs₀.2.2.1] with q hq
      exact h_local_eq p₀ hp₀ q hq
    exact ((hs₀.2.2.2.2.2.1.differentiableAt
      (hs₀.1.mem_nhds hs₀.2.2.1)).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
  have hPartials : ∀ p₀ ∈ T_mero,
      iterDerivYT 1 0 𝔰_raw p₀ = η_y p₀ ∧ iterDerivYT 0 1 𝔰_raw p₀ = η_t p₀ := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    have hs₀ := h_spec p₀ hp₀
    have h_ev_y : (fun z : ℂ => 𝔰_raw (z, p₀.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p₀.1]
        (fun z : ℂ => F_of p₀ hp₀ (z, p₀.2)) := by
      filter_upwards [(hs₀.1.preimage
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).mem_nhds hs₀.2.2.1] with z hz
      exact h_local_eq p₀ hp₀ (z, p₀.2) hz
    have h_ev_t : (fun w : ℂ => 𝔰_raw (p₀.1, w)) =ᶠ[nhds p₀.2]
        (fun w : ℂ => F_of p₀ hp₀ (p₀.1, w)) := by
      filter_upwards [(hs₀.1.preimage
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mem_nhds hs₀.2.2.1] with w hw
      exact h_local_eq p₀ hp₀ (p₀.1, w) hw
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact h_ev_y.deriv_eq.trans (hs₀.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 p₀ hs₀.2.2.1).1
    · exact h_ev_t.deriv_eq.trans (hs₀.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 p₀ hs₀.2.2.1).2
  have h0_T : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ T_mero := hB_sub_T h0_B
  have hZero0 : 𝔰_raw ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    have hs0 := h_spec ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) h0_T
    have h_dif : 𝔰_raw ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = F_of ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) h0_T ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) := by
      simp [𝔰_raw, h0_T]
    rw [h_dif, hs0.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ⟨hs0.2.2.1, h0_B⟩, h_sbase_0]
  
  have hOrig : ∀ q ∈ B_orig, 𝔰_raw q = K.𝔰_init q := by
    intro q hq
    have hDiff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => 𝔰_raw x - K.𝔰_init x) B_orig :=
      (hHolo.mono hOrig_T).sub h_sinit_orig_holo
    have hDiff_zero : ∀ x ∈ B_orig,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun z => 𝔰_raw z - K.𝔰_init z) x = 0 ∧
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun z => 𝔰_raw z - K.𝔰_init z) x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1_y := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball (hHolo.mono hOrig_T) x hx).1
      have h1_t := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball (hHolo.mono hOrig_T) x hx).2.1
      have h2_y := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball h_sinit_orig_holo x hx).1
      have h2_t := (h_slice Metric.isOpen_ball h_sinit_orig_holo x hx).2.1
      refine ⟨(h1_y.sub h2_y).deriv.trans ?_, (h1_t.sub h2_t).deriv.trans ?_⟩
      · rw [(hPartials x (hOrig_T hx)).1, (hη_orig x hx).1, sub_self]
      · rw [(hPartials x (hOrig_T hx)).2, (hη_orig x hx).2, sub_self]
    have h0_orig : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_orig := Metric.mem_ball_self Reg.r_origin_pos
    have h_eq := h_const_zero Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      hDiff_holo hDiff_zero hq h0_orig
    have h_sinit_0 : K.𝔰_init ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = 0 :=
      K.𝔰_init_zero 0 (by simpa using K.s_init_pos)
    rw [hZero0, h_sinit_0, sub_self] at h_eq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
  have hExp : ∀ p ∈ T_mero, Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_raw p) = VExt.V_plus p := by
    let E_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_raw p)
    have hE_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ E_raw T_mero :=
      ((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul hHolo).cexp
    have hE_orig : ∀ q ∈ B_orig, E_raw q = VExt.V_plus q := by
      intro q hq
      dsimp only [E_raw]
      rw [hOrig q hq, ← hVp_orig_eq q hq]
    exact Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Reg.T_mero_open Reg.T_mero_preconnected
      hE_holo VExt.V_plus_holo h0_T Reg.r_origin_pos hOrig_T hE_orig
  have hMaps : ∀ p ∈ T_mero, 𝔰_raw p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
    intro p hp
    change ENNReal.ofReal |(𝔰_raw p).im| < M.h_X 0
    rcases eq_top_or_lt_top (M.h_X 0) with hTop | hLtTop
    · rw [hTop]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    · let H₀ : ℝ := (M.h_X 0).toReal
      have hH₀ : M.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ne_of_lt hLtTop)).symm
      obtain ⟨hH₀_pos, hWall⟩ := VExt.V_wall_strict H₀ hH₀
      obtain ⟨hVp_lt, hVm_lt⟩ := hWall p hp
      have h_exp_norm : ‖VExt.V_plus p‖ = Real.exp (-(𝔰_raw p).im) := by
        rw [← hExp p hp, Complex.norm_exp]
        congr 1
        simp [Complex.mul_re]
      have h_neg_lt : -(𝔰_raw p).im < H₀ := Real.exp_lt_exp.mp (h_exp_norm ▸ hVp_lt)
      have h_vm_norm : ‖VExt.V_minus p‖ = Real.exp (𝔰_raw p).im := by
        have h_prod_norm : Real.exp (-(𝔰_raw p).im) * ‖VExt.V_minus p‖ = 1 := by
          rw [← h_exp_norm, ← norm_mul, VExt.V_mul_one p hp, norm_one]
        have h_exp_cancel : Real.exp (-(𝔰_raw p).im) * Real.exp (𝔰_raw p).im = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Real.exp_ne_zero (-(𝔰_raw p).im))
          (h_prod_norm.trans h_exp_cancel.symm)
      have h_pos_lt : (𝔰_raw p).im < H₀ := Real.exp_lt_exp.mp (h_vm_norm ▸ hVm_lt)
      have h_abs_lt : |(𝔰_raw p).im| < H₀ := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, h_pos_lt⟩
      rw [hH₀]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hH₀_pos).mpr h_abs_lt
  exact ⟨𝔰_raw, hHolo, hExp, hMaps, hOrig⟩

(Ω : Set Plane)
