proof.tactics:
by
  let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
  have hp₀_orig : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin := Metric.mem_ball_self Reg.r_origin_pos
  have hB_orig_T : Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X :=
    fun q hq => Reg.U_reg_sub (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).1
  have hp₀_T : p₀ ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := hB_orig_T hp₀_orig
  let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < K.s_init ∧ ‖p.2‖ < K.r_init }
  have hB_init_eq : B_init =
      (Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) K.s_init) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) K.r_init := by
    ext p
    simp [B_init, Set.mem_prod]
  have hB_init_open : IsOpen B_init :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hB_init_preconn : IsPreconnected B_init := by
    rw [hB_init_eq]
    exact (((convex_ball (0 : ℝ) K.s_init).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).prod
      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) K.r_init)).isPreconnected
  have hB_init_T : B_init ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := by
    intro p hp
    apply Reg.base_sub_T_mero
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · linarith [hp.1, K.s_init_le, M.s_base_pos]
    · linarith [hp.2, K.r_init_le, M.r_base_pos]
  have hB_orig_init : Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin ⊆ B_init :=
    fun q hq => (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).2
  have h_init_eq : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < K.s_init → ‖t‖ < K.r_init →
      𝔰_raw (y, t) = K.𝔰_init (y, t) := by
    intro y t hy ht
    exact Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D hB_init_open hB_init_preconn
      (hHolo.mono hB_init_T) K.𝔰_init_holo (hB_orig_init hp₀_orig)
      Reg.r_origin_pos hB_orig_init hOrig (y, t) ⟨hy, ht⟩
  have hDH_iff : ∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ↔
      y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
    intro y
    simp only [meroTubeENNR, horizStripENNR, Set.mem_setOf_eq, norm_zero, map_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hneg, hpos⟩
      rcases abs_choice y.im with h_eq | h_eq <;> rwa [h_eq]
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨M.r_base_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (neg_le_abs y.im)) hy
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_abs_self y.im)) hy
  have hDH_preimage : horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) =
      (fun y : ℂ => (y, (0 : ℂ))) ⁻¹' meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := by
    ext y
    exact (hDH_iff y).symm
  have hDH_open : IsOpen (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) := by
    rw [hDH_preimage]
    exact Reg.T_mero_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hDH_conv : Convex ℝ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) := by
    intro s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ a b ha hb hab
    simp only [horizStripENNR, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hs₁ hs₂ ⊢
    have him : |(a • s₁ + b • s₂).im| ≤ max |s₁.im| |s₂.im| := by
      calc |(a • s₁ + b • s₂).im|
          = |a * s₁.im + b * s₂.im| := by simp
        _ ≤ |a * s₁.im| + |b * s₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |s₁.im| + b * |s₂.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ ≤ a * max |s₁.im| |s₂.im| + b * max |s₁.im| |s₂.im| := by
            gcongr
            · exact le_max_left _ _
            · exact le_max_right _ _
        _ = max |s₁.im| |s₂.im| := by
            rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
    rcases le_total |s₁.im| |s₂.im| with hle | hle
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (him.trans_eq (max_eq_right hle))) hs₂
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (him.trans_eq (max_eq_left hle))) hs₁
  have h_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), 𝔰_raw (y, 0) = y := by
    intro y hy
    let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ×ˢ Set.univ
    have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := hDH_open.prod isOpen_univ
    have hW₀_preconn : IsPreconnected W₀ := (hDH_conv.prod convex_univ).isPreconnected
    have hf₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => 𝔰_raw (p.1, 0)) W₀ :=
      hHolo.comp (differentiableOn_fst.prodMk (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ)))
        (fun p hp => (hDH_iff p.1).mpr hp.1)
    have hq1_im : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ K.s_init, |q.1.im| < K.s_init := by
      intro q hq
      have hqn : ‖q‖ < K.s_init := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hq
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm q.1) (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_fst_le q) hqn)
    have hball_W₀ : Metric.ball p₀ K.s_init ⊆ W₀ := by
      intro q hq
      refine ⟨(hDH_iff q.1).mp (Reg.base_sub_T_mero ⟨?_, ?_⟩), Set.mem_univ _⟩
      · linarith [hq1_im q hq, K.s_init_le, M.s_base_pos]
      · simp [M.r_base_pos]
    have hp₀_W₀ : p₀ ∈ W₀ := hball_W₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self K.s_init_pos)
    have hball_eq : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ K.s_init, 𝔰_raw (q.1, 0) = q.1 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq1 := hq1_im q hq
      rw [h_init_eq q.1 0 hq1 (by simpa using K.r_init_pos), K.𝔰_init_zero q.1 hq1]
    exact Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D hW₀_open hW₀_preconn hf₀_holo differentiableOn_fst
      hp₀_W₀ K.s_init_pos hball_W₀ hball_eq (y, 0) ⟨hy, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have h_qp : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
      𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰_raw p + 2 * Real.pi := by
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ), p.2))
        (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) := by
      intro p hp
      simpa [meroTubeENNR] using hp
    have h_lhs : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => 𝔰_raw (p.1 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ), p.2))
        (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) :=
      hHolo.comp ((differentiableOn_fst.add_const (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).prodMk
        differentiableOn_snd) h_maps
    have h_rhs : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => 𝔰_raw p + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
        (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) :=
      hHolo.add_const (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
    have h_orig : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin,
        𝔰_raw (q.1 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ), q.2) = 𝔰_raw q + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hy, ht⟩ := (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).2
      have hy' : |(q.1 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im| < K.s_init := by simpa using hy
      rw [h_init_eq (q.1 + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) q.2 hy' ht, h_init_eq q.1 q.2 hy ht,
        K.𝔰_init_quasiperiodic q.1 q.2 hy ht]
    exact Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Reg.T_mero_open Reg.T_mero_preconnected
      h_lhs h_rhs hp₀_T Reg.r_origin_pos hB_orig_T h_orig
  have h_even : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰_raw p := by
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, -p.2))
        (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨ht, hneg, hpos⟩
      have ht_ball : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ht
      have hct_ball : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M.r_base :=
        mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (by simpa using ht)
      refine ⟨by simpa using ht, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [map_neg, M.h_X_even (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) hct_ball] using hneg
      · simpa [M.h_X_even p.2 ht_ball] using hpos
    have h_lhs : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => 𝔰_raw (p.1, -p.2))
        (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) :=
      hHolo.comp (differentiableOn_fst.prodMk differentiableOn_snd.neg) h_maps
    have h_orig : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin, 𝔰_raw (q.1, -q.2) = 𝔰_raw q := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hy, ht⟩ := (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).2
      rw [h_init_eq q.1 (-q.2) hy (by simpa using ht), h_init_eq q.1 q.2 hy ht,
        K.𝔰_init_even q.1 q.2 hy ht]
    exact Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Reg.T_mero_open Reg.T_mero_preconnected
      h_lhs hHolo hp₀_T Reg.r_origin_pos hB_orig_T h_orig
  have h_conj : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
      𝔰_raw (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰_raw p) := by
    have hT_star : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X,
        star p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨ht, hneg, hpos⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def] using ht
      · simpa [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def] using hpos
      · simpa [Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def] using hneg
    let g_conj : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := star ∘ 𝔰_raw ∘ star
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_conj (meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X) := by
      intro p hp
      have h_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ 𝔰_raw (star p) :=
        hHolo.differentiableAt (Reg.T_mero_open.mem_nhds (hT_star p hp))
      have h_ss := h_at.star_star
      rw [star_star] at h_ss
      exact h_ss.differentiableWithinAt
    have hg_orig : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ Reg.r_origin, g_conj q = 𝔰_raw q := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨hy, ht⟩ := (Reg.ball_origin_sub hq).2
      have hy' : |(starRingEnd ℂ q.1).im| < K.s_init := by simpa using hy
      have ht' : ‖starRingEnd ℂ q.2‖ < K.r_init := by simpa using ht
      change star (𝔰_raw (star q.1, star q.2)) = 𝔰_raw q
      rw [Complex.star_def, h_init_eq (starRingEnd ℂ q.1) (starRingEnd ℂ q.2) hy' ht',
        K.𝔰_init_conj q.1 q.2 hy ht, h_init_eq q.1 q.2 hy ht]
      exact Complex.conj_conj _
    intro p hp
    have h_eq : g_conj p = 𝔰_raw p :=
      Reg.eqOn_of_preconnected_2D Reg.T_mero_open Reg.T_mero_preconnected
        hg_holo hHolo hp₀_T Reg.r_origin_pos hB_orig_T hg_orig p hp
    have h_ap := congrArg star h_eq
    simpa [g_conj, Function.comp_apply, Prod.star_def, Complex.star_def] using h_ap
  have hDH_shift : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
      s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := by
    intro k s hs
    have him : (s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))).im = s.im := by simp
    simpa [horizStripENNR, him] using hs
  have h_f_int : ∀ (k : ℤ), ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
      K.f (s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = K.f s := by
    intro k
    refine Int.induction_on k ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s _; simp
    · intro n ih s hs
      have h_step : s + (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
          (s + ((n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_step, K.f_periodic _ (hDH_shift (n : ℤ) s hs), ih s hs]
    · intro n ih s hs
      let s' : ℂ := s + ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
      have hs' : s' ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := hDH_shift (-(n : ℤ) - 1) s hs
      have h_step : s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) =
          s + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
        dsimp [s']; push_cast; ring
      calc K.f s' = K.f (s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := (K.f_periodic s' hs').symm
        _ = K.f (s + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) := by rw [h_step]
        _ = K.f s := ih s hs
  have h_Γ_int : ∀ (k : ℤ), ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
      K.Γ (s + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = K.Γ s := by
    intro k
    refine Int.induction_on k ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro s _ _; simp
    · intro n ih s hs hfs
      let s_n : ℂ := s + ((n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
      have hs_n : s_n ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := hDH_shift (n : ℤ) s hs
      have hfs_n : K.f s_n ≠ 0 := by
        dsimp [s_n]
        rwa [h_f_int (n : ℤ) s hs]
      have h_step : s + (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
          s_n + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [s_n]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h_step, K.Γ_periodic s_n hs_n hfs_n]
      exact ih s hs hfs
    · intro n ih s hs hfs
      let s' : ℂ := s + ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
      have hs' : s' ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) := hDH_shift (-(n : ℤ) - 1) s hs
      have hfs' : K.f s' ≠ 0 := by
        dsimp [s']
        rwa [h_f_int (-(n : ℤ) - 1) s hs]
      have h_step : s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) =
          s + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
        dsimp [s']; push_cast; ring
      calc K.Γ s' = K.Γ (s' + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := (K.Γ_periodic s' hs' hfs').symm
        _ = K.Γ (s + ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) := by rw [h_step]
        _ = K.Γ s := ih s hs hfs
  have h_reg_impact : ∀ q ∈ Reg.U_reg, ∀ i : Fin 2, Reg.X_true i q = K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i := by
    intro q hq i
    obtain ⟨r_loc, 𝔰_loc, hr_loc, _, _, h_loc⟩ := ExpLift.v_local_lift q hq
    obtain ⟨hv_eq, hs_mem, hf_nz, hX_eq⟩ := h_loc q (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_loc)
    have hexp : Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_raw q) = Complex.exp (Complex.I * 𝔰_loc q) :=
      (hExpReg q hq).trans hv_eq.symm
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp hexp
    have hs_eq : 𝔰_raw q = 𝔰_loc q + (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
      linear_combination hk
    rw [hs_eq, h_Γ_int k (𝔰_loc q) hs_mem hf_nz, hX_eq i]
  have h_mero_agrees : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → U ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X → ContinuousOn G U →
      (∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ Reg.U_reg → Reg.X_true i q = G q) →
      MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) G U := by
    intro i U G hU_open hU_sub hG_cont hG_reg
    refine ⟨hU_sub, ?_⟩
    intro p₁ hp₁
    have hp₁_T : p₁ ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := hU_sub hp₁
    obtain ⟨ε_U, hε_U_pos, hε_U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p₁ hp₁
    let r₁ : ℝ := min ((M.X_mero i).rad p₁) ε_U
    have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min ((M.X_mero i).rad_pos p₁ hp₁_T) hε_U_pos
    have hr₁_le : r₁ ≤ (M.X_mero i).rad p₁ := min_le_left _ _
    have hr₁_sub : Metric.ball p₁ r₁ ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hε_U
    refine ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_le, hr₁_sub, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    have hq_U : q ∈ U := hr₁_sub hq
    have hq_T : q ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X := hU_sub hq_U
    have hq_rad_p₁ : q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ((M.X_mero i).rad p₁) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le hq
    let LHS : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (M.X_mero i).num p₁
    let RHS : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w => G w * (M.X_mero i).den p₁ w
    have hLHS_cont : ContinuousAt LHS q :=
      (((M.X_mero i).num_holo p₁ hp₁_T).differentiableAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq_rad_p₁)).continuousAt
    have hDen_cont : ContinuousAt ((M.X_mero i).den p₁) q :=
      (((M.X_mero i).den_holo p₁ hp₁_T).differentiableAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq_rad_p₁)).continuousAt
    have hRHS_cont : ContinuousAt RHS q :=
      (hG_cont.continuousAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hq_U)).mul hDen_cont
    obtain ⟨r_q, B_chart, hr_q, hr_q_rad, _, hB_holo, ⟨q_nz, hq_nz_mem, hB_qnz⟩, hB_reg⟩ :=
      Reg.chart_nonvanishing q hq_T
    have hr_q_i : r_q ≤ (M.X_mero i).rad q := by
      fin_cases i
      · exact hr_q_rad.trans (min_le_left _ _)
      · exact hr_q_rad.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hq_nz_norm : ‖q_nz - q‖ < r_q / 2 := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hq_nz_mem
    let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => q + z • (q_nz - q)
    have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
      (differentiable_const q).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (q_nz - q))
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := hγ_diff.continuous
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = q := by simp [γ]
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = q_nz := by simp [γ]
    have hγ_maps : Set.MapsTo γ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) (Metric.ball q r_q) := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
      rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
      have hsub : γ z - q = z • (q_nz - q) := add_sub_cancel_left q _
      rw [hsub, norm_smul]
      calc ‖z‖ * ‖q_nz - q‖
          ≤ ‖z‖ * (r_q / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hq_nz_norm) (norm_nonneg z)
        _ < 2 * (r_q / 2) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz_lt (half_pos hr_q)
        _ = r_q := by ring
    let b : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => B_chart (γ z)
    have hb_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ b (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) :=
      hB_holo.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn hγ_maps
    have hb_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ b (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) :=
      hb_holo.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hb_at0 : AnalyticAt ℂ b 0 := hb_ana 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self two_pos)
    have hb_nz : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, b z ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hb_at0.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with h_ev0 | h_ev_nz
      · exfalso
        have h1_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2 := by
          norm_num [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        have hb1 : b 1 = 0 :=
          hb_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 2).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self two_pos) h_ev0 h1_mem
        exact hB_qnz (by simpa [b, hγ1] using hb1)
      · exact h_ev_nz
    have hz_D2 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2 :=
      nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) two_pos)
    have hz_r1 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, γ z ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ :=
      nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hγ_cont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
        (by rw [hγ0]; exact Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq))
    have h_ev_eq : (LHS ∘ γ) =ᶠ[nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ] (RHS ∘ γ) := by
      filter_upwards [hb_nz, hz_D2, hz_r1] with z hbz hz2 hzr1
      have hq'_rq : γ z ∈ Metric.ball q r_q := hγ_maps hz2
      obtain ⟨hq'_reg, hq'_chart⟩ := hB_reg (γ z) hq'_rq hbz
      obtain ⟨h_den_q, h_num_q⟩ := hq'_chart i
      have hq'_rad_p₁ : γ z ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ((M.X_mero i).rad p₁) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le hzr1
      have hq'_rad_q : γ z ∈ Metric.ball q ((M.X_mero i).rad q) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_q_i hq'_rq
      have h_compat := (M.X_mero i).compat p₁ hp₁_T q hq_T (γ z) ⟨hq'_rad_p₁, hq'_rad_q⟩
      have h_X_eq : Reg.X_true i (γ z) = G (γ z) := hG_reg (γ z) (hr₁_sub hzr1) hq'_reg
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ h_den_q
      calc LHS (γ z) * (M.X_mero i).den q (γ z)
          = (M.X_mero i).num q (γ z) * (M.X_mero i).den p₁ (γ z) := h_compat
        _ = (Reg.X_true i (γ z) * (M.X_mero i).den q (γ z)) *
              (M.X_mero i).den p₁ (γ z) := by rw [h_num_q]
        _ = RHS (γ z) * (M.X_mero i).den q (γ z) := by
              dsimp [RHS]; rw [h_X_eq]; ring
    have hLHS_lim : Filter.Tendsto (LHS ∘ γ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhds (LHS q)) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (LHS ∘ γ) 0 :=
        (hγ0 ▸ hLHS_cont).comp hγ_cont.continuousAt
      simpa [Function.comp_apply, hγ0] using h1.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
    have hRHS_lim : Filter.Tendsto (RHS ∘ γ) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhds (RHS q)) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (RHS ∘ γ) 0 :=
        (hγ0 ▸ hRHS_cont).comp hγ_cont.continuousAt
      simpa [Function.comp_apply, hγ0] using h1.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hLHS_lim.congr' h_ev_eq) hRHS_lim
  have h_comp_X : ∀ p ∈ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X, K.f (𝔰_raw p) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X ∧
        (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (M.X_mero i) (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i) (Metric.ball p r) := by
    intro p hp hfp
    have hs_cont : ContinuousAt 𝔰_raw p :=
      (hHolo.differentiableAt (Reg.T_mero_open.mem_nhds hp)).continuousAt
    have hf_cont : ContinuousAt K.f (𝔰_raw p) :=
      (K.f_holo.differentiableAt (hDH_open.mem_nhds (hMaps p hp))).continuousAt
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_prop⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (Filter.Eventually.and (Reg.T_mero_open.mem_nhds hp)
        ((hf_cont.comp hs_cont).eventually_ne hfp))
    have hr_sub : Metric.ball p r ⊆ meroTubeENNR M.r_base M.h_X :=
      fun q hq => (hr_prop q hq).1
    have hr_fnz : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, K.f (𝔰_raw q) ≠ 0 :=
      fun q hq => (hr_prop q hq).2
    refine ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub, hr_fnz, ?_⟩
    intro i
    have hG_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i) (Metric.ball p r) := by
      intro q hq
      have hΓ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => K.Γ z i) (𝔰_raw q) := by
        have hreg := K.Γ_reg_holo (𝔰_raw q) (hMaps q (hr_sub hq)) (hr_fnz q hq)
        fin_cases i
        · exact hreg.1
        · exact hreg.2
      have hs_q : ContinuousAt 𝔰_raw q :=
        (hHolo.differentiableAt (Reg.T_mero_open.mem_nhds (hr_sub hq))).continuousAt
      exact (hΓ_diff.continuousAt.comp hs_q).continuousWithinAt
    exact h_mero_agrees i (Metric.ball p r) (fun q => K.Γ (𝔰_raw q) i)
      Metric.isOpen_ball hr_sub hG_cont (fun q _ hq_reg => h_reg_impact q hq_reg i)
  exact ⟨{
    𝔰_raw := 𝔰_raw
    𝔰_raw_holo := hHolo
    𝔰_raw_maps_to := hMaps
    𝔰_raw_init_eq := h_init_eq
    𝔰_raw_zero := h_zero
    𝔰_raw_quasiperiodic := h_qp
    𝔰_raw_even := h_even
    𝔰_raw_conj := h_conj
    𝔰_raw_comp_X := h_comp_X
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h_series_engine : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
      (∀ m : ℕ, ‖c m‖ ≤ M / (m.factorial : ℝ)) →
      (∀ z : ℂ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * z ^ m)) ∧
      ((∑' m : ℕ, c m * (0 : ℂ) ^ m) = c 0) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, (∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ m) = c 0 + z * ∑' k : ℕ, c (k + 1) * z ^ k) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * w ^ m)
        (∑' k : ℕ, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * c (k + 1) * z ^ k) z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℂ) * c m * z ^ m)
        (z * ∑' k : ℕ, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * c (k + 1) * z ^ k)) := by
    intro c M hM hc
    have h_sum : ∀ z : ℂ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * z ^ m) := by
      intro z
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial ‖z‖).mul_left M) ?_
      intro m

    rw [norm_div, norm_one, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_natCast]
    have h_le : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
      have : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
      linarith [show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) by positivity]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)) h_le
  have hcB2_bd : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖cB2 m‖ ≤ 1 / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
    intro m
    dsimp [cB2]
    rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_natCast]
    have h_nat : (m + 1) * m.factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ (2 * m + 2)]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (Nat.factorial_le (by omega))
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < (m.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h2 h1]
    have hr : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (m.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h_nat
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    linarith

  obtain ⟨hA_sum, hA_z, _, hA_deriv, _⟩ := h_series_engine cA 1 zero_le_one hcA_bd
  obtain ⟨hB0_sum, hB0_z, hB0_peel, hB0_deriv, _⟩ := h_series_engine cB0 1 zero_le_one hcB0_bd
  obtain ⟨hC_sum, hC_z, _, hC_deriv, _⟩ := h_series_engine cC 1 zero_le_one hcC_bd
  obtain ⟨hB1_sum, hB1_z, hB1_peel, hB1_deriv, _⟩ := h_series_engine cB1 1 zero_le_one hcB1_bd
  obtain ⟨hB2_sum, hB2_z, _, _, _⟩ := h_series_engine cB2 1 zero_le_one hcB2_bd

  let A_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' m : ℕ, cA m * μ ^ m
  let B0_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' m : ℕ, cB0 m * μ ^ m
  let B_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => 1 + B0_ser μ
  let C_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' m : ℕ, cC m * μ ^ m
  let B1_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' m : ℕ, cB1 m * μ ^ m
  let B2_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' m : ℕ, cB2 m * μ ^ m

  have hPhi2_eq : ∀ μ : ℂ, frozenPhiSecond μ = A_ser μ / (2 * B_ser μ) := by
    intro μ
    unfold frozenPhiSecond A_ser B_ser B0_ser
    congr 1
    · refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
      dsimp [cA]
      ring
    · congr 1
      congr 1
      refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
      dsimp [cB0]
      ring

  have hG2_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, frozenSecondFieldG w = (12 * C_ser (4 * w)) / B_ser (4 * w) := by
    intro w
    unfold frozenSecondFieldG C_ser B_ser B0_ser
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
      dsimp [cC]
      rw [mul_pow]
      ring
    · congr 1
      refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
      dsimp [cB0]
      rw [mul_pow]
      ring

  have hA0 : A_ser 0 = 1 / 6 := by
    dsimp [A_ser]; rw [hA_z]; dsimp [cA]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  have hB0_0 : B0_ser 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [B0_ser]; rw [hB0_z]; dsimp [cB0]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  have hB_0 : B_ser 0 = 2 := by dsimp [B_ser]; rw [hB0_0]; norm_num
  have hC0 : C_ser 0 = 1 / 6 := by
    dsimp [C_ser]; rw [hC_z]; dsimp [cC]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  have hB1_0 : B1_ser 0 = 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [B1_ser]; rw [hB1_z]; dsimp [cB1]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]

  have hPhi2_zero_val : frozenPhiSecond 0 = (1 / 24 : ℂ) := by

  have hG2_zero_val : frozenSecondFieldG 0 = 1 := by

  have hB_hasDeriv : ∀ μ : ℂ, HasDerivAt B_ser (B1_ser μ) μ := by
    intro μ
    have h_coef : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * cB0 (k + 1) = cB1 k := by
      intro k
      dsimp [cB0, cB1]
      have h_fac : ((2 * (k + 1)).factorial : ℂ) =
          (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) * ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
        have : (2 * (k + 1)).factorial = (2 * k + 2) * (2 * k + 1).factorial :=
          Nat.factorial_succ (2 * k + 1)
        rw [this]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hf_ne : ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      have hk1_ne : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      rw [h_fac]
      field_simp [hf_ne, hk1_ne]
    have h_tsum : (∑' k : ℕ, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * cB0 (k + 1) * μ ^ k) = B1_ser μ := by
      dsimp [B1_ser]
      refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
      rw [h_coef k]
    have hd := (hasDerivAt_const μ (1 : ℂ)).add (hB0_deriv μ)
    rw [zero_add, h_tsum] at hd
    exact hd

  have hB1_hasDeriv : ∀ μ : ℂ, HasDerivAt B1_ser (B2_ser μ) μ := by
    intro μ
    have h_tsum : (∑' k : ℕ, ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * cB1 (k + 1) * μ ^ k) = B2_ser μ := by

  have hB_ne_zero : ∀ μ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 8, B_ser μ ≠ 0 := by
    intro μ hμ hB_zero
    have hμ_norm : ‖μ‖ < 8 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hμ
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := @IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq ℂ _ _ (-μ) 2 (by norm_num)
    have hμ_eq : μ = -(z ^ 2) := by rw [hz, neg_neg]
    have hB0_cos : B0_ser (-(z ^ 2)) = Complex.cos z := by
      rw [Complex.cos_eq_tsum z]
      dsimp [B0_ser, cB0]
      refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
      have hp : (-(z ^ 2)) ^ m = (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) := by
        rw [pow_mul, ← mul_pow]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hp]
      ring
    rw [hμ_eq] at hB_zero
    dsimp [B_ser] at hB_zero
    rw [hB0_cos] at hB_zero
    have hcos_neg1 : Complex.cos z = -1 := by linear_combination hB_zero
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.cos_eq_neg_one_iff.mp hcos_neg1
    have hz_form : z = ((((2 * k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← hk]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_odd_sq : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h_int : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 * k + 1) ^ 2 := by
        rcases le_or_gt 0 k with hk0 | hk0
        · nlinarith
        · have : k ≤ -1 := by omega
          nlinarith
      exact_mod_cast h_int
    have h_pi_sq : (9 : ℝ) < Real.pi ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
    have h_norm_ge : (9 : ℝ) < ‖μ‖ := by
      rw [hμ_eq, norm_neg, norm_pow, hz_form, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, mul_pow]

    linarith

  have hPhi2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ frozenPhiSecond (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 8) := by
    have hA_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A_ser (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 8) :=

  have hG2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ frozenSecondFieldG (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) := by
    have h4_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (4 : ℂ) * w) :=

    have h12C_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => 12 * C_ser (4 * w)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) := by
      intro w _
      exact (((hC_deriv (4 * w)).differentiableAt.comp w (h4_diff w)).const_mul 12).differentiableWithinAt
    have hB4_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ => B_ser (4 * w)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) := by
      intro w _
      exact ((hB_hasDeriv (4 * w)).differentiableAt.comp w (h4_diff w)).differentiableWithinAt
    have hB4_ne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2, B_ser (4 * w) ≠ 0 := by

  have hR1 : ∀ μ : ℂ, 2 * B1_ser μ - 1 = μ * C_ser μ := by
    intro μ
    have hp := hB1_peel μ
    have hc0 : cB1 0 = 1 / 2 := by dsimp [cB1]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have h_sh : (∑' k : ℕ, cB1 (k + 1) * μ ^ k) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * C_ser μ := by
      have hs := (hC_sum μ).hasSum.mul_left (1 / 2 : ℂ)
      refine (hs.congr_fun ?_).tsum_eq
      intro k
      dsimp [cB1, cC]
      have : 2 * (k + 1) + 1 = 2 * k + 3 := by omega
      rw [this]
      ring
    change 2 * (∑' m : ℕ, cB1 m * μ ^ m) - 1 = μ * C_ser μ
    rw [hp, hc0, h_sh]
    ring

  let S_B0_shift : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ => ∑' k : ℕ, cB0 (k + 1) * μ ^ k
  have hS_B0_sum : ∀ μ : ℂ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => cB0 (k + 1) * μ ^ k) := by
    intro μ
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial ‖μ‖) ?_
    intro k
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    have h_fac : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * (k + 1)).factorial : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
    have hc_k : ‖cB0 (k + 1)‖ ≤ 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [cB0]
      rw [norm_div, norm_one, Complex.norm_natCast]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos k)) h_fac
    calc ‖cB0 (k + 1)‖ * ‖μ‖ ^ k
        ≤ (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)) * ‖μ‖ ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_k (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg μ) k)
      _ = ‖μ‖ ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ) := by ring

  have hB0_peel_eq : ∀ μ : ℂ, B0_ser μ = 1 + μ * S_B0_shift μ := by
    intro μ
    have hp := hB0_peel μ
    have hc0 : cB0 0 = 1 := by dsimp [cB0]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    rwa [hc0] at hp

  have hR2 : ∀ μ : ℂ, B_ser μ - 4 * B1_ser μ = μ * A_ser μ := by
    intro μ
    have h_2B1 : 4 * B1_ser μ = 2 + 2 * μ * C_ser μ := by
      linear_combination 2 * hR1 μ
    have h_diff_ser : S_B0_shift μ - 2 * C_ser μ = A_ser μ := by
      have hs := (hS_B0_sum μ).hasSum.sub ((hC_sum μ).hasSum.mul_left 2)
      refine (hs.congr_fun ?_).unique (hA_sum μ).hasSum
      intro k
      dsimp [cB0, cC, cA]
      have h_idx : 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 := by omega
      rw [h_idx]
      have h_fac : ((2 * k + 3).factorial : ℂ) =
          ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * k + 2).factorial : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_succ (2 * k + 2)
      have hf_ne : ((2 * k + 2).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      have h2k3_ne : ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      rw [h_fac]
      field_simp [hf_ne, h2k3_ne]
      push_cast
      ring
    calc B_ser μ - 4 * B1_ser μ
        = (1 + (1 + μ * S_B0_shift μ)) - (2 + 2 * μ * C_ser μ) := by
          dsimp [B_ser]; rw [hB0_peel_eq μ, h_2B1]
      _ = μ * (S_B0_shift μ - 2 * C_ser μ) := by ring
      _ = μ * A_ser μ := by rw [h_diff_ser]

  have hR3 : ∀ μ : ℂ, 4 * μ * B2_ser μ + 2 * B1_ser μ = B_ser μ - 1 := by
    intro μ
    have h_2B1 : 2 * B1_ser μ = 1 + μ * C_ser μ := by
      linear_combination hR1 μ
    have h_sum_ser : 4 * B2_ser μ + C_ser μ = S_B0_shift μ := by
      have hs := ((hB2_sum μ).hasSum.mul_left 4).add (hC_sum μ).hasSum
      refine (hs.congr_fun ?_).unique (hS_B0_sum μ).hasSum
      intro k
      dsimp [cB2, cC, cB0]
      have h_idx : 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 := by omega
      rw [h_idx]
      have h_fac : ((2 * k + 3).factorial : ℂ) =
          ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * k + 2).factorial : ℂ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_succ (2 * k + 2)
      have hf_ne : ((2 * k + 2).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      have h2k3_ne : ((2 * k + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      rw [h_fac]
      field_simp [hf_ne, h2k3_ne]
      push_cast
      ring
    calc 4 * μ * B2_ser μ + 2 * B1_ser μ
        = 1 + μ * (4 * B2_ser μ + C_ser μ) := by rw [h_2B1]; ring
      _ = 1 + μ * S_B0_shift μ := by rw [h_sum_ser]
      _ = B0_ser μ := (hB0_peel_eq μ).symm
      _ = B_ser μ - 1 := by dsimp [B_ser]; ring

  
  let g_inv_ser : ℂ → ℂ := fun μ =>
    (B_ser μ - 1) * (B_ser μ - 1) - (4 * μ) * (B1_ser μ * B1_ser μ)
  have hg_inv_deriv0 : ∀ μ : ℂ, HasDerivAt g_inv_ser 0 μ := by
    intro μ
    have hd_Bm1 : HasDerivAt (fun w => B_ser w - 1) (B1_ser μ - 0) μ :=
      (hB_hasDeriv μ).sub (hasDerivAt_const μ 1)
    have hd_part1 := hd_Bm1.mul hd_Bm1
    have hd_4mu : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 4 * w) (4 * 1) μ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id μ).const_mul 4
    have hd_B1sq := (hB1_hasDeriv μ).mul (hB1_hasDeriv μ)
    have hd_part2 := hd_4mu.mul hd_B1sq
    have hd_tot : HasDerivAt g_inv_ser
        (((B1_ser μ - 0) * (B_ser μ - 1) + (B_ser μ - 1) * (B1_ser μ - 0)) -
          (4 * 1 * (B1_ser μ * B1_ser μ) +
            4 * μ * (B2_ser μ * B1_ser μ + B1_ser μ * B2_ser μ))) μ :=
      hd_part1.sub hd_part2
    have h_zero_val :
        ((B1_ser μ - 0) * (B_ser μ - 1) + (B_ser μ - 1) * (B1_ser μ - 0)) -
          (4 * 1 * (B1_ser μ * B1_ser μ) +
            4 * μ * (B2_ser μ * B1_ser μ + B1_ser μ * B2_ser μ)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination -2 * B1_ser μ * hR3 μ
    rwa [h_zero_val] at hd_tot

  have h_inv_const : ∀ μ : ℂ, 4 * μ * B1_ser μ ^ 2 = B_ser μ * (B_ser μ - 2) := by
    intro μ
    have hg_eq : g_inv_ser μ = g_inv_ser 0 :=
      is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (fun w => (hg_inv_deriv0 w).differentiableAt)
        (fun w => (hg_inv_deriv0 w).deriv) μ 0
    have hg0 : g_inv_ser 0 = 1 := by

      rw [hB_0, hB1_0]
      norm_num
    rw [hg0] at hg_eq
    dsimp [g_inv_ser] at hg_eq
    linear_combination -hg_eq

  have h_num_id : ∀ μ : ℂ, 4 * B1_ser μ ^ 2 - 4 * B2_ser μ * B_ser μ = B_ser μ * C_ser μ := by
    intro μ
    by_cases hμ : μ = 0
    · subst hμ
      rw [hB1_0, hB2_0, hB_0, hC0]
      norm_num
    · apply mul_left_cancel₀ hμ
      calc μ * (4 * B1_ser μ ^ 2 - 4 * B2_ser μ * B_ser μ)
          = (4 * μ * B1_ser μ ^ 2) - (4 * μ * B2_ser μ + 2 * B1_ser μ) * B_ser μ +
              2 * B1_ser μ * B_ser μ := by ring
        _ = B_ser μ * (B_ser μ - 2) - (B_ser μ - 1) * B_ser μ + 2 * B1_ser μ * B_ser μ := by
            rw [h_inv_const μ, hR3 μ]
        _ = B_ser μ * (2 * B1_ser μ - 1) := by ring
        _ = B_ser μ * (μ * C_ser μ) := by rw [hR1 μ]
        _ = μ * (B_ser μ * C_ser μ) := by ring

  have hPair2 : IsDeepPureFrozenPair frozenPhiSecond frozenSecondFieldG := by
    refine

        phi_zero := hPhi2_zero_val

    have hd_phi2 : HasDerivAt frozenPhiSecond (deriv frozenPhiSecond μ) μ :=

    have h_ev : (fun w : ℂ => (2 * w) * frozenPhiSecond w) =ᶠ[nhds μ]
        (fun w : ℂ => 1 - 4 * (B1_ser w / B_ser w)) := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hμ_nhds ?_
      intro w hw

      have hBw : B_ser w ≠ 0 := hB_ne_zero w hw
      have h_wA : w * A_ser w = B_ser w - 4 * B1_ser w := (hR2 w).symm
      rw [hPhi2_eq w]

        field_simp [hBw]
      rw [h1, h_wA]
      field_simp [hBw]
    have hd_rhs : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 1 - 4 * (B1_ser w / B_ser w))
        (0 - 4 * ((B2_ser μ * B_ser μ - B1_ser μ * B1_ser μ) / B_ser μ ^ 2)) μ := by
      have hq := (hB1_hasDeriv μ).div (hB_hasDeriv μ) (hB_ne_zero μ hμ)

      hd_lhs.unique (hd_rhs.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev)

        (4 * B1_ser μ ^ 2 - 4 * B2_ser μ * B_ser μ) / B_ser μ ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [h_simp1, h_num_id μ]

  have hRootGen : ∀ G_sq : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G_sq (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2) →
      G_sq 0 = 1 →
      Nonempty (DeepPureRootData G_sq) := by
    intro G_sq hG_holo hG_zero
    have hG_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ G_sq 0 :=
      hG_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 (by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hG_diff0.continuousAt (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
    let δ₂ : ℝ := min δ₁ 1
    have hδ₂_pos : 0 < δ₂ := lt_min hδ₁_pos zero_lt_one
    have hδ₂_le_δ₁ : δ₂ ≤ δ₁ := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ₂_le_one : δ₂ ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have hG_slit_and_ne : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂,
        G_sq ζ ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧ G_sq ζ ≠ 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ < δ₂ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hζ
      have h_dist : dist (G_sq ζ) (G_sq 0) < 1 / 2 := by
        apply hδ₁
        rw [dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ_norm hδ₂_le_δ₁
      rw [hG_zero, dist_eq_norm] at h_dist
      have h_re_sub : |(G_sq ζ - 1).re| ≤ ‖G_sq ζ - 1‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
      have h_re_pos : 0 < (G_sq ζ).re := by
        have h1 := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h_re_sub h_dist)).1
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re] at h1
        linarith
      refine ⟨Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl h_re_pos), ?_⟩
      intro h0
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at h_re_pos
      linarith

    let k_G : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp (-(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (G_sq ζ))
    have hk_ne : ∀ ζ : ℂ, k_G ζ ≠ 0 := fun ζ => Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hk_zero : k_G 0 = 1 := by
      dsimp [k_G]
      rw [hG_zero, Complex.log_one, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]
    have hk_diff : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂, DifferentiableAt ℂ k_G ζ := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_in_2 : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 2 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hζ ⊢
        linarith
      have hG_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ G_sq ζ :=
        hG_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hζ_in_2)
      have hlog_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => Complex.log (G_sq w)) ζ :=
        (Complex.differentiableAt_log (hG_slit_and_ne ζ hζ).1).comp ζ hG_d
      exact (hlog_d.const_mul (-(1 / 3 : ℂ))).cexp

    have hk_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ k_G 0 := hk_diff 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₂_pos)
    obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃_pos, hδ₃⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hk_diff0.continuousAt (1 / 16) (by norm_num)
    let r_ζ : ℝ := min δ₂ (min δ₃ (1 / 2))
    have hr_ζ_pos : 0 < r_ζ := lt_min hδ₂_pos (lt_min hδ₃_pos (by norm_num))
    have hr_ζ_le_δ₂ : r_ζ ≤ δ₂ := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_ζ_le_δ₃ : r_ζ ≤ δ₃ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_ζ_le_half : r_ζ ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)

    have hk_ball_props : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ k_G ζ ∧ ‖k_G ζ - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧ k_G ζ ^ 3 * G_sq ζ = 1 := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ < r_ζ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hζ
      have hζ_δ₂ : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ_norm hr_ζ_le_δ₂
      have hk_close : ‖k_G ζ - 1‖ < 1 / 16 := by
        have hd := @hδ₃ ζ (by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ_norm hr_ζ_le_δ₃)
        rwa [hk_zero, dist_eq_norm] at hd
      have hk_cub : k_G ζ ^ 3 * G_sq ζ = 1 := by
        have hG_ne := (hG_slit_and_ne ζ hζ_δ₂).2
        have h_pow : k_G ζ ^ 3 = (G_sq ζ)⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [k_G]
          rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
          have h_arg : (3 : ℕ) * (-(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (G_sq ζ)) =
              -Complex.log (G_sq ζ) := by
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log hG_ne]
        rw [h_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hG_ne]
      exact ⟨hk_diff ζ hζ_δ₂, hk_close, hk_cub⟩

    let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ζ * (k_G ζ ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hψ_zero : ψ 0 = 0 := by simp [ψ]
    have hψ_diff : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ, DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ ζ := by
      intro ζ hζ
      exact differentiableAt_id.mul
        (((hk_ball_props ζ hζ).1.pow 2).inv (pow_ne_zero 2 (hk_ne ζ)))
    have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ) :=
      fun ζ hζ => (hψ_diff ζ hζ).differentiableWithinAt
    have hψ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ ψ 0 :=
      hψ_holo.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_ζ_pos)
    have hψ_deriv0 : deriv ψ 0 = 1 := by
      have hq_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ => (k_G ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) 0 :=
        ((hk_diff0.pow 2).inv (pow_ne_zero 2 (hk_ne 0)))
      have hd : HasDerivAt ψ ((1 : ℂ) * (k_G 0 ^ 2)⁻¹ +
          (0 : ℂ) * deriv (fun ζ => (k_G ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) 0) 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).mul hq_diff0.hasDerivAt
      have h_val : (1 : ℂ) * (k_G 0 ^ 2)⁻¹ + (0 : ℂ) * deriv (fun ζ => (k_G ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) 0 = 1 := by
        rw [hk_zero]
        norm_num
      rw [h_val] at hd
      exact hd.deriv
    have hψ_deriv_ne : deriv ψ 0 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hψ_deriv0]
      exact one_ne_zero

    let h_strict : HasStrictDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ 0) 0 := hψ_ana.hasStrictDerivAt
    let ψ_inv : ℂ → ℂ := HasStrictDerivAt.localInverse ψ (deriv ψ 0) 0 h_strict hψ_deriv_ne
    have hψ_inv_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ ψ_inv 0 := by
      simpa [ψ_inv, hψ_zero] using hψ_ana.analyticAt_localInverse hψ_deriv_ne
    have h_ev_left : ∀ᶠ ζ in nhds (0 : ℂ), ψ_inv (ψ ζ) = ζ :=
      h_strict.eventually_left_inverse hψ_deriv_ne
    have hψ_inv_zero : ψ_inv 0 = 0 := by
      have h0 := h_ev_left.self_of_nhds
      rwa [hψ_zero] at h0
    obtain ⟨δ_L, hδ_L_pos, hδ_L⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_ev_left
    let ρ_ζ : ℝ := min r_ζ δ_L
    have hρ_ζ_pos : 0 < ρ_ζ := lt_min hr_ζ_pos hδ_L_pos
    have hρ_ζ_le_r : ρ_ζ ≤ r_ζ := min_le_left _ _
    have hρ_ζ_le_δL : ρ_ζ ≤ δ_L := min_le_right _ _

    have h_ev_diff : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_inv u :=
      Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mp hψ_inv_ana
    have h_ev_right : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), ψ (ψ_inv u) = u := by
      simpa [ψ_inv, hψ_zero] using h_strict.eventually_right_inverse hψ_deriv_ne
    have h_ev_ball : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), ψ_inv u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_ζ := by
      have h_mem : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_ζ ∈ nhds (ψ_inv 0) := by
        rw [hψ_inv_zero]
        exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hρ_ζ_pos
      exact hψ_inv_ana.continuousAt.eventually_mem h_mem

    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀⟩ :=
      Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (h_ev_diff.and (h_ev_right.and h_ev_ball))

    let ρ_u : ℝ := min (ρ₀ / 2) (min (ρ_ζ / 4) (1 / 8))
    have hρ_u_pos : 0 < ρ_u := lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num))
    have hρ_u_le_half_ρ₀ : ρ_u ≤ ρ₀ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hρ_u_le_q_ρζ : ρ_u ≤ ρ_ζ / 4 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hρ_u_le_eighth : ρ_u ≤ 1 / 8 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hρ_u_lt_quarter : ρ_u < 1 / 4 := by linarith
    let C_j : ℝ := 4 / ρ_u
    have hC_j_pos : 0 < C_j := by positivity
    let j_root : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => k_G (ψ_inv u)
    have hj_zero : j_root 0 = 1 := by
      dsimp [j_root]
      rw [hψ_inv_zero, hk_zero]

    have h_ρ₀_props : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀,
        DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_inv u ∧ ψ (ψ_inv u) = u ∧
        ψ_inv u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_ζ ∧ ψ_inv u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ := by
      intro u hu
      have hu_dist : dist u 0 < ρ₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hu
      obtain ⟨hd, hr, hb⟩ := hρ₀ hu_dist
      have hb_r : ψ_inv u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hb ⊢
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hb hρ_ζ_le_r
      exact ⟨hd, hr, hb, hb_r⟩

    have hj_diff_ρ₀ : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀, DifferentiableAt ℂ j_root u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨hd, _, _, hb_r⟩ := h_ρ₀_props u hu
      exact (hk_ball_props (ψ_inv u) hb_r).1.comp u hd

    have hj_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ j_root (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_u) := by
      intro u hu
      have hu_ρ₀ : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
        linarith
      exact (hj_diff_ρ₀ u hu_ρ₀).differentiableWithinAt

    
    let g_inv : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (j_root w)⁻¹
    have hg_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_inv (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀) := by
      intro z hz
      exact ((hj_diff_ρ₀ z hz).inv (hk_ne (ψ_inv z))).differentiableWithinAt
    have hg_inv_bound_ρ₀ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀, ‖g_inv z‖ ≤ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hb_r⟩ := h_ρ₀_props z hz
      have h_close : ‖j_root z - 1‖ < 1 / 16 := (hk_ball_props (ψ_inv z) hb_r).2.1
      have h_tri : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖j_root z - 1‖ + ‖j_root z‖ := by
        calc (1 : ℝ) = ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_one.symm
          _ = ‖(1 - j_root z) + j_root z‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖1 - j_root z‖ + ‖j_root z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖j_root z - 1‖ + ‖j_root z‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
      have hj_gt : (15 / 16 : ℝ) < ‖j_root z‖ := by linarith
      dsimp [g_inv]
      rw [norm_inv]
      have h_inv_le : (‖j_root z‖)⁻¹ ≤ (15 / 16 : ℝ)⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hj_gt.le
      linarith [show (15 / 16 : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 2 by norm_num]

    have hg_inv_deriv_le : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_u, ‖deriv g_inv w‖ ≤ C_j := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ < ρ_u := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hw
      have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall w (ρ_u / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        have h_tri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ + ‖w‖ := by
          calc ‖z‖ = ‖(z - w) + w‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖z - w‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        linarith
      have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g_inv (Metric.ball w (ρ_u / 2)) :=
        hg_inv_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_cb_sub
      have h_sph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere w (ρ_u / 2), ‖g_inv z‖ ≤ 2 :=
        fun z hz => hg_inv_bound_ρ₀ z (h_cb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
      have h_cauchy :=
        Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity : 0 < ρ_u / 2) h_dc h_sph
      have h_eq_Cj : (2 : ℝ) / (ρ_u / 2) = C_j := by
        dsimp [C_j]
        field_simp [hρ_u_pos.ne']
        ring
      rwa [h_eq_Cj] at h_cauchy

    refine ⟨
      { ρ_u := ρ_u
        C_j := C_j
        j_root := j_root
        ρ_u_pos := hρ_u_pos
        ρ_u_lt := hρ_u_lt_quarter
        C_j_pos := hC_j_pos
        j_holo := hj_holo
        j_zero := hj_zero
        j_props := ?_
        j_unique := ?_ }⟩
    · intro u hu
      have hu_ρ₀ : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
        linarith
      obtain ⟨_, h_right, hb_ρζ, hb_r⟩ := h_ρ₀_props u hu_ρ₀
      obtain ⟨_, hk_close, hk_cub⟩ := hk_ball_props (ψ_inv u) hb_r
      have h_uj2 : u * (j_root u) ^ 2 = ψ_inv u := by
        have hk2_ne : k_G (ψ_inv u) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (hk_ne (ψ_inv u))
        dsimp [j_root]
        nth_rw 1 [← h_right]
        dsimp [ψ]
        rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hk2_ne, mul_one]
      have h_lip : ‖(j_root u)⁻¹ - 1‖ ≤ C_j * ‖u‖ := by
        have h_diff_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_u, DifferentiableAt ℂ g_inv w := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_ρ₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw ⊢
            linarith
          exact (hj_diff_ρ₀ w hw_ρ₀).inv (hk_ne (ψ_inv w))
        have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_u := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_u_pos
        have hmvi := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le h_diff_ball hg_inv_deriv_le
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_u) h0_mem hu
        have hg0 : g_inv 0 = 1 := by dsimp [g_inv]; rw [hj_zero, inv_one]
        simpa [g_inv, hg0] using hmvi
      have h_arg_lt2 : ‖u * (j_root u) ^ 2‖ < 2 := by
        rw [h_uj2]
        have h_lt_ρζ : ‖ψ_inv u‖ < ρ_ζ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hb_ρζ
        linarith
      have h_root_eq : (j_root u) ^ 3 * G_sq (u * (j_root u) ^ 2) = 1 := by
        rw [h_uj2]
        exact hk_cub
      exact ⟨hk_ne (ψ_inv u), hk_close, h_lip, h_arg_lt2, h_root_eq⟩
    · intro u hu J hJ_close hJ_eq
      have hu_norm : ‖u‖ < ρ_u := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hu
      have hJ_norm : ‖J‖ < 2 := by
        have h_tri : ‖J‖ ≤ ‖J - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
          calc ‖J‖ = ‖(J - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖J - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        rw [norm_one] at h_tri
        linarith
      have hJ2_le : ‖J‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg J]
      let ζ' : ℂ := u * J ^ 2
      have hζ'_norm : ‖ζ'‖ < ρ_ζ := by
        dsimp [ζ']
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        have h1 : ‖u‖ * ‖J‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ * 4 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ2_le (norm_nonneg u)
        have h2 : ‖u‖ * 4 < 4 * ρ_u := by linarith
        linarith
      have hζ'_in_r : ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_ζ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ'_norm hρ_ζ_le_r
      have hζ'_in_δ₂ : ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hζ'_norm hρ_ζ_le_r) hr_ζ_le_δ₂
      obtain ⟨_, hk_close, hk_cub⟩ := hk_ball_props ζ' hζ'_in_r
      have hG_ne : G_sq ζ' ≠ 0 := (hG_slit_and_ne ζ' hζ'_in_δ₂).2
      have hJ3_eq : J ^ 3 = k_G ζ' ^ 3 :=
        mul_right_cancel₀ hG_ne (by rw [hk_cub]; exact hJ_eq)
      have h_fac : (J - k_G ζ') * (J ^ 2 + J * k_G ζ' + k_G ζ' ^ 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination hJ3_eq
      have h_quad_ne : J ^ 2 + J * k_G ζ' + k_G ζ' ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hq0
        let a : ℂ := J - 1
        let b : ℂ := k_G ζ' - 1
        have ha : ‖a‖ < 1 / 8 := hJ_close
        have hb : ‖b‖ < 1 / 16 := hk_close
        have h_alg : (J ^ 2 + J * k_G ζ' + k_G ζ' ^ 2) - 3 =
            a ^ 2 + 3 * a + a * b + 3 * b + b ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [a, b]
          ring
        have h_lhs_norm : ‖(J ^ 2 + J * k_G ζ' + k_G ζ' ^ 2) - 3‖ = 3 := by
          rw [hq0]
          norm_num
        have h_rhs_norm : ‖a ^ 2 + 3 * a + a * b + 3 * b + b ^ 2‖ < 3 := by
          calc ‖a ^ 2 + 3 * a + a * b + 3 * b + b ^ 2‖
              ≤ ‖a ^ 2 + 3 * a + a * b + 3 * b‖ + ‖b ^ 2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖a ^ 2 + 3 * a + a * b‖ + ‖3 * b‖ + ‖b ^ 2‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖a ^ 2 + 3 * a‖ + ‖a * b‖ + ‖3 * b‖ + ‖b ^ 2‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖a ^ 2‖ + ‖3 * a‖ + ‖a * b‖ + ‖3 * b‖ + ‖b ^ 2‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 3 * ‖a‖ + ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ + 3 * ‖b‖ + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := by
                simp only [norm_pow, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
            _ < 3 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg b]
        rw [h_alg] at h_lhs_norm
        linarith
      have hJ_eq_k : J = k_G ζ' := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h_fac).resolve_right h_quad_ne)
      have hψ_ζ' : ψ ζ' = u := by
        dsimp [ψ, ζ']
        rw [← hJ_eq_k]
        have hJ2_ne : J ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (by rw [hJ_eq_k]; exact hk_ne ζ')
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hJ2_ne, mul_one]
      have h_left_ζ' : ψ_inv (ψ ζ') = ζ' := by
        apply hδ_L
        rw [dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hζ'_norm hρ_ζ_le_δL
      rw [hψ_ζ'] at h_left_ζ'
      dsimp [j_root]
      rw [h_left_ζ', hJ_eq_k]

  exact ⟨hPair1, hEqPhi1, hEqG1, hPair2, hRootGen⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h2α1 : 0 < 2 * α - 1 := by linarith
  have hρ_pos : 0 < R.ρ_u := R.ρ_u_pos
  have hCj_pos : 0 < R.C_j := R.C_j_pos
  let κ_A : ℝ := 1 / (8 * (A₀ + 5))
  have hA5_pos : 0 < A₀ + 5 := by linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ_A := by dsimp [κ_A]; positivity
  have hκ_lt : κ_A < 1 / 40 := by
    dsimp [κ_A]
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  let C_g : ℝ := (1 / 4 : ℝ) * R.C_j * M_W

  let coneOf : ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun c M => { Z : ℂ | c < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < M * (-Z.im) }
  have h_cone_open : ∀ c M : ℝ, IsOpen (coneOf c M) := by
    intro c M
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im.neg).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re)
        (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_im.neg))
  have h_cone_convex : ∀ c M : ℝ, 0 < M → Convex ℝ (coneOf c M) := by
    intro c M hM Z₁ hZ₁ Z₂ hZ₂ a b ha hb hab
    rcases hZ₁ with ⟨hZ₁_im, hZ₁_re⟩
    rcases hZ₂ with ⟨hZ₂_im, hZ₂_re⟩
    have him : -(a • Z₁ + b • Z₂).im = a * (-Z₁.im) + b * (-Z₂.im) := by
      simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
      ring
    have hre : (a • Z₁ + b • Z₂).re = a * Z₁.re + b * Z₂.re := by
      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re]
    constructor
    · rw [him]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp at hab; subst hab; simpa
      · have h1 : a * c < a * (-Z₁.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hZ₁_im ha_pos
        have h2 : b * c ≤ b * (-Z₂.im) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ₂_im.le hb
        have hac : a * c + b * c = c := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
        linarith
    · rw [hre, him]
      calc |a * Z₁.re + b * Z₂.re|
          ≤ |a * Z₁.re| + |b * Z₂.re| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |Z₁.re| + b * |Z₂.re| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ < M * (a * (-Z₁.im) + b * (-Z₂.im)) := by
            rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
            · simp at hab; subst hab; simpa using hZ₂_re
            · have h1 : a * |Z₁.re| < a * (M * (-Z₁.im)) :=
                mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hZ₁_re ha_pos
              have h2 : b * |Z₂.re| ≤ b * (M * (-Z₂.im)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hZ₂_re.le hb
              linarith

  
  have h_cone_ball : ∀ (M : ℝ) (Z Z' : ℂ),
      0 ≤ M → M ≤ A₀ + 4 → 0 < -Z.im → |Z.re| < M * (-Z.im) →
      ‖Z' - Z‖ ≤ 2 * κ_A * (-Z.im) →
      (19 / 20 : ℝ) * (-Z.im) < -Z'.im ∧
      -Z'.im < 2 * (-Z.im) ∧
      |Z'.re| < (M + 1 / 2) * (-Z'.im) := by
    intro M Z Z' hM0 hM_hi hy hZ_re hdist
    have him_diff : |Z'.im - Z.im| ≤ 2 * κ_A * (-Z.im) :=
      le_trans (by simpa [Complex.sub_im] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Z' - Z)) hdist
    have hre_diff : |Z'.re - Z.re| ≤ 2 * κ_A * (-Z.im) :=
      le_trans (by simpa [Complex.sub_re] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Z' - Z)) hdist
    have him_lo : (1 - 2 * κ_A) * (-Z.im) ≤ -Z'.im := by
      have := (abs_le.mp him_diff).2
      nlinarith
    have him_hi : -Z'.im ≤ (1 + 2 * κ_A) * (-Z.im) := by
      have := (abs_le.mp him_diff).1
      nlinarith
    have h19 : (19 / 20 : ℝ) * (-Z.im) < -Z'.im := by nlinarith [hκ_lt]
    have h2 : -Z'.im < 2 * (-Z.im) := by nlinarith [hκ_lt]
    have h_slope : M + 2 * κ_A < (M + 1 / 2) * (1 - 2 * κ_A) := by
      have h_eq : (M + 1 / 2) * (1 - 2 * κ_A) - (M + 2 * κ_A) =
          (4 * A₀ - 2 * M + 17) / (8 * (A₀ + 5)) := by
        dsimp [κ_A]
        field_simp [hA5_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_num : 0 < 4 * A₀ - 2 * M + 17 := by linarith
      linarith [div_pos h_num (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * (A₀ + 5))]
    have hre_lt : |Z'.re| < (M + 1 / 2) * (-Z'.im) := by
      have hre1 : |Z'.re| ≤ |Z.re| + |Z'.re - Z.re| := by
        have := abs_add_le Z.re (Z'.re - Z.re)
        simpa using this
      calc |Z'.re|
          ≤ |Z.re| + |Z'.re - Z.re| := hre1
        _ < M * (-Z.im) + 2 * κ_A * (-Z.im) := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hZ_re hre_diff
        _ = (M + 2 * κ_A) * (-Z.im) := by ring
        _ < ((M + 1 / 2) * (1 - 2 * κ_A)) * (-Z.im) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_slope hy
        _ = (M + 1 / 2) * ((1 - 2 * κ_A) * (-Z.im)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (M + 1 / 2) * (-Z'.im) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left him_lo (by linarith)
    exact ⟨h19, h2, hre_lt⟩

  
  have h_cone_ray : ∀ (c M τ : ℝ) (W' : ℂ),
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ τ → W' ∈ coneOf c M → W' - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ coneOf c M := by
    intro c M τ W' hM hτ ⟨h_im, h_re⟩
    have him : -(W' - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = -W'.im + τ := by simp; ring
    have hre : (W' - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = W'.re := by simp
    refine ⟨by rw [him]; linarith, ?_⟩
    rw [hre, him]
    calc |W'.re| < M * (-W'.im) := h_re
      _ ≤ M * (-W'.im + τ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hM

  
  have h_rpow_le_inv : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → x ^ (-2 * α) ≤ x⁻¹ := by
    intro x hx
    calc x ^ (-2 * α) ≤ x ^ (-1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx (by linarith)
      _ = x⁻¹ := Real.rpow_neg_one x

  
  have h_rpow_int : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun τ : ℝ => (y + τ) ^ (-2 * α))
        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (y + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) = y ^ (1 - 2 * α) / (2 * α - 1) := by
    intro y hy
    let γ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => -(y + τ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) / (2 * α - 1)
    have h_deriv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ici (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt γ ((y + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hyτ : 0 < y + τ := by change 0 ≤ τ at hτ; linarith
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t) 1 τ := (hasDerivAt_id τ).const_add y
      have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := 1 - 2 * α) (Or.inl hyτ.ne')).comp τ h1
      have h3 := h2.neg.div_const (2 * α - 1)
      convert h3 using 1
      · ext x; rfl
      · have hexp : 1 - 2 * α - 1 = -2 * α := by ring
        rw [hexp]
        field_simp [h2α1.ne']
        ring
    have h_nonneg : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ (y + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
      intro τ hτ
      change 0 < τ at hτ
      exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have h_tend : Filter.Tendsto γ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-(2 * α - 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop h2α1
      have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => τ + y) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop y Filter.tendsto_id
      have ht3 := (ht1.comp ht2).neg.div_const (2 * α - 1)
      simpa [γ, add_comm, show -(2 * α - 1) = 1 - 2 * α by ring] using ht3
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg' h_deriv h_nonneg h_tend, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg' h_deriv h_nonneg h_tend]
    dsimp [γ]
    ring

  
  
  
  let Ω_int : Set ℂ := coneOf (D_ray / 4) (A₀ + 5)

      exact ⟨hT, h_cone_ray _ _ τ p.2 (by positivity) (le_of_lt hτ) hZ⟩
    have h_cont_ray : ContinuousOn
        (fun τ : ℝ => g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hg_cont.comp (by fun_prop) h_ray_maps
    refine h_dom.mono' (h_cont_ray.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi) ?_
    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with τ hτ
    have hpτ := (hg_int (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) (h_ray_maps hτ)).2.2.2.2.1
    have him_τ : -(p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = -p.2.im + τ := by simp; ring
    rwa [him_τ] at hpτ

  
  let 𝒴 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    p.2 + Complex.I * ∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)

  
  have h𝒴_basic : ∀ T Z : ℂ, (T, Z) ∈ U_ray →
      ‖𝒴 (T, Z) - Z‖ ≤ C_ray * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
      ‖𝒴 (T, Z) - Z‖ ≤ (1 / (32 * (A₀ + 5))) * (-Z.im) ∧
      (T / 2) ^ 2 * W Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.ρ_u ∧
      𝒴 (-T, Z) = 𝒴 (T, Z) := by
    intro T Z ⟨hT, hZ⟩
    have hp_int : (T, Z) ∈ U_int := ⟨by linarith, hΩ_wide_sub_int hZ⟩
    have hy_pos : 0 < -Z.im := by linarith [hZ.1]
    have h_int_g := hg_ray_integrable (T, Z) hp_int
    have h_dom_int := (h_rpow_int (-Z.im) hy_pos)
    have h_disp : ‖𝒴 (T, Z) - Z‖ ≤ C_ray * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
      have h_sub : 𝒴 (T, Z) - Z =
          Complex.I * ∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g (T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        dsimp [𝒴]; ring
      rw [h_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
      calc ‖∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g (T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
          ≤ ∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖g (T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ :=
            MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), C_g * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Z.im + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
            refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_int_g.norm
              (h_dom_int.1.const_mul _) ?_
            filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with τ hτ
            have hpτ := (hg_int (T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              ⟨by linarith, h_cone_ray _ _ τ Z (by positivity) (le_of_lt hτ) (hΩ_wide_sub_int hZ)⟩).2.2.2.2.1
            have him_τ : -(Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = -Z.im + τ := by simp; ring
            rwa [him_τ] at hpτ
        _ = C_g * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ∫ τ in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (-Z.im + τ) ^ (-2 * α) :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = C_g * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ((-Z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) / (2 * α - 1)) := by rw [h_dom_int.2]
        _ = C_ray * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by dsimp [C_ray]; ring
    have h_small : ‖𝒴 (T, Z) - Z‖ ≤ (1 / (32 * (A₀ + 5))) * (-Z.im) := by
      have hT_sq : ‖T‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * T₀ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : ‖T‖ ≤ 2 * T₀ := by linarith
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg T]
      have hy_ge1 : 1 ≤ -Z.im := by linarith [hZ.1]
      have hrpow_split : (-Z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) = (-Z.im) * (-Z.im) ^ (-2 * α) := by
        rw [show (1 : ℝ) - 2 * α = 1 + (-2 * α) by ring,
            Real.rpow_add hy_pos 1 (-2 * α), Real.rpow_one]
      have hrpow_le : (-Z.im) ^ (-2 * α) ≤ 2 / D_ray := by
        calc (-Z.im) ^ (-2 * α) ≤ (-Z.im)⁻¹ := h_rpow_le_inv _ hy_ge1
          _ ≤ (D_ray / 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hZ.1.le
          _ = 2 / D_ray := by ring
      have h_coeff : 8 * C_ray * T₀ ^ 2 / D_ray ≤ 1 / (32 * (A₀ + 5)) := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hDray_pos (by positivity)]
        linarith
      calc ‖𝒴 (T, Z) - Z‖
          ≤ C_ray * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * ((-Z.im) * (-Z.im) ^ (-2 * α)) := by
            rwa [← hrpow_split]
        _ ≤ C_ray * (4 * T₀ ^ 2) * ((-Z.im) * (2 / D_ray)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT_sq hCray_pos.le)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le hy_pos.le) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = (8 * C_ray * T₀ ^ 2 / D_ray) * (-Z.im) := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / (32 * (A₀ + 5))) * (-Z.im) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff hy_pos.le
    have h_even : 𝒴 (-T, Z) = 𝒴 (T, Z) := by
      have hg_ev : ∀ τ : ℝ, g (-T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = g (T, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        intro τ
        simp only [g, u_fn]
        congr 2
        ring
      simp only [𝒴, hg_ev]
    exact ⟨h_disp, h_small, (hg_int (T, Z) hp_int).2.2.2.1, h_even⟩

  have h𝒴_zero : ∀ Z ∈ Ω_wide, 𝒴 (0, Z) = Z := by
    intro Z _
    have hg0 : ∀ τ : ℝ, g (0, Z - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 0 := by
      intro τ
      simp [g, u_fn, φ, R.j_zero]
    simp [𝒴, hg0]

  
  have h𝒴_diff_and_deriv : ∀ T_s Z_s : ℂ, (T_s, Z_s) ∈ U_ray →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ 𝒴 (T_s, Z_s) ∧
      deriv (fun Z' : ℂ => 𝒴 (T_s, Z')) Z_s = (R.j_root ((T_s / 2) ^ 2 * W Z_s))⁻¹ ∧
      ‖deriv (fun Z' : ℂ => 𝒴 (T_s, Z') - Z') Z_s‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    intro T_s Z_s ⟨hT_s, hZ_s⟩
    have hy_s : 0 < -Z_s.im := by linarith [hZ_s.1]
    let r_T : ℝ := T₀ / 4
    let r_Z : ℝ := κ_A * (-Z_s.im)
    let c₀ : ℝ := D_ray / 4
    have hr_T : 0 < r_T := by dsimp [r_T]; positivity
    have hr_Z : 0 < r_Z := mul_pos hκ_pos hy_s
    have hc₀ : 0 < c₀ := by dsimp [c₀]; positivity
    let s_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball T_s r_T ×ˢ Metric.ball Z_s r_Z
    have hs_nhds : s_box ∈ nhds (T_s, Z_s) :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
        ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_T, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_Z⟩
    let B_dom : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ =>
      M_φ * (T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α)
    have hB_dom_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn B_dom (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (h_rpow_int c₀ hc₀).1.const_mul _

    
    have h_box_est : ∀ p ∈ s_box, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
        (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ U_int ∧
        ‖d_Z_g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B_dom τ ∧
        ‖L_g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ B_dom τ := by
      intro p ⟨hpT, hpZ⟩ τ hτ
      have hT_lt2 : ‖p.1‖ < 2 * T₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hpT
        have := norm_sub_norm_le p.1 T_s
        dsimp [r_T] at hpT
        linarith
      
      have hζ_in : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) r_Z,
          ζ ∈ Ω_int ∧ c₀ + τ < -ζ.im := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hpZ
        set ζ₀ : ℂ := ζ + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
        have hζ₀_dist : ‖ζ₀ - Z_s‖ ≤ 2 * κ_A * (-Z_s.im) := by
          have heq : ζ₀ - Z_s = (ζ - (p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + (p.2 - Z_s) := by
            dsimp [ζ₀]; ring
          rw [heq]
          calc ‖(ζ - (p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + (p.2 - Z_s)‖
              ≤ ‖ζ - (p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ + ‖p.2 - Z_s‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ r_Z + r_Z := add_le_add hζ hpZ.le
            _ = 2 * κ_A * (-Z_s.im) := by dsimp [r_Z]; ring
        obtain ⟨h19, _, hre₀⟩ :=
          h_cone_ball (A₀ + 4) Z_s ζ₀ (by positivity) le_rfl hy_s hZ_s.2 hζ₀_dist
        have hc₀_ζ₀ : c₀ < -ζ₀.im := by
          dsimp [c₀]; linarith [hZ_s.1]
        have hζ₀_int : ζ₀ ∈ Ω_int := ⟨hc₀_ζ₀, lt_trans hre₀ (by nlinarith [hc₀_ζ₀, hc₀])⟩
        have hζ_eq : ζ = ζ₀ - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I := by dsimp [ζ₀]; ring
        rw [hζ_eq]
        refine ⟨h_cone_ray _ _ τ ζ₀ (by positivity) hτ.le hζ₀_int, ?_⟩
        have him_eq : -(ζ₀ - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = -ζ₀.im + τ := by simp; ring
        rw [him_eq]; linarith
      set q : ℂ × ℂ := (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have hq_center := hζ_in q.2 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_Z.le)
      have hq_int : q ∈ U_int := ⟨hT_lt2, hq_center.1⟩
      
      have hW_ball_sub : Metric.closedBall q.2 r_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have := (hζ_in ζ hζ).2
        change ζ.im < 0
        linarith
      have hW_sphere : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere q.2 r_Z,
          ‖W ζ‖ ≤ M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        obtain ⟨hζ_int, hζ_im⟩ := hζ_in ζ (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)
        have h1 : 1 ≤ -ζ.im := by dsimp [c₀] at hζ_im; linarith
        have hre6 : |ζ.re| ≤ (A₀ + 6) * (-ζ.im) := by nlinarith [hζ_int.2]
        calc ‖W ζ‖ ≤ M_W * (-ζ.im) ^ (-2 * α) := hW_bound ζ h1 hre6
          _ ≤ M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hζ_im.le (by linarith)) hMW.le
      have hdW_est : ‖deriv W q.2‖ ≤ r_Z⁻¹ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
        have hcau := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr_Z
          (hW_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hW_ball_sub) hW_sphere
        simpa [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc] using hcau
      have hW_q : ‖W q.2‖ ≤ M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
        calc ‖W q.2‖ ≤ M_W * (-q.2.im) ^ (-2 * α) := (hg_int q hq_int).2.1
          _ ≤ M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hq_center.2.le (by linarith)) hMW.le
      have hdφ_q : ‖deriv φ (u_fn q)‖ ≤ M_φ :=
        hM_φ_bound (u_fn q) (hg_int q hq_int).2.2.1
      have hT_half : ‖q.1 / 2‖ ≤ T₀ := by
        rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith
      have hT_sq : ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2‖ ≤ T₀ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hT_half 2
      have hdZ_le : ‖d_Z_g q‖ ≤ B_dom τ := by
        dsimp [d_Z_g, B_dom]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        have h1 : ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2‖ * ‖deriv W q.2‖ ≤
            (T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by
          have hp1 : ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2‖ * ‖deriv W q.2‖ ≤
              T₀ ^ 2 * (r_Z⁻¹ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) :=
            mul_le_mul hT_sq hdW_est (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          have hp2 : 0 ≤ T₀ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by positivity
          linarith
        calc ‖deriv φ (u_fn q)‖ * (‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2‖ * ‖deriv W q.2‖)
            ≤ M_φ * ((T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) :=
              mul_le_mul hdφ_q h1 (by positivity) hM_φ_pos.le
          _ = M_φ * (T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) := by ring
      have hLg_le : ‖L_g q‖ ≤ B_dom τ := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by dsimp [B_dom]; positivity) ?_
        rintro ⟨v₁, v₂⟩
        have hv1 : ‖v₁‖ ≤ ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := le_max_left _ _
        have hv2 : ‖v₂‖ ≤ ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := le_max_right _ _
        have h_eval : (L_g q) (v₁, v₂) =
            deriv φ (u_fn q) * ((q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁ + (q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂) := by
          dsimp [L_g]; simp; ring
        rw [h_eval, norm_mul]
        have h_in1 : ‖(q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁‖ ≤
            T₀ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          calc ‖q.1 / 2‖ * ‖W q.2‖ * ‖v₁‖
              ≤ T₀ * (M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ :=
                mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hT_half hW_q (norm_nonneg _) hT₀.le) hv1
                  (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = T₀ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by ring
        have h_in2 : ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂‖ ≤
            T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          calc ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2‖ * ‖deriv W q.2‖ * ‖v₂‖
              ≤ T₀ ^ 2 * (r_Z⁻¹ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α)) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ :=
                mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hT_sq hdW_est (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)) hv2
                  (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by ring
        have h_sum : ‖(q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁ + (q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂‖ ≤
            (T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by
          calc ‖(q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁ + (q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂‖
              ≤ ‖(q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁‖ + ‖(q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ (T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by
                linarith
        calc ‖deriv φ (u_fn q)‖ *
              ‖(q.1 / 2) * W q.2 * v₁ + (q.1 / 2) ^ 2 * deriv W q.2 * v₂‖
            ≤ M_φ * ((T₀ * M_W + T₀ ^ 2 * r_Z⁻¹ * M_W) * (c₀ + τ) ^ (-2 * α) * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖) :=
              mul_le_mul hdφ_q h_sum (norm_nonneg _) hM_φ_pos.le
          _ = B_dom τ * ‖(v₁, v₂)‖ := by dsimp [B_dom]; ring
      exact ⟨hq_int, hdZ_le, hLg_le⟩

    have hp_s_box : (T_s, Z_s) ∈ s_box := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_T, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_Z⟩
    have hp_s_int : (T_s, Z_s) ∈ U_int := ⟨by linarith, hΩ_wide_sub_int hZ_s⟩
    let μ_ray := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
    let F_2d : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun p τ => g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    let F'_2d : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p τ =>
      L_g (p.1, p.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)

    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds (T_s, Z_s), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F_2d p) μ_ray := by
      filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
      have h_cont_p : ContinuousOn (F_2d p) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hg_cont.comp (by fun_prop) (fun τ hτ => (h_box_est p hp τ hτ).1)
      exact h_cont_p.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F'_2d (T_s, Z_s)) μ_ray := by
      refine (hLg_cont.comp (by fun_prop) ?_).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
      intro τ hτ
      exact (h_box_est (T_s, Z_s) hp_s_box τ hτ).1
    have hF'_bound : ∀ᵐ τ ∂μ_ray, ∀ p ∈ s_box, ‖F'_2d p τ‖ ≤ B_dom τ := by
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with τ hτ p hp
      exact (h_box_est p hp τ hτ).2.2
    have hF'_has : ∀ᵐ τ ∂μ_ray, ∀ p ∈ s_box, HasFDerivAt (fun q => F_2d q τ) (F'_2d p τ) p := by
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with τ hτ p hp
      have hq := (hg_int _ (h_box_est p hp τ hτ).1).2.2.2.2.2.1
      have h_sh : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1, q.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ℂ × ℂ)) p := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.1) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ) p :=
          hasFDerivAt_fst
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ) p := hasFDerivAt_snd.sub_const _
        convert h1.prodMk h2 using 1
        ext <;> simp
      have hc := hq.comp p h_sh
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at hc
      exact hc
    have hI_fd := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
      hs_nhds hF_meas (hg_ray_integrable (T_s, Z_s) hp_s_int)
      hF'_meas hF'_bound hB_dom_int hF'_has
    have h𝒴_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ 𝒴 (T_s, Z_s) :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd.differentiableAt.add (hI_fd.differentiableAt.const_mul Complex.I)

    
    let F_1d : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun Z' τ => g (T_s, Z' - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    let F'_1d : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun Z' τ => d_Z_g (T_s, Z' - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hsZ_nhds : Metric.ball Z_s r_Z ∈ nhds Z_s :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_Z)
    have hF1_meas : ∀ᶠ Z' in nhds Z_s, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F_1d Z') μ_ray := by
      filter_upwards [hsZ_nhds] with Z' hZ'
      have h_cont_1d : ContinuousOn (F_1d Z') (Set.Ioi 0) :=
        hg_cont.comp (by fun_prop) (fun τ hτ =>
          (h_box_est (T_s, Z') ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_T, hZ'⟩ τ hτ).1)
      exact h_cont_1d.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
    have hF'1_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F'_1d Z_s) μ_ray := by
      refine (hdZg_cont.comp (by fun_prop) ?_).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi
      intro τ hτ
      exact (h_box_est (T_s, Z_s) hp_s_box τ hτ).1
    have hF'1_bound : ∀ᵐ τ ∂μ_ray, ∀ Z' ∈ Metric.ball Z_s r_Z, ‖F'_1d Z' τ‖ ≤ B_dom τ := by

        linarith
      have hS_lip : ‖S_lim p - Z₀‖ ≤ K₀ * ‖p - p₀‖ := by
        dsimp [K₀]; linarith
      have h1_lip : ‖p.1 - T₀'‖ ≤ K₀ * ‖p - p₀‖ := by
        have hm : ‖p.1 - T₀'‖ ≤ ‖p - p₀‖ := le_max_left _ _
        calc ‖p.1 - T₀'‖ ≤ 1 * ‖p - p₀‖ := by rw [one_mul]; exact hm

      exact max_le h1_lip hS_lip

    have hq_tend : Filter.Tendsto q_fn (nhds p₀) (nhds (T₀', Z₀)) := by
      rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      refine squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hq_lip ?_
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => K₀ * ‖p - p₀‖) := by fun_prop
      simpa using h_cont.tendsto p₀

    let M : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      b⁻¹ • (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ - a • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ)
    have hM_fd : HasFDerivAt S_lim M p₀ := by
      rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro ε hε
      let ε' : ℝ := ‖b‖ * ε / K₀
      have hε' : 0 < ε' := by dsimp [ε']; positivity
      have hL_ev := Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff.mp (hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO.mp hL_fd) hε'
      filter_upwards [hΩ_inv_open.mem_nhds hp₀, hq_lip, hq_tend.eventually hL_ev]
        with p hp_in hp_lip hp_L
      obtain ⟨_, h𝒴_p, _⟩ := hS_inv p hp_in
      have hL_split : L (q_fn p - (T₀', Z₀)) =
          a * (p.1 - T₀') + b * (S_lim p - Z₀) := by

            (p.1 - T₀') • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + (S_lim p - Z₀) • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
          ext <;> (dsimp [q_fn]; simp)
        rw [h_vec, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        dsimp [a, b]
        ring

        dsimp [M, Y₀, T₀']; simp
      have h_alg : S_lim p - Z₀ - M (p - p₀) =

        have hY_eq : 𝒴 (q_fn p) = p.2 := h𝒴_p
        rw [hM_eval, hY_eq, h𝒴₀, hL_split]
        field_simp [hb_ne]
        ring
      rw [h_alg, norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_inv]
      calc ‖b‖⁻¹ * ‖𝒴 (q_fn p) - 𝒴 (T₀', Z₀) - L (q_fn p - (T₀', Z₀))‖
          ≤ ‖b‖⁻¹ * (ε' * ‖q_fn p - (T₀', Z₀)‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_L (by positivity)
        _ ≤ ‖b‖⁻¹ * (ε' * (K₀ * ‖p - p₀‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left

        _ = ε * ‖p - p₀‖ := by
            dsimp [ε']
            field_simp [hb_pos.ne', hK₀_pos.ne']

    have hS_dY : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (p₀.1, Y'))

      · rfl
      · dsimp [M]
        simp [hb_eq]
        rfl
    exact ⟨hM_fd.differentiableAt, hS_dY.deriv⟩

  
  have hS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_lim Ω_deep := fun p hp =>

  have hS_props : ∀ T Y : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → D_ray < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) →

        G_sq ((T / 2) ^ 2 * W (S_lim (T, Y)) *
          (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 2) = 1 := by
    intro T Y hT hY_im hY_re
    have hp_deep : (T, Y) ∈ Ω_deep := ⟨hT, hY_im, hY_re⟩

      have h_eq : 𝒴 (T, S_lim (-T, Y)) = 𝒴 (T, S_lim (T, Y)) := by

    have hdY := (hS_fderiv_and_derivY (T, Y) hp_inv).2

    have hu₀ : u₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.ρ_u :=

    have hj_p := R.j_props u₀ hu₀
    rw [hdY]
    exact ⟨h_im_neg, h_even_S, h_disp, hj_p.2.2.2.1, hj_p.2.2.2.2⟩

  have hS_zero : ∀ Y : ℂ, D_ray < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y := by

    have hY_C₁ : Y ∈ C₁_cone := (hball_sub Y (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_Y.le)).1

  let V₀ : Set ℂ := coneOf D₀ A₀

    ⟨by rw [hz₀_im]; linarith, by rw [hz₀_re, abs_zero, hz₀_im]; positivity⟩

    filter_upwards [(hV₀_open.inter hV₂_open).mem_nhds ⟨hz₀_V₀, hz₀_V₂⟩] with Y ⟨hYV₀, hYV₂⟩
    obtain ⟨hSY_w, _, _, _⟩ := hV₂_props Y hYV₂
    obtain ⟨hSm_w, h𝒴_Sm, _⟩ := hS_inv (T, Y) (hΩ_deep_sub_inv (hV₀_sub_deep Y hYV₀))
    have h_eq : 𝒴 (T, S_star Y) = 𝒴 (T, S_mod Y) := by
      rw [hh_zero Y hYV₂, h𝒴_Sm]
    have hexp := h_exp_wide T (S_star Y) (S_mod Y) hT_ray hSY_w hSm_w
    rw [h_eq, sub_self, norm_zero] at hexp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp (by linarith))
  have h_eqOn := AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
    ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hV₀_open).mpr hS_star_V₀)
    ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hV₀_open).mpr hS_mod_holo)
    hV₀_conv.isPreconnected hz₀_V₀ h_ev_eq
  intro Y hY_im hY_re
  exact h_eqOn ⟨hY_im, hY_re⟩
