proof.tactics:
by
 have hCalc : DeepPassPartialCalculus S A := by
  have h_pderiv1 : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ g W → DifferentiableOn ℂ (deepPassPhiDS g) W := by
    intro W g hW hg p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨r_raw, hr_raw_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let R : ℝ := r_raw / 4
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := by positivity
    have h4R_sub : Metric.ball p₀ (4 * R) ⊆ W := by
      have : 4 * R = r_raw := by dsimp [R]; ring
      rwa [this]
    have h3R_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * R) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans h4R_sub
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (3 * R)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hg.continuousOn.mono h3R_sub)
    let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    have hM_bd : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * R), ‖g q‖ ≤ M :=
      fun q hq => le_trans (hM₀ q hq) (le_max_left _ _)
    let B₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ R
    let B₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ (R / 2)
    have hB₂_open : IsOpen B₂ := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hp₀_B₂ : p₀ ∈ B₂ := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
    let h_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (R : ℂ) / ((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ)
    have hh_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < ‖h_seq m‖ := by
      intro m
      dsimp [h_seq]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos, Complex.norm_natCast]
      positivity
    have hh_ne : ∀ m : ℕ, h_seq m ≠ 0 := fun m => norm_pos_iff.mp (hh_pos m)
    have hh_norm : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖h_seq m‖ = R / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro m
      dsimp [h_seq]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos, Complex.norm_natCast]
      push_cast
      rfl
    have hh_le : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖h_seq m‖ ≤ R / 2 := by
      intro m
      rw [hh_norm m]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hR_pos.le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    let D_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) := fun m p => (g (p.1 + h_seq m, p.2) - g p) / h_seq m
    have hD_holo : ∀ m : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (D_seq m) B₁ := by
      intro m
      have h_shift : Differentiable ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + h_seq m, p.2)) := by fun_prop
      have h_maps1 : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + h_seq m, p.2)) B₁ W := by
        intro p hp
        apply h4R_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def, max_lt_iff] at hp ⊢
        simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub] at hp ⊢
        refine ⟨?_, lt_trans hp.2 (by linarith)⟩
        calc ‖p.1 + h_seq m - p₀.1‖ = ‖(p.1 - p₀.1) + h_seq m‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖p.1 - p₀.1‖ + ‖h_seq m‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < R + R / 2 := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hp.1 (hh_le m)
          _ < 4 * R := by linarith
      have h_maps0 : B₁ ⊆ W := (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans h4R_sub
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => g (p.1 + h_seq m, p.2)) B₁ :=
        hg.comp h_shift.differentiableOn h_maps1
      have h0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ g B₁ := hg.mono h_maps0
      have h_post : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w / h_seq m) := by fun_prop
      exact h_post.comp_differentiableOn ((h1.sub h0).congr (fun _ _ => rfl))
    let C₂ : ℝ := 2 * M / R ^ 2
    have hC₂_nn : 0 ≤ C₂ := by positivity
    have hD_err : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ B₁,
        ‖D_seq m p - deepPassPhiDS g p‖ ≤ C₂ * ‖h_seq m‖ := by
      intro m ⟨z, w⟩ hp
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def, max_lt_iff] at hp
      simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub] at hp
      let g_w : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => g (ξ, w)
      have hgw_2R : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_w (Metric.ball z (2 * R)) := by
        have h_emb : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, w)) (Metric.ball z (2 * R)) := by fun_prop
        refine hg.comp h_emb (fun ξ hξ => h4R_sub ?_)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hξ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def, max_lt_iff]
        simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
        refine ⟨?_, lt_trans hp.2 (by linarith)⟩
        calc ‖ξ - p₀.1‖ = ‖(ξ - z) + (z - p₀.1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖ξ - z‖ + ‖z - p₀.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < 2 * R + R := add_lt_add hξ hp.1
          _ < 4 * R := by linarith
      have hdgw_2R : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g_w) (Metric.ball z (2 * R)) :=
        hgw_2R.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h2deriv_bd : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball z R, ‖deriv (deriv g_w) ζ‖ ≤ C₂ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
        have h_cb_3R : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ R, (ξ, w) ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (3 * R) := by
          intro ξ hξ
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hξ
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
          simp only [Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub]
          refine max_le ?_ (by linarith [hp.2])
          calc ‖ξ - p₀.1‖ = ‖(ξ - ζ) + (ζ - z) + (z - p₀.1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖(ξ - ζ) + (ζ - z)‖ + ‖z - p₀.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ (‖ξ - ζ‖ + ‖ζ - z‖) + ‖z - p₀.1‖ := add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _
            _ ≤ R + R + R := by linarith
            _ = 3 * R := by ring
        have hgw_W : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_w ((fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, w)) ⁻¹' W) :=
          hg.comp (by fun_prop) (fun _ h => h)
        have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g_w (Metric.ball ζ R) :=
          hgw_W.diffContOnCl_ball (fun ξ hξ => h3R_sub (h_cb_3R ξ hξ))
        have h_sph : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.sphere ζ R, ‖g_w ξ‖ ≤ M :=
          fun ξ hξ => hM_bd (ξ, w) (h_cb_3R ξ (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hξ))
        have h_it := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le 2 hR_pos h_dc h_sph
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one] at h_it
        simpa [C₂] using h_it
      have hdgw_lip : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball z R, ‖deriv g_w ζ - deriv g_w z‖ ≤ C₂ * ‖ζ - z‖ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have h_da : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball z R, DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv g_w) u :=
          fun u hu => hdgw_2R.differentiableAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hu))
        exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          h_da h2deriv_bd (convex_ball z R) (Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos) hζ
      let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => g_w ζ - ζ * deriv g_w z
      have h_cb_in_R : Metric.closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖ ⊆ Metric.ball z R :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (lt_of_le_of_lt (hh_le m) (by linarith))
      have hψ_da : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖, DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ ζ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_2R : ζ ∈ Metric.ball z (2 * R) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (h_cb_in_R hζ)
        exact (hgw_2R.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hζ_2R)).sub
          (differentiableAt_id.mul_const _)
      have hψ_d_bd : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖, ‖deriv ψ ζ‖ ≤ C₂ * ‖h_seq m‖ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_2R : ζ ∈ Metric.ball z (2 * R) :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (h_cb_in_R hζ)
        have hd_gw := (hgw_2R.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hζ_2R)).hasDerivAt
        have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun ξ : ℂ => ξ * deriv g_w z) (deriv g_w z) ζ := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id ζ).mul_const (deriv g_w z)
        have hd_ψ : deriv ψ ζ = deriv g_w ζ - deriv g_w z := (hd_gw.sub hd_lin).deriv
        rw [hd_ψ]
        have hζ_dist : ‖ζ - z‖ ≤ ‖h_seq m‖ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hζ
        exact le_trans (hdgw_lip ζ (h_cb_in_R hζ))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hζ_dist hC₂_nn)
      have hz_mem_cb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖ :=
        Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hh_pos m).le
      have hzh_mem_cb : z + h_seq m ∈ Metric.closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖ := by
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have h_est := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        hψ_da hψ_d_bd (convex_closedBall z ‖h_seq m‖) hz_mem_cb hzh_mem_cb
      have h_id : D_seq m (z, w) - deepPassPhiDS g (z, w) = (ψ (z + h_seq m) - ψ z) / h_seq m := by
        dsimp [D_seq, deepPassPhiDS, ψ, g_w]
        field_simp [hh_ne m]
        ring
      rw [h_id, norm_div, div_le_iff₀ (hh_pos m)]
      simpa using h_est
    have hfderiv_diff : ∀ m k : ℕ, ∀ c ∈ B₂,
        ‖fderiv ℂ (D_seq m) c - fderiv ℂ (D_seq k) c‖ ≤ (8 * M / R ^ 3) * (‖h_seq m‖ + ‖h_seq k‖) := by
      intro m k c hc
      have h_sub_B₁ : Metric.ball c (R / 2) ⊆ B₁ := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hc hq ⊢
        calc ‖q - p₀‖ = ‖(q - c) + (c - p₀)‖ := by abel_nf
          _ ≤ ‖q - c‖ + ‖c - p₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _

     p_seq := deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq
     D_pass_ge := C_core.D_pass_ge
     D_rec_ge := R_rec.D_rec_ge
     C_pass_pos := C_core.C_pass_pos
     B_pos := fun n => (hdB_pos n).2
     B_tendsto := hB_tend
     W_holo := hF_holo.pow 2
     W_bound := hW1_bd
     trunc_passages := fun R_top hR => by
       obtain ⟨N_c, hNc⟩ := C_core.trunc_and_tube R_top hR
       exact ⟨N_c, fun n hn => ⟨(hNc n hn).1, (hNc n hn).2.1, (hNc n hn).2.2.1⟩⟩
     action_holo_and_conv := hAct1
     recurrence_eq := R_rec.recurrence_eq
   }, fun R_top hR => ?_⟩
   obtain ⟨N_c, hNc⟩ := C_core.trunc_and_tube R_top hR
   exact ⟨N_c, fun n hn T Y hT hY1 hY2 hY3 h_tube =>
     (hNc n hn).2.2.2 T Y hT hY1 hY2 hY3 h_tube⟩
 · intro Q hQ_holo hF_conv hQ_conv
   obtain ⟨hW2_bd, hAct2⟩ := hConv.2 Q hQ_holo hF_conv hQ_conv
   refine ⟨{
     D_pass := C_core.D_pass
     D_rec := R_rec.D_rec
     C_pass := C_core.C_pass
     S_seq := C_core.S_seq
     p_seq := deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq
     D_pass_ge := C_core.D_pass_ge
     D_rec_ge := R_rec.D_rec_ge
     C_pass_pos := C_core.C_pass_pos
     B_pos := fun n => (hdB_pos n).2
     B_tendsto := hB_tend
     W_holo := hQ_holo
     W_bound := hW2_bd
     trunc_passages := fun R_top hR => by
       obtain ⟨N_c, hNc⟩ := C_core.trunc_and_tube R_top hR
       exact ⟨N_c, fun n hn => ⟨(hNc n hn).1, (hNc n hn).2.1, (hNc n hn).2.2.1⟩⟩
     action_holo_and_conv := hAct2
     recurrence_eq := R_rec.recurrence_eq
   }, fun R_top hR => ?_⟩
   obtain ⟨N_c, hNc⟩ := C_core.trunc_and_tube R_top hR
   exact ⟨N_c, fun n hn T Y hT hY1 hY2 hY3 h_tube =>
     (hNc n hn).2.2.2 T Y hT hY1 hY2 hY3 h_tube⟩

deep_rescaled_passages_and_recurrence.definitions:
noncomputable def deepPassPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ξ_seq d_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z

noncomputable def deepPassStep (d_seq B_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  T * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)

noncomputable def deepPassActionSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (ξ_seq d_seq B_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (T Z J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  smallChordActionP A.Phi (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z) J (deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T)

noncomputable def deepPassPhiDS (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => Phi (s', q.2)) q.1

noncomputable def deepPassPhiDH (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun h' : ℂ => Phi (q.1, h')) q.2

structure DeepPassPartialCalculus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) : Prop where
  phi_ds_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deepPassPhiDS A.Phi) (smallChordDomain S A.η_SL)
  phi_dh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deepPassPhiDH A.Phi) (smallChordDomain S A.η_SL)
  deriv_actionP_J : ∀ s J t : ℂ,
    (s, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    deriv (fun J' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s J' t) J =
      3 * J ^ 2 * A.Phi (s, t * J) + J ^ 3 * t * deepPassPhiDH A.Phi (s, t * J)
  deriv_actionP_s : ∀ s J t : ℂ,
    (s, t * J) ∈ smallChordDomain S A.η_SL →
    deriv (fun s' : ℂ => smallChordActionP A.Phi s' J t) s =
      J ^ 3 * deepPassPhiDS A.Phi (s, t * J)
  cauchy_deriv_conv : ∀ (U_Z K_Z : Set ℂ) (ρ_K : ℝ)
      (g_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (g_lim : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U_Z → IsCompact K_Z → 0 < ρ_K →
    Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ⊆ U_Z →
    (∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_seq n q.1 q.2)
        (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_lim q.1 q.2)
      (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) →
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => g_seq n q.1 q.2)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => g_lim q.1 q.2)
      Filter.atTop (Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 16)) →
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun J' => g_seq n q.1 J') q.2)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => g_lim q.1 J') q.2)
      Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∧
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun Z' => g_seq n Z' q.2) q.1)
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Z' => g_lim Z' q.2) q.1)
      Filter.atTop (K_Z ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8))

structure DeepPassConeCore (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (α A₀ T₀ δ_b : ℝ) (d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ) where
  D_pass : ℝ
  C_A : ℝ
  C_pass : ℝ
  N_coarse : ℕ
  S_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  D_pass_ge : 20 ≤ D_pass
  C_A_pos : 0 < C_A
  C_pass_pos : 0 < C_pass
  C_A_sq_le : C_A ^ 2 ≤ C_pass
  coarse_bound : ∀ n ≥ N_coarse, ∀ Z : ℂ,
    1 ≤ -Z.im → d_seq n * (-Z.im) ≤ δ_b → |Z.re| ≤ (A₀ + 6) * (-Z.im) →
    (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z) ≤
      C_A * (-Z.im) ^ (-α)
  trunc_and_tube : ∀ R_top : ℝ, D_pass < R_top →
    ∃ N_cone : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_cone,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_seq n)
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ ∧
          D_pass / 2 < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < R_top ∧
          |p.2.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-p.2.im) } ∧
      (∀ T Y : ℂ,
        ‖T‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top →
        |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        (S_seq n (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
        ‖S_seq n (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C_pass * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        S_seq n (0, Y) = Y) ∧
      (∀ T Y : ℂ,
        ‖T‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        D_pass / 2 < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top →
        |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) →
        (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Y, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T) ∈
          finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
        S_seq n (T, Y) =
          (S.𝔰 (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Y, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T) -
            (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ))

structure DeepPassRecurrenceData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (A : SmallFieldChordActionData S) (α A₀ T₀ δ_b : ℝ)
    (d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (C_core : DeepPassConeCore S α A₀ T₀ δ_b d_seq B_seq ξ_seq) where
  D_rec : ℝ
  D_rec_ge : C_core.D_pass ≤ D_rec
  small_field_on_D_rec :
    4 * T₀ ^ 2 * C_core.C_A ^ 2 * (2 / D_rec) ^ (2 * α) < min (A.η_SL / 2) 4
  compact_chord_admissible : ∀ K_pad : Set ℂ, IsCompact K_pad →
    K_pad ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } →
    (∃ N_adm : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_adm,
      ∀ Z ∈ K_pad, ∀ J : ℂ, ‖J‖ ≤ 5 / 4 → ∀ T' : ℂ, ‖T'‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z, deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T' * J) ∈
          smallChordDomain S A.η_SL) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_deriv : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_deriv,
      ∀ Z ∈ K_pad, ∀ J : ℂ, ‖J‖ ≤ 5 / 4 → ∀ T' : ℂ, ‖T'‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * T₀ →
        ‖(deepPassStep d_seq B_seq n T' * J) ^ 2 *
          deriv S.f (deepPassPt S ξ_seq d_seq n Z)‖ < ε)
  action_holo_on_open : ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ →
    ∀ K_Z : Set ℂ, IsCompact K_Z →
      K_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Z.im) } →
      ∃ (U_Z : Set ℂ) (ρ_K : ℝ),
        IsOpen U_Z ∧ 0 < ρ_K ∧ K_Z ⊆ U_Z ∧
        Metric.cthickening ρ_K K_Z ⊆ U_Z ∧
        Metric.cthickening (2 * ρ_K) K_Z ⊆
          { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } ∧
        U_Z ⊆ { Z : ℂ | D_rec / 2 < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A₀ + 4) * (-Z.im) } ∧
        ∃ N_holo : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_holo,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T q.1 q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
              deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T q.1 J') q.2)
            (U_Z ×ˢ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))
  recurrence_eq : ∀ R_top : ℝ, 3 * D_rec < R_top →
    ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → T ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N_rec : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_rec,
        ∀ Y : ℂ, 2 * D_rec < -Y.im → -Y.im < R_top - 2 → |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) →
          let h_n : ℂ := T / (B_seq n : ℂ)
          let J_p : ℂ := (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y + h_n) - C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)) / h_n
          let J_m : ℂ := (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y) - C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) / h_n
          ‖J_p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧ ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          D_rec < -(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).im ∧
          |(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)).im) ∧
          D_rec < -(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im ∧
          |(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-(C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)).im) ∧
          deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y)) J') J_p -
            deriv (fun J' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y - h_n)) J') J_m =
            h_n * deriv (fun Z' => deepPassActionSeq S A ξ_seq d_seq B_seq n T Z' J_p) (C_core.S_seq n (T, Y))

informal_problem.statement:
(α A₀ T₀ D₀ : ℝ) (B_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (Phi_sq G_sq W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hα1 : 1 / 2 < α) (hα2 : α < 1) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hT₀ : 0 < T₀)
    (hPair : IsDeepPureFrozenPair Phi_sq G_sq)
    (M : DeepPureModelSolution α A₀ T₀ G_sq W)
    (P : DeepPureRescaledPassages α A₀ T₀ B_seq Phi_sq W)
    (hD₀ : max M.D_mod P.D_pass ≤ D₀)
    (K : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hK_comp : IsCompact K)
    (hK_sub : K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) })
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K, ‖P.S_seq n p - M.S_lim p‖ < ε

signature.name: deep_divided_difference_limit_identification
signature.statement:
(α A₀ T₀ D₀ : ℝ) (B_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (Phi_sq G_sq W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hα1 : 1 / 2 < α) (hα2 : α < 1) (hA₀ : 0 < A₀) (hT₀ : 0 < T₀)
    (hPair : IsDeepPureFrozenPair Phi_sq G_sq)
    (M : DeepPureModelSolution α A₀ T₀ G_sq W)
    (P : DeepPureRescaledPassages α A₀ T₀ B_seq Phi_sq W)
    (hD₀ : max M.D_mod P.D_pass ≤ D₀)
    (K : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hK_comp : IsCompact K)
    (hK_sub : K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) })
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K, ‖P.S_seq n p - M.S_lim p‖ < ε

proof.tactics:
by
  have hD₀_mod : M.D_mod ≤ D₀ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hD₀
  have hD₀_pass : P.D_pass ≤ D₀ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hD₀
  have hD₀_ge20 : 20 ≤ D₀ := le_trans M.D_mod_ge hD₀_mod
  
  have h_s1 : (∀ T_star Y_star : ℂ,
      ‖T_star‖ < T₀ → T_star ≠ 0 → D₀ < -Y_star.im → |Y_star.re| < A₀ * (-Y_star.im) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => P.S_seq n (T_star, Y_star)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star)))) →
      ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K, ‖P.S_seq n p - M.S_lim p‖ < ε := by
    intro hPt
    by_contra h_not
    have h_ex : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ N, ∃ p ∈ K, ε ≤ ‖P.S_seq n p - M.S_lim p‖ := by
      intro N
      by_contra! h_all
      exact h_not ⟨N, h_all⟩
    classical
    let stepN : ℕ → { n : ℕ // ∃ p ∈ K, ε ≤ ‖P.S_seq n p - M.S_lim p‖ } :=
      fun N => ⟨Classical.choose (h_ex N), (Classical.choose_spec (h_ex N)).2⟩
    have h_stepN_ge : ∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ (stepN N).1 :=
      fun N => (Classical.choose_spec (h_ex N)).1
    let φ₀ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => Nat.recOn k (stepN 0).1 (fun _ prev => (stepN (prev + 1)).1)
    have hφ₀_mono : StrictMono φ₀ :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => Nat.lt_of_succ_le (h_stepN_ge (φ₀ k + 1))
    have hφ₀_bad : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ p ∈ K, ε ≤ ‖P.S_seq (φ₀ k) p - M.S_lim p‖ := by
      intro k
      cases k with
      | zero => exact (stepN 0).2
      | succ k => exact (stepN (φ₀ k + 1)).2
    let p_seq_K : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun k => Classical.choose (hφ₀_bad k)
    have hp_mem : ∀ k : ℕ, p_seq_K k ∈ K := fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hφ₀_bad k)).1
    have hp_ge : ∀ k : ℕ, ε ≤ ‖P.S_seq (φ₀ k) (p_seq_K k) - M.S_lim (p_seq_K k)‖ :=
      fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hφ₀_bad k)).2
    obtain ⟨p_star, hp_star_K, ψ₁, hψ₁_mono, hq_tend⟩ := hK_comp.tendsto_subseq hp_mem
    let T_star : ℂ := p_star.1
    let Y_star : ℂ := p_star.2
    let φ₁ : ℕ → ℕ := φ₀ ∘ ψ₁
    let q_k : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := p_seq_K ∘ ψ₁
    have hφ₁_mono : StrictMono φ₁ := hφ₀_mono.comp hψ₁_mono
    have hp_star_cone := hK_sub hp_star_K
    have hT_star : ‖T_star‖ < T₀ := hp_star_cone.1
    have hY_star_im : D₀ < -Y_star.im := hp_star_cone.2.1
    have hY_star_re : |Y_star.re| < A₀ * (-Y_star.im) := hp_star_cone.2.2
    let ρ_T : ℝ := T₀ / 8
    let δ₀ : ℝ := min (D₀ / (4 * (A₀ + 4))) 1
    let R_top : ℝ := -Y_star.im + 10
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ_T := by dsimp [ρ_T]; positivity
    have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min (by positivity) zero_lt_one
    have hδ₀_le_one : δ₀ ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have hδ₀_le_frac : δ₀ ≤ D₀ / (4 * (A₀ + 4)) := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ₀_prod : (A₀ + 4) * (2 * δ₀) ≤ D₀ / 2 := by
      have h4pos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * (A₀ + 4) := by positivity
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h4pos).mp hδ₀_le_frac
      nlinarith
    have h2δ₀_le_D8 : 2 * δ₀ ≤ D₀ / 8 := by nlinarith
    have hR_top_gt : P.D_pass < R_top := by dsimp [R_top]; linarith
    obtain ⟨N_cone, hN_cone⟩ := P.trunc_passages R_top hR_top_gt
    let W_trunc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖p.1‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ ∧
        P.D_pass / 2 < -p.2.im ∧ -p.2.im < R_top ∧
        |p.2.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-p.2.im) }
    have h_poly_in : ∀ T Y : ℂ,
        T ∈ Metric.closedBall T_star (2 * ρ_T) →
        Y ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_star (2 * δ₀) →
        (T, Y) ∈ W_trunc ∧ 1 ≤ -Y.im := by
      intro T Y hT_cb hY_cb
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hT_cb hY_cb
      have hT_norm : ‖T‖ < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀ := by
        have h1 : ‖T‖ ≤ ‖T - T_star‖ + ‖T_star‖ := norm_le_norm_sub_add T T_star
        dsimp [ρ_T] at hT_cb
        linarith
      have him_diff : |Y.im - Y_star.im| ≤ 2 * δ₀ :=
        le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Y - Y_star)) hY_cb
      have hre_diff : |Y.re - Y_star.re| ≤ 2 * δ₀ :=
        le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Y - Y_star)) hY_cb
      rw [abs_le] at him_diff hre_diff
      have hY_im_lo : P.D_pass / 2 < -Y.im := by linarith
      have hY_im_ge1 : 1 ≤ -Y.im := by linarith
      have hY_im_hi : -Y.im < R_top := by dsimp [R_top]; linarith
      have hY_re : |Y.re| < (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) := by
        have hre1 : |Y.re| ≤ |Y_star.re| + 2 * δ₀ := by
          rw [abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self Y_star.re, neg_abs_le Y_star.re]
        have h_rhs : (A₀ + 3) * (-Y_star.im - 2 * δ₀) ≤ (A₀ + 3) * (-Y.im) := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      exact ⟨⟨hT_norm, hY_im_lo, hY_im_hi, hY_re⟩, hY_im_ge1⟩
    let M_star : ℝ := P.C_pass * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * T₀) ^ 2
    have hC_pass_pos : 0 < P.C_pass := P.C_pass_pos
    have hM_star_pos : 0 < M_star := by dsimp [M_star]; positivity
    have h_lip_slice : ∀ n ≥ N_cone, ∀ T Y : ℂ,
        T ∈ Metric.ball T_star ρ_T → Y ∈ Metric.ball Y_star δ₀ →
        ‖P.S_seq n (T, Y) - P.S_seq n (T_star, Y_star)‖ ≤
          (M_star / ρ_T) * ‖T - T_star‖ + (M_star / δ₀ + 1) * ‖Y - Y_star‖ := by
      intro n hn T Y hT_b hY_b
      obtain ⟨hS_holo, hS_bnd, _⟩ := hN_cone n hn

            G_sq ((T_star / 2) ^ 2 * W (S_star (Y_m m)) * (J (Y_m m)) ^ 2))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 12 : ℂ)) := by
        simpa using ((hJ_tend1.pow 3).const_mul (1 / 12 : ℂ)).mul hG_tend1
      exact h_prod.congr fun m => (he_leg (Y_m m) (hYm_in_V m)).symm
    intro Y hY_im hY_re
    have hY_V : Y ∈ V_deep := ⟨hY_im, hY_re⟩
    have he_eq_const : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => e (Y_m m)) Filter.atTop (nhds (e Y)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.congr fun m => (he_const (hYm_in_V m) hY_V).symm
    have he_val : e Y = (1 / 12 : ℂ) := tendsto_nhds_unique he_eq_const he_tend
    rw [he_leg Y hY_V] at he_val
    linear_combination 12 * he_val
  
  refine h_s1 ?_
  intro T_star Y_star hT_star hT_ne hY_im hY_re
  by_contra h_not_pt
  have h_ex_pt : ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n ≥ N,
      ε₀ ≤ dist (P.S_seq n (T_star, Y_star)) (M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star)) := by
    by_contra! h_all
    exact h_not_pt (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr h_all)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, h_freq⟩ := h_ex_pt
  classical
  let stepPt : ℕ → { n : ℕ // ε₀ ≤ dist (P.S_seq n (T_star, Y_star)) (M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star)) } :=
    fun N => ⟨Classical.choose (h_freq N), (Classical.choose_spec (h_freq N)).2⟩
  have h_stepPt_ge : ∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ (stepPt N).1 :=
    fun N => (Classical.choose_spec (h_freq N)).1
  let φ₁ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => Nat.recOn k (stepPt 0).1 (fun _ prev => (stepPt (prev + 1)).1)
  have hφ₁_mono : StrictMono φ₁ :=
    strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun k => Nat.lt_of_succ_le (h_stepPt_ge (φ₁ k + 1))
  have hφ₁_sep : ∀ k : ℕ,
      ε₀ ≤ dist (P.S_seq (φ₁ k) (T_star, Y_star)) (M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star)) := by
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero => exact (stepPt 0).2
    | succ k => exact (stepPt (φ₁ k + 1)).2
  obtain ⟨ψ, S_star, hψ_mono, hS_holo, hS_conv, hS_deriv_conv, hS_disp⟩ :=
    h_s2 T_star hT_star φ₁ hφ₁_mono
  let C_star : ℝ := P.C_pass * T₀ ^ 2 + 1
  have hC_star_pos : 0 < C_star := by
    have := P.C_pass_pos
    dsimp [C_star]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₀_le_D₁, hG_holo, hEL⟩ :=
    h_s3 C_star hC_star_pos T_star hT_star hT_ne (φ₁ ∘ ψ) (hφ₁_mono.comp hψ_mono)
      S_star hS_holo hS_conv hS_deriv_conv hS_disp
  have hODE := h_s4 D₁ C_star hD₀_le_D₁ hC_star_pos T_star S_star hS_holo hS_disp hG_holo hEL
  have hC₁_sub_C₂ : { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A₀ + 1) * (-Y.im) } ⊆
      { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) } := by
    intro Y hY
    have : 0 < -Y.im := by linarith [hY.1]
    exact ⟨hY.1, by nlinarith [hY.2]⟩
  have hS_eq_lim : S_star Y_star = M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star) :=
    M.S_lim_unique_1d D₀ hD₀_mod T_star hT_star S_star C_star D₁ hD₀_le_D₁ hC_star_pos
      (hS_holo.mono hC₁_sub_C₂)
      (fun Y h1 h2 => hS_disp Y h1 (hC₁_sub_C₂ ⟨h1, h2⟩).2)
      hODE Y_star hY_im hY_re
  have hY_star_C₂ : Y_star ∈ { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A₀ + 2) * (-Y.im) } := by
    have : 0 < -Y_star.im := by linarith
    exact ⟨hY_im, by nlinarith⟩
  have h_sub_conv : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun k => P.S_seq (φ₁ (ψ k)) (T_star, Y_star)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (M.S_lim (T_star, Y_star))) := by
    rw [← hS_eq_lim]
    exact hS_conv.tendsto_at hY_star_C₂
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_sub_conv ε₀ hε₀_pos
  exact absurd (hk₀ k₀ le_rfl) (not_lt_of_ge (hφ₁_sep (ψ k₀)))

informal_problem.statement:
(hVolt : SfcaVolterraKernelProp) :
    (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
      IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish (sfcaNumN Q) ∧
      ∀ z₀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        1 / 4 <
          (sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 *
            sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 /
            (sfcaVolterraK Q 1) ^ 2).re ∧
        ‖sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 3 ∧
        sfcaNumN Q (-z₀) (-z₁) = sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁ ∧
        sfcaNumN (fun w => Q (1 - w)) (-z₁) (-z₀) = sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁) ∧
    ∃ C_N : ℝ, 0 < C_N ∧
      ∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (M_diff : ℝ),
        ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
        0 ≤ M_diff →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ M_diff) →
        ∀ z₀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
          ‖sfcaNumN Q₁ z₀ z₁ - sfcaNumN Q₂ z₀ z₁‖ ≤ C_N * M_diff

proof.tactics:
by
  let sfcaSqrt : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ)
  have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
  have hRhoB_eq : sfcaRhoB = 1 / 16 := rfl
  have hRhoB_pos : 0 < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaRhoB]
  have hRhoB_nonneg : 0 ≤ sfcaRhoB := hRhoB_pos.le
  have hRhoB_le_half : sfcaRhoB ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num [sfcaRhoB]
  have h32_norm : ‖(3 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 3 / 2 := by rw [norm_div]; norm_num
  have h14_norm : ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 4 := by rw [norm_div]; norm_num

  
  have hSqrt_props : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 / 4 < ζ.re →
      (sfcaSqrt ζ) ^ 2 = ζ ∧ 1 / 2 < (sfcaSqrt ζ).re := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      simp [h0] at hζ
      linarith
    have hsq : (sfcaSqrt ζ) ^ 2 = ζ := by
      calc (sfcaSqrt ζ) ^ 2
          = sfcaSqrt ζ * sfcaSqrt ζ := sq _
        _ = Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ) := by
            dsimp [sfcaSqrt]
            rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        _ = Complex.exp (Complex.log ζ) := by
            congr 1
            ring
        _ = ζ := Complex.exp_log hζ_ne
    have him_mem : ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).im ∈
        Set.Icc (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
      have him_eq : ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).im = (Complex.log ζ).im / 2 := by
        simp [Complex.mul_im]
        ring
      rw [him_eq]
      exact ⟨by linarith [Complex.neg_pi_lt_log_im ζ], by linarith [Complex.log_im_le_pi ζ]⟩
    have hre_nonneg : 0 ≤ (sfcaSqrt ζ).re := by
      dsimp [sfcaSqrt]
      rw [Complex.exp_re]
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc him_mem)
    have hre_sq_eq : ζ.re = (sfcaSqrt ζ).re * (sfcaSqrt ζ).re -
        (sfcaSqrt ζ).im * (sfcaSqrt ζ).im := by
      nth_rw 1 [← hsq]
      rw [sq, Complex.mul_re]
    have him_sq : 0 ≤ (sfcaSqrt ζ).im * (sfcaSqrt ζ).im := mul_self_nonneg _
    exact ⟨hsq, by nlinarith⟩

  have hSqrt_lip : ∀ ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ, 1 / 4 < ζ₁.re → 1 / 4 < ζ₂.re →
      ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ ≤ ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ := by
    intro ζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₁ hζ₂
    obtain ⟨hsq₁, hre₁⟩ := hSqrt_props ζ₁ hζ₁
    obtain ⟨hsq₂, hre₂⟩ := hSqrt_props ζ₂ hζ₂
    have hsum_ge : 1 ≤ ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ + sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ := by
      have h1 : 1 < (sfcaSqrt ζ₁ + sfcaSqrt ζ₂).re := by
        simp only [Complex.add_re]
        linarith
      exact le_trans h1.le (Complex.re_le_norm _)
    calc ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖
        = ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ * ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ + sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_ge (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖(sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂) * (sfcaSqrt ζ₁ + sfcaSqrt ζ₂)‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
      _ = ‖(sfcaSqrt ζ₁) ^ 2 - (sfcaSqrt ζ₂) ^ 2‖ := by
          congr 1
          ring
      _ = ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ := by rw [hsq₁, hsq₂]

  
  have hVolterraK_congr : ∀ P₁ P₂ : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn P₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn P₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖P₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ‖P₂ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, P₁ w = P₂ w) →
      sfcaVolterraK P₁ 1 = sfcaVolterraK P₂ 1 := by
    intro P₁ P₂ hP₁_c hP₂_c hP_b hP_eq
    have h_zero_diff : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖P₁ w - P₂ w‖ ≤ 0 := by
      intro w hw
      simp [hP_eq w hw]
    have h_lip := (hVolt.lip_bounds P₁ P₂ 0 hP₁_c hP₂_c hP_b le_rfl h_zero_diff 1 h1_mem).2.1
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp h_lip)

  
  have hBaseBounds : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
      7 / 8 ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ∧
      sfcaVolterraK Q 1 ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w‖ ≤ 17 / 16 ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w‖ ≤ 65 / 64 ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 8 := by
    intro Q hQ_cont hQ_le
    obtain ⟨hk₀_lo, hQB⟩ :=
      hVolt.quant_bounds Q sfcaRhoB hQ_cont hRhoB_nonneg hRhoB_le_half hQ_le
    have hk₀_ne : sfcaVolterraK Q 1 ≠ 0 :=
      norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hk₀_lo)
    refine ⟨hk₀_lo, hk₀_ne, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hC, hK, hCd, hKd⟩ := hQB w hw
    have h1_norm : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1 := norm_one
    have hw_norm : ‖(w : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      simp [abs_of_nonneg hw.1, hw.2]
    have hC_b : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w‖ ≤ 17 / 16 := by
      calc ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w‖
          = ‖(sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 17 / 16 := by linarith [hRhoB_eq, h1_norm]
    have hK_b : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w‖ ≤ 65 / 64 := by
      calc ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w‖
          = ‖(sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)) + (w : ℂ)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w - (w : ℂ)‖ + ‖(w : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 65 / 64 := by linarith [hRhoB_eq, hw_norm]
    have hCd_b : ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      linarith [hRhoB_eq]
    have hKd_b : ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 8 := by
      calc ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w‖
          = ‖(sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 9 / 8 := by linarith [hRhoB_eq, h1_norm]
    exact ⟨hC_b, hK_b, hCd_b, hKd_b⟩

  
  have hSingleEnv : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
      ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
      ContinuousOn (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ContinuousOn (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 3 / 20 ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 / sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ≤ 37 / 28 ∧
      ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 / sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ≤ 37 / 28 ∧
      1 / 4 <
        (sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 *
          sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 /
          (sfcaVolterraK Q 1) ^ 2).re ∧
      ‖sfcaSqrt
          (sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 *
            sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 /
            (sfcaVolterraK Q 1) ^ 2)‖ ≤ 3 / 2 ∧
      ‖sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 3 := by
    intro Q z₀ z₁ hQ_cont hQ_le hz₀ hz₁
    obtain ⟨hk₀_lo, hk₀_ne, hBB⟩ := hBaseBounds Q hQ_cont hQ_le
    obtain ⟨hC_c, hK_c, hCd_c, hKd_c, _⟩ := hVolt.ode_laws Q hQ_cont
    have hF_c : ContinuousOn (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hC_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hK_c)
    have hFd_c : ContinuousOn (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hCd_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hKd_c)
    have hQp_c : ContinuousOn (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hQ_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hFd_c)).sub (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_c.pow 2))
    have hQm_c : ContinuousOn (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hQ_cont.add (continuousOn_const.mul hFd_c)).sub (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_c.pow 2))
    have hz₀_le : ‖z₀‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [hz₀.le, hRhoB_eq]
    have hz₁_le : ‖z₁‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [hz₁.le, hRhoB_eq]
    have hC1_le : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ ≤ 17 / 16 := (hBB 1 h1_mem).1
    have hK1_le : ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ≤ 65 / 64 := (hBB 1 h1_mem).2.1
    have hs_num : ‖z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ ≤ 33 / 256 := by
      calc ‖z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖
          ≤ ‖z₁‖ + ‖z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖z₁‖ + ‖z₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 / 16 + (1 / 16) * (17 / 16) :=
            add_le_add hz₁_le (mul_le_mul hz₀_le hC1_le (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
        _ = 33 / 256 := by norm_num
    have hs_tight : ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 33 / 224 := by
      have hmul_eq : sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1 = z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₀_ne
      have hprod_le : (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 33 / 256 := by
        calc (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖
            ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ * ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk₀_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ = ‖z₁ - z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ := by rw [hmul_eq]
          _ ≤ 33 / 256 := hs_num
      linarith
    have hs_le : ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 3 / 20 := le_trans hs_tight (by norm_num)
    have hField_bounds : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 32 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 32 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
        ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hCw, hKw, hCdw, hKdw⟩ := hBB w hw
      have hFw : ‖sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        calc ‖sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w‖
            ≤ ‖z₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q w‖ + ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q w‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖z₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q w‖ + ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraK Q w‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (1 / 16) * (17 / 16) + (33 / 224) * (65 / 64) :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul hz₀_le hCw (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
                (mul_le_mul hs_tight hKw (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          _ ≤ 1 / 4 := by norm_num
      have hFdw : ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 7 / 40 := by
        calc ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w‖
            ≤ ‖z₀ * sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ + ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁ * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖z₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q w‖ +
                ‖sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q w‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (1 / 16) * (1 / 8) + (33 / 224) * (9 / 8) :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul hz₀_le hCdw (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
                (mul_le_mul hs_tight hKdw (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          _ ≤ 7 / 40 := by norm_num
      have hFw_sq : ‖(sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
        rw [norm_pow]
        have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w‖ := norm_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      have hQp_diff : ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 32 := by
        have h_eq : sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w =
            -((3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w) -
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [sfcaPotPlus]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖-((3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w) -
                (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖
            ≤ ‖-((3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w)‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w‖ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖(sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_neg, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h32_norm,
                norm_mul, h14_norm]
          _ ≤ 9 / 32 := by linarith
      have hQm_diff : ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ ≤ 9 / 32 := by
        have h_eq : sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w =
            (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [sfcaPotMinus]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w -
                (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖
            ≤ ‖(3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁ w‖ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖(sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h32_norm,
                norm_mul, h14_norm]
          _ ≤ 9 / 32 := by linarith
      have hQw : ‖Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith [hQ_le w hw, hRhoB_eq]
      have hQp_b : ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        calc ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w‖
            = ‖(sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w) + Q w‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ + ‖Q w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have hQm_b : ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        calc ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w‖
            = ‖(sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w) + Q w‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ w - Q w‖ + ‖Q w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      exact ⟨hFw, hQp_diff, hQm_diff, hQp_b, hQm_b⟩
    have hQ_half : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      fun w hw => le_trans (hQ_le w hw) hRhoB_le_half
    have hkp_diff : ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ≤ 9 / 32 :=
      (hVolt.lip_bounds (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) Q (9 / 32) hQp_c hQ_cont
        (fun w hw => ⟨(hField_bounds w hw).2.2.2.1, hQ_half w hw⟩) (by norm_num)
        (fun w hw => (hField_bounds w hw).2.1) 1 h1_mem).2.1
    have hkm_diff : ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK Q 1‖ ≤ 9 / 32 :=
      (hVolt.lip_bounds (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) Q (9 / 32) hQm_c hQ_cont
        (fun w hw => ⟨(hField_bounds w hw).2.2.2.2, hQ_half w hw⟩) (by norm_num)
        (fun w hw => (hField_bounds w hw).2.2.1) 1 h1_mem).2.1
    set k₀ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
    set k_p := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1
    set k_m := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1
    set u_p := k_p / k₀
    set u_m := k_m / k₀
    have hup_sub : ‖u_p - 1‖ ≤ 9 / 28 := by
      have hmul_eq : (u_p - 1) * k₀ = k_p - k₀ := by
        dsimp [u_p]
        rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₀_ne, one_mul]
      have hprod : (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_p - 1‖ ≤ 9 / 32 := by
        calc (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_p - 1‖
            ≤ ‖k₀‖ * ‖u_p - 1‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk₀_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖(u_p - 1) * k₀‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ = ‖k_p - k₀‖ := by rw [hmul_eq]
          _ ≤ 9 / 32 := hkp_diff
      linarith
    have hum_sub : ‖u_m - 1‖ ≤ 9 / 28 := by
      have hmul_eq : (u_m - 1) * k₀ = k_m - k₀ := by
        dsimp [u_m]
        rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₀_ne, one_mul]
      have hprod : (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_m - 1‖ ≤ 9 / 32 := by
        calc (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_m - 1‖
            ≤ ‖k₀‖ * ‖u_m - 1‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk₀_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖(u_m - 1) * k₀‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ = ‖k_m - k₀‖ := by rw [hmul_eq]
          _ ≤ 9 / 32 := hkm_diff
      linarith
    have h1_norm : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1 := norm_one
    have hup_le : ‖u_p‖ ≤ 37 / 28 := by
      calc ‖u_p‖ = ‖(u_p - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖u_p - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 37 / 28 := by linarith
    have hum_le : ‖u_m‖ ≤ 37 / 28 := by
      calc ‖u_m‖ = ‖(u_m - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖u_m - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 37 / 28 := by linarith
    set ζ := k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2
    have hζ_sub_eq : ζ - 1 = (u_p - 1) + (u_m - 1) + (u_p - 1) * (u_m - 1) := by
      dsimp [ζ, u_p, u_m]
      field_simp [hk₀_ne]
      ring
    have hζ_sub_norm : ‖ζ - 1‖ ≤ 585 / 784 := by
      rw [hζ_sub_eq]
      calc ‖(u_p - 1) + (u_m - 1) + (u_p - 1) * (u_m - 1)‖
          ≤ ‖(u_p - 1) + (u_m - 1)‖ + ‖(u_p - 1) * (u_m - 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (‖u_p - 1‖ + ‖u_m - 1‖) + ‖u_p - 1‖ * ‖u_m - 1‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul]
            exact add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
        _ ≤ (9 / 28 + 9 / 28) + (9 / 28) * (9 / 28) :=
            add_le_add (add_le_add hup_sub hum_sub)
              (mul_le_mul hup_sub hum_sub (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
        _ = 585 / 784 := by norm_num
    have hζ_re : 1 / 4 < ζ.re := by
      have habs := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (ζ - 1)
      have hre_sub : -(585 / 784 : ℝ) ≤ (ζ - 1).re := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp habs).1, hζ_sub_norm]
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re] at hre_sub
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hζ_sq, _⟩ := hSqrt_props ζ hζ_re
    have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 9 / 4 := by
      calc ‖ζ‖ = ‖(ζ - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖ζ - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 9 / 4 := by linarith
    have hsqrt_norm : ‖sfcaSqrt ζ‖ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      have hsq_norm : ‖sfcaSqrt ζ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ζ‖ := by
        rw [← norm_pow, hζ_sq]
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖sfcaSqrt ζ‖ := norm_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hNum_norm : ‖sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁‖ ≤ 3 := by
      change ‖k₀ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ)‖ ≤ 3
      calc ‖k₀ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ)‖
          = ‖k₀‖ * ‖1 - sfcaSqrt ζ‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖k₀‖ * (‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaSqrt ζ‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sub_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (65 / 64) * (1 + 3 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul hK1_le (by linarith) (by positivity) (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ 3 := by norm_num
    exact ⟨hQp_c, hQm_c, hs_le,
      fun w hw => ⟨(hField_bounds w hw).1,
        (hField_bounds w hw).2.2.2.1, (hField_bounds w hw).2.2.2.2⟩,
      hup_le, hum_le, hζ_re, hsqrt_norm, hNum_norm⟩

  
  have hReversal : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₀ z₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
      ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
      sfcaNumN (fun w => Q (1 - w)) (-z₁) (-z₀) = sfcaNumN Q z₀ z₁ := by
    intro Q z₀ z₁ hQ_cont hQ_le hz₀ hz₁
    let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => 1 - w
    let Q_rev : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q (1 - w)
    have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨by linarith [hw.2], by linarith [hw.1]⟩
    have hφ_cont : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn
    have hQrev_cont : ContinuousOn Q_rev (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQ_cont.comp hφ_cont hφ_maps
    have hQrev_le : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q_rev w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB :=
      fun w hw => hQ_le (1 - w) (hφ_maps hw)
    have hQrev_half : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q_rev w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      fun w hw => le_trans (hQrev_le w hw) hRhoB_le_half
    obtain ⟨_, hk₀_ne, _⟩ := hBaseBounds Q hQ_cont hQ_le
    have hk₀_rev : sfcaVolterraK Q_rev 1 = sfcaVolterraK Q 1 :=
      hVolt.rev_symm Q hQ_cont
    obtain ⟨hC_c, hK_c, hCd_c, hKd_c, _, hC0, hCd0, hK0, hKd0, hODE_deriv⟩ :=
      hVolt.ode_laws Q hQ_cont
    let F := sfcaFieldF Q z₀ z₁
    let F' := sfcaFieldFDeriv Q z₀ z₁
    have hF_c : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hC_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hK_c)
    have hFd_c : ContinuousOn F' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hCd_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hKd_c)
    have hF0 : F 0 = z₀ := by
      simp [F, sfcaFieldF, hC0, hK0]
    have hF1 : F 1 = z₁ := by
      dsimp [F, sfcaFieldF, sfcaSlopeA1]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₀_ne]
      ring
    have hF_ode : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt F (F' v) v ∧ HasDerivAt F' (Q v * F v) v := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨hdC, hdCd, hdK, hdKd⟩ := hODE_deriv v hv
      refine ⟨(hdC.const_mul z₀).add (hdK.const_mul (sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁)), ?_⟩
      refine ((hdCd.const_mul z₀).add (hdKd.const_mul (sfcaSlopeA1 Q z₀ z₁))).congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [F, sfcaFieldF]
      ring
    let h : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => -F (1 - w)
    let h' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => F' (1 - w)
    have hh_c : ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hF_c.comp hφ_cont hφ_maps).neg
    have hhd_c : ContinuousOn h' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hFd_c.comp hφ_cont hφ_maps
    have hh_ode : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt h (h' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt h' (Q_rev w * h w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have h1w : 1 - w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨by linarith [hw.2], by linarith [hw.1]⟩
      obtain ⟨hdF, hdFd⟩ := hF_ode (1 - w) h1w
      have hφ_d : HasDerivAt φ (-1 : ℝ) w := by
        simpa [φ] using (hasDerivAt_id w).const_sub (1 : ℝ)
      have hh_d : HasDerivAt h (h' w) w := by
        refine ((hdF.scomp w hφ_d).neg).congr_deriv ?_
        simp [h']
      have hhd_d : HasDerivAt h' (Q_rev w * h w) w := by
        refine (hdFd.scomp w hφ_d).congr_deriv ?_
        simp [Q_rev, h]
      exact ⟨hh_d, hhd_d⟩
    have hh_uniq := hVolt.ode_unique Q_rev h h' hQrev_cont hQrev_half hh_c hhd_c hh_ode
    have hh0 : h 0 = -z₁ := by simp [h, hF1]
    have hh1 : h 1 = -z₀ := by simp [h, hF0]
    have hhd0_eq : h' 0 = sfcaSlopeA1 Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) := by
      have h_at_1 := (hh_uniq 1 h1_mem).1
      rw [hh0, hh1, hk₀_rev] at h_at_1
      dsimp [sfcaSlopeA1]
      rw [hk₀_rev, eq_div_iff hk₀_ne]
      linear_combination -h_at_1
    have hPot_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        sfcaPotPlus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) w = sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w) ∧
        sfcaPotMinus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) w = sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hh_w, hhd_w⟩ := hh_uniq w hw
      rw [hh0, hhd0_eq] at hh_w hhd_w
      have hFw_eq : sfcaFieldF Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) w = -F (1 - w) := hh_w.symm
      have hFdw_eq : sfcaFieldFDeriv Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) w = F' (1 - w) := hhd_w.symm
      constructor
      · dsimp only [sfcaPotPlus, Q_rev]
        rw [hFw_eq, hFdw_eq]
        dsimp only [F, F']
        ring
      · dsimp only [sfcaPotMinus, Q_rev]
        rw [hFw_eq, hFdw_eq]
        dsimp only [F, F']
        ring
    have hnz₁ : ‖-z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB := by simpa using hz₁
    have hnz₀ : ‖-z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB := by simpa using hz₀
    obtain ⟨hQp_c, hQm_c, _, hQpm_b, _⟩ := hSingleEnv Q z₀ z₁ hQ_cont hQ_le hz₀ hz₁
    obtain ⟨hQprev_c, hQmrev_c, _, hQpmrev_b, _⟩ :=
      hSingleEnv Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀) hQrev_cont hQrev_le hnz₁ hnz₀
    have hQp_flip_c : ContinuousOn (fun w => sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQp_c.comp hφ_cont hφ_maps
    have hQm_flip_c : ContinuousOn (fun w => sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hQm_c.comp hφ_cont hφ_maps
    have hkp_eq :
        sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀)) 1 =
          sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 := by
      calc sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀)) 1
          = sfcaVolterraK (fun w => sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w)) 1 :=
            hVolterraK_congr _ _ hQprev_c hQp_flip_c
              (fun w hw => ⟨(hQpmrev_b w hw).2.1, (hQpm_b (1 - w) (hφ_maps hw)).2.1⟩)
              (fun w hw => (hPot_eq w hw).1)
        _ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) 1 :=
            hVolt.rev_symm (sfcaPotPlus Q z₀ z₁) hQp_c
    have hkm_eq :
        sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀)) 1 =
          sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 := by
      calc sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q_rev (-z₁) (-z₀)) 1
          = sfcaVolterraK (fun w => sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁ (1 - w)) 1 :=
            hVolterraK_congr _ _ hQmrev_c hQm_flip_c
              (fun w hw => ⟨(hQpmrev_b w hw).2.2, (hQpm_b (1 - w) (hφ_maps hw)).2.2⟩)
              (fun w hw => (hPot_eq w hw).2)
        _ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) 1 :=
            hVolt.rev_symm (sfcaPotMinus Q z₀ z₁) hQm_c
    dsimp only [sfcaNumN]
    rw [hk₀_rev, hkp_eq, hkm_eq]

  
  have hVanishLeft : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (z₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ sfcaRhoB) →
      ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
      sfcaNumN Q 0 z₁ = 0 := by
    intro Q z₁ hQ_cont hQ_le hz₁
    obtain ⟨_, hk₀_ne, _⟩ := hBaseBounds Q hQ_cont hQ_le
    by_cases hz₁_zero : z₁ = 0
    · subst hz₁_zero
      have hQp0 : sfcaPotPlus Q 0 0 = Q := by
        ext w
        simp [sfcaPotPlus, sfcaFieldF, sfcaFieldFDeriv, sfcaSlopeA1]
      have hQm0 : sfcaPotMinus Q 0 0 = Q := by
        ext w
        simp [sfcaPotMinus, sfcaFieldF, sfcaFieldFDeriv, sfcaSlopeA1]
      dsimp only [sfcaNumN]
      rw [hQp0, hQm0, ← sq, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 hk₀_ne), Complex.log_one,
        mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, sub_self, mul_zero]
    · have hz₀_lt : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ < sfcaRhoB := by simpa using hRhoB_pos
      obtain ⟨hQp_c, hQm_c, _, hQpm_b, _⟩ := hSingleEnv Q 0 z₁ hQ_cont hQ_le hz₀_lt hz₁
      obtain ⟨hC_c, hK_c, hCd_c, hKd_c, _, hC0, hCd0, hK0, hKd0, hODE_deriv⟩ :=
        hVolt.ode_laws Q hQ_cont
      let k₀ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
      let a₁ := sfcaSlopeA1 Q 0 z₁
      have ha₁_eq : a₁ = z₁ / k₀ := by simp [a₁, k₀, sfcaSlopeA1]
      have ha₁_ne : a₁ ≠ 0 := by
        rw [ha₁_eq]
        exact div_ne_zero hz₁_zero hk₀_ne
      have ha₁_mul : a₁ * k₀ = z₁ := by
        rw [ha₁_eq]
        exact div_mul_cancel₀ z₁ hk₀_ne
      let F := sfcaFieldF Q 0 z₁
      let F' := sfcaFieldFDeriv Q 0 z₁
      have hF_c : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul hC_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hK_c)
      have hFd_c : ContinuousOn F' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul hCd_c).add (continuousOn_const.mul hKd_c)
      have hF0 : F 0 = 0 := by simp [F, sfcaFieldF, hK0]
      have hFd0 : F' 0 = a₁ := by simp [F', a₁, sfcaFieldFDeriv, hKd0]
      have hF1 : F 1 = z₁ := by
        dsimp [F, sfcaFieldF]
        rw [zero_mul, zero_add]
        exact ha₁_mul
      have hF_ode : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt F (F' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt F' (Q w * F w) w := by

          _ = ‖(s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraK Q₁ 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ ≤ (17 / 80 : ℝ) * M_diff := by rw [h_id]; exact hrhs
      linarith
    have hPot_diff : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff ∧
        ‖sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
      intro w hw

      obtain ⟨_, hK₂w, _, hKd₂w⟩ := hBB₂ w hw
      have hF_d : ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        have h_eq : sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w =
            z₀ * (sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w) +
              (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w +
              s₁ * (sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w) := by
          dsimp [sfcaFieldF, s₁, s₂]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖z₀ * (sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w) +
                (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w +
                s₁ * (sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w)‖
            ≤ ‖z₀ * (sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w) +
                (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁ * (sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖z₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraC Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁ - s₂‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraK Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraK Q₂ w‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, ← norm_mul z₀, ← norm_mul (s₁ - s₂)]
              exact add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ (1 / 16) * M_diff + ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff) * (65 / 64) + (3 / 20) * M_diff :=
              add_le_add
                (add_le_add (mul_le_mul hz₀_le hc_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
                  (mul_le_mul hs_diff hK₂w (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)))
                (mul_le_mul hs₁_le hk_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff := by linarith
      have hFd_d :
          ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        have h_eq : sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w =
            z₀ * (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w) +
              (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w +
              s₁ * (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w) := by
          dsimp [sfcaFieldFDeriv, s₁, s₂]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖z₀ * (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w) +
                (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w +
                s₁ * (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w)‖
            ≤ ‖z₀ * (sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w) +
                (s₁ - s₂) * sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁ * (sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖z₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁ - s₂‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w‖ +
                ‖s₁‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₁ w - sfcaVolterraKDeriv Q₂ w‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, ← norm_mul z₀, ← norm_mul (s₁ - s₂)]
              exact add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ (1 / 16) * (2 * M_diff) + ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff) * (9 / 8) +
                (3 / 20) * (2 * M_diff) :=
              add_le_add

                (mul_le_mul hs₁_le hkd_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          _ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by linarith
      have hFsq_d :
          ‖(sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ ≤

        have h_sum : ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w + sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          calc ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w + sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖
              ≤ ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w‖ + ‖sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith [(hField₁ w hw).1, (hField₂ w hw).1]
        have h_fac : (sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 =
            (sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) *
              (sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w + sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) := by ring
        rw [h_fac, norm_mul]
        calc ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ *
              ‖sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w + sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖
            ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff) * (1 / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul hF_d h_sum (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by ring
      have hQw_d := hQ_diff w hw
      have hQp_d : ‖sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        have h_eq : sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w =
            (Q₁ w - Q₂ w) -
              (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) -
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2) := by
          dsimp [sfcaPotPlus]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(Q₁ w - Q₂ w) -
                (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                  (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) -
                (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2)‖
            ≤ ‖(Q₁ w - Q₂ w) -
                (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                  (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w)‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) *
                  ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ +
                (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖(sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, h14_norm]
              have h_sub := norm_sub_le (Q₁ w - Q₂ w)
                ((3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                  (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w))
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h32_norm] at h_sub
              linarith
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by linarith
      have hQm_d : ‖sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        have h_eq : sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁ w =
            (Q₁ w - Q₂ w) +
              (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) -
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2) := by
          dsimp [sfcaPotMinus]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(Q₁ w - Q₂ w) +

                (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2)‖
            ≤ ‖(Q₁ w - Q₂ w) +
                (3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                  (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w)‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) *
                  ((sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ +
                (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w‖ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖(sfcaFieldF Q₁ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2 - (sfcaFieldF Q₂ z₀ z₁ w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, h14_norm]
              have h_add := norm_add_le (Q₁ w - Q₂ w)
                ((3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I *
                  (sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₁ z₀ z₁ w - sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₂ z₀ z₁ w))
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h32_norm] at h_add
              linarith
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff := by linarith
      exact ⟨hQp_d, hQm_d⟩
    have hkp_d :
        ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ ≤
          (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff :=
      (hVolt.lip_bounds (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) ((9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff)
        hQp₁_c hQp₂_c (fun w hw => ⟨(hField₁ w hw).2.1, (hField₂ w hw).2.1⟩) (by positivity)

    have hkm_d :
        ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ ≤
          (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff :=
      (hVolt.lip_bounds (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) ((9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff)
        hQm₁_c hQm₂_c (fun w hw => ⟨(hField₁ w hw).2.2, (hField₂ w hw).2.2⟩) (by positivity)
        (fun w hw => (hPot_diff w hw).2) 1 h1_mem).2.1
    set k₁ := sfcaVolterraK Q₁ 1
    set k₂ := sfcaVolterraK Q₂ 1
    have hk_d : ‖k₁ - k₂‖ ≤ M_diff := (hLipQ 1 h1_mem).2.1
    have hk₂_le : ‖k₂‖ ≤ 65 / 64 := (hBB₂ 1 h1_mem).2.1
    set u_p1 := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₁
    set u_p2 := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₂
    set u_m1 := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₁
    set u_m2 := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₂
    have hup_d : ‖u_p1 - u_p2‖ ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
      have hm1 : u_p1 * k₁ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₁_ne
      have hm2 : u_p2 * k₂ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₂_ne
      have h_id : (u_p1 - u_p2) * k₁ =
          (sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1) -
            u_p2 * (k₁ - k₂) := by
        linear_combination hm1 - hm2
      have hrhs :
          ‖(sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1) -

        calc ‖(sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1) -
                u_p2 * (k₁ - k₂)‖
            ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ +
                ‖u_p2 * (k₁ - k₂)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ +
                ‖u_p2‖ * ‖k₁ - k₂‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff + (37 / 28) * M_diff :=

          _ = (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by ring
      have hprod : (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_p1 - u_p2‖ ≤ (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        calc (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_p1 - u_p2‖
            ≤ ‖k₁‖ * ‖u_p1 - u_p2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk₁_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖(u_p1 - u_p2) * k₁‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ ≤ (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by rw [h_id]; exact hrhs
      linarith
    have hum_d : ‖u_m1 - u_m2‖ ≤ (9 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
      have hm1 : u_m1 * k₁ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₁_ne
      have hm2 : u_m2 * k₂ = sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₂_ne
      have h_id : (u_m1 - u_m2) * k₁ =

        linear_combination hm1 - hm2
      have hrhs :
          ‖(sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1) -
              u_m2 * (k₁ - k₂)‖ ≤ (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        calc ‖(sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1) -
                u_m2 * (k₁ - k₂)‖
            ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ +
                ‖u_m2 * (k₁ - k₂)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = ‖sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 - sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1‖ +
                ‖u_m2‖ * ‖k₁ - k₂‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * M_diff + (37 / 28) * M_diff :=
              add_le_add hkm_d (mul_le_mul hum₂_le hk_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
          _ = (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by ring
      have hprod : (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_m1 - u_m2‖ ≤ (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by
        calc (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖u_m1 - u_m2‖
            ≤ ‖k₁‖ * ‖u_m1 - u_m2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk₁_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖(u_m1 - u_m2) * k₁‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ ≤ (25 / 7 : ℝ) * M_diff := by rw [h_id]; exact hrhs
      linarith
    set ζ₁ := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 *
      sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₁ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₁ ^ 2
    set ζ₂ := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 *
      sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₂ z₀ z₁) 1 / k₂ ^ 2
    have hζ_d : ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ ≤ 12 * M_diff := by
      have h_eq : ζ₁ - ζ₂ = (u_p1 - u_p2) * u_m1 + u_p2 * (u_m1 - u_m2) := by
        dsimp [ζ₁, ζ₂, u_p1, u_p2, u_m1, u_m2]

      rw [h_eq]
      calc ‖(u_p1 - u_p2) * u_m1 + u_p2 * (u_m1 - u_m2)‖
          ≤ ‖(u_p1 - u_p2) * u_m1‖ + ‖u_p2 * (u_m1 - u_m2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖u_p1 - u_p2‖ * ‖u_m1‖ + ‖u_p2‖ * ‖u_m1 - u_m2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ ((9 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff) * (37 / 28) + (37 / 28) * ((9 / 2 : ℝ) * M_diff) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hup_d hum₁_le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul hup₂_le hum_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
        _ ≤ 12 * M_diff := by linarith
    have hsqrt_d : ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ ≤ 12 * M_diff :=
      le_trans (hSqrt_lip ζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₁_re hζ₂_re) hζ_d
    have h1_sub_sqrt₁ : ‖1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁‖ ≤ 5 / 2 := by
      have h1_norm : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ = 1 := norm_one
      calc ‖1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁‖
          ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 5 / 2 := by linarith
    change ‖k₁ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁) - k₂ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₂)‖ ≤ 16 * M_diff
    have h_num_split : k₁ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁) - k₂ * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₂) =

    rw [h_num_split]
    calc ‖(k₁ - k₂) * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁) - k₂ * (sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂)‖
        ≤ ‖(k₁ - k₂) * (1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁)‖ + ‖k₂ * (sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂)‖ :=
          norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖k₁ - k₂‖ * ‖1 - sfcaSqrt ζ₁‖ + ‖k₂‖ * ‖sfcaSqrt ζ₁ - sfcaSqrt ζ₂‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ M_diff * (5 / 2) + (65 / 64) * (12 * M_diff) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul hk_d h1_sub_sqrt₁ (norm_nonneg _) hM_nonneg)
            (mul_le_mul hk₂_le hsqrt_d (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
      _ ≤ 16 * M_diff := by linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ f : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ, IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish f →
      (∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖b₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        b₀ * b₁ * sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁ = f b₀ b₁) ∧
      (∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖b₀‖ < sfcaRhoC → ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoC →
        sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁ =
          (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                f (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₀) (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₁) /
                  ((circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₀ - b₀) * (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₁ - b₁)))) ∧
      ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => sfcaBivarDiv f z.1 z.2) (0, 0) ∧
      (∀ g : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ, IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish g →

proof.tactics:
by
  have hRhoB_eq : sfcaRhoB = 1 / 16 := rfl
  have hRhoC_eq : sfcaRhoC = 1 / 32 := rfl
  have hRhoB_pos : 0 < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaRhoB]
  have hRhoC_pos : 0 < sfcaRhoC := by norm_num [sfcaRhoC]
  have hRhoC_lt_B : sfcaRhoC < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaRhoC, sfcaRhoB]
  
  have hA1 : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ, IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish f →
      ∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖b₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        b₀ * b₁ * sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁ = f b₀ b₁ := by
    intro f hf b₀ b₁ hb₀ hb₁
    set G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => f z₀ z₁) 0 b₁
    have h0_lt : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ < sfcaRhoB := by simpa using hRhoB_pos
    have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
      by_cases hb₁0 : b₁ = 0
      · subst hb₁0
        simp only [G, dslope_same]
        have h_ev : (fun z₁ : ℂ => f 0 z₁) =ᶠ[nhds 0] (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hRhoB_pos)
            (fun z₁ hz₁ => hf.2.1 z₁ (by simpa using hz₁))
        rw [h_ev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      · simp only [G, dslope_of_ne _ hb₁0, slope_def_field, hf.2.1 b₁ hb₁, hf.2.1 0 h0_lt,
          sub_zero, zero_div]
    have h_outer : b₀ * sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁ = G b₀ := by
      have h := sub_smul_dslope G 0 b₀
      simpa [sfcaBivarDiv, G, hG0, smul_eq_mul] using h
    have h_inner : b₁ * G b₀ = f b₀ b₁ := by
      have h := sub_smul_dslope (fun z₁ => f b₀ z₁) 0 b₁
      simpa [G, hf.2.2 b₀ hb₀, smul_eq_mul] using h
    calc b₀ * b₁ * sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁
        = b₁ * (b₀ * sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁) := by ring
      _ = b₁ * G b₀ := by rw [h_outer]
      _ = f b₀ b₁ := h_inner
  
  have h_dslope_circle : ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (r ρ : ℝ) (b : ℂ),
      0 < ρ → ρ < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball 0 r) → h 0 = 0 → ‖b‖ < ρ →
      dslope h 0 b =
        ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            h (circleMap 0 ρ θ) / (circleMap 0 ρ θ - b) := by
    intro h r ρ b hρ hρr hh hh0 hb
    have hr : 0 < r := lt_trans hρ hρr
    have h_dsl : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dslope h 0) (Metric.ball 0 r) :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr)).mpr hh
    have h_sub : closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r :=
      Metric.closure_ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hρr)
    have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (dslope h 0) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
      (h_dsl.mono h_sub).diffContOnCl
    have hb_mem : b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ := by simpa using hb
    have h_cif := h_dc.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hb_mem
    rw [← h_cif, circleIntegral]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
    set w : ℂ := circleMap 0 ρ θ
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = ρ := by
      simp [w, abs_of_pos hρ]
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw0
      rw [hw0, norm_zero] at hw_norm
      linarith
    have hd_eq : dslope h 0 w = h w / w := by
      rw [dslope_of_ne h hw_ne, slope_def_field, hh0, sub_zero, sub_zero]
    have hderiv : deriv (circleMap 0 ρ) θ = w * Complex.I := by
      simp [w]
    have h2pi_ne : ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
    have hI_ne : (Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
    rw [hderiv, hd_eq]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hw_ne, h2pi_ne, hI_ne]
  
  have hA2 : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ, IsSfcaBivarHoloVanish f →
      ∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖b₀‖ < sfcaRhoC → ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoC →
        sfcaBivarDiv f b₀ b₁ =
          (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                f (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₀) (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₁) /
                  ((circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₀ - b₀) * (circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC θ₁ - b₁))) := by
    intro f hf b₀ b₁ hb₀ hb₁
    set w : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC
    set G : ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => f z₀ z₁) 0 b₁
    have hw_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖w θ‖ = sfcaRhoC := fun θ => by
      simp [w, abs_of_pos hRhoC_pos]
    have hw_lt_B : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖w θ‖ < sfcaRhoB := fun θ => (hw_norm θ).trans_lt hRhoC_lt_B
    have hw_sphere : ∀ θ : ℝ, w θ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoC :=
      fun θ => circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hRhoC_pos.le θ
    have h_slice₁ : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z₁ => f z₀ z₁) (Metric.ball 0 sfcaRhoB) := by
      intro z₀ hz₀
      exact hf.1.comp ((differentiable_const z₀).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun z₁ hz₁ => ⟨by simpa using hz₀, hz₁⟩)
    have h_slice₀ : ∀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z₀ => f z₀ z₁) (Metric.ball 0 sfcaRhoB) := by
      intro z₁ hz₁
      exact hf.1.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const z₁)).differentiableOn
        (fun z₀ hz₀ => ⟨hz₀, by simpa using hz₁⟩)
    have hG_eq : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ < sfcaRhoB →
        G z₀ = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f z₀ (w θ₁) / (w θ₁ - b₁) := by
      intro z₀ hz₀
      exact h_dslope_circle (fun z₁ => f z₀ z₁) sfcaRhoB sfcaRhoC b₁
        hRhoC_pos hRhoC_lt_B (h_slice₁ z₀ hz₀) (hf.2.2 z₀ hz₀) hb₁
    have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hG_eq 0 (by simpa using hRhoB_pos)]
      have h_z : ∀ θ₁ : ℝ, f 0 (w θ₁) / (w θ₁ - b₁) = 0 :=
        fun θ₁ => by simp [hf.2.1 (w θ₁) (hw_lt_B θ₁)]
      simp [h_z]
    have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball 0 (3 / 64)) := by
      let K : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (7 / 128) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoC
      have hK_comp : IsCompact K :=
        (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (7 / 128)).prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoC)
      have hK_ne : K.Nonempty := ⟨(0, w 0), by norm_num, hw_sphere 0⟩
      have hK_sub : K ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) sfcaRhoB := by
        rintro ⟨z₀, z₁⟩ ⟨hz₀, hz₁⟩
        simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz₀
        simp only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz₁
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        · linarith [hRhoB_eq]
        · linarith [hRhoC_lt_B]
      have hK_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ‖f p.1 p.2‖) K :=
        continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hf.1.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      obtain ⟨p_max, _, hp_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne hK_cont
      let M : ℝ := max ‖f p_max.1 p_max.2‖ 0
      have hM_bound : ∀ z₀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ ≤ 7 / 128 → ‖z₁‖ = sfcaRhoC → ‖f z₀ z₁‖ ≤ M := by
        intro z₀ z₁ hz₀ hz₁
        have hp : (z₀, z₁) ∈ K := ⟨by simpa using hz₀, by simpa using hz₁⟩
        exact le_trans (hp_max hp) (le_max_left _ _)
      let δ₁ : ℝ := sfcaRhoC - ‖b₁‖
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := sub_pos.mpr hb₁
      have hw_sub_ge : ∀ θ₁ : ℝ, δ₁ ≤ ‖w θ₁ - b₁‖ := fun θ₁ => by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (w θ₁) b₁
        rwa [hw_norm θ₁] at this
      have hw_sub_ne : ∀ θ₁ : ℝ, w θ₁ - b₁ ≠ 0 := fun θ₁ h0 => by
        have := hw_sub_ge θ₁
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z θ₁ => f z (w θ₁) / (w θ₁ - b₁)
      let F' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z θ₁ => deriv (fun ζ => f ζ (w θ₁)) z / (w θ₁ - b₁)
      have hF_cont : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ < sfcaRhoB → Continuous (F z) := by
        intro z hz
        have h_num : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => f z (w θ₁)) :=
          (h_slice₁ z hz).continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC)
            (fun θ₁ => by simpa using hw_lt_B θ₁)
        have h_den : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => w θ₁ - b₁) :=
          (continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC).sub continuous_const
        exact h_num.div h_den hw_sub_ne
      intro z₀₀ hz₀₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hz₀₀_norm : ‖z₀₀‖ < 3 / 64 := by simpa using hz₀₀
      have hz₀₀_lt_B : ‖z₀₀‖ < sfcaRhoB := by linarith [hRhoB_eq]
      let s : Set ℂ := Metric.ball z₀₀ (1 / 256)
      have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds z₀₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀₀ (by norm_num)
      have hs_lt_B : ∀ z ∈ s, ‖z‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
        intro z hz
        simp only [s, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        have h_tri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - z₀₀‖ + ‖z₀₀‖ := by
          calc ‖z‖ = ‖(z - z₀₀) + z₀₀‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖z - z₀₀‖ + ‖z₀₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        linarith [hRhoB_eq]
      have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ z in nhds z₀₀,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F z)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        refine Filter.eventually_of_mem hs_nhds (fun z hz => ?_)
        exact (hF_cont z (hs_lt_B z hz)).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (F z₀₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (hF_cont z₀₀ hz₀₀_lt_B).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' z₀₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        obtain ⟨h_seq, hh_ne, hh_norm, hh_tend0⟩ :
            ∃ h_seq : ℕ → ℂ,
              (∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n ≠ 0) ∧
              (∀ n : ℕ, ‖h_seq n‖ ≤ 1 / 512) ∧
              Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          refine ⟨fun n => (((1 / 512 : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ),
            fun n => ?_, fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
          · have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 512 : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by positivity
            have h_le1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
              have h_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
                have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
                linarith
              simpa using one_div_le_one_div_of_le zero_lt_one h_ge
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h_pos]
            linarith
          · have h_real : Filter.Tendsto
                (fun n : ℕ => (1 / 512 : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
                Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 / 512 : ℝ) * 0)) :=
              (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 / 512 : ℝ))).mul
                tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
            rw [mul_zero] at h_real
            have h_comp := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt (x := (0 : ℝ))).tendsto.comp h_real
            simpa [Function.comp_def] using h_comp
        let φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n θ₁ =>
          ((h_seq n)⁻¹ * (f (z₀₀ + h_seq n) (w θ₁) - f z₀₀ (w θ₁))) / (w θ₁ - b₁)
        have hφ_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (φ n)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
          intro n
          have hzn : ‖z₀₀ + h_seq n‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
            have h1 := norm_add_le z₀₀ (h_seq n)
            have h2 := hh_norm n
            linarith [hRhoB_eq]
          have hc1 : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => f (z₀₀ + h_seq n) (w θ₁)) :=
            (h_slice₁ (z₀₀ + h_seq n) hzn).continuousOn.comp_continuous
              (continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC) (fun θ₁ => by simpa using hw_lt_B θ₁)
          have hc0 : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => f z₀₀ (w θ₁)) :=
            (h_slice₁ z₀₀ hz₀₀_lt_B).continuousOn.comp_continuous
              (continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC) (fun θ₁ => by simpa using hw_lt_B θ₁)
          have hc_den : Continuous (fun θ₁ : ℝ => w θ₁ - b₁) :=
            (continuous_circleMap 0 sfcaRhoC).sub continuous_const
          exact ((continuous_const.mul (hc1.sub hc0)).div hc_den hw_sub_ne).aestronglyMeasurable
        have hh_tend_nhdsWithin : Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) :=
          tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within h_seq hh_tend0
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hh_ne n))
        have hφ_tend : ∀ θ₁ : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => φ n θ₁) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (F' z₀₀ θ₁)) := by
          intro θ₁
          have h_da : HasDerivAt (fun ζ => f ζ (w θ₁))
              (deriv (fun ζ => f ζ (w θ₁)) z₀₀) z₀₀ :=
            ((h_slice₀ (w θ₁) (hw_lt_B θ₁)).differentiableAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simpa using hz₀₀_lt_B))).hasDerivAt
          have h_sl := (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp h_da).comp hh_tend_nhdsWithin
          have h_sl' : Filter.Tendsto
              (fun n => (h_seq n)⁻¹ * (f (z₀₀ + h_seq n) (w θ₁) - f z₀₀ (w θ₁)))
              Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv (fun ζ => f ζ (w θ₁)) z₀₀)) := by

  have h_div_nonzero : ∀ Λ : ℂ, Λ ≠ 0 → ‖Λ‖ < sfcaEtaSL →
