    intro Λ hΛ_ne hΛ_lt
    set z : ℂ := Λ / 2
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hΛ_ne two_ne_zero
    have hΛ_eq : Λ = 2 * z := by dsimp [z]; ring
    have hΛ_lt_num : ‖Λ‖ < 1 / 256 := by simpa [sfcaEtaSL] using hΛ_lt
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = ‖Λ‖ / 2 := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [norm_div]
      norm_num
    have hz_le_512 : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 / 512 := by linarith
    have hz_le_one : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hSlope0 : sfcaSlopeA1 Q₀ Λ Λ = 0 := by
      simp [sfcaSlopeA1, hC0_1, hK0_1]
    have hCDeriv0 : ∀ w : ℝ, sfcaVolterraCDeriv Q₀ w = 0 := by
      intro w
      simp [sfcaVolterraCDeriv, Q₀]
    have hFDeriv0 : ∀ w : ℝ, sfcaFieldFDeriv Q₀ Λ Λ w = 0 := by
      intro w
      simp [sfcaFieldFDeriv, hCDeriv0, hSlope0]
    have hF_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, sfcaFieldF Q₀ Λ Λ w = 2 * z := by
      intro w hw
      have hCw : sfcaVolterraC Q₀ w = 1 := (hVolt.zero_pot w hw).1
      simp only [sfcaFieldF, hCw, hSlope0]
      rw [hΛ_eq]
      ring
    have hPotP_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, sfcaPotPlus Q₀ Λ Λ w = -z ^ 2 := by
      intro w hw
      simp only [sfcaPotPlus, Q₀, hFDeriv0 w, hF_eq w hw]
      ring
    have hPotM_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, sfcaPotMinus Q₀ Λ Λ w = -z ^ 2 := by
      intro w hw
      simp only [sfcaPotMinus, Q₀, hFDeriv0 w, hF_eq w hw]
      ring
    have h_ode_eval : ∀ P : ℝ → ℂ, (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, P w = -z ^ 2) →
        sfcaVolterraK P 1 = Complex.sin z / z := by
      intro P hP
      let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) / z
      let g' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z)
      have hP_cont : ContinuousOn P (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.congr (fun w hw => hP w hw)
      have hP_bdd : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖P w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [hP w hw, norm_neg, norm_pow]
        have hz2 : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 512 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz_le_512 2
        linarith
      have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        ((Complex.continuous_sin.comp
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).div_const z).continuousOn
      have hg'_cont : ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (Complex.continuous_cos.comp
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).continuousOn
      have h_deriv : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt g (g' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt g' (P w * g w) w := by
        intro w hw
        constructor
        · have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => Complex.sin (ζ * z) / z)
              ((Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z) * (1 * z)) / z) (w : ℂ) :=
            (((hasDerivAt_id (w : ℂ)).mul_const z).csin).div_const z
          have hsimp1 : (Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z) * (1 * z)) / z = g' w := by
            dsimp [g']
            field_simp [hz_ne]
          rw [hsimp1] at hd1
          exact hd1.comp_ofReal
        · have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => Complex.cos (ζ * z))
              (-Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) * (1 * z)) (w : ℂ) :=
            ((hasDerivAt_id (w : ℂ)).mul_const z).ccos
          have hsimp2 : -Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) * (1 * z) = P w * g w := by
            rw [hP w (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw)]
            dsimp [g]
            field_simp [hz_ne]
          rw [hsimp2] at hd2
          exact hd2.comp_ofReal
      have h_uniq := (hVolt.ode_unique P g g' hP_cont hP_bdd hg_cont hg'_cont h_deriv 1 h1_mem).1
      have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp [g]
      have hg'0 : g' 0 = 1 := by simp [g']
      have hg1 : g 1 = Complex.sin z / z := by simp [g]
      rw [hg0, hg'0, hg1, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_add] at h_uniq
      exact h_uniq.symm
    set u : ℂ := Complex.sin z / z
    have hKp : sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q₀ Λ Λ) 1 = u := h_ode_eval _ hPotP_eq
    have hKm : sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q₀ Λ Λ) 1 = u := h_ode_eval _ hPotM_eq
    have hu_diff : ‖u - 1‖ < 1 / 4 := by
      have h_rem := h_sinc_rem z hz_ne hz_le_one
      have hz2 : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 512 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz_le_512 2
      have hz3 : ‖z‖ ^ 3 ≤ (1 / 512 : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz_le_512 3
      dsimp [u]
      linarith
    have hu_re_pos : 0 < u.re := by
      have h_abs : |(u - 1).re| ≤ ‖u - 1‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (u - 1)
      have h_sub_re : (u - 1).re = u.re - 1 := by simp
      rw [h_sub_re] at h_abs
      have h_lo := (abs_le.mp h_abs).1
      linarith
    have hNum_eq : sfcaNumN Q₀ Λ Λ = 1 - u := by
      dsimp only [sfcaNumN]
      rw [hK0_1, hKp, hKm]
      have hu_sq : u * u / (1 : ℂ) ^ 2 = u ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [hu_sq, h_sqrt_re_pos u hu_re_pos, one_mul]
    have hΛ_rhoB : ‖Λ‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
      norm_num [sfcaRhoB]
      linarith
    have hDiv_prod : Λ * Λ * sfcaDivH Q₀ Λ Λ = 1 - u := by
      rw [hDiv0 Λ Λ hΛ_rhoB hΛ_rhoB, hNum_eq]
    have h_rhs_prod : Λ * Λ * ((z - Complex.sin z) / (4 * z ^ 3)) = 1 - u := by
      rw [hΛ_eq]
      dsimp [u]
      field_simp [hz_ne]
      ring
    have hΛ2_ne : Λ * Λ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hΛ_ne hΛ_ne
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hΛ2_ne (hDiv_prod.trans h_rhs_prod.symm)
  let r_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (1 / 512 : ℝ) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
  let Λ_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (r_seq n : ℂ)
  have hr_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < r_seq n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [r_seq]
    positivity
  have hr_le : ∀ n : ℕ, r_seq n ≤ 1 / 512 := by
    intro n
    have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    have h_inv_le : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
    dsimp [r_seq]
    linarith
  have h_seq_bound : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ‖sfcaDivH Q₀ (Λ_seq n) (Λ_seq n) - 1 / 24‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * r_seq n := by
    intro n
    have hΛn_ne : Λ_seq n ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hr_pos n).ne'
    have hΛn_norm : ‖Λ_seq n‖ = r_seq n := by
      dsimp [Λ_seq]
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hr_pos n).le]
    have hΛn_lt : ‖Λ_seq n‖ < sfcaEtaSL := by
      rw [hΛn_norm]
      norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]
      linarith [hr_le n]
    set z_n : ℂ := Λ_seq n / 2
    have hzn_ne : z_n ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hΛn_ne two_ne_zero
    have hzn_norm : ‖z_n‖ = r_seq n / 2 := by
      dsimp [z_n]
      rw [norm_div, hΛn_norm]
      norm_num
    have hzn_le_one : ‖z_n‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hzn_norm]
      linarith [hr_le n]
    rw [h_div_nonzero (Λ_seq n) hΛn_ne hΛn_lt]
    calc ‖(z_n - Complex.sin z_n) / (4 * z_n ^ 3) - 1 / 24‖
        ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z_n‖ := h_phi_rem z_n hzn_ne hzn_le_one
      _ = (1 / 8 : ℝ) * r_seq n := by rw [hzn_norm]; ring
  have hr_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto r_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) :=
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    simpa [r_seq] using h0.const_mul (1 / 512 : ℝ)
  have h_bound_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / 8 : ℝ) * r_seq n)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hr_tendsto.const_mul (1 / 8 : ℝ)
  have h_tendsto_rhs : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => sfcaDivH Q₀ (Λ_seq n) (Λ_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 24 : ℂ)) := by
    have h_sub_zero : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => sfcaDivH Q₀ (Λ_seq n) (Λ_seq n) - (1 / 24 : ℂ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      squeeze_zero_norm h_seq_bound h_bound_tendsto
    exact tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.mp h_sub_zero
  have hΛ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto Λ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
    have hc := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hr_tendsto
    simpa [Λ_seq, Function.comp_def] using hc
  have h_tendsto_lhs : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => sfcaDivH Q₀ (Λ_seq n) (Λ_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (sfcaDivH Q₀ 0 0)) :=
    hCont0.tendsto.comp (hΛ_tendsto.prodMk_nhds hΛ_tendsto)
  have hDiv00 : sfcaDivH Q₀ 0 0 = 1 / 24 :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique h_tendsto_lhs h_tendsto_rhs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change sfcaUniversalPsi Q₀ 0 0 = 1 / 24
    rw [h_psi_eq 0, hDiv00]
  · intro Λ hΛ
    change sfcaUniversalPsi Q₀ Λ 0 = frozenPhiFirst Λ
    rw [h_psi_eq Λ]
    by_cases hΛ0 : Λ = 0
    · subst hΛ0
      simp [frozenPhiFirst, hDiv00]
    · simp [frozenPhiFirst, hΛ0, h_div_nonzero Λ hΛ0 hΛ]

signature.statement:
(hVolt : SfcaVolterraKernelProp)
    (hZero : sfcaUniversalPsi (fun _ => 0) 0 0 = 1 / 24)
    (hDiv : ∀ μ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ < sfcaEtaSL → ‖b₀‖ < sfcaRhoB → ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoB →
      b₀ * b₁ * sfcaDivH (fun _ => μ) b₀ b₁ = sfcaNumN (fun _ => μ) b₀ b₁)
    (hCont : ∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ < sfcaEtaSL →
      ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => sfcaDivH (fun _ => μ) z.1 z.2) (0, 0)) :
    ∀ μ : ℂ, ‖μ‖ < sfcaEtaSL → sfcaUniversalPsi (fun _ => μ) 0 0 = frozenPhiSecond μ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro μ hμ
  by_cases hμ0 : μ = 0
  · subst hμ0
    rw [hZero]
    have h_num :
        (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) =
          1 / 6 := by
      rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
      · have h3 : (2 * 0 + 3).factorial = 6 := by decide
        rw [h3]
        norm_num
      · intro m hm
        simp [zero_pow hm]
    have h_den : (∑' m : ℕ, (0 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)) = 1 := by
      rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
      · have h0 : (2 * 0).factorial = 1 := by decide
        rw [h0]
        norm_num
      · intro m hm
        simp [zero_pow hm]
    unfold frozenPhiSecond
    rw [h_num, h_den]
    norm_num
  · obtain ⟨lam, hlam_sq⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq μ (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      norm_num at hlam_sq
      exact hμ0 hlam_sq.symm
    have hμ_lt : ‖μ‖ < 1 / 256 := by simpa [sfcaEtaSL] using hμ
    have hlam_norm_sq : ‖lam‖ ^ 2 < 1 / 256 := by
      calc ‖lam‖ ^ 2 = ‖lam ^ 2‖ := (norm_pow lam 2).symm
        _ = ‖μ‖ := by rw [hlam_sq]
        _ < 1 / 256 := hμ_lt
    have hlam_lt : ‖lam‖ < 1 / 16 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg lam]
    let g₀ : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.exp ((w : ℂ) * lam)
    let g₀' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => lam * Complex.exp ((w : ℂ) * lam)
    let E₀ : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.exp (-2 * lam * (w : ℂ))
    let A : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => (Complex.exp ((w : ℂ) * lam) - 1) / lam
    let phaseInt : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, E₀ w * Complex.exp (ζ * A w)
    let I₀ : ℂ := ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, E₀ w
    let I₁ : ℂ := ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, E₀ w * A w
    let I₂ : ℂ := ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, E₀ w * (A w) ^ 2
    have hg₀_cont : Continuous g₀ := by dsimp [g₀]; fun_prop
    have hg₀'_cont : Continuous g₀' := by dsimp [g₀']; fun_prop
    have hE₀_cont : Continuous E₀ := by dsimp [E₀]; fun_prop
    have hA_cont : Continuous A := by dsimp [A]; fun_prop
    have hg₀_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt g₀ (g₀' w) w := by
      intro w
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z * lam) lam (w : ℂ) := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (w : ℂ)).mul_const lam
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp (z * lam)) (g₀' w) (w : ℂ) := by
        simpa [g₀', mul_comm] using h1.cexp
      exact h2.comp_ofReal
    have hg₀'_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt g₀' (lam ^ 2 * g₀ w) w := by
      intro w
      have h1 : HasDerivAt g₀' (lam * g₀' w) w := (hg₀_deriv w).const_mul lam
      have h_eq : lam * g₀' w = lam ^ 2 * g₀ w := by dsimp [g₀, g₀']; ring
      rwa [h_eq] at h1
    have hA_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt A (g₀ w) w := by
      intro w
      have h1 : HasDerivAt A (g₀' w / lam) w :=
        ((hg₀_deriv w).sub_const 1).div_const lam
      have h_eq : g₀' w / lam = g₀ w := by
        dsimp [g₀, g₀']
        exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hlam_ne
      rwa [h_eq] at h1
    
    have h_abel : ∀ (P g g' : ℝ → ℂ),
        ContinuousOn P (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, g w ≠ 0) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g (g' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt g' (P w * g w) w) →
        sfcaVolterraK P 1 = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro P g g' hP_c hg_c hg'_c hg_ne hg_ode
      obtain ⟨_, hk_c, _, hk'_c, _, _, _, hk0, hk'0, hk_ode⟩ := hVolt.ode_laws P hP_c
      let k := sfcaVolterraK P
      let k' := sfcaVolterraKDeriv P
      let W : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => k' v * g v - k v * g' v
      have hW_c : ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (hk'_c.mul hg_c).sub (hk_c.mul hg'_c)
      have hW_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt W 0 v := by
        intro v hv
        have hraw := ((hk_ode v hv).2.2.2.mul (hg_ode v hv).1).sub
          ((hk_ode v hv).2.2.1.mul (hg_ode v hv).2)
        have hzero : P v * k v * g v + k' v * g' v - (k' v * g' v + k v * (P v * g v)) = 0 := by
          ring
        rwa [hzero] at hraw
      have hW_const : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, W w = g 0 := by
        intro w hw
        have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
          (hW_c.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2))
          (fun v hv => hW_deriv v ⟨hv.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hv.2 hw.2⟩)
          intervalIntegrable_const
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at hint
        have hW0 : W 0 = g 0 := by simp [W, k, k', hk0, hk'0]
        exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hint.symm).trans hW0
      let R_q : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => k w / g w
      have hRq_c : ContinuousOn R_q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hk_c.div hg_c hg_ne
      have hRq_deriv : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt R_q (g 0 * (g w ^ 2)⁻¹) w := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_cc : w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw
        have hraw := ((hk_ode w hw).2.2.1).div (hg_ode w hw).1 (hg_ne w hw_cc)
        have h_eq : (k' w * g w - k w * g' w) / g w ^ 2 = g 0 * (g w ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          change W w / g w ^ 2 = g 0 * (g w ^ 2)⁻¹
          rw [hW_const w hw_cc, div_eq_mul_inv]
        rwa [h_eq] at hraw
      have h_rhs_c : ContinuousOn (fun w => g 0 * (g w ^ 2)⁻¹) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.mul ((hg_c.pow 2).inv₀ (fun w hw => pow_ne_zero 2 (hg_ne w hw)))
      have h_rhs_int :
          IntervalIntegrable (fun w => g 0 * (g w ^ 2)⁻¹) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
        apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
        rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      have hint2 := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le zero_le_one
        hRq_c hRq_deriv h_rhs_int
      have hRq0 : R_q 0 = 0 := by simp [R_q, k, hk0]
      rw [hRq0, sub_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hint2
      have hg1_ne : g 1 ≠ 0 := hg_ne 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
      have hk1_div : k 1 / g 1 = g 0 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w ^ 2)⁻¹ := hint2.symm
      calc k 1 = (k 1 / g 1) * g 1 := (div_mul_cancel₀ (k 1) hg1_ne).symm
        _ = (g 0 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w ^ 2)⁻¹) * g 1 := by rw [hk1_div]
        _ = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    
    let P₀ : ℝ → ℂ := fun _ => lam ^ 2
    let k₀ : ℂ := sfcaVolterraK P₀ 1
    have hg₀_inv_sq : ∀ w : ℝ, (g₀ w ^ 2)⁻¹ = E₀ w := by
      intro w
      dsimp [g₀, E₀]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_neg]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hk₀_eq : k₀ = Complex.exp lam * I₀ := by
      have hab := h_abel P₀ g₀ g₀' continuousOn_const hg₀_cont.continuousOn hg₀'_cont.continuousOn
        (fun w _ => Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
        (fun w _ => ⟨hg₀_deriv w, hg₀'_deriv w⟩)
      have hg0_0 : g₀ 0 = 1 := by simp [g₀]
      have hg0_1 : g₀ 1 = Complex.exp lam := by simp [g₀]
      have hint_eq : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g₀ w ^ 2)⁻¹) = I₀ := by
        simp only [hg₀_inv_sq, I₀]
      change sfcaVolterraK P₀ 1 = Complex.exp lam * I₀
      rw [hab, hg0_0, hg0_1, one_mul, hint_eq]
    have hk₀_norm : 7 / 8 ≤ ‖k₀‖ :=
      (hVolt.quant_bounds P₀ (1 / 256) continuousOn_const (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        (fun _ _ => by dsimp [P₀]; rw [hlam_sq]; exact hμ_lt.le)).1
    have hk₀_ne : k₀ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0

      rw [hI₂_val, hI₁_val, hJ₁_val, hI₀_val, hexp_neg, hexp_neg2, hcosh_v, hsinh_v]
      have hv_sq_sub : v ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply h1_sub_v2_ne
        field_simp [hv_ne]
        linear_combination h0
      field_simp [hlam_ne, hv_ne, h1_sub_v2_ne, hden2, hv_sq_sub]
      ring
    have h_den_series :
        1 + (∑' m : ℕ, (lam ^ 2) ^ m / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)) = 1 + Complex.cosh lam := by
      rw [Complex.cosh_eq_tsum lam]
      congr 1
      refine tsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
      rw [pow_mul]
    have h_num_series :
        (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (lam ^ 2) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) =
          (lam * (1 + Complex.cosh lam) - 2 * Complex.sinh lam) / lam ^ 3 := by
      have hc_shift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (Complex.hasSum_cosh lam)
      simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, mul_zero, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
        div_one] at hc_shift
      have hs_shift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (Complex.hasSum_sinh lam)
      simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, mul_zero, zero_add, pow_one, Nat.factorial_one,
        Nat.cast_one, div_one] at hs_shift
      have hComb := ((hc_shift.mul_left lam).sub (hs_shift.mul_left 2)).mul_left ((lam ^ 3)⁻¹)
      have hComb' : HasSum
          (fun m : ℕ => ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (lam ^ 2) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
          ((lam * (1 + Complex.cosh lam) - 2 * Complex.sinh lam) / lam ^ 3) := by
        have hsum_eq :
            (lam ^ 3)⁻¹ * (lam * (Complex.cosh lam - 1) - 2 * (Complex.sinh lam - lam)) =
              (lam * (1 + Complex.cosh lam) - 2 * Complex.sinh lam) / lam ^ 3 := by
          ring
        rw [hsum_eq] at hComb
        refine hComb.congr_fun (fun m => ?_)
        have hidx2 : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by ring
        have hidx3 : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by ring
        rw [hidx3, hidx2]
        have hfac :
            ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) =
              ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * m + 2).factorial : ℂ) := by
          rw [Nat.factorial_succ (2 * m + 2)]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hp2 : lam ^ (2 * m + 2) = (lam ^ 2) ^ m * lam ^ 2 := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
        have hp3 : lam ^ (2 * m + 3) = (lam ^ 2) ^ m * lam ^ 3 := by rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
        have hfac_ne : ((2 * m + 2).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
          Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        have h2m3_ne : ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
        have hlam3_ne : lam ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hlam_ne
        rw [hfac, hp2, hp3]
        field_simp [hfac_ne, h2m3_ne, hlam_ne, hlam3_ne]
        push_cast
        ring
      exact hComb'.tsum_eq
    have h_moments_eq_frozen :
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (I₂ - I₁ ^ 2 / I₀) = frozenPhiSecond (lam ^ 2) := by
      rw [h_moments_closed]
      unfold frozenPhiSecond
      rw [h_num_series, h_den_series, div_div]
      congr 1
      ring
    
    let b₀_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => η_c n
    let b₁_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => η_c n * Complex.exp lam
    have h_div_seq : ∀ n : ℕ,
        sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) = I₀ * (1 - w_seq n) / (η_c n) ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨hb₀_n, hb₁_n, hrat_n⟩ := h_wron (η_r n) (hη_pos n) (hη_lt64 n)
      have hP₀_eq : P₀ = (fun _ => μ) := by
        ext w
        exact hlam_sq
      have hdiv_n := hDiv (lam ^ 2) (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) (by rwa [hlam_sq]) hb₀_n hb₁_n
      change b₀_seq n * b₁_seq n * sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) =
        sfcaNumN P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) at hdiv_n
      unfold sfcaNumN at hdiv_n
      change b₀_seq n * b₁_seq n * sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) =
        k₀ * (1 - Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log
          (sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n)) 1 *
            sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n)) 1 / k₀ ^ 2))) at hdiv_n
      rw [hrat_n, hk₀_eq] at hdiv_n
      change (η_c n) * (η_c n * Complex.exp lam) * sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) =
        (Complex.exp lam * I₀) * (1 - w_seq n) at hdiv_n
      have hηc_ne : η_c n ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hη_pos n).ne'
      have hexp_ne : Complex.exp lam ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero lam
      have h_cancel : sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n) * (η_c n) ^ 2 = I₀ * (1 - w_seq n) := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hexp_ne
        linear_combination hdiv_n
      exact eq_div_of_mul_eq (pow_ne_zero 2 hηc_ne) h_cancel
    have hb₁_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto b₁_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [b₁_seq] using hηc_tendsto.mul_const (Complex.exp lam)
    have hprod_tendsto :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (b₀_seq n, b₁_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0, 0)) :=
      hηc_tendsto.prodMk_nhds hb₁_tendsto
    have h_lhs_tendsto :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (sfcaDivH P₀ 0 0)) :=
      ((hCont (lam ^ 2) (by rwa [hlam_sq])).tendsto).comp hprod_tendsto
    have h_rhs_tendsto :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => sfcaDivH P₀ (b₀_seq n) (b₁_seq n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (I₂ - I₁ ^ 2 / I₀))) := by
      simpa only [h_div_seq] using h_asymp
    have h_div00 : sfcaDivH P₀ 0 0 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (I₂ - I₁ ^ 2 / I₀) :=
      tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs_tendsto h_rhs_tendsto
    have h_psi : sfcaUniversalPsi P₀ 0 0 = sfcaDivH P₀ 0 0 := by
      simp [sfcaUniversalPsi]
    have hP₀_eq : P₀ = (fun _ => μ) := by
      ext w
      exact hlam_sq
    rw [← hP₀_eq, h_psi, h_div00, h_moments_eq_frozen, hlam_sq]

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  let rectOpen : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ :=
    fun a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ => { w : ℂ | a₁ < w.re ∧ w.re < a₂ ∧ b₁ < w.im ∧ w.im < b₂ }
  have hRect_open : ∀ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂, IsOpen (rectOpen a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂) := by
    intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
      ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
  have hRect_convex : ∀ a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂, Convex ℝ (rectOpen a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂) := by
    intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    have hre : (a • x + b • y).re = a * x.re + b * y.re := by
      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re]
    have him : (a • x + b • y).im = a * x.im + b * y.im := by
      simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im]
    have h_comb : ∀ {u v c₁ c₂ : ℝ}, c₁ < u → u < c₂ → c₁ < v → v < c₂ →
        c₁ < a * u + b * v ∧ a * u + b * v < c₂ := by
      intro u v c₁ c₂ hu1 hu2 hv1 hv2
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
        subst hb1
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · have h1 : 0 < a * (u - c₁) := mul_pos ha_pos (sub_pos.mpr hu1)
        have h2 : 0 ≤ b * (v - c₁) := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hv1))
        have h3 : 0 < a * (c₂ - u) := mul_pos ha_pos (sub_pos.mpr hu2)
        have h4 : 0 ≤ b * (c₂ - v) := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hv2))
        have id1 : a * u + b * v - c₁ = a * (u - c₁) + b * (v - c₁) := by
          calc a * u + b * v - c₁ = a * u + b * v - (a + b) * c₁ := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (u - c₁) + b * (v - c₁) := by ring
        have id2 : c₂ - (a * u + b * v) = a * (c₂ - u) + b * (c₂ - v) := by
          calc c₂ - (a * u + b * v) = (a + b) * c₂ - (a * u + b * v) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
            _ = a * (c₂ - u) + b * (c₂ - v) := by ring
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := h_comb hx.1 hx.2.1 hy.1 hy.2.1
    obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := h_comb hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2 hy.2.2.1 hy.2.2.2
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hHalf_open : ∀ B : ℝ, IsOpen { w : ℂ | w.re < B } :=
    fun B => isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
  have hHalf_convex : ∀ B : ℝ, Convex ℝ { w : ℂ | w.re < B } := by
    intro B x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    change (a • x + b • y).re < B
    have hre : (a • x + b • y).re = a * x.re + b * y.re := by
      simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re]
    rw [hre]
    have hx' : x.re < B := hx
    have hy' : y.re < B := hy
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      subst hb1; linarith
    · have h1 : 0 < a * (B - x.re) := mul_pos ha_pos (sub_pos.mpr hx')
      have h2 : 0 ≤ b * (B - y.re) := mul_nonneg hb (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hy'))
      have id1 : B - (a * x.re + b * y.re) = a * (B - x.re) + b * (B - y.re) := by
        calc B - (a * x.re + b * y.re) = (a + b) * B - (a * x.re + b * y.re) := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          _ = a * (B - x.re) + b * (B - y.re) := by ring
      linarith

  let U_Br : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Br.r_t
  let U_Br_punc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Br.r_t \ {0})
  let B_end : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ)) Br.r_end
  let U_log : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) ×ˢ { w : ℂ | w.re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) }
  let w_end : ℂ := (Real.log Br.t_end : ℂ)
  let q_end : ℂ × ℂ := ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), (Br.t_end : ℂ))
  let p_log_end : ℂ × ℂ := ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), w_end)
  let τ_2pi : ℂ := 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let E_exp : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, Complex.exp p.2)

  have hU_log_open : IsOpen U_log :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (hHalf_open _)
  have hU_log_preconn : IsPreconnected U_log :=
    ((convex_ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8)).prod (hHalf_convex _)).isPreconnected
  have hE_exp_diff : Differentiable ℂ E_exp :=
    differentiable_fst.prodMk (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp differentiable_snd)
  have hlog_t_end_lt : Real.log Br.t_end < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) :=
    Real.log_lt_log Br.t_end_pos Br.t_end_lt
  have hlog_34_lt : Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) < Real.log Br.r_t :=
    Real.log_lt_log (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos]) (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos])
  have hexp_w_end : Complex.exp w_end = (Br.t_end : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [w_end]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log Br.t_end_pos]
  have hw_end_re : w_end.re = Real.log Br.t_end := Complex.ofReal_re _
  have hw_end_im : w_end.im = 0 := Complex.ofReal_im _
  have hτ_2pi_re : τ_2pi.re = 0 := by simp [τ_2pi]
  have hexp_add_int : ∀ (z : ℂ) (n : ℤ), Complex.exp (z + (n : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = Complex.exp z := by
    intro z n
    rw [Complex.exp_add, show τ_2pi = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I from rfl,
      Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
  have hexp_mem_punc : ∀ y w : ℂ,
      y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y → w.re < Real.log Br.r_t →
        (y, Complex.exp w) ∈ U_Br_punc := by
    intro y w hy hw
    refine ⟨hy, ⟨?_, Complex.exp_ne_zero w⟩⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_exp]
    have hexp_lt := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hw
    rwa [Real.exp_log Br.r_t_pos] at hexp_lt
  have hU_log_maps_Br : ∀ p ∈ U_log, E_exp p ∈ U_Br_punc :=
    fun p hp => hexp_mem_punc p.1 p.2
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [Br.r_y_pos]) hp.1)
      (lt_trans hp.2 hlog_34_lt)
  have hB_end_sub_Br : B_end ⊆ U_Br := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2_pos, hp2_lt⟩ := Br.ball_end_sub hp
    exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [Br.r_y_pos]) hp1,
      by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith [Br.r_t_pos]⟩

  
  
  
  have h_s1 : ∃ (d : ℕ) (r_log_end : ℝ) (M_log : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      1 ≤ d ∧ 0 < r_log_end ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_log ι) U_log) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log,
        ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1),
          Br.A_coeff ι m (p.1, Complex.exp p.2) * (M_log ι p) ^ (m : ℕ) = 0) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log, ∀ n : ℤ,
        M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (n : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) = M_log ι p) ∧
      Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end ⊆ U_log ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end, (p.1, Complex.exp p.2) ∈ B_end) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end,
        M_log ι p = Br.M₁_end ι (p.1, Complex.exp p.2)) := by
    
    let δ_w0 : ℝ := (Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) - Real.log Br.t_end) / 2
    have hδ_w0_pos : 0 < δ_w0 := by dsimp [δ_w0]; linarith
    have hw_ball_re : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_end δ_w0, w.re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) := by
      intro w hw
      have hre_sub : |w.re - Real.log Br.t_end| < δ_w0 := by
        have h1 : |(w - w_end).re| ≤ ‖w - w_end‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - w_end)
        have h2 : ‖w - w_end‖ < δ_w0 := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hw
        have h3 : (w - w_end).re = w.re - Real.log Br.t_end := by simp [w_end]
        rw [h3] at h1
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
      rw [abs_lt] at hre_sub
      dsimp [δ_w0] at hre_sub
      linarith
    let a₁ : ℝ := Br.y₀ - 7 * Br.r_y / 10
    let a₂ : ℝ := Br.y₀ + 7 * Br.r_y / 10
    let b₁ : ℝ := -7 * Br.r_y / 10
    let b₂ : ℝ := 7 * Br.r_y / 10
    let a₁' : ℝ := Br.y₀ - 13 * Br.r_y / 20
    let a₂' : ℝ := Br.y₀ + 13 * Br.r_y / 20
    let b₁' : ℝ := -13 * Br.r_y / 20
    let b₂' : ℝ := 13 * Br.r_y / 20
    have hQy_sub : rectOpen a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have hsq : ‖y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = (y.re - Br.y₀) ^ 2 + y.im ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
        simp
        ring
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2, hy3, hy4⟩ := hy
      dsimp [a₁, a₂, b₁, b₂] at hy1 hy2 hy3 hy4
      have hre_sq : (y.re - Br.y₀) ^ 2 < (7 * Br.r_y / 10) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have him_sq : y.im ^ 2 < (7 * Br.r_y / 10) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hnorm_sq : ‖y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 < Br.r_y ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [Br.r_y_pos]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)), Br.r_y_pos]
    have hBall58_sub_Qy' : Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) ⊆ rectOpen a₁' a₂' b₁' b₂' := by
      intro y hy
      have hnorm : ‖y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)‖ < 5 * Br.r_y / 8 := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy
      have hre : |y.re - Br.y₀| < 13 * Br.r_y / 20 := by
        have h1 : |(y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)).re| ≤ ‖y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at h1
        linarith [Br.r_y_pos]
      have him : |y.im| < 13 * Br.r_y / 20 := by
        have h1 : |(y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)).im| ≤ ‖y - (Br.y₀ : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero] at h1
        linarith [Br.r_y_pos]
      rw [abs_lt] at hre him
      exact ⟨by dsimp [a₁']; linarith, by dsimp [a₂']; linarith,
        by dsimp [b₁']; linarith, by dsimp [b₂']; linarith⟩
    have hInit_sep : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        let U_init := rectOpen a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball w_end δ_w0
        let A_init : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun m q => Br.A_coeff ι m (E_exp q)
        (∀ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1), DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_init m) U_init) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ U_init,
          A_init (Fin.last (Br.D_det ι)) q ≠ 0 ∧
          ∀ z : ℂ,
            ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1), A_init m q * z ^ (m : ℕ) = 0 →
            ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι),
              (((m : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * A_init m.succ q * z ^ (m : ℕ) ≠ 0) := by
      intro ι
      have hmaps : ∀ q ∈ rectOpen a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball w_end δ_w0,
          E_exp q ∈ U_Br_punc :=

      have hsub_init : Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end ⊆

        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected hsub_outer

        ((hΛ_init_holo ι).mono hsub_init)
        ((Br.M₁_end_holo ι).comp hE_exp_diff.differentiableOn hexp_maps_end)

        (by rw [hΛ_init_seed ι, hE_p_log_end]) p hp

    
    let E_swap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.2, Complex.exp q.1)
    have hE_swap_diff : Differentiable ℂ E_swap :=
      differentiable_snd.prodMk (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp differentiable_fst)
    let R_w : ℂ → Set ℂ := fun w_st =>
      rectOpen (min w_st.re w_end.re - 2) (Real.log Br.r_t)
        (min w_st.im 0 - 2) (max w_st.im 0 + 2)
    let R'_w : ℂ → Set ℂ := fun w_st =>
      rectOpen (min w_st.re w_end.re - 1) (Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4))
        (min w_st.im 0 - 1) (max w_st.im 0 + 1)
    have hRw_sub : ∀ w_st : ℂ, R'_w w_st ⊆ R_w w_st := by
      intro w_st w ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, lt_trans h2 hlog_34_lt, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hw_end_mem_R' : ∀ w_st : ℂ, w_end ∈ R'_w w_st := by
      intro w_st
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · linarith [min_le_right w_st.re w_end.re]
      · simpa [hw_end_re] using hlog_t_end_lt
      · linarith [min_le_right w_st.im 0, hw_end_im]
      · linarith [le_max_right w_st.im 0, hw_end_im]
    have hw_self_mem_R' : ∀ w_st : ℂ, w_st.re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) → w_st ∈ R'_w w_st := by
      intro w_st hw_re
      exact ⟨by linarith [min_le_left w_st.re w_end.re], hw_re,
        by linarith [min_le_left w_st.im 0], by linarith [le_max_left w_st.im 0]⟩
    have hSep_swap : ∀ (w_st t_c : ℂ) (r_ty : ℝ) (ι : Fin 2),
        0 < r_ty → Metric.ball t_c r_ty ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y →
        let U_sw := R_w w_st ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c r_ty
        let A_sw : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun m q => Br.A_coeff ι m (E_swap q)
        ((∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (g₁ g₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),

            (∀ q ∈ V, ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1), A_sw m q * (g₂ q) ^ (m : ℕ) = 0) →
            g₁ q₀ = g₂ q₀ → ∀ q ∈ V, g₁ q = g₂ q) ∧
          (∀ (a₁' a₂' b₁' b₂' : ℝ) (w₀ z₀ : ℂ),
            min w_st.re w_end.re - 2 < a₁' → a₁' < a₂' → a₂' < Real.log Br.r_t →
            min w_st.im 0 - 2 < b₁' → b₁' < b₂' → b₂' < max w_st.im 0 + 2 →
            a₁' < w₀.re → w₀.re < a₂' → b₁' < w₀.im → w₀.im < b₂' →

      intro w_st t_c r_ty ι hr_ty hball_sub
      have hmaps : ∀ q ∈ R_w w_st ×ˢ Metric.ball t_c r_ty, E_swap q ∈ U_Br_punc :=

        ⟨hBall58_sub_Qy' u.2.1, Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_init_pos ι)⟩
    choose δ_loc Φ_loc hδ_loc_pos hδ_loc_le hΦ_loc_holo hΦ_loc_seed hΦ_loc_solves using h_loc_ex
    have hΦ_eq_Λ : ∀ (u : U_log) (ι : Fin 2),

      have hswap_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.2, q.1)) :=

      exact (hSep_swap u.1.2 u.1.1 (r_y_loc u) ι (hr_y_loc_pos u) (hr_y_loc_subBr u)).1

        hV_open hV_preconn hV_sub_sw

        ((hΦ_loc_holo u ι).mono hV_sub_loc)

        (fun q hq => hΦ_loc_solves u ι q (hV_sub_loc hq))
        (fun q hq => hΛ_init_solves ι (q.2, q.1) (hV_maps_init q hq))
        (hΦ_loc_seed u ι) (w, y) ⟨hw, hy⟩
    have hΦ_compat : ∀ (u₁ u₂ : U_log) (ι : Fin 2) (y w : ℂ),

        Φ_loc u₁ ι (w, y) = Φ_loc u₂ ι (w, y) := by
      intro u₁ u₂ ι y w hy hw

        (R'_w u₁.1.2 ∩ R'_w u₂.1.2) ×ˢ

      have hV_open : IsOpen V₁₂ :=

      have hV_sub₁ : V₁₂ ⊆ R'_w u₁.1.2 ×ˢ Metric.ball u₁.1.1 (δ_loc u₁ ι) :=

      have hV_sub₂ : V₁₂ ⊆ R'_w u₂.1.2 ×ˢ Metric.ball u₂.1.1 (δ_loc u₂ ι) :=

      have hV_sub_sw : V₁₂ ⊆ R_w u₁.1.2 ×ˢ Metric.ball u₁.1.1 (r_y_loc u₁) :=

      have h_seed_eq : Φ_loc u₁ ι (w_end, y) = Φ_loc u₂ ι (w_end, y) := by
        rw [hΦ_eq_Λ u₁ ι w_end ⟨hw_end_mem_R' u₁.1.2, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_w1_pos⟩ y hy.1,
            hΦ_eq_Λ u₂ ι w_end ⟨hw_end_mem_R' u₂.1.2, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_w1_pos⟩ y hy.2]
      exact (hSep_swap u₁.1.2 u₁.1.1 (r_y_loc u₁) ι (hr_y_loc_pos u₁) (hr_y_loc_subBr u₁)).1
        V₁₂ (Φ_loc u₁ ι) (Φ_loc u₂ ι) (w_end, y)
        hV_open hV_preconn hV_sub_sw
        ⟨⟨hw_end_mem_R' u₁.1.2, hw_end_mem_R' u₂.1.2⟩, hy⟩
        ((hΦ_loc_holo u₁ ι).mono hV_sub₁)
        ((hΦ_loc_holo u₂ ι).mono hV_sub₂)
        (fun q hq => hΦ_loc_solves u₁ ι q (hV_sub₁ hq))
        (fun q hq => hΦ_loc_solves u₂ ι q (hV_sub₂ hq))
        h_seed_eq (w, y) ⟨hw, hy⟩

    let M_log : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun ι p => @dite ℂ (p ∈ U_log) (Classical.propDecidable _)
        (fun hp => Φ_loc ⟨p, hp⟩ ι (p.2, p.1)) (fun _ => 0)
    have hM_log_def : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ) (hp : p ∈ U_log),
        M_log ι p = Φ_loc ⟨p, hp⟩ ι (p.2, p.1) :=
      fun ι p hp => @dite_eq_left_of_eq_true ℂ (p ∈ U_log) (Classical.propDecidable _)
        (fun h => Φ_loc ⟨p, h⟩ ι (p.2, p.1)) (fun _ => 0) (eq_true hp)
    have hM_log_local : ∀ (u : U_log) (ι : Fin 2),
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball u.1.1 (δ_loc u ι) ×ˢ R'_w u.1.2,
          q ∈ U_log ∧ M_log ι q = Φ_loc u ι (q.2, q.1) := by
      intro u ι q hq
      have hq_mem : q ∈ U_log :=
        ⟨hr_y_loc_sub58 u (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hδ_loc_le u ι) hq.1), hq.2.2.1⟩
      refine ⟨hq_mem, ?_⟩
      rw [hM_log_def ι q hq_mem]
      exact hΦ_compat ⟨q, hq_mem⟩ u ι q.1 q.2
        ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_loc_pos ⟨q, hq_mem⟩ ι), hq.1⟩
        ⟨hw_self_mem_R' q.2 hq_mem.2, hq.2⟩
    have hM_log_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_log ι) U_log := by
      intro ι p hp
      let u : U_log := ⟨p, hp⟩
      let O_u : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p.1 (δ_loc u ι) ×ˢ R'_w p.2
      have hO_open : IsOpen O_u := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (hRect_open _ _ _ _)
      have hp_O : p ∈ O_u :=
        ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_loc_pos u ι), hw_self_mem_R' p.2 hp.2⟩
      have hswap_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.2, q.1)) :=
        differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst
      have hcomp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => Φ_loc u ι (q.2, q.1)) O_u := by
        change DifferentiableOn ℂ ((Φ_loc u ι) ∘ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.2, q.1))) O_u
        exact (hΦ_loc_holo u ι).comp hswap_diff.differentiableOn (fun q hq => ⟨hq.2, hq.1⟩)
      have hcomp_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => Φ_loc u ι (q.2, q.1)) p :=
        hcomp_holo.differentiableAt (hO_open.mem_nhds hp_O)
      exact (hcomp_at.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO_open.mem_nhds hp_O)
          (fun q hq => (hM_log_local u ι q hq).2))).differentiableWithinAt
    have hM_log_solves : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log,
        ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1),
          Br.A_coeff ι m (p.1, Complex.exp p.2) * (M_log ι p) ^ (m : ℕ) = 0 := by
      intro ι p hp
      rw [hM_log_def ι p hp]
      exact hΦ_loc_solves ⟨p, hp⟩ ι (p.2, p.1)
        ⟨hw_self_mem_R' p.2 hp.2, Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_loc_pos ⟨p, hp⟩ ι)⟩
    have hM_log_eq_end : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end,
        M_log ι p = Br.M₁_end ι (p.1, Complex.exp p.2) := by
      intro ι p hp
      have hp_U : p ∈ U_log := hB_log_end_sub hp
      rw [hM_log_def ι p hp_U]
      have hp_prod : p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_log_end ×ˢ Metric.ball w_end r_log_end := by
        rwa [ball_prod_same]
      have hw_w1 : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball w_end δ_w1 :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_log_le_w1 hp_prod.2
      rw [hΦ_eq_Λ ⟨p, hp_U⟩ ι p.2 ⟨hw_self_mem_R' p.2 hp_U.2, hw_w1⟩ p.1
        (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_loc_pos ⟨p, hp_U⟩ ι))]
      exact hΛ_eq_end ι p hp

    
    have h_per_ι : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∃ d_ι : ℕ, 1 ≤ d_ι ∧
        ∀ p ∈ U_log, M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (d_ι : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = M_log ι p := by
      intro ι
      let D_ι : ℕ := Br.D_det ι
      have hq_end_punc : q_end ∈ U_Br_punc := by
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self Br.r_y_pos, ⟨?_, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Br.t_end_pos.ne'⟩⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos Br.t_end_pos]
        linarith [Br.t_end_lt, Br.r_t_pos]
      have hlead_ne : Br.A_coeff ι (Fin.last D_ι) q_end ≠ 0 :=
        (Br.separable_punc ι q_end hq_end_punc).1
      let P₀ : Polynomial ℂ :=
        ∑ m : Fin (D_ι + 1), Polynomial.C (Br.A_coeff ι m q_end) * Polynomial.X ^ (m : ℕ)
      have hP₀_coeff : ∀ k : ℕ, P₀.coeff k =
          ∑ m : Fin (D_ι + 1), if k = (m : ℕ) then Br.A_coeff ι m q_end else 0 := by
        intro k
        dsimp only [P₀]
        rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
        split_ifs <;> ring
      have hP₀_coeff_D : P₀.coeff D_ι = Br.A_coeff ι (Fin.last D_ι) q_end := by
        rw [hP₀_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last D_ι)]
        · simp
        · intro m _ hm
          have hval : D_ι ≠ (m : ℕ) := fun heq => hm (Fin.ext heq.symm)
          simp [hval]
        · intro hnot; exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _))
      have hP₀_ne : P₀ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        rw [h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hP₀_coeff_D
        exact hlead_ne hP₀_coeff_D.symm
      have hP₀_deg : P₀.natDegree ≤ D_ι := by
        rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
        intro k hk
        rw [hP₀_coeff]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => ?_
        have hval : k ≠ (m : ℕ) := by have := m.2; omega
        simp [hval]
      let z_nat : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => M_log ι ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), w_end + (k : ℂ) * τ_2pi)
      have hz_mem_U : ∀ k : ℕ, ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), w_end + (k : ℂ) * τ_2pi) ∈ U_log := by
        intro k
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity [Br.r_y_pos]), ?_⟩
        change (w_end + (k : ℂ) * τ_2pi).re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
        have hre : (w_end + (k : ℂ) * τ_2pi).re = Real.log Br.t_end := by
          simp [w_end, τ_2pi]
        rw [hre]
        exact hlog_t_end_lt
      have hz_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun k : Fin (D_ι + 1) => z_nat k.1)
          (↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (D_ι + 1)))) (↑P₀.roots.toFinset) := by
        intro k _
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hP₀_ne,
          Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
        dsimp only [P₀]
        rw [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
        have h_sol := hM_log_solves ι ((Br.y₀ : ℂ), w_end + (k.1 : ℂ) * τ_2pi) (hz_mem_U k.1)
        have hexp_k : Complex.exp (w_end + (k.1 : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = (Br.t_end : ℂ) := by
          have h1 := hexp_add_int w_end (k.1 : ℤ)
          rw [Int.cast_natCast] at h1
          rw [h1, hexp_w_end]
        rw [hexp_k] at h_sol
        simpa [z_nat] using h_sol
      have hcard_lt : P₀.roots.toFinset.card < (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (D_ι + 1))).card := by
        have h1 : P₀.roots.toFinset.card ≤ P₀.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le P₀.roots
        have h2 : P₀.roots.card ≤ P₀.natDegree := Polynomial.card_roots' P₀
        simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        omega
      obtain ⟨k₁, _, k₂, _, hk_ne, hzk_eq⟩ :=
        Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hcard_lt hz_maps
      have hex_ab : ∃ a b : ℕ, a < b ∧ z_nat a = z_nat b := by
        rcases lt_trichotomy k₁.1 k₂.1 with hlt | heq | hgt
        · exact ⟨k₁.1, k₂.1, hlt, hzk_eq⟩
        · exact False.elim (hk_ne (Fin.ext heq))
        · exact ⟨k₂.1, k₁.1, hgt, hzk_eq.symm⟩
      obtain ⟨a, b, hab_lt, hz_ab⟩ := hex_ab
      refine ⟨b - a, by omega, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      let w₁ : ℂ := p.2 - (a : ℂ) * τ_2pi
      have hw₁_re : w₁.re = p.2.re := by simp [w₁, τ_2pi]
      let V_per : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R'_w w₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8)
      have hVp_open : IsOpen V_per := (hRect_open _ _ _ _).prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hVp_preconn : IsPreconnected V_per :=
        ((hRect_convex _ _ _ _).prod (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
      have hVp_sub : V_per ⊆ R_w w₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y :=
        fun q hq => ⟨hRw_sub w₁ hq.1, Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [Br.r_y_pos]) hq.2⟩
      have hshift_holo : ∀ m_sh : ℕ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => M_log ι (q.2, q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) V_per ∧
          ∀ q ∈ V_per,
            ∑ m : Fin (Br.D_det ι + 1),
              Br.A_coeff ι m (E_swap q) *
                (M_log ι (q.2, q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) ^ (m : ℕ) = 0 := by
        intro m_sh
        let sh_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.2, q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi)
        have hsh_diff : Differentiable ℂ sh_map :=
          differentiable_snd.prodMk (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const _))
        have hsh_maps : Set.MapsTo sh_map V_per U_log := by
          intro q hq
          refine ⟨hq.2, ?_⟩
          change (q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi).re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
          have hre : (q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi).re = q.1.re := by simp [τ_2pi]
          rw [hre]
          exact hq.1.2.1
        refine ⟨by
          change DifferentiableOn ℂ ((M_log ι) ∘ sh_map) V_per
          exact (hM_log_holo ι).comp hsh_diff.differentiableOn hsh_maps, fun q hq => ?_⟩
        have h_sol := hM_log_solves ι (sh_map q) (hsh_maps hq)
        have hexp_eq : Complex.exp (q.1 + (m_sh : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = Complex.exp q.1 := by
          have h1 := hexp_add_int q.1 (m_sh : ℤ)
          rwa [Int.cast_natCast] at h1
        dsimp only [sh_map, E_swap] at h_sol ⊢
        rwa [hexp_eq] at h_sol
      have h_eq_V :=
        (hSep_swap w₁ (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y ι Br.r_y_pos Set.Subset.rfl).1
          V_per
          (fun q => M_log ι (q.2, q.1 + (a : ℂ) * τ_2pi))
          (fun q => M_log ι (q.2, q.1 + (b : ℂ) * τ_2pi))
          (w_end, (Br.y₀ : ℂ))
          hVp_open hVp_preconn hVp_sub
          ⟨hw_end_mem_R' w₁, Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity [Br.r_y_pos])⟩
          (hshift_holo a).1 (hshift_holo b).1
          (hshift_holo a).2 (hshift_holo b).2
          hz_ab (w₁, p.1)
          ⟨hw_self_mem_R' w₁ (by rw [hw₁_re]; exact hp.2), hp.1⟩
      have hw₁_a : w₁ + (a : ℂ) * τ_2pi = p.2 := by dsimp [w₁]; ring
      have ha_add : a + (b - a) = b := by omega
      have hb_cast : (b : ℂ) = (a : ℂ) + ((b - a : ℕ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast ha_add.symm
      have hw₁_b : w₁ + (b : ℂ) * τ_2pi = p.2 + ((b - a : ℕ) : ℂ) * τ_2pi := by
        rw [hb_cast]; dsimp [w₁]; ring
      rw [hw₁_a, hw₁_b] at h_eq_V
      exact h_eq_V.symm

    choose d_fn hd_fn_pos hd_fn_per using h_per_ι
    have h_nat_mul_per : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (s : ℕ),
        (∀ p ∈ U_log, M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (s : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = M_log ι p) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ U_log,
          M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (k : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) = M_log ι p := by
      intro ι s hs k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro p _
        simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro p hp
        have hp_sh : (p.1, p.2 + (k : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) ∈ U_log := by
          refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
          change (p.2 + (k : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi)).re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
          have hre : (p.2 + (k : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi)).re = p.2.re := by simp [τ_2pi]
          rw [hre]; exact hp.2
        have h_assoc : p.2 + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi) =
            (p.2 + (k : ℂ) * ((s : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) + (s : ℂ) * τ_2pi := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_assoc, hs _ hp_sh, ih p hp]
    let d : ℕ := d_fn 0 * d_fn 1
    have hd_pos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.mul_pos (hd_fn_pos 0) (hd_fn_pos 1)
    have hd_base : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log,
        M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = M_log ι p := by
      intro ι p hp
      fin_cases ι
      · have h1 := h_nat_mul_per 0 (d_fn 0) (hd_fn_per 0) (d_fn 1) p hp
        have heq : (d_fn 1 : ℂ) * ((d_fn 0 : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = (d : ℂ) * τ_2pi := by
          dsimp [d]; push_cast; ring
        rwa [heq] at h1
      · have h1 := h_nat_mul_per 1 (d_fn 1) (hd_fn_per 1) (d_fn 0) p hp
        have heq : (d_fn 0 : ℂ) * ((d_fn 1 : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = (d : ℂ) * τ_2pi := by
          dsimp [d]; push_cast; ring
        rwa [heq] at h1
    have hM_log_per : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log, ∀ n : ℤ,
        M_log ι (p.1, p.2 + (n : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) = M_log ι p := by
      intro ι p hp n
      rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg n with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
      · simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using h_nat_mul_per ι d (hd_base ι) k p hp
      · have hp_neg : (p.1, p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) ∈ U_log := by
          refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
          change (p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)).re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
          have hre : (p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)).re = p.2.re := by simp [τ_2pi]
          rw [hre]; exact hp.2
        have hpos := h_nat_mul_per ι d (hd_base ι) k
          (p.1, p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) hp_neg
        have hsub : (p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi)) + (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) = p.2 := by
          ring
        rw [hsub] at hpos
        have hcast : p.2 + ((-(k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) =
            p.2 - (k : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [hcast]
        exact hpos.symm
    exact ⟨d, r_log_end, M_log, hd_pos, hr_log_end_pos, hM_log_holo, hM_log_solves,
      hM_log_per, hB_log_end_sub, hexp_maps_end, hM_log_eq_end⟩

  obtain ⟨d, r_log_end, M_log, hd_pos, hr_log_end_pos, hM_log_holo, hM_log_solves,
    hM_log_per, hB_log_end_sub, hexp_maps_end, hM_log_eq_end⟩ := h_s1

  
  
  
  have hd_ne_zero : d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hd_pos
  have hd_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hd_pos
  have hd_ne_R : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd_pos_R
  have hd_ne_C : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hd_ne_zero

  have h_s2 : ∃ (r_yp r_τ : ℝ) (K_p : ℕ) (M_puis N_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_yp ∧ r_yp ≤ Br.r_y / 2 ∧
      0 < r_τ ∧ r_τ ^ d < Br.r_t / 2 ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_puis ι)
          (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}))) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_puis ι)
          (Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)) ∧
      (∀ ι : Fin 2,
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
          p.2 ≠ 0 → N_puis ι p = p.2 ^ K_p * M_puis ι p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
        (p.1, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log p.2) ∈ U_log ∧
        Complex.exp ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log p.2) = p.2 ^ d ∧
        ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι p = M_log ι (p.1, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log p.2)) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}),
        ∃ (O_τ : Set ℂ) (ℓ : ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen O_τ ∧ p.2 ∈ O_τ ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ ℓ p.2 ∧
          ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp, ∀ ζ ∈ O_τ,
            (y, ℓ ζ) ∈ U_log ∧
            Complex.exp (ℓ ζ) = ζ ^ d ∧
            ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι (y, ζ) = M_log ι (y, ℓ ζ)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp, ∀ w : ℂ,
        w.re < (d : ℝ) * Real.log r_τ →
        (y, w) ∈ U_log ∧
        (y, Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) ∈
          Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0}) ∧
        (Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) ^ d = Complex.exp w ∧
        ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι (y, Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) = M_log ι (y, w)) := by
    let r_τ_raw : ℝ := (3 * Br.r_t / 4) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹)
    have hr_τ_raw_pos : 0 < r_τ_raw :=
      Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos]) _
    have hr_τ_raw_pow : r_τ_raw ^ d = 3 * Br.r_t / 4 := by
      dsimp [r_τ_raw]
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith [Br.r_t_pos]),
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hd_ne_R, Real.rpow_one]
    have hd_log_raw : (d : ℝ) * Real.log r_τ_raw = Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4) := by
      rw [← Real.log_pow, hr_τ_raw_pow]
    let r_yp : ℝ := Br.r_y / 2
    have hr_yp_pos : 0 < r_yp := by dsimp [r_yp]; positivity [Br.r_y_pos]
    have hr_yp_le : r_yp ≤ Br.r_y / 2 := le_rfl
    let r_τ : ℝ := r_τ_raw / 2
    have hr_τ_pos : 0 < r_τ := by dsimp [r_τ]; positivity
    have hr_τ_pow_lt : r_τ ^ d < Br.r_t / 2 := by
      have hd_sub : d = (d - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hd_pos).symm
      have hhalf_pow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        rw [hd_sub, pow_succ]
        have h1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (d - 1) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        linarith
      have hpow_eq : r_τ ^ d = r_τ_raw ^ d * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d := by
        dsimp [r_τ]
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
        norm_num
      rw [hpow_eq, hr_τ_raw_pow]
      nlinarith [Br.r_t_pos]

    let K_p : ℕ := d * Br.m_t + 1
    let M_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun ι p => M_log ι (p.1, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log p.2)
    let N_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun ι p => if p.2 = 0 then 0 else p.2 ^ K_p * M_puis ι p
    let B_puis : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ
    let B_puis_punc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0})
    let U_punc_raw : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ_raw \ {0})
    have hU_punc_raw_open : IsOpen U_punc_raw :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
    have hB_puis_punc_sub_raw : B_puis_punc ⊆ U_punc_raw :=
      Set.prod_mono
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [r_yp]; linarith [Br.r_y_pos]))
        (fun τ hτ => ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [r_τ]; linarith) hτ.1, hτ.2⟩)

    have hN_puis_eq : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ B_puis, p.2 ≠ 0 →
        N_puis ι p = p.2 ^ K_p * M_puis ι p := by
      intro ι p _ hp2
      simp [N_puis, hp2]

    have hlog_mem_U_log : ∀ y ζ : ℂ,
        y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) →
        ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ_raw \ {0} →
          (y, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ) ∈ U_log ∧
          Complex.exp ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ) = ζ ^ d := by
      intro y ζ hy hζ
      have hζ_norm_lt : ‖ζ‖ < r_τ_raw := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hζ.1
      have hζ_norm_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ.2
      refine ⟨⟨hy, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · change ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
        have hre : ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).re = (d : ℝ) * Real.log ‖ζ‖ := by
          simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.log_re]
        rw [hre, ← hd_log_raw]
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.log_lt_log hζ_norm_pos hζ_norm_lt) hd_pos_R
      · rw [Complex.exp_nat_mul, Complex.exp_log hζ.2]

    have hLocalLift : ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R → R ≤ r_τ_raw →
        ∀ τ₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R \ {0},
          ∃ (O_τ : Set ℂ) (ℓ : ℂ → ℂ),
            IsOpen O_τ ∧ τ₀ ∈ O_τ ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ ℓ τ₀ ∧
            ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8), ∀ ζ ∈ O_τ,
              (y, ℓ ζ) ∈ U_log ∧
              Complex.exp (ℓ ζ) = ζ ^ d ∧
              ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι (y, ζ) = M_log ι (y, ℓ ζ) := by
      intro R _ hR_le τ₀ hτ₀
      rcases Complex.mem_slitPlane_or_neg_mem_slitPlane hτ₀.2 with hslit | hneg_slit
      · refine ⟨Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ Complex.slitPlane,
          fun ζ => (d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ,
          Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Complex.isOpen_slitPlane,
          ⟨hτ₀.1, hslit⟩,
          (Complex.differentiableAt_log hslit).const_mul (d : ℂ), ?_⟩
        intro y hy ζ hζ
        have hζ_raw : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ_raw \ {0} :=
          ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hR_le hζ.1, Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hζ.2⟩
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hlog_mem_U_log y ζ hy hζ_raw
        exact ⟨h1, h2, fun _ => rfl⟩
      · refine ⟨Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∩ (fun ζ : ℂ => -ζ) ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane,
          fun ζ => (d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I),
          Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage continuous_neg),
          ⟨hτ₀.1, hneg_slit⟩,
          (((Complex.differentiableAt_log hneg_slit).comp τ₀ differentiableAt_id.neg).add
            (differentiableAt_const _)).const_mul (d : ℂ), ?_⟩
        intro y hy ζ hζ
        have hneg_ne : -ζ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hζ.2
        have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mp hneg_ne
        have hζ_norm_lt : ‖ζ‖ < r_τ_raw :=
          by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using Metric.ball_subset_ball hR_le hζ.1
        have hζ_norm_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ_ne
        have hℓ_U : (y, (d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U_log := by
          refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
          change ((d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re <
            Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
          have hre : ((d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)).re =
              (d : ℝ) * Real.log ‖ζ‖ := by
            simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.log_re]
          rw [hre, ← hd_log_raw]
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.log_lt_log hζ_norm_pos hζ_norm_lt) hd_pos_R
        have hexp_one : Complex.exp (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) = ζ := by
          rw [Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_log hneg_ne, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I]
          ring
        have hexp_d : Complex.exp ((d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
            ζ ^ d := by
          rw [Complex.exp_nat_mul, hexp_one]
        have hexp_eq_log :
            Complex.exp (Complex.log ζ) =
              Complex.exp (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          rw [Complex.exp_log hζ_ne, hexp_one]
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp hexp_eq_log
        refine ⟨hℓ_U, hexp_d, fun ι => ?_⟩
        dsimp only [M_puis]
        have hmul : (d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ =
            (d : ℂ) * (Complex.log (-ζ) + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
              (n : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) := by
          rw [hn]
          dsimp [τ_2pi]
          ring
        rw [hmul]
        exact hM_log_per ι _ hℓ_U n

    have hM_puis_raw_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_puis ι) U_punc_raw := by
      intro ι q₀ hq₀
      obtain ⟨O_τ, ℓ, hO_open, hq₀_O, hℓ_diff, hℓ_props⟩ :=
        hLocalLift r_τ_raw hr_τ_raw_pos le_rfl q₀.2 hq₀.2
      let O_2d : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) ×ˢ O_τ
      have hO2_open : IsOpen O_2d := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod hO_open
      have hq₀_O2 : q₀ ∈ O_2d := ⟨hq₀.1, hq₀_O⟩
      have hmap_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1, ℓ q.2)) q₀ :=
        differentiableAt_fst.prodMk (hℓ_diff.comp q₀ differentiableAt_snd)
      have hcomp_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => M_log ι (q.1, ℓ q.2)) q₀ :=
        ((hM_log_holo ι).differentiableAt
          (hU_log_open.mem_nhds (hℓ_props q₀.1 hq₀.1 q₀.2 hq₀_O).1)).comp q₀ hmap_diff
      exact (hcomp_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO2_open.mem_nhds hq₀_O2)
          (fun q hq => (hℓ_props q.1 hq.1 q.2 hq.2).2.2 ι))).differentiableWithinAt

    have hM_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_puis ι) B_puis_punc :=
      fun ι => (hM_puis_raw_holo ι).mono hB_puis_punc_sub_raw

    have hpullback_exp_div_d :
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp, ∀ w : ℂ,
          w.re < (d : ℝ) * Real.log r_τ →
          (y, w) ∈ U_log ∧
          (y, Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) ∈ B_puis_punc ∧
          (Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) ^ d = Complex.exp w ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι (y, Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))) = M_log ι (y, w) := by
      intro y hy w hw
      have hy_58 : y ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (5 * Br.r_y / 8) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [r_yp]; linarith [Br.r_y_pos]) hy
      have hlog_τ_lt : Real.log r_τ < Real.log r_τ_raw :=
        Real.log_lt_log hr_τ_pos (by dsimp [r_τ]; linarith)
      have hw_U : (y, w) ∈ U_log := by
        refine ⟨hy_58, ?_⟩
        change w.re < Real.log (3 * Br.r_t / 4)
        rw [← hd_log_raw]
        exact lt_trans hw (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlog_τ_lt hd_pos_R)
      let ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ))
      have hdiv_re : (w / (d : ℂ)).re = w.re / (d : ℝ) := by
        have hcast : (w / (d : ℂ)) = w * (((d : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; rfl
        rw [hcast, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero,
          div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hζ_punc : (y, ζ) ∈ B_puis_punc := by
        refine ⟨hy, ⟨?_, Complex.exp_ne_zero _⟩⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_exp, hdiv_re]
        have hdiv_lt : w.re / (d : ℝ) < Real.log r_τ :=
          (div_lt_iff₀ hd_pos_R).mpr (by linarith)
        have hexp_lt := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hdiv_lt
        rwa [Real.exp_log hr_τ_pos] at hexp_lt
      have hζ_pow : ζ ^ d = Complex.exp w := by
        dsimp [ζ]
        rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd_ne_C]
      have hexp_log_ζ : Complex.exp (Complex.log ζ) = Complex.exp (w / (d : ℂ)) :=
        Complex.exp_log hζ_punc.2.2
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp hexp_log_ζ
      refine ⟨hw_U, hζ_punc, hζ_pow, fun ι => ?_⟩
      dsimp only [M_puis]
      have hmul : (d : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ = w + (n : ℂ) * ((d : ℂ) * τ_2pi) := by
        rw [hn, mul_add, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd_ne_C]
        dsimp [τ_2pi]
        ring
      rw [hmul]
      exact hM_log_per ι (y, w) hw_U n

    have hN_puis_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (N_puis ι) B_puis := by
      intro ι
      let D_ι : ℕ := Br.D_det ι
      have hD_pos : 1 ≤ D_ι := Br.D_det_pos ι
      obtain ⟨G_div, hG_holo, hG_eq⟩ := Br.lead_dvd ι
      let pow_d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, p.2 ^ d)
      have hpow_d_cont : Continuous pow_d := continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.pow d)
      let K_sub : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        Metric.closedBall (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (9 * Br.r_y / 16) ×ˢ
          Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (3 * r_τ_raw / 4)
      have hK_sub_compact : IsCompact K_sub :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall _ _)
      have hK_sub_maps : ∀ p ∈ K_sub, pow_d p ∈ U_Br := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp.1) (by linarith [Br.r_y_pos])), ?_⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_pow]
        have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ ≤ 3 * r_τ_raw / 4 := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
        have h1 : ‖p.2‖ ^ d ≤ (3 * r_τ_raw / 4) ^ d :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hp2 d
        have h2 : (3 * r_τ_raw / 4) ^ d = r_τ_raw ^ d * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ d := by
          rw [show 3 * r_τ_raw / 4 = r_τ_raw * (3 / 4) by ring, mul_pow]
        have h3 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ d ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        rw [h2, hr_τ_raw_pow] at h1
        nlinarith [Br.r_t_pos]
      let a_lead : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Br.A_coeff ι (Fin.last D_ι) (pow_d p)
      have ha_lead_cont : ContinuousOn a_lead K_sub :=
        (Br.coeff_holo ι (Fin.last D_ι)).continuousOn.comp hpow_d_cont.continuousOn hK_sub_maps
      let c_m : Fin D_ι → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun m p =>
        Br.A_coeff ι m.castSucc (pow_d p) * (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1 - (m : ℕ))
      have hc_m_cont : ∀ m : Fin D_ι, ContinuousOn (c_m m) K_sub := fun m =>
        ((Br.coeff_holo ι m.castSucc).continuousOn.comp hpow_d_cont.continuousOn hK_sub_maps).mul
          (ha_lead_cont.pow _)
      have hsum_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖) K_sub :=
        continuousOn_finsetSum _ fun m _ => (hc_m_cont m).norm
      obtain ⟨M_poly, hM_poly⟩ := hK_sub_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hsum_cont
      let C_sum : ℝ := 1 + max M_poly 0
      have hC_sum_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_sum := by dsimp [C_sum]; linarith [le_max_right M_poly 0]
      have hC_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_sum := by linarith
      have hdiv_cont : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => G_div (pow_d p) / Br.H_tilde (pow_d p)) K_sub :=
        (hG_holo.continuousOn.comp hpow_d_cont.continuousOn hK_sub_maps).div
          (Br.H_tilde_holo.continuousOn.comp hpow_d_cont.continuousOn hK_sub_maps)
          (fun p hp => Br.H_tilde_ne_zero (pow_d p) (hK_sub_maps p hp))
      obtain ⟨M_div, hM_div⟩ := hK_sub_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdiv_cont
      let C_div : ℝ := max M_div 0
      have hC_div_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_div := le_max_right M_div 0

      have hN_bound : ∀ p ∈ K_sub, ‖N_puis ι p‖ ≤ (C_div * C_sum) * ‖p.2‖ := by
        intro p hp
        by_cases hp2 : p.2 = 0
        · simp [N_puis, hp2]
        · have hp_raw : p ∈ U_punc_raw :=
            ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr
              (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp.1) (by linarith [Br.r_y_pos])),
             ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr
               (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp.2) (by linarith)), hp2⟩⟩
          obtain ⟨hp_log, hp_exp⟩ := hlog_mem_U_log p.1 p.2 hp_raw.1 hp_raw.2
          have h_sol := hM_log_solves ι (p.1, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log p.2) hp_log
          rw [hp_exp] at h_sol
          change ∑ m : Fin (D_ι + 1), Br.A_coeff ι m (pow_d p) * (M_puis ι p) ^ (m : ℕ) = 0 at h_sol
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at h_sol
          let w : ℂ := a_lead p * M_puis ι p
          have hw_monic : w ^ D_ι = -(∑ m : Fin D_ι, c_m m p * w ^ (m : ℕ)) := by
            have hmul := congr_arg (fun z : ℂ => (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1) * z) h_sol
            simp only [mul_zero, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum] at hmul
            have htop : (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1) *
                (Br.A_coeff ι (Fin.last D_ι) (pow_d p) * (M_puis ι p) ^ (Fin.last D_ι : ℕ)) =
                w ^ D_ι := by
              change (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1) * (a_lead p * (M_puis ι p) ^ D_ι) =
                (a_lead p * M_puis ι p) ^ D_ι
              have hd1 : (D_ι - 1) + 1 = D_ι := Nat.sub_add_cancel hD_pos
              rw [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, hd1]
            have hsum_eq :
                (∑ x : Fin D_ι, (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1) *
                  (Br.A_coeff ι x.castSucc (pow_d p) * (M_puis ι p) ^ (x.castSucc : ℕ))) =
                ∑ x : Fin D_ι, c_m x p * w ^ (x : ℕ) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
              have hm_le : (m : ℕ) ≤ D_ι - 1 := by have := m.2; omega
              have hm_add : (D_ι - 1 - (m : ℕ)) + (m : ℕ) = D_ι - 1 := Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_le
              dsimp only [c_m, w, Fin.val_castSucc]
              rw [mul_pow, show Br.A_coeff ι m.castSucc (pow_d p) * (a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1 - (m : ℕ)) *
                  ((a_lead p) ^ (m : ℕ) * (M_puis ι p) ^ (m : ℕ)) =
                ((a_lead p) ^ (D_ι - 1 - (m : ℕ)) * (a_lead p) ^ (m : ℕ)) *
                  (Br.A_coeff ι m.castSucc (pow_d p) * (M_puis ι p) ^ (m : ℕ)) by ring,
                ← pow_add, hm_add]
            rw [htop, hsum_eq] at hmul
            exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hmul
          have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ C_sum := by
            by_cases hw1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1
            · linarith
            · have hw1' : 1 < ‖w‖ := not_le.mp hw1
              have hw_pow_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) := pow_pos (by linarith) _
              have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ D_ι ≤ (∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖) * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) := by
                calc ‖w‖ ^ D_ι = ‖w ^ D_ι‖ := (norm_pow w D_ι).symm
                  _ = ‖∑ m : Fin D_ι, c_m m p * w ^ (m : ℕ)‖ := by rw [hw_monic, norm_neg]
                  _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p * w ^ (m : ℕ)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
                  _ = ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖ * ‖w‖ ^ (m : ℕ) := by
                      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
                      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
                  _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖ * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) := by
                      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
                      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
                      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (le_of_lt hw1') (by have := m.2; omega)
                  _ = (∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖) * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
              have hsum_le : ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖ ≤ C_sum := by
                have hb := hM_poly p hp
                rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
                have hb' : ∑ m : Fin D_ι, ‖c_m m p‖ ≤ M_poly := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hb
                dsimp [C_sum]
                linarith [le_max_left M_poly 0]
              have h2 : ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) ≤ C_sum * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) := by
                have hd1 : (D_ι - 1) + 1 = D_ι := Nat.sub_add_cancel hD_pos
                have hpow_split : ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ ^ (D_ι - 1) = ‖w‖ ^ D_ι := by
                  rw [mul_comm, ← pow_succ, hd1]
                rw [hpow_split]
                exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum_le (le_of_lt hw_pow_pos))
              exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h2 hw_pow_pos
          have hH_ne : Br.H_tilde (pow_d p) ≠ 0 := Br.H_tilde_ne_zero (pow_d p) (hK_sub_maps p hp)
          have hlead_id := hG_eq (pow_d p) (hK_sub_maps p hp)
          change (p.2 ^ d) ^ Br.m_t * Br.H_tilde (pow_d p) = a_lead p * G_div (pow_d p) at hlead_id
          rw [← pow_mul] at hlead_id
          have hN_id : N_puis ι p = p.2 * (G_div (pow_d p) / Br.H_tilde (pow_d p)) * w := by
            have hN_def : N_puis ι p = p.2 ^ (d * Br.m_t + 1) * M_puis ι p := by
              simp [N_puis, K_p, hp2]
            rw [hN_def]
            dsimp only [w]
            apply mul_right_cancel₀ hH_ne
            calc p.2 ^ (d * Br.m_t + 1) * M_puis ι p * Br.H_tilde (pow_d p)
                = p.2 * (p.2 ^ (d * Br.m_t) * Br.H_tilde (pow_d p)) * M_puis ι p := by
                    rw [pow_succ]; ring
              _ = p.2 * (a_lead p * G_div (pow_d p)) * M_puis ι p := by rw [hlead_id]
              _ = p.2 * (G_div (pow_d p) / Br.H_tilde (pow_d p) * Br.H_tilde (pow_d p)) *
                    (a_lead p * M_puis ι p) := by
                    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hH_ne]; ring

      let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        { toLinearMap :=
            { toFun := Prod.fst

        { toLinearMap :=
            { toFun := Prod.snd

      let r_c : ℝ := 5 * r_τ_raw / 8

        intro θ

      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := continuous_circleMap 0 r_c
      have hγ_deriv_cont : Continuous (deriv γ) := by
        have h_eq : deriv γ = fun θ => circleMap 0 r_c θ * Complex.I := by

      let K_cir : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        Metric.closedBall (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r_c
      have hK_cir_compact : IsCompact K_cir :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod (isCompact_sphere _ _)
      have hK_cir_sub : K_cir ⊆ U_punc_raw := by
        intro q hq
        have hq2_norm : ‖q.2‖ = r_c := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hq.2
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr
          (lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1) (by dsimp [r_yp]; linarith [Br.r_y_pos])),
          ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hq2_norm]; dsimp [r_c]; linarith
        · intro h0; rw [h0, norm_zero] at hq2_norm; linarith
      have hpA_M_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA (M_puis ι)) U_punc_raw :=
        (hKit.pderiv_holo hU_punc_raw_open (hM_puis_raw_holo ι)).1
      obtain ⟨B_M0, hB_M0⟩ :=
        hK_cir_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hM_puis_raw_holo ι).continuousOn.mono hK_cir_sub)
      obtain ⟨B_dM0, hB_dM0⟩ :=
        hK_cir_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hpA_M_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_cir_sub)
      let B_M : ℝ := max B_M0 0

      have hB_M_nonneg : 0 ≤ B_M := le_max_right _ _
      have hB_dM_nonneg : 0 ≤ B_dM := le_max_right _ _
      have hp_sep_cir : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, ∀ θ : ℝ, r_τ_raw / 8 < ‖γ θ - p.2‖ := by
        intro p hp θ
        have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
        have htri : ‖γ θ‖ ≤ ‖γ θ - p.2‖ + ‖p.2‖ := by

        rw [hγ_norm θ] at htri
        dsimp [r_c, r_τ] at htri hp2
        linarith
      let c_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ :=
        fun p θ => (deriv γ θ * (γ θ) ^ K_p) * (γ θ - p.2)⁻¹
      let d_fn_c : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => M_puis ι (p.1, γ θ)

      let c'_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=

      let d'_fn : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=

        fun p θ => c_fn p θ • d'_fn p θ + d_fn_c p θ • c'_fn p θ
      have h2piI_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_pos.ne'))
          Complex.I_ne_zero
      have hB_puis_open : IsOpen B_puis := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hCauchy_rep : ∀ p ∈ B_puis,
          N_puis ι p = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_int p θ := by
        intro p hp
        have hy9 : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) (9 * Br.r_y / 16) :=

        have hc_cont : Continuous (c_fn p) :=

      have hF_fderiv : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ B_puis,

          simp [hπ₂_apply, inv_pow]
        have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun q => c_fn q θ) (c'_fn p θ) p :=
          (hinv.const_mul (deriv γ θ * (γ θ) ^ K_p)).congr_fderiv (smul_smul _ _ π₂)
        have h_in_raw : (p.1, γ θ) ∈ U_punc_raw :=

        have hslice_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => M_puis ι (z, γ θ)) p.1 := by

        have hc_le : ‖c_fn p θ‖ ≤ r_c * r_c ^ K_p * (r_τ_raw / 8)⁻¹ := by

          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, hγ_deriv_norm θ, hγ_norm θ]

        have hc'_le : ‖c'_fn p θ‖ ≤ r_c * r_c ^ K_p * ((r_τ_raw / 8)⁻¹ ^ 2) := by

          rw [norm_smul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, hγ_deriv_norm θ, hγ_norm θ]

          have h1 : r_c * r_c ^ K_p * ‖(γ θ - p.2)⁻¹‖ ^ 2 ≤

        have hp_cir : (p.1, γ θ) ∈ K_cir := ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hp.1, hγ_sphere θ⟩
        have hd_le : ‖d_fn_c p θ‖ ≤ B_M :=

        have hd'_le : ‖d'_fn p θ‖ ≤ B_dM := by

          rw [norm_smul]

          ((hF_cont p₀ hp₀).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          (hF'_cont p₀ hp₀).aestronglyMeasurable
