    Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0})

  
  
  
  
  have hChain_snd : ∀ {U_old O_y O_u : Set _} {E_old F_old E_new F_new : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      {φ : ℂ → ℂ} {y u : ℂ},
      IsOpen U_old → IsOpen O_y → IsOpen O_u → y ∈ O_y → u ∈ O_u →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ φ u →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_old ι) U_old) →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_old ι) U_old) →
      (∀ y' ∈ O_y, ∀ u' ∈ O_u,
        (y', φ u') ∈ U_old ∧
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, E_new ι (y', u') = E_old ι (y', φ u')) ∧
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, F_new ι (y', u') = F_old ι (y', φ u'))) →
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect E_new F_new) (y, u) =
        deriv φ u * homRankOneDet (homIntersect E_old F_old) (y, φ u) ∧
      ∀ ι : Fin 2,
        homReflectRes E_new F_new ι (y, u) = homReflectRes E_old F_old ι (y, φ u) := by
    intro U_old O_y O_u E_old F_old E_new F_new φ y u
      hU_old hOy hOu hy hu hφ hE_holo hF_holo hrel
    have hW_eq : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ y' ∈ O_y, ∀ u' ∈ O_u,
        homIntersect E_new F_new k (y', u') = homIntersect E_old F_old k (y', φ u') := by
      intro k y' hy' u' hu'
      obtain ⟨_, hEe, hFe⟩ := hrel y' hy' u' hu'
      fin_cases k <;> simp [homIntersect, hEe, hFe]
    have hW_old_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (homIntersect E_old F_old k) U_old := by
      intro k
      fin_cases k
      · exact (hF_holo 1).sub (hE_holo 1)
      · exact (hE_holo 0).sub (hF_holo 0)
      · exact ((hE_holo 0).mul (hF_holo 1)).sub ((hE_holo 1).mul (hF_holo 0))
    have h_dy : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (homIntersect E_new F_new k) (y, u) =
          iterDerivYT 1 0 (homIntersect E_old F_old k) (y, φ u) := by
      intro k
      change deriv (fun y' : ℂ => homIntersect E_new F_new k (y', u)) y =
        deriv (fun y' : ℂ => homIntersect E_old F_old k (y', φ u)) y
      exact Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOy.mem_nhds hy) fun y' hy' => hW_eq k y' hy' u hu)
    have h_du : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (homIntersect E_new F_new k) (y, u) =
          iterDerivYT 0 1 (homIntersect E_old F_old k) (y, φ u) * deriv φ u := by
      intro k
      change deriv (fun u' : ℂ => homIntersect E_new F_new k (y, u')) u =
        deriv (fun z : ℂ => homIntersect E_old F_old k (y, z)) (φ u) * deriv φ u
      have hin : (y, φ u) ∈ U_old := (hrel y hy u hu).1
      have hslice_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
          (fun z : ℂ => homIntersect E_old F_old k (y, z)) (φ u) := by
        change DifferentiableAt ℂ
          ((homIntersect E_old F_old k) ∘ (fun z : ℂ => (y, z))) (φ u)
        exact ((hW_old_holo k).differentiableAt (hU_old.mem_nhds hin)).comp (φ u)
          ((differentiableAt_const y).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      have hcomp := hslice_diff.hasDerivAt.comp u hφ.hasDerivAt
      exact (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOu.mem_nhds hu) fun u' hu' => hW_eq k y hy u' hu')).deriv
    have hW_at : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        homIntersect E_new F_new k (y, u) = homIntersect E_old F_old k (y, φ u) :=
      fun k => hW_eq k y hy u hu
    have hE_at : ∀ j : Fin 2, E_new j (y, u) = E_old j (y, φ u) :=
      fun j => (hrel y hy u hu).2.1 j
    have hF_at : ∀ j : Fin 2, F_new j (y, u) = F_old j (y, φ u) :=
      fun j => (hrel y hy u hu).2.2 j
    refine ⟨?_, fun ι => ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [homRankOneDet]
      rw [hW_at 0, hW_at 1, hW_at 2, h_dy 0, h_dy 1, h_dy 2, h_du 0, h_du 1, h_du 2]
      ring
    · dsimp only [homReflectRes, homReflectOut]
      rw [hW_at 0, hW_at 1, hW_at 2, h_dy 0, h_dy 1, h_dy 2,
        hE_at 0, hE_at 1, hE_at ι, hF_at ι]

  have hDom_open : IsOpen (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ (IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const
  have hDualShift_holo_dom : ∀ k : ℤ, |(k : ℝ)| ≤ 1 → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C k ι) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro k hk ι
    have haff : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)) :=
      (differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const _).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
        differentiable_snd
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ
      ((fun w : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C w.1 w.2 ι) ∘
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2, q.2)))
      (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)
    refine (hDet.dualLine_holo ι).comp haff.differentiableOn ?_
    intro q ⟨hq1, hq2, _⟩
    have hq2_im : |q.2.im| ≤ ‖q.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm q.2
    have hmul_im : |((k : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
      have him : ((k : ℂ) * q.2).im = (k : ℝ) * q.2.im := by simp [Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him, abs_mul]
      calc |(k : ℝ)| * |q.2.im| ≤ 1 * ‖q.2‖ :=
            mul_le_mul hk hq2_im (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = ‖q.2‖ := one_mul _
    have hadd_im : |(q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤ |q.1.im| + |((k : ℂ) * q.2).im| := by
      simpa only [Complex.add_im] using abs_add_le q.1.im ((k : ℂ) * q.2).im
    exact ⟨by linarith [W.r_base_lt_s_base, W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos],
      by linarith [W.r_base_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
  have hB_end_sub_dom : B_end ⊆ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx :=
    Set.Subset.trans hB_end_sub_Br Br.bidisk_sub_dom
  have hU_log_maps_dom : ∀ p ∈ U_log, E_exp p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx :=
    fun p hp => Br.bidisk_sub_dom ⟨(hU_log_maps_Br p hp).1, (hU_log_maps_Br p hp).2.1⟩

  let E_log : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => dualLineShift C 0 ι (E_exp p)
  have hE_log_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_log ι) U_log := by
    intro ι
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ ((dualLineShift C 0 ι) ∘ E_exp) U_log
    exact (hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) ι).comp hE_exp_diff.differentiableOn hU_log_maps_dom
  let W_log : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect E_log M_log
  have hW_log_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W_log k) U_log := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (hM_log_holo 1).sub (hE_log_holo 1)
    · exact (hE_log_holo 0).sub (hM_log_holo 0)
    · exact ((hE_log_holo 0).mul (hM_log_holo 1)).sub ((hE_log_holo 1).mul (hM_log_holo 0))
  have hDet_log_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (homRankOneDet W_log) U_log := by
    have hdy : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log k)) U_log :=
      fun k => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hU_log_open (hW_log_holo k) 1 0
    have hdt : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 (W_log k)) U_log :=
      fun k => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hU_log_open (hW_log_holo k) 0 1
    exact (((hW_log_holo 0).mul (((hdy 1).mul (hdt 2)).sub ((hdt 1).mul (hdy 2)))).sub
      ((hW_log_holo 1).mul (((hdy 0).mul (hdt 2)).sub ((hdt 0).mul (hdy 2))))).add
      ((hW_log_holo 2).mul (((hdy 0).mul (hdt 1)).sub ((hdt 0).mul (hdy 1))))
  have hRefl_log_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (homReflectRes E_log M_log ι) U_log := by
    have hdy : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log k)) U_log :=
      fun k => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hU_log_open (hW_log_holo k) 1 0
    have hT0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => W_log 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 0) p -
          W_log 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 2) p) U_log :=
      ((hW_log_holo 2).mul (hdy 0)).sub ((hW_log_holo 0).mul (hdy 2))
    have hT1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => W_log 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 1) p -
          W_log 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 2) p) U_log :=
      ((hW_log_holo 2).mul (hdy 1)).sub ((hW_log_holo 1).mul (hdy 2))
    have hV_holo : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (homReflectOut E_log W_log j) U_log := by
      intro j
      have hN0 := hT1
      have hN1 := hT0.neg
      have hdotLN := ((hE_log_holo 0).mul hN0).add ((hE_log_holo 1).mul hN1)
      have hdotNN := (hN0.mul hN0).add (hN1.mul hN1)
      have hNj : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p => if j = 0 then
            W_log 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 1) p - W_log 1 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 2) p
          else
            -(W_log 2 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 0) p -
              W_log 0 p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_log 2) p)) U_log := by
        fin_cases j
        · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, ↓reduceIte]
          exact hN0
        · have h1_ne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
          simp only [Fin.mk_one, h1_ne, ↓reduceIte]
          exact hN1
      exact (((differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)).mul hdotLN).mul hNj).sub
        (hdotNN.mul (hE_log_holo j))
    intro ι
    exact ((hW_log_holo 2).mul (hV_holo ι)).sub
      ((((hV_holo 0).mul (hW_log_holo 0)).add ((hV_holo 1).mul (hW_log_holo 1))).mul
        (hM_log_holo ι))

  have hDet_end : ∀ p ∈ B_end,
      homRankOneDet (homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) Br.M₁_end) p = 0 :=
    Br.fwd_rank_one B_col.primary_rank_one
  have hRefl_end : ∀ p ∈ B_end, ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      homReflectRes (dualLineShift C 0) Br.M₁_end ι p = 0 :=
    Br.fwd_reflect B_col.primary_reflect
  have hDet_Refl_B_log : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end,
      homRankOneDet W_log p = 0 ∧ ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes E_log M_log ι p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp_prod : p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_log_end ×ˢ Metric.ball w_end r_log_end := by
      rwa [ball_prod_same]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hChain_snd
      (E_old := dualLineShift C 0) (F_old := Br.M₁_end)
      (E_new := E_log) (F_new := M_log)
      Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isOpen_ball
      hp_prod.1 hp_prod.2 (Complex.differentiable_exp p.2)
      (fun ι => (hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) ι).mono hB_end_sub_dom)
      Br.M₁_end_holo
      (fun y' hy' u' hu' => by
        have hq : (y', u') ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end := by
          rw [← ball_prod_same]; exact ⟨hy', hu'⟩
        exact ⟨hexp_maps_end (y', u') hq, fun _ => rfl,
          fun ι => hM_log_eq_end ι (y', u') hq⟩)
    refine ⟨?_, fun ι => ?_⟩
    · rw [h1, hDet_end (E_exp p) (hexp_maps_end p hp), mul_zero]
    · rw [h2 ι, hRefl_end (E_exp p) (hexp_maps_end p hp) ι]
  have hDet_U_log : ∀ p ∈ U_log, homRankOneDet W_log p = 0 :=
    hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_log_open hU_log_preconn
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_log_end, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_log_end_pos⟩
      hB_log_end_sub hDet_log_holo (fun p hp => (hDet_Refl_B_log p hp).1)
  have hRefl_U_log : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_log, homReflectRes E_log M_log ι p = 0 :=
    fun ι => hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_log_open hU_log_preconn
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_log_end, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_log_end_pos⟩
      hB_log_end_sub (hRefl_log_holo ι) (fun p hp => (hDet_Refl_B_log p hp).2 ι)

  have hpuis_rank_one_and_reflect :
      ∀ p ∈ B_puis_punc,
        homRankOneDet (homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis) p = 0 ∧
        ∀ ι : Fin 2, homReflectRes (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis ι p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨O_τ, ℓ, hO_open, hp2_O, hℓ_diff, hℓ_props⟩ := hM_puis_lift p hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hChain_snd
      (E_old := E_log) (F_old := M_log)
      (E_new := puisDualLine0 C d) (F_new := M_puis)
      hU_log_open Metric.isOpen_ball hO_open hp.1 hp2_O hℓ_diff
      hE_log_holo hM_log_holo
      (fun y' hy' ζ hζ => by
        obtain ⟨hU, hexp, hMp⟩ := hℓ_props y' hy' ζ hζ
        refine ⟨hU, fun ι => ?_, hMp⟩
        change dualLineShift C 0 ι (y', ζ ^ d) = dualLineShift C 0 ι (y', Complex.exp (ℓ ζ))
        rw [hexp])
    refine ⟨?_, fun ι => ?_⟩
    · rw [h1, hDet_U_log (p.1, ℓ p.2) (hℓ_props p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp2_O).1, mul_zero]
    · rw [h2 ι, hRefl_U_log ι (p.1, ℓ p.2) (hℓ_props p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp2_O).1]

  
  have hVanish_puis_to_end : ∀ (H : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => H (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p)) U_log →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => H p (Br.M₁_end 0 p) (Br.M₁_end 1 p)) B_end →
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B_puis_punc →
      (∀ q ∈ V, H (q.1, q.2 ^ d) (M_puis 0 q) (M_puis 1 q) = 0) →
      ∀ p ∈ B_end, H p (Br.M₁_end 0 p) (Br.M₁_end 1 p) = 0 := by
    intro H V hf_log_holo hf_end_holo hV_open ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ hV_sub hV_zero
    let Pi_d : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, Complex.exp (p.2 / (d : ℂ)))
    have hPi_d_cont : Continuous Pi_d :=
      continuous_fst.prodMk
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_snd.div_const (d : ℂ)))
    let U_pull : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) r_yp ×ˢ { w : ℂ | w.re < (d : ℝ) * Real.log r_τ }
    let V_log : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_pull ∩ Pi_d ⁻¹' V
    have hV_log_open : IsOpen V_log :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (hHalf_open _)).inter (hV_open.preimage hPi_d_cont)
    have hq₀_punc : q₀ ∈ B_puis_punc := hV_sub hq₀
    let w₀ : ℂ := (d : ℂ) * Complex.log q₀.2
    have hw₀_V_log : (q₀.1, w₀) ∈ V_log := by
      refine ⟨⟨hq₀_punc.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · change ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log q₀.2).re < (d : ℝ) * Real.log r_τ
        have hre : ((d : ℂ) * Complex.log q₀.2).re = (d : ℝ) * Real.log ‖q₀.2‖ := by
          simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.log_re]
        rw [hre]
        have hnorm_lt : ‖q₀.2‖ < r_τ := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hq₀_punc.2.1
        exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
          (Real.log_lt_log (norm_pos_iff.mpr hq₀_punc.2.2) hnorm_lt) hd_pos_R
      · change (q₀.1, Complex.exp (w₀ / (d : ℂ))) ∈ V
        have hdiv : w₀ / (d : ℂ) = Complex.log q₀.2 := mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hd_ne_C
        rw [hdiv, Complex.exp_log hq₀_punc.2.2]
        exact hq₀
    have hV_log_sub : V_log ⊆ U_log :=
      fun p hp => (hpullback_exp_div_d p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.1.2).1
    have hf_log_zero_V : ∀ p ∈ V_log, H (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p) = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨_, _, hpow, hMp⟩ := hpullback_exp_div_d p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.1.2
      have h1 : E_exp p = ((Pi_d p).1, (Pi_d p).2 ^ d) := Prod.ext rfl hpow.symm
      rw [h1, ← hMp 0, ← hMp 1]
      exact hV_zero (Pi_d p) hp.2
    have hf_log_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_log, H (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p) = 0 :=
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_log_open hU_log_preconn
        hV_log_open ⟨(q₀.1, w₀), hw₀_V_log⟩ hV_log_sub hf_log_holo hf_log_zero_V
    let L_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, Complex.log p.2)
    have ht_end_slit : (Br.t_end : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
      Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by simpa using Br.t_end_pos))
    have hL_q_end : L_map q_end = p_log_end :=
      Prod.ext rfl (Complex.ofReal_log Br.t_end_pos.le).symm
    have hL_contAt : ContinuousAt L_map q_end :=
      continuousAt_fst.prodMk
        (ContinuousAt.comp (g := Complex.log) (f := Prod.snd)
          (Complex.differentiableAt_log ht_end_slit).continuousAt continuousAt_snd)
    have h_nhds_end :
        B_end ∩ (Prod.snd ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane) ∩ (L_map ⁻¹' Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end) ∈
          nhds q_end :=
      Filter.inter_mem
        (Filter.inter_mem
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds q_end Br.r_end_pos)
          ((Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage continuous_snd).mem_nhds ht_end_slit))
        (hL_contAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (hL_q_end.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds p_log_end hr_log_end_pos))
    obtain ⟨δ_e, hδ_e_pos, hδ_e_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_end
    have hf_end_zero_ball : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball q_end δ_e,
        H p (Br.M₁_end 0 p) (Br.M₁_end 1 p) = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨⟨_, hp_slit⟩, hp_L⟩ := hδ_e_sub hp
      have hp2_ne : p.2 ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hp_slit
      have hexp_L : E_exp (L_map p) = p := Prod.ext rfl (Complex.exp_log hp2_ne)
      have hM0 : M_log 0 (L_map p) = Br.M₁_end 0 p := by
        have h1 := hM_log_eq_end 0 (L_map p) hp_L
        change M_log 0 (L_map p) = Br.M₁_end 0 (E_exp (L_map p)) at h1
        rwa [hexp_L] at h1
      have hM1 : M_log 1 (L_map p) = Br.M₁_end 1 p := by
        have h1 := hM_log_eq_end 1 (L_map p) hp_L
        change M_log 1 (L_map p) = Br.M₁_end 1 (E_exp (L_map p)) at h1
        rwa [hexp_L] at h1
      rw [← hM0, ← hM1]
      simpa only [hexp_L] using hf_log_zero (L_map p) (hB_log_end_sub hp_L)
    exact hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨q_end, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_e_pos⟩
      (fun p hp => ((hδ_e_sub hp).1).1) hf_end_holo hf_end_zero_ball

  let r_wit : ℝ := min (W.s_base / 2) (W.r_base / 2)
  have hr_wit_pos : 0 < r_wit :=
    lt_min (by positivity [W.s_base_pos]) (by positivity [W.r_base_pos])
  have hr_wit_le_det : r_wit ≤ min (hDet.s_det / 2) (hDet.r_det / 2) :=
    min_le_min (by linarith [W.s_base_le_det]) (by linarith [W.r_base_le_det])
  have hwit_mem_dom : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      |p.1.im| < r_wit → ‖p.2‖ < r_wit → p.2.im = 0 →
        p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx := by
    intro p hp1 hp2 hp2_im
    let S_nat : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs
    have h2J_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((S_nat : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hp1 (min_le_left _ _),
      lt_of_lt_of_le hp2 (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith [W.r_base_pos])), ?_⟩
    rw [hp2_im, abs_zero]
    exact div_pos W.s_base_pos h2J_pos

  have hB_puis_punc_open : IsOpen B_puis_punc :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
  have hB_puis_punc_ne : B_puis_punc.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨((Br.y₀ : ℂ), ((r_τ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self hr_yp_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      linarith
    · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by linarith)

  have hnot_w2_zero :
      ¬ ∀ p ∈ B_puis_punc, homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0 := by
    intro hAll
    let H_w2 : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p z₀ z₁ => dualLineShift C 0 0 p * z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p * z₀
    have hend : ∀ p ∈ B_end, homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) Br.M₁_end 2 p = 0 :=
      hVanish_puis_to_end H_w2 B_puis_punc
        (((hE_log_holo 0).mul (hM_log_holo 1)).sub ((hE_log_holo 1).mul (hM_log_holo 0)))
        ((((hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) 0).mono hB_end_sub_dom).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 1)).sub
          (((hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) 1).mono hB_end_sub_dom).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)))
        hB_puis_punc_open hB_puis_punc_ne Set.Subset.rfl hAll
    have hdom := Br.rev_w2_zero hend
    obtain ⟨p_w, hp1, hp2, hp_im, hp_nz⟩ :=
      B_col.primary_w2_ne_zero r_wit hr_wit_pos hr_wit_le_det
    exact hp_nz (hdom p_w (hwit_mem_dom p_w hp1 hp2 hp_im))

  have hnot_iso_line : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_iso c_star : ℂ),
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B_puis_punc → (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) →
      ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
          homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 0 p +
            s_iso * Complex.I * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 1 p -
            c_star * homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis 2 p = 0 := by
    intro V s_iso c_star hVo hVne hVsub hs_iso hAll
    let H_iso : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z₀ z₁ =>
      (z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p) +
        s_iso * Complex.I * (dualLineShift C 0 0 p - z₀) -
        c_star * (dualLineShift C 0 0 p * z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p * z₀)
    have hL0_end : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C 0 j) B_end :=
      fun j => (hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) j).mono hB_end_sub_dom
    have hend := hVanish_puis_to_end H_iso V
      ((((hM_log_holo 1).sub (hE_log_holo 1)).add
        ((differentiableOn_const (s_iso * Complex.I)).mul
          ((hE_log_holo 0).sub (hM_log_holo 0)))).sub
        ((differentiableOn_const c_star).mul
          (((hE_log_holo 0).mul (hM_log_holo 1)).sub ((hE_log_holo 1).mul (hM_log_holo 0)))))
      ((((Br.M₁_end_holo 1).sub (hL0_end 1)).add
        ((differentiableOn_const (s_iso * Complex.I)).mul
          ((hL0_end 0).sub (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)))).sub
        ((differentiableOn_const c_star).mul
          (((hL0_end 0).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 1)).sub ((hL0_end 1).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)))))
      hVo hVne hVsub hAll
    have hdom := Br.rev_iso_line s_iso c_star hend
    obtain ⟨p_w, hp1, hp2, hp_im, hp_nz⟩ :=
      B_col.primary_not_isotropic_line r_wit s_iso c_star hr_wit_pos hr_wit_le_det hs_iso
    exact hp_nz (hdom p_w (hwit_mem_dom p_w hp1 hp2 hp_im))

  have hnot_prev_eq : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B_puis_punc →
      ¬ ∀ p ∈ V,
          let W₁ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C d) M_puis
          let W₀ : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k q =>
            homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0) k (q.1, q.2 ^ d)
          W₁ 0 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 0 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 ∧
          W₁ 1 p * W₀ 2 p - W₀ 1 p * W₁ 2 p = 0 := by
    intro V hVo hVne hVsub hAll
    let W₀_base : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0)
    have hW₀_dom : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₀_base k) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
      have hm1 := hDualShift_holo_dom (-1) (by norm_num)
      have h0 := hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num)
      intro k
      fin_cases k
      · exact (h0 1).sub (hm1 1)
      · exact (hm1 0).sub (h0 0)
      · exact ((hm1 0).mul (h0 1)).sub ((hm1 1).mul (h0 0))
    have hW₀_log : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => W₀_base k (E_exp p)) U_log := by
      intro k
      change DifferentiableOn ℂ ((W₀_base k) ∘ E_exp) U_log
      exact (hW₀_dom k).comp hE_exp_diff.differentiableOn hU_log_maps_dom
    have hW₀_end : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₀_base k) B_end :=
      fun k => (hW₀_dom k).mono hB_end_sub_dom
    have hL0_end : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C 0 j) B_end :=
      fun j => (hDualShift_holo_dom 0 (by norm_num) j).mono hB_end_sub_dom
    let H_prev0 : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z₀ z₁ =>
      (z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p) * W₀_base 2 p -
        W₀_base 0 p * (dualLineShift C 0 0 p * z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p * z₀)
    let H_prev1 : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z₀ z₁ =>
      (dualLineShift C 0 0 p - z₀) * W₀_base 2 p -
        W₀_base 1 p * (dualLineShift C 0 0 p * z₁ - dualLineShift C 0 1 p * z₀)
    have hend0 := hVanish_puis_to_end H_prev0 V
      ((((hM_log_holo 1).sub (hE_log_holo 1)).mul (hW₀_log 2)).sub
        ((hW₀_log 0).mul (((hE_log_holo 0).mul (hM_log_holo 1)).sub
          ((hE_log_holo 1).mul (hM_log_holo 0)))))
      ((((Br.M₁_end_holo 1).sub (hL0_end 1)).mul (hW₀_end 2)).sub
        ((hW₀_end 0).mul (((hL0_end 0).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 1)).sub
          ((hL0_end 1).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)))))
      hVo hVne hVsub (fun q hq => (hAll q hq).1)
    have hend1 := hVanish_puis_to_end H_prev1 V
      ((((hE_log_holo 0).sub (hM_log_holo 0)).mul (hW₀_log 2)).sub
        ((hW₀_log 1).mul (((hE_log_holo 0).mul (hM_log_holo 1)).sub
          ((hE_log_holo 1).mul (hM_log_holo 0)))))
      ((((hL0_end 0).sub (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)).mul (hW₀_end 2)).sub
        ((hW₀_end 1).mul (((hL0_end 0).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 1)).sub
          ((hL0_end 1).mul (Br.M₁_end_holo 0)))))
      hVo hVne hVsub (fun q hq => (hAll q hq).2)
    have hdom := Br.rev_prev_eq (fun p hp => ⟨hend0 p hp, hend1 p hp⟩)
    obtain ⟨p_w, hp1, hp2, hp_im, hp_or⟩ :=
      B_col.primary_step_distinct r_wit hr_wit_pos hr_wit_le_det
    obtain ⟨h0_z, h1_z⟩ := hdom p_w (hwit_mem_dom p_w hp1 hp2 hp_im)
    exact hp_or.elim (fun hne => hne h0_z) (fun hne => hne h1_z)

  have hnot_primary : ∀ (V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsOpen V → V.Nonempty → V ⊆ B_puis_punc →
      ¬ ∀ p ∈ V, ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι p = dualLineShift C 1 ι (p.1, p.2 ^ d) := by
    intro V hVo hVne hVsub hAll
    obtain ⟨ι_def, p_def, hp_def, hne_def⟩ := Br.M₁_ne_primary
    let H_pr : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z₀ z₁ =>
      (if ι_def = 0 then z₀ else z₁) - dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p
    have hsel_log : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => if ι_def = 0 then M_log 0 p else M_log 1 p) U_log := by
      fin_cases ι_def
      · simpa only [Fin.zero_eta, ↓reduceIte] using hM_log_holo 0
      · have h1_ne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
        simpa only [Fin.mk_one, h1_ne, ↓reduceIte] using hM_log_holo 1
    have hsel_end : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => if ι_def = 0 then Br.M₁_end 0 p else Br.M₁_end 1 p) B_end := by
      fin_cases ι_def
      · simpa only [Fin.zero_eta, ↓reduceIte] using Br.M₁_end_holo 0
      · have h1_ne : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 := by decide
        simpa only [Fin.mk_one, h1_ne, ↓reduceIte] using Br.M₁_end_holo 1
    have hL1_log : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => dualLineShift C 1 ι_def (E_exp p)) U_log := by
      change DifferentiableOn ℂ ((dualLineShift C 1 ι_def) ∘ E_exp) U_log
      exact (hDualShift_holo_dom 1 (by norm_num) ι_def).comp hE_exp_diff.differentiableOn
        hU_log_maps_dom
    have hL1_end : DifferentiableOn ℂ (dualLineShift C 1 ι_def) B_end :=
      (hDualShift_holo_dom 1 (by norm_num) ι_def).mono hB_end_sub_dom
    have hend := hVanish_puis_to_end H_pr V
      (hsel_log.sub hL1_log) (hsel_end.sub hL1_end) hVo hVne hVsub
      (fun q hq => by
        dsimp [H_pr]
        fin_cases ι_def <;> simp [hAll q hq])
    have h_at := hend p_def hp_def
    dsimp [H_pr] at h_at
    fin_cases ι_def <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, ↓reduceIte, sub_eq_zero] at h_at hne_def <;>
      exact hne_def h_at

  
  have hEval_holo : ∀ (M : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) P)
        (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
    intro M
    let S_nat : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup fun a : Fin N_idx => (q_idx a).natAbs
    let J_bound : ℝ := (S_nat : ℝ) + 2
    have h2J_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * J_bound := by dsimp [J_bound]; positivity
    have hJet_holo : ∀ v : SymJetVar N_idx M,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => symJetEnv C q_idx M q v)
          (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
      intro v
      have hAff_diff : Differentiable ℂ
          (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2, r.2)) :=
        (differentiable_fst.add ((differentiable_const _).mul differentiable_snd)).prodMk
          differentiable_snd
      have hAff_maps : Set.MapsTo
          (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2, r.2))
          (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)
          { w : ℂ × ℂ | |w.1.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det ∧ ‖w.2‖ < 2 * hDet.r_det } := by
        intro q ⟨hq1, hq2, hq3⟩
        have ha_nat : (q_idx v.1).natAbs ≤ S_nat :=
          Finset.le_sup (f := fun b : Fin N_idx => (q_idx b).natAbs) (Finset.mem_univ v.1)
        have ha_cast : (((q_idx v.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (S_nat : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr ha_nat
        have ha_abs : |(q_idx v.1 : ℝ)| = (((q_idx v.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          rcases Int.natAbs_eq (q_idx v.1) with h | h
          · have hR := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) h
            rw [Int.cast_natCast] at hR
            rw [hR, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
          · have hR := congrArg (Int.cast (R := ℝ)) h
            rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] at hR
            rw [hR, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
        have ha_le_J : |(q_idx v.1 : ℝ)| ≤ J_bound := by
          dsimp [J_bound]; linarith
        have hq3_mul : |q.2.im| * (2 * J_bound) < W.s_base :=
          (lt_div_iff₀ h2J_pos).mp hq3
        have hqa_im : |((q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * q.2).im| < W.s_base / 2 := by
          have him_eq : ((q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * q.2).im = (q_idx v.1 : ℝ) * q.2.im := by
            simp [Complex.mul_im]
          rw [him_eq, abs_mul]
          have h1 : |(q_idx v.1 : ℝ)| * |q.2.im| ≤ J_bound * |q.2.im| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha_le_J (abs_nonneg _)
          linarith
        have h_add : |(q.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * q.2).im| ≤
            |q.1.im| + |((q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * q.2).im| := by
          simpa only [Complex.add_im] using abs_add_le q.1.im ((q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * q.2).im
        exact ⟨by linarith [W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos],
          by linarith [W.r_base_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos]⟩
      have hShift_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2) r.2 v.2.1)
          (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) := by
        change DifferentiableOn ℂ
          ((fun w : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C w.1 w.2 v.2.1) ∘
            (fun r : ℂ × ℂ => (r.1 + (q_idx v.1 : ℂ) * r.2, r.2)))
          (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)
        exact (hDet.dualLine_holo v.2.1).comp hAff_diff.differentiableOn hAff_maps
      exact hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hDom_open hShift_holo v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
    intro P
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun Q_p => DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) Q_p)
        (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx))
      P
      (fun c => by
        simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_C] using
          (differentiableOn_const c :
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => c) (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx)))
      (fun P₁ P₂ ih₁ ih₂ => by
        have hfn :
            (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) (P₁ + P₂)) =
              (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) P₁ +
                MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) P₂) := by
          ext q; exact map_add _ P₁ P₂
        rw [hfn]; exact ih₁.add ih₂)
      (fun P₁ v ih => by
        have hfn :
            (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) (P₁ * MvPolynomial.X v)) =
              (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M q) P₁ *
                symJetEnv C q_idx M q v) := by
          ext q; simp only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
        rw [hfn]; exact ih.mul (hJet_holo v))

  have hPolySum_holo : ∀ {U_s : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {φ_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ} {g_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
      (M D : ℕ) (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ φ_map U_s →
      Set.MapsTo φ_map U_s (symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g_fn U_s →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q => ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg) *
            (g_fn q) ^ (deg : ℕ)) U_s := by
    intro U_s φ_map g_fn M D P_coeff hφ_holo hφ_maps hg_holo
    have h_fin : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (D + 1)),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q => ∑ deg ∈ s,
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg) *
              (g_fn q) ^ (deg : ℕ)) U_s := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        have h0 :
            (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => ∑ deg ∈ (∅ : Finset (Fin (D + 1))),
              MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg) *
                (g_fn q) ^ (deg : ℕ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
          ext q; exact Finset.sum_empty
        rw [h0]; exact differentiableOn_const 0
      | @insert deg s hdeg ih =>
        have hev_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg)) U_s := by
          change DifferentiableOn ℂ
            ((fun w => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M w) (P_coeff deg)) ∘ φ_map) U_s
          exact (hEval_holo M (P_coeff deg)).comp hφ_holo hφ_maps
        have hterm : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun q => MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg) *
              (g_fn q) ^ (deg : ℕ)) U_s :=
          hev_comp.mul (hg_holo.pow (deg : ℕ))
        have hfn :
            (fun q => ∑ j ∈ insert deg s,
              MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff j) *
                (g_fn q) ^ (j : ℕ)) =
            (fun q =>
              MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff deg) *
                (g_fn q) ^ (deg : ℕ) +
              ∑ j ∈ s,
                MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (φ_map q)) (P_coeff j) *
                  (g_fn q) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
          ext q; exact Finset.sum_insert hdeg
        rw [hfn]; exact hterm.add ih
    exact h_fin Finset.univ

  have hpuis_poly_transfer : ∀ (y_m t_m r_m : ℝ) (M_cand : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < t_m → 0 < r_m →
      Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ⊆ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx →
      (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_cand ι) (Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m)) →
      (∃ V_τ : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen V_τ ∧ V_τ.Nonempty ∧ V_τ ⊆ B_puis_punc ∧
        (∀ q ∈ V_τ, (q.1, q.2 ^ d) ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m ∧
          ∀ ι : Fin 2, M_puis ι q = M_cand ι (q.1, q.2 ^ d))) →
      ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
        (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
        (∀ p ∈ B_end,
          ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
              (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0) ↔
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m,
          ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
              (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0) := by
    intro y_m t_m r_m M_cand _ hr_m_pos hBm_sub hMcand_holo
      ⟨V_τ, hVτ_open, hVτ_ne, hVτ_sub, hVτ_cand⟩ M D ι_star P_coeff
    let B_m : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball ((y_m : ℂ), (t_m : ℂ)) r_m
    let H_poly : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p z₀ z₁ =>
      ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
        MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
          (if ι_star = 0 then z₀ else z₁) ^ (deg : ℕ)
    have hsel_eq : ∀ (F_fn : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
        (if ι_star = 0 then F_fn 0 q else F_fn 1 q) = F_fn ι_star q := by
      intro F_fn q; fin_cases ι_star <;> rfl
    have hf_log_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => H_poly (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p)) U_log := by
      have hfn : (fun p => H_poly (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p)) =
          (fun p => ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (E_exp p)) (P_coeff deg) *
              (M_log ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ)) := by
        ext p; dsimp [H_poly]; rw [hsel_eq]
      rw [hfn]
      exact hPolySum_holo M D P_coeff hE_exp_diff.differentiableOn hU_log_maps_dom
        (hM_log_holo ι_star)
    have hf_end_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => H_poly p (Br.M₁_end 0 p) (Br.M₁_end 1 p)) B_end := by
      have hfn : (fun p => H_poly p (Br.M₁_end 0 p) (Br.M₁_end 1 p)) =
          (fun p => ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
              (Br.M₁_end ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ)) := by
        ext p; dsimp [H_poly]; rw [hsel_eq]
      rw [hfn]
      exact hPolySum_holo M D P_coeff differentiableOn_id hB_end_sub_dom
        (Br.M₁_end_holo ι_star)
    have hf_cand_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
            (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ)) B_m :=
      hPolySum_holo M D P_coeff differentiableOn_id hBm_sub (hMcand_holo ι_star)
    constructor
    · intro hEnd
      have hf_log_zero_B : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_log_end r_log_end,
          H_poly (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p) = 0 := by
        intro p hp
        dsimp [H_poly]
        rw [hsel_eq, hM_log_eq_end ι_star p hp]
        exact hEnd (E_exp p) (hexp_maps_end p hp)
      have hf_log_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_log, H_poly (E_exp p) (M_log 0 p) (M_log 1 p) = 0 :=
        hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hU_log_open hU_log_preconn
          Metric.isOpen_ball ⟨p_log_end, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_log_end_pos⟩
          hB_log_end_sub hf_log_holo hf_log_zero_B
      have hf_puis_zero : ∀ q ∈ B_puis_punc,
          ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M (q.1, q.2 ^ d)) (P_coeff deg) *
              (M_puis ι_star q) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0 := by
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨hq_log, hq_exp, hq_Mp⟩ := hM_puis_def q hq
        have h0 := hf_log_zero (q.1, (d : ℂ) * Complex.log q.2) hq_log
        dsimp [H_poly, E_exp] at h0
        rw [hsel_eq, hq_exp, ← hq_Mp ι_star] at h0
        exact h0
      obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀_V⟩ := hVτ_ne
      have hq₀_punc : q₀ ∈ B_puis_punc := hVτ_sub hq₀_V
      let τ'₀ : ℂ := q₀.2
      have hτ'₀_ne : τ'₀ ≠ 0 := hq₀_punc.2.2
      let t'₀ : ℂ := τ'₀ ^ d
      have ht'₀_ne : t'₀ ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero d hτ'₀_ne
      let p'₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (q₀.1, t'₀)
      have hp'₀_Bm : p'₀ ∈ B_m := (hVτ_cand q₀ hq₀_V).1
      let ℓ_root : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun t => τ'₀ * Complex.exp (Complex.log (t / t'₀) / (d : ℂ))
      have hℓ_at_t'₀ : ℓ_root t'₀ = τ'₀ := by
        dsimp [ℓ_root]
        rw [div_self ht'₀_ne, Complex.log_one, zero_div, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
      have hdiv_slit : t'₀ / t'₀ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
        rw [div_self ht'₀_ne]; exact Complex.one_mem_slitPlane
      have hlog_div_contAt : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℂ => Complex.log (t / t'₀)) t'₀ :=
        ContinuousAt.comp (g := Complex.log) (f := fun t : ℂ => t / t'₀)
          (Complex.differentiableAt_log hdiv_slit).continuousAt
          (continuousAt_id.div_const t'₀)
      have hexp_div_contAt :
          ContinuousAt (fun t : ℂ => Complex.exp (Complex.log (t / t'₀) / (d : ℂ))) t'₀ :=
        ContinuousAt.comp (g := Complex.exp)
          (f := fun t : ℂ => Complex.log (t / t'₀) / (d : ℂ))
          Complex.continuous_exp.continuousAt (hlog_div_contAt.div_const (d : ℂ))
      have hℓ_contAt : ContinuousAt ℓ_root t'₀ :=
        continuousAt_const.mul hexp_div_contAt
      let Φ_sec : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, ℓ_root p.2)
      have hΦ_at_p'₀ : Φ_sec p'₀ = q₀ := Prod.ext rfl hℓ_at_t'₀
      have hΦ_contAt : ContinuousAt Φ_sec p'₀ :=
        continuousAt_fst.prodMk
          (ContinuousAt.comp (g := ℓ_root) (f := Prod.snd) hℓ_contAt continuousAt_snd)
      have hdiv2_open : IsOpen ((fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 / t'₀) ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane) :=
        Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage (continuous_snd.div_const t'₀)
      have h_nhds_m :
          B_m ∩ ((fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 / t'₀) ⁻¹' Complex.slitPlane) ∩ (Φ_sec ⁻¹' V_τ) ∈
            nhds p'₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem
          (Filter.inter_mem
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp'₀_Bm)
            (hdiv2_open.mem_nhds hdiv_slit))
          (hΦ_contAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hΦ_at_p'₀.symm ▸ hVτ_open.mem_nhds hq₀_V))
      obtain ⟨δ_m, hδ_m_pos, hδ_m_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_m
      have hf_cand_ball : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p'₀ δ_m,
          ∑ deg : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (symJetEnv C q_idx M p) (P_coeff deg) *
              (M_cand ι_star p) ^ (deg : ℕ) = 0 := by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨⟨_, hp_slit⟩, hp_Φ⟩ := hδ_m_sub hp
        have hdiv_ne : p.2 / t'₀ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hp_slit
        have hℓ_pow : (ℓ_root p.2) ^ d = p.2 := by
          dsimp [ℓ_root]
          rw [mul_pow, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd_ne_C,
            Complex.exp_log hdiv_ne]
          dsimp [t'₀]
          exact mul_div_cancel₀ p.2 ht'₀_ne
        have hΦ_pow : ((Φ_sec p).1, (Φ_sec p).2 ^ d) = p := Prod.ext rfl hℓ_pow
        have hcand_eq : M_cand ι_star p = M_puis ι_star (Φ_sec p) := by
          have h1 := (hVτ_cand (Φ_sec p) hp_Φ).2 ι_star
          rw [hΦ_pow] at h1
          exact h1.symm
        rw [hcand_eq]
        simpa only [hΦ_pow] using hf_puis_zero (Φ_sec p) (hVτ_sub hp_Φ)
      exact hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D Metric.isOpen_ball
        (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball
        ⟨p'₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_m_pos⟩
        (fun p hp => ((hδ_m_sub hp).1).1) hf_cand_holo hf_cand_ball
    · intro hCand
      have hEnd := hVanish_puis_to_end H_poly V_τ hf_log_holo hf_end_holo
        hVτ_open hVτ_ne hVτ_sub
        (fun q hq => by
          dsimp [H_poly]
          rw [hsel_eq, (hVτ_cand q hq).2 ι_star]
          exact hCand (q.1, q.2 ^ d) (hVτ_cand q hq).1)
      intro p hp
      have h0 := hEnd p hp
      dsimp [H_poly] at h0
      rwa [hsel_eq] at h0

  
  
  
  exact ⟨{
    d := d
    d_pos := hd_pos
    r_yp := r_yp
    r_τ := r_τ
    K_p := K_p
    r_yp_pos := hr_yp_pos
    r_yp_le := hr_yp_le
    r_τ_pos := hr_τ_pos
    r_τ_pow_lt := hr_τ_pow_lt
    M_puis := M_puis
    N_puis := N_puis
    M_puis_holo := hM_puis_holo
    N_puis_holo := hN_puis_holo
    N_puis_eq := hN_puis_eq
    puis_rank_one := fun p hp => (hpuis_rank_one_and_reflect p hp).1
    puis_reflect := fun p hp => (hpuis_rank_one_and_reflect p hp).2
    not_w2_zero := hnot_w2_zero
    not_iso_line := hnot_iso_line
    not_prev_eq := hnot_prev_eq
    not_primary := hnot_primary
    puis_poly_transfer := hpuis_poly_transfer
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have h_tau_extract :
      ∀ (y_c : ℂ) (r_y r_τ : ℝ), 0 < r_y → 0 < r_τ →
        ∀ (K : ℕ) (F : Fin K → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ k : Fin K, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F k) (Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)) →
          (∃ k_nz : Fin K, ∃ p_star ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
            F k_nz p_star ≠ 0) →
          ∃ (m : ℕ) (F_div : Fin K → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
            (∀ k : Fin K,
              DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_div k) (Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)) ∧
            (∀ k : Fin K, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
              F k p = p.2 ^ m * F_div k p) ∧
            (∃ k₀ : Fin K, ∃ y₀ ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y, F_div k₀ (y₀, 0) ≠ 0) := by
    intro y_c r_y r_τ hr_y hr_τ K F hF_holo hF_nz
    let U_y : Set ℂ := Metric.ball y_c r_y
    let B : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ
    have hB_open : IsOpen B := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.fst, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap := { toFun := Prod.snd, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    have hπ₁_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₁ q = q.1 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₂_apply : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, π₂ q = q.2 := fun _ => rfl
    have hπ₁_norm : ‖π₁‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₁ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₁_apply] using norm_fst_le q)
    have hπ₂_norm : ‖π₂‖ ≤ 1 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound π₂ zero_le_one
        (fun q => by simpa [hπ₂_apply] using norm_snd_le q)
    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g B → ∀ q ∈ B,
        HasFDerivAt g (pderivA g q • π₁ + pderivD g q • π₂) q := by
      intro g hg q hq
      have hL : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q :=
        (hg.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
      have hinj1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) (1, 0) q.1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const q.1 q.2)
      have hinj2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (q.1, w)) (0, 1) q.2 :=
        (hasDerivAt_const q.2 q.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id q.2)
      have hpA : pderivA g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (1, 0) := (hL.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hinj1).deriv
      have hpD : pderivD g q = (fderiv ℂ g q) (0, 1) := (hL.comp_hasDerivAt q.2 hinj2).deriv
      refine hL.congr_fderiv ?_
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨u, v⟩ => ?_
      have huv : (u, v) = u • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;> (change _ = u * _ + v * _; ring)
      conv_lhs => rw [huv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
      rw [← hpA, ← hpD]
      change u * pderivA g q + v * pderivD g q = pderivA g q * u + pderivD g q * v
      ring
    have hparam_int01_holo : ∀ (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (r B_bnd : ℝ), 0 < r →
        ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ) (Φ' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)),
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, g p = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Φ p s) →
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ContinuousOn (Φ p) (Set.Icc 0 1)) →
        ContinuousOn (Φ' p₀) (Set.Icc 0 1) →
        (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, ‖Φ' p s‖ ≤ B_bnd) →
        (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r, HasFDerivAt (fun q => Φ q s) (Φ' p s) p) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      intro p₀ r B_bnd hr g Φ Φ' hrep hcont hcont' hbnd hfderiv
      have huIoc : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Ioc 0 1 := Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one
      have hint : HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Φ p s)
          (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, Φ' p₀ s) p₀ :=
        intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℂ)
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr)
          (by filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr] with p hp
              rw [huIoc]
              exact ((hcont p hp).mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc)
          ((hcont p₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
          (by rw [huIoc]
              exact (hcont'.mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioc)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs p hp =>
            hbnd s (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self (huIoc ▸ hs)) p hp)
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs p hp =>
            hfderiv s (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self (huIoc ▸ hs)) p hp)
      exact hint.differentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr) hrep)
    let divTauStep : (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :=
      fun g p => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, pderivD g (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)
    have hstep_holo : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g B → DifferentiableOn ℂ (divTauStep g) B := by
      intro g hg p₀ hp₀
      apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      let h : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := pderivD g
      have hh : DifferentiableOn ℂ h B := (hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open hg).2
      obtain ⟨hhA, hhD⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open hh
      have hy₀ : dist p₀.1 y_c < r_y := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp₀.1
      have hτ₀ : ‖p₀.2‖ < r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp₀.2
      let r : ℝ := min ((r_y - dist p₀.1 y_c) / 2) ((r_τ - ‖p₀.2‖) / 2)
      have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hr_y_le : r ≤ (r_y - dist p₀.1 y_c) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      have hr_τ_le : r ≤ (r_τ - ‖p₀.2‖) / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      let R_τ : ℝ := ‖p₀.2‖ + r
      have hR_τ_lt : R_τ < r_τ := by dsimp [R_τ]; linarith
      let K_box : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall p₀.1 r ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_τ
      have hK_compact : IsCompact K_box :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall p₀.1 r).prod
          (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_τ)
      have hK_sub : K_box ⊆ B := by
        intro q hq
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_⟩
        · have hq1 : dist q.1 p₀.1 ≤ r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.1
          linarith [dist_triangle q.1 p₀.1 y_c]
        · have hq2 : dist q.2 0 ≤ R_τ := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq.2
          linarith
      obtain ⟨M_A0, hM_A0⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hhA.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      obtain ⟨M_D0, hM_D0⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hhD.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      let M_A : ℝ := max M_A0 0
      let M_D : ℝ := max M_D0 0
      have hM_A_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_A := le_max_right _ _
      have hM_D_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_D := le_max_right _ _
      let B_bnd : ℝ := M_A + M_D
      have hscale_mem : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r,
          (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) ∈ K_box := by
        intro s hs p hp
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp
        refine ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (le_of_lt hp.1), ?_⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
        have hp2_norm : ‖p.2‖ ≤ R_τ := by
          have htri : ‖p.2‖ ≤ ‖p.2 - p₀.2‖ + ‖p₀.2‖ := by
            simpa using norm_add_le (p.2 - p₀.2) p₀.2
          have hd : ‖p.2 - p₀.2‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hp.2
          dsimp [R_τ]; linarith
        calc s * ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1 * R_τ := mul_le_mul hs.2 hp2_norm (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = R_τ := one_mul R_τ
      let L_s : ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ)) := fun s =>
        { toLinearMap :=
            { toFun := fun q => (q.1, (s : ℂ) * q.2)
              map_add' := fun q₁ q₂ => Prod.ext rfl (mul_add (s : ℂ) q₁.2 q₂.2)
              map_smul' := fun c q => Prod.ext rfl (by
                change (s : ℂ) * (c * q.2) = c * ((s : ℂ) * q.2); ring) }
          cont := continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd) }
      let Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p s => h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)
      let Φ' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun p s =>
        pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) • π₁ + ((s : ℂ) * pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) • π₂
      refine hparam_int01_holo p₀ r B_bnd hr (divTauStep g) Φ Φ' (fun _ _ => rfl) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro p hp
        have hpath : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) :=
          continuous_const.prodMk (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
        exact hh.continuousOn.comp hpath.continuousOn (fun s hs => hK_sub (hscale_mem s hs p hp))
      · have hp₀_mem : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
        have hpath : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (p₀.1, (s : ℂ) * p₀.2)) :=
          continuous_const.prodMk (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
        have hcA : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => pderivA h (p₀.1, (s : ℂ) * p₀.2)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
          hhA.continuousOn.comp hpath.continuousOn (fun s hs => hK_sub (hscale_mem s hs p₀ hp₀_mem))
        have hcD : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ) * pderivD h (p₀.1, (s : ℂ) * p₀.2))
            (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul
            (hhD.continuousOn.comp hpath.continuousOn
              (fun s hs => hK_sub (hscale_mem s hs p₀ hp₀_mem)))
        exact (hcA.smul continuousOn_const).add (hcD.smul continuousOn_const)
      · intro s hs p hp
        have hqK : (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) ∈ K_box := hscale_mem s hs p hp
        have hbA : ‖pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)‖ ≤ M_A :=
          (hM_A0 _ hqK).trans (le_max_left _ _)
        have hbD : ‖pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)‖ ≤ M_D :=
          (hM_D0 _ hqK).trans (le_max_left _ _)
        have hs_abs : ‖(s : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
          exact hs.2
        calc ‖Φ' p s‖
            ≤ ‖pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) • π₁‖ +
                ‖((s : ℂ) * pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) • π₂‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)‖ * ‖π₁‖ +
                (‖(s : ℂ)‖ * ‖pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)‖) * ‖π₂‖ := by
                rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ M_A * 1 + (1 * M_D) * 1 := by gcongr
          _ = B_bnd := by dsimp [B_bnd]; ring
      · intro s hs p hp
        have hqB : (L_s s) p ∈ B := hK_sub (hscale_mem s hs p hp)
        have hh_fd := (hfderiv_decomp hh ((L_s s) p) hqB).comp p (L_s s).hasFDerivAt
        refine hh_fd.congr_fderiv ?_
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun ⟨u, v⟩ => ?_
        change pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) * u + pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) * ((s : ℂ) * v) =
          pderivA h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) * u + ((s : ℂ) * pderivD h (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) * v
        ring
    have hstep_ftc : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}, DifferentiableOn ℂ g B →
        (∀ y ∈ U_y, g (y, 0) = 0) → ∀ p ∈ B, g p = p.2 * divTauStep g p := by
      intro g hg hg0 p hp
      have hpD_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivD g) B := (hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open hg).2
      let φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => g (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)
      let φ' : ℝ → ℂ := fun s => p.2 * pderivD g (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)
      have hmem_seg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) ∈ B := by
        intro s hs
        refine ⟨hp.1, ?_⟩
        have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
        calc s * ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1 * ‖p.2‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs.2 (norm_nonneg _)
          _ < r_τ := by linarith
      have huIcc : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Icc 0 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one
      have hderiv_seg : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt φ (φ' s) s := by
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := huIcc ▸ hs
        have hqs : (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2) ∈ B := hmem_seg s hs'
        have hslice : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => g (p.1, w)) ((s : ℂ) * p.2) :=
          (hg.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hqs)).comp ((s : ℂ) * p.2)
            ((differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
        have hw : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g (p.1, w))
            (pderivD g (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) ((s : ℂ) * p.2) :=
          hslice.hasDerivAt
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * p.2) p.2 s := by
          simpa using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := s)).mul_const p.2
        simpa [φ, φ', Function.comp_def, smul_eq_mul] using hw.scomp s hlin
      have hφ'_cont : ContinuousOn φ' (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
        have hpath : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (p.1, (s : ℂ) * p.2)) :=
          continuous_const.prodMk (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
        exact continuousOn_const.mul (hpD_holo.continuousOn.comp hpath.continuousOn hmem_seg)
      have hint_eq := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv_seg
        (hφ'_cont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one)
      have h1 : φ 1 = g p := by dsimp [φ]; simp
      have h0 : φ 0 = 0 := by dsimp [φ]; simp [hg0 p.1 hp.1]
      rw [h1, h0, sub_zero] at hint_eq
      dsimp only [φ', divTauStep] at hint_eq ⊢
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hint_eq
      exact hint_eq.symm
    let divTauSeq : (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) := fun g n => (divTauStep^[n]) g
    have hseq_holo : ∀ (k : Fin K) (n : ℕ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (divTauSeq (F k) n) B := by
      intro k n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact hF_holo k
      | succ n ih =>
        dsimp only [divTauSeq]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        exact hstep_holo ih
    have hseq_factor : ∀ (k : Fin K) (n : ℕ),
        (∀ j < n, ∀ y ∈ U_y, divTauSeq (F k) j (y, 0) = 0) →
        ∀ p ∈ B, F k p = p.2 ^ n * divTauSeq (F k) n p := by
      intro k n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro _ p _; simp [divTauSeq]
      | succ n ih =>
        intro hzero p hp
        have hprev := ih (fun j hj => hzero j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)) p hp
        have hstep_n : divTauSeq (F k) n p = p.2 * divTauSeq (F k) (n + 1) p := by
          dsimp only [divTauSeq]
          rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
          exact hstep_ftc (hseq_holo k n) (hzero n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) p hp
        rw [hprev, hstep_n]
        ring
    have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ k : Fin K, ∃ y ∈ U_y, divTauSeq (F k) n (y, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hAllZero
      have hAllZero' : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Fin K), ∀ y ∈ U_y, divTauSeq (F k) n (y, 0) = 0 :=
        fun n k y hy => by_contra fun hne => hAllZero ⟨n, k, y, hy, hne⟩
      obtain ⟨k_nz, p_star, hp_star, hp_star_nz⟩ := hF_nz
      have hy_star : p_star.1 ∈ U_y := hp_star.1
      have hτ_star : ‖p_star.2‖ < r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp_star.2
      let R : ℝ := (‖p_star.2‖ + r_τ) / 2
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; linarith [norm_nonneg p_star.2]
      have hτ_lt_R : ‖p_star.2‖ < R := by dsimp [R]; linarith
      have hR_lt_rτ : R < r_τ := by dsimp [R]; linarith
      have hcl_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR_lt_rτ
      have hsliceF_cont :
          ContinuousOn (fun ζ : ℂ => F k_nz (p_star.1, ζ)) (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        have hemb : Continuous (fun ζ : ℂ => (p_star.1, ζ)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
        exact (hF_holo k_nz).continuousOn.comp hemb.continuousOn (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hy_star, hcl_sub hζ⟩)
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hsliceF_cont
      let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hbound_n : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖F k_nz p_star‖ ≤ M * (‖p_star.2‖ / R) ^ n := by
        intro n
        let q_n : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => divTauSeq (F k_nz) n (p_star.1, ζ)
        have hq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q_n (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ) := by
          have hemb : Differentiable ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => (p_star.1, ζ)) :=
            (differentiable_const p_star.1).prodMk differentiable_id
          exact (hseq_holo k_nz n).comp hemb.differentiableOn (fun ζ hζ => ⟨hy_star, hζ⟩)
        have hdcc : DiffContOnCl ℂ q_n (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) := hq_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcl_sub
        have hfront : ∀ ζ ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R), ‖q_n ζ‖ ≤ M / R ^ n := by
          intro ζ hζ
          rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hR_pos.ne'] at hζ
          have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = R := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hζ
          have hζ_cl : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ
          have hζ_B : (p_star.1, ζ) ∈ B := ⟨hy_star, hcl_sub hζ_cl⟩
          have hfac := hseq_factor k_nz n (fun j _ y hy => hAllZero' j k_nz y hy) (p_star.1, ζ) hζ_B
          have hnorm_eq : R ^ n * ‖q_n ζ‖ = ‖F k_nz (p_star.1, ζ)‖ := by
            calc R ^ n * ‖q_n ζ‖ = ‖ζ‖ ^ n * ‖q_n ζ‖ := by rw [hζ_norm]
              _ = ‖ζ ^ n * q_n ζ‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
              _ = ‖F k_nz (p_star.1, ζ)‖ := by rw [← hfac]
          have hle_M : ‖F k_nz (p_star.1, ζ)‖ ≤ M := (hM₀ ζ hζ_cl).trans (le_max_left _ _)
          rw [le_div_iff₀' (pow_pos hR_pos n), hnorm_eq]
          exact hle_M
        have hτ_cl : p_star.2 ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
          subset_closure (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hτ_lt_R)
        have hq_star : ‖q_n p_star.2‖ ≤ M / R ^ n :=
          Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hdcc hfront hτ_cl
        have hfac_star := hseq_factor k_nz n (fun j _ y hy => hAllZero' j k_nz y hy) p_star hp_star
        calc ‖F k_nz p_star‖
            = ‖p_star.2 ^ n * q_n p_star.2‖ := by rw [← hfac_star]
          _ = ‖p_star.2‖ ^ n * ‖q_n p_star.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
          _ ≤ ‖p_star.2‖ ^ n * (M / R ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_star (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) n)
          _ = M * (‖p_star.2‖ / R) ^ n := by
              rw [div_pow ‖p_star.2‖ R n, mul_div_left_comm]
      have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖p_star.2‖ / R := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hR_pos.le
      have hr_lt_one : ‖p_star.2‖ / R < 1 := (div_lt_one hR_pos).mpr hτ_lt_R
      have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => M * (‖p_star.2‖ / R) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt_one)
      have hle0 : ‖F k_nz p_star‖ ≤ 0 :=
        ge_of_tendsto htend (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound_n)
      exact not_lt_of_ge hle0 (norm_pos_iff.mpr hp_star_nz)
    let m : ℕ := Nat.find hex
    refine ⟨m, fun k => divTauSeq (F k) m, fun k => hseq_holo k m, ?_, Nat.find_spec hex⟩
    intro k p hp
    exact hseq_factor k m (fun j hj y hy => by
      by_contra hne
      exact Nat.find_min hex hj ⟨k, y, hy, hne⟩) p hp

  
  have h_wronsk_scale :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ (ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (F G_fn : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ U →
        (∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F k) U) →
        (∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ q ∈ U, G_fn k q = ψ q * F k q) →
        ∀ p ∈ U, homRankOneDet G_fn p = (ψ p) ^ 3 * homRankOneDet F p := by
    intro U hU ψ F G_fn hψ hF hG_eq p hp
    have hdA : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        iterDerivYT 1 0 (G_fn k) p = pderivA ψ p * F k p + ψ p * iterDerivYT 1 0 (F k) p := by
      intro k
      have hopen_A : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, p.2) ∈ U} :=
        hU.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      have hev : (fun z : ℂ => G_fn k (z, p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
          (fun z : ℂ => ψ (z, p.2) * F k (z, p.2)) := by
        filter_upwards [hopen_A.mem_nhds hp] with z hz
        exact hG_eq k (z, p.2) hz
      have hψ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ψ (z, p.2)) p.1 :=
        (hψ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.1
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2))
      have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => F k (z, p.2)) p.1 :=
        ((hF k).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.1
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2))
      change deriv (fun z : ℂ => G_fn k (z, p.2)) p.1 = _
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact (hψ_at.hasDerivAt.mul hF_at.hasDerivAt).deriv
    have hdD : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        iterDerivYT 0 1 (G_fn k) p = pderivD ψ p * F k p + ψ p * iterDerivYT 0 1 (F k) p := by
      intro k
      have hopen_D : IsOpen {w : ℂ | (p.1, w) ∈ U} :=
        hU.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hev : (fun w : ℂ => G_fn k (p.1, w)) =ᶠ[nhds p.2]
          (fun w : ℂ => ψ (p.1, w) * F k (p.1, w)) := by
        filter_upwards [hopen_D.mem_nhds hp] with w hw
        exact hG_eq k (p.1, w) hw
      have hψ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ψ (p.1, w)) p.2 :=
        (hψ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.2
          ((differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => F k (p.1, w)) p.2 :=
        ((hF k).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.2
          ((differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
      change deriv (fun w : ℂ => G_fn k (p.1, w)) p.2 = _
      rw [hev.deriv_eq]
      exact (hψ_at.hasDerivAt.mul hF_at.hasDerivAt).deriv
    dsimp only [homRankOneDet]
    rw [hG_eq 0 p hp, hG_eq 1 p hp, hG_eq 2 p hp, hdA 0, hdA 1, hdA 2, hdD 0, hdD 1, hdD 2]
    ring

  have h_wronsk_quotient :
      ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)}, IsOpen U → ∀ (F : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (Z : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F k) U) →
        (∀ p ∈ U, F 2 p ≠ 0) →
        (∀ p ∈ U, homRankOneDet F p = 0) →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U, Z ι p = F ι.castSucc p / F 2 p) →
        ∀ p ∈ U, pderivA (Z 0) p * pderivD (Z 1) p = pderivD (Z 0) p * pderivA (Z 1) p := by
    intro U hU F Z hF hF2_nz hdet hZ_eq
    have hZ_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Z ι) U := fun ι =>
      (((hF ι.castSucc).mul ((hF 2).fun_inv hF2_nz)).congr
        (fun q hq => by rw [hZ_eq ι q hq, div_eq_mul_inv]; rfl))
    let F_Z : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun k => if k = 0 then Z 0 else if k = 1 then Z 1 else fun _ => (1 : ℂ)
    have hFZ_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_Z k) U := by
      intro k; fin_cases k
      · exact hZ_holo 0
      · exact hZ_holo 1
      · exact differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)
    have hF_scale : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ q ∈ U, F k q = F 2 q * F_Z k q := by
      intro k q hq; fin_cases k
      · change F 0 q = F 2 q * Z 0 q
        rw [hZ_eq 0 q hq]; exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hF2_nz q hq)).symm
      · change F 1 q = F 2 q * Z 1 q
        rw [hZ_eq 1 q hq]; exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hF2_nz q hq)).symm
      · change F 2 q = F 2 q * 1
        exact (mul_one _).symm
    intro p hp
    have hscale := h_wronsk_scale hU (F 2) F_Z F (hF 2) hFZ_holo hF_scale p hp
    rw [hdet p hp] at hscale
    have hFZ_det : homRankOneDet F_Z p = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hscale.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 3 (hF2_nz p hp))
    have hcA : iterDerivYT 1 0 (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) p = 0 := deriv_const p.1 (1 : ℂ)
    have hcD : iterDerivYT 0 1 (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) p = 0 := deriv_const p.2 (1 : ℂ)
    have hFZ0 : F_Z 0 = Z 0 := rfl
    have hFZ1 : F_Z 1 = Z 1 := rfl
    have hFZ2 : F_Z 2 = fun _ => (1 : ℂ) := rfl
    dsimp only [homRankOneDet] at hFZ_det
    rw [hFZ0, hFZ1, hFZ2, hcA, hcD] at hFZ_det
    change Z 0 p * (pderivA (Z 1) p * 0 - pderivD (Z 1) p * 0) -
        Z 1 p * (pderivA (Z 0) p * 0 - pderivD (Z 0) p * 0) +
        1 * (pderivA (Z 0) p * pderivD (Z 1) p - pderivD (Z 0) p * pderivA (Z 1) p) = 0 at hFZ_det
    linear_combination hFZ_det

  have h_wronsk_tau_obs :
      ∀ (y_c : ℂ) (r_y r_τ : ℝ), 0 < r_y → 0 < r_τ →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          (∀ k : Fin 3,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (F k) (Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ)) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ u₂ (Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ) →
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ,
            F 2 p = p.2 ^ (m + 1) * u₂ p) →
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ, homRankOneDet F p = 0) →
          ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_c r_y,
            ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ (y, 0) *
              (F 0 (y, 0) * pderivA (F 1) (y, 0) - F 1 (y, 0) * pderivA (F 0) (y, 0)) = 0 := by
    intro y_c r_y r_τ hr_y hr_τ m F u₂ hF hu₂ hF2 hdet
    let B : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ
    have hB_open : IsOpen B := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    obtain ⟨hF0A, hF0D⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open (hF 0)
    obtain ⟨hF1A, hF1D⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open (hF 1)
    obtain ⟨hu₂A, hu₂D⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hB_open hu₂
    let R_rem : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      F 0 p * (pderivA (F 1) p * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p) -
        pderivD (F 1) p * (p.2 * pderivA u₂ p)) -
      F 1 p * (pderivA (F 0) p * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p) -
        pderivD (F 0) p * (p.2 * pderivA u₂ p)) +
      (p.2 * u₂ p) * (pderivA (F 0) p * pderivD (F 1) p - pderivD (F 0) p * pderivA (F 1) p)
    have hτ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Prod.snd B := differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
    have hterm_u : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p) B :=
      ((differentiableOn_const _).mul hu₂).add (hτ_holo.mul hu₂D)
    have hR_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_rem B :=
      (((hF 0).mul ((hF1A.mul hterm_u).sub (hF1D.mul (hτ_holo.mul hu₂A)))).sub
        ((hF 1).mul ((hF0A.mul hterm_u).sub (hF0D.mul (hτ_holo.mul hu₂A))))).add
        ((hτ_holo.mul hu₂).mul ((hF0A.mul hF1D).sub (hF0D.mul hF1A)))
    have hmul_zero : ∀ p ∈ B, p.2 ^ m * R_rem p = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hdA : iterDerivYT 1 0 (F 2) p = p.2 ^ (m + 1) * pderivA u₂ p := by
        have hopen_A : IsOpen {z : ℂ | (z, p.2) ∈ B} :=
          hB_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        have hev : (fun z : ℂ => F 2 (z, p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
            (fun z : ℂ => p.2 ^ (m + 1) * u₂ (z, p.2)) := by
          filter_upwards [hopen_A.mem_nhds hp] with z hz
          exact hF2 (z, p.2) hz
        have hu_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => u₂ (z, p.2)) p.1 :=
          (hu₂.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.1
            (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2))
        change deriv (fun z : ℂ => F 2 (z, p.2)) p.1 = _
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        exact (hu_at.hasDerivAt.const_mul (p.2 ^ (m + 1))).deriv
      have hdD : iterDerivYT 0 1 (F 2) p =
          p.2 ^ m * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p) := by
        have hopen_D : IsOpen {w : ℂ | (p.1, w) ∈ B} :=
          hB_open.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have hev : (fun w : ℂ => F 2 (p.1, w)) =ᶠ[nhds p.2]
            (fun w : ℂ => w ^ (m + 1) * u₂ (p.1, w)) := by
          filter_upwards [hopen_D.mem_nhds hp] with w hw
          exact hF2 (p.1, w) hw
        have hu_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => u₂ (p.1, w)) p.2 :=
          (hu₂.differentiableAt (hB_open.mem_nhds hp)).comp p.2
            ((differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id)
        have hpow_at : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w ^ (m + 1)) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * p.2 ^ m) p.2 := by
          simpa using hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) p.2
        have hprod_d : deriv (fun w : ℂ => w ^ (m + 1) * u₂ (p.1, w)) p.2 =
            ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * p.2 ^ m * u₂ p + p.2 ^ (m + 1) * pderivD u₂ p :=
          (hpow_at.mul hu_at.hasDerivAt).deriv
        change deriv (fun w : ℂ => F 2 (p.1, w)) p.2 = _
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, hprod_d]
        ring
      have h0 := hdet p hp
      dsimp only [homRankOneDet] at h0
      rw [hF2 p hp, hdA, hdD] at h0
      change F 0 p *
          (pderivA (F 1) p * (p.2 ^ m * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p)) -
            pderivD (F 1) p * (p.2 ^ (m + 1) * pderivA u₂ p)) -
        F 1 p *
          (pderivA (F 0) p * (p.2 ^ m * (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * u₂ p + p.2 * pderivD u₂ p)) -
            pderivD (F 0) p * (p.2 ^ (m + 1) * pderivA u₂ p)) +
        p.2 ^ (m + 1) * u₂ p *
          (pderivA (F 0) p * pderivD (F 1) p - pderivD (F 0) p * pderivA (F 1) p) = 0 at h0
      dsimp only [R_rem]
      linear_combination h0
    let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_c r_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ \ {0})
    have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
    have hV_ne : V.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨(y_c, ((r_τ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self hr_y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (half_pos hr_τ)]
        linarith
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (half_pos hr_τ).ne'
    have hV_sub : V ⊆ B := Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left
    have hR_V : ∀ p ∈ V, R_rem p = 0 := fun p hp =>
      (mul_eq_zero.mp (hmul_zero p (hV_sub hp))).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero m hp.2.2)
    have hB_preconn : IsPreconnected B :=
      (convex_ball y_c r_y).isPreconnected.prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r_τ).isPreconnected
    have hR_B : ∀ p ∈ B, R_rem p = 0 :=
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hB_open hB_preconn hV_open hV_ne hV_sub hR_holo hR_V
    intro y hy
    have hval := hR_B (y, 0) ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hr_τ⟩
    dsimp only [R_rem] at hval
    linear_combination hval

  
  have h_glancing_inf_obs :
      ∀ (y_c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (θ w₀ w₁ v₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ θ (Metric.ball y_c R) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ w₀ (Metric.ball y_c R) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ w₁ (Metric.ball y_c R) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ v₂ (Metric.ball y_c R) →
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_c R, deriv θ y ≠ 0) →
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_c R, Complex.cos (θ y) * w₀ y + Complex.sin (θ y) * w₁ y = 0) →
        (∃ y_star ∈ Metric.ball y_c R, w₀ y_star ≠ 0 ∨ w₁ y_star ≠ 0) →
        (∃ y_u ∈ Metric.ball y_c R, v₂ y_u ≠ 0) →
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_c R, v₂ y * (w₀ y * deriv w₁ y - w₁ y * deriv w₀ y) = 0) →
        False := by
    intro y_c R θ w₀ w₁ v₂ hθ hw₀ hw₁ hv₂ hθ_deriv hinc hw_nz hv₂_nz hwronsk
    let U_loc : Set ℂ := Metric.ball y_c R
    let α : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => -Complex.sin (θ y) * w₀ y + Complex.cos (θ y) * w₁ y
    have hα_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ α U_loc :=
      (((Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn hθ).neg).mul hw₀).add
        ((Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn hθ).mul hw₁)
    have hw_rec : ∀ y ∈ U_loc,
        w₀ y = -α y * Complex.sin (θ y) ∧ w₁ y = α y * Complex.cos (θ y) := by
      intro y hy
      have hcs := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ y)
      have h1 := hinc y hy
      have h2 : -Complex.sin (θ y) * w₀ y + Complex.cos (θ y) * w₁ y = α y := rfl
      constructor
      · linear_combination -(w₀ y) * hcs + Complex.cos (θ y) * h1 - Complex.sin (θ y) * h2
      · linear_combination -(w₁ y) * hcs + Complex.sin (θ y) * h1 + Complex.cos (θ y) * h2
    obtain ⟨y_star, hy_star, hw_star⟩ := hw_nz
    have hα_star_nz : α y_star ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      obtain ⟨hw0_eq, hw1_eq⟩ := hw_rec y_star hy_star
      rw [h0] at hw0_eq hw1_eq
      rcases hw_star with hnz | hnz
      · exact hnz (by linear_combination hw0_eq)
      · exact hnz (by linear_combination hw1_eq)
    have hwronsk_id : ∀ y ∈ U_loc,
        w₀ y * deriv w₁ y - w₁ y * deriv w₀ y = (α y) ^ 2 * deriv θ y := by
      intro y hy
      have hα_at : HasDerivAt α (deriv α y) y :=
        (hα_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).hasDerivAt
      have hθ_at : HasDerivAt θ (deriv θ y) y :=
        (hθ.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).hasDerivAt
      have hsin_at : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.sin (θ z)) (Complex.cos (θ y) * deriv θ y) y :=
        (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (θ y)).comp y hθ_at
      have hcos_at : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.cos (θ z)) (-Complex.sin (θ y) * deriv θ y) y :=
        (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (θ y)).comp y hθ_at
      have hw₀_ev : w₀ =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun z => -α z * Complex.sin (θ z)) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact (hw_rec z hz).1
      have hw₁_ev : w₁ =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun z => α z * Complex.cos (θ z)) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact (hw_rec z hz).2
      have hdw₀ : deriv w₀ y =
          -deriv α y * Complex.sin (θ y) + (-α y) * (Complex.cos (θ y) * deriv θ y) := by
        rw [hw₀_ev.deriv_eq]
        exact (hα_at.neg.mul hsin_at).deriv
      have hdw₁ : deriv w₁ y =
          deriv α y * Complex.cos (θ y) + α y * (-Complex.sin (θ y) * deriv θ y) := by
        rw [hw₁_ev.deriv_eq]
        exact (hα_at.mul hcos_at).deriv
      obtain ⟨hw0_y, hw1_y⟩ := hw_rec y hy
      have hcs := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ y)
      rw [hw0_y, hw1_y, hdw₀, hdw₁]
      linear_combination (α y) ^ 2 * deriv θ y * hcs
    have hv₂_mul_zero : ∀ y ∈ U_loc, v₂ y * (α y) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h0 := hwronsk y hy
      rw [hwronsk_id y hy, ← mul_assoc] at h0
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_right (hθ_deriv y hy)
    have hα_cont : ContinuousAt α y_star :=
      hα_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy_star)
    have hv₂_ev0 : v₂ =ᶠ[nhds y_star] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy_star, hα_cont.eventually_ne hα_star_nz]
        with z hz hαz
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hv₂_mul_zero z hz)).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero 2 hαz)
    have hv₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ v₂ U_loc :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hv₂
    obtain ⟨y_u, hy_u, hy_u_nz⟩ := hv₂_nz
    exact hy_u_nz (hv₂_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      (convex_ball y_c R).isPreconnected hy_star hv₂_ev0 hy_u)

  have h_real_slice_nz :
      ∀ (y₀ R r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ R → ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) R) →
        (∃ z_star ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) R, f z_star ≠ 0) →
        ∃ y₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (y₀ - r) (y₀ + r), f (y₁ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y₀ R r hr_pos hr_le f hf hf_nz
    by_contra hAllZero
    have hAllZero' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (y₀ - r) (y₀ + r), f (x : ℂ) = 0 :=
      fun x hx => by_contra fun hne => hAllZero ⟨x, hx, hne⟩
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le hr_pos hr_le
    have hf_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) R) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hf
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => y₀ + r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have hx_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, x_seq n ∈ Set.Ioo (y₀ - r) (y₀ + r) ∧ (x_seq n : ℂ) ≠ (y₀ : ℂ) := by
      intro n
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have hd_pos : 0 < r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := div_pos hr_pos hn_pos
      have hd_le : r / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ r / 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hr_pos.le (by positivity)
          (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
      refine ⟨⟨by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith, by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      intro heq
      have hre := congr_arg Complex.re heq
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
      dsimp [x_seq] at hre
      linarith
    have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (x_seq n : ℂ))
        Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (y₀ : ℂ) {(y₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hx_mem n).2)⟩
      have hreal : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds y₀) := by
        have hden : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        simpa [x_seq] using Filter.Tendsto.const_add y₀ (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden)
      exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto y₀).comp hreal
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (y₀ : ℂ) {(y₀ : ℂ)}ᶜ, f z = 0 :=
      hx_tendsto.frequently
        ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hAllZero' (x_seq n) (hx_mem n).1)).frequently)
    obtain ⟨z_star, hz_star, hz_nz⟩ := hf_nz
    exact hz_nz (hf_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      (convex_ball (y₀ : ℂ) R).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos) hfreq hz_star)

  
  let U_y : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp
  let B_puis : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ
  let B_punc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_y ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0})
  have hBpuis_open : IsOpen B_puis := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hBpunc_open : IsOpen B_punc :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
  have hBpunc_sub : B_punc ⊆ B_puis := Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl Set.inter_subset_left
  have hBpuis_preconn : IsPreconnected B_puis :=
    (convex_ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp).isPreconnected.prod

  have hBpunc_ne : B_punc.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨((Br.y₀ : ℂ), ((G.r_τ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_yp_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,

      linarith [G.r_τ_pos]
    · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (half_pos G.r_τ_pos).ne'
  have hd_ne : G.d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt G.d_pos
  let powMap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, p.2 ^ G.d)
  have hpow_maps_dom : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, powMap p ∈ symCollarDom W.s_base W.r_base q_idx := by
    intro p hp
    apply Br.bidisk_sub_dom
    refine ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [G.r_yp_le, Br.r_y_pos]) hp.1, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_pow]
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < G.r_τ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2

    linarith [G.r_τ_pow_lt, Br.r_t_pos]

  let L_puis : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := puisDualLine0 C G.d
  have hLpuis_eq : ∀ (ι : Fin 2) (p : ℂ × ℂ),

    intro ι p

    have h0 : p.1 + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (p.2 ^ G.d) = p.1 := by push_cast; ring
