  let W₁_puis : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect L_puis G.M_puis
  let W_raw : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k p =>
    if k = 0 then G.N_puis 1 p - p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 1 p
    else if k = 1 then p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 0 p - G.N_puis 0 p
    else L_puis 0 p * G.N_puis 1 p - L_puis 1 p * G.N_puis 0 p
  have hτK_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2 ^ G.K_p) B_puis :=
    (differentiable_snd.pow G.K_p).differentiableOn
  have hW_raw_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W_raw k) B_puis := by
    intro k; fin_cases k
    · exact (G.N_puis_holo 1).sub (hτK_holo.mul (hpuisDual0_holo 1))
    · exact (hτK_holo.mul (hpuisDual0_holo 0)).sub (G.N_puis_holo 0)
    · exact ((hpuisDual0_holo 0).mul (G.N_puis_holo 1)).sub
        ((hpuisDual0_holo 1).mul (G.N_puis_holo 0))
  have hW_raw_punc : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ p ∈ B_punc, W_raw k p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis k p := by
    intro k p hp
    have hN0 := G.N_puis_eq 0 p (hBpunc_sub hp) hp.2.2
    have hN1 := G.N_puis_eq 1 p (hBpunc_sub hp) hp.2.2
    fin_cases k
    · change G.N_puis 1 p - p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 1 p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * (G.M_puis 1 p - L_puis 1 p)
      rw [hN1]; ring
    · change p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 0 p - G.N_puis 0 p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * (L_puis 0 p - G.M_puis 0 p)
      rw [hN0]; ring
    · change L_puis 0 p * G.N_puis 1 p - L_puis 1 p * G.N_puis 0 p =
        p.2 ^ G.K_p * (L_puis 0 p * G.M_puis 1 p - L_puis 1 p * G.M_puis 0 p)
      rw [hN0, hN1]; ring
  have hW_raw_inc : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      L_puis 0 p * W_raw 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_raw 1 p = W_raw 2 p := by
    intro p
    change L_puis 0 p * (G.N_puis 1 p - p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 1 p) +
        L_puis 1 p * (p.2 ^ G.K_p * L_puis 0 p - G.N_puis 0 p) =
      L_puis 0 p * G.N_puis 1 p - L_puis 1 p * G.N_puis 0 p
    ring
  have hex_pstar : ∃ p_star ∈ B_punc, W₁_puis 2 p_star ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hAll
    exact G.not_w2_zero (fun p hp => by_contra fun hne => hAll ⟨p, hp, hne⟩)
  obtain ⟨p_star, hp_star_punc, hW1_2_pstar_nz⟩ := hex_pstar
  have hp_star_puis : p_star ∈ B_puis := hBpunc_sub hp_star_punc
  have hW_raw_2_pstar_nz : W_raw 2 p_star ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hW_raw_punc 2 p_star hp_star_punc]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero G.K_p hp_star_punc.2.2) hW1_2_pstar_nz

  obtain ⟨m_star, W_tilde, hWt_holo, hWt_eq_raw, hWt_zero_nz⟩ :=
    h_tau_extract (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp G.r_τ G.r_yp_pos G.r_τ_pos 3 W_raw hW_raw_holo
      ⟨2, p_star, hp_star_puis, hW_raw_2_pstar_nz⟩
  have hWt2_pstar_nz : W_tilde 2 p_star ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hraw := hWt_eq_raw 2 p_star hp_star_puis
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hraw
    exact hW_raw_2_pstar_nz hraw
  have hWt_puis_eq : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, p.2 ≠ 0 → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      p.2 ^ m_star * W_tilde k p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁_puis k p := by
    intro p hp hp2 k

    exact hW_raw_punc k p ⟨hp.1, hp.2, hp2⟩

  let Δ_inc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun p => L_puis 0 p * W_tilde 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_tilde 1 p - W_tilde 2 p
  have hΔ_inc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_inc B_puis :=
    (((hpuisDual0_holo 0).mul (hWt_holo 0)).add ((hpuisDual0_holo 1).mul (hWt_holo 1))).sub
      (hWt_holo 2)
  have hΔ_inc_punc : ∀ p ∈ B_punc, Δ_inc p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hp_puis := hBpunc_sub hp
    have hmul : p.2 ^ m_star * Δ_inc p = 0 := by
      dsimp only [Δ_inc]
      calc p.2 ^ m_star * (L_puis 0 p * W_tilde 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_tilde 1 p - W_tilde 2 p)
          = L_puis 0 p * (p.2 ^ m_star * W_tilde 0 p) +
              L_puis 1 p * (p.2 ^ m_star * W_tilde 1 p) -
              (p.2 ^ m_star * W_tilde 2 p) := by ring
        _ = L_puis 0 p * W_raw 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_raw 1 p - W_raw 2 p := by
            rw [← hWt_eq_raw 0 p hp_puis, ← hWt_eq_raw 1 p hp_puis, ← hWt_eq_raw 2 p hp_puis]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hW_raw_inc p, sub_self]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero m_star hp.2.2)
  have hΔ_inc_zero : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, Δ_inc p = 0 :=
    hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hBpuis_open hBpuis_preconn hBpunc_open hBpunc_ne
      hBpunc_sub hΔ_inc_holo hΔ_inc_punc

  have hW₁_punc_holo : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W₁_puis k) B_punc := by
    intro k; fin_cases k
    · exact (G.M_puis_holo 1).sub ((hpuisDual0_holo 1).mono hBpunc_sub)
    · exact ((hpuisDual0_holo 0).mono hBpunc_sub).sub (G.M_puis_holo 0)
    · exact (((hpuisDual0_holo 0).mono hBpunc_sub).mul (G.M_puis_holo 1)).sub
        (((hpuisDual0_holo 1).mono hBpunc_sub).mul (G.M_puis_holo 0))
  have hWt_det_punc : ∀ p ∈ B_punc, homRankOneDet W_tilde p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have hraw_det1 := h_wronsk_scale hBpunc_open (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ G.K_p) W₁_puis W_raw
      (differentiable_snd.pow G.K_p).differentiableOn hW₁_punc_holo hW_raw_punc p hp
    rw [G.puis_rank_one p hp, mul_zero] at hraw_det1
    have hraw_det2 := h_wronsk_scale hBpunc_open (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ m_star) W_tilde W_raw
      (differentiable_snd.pow m_star).differentiableOn
      (fun k => (hWt_holo k).mono hBpunc_sub)
      (fun k q hq => hWt_eq_raw k q (hBpunc_sub hq)) p hp
    rw [hraw_det1] at hraw_det2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hraw_det2.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 3 (pow_ne_zero m_star hp.2.2))
  have hWt_det_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (homRankOneDet W_tilde) B_puis := by
    have hA : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 1 0 (W_tilde k)) B_puis :=
      fun k => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hBpuis_open (hWt_holo k) 1 0
    have hD : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (iterDerivYT 0 1 (W_tilde k)) B_puis :=
      fun k => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hBpuis_open (hWt_holo k) 0 1
    exact (((hWt_holo 0).mul (((hA 1).mul (hD 2)).sub ((hD 1).mul (hA 2)))).sub
      ((hWt_holo 1).mul (((hA 0).mul (hD 2)).sub ((hD 0).mul (hA 2))))).add
      ((hWt_holo 2).mul (((hA 0).mul (hD 1)).sub ((hD 0).mul (hA 1))))
  have hWt_det_zero : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, homRankOneDet W_tilde p = 0 :=
    hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hBpuis_open hBpuis_preconn hBpunc_open hBpunc_ne
      hBpunc_sub hWt_det_holo hWt_det_punc

  have hex_zstar : ∃ z_star ∈ U_y, W_tilde 2 (z_star, 0) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hNoZ
    have hW2_slice0 : ∀ y ∈ U_y, W_tilde 2 (y, 0) = 0 :=
      fun y hy => by_contra fun hne => hNoZ ⟨y, hy, hne⟩
    obtain ⟨m', u_tup, hu_tup_holo, hu_tup_eq, ⟨k₁, y_u, hy_u, hu_yu_nz⟩⟩ :=
      h_tau_extract (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp G.r_τ G.r_yp_pos G.r_τ_pos 1 (fun _ => W_tilde 2)
        (fun _ => hWt_holo 2) ⟨0, p_star, hp_star_puis, hWt2_pstar_nz⟩
    let u₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := u_tup 0
    have hu₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ u₂ B_puis := hu_tup_holo 0
    have hu₂_eq : ∀ p ∈ B_puis, W_tilde 2 p = p.2 ^ m' * u₂ p := hu_tup_eq 0
    have hu₂_yu_nz : u₂ (y_u, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      have hk : k₁ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim k₁ 0
      simpa [u₂, hk] using hu_yu_nz
    have hm'_ne : m' ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm0
      have heq := hu₂_eq (y_u, 0) ⟨hy_u, Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_τ_pos⟩
      rw [hm0, pow_zero, one_mul, hW2_slice0 y_u hy_u] at heq
      exact hu₂_yu_nz heq.symm
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hm'_ne
    have hobs_m := h_wronsk_tau_obs (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp G.r_τ G.r_yp_pos G.r_τ_pos
      m W_tilde u₂ hWt_holo hu₂_holo hu₂_eq hWt_det_zero
    have hm1_ne : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero m)
    have hwronsk_1d : ∀ y ∈ U_y,
        u₂ (y, 0) *
          (W_tilde 0 (y, 0) * deriv (fun z => W_tilde 1 (z, 0)) y -
            W_tilde 1 (y, 0) * deriv (fun z => W_tilde 0 (z, 0)) y) = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h0 := hobs_m y hy
      rw [mul_assoc] at h0
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left hm1_ne
    have hUy_strip : U_y ⊆ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) := by
      intro y hy
      change |y.im| < 2 * C.s₀
      linarith [hUy_im y hy, W.s_base_le_s₀, C.s₀_pos]
    have hϕ_holo_Uy : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.ϕ_ℂ U_y := C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.mono hUy_strip
    have hϕ_deriv_Uy : ∀ y ∈ U_y, deriv C.ϕ_ℂ y ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero y (hUy_strip hy)
    have hslice0_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun y : ℂ => (y, (0 : ℂ))) U_y B_puis :=
      fun y hy => ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_τ_pos⟩
    have hslice0_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun y : ℂ => (y, (0 : ℂ))) :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)
    have hw₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => W_tilde 0 (y, 0)) U_y :=
      (hWt_holo 0).comp hslice0_diff.differentiableOn hslice0_maps
    have hw₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => W_tilde 1 (y, 0)) U_y :=
      (hWt_holo 1).comp hslice0_diff.differentiableOn hslice0_maps
    have hv₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => u₂ (y, 0)) U_y :=
      hu₂_holo.comp hslice0_diff.differentiableOn hslice0_maps
    have hinc_1d : ∀ y ∈ U_y,
        Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ y) * W_tilde 0 (y, 0) +
          Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ y) * W_tilde 1 (y, 0) = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_im : |y.im| < W.s_base / 2 := hUy_im y hy
      have hy_s1 : |y.im| < 2 * C.s₁ := by
        linarith [hy_im, W.s_base_le_s₁, C.r₁_pos, C.r₁_lt_s₁]
      have hθ_zero : glancingTheta C y 0 = C.ϕ_ℂ y := by
        dsimp [glancingTheta]
        rw [C.U_zero y hy_s1]
      have hoff : glancingOffset C y 0 ≠ 0 :=
        W.offset_ne_zero y 0 (by linarith [W.s_base_pos]) (by rw [norm_zero]; linarith [W.r_base_pos])
      have h0_pow : (0 : ℂ) ^ G.d = 0 := zero_pow hd_ne
      have hinc0 := hΔ_inc_zero (y, 0) ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_τ_pos⟩
      dsimp only [Δ_inc] at hinc0
      rw [hW2_slice0 y hy, sub_zero, hLpuis_eq 0 (y, 0), hLpuis_eq 1 (y, 0)] at hinc0
      dsimp only at hinc0
      rw [h0_pow] at hinc0
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hθ_zero] at hinc0
      have hmul := congr_arg (· * glancingOffset C y 0) hinc0
      rw [zero_mul, add_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hoff,
        div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hoff] at hmul
      exact hmul
    obtain ⟨k₀, y_star, hy_star, hk₀_nz⟩ := hWt_zero_nz
    have hw_nz_1d : ∃ y_s ∈ U_y, W_tilde 0 (y_s, 0) ≠ 0 ∨ W_tilde 1 (y_s, 0) ≠ 0 := by
      refine ⟨y_star, hy_star, ?_⟩
      fin_cases k₀
      · exact Or.inl hk₀_nz
      · exact Or.inr hk₀_nz
      · exact False.elim (hk₀_nz (hW2_slice0 y_star hy_star))
    exact h_glancing_inf_obs (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp C.ϕ_ℂ
      (fun y => W_tilde 0 (y, 0)) (fun y => W_tilde 1 (y, 0)) (fun y => u₂ (y, 0))
      hϕ_holo_Uy hw₀_holo hw₁_holo hv₂_holo hϕ_deriv_Uy hinc_1d hw_nz_1d
      ⟨y_u, hy_u, hu₂_yu_nz⟩ hwronsk_1d

  have hw₂_slice_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => W_tilde 2 (y, 0)) U_y :=
    (hWt_holo 2).comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)).differentiableOn
      (fun y hy => ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_τ_pos⟩)
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁_Ioo, hy₁_nz⟩ :=
    h_real_slice_nz Br.y₀ G.r_yp (G.r_yp / 2) (half_pos G.r_yp_pos)
      (by linarith [G.r_yp_pos]) (fun y => W_tilde 2 (y, 0)) hw₂_slice_holo hex_zstar
  have hy₁_dist : dist (y₁ : ℂ) (Br.y₀ : ℂ) < G.r_yp / 2 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hy₁_Ioo.1], by linarith [hy₁_Ioo.2]⟩
  let p₁ : ℂ × ℂ := ((y₁ : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
  have hp₁_mem : p₁ ∈ B_puis :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [G.r_yp_pos]), Metric.mem_ball_self G.r_τ_pos⟩
  let O_w2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B_puis ∩ (W_tilde 2) ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
  have hO_w2_open : IsOpen O_w2 :=
    (hWt_holo 2).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hBpuis_open isOpen_compl_singleton
  obtain ⟨δ_nz, hδ_nz_pos, hδ_nz_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO_w2_open p₁ ⟨hp₁_mem, hy₁_nz⟩

  let ρ₁ : ℝ := min δ_nz (min (G.r_yp / 2) G.r_τ)
  have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ := lt_min hδ_nz_pos (lt_min (half_pos G.r_yp_pos) G.r_τ_pos)
  have hρ₁_le_half : ρ₁ ≤ G.r_yp / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρ₁_le_τ : ρ₁ ≤ G.r_τ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hball_y₁_sub : Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ⊆ U_y := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz ⊢
    linarith [dist_triangle z (y₁ : ℂ) (Br.y₀ : ℂ)]
  let B₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (y₁ : ℂ) ρ₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₁
  have hB₁_open : IsOpen B₁ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hB₁_sub_O : B₁ ⊆ O_w2 := by
    intro p hp
    apply hδ_nz_sub
    have hp_ball : p ∈ Metric.ball p₁ ρ₁ := by
      dsimp only [B₁, p₁] at hp ⊢
      rwa [← ball_prod_same]
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp_ball
  have hB₁_sub_Bpuis : B₁ ⊆ B_puis := fun p hp => (hB₁_sub_O hp).1
  have hWt2_B₁_nz : ∀ p ∈ B₁, W_tilde 2 p ≠ 0 := fun p hp => (hB₁_sub_O hp).2
  have hWt_B₁ : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℂ (W_tilde k) B₁ :=
    fun k => (hWt_holo k).mono hB₁_sub_Bpuis
  let Z : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p => W_tilde ι.castSucc p / W_tilde 2 p
  have hZ_B₁_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Z ι) B₁ := fun ι =>
    (((hWt_B₁ ι.castSucc).mul ((hWt_B₁ 2).fun_inv hWt2_B₁_nz)).congr
      (fun p _ => by dsimp [Z]; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]))
  have hZ_inc : ∀ p ∈ B₁, L_puis 0 p * Z 0 p + L_puis 1 p * Z 1 p = 1 := by
    intro p hp
    have h0 := hΔ_inc_zero p (hB₁_sub_Bpuis hp)
    have hne : W_tilde 2 p ≠ 0 := hWt2_B₁_nz p hp
    have hsum : L_puis 0 p * W_tilde 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_tilde 1 p = W_tilde 2 p :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    change L_puis 0 p * (W_tilde 0 p / W_tilde 2 p) +
      L_puis 1 p * (W_tilde 1 p / W_tilde 2 p) = 1
    calc L_puis 0 p * (W_tilde 0 p / W_tilde 2 p) + L_puis 1 p * (W_tilde 1 p / W_tilde 2 p)
        = (L_puis 0 p * W_tilde 0 p + L_puis 1 p * W_tilde 1 p) / W_tilde 2 p := by ring
      _ = W_tilde 2 p / W_tilde 2 p := by rw [hsum]
      _ = 1 := div_self hne
  have hZ_rank_one : ∀ p ∈ B₁,
      pderivA (Z 0) p * pderivD (Z 1) p = pderivD (Z 0) p * pderivA (Z 1) p :=
    h_wronsk_quotient hB₁_open W_tilde Z hWt_B₁ hWt2_B₁_nz
      (fun p hp => hWt_det_zero p (hB₁_sub_Bpuis hp)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

  exact ⟨{
    y₁ := y₁
    ρ₁ := ρ₁
    m_star := m_star
    ρ₁_pos := hρ₁_pos
    ball_y₁_sub := hball_y₁_sub
    ρ₁_le_τ := hρ₁_le_τ
    W_tilde := W_tilde
    Z := Z
    W_tilde_holo := hWt_B₁
    W_tilde_puis_eq := fun p hp hp2 k => hWt_puis_eq p (hB₁_sub_Bpuis hp) hp2 k
    W_tilde_two_ne_zero := hWt2_B₁_nz
    Z_eq := fun _ _ _ => rfl
    Z_holo := hZ_B₁_holo
    Z_incidence := hZ_inc
    Z_rank_one := hZ_rank_one
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have isOpen_horizStrip : ∀ H : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip H) :=
    fun _ => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const

  
  
  have h_real_witness :
      ∀ (y_c R_b r_in : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < R_b → 0 < r_in → r_in ≤ R_b →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball (y_c : ℂ) R_b) →
        (∃ z_star ∈ Metric.ball (y_c : ℂ) R_b, f z_star ≠ 0) →
        ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (y_c - r_in) (y_c + r_in), f (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y_c R_b r_in f hR_b hr_in _hr_le hf_holo ⟨z_star, hz_star_mem, hz_star_nz⟩
    by_contra hAllRealZero
    have hAllRealZero' : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (y_c - r_in) (y_c + r_in), f (x : ℂ) = 0 :=
      fun x hx => by_contra fun hne => hAllRealZero ⟨x, hx, hne⟩
    have hf_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.ball (y_c : ℂ) R_b) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hf_holo
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => y_c + r_in / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have hx_seq_mem : ∀ n : ℕ,
        x_seq n ∈ Set.Ioo (y_c - r_in) (y_c + r_in) ∧ (x_seq n : ℂ) ≠ (y_c : ℂ) := by
      intro n
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have hd_pos : 0 < r_in / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := div_pos hr_in hn_pos
      have hd_le : r_in / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ r_in / 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hr_in.le (by positivity)
          (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
      refine ⟨⟨by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith, by dsimp [x_seq]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      intro heq
      have hre := congr_arg Complex.re heq
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
      dsimp [x_seq] at hre
      linarith
    have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (x_seq n : ℂ))
        Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (y_c : ℂ) {(y_c : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hx_seq_mem n).2)⟩
      have hreal : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds y_c) := by
        have hden : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num)
            (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
        simpa [x_seq] using Filter.Tendsto.const_add y_c (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop hden)
      exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto y_c).comp hreal
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (y_c : ℂ) {(y_c : ℂ)}ᶜ, f z = 0 :=
      hx_tendsto.frequently ((Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun n => hAllRealZero' (x_seq n) (hx_seq_mem n).1)).frequently)
    have hzero_all := hf_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      (convex_ball (y_c : ℂ) R_b).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hR_b) h_freq hz_star_mem
    exact hz_star_nz hzero_all

  
  
  
  have hd_ne_zero : G.d ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt G.d_pos
  have h0_pow_d : (0 : ℂ) ^ G.d = 0 := zero_pow hd_ne_zero
  let U₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (R.y₁ : ℂ) R.ρ₁
  let B₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R.ρ₁
  let Z_zero : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ := fun ι s => R.Z ι (s, 0)

  have hZ0_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Z_zero ι) U₁ := by
    intro ι
    have hemb : Differentiable ℂ (fun s : ℂ => (s, (0 : ℂ))) :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)
    exact (R.Z_holo ι).comp hemb.differentiableOn
      (fun s hs => ⟨hs, Metric.mem_ball_self R.ρ₁_pos⟩)

  have hZ0_inc : ∀ s ∈ U₁,
      dualLineShift C 0 0 (s, 0) * Z_zero 0 s + dualLineShift C 0 1 (s, 0) * Z_zero 1 s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    have hinc := R.Z_incidence (s, 0) ⟨hs, Metric.mem_ball_self R.ρ₁_pos⟩
    simpa only [puisDualLine0, h0_pow_d, Z_zero] using hinc

  have hU₁_bounds : ∀ s ∈ U₁, |s.im| < W.s_base / 2 := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_yp : s ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp := R.ball_y₁_sub hs
    have hs_ry : s ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [G.r_yp_le, Br.r_y_pos]) hs_yp
    have hp_bidisk : (s, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) Br.r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Br.r_t :=
      ⟨hs_ry, Metric.mem_ball_self Br.r_t_pos⟩
    exact (Br.bidisk_sub_dom hp_bidisk).1

  have hU₁_s₁ : ∀ s ∈ U₁, |s.im| < 2 * C.s₁ :=
    fun s hs => by linarith [hU₁_bounds s hs, W.s_base_pos, W.s_base_le_s₁]
  have hU₁_s₀ : ∀ s ∈ U₁, s ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s₀) :=
    fun s hs => by
      change |s.im| < 2 * C.s₀
      linarith [hU₁_bounds s hs, W.s_base_pos, W.s_base_le_s₀]
  have hU₁_sh : ∀ s ∈ U₁, C.ϕ_ℂ s ∈ horizStrip (2 * C.s_h) :=
    fun s hs => C.ϕ_ℂ_maps_to s (hU₁_s₀ s hs)
  have hU₁_det : ∀ s ∈ U₁, |s.im| < 2 * hDet.s_det :=
    fun s hs => by linarith [hU₁_bounds s hs, W.s_base_pos, W.s_base_le_det]

  have hoff_eq : ∀ s ∈ U₁, glancingOffset C s 0 = C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) := by
    intro s hs
    dsimp [glancingOffset, supportAction1_ℂ, glancingTheta]
    rw [add_zero, C.U_zero s (hU₁_s₁ s hs)]
    have hsub : (C.ϕ_ℂ s - C.ϕ_ℂ s) / 2 = 0 := by ring
    have hadd : (C.ϕ_ℂ s + C.ϕ_ℂ s) / 2 = C.ϕ_ℂ s := by ring
    rw [hsub, hadd, Complex.sin_zero, Complex.cos_zero]
    ring

  have hh_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ U₁, C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) ≠ 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [← hoff_eq s hs]
    refine W.offset_ne_zero s 0 ?_ ?_
    · linarith [hU₁_bounds s hs, W.s_base_pos]
    · rw [norm_zero]; linarith [W.r_base_pos]

  have hL₀_zero : ∀ s ∈ U₁,
      dualLineShift C 0 0 (s, 0) = Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) / C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
      dualLineShift C 0 1 (s, 0) = Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) / C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) := by
    intro s hs
    have h0 : s + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) = s := by simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change glancingDualLine C (s + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * 0) 0 0 = _
      rw [h0]
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_zero, hoff_eq s hs, glancingTheta,
        C.U_zero s (hU₁_s₁ s hs)]
    · change glancingDualLine C (s + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * 0) 0 1 = _
      rw [h0]
      simp only [glancingDualLine, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, hoff_eq s hs,
        glancingTheta, C.U_zero s (hU₁_s₁ s hs)]

  have hSupport_eq : ∀ s ∈ U₁,
      Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 0 s + Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 1 s =
        C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) := by
    intro s hs
    have hinc := hZ0_inc s hs
    rw [(hL₀_zero s hs).1, (hL₀_zero s hs).2] at hinc
    have h1 : (Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 0 s +
        Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 1 s) / C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) = 1 := by
      rw [← hinc]; ring
    simpa only [one_mul] using (div_eq_iff (hh_ne_zero s hs)).mp h1

  have hEnv_id : ∀ (y_c : ℂ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → Metric.ball y_c δ ⊆ U₁ →
      (∀ s ∈ Metric.ball y_c δ,
        dualLineShift C 0 0 (s, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 0) s +
          dualLineShift C 0 1 (s, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 1) s = 0) →
      ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball y_c δ, ∀ ι : Fin 2, Z_zero ι s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ι := by
    intro y_c δ _hδ hsub htan s hs ι
    have hs_U₁ : s ∈ U₁ := hsub hs
    have htan_s := htan s hs
    rw [(hL₀_zero s hs_U₁).1, (hL₀_zero s hs_U₁).2] at htan_s
    have htan_clear :
        Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 0) s +
          Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 1) s = 0 := by
      have h1 : (Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 0) s +
          Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 1) s) / C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) = 0 := by
        rw [← htan_s]; ring
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp h1).resolve_right (hh_ne_zero s hs_U₁)
    have hϕ_d : HasDerivAt C.ϕ_ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) s :=
      (C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip _).mem_nhds (hU₁_s₀ s hs_U₁))).hasDerivAt
    have hh_d : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s)) (C.ϕ_ℂ s) :=
      (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip _).mem_nhds (hU₁_sh s hs_U₁))).hasDerivAt
    have hZ0_d0 : HasDerivAt (Z_zero 0) (deriv (Z_zero 0) s) s :=
      ((hZ0_holo 0).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_U₁)).hasDerivAt
    have hZ0_d1 : HasDerivAt (Z_zero 1) (deriv (Z_zero 1) s) s :=
      ((hZ0_holo 1).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_U₁)).hasDerivAt
    have hcos_d : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (-Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s)).comp s hϕ_d
    have hsin_d : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) s :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s)).comp s hϕ_d
    have hLHS_d := (hcos_d.mul hZ0_d0).add (hsin_d.mul hZ0_d1)
    change HasDerivAt
      (fun z => Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Z_zero 0 z + Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Z_zero 1 z) _ s
      at hLHS_d
    have hRHS_d : HasDerivAt (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) s :=
      hh_d.comp s hϕ_d
    have hev_supp : (fun z => Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Z_zero 0 z +
        Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Z_zero 1 z) =ᶠ[nhds s] (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_U₁] with z hz
      exact hSupport_eq z hz
    have hderiv_eq :
        ((-Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 0 s +
          Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 0) s) +
        ((Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 1 s +
          Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv (Z_zero 1) s) =
        deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s := by
      rw [← hLHS_d.deriv, hev_supp.deriv_eq, hRHS_d.deriv]
    have hmul_orth :
        deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s *
          (-Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 0 s +
            Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 1 s - deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hderiv_eq - htan_clear
    have hϕ_nz : deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s ≠ 0 := C.ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero s (hU₁_s₀ s hs_U₁)
    have hOrth_eq :
        -Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 0 s + Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Z_zero 1 s =
          deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul_orth).resolve_left hϕ_nz)
    have hsupp_s := hSupport_eq s hs_U₁
    have hcs := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (C.ϕ_ℂ s)
    fin_cases ι
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, glancingBoundaryCurve, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      linear_combination
        Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * hsupp_s - Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * hOrth_eq - Z_zero 0 s * hcs
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, glancingBoundaryCurve, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      linear_combination
        Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * hsupp_s + Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * hOrth_eq - Z_zero 1 s * hcs

  have hex_c_z : ∃ (c : Fin 2) (z_star : ℂ), z_star ∈ U₁ ∧ deriv (Z_zero c) z_star ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hNone
    have hAll0 : ∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ s ∈ U₁, deriv (Z_zero ι) s = 0 :=
      fun ι s hs => by_contra fun hne => hNone ⟨ι, s, hs, hne⟩
    have hZ_eq_Γ : ∀ s ∈ U₁, ∀ ι : Fin 2, Z_zero ι s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ι :=
      hEnv_id (R.y₁ : ℂ) R.ρ₁ R.ρ₁_pos Set.Subset.rfl
        (fun s hs => by simp [hAll0 0 s hs, hAll0 1 s hs])
    let s₁ : ℂ := (R.y₁ : ℂ)
    have hs₁_U₁ : s₁ ∈ U₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self R.ρ₁_pos
    let θ₁ : ℂ := C.ϕ_ℂ s₁
    have hϕ_d1 : HasDerivAt C.ϕ_ℂ (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) s₁ :=
      (C.ϕ_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip _).mem_nhds (hU₁_s₀ s₁ hs₁_U₁))).hasDerivAt
    have hh_d1 : HasDerivAt C.h_ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁) θ₁ :=
      (C.h_ℂ_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip _).mem_nhds (hU₁_sh s₁ hs₁_U₁))).hasDerivAt
    have hh'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv C.h_ℂ) (horizStrip (2 * C.s_h)) :=
      C.h_ℂ_holo.deriv (isOpen_horizStrip _)
    have hh'_d1 : HasDerivAt (deriv C.h_ℂ) (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) θ₁ :=
      (hh'_holo.differentiableAt ((isOpen_horizStrip _).mem_nhds (hU₁_sh s₁ hs₁_U₁))).hasDerivAt
    have hcos_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (-Complex.sin θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) s₁ :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos θ₁).comp s₁ hϕ_d1
    have hsin_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (Complex.cos θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) s₁ :=
      (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin θ₁).comp s₁ hϕ_d1
    have hh_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) s₁ :=
      hh_d1.comp s₁ hϕ_d1
    have hh'_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z => deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z))
        (deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) s₁ :=
      hh'_d1.comp s₁ hϕ_d1
    have hΓ0_d := (hh_comp.mul hcos_d1).sub (hh'_comp.mul hsin_d1)
    change HasDerivAt
      (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z) -
        deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) _ s₁ at hΓ0_d
    have hΓ1_d := (hh_comp.mul hsin_d1).add (hh'_comp.mul hcos_d1)
    change HasDerivAt
      (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z) +
        deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) _ s₁ at hΓ1_d
    have hev0 : Z_zero 0 =ᶠ[nhds s₁]
        (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z) -
          deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₁_U₁] with z hz
      simpa only [glancingBoundaryCurve, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using hZ_eq_Γ z hz 0
    have hev1 : Z_zero 1 =ᶠ[nhds s₁]
        (fun z => C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ z) +
          deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ z) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ z)) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs₁_U₁] with z hz
      simpa only [glancingBoundaryCurve, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using
        hZ_eq_Γ z hz 1
    have hd0_raw :
        ((deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) * Complex.cos θ₁ +
          C.h_ℂ θ₁ * (-Complex.sin θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁)) -
        ((deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) * Complex.sin θ₁ +
          deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁ * (Complex.cos θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hΓ0_d.deriv, ← hev0.deriv_eq, hAll0 0 s₁ hs₁_U₁]
    have hd1_raw :
        ((deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) * Complex.sin θ₁ +
          C.h_ℂ θ₁ * (Complex.cos θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁)) +
        ((deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) * Complex.cos θ₁ +
          deriv C.h_ℂ θ₁ * (-Complex.sin θ₁ * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hΓ1_d.deriv, ← hev1.deriv_eq, hAll0 1 s₁ hs₁_U₁]
    have hd0 : -(C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁ * Complex.sin θ₁ = 0 := by
      linear_combination hd0_raw
    have hd1 : (C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁ * Complex.cos θ₁ = 0 := by
      linear_combination hd1_raw
    have hcs1 := Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ₁
    have hlaz := C.lazutkin_norm_ℂ s₁ (hU₁_s₀ s₁ hs₁_U₁)
    have hc_sq_zero : (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      calc (C.c : ℂ) ^ 2
          = ((C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 3) ^ 2 := by rw [← hlaz]
        _ = (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 4 *
              (((C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 2 * 1) := by ring
        _ = (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 4 *
              (((C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 2 *
                (Complex.cos θ₁ ^ 2 + Complex.sin θ₁ ^ 2)) := by rw [hcs1]
        _ = (deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁) ^ 4 *
              ((-(C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁ * Complex.sin θ₁) ^ 2 +
               ((C.h_ℂ θ₁ + deriv (deriv C.h_ℂ) θ₁) * deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s₁ * Complex.cos θ₁) ^ 2) := by
              ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hd0, hd1]; ring
    have hc_zero : (C.c : ℂ) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp (by rwa [sq] at hc_sq_zero) with h | h <;> exact h
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr C.c_pos.ne' hc_zero

  obtain ⟨c, z_reg_star, hz_reg_mem, hz_reg_nz⟩ := hex_c_z
  obtain ⟨y₁', hy₁'_Ioo, hc_reg⟩ :=
    h_real_witness R.y₁ R.ρ₁ (R.ρ₁ / 2) (deriv (Z_zero c))
      R.ρ₁_pos (by linarith [R.ρ₁_pos]) (by linarith [R.ρ₁_pos])
      ((hZ0_holo c).deriv Metric.isOpen_ball) ⟨z_reg_star, hz_reg_mem, hz_reg_nz⟩

  
  
  
  let s₁' : ℂ := (y₁' : ℂ)
  let ρ' : ℝ := R.ρ₁ / 2
  have hρ'_pos : 0 < ρ' := by dsimp [ρ']; linarith [R.ρ₁_pos]
  have hy₁'_abs : |y₁' - R.y₁| < R.ρ₁ / 2 :=
    abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [hy₁'_Ioo.1], by linarith [hy₁'_Ioo.2]⟩
  let U₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s₁' ρ'
  let B₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ'
  have hU₀_sub_U₁ : U₀ ⊆ U₁ := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
    have hdiff : ‖s₁' - (R.y₁ : ℂ)‖ = |y₁' - R.y₁| := by
      dsimp [s₁']
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have htri : ‖z - (R.y₁ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖z - s₁'‖ + ‖s₁' - (R.y₁ : ℂ)‖ := by
      simpa using norm_add_le (z - s₁') (s₁' - (R.y₁ : ℂ))
    dsimp [ρ'] at hz
    linarith
  have hB₀_sub_B₁ : B₀ ⊆ B₁ :=
    Set.prod_mono hU₀_sub_U₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [ρ']; linarith [R.ρ₁_pos]))
  have hs₁'_U₀ : s₁' ∈ U₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ'_pos

  have hf_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ (Z_zero c) s₁' :=
    (hZ0_holo c).analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hU₀_sub_U₁ hs₁'_U₀))
  let hf_strict : HasStrictDerivAt (Z_zero c) (deriv (Z_zero c) s₁') s₁' :=
    hf_ana.hasStrictDerivAt
  let w₀ : ℂ := Z_zero c s₁'
  let ψ_inv : ℂ → ℂ :=
    HasStrictDerivAt.localInverse (Z_zero c) (deriv (Z_zero c) s₁') s₁' hf_strict hc_reg
  have hψ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ ψ_inv w₀ := hf_ana.analyticAt_localInverse hc_reg
  obtain ⟨r_w0, hr_w0_pos, hψ_ana_ball⟩ := hψ_ana.exists_ball_analyticOnNhd
  have hψ_holo0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ_inv (Metric.ball w₀ r_w0) := hψ_ana_ball.differentiableOn
  have h_linv_ev : ∀ᶠ y in nhds s₁', ψ_inv (Z_zero c y) = y :=
    hf_strict.eventually_left_inverse hc_reg
  have h_rinv_ev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, Z_zero c (ψ_inv w) = w :=
    hf_strict.eventually_right_inverse hc_reg
  have hψ_w₀ : ψ_inv w₀ = s₁' := h_linv_ev.self_of_nhds
  have hψ_cont_w₀ : ContinuousAt ψ_inv w₀ :=
    hψ_holo0.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_w0_pos))
  have hw_nhds :
      Metric.ball w₀ r_w0 ∩ ψ_inv ⁻¹' U₀ ∩ {w : ℂ | Z_zero c (ψ_inv w) = w} ∈ nhds w₀ :=
    Filter.inter_mem
      (Filter.inter_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ hr_w0_pos)
        (hψ_cont_w₀.preimage_mem_nhds (hψ_w₀.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₁' hρ'_pos)))
      h_rinv_ev
  obtain ⟨r_w, hr_w_pos, hr_w_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hw_nhds
  let W_w : Set ℂ := Metric.ball w₀ r_w
  have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ_inv W_w :=
    hψ_holo0.mono (fun w hw => ((hr_w_sub hw).1).1)
  have hψ_props : ∀ w ∈ W_w, ψ_inv w ∈ U₀ ∧ Z_zero c (ψ_inv w) = w :=
    fun w hw => ⟨((hr_w_sub hw).1).2, (hr_w_sub hw).2⟩

  have hderiv_c_cont : ContinuousAt (deriv (Z_zero c)) s₁' :=
    ((hZ0_holo c).deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hU₀_sub_U₁ hs₁'_U₀))
  have hy_nhds :
      {y : ℂ | ψ_inv (Z_zero c y) = y} ∩ {y : ℂ | deriv (Z_zero c) y ≠ 0} ∈ nhds s₁' :=
    Filter.inter_mem h_linv_ev (hderiv_c_cont.eventually_ne hc_reg)
  obtain ⟨δ_a1, hδ_a1_pos, hδ_a1_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hy_nhds

  have hp₁'_B₁ : (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B₁ :=
    hB₀_sub_B₁ ⟨hs₁'_U₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ'_pos⟩
  have hZc_cont : ContinuousAt (R.Z c) (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) :=
    (R.Z_holo c).continuousOn.continuousAt
      ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds hp₁'_B₁)
  have hZc_nhds : (R.Z c) ⁻¹' W_w ∈ nhds (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) :=
    hZc_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w₀ hr_w_pos)
  obtain ⟨δ_a2, hδ_a2_pos, hδ_a2_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hZc_nhds

  let δ_a : ℝ := min ρ' (min δ_a1 δ_a2)
  have hδ_a_pos : 0 < δ_a := lt_min hρ'_pos (lt_min hδ_a1_pos hδ_a2_pos)
  have hδ_a_le_ρ' : δ_a ≤ ρ' := min_le_left _ _
  let U_a : Set ℂ := Metric.ball s₁' δ_a
  let B_a : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_a
  have hBa_eq_ball : B_a = Metric.ball (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) δ_a := ball_prod_same s₁' 0 δ_a
  have hBa_open : IsOpen B_a := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hUa_sub_U₀ : U_a ⊆ U₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_a_le_ρ'
  have hUa_sub_U₁ : U_a ⊆ U₁ := Set.Subset.trans hUa_sub_U₀ hU₀_sub_U₁
  have hBa_sub_B₀ : B_a ⊆ B₀ :=
    Set.prod_mono hUa_sub_U₀ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_a_le_ρ')
  have hBa_sub_B₁ : B_a ⊆ B₁ := Set.Subset.trans hBa_sub_B₀ hB₀_sub_B₁
  have hZc_maps_Ww : Set.MapsTo (R.Z c) B_a W_w := by
    intro p hp
    apply hδ_a2_sub
    rw [hBa_eq_ball] at hp
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball
      (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)) hp

  let σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => ψ_inv (R.Z c p)
  have hσ_holo_a : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ B_a :=
    hψ_holo.comp ((R.Z_holo c).mono hBa_sub_B₁) hZc_maps_Ww
  have hσ_maps_U₁ : ∀ p ∈ B_a, σ p ∈ U₁ :=
    fun p hp => hU₀_sub_U₁ (hψ_props (R.Z c p) (hZc_maps_Ww hp)).1
  have hZc_comp_a : ∀ p ∈ B_a, Z_zero c (σ p) = R.Z c p :=
    fun p hp => (hψ_props (R.Z c p) (hZc_maps_Ww hp)).2
  have hσ_zero_a : ∀ y ∈ U_a, σ (y, 0) = y := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : y ∈ Metric.ball s₁' δ_a1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hy
    exact (hδ_a1_sub hy1).1
  have hderiv_c_nz : ∀ y ∈ U_a, deriv (Z_zero c) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : y ∈ Metric.ball s₁' δ_a1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) hy
    exact (hδ_a1_sub hy1).2

  have hcoeff_tay : ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ),
      MvPowerSeries.coeff d (taylor2D g q) =
        iterDerivYT (d 0) (d 1) g q / (((d 0).factorial : ℂ) * ((d 1).factorial : ℂ)) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl

  have hZ_comp_a : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ B_a, R.Z ι p = Z_zero ι (σ p) := by
    intro ι
    let G_ι : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Z_zero ι (σ p)
    let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => R.Z ι p - G_ι p
    have hGι_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_ι B_a :=
      (hZ0_holo ι).comp hσ_holo_a hσ_maps_U₁
    have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F B_a :=
      ((R.Z_holo ι).mono hBa_sub_B₁).sub hGι_holo
    have hcomp_pderiv : ∀ (j : Fin 2), ∀ p ∈ B_a,
        pderivA (fun q => Z_zero j (σ q)) p = deriv (Z_zero j) (σ p) * pderivA σ p ∧
        pderivD (fun q => Z_zero j (σ q)) p = deriv (Z_zero j) (σ p) * pderivD σ p := by
      intro j p hp
      have hZ_d : HasDerivAt (Z_zero j) (deriv (Z_zero j) (σ p)) (σ p) :=
        ((hZ0_holo j).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hσ_maps_U₁ p hp))).hasDerivAt
      have hσ_diff_p : DifferentiableAt ℂ σ p :=
        hσ_holo_a.differentiableAt (hBa_open.mem_nhds hp)
      have hembA : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, p.2)) p.1 :=
        differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2)
      have hembD : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (p.1, z)) p.2 :=
        (differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id
      have hσ_A : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => σ (z, p.2)) (pderivA σ p) p.1 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := σ) p.1 hσ_diff_p hembA).hasDerivAt
      have hσ_D : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => σ (p.1, z)) (pderivD σ p) p.2 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := σ) p.2 hσ_diff_p hembD).hasDerivAt
      have hcomp_A : HasDerivAt ((Z_zero j) ∘ (fun z : ℂ => σ (z, p.2)))
          (deriv (Z_zero j) (σ p) * pderivA σ p) p.1 :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := Z_zero j) (h := fun z : ℂ => σ (z, p.2)) p.1 hZ_d hσ_A
      have hcomp_D : HasDerivAt ((Z_zero j) ∘ (fun z : ℂ => σ (p.1, z)))
          (deriv (Z_zero j) (σ p) * pderivD σ p) p.2 :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := Z_zero j) (h := fun z : ℂ => σ (p.1, z)) p.2 hZ_d hσ_D
      exact ⟨hcomp_A.deriv, hcomp_D.deriv⟩
    have hZc_pderiv : ∀ p ∈ B_a,
        pderivA (R.Z c) p = deriv (Z_zero c) (σ p) * pderivA σ p ∧
        pderivD (R.Z c) p = deriv (Z_zero c) (σ p) * pderivD σ p := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hcA, hcD⟩ := hcomp_pderiv c p hp
      have hevA : (fun z : ℂ => R.Z c (z, p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1]
          (fun z : ℂ => Z_zero c (σ (z, p.2))) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp.1] with z hz
        exact (hZc_comp_a (z, p.2) ⟨hz, hp.2⟩).symm
      have hevD : (fun z : ℂ => R.Z c (p.1, z)) =ᶠ[nhds p.2]
          (fun z : ℂ => Z_zero c (σ (p.1, z))) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hp.2] with z hz
        exact (hZc_comp_a (p.1, z) ⟨hp.1, hz⟩).symm
      exact ⟨(hevA.deriv_eq).trans hcA, (hevD.deriv_eq).trans hcD⟩
    have hPDE : ∀ p ∈ B_a,
        pderivA (R.Z c) p * pderivD F p = pderivD (R.Z c) p * pderivA F p := by
      intro p hp
      have hZi_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (R.Z ι) p :=
        (R.Z_holo ι).differentiableAt
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds (hBa_sub_B₁ hp))
      have hGi_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ G_ι p :=
        hGι_holo.differentiableAt (hBa_open.mem_nhds hp)
      have hembA : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, p.2)) p.1 :=
        differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const p.2)
      have hembD : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (p.1, z)) p.2 :=
        (differentiableAt_const p.1).prodMk differentiableAt_id
      have hZi_A : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => R.Z ι (z, p.2)) (pderivA (R.Z ι) p) p.1 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := R.Z ι) p.1 hZi_diff hembA).hasDerivAt
      have hZi_D : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => R.Z ι (p.1, z)) (pderivD (R.Z ι) p) p.2 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := R.Z ι) p.2 hZi_diff hembD).hasDerivAt
      have hGi_A : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => G_ι (z, p.2)) (pderivA G_ι p) p.1 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := G_ι) p.1 hGi_diff hembA).hasDerivAt
      have hGi_D : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => G_ι (p.1, z)) (pderivD G_ι p) p.2 :=
        (DifferentiableAt.comp (g := G_ι) p.2 hGi_diff hembD).hasDerivAt
      have hFA : pderivA F p = pderivA (R.Z ι) p - pderivA G_ι p := (hZi_A.sub hGi_A).deriv
      have hFD : pderivD F p = pderivD (R.Z ι) p - pderivD G_ι p := (hZi_D.sub hGi_D).deriv
      obtain ⟨hGA, hGD⟩ := hcomp_pderiv ι p hp
      obtain ⟨hZA, hZD⟩ := hZc_pderiv p hp
      have hG_rel : pderivA (R.Z c) p * pderivD G_ι p = pderivD (R.Z c) p * pderivA G_ι p := by
        change pderivA (R.Z c) p * pderivD (fun q => Z_zero ι (σ q)) p =
          pderivD (R.Z c) p * pderivA (fun q => Z_zero ι (σ q)) p
        rw [hZA, hZD, hGA, hGD]
        ring
      have hZ_rel :
          pderivA (R.Z c) p * pderivD (R.Z ι) p = pderivD (R.Z c) p * pderivA (R.Z ι) p := by
        have hr1 := R.Z_rank_one p (hBa_sub_B₁ hp)
        fin_cases c <;> fin_cases ι <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one]
        · ring
        · exact hr1
        · linear_combination -hr1
        · ring
      rw [hFA, hFD]
      linear_combination hZ_rel - hG_rel
    obtain ⟨hZcA_holo, hZcD_holo⟩ :=
      hKit.pderiv_holo hBa_open ((R.Z_holo c).mono hBa_sub_B₁)
    obtain ⟨hFA_holo, hFD_holo⟩ := hKit.pderiv_holo hBa_open hF_holo
    have h_tau_vanish : ∀ β : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U_a, iterDerivYT 0 β F (y, 0) = 0 := by
      intro β
      induction β using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h β ih =>
        cases β with
        | zero =>
          intro y hy
          change F (y, 0) = 0
          dsimp [F, G_ι, Z_zero]
          rw [hσ_zero_a y hy, sub_self]
        | succ n =>
          intro y hy
          let p_y : ℂ × ℂ := (y, (0 : ℂ))
          have hp_y : p_y ∈ B_a := ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos⟩
          have h_pA_vanish : ∀ j ≤ n, iterDerivYT 0 j (pderivA F) p_y = 0 := by
            intro j hj
            have hj_lt : j < n + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj
            have hstep := hKit.iterDerivYT_step hBa_open hF_holo 0 j p_y hp_y
            rw [← hstep.1, ← hstep.2.2.1]
            change deriv (fun z : ℂ => iterDerivYT 0 j F (z, 0)) y = 0
            have hev : (fun z : ℂ => iterDerivYT 0 j F (z, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
                (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
              filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
              exact ih j hj_lt z hz
            rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
          have htay_eq :
              taylor2D (pderivA (R.Z c)) p_y * taylor2D (pderivD F) p_y =
                taylor2D (pderivD (R.Z c)) p_y * taylor2D (pderivA F) p_y := by
            have hcongr := hKit.taylor2D_congr hBa_open hp_y hPDE
            have hmul1 := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hBa_open hp_y).2 hZcA_holo hFD_holo).2.2
            have hmul2 := ((hKit.taylor2D_algebra hBa_open hp_y).2 hZcD_holo hFA_holo).2.2
            rw [← hmul1, ← hmul2]
            exact hcongr
          let d_n : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 1 n
          have hd_n_0 : d_n 0 = 0 := by simp [d_n]
          have hd_n_1 : d_n 1 = n := by simp [d_n]
          have hcoeff_eq := congr_arg (MvPowerSeries.coeff d_n) htay_eq
          rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul, MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul] at hcoeff_eq
          have hRHS_zero :
              (∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d_n,
                MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (taylor2D (pderivD (R.Z c)) p_y) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (taylor2D (pderivA F) p_y)) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun r hr => ?_)
            have hr_add : r.1 + r.2 = d_n := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hr
            have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = 0 := by
              have h := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 0) hr_add
              simpa [Finsupp.add_apply, hd_n_0] using h
            have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = n := by
              have h := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 1) hr_add
              simpa [Finsupp.add_apply, hd_n_1] using h
            have hr2_0 : r.2 0 = 0 := by omega
            have hr2_le : r.2 1 ≤ n := by omega
            rw [hcoeff_tay r.2 (pderivA F) p_y, hr2_0, h_pA_vanish (r.2 1) hr2_le,
              zero_div, mul_zero]
          let r₀ : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) × (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) := (0, d_n)
          have hLHS_single :
              (∑ r ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal d_n,
                MvPowerSeries.coeff r.1 (taylor2D (pderivA (R.Z c)) p_y) *
                  MvPowerSeries.coeff r.2 (taylor2D (pderivD F) p_y)) =
              MvPowerSeries.coeff 0 (taylor2D (pderivA (R.Z c)) p_y) *
                MvPowerSeries.coeff d_n (taylor2D (pderivD F) p_y) := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_single r₀ (fun r hr hne => ?_) (fun hnotmem => ?_)
            · have hr_add : r.1 + r.2 = d_n := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hr
              have hr0 : r.1 0 + r.2 0 = 0 := by
                have h := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 0) hr_add
                simpa [Finsupp.add_apply, hd_n_0] using h
              have hr1 : r.1 1 + r.2 1 = n := by
                have h := congr_arg (fun u : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => u 1) hr_add
                simpa [Finsupp.add_apply, hd_n_1] using h
              have hr2_0 : r.2 0 = 0 := by omega
              have hr2_lt : r.2 1 < n := by
                by_contra hnot_lt
                have hr2_1 : r.2 1 = n := by omega
                have hr1_1 : r.1 1 = 0 := by omega
                apply hne
                refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
                · ext i
                  fin_cases i
                  · simp [r₀]; omega
                  · simp [r₀, hr1_1]
                · ext i
                  fin_cases i
                  · simp [r₀, hd_n_0]; omega
                  · simp [r₀, hd_n_1, hr2_1]
              have hstep_D := (hKit.iterDerivYT_step hBa_open hF_holo 0 (r.2 1) p_y hp_y).2.1
              have hvan : iterDerivYT 0 (r.2 1) (pderivD F) p_y = 0 := by
                rw [← hstep_D]
                exact ih (r.2 1 + 1) (Nat.add_lt_add_right hr2_lt 1) y hy
              rw [hcoeff_tay r.2 (pderivD F) p_y, hr2_0, hvan, zero_div, mul_zero]
            · exfalso
              apply hnotmem
              rw [Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal]
              exact zero_add d_n
          rw [hLHS_single, hRHS_zero] at hcoeff_eq
          rw [hcoeff_tay 0 (pderivA (R.Z c)) p_y, hcoeff_tay d_n (pderivD F) p_y] at hcoeff_eq
          simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, hd_n_0, hd_n_1, Nat.factorial_zero,
            Nat.cast_one, one_mul, div_one] at hcoeff_eq
          have hZc_at_0 : iterDerivYT 0 0 (pderivA (R.Z c)) p_y = deriv (Z_zero c) y := rfl
          have hstep_n := (hKit.iterDerivYT_step hBa_open hF_holo 0 n p_y hp_y).2.1
          rw [hZc_at_0, ← hstep_n] at hcoeff_eq
          have hdiv0 : iterDerivYT 0 (n + 1) F p_y / (n.factorial : ℂ) = 0 :=
            (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoeff_eq).resolve_left (hderiv_c_nz y hy)
          have hfact_ne : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
            Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
          exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hdiv0).resolve_right hfact_ne
    have h_all_vanish : ∀ α β : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ U_a, iterDerivYT α β F (y, 0) = 0 := by
      intro α
      induction α with
      | zero => exact h_tau_vanish
      | succ α ihα =>
        intro β y hy
        have hp_y : (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_a := ⟨hy, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos⟩
        have hstep := (hKit.iterDerivYT_step hBa_open hF_holo α β (y, 0) hp_y).2.2.1
        rw [← hstep]
        change deriv (fun z : ℂ => iterDerivYT α β F (z, 0)) y = 0
        have hev : (fun z : ℂ => iterDerivYT α β F (z, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds y]
            (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
          exact ihα β z hz
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    have hp₁'_Ba : (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_a :=
      ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos⟩
    have htay0 : taylor2D F (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      ext d
      rw [hcoeff_tay, h_all_vanish (d 0) (d 1) s₁' (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos), zero_div,
        MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero]
    have hBa_preconn : IsPreconnected B_a :=
      (convex_ball s₁' δ_a).isPreconnected.prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ_a).isPreconnected
    have hF_zero : ∀ p ∈ B_a, F p = 0 :=
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_taylor2D_zero hBa_open hBa_preconn hp₁'_Ba hF_holo htay0
    intro p hp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hF_zero p hp)

  have hp₁'_Ba_main : (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_a :=
    ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos⟩
  have hσ_cont_p₁' : ContinuousAt σ (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) :=
    hσ_holo_a.continuousOn.continuousAt (hBa_open.mem_nhds hp₁'_Ba_main)
  have hσ_p₁'_eq : σ (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) = s₁' :=
    hσ_zero_a s₁' (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos)
  have hσ_Ua_nhds : σ ⁻¹' U_a ∈ nhds (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) :=
    hσ_cont_p₁'.preimage_mem_nhds (hσ_p₁'_eq.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₁' hδ_a_pos)
  obtain ⟨δ_b_raw, hδ_b_raw_pos, hδ_b_raw_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hσ_Ua_nhds
  let δ_b : ℝ := min δ_b_raw δ_a
  have hδ_b_pos : 0 < δ_b := lt_min hδ_b_raw_pos hδ_a_pos
  have hδ_b_le_a : δ_b ≤ δ_a := min_le_right _ _
  let B_b : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₁' δ_b ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_b
  have hBb_eq_ball : B_b = Metric.ball (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) δ_b := ball_prod_same s₁' 0 δ_b
  have hBb_open : IsOpen B_b := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hBb_sub_Ba : B_b ⊆ B_a :=
    Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_b_le_a) (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_b_le_a)
  have hBb_sub_B₁ : B_b ⊆ B₁ := Set.Subset.trans hBb_sub_Ba hBa_sub_B₁
  have hσ_holo_b : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ B_b := hσ_holo_a.mono hBb_sub_Ba
  have hσ_maps_a : ∀ p ∈ B_b, σ p ∈ U_a := by
    intro p hp
    apply hδ_b_raw_sub
    rw [hBb_eq_ball] at hp
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hp
  have hσ_zero_b : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball s₁' δ_b, σ (y, 0) = y :=
    fun y hy => hσ_zero_a y (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_b_le_a hy)
  have hZ_comp_b : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ B_b, R.Z ι p = Z_zero ι (σ p) :=
    fun ι p hp => hZ_comp_a ι p (hBb_sub_Ba hp)

  
  
  
  let W₁ : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect (puisDualLine0 C G.d) G.M_puis
  have hBb_punc_sub_G : ∀ p ∈ B_b, p.2 ≠ 0 →
      p ∈ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0}) := by
    intro p hp hp2
    have hp₁ := hBb_sub_B₁ hp
    exact ⟨R.ball_y₁_sub hp₁.1, ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball R.ρ₁_le_τ hp₁.2, hp2⟩⟩

  have hW₁_rel : ∀ p ∈ B_b, p.2 ≠ 0 →
      W₁ 2 p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ ι : Fin 2, W₁ ι.castSucc p = W₁ 2 p * Z_zero ι (σ p) := by
    intro p hp hp2
    have hp₁ := hBb_sub_B₁ hp
    have hpeq := R.W_tilde_puis_eq p hp₁ hp2
    have hW2_tilde_ne : R.W_tilde 2 p ≠ 0 := R.W_tilde_two_ne_zero p hp₁
    have hpow_m_ne : p.2 ^ R.m_star ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero R.m_star hp2
    have hpow_K_ne : p.2 ^ G.K_p ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero G.K_p hp2
    have hW1_2_ne : W₁ 2 p ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hmul := hpeq 2
      change p.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁ 2 p at hmul
      rw [h0, mul_zero] at hmul
      exact mul_ne_zero hpow_m_ne hW2_tilde_ne hmul
    refine ⟨hW1_2_ne, fun ι => ?_⟩
    have hmul_ι : p.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde ι.castSucc p =
        p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁ ι.castSucc p := hpeq ι.castSucc
    have hmul_2 : p.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 p = p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁ 2 p := hpeq 2
    have hZ_eq : R.Z ι p = R.W_tilde ι.castSucc p / R.W_tilde 2 p := R.Z_eq ι p hp₁
    have hW_tilde_ι : R.W_tilde ι.castSucc p = R.W_tilde 2 p * R.Z ι p := by
      rw [hZ_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hW2_tilde_ne]
    rw [hW_tilde_ι] at hmul_ι
    have h_scaled :
        p.2 ^ G.K_p * W₁ ι.castSucc p =
          p.2 ^ G.K_p * (W₁ 2 p * Z_zero ι (σ p)) := by
      rw [← hZ_comp_b ι p hp, ← hmul_ι,
        show p.2 ^ R.m_star * (R.W_tilde 2 p * R.Z ι p) =
          (p.2 ^ R.m_star * R.W_tilde 2 p) * R.Z ι p by ring,
        hmul_2]
      ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hpow_K_ne h_scaled

  
  have h_iso_witness :
      ∃ z ∈ U_a, (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) ^ 2 + (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hNoIso
    have hIso0 : ∀ z ∈ U_a, (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) ^ 2 + (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) ^ 2 = 0 :=
      fun z hz => by_contra fun hne => hNoIso ⟨z, hz, hne⟩
    let g_plus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Z_zero 0 z + Complex.I * Z_zero 1 z
    let g_minus : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Z_zero 0 z - Complex.I * Z_zero 1 z
    have hg_plus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_plus U_a :=
      ((hZ0_holo 0).mono hUa_sub_U₁).add
        ((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul ((hZ0_holo 1).mono hUa_sub_U₁))
    have hg_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_minus U_a :=
      ((hZ0_holo 0).mono hUa_sub_U₁).sub
        ((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul ((hZ0_holo 1).mono hUa_sub_U₁))
    have hg_deriv_mul : ∀ z ∈ U_a, deriv g_plus z * deriv g_minus z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h0d : HasDerivAt (Z_zero 0) (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) z :=
        ((hZ0_holo 0).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hUa_sub_U₁ hz))).hasDerivAt
      have h1d : HasDerivAt (Z_zero 1) (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) z :=
        ((hZ0_holo 1).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hUa_sub_U₁ hz))).hasDerivAt
      have hp_d : deriv g_plus z = deriv (Z_zero 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (Z_zero 1) z :=
        (h0d.add (h1d.const_mul Complex.I)).deriv
      have hm_d : deriv g_minus z = deriv (Z_zero 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (Z_zero 1) z :=
        (h0d.sub (h1d.const_mul Complex.I)).deriv
      rw [hp_d, hm_d]
      calc (deriv (Z_zero 0) z + Complex.I * deriv (Z_zero 1) z) *
              (deriv (Z_zero 0) z - Complex.I * deriv (Z_zero 1) z)
          = (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) ^ 2 - Complex.I ^ 2 * (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) ^ 2 + (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) ^ 2 := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        _ = 0 := hIso0 z hz
    have h_factor_zero :
        ∃ s_iso : ℂ, (s_iso = 1 ∨ s_iso = -1) ∧
          ∀ z ∈ U_a, deriv (fun w => Z_zero 0 w + s_iso * Complex.I * Z_zero 1 w) z = 0 := by
      by_cases hgp : ∀ z ∈ U_a, deriv g_plus z = 0
      · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        simpa only [one_mul] using hgp z hz
      · obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := not_forall.mp hgp
        obtain ⟨hz₁_Ua, hz₁_nz⟩ := not_imp.mp hz₁
        have hgp'_cont : ContinuousAt (deriv g_plus) z₁ :=
          (hg_plus_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).continuousOn.continuousAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz₁_Ua)
        have hgm'_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (deriv g_minus) U_a :=
          (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr
            (hg_minus_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball)
        have hev_gm0 : deriv g_minus =ᶠ[nhds z₁] 0 := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz₁_Ua,
            hgp'_cont.eventually_ne hz₁_nz] with z hz hne
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (hg_deriv_mul z hz)).resolve_left hne
        have hgm_all0 : ∀ z ∈ U_a, deriv g_minus z = 0 :=
          fun z hz => hgm'_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            (convex_ball s₁' δ_a).isPreconnected hz₁_Ua hev_gm0 hz
        refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        have hfn : (fun w => Z_zero 0 w + (-1 : ℂ) * Complex.I * Z_zero 1 w) = g_minus := by
          ext w; dsimp [g_minus]; ring
        rw [hfn]
        exact hgm_all0 z hz
    obtain ⟨s_iso, hs_iso, hderiv_iso0⟩ := h_factor_zero
    let g_iso : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Z_zero 0 w + s_iso * Complex.I * Z_zero 1 w
    have hg_iso_diff : ∀ z ∈ U_a, DifferentiableAt ℂ g_iso z := by
      intro z hz
      have h0 := (hZ0_holo 0).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hUa_sub_U₁ hz))
      have h1 := (hZ0_holo 1).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hUa_sub_U₁ hz))
      exact h0.add (h1.const_mul (s_iso * Complex.I))
    let c_star : ℂ := g_iso s₁'
    have hg_iso_const : ∀ z ∈ U_a, g_iso z = c_star := by
      intro z hz
      have hnorm0 : ‖g_iso z - g_iso s₁'‖ ≤ (0 : ℝ) * ‖z - s₁'‖ :=
        Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hg_iso_diff
          (fun w hw => by rw [hderiv_iso0 w hw, norm_zero])
          (convex_ball s₁' δ_a) (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_a_pos) hz
      rw [zero_mul, norm_le_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at hnorm0
      exact hnorm0
    let V_b : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₁' δ_b ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_b \ {0})
    have hVb_open : IsOpen V_b :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
    have hVb_ne : V_b.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨(s₁', ((δ_b / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_b_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by linarith)
    have hVb_sub : V_b ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0}) :=
      fun p hp => hBb_punc_sub_G p ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩ hp.2.2
    refine G.not_iso_line V_b s_iso c_star hVb_open hVb_ne hVb_sub hs_iso (fun p hp => ?_)
    obtain ⟨_, hW_vals⟩ := hW₁_rel p ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩ hp.2.2
    have hW0 : W₁ 0 p = W₁ 2 p * Z_zero 0 (σ p) := hW_vals 0
    have hW1 : W₁ 1 p = W₁ 2 p * Z_zero 1 (σ p) := hW_vals 1
    change W₁ 0 p + s_iso * Complex.I * W₁ 1 p - c_star * W₁ 2 p = 0
    rw [hW0, hW1]
    have hconst_p : Z_zero 0 (σ p) + s_iso * Complex.I * Z_zero 1 (σ p) = c_star :=
      hg_iso_const (σ p) (hσ_maps_a p ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩)
    linear_combination W₁ 2 p * hconst_p

  
  have h_tr_witness :
      ∃ z ∈ U_a,
        dualLineShift C 0 0 (z, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 0) z +
          dualLineShift C 0 1 (z, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 1) z ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hNoTr
    have hTr0 : ∀ s ∈ U_a,
        dualLineShift C 0 0 (s, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 0) s +
          dualLineShift C 0 1 (s, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 1) s = 0 :=
      fun s hs => by_contra fun hne => hNoTr ⟨s, hs, hne⟩
    have hBoundary : ∀ s ∈ U_a, ∀ ι : Fin 2, Z_zero ι s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ι :=
      hEnv_id s₁' δ_a hδ_a_pos hUa_sub_U₁ hTr0
    obtain ⟨r_s, r_env, s_minus, s_plus, Q_inc, hr_env_pos, hr_env_le_rs, _hrs_lt,
      hs_minus_holo, hs_plus_holo, hs_pm_props, hQ_inc_factor, hEnv_uniq⟩ :=
      B_col.envelope_quad_factor y₁'
    have hrs_pos : 0 < r_s := lt_of_lt_of_le hr_env_pos hr_env_le_rs
    have hσ_rs_nhds : σ ⁻¹' (Metric.ball s₁' r_s) ∈ nhds (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) :=
      hσ_cont_p₁'.preimage_mem_nhds (hσ_p₁'_eq.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₁' hrs_pos)
    obtain ⟨r_σ, hr_σ_pos, hr_σ_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hσ_rs_nhds
    let δ_env : ℝ :=
      min δ_b (min r_σ (min 1 (min r_env (min B_cr.s_det B_cr.r_det))))
    have hδ_env_pos : 0 < δ_env :=
      lt_min hδ_b_pos
        (lt_min hr_σ_pos
          (lt_min one_pos
            (lt_min hr_env_pos (lt_min B_cr.s_det_pos B_cr.r_det_pos))))
    have hδ_env_le_b : δ_env ≤ δ_b := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ_env_le_rσ : δ_env ≤ r_σ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hδ_env_le_one : δ_env ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hδ_env_le_renv : δ_env ≤ r_env :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    have hδ_env_le_sdet : δ_env ≤ B_cr.s_det :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))))
    have hδ_env_le_rdet : δ_env ≤ B_cr.r_det :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _)
          (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))))
    let B_env : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₁' δ_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_env
    have hB_env_eq_ball : B_env = Metric.ball (s₁', (0 : ℂ)) δ_env :=
      ball_prod_same s₁' 0 δ_env
    have hB_env_open : IsOpen B_env := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hB_env_preconn : IsPreconnected B_env :=
      (convex_ball s₁' δ_env).isPreconnected.prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) δ_env).isPreconnected
    have hB_env_sub_Bb : B_env ⊆ B_b :=
      Set.prod_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_env_le_b) (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_env_le_b)
    let powMap : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, p.2 ^ G.d)
    have hpowMap_diff : Differentiable ℂ powMap :=
      differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.pow G.d)
    have hpowMap_B_env : ∀ p ∈ B_env,
        ‖p.2 ^ G.d‖ < δ_env ∧
        powMap p ∈ Metric.ball s₁' r_env ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_env ∧
        |p.1.im| < B_cr.s_det ∧
        ‖p.2 ^ G.d‖ < B_cr.r_det := by
      intro p hp
      have hp2_lt : ‖p.2‖ < δ_env := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2
      have hp2_le_one : ‖p.2‖ ≤ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hp2_lt hδ_env_le_one)
      have hpow_le : ‖p.2 ^ G.d‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ := by
        rw [norm_pow]
        exact pow_le_of_le_one (norm_nonneg p.2) hp2_le_one hd_ne_zero
      have hpow_lt : ‖p.2 ^ G.d‖ < δ_env := lt_of_le_of_lt hpow_le hp2_lt
      have hp1_im : |p.1.im| < B_cr.s_det := by
        have hp1_norm : ‖p.1 - s₁'‖ < δ_env := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1
        have him_eq : (p.1 - s₁').im = p.1.im := by simp [s₁']
        have him_le : |p.1.im| ≤ ‖p.1 - s₁'‖ := by
          rw [← him_eq]
          exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm (p.1 - s₁')
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt him_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hp1_norm hδ_env_le_sdet)
      refine ⟨hpow_lt, ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_env_le_renv hp.1, ?_⟩, hp1_im,
        lt_of_lt_of_le hpow_lt hδ_env_le_rdet⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpow_lt hδ_env_le_renv
    have hσ_rs_on_env : ∀ p ∈ B_env, σ p ∈ Metric.ball s₁' r_s := by
      intro p hp
      apply hr_σ_sub
      rw [hB_env_eq_ball] at hp
      exact Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_env_le_rσ hp
    let f_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => σ p - s_minus (powMap p)
    let f_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => σ p - s_plus (powMap p)
    have hf_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_minus B_env :=
      (hσ_holo_b.mono hB_env_sub_Bb).sub
        (hs_minus_holo.comp hpowMap_diff.differentiableOn (fun p hp => (hpowMap_B_env p hp).2.1))
    have hf_plus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_plus B_env :=
      (hσ_holo_b.mono hB_env_sub_Bb).sub
        (hs_plus_holo.comp hpowMap_diff.differentiableOn (fun p hp => (hpowMap_B_env p hp).2.1))
    have hprod_zero : ∀ p ∈ B_env, f_minus p * f_plus p = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_Bb := hB_env_sub_Bb hp
      have hp_B₁ := hBb_sub_B₁ hp_Bb
      have hinc := R.Z_incidence p hp_B₁
      rw [hZ_comp_b 0 p hp_Bb, hZ_comp_b 1 p hp_Bb,
        hBoundary (σ p) (hσ_maps_a p hp_Bb) 0,
        hBoundary (σ p) (hσ_maps_a p hp_Bb) 1] at hinc
      change dualLineShift C 0 0 (powMap p) * glancingBoundaryCurve C (σ p) 0 +
        dualLineShift C 0 1 (powMap p) * glancingBoundaryCurve C (σ p) 1 = 1 at hinc
      obtain ⟨hQ_nz, hQ_eq⟩ :=
        hQ_inc_factor (σ p) (hσ_rs_on_env p hp) (powMap p) (hpowMap_B_env p hp).2.1
      have hmul0 : (f_minus p * f_plus p) * Q_inc (σ p) (powMap p) = 0 := by
        dsimp [f_minus, f_plus]
        rw [← hQ_eq, hinc, sub_self]
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul0).resolve_right hQ_nz
    have h_branch_split :
        (∀ p ∈ B_env, σ p = s_minus (powMap p)) ∨
        (∀ p ∈ B_env, σ p = s_plus (powMap p)) := by
      by_cases hfm : ∀ p ∈ B_env, f_minus p = 0
      · exact Or.inl (fun p hp => sub_eq_zero.mp (hfm p hp))
      · obtain ⟨p_nz, hp_nz⟩ := not_forall.mp hfm
        obtain ⟨hp_nz_mem, hp_nz_val⟩ := not_imp.mp hp_nz
        let V_nz : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B_env ∩ f_minus ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ
        have hV_nz_open : IsOpen V_nz :=
          hf_minus_holo.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hB_env_open isOpen_compl_singleton
        have hV_nz_ne : V_nz.Nonempty := ⟨p_nz, hp_nz_mem, hp_nz_val⟩
        have hfp_on_V : ∀ q ∈ V_nz, f_plus q = 0 :=
          fun q hq => (mul_eq_zero.mp (hprod_zero q hq.1)).resolve_left hq.2
        have hfp_all : ∀ p ∈ B_env, f_plus p = 0 :=
          hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hB_env_open hB_env_preconn
            hV_nz_open hV_nz_ne Set.inter_subset_left hf_plus_holo hfp_on_V
        exact Or.inr (fun p hp => sub_eq_zero.mp (hfp_all p hp))
    let V_env : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball s₁' δ_env ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_env \ {0})
    have hV_env_open : IsOpen V_env :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.prod (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton)
    have hV_env_ne : V_env.Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨(s₁', ((δ_env / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_env_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        linarith
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by linarith)
    have hV_env_sub_G :
        V_env ⊆ Metric.ball (Br.y₀ : ℂ) G.r_yp ×ˢ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) G.r_τ \ {0}) :=
      fun p hp => hBb_punc_sub_G p (hB_env_sub_Bb ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩) hp.2.2

    rcases h_branch_split with h_eq_minus | h_eq_plus
    · 
      refine G.not_prev_eq V_env hV_env_open hV_env_ne hV_env_sub_G (fun p hp => ?_)
      have hp_env : p ∈ B_env := ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩
      have hp_Bb : p ∈ B_b := hB_env_sub_Bb hp_env
      obtain ⟨_, hpow_renv, hy_sdet, ht_rdet⟩ := hpowMap_B_env p hp_env
      let y : ℂ := p.1
      let t : ℂ := p.2 ^ G.d
      have hZ_eq_X₀ : ∀ ι : Fin 2, Z_zero ι (σ p) = glancingImpact C (y - t / 2) t ι := by
        intro ι
        rw [hBoundary (σ p) (hσ_maps_a p hp_Bb) ι, h_eq_minus p hp_env]
        exact congr_fun (hs_pm_props (y, t) hpow_renv).2.2.1 ι
      have hy_im1 : |y.im| < B_cr.s_det + B_cr.r_det := by linarith [B_cr.r_det_pos]
      have hyt_im2 : |(y - t).im| < B_cr.s_det + B_cr.r_det := by
        have htri : |(y - t).im| ≤ |y.im| + |t.im| := by
          rw [Complex.sub_im, sub_eq_add_neg]
          simpa only [abs_neg] using abs_add_le y.im (-t.im)
        have htim : |t.im| ≤ ‖t‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm t
        linarith
      have hcram1 := (B_cr.cramer_edge_identities y t hy_im1 ht_rdet).1.1
      have hcram2_raw := (B_cr.cramer_edge_identities (y - t) t hyt_im2 ht_rdet).1.2
      have hshift_half : (y - t) + t / 2 = y - t / 2 := by ring
      rw [hshift_half] at hcram2_raw
      have hL0_shift : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          dualLineShift C 0 ι (y, t) = glancingDualLine C y t ι := by
        intro ι
        change glancingDualLine C (y + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * t) t ι = _
        have h0 : y + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * t = y := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h0]
      have hLm1_shift : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
          dualLineShift C (-1) ι (y, t) = glancingDualLine C (y - t) t ι := by
        intro ι
        change glancingDualLine C (y + ((-1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * t) t ι = _
        have hm1 : y + ((-1 : ℤ) : ℂ) * t = y - t := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hm1]
      let W₀_fn : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k q =>
        homIntersect (dualLineShift C (-1)) (dualLineShift C 0) k (q.1, q.2 ^ G.d)
      have hW₀_0 : W₀_fn 0 p = W₀_fn 2 p * glancingImpact C (y - t / 2) t 0 := by
        dsimp only [W₀_fn, homIntersect]
        change dualLineShift C 0 1 (y, t) - dualLineShift C (-1) 1 (y, t) =

      obtain ⟨r_plus, hr_plus_pos, hr_plus_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hplus_nhds
      let B_plus : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (s₁', (t₀ : ℂ)) r_plus

      have hL₀_lift_eq : ∀ q ∈ B_plus, ∀ ι : Fin 2,

      let W_cand : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := homIntersect (dualLineShift C 0) F_cand
      have hW_cand_eq : ∀ q ∈ B_plus, ∀ k : Fin 3, W_cand k q = W₁ k (liftMap q) := by

      have hF_cand_eq_L1 : ∀ q ∈ B_plus, ∀ ι : Fin 2, F_cand ι q = dualLineShift C 1 ι q := by

        let p_q : ℂ × ℂ := liftMap q

        have hpow_pq : powMap p_q = q :=

        obtain ⟨hW1_2_ne, hW1_vals⟩ := hW₁_rel p_q hp_q_Bb hp_q_V.2.2
        have hZ_pq : ∀ ι : Fin 2,

  let F_iso : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (deriv (Z_zero 0) z) ^ 2 + (deriv (Z_zero 1) z) ^ 2

    dualLineShift C 0 0 (z, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 0) z +
      dualLineShift C 0 1 (z, 0) * deriv (Z_zero 1) z
  let H_good : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => F_iso z * F_tr z

  have hZ0_deriv_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (Z_zero ι)) U_a :=
    fun ι => ((hZ0_holo ι).deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).mono hUa_sub_U₁
  have hL₀_slice_holo : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => dualLineShift C 0 ι (z, 0)) U_a := by
    intro ι
    have hfn : (fun z : ℂ => dualLineShift C 0 ι (z, 0)) =
        (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C w.1 w.2 ι) ∘ (fun z : ℂ => (z, (0 : ℂ))) := by
      ext z
      change glancingDualLine C (z + ((0 : ℤ) : ℂ) * 0) 0 ι = glancingDualLine C z 0 ι
      simp
    rw [hfn]
    have hemb : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, (0 : ℂ))) :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const 0)
    refine (hDet.dualLine_holo ι).comp hemb.differentiableOn (fun z hz => ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
    · exact hU₁_det z (hUa_sub_U₁ hz)
    · rw [norm_zero]; linarith [hDet.r_det_pos]
  have hF_iso_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_iso U_a :=
    ((hZ0_deriv_holo 0).pow 2).add ((hZ0_deriv_holo 1).pow 2)
  have hF_tr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_tr U_a :=
    ((hL₀_slice_holo 0).mul (hZ0_deriv_holo 0)).add
      ((hL₀_slice_holo 1).mul (hZ0_deriv_holo 1))
  have hH_good_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_good U_a :=
    hF_iso_holo.mul hF_tr_holo

  have hH_good_witness : ∃ z_star ∈ U_a, H_good z_star ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hAll0
    have hAll0' : ∀ z ∈ U_a, H_good z = 0 :=
      fun z hz => by_contra fun hne => hAll0 ⟨z, hz, hne⟩
    obtain ⟨z_iso, hz_iso_mem, hz_iso_nz⟩ := h_iso_witness
    obtain ⟨z_tr, hz_tr_mem, hz_tr_nz⟩ := h_tr_witness
    have hF_iso_cont : ContinuousAt F_iso z_iso :=
      hF_iso_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz_iso_mem)

    have hev_tr0 : F_tr =ᶠ[nhds z_iso] 0 := by

    have htr_z := hF_tr_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero

    exact hz_tr_nz htr_z

  let δ_s : ℝ := δ_b / 2
  have hδ_s_pos : 0 < δ_s := by dsimp [δ_s]; linarith
  have hδ_s_le_a : δ_s ≤ δ_a := by dsimp [δ_s]; linarith
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂_Ioo, hH_y₂_nz⟩ :=
    h_real_witness y₁' δ_a δ_s H_good hδ_a_pos hδ_s_pos hδ_s_le_a hH_good_holo hH_good_witness
  obtain ⟨hZ0_noniso_y₂, hZ0_trans_y₂⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hH_y₂_nz

  have hy₂_abs : |y₂ - y₁'| < δ_b / 2 :=
    abs_lt.mpr ⟨by dsimp [δ_s] at hy₂_Ioo; linarith [hy₂_Ioo.1],
      by dsimp [δ_s] at hy₂_Ioo; linarith [hy₂_Ioo.2]⟩
  have hball_y₂_sub_b : Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s ⊆ Metric.ball s₁' δ_b := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
    have hdiff : ‖(y₂ : ℂ) - s₁'‖ = |y₂ - y₁'| := by
      dsimp [s₁']
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have htri : ‖z - s₁'‖ ≤ ‖z - (y₂ : ℂ)‖ + ‖(y₂ : ℂ) - s₁'‖ := by
      simpa using norm_add_le (z - (y₂ : ℂ)) ((y₂ : ℂ) - s₁')
    dsimp [δ_s] at hz
    linarith
  have hball_y₂_s_sub : Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s ⊆ U₁ :=
    Set.Subset.trans hball_y₂_sub_b
      (Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_b_le_a) hUa_sub_U₁)

  let q₂ : ℂ × ℂ := ((y₂ : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))
  have hy₂_in_b : (y₂ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball s₁' δ_b :=
    hball_y₂_sub_b (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_s_pos)
  have hq₂_Bb : q₂ ∈ B_b := ⟨hy₂_in_b, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_b_pos⟩
  have hσ_q₂ : σ q₂ = (y₂ : ℂ) := hσ_zero_b (y₂ : ℂ) hy₂_in_b
  have hpderivA_σ_q₂ : pderivA σ q₂ = 1 := by
    change deriv (fun z : ℂ => σ (z, 0)) (y₂ : ℂ) = 1
    have hev : (fun z : ℂ => σ (z, 0)) =ᶠ[nhds (y₂ : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => z) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy₂_in_b] with z hz
      exact hσ_zero_b z hz
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_id'']
  have hpderivA_σ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (pderivA σ) B_b :=
    (hKit.pderiv_holo hBb_open hσ_holo_b).1
  have hσ_cont_q₂ : ContinuousAt σ q₂ :=
    hσ_holo_b.continuousOn.continuousAt (hBb_open.mem_nhds hq₂_Bb)
  have hpderivA_cont_q₂ : ContinuousAt (pderivA σ) q₂ :=
    hpderivA_σ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hBb_open.mem_nhds hq₂_Bb)
  have hq₂_nhds :
      B_b ∩ σ ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ_s) ∩ {p : ℂ × ℂ | pderivA σ p ≠ 0} ∈ nhds q₂ :=
    Filter.inter_mem
      (Filter.inter_mem (hBb_open.mem_nhds hq₂_Bb)
        (hσ_cont_q₂.preimage_mem_nhds (hσ_q₂.symm ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds (y₂ : ℂ) hδ_s_pos)))
      (hpderivA_cont_q₂.eventually_ne (by rw [hpderivA_σ_q₂]; exact one_ne_zero))
  obtain ⟨r_σ2, hr_σ2_pos, hr_σ2_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hq₂_nhds
  let δ₂ : ℝ := min r_σ2 δ_s
  have hδ₂_pos : 0 < δ₂ := lt_min hr_σ2_pos hδ_s_pos
  have hδ₂_le_s : δ₂ ≤ δ_s := min_le_right _ _
  have hδ₂_le_ρ₁ : δ₂ ≤ R.ρ₁ := by
    dsimp [ρ'] at hδ_a_le_ρ'
    linarith [hδ₂_le_s, hδ_s_le_a, hδ_a_le_ρ', R.ρ₁_pos]
  let B₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (y₂ : ℂ) δ₂ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₂
  have hB₂_sub_rσ2 : B₂ ⊆ Metric.ball q₂ r_σ2 := by
    dsimp only [B₂, q₂]
    rw [ball_prod_same]
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
  have hB₂_sub_Bb : B₂ ⊆ B_b := fun p hp => ((hr_σ2_sub (hB₂_sub_rσ2 hp)).1).1

  exact ⟨{
    y₂ := y₂
    δ_s := δ_s
    δ₂ := δ₂
    δ_s_pos := hδ_s_pos
    δ₂_pos := hδ₂_pos
    δ₂_le_s := hδ₂_le_s
    ball_y₂_s_sub := hball_y₂_s_sub
    δ₂_le_ρ₁ := hδ₂_le_ρ₁
    Z_zero := Z_zero
    σ := σ
    Z_zero_holo := fun ι => (hZ0_holo ι).mono hball_y₂_s_sub
    Z_zero_incidence_zero := fun s hs => hZ0_inc s (hball_y₂_s_sub hs)
    Z_zero_nonisotropic_at := hZ0_noniso_y₂
    Z_zero_transverse_at := hZ0_trans_y₂
    σ_holo := hσ_holo_b.mono hB₂_sub_Bb
    σ_maps_to := fun p hp => ((hr_σ2_sub (hB₂_sub_rσ2 hp)).1).2
    σ_at_zero := fun y hy => hσ_zero_b y (hball_y₂_sub_b (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₂_le_s hy))
    σ_pderivA_ne_zero := fun p hp => (hr_σ2_sub (hB₂_sub_rσ2 hp)).2
    Z_eq_comp_σ := fun ι p hp => hZ_comp_b ι p (hB₂_sub_Bb hp)
  }⟩
