proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hDetour : ∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {p_a p_b : ℂ × ℂ},
      IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ H U →
      p_a ∈ U → H p_a ≠ 0 → p_b ∈ U → H p_b ≠ 0 →
      ∃ p₁ p₂ : ℂ × ℂ,
        (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 - τ) • p_a + τ • p₁ ∈ { q ∈ U | H q ≠ 0 }) ∧
        (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 - τ) • p₁ + τ • p₂ ∈ { q ∈ U | H q ≠ 0 }) ∧
        (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 - τ) • p₂ + τ • p_b ∈ { q ∈ U | H q ≠ 0 }) := by
    intro U H p_a p_b hU hConv hH hp_a hHa hp_b hHb
    let φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z =>
      ((1 - z) * p_a.1 + z * p_b.1, (1 - z) * p_a.2 + z * p_b.2)
    have hφ_diff : Differentiable ℂ φ :=
      ((((differentiable_const (1 : ℂ)).sub differentiable_id).mul
          (differentiable_const p_a.1)).add
        (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const p_b.1))).prodMk
      ((((differentiable_const (1 : ℂ)).sub differentiable_id).mul
          (differentiable_const p_a.2)).add
        (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const p_b.2)))
    have hφ0 : φ 0 = p_a := by ext <;> simp [φ]
    have hφ1 : φ 1 = p_b := by ext <;> simp [φ]
    have hφ_seg : ∀ (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (τ : ℝ),
        (1 - τ) • φ z₀ + τ • φ z₁ =
          φ (((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) * z₀ + (τ : ℂ) * z₁) := by
      intro z₀ z₁ τ
      ext <;>
        simp only [φ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
          Complex.real_smul] <;>
        push_cast <;> ring
    have hφ_real_mem : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, φ (u : ℂ) ∈ U := by
      intro u hu
      have h_eq : (1 - u) • p_a + u • p_b = φ (u : ℂ) := by
        rw [← hφ0, ← hφ1, hφ_seg]
        simp
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact hConv hp_a hp_b (sub_nonneg.mpr hu.2) hu.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 u)
    let I_ℂ : Set ℂ := Complex.ofReal '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    have hI_comp : IsCompact I_ℂ := isCompact_Icc.image Complex.continuous_ofReal
    have hU_pre_open : IsOpen (φ ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage hφ_diff.continuous
    have hI_sub : I_ℂ ⊆ φ ⁻¹' U := by
      rintro z ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact hφ_real_mem u hu
    obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_thick⟩ :=
      hI_comp.exists_thickening_subset_open hU_pre_open hI_sub
    let δ : ℝ := ε / 2
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
    let R_δ : Set ℂ := { z : ℂ | -δ < z.re ∧ z.re < 1 + δ ∧ -δ < z.im ∧ z.im < δ }
    have hRδ_eq : R_δ =
        (Complex.reCLM ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-δ) (1 + δ)) ∩
          (Complex.imCLM ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) := by
      ext z
      simp [R_δ, Set.mem_Ioo, and_assoc]
    have hRδ_open : IsOpen R_δ := by
      rw [hRδ_eq]
      exact (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.reCLM.continuous).inter
        (isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.imCLM.continuous)
    have hRδ_preconn : IsPreconnected R_δ := by
      rw [hRδ_eq]
      exact (((convex_Ioo (-δ) (1 + δ)).linear_preimage Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap).inter
        ((convex_Ioo (-δ) δ).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap)).isPreconnected
    have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ R_δ U := by
      intro z ⟨hz_re1, hz_re2, hz_im1, hz_im2⟩
      have h_clamp : ∃ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |z.re - u| < δ := by
        rcases le_or_gt z.re 0 with hz0 | hz0
        · refine ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
        · rcases le_or_gt z.re 1 with hz1 | hz1
          · refine ⟨z.re, ⟨le_of_lt hz0, hz1⟩, by simp [hδ_pos]⟩
          · refine ⟨1, ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu_mem, hu_re⟩ := h_clamp
      have hz_im : |z.im| < δ := abs_lt.mpr ⟨hz_im1, hz_im2⟩
      have hz_sub : z - (u : ℂ) = ((z.re - u : ℝ) : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      have h_dist : dist z (u : ℂ) < ε := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, hz_sub]
        calc ‖((z.re - u : ℝ) : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖
            ≤ ‖((z.re - u : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖(z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |z.re - u| + |z.im| := by
              rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
                Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ < δ + δ := add_lt_add hu_re hz_im
          _ = ε := by dsimp [δ]; ring
      exact hε_thick (Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨(u : ℂ), ⟨u, hu_mem, rfl⟩, h_dist⟩)
    let h : ℂ → ℂ := H ∘ φ
    have hh_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ h R_δ := hH.comp hφ_diff.differentiableOn hφ_maps
    have hh_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h R_δ := hh_diff.analyticOnNhd hRδ_open
    have h0_Rδ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ R_δ := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> linarith
    have h1_Rδ : (1 : ℂ) ∈ R_δ := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp <;> linarith
    have hh0 : h 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [h, hφ0] using hHa
    have hh1 : h 1 ≠ 0 := by simpa [h, hφ1] using hHb
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_nz⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
        ((hh_ana 0 h0_Rδ).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hh0))
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_nz⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
        ((hh_ana 1 h1_Rδ).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
          (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hh1))
    let η₀ : ℝ := min (δ / 2) (min r₀ r₁)
    have hη₀_pos : 0 < η₀ := lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min hr₀_pos hr₁_pos)
    let ψ_ℂ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (x.1 : ℂ) + (x.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ_ℂ :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
    let K_rect : Set ℂ := ψ_ℂ '' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (-δ / 2) (δ / 2))
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K_rect := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hψ_cont
    have hK_sub_Rδ : K_rect ⊆ R_δ := by
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      have hre : (ψ_ℂ (x, y)).re = x := by simp [ψ_ℂ]
      have him : (ψ_ℂ (x, y)).im = y := by simp [ψ_ℂ]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let Z_K : Set ℂ := K_rect ∩ h ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}
    have hZK_closed : IsClosed Z_K :=
      (hh_diff.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_Rδ).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed
        hK_comp.isClosed isClosed_singleton
    have hZK_comp : IsCompact Z_K :=
      hK_comp.of_isClosed_subset hZK_closed Set.inter_subset_left
    have h_iso : ∀ z : ↥Z_K, ∃ r_z : ℝ, 0 < r_z ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball z.1 r_z, w ≠ z.1 → h w ≠ 0 := by
      intro z
      have hz_Rδ : z.1 ∈ R_δ := hK_sub_Rδ z.2.1
      rcases (hh_ana z.1 hz_Rδ).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with h_ev0 | h_ev_ne
      · exfalso
        have h0_eq : h 0 = 0 :=
          AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
            hh_ana hRδ_preconn hz_Rδ h_ev0 h0_Rδ
        exact hh0 h0_eq
      · rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at h_ev_ne
        obtain ⟨r_z, hr_z_pos, hr_z⟩ := h_ev_ne
        exact ⟨r_z, hr_z_pos, fun w hw hw_ne => hr_z (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw) hw_ne⟩
    choose r_iso hr_iso_pos hr_iso using h_iso
    obtain ⟨t_cov, ht_cov⟩ :=
      hZK_comp.elim_finite_subcover
        (fun z : ↥Z_K => Metric.ball z.1 (r_iso z))
        (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
        (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_iso_pos ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩)
    have hZK_sub_fin : Z_K ⊆ Subtype.val '' (t_cov : Set ↥Z_K) := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_un := ht_cov hw
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hw_un with ⟨z, hz_t, hw_ball⟩
      refine ⟨z, hz_t, ?_⟩
      by_contra hw_ne
      exact hr_iso z w hw_ball (Ne.symm hw_ne) hw.2
    have hZK_fin : Z_K.Finite := (t_cov.finite_toSet.image Subtype.val).subset hZK_sub_fin
    let F_im : Set ℝ := Complex.im '' Z_K
    have hFim_fin : F_im.Finite := hZK_fin.image Complex.im
    let g_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => η₀ / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have hg_inj : Function.Injective g_seq := by
      intro m n hmn
      dsimp [g_seq] at hmn
      have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      rw [div_eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hm_pos) (ne_of_gt hn_pos)] at hmn
      have h_lin : 4 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) = 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
        mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hη₀_pos) (by linarith)
      have h_cast : (m : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by linarith
      exact Nat.cast_inj.mp h_cast
    have hg_inf : (Set.range g_seq).Infinite := Set.infinite_range_of_injective hg_inj
    have hex_n : ∃ n : ℕ, g_seq n ∉ F_im := by
      by_contra h_all
      push Not at h_all
      exact hg_inf (hFim_fin.subset (by rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩; exact h_all n))
    obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀_not_mem⟩ := hex_n
    let s₀ : ℝ := g_seq n₀
    have hs₀_pos : 0 < s₀ := by
      dsimp [s₀, g_seq]
      exact div_pos hη₀_pos (by positivity)
    have hs₀_lt_η₀ : s₀ < η₀ := by
      dsimp [s₀, g_seq]
      have hden_gt : (1 : ℝ) < 4 * ((n₀ : ℝ) + 1) := by
        have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n₀ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n₀
        linarith
      exact div_lt_self hη₀_pos hden_gt
    have hs₀_le_δ2 : s₀ ≤ δ / 2 :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hs₀_lt_η₀ (min_le_left _ _))
    have hs₀_lt_r₀ : s₀ < r₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hs₀_lt_η₀ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hs₀_lt_r₁ : s₀ < r₁ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hs₀_lt_η₀ (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    let z₁ : ℂ := (s₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let z₂ : ℂ := 1 + (s₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    refine ⟨φ z₁, φ z₂, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro τ hτ
      have h_pt : (1 - τ) • p_a + τ • φ z₁ = φ (((τ * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        rw [← hφ0, hφ_seg]
        congr 1
        dsimp [z₁]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_pt]
      let ζ₁ : ℂ := ((τ * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hτs_nonneg : 0 ≤ τ * s₀ := mul_nonneg hτ.1 (le_of_lt hs₀_pos)
      have hτs_le : τ * s₀ ≤ s₀ := mul_le_of_le_one_left (le_of_lt hs₀_pos) hτ.2
      have hζ₁_Rδ : ζ₁ ∈ R_δ := by
        have hre : ζ₁.re = 0 := by simp [ζ₁]
        have him : ζ₁.im = τ * s₀ := by simp [ζ₁]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hζ₁_ball : ζ₁ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        dsimp [ζ₁]
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg hτs_nonneg]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hτs_le hs₀_lt_r₀
      exact ⟨hφ_maps hζ₁_Rδ, hr₀_nz hζ₁_ball⟩
    · 
      intro τ hτ
      have h_pt : (1 - τ) • φ z₁ + τ • φ z₂ = φ (ψ_ℂ (τ, s₀)) := by
        rw [hφ_seg]
        congr 1
        dsimp [z₁, z₂, ψ_ℂ]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_pt]
      let ζ₂ : ℂ := ψ_ℂ (τ, s₀)
      have hζ₂_K : ζ₂ ∈ K_rect :=
        ⟨(τ, s₀), ⟨hτ, ⟨by linarith, hs₀_le_δ2⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hφ_maps (hK_sub_Rδ hζ₂_K), ?_⟩
      intro hh_zero
      apply hn₀_not_mem
      have hζ₂_ZK : ζ₂ ∈ Z_K := ⟨hζ₂_K, hh_zero⟩
      have him : ζ₂.im = s₀ := by simp [ζ₂, ψ_ℂ]
      exact ⟨ζ₂, hζ₂_ZK, him⟩
    · 
      intro τ hτ
      have h_pt : (1 - τ) • φ z₂ + τ • p_b =
          φ (1 + (((1 - τ) * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
        rw [← hφ1, hφ_seg]
        congr 1
        dsimp [z₂]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_pt]
      let ζ₃ : ℂ := 1 + (((1 - τ) * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have h1τ_nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - τ) * s₀ :=
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hτ.2) (le_of_lt hs₀_pos)
      have h1τ_le : (1 - τ) * s₀ ≤ s₀ :=
        mul_le_of_le_one_left (le_of_lt hs₀_pos) (by linarith [hτ.1])
      have hζ₃_Rδ : ζ₃ ∈ R_δ := by
        have hre : ζ₃.re = 1 := by simp [ζ₃]
        have him : ζ₃.im = (1 - τ) * s₀ := by simp [ζ₃]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hζ₃_ball : ζ₃ ∈ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) r₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hsub : ζ₃ - 1 = (((1 - τ) * s₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          dsimp [ζ₃]; ring
        rw [hsub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg h1τ_nonneg]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1τ_le hs₀_lt_r₁
      exact ⟨hφ_maps hζ₃_Rδ, hr₁_nz hζ₃_ball⟩

  refine {
    isPreconnected_compl_zero := ?_
    exists_nonzero_finset_on_open := ?_
    detour_root_chain := ?_
  }
  · 
    intro U H hU hConv hH
    refine isPreconnected_of_forall_pair (fun p_a hp_a p_b hp_b => ?_)
    obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, hseg₁, hseg₂, hseg₃⟩ :=
      hDetour hU hConv hH hp_a.1 hp_a.2 hp_b.1 hp_b.2
    let segSet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      fun q q' => (fun τ : ℝ => (1 - τ) • q + τ • q') '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    have hseg_pre : ∀ q q', IsPreconnected (segSet q q') := fun q q' =>
      isPreconnected_Icc.image _
        (((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).smul continuous_const).add
          (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousOn
    have hseg_left : ∀ q q', q ∈ segSet q q' :=
      fun q q' => ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, by simp⟩
    have hseg_right : ∀ q q', q' ∈ segSet q q' :=
      fun q q' => ⟨1, ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩, by simp⟩
    let T : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (segSet p_a p₁ ∪ segSet p₁ p₂) ∪ segSet p₂ p_b
    have hT_sub : T ⊆ { p ∈ U | H p ≠ 0 } := by
      rintro q ((⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ | ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩) | ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩)
      · exact hseg₁ τ hτ
      · exact hseg₂ τ hτ
      · exact hseg₃ τ hτ
    have hT₁₂_pre : IsPreconnected (segSet p_a p₁ ∪ segSet p₁ p₂) :=
      IsPreconnected.union p₁ (hseg_right p_a p₁) (hseg_left p₁ p₂)
        (hseg_pre p_a p₁) (hseg_pre p₁ p₂)

        IsOpen V → IsPreconnected V → V ⊆ W_reg → q₀ ∈ V →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ V →
        (∀ q ∈ V, P_fn ι q (g₁ q) = 0) →
        (∀ q ∈ V, P_fn ι q (g₂ q) = 0) →
        g₁ q₀ = g₂ q₀ →
        ∀ q ∈ V, g₁ q = g₂ q := by
      intro ι V g₁ g₂ q₀ hV_open hV_preconn hV_sub hq₀ hg₁ hg₂ hg₁_sol hg₂_sol hg_eq
      let S_eq : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q ∈ V | g₁ q = g₂ q }
      have hSeq_open : IsOpen S_eq := by
        rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
        intro q_s ⟨hq_V, hq_eq⟩
        let z_s := g₁ q_s
        obtain ⟨δ_q, δ_z, ρ, hδ_q_pos, hδ_z_pos, _, _, _, _, hρ_uniq⟩ :=
          hLoc_sheet ι q_s (hV_sub hq_V) z_s (hg₁_sol q_s hq_V)
        have hg₁_cont : ContinuousAt g₁ q_s :=
          (hg₁.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq_V)).continuousAt
        have hg₂_cont : ContinuousAt g₂ q_s :=
          (hg₂.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq_V)).continuousAt
        have hz₁_mem : g₁ ⁻¹' Metric.ball z_s δ_z ∈ nhds q_s :=
          hg₁_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z_s hδ_z_pos)
        have hz₂_mem : g₂ ⁻¹' Metric.ball z_s δ_z ∈ nhds q_s :=
          hg₂_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (hq_eq ▸ Metric.ball_mem_nhds z_s hδ_z_pos)
        have hM_nhds :
            V ∩ Metric.ball q_s δ_q ∩ g₁ ⁻¹' Metric.ball z_s δ_z ∩
              g₂ ⁻¹' Metric.ball z_s δ_z ∈ nhds q_s :=
          Filter.inter_mem
            (Filter.inter_mem
              (Filter.inter_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hq_V) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds q_s hδ_q_pos))
              hz₁_mem)
            hz₂_mem
        obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hM_nhds
        refine ⟨r, hr_pos, fun p hp => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hp_V, hp_δq⟩, hp_g₁⟩, hp_g₂⟩ := hr_sub hp
        have h1 : g₁ p = ρ p := hρ_uniq p hp_δq (g₁ p) hp_g₁ (hg₁_sol p hp_V)
        have h2 : g₂ p = ρ p := hρ_uniq p hp_δq (g₂ p) hp_g₂ (hg₂_sol p hp_V)
        exact ⟨hp_V, h1.trans h2.symm⟩
      have hSeq_closed : closure S_eq ∩ V ⊆ S_eq := by
        rintro q_s ⟨hq_cl, hq_V⟩
        refine ⟨hq_V, ?_⟩
        by_contra h_ne
        have hg₁_cont : ContinuousAt g₁ q_s :=
          (hg₁.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq_V)).continuousAt
        have hg₂_cont : ContinuousAt g₂ q_s :=
          (hg₂.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hq_V)).continuousAt
        have h_sub_ne : g₁ q_s - g₂ q_s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
        have h_ev : ∀ᶠ p in nhds q_s, g₁ p - g₂ p ≠ 0 :=
          (hg₁_cont.sub hg₂_cont).preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds h_sub_ne)
        obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, hr_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_ev
        obtain ⟨p, hp_Seq, hp_dist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hq_cl r hr_pos
        have hp_ball : p ∈ Metric.ball q_s r := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]
          exact hp_dist
        exact hr_sub hp_ball (sub_eq_zero.mpr hp_Seq.2)
      have hV_sub_Seq : V ⊆ S_eq :=
        hV_preconn.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hSeq_open ⟨q₀, hq₀, hq₀, hg_eq⟩ hSeq_closed
      exact fun q hq => (hV_sub_Seq hq).2
    
    let P_poly : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → Polynomial ℂ :=
      fun ι q => ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), Polynomial.C (C_poly ι d q) * Polynomial.X ^ (d : ℕ)
    have hP_eval : ∀ ι q z, Polynomial.eval z (P_poly ι q) = P_fn ι q z := by
      intro ι q z
      simp [P_poly, P_fn, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    have hPz_eval : ∀ ι q z,
        Polynomial.eval z (Polynomial.derivative (P_poly ι q)) = Pz_fn ι q z := by
      intro ι q z
      simp only [P_poly, map_sum, Polynomial.derivative_C_mul_X_pow, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum,
        Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, CharP.cast_eq_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, Fin.val_succ,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel, Pz_fn]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      push_cast
      ring
    have hP_deg_ne : ∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ q ∈ W_reg,
        P_poly ι q ≠ 0 ∧ (P_poly ι q).natDegree = D_det ι ∧
        (P_poly ι q).roots.toFinset.card = D_det ι := by
      intro ι q hq
      have h_coeff : ∀ n : ℕ, (P_poly ι q).coeff n =
          ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), if n = (d : ℕ) then C_poly ι d q else 0 := by
        intro n
        simp [P_poly, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
      have h_coeff_D : (P_poly ι q).coeff (D_det ι) = C_poly ι (Fin.last (D_det ι)) q := by
        rw [h_coeff (D_det ι)]
        have h_eq :
            (∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), if D_det ι = (d : ℕ) then C_poly ι d q else 0) =
            ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), if d = Fin.last (D_det ι) then C_poly ι d q else 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
          have h_iff : (D_det ι = (d : ℕ)) ↔ (d = Fin.last (D_det ι)) :=
            ⟨fun h => Fin.ext h.symm, fun h => by subst h; rfl⟩
          simp [h_iff]
        rw [h_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (Fin.last (D_det ι))]
        simp
      have h_ne : P_poly ι q ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply (hSep_reg ι q hq).1
        rw [← h_coeff_D, h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero]
      have h_deg_ge : D_det ι ≤ (P_poly ι q).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (h_coeff_D ▸ (hSep_reg ι q hq).1)
      have h_deg_le : (P_poly ι q).natDegree ≤ D_det ι := by
        rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
        intro N hN
        rw [h_coeff N]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun d _ => ?_)
        have h_neq : N ≠ (d : ℕ) := by have := d.2; omega
        simp [h_neq]
      have h_deg : (P_poly ι q).natDegree = D_det ι := le_antisymm h_deg_le h_deg_ge
      have h_nodup : (P_poly ι q).roots.Nodup := by
        rw [Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one]
        intro z
        rw [Polynomial.count_roots]
        by_contra h_gt
        have h_one_lt : 1 < Polynomial.rootMultiplicity z (P_poly ι q) := not_le.mp h_gt
        obtain ⟨h_root, h_droot⟩ :=
          (Polynomial.one_lt_rootMultiplicity_iff_isRoot h_ne).mp h_one_lt
        rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, hP_eval] at h_root
        rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, hPz_eval] at h_droot
        exact (hSep_reg ι q hq).2 z h_root h_droot
      have h_card : (P_poly ι q).roots.toFinset.card = D_det ι := by
        rw [Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup h_nodup, IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, h_deg]
      exact ⟨h_ne, h_deg, h_card⟩
    have hTriv_one : ∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ q ∈ W_reg, ∃ r_q : ℝ, 0 < r_q ∧
        Metric.ball q r_q ⊆ W_reg ∧
        ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball q r_q, ∀ z_s : ℂ, P_fn ι q' z_s = 0 →
          ∃ σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball q r_q) ∧
            σ q' = z_s ∧
            ∀ q'' ∈ Metric.ball q r_q, P_fn ι q'' (σ q'') = 0 := by
      intro ι q hq
      obtain ⟨hPq_ne, _, hS₀_card⟩ := hP_deg_ne ι q hq
      let S₀ : Finset ℂ := (P_poly ι q).roots.toFinset
      have h_root_S₀ : ∀ z : ↥S₀, P_fn ι q z.1 = 0 := by
        intro z
        have hz_mem : z.1 ∈ (P_poly ι q).roots := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp z.2
        have hz_isRoot : (P_poly ι q).IsRoot z.1 := (Polynomial.mem_roots hPq_ne).mp hz_mem
        rwa [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, hP_eval] at hz_isRoot
      choose δ_z _ ρ_z hδ_z_pos _ _ hρ_z_holo hρ_z_pt hρ_z_sol _ using
        fun z : ↥S₀ => hLoc_sheet ι q hq z.1 (h_root_S₀ z)
      have hM_balls : (⋂ z : ↥S₀, Metric.ball q (δ_z z)) ∈ nhds q :=
        Filter.iInter_mem.mpr (fun z => Metric.ball_mem_nhds q (hδ_z_pos z))
      have hM_sep :
          (⋂ p : ↥S₀ × ↥S₀, { q' : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ≠ p.2 → ρ_z p.1 q' ≠ ρ_z p.2 q' }) ∈ nhds q := by
        rw [Filter.iInter_mem]
        intro ⟨z₁, z₂⟩
        by_cases h_eq : z₁ = z₂
        · exact Filter.univ_mem' (fun _ h_ne => False.elim (h_ne h_eq))
        · have hc₁ : ContinuousAt (ρ_z z₁) q :=
            ((hρ_z_holo z₁).differentiableAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₁)))).continuousAt
          have hc₂ : ContinuousAt (ρ_z z₂) q :=
            ((hρ_z_holo z₂).differentiableAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (hδ_z_pos z₂)))).continuousAt
          have h_diff_ne : ρ_z z₁ q - ρ_z z₂ q ≠ 0 := by
            rw [hρ_z_pt z₁, hρ_z_pt z₂]
            exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun hv => h_eq (Subtype.ext hv))
          have h_ev : ∀ᶠ q' in nhds q, ρ_z z₁ q' - ρ_z z₂ q' ≠ 0 :=
            (hc₁.sub hc₂).preimage_mem_nhds (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds h_diff_ne)
          exact Filter.mem_of_superset h_ev (fun q' hq' _ => sub_ne_zero.mp hq')
      have hM_all :
          W_reg ∩ (⋂ z : ↥S₀, Metric.ball q (δ_z z)) ∩
            (⋂ p : ↥S₀ × ↥S₀, { q' : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ≠ p.2 → ρ_z p.1 q' ≠ ρ_z p.2 q' }) ∈ nhds q :=
        Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds hq) hM_balls) hM_sep
      obtain ⟨r_q, hr_q_pos, hr_q_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hM_all
      refine ⟨r_q, hr_q_pos, fun q' hq' => (hr_q_sub hq').1.1, ?_⟩
      intro q' hq' z_s hz_s
      obtain ⟨⟨hq'_W, hq'_balls⟩, hq'_sep⟩ := hr_q_sub hq'
      obtain ⟨hPq'_ne, hPq'_deg, _⟩ := hP_deg_ne ι q' hq'_W
      let f_q' : ↥S₀ → ℂ := fun z => ρ_z z q'
      have hf_inj : Function.Injective f_q' := by
        intro z₁ z₂ h_feq
        by_contra h_ne
        exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hq'_sep (z₁, z₂) h_ne h_feq
      let T_q' : Finset ℂ := S₀.attach.image f_q'
      have hT_card : T_q'.card = D_det ι := by
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective S₀.attach hf_inj, Finset.card_attach]
        exact hS₀_card
      have hT_roots_eval : ∀ w ∈ T_q', Polynomial.eval w (P_poly ι q') = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
        rw [hP_eval]
        exact (hρ_z_sol z q' (Set.mem_iInter.mp hq'_balls z)).2
      have h_roots_eq : (P_poly ι q').roots = T_q'.val :=
        Polynomial.roots_eq_of_natDegree_le_card_of_ne_zero hT_roots_eval
          (by rw [hPq'_deg, hT_card]) hPq'_ne
      have hz_mem_roots : z_s ∈ (P_poly ι q').roots :=
        (Polynomial.mem_roots hPq'_ne).mpr
          (by rw [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, hP_eval]; exact hz_s)
      rw [h_roots_eq] at hz_mem_roots
      have hz_mem_T : z_s ∈ T_q' := hz_mem_roots
      obtain ⟨z, _, hz_eq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz_mem_T
      have h_sub_z : Metric.ball q r_q ⊆ Metric.ball q (δ_z z) :=
        fun q'' hq'' => Set.mem_iInter.mp (hr_q_sub hq'').1.2 z
      exact ⟨ρ_z z, (hρ_z_holo z).mono h_sub_z, hz_eq,
        fun q'' hq'' => (hρ_z_sol z q'' (h_sub_z hq'')).2⟩
    have hTriv_both : ∀ q ∈ W_reg, ∃ r_q : ℝ, 0 < r_q ∧
        Metric.ball q r_q ⊆ W_reg ∧
        ∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball q r_q, ∀ z_s : ℂ, P_fn ι q' z_s = 0 →
          ∃ σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball q r_q) ∧
            σ q' = z_s ∧
            ∀ q'' ∈ Metric.ball q r_q, P_fn ι q'' (σ q'') = 0 := by

      obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, _, hr₁_lift⟩ := hTriv_one 1 q hq
      refine ⟨min r₀ r₁, lt_min hr₀_pos hr₁_pos,

      fin_cases ι

        exact ⟨σ, hσ_holo.mono hsub, hσ_pt, fun q'' hq'' => hσ_sol q'' (hsub hq'')⟩
      · have hsub : Metric.ball q (min r₀ r₁) ⊆ Metric.ball q r₁ :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
        obtain ⟨σ, hσ_holo, hσ_pt, hσ_sol⟩ := hr₁_lift q' (hsub hq') z_s hz_s
        exact ⟨σ, hσ_holo.mono hsub, hσ_pt, fun q'' hq'' => hσ_sol q'' (hsub hq'')⟩
    
    have hSeg : ∀ (q₀ q₁ : ℂ × ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ) (M₀ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 - τ) • q₀ + τ • q₁ ∈ W_reg) →
        0 < r₀ →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₀ ι) (Metric.ball q₀ r₀)) →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r₀, P_fn ι q (M₀ ι q) = 0) →
        ∃ (r₁ : ℝ) (M₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < r₁ ∧ Metric.ball q₁ r₁ ⊆ W_reg ∧
          (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M₁ ι) (Metric.ball q₁ r₁)) ∧
          (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₁ r₁, P_fn ι q (M₁ ι q) = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (RootDetourChain W_reg C_poly q₀ r₀ M₀ q₁ r₁ M₁) := by
      intro q₀ q₁ r₀ M₀ hseg hr₀ hM₀_holo hM₀_sol
      let γ : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun τ => (1 - τ) • q₀ + τ • q₁
      have hγ_cont : Continuous γ :=
        ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).smul continuous_const).add
          (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
      let S_seg : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := γ '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
      have hS_comp : IsCompact S_seg := isCompact_Icc.image hγ_cont
      have hS_sub_W : S_seg ⊆ W_reg := by
        rintro x ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩

        fun p : ↥S_seg => hTriv_both p.1 (hS_sub_W p.2)
      have hS_cov : S_seg ⊆ ⋃ p : ↥S_seg, Metric.ball p.1 (r_triv p) :=
        fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_triv_pos ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩
      obtain ⟨δ_leb, hδ_leb_pos, hδ_leb⟩ :=
        lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hS_comp (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hS_cov
      have hLift_seg : ∀ x ∈ S_seg,
          Metric.ball x δ_leb ⊆ W_reg ∧
          ∀ (ι : Fin 2), ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball x δ_leb, ∀ z_s : ℂ, P_fn ι q' z_s = 0 →
            ∃ σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
              DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball x δ_leb) ∧
              σ q' = z_s ∧
              ∀ q'' ∈ Metric.ball x δ_leb, P_fn ι q'' (σ q'') = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨p, hp_sub⟩ := hδ_leb x hx
        refine ⟨Set.Subset.trans hp_sub (hr_triv_W p), ?_⟩
        intro ι q' hq' z_s hz_s
        obtain ⟨σ, hσ_holo, hσ_pt, hσ_sol⟩ := hr_triv_lift p ι q' (hp_sub hq') z_s hz_s
        exact ⟨σ, hσ_holo.mono hp_sub, hσ_pt, fun q'' hq'' => hσ_sol q'' (hp_sub hq'')⟩
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (dist q₀ q₁ / δ_leb)
      let N : ℕ := max N₀ 1
      have hN_ge_one : 1 ≤ N := le_max_right N₀ 1
      have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_ge_one
      have hstep_lt : dist q₀ q₁ / (N : ℝ) < δ_leb := by
        have hN₀_le : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_max_left N₀ 1)
        have h_lt_N : dist q₀ q₁ / δ_leb < (N : ℝ) := lt_of_lt_of_le hN₀_gt hN₀_le
        have h_mul : dist q₀ q₁ < (N : ℝ) * δ_leb := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ_leb_pos).mp h_lt_N
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      let s_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((min k N : ℕ) : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)
      let c_fn : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun k => γ (s_fn k)
      let r_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then min r₀ δ_leb else δ_leb
      have hs_mem : ∀ k : ℕ, s_fn k ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        intro k
        refine ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (le_of_lt hN_pos), ?_⟩
        exact (div_le_one hN_pos).mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr (min_le_right k N))
      have hc_mem : ∀ k : ℕ, c_fn k ∈ S_seg :=
        fun k => ⟨s_fn k, hs_mem k, rfl⟩
      have hc_zero : c_fn 0 = q₀ := by
        dsimp [c_fn, s_fn, γ]
        simp
      have hc_last : c_fn N = q₁ := by
        have hsN : s_fn N = 1 := by
          dsimp [s_fn]
          rw [min_self, div_self (ne_of_gt hN_pos)]
        dsimp [c_fn]
        rw [hsN]
        dsimp [γ]
        simp
      have hr_fn_pos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < r_fn k := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · simp [r_fn, hk, lt_min hr₀ hδ_leb_pos]
        · simp [r_fn, hk, hδ_leb_pos]
      have hr_fn_le : ∀ k : ℕ, r_fn k ≤ δ_leb := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = 0
        · simp [r_fn, hk, min_le_right r₀ δ_leb]
        · simp [r_fn, hk]
      have hball_fn_W : ∀ k : ℕ, Metric.ball (c_fn k) (r_fn k) ⊆ W_reg :=
        fun k => Set.Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hr_fn_le k))
          (hLift_seg (c_fn k) (hc_mem k)).1
      have hc_in_next : ∀ k : ℕ, c_fn k ∈ Metric.ball (c_fn (k + 1)) (r_fn (k + 1)) := by
        intro k
        have hr_succ : r_fn (k + 1) = δ_leb := by simp [r_fn]
        rw [hr_succ, Metric.mem_ball]
        have hγ_sub : γ (s_fn k) - γ (s_fn (k + 1)) =
            (s_fn k - s_fn (k + 1)) • (q₁ - q₀) := by
          ext <;>
            simp only [γ, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
              Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Complex.real_smul] <;>
            push_cast <;> ring
        have h_dist_eq : dist (c_fn k) (c_fn (k + 1)) =
            |s_fn (k + 1) - s_fn k| * dist q₀ q₁ := by
          dsimp [c_fn]
          rw [dist_eq_norm, hγ_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm,
            ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm q₁ q₀]
        have hmin1 : min k N ≤ min (k + 1) N := by omega
        have hmin2 : min (k + 1) N ≤ min k N + 1 := by omega
        have h_num_nonneg :
            0 ≤ ((min (k + 1) N : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((min k N : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
          sub_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hmin1)
        have h_num_le :
            ((min (k + 1) N : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((min k N : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
          have hc : ((min (k + 1) N : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((min k N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
            Nat.cast_le.mpr hmin2
          rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hc
          linarith
        have hs_diff_le : |s_fn (k + 1) - s_fn k| ≤ 1 / (N : ℝ) := by
          dsimp [s_fn]
          rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg h_num_nonneg, abs_of_pos hN_pos]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num_le (le_of_lt hN_pos)
        calc dist (c_fn k) (c_fn (k + 1))
            = |s_fn (k + 1) - s_fn k| * dist q₀ q₁ := h_dist_eq
          _ ≤ (1 / (N : ℝ)) * dist q₀ q₁ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_diff_le dist_nonneg
          _ = dist q₀ q₁ / (N : ℝ) := one_div_mul_eq_div _ _
          _ < δ_leb := hstep_lt
      let ChainNode (k : ℕ) : Type :=
        { M : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ //
          ∀ ι : Fin 2,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (M ι) (Metric.ball (c_fn k) (r_fn k)) ∧
            ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c_fn k) (r_fn k), P_fn ι q (M ι q) = 0 }
      let baseNode : ChainNode 0 :=
        ⟨M₀, fun ι => by
          have hsub0 : Metric.ball (c_fn 0) (r_fn 0) ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ r₀ := by
            rw [hc_zero]
            exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r₀ δ_leb)
          exact ⟨(hM₀_holo ι).mono hsub0, fun q hq => hM₀_sol ι q (hsub0 hq)⟩⟩
      let stepEx : ∀ (k : ℕ) (prev : ChainNode k) (ι : Fin 2),
          ∃ σ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball (c_fn (k + 1)) δ_leb) ∧
            σ (c_fn k) = prev.1 ι (c_fn k) ∧
            ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball (c_fn (k + 1)) δ_leb, P_fn ι q (σ q) = 0 :=
        fun k prev ι =>
          (hLift_seg (c_fn (k + 1)) (hc_mem (k + 1))).2 ι (c_fn k)
            (by simpa [r_fn] using hc_in_next k)
            (prev.1 ι (c_fn k))
            ((prev.2 ι).2 (c_fn k) (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_fn_pos k)))
      let stepNode : ∀ (k : ℕ), ChainNode k → ChainNode (k + 1) :=
        fun k prev =>
          ⟨fun ι => Classical.choose (stepEx k prev ι),
           fun ι => by
             have hspec := Classical.choose_spec (stepEx k prev ι)
             have hr_succ : r_fn (k + 1) = δ_leb := by simp [r_fn]
             rw [hr_succ]
             exact ⟨hspec.1, hspec.2.2⟩⟩
      let seqNode : ∀ k : ℕ, ChainNode k :=
        fun k => Nat.rec baseNode stepNode k
      have hseq_match : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ι : Fin 2),
          (seqNode (k + 1)).1 ι (c_fn k) = (seqNode k).1 ι (c_fn k) :=
        fun k ι => (Classical.choose_spec (stepEx k (seqNode k) ι)).2.1
      let r₁ : ℝ := δ_leb
      let M₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := (seqNode N).1
      have hN_ne_zero : N ≠ 0 := by omega
      have hrN_eq : r_fn N = r₁ := by simp [r_fn, hN_ne_zero, r₁]
      refine ⟨r₁, M₁, hδ_leb_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hc_last, ← hrN_eq]
        exact hball_fn_W N
      · intro ι
        rw [← hc_last, ← hrN_eq]
        exact ((seqNode N).2 ι).1
      · intro ι q hq
        rw [← hc_last, ← hrN_eq] at hq
        exact ((seqNode N).2 ι).2 q hq
      · refine ⟨{
          L_ch := N
          c_ch := fun j => c_fn j.1
          r_ch := fun j => r_fn j.1
          M_ch := fun j => (seqNode j.1).1
          r_ch_pos := fun j => hr_fn_pos j.1
          ball_sub_reg := fun j => hball_fn_W j.1
          start_eq := ⟨hc_zero, by
            rw [show (0 : Fin (N + 1)).1 = 0 from rfl, hc_zero]
            exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r₀ δ_leb),
            fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
          end_eq := ⟨hc_last, hrN_eq, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
          step_overlap := fun j => by
            let B_ov : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              Metric.ball (c_fn j.1) (r_fn j.1) ∩
                Metric.ball (c_fn (j.1 + 1)) (r_fn (j.1 + 1))
            have hcj_mem : c_fn j.1 ∈ B_ov :=
              ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hr_fn_pos j.1), hc_in_next j.1⟩
            refine ⟨⟨c_fn j.1, hcj_mem⟩, fun ι q hq => ?_⟩
            have hB_open : IsOpen B_ov := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
            have hB_preconn : IsPreconnected B_ov :=
              ((convex_ball (c_fn j.1) (r_fn j.1)).inter
                (convex_ball (c_fn (j.1 + 1)) (r_fn (j.1 + 1)))).isPreconnected
            have hB_sub_W : B_ov ⊆ W_reg :=
              Set.Subset.trans Set.inter_subset_left (hball_fn_W j.1)
            exact hUniq ι B_ov ((seqNode j.1).1 ι) ((seqNode (j.1 + 1)).1 ι)
              (c_fn j.1) hB_open hB_preconn hB_sub_W hcj_mem
              (((seqNode j.1).2 ι).1.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
              (((seqNode (j.1 + 1)).2 ι).1.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
              (fun p hp => ((seqNode j.1).2 ι).2 p hp.1)
              (fun p hp => ((seqNode (j.1 + 1)).2 ι).2 p hp.2)
              (hseq_match j.1 ι).symm q hq
          holo_and_solves := fun j ι => (seqNode j.1).2 ι
        }⟩
    
    have hTrans : ∀ {p₀ p₁ p₂ : ℂ × ℂ} {r₀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ}
        {M₀ M₁ M₂ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        RootDetourChain W_reg C_poly p₀ r₀ M₀ p₁ r₁ M₁ →
        RootDetourChain W_reg C_poly p₁ r₁ M₁ p₂ r₂ M₂ →
        Nonempty (RootDetourChain W_reg C_poly p₀ r₀ M₀ p₂ r₂ M₂) := by
      intro p₀ p₁ p₂ r₀ r₁ r₂ M₀ M₁ M₂ ch₁ ch₂
      let L_tot : ℕ := ch₁.L_ch + 1 + ch₂.L_ch
      let c_tot : Fin (L_tot + 1) → ℂ × ℂ := fun k =>
        if hk : k.1 < ch₁.L_ch + 1 then ch₁.c_ch ⟨k.1, hk⟩
        else ch₂.c_ch ⟨k.1 - (ch₁.L_ch + 1), by omega⟩
      let r_tot : Fin (L_tot + 1) → ℝ := fun k =>
        if hk : k.1 < ch₁.L_ch + 1 then ch₁.r_ch ⟨k.1, hk⟩
        else ch₂.r_ch ⟨k.1 - (ch₁.L_ch + 1), by omega⟩
      let M_tot : Fin (L_tot + 1) → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun k =>
        if hk : k.1 < ch₁.L_ch + 1 then ch₁.M_ch ⟨k.1, hk⟩
        else ch₂.M_ch ⟨k.1 - (ch₁.L_ch + 1), by omega⟩
      refine ⟨{
        L_ch := L_tot
        c_ch := c_tot
        r_ch := r_tot
        M_ch := M_tot
        r_ch_pos := fun k => by
          dsimp [r_tot]
          split_ifs with hk
          · exact ch₁.r_ch_pos ⟨k.1, hk⟩
          · exact ch₂.r_ch_pos _
        ball_sub_reg := fun k => by
          dsimp [c_tot, r_tot]
          split_ifs with hk
          · exact ch₁.ball_sub_reg ⟨k.1, hk⟩
          · exact ch₂.ball_sub_reg _
        start_eq := by
          have hc0 : c_tot 0 = ch₁.c_ch 0 := rfl
          have hr0 : r_tot 0 = ch₁.r_ch 0 := rfl
          have hM0 : M_tot 0 = ch₁.M_ch 0 := rfl
          rw [hc0, hr0, hM0]
          exact ch₁.start_eq
        end_eq := by
          have hcl : c_tot (Fin.last L_tot) = ch₂.c_ch (Fin.last ch₂.L_ch) := by
            dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
            · exfalso; dsimp [L_tot] at h; omega
            · congr 1; ext; dsimp [L_tot]; omega
          have hrl : r_tot (Fin.last L_tot) = ch₂.r_ch (Fin.last ch₂.L_ch) := by
            dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
            · exfalso; dsimp [L_tot] at h; omega
            · congr 1; ext; dsimp [L_tot]; omega
          have hMl : M_tot (Fin.last L_tot) = ch₂.M_ch (Fin.last ch₂.L_ch) := by
            dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
            · exfalso; dsimp [L_tot] at h; omega
            · congr 1; ext; dsimp [L_tot]; omega
          rw [hcl, hrl, hMl]
          exact ch₂.end_eq
        step_overlap := fun j => by
          rcases lt_trichotomy j.1 ch₁.L_ch with hj_lt | hj_eq | hj_gt
          · let j₁ : Fin ch₁.L_ch := ⟨j.1, hj_lt⟩
            have hc1 : c_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.c_ch j₁.castSucc := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            have hr1 : r_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.r_ch j₁.castSucc := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            have hM1 : M_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.M_ch j₁.castSucc := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            have hc2 : c_tot j.succ = ch₁.c_ch j₁.succ := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            have hr2 : r_tot j.succ = ch₁.r_ch j₁.succ := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            have hM2 : M_tot j.succ = ch₁.M_ch j₁.succ := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · rfl
              · exfalso; omega
            rw [hc1, hr1, hM1, hc2, hr2, hM2]
            exact ch₁.step_overlap j₁
          · have hc1 : c_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.c_ch (Fin.last ch₁.L_ch) := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
              · exfalso; omega
            have hr1 : r_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.r_ch (Fin.last ch₁.L_ch) := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
              · exfalso; omega
            have hM1 : M_tot j.castSucc = ch₁.M_ch (Fin.last ch₁.L_ch) := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
              · exfalso; omega
            have hc2 : c_tot j.succ = ch₂.c_ch 0 := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
            have hr2 : r_tot j.succ = ch₂.r_ch 0 := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
            have hM2 : M_tot j.succ = ch₂.M_ch 0 := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; simp [hj_eq]
            rw [hc1, hr1, hM1, hc2, hr2, hM2, ch₁.end_eq.1, ch₁.end_eq.2.1]
            have hp₁_mem2 : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball (ch₂.c_ch 0) (ch₂.r_ch 0) := by
              rw [ch₂.start_eq.1]
              exact Metric.mem_ball_self (ch₂.r_ch_pos 0)
            have hp₁_mem1 : p₁ ∈ Metric.ball p₁ r₁ := ch₂.start_eq.2.1 hp₁_mem2
            refine ⟨⟨p₁, hp₁_mem1, hp₁_mem2⟩, fun ι q hq => ?_⟩
            rw [ch₁.end_eq.2.2 ι q hq.1, ch₂.start_eq.2.2 ι q hq.2]
          · let j₂ : Fin ch₂.L_ch := ⟨j.1 - (ch₁.L_ch + 1), by omega⟩
            have hc1 : c_tot j.castSucc = ch₂.c_ch j₂.castSucc := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · rfl
            have hr1 : r_tot j.castSucc = ch₂.r_ch j₂.castSucc := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · rfl
            have hM1 : M_tot j.castSucc = ch₂.M_ch j₂.castSucc := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · rfl
            have hc2 : c_tot j.succ = ch₂.c_ch j₂.succ := by
              dsimp [c_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; dsimp [j₂]; omega
            have hr2 : r_tot j.succ = ch₂.r_ch j₂.succ := by
              dsimp [r_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; dsimp [j₂]; omega
            have hM2 : M_tot j.succ = ch₂.M_ch j₂.succ := by
              dsimp [M_tot]; split_ifs with h
              · exfalso; omega
              · congr 1; ext; dsimp [j₂]; omega
            rw [hc1, hr1, hM1, hc2, hr2, hM2]
            exact ch₂.step_overlap j₂
        holo_and_solves := fun k ι => by
          dsimp [c_tot, r_tot, M_tot]
          split_ifs with hk
          · exact ch₁.holo_and_solves ⟨k.1, hk⟩ ι
          · exact ch₂.holo_and_solves _ ι
      }⟩
    
    obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, hseg₁, hseg₂, hseg₃⟩ :=
      hDetour hU hConv hH hp_a hHa hp_b hHb
    obtain ⟨r₁, M₁, hr₁, _, hM₁_holo, hM₁_sol, ⟨ch₁⟩⟩ :=
      hSeg p_a p₁ r_a M_a hseg₁ hr_a hMa_holo hMa_sol
    obtain ⟨r₂, M₂, hr₂, _, hM₂_holo, hM₂_sol, ⟨ch₂⟩⟩ :=
      hSeg p₁ p₂ r₁ M₁ hseg₂ hr₁ hM₁_holo hM₁_sol
    obtain ⟨r_b, M_b, hr_b, hrb_sub, hMb_holo, hMb_sol, ⟨ch₃⟩⟩ :=
      hSeg p₂ p_b r₂ M₂ hseg₃ hr₂ hM₂_holo hM₂_sol
    obtain ⟨ch₁₂⟩ := hTrans ch₁ ch₂
    obtain ⟨ch₁₂₃⟩ := hTrans ch₁₂ ch₃
    exact ⟨r_b, M_b, hr_b, hrb_sub, hMb_holo, hMb_sol, ⟨ch₁₂₃⟩⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_pow_holo : ∀ {O : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f O → ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => f p ^ n) O := by
    intro O f hf n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero] using (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ O)
    | succ n ih =>
      have h_fn : (fun p => f p ^ (n + 1)) = (fun p => f p ^ n * f p) := by
        ext p; exact pow_succ (f p) n
      rw [h_fn]
      exact ih.mul hf
  
  have h_s2 : ∀ (r₀ : ℝ), 0 < r₀ →
      ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ H (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀) →
        (∃ p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀, H p ≠ 0) →
        ∃ (y₀ : ℝ) (r_y r_t : ℝ) (m_t : ℕ) (H_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          0 < r_y ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
          Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t ⊆
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ H_tilde (Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t, H_tilde p ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t,
            p.2 ^ m_t * H_tilde p = H p) := by
    intro r₀ hr₀ H hH_holo hH_nz
    let B₀ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀
    let B_orig : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := B₀ ×ˢ B₀
    have hB₀_open : IsOpen B₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hB_orig_open : IsOpen B_orig := hB₀_open.prod hB₀_open
    have hB_orig_preconn : IsPreconnected B_orig :=
      ((convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r₀).prod (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r₀)).isPreconnected
    have h0_B₀ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀
    have h0_orig : ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) ∈ B_orig := ⟨h0_B₀, h0_B₀⟩
    have h_iterY_zero : ∀ α : ℕ, iterDerivY α (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro α
      induction α with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ α ih =>
        ext p
        simp [iterDerivY, ih]
    have h_deriv_zero_fn : deriv (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      ext z
      exact deriv_const z (0 : ℂ)
    have h_iter_zero_1d : ∀ β : ℕ,
        (fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro β
      induction β with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ β ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, h_deriv_zero_fn, ih]
    have h_iterYT_zero : ∀ α β : ℕ, iterDerivYT α β (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro α β
      ext p
      simp [iterDerivYT, h_iterY_zero α, h_iter_zero_1d β]
    have h_real_slice_zero : ∀ {g : ℂ → ℂ},
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g B₀ →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r₀ / 2) (r₀ / 2), g (x : ℂ) = 0) →
        ∀ y ∈ B₀, g y = 0 := by
      intro g hg_holo hg_real
      let G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => g p.1
      have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G B_orig :=
        hg_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1)
      have hpderivD_G : pderivD G = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext p
        exact deriv_const p.2 (g p.1)
      have hG_beta_pos : ∀ α β' : ℕ, iterDerivYT α (β' + 1) G ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        intro α β'
        rw [(hKit.iterDerivYT_step hB_orig_open hG_holo α β' ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) h0_orig).2.1,
          hpderivD_G, h_iterYT_zero]
      have hG_real_alpha : ∀ α : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r₀ / 2) (r₀ / 2),
          iterDerivYT α 0 G ((x : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        intro α
        induction α with
        | zero =>
          intro x hx
          exact hg_real x hx
        | succ α ih =>
          intro x hx
          have hx_B₀ : (x : ℂ) ∈ B₀ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]

    intro M v
    by_cases hv : v.1 = 0 <;> simp only [lineJetEnv, hv, ↓reduceIte]
    · exact hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hV_det_open (hL0_holo v.2.1) v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
    · exact hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hV_det_open (hLb_holo v.2.1) v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1
  have hEval_holo_V : ∀ (M : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) P)
        V_det := by
    intro M P
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun Q_p => DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
          (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) Q_p)
        V_det)
      P
      (fun c => by
        simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_C] using
          (differentiableOn_const c : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ V_det))
      (fun P₁ P₂ ih₁ ih₂ => by
        have hfn :
            (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) (P₁ + P₂)) =
            (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) P₁ +
              MvPolynomial.eval
                (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) P₂) := by
          ext p; exact map_add _ P₁ P₂
        rw [hfn]
        exact ih₁.add ih₂)
      (fun P₁ v ih => by
        have hfn :
            (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p)
              (P₁ * MvPolynomial.X v)) =
            (fun p => MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p) P₁ *
              lineJetEnv M (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C (b : ℤ)) p v) := by
          ext p; simp only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
        rw [hfn]
        exact ih.mul (hJet_holo_V M v))
  have hA_holo_V : ∀ ι d, DifferentiableOn ℂ (A_coeff ι d) V_det :=
    fun ι d => hEval_holo_V (M_det ι) (Q_det ι d)
  have hΔ_holo_V : ∀ ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Δ_base ι) V_det :=
    fun ι => hEval_holo_V (M_det ι) (Disc_det ι)
  let Φ_solves : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun ι p =>
    ∑ d : Fin (D_det ι + 1), A_coeff ι d p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ)
  have hΦ_holo_V : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (Φ_solves ι) V_det := by
    intro ι
    have h_sum : ∀ s : Finset (Fin (D_det ι + 1)),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p => ∑ d ∈ s, A_coeff ι d p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ)) V_det := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty =>
        simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ))
      | @insert d s hd ih =>
        have h_fn :
            (fun p => ∑ j ∈ insert d s, A_coeff ι j p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (j : ℕ)) =
            (fun p => A_coeff ι d p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) +
              ∑ j ∈ s, A_coeff ι j p * (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
          ext p; exact Finset.sum_insert hd
        rw [h_fn]
        exact ((hA_holo_V ι d).mul (h_pow_holo (hL1_holo ι) (d : ℕ))).add ih
    exact h_sum Finset.univ
  let U_small : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < hDet.s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < hDet.r_det / (b : ℝ) }
  have hU_small_open : IsOpen U_small :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hU_small_ne : U_small.Nonempty :=
    ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), by simp [U_small, hDet.s_det_pos, div_pos hDet.r_det_pos hb_pos]⟩
  have hU_small_sub : U_small ⊆ V_det := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    have hp2_mul : ‖p.2‖ * (b : ℝ) < hDet.r_det := (lt_div_iff₀ hb_pos).mp hp2
    have h2_le : 2 * ‖p.2‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ * (b : ℝ) := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg p.2]
    have him_b : |(p.1 + (b : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + ‖p.2‖ * (b : ℝ) := by
      have him_eq : (p.1 + (b : ℂ) * p.2).im = p.1.im + (b : ℝ) * p.2.im := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him_eq]
      calc |p.1.im + (b : ℝ) * p.2.im|
          ≤ |p.1.im| + |(b : ℝ) * p.2.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |p.1.im| + (b : ℝ) * |p.2.im| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hb_pos]
        _ ≤ |p.1.im| + (b : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ := by
            gcongr; exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2
        _ = |p.1.im| + ‖p.2‖ * (b : ℝ) := by ring
    exact ⟨by linarith [hDet.r_det_pos], by linarith [hDet.s_det_pos],
      by linarith [hDet.r_det_lt_s_det, hDet.s_det_pos]⟩
  let S_all : ℕ := (wallAllShifts K q_idx).sup (fun q : ℤ => q.natAbs)
  have hJ_all_eq : wallAllJBound K q_idx = (S_all : ℝ) + 2 := rfl
  have hb_mem_all : (b : ℤ) ∈ wallAllShifts K q_idx := by
    refine Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_)
    simp [b]
  have hb_le_S : b ≤ S_all := by
    have h := Finset.le_sup (f := fun q : ℤ => q.natAbs) hb_mem_all
    simpa only [Int.natAbs_natCast] using h
  have hb_le_J : (b : ℝ) ≤ wallAllJBound K q_idx := by
    have hcast : (b : ℝ) ≤ (S_all : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hb_le_S
    linarith [hJ_all_eq]
  have hJ_all_pos : 0 < wallAllJBound K q_idx := by linarith [hb_pos, hb_le_J]
  have h2J_all_pos : 0 < 2 * wallAllJBound K q_idx := by linarith
  let U_uni : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx
  have hU_uni_open : IsOpen U_uni := by
    refine IsOpen.inter ?_ (IsOpen.inter ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
        continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const
  have hU_uni_ne : U_uni.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.zero_im, abs_zero]; linarith [W.s_base_pos]
    · simpa only [norm_zero] using W.r_base_pos
    · simp only [Complex.zero_im, abs_zero]; exact div_pos W.s_base_pos h2J_all_pos
  have hU_uni_sub : U_uni ⊆ V_det := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩
    have hp3_mul : |p.2.im| * (2 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) < W.s_base :=
      (lt_div_iff₀ h2J_all_pos).mp hp3
    have hb_im : (b : ℝ) * |p.2.im| < W.s_base / 2 := by
      have hle : 2 * ((b : ℝ) * |p.2.im|) ≤ |p.2.im| * (2 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg p.2.im, hb_le_J]
      linarith
    have him_b : |(p.1 + (b : ℂ) * p.2).im| ≤ |p.1.im| + (b : ℝ) * |p.2.im| := by
      have him_eq : (p.1 + (b : ℂ) * p.2).im = p.1.im + (b : ℝ) * p.2.im := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
      rw [him_eq]
      simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hb_pos] using abs_add_le p.1.im ((b : ℝ) * p.2.im)
    exact ⟨by linarith [W.r_base_le_det, hDet.r_det_pos],
      by linarith [W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos],
      by linarith [W.s_base_le_det, hDet.s_det_pos]⟩
  have hΦ_small : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_small, Φ_solves ι p = 0 := by
    intro ι p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    have h_raw := (h_det_props ι).1 p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2
    dsimp only [Φ_solves, A_coeff]
    rw [h_shift0, h_shiftb]
    simpa only [h_shift1 p.1 p.2 ι, Prod.mk.eta] using h_raw
  have hΦ_uni : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ U_uni, Φ_solves ι p = 0 :=
    fun ι p hp =>
      hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hV_det_open hV_det_preconn
        hU_small_open hU_small_ne hU_small_sub (hΦ_holo_V ι) (hΦ_small ι) p (hU_uni_sub hp)
  let DenseNZ : (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → Prop :=
    fun f => ∀ O : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen O → O.Nonempty → O ⊆ V_det → ∃ p ∈ O, f p ≠ 0
  have h_dense_of_wit : ∀ {f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f V_det → (∃ p₀ ∈ V_det, f p₀ ≠ 0) → DenseNZ f := by
    intro f hf ⟨p₀, hp₀, hfp₀⟩ O hO hOne hOsub
    by_contra h_zero
    push Not at h_zero
    exact hfp₀ (hKit.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_2D hV_det_open hV_det_preconn
      hO hOne hOsub hf h_zero p₀ hp₀)
  have h_dense_mul : ∀ {f g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
      ContinuousOn f V_det → DenseNZ f → DenseNZ g → DenseNZ (fun p => f p * g p) := by
    intro f g hf_cont hdf hdg O hO hOne hOsub
    obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hfp₁⟩ := hdf O hO hOne hOsub
    have hf_at : ContinuousAt f p₁ :=
      hf_cont.continuousAt (hV_det_open.mem_nhds (hOsub hp₁))
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hball⟩ :=
      Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
        (Filter.inter_mem (hO.mem_nhds hp₁) (hf_at.eventually_ne hfp₁))
    obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hgp₂⟩ :=
      hdg (Metric.ball p₁ δ) Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hδ_pos)
        (fun q hq => hOsub (hball hq).1)
    exact ⟨p₂, (hball hp₂).1, mul_ne_zero (hball hp₂).2 hgp₂⟩
  have hA_dense : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DenseNZ (A_coeff ι (Fin.last (D_det ι))) := by
    intro ι
    obtain ⟨y, t, hy, ht, hQ_nz, _⟩ := (h_det_props ι).2.1
    refine h_dense_of_wit (hA_holo_V ι (Fin.last (D_det ι))) ⟨(y, t), hU_small_sub ⟨hy, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [A_coeff]
    rw [h_shift0, h_shiftb]
    exact hQ_nz
  have hΔ_dense : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DenseNZ (Δ_base ι) := by
    intro ι
    obtain ⟨y, t, hy, ht, _, hD_nz⟩ := (h_det_props ι).2.1
    refine h_dense_of_wit (hΔ_holo_V ι) ⟨(y, t), hU_small_sub ⟨hy, ht⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [Δ_base]
    rw [h_shift0, h_shiftb]
    exact hD_nz
  let H_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p *
      A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p * Δ_base 1 p
  have hH_base_holo_V : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_base V_det :=
    (((hA_holo_V 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0))).mul (hΔ_holo_V 0)).mul
      (hA_holo_V 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)))).mul (hΔ_holo_V 1)
  have hH_base_dense : DenseNZ H_base := by
    have h01 : DenseNZ (fun p => A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p) :=
      h_dense_mul (hA_holo_V 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0))).continuousOn (hA_dense 0) (hΔ_dense 0)
    have h012 : DenseNZ (fun p => A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p *
        A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p) :=
      h_dense_mul
        ((hA_holo_V 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0))).continuousOn.mul (hΔ_holo_V 0).continuousOn)
        h01 (hA_dense 1)
    exact h_dense_mul
      (((hA_holo_V 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0))).continuousOn.mul (hΔ_holo_V 0).continuousOn).mul
        (hA_holo_V 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1))).continuousOn)
      h012 (hΔ_dense 1)
  let r₀ : ℝ :=
    min (W.s_base / 4) (min (W.r_base / 2) (W.s_base / (4 * wallAllJBound K q_idx)))
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ :=
    lt_min (by linarith [W.s_base_pos])
      (lt_min (by linarith [W.r_base_pos]) (div_pos W.s_base_pos (by linarith)))
  let B_orig : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀
  have hB_orig_sub_uni : B_orig ⊆ U_uni := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hp1 hp2
    have hr₀_1 : r₀ ≤ W.s_base / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr₀_2 : r₀ ≤ W.r_base / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr₀_3 : r₀ ≤ W.s_base / (4 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have him1 : |p.1.im| ≤ ‖p.1‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.1
    have him2 : |p.2.im| ≤ ‖p.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm p.2
    have h_div_lt :
        W.s_base / (4 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) < W.s_base / (2 * wallAllJBound K q_idx) :=
      div_lt_div_of_pos_left W.s_base_pos h2J_all_pos (by linarith)
    exact ⟨by linarith [W.s_base_pos], by linarith [W.r_base_pos], by linarith⟩
  have hH_base_nz_orig : ∃ p ∈ B_orig, H_base p ≠ 0 :=
    hH_base_dense B_orig (Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball)
      ⟨((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos⟩
      (Set.Subset.trans hB_orig_sub_uni hU_uni_sub)
  obtain ⟨y₀, r_y, r_t, m_t, H_tilde, hr_y_pos, hr_t_pos, h_bi_sub_orig,
      hH_tilde_bi_holo, hH_tilde_bi_nz, hH_bi_factor⟩ :=
    h_s2 r₀ hr₀_pos H_base (hH_base_holo_V.mono (Set.Subset.trans hB_orig_sub_uni hU_uni_sub))
      hH_base_nz_orig
  refine ⟨{
    M_det := M_det
    D_det := D_det
    D_det_pos := D_det_pos
    Q_det := Q_det
    Disc_det := Disc_det
    A_coeff := A_coeff
    Δ_base := Δ_base
    A_coeff_def := fun _ _ _ => rfl
    Δ_base_def := fun _ _ => rfl
    univ_separable := fun ι env z hlead hdisc hroot =>
      (h_det_props ι).2.2 env z hlead hdisc hroot
    base_coeff_holo := fun ι d => (hA_holo_V ι d).mono hU_uni_sub
    base_disc_holo := fun ι => (hΔ_holo_V ι).mono hU_uni_sub
    base_lead_witness := fun ι => hA_dense ι U_uni hU_uni_open hU_uni_ne hU_uni_sub
    base_disc_witness := fun ι => hΔ_dense ι U_uni hU_uni_open hU_uni_ne hU_uni_sub
    base_primary_solves := hΦ_uni
    y₀ := y₀
    r_y := r_y
    r_t := r_t
    t_end := r_t / 2
    m_t := m_t
    H_tilde := H_tilde
    r_y_pos := hr_y_pos
    r_t_pos := hr_t_pos
    t_end_pos := by linarith [hr_t_pos]
    t_end_lt := by linarith [hr_t_pos]
    bidisk_sub_unified := Set.Subset.trans h_bi_sub_orig hB_orig_sub_uni
    H_tilde_holo := hH_tilde_bi_holo
    H_tilde_ne_zero := hH_tilde_bi_nz
    H_base_factor := hH_bi_factor
    separable_punc := fun ι p ⟨hp1, hp2_ball, hp2_ne⟩ => by
      have hp_bi : p ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ : ℂ) r_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t := ⟨hp1, hp2_ball⟩
      have hp2_ne' : p.2 ≠ 0 := hp2_ne
      have hprod_nz :
          A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p *
            A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p * Δ_base 1 p ≠ 0 := by
        change H_base p ≠ 0
        rw [← hH_bi_factor p hp_bi]
        exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m_t hp2_ne') (hH_tilde_bi_nz p hp_bi)
      have h012_nz :
          A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p *
            A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hprod_nz
      have hΔ1_nz : Δ_base 1 p ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hprod_nz
      have h01_nz : A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p * Δ_base 0 p ≠ 0 :=
        left_ne_zero_of_mul h012_nz
      have hA1_nz : A_coeff 1 (Fin.last (D_det 1)) p ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h012_nz
      have hA0_nz : A_coeff 0 (Fin.last (D_det 0)) p ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul h01_nz
      have hΔ0_nz : Δ_base 0 p ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h01_nz
      fin_cases ι
      · exact ⟨hA0_nz, fun z hz => (h_det_props 0).2.2 _ z hA0_nz hΔ0_nz hz⟩
      · exact ⟨hA1_nz, fun z hz => (h_det_props 1).2.2 _ z hA1_nz hΔ1_nz hz⟩
    clear_pair := h_s3 M_det D_det Q_det Disc_det
  }⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hSum_holo : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (f : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∑ i ∈ s, f i p) U := by
    intro α s U f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using
        (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) U)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hfn : (fun p => ∑ i ∈ insert a s, f i p) = (fun p => f a p + ∑ i ∈ s, f i p) := by
        ext p; exact Finset.sum_insert ha
      rw [hfn]
      exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
        (ih (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))
  have hProd_holo : ∀ {α : Type} (s : Finset α) {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (f : α → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∏ i ∈ s, f i p) U := by
    intro α s U f hf
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa only [Finset.prod_empty] using
        (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ) : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) U)
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      have hfn : (fun p => ∏ i ∈ insert a s, f i p) = (fun p => f a p * ∏ i ∈ s, f i p) := by
        ext p; exact Finset.prod_insert ha
      rw [hfn]
      exact (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).mul
        (ih (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))

            hE_holo hE_bot hE_top h_prim p (hV_sub hp),
        fun h_alt =>
          hRev (E_loop := E_lp) (E_prim := E_pr) (E_alt := E_al)
            hV_op hV_ne hV_sub hE_holo hE_bot hE_top h_alt⟩
  }⟩

wall_loop_top_branch_and_monodromy_trans.definitions:
noncomputable def wltbExpPt (y_star : ℂ) (wt : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (y_star + Complex.exp wt.1, wt.2)

noncomputable def wltbSlitLog (y_star : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (Real.log ρ : ℂ) - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
    Complex.log ((Complex.I / (ρ : ℂ)) * (y - y_star))

noncomputable def wltbDerivY : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, f => f
  | α + 1, f => fun p => Complex.exp (-p.1) * pderivA (wltbDerivY α f) p

noncomputable def wltbDerivYT (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  iterDerivYT 0 β (wltbDerivY α f) p

noncomputable def wltbHomRankOneDet (W_hom : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  W_hom 0 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 2) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 1) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p) -
  W_hom 1 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 2) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p) +
  W_hom 2 p * (wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 1) p -
    wltbDerivYT 0 1 (W_hom 0) p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p)

noncomputable def wltbHomReflectOut (E : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (W_hom : Fin 3 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let T₀ := W_hom 2 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 0) p - W_hom 0 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p
    let T₁ := W_hom 2 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 1) p - W_hom 1 p * wltbDerivYT 1 0 (W_hom 2) p
    let N₀ := T₁
    let N₁ := -T₀
    let dotLN := E 0 p * N₀ + E 1 p * N₁
    let dotNN := N₀ * N₀ + N₁ * N₁
    2 * dotLN * (if ι = 0 then N₀ else N₁) - dotNN * E ι p

noncomputable def wltbHomReflectRes (E F : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
  fun ι p =>
    let W_hom := homIntersect E F
    let V := wltbHomReflectOut E W_hom
    W_hom 2 p * V ι p - (V 0 p * W_hom 0 p + V 1 p * W_hom 1 p) * F ι p

noncomputable def wltbLineJetEnv (M : ℕ) (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    LineJetVar M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    if v.1 = 0 then
      wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₀ v.2.1) p
    else
      wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₁ v.2.1) p

noncomputable def wltbFieldSymJetEnv {N_idx : ℕ} (q_idx : Fin N_idx → ℤ) (M : ℕ)
    (E : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : SymJetVar N_idx M → ℂ :=
  fun v => wltbDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E (q_idx v.1) v.2.1) p

proof.tactics:
by
  let F_all : Finset ℤ := wallAllShifts K q_idx
  let b_int : ℤ := (wallBridgeB K : ℤ)
  let U_uni : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := wallUnifiedDom W.s_base W.r_base K q_idx
  let p_anc : ℂ × ℂ := wallAnchorPt x_star H₂ ρ t₂
  let B_anc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p_anc r_anchor
  let Ω_anc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p ∈ B_anc | H_top_guard p ≠ 0 }
  let F_anc : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := wallAnchorField W x_star H₂ ρ t₂
  have h1_mem : (1 : ℤ) ∈ F_all := Finset.mem_insert_self 1 _
  have hm1_mem : (-1 : ℤ) ∈ F_all :=
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ (by simp))
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℤ) ∈ F_all :=
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ (by simp))
  have hb_mem : b_int ∈ F_all :=
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ (by simp [b_int]))
  have hq_mem : ∀ a : Fin N_idx, q_idx a ∈ F_all := fun a =>
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
      (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem q_idx (Finset.mem_univ a)))
  
  let IsLocalHolo :
      ((ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → Prop :=
    fun Ψ =>
      (∀ {U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {E : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {M_br : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen U →
        (∀ q ∈ F_all, ∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (E q c) U) →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_br ι) U) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (Ψ E M_br) U) ∧
      (∀ {V : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {E₁ E₂ : ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ}
          {M₁ M₂ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        IsOpen V →
        (∀ q ∈ F_all, ∀ c : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ V, E₁ q c p = E₂ q c p) →
        (∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ V, M₁ ι p = M₂ ι p) →
        ∀ p ∈ V, Ψ E₁ M₁ p = Ψ E₂ M₂ p)
  have hL_const : ∀ c : ℂ, IsLocalHolo (fun _ _ _ => c) := fun c =>
    ⟨fun _ _ _ => differentiableOn_const c, fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hL_coord : ∀ (q : ℤ), q ∈ F_all → ∀ c : Fin 2,
      IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => E q c p) := fun q hq c =>
    ⟨fun _ hE _ => hE q hq c, fun _ hE _ p hp => hE q hq c p hp⟩
  have hL_branch : ∀ ι : Fin 2, IsLocalHolo (fun _ M_br p => M_br ι p) := fun ι =>
    ⟨fun _ _ hM => hM ι, fun _ _ hM p hp => hM ι p hp⟩
  have hL_add : ∀ {Ψ₁ Ψ₂}, IsLocalHolo Ψ₁ → IsLocalHolo Ψ₂ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => Ψ₁ E M_br p + Ψ₂ E M_br p) := fun h₁ h₂ =>
    ⟨fun hU hE hM => (h₁.1 hU hE hM).add (h₂.1 hU hE hM),
     fun hV hE hM p hp => by dsimp only; rw [h₁.2 hV hE hM p hp, h₂.2 hV hE hM p hp]⟩
  have hL_sub : ∀ {Ψ₁ Ψ₂}, IsLocalHolo Ψ₁ → IsLocalHolo Ψ₂ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => Ψ₁ E M_br p - Ψ₂ E M_br p) := fun h₁ h₂ =>
    ⟨fun hU hE hM => (h₁.1 hU hE hM).sub (h₂.1 hU hE hM),
     fun hV hE hM p hp => by dsimp only; rw [h₁.2 hV hE hM p hp, h₂.2 hV hE hM p hp]⟩
  have hL_neg : ∀ {Ψ}, IsLocalHolo Ψ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => -Ψ E M_br p) := fun h =>
    ⟨fun hU hE hM => (h.1 hU hE hM).neg,
     fun hV hE hM p hp => by dsimp only; rw [h.2 hV hE hM p hp]⟩
  have hL_mul : ∀ {Ψ₁ Ψ₂}, IsLocalHolo Ψ₁ → IsLocalHolo Ψ₂ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => Ψ₁ E M_br p * Ψ₂ E M_br p) := fun h₁ h₂ =>
    ⟨fun hU hE hM => (h₁.1 hU hE hM).mul (h₂.1 hU hE hM),
     fun hV hE hM p hp => by dsimp only; rw [h₁.2 hV hE hM p hp, h₂.2 hV hE hM p hp]⟩
  have hL_pow : ∀ (n : ℕ) {Ψ}, IsLocalHolo Ψ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => (Ψ E M_br p) ^ n) := by
    intro n Ψ hΨ
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      simpa only [pow_zero] using hL_const 1
    | succ n ih =>
      simpa only [pow_succ] using hL_mul ih hΨ
  have hL_sum : ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α)
      (Φ : α → (ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, IsLocalHolo (Φ i)) →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => ∑ i ∈ s, Φ i E M_br p) := by
    intro α _ s Φ hΦ
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using hL_const 0
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
      simpa only [Finset.sum_insert ha] using
        hL_add (hΦ a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
          (ih (fun i hi => hΦ i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)))
  have hL_derivYT : ∀ (α β : ℕ) {Ψ}, IsLocalHolo Ψ →
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => iterDerivYT α β (Ψ E M_br) p) := by
    intro α β Ψ hΨ
    refine ⟨fun hU hE hM => hKit.iterDerivYT_holo hU (hΨ.1 hU hE hM) α β, ?_⟩
    intro V E₁ E₂ M₁ M₂ hV hE hM p hp
    have h_tay := hKit.taylor2D_congr hV hp (hΨ.2 hV hE hM)
    let d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.single 0 α + Finsupp.single 1 β
    have hd0 : d 0 = α := by simp [d, Finsupp.add_apply]
    have hd1 : d 1 = β := by simp [d, Finsupp.add_apply]
    have h_coeff : taylor2D (Ψ E₁ M₁) p d = taylor2D (Ψ E₂ M₂) p d :=
      congrFun h_tay d
    dsimp only [taylor2D] at h_coeff
    rw [hd0, hd1] at h_coeff
    have hfac : ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ)) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero α))
        (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero β))
    calc iterDerivYT α β (Ψ E₁ M₁) p
        = (iterDerivYT α β (Ψ E₁ M₁) p / ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ))) *
            ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ)) := (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfac).symm
      _ = (iterDerivYT α β (Ψ E₂ M₂) p / ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ))) *
            ((α.factorial : ℂ) * (β.factorial : ℂ)) := by rw [h_coeff]
      _ = iterDerivYT α β (Ψ E₂ M₂) p := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hfac
  have hL_line_eval : ∀ (M : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
      IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M (E 0) (E b_int) p) P) := by
    intro M P
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun Q_p =>
        IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M (E 0) (E b_int) p) Q_p))
      P
      (fun a => by simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_C] using hL_const a)
      (fun P₁ P₂ ih₁ ih₂ => by simpa only [map_add] using hL_add ih₁ ih₂)
      (fun P₁ v ih => by
        have hv_loc : IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => lineJetEnv M (E 0) (E b_int) p v) := by
          by_cases hv0 : v.1 = 0
          · simpa only [lineJetEnv, hv0, ↓reduceIte] using
              hL_derivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (hL_coord 0 h0_mem v.2.1)
          · simpa only [lineJetEnv, hv0, ↓reduceIte] using
              hL_derivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (hL_coord b_int hb_mem v.2.1)
        simpa only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X] using hL_mul ih hv_loc)
  have hL_line_poly : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι : Fin 2)
      (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p =>
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv M (E 0) (E b_int) p) (Q d) *
            (M_br ι p) ^ (d : ℕ)) := fun M D ι Q =>
    hL_sum Finset.univ _ (fun d _ =>
      hL_mul (hL_line_eval M (Q d)) (hL_pow (d : ℕ) (hL_branch ι)))
  have hL_sym_eval : ∀ (M : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M E p) P) := by
    intro M P
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun Q_p =>
        IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M E p) Q_p))
      P
      (fun a => by simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval_C] using hL_const a)
      (fun P₁ P₂ ih₁ ih₂ => by simpa only [map_add] using hL_add ih₁ ih₂)
      (fun P₁ v ih => by
        have hv_loc : IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M E p v) :=
          hL_derivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (hL_coord (q_idx v.1) (hq_mem v.1) v.2.1)
        simpa only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_X] using hL_mul ih hv_loc)
  have hL_sym_poly : ∀ (M D : ℕ) (ι_star : Fin 2)
      (P_coeff : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (SymJetVar N_idx M) ℂ),
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p =>
        ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (fieldSymJetEnv q_idx M E p) (P_coeff d) *
            (M_br ι_star p) ^ (d : ℕ)) := fun M D ι_star P_coeff =>
    hL_sum Finset.univ _ (fun d _ =>
      hL_mul (hL_sym_eval M (P_coeff d)) (hL_pow (d : ℕ) (hL_branch ι_star)))
  have hL_homInt :
      ∀ {A B : Fin 2 → (ℤ → Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ},
        (∀ c : Fin 2, IsLocalHolo (A c)) →
        (∀ c : Fin 2, IsLocalHolo (B c)) →
        ∀ k : Fin 3,
          IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p =>
            homIntersect (fun c => A c E M_br) (fun c => B c E M_br) k p) := by
    intro A B hA hB k
    fin_cases k
    · exact hL_sub (hB 1) (hA 1)
    · exact hL_sub (hA 0) (hB 0)
    · exact hL_sub (hL_mul (hA 0) (hB 1)) (hL_mul (hA 1) (hB 0))
  have hW_br : ∀ k : Fin 3,
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => homIntersect (E 0) M_br k p) :=
    hL_homInt (fun c => hL_coord 0 h0_mem c) (fun c => hL_branch c)
  have hW_prev : ∀ k : Fin 3,
      IsLocalHolo (fun E _ p => homIntersect (E (-1)) (E 0) k p) :=
    hL_homInt (fun c => hL_coord (-1) hm1_mem c) (fun c => hL_coord 0 h0_mem c)
  have hL_rank_one :
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => homRankOneDet (homIntersect (E 0) M_br) p) := by
    refine hL_add
      (hL_sub
        (hL_mul (hW_br 0)
          (hL_sub
            (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 1)) (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 2)))
            (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 1)) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 2)))))
        (hL_mul (hW_br 1)
          (hL_sub
            (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 0)) (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 2)))
            (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 0)) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 2))))))
      (hL_mul (hW_br 2)
        (hL_sub
          (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 0)) (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 1)))
          (hL_mul (hL_derivYT 0 1 (hW_br 0)) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 1)))))
  have hL_reflect_res : ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      IsLocalHolo (fun E M_br p => homReflectRes (E 0) M_br ι p) := by
    have hT₀ :=
      hL_sub (hL_mul (hW_br 2) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 0)))
        (hL_mul (hW_br 0) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 2)))
    have hT₁ :=
      hL_sub (hL_mul (hW_br 2) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 1)))
        (hL_mul (hW_br 1) (hL_derivYT 1 0 (hW_br 2)))
    have hN₀ := hT₁
    have hN₁ := hL_neg hT₀
    have hdotLN :=
      hL_add (hL_mul (hL_coord 0 h0_mem 0) hN₀) (hL_mul (hL_coord 0 h0_mem 1) hN₁)
