            {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ isOpen_compl_singleton
        obtain ⟨p_mid, ⟨⟨hp_mid_B0, hp_mid_B1⟩, hp_mid_exc1⟩, hp_mid_exc0⟩ :=
          hH_exc_open_wit i₀ V_m_exc1 hV_m_exc1_open
            ⟨p_m1, ⟨hp_m1_B0, hp_m1_B1⟩, hp_m1_exc1⟩ (fun _ hp => hp.1.1)
        obtain ⟨r_m, M_mid, hr_m_pos, hball_rm_sub, hM_mid_holo_rm, hM_mid_solves_rm, hCh⟩ :=
          K_cont.detour_root_chain (C_cl i₁) p_curr p_mid r_curr M_curr
            Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _) (hH_exc_holo i₁) E_base.D_det_pos
            (h_cl_props i₁).1 (h_sep_cl i₁) hp_curr hH_curr hp_mid_B1 hp_mid_exc1
            hr_curr (fun q hq => (hball_curr hq).1) hM_curr_holo hM_curr_solves
        have hreg1_sub_Ω1 : { q ∈ B_ball i₁ | H_exc i₁ q ≠ 0 } ⊆ Ω_k i₁ := by
          intro q ⟨hq_B, hq_exc⟩
          simp only [H_exc, mul_ne_zero_iff] at hq_exc
          exact ⟨hq_B, hq_exc.1.1.1.1⟩
        have hreg0_sub_Ω0 : { q ∈ B_ball i₀ | H_exc i₀ q ≠ 0 } ⊆ Ω_k i₀ := by
          intro q ⟨hq_B, hq_exc⟩
          simp only [H_exc, mul_ne_zero_iff] at hq_exc
          exact ⟨hq_B, hq_exc.1.1.1.1⟩
        have hreg0_open : IsOpen { q ∈ B_ball i₀ | H_exc i₀ q ≠ 0 } :=
          (continuousOn_open_iff Metric.isOpen_ball).mp (hH_exc_holo i₀).continuousOn
            {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ isOpen_compl_singleton
        obtain ⟨r'_mid, hr'_mid_pos, hball_r'mid_sub⟩ :=
          Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hreg0_open) p_mid
            ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hr_m_pos, hp_mid_B0, hp_mid_exc0⟩
        have hball_r'mid_Ω1 : Metric.ball p_mid r'_mid ⊆ Ω_k i₁ :=
          fun q hq => hreg1_sub_Ω1 (hball_rm_sub (hball_r'mid_sub hq).1)
        have hball_r'mid_Ω0 : Metric.ball p_mid r'_mid ⊆ Ω_k i₀ :=
          fun q hq => hreg0_sub_Ω0 (hball_r'mid_sub hq).2
        have hF1_eq_F0 : ∀ q ∈ F_all, ∀ c : Fin 2,
            ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_mid r'_mid, F_k i₁ q c p = F_k i₀ q c p := by
          intro q hq c p hp
          have hp_Ω1 := hball_r'mid_Ω1 hp
          have hp_Ω0 := hball_r'mid_Ω0 hp
          exact ((hStep_compat k hk1).2 q hq c p ⟨hp_Ω0.1, hp_Ω1.1⟩
            ((hD_prod_nz i₀ p).mp hp_Ω0.2 q hq c)
            ((hD_prod_nz i₁ p).mp hp_Ω1.2 q hq c)).symm
        have hM_mid_solves_i0 : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p_mid r'_mid,
            ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1), C_cl i₀ ι d p * (M_mid ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
          intro ι p hp
          have h_ev1 :=
            (h_cl_solves_iff i₁ ι p (hball_r'mid_Ω1 hp) (M_mid ι p)).mp
              (hM_mid_solves_rm ι p (hball_r'mid_sub hp).1)
          have h_congr : ∀ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
              MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_k i₁ 0) (F_k i₁ b_int) p)
                (E_base.Q_det ι d) =
              MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_k i₀ 0) (F_k i₀ b_int) p)
                (E_base.Q_det ι d) :=
            fun d => (hL_line_eval (E_base.M_det ι) (E_base.Q_det ι d)).2
              (M₁ := fun _ _ => 0) (M₂ := fun _ _ => 0)
              Metric.isOpen_ball hF1_eq_F0 (fun _ _ _ => rfl) p hp
          have h_ev0 :
              ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
                MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_k i₀ 0) (F_k i₀ b_int) p)
                  (E_base.Q_det ι d) * (M_mid ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
            simpa only [← h_congr] using h_ev1
          exact (h_cl_solves_iff i₀ ι p (hball_r'mid_Ω0 hp) (M_mid ι p)).mpr h_ev0
        obtain ⟨p_bot, r_bot, M_bot, hp_bot_uni, hp_bot_base, hr_bot_pos, hball_rbot_uni,
            hM_bot_holo, hM_bot_solves, h_ih_iff⟩ :=
          ih (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hk1) p_mid r'_mid M_mid hp_mid_B0 hp_mid_exc0
            hr'_mid_pos hball_r'mid_Ω0
            (fun ι => (hM_mid_holo_rm ι).mono (fun q hq => (hball_r'mid_sub hq).1))
            hM_mid_solves_i0
        refine ⟨p_bot, r_bot, M_bot, hp_bot_uni, hp_bot_base, hr_bot_pos, hball_rbot_uni,
          hM_bot_holo, hM_bot_solves, ?_⟩
        intro Ψ hΨ
        have h1 := hTransfer_detour hΨ (hΩ_open i₁) hreg1_sub_Ω1 hr_curr hball_curr
          hr_m_pos (hF_holo i₁) hM_curr_holo hCh
        have h2 := hTransfer_overlap hΨ
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
          Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
          Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr'_mid_pos)
          (fun q hq => (hball_r'mid_sub hq).1) Subset.rfl
          (fun q hq c => (hF_holo i₁ q hq c).mono (Set.Subset.trans hball_rm_sub hreg1_sub_Ω1))
          hM_mid_holo_rm
          (fun q hq c => (hF_holo i₀ q hq c).mono hball_r'mid_Ω0)
          (fun ι => (hM_mid_holo_rm ι).mono (fun q hq => (hball_r'mid_sub hq).1))
          hF1_eq_F0 (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
        exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h_ih_iff hΨ))
    refine ⟨hPrim_iff, ?_⟩
    intro M_top hM_top_holo hM_top_solves
    obtain ⟨p_init, ⟨hp_init_Btop, hp_init_anc⟩, hp_init_exc⟩ :=
      hH_exc_open_wit i_top (B_ball i_top ∩ Ω_anc)
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hAnc_open) hTop_compat.1 Set.inter_subset_left
    have hreg_top_open : IsOpen { q ∈ B_ball i_top | H_exc i_top q ≠ 0 } :=
      (continuousOn_open_iff Metric.isOpen_ball).mp (hH_exc_holo i_top).continuousOn
        {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ isOpen_compl_singleton
    obtain ⟨r_init, hr_init_pos, hV_init_sub_both⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hAnc_open.inter hreg_top_open) p_init
        ⟨hp_init_anc, hp_init_Btop, hp_init_exc⟩
    let V_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p_init r_init
    have hV_init_Ωtop : V_init ⊆ Ω_k i_top := by
      intro q hq
      have hq_reg := (hV_init_sub_both hq).2
      have hq_exc := hq_reg.2
      simp only [H_exc, mul_ne_zero_iff] at hq_exc
      exact ⟨hq_reg.1, hq_exc.1.1.1.1⟩
    have hFtop_eq_Fanc : ∀ q ∈ F_all, ∀ c : Fin 2,
        ∀ p ∈ V_init, F_k i_top q c p = F_anc q c p := by
      intro q hq c p hp
      have hp_Ωtop := hV_init_Ωtop hp
      exact hTop_compat.2 q hq c p ⟨hp_Ωtop.1, (hV_init_sub_both hp).1⟩
        ((hD_prod_nz i_top p).mp hp_Ωtop.2 q hq c)
    have hM_top_holo_V : ∀ ι : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (M_top ι) V_init :=
      fun ι => (hM_top_holo ι).mono (fun q hq => ((hV_init_sub_both hq).1).1)
    have hM_top_solves_cl : ∀ ι : Fin 2, ∀ p ∈ V_init,
        ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1), C_cl i_top ι d p * (M_top ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
      intro ι p hp
      have h_congr : ∀ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
          MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_k i_top 0) (F_k i_top b_int) p)
            (E_base.Q_det ι d) =
          MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_anc 0) (F_anc b_int) p)
            (E_base.Q_det ι d) :=
        fun d => (hL_line_eval (E_base.M_det ι) (E_base.Q_det ι d)).2
          (M₁ := fun _ _ => 0) (M₂ := fun _ _ => 0)
          Metric.isOpen_ball hFtop_eq_Fanc (fun _ _ _ => rfl) p hp
      have h_ev_top :
          ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (F_k i_top 0) (F_k i_top b_int) p)
              (E_base.Q_det ι d) * (M_top ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
        simpa only [h_congr] using hM_top_solves ι p (hV_init_sub_both hp).1
      exact (h_cl_solves_iff i_top ι p (hV_init_Ωtop hp) (M_top ι p)).mpr h_ev_top
    obtain ⟨p_bot, r_bot, M_bot, hp_bot_uni, hp_bot_base, hr_bot_pos, hball_rbot_uni,
        hM_bot_holo, hM_bot_solves, h_bot_iff⟩ :=
      h_desc_ind (L_vert - 1) (Nat.sub_lt hL_pos Nat.one_pos) p_init r_init M_top
        hp_init_Btop hp_init_exc hr_init_pos hV_init_Ωtop hM_top_holo_V hM_top_solves_cl
    let p_end : ℂ × ℂ := ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ))
    have hp_end_bidisk : p_end ∈ Metric.ball (E_base.y₀ : ℂ) E_base.r_y ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E_base.r_t := by
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self E_base.r_y_pos, ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos E_base.t_end_pos]
      linarith [E_base.t_end_lt, E_base.r_t_pos]
    have hp_end_uni : p_end ∈ U_uni := E_base.bidisk_sub_unified hp_end_bidisk
    have hp_end_base_nz : H_base p_end ≠ 0 := by
      dsimp only [H_base]
      rw [← E_base.H_base_factor p_end hp_end_bidisk]
      refine mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero E_base.m_t ?_)
        (E_base.H_tilde_ne_zero p_end hp_end_bidisk)
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt E_base.t_end_pos)
    obtain ⟨r_end_raw, M₁_end, hr_end_raw_pos, hball_raw_sub, hM₁_holo_raw,
        hM₁_solves_raw, hCh_end⟩ :=
      K_cont.detour_root_chain E_base.A_coeff p_bot p_end r_bot M_bot
        hUni_open hUni_conv hH_base_holo E_base.D_det_pos E_base.base_coeff_holo
        h_sep_base hp_bot_uni hp_bot_base hp_end_uni hp_end_base_nz
        hr_bot_pos hball_rbot_uni hM_bot_holo hM_bot_solves
    let r_end : ℝ :=
      min r_end_raw
        (min (3 * E_base.r_y / 4)
          (min (E_base.t_end / 2) (3 * E_base.r_t / 4 - E_base.t_end)))
    have hr_end_pos : 0 < r_end :=
      lt_min hr_end_raw_pos
        (lt_min (by linarith [E_base.r_y_pos])
          (lt_min (by linarith [E_base.t_end_pos]) (by linarith [E_base.t_end_lt])))
    have hr_end_le_raw : r_end ≤ r_end_raw := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_end_le_ry : r_end ≤ 3 * E_base.r_y / 4 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_end_le_t2 : r_end ≤ E_base.t_end / 2 :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hr_end_le_gap : r_end ≤ 3 * E_base.r_t / 4 - E_base.t_end :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hball_end_sub :
        Metric.ball p_end r_end ⊆
          Metric.ball (E_base.y₀ : ℂ) (3 * E_base.r_y / 4) ×ˢ
            { t : ℂ | 0 < ‖t‖ ∧ ‖t‖ < 3 * E_base.r_t / 4 } := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq] at hp
      have hp1 : dist p.1 (E_base.y₀ : ℂ) < r_end := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hp
      have hp2 : ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ < r_end := by
        simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hp
      have ht_norm : ‖(E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ = E_base.t_end := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos E_base.t_end_pos]
      have h_tri_lo : E_base.t_end ≤ ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ + ‖p.2‖ := by
        calc E_base.t_end = ‖(E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ := ht_norm.symm
          _ = ‖((E_base.t_end : ℂ) - p.2) + p.2‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖(E_base.t_end : ℂ) - p.2‖ + ‖p.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ + ‖p.2‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
      have h_tri_hi : ‖p.2‖ ≤ ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ + E_base.t_end := by
        calc ‖p.2‖ = ‖(p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) + (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ + ‖(E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖p.2 - (E_base.t_end : ℂ)‖ + E_base.t_end := by rw [ht_norm]
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hp1 hr_end_le_ry), ?_, ?_⟩
      · linarith [E_base.t_end_pos, hp2, hr_end_le_t2, h_tri_lo]
      · linarith [hp2, hr_end_le_gap, h_tri_hi]
    refine ⟨V_init, r_end, M₁_end, Metric.isOpen_ball,
      Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr_init_pos, fun q hq => (hV_init_sub_both hq).1,
      hr_end_pos, hball_end_sub,
      fun ι => (hM₁_holo_raw ι).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_end_le_raw),
      fun ι p hp => hM₁_solves_raw ι p (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_end_le_raw hp), ?_⟩
    intro Ψ hΨ
    have h_init_eq :
        (∀ p ∈ V_init, Ψ F_anc M_top p = 0) ↔
        (∀ p ∈ V_init, Ψ (F_k i_top) M_top p = 0) :=
      hTransfer_overlap hΨ Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
        Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
        Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr_init_pos) Subset.rfl Subset.rfl
        (fun q hq c => (hAnc_holo q hq c).mono (fun r hr => (hV_init_sub_both hr).1))
        hM_top_holo_V
        (fun q hq c => (hF_holo i_top q hq c).mono hV_init_Ωtop)
        hM_top_holo_V
        (fun q hq c p hp => (hFtop_eq_Fanc q hq c p hp).symm)
        (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    have h_end_det := hTransfer_detour hΨ hUni_open (fun _ hq => hq.1) hr_bot_pos
      hball_rbot_uni hr_end_raw_pos hUni_holo hM_bot_holo hCh_end
    have h_end_shrink := hTransfer_overlap hΨ
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr_end_pos)
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_end_le_raw) Subset.rfl
      (fun q hq c => (hUni_holo q hq c).mono (fun r hr => (hball_raw_sub hr).1))
      hM₁_holo_raw
      (fun q hq c => (hUni_holo q hq c).mono
        (fun r hr => (hball_raw_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_end_le_raw hr)).1))
      (fun ι => (hM₁_holo_raw ι).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_end_le_raw))
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    exact h_init_eq.trans ((h_bot_iff hΨ).trans (h_end_det.trans h_end_shrink))
  
  refine ⟨{
    primary_solves_at_anchor := fun ι => by
      have h_base : ∀ p ∈ U_uni,
          ∑ d : Fin (E_base.D_det ι + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv (E_base.M_det ι) (dualLineShift C 0) (dualLineShift C b_int) p)
              (E_base.Q_det ι d) *
            (dualLineShift C 1 ι p) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 := by
        intro p hp
        simpa only [b_int, E_base.A_coeff_def] using E_base.base_primary_solves ι p hp
      exact (hPrim_iff
        (hL_line_poly (E_base.M_det ι) (E_base.D_det ι) ι (E_base.Q_det ι))).mp h_base
    ascend_rank_one := fun h => (hPrim_iff hL_rank_one).mp h
    ascend_reflect := fun h p hp ι =>
      (hPrim_iff (hL_reflect_res ι)).mp (fun q hq => h q hq ι) p hp
    descend_primary_w2_zero := fun h => (hPrim_iff hL_w2_comp).mpr h
    descend_primary_iso_line := fun s_iso c_star h =>
      (hPrim_iff (hL_iso_line s_iso c_star)).mpr h
    descend_primary_prev_eq := fun h p hp =>
      ⟨(hPrim_iff hL_prev_cross₀).mpr (fun q hq => (h q hq).1) p hp,
       (hPrim_iff hL_prev_cross₁).mpr (fun q hq => (h q hq).2) p hp⟩
    primary_poly_transfer := fun M D ι_star P_coeff =>
      hPrim_iff (hL_sym_poly M D ι_star P_coeff)
    descend_branch := fun M_top hM_holo hM_solves ⟨ι_def, hM_ne⟩ => by
      obtain ⟨V_init, r_end, M₁_end, hV_open, hV_ne, hV_sub, hr_end_pos, hball_end_sub,
          hM₁_holo, hM₁_solves, hBr_iff⟩ := hBr_desc M_top hM_holo hM_solves
      refine ⟨V_init, r_end, M₁_end, hV_open, hV_ne, hV_sub, hr_end_pos, hball_end_sub,
        hM₁_holo, hM₁_solves, ?_,
        fun h => (hBr_iff hL_rank_one).mp (fun p hp => h p (hV_sub hp)),
        fun h p hp ι =>
          (hBr_iff (hL_reflect_res ι)).mp (fun q hq => h q (hV_sub hq) ι) p hp,
        fun h => (hBr_iff hL_w2_comp).mpr h,
        fun s_iso c_star h => (hBr_iff (hL_iso_line s_iso c_star)).mpr h,
        fun h p hp =>
          ⟨(hBr_iff hL_prev_cross₀).mpr (fun q hq => (h q hq).1) p hp,
           (hBr_iff hL_prev_cross₁).mpr (fun q hq => (h q hq).2) p hp⟩,
        fun M D ι_star P_coeff => hBr_iff (hL_sym_poly M D ι_star P_coeff)⟩
      refine ⟨ι_def, ?_⟩
      by_contra h_all_eq
      push Not at h_all_eq
      have h_diff_end :
          ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball ((E_base.y₀ : ℂ), (E_base.t_end : ℂ)) r_end,
            M₁_end ι_def p - dualLineShift C 1 ι_def p = 0 :=
        fun p hp => sub_eq_zero.mpr (h_all_eq p hp)
      have h_diff_init := (hBr_iff (hL_branch_diff ι_def)).mpr h_diff_end
      obtain ⟨p_wit, hp_wit_V, hp_wit_ne⟩ := hM_ne V_init hV_open hV_ne hV_sub
      exact hp_wit_ne (sub_eq_zero.mp (h_diff_init p_wit hp_wit_V))
  }⟩

    hm hd hΔ h2Δ h4d hr hM hCinit h12r hrd hrM hAbs
    L_in S_init W_steep
    hShape hs_init_holo hs_init_even_bound _hs_init_zero hs_init_rec
  obtain ⟨s_up, hs_up_holo, hs_up_strip, hs_up_bound, hs_up_init, hs_up_rec⟩ :=
    hUpMain x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init s_init
      hm hd hΔ h2Δ h4d hr hM hCinit h12r hrd hrM hAbs
      hShape hs_init_holo (fun y t hyt => (hs_init_even_bound y t hyt).2) hs_init_rec
  let W_up : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      d / 2 < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
      |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
      ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
      γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < p.2.im }
  let s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => if 0 ≤ p.2.im then s_up p else s_up (p.1, -p.2)
  have him_ne : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W_steep → p.2.im ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 : 0 ≤ γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ := mul_nonneg hγ1.le (norm_nonneg p.2)
    have h2 : 0 < |p.2.im| := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hp.2.2.2.2
    exact abs_pos.mp h2
  have h_pos_up : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W_steep → 0 < p.2.im → p ∈ W_up := by
    intro p hp hpos
    refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have habs : |p.2.im| = p.2.im := abs_of_pos hpos
    linarith only [hp.2.2.2.2, habs]
  have h_neg_up : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ W_steep → p.2.im < 0 → (p.1, -p.2) ∈ W_up := by
    intro p hp hneg
    refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only
      simpa only [norm_neg] using hp.2.2.2.1
    · dsimp only
      rw [norm_neg, Complex.neg_im, ← abs_of_neg hneg]
      exact hp.2.2.2.2
  refine ⟨s_steep, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (him_ne p hp) with hneg | hpos
    · let U_neg : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q : ℂ × ℂ | q.2.im < 0 }
      have hU_neg_open : IsOpen U_neg :=
        isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
      let L_neg : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { toFun := fun q => (q.1, -q.2)
          map_add' := fun q₁ q₂ => by ext <;> simp [add_comm]
          map_smul' := fun c q => by ext <;> simp
          cont := continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.neg }
      have h_maps : Set.MapsTo L_neg (W_steep ∩ U_neg) W_up := by
        intro q hq
        exact h_neg_up q hq.1 hq.2
      have h_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => s_up (L_neg q)) (W_steep ∩ U_neg) :=
        hs_up_holo.comp L_neg.differentiableOn h_maps
      have h_eq : Set.EqOn s_steep (fun q => s_up (L_neg q)) (W_steep ∩ U_neg) := by
        intro q hq
        have h_not : ¬ (0 ≤ q.2.im) := not_le.mpr hq.2
        change (if 0 ≤ q.2.im then s_up q else s_up (q.1, -q.2)) = s_up (q.1, -q.2)
        rw [if_neg h_not]
      have h_inter : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ s_steep (W_steep ∩ U_neg) p :=
        (h_comp.congr h_eq) p ⟨hp, hneg⟩
      exact (differentiableWithinAt_inter (hU_neg_open.mem_nhds hneg)).mp h_inter
    · let U_pos : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { q : ℂ × ℂ | 0 < q.2.im }
      have hU_pos_open : IsOpen U_pos :=
        isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_snd)
      have h_sub : W_steep ∩ U_pos ⊆ W_up := by
        intro q hq
        exact h_pos_up q hq.1 hq.2
      have h_eq : Set.EqOn s_steep s_up (W_steep ∩ U_pos) := by
        intro q hq
        change (if 0 ≤ q.2.im then s_up q else s_up (q.1, -q.2)) = s_up q
        rw [if_pos hq.2.le]
      have h_inter : DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ s_steep (W_steep ∩ U_pos) p :=
        ((hs_up_holo.mono h_sub).congr h_eq) p ⟨hp, hpos⟩
      exact (differentiableWithinAt_inter (hU_pos_open.mem_nhds hpos)).mp h_inter
  · intro p hp
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (him_ne p hp) with hneg | hpos
    · have h_not : ¬ (0 ≤ p.2.im) := not_le.mpr hneg
      change (if 0 ≤ p.2.im then s_up p else s_up (p.1, -p.2)) ∈ X.D_strip
      rw [if_neg h_not]
      exact hs_up_strip (p.1, -p.2) (h_neg_up p hp hneg)
    · change (if 0 ≤ p.2.im then s_up p else s_up (p.1, -p.2)) ∈ X.D_strip
      rw [if_pos hpos.le]
      exact hs_up_strip p (h_pos_up p hp hpos)
  · intro y t hyt
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (him_ne (y, t) hyt) with hneg | hpos
    · have h_not : ¬ (0 ≤ t.im) := not_le.mpr hneg
      have h_pos_neg : 0 ≤ (-t).im := by
        rw [Complex.neg_im]
        linarith only [hneg]
      have hs1 : s_steep (y, t) = s_up (y, -t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y, t) else s_up (y, -t)) = s_up (y, -t)
        rw [if_neg h_not]
      have hs2 : s_steep (y, -t) = s_up (y, -t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ (-t).im then s_up (y, -t) else s_up (y, -(-t))) = s_up (y, -t)
        rw [if_pos h_pos_neg]
      refine ⟨by rw [hs1, hs2], ?_⟩
      rw [hs1]
      simpa only [norm_neg] using hs_up_bound y (-t) (h_neg_up (y, t) hyt hneg)
    · have h_not_neg : ¬ (0 ≤ (-t).im) := by
        rw [Complex.neg_im]
        linarith only [hpos]
      have hs1 : s_steep (y, t) = s_up (y, t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y, t) else s_up (y, -t)) = s_up (y, t)
        rw [if_pos hpos.le]
      have hs2 : s_steep (y, -t) = s_up (y, t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ (-t).im then s_up (y, -t) else s_up (y, -(-t))) = s_up (y, t)
        rw [if_neg h_not_neg, neg_neg]
      refine ⟨by rw [hs1, hs2], ?_⟩
      rw [hs1]
      exact hs_up_bound y t (h_pos_up (y, t) hyt hpos)
  · intro y t hyt hdeep
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (him_ne (y, t) hyt) with hneg | hpos
    · have h_not : ¬ (0 ≤ t.im) := not_le.mpr hneg
      have hs1 : s_steep (y, t) = s_up (y, -t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y, t) else s_up (y, -t)) = s_up (y, -t)
        rw [if_neg h_not]
      rw [hs1, hs_up_init y (-t) (h_neg_up (y, t) hyt hneg) hdeep]
      have hyt_S : (y, t) ∈ S_init := by
        have hD_pos : 0 < h_ref - y.im := by linarith only [hd, hyt.1]
        have hD_lt : h_ref - y.im < δ_ceil := by linarith only [hΔ, hyt.2.1]
        have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_ceil := by linarith only [hΔ, h2Δ]
        have h_Lin_gt : m_steep < L_in := by
          have : 0 < 2 / γ_steep := div_pos (by norm_num) hγ1
          dsimp only [L_in]
          linarith only [hm, this]
        have h_re : |y.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - y.im) :=
          lt_trans hyt.2.2.1 (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h_Lin_gt hD_pos)
        have h_div_le : (h_ref - y.im) / d ≤ δ_ceil / d :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hD_lt.le hd.le
        have h_rpow_le : ((h_ref - y.im) / d) ^ α ≤ (δ_ceil / d) ^ α :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg hD_pos.le hd.le) h_div_le (by linarith only [hα1])
        have h_rpow_pos : 0 < (δ_ceil / d) ^ α :=
          Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hδ_pos hd) α
        have h_t_lt : ‖t‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α := by
          have h10 : 10 * r * ((h_ref - y.im) / d) ^ α ≤ 10 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le (by positivity)
          have h12 : 10 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α := by
            nlinarith only [hr, h_rpow_pos]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hyt.2.2.2.1 h10 |>.trans h12
        exact ⟨by linarith only [hΔ, hdeep], hD_lt, h_re, h_t_lt⟩
      exact (hs_init_even_bound y t hyt_S).1
    · have hs1 : s_steep (y, t) = s_up (y, t) := by
        change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y, t) else s_up (y, -t)) = s_up (y, t)
        rw [if_pos hpos.le]
      rw [hs1]
      exact hs_up_init y t (h_pos_up (y, t) hyt hpos) hdeep
  · intro y t ht_steep h_prev h_curr h_next
    dsimp only
    have hpos : 0 < t.im :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_nonneg hγ1.le (norm_nonneg t)) ht_steep
    have hs_prev : s_steep (y - t, t) = s_up (y - t, t) := by
      change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y - t, t) else s_up (y - t, -t)) = s_up (y - t, t)
      rw [if_pos hpos.le]
    have hs_curr : s_steep (y, t) = s_up (y, t) := by
      change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y, t) else s_up (y, -t)) = s_up (y, t)
      rw [if_pos hpos.le]
    have hs_next : s_steep (y + t, t) = s_up (y + t, t) := by
      change (if 0 ≤ t.im then s_up (y + t, t) else s_up (y + t, -t)) = s_up (y + t, t)
      rw [if_pos hpos.le]
    simpa only [hs_prev, hs_curr, hs_next] using
      hs_up_rec y t ht_steep
        (h_pos_up (y - t, t) h_prev hpos)
        (h_pos_up (y, t) h_curr hpos)
        (h_pos_up (y + t, t) h_next hpos)

ref_height_steep_sector_continuation.definitions:
noncomputable def refSteepActionA {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24

noncomputable def refSteepActionDJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t) J

noncomputable def refSteepActionDS {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t) s

noncomputable def refSteepPerturbG {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J t - t * refSteepActionDS P s_0 J t

noncomputable def refSteepResidual {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t J -
    refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t

def refSteepPolydisk (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t }

noncomputable def refSteepIterJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * refSteepResidual P s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def refSteepSolJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def refSteepChain {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_init (y_bot, t), s_init (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := refSteepChain P s_init y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * refSteepSolJ P prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def refSteepPsi {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (refSteepChain P s_init (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

def RefSteepJetProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      ‖s_m - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 4 →
      ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J =
        (deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J t) s_0) -
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m) ∧
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
      ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      HasDerivAt (fun J' => refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J')
        ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J) J) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_fn J_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_fn U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ J_fn U →
    (∀ p₀ ∈ U, ∃ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) ∧
      ‖s_fn p₀ - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖J_fn p₀ - 1‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ ‖p₀.2‖ < r_t) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDS P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U) ∧
  (∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t ρ_s M_a : ℝ) (s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ),
    0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 0 < ρ_s → 0 ≤ M_a →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
    ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 32 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
    (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
        ‖s' - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧
        ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
          ‖refSteepActionA P s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
    (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
      ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤
        4096 * M_a + 64 * ‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s) ∧
    ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
    ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J_m t - refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t‖ ≤
      (32 * M_a / ρ_s) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖)

def IsRefSteepContractivePt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : Prop :=
  t ≠ 0 ∧
  let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
  ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 32 ∧
  (∃ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) ∧
    ‖s_m - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖t‖ < r_t) ∧
  (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
    ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤ 1 / 32) ∧
  ‖refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 256

def RefSteepSolverProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
    IsRefSteepContractivePt X P s_m s_0 t →
    let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let J_p := refSteepSolJ P s_m s_0 t
    ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J_p -
      t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_p t) s_0 =
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m ∧
    (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
      deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_0 J'' t) J' -
        t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J' t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_m J'' t) J_m →
      J' = J_p)) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_m s_0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_m U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_0 U →
    (∀ p ∈ U, IsRefSteepContractivePt X P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepSolJ P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2) U)

def RefSteepStepAdmProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) : Prop :=
  (∀ β x_start Δ : ℝ, ∀ M : ℕ,
    1 < β → 0 < x_start → 0 < Δ →
    Δ * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, (x_start + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Δ) ^ (-β)) ≤
      x_start ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) ∧
  (∀ (α γ_steep x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init : ℝ)
     (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < m_steep → 0 < d → 0 < Δ_slab → 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil →
    0 < r → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_init →
    C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil / (γ_steep * Δ_slab)) ≤
      M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
    let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 4
    let S_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        δ_ceil - Δ_slab < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
        |p.1.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α }
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s_init S_init →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ S_init → ‖s_init (y, t) - y‖ ≤ C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2) →
    ∀ z_bot t : ℂ,
      γ_steep * ‖t‖ < t.im →
      ‖t‖ < 10 * r * (δ_ceil / d) ^ α →
      δ_ceil - (31 / 32) * Δ_slab < h_ref - (z_bot + t).im →
      h_ref - z_bot.im < δ_ceil - (1 / 32) * Δ_slab →
      |(z_bot + t).re - x₀| ≤ (m_steep + 1 / γ_steep) * (h_ref - (z_bot + t).im) →
      (z_bot, t) ∈ S_init ∧
      (z_bot + t, t) ∈ S_init ∧
      ‖s_init (z_bot, t) - z_bot‖ ≤ ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
      ‖s_init (z_bot + t, t) - (z_bot + t)‖ ≤
        ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
      ‖(s_init (z_bot + t, t) - s_init (z_bot, t)) / t - 1‖ ≤
        ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_ceil ^ (-2 * α)) ∧

noncomputable def refSteepActionA {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24

noncomputable def refSteepActionDJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t) J

noncomputable def refSteepActionDS {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t) s

noncomputable def refSteepPerturbG {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J t - t * refSteepActionDS P s_0 J t

noncomputable def refSteepResidual {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2) +
    refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t J -
    refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t

def refSteepPolydisk (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t }

noncomputable def refSteepIterJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (s_0 - s_m) / t
  | n + 1 =>
      let u := refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t n
      u - (4 : ℂ) * refSteepResidual P s_m ((s_0 - s_m) / t) s_0 t u

noncomputable def refSteepSolJ {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_m s_0 t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t)

noncomputable def refSteepChain {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y_bot t : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0 => (s_init (y_bot, t), s_init (y_bot + t, t))
  | j + 1 =>
      let prev := refSteepChain P s_init y_bot t j
      (prev.2, prev.2 + t * refSteepSolJ P prev.1 prev.2 t)

noncomputable def refSteepPsi {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (s_init : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℕ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (refSteepChain P s_init (y - ((N : ℂ) + 1) * t) t N).2

    have h_int_ψ_bound : (∫ s in (-1 : ℝ)..1, ψ s) ≤ 4 * δ_v := by

    have h_poisson_rep : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,

        (g ζ).im = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ := by

        have hlin : (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K_w φ - 1) / 2) =
            ((∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) - 2 * Real.pi) / 2 := by
          have h_eq_fn : (fun φ : ℝ => (K_w φ - 1) / 2) = fun φ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (K_w φ - 1) := by
            ext φ; ring
          rw [h_eq_fn, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
            intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hK_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const,
            intervalIntegral.integral_const]
          simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
          ring
        have hint_eq : (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) = 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
        rw [hint_eq]
        have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [h2pi_ne]
      refine ⟨hK_cont, hK_nonneg, hK_avg, ?_⟩
      have hF_cont_ζ : Continuous (F_ker ζ) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hχ_cont).mul h_ker_cont
      have h_im_mul : ∀ Z : ℂ, ((Complex.I / (Real.pi : ℂ)) * Z).im = Z.re / Real.pi := by
        intro Z
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      have h_re_comm := ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
        Complex.reCLM (hF_cont_ζ.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      change (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F_ker ζ φ).re) =
        (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_ker ζ φ).re at h_re_comm
      have hF_re : ∀ φ : ℝ, (F_ker ζ φ).re = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (χ φ * K_w φ - χ φ) := by
        intro φ
        have h1 : (F_ker ζ φ).re = χ φ * (w / (circleMap 0 1 φ - w)).re := by
          dsimp [F_ker]
          change ((χ φ : ℂ) * (w / (circleMap 0 1 φ - w))).re = _
          simp
        rw [h1, h_re_eq φ]
        ring
      dsimp [g]
      rw [h_im_mul, ← h_re_comm]
      simp_rw [hF_re]
      have hχK_cont' : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => χ φ * K_w φ) := hχ_cont.mul hK_cont
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hχK_cont'.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hχ_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        hχ_mean, sub_zero]
      ring

    have hg_im_bounds : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
        -M_dip ≤ (g ζ).im ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus := by
      intro ζ hζ
      obtain ⟨hK_cont, hK_nonneg, hK_avg, hg_im⟩ := h_poisson_rep ζ hζ
      rw [hg_im]
      set K_w : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ =>
        (1 - ‖(r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2) / ‖circleMap 0 1 φ - (r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2
      have hχK_cont : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => χ φ * K_w φ) := hχ_cont.mul hK_cont
      have h_lo_int := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
        ((show Continuous (fun φ => -M_dip * K_w φ) from hK_cont.const_mul (-M_dip)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hχK_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun φ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hχ_lo φ) (hK_nonneg φ))
      have h_hi_int := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi)
        (hχK_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((show Continuous (fun φ => η_plus * K_w φ) from hK_cont.const_mul η_plus).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (fun φ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hχ_hi φ) (hK_nonneg φ))
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_lo_int h_hi_int
      constructor
      · calc -M_dip = -M_dip * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) := by
              rw [hK_avg, mul_one]
          _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (-M_dip * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) := by ring
          _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lo_int (by positivity)
      · calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ)
            ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (η_plus * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hi_int (by positivity)
          _ = η_plus * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) := by ring
          _ = η_plus := by rw [hK_avg, mul_one]

    have hg_sphere_norm : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have h_img : ζ ∈ circleMap 0 1 '' Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [image_circleMap_Ioc]
        simpa using hζ
      obtain ⟨θ, _, rfl⟩ := h_img
      set ζ := circleMap 0 1 θ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := by simp [ζ, norm_circleMap_zero]
      have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := by intro h0; simp [h0] at hζ_norm
      have hrζ_lt : ‖(r : ℂ) * ζ‖ < 1 := by
        rw [norm_mul, hζ_norm, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_pos.le]
        exact hr_lt
      have h_ker_cont : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ =>
          ((r : ℂ) * ζ) / (circleMap 0 1 φ - (r : ℂ) * ζ)) := by
        refine continuous_const.div ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).sub continuous_const) ?_
        intro φ
        have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le (circleMap 0 1 φ) ((r : ℂ) * ζ)
        rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_one] at h1
        exact norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
      let G_diff : ℝ → ℂ := fun φ =>
        ((χ φ - χ θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((r : ℂ) * ζ) / (circleMap 0 1 φ - (r : ℂ) * ζ))
      have hG_per : Function.Periodic G_diff (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro φ
        have hc_per : circleMap 0 1 (φ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap 0 1 φ := by
          rw [h_circle_add]
          simp [circleMap_zero, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I]
        simp only [G_diff, hχ_per φ, hc_per]
      have h_sub_mean : (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_ker ζ φ) =
          ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_diff φ := by
        have h_eq_fn : ∀ φ : ℝ, G_diff φ =
            F_ker ζ φ - (χ θ : ℂ) * (((r : ℂ) * ζ) / (circleMap 0 1 φ - (r : ℂ) * ζ)) := by
          intro φ
          dsimp [G_diff, F_ker]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hF_ζ_cont : Continuous (F_ker ζ) :=
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hχ_cont).mul h_ker_cont
        simp_rw [h_eq_fn]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
            (hF_ζ_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((h_ker_cont.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable _ _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, h_mean_kernel ((r : ℂ) * ζ) hrζ_lt,
          mul_zero, sub_zero]
      have h_shifted := h_shift_ℂ G_diff θ hG_per
      have h_int_bound : ‖∫ u in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, G_diff (θ + u)‖ ≤
          (Real.pi * L_χ) * |Real.pi - -Real.pi| := by
        refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const ?_
        intro u hu
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])] at hu
        have hu_cc : u ∈ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := ⟨hu.1.le, hu.2⟩
        have h_jord := (h_jordan u r hu_cc hr_lo hr_lt).2
        have h_rot : ((r : ℂ) * ζ) / (circleMap 0 1 (θ + u) - (r : ℂ) * ζ) =
            (r : ℂ) / (circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)) := by
          have h_den : circleMap 0 1 (θ + u) - (r : ℂ) * ζ =
              ζ * (circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)) := by
            dsimp [ζ]
            rw [h_circle_add]
            ring
          rw [h_den, mul_comm (r : ℂ) ζ, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hζ_ne]
        dsimp [G_diff]
        rw [h_rot]
        by_cases hu0 : u = 0
        · subst hu0
          simp [mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hLχ_pos.le]
        · have hu_pos : 0 < |u| := abs_pos.mpr hu0
          have h_j_pos : 0 < |u| / Real.pi := div_pos hu_pos Real.pi_pos
          rw [norm_mul, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_pos.le]
          have h_lip_u : |χ (θ + u) - χ θ| ≤ L_χ * |u| := by
            simpa using hχ_lip (θ + u) θ
          have h_num : |χ (θ + u) - χ θ| * r ≤ L_χ * |u| := by
            calc |χ (θ + u) - χ θ| * r ≤ (L_χ * |u|) * 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul h_lip_u hr_lt.le hr_pos.le (by positivity)
              _ = L_χ * |u| := mul_one _
          calc |χ (θ + u) - χ θ| * (r / ‖circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)‖)
              = (|χ (θ + u) - χ θ| * r) / ‖circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)‖ :=
                (mul_div_assoc _ _ _).symm
            _ ≤ (L_χ * |u|) / (|u| / Real.pi) :=
                div_le_div₀ (by positivity) h_num h_j_pos h_jord
            _ = Real.pi * L_χ := by
                field_simp [hu_pos.ne', Real.pi_pos.ne']
      rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi - -Real.pi)] at h_int_bound
      dsimp [g, C_bump]
      rw [h_sub_mean, h_shifted, norm_mul, norm_div, Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le]
      calc (1 / Real.pi) * ‖∫ u in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, G_diff (θ + u)‖
          ≤ (1 / Real.pi) * ((Real.pi * L_χ) * (Real.pi - -Real.pi)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_bound (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * Real.pi * L_χ := by
            field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne']
            ring

    have hg_ball_norm : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump := by
      have h1_lt_inv : 1 < 1 / r := (one_lt_div hr_pos).mpr hr_lt
      have h_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball h1_lt_inv
      have h_diffCont : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
        refine (hg_holo.mono ?_).diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero]
        exact h_sub
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [← closure_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero] at hζ
      refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball
        h_diffCont ?_ hζ
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero]
      exact hg_sphere_norm

    refine ⟨g, hg_holo, hg_zero, fun ζ hζ => ⟨hg_ball_norm ζ hζ, (hg_im_bounds ζ hζ).1,
      (hg_im_bounds ζ hζ).2⟩, ?_⟩
    intro ζ hζ h_collar
    have hζ_cb : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ
    refine ⟨by linarith [(hg_im_bounds ζ hζ_cb).1], ?_⟩
    have h_img : ζ ∈ circleMap 0 1 '' Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [image_circleMap_Ioc]
      simpa using hζ
    obtain ⟨θ, _, rfl⟩ := h_img
    set ζ := circleMap 0 1 θ
    have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := by simp [ζ, norm_circleMap_zero]
    have hcζ_norm : ‖c + ζ‖ < 4 / 3 := by
      calc ‖c + ζ‖ ≤ ‖c‖ + ‖ζ‖ := norm_add_le c ζ
        _ < 1 / 3 + 1 := by linarith
        _ = 4 / 3 := by norm_num
    have hsin_y₀ : |Real.sin θ - y₀| < δ_v / 2 := by
      have him : (c + ζ).im = Real.sin θ - y₀ := by
        dsimp [ζ, y₀]
        simp [circleMap_zero]
        ring
      rw [← him]
      calc |(c + ζ).im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_steep * ‖c + ζ‖ := h_collar
        _ ≤ (6 / 5) * (δ_v / 4) * (4 / 3) := by
            have : γ_steep * ‖c + ζ‖ ≤ (δ_v / 4) * (4 / 3) :=
              mul_le_mul hγs_le_δv hcζ_norm.le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            linarith
        _ = (2 / 5) * δ_v := by ring
        _ < δ_v / 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hK_cont, hK_nonneg, hK_avg, hg_im⟩ := h_poisson_rep ζ hζ_cb
    set K_w : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ =>
      (1 - ‖(r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2) / ‖circleMap 0 1 φ - (r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2
    let P_err : ℝ → ℝ := fun φ => (M_dip + χ φ) * K_w φ
    have hP_cont : Continuous P_err := (continuous_const.add hχ_cont).mul hK_cont
    have hP_per : Function.Periodic P_err (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro φ
      have hc_per : circleMap 0 1 (φ + 2 * Real.pi) = circleMap 0 1 φ := by
        rw [h_circle_add]
        simp [circleMap_zero, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I]
      dsimp [P_err, K_w]
      rw [hχ_per φ, hc_per]
    have h_err_rep : M_dip + (g ζ).im =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, P_err (θ + u) := by
      rw [hg_im, ← h_shift_ℝ P_err θ hP_per]
      have h_add : ∀ φ : ℝ, P_err φ = M_dip * K_w φ + χ φ * K_w φ := by
        intro φ; dsimp [P_err]; ring
      have hχK_cont : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => χ φ * K_w φ) := hχ_cont.mul hK_cont
      simp_rw [h_add]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
          ((hK_cont.const_mul M_dip).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hχK_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      calc M_dip + (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ)
          = M_dip * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) +
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ) := by
            rw [hK_avg, mul_one]
        _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              (M_dip * (∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_w φ) +
                ∫ φ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), χ φ * K_w φ) := by ring
    have h_pt_bound : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, P_err (θ + u) ≤ C_err * (1 - r) := by
      intro u hu
      by_cases hu_small : |u| ≤ δ_v / 2
      · have h_sin_u : |Real.sin (θ + u) - y₀| ≤ δ_v := by
          have h1 := Real.abs_sin_sub_sin_le (θ + u) θ
          have h2 : (θ + u) - θ = u := by ring
          rw [h2] at h1
          have h3 := abs_add_le (Real.sin (θ + u) - Real.sin θ) (Real.sin θ - y₀)
          have h4 : (Real.sin (θ + u) - Real.sin θ) + (Real.sin θ - y₀) =
              Real.sin (θ + u) - y₀ := by ring
          rw [h4] at h3
          linarith
        have hτ_one : τ_c (θ + u) = 1 := by
          dsimp [τ_c, ψ]
          have : |Real.sin (θ + u) - y₀| / δ_v ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hδv_pos).mpr h_sin_u
          have hmin : min 1 (2 - |Real.sin (θ + u) - y₀| / δ_v) = 1 :=
            min_eq_left (by linarith)
          rw [hmin, max_eq_right zero_le_one]
        have hχ_eq : M_dip + χ (θ + u) = 0 := by
          dsimp [χ, c_top, A_bump]
          rw [hτ_one]
          field_simp [h1_sub_μ_pos.ne']
          ring
        dsimp [P_err]
        rw [hχ_eq, zero_mul]
        exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
      · push Not at hu_small
        have h_jord_sq := (h_jordan u r hu hr_lo hr_lt).1
        have h_rot_norm : ‖circleMap 0 1 (θ + u) - (r : ℂ) * ζ‖ =
            ‖circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)‖ := by
          have : circleMap 0 1 (θ + u) - (r : ℂ) * ζ =
              ζ * (circleMap 0 1 u - (r : ℂ)) := by
            dsimp [ζ]
            rw [h_circle_add]
            ring
          rw [this, norm_mul, hζ_norm, one_mul]
        have h_den_lo : δ_v ^ 2 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2) ≤
            ‖circleMap 0 1 (θ + u) - (r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [h_rot_norm]
          have hu_sq : (δ_v / 2) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := by
            have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hu_small.le 2
            simpa [sq_abs] using this
          have h1 : 2 * (δ_v / 2) ^ 2 / Real.pi ^ 2 ≤ 2 * u ^ 2 / Real.pi ^ 2 := by
            refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sq_nonneg _)
            linarith
          have h2 : δ_v ^ 2 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2) = 2 * (δ_v / 2) ^ 2 / Real.pi ^ 2 := by ring
          linarith
        have h_num_hi : 1 - ‖(r : ℂ) * ζ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 - r) := by
          rw [norm_mul, hζ_norm, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_pos.le]
          nlinarith
        have hK_hi : K_w (θ + u) ≤ 2 * (1 - r) / (δ_v ^ 2 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2)) := by
          dsimp [K_w]
          exact div_le_div₀ (by linarith) h_num_hi (by positivity) h_den_lo
        have hMχ_hi : M_dip + χ (θ + u) ≤ M_dip + η_plus := by linarith [hχ_hi (θ + u)]
        calc P_err (θ + u)
            ≤ (M_dip + η_plus) * (2 * (1 - r) / (δ_v ^ 2 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2))) :=
              mul_le_mul hMχ_hi hK_hi (hK_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = C_err * (1 - r) := by
              dsimp [C_err]
              field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hδv_pos.ne']
              ring
    rw [h_err_rep]
    have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
      ((hP_cont.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := C_err * (1 - r)))
      (fun u hu => h_pt_bound u hu)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const] at h_int_le
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_int_le
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ u in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, P_err (θ + u))
        ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((Real.pi - -Real.pi) * (C_err * (1 - r))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (by positivity)
      _ = C_err * (1 - r) := by
          field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne']
          ring

  have h_s3 : spdcCirclePatchProp := by
    intro V_comb P_patch U_comb Φ_base R_Φ hV_open hU_holo hP_open hR_Φ hΦ_holo hΦ_zero h_bdry
    dsimp only
    set H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => U_comb (p + Φ_base ζ)) 0 1
    have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR_Φ
    have hΦ_diffAt : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ_base ζ :=
      fun ζ hζ => hΦ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (h_cb_sub hζ))
    let γ_base : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun θ => Φ_base (circleMap 0 1 θ)
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ_base := by
      refine ContinuousOn.comp_continuous
        (fun ζ hζ => (hΦ_diffAt ζ hζ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (continuous_circleMap 0 1) ?_
      intro θ
      simp [norm_circleMap_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p₀ hp₀
      obtain ⟨r_p, hr_p_pos, hr_p_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hP_open p₀ hp₀
      let K₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (fun θ : ℝ => p₀ + γ_base θ) '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have hK₀_comp : IsCompact K₀ := isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_const.add hγ_cont)
      have hK₀_sub : K₀ ⊆ V_comb := by
        rintro _ ⟨θ, _, rfl⟩
        exact h_bdry p₀ hp₀ θ
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hK_ct_sub⟩ := hK₀_comp.exists_cthickening_subset_open hV_open hK₀_sub
      have hK_ct_comp : IsCompact (Metric.cthickening δ K₀) := hK₀_comp.cthickening
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hK_ct_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hU_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_ct_sub)
      let M₁ : ℝ := max M₀ 0
      have hM₁_nn : 0 ≤ M₁ := le_max_right _ _
      let ρ : ℝ := min (δ / 3) r_p
      have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := lt_min (by positivity) hr_p_pos
      have h_mem_ct : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * ρ), ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          q + γ_base θ ∈ Metric.cthickening δ K₀ := by
        intro q hq θ hθ
        apply Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening
        rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
        refine ⟨p₀ + γ_base θ, ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
