      intro m' r' δ_lo δ_hi t₀ hm' hr' hδ_lo
      dsimp only
      refine ⟨(h_cone_open m' r' δ_lo δ_hi).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const), ?_⟩
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
      set δ₁ : ℝ := h_ref - y₁.im
      set δ₂ : ℝ := h_ref - y₂.im
      have h_im : h_ref - (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im = a * δ₁ + b * δ₂ := by
        simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
        dsimp [δ₁, δ₂]
        linear_combination h_ref * hab.symm
      have h_re : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).re - x₀ = a * (y₁.re - x₀) + b * (y₂.re - x₀) := by
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        linear_combination -x₀ * hab.symm
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt hδ_lo hy₁.1
      have hδ₂_pos : 0 < δ₂ := lt_of_le_of_lt hδ_lo hy₂.1
      have hc1 : δ_lo < a * δ₁ + b * δ₂ := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          nlinarith [hy₂.1]
        · nlinarith [hy₁.1, hy₂.1]
      have hc2 : a * δ₁ + b * δ₂ < δ_hi := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          nlinarith [hy₂.2.1]
        · nlinarith [hy₁.2.1, hy₂.2.1]
      have hc3 : |(a • y₁ + b • y₂).re - x₀| < m' * (a * δ₁ + b * δ₂) := by
        rw [h_re]
        have h_tri := abs_add_le (a * (y₁.re - x₀)) (b * (y₂.re - x₀))
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb] at h_tri
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          nlinarith [hy₂.2.2.1]
        · nlinarith [hy₁.2.2.1, hy₂.2.2.1, abs_nonneg (y₂.re - x₀)]
      have hc4 : ‖t₀‖ < r' * ((a * δ₁ + b * δ₂) / d) ^ α := by
        rcases le_total δ₁ δ₂ with h12 | h21
        · have h_ge : δ₁ ≤ a * δ₁ + b * δ₂ := by nlinarith
          have h_rpow : (δ₁ / d) ^ α ≤ ((a * δ₁ + b * δ₂) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_ge hd.le) hα_pos.le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy₁.2.2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow hr'.le)
        · have h_ge : δ₂ ≤ a * δ₁ + b * δ₂ := by nlinarith
          have h_rpow : (δ₂ / d) ^ α ≤ ((a * δ₁ + b * δ₂) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_ge hd.le) hα_pos.le
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy₂.2.2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow hr'.le)
      change δ_lo < h_ref - (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im ∧
        h_ref - (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im < δ_hi ∧
        |(a • y₁ + b • y₂).re - x₀| < m' * (h_ref - (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im) ∧
        ‖t₀‖ < r' * ((h_ref - (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im) / d) ^ α
      rw [h_im]
      exact ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩

    have h_rect_open_convex : ∀ x_c rx y_lo y_hi : ℝ,
        let R_sl : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | |y.re - x_c| < rx ∧ y_lo < y.im ∧ y.im < y_hi }
        IsOpen R_sl ∧ Convex ℝ R_sl := by
      intro x_c rx y_lo y_hi
      dsimp only
      refine ⟨(isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
          continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)), ?_⟩
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
      have h_re : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).re - x_c = a * (y₁.re - x_c) + b * (y₂.re - x_c) := by
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        linear_combination -x_c * hab.symm
      have h_im : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im = a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im := by
        simp [Complex.real_smul]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le (a * (y₁.re - x_c)) (b * (y₂.re - x_c))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb] at h_tri
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_re]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1
          simpa using hy₂.1
        · nlinarith [hy₁.1, hy₂.1, abs_nonneg (y₂.re - x_c)]
      · rw [h_im]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1
          simpa using hy₂.2.1
        · have h1 : a * y_lo < a * y₁.im := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁.2.1 ha_pos
          have h2 : b * y_lo ≤ b * y₂.im := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂.2.1.le hb
          have h3 : (a + b) * y_lo = y_lo := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          linarith
      · rw [h_im]
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
        · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
          subst hb1
          simpa using hy₂.2.2
        · have h1 : a * y₁.im < a * y_hi := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁.2.2 ha_pos
          have h2 : b * y₂.im ≤ b * y_hi := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂.2.2.le hb
          have h3 : (a + b) * y_hi = y_hi := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          linarith

    have h_1d_uniq : ∀ (V S_seed : Set ℂ) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ) (y_seed : ℂ),
        IsOpen V → Convex ℝ V → IsOpen S_seed → S_seed ⊆ V → y_seed ∈ S_seed →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ V → DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ V →
        (∀ y ∈ S_seed, f₁ y = f₂ y) →
        ∀ y ∈ V, f₁ y = f₂ y := by
      intro V S_seed f₁ f₂ y_seed hVo hVc hSo hSV hys hf₁ hf₂ heq y hy
      exact AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
        (hf₁.analyticOnNhd hVo) (hf₂.analyticOnNhd hVo) hVc.isPreconnected
        (hSV hys) (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hSo.mem_nhds hys) heq) hy

    have h_steep_slice_eq : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, γ_dyad * ‖t₀‖ < |t₀.im| →
        { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ W_steep } =
          { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ spdcConeDomain h_ref x₀ m_steep d (10 * r) α (d / 2) δ_ceil } := by
      intro t₀ ht₀
      ext y
      simp only [W_steep, spdcSteepDomain, spdcConeDomain, Set.mem_setOf_eq, mul_assoc]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1⟩,
        fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2, ht₀⟩⟩

    have h_prev_eq_steep : ∀ p ∈ Ω_prev ∩ W_steep, U_prev p = U_steep p := by
      rintro ⟨y₀, t₀⟩ ⟨hp_prev, hp_steep⟩
      have ht₀_st : γ_dyad * ‖t₀‖ < |t₀.im| := hp_steep.2.2.2.2
      let V_ov : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ Ω_prev } ∩ { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ W_steep }
      let S_ov : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ Ω₀ } ∩ { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ W_steep }
      obtain ⟨h1_o, h1_c⟩ := h_slice_open_convex m r δ_prev δ_ceil t₀ hm_pos hr hδ_prev_pos.le
      obtain ⟨h0_o, _⟩ := h_slice_open_convex m r δ₀ δ_ceil t₀ hm_pos hr hδ₀_pos.le
      obtain ⟨hw_o, hw_c⟩ := h_slice_open_convex m_steep (10 * r) (d / 2) δ_ceil t₀
        hm_steep_pos (by positivity) (by positivity)
      rw [← h_steep_slice_eq t₀ ht₀_st] at hw_o hw_c
      let δ_low : ℝ := max (h_ref - y₀.im) ((3 / 2) * δ₀)
      let y_low : ℂ := (y₀.re : ℂ) + ((h_ref - δ_low : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hy_low_im : h_ref - y_low.im = δ_low := by simp [y_low]
      have hy_low_re : y_low.re = y₀.re := by simp [y_low]
      have hδ_low_ge : h_ref - y₀.im ≤ δ_low := le_max_left _ _
      have hδ_low_gt_δ₀ : δ₀ < δ_low :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)
      have hδ_low_lt_ceil : δ_low < δ_ceil :=
        max_lt hp_prev.2.1 (by linarith)
      have h_rpow_le : ((h_ref - y₀.im) / d) ^ α ≤ (δ_low / d) ^ α :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (div_nonneg (lt_trans hδ_prev_pos hp_prev.1).le hd.le)
          (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ_low_ge hd.le) hα_pos.le
      have hy_low_mem : y_low ∈ S_ov := by
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ht₀_st⟩⟩
        · simpa [hy_low_im] using hδ_low_gt_δ₀
        · simpa [hy_low_im] using hδ_low_lt_ceil
        · rw [hy_low_re, hy_low_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp_prev.2.2.1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_low_ge hm_pos.le)
        · rw [hy_low_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp_prev.2.2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le hr.le)
        · rw [hy_low_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp_steep.1 hδ_low_ge
        · simpa [hy_low_im] using hδ_low_lt_ceil
        · rw [hy_low_re, hy_low_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp_steep.2.2.1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_low_ge hm_steep_pos.le)
        · rw [hy_low_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp_steep.2.2.2.1
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le (by positivity))
      exact h_1d_uniq V_ov S_ov (fun y => U_prev (y, t₀)) (fun y => U_steep (y, t₀)) y_low
        (h1_o.inter hw_o) (h1_c.inter hw_c) (h0_o.inter hw_o)
        (fun y hy => ⟨hΩ₀_sub_prev hy.1, hy.2⟩) hy_low_mem
        (hU_prev_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
          (fun y hy => hy.1))
        (hU_steep_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
          (fun y hy => hy.2))
        (fun y hy => by rw [hU_prev_U₀ (y, t₀) hy.1, hU₀_steep (y, t₀) hy])
        y₀ ⟨hp_prev, hp_steep⟩

    let V_comb : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Ω_prev ∪ W_steep
    have hV_comb_open : IsOpen V_comb := hΩ_prev_open.union hW_steep_open
    let U_comb : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => if p ∈ Ω_prev then U_prev p else U_steep p
    have hU_comb_prev : ∀ p ∈ Ω_prev, U_comb p = U_prev p := fun p hp => if_pos hp
    have hU_comb_steep : ∀ p ∈ W_steep, U_comb p = U_steep p := by
      intro p hp
      by_cases hp_pr : p ∈ Ω_prev
      · dsimp [U_comb]
        rw [if_pos hp_pr]
        exact h_prev_eq_steep p ⟨hp_pr, hp⟩
      · dsimp [U_comb]
        rw [if_neg hp_pr]
    have hU_comb_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_comb V_comb := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with hp_pr | hp_st
      · have h_ev : U_comb =ᶠ[nhds p] U_prev :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩ_prev_open.mem_nhds hp_pr) hU_comb_prev
        exact ((hU_prev_holo.differentiableAt (hΩ_prev_open.mem_nhds hp_pr)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
          h_ev).differentiableWithinAt
      · have h_ev : U_comb =ᶠ[nhds p] U_steep :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW_steep_open.mem_nhds hp_st) hU_comb_steep
        exact ((hU_steep_holo.differentiableAt (hW_steep_open.mem_nhds hp_st)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
          h_ev).differentiableWithinAt

    let IsActive : ℂ × ℂ → Prop := fun p => p ∈ Ω_next ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < (3 / 2) * δ_prev
    have hActive_open : IsOpen { p : ℂ × ℂ | IsActive p } :=
      hΩ_next_open.inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
          continuous_const)

    let δ_h_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => h_ref - p.1.im
    let R_rad_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => r * (δ_h_fn p / d) ^ α
    let c_shift_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.2 / ((3 * R_rad_fn p : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let g_bump_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      if hc : ‖c_shift_fn p‖ < 1 / 3 then Classical.choose (hBump_ex (c_shift_fn p) hc)
      else fun _ => 0
    let Φ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p ζ =>
      ((δ_h_fn p : ℂ) * g_bump_fn p ζ, ((3 * R_rad_fn p : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ)
    let H_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p q =>
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => U_comb (q + Φ_fn p ζ)) 0 1
    let σ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => (D_dip + C_bump + 2) * δ_h_fn p
    let μ_y_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p => (1 / 20) * min (δ_h_fn p) (δ_h_fn p - δ_next)
    let μ_t_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ := fun p =>
      min ((R_rad_fn p - ‖p.2‖) / 2) (γ_dyad * R_rad_fn p / 20)
    let W_rect_fn : ℂ × ℂ → Set ℂ := fun p =>
      { y : ℂ | |y.re - p.1.re| < μ_y_fn p ∧
        p.1.im - σ_fn p - μ_y_fn p < y.im ∧ y.im < p.1.im + μ_y_fn p }
    let S_rect_fn : ℂ × ℂ → Set ℂ := fun p =>
      { y : ℂ | |y.re - p.1.re| < μ_y_fn p ∧
        p.1.im - σ_fn p - μ_y_fn p < y.im ∧ y.im < p.1.im - σ_fn p + μ_y_fn p }
    let P_box_fn : ℂ × ℂ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun p =>
      W_rect_fn p ×ˢ Metric.ball p.2 (μ_t_fn p)

    have h_active_patch : ∀ p_st : ℂ × ℂ, IsActive p_st →
        0 < σ_fn p_st ∧ 0 < μ_y_fn p_st ∧ 0 < μ_t_fn p_st ∧
        p_st ∈ P_box_fn p_st ∧
        IsOpen (P_box_fn p_st) ∧
        S_rect_fn p_st ⊆ W_rect_fn p_st ∧
        S_rect_fn p_st ×ˢ Metric.ball p_st.2 (μ_t_fn p_st) ⊆ Ω_prev ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_fn p_st) (P_box_fn p_st) ∧
        (∀ q ∈ S_rect_fn p_st ×ˢ Metric.ball p_st.2 (μ_t_fn p_st), H_fn p_st q = U_prev q) ∧
        ‖H_fn p_st p_st‖ ≤ M_amp * (δ_h_fn p_st) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
      intro p_st ⟨hp_next, hp_hi⟩
      set δ_h : ℝ := δ_h_fn p_st
      set R : ℝ := R_rad_fn p_st
      have hδ_h_gt_next : δ_next < δ_h := hp_next.1
      have hδ_h_pos : 0 < δ_h := lt_trans hδ_next_pos hδ_h_gt_next
      have hδ_h_lt_32_δ₀ : δ_h < (3 / 2) * δ₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hp_hi (by linarith)
      have hR_pos : 0 < R := mul_pos hr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hδ_h_pos hd) α)
      have ht_lt_R : ‖p_st.2‖ < R := hp_next.2.2.2
      have hc_lt : ‖c_shift_fn p_st‖ < 1 / 3 := by
        dsimp [c_shift_fn]
        rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 * R)]
        exact (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)).mpr (by linarith)
      let g : ℂ → ℂ := Classical.choose (hBump_ex (c_shift_fn p_st) hc_lt)
      have hg_eq : g_bump_fn p_st = g := dif_pos hc_lt
      have h_spec := Classical.choose_spec (hBump_ex (c_shift_fn p_st) hc_lt)
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) := h_spec.1
      have hg_zero : g 0 = 0 := h_spec.2.1
      have hg_cb : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ 1 / 5 :=
        h_spec.2.2.1
      have hg_col : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1,
          |(c_shift_fn p_st + ζ).im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_dyad * ‖c_shift_fn p_st + ζ‖ →
          (g ζ).im ≤ -(D_dip + 1) := h_spec.2.2.2

      have hσ_pos : 0 < σ_fn p_st := by dsimp [σ_fn]; positivity
      have hμy_pos : 0 < μ_y_fn p_st := by
        dsimp [μ_y_fn]
        exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min hδ_h_pos (by linarith))
      have hμy_le : μ_y_fn p_st ≤ δ_h / 20 := by
        dsimp [μ_y_fn]
        have := min_le_left δ_h (δ_h - δ_next)
        linarith
      have hμt_pos : 0 < μ_t_fn p_st :=
        lt_min (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have hμt_le1 : μ_t_fn p_st ≤ (R - ‖p_st.2‖) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      have hμt_le2 : μ_t_fn p_st ≤ γ_dyad * R / 20 := min_le_right _ _

      have hp_in_box : p_st ∈ P_box_fn p_st := by
        refine ⟨⟨by simp [hμy_pos], by linarith, by linarith⟩,
          Metric.mem_ball_self hμt_pos⟩
      have hP_open : IsOpen (P_box_fn p_st) :=
        (h_rect_open_convex p_st.1.re (μ_y_fn p_st) (p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st - μ_y_fn p_st)
          (p_st.1.im + μ_y_fn p_st)).1.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hS_sub_W : S_rect_fn p_st ⊆ W_rect_fn p_st := by
        intro y hy
        exact ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1, by linarith [hy.2.2]⟩

      have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (Φ_fn p_st) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) := by
        dsimp [Φ_fn]
        rw [hg_eq]
        exact (hg_holo.const_mul (δ_h : ℂ)).prodMk
          (differentiable_id.differentiableOn.const_mul ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hΦ_zero : Φ_fn p_st 0 = 0 := by
        dsimp [Φ_fn]
        rw [hg_eq, hg_zero]
        simp

      have h_common : ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p_st, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
          let q' : ℂ × ℂ := q + Φ_fn p_st ζ
          h_ref - q'.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
          |q'.1.re - x₀| < (m + C_bump + 2) * δ_h ∧
          ‖q'.2‖ < 4 * R := by
        intro q hq ζ hζ
        dsimp only
        set q' : ℂ × ℂ := q + Φ_fn p_st ζ
        have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa using hζ
        have hg_norm : ‖g ζ‖ ≤ C_bump := (hg_cb ζ hζ).1
        have hg_re : |(g ζ).re| ≤ C_bump := le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
        have hg_im : |(g ζ).im| ≤ C_bump := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hg_norm
        have hq1_re : q'.1.re = q.1.re + δ_h * (g ζ).re := by
          simp [q', Φ_fn, hg_eq, δ_h]
        have hq1_im : q'.1.im = q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im := by
          simp [q', Φ_fn, hg_eq, δ_h]
        have h_depth_hi : h_ref - q'.1.im < δ_ceil := by
          have h_diff_y : p_st.1.im - q.1.im < (D_dip + C_bump + 2 + 1 / 20) * δ_h := by
            have := hq.1.2.1
            dsimp [σ_fn] at this
            linarith
          have h_neg_gim : -(g ζ).im ≤ C_bump := by
            have := (abs_le.mp hg_im).1
            linarith
          have h1 : h_ref - q'.1.im < (D_dip + 2 * C_bump + 4) * δ_h := by
            rw [hq1_im]
            have : h_ref - (q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im) =
                δ_h + (p_st.1.im - q.1.im) + δ_h * (-(g ζ).im) := by dsimp [δ_h, δ_h_fn]; ring
            rw [this]
            nlinarith
          have h2 : (D_dip + 2 * C_bump + 4) * δ_h <
              (D_dip + 2 * C_bump + 4) * ((3 / 2) * δ₀) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hδ_h_lt_32_δ₀ (by positivity)
          nlinarith
        have h_re_hi : |q'.1.re - x₀| < (m + C_bump + 2) * δ_h := by
          rw [hq1_re]
          have h_split : q.1.re + δ_h * (g ζ).re - x₀ =
              (q.1.re - p_st.1.re) + (p_st.1.re - x₀) + δ_h * (g ζ).re := by ring
          rw [h_split]
          have h_tri1 := abs_add_le ((q.1.re - p_st.1.re) + (p_st.1.re - x₀)) (δ_h * (g ζ).re)
          have h_tri2 := abs_add_le (q.1.re - p_st.1.re) (p_st.1.re - x₀)
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hδ_h_pos] at h_tri1
          have hp_re := hp_next.2.2.1
          have hq_re := hq.1.1
          nlinarith
        have h_t_hi : ‖q'.2‖ < 4 * R := by
          have ht_dist : ‖q.2 - p_st.2‖ < μ_t_fn p_st := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hq.2
          have hq2_lt_R : ‖q.2‖ < R := by
            have := norm_sub_norm_le q.2 p_st.2
            linarith
          have h3Rζ : ‖((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ‖ ≤ 3 * R := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
            nlinarith
          calc ‖q'.2‖ = ‖q.2 + ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ‖ := rfl
            _ ≤ ‖q.2‖ + ‖((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ < 4 * R := by linarith
        exact ⟨h_depth_hi, h_re_hi, h_t_hi⟩

      have h_deep_in_prev : ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p_st, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
          D_dip * δ_h < h_ref - (q + Φ_fn p_st ζ).1.im →
          q + Φ_fn p_st ζ ∈ Ω_prev := by
        intro q hq ζ hζ h_deep
        obtain ⟨h_ceil, h_re, h_t⟩ := h_common q hq ζ hζ
        set q' : ℂ × ℂ := q + Φ_fn p_st ζ
        have h_lo : δ_prev < h_ref - q'.1.im := by nlinarith
        have h_re' : |q'.1.re - x₀| < m * (h_ref - q'.1.im) := by
          calc |q'.1.re - x₀| < (m + C_bump + 2) * δ_h := h_re
            _ ≤ (m * D_dip) * δ_h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_D hδ_h_pos.le
            _ = m * (D_dip * δ_h) := by ring
            _ < m * (h_ref - q'.1.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_deep hm_pos
        have h_t' : ‖q'.2‖ < r * ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α := by
          have h1 : D_dip ^ α * R = r * ((D_dip * δ_h) / d) ^ α := by
            dsimp [R, R_rad_fn]
            have : (D_dip * δ_h) / d = D_dip * (δ_h / d) := by ring
            rw [this, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
            ring
          have h2 : ((D_dip * δ_h) / d) ^ α ≤ ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_deep.le hd.le) hα_pos.le
          calc ‖q'.2‖ < 4 * R := h_t
            _ < 11 * R := by linarith
            _ ≤ D_dip ^ α * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD_rpow hR_pos.le
            _ = r * ((D_dip * δ_h) / d) ^ α := h1
            _ ≤ r * ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hr.le
        exact ⟨h_lo, h_ceil, h_re', h_t'⟩

      have h_seed_disk : ∀ q ∈ S_rect_fn p_st ×ˢ Metric.ball p_st.2 (μ_t_fn p_st),
          ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, q + Φ_fn p_st ζ ∈ Ω_prev := by
        intro q hq ζ hζ
        have hq_box : q ∈ P_box_fn p_st := ⟨hS_sub_W hq.1, hq.2⟩
        refine h_deep_in_prev q hq_box ζ hζ ?_
        have hq1_im : (q + Φ_fn p_st ζ).1.im = q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im := by
          simp [Φ_fn, hg_eq, δ_h]
        have hg_im_hi : (g ζ).im ≤ 1 / 5 := (hg_cb ζ hζ).2
        have hq_im_hi : q.1.im < p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st + μ_y_fn p_st := hq.1.2.2
        rw [hq1_im]
        dsimp [σ_fn] at hq_im_hi
        have : h_ref - (q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im) =
            δ_h + (p_st.1.im - q.1.im) - δ_h * (g ζ).im := by dsimp [δ_h, δ_h_fn]; ring
        rw [this]
        nlinarith

      have h_seed_sub_prev : S_rect_fn p_st ×ˢ Metric.ball p_st.2 (μ_t_fn p_st) ⊆ Ω_prev := by
        intro q hq
        have h0 := h_seed_disk q hq 0 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one)
        simpa [hΦ_zero] using h0

      have h_circle_cases : ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p_st, ∀ θ : ℝ,
          let ζ : ℂ := circleMap 0 1 θ
          let q' : ℂ × ℂ := q + Φ_fn p_st ζ
          (q' ∈ W_steep ∧ δ_h / 2 < h_ref - q'.1.im) ∨
          (q' ∈ Ω_prev ∧ D_dip * δ_h < h_ref - q'.1.im) := by
        intro q hq θ
        dsimp only
        set ζ : ℂ := circleMap 0 1 θ
        set q' : ℂ × ℂ := q + Φ_fn p_st ζ
        have hζ_sp : ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp [ζ, norm_circleMap_zero]
        have hζ_cb : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ_sp
        obtain ⟨h_ceil, h_re, h_t⟩ := h_common q hq ζ hζ_cb
        have hq1_im : q'.1.im = q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im := by simp [q', Φ_fn, hg_eq, δ_h]
        by_cases h_st : γ_dyad * ‖q'.2‖ < |q'.2.im|
        · left
          have hg_im_hi : (g ζ).im ≤ 1 / 5 := (hg_cb ζ hζ_cb).2
          have hq_im_hi : q.1.im < p_st.1.im + μ_y_fn p_st := hq.1.2.2
          have h_gt_half : δ_h / 2 < h_ref - q'.1.im := by
            rw [hq1_im]
            have : h_ref - (q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im) =
                δ_h + (p_st.1.im - q.1.im) - δ_h * (g ζ).im := by dsimp [δ_h, δ_h_fn]; ring
            rw [this]
            nlinarith
          have h_gt_d2 : d / 2 < h_ref - q'.1.im := by linarith
          have h_re_st : |q'.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (h_ref - q'.1.im) := by
            calc |q'.1.re - x₀| < (m + C_bump + 2) * δ_h := h_re
              _ = m_steep * (δ_h / 2) := by dsimp [m_steep]; ring
              _ < m_steep * (h_ref - q'.1.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_gt_half hm_steep_pos
          have h_t_st : ‖q'.2‖ < 10 * r * ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α := by
            have h_half_rpow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ α := by
              have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
                (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hα₂.le
              simpa using this
            have h1 : 5 * R ≤ 10 * r * ((δ_h / 2) / d) ^ α := by
              dsimp [R, R_rad_fn]
              have : (δ_h / 2) / d = (1 / 2) * (δ_h / d) := by ring
              rw [this, Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
              have hd_rpow_pos : 0 < (δ_h / d) ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) α
              nlinarith
            have h2 : ((δ_h / 2) / d) ^ α ≤ ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
                (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_gt_half.le hd.le) hα_pos.le
            calc ‖q'.2‖ < 4 * R := h_t
              _ < 5 * R := by linarith
              _ ≤ 10 * r * ((δ_h / 2) / d) ^ α := h1
              _ ≤ 10 * r * ((h_ref - q'.1.im) / d) ^ α :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
          exact ⟨⟨h_gt_d2, h_ceil, h_re_st, h_t_st, h_st⟩, h_gt_half⟩
        · right
          push Not at h_st
          let t_st' : ℂ := p_st.2 + ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ
          have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := by simpa using hζ_sp
          have ht_st'_gt : 2 * R < ‖t_st'‖ := by
            have h1 : ‖((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ‖ = 3 * R := by
              rw [norm_mul, hζ_norm, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
                Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
            have h2 : ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ = t_st' - p_st.2 := by dsimp [t_st']; abel
            have h3 := norm_sub_le t_st' p_st.2
            rw [← h2, h1] at h3
            linarith
          have ht_diff : ‖q.2 - p_st.2‖ < (γ_dyad / 40) * ‖t_st'‖ := by
            have h1 : ‖q.2 - p_st.2‖ < μ_t_fn p_st := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hq.2
            calc ‖q.2 - p_st.2‖ < γ_dyad * R / 20 := lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hμt_le2
              _ < (γ_dyad / 40) * ‖t_st'‖ := by nlinarith
          have hq2_le : ‖q'.2‖ < (11 / 10) * ‖t_st'‖ := by
            have h_eq : q'.2 = t_st' + (q.2 - p_st.2) := by
              dsimp [q', Φ_fn, t_st']
              abel
            rw [h_eq]
            have h1 := norm_add_le t_st' (q.2 - p_st.2)
            nlinarith
          have ht_st'_im : |t_st'.im| ≤ (6 / 5) * γ_dyad * ‖t_st'‖ := by
            have h_eq : t_st' = q'.2 - (q.2 - p_st.2) := by dsimp [q', Φ_fn, t_st']; abel
            have h1 : |t_st'.im| ≤ |q'.2.im| + |(q.2 - p_st.2).im| := by
              rw [h_eq, Complex.sub_im]
              exact abs_sub _ _
            have h2 : |(q.2 - p_st.2).im| ≤ ‖q.2 - p_st.2‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
            nlinarith
          have h_col_c : |(c_shift_fn p_st + ζ).im| ≤
              (6 / 5) * γ_dyad * ‖c_shift_fn p_st + ζ‖ := by
            have h3R_ne : ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
            have h_scale : t_st' = ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * (c_shift_fn p_st + ζ) := by
              dsimp [t_st', c_shift_fn]
              change p_st.2 + ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ = ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p_st.2 / ((3 * R : ℝ) : ℂ) + ζ)
              field_simp [h3R_ne]
            have h_im_sc : t_st'.im = (3 * R) * (c_shift_fn p_st + ζ).im := by
              rw [h_scale]
              simp
            have h_nm_sc : ‖t_st'‖ = (3 * R) * ‖c_shift_fn p_st + ζ‖ := by
              rw [h_scale, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
            rw [h_im_sc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 3 * R), h_nm_sc] at ht_st'_im
            nlinarith
          have hg_dip : (g ζ).im ≤ -(D_dip + 1) := hg_col ζ hζ_sp h_col_c
          have hq_im_hi : q.1.im < p_st.1.im + μ_y_fn p_st := hq.1.2.2
          have h_deep : D_dip * δ_h < h_ref - q'.1.im := by
            rw [hq1_im]
            have : h_ref - (q.1.im + δ_h * (g ζ).im) =
                δ_h + (p_st.1.im - q.1.im) - δ_h * (g ζ).im := by dsimp [δ_h, δ_h_fn]; ring
            rw [this]
            nlinarith
          exact ⟨h_deep_in_prev q hq ζ hζ_cb h_deep, h_deep⟩

      have h_circle_in_V : ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p_st, ∀ θ : ℝ,
          q + Φ_fn p_st (circleMap 0 1 θ) ∈ V_comb := by
        intro q hq θ
        rcases h_circle_cases q hq θ with ⟨h_w, _⟩ | ⟨h_p, _⟩
        · exact Or.inr h_w
        · exact Or.inl h_p

      obtain ⟨hH_holo, hH_disk, hH_bd⟩ := hPatch V_comb (P_box_fn p_st) U_comb
        (Φ_fn p_st) R_Φ hV_comb_open hU_comb_holo hP_open hR_Φ hΦ_holo hΦ_zero h_circle_in_V

      have hH_seed_eq : ∀ q ∈ S_rect_fn p_st ×ˢ Metric.ball p_st.2 (μ_t_fn p_st),
          H_fn p_st q = U_prev q := by
        intro q hq
        have hq_box : q ∈ P_box_fn p_st := ⟨hS_sub_W hq.1, hq.2⟩
        change (fun p => Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => U_comb (p + Φ_fn p_st ζ)) 0 1) q = U_prev q
        rw [hH_disk q hq_box (fun ζ hζ => Or.inl (h_seed_disk q hq ζ hζ)),
          hU_comb_prev q (h_seed_sub_prev hq)]

      have hH_center_bd : ‖H_fn p_st p_st‖ ≤ M_amp * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
        refine hH_bd p_st hp_in_box (M_amp * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ?_
        intro θ
        set q' : ℂ × ℂ := p_st + Φ_fn p_st (circleMap 0 1 θ)
        rcases h_circle_cases p_st hp_in_box θ with ⟨h_w, h_gt_half⟩ | ⟨h_p, h_deep⟩
        · rw [hU_comb_steep q' h_w]
          have h1 := hU_steep_bd q' h_w
          have h_rpow : (h_ref - q'.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ (δ_h / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) h_gt_half.le (by linarith)
          have h_two_cancel : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * (δ_h / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * α) =
              δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
            rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
            congr 1
            ring
          calc ‖U_steep q'‖
              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * M_amp * (h_ref - q'.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := h1
            _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * M_amp * (δ_h / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow (by positivity)
            _ = M_amp * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * (δ_h / 2) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) := by ring
            _ = M_amp * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by rw [h_two_cancel]
        · rw [hU_comb_prev q' h_p]
          have h1 := hU_prev_bd q' h_p
          have h_gt : δ_h ≤ h_ref - q'.1.im := by nlinarith
          have h_rpow : (h_ref - q'.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hδ_h_pos h_gt (by linarith)
          exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow hM_amp)

      exact ⟨hσ_pos, hμy_pos, hμt_pos, hp_in_box, hP_open, hS_sub_W,
        h_seed_sub_prev, hH_holo, hH_seed_eq, hH_center_bd⟩

    have hH_eq_prev : ∀ p_st : ℂ × ℂ, IsActive p_st →
        ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p_st ∩ Ω_prev, H_fn p_st q = U_prev q := by
      intro p_st hp_act ⟨y₀, t₀⟩ ⟨hq_box, hq_prev⟩
      obtain ⟨hσ_pos, hμy_pos, _, _, hP_open, hS_sub_W, h_seed_sub, hH_holo, hH_seed, _⟩ :=
        h_active_patch p_st hp_act
      let V₁ : Set ℂ := W_rect_fn p_st ∩ { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ Ω_prev }
      obtain ⟨hW_o, hW_c⟩ := h_rect_open_convex p_st.1.re (μ_y_fn p_st)
        (p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st - μ_y_fn p_st) (p_st.1.im + μ_y_fn p_st)
      obtain ⟨hS_o, _⟩ := h_rect_open_convex p_st.1.re (μ_y_fn p_st)
        (p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st - μ_y_fn p_st) (p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st + μ_y_fn p_st)
      obtain ⟨hPr_o, hPr_c⟩ := h_slice_open_convex m r δ_prev δ_ceil t₀ hm_pos hr hδ_prev_pos.le
      let y_seed : ℂ := (p_st.1.re : ℂ) + ((p_st.1.im - σ_fn p_st : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hys_mem : y_seed ∈ S_rect_fn p_st := by
        refine ⟨by simp [y_seed, hμy_pos], ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [y_seed] <;> linarith
      have hS_sub_V₁ : S_rect_fn p_st ⊆ V₁ := fun y hy =>
        ⟨hS_sub_W hy, h_seed_sub ⟨hy, hq_box.2⟩⟩
      exact h_1d_uniq V₁ (S_rect_fn p_st) (fun y => H_fn p_st (y, t₀)) (fun y => U_prev (y, t₀))
        y_seed (hW_o.inter hPr_o) (hW_c.inter hPr_c) hS_o hS_sub_V₁ hys_mem
        (hH_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
          (fun y hy => ⟨hy.1, hq_box.2⟩))
        (hU_prev_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
          (fun y hy => hy.2))
        (fun y hy => hH_seed (y, t₀) ⟨hy, hq_box.2⟩)
        y₀ ⟨hq_box.1, hq_prev⟩

    have hH_pair_le : ∀ p₁ p₂ : ℂ × ℂ, IsActive p₁ → IsActive p₂ →
        p₁.1.im - σ_fn p₁ - μ_y_fn p₁ ≤ p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ - μ_y_fn p₂ →
        ∀ q ∈ P_box_fn p₁ ∩ P_box_fn p₂, H_fn p₁ q = H_fn p₂ q := by
      intro p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ h_bot_le ⟨y₀, t₀⟩ ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, hH₁_holo, _, _⟩ := h_active_patch p₁ hp₁
      obtain ⟨_, hμy₂_pos, _, _, _, hS₂_sub_W₂, h_seed₂_sub, hH₂_holo, _, _⟩ :=
        h_active_patch p₂ hp₂
      by_cases h_in_S₂ : y₀.im < p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ + μ_y_fn p₂
      · have hy₀_S₂ : y₀ ∈ S_rect_fn p₂ := ⟨hq₂.1.1, hq₂.1.2.1, h_in_S₂⟩
        have hq_prev : (y₀, t₀) ∈ Ω_prev := h_seed₂_sub ⟨hy₀_S₂, hq₂.2⟩
        rw [hH_eq_prev p₁ hp₁ (y₀, t₀) ⟨hq₁, hq_prev⟩,
          hH_eq_prev p₂ hp₂ (y₀, t₀) ⟨hq₂, hq_prev⟩]
      · push Not at h_in_S₂
        let V₁₂ : Set ℂ := W_rect_fn p₁ ∩ W_rect_fn p₂
        let S₁₂ : Set ℂ := W_rect_fn p₁ ∩ S_rect_fn p₂
        obtain ⟨hW₁_o, hW₁_c⟩ := h_rect_open_convex p₁.1.re (μ_y_fn p₁)
          (p₁.1.im - σ_fn p₁ - μ_y_fn p₁) (p₁.1.im + μ_y_fn p₁)
        obtain ⟨hW₂_o, hW₂_c⟩ := h_rect_open_convex p₂.1.re (μ_y_fn p₂)
          (p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ - μ_y_fn p₂) (p₂.1.im + μ_y_fn p₂)
        obtain ⟨hS₂_o, _⟩ := h_rect_open_convex p₂.1.re (μ_y_fn p₂)
          (p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ - μ_y_fn p₂) (p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ + μ_y_fn p₂)
        let y_bot : ℂ := (y₀.re : ℂ) + ((p₂.1.im - σ_fn p₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        have hy_bot_S₁₂ : y_bot ∈ S₁₂ := by
          refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · simpa [y_bot] using hq₁.1.1
          · simp only [y_bot, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
            linarith
          · simp only [y_bot, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,

        _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * A_ind) * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h_pos_d _).le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_Cst_le (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * M_amp * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
            dsimp [M_amp]; ring

    have hU₀_steep : ∀ p ∈ Ω_init ∩ W_steep, U₀ p = U_steep p := by
      intro p ⟨hp_init, hp_st⟩
      have hp2_ne : p.2 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (hW_p2_ne p hp_st)
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp2_ne
      rw [(hU₀_alg_even p hp_init).2, hs_agree p ⟨hp_init, hp_st⟩]
      dsimp [U_steep]
      exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp2_ne).symm

    let δ_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => max d (δ₀ / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)
    have hδ_seq_zero : δ_seq 0 = δ₀ := by
      simp [δ_seq, max_eq_right hd_lt_δ₀.le]
    have hδ_seq_ge_d : ∀ n : ℕ, d ≤ δ_seq n := fun _ => le_max_left _ _
    have hδ_seq_mono : ∀ n : ℕ, δ_seq (n + 1) ≤ δ_seq n := by
      intro n
      dsimp [δ_seq]
      refine max_le_max le_rfl ?_
      rw [pow_succ]
      have h2n_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hδ₀_pos.le h2n_pos (by linarith)
    have hδ_seq_le_δ₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, δ_seq n ≤ δ₀ := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => rw [hδ_seq_zero]
      | succ n ih => exact le_trans (hδ_seq_mono n) ih
    have hδ_seq_two : ∀ n : ℕ, δ_seq n ≤ 2 * δ_seq (n + 1) := by
      intro n
      dsimp [δ_seq]
      rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ two_pos.le]
      refine max_le_max (by linarith) ?_
      have h2n_ne : ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      rw [pow_succ]
      field_simp [h2n_ne]
      ring_nf
      exact le_rfl

    have h_ind : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ U_n : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        let Ω_n := spdcConeDomain h_ref x₀ m_aux d r α (δ_seq n) δ_ceil
        DifferentiableOn ℂ U_n Ω_n ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Ω_init, U_n p = U₀ p) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Ω_n, U_n (p.1, -p.2) = U_n p) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Ω_n, ‖U_n p‖ ≤ M_amp * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Ω_n ∩ W_steep, U_n p = U_steep p) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨U₀, ?_⟩
        dsimp only
        rw [hδ_seq_zero]
        exact ⟨hU₀_holo, fun _ _ => rfl, fun p hp => (hU₀_alg_even p hp).1, hU₀_bd, hU₀_steep⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨U_n, hUn_holo, hUn_U₀, hUn_even, hUn_bd, hUn_st⟩ := ih
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hδ_seq_mono n) with h_lt | h_eq
        · obtain ⟨U_next, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ :=
            ref_dyadic_band_step h_ref x₀ α d r D_dip C_bump γ_dyad R_Φ m_aux δ₀ δ_ceil
              M_amp (δ_seq n) (δ_seq (n + 1)) U₀ U_steep U_n
              hα₁ hα₂ hd hr hM_amp_pos.le hD_ge hD_rpow hFixedBump h_s3
              hm_aux_pos hm_aux_D hδ₀_pos hd_lt_δ₀ (hδ_seq_ge_d (n + 1)) h_lt
              (hδ_seq_le_δ₀ n) (hδ_seq_two n) (by dsimp [δ_ceil, M_ceil]; exact le_rfl)
              hU_steep_holo hU_steep_bd hU₀_steep hUn_holo hUn_U₀ hUn_even hUn_bd
          refine ⟨U_next, h1, ?_, h3, h4, h5⟩
          intro p hp
          have hp_n : p ∈ spdcConeDomain h_ref x₀ m_aux d r α (δ_seq n) δ_ceil :=
            ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (hδ_seq_le_δ₀ n) hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2⟩
          rw [h2 p hp_n, hUn_U₀ p hp]
        · refine ⟨U_n, ?_⟩
          dsimp only
          rw [h_eq]
          exact ⟨hUn_holo, hUn_U₀, hUn_even, hUn_bd, hUn_st⟩

    obtain ⟨N_fin, hN_pow⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (div_pos hd hδ₀_pos)
      (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
    have hδ_fin : δ_seq N_fin = d := by
      dsimp [δ_seq]
      apply max_eq_left
      rw [_root_.one_div_pow] at hN_pow
      have h1 := (lt_div_iff₀ hδ₀_pos).mp hN_pow
      have h2 : δ₀ / (2 : ℝ) ^ N_fin = 1 / (2 : ℝ) ^ N_fin * δ₀ := by ring
      linarith

    obtain ⟨U_fin, hUfin_holo, hUfin_U₀, hUfin_even, hUfin_bd, hUfin_steep⟩ := h_ind N_fin
    rw [hδ_fin] at hUfin_holo hUfin_even hUfin_bd hUfin_steep
    set Ω_d : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := spdcConeDomain h_ref x₀ m_aux d r α d δ_ceil

    have hΩ_out_sub : Ω_out ⊆ Ω_d := by
      intro p hp
      have hδ_p_pos : 0 < h_ref - p.1.im := lt_trans hd hp.1
      refine ⟨hp.1, ?_, ?_, hp.2.2.2⟩
      · calc h_ref - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ := hp.2.1
          _ < 8 * δ₀ := by linarith
          _ < M_ceil * δ₀ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hM_ceil_gt hδ₀_pos
      · exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2.2.1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hδ_p_pos.le)

    let s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 + p.2 ^ 2 * U_fin p
    refine ⟨s_cone, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (differentiableOn_fst (𝕜 := ℂ)).add
        (((differentiableOn_snd (𝕜 := ℂ)).pow 2).mul (hUfin_holo.mono hΩ_out_sub))
    · rintro ⟨y, t⟩ hp
      have hp_d : (y, t) ∈ Ω_d := hΩ_out_sub hp
      set δ_y : ℝ := h_ref - y.im
      have hδ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y := lt_trans hd hp.1
      have ht_lt : ‖t‖ < r * (δ_y / d) ^ α := hp.2.2.2
      have ht_sq_le : ‖t‖ ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 * (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * d ^ (-2 * α)) := by
        have h1 : ‖t‖ ^ 2 ≤ (r * (δ_y / d) ^ α) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg t) ht_lt.le 2
        have h_div_rpow : (δ_y / d) ^ α = δ_y ^ α * d ^ (-α) := by
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Real.mul_rpow hδ_y_pos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hd.le),
            Real.inv_rpow hd.le, Real.rpow_neg hd.le]
        have h_sq_id : (r * (δ_y / d) ^ α) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * d ^ (-2 * α)) := by
          rw [h_div_rpow]
          have hδ2 : δ_y ^ α * δ_y ^ α = δ_y ^ (2 * α) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hδ_y_pos]
            congr 1; ring
          have hd2 : d ^ (-α) * d ^ (-α) = d ^ (-2 * α) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hd]
            congr 1; ring
          calc (r * (δ_y ^ α * d ^ (-α))) ^ 2
              = r ^ 2 * ((δ_y ^ α * δ_y ^ α) * (d ^ (-α) * d ^ (-α))) := by ring
            _ = r ^ 2 * (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * d ^ (-2 * α)) := by rw [hδ2, hd2]
        rwa [h_sq_id] at h1
      have h_disp : ‖s_cone (y, t) - y‖ ≤
          A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_y := by
        have h_sub : s_cone (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_fin (y, t) := by dsimp [s_cone]; ring
        rw [h_sub, norm_mul, norm_pow]
        have hU_le := hUfin_bd (y, t) hp_d
        have hδ_cancel : δ_y ^ (2 * α) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) = δ_y := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hδ_y_pos]
          have : 2 * α + (1 - 2 * α) = 1 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.rpow_one]
        calc ‖t‖ ^ 2 * ‖U_fin (y, t)‖
            ≤ (r ^ 2 * (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * d ^ (-2 * α))) *
                (M_amp * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α)) :=
              mul_le_mul ht_sq_le hU_le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 *
                (δ_y ^ (2 * α) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α)) := by dsimp [M_amp]; ring
          _ = A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_y := by rw [hδ_cancel]
      have h_rad_pos : 0 < A_ind * r ^ 2 * d ^ (-2 * α) * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_y :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hA_ind_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hr))
          (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _)) (sq_pos_of_pos hM_scale)) hδ_y_pos
      refine h_ball y hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2.1 ?_
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    · intro y t hp
      have hp_d : (y, t) ∈ Ω_d := hΩ_out_sub hp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [s_cone]
        rw [hUfin_even (y, t) hp_d]
        ring
      · have h_sub : s_cone (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_fin (y, t) := by dsimp [s_cone]; ring
        rw [h_sub, norm_mul, norm_pow]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hUfin_bd (y, t) hp_d) (sq_nonneg ‖t‖)
        dsimp [M_amp] at h1
        linarith [show ‖t‖ ^ 2 * (A_ind * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) =
          A_ind * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) by ring]
    · intro y _
      simp [s_cone]
    · intro p ⟨_, hp_init⟩
      dsimp [s_cone]
      rw [hUfin_U₀ p hp_init, (hU₀_alg_even p hp_init).2]
      ring
    · intro p ⟨hp_out, hp_st⟩
      have hp2_ne : p.2 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (hW_p2_ne p hp_st)
      dsimp [s_cone]
      rw [hUfin_steep p ⟨hΩ_out_sub hp_out, hp_st⟩]
      dsimp [U_steep]
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hp2_ne]
      ring

  exact ⟨h_s1, h_dyad⟩

(hSteep : RefSteepContinuationProp)
    (hDyad : RefDyadicConeFillingProp)
    (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : ChordActionPackage S.toExpStripData)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData S.toExpStripData kind)
    (α₀ δ_b : ℝ)
    (hα₁ : 1 / 2 < α₀) (hα₂ : α₀ < 1)
    (hδ₁ : 0 < δ_b) (hδ₂ : δ_b < S.H / 2)
    (hh_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, seq.h_seq n < S.H)
    (hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto seq.h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H))
    (hℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto seq.ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hgap_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (S.H - seq.h_seq n) / seq.ℓ_seq n)
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hCone : ∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im → seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - seq.x_seq n| ≤ L * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) →
      shapeModulus S s ≤
        C_L * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) :
    DeepPassageAnchorData S.toExpStripData P kind seq

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hgap_tendsto
  have test_pillar1_holo :
      ∀ (X_loc : ExpStripData) (P_loc : ChordActionPackage X_loc) (U : Set ℂ)
        (s_p s_c J_p J_c t_f : ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_p U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_c U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_p U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_c U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ t_f U →
        (∀ z₀ ∈ U, ∃ (s₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t M₀ δ_z : ℝ),
          0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧ 4 * r_t ≤ r_s ∧ 0 ≤ M₀ ∧ r_t * M₀ ≤ P_loc.η_sf ∧
          0 < δ_z ∧ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z ⊆ U ∧
          Metric.ball s₀ r_s ⊆ X_loc.D_strip ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, ‖X_loc.f w‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ Real.sqrt ‖X_loc.q w‖ ≤ M₀) ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z,
            ‖s_p z - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖s_c z - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧
            ‖J_p z - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖J_c z - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖t_f z‖ < r_t)) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z =>
            deriv (fun J' => P_loc.p_act (s_c z) J' (t_f z)) (J_c z) -
              t_f z * deriv (fun s' => P_loc.p_act s' (J_c z) (t_f z)) (s_c z) -
              deriv (fun J' => P_loc.p_act (s_p z) J' (t_f z)) (J_p z))
          U := by
    intro X_loc P_loc U s_p s_c J_p J_c t_f hU hs_p hs_c hJ_p hJ_c ht_f hloc
    have holo_2d_comp_deriv : ∀ (z₀ c₀ : ℂ) (δ_z R₀ : ℝ) (V : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < δ_z → 0 < R₀ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ V (Metric.ball z₀ δ_z ×ˢ Metric.ball c₀ R₀) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ w (Metric.ball z₀ δ_z) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z, w z ∈ Metric.ball c₀ R₀) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => deriv (fun ξ => V (z, ξ)) (w z)) z₀ := by
      intro z₀ c₀ δ_z R₀ V w hδ_z hR₀ hV hw hw_maps
      have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z := Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_z
      let w₀ : ℂ := w z₀
      have hw₀_mem : w₀ ∈ Metric.ball c₀ R₀ := hw_maps z₀ hz₀_mem
      have hd₀_pos : 0 < R₀ - dist w₀ c₀ := sub_pos.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hw₀_mem)
      let ρ : ℝ := (R₀ - dist w₀ c₀) / 3
      have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by positivity
      have hw_cont : ContinuousAt w z₀ :=
        (hw.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz₀_mem)).continuousAt
      obtain ⟨δ_w, hδ_w_pos, hδ_w⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hw_cont ρ hρ_pos
      let δ₁ : ℝ := min (δ_z / 2) δ_w
      have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := lt_min (by positivity) hδ_w_pos
      have hδ₁_lt_δz : δ₁ < δ_z := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      have hball_sub_c₀ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ₁,
          Metric.ball (w z) (3 * ρ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball c₀ R₀ := by
        intro z hz ξ hξ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz hξ ⊢
        have hzw : dist (w z) w₀ < ρ := hδ_w (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _))
        have ht1 := dist_triangle ξ (w z) c₀
        have ht2 := dist_triangle (w z) w₀ c₀
        dsimp [ρ] at hξ hzw
        linarith
      let K : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z θ =>
        (circleMap 0 ρ θ * Complex.I) *
          ((1 / (circleMap 0 ρ θ) ^ 2) * V (z, w z + circleMap 0 ρ θ))
      have h_eq_int : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ₁,
          deriv (fun ξ => V (z, ξ)) (w z) =
            (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K z θ := by
        intro z hz
        have hz_δz : z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₁_lt_δz.le hz
        have hV_slice : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ => V (z, ξ))
            (Metric.ball (w z) (3 * ρ / 2)) := by
          refine hV.comp (differentiable_const z |>.prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn ?_
          intro ξ hξ
          exact ⟨hz_δz, hball_sub_c₀ z hz hξ⟩
        have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ξ => V (z, ξ)) (Metric.ball (w z) ρ) :=
          hV_slice.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
        have h_ci := DiffContOnCl.deriv_eq_smul_circleIntegral hρ_pos h_dc
        have h_ci_eq : (∮ ζ in C(w z, ρ), (1 / (ζ - w z) ^ 2) • V (z, ζ)) =
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K z θ := by
          unfold circleIntegral
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
          dsimp only
          rw [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center]
          have hcm : circleMap (w z) ρ θ = w z + circleMap 0 ρ θ := by
            simp [circleMap]
          rw [hcm]
          simp only [K, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [h_ci_eq] at h_ci
        have h2pi_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
          simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', Complex.I_ne_zero]
        rw [smul_eq_mul] at h_ci
        calc deriv (fun ξ => V (z, ξ)) (w z)
            = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
                ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) * deriv (fun ξ => V (z, ξ)) (w z)) := by
              field_simp [h2pi_ne]
          _ = (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
                ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K z θ := by rw [← h_ci]
      have hcm_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖circleMap 0 ρ θ‖ = ρ := by
        intro θ
        rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hρ_pos]
      have hcm_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap 0 ρ θ ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ h0
        have := hcm_norm θ
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      have h_maps_prod : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ₁, ∀ θ : ℝ,
          (z, w z + circleMap 0 ρ θ) ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ_z ×ˢ Metric.ball c₀ R₀ := by
        intro z hz θ
        refine ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₁_lt_δz.le hz, hball_sub_c₀ z hz ?_⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hcm_norm]
        linarith
      have hK_cont_prod : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2)
          (Metric.ball z₀ δ₁ ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℝ => circleMap 0 ρ p.2 * Complex.I) :=
          ((continuous_circleMap 0 ρ).comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const
        have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (circleMap 0 ρ p.2) ^ 2) := by
          refine continuous_const.div (((continuous_circleMap 0 ρ).comp continuous_snd).pow 2) ?_
          intro p
          exact pow_ne_zero 2 (hcm_ne p.2)
        have hw_sub : ContinuousOn w (Metric.ball z₀ δ₁) :=
          (hw.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ₁_lt_δz.le)).continuousOn

        have hs_p_eq : s_p_par T' = s_cone (y - t_par T', t_par T') := hs_fn_top _ hsh.1
        have hs_c_eq : s_c_par T' = s_cone (y, t_par T') := hs_fn_top _ hsh.2.1
        have hs_n_eq : s_n_par T' = s_cone (y + t_par T', t_par T') := hs_fn_top _ hsh.2.2
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hs_p_eq]
          have h_cb : y - t_par T' ∈ Metric.closedBall y ((1 / 4) * (ℓ * D)) :=
            Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hyp_mem16)
          have hd1 := le_trans (h_disp_ball _ h_cb T' hT'_lt) h_disp_small
          have htri : ‖s_cone (y - t_par T', t_par T') - y‖ ≤
              ‖s_cone (y - t_par T', t_par T') - (y - t_par T')‖ + ‖t_par T'‖ := by
            have h_eq : s_cone (y - t_par T', t_par T') - y =
                (s_cone (y - t_par T', t_par T') - (y - t_par T')) - t_par T' := by ring
            rw [h_eq]
            exact norm_sub_le _ _
          linarith
        · rw [hs_c_eq]
          have hd1 := le_trans
            (h_disp_ball y (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity)) T' hT'_lt) h_disp_small
          linarith
        · have h_id : J_p_par T' - 1 = (g_w y - g_w (y - t_par T')) / t_par T' := by
            dsimp [J_p_par, g_w]
            rw [hs_c_eq, hs_p_eq, div_sub_one ht'_ne]
            congr 1
            ring
          rw [h_id, norm_div]
          have hsub : ‖y - (y - t_par T')‖ = ‖t_par T'‖ := by simp
          rw [hsub] at hmvt_p
          have hle : ‖g_w y - g_w (y - t_par T')‖ / ‖t_par T'‖ ≤ 1 / 8 :=
            (div_le_iff₀ ht'_pos).mpr hmvt_p
          linarith
        · have h_id : J_c_par T' - 1 = (g_w (y + t_par T') - g_w y) / t_par T' := by
            dsimp [J_c_par, g_w]
            rw [hs_n_eq, hs_c_eq, div_sub_one ht'_ne]
            congr 1
            ring
          rw [h_id, norm_div]
          have hsub : ‖y + t_par T' - y‖ = ‖t_par T'‖ := by simp
          rw [hsub] at hmvt_c
          have hle : ‖g_w (y + t_par T') - g_w y‖ / ‖t_par T'‖ ≤ 1 / 8 :=
            (div_le_iff₀ ht'_pos).mpr hmvt_c
          linarith
      let g_par : ℂ → ℂ := fun T' =>
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_c_par T') J' (t_par T')) (J_c_par T') -
          t_par T' * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (J_c_par T') (t_par T')) (s_c_par T') -
          deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_p_par T') J' (t_par T')) (J_p_par T')
      have hg_par_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_par U_par := by
        let r_s_par : ℝ := (1 / 2) * (ℓ * D)
        let r_t_par : ℝ := 2 * T_max / m
        let M₀_par : ℝ := 2 * C_unif * m * D ^ (-α)
        have h_rs_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y r_s_par,
            w ∈ S.toExpStripData.D_strip ∧
            ‖S.toExpStripData.f w‖ ≤ M₀_par ∧
            Real.sqrt ‖S.toExpStripData.q w‖ ≤ M₀_par := by
          intro w hw
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
          have him_diff : |w.im - y.im| < (1 / 2) * (ℓ * D) :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - y)) hw
          have hre_diff : |w.re - y.re| < (1 / 2) * (ℓ * D) :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - y)) hw
          rw [abs_lt] at him_diff
          have hw_lo : (1 / 2) * (ℓ * D) < h_ref - w.im := by linarith
          have hw_hi : h_ref - w.im < (3 / 2) * (ℓ * D) := by linarith
          have hw1 : ℓ ≤ h_ref - w.im := by
            have : ℓ * 2 ≤ ℓ * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hℓ_pos.le
            linarith
          have hw2 : h_ref - w.im ≤ δ_b := by
            have h1 : ℓ * D < ℓ * D_top := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hY2 hℓ_pos
            have h2 : ℓ * (2 * D_top) < δ_b :=
              (lt_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 2 * D_top by positivity)).mp hℓ_lt_δb_Dtop
            have h3 : ℓ * (2 * D_top) = 2 * (ℓ * D_top) := by ring
            linarith
          have hw3 : |w.re - x₀| ≤ L_req * (h_ref - w.im) := by
            have htri : |w.re - x₀| ≤ |w.re - y.re| + |y.re - x₀| := by
              simpa using abs_sub_le w.re y.re x₀
            have h1 : |w.re - x₀| ≤ (2 * A + 2) * ((1 / 2) * (ℓ * D)) := by
              have : (2 * A + 2) * ((1 / 2) * (ℓ * D)) = A * (ℓ * D) + ℓ * D := by ring
              linarith
            have h2 : (2 * A + 2) * ((1 / 2) * (ℓ * D)) ≤ (2 * A + 2) * (h_ref - w.im) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_lo.le (by positivity)
            exact le_trans (le_trans h1 h2)
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (by linarith))
          obtain ⟨hw_mem, hw_mod⟩ := hN₄ n hn₄ w hw1 hw2 hw3
          have h_rpow_le : (ℓ / (h_ref - w.im)) ^ α ≤ 2 * D ^ (-α) := by
            have hw_pos : 0 < h_ref - w.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hw_lo
            have h_rat : ℓ / (h_ref - w.im) ≤ 2 / D := by
              rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hw_pos hD_pos]
              linarith
            calc (ℓ / (h_ref - w.im)) ^ α
                ≤ (2 / D) ^ α := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_rat (by positivity)
              _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ α * D ^ (-α) := h_div_rpow_neg 2 D α (by norm_num) hD_pos
              _ ≤ 2 * D ^ (-α) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2_rpow_le (by positivity)
          have h_mod_M₀ : shapeModulus S w ≤ M₀_par := by
            calc shapeModulus S w ≤ C_unif * m * (ℓ / (h_ref - w.im)) ^ α := hw_mod
              _ ≤ C_unif * m * (2 * D ^ (-α)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_le (by positivity)
              _ = M₀_par := by dsimp [M₀_par]; ring
          exact ⟨hw_mem, le_trans (le_max_left _ _) h_mod_M₀,
            le_trans (le_max_right _ _) h_mod_M₀⟩
        refine test_pillar1_holo S.toExpStripData P U_par
          s_p_par s_c_par J_p_par J_c_par t_par hU_par_open
          hs_p_par_holo hs_c_par_holo hJ_p_par_holo hJ_c_par_holo ht_par_holo ?_
        intro T₀ hT₀
        obtain ⟨δ_T, hδ_T_pos, hδ_T_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_par_open T₀ hT₀
        refine ⟨y, r_s_par, r_t_par, M₀_par, δ_T, by positivity, by positivity, ?_,
          by positivity, ?_, hδ_T_pos, hδ_T_sub,
          fun w hw => (h_rs_ball w hw).1,
          fun w hw => (h_rs_ball w hw).2, ?_⟩
        · dsimp [r_s_par, r_t_par]
          have h1 : 8 * T_max / m < (1 / 4) * ℓ := by
            rw [div_lt_iff₀ hm_pos]
            linarith [hb_32T]
          have h2 : ℓ * 1 < ℓ * D := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hℓ_pos
          have h3 : 4 * (2 * T_max / m) = 8 * T_max / m := by ring
          linarith
        · dsimp [r_t_par, M₀_par]
          have h_eq : (2 * T_max / m) * (2 * C_unif * m * D ^ (-α)) =
              4 * T_max * C_unif * D ^ (-α) := by
            field_simp [hm_pos.ne']
            ring
          rw [h_eq]
          have h_anti := h_rpow_anti D_anc D (-α) hD_anc_pos hD_gt_anc.le (by linarith)
          have h1 : 4 * T_max * C_unif * D ^ (-α) ≤ 8 * T_max * C_unif * D_anc ^ (-α) := by
            have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_anti (show 0 ≤ 4 * T_max * C_unif by positivity)
            have : 0 ≤ 4 * T_max * C_unif * D_anc ^ (-α) := by positivity
            linarith
          exact le_trans h1 (le_trans hD_anc_rpow1 (min_le_right _ _))
        · intro T' hT'_ball
          have hT'_U : T' ∈ U_par := hδ_T_sub hT'_ball
          have hb := hJ_bounds_par T' hT'_U
          have hT'_lt : ‖T'‖ < 2 * T_max := by
            simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hT'_U.1
          have ht'_rt : ‖t_par T'‖ < r_t_par := by
            dsimp [t_par, r_t_par]
            rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hm_pos]
            exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hT'_lt hm_pos
          exact ⟨hb.1, hb.2.1, hb.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2, ht'_rt⟩
      have hg_par_cone : ∀ T' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * T_max),
          γ_dyad * ‖T'‖ < T'.im → g_par T' = 0 := by
        intro T' hT'_ball hT'_steep
        have hT'_lt : ‖T'‖ < 2 * T_max := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hT'_ball
        have ht'_im : (t_par T').im = T'.im / m := by
          have hmul : (m : ℂ) * t_par T' = T' := mul_div_cancel₀ T' hm_c_ne
          have him := congr_arg Complex.im hmul
          simp at him
          field_simp [hm_pos.ne']
          linarith
        have ht'_steep : γ_dyad * ‖t_par T'‖ < (t_par T').im := by
          dsimp [t_par]
          rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hm_pos,
            ht'_im, mul_div_assoc']
          exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hT'_steep hm_pos
        have h_in_Wdyad : ∀ w : ℂ, (w, t_par T') ∈ U_top → (w, t_par T') ∈ W_steep_dyad := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_out : (w, t_par T') ∈ Ω_out := hU_top_sub_out hw
          refine ⟨by linarith [hw.1, hd_pos],
            lt_trans hw.2.1 (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hδ₀_pos), ?_, ?_,
            lt_of_lt_of_le ht'_steep (le_abs_self _)⟩
          · have hm_lt : m₀ < m_steep := by
              have : m₀ ≤ m_aux := le_max_left _ _
              dsimp [m_steep]
              linarith
            exact lt_trans hw.2.2.1 (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_lt (lt_trans hd_pos hw.1))
          · have hpos : 0 < r * ((h_ref - w.im) / d) ^ α := by
              have : 0 < h_ref - w.im := lt_trans hd_pos hw.1
              positivity
            linarith [hw_out.2.2.2]
        have hsh := h_shifts_Utop T' hT'_ball
        have hp_st : s_p_par T' = s_steep (y - t_par T', t_par T') := by
          dsimp [s_p_par]
          rw [hs_fn_top _ hsh.1]
          exact hs_cone_steep _ ⟨hU_top_sub_out hsh.1, h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.1⟩
        have hc_st : s_c_par T' = s_steep (y, t_par T') := by
          dsimp [s_c_par]
          rw [hs_fn_top _ hsh.2.1]
          exact hs_cone_steep _ ⟨hU_top_sub_out hsh.2.1, h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.2.1⟩
        have hn_st : s_n_par T' = s_steep (y + t_par T', t_par T') := by
          dsimp [s_n_par]
          rw [hs_fn_top _ hsh.2.2]
          exact hs_cone_steep _ ⟨hU_top_sub_out hsh.2.2, h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.2.2⟩
        have hrec := hs_steep_rec y (t_par T') ht'_steep
          (hW_sub_st (h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.1))
          (hW_sub_st (h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.2.1))
          (hW_sub_st (h_in_Wdyad _ hsh.2.2))
        dsimp [g_par, J_p_par, J_c_par]
        rw [hp_st, hc_st, hn_st]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hrec
      have hT_mem_par : T ∈ U_par := by
        refine ⟨?_, Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr hT_ne⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        linarith
      have hgT := test_pillar1_punc (2 * T_max) γ_dyad g_par
        (by positivity) hγ_pos (by linarith) hg_par_holo hg_par_cone T hT_mem_par
      dsimp [g_par, s_p_par, s_c_par, s_n_par, J_p_par, J_c_par, t_par] at hgT
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hgT
  let U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    if hn : n ≥ N_init then Classical.choose (h_build_n n hn) else ∅
  let s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n =>
    if hn : n ≥ N_init then Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_build_n n hn)) else fun _ => 0
  let δ_base : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => δ_base_val
  refine ⟨N_init, U_phys, s_tilde, δ_base, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hU_eq : U_phys n = Classical.choose (h_build_n n hn) := dif_pos hn
  have hs_eq : s_tilde n = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (h_build_n n hn)) := dif_pos hn
  rw [hU_eq, hs_eq]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (h_build_n n hn))
