proof.tactics:
by
  let s_base_full : ℝ := (3 / 4) * E.s_star
  let ρ_base : ℝ := min (E.r_star / 2) (P.r_rec / 2)
  have hs_star_pos : 0 < E.s_star := E.s_star_pos
  have hr_star_pos : 0 < E.r_star := E.r_star_pos
  have hr_rec_pos : 0 < P.r_rec := P.r_rec_pos
  have hρ_base_pos : 0 < ρ_base := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hρ_le_rstar : ρ_base ≤ E.r_star / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hρ_le_rrec : ρ_base ≤ P.r_rec / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨C_init, U_base, N_shape, hC_init_ge_one, hU_holo, hU_props, hlim1, hlim2, hShape⟩ :=
    entire_collar_quotient_and_reflected_bounds E P kind seq α₀ C_ℓ C_cone
      hα₁ hα₂ hCℓ hCcone h_bounds hh_tendsto hlog_tendsto hCone
  have hC_init_pos : 0 < C_init := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_init_ge_one
  obtain ⟨D_dip, C_bump, M_ceil, γ_dyad, hD_dip, hC_bump, hM_ceil,
      hγ_dyad_pos, hγ_dyad_lt, hDyad_apply⟩ := hDyad α₀ hα₁ hα₂
  let K₀ : ℝ := 4 * M_ceil
  have hK₀_gt_32 : 32 < K₀ := by dsimp [K₀]; linarith
  have hK₀_pos : 0 < K₀ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨C_bump_init, γ_init, hCb_init, hγ_init_pos, hγ_init_lt, hInit_apply⟩ :=
    affine_schwarz_poisson_band_initializer hBump α₀ K₀ γ_dyad
      hα₁ hα₂ (by linarith) hγ_dyad_pos hγ_dyad_lt
  have hD_strip_eq : E.toExpStripData.D_strip = Set.univ := rfl
  have hD_strip_open : IsOpen E.toExpStripData.D_strip := isOpen_univ
  have hD_strip_conv : Convex ℝ E.toExpStripData.D_strip := convex_univ
  obtain ⟨C_st, η_st, hC_st_ge_one, hη_st_pos, _, hSteep_apply⟩ :=
    hSteep E.toExpStripData hD_strip_open P α₀ γ_init
      hα₁ hα₂ hγ_init_pos (by linarith)
  have hC_st_pos : 0 < C_st := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hC_st_ge_one
  have hRec_apply :=
    cone_parameter_recurrence_continuation E.toExpStripData hD_strip_eq P α₀ γ_dyad
      hα₁ hα₂ hγ_dyad_pos (by linarith)

  intro T_max hT_max
  let A₀ : ℝ := max 1 ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α₀ - 1) * C_st)
  have hA₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ A₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hA₀_pos : 0 < A₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hA₀_ge_one
  let A_ind : ℝ := max A₀ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α₀ - 1) * C_st)
  have hA_ind_ge_one : 1 ≤ A_ind := le_trans hA₀_ge_one (le_max_left _ _)
  have hA_ind_pos : 0 < A_ind := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hA_ind_ge_one
  let C_anc : ℝ := 9 * A_ind * C_cone ^ 2
  have hC_anc_pos : 0 < C_anc := by positivity

  let B₁ : ℝ := max 1 (12 * T_max * C_cone / η_st)
  let B₂ : ℝ := max 1 (24 * T_max * C_cone / P.η_sf)
  let B₃ : ℝ := max 1 (4096 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2)
  let D_anc : ℝ := max 40 (max (2 * B₁ ^ 2) (max (B₂ ^ 2) B₃))
  have hD_anc_ge_40 : 40 ≤ D_anc := le_max_left _ _
  have hD_anc_pos : 0 < D_anc := by linarith
  have hB₁_ge_one : 1 ≤ B₁ := le_max_left _ _
  have hB₂_ge_one : 1 ≤ B₂ := le_max_left _ _
  have hB₃_ge_one : 1 ≤ B₃ := le_max_left _ _
  have hη_sf_pos : 0 < P.η_sf := P.η_sf_pos

  have hD_anc_B₁ : 12 * T_max * C_cone * (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) ≤ η_st := by
    have h2B₁ : 2 * B₁ ^ 2 ≤ D_anc :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hB₁_sq : B₁ ^ 2 ≤ D_anc / 2 := by linarith
    have h1_le : 1 ≤ D_anc / 2 := by linarith
    have he1 : (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) ≤ (D_anc / 2) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le (by linarith)
    have he2 : (D_anc / 2) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (B₁ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hB₁_sq (by norm_num)
    have he3 : ((B₁ : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = B₁⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast B₁ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
      norm_num
      exact Real.rpow_neg_one B₁
    have hle_inv : (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) ≤ B₁⁻¹ := by linarith
    have hdiv_le : 12 * T_max * C_cone / η_st ≤ B₁ := le_max_right _ _
    have hmul_B₁ : 12 * T_max * C_cone ≤ B₁ * η_st := (div_le_iff₀ hη_st_pos).mp hdiv_le
    calc 12 * T_max * C_cone * (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀)
        ≤ 12 * T_max * C_cone * B₁⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle_inv (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (B₁ * η_st) * B₁⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmul_B₁ (by positivity)
      _ = η_st := by field_simp [(lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB₁_ge_one).ne']

  have hD_anc_B₂ : 24 * T_max * C_cone * D_anc ^ (-α₀) ≤ P.η_sf := by
    have hB₂_sq : B₂ ^ 2 ≤ D_anc :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    have h1_le : 1 ≤ D_anc := by linarith
    have he1 : D_anc ^ (-α₀) ≤ D_anc ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le (by linarith)
    have he2 : D_anc ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (B₂ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hB₂_sq (by norm_num)
    have he3 : ((B₂ : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℕ)) ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = B₂⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast B₂ 2, ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
      norm_num
      exact Real.rpow_neg_one B₂
    have hle_inv : D_anc ^ (-α₀) ≤ B₂⁻¹ := by linarith
    have hdiv_le : 24 * T_max * C_cone / P.η_sf ≤ B₂ := le_max_right _ _
    have hmul_B₂ : 24 * T_max * C_cone ≤ B₂ * P.η_sf := (div_le_iff₀ hη_sf_pos).mp hdiv_le
    calc 24 * T_max * C_cone * D_anc ^ (-α₀)
        ≤ 24 * T_max * C_cone * B₂⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle_inv (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (B₂ * P.η_sf) * B₂⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmul_B₂ (by positivity)
      _ = P.η_sf := by field_simp [(lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB₂_ge_one).ne']

  have hD_anc_B₃ : 256 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2 * D_anc ^ (-2 * α₀) ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    have hB₃_le : B₃ ≤ D_anc :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    have h1_le : 1 ≤ D_anc := by linarith
    have he1 : D_anc ^ (-2 * α₀) ≤ D_anc ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le (by linarith)
    have he2 : D_anc ^ (-1 : ℝ) ≤ B₃ ^ (-1 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hB₃_le (by norm_num)
    have hle_inv : D_anc ^ (-2 * α₀) ≤ B₃⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg_one B₃] at he2
      exact le_trans he1 he2
    have h4096 : 4096 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2 ≤ B₃ := le_max_right _ _
    have hB₃_pos : 0 < B₃ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hB₃_ge_one
    calc 256 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2 * D_anc ^ (-2 * α₀)
        ≤ 256 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2 * B₃⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle_inv (by positivity)
      _ = (4096 * C_anc * T_max ^ 2) * B₃⁻¹ / 16 := by ring
      _ ≤ B₃ * B₃⁻¹ / 16 := by
          gcongr
      _ = 1 / 16 := by field_simp [hB₃_pos.ne']

  clear_value D_anc
  clear B₁ B₂ B₃ hB₁_ge_one hB₂_ge_one hB₃_ge_one

  refine ⟨D_anc, C_anc, α₀, hD_anc_pos, hC_anc_pos, hα₁, hα₂, ?_⟩
  intro A D_top hA hD_top

  let s_base_init : ℝ := E.s_star / 4
  have hs_base_init_pos : 0 < s_base_init := by positivity
  let δ_seed : ℝ := s_base_init / (16 * (1 + C_bump_init))
  have hδ_seed_pos : 0 < δ_seed := by positivity
  have hδ_seed_lt : δ_seed < s_base_init / 16 := by
    dsimp [δ_seed]
    have hden : 16 < 16 * (1 + C_bump_init) := by linarith
    exact div_lt_div_of_pos_left hs_base_init_pos (by norm_num) hden
  let Δ_slab : ℝ := E.s_star / 2
  have hΔ_slab_pos : 0 < Δ_slab := by positivity

  let m₀ : ℝ := 2 * A + 4
  have hm₀_ge_4 : 4 ≤ m₀ := by dsimp [m₀]; linarith
  have hm₀_pos : 0 < m₀ := by linarith
  let m_aux : ℝ := max m₀ ((C_bump + 4) / (D_dip - 1))
  have hm_aux_pos : 0 < m_aux := lt_of_lt_of_le hm₀_pos (le_max_left _ _)
  let m_steep_dyad : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + C_bump + 2)
  let m_steep_init : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + (4 * K₀ + 1) * C_bump_init + 2)
  let m_steep_big : ℝ := max m_steep_dyad m_steep_init
  have hm_steep_big_pos : 0 < m_steep_big :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < m_steep_dyad) (le_max_left _ _)

  let R_phys : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 2 * T_max / seq.m_seq n
  let r_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 4 * T_max / seq.m_seq n
  let δ₀ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => seq.h_seq n / K₀
  let d_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (D_anc / 2) * seq.ℓ_seq n
  let δ_ceil : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => seq.h_seq n + E.s_star / 4
  let M_scale : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 3 * C_cone * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀

  let U_base_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < R_phys n ∧ |p.1.im| < δ_seed / 2 }
  let U_upper : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      ‖p.2‖ < R_phys n ∧
      d_seq n < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
      seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ n ∧
      |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) }
  let U_lower : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      ‖p.2‖ < R_phys n ∧
      δ₀ n < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
      seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < seq.h_seq n + δ_seed / 2 ∧
      |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) }
  let U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    U_upper n ∪ (U_lower n ∪ U_base_phys n)
  let δ_base : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => δ_seed / 2

  
  let ε_lim1 : ℝ :=
    min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) / (48 * T_max * (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀)
  have hε_lim1_pos : 0 < ε_lim1 := by positivity
  let c_mul2 : ℝ := 9 * C_cone ^ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)
  have hc_mul2_pos : 0 < c_mul2 := by positivity
  let B_lim2 : ℝ := C_init * (1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) / c_mul2

  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ :=
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hh_tendsto) (max (2 * E.s_star) (4 * δ_seed))
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ :=
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.h_div_ℓ_tendsto)
      (max (8 * K₀ * D_anc) (4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4)))
  obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ :=
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.b_tendsto)
      (max (8 * T_max / (D_anc * η_st)) (64 * T_max))
  obtain ⟨N₄, hN₄⟩ :=
    (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.m_tendsto) (4 * T_max / ρ_base + 1)
  obtain ⟨N₅, hN₅⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim1) ε_lim1 hε_lim1_pos
  obtain ⟨N₆, hN₆⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hlim2) B_lim2

  let N_init : ℕ := max N_shape (max (max N₁ N₂) (max (max N₃ N₄) (max N₅ N₆)))

  have h_exists_n : ∀ n ≥ N_init, ∃ s_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
          |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
      IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
      0 < δ_base n ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
        ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
          ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_t (U_phys n) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_t p ∈ E.toExpStripData.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_t (y, -t) = s_t (y, t)) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
        (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ E.toExpStripData.Tube ∧
          s_t (y, t) = E.toExpStripData.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
      (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
        D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top → |y.re| < A * (-y.im) →
        s_t (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
          s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
        (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
        0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
        ‖(s_t (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
            (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
          C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) ∧
      (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
        (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
        (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
        (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
        let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
        let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
        let s_prev : ℂ := s_t (y - t, t)
        let s_curr : ℂ := s_t (y, t)
        let s_next : ℂ := s_t (y + t, t)
        let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
        let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
          deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) := by
    intro n hn
    have hn_shape : N_shape ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_rest : max (max N₁ N₂) (max (max N₃ N₄) (max N₅ N₆)) ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_rest)
    have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_rest)
    have hn₃ : N₃ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_rest))
    have hn₄ : N₄ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_rest))
    have hn₅ : N₅ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_rest))
    have hn₆ : N₆ ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_rest))

    have hh_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n := (h_bounds n).1
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n := seq.ℓ_pos n
    have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
    have hd_pos : 0 < d_seq n := by dsimp [d_seq]; positivity
    have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ n := by dsimp [δ₀]; positivity
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_seq n := by dsimp [r_seq]; positivity
    have hR_phys_pos : 0 < R_phys n := by dsimp [R_phys]; positivity
    have hM_pos : 0 < M_scale n := by dsimp [M_scale]; positivity

    have hh_ge_2s : 2 * E.s_star ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hN₁ n hn₁)
    have hh_ge_4seed : 4 * δ_seed ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hN₁ n hn₁)
    have hh_div_ℓ_anc : 8 * K₀ * D_anc ≤ seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hN₂ n hn₂)
    have hh_div_ℓ_top : 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) ≤ seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hN₂ n hn₂)
    have hh_ge_anc : 8 * K₀ * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp hh_div_ℓ_anc
    have hh_ge_top : 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) * seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp hh_div_ℓ_top
    have hb_ge_st : 8 * T_max / (D_anc * η_st) ≤ seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hN₃ n hn₃)
    have hb_ge_64 : 64 * T_max ≤ seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hN₃ n hn₃)
    have hm_gt_4T : 4 * T_max / ρ_base < seq.m_seq n := by
      have := hN₄ n hn₄
      linarith
    have hR_phys_lt_ρ : R_phys n < ρ_base := by
      dsimp [R_phys]
      have h1 : 4 * T_max < seq.m_seq n * ρ_base := (div_lt_iff₀ hρ_base_pos).mp hm_gt_4T
      have h2 : 2 * T_max < seq.m_seq n * ρ_base := by linarith
      exact (div_lt_iff₀ hm_pos).mpr (by linarith)

    have hlim1_n : (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ < ε_lim1 := by
      have hd_dist := hN₅ n hn₅
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ := by positivity
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] at hd_dist
      exact hd_dist

    have h_param_small :
        12 * r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤
          min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) := by
      have h_ratio_le : 2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n ≤ (4 / D_anc) * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) := by
        have h_eq : 2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n = (4 / D_anc) * (seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) := by
          dsimp [d_seq]
          field_simp [hD_anc_pos.ne', hℓ_pos.ne']
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have hrpow_le : (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤
          (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ := by
        calc (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀
            ≤ ((4 / D_anc) * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n)) ^ α₀ :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_ratio_le (by positivity)
          _ = (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ :=
              Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have h12r : 12 * r_seq n = 48 * T_max * (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [r_seq]
        ring
      have hprod_lt :
          48 * T_max * (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ *
            ((seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) <
          min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) := by
        have h_pos_fac : 0 < 48 * T_max * (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ := by positivity
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlim1_n h_pos_fac
        have h_cancel : 48 * T_max * (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ * ε_lim1 =
            min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) := by
          dsimp [ε_lim1]
          field_simp [h_pos_fac.ne']
        rwa [h_cancel] at hmul
      calc 12 * r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀
          ≤ (48 * T_max * (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹) *
              ((4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) := by
            rw [h12r]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity)
        _ = 48 * T_max * (4 / D_anc) ^ α₀ *
              ((seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) := by ring
        _ ≤ min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) := hprod_lt.le

    have hδ_ceil_le_2h : δ_ceil n ≤ 2 * seq.h_seq n := by
      dsimp [δ_ceil]
      linarith
    have hδ_ceil_pos : 0 < δ_ceil n := by dsimp [δ_ceil]; positivity

    have h_steep_param_small :
        12 * r_seq n * (δ_ceil n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤ min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) := by
      have hdiv_le : δ_ceil n / d_seq n ≤ 2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ_ceil_le_2h hd_pos.le
      have hrpow_le : (δ_ceil n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤ (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hdiv_le (by positivity)
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity)) h_param_small

    have h_init_param_small : 8 * r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤ ρ_base := by
      have h8_le_12 : 8 * r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤
          12 * r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ := by
        have : 0 ≤ r_seq n * (2 * seq.h_seq n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ := by positivity
        linarith
      have hmin_le : min (Δ_slab / 16) (ρ_base / 2) ≤ ρ_base / 2 := min_le_right _ _
      linarith

    have h_absorb_2h :
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale n ^ 2 * (2 * seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
      have hlim2_n : B_lim2 ≤
          (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
            (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + seq.h_seq n) := hN₆ n hn₆
      have h1h_pos : 0 < 1 + seq.h_seq n := by positivity
      have hmul1 : B_lim2 * (1 + seq.h_seq n) ≤
          (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) * (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) :=
        (le_div_iff₀ h1h_pos).mp hlim2_n
      have hmul2 : c_mul2 * (B_lim2 * (1 + seq.h_seq n)) ≤
          c_mul2 * ((seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
            (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul1 hc_mul2_pos.le
      have hrhs_eq :
          c_mul2 * ((seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
            (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) =
          M_scale n ^ 2 * (2 * seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
        dsimp [c_mul2, M_scale]
        have hℓ_pow : ((seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ((seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hℓ_pos.le]
          ring_nf
        have h2h_pow : (2 * seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) =
            (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) * (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) :=
          Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hh_pos.le
        rw [h2h_pow]
        calc 9 * C_cone ^ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) *
              (seq.m_seq n ^ 2 * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ (2 * α₀) * seq.h_seq n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀))
            = 9 * C_cone ^ 2 * seq.m_seq n ^ 2 * ((seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀) ^ (2 : ℕ)) *
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) * seq.h_seq n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) := by
              rw [hℓ_pow]; ring
          _ = (3 * C_cone * seq.m_seq n * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀) ^ 2 *
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) * seq.h_seq n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) := by ring
      have hlhs_eq : c_mul2 * (B_lim2 * (1 + seq.h_seq n)) =
          C_init * (1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by
        dsimp [B_lim2]
        field_simp [hc_mul2_pos.ne']
      have hlhs_le :
          C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) ≤
            C_init * (1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by
        have h8_le : 8 * δ_ceil n ≤ 16 * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by linarith
        have hdiv_le : 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab) ≤
            (16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by
          have : (16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) =
              16 * (1 + seq.h_seq n) / (γ_init * Δ_slab) := by ring
          rw [this]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h8_le (by positivity)
        have h1_le_add : 1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab) ≤
            (1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by
          nlinarith only [hdiv_le, hh_pos]
        calc C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab))
            ≤ C_init * ((1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_le_add hC_init_pos.le
          _ = C_init * (1 + 16 / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) * (1 + seq.h_seq n) := by ring
      linarith

    clear_value N_init ε_lim1 c_mul2 B_lim2
    clear hN₁ hN₂ hN₃ hN₄ hN₅ hN₆ hn_rest

    have h_absorb_ceil :
        C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) ≤
          M_scale n ^ 2 * (δ_ceil n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
      have hrpow_le : (2 * seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) ≤ (δ_ceil n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hδ_ceil_pos hδ_ceil_le_2h (by linarith)
      exact le_trans h_absorb_2h (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity))

    have hC_init_le_2h : C_init ≤ M_scale n ^ 2 * (2 * seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
      have h_ge : C_init ≤ C_init * (1 + 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab)) := by
        have : 0 ≤ 8 * δ_ceil n / (γ_init * Δ_slab) := by positivity
        nlinarith only [this, hC_init_pos]
      exact le_trans h_ge h_absorb_2h

    have hr_div_d : r_seq n / d_seq n ≤ η_st := by
      have h_eq : r_seq n / d_seq n =
          (8 * T_max / D_anc) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) := by
        dsimp [r_seq, d_seq]
        field_simp [hm_pos.ne', hD_anc_pos.ne', hℓ_pos.ne']
        ring
      rw [h_eq]
      have hprod_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n := mul_pos hℓ_pos hm_pos
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hprod_pos]
      have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hD_anc_pos hη_st_pos)).mp hb_ge_st
      have : 8 * T_max / D_anc ≤ η_st * (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hD_anc_pos]
        linarith
      linarith

    have hr_d_M : r_seq n * (d_seq n) ^ (-α₀) * M_scale n ≤ η_st := by
      have hd_rpow : (d_seq n) ^ (-α₀) = (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (-α₀) := by
        dsimp [d_seq]
        exact Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) hℓ_pos.le
      have hℓ_cancel : (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (-α₀) * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hℓ_pos]
        norm_num
      have h_eq : r_seq n * (d_seq n) ^ (-α₀) * M_scale n =
          12 * T_max * C_cone * (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) := by
        dsimp [r_seq, M_scale]
        rw [hd_rpow]
        calc (4 * T_max / seq.m_seq n) * ((D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ (-α₀)) *
              (3 * C_cone * seq.m_seq n * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀)
            = 12 * T_max * C_cone * (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) *
                (seq.m_seq n / seq.m_seq n) *
                (seq.ℓ_seq n ^ (-α₀) * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀) := by ring
          _ = 12 * T_max * C_cone * (D_anc / 2) ^ (-α₀) := by
              rw [div_self hm_pos.ne', hℓ_cancel]; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hD_anc_B₁

    have h_shape_scaled : ∀ s : ℂ,
        seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im →
        seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ (3 / 2) * seq.h_seq n →
        ‖E.f s‖ ≤ M_scale n * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-α₀) ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖ ≤ M_scale n * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-α₀) := by
      intro s hs_lo hs_hi
      have hδ_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n - s.im := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ_pos hs_lo
      obtain ⟨hf_b, hq_b⟩ := hShape n hn_shape s hs_lo hs_hi
      have hrpow_div : (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ =
          (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-α₀) := by
        calc (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀
            = (seq.ℓ_seq n * (seq.h_seq n - s.im)⁻¹) ^ α₀ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          _ = (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ * ((seq.h_seq n - s.im)⁻¹) ^ α₀ :=
              Real.mul_rpow hℓ_pos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hδ_pos.le)
          _ = (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ * ((seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ^ α₀ := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one (seq.h_seq n - s.im)]
          _ = (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-α₀) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul hδ_pos.le]; ring_nf
      have hrhs_eq :
          (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ =
            M_scale n * (seq.h_seq n - s.im) ^ (-α₀) := by
        dsimp [M_scale]
        rw [hrpow_div]
        ring
      rw [hrhs_eq] at hf_b hq_b
      exact ⟨hf_b, hq_b⟩

    
    have hDℓ_pos : 0 < D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n := mul_pos hD_anc_pos hℓ_pos
    have h2Δ_le_ceil : 2 * Δ_slab ≤ δ_ceil n := by
      dsimp [Δ_slab, δ_ceil]; linarith
    have h4d_le_ceil : 4 * d_seq n ≤ δ_ceil n - Δ_slab := by
      dsimp [d_seq, δ_ceil, Δ_slab]
      have h1 : 2 * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n / 2 := by
        have hle : 4 * (D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) ≤ (8 * K₀) * (D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hK₀_gt_32]) hDℓ_pos.le
        have heq1 : (8 * K₀) * (D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) = 8 * K₀ * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n := by ring
        have heq2 : 2 * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n = 2 * (D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) := by ring
        linarith only [hle, heq1, heq2, hh_ge_anc]
      linarith only [h1, hh_ge_2s, hs_star_pos]

    let L_in : ℝ := 2 * m_steep_big + 2 / γ_init + 4
    let S_init_n : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        δ_ceil n - Δ_slab < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧ seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < δ_ceil n ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < L_in * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 12 * r_seq n * (δ_ceil n / d_seq n) ^ α₀ }
    have hS_init_bounds : ∀ p ∈ S_init_n,
        |p.1.im| < E.s_star / 4 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, _, hp4⟩
      have him : |p.1.im| < E.s_star / 4 := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        dsimp [δ_ceil, Δ_slab] at hp1 hp2
        constructor <;> linarith
      have ht : ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base := by
        have hle := le_trans h_steep_param_small (min_le_right _ _)
        linarith
      exact ⟨him, ht⟩
    have hS_init_sub_T : S_init_n ⊆ E.T := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨him, ht⟩ := hS_init_bounds p hp
      apply E.T_base_subset
      left
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

    obtain ⟨s_steep, hs_steep_holo, _, hs_steep_props, hs_steep_base, hs_steep_rec⟩ :=
      hSteep_apply (seq.x_seq n) (seq.h_seq n) m_steep_big (d_seq n) (δ_ceil n) Δ_slab
        (r_seq n) (M_scale n) C_init E.𝔰
        hm_steep_big_pos hd_pos hΔ_slab_pos h2Δ_le_ceil h4d_le_ceil hr_pos hM_pos
        hC_init_pos.le (le_trans h_steep_param_small (min_le_left _ _))
        hr_div_d hr_d_M h_absorb_ceil
        (by
          intro s hs_lo hs_hi _
          have hs_ℓ : seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im := by
            dsimp [d_seq] at hs_lo
            nlinarith only [hs_lo, hD_anc_ge_40, hℓ_pos]
          have hs_top : seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ (3 / 2) * seq.h_seq n := by
            dsimp [δ_ceil] at hs_hi
            linarith only [hs_hi, hh_ge_2s, hh_pos]
          obtain ⟨hf_s, hq_s⟩ := h_shape_scaled s hs_ℓ hs_top
          exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hf_s, hq_s⟩)
        (E.𝔰_holo.mono hS_init_sub_T)
        (by
          intro y t hyt
          obtain ⟨him, ht⟩ := hS_init_bounds (y, t) hyt
          have hT : (y, t) ∈ E.T := hS_init_sub_T hyt
          have him_full : |y.im| < s_base_full := by dsimp [s_base_full]; linarith
          obtain ⟨h_div, _, h_ub⟩ := hU_props y t him_full ht
          refine ⟨E.𝔰_even y t hT, ?_⟩
          calc ‖E.𝔰 (y, t) - y‖
              = ‖t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t)‖ := by rw [h_div]
            _ = ‖t‖ ^ 2 * ‖U_base (y, t)‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
            _ ≤ ‖t‖ ^ 2 * C_init := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ub (by positivity)
            _ = C_init * ‖t‖ ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _)
        (fun y _ => E.𝔰_zero y)
        (by
          intro y t ht_ne _ hyt _
          obtain ⟨him, ht⟩ := hS_init_bounds (y, t) hyt
          dsimp at him ht
          have him_3 : |y.im| < E.toExpStripData.s_star / 3 := by
            change |y.im| < E.s_star / 3
            linarith
          have ht_rec : ‖t‖ < P.r_rec := by linarith
          exact P.base_recurrence y t him_3 (norm_pos_iff.mpr ht_ne) ht_rec)

    
    have h4d_le_mid : 4 * d_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) := by
      dsimp [d_seq]
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K₀)]
      have heq : 4 * (D_anc / 2 * seq.ℓ_seq n) * (2 * K₀) =
          (8 * K₀ * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) / 2 := by ring
      linarith only [heq, hh_ge_anc, hh_pos]
    let W_steep_big : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        d_seq n / 2 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < δ_ceil n - Δ_slab / 4 ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m_steep_big * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ∧
        γ_init * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
    let W_steep_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        d_seq n / 2 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < seq.h_seq n + s_base_init / 2 ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m_steep_init * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ∧
        γ_init * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
    have hW_init_sub_big : W_steep_init ⊆ W_steep_big := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
      have hδ_pos_p : 0 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
      have hceil_eq : seq.h_seq n + s_base_init / 2 = δ_ceil n - Δ_slab / 4 := by
        dsimp [s_base_init, δ_ceil, Δ_slab]; ring
      have hm_le : m_steep_init ≤ m_steep_big := le_max_right _ _
      refine ⟨hp1, by linarith, ?_, hp4, hp5⟩
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hp3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hδ_pos_p.le)

    obtain ⟨s_band₀, hs_band₀_holo, hs_band₀_props, hs_band₀_zero,
        hs_band₀_base, hs_band₀_steep⟩ :=
      hInit_apply (seq.x_seq n) (seq.h_seq n) s_base_init ρ_base m_aux (d_seq n)
        (r_seq n) (M_scale n) C_st C_init E.𝔰 U_base s_steep
        hs_base_init_pos (by dsimp [s_base_init]; linarith) hρ_base_pos hm_aux_pos
        hd_pos h4d_le_mid hr_pos hM_pos hC_st_pos hC_init_pos.le
        h_init_param_small hC_init_le_2h
        (hU_holo.mono (fun p hp => ⟨by dsimp [s_base_init, s_base_full] at *; linarith [hp.1], hp.2⟩))
        (fun y t hyt => hU_props y t (by dsimp [s_base_init, s_base_full] at *; linarith [hyt.1]) hyt.2)
        (hs_steep_holo.mono hW_init_sub_big)
        (fun y t hyt => hs_steep_props y t (hW_init_sub_big hyt))
        (by
          intro p hp him _
          have hp_big : p ∈ W_steep_big := hW_init_sub_big hp
          have h_im_lt : p.1.im < s_base_init / 2 := (abs_lt.mp him).2
          have h_slab_gt : δ_ceil n - (3 / 4) * Δ_slab < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := by
            dsimp [δ_ceil, Δ_slab, s_base_init] at *
            linarith
          exact hs_steep_base p.1 p.2 hp_big h_slab_gt)

    
    have hd_lt_δ₀ : d_seq n < δ₀ n := by
      dsimp [d_seq, δ₀]
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hK₀_pos]
      have heq : D_anc / 2 * seq.ℓ_seq n * K₀ =
          (8 * K₀ * D_anc * seq.ℓ_seq n) / 16 := by ring
      linarith only [heq, hh_ge_anc, hh_pos]
    let Ω_mid : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < seq.h_seq n + δ_seed ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m_aux * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ }
    let Ω_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        δ₀ n < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ n ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m_aux * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ }
    let W_steep_dyad : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        d_seq n / 2 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < M_ceil * δ₀ n ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m_steep_dyad * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ ∧
        γ_dyad * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| }
    let Ω_out : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        d_seq n < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
        seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ n ∧
        |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
        ‖p.2‖ < r_seq n * ((seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) / d_seq n) ^ α₀ }

    have hMceil_δ₀ : M_ceil * δ₀ n = seq.h_seq n / 4 := by
      dsimp [δ₀, K₀]
      field_simp [(by linarith : M_ceil ≠ 0)]
    have hΩ_init_sub_mid : Ω_init ⊆ Ω_mid := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩
      have hlo : seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) < δ₀ n := by
        dsimp [δ₀]
        have : seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) = (seq.h_seq n / K₀) / 2 := by ring
        linarith
      refine ⟨lt_trans hlo hp1, ?_, hp3, hp4⟩
      rw [hMceil_δ₀] at hp2
      linarith
    have hW_dyad_sub_big : W_steep_dyad ⊆ W_steep_big := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
      have hδ_pos_p : 0 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
      have hm_le : m_steep_dyad ≤ m_steep_big := le_max_left _ _
      have hγ_le : γ_init * ‖p.2‖ ≤ γ_dyad * ‖p.2‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ_init_lt.le (norm_nonneg _)
      refine ⟨hp1, ?_, lt_of_lt_of_le hp3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hδ_pos_p.le),
        hp4, lt_of_le_of_lt hγ_le hp5⟩
      rw [hMceil_δ₀] at hp2
      dsimp [δ_ceil, Δ_slab]
      linarith

    obtain ⟨s_cone, hs_cone_holo, _, hs_cone_props, hs_cone_zero,
        hs_cone_init, hs_cone_steep⟩ :=
      hDyad_apply E.toExpStripData hD_strip_open hD_strip_conv
        (seq.x_seq n) (seq.h_seq n) m₀ (d_seq n) (δ₀ n) (r_seq n) (M_scale n)
        C_st A₀ s_band₀ s_steep
        hm₀_pos hd_pos hd_lt_δ₀ hr_pos hM_pos hC_st_pos hA₀_pos.le
        (hs_band₀_holo.mono hΩ_init_sub_mid)
        (fun y t hyt => hs_band₀_props y t (hΩ_init_sub_mid hyt))
        (fun y hy => hs_band₀_zero y (hΩ_init_sub_mid hy))
        (hs_steep_holo.mono hW_dyad_sub_big)
        (fun y t hyt => hs_steep_props y t (hW_dyad_sub_big hyt))
        (by
          intro p hp
          rcases hp with ⟨hp_init, hp_dyad⟩
          have hp_mid : p ∈ Ω_mid := hΩ_init_sub_mid hp_init
          have hδ_pos_p : 0 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := lt_trans hδ₀_pos hp_init.1
          have hm_aux_lt : m_aux < m_steep_init := by
            dsimp [m_steep_init]
            have : 0 < (4 * K₀ + 1) * C_bump_init := by positivity
            linarith
          have hp_w_init : p ∈ W_steep_init := by
            refine ⟨hp_dyad.1, ?_, ?_, hp_dyad.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
            · have hp2 := hp_dyad.2.1
              rw [hMceil_δ₀] at hp2
              linarith
            · exact lt_trans hp_init.2.2.1
                (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hm_aux_lt hδ_pos_p)
            · exact lt_of_le_of_lt
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hγ_init_lt.le (norm_nonneg _))
                hp_dyad.2.2.2.2
          exact hs_band₀_steep p ⟨hp_mid, hp_w_init⟩)
        (fun _ _ _ _ => Set.subset_univ _)

    clear hSteep_apply hInit_apply hDyad_apply L_in S_init_n hS_init_bounds hS_init_sub_T
      W_steep_init hW_init_sub_big

    
    classical
    let s_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      if p ∈ U_upper n then s_cone p
      else if p ∈ U_lower n then s_band₀ p
      else E.𝔰 p

    have hU_upper_open : IsOpen (U_upper n) := by
      have hc_t : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ‖p.2‖) := continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd
      have hc_im : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1.im) := Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst
      have hc_depth : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) := continuous_const.sub hc_im
      have hc_re_diff : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n|) :=
        continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)
      have hc_cone : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im)) :=
        continuous_const.mul hc_depth
      exact (isOpen_lt hc_t continuous_const).inter <|
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc_depth).inter <|
          (isOpen_lt hc_depth continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hc_re_diff hc_cone)
    have hU_lower_open : IsOpen (U_lower n) := by
      have hc_t : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ‖p.2‖) := continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd
      have hc_im : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1.im) := Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst
      have hc_depth : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) := continuous_const.sub hc_im
      have hc_re_diff : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n|) :=
        continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)
      have hc_cone : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im)) :=
        continuous_const.mul hc_depth
      exact (isOpen_lt hc_t continuous_const).inter <|
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc_depth).inter <|
          (isOpen_lt hc_depth continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hc_re_diff hc_cone)
    have hU_base_open : IsOpen (U_base_phys n) :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)) continuous_const)
    have hU_phys_open : IsOpen (U_phys n) :=
      hU_upper_open.union (hU_lower_open.union hU_base_open)

    have hR_phys_lt_cone : ∀ δ_p : ℝ, d_seq n < δ_p →
        R_phys n < r_seq n * (δ_p / d_seq n) ^ α₀ := by
      intro δ_p hδ_gt
      have h1_le : 1 ≤ δ_p / d_seq n := (one_le_div hd_pos).mpr hδ_gt.le
      have hrpow_ge : 1 ≤ (δ_p / d_seq n) ^ α₀ := Real.one_le_rpow h1_le (by positivity)
      have hR_lt_r : R_phys n < r_seq n := by
        dsimp [R_phys, r_seq]
        exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith only [hT_max]) hm_pos
      calc R_phys n < r_seq n * 1 := by linarith only [hR_lt_r]
        _ ≤ r_seq n * (δ_p / d_seq n) ^ α₀ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_ge hr_pos.le

    have hU_upper_sub_out : U_upper n ⊆ Ω_out := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp_t, hp_lo, hp_hi, hp_re⟩
      exact ⟨hp_lo, hp_hi, hp_re, lt_trans hp_t (hR_phys_lt_cone _ hp_lo)⟩
    have hU_lower_sub_mid : U_lower n ⊆ Ω_mid := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp_t, hp_lo, hp_hi, hp_re⟩
      have hδ_pos_p : 0 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := lt_trans hδ₀_pos hp_lo
      have hlo : seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) < δ₀ n := by
        dsimp [δ₀]
        have : seq.h_seq n / (2 * K₀) = (seq.h_seq n / K₀) / 2 := by ring
        linarith only [this, hδ₀_pos]
      have hm_le : m₀ ≤ m_aux := le_max_left _ _
      exact ⟨lt_trans hlo hp_lo, by linarith only [hp_hi, hδ_seed_pos],
        lt_of_lt_of_le hp_re (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hδ_pos_p.le),
        lt_trans hp_t (hR_phys_lt_cone _ (lt_trans hd_lt_δ₀ hp_lo))⟩
    have hU_base_sub_T : U_base_phys n ⊆ E.T := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hp_t, hp_im⟩
      apply E.T_base_subset
      left
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [s_base_init] at hδ_seed_lt
        linarith only [hp_im, hδ_seed_lt, hδ_seed_pos, hs_star_pos]
      · have h1 : ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base := lt_trans hp_t hR_phys_lt_ρ
        linarith only [h1, hρ_le_rstar, hr_star_pos]

    have hs_t_upper : ∀ p ∈ U_upper n, s_t p = s_cone p := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp [s_t]
      split_ifs
      rfl
    have hs_t_lower : ∀ p ∈ U_lower n, s_t p = s_band₀ p := by
      intro p hp
      dsimp [s_t]
      split_ifs with h_up
      · have hp_out : p ∈ Ω_out := hU_upper_sub_out h_up
        have hp_init : p ∈ Ω_init := by
          have hδ_pos_p : 0 < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im := lt_trans hδ₀_pos hp.2.1
          have hm_le : m₀ ≤ m_aux := le_max_left _ _
          have h2δ₀_lt : 2 * δ₀ n < M_ceil * δ₀ n :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith only [hM_ceil]) hδ₀_pos
          exact ⟨hp.2.1, lt_trans h_up.2.2.1 h2δ₀_lt,
            lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2.2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_le hδ_pos_p.le),
            hp_out.2.2.2⟩
        exact hs_cone_init p ⟨hp_out, hp_init⟩
      · rfl
    have hs_t_base : ∀ p ∈ U_base_phys n, s_t p = E.𝔰 p := by
      intro p hp
      have h_not_up : p ∉ U_upper n := by
        intro h_up
        have him_lt : p.1.im < δ_seed / 2 := (abs_lt.mp hp.2).2
        have h2δ₀_lt : 2 * δ₀ n < seq.h_seq n / 16 := by
          dsimp [δ₀]
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ hK₀_pos]
          nlinarith only [hh_pos, hK₀_gt_32]
        have h_up_hi := h_up.2.2.1
        linarith only [him_lt, h2δ₀_lt, hh_ge_4seed, h_up_hi, hh_pos]
      dsimp [s_t]
      split_ifs with h_lo
      · have hp2 := hp.2
        exact hs_band₀_base p (hU_lower_sub_mid h_lo) (by linarith only [hp2, hδ_seed_pos])
      · rfl

    have hs_t_holo_upper : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_t (U_upper n) :=
      (hs_cone_holo.mono hU_upper_sub_out).congr hs_t_upper
    have hs_t_holo_lower : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_t (U_lower n) :=
      (hs_band₀_holo.mono hU_lower_sub_mid).congr hs_t_lower
    have hs_t_holo_base : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_t (U_base_phys n) :=
      (E.𝔰_holo.mono hU_base_sub_T).congr hs_t_base
    have hs_t_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_t (U_phys n) :=
      hs_t_holo_upper.union_of_isOpen
        (hs_t_holo_lower.union_of_isOpen hs_t_holo_base hU_lower_open hU_base_open)
        hU_upper_open (hU_lower_open.union hU_base_open)

    clear_value s_t
    clear hs_t_holo_upper hs_t_holo_lower hs_t_holo_base
      hU_upper_open hU_lower_open hU_base_open

    
    let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
        |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
    have h_cone_maps_upper : ∀ Y T : ℂ,
        D_anc < -Y.im → -Y.im < D_top → |Y.re| < A * (-Y.im) → ‖T‖ < 2 * T_max →
        (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_upper n := by
      intro Y T hY_lo hY_hi hY_re hT_lt
      have hy_re : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).re = seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * Y.re := by
        simp [s_n]
      have hy_im : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).im = seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * Y.im := by
        simp [s_n]
      have hδ_eq : seq.h_seq n - (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).im = seq.ℓ_seq n * (-Y.im) := by
        rw [hy_im]; ring
      have ht_norm : ‖T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)‖ < R_phys n := by
        dsimp [R_phys]
        rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hm_pos.le]
        exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hT_lt hm_pos
      have hd_lt : d_seq n < seq.h_seq n - (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).im := by
        rw [hδ_eq]; dsimp [d_seq]
        nlinarith only [hY_lo, hD_anc_pos, hℓ_pos]
      have hhi_lt : seq.h_seq n - (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).im < 2 * δ₀ n := by
        rw [hδ_eq]
        dsimp [δ₀]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, lt_div_iff₀ hK₀_pos,
          show seq.ℓ_seq n * -Y.im * K₀ = (K₀ * (-Y.im)) * seq.ℓ_seq n by ring]
        have h1 : K₀ * (-Y.im) < 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) := by
          nlinarith only [hY_hi, hK₀_pos, hD_top, hD_anc_pos]
        have h2 : (K₀ * (-Y.im)) * seq.ℓ_seq n < 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) * seq.ℓ_seq n :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 hℓ_pos
        linarith only [h2, hh_ge_top, hh_pos]
      have hre_lt :
          |(s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).re - seq.x_seq n| <
            m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).im) := by
        have h_sub : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y).re - seq.x_seq n = seq.ℓ_seq n * Y.re := by
          rw [hy_re]; ring
        rw [h_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hℓ_pos, hδ_eq]
        have hY_pos : 0 < -Y.im := lt_trans hD_anc_pos hY_lo
        have h2 : A < m₀ := by dsimp [m₀]; linarith only [hA]
        calc seq.ℓ_seq n * |Y.re|
            < seq.ℓ_seq n * (A * (-Y.im)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hY_re hℓ_pos
          _ < seq.ℓ_seq n * (m₀ * (-Y.im)) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 hY_pos) hℓ_pos
          _ = m₀ * (seq.ℓ_seq n * (-Y.im)) := by ring
      exact ⟨ht_norm, hd_lt, hhi_lt, hre_lt⟩

    refine ⟨s_t, hU_phys_open, by dsimp [δ_base]; positivity, ?_, ?_, hs_t_holo,
      fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro y t hyt _ τ hτ_lo hτ_hi
      have hy'_re : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = y.re := by simp
      have hy'_im : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = τ := by simp
      rcases hyt with h_up | h_lo | h_base
      · by_cases h_split : seq.h_seq n - ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im < 2 * δ₀ n
        · left
          refine ⟨h_up.1, ?_, h_split, ?_⟩
          · have h_up_lo := h_up.2.1
            rw [hy'_im]; linarith only [h_up_lo, hτ_hi]
          · rw [hy'_re, hy'_im]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_up.2.2.2
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hτ_hi]) hm₀_pos.le)
        · right; left
          refine ⟨h_up.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · linarith only [h_split, hδ₀_pos]
          · rw [hy'_im]; linarith only [hτ_lo, hδ_seed_pos]
          · rw [hy'_re, hy'_im]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_up.2.2.2
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hτ_hi]) hm₀_pos.le)
      · right; left
        refine ⟨h_lo.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have h_lo_1 := h_lo.2.1
          rw [hy'_im]; linarith only [h_lo_1, hτ_hi]
        · rw [hy'_im]; linarith only [hτ_lo, hδ_seed_pos]
        · rw [hy'_re, hy'_im]
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_lo.2.2.2
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hτ_hi]) hm₀_pos.le)
      · right; right
        refine ⟨h_base.1, ?_⟩
        have hb2 := (abs_lt.mp h_base.2).2
        rw [hy'_im, abs_of_nonneg hτ_lo]
        linarith only [hτ_hi, hb2]
    · 
      intro y t hyt
      rcases hyt with h_up | h_lo | h_base
      · left; simpa [U_upper] using h_up
      · right; left; simpa [U_lower] using h_lo
      · right; right; simpa [U_base_phys] using h_base
    · 
      intro y t hyt
      rcases hyt with h_up | h_lo | h_base
      · have h_up_neg : (y, -t) ∈ U_upper n := by simpa [U_upper] using h_up
        rw [hs_t_upper (y, -t) h_up_neg, hs_t_upper (y, t) h_up]
        exact (hs_cone_props y t (hU_upper_sub_out h_up)).1
      · have h_lo_neg : (y, -t) ∈ U_lower n := by simpa [U_lower] using h_lo
        rw [hs_t_lower (y, -t) h_lo_neg, hs_t_lower (y, t) h_lo]
        exact (hs_band₀_props y t (hU_lower_sub_mid h_lo)).1
      · have h_base_neg : (y, -t) ∈ U_base_phys n := by simpa [U_base_phys] using h_base
        rw [hs_t_base (y, -t) h_base_neg, hs_t_base (y, t) h_base]
        exact E.𝔰_even y t (hU_base_sub_T h_base)
    · 
      intro y t hy_im ht_norm
      have ht_R : ‖t‖ < R_phys n := by
        dsimp [R_phys]
        have hlt : T_max / seq.m_seq n < 2 * T_max / seq.m_seq n :=
          div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith only [hT_max]) hm_pos
        linarith only [ht_norm, hlt]
      have h_mem_base : (y, t) ∈ U_base_phys n := ⟨ht_R, hy_im⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inr (Or.inr h_mem_base), hU_base_sub_T h_mem_base,
        hs_t_base (y, t) h_mem_base⟩
    · 
      intro Y _ hY_lo hY_hi hY_re
      have h0 : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_upper n := by
        simpa using h_cone_maps_upper Y 0 hY_lo hY_hi hY_re (by simp; positivity)
      rw [hs_t_upper _ h0]
      exact hs_cone_zero _ (hU_upper_sub_out h0)
    · 
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with ⟨hY_lo, hY_hi, hY_re, hT_lt⟩
      have hp_up : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_upper n :=
        h_cone_maps_upper p.1 p.2 hY_lo hY_hi hY_re (by linarith only [hT_lt, hT_max])
      refine ⟨Or.inl hp_up, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have him : (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im =
            seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * p.1.im := by simp [s_n]
        rw [him]
        have h1 : seq.ℓ_seq n * (-p.1.im) < D_top * seq.ℓ_seq n := by
          nlinarith only [hY_hi, hℓ_pos]
        have h2 : D_top * seq.ℓ_seq n < 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) * seq.ℓ_seq n := by
          have h2a : D_top < 4 * K₀ * (D_top + 4) := by
            nlinarith only [hK₀_gt_32, hD_top, hD_anc_pos]
          exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2a hℓ_pos
        linarith only [h1, h2, hh_ge_top]
      · let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1
        let t : ℂ := p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
        change ‖(s_t (y, t) - s_n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
          C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)
        rw [hs_t_upper (y, t) hp_up]
        have h_sub_eq :
            (s_cone (y, t) - s_n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1 =
              (s_cone (y, t) - y) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) := by
          have hℓ_c_ne : (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hℓ_pos.ne'
          dsimp [y]
          field_simp [hℓ_c_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_sub_eq, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hℓ_pos.le]
        have h_disp := (hs_cone_props y t (hU_upper_sub_out hp_up)).2
        have hδ_eq : seq.h_seq n - y.im = seq.ℓ_seq n * (-p.1.im) := by simp [y, s_n]
        have ht_sq : ‖t‖ ^ 2 = ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 / (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [t]
          rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hm_pos.le, div_pow]
        have hY_pos : 0 < -p.1.im := lt_trans hD_anc_pos hY_lo
        have hδ_rpow : (seq.h_seq n - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) =
            (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
          rw [hδ_eq]
          exact Real.mul_rpow hℓ_pos.le hY_pos.le
        have hℓ_pow2 : ((seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast ((seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul hℓ_pos.le]
          ring_nf
        have hℓ_sum : (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) = seq.ℓ_seq n := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hℓ_pos]
          have : 2 * α₀ + (1 - 2 * α₀) = 1 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.rpow_one]
        have hrhs_eq :
            (A_ind * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M_scale n ^ 2 * (seq.h_seq n - y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) /
              seq.ℓ_seq n =
            C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
          dsimp [M_scale, C_anc]
          rw [ht_sq, hδ_rpow]
          calc (A_ind * (‖p.2‖ ^ 2 / seq.m_seq n ^ 2) *
                (3 * C_cone * seq.m_seq n * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀) ^ 2 *
                (seq.ℓ_seq n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀))) / seq.ℓ_seq n
              = 9 * A_ind * C_cone ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) *
                  (seq.m_seq n ^ 2 / seq.m_seq n ^ 2) *
                  ((((seq.ℓ_seq n ^ α₀) ^ (2 : ℕ)) * seq.ℓ_seq n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)) /
                    seq.ℓ_seq n) := by ring
            _ = 9 * A_ind * C_cone ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) := by
                rw [div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 hm_pos.ne'), hℓ_pow2, hℓ_sum, div_self hℓ_pos.ne']
                ring
        rw [← hrhs_eq]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_disp hℓ_pos.le
    · 
      intro Y T hT_ne hY_mem _ _
      rcases hY_mem with ⟨hY_lo, hY_hi, hY_re, hT_lt⟩
      have hΩ_rec_eq :
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d_seq n < seq.h_seq n - p.1.im ∧
            seq.h_seq n - p.1.im < 2 * δ₀ n ∧
            |p.1.re - seq.x_seq n| < m₀ * (seq.h_seq n - p.1.im) ∧
            ‖p.2‖ < R_phys n } = U_upper n := by
        ext p
        exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨h4, h1, h2, h3⟩,
          fun ⟨h4, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩⟩
      have h4d_lt_2δ₀ : 4 * d_seq n < 2 * δ₀ n := by
        dsimp [d_seq, δ₀]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, lt_div_iff₀ hK₀_pos]
        nlinarith only [hh_ge_anc, hh_pos, hK₀_pos, hD_anc_pos, hℓ_pos]
      let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
      let t₀ : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
      have hy_re : y.re = seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * Y.re := by simp [y, s_n]
      have hy_im : y.im = seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * Y.im := by simp [y, s_n]
      have hδ_y_eq : seq.h_seq n - y.im = seq.ℓ_seq n * (-Y.im) := by rw [hy_im]; ring

        0 < C_st → 0 ≤ C_init →
        8 * r * (2 * h_ref / d) ^ α ≤ ρ_base →

        (let m_steep_init : ℝ := 2 * (m_aux + (4 * K₀ + 1) * C_bump_init + 2)
         let A₀ : ℝ := max 1 ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st)

def EntireConeParamRecurrenceProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), X.D_strip = Set.univ →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_rec : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_rec → γ_rec < 1 / 4 →
    ∀ (x₀ h_ref d δ_top m₀ R_par M_scale C_disp : ℝ)
      (s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < d → 4 * d < δ_top → 1 ≤ m₀ → 0 < R_par → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_disp →
      (let Ω_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
         { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_top ∧
           |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
           ‖p.2‖ < R_par }
       (∀ w : ℂ, d ≤ h_ref - w.im → h_ref - w.im ≤ (3 / 2) * δ_top →
         ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ∧
         Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α)) →
       DifferentiableOn ℂ s_cone Ω_rec →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         ‖s_cone (z, t) - z‖ ≤ C_disp * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, γ_rec * ‖t‖ < t.im →
         (z - t, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z + t, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         let s_prev := s_cone (z - t, t)
         let s_curr := s_cone (z, t)
         let s_next := s_cone (z + t, t)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
           t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
       ∀ y t₀ : ℂ,
         let δ_y : ℝ := h_ref - y.im
         2 * d ≤ δ_y → (5 / 4) * δ_y < δ_top →

         64 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (-2 * α) ≤ 1 / 16 →
         let s_prev := s_cone (y - t₀, t₀)
         let s_curr := s_cone (y, t₀)
         let s_next := s_cone (y + t₀, t₀)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t₀
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t₀
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t₀) J_curr -
           t₀ * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t₀) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t₀) J_prev)

           (∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_mid → s_band₀ (y, 0) = y) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, |p.1.im| < δ_seed → s_band₀ p = s_base_fn p) ∧
           (∀ p ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init, s_band₀ p = s_steep p))

def EntireConeParamRecurrenceProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (X : ExpStripData), X.D_strip = Set.univ →
  ∀ (P : ChordActionPackage X) (α γ_rec : ℝ),
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < γ_rec → γ_rec < 1 / 4 →
    ∀ (x₀ h_ref d δ_top m₀ R_par M_scale C_disp : ℝ)
      (s_cone : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < d → 4 * d < δ_top → 1 ≤ m₀ → 0 < R_par → 0 < M_scale → 0 ≤ C_disp →
      (let Ω_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
         { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           d < h_ref - p.1.im ∧ h_ref - p.1.im < δ_top ∧
           |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im) ∧
           ‖p.2‖ < R_par }
       (∀ w : ℂ, d ≤ h_ref - w.im → h_ref - w.im ≤ (3 / 2) * δ_top →
         ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ∧
         Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α)) →
       DifferentiableOn ℂ s_cone Ω_rec →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         ‖s_cone (z, t) - z‖ ≤ C_disp * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) →
       (∀ z t : ℂ, γ_rec * ‖t‖ < t.im →
         (z - t, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z, t) ∈ Ω_rec → (z + t, t) ∈ Ω_rec →
         let s_prev := s_cone (z - t, t)
         let s_curr := s_cone (z, t)
         let s_next := s_cone (z + t, t)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
           t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev) →
       ∀ y t₀ : ℂ,
         let δ_y : ℝ := h_ref - y.im
         2 * d ≤ δ_y → (5 / 4) * δ_y < δ_top →
         |y.re - x₀| < ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * m₀ - 1 / 4) * δ_y →
         t₀ ≠ 0 → ‖t₀‖ < R_par / 2 → R_par ≤ δ_y / 32 →
         4 * R_par * M_scale * δ_y ^ (-α) ≤ P.η_sf →
         64 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (-2 * α) ≤ 1 / 16 →
         let s_prev := s_cone (y - t₀, t₀)
         let s_curr := s_cone (y, t₀)
         let s_next := s_cone (y + t₀, t₀)
         let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t₀
         let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t₀
         deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t₀) J_curr -
           t₀ * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t₀) s_curr =
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t₀) J_prev)

  let R_ratio : ℝ := 4 * T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖ / M_mod.ρ_mod
  have hR_ratio_pos : 0 < R_ratio := by positivity

  have h10_le_D₀ : 10 ≤ D₀ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hD₀_pos : 0 < D₀ := by linarith
  have hSmall : T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖ * Real.exp (-D₀) < M_mod.ρ_mod := by
    have hlog_lt : Real.log R_ratio < D₀ := by
      have : Real.log R_ratio + 1 ≤ D₀ := le_max_right _ _

    have hexp_lt : Real.exp (-D₀) < Real.exp (-Real.log R_ratio) :=
      Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    rw [Real.exp_neg (Real.log R_ratio), Real.exp_log hR_ratio_pos] at hexp_lt
    have hinv : R_ratio⁻¹ = M_mod.ρ_mod / (4 * T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖) := by
      dsimp [R_ratio]
      rw [inv_div]
    rw [hinv] at hexp_lt
    have hTc_pos : 0 < T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖ := mul_pos hT_max hc₀_pos
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp_lt hTc_pos
    have h_eq : T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖ * (M_mod.ρ_mod / (4 * T_max * ‖seq.c₀‖)) =

      field_simp [hT_max.ne', hc₀_pos.ne']
    linarith
  let C_deep : ℝ := max 1 (M_mod.C_Δ * ‖seq.c₀‖ ^ 2)
  have hC_deep_pos : 0 < C_deep := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  let w_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * p.1)
  let S_deep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 + M_mod.Δ₀ (w_map p)
  let dom : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
  have hw_re : ∀ z : ℂ, (-Complex.I * z).re = z.im := by
    intro z

  have hw_maps : Set.MapsTo w_map dom (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) M_mod.ρ_mod) := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    dsimp [w_map]

  have hw_diff : Differentiable ℂ w_map :=

  have hS_deep_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_deep dom :=

  · intro Y T hY hT

          _ = ‖seq.c₀‖ ^ 2 * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * (-Y.im)) := by rw [hexp_sq]
      let β : ℝ := 2 * α - 1

        have h1 : Real.exp (-2 * D) = (Real.exp (2 * D))⁻¹ := by
          have hneg : -2 * D = -(2 * D) := by ring
          rw [hneg, Real.exp_neg]
        have h2 : D ^ (1 - 2 * α) = (D ^ β)⁻¹ := by
          have hexp_eq : 1 - 2 * α = -β := by dsimp [β]; ring
          rw [hexp_eq, Real.rpow_neg hD_pos.le]
        rw [h1, h2]

      have hCΔ_pos : 0 < M_mod.C_Δ := M_mod.C_Δ_pos

        _ ≤ C_deep * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * D) := by

        _ ≤ C_deep * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * D ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by

    · have hw_neg : w_map (Y, -T) = -w_map (Y, T) := by

    · have hw_lt : ‖(T * seq.c₀) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < M_mod.ρ_mod := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, w_map] using hw_mem

structure DfmcFrozenKernelData (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  tildePhi : ℂ → ℂ
  G_ker : ℂ → ℂ
  r_reg : ℝ
  r_reg_pos : 0 < r_reg
  r_reg_le_one : r_reg ≤ 1
  tildePhi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ tildePhi (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
  G_ker_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_ker (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
  tildePhi_even : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, tildePhi (-u) = tildePhi u
  G_ker_even : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, G_ker (-u) = G_ker u
  tildePhi_zero : tildePhi 0 = 1 / 24
  G_ker_zero : G_ker 0 = 1
  action_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ, frozenActionP kind lam J = J ^ 3 * tildePhi (lam * J / 2)
  energy_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 →
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * G_ker (lam * J / 2)
  regular_of_small : ∀ lam J : ℂ, J ≠ 0 → ‖lam * J / 2‖ < r_reg →
    IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  frozen_action_holo_2d : ∀ (c₀ T : ℂ),
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2)
      { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2 / 2‖ < 1 }
  legendre_deriv_zero : ∀ (V : Set ℂ) (S_star : ℂ → ℂ) (c₀ T : ℂ),
    IsOpen V →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V →
    (∀ Y ∈ V, ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * deriv S_star Y / 2‖ < 1) →
    (∀ Y ∈ V,
      deriv (fun Y' =>
        deriv (fun J' =>
          frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y')) J')
          (deriv S_star Y')) Y =
      deriv (fun S' =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (deriv S_star Y))
        (S_star Y)) →
    ∀ Y ∈ V,
      deriv (fun Y' =>
        frozenEnergyE kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y'))
          (deriv S_star Y')) Y = 0

structure DfmcAnalyticModelPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  ρ_mod : ℝ
  r_lam : ℝ
  ρ_J : ℝ
  C_Δ : ℝ
  Δ₀ : ℂ → ℂ
  ρ_mod_pos : 0 < ρ_mod
  r_lam_pos : 0 < r_lam
  ρ_J_pos : 0 < ρ_J
  ρ_J_lt : ρ_J < 1 / 4
  C_Δ_pos : 0 < C_Δ
  Δ₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₀ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod)
  Δ₀_zero : Δ₀ 0 = 0
  Δ₀_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, Δ₀ (-w) = Δ₀ w
  Δ₀_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, ‖Δ₀ w‖ ≤ C_Δ * ‖w‖ ^ 2
  model_energy : ∀ (w_coeff Y : ℂ),
    ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < ρ_mod →
    frozenEnergyE kind
      (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I *
        (Y + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)))))
      (deriv (fun Y' => Y' + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y'))) Y) = 1 / 12
  regular_on_polydisk : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_lam → ‖J - 1‖ < ρ_J →

def DfmcAnchorWitnessAt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (T_bound D_anc C_anc α A' D_top' : ℝ)
    (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n ≥ N_init,
    let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        D_anc < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top' ∧
        |p.1.re| < A' * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_bound }
    IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
    0 < δ_base n ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
      ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
        ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_bound / seq.m_seq n →
      (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n →
      D_anc < -y.im → -y.im < D_top' → |y.re| < A' * (-y.im) →
      s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y, 0) =
        s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * y) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
      (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
      0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im ∧
      ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
          (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - p.1‖ ≤
        C_anc * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (-p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) ∧
    (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
      (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
      (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
      (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
      let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
      let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
      let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
      let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
      let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
      let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
      let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
        t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

def DfmcHasAnchorAt (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (T_bound D_anc C_anc α : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A' D_top' : ℝ, 0 < A' → D_anc + 2 < D_top' →
    ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
      (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
      DfmcAnchorWitnessAt X P kind seq T_bound D_anc C_anc α A' D_top'

structure DfmcExtractedLimit (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (D₀ C_anc α A T_max : ℝ) where
  Y_star : ℂ
  T_star : ℂ
  S_star : ℂ → ℂ
  φ : ℕ → ℕ
  F_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ
  T_star_ne : T_star ≠ 0
  T_star_lt : ‖T_star‖ < T_max
  Y_star_mem : D₀ < -Y_star.im ∧ |Y_star.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y_star.im)
  φ_strictMono : StrictMono φ
  S_star_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star
    { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  S_star_bound : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) →

  F_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F_seq S_star Filter.atTop
    { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  F_deriv_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun k => deriv (F_seq k)) (deriv S_star)
    Filter.atTop { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) }
  local_holo_and_recurrence :
    ∀ (Y₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ), 0 < r₀ →
      Metric.closedBall Y₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆
        { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) } →
      ∃ K₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K₀,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_seq k) (Metric.ball Y₀ (2 * r₀)) ∧
        (let n := φ k
         let a_n : ℂ := T_star / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
         let t : ℂ := T_star / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
         let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
         ‖a_n‖ < r₀ / 2 ∧
         ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Y₀ r₀,
           let s_prev := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * F_seq k (Y - a_n)
           let s_curr := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * F_seq k Y
           let J_prev := (F_seq k Y - F_seq k (Y - a_n)) / a_n
           let J_curr := (F_seq k (Y + a_n) - F_seq k Y) / a_n
           deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
             t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
             deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro u v huv hdom
  let h_r : ℝ := v - u
  have h_r_pos : 0 < h_r := sub_pos.mpr huv
  have h_r_ne : h_r ≠ 0 := h_r_pos.ne'
  let h : ℂ := (h_r : ℂ)
  have h_ne : h ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_r_ne
  have hc_ne : (S.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr S.c_pos.ne'
  have hOpen_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have hf_deriv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    S.f_holo.deriv hOpen_strip
  have hreal_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro x
    change |(x : ℂ).im| < S.H
    simp [S.H_pos]
  have hf_re_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (S.f (x : ℂ)).re := fun x => (S.f_real_pos x).1
  have hf_eq_re : ∀ x : ℝ, S.f (x : ℂ) = (((S.f (x : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x
    calc S.f (x : ℂ)
        = (((S.f (x : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((S.f (x : ℂ)).im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
          (Complex.re_add_im (S.f (x : ℂ))).symm
      _ = (((S.f (x : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp [(S.f_real_pos x).2]
  have hf_real_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, S.f (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [hf_eq_re x]
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hf_re_pos x).ne'
  have hΓ_eq_re : ∀ (x : ℝ) (i : Fin 2), S.Γ (x : ℂ) i = (((S.Γ (x : ℂ) i).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro x i
    have hconj : starRingEnd ℂ (S.Γ (x : ℂ) i) = S.Γ (x : ℂ) i := by
      have h1 := S.Γ_conj (x : ℂ) (hreal_mem x) (hf_real_ne x) i
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have him : (S.Γ (x : ℂ) i).im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj
    calc S.Γ (x : ℂ) i
        = (((S.Γ (x : ℂ) i).re : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((S.Γ (x : ℂ) i).im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
          (Complex.re_add_im (S.Γ (x : ℂ) i)).symm
      _ = (((S.Γ (x : ℂ) i).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp [him]
  let ξ : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => u + h_r * w
  let ζ : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => (u : ℂ) + (w : ℂ) * h
  have hζ_eq : ∀ w : ℝ, ζ w = ((ξ w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro w
    dsimp [ζ, ξ, h]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hξ_zero : ξ 0 = u := by dsimp [ξ]; ring
  have hξ_one : ξ 1 = v := by dsimp [ξ, h_r]; ring
  have hζ_zero : ζ 0 = (u : ℂ) := by rw [hζ_eq 0, hξ_zero]
  have hζ_one : ζ 1 = (v : ℂ) := by rw [hζ_eq 1, hξ_one]
  have hζ_mem : ∀ w : ℝ, ζ w ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro w
    rw [hζ_eq w]
    exact hreal_mem (ξ w)
  have hζ_nhds : ∀ w : ℝ, horizStrip S.H ∈ nhds (ζ w) :=
    fun w => hOpen_strip.mem_nhds (hζ_mem w)
  have hζ_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt ζ h w := by
    intro w
    have hw : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) * h) ((1 : ℂ) * h) w :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id w).ofReal_comp).mul_const h
    rw [one_mul] at hw
    exact hw.const_add (u : ℂ)
  have hζ_cont : Continuous ζ :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun w => (hζ_deriv w).continuousAt
  let Q : ℝ → ℂ := sfcaStripPot S (u : ℂ) h
  have hQ_cont_all : Continuous Q :=
    continuous_const.mul (S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hζ_cont hζ_mem)
  have hQ_cont : ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ_cont_all.continuousOn
  let y : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => h * S.f (ζ w)
  let y' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => h ^ 2 * deriv S.f (ζ w)
  let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => S.ϕ (ζ w) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ)
  have hΦ_zero : Φ 0 = 0 := by simp [Φ, hζ_zero]
  have hΦ_one : Φ 1 = S.ϕ (v : ℂ) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ) := by simp [Φ, hζ_one]
  have hΦ_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt Φ (y w) w := by
    intro w
    have hϕ_at : HasDerivAt S.ϕ (S.f (ζ w)) (ζ w) := by
      rw [← S.deriv_ϕ (ζ w) (hζ_mem w)]
      exact (S.ϕ_holo.differentiableAt (hζ_nhds w)).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => S.ϕ (ζ x)) (S.f (ζ w) * h) w :=
      HasDerivAt.comp w hϕ_at (hζ_deriv w)
    have hsub : HasDerivAt Φ (S.f (ζ w) * h - 0) w :=
      hcomp.sub (hasDerivAt_const w (S.ϕ (u : ℂ)))
    have hval : S.f (ζ w) * h - 0 = y w := by dsimp [y]; ring
    rwa [hval] at hsub
  have hy_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt y (y' w) w := by
    intro w
    have hf_at : HasDerivAt S.f (deriv S.f (ζ w)) (ζ w) :=
      (S.f_holo.differentiableAt (hζ_nhds w)).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => S.f (ζ x)) (deriv S.f (ζ w) * h) w :=
      HasDerivAt.comp w hf_at (hζ_deriv w)
    have hmul := hcomp.const_mul h
    have hval : h * (deriv S.f (ζ w) * h) = y' w := by dsimp [y']; ring
    rwa [hval] at hmul
  have hy'_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt y' (Q w * y w) w := by
    intro w
    have hf'_at : HasDerivAt (deriv S.f) (S.q (ζ w) * S.f (ζ w)) (ζ w) := by
      rw [← S.deriv2_f (ζ w) (hζ_mem w)]
      exact (hf_deriv_holo.differentiableAt (hζ_nhds w)).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => deriv S.f (ζ x)) ((S.q (ζ w) * S.f (ζ w)) * h) w :=
      HasDerivAt.comp w hf'_at (hζ_deriv w)
    have hmul := hcomp.const_mul (h ^ 2)
    have hval : h ^ 2 * ((S.q (ζ w) * S.f (ζ w)) * h) = Q w * y w := by
      dsimp [Q, sfcaStripPot, ζ, y]
      ring
    rwa [hval] at hmul
  have hy_cont : Continuous y :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun w => (hy_deriv w).continuousAt
  have hy'_cont : Continuous y' :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun w => (hy'_deriv w).continuousAt

  let a₀ : ℂ := h * S.f (u : ℂ)
  let a₁ : ℂ := h ^ 2 * deriv S.f (u : ℂ)
  let b₁ : ℂ := a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 + a₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  have hPhi_eq : sfcaStripPhi S ((u : ℂ), h) = sfcaDivH Q a₀ b₁ := rfl
  have ha₀_eta : ‖a₀‖ < sfcaEtaSL := hdom.2.2.1
  have ha₁_eta : ‖a₁‖ < sfcaEtaSL := hdom.2.2.2.1
  have hQ_eta : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ < sfcaEtaSL := hdom.2.2.2.2
  have ha₀_rho : ‖a₀‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
    have : sfcaEtaSL < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB]
    exact lt_trans ha₀_eta this
  have hQ_rho : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
    intro w hw
    have : sfcaEtaSL < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB]
    exact lt_trans (hQ_eta w hw) this
  have hQ_half : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have : sfcaEtaSL ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]
    exact le_trans (hQ_eta w hw).le this
  have hqb := hVolt.quant_bounds Q sfcaEtaSL hQ_cont (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL])
    (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]) (fun w hw => (hQ_eta w hw).le)
  let k₀ : ℂ := sfcaVolterraK Q 1
  have hk₀_lb : 7 / 8 ≤ ‖k₀‖ := hqb.1
  have hk₀_ne : k₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at hk₀_lb
    norm_num at hk₀_lb
  have hone_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
  have hC1_le : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1 - 1‖ ≤ sfcaEtaSL := (hqb.2 1 hone_mem).1
    have h2 : ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1 - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
      calc ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ = ‖(sfcaVolterraC Q 1 - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1 - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    rw [norm_one] at h2
    have h3 : sfcaEtaSL + 1 ≤ 2 := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]
    linarith
  have hK1_le : ‖k₀‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 : ‖k₀ - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * sfcaEtaSL := (hqb.2 1 hone_mem).2.1
    rw [Complex.ofReal_one] at h1
    have h2 : ‖k₀‖ ≤ ‖k₀ - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
      calc ‖k₀‖ = ‖(k₀ - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖k₀ - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    rw [norm_one] at h2
    have h3 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * sfcaEtaSL + 1 ≤ 2 := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]
    linarith
  have hb₁_rho : ‖b₁‖ < sfcaRhoB := by
    calc ‖b₁‖
        ≤ ‖a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ + ‖a₁ * k₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖a₀‖ * ‖sfcaVolterraC Q 1‖ + ‖a₁‖ * ‖k₀‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul a₀, norm_mul a₁]
      _ ≤ sfcaEtaSL * 2 + sfcaEtaSL * 2 :=
          add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul ha₀_eta.le hC1_le (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]))
            (mul_le_mul ha₁_eta.le hK1_le (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]))
      _ < sfcaRhoB := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL, sfcaRhoB]
  have hy_zero : y 0 = a₀ := by simp [y, hζ_zero, a₀]
  have hy'_zero : y' 0 = a₁ := by simp [y', hζ_zero, a₁]
  have hy_one : y 1 = h * S.f (v : ℂ) := by simp [y, hζ_one]
  have h_ode_y := hVolt.ode_unique Q y y' hQ_cont hQ_half hy_cont.continuousOn
    hy'_cont.continuousOn (fun w _ => ⟨hy_deriv w, hy'_deriv w⟩)
  have hb₁_eq_y1 : b₁ = y 1 := by
    have h1 := (h_ode_y 1 hone_mem).1
    rw [hy_zero, hy'_zero] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hb₁_eq : b₁ = h * S.f (v : ℂ) := hb₁_eq_y1.trans hy_one
  have hSlope_eq : sfcaSlopeA1 Q a₀ b₁ = a₁ := by
    dsimp [sfcaSlopeA1, b₁, k₀]
    have : a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 + a₁ * sfcaVolterraK Q 1 - a₀ * sfcaVolterraC Q 1 =

    rw [this]
    exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ a₁ hk₀_ne
  have hFieldF_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, sfcaFieldF Q a₀ b₁ w = y w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := (h_ode_y w hw).1
    rw [hy_zero, hy'_zero] at h1
    dsimp [sfcaFieldF]
    rw [hSlope_eq, ← h1]
  have hFieldFDeriv_eq : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, sfcaFieldFDeriv Q a₀ b₁ w = y' w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := (h_ode_y w hw).2
    rw [hy_zero, hy'_zero] at h1
    dsimp [sfcaFieldFDeriv]
    rw [hSlope_eq, ← h1]
  have ha₀_ne : a₀ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero h_ne (hf_real_ne u)
  have hb₁_ne : b₁ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hb₁_eq]
    exact mul_ne_zero h_ne (hf_real_ne v)
  have ha₀b₁_ne : a₀ * b₁ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha₀_ne hb₁_ne
  have hy_ne : ∀ w : ℝ, y w ≠ 0 := by
    intro w
    dsimp [y]
    rw [hζ_eq w]
    exact mul_ne_zero h_ne (hf_real_ne (ξ w))

  have h_wronskian : ∀ (P g g' : ℝ → ℂ),
      ContinuousOn P (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, g w ≠ 0) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt g (g' w) w ∧ HasDerivAt g' (P w * g w) w) →
      sfcaVolterraK P 1 = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    intro P g g' hP_c hg_c hg'_c hg_ne hg_ode
    obtain ⟨_, hk_c, _, hk'_c, _, _, _, hk_0, hk'_0, hP_ode⟩ := hVolt.ode_laws P hP_c
    let k : ℝ → ℂ := sfcaVolterraK P
    let k' : ℝ → ℂ := sfcaVolterraKDeriv P
    let W : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => g w * k' w - g' w * k w
    have hW_c : ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      (hg_c.mul hk'_c).sub (hg'_c.mul hk_c)
    have hW_0 : W 0 = g 0 := by
      dsimp [W, k, k']
      rw [hk_0, hk'_0]
      ring
    have hW_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt W 0 x := by
      intro x hx
      have hd1 := (hg_ode x hx).1.mul (hP_ode x hx).2.2.2
      have hd2 := (hg_ode x hx).2.mul (hP_ode x hx).2.2.1
      have hd := hd1.sub hd2
      have hzero : (g' x * k' x + g x * (P x * k x)) - (P x * g x * k x + g' x * k' x) = 0 := by
        ring
      rwa [hzero] at hd
    have hW_const : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, W w = g 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have hW_sub_c : ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc 0 w) :=
        hW_c.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2)
      have hW_sub_d : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 w, HasDerivAt W 0 x :=
        fun x hx => hW_deriv x (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo_right hw.2 hx)
      have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1 hW_sub_c
        hW_sub_d intervalIntegrable_const
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at hint
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hint.symm).trans hW_0
    let q_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => k w / g w
    have hq_c : ContinuousOn q_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hk_c.div hg_c hg_ne
    have hq_0 : q_fn 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [q_fn, k]
      rw [hk_0, zero_div]
    let d_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => g 0 * (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2
    have hd_c : ContinuousOn d_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      continuousOn_const.mul ((hg_c.inv₀ hg_ne).pow 2)
    have hd_int : IntervalIntegrable d_fn MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
    have hq_deriv : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt q_fn (d_fn w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_icc : w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw
      have hgw_ne : g w ≠ 0 := hg_ne w hw_icc
      have hdiv := (hP_ode w hw).2.2.1.div (hg_ode w hw).1 hgw_ne
      have hval : (k' w * g w - k w * g' w) / g w ^ 2 = d_fn w := by
        have hWw : k' w * g w - k w * g' w = g 0 := by
          calc k' w * g w - k w * g' w = W w := by dsimp [W]; ring
            _ = g 0 := hW_const w hw_icc
        rw [hWw]
        dsimp [d_fn]
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
      rwa [hval] at hdiv
    have hint_q := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le zero_le_one hq_c
      hq_deriv hd_int
    rw [hq_0, sub_zero] at hint_q
    have hint_pull : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, d_fn w) = g 0 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [d_fn]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul (g 0) _
    rw [hint_pull] at hint_q
    have hg1_ne : g 1 ≠ 0 := hg_ne 1 hone_mem
    calc sfcaVolterraK P 1
        = q_fn 1 * g 1 := (div_mul_cancel₀ (k 1) hg1_ne).symm
      _ = (g 0 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2) * g 1 := by rw [← hint_q]
      _ = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring

  let F_arc : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => S.c / (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re ^ 2
  let A_arc : ℝ := ∫ ξ in u..v, F_arc ξ
  have hF_arc_cont : Continuous F_arc := by
    refine continuous_const.div ?_ ?_
    · exact (Complex.continuous_re.comp
        (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal hreal_mem)).pow 2
    · intro ξ
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (hf_re_pos ξ).ne'
  have hF_arc_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < F_arc ξ :=
    fun ξ => div_pos S.c_pos (pow_pos (hf_re_pos ξ) 2)
  have hA_arc_pos : 0 < A_arc :=
    intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos (hF_arc_cont.intervalIntegrable u v)
      hF_arc_pos huv
  have hA_arc_ne : (A_arc : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hA_arc_pos.ne'
  let C_scale : ℂ := a₀ * b₁ / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)
  have hC_scale_ne : C_scale ≠ 0 :=
    div_ne_zero ha₀b₁_ne (mul_ne_zero hc_ne (pow_ne_zero 3 h_ne))
  have hk₀_eval : k₀ = C_scale * (A_arc : ℂ) := by
    have hk₀_wr := h_wronskian Q y y' hQ_cont hy_cont.continuousOn hy'_cont.continuousOn
      (fun w _ => hy_ne w) (fun w _ => ⟨hy_deriv w, hy'_deriv w⟩)
    have hy_inv_sq : ∀ w : ℝ,
        (y w)⁻¹ ^ 2 = (((S.c * h_r ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((F_arc (u + h_r * w) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro w
      set fw : ℝ := (S.f ((u + h_r * w : ℝ) : ℂ)).re
      have hfw_pos : 0 < fw := hf_re_pos (u + h_r * w)
      have hfw_c_ne : (fw : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hfw_pos.ne'
      have hyw : y w = (h_r : ℂ) * (fw : ℂ) := by
        calc y w
            = (h_r : ℂ) * S.f ((u + h_r * w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
                dsimp [y, h]
                rw [hζ_eq w]

      rw [hyw, hF]

      field_simp [hc_ne, h_ne, hfw_c_ne]
    have hint_y : (∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (y w)⁻¹ ^ 2) =
        (((S.c * h_r ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, F_arc (u + h_r * w) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp_rw [hy_inv_sq]
