      have hmul := intervalIntegral.mul_integral_comp_add_mul
        (f := F_arc) (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) h_r u
      have h0 : u + h_r * 0 = u := by ring
      have h1 : u + h_r * 1 = v := by dsimp [h_r]; ring

      eq_div_of_mul_eq h_r_ne (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h_rescale)
    change sfcaVolterraK Q 1 = C_scale * (A_arc : ℂ)
    rw [hk₀_wr, hy_zero, ← hb₁_eq_y1, hint_y, hint_real]

    push_cast

  have h_gauge_eval : ∀ (ι : ℂ) (P : ℝ → ℂ),
      (ι = -Complex.I ∨ ι = Complex.I) →
      Set.EqOn P (fun w => Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * ι * y' w - (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (y w) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      sfcaVolterraK P 1 =
        C_scale * Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
          ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + ι * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by
    intro ι P hι_cases hP_eq
    have hι_sq : ι ^ 2 = -1 := by
      rcases hι_cases with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Complex.I_sq]
    have hι_trig : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.cos z - ι * Complex.sin z = Complex.exp (-ι * z) := by
      intro z
      rcases hι_cases with rfl | rfl
      · have hexp := Complex.exp_mul_I z
        have harg : -(-Complex.I) * z = z * Complex.I := by ring
        rw [harg, hexp]
        ring
      · have hexp := Complex.exp_mul_I (-z)
        rw [Complex.cos_neg, Complex.sin_neg] at hexp
        have harg : -Complex.I * z = (-z) * Complex.I := by ring
        rw [harg, hexp]
        ring
    let E_ι : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * Φ w)
    let g_ι : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => y w * E_ι w
    let g_ι' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => (y' w + (ι / 2) * (y w) ^ 2) * E_ι w
    let P_exp : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * ι * y' w - (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (y w) ^ 2
    have hE_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt E_ι (E_ι w * ((ι / 2) * y w)) w :=
      fun w => HasDerivAt.comp w (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp ((ι / 2) * Φ w))
        ((hΦ_deriv w).const_mul (ι / 2))
    have hg_ι_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt g_ι (g_ι' w) w := by
      intro w
      have hd := (hy_deriv w).mul (hE_deriv w)
      have hval : y' w * E_ι w + y w * (E_ι w * ((ι / 2) * y w)) = g_ι' w := by
        dsimp [g_ι']
        ring
      rwa [hval] at hd
    have hg_ι'_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt g_ι' (P_exp w * g_ι w) w := by
      intro w
      have hd_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (y x) ^ 2) (2 * y w ^ (2 - 1) * y' w) w :=
        (hy_deriv w).pow 2
      have hd_factor : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => y' x + (ι / 2) * (y x) ^ 2)
          (Q w * y w + (ι / 2) * (2 * y w ^ (2 - 1) * y' w)) w :=
        (hy'_deriv w).add (hd_sq.const_mul (ι / 2))
      have hd := hd_factor.mul (hE_deriv w)
      have hval : (Q w * y w + (ι / 2) * (2 * y w ^ (2 - 1) * y' w)) * E_ι w +
          (y' w + (ι / 2) * (y w) ^ 2) * (E_ι w * ((ι / 2) * y w)) = P_exp w * g_ι w := by
        dsimp [P_exp, g_ι]
        calc (Q w * y w + (ι / 2) * (2 * y w ^ 1 * y' w)) * E_ι w +
              (y' w + (ι / 2) * (y w) ^ 2) * (E_ι w * ((ι / 2) * y w))
            = (Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * ι * y' w + (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ι ^ 2 * (y w) ^ 2) *
                (y w * E_ι w) := by ring
          _ = (Q w + (3 / 2 : ℂ) * ι * y' w - (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (y w) ^ 2) * (y w * E_ι w) := by
              rw [hι_sq]; ring
      rwa [hval] at hd
    have hg_ι_cont : Continuous g_ι :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun w => (hg_ι_deriv w).continuousAt
    have hg_ι'_cont : Continuous g_ι' :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun w => (hg_ι'_deriv w).continuousAt
    have hP_exp_cont : Continuous P_exp :=
      (hQ_cont_all.add (continuous_const.mul hy'_cont)).sub (continuous_const.mul (hy_cont.pow 2))
    have hP_cont : ContinuousOn P (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hP_exp_cont.continuousOn.congr hP_eq
    have hg_ι_ne : ∀ w : ℝ, g_ι w ≠ 0 :=
      fun w => mul_ne_zero (hy_ne w) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
    have hP_wr := h_wronskian P g_ι g_ι' hP_cont hg_ι_cont.continuousOn hg_ι'_cont.continuousOn
      (fun w _ => hg_ι_ne w) (fun w hw => by
        refine ⟨hg_ι_deriv w, ?_⟩
        have hEqw : P w = P_exp w := hP_eq (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hw)
        rw [hEqw]
        exact hg_ι'_deriv w)
    let Z_ι : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => S.Γ (ζ w) 1 + ι * S.Γ (ζ w) 0
    let Prim_ι : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => (Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) * Z_ι w
    have hPrim_deriv : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt Prim_ι ((g_ι w)⁻¹ ^ 2) w := by
      intro w
      have hfw_ne : S.f (ζ w) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hζ_eq w]
        exact hf_real_ne (ξ w)
      have hEw_ne : E_ι w ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      have hΓ_reg := S.Γ_reg_holo (ζ w) (hζ_mem w) hfw_ne
      have hΓ0_at := hΓ_reg.1.hasDerivAt
      rw [S.Γ_deriv₀ (ζ w) (hζ_mem w) hfw_ne] at hΓ0_at
      have hΓ1_at := hΓ_reg.2.hasDerivAt
      rw [S.Γ_deriv₁ (ζ w) (hζ_mem w) hfw_ne] at hΓ1_at
      have hZ_d := (HasDerivAt.comp w hΓ1_at (hζ_deriv w)).add
        ((HasDerivAt.comp w hΓ0_at (hζ_deriv w)).const_mul ι)
      have hPrim_d := hZ_d.const_mul (Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3))
      have htrig_eq :
          ((S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ζ w))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ (ζ w))) * h +
            ι * ((-S.c * (S.f (ζ w))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (S.ϕ (ζ w))) * h) =
          h * (S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ζ w))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-ι * S.ϕ (ζ w)) := by
        rw [← hι_trig (S.ϕ (ζ w))]
        ring
      have hexp_prod :
          Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-ι * S.ϕ (ζ w)) * (E_ι w) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        dsimp [E_ι, Φ]
        rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
        have : ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ) + -ι * S.ϕ (ζ w) +
            ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (ζ w) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) + (ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (ζ w) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) = 0 := by
          ring
        rw [this, Complex.exp_zero]
      have hE_inv_sq :
          (E_ι w)⁻¹ ^ 2 = Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-ι * S.ϕ (ζ w)) := by
        apply mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hEw_ne)
        rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hEw_ne, one_pow]
        exact hexp_prod.symm
      have hval : (Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) *
          (((S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ζ w))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ (ζ w))) * h +
            ι * ((-S.c * (S.f (ζ w))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (S.ϕ (ζ w))) * h)) =
          (g_ι w)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
        rw [htrig_eq]
        dsimp [g_ι, y]
        rw [mul_inv, mul_pow, hE_inv_sq]
        field_simp [hc_ne, h_ne, hfw_ne]
      rw [hval] at hPrim_d
      exact hPrim_d
    have hg_ι_inv_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun w => (g_ι w)⁻¹ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact (hg_ι_cont.continuousOn.inv₀ (fun w _ => hg_ι_ne w)).pow 2
    have hint_g := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun w _ => hPrim_deriv w) hg_ι_inv_int
    have hg0_eq : g_ι 0 = a₀ := by
      dsimp [g_ι, E_ι]
      rw [hy_zero, hΦ_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have hg1_eq : g_ι 1 = b₁ * Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) := by
      dsimp [g_ι, E_ι]
      rw [← hb₁_eq_y1, hΦ_one]
    have hPrim_diff : Prim_ι 1 - Prim_ι 0 =
        (Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) *
          ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + ι * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by
      dsimp [Prim_ι, Z_ι]
      rw [hζ_one, hζ_zero]
      ring
    have hexp_merge :
        Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) * Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) =
          Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hP_wr, hg0_eq, hg1_eq, hint_g, hPrim_diff]
    dsimp [C_scale]
    calc a₀ * (b₁ * Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ)))) *
          ((Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) *
            ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + ι * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)))
        = (a₀ * b₁ / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) *
            (Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) - S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) * Complex.exp (ι * S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
            ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + ι * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by ring
      _ = (a₀ * b₁ / ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3)) *
            Complex.exp ((ι / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
            ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + ι * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by
          rw [hexp_merge]

  let k_p : ℂ := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotPlus Q a₀ b₁) 1
  let k_m : ℂ := sfcaVolterraK (sfcaPotMinus Q a₀ b₁) 1
  have hk_p_eval : k_p =
      C_scale * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
        ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + (-Complex.I) * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by
    apply h_gauge_eval (-Complex.I) (sfcaPotPlus Q a₀ b₁) (Or.inl rfl)
    intro w hw
    dsimp [sfcaPotPlus]
    rw [hFieldF_eq w hw, hFieldFDeriv_eq w hw]
    ring
  have hk_m_eval : k_m =
      C_scale * Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
        ((S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1) + Complex.I * (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0)) := by
    apply h_gauge_eval Complex.I (sfcaPotMinus Q a₀ b₁) (Or.inr rfl)
    intro w hw
    dsimp [sfcaPotMinus]
    rw [hFieldF_eq w hw, hFieldFDeriv_eq w hw]
  let ΔΓ₀ : ℝ := (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0).re - (S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0).re
  let ΔΓ₁ : ℝ := (S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1).re - (S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1).re
  let L_chord : ℝ := Real.sqrt (ΔΓ₀ ^ 2 + ΔΓ₁ ^ 2)
  have hL_chord_nonneg : 0 ≤ L_chord := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hL_chord_sq : L_chord ^ 2 = ΔΓ₀ ^ 2 + ΔΓ₁ ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg ΔΓ₀) (sq_nonneg ΔΓ₁))
  have hkp_km : k_p * k_m = C_scale ^ 2 * ((L_chord ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hexp_cancel :
        Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
          Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) = 1 := by
      rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      have : (-Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) +
          (Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ)) = 0 := by ring
      rw [this, Complex.exp_zero]
    have hΔ0 : S.Γ (v : ℂ) 0 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 0 = (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ) :=
      (congr_arg₂ (· - ·) (hΓ_eq_re v 0) (hΓ_eq_re u 0)).trans (Complex.ofReal_sub _ _).symm
    have hΔ1 : S.Γ (v : ℂ) 1 - S.Γ (u : ℂ) 1 = (ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) :=
      (congr_arg₂ (· - ·) (hΓ_eq_re v 1) (hΓ_eq_re u 1)).trans (Complex.ofReal_sub _ _).symm
    have hnorm_sq :
        ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I) * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ)) * ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ)) =
          ((L_chord ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      calc ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I) * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ)) * ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ))
          = (ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) ^ 2 - Complex.I ^ 2 * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ) ^ 2 + (ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) ^ 2 := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        _ = ((ΔΓ₀ ^ 2 + ΔΓ₁ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_cast
        _ = ((L_chord ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hL_chord_sq]
    rw [hk_p_eval, hk_m_eval, hΔ0, hΔ1]
    calc (C_scale * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
            ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I) * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ))) *
          (C_scale * Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
            ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ)))
        = C_scale ^ 2 *
            (Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ))) *
              Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * (S.ϕ (v : ℂ) + S.ϕ (u : ℂ)))) *
            (((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I) * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ)) *
              ((ΔΓ₁ : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ΔΓ₀ : ℂ))) := by ring
      _ = C_scale ^ 2 * ((L_chord ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hexp_cancel, hnorm_sq]; ring

  let r : ℝ := L_chord / A_arc
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg hL_chord_nonneg hA_arc_pos.le
  have hratio_eq : k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2 = ((r ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hkp_km, hk₀_eval]
    change C_scale ^ 2 * ((L_chord ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) / (C_scale * (A_arc : ℂ)) ^ 2 =

    rw [Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_div]
    field_simp [hC_scale_ne, hA_arc_ne]
  have hUniv_q := (hUniv.div_and_slit Q hQ_cont hQ_rho).2 a₀ b₁ ha₀_rho hb₁_rho
  have hre_gt : 1 / 4 < (k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2).re := hUniv_q.1
  have hdiv_eq : a₀ * b₁ * sfcaDivH Q a₀ b₁ = sfcaNumN Q a₀ b₁ := hUniv_q.2.1

  have hr_ne_zero : r ≠ 0 := by

  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr_nonneg (Ne.symm hr_ne_zero)

    rw [hhalf, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log hr_pos]
  have hNum_eval : sfcaNumN Q a₀ b₁ =

    change k₀ * (1 - Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (k_p * k_m / k₀ ^ 2))) =

      _ = C_scale * ((A_arc * (1 - r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one]
      _ = C_scale * (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u v : ℂ) := by rw [hsga_eq]
  have hsc_pow : ((S.c * (v - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3 := by
    dsimp [h, h_r]
    push_cast
    ring
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha₀b₁_ne
  calc a₀ * b₁ * (((S.c * (v - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * sfcaStripPhi S ((u : ℂ), h))
      = ((S.c * (v - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (a₀ * b₁ * sfcaDivH Q a₀ b₁) := by
          rw [hPhi_eq]
          ring
    _ = ((S.c : ℂ) * h ^ 3) * (C_scale * (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u v : ℂ)) := by
          rw [hsc_pow, hdiv_eq, hNum_eval]
    _ = a₀ * b₁ * (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u v : ℂ) := by
          dsimp [C_scale]
          field_simp [hc_ne, h_ne]

      (S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)),

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x t ht_pos ht_lt hdom_m hdom_p s_m s_0 s_p J_m J_p
  have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := ht_pos.ne'
  have ht_ℂ_ne : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht_ne
  
  have hξ_strip : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (ξ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro ξ
    simp [horizStrip, S.H_pos]
  have hf_re_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re :=
    fun ξ => (S.f_real_pos ξ).1
  have hf_real : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (((S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) = S.f (ξ : ℂ) := by
    intro ξ
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp
    · simp [(S.f_real_pos ξ).2]
  have hf_ne : ∀ ξ : ℝ, S.f (ξ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro ξ h0
    have hpos := hf_re_pos ξ
    rw [h0] at hpos
    norm_num at hpos
  have hϕ_real : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (((S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) = S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ) := by
    intro ξ
    apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp
    have hc := S.ϕ_conj (ξ : ℂ) (hξ_strip ξ)
    rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hc
    exact hc.symm
  let g_arc : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => S.c / (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re ^ 2
  have hg_arc_cont : Continuous g_arc := by
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => S.f (ξ : ℂ)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal hξ_strip
    have hfre_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re) :=
      Complex.continuous_re.comp hf_cont
    exact continuous_const.div (hfre_cont.pow 2)
      (fun ξ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hf_re_pos ξ).ne')
  
  let X₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (S.Γ (ξ : ℂ) 0).re
  let X₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (S.Γ (ξ : ℂ) 1).re
  have hX₀_deriv : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt X₀ (-g_arc ξ * Real.sin (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re) ξ := by
    intro ξ
    have hΓ0 := (S.Γ_reg_holo (ξ : ℂ) (hξ_strip ξ) (hf_ne ξ)).1.hasDerivAt
    rw [S.Γ_deriv₀ (ξ : ℂ) (hξ_strip ξ) (hf_ne ξ)] at hΓ0
    have hr_ne : (((S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hf_re_pos ξ).ne'
    have hval : -(S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)) =
        ((-g_arc ξ * Real.sin (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      calc -(S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ))
          = -(S.c : ℂ) * (((S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
              Complex.sin (((S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            rw [hf_real ξ, hϕ_real ξ]
        _ = ((-g_arc ξ * Real.sin (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            dsimp only [g_arc]
            push_cast
            field_simp [hr_ne]
    rw [hval] at hΓ0
    have h1 := hΓ0.comp_ofReal
    have h2 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ξ h1
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, Complex.ofReal_re] at h2
    exact h2
  have hX₁_deriv : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt X₁ (g_arc ξ * Real.cos (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re) ξ := by
    intro ξ
    have hΓ1 := (S.Γ_reg_holo (ξ : ℂ) (hξ_strip ξ) (hf_ne ξ)).2.hasDerivAt
    rw [S.Γ_deriv₁ (ξ : ℂ) (hξ_strip ξ) (hf_ne ξ)] at hΓ1
    have hr_ne : (((S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hf_re_pos ξ).ne'
    have hval : (S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)) =
        ((g_arc ξ * Real.cos (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      calc (S.c : ℂ) * (S.f (ξ : ℂ))⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ))
          = (S.c : ℂ) * (((S.f (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
              Complex.cos (((S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            rw [hf_real ξ, hϕ_real ξ]
        _ = ((g_arc ξ * Real.cos (S.ϕ (ξ : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            dsimp only [g_arc]
            push_cast
            field_simp [hr_ne]
    rw [hval] at hΓ1
    have h1 := hΓ1.comp_ofReal
    have h2 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt ξ h1
    rw [Complex.reCLM_apply, Complex.ofReal_re] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht_pos.le]
    exact ht_lt
  have ht_ball : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star :=
    mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ht_norm
  have hhX_pos : 0 < S.h_X (t : ℂ) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds (t : ℂ) ht_ball).1
  have hp_tube : ∀ z : ℝ, ((z : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro z
    refine ⟨ht_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [Complex.conj_ofReal, hhX_pos]
    · simp [hhX_pos]
  have h𝔰_real : ∀ z : ℝ,
      (((S.𝔰 ((z : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).re : ℝ) : ℂ) = S.𝔰 ((z : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by
    intro z
    apply Complex.conj_eq_iff_re.mp
    have hc := S.𝔰_conj ((z : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) (hp_tube z)
    simpa [Complex.conj_ofReal] using hc.symm
  let u₀ : ℝ := s_m.re
  let v₀ : ℝ := s_0.re
  let w₀ : ℝ := s_p.re
  have hu₀_eq : (u₀ : ℂ) = s_m := by
    dsimp only [u₀, s_m]
    have harg : (((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by simp
    rw [← harg]
    exact h𝔰_real (x - t)
  have hv₀_eq : (v₀ : ℂ) = s_0 := h𝔰_real x
  have hw₀_eq : (w₀ : ℂ) = s_p := by
    dsimp only [w₀, s_p]
    have harg : (((x + t : ℝ) : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) := by simp
    rw [← harg]
    exact h𝔰_real (x + t)
  have hJm_eq : (((v₀ - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) = J_m := by
    dsimp only [J_m]
    push_cast
    rw [hu₀_eq, hv₀_eq]
  have hJp_eq : (((w₀ - v₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) = J_p := by
    dsimp only [J_p]
    push_cast
    rw [hv₀_eq, hw₀_eq]
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hstep_m, _, _, _, _, hℓ_m_pos, hΓm0_c, hΓm1_c, _⟩ :=
    S.real_collar_chord (x - t) t ht_pos ht_lt
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hstep_0, hθ_sum_raw, _, _, _, hℓ_0_pos, hΓ00_c, hΓ01_c, _⟩ :=
    S.real_collar_chord x t ht_pos ht_lt
  let θ_m : ℝ := (S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re
  let θ_0 : ℝ := (S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2, (t : ℂ))).re
  let ϕ_0 : ℝ := (S.ϕ (v₀ : ℂ)).re
  let ℓ_m : ℝ := S.ℓ_chord (x - t) t
  let ℓ_0 : ℝ := S.ℓ_chord x t
  have hxmt_add : ((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hxmt_half : ((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) / 2 = (x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) / 2 := by
    push_cast; ring
  have hxmt_eq : ((x - t : ℝ) : ℂ) = (x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hxmt_add, hxmt_eq] at hstep_m
  have hu₀_lt_v₀ : u₀ < v₀ := by
    dsimp only [u₀, v₀, s_m, s_0]
    linarith
  have hv₀_lt_w₀ : v₀ < w₀ := by
    dsimp only [v₀, w₀, s_0, s_p]
    linarith
  have hθ_sum : θ_m + θ_0 = 2 * ϕ_0 := by
    dsimp only [θ_m, θ_0, ϕ_0]
    rw [hv₀_eq]
    exact hθ_sum_raw
  have hcos_eq : Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0) = Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0) := by
    have hdiff : θ_0 - ϕ_0 = -(θ_m - ϕ_0) := by linarith
    rw [hdiff, Real.cos_neg]
  have hm0 : X₀ v₀ - X₀ u₀ = -ℓ_m * Real.sin θ_m := by
    rw [hxmt_add, hxmt_half, hxmt_eq] at hΓm0_c
    change S.Γ s_0 0 - S.Γ s_m 0 = -(ℓ_m : ℂ) * (Real.sin θ_m : ℂ) at hΓm0_c
    rw [← hv₀_eq, ← hu₀_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_neg, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] at hΓm0_c
    have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hΓm0_c
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
    exact hre
  have hm1 : X₁ v₀ - X₁ u₀ = ℓ_m * Real.cos θ_m := by
    rw [hxmt_add, hxmt_half, hxmt_eq] at hΓm1_c
    change S.Γ s_0 1 - S.Γ s_m 1 = (ℓ_m : ℂ) * (Real.cos θ_m : ℂ) at hΓm1_c
    rw [← hv₀_eq, ← hu₀_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] at hΓm1_c
    have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hΓm1_c
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
    exact hre
  have hp0 : X₀ w₀ - X₀ v₀ = -ℓ_0 * Real.sin θ_0 := by
    change S.Γ s_p 0 - S.Γ s_0 0 = -(ℓ_0 : ℂ) * (Real.sin θ_0 : ℂ) at hΓ00_c
    rw [← hw₀_eq, ← hv₀_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_neg, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] at hΓ00_c
    have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hΓ00_c
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
    exact hre
  have hp1 : X₁ w₀ - X₁ v₀ = ℓ_0 * Real.cos θ_0 := by
    change S.Γ s_p 1 - S.Γ s_0 1 = (ℓ_0 : ℂ) * (Real.cos θ_0 : ℂ) at hΓ01_c
    rw [← hw₀_eq, ← hv₀_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] at hΓ01_c
    have hre := congr_arg Complex.re hΓ01_c
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
    exact hre
  
  have hInt_m : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => ∫ ξ in u₀..v, g_arc ξ) (g_arc v₀) v₀ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
      (hg_arc_cont.intervalIntegrable u₀ v₀)
      (hg_arc_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds v₀))
      hg_arc_cont.continuousAt
  have hInt_p : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ ξ in u..w₀, g_arc ξ) (-g_arc v₀) v₀ := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ ξ in w₀..u, g_arc ξ) (g_arc v₀) v₀ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (hg_arc_cont.intervalIntegrable w₀ v₀)
        (hg_arc_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds v₀))
        hg_arc_cont.continuousAt
    have h2 := h1.neg
    have h_eq : (-fun u : ℝ => ∫ ξ in w₀..u, g_arc ξ) =
        (fun u : ℝ => ∫ ξ in u..w₀, g_arc ξ) := by
      ext u
      exact (intervalIntegral.integral_symm w₀ u).symm
    rwa [h_eq] at h2
  
  have hChord_m : HasDerivAt
      (fun v : ℝ => Real.sqrt ((X₀ v - X₀ u₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ v - X₁ u₀) ^ 2))
      (g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
    have hsub0 : HasDerivAt (fun v => X₀ v - X₀ u₀) (-g_arc v₀ * Real.sin ϕ_0) v₀ :=
      (hX₀_deriv v₀).sub_const (X₀ u₀)
    have hq0 : HasDerivAt (fun v => (X₀ v - X₀ u₀) ^ 2)
        (2 * (-ℓ_m * Real.sin θ_m) * (-g_arc v₀ * Real.sin ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, hm0, pow_one] using
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (X₀ v₀ - X₀ u₀)).comp v₀ hsub0
    have hsub1 : HasDerivAt (fun v => X₁ v - X₁ u₀) (g_arc v₀ * Real.cos ϕ_0) v₀ :=
      (hX₁_deriv v₀).sub_const (X₁ u₀)
    have hq1 : HasDerivAt (fun v => (X₁ v - X₁ u₀) ^ 2)
        (2 * (ℓ_m * Real.cos θ_m) * (g_arc v₀ * Real.cos ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, hm1, pow_one] using
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (X₁ v₀ - X₁ u₀)).comp v₀ hsub1
    have hQ : HasDerivAt (fun v => (X₀ v - X₀ u₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ v - X₁ u₀) ^ 2)
        (2 * ℓ_m * g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      convert hq0.add hq1 using 1
      rw [Real.cos_sub]
      ring
    have hQ_val : (X₀ v₀ - X₀ u₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ v₀ - X₁ u₀) ^ 2 = ℓ_m ^ 2 := by
      rw [hm0, hm1]
      calc (-ℓ_m * Real.sin θ_m) ^ 2 + (ℓ_m * Real.cos θ_m) ^ 2
          = ℓ_m ^ 2 * (Real.sin θ_m ^ 2 + Real.cos θ_m ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = ℓ_m ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]
        _ = ℓ_m ^ 2 := mul_one _
    have hQ_ne : (X₀ v₀ - X₀ u₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ v₀ - X₁ u₀) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hQ_val]
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 hℓ_m_pos.ne'
    have hsqrt := hQ.sqrt hQ_ne
    convert hsqrt using 1
    rw [hQ_val, Real.sqrt_sq hℓ_m_pos.le]
    have hne : ℓ_m ≠ 0 := hℓ_m_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hne]
    dsimp only [ℓ_m]
  have hArcChord_m : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => sgaRealArcMinusChord S u₀ v)
      (g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0))) v₀ := by
    have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => sgaRealArcMinusChord S u₀ v)
        (g_arc v₀ - g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) v₀ := hInt_m.sub hChord_m
    convert hsub using 1
    ring
  have hChord_p : HasDerivAt
      (fun u : ℝ => Real.sqrt ((X₀ w₀ - X₀ u) ^ 2 + (X₁ w₀ - X₁ u) ^ 2))
      (-g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
    have hsub0 : HasDerivAt (fun u => X₀ w₀ - X₀ u) (g_arc v₀ * Real.sin ϕ_0) v₀ := by
      simpa using (hX₀_deriv v₀).const_sub (X₀ w₀)
    have hq0 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (X₀ w₀ - X₀ u) ^ 2)
        (2 * (-ℓ_0 * Real.sin θ_0) * (g_arc v₀ * Real.sin ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, hp0, pow_one] using
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (X₀ w₀ - X₀ v₀)).comp v₀ hsub0
    have hsub1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => X₁ w₀ - X₁ u) (-g_arc v₀ * Real.cos ϕ_0) v₀ := by
      simpa [neg_mul] using (hX₁_deriv v₀).const_sub (X₁ w₀)
    have hq1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (X₁ w₀ - X₁ u) ^ 2)
        (2 * (ℓ_0 * Real.cos θ_0) * (-g_arc v₀ * Real.cos ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, hp1, pow_one] using
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (X₁ w₀ - X₁ v₀)).comp v₀ hsub1
    have hQ : HasDerivAt (fun u => (X₀ w₀ - X₀ u) ^ 2 + (X₁ w₀ - X₁ u) ^ 2)
        (-2 * ℓ_0 * g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0)) v₀ := by
      convert hq0.add hq1 using 1
      rw [Real.cos_sub]
      ring
    have hQ_val : (X₀ w₀ - X₀ v₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ w₀ - X₁ v₀) ^ 2 = ℓ_0 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hp0, hp1]
      calc (-ℓ_0 * Real.sin θ_0) ^ 2 + (ℓ_0 * Real.cos θ_0) ^ 2
          = ℓ_0 ^ 2 * (Real.sin θ_0 ^ 2 + Real.cos θ_0 ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = ℓ_0 ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]
        _ = ℓ_0 ^ 2 := mul_one _
    have hQ_ne : (X₀ w₀ - X₀ v₀) ^ 2 + (X₁ w₀ - X₁ v₀) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hQ_val]
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 hℓ_0_pos.ne'
    have hsqrt := hQ.sqrt hQ_ne
    convert hsqrt using 1
    rw [hQ_val, Real.sqrt_sq hℓ_0_pos.le]
    have hne : ℓ_0 ≠ 0 := hℓ_0_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hne]
    dsimp only [ℓ_0]
  have hArcChord_p : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => sgaRealArcMinusChord S u w₀)
      (-g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0))) v₀ := by
    have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => sgaRealArcMinusChord S u w₀)
        (-g_arc v₀ - -g_arc v₀ * Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0)) v₀ := hInt_p.sub hChord_p
    convert hsub using 1
    ring
  
  let V_m : Set ℝ :=
    Set.Ioi u₀ ∩
      (fun v : ℝ => ((u₀ : ℂ), ((v - u₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))) ⁻¹' (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL)
  have hVm_open : IsOpen V_m := by
    refine isOpen_Ioi.inter (hOpen.preimage ?_)
    exact continuous_const.prodMk
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
  have hv₀_Vm : v₀ ∈ V_m := by
    refine ⟨hu₀_lt_v₀, ?_⟩
    change ((u₀ : ℂ), ((v₀ - u₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL
    rw [Complex.ofReal_sub, hu₀_eq, hv₀_eq]
    exact hdom_m
  let g_m : ℂ → ℂ := fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_m J' (t : ℂ)
  have h_eq_Vm : ∀ v ∈ V_m,
      ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * g_m (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u₀ v : ℂ) := by
    intro v hv
    dsimp only [g_m, smallChordActionP]
    have h1 : (t : ℂ) * (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((v - u₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht_ℂ_ne
    have h2 : ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 =
        ((S.c * (v - u₀) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      field_simp [ht_ℂ_ne]
    rw [← mul_assoc, h2, h1, ← hu₀_eq]
    exact hGeom u₀ v hv.1 hv.2
  have htJm : (t : ℂ) * J_m = s_0 - s_m := mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht_ℂ_ne
  have hPhi_m_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sfcaStripPhi S) (s_m, (t : ℂ) * J_m) :=
    hHolo.differentiableAt (hOpen.mem_nhds (by rw [htJm]; exact hdom_m))
  have hpair_m : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => (s_m, (t : ℂ) * J')) J_m := by
    fun_prop
  have hJ_pow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 3) J_m := by
    fun_prop
  have hg_m_raw := hJ_pow.mul (hPhi_m_diff.comp J_m hpair_m)
  have hg_m_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ g_m J_m := hg_m_raw
  have hg_m_deriv : HasDerivAt g_m (deriv g_m J_m) (((v₀ - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [hJm_eq]
    exact hg_m_diff.hasDerivAt
  have hin_m_R : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (v - u₀) / t) t⁻¹ v₀ := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using ((hasDerivAt_id v₀).sub_const u₀).div_const t
  have hin_m : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ)) ((t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) v₀ :=
    hin_m_R.ofReal_comp
  have hcomp_m : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => g_m (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (((t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m) v₀ := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, smul_eq_mul] using HasDerivAt.scomp v₀ hg_m_deriv hin_m
  have hscaled_m := hcomp_m.const_mul ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hev_m :
      (fun v : ℝ => ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * g_m (((v - u₀) / t : ℝ) : ℂ)) =ᶠ[nhds v₀]
        (fun v : ℝ => (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u₀ v : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVm_open.mem_nhds hv₀_Vm) h_eq_Vm
  have h_eq_deriv_m_raw :
      ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m) =
        ((g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    (hscaled_m.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_m.symm).unique hArcChord_m.ofReal_comp
  have h_eq_deriv_m :
      ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m =
        ((g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hsimp : ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((t⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m) =
        ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m := by
      push_cast
      field_simp [ht_ℂ_ne]
    rwa [hsimp] at h_eq_deriv_m_raw
  
  let P_t : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) q.1 q.2 (t : ℂ)
  have htJp : (t : ℂ) * J_p = s_p - s_0 := mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht_ℂ_ne
  have hPhi_p_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sfcaStripPhi S) (s_0, (t : ℂ) * J_p) :=
    hHolo.differentiableAt (hOpen.mem_nhds (by rw [htJp]; exact hdom_p))
  have hpair_p : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.1, (t : ℂ) * q.2)) (s_0, J_p) := by
    fun_prop
  have hq2_pow : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ 3) (s_0, J_p) := by
    fun_prop
  have hP_raw := hq2_pow.mul (hPhi_p_diff.comp (s_0, J_p) hpair_p)
  have hP_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ P_t (s_0, J_p) := hP_raw
  let L : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fderiv ℂ P_t (s_0, J_p)
  have hP : HasFDerivAt P_t L (s_0, J_p) := hP_diff.hasFDerivAt
  have hdJ : deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s_0 J' (t : ℂ)) J_p =
      L (0, 1) := by
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (s_0, J')) (0, 1) J_p :=
      (hasDerivAt_const J_p s_0).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id J_p)
    exact (hP.comp_hasDerivAt J_p hp).deriv
  have hds : deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP (sfcaStripPhi S) s' J_p (t : ℂ)) s_0 =
      L (1, 0) := by
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℂ => (s', J_p)) (1, 0) s_0 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id s_0).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s_0 J_p)
    exact (hP.comp_hasDerivAt s_0 hp).deriv
  let γ_p : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun u => ((u : ℂ), (((w₀ - u) / t : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have hγ_eq : γ_p v₀ = (s_0, J_p) := Prod.ext hv₀_eq hJp_eq
  have h_u1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ)) 1 v₀ := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v₀).ofReal_comp
  have h_u2_R : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (w₀ - u) / t) (-t⁻¹) v₀ := by
    have hsub : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => w₀ - u) (-1) v₀ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id v₀).const_sub w₀
    simpa [neg_div, one_div] using hsub.div_const t
  have h_u2 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (((w₀ - u) / t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-(t : ℂ)⁻¹) v₀ := by
    simpa using h_u2_R.ofReal_comp
  have hγ_deriv : HasDerivAt γ_p (1, -(t : ℂ)⁻¹) v₀ := h_u1.prodMk h_u2
  have hP_R : HasFDerivAt P_t (L.restrictScalars ℝ) (γ_p v₀) := by
    rw [hγ_eq]
    exact hP.restrictScalars ℝ
  have hcomp_p_raw := hP_R.comp_hasDerivAt v₀ hγ_deriv
  have hL_val : (L.restrictScalars ℝ) (1, -(t : ℂ)⁻¹) = L (1, 0) - (t : ℂ)⁻¹ * L (0, 1) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars']
    have h_vec : ((1 : ℂ), -(t : ℂ)⁻¹) = (1, 0) - (t : ℂ)⁻¹ • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [h_vec, L.map_sub, L.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hcomp_p : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => P_t (γ_p u))
      (L (1, 0) - (t : ℂ)⁻¹ * L (0, 1)) v₀ := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, hL_val] using hcomp_p_raw
  
  let V_p : Set ℝ :=
    Set.Iio w₀ ∩
      (fun u : ℝ => ((u : ℂ), ((w₀ - u : ℝ) : ℂ))) ⁻¹' (smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL)
  have hVp_open : IsOpen V_p := by
    refine isOpen_Iio.inter (hOpen.preimage ?_)
    exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.prodMk
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
  have hv₀_Vp : v₀ ∈ V_p := by
    refine ⟨hv₀_lt_w₀, ?_⟩
    change ((v₀ : ℂ), ((w₀ - v₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL
    rw [Complex.ofReal_sub, hv₀_eq, hw₀_eq]
    exact hdom_p
  have h_eq_Vp : ∀ u ∈ V_p,
      ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P_t (γ_p u) =
        (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u w₀ : ℂ) := by
    intro u hu
    dsimp only [P_t, γ_p, smallChordActionP]
    have h1 : (t : ℂ) * (((w₀ - u) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((w₀ - u : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ ht_ℂ_ne
    have h2 : ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((w₀ - u) / t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 =
        ((S.c * (w₀ - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      push_cast
      field_simp [ht_ℂ_ne]
    rw [← mul_assoc, h2, h1]
    exact hGeom u w₀ hu.1 hu.2
  have hscaled_p := hcomp_p.const_mul ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hev_p :
      (fun u : ℝ => ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * P_t (γ_p u)) =ᶠ[nhds v₀]
        (fun u : ℝ => (sgaRealArcMinusChord S u w₀ : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hVp_open.mem_nhds hv₀_Vp) h_eq_Vp
  have h_eq_deriv_p_raw :
      ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (L (1, 0) - (t : ℂ)⁻¹ * L (0, 1)) =
        ((-g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_0 - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    (hscaled_p.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_p.symm).unique hArcChord_p.ofReal_comp
  have h_lhs_p :
      ((S.c * t ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (L (1, 0) - (t : ℂ)⁻¹ * L (0, 1)) =
        -(((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (L (0, 1) - (t : ℂ) * L (1, 0))) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp [ht_ℂ_ne]
    ring
  have h_eq_deriv_p :
      ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (L (0, 1) - (t : ℂ) * L (1, 0)) =
        ((g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [h_lhs_p, hcos_eq] at h_eq_deriv_p_raw
    have hrhs : ((-g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        -((g_arc v₀ * (1 - Real.cos (θ_m - ϕ_0)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [neg_mul, Complex.ofReal_neg]
    rw [hrhs] at h_eq_deriv_p_raw
    exact neg_inj.mp h_eq_deriv_p_raw
  have h_match :
      ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (L (0, 1) - (t : ℂ) * L (1, 0)) =
        ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * deriv g_m J_m :=
    h_eq_deriv_p.trans h_eq_deriv_m.symm
  have hct2_ne : ((S.c * t ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr
    have hc_pos : 0 < S.c * t ^ 2 := mul_pos S.c_pos (pow_pos ht_pos 2)
    exact hc_pos.ne'
  have h_cancel := mul_left_cancel₀ hct2_ne h_match
  rw [← hdJ, ← hds] at h_cancel
  exact h_cancel

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :
    ∀ H₁ : ℝ, 0 < H₁ → H₁ < S.H →
      ∃ (r_sub : ℝ) (J_m_tilde J_p_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_sub ∧ r_sub < S.r_star ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_m_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_p_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
          (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
          t * J_m_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y, t) - S.𝔰 (y - t, t) ∧
          t * J_p_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - S.𝔰 (y, t) ∧
          (S.𝔰 (y - t, t), t * J_m_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
          (S.𝔰 (y, t), t * J_p_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL ∧
          ‖J_m_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          ‖J_p_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :

      ∃ (r_sub : ℝ) (J_m_tilde J_p_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_sub ∧ r_sub < S.r_star ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_m_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ J_p_tilde (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) ∧
        ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro H₁ hH₁_pos hH₁_lt
  have hOpen_strip : ∀ B : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip B) :=
    fun B => isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  
  let H₂ : ℝ := (2 * H₁ + S.H) / 3
  let H₃ : ℝ := (H₁ + 2 * S.H) / 3
  have hH₁_lt_H₂ : H₁ < H₂ := by dsimp [H₂]; linarith
  have hH₂_lt_H₃ : H₂ < H₃ := by dsimp [H₂, H₃]; linarith
  have hH₃_lt_H : H₃ < S.H := by dsimp [H₃]; linarith
  have hH₂_lt_H : H₂ < S.H := lt_trans hH₂_lt_H₃ hH₃_lt_H
  have hH₂_pos : 0 < H₂ := lt_trans hH₁_pos hH₁_lt_H₂
  have hH₃_pos : 0 < H₃ := lt_trans hH₂_pos hH₂_lt_H₃
  have hgap_pos : 0 < H₂ - H₁ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨u_lsc, hu_open, hu_eq⟩ := lowerSemicontinuousOn_iff_preimage_Ioi.mp S.h_X_lsc H₃
  let V_lsc : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star ∩ S.h_X ⁻¹' Set.Ioi H₃
  have hV_open : IsOpen V_lsc := by
    change IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star ∩ S.h_X ⁻¹' Set.Ioi H₃)
    rw [hu_eq]
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter hu_open
  have h0_V : (0 : ℂ) ∈ V_lsc := by
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self S.r_star_pos, ?_⟩
    change H₃ < S.h_X 0
    rw [S.h_X_zero]
    exact hH₃_lt_H
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_open 0 h0_V
  let δ_lsc : ℝ := min δ₀ (S.r_star / 2)
  have hδ_lsc_pos : 0 < δ_lsc := lt_min hδ₀_pos (by linarith [S.r_star_pos])
  have hδ_lsc_le_δ₀ : δ_lsc ≤ δ₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_lsc_lt_r : δ_lsc < S.r_star := by
    have : δ_lsc ≤ S.r_star / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    linarith [S.r_star_pos]
  let U₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStrip H₃ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lsc
  have hU₃_tube : U₃ ⊆ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with ⟨hq1, hq2⟩
    have hzim : |q.1.im| < H₃ := hq1
    rw [abs_lt] at hzim
    have ht_norm : ‖q.2‖ < δ_lsc := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hq2
    have ht_V : q.2 ∈ V_lsc := hδ₀_sub (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_norm hδ_lsc_le_δ₀))
    have ht_conj_V : starRingEnd ℂ q.2 ∈ V_lsc := by
      apply hδ₀_sub
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, Complex.norm_conj]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht_norm hδ_lsc_le_δ₀
    have hh_t : H₃ < S.h_X q.2 := ht_V.2
    have hh_conj : H₃ < S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ q.2) := ht_conj_V.2
    exact ⟨lt_trans ht_norm hδ_lsc_lt_r, by linarith [hzim.1], by linarith [hzim.2]⟩

  
  let Δ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun z t => S.𝔰 (z, t) - z
  let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun z => dslope (Δ z) 0
  let W : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => dslope (g₁ q.1) 0 q.2
  have hW_fac : ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ horizStrip H₃ → ∀ t : ℂ, t ^ 2 * W (z, t) = Δ z t := by
    intro z hz t
    have hz_H : z ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_trans hz hH₃_lt_H
    have hΔ0 : Δ z 0 = 0 := by simp [Δ, S.𝔰_zero z hz_H]
    have hg₁0 : g₁ z 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [g₁, Δ]
      rw [dslope_same, deriv_sub_const, S.𝔰_deriv_t_zero z hz_H]
    have h1 := sub_smul_dslope (Δ z) 0 t
    simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hΔ0] at h1
    have h2 := sub_smul_dslope (g₁ z) 0 t
    simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hg₁0] at h2
    calc t ^ 2 * W (z, t) = t * (t * W (z, t)) := by ring
      _ = t * g₁ z t := by rw [h2]
      _ = Δ z t := h1

  
  have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => Δ q.1 q.2) U₃ :=
    (S.𝔰_holo.mono hU₃_tube).sub (differentiable_fst (𝕜 := ℂ)).differentiableOn
  have hΔ_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => Δ q.1 q.2) U₃ := hΔ_holo.continuousOn
  have hW_1d_holo : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip H₃,

            (fun q hq => (hKW_cont q hq).aestronglyMeasurable))
          (hKW_cont q₀ hq₀_V₀).continuousOn.intervalIntegrable
          hF'_meas
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ q hq =>
            h_cauchy_fderiv q₀ r M_int (fun q' => K_W q' θ) hr_pos hM_int_nn
              (hKW_holo θ) (fun q' hq' => hKW_bdd q' hq' θ) q hq))
          intervalIntegrable_const
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ q hq =>
            ((hKW_holo θ).differentiableAt
              (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hq))).hasFDerivAt))
      exact h_hasFDeriv.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact hInt_holo.const_mul (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)

  
  have hDerivF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    S.f_holo.deriv (hOpen_strip S.H)
  have hDerivF_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, deriv S.f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = deriv S.f s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' : s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip S.H := by simpa [horizStrip] using hs
    have hf_at : HasDerivAt S.f (deriv S.f (s + 2 * Real.pi)) (s + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      (S.f_holo.differentiableAt ((hOpen_strip S.H).mem_nhds hs')).hasDerivAt
    have h_sh : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w + 2 * Real.pi) 1 s :=
      (hasDerivAt_id s).add_const (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
    have h_comp : deriv (fun w : ℂ => S.f (w + 2 * Real.pi)) s = deriv S.f (s + 2 * Real.pi) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_one] using (hf_at.comp s h_sh).deriv
    have h_ev : (fun w : ℂ => S.f (w + 2 * Real.pi)) =ᶠ[nhds s] S.f :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hOpen_strip S.H).mem_nhds hs) (fun w hw => S.f_periodic w hw)
    rw [← h_comp, h_ev.deriv_eq]
  have h_mod_2pi : ∀ (B : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ s ∈ horizStrip B, Φ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Φ s) →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip B, ∃ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        Φ z = Φ ((x₀ : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro B Φ hΦ_per
    have h_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ horizStrip B →
        Φ (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = Φ s := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro s _; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro s hs
        have hs_n : s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip B := by
          simpa [horizStrip] using hs
        have h_step : s + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            (s + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_step, hΦ_per _ hs_n, ih s hs]
    have h_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (s : ℂ), s ∈ horizStrip B →
        Φ (s + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = Φ s := by
      intro k s hs
      rcases k with n | n
      · simpa using h_nat n s hs
      · set s' : ℂ := s + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        have hs' : s' ∈ horizStrip B := by simpa [s', horizStrip] using hs
        have h_back : s' + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = s := by
          simp only [s', Int.cast_negSucc]; push_cast; ring
        have h1 := h_nat (n + 1) s' hs'
        rw [h_back] at h1
        exact h1.symm
    intro z hz
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let k : ℤ := ⌊z.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x₀ : ℝ := z.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hx₀_nn : 0 ≤ x₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp (Int.floor_le (z.re / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [x₀]; linarith
    have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (z.re / (2 * Real.pi)))
      dsimp [x₀]; linarith
    set z₀ : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ horizStrip B := by simpa [z₀, horizStrip] using hz
    have hz_eq : z₀ + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = z := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [z₀, x₀]
    refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀_nn, hx₀_le⟩, ?_⟩
    change Φ z = Φ z₀
    rw [← hz_eq, h_int k z₀ hz₀]

  
  let R_H₂ : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H₂) H₂
  have hR_H₂_comp : IsCompact R_H₂ := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  let K_box : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ) := R_H₂ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (δ_lsc / 2)
  have hK_box_comp : IsCompact K_box := hR_H₂_comp.prod (isCompact_closedBall 0 (δ_lsc / 2))
  let ψ_W : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => ((p.1.1 : ℂ) + (p.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I, p.2)
  have hψ_W_cont : Continuous ψ_W := by fun_prop
  have hψ_W_maps : Set.MapsTo ψ_W K_box U_W := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨⟨_, hp_im_lo, hp_im_hi⟩, hp_t⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change |((p.1.1 : ℂ) + (p.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < H₃
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      rw [abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · exact mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp hp_t) hhalf_lt_rW)
  obtain ⟨C_W, hC_W⟩ :=
    hK_box_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hW_holo.continuousOn.comp hψ_W_cont.continuousOn hψ_W_maps)
  let M_W : ℝ := max C_W 1
  have hM_W_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_W := le_max_right _ _
  have hM_W_pos : 0 < M_W := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_W_ge_one
  have hW_sub_bound : ∀ z t : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ H₂ → ‖t‖ ≤ δ_lsc / 2 → ‖W (z, t)‖ ≤ M_W := by
    intro z t hz_im ht_le
    have hz_H₃ : z ∈ horizStrip H₃ := lt_of_le_of_lt hz_im hH₂_lt_H₃
    have ht_rW : t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_W :=
      mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt ht_le hhalf_lt_rW)
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hW_eq⟩ :=
      h_mod_2pi H₃ (fun s => W (s, t)) (fun s hs => hW_periodic s t ⟨hs, ht_rW⟩) z hz_H₃
    have hp_mem : ((x₀, z.im), t) ∈ K_box :=
      ⟨⟨hx₀, abs_le.mp hz_im⟩, mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr ht_le⟩
    rw [hW_eq]
    exact le_trans (hC_W ((x₀, z.im), t) hp_mem) (le_max_left _ _)

  let φ_s : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hφ_s_cont : Continuous φ_s := by fun_prop
  have hφ_s_maps : Set.MapsTo φ_s R_H₂ (horizStrip S.H) := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨_, hp_lo, hp_hi⟩
    change |(φ_s p).im| < S.H
    have him : (φ_s p).im = p.2 := by simp [φ_s]
    rw [him, abs_lt]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨C_f, hC_f⟩ := hR_H₂_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp hφ_s_cont.continuousOn hφ_s_maps)
  obtain ⟨C_df, hC_df⟩ := hR_H₂_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hDerivF_holo.continuousOn.comp hφ_s_cont.continuousOn hφ_s_maps)
  obtain ⟨C_q, hC_q⟩ := hR_H₂_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp hφ_s_cont.continuousOn hφ_s_maps)
  let M_field : ℝ := max (max C_f C_df) (max C_q 1)
  have hM_field_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_field := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hM_field_pos : 0 < M_field := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hM_field_ge_one
  have hField_bound : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H₂,
      ‖S.f s‖ ≤ M_field ∧ ‖deriv S.f s‖ ≤ M_field ∧ ‖S.q s‖ ≤ M_field := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_H : s ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_trans hs hH₂_lt_H
    have hs_im : s.im ∈ Set.Icc (-H₂) H₂ := abs_le.mp (le_of_lt hs)
    obtain ⟨xf, hxf, hf_eq⟩ := h_mod_2pi S.H S.f S.f_periodic s hs_H
    obtain ⟨xdf, hxdf, hdf_eq⟩ := h_mod_2pi S.H (deriv S.f) hDerivF_periodic s hs_H
    obtain ⟨xq, hxq, hq_eq⟩ := h_mod_2pi S.H S.q S.q_periodic s hs_H
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hf_eq]
      exact le_trans (hC_f (xf, s.im) ⟨hxf, hs_im⟩)
        (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
    · rw [hdf_eq]
      exact le_trans (hC_df (xdf, s.im) ⟨hxdf, hs_im⟩)
        (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
    · rw [hq_eq]
      exact le_trans (hC_q (xq, s.im) ⟨hxq, hs_im⟩)
        (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))

  
  have heta_pos : 0 < sfcaEtaSL := by norm_num [sfcaEtaSL]
  let r_sub : ℝ :=
    min (min (δ_lsc / 4) (S.r_star / 2))
      (min (min (H₂ - H₁) 1 / (64 * M_W)) (sfcaEtaSL / (4 * M_field)))
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_sub := by
    refine lt_min (lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith [S.r_star_pos]))
      (lt_min (div_pos (lt_min hgap_pos zero_lt_one) (by positivity)) (by positivity))
  have hr_lt : r_sub < S.r_star := by
    have : r_sub ≤ S.r_star / 2 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have hr_le_δ4 : r_sub ≤ δ_lsc / 4 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hr_MW_le : r_sub * M_W ≤ min (H₂ - H₁) 1 / 64 := by
    have h1 : r_sub ≤ min (H₂ - H₁) 1 / (64 * M_W) :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hM_W_pos.le
    have h_eq : min (H₂ - H₁) 1 / (64 * M_W) * M_W = min (H₂ - H₁) 1 / 64 := by
      field_simp [hM_W_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq] at h2
  have hr_MW_le_gap : r_sub * M_W ≤ (H₂ - H₁) / 64 :=
    le_trans hr_MW_le (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) (by norm_num))
  have hr_MW_le_inv64 : r_sub * M_W ≤ 1 / 64 :=
    le_trans hr_MW_le (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num))
  have hr_le_rMW : r_sub ≤ r_sub * M_W := by nlinarith
  have hr_le_gap : r_sub ≤ (H₂ - H₁) / 64 := le_trans hr_le_rMW hr_MW_le_gap
  have hr_le_inv64 : r_sub ≤ 1 / 64 := le_trans hr_le_rMW hr_MW_le_inv64
  have hr_Mf_le : r_sub * M_field ≤ sfcaEtaSL / 4 := by
    have h1 : r_sub ≤ sfcaEtaSL / (4 * M_field) :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hM_field_pos.le
    have h_eq : sfcaEtaSL / (4 * M_field) * M_field = sfcaEtaSL / 4 := by
      field_simp [hM_field_pos.ne']
    rwa [h_eq] at h2

  let shift_p : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1 + p.2, p.2)
  let shift_m : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1 - p.2, p.2)
  let J_m_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => 1 + p.2 * (W p - W (shift_m p))
  let J_p_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => 1 + p.2 * (W (shift_p p) - W p)
  let U₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub

  have h_shift_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      |y.im| < H₁ + (H₂ - H₁) / 64 ∧
      |(y + t).im| < H₁ + (H₂ - H₁) / 64 ∧
      |(y - t).im| < H₁ + (H₂ - H₁) / 64 := by
    intro y t hy ht
    have hy_im : |y.im| < H₁ := hy
    have ht_im : |t.im| < (H₂ - H₁) / 64 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm t) (lt_of_lt_of_le ht hr_le_gap)
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Complex.add_im]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
    · rw [Complex.sub_im]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_sub _ _) (by linarith)

  have h_pt_in_domains : ∀ z t : ℂ, |z.im| < H₁ + (H₂ - H₁) / 64 → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
      z ∈ horizStrip H₂ ∧ z ∈ horizStrip H₃ ∧ (z, t) ∈ U_W ∧ (z, t) ∈ U₃ ∧
      (z, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧ ‖W (z, t)‖ ≤ M_W := by
    intro z t hzim ht
    have hz_H₂ : z ∈ horizStrip H₂ := by change |z.im| < H₂; linarith
    have hz_H₃ : z ∈ horizStrip H₃ := lt_trans hz_H₂ hH₂_lt_H₃
    have ht_half : ‖t‖ ≤ δ_lsc / 2 := by linarith
    have ht_rW : ‖t‖ < r_W := lt_of_le_of_lt ht_half hhalf_lt_rW
    have ht_δ : ‖t‖ < δ_lsc := lt_trans ht_rW hrW_lt_ρW |>.trans hρW_lt_δ
    have h_UW : (z, t) ∈ U_W := ⟨hz_H₃, mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ht_rW⟩
    have h_U₃ : (z, t) ∈ U₃ := ⟨hz_H₃, mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ht_δ⟩
    exact ⟨hz_H₂, hz_H₃, h_UW, h_U₃, hU₃_tube h_U₃, hW_sub_bound z t hz_H₂.le ht_half⟩

  have hU₁_sub_UW : U₁ ⊆ U_W := by
    intro p hp
    have ht : ‖p.2‖ < r_sub := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp.2
    exact (h_pt_in_domains p.1 p.2 (h_shift_im p.1 p.2 hp.1 ht).1 ht).2.2.1
  have hshift_p_maps : Set.MapsTo shift_p U₁ U_W := by
    intro p hp
    have ht : ‖p.2‖ < r_sub := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp.2
    exact (h_pt_in_domains (p.1 + p.2) p.2 (h_shift_im p.1 p.2 hp.1 ht).2.1 ht).2.2.1
  have hshift_m_maps : Set.MapsTo shift_m U₁ U_W := by
    intro p hp
    have ht : ‖p.2‖ < r_sub := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp.2
    exact (h_pt_in_domains (p.1 - p.2) p.2 (h_shift_im p.1 p.2 hp.1 ht).2.2 ht).2.2.1

  have hshift_p_diff : Differentiable ℂ shift_p :=
    ((differentiable_fst (𝕜 := ℂ)).add (differentiable_snd (𝕜 := ℂ))).prodMk
      (differentiable_snd (𝕜 := ℂ))
  have hshift_m_diff : Differentiable ℂ shift_m :=
    ((differentiable_fst (𝕜 := ℂ)).sub (differentiable_snd (𝕜 := ℂ))).prodMk
      (differentiable_snd (𝕜 := ℂ))
  have hW_0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ W U₁ := hW_holo.mono hU₁_sub_UW
  have hW_p_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => W (shift_p p)) U₁ :=
    hW_holo.comp hshift_p_diff.differentiableOn hshift_p_maps
  have hW_m_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => W (shift_m p)) U₁ :=
    hW_holo.comp hshift_m_diff.differentiableOn hshift_m_maps
  have hConst1_U₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun _ : ℂ × ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) U₁ :=
    differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)
  have hsnd_U₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) U₁ :=
    (differentiable_snd (𝕜 := ℂ)).differentiableOn
  have hJm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_m_tilde U₁ :=
    hConst1_U₁.add (hsnd_U₁.mul (hW_0_holo.sub hW_m_holo))
  have hJp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_p_tilde U₁ :=
    hConst1_U₁.add (hsnd_U₁.mul (hW_p_holo.sub hW_0_holo))

  
  have h_in_scd : ∀ s_a h_a : ℂ,
      s_a ∈ horizStrip H₂ → s_a + h_a ∈ horizStrip H₂ → ‖h_a‖ < 2 * r_sub →
      (s_a, h_a) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL := by
    intro s_a h_a hsa hsaha hha
    have hsa_H : s_a ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_trans hsa hH₂_lt_H
    have hsaha_H : s_a + h_a ∈ horizStrip S.H := lt_trans hsaha hH₂_lt_H
    have hha_le_one : ‖h_a‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hha2_lt : ‖h_a ^ 2‖ < 2 * r_sub := by
      calc ‖h_a ^ 2‖ = ‖h_a‖ * ‖h_a‖ := by rw [norm_pow, sq]
        _ ≤ ‖h_a‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hha_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖h_a‖ := mul_one _
        _ < 2 * r_sub := hha
    obtain ⟨hf_le, hdf_le, _⟩ := hField_bound s_a hsa
    have h_f_lt : ‖h_a * S.f s_a‖ < sfcaEtaSL := by
      calc ‖h_a * S.f s_a‖ = ‖h_a‖ * ‖S.f s_a‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖h_a‖ * M_field := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < (2 * r_sub) * M_field := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hha hM_field_pos
        _ = 2 * (r_sub * M_field) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (sfcaEtaSL / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_Mf_le (by norm_num)
        _ < sfcaEtaSL := by linarith
    have h_df_lt : ‖h_a ^ 2 * deriv S.f s_a‖ < sfcaEtaSL := by
      calc ‖h_a ^ 2 * deriv S.f s_a‖ = ‖h_a ^ 2‖ * ‖deriv S.f s_a‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖h_a ^ 2‖ * M_field := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdf_le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < (2 * r_sub) * M_field := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hha2_lt hM_field_pos
        _ = 2 * (r_sub * M_field) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (sfcaEtaSL / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_Mf_le (by norm_num)
        _ < sfcaEtaSL := by linarith
    refine ⟨hsa_H, hsaha_H, h_f_lt, h_df_lt, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with ⟨hw0, hw1⟩
    have hseg_H₂ : s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a ∈ horizStrip H₂ := by
      change |(s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a).im| < H₂
      have him : (s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a).im = (1 - w) * s_a.im + w * (s_a + h_a).im := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
        ring
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      have h1 : |s_a.im| < H₂ := hsa
      have h2 : |(s_a + h_a).im| < H₂ := hsaha
      rw [abs_lt] at h1 h2
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hw0 with rfl | hw_pos
      · simp [h1.1, h1.2]
      · constructor <;> nlinarith
    have hq_le : ‖S.q (s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a)‖ ≤ M_field := (hField_bound _ hseg_H₂).2.2
    calc ‖h_a ^ 2 * S.q (s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a)‖
        = ‖h_a ^ 2‖ * ‖S.q (s_a + (w : ℂ) * h_a)‖ := norm_mul _ _
      _ ≤ ‖h_a ^ 2‖ * M_field := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_le (norm_nonneg _)
      _ < (2 * r_sub) * M_field := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hha2_lt hM_field_pos
      _ = 2 * (r_sub * M_field) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * (sfcaEtaSL / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_Mf_le (by norm_num)
      _ < sfcaEtaSL := by linarith

  
  refine ⟨r_sub, J_m_tilde, J_p_tilde, hr_pos, hr_lt, hJm_holo, hJp_holo, ?_⟩
  intro y t hy ht
  obtain ⟨hy_sh, hyp_sh, hym_sh⟩ := h_shift_im y t hy ht
  obtain ⟨_, hy_H₃, _, _, hy_tube, hWy_le⟩ := h_pt_in_domains y t hy_sh ht
  obtain ⟨_, hyp_H₃, _, _, hyp_tube, hWyp_le⟩ := h_pt_in_domains (y + t) t hyp_sh ht
  obtain ⟨_, hym_H₃, _, _, hym_tube, hWym_le⟩ := h_pt_in_domains (y - t) t hym_sh ht
  have hs_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, z ∈ horizStrip H₃ → S.𝔰 (z, t) = z + t ^ 2 * W (z, t) := by
    intro z hz
    have h := hW_fac z hz t
    dsimp [Δ] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have h_lift_H₂ : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| < H₁ + (H₂ - H₁) / 64 →
      z ∈ horizStrip H₃ → ‖W (z, t)‖ ≤ M_W → S.𝔰 (z, t) ∈ horizStrip H₂ := by
    intro z hzim hz_H₃ hWz
    change |(S.𝔰 (z, t)).im| < H₂
    rw [hs_eq z hz_H₃, Complex.add_im]
    have htW : ‖t‖ * ‖W (z, t)‖ ≤ r_sub * M_W :=
      mul_le_mul ht.le hWz (norm_nonneg _) hr_pos.le
    have ht2W : ‖t ^ 2 * W (z, t)‖ ≤ (H₂ - H₁) / 64 := by
      calc ‖t ^ 2 * W (z, t)‖ = ‖t‖ * (‖t‖ * ‖W (z, t)‖) := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, sq, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ r_sub * (r_sub * M_W) :=
            mul_le_mul ht.le htW (by positivity) hr_pos.le
        _ ≤ ((H₂ - H₁) / 64) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul hr_le_gap (by linarith) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = (H₂ - H₁) / 64 := mul_one _
    have him_le : |(t ^ 2 * W (z, t)).im| ≤ (H₂ - H₁) / 64 :=
      le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) ht2W
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)

  have hs0_H₂ : S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip H₂ := h_lift_H₂ y hy_sh hy_H₃ hWy_le
  have hsp_H₂ : S.𝔰 (y + t, t) ∈ horizStrip H₂ := h_lift_H₂ (y + t) hyp_sh hyp_H₃ hWyp_le
  have hsm_H₂ : S.𝔰 (y - t, t) ∈ horizStrip H₂ := h_lift_H₂ (y - t) hym_sh hym_H₃ hWym_le

  have hJm_alg : t * J_m_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y, t) - S.𝔰 (y - t, t) := by
    rw [hs_eq y hy_H₃, hs_eq (y - t) hym_H₃]
    dsimp [J_m_tilde, shift_m]
    ring
  have hJp_alg : t * J_p_tilde (y, t) = S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - S.𝔰 (y, t) := by
    rw [hs_eq (y + t) hyp_H₃, hs_eq y hy_H₃]
    dsimp [J_p_tilde, shift_p]
    ring

  have hJm_close : ‖J_m_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16 := by
    have h_sub_eq : J_m_tilde (y, t) - 1 = t * (W (y, t) - W (y - t, t)) := by
      dsimp [J_m_tilde, shift_m]; ring
    rw [h_sub_eq, norm_mul]
    have h_diff : ‖W (y, t) - W (y - t, t)‖ ≤ 2 * M_W :=
      le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (by linarith)
    calc ‖t‖ * ‖W (y, t) - W (y - t, t)‖
        ≤ ‖t‖ * (2 * M_W) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff (norm_nonneg _)
      _ < r_sub * (2 * M_W) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * (r_sub * M_W) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * (1 / 64) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_MW_le_inv64 (by norm_num)
      _ < 1 / 16 := by norm_num

  have hJp_close : ‖J_p_tilde (y, t) - 1‖ < 1 / 16 := by
    have h_sub_eq : J_p_tilde (y, t) - 1 = t * (W (y + t, t) - W (y, t)) := by
      dsimp [J_p_tilde, shift_p]; ring
    rw [h_sub_eq, norm_mul]
    have h_diff : ‖W (y + t, t) - W (y, t)‖ ≤ 2 * M_W :=
      le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (by linarith)
    calc ‖t‖ * ‖W (y + t, t) - W (y, t)‖
        ≤ ‖t‖ * (2 * M_W) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff (norm_nonneg _)
      _ < r_sub * (2 * M_W) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * (r_sub * M_W) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * (1 / 64) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_MW_le_inv64 (by norm_num)
      _ < 1 / 16 := by norm_num

  have hJm_norm : ‖J_m_tilde (y, t)‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 := norm_le_norm_sub_add (J_m_tilde (y, t)) 1
    rw [norm_one] at h1
    linarith
  have hJp_norm : ‖J_p_tilde (y, t)‖ ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 := norm_le_norm_sub_add (J_p_tilde (y, t)) 1
    rw [norm_one] at h1
    linarith

  have hscd_m : (S.𝔰 (y - t, t), t * J_m_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL := by
    refine h_in_scd (S.𝔰 (y - t, t)) (t * J_m_tilde (y, t)) hsm_H₂ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hJm_alg, add_sub_cancel]
      exact hs0_H₂
    · calc ‖t * J_m_tilde (y, t)‖ = ‖t‖ * ‖J_m_tilde (y, t)‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖t‖ * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJm_norm (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < r_sub * 2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (by norm_num)
        _ = 2 * r_sub := by ring

  have hscd_p : (S.𝔰 (y, t), t * J_p_tilde (y, t)) ∈ smallChordDomain S sfcaEtaSL := by
    refine h_in_scd (S.𝔰 (y, t)) (t * J_p_tilde (y, t)) hs0_H₂ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hJp_alg, add_sub_cancel]
      exact hsp_H₂
    · calc ‖t * J_p_tilde (y, t)‖ = ‖t‖ * ‖J_p_tilde (y, t)‖ := norm_mul _ _
        _ ≤ ‖t‖ * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJp_norm (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < r_sub * 2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (by norm_num)
        _ = 2 * r_sub := by ring

  exact ⟨hy_tube, hyp_tube, hym_tube, hJm_alg, hJp_alg, hscd_m, hscd_p, hJm_close, hJp_close⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Phi Ω →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun z => Phi (z, q.2)) q.1) Ω ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun w => Phi (q.1, w)) q.2) Ω) ∧
    (∀ (H₁ r_sub : ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < H₁ → 0 < r_sub →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F₁ (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F₂ (horizStrip H₁ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub) →
      (∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_sub → F₁ ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = F₂ ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) →
      ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub → F₁ (y, t) = F₂ (y, t))

(∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_partial_1 : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Phi Ω →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun z => Phi (z, q.2)) q.1) Ω := by
    intro Ω Phi hOpen hPhi q₀ hq₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hOpen q₀ hq₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 4
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    let K₃ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ (3 * r)
    let K₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r)
    have hK₃_sub : K₃ ⊆ Ω :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [r]; linarith)).trans hε_sub
    have hK₂_sub_K₃ : K₂ ⊆ K₃ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
    have hK₂_sub : K₂ ⊆ Ω := hK₂_sub_K₃.trans hK₃_sub
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall q₀ (3 * r)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hPhi.continuousOn.mono hK₃_sub)
    let M : ℝ := max C₀ 0
    have hPhi_le_M : ∀ p ∈ K₃, ‖Phi p‖ ≤ M := fun p hp =>
      (hC₀ p hp).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hfderiv_le : ∀ p ∈ K₂, ‖fderiv ℂ Phi p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_K₃ : p ∈ K₃ := hK₂_sub_K₃ hp
      have hball_K₃ : Metric.ball p r ⊆ K₃ := by
        intro p' hp'
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hp ⊢
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp'
        linarith [dist_triangle p' p q₀]
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Phi (Metric.ball p r) (Metric.closedBall (Phi p) (2 * M)) := by
        intro p' hp'
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        calc ‖Phi p' - Phi p‖ ≤ ‖Phi p'‖ + ‖Phi p‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add (hPhi_le_M p' (hball_K₃ hp')) (hPhi_le_M p hp_K₃)
          _ = 2 * M := by ring
      exact Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball
        (hPhi.mono (hball_K₃.trans hK₃_sub)) hmaps hr
    let s_nhd : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball q₀ r
    have hs_nhds : s_nhd ∈ nhds q₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds q₀ hr
    let c : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun θ => (circleMap 0 r θ, 0)
    let κ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))⁻¹ * (circleMap 0 r θ)⁻¹
    have hc_cont : Continuous c := (continuous_circleMap 0 r).prodMk continuous_const
    have hcm_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap 0 r θ ≠ 0 := fun θ => circleMap_ne_center hr.ne'
    have hκ_cont : Continuous κ :=
      continuous_const.mul ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).inv₀ hcm_ne)
    have hcm_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖circleMap 0 r θ‖ = r := by
      intro θ
      rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hr]
    have hκ_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖κ θ‖ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * r⁻¹ := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [κ]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_inv, hcm_norm θ]
      congr 1
      have h2pi_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      calc ‖(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))‖⁻¹ = ‖((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)‖⁻¹ := by push_cast; rfl
        _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_nonneg]
    have h_slice_K₂ : ∀ q ∈ s_nhd, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall q.1 r, (ζ, q.2) ∈ K₂ := by
      intro q hq ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hζ ⊢
      have hd1 : dist (ζ, q.2) q ≤ r := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self]
        exact max_le hζ hr.le
      linarith [dist_triangle (ζ, q.2) q q₀]
    have h_add_c_eq : ∀ (q : ℂ × ℂ) (θ : ℝ), (circleMap q.1 r θ, q.2) = q + c θ := by
      intro q θ
      apply Prod.ext
      · change circleMap q.1 r θ = q.1 + circleMap 0 r θ
        linear_combination circleMap_sub_center q.1 r θ
      · simp [c]
    have h_add_c_K₂ : ∀ q ∈ s_nhd, ∀ θ : ℝ, q + c θ ∈ K₂ := by
      intro q hq θ
      rw [← h_add_c_eq q θ]
      refine h_slice_K₂ q hq (circleMap q.1 r θ) ?_
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap_sub_center, hcm_norm θ]
    have h_cauchy_eq : ∀ q ∈ s_nhd,
        deriv (fun z => Phi (z, q.2)) q.1 =
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), κ θ • Phi (q + c θ) := by
      intro q hq
      let U_q : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | (ζ, q.2) ∈ Ω }
      have hUq_open : IsOpen U_q := hOpen.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall q.1 r ⊆ U_q := fun ζ hζ =>
        hK₂_sub (h_slice_K₂ q hq ζ hζ)
      have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Phi (z, q.2)) U_q :=
        hPhi.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q.2)).differentiableOn
          (fun _ hζ => hζ)
      have h_cif :=
        (Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
          hUq_open hcb_sub hg_diff (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).symm
      rw [h_cif, circleIntegral_def_Icc, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      rw [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center, h_add_c_eq q θ]
      dsimp only [κ]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      have hne_cm : circleMap 0 r θ ≠ 0 := hcm_ne θ
      have hne_2pi : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)
      have hne_I : Complex.I ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
      field_simp [hne_cm, hne_2pi, hne_I]
    let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun q θ => κ θ • Phi (q + c θ)
    let F' : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun q θ => κ θ • fderiv ℂ Phi (q + c θ)
    let B : ℝ := ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * r⁻¹) * (2 * M / r)
    have hF_cont : ∀ q ∈ s_nhd, Continuous (F q) := by
      intro q hq
      refine hκ_cont.smul ?_
      exact hPhi.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.add hc_cont)
        (fun θ => hK₂_sub (h_add_c_K₂ q hq θ))
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀,
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F q)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem hs_nhds (fun q hq => ?_)
      exact ((hF_cont q hq).continuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIcc).mono_measure
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc le_rfl)
    have hFq₀_int : IntervalIntegrable (F q₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hF_cont q₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hF'q₀_meas :
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' q₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      have hm_fd : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun θ => fderiv ℂ Phi (q₀ + c θ))
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) :=
        ((measurable_fderiv ℂ Phi).comp
          (continuous_const.add hc_cont).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
      exact hκ_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable.smul hm_fd
    have hF'_bound : ∀ᵐ θ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, θ ∈ Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi) →
        ∀ q ∈ s_nhd, ‖F' q θ‖ ≤ B := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ q hq => ?_)
      dsimp only [F', B]
      rw [norm_smul, hκ_norm θ]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfderiv_le (q + c θ) (h_add_c_K₂ q hq θ)) (by positivity)
    have hB_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => B) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      intervalIntegrable_const
    have h_int_fderiv :=
      intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (F := F) (F' := F') hs_nhds hF_meas hFq₀_int hF'q₀_meas hF'_bound hB_int
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ q hq => by
          have h_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Phi (q + c θ) :=
            hPhi.differentiableAt (hOpen.mem_nhds (hK₂_sub (h_add_c_K₂ q hq θ)))
          have h_comp := h_at.hasFDerivAt.comp q ((hasFDerivAt_id q).add_const (c θ))
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at h_comp
          exact h_comp.const_smul (κ θ)))
    have h_ev :
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F q θ) =ᶠ[nhds q₀]
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun z => Phi (z, q.2)) q.1) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hs_nhds (fun q hq => (h_cauchy_eq q hq).symm)
    exact (h_int_fderiv.differentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev.symm).differentiableWithinAt
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Ω Phi hOpen hPhi
    refine ⟨h_partial_1 Ω Phi hOpen hPhi, ?_⟩
    let σ : (ℂ × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.prodComm ℂ ℂ ℂ
    let Ω' : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := σ ⁻¹' Ω
    have hΩ'_open : IsOpen Ω' := hOpen.preimage σ.continuous
    have hPsi : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Phi (σ p)) Ω' :=
      hPhi.comp σ.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
    have h1 := h_partial_1 Ω' (fun p => Phi (σ p)) hΩ'_open hPsi
    exact h1.comp σ.differentiable.differentiableOn (fun q hq => by simpa [Ω', σ] using hq)
  · intro H₁ r_sub F₁ F₂ hH₁ hr hF₁ hF₂ hReal
    let S₁ : Set ℂ := horizStrip H₁
    let B_t : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub
    have hStage1 : ∀ (x : ℝ), ∀ t ∈ B_t, F₁ ((x : ℂ), t) = F₂ ((x : ℂ), t) := by
      intro x t ht_mem
      have hx_S₁ : (x : ℂ) ∈ S₁ := by simpa [S₁, horizStrip] using hH₁
      have h_emb : Differentiable ℂ (fun τ : ℂ => ((x : ℂ), τ)) :=
        (differentiable_const (x : ℂ)).prodMk differentiable_id
      have h_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun τ : ℂ => ((x : ℂ), τ)) B_t (S₁ ×ˢ B_t) :=
        fun τ hτ => ⟨hx_S₁, hτ⟩
      have hg₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun τ => F₁ ((x : ℂ), τ)) B_t :=
        (hF₁.comp h_emb.differentiableOn h_maps).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hg₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun τ => F₂ ((x : ℂ), τ)) B_t :=
        (hF₂.comp h_emb.differentiableOn h_maps).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
      have hfreq_t : ∃ᶠ τ : ℂ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
          F₁ ((x : ℂ), τ) = F₂ ((x : ℂ), τ) := by
        rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
        intro V hV
        obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hV
        let t₀ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (r_sub / 2)
        have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
        have ht₀_lt_ε : t₀ < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
        have ht₀_lt_r : t₀ < r_sub := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
        refine ⟨(t₀ : ℂ), hε_sub ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hReal x t₀ ht₀_pos ht₀_lt_r⟩
        · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht₀_pos.le]
          exact ht₀_lt_ε
        · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht₀_pos.ne'
      exact hg₁_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hg₂_ana
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r_sub).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hr) hfreq_t ht_mem
    have hS₁_open : IsOpen S₁ :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hS₁_eq : S₁ = Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-H₁) H₁ := by
      ext s
      simp [S₁, horizStrip, abs_lt]
    have hS₁_preconn : IsPreconnected S₁ := by
      rw [hS₁_eq]
      exact ((convex_Ioo (-H₁) H₁).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).isPreconnected
    have h0_S₁ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ S₁ := by simpa [S₁, horizStrip] using hH₁
    intro y t hy ht
    have ht_mem : t ∈ B_t := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ht
    have h_emb_y : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, t)) :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)
    have h_maps_y : Set.MapsTo (fun z : ℂ => (z, t)) S₁ (S₁ ×ˢ B_t) :=
      fun z hz => ⟨hz, ht_mem⟩
    have hh₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => F₁ (z, t)) S₁ :=
      (hF₁.comp h_emb_y.differentiableOn h_maps_y).analyticOnNhd hS₁_open
    have hh₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => F₂ (z, t)) S₁ :=
      (hF₂.comp h_emb_y.differentiableOn h_maps_y).analyticOnNhd hS₁_open
    have hfreq_y : ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
        F₁ (z, t) = F₂ (z, t) := by
      rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
      intro V hV
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hV
      let x₀ : ℝ := ε / 2
      have hx₀_pos : 0 < x₀ := by positivity
      have hx₀_lt_ε : x₀ < ε := by dsimp [x₀]; linarith
      refine ⟨(x₀ : ℂ), hε_sub ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hStage1 x₀ t ht_mem⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hx₀_pos.le]
        exact hx₀_lt_ε
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx₀_pos.ne'
    exact hh₁_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hh₂_ana
      hS₁_preconn h0_S₁ hfreq_y hy
