proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hStage1 : FrozenCalculusProp ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, 3 * firstFieldG z + z * deriv firstFieldG z = 3 * firstFieldSinc z) ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, deriv firstFieldSinc z = -(z / 3) * firstFieldG z) := by
    have h_even_entire : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (C B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ C → 1 ≤ B →
        (∀ m : ℕ, ‖c m‖ ≤ C * B ^ m / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) →
        let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ (2 * m)
        let F' : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)
        Differentiable ℂ F ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, HasDerivAt F (F' z) z) ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * z ^ (2 * m))) ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1))) ∧
        F 0 = c 0 ∧
        deriv F 0 = 0 ∧
        (∀ (k z : ℂ), k * F z + z * deriv F z =
          ∑' m : ℕ, c m * (k + ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ)) * z ^ (2 * m)) := by
      intro c C B hC hB hc
      dsimp only
      have h_core : ∀ y : ℂ,
          Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * y ^ (2 * m)) ∧
          Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * y ^ (2 * m - 1)) ∧
          HasDerivAt (fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ (2 * m))
            (∑' m : ℕ, c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * y ^ (2 * m - 1)) y := by
        intro y
        let R : ℝ := ‖y‖ + 1
        have hR_ge_one : 1 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith [norm_nonneg y]
        have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR_ge_one
        have hBR_nonneg : 0 ≤ B * R := by positivity
        let t : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R
        have ht_open : IsOpen t := Metric.isOpen_ball
        have ht_pre : IsPreconnected t := (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R).isPreconnected
        have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ t := Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos
        have hy_mem : y ∈ t := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          dsimp [R]
          linarith
        have h_inj_even : Function.Injective (fun m : ℕ => 2 * m) := fun a b h => by
          dsimp at h; omega
        have h_inj_odd : Function.Injective (fun m : ℕ => 2 * m - 1) := fun a b h => by
          dsimp at h; omega
        have hu0_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ))) :=
          ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (B * R)).comp_injective h_inj_even).mul_left C
        have hu1_sum : Summable
            (fun m : ℕ => C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) / ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ))) :=
          ((Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (B * R)).comp_injective h_inj_odd).mul_left C
        have hg_bound : ∀ z ∈ t, ∀ m : ℕ,
            ‖c m * z ^ (2 * m)‖ ≤ C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ)) := by
          intro z hz m
          have hzR : ‖z‖ ≤ R := le_of_lt (by simpa [t] using hz)
          have hBm : B ^ m ≤ B ^ (2 * m) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (by omega)
          have hBRm : B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m) ≤ (B * R) ^ (2 * m) := by
            calc B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m)
                ≤ B ^ (2 * m) * R ^ (2 * m) :=
                  mul_le_mul hBm (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hzR _)
                    (by positivity) (by positivity)
              _ = (B * R) ^ (2 * m) := (mul_pow B R (2 * m)).symm
          have hfac : ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
          have hfac_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
          calc ‖c m * z ^ (2 * m)‖
              = ‖c m‖ * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m) := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
            _ ≤ (C * B ^ m / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc m) (by positivity)
            _ = C * (B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m)) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by ring
            _ ≤ C * (B * R) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
                gcongr
            _ ≤ C * (B * R) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hfac_pos hfac
            _ = C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m) / ((2 * m).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
        have hg'_deriv : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ t,
            HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => c m * w ^ (2 * m))
              (c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)) z := by
          intro m z _
          cases m with
          | zero =>
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_const z (c 0))
          | succ k =>
            have hp := (hasDerivAt_pow (2 * (k + 1)) z).const_mul (c (k + 1))
            simpa [mul_assoc] using hp
        have hg'_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ t,
            ‖c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)‖ ≤
              C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) / ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
          intro m z hz
          have hzR : ‖z‖ ≤ R := le_of_lt (by simpa [t] using hz)
          cases m with
          | zero =>
            simp [hC]
          | succ k =>
            set m := k + 1
            have hm_ge : 1 ≤ m := Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k)
            have hBm : B ^ m ≤ B ^ (2 * m - 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (by omega)
            have hBRm : B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1) ≤ (B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) := by
              calc B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1)
                  ≤ B ^ (2 * m - 1) * R ^ (2 * m - 1) :=
                    mul_le_mul hBm (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hzR _)
                      (by positivity) (by positivity)
                _ = (B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) := (mul_pow B R (2 * m - 1)).symm
            have hfac_nat : (2 * m) * (2 * m - 1).factorial ≤ (2 * m + 1).factorial := by
              have h1 : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
              have h2 : (2 * m) * (2 * m - 1).factorial = (2 * m).factorial := by
                conv_rhs => rw [← h1, Nat.factorial_succ, h1]
              rw [h2]
              exact Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
            have hfac_real : ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
                ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac_nat
            have hfac_div : ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
                1 / ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
              rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
              linarith
            calc ‖c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)‖
                = ‖c m‖ * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1) := by
                  rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
              _ ≤ (C * B ^ m / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) *
                    ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc m) (by positivity)) (by positivity)
              _ = C * (B ^ m * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1)) *
                    (((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
              _ ≤ C * (B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) * (1 / ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ)) :=
                  mul_le_mul
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBRm hC)
                    hfac_div (by positivity) (by positivity)
              _ = C * ((B * R) ^ (2 * m - 1) / ((2 * m - 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
        have hsum_y : Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * y ^ (2 * m)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu0_sum (hg_bound y hy_mem)
        have hsum_0 : Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu0_sum (hg_bound 0 h0_mem)
        have hsum_y' : Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * y ^ (2 * m - 1)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu1_sum fun m => hg'_bound m y hy_mem
        have hderiv := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu1_sum ht_open ht_pre
          hg'_deriv hg'_bound h0_mem hsum_0 hy_mem
        exact ⟨hsum_y, hsum_y', hderiv⟩
      have hF_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ (2 * m)) :=
        fun y => (h_core y).2.2.differentiableAt
      have hF_zero : (∑' m : ℕ, c m * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) = c 0 := by
        rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
        · simp
        · intro m hm
          have h2m : 2 * m ≠ 0 := by omega
          simp [zero_pow h2m]
      have hF'_zero : deriv (fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 0 := by
        rw [(h_core 0).2.2.deriv]
        convert tsum_zero with m
        cases m with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k =>
          have h2m : 2 * (k + 1) - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
          simp [zero_pow h2m]
      refine ⟨hF_diff, fun z => (h_core z).2.2, fun z => (h_core z).1,
        fun z => (h_core z).2.1, hF_zero, hF'_zero, ?_⟩
      intro k z
      rw [(h_core z).2.2.deriv, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left,
        ← ((h_core z).1.mul_left k).tsum_add ((h_core z).2.1.mul_left z)]
      congr 1
      ext m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp; ring
      | succ n =>
        have hexp : 1 + (2 * (n + 1) - 1) = 2 * (n + 1) := by omega
        calc k * (c (n + 1) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1))) +
                z * (c (n + 1) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1) - 1))
            = k * c (n + 1) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1)) +
                c (n + 1) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z ^ 1 * z ^ (2 * (n + 1) - 1)) := by ring
          _ = k * c (n + 1) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1)) +
                c (n + 1) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1)) := by
              rw [← pow_add, hexp]
          _ = c (n + 1) * (k + ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ)) * z ^ (2 * (n + 1)) := by ring

    let c_sinc : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_gF : ℕ → ℂ := fun m =>
      6 * (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_sinhc : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => 1 / ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_gQ : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => 6 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_HF : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_KF : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m / ((2 * m + 2).factorial : ℂ)
    let c_HQ : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)
    let H_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_HF m * z ^ (2 * m)
    let K_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_KF m * z ^ (2 * m)
    let H_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_HQ m * z ^ (2 * m)

    have hsinc_eq : firstFieldSinc = fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_sinc m * z ^ (2 * m) := by
      ext z; unfold firstFieldSinc; congr 1; ext m; dsimp [c_sinc]; ring
    have hgF_eq : firstFieldG = fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_gF m * z ^ (2 * m) := by
      ext z; unfold firstFieldG; congr 1; ext m; dsimp [c_gF]; ring
    have hsinhc_eq : secondFieldSinhc = fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_sinhc m * z ^ (2 * m) := by
      ext z; unfold secondFieldSinhc; congr 1; ext m; dsimp [c_sinhc]; ring
    have hgQ_eq : secondFieldGNum = fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_gQ m * z ^ (2 * m) := by
      ext z; unfold secondFieldGNum; congr 1; ext m; dsimp [c_gQ]; ring

    have h_sinc := h_even_entire c_sinc 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_sinc]
      rw [norm_div, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
      simp
    have h_gF := h_even_entire c_gF 3 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_gF]
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow,
        Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have hfac : (2 * (m + 1)) * (2 * m + 1).factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
        have h1 : (2 * m + 3).factorial = (2 * m + 3) * (2 * m + 2) * (2 * m + 1).factorial := by
          have ha : 2 * m + 3 = (2 * m + 2) + 1 := by omega
          have hb : 2 * m + 2 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 := by omega
          rw [ha, Nat.factorial_succ, hb, Nat.factorial_succ]
          ring
        rw [h1]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by nlinarith)
      have hfac_r : (2 : ℝ) * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
          ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h_sinhc := h_even_entire c_sinhc 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_sinhc]
      rw [norm_div, norm_one, Complex.norm_natCast]
      simp
    have h_gQ := h_even_entire c_gQ 1 4 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_gQ]
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_ofNat,
        Complex.norm_natCast, one_mul]
      have hfac : 6 * (2 * m + 1).factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
        have h1 : (2 * m + 3).factorial = (2 * m + 3) * (2 * m + 2) * (2 * m + 1).factorial := by
          have ha : 2 * m + 3 = (2 * m + 2) + 1 := by omega
          have hb : 2 * m + 2 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 := by omega
          rw [ha, Nat.factorial_succ, hb, Nat.factorial_succ]
          ring
        rw [h1]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by nlinarith)
      have hfac_r : (6 : ℝ) * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hfac
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4) m]
    have h_HF := h_even_entire c_HF 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_HF]
      rw [norm_div, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_one]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one (by positivity)
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega))
    have h_KF := h_even_entire c_KF 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_KF]
      rw [norm_div, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_one]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one (by positivity)
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_le (by omega))
    have h_HQ := h_even_entire c_HQ 1 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun m => by
      dsimp [c_HQ]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_natCast, one_pow, mul_one]
      have hfac : (2 * m + 2) * (2 * m + 1).factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
        have h1 : (2 * m + 2) * (2 * m + 1).factorial = (2 * m + 2).factorial :=
          (Nat.factorial_succ (2 * m + 1)).symm
        rw [h1]
        exact Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
      have hfac_r : ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℝ) ≤
          ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hfac
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      linarith

    have hsinc_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldSinc := hsinc_eq ▸ h_sinc.1
    have hgF_entire : Differentiable ℂ firstFieldG := hgF_eq ▸ h_gF.1
    have hsinhc_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldSinhc := hsinhc_eq ▸ h_sinhc.1
    have hgQ_entire : Differentiable ℂ secondFieldGNum := hgQ_eq ▸ h_gQ.1

    have hsinc_zero : firstFieldSinc 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hsinc_eq, h_sinc.2.2.2.2.1]; simp [c_sinc]
    have hgF_zero : firstFieldG 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hgF_eq, h_gF.2.2.2.2.1]; dsimp [c_gF]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have hsinhc_zero : secondFieldSinhc 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hsinhc_eq, h_sinhc.2.2.2.2.1]; simp [c_sinhc]
    have hgQ_zero : secondFieldGNum 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hgQ_eq, h_gQ.2.2.2.2.1]; dsimp [c_gQ]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have hHQ_zero : H_Q 0 = 1 / 3 := by
      change (fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, c_HQ m * z ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 1 / 3
      rw [h_HQ.2.2.2.2.1]; dsimp [c_HQ]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]

    have hfac_succ_cast :
        ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1).factorial : ℂ) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (n.factorial : ℂ) := by
      intro n; rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; rfl

    have h_ode_HF : ∀ z : ℂ, 3 * H_F z + z * deriv H_F z = K_F z := by
      intro z
      rw [h_HF.2.2.2.2.2.2 3 z]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_HF, c_KF]
      have h1 : (2 * m + 3).factorial = (2 * m + 2 + 1).factorial := rfl
      rw [h1, hfac_succ_cast (2 * m + 2)]
      have hne : ((2 * m + 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hnum : (3 : ℂ) + ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((2 * m + 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hnum]
      field_simp [hne]

    have h_ode_KF : ∀ z : ℂ, 2 * K_F z + z * deriv K_F z = firstFieldSinc z := by
      intro z
      rw [h_KF.2.2.2.2.2.2 2 z, hsinc_eq]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_KF, c_sinc]
      have h1 : (2 * m + 2).factorial = (2 * m + 1 + 1).factorial := rfl
      rw [h1, hfac_succ_cast (2 * m + 1)]
      have hne : ((2 * m + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hnum : (2 : ℂ) + ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((2 * m + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hnum]
      field_simp [hne]

    have h_KF_sub_HF : ∀ z : ℂ, K_F z - H_F z = (1 / 3 : ℂ) * firstFieldG z := by
      intro z
      dsimp [K_F, H_F]
      rw [← (h_KF.2.2.1 z).tsum_sub (h_HF.2.2.1 z), hgF_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_KF, c_HF, c_gF]
      have h1 : (2 * m + 3).factorial = (2 * m + 2 + 1).factorial := rfl
      rw [h1, hfac_succ_cast (2 * m + 2)]
      have hne1 : ((2 * m + 2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hne2 : ((2 * m + 2).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [hne1, hne2]
      push_cast
      ring

    have h_ode_gF : ∀ z : ℂ, 3 * firstFieldG z + z * deriv firstFieldG z = 3 * firstFieldSinc z := by
      intro z
      rw [hgF_eq, h_gF.2.2.2.2.2.2 3 z, hsinc_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_gF, c_sinc]
      have h1 : ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) =
          ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
        have ha : 2 * m + 3 = (2 * m + 2) + 1 := by omega
        have hb : 2 * m + 2 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 := by omega
        rw [ha, Nat.factorial_succ, hb, Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h1]
      have hne1 : ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hne2 : ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hne3 : ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [hne1, hne2, hne3]
      push_cast
      ring

    have h_deriv_sinc : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv firstFieldSinc z = -(z / 3) * firstFieldG z := by
      intro z
      rw [hsinc_eq, (h_sinc.2.1 z).deriv]
      dsimp only
      have hhs := (h_sinc.2.2.2.1 z).hasSum
      have hshift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hhs
      simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.cast_zero,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hshift
      rw [← hshift.tsum_eq, hgF_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_sinc, c_gF]
      have hexp1 : 2 * (m + 1) - 1 = 2 * m + 1 := by omega
      have hexp2 : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
      rw [hexp1, hexp2, pow_succ (-1 : ℂ) m, pow_succ z (2 * m)]
      push_cast
      ring

    have h_ode_HQ : ∀ z : ℂ, 3 * H_Q z + z * deriv H_Q z = secondFieldSinhc z := by
      intro z
      rw [h_HQ.2.2.2.2.2.2 3 z, hsinhc_eq]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_HQ, c_sinhc]
      have h1 : ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) =
          ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
        have ha : 2 * m + 3 = (2 * m + 2) + 1 := by omega
        have hb : 2 * m + 2 = (2 * m + 1) + 1 := by omega
        rw [ha, Nat.factorial_succ, hb, Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h1]
      have hne1 : ((2 * m + 3 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hne2 : ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      have hne3 : ((2 * m + 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [hne1, hne2, hne3]
      push_cast
      ring

    have h_ode_sinhc :
        ∀ z : ℂ, secondFieldSinhc z + z * deriv secondFieldSinhc z = Complex.cosh z := by
      intro z
      calc secondFieldSinhc z + z * deriv secondFieldSinhc z
          = 1 * secondFieldSinhc z + z * deriv secondFieldSinhc z := by ring
        _ = Complex.cosh z := by
            rw [hsinhc_eq, h_sinhc.2.2.2.2.2.2 1 z, Complex.cosh_eq_tsum]
            congr 1; ext m
            dsimp [c_sinhc]
            rw [hfac_succ_cast (2 * m)]
            have hne1 : ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
            have hne2 : ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
              Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
            field_simp [hne1, hne2]
            push_cast
            ring

    have hsinc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * firstFieldSinc z = Complex.sin z := by
      intro z
      rw [hsinc_eq, ← tsum_mul_left, Complex.sin_eq_tsum]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_sinc]
      rw [pow_succ z (2 * m)]
      ring

    have hsinhc_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z * secondFieldSinhc z = Complex.sinh z := by
      intro z
      rw [hsinhc_eq, ← tsum_mul_left, Complex.sinh_eq_tsum]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [c_sinhc]
      rw [pow_succ z (2 * m)]
      ring

    have hgF_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 3 * firstFieldG z = 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z) := by
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z ^ 3 * firstFieldG z - 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z)
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ z : ℂ, HasDerivAt φ 0 z := by
        intro z
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 3 * firstFieldG w)
            ((3 : ℂ) * z ^ (3 - 1) * firstFieldG z + z ^ 3 * deriv firstFieldG z) z :=
          (hasDerivAt_pow 3 z).mul hgF_entire.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 3 * (Complex.sin w - w * Complex.cos w))
            (3 * (Complex.cos z - (1 * Complex.cos z + z * (-Complex.sin z)))) z :=
          (Complex.hasDerivAt_sin z |>.sub
            ((hasDerivAt_id z).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos z))).const_mul 3
        have hd := hd1.sub hd2
        have hzero : ((3 : ℂ) * z ^ (3 - 1) * firstFieldG z + z ^ 3 * deriv firstFieldG z) -
            3 * (Complex.cos z - (1 * Complex.cos z + z * (-Complex.sin z))) = 0 := by
          calc (3 : ℂ) * z ^ 2 * firstFieldG z + z ^ 3 * deriv firstFieldG z -
                3 * (Complex.cos z - (1 * Complex.cos z + z * (-Complex.sin z)))
              = z ^ 2 * (3 * firstFieldG z + z * deriv firstFieldG z) - 3 * z * Complex.sin z := by
                ring
            _ = z ^ 2 * (3 * firstFieldSinc z) - 3 * z * Complex.sin z := by rw [h_ode_gF z]
            _ = 3 * z * (z * firstFieldSinc z - Complex.sin z) := by ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hsinc_mul z, sub_self, mul_zero]
        exact hzero ▸ hd
      have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ Set.univ :=
        fun z _ => (hφ_deriv z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hφ_eq0 : Set.EqOn (deriv φ) 0 Set.univ := fun z _ => (hφ_deriv z).deriv
      intro z
      have hc := isOpen_univ.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isPreconnected_univ hφ_diff hφ_eq0
        (Set.mem_univ z) (Set.mem_univ 0)
      have h0 : φ 0 = 0 := by simp [φ]
      rw [h0] at hc
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc

    have hHQ_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, z ^ 3 * H_Q z = z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z := by
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => z ^ 3 * H_Q z - (z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z)
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ z : ℂ, HasDerivAt φ 0 z := by
        intro z
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 3 * H_Q w)
            ((3 : ℂ) * z ^ (3 - 1) * H_Q z + z ^ 3 * deriv H_Q z) z :=
          (hasDerivAt_pow 3 z).mul h_HQ.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w * Complex.cosh w - Complex.sinh w)
            ((1 * Complex.cosh z + z * Complex.sinh z) - Complex.cosh z) z :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id z).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cosh z)).sub (Complex.hasDerivAt_sinh z)
        have hd := hd1.sub hd2
        have hzero : ((3 : ℂ) * z ^ (3 - 1) * H_Q z + z ^ 3 * deriv H_Q z) -
            ((1 * Complex.cosh z + z * Complex.sinh z) - Complex.cosh z) = 0 := by
          calc (3 : ℂ) * z ^ 2 * H_Q z + z ^ 3 * deriv H_Q z -
                ((1 * Complex.cosh z + z * Complex.sinh z) - Complex.cosh z)
              = z ^ 2 * (3 * H_Q z + z * deriv H_Q z) - z * Complex.sinh z := by ring
            _ = z ^ 2 * secondFieldSinhc z - z * Complex.sinh z := by rw [h_ode_HQ z]
            _ = z * (z * secondFieldSinhc z - Complex.sinh z) := by ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hsinhc_mul z, sub_self, mul_zero]
        exact hzero ▸ hd
      have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ Set.univ :=
        fun z _ => (hφ_deriv z).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hφ_eq0 : Set.EqOn (deriv φ) 0 Set.univ := fun z _ => (hφ_deriv z).deriv
      intro z
      have hc := isOpen_univ.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isPreconnected_univ hφ_diff hφ_eq0
        (Set.mem_univ z) (Set.mem_univ 0)
      have h0 : φ 0 = 0 := by simp [φ]
      rw [h0] at hc
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc

    have hgQ_mul : ∀ z : ℂ,
        2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z = 3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z) := by
      intro z
      have hhs := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (Complex.hasSum_sinh (2 * z))
      simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.mul_zero, zero_add, pow_one,
        Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one] at hhs
      have hhs' := hhs.mul_left (3 / 2 : ℂ)
      have h_val : (3 / 2 : ℂ) * (Complex.sinh (2 * z) - 2 * z) =
          3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z) := by
        rw [Complex.sinh_two_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_val] at hhs'
      have h_lhs : HasSum
          (fun n : ℕ =>
            (3 / 2 : ℂ) * ((2 * z) ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1) / ((2 * (n + 1) + 1).factorial : ℂ)))
          (2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z) := by
        rw [hgQ_eq]
        have h_s := (h_gQ.2.2.1 z).hasSum.mul_left (2 * z ^ 3)
        refine h_s.congr_fun fun m => ?_
        dsimp [c_gQ]
        have hexp : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
        rw [hexp]
        have hpow : (2 * z) ^ (2 * m + 3) = 8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * z ^ (2 * m) * z ^ 3 := by
          rw [mul_pow, pow_add, pow_mul]
          norm_num
          ring
        rw [hpow]
        ring
      exact h_lhs.unique hhs'

    have h_Q_alg1 : ∀ z : ℂ,
        3 * (secondFieldSinhc z ^ 2 - H_Q z * Complex.cosh z) = 2 * secondFieldGNum z := by
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z = 0
      · subst hz
        rw [hsinhc_zero, hHQ_zero, Complex.cosh_zero, hgQ_zero]
        norm_num
      · have hz3 : z ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hz
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hz3
        calc z ^ 3 * (3 * (secondFieldSinhc z ^ 2 - H_Q z * Complex.cosh z))
            = 3 * (z * (z * secondFieldSinhc z) ^ 2 - (z ^ 3 * H_Q z) * Complex.cosh z) := by ring
          _ = 3 * (z * Complex.sinh z ^ 2 -
                (z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z) * Complex.cosh z) := by
              rw [hsinhc_mul z, hHQ_mul z]
          _ = 3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z -
                z * (Complex.cosh z ^ 2 - Complex.sinh z ^ 2)) := by ring
          _ = 3 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z) := by
              rw [Complex.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq z, mul_one]
          _ = 2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z := (hgQ_mul z).symm
          _ = z ^ 3 * (2 * secondFieldGNum z) := by ring

    have h_Q_alg2 : ∀ z : ℂ,
        secondFieldSinhc z * Complex.cosh z - z * H_Q z * Complex.sinh z =
          secondFieldSinhc z ^ 2 := by
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z = 0
      · subst hz
        rw [hsinhc_zero, Complex.cosh_zero, Complex.sinh_zero]
        ring
      · have hz2 : z ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hz
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hz2
        calc z ^ 2 * (secondFieldSinhc z * Complex.cosh z - z * H_Q z * Complex.sinh z)
            = z * (z * secondFieldSinhc z) * Complex.cosh z -
                (z ^ 3 * H_Q z) * Complex.sinh z := by ring
          _ = z * Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z -
                (z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z) * Complex.sinh z := by
              rw [hsinhc_mul z, hHQ_mul z]
          _ = Complex.sinh z ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (z * secondFieldSinhc z) ^ 2 := by rw [hsinhc_mul z]
          _ = z ^ 2 * secondFieldSinhc z ^ 2 := by ring

    have hlin_lam : ∀ lam J : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => lam * w / 2) (lam / 2) J := by
      intro lam J
      have h := ((hasDerivAt_id J).const_mul lam).div_const 2
      rwa [mul_one] at h

    have hpF_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        frozenActionP .firstField lam J = (J ^ 3 / 4) * H_F (lam * J / 2) := by
      intro lam J
      unfold frozenActionP
      dsimp [H_F, c_HF]
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      have h2 : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) = 4 * (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) := by
        rw [pow_add]; norm_num; ring
      rw [h2, div_pow, mul_pow, pow_add J (2 * m) 3]
      have h2ne : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      have hfne : ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [h2ne, hfne]

    have hpF_deriv : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        HasDerivAt (frozenActionP .firstField lam)
          ((J ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2)) J := by
      intro lam J
      have hlin := hlin_lam lam J
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => H_F (lam * w / 2))
          (deriv H_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) J :=
        HasDerivAt.comp J h_HF.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt hlin
      have hprod : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w ^ 3 / 4) * H_F (lam * w / 2))
          (((3 : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1) / 4) * H_F (lam * J / 2) +
            (J ^ 3 / 4) * (deriv H_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2))) J :=
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 J).div_const 4).mul hcomp
      have h_eq_fn : frozenActionP .firstField lam = fun w => (w ^ 3 / 4) * H_F (lam * w / 2) := by
        ext w; exact hpF_eq lam w
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      have h_val : ((3 : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1) / 4) * H_F (lam * J / 2) +
          (J ^ 3 / 4) * (deriv H_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) =
          (J ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2) := by
        calc ((3 : ℂ) * J ^ 2 / 4) * H_F (lam * J / 2) +
              (J ^ 3 / 4) * (deriv H_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2))
            = (J ^ 2 / 4) *
                (3 * H_F (lam * J / 2) + (lam * J / 2) * deriv H_F (lam * J / 2)) := by ring
          _ = (J ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2) := by rw [h_ode_HF (lam * J / 2)]
      exact h_val ▸ hprod

    have hpF_deriv2 : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        HasDerivAt (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam))
          ((J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2)) J := by
      intro lam J
      have h_eq_fn : deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam) =
          fun w => (w ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * w / 2) := by
        ext w; exact (hpF_deriv lam w).deriv
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      have hlin := hlin_lam lam J
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => K_F (lam * w / 2))
          (deriv K_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) J :=
        HasDerivAt.comp J h_KF.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt hlin
      have hprod : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * w / 2))
          (((2 : ℂ) * J ^ (2 - 1) / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2) +
            (J ^ 2 / 4) * (deriv K_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2))) J :=
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 J).div_const 4).mul hcomp
      have h_val : ((2 : ℂ) * J ^ (2 - 1) / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2) +
          (J ^ 2 / 4) * (deriv K_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) =
          (J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2) := by
        calc ((2 : ℂ) * J ^ 1 / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2) +
              (J ^ 2 / 4) * (deriv K_F (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2))
            = (J / 4) *
                (2 * K_F (lam * J / 2) + (lam * J / 2) * deriv K_F (lam * J / 2)) := by ring
          _ = (J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2) := by rw [h_ode_KF (lam * J / 2)]
      exact h_val ▸ hprod

    have henergy_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        frozenEnergyE .firstField lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * firstFieldG (lam * J / 2) := by
      intro lam J
      unfold frozenEnergyE
      rw [(hpF_deriv lam J).deriv, hpF_eq lam J]
      calc J * ((J ^ 2 / 4) * K_F (lam * J / 2)) - (J ^ 3 / 4) * H_F (lam * J / 2)
          = (J ^ 3 / 4) * (K_F (lam * J / 2) - H_F (lam * J / 2)) := by ring
        _ = (J ^ 3 / 4) * ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * firstFieldG (lam * J / 2)) := by
            rw [h_KF_sub_HF (lam * J / 2)]
        _ = (J ^ 3 / 12) * firstFieldG (lam * J / 2) := by ring

    have htwist_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J =
          (J / 4) * firstFieldSinc (lam * J / 2) :=
      fun lam J => (hpF_deriv2 lam J).deriv

    have hpQ_eq : ∀ lam J : ℂ,
        frozenActionP .secondField lam J =
          ((J ^ 3 / 8) * H_Q (lam * J / 2)) / Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) := by
      intro lam J
      unfold frozenActionP
      dsimp [H_Q, c_HQ]
      congr 1
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      have h4 : (4 : ℂ) ^ m = (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) := by
        rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
      rw [h4, div_pow, mul_pow, pow_add J (2 * m) 3]
      have h2ne : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
      have hfne : ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [h2ne, hfne]

    have hpQ_deriv : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
        HasDerivAt (frozenActionP .secondField lam)
          ((1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J * secondFieldSinhc (lam * J / 2) / Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2)) ^ 2) J := by
      intro lam J hcosh
      have h_eq_fn : frozenActionP .secondField lam =
          fun w => ((w ^ 3 / 8) * H_Q (lam * w / 2)) / Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) := by
        ext w; exact hpQ_eq lam w
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      have hlin := hlin_lam lam J
      have hnum_comp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => H_Q (lam * w / 2))
          (deriv H_Q (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) J :=
        HasDerivAt.comp J h_HQ.1.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt hlin
      have hnum : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w ^ 3 / 8) * H_Q (lam * w / 2))
          (((3 : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1) / 8) * H_Q (lam * J / 2) +
            (J ^ 3 / 8) * (deriv H_Q (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2))) J :=
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 3 J).div_const 8).mul hnum_comp
      have hden : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2))
          (Complex.sinh (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) J := by
        have hc : HasDerivAt Complex.cosh (Complex.sinh (lam * J / 2)) (lam * J / 2) :=
          Complex.hasDerivAt_cosh (lam * J / 2)
        exact hc.comp J hlin
      have hquot := hnum.div hden hcosh
      set z : ℂ := lam * J / 2
      have h_val :
          ((((3 : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1) / 8) * H_Q z + (J ^ 3 / 8) * (deriv H_Q z * (lam / 2))) *
              Complex.cosh z -
            ((J ^ 3 / 8) * H_Q z) * (Complex.sinh z * (lam / 2))) /
            Complex.cosh z ^ 2 =
          (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J * secondFieldSinhc z / Complex.cosh z) ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (((3 : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1) / 8) * H_Q z + (J ^ 3 / 8) * (deriv H_Q z * (lam / 2))) *

            ((J ^ 3 / 8) * H_Q z) * (Complex.sinh z * (lam / 2)) =
            (J ^ 2 / 8) * ((3 * H_Q z + z * deriv H_Q z) * Complex.cosh z -
              z * H_Q z * Complex.sinh z) := by
          dsimp [z]; ring
        rw [h1, h_ode_HQ z, h_Q_alg2 z]
        field_simp [hcosh]
      exact h_val ▸ hquot

    have hpQ_deriv2 : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →
        HasDerivAt (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam))
          ((J * secondFieldSinhc (lam * J / 2)) / (4 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 3)) J := by
      intro lam J hcosh
      let U : Set ℂ := { w : ℂ | Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ≠ 0 }

        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU_open.mem_nhds hcosh) fun w hw => (hpQ_deriv lam w hw).deriv
      have hlin := hlin_lam lam J
      have h_sinhc_comp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => secondFieldSinhc (lam * w / 2))

        HasDerivAt.comp J hsinhc_entire.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt hlin
      have h_u_num : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w * secondFieldSinhc (lam * w / 2))
          (1 * secondFieldSinhc (lam * J / 2) +

        (hasDerivAt_id J).mul h_sinhc_comp

        have hc : HasDerivAt Complex.cosh (Complex.sinh (lam * J / 2)) (lam * J / 2) :=

        have hsq : Complex.cosh z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z * Complex.sinh z = 1 := by

          (1 / Complex.cosh z ^ 2) J := h_u_simp ▸ h_u

      have h_sq_val :

            (((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (J * secondFieldSinhc z / Complex.cosh z) ^ (2 - 1) *

          (J * secondFieldSinhc z) / (4 * Complex.cosh z ^ 3) := by
        push_cast
        field_simp [hcosh]
        ring
      exact (h_sq_val ▸ h_sq).congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev

    have henergy_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 →

          intro w _

        have hlip := hs_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le

        have hg_diff : g J₁ - g J₂ = -(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (J₁ - J₂) := by

        rw [hg_diff, norm_mul, norm_neg] at hlip

            exact hval ▸ hd_sub
          have hlin14 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => (1 / 4 : ℂ) * y) (1 / 4 : ℂ) w := by

        have hlip := hs_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
          hg_deriv hg_bound hJ₂_mem hJ₁_mem
        have hg_diff : g J₁ - g J₂ = -(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (J₁ - J₂) := by
          dsimp [g]; rw [hE_eq]; ring

    exact ⟨{

            ‖(c m : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m)‖ ≤ C * (q ^ 2) ^ m := by
          intro z hz m
          have hzR : ‖z‖ ≤ R := le_of_lt (by simpa using hz)
          calc ‖(c m : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m)‖
              = |c m| * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m) := by
                rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            _ ≤ (C * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m)) * R ^ (2 * m) :=
                mul_le_mul (hc m) (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hzR _)
                  (by positivity) (by positivity)
            _ = C * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) * R ^ (2 * m)) := by ring
            _ = C * (q ^ 2) ^ m := by rw [h_pow_q m]
        have hg'_deriv : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
            HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (c m : ℂ) * w ^ (2 * m))
              ((c m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)) z := by
          intro m z _
          cases m with
          | zero => simpa using (hasDerivAt_const z (c 0 : ℂ))
          | succ k =>
            have hp := (hasDerivAt_pow (2 * (k + 1)) z).const_mul (c (k + 1) : ℂ)
            simpa [mul_assoc] using hp
        have hg'_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
            ‖(c m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)‖ ≤
              (2 * C * R⁻¹) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 1 * (q ^ 2) ^ m) := by
          intro m z hz
          have hzR : ‖z‖ ≤ R := le_of_lt (by simpa using hz)
          cases m with
          | zero => simp
          | succ k =>
            set m := k + 1
            have hR_pow : R ^ (2 * m - 1) = R ^ (2 * m) * R⁻¹ := by
              have hexp : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
              calc R ^ (2 * m - 1)
                  = R ^ (2 * m - 1) * (R * R⁻¹) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hR_pos.ne', mul_one]
                _ = (R ^ (2 * m - 1) * R) * R⁻¹ := by ring
                _ = R ^ (2 * m - 1 + 1) * R⁻¹ := by rw [← pow_succ]
                _ = R ^ (2 * m) * R⁻¹ := by rw [hexp]
            calc ‖(c m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * m - 1)‖
                = |c m| * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖z‖ ^ (2 * m - 1) := by
                  rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                    Complex.norm_natCast]
              _ ≤ (C * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m)) * (2 * (m : ℝ)) * R ^ (2 * m - 1) := by
                  have hcast : ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (m : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
                  rw [hcast]
                  exact mul_le_mul
                    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hc m) (by positivity))
                    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hzR _)
                    (by positivity) (by positivity)
              _ = (2 * C * R⁻¹) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 1 * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) * R ^ (2 * m))) := by
                  rw [hR_pow, pow_one]; ring
              _ = (2 * C * R⁻¹) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 1 * (q ^ 2) ^ m) := by rw [h_pow_q m]
        have hsum_v : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (c m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu0 (hg_bound v hv_R)
        have hsum_r : Summable (fun m : ℕ => c m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) := by
          refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hu0 fun m => ?_
          have h := hg_bound v hv_R m
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real] at h
          rwa [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_norm]
        have hsum_0 : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (c m : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu0 (hg_bound 0 h0_R)
        have hsum_v' : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (c m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m - 1)) :=
          Summable.of_norm_bounded hu1 fun m => hg'_bound m v hv_R
        have hderiv := hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu1 Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R).isPreconnected hg'_deriv hg'_bound h0_R hsum_0 hv_R
        exact ⟨hsum_v, hsum_r, hsum_v', hderiv⟩
      have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m))
          (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
        fun v hv => (h_core v hv).2.2.2.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hF_zero : (∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) = c 0 := by
        rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
        · simp
        · intro m hm
          have h2m : 2 * m ≠ 0 := by omega
          simp [zero_pow h2m]
      have hF_even : ∀ v : ℂ,
          (∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * (-v) ^ (2 * m)) = ∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m) := by
        intro v; congr 1; ext m; rw [pow_mul, pow_mul, neg_sq]
      have hF_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < ρ →
          ((∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).im = 0 ∧
           (∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).re = ∑' m : ℕ, c m * r ^ (2 * m)) := by
        intro r _
        have heq : (∑' m : ℕ, (c m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) =
            (((∑' m : ℕ, c m * r ^ (2 * m)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [Complex.ofReal_tsum]
          congr 1; ext m; push_cast; rfl
        rw [heq]
        exact ⟨Complex.ofReal_im _, Complex.ofReal_re _⟩
      refine ⟨hF_holo, fun v hv => (h_core v hv).2.2.2, fun v hv => (h_core v hv).1,
        fun v hv => (h_core v hv).2.1, fun v hv => (h_core v hv).2.2.1,
        hF_zero, hF_even, hF_real, ?_⟩
      intro k v hv
      rw [(h_core v hv).2.2.2.deriv, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left,
        ← ((h_core v hv).1.mul_left k).tsum_add ((h_core v hv).2.2.1.mul_left v)]
      congr 1; ext m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp; ring
      | succ n =>
        have hexp : 1 + (2 * (n + 1) - 1) = 2 * (n + 1) := by omega
        calc k * ((c (n + 1) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1))) +
                v * ((c (n + 1) : ℂ) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1) - 1))
            = k * (c (n + 1) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1)) +
                (c (n + 1) : ℂ) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
                  (v ^ 1 * v ^ (2 * (n + 1) - 1)) := by ring
          _ = k * (c (n + 1) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1)) +
                (c (n + 1) : ℂ) * ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1)) := by
              rw [← pow_add, hexp]
          _ = ((c (n + 1) : ℂ) * (k + ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ))) * v ^ (2 * (n + 1)) := by ring

    have h_cauchy_comp : ∀ (a w : ℕ → ℝ),
        a 0 = 0 → (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m) → (∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ w k) →
        ∃ compCoeff : ℕ → ℝ,
          compCoeff 0 = w 0 ∧
          compCoeff 1 = w 1 * a 1 ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ compCoeff m) ∧
          (∀ (v A_v Φ_v : ℂ) (S_r : ℝ),
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (a m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) A_v →
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => a m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) S_r →
            HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (w k : ℂ) * A_v ^ k) Φ_v →
            Summable (fun k : ℕ => w k * S_r ^ k) →
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (compCoeff m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) Φ_v) := by
      intro a w ha0 ha_nonneg hw_nonneg
      let cauchyPow : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
        Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ → ℝ) (fun m => if m = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          (fun _ prev m => ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m, a ij.1 * prev ij.2) k
      have hcp_zero : ∀ m : ℕ, cauchyPow 0 m = if m = 0 then 1 else 0 := fun _ => rfl
      have hcp_succ : ∀ k m : ℕ,
          cauchyPow (k + 1) m =
            ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal m, a ij.1 * cauchyPow k ij.2 :=
        fun _ _ => rfl
      have hcp_nonneg : ∀ k m : ℕ, 0 ≤ cauchyPow k m := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => intro m; rw [hcp_zero]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
        | succ k ih =>
          intro m; rw [hcp_succ]
          exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (ha_nonneg ij.1) (ih ij.2)
      have hcp_vanish : ∀ k m : ℕ, m < k → cauchyPow k m = 0 := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => intro m hm; omega
        | succ k ih =>
          intro m hm; rw [hcp_succ]
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro ij hij
          have hij_sum : ij.1 + ij.2 = m := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
          by_cases h1 : ij.1 = 0
          · rw [h1, ha0, zero_mul]
          · rw [ih ij.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
      have hcp_1_1 : cauchyPow 1 1 = a 1 := by
        change cauchyPow (0 + 1) 1 = a 1
        rw [hcp_succ 0 1, Finset.sum_eq_single (1, 0)]
        · simp [hcp_zero]
        · intro ij hij hne
          have hsum : ij.1 + ij.2 = 1 := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
          have h2 : ij.2 ≠ 0 := by
            intro h20
            apply hne
            ext <;> omega
          simp [hcp_zero, h2]
        · intro hnot
          exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mpr rfl))
      let compCoeff : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), w k * cauchyPow k m
      have hcc_0 : compCoeff 0 = w 0 := by simp [compCoeff, hcp_zero]
      have hcc_1 : compCoeff 1 = w 1 * a 1 := by
        simp [compCoeff, Finset.sum_range_succ, hcp_zero, hcp_1_1]
      have hcc_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ compCoeff m := fun m =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => mul_nonneg (hw_nonneg k) (hcp_nonneg k m)
      refine ⟨compCoeff, hcc_0, hcc_1, hcc_nonneg, ?_⟩
      intro v A_v Φ_v S_r hA hSr hΦ hSw
      have h_pow_sum : ∀ k : ℕ,
          HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (cauchyPow k m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (A_v ^ k) ∧
          HasSum (fun m : ℕ => cauchyPow k m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) (S_r ^ k) := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero =>
          constructor
          · have heq : (fun m : ℕ => (cauchyPow 0 m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) =
                fun m : ℕ => if m = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0 := by
              ext m; rw [hcp_zero]; split_ifs with hm <;> simp [hm]
            rw [heq, pow_zero]
            exact hasSum_ite_eq 0 (1 : ℂ)
          · have heq : (fun m : ℕ => cauchyPow 0 m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) =
                fun m : ℕ => if m = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
              ext m; rw [hcp_zero]; split_ifs with hm <;> simp [hm]
            rw [heq, pow_zero]
            exact hasSum_ite_eq 0 (1 : ℝ)
        | succ k ih =>
          obtain ⟨ih_c, ih_r⟩ := ih
          let fc : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (a m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
          let gc : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (cauchyPow k m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
          let fr : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => a m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)
          let gr : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => cauchyPow k m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)
          have hfc_norm : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖fc m‖ = fr m := fun m => by
            dsimp [fc, fr]
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (ha_nonneg m)]
          have hgc_norm : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖gc m‖ = gr m := fun m => by
            dsimp [gc, gr]
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_nonneg (hcp_nonneg k m)]
          have hfc_s : Summable (fun m => ‖fc m‖) := by simpa [hfc_norm] using hSr.summable
          have hgc_s : Summable (fun m => ‖gc m‖) := by simpa [hgc_norm] using ih_r.summable
          have hfr_s : Summable (fun m => ‖fr m‖) := hSr.summable.norm
          have hgr_s : Summable (fun m => ‖gr m‖) := ih_r.summable.norm
          have hconv_c_sum : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
              ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fc ij.1 * gc ij.2) :=
            summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul (summable_mul_of_summable_norm hfc_s hgc_s)
          have hconv_r_sum : Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
              ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fr ij.1 * gr ij.2) :=
            summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul (summable_mul_of_summable_norm hfr_s hgr_s)
          have hconv_c_tsum := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm hfc_s hgc_s
          have hconv_r_tsum := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm hfr_s hgr_s
          have hterm_c : ∀ n : ℕ,
              (∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fc ij.1 * gc ij.2) =
                (cauchyPow (k + 1) n : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * n) := by
            intro n
            rw [hcp_succ, Complex.ofReal_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ij hij => ?_
            have hsum : ij.1 + ij.2 = n := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
            dsimp [fc, gc]
            push_cast
            calc (a ij.1 : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * ij.1) * ((cauchyPow k ij.2 : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * ij.2))
                = (a ij.1 : ℂ) * (cauchyPow k ij.2 : ℂ) * (v ^ (2 * ij.1) * v ^ (2 * ij.2)) := by
                  ring
              _ = (a ij.1 : ℂ) * (cauchyPow k ij.2 : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * n) := by
                  rw [← pow_add, ← Nat.mul_add, hsum]
          have hterm_r : ∀ n : ℕ,
              (∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fr ij.1 * gr ij.2) =
                cauchyPow (k + 1) n * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * n) := by
            intro n
            rw [hcp_succ, Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ij hij => ?_
            have hsum : ij.1 + ij.2 = n := Finset.HasAntidiagonal.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
            dsimp [fr, gr]
            calc a ij.1 * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * ij.1) * (cauchyPow k ij.2 * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * ij.2))
                = a ij.1 * cauchyPow k ij.2 * (‖v‖ ^ (2 * ij.1) * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * ij.2)) := by ring
              _ = a ij.1 * cauchyPow k ij.2 * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * n) := by
                  rw [← pow_add, ← Nat.mul_add, hsum]
          constructor
          · have hs1 : HasSum
                (fun n : ℕ => ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fc ij.1 * gc ij.2)
                (A_v ^ (k + 1)) := by
              have h := hconv_c_sum.hasSum
              rw [← hconv_c_tsum, hA.tsum_eq, ih_c.tsum_eq, ← pow_succ'] at h
              exact h
            exact hs1.congr_fun fun n => (hterm_c n).symm
          · have hs2 : HasSum
                (fun n : ℕ => ∑ ij ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, fr ij.1 * gr ij.2)
                (S_r ^ (k + 1)) := by
              have h := hconv_r_sum.hasSum
              rw [← hconv_r_tsum, hSr.tsum_eq, ih_r.tsum_eq, ← pow_succ'] at h
              exact h
            exact hs2.congr_fun fun n => (hterm_r n).symm
      let G : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun k m => ((w k * cauchyPow k m : ℝ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
      have hG_norm : ∀ k m : ℕ, ‖G k m‖ = w k * (cauchyPow k m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) := by
        intro k m
        dsimp [G]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw_nonneg k) (hcp_nonneg k m))]
        ring
      have hG_norm_nonneg : (0 : ℕ × ℕ → ℝ) ≤ fun p => ‖G p.1 p.2‖ :=
        fun _ => norm_nonneg _
      have hG_row_sum : ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖G k m‖) := by
        intro k
        simp_rw [hG_norm]
        exact (h_pow_sum k).2.summable.mul_left (w k)
      have hG_iter_sum : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ∑' m : ℕ, ‖G k m‖) := by
        have heq : (fun k : ℕ => ∑' m : ℕ, ‖G k m‖) = fun k : ℕ => w k * S_r ^ k := by
          ext k
          simp_rw [hG_norm, tsum_mul_left, (h_pow_sum k).2.tsum_eq]
        rwa [heq]
      have hG_prod_norm : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => ‖G p.1 p.2‖) :=
        (summable_prod_of_nonneg hG_norm_nonneg).mpr ⟨hG_row_sum, hG_iter_sum⟩
      have hG_prod : Summable (Function.uncurry G) := Summable.of_norm hG_prod_norm
      have hG_swap_norm : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => ‖G p.2 p.1‖) := hG_prod_norm.prod_symm
      have hG_swap_props :=
        (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => norm_nonneg (G p.2 p.1))).mp hG_swap_norm
      have hG_col_sum : ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => G k m) :=
        fun m => Summable.of_norm (hG_swap_props.1 m)
      have hG_row_sum_c : ∀ k : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => G k m) :=
        fun k => Summable.of_norm (hG_row_sum k)
      have hG_col_tsum_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∑' k : ℕ, G k m) :=
        Summable.of_norm_bounded hG_swap_props.2 fun m =>
          norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hG_swap_props.1 m)
      have hG_comm := hG_prod.tsum_comm' hG_row_sum_c hG_col_sum
      have h_col_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, (∑' k : ℕ, G k m) = (compCoeff m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m) := by
        intro m
        rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (m + 1))]
        · dsimp [compCoeff, G]
          rw [Complex.ofReal_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        · intro k hk
          rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk
          dsimp [G]
          rw [hcp_vanish k m (by omega), mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
      have h_row_eq : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑' m : ℕ, G k m) = (w k : ℂ) * A_v ^ k := by
        intro k
        have heq : (fun m : ℕ => G k m) =
            fun m : ℕ => (w k : ℂ) * ((cauchyPow k m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) := by
          ext m; dsimp [G]; push_cast; ring
        rw [heq, tsum_mul_left, (h_pow_sum k).1.tsum_eq]
      have h_res := hG_col_tsum_sum.hasSum
      simp_rw [h_col_eq] at h_res
      have h_val : (∑' m : ℕ, (compCoeff m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) = Φ_v := by
        simp_rw [← h_col_eq]
        rw [hG_comm]
        simp_rw [h_row_eq]
        exact hΦ.tsum_eq
      rwa [h_val] at h_res

    have h_exp_even : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (L : ℂ → ℂ),
        c 0 = 0 → 0 < c 1 → (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ c m) → 0 < ρ →
        (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (c m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (L v)) →
        ∃ p_even : ℕ → ℝ,
          p_even 0 = 1 ∧ p_even 1 = c 1 ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ p_even m) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ,
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (p_even m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (Complex.exp (L v))) := by
      intro c ρ L hc0 hc1 hc_nonneg hρ hL
      let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)
      have hw_nonneg : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ w k := fun k => by dsimp [w]; positivity
      obtain ⟨p_even, hp0, hp1, hp_nonneg, hp_sum⟩ := h_cauchy_comp c w hc0 hc_nonneg hw_nonneg
      have hp0' : p_even 0 = 1 := by rw [hp0]; simp [w]
      have hp1' : p_even 1 = c 1 := by rw [hp1]; simp [w]
      refine ⟨p_even, hp0', hp1', hp_nonneg, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      have hv_norm : (‖v‖ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v)]
        simpa using hv
      have hL_r_c := hL (‖v‖ : ℂ) hv_norm
      have hL_r : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => c m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) (L (‖v‖ : ℂ)).re := by
        have hre := Complex.reCLM.hasSum hL_r_c
        refine hre.congr_fun fun m => ?_
        change c m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m) = ((c m : ℂ) * (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).re
        have heq : (c m : ℂ) * (‖v‖ : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) = ((c m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; rfl
        rw [heq, Complex.ofReal_re]
      have hexp_c : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (w k : ℂ) * (L v) ^ k) (Complex.exp (L v)) := by
        rw [Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
        refine (NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (L v)).congr_fun fun k => ?_
        dsimp [w]; push_cast; ring
      have hexp_r : Summable (fun k : ℕ => w k * ((L (‖v‖ : ℂ)).re) ^ k) := by
        refine (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (L (‖v‖ : ℂ)).re).congr fun k => ?_
        dsimp [w]; ring
      exact hp_sum v (L v) (Complex.exp (L v)) (L (‖v‖ : ℂ)).re (hL v hv) hL_r hexp_c hexp_r

    have h_kaluza : ∀ (d : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ),
        d 0 = 1 → (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < d m) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (d m) ^ 2 ≤ d (m - 1) * d (m + 1)) →
        0 < ρ → (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → d m ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * d (m - 1)) →
        ∃ (β γ : ℕ → ℝ) (D B : ℂ → ℂ),
          β 0 = 0 ∧
          β 1 = d 1 ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ β m) ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, β m ≤ d m) ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, d m ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ (2 * m)) ∧
          (∀ v : ℂ, D v = ∑' m : ℕ, (d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) ∧
          (∀ v : ℂ, B v = ∑' m : ℕ, (β m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ B (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) ∧
          (∀ k : ℂ, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ,
            k * D v + v * deriv D v =
              ∑' m : ℕ, ((d m : ℂ) * (k + ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ))) * v ^ (2 * m)) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => (d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m))) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => (β m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m))) ∧
          D 0 = 1 ∧
          B 0 = 0 ∧
          (∀ v : ℂ, B (-v) = B v) ∧
          (∀ r : ℝ, |r| < ρ → (B (r : ℂ)).im = 0) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, (1 - B v) * D v = 1) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, ‖B v‖ < 1) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, 1 - B v ∈ Complex.slitPlane) ∧
          γ 0 = 0 ∧
          γ 1 = d 1 ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ γ m) ∧
          (∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ,
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (γ m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (-Complex.log (1 - B v))) := by
      intro d ρ hd0 hd_pos hd_log hρ hd_step
      have hd_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, d m ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ (2 * m) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => simp [hd0]
        | succ k ih =>
          calc d (k + 1)
              ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * d k := hd_step (k + 1) (by omega)
            _ ≤ ρ⁻¹ ^ 2 * ρ⁻¹ ^ (2 * k) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
            _ = ρ⁻¹ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by rw [← pow_add]; ring_nf
      have hd_ratio_step : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → d m / d (m - 1) ≤ d (m + 1) / d m := by
        intro m hm
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (hd_pos (m - 1)) (hd_pos m)]
        nlinarith [hd_log m hm]
      have hd_ratio_add : ∀ (i n : ℕ), 1 ≤ i →
          d i / d (i - 1) ≤ d (i + n) / d (i + n - 1) := by
        intro i n hi
        induction n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ n ih =>
          have hstep := hd_ratio_step (i + n) (by omega)
          have h1 : i + (n + 1) = i + n + 1 := by omega
          have hsub : i + n + 1 - 1 = i + n := by omega
          rw [h1, hsub]
          exact le_trans ih hstep
      have hd_ratio : ∀ i m : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ m → d i * d (m - 1) ≤ d m * d (i - 1) := by
        intro i m hi him
        have hdiv : d i / d (i - 1) ≤ d m / d (m - 1) := by
          have h := hd_ratio_add i (m - i) hi
          rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le him] at h
        rwa [div_le_div_iff₀ (hd_pos (i - 1)) (hd_pos (m - 1))] at hdiv

      let kStep : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ) := fun n =>
        Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ → ℝ) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
          (fun k prev m =>
            if m = k + 1 then d (k + 1) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, prev j * d (k + 1 - j)
            else prev m) n
      have hkStep_le : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → kStep n m = kStep m m := by
        intro m n hmn
        induction n with
        | zero =>
          have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
          subst hm0; rfl
        | succ k ih =>
          by_cases hmk : m = k + 1
          · subst hmk; rfl
          · have hle : m ≤ k := by omega
            change (if m = k + 1 then _ else kStep k m) = kStep m m
            simp only [hmk, ↓reduceIte]
            exact ih hle
      let β : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => kStep m m
      have hβ_zero : β 0 = 0 := rfl
      have hβ_rec : ∀ k : ℕ, β (k + 1) = d (k + 1) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, β j * d (k + 1 - j) := by
        intro k
        change (if k + 1 = k + 1 then d (k + 1) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, kStep k j * d (k + 1 - j)
          else kStep k (k + 1)) = _
        simp only [↓reduceIte]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        have hjk : j ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).2
        rw [hkStep_le j k hjk]
      have hβ_one : β 1 = d 1 := by
        change β (0 + 1) = d (0 + 1)
        rw [hβ_rec 0]
        have hemp : Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) 0 = ∅ := by decide
        rw [hemp, Finset.sum_empty, sub_zero]
      have hβ_conv : ∀ k : ℕ, (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 1 - j)) = d (k + 1) := by
        intro k
        have hsplit : Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1) = insert (k + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 k) := by
          ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega
        have hnot : k + 1 ∉ Finset.Icc 1 k := by simp
        rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_insert hnot, Nat.sub_self, hd0, mul_one, hβ_rec k]
        ring
      have hβ_bounds : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ β m ∧ β m ≤ d m := by
        intro m
        induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
        | _ m ih =>
          match m with
          | 0 => exact ⟨by rw [hβ_zero], by rw [hβ_zero, hd0]; norm_num⟩
          | 1 => exact ⟨by rw [hβ_one]; exact (hd_pos 1).le, by rw [hβ_one]⟩
          | k + 2 =>
            rw [hβ_rec (k + 1)]
            have hsum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 2 - j) :=
              Finset.sum_nonneg fun j hj => by
                have hlt : j < k + 2 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).2; omega
                exact mul_nonneg (ih j hlt).1 (hd_pos _).le
            have hsum_le : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 2 - j)) ≤ d (k + 2) := by
              have hmul : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 2 - j)) * d (k + 1) ≤
                  d (k + 2) * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 1 - j)) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
                obtain ⟨hj1, hjk⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj
                have hβj : 0 ≤ β j := (ih j (by omega)).1
                have hr := hd_ratio (k + 2 - j) (k + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
                have hsub1 : (k + 2) - 1 = k + 1 := by omega
                have hsub2 : (k + 2 - j) - 1 = k + 1 - j := by omega
                rw [hsub1, hsub2] at hr
                calc β j * d (k + 2 - j) * d (k + 1)
                    = β j * (d (k + 2 - j) * d (k + 1)) := by ring
                  _ ≤ β j * (d (k + 2) * d (k + 1 - j)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr hβj
                  _ = d (k + 2) * (β j * d (k + 1 - j)) := by ring
              rw [hβ_conv k] at hmul
              exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul (hd_pos (k + 1))
            exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

      have hd_abs : ∀ m : ℕ, |d m| ≤ 1 * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) := fun m => by
        rw [abs_of_pos (hd_pos m), one_mul]; exact hd_bound m
      have hβ_abs : ∀ m : ℕ, |β m| ≤ 1 * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) := fun m => by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hβ_bounds m).1, one_mul]
        exact le_trans (hβ_bounds m).2 (hd_bound m)
      have hD_calc := h_even_ball ρ 1 d hρ zero_le_one hd_abs
      have hB_calc := h_even_ball ρ 1 β hρ zero_le_one hβ_abs
      let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
      let B : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (β m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)

      have h_mul_inv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, (1 - B v) * D v = 1 := by
        intro v hv
        let β_tilde : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m = 0 then 1 else -β m
        have hbt_sum : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (β_tilde m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (1 - B v) := by
          have h1 : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => if m = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) 1 := hasSum_ite_eq 0 1
          have h2 := (hB_calc.2.2.1 v hv).hasSum
          refine (h1.sub h2).congr_fun fun m => ?_
          dsimp [β_tilde]
          split_ifs with hm
          · subst hm; simp [hβ_zero]
          · simp
        have hbt_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖(β_tilde m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)‖) := by
          refine (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp ?_
          have htail := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (hB_calc.2.2.2.1 v hv)
          refine htail.congr fun m => ?_
          have hbt_succ : β_tilde (m + 1) = -β (m + 1) := rfl
          rw [hbt_succ, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hβ_bounds (m + 1)).1]
        have hd_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖(d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)‖) := by
          refine (hD_calc.2.2.2.1 v hv).congr fun m => ?_
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hd_pos m)]
        have hprod := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_range_of_summable_norm hbt_norm hd_norm
        rw [← hbt_sum.tsum_eq]
        change (∑' m : ℕ, (β_tilde m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) *
            (∑' m : ℕ, (d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) = 1
        rw [hprod, tsum_eq_single 0]
        · simp [β_tilde, hd0]
        · intro m hm
          cases m with
          | zero => exact False.elim (hm rfl)
          | succ k =>
            have hcoeff :
                (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1 + 1),
                  (β_tilde j : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * j) *
                    ((d (k + 1 - j) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1 - j)))) =
                (((d (k + 1) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 1 - j)) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                  v ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
              have hfactor : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1 + 1),
                  (β_tilde j : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * j) *
                    ((d (k + 1 - j) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1 - j))) =
                    ((β_tilde j * d (k + 1 - j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
                intro j hj
                have hjk : j ≤ k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
                push_cast
                calc (β_tilde j : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * j) *
                      ((d (k + 1 - j) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1 - j)))
                    = (β_tilde j : ℂ) * (d (k + 1 - j) : ℂ) *
                        (v ^ (2 * j) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1 - j))) := by ring
                  _ = (β_tilde j : ℂ) * (d (k + 1 - j) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
                      rw [← pow_add, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hjk]
              rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hfactor, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Complex.ofReal_sum]
              congr 2
              have hrange : Finset.range (k + 1 + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1)) := by
                ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
              have h0_not : (0 : ℕ) ∉ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1) := by simp
              rw [hrange, Finset.sum_insert h0_not]
              have htail : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β_tilde j * d (k + 1 - j)) =
                  -(∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), β j * d (k + 1 - j)) := by
                rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
                refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
                have hj_ne : j ≠ 0 := by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1; omega
                simp [β_tilde, hj_ne]
              rw [htail]
              simp [β_tilde]
              ring
            rw [hcoeff, hβ_conv k, sub_self, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]

      have h_norm_B_aux : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ,
          let S_B : ℝ := ∑' m : ℕ, β m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)
          ‖B v‖ ≤ S_B ∧ 0 ≤ S_B ∧ S_B < 1 := by
        intro v hv
        dsimp only
        set r : ℝ := ‖v‖
        have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg v
        have hr_lt : |r| < ρ := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg hr_nonneg]
          simpa [r] using hv
        have hr_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact hr_lt
        have hB_re := (hB_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr_lt)
        have hD_re := (hD_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr_lt)
        set S_B : ℝ := ∑' m : ℕ, β m * r ^ (2 * m)
        set S_D : ℝ := ∑' m : ℕ, d m * r ^ (2 * m)
        have h_id_r := congrArg Complex.re (h_mul_inv (r : ℂ) hr_mem)
        simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.sub_im,
          Complex.one_im] at h_id_r
        change (1 - (B (r : ℂ)).re) * (D (r : ℂ)).re -
            (0 - (B (r : ℂ)).im) * (D (r : ℂ)).im = 1 at h_id_r
        have hB_im0 : (B (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := hB_re.1
        have hB_reS : (B (r : ℂ)).re = S_B := hB_re.2
        have hD_im0 : (D (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := hD_re.1
        have hD_reS : (D (r : ℂ)).re = S_D := hD_re.2
        rw [hB_im0, hD_im0, hB_reS, hD_reS] at h_id_r
        have hSD_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => d m * r ^ (2 * m)) := by
          simpa [r] using hD_calc.2.2.2.1 v hv
        have hSD_ge_one : 1 ≤ S_D := by
          have h0 := hSD_sum.le_tsum 0 fun m _ => mul_nonneg (hd_pos m).le (by positivity)
          simpa [hd0] using h0
        have hSB_nonneg : 0 ≤ S_B := tsum_nonneg fun m =>
          mul_nonneg (hβ_bounds m).1 (by positivity)
        have hSB_lt_one : S_B < 1 := by nlinarith
        have hnorm_le : ‖B v‖ ≤ S_B := by
          calc ‖B v‖
              ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖(β m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)‖ :=
                norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (by
                  refine (hB_calc.2.2.2.1 v hv).congr fun m => ?_
                  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                    abs_of_nonneg (hβ_bounds m).1])
            _ = S_B := by
                dsimp [S_B, r]
                congr 1; ext m
                rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                  abs_of_nonneg (hβ_bounds m).1]
        exact ⟨hnorm_le, hSB_nonneg, hSB_lt_one⟩

      have h_norm_B : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, ‖B v‖ < 1 :=
        fun v hv => lt_of_le_of_lt (h_norm_B_aux v hv).1 (h_norm_B_aux v hv).2.2
      have h_slit : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, 1 - B v ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
        intro v hv
        refine Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl ?_)
        have hre : (B v).re ≤ ‖B v‖ := Complex.re_le_norm (B v)
        have hlt := h_norm_B v hv
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
        linarith

      let w_log : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if k = 0 then 0 else 1 / (k : ℝ)
      have hw_log_nonneg : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ w_log k := by
        intro k; dsimp [w_log]; split_ifs <;> positivity
      obtain ⟨γ, hγ0_raw, hγ1_raw, hγ_nonneg, hγ_sum⟩ :=
        h_cauchy_comp β w_log hβ_zero (fun m => (hβ_bounds m).1) hw_log_nonneg
      have hγ0 : γ 0 = 0 := by rw [hγ0_raw]; simp [w_log]
      have hγ1 : γ 1 = d 1 := by rw [hγ1_raw, hβ_one]; simp [w_log]
      have h_neg_log : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ,
          HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (γ m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (-Complex.log (1 - B v)) := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨_, hSB_nonneg, hSB_lt⟩ := h_norm_B_aux v hv
        have hlog_c : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (w_log k : ℂ) * (B v) ^ k) (-Complex.log (1 - B v)) := by
          refine (Complex.hasSum_taylorSeries_neg_log (h_norm_B v hv)).congr_fun fun k => ?_
          cases k with
          | zero => simp [w_log]
          | succ n => dsimp [w_log]; push_cast; ring
        have hlog_r : Summable
            (fun k : ℕ => w_log k * (∑' m : ℕ, β m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m)) ^ k) := by
          refine Summable.of_norm_bounded
            (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hSB_nonneg hSB_lt) fun k => ?_
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (hw_log_nonneg k) (pow_nonneg hSB_nonneg k))]
          have hw_le_one : w_log k ≤ 1 := by
            cases k with
            | zero => simp [w_log]
            | succ n =>
              change (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1
              exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n) (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (pow_nonneg hSB_nonneg k) hw_le_one
        exact hγ_sum v (B v) (-Complex.log (1 - B v)) (∑' m : ℕ, β m * ‖v‖ ^ (2 * m))
          (hB_calc.2.2.1 v hv).hasSum (hB_calc.2.2.2.1 v hv).hasSum hlog_c hlog_r

      have hD_zero : D 0 = 1 := by
        change (fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (d m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 1
        rw [hD_calc.2.2.2.2.2.1, hd0]; norm_num
      have hB_zero : B 0 = 0 := by
        change (fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (β m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 0
        rw [hB_calc.2.2.2.2.2.1, hβ_zero]; norm_num

      exact ⟨β, γ, D, B, hβ_zero, hβ_one, fun m => (hβ_bounds m).1, fun m => (hβ_bounds m).2,
        hd_bound, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, hD_calc.1, hB_calc.1, hD_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
        hD_calc.2.2.1, hB_calc.2.2.1, hD_zero, hB_zero, hB_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,
        fun r hr => (hB_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr).1, h_mul_inv, h_norm_B, h_slit,
        hγ0, hγ1, hγ_nonneg, h_neg_log⟩

    exact ⟨h_even_ball, h_exp_even, h_kaluza⟩

  obtain ⟨h_even_ball, h_exp_even, h_kaluza⟩ := hStage2

  
  
  
  have hStage3 : Nonempty (ModelDiskInput .firstField) := by
    have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have hpi_gt_3 : (3 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
    let S_zeta : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2)
    let d_F : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2)) * S_zeta m

    have hS_sum : ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2)) := by
      intro m
      have h1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 * m + 2)) :=
        Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.mpr (by omega)
      have h2 := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h1
      exact h2.congr fun n => by push_cast; rfl

    have hS_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < S_zeta m := by
      intro m
      have hle := (hS_sum m).le_tsum 0 fun k _ => by positivity
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2) := by positivity
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h0 hle

    have hd_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < d_F m := fun m => mul_pos (by positivity) (hS_pos m)

    have hS_zero : S_zeta 0 = Real.pi ^ 2 / 6 := by
      have hshift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hasSum_zeta_two
      simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.cast_zero, ne_eq,
        OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, div_zero, sub_zero] at hshift
      dsimp [S_zeta]
      rw [← hshift.tsum_eq]
      congr 1; ext n; push_cast; rfl

    have hd_zero : d_F 0 = 1 := by
      dsimp [d_F]; rw [hS_zero]; field_simp [hpi_pos.ne']

    have hd_log : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (d_F m) ^ 2 ≤ d_F (m - 1) * d_F (m + 1) := by
      intro m hm
      have hS_cs : (S_zeta m) ^ 2 ≤ S_zeta (m - 1) * S_zeta (m + 1) := by
        let r_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2)
        let f_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * (m - 1) + 2)
        let g_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 2)
        have h_fin : ∀ N : ℕ,
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, r_fn n) ^ 2 ≤
              (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f_fn n) * (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, g_fn n) := by
          intro N
          refine Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul (Finset.range N)
            (fun n _ => by dsimp [f_fn]; positivity)
            (fun n _ => by dsimp [g_fn]; positivity)
            (fun n _ => ?_)
          dsimp [r_fn, f_fn, g_fn]
          have hexp : (2 * (m - 1) + 2) + (2 * (m + 1) + 2) = 2 * (2 * m + 2) := by omega
          have h_eq : (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2)) ^ 2 =
              (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * (m - 1) + 2)) *
                (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 2)) := by
            rw [div_pow, one_pow, div_mul_div_comm, one_mul, ← pow_add, hexp, pow_mul']
          exact h_eq.le
        have ht_r := (hS_sum m).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
        have ht_f := (hS_sum (m - 1)).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
        have ht_g := (hS_sum (m + 1)).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
        exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (ht_r.pow 2) (ht_f.mul ht_g)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_fin)
      have hpi_pow : (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2)) ^ 2 =
          (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * (m - 1) + 2)) * (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 2)) := by
        have hexp : (2 * (m - 1) + 2) + (2 * (m + 1) + 2) = 2 * (2 * m + 2) := by omega
        rw [div_pow, div_mul_div_comm, ← pow_add, hexp, pow_mul']
        norm_num
      dsimp [d_F]
      calc ((6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2)) * S_zeta m) ^ 2
          = (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2)) ^ 2 * (S_zeta m) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2)) ^ 2 * (S_zeta (m - 1) * S_zeta (m + 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS_cs (by positivity)
        _ = ((6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * (m - 1) + 2)) * S_zeta (m - 1)) *
              ((6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 2)) * S_zeta (m + 1)) := by
            rw [hpi_pow]; ring

    have hd_step : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → d_F m ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ ^ 2 * d_F (m - 1) := by
      intro m hm
      have hS_le : S_zeta m ≤ S_zeta (m - 1) := by
        refine (hS_sum m).tsum_le_tsum (fun n => ?_) (hS_sum (m - 1))
        have hbase : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
          (pow_le_pow_right₀ hbase (by omega))
      have hpi_eq : 6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * m + 2) =
          Real.pi⁻¹ ^ 2 * (6 / Real.pi ^ (2 * (m - 1) + 2)) := by
        have hexp : 2 * m + 2 = (2 * (m - 1) + 2) + 2 := by omega
        rw [hexp, pow_add]
        field_simp [hpi_pos.ne']
      dsimp [d_F]
      rw [hpi_eq, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS_le (by positivity)) (by positivity)

    obtain ⟨β, _, ψ, B_F, hK_β_zero, _, hK_β_nonneg, hK_β_le, hK_d_bound,
      hK_D_eq, hK_B_eq, _, _, _, _, _, hK_D_zero, _, _, _,
      hK_mul_inv_eq, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
      h_kaluza d_F Real.pi hd_zero hd_pos hd_log hpi_pos hd_step

    have h_sinc_mul_psi : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi,
        firstFieldSinc v * ψ v = firstFieldG v := by
      intro v hv
      by_cases hv0 : v = 0
      · subst hv0
        rw [hCalc.sinc_zero, hK_D_zero, mul_one, hCalc.gF_zero]
      · have hv_norm_pos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv0
        have hv_norm_lt : ‖v‖ < Real.pi := by simpa using hv
        let x : ℂ := v / (Real.pi : ℂ)
        have hpi_c_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpi_pos.ne'
        have hx_mul : (Real.pi : ℂ) * x = v := mul_div_cancel₀ v hpi_c_ne
        have hx_ne : x ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hv0 hpi_c_ne
        have hx_norm : ‖x‖ = ‖v‖ / Real.pi := by
          dsimp [x]
          rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpi_pos]
        have hx_norm_pos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by rw [hx_norm]; positivity
        have hx_norm_lt : ‖x‖ < 1 := by rw [hx_norm, div_lt_one hpi_pos]; exact hv_norm_lt
        have hx_comp : x ∈ Complex.integerComplement := by
          intro hk
          rcases hk with ⟨k, hk_eq⟩
          by_cases hk0 : k = 0
          · subst hk0; simp at hk_eq; exact hx_ne hk_eq.symm
          · have hk_abs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by
              have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k| := Int.one_le_abs hk0
              exact_mod_cast this
            have hnorm_k : ‖(k : ℂ)‖ = |(k : ℝ)| := by
              rw [← Complex.ofReal_intCast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
            rw [← hk_eq, hnorm_k] at hx_norm_lt
            linarith
        have hsin_ne : Complex.sin v ≠ 0 := by
          intro hsin0
          rw [Complex.sin_eq_zero_iff] at hsin0
          rcases hsin0 with ⟨k, hk_v⟩
          apply hx_comp
          refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
          dsimp [x]
          rw [hk_v, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hpi_c_ne]
        have hcot := cot_series_rep' hx_comp
        rw [hx_mul] at hcot
        have hcot_mul := congrArg (fun w : ℂ => -x * w) hcot
        have hlhs_cot : -x * ((Real.pi : ℂ) * v.cot - 1 / x) = 1 - v * v.cot := by
          calc -x * ((Real.pi : ℂ) * v.cot - 1 / x)
              = x * (1 / x) - ((Real.pi : ℂ) * x) * v.cot := by ring
            _ = 1 - v * v.cot := by rw [mul_one_div_cancel hx_ne, hx_mul]
        rw [hlhs_cot, ← tsum_mul_left] at hcot_mul
        let H : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun n m =>
          2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2) / ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2)
        have ha_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖((n : ℂ) + 1)‖ = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
          intro n
          have hc : ((n : ℂ) + 1) = (((n : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
          rw [hc, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
        have hH_norm : ∀ n m : ℕ,
            ‖H n m‖ = 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (2 * m + 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2) := by
          intro n m
          dsimp [H]
          rw [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, Complex.norm_ofNat, ha_norm n]
        have hH_row : ∀ n : ℕ,
            HasSum (H n) (-x * (1 / (x - ((n : ℂ) + 1)) + 1 / (x + ((n : ℂ) + 1)))) ∧
            HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ‖H n m‖)
              (2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)) := by
          intro n
          set a : ℂ := (n : ℂ) + 1
          set ar : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 1
          have har_ge : 1 ≤ ar := by dsimp [ar]; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          have har_pos : 0 < ar := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one har_ge
          have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := by
            intro ha0
            have hn := congrArg norm ha0
            rw [norm_zero, ha_norm n] at hn
            linarith
          have hxa_lt : ‖x / a‖ < 1 := by
            rw [norm_div, ha_norm n, div_lt_one har_pos]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx_norm_lt har_ge
          have hxa2_lt : ‖(x / a) ^ 2‖ < 1 := by
            rw [norm_pow]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg (x / a)]
          have hgeom_c := (hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hxa2_lt).mul_left (2 * (x / a) ^ 2)
          have hxa_sub_ne : x - a ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            have heq : x = a := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
            have hn := congrArg norm heq
            rw [ha_norm n] at hn
            linarith
          have hxa_add_ne : x + a ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            have heq : x = -a := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0
            have hn := congrArg norm heq
            rw [norm_neg, ha_norm n] at hn
            linarith
