          have h1_sub_ne : (1 : ℂ) - (x / a) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            have hmul : a ^ 2 * (1 - (x / a) ^ 2) = (a - x) * (x + a) := by
              field_simp [ha_ne]; ring
            rw [h0, mul_zero] at hmul
            rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul.symm with h1 | h2
            · exact hxa_sub_ne (sub_eq_zero.mpr (sub_eq_zero.mp h1).symm)
            · exact hxa_add_ne h2
          have hsum_c_eq : 2 * (x / a) ^ 2 * (1 - (x / a) ^ 2)⁻¹ =
              -x * (1 / (x - a) + 1 / (x + a)) := by
            rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff h1_sub_ne]
            field_simp [ha_ne, hxa_sub_ne, hxa_add_ne]
            ring
          rw [hsum_c_eq] at hgeom_c
          have hgeom_c' : HasSum (H n) (-x * (1 / (x - a) + 1 / (x + a))) := by
            refine hgeom_c.congr_fun fun m => (?_ : _ = H n m).symm
            have hexp : 2 * m + 2 = 2 + 2 * m := by omega
            calc 2 * (x / a) ^ 2 * ((x / a) ^ 2) ^ m
                = 2 * ((x / a) ^ 2 * (x / a) ^ (2 * m)) := by rw [← pow_mul]; ring
              _ = 2 * (x / a) ^ (2 + 2 * m) := by rw [← pow_add]
              _ = 2 * (x / a) ^ (2 * m + 2) := by rw [hexp]
              _ = 2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2) / a ^ (2 * m + 2) := by rw [div_pow]; ring
              _ = H n m := rfl
          have hqar_lt : (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2 < 1 := by
            have h1 : ‖x‖ / ar < 1 := (div_lt_one har_pos).mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hx_norm_lt har_ge)
            nlinarith [div_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) har_pos.le]
          have hgeom_r := (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) hqar_lt).mul_left
            (2 * (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2)
          have h1_sub_r_pos : 0 < ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
          have hsum_r_eq : 2 * (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2 * (1 - (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2)⁻¹ =
              2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
            have h1_ne : (1 : ℝ) - (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
              have : (1 - (‖x‖ / ar) ^ 2) * ar ^ 2 = ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
                field_simp [har_pos.ne']
              intro h0; rw [h0, zero_mul] at this; linarith
            field_simp [har_pos.ne', h1_sub_r_pos.ne', h1_ne]
          rw [hsum_r_eq] at hgeom_r
          have hgeom_r' : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ‖H n m‖) (2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)) := by
            refine hgeom_r.congr_fun fun m => ?_
            rw [hH_norm n m]
            dsimp [ar]
            rw [← pow_mul, mul_assoc, ← pow_add, div_pow]
            have hexp : 2 + 2 * m = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
            rw [hexp]
            ring
          exact ⟨hgeom_c', hgeom_r'⟩
        have hH_iter_sum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑' m : ℕ, ‖H n m‖) := by
          have hmaj : Summable
              (fun n : ℕ => (2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2)) :=
            (hS_sum 0).mul_left _
          refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hmaj fun n => ?_
          rw [(hH_row n).2.tsum_eq]
          set ar : ℝ := (n : ℝ) + 1
          have har_ge : 1 ≤ ar := by dsimp [ar]; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          have har_pos : 0 < ar := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one har_ge
          have har2_ge : 1 ≤ ar ^ 2 := by nlinarith
          have h1_pos : 0 < 1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
          have hden_ge : (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) * ar ^ 2 ≤ ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
            nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left har2_ge (sq_nonneg ‖x‖)]
          have har2_sub_pos : 0 < ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos h1_pos (by positivity)) hden_ge
          have hpos_val : 0 ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
            div_nonneg (by positivity) har2_sub_pos.le
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hpos_val]
          calc 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (ar ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)
              ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / ((1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) * ar ^ 2) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (mul_pos h1_pos (by positivity)) hden_ge
            _ = (2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2)) * (1 / ar ^ 2) := by
                field_simp [h1_pos.ne', har_pos.ne']
        have hH_prod_norm : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => ‖H p.1 p.2‖) :=
          (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)).mpr
            ⟨fun n => (hH_row n).2.summable, hH_iter_sum⟩
        have hH_prod : Summable (Function.uncurry H) := Summable.of_norm hH_prod_norm
        have hH_col_sum : ∀ m : ℕ, Summable (fun n : ℕ => H n m) := by
          intro m
          have hc_sum := (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasSum (hS_sum m).hasSum).summable.mul_left
            (2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2))
          refine hc_sum.congr fun n => ?_
          dsimp [H]; push_cast; ring
        have hH_comm := hH_prod.tsum_comm' (fun n => (hH_row n).1.summable) hH_col_sum
        have h_cot_psi : 1 - v * v.cot = (v ^ 2 / 3) * ψ v := by
          rw [hcot_mul]
          simp_rw [← (hH_row _).1.tsum_eq]
          rw [← hH_comm, hK_D_eq v, ← tsum_mul_left]
          congr 1; ext m
          have hcol_tsum : (∑' n : ℕ, H n m) = 2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2) * (S_zeta m : ℂ) := by
            have hc_hs :=
              (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasSum (hS_sum m).hasSum).mul_left (2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2))
            have hc_hs' : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => H n m) (2 * x ^ (2 * m + 2) * (S_zeta m : ℂ)) := by
              refine hc_hs.congr_fun fun n => ?_
              dsimp [H]; push_cast; ring
            exact hc_hs'.tsum_eq
          rw [hcol_tsum]
          dsimp [d_F, x]
          push_cast
          have hpi_pow_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hpi_c_ne
          rw [div_pow, pow_add v (2 * m) 2]
          field_simp [hpi_pow_ne]
          ring
        have h3_mul := congrArg (fun w : ℂ => 3 * Complex.sin v * w) h_cot_psi
        have hlhs3 : 3 * Complex.sin v * (1 - v * v.cot) =
            3 * (Complex.sin v - v * Complex.cos v) := by
          rw [Complex.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
          field_simp [hsin_ne]
        have hrhs3 : 3 * Complex.sin v * ((v ^ 2 / 3) * ψ v) =
            v ^ 3 * (firstFieldSinc v * ψ v) := by
          rw [← hCalc.sinc_mul v]
          ring
        rw [hlhs3, hrhs3, ← hCalc.gF_mul v] at h3_mul
        exact (mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hv0) h3_mul).symm

    let μ_F : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m = 0 then 0 else -β m / (2 * (m : ℝ))
    let ℓ_F : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => if m = 0 then 0 else (d_F (m - 1) / 3 - 2 * β m) / (2 * (m : ℝ))

    have hμ_abs : ∀ m : ℕ, |μ_F m| ≤ 1 * (Real.pi⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) := by
      intro m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [μ_F]
      | succ k =>
        have hμ_succ : μ_F (k + 1) = -β (k + 1) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
        rw [hμ_succ]
        have h2m_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos k
          linarith
        rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hK_β_nonneg (k + 1)), abs_of_pos (by linarith),
          one_mul]
        calc β (k + 1) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
            ≤ β (k + 1) / 1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hK_β_nonneg _) zero_lt_one (by linarith)
          _ = β (k + 1) := div_one _
          _ ≤ d_F (k + 1) := hK_β_le (k + 1)
          _ ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := hK_d_bound (k + 1)

    have hℓ_pos_succ : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ℓ_F (k + 1) := by
      intro k
      have hℓ_succ : ℓ_F (k + 1) = (d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
      rw [hℓ_succ]
      have hpi2_gt_9 : (9 : ℝ) < Real.pi ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hinv_lt : Real.pi⁻¹ ^ 2 < 1 / 9 := by
        rw [inv_pow, one_div]
        exact inv_strictAnti₀ (by norm_num) hpi2_gt_9
      have hβ_lt : β (k + 1) < (1 / 9 : ℝ) * d_F k := by
        calc β (k + 1)
            ≤ d_F (k + 1) := hK_β_le (k + 1)
          _ ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ ^ 2 * d_F k := hd_step (k + 1) (by omega)
          _ < (1 / 9 : ℝ) * d_F k := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hinv_lt (hd_pos k)
      have hnum_pos : 0 < d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1) := by linarith [hd_pos k]
      have hden_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      exact div_pos hnum_pos hden_pos

    have hℓ_zero : ℓ_F 0 = 0 := by simp [ℓ_F]
    have hℓ_one_pos : 0 < ℓ_F 1 := hℓ_pos_succ 0
    have hℓ_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ ℓ_F m := by
      intro m; cases m with
      | zero => simp [ℓ_F]
      | succ k => exact (hℓ_pos_succ k).le

    have hℓ_abs : ∀ m : ℕ, |ℓ_F m| ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 * (Real.pi⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) := by
      intro m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [ℓ_F]; positivity
      | succ k =>
        rw [abs_of_pos (hℓ_pos_succ k)]
        have hℓ_succ : ℓ_F (k + 1) = (d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
        rw [hℓ_succ]
        have h2m_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos k
          linarith
        have hnum_le : d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1) ≤ d_F k := by
          linarith [hK_β_nonneg (k + 1), hd_pos k]
        have hdiv_le : (d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ d_F k := by
          calc (d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
              ≤ d_F k / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum_le (by linarith)
            _ ≤ d_F k / 1 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (hd_pos k).le zero_lt_one (by linarith)
            _ = d_F k := div_one _
        calc (d_F k / 3 - 2 * β (k + 1)) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
            ≤ d_F k := hdiv_le
          _ ≤ Real.pi⁻¹ ^ (2 * k) := hK_d_bound k
          _ = Real.pi ^ 2 * Real.pi⁻¹ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
              have hexp : 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 2 := by omega
              rw [hexp, pow_add]
              field_simp [hpi_pos.ne']

    have hM_calc := h_even_ball Real.pi 1 μ_F hpi_pos zero_le_one hμ_abs
    have hL_calc := h_even_ball Real.pi (Real.pi ^ 2) ℓ_F hpi_pos (by positivity) hℓ_abs
    let M_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (μ_F m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
    let L_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (ℓ_F m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
    let P_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp (L_F v)

    obtain ⟨p_even, hp_zero, hp_one_eq, hp_nonneg, hP_hasSum⟩ :=
      h_exp_even ℓ_F Real.pi L_F hℓ_zero hℓ_one_pos hℓ_nonneg hpi_pos
        (fun v hv => (hL_calc.2.2.1 v hv).hasSum)
    have hp_one_pos : 0 < p_even 1 := hp_one_eq ▸ hℓ_one_pos

    have hM_zero : M_F 0 = 0 := by
      change (fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (μ_F m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 0
      rw [hM_calc.2.2.2.2.2.1]; simp [μ_F]
    have hL_zero : L_F 0 = 0 := by
      change (fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (ℓ_F m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 0
      rw [hL_calc.2.2.2.2.2.1]; simp [ℓ_F]

    have h_v_deriv_M : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi, v * deriv M_F v = -B_F v := by
      intro v hv
      have h0 := hM_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 0 v hv
      simp only [zero_mul, zero_add] at h0
      rw [h0, hK_B_eq v, ← tsum_neg]
      congr 1; ext m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [μ_F, hK_β_zero]
      | succ k =>
        have hμ_succ : μ_F (k + 1) = -β (k + 1) / (2 * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
        rw [hμ_succ]
        have hne : (2 : ℂ) * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
        push_cast
        field_simp [hne]

    have h_deriv_M_zero : deriv M_F 0 = 0 := by
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi := Metric.mem_ball_self hpi_pos
      rw [(hM_calc.2.1 0 h0_mem).deriv]
      dsimp only
      convert tsum_zero with m
      cases m with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
        have h2m : 2 * (k + 1) - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp [zero_pow h2m]

    have h_deriv_gF_zero : deriv firstFieldG 0 = 0 := by
      have h_even_gF : ∀ z : ℂ, firstFieldG (-z) = firstFieldG z := by
        intro z; unfold firstFieldG; congr 1; ext m; rw [pow_mul, pow_mul, neg_sq]
      have hg0 : HasDerivAt firstFieldG (deriv firstFieldG (-0)) (-0) :=
        hCalc.gF_entire.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hneg : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => -z) (-1) 0 := (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).neg
      have hd1_raw := hg0.comp (0 : ℂ) hneg
      have hd1_val : deriv firstFieldG (-0) * (-1) = -deriv firstFieldG 0 := by simp
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => firstFieldG (-z)) (-deriv firstFieldG 0) 0 :=
        hd1_val ▸ hd1_raw
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => firstFieldG (-z)) (deriv firstFieldG 0) 0 := by
        have hfn : (fun z : ℂ => firstFieldG (-z)) = firstFieldG := funext h_even_gF
        rw [hfn]
        exact (hCalc.gF_entire.differentiableAt (x := 0)).hasDerivAt
      have heq := hd1.unique hd2
      linear_combination -heq / 2

    have h_gF_ode_M : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi,
        deriv firstFieldG v = 3 * deriv M_F v * firstFieldG v := by
      intro v hv
      by_cases hv0 : v = 0
      · subst hv0
        rw [h_deriv_gF_zero, h_deriv_M_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul]
      · apply mul_left_cancel₀ hv0
        calc v * deriv firstFieldG v
            = 3 * firstFieldSinc v - 3 * firstFieldG v := by linear_combination h_ode_gF v
          _ = 3 * firstFieldSinc v * (1 - (1 - B_F v) * ψ v) +
                3 * (-B_F v) * (firstFieldSinc v * ψ v) +
                3 * (firstFieldSinc v * ψ v - firstFieldG v) := by ring
          _ = 3 * (v * deriv M_F v) * firstFieldG v := by
              rw [hK_mul_inv_eq v hv, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_add,
                h_sinc_mul_psi v hv, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero, h_v_deriv_M v hv]
          _ = v * (3 * deriv M_F v * firstFieldG v) := by ring

    have h_gF_eq_exp : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi,
        firstFieldG v = Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) := by
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => firstFieldG v * Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v)
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi, HasDerivAt φ 0 v := by
        intro v hv
        have hdM' : HasDerivAt M_F (deriv M_F v) v :=
          (hM_calc.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv)).hasDerivAt
        have hexp_at : HasDerivAt Complex.exp (Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v)) (-3 * M_F v) :=
          Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-3 * M_F v)
        have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Complex.exp (-3 * M_F w))
            (Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v) * (-3 * deriv M_F v)) v :=
          hexp_at.comp v (hdM'.const_mul (-3))
        have hd_prod := (hCalc.gF_entire.differentiableAt (x := v)).hasDerivAt.mul hd_exp
        have hzero : deriv firstFieldG v * Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v) +
            firstFieldG v * (Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v) * (-3 * deriv M_F v)) = 0 := by
          rw [h_gF_ode_M v hv]; ring
        exact hzero ▸ hd_prod
      have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hφ_eq0 : Set.EqOn (deriv φ) 0 (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).deriv
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi := Metric.mem_ball_self hpi_pos
      intro v hv
      have hc := Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi).isPreconnected hφ_diff hφ_eq0 hv h0_mem
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = 1 := by simp [φ, hCalc.gF_zero, hM_zero]
      rw [hφ0] at hc
      calc firstFieldG v
          = φ v * Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) := by
            dsimp [φ]
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
            simp
        _ = 1 * Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) := by rw [hc]
        _ = Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) := one_mul _

    have h_deriv_LM : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi,
        deriv L_F v - 2 * deriv M_F v = (v / 3) * ψ v := by
      intro v hv
      rw [(hL_calc.2.1 v hv).deriv, (hM_calc.2.1 v hv).deriv]
      dsimp only
      rw [← tsum_mul_left,
        ← (hL_calc.2.2.2.2.1 v hv).tsum_sub ((hM_calc.2.2.2.2.1 v hv).mul_left 2)]
      have hdiff_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
          (ℓ_F m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m - 1) -
            2 * ((μ_F m : ℂ) * ((2 * m : ℕ) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m - 1))) :=
        (hL_calc.2.2.2.2.1 v hv).sub ((hM_calc.2.2.2.2.1 v hv).mul_left 2)
      have hshift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hdiff_sum.hasSum
      simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.cast_zero,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hshift
      rw [← hshift.tsum_eq, hK_D_eq v, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      have hℓ_succ : ℓ_F (m + 1) = (d_F m / 3 - 2 * β (m + 1)) / (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
      have hμ_succ : μ_F (m + 1) = -β (m + 1) / (2 * ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := rfl
      rw [hℓ_succ, hμ_succ]
      have hexp : 2 * (m + 1) - 1 = 2 * m + 1 := by omega
      rw [hexp, pow_succ v (2 * m)]
      have hne : (2 : ℂ) * (((m : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
        exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hm_pos.ne')
      push_cast
      field_simp [hne]
      ring

    have h_sinc_mul_PF : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi,
        firstFieldSinc v * P_F v = Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := by
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => firstFieldSinc v * Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v)
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi, HasDerivAt φ 0 v := by
        intro v hv
        have hdL : HasDerivAt L_F (deriv L_F v) v :=
          (hL_calc.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv)).hasDerivAt
        have hdM : HasDerivAt M_F (deriv M_F v) v :=
          (hM_calc.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv)).hasDerivAt
        have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => L_F w - 2 * M_F w)
            (deriv L_F v - 2 * deriv M_F v) v := hdL.sub (hdM.const_mul 2)
        have hexp_at : HasDerivAt Complex.exp (Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v))
            (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) := Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v)
        have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Complex.exp (L_F w - 2 * M_F w))
            (Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) * (deriv L_F v - 2 * deriv M_F v)) v :=
          hexp_at.comp v hd_sub
        have hd_prod := (hCalc.sinc_entire.differentiableAt (x := v)).hasDerivAt.mul hd_exp
        have hzero : deriv firstFieldSinc v * Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) +
            firstFieldSinc v *
              (Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) * (deriv L_F v - 2 * deriv M_F v)) = 0 := by
          rw [h_deriv_sinc v, h_deriv_LM v hv]
          calc -(v / 3) * firstFieldG v * Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) +
                firstFieldSinc v * (Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) * ((v / 3) * ψ v))
              = (v / 3) * (firstFieldSinc v * ψ v - firstFieldG v) *
                  Complex.exp (L_F v - 2 * M_F v) := by ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [h_sinc_mul_psi v hv, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_mul]
        exact hzero ▸ hd_prod
      have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hφ_eq0 : Set.EqOn (deriv φ) 0 (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).deriv
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi := Metric.mem_ball_self hpi_pos
      intro v hv
      have hc := Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi).isPreconnected hφ_diff hφ_eq0 hv h0_mem
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = 1 := by simp [φ, hCalc.sinc_zero, hM_zero, hL_zero]
      rw [hφ0] at hc
      calc firstFieldSinc v * P_F v
          = φ v * Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := by
            dsimp [φ, P_F]
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
            congr 2; ring
        _ = 1 * Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := by rw [hc]
        _ = Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := one_mul _

    have hP_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P_F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi) :=
      Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn hL_calc.1

    refine ⟨{
      v_c := Real.pi
      P := P_F
      M := M_F
      p_even := p_even
      v_c_pos := hpi_pos
      p_zero := hp_zero
      p_one_pos := hp_one_pos
      p_nonneg := hp_nonneg
      P_holo := hP_holo
      P_ne_zero := fun v _ => Complex.exp_ne_zero (L_F v)
      P_hasSum := hP_hasSum
      M_holo := hM_calc.1
      M_zero := hM_zero
      M_even := fun v _ => hM_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 v
      M_real := fun r hr => (hM_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr).1
      disk_energy_reg := ?_
      real_bridge := ?_
    }⟩
    · intro v hv
      dsimp only
      set lam : ℂ := 2 * v * Complex.exp (M_F v)
      set J : ℂ := P_F v * (1 + v * deriv M_F v)
      have h_sinc_ne : firstFieldSinc v ≠ 0 := by
        intro hs0
        have h := h_sinc_mul_PF v hv
        rw [hs0, zero_mul] at h
        exact Complex.exp_ne_zero (2 * M_F v) h.symm
      have hJ_eq : J = Complex.exp (-M_F v) := by
        have hmul : firstFieldG v * J = Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := by
          calc firstFieldG v * J
              = (firstFieldSinc v * ψ v) * (P_F v * (1 - B_F v)) := by
                dsimp [J]; rw [h_sinc_mul_psi v hv, h_v_deriv_M v hv]; ring
            _ = (firstFieldSinc v * P_F v) * ((1 - B_F v) * ψ v) := by ring
            _ = Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) * 1 := by rw [h_sinc_mul_PF v hv, hK_mul_inv_eq v hv]
            _ = Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := mul_one _
        rw [h_gF_eq_exp v hv] at hmul
        calc J = Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v) * (Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) * J) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]; simp
          _ = Complex.exp (-3 * M_F v) * Complex.exp (2 * M_F v) := by rw [hmul]
          _ = Complex.exp (-M_F v) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hlamJ : lam * J / 2 = v := by
        dsimp [lam]
        rw [hJ_eq]
        calc 2 * v * Complex.exp (M_F v) * Complex.exp (-M_F v) / 2
            = v * (Complex.exp (M_F v) * Complex.exp (-M_F v)) := by ring
          _ = v * 1 := by rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero]
          _ = v := mul_one v
      have hJ_ne : J ≠ 0 := hJ_eq ▸ Complex.exp_ne_zero (-M_F v)
      refine ⟨?_, hJ_ne, ?_⟩
      · rw [hCalc.energy_first lam J, hlamJ, hJ_eq, h_gF_eq_exp v hv]
        have hexp3 : Complex.exp (-M_F v) ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_F v) = 1 := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_add]
          have : ((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (-M_F v) + 3 * M_F v = 0 := by push_cast; ring
          rw [this, Complex.exp_zero]
        calc (Complex.exp (-M_F v) ^ 3 / 12) * Complex.exp (3 * M_F v)
            = (Complex.exp (-M_F v) ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_F v)) / 12 := by ring
          _ = 1 / 12 := by rw [hexp3]
      · rw [hCalc.twist_first lam J, hlamJ]
        exact mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero hJ_ne (by norm_num)) h_sinc_ne
    · refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      intro r ⟨hr_pos, hr_lt⟩
      have hr_abs : |r| < Real.pi := by rw [abs_of_pos hr_pos]; exact hr_lt
      have hr_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) Real.pi := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hr_abs
      have hM_im : (M_F (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := (hM_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr_abs).1
      have hM_eq_re : M_F (r : ℂ) = (((M_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hM_im]
      have hL_im : (L_F (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := (hL_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 r hr_abs).1
      have hL_eq_re : L_F (r : ℂ) = (((L_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hL_im]
      have hP_eq_re : P_F (r : ℂ) = (((P_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [P_F]
        rw [hL_eq_re, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
        simp
      have hsinc_r : firstFieldSinc (r : ℂ) = ((Real.sin r / r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        have hmul := hCalc.sinc_mul (r : ℂ)
        have hr_c_ne : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr_pos.ne'
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_sin] at hmul
        calc firstFieldSinc (r : ℂ)
            = ((r : ℂ) * firstFieldSinc (r : ℂ)) / (r : ℂ) := by field_simp [hr_c_ne]
          _ = (Real.sin r : ℂ) / (r : ℂ) := by rw [hmul]
          _ = ((Real.sin r / r : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
      constructor
      · rw [h_gF_eq_exp (r : ℂ) hr_mem, hM_eq_re]
        have h3 : (3 : ℂ) * (((M_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            (((3 * (M_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h3, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
        norm_cast
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        norm_num
      · have hid := h_sinc_mul_PF (r : ℂ) hr_mem
        rw [hsinc_r, hP_eq_re, hM_eq_re] at hid
        have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * (((M_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            (((2 * (M_F (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h2, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, ← Complex.ofReal_mul] at hid
        exact Complex.ofReal_injective hid

  
  
  
  have hStage4 : Nonempty (ModelDiskInput .secondField) := by
    let a_Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => 3 / ((2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * (m : ℝ) + 3))
    have ha_zero : a_Q 0 = 1 := by dsimp [a_Q]; norm_num
    have ha_one : a_Q 1 = 1 / 5 := by dsimp [a_Q]; norm_num
    have ha_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < a_Q m := fun m => by dsimp [a_Q]; positivity
    have ha_log : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → (a_Q m) ^ 2 ≤ a_Q (m - 1) * a_Q (m + 1) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
      have hm_sub : ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hm, Nat.cast_one]
      dsimp [a_Q]
      rw [hm_sub]
      push_cast
      have hd1 : 0 < (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * (m : ℝ) + 3) := by nlinarith
      have hd2 : 0 < (2 * ((m : ℝ) - 1) + 1) * (2 * ((m : ℝ) - 1) + 3) := by nlinarith
      have hd3 : 0 < (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) + 1) * (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) + 3) := by nlinarith
      rw [div_pow, div_mul_div_comm, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have ha_step : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a_Q m ≤ (1 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * a_Q (m - 1) := by
      intro m hm
      have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
      have hm_sub : ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) - 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub hm, Nat.cast_one]
      dsimp [a_Q]
      rw [hm_sub]
      simp only [inv_one, one_pow, one_mul]
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)]
      nlinarith

    obtain ⟨_, γ_Q, g_Q, B_Q, _, _, _, _, _, hK_D_eq, _, _, hK_B_holo,
      hK_D_ode, hK_D_sum, _, _, hK_B_zero, hK_B_even, hK_B_real,
      hK_mul_inv_eq, hK_norm_B_lt_one, hK_one_sub_B_slit,
      hK_γ_zero, hK_γ_one, hK_γ_nonneg, hK_neg_log_hasSum⟩ :=
      h_kaluza a_Q 1 ha_zero ha_pos ha_log zero_lt_one ha_step

    let M_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => -(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (1 - B_Q v)
    let P_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp (2 * M_Q v)

    have hM_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        HasDerivAt M_Q ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * deriv B_Q v / (1 - B_Q v)) v := by
      intro v hv
      have hdB : HasDerivAt B_Q (deriv B_Q v) v :=
        (hK_B_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 1 - B_Q w) (-deriv B_Q v) v := by
        convert (hasDerivAt_const v (1 : ℂ)).sub hdB using 1
        ring
      have hlog_at : HasDerivAt Complex.log ((1 - B_Q v)⁻¹) (1 - B_Q v) :=
        Complex.hasDerivAt_log (hK_one_sub_B_slit v hv)
      have hd_log := HasDerivAt.comp v hlog_at hd_sub
      have hd_M := hd_log.const_mul (-(1 / 3 : ℂ))
      have hval : -(1 / 3 : ℂ) * ((1 - B_Q v)⁻¹ * (-deriv B_Q v)) =
          (1 / 3 : ℂ) * deriv B_Q v / (1 - B_Q v) := by ring
      exact hval ▸ hd_M

    have hM_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ M_Q (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      fun v hv => (hM_deriv v hv).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

    have hP_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ P_Q (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn (hM_holo.const_mul 2)

    have hM_zero : M_Q 0 = 0 := by simp [M_Q, hK_B_zero]

    have hM_even : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, M_Q (-v) = M_Q v := by
      intro v _; dsimp [M_Q]; rw [hK_B_even v]

    have hM_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < 1 → (M_Q (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
      intro r hr
      have hr_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hr
      have hB_im : (B_Q (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := hK_B_real r hr
      have hB_norm : ‖B_Q (r : ℂ)‖ < 1 := hK_norm_B_lt_one (r : ℂ) hr_mem
      have hB_re_le : (B_Q (r : ℂ)).re ≤ ‖B_Q (r : ℂ)‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
      have h1_pos : 0 < 1 - (B_Q (r : ℂ)).re := by linarith
      have h1_eq : 1 - B_Q (r : ℂ) = (((1 - (B_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hB_im]
      dsimp [M_Q]
      rw [h1_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_log h1_pos.le]
      have hc : -(1 / 3 : ℂ) * ((Real.log (1 - (B_Q (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (((-(1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 - (B_Q (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hc, Complex.ofReal_im]

    have hgQ_eq_exp : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g_Q v = Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) := by
      intro v hv
      have h1_ne : 1 - B_Q v ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h := hK_mul_inv_eq v hv
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at h
        exact zero_ne_one h
      have hexp3 : Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) = (1 - B_Q v)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [M_Q]
        have h3 : (3 : ℂ) * (-(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (1 - B_Q v)) =
            -Complex.log (1 - B_Q v) := by ring
        rw [h3, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_log h1_ne]
      rw [hexp3]
      calc g_Q v = (1 - B_Q v)⁻¹ * ((1 - B_Q v) * g_Q v) := by field_simp [h1_ne]
        _ = (1 - B_Q v)⁻¹ * 1 := by rw [hK_mul_inv_eq v hv]
        _ = (1 - B_Q v)⁻¹ := mul_one _

    let c_L : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (2 / 3 : ℝ) * γ_Q m
    have hcL_0 : c_L 0 = 0 := by dsimp [c_L]; rw [hK_γ_zero, mul_zero]
    have hcL_1 : 0 < c_L 1 := by dsimp [c_L]; rw [hK_γ_one, ha_one]; norm_num
    have hcL_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ c_L m := fun m => mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hK_γ_nonneg m)
    have h2M_hasSum : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (c_L m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) (2 * M_Q v) := by
      intro v hv
      have hs := (hK_neg_log_hasSum v hv).mul_left (2 / 3 : ℂ)
      have hval : (2 / 3 : ℂ) * (-Complex.log (1 - B_Q v)) = 2 * M_Q v := by
        dsimp [M_Q]; ring
      rw [hval] at hs
      refine hs.congr_fun fun m => ?_
      dsimp [c_L]; push_cast; ring

    obtain ⟨p_even, hp_zero, hp_one_eq, hp_nonneg, hP_hasSum⟩ :=
      h_exp_even c_L 1 (fun v => 2 * M_Q v) hcL_0 hcL_1 hcL_nonneg zero_lt_one h2M_hasSum
    have hp_one_pos : 0 < p_even 1 := hp_one_eq ▸ hcL_1

    let c_AQ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1)
    have hcAQ_abs : ∀ m : ℕ, |c_AQ m| ≤ 1 * ((1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * m) := by
      intro m
      dsimp [c_AQ]
      simp only [inv_one, one_pow, mul_one]
      have hden_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) m]
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ hden_ge (by positivity)

    have hAQ_calc := h_even_ball 1 1 c_AQ zero_lt_one zero_le_one hcAQ_abs
    let A_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => ∑' m : ℕ, (c_AQ m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)
    let z_Q : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((1 + v) / (1 - v))

    have h_ode_gQ : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        3 * g_Q v + v * deriv g_Q v = 3 * A_Q v := by
      intro v hv
      rw [hK_D_ode 3 v hv]
      dsimp [A_Q]
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1; ext m
      dsimp [a_Q, c_AQ]
      have hne1 : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
        have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
        have hc : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 = (((2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hc]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne'
      have hne3 : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 3 ≠ 0 := by
        have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (m : ℝ) + 3 := by positivity
        have hc : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 3 = (((2 * (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [hc]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne'
      push_cast
      field_simp [hne1, hne3]
      ring

    have h_slit_cayley : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        1 - v ≠ 0 ∧ 1 + v ≠ 0 ∧ (1 + v) / (1 - v) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_lt : ‖v‖ < 1 := by simpa using hv
      have h1_sub_ne : 1 - v ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have heq : v = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm
        rw [heq, norm_one] at hv_lt
        exact lt_irrefl 1 hv_lt
      have h1_add_ne : 1 + v ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have heq : v = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0
        rw [heq, norm_neg, norm_one] at hv_lt
        exact lt_irrefl 1 hv_lt
      refine ⟨h1_sub_ne, h1_add_ne, Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl ?_)⟩
      rw [Complex.div_re]
      have hden_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (1 - v) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr h1_sub_ne
      have hnum_eq : (1 + v).re * (1 - v).re + (1 + v).im * (1 - v).im = 1 - ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.one_re, Complex.sub_re,
          Complex.add_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.sub_im, zero_add, zero_sub]
        have hsq : v.re ^ 2 + v.im ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
          ring
        linear_combination -hsq
      rw [← add_div, hnum_eq]
      have hnum_pos : 0 < 1 - ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
      exact div_pos hnum_pos hden_pos

    have hzQ_eq_vAQ : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, z_Q v = v * A_Q v := by
      let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => z_Q v - v * A_Q v
      have hφ_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, HasDerivAt φ 0 v := by
        intro v hv
        have hv_lt : ‖v‖ < 1 := by simpa using hv
        obtain ⟨h1_sub, h1_add, hslit⟩ := h_slit_cayley v hv
        have h1_v2_ne : 1 - v ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
          have hfac : 1 - v ^ 2 = (1 - v) * (1 + v) := by ring
          rw [hfac]; exact mul_ne_zero h1_sub h1_add
        have h_num_d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 1 + w) 1 v := by
          convert (hasDerivAt_const v (1 : ℂ)).add (hasDerivAt_id v) using 1
          · rfl
          · ring
        have h_den_d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 1 - w) (-1) v := by
          convert (hasDerivAt_const v (1 : ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id v) using 1
          · rfl
          · ring
        have h_cayley_d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (1 + w) / (1 - w))
            ((1 * (1 - v) - (1 + v) * (-1)) / (1 - v) ^ 2) v :=
          h_num_d.div h_den_d h1_sub
        have hlog_at : HasDerivAt Complex.log (((1 + v) / (1 - v))⁻¹) ((1 + v) / (1 - v)) :=
          Complex.hasDerivAt_log hslit
        have hzQ_d_raw := (HasDerivAt.comp v hlog_at h_cayley_d).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ)
        have hzQ_val : (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
            (((1 + v) / (1 - v))⁻¹ * ((1 * (1 - v) - (1 + v) * (-1)) / (1 - v) ^ 2)) =
            (1 - v ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [h1_sub, h1_add, h1_v2_ne]
          ring
        have hzQ_d : HasDerivAt z_Q (1 - v ^ 2)⁻¹ v := hzQ_val ▸ hzQ_d_raw
        have hd_AQ : HasDerivAt A_Q (deriv A_Q v) v :=
          (hAQ_calc.1.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv)).hasDerivAt
        have hvAQ_d_raw := (hasDerivAt_id v).mul hd_AQ
        have hvAQ_val : 1 * A_Q v + v * deriv A_Q v = (1 - v ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [hAQ_calc.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 1 v hv]
          have hv2_lt : ‖v ^ 2‖ < 1 := by rw [norm_pow]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
          rw [← (hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one hv2_lt).tsum_eq]
          congr 1; ext m
          dsimp [c_AQ]
          have hne : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
            have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
            have hc : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 = (((2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [hc]
            exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne'
          rw [← pow_mul]
          push_cast
          field_simp [hne]
          ring
        have hvAQ_d : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w * A_Q w) (1 - v ^ 2)⁻¹ v :=
          hvAQ_val ▸ hvAQ_d_raw
        convert hzQ_d.sub hvAQ_d using 1
        exact (sub_self _).symm
      have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hφ_eq0 : Set.EqOn (deriv φ) 0 (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
        fun v hv => (hφ_deriv v hv).deriv
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one
      intro v hv
      have hc := Metric.isOpen_ball.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 1).isPreconnected hφ_diff hφ_eq0 hv h0_mem
      have hφ0 : φ 0 = 0 := by simp [φ, z_Q]
      rw [hφ0] at hc
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc

    have h_gQ_alg : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        8 * v ^ 3 * g_Q v = 12 * (v - (1 - v ^ 2) * z_Q v) := by
      intro v hv
      have hAQ_hs := (hAQ_calc.2.2.1 v hv).hasSum
      have hshift := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hAQ_hs
      have h0_term : (c_AQ 0 : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * 0) = 1 := by dsimp [c_AQ]; norm_num
      simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, h0_term] at hshift
      have hgQ_hs := (hK_D_sum v hv).hasSum.mul_left (2 * v ^ 2)
      rw [← hK_D_eq v] at hgQ_hs
      have hcomb := (hAQ_hs.mul_left (3 * v ^ 2)).sub (hshift.mul_left 3)
      have hterm_eq : ∀ m : ℕ,
          2 * v ^ 2 * ((a_Q m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) =
            3 * v ^ 2 * ((c_AQ m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) -
              3 * ((c_AQ (m + 1) : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * (m + 1))) := by
        intro m
        dsimp [a_Q, c_AQ]
        have hne1 : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
          have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
          have hc : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 1 = (((2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
          rw [hc]
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne'
        have hne3 : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 3 ≠ 0 := by
          have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (m : ℝ) + 3 := by positivity
          have hc : (2 : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) + 3 = (((2 * (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
          rw [hc]
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne'
        have hexp : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
        rw [hexp, pow_add v (2 * m) 2]
        push_cast
        have h3 : 2 * ((m : ℂ) + 1) + 1 = 2 * (m : ℂ) + 3 := by ring
        rw [h3]
        field_simp [hne1, hne3]
        ring
      have h2v2 : 2 * v ^ 2 * g_Q v = 3 * v ^ 2 * A_Q v - 3 * (A_Q v - 1) :=
        hgQ_hs.unique (hcomb.congr_fun hterm_eq)
      rw [hzQ_eq_vAQ v hv]
      linear_combination 4 * v * h2v2

    have hzQ_hyp : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ≠ 0 ∧
        Complex.sinh (z_Q v) = v * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ∧
        Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) = 1 := by
      intro v hv
      obtain ⟨h1_sub, h1_add, hslit⟩ := h_slit_cayley v hv
      set z : ℂ := z_Q v
      have hcayley_ne : (1 + v) / (1 - v) ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero h1_add h1_sub
      have hexp2z : Complex.exp (2 * z) = (1 + v) / (1 - v) := by
        have h2z : 2 * z = Complex.log ((1 + v) / (1 - v)) := by dsimp [z, z_Q]; ring
        rw [h2z, Complex.exp_log hcayley_ne]
      have hexp_split : Complex.exp z = Complex.exp (-z) * Complex.exp (2 * z) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hcosh_eq : Complex.cosh z = Complex.exp (-z) / (1 - v) := by
        change (Complex.exp z + Complex.exp (-z)) / 2 = Complex.exp (-z) / (1 - v)
        rw [hexp_split, hexp2z]
        field_simp [h1_sub]
        ring
      have hsinh_eq : Complex.sinh z = v * Complex.cosh z := by
        rw [hcosh_eq]
        change (Complex.exp z - Complex.exp (-z)) / 2 = v * (Complex.exp (-z) / (1 - v))
        rw [hexp_split, hexp2z]
        field_simp [h1_sub]
        ring
      have hcosh_ne : Complex.cosh z ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hcosh_eq]
        exact div_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _) h1_sub
      have hcosh_sq : Complex.cosh z ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2) = 1 := by
        calc Complex.cosh z ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2)
            = Complex.cosh z ^ 2 - (v * Complex.cosh z) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = Complex.cosh z ^ 2 - Complex.sinh z ^ 2 := by rw [← hsinh_eq]
          _ = 1 := Complex.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq z
      exact ⟨hcosh_ne, hsinh_eq, hcosh_sq⟩

    refine ⟨{
      v_c := 1
      P := P_Q
      M := M_Q
      p_even := p_even
      v_c_pos := zero_lt_one
      p_zero := hp_zero
      p_one_pos := hp_one_pos
      p_nonneg := hp_nonneg
      P_holo := hP_holo
      P_ne_zero := fun v _ => Complex.exp_ne_zero (2 * M_Q v)
      P_hasSum := hP_hasSum
      M_holo := hM_holo
      M_zero := hM_zero
      M_even := hM_even
      M_real := hM_real
      disk_energy_reg := ?_
      real_bridge := ?_
    }⟩
    · intro v hv
      dsimp only
      set lam : ℂ := 2 * v * Complex.exp (M_Q v)
      set J : ℂ := P_Q v * (1 + v * deriv M_Q v)
      have hderiv_gQ : deriv g_Q v = 3 * deriv M_Q v * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) := by
        have hev : g_Q =ᶠ[nhds v] fun w => Complex.exp (3 * M_Q w) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv) hgQ_eq_exp
        rw [hev.deriv_eq]
        have hexp_at : HasDerivAt Complex.exp (Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v)) (3 * M_Q v) :=
          Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (3 * M_Q v)
        have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Complex.exp (3 * M_Q w))
            (Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) * (3 * ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * deriv B_Q v / (1 - B_Q v)))) v :=
          hexp_at.comp v ((hM_deriv v hv).const_mul 3)
        rw [hd'.deriv, (hM_deriv v hv).deriv]
        ring
      have hexp3_AQ : Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) * (1 + v * deriv M_Q v) = A_Q v := by
        have h := h_ode_gQ v hv
        rw [hgQ_eq_exp v hv, hderiv_gQ] at h
        linear_combination h / 3
      have hJ_eq : J = Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * A_Q v := by
        have hexp_split2 : Complex.exp (2 * M_Q v) =
            Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        calc J = Complex.exp (2 * M_Q v) * (1 + v * deriv M_Q v) := rfl
          _ = (Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v)) * (1 + v * deriv M_Q v) := by
              rw [hexp_split2]
          _ = Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * (Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) * (1 + v * deriv M_Q v)) := by ring
          _ = Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * A_Q v := by rw [hexp3_AQ]
      have hlamJ : lam * J / 2 = z_Q v := by
        dsimp [lam]
        rw [hJ_eq, hzQ_eq_vAQ v hv]
        calc 2 * v * Complex.exp (M_Q v) * (Complex.exp (-M_Q v) * A_Q v) / 2
            = v * (Complex.exp (M_Q v) * Complex.exp (-M_Q v)) * A_Q v := by ring
          _ = v * 1 * A_Q v := by rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero]
          _ = v * A_Q v := by ring
      obtain ⟨hcosh_ne, hsinh_eq, hcosh_sq⟩ := hzQ_hyp v hv
      have hcosh_lamJ : Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 := hlamJ ▸ hcosh_ne
      by_cases hv0 : v = 0
      · subst hv0
        have hAQ0 : A_Q 0 = 1 := by
          change (fun w => ∑' m : ℕ, (c_AQ m : ℂ) * w ^ (2 * m)) 0 = 1
          rw [hAQ_calc.2.2.2.2.2.1]; simp [c_AQ]
        have hJ1 : J = 1 := by rw [hJ_eq, hM_zero, neg_zero, Complex.exp_zero, hAQ0, one_mul]
        have hlam0 : lam = 0 := by dsimp [lam]; simp
        have hz0 : lam * J / 2 = 0 := by rw [hlam0, zero_mul, zero_div]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, hcosh_lamJ, ?_⟩
        · rw [hCalc.energy_second lam J hcosh_lamJ, hz0, hJ1, Complex.cosh_zero, hCalc.gQ_zero]
          norm_num
        · rw [hJ1]; exact one_ne_zero
        · rw [hCalc.twist_second lam J hcosh_lamJ, hz0, hJ1, hCalc.sinhc_zero, Complex.cosh_zero]
          norm_num
      · have hsinh_ne : Complex.sinh (z_Q v) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hsinh_eq]; exact mul_ne_zero hv0 hcosh_ne
        have hmul_sinhc : z_Q v * secondFieldSinhc (z_Q v) = Complex.sinh (z_Q v) :=
          hCalc.sinhc_mul (z_Q v)
        have hz_ne : z_Q v ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz0
          have h := hmul_sinhc
          rw [hz0, zero_mul] at h
          have hs0 : Complex.sinh (z_Q v) = 0 := by rw [hz0]; exact h.symm
          exact hsinh_ne hs0
        have hsinhc_ne : secondFieldSinhc (z_Q v) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hs0; rw [hs0, mul_zero] at hmul_sinhc; exact hsinh_ne hmul_sinhc.symm
        have hAQ_ne : A_Q v ≠ 0 := by
          intro hA0
          have := hzQ_eq_vAQ v hv
          rw [hA0, mul_zero] at this
          exact hz_ne this
        have hJ_ne : J ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hJ_eq]
          exact mul_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _) hAQ_ne
        refine ⟨?_, hJ_ne, hcosh_lamJ, ?_⟩
        · rw [hCalc.energy_second lam J hcosh_lamJ, hlamJ]
          have h2z3_ne : 2 * (z_Q v) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 3 hz_ne)
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ h2z3_ne
          have hstep1 : 2 * (z_Q v) ^ 3 *
              ((J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) * secondFieldGNum (z_Q v)) =
              (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) *
                (2 * (z_Q v) ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum (z_Q v)) := by ring
          rw [hstep1, hCalc.gQ_mul (z_Q v), hsinh_eq]
          have hstep2 : (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) *
              (3 * (v * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) - z_Q v)) =
              (J ^ 3 / 4) * (v - (1 - v ^ 2) * z_Q v) := by
            have h1 : Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hcosh_ne
            calc (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) *
                  (3 * (v * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) - z_Q v))
                = (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) *
                    (3 * (v * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2 - 1 * z_Q v)) := by ring
              _ = (J ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2)) *
                    (3 * (v * Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2 -
                      (Complex.cosh (z_Q v) ^ 2 * (1 - v ^ 2)) * z_Q v)) := by rw [hcosh_sq]
              _ = (J ^ 3 / 4) * (v - (1 - v ^ 2) * z_Q v) := by field_simp [h1]; ring
          rw [hstep2]
          have hv_sub : v - (1 - v ^ 2) * z_Q v = (2 / 3 : ℂ) * v ^ 3 * g_Q v := by
            linear_combination -(1 / 12 : ℂ) * h_gQ_alg v hv
          rw [hv_sub, hgQ_eq_exp v hv]
          have hJlam : J ^ 3 * v ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) = (z_Q v) ^ 3 := by
            have h1 : lam * J / 2 = z_Q v := hlamJ
            have h2 : v * Complex.exp (M_Q v) * J = z_Q v := by
              dsimp [lam] at h1; linear_combination h1
            have h3 : (v * Complex.exp (M_Q v) * J) ^ 3 = (z_Q v) ^ 3 := congrArg (· ^ 3) h2
            have hexp3 : Complex.exp (M_Q v) ^ 3 = Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v) := by
              rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]; push_cast; rfl
            calc J ^ 3 * v ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v)
                = v ^ 3 * Complex.exp (M_Q v) ^ 3 * J ^ 3 := by rw [← hexp3]; ring
              _ = (v * Complex.exp (M_Q v) * J) ^ 3 := by ring
              _ = (z_Q v) ^ 3 := h3
          calc (J ^ 3 / 4) * ((2 / 3 : ℂ) * v ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v))
              = (1 / 6 : ℂ) * (J ^ 3 * v ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * M_Q v)) := by ring
            _ = (1 / 6 : ℂ) * (z_Q v) ^ 3 := by rw [hJlam]
            _ = 2 * (z_Q v) ^ 3 * (1 / 12 : ℂ) := by ring
        · rw [hCalc.twist_second lam J hcosh_lamJ, hlamJ]
          exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hJ_ne hsinhc_ne)
            (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 3 hcosh_ne))
    · refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro r ⟨hr_pos, hr_lt⟩
        have hr_abs : |r| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hr_pos]; exact hr_lt
        have hM_im : (M_Q (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := hM_real r hr_abs
        have hM_eq : M_Q (r : ℂ) = (((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hM_im]
        have h2 : 2 * M_Q (r : ℂ) = (((2 * (M_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          nth_rw 1 [hM_eq]; push_cast; ring
        change (Complex.exp (2 * M_Q (r : ℂ))).re = Real.exp (2 * (M_Q (r : ℂ)).re)
        rw [h2, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.ofReal_re]
      · intro z hz
        set r : ℝ := Real.tanh z
        have hcosh_z_pos : 0 < Real.cosh z := Real.cosh_pos z
        have hsinh_z_pos : 0 < Real.sinh z := Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hz
        have hsinh_lt_cosh : Real.sinh z < Real.cosh z := by
          have hsq := Real.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq z
          nlinarith
        have hr_pos : 0 < r := by
          dsimp [r]; rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]; exact div_pos hsinh_z_pos hcosh_z_pos
        have hr_lt : r < 1 := by
          dsimp [r]; rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh, div_lt_one hcosh_z_pos]
          exact hsinh_lt_cosh
        have hr_abs : |r| < 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hr_pos]; exact hr_lt
        have hr_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact hr_abs
        have h_cayley_r : (1 + r) / (1 - r) = Real.exp (2 * z) := by
          dsimp [r]
          rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
          have hsum_e : Real.cosh z + Real.sinh z = Real.exp z := by
            rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.sinh_eq]; ring
          have hsub_e : Real.cosh z - Real.sinh z = Real.exp (-z) := by
            rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.sinh_eq]; ring
          have hsub_ne : Real.cosh z - Real.sinh z ≠ 0 := by linarith
          have h1_ne : 1 - Real.sinh z / Real.cosh z ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            have := (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).symm
            have := (div_eq_one_iff_eq hcosh_z_pos.ne').mp this
            linarith
          have hdiv : (1 + Real.sinh z / Real.cosh z) / (1 - Real.sinh z / Real.cosh z) =
              (Real.cosh z + Real.sinh z) / (Real.cosh z - Real.sinh z) := by
            field_simp [hcosh_z_pos.ne', hsub_ne, h1_ne]
          rw [hdiv, hsum_e, hsub_e, div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg (-z), neg_neg, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1; ring
        have hzQ_r : z_Q (r : ℂ) = (z : ℂ) := by
          dsimp [z_Q]
          have hc : (1 + (r : ℂ)) / (1 - (r : ℂ)) = (((1 + r) / (1 - r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            push_cast; rfl
          rw [hc, h_cayley_r, ← Complex.ofReal_log (Real.exp_pos (2 * z)).le, Real.log_exp]
          push_cast; ring
        have h1_r2 : 1 - (r : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1 / (Complex.cosh (z : ℂ)) ^ 2 := by
          have hr_real : 1 - r ^ 2 = 1 / (Real.cosh z) ^ 2 := by
            dsimp [r]
            rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
            field_simp [hcosh_z_pos.ne']
            exact Real.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq z
          have hc : 1 - (r : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((1 - r ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
          rw [hc, hr_real]
          push_cast; rfl
        have hM_im : (M_Q (r : ℂ)).im = 0 := hM_real r hr_abs
        have hM_eq : M_Q (r : ℂ) = (((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hM_im]
        have hgQ_r : g_Q (r : ℂ) = (((Real.exp ((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re)) : ℂ)) ^ 3 := by
          rw [hgQ_eq_exp (r : ℂ) hr_mem, hM_eq]
          have h3 : (3 : ℂ) * (((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) =
              (((3 * (M_Q (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
          rw [h3, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
          norm_cast
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
          norm_num
        have halg := h_gQ_alg (r : ℂ) hr_mem
        rw [hzQ_r, h1_r2, hgQ_r] at halg
        calc (((2 * r * Real.exp ((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 3
            = 8 * (r : ℂ) ^ 3 * (((Real.exp ((M_Q (r : ℂ)).re)) : ℂ)) ^ 3 := by
              push_cast; ring
          _ = 12 * ((r : ℂ) - 1 / Complex.cosh (z : ℂ) ^ 2 * (z : ℂ)) := halg
          _ = 12 * ((r : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) / Complex.cosh (z : ℂ) ^ 2) := by ring

  exact ⟨hCalc, hStage3, hStage4⟩

signature.statement:
(hCalc : FrozenCalculusProp) (kind : ExpProfileKind) (I : ModelDiskInput kind) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hFwd : IdpluForwardDiskMapProp I := by
    let B : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball_self I.v_c_pos
    have hP_zero : I.P 0 = 1 := by
      have hsum0 := I.P_hasSum 0 h0_mem
      have hsingle : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (I.p_even m : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)) 1 := by
        convert hasSum_single (0 : ℕ) (fun m hm => ?_) using 1
        · simp [I.p_zero]
        · have h2m : 2 * m ≠ 0 := by omega
          simp [zero_pow h2m]
      exact hsum0.unique hsingle
    have hP_even : ∀ v ∈ B, I.P (-v) = I.P v := by
      intro v hv
      have hnv : -v ∈ B := by simpa [B] using hv
      have h1 := I.P_hasSum (-v) hnv
      have h2 := I.P_hasSum v hv
      have heq : (fun m : ℕ => (I.p_even m : ℂ) * (-v) ^ (2 * m)) =
          (fun m : ℕ => (I.p_even m : ℂ) * v ^ (2 * m)) := by
        ext m
        rw [pow_mul, pow_mul, neg_sq]
      rw [heq] at h1
      exact h1.unique h2
    have hP_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < I.v_c → (I.P (r : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ 1 ≤ (I.P (r : ℂ)).re := by
      intro r hr
      have hr_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ B := by
        simpa [B, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hr
      have hsum_c := I.P_hasSum (r : ℂ) hr_mem
      have him : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ((I.p_even m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).im) (I.P (r : ℂ)).im :=
        Complex.imCLM.hasSum hsum_c
      have hre : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ((I.p_even m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).re) (I.P (r : ℂ)).re :=
        Complex.reCLM.hasSum hsum_c
      have him0 : (fun m : ℕ => ((I.p_even m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).im) = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext m
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_im]
      rw [him0] at him
      have hre_eq : (fun m : ℕ => ((I.p_even m : ℂ) * (r : ℂ) ^ (2 * m)).re) =
          fun m => I.p_even m * r ^ (2 * m) := by
        ext m
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_re]
      rw [hre_eq] at hre
      refine ⟨him.unique hasSum_zero, ?_⟩
      have h0_le : I.p_even 0 * r ^ (2 * 0) ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, I.p_even m * r ^ (2 * m) :=
        hre.summable.le_tsum 0 (fun m _ => mul_nonneg (I.p_nonneg m) (by rw [pow_mul]; positivity))
      rw [hre.tsum_eq] at h0_le
      simpa [I.p_zero] using h0_le
    have hSlope_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (idpluSlopeQ I) B := by
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (I.P z)⁻¹) B := I.P_holo.inv I.P_ne_zero
      exact (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)).mpr hg_holo
    have hSlope_deriv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (idpluSlopeQ I)) B :=
      hSlope_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hSlope_mul : ∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ * idpluSlopeQ I ξ = (I.P ξ)⁻¹ - 1 := by
      intro ξ
      have h := sub_smul_dslope (fun z : ℂ => (I.P z)⁻¹) 0 ξ
      simpa [idpluSlopeQ, hP_zero] using h
    have hSlope_odd_ne : ∀ ξ ∈ B, ξ ≠ 0 → idpluSlopeQ I (-ξ) = -idpluSlopeQ I ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ hne
      have h1 := hSlope_mul (-ξ)
      rw [hP_even ξ hξ, ← hSlope_mul ξ] at h1
      have h2 : ξ * (idpluSlopeQ I (-ξ) + idpluSlopeQ I ξ) = 0 := by linear_combination -h1
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h0 | hsum
      · exact absurd h0 hne
      · exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum
    have hSlope_zero : idpluSlopeQ I 0 = 0 := by
      let seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((I.v_c / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hseq_tend : Filter.Tendsto seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => I.v_c / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
            Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
              (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
          exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop h_atTop
        exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
      have hcont0 : ContinuousAt (idpluSlopeQ I) 0 :=
        (hSlope_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)).continuousAt
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => idpluSlopeQ I (seq n)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (idpluSlopeQ I 0)) := hcont0.tendsto.comp hseq_tend
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => idpluSlopeQ I (-seq n)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (idpluSlopeQ I 0)) := by
        have hneg : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => -seq n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using hseq_tend.neg
        exact hcont0.tendsto.comp hneg
      have heq : ∀ n : ℕ, idpluSlopeQ I (-seq n) = -idpluSlopeQ I (seq n) := by
        intro n
        have hpos : 0 < I.v_c / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by have := I.v_c_pos; positivity
        have hlt : I.v_c / (2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) < I.v_c := by
          have hden : (1 : ℝ) < 2 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
          exact div_lt_self I.v_c_pos hden
        have hmem : seq n ∈ B := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          dsimp only [seq]
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos]
          exact hlt
        have hne : seq n ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpos.ne'
        exact hSlope_odd_ne (seq n) hmem hne
      have h2' : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => idpluSlopeQ I (-seq n)) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (-idpluSlopeQ I 0)) := by
        simpa [heq] using h1.neg
      have h0eq : idpluSlopeQ I 0 = -idpluSlopeQ I 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h2'
      linear_combination h0eq / 2
    have hSlope_odd : ∀ ξ ∈ B, idpluSlopeQ I (-ξ) = -idpluSlopeQ I ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      by_cases h0 : ξ = 0
      · simp [h0, hSlope_zero]
      · exact hSlope_odd_ne ξ hξ h0
    have hQ_hasDeriv : ∀ v₀ ∈ B, HasDerivAt (idpluQ I) (idpluSlopeQ I v₀) v₀ := by
      intro v₀ hv₀
      have hv₀_lt : ‖v₀‖ < I.v_c := by simpa [B] using hv₀
      let ε : ℝ := (I.v_c - ‖v₀‖) / 3
      have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε]; linarith
      let ρ₁ : ℝ := ‖v₀‖ + ε
      have hρ₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ ρ₁ := by positivity
      have hρ₁_lt : ρ₁ < I.v_c := by dsimp [ρ₁, ε]; linarith
      have hK_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁) := isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁
      have hK_ne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁).Nonempty := ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ₁_nonneg⟩
      have hK_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ ⊆ B :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hρ₁_lt
      obtain ⟨z₀, _, hz₀_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hSlope_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_sub))
      obtain ⟨z₁, _, hz₁_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hSlope_deriv_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_sub))
      let M₀ : ℝ := ‖idpluSlopeQ I z₀‖
      let M₁ : ℝ := ‖deriv (idpluSlopeQ I) z₁‖
      let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun v t => v * idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v)
      let F' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun v t =>
        idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v) + (t : ℂ) * v * deriv (idpluSlopeQ I) ((t : ℂ) * v)
      have htv_mem : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball v₀ ε, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          (t : ℂ) * v ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ₁ := by
        intro v hv t ht
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
        have hv_norm : ‖v‖ < ρ₁ := by
          have h1 : ‖v - v₀‖ < ε := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hv
          have h2 : ‖v‖ ≤ ‖v₀‖ + ‖v - v₀‖ := norm_le_insert' v v₀
          dsimp [ρ₁]; linarith
        nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2, norm_nonneg v]
      have hF_cont : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball v₀ ε, ContinuousOn (F v) (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
        intro v hv
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
        refine continuousOn_const.mul ?_
        exact hSlope_holo.continuousOn.comp
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const)
          (fun t ht => hK_sub (htv_mem v hv t ht))
      have hF'_cont₀ : ContinuousOn (F' v₀) (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
        have hmap : Set.MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * v₀) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) B :=
          fun t ht => hK_sub (htv_mem v₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hε_pos) t ht)
        have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v₀)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          hSlope_holo.continuousOn.comp
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const) hmap
        have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv (idpluSlopeQ I) ((t : ℂ) * v₀))
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          hSlope_deriv_holo.continuousOn.comp
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const) hmap
        exact hc1.add ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul continuousOn_const).mul hc2)
      have h_leibniz : HasDerivAt (idpluQ I) (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' v₀ t) v₀ := by
        refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
          (Metric.ball_mem_nhds v₀ hε_pos) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
          (intervalIntegrable_const :
            IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => M₀ + ρ₁ * M₁) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1) ?_).2
        · refine Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.ball_mem_nhds v₀ hε_pos) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
          intro v hv
          exact (hF_cont v hv).mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc |>.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
        · exact (hF_cont v₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hε_pos)).intervalIntegrable
        · exact hF'_cont₀.mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc |>.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht v hv => ?_)
          have ht_icc : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
            have := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht
            rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at this
          have hmem_cl := htv_mem v hv t ht_icc
          have hb0 : ‖idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v)‖ ≤ M₀ := hz₀_max hmem_cl
          have hb1 : ‖deriv (idpluSlopeQ I) ((t : ℂ) * v)‖ ≤ M₁ := hz₁_max hmem_cl
          have htv_norm : ‖(t : ℂ) * v‖ ≤ ρ₁ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hmem_cl
          calc ‖F' v t‖
              ≤ ‖idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v)‖ +
                  ‖(t : ℂ) * v‖ * ‖deriv (idpluSlopeQ I) ((t : ℂ) * v)‖ := by
                dsimp [F']
                exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by rw [norm_mul])
            _ ≤ M₀ + ρ₁ * M₁ :=
                add_le_add hb0 (mul_le_mul htv_norm hb1 (norm_nonneg _) hρ₁_nonneg)
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht v hv => ?_)

        w_real_surj := hw_real_surj
        w_real_props := hw_real_props }
  have hLoc_ne : Nonempty (IdpluLocalNonnegOddSeriesData I) := by
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := Metric.mem_ball_self I.v_c_pos
    have hw_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ (idpluWMap I) 0 :=
      ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hFwd.w_map_holo) 0 h0_mem
    have h2_ne : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    have hderiv0_ne : deriv (idpluWMap I) 0 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hFwd.w_map_deriv_zero]; exact h2_ne
    have hw_sderiv0 : HasStrictDerivAt (idpluWMap I) (deriv (idpluWMap I) 0) 0 :=
      hw_ana0.hasStrictDerivAt
    let v_loc : ℂ → ℂ :=
      hw_sderiv0.localInverse (idpluWMap I) (deriv (idpluWMap I) 0) 0 hderiv0_ne
    have hv_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ v_loc 0 := by
      simpa [v_loc, hFwd.w_map_zero] using hw_ana0.analyticAt_localInverse hderiv0_ne
    have hv_deriv0 : HasDerivAt v_loc ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹) 0 := by
      have h := (hw_sderiv0.to_localInverse hderiv0_ne).hasDerivAt
      simpa [v_loc, hFwd.w_map_zero, hFwd.w_map_deriv_zero] using h
    have hv_right_ev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), idpluWMap I (v_loc w) = w := by
      simpa [v_loc, hFwd.w_map_zero] using hw_sderiv0.eventually_right_inverse hderiv0_ne
    have hv_left_ev : ∀ᶠ v in nhds (0 : ℂ), v_loc (idpluWMap I v) = v :=
      hw_sderiv0.eventually_left_inverse hderiv0_ne
    have hv_zero : v_loc 0 = 0 := by
      have h := hv_left_ev.self_of_nhds
      rwa [hFwd.w_map_zero] at h
    let a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => iteratedDeriv n v_loc 0 / (n.factorial : ℂ)
    have ha_ps : HasFPowerSeriesAt v_loc (FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a) 0 :=
      hv_ana0.hasFPowerSeriesAt
    rcases ha_ps with ⟨r_ps, hr_ps⟩
    have h_eball_open : IsOpen (Metric.eball (0 : ℂ) r_ps) := Metric.isOpen_eball
    have h0_eball : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ℂ) r_ps := by
      simp [Metric.mem_eball, hr_ps.r_pos]
    have hev_eball : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), w ∈ Metric.eball (0 : ℂ) r_ps :=
      h_eball_open.mem_nhds h0_eball
    have hv_cont0 : ContinuousAt v_loc 0 := hv_ana0.continuousAt
    have hev_vc : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), ‖v_loc w‖ < I.v_c / 2 := by
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), v_loc w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (I.v_c / 2) := by
        refine hv_cont0.tendsto.eventually_mem ?_
        rw [hv_zero]
        exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) (half_pos I.v_c_pos)
      exact h1.mono (fun w hw => by simpa using hw)
    have hev_neg_left : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), v_loc (idpluWMap I (-v_loc w)) = -v_loc w := by
      have h_neg_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun w : ℂ => -v_loc w) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [hv_zero] using hv_cont0.tendsto.neg
      exact h_neg_tend.eventually hv_left_ev
    have hev_all := hev_eball.and (hv_right_ev.and (hev_vc.and hev_neg_left))
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_all
    let r₀ : ℝ := min δ₀ (idpluRadius I)
    have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hδ₀_pos hFwd.R_pos
    have hr₀_le_R : r₀ ≤ idpluRadius I := min_le_right _ _
    have hr₀_le_δ : r₀ ≤ δ₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have hv_props : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀,
        HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * w ^ n) (v_loc w) ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℂ v_loc w ∧
        ‖v_loc w‖ < I.v_c / 2 ∧
        idpluWMap I (v_loc w) = w ∧
        v_loc (-w) = -v_loc w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_δ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₀_le_δ hw
      obtain ⟨hw_eb, hw_rinv, hw_norm, hw_nleft⟩ := hδ₀ w hw_δ
      have hsum_raw := hr_ps.hasSum hw_eb
      rw [zero_add] at hsum_raw
      have hsum : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * w ^ n) (v_loc w) := by
        convert hsum_raw using 1
        ext n
        simp only [FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_apply_eq, smul_eq_mul]
      have hdiff_on := hr_ps.differentiableOn
      have hdiff_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ v_loc w :=
        hdiff_on.differentiableAt (h_eball_open.mem_nhds hw_eb)
      have h_odd : v_loc (-w) = -v_loc w := by
        have hv_mem : v_loc w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
          linarith [I.v_c_pos]
        have hw_odd_val : idpluWMap I (-v_loc w) = -w := by
          rw [hFwd.w_map_odd (v_loc w) hv_mem, hw_rinv]
        rw [hw_odd_val] at hw_nleft
        exact hw_nleft
      exact ⟨hsum, hdiff_at, hw_norm, hw_rinv, h_odd⟩
    have hv_ode : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀,
        w * deriv v_loc w = v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨_, hdiff_w, hw_norm, hw_rinv, _⟩ := hv_props w hw
      have hv_mem : v_loc w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith [I.v_c_pos]
      have hd_wmap : HasDerivAt (idpluWMap I) (deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w)) (v_loc w) :=
        (hFwd.w_map_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hv_mem)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => idpluWMap I (v_loc z))
          (deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w) * deriv v_loc w) w :=
        hd_wmap.comp w hdiff_w.hasDerivAt
      have hev_id : (fun z : ℂ => idpluWMap I (v_loc z)) =ᶠ[nhds w] id := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
        intro z hz
        exact (hv_props z hz).2.2.2.1
      have h_prod_one : deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w) * deriv v_loc w = 1 :=
        hd_comp.unique ((hasDerivAt_id w).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_id)
      have h_wderiv := hFwd.w_map_deriv (v_loc w) hv_mem
      have hP_ne := I.P_ne_zero (v_loc w) hv_mem
      have h_mul_eq : v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w) * deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w) = w := by
        rw [h_wderiv]
        have h1 : v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w) * (2 * Complex.exp (idpluQ I (v_loc w)) / I.P (v_loc w)) =

          field_simp [hP_ne]
        rw [h1, hw_rinv]
      calc w * deriv v_loc w
          = (v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w) * deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w)) * deriv v_loc w := by
              rw [h_mul_eq]
        _ = (v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w)) * (deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_loc w) * deriv v_loc w) := by
              ring
        _ = v_loc w * I.P (v_loc w) := by rw [h_prod_one, mul_one]

    have h_series_trunc : ∀ (b : ℕ → ℂ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ →
        Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖b n‖ * ρ ^ n) →
        ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < ρ →
          Summable (fun n : ℕ => b n * w ^ n) ∧
          ‖(∑' n : ℕ, b n * w ^ n) - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, b k * w ^ k‖ ≤ C * ‖w‖ ^ N := by
      intro b ρ hρ hsum_ρ N
      have hs_shift : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖b (j + N)‖ * ρ ^ (j + N)) :=
        (summable_nat_add_iff N).mpr hsum_ρ
      have hs_tail : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖b (j + N)‖ * ρ ^ j) := by
        have hpow_ne : ρ ^ N ≠ 0 := (pow_pos hρ N).ne'
        convert hs_shift.mul_left ((ρ ^ N)⁻¹) using 1
        ext j
        rw [pow_add]
        field_simp [hpow_ne]
      let C : ℝ := ∑' j : ℕ, ‖b (j + N)‖ * ρ ^ j
      refine ⟨C, tsum_nonneg (fun j => by positivity), fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have hw_sum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => b n * w ^ n) := by
        refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hsum_ρ (fun n => ?_)
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw.le n) (norm_nonneg _)
      refine ⟨hw_sum, ?_⟩
      have h_split := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' N).mpr hw_sum.hasSum
      rw [← h_split.tsum_eq]
      have h_tail_w_norm : Summable (fun j : ℕ => ‖b (j + N) * w ^ j‖) := by
        refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => ?_) hs_tail
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw.le j) (norm_nonneg _)
      have h_fac : (fun j : ℕ => b (j + N) * w ^ (j + N)) =
          fun j : ℕ => w ^ N * (b (j + N) * w ^ j) := by
        ext j; rw [pow_add]; ring
      rw [h_fac, tsum_mul_left, norm_mul, norm_pow]
      calc ‖w‖ ^ N * ‖∑' j : ℕ, b (j + N) * w ^ j‖
          ≤ ‖w‖ ^ N * (∑' j : ℕ, ‖b (j + N) * w ^ j‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_tail_w_norm) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ ‖w‖ ^ N * C := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_tail_w_norm.tsum_le_tsum (fun j => ?_) hs_tail)
              (by positivity)
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw.le j) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = C * ‖w‖ ^ N := mul_comm _ _

    have h_poly_vanish : ∀ (N : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℂ) (C ρ : ℝ),
        0 ≤ C → 0 < ρ →
        (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < ρ → ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), d k * w ^ k‖ ≤ C * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1)) →
        ∀ k ≤ N, d k = 0 := by
      intro N d C ρ hC hρ hbound k hkN
      induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h K ih =>
        by_contra hK_ne
        have hK_pos : 0 < ‖d K‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hK_ne
        let M_rem : ℝ := C + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), ‖d (K + j + 1)‖
        have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_rem :=
          add_nonneg hC (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _))
        let x : ℝ := min (min ρ 1 / 2) (‖d K‖ / (2 * (M_rem + 1)))
        have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
        have hx_lt_ρ : x < ρ := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (half_lt_self (lt_min hρ zero_lt_one)) (min_le_left _ _))
        have hx_le_1 : x ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _)

        have hx_small : (M_rem + 1) * x ≤ ‖d K‖ / 2 := by
