          have hpos_m : 0 < M_rem + 1 := by linarith
          calc (M_rem + 1) * x ≤ (M_rem + 1) * (‖d K‖ / (2 * (M_rem + 1))) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hpos_m.le
            _ = ‖d K‖ / 2 := by field_simp [hpos_m.ne']
        have hsum_split : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), d k * (x : ℂ) ^ k =
            (x : ℂ) ^ K * (d K + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)) := by
          have hN_eq : N + 1 = K + ((N - K) + 1) := by omega
          rw [hN_eq, Finset.sum_range_add]
          have hlow : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, d k * (x : ℂ) ^ k = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => ?_)
            rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
            rw [ih j hj (by omega), zero_mul]
          rw [hlow, zero_add, Finset.sum_range_succ', add_comm]
          simp only [add_zero, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          · ring
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
            have hexp : K + (j + 1) = K + j + 1 := by omega
            rw [← hexp, pow_add (x : ℂ) K (j + 1)]
            ring
        have h_ineq := hbound (x : ℂ)
          (by simpa [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hx_pos] using hx_lt_ρ)
        rw [hsum_split, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hx_pos] at h_ineq
        have hxK_pos : 0 < x ^ K := pow_pos hx_pos K
        have hpow_split : x ^ (N + 1) = x ^ K * x ^ (N + 1 - K) := by
          rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le (by omega : K ≤ N + 1)]
        rw [hpow_split] at h_ineq
        have h_div : ‖d K + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)‖ ≤
            C * x ^ (N + 1 - K) := by
          have : x ^ K * ‖d K + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)‖ ≤
              x ^ K * (C * x ^ (N + 1 - K)) := by linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hxK_pos
        have h_rev : ‖d K‖ - ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)‖ ≤
            ‖d K + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)‖ := by
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (d K)
            (-∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1))
          simpa [sub_neg_eq_add] using this
        have h_rem_norm : ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), d (K + j + 1) * (x : ℂ) ^ (j + 1)‖ ≤
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N - K), ‖d (K + j + 1)‖) * x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_))
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hx_pos]
          have hj_pow : x ^ (j + 1) ≤ x ^ 1 :=
            pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx_pos.le hx_le_1 (by omega)
          rw [pow_one] at hj_pow
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj_pow (norm_nonneg _)
        have h_C_pow : C * x ^ (N + 1 - K) ≤ C * x := by
          have hpow_le : x ^ (N + 1 - K) ≤ x ^ 1 :=
            pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx_pos.le hx_le_1 (by omega)
          rw [pow_one] at hpow_le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le hC
        have h_dk_le : ‖d K‖ ≤ M_rem * x := by
          dsimp [M_rem]
          linarith
        nlinarith

    have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by simp [a, hv_zero]
    have ha1 : a 1 = 1 / 2 := by
      simp only [a, iteratedDeriv_one, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one, hv_deriv0.deriv]
      norm_num
    let r₁ : ℝ := min (r₀ / 4) 1
    have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := lt_min (by positivity) zero_lt_one
    have hr₁_le_1 : r₁ ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
    have h2r₁_lt : 2 * r₁ < r₀ := by
      have : r₁ ≤ r₀ / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have h_sum_2r₁ : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a n‖ * (2 * r₁) ^ n) := by
      have hmem : ((2 * r₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
        exact h2r₁_lt
      have hs := (hv_props ((2 * r₁ : ℝ) : ℂ) hmem).1.summable.norm
      convert hs using 1
      ext n
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    have h_sum_r₁ : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a n‖ * r₁ ^ n) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity)
        (fun n => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr₁_pos.le (by linarith) n) (norm_nonneg _))
        h_sum_2r₁
    have ha_even : ∀ k : ℕ, a (2 * k) = 0 := by
      intro k
      let d_ev : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => a m * (1 + (-1 : ℂ) ^ m)
      have hd_sum_r₁ : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖d_ev m‖ * r₁ ^ m) := by
        refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity) (fun m => ?_) (h_sum_r₁.mul_left 2)
        dsimp [d_ev]
        rw [norm_mul]
        have h2 : ‖(1 : ℂ) + (-1 : ℂ) ^ m‖ ≤ 2 := by
          calc ‖(1 : ℂ) + (-1 : ℂ) ^ m‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖(-1 : ℂ) ^ m‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = 2 := by simp; norm_num
        calc ‖a m‖ * ‖(1 : ℂ) + (-1 : ℂ) ^ m‖ * r₁ ^ m
            ≤ ‖a m‖ * 2 * r₁ ^ m :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg _))
                (pow_nonneg hr₁_pos.le m)
          _ = 2 * (‖a m‖ * r₁ ^ m) := by ring
      obtain ⟨C_ev, hC_ev, htrunc_ev⟩ := h_series_trunc d_ev r₁ hr₁_pos hd_sum_r₁ (2 * k + 1)
      have h_ev_bound : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < r₁ →
          ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.range (2 * k + 1), d_ev m * w ^ m‖ ≤ C_ev * ‖w‖ ^ (2 * k + 1) := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_r₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith
        have hnw_r₀ : -w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by simpa using hw_r₀
        have hs_add := ((hv_props w hw_r₀).1).add ((hv_props (-w) hnw_r₀).1)
        rw [(hv_props w hw_r₀).2.2.2.2, add_neg_cancel] at hs_add
        have h_d_eq : (fun m : ℕ => a m * w ^ m + a m * (-w) ^ m) = fun m => d_ev m * w ^ m := by
          ext m; dsimp [d_ev]; rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul w, mul_pow]; ring
        rw [h_d_eq] at hs_add
        have h_tsum_zero : (∑' m : ℕ, d_ev m * w ^ m) = 0 := hs_add.tsum_eq
        have htr := (htrunc_ev w hw).2
        rw [h_tsum_zero, zero_sub, norm_neg] at htr
        exact htr
      have hd_zero := h_poly_vanish (2 * k) d_ev C_ev r₁ hC_ev hr₁_pos h_ev_bound (2 * k) le_rfl
      dsimp [d_ev] at hd_zero
      rw [pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow] at hd_zero
      have h2ne : (1 + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hd_zero).resolve_right h2ne

    have hv_lhs_series : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁,
        w * deriv v_loc w - v_loc w = ∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℂ) - 1) * a n * w ^ n := by
      intro w hw
      let u_dom : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => r₁⁻¹ * (‖a n‖ * (2 * r₁) ^ n)
      have hu_sum : Summable u_dom := h_sum_2r₁.mul_left r₁⁻¹
      have hd_term : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁,
          HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => a n * ζ ^ n) ((n : ℂ) * a n * z ^ (n - 1)) z := by
        intro n z _
        cases n with
        | zero =>
          simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
          exact hasDerivAt_const z (a 0)
        | succ m =>
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
          convert (hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) z).const_mul (a (m + 1)) using 1
          push_cast; ring
      have hd_bound : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁,
          ‖(n : ℂ) * a n * z ^ (n - 1)‖ ≤ u_dom n := by
        intro n z hz
        have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < r₁ := by simpa using hz
        cases n with
        | zero =>
          dsimp [u_dom]
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, norm_zero]
          positivity
        | succ m =>
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, norm_pow]
          have hm2 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := by
            exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := m + 1)).le
          have hz_pow : ‖z‖ ^ m ≤ r₁ ^ m := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hz_lt.le m
          calc ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖a (m + 1)‖ * ‖z‖ ^ m
              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) * ‖a (m + 1)‖ * r₁ ^ m := by
                refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2 (norm_nonneg _)) hz_pow
                  (by positivity) (by positivity)
            _ = u_dom (m + 1) := by
                dsimp [u_dom]
                rw [mul_pow, pow_succ r₁ m]
                field_simp [hr₁_pos.ne']
      have h0_r₁ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos
      have h0_r₀ : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos
      have hd_tsum : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, a n * z ^ n)
          (∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ (n - 1)) w :=
        hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu_sum Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r₁).isPreconnected hd_term hd_bound h0_r₁
          (hv_props 0 h0_r₀).1.summable hw
      have hev_tsum : (fun z : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, a n * z ^ n) =ᶠ[nhds w] v_loc := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
        intro z hz
        have hz_r₀ : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz
        exact (hv_props z hz_r₀).1.tsum_eq
      have hderiv_eq : deriv v_loc w = ∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ (n - 1) :=
        (hd_tsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_tsum.symm).deriv
      have hw_r₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hw
      have hs_v : Summable (fun n : ℕ => a n * w ^ n) := (hv_props w hw_r₀).1.summable
      have hs_dv : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ (n - 1)) :=
        Summable.of_norm_bounded hu_sum (fun n => hd_bound n w hw)
      have hs_wdv : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ n) := by
        convert hs_dv.mul_left w using 1
        ext n
        cases n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m =>
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
          ring
      rw [hderiv_eq, ← tsum_mul_left]
      have h_wdv_eq : (∑' n : ℕ, w * ((n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ (n - 1))) =
          ∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℂ) * a n * w ^ n := by
        congr 1; ext n
        cases n with
        | zero => simp
        | succ m => simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]; ring
      rw [h_wdv_eq, ← (hv_props w hw_r₀).1.tsum_eq, ← hs_wdv.tsum_sub hs_v]
      congr 1; ext n; ring

    have h_sum_lhs_r₁ : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖((n : ℂ) - 1) * a n‖ * r₁ ^ n) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) (h_sum_2r₁.mul_left 2)
      rw [norm_mul]
      have hn_le : ‖(n : ℂ) - 1‖ ≤ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        have h1 : ‖(n : ℂ) - 1‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
          calc ‖(n : ℂ) - 1‖ ≤ ‖(n : ℂ)‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by simp
        have h2 : (n : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := n)
        have h3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
        linarith
      calc ‖(n : ℂ) - 1‖ * ‖a n‖ * r₁ ^ n
          ≤ (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ n) * ‖a n‖ * r₁ ^ n :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn_le (norm_nonneg _))
              (pow_nonneg hr₁_pos.le n)
        _ = 2 * (‖a n‖ * (2 * r₁) ^ n) := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

    let NonnegPoly : Polynomial ℝ → Prop := fun p => ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p.coeff k
    have hNP_one : NonnegPoly 1 := fun k => by rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hNP_C_mul : ∀ (r : ℝ) p, 0 ≤ r → NonnegPoly p → NonnegPoly (Polynomial.C r * p) :=
      fun r p hr hp k => by rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]; exact mul_nonneg hr (hp k)
    have hNP_X_pow : ∀ (m : ℕ), NonnegPoly (Polynomial.X ^ m) :=
      fun m k => by rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hNP_mul : ∀ p q, NonnegPoly p → NonnegPoly q → NonnegPoly (p * q) :=
      fun p q hp hq k => by
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hp x.1) (hq x.2))
    have hNP_pow : ∀ p (m : ℕ), NonnegPoly p → NonnegPoly (p ^ m) := by
      intro p m hp
      induction m with
      | zero => simpa using hNP_one
      | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact hNP_mul _ _ ih hp
    have hNP_sum : ∀ (s : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ),
        (∀ i ∈ s, NonnegPoly (f i)) → NonnegPoly (∑ i ∈ s, f i) := by
      intro s f hf k
      rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => hf i hi k)

    obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁_nonneg, h_trunc_1⟩ := h_series_trunc a r₁ hr₁_pos h_sum_r₁ 1
    have hv_lin_bound : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < r₁ → ‖v_loc w‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖w‖ := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_r₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith
      have htr := (h_trunc_1 w hw).2
      rw [(hv_props w hw_r₀).1.tsum_eq, Finset.sum_range_one, ha0, zero_mul, sub_zero, pow_one] at htr
      exact htr
    let ρ_P : ℝ := I.v_c / 2
    have hρ_P_pos : 0 < ρ_P := half_pos I.v_c_pos
    have hρ_P_lt : ρ_P < I.v_c := half_lt_self I.v_c_pos
    obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂_def⟩ : ∃ M₂ : ℝ, M₂ = max M₁ (ρ_P / r₁) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM₂_pos : 0 < M₂ := by rw [hM₂_def]; positivity
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_def⟩ : ∃ r₂ : ℝ, r₂ = ρ_P / M₂ := ⟨ρ_P / M₂, rfl⟩
    have hr₂_pos : 0 < r₂ := by rw [hr₂_def]; exact div_pos hρ_P_pos hM₂_pos
    have hr₂_le_r₁ : r₂ ≤ r₁ := by
      have h1 : ρ_P / r₁ ≤ M₂ := by
        rw [hM₂_def]
        exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (by linarith)
      rw [hr₂_def, div_le_iff₀ hM₂_pos]
      have := (div_le_iff₀ hr₁_pos).mp h1
      linarith
    have hr₂_le_1 : r₂ ≤ 1 := le_trans hr₂_le_r₁ hr₁_le_1
    have hv_ratio_bound : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < r₂ →
        ‖v_loc w‖ ≤ ρ_P * (‖w‖ / r₂) ∧ ‖v_loc w‖ < ρ_P := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_r₁ : ‖w‖ < r₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hw hr₂_le_r₁
      have hM₁_le : M₁ ≤ M₂ := by
        rw [hM₂_def]
        exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (by linarith)
      have h1 : ‖v_loc w‖ ≤ M₂ * ‖w‖ :=
        (hv_lin_bound w hw_r₁).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM₁_le (norm_nonneg w))
      have h_eq : M₂ * ‖w‖ = ρ_P * (‖w‖ / r₂) := by
        rw [hr₂_def]; field_simp [hM₂_pos.ne', hρ_P_pos.ne']
      rw [h_eq] at h1
      have hlt1 : ‖w‖ / r₂ < 1 := (div_lt_one hr₂_pos).mpr hw
      exact ⟨h1, lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (by nlinarith)⟩
    have hP_sum_ρP : Summable (fun m : ℕ => I.p_even m * ρ_P ^ (2 * m)) := by
      have hmem : (ρ_P : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hρ_P_pos]
        exact hρ_P_lt
      have hs := (I.P_hasSum (ρ_P : ℂ) hmem).summable.norm
      convert hs using 1
      ext m
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (I.p_nonneg m), abs_of_pos hρ_P_pos]

    have ha_real_nonneg : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ (a N).re ∧ a N = ((a N).re : ℂ) := by
      intro N
      induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h N ih =>
        rcases eq_or_ne N 0 with rfl | hN0
        · simp [ha0]
        rcases eq_or_ne N 1 with rfl | hN1
        · rw [ha1]; norm_num
        have hN_ge2 : 2 ≤ N := by omega
        let Q_poly : Polynomial ℝ :=
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, Polynomial.C (a k).re * Polynomial.X ^ k
        have hQ_NP : NonnegPoly Q_poly :=
          hNP_sum (Finset.Ico 1 N) _ (fun k hk =>
            hNP_C_mul (a k).re _ (ih k (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).2).1 (hNP_X_pow k))
        let R_poly : Polynomial ℝ :=
          ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, Polynomial.C (I.p_even m) * Q_poly ^ (2 * m + 1)
        have hR_NP : NonnegPoly R_poly :=
          hNP_sum (Finset.Icc 1 N) _ (fun m _ =>
            hNP_C_mul (I.p_even m) _ (I.p_nonneg m) (hNP_pow Q_poly (2 * m + 1) hQ_NP))
        let Q_C : Polynomial ℂ := Q_poly.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)
        let R_C : Polynomial ℂ := R_poly.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)
        let B_N : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, a k * w ^ k
        have hBN_eq_eval : ∀ w : ℂ, B_N w = Q_C.eval w := by
          intro w
          dsimp [B_N, Q_C, Q_poly]
          rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
          have hN_pos : 1 ≤ N := by omega
          rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le 1) hN_pos]
          have h0_sum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 0 1, a k * w ^ k = 0 := by simp [ha0]
          rw [h0_sum, zero_add]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => ?_)
          simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow,
            Complex.coe_algebraMap]
          rw [← (ih k (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).2).2]
        have hRC_eval : ∀ w : ℂ,
            R_C.eval w = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (I.p_even (m + 1) : ℂ) * (B_N w) ^ (2 * m + 3) := by
          intro w
          have h1 : R_C.eval w = ∑ m' ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
              (I.p_even m' : ℂ) * (Q_C.eval w) ^ (2 * m' + 1) := by
            dsimp [R_C, R_poly, Q_C]
            rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m' _ => ?_)
            simp [Polynomial.eval_map]
          rw [h1]
          have h_bij : ∑ m' ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (I.p_even m' : ℂ) * (Q_C.eval w) ^ (2 * m' + 1) =
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (I.p_even (m + 1) : ℂ) * (Q_C.eval w) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) := by
            have hIco : Finset.Icc 1 N = Finset.Ico 1 (N + 1) := rfl
            rw [hIco]
            simpa [add_comm] using
              (Finset.sum_Ico_add (fun m' => (I.p_even m' : ℂ) * (Q_C.eval w) ^ (2 * m' + 1)) 0 N 1).symm
          rw [h_bij]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          rw [← hBN_eq_eval w]
          have hexp : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
          rw [hexp]
        obtain ⟨C_lhs, hC_lhs_nn, h_trunc_lhs⟩ :=
          h_series_trunc (fun n => ((n : ℂ) - 1) * a n) r₁ hr₁_pos h_sum_lhs_r₁ (N + 1)
        obtain ⟨M_rem, hM_rem_nn, h_trunc_N⟩ := h_series_trunc a r₁ hr₁_pos h_sum_r₁ N
        let M_B : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 N, ‖a k‖
        have hM_B_nn : 0 ≤ M_B := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
        have hBN_lin : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < r₂ → ‖B_N w‖ ≤ M_B * ‖w‖ := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_le1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := hw.le.trans hr₂_le_1
          dsimp [B_N]
          rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le 1) (by omega : 1 ≤ N)]
          have h0s : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 0 1, a k * w ^ k = 0 := by simp [ha0]
          rw [h0s, zero_add, Finset.sum_mul]
          refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_))
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
          have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk).1
          by_cases hw0 : w = 0
          · rw [hw0, norm_zero, zero_pow (by omega : k ≠ 0), mul_zero]
          · have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0
            have hpow_le : ‖w‖ ^ k ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hw_pos.le hw_le1 hk1
            rw [pow_one] at hpow_le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le (norm_nonneg _)
        have hP_shift_sum : Summable (fun j : ℕ => I.p_even (j + (N + 1)) * ρ_P ^ (2 * (j + (N + 1)))) :=
          (summable_nat_add_iff (N + 1)).mpr hP_sum_ρP
        let C_Ptail : ℝ := ρ_P * (r₂ ^ (N + 1))⁻¹ *
          ∑' j : ℕ, I.p_even (j + (N + 1)) * ρ_P ^ (2 * (j + (N + 1)))
        have hC_Ptail_nn : 0 ≤ C_Ptail :=
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ_P_pos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg hr₂_pos.le _)))
            (tsum_nonneg (fun j => mul_nonneg (I.p_nonneg _) (by positivity)))
        let C_rep : ℝ := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
          I.p_even (m + 1) *
            (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 3), M₁ ^ j * M_B ^ (2 * m + 2 - j)) * M_rem
        have hC_rep_nn : 0 ≤ C_rep :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => mul_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (I.p_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity))) hM_rem_nn)
        let C_Rhigh : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (N + 1) (R_poly.natDegree + 1), |R_poly.coeff k|
        have hC_Rhigh_nn : 0 ≤ C_Rhigh := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
        let C_tot : ℝ := C_lhs + C_Ptail + C_rep + C_Rhigh
        have hC_tot_nn : 0 ≤ C_tot := by positivity
        let d_diff : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => ((k : ℂ) - 1) * a k - (R_poly.coeff k : ℂ)
        have h_diff_bound : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < r₂ →
            ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), d_diff k * w ^ k‖ ≤ C_tot * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
          intro w hw
          have hw_r₁ : ‖w‖ < r₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hw hr₂_le_r₁
          have hw_r₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith
          have hw_le1 : ‖w‖ ≤ 1 := hw.le.trans hr₂_le_1
          let poly_LHS : ℂ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ((k : ℂ) - 1) * a k * w ^ k
          have h_lhs_err : ‖(w * deriv v_loc w - v_loc w) - poly_LHS‖ ≤ C_lhs * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
            have h1 := (h_trunc_lhs w hw_r₁).2
            have hw_ball_r₁ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁ := by simpa using hw_r₁
            rwa [← hv_lhs_series w hw_ball_r₁] at h1
          have h_ode_sub : w * deriv v_loc w - v_loc w = v_loc w * (I.P (v_loc w) - 1) := by
            rw [hv_ode w hw_r₀]; ring
          obtain ⟨hv_rat, hv_lt_ρP⟩ := hv_ratio_bound w hw
          have hv_mem_vc : v_loc w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]; linarith
          have hP_hs := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (I.P_hasSum (v_loc w) hv_mem_vc)
          simp only [Finset.sum_range_one, mul_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, I.p_zero] at hP_hs
          have h_vP_hs : HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (I.p_even (m + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * m + 3))
              (v_loc w * (I.P (v_loc w) - 1)) := by
            convert hP_hs.mul_left (v_loc w) using 1
            ext m
            have hexp : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
            rw [hexp, pow_succ' (v_loc w) (2 * m + 2)]
            ring
          have h_vP_split := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' N).mpr h_vP_hs
          let fin_vP : ℂ := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (I.p_even (m + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * m + 3)
          have h_ptail_err : ‖v_loc w * (I.P (v_loc w) - 1) - fin_vP‖ ≤ C_Ptail * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
            rw [← h_vP_split.tsum_eq]
            let maj : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
              ρ_P * (r₂ ^ (N + 1))⁻¹ * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1) *
                (I.p_even (j + (N + 1)) * ρ_P ^ (2 * (j + (N + 1))))
            have hmaj_sum : Summable maj :=
              hP_shift_sum.mul_left (ρ_P * (r₂ ^ (N + 1))⁻¹ * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1))
            have hterm_le : ∀ j : ℕ,
                ‖(I.p_even (j + N + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3)‖ ≤ maj j := by
              intro j
              rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                abs_of_nonneg (I.p_nonneg _)]
              have hq_le1 : ‖w‖ / r₂ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hr₂_pos).mpr hw.le
              have hpow_v : ‖v_loc w‖ ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3) ≤
                  ρ_P ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3) * (‖w‖ / r₂) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3) := by
                rw [← mul_pow]
                exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hv_rat _
              have hq_pow : (‖w‖ / r₂) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3) ≤ (‖w‖ / r₂) ^ (N + 1) := by
                by_cases hw0 : w = 0
                · simp [hw0, zero_pow (by omega : 2 * (j + N) + 3 ≠ 0),
                    zero_pow (by omega : N + 1 ≠ 0)]
                · have hq_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ / r₂ := div_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0) hr₂_pos
                  exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq_pos.le hq_le1 (by omega)
              have h_idx1 : j + N + 1 = j + (N + 1) := by omega
              have h_idx2 : 2 * (j + N) + 3 = 1 + 2 * (j + (N + 1)) := by omega
              rw [h_idx1]
              calc I.p_even (j + (N + 1)) * ‖v_loc w‖ ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3)
                  ≤ I.p_even (j + (N + 1)) *
                      (ρ_P ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3) * (‖w‖ / r₂) ^ (N + 1)) := by
                    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                      (hpow_v.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_pow (by positivity)))
                      (I.p_nonneg _)
                _ = maj j := by
                    dsimp [maj]
                    rw [h_idx2, pow_add ρ_P 1, pow_one, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
                    ring
            have hnorm_sum : Summable
                (fun j : ℕ => ‖(I.p_even (j + N + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3)‖) :=
              Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) hterm_le hmaj_sum
            calc ‖∑' j : ℕ, (I.p_even (j + N + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3)‖
                ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ‖(I.p_even (j + N + 1) : ℂ) * (v_loc w) ^ (2 * (j + N) + 3)‖ :=
                  norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm_sum
              _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, maj j := hnorm_sum.tsum_le_tsum hterm_le hmaj_sum
              _ = C_Ptail * ‖w‖ ^ (N + 1) := by
                  dsimp [maj, C_Ptail]
                  rw [tsum_mul_left]
                  ring

                  (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg w) _)
                  (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) m) (L.c_nonneg n))
            _ = (r₁ ^ m)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ) ^ m * q ^ n) * (L.c n * r₂ ^ n) := by
                rw [hr₁_eq]; ring
            _ ≤ (r₁ ^ m)⁻¹ * M_q * (L.c n * r₂ ^ n) := by
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hMq_bound n) (by positivity))
                  (mul_nonneg (L.c_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg hr₂_pos.le n))
      obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀_sum, hu₀_bound⟩ := h_major k
      obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁_sum, hu₁_bound⟩ := h_major (k + 1)
      have hz_r₁ : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁ := by simpa using hz_lt_r₁
      have hsum_z_norm : Summable
          (fun n : ℕ => ‖(Nat.descFactorial n k : ℂ) * (L.c n : ℂ) * z ^ (n - k)‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (hu₀_bound z hz_r₁) hu₀_sum
      have hd_fk : HasDerivAt (f_k k) (f_k (k + 1) z) z :=
        hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu₁_sum Metric.isOpen_ball
          (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r₁).isPreconnected
          (fun n w _ => hf_term_deriv k n w)
          (fun n w hw => hu₁_bound w hw n)
          hz_r₁ (Summable.of_norm hsum_z_norm) hz_r₁
      exact ⟨hsum_z_norm, hd_fk⟩

    have hS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star) := by
      rw [← hf_zero]
      exact fun z hz => (hf_sum_and_deriv 0 z hz).2.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hS_real_cont : ContinuousOn S_real (Set.Ico 0 ρ_star) := by
      intro r hr
      have h_ev : S_real =ᶠ[nhdsWithin r (Set.Ico 0 ρ_star)] fun x : ℝ => (S (x : ℂ)).re := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.mp self_mem_nhdsWithin (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
        intro x hx
        dsimp only
        rw [hS_real_cast x hx.1 hx.2, Complex.ofReal_re]
      have hc_mem : (r : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr.1]
        exact hr.2
      have hcont_at : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => (S (x : ℂ)).re) r :=
        Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp
          ((hS_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hc_mem)).continuousAt.comp
            Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt)
      exact hcont_at.continuousWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev
        (by rw [hS_real_cast r hr.1 hr.2, Complex.ofReal_re])
    have hS_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star, iteratedDeriv k S z = f_k k z := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro z _; simp [hf_zero]
      | succ k ih =>
        intro z hz
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
        have hev : iteratedDeriv k S =ᶠ[nhds z] f_k k :=
          Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w hw => ih w hw))
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, (hf_sum_and_deriv k z hz).2.deriv]
    have hS_taylor_re : ∀ x₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ_star, ∀ k : ℕ,
        Summable (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k)) ∧
        ((iteratedDeriv k S (x₀ : ℂ) / (k.factorial : ℂ)).re) =
          ∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k) := by
      intro x₀ hx₀ k
      have hx₀_ball : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hx₀.1]
        exact hx₀.2
      have hsum_norm := (hf_sum_and_deriv k (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_ball).1
      have hsum_c : Summable
          (fun n : ℕ => (Nat.descFactorial n k : ℂ) * (L.c n : ℂ) * (x₀ : ℂ) ^ (n - k)) :=
        Summable.of_norm hsum_norm
      have hk_ne_c : (k.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
      have hterm_eq : ∀ n : ℕ,
          ((Nat.descFactorial n k : ℂ) * (L.c n : ℂ) * (x₀ : ℂ) ^ (n - k)) / (k.factorial : ℂ) =
            (((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        intro n
        rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose n k]
        push_cast
        field_simp [hk_ne_c]
      have hdiv_hs : HasSum
          (fun n : ℕ => (((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k) : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (f_k k (x₀ : ℂ) / (k.factorial : ℂ)) := by
        convert hsum_c.hasSum.div_const (k.factorial : ℂ) using 1
        ext n; exact (hterm_eq n).symm
      have hre_hs := Complex.reCLM.hasSum hdiv_hs
      have hre_fn : (fun n : ℕ =>
          Complex.reCLM (((Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k) : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          fun n => (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * L.c n * x₀ ^ (n - k) := by
        ext n; exact Complex.ofReal_re _
      rw [hre_fn] at hre_hs
      rw [hS_iter k (x₀ : ℂ) hx₀_ball]
      exact ⟨hre_hs.summable, hre_hs.tsum_eq.symm⟩

    have h_rinv_on_subball : ∀ r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ → r₁ ≤ ρ_star →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, ‖S z‖ < I.v_c) →
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, idpluWMap I (S z) = z := by
      intro r₁ hr₁_pos hr₁_le hmaps
      have hS_sub : DifferentiableOn ℂ S (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
        hS_holo.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_le)
      have hcomp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => idpluWMap I (S z))
          (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
        hFwd.w_map_holo.comp hS_sub (fun z hz => by simpa using hmaps z hz)
      have h_ana1 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => idpluWMap I (S z)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hcomp_holo
      have h_ana2 : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ id (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁) :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr differentiableOn_id
      let r_ag : ℝ := min L.r₀ r₁
      have hr_ag_pos : 0 < r_ag := lt_min L.r₀_pos hr₁_pos
      have hev0 : (fun z => idpluWMap I (S z)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] id := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr_ag_pos)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
        intro z hz
        have hz_r₀ : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r₀ :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
        exact (L.local_inv z hz_r₀).2.2
      exact h_ana1.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h_ana2
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r₁).isPreconnected (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₁_pos) hev0

    have hS_real_lt_vc : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) ρ_star, S_real ρ < I.v_c := by
      intro ρ hρ
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hρ.1 with rfl | hρ_pos_cur
      · rw [hS_real_zero]; exact I.v_c_pos
      · obtain ⟨v_ρ, hv_ρ_mem, hv_ρ_eq⟩ :=
          hFwd.w_real_surj ρ ⟨hρ.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hρ.2 hρ_le_R⟩
        let v₁ : ℝ := (v_ρ + I.v_c) / 2
        have hv₁_gt : v_ρ < v₁ := by dsimp [v₁]; linarith [hv_ρ_mem.2]
        have hv₁_lt : v₁ < I.v_c := by dsimp [v₁]; linarith [hv_ρ_mem.2]
        have hv₁_pos : 0 < v₁ := by dsimp [v₁]; linarith [hv_ρ_mem.1, I.v_c_pos]
        have hv₁_mem : v₁ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c := ⟨hv₁_pos.le, hv₁_lt⟩
        have hρ_lt_wv₁ : ρ < idpluWReal I v₁ := by
          rw [← hv_ρ_eq]
          exact hFwd.w_real_strictMono hv_ρ_mem hv₁_mem hv₁_gt
        by_contra h_ge
        push Not at h_ge
        have hcont_Icc : ContinuousOn S_real (Set.Icc 0 ρ) :=
          hS_real_cont.mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hρ.2⟩)
        have hv₁_in_range : v₁ ∈ Set.Icc (S_real 0) (S_real ρ) := by
          rw [hS_real_zero]
          exact ⟨hv₁_pos.le, hv₁_lt.le.trans h_ge⟩
        obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_icc, hr₁_eq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hρ.1 hcont_Icc hv₁_in_range
        have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr₁_icc.1 with rfl | hpos
          · rw [hS_real_zero] at hr₁_eq; linarith
          · exact hpos
        have hr₁_lt_ρstar : r₁ < ρ_star := lt_of_le_of_lt hr₁_icc.2 hρ.2
        have hmaps_r₁ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, ‖S z‖ < I.v_c := by
          intro z hz
          have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < r₁ := by simpa using hz
          calc ‖S z‖ ≤ S_real ‖z‖ := (h_sum_complex z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁_lt_ρstar.le hz)).2
            _ ≤ S_real r₁ := hS_real_mono ‖z‖ r₁ (norm_nonneg z) hz_lt.le hr₁_lt_ρstar
            _ = v₁ := hr₁_eq
            _ < I.v_c := hv₁_lt
        have h_rinv_r₁ := h_rinv_on_subball r₁ hr₁_pos hr₁_lt_ρstar.le hmaps_r₁
        have h_real_id : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₁, idpluWReal I (S_real x) = x := by
          intro x hx
          have hx_ball : (x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁ := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_pos hx.1]
            exact hx.2
          have hSx_le : S_real x ≤ v₁ := by
            rw [← hr₁_eq]
            exact hS_real_mono x r₁ hx.1.le hx.2.le hr₁_lt_ρstar
          have hSx_abs : |S_real x| < I.v_c := by
            rw [abs_of_nonneg (hS_real_nonneg x hx.1.le)]
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt hSx_le hv₁_lt
          have h1 := h_rinv_r₁ (x : ℂ) hx_ball
          rw [hS_real_cast x hx.1.le (lt_trans hx.2 hr₁_lt_ρstar),
            hFwd.w_map_real (S_real x) hSx_abs] at h1
          exact Complex.ofReal_injective h1
        let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => r₁ - r₁ / ((m : ℝ) + 2)
        have hx_mem : ∀ m : ℕ, x_seq m ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r₁ := by
          intro m
          have hm_ge2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) m]
          have hdiv_pos : 0 < r₁ / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
          have hdiv_lt : r₁ / ((m : ℝ) + 2) < r₁ := div_lt_self hr₁_pos (by linarith)
          dsimp [x_seq]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hx_tend : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds r₁) := by
          have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => r₁ / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
              (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
          simpa [x_seq] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub h0
        have hx_tend_nhdsW : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin r₁ (Set.Ico 0 ρ_star)) :=
          tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hx_tend, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m =>
            ⟨(hx_mem m).1.le, lt_trans (hx_mem m).2 hr₁_lt_ρstar⟩)⟩
        have hS_seq_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => S_real (x_seq m)) Filter.atTop (nhds v₁) := by
          rw [← hr₁_eq]
          exact (hS_real_cont r₁ ⟨hr₁_pos.le, hr₁_lt_ρstar⟩).tendsto.comp hx_tend_nhdsW
        have hS_seq_nhdsW : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => S_real (x_seq m)) Filter.atTop
            (nhdsWithin v₁ (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)) := by
          refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hS_seq_tend, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun m => ?_)⟩
          have hx_m := hx_mem m
          have hle : S_real (x_seq m) ≤ v₁ := by
            rw [← hr₁_eq]
            exact hS_real_mono (x_seq m) r₁ hx_m.1.le hx_m.2.le hr₁_lt_ρstar
          exact ⟨hS_real_nonneg (x_seq m) hx_m.1.le, lt_of_le_of_lt hle hv₁_lt⟩
        have hw_seq_tend1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => idpluWReal I (S_real (x_seq m)))
            Filter.atTop (nhds (idpluWReal I v₁)) :=
          (hFwd.w_real_cont v₁ hv₁_mem).tendsto.comp hS_seq_nhdsW
        have hw_seq_tend2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m => idpluWReal I (S_real (x_seq m)))
            Filter.atTop (nhds r₁) := by
          have heq : (fun m => idpluWReal I (S_real (x_seq m))) = x_seq := by
            ext m; exact h_real_id (x_seq m) (hx_mem m)
          rwa [heq]
        have hwv₁_eq : idpluWReal I v₁ = r₁ := tendsto_nhds_unique hw_seq_tend1 hw_seq_tend2
        linarith [hr₁_icc.2]

    have hS_maps_ρstar : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star, ‖S z‖ < I.v_c := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_lt : ‖z‖ < ρ_star := by simpa using hz
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_sum_complex z hz).2 (hS_real_lt_vc ‖z‖ ⟨norm_nonneg z, hz_lt⟩)
    have h_rinv_ρstar : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star, idpluWMap I (S z) = z :=
      h_rinv_on_subball ρ_star hρ_pos le_rfl hS_maps_ρstar
    have h_real_rinv_ρstar : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) ρ_star, idpluWReal I (S_real x) = x := by
      intro x hx
      have hx_ball : (x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hx.1]
        exact hx.2
      have hSx_abs : |S_real x| < I.v_c := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hS_real_nonneg x hx.1)]
        exact hS_real_lt_vc x hx
      have h1 := h_rinv_ρstar (x : ℂ) hx_ball
      rw [hS_real_cast x hx.1 hx.2, hFwd.w_map_real (S_real x) hSx_abs] at h1
      exact Complex.ofReal_injective h1

    have hρ_eq_R : ρ_star = R := by
      by_contra h_ne
      have hρ_lt_R : ρ_star < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hρ_le_R h_ne
      obtain ⟨v_star, hv_star_mem, hv_star_eq⟩ := hFwd.w_real_surj ρ_star ⟨hρ_pos.le, hρ_lt_R⟩
      have hv_star_pos : 0 < v_star := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hv_star_mem.1 with rfl | hpos
        · rw [hFwd.w_real_zero] at hv_star_eq; linarith
        · exact hpos
      have hv_star_ball : (v_star : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hv_star_pos]
        exact hv_star_mem.2
      have hw_ana_vs : AnalyticAt ℂ (idpluWMap I) (v_star : ℂ) :=
        ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hFwd.w_map_holo)
          (v_star : ℂ) hv_star_ball
      have hderiv_vs_ne : deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_star : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hFwd.w_map_deriv (v_star : ℂ) hv_star_ball]
        exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
          (I.P_ne_zero (v_star : ℂ) hv_star_ball)
      have hw_sderiv_vs := hw_ana_vs.hasStrictDerivAt
      let g : ℂ → ℂ :=
        hw_sderiv_vs.localInverse (idpluWMap I) (deriv (idpluWMap I) (v_star : ℂ))
          (v_star : ℂ) hderiv_vs_ne
      have hw_vs_val : idpluWMap I (v_star : ℂ) = (ρ_star : ℂ) := by
        rw [hFwd.w_map_real v_star (by rw [abs_of_pos hv_star_pos]; exact hv_star_mem.2), hv_star_eq]
      have hg_ana_ρ : AnalyticAt ℂ g (ρ_star : ℂ) := by
        have h := hw_ana_vs.analyticAt_localInverse hderiv_vs_ne
        rwa [hw_vs_val] at h
      obtain ⟨U_g, hUg_nhds, hg_ana_Ug⟩ := hg_ana_ρ.exists_mem_nhds_analyticOnNhd
      obtain ⟨r_g, hr_g_pos, hball_sub_Ug⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hUg_nhds
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (ρ_star : ℂ) r_g) :=
        ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
          (hg_ana_Ug.mono hball_sub_Ug))
      obtain ⟨r_v0, hr_v0_pos, hg_left_ball⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hw_sderiv_vs.eventually_left_inverse hderiv_vs_ne)
      let r_v : ℝ := min r_v0 (min v_star (I.v_c - v_star))
      have hr_v_pos : 0 < r_v :=
        lt_min hr_v0_pos (lt_min hv_star_pos (by linarith [hv_star_mem.2]))
      have hr_v_le_v0 : r_v ≤ r_v0 := min_le_left _ _
      have hr_v_le_vs : r_v ≤ v_star := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      let x_lo : ℝ := idpluWReal I (v_star - r_v / 2)
      have hv_lo_mem : v_star - r_v / 2 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c :=
        ⟨by linarith, by linarith [hv_star_mem.2]⟩
      have hx_lo_lt : x_lo < ρ_star := by
        rw [← hv_star_eq]
        exact hFwd.w_real_strictMono hv_lo_mem hv_star_mem (by linarith)
      have hg_eq_S_real : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo x_lo ρ_star, g (x : ℂ) = S (x : ℂ) := by
        intro x hx
        have hx_ico : x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) ρ_star := ⟨by
          have h0_le : 0 ≤ x_lo := by
            rw [← hFwd.w_real_zero]
            exact hFwd.w_real_strictMono.monotoneOn ⟨le_rfl, I.v_c_pos⟩ hv_lo_mem hv_lo_mem.1
          linarith [hx.1], hx.2⟩
        have hSx_mem : S_real x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c :=
          ⟨hS_real_nonneg x hx_ico.1, hS_real_lt_vc x hx_ico⟩
        have hwSx : idpluWReal I (S_real x) = x := h_real_rinv_ρstar x hx_ico
        have hSx_gt : v_star - r_v / 2 < S_real x := by
          by_contra hle; push Not at hle
          have := hFwd.w_real_strictMono.monotoneOn hSx_mem hv_lo_mem hle
          linarith [hx.1]
        have hSx_lt : S_real x < v_star := by
          by_contra hge; push Not at hge
          have := hFwd.w_real_strictMono.monotoneOn hv_star_mem hSx_mem hge
          linarith [hx.2, hv_star_eq]
        have hSx_in_rv0 : ((S_real x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (v_star : ℂ) r_v0 := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h_gl := hg_left_ball ((S_real x : ℝ) : ℂ) hSx_in_rv0
        rw [← hS_real_cast x hx_ico.1 hx_ico.2] at h_gl
        have hx_ball : (x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_star := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_nonneg hx_ico.1]
          exact hx_ico.2
        rwa [h_rinv_ρstar (x : ℂ) hx_ball] at h_gl
      let δ : ℝ := min (min ρ_star (R - ρ_star)) (min r_g (2 * (ρ_star - x_lo))) / 4
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by
        have h1 : 0 < min ρ_star (R - ρ_star) := lt_min hρ_pos (by linarith)
        have h2 : 0 < min r_g (2 * (ρ_star - x_lo)) := lt_min hr_g_pos (by linarith)
        dsimp [δ]; positivity

          (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
      ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
        S_loc Y = Y + Δ_ball (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) := by
    intro w_coeff D₁ S_loc hD₁ hS_holo hS_decay hw_bound hS_energy
    let lam_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball w)
    let J_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_ball w
    have h0_R : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := Metric.mem_ball_self hR_pos
    have hJ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_mod (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      (differentiableOn_const (1 : ℂ)).sub
        ((differentiableOn_id.const_mul Complex.I).mul (hΔ_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball))
    have hlam_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R,
        HasDerivAt lam_mod (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball w) * J_mod w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hd_Δ := (hΔ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_exp := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball w)).comp w
        (hd_Δ.const_mul (-Complex.I))
      have hd_prod := (hasDerivAt_id w).mul hd_exp
      convert hd_prod using 1
      · ext z; rfl
      · dsimp [J_mod]; ring
    have hlam_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ lam_mod (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      fun w hw => (hlam_hasDeriv w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hlam_zero : lam_mod 0 = 0 := by simp [lam_mod]
    have hJ_zero : J_mod 0 = 1 := by simp [J_mod]
    have hlam_deriv0 : deriv lam_mod 0 = 1 := by
      rw [(hlam_hasDeriv 0 h0_R).deriv, hΔ_zero, hJ_zero]
      simp
    obtain ⟨δ_E, hδ_E_pos, hJ_inj⟩ := hCalc.local_J_inj
    have hJ_cont0 : ContinuousAt J_mod 0 :=
      (hJ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_R)).continuousAt
    have hΔ_cont0 : ContinuousAt Δ_ball 0 :=
      (hΔ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_R)).continuousAt
    have hev_rw : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ),
        w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∧ ‖J_mod w - 1‖ < δ_E ∧ ‖Δ_ball w‖ < 1 := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.and (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hR_pos) ?_
      refine ((hJ_cont0.tendsto.eventually_mem
        (by rw [hJ_zero]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds (1 : ℂ) hδ_E_pos)).mono
          (fun w hw => by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hw)).and ?_
      exact (hΔ_cont0.tendsto.eventually_mem
        (by rw [hΔ_zero]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) zero_lt_one)).mono
          (fun w hw => by simpa using hw)
    obtain ⟨r_w, hr_w_pos, hr_w_props⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_rw
    have hlam_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ lam_mod 0 :=
      ((Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hlam_holo) 0 h0_R
    have hderiv_lam0_ne : deriv lam_mod 0 ≠ 0 := by rw [hlam_deriv0]; norm_num
    have hlam_sderiv0 := hlam_ana0.hasStrictDerivAt
    let w_of_lam : ℂ → ℂ :=
      hlam_sderiv0.localInverse lam_mod (deriv lam_mod 0) 0 hderiv_lam0_ne
    have hw_ana0 : AnalyticAt ℂ w_of_lam 0 := by
      simpa [w_of_lam, hlam_zero] using hlam_ana0.analyticAt_localInverse hderiv_lam0_ne
    have hw_deriv0 : HasDerivAt w_of_lam 1 0 := by
      have h := (hlam_sderiv0.to_localInverse hderiv_lam0_ne).hasDerivAt
      simpa [w_of_lam, hlam_zero, hlam_deriv0] using h
    have hw_zero : w_of_lam 0 = 0 := by
      have h := (hlam_sderiv0.eventually_left_inverse hderiv_lam0_ne).self_of_nhds
      rwa [hlam_zero] at h
    obtain ⟨U_w, hUw_nhds, hw_ana_Uw⟩ := hw_ana0.exists_mem_nhds_analyticOnNhd
    have hev_lam : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ),
        lam ∈ U_w ∧ w_of_lam lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧ lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) = lam := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.and hUw_nhds ?_
      refine (hw_ana0.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually_mem
        (by rw [hw_zero]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hr_w_pos)).and ?_
      simpa [w_of_lam, hlam_zero] using hlam_sderiv0.eventually_right_inverse hderiv_lam0_ne
    obtain ⟨δ_lam0, hδ_lam0_pos, hδ_lam0_props⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev_lam
    let δ_lam : ℝ := min δ_lam0 δ_E
    have hδ_lam_pos : 0 < δ_lam := lt_min hδ_lam0_pos hδ_E_pos
    have hδ_lam_le_E : δ_lam ≤ δ_E := min_le_right _ _
    have hδ_lam_le_0 : δ_lam ≤ δ_lam0 := min_le_left _ _
    have hw_of_lam_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ w_of_lam (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lam) := by
      have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lam ⊆ U_w :=
        fun lam hlam => (hδ_lam0_props lam (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_lam_le_0 hlam)).1
      exact (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
        (hw_ana_Uw.mono hsub)
    let j_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => J_mod (w_of_lam lam)
    have hj_mod_props : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lam,
        w_of_lam lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
        lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) = lam ∧
        ‖j_mod lam - 1‖ < δ_E ∧
        frozenEnergyE kind lam (j_mod lam) = 1 / 12 ∧
        lam * j_mod lam * deriv w_of_lam lam = w_of_lam lam := by
      intro lam hlam
      obtain ⟨_, hw_in_rw, hrinv⟩ := hδ_lam0_props lam (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_lam_le_0 hlam)
      obtain ⟨hw_in_R, hJ_close, _⟩ := hr_w_props (w_of_lam lam) hw_in_rw
      have henergy : frozenEnergyE kind lam (j_mod lam) = 1 / 12 := by
        have h := (h_ball_reg (w_of_lam lam) hw_in_R).1
        change frozenEnergyE kind (lam_mod (w_of_lam lam)) (j_mod lam) = 1 / 12 at h
        rwa [hrinv] at h
      have hd_w : HasDerivAt w_of_lam (deriv w_of_lam lam) lam :=
        (hw_of_lam_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hlam)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_lam : HasDerivAt lam_mod (deriv lam_mod (w_of_lam lam)) (w_of_lam lam) :=
        (hlam_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw_in_R)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_comp := hd_lam.comp lam hd_w
      have hev_id : (fun z => lam_mod (w_of_lam z)) =ᶠ[nhds lam] id :=
        Filter.Eventually.mp (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hlam)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z hz =>
            (hδ_lam0_props z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_lam_le_0 hz)).2.2))
      have h_prod_one : deriv lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) * deriv w_of_lam lam = 1 :=
        hd_comp.unique ((hasDerivAt_id lam).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev_id)
      have hw_mul_dlam : w_of_lam lam * deriv lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) = lam * j_mod lam := by
        rw [(hlam_hasDeriv (w_of_lam lam) hw_in_R).deriv]
        calc w_of_lam lam * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball (w_of_lam lam)) * J_mod (w_of_lam lam))
            = lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) * j_mod lam := by dsimp [lam_mod, j_mod]; ring
          _ = lam * j_mod lam := by rw [hrinv]
      have hode : lam * j_mod lam * deriv w_of_lam lam = w_of_lam lam := by
        calc lam * j_mod lam * deriv w_of_lam lam
            = (w_of_lam lam * deriv lam_mod (w_of_lam lam)) * deriv w_of_lam lam := by rw [hw_mul_dlam]
          _ = w_of_lam lam * (deriv lam_mod (w_of_lam lam) * deriv w_of_lam lam) := by ring
          _ = w_of_lam lam := by rw [h_prod_one, mul_one]
      exact ⟨hw_in_rw, hrinv, hJ_close, henergy, hode⟩

    let U_hp : ℝ → Set ℂ := fun D => { Y : ℂ | D < -Y.im }
    have hU_open : ∀ D : ℝ, IsOpen (U_hp D) :=
      fun D => isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im.neg
    have hU_preconn : ∀ D : ℝ, IsPreconnected (U_hp D) := by
      intro D
      refine Convex.isPreconnected (fun y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab => ?_)
      change D < -(a • y₁ + b • y₂).im
      have him : -(a • y₁ + b • y₂).im = a * (-y₁.im) + b * (-y₂.im) := by simp; ring
      rw [him]
      have hy₁' : D < -y₁.im := hy₁
      have hy₂' : D < -y₂.im := hy₂
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp only [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; linarith
      · have h1 : a * D < a * (-y₁.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁' ha_pos
        have h2 : b * D ≤ b * (-y₂.im) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂'.le hb
        have h3 : (a + b) * D < a * (-y₁.im) + b * (-y₂.im) := by linarith
        rwa [hab, one_mul] at h3
    obtain ⟨D_a, hDa_gt, hDa_decay⟩ := hS_decay (δ_E / 2) (half_pos hδ_E_pos)
    obtain ⟨D_b, hDb_gt, hDb_decay⟩ := hS_decay 1 zero_lt_one
    have h_cauchy_deriv : ∀ Y : ℂ, D_a + 2 < -Y.im → ‖deriv S_loc Y - 1‖ < δ_E := by
      intro Y hY
      let g_diff : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => S_loc Z - Z
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_diff (U_hp D₁) := hS_holo.sub differentiableOn_id
      have hcl_sub_Da : Metric.closedBall Y 1 ⊆ U_hp D_a := by
        intro Z hZ
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hZ
        have him_diff : |Z.im - Y.im| ≤ 1 := by
          have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Z - Y)
          simpa using this.trans hZ
        rw [abs_le] at him_diff
        change D_a < -Z.im
        linarith
      have hcl_sub_D₁ : Metric.closedBall Y 1 ⊆ U_hp D₁ :=
        fun Z hZ => lt_trans hDa_gt (hcl_sub_Da hZ)
      have hg_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g_diff (Metric.ball Y 1) :=
        hg_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcl_sub_D₁
      have h_sph : ∀ Z ∈ Metric.sphere Y 1, ‖g_diff Z‖ ≤ δ_E / 2 :=
        fun Z hZ => (hDa_decay Z (hcl_sub_Da (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hZ))).le
      have h_norm_le :=
        Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le zero_lt_one hg_dc h_sph
      rw [div_one] at h_norm_le
      have hY_D₁ : Y ∈ U_hp D₁ := lt_trans hDa_gt (by linarith : D_a < -Y.im)
      have hd_g : HasDerivAt g_diff (deriv S_loc Y - 1) Y :=
        ((hS_holo.differentiableAt ((hU_open D₁).mem_nhds hY_D₁)).hasDerivAt).sub (hasDerivAt_id Y)
      rw [hd_g.deriv] at h_norm_le
      linarith

    let w_Y : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)
    let Λ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y)
    have hw_Y_norm : ∀ Y : ℂ, ‖w_Y Y‖ = ‖w_coeff‖ * Real.exp Y.im := by
      intro Y
      dsimp [w_Y]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
      congr 2
      simp
    have hw_coeff_bound : ‖w_coeff‖ ≤ (R / 2) * Real.exp (D₁ + 1) := by
      let Y₀ : ℂ := -((D₁ + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hY₀_im : Y₀.im = -(D₁ + 1) := by simp [Y₀]
      have hY₀_mem : D₁ < -Y₀.im := by rw [hY₀_im]; linarith
      have hb0 : ‖w_Y Y₀‖ < R / 2 := hw_bound Y₀ hY₀_mem
      rw [hw_Y_norm Y₀, hY₀_im, Real.exp_neg] at hb0
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (D₁ + 1) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb0 hexp_pos
      have hcancel : ‖w_coeff‖ * (Real.exp (D₁ + 1))⁻¹ * Real.exp (D₁ + 1) = ‖w_coeff‖ := by
        field_simp [hexp_pos.ne']
      rw [hcancel] at hmul
      exact hmul.le
    let η_target : ℝ := min r_w (δ_lam * Real.exp (-1))
    have hη_pos : 0 < η_target := lt_min hr_w_pos (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨D_c, hDc_gt, hDc_exp⟩ :
        ∃ D_c : ℝ, D₁ + 1 < D_c ∧ (R / 2) * Real.exp (D₁ + 1 - D_c) < η_target := by
      let Dc_val : ℝ := D₁ + 2 + max 0 (Real.log (R / η_target))
      refine ⟨Dc_val, by dsimp [Dc_val]; linarith [le_max_left (0 : ℝ) (Real.log (R / η_target))], ?_⟩
      have h_arg : D₁ + 1 - Dc_val ≤ -Real.log (R / η_target) := by
        have : Real.log (R / η_target) ≤ max 0 (Real.log (R / η_target)) := le_max_right _ _
        dsimp [Dc_val]; linarith
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (D₁ + 1 - Dc_val) ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log (R / η_target)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_arg
      have hpos_div : 0 < R / η_target := div_pos hR_pos hη_pos
      rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hpos_div, inv_div] at hexp_le
      calc (R / 2) * Real.exp (D₁ + 1 - Dc_val)
          ≤ (R / 2) * (η_target / R) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le (by positivity)
        _ = η_target / 2 := by field_simp [hR_pos.ne']
        _ < η_target := half_lt_self hη_pos
    let D₃ : ℝ := max (max (D_a + 2) D_b) D_c
    have hD₃_gt_D₁ : D₁ < D₃ := lt_trans (by linarith : D₁ < D₁ + 1)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hDc_gt (le_max_right _ _))
    have h_deep_props : ∀ Y ∈ U_hp D₃,
        ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < 1 ∧
        w_Y Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ∧
        ‖Δ_ball (w_Y Y)‖ < 1 ∧
        Λ Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lam ∧
        deriv S_loc Y = j_mod (Λ Y) := by
      intro Y hY
      have hY_im : D₃ < -Y.im := hY
      have hY_Da2 : D_a + 2 < -Y.im :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hY_im
      have hY_Db : D_b < -Y.im :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hY_im
      have hY_Dc : D_c < -Y.im := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hY_im
      have hY_D₁ : D₁ < -Y.im := lt_trans hD₃_gt_D₁ hY_im
      have hS_lt1 : ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < 1 := hDb_decay Y hY_Db
      have hwY_lt_η : ‖w_Y Y‖ < η_target := by
        rw [hw_Y_norm Y]
        have hexp_lt : Real.exp Y.im < Real.exp (-D_c) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        calc ‖w_coeff‖ * Real.exp Y.im
            ≤ (R / 2) * Real.exp (D₁ + 1) * Real.exp (-D_c) :=
              mul_le_mul hw_coeff_bound hexp_lt.le (Real.exp_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (R / 2) * Real.exp (D₁ + 1 - D_c) := by
              rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
          _ < η_target := hDc_exp
      have hwY_in_rw : w_Y Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hwY_lt_η (min_le_left _ _)
      have hΔ_lt1 : ‖Δ_ball (w_Y Y)‖ < 1 := (hr_w_props (w_Y Y) hwY_in_rw).2.2
      have hΛ_split : Λ Y = w_Y Y * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)) := by
        dsimp [Λ, w_Y]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 2; ring
      have hΛ_in_δlam : Λ Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_lam := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hΛ_split, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
        have hre_le : (-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)).re ≤ 1 := by
          have h1 : (-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)).re ≤ ‖-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)‖ :=
            Complex.re_le_norm _
          rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul] at h1
          linarith
        have hexp_le_e : Real.exp ((-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)).re) ≤ Real.exp 1 :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre_le
        have hwY_lt_δe : ‖w_Y Y‖ < δ_lam * Real.exp (-1) :=
          lt_of_lt_of_le hwY_lt_η (min_le_right _ _)
        calc ‖w_Y Y‖ * Real.exp ((-Complex.I * (S_loc Y - Y)).re)
            < (δ_lam * Real.exp (-1)) * Real.exp 1 := by
              refine lt_of_le_of_lt
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le_e (norm_nonneg _))
                (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hwY_lt_δe (Real.exp_pos 1))
          _ = δ_lam := by rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
      have hΛ_lt_E : ‖Λ Y‖ < δ_E := by
        have : ‖Λ Y‖ < δ_lam := by simpa using hΛ_in_δlam
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le this hδ_lam_le_E
      have hdS_close : ‖deriv S_loc Y - 1‖ < δ_E := h_cauchy_deriv Y hY_Da2
      obtain ⟨_, _, hj_close, hj_energy, _⟩ := hj_mod_props (Λ Y) hΛ_in_δlam
      have hdS_eq_j : deriv S_loc Y = j_mod (Λ Y) :=
        hJ_inj kind (Λ Y) (deriv S_loc Y) (j_mod (Λ Y)) hΛ_lt_E hdS_close hj_close
          ((hS_energy Y hY_D₁).trans hj_energy.symm)
      exact ⟨hS_lt1, hwY_in_rw, hΔ_lt1, hΛ_in_δlam, hdS_eq_j⟩

    let F_inv : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => w_of_lam (Λ Y) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)
    have hF_hasDeriv0 : ∀ Y ∈ U_hp D₃, HasDerivAt F_inv 0 Y := by
      intro Y hY
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hΛ_in_δlam, hdS_eq_j⟩ := h_deep_props Y hY
      have hY_D₁ : Y ∈ U_hp D₁ := lt_trans hD₃_gt_D₁ hY
      have hd_S : HasDerivAt S_loc (j_mod (Λ Y)) Y := by
        rw [← hdS_eq_j]
        exact (hS_holo.differentiableAt ((hU_open D₁).mem_nhds hY_D₁)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_Λ : HasDerivAt Λ (-Complex.I * Λ Y * j_mod (Λ Y)) Y := by
        have hd_exp := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y)).comp Y
          (hd_S.const_mul (-Complex.I))
        convert hd_exp.const_mul w_coeff using 1
        dsimp [Λ]; ring
      have hd_wlam : HasDerivAt w_of_lam (deriv w_of_lam (Λ Y)) (Λ Y) :=
        (hw_of_lam_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hΛ_in_δlam)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_comp := hd_wlam.comp Y hd_Λ
      have hd_expY : HasDerivAt (fun Z : ℂ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * Z))
          (Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)) Y := by
        convert (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (Complex.I * Y)).comp Y
          ((hasDerivAt_id Y).const_mul Complex.I) using 1
        · ext Z; simp
        · ring
      have hd_prod := hd_comp.mul hd_expY
      convert hd_prod using 1
      · ext Z; rfl
      · have hode := (hj_mod_props (Λ Y) hΛ_in_δlam).2.2.2.2
        calc (0 : ℂ)
            = (-Complex.I * w_of_lam (Λ Y)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) +
                w_of_lam (Λ Y) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)) := by ring
          _ = (-Complex.I * (Λ Y * j_mod (Λ Y) * deriv w_of_lam (Λ Y))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) +
                w_of_lam (Λ Y) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)) := by rw [hode]
          _ = deriv w_of_lam (Λ Y) * (-Complex.I * Λ Y * j_mod (Λ Y)) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) +
                w_of_lam (Λ Y) * (Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)) := by ring
    have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_inv (U_hp D₃) :=
      fun Y hY => (hF_hasDeriv0 Y hY).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hF_deriv0 : Set.EqOn (deriv F_inv) 0 (U_hp D₃) :=
      fun Y hY => (hF_hasDeriv0 Y hY).deriv
    have hF_const : ∀ x ∈ U_hp D₃, ∀ y ∈ U_hp D₃, F_inv x = F_inv y :=
      fun _ hx _ hy =>
        (hU_open D₃).is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (hU_preconn D₃) hF_holo hF_deriv0 hx hy

    let Φ_sl : ℂ → ℂ := dslope w_of_lam 0
    have hΦ_mul : ∀ z : ℂ, w_of_lam z = z * Φ_sl z := by
      intro z
      have h := sub_smul_dslope w_of_lam 0 z
      simpa [Φ_sl, hw_zero] using h.symm
    have hΦ_zero : Φ_sl 0 = 1 := by
      simp [Φ_sl, dslope_same, hw_deriv0.deriv]
    have hΦ_cont0 : ContinuousAt Φ_sl 0 :=
      (continuousAt_dslope_same.mpr hw_ana0.differentiableAt)
    let Y_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => -(τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hY_ray_im : ∀ τ : ℝ, (Y_ray τ).im = -τ := by intro τ; simp [Y_ray]
    have h_ray_diff_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨D_ε, _, hD_ε⟩ := hS_decay ε hε
      refine ⟨D_ε + 1, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
      have hmem : D_ε < -(Y_ray τ).im := by rw [hY_ray_im]; linarith
      simpa [dist_zero_right] using hD_ε (Y_ray τ) hmem
    have h_Λ_ray_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Λ (Y_ray τ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have hw_ray_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => w_Y (Y_ray τ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
        have h_eq : (fun τ : ℝ => ‖w_Y (Y_ray τ)‖) = fun τ => ‖w_coeff‖ * Real.exp (-τ) := by
          ext τ; rw [hw_Y_norm, hY_ray_im]
        rw [h_eq]
        simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul
          (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot)
      have hexp_diff_tend : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        have harg : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => -Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := -Complex.I)).mul h_ray_diff_tend
          rwa [mul_zero] at h
        have hc := (Complex.continuous_exp.tendsto 0).comp harg
        rwa [Complex.exp_zero] at hc
      have h_split : (fun τ : ℝ => Λ (Y_ray τ)) =
          fun τ => w_Y (Y_ray τ) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)) := by
        ext τ; dsimp [Λ, w_Y]; rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
      rw [h_split]
      simpa using hw_ray_tend.mul hexp_diff_tend
    have h_F_ray_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => F_inv (Y_ray τ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds w_coeff) := by
      have h_eq : (fun τ : ℝ => F_inv (Y_ray τ)) =
          fun τ => Φ_sl (Λ (Y_ray τ)) * w_coeff *
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)) := by
        ext τ
        dsimp [F_inv]
        rw [hΦ_mul (Λ (Y_ray τ))]
        dsimp [Λ]
        calc (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc (Y_ray τ)) * Φ_sl (Λ (Y_ray τ))) *
                Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y_ray τ)
            = Φ_sl (Λ (Y_ray τ)) * w_coeff *
                (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc (Y_ray τ)) *
                  Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y_ray τ)) := by ring
          _ = Φ_sl (Λ (Y_ray τ)) * w_coeff *
                Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)) := by
              rw [← Complex.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
      rw [h_eq]
      have hΦ_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Φ_sl (Λ (Y_ray τ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        rw [← hΦ_zero]
        exact hΦ_cont0.tendsto.comp h_Λ_ray_tend
      have hexp_tend : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        have harg : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => -Complex.I * (S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := -Complex.I)).mul h_ray_diff_tend
          rwa [mul_zero] at h
        have hc := (Complex.continuous_exp.tendsto 0).comp harg
        rwa [Complex.exp_zero] at hc
      simpa using (hΦ_tend.mul tendsto_const_nhds).mul hexp_tend
    have hF_eq_wcoeff : ∀ Y ∈ U_hp D₃, F_inv Y = w_coeff := by
      intro Y hY
      have hev_const : (fun τ : ℝ => F_inv (Y_ray τ)) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] fun _ => F_inv Y := by
        refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨D₃ + 1, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
        have hmem : Y_ray τ ∈ U_hp D₃ := by change D₃ < -(Y_ray τ).im; rw [hY_ray_im]; linarith
        exact hF_const (Y_ray τ) hmem Y hY
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev_const.symm) h_F_ray_tend

    have h_eq_deep : ∀ Y ∈ U_hp D₃, S_loc Y = Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y) := by
      by_cases hw0 : w_coeff = 0
      · have hg_deriv0 : ∀ Y ∈ U_hp D₃, HasDerivAt (fun Z => S_loc Z - Z) 0 Y := by
          intro Y hY
          have hY_D₁ : Y ∈ U_hp D₁ := lt_trans hD₃_gt_D₁ hY
          have hΛ0 : Λ Y = 0 := by simp [Λ, hw0]
          have hdS1 : deriv S_loc Y = 1 := by
            rw [(h_deep_props Y hY).2.2.2.2, hΛ0]
            simp [j_mod, hw_zero, hJ_zero]
          have hd_S : HasDerivAt S_loc 1 Y := by
            rw [← hdS1]
            exact (hS_holo.differentiableAt ((hU_open D₁).mem_nhds hY_D₁)).hasDerivAt
          convert hd_S.sub (hasDerivAt_id Y) using 1
          · ext Z; rfl
          · norm_num
        have hg_const : ∀ x ∈ U_hp D₃, ∀ y ∈ U_hp D₃, S_loc x - x = S_loc y - y :=
          fun _ hx _ hy => (hU_open D₃).is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (hU_preconn D₃)
            (fun Y hY => (hg_deriv0 Y hY).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
            (fun Y hY => (hg_deriv0 Y hY).deriv) hx hy
        intro Y hY
        have hev_g : (fun τ : ℝ => S_loc (Y_ray τ) - Y_ray τ) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
            fun _ => S_loc Y - Y := by
          refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨D₃ + 1, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
          have hmem : Y_ray τ ∈ U_hp D₃ := by change D₃ < -(Y_ray τ).im; rw [hY_ray_im]; linarith
          exact hg_const (Y_ray τ) hmem Y hY
        have hdiff0 : S_loc Y - Y = 0 :=
          tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev_g.symm) h_ray_diff_tend
        have hSY : S_loc Y = Y := sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff0
        simp [hSY, w_Y, hw0, hΔ_zero]
      · intro Y hY
        obtain ⟨hS_lt1, _, hΔ_lt1, hΛ_in_δlam, _⟩ := h_deep_props Y hY
        have h_wof_eq : w_of_lam (Λ Y) = w_Y Y := by
          have h1 := hF_eq_wcoeff Y hY
          dsimp [F_inv] at h1
          have hexp_inv : w_of_lam (Λ Y) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) = w_of_lam (Λ Y) := by
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
            have : Complex.I * Y + -Complex.I * Y = 0 := by ring
            rw [this, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
          rw [← hexp_inv, h1]
        have hΛ_eq_lammod : Λ Y = lam_mod (w_Y Y) := by
          rw [← h_wof_eq, (hj_mod_props (Λ Y) hΛ_in_δlam).2.1]
        have hexp_eq : Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y) =
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y))) := by
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ hw0
          calc w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y)
              = Λ Y := rfl
            _ = lam_mod (w_Y Y) := hΛ_eq_lammod
            _ = w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) *
                  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) := rfl
            _ = w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y))) := by
                rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
        obtain ⟨k, hk_eq⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp hexp_eq
        have hk_lin : (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
            (Y - S_loc Y) + Δ_ball (w_Y Y) := by
          have hmulI := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => Complex.I * z) hk_eq
          have hL : Complex.I * (-Complex.I * S_loc Y) = S_loc Y := by
            calc Complex.I * (-Complex.I * S_loc Y)
                = -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * S_loc Y := by ring
              _ = S_loc Y := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
          have hR : Complex.I * (-Complex.I * (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) +
              (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
              (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) - (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
            calc Complex.I * (-Complex.I * (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) +
                    (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I))
                = -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) +
                    (Complex.I * Complex.I) * ((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) := by ring
              _ = (Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)) - (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
                  rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
          rw [hL, hR] at hmulI
          linear_combination hmulI
        have hk_norm : |(k : ℝ)| * (2 * Real.pi) < 2 := by
          have hnorm_eq : ‖(k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))‖ = |(k : ℝ)| * (2 * Real.pi) := by
            have hc : (k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) = (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              push_cast; ring
            rw [hc, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul,
              abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)]
          rw [← hnorm_eq, hk_lin]
          calc ‖(Y - S_loc Y) + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)‖
              ≤ ‖Y - S_loc Y‖ + ‖Δ_ball (w_Y Y)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ + ‖Δ_ball (w_Y Y)‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
            _ < 1 + 1 := add_lt_add hS_lt1 hΔ_lt1
            _ = 2 := by norm_num
        have hpi_gt : (2 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        have hk_abs_lt1 : |(k : ℝ)| < 1 := by nlinarith
        rw [abs_lt] at hk_abs_lt1
        have hk_gt : (-1 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk_abs_lt1.1
        have hk_lt : k < (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hk_abs_lt1.2
        have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
        rw [hk0, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hk_lin
        linear_combination hk_lin

    let S_rhs : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => Y + Δ_ball (w_Y Y)
    have hS_rhs_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_rhs (U_hp D₁) := by
      have hwY_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ w_Y (U_hp D₁) :=
        (((differentiableOn_id.const_mul (-Complex.I)).cexp).const_mul w_coeff)
      have hwY_maps : Set.MapsTo w_Y (U_hp D₁) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) := by
        intro Y hY
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_trans (hw_bound Y hY) (half_lt_self hR_pos)
      exact differentiableOn_id.add (hΔ_holo.comp hwY_holo hwY_maps)
    have h_ana_loc : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S_loc (U_hp D₁) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (hU_open D₁)).mpr hS_holo
    have h_ana_rhs : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ S_rhs (U_hp D₁) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (hU_open D₁)).mpr hS_rhs_holo
    let Y_base : ℂ := -((D₃ + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hY_base_D₃ : Y_base ∈ U_hp D₃ := by
      change D₃ < -Y_base.im; simp [Y_base]
    have hY_base_D₁ : Y_base ∈ U_hp D₁ := lt_trans hD₃_gt_D₁ hY_base_D₃
    have hev_base : S_loc =ᶠ[nhds Y_base] S_rhs :=
      Filter.Eventually.mp ((hU_open D₃).mem_nhds hY_base_D₃)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_eq_deep)
    intro Y hY
    exact h_ana_loc.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h_ana_rhs (hU_preconn D₁)
      hY_base_D₁ hev_base hY

  refine ⟨{
    R := R
    r_uniq := r_uniq
    Δ_ball := Δ_ball
    w_real := w_real
    R_pos := hR_pos
    r_uniq_pos := half_pos hR_pos
    r_uniq_lt := half_lt_self hR_pos
    Δ_ball_holo := hΔ_holo
    Δ_ball_zero := hΔ_zero
    Δ_ball_even := hΔ_even
    ball_regular_energy := h_ball_reg
    local_uniqueness := h_uniq
    w_real_cont := hFwd.w_real_cont
    w_real_tendsto := hFwd.w_real_tendsto
    w_real_props := fun r hr => by
      obtain ⟨hpos, hlt, hderiv⟩ := hFwd.w_real_props r hr
      refine ⟨hpos, hlt, hderiv, ?_⟩
      have hv_real : G.v_inv (w_real r : ℂ) = (r : ℂ) := G.v_inv_real r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩
      have hr_abs : |r| < I.v_c := by rw [abs_of_pos hr.1]; exact hr.2
      have hM_im := I.M_real r hr_abs
      have hQ_im := hFwd.Q_real r hr_abs
      have hM_eq : I.M (r : ℂ) = (((I.M (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        Complex.ext (Complex.ofReal_re _).symm (hM_im.trans (Complex.ofReal_im _).symm)
      have hQ_eq : idpluQ I (r : ℂ) = (((idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        Complex.ext (Complex.ofReal_re _).symm (hQ_im.trans (Complex.ofReal_im _).symm)
      let x_diff : ℝ := (I.M (r : ℂ)).re - (idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).re
      have hLHS : Δ_ball (w_real r : ℂ) = Complex.I * (x_diff : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [Δ_ball, x_diff]
        rw [hv_real]
        nth_rw 1 [hM_eq]
        nth_rw 1 [hQ_eq]
        push_cast; rfl
      have hquot : (2 * r * Real.exp ((I.M (r : ℂ)).re)) / w_real r = Real.exp x_diff := by
        dsimp [w_real, idpluWReal, x_diff]
        rw [Real.exp_sub]
        have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := hr.1.ne'
        have hexp_ne : Real.exp ((idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).re) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
        field_simp [hr_ne, hexp_ne]
      have hquot_c :
          ((2 * r * Real.exp ((I.M (r : ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (w_real r : ℂ) =
            ((Real.exp x_diff : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_div, hquot]
      rw [hLHS, hquot_c, ← Complex.ofReal_log (Real.exp_nonneg x_diff), Real.log_exp]
  }⟩

inner_disk_pringsheim_and_local_uniquene.definitions:
noncomputable def idpluSlopeQ {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (ξ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (fun z : ℂ => (I.P z)⁻¹) 0 ξ

noncomputable def idpluQ {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, v * idpluSlopeQ I ((t : ℂ) * v)

noncomputable def idpluWMap {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (v : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * v * Complex.exp (idpluQ I v)

noncomputable def idpluWReal {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * r * Real.exp ((idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).re)

noncomputable def idpluRadius {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) : ℝ :=
  sSup (idpluWReal I '' Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c)

structure IdpluForwardDiskMapProp {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) : Prop where
  R_pos : 0 < idpluRadius I
  R_le : idpluRadius I ≤ 2 * I.v_c
  Q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (idpluQ I) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c)
  Q_zero : idpluQ I 0 = 0
  Q_even : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c, idpluQ I (-v) = idpluQ I v
  Q_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < I.v_c → (idpluQ I (r : ℂ)).im = 0
  Q_mul_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c,
    v * deriv (idpluQ I) v = (I.P v)⁻¹ - 1
  w_map_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (idpluWMap I) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c)
  w_map_zero : idpluWMap I 0 = 0
  w_map_deriv_zero : deriv (idpluWMap I) 0 = 2
  w_map_odd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c, idpluWMap I (-v) = -idpluWMap I v
  w_map_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c,
    deriv (idpluWMap I) v = 2 * Complex.exp (idpluQ I v) / I.P v
  w_map_real : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < I.v_c → idpluWMap I (r : ℂ) = (idpluWReal I r : ℂ)
  w_real_cont : ContinuousOn (idpluWReal I) (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_strictMono : StrictMonoOn (idpluWReal I) (Set.Ico 0 I.v_c)
  w_real_zero : idpluWReal I 0 = 0
  w_real_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (idpluWReal I)
    (nhdsWithin I.v_c (Set.Iio I.v_c)) (nhds (idpluRadius I))
  w_real_surj : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (idpluRadius I),
    ∃ r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c, idpluWReal I r = y
  w_real_props : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    0 < idpluWReal I r ∧ idpluWReal I r < idpluRadius I ∧
    HasDerivAt (idpluWReal I) (idpluWReal I r / (r * (I.P (r : ℂ)).re)) r

structure IdpluLocalNonnegOddSeriesData {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  c : ℕ → ℝ
  r₀ : ℝ
  r₀_pos : 0 < r₀
  r₀_le_R : r₀ ≤ idpluRadius I
  c_zero : c 0 = 0
  c_one : c 1 = 1 / 2
  c_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ c n
  c_even_zero : ∀ k : ℕ, c (2 * k) = 0
  local_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀,
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n) ∧
    ‖∑' n : ℕ, (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n‖ < I.v_c ∧
    idpluWMap I (∑' n : ℕ, (c n : ℂ) * w ^ n) = w

structure IdpluPringsheimInverseData {kind : ExpProfileKind} (I : ModelDiskInput kind) where
  v_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  v_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ v_inv (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I))
  v_inv_zero : v_inv 0 = 0
  v_inv_odd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I), v_inv (-w) = -v_inv w
  v_inv_maps_to : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    v_inv w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) I.v_c
  w_map_v_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    idpluWMap I (v_inv w) = w
  v_inv_ode : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (idpluRadius I),
    w * deriv v_inv w = v_inv w * I.P (v_inv w)
  v_inv_real : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) I.v_c,
    v_inv (idpluWReal I r : ℂ) = (r : ℂ)
