        Complex.I * Complex.log (((2 * r * Real.exp (M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) / (w_real r : ℂ)))
    (hw_lim : Filter.Tendsto w_real (nhdsWithin Real.pi (Set.Iio Real.pi)) (nhds R)) :
    LocalSlitChartProp .firstField R Δ_ball

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hpi_gt_three : (3 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
  have hpi_c_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpi_pos.ne'
  have hR_c_ne : (R : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hR.ne'

  
  have h_seq_pos : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ →
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ρ / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ∧ ρ / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < ρ) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro ρ hρ
    refine ⟨fun n => ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      exact div_lt_self hρ (by linarith)
    · exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
        (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)

  
  have h_dslope_mul : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, f 0 = 0 → ∀ z : ℂ, f z = z * dslope f 0 z := by
    intro f hf0 z
    have h := sub_smul_dslope f 0 z
    simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, hf0] at h
    exact h.symm

  
  
  
  have hgF_pi : firstFieldG (Real.pi : ℂ) = ((3 / Real.pi ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hmul := hCalc.gF_mul (Real.pi : ℂ)
    have hsin : Complex.sin (Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_sin, Real.sin_pi, Complex.ofReal_zero]
    have hcos : Complex.cos (Real.pi : ℂ) = -1 := by
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_cos, Real.cos_pi, Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.ofReal_one]
    rw [hsin, hcos] at hmul
    have hpow_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hpi_c_ne
    calc firstFieldG (Real.pi : ℂ)
        = ((Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 3 * firstFieldG (Real.pi : ℂ)) / (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 3 := by
            field_simp [hpow_ne]
      _ = 3 * ((0 : ℂ) - (Real.pi : ℂ) * (-1)) / (Real.pi : ℂ) ^ 3 := by rw [hmul]
      _ = ((3 / Real.pi ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            push_cast
            field_simp [hpi_c_ne]
            ring

  let gTilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (firstFieldG v))
  let g_pi_re : ℝ := Real.exp ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (3 / Real.pi ^ 2))
  have hg_pi_re_pos : 0 < g_pi_re := Real.exp_pos _
  have hgTilde_pi : gTilde (Real.pi : ℂ) = (g_pi_re : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [gTilde, g_pi_re]
    rw [hgF_pi, ← Complex.ofReal_log (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / Real.pi ^ 2)]
    have hcast : (1 / 3 : ℂ) * ((Real.log (3 / Real.pi ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (((1 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (3 / Real.pi ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_exp]

  have hgF_re_cont : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℂ => (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)).re) 0 := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℂ => (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)).re) :=
      Complex.continuous_re.comp (hCalc.gF_entire.continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id))
    exact hc.continuousAt
  have hgF_re_zero : (0 : ℝ) < (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + 0)).re := by
    rw [add_zero, hgF_pi, Complex.ofReal_re]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨δ_g, hδ_g_pos, hδ_g⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hgF_re_cont.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hgF_re_zero))
  let r_v : ℝ := min δ_g (1 / 4)
  have hr_v_pos : 0 < r_v := lt_min hδ_g_pos (by norm_num)
  have hr_v_le_quarter : r_v ≤ 1 / 4 := min_le_right _ _
  have hgF_slit : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v,
      firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_g :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hu
    exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (hδ_g u hu'))
  have hgTilde_cube : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v,
      (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) ^ 3 = firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) := by
    intro u hu
    have hne : firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hgF_slit u hu)
    dsimp [gTilde]
    rw [pow_three, ← Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.exp_add]
    have hsum :
        (1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) +
          ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) +
            (1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u))) =
        Complex.log (firstFieldG ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) := by ring
    rw [hsum, Complex.exp_log hne]
  have hgTilde_real : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi,
      gTilde (r : ℂ) = ((Real.exp (M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro r hr
    have hcube := (hG_cube r hr).symm
    have hexp3 : ((Real.exp (M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 = ((Real.exp (3 * M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      norm_cast
      rw [pow_three, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1; ring
    dsimp [gTilde]
    rw [hcube, hexp3, ← Complex.ofReal_log (Real.exp_nonneg _), Real.log_exp]
    have hcast : (1 / 3 : ℂ) * ((3 * M_real r : ℝ) : ℂ) = (M_real r : ℂ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_exp]
  have hgTilde_diffAt : ∀ v : ℂ, firstFieldG v ∈ Complex.slitPlane →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ gTilde v := by
    intro v hv
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt firstFieldG (deriv firstFieldG v) v :=
      (hCalc.gF_entire v).hasDerivAt
    have hd2 := ((hd1.clog hv).const_mul (1 / 3 : ℂ)).cexp
    exact hd2.differentiableAt
  have hpi_add_ne : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v, (Real.pi : ℂ) + u ≠ 0 := by
    intro u hu h_eq
    have hu_norm : ‖u‖ < r_v := by simpa using hu
    have hu_eq : u = -(Real.pi : ℂ) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h_eq
    rw [hu_eq, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpi_pos] at hu_norm
    linarith

  
  have hw_cont : ContinuousOn w_real (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) :=
    fun r hr => (hw_deriv r hr).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hw_mono : StrictMonoOn w_real (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) := by
    refine strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) hw_cont ?_
    intro r hr_int
    have hr : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := interior_subset hr_int
    rw [(hw_deriv r hr).deriv]
    have hw_r : 0 < w_real r := hw_pos r hr
    have hsin_r : 0 < Real.sin r := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hr.1 hr.2
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := hr.1
    positivity
  have hw_lt_R : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi, w_real r < R := by
    intro r hr
    let r_mid : ℝ := (r + Real.pi) / 2
    have hr_mid_mem : r_mid ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
      dsimp [r_mid]; exact ⟨by linarith [hr.1], by linarith [hr.2]⟩
    have hr_lt_mid : r < r_mid := by dsimp [r_mid]; linarith [hr.2]
    have hlt1 : w_real r < w_real r_mid := hw_mono hr hr_mid_mem hr_lt_mid
    have hgap_pos : 0 < Real.pi - r_mid := by dsimp [r_mid]; linarith [hr.2]
    obtain ⟨hseq_bds, hseq_lim⟩ := h_seq_pos (Real.pi - r_mid) hgap_pos
    let s_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.pi - (Real.pi - r_mid) / ((n : ℝ) + 2)
    have hs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto s_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin Real.pi (Set.Iio Real.pi)) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_⟩
      · simpa [s_seq] using tendsto_const_nhds.sub hseq_lim
      · change s_seq n < Real.pi
        dsimp [s_seq]; linarith [(hseq_bds n).1]
    have hw_seq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => w_real (s_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds R) :=
      hw_lim.comp hs_tendsto
    have hw_mid_le : w_real r_mid ≤ R := by
      refine ge_of_tendsto hw_seq_tendsto (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
      have hs_gt : r_mid < s_seq n := by dsimp [s_seq]; linarith [(hseq_bds n).2]
      have hs_lt : s_seq n < Real.pi := by dsimp [s_seq]; linarith [(hseq_bds n).1]
      exact (hw_mono hr_mid_mem ⟨lt_trans hr_mid_mem.1 hs_gt, hs_lt⟩ hs_gt).le
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt1 hw_mid_le

  
  let kappa : ℂ → ℂ := fun u =>
    Complex.sin ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) /
      (((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) ^ 2)
  have hkappa_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ kappa (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v) := by
    intro u hu
    have h_shift : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (Real.pi : ℂ) + z) u :=
      (differentiableAt_id.const_add (Real.pi : ℂ))
    have h_num : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Complex.sin ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z)) u :=
      Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableAt.comp u h_shift
    have h_gt : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z)) u :=
      (hgTilde_diffAt _ (hgF_slit u hu)).comp u h_shift
    have h_den : DifferentiableAt ℂ
        (fun z : ℂ => ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z)) ^ 2) u :=
      (h_shift.pow 2).mul (h_gt.pow 2)
    have h_den_ne : ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 (hpi_add_ne u hu))
        (pow_ne_zero 2 (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
    exact (h_num.div h_den h_den_ne).differentiableWithinAt

  obtain ⟨K_raw, hK_raw⟩ := hkappa_holo.isExactOn_ball
  let K_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => K_raw u - K_raw 0
  let W_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp (K_F u)
  have hK_F_zero : K_F 0 = 0 := sub_self _
  have hW_F_zero : W_F 0 = (R : ℂ) := by simp [W_F, hK_F_zero]
  have hK_F_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v, HasDerivAt K_F (kappa u) u :=
    fun u hu => (hK_raw u hu).sub_const (K_raw 0)
  have hW_F_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v, HasDerivAt W_F (W_F u * kappa u) u := by
    intro u hu
    have hd := ((hK_F_deriv u hu).cexp).const_mul (R : ℂ)
    simpa [W_F, mul_assoc] using hd

  
  have hW_F_real_bridge : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0,
      W_F (x : ℂ) = (w_real (Real.pi + x) : ℂ) := by
    let F_bridge : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (w_real (Real.pi + y) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ))
    have hF_deriv : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0, HasDerivAt F_bridge 0 y := by
      intro y hy
      let r : ℝ := Real.pi + y
      have hr : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
        dsimp [r]; exact ⟨by linarith [hy.1], by linarith [hy.2]⟩
      have hy_ball : (y : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_neg hy.2]
        linarith [hy.1]
      let κ_r : ℝ := Real.sin r / (r ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M_real r))
      have hκ_eq : kappa (y : ℂ) = (κ_r : ℂ) := by
        have h_add : (Real.pi : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) = (r : ℂ) := by dsimp [r]; push_cast; ring
        have hexp2 : (((Real.exp (M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ^ 2 = ((Real.exp (2 * M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          norm_cast
          rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1; ring
        dsimp [kappa, κ_r]
        rw [h_add, hgTilde_real r hr, hexp2, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
        push_cast; rfl
      have hw_y : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => w_real (Real.pi + z)) (w_real r * κ_r) y := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => Real.pi + z) 1 y := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id y).const_add Real.pi
        have h2 := (hw_deriv r hr).comp y h1
        have hval : (w_real r * Real.sin r / (r ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * M_real r))) * 1 =
            w_real r * κ_r := by dsimp [κ_r]; ring
        rwa [hval] at h2
      have hw_c : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (w_real (Real.pi + z) : ℂ))
          (((w_real r * κ_r : ℝ) : ℂ)) y := hw_y.ofReal_comp
      have hK_y : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => K_F (z : ℂ)) (κ_r : ℂ) y := by
        have hd := (hK_F_deriv (y : ℂ) hy_ball).comp_ofReal
        rwa [hκ_eq] at hd
      have hexp_y : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => Complex.exp (-K_F (z : ℂ)))
          (Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ)) * -(κ_r : ℂ)) y := hK_y.neg.cexp
      have hprod : HasDerivAt F_bridge
          ((((w_real r * κ_r : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ)) +
            (w_real r : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ)) * -(κ_r : ℂ))) y :=
        hw_c.mul hexp_y
      have hzero : (((w_real r * κ_r : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ)) +
          (w_real r : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-K_F (y : ℂ)) * -(κ_r : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        push_cast; ring
      rwa [hzero] at hprod
    have hF_const : ∀ x y : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0 → y ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0 →
        F_bridge x = F_bridge y := by
      intro x y hx hy
      refine IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isOpen_Ioo isPreconnected_Ioo
        (fun z hz => (hF_deriv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
        (fun z hz => (hF_deriv z hz).deriv) hx hy
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hseq_bds, hseq_lim⟩ := h_seq_pos r_v hr_v_pos
    let y_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => -(r_v / ((n : ℝ) + 2))
    have hy_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, y_seq n ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0 := by
      intro n; dsimp [y_seq]; exact ⟨by linarith [(hseq_bds n).2], by linarith [(hseq_bds n).1]⟩
    have hy_tendsto_0 : Filter.Tendsto y_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [y_seq] using hseq_lim.neg
    have hr_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.pi + y_seq n) Filter.atTop
        (nhdsWithin Real.pi (Set.Iio Real.pi)) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_⟩
      · simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add hy_tendsto_0
      · change Real.pi + y_seq n < Real.pi
        linarith [(hy_mem n).2]
    have hw_seq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (w_real (Real.pi + y_seq n) : ℂ)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (R : ℂ)) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto R).comp (hw_lim.comp hr_tendsto)
    have hK_cont0 : ContinuousAt K_F 0 :=
      (hK_F_deriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v_pos)).continuousAt
    have hexp_seq : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Complex.exp (-K_F (y_seq n : ℂ))) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 1) := by
      have hc1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (y_seq n : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hy_tendsto_0
      have hc2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => -K_F (y_seq n : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [hK_F_zero, Function.comp_def] using (hK_cont0.tendsto.comp hc1).neg
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_exp.tendsto 0).comp hc2
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F_bridge (y_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (R : ℂ)) := by
      simpa [F_bridge] using hw_seq.mul hexp_seq
    have hF_const_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F_bridge (y_seq n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (F_bridge x)) := by
      have heq : (fun n => F_bridge (y_seq n)) = fun _ : ℕ => F_bridge x :=
        funext fun n => hF_const (y_seq n) x (hy_mem n) hx
      rw [heq]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have hFx_eq : F_bridge x = (R : ℂ) := tendsto_nhds_unique hF_const_lim hF_lim
    calc W_F (x : ℂ)
        = (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp (K_F (x : ℂ)) := rfl
      _ = F_bridge x * Complex.exp (K_F (x : ℂ)) := by rw [hFx_eq]
      _ = (w_real (Real.pi + x) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (-K_F (x : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (K_F (x : ℂ))) := by
            dsimp [F_bridge]; ring
      _ = (w_real (Real.pi + x) : ℂ) := by
            rw [← Complex.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]

  
  
  
  let A_F : ℂ → ℂ := fun u =>
    firstFieldSinc u / (((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) ^ 2)
  have hkappa_eq_AF : ∀ u : ℂ, kappa u = -u * A_F u := by
    intro u
    have hsin : Complex.sin ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) = -(u * firstFieldSinc u) := by
      rw [add_comm, Complex.sin_add_pi, ← hCalc.sinc_mul u]
    dsimp [kappa, A_F]
    rw [hsin]
    ring
  have hAF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A_F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v) := by
    intro u hu
    have h_shift : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (Real.pi : ℂ) + z) u :=
      differentiableAt_id.const_add (Real.pi : ℂ)
    have h_gt : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z)) u :=
      (hgTilde_diffAt _ (hgF_slit u hu)).comp u h_shift
    have h_den : DifferentiableAt ℂ
        (fun z : ℂ => ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + z)) ^ 2) u :=
      (h_shift.pow 2).mul (h_gt.pow 2)
    have h_den_ne : ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u) ^ 2 * (gTilde ((Real.pi : ℂ) + u)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 (hpi_add_ne u hu))
        (pow_ne_zero 2 (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
    exact ((hCalc.sinc_entire u).div h_den h_den_ne).differentiableWithinAt

  let F_diff : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (R : ℂ) - W_F u
  have hF_diff_zero : F_diff 0 = 0 := by simp [F_diff, hW_F_zero]
  have hF_diff_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v,
      HasDerivAt F_diff (u * (W_F u * A_F u)) u := by
    intro u hu
    have hd := (hW_F_deriv u hu).const_sub (R : ℂ)
    have hval : -(W_F u * kappa u) = u * (W_F u * A_F u) := by rw [hkappa_eq_AF u]; ring
    simpa [F_diff, hval] using hd
  have hF_diff_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_diff (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v) :=
    fun u hu => (hF_diff_deriv u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  let f₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope F_diff 0
  let Ψ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope f₁ 0
  have hf₁_zero : f₁ 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp [f₁]
    rw [dslope_same, (hF_diff_deriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v_pos)).deriv]
    ring
  have hF_eq_Ψ : ∀ u : ℂ, (R : ℂ) - W_F u = u ^ 2 * Ψ u := by
    intro u
    have h1 := h_dslope_mul F_diff hF_diff_zero u
    have h2 := h_dslope_mul f₁ hf₁_zero u
    dsimp [F_diff, f₁, Ψ] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring
  have hball_nhds_rv : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_v_pos
  have hf₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rv).mpr hF_diff_holo
  have hΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rv).mpr hf₁_holo
  have hΨ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ Ψ 0 :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hΨ_holo 0
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v_pos)

  have h2Ψ0 : 2 * Ψ 0 = W_F 0 * A_F 0 := by
    have h_ident : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v, u ≠ 0 →
        2 * Ψ u + u * deriv Ψ u = W_F u * A_F u := by
      intro u hu hu_ne
      have hd_Ψ : HasDerivAt Ψ (deriv Ψ u) u :=
        (hΨ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_u2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2) (2 * u) u := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 u)
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt F_diff (2 * u * Ψ u + u ^ 2 * deriv Ψ u) u := by
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2 * Ψ z) (2 * u * Ψ u + u ^ 2 * deriv Ψ u) u :=
          hd_u2.mul hd_Ψ
        have hfun : (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2 * Ψ z) = F_diff := funext fun z => (hF_eq_Ψ z).symm
        rwa [hfun] at hp
      have heq_d := hd_prod.unique (hF_diff_deriv u hu)
      have hmul_u : u * (2 * Ψ u + u * deriv Ψ u) = u * (W_F u * A_F u) := by
        linear_combination heq_d
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hu_ne hmul_u
    obtain ⟨hseq_bds, hseq_lim⟩ := h_seq_pos r_v hr_v_pos
    let u_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r_v / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hu_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto u_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      dsimp only [u_seq]
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hseq_lim
    have h_lhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 2 * Ψ (u_seq n) + u_seq n * deriv Ψ (u_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * Ψ 0)) := by
      have h1 := (hΨ_ana.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hu_tendsto).const_mul (2 : ℂ)
      have h2 := hu_tendsto.mul (hΨ_ana.deriv.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hu_tendsto)
      simpa using h1.add h2
    have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => W_F (u_seq n) * A_F (u_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (W_F 0 * A_F 0)) := by
      have hW_c : ContinuousAt W_F 0 :=
        (hW_F_deriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v_pos)).continuousAt
      have hA_c : ContinuousAt A_F 0 :=
        (hAF_holo.differentiableAt hball_nhds_rv).continuousAt
      exact (hW_c.tendsto.comp hu_tendsto).mul (hA_c.tendsto.comp hu_tendsto)
    have h_eq_seq : (fun n => 2 * Ψ (u_seq n) + u_seq n * deriv Ψ (u_seq n)) =
        (fun n => W_F (u_seq n) * A_F (u_seq n)) := by
      ext n
      apply h_ident (u_seq n)
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (hseq_bds n).1]
        exact (hseq_bds n).2
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hseq_bds n).1.ne'
    rw [h_eq_seq] at h_lhs
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs h_rhs

  have hΨ0_val : Ψ 0 = ((R / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * g_pi_re ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    have hA0 : W_F 0 * A_F 0 = ((R / (Real.pi ^ 2 * g_pi_re ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [A_F]
      rw [hW_F_zero, hCalc.sinc_zero, add_zero, hgTilde_pi]
      push_cast; field_simp [hpi_c_ne, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hg_pi_re_pos.ne']
    rw [hA0] at h2Ψ0
    calc Ψ 0 = (2 * Ψ 0) / 2 := by ring
      _ = ((R / (Real.pi ^ 2 * g_pi_re ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2 := by rw [h2Ψ0]
      _ = ((R / (2 * Real.pi ^ 2 * g_pi_re ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hΨ0_re_pos : 0 < (Ψ 0).re := by
    rw [hΨ0_val, Complex.ofReal_re]
    positivity

  
  have hΨ_re_cont : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℂ => (Ψ u).re) 0 :=
    Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp hΨ_ana.continuousAt
  obtain ⟨δ_Ψ, hδ_Ψ_pos, hδ_Ψ⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hΨ_re_cont.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hΨ0_re_pos))
  let r_v1 : ℝ := min r_v δ_Ψ
  have hr_v1_pos : 0 < r_v1 := lt_min hr_v_pos hδ_Ψ_pos
  have hr_v1_le_rv : r_v1 ≤ r_v := min_le_left _ _
  have hΨ_slit : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1, Ψ u ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro u hu
    exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl
      (hδ_Ψ u (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu)))

  let σ_map : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => u * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u))
  let sigmaIn : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w))
  let sigmaOut : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.I * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ)))
  have hσ_map_zero : σ_map 0 = 0 := by simp [σ_map]
  have hσ_map_sq : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1, (σ_map u) ^ 2 = (R : ℂ) - W_F u := by
    intro u hu
    have hΨ_ne : Ψ u ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hΨ_slit u hu)
    dsimp [σ_map]
    rw [mul_pow, pow_two (Complex.exp _), ← Complex.exp_add]
    have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u) =
        Complex.log (Ψ u) := by ring
    rw [hhalf, Complex.exp_log hΨ_ne, hF_eq_Ψ u]
  have hσ_map_deriv_at : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1,
      HasDerivAt σ_map
        (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u)) +
          u * (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u)) *
            ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (deriv Ψ u / Ψ u)))) u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_rv : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_v1_le_rv hu
    have hd_Ψ : HasDerivAt Ψ (deriv Ψ u) u :=
      (hΨ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_rv)).hasDerivAt
    have hd_exp := ((hd_Ψ.clog (hΨ_slit u hu)).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ)).cexp
    have hp : HasDerivAt σ_map
        (1 * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u)) +
          u * (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ u)) *
            ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (deriv Ψ u / Ψ u)))) u :=
      (hasDerivAt_id u).mul hd_exp
    rwa [one_mul] at hp
  have hσ_map_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ_map (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1) :=
    fun u hu => (hσ_map_deriv_at u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hσ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ σ_map 0 :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hσ_map_holo 0
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v1_pos)
  have hdσ0_ne : deriv σ_map 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have hd0 := (hσ_map_deriv_at 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_v1_pos)).deriv
    rw [hd0, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _

  
  have hσ_map_neg_real : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v1) 0,
      σ_map (x : ℂ) = sigmaIn ((w_real (Real.pi + x)) : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_rv : x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0 := ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (neg_le_neg hr_v1_le_rv) hx.1, hx.2⟩
    let r : ℝ := Real.pi + x
    have hr : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
      dsimp [r]; exact ⟨by linarith [hx_rv.1], by linarith [hx_rv.2]⟩
    let w_x : ℝ := w_real r
    have hw_x_lt : w_x < R := hw_lt_R r hr
    have hRw_pos : 0 < R - w_x := sub_pos.mpr hw_x_lt
    have hnx_pos : 0 < -x := neg_pos.mpr hx.2
    have hx_c_ne : (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx.2.ne
    have hΨ_x : Ψ (x : ℂ) = (((R - w_x) / (-x) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hsq := hF_eq_Ψ (x : ℂ)
      rw [hW_F_real_bridge x hx_rv] at hsq
      have hpow_ne : (x : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hx_c_ne
      calc Ψ (x : ℂ)
          = ((x : ℂ) ^ 2 * Ψ (x : ℂ)) / (x : ℂ) ^ 2 := by field_simp [hpow_ne]
        _ = ((R : ℂ) - (w_x : ℂ)) / (x : ℂ) ^ 2 := by rw [← hsq]
        _ = (((R - w_x) / (-x) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    have hlog_Ψ : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ (x : ℂ)) =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - (w_x : ℂ)) - ((Real.log (-x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hRw_eq : (R : ℂ) - (w_x : ℂ) = ((R - w_x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hΨ_x, hRw_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_log (by positivity),
        ← Complex.ofReal_log hRw_pos.le,
        Real.log_div hRw_pos.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 hnx_pos.ne'), Real.log_pow]
      push_cast; ring
    dsimp [σ_map, sigmaIn]
    change (x : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ψ (x : ℂ))) =
      -Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - (w_x : ℂ)))
    rw [hlog_Ψ, Complex.exp_sub, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log hnx_pos]
    have hnx_ne : ((-x : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hnx_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hnx_ne]
    push_cast; ring

  
  let hf_strict := hσ_ana.hasStrictDerivAt
  let U_inv : ℂ → ℂ := hf_strict.localInverse σ_map (deriv σ_map 0) 0 hdσ0_ne
  have hU_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ U_inv 0 := by
    have ha := hσ_ana.analyticAt_localInverse hdσ0_ne
    simpa [U_inv, hf_strict, hσ_map_zero] using ha
  have hU_zero : U_inv 0 = 0 := by
    have h0 : U_inv (σ_map 0) = 0 := (hf_strict.eventually_left_inverse hdσ0_ne).self_of_nhds
    simpa [hσ_map_zero] using h0
  have hU_deriv0_ne : deriv U_inv 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have hd : HasDerivAt U_inv (deriv σ_map 0)⁻¹ 0 := by
      simpa [U_inv, hσ_map_zero] using (hf_strict.to_localInverse hdσ0_ne).hasDerivAt
    rw [hd.deriv]
    exact inv_ne_zero hdσ0_ne

  have hev_U_diff : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds (0 : ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℂ U_inv σ :=
    hU_ana.eventually_analyticAt.mono fun _ h => h.differentiableAt
  have hev_U_right : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds (0 : ℂ), σ_map (U_inv σ) = σ := by
    simpa [U_inv, hσ_map_zero] using hf_strict.eventually_right_inverse hdσ0_ne
  have hev_U_ball : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds (0 : ℂ), U_inv σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1 := by
    have hc := hU_ana.continuousAt.tendsto
    rw [hU_zero] at hc
    exact hc.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_v1_pos)
  obtain ⟨r_σ_raw, hr_σ_raw_pos, hr_σ_raw⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    ((hev_U_diff.and hev_U_right).and hev_U_ball)
  let r_σ0 : ℝ := min r_σ_raw (Real.sqrt (R / 4))
  have hr_σ0_pos : 0 < r_σ0 := lt_min hr_σ_raw_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  have hr_σ0_sq : r_σ0 ^ 2 < R / 2 := by
    have hle : r_σ0 ≤ Real.sqrt (R / 4) := min_le_right _ _
    have hsq : r_σ0 ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (R / 4)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr_σ0_pos.le hle 2
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at hsq
    linarith
  have hU_props0 : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ U_inv σ ∧
      U_inv σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v1 ∧
      W_F (U_inv σ) = (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ_raw :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hσ
    obtain ⟨⟨hd, hright⟩, hmem⟩ := hr_σ_raw σ hσ'
    refine ⟨hd, hmem, ?_⟩
    have hsq := hσ_map_sq (U_inv σ) hmem
    rw [hright] at hsq
    linear_combination hsq

  
  let v_σ : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => (Real.pi : ℂ) + U_inv σ
  let lam_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => 2 * v_σ σ * gTilde (v_σ σ)
  have hU_in_rv : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, U_inv σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_v :=
    fun σ hσ => Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_v1_le_rv (hU_props0 σ hσ).2.1
  have hv_σ_ne : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, v_σ σ ≠ 0 :=
    fun σ hσ => hpi_add_ne (U_inv σ) (hU_in_rv σ hσ)
  have hlam_tilde_ne : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, lam_tilde σ ≠ 0 :=
    fun σ hσ => mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hv_σ_ne σ hσ)) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have hR_sub_sq_ne : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro σ hσ h_eq
    have hσ_norm : ‖σ‖ < r_σ0 := by simpa using hσ
    have hσ_sq_lt : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 < R / 2 := by
      have : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 ≤ r_σ0 ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg σ) hσ_norm.le 2
      linarith
    have hR_eq : (R : ℂ) = σ ^ 2 := sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
    have hnorm := congrArg norm hR_eq
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR, norm_pow] at hnorm
    linarith
  have hlam_tilde_diffAt : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, DifferentiableAt ℂ lam_tilde σ := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hv_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ v_σ σ := (hU_props0 σ hσ).1.const_add (Real.pi : ℂ)
    have hgt_d : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => gTilde (v_σ z)) σ :=
      (hgTilde_diffAt (v_σ σ) (hgF_slit (U_inv σ) (hU_in_rv σ hσ))).comp σ hv_d
    exact (hv_d.const_mul 2).mul hgt_d
  have hlam_tilde_cube : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0,
      (lam_tilde σ) ^ 3 = 24 * (Complex.sin (v_σ σ) - v_σ σ * Complex.cos (v_σ σ)) := by
    intro σ hσ
    calc (lam_tilde σ) ^ 3
        = 8 * ((v_σ σ) ^ 3 * (gTilde (v_σ σ)) ^ 3) := by dsimp [lam_tilde]; ring
      _ = 8 * ((v_σ σ) ^ 3 * firstFieldG (v_σ σ)) := by
            rw [hgTilde_cube (U_inv σ) (hU_in_rv σ hσ)]
      _ = 24 * (Complex.sin (v_σ σ) - v_σ σ * Complex.cos (v_σ σ)) := by
            rw [hCalc.gF_mul (v_σ σ)]; ring

  have hlam_tilde_deriv : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0,
      HasDerivAt lam_tilde (-4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)) σ := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hd_U : HasDerivAt U_inv (deriv U_inv σ) σ := (hU_props0 σ hσ).1.hasDerivAt
    have hd_v : HasDerivAt v_σ (deriv U_inv σ) σ := by
      simpa [v_σ] using hd_U.const_add (Real.pi : ℂ)
    have hd_lam : HasDerivAt lam_tilde (deriv lam_tilde σ) σ :=
      (hlam_tilde_diffAt σ hσ).hasDerivAt
    have hd_cube_lhs : HasDerivAt (fun z => (lam_tilde z) ^ 3)
        (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 * deriv lam_tilde σ) σ := by
      have hp : HasDerivAt (fun z => (lam_tilde z) ^ 3)
          (((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (lam_tilde σ) ^ (3 - 1) * deriv lam_tilde σ) σ :=
        hd_lam.pow 3
      norm_num at hp
      exact hp
    have hd_trig : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 24 * (Complex.sin w - w * Complex.cos w))
        (24 * (v_σ σ * Complex.sin (v_σ σ))) (v_σ σ) := by
      have h1 := Complex.hasDerivAt_sin (v_σ σ)
      have h2 := (hasDerivAt_id (v_σ σ)).mul (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (v_σ σ))
      have h3 := (h1.sub h2).const_mul (24 : ℂ)
      have hval : (24 : ℂ) * (Complex.cos (v_σ σ) -
          (1 * Complex.cos (v_σ σ) + v_σ σ * -Complex.sin (v_σ σ))) =
          24 * (v_σ σ * Complex.sin (v_σ σ)) := by ring
      simpa [id_eq, hval] using h3
    have hd_cube_rhs : HasDerivAt
        (fun z => 24 * (Complex.sin (v_σ z) - v_σ z * Complex.cos (v_σ z)))
        (24 * (v_σ σ * Complex.sin (v_σ σ)) * deriv U_inv σ) σ :=
      hd_trig.comp σ hd_v
    have hev_cube : (fun z => (lam_tilde z) ^ 3) =ᶠ[nhds σ]
        (fun z => 24 * (Complex.sin (v_σ z) - v_σ z * Complex.cos (v_σ z))) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hσ) hlam_tilde_cube
    have hEqA : 3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 * deriv lam_tilde σ =
        24 * (v_σ σ * Complex.sin (v_σ σ)) * deriv U_inv σ :=
      (hev_cube.hasDerivAt_iff.mp hd_cube_lhs).unique hd_cube_rhs
    have hd_WF_lhs : HasDerivAt (fun z => W_F (U_inv z))
        ((W_F (U_inv σ) * kappa (U_inv σ)) * deriv U_inv σ) σ :=
      (hW_F_deriv (U_inv σ) (hU_in_rv σ hσ)).comp σ hd_U
    have hd_WF_rhs : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z ^ 2) (-2 * σ) σ := by
      have hp := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 σ).const_sub (R : ℂ)
      simpa using hp
    have hev_WF : (fun z => W_F (U_inv z)) =ᶠ[nhds σ] (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z ^ 2) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hσ)
        (fun z hz => (hU_props0 z hz).2.2)
    have hEqB_raw : (W_F (U_inv σ) * kappa (U_inv σ)) * deriv U_inv σ = -2 * σ :=
      (hev_WF.hasDerivAt_iff.mp hd_WF_lhs).unique hd_WF_rhs
    rw [(hU_props0 σ hσ).2.2] at hEqB_raw
    have hkappa_lam : kappa (U_inv σ) * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 = 4 * Complex.sin (v_σ σ) := by
      have hv_ne : v_σ σ ≠ 0 := hv_σ_ne σ hσ
      have hgt_ne : gTilde (v_σ σ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      change (Complex.sin (v_σ σ) / ((v_σ σ) ^ 2 * (gTilde (v_σ σ)) ^ 2)) *
        (2 * v_σ σ * gTilde (v_σ σ)) ^ 2 = 4 * Complex.sin (v_σ σ)
      field_simp [hv_ne, hgt_ne]
      ring
    have hEqB : 4 * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * Complex.sin (v_σ σ) * deriv U_inv σ =
        -2 * σ * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 := by
      calc 4 * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * Complex.sin (v_σ σ) * deriv U_inv σ
          = ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * (kappa (U_inv σ) * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) * deriv U_inv σ := by
              rw [hkappa_lam]; ring
        _ = (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * kappa (U_inv σ) * deriv U_inv σ) * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = -2 * σ * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 := by rw [hEqB_raw]
    have hcomb : (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) * (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * deriv lam_tilde σ) =
        (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) * (-4 * v_σ σ * σ) := by
      calc (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) * (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * deriv lam_tilde σ)
          = ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 * deriv lam_tilde σ) := by ring
        _ = ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * (24 * (v_σ σ * Complex.sin (v_σ σ)) * deriv U_inv σ) := by
              rw [hEqA]
        _ = 6 * v_σ σ * (4 * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * Complex.sin (v_σ σ) * deriv U_inv σ) := by ring
        _ = 6 * v_σ σ * (-2 * σ * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) := by rw [hEqB]
        _ = (3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2) * (-4 * v_σ σ * σ) := by ring
    have h3lam_ne : 3 * (lam_tilde σ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 (hlam_tilde_ne σ hσ))
    have hmul_eq : ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * deriv lam_tilde σ = -4 * v_σ σ * σ :=
      mul_left_cancel₀ h3lam_ne hcomb
    have hderiv_val : deriv lam_tilde σ = -4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) := by
      have hw_ne := hR_sub_sq_ne σ hσ
      calc deriv lam_tilde σ
          = (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * deriv lam_tilde σ) / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) := by
              field_simp [hw_ne]
        _ = -4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) := by rw [hmul_eq]
    rwa [hderiv_val] at hd_lam

  
  let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope U_inv 0
  have hU_eq_g₁ : ∀ σ : ℂ, U_inv σ = σ * g₁ σ := h_dslope_mul U_inv hU_zero
  have hg₁_zero : g₁ 0 = deriv U_inv 0 := dslope_same U_inv 0
  have hball_nhds_rσ0 : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0 ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
    Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_σ0_pos
  have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rσ0).mpr
      (fun σ hσ => (hU_props0 σ hσ).1.differentiableWithinAt)
  have hg₁_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ g₁ 0 :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hg₁_holo 0
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_σ0_pos)

  let D_lam : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => lam_tilde (-σ) - lam_tilde σ
  let H_odd : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => 4 * (g₁ σ + g₁ (-σ)) / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)
  have hD_lam_zero : D_lam 0 = 0 := by simp [D_lam]
  have hD_lam_deriv : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0,
      HasDerivAt D_lam (σ ^ 2 * H_odd σ) σ := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hnσ : -σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0 := by simpa using hσ
    have hd_neg : HasDerivAt (fun z => lam_tilde (-z))
        ((-4 * v_σ (-σ) * (-σ) / ((R : ℂ) - (-σ) ^ 2)) * (-1)) σ :=
      (hlam_tilde_deriv (-σ) hnσ).comp σ (hasDerivAt_id σ).neg
    have hd_diff : HasDerivAt D_lam
        (((-4 * v_σ (-σ) * (-σ) / ((R : ℂ) - (-σ) ^ 2)) * (-1)) -
          (-4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2))) σ :=
      hd_neg.sub (hlam_tilde_deriv σ hσ)
    have hval : ((-4 * v_σ (-σ) * (-σ) / ((R : ℂ) - (-σ) ^ 2)) * (-1)) -
        (-4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)) = σ ^ 2 * H_odd σ := by
      have hw_ne := hR_sub_sq_ne σ hσ
      dsimp [H_odd, v_σ]
      rw [hU_eq_g₁ σ, hU_eq_g₁ (-σ), neg_sq]
      field_simp [hw_ne]
      ring
    rwa [hval] at hd_diff
  have hD_lam_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_lam (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0) :=
    fun σ hσ => (hD_lam_deriv σ hσ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  let d₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope D_lam 0
  let d₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope d₁ 0
  let d₃ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope d₂ 0
  have hd₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rσ0).mpr hD_lam_holo
  have hd₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rσ0).mpr hd₁_holo
  have hd₃_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₃ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hball_nhds_rσ0).mpr hd₂_holo
  have hd₂_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ d₂ 0 :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hd₂_holo 0
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_σ0_pos)
  have hd₃_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ d₃ 0 :=
    (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr hd₃_holo 0
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_σ0_pos)

  have hd₁_zero : d₁ 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp [d₁]
    rw [dslope_same, (hD_lam_deriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_σ0_pos)).deriv]
    ring
  have hD_eq_d₂ : ∀ σ : ℂ, D_lam σ = σ ^ 2 * d₂ σ := by
    intro σ
    have h1 := h_dslope_mul D_lam hD_lam_zero σ
    have h2 := h_dslope_mul d₁ hd₁_zero σ
    dsimp [d₁, d₂] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [h1, h2]; ring
  have hH_odd_cont0 : ContinuousAt H_odd 0 := by
    have hg_pos : ContinuousAt g₁ 0 := hg₁_ana.continuousAt
    have hg_neg : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => g₁ (-z)) 0 := by
      have h0 : ContinuousAt g₁ (-(0 : ℂ)) := by simpa using hg₁_ana.continuousAt
      exact h0.comp continuous_neg.continuousAt
    have hnum : ContinuousAt (fun z => 4 * (g₁ z + g₁ (-z))) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.mul (hg_pos.add hg_neg)
    have hden : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z ^ 2) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.sub (continuous_pow 2).continuousAt
    exact hnum.div hden (by simpa using hR_c_ne)

  obtain ⟨hσseq_bds, hσseq_lim⟩ := h_seq_pos r_σ0 hr_σ0_pos
  let σ_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r_σ0 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have hσ_seq_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, σ_seq n ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0 ∧ σ_seq n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨?_, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hσseq_bds n).1.ne'⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (hσseq_bds n).1]
    exact (hσseq_bds n).2
  have hσ_seq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto σ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
    dsimp only [σ_seq]
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hσseq_lim

  have hd₂_zero : d₂ 0 = 0 := by
    have h_ident2 : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, σ ≠ 0 →
        2 * d₂ σ + σ * deriv d₂ σ = σ * H_odd σ := by
      intro σ hσ hσ_ne
      have hd_d₂ : HasDerivAt d₂ (deriv d₂ σ) σ :=
        (hd₂_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hσ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_s2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2) (2 * σ) σ := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 σ)
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt D_lam (2 * σ * d₂ σ + σ ^ 2 * deriv d₂ σ) σ := by
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2 * d₂ z) (2 * σ * d₂ σ + σ ^ 2 * deriv d₂ σ) σ :=
          hd_s2.mul hd_d₂
        have hfun : (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2 * d₂ z) = D_lam := funext fun z => (hD_eq_d₂ z).symm
        rwa [hfun] at hp
      have heq_d := hd_prod.unique (hD_lam_deriv σ hσ)
      have hmul : σ * (2 * d₂ σ + σ * deriv d₂ σ) = σ * (σ * H_odd σ) := by
        linear_combination heq_d
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hσ_ne hmul
    have h_lhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 2 * d₂ (σ_seq n) + σ_seq n * deriv d₂ (σ_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * d₂ 0)) := by
      have h1 := (hd₂_ana.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto).const_mul (2 : ℂ)
      have h2 := hσ_seq_tendsto.mul (hd₂_ana.deriv.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto)
      simpa using h1.add h2
    have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => σ_seq n * H_odd (σ_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hσ_seq_tendsto.mul (hH_odd_cont0.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto)
    have h_eq_seq : (fun n => 2 * d₂ (σ_seq n) + σ_seq n * deriv d₂ (σ_seq n)) =
        (fun n => σ_seq n * H_odd (σ_seq n)) :=
      funext fun n => h_ident2 (σ_seq n) (hσ_seq_mem n).1 (hσ_seq_mem n).2
    rw [h_eq_seq] at h_lhs
    have h2d2 : 2 * d₂ 0 = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs h_rhs
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2d2).resolve_left two_ne_zero

  have hD_eq_d₃ : ∀ σ : ℂ, D_lam σ = σ ^ 3 * d₃ σ := by
    intro σ
    have h3 := h_dslope_mul d₂ hd₂_zero σ
    dsimp [d₃] at h3 ⊢
    rw [hD_eq_d₂ σ, h3]; ring

  have hd₃0_ne : d₃ 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have h_ident3 : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0, σ ≠ 0 →
        3 * d₃ σ + σ * deriv d₃ σ = H_odd σ := by
      intro σ hσ hσ_ne
      have hd_d₃ : HasDerivAt d₃ (deriv d₃ σ) σ :=
        (hd₃_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hσ)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_s3 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 3) (3 * σ ^ 2) σ := by
        simpa [Nat.cast_ofNat] using (hasDerivAt_pow 3 σ)
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt D_lam (3 * σ ^ 2 * d₃ σ + σ ^ 3 * deriv d₃ σ) σ := by
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 3 * d₃ z) (3 * σ ^ 2 * d₃ σ + σ ^ 3 * deriv d₃ σ) σ :=
          hd_s3.mul hd_d₃
        have hfun : (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 3 * d₃ z) = D_lam := funext fun z => (hD_eq_d₃ z).symm
        rwa [hfun] at hp
      have heq_d := hd_prod.unique (hD_lam_deriv σ hσ)
      have hmul : σ ^ 2 * (3 * d₃ σ + σ * deriv d₃ σ) = σ ^ 2 * H_odd σ := by
        linear_combination heq_d
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hσ_ne) hmul
    have h_lhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 3 * d₃ (σ_seq n) + σ_seq n * deriv d₃ (σ_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (3 * d₃ 0)) := by
      have h1 := (hd₃_ana.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto).const_mul (3 : ℂ)
      have h2 := hσ_seq_tendsto.mul (hd₃_ana.deriv.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto)
      simpa using h1.add h2
    have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => H_odd (σ_seq n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (H_odd 0)) :=
      hH_odd_cont0.tendsto.comp hσ_seq_tendsto
    have h_eq_seq : (fun n => 3 * d₃ (σ_seq n) + σ_seq n * deriv d₃ (σ_seq n)) =
        (fun n => H_odd (σ_seq n)) :=
      funext fun n => h_ident3 (σ_seq n) (hσ_seq_mem n).1 (hσ_seq_mem n).2
    rw [h_eq_seq] at h_lhs
    have h3d3 : 3 * d₃ 0 = H_odd 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs h_rhs
    have hH0_ne : H_odd 0 ≠ 0 := by
      have h_num : 4 * (g₁ 0 + g₁ (-0)) = 8 * deriv U_inv 0 := by
        rw [neg_zero, hg₁_zero]; ring
      dsimp [H_odd]
      rw [h_num, zero_pow two_ne_zero, sub_zero]
      exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hU_deriv0_ne) hR_c_ne
    intro hd3_eq
    rw [hd3_eq, mul_zero] at h3d3
    exact hH0_ne h3d3.symm

  
  let q_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => lam_tilde σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)
  have hq0_re_pos : 0 < (q_tilde 0).re := by
    have hq0 : q_tilde 0 = ((2 * Real.pi * g_pi_re / R : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [q_tilde, lam_tilde, v_σ]
      rw [hU_zero, add_zero, hgTilde_pi, zero_pow two_ne_zero, sub_zero]
      push_cast; ring
    rw [hq0, Complex.ofReal_re]
    positivity
  have hq_cont0 : ContinuousAt (fun σ : ℂ => (q_tilde σ).re) 0 := by
    have hlam_c : ContinuousAt lam_tilde 0 :=
      (hlam_tilde_diffAt 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_σ0_pos)).continuousAt
    have hden_c : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z ^ 2) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.sub (continuous_pow 2).continuousAt
    exact Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp (hlam_c.div hden_c (by simpa using hR_c_ne))
  have hev_q_pos : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds (0 : ℂ), 0 < (q_tilde σ).re :=
    hq_cont0.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hq0_re_pos)
  have hev_d3_ne : ∀ᶠ σ in nhds (0 : ℂ), d₃ σ ≠ 0 :=
    hd₃_ana.continuousAt.eventually_ne hd₃0_ne
  obtain ⟨r_σ_sub, hr_σ_sub_pos, hr_σ_sub⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hev_q_pos.and hev_d3_ne)
  let r_σ : ℝ := min r_σ0 r_σ_sub
  have hr_σ_pos : 0 < r_σ := lt_min hr_σ0_pos hr_σ_sub_pos
  have hr_σ_le_0 : r_σ ≤ r_σ0 := min_le_left _ _
  have hr_σ_sq : r_σ ^ 2 < R / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr_σ_pos.le hr_σ_le_0 2) hr_σ0_sq
  have hq_slit : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ, q_tilde σ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ_sub :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hσ
    exact Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (hr_σ_sub σ hσ').1)
  have hd₃_ne_ball : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ, d₃ σ ≠ 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ_sub :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hσ
    exact (hr_σ_sub σ hσ').2

  
  have hev_left_inv : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), U_inv (σ_map u) = u :=
    hf_strict.eventually_left_inverse hdσ0_ne
  have hev_σ_in_ball : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : ℂ), σ_map u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ := by
    have hc := hσ_ana.continuousAt.tendsto
    rw [hσ_map_zero] at hc
    exact hc.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_σ_pos)
  obtain ⟨δ_u0, hδ_u0_pos, hδ_u0⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hev_left_inv.and hev_σ_in_ball)
  let δ_u : ℝ := min δ_u0 (r_v1 / 2)
  have hδ_u_pos : 0 < δ_u := lt_min hδ_u0_pos (by positivity)
  have hδ_u_lt_rv1 : δ_u < r_v1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  have hU_left_inv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_u,
      σ_map u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ ∧ U_inv (σ_map u) = u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu' : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_u0 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hu
    exact ⟨(hδ_u0 u hu').2, (hδ_u0 u hu').1⟩

  
  let Δ_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := fun σ => Complex.I * Complex.log (q_tilde σ)
  have hΔ_tilde_deriv : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ,
      HasDerivAt Δ_tilde
        (2 * Complex.I * σ * (lam_tilde σ - 2 * v_σ σ) /
          (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * lam_tilde σ)) σ := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ0 : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_σ_le_0 hσ
    have hw_ne := hR_sub_sq_ne σ hσ0
    have hlam_ne := hlam_tilde_ne σ hσ0
    have hd_den : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z ^ 2) (-2 * σ) σ := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 σ).const_sub (R : ℂ)
    have hd_q := (hlam_tilde_deriv σ hσ0).div hd_den hw_ne
    have hd_Δ : HasDerivAt Δ_tilde
        (Complex.I * (((-4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) -
            lam_tilde σ * (-2 * σ)) /
          ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) ^ 2) / q_tilde σ)) σ :=
      (hd_q.clog (hq_slit σ hσ)).const_mul Complex.I
    have hval : Complex.I *
        (((-4 * v_σ σ * σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) -
            lam_tilde σ * (-2 * σ)) /
          ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) ^ 2) / q_tilde σ) =
        2 * Complex.I * σ * (lam_tilde σ - 2 * v_σ σ) /
          (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * lam_tilde σ) := by
      dsimp [q_tilde]
      field_simp [hw_ne, hlam_ne]
      ring
    rwa [hval] at hd_Δ

  have hΔ_tilde_odd_ne : ∀ σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ, σ ≠ 0 → Δ_tilde (-σ) ≠ Δ_tilde σ := by
    intro σ hσ hσ_ne h_eq
    have hnσ : -σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ := by simpa using hσ
    have hq_pos_ne : q_tilde σ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hq_slit σ hσ)
    have hq_neg_ne : q_tilde (-σ) ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hq_slit (-σ) hnσ)
    have hlog_eq : Complex.log (q_tilde (-σ)) = Complex.log (q_tilde σ) := by
      have hm := congrArg (-Complex.I * ·) h_eq
      dsimp [Δ_tilde] at hm
      have hI : ∀ z : ℂ, -Complex.I * (Complex.I * z) = z := by
        intro z; rw [← mul_assoc]; simp
      rwa [hI, hI] at hm
    have hexp_eq := congrArg Complex.exp hlog_eq
    rw [Complex.exp_log hq_neg_ne, Complex.exp_log hq_pos_ne] at hexp_eq
    dsimp [q_tilde] at hexp_eq
    rw [neg_sq] at hexp_eq
    have hw_ne := hR_sub_sq_ne σ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_σ_le_0 hσ)
    have hlam_eq : lam_tilde (-σ) = lam_tilde σ := by
      calc lam_tilde (-σ)
          = (lam_tilde (-σ) / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)) * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) := by field_simp [hw_ne]
        _ = (lam_tilde σ / ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2)) * ((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) := by rw [hexp_eq]
        _ = lam_tilde σ := by field_simp [hw_ne]
    have hD_zero : D_lam σ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hlam_eq
    rw [hD_eq_d₃ σ] at hD_zero
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 3 hσ_ne) (hd₃_ne_ball σ hσ) hD_zero

  
  
  
  let r_patch : ℝ := r_σ ^ 2
  have hr_patch_pos : 0 < r_patch := sq_pos_of_pos hr_σ_pos
  have hr_patch_lt_R : r_patch < R := by dsimp [r_patch]; linarith

  have h_sigmaIn_props : ∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      let σ := sigmaIn w
      0 < ‖σ‖ ∧ ‖σ‖ < r_σ ∧ (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 = w ∧
      HasDerivAt sigmaIn (-1 / (2 * σ)) w := by
    intro w ⟨hw_ball, hw_slit⟩
    dsimp only
    set σ : ℂ := sigmaIn w
    have hRw_ne : (R : ℂ) - w ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hw_slit
    have hσ_sq : σ ^ 2 = (R : ℂ) - w := by
      dsimp [σ, sigmaIn]
      rw [neg_sq, pow_two, ← Complex.exp_add]
      have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w) +
          (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w) = Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w) := by ring
      rw [hhalf, Complex.exp_log hRw_ne]
    have hRw_eq : (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 = w := by rw [hσ_sq]; ring
    have hnorm_sq : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 = ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [← norm_pow, hσ_sq, norm_sub_rev]
    have hw_dist : ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ < r_σ ^ 2 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, r_patch] using hw_ball
    have hσ_pos : 0 < ‖σ‖ := by
      have hsq_pos : 0 < ‖σ‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← norm_pow, hσ_sq]
        exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hRw_ne
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr fun h0 => by simp [h0] at hsq_pos
    have hσ_lt : ‖σ‖ < r_σ := by
      have : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 < r_σ ^ 2 := by linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg σ, hr_σ_pos]
    have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hσ_pos
    have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (R : ℂ) - z) (-1) w := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id w).const_sub (R : ℂ)
    have hd_in : HasDerivAt sigmaIn
        (-(Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w)) *
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (-1 / ((R : ℂ) - w))))) w :=
      (((hd_sub.clog hw_slit).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ)).cexp).neg
    have hval : -(Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w)) *
        ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (-1 / ((R : ℂ) - w)))) = -1 / (2 * σ) := by
      have hexp_σ : Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w)) = -σ := by
        dsimp [σ, sigmaIn]; ring
      rw [hexp_σ, ← hσ_sq]
      field_simp [hσ_ne]
    exact ⟨hσ_pos, hσ_lt, hRw_eq, by rwa [hval] at hd_in⟩

  have h_sigmaOut_props : ∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      let σ := sigmaOut w
      0 < ‖σ‖ ∧ ‖σ‖ < r_σ ∧ (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 = w ∧
      HasDerivAt sigmaOut (-1 / (2 * σ)) w := by
    intro w ⟨hw_ball, hw_slit⟩
    dsimp only
    set σ : ℂ := sigmaOut w
    have hwR_ne : w - (R : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero hw_slit
    have hσ_sq : σ ^ 2 = (R : ℂ) - w := by
      dsimp [σ, sigmaOut]
      rw [mul_pow, Complex.I_sq, pow_two (Complex.exp _), ← Complex.exp_add]
      have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ)) +
          (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ)) = Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ)) := by ring
      rw [hhalf, Complex.exp_log hwR_ne]
      ring
    have hRw_eq : (R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2 = w := by rw [hσ_sq]; ring
    have hw_dist : ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ < r_σ ^ 2 := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, r_patch] using hw_ball
    have hnorm_sq : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 = ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ := by
      rw [← norm_pow, hσ_sq, norm_sub_rev]
    have hσ_pos : 0 < ‖σ‖ := by
      have hsq_pos : 0 < ‖σ‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hnorm_sq]; exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hwR_ne
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr fun h0 => by simp [h0] at hsq_pos
    have hσ_lt : ‖σ‖ < r_σ := by
      have : ‖σ‖ ^ 2 < r_σ ^ 2 := by linarith
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg σ, hr_σ_pos]
    have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hσ_pos
    have hd_sub : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z - (R : ℂ)) 1 w := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id w).sub_const (R : ℂ)
    have hd_out : HasDerivAt sigmaOut
        (Complex.I * (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ))) *
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 / (w - (R : ℂ)))))) w :=
      (((hd_sub.clog hw_slit).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℂ)).cexp).const_mul Complex.I
    have hval : Complex.I * (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ))) *
        ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 / (w - (R : ℂ))))) = -1 / (2 * σ) := by
      have hwR_σ : w - (R : ℂ) = -σ ^ 2 := by linear_combination hσ_sq
      calc Complex.I * (Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (w - (R : ℂ))) *
              ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 / (w - (R : ℂ)))))
          = σ * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 / (w - (R : ℂ)))) := by dsimp [σ, sigmaOut]; ring
        _ = σ * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (1 / (-σ ^ 2))) := by rw [hwR_σ]
        _ = -1 / (2 * σ) := by field_simp [hσ_ne]
    exact ⟨hσ_pos, hσ_lt, hRw_eq, by rwa [hval] at hd_out⟩

  have h_exp_half_pi : Complex.exp (((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Complex.I := by
    rw [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
    simp

  have h_sheet_cmp : ∀ w : ℂ,
      (0 < w.im → sigmaOut w = sigmaIn w) ∧
      (w.im < 0 → sigmaIn w = -sigmaOut w) := by
    intro w
    let z : ℂ := w - (R : ℂ)
    have hnz : -z = (R : ℂ) - w := by dsimp [z]; ring
    have hz_im : z.im = w.im := by simp [z]
    refine ⟨fun hw_pos => ?_, fun hw_neg => ?_⟩
    · have hz_pos : 0 < z.im := by linarith
      have harg := Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos hz_pos
      have hlog : Complex.log (-z) = Complex.log z - (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [Complex.log_re]
        · simp [Complex.log_im, harg]
      have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w) =
          (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log z - ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        rw [← hnz, hlog]; push_cast; ring
      dsimp [sigmaIn, sigmaOut]
      change Complex.I * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log z) =
        -Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w))
      rw [hhalf, Complex.exp_sub, h_exp_half_pi]
      have hI_ne : (Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
      field_simp [hI_ne]
      simp [Complex.I_sq]
    · have hz_neg : z.im < 0 := by linarith
      have harg := Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg hz_neg
      have hlog : Complex.log (-z) = Complex.log z + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [Complex.log_re]
        · simp [Complex.log_im, harg]
      have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w) =
          (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log z + ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        rw [← hnz, hlog]; push_cast; ring
      dsimp [sigmaIn, sigmaOut]
      change -Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((R : ℂ) - w)) =
        -(Complex.I * Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log z))
      rw [hhalf, Complex.exp_add, h_exp_half_pi]
      ring

  
  
  
  let Δ_slit_in : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Δ_tilde (sigmaIn w)
  let Δ_slit_out : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Δ_tilde (sigmaOut w)
  let r_left : ℝ := Real.pi - δ_u / 2
  have hr_left_mem : r_left ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi := by
    have : δ_u < 1 / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ_u_lt_rv1 (le_trans hr_v1_le_rv hr_v_le_quarter)
    dsimp [r_left]
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  let ε_ov : ℝ := min (r_patch / 2) (R - w_real r_left)
  have hε_ov_pos : 0 < ε_ov :=
    lt_min (by positivity) (sub_pos.mpr (hw_lt_R r_left hr_left_mem))
  have hε_ov_lt_r : ε_ov < r_patch :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)

  
  have h_chart_calc : ∀ (σ_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (w : ℂ),
      0 < ‖σ_fn w‖ → ‖σ_fn w‖ < r_σ → (R : ℂ) - (σ_fn w) ^ 2 = w →
      HasDerivAt σ_fn (-1 / (2 * σ_fn w)) w →
      let Δ_fn := fun z => Δ_tilde (σ_fn z)
      DifferentiableAt ℂ Δ_fn w ∧
      (let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_fn w)
       let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_fn w
       frozenEnergyE .firstField lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState .firstField lam J) := by
    intro σ_fn w hσ_pos hσ_lt hRw_eq hd_σ
    set σ : ℂ := σ_fn w
    have hσ_ball : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ := by simpa using hσ_lt
    have hσ0_ball : σ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ0 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_σ_le_0 hσ_ball
    have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hσ_pos
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hRw_eq]
      exact hR_sub_sq_ne σ hσ0_ball
    have hlam_σ_ne : lam_tilde σ ≠ 0 := hlam_tilde_ne σ hσ0_ball
    have hq_σ_ne : q_tilde σ ≠ 0 := Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hq_slit σ hσ_ball)
    have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun z => Δ_tilde (σ_fn z))
        ((2 * Complex.I * σ * (lam_tilde σ - 2 * v_σ σ) /
            (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * lam_tilde σ)) * (-1 / (2 * σ))) w :=
      (hΔ_tilde_deriv σ hσ_ball).comp w hd_σ
    refine ⟨hd_comp.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [hd_comp.deriv]
    have hlam_eq : w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_tilde σ) = lam_tilde σ := by
      have hI_log : -Complex.I * Δ_tilde σ = Complex.log (q_tilde σ) := by
        dsimp [Δ_tilde]; rw [← mul_assoc]; simp
      rw [hI_log, Complex.exp_log hq_σ_ne]
      dsimp [q_tilde]
      rw [hRw_eq]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hw_ne
    have hJ_eq : 1 - Complex.I * w *
        ((2 * Complex.I * σ * (lam_tilde σ - 2 * v_σ σ) /
            (((R : ℂ) - σ ^ 2) * lam_tilde σ)) * (-1 / (2 * σ))) =
        (gTilde (v_σ σ))⁻¹ := by
      have hv_ne := hv_σ_ne σ hσ0_ball
      have hgt_ne : gTilde (v_σ σ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      rw [hRw_eq]
      dsimp [lam_tilde] at hlam_σ_ne ⊢
      field_simp [hw_ne, hσ_ne, hv_ne, hgt_ne, hlam_σ_ne]
      simp only [Complex.I_sq]
      ring
    rw [hlam_eq, hJ_eq]
    have hhalf_prod : lam_tilde σ * (gTilde (v_σ σ))⁻¹ / 2 = v_σ σ := by
      have hgt_ne : gTilde (v_σ σ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      dsimp [lam_tilde]
      field_simp [hgt_ne]
    have hgt_ne : gTilde (v_σ σ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨inv_ne_zero hgt_ne, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hCalc.energy_first, hhalf_prod]
      have hcube : firstFieldG (v_σ σ) = (gTilde (v_σ σ)) ^ 3 :=
        (hgTilde_cube (U_inv σ) (hU_in_rv σ hσ0_ball)).symm
      rw [hcube]
      field_simp [hgt_ne]
    · rw [hCalc.twist_first, hhalf_prod]
      refine mul_ne_zero (div_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hgt_ne) (by norm_num)) ?_
      intro hsinc_zero
      have hsin_v : Complex.sin (v_σ σ) = 0 := by
        rw [← hCalc.sinc_mul (v_σ σ), hsinc_zero, mul_zero]
      have hsin_U : Complex.sin (U_inv σ) = 0 := by
        dsimp [v_σ] at hsin_v
        rw [add_comm, Complex.sin_add_pi, neg_eq_zero] at hsin_v
        exact hsin_v
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hsin_U
      have hU_norm : ‖U_inv σ‖ < 1 / 4 := by
        have h1 : ‖U_inv σ‖ < r_v := by simpa using hU_in_rv σ hσ0_ball
        linarith
      have hk_zero : k = 0 := by
        by_contra hk_ne
        have hk_abs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by
          exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk_ne
        have hnorm_eq : ‖U_inv σ‖ = |(k : ℝ)| * Real.pi := by
          rw [hk, norm_mul, Complex.norm_intCast, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpi_pos]
        have hge : Real.pi ≤ ‖U_inv σ‖ := by
          rw [hnorm_eq]
          nlinarith
        linarith
      have hU_eq0 : U_inv σ = 0 := by simp [hk, hk_zero]
      have hW_eq := (hU_props0 σ hσ0_ball).2.2
      rw [hU_eq0, hW_F_zero] at hW_eq
      have hσ_sq0 : σ ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination hW_eq
      exact hσ_ne (eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hσ_sq0)

  refine ⟨r_patch, ε_ov, Δ_slit_in, Δ_slit_out,
    hr_patch_pos, hr_patch_lt_R, hε_ov_pos, hε_ov_lt_r,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h_sigmaIn_props w hw
    exact (h_chart_calc sigmaIn w h1 h2 h3 h4).1.differentiableWithinAt
  · 
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h_sigmaOut_props w hw
    exact (h_chart_calc sigmaOut w h1 h2 h3 h4).1.differentiableWithinAt
  · 
    intro x hx
    let w_ext : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => if r < Real.pi then w_real r else R
    have hw_ext_cont : ContinuousOn w_ext (Set.Icc r_left Real.pi) := by
      intro r hr_mem
      by_cases hr_lt : r < Real.pi
      · have hr_oo : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi :=
          ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hr_left_mem.1 hr_mem.1, hr_lt⟩
        have hev : w_ext =ᶠ[nhds r] w_real := by
          filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hr_oo] with s hs
          simp [w_ext, hs.2]
        exact ((continuousAt_congr hev).mpr (hw_deriv r hr_oo).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
      · have hr_eq : r = Real.pi := le_antisymm hr_mem.2 (not_lt.mp hr_lt)
        rw [hr_eq, Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp hw_lim ε hε
        refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun s hs_mem hs_dist => ?_⟩
        have hw_pi : w_ext Real.pi = R := by simp [w_ext]
        rw [hw_pi]
        by_cases hs_lt : s < Real.pi
        · simpa [w_ext, hs_lt] using hδ hs_lt hs_dist
        · have hs_eq : s = Real.pi := le_antisymm hs_mem.2 (not_lt.mp hs_lt)
          simp [w_ext, hs_eq, hε]
    have hx_in_img : x ∈ w_ext '' Set.Icc r_left Real.pi := by
      apply intermediate_value_Icc hr_left_mem.2.le hw_ext_cont
      have h_left : w_ext r_left = w_real r_left := by simp [w_ext, hr_left_mem.2]
      have h_right : w_ext Real.pi = R := by simp [w_ext]
      rw [h_left, h_right]
      have hε_le : ε_ov ≤ R - w_real r_left := min_le_right _ _
      exact ⟨by linarith [hx.1], hx.2.le⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr_icc, hr_eq_x⟩ := hx_in_img
    have hr_lt_pi : r < Real.pi := by
      by_contra h_not
      simp only [w_ext, h_not, ↓reduceIte] at hr_eq_x
      linarith [hx.2]
    have hw_r_eq_x : w_real r = x := by simpa [w_ext, hr_lt_pi] using hr_eq_x
    have hr_gt_left : r_left < r := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne hr_icc.1 ?_
      intro h_eq
      rw [← h_eq] at hw_r_eq_x
      have hε_le : ε_ov ≤ R - w_real r_left := min_le_right _ _
      linarith [hx.1]
    have hr_oo : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) Real.pi :=
      ⟨lt_trans hr_left_mem.1 hr_gt_left, hr_lt_pi⟩
    let u_x : ℝ := r - Real.pi
    have hu_x_bds : -δ_u / 2 < u_x ∧ u_x < 0 := by
      dsimp [u_x, r_left] at hr_gt_left ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hu_x_rv1 : u_x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v1) 0 :=
      ⟨by linarith [hu_x_bds.1, hδ_u_lt_rv1, hδ_u_pos], hu_x_bds.2⟩
    have hu_x_ball : (u_x : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_u := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_neg hu_x_bds.2]
      linarith [hu_x_bds.1, hδ_u_pos]
    have hr_sum : Real.pi + u_x = r := by dsimp [u_x]; ring
    have hσ_eq : σ_map (u_x : ℂ) = sigmaIn (x : ℂ) := by
      have h := hσ_map_neg_real u_x hu_x_rv1
      rwa [hr_sum, hw_r_eq_x] at h
    obtain ⟨hσ_mem, hU_σ⟩ := hU_left_inv (u_x : ℂ) hu_x_ball
    rw [hσ_eq] at hσ_mem hU_σ
    have hv_eq : v_σ (sigmaIn (x : ℂ)) = (r : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [v_σ]
      rw [hU_σ]
      exact_mod_cast hr_sum
    have hRw_σ : (R : ℂ) - (sigmaIn (x : ℂ)) ^ 2 = (x : ℂ) := by
      have h1 := (hU_props0 (sigmaIn (x : ℂ)) (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_σ_le_0 hσ_mem)).2.2
      have hu_rv : u_x ∈ Set.Ioo (-r_v) 0 :=
        ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (neg_le_neg hr_v1_le_rv) hu_x_rv1.1, hu_x_rv1.2⟩
      rw [hU_σ, hW_F_real_bridge u_x hu_rv, hr_sum, hw_r_eq_x] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have hlam_eq : lam_tilde (sigmaIn (x : ℂ)) = ((2 * r * Real.exp (M_real r) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [lam_tilde]
      rw [hv_eq, hgTilde_real r hr_oo]
      push_cast; ring
    dsimp [Δ_slit_in, Δ_tilde, q_tilde]
    rw [hlam_eq, hRw_σ, ← hw_r_eq_x, hΔ_real r hr_oo]
  · 
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h_sigmaIn_props w hw
    exact (h_chart_calc sigmaIn w h1 h2 h3 h4).2
  · 
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h_sigmaOut_props w hw
    exact (h_chart_calc sigmaOut w h1 h2 h3 h4).2
  · 
    intro w _ hw_pos
    dsimp [Δ_slit_in, Δ_slit_out]
    rw [(h_sheet_cmp w).1 hw_pos]
  · 
    intro w ⟨_, hw_out⟩ hw_neg
    obtain ⟨hσ_pos, hσ_lt, _, _⟩ := h_sigmaOut_props w hw_out
    have hσ_ball : sigmaOut w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_σ := by simpa using hσ_lt
    have hσ_ne : sigmaOut w ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hσ_pos
    dsimp [Δ_slit_in, Δ_slit_out]
    rw [(h_sheet_cmp w).2 hw_neg]
    exact (hΔ_tilde_odd_ne (sigmaOut w) hσ_ball hσ_ne).symm

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  let Λ : ℝ := (12 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)
  have hΛ_pos : 0 < Λ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hΛ_cube : Λ ^ (3 : ℕ) = 12 := by
    dsimp [Λ]
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hΛ_gt_two : 2 < Λ := by
    by_contra! h_le
    have : Λ ^ (3 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ (3 : ℕ) := pow_le_pow_left₀ hΛ_pos.le h_le 3
    linarith
  have hΛ_sq_gt_four : 4 < Λ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  let a₀ : ℝ := 4 * R / Λ ^ 2
  have ha₀_pos : 0 < a₀ := by dsimp [a₀]; positivity
  have h2a₀_pos : 0 < 2 * a₀ := by positivity

  let S_strip : ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun M B => { z : ℂ | M < z.re ∧ |z.im| < B }
  have hS_open : ∀ M B : ℝ, IsOpen (S_strip M B) := fun M B =>
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const)
  have hS_ball_sub : ∀ (M₁ B₁ M₂ B₂ r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → r ≤ M₂ - M₁ → r ≤ B₁ - B₂ →
      ∀ z ∈ S_strip M₂ B₂, Metric.closedBall z r ⊆ S_strip M₁ B₁ := by
    intro M₁ B₁ M₂ B₂ r hr hM hB z ⟨hz_re, hz_im⟩ w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Complex.dist_eq] at hw
    have hre : |w.re - z.re| ≤ r :=
      le_trans (by simpa using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - z)) hw
    have him : |w.im - z.im| ≤ r :=
      le_trans (by simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - z)) hw
    have him_tri : |w.im| ≤ |z.im| + |w.im - z.im| := by

          Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Real.cosh_pos y).ne'
        have hexp_ne : (Real.exp (M_real r) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
          Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
        have hexp2 : Real.exp (2 * M_real r) = Real.exp (M_real r) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; ring_nf
        rw [hexp2]
        push_cast
        field_simp [hr_ne, hch_ne, hexp_ne]
        ring
      convert hd_wc.mul hd_exp_r using 1
      rw [hPsi_real]
      push_cast; ring
    have hF_diff_Ioi : DifferentiableOn ℝ F_br (Set.Ioi (10 : ℝ)) :=
      fun y hy => (hF_deriv y hy).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hF_zero_Ioi : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioi (10 : ℝ), deriv F_br y = 0 :=
      fun y hy => (hF_deriv y hy).deriv
    have hF_const : ∀ y₁ ∈ Set.Ioi (10 : ℝ), ∀ y₂ ∈ Set.Ioi (10 : ℝ), F_br y₁ = F_br y₂ :=
      fun _ hy₁ _ hy₂ =>
        isOpen_Ioi.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isPreconnected_Ioi hF_diff_Ioi hF_zero_Ioi hy₁ hy₂
    have htanh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto Real.tanh Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall Real.tanh_lt_one⟩
      have hexp0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
        Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (Filter.tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by norm_num))
      have h_rat : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun y : ℝ => (1 - Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y)) / (1 + Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 - 0) / (1 + 0))) :=
        (tendsto_const_nhds.sub hexp0).div (tendsto_const_nhds.add hexp0) (by norm_num)
      rw [show ((1 : ℝ) - 0) / (1 + 0) = 1 by norm_num] at h_rat
      refine h_rat.congr (fun y => ?_)
      rw [Real.tanh_eq]
      have hey_ne : Real.exp y ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos y).ne'
      have h2y : Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y) = Real.exp (-y) / Real.exp y := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      rw [h2y]
      field_simp [hey_ne]
    have hIQ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => I_Q (y : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero_norm'
        (a := fun y : ℝ => ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_ψ) * Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y)) ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (10 : ℝ)] with y hy
        have hy_S2 : (y : ℂ) ∈ S_strip (19 / 2) (13 / 4 * Real.pi) :=
          ⟨by simp; linarith, by simp; positivity⟩
        simpa [mul_assoc] using (hS2_props (y : ℂ) hy_S2).2.2.2.1
      · have hexp0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp ((-2 : ℝ) * y)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (Filter.tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by norm_num))
        simpa using hexp0.const_mul ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_ψ)
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F_br Filter.atTop (nhds (R : ℂ)) := by
      have hw_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => (w_real (Real.tanh y) : ℂ))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (R : ℂ)) :=
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto R).comp (hw_lim.comp htanh_tendsto)
      have hexp_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (I_Q (y : ℂ)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_zero]
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.tendsto 0).comp hIQ_tendsto
      simpa [F_br] using hw_t.mul hexp_t
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨h_lam_real x (by linarith), ?_⟩
    have hF_ev : Filter.Tendsto F_br Filter.atTop (nhds (F_br x)) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (x + 1)] with y hy
      exact hF_const x hx y (show (10 : ℝ) < y by linarith)
    have hFx_eq : F_br x = (R : ℂ) := tendsto_nhds_unique hF_ev hF_lim
    dsimp [W_Q]
    calc (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-I_Q (x : ℂ))
        = ((w_real (Real.tanh x) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (I_Q (x : ℂ))) *
            Complex.exp (-I_Q (x : ℂ)) := by rw [← hFx_eq]
      _ = (w_real (Real.tanh x) : ℂ) *
            (Complex.exp (I_Q (x : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-I_Q (x : ℂ))) := by ring
      _ = (w_real (Real.tanh x) : ℂ) := by
          rw [← Complex.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]

  have hWQ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, 10 < x →
      (W_Q (x : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧ 0 < (W_Q (x : ℂ)).re ∧ (W_Q (x : ℂ)).re < R := by
    intro x hx
    have hbr := (h_real_bridge x hx).2
    have hr_mem := htanh_mem_Ioo x (by linarith)
