    exact ⟨trivial, hw_pos _ hr_mem, hw_lt_R _ hr_mem⟩

  
  
  
  let C_h : ℝ := 5 * C_W / a₀
  have hC_h_pos : 0 < C_h := by dsimp [C_h]; positivity
  let C_rem : ℝ := 4 * (26 * (8 * C_h + 8) + 8)
  have hC_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem := by dsimp [C_rem]; positivity
  let M_1 : ℝ := max 11 (max (Real.log (20 * C_h) + 1) (Real.log (2 * C_rem) + 1))
  have hM1_ge_11 : 11 ≤ M_1 := le_max_left _ _
  have hCh_exp_lt : ∀ x : ℝ, M_1 < x → C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) < 1 / 20 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := by linarith
    have hlog_lt : Real.log (20 * C_h) < x := by
      have : Real.log (20 * C_h) + 1 ≤ M_1 :=
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      linarith
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp (-x) < (20 * C_h)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (-x) < Real.exp (-Real.log (20 * C_h)) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      nth_rw 2 [Real.exp_neg] at h1
      rwa [Real.exp_log (by positivity)] at h1
    have h1 : C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-x) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) hC_h_pos.le
    have h2 : C_h * Real.exp (-x) < C_h * (20 * C_h)⁻¹ :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp_lt hC_h_pos
    have h3 : C_h * (20 * C_h)⁻¹ = 1 / 20 := by field_simp [hC_h_pos.ne']
    linarith
  have hCrem_exp_lt : ∀ x : ℝ, M_1 < x →
      2 * C_rem * Real.exp (-3 * x) < Real.exp (-2 * x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hlog_lt : Real.log (2 * C_rem) < x := by
      have : Real.log (2 * C_rem) + 1 ≤ M_1 :=
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
      linarith
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp (-x) < (2 * C_rem)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (-x) < Real.exp (-Real.log (2 * C_rem)) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      nth_rw 2 [Real.exp_neg] at h1
      rwa [Real.exp_log (by positivity)] at h1
    have h1 : 2 * C_rem * Real.exp (-x) < 1 := by
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hexp_lt (by positivity : 0 < 2 * C_rem)
      rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)] at this
    have hexp_split : Real.exp (-3 * x) = Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp (-2 * x) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    calc 2 * C_rem * Real.exp (-3 * x)
        = (2 * C_rem * Real.exp (-x)) * Real.exp (-2 * x) := by rw [hexp_split]; ring
      _ < 1 * Real.exp (-2 * x) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h1 (Real.exp_pos _)
      _ = Real.exp (-2 * x) := one_mul _

  let V : Set ℂ := S_strip M_1 (2 * Real.pi)
  have hV_open : IsOpen V := hS_open M_1 (2 * Real.pi)
  let u_map : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ h =>
    E_W (z₀ + h) / (((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀))
  let T_map : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ h => -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (1 - u_map z₀ h)

  have h_add_S3 : ∀ z₀ ∈ V, ∀ h : ℂ, ‖h‖ < 1 / 3 → z₀ + h ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) := by
    intro z₀ ⟨hz_re, hz_im⟩ h hh
    have hre : |h.re| ≤ ‖h‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm h
    have him : |h.im| ≤ ‖h‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm h
    have him_tri : |(z₀ + h).im| ≤ |z₀.im| + |h.im| := by
      simpa using abs_add_le z₀.im h.im
    rw [abs_le] at hre
    exact ⟨by simp; linarith, by linarith⟩

  have hu_T_props : ∀ z₀ ∈ V, ∀ h : ℂ, ‖h‖ < 1 / 3 →
      ‖u_map z₀ h‖ ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) ∧
      1 - u_map z₀ h ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖1 - u_map z₀ h‖ ∧
      ‖T_map z₀ h‖ ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) ∧
      ‖T_map z₀ h‖ ≤ 1 / 20 ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (T_map z₀) h ∧
      ‖deriv (T_map z₀) h‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro z₀ hz₀ h hh
    have hzh_S3 := h_add_S3 z₀ hz₀ h hh
    obtain ⟨hEW_v, hEW_d⟩ := hEW_bound_S3 (z₀ + h) hzh_S3
    have h_re_lo : z₀.re - 1 / 3 ≤ (z₀ + h).re := by
      have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm h; rw [abs_le] at this
      simp only [Complex.add_re]; linarith
    have hexp_72 : Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * (z₀ + h).re) ≤
        10 * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
      have h1 : Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * (z₀ + h).re) ≤
          Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      have hexp2_lt_10 : Real.exp 2 ≤ 10 := by
        have : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos 1]
      exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp2_lt_10 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    have h_den_norm : ‖((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀)‖ =
        2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re) := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h2a₀_pos, Complex.norm_exp]
      simp
    have h_ratio_bound : ∀ B : ℝ, B ≤ C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * (z₀ + h).re) →
        B / (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re)) ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
      intro B hB
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h1 : B ≤ 10 * C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
        nlinarith [hC_W_pos]
      have h2 : C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) * (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re)) =
          10 * C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
        dsimp [C_h]
        have hexp_m : Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re) =
            Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        calc 5 * C_W / a₀ * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) * (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re))
            = (5 * C_W / a₀ * (2 * a₀)) *
              (Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re)) := by ring
          _ = (10 * C_W) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
              rw [hexp_m]; congr 1; field_simp [ha₀_pos.ne']; ring
          _ = 10 * C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by ring
      linarith
    have hu_norm : ‖u_map z₀ h‖ ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
      dsimp [u_map]; rw [norm_div, h_den_norm]
      exact h_ratio_bound _ hEW_v
    have hCh_lt : C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) < 1 / 20 :=
      hCh_exp_lt z₀.re hz₀.1
    have hu_lt_20 : ‖u_map z₀ h‖ < 1 / 20 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu_norm hCh_lt
    have h1mu_re : 0 < (1 - u_map z₀ h).re := by
      have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (u_map z₀ h)
      rw [abs_le] at this
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]; linarith
    have h1mu_slit : 1 - u_map z₀ h ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
      Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl h1mu_re)
    have h1mu_half : 1 / 2 ≤ ‖1 - u_map z₀ h‖ := by
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) (u_map z₀ h)
      simp only [norm_one] at htri; linarith
    have hT_le_u : ‖T_map z₀ h‖ ≤ ‖u_map z₀ h‖ := by
      dsimp [T_map]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, show ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      have heq : 1 - u_map z₀ h = 1 + (-u_map z₀ h) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      have hlog_b := h_log_one_add (-u_map z₀ h) (by rw [norm_neg]; linarith)
      rw [norm_neg] at hlog_b
      linarith
    have hT_exp : ‖T_map z₀ h‖ ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) :=
      le_trans hT_le_u hu_norm
    
    have hd_EW_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ E_W (z₀ + h) :=
      hEW_holo_S3.differentiableAt ((hS_open 10 (3 * Real.pi)).mem_nhds hzh_S3)
    have hd_shift : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => E_W (z₀ + w)) (deriv E_W (z₀ + h)) h := by
      have hc := HasDerivAt.comp h hd_EW_at.hasDerivAt ((hasDerivAt_id h).const_add z₀)
      rw [mul_one] at hc; exact hc
    let c_den : ℂ := ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀)
    have hd_u : HasDerivAt (u_map z₀) (deriv E_W (z₀ + h) / c_den) h :=
      hd_shift.div_const c_den
    have hd_T : HasDerivAt (T_map z₀)
        (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) * (-(deriv E_W (z₀ + h) / c_den) / (1 - u_map z₀ h))) h := by
      have hd1 := (hasDerivAt_const h (1 : ℂ)).sub hd_u
      rw [zero_sub] at hd1
      exact (hd1.clog h1mu_slit).const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))
    have hdu_norm : ‖deriv E_W (z₀ + h) / c_den‖ ≤ 1 / 20 := by
      rw [norm_div, show ‖c_den‖ = 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀.re) from h_den_norm]
      exact le_trans (h_ratio_bound _ hEW_d) hCh_lt.le
    have hdT_bound : ‖deriv (T_map z₀) h‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [hd_T.deriv, norm_mul, norm_neg, show ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 2 by norm_num,
        norm_div, norm_neg]
      have h1mu_pos : 0 < ‖1 - u_map z₀ h‖ := by linarith
      have h_div : ‖deriv E_W (z₀ + h) / c_den‖ / ‖1 - u_map z₀ h‖ ≤
          (1 / 20 : ℝ) / (1 / 2) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ h1mu_pos]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    exact ⟨hu_norm, h1mu_slit, h1mu_half, hT_exp, le_trans hT_exp hCh_lt.le,
      hd_T.differentiableAt, hdT_bound⟩

  have hT_lip : ∀ z₀ ∈ V, ∀ h₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4),
      ∀ h₂ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4),
      ‖T_map z₀ h₁ - T_map z₀ h₂‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖h₁ - h₂‖ := by
    intro z₀ hz₀ h₁ hh₁ h₂ hh₂
    have h_lt3 : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4), ‖w‖ < 1 / 3 := by
      intro w hw; rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hw; linarith
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun w hw => (hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ w (h_lt3 w hw)).2.2.2.2.2.1)
      (fun w hw => (hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ w (h_lt3 w hw)).2.2.2.2.2.2)
      (convex_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) hh₂ hh₁

  
  let h_iter : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k =>
    Nat.rec (fun _ => 0) (fun _ prev z₀ => T_map z₀ (prev z₀)) k
  have h_iter_zero : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, h_iter 0 z₀ = 0 := fun _ => rfl
  have h_iter_succ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z₀ : ℂ), h_iter (k + 1) z₀ = T_map z₀ (h_iter k z₀) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl

  have h_iter_mem_holo : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (∀ z₀ ∈ V, h_iter k z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (h_iter k) V := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨fun _ _ => Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by norm_num),
        differentiableOn_const 0⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro z₀ hz₀
        rw [h_iter_succ, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        have hk_lt : ‖h_iter k z₀‖ < 1 / 3 := by
          have := ih.1 z₀ hz₀
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this; linarith
        exact le_trans (hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ (h_iter k z₀) hk_lt).2.2.2.2.1 (by norm_num)
      · intro z₀ hz₀
        have hk_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (h_iter k) z₀ :=
          ih.2.differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hz₀)
        have hk_lt : ‖h_iter k z₀‖ < 1 / 3 := by
          have := ih.1 z₀ hz₀
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this; linarith
        have hzh_S3 := h_add_S3 z₀ hz₀ (h_iter k z₀) hk_lt
        have hd_EW : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => E_W (w + h_iter k w)) z₀ :=
          DifferentiableAt.comp z₀
            (hEW_holo_S3.differentiableAt ((hS_open 10 (3 * Real.pi)).mem_nhds hzh_S3))
            ((differentiableAt_id).add hk_at)
        have hd_den : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun w : ℂ => ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * w)) z₀ := by fun_prop
        have hden_ne : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀) ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h2a₀_pos.ne') (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
        have hd_1mu : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => 1 - u_map w (h_iter k w)) z₀ :=
          (differentiableAt_const (1 : ℂ)).sub (hd_EW.div hd_den hden_ne)
        have h_slit := (hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ (h_iter k z₀) hk_lt).2.1
        have hd_log : DifferentiableAt ℂ
            (fun w : ℂ => -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (1 - u_map w (h_iter k w))) z₀ :=
          ((hd_1mu.hasDerivAt.clog h_slit).const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))).differentiableAt
        exact hd_log.differentiableWithinAt

  have h_iter_step : ∀ (k : ℕ), ∀ z₀ ∈ V,
      ‖h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * ‖h_iter 1 z₀‖ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro z₀ _; simp [h_iter_zero]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro z₀ hz₀
      rw [h_iter_succ (k + 1), h_iter_succ k]
      calc ‖T_map z₀ (h_iter (k + 1) z₀) - T_map z₀ (h_iter k z₀)‖
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀‖ :=
            hT_lip z₀ hz₀ _ ((h_iter_mem_holo (k + 1)).1 z₀ hz₀)
              _ ((h_iter_mem_holo k).1 z₀ hz₀)
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * ‖h_iter 1 z₀‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih z₀ hz₀) (by norm_num)
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * ‖h_iter 1 z₀‖ := by ring

  have h_iter1_bound : ∀ z₀ ∈ V,
      ‖h_iter 1 z₀‖ ≤ C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) ∧ ‖h_iter 1 z₀‖ ≤ 1 / 20 := by
    intro z₀ hz₀
    have h1_eq : h_iter 1 z₀ = T_map z₀ 0 := rfl
    rw [h1_eq]
    have hp := hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ 0 (by norm_num)
    exact ⟨hp.2.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2.2.1⟩

  let h_lim : ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ => ∑' k : ℕ, (h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀)
  let Z_sol : ℂ → ℂ := fun z₀ => z₀ + h_lim z₀

  have h_unif_conv : TendstoUniformlyOn h_iter h_lim Filter.atTop V := by
    have hu_sum : Summable (fun k : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * (1 / 20 : ℝ)) :=
      summable_geometric_two.mul_right (1 / 20)
    have h_tsum : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun N z₀ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀))
        h_lim Filter.atTop V := by
      refine tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat hu_sum (fun k z₀ hz₀ => ?_)
      exact le_trans (h_iter_step k z₀ hz₀)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_iter1_bound z₀ hz₀).2 (by positivity))
    refine h_tsum.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N z₀ _ => ?_)
    dsimp only
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => h_iter k z₀) N, h_iter_zero, sub_zero]

  have h_lim_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_lim V :=
    h_unif_conv.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k => (h_iter_mem_holo k).2) hV_open
  have hZ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Z_sol V :=
    differentiableOn_id.add h_lim_holo

  have hZ_prop : ∀ z₀ ∈ V,
      ‖h_lim z₀‖ ≤ 2 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) ∧
      h_lim z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4) ∧
      T_map z₀ (h_lim z₀) = h_lim z₀ ∧
      Z_sol z₀ ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) ∧
      W_Q (Z_sol z₀) = (R : ℂ) - ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀) := by
    intro z₀ hz₀
    let B₀ : ℝ := C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re)
    have h_step_B₀ : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₀ :=
      fun k => le_trans (h_iter_step k z₀ hz₀)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_iter1_bound z₀ hz₀).1 (by positivity))
    have h_maj_sum : Summable (fun k : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₀) :=
      summable_geometric_two.mul_right B₀
    have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_step_B₀ h_maj_sum
    have h_lim_bound : ‖h_lim z₀‖ ≤ 2 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
      calc ‖h_lim z₀‖
          ≤ ∑' k : ℕ, ‖h_iter (k + 1) z₀ - h_iter k z₀‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_norm_sum
        _ ≤ ∑' k : ℕ, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * B₀) := h_norm_sum.tsum_le_tsum h_step_B₀ h_maj_sum
        _ = (∑' k : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k) * B₀ := tsum_mul_right
        _ = 2 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * z₀.re) := by
            rw [tsum_geometric_two]; dsimp [B₀]; ring
    have hB₀_lt : B₀ < 1 / 20 := hCh_exp_lt z₀.re hz₀.1
    have h_lim_cb : h_lim z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp [B₀] at hB₀_lt
      linarith
    have h_pt : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => h_iter k z₀) Filter.atTop (nhds (h_lim z₀)) :=
      h_unif_conv.tendsto_at hz₀
    have h_pt_succ : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => h_iter (k + 1) z₀) Filter.atTop (nhds (h_lim z₀)) :=
      (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr h_pt
    have h_T_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => T_map z₀ (h_iter k z₀))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (T_map z₀ (h_lim z₀))) := by
      rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      refine squeeze_zero_norm'
        (a := fun k => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖h_iter k z₀ - h_lim z₀‖) ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards with k
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact hT_lip z₀ hz₀ _ ((h_iter_mem_holo k).1 z₀ hz₀) _ h_lim_cb
      · have h0 := tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mp h_pt
        simpa using h0.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    have h_fp : T_map z₀ (h_lim z₀) = h_lim z₀ :=
      tendsto_nhds_unique h_T_tendsto h_pt_succ
    have h_lim_lt3 : ‖h_lim z₀‖ < 1 / 3 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at h_lim_cb; linarith
    have hZ_mem : Z_sol z₀ ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) :=
      h_add_S3 z₀ hz₀ (h_lim z₀) h_lim_lt3
    have h1mu_slit := (hu_T_props z₀ hz₀ (h_lim z₀) h_lim_lt3).2.1
    have h1mu_ne : 1 - u_map z₀ (h_lim z₀) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; rw [h0] at h1mu_slit
      rcases Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mp h1mu_slit with h | h <;> simp at h
    have h_log_eq : Complex.log (1 - u_map z₀ (h_lim z₀)) = -2 * h_lim z₀ := by
      dsimp [T_map] at h_fp
      linear_combination -2 * h_fp
    have hexp_eq : Complex.exp (-2 * h_lim z₀) = 1 - u_map z₀ (h_lim z₀) := by
      rw [← h_log_eq, Complex.exp_log h1mu_ne]
    have hW_inv : W_Q (Z_sol z₀) =
        (R : ℂ) - ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀) := by
      have h2a_ne : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h2a₀_pos.ne'
      have hexp_z0_ne : Complex.exp (-2 * z₀) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      have h_mul : (((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀)) *
          Complex.exp (-2 * h_lim z₀) =
          ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀) - E_W (Z_sol z₀) := by
        rw [hexp_eq]
        dsimp [u_map, Z_sol]
        field_simp [h2a_ne, hexp_z0_ne]
      have hexp_Z : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * Z_sol z₀) =
          (((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z₀)) * Complex.exp (-2 * h_lim z₀) := by
        dsimp [Z_sol]
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]; congr 2; ring
      have hEW_def : W_Q (Z_sol z₀) =
          (R : ℂ) - ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * Z_sol z₀) - E_W (Z_sol z₀) := by
        dsimp [E_W]; ring
      rw [hEW_def, hexp_Z, h_mul]
      ring
    exact ⟨h_lim_bound, h_lim_cb, h_fp, hZ_mem, hW_inv⟩

  
  let z0_in : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
    -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (((R : ℂ) - w) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))

  have hZ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, M_1 + 1 < x →
      let w_x := (W_Q (x : ℂ)).re
      z0_in (w_x : ℂ) ∈ V ∧ Z_sol (z0_in (w_x : ℂ)) = (x : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_gt_10 : 10 < x := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hWQ_im, hw_pos_x, hw_lt_Rx⟩ := hWQ_real x hx_gt_10
    intro w_x
    have hWQ_eq : W_Q (x : ℂ) = (w_x : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w_x, hWQ_im]
    have hRw_pos : 0 < R - w_x := sub_pos.mpr hw_lt_Rx
    have hx_S3 : (x : ℂ) ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) :=
      ⟨by simp; linarith, by simp; positivity⟩
    have hEW_x_eq : E_W (x : ℂ) = (((R - w_x) - 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [E_W]
      rw [hWQ_eq]
      have hexp_r : Complex.exp (-2 * (x : ℂ)) = ((Real.exp (-2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [show (-2 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = ((-2 * x : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
      rw [hexp_r]; push_cast; ring
    have hEW_abs : |(R - w_x) - 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)| ≤
        C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by
      have hb := (hEW_bound_S3 (x : ℂ) hx_S3).1
      rw [hEW_x_eq, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
      simpa using hb
    let ρ : ℝ := (R - w_x) / (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x))
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := div_pos hRw_pos (mul_pos h2a₀_pos (Real.exp_pos _))
    have hρ_near : |ρ - 1| < 1 / 5 := by
      have heq : ρ - 1 = ((R - w_x) - 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)) /
          (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)) := by
        dsimp [ρ]; field_simp [h2a₀_pos.ne', (Real.exp_pos (-2 * x)).ne']
      rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos h2a₀_pos (Real.exp_pos _))]
      have h1 : |(R - w_x) - 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)| / (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)) ≤
          C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos h2a₀_pos (Real.exp_pos _))]
        have hrhs : C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) * (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x)) =
            10 * C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by
          dsimp [C_h]
          have hm : Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) * Real.exp (-2 * x) =
              Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          calc 5 * C_W / a₀ * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) * (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x))
              = (5 * C_W / a₀ * (2 * a₀)) *
                (Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x) * Real.exp (-2 * x)) := by ring
            _ = (10 * C_W) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by
                rw [hm]; congr 1; field_simp [ha₀_pos.ne']; ring
            _ = 10 * C_W * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x) := by ring
        nlinarith [hC_W_pos, Real.exp_pos (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x)]
      have h2 := hCh_exp_lt x (by linarith)
      linarith
    rw [abs_lt] at hρ_near
    have hexp_half_ge : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 / 2 : ℝ); linarith
    have hexp_nhalf_le : Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 2 / 3 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      exact inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hexp_half_ge |>.trans_eq (by norm_num)
    have hlog_ρ_lo : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) < Real.log ρ := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos _) (by linarith : Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) < ρ)
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hlog_ρ_hi : Real.log ρ < 1 / 2 := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log hρ_pos (by linarith : ρ < Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    let z₀_r : ℝ := -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log ((R - w_x) / (2 * a₀))
    have hz₀_r_diff : x - z₀_r = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log ρ := by
      have h_split : (R - w_x) / (2 * a₀) = ρ * Real.exp (-2 * x) := by
        dsimp [ρ]; field_simp [h2a₀_pos.ne', (Real.exp_pos (-2 * x)).ne']
      dsimp [z₀_r]
      rw [h_split, Real.log_mul hρ_pos.ne' (Real.exp_pos _).ne', Real.log_exp]
      ring
    have hz0_in_eq : z0_in (w_x : ℂ) = (z₀_r : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [z0_in, z₀_r]
      have h_arg : ((R : ℂ) - (w_x : ℂ)) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (((R - w_x) / (2 * a₀) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, ← Complex.ofReal_log (by positivity)]
      push_cast; ring
    have hz₀_mem_V : (z₀_r : ℂ) ∈ V := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp; linarith
      · simp; positivity
    rw [hz0_in_eq]
    refine ⟨hz₀_mem_V, ?_⟩
    let h_x : ℂ := ((x - z₀_r : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hhx_cb : h_x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp [h_x]
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hexp_z0r : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * (z₀_r : ℂ)) =
        ((R - w_x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have h1 : (-2 : ℂ) * (z₀_r : ℂ) =
          ((Real.log ((R - w_x) / (2 * a₀)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [z₀_r]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h1, ← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log (div_pos hRw_pos h2a₀_pos)]
      have ha₀_c_ne : (a₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha₀_pos.ne'
      push_cast; field_simp [ha₀_c_ne]
    have h1mu_hx : 1 - u_map (z₀_r : ℂ) h_x = Complex.exp (-2 * h_x) := by
      dsimp [u_map]
      have h_add_x : (z₀_r : ℂ) + h_x = (x : ℂ) := by dsimp [h_x]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h_add_x, hexp_z0r, hEW_x_eq]
      have hexp_split : ((2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          ((R - w_x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * h_x) := by
        have hx_sum : (-2 * x : ℝ) = -2 * z₀_r + (-2 * (x - z₀_r)) := by ring
        have h_real : 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x) =
            (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀_r)) * Real.exp (-2 * (x - z₀_r)) := by
          rw [hx_sum, Real.exp_add]; ring
        have h_2z0r : 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * z₀_r) = R - w_x := by
          have : -2 * z₀_r = Real.log ((R - w_x) / (2 * a₀)) := by dsimp [z₀_r]; ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_log (div_pos hRw_pos h2a₀_pos)]; field_simp [h2a₀_pos.ne']
        rw [h_real, h_2z0r]
        dsimp [h_x]
        rw [show (-2 : ℂ) * ((x - z₀_r : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((-2 * (x - z₀_r) : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
          ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
        push_cast; ring
      have hRw_ne : ((R - w_x : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hRw_pos.ne'
      have h_sub_c : (((R - w_x) - 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          ((R - w_x : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_sub_c, hexp_split]
      field_simp [hRw_ne]; ring
    have hT_hx : T_map (z₀_r : ℂ) h_x = h_x := by
      dsimp [T_map]
      rw [h1mu_hx, Complex.log_exp]
      · ring
      · dsimp [h_x]; simp; linarith
      · dsimp [h_x]; simp; linarith
    have hhx_eq_lim : h_x = h_lim (z₀_r : ℂ) := by
      have h_lip := hT_lip (z₀_r : ℂ) hz₀_mem_V h_x hhx_cb
        (h_lim (z₀_r : ℂ)) (hZ_prop (z₀_r : ℂ) hz₀_mem_V).2.1
      rw [hT_hx, (hZ_prop (z₀_r : ℂ) hz₀_mem_V).2.2.1] at h_lip
      have h_zero : ‖h_x - h_lim (z₀_r : ℂ)‖ = 0 :=
        le_antisymm (by linarith [norm_nonneg (h_x - h_lim (z₀_r : ℂ))]) (norm_nonneg _)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h_zero)
    dsimp [Z_sol]
    rw [← hhx_eq_lim]
    dsimp [h_x]; push_cast; ring

  
  have hZ_mono : ∀ z₀ ∈ V, z₀ + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ V →
      lamZ (Z_sol (z₀ + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≠ lamZ (Z_sol z₀) := by
    intro z₀ hz₀ hz₀'
    let z₀' : ℂ := z₀ + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let x₀ : ℝ := z₀.re
    have hx₀_gt : M_1 < x₀ := hz₀.1
    have hx₀'_re : z₀'.re = x₀ := by dsimp [z₀', x₀]; simp
    let q₀ : ℂ := Complex.exp (-2 * z₀)
    have hq₀_norm : ‖q₀‖ = Real.exp (-2 * x₀) := by
      dsimp [q₀, x₀]; rw [Complex.norm_exp]; simp
    have hq₀'_eq : Complex.exp (-2 * z₀') = q₀ := by
      dsimp [z₀', q₀]
      have h_rew : -2 * (z₀ + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          -2 * z₀ + (-((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) + -((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by ring
      rw [h_rew, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I]
      norm_num
    
    have h_sheet_rem : ∀ w₀ ∈ V, w₀.re = x₀ → Complex.exp (-2 * w₀) = q₀ →
        ‖(1 - PhiQ (Z_sol w₀)) - (2 + 4 * Z_sol w₀) * q₀‖ ≤ C_rem * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by
      intro w₀ hw₀ hw_re hw_exp
      obtain ⟨hh_b, hh_cb, _, hz_S3, _⟩ := hZ_prop w₀ hw₀
      rw [hw_re] at hh_b
      let h := h_lim w₀
      let z := Z_sol w₀
      let q := Complex.exp (-2 * z)
      have hz_S0 := hS3_sub_S0 hz_S3
      obtain ⟨_, _, h1pq_gt, _, h1pq_ne, _, _, _, _, hPhi_q, _, _, _, _⟩ := hS0_q z hz_S0
      change 1 / 2 < ‖1 + q‖ at h1pq_gt
      change 1 + q ≠ 0 at h1pq_ne
      change PhiQ z = (1 - q ^ 2 - 4 * z * q) / (1 + q) ^ 2 at hPhi_q
      have hh_norm_quarter : ‖h‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hh_cb
      have hq_prod : q = q₀ * Complex.exp (-2 * h) := by
        dsimp [q, z, Z_sol]
        rw [← hw_exp, ← Complex.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hexp_2h_diff : ‖Complex.exp (-2 * h) - 1‖ ≤ 8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
        have h2h : ‖-2 * h‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith
        have hb := h_exp_sub_one (-2 * h) h2h
        rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat] at hb
        linarith
      have hexp_2h_norm : ‖Complex.exp (-2 * h)‖ ≤ 2 := by
        have h2h : ‖-2 * h‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith
        have hb := h_exp_sub_one (-2 * h) h2h
        have htri := norm_add_le (1 : ℂ) (Complex.exp (-2 * h) - 1)
        simp only [add_sub_cancel, norm_one] at htri
        linarith
      have hq_norm_le : ‖q‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-2 * x₀) := by
        rw [hq_prod, norm_mul, hq₀_norm]
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-2 * x₀)]
      have hq_diff : ‖q - q₀‖ ≤ 8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
        have heq : q - q₀ = q₀ * (Complex.exp (-2 * h) - 1) := by rw [hq_prod]; ring
        rw [heq, norm_mul, hq₀_norm]
        calc Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * ‖Complex.exp (-2 * h) - 1‖
            ≤ Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * (8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_2h_diff (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = 8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
              have hm : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) =
                  Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
              calc Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * (8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀))
                  = 8 * C_h * (Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * Real.exp (-(3 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀)) := by ring
                _ = 8 * C_h * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by rw [hm]
      have hz_re_hi : z.re ≤ x₀ + 1 := by
        have hre_eq : z.re = x₀ + h.re := by simp [z, Z_sol, h, hw_re]
        have := Complex.re_le_norm h
        linarith
      have h2_4z_bound : ‖2 + 4 * z‖ ≤ 26 * Real.exp (x₀ / 2) := by
        have hz_lt := h_norm_z_S0 z hz_S0
        have hexp_z : Real.exp (z.re / 2) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (x₀ / 2) := by
          have h1 : Real.exp (z.re / 2) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (x₀ / 2) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
          exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_half_le_2 (Real.exp_pos _).le)
        have h1_le : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (x₀ / 2) :=
          Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
        have htri := norm_add_le (2 : ℂ) (4 * z)
        rw [Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat] at htri
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (x₀ / 2)]
      have h_alg : (1 - PhiQ z) - (2 + 4 * z) * q₀ =
          ((2 + 4 * z) * ((q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q) + (-q₀ * q ^ 2)) + 2 * q ^ 2) /
            (1 + q) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hPhi_q]
        field_simp [h1pq_ne]
        ring
      have h2q0q : ‖-2 * q₀ * q‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_mul, hq₀_norm]
        have h1 : 2 * (Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * ‖q‖) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
          have : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * Real.exp (-2 * x₀) = Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-2 * x₀)]
        have h2 : Real.exp (-4 * x₀) ≤ Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        linarith
      have hq0q2 : ‖-q₀ * q ^ 2‖ ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
        rw [neg_mul, norm_neg, norm_mul, norm_pow, hq₀_norm]
        have hsq : ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
          calc ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.exp (-2 * x₀)) ^ 2 :=
                pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq_norm_le 2
            _ = 4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
                have : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
                rw [mul_pow, this]; ring
        have h1 : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * (4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀)) = 4 * Real.exp (-6 * x₀) := by
          have : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) = Real.exp (-6 * x₀) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          linarith
        have h2 : Real.exp (-6 * x₀) ≤ Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-2 * x₀)]
      have h2q2 : ‖2 * q ^ 2‖ ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_pow]
        have hsq : ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
          calc ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.exp (-2 * x₀)) ^ 2 :=
                pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq_norm_le 2
            _ = 4 * Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
                have : Real.exp (-2 * x₀) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-4 * x₀) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; ring
                rw [mul_pow, this]; ring
        have h2 : Real.exp (-4 * x₀) ≤ Real.exp (-3 * x₀) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        linarith
      have h_brack : ‖(q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q) + (-q₀ * q ^ 2)‖ ≤
          (8 * C_h + 8) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) := by
        have htri1 := norm_add_le ((q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q)) (-q₀ * q ^ 2)
        have htri2 := norm_add_le (q - q₀) (-2 * q₀ * q)
        linarith [Real.exp_pos (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀)]
      have h_prod_num : ‖(2 + 4 * z) * ((q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q) + (-q₀ * q ^ 2)) + 2 * q ^ 2‖ ≤
          (26 * (8 * C_h + 8) + 8) * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by
        have htri := norm_add_le
          ((2 + 4 * z) * ((q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q) + (-q₀ * q ^ 2))) (2 * q ^ 2)
        rw [norm_mul] at htri
        have hm : (26 * Real.exp (x₀ / 2)) *
            ((8 * C_h + 8) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀)) =
            26 * (8 * C_h + 8) * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by
          have hexp_c : Real.exp (x₀ / 2) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀) =
              Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          calc (26 * Real.exp (x₀ / 2)) * ((8 * C_h + 8) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀))
              = 26 * (8 * C_h + 8) * (Real.exp (x₀ / 2) * Real.exp (-(7 / 2 : ℝ) * x₀)) := by ring
            _ = 26 * (8 * C_h + 8) * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by rw [hexp_c]
        have hmul_le := mul_le_mul h2_4z_bound h_brack (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        linarith
      rw [h_alg, norm_div, norm_pow]
      have h_den : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < ‖1 + q‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      dsimp [C_rem]
      let K_num : ℝ := (26 * (8 * C_h + 8) + 8) * Real.exp (-3 * x₀)
      have hK_nonneg : 0 ≤ K_num := by dsimp [K_num]; positivity
      have h1_le_4den : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ‖1 + q‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
      calc ‖(2 + 4 * z) * ((q - q₀) + (-2 * q₀ * q) + (-q₀ * q ^ 2)) + 2 * q ^ 2‖
          ≤ K_num := h_prod_num
        _ = K_num * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ K_num * (4 * ‖1 + q‖ ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_le_4den hK_nonneg
        _ = 4 * (26 * (8 * C_h + 8) + 8) * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) * ‖1 + q‖ ^ 2 := by
            dsimp [K_num]; ring

    have hr1 := h_sheet_rem z₀ hz₀ rfl rfl
    have hr2 := h_sheet_rem z₀' hz₀' hx₀'_re hq₀'_eq
    let z₁ := Z_sol z₀
    let z₂ := Z_sol z₀'
    let rem : ℂ := ((1 - PhiQ z₂) - (2 + 4 * z₂) * q₀) -
      ((1 - PhiQ z₁) - (2 + 4 * z₁) * q₀)
    have hPhi_jump : PhiQ z₁ - PhiQ z₂ = 4 * (z₂ - z₁) * q₀ + rem := by
      dsimp [rem]; ring
    have hrem_lt : ‖rem‖ < Real.exp (-2 * x₀) := by
      have htri := norm_sub_le
        ((1 - PhiQ z₂) - (2 + 4 * z₂) * q₀)
        ((1 - PhiQ z₁) - (2 + 4 * z₁) * q₀)
      have hsum : ‖rem‖ ≤ 2 * C_rem * Real.exp (-3 * x₀) := by linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hsum (hCrem_exp_lt x₀ hx₀_gt)
    have hz_diff_gt : 5 / 2 < ‖z₂ - z₁‖ := by
      have heq : z₂ - z₁ = (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I + (h_lim z₀' - h_lim z₀) := by
        dsimp [z₂, z₁, Z_sol, z₀']; ring
      have hh1 : ‖h_lim z₀‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        have := (hZ_prop z₀ hz₀).2.1
        rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this
      have hh2 : ‖h_lim z₀'‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        have := (hZ_prop z₀' hz₀').2.1
        rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this
      have hh_diff : ‖h_lim z₀' - h_lim z₀‖ ≤ 1 / 2 :=
        le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (by linarith)
      have hpi_norm : ‖(Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = Real.pi := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le ((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) (-(h_lim z₀' - h_lim z₀))
      simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, norm_neg, hpi_norm] at htri
      rw [heq]
      linarith
    have hmain_gt : 10 * Real.exp (-2 * x₀) < ‖4 * (z₂ - z₁) * q₀‖ := by
      rw [mul_assoc, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_mul, hq₀_norm]
      nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-2 * x₀)]
    have hPhi_ne : PhiQ z₁ ≠ PhiQ z₂ := by
      intro heq
      have h0 : ‖PhiQ z₁ - PhiQ z₂‖ = 0 := by rw [heq, sub_self, norm_zero]
      have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (4 * (z₂ - z₁) * q₀) (-rem)
      simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, norm_neg, ← hPhi_jump, h0] at htri
      linarith [Real.exp_pos (-2 * x₀)]
    intro hlam_eq
    have hc1 := (h_lam_psi_S0 z₁ (hS3_sub_S0 (hZ_prop z₀ hz₀).2.2.2.1)).2.1
    have hc2 := (h_lam_psi_S0 z₂ (hS3_sub_S0 (hZ_prop z₀' hz₀').2.2.2.1)).2.1
    have h12_eq : (12 : ℂ) * PhiQ z₁ = 12 * PhiQ z₂ := by
      rw [← hc1, ← hc2, hlam_eq]
    exact hPhi_ne (mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num) h12_eq)

  
  
  
  let r_patch : ℝ := min (R / 4) (2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * (M_1 + 1)))
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_patch :=
    lt_min (by positivity) (mul_pos h2a₀_pos (Real.exp_pos _))
  have hr_quarter : r_patch ≤ R / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hr_lt_R : r_patch < R := by linarith
  have hr_exp : r_patch ≤ 2 * a₀ * Real.exp (-2 * (M_1 + 1)) := min_le_right _ _

  have h_slitIn_open : IsOpen (slitInDomain R r_patch) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
      (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
  have h_slitOut_open : IsOpen (slitOutDomain R r_patch) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
      (Complex.isOpen_slitPlane.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))

  have h_div_slit : ∀ (u : ℂ) (c : ℝ), u ∈ Complex.slitPlane → 0 < c →
      u / (c : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧ u / (c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro u c hu hc
    have h_eq : u / (c : ℂ) = u * ((c⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Complex.ofReal_inv]
    have hre_eq : (u / (c : ℂ)).re = u.re * c⁻¹ := by rw [h_eq]; simp
    have him_eq : (u / (c : ℂ)).im = u.im * c⁻¹ := by rw [h_eq]; simp
    have h_mem : u / (c : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff] at hu ⊢
      rcases hu with hre | him
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [hre_eq]; exact mul_pos hre (inv_pos.mpr hc))
      · exact Or.inr (by rw [him_eq]; exact mul_ne_zero him (inv_ne_zero hc.ne'))
    refine ⟨h_mem, ?_⟩
    intro h0
    rw [h0] at h_mem
    rcases Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mp h_mem with h | h <;> simp at h

  let z0_out : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
    ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I -
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ((w - (R : ℂ)) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))

  have hz0_in_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z0_in (slitInDomain R r_patch) := by
    intro w hw
    have h_slit := (h_div_slit ((R : ℂ) - w) (2 * a₀) hw.2 h2a₀_pos).1
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => ((R : ℂ) - u) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)) w :=
      ((differentiableAt_const (R : ℂ)).sub differentiableAt_id).div_const _
    exact ((hd1.hasDerivAt.clog h_slit).const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℂ))).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  have hz0_in_prop : ∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      z0_in w ∈ V ∧ ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z0_in w) = (R : ℂ) - w := by
    intro w hw
    let ζ : ℂ := ((R : ℂ) - w) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := (h_div_slit ((R : ℂ) - w) (2 * a₀) hw.2 h2a₀_pos).2
    have hζ_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ_ne
    have hw_dist : ‖(R : ℂ) - w‖ < r_patch := by
      have hb := hw.1
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, norm_sub_rev] at hb
    have hζ_norm_lt : ‖ζ‖ < Real.exp (-2 * (M_1 + 1)) := by
      dsimp [ζ]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h2a₀_pos]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2a₀_pos]
      have : r_patch ≤ Real.exp (-2 * (M_1 + 1)) * (2 * a₀) := by linarith
      linarith
    have hlog_lt : Real.log ‖ζ‖ < -2 * (M_1 + 1) := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log hζ_pos hζ_norm_lt
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hz0_eq : z0_in w = ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ := by
      dsimp [z0_in, ζ]; push_cast; ring
    have hre_gt : M_1 < (z0_in w).re := by
      rw [hz0_eq]
      simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.log_re,
        zero_mul, sub_zero]
      linarith
    have him_lt : |(z0_in w).im| < 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [hz0_eq]
      simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.log_im,
        zero_mul, add_zero]
      have harg := Complex.abs_arg_le_pi ζ
      rw [abs_mul, show |(-1 / 2 : ℝ)| = 1 / 2 by norm_num]
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    refine ⟨⟨hre_gt, him_lt⟩, ?_⟩
    have h_neg2 : -2 * z0_in w = Complex.log ζ := by dsimp [z0_in, ζ]; ring
    rw [h_neg2, Complex.exp_log hζ_ne]
    dsimp [ζ]
    have h2a_ne : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h2a₀_pos.ne'
    field_simp [h2a_ne]

  have hz0_out_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z0_out (slitOutDomain R r_patch) := by
    intro w hw
    have h_slit := (h_div_slit (w - (R : ℂ)) (2 * a₀) hw.2 h2a₀_pos).1
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (u - (R : ℂ)) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)) w :=
      (differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const (R : ℂ))).div_const _
    have hd_log := ((hd1.hasDerivAt.clog h_slit).const_mul ((1 / 2 : ℂ))).differentiableAt
    exact ((differentiableAt_const _).sub hd_log).differentiableWithinAt

  have hz0_out_prop : ∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      z0_out w ∈ V ∧ ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (-2 * z0_out w) = (R : ℂ) - w := by
    intro w hw
    let ζ : ℂ := (w - (R : ℂ)) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := (h_div_slit (w - (R : ℂ)) (2 * a₀) hw.2 h2a₀_pos).2
    have hζ_pos : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ_ne
    have hw_dist : ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ < r_patch := by
      have hb := hw.1
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq] at hb
    have hζ_norm_lt : ‖ζ‖ < Real.exp (-2 * (M_1 + 1)) := by
      dsimp [ζ]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos h2a₀_pos]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2a₀_pos]
      linarith
    have hlog_lt : Real.log ‖ζ‖ < -2 * (M_1 + 1) := by
      have := Real.log_lt_log hζ_pos hζ_norm_lt
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at this
    have hz0_eq : z0_out w =
        ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ := by
      dsimp [z0_out, ζ]; push_cast; ring
    have hre_gt : M_1 < (z0_out w).re := by
      rw [hz0_eq]
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.log_re, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_self, sub_zero, zero_add]
      linarith
    have him_lt : |(z0_out w).im| < 2 * Real.pi := by
      rw [hz0_eq]
      simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.log_im, mul_one, zero_mul, add_zero]
      have harg := Complex.abs_arg_le_pi ζ
      have htri := abs_add_le (Real.pi / 2) ((-1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ.arg)
      rw [abs_of_pos (div_pos Real.pi_pos (by norm_num)), abs_mul,
        show |(-1 / 2 : ℝ)| = 1 / 2 by norm_num] at htri
      linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    refine ⟨⟨hre_gt, him_lt⟩, ?_⟩
    have h_neg2 : -2 * z0_out w = -((Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) + Complex.log ζ := by
      dsimp [z0_out, ζ]; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_neg2, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_neg, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I, Complex.exp_log hζ_ne]
    dsimp [ζ]
    have h2a_ne : ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h2a₀_pos.ne'
    field_simp [h2a_ne]
    ring

  have hz0_sheet_cmp : ∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch ∩ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      (0 < w.im → z0_out w = z0_in w) ∧
      (w.im < 0 → z0_out w = z0_in w + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro w _
    let ζ : ℂ := (w - (R : ℂ)) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have h_neg_ζ : ((R : ℂ) - w) / ((2 * a₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) = -ζ := by dsimp [ζ]; ring
    have hζ_im : ζ.im = w.im * (2 * a₀)⁻¹ := by
      have heq : ζ = (w - (R : ℂ)) * (((2 * a₀)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [ζ]; rw [div_eq_mul_inv, Complex.ofReal_inv]
      rw [heq]; simp
    have hz_out_ζ : z0_out w =
        ((Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ := rfl
    have hz_in_ζ : z0_in w = -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (-ζ) := by
      dsimp [z0_in]; rw [h_neg_ζ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro him_pos
      have hζ_im_pos : 0 < ζ.im := by
        rw [hζ_im]; exact mul_pos him_pos (inv_pos.mpr h2a₀_pos)
      have harg := Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos hζ_im_pos
      have hlog_neg : Complex.log (-ζ) = Complex.log ζ - (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [Complex.log_re]
        · simp [Complex.log_im, harg]
      rw [hz_out_ζ, hz_in_ζ, hlog_neg]
      push_cast; ring
    · intro him_neg
      have hζ_im_neg : ζ.im < 0 := by
        rw [hζ_im]; exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos him_neg (inv_pos.mpr h2a₀_pos)
      have harg := Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg hζ_im_neg
      have hlog_neg : Complex.log (-ζ) = Complex.log ζ + (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [Complex.log_re]
        · simp [Complex.log_im, harg]
      rw [hz_out_ζ, hz_in_ζ, hlog_neg]
      push_cast; ring

  
  
  
  let z_in : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Z_sol (z0_in w)
  let z_out : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Z_sol (z0_out w)
  let Δ_slit_in : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.I * Complex.log (lamZ (z_in w) / w)
  let Δ_slit_out : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.I * Complex.log (lamZ (z_out w) / w)

  have h_chart_reg : ∀ (Ω : Set ℂ) (z_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω →
      Ω ⊆ Metric.ball (R : ℂ) r_patch →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ z_fn Ω →
      (∀ w ∈ Ω, z_fn w ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) ∧ W_Q (z_fn w) = w) →
      let Δ_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => Complex.I * Complex.log (lamZ (z_fn u) / u)
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_fn Ω ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Ω, w ≠ 0 ∧ lamZ (z_fn w) / w ≠ 0 ∧
        let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_fn w)
        let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_fn w
        frozenEnergyE .secondField lam J = 1 / 12 ∧
        IsRegularFrozenState .secondField lam J) := by
    intro Ω z_fn hΩ_open hΩ_ball hz_holo hz_prop Δ_fn
    have h_pointwise : ∀ w ∈ Ω,
        HasDerivAt Δ_fn
          (Complex.I * (((2 * z_fn w - lamZ (z_fn w)) / w ^ 2) / (lamZ (z_fn w) / w))) w ∧
        w ≠ 0 ∧
        lamZ (z_fn w) / w ≠ 0 ∧
        (let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_fn w)
         let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_fn w
         frozenEnergyE .secondField lam J = 1 / 12 ∧
         IsRegularFrozenState .secondField lam J) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hz_S3, hW_eq⟩ := hz_prop w hw
      let z : ℂ := z_fn w
      have hz_S0 : z ∈ S_strip 8 (4 * Real.pi) := hS3_sub_S0 hz_S3
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hcosh_ne, hsinh_ne, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hS0_q z hz_S0
      obtain ⟨hlam_ne, hlam_cube, hlam_near, _, hd_lam_z, _, _⟩ := h_lam_psi_S0 z hz_S0
      have hw_dist : ‖w - (R : ℂ)‖ < R / 4 := by
        have hb := hΩ_ball hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq] at hb
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hb hr_quarter
      have hw_norm_gt : 3 * R / 4 < ‖w‖ := by
        have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (R : ℂ) ((R : ℂ) - w)
        have hR_norm : ‖(R : ℂ)‖ = R := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR]
        rw [sub_sub_cancel, hR_norm, norm_sub_rev] at htri
        linarith
      have hw_pos_norm : 0 < ‖w‖ := by linarith
      have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp hw_pos_norm.ne'
      have hR_c_ne : (R : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hR.ne'
      
      have h_quot_near : ‖lamZ z / w - ((Λ / R : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < Λ / R := by
        have heq : lamZ z / w - ((Λ / R : ℝ) : ℂ) =
            ((R : ℂ) * (lamZ z - (Λ : ℂ)) - (Λ : ℂ) * (w - (R : ℂ))) / (w * (R : ℂ)) := by
          push_cast; field_simp [hw_ne, hR_c_ne]; ring
        have hR_norm : ‖(R : ℂ)‖ = R := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR]
        have hΛ_norm : ‖(Λ : ℂ)‖ = Λ := by
          rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hΛ_pos]
        rw [heq, norm_div, norm_mul, hR_norm]
        have h_num : ‖(R : ℂ) * (lamZ z - (Λ : ℂ)) - (Λ : ℂ) * (w - (R : ℂ))‖ < Λ * R / 2 := by
          have htri := norm_sub_le ((R : ℂ) * (lamZ z - (Λ : ℂ))) ((Λ : ℂ) * (w - (R : ℂ)))
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, hR_norm, hΛ_norm] at htri
          nlinarith
        have h_den_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ * R := mul_pos hw_pos_norm hR
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ h_den_pos]
        have h_rhs : Λ / R * (‖w‖ * R) = Λ * ‖w‖ := by field_simp [hR.ne']
        rw [h_rhs]
        nlinarith
      have h_quot_re : 0 < (lamZ z / w).re := by
        have hre := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (lamZ z / w - ((Λ / R : ℝ) : ℂ))
        simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re] at hre
        rw [abs_le] at hre
        linarith
      have h_quot_slit : lamZ z / w ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
        Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl h_quot_re)
      have h_quot_ne : lamZ z / w ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hlam_ne hw_ne
      
      have hz_at : HasDerivAt z_fn (deriv z_fn w) w :=
        (hz_holo.differentiableAt (hΩ_open.mem_nhds hw)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_WQ : HasDerivAt W_Q (W_Q z * PsiQ z) z :=
        (hS2_props z (hS3_sub_S2 hz_S3)).2.1
      have hd_W_comp : HasDerivAt (fun u => W_Q (z_fn u))
          ((W_Q z * PsiQ z) * deriv z_fn w) w :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := W_Q) (h := z_fn) w hd_WQ hz_at
      have hev_W : (fun u => W_Q (z_fn u)) =ᶠ[nhds w] id :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩ_open.mem_nhds hw) (fun u hu => (hz_prop u hu).2)
      have hd_W_id : HasDerivAt (fun u => W_Q (z_fn u)) 1 w :=
        hev_W.hasDerivAt_iff.mpr (hasDerivAt_id w)
      have hw_psi_deriv : w * PsiQ z * deriv z_fn w = 1 := by
        have h_uniq := hd_W_comp.unique hd_W_id
        dsimp [z] at h_uniq
        rwa [hW_eq] at h_uniq
      
      have hd_lam_comp : HasDerivAt (fun u => lamZ (z_fn u))
          ((2 * z * PsiQ z) * deriv z_fn w) w :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h₂ := lamZ) (h := z_fn) w hd_lam_z hz_at
      have hd_quot_raw : HasDerivAt (fun u => lamZ (z_fn u) / u)
          ((((2 * z * PsiQ z) * deriv z_fn w) * w - lamZ z * 1) / w ^ 2) w :=
        hd_lam_comp.div (hasDerivAt_id w) hw_ne
      have h_quot_deriv_simp :
          (((2 * z * PsiQ z) * deriv z_fn w) * w - lamZ z * 1) / w ^ 2 =
            (2 * z - lamZ z) / w ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : ((2 * z * PsiQ z) * deriv z_fn w) * w = 2 * z * (w * PsiQ z * deriv z_fn w) := by ring
        rw [h1, hw_psi_deriv, mul_one, mul_one]
      rw [h_quot_deriv_simp] at hd_quot_raw
      have hd_Δ : HasDerivAt Δ_fn
          (Complex.I * (((2 * z - lamZ z) / w ^ 2) / (lamZ z / w))) w :=
        (hd_quot_raw.clog h_quot_slit).const_mul Complex.I
      refine ⟨hd_Δ, hw_ne, h_quot_ne, ?_⟩
      
      dsimp only
      set lam : ℂ := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_fn w)
      set J : ℂ := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_fn w
      have hlam_eq : lam = lamZ z := by
        dsimp [lam, Δ_fn]
        have hI : -Complex.I * (Complex.I * Complex.log (lamZ z / w)) =
            Complex.log (lamZ z / w) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc]; simp
        change w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Complex.I * Complex.log (lamZ z / w))) = lamZ z
        rw [hI, Complex.exp_log h_quot_ne, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hw_ne]
      have hJ_eq : J = 2 * z / lamZ z := by
        dsimp [J]
        rw [hd_Δ.deriv]
        field_simp [hw_ne, hlam_ne]
        rw [Complex.I_sq]
        ring
      have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hre : 10 < z.re := hz_S3.1
        rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hre; linarith
      have hJ_ne : J ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hJ_eq]; exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hz_ne) hlam_ne
      have hlj_eq : lam * J / 2 = z := by
        rw [hlam_eq, hJ_eq]; field_simp [hlam_ne]
      have hcosh_lj : Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 := by
        rwa [hlj_eq]
      have h_cube_cosh : (Complex.cosh z) ^ 2 * (lamZ z) ^ 3 =
          12 * (Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z) := by
        rw [hlam_cube]
        dsimp [PhiQ]
        rw [Complex.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
        field_simp [hcosh_ne]
      have h_sc_ne : Complex.sinh z * Complex.cosh z - z ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have lhs_ne : (Complex.cosh z) ^ 2 * (lamZ z) ^ 3 ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hcosh_ne) (pow_ne_zero 3 hlam_ne)
        rw [h0, mul_zero] at h_cube_cosh
        exact lhs_ne h_cube_cosh
      have h_energy : frozenEnergyE .secondField lam J = 1 / 12 := by
        rw [hCalc.energy_second lam J hcosh_lj, hlj_eq, hJ_eq]
        have h_rew : ((2 * z / lamZ z) ^ 3 / (12 * Complex.cosh z ^ 2)) * secondFieldGNum z =
            (4 * (2 * z ^ 3 * secondFieldGNum z)) /
              (12 * ((Complex.cosh z) ^ 2 * (lamZ z) ^ 3)) := by ring
        rw [h_rew, hCalc.gQ_mul z, h_cube_cosh]
        field_simp [h_sc_ne]
        norm_num
      have hsinhc_ne : secondFieldSinhc z ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hmul := hCalc.sinhc_mul z
        rw [h0, mul_zero] at hmul
        exact hsinh_ne hmul.symm
      have h_twist_ne : deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hCalc.twist_second lam J hcosh_lj, hlj_eq]
        exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hJ_ne hsinhc_ne)
          (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 3 hcosh_ne))
      exact ⟨h_energy, ⟨hJ_ne, hcosh_lj, h_twist_ne⟩⟩
    refine ⟨fun w hw => (h_pointwise w hw).1.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
      fun w hw => (h_pointwise w hw).2⟩

  have hz_in_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z_in (slitInDomain R r_patch) :=
    hZ_holo.comp hz0_in_holo (fun w hw => (hz0_in_prop w hw).1)
  have hz_in_prop : ∀ w ∈ slitInDomain R r_patch,
      z_in w ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) ∧ W_Q (z_in w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hz0_V, hexp_in⟩ := hz0_in_prop w hw
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hz_S3, hW_inv⟩ := hZ_prop (z0_in w) hz0_V
    refine ⟨hz_S3, ?_⟩
    dsimp [z_in]
    rw [hW_inv, hexp_in]; ring

  have hz_out_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ z_out (slitOutDomain R r_patch) :=
    hZ_holo.comp hz0_out_holo (fun w hw => (hz0_out_prop w hw).1)
  have hz_out_prop : ∀ w ∈ slitOutDomain R r_patch,
      z_out w ∈ S_strip 10 (3 * Real.pi) ∧ W_Q (z_out w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hz0_V, hexp_out⟩ := hz0_out_prop w hw
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hz_S3, hW_inv⟩ := hZ_prop (z0_out w) hz0_V
    refine ⟨hz_S3, ?_⟩
    dsimp [z_out]
    rw [hW_inv, hexp_out]; ring

  have h_in_pack := h_chart_reg (slitInDomain R r_patch) z_in
    h_slitIn_open (fun _ hw => hw.1) hz_in_holo hz_in_prop
  have h_out_pack := h_chart_reg (slitOutDomain R r_patch) z_out
    h_slitOut_open (fun _ hw => hw.1) hz_out_holo hz_out_prop

  
  let t_left : ℝ := M_1 + 2
  have ht_left_pos : 0 < t_left := by dsimp [t_left]; linarith
  let r_left : ℝ := Real.tanh t_left
  have hr_left_mem : r_left ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := htanh_mem_Ioo t_left ht_left_pos
  let ε_ov : ℝ := min (r_patch / 2) (R - w_real r_left)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε_ov :=
    lt_min (by positivity) (sub_pos.mpr (hw_lt_R r_left hr_left_mem))
  have hε_lt_r : ε_ov < r_patch :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)

  have h_real_eq : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (R - ε_ov) R, Δ_slit_in (x : ℂ) = Δ_ball (x : ℂ) := by
    let w_ext : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => if r < 1 then w_real r else R
    have hw_ext_cont : ContinuousOn w_ext (Set.Icc r_left 1) := by
      intro r hr
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hr.2 with hr_lt | rfl
      · have hr_Ioo : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hr_left_mem.1 hr.1, hr_lt⟩
        rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ :=
          Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hw_deriv r hr_Ioo).continuousAt ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ (1 - r), lt_min hδ_pos (by linarith), fun y _ hyd => ?_⟩
        have hy_lt : y < 1 := by
          have hyd2 : dist y r < 1 - r := lt_of_lt_of_le hyd (min_le_right _ _)
          rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hyd2
          linarith
        simp only [w_ext, hy_lt, hr_lt, ↓reduceIte]
        exact hδ (lt_of_lt_of_le hyd (min_le_left _ _))
      · rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
        intro ε hε
        have hw_lim_m := Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp hw_lim ε hε
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hw_lim_m
        refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, fun y hy hyd => ?_⟩
        simp only [w_ext, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte]
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hy.2 with hy_lt | rfl
        · simp only [hy_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          exact hδ hy_lt hyd
        · simp [hε]
    intro x ⟨hx_lo, hx_hi⟩
    have hw_ext_left : w_ext r_left ≤ x := by
      have h_eq : w_ext r_left = w_real r_left := by simp [w_ext, hr_left_mem.2]
      have h_le : ε_ov ≤ R - w_real r_left := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    have hw_ext_right : x ≤ w_ext 1 := by simp [w_ext, hx_hi.le]
    obtain ⟨r, hr_Icc, hr_val⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hr_left_mem.2.le hw_ext_cont
      ⟨hw_ext_left, hw_ext_right⟩
    have hr_lt_1 : r < 1 := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hr_Icc.2 with h | rfl
      · exact h
      · simp only [w_ext, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte] at hr_val
        linarith
    have hr_eq_x : w_real r = x := by
      simpa [w_ext, hr_lt_1] using hr_val
    have hr_gt_left : r_left < r := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hr_Icc.1 with h | rfl
      · exact h
      · have h_le : ε_ov ≤ R - w_real r_left := min_le_right _ _
        linarith
    have hr_Ioo : r ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨lt_trans hr_left_mem.1 hr_gt_left, hr_lt_1⟩
    
    let t : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log ((1 + r) / (1 - r))
    have h1mr_pos : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
    have h1pr_pos : 0 < 1 + r := by linarith [hr_Ioo.1]
    have hexp_2t : Real.exp (2 * t) = (1 + r) / (1 - r) := by
      have h2t : 2 * t = Real.log ((1 + r) / (1 - r)) := by dsimp [t]; ring
      rw [h2t, Real.exp_log (div_pos h1pr_pos h1mr_pos)]
    have htanh_from_exp : ∀ s : ℝ, Real.tanh s = (Real.exp (2 * s) - 1) / (Real.exp (2 * s) + 1) := by
      intro s
      rw [Real.tanh_eq]
      have hes_ne : Real.exp s ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos s).ne'
      have h2s : Real.exp (2 * s) = Real.exp s * Real.exp s := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have hns : Real.exp (-s) = (Real.exp s)⁻¹ := Real.exp_neg s
      rw [h2s, hns]
      field_simp [hes_ne]
    have htanh_t : Real.tanh t = r := by
      rw [htanh_from_exp t, hexp_2t]
      field_simp [h1mr_pos.ne']
      ring
    have hexp_2t_left : Real.exp (2 * t_left) = (1 + r_left) / (1 - r_left) := by
      have ht_l : r_left = (Real.exp (2 * t_left) - 1) / (Real.exp (2 * t_left) + 1) :=
        htanh_from_exp t_left
      have h1ml_pos : 0 < 1 - r_left := sub_pos.mpr hr_left_mem.2
      have hden_pos : 0 < Real.exp (2 * t_left) + 1 := by positivity
      rw [eq_div_iff h1ml_pos.ne']
      rw [eq_div_iff hden_pos.ne'] at ht_l
      linarith
    have ht_gt_left : t_left < t := by
      have h1ml_pos : 0 < 1 - r_left := sub_pos.mpr hr_left_mem.2
      have h_frac_lt : (1 + r_left) / (1 - r_left) < (1 + r) / (1 - r) := by
        rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ h1ml_pos h1mr_pos]
        nlinarith
      rw [← hexp_2t_left, ← hexp_2t, Real.exp_lt_exp] at h_frac_lt
      linarith
    have ht_gt_M1 : M_1 + 1 < t := by dsimp [t_left] at ht_gt_left; linarith
    have ht_gt_10 : 10 < t := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hlam_t, hWQ_t⟩ := h_real_bridge t ht_gt_10
    rw [htanh_t, hr_eq_x] at hWQ_t
    rw [htanh_t] at hlam_t
    have hWQ_t_re : (W_Q (t : ℂ)).re = x := by rw [hWQ_t, Complex.ofReal_re]
    have hz_real_t := (hZ_real t ht_gt_M1).2
    rw [hWQ_t_re] at hz_real_t
    have hzin_x : z_in (x : ℂ) = (t : ℂ) := hz_real_t
    dsimp [Δ_slit_in]
    rw [hzin_x, hlam_t, ← hr_eq_x, hΔ_real r hr_Ioo]

  
  refine ⟨r_patch, ε_ov, Δ_slit_in, Δ_slit_out,
    hr_pos, hr_lt_R, hε_pos, hε_lt_r,
    h_in_pack.1, h_out_pack.1, h_real_eq,
    fun w hw => (h_in_pack.2 w hw).2.2,
    fun w hw => (h_out_pack.2 w hw).2.2,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hw him_pos
    have hz0_eq := (hz0_sheet_cmp w hw).1 him_pos
    dsimp [Δ_slit_out, Δ_slit_in, z_out, z_in]
    rw [hz0_eq]
  · intro w hw him_neg hΔ_eq
    have hz0_in_V : z0_in w ∈ V := (hz0_in_prop w hw.1).1
    have hz0_out_V : z0_out w ∈ V := (hz0_out_prop w hw.2).1
    have hz0_shift := (hz0_sheet_cmp w hw).2 him_neg
    rw [hz0_shift] at hz0_out_V
    have hlam_ne_sheets := hZ_mono (z0_in w) hz0_in_V hz0_out_V
    have hw_ne : w ≠ 0 := (h_in_pack.2 w hw.1).1
    have hq_in_ne : lamZ (z_in w) / w ≠ 0 := (h_in_pack.2 w hw.1).2.1
    have hq_out_ne : lamZ (z_out w) / w ≠ 0 := (h_out_pack.2 w hw.2).2.1
    have hlog_eq : Complex.log (lamZ (z_out w) / w) = Complex.log (lamZ (z_in w) / w) :=
      mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero hΔ_eq
    have hexp_q := congrArg Complex.exp hlog_eq
    rw [Complex.exp_log hq_out_ne, Complex.exp_log hq_in_ne] at hexp_q
    have hlam_eq : lamZ (z_out w) = lamZ (z_in w) := by
      have := congrArg (· * w) hexp_q
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hw_ne, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hw_ne] at this
    dsimp [z_out, z_in] at hlam_eq
    rw [hz0_shift] at hlam_eq
    exact hlam_ne_sheets hlam_eq

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 :
      ∀ (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ t₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ),
        IsDownwardVertConvex U₁ →
        IsDownwardVertConvex U₂ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
        (y₀, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
        0 ≤ y₀.im →
        0 < δ₀ →
        (∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f₁ (y, t₀) = f₂ (y, t₀)) →
        f₁ (y₀, t₀) = f₂ (y₀, t₀) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ f₁ f₂ y₀ t₀ δ₀ hU₁ hU₂ hf₁ hf₂ hy₀ him hδ₀ heq
    let x₀ : ℝ := y₀.re
    let η₀ : ℝ := y₀.im
    let V : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ }
    have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
      (hU₁.1.inter hU₂.1).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    let γ : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => (x₀ : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := by fun_prop
    let K : Set ℂ := γ '' Set.Icc 0 η₀
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.image hγ_cont

        (h_fderiv_int.differentiableAt).const_mul (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)
      have heq_ev :
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) =ᶠ[nhds q₀]
            (fun q => ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_int q θ) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds q₀ hr_pos] with q hq
        exact h_rep q hq
      exact (h_int_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq_ev).differentiableWithinAt
    intro U F hU hF
    refine ⟨h_first U F hU hF, ?_⟩
    let L_swap : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.2.1, q.1, q.2.2)
    have hL_diff : Differentiable ℂ L_swap := by fun_prop
    have hU' : IsOpen (L_swap ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage hL_diff.continuous
    have hF' : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F ∘ L_swap) (L_swap ⁻¹' U) :=
      hF.comp hL_diff.differentiableOn fun _ hq => hq
    have hG' := h_first (L_swap ⁻¹' U) (F ∘ L_swap) hU' hF'
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo L_swap U (L_swap ⁻¹' U) := by
      intro q hq
      simpa [L_swap] using hq
    exact hG'.comp hL_diff.differentiableOn hmaps

  exact
    { vertical_tube_uniqueness := h_s1
      binomial_dip_poly := h_s2
      circle_average_disk_continuation := h_s3
      partial_derivs_holo_3d := h_s4 }

noncomputable def rctScaledActionP {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.p_act (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S) J (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))

noncomputable def rctModelActionP (kind : ExpProfileKind) {X : ExpStripData}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  frozenActionP kind (T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S)) J

noncomputable def rctActDS (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun S' => F S' J T) S

noncomputable def rctActDJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' => F S J' T) J

noncomputable def rctActDJJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun J' => deriv (fun J'' => F S J'' T) J') J

noncomputable def rctActDSJ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv (fun S' => deriv (fun J' => F S' J' T) J) S

noncomputable def rctActDJS (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S J T : ℂ) : ℂ :=

noncomputable def rctInitSymplecticState {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (S_prev S_curr T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  if 0 < σ then
    let D_prev : ℂ := (S_curr - S_prev) / a_n
    (S_curr, rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_prev D_prev T)
  else
    let D_prev : ℂ := (S_prev - S_curr) / a_n
    (S_curr,
      rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_curr D_prev T -
        a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S_curr D_prev T)

noncomputable def rctRunCorridorChain {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (σ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0, _, _, q₀ => q₀
  | k + 1, Y₀, T, q₀ =>
      let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      Ψ n (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)
        (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T q₀)

structure RctFrozenJetAndELProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  chart_jets :
    ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenState kind
        (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
      let μ₀ : ℂ := rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₀ J₀ T₀
      μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ (r_c : ℝ) (N_c : ℕ) (M_c : ℝ),
        0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧
        let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
          (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_ε ≥ N_c, ∀ n ≥ N_ε,
          ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T) -
              (rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₂ J₂ T)‖ ≤
              ε * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c, ∀ (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (Y T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let D_prev : ℂ := (S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - a_n)) / a_n
          let D_curr : ℂ := (S_fn (Y + a_n) - S_fn Y) / a_n
          (S_fn Y, (D_curr, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          (S_fn (Y - a_n), (D_prev, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
          rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T -
            a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T =
            rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn (Y - a_n)) D_prev T)
  model_euler_lagrange :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
      ∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V_mod →
        ∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
          ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
            let Y : ℂ := p.1
            let T : ℂ := p.2
            let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
            let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
            let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
            (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
            ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T -
                a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T) -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T)) D_prev T‖ ≤
              C_EL * ‖a‖ ^ 2

def RctCorridorStepEngineProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max L_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max → 0 < L_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
    (∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K_corr, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
        let Y : ℂ := p.1
        let T : ℂ := p.2
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
        let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
        (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
        ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖) ∧
    ∃ (η_corr r_init C_Gron : ℝ) (N_eng : ℕ) (δ_mod : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_init ∧ 0 < C_Gron ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ_mod n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ_mod Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ (n d k₁ : ℕ) (Y₀ T : ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (d + k₁) Y₀ T q₀ =
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k₁
            (Y₀ + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
            (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n d Y₀ T q₀)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
          T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
          (∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) ∈ U_corr) →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let e_init : ℝ :=
            ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
          e_init < r_init →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let S_k : ℂ :=
              (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T
                (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T)).1
            ‖S_k - S_star (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ ≤
              C_Gron * (e_init + δ_mod n) ∧
            expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_k ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
          (∀ w ∈ W,
            T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
            let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (∀ k ≤ K_n, (Y₀_fn w + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr) ∧
            ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init) →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                  (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1)
              W)
