    (σ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  | 0, _, _, q₀ => q₀
  | k + 1, Y₀, T, q₀ =>
      let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      Ψ n (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)
        (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T q₀)

structure RctFrozenJetAndELProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop where
  chart_jets :
    ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenState kind
        (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
      let μ₀ : ℂ := rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₀ J₀ T₀
      μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ (r_c : ℝ) (N_c : ℕ) (M_c : ℝ),
        0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧
        let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
            ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
          (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
              M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_ε ≥ N_c, ∀ n ≥ N_ε,
          ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
            (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T) -
              (rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₂ J₂ T)‖ ≤
              ε * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_c, ∀ (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (Y T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let D_prev : ℂ := (S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - a_n)) / a_n
          let D_curr : ℂ := (S_fn (Y + a_n) - S_fn Y) / a_n
          (S_fn Y, (D_curr, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          (S_fn (Y - a_n), (D_prev, T)) ∈ Q_c →
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
          rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T -
            a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T =
            rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn (Y - a_n)) D_prev T)
  model_euler_lagrange :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
      ∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V_mod →
        ∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
          ∀ p ∈ K, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
            let Y : ℂ := p.1
            let T : ℂ := p.2
            let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
            let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
            let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
            (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
            ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
            ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T -
                a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T) -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T)) D_prev T‖ ≤
              C_EL * ‖a‖ ^ 2

def RctCorridorStepEngineProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max L_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max → 0 < L_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1) V_mod ∧
    (∃ (a_max C_EL : ℝ), 0 < a_max ∧ 0 < C_EL ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K_corr, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ a_max →
        let Y : ℂ := p.1
        let T : ℂ := p.2
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
        let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
        (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
        ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a‖) ∧
    ∃ (η_corr r_init C_Gron : ℝ) (N_eng : ℕ) (δ_mod : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_init ∧ 0 < C_Gron ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ_mod n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ_mod Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ (n d k₁ : ℕ) (Y₀ T : ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (d + k₁) Y₀ T q₀ =
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k₁
            (Y₀ + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
            (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n d Y₀ T q₀)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
          T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
          (∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) ∈ U_corr) →
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          let e_init : ℝ :=
            ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
          e_init < r_init →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            let S_k : ℂ :=
              (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T
                (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T)).1
            ‖S_k - S_star (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ ≤
              C_Gron * (e_init + δ_mod n) ∧
            expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_k ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_eng, ∀ K_n : ℕ,
        (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
        ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
          (∀ w ∈ W,
            T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
            let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            (∀ k ≤ K_n, (Y₀_fn w + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr) ∧
            ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
              ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init) →
          ∀ k ≤ K_n,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                  (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1)
              W)

subgoal_signatures.name: horizontal_corridor_chain_tracking
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hEngine : RctCorridorStepEngineProp X P kind seq) :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (T₀ Y_plus : ℂ)
      (ε_plus L_max : ℝ) (S_init : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (N_base : ℕ) (N_step : ℕ → ℕ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      T₀ ≠ 0 → 0 < ε_plus → 0 < L_max →
      Metric.closedBall Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) ×ˢ ({T₀} : Set ℂ) ⊆ V_mod →
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_plus ε_plus, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L_max,
        (Z + (τ : ℂ) * T₀, T₀) ∈ V_mod) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_init n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus))) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus),
        Z - T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        Z + T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n Z T₀) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_init (fun Z => S_star (Z, T₀))
        Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_plus)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max) →
      ∃ (N_tr : ℕ) (S_chain : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        N_base ≤ N_tr ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_chain n j) (Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          S_chain n 0 Z = S_init n Z ∧ S_chain n 1 Z = S_init n (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j < N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          Z + a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus →
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_chain n j (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ ≥ N_tr, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
            let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            ‖S_chain n j Z - S_star (Z + (j : ℂ) * a_n, T₀)‖ < ε)

subgoal_signatures.name: steep_corridor_vertical_passage
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hEngine : RctCorridorStepEngineProp X P kind seq) :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (σ η T_max : ℝ) (U_T : Set ℂ) (x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top : ℝ)
      (K_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < η → 0 < T_max →
      IsOpen U_T →
      U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
      x_lo < x_hi → y_bot < y_top →
      (let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T }
       let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
       let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
       B_init ⊆ V_mod →
       IsCompact K_steep →
       K_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
         x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
         y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } →
       (∀ p ∈ K_steep, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
         let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
         let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
           (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
         x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
         (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi) →
       ∃ W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
         IsOpen W_steep ∧
         K_steep ⊆ W_steep ∧
         W_steep ⊆ V_mod ∧
         W_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
           y_bot + δ_y / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, (Y, T) ∈ W_steep →
           ∀ τ : ℝ, y_bot + δ_y ≤ τ → τ ≤ Y.im →
             ((Y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, T) ∈ W_steep) ∧
         ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_low : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_low n) B_init) →
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
             (Y, T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
           (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B_init →
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_low S_star Filter.atTop K) →
           ∃ (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
             N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
               expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
               S_ext n p = S_low n p) ∧

noncomputable def expParamStar {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : ℝ :=
  (‖seq.c₀‖)⁻¹

noncomputable def expArgC0 {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : ℝ :=
  Complex.arg seq.c₀

noncomputable def expShearOffset (T_star : ℝ) (T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -Complex.I * Complex.log (T / (T_star : ℂ))

noncomputable def expShearedModelW (α_c : ℝ) (Y_tilde : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y_tilde - (α_c : ℂ)))

noncomputable def expShearedInnerModel {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  p.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) p.2 +
    M.Δ_inner (expShearedModelW (expArgC0 seq) p.1)

def expShearedInnerDomain {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    ‖p.2 - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq ∧
    expShearedModelW (expArgC0 seq) p.1 ∈ branchInnerDomain M.R M.ν M.θ M.δ_θ }

def complexRect (x_lo x_hi y_lo y_hi : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | x_lo < z.re ∧ z.re < x_hi ∧ y_lo < z.im ∧ z.im < y_hi }

noncomputable def physToSheared {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  ((p.1 - expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) -
    expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) ((seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2),
   (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2)

noncomputable def shearedToPhys {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  (expBasePt seq n +
    (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (q.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) q.2),
   q.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))

noncomputable def shearedRescaledLift {X : ExpStripData} {kind : ExpProfileKind}
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (s_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  rescaledLift seq s_fn n (q.1 + expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) q.2) q.2

structure ShearedModelAndDeepBridgeProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Prop where
  T_star_pos : 0 < expParamStar seq
  unit_c₀ :
    (expParamStar seq : ℂ) * seq.c₀ =
      Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  shear_zero : expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) (expParamStar seq : ℂ) = 0
  shear_holo_bounds :
    let U_T_all := Metric.ball (expParamStar seq : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq)
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (expShearOffset (expParamStar seq)) U_T_all ∧
    ∀ T ∈ U_T_all,
      T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < 2 * expParamStar seq ∧
      |(expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) T).im| < 1 ∧
      |(expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) T).re| < 4
  inner_model_reg :
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M)
  mem_inner_of_lt_log_R :
    ∀ Y_tilde T : ℂ,
      ‖T - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M
  mem_inner_of_sector :
    ∀ (sgn : ℝ) (Y_tilde T : ℂ),
      (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ‖T - (expParamStar seq : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν →
      |Y_tilde.re - (expArgC0 seq - sgn * M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M
  arcsin_collar :
    ∀ (x₀ δ_ϕ : ℝ),
      x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (1 / 4) → 0 < δ_ϕ →
      ∀ ϕ : ℝ, |Real.sin ϕ - x₀| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 δ_ϕ →
        ∃ k : ℤ,
          |ϕ - Real.arcsin x₀ - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
          |ϕ - (Real.pi - Real.arcsin x₀) - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ
  deep_sheared_init :
    ∃ D₁ : ℝ, 2 ≤ D₁ ∧
      ∀ (X_deep H_deep_bot : ℝ), 0 < X_deep → H_deep_bot < -D₁ - 4 →
        let U_T_all := Metric.ball (expParamStar seq : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * expParamStar seq)
        let R_deep := complexRect (-X_deep) X_deep H_deep_bot (-D₁ - 1)
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let S_sh := shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n
            IsDownwardVertConvex (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < 4 * expParamStar seq / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ q ∈ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all, shearedToPhys seq n q ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ S_sh (R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all) ∧
            (∀ q ∈ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all,
              expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh q ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_all → Y ∈ R_deep →
              Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →
              Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →
              SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_sh (Z, T)) n Y T)) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ R_deep ×ˢ U_T_all →
            TendstoUniformlyOn
              (fun n q => shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n q)
              (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop K)

def ShearedDiskLiftProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max R_rad η M_g η_plus : ℝ)
    (U_T_prev K_T_prev U_T_c : Set ℂ)
    (x_lo x_c_lo x_c_hi x_hi H_prev_bot y_bot y_top H_c_bot H_c_top : ℝ)
    (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < R_rad → 0 < η → 0 ≤ M_g → 0 < η_plus →
    IsOpen U_T_prev → IsCompact K_T_prev → K_T_prev ⊆ U_T_prev →
    U_T_prev ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T_max →
    IsOpen U_T_c →
    x_lo < x_c_lo - M_g → x_c_lo < x_c_hi → x_c_hi + M_g < x_hi →
    H_prev_bot < y_bot → y_bot < y_top →
    H_prev_bot < H_c_bot - M_g → H_c_bot < H_c_top →
    (let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
     let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
     let U_prev : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi H_prev_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let B_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let W_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_c_lo x_c_hi H_c_bot H_c_top ×ˢ U_T_c
     H_c_bot < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
     Differentiable ℂ g → g 0 = 0 →
     (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M_g ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ ∈ U_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       |(T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η →
       H_c_top + (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤
         y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) →
     B_rec ⊆ V_mod →
     (∀ p ∈ W_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       (p.1 + g ζ, p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ) ∈ V_mod) →
     (∀ (σ : ℝ), (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
       ∀ (Y' T' : ℂ),
         x_c_lo - M_g ≤ Y'.re → Y'.re ≤ x_c_hi + M_g →
         y_mid ≤ Y'.im → Y'.im ≤ H_c_top + η_plus →
         T' ∈ K_T_prev → (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ σ * T'.im →
         ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid Y'.im,
           let Y_vert : ℂ := (Y'.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
           let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * T'.im)
           (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
             (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T', T') ∈ V_mod) ∧
           x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re ∧
           (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re < x_hi) →
     ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_prev : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_prev n) U_prev) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ p ∈ U_prev,
         expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_prev n p ∈ X.D_strip) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
         (Y, T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_prev n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
       (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U_prev →
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_prev S_star Filter.atTop K) →
       ∃ (N₁ : ℕ) (S_next : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
         N₀ ≤ N₁ ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_next n) W_c) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_next n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
           S_next n p = S_prev n p) ∧
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_next S_star Filter.atTop W_c)

def VertRecurrenceProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max : ℝ) (U_T K_T : Set ℂ)
    (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ y_seed δ_r : ℝ)
    (N₀ : ℕ) (S_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < δ_r →
    IsOpen U_T → IsCompact K_T → K_T ⊆ U_T →
    U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
    x₁ + 2 * δ_r < x₂ → y₁ + 2 * δ_r < y₂ →
    y₁ + δ_r < y_seed → y_seed ≤ y₂ →
    complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T ⊆ V_mod →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_seq n) (complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T)) →
    (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_seq S_star Filter.atTop K) →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ K_T →
      Y ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
    ∃ N_rec : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N_rec ∧
      ∀ n ≥ N_rec, ∀ T ∈ K_T,
        ∀ Y ∈ complexRect (x₁ + δ_r) (x₂ - δ_r) (y₁ + δ_r) (y₂ - δ_r),
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T

def StageOneShearedProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ ν' : ℝ, 0 < ν' → ν' < M.ν →
    let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
    let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
    let r₀ : ℝ := T_star / 32
    let X₁ : ℝ := |α_c| + M.θ + 10
    let U_T_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
    ∃ (H_1_bot H_cut_0 : ℝ) (N₁ : ℕ)
      (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ) (S₁ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      H_1_bot < Real.log M.R - 55 ∧
      H_1_bot + 1 < H_cut_0 ∧
      H_cut_0 < Real.log M.R - 50 ∧
      (let R_1_full := complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot (Real.log M.R - ν')
       let R_1_rec :=
         complexRect (-X₁ + ν' / 8) (X₁ - ν' / 8)
           (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - (9 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
       (∀ n ≥ N₁,
         IsDownwardVertConvex (U_phys n) ∧
         0 < δ_base n ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < 4 * T_star / seq.m_seq n →
           (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_cut_0 ×ˢ U_T_1,
           shearedToPhys seq n q ∈ U_phys n ∧
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q =
             s_tilde n (shearedToPhys seq n q)) ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₁ n) (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_1 → Y ∈ R_1_rec →
           SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S₁ n (Z, T)) n Y T)) ∧
       TendstoUniformlyOn S₁ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
         (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1))

  arcsin_collar :
    ∀ (x₀ δ_ϕ : ℝ),

    ∃ D₁ : ℝ, 2 ≤ D₁ ∧

            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_all → Y ∈ R_deep →
              Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →
              Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ R_deep →

def ShearedDiskLiftProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max R_rad η M_g η_plus : ℝ)
    (U_T_prev K_T_prev U_T_c : Set ℂ)
    (x_lo x_c_lo x_c_hi x_hi H_prev_bot y_bot y_top H_c_bot H_c_top : ℝ)
    (g : ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < R_rad → 0 < η → 0 ≤ M_g → 0 < η_plus →
    IsOpen U_T_prev → IsCompact K_T_prev → K_T_prev ⊆ U_T_prev →
    U_T_prev ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) T_max →
    IsOpen U_T_c →
    x_lo < x_c_lo - M_g → x_c_lo < x_c_hi → x_c_hi + M_g < x_hi →
    H_prev_bot < y_bot → y_bot < y_top →
    H_prev_bot < H_c_bot - M_g → H_c_bot < H_c_top →
    (let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
     let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
     let U_prev : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi H_prev_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let B_rec : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top ×ˢ U_T_prev
     let W_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := complexRect x_c_lo x_c_hi H_c_bot H_c_top ×ˢ U_T_c
     H_c_bot < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
     Differentiable ℂ g → g 0 = 0 →
     (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ M_g ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ ∈ U_T_prev) →
     (∀ T_c ∈ U_T_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
       |(T_c + (R_rad : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
         (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η →
       H_c_top + (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤
         y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) →
     B_rec ⊆ V_mod →
     (∀ p ∈ W_c, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
       (p.1 + g ζ, p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ) ∈ V_mod) →
     (∀ (σ : ℝ), (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
       ∀ (Y' T' : ℂ),
         x_c_lo - M_g ≤ Y'.re → Y'.re ≤ x_c_hi + M_g →
         y_mid ≤ Y'.im → Y'.im ≤ H_c_top + η_plus →
         T' ∈ K_T_prev → (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ σ * T'.im →
         ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid Y'.im,
           let Y_vert : ℂ := (Y'.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
           let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * T'.im)
           (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
             (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T', T') ∈ V_mod) ∧
           x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re ∧
           (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re < x_hi) →
     ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_prev : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_prev n) U_prev) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ p ∈ U_prev,
         expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_prev n p ∈ X.D_strip) →
       (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
         (Y, T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_rec →
         SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_prev n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
       (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U_prev →
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_prev S_star Filter.atTop K) →
       ∃ (N₁ : ℕ) (S_next : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
         N₀ ≤ N₁ ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_next n) W_c) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_next n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ W_c, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y - η_plus →
           S_next n p = S_prev n p) ∧
         TendstoUniformlyOn S_next S_star Filter.atTop W_c)

def VertRecurrenceProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (T_max : ℝ) (U_T K_T : Set ℂ)
    (x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ y_seed δ_r : ℝ)
    (N₀ : ℕ) (S_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    0 < T_max → 0 < δ_r →
    IsOpen U_T → IsCompact K_T → K_T ⊆ U_T →
    U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
    x₁ + 2 * δ_r < x₂ → y₁ + 2 * δ_r < y₂ →
    y₁ + δ_r < y_seed → y_seed ≤ y₂ →
    complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T ⊆ V_mod →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_seq n) (complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T)) →
    (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ ×ˢ U_T →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_seq S_star Filter.atTop K) →
    (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ K_T →
      Y ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
    ∃ N_rec : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N_rec ∧
      ∀ n ≥ N_rec, ∀ T ∈ K_T,
        ∀ Y ∈ complexRect (x₁ + δ_r) (x₂ - δ_r) (y₁ + δ_r) (y₂ - δ_r),
          SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_seq n (Z, T)) n Y T

def StageOneShearedProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ ν' : ℝ, 0 < ν' → ν' < M.ν →
    let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
    let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
    let r₀ : ℝ := T_star / 32
    let X₁ : ℝ := |α_c| + M.θ + 10
    let U_T_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
    ∃ (H_1_bot H_cut_0 : ℝ) (N₁ : ℕ)
      (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ) (S₁ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      H_1_bot < Real.log M.R - 55 ∧
      H_1_bot + 1 < H_cut_0 ∧
      H_cut_0 < Real.log M.R - 50 ∧
      (let R_1_full := complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot (Real.log M.R - ν')
       let R_1_rec :=
         complexRect (-X₁ + ν' / 8) (X₁ - ν' / 8)
           (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - (9 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
       (∀ n ≥ N₁,
         IsDownwardVertConvex (U_phys n) ∧
         0 < δ_base n ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < 4 * T_star / seq.m_seq n →
           (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_cut_0 ×ˢ U_T_1,
           shearedToPhys seq n q ∈ U_phys n ∧
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q =
             s_tilde n (shearedToPhys seq n q)) ∧
         DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₁ n) (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1) ∧
         (∀ q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1,
           expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n q ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ U_T_1 → Y ∈ R_1_rec →
           SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S₁ n (Z, T)) n Y T)) ∧
       TendstoUniformlyOn S₁ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
         (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1))

        _ ≤ B.ε_patch := hZ_norm
    have h_im_diff : |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| ≤ B.ε_patch := by
      calc |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| = |(Z - Y_plus).im| := by simp [Y_plus]
        _ ≤ ‖Z - Y_plus‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ ≤ B.ε_patch := hZ_norm
    rw [abs_le] at h_re_diff h_im_diff
    have hτ_lo : 0 ≤ τ * T_star := mul_nonneg hτ.1 hT_pos.le
    have hτ_hi : τ * T_star ≤ 2 * M.θ := by
      calc τ * T_star ≤ L_max * T_star := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτ.2 hT_pos.le
        _ = 2 * M.θ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hT_pos.ne'
    let Z' : ℂ := Z + (τ : ℂ) * (T_star : ℂ)
    have hZ'_re : Z'.re = Z.re + τ * T_star := by simp [Z']
    have hZ'_im : Z'.im = Z.im := by simp [Z']
    have hu_pos : 0 < Z'.im - Real.log M.R := by
      rw [hZ'_im]; linarith [B.ε_patch_lt_ν, B.ν'_pos]
    have hu_lt_ν : Z'.im - Real.log M.R < M.ν := by
      rw [hZ'_im]; linarith [B.ε_patch_lt_ν, B.ν'_pos, B.ν'_lt]
    have hψ_arg : |α_c - Z'.re| < M.θ + M.δ_θ := by
      rw [hZ'_re, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [B.ε_patch_lt_δ, M.θ_pos, M.δ_θ_pos]
    obtain ⟨hw_re, hw_norm, hw_arg⟩ :=
      h_polar_props Z' (lt_trans hψ_arg h_angle_sum)
    refine ⟨hw_re, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hw_norm]
      exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_right M.R_pos (Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hu_pos)
    · rw [hw_norm]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hu_lt_ν) M.R_pos
    · rwa [hw_arg]
  have hY_minus_seg : Y_minus = Y_plus + (L_max : ℂ) * (T_star : ℂ) := by
    have hcancel : L_max * T_star = 2 * M.θ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hT_pos.ne'
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [Y_plus, Y_minus, hcancel]; ring
    · simp [Y_plus, Y_minus]
  have hY_minus_V : (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)) ∈ V_outer := by
    rw [hY_minus_seg]
    exact hSeg_out Y_plus (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hε_pos.le) L_max ⟨hL_max_pos.le, le_rfl⟩
  have hCont_out : ContinuousAt (fun Z => S_outer (Z, (T_star : ℂ))) Y_minus := by
    have hS_cont : ContinuousAt S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)) :=
      hS_out_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hV_out_open.mem_nhds hY_minus_V)
    have h_pair_cont : ContinuousAt (fun Z : ℂ => (Z, (T_star : ℂ))) Y_minus := by fun_prop
    exact Filter.Tendsto.comp hS_cont h_pair_cont
  have hMono_ne : S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)) ≠ F_inner Y_minus := by
    have hw_minus : w_map (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)) =
        (M.R : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((B.ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - (M.θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      rw [hw_exp Y_minus]
      congr 2
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [Y_minus]
    have h_ne := M.monodromy_minus_ne (B.ν' / 2) (half_pos B.ν'_pos)
      (by linarith [B.ν'_pos, B.ν'_lt])
    intro h_eq
    dsimp [S_outer, F_inner] at h_eq
    have hΔ_eq : M.Δ_outer (w_map (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ))) =
        M.Δ_inner (w_map (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ))) := add_left_cancel h_eq
    rw [hw_minus] at hΔ_eq
    exact h_ne hΔ_eq

  
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => T_star / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n)
  let N_step : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => Nat.floor (2 * M.θ / a n)
  have ha_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < a n :=
    fun n => div_pos hT_pos (mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n))
  have ha_cast : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (a n : ℂ) = (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    fun n => Complex.ofReal_div T_star (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n)
  have ha_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    seq.b_tendsto.const_div_atTop T_star
  have hStep_le : ∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max := by
    intro n
    have hb_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
    have hfl : (N_step n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * M.θ / a n :=
      Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by linarith [M.θ_pos]) (ha_pos n).le)
    have hdiv_eq : 2 * M.θ / a n = L_max * (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) := by
      dsimp [a, L_max]
      field_simp [hT_pos.ne', hb_pos.ne']
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hb_pos]
    linarith
  have hInit_holo : ∀ n ≥ N_prom,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_true n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * B.ε_patch)) := by
    intro n hn
    refine (hProm n hn).1.mono fun Z hZ => ?_
    have hZ_norm : ‖Z - Y_plus‖ < 3 * B.ε_patch := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hZ
    change |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| < 3 * B.ε_patch
    calc |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| = |(Z - Y_plus).im| := by simp [Y_plus]
      _ ≤ ‖Z - Y_plus‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      _ < 3 * B.ε_patch := hZ_norm
  have hInit_rec : ∀ n ≥ N_prom, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * B.ε_patch),
      Z - (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * B.ε_patch) →
      Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
        Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * B.ε_patch) →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_true n) n Z (T_star : ℂ) := by
    intro n hn Z hZ hZ_prev hZ_next
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, h_rec_plus⟩ :=
      B.patch_props n (le_trans hN_prom_ge hn)
    have hZ_3 : Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * B.ε_patch) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
    have h_rec := h_rec_plus Z hZ hZ_prev hZ_next
    unfold SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence at h_rec ⊢
    dsimp only at h_rec ⊢
    rw [(hProm n hn).2.1 _ hZ_prev, (hProm n hn).2.1 _ hZ_3, (hProm n hn).2.1 _ hZ_next]
    exact h_rec
  have hConv_plus_true : TendstoUniformlyOn S_true F_inner Filter.atTop
      (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * B.ε_patch)) := by
    refine B.conv_plus.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_prom] with n hn Z hZ
    exact ((hProm n hn).2.1 Z
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ)).symm
  have hInit_conv : TendstoUniformlyOn S_true (fun Z => S_outer (Z, (T_star : ℂ)))
      Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * B.ε_patch)) :=
    hConv_plus_true.congr_right fun Z hZ =>
      (hOv_eq Z (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith) hZ)).symm
  obtain ⟨N_tr, S_chain, hN_tr_ge, hChain_holo, hChain_init, hChain_shift, hChain_conv⟩ :=
    hTrack.horizontal_chain_tracking V_outer S_outer (T_star : ℂ) Y_plus B.ε_patch L_max
      S_true N_prom N_step hMod_out hT_c_ne hε_pos hL_max_pos hBall_out hSeg_out
      hInit_holo hInit_rec hInit_conv hStep_le

  obtain ⟨N_a, hN_a⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp ha_tendsto) B.ε_patch hε_pos
  have ha_lt : ∀ n ≥ N_a, a n < B.ε_patch := by
    intro n hn
    have hd := hN_a n hn
    rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (ha_pos n)] at hd
  let B₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.ball Y_plus B.ε_patch
  have h_glue : ∀ n ≥ max N_tr N_a, ∀ j ≤ N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ B₁,
      S_chain n j Z = S_true n (Z + (j : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)) := by
    intro n hn j
    have hn_tr : N_tr ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_a : N_a ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have hn_prom : N_prom ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_ge hn_tr
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _ Z hZ
      simpa using (hChain_init n hn_tr Z hZ).1
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj1
      have hj_lt : j < N_step n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hj1
      have hf₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (S_chain n (j + 1)) B₁ :=
        (hChain_holo n hn_tr (j + 1) hj1).analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h_shift_maps : Set.MapsTo
          (fun Z : ℂ => Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)) B₁ H_band := by
        intro Z hZ
        have hZ_norm : ‖Z - Y_plus‖ < B.ε_patch := by
          simpa [B₁, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hZ
        change |(Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)).im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| <
          3 * B.ε_patch
        have him : (Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)).im = Z.im := by simp
        rw [him]
        calc |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| = |(Z - Y_plus).im| := by simp [Y_plus]
          _ ≤ ‖Z - Y_plus‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
          _ < B.ε_patch := hZ_norm
          _ < 3 * B.ε_patch := by linarith
      have hf₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun Z => S_true n (Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ))) B₁ :=
        (hProm n hn_prom).1.comp
          (differentiable_id.add (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn h_shift_maps
      have hf₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
          (fun Z => S_true n (Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ))) B₁ :=
        hf₂_holo.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
      let V_ov : Set ℂ := B₁ ∩ { Z : ℂ | Z + (a n : ℂ) ∈ B₁ }
      have hV_ov_open : IsOpen V_ov :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
      let Z_mid : ℂ := Y_plus - ((a n / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have ha_half_lt : a n / 2 < B.ε_patch := by linarith [ha_pos n, ha_lt n hn_a]
      have hZ_mid_B₁ : Z_mid ∈ B₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_sub : Z_mid - Y_plus = -((a n / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by dsimp [Z_mid]; ring
        rw [h_sub, norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (half_pos (ha_pos n))]
        exact ha_half_lt
      have hZ_mid_add_B₁ : Z_mid + (a n : ℂ) ∈ B₁ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_sub : Z_mid + (a n : ℂ) - Y_plus = ((a n / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          dsimp [Z_mid]; push_cast; ring
        rw [h_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (half_pos (ha_pos n))]
        exact ha_half_lt
      have h_ov_eq : ∀ Z ∈ V_ov,
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_true n (Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)) := by
        intro Z hZ
        have hZ_add_raw :
            Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ B₁ := by
          rw [← ha_cast n]
          exact hZ.2
        have h1 := hChain_shift n hn_tr j hj_lt Z hZ.1 hZ_add_raw
        rw [← ha_cast n] at h1
        rw [h1, ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hj1) (Z + (a n : ℂ)) hZ.2]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      have hev_eq : S_chain n (j + 1) =ᶠ[nhds Z_mid]
          (fun Z => S_true n (Z + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ))) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV_ov_open.mem_nhds ⟨hZ_mid_B₁, hZ_mid_add_B₁⟩) h_ov_eq
      exact hf₁_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hf₂_ana
        (convex_ball Y_plus B.ε_patch).isPreconnected hZ_mid_B₁ hev_eq

  let Y_end : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => Y_plus + (N_step n : ℂ) * (a n : ℂ)
  have hY_plus_add : Y_plus + ((2 * M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) = Y_minus := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [Y_plus, Y_minus]; ring
    · simp [Y_plus, Y_minus]
  have hY_end_dist : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖Y_end n - Y_minus‖ < a n := by
    intro n
    have hfl_le : (N_step n : ℝ) * a n ≤ 2 * M.θ :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (ha_pos n)).mp
        (Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (by linarith [M.θ_pos]) (ha_pos n).le))
    have hfl_gt : 2 * M.θ < ((N_step n : ℝ) + 1) * a n :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ (ha_pos n)).mp (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _)
    have hdiff : Y_end n - Y_minus = (((N_step n : ℝ) * a n - 2 * M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← hY_plus_add]
      dsimp [Y_end]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hdiff, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hY_end_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto Y_end Filter.atTop (nhds Y_minus) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N_ε, hN_ε⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp ha_tendsto) ε hε
    refine ⟨N_ε, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hd := hN_ε n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (ha_pos n)] at hd
    exact lt_trans (hY_end_dist n) hd

  let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => S_true n (Y_end n)
  let s_closed : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall Y_minus (2 * B.ε_patch)
  have hConv_minus_true : TendstoUniformlyOn S_true F_inner Filter.atTop s_closed := by
    refine B.conv_minus.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_prom] with n hn Z hZ
    exact ((hProm n hn).2.2 Z
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ)).symm
  have hs_closed_sub : s_closed ⊆ H_band := by
    intro Z hZ
    have hZ_norm : ‖Z - Y_minus‖ ≤ 2 * B.ε_patch := by
      simpa [s_closed, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hZ
    change |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| < 3 * B.ε_patch
    calc |Z.im - (Real.log M.R + B.ν' / 2)| = |(Z - Y_minus).im| := by simp [Y_minus]
      _ ≤ ‖Z - Y_minus‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      _ ≤ 2 * B.ε_patch := hZ_norm
      _ < 3 * B.ε_patch := by linarith
  have hF_inner_cont : ContinuousOn F_inner s_closed :=
    hConv_minus_true.continuousOn
      ((Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_prom).mono
        fun n hn => ((hProm n hn).1.mono hs_closed_sub).continuousOn).frequently
  have hY_end_within : Filter.Tendsto Y_end Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin Y_minus s_closed) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within Y_end hY_end_tendsto
      ((Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N_a).mono fun n hn => by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        linarith [hY_end_dist n, ha_lt n hn])
  have hLim_inner : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds (F_inner Y_minus)) :=
    hConv_minus_true.tendsto_comp
      (hF_inner_cont Y_minus (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity))) hY_end_within

  have hLim_outer : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds (S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)))) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₁, _, hN₁⟩ := hChain_conv (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ :=
      (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (hCont_out.tendsto.comp hY_end_tendsto)) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨max (max N_tr N_a) (max N₁ N₂), fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hn_glue : max N_tr N_a ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hY_plus_B₁ : Y_plus ∈ B₁ := Metric.mem_ball_self hε_pos
    have hu_eq : u n = S_chain n (N_step n) Y_plus :=
      (h_glue n hn_glue (N_step n) le_rfl Y_plus hY_plus_B₁).symm
    have h_track_step := hN₁ n hn₁ (N_step n) le_rfl Y_plus hY_plus_B₁
    have h_end_eq :
        Y_plus + (N_step n : ℂ) * ((T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          Y_end n := by
      rw [← ha_cast n]
    have hd₁ : dist (u n) (S_outer (Y_end n, (T_star : ℂ))) < ε / 2 := by
      rw [hu_eq, dist_eq_norm, ← h_end_eq]
      exact h_track_step
    have hd₂ : dist (S_outer (Y_end n, (T_star : ℂ))) (S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ))) < ε / 2 :=
      hN₂ n hn₂
    calc dist (u n) (S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ)))
        ≤ dist (u n) (S_outer (Y_end n, (T_star : ℂ))) +
            dist (S_outer (Y_end n, (T_star : ℂ))) (S_outer (Y_minus, (T_star : ℂ))) :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hd₁ hd₂
      _ = ε := add_halves ε

  exact hMono_ne (tendsto_nhds_unique hLim_outer hLim_inner)

signature.statement: VolterraDivisionProp

proof.tactics:
by
  have hSfca : SfcaVolterraKernelProp := volterra_unit_interval_kernels
  obtain ⟨hODE, hLip⟩ := volterra_ode_uniqueness_wronskian_and_lip hSfca
  obtain ⟨hNeg, hRevRoot, hRevNum, hWronskProd, hk0_zero, hFreeTrig, hFreeLim⟩ :=
    sl_exact_symmetries_wronskian_product_and_free_eval hSfca hODE hLip
  have hEnv :=
    sl_numerator_slit_envelope_and_lipschitz hODE hLip
      (fun Q hQ => (hNeg Q 0 0 hQ).1) hWronskProd hRevNum
  obtain ⟨hCauchy, hDoubleHolo, hBivarRev⟩ := bivariate_hybrid_dslope_cauchy_and_param_holo

  have hDivEq : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ), k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 → ∀ a₀ a₁ : ℂ,
      slDivided Q a₀ a₁ =
        bivarHybridDiv (slNumerator Q) a₀ (a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1) := by
    intro Q hk0 a₀ a₁
    dsimp [slDivided, bivarHybridDiv]
    split_ifs with h_nz
    · have h_slope :
          (a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1 - a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1 = a₁ := by
        have h_sub : a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1 - a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 =
            a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1 := by ring
        rw [h_sub, mul_div_cancel_right₀ a₁ hk0]
      simp only [slNumerator, h_slope]
    · rfl

  have hPart4 : ∀ Q₀ : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn Q₀ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel Q₀ 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∃ δ_Q r_b M_num : ℝ,
        0 < δ_Q ∧ 0 < r_b ∧ 0 < M_num ∧
        (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
          ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
          k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 ∧
          (∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖w₁‖ ≤ r_b →
            ‖slNumerator Q w₀ w₁‖ ≤ M_num ∧
            slNumerator Q 0 w₁ = 0 ∧
            slNumerator Q w₀ 0 = 0) ∧
          (∀ a₀ a₁ : ℂ,
            let b₀ := a₀
            let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
            ‖b₀‖ < r_b / 2 → ‖b₁‖ < r_b / 2 →
            slDivided Q a₀ a₁ =
              (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                    slNumerator Q
                      ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
                      ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) /
                    (((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - b₀) *

def VolterraODEProp : Prop :=
  ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    c0Kernel Q 0 = 1 ∧
    c0Deriv Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Kernel Q 0 = 0 ∧
    k0Deriv Q 0 = 1 ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (c0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Kernel Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    ContinuousOn (k0Deriv Q) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Kernel Q) (c0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (c0Deriv Q) (Q w * c0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Kernel Q) (k0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (k0Deriv Q) (Q w * k0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) ∧
    (∀ y y' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn y (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn y' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt y (y' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt y' (Q w * y w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        y w = y 0 * c0Kernel Q w + y' 0 * k0Kernel Q w ∧
        y' w = y 0 * c0Deriv Q w + y' 0 * k0Deriv Q w) ∧
    (∀ g g' : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn g' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        g w ≠ 0 ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g (g' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt g' (Q w * g w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2)

def VolterraLipHoloProp : Prop :=
  (∀ (M Δ : ℝ) (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
    0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ Δ →
    ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q₁ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₂ w‖ ≤ M ∧ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
      ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M ∧
      ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ M * Real.exp M ∧
      ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 + M * Real.exp M ∧
      ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ ∧
      ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ) ∧
  (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen U →
    ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q q.1 q.2) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Q p w) U) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ a₀ U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ a₁ U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => k0Kernel (Q p) 1) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kPlusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => kMinusVal (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) U)

  if b₀ ≠ 0 ∧ b₁ ≠ 0 then

      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 b₀) 0 b₁

    fun p => (X.𝔰 (p.1, p.2), p.2 * J_curr_tilde p)
  have hg_maps : ∀ p ∈ U_rec, g_prev p ∈ Ω_phi ∧ g_curr p ∈ Ω_phi := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hp2
    obtain ⟨him_p, him_c, hJp_1, hJc_1, _, _⟩ := hCollar_pt p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2
    have hJp_n : ‖J_prev_tilde p‖ < 9 / 8 := by
      have := norm_le_insert' (J_prev_tilde p) 1; norm_num at this; linarith
    have hJc_n : ‖J_curr_tilde p‖ < 9 / 8 := by
      have := norm_le_insert' (J_curr_tilde p) 1; norm_num at this; linarith
    refine ⟨⟨him_p, ?_⟩, ⟨him_c, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul]
      calc ‖p.2‖ * ‖J_prev_tilde p‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ * (9 / 8) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJp_n.le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < r_rec * (9 / 8) := by linarith
        _ < r_t_base := by linarith
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul]
      calc ‖p.2‖ * ‖J_curr_tilde p‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ * (9 / 8) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJc_n.le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ < r_rec * (9 / 8) := by linarith
        _ < r_t_base := by linarith
  have hg_prev_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_prev U_rec :=
    hs_prev_holo.prodMk (differentiable_snd.differentiableOn.mul hJp_holo)
  have hg_curr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_curr U_rec :=
    hs_curr_holo.prodMk (differentiable_snd.differentiableOn.mul hJc_holo)
  let F_ext : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    (3 * (J_curr_tilde p) ^ 2 * chordPhi X (g_curr p).1 (g_curr p).2 +
      (J_curr_tilde p) ^ 3 * (Φ₂ (g_curr p) * p.2) -
      p.2 * ((J_curr_tilde p) ^ 3 * Φ₁ (g_curr p))) -
    (3 * (J_prev_tilde p) ^ 2 * chordPhi X (g_prev p).1 (g_prev p).2 +
      (J_prev_tilde p) ^ 3 * (Φ₂ (g_prev p) * p.2))
  have hF_ext_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_ext U_rec := by
    have hc_phi := hPhi_holo.comp hg_curr_holo (fun p hp => (hg_maps p hp).2)
    have hc_1 := hΦ_parts.1.comp hg_curr_holo (fun p hp => (hg_maps p hp).2)
    have hc_2 := hΦ_parts.2.comp hg_curr_holo (fun p hp => (hg_maps p hp).2)
    have hp_phi := hPhi_holo.comp hg_prev_holo (fun p hp => (hg_maps p hp).1)
    have hp_2 := hΦ_parts.2.comp hg_prev_holo (fun p hp => (hg_maps p hp).1)
    have ht_d : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) U_rec :=
      differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
    exact ((((hJc_holo.pow 2).const_mul 3).mul hc_phi).add
      ((hJc_holo.pow 3).mul (hc_2.mul ht_d)) |>.sub
      (ht_d.mul ((hJc_holo.pow 3).mul hc_1))).sub
      ((((hJp_holo.pow 2).const_mul 3).mul hp_phi).add
        ((hJp_holo.pow 3).mul (hp_2.mul ht_d)))
  have hArc_Ω : ∀ u v : ℝ, u < v → ((u : ℂ), ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_phi →
      ((X.c * (v - u) ^ 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * chordPhi X (u : ℂ) ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        (draftRealArcMinusChord X u v : ℂ) := by
    intro u v huv ⟨hu_st, hv_ball⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv)] at hv_ball
    obtain ⟨_, hb_u⟩ := hSub_bounds (u : ℂ) hu_st
    have hu_in_ball : (u : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (u : ℂ) (X.s_star / 5) :=
      Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith [hX.s_star_pos])
    apply part2_wronskian hVolt X hX u v huv
    · intro w ⟨hw0, hw1⟩
      have hzw_in : (u : ℂ) + (w : ℂ) * ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
          Metric.ball (u : ℂ) (X.s_star / 5) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul,
          Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg hw0, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv)]
        calc w * (v - u) ≤ 1 * r_t_base :=
              mul_le_mul hw1 hv_ball.le (sub_pos.mpr huv).le zero_le_one
          _ < X.s_star / 5 := by linarith [hX.s_star_pos]
      dsimp [stripPotential]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv)]
      calc (v - u) ^ 2 * ‖X.q ((u : ℂ) + (w : ℂ) * ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ))‖
          ≤ r_t_base ^ 2 * ‖X.q ((u : ℂ) + (w : ℂ) * ((v - u : ℝ) : ℂ))‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_pos.mpr huv).le hv_ball.le 2)
              (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 / 64 := (hb_u _ hzw_in).2.2.1
    · rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv)]
      calc (v - u) * ‖X.f (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ r_t_base * ‖X.f (u : ℂ)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv_ball.le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 / 256 := (hb_u _ hu_in_ball).2.2.2.1
    · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr huv)]
      calc (v - u) ^ 2 * ‖deriv X.f (u : ℂ)‖ ≤ r_t_base ^ 2 * ‖deriv X.f (u : ℂ)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_pos.mpr huv).le hv_ball.le 2)
              (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 / 256 := (hb_u _ hu_in_ball).2.2.2.2
  have hF_real_zero : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_rec → F_ext ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    intro x t ht_pos ht_lt
    have hx_im : |(x : ℂ).im| < X.s_star / 3 := by simp [hX.s_star_pos]
    have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ < r_rec := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht_pos]; exact ht_lt
    have hp_mem : ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) ∈ U_rec := ⟨hx_im, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht_norm⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hJp_mul, hJc_mul⟩ := hCollar_pt (x : ℂ) (t : ℂ) hx_im ht_norm
    obtain ⟨hgp_in, hgc_in⟩ := hg_maps ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) hp_mem
    have ht_ne : (t : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht_pos.ne'
    have hJp_eq : J_prev_tilde ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) =
        (X.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) - X.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) - (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) / (t : ℂ) :=
      eq_div_of_mul_eq ht_ne (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hJp_mul)
    have hJc_eq : J_curr_tilde ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) =
        (X.𝔰 ((x : ℂ) + (t : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) - X.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))) / (t : ℂ) :=
      eq_div_of_mul_eq ht_ne (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hJc_mul)
    have h_var := part4_real_variation X hX Ω_phi hΩ_open hPhi_holo hArc_Ω
      x t ht_pos (lt_trans ht_lt hr_rec_lt)
      (by dsimp [g_prev] at hgp_in; rwa [hJp_mul] at hgp_in)
      (by dsimp [g_curr] at hgc_in; rwa [hJc_mul] at hgc_in)
    dsimp only at h_var
    dsimp [F_ext, g_prev, g_curr]
    rw [hJp_eq, hJc_eq]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h_var
  have h_strip_conv : Convex ℝ (horizStrip (X.s_star / 3)) := by
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |(a • z₁ + b • z₂).im| < X.s_star / 3
    change |z₁.im| < X.s_star / 3 at hz₁
    change |z₂.im| < X.s_star / 3 at hz₂
    have him : (a • z₁ + b • z₂).im = a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im := by simp
    rw [him]
    calc |a * z₁.im + b * z₂.im| ≤ |a * z₁.im| + |b * z₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = a * |z₁.im| + b * |z₂.im| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ < a * (X.s_star / 3) + b * (X.s_star / 3) := by
          rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
          · simp only [zero_add] at hab; subst hab; linarith
          · nlinarith
      _ = (a + b) * (X.s_star / 3) := by ring
      _ = X.s_star / 3 := by rw [hab, one_mul]
  have hF_step1 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (X.s_star / 3), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_rec →
      F_ext (y, (t : ℂ)) = 0 := by
    intro y hy t ht0 ht1
    have ht_ball : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_rec := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact ht1
    have h1d_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => F_ext (z, (t : ℂ)))
        (horizStrip (X.s_star / 3)) :=
      hF_ext_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (t : ℂ))).differentiableOn
        (fun z hz => ⟨hz, ht_ball⟩)
    have h1d_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => F_ext (z, (t : ℂ))) (horizStrip (X.s_star / 3)) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (h_open_strip (X.s_star / 3))).mpr h1d_holo
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip (X.s_star / 3) := by
      simp [horizStrip, hX.s_star_pos]
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, F_ext (z, (t : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
      intro V hV
      rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff] at hV
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := hV
      let x_w : ℝ := ε / 2
      have hx_pos : 0 < x_w := by positivity
      refine ⟨(x_w : ℂ), hε_sub ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hF_real_zero x_w t ht0 ht1⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hx_pos]
        dsimp [x_w]; linarith
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hx_pos.ne'
    exact h1d_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      h_strip_conv.isPreconnected h0_mem h_freq hy
  have hF_all_zero : ∀ p ∈ U_rec, F_ext p = 0 := by
    intro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    have h2d_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun τ => F_ext (p.1, τ)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_rec) :=
      hF_ext_holo.comp ((differentiable_const p.1).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun τ hτ => ⟨hp1, hτ⟩)
    have h2d_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun τ => F_ext (p.1, τ)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_rec) :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn Metric.isOpen_ball).mpr h2d_holo
    have h0_ball : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_rec := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_rec_pos
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ τ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, F_ext (p.1, τ) = 0 := by
      rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
      intro V hV
      rw [Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff] at hV
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := hV
      let t_w : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (r_rec / 2)
      have ht_pos : 0 < t_w := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
      have ht_lt_r : t_w < r_rec :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
      have ht_lt_ε : t_w < ε :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨(t_w : ℂ), hε_sub ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hF_step1 p.1 hp1 t_w ht_pos ht_lt_r⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos ht_pos]
        exact ht_lt_ε
      · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ht_pos.ne'
    exact h2d_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) r_rec).isPreconnected h0_ball h_freq hp2
  refine ⟨r_rec, hr_rec_pos, hr_rec_lt, ?_⟩
  intro y t hy ht_pos ht_lt
  have ht_ne : t ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp ht_pos
  have hp_mem : (y, t) ∈ U_rec := ⟨hy, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using ht_lt⟩
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hJp_mul, hJc_mul⟩ := hCollar_pt y t hy ht_lt
  obtain ⟨hgp_in, hgc_in⟩ := hg_maps (y, t) hp_mem
  set s_prev : ℂ := X.𝔰 (y - t, t)
  set s_curr : ℂ := X.𝔰 (y, t)
  set s_next : ℂ := X.𝔰 (y + t, t)
  set J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
  set J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
  have hJp_eq : J_prev_tilde (y, t) = J_prev :=
    eq_div_of_mul_eq ht_ne (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hJp_mul)
  have hJc_eq : J_curr_tilde (y, t) = J_curr :=
    eq_div_of_mul_eq ht_ne (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hJc_mul)
  have hgp_mem : (s_prev, t * J_prev) ∈ Ω_phi := by
    dsimp [g_prev] at hgp_in; rwa [hJp_eq] at hgp_in
  have hgc_mem : (s_curr, t * J_curr) ∈ Ω_phi := by
    dsimp [g_curr] at hgc_in; rwa [hJc_eq] at hgc_in
  obtain ⟨hds_curr, hdJ_curr⟩ := h_part_formulas s_curr J_curr t hgc_mem
  obtain ⟨_, hdJ_prev⟩ := h_part_formulas s_prev J_prev t hgp_mem
  have hF0 := hF_all_zero (y, t) hp_mem
  dsimp [F_ext, g_prev, g_curr] at hF0
  rw [hJp_eq, hJc_eq] at hF0
  change deriv (fun J' => chordActionP X s_curr J' t) J_curr -
    t * deriv (fun s' => chordActionP X s' J_curr t) s_curr =
    deriv (fun J' => chordActionP X s_prev J' t) J_prev
  rw [hdJ_curr, hds_curr, hdJ_prev]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hF0

informal_problem.statement:
(hVolt : VolterraDivisionProp) (X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ)
    (hReg : IsRegularFrozenState kind (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀) :
    ∃ (δ_reg : ℝ) (N_reg : ℕ), 0 < δ_reg ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
            chordActionP X
              ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
              q.2.1
              (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) =>
          chordActionP X
            ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
            q.2.1
            (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
          frozenActionP kind (q.2.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2.1)
        Filter.atTop
        { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }

by
  
  
  
  have hDeep1 : ∀ Λ : ℂ, deepPurePhiSqFirst (Λ ^ 2) = frozenPhiFirst Λ := by
    intro Λ
    unfold deepPurePhiSqFirst frozenPhiFirst
    split_ifs with hΛ
    · rw [hΛ, zero_pow two_ne_zero]
      have htsum : (∑' m : ℕ, (-(0 : ℂ) / 4) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) = 1 / 6 := by
        rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
        · simp [Nat.factorial]
        · intro m hm; simp [zero_pow hm]
      rw [htsum]; norm_num
    · let z : ℂ := Λ / 2
      have hz : z ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hΛ two_ne_zero
      have hsin := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr (Complex.hasSum_sin z)
      have h0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1,
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ i * z ^ (2 * i + 1) / ((2 * i + 1).factorial : ℂ)) = z := by
        simp
      rw [h0] at hsin
      have hmul := hsin.mul_left (-(1 / (z ^ 3)))
      have h_eq : (fun m : ℕ => -(1 / z ^ 3) *
          ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (m + 1) * z ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) / ((2 * (m + 1) + 1).factorial : ℂ))) =
          (fun m : ℕ => (-(Λ ^ 2) / 4) ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) := by
        ext m
        have hm1 : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 3 + 2 * m := by omega
        have hm2 : 2 * m + 3 = 3 + 2 * m := by omega
        rw [hm1, hm2, pow_add (-1 : ℂ) m 1, pow_add z 3 (2 * m), pow_mul z 2 m]
        have hz2 : z ^ 2 = Λ ^ 2 / 4 := by dsimp [z]; ring
        have hneg : (-(Λ ^ 2) / 4) ^ m = (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (Λ ^ 2 / 4) ^ m := by
          have : -(Λ ^ 2) / 4 = (-1 : ℂ) * (Λ ^ 2 / 4) := by ring
          rw [this, mul_pow]
        rw [hz2, hneg]
        have hz3 : z ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hz
        have hf : ((3 + 2 * m).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
          Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
        field_simp [hz3, hf]
      rw [h_eq] at hmul
      rw [hmul.tsum_eq]
      dsimp [z]
      field_simp [hΛ]
      ring

  let frozenPhi : ExpProfileKind → ℂ → ℂ := fun k Λ =>
    match k with
    | .firstField => frozenPhiFirst Λ
    | .secondField =>
        (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * Λ ^ (2 * m) /
          (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))) /
          Complex.cosh (Λ / 2)

  have h_factor : ∀ (k : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ),
      frozenActionP k lam J = J ^ 3 * frozenPhi k (lam * J) := by
    intro k lam J
    cases k with
    | firstField =>
      dsimp [frozenActionP, frozenPhi]
      rw [← hDeep1 (lam * J)]
      dsimp [deepPurePhiSqFirst]
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 1
      ext m
      have hJ : J ^ (2 * m + 3) = J ^ 3 * (J ^ 2) ^ m := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_mul, mul_comm]
      have hlam : lam ^ (2 * m) = (lam ^ 2) ^ m := pow_mul lam 2 m
      have h2 : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) = 4 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
        rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
        norm_num
        ring
      have hneg : (-((lam * J) ^ 2) / 4) ^ m =
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (lam ^ 2) ^ m * (J ^ 2) ^ m / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
        have : -((lam * J) ^ 2) / 4 = ((-1 : ℂ) * lam ^ 2 * J ^ 2) / 4 := by ring
        rw [this, div_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow]
      rw [hJ, hlam, h2, hneg]
      ring
    | secondField =>
      dsimp [frozenActionP, frozenPhi]
      rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← tsum_mul_left]
      congr 2
      ext m
      have hJ : J ^ (2 * m + 3) = J ^ 3 * J ^ (2 * m) := by
        rw [pow_add, mul_comm]
      have hmul : (lam * J) ^ (2 * m) = lam ^ (2 * m) * J ^ (2 * m) := mul_pow lam J (2 * m)
      rw [hJ, hmul]
      ring

  have h_phi_zero : ∀ k : ExpProfileKind, frozenPhi k 0 = (1 / 24 : ℂ) := by
    intro k

      have hsum : (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m) /

  have h_phi_first : ∀ Λ : ℂ, Λ ≠ 0 →

  have h_phi_second : ∀ Λ : ℂ, Λ ≠ 0 → Complex.cosh (Λ / 2) ≠ 0 →
      frozenPhi .secondField Λ =
        1 / (2 * Λ ^ 2) - Complex.sinh (Λ / 2) / (Λ ^ 3 * Complex.cosh (Λ / 2)) := by
    intro Λ hΛ hcosh
    let z : ℂ := Λ / 2
    have hs1 := (Complex.hasSum_cosh z).mul_left z
    have hs2 := Complex.hasSum_sinh z
    have hs_diff := hs1.sub hs2
    have h_term : (fun n : ℕ => z * (z ^ (2 * n) / ((2 * n).factorial : ℂ)) -
        z ^ (2 * n + 1) / ((2 * n + 1).factorial : ℂ)) =
        (fun n : ℕ => ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * n + 1) / ((2 * n + 1).factorial : ℂ)) := by
      ext n
      have hfac : ((2 * n + 1).factorial : ℂ) =
          ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((2 * n).factorial : ℂ) := by
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast
        rfl
      have hne1 : ((2 * n).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      have hne2 : ((2 * n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
      rw [hfac]
      field_simp [hne1, hne2]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_term] at hs_diff
    have hs_shift : HasSum
        (fun m : ℕ => ((2 * (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) /
          ((2 * (m + 1) + 1).factorial : ℂ))
        (z * Complex.cosh z - Complex.sinh z) := by
      have h0 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1,
          ((2 * i : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * i + 1) / ((2 * i + 1).factorial : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        simp
      have hs' := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hs_diff
      rwa [h0, sub_zero] at hs'
    have hs_scaled := hs_shift.mul_left ((Λ ^ 3)⁻¹)
    have h_scaled_eq : (fun m : ℕ => (Λ ^ 3)⁻¹ *
        (((2 * (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * z ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) /
          ((2 * (m + 1) + 1).factorial : ℂ))) =
        (fun m : ℕ => ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * Λ ^ (2 * m) /
          (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))) := by
      ext m
      have hm1 : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
      have hm2 : 2 * m + 2 + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
      rw [hm1, hm2]
      have hzpow : z ^ (2 * m + 3) = Λ ^ 3 * Λ ^ (2 * m) / (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m) := by
        dsimp [z]
        have hexp : 2 * m + 3 = 3 + 2 * m := by omega
        have hsq : (Λ / 2) ^ 2 = Λ ^ 2 / 4 := by ring
        rw [hexp, pow_add, pow_mul, hsq, div_pow, div_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring
      rw [hzpow]
      have h4ne : (4 : ℂ) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero m (by norm_num)
      have hfne : ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
      field_simp [hΛ, h4ne, hfne]
    rw [h_scaled_eq] at hs_scaled
    dsimp [frozenPhi]
    rw [hs_scaled.tsum_eq]
    dsimp only [z]
    set c_val : ℂ := Complex.cosh (Λ / 2)
    set s_val : ℂ := Complex.sinh (Λ / 2)
    have hc_ne : c_val ≠ 0 := hcosh
    field_simp [hΛ, hc_ne]

  have h_reg_first : ∀ lam J : ℂ, IsRegularFrozenState .firstField lam J →

    intro lam J ⟨hJ, hdd⟩

      have h_rhs : HasDerivAt

    have hd1_eq : deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam) =

    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam))
        (Complex.sin (lam * J / 2) / (2 * lam)) J := by

      have h_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => Complex.cos (lam * x / 2))
          (-Complex.sin (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)) J := by
        convert HasDerivAt.comp J (Complex.hasDerivAt_cos (lam * J / 2)) (h_lin_fn J) using 1; rfl
      convert (hasDerivAt_const J (1 / lam ^ 2)).sub (h_cos.div_const (lam ^ 2)) using 1
      field_simp [hlam]; ring
    rw [hd2.deriv] at hdd
    intro hsin0
    rw [hsin0, zero_div] at hdd
    exact hdd rfl

  have h_reg_second : ∀ lam J : ℂ, IsRegularFrozenState .secondField lam J →

    intro lam J ⟨hJ, hcosh, hdd⟩
    refine ⟨hJ, hcosh, fun hlam => ?_⟩

        dsimp [g]

    have h_lin_fn : ∀ w : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => lam * x / 2) (lam / 2) w := by
      intro w
      convert ((hasDerivAt_id w).const_mul lam).div_const 2 using 1
      · rfl
      · ring
    have hd1 : ∀ w ∈ V,
        deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam) w =
          1 / (2 * lam ^ 2) - 1 / (2 * lam ^ 2 * Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2) := by
      intro w hw
      have h_sh : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => Complex.sinh (lam * x / 2))
          (Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) * (lam / 2)) w := by

      have h_ch : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => Complex.cosh (lam * x / 2))
          (Complex.sinh (lam * w / 2) * (lam / 2)) w := by
        convert HasDerivAt.comp w (Complex.hasDerivAt_cosh (lam * w / 2)) (h_lin_fn w) using 1; rfl
      have hc_ne : Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ≠ 0 := hw
      have hden_ne : lam ^ 3 * Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ≠ 0 :=

      have h_quot := h_sh.div (h_ch.const_mul (lam ^ 3)) hden_ne
      have h_g : HasDerivAt g
          (1 / (2 * lam ^ 2) - 1 / (2 * lam ^ 2 * Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2)) w := by
        convert ((hasDerivAt_id w).div_const (2 * lam ^ 2)).sub h_quot using 1
        · rfl
        · have hid := Complex.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq (lam * w / 2)
          have hsh2 : Complex.sinh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2 =
              Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by
            calc Complex.sinh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2
                = Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2 -
                    (Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2 - Complex.sinh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2) := by ring
              _ = Complex.cosh (lam * w / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by rw [hid]
          field_simp [hlam, hc_ne]
          rw [hsh2]

      have hev : frozenActionP .secondField lam =ᶠ[nhds w] g :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨V, hV_open.mem_nhds hw, hact_eq⟩

    have hd2 : HasDerivAt (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam))

        convert HasDerivAt.comp J (Complex.hasDerivAt_cosh (lam * J / 2)) (h_lin_fn J) using 1; rfl
      have h_den : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => 2 * lam ^ 2 * Complex.cosh (lam * x / 2) ^ 2)
          (2 * lam ^ 2 * (2 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 1 *
            (Complex.sinh (lam * J / 2) * (lam / 2)))) J :=
        (h_ch.pow 2).const_mul (2 * lam ^ 2)
      have hc_ne : Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 := hcosh
      have hden_ne : 2 * lam ^ 2 * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hlam)) (pow_ne_zero 2 hc_ne)
      have h_g' : HasDerivAt g'
          (Complex.sinh (lam * J / 2) / (2 * lam * Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ^ 3)) J := by
        convert (hasDerivAt_const J (1 / (2 * lam ^ 2))).sub
          ((hasDerivAt_const J (1 : ℂ)).div h_den hden_ne) using 1
        field_simp [hlam, hc_ne]; ring
      have hev : deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam) =ᶠ[nhds J] g' :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨V, hV_open.mem_nhds hJ_mem, hd1⟩
      exact h_g'.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    rw [hd2.deriv] at hdd
    intro hsinh0
    rw [hsinh0, zero_div] at hdd
    exact hdd rfl

  have h_kern_zero : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      c0Kernel (fun _ => 0) w = 1 ∧ c0Deriv (fun _ => 0) w = 0 ∧
      k0Kernel (fun _ => 0) w = (w : ℂ) ∧ k0Deriv (fun _ => 0) w = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hIVP, _⟩ :=
      hVolt.1 (fun _ => 0) continuousOn_const
    have hc := hIVP (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 0) continuousOn_const continuousOn_const
      (fun w _ => ⟨hasDerivWithinAt_const w _ 1, by simpa using hasDerivWithinAt_const w _ (0 : ℂ)⟩)

  have h_kern_const_sq : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (ν : ℂ), ν ≠ 0 →

    have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩

  have h_kern_neg_quarter_sq : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (μ : ℂ), μ ≠ 0 →

  have h_pert_cont_of : ∀ (sgn a₀ a₁ : ℂ) (Q : ℝ → ℂ),
