        rw [h_rew]
        have t1 := norm_add_le
          (a₀_seq n p * (c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 - c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1) +
            (a₀_seq n p - a₀_lim p) * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1)
          (a₁_seq n p * k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1)
        have t2 := norm_add_le
          (a₀_seq n p * (c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 - c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1))
          ((a₀_seq n p - a₀_lim p) * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1)
        have m1 : ‖a₀_seq n p * (c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 - c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1)‖ ≤
            (r_b / 8 + 1) * (Real.exp M_Q * η_in) := by
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul ha0_seq_le h_lip.2.2.2.2.1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        have m2 : ‖(a₀_seq n p - a₀_lim p) * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1‖ ≤
            η_in * Real.exp M_Q := by
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul ha0_d.le hc0_le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        have m3 : ‖a₁_seq n p * k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1‖ ≤ η_in * Real.exp M_Q := by
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul ha1_d.le h_lip.2.1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        dsimp [C_B]
        nlinarith [Real.exp_pos M_Q, hr_b, hη_in_pos]
      have hCB_lt : C_B * η_in < η := by
        have := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * C_B)).mp hη_le_CB
        linarith
      have hη_in_lt_η : η_in < η := by
        have hCB_ge1 : 1 ≤ C_B := by dsimp [C_B]; linarith [ show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r_b / 8 + 3) * Real.exp M_Q by positivity ]
        have : η_in ≤ C_B * η_in := by
          simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCB_ge1 hη_in_pos.le
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt this hCB_lt
      exact ⟨fun w hw => lt_trans (hQ_d w hw) hη_in_lt_η,
        lt_trans ha0_d hη_in_lt_η, lt_of_le_of_lt hb1_diff hCB_lt⟩

    let η_safe : ℝ := min (δ_Q / 2) (r_b / 8)
    have hη_safe_pos : 0 < η_safe := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁_ge, hN₁⟩ := h_unif_B η_safe hη_safe_pos

    have h_B_safe : ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ U_δ,
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q_seq n p w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) ∧
        ‖a₀_seq n p‖ < r_b / 4 ∧
        ‖a₀_seq n p * c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 + a₁_seq n p * k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1‖ < r_b / 4 ∧
        k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro n hn p hp
      obtain ⟨hq_d0, ha0_lim_lt, hb1_lim_lt, _⟩ := h_lim_Uδ p hp
      obtain ⟨hQ_d, ha0_d, hb1_d⟩ := hN₁ n hn p hp
      have hη1 : η_safe ≤ δ_Q / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      have hη2 : η_safe ≤ r_b / 8 := min_le_right _ _
      have hQ_Q0 : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q_seq n p w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q := by
        intro w hw
        dsimp [Q₀]
        calc ‖Q_seq n p w - q_lim p₀‖
            = ‖(Q_seq n p w - q_lim p) + (q_lim p - q_lim p₀)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖Q_seq n p w - q_lim p‖ + ‖q_lim p - q_lim p₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < δ_Q := by linarith [hQ_d w hw]
      have hb0_lt : ‖a₀_seq n p‖ < r_b / 4 := by
        calc ‖a₀_seq n p‖ = ‖a₀_lim p + (a₀_seq n p - a₀_lim p)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖a₀_lim p‖ + ‖a₀_seq n p - a₀_lim p‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < r_b / 4 := by linarith
      set b₁_n := a₀_seq n p * c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 + a₁_seq n p * k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1
      have hb1_lt : ‖b₁_n‖ < r_b / 4 := by
        calc ‖b₁_n‖
            = ‖a₀_lim p * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1 +
                (b₁_n - a₀_lim p * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖a₀_lim p * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1‖ +
                ‖b₁_n - a₀_lim p * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < r_b / 4 := by linarith
      have hk0_n : k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 ≠ 0 := by
        have hp1 : p ∈ U₁ := hU_sub hp
        have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
        have hQ_cont_p : ContinuousOn (Q_seq n p) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          hQ_slice_cont n hn0 p hp1
        exact (hRep (Q_seq n p) hQ_cont_p hQ_Q0).1
      exact ⟨hQ_Q0, hb0_lt, hb1_lt, hk0_n⟩

    
    let ζ_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => (r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hζ_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖ζ_c θ‖ = r_b := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [ζ_c]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr_b.le,
        Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    let cauchyF : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁ =>
      slNumerator Q (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁) / ((ζ_c θ₀ - b₀) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁))

    have h_cauchy_int : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ),
        ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
        ‖b₀‖ ≤ r_b / 4 → ‖b₁‖ ≤ r_b / 4 →
        Measurable (Function.uncurry (cauchyF Q b₀ b₁)) ∧
        (∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, ‖cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ 4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ θ₀ : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
        IntervalIntegrable
          (fun θ₀ : ℝ => ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro Q b₀ b₁ hQ_c hQ_d hb0 hb1
      obtain ⟨_, hNum_bound, _⟩ := hRep Q hQ_c hQ_d
      obtain ⟨_, _, hkp_univ, hkm_univ⟩ :=
        hVolt.2.1.2 (Set.univ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (fun _ => Q) Prod.fst
          (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => (w.2 - w.1 * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1)
          isOpen_univ
          (ContinuousOn.comp hQ_c continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hq => hq.2))
          (fun _ _ => differentiableOn_const _)
          differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
          (by fun_prop)
      have hkp_meas : Measurable
          (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => kPlusVal Q w.1 ((w.2 - w.1 * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1)) :=
        (continuousOn_univ.mp hkp_univ.continuousOn).measurable
      have hkm_meas : Measurable
          (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => kMinusVal Q w.1 ((w.2 - w.1 * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1)) :=
        (continuousOn_univ.mp hkm_univ.continuousOn).measurable
      have hroot_meas : Measurable
          (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => canonRoot Q w.1 ((w.2 - w.1 * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1)) := by
        dsimp [canonRoot]
        refine ((hkp_meas.add hkm_meas).div_const 2).mul ?_
        refine Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp (measurable_const.mul ?_)
        refine Complex.measurable_log.comp ?_
        exact ((measurable_const.mul hkp_meas).mul hkm_meas).div
          ((hkp_meas.add hkm_meas).pow_const 2)
      have hζ_cont : Continuous ζ_c := by dsimp [ζ_c]; fun_prop
      have hF_meas_aux : ∀ (root_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), Measurable root_fn →
          Measurable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
            (k0Kernel Q 1 - root_fn (ζ_c q.1, ζ_c q.2)) /
              ((ζ_c q.1 - b₀) * (ζ_c q.2 - b₁))) := by
        intro root_fn hm
        fun_prop
      have hF_meas : Measurable (Function.uncurry (cauchyF Q b₀ b₁)) :=
        hF_meas_aux _ hroot_meas
      have hF_bound : ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ, ‖cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ 4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2 := by
        intro θ₀ θ₁
        dsimp [cauchyF]
        rw [norm_div, norm_mul]
        have hN_le : ‖slNumerator Q (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁)‖ ≤ M_num :=
          (hNum_bound (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁) (hζ_norm θ₀).le (hζ_norm θ₁).le).1
        have hd0 : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀) b₀
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀) + b₀ = ζ_c θ₀ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₀] at this
          linarith
        have hd1 : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁) b₁
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁) + b₁ = ζ_c θ₁ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₁] at this
          linarith
        have hden_ge : r_b ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀‖ * ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁‖ := by
          calc r_b ^ 2 / 4 = (r_b / 2) * (r_b / 2) := by ring
            _ ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀‖ * ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁‖ :=
              mul_le_mul hd0 hd1 (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
        calc ‖slNumerator Q (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁)‖ / (‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀‖ * ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁‖)
            ≤ M_num / (r_b ^ 2 / 4) :=
              div_le_div₀ hM_num.le hN_le (by positivity) hden_ge
          _ = 4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2 := by ring
      let B_F : ℝ := 4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2
      have hB_F_pos : 0 < B_F := by positivity
      have h_slice_meas : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ), Measurable (Function.uncurry G) →
          ∀ θ₀ : ℝ, Measurable (G θ₀) :=
        fun G hG θ₀ => hG.comp (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun θ₁ : ℝ => (θ₀, θ₁)))
      have h_int_sm : ∀ (G : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ), Measurable (Function.uncurry G) →
          MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
            (fun θ₀ : ℝ => ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G θ₀ θ₁) := by
        intro G hG
        have h_le : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
        simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h_le]
        exact hG.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_inner_int : ∀ θ₀ : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro θ₀
        have hm1 : Measurable (cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀) := h_slice_meas _ hF_meas θ₀
        exact (intervalIntegrable_const (c := B_F)).mono_fun hm1.aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ₁ => by
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hB_F_pos.le]
            exact hF_bound θ₀ θ₁)
      have h_outer_sm : MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
          (fun θ₀ : ℝ => ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁) :=
        h_int_sm _ hF_meas
      have h_outer_int : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun θ₀ : ℝ => ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := B_F * (2 * Real.pi))).mono_fun
          h_outer_sm.aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ₀ => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        have hb : ∀ θ₁ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
            ‖cauchyF Q b₀ b₁ θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ B_F := fun θ₁ _ => hF_bound θ₀ θ₁
        have hint_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
        rwa [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos] at hint_le
      exact ⟨hF_meas, hF_bound, h_inner_int, h_outer_int⟩

    refine ⟨δ, N₁, hδ_pos, hδ_le1, hN₁_ge,
      fun p hp => (h_lim_Uδ p hp).2.2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n hn
      have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
      obtain ⟨_, hQ_c, _, hQ_h, ha0_h, ha1_h⟩ := h3_holo n hn0
      refine ⟨fun p hp => (h_B_safe n hn p hp).2.2.2, ?_⟩
      refine hHoloDiv U_δ (Q_seq n) (a₀_seq n) (a₁_seq n) (hU_δ_open δ)
        (hQ_c.mono (Set.prod_mono_left hU_sub))
        (fun w hw => (hQ_h w hw).mono hU_sub)
        (fun p hp w hw => (h_B_safe n hn p hp).1 w hw)
        (ha0_h.mono hU_sub) (ha1_h.mono hU_sub) ?_
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨_, hb0_lt, hb1_lt, _⟩ := h_B_safe n hn p hp
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

    · 
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      let C_cauchy : ℝ := 4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2 + 64 * M_num / r_b ^ 3 + 1
      have hC_cauchy_pos : 0 < C_cauchy := by positivity
      let η_c : ℝ := min η_safe (ε / (2 * C_cauchy))
      have hη_c_pos : 0 < η_c := lt_min hη_safe_pos (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨N₂, _, hN₂⟩ := h_unif_B η_c hη_c_pos
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn p hp => ?_⟩
      have hn1 : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn2 : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn1
      have hp1 : p ∈ U₁ := hU_sub hp
      obtain ⟨hq_d0, ha0_lim_lt, hb1_lim_lt, _⟩ := h_lim_Uδ p hp
      obtain ⟨hQ_Q0, hb0_n_lt, hb1_n_lt, _⟩ := h_B_safe n hn1 p hp
      obtain ⟨hQ_d, ha0_d, hb1_d⟩ := hN₂ n hn2 p hp
      have hQ_cont_p : ContinuousOn (Q_seq n p) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hQ_slice_cont n hn0 p hp1
      set b₀_n := a₀_seq n p
      set b₁_n := a₀_seq n p * c0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 + a₁_seq n p * k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1
      set b₀_l := a₀_lim p
      set b₁_l := a₀_lim p * c0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p) 1
      have h_rep_n : slDivided (Q_seq n p) (a₀_seq n p) (a₁_seq n p) =
          (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁ :=
        (hRep (Q_seq n p) hQ_cont_p hQ_Q0).2.2 (a₀_seq n p) (a₁_seq n p)
          (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hqlim_Q0 : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(fun _ : ℝ => q_lim p) w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q :=
        fun _ _ => lt_trans hq_d0 (by linarith)
      have h_rep_l : slDivided (fun _ => q_lim p) (a₀_lim p) 0 =
          (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁ := by
        have hr := (hRep (fun _ => q_lim p) continuousOn_const hqlim_Q0).2.2
          (a₀_lim p) 0 (by linarith) (by rw [zero_mul, add_zero]; linarith [hb1_lim_lt])
        simpa [b₀_l, b₁_l] using hr
      obtain ⟨_, _, h_in_n, h_out_n⟩ :=
        h_cauchy_int (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n hQ_cont_p hQ_Q0
          (by linarith) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨_, _, h_in_l, h_out_l⟩ :=
        h_cauchy_int (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l continuousOn_const hqlim_Q0
          (by linarith) (by linarith)

      have h_pt_diff : ∀ θ₀ θ₁ : ℝ,
          ‖cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁ -
            cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ C_cauchy * η_c := by
        intro θ₀ θ₁
        set N₁_v := slNumerator (Q_seq n p) (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁)
        set N₂_v := slNumerator (fun _ => q_lim p) (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁)
        set D₁_v := (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_n)
        set D₂_v := (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_l) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l)
        have hd0_n : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) b₀_n
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) + b₀_n = ζ_c θ₀ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₀] at this; linarith
        have hd1_n : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_n‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_n) b₁_n
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_n) + b₁_n = ζ_c θ₁ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₁] at this; linarith
        have hd0_l : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_l‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_l) b₀_l
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_l) + b₀_l = ζ_c θ₀ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₀] at this; linarith
        have hd1_l : r_b / 2 ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l‖ := by
          have := norm_add_le (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l) b₁_l
          have h_eq : (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l) + b₁_l = ζ_c θ₁ := by ring
          rw [h_eq, hζ_norm θ₁] at this; linarith
        have hD1_ge : r_b ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ‖D₁_v‖ := by
          dsimp [D₁_v]; rw [norm_mul]
          calc r_b ^ 2 / 4 = (r_b / 2) * (r_b / 2) := by ring
            _ ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n‖ * ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_n‖ :=
              mul_le_mul hd0_n hd1_n (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
        have hD2_ge : r_b ^ 2 / 4 ≤ ‖D₂_v‖ := by
          dsimp [D₂_v]; rw [norm_mul]
          calc r_b ^ 2 / 4 = (r_b / 2) * (r_b / 2) := by ring
            _ ≤ ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_l‖ * ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l‖ :=
              mul_le_mul hd0_l hd1_l (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
        have hD1_ne : D₁_v ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hD1_ge)
        have hD2_ne : D₂_v ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hD2_ge)
        have h_alg : cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁ -
            cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁ =
            (N₁_v - N₂_v) / D₁_v + N₂_v * (D₂_v - D₁_v) / (D₁_v * D₂_v) := by
          change N₁_v / D₁_v - N₂_v / D₂_v =
            (N₁_v - N₂_v) / D₁_v + N₂_v * (D₂_v - D₁_v) / (D₁_v * D₂_v)
          field_simp [hD1_ne, hD2_ne]; ring
        rw [h_alg]
        have hN_lip : ‖N₁_v - N₂_v‖ ≤ M_num * η_c :=
          hLipN (Q_seq n p) (fun _ => q_lim p) η_c hη_c_pos.le hQ_cont_p continuousOn_const
            (fun w hw => ⟨hQ_Q0 w hw, hqlim_Q0 w hw, (hQ_d w hw).le⟩)
            (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁) (hζ_norm θ₀).le (hζ_norm θ₁).le
        have hN2_le : ‖N₂_v‖ ≤ M_num :=
          ((hRep (fun _ => q_lim p) continuousOn_const hqlim_Q0).2.1
            (ζ_c θ₀) (ζ_c θ₁) (hζ_norm θ₀).le (hζ_norm θ₁).le).1
        have hD_sub : ‖D₂_v - D₁_v‖ ≤ 4 * r_b * η_c := by
          have h_rew : D₂_v - D₁_v =
              (b₀_n - b₀_l) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l) + (ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) * (b₁_n - b₁_l) := by
            dsimp [D₁_v, D₂_v]; ring
          rw [h_rew]
          have t1 := norm_add_le ((b₀_n - b₀_l) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l))
            ((ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) * (b₁_n - b₁_l))
          have hi1 : ‖ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l‖ ≤ 2 * r_b := by
            have := norm_sub_le (ζ_c θ₁) b₁_l
            rw [hζ_norm θ₁] at this; linarith
          have hi0 : ‖ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n‖ ≤ 2 * r_b := by
            have := norm_sub_le (ζ_c θ₀) b₀_n
            rw [hζ_norm θ₀] at this; linarith
          have m1 : ‖(b₀_n - b₀_l) * (ζ_c θ₁ - b₁_l)‖ ≤ η_c * (2 * r_b) := by
            rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ha0_d.le hi1 (norm_nonneg _) hη_c_pos.le
          have m2 : ‖(ζ_c θ₀ - b₀_n) * (b₁_n - b₁_l)‖ ≤ (2 * r_b) * η_c := by
            rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hi0 hb1_d.le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          linarith
        have h_term1 : ‖(N₁_v - N₂_v) / D₁_v‖ ≤ (4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2) * η_c := by
          rw [norm_div]
          calc ‖N₁_v - N₂_v‖ / ‖D₁_v‖
              ≤ (M_num * η_c) / (r_b ^ 2 / 4) :=
                div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hN_lip (by positivity) hD1_ge
            _ = (4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2) * η_c := by ring
        have h_term2 : ‖N₂_v * (D₂_v - D₁_v) / (D₁_v * D₂_v)‖ ≤
            (64 * M_num / r_b ^ 3) * η_c := by
          rw [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul]
          have hnum_le : ‖N₂_v‖ * ‖D₂_v - D₁_v‖ ≤ M_num * (4 * r_b * η_c) :=
            mul_le_mul hN2_le hD_sub (norm_nonneg _) hM_num.le
          have hden_ge : (r_b ^ 2 / 4) * (r_b ^ 2 / 4) ≤ ‖D₁_v‖ * ‖D₂_v‖ :=
            mul_le_mul hD1_ge hD2_ge (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _)
          calc (‖N₂_v‖ * ‖D₂_v - D₁_v‖) / (‖D₁_v‖ * ‖D₂_v‖)
              ≤ (M_num * (4 * r_b * η_c)) / ((r_b ^ 2 / 4) * (r_b ^ 2 / 4)) :=
                div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hnum_le (by positivity) hden_ge
            _ = (64 * M_num / r_b ^ 3) * η_c := by field_simp [hr_b.ne']; ring
        calc ‖(N₁_v - N₂_v) / D₁_v + N₂_v * (D₂_v - D₁_v) / (D₁_v * D₂_v)‖
            ≤ ‖(N₁_v - N₂_v) / D₁_v‖ + ‖N₂_v * (D₂_v - D₁_v) / (D₁_v * D₂_v)‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (4 * M_num / r_b ^ 2) * η_c + (64 * M_num / r_b ^ 3) * η_c :=
              add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ ≤ C_cauchy * η_c := by dsimp [C_cauchy]; nlinarith [hη_c_pos]

      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, h_rep_n, h_rep_l, ← mul_sub,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_out_n h_out_l, norm_mul]
      have h_inner_le : ∀ θ₀ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ‖(∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁) -
            (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁)‖ ≤
            (C_cauchy * η_c) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro θ₀ _
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (h_in_n θ₀) (h_in_l θ₀)]
        have hb_diff : ∀ θ₁ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
            ‖cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁ -
              cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁‖ ≤ C_cauchy * η_c :=
          fun θ₁ _ => h_pt_diff θ₀ θ₁
        have hle := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb_diff
        rwa [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos] at hle
      have h_outer_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_inner_le
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos] at h_outer_le
      have h2pi_sq_pos : 0 < (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_pref_norm : ‖(((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹‖ = ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_sq_pos.le]
      rw [h_pref_norm]
      have h_prod_le : ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2)⁻¹ *
          ‖∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ((∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cauchyF (Q_seq n p) b₀_n b₁_n θ₀ θ₁) -
             (∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
               cauchyF (fun _ => q_lim p) b₀_l b₁_l θ₀ θ₁))‖ ≤ C_cauchy * η_c := by
        calc ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2)⁻¹ * _
            ≤ ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((C_cauchy * η_c) * (2 * Real.pi) * (2 * Real.pi)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_outer_le (by positivity)
          _ = C_cauchy * η_c := by field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
      have h_lt_eps : C_cauchy * η_c < ε := by
        have : η_c ≤ ε / (2 * C_cauchy) := min_le_right _ _
        have := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * C_cauchy)).mp this
        linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_prod_le h_lt_eps

  
  
  
  
  have h_chordPhi_eq_sl : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ),
      s_pt n p ∈ X.D_strip → s_pt n p + h_pt n p ∈ X.D_strip →
      k0Kernel (Q_seq n p) 1 ≠ 0 →
      chordPhi X (s_pt n p) (h_pt n p) = slDivided (Q_seq n p) (a₀_seq n p) (a₁_seq n p) := by
    intro n p hs hsh hk0
    unfold chordPhi
    split_ifs with hh hcond
    · have hQ0 : Q_seq n p = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext w; simp [Q_seq, stripPotential, hh]
      have ha0_0 : a₀_seq n p = 0 := by simp [a₀_seq, hh]
      have ha1_0 : a₁_seq n p = 0 := by simp [a₁_seq, hh]
      rw [hQ0, ha0_0, ha1_0, hVolt.2.2.1.2.2]
    · rfl
    · exfalso; exact hcond ⟨hs, hsh, hk0⟩

  let lam₀ : ℂ := T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)
  have hΛ_p0 : Λ_fn p₀ = lam₀ * J₀ := by
    dsimp [Λ_fn, p₀, H₀, lam₀]; ring

  have h_bidisk : ∃ (δ₀ : ℝ) (N_reg : ℕ), 0 < δ₀ ∧
      let U_δ₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₀ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₀ }
      (∀ n ≥ N_reg, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => chordPhi X (s_pt n p) (h_pt n p)) U_δ₀) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n p => chordPhi X (s_pt n p) (h_pt n p))
        (fun p => frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn p))
        Filter.atTop U_δ₀ := by
    have hkind_or : kind = .firstField ∨ kind = .secondField :=
      ExpProfileKind.casesOn kind (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
    rcases hkind_or with hkind | hkind
    · 
      have hReg1 : IsRegularFrozenState .firstField lam₀ J₀ := hkind ▸ hReg
      obtain ⟨hJ0_ne, hsin_reg⟩ := h_reg_first lam₀ J₀ hReg1
      by_cases hT0 : T₀ = 0
      · 
        have hΛ0_zero : Λ_fn p₀ = 0 := by
          rw [hΛ_p0]; dsimp [lam₀]; simp [hT0]
        have hk0_0 : k0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p₀) 1 ≠ 0 := by
          have h1 : k0Kernel (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) 1 = 1 := by
            simpa using (h_kern_zero 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).2.2.1
          have hq0 : (fun _ : ℝ => q_lim p₀) = fun _ => (0 : ℂ) := by
            ext; simp [q_lim, hkind]
          rw [hq0, h1]; exact one_ne_zero
        have ha0_0 : a₀_lim p₀ = 0 := by simp [a₀_lim, hkind, hΛ0_zero]
        obtain ⟨δ₄, N₁, hδ₄_pos, hδ₄_le1, hN₁_ge, _, h4_holo, h4_unif⟩ :=
          h_regime_B hk0_0 ha0_0
        have hΛ_cont : Continuous Λ_fn := by dsimp [Λ_fn]; fun_prop
        obtain ⟨δ_pi, hδ_pi_pos, hδ_pi⟩ :=
          Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hΛ_cont.continuousAt Real.pi Real.pi_pos
        let δ₀ : ℝ := min δ₄ δ_pi
        have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hδ₄_pos hδ_pi_pos
        let U_δ₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₀ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₀ }
        have hU0_sub4 : U_δ₀ ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₄ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₄ } :=
          fun p hp => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 (min_le_left _ _),
                       lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
        have hU0_sub1 : U_δ₀ ⊆ U₁ := fun p hp =>
          ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (hU0_sub4 hp).1 hδ₄_le1,
           lt_of_lt_of_le (hU0_sub4 hp).2 hδ₄_le1⟩
        have h_lim_eq : ∀ p ∈ U_δ₀,
            slDivided (fun _ => q_lim p) (a₀_lim p) 0 = frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn p) := by
          intro p hp
          dsimp [q_lim, a₀_lim]
          rw [hkind]
          dsimp
          by_cases hΛp : Λ_fn p = 0
          · rw [hΛp, hVolt.2.2.1.2.2, h_phi_zero .firstField]
          · have hdist_pi : dist p p₀ < δ_pi := by
              rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
              exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hp.1) (min_le_right _ _),
                     lt_of_lt_of_le (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hp.2) (min_le_right _ _)⟩
            have hΛ_lt_pi : ‖Λ_fn p‖ < Real.pi := by
              have hd := hδ_pi hdist_pi
              rwa [hΛ0_zero, dist_zero_right] at hd
            have hsin_ne : Complex.sin (Λ_fn p / 2) ≠ 0 := by
              intro hsin0
              obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hsin0
              rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk_ne
              · simp at hk; exact hΛp hk
              · have hk_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by
                  have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k| := Int.one_le_abs hk_ne
                  exact_mod_cast this
                have hnorm_eq : ‖Λ_fn p / 2‖ = |(k : ℝ)| * Real.pi := by
                  rw [hk, norm_mul, Complex.norm_intCast, Complex.norm_real,
                    Real.norm_of_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le]
                have hhalf : ‖Λ_fn p / 2‖ < Real.pi / 2 := by
                  rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]; linarith
                nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
            rw [h_sl_first (Λ_fn p) hΛp hsin_ne, h_phi_first (Λ_fn p) hΛp]
        refine ⟨δ₀, N₁, hδ₀_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro n hn
          have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
          refine ((h4_holo n hn).2.mono hU0_sub4).congr ?_
          intro p hp
          obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
          exact h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p (hU0_sub4 hp))
        · have hu := h4_unif.mono hU0_sub4
          rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hu ⊢
          intro ε hε
          filter_upwards [hu ε hε, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N₁] with n hn_eps hn p hp
          have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
          obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
          rw [h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p (hU0_sub4 hp)),
            ← h_lim_eq p hp]
          exact hn_eps p hp
      · 
        have hlam0_ne : lam₀ ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hT0 seq.c₀_ne_zero) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
        have hΛ0_ne : Λ_fn p₀ ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hΛ_p0]; exact mul_ne_zero hlam0_ne hJ0_ne
        have hsin0_ne : Complex.sin (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hΛ_p0]; exact hsin_reg hlam0_ne
        obtain ⟨δ₀, N₁, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le1, hN₁_ge, hΛ_ne_on, h4_holo, h4_unif⟩ :=
          h_regime_A hkind hΛ0_ne hsin0_ne
        let U_δ₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₀ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₀ }
        have hU0_sub1 : U_δ₀ ⊆ U₁ := fun p hp =>
          ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 hδ₀_le1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 hδ₀_le1⟩
        refine ⟨δ₀, N₁, hδ₀_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro n hn
          have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
          refine (h4_holo n hn).2.congr ?_
          intro p hp
          obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
          exact h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p hp)
        · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h4_unif ⊢
          intro ε hε
          filter_upwards [h4_unif ε hε, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N₁] with n hn_eps hn p hp
          have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
          obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
          rw [h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p hp),
            hkind, h_phi_first (Λ_fn p) (hΛ_ne_on p hp)]
          exact hn_eps p hp

    · 
      have hReg2 : IsRegularFrozenState .secondField lam₀ J₀ := hkind ▸ hReg
      obtain ⟨hJ0_ne, hcosh0_ne, hsinh_reg⟩ := h_reg_second lam₀ J₀ hReg2
      have hk0_0 : k0Kernel (fun _ => q_lim p₀) 1 ≠ 0 := by
        dsimp [q_lim]; rw [hkind]; dsimp
        by_cases hΛ0 : Λ_fn p₀ = 0
        · rw [hΛ0, zero_pow two_ne_zero]
          have h1 : k0Kernel (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) 1 = 1 := by
            simpa using (h_kern_zero 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).2.2.1
          rw [h1]; exact one_ne_zero
        · have hlam0_ne : lam₀ ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0; apply hΛ0; rw [hΛ_p0, h0, zero_mul]
          have hsinh0_ne : Complex.sinh (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [hΛ_p0]; exact hsinh_reg hlam0_ne
          have hcosh0_ne' : Complex.cosh (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) ≠ 0 := by
            rwa [hΛ_p0]
          have hk_val := (h_kern_const_sq (fun _ => (Λ_fn p₀) ^ 2) (Λ_fn p₀) hΛ0
            continuousOn_const (fun _ _ => rfl)).2
          rw [hk_val]
          have hsinh_full : Complex.sinh (Λ_fn p₀) =
              2 * Complex.sinh (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) * Complex.cosh (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) := by
            have h2 : Λ_fn p₀ = 2 * (Λ_fn p₀ / 2) := by ring
            conv_lhs => rw [h2]
            exact Complex.sinh_two_mul (Λ_fn p₀ / 2)
          rw [hsinh_full]
          exact div_ne_zero
            (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hsinh0_ne) hcosh0_ne') hΛ0
      have ha0_0 : a₀_lim p₀ = 0 := by simp [a₀_lim, hkind]
      obtain ⟨δ₀, N₁, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le1, hN₁_ge, hk0_lim_ne, h4_holo, h4_unif⟩ :=
        h_regime_B hk0_0 ha0_0
      let U_δ₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₀ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₀ }
      have hU0_sub1 : U_δ₀ ⊆ U₁ := fun p hp =>
        ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hp.1 hδ₀_le1, lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2 hδ₀_le1⟩
      have h_lim_eq : ∀ p ∈ U_δ₀,
          slDivided (fun _ => q_lim p) (a₀_lim p) 0 = frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn p) := by
        intro p hp
        have hk0_p := hk0_lim_ne p hp
        dsimp [q_lim, a₀_lim] at hk0_p ⊢
        rw [hkind] at hk0_p ⊢
        dsimp at hk0_p ⊢
        by_cases hΛp : Λ_fn p = 0
        · rw [hΛp, zero_pow two_ne_zero, hVolt.2.2.1.2.2, h_phi_zero .secondField]
        · obtain ⟨hcosh_p, _, hsl_p⟩ := h_sl_second (Λ_fn p) hΛp hk0_p
          rw [hsl_p, h_phi_second (Λ_fn p) hΛp hcosh_p]
      refine ⟨δ₀, N₁, hδ₀_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro n hn
        have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
        refine (h4_holo n hn).2.congr ?_
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
        exact h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p hp)
      · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h4_unif ⊢
        intro ε hε
        filter_upwards [h4_unif ε hε, Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N₁] with n hn_eps hn p hp
        have hn0 : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge hn
        obtain ⟨hs, hsh⟩ := (h3_holo n hn0).1 p (hU0_sub1 hp)
        rw [h_chordPhi_eq_sl n p hs hsh ((h4_holo n hn).1 p hp), ← h_lim_eq p hp]
        exact hn_eps p hp

  
  obtain ⟨δ₀, N_reg, hδ₀_pos, h_bi_holo, h_bi_unif⟩ := h_bidisk
  let δ_reg : ℝ := min (min δ₀ 1) (δ₀ / (‖J₀‖ + ‖T₀‖ + 2))
  have hδ_reg_pos : 0 < δ_reg :=
    lt_min (lt_min hδ₀_pos zero_lt_one) (by positivity)
  let P_reg : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }
  let U_δ₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - S₀‖ < δ₀ ∧ ‖p.2 - H₀‖ < δ₀ }
  let π_SH : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, q.2.2 * q.2.1)

  have h_maps : Set.MapsTo π_SH P_reg U_δ₀ := by
    intro q ⟨hqS, hqJ, hqT⟩
    have hδ_le0 : δ_reg ≤ δ₀ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hδ_le1 : δ_reg ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hδ_prod : δ_reg ≤ δ₀ / (‖J₀‖ + ‖T₀‖ + 2) := min_le_right _ _
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hqS hδ_le0, ?_⟩
    dsimp [π_SH, H₀]
    have hJ_norm : ‖q.2.1‖ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + 1 := by
      calc ‖q.2.1‖ = ‖J₀ + (q.2.1 - J₀)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + 1 := by linarith
    have h_rew : q.2.2 * q.2.1 - T₀ * J₀ =
        (q.2.2 - T₀) * q.2.1 + T₀ * (q.2.1 - J₀) := by ring
    rw [h_rew]
    have t1 := norm_add_le ((q.2.2 - T₀) * q.2.1) (T₀ * (q.2.1 - J₀))
    have m1 : ‖(q.2.2 - T₀) * q.2.1‖ ≤ δ_reg * (‖J₀‖ + 1) := by
      rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hqT.le hJ_norm (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have m2 : ‖T₀ * (q.2.1 - J₀)‖ ≤ ‖T₀‖ * δ_reg := by
      rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqJ.le (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_mul_le : δ_reg * (‖J₀‖ + ‖T₀‖ + 2) ≤ δ₀ :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < ‖J₀‖ + ‖T₀‖ + 2)).mp hδ_prod
    nlinarith [hδ_reg_pos, norm_nonneg J₀, norm_nonneg T₀]

  have h_act_n : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ),
      chordActionP X
        ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
        q.2.1 (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) =
        q.2.1 ^ 3 * chordPhi X (s_pt n (π_SH q)) (h_pt n (π_SH q)) := by
    intro n q
    dsimp [chordActionP, s_pt, h_pt, s_n, π_SH]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]

  have h_act_lim : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ,
      frozenActionP kind (q.2.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2.1 =
        q.2.1 ^ 3 * frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn (π_SH q)) := by
    intro q
    rw [h_factor]
    congr 2
    dsimp [Λ_fn, π_SH]
    ring

  have h_pull_holo : ∀ (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ G U_δ₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => q.2.1 ^ 3 * G (π_SH q)) P_reg := by
    intro G hG
    exact DifferentiableOn.mul (by fun_prop)
      (hG.comp (by dsimp [π_SH]; fun_prop) h_maps)

  refine ⟨δ_reg, N_reg, hδ_reg_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    exact (h_pull_holo _ (h_bi_holo n hn)).congr (fun q _ => h_act_n n q)
  · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h_bi_unif ⊢
    intro ε hε
    let M_J3 : ℝ := (‖J₀‖ + 1) ^ 3 + 1
    have hM_J3_pos : 0 < M_J3 := by positivity
    filter_upwards [h_bi_unif (ε / M_J3) (by positivity)] with n hn q hq
    have hd := hn (π_SH q) (h_maps hq)
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hd ⊢
    rw [h_act_n n q, h_act_lim q, ← mul_sub, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    have hδ_le1 : δ_reg ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hJ_le : ‖q.2.1‖ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + 1 := by
      calc ‖q.2.1‖ = ‖J₀ + (q.2.1 - J₀)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + 1 := by linarith [hq.2.1]
    have hJ3_le : ‖q.2.1‖ ^ 3 ≤ M_J3 := by
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hJ_le 3
      dsimp [M_J3]; linarith
    calc ‖q.2.1‖ ^ 3 * ‖chordPhi X (s_pt n (π_SH q)) (h_pt n (π_SH q)) -
          frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn (π_SH q))‖
        ≤ M_J3 * ‖chordPhi X (s_pt n (π_SH q)) (h_pt n (π_SH q)) -
            frozenPhi kind (Λ_fn (π_SH q))‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hJ3_le (norm_nonneg _)
      _ < M_J3 * (ε / M_J3) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd hM_J3_pos
      _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε hM_J3_pos.ne'

proof.tactics:
by
  let B1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1
  
  have hCosh : ∀ u ∈ B1, Complex.cosh u ≠ 0 := by
    intro u hu h_zero
    have hu_lt : ‖u‖ < 1 := by simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
    have hcos : Complex.cos (u * Complex.I) = 0 := by
      rw [Complex.cos_mul_I]
      exact h_zero
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.cos_eq_zero_iff.mp hcos
    let r : ℝ := (2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / 2
    have hk_real : u * Complex.I = (r : ℂ) := by
      rw [hk]
      dsimp [r]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hnorm := congrArg norm hk_real
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
    have hpi : 3 < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_three
    have hr_gt_one : 1 < |r| := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 k with hk0 | hk0
      · have hk_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk0
        have hr_gt : 1 < r := by dsimp [r]; nlinarith
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hr_gt (le_abs_self r)
      · have hk_le : k ≤ -1 := by omega
        have hk_le' : (k : ℝ) ≤ -1 := by exact_mod_cast hk_le
        have hr_lt : r < -1 := by dsimp [r]; nlinarith
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (neg_le_abs r)
    linarith
  
  have hEntireSeries : ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ),
      (∀ m : ℕ, ‖c m‖ ≤ 1 / (m.factorial : ℝ)) →
      Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => ∑' m : ℕ, c m * z ^ m) ∧
        (∑' m : ℕ, c m * (0 : ℂ) ^ m) = c 0 := by
    intro c hc
    have h_zero : (∑' m : ℕ, c m * (0 : ℂ) ^ m) = c 0 := by
      rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
      · simp
      · intro m hm
        simp [zero_pow hm]
    refine ⟨fun z₀ => ?_, h_zero⟩
    let R : ℝ := ‖z₀‖ + 1
    have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by dsimp [R]; linarith [norm_nonneg z₀]
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hR1
    let g : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun m w => c m * w ^ m
    let g' : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun m w =>
      match m with
      | 0 => 0
      | k + 1 => c (k + 1) * (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * w ^ k)
    let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (2 * R) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)
    have hu_sum : Summable u := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial (2 * R)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, HasDerivAt (g m) (g' m y) y := by
      intro m y _
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        dsimp [g, g']
        simpa using hasDerivAt_const y (c 0 * 1)
      | succ k =>
        dsimp [g, g']
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow (k + 1) y).const_mul (c (k + 1))
    have hg'_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖g' m y‖ ≤ u m := by
      intro m y hy
      have hy_le : ‖y‖ ≤ R := le_of_lt (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hy)
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        simp [g', u]
      | succ k =>
        dsimp [g', u]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast]
        have hyk : ‖y‖ ^ k ≤ R ^ (k + 1) :=
          le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg y) hy_le k)
            (pow_le_pow_right₀ hR1 (Nat.le_succ k))
        have hk2 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
          exact_mod_cast le_of_lt (Nat.lt_two_pow_self (n := k + 1))
        have hprod : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ k ≤ (2 * R) ^ (k + 1) := by
          calc ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ k
              ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * R ^ (k + 1) :=
                mul_le_mul hk2 hyk (by positivity) (by positivity)
            _ = (2 * R) ^ (k + 1) := by rw [mul_pow]
        calc ‖c (k + 1)‖ * (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖y‖ ^ k)
            ≤ (1 / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * (2 * R) ^ (k + 1) :=
              mul_le_mul (hc (k + 1)) hprod (by positivity) (by positivity)
          _ = (2 * R) ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) := one_div_mul_eq_div _ _
    have hg0_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => g m 0) := by
      refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial 0) (fun m => ?_)
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        dsimp [g]
        simpa using hc 0
      | succ k =>
        dsimp [g]
        simp [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)]
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
      simp [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, R]
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
      simp [Metric.mem_ball, hR_pos]
    exact (hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected hu_sum Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R).isPreconnected hg_deriv hg'_bound h0_mem hg0_sum
      hz₀_mem).differentiableAt
  have hExistsPhi : ∃ tildePhi : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ tildePhi B1 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ B1, tildePhi (-u) = tildePhi u) ∧
      tildePhi 0 = 1 / 24 ∧
      (∀ lam J : ℂ, frozenActionP kind lam J = J ^ 3 * tildePhi (lam * J / 2)) := by
    cases kind with
    | firstField =>
      let cF : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m / (4 * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
      have hcF_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖cF m‖ ≤ 1 / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
        intro m
        dsimp [cF]
        rw [norm_div, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, norm_mul,
          Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_natCast]
        have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
        have hfac_le : m.factorial ≤ 4 * (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
          have h1 : m.factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3).factorial := Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
          omega
        have hfac_le_real : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hfac_le
        exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hm_pos hfac_le_real
      obtain ⟨hSF_diff, hSF_zero⟩ := hEntireSeries cF hcF_bound
      let tildePhi : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => ∑' m : ℕ, cF m * (u ^ 2) ^ m
      refine ⟨tildePhi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (hSF_diff.comp (differentiable_id.pow 2)).differentiableOn
      · intro u _
        dsimp [tildePhi]
        simp
      · dsimp [tildePhi]
        rw [sq, zero_mul, hSF_zero]
        dsimp [cF]
        norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      · intro lam J
        dsimp [tildePhi, frozenActionP, cF]
        rw [← tsum_mul_left]
        refine tsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
        have h_pow1 : ((lam * J / 2) ^ 2) ^ m = lam ^ (2 * m) * J ^ (2 * m) / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
          calc ((lam * J / 2) ^ 2) ^ m
              = ((lam ^ 2 * J ^ 2) / 4) ^ m := by congr 1; ring
            _ = (lam ^ 2 * J ^ 2) ^ m / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := div_pow _ _ _
            _ = lam ^ (2 * m) * J ^ (2 * m) / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
                rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
        have h_pow2 : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) = 4 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
          rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
          ring
        have h_powJ : J ^ (2 * m + 3) = J ^ 3 * J ^ (2 * m) := by
          rw [pow_add]
          ring
        rw [h_pow1, h_pow2, h_powJ, div_mul_div_comm, mul_div_assoc']
        congr 1
        · ring
        · ring
    | secondField =>
      let cQ : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (8 * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
      have hcQ_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖cQ m‖ ≤ 1 / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
        intro m
        dsimp [cQ]
        rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_natCast, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_natCast]
        have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m.factorial : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
        have h8_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by
          have : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℝ) :=
            Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos _)
          linarith
        rw [div_le_iff₀ h8_pos, one_div_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hm_pos]
        have h_nat : (2 * m + 2) * m.factorial ≤ 8 * (2 * m + 3).factorial := by
          have h1 : m.factorial ≤ (2 * m + 2).factorial := Nat.factorial_le (by omega)
          have h2 : (2 * m + 2) * m.factorial ≤ (2 * m + 3) * (2 * m + 2).factorial :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) h1
          have h3 : (2 * m + 3).factorial = (2 * m + 3) * (2 * m + 2).factorial :=
            Nat.factorial_succ (2 * m + 2)
          omega
        simpa [one_mul] using (show (((2 * m + 2) * m.factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((8 * (2 * m + 3).factorial : ℕ) : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast h_nat)
      obtain ⟨hSQ_diff, hSQ_zero⟩ := hEntireSeries cQ hcQ_bound
      let SQ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ∑' m : ℕ, cQ m * z ^ m
      let tildePhi : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => SQ (u ^ 2) / Complex.cosh u
      refine ⟨tildePhi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ((hSQ_diff.comp (differentiable_id.pow 2)).differentiableOn).div
          Complex.differentiable_cosh.differentiableOn hCosh
      · intro u _
        dsimp [tildePhi]
        rw [neg_sq, Complex.cosh_neg]
      · dsimp [tildePhi, SQ]
        rw [sq, zero_mul, hSQ_zero, Complex.cosh_zero]
        dsimp [cQ]
        norm_num [Nat.factorial]
      · intro lam J
        dsimp [tildePhi, SQ, frozenActionP, cQ]
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← tsum_mul_left]
        congr 1
        refine tsum_congr (fun m => ?_)
        have h_pow1 : ((lam * J / 2) ^ 2) ^ m = lam ^ (2 * m) * J ^ (2 * m) / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
          calc ((lam * J / 2) ^ 2) ^ m
              = ((lam ^ 2 * J ^ 2) / 4) ^ m := by congr 1; ring
            _ = (lam ^ 2 * J ^ 2) ^ m / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := div_pow _ _ _
            _ = lam ^ (2 * m) * J ^ (2 * m) / (4 : ℂ) ^ m := by
                rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
        have h_powJ : J ^ (2 * m + 3) = J ^ 3 * J ^ (2 * m) := by
          rw [pow_add]
          ring
        rw [h_pow1, h_powJ, div_mul_div_comm, mul_div_assoc']
        congr 1
        · ring
        · ring
  obtain ⟨tildePhi, hPhi_holo, hPhi_even, hPhi_zero, hAction⟩ := hExistsPhi
  
  let M_ker : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => 3 * tildePhi u + u * deriv tildePhi u
  let G_ker : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => 12 * (2 * tildePhi u + u * deriv tildePhi u)
  let H_ker : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => 2 * M_ker u + u * deriv M_ker u
  have hPhi'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv tildePhi) B1 :=
    hPhi_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hM_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ M_ker B1 :=
    (hPhi_holo.const_mul 3).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hPhi'_holo)
  have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_ker B1 :=
    ((hPhi_holo.const_mul 2).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hPhi'_holo)).const_mul 12
  have hM'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv M_ker) B1 :=
    hM_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hH_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_ker B1 :=
    (hM_holo.const_mul 2).add (differentiableOn_id.mul hM'_holo)
  have hM_zero : M_ker 0 = 1 / 8 := by
    dsimp [M_ker]
    rw [hPhi_zero]
    norm_num
  have hG_zero : G_ker 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [G_ker]
    rw [hPhi_zero]
    norm_num
  have hH_zero : H_ker 0 = 1 / 4 := by
    dsimp [H_ker]
    rw [hM_zero]
    norm_num
  have hG_even : ∀ u ∈ B1, G_ker (-u) = G_ker u := by
    intro u hu
    have h_neg_u : -u ∈ B1 := by simpa [B1] using hu
    have h_diff_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ tildePhi u :=
      hPhi_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu)
    have h_diff_neg_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ tildePhi (-u) :=
      hPhi_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h_neg_u)
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => tildePhi (-w)) (deriv tildePhi (-u) * (-1)) u :=
      h_diff_neg_u.hasDerivAt.comp u (hasDerivAt_id u).neg
    have h_ev : tildePhi =ᶠ[nhds u] (fun w : ℂ => tildePhi (-w)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu)
        (fun w hw => (hPhi_even w hw).symm)
    have h_deriv_eq : deriv tildePhi (-u) * (-1) = deriv tildePhi u :=
      (h_comp.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).unique h_diff_u.hasDerivAt
    have h_mul_eq : (-u) * deriv tildePhi (-u) = u * deriv tildePhi u := by
      calc (-u) * deriv tildePhi (-u)
          = u * (deriv tildePhi (-u) * (-1)) := by ring
        _ = u * deriv tildePhi u := by rw [h_deriv_eq]
    dsimp [G_ker]
    rw [hPhi_even u hu, h_mul_eq]
  have h_dJ : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 →
      deriv (frozenActionP kind lam) J = J ^ 2 * M_ker (lam * J / 2) := by
    intro lam J hu
    have hu_mem : lam * J / 2 ∈ B1 := by simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
    have h_phi_at : HasDerivAt tildePhi (deriv tildePhi (lam * J / 2)) (lam * J / 2) :=
      (hPhi_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => lam * J' / 2) (lam * 1 / 2) J :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id J).const_mul lam).div_const 2
    have h_prod : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 3 * tildePhi (lam * J' / 2))
        ((((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * J ^ (3 - 1)) * tildePhi (lam * J / 2) +
          J ^ 3 * (deriv tildePhi (lam * J / 2) * (lam * 1 / 2))) J :=
      (hasDerivAt_pow 3 J).mul (h_phi_at.comp J h_lin)
    have h_fn_eq : frozenActionP kind lam = fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 3 * tildePhi (lam * J' / 2) :=
      funext (hAction lam)
    rw [h_fn_eq, h_prod.deriv]
    dsimp [M_ker]
    ring
  have hEnergy : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 →
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = (J ^ 3 / 12) * G_ker (lam * J / 2) := by
    intro lam J hu
    unfold frozenEnergyE
    rw [h_dJ lam J hu, hAction lam J]
    dsimp [M_ker, G_ker]
    ring
  have h_dJJ : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 →
      deriv (deriv (frozenActionP kind lam)) J = J * H_ker (lam * J / 2) := by
    intro lam J hu
    have hu_mem : lam * J / 2 ∈ B1 := by simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
    let W_lam : Set ℂ := { J' : ℂ | ‖lam * J' / 2‖ < 1 }
    have hW_open : IsOpen W_lam :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).div_const 2))
        continuous_const
    have h_ev : deriv (frozenActionP kind lam) =ᶠ[nhds J]
        fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 2 * M_ker (lam * J' / 2) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW_open.mem_nhds hu) (fun J' hJ' => h_dJ lam J' hJ')
    have hM_at : HasDerivAt M_ker (deriv M_ker (lam * J / 2)) (lam * J / 2) :=
      (hM_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => lam * J' / 2) (lam * 1 / 2) J :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id J).const_mul lam).div_const 2
    have hM_comp : HasDerivAt (M_ker ∘ fun J' : ℂ => lam * J' / 2)
        (deriv M_ker (lam * J / 2) * (lam * 1 / 2)) J :=
      hM_at.comp J h_lin
    have h_prod : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => J' ^ 2 * M_ker (lam * J' / 2))
        ((((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * J ^ (2 - 1)) * M_ker (lam * J / 2) +
          J ^ 2 * (deriv M_ker (lam * J / 2) * (lam * 1 / 2))) J :=
      (hasDerivAt_pow 2 J).mul hM_comp
    rw [(h_prod.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).deriv]
    dsimp [H_ker]
    ring
  have h0_mem_B1 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B1 := by simp [B1]
  have hH_cont : ContinuousAt H_ker 0 :=
    (hH_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem_B1)).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨δ_reg, hδ_pos, hδ_ball⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hH_cont (1 / 8) (by norm_num)
  let r_reg : ℝ := min δ_reg 1
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_reg := lt_min hδ_pos zero_lt_one
  have hr_le : r_reg ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  have hReg : ∀ lam J : ℂ, J ≠ 0 → ‖lam * J / 2‖ < r_reg →
      IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J := by
    intro lam J hJ hu_reg
    have hu1 : ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hu_reg (min_le_right _ _)
    have hu_δ : dist (lam * J / 2) 0 < δ_reg := by
      simpa [dist_zero_right] using lt_of_lt_of_le hu_reg (min_le_left _ _)
    have hH_dist : ‖H_ker (lam * J / 2) - 1 / 4‖ < 1 / 8 := by
      have hd := hδ_ball hu_δ
      rwa [hH_zero, dist_eq_norm] at hd
    have hH_ne : H_ker (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hH0
      rw [hH0] at hH_dist
      norm_num at hH_dist
    have hdJJ_ne : deriv (deriv (frozenActionP kind lam)) J ≠ 0 := by
      rw [h_dJJ lam J hu1]
      exact mul_ne_zero hJ hH_ne
    have hcosh_ne : Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 :=
      hCosh (lam * J / 2) (by simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu1)
    cases kind with
    | firstField => exact ⟨hJ, hdJJ_ne⟩
    | secondField => exact ⟨hJ, hcosh_ne, hdJJ_ne⟩
  have hHolo2d : ∀ (c₀ T : ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ =>
          frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2)
        { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2 / 2‖ < 1 } := by
    intro c₀ T
    let U_2d : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { q : ℂ × ℂ | ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2 / 2‖ < 1 }
    let Φ_arg : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2 / 2
    have hΦ_num_diff : Differentiable ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1) * q.2) :=
      ((differentiable_const (T * c₀)).mul
        (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp
          ((differentiable_const (-Complex.I)).mul differentiable_fst))).mul
        differentiable_snd
    have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ_arg := by
      dsimp [Φ_arg]
      simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact hΦ_num_diff.mul (differentiable_const ((2 : ℂ)⁻¹))
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo Φ_arg U_2d B1 := by
      intro q hq
      simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Φ_arg, U_2d] using hq
    have h_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ 3 * tildePhi (Φ_arg q)) U_2d :=
      (differentiable_snd.pow 3).differentiableOn.mul
        (hPhi_holo.comp hΦ_diff.differentiableOn h_maps)
    exact h_comp.congr (fun q _ => hAction (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2)
  
  have hLegendre : ∀ (V : Set ℂ) (S_star : ℂ → ℂ) (c₀ T : ℂ),
      IsOpen V →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_star V →
      (∀ Y ∈ V, ‖T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * deriv S_star Y / 2‖ < 1) →
      (∀ Y ∈ V,
        deriv (fun Y' =>
          deriv (fun J' =>
            frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y')) J')
            (deriv S_star Y')) Y =
        deriv (fun S' =>
          frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (deriv S_star Y))
          (S_star Y)) →
      ∀ Y ∈ V,
        deriv (fun Y' =>
          frozenEnergyE kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y'))
            (deriv S_star Y')) Y = 0 := by
    intro V S_star c₀ T hV hS hBall hEL Y hY
    let J_star : ℂ → ℂ := deriv S_star
    let lam_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y')
    let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => lam_star Y' * J_star Y' / 2
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => deriv (frozenActionP kind (lam_star Y')) (J_star Y')
    let h : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => frozenActionP kind (lam_star Y') (J_star Y')
    have hJ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_star V := hS.deriv hV
    have hV_nhds : V ∈ nhds Y := hV.mem_nhds hY
    have hS_deriv : HasDerivAt S_star (J_star Y) Y :=
      (hS.differentiableAt hV_nhds).hasDerivAt
    have hJ_deriv : HasDerivAt J_star (deriv J_star Y) Y :=
      (hJ_holo.differentiableAt hV_nhds).hasDerivAt
    have hlam_deriv : HasDerivAt lam_star
        ((T * c₀) * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * (-Complex.I * J_star Y))) Y :=
      ((Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y)).comp Y
        (hS_deriv.const_mul (-Complex.I))).const_mul (T * c₀)
    let u'_val : ℂ :=
      (((T * c₀) * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * (-Complex.I * J_star Y))) *
        J_star Y + lam_star Y * deriv J_star Y) / 2
    have hu_deriv : HasDerivAt u_star u'_val Y :=
      (hlam_deriv.mul hJ_deriv).div_const 2
    have hu_Y_mem : u_star Y ∈ B1 := by
      simpa [B1, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, u_star, lam_star, J_star] using hBall Y hY
    have hPhi_at_uY : HasDerivAt tildePhi (deriv tildePhi (u_star Y)) (u_star Y) :=
      (hPhi_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_Y_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have hg_eq_on : ∀ Y' ∈ V, g Y' = (J_star Y') ^ 2 * M_ker (u_star Y') :=
      fun Y' hY' => h_dJ (lam_star Y') (J_star Y') (hBall Y' hY')
    have hg_ev : g =ᶠ[nhds Y] fun Y' : ℂ => (J_star Y') ^ 2 * M_ker (u_star Y') :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hV_nhds hg_eq_on
    have hg_rhs_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun Y' : ℂ => (J_star Y') ^ 2 * M_ker (u_star Y')) Y :=
      (hJ_deriv.differentiableAt.pow 2).mul
        ((hM_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_Y_mem)).comp Y
          hu_deriv.differentiableAt)
    have hg_deriv : HasDerivAt g (deriv g Y) Y :=
      (hg_rhs_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq hg_ev).hasDerivAt
    have hg_Y : g Y = (J_star Y) ^ 2 * M_ker (u_star Y) := hg_eq_on Y hY
    
    let ν : ℂ → ℂ := fun S' => T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S') * J_star Y / 2
    have hν_eq : ν (S_star Y) = u_star Y := rfl
    have hν_deriv : HasDerivAt ν
        (((T * c₀) * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * (-Complex.I * 1)) *
          J_star Y) / 2) (S_star Y) :=
      ((((Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y)).comp (S_star Y)
        ((hasDerivAt_id (S_star Y)).const_mul (-Complex.I))).const_mul (T * c₀)).mul_const
        (J_star Y)).div_const 2
    have hPhi_at_ν : HasDerivAt tildePhi (deriv tildePhi (u_star Y)) (ν (S_star Y)) := by
      rwa [hν_eq]
    have hRHS_fn : (fun S' : ℂ =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (J_star Y)) =
        fun S' : ℂ => (J_star Y) ^ 3 * tildePhi (ν S') :=
      funext (fun S' => hAction (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (J_star Y))
    let rhs_val : ℂ :=
      (J_star Y) ^ 3 * (deriv tildePhi (u_star Y) *
        (((T * c₀) * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y) * (-Complex.I * 1)) *
          J_star Y) / 2))
    have hRHS_eq : deriv (fun S' : ℂ =>
        frozenActionP kind (T * c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S')) (J_star Y)) (S_star Y) =
        rhs_val := by
      rw [hRHS_fn]
      exact ((hPhi_at_ν.comp (S_star Y) hν_deriv).const_mul ((J_star Y) ^ 3)).deriv
    have hdg_eq : deriv g Y = rhs_val := (hEL Y hY).trans hRHS_eq
    
    have hh_fn : h = fun Y' : ℂ => (J_star Y') ^ 3 * tildePhi (u_star Y') :=
      funext (fun Y' => hAction (lam_star Y') (J_star Y'))
    let h'_val : ℂ :=
      (((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (J_star Y) ^ (3 - 1) * deriv J_star Y) * tildePhi (u_star Y) +
        (J_star Y) ^ 3 * (deriv tildePhi (u_star Y) * u'_val)
    have hh_deriv : HasDerivAt h h'_val Y := by
      rw [hh_fn]
      exact (hJ_deriv.fun_pow 3).mul (hPhi_at_uY.comp Y hu_deriv)
    
    have hE_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ =>
        frozenEnergyE kind (lam_star Y') (J_star Y'))
        ((deriv J_star Y * g Y + J_star Y * deriv g Y) - h'_val) Y :=
      (hJ_deriv.mul hg_deriv).sub hh_deriv
    have hE_zero_val : (deriv J_star Y * g Y + J_star Y * deriv g Y) - h'_val = 0 := by
      rw [hg_Y, hdg_eq]
      dsimp [M_ker, rhs_val, h'_val, u'_val, u_star, lam_star]
      ring
    rw [hE_zero_val] at hE_deriv
    exact hE_deriv.deriv
  exact
    ⟨{ tildePhi := tildePhi
       G_ker := G_ker
       r_reg := r_reg
       r_reg_pos := hr_pos
       r_reg_le_one := hr_le
       tildePhi_holo := hPhi_holo
       G_ker_holo := hG_holo
       tildePhi_even := hPhi_even
       G_ker_even := hG_even
       tildePhi_zero := hPhi_zero
       G_ker_zero := hG_zero
       action_eq := hAction
       energy_eq := hEnergy
       regular_of_small := hReg
       frozen_action_holo_2d := hHolo2d
       legendre_deriv_zero := hLegendre }⟩

(kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (K_ker : DfmcFrozenKernelData kind) :
