signature.name: dfmc_analytic_model_and_ode_uniqueness
signature.statement:
(kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (K_ker : DfmcFrozenKernelData kind) :
    Nonempty (DfmcAnalyticModelPackage kind)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hG_diff0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ K_ker.G_ker 0 :=
    K_ker.G_ker_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 zero_lt_one)
  obtain ⟨δ_G, hδ_G_pos, hδ_G⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hG_diff0.continuousAt (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  let r₀ : ℝ := min δ_G (K_ker.r_reg / 2)
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := lt_min hδ_G_pos (half_pos K_ker.r_reg_pos)
  have hr₀_lt_reg : r₀ < K_ker.r_reg :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (half_lt_self K_ker.r_reg_pos)
  have hr₀_lt_one : r₀ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hr₀_lt_reg K_ker.r_reg_le_one
  have hG_slit : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → K_ker.G_ker u ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧ K_ker.G_ker u ≠ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_δ : dist u 0 < δ_G := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_dist : ‖K_ker.G_ker u - 1‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm, K_ker.G_ker_zero] using hδ_G hu_δ
    have h_re_abs : |(K_ker.G_ker u - 1).re| ≤ ‖K_ker.G_ker u - 1‖ :=
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    have h_re_pos : 0 < (K_ker.G_ker u).re := by
      rw [abs_le] at h_re_abs
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re] at h_re_abs
      linarith
    refine ⟨Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl h_re_pos), ?_⟩
    intro h0
    simp [h0] at h_re_pos

  let g_pos : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => Complex.exp ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u))
  let g_neg : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => Complex.exp (-(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u))
  have hg_pos_zero : g_pos 0 = 1 := by simp [g_pos, K_ker.G_ker_zero]
  have hg_neg_zero : g_neg 0 = 1 := by simp [g_neg, K_ker.G_ker_zero]
  have hg_pos_even : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → g_pos (-u) = g_pos u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu1 : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans hu hr₀_lt_one
    dsimp [g_pos]
    rw [K_ker.G_ker_even u hu1]
  have hg_neg_even : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → g_neg (-u) = g_neg u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu1 : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans hu hr₀_lt_one
    dsimp [g_neg]
    rw [K_ker.G_ker_even u hu1]
  have hg_pos_diff : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → DifferentiableAt ℂ g_pos u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu1 : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans hu hr₀_lt_one
    have hG_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ K_ker.G_ker u :=
      K_ker.G_ker_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu1)
    have hlog_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker z)) u :=
      (Complex.differentiableAt_log (hG_slit u hu).1).comp u hG_u
    exact ((differentiableAt_const _).mul hlog_u).cexp
  have hg_neg_diff : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → DifferentiableAt ℂ g_neg u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu1 : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans hu hr₀_lt_one
    have hG_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ K_ker.G_ker u :=
      K_ker.G_ker_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu1)
    have hlog_u : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker z)) u :=
      (Complex.differentiableAt_log (hG_slit u hu).1).comp u hG_u
    exact ((differentiableAt_const _).mul hlog_u).cexp
  have hg_mul_one : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → g_pos u * g_neg u = 1 := by
    intro u _
    dsimp [g_pos, g_neg]
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    have h0 : (1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u) +
        -(1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u) = 0 := by ring
    rw [h0, Complex.exp_zero]
  have hg_pos_cube : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → (g_pos u) ^ 3 = K_ker.G_ker u := by
    intro u hu
    dsimp [g_pos]
    rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    have h3 : ((3 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((1 / 3 : ℂ) * Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u)) =
        Complex.log (K_ker.G_ker u) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h3]
    exact Complex.exp_log (hG_slit u hu).2
  have hg_neg_cube : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r₀ → (g_neg u) ^ 3 * K_ker.G_ker u = 1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← hg_pos_cube u hu, ← mul_pow, mul_comm, hg_mul_one u hu, one_pow]

  obtain ⟨δ_g, hδ_g_pos, hδ_g⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hg_pos_diff 0 (by simpa using hr₀_pos)).continuousAt
      (1 / 6) (by norm_num)
  let r_g : ℝ := min r₀ δ_g
  have hr_g_pos : 0 < r_g := lt_min hr₀_pos hδ_g_pos
  have hg_pos_near : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r_g → ‖g_pos u - 1‖ < 1 / 6 := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_δ : dist u 0 < δ_g := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right _ _)
    simpa [dist_eq_norm, hg_pos_zero] using hδ_g hu_δ

  let Ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (2 * u) * g_pos u
  have hΨ_zero : Ψ 0 = 0 := by simp [Ψ]
  have hΨ_odd : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r_g → Ψ (-u) = -Ψ u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu0 : ‖u‖ < r₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _)
    dsimp [Ψ]
    rw [hg_pos_even u hu0]
    ring
  have hΨ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (Metric.ball 0 r_g) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hu
    have hu0 : ‖u‖ < r₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_left _ _)
    exact (((differentiableAt_const (2 : ℂ)).mul differentiableAt_id).mul
      (hg_pos_diff u hu0)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hΨ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ Ψ 0 :=
    hΨ_holo.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_g_pos)
  have hΨ_hasDeriv0 : HasDerivAt Ψ 2 0 := by
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => 2 * u) (2 * 1) 0 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul 2
    have h2 : HasDerivAt g_pos (deriv g_pos 0) 0 :=
      (hg_pos_diff 0 (by simpa using hr₀_pos)).hasDerivAt
    have h3 := h1.mul h2
    convert h3 using 1
    simp [hg_pos_zero]
  have hΨ_deriv_ne : deriv Ψ 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hΨ_hasDeriv0.deriv]
    norm_num
  have hΨ_strict : HasStrictDerivAt Ψ (deriv Ψ 0) 0 := hΨ_ana.hasStrictDerivAt
  let U : ℂ → ℂ := hΨ_strict.localInverse Ψ (deriv Ψ 0) 0 hΨ_deriv_ne
  have hU_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ U 0 := by
    simpa [U, hΨ_zero] using hΨ_ana.analyticAt_localInverse hΨ_deriv_ne
  obtain ⟨δ_L, hδ_L_pos, hδ_L⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hΨ_strict.eventually_left_inverse hΨ_deriv_ne)
  let r_u : ℝ := min r_g δ_L
  have hr_u_pos : 0 < r_u := lt_min hr_g_pos hδ_L_pos
  have hU_left : ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ < r_u → U (Ψ u) = u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_δ : dist u 0 < δ_L := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hu (min_le_right _ _)
    exact hδ_L hu_δ
  have hU_zero : U 0 = 0 := by
    have h := hU_left 0 (by simpa using hr_u_pos)
    simpa [hΨ_zero] using h
  have hU_ev : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ U lam ∧ Ψ (U lam) = lam ∧ U lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u := by
    have h1 := Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mp hU_ana
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ), Ψ (U lam) = lam := by
      simpa [U, hΨ_zero] using hΨ_strict.eventually_right_inverse hΨ_deriv_ne
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ lam in nhds (0 : ℂ), U lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_u :=
      hU_ana.continuousAt.eventually_mem (by rw [hU_zero]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_u_pos)
    exact h1.and (h2.and h3)
  obtain ⟨δ_lam, hδ_lam_pos, hδ_lam⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hU_ev

  let ρ_J : ℝ := 1 / 6
  have hρ_J_pos : 0 < ρ_J := by norm_num
  have hρ_J_lt : ρ_J < 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  let r_J : ℝ := min δ_lam r_u
  have hr_J_pos : 0 < r_J := lt_min hδ_lam_pos hr_u_pos
  let J_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => g_neg (U lam)

  have hU_props : ∀ lam : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_J →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ U lam ∧ Ψ (U lam) = lam ∧ ‖U lam‖ < r_u := by
    intro lam hlam
    have hd : dist lam 0 < δ_lam := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlam (min_le_left _ _)
    rcases hδ_lam hd with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at h3
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hU_odd : ∀ lam : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_J → U (-lam) = -U lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    have h_neg_lam : ‖-lam‖ < r_J := by simpa using hlam
    have hu_lt : ‖U lam‖ < r_u := (hU_props lam hlam).2.2
    have hu_g : ‖U lam‖ < r_g := lt_of_lt_of_le hu_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_neg_u : ‖-U lam‖ < r_u := by simpa using hu_lt
    have hΨ_neg : Ψ (-U lam) = -lam := by
      rw [hΨ_odd (U lam) hu_g, (hU_props lam hlam).2.1]
    have hL := hU_left (-U lam) h_neg_u
    rw [hΨ_neg] at hL
    exact hL

  have hJ_mod_zero : J_mod 0 = 1 := by simp [J_mod, hU_zero, hg_neg_zero]
  have hJ_mod_ne : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J, J_mod lam ≠ 0 := by
    intro lam _
    exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have hJ_mod_even : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J, J_mod (-lam) = J_mod lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    have hu0 : ‖U lam‖ < r₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hU_props lam hlam).2.2
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    dsimp [J_mod]
    rw [hU_odd lam hlam, hg_neg_even (U lam) hu0]
  have hJ_mod_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_mod (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J) := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    have hu0 : ‖U lam‖ < r₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (hU_props lam hlam).2.2
        (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    exact ((hg_neg_diff (U lam) hu0).comp lam (hU_props lam hlam).1).differentiableWithinAt
  have hJ_mod_energy : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J,
      frozenEnergyE kind lam (J_mod lam) = 1 / 12 := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    set u := U lam
    have hu_u : ‖u‖ < r_u := (hU_props lam hlam).2.2
    have hu0 : ‖u‖ < r₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hu_u (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hΨ_u : Ψ u = lam := (hU_props lam hlam).2.1
    have h_arg : lam * J_mod lam / 2 = u := by
      calc lam * J_mod lam / 2
          = Ψ u * g_neg u / 2 := by rw [hΨ_u]
        _ = (2 * u * g_pos u) * g_neg u / 2 := rfl
        _ = u * (g_pos u * g_neg u) := by ring
        _ = u := by rw [hg_mul_one u hu0, mul_one]
    have hu1 : ‖lam * J_mod lam / 2‖ < 1 := by
      rw [h_arg]
      exact lt_trans hu0 hr₀_lt_one
    rw [K_ker.energy_eq lam (J_mod lam) hu1, h_arg]
    have hcube : (J_mod lam) ^ 3 * K_ker.G_ker u = 1 := hg_neg_cube u hu0
    calc ((J_mod lam) ^ 3 / 12) * K_ker.G_ker u
        = ((J_mod lam) ^ 3 * K_ker.G_ker u) / 12 := by ring
      _ = 1 / 12 := by rw [hcube]

  have h_poly_reg : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_J → ‖J - 1‖ < ρ_J →
      ‖lam * J / 2‖ < 1 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J := by
    intro lam J hlam hJ
    have hJ_upper : ‖J‖ < 7 / 6 := by
      have h1' : ‖(J - 1) + 1‖ ≤ ‖J - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le (J - 1) 1
      simp only [sub_add_cancel, norm_one] at h1'
      dsimp [ρ_J] at hJ
      linarith
    have hJ_lower : 5 / 6 < ‖J‖ := by
      have h1 : ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖1 - J‖ + ‖J‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (1 - J) J
      rw [norm_one, norm_sub_rev] at h1
      dsimp [ρ_J] at hJ
      linarith
    have hJ_ne : J ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at hJ_lower
      linarith
    have hu_le_lam : ‖lam * J / 2‖ ≤ ‖lam‖ := by
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have hlam_nn : 0 ≤ ‖lam‖ := norm_nonneg lam
      nlinarith
    have hu_lt_rJ : ‖lam * J / 2‖ < r_J := lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_lam hlam
    have hu_lt_r0 : ‖lam * J / 2‖ < r₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hu_lt_rJ
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
    exact ⟨lt_trans hu_lt_r0 hr₀_lt_one,
      K_ker.regular_of_small lam J hJ_ne (lt_trans hu_lt_r0 hr₀_lt_reg)⟩

  have h_root_unique : ∀ lam J : ℂ, ‖lam‖ < r_J → ‖J - 1‖ < ρ_J →
      frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 → J = J_mod lam := by
    intro lam J hlam hJ hE
    have hJ_upper : ‖J‖ < 7 / 6 := by
      have h1 : ‖(J - 1) + 1‖ ≤ ‖J - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le (J - 1) 1
      simp only [sub_add_cancel, norm_one] at h1
      dsimp [ρ_J] at hJ
      linarith
    set u' : ℂ := lam * J / 2
    have hu'_le_lam : ‖u'‖ ≤ ‖lam‖ := by
      dsimp [u']
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have hlam_nn : 0 ≤ ‖lam‖ := norm_nonneg lam
      nlinarith
    have hu'_lt_rJ : ‖u'‖ < r_J := lt_of_le_of_lt hu'_le_lam hlam
    have hu'_lt_ru : ‖u'‖ < r_u := lt_of_lt_of_le hu'_lt_rJ (min_le_right _ _)
    have hu'_lt_rg : ‖u'‖ < r_g := lt_of_lt_of_le hu'_lt_ru (min_le_left _ _)
    have hu'_lt_r0 : ‖u'‖ < r₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hu'_lt_rg (min_le_left _ _)
    have hu'_lt_1 : ‖u'‖ < 1 := lt_trans hu'_lt_r0 hr₀_lt_one
    have hE_eq := K_ker.energy_eq lam J hu'_lt_1
    rw [hE] at hE_eq
    have h_prod_one : J ^ 3 * K_ker.G_ker u' = 1 := by
      linear_combination -12 * hE_eq
    set ζ : ℂ := J * g_pos u'
    have hζ_cube : ζ ^ 3 = 1 := by
      dsimp [ζ]
      rw [mul_pow, hg_pos_cube u' hu'_lt_r0, h_prod_one]
    have hζ_fac : (ζ - 1) * (ζ ^ 2 + ζ + 1) = 0 := by
      calc (ζ - 1) * (ζ ^ 2 + ζ + 1) = ζ ^ 3 - 1 := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [hζ_cube, sub_self]
    have hg_near : ‖g_pos u' - 1‖ < 1 / 6 := hg_pos_near u' hu'_lt_rg
    have hg_norm : ‖g_pos u'‖ < 7 / 6 := by
      have h1 : ‖(g_pos u' - 1) + 1‖ ≤ ‖g_pos u' - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ :=
        norm_add_le (g_pos u' - 1) 1
      simp only [sub_add_cancel, norm_one] at h1
      linarith
    have hζ_near : ‖ζ - 1‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      have h_split : ζ - 1 = (J - 1) * g_pos u' + (g_pos u' - 1) := by
        dsimp [ζ]
        ring
      rw [h_split]
      have h1 : ‖(J - 1) * g_pos u' + (g_pos u' - 1)‖ ≤
          ‖(J - 1) * g_pos u'‖ + ‖g_pos u' - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_mul] at h1
      dsimp [ρ_J] at hJ
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (J - 1), norm_nonneg (g_pos u')]
    have h_quad_ne : ζ ^ 2 + ζ + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq0
      have h_eq3 : (ζ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * (ζ - 1) = -3 := by
        linear_combination hq0
      have h_norm3 : ‖(ζ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * (ζ - 1)‖ = 3 := by
        rw [h_eq3]
        norm_num
      have h_tri : ‖(ζ - 1) ^ 2 + 3 * (ζ - 1)‖ ≤ ‖(ζ - 1) ^ 2‖ + ‖3 * (ζ - 1)‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_pow, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat] at h_tri
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ζ - 1)]
    have hζ_eq_one : ζ = 1 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hζ_fac with h1 | h2
      · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h1
      · exact False.elim (h_quad_ne h2)
    have hΨ_u' : Ψ u' = lam := by
      calc Ψ u' = (2 * (lam * J / 2)) * g_pos u' := rfl
        _ = lam * (J * g_pos u') := by ring
        _ = lam * ζ := rfl
        _ = lam := by rw [hζ_eq_one, mul_one]
    have hu'_eq : u' = U lam := by
      have hL := hU_left u' hu'_lt_ru
      rw [hΨ_u'] at hL
      exact hL.symm
    calc J = J * (g_pos u' * g_neg u') := by rw [hg_mul_one u' hu'_lt_r0, mul_one]
      _ = ζ * g_neg u' := by dsimp [ζ]; ring
      _ = g_neg u' := by rw [hζ_eq_one, one_mul]
      _ = J_mod lam := by dsimp [J_mod]; rw [hu'_eq]

  
  
  
  let f_inv : ℂ → ℂ := fun ξ => (J_mod ξ)⁻¹
  have hf_inv_zero : f_inv 0 = 1 := by simp [f_inv, hJ_mod_zero]
  have hf_inv_even : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J, f_inv (-ξ) = f_inv ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    dsimp [f_inv]
    rw [hJ_mod_even ξ hξ]
  have hf_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_inv (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    exact ((hJ_mod_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hξ)).inv
      (hJ_mod_ne ξ hξ)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hf_inv_deriv0 : deriv f_inv 0 = 0 := by
    have hd_pos : HasDerivAt f_inv (deriv f_inv 0) 0 :=
      (hf_inv_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_J_pos)).hasDerivAt
    have hd_pos' : HasDerivAt f_inv (deriv f_inv 0) (-(0 : ℂ)) := by
      rwa [neg_zero]
    have hd_neg : HasDerivAt (fun ξ => f_inv (-ξ)) (deriv f_inv 0 * (-1)) 0 :=
      hd_pos'.comp (0 : ℂ) (hasDerivAt_neg (0 : ℂ))
    have hev : f_inv =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun ξ => f_inv (-ξ)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_J_pos)
        (fun ξ hξ => (hf_inv_even ξ hξ).symm)
    have hd_eq : deriv f_inv 0 * (-1) = deriv f_inv 0 :=
      (hd_neg.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).unique hd_pos
    linear_combination -hd_eq / 2

  let q : ℂ → ℂ := dslope f_inv 0
  have hq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_J_pos)).mpr hf_inv_holo
  have hq_zero : q 0 = 0 := by simp [q, dslope_same, hf_inv_deriv0]
  have hq_mul : ∀ ξ : ℂ, ξ * q ξ = f_inv ξ - 1 := by
    intro ξ
    simpa [q, hf_inv_zero] using sub_smul_dslope f_inv 0 ξ
  have hq_odd : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J, q (-ξ) = -q ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    by_cases h0 : ξ = 0
    · simp [h0, hq_zero]
    · have h_neg_ne : -ξ ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr h0
      have h1 : (-ξ) * q (-ξ) = (-ξ) * (-q ξ) := by
        calc (-ξ) * q (-ξ) = f_inv (-ξ) - 1 := hq_mul (-ξ)
          _ = f_inv ξ - 1 := by rw [hf_inv_even ξ hξ]
          _ = ξ * q ξ := (hq_mul ξ).symm
          _ = (-ξ) * (-q ξ) := by ring
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ h_neg_ne h1

  let r_half : ℝ := r_J / 2
  have hr_half_pos : 0 < r_half := half_pos hr_J_pos
  have hr_half_le : r_half ≤ r_J := half_le_self hr_J_pos.le
  have hcb_sub_q : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr_J_pos)

  let q₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope q 0
  have hq₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_J_pos)).mpr hq_holo
  obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hq₂_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_q)
  let M₁ : ℝ := max B₁ 1
  have hM₁_pos : 0 < M₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hq_lin : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half, ‖q z‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have hmul : z * q₂ z = q z := by
      simpa [q₂, hq_zero] using sub_smul_dslope q 0 z
    rw [← hmul, norm_mul, mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (hB₁ z hz) (le_max_left _ _)) (norm_nonneg z)

  have hdq_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv q) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J) :=
    hq_holo.deriv isOpen_ball
  obtain ⟨B_dq, hB_dq⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hdq_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_q)
  let M_dq : ℝ := max B_dq 1
  have hM_dq_pos : 0 < M_dq := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hdq_bdd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half, ‖deriv q z‖ ≤ M_dq :=
    fun z hz => le_trans (hB_dq z hz) (le_max_left _ _)

  let I_prim : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, lam * q ((t : ℂ) * lam)
  have hI_zero : I_prim 0 = 0 := by simp [I_prim]
  have hI_even : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half, I_prim (-lam) = I_prim lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    dsimp [I_prim]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t ht => ?_)
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
    have htl_mem : (t : ℂ) * lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.1]
      have h1 : t * ‖lam‖ ≤ 1 * r_half :=
        mul_le_mul ht.2 hlam.le (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      rw [one_mul] at h1
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (half_lt_self hr_J_pos)
    have h_neg_arg : (t : ℂ) * (-lam) = -((t : ℂ) * lam) := by ring
    rw [h_neg_arg, hq_odd _ htl_mem]
    ring
  have hI_bound : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half, ‖I_prim lam‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖lam‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    have h_int_le : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖lam * q ((t : ℂ) * lam)‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖lam‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have ht_pos : 0 ≤ t := ht.1.le
      have htl_cb : (t : ℂ) * lam ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_of_nonneg ht_pos]
        nlinarith [ht.2, norm_nonneg lam]
      have hq_le := hq_lin _ htl_cb
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht_pos] at hq_le
      rw [norm_mul]
      calc ‖lam‖ * ‖q ((t : ℂ) * lam)‖
          ≤ ‖lam‖ * (M₁ * (t * ‖lam‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_le (norm_nonneg lam)
        _ = (M₁ * ‖lam‖ ^ 2) * t := by ring
        _ ≤ (M₁ * ‖lam‖ ^ 2) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.2 (by positivity)
        _ = M₁ * ‖lam‖ ^ 2 := mul_one _
    have h_norm := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_int_le
    simpa [I_prim] using h_norm

  have hI_hasDeriv : ∀ lam₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half,
      HasDerivAt I_prim (q lam₀) lam₀ := by
    intro lam₀ hlam₀
    let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun x t => x * q ((t : ℂ) * x)
    let F' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun x t =>
      q ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ))
    have h_maps_cb : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half,
        Set.MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * x) (Set.uIcc 0 1)
          (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_half) := by
      intro x hx t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hx
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.1]
      nlinarith [ht.2, norm_nonneg x]
    have hF_cont : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half,
        ContinuousOn (F x) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      intro x hx
      have h_lin_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * x) :=
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const
      have hq_comp : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => q ((t : ℂ) * x)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) :=
        (hq_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_q).comp h_lin_cont.continuousOn (h_maps_cb x hx)
      exact continuousOn_const.mul hq_comp
    have hF'_cont : ContinuousOn (F' lam₀) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      have h_lin_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * lam₀) :=
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const
      have hq_comp : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) :=
        (hq_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_q).comp h_lin_cont.continuousOn
          (h_maps_cb lam₀ hlam₀)
      have hdq_comp : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) :=
        (hdq_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_q).comp h_lin_cont.continuousOn
          (h_maps_cb lam₀ hlam₀)
      exact hq_comp.add
        (continuousOn_const.mul (hdq_comp.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn))
    have h_leibniz :=
      intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (s := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half)
        (bound := fun _ : ℝ => M₁ * r_half + r_half * M_dq)
        (F := F) (F' := F') (x₀ := lam₀) (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hlam₀)
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hlam₀) (fun x hx =>
          ((hF_cont x hx).mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc))
        (hF_cont lam₀ hlam₀).intervalIntegrable
        ((hF'_cont.mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => by
          have ht_uIcc : t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht
          have htx_cb := h_maps_cb x hx ht_uIcc
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht_uIcc
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hx
          have htx_norm : ‖(t : ℂ) * x‖ ≤ r_half := by
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using htx_cb
          have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht_uIcc.1]
            exact ht_uIcc.2
          have h1 : ‖q ((t : ℂ) * x)‖ ≤ M₁ * r_half :=
            le_trans (hq_lin _ htx_cb) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htx_norm hM₁_pos.le)
          have h2 : ‖x * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x) * (t : ℂ))‖ ≤ r_half * M_dq := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
            have hd := hdq_bdd _ htx_cb
            have hprod : ‖deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x)‖ * ‖(t : ℂ)‖ ≤ M_dq * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul hd ht_norm (norm_nonneg _) hM_dq_pos.le
            have hx_le : ‖x‖ ≤ r_half := hx.le
            nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
          exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add h1 h2)))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht x hx => by
          have ht_uIcc : t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht
          have htx_ball : (t : ℂ) * x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J :=
            hcb_sub_q (h_maps_cb x hx ht_uIcc)
          have hq_at : HasDerivAt q (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x)) ((t : ℂ) * x) :=
            (hq_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds htx_ball)).hasDerivAt
          have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℂ => (t : ℂ) * x') ((t : ℂ) * 1) x :=
            (hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (t : ℂ)
          have h_comp := hq_at.comp x h_lin
          have h_prod : HasDerivAt (fun x' => F x' t)
              (1 * q ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x) * ((t : ℂ) * 1))) x :=
            (hasDerivAt_id x).mul h_comp
          have h_eq : 1 * q ((t : ℂ) * x) + x * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * x) * ((t : ℂ) * 1)) =
              F' x t := by
            dsimp [F']
            ring
          rwa [h_eq] at h_prod))
    have h_ftc : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F' lam₀ t = q lam₀ := by
      have h_gamma_deriv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ) * q ((s : ℂ) * lam₀)) (F' lam₀ t) t := by
        intro t ht
        have htl_ball : (t : ℂ) * lam₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J :=
          hcb_sub_q (h_maps_cb lam₀ hlam₀ ht)
        have hq_at : HasDerivAt q (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀)) ((t : ℂ) * lam₀) :=
          (hq_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds htl_ball)).hasDerivAt
        have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z * lam₀) (1 * lam₀) (t : ℂ) :=
          (hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul_const lam₀
        have h_comp := hq_at.comp (t : ℂ) h_lin
        have h_prod_c : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z * q (z * lam₀))
            (1 * q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀) +
              (t : ℂ) * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀) * (1 * lam₀))) (t : ℂ) :=
          (hasDerivAt_id (t : ℂ)).mul h_comp
        have h_eq_deriv : 1 * q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀) +
            (t : ℂ) * (deriv q ((t : ℂ) * lam₀) * (1 * lam₀)) = F' lam₀ t := by
          dsimp [F']
          ring
        rw [h_eq_deriv] at h_prod_c
        exact h_prod_c.comp_ofReal
      have hint :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_gamma_deriv h_leibniz.1
      simpa using hint
    rw [h_ftc] at h_leibniz
    exact h_leibniz.2

  let W : ℂ → ℂ := fun lam => lam * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)
  have hW_zero : W 0 = 0 := by simp [W]
  have hW_odd : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half, W (-lam) = -W lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    dsimp [W]
    rw [hI_even lam hlam]
    ring
  have hW_hasDeriv : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half,
      HasDerivAt W ((J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)) lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    have h_exp := (hI_hasDeriv lam hlam).cexp
    have h_prod : HasDerivAt W
        (1 * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) + lam * (Complex.exp (I_prim lam) * q lam)) lam :=
      (hasDerivAt_id lam).mul h_exp
    have hq_eq : 1 + lam * q lam = (J_mod lam)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hq_mul lam]
      dsimp [f_inv]
      ring
    have h_eq : 1 * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) + lam * (Complex.exp (I_prim lam) * q lam) =
        (J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) := by
      calc 1 * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) + lam * (Complex.exp (I_prim lam) * q lam)
          = (1 + lam * q lam) * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) := by ring
        _ = (J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) := by rw [hq_eq]
    rwa [h_eq] at h_prod
  have hW_holo_half : DifferentiableOn ℂ W (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half) :=
    fun lam hlam => (hW_hasDeriv lam hlam).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hW_ode : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half,
      lam * J_mod lam * deriv W lam = W lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [(hW_hasDeriv lam hlam).deriv]
    have hJ_ne := hJ_mod_ne lam (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_half_le hlam)
    calc lam * J_mod lam * ((J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam))
        = lam * (J_mod lam * (J_mod lam)⁻¹) * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) := by ring
      _ = W lam := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hJ_ne, mul_one]

  have hW_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ W 0 :=
    hW_holo_half.analyticAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_half_pos)
  have hW_deriv0 : deriv W 0 = 1 := by
    rw [(hW_hasDeriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_half_pos)).deriv]
    simp [hJ_mod_zero, hI_zero]
  have hW_deriv_ne : deriv W 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hW_deriv0]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hW_strict : HasStrictDerivAt W (deriv W 0) 0 := hW_ana.hasStrictDerivAt
  let Λ : ℂ → ℂ := hW_strict.localInverse W (deriv W 0) 0 hW_deriv_ne
  have hΛ_ana : AnalyticAt ℂ Λ 0 := by
    simpa [Λ, hW_zero] using hW_ana.analyticAt_localInverse hW_deriv_ne
  obtain ⟨δ_WL, hδ_WL_pos, hδ_WL⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hW_strict.eventually_left_inverse hW_deriv_ne)
  let r_lam : ℝ := min r_half δ_WL
  have hr_lam_pos : 0 < r_lam := lt_min hr_half_pos hδ_WL_pos
  have hr_lam_le_half : r_lam ≤ r_half := min_le_left _ _
  have hr_lam_le_J : r_lam ≤ r_J := le_trans hr_lam_le_half hr_half_le
  have hΛ_left : ∀ lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam, Λ (W lam) = lam := by
    intro lam hlam
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hlam
    have hd : dist lam 0 < δ_WL := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlam (min_le_right _ _)
    exact hδ_WL hd
  have hΛ_zero : Λ 0 = 0 := by
    have h := hΛ_left 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_lam_pos)
    simpa [hW_zero] using h
  have hΛ_ev : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ Λ w ∧ W (Λ w) = w ∧ Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam := by
    have h1 := Complex.analyticAt_iff_eventually_differentiableAt.mp hΛ_ana
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), W (Λ w) = w := by
      simpa [Λ, hW_zero] using hW_strict.eventually_right_inverse hW_deriv_ne
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (0 : ℂ), Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam :=
      hΛ_ana.continuousAt.eventually_mem
        (by rw [hΛ_zero]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hr_lam_pos)
    exact h1.and (h2.and h3)
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hΛ_ev

  have hΛ_props : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ Λ w ∧ W (Λ w) = w ∧ Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hw
    have hd : dist w 0 < ρ₀ := by rwa [dist_zero_right]
    exact hρ₀ hd
  have hΛ_holo₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ Λ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀) :=
    fun w hw => (hΛ_props w hw).1.differentiableWithinAt
  have hΛ_odd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀, Λ (-w) = -Λ w := by
    intro w hw
    have hlam_mem : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam := (hΛ_props w hw).2.2
    have hlam_half : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_half hlam_mem
    have h_neg_lam : -Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam := by
      simpa using hlam_mem
    have hW_neg : W (-Λ w) = -w := by
      rw [hW_odd (Λ w) hlam_half, (hΛ_props w hw).2.1]
    have hL := hΛ_left (-Λ w) h_neg_lam
    rw [hW_neg] at hL
    exact hL
  have hΛ_deriv_rel : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀,
      ((J_mod (Λ w))⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim (Λ w))) * deriv Λ w = 1 := by
    intro w hw
    have hlam_half : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_half (hΛ_props w hw).2.2
    have h_comp := (hW_hasDeriv (Λ w) hlam_half).comp w (hΛ_props w hw).1.hasDerivAt
    have hev : id =ᶠ[nhds w] (W ∘ Λ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw)
        (fun z hz => ((hΛ_props z hz).2.1).symm)
    exact (h_comp.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).unique (hasDerivAt_id w)

  let ρ_mod : ℝ := ρ₀ / 2
  have hρ_mod_pos : 0 < ρ_mod := half_pos hρ₀_pos
  have hρ_mod_le : ρ_mod ≤ ρ₀ := half_le_self hρ₀_pos.le
  have hcb_sub_Λ : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)
  let Λ₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope Λ 0
  have hΛ₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Λ₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hρ₀_pos)).mpr hΛ_holo₀
  obtain ⟨B_Λ, hB_Λ⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hΛ₂_holo.continuousOn.mono hcb_sub_Λ)
  let M_Λ : ℝ := max B_Λ 1
  have hM_Λ_pos : 0 < M_Λ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _)
  have hΛ_lin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, ‖Λ w‖ ≤ M_Λ * ‖w‖ := by
    intro w hw
    have hmul : w * Λ₂ w = Λ w := by
      simpa [Λ₂, hΛ_zero] using sub_smul_dslope Λ 0 w
    rw [← hmul, norm_mul, mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans (hB_Λ w hw) (le_max_left _ _)) (norm_nonneg w)

  let C_Δ : ℝ := max 1 (M₁ * M_Λ ^ 2)
  have hC_Δ_pos : 0 < C_Δ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  let Δ₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => -Complex.I * I_prim (Λ w)
  have hΔ₀_zero : Δ₀ 0 = 0 := by simp [Δ₀, hΛ_zero, hI_zero]
  have hΔ₀_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod,
      HasDerivAt Δ₀ (-Complex.I * (q (Λ w) * deriv Λ w)) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hw₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_mod_le hw
    have hlam_half : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_half (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.2
    exact ((hI_hasDeriv (Λ w) hlam_half).comp w (hΛ_props w hw₀).1.hasDerivAt).const_mul
      (-Complex.I)
  have hΔ₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ₀ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod) :=
    fun w hw => (hΔ₀_hasDeriv w hw).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hΔ₀_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, Δ₀ (-w) = Δ₀ w := by
    intro w hw
    have hw₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_mod_le hw
    have hlam_half : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_half (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.2
    dsimp [Δ₀]
    rw [hΛ_odd w hw₀, hI_even (Λ w) hlam_half]
  have hΔ₀_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod, ‖Δ₀ w‖ ≤ C_Δ * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have hw₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_mod_le hw
    have hw_cb : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw
    have hlam_half : Λ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_half (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.2
    have h1 : ‖Δ₀ w‖ = ‖I_prim (Λ w)‖ := by
      dsimp [Δ₀]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
    have h2 : ‖I_prim (Λ w)‖ ≤ M₁ * ‖Λ w‖ ^ 2 := hI_bound (Λ w) hlam_half
    have h3 : ‖Λ w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (M_Λ * ‖w‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hΛ_lin w hw_cb) 2
    calc ‖Δ₀ w‖ = ‖I_prim (Λ w)‖ := h1
      _ ≤ M₁ * ‖Λ w‖ ^ 2 := h2
      _ ≤ M₁ * (M_Λ * ‖w‖) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hM₁_pos.le
      _ = (M₁ * M_Λ ^ 2) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ C_Δ * ‖w‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (sq_nonneg _)

  have h_exp_shift : ∀ (w_coeff Y : ℂ),
      ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < ρ_mod →
      w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I *
        (Y + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)))) =
        Λ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) := by
    intro w_coeff Y hw
    set w := w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)
    have hw₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hw hρ_mod_le
    set lam := Λ w
    have hW_lam : W lam = w := (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.1
    have h_arg : -Complex.I * (Y + Δ₀ w) = -Complex.I * Y + (-I_prim lam) := by
      dsimp [Δ₀, lam]
      calc -Complex.I * (Y + -Complex.I * I_prim (Λ w))
          = -Complex.I * Y + (Complex.I ^ 2) * I_prim (Λ w) := by ring
        _ = -Complex.I * Y + (-I_prim (Λ w)) := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
    rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_add]
    calc w_coeff * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) * Complex.exp (-I_prim lam))
        = w * Complex.exp (-I_prim lam) := by dsimp [w]; ring
      _ = W lam * Complex.exp (-I_prim lam) := by rw [hW_lam]
      _ = lam * (Complex.exp (I_prim lam) * Complex.exp (-I_prim lam)) := by
          dsimp [W]; ring
      _ = lam * Complex.exp (I_prim lam + -I_prim lam) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]
      _ = lam := by simp

  have h_shift_hasDeriv : ∀ (w_coeff Y : ℂ),
      ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < ρ_mod →
      HasDerivAt (fun Y' => Y' + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y')))
        (J_mod (Λ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)))) Y := by
    intro w_coeff Y hw
    set w := w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)
    have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_mod := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hw₀ : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_mod_le hw_ball
    set lam := Λ w
    have hlam_J : lam ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_J :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_J (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.2
    have hJ_ne : J_mod lam ≠ 0 := hJ_mod_ne lam hlam_J
    have hW_lam : lam * Complex.exp (I_prim lam) = w := (hΛ_props w hw₀).2.1
    have h_rel : ((J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)) * deriv Λ w = 1 :=
      hΛ_deriv_rel w hw₀
    have h_ω : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y'))
        (-Complex.I * w) Y := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => -Complex.I * Y') (-Complex.I * 1) Y :=
        (hasDerivAt_id Y).const_mul (-Complex.I)
      have h2 := h1.cexp.const_mul w_coeff
      convert h2 using 1
      dsimp [w]
      ring
    have h_comp := (hΔ₀_hasDeriv w hw_ball).comp Y h_ω
    have h_sum : HasDerivAt (fun Y' => Y' + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y')))
        (1 + (-Complex.I * (q lam * deriv Λ w)) * (-Complex.I * w)) Y :=
      (hasDerivAt_id Y).add h_comp
    have h_prod : w * q lam * deriv Λ w = 1 - J_mod lam := by
      have h_wq : w * q lam * deriv Λ w =
          (lam * q lam) * J_mod lam *
            (((J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)) * deriv Λ w) := by
        calc w * q lam * deriv Λ w
            = (lam * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)) * q lam * deriv Λ w := by rw [← hW_lam]
          _ = (lam * q lam) * (J_mod lam * (J_mod lam)⁻¹) *
                Complex.exp (I_prim lam) * deriv Λ w := by
              rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hJ_ne]; ring
          _ = (lam * q lam) * J_mod lam *
                (((J_mod lam)⁻¹ * Complex.exp (I_prim lam)) * deriv Λ w) := by ring
      rw [h_wq, h_rel, mul_one, hq_mul lam]
      dsimp [f_inv]
      calc ((J_mod lam)⁻¹ - 1) * J_mod lam
          = (J_mod lam)⁻¹ * J_mod lam - J_mod lam := by ring
        _ = 1 - J_mod lam := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hJ_ne]
    have h_eq : 1 + (-Complex.I * (q lam * deriv Λ w)) * (-Complex.I * w) = J_mod lam := by
      calc 1 + (-Complex.I * (q lam * deriv Λ w)) * (-Complex.I * w)
          = 1 + (Complex.I ^ 2) * (w * q lam * deriv Λ w) := by ring
        _ = 1 - w * q lam * deriv Λ w := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
        _ = 1 - (1 - J_mod lam) := by rw [h_prod]
        _ = J_mod lam := by ring
    rwa [h_eq] at h_sum

  
  
  
  refine ⟨{
    ρ_mod := ρ_mod
    r_lam := r_lam
    ρ_J := ρ_J
    C_Δ := C_Δ
    Δ₀ := Δ₀
    ρ_mod_pos := hρ_mod_pos
    r_lam_pos := hr_lam_pos
    ρ_J_pos := hρ_J_pos
    ρ_J_lt := hρ_J_lt
    C_Δ_pos := hC_Δ_pos
    Δ₀_holo := hΔ₀_holo
    Δ₀_zero := hΔ₀_zero
    Δ₀_even := hΔ₀_even
    Δ₀_bound := hΔ₀_bound
    model_energy := fun w_coeff Y hw => by
      rw [h_exp_shift w_coeff Y hw, (h_shift_hasDeriv w_coeff Y hw).deriv]
      have hw₀ : w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hw hρ_mod_le
      exact hJ_mod_energy _ (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_lam_le_J (hΛ_props _ hw₀).2.2)
    regular_on_polydisk := fun lam J hlam hJ =>
      h_poly_reg lam J (lt_of_lt_of_le hlam hr_lam_le_J) hJ
    cone_ode_uniqueness := ?_
  }⟩
  intro w_coeff D₁ A₁ S_star hD₁ hA₁ hS_holo hS_tendsto hS_cone
  let 𝒞 : Set ℂ := { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < A₁ * (-Y.im) }
  have h𝒞_open : IsOpen 𝒞 :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im.neg).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re)
        (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_im.neg))
  have h𝒞_conv : Convex ℝ 𝒞 := by
    intro Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂ a b ha hb hab
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
      simpa [ha0, hb1] using hY₂
    · have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
      rcases hY₁ with ⟨hY₁_im, hY₁_re⟩
      rcases hY₂ with ⟨hY₂_im, hY₂_re⟩
      have him : (a • Y₁ + b • Y₂).im = a * Y₁.im + b * Y₂.im := by simp
      have hre : (a • Y₁ + b • Y₂).re = a * Y₁.re + b * Y₂.re := by simp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [him]
        have h1 : a * D₁ < a * (-Y₁.im) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hY₁_im ha_pos
        have h2 : b * D₁ ≤ b * (-Y₂.im) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY₂_im.le hb
        nlinarith
      · rw [him, hre]
        have h_abs : |a * Y₁.re + b * Y₂.re| ≤ a * |Y₁.re| + b * |Y₂.re| := by
          calc |a * Y₁.re + b * Y₂.re|
              ≤ |a * Y₁.re| + |b * Y₂.re| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ = a * |Y₁.re| + b * |Y₂.re| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        have h1 : a * |Y₁.re| < a * (A₁ * (-Y₁.im)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hY₁_re ha_pos
        have h2 : b * |Y₂.re| ≤ b * (A₁ * (-Y₂.im)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY₂_re.le hb
        linarith

  let lam_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_star Y)
  let F_int : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => W (lam_star Y) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y)
  have hS_deriv_eq : ∀ Y ∈ 𝒞, deriv S_star Y = J_mod (lam_star Y) := by
    intro Y hY
    rcases hS_cone Y hY.1 hY.2 with ⟨_, hlam_lt, hJ_lt, hE⟩
    exact h_root_unique (lam_star Y) (deriv S_star Y)
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hlam_lt hr_lam_le_J) hJ_lt hE
  have hF_hasDeriv : ∀ Y ∈ 𝒞, HasDerivAt F_int 0 Y := by
    intro Y hY
    rcases hS_cone Y hY.1 hY.2 with ⟨_, hlam_lt, _, _⟩
    have hlam_half : lam_star Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_half := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlam_lt hr_lam_le_half
    have hS_at : HasDerivAt S_star (J_mod (lam_star Y)) Y := by
      rw [← hS_deriv_eq Y hY]
      exact (hS_holo.differentiableAt (h𝒞_open.mem_nhds hY)).hasDerivAt
    have hlam_at : HasDerivAt lam_star (-Complex.I * (lam_star Y * J_mod (lam_star Y))) Y := by
      have h1 := (hS_at.const_mul (-Complex.I)).cexp.const_mul w_coeff
      convert h1 using 1
      dsimp [lam_star]
      ring
    have hW_at : HasDerivAt W (deriv W (lam_star Y)) (lam_star Y) :=
      (hW_hasDeriv (lam_star Y) hlam_half).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hW_comp : HasDerivAt (fun Y' => W (lam_star Y')) (-Complex.I * W (lam_star Y)) Y := by
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun Y' => W (lam_star Y'))
          (deriv W (lam_star Y) * (-Complex.I * (lam_star Y * J_mod (lam_star Y)))) Y :=
        hW_at.comp Y hlam_at
      have h_eq : deriv W (lam_star Y) * (-Complex.I * (lam_star Y * J_mod (lam_star Y))) =
          -Complex.I * W (lam_star Y) := by
        calc deriv W (lam_star Y) * (-Complex.I * (lam_star Y * J_mod (lam_star Y)))
            = -Complex.I * (lam_star Y * J_mod (lam_star Y) * deriv W (lam_star Y)) := by ring
          _ = -Complex.I * W (lam_star Y) := by rw [hW_ode (lam_star Y) hlam_half]
      rwa [h_eq] at hc
    have hexp_at : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y'))
        (Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) * Complex.I) Y := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => Complex.I * Y') (Complex.I * 1) Y :=
        (hasDerivAt_id Y).const_mul Complex.I
      have h2 := h1.cexp
      rwa [mul_one] at h2
    have hprod : HasDerivAt F_int
        ((-Complex.I * W (lam_star Y)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) +
          W (lam_star Y) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) * Complex.I)) Y :=
      hW_comp.mul hexp_at
    have h_zero : (-Complex.I * W (lam_star Y)) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) +
        W (lam_star Y) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) * Complex.I) = 0 := by ring
    rwa [h_zero] at hprod
  have hF_const : ∀ Y₁ ∈ 𝒞, ∀ Y₂ ∈ 𝒞, F_int Y₁ = F_int Y₂ := by
    intro Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂
    have h_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_int 𝒞 :=
      fun Z hZ => (hF_hasDeriv Z hZ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have h_le : ‖F_int Y₁ - F_int Y₂‖ ≤ 0 * ‖Y₁ - Y₂‖ :=
      h𝒞_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun Z hZ => h_diff.differentiableAt (h𝒞_open.mem_nhds hZ))
        (fun Z hZ => by rw [(hF_hasDeriv Z hZ).deriv, norm_zero])
        hY₂ hY₁
    rw [ zero_mul, norm_le_zero_iff] at h_le
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_le

  let Y_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => -(τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let δ_ray : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => S_star (Y_ray τ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hY_ray_mem : ∀ τ : ℝ, D₁ + 1 ≤ τ → Y_ray τ ∈ 𝒞 := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [Y_ray]
      linarith
    · simp [Y_ray]
      exact mul_pos hA₁ hτ_pos
  have hexp_neg_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    have h_eq : (fun τ : ℝ => ‖Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ))‖) = fun τ : ℝ => Real.exp (-τ) := by
      ext τ
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      simp
    rw [h_eq]
    exact Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero
  have hlam_ray_eq : ∀ τ : ℝ,
      lam_star (Y_ray τ) =
        w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) := by
    intro τ
    have h_arg : -Complex.I * S_star (Y_ray τ) = -(τ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) := by
      have hS_eq : S_star (Y_ray τ) = δ_ray τ - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        dsimp [δ_ray]
        ring
      rw [hS_eq]
      calc -Complex.I * (δ_ray τ - (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          = (Complex.I ^ 2) * (τ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) := by ring
        _ = -(τ : ℂ) + (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
    dsimp [lam_star]
    rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_add]
    ring
  have hexp_δ_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => -Complex.I * δ_ray τ)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (-Complex.I * 0)) :=
      hS_tendsto.const_mul (-Complex.I)
    rw [mul_zero] at h1
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.exp 0)) :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h1
    rwa [Complex.exp_zero] at h2
  have hlam_ray_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => lam_star (Y_ray τ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ))) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds ((w_coeff * 0) * 1)) :=
      (hexp_neg_tendsto.const_mul w_coeff).mul hexp_δ_tendsto
    rw [mul_zero, zero_mul] at h1
    exact h1.congr (fun τ => (hlam_ray_eq τ).symm)
  have hI_cont0 : ContinuousAt I_prim 0 :=
    (hI_hasDeriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_half_pos)).continuousAt
  have hF_ray_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => F_int (Y_ray τ)) Filter.atTop (nhds w_coeff) := by
    let g_lim : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ =>
      (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ)) *
        Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ)))
    have hg_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto g_lim Filter.atTop (nhds w_coeff) := by
      have hI_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (I_prim 0)) :=
        hI_cont0.tendsto.comp hlam_ray_tendsto
      rw [hI_zero] at hI_lim
      have hexp_I : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ))))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.exp 0)) :=
        Complex.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hI_lim
      rw [Complex.exp_zero] at hexp_I
      have hwδ : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (w_coeff * 1)) :=
        hexp_δ_tendsto.const_mul w_coeff
      have hprod : Filter.Tendsto g_lim Filter.atTop (nhds ((w_coeff * 1) * 1)) :=
        hwδ.mul hexp_I
      rwa [mul_one, mul_one] at hprod
    refine hg_tendsto.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (D₁ + 1)] with τ hτ
    have hIY : Complex.I * Y_ray τ = (τ : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [Y_ray]
      calc Complex.I * (-(τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = -(Complex.I ^ 2) * (τ : ℂ) := by ring
        _ = (τ : ℂ) := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
    dsimp [F_int, W, g_lim]
    rw [hIY]
    have hl := hlam_ray_eq τ
    calc (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ)) *
          Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ)))
        = w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) *
            Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ))) := by simp
      _ = w_coeff * (Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (τ : ℂ)) *
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ) *
            Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ))) := by rw [Complex.exp_add]
      _ = (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * δ_ray τ)) *
            Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ))) * Complex.exp (τ : ℂ) := by ring
      _ = lam_star (Y_ray τ) * Complex.exp (I_prim (lam_star (Y_ray τ))) *
            Complex.exp (τ : ℂ) := by rw [← hl]

  have hW_lam_eq : ∀ Y ∈ 𝒞, W (lam_star Y) = w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) := by
    intro Y hY
    have h_const_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => F_int (Y_ray τ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (F_int Y)) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (D₁ + 1)] with τ hτ
      exact hF_const Y hY (Y_ray τ) (hY_ray_mem τ hτ)
    have hF_eq : F_int Y = w_coeff := tendsto_nhds_unique h_const_lim hF_ray_tendsto
    calc W (lam_star Y)
        = W (lam_star Y) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * Y) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) := by
            rw [← Complex.exp_add]; simp
      _ = F_int Y * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) := by dsimp [F_int]; ring
      _ = w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y) := by rw [hF_eq]

  let S_mod : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => Y' + Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y'))
  let D_diff : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y' => S_star Y' - S_mod Y'
  have hD_hasDeriv : ∀ Y ∈ 𝒞, HasDerivAt D_diff 0 Y := by
    intro Y hY
    rcases hS_cone Y hY.1 hY.2 with ⟨hw_lt, hlam_lt, _, _⟩
    have hlam_mem : lam_star Y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_lam := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hlam_eq_Λ : lam_star Y = Λ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) := by
      have hL := hΛ_left (lam_star Y) hlam_mem
      rw [hW_lam_eq Y hY] at hL
      exact hL.symm
    have hS_at : HasDerivAt S_star (J_mod (lam_star Y)) Y := by
      rw [← hS_deriv_eq Y hY]
      exact (hS_holo.differentiableAt (h𝒞_open.mem_nhds hY)).hasDerivAt
    have hmod_at : HasDerivAt S_mod (J_mod (lam_star Y)) Y := by
      rw [hlam_eq_Λ]
      exact h_shift_hasDeriv w_coeff Y hw_lt
    have hsub : HasDerivAt D_diff (J_mod (lam_star Y) - J_mod (lam_star Y)) Y :=
      hS_at.sub hmod_at
    rwa [sub_self] at hsub
  have hD_const : ∀ Y₁ ∈ 𝒞, ∀ Y₂ ∈ 𝒞, D_diff Y₁ = D_diff Y₂ := by
    intro Y₁ hY₁ Y₂ hY₂
    have h_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_diff 𝒞 :=
      fun Z hZ => (hD_hasDeriv Z hZ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have h_le : ‖D_diff Y₁ - D_diff Y₂‖ ≤ 0 * ‖Y₁ - Y₂‖ :=
      h𝒞_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun Z hZ => h_diff.differentiableAt (h𝒞_open.mem_nhds hZ))
        (fun Z hZ => by rw [(hD_hasDeriv Z hZ).deriv, norm_zero])
        hY₂ hY₁
    rw [zero_mul, norm_le_zero_iff] at h_le
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_le
  have hD_ray_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => D_diff (Y_ray τ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hΔ_cont0 : ContinuousAt Δ₀ 0 :=
      (hΔ₀_hasDeriv 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_mod_pos)).continuousAt
    have hw_ray_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (w_coeff * 0)) :=
      hexp_neg_tendsto.const_mul w_coeff
    rw [mul_zero] at hw_ray_lim
    have hΔ_ray_lim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ)))) Filter.atTop (nhds (Δ₀ 0)) :=
      hΔ_cont0.tendsto.comp hw_ray_lim
    rw [hΔ₀_zero] at hΔ_ray_lim
    have h_sub_lim : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => δ_ray τ - Δ₀ (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-(τ : ℂ))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (0 - 0)) :=
      hS_tendsto.sub hΔ_ray_lim
    rw [sub_self] at h_sub_lim
    refine h_sub_lim.congr (fun τ => ?_)
    have h_neg_IY : -Complex.I * Y_ray τ = -(τ : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [Y_ray]
      calc -Complex.I * (-(τ : ℂ) * Complex.I) = (Complex.I ^ 2) * (τ : ℂ) := by ring
        _ = -(τ : ℂ) := by rw [Complex.I_sq]; ring
    dsimp [D_diff, S_mod, δ_ray]
    rw [h_neg_IY]
    dsimp [Y_ray]
    ring

  intro Y hY_im hY_re
  have hY : Y ∈ 𝒞 := ⟨hY_im, hY_re⟩
  have h_const_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => D_diff (Y_ray τ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (D_diff Y)) := by
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (D₁ + 1)] with τ hτ
    exact hD_const Y hY (Y_ray τ) (hY_ray_mem τ hτ)
  have hD_zero : D_diff Y = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique h_const_lim hD_ray_tendsto
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hD_zero

informal_problem.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (T_max D_anc C_anc α D₀ A D_top : ℝ)
    (hT_max : 0 < T_max) (hD_anc : 0 < D_anc) (hC_anc : 0 < C_anc)
    (hα₁ : 1 / 2 < α) (hα₂ : α < 1) (hD₀_ge : D_anc ≤ D₀)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hD_top : D₀ + 2 < D_top)
    (hAnc2 : DfmcHasAnchorAt X P kind seq (2 * T_max) D_anc C_anc α)
    (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hWit : DfmcAnchorWitnessAt X P kind seq (2 * T_max) D_anc C_anc α
      (A + 2) (D_top + 4) N_init U_phys s_tilde δ_base)
    (S_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hS_cont : ContinuousOn S_cand { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max })
    (hS_zero : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → S_cand (Y, 0) = Y)
    (K : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (hK_comp : IsCompact K)
    (hK_sub : K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧ |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max })
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hFail : ¬ ∃ N₁ : ℕ, N_init ≤ N₁ ∧ ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
      let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
      ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
          (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - S_cand p‖ < ε) :
    ∃ L : DfmcExtractedLimit X P kind seq D₀ C_anc α A T_max,
      L.S_star L.Y_star ≠ S_cand (L.Y_star, L.T_star)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hD₀_pos : 0 < D₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le hD_anc hD₀_ge
  have hD_top_pos : 0 < D_top := by linarith
  
  have h_lip_of_holo_bdd : ∀ (U Ω : Set ℂ) (r M : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → 0 < r →
      (∀ w ∈ U, Metric.closedBall w r ⊆ Ω) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f Ω →
      (∀ z ∈ Ω, ‖f z‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ (M / r) * ‖x - y‖ := by
    intro U Ω r M f hU_open hU_conv hr h_ball hf_holo hf_bdd x hx y hy
    have hU_sub : U ⊆ Ω := fun w hw => h_ball w hw (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
    have hf_U : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U := hf_holo.mono hU_sub
    have h_deriv : ∀ w ∈ U, ‖deriv f w‖ ≤ M / r := fun w hw =>
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
        (hf_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (h_ball w hw))
        (fun z hz => hf_bdd z (h_ball w hw (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
    exact hU_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (fun w hw => (hf_U w hw).differentiableAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hw)) h_deriv hy hx
  
  have h_vert_uniq : ∀ (A₁ D_top₁ A₂ D_top₂ : ℝ)
      (N₁ N₂ : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
      (s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℕ → ℝ),
      DfmcAnchorWitnessAt X P kind seq (2 * T_max) D_anc C_anc α A₁ D_top₁ N₁ U₁ s₁ δ₁ →
      DfmcAnchorWitnessAt X P kind seq (2 * T_max) D_anc C_anc α A₂ D_top₂ N₂ U₂ s₂ δ₂ →
      ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n → N₂ ≤ n →
      ∀ Y T : ℂ,
        D_anc < -Y.im → -Y.im < D_top₁ → -Y.im < D_top₂ →
        |Y.re| < A₁ * (-Y.im) → |Y.re| < A₂ * (-Y.im) → ‖T‖ < 2 * T_max →
        rescaledLift seq (s₁ n) n Y T = rescaledLift seq (s₂ n) n Y T := by
    intro A₁ D_top₁ A₂ D_top₂ N₁ N₂ U₁ U₂ s₁ s₂ δ₁ δ₂ hW₁ hW₂ n hn₁ hn₂ Y T
      hY_lo hY_hi₁ hY_hi₂ hY_re₁ hY_re₂ hT
    rcases hW₁ n hn₁ with
      ⟨hOpen₁, hδ₁, hVert₁, _, hHolo₁, _, _, hBase₁, _, hCone₁, _⟩
    rcases hW₂ n hn₂ with
      ⟨hOpen₂, hδ₂, hVert₂, _, hHolo₂, _, _, hBase₂, _, hCone₂, _⟩
    let y₀ : ℂ := expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
    let t₀ : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
    have hc₁ := hCone₁ (Y, T) ⟨hY_lo, hY_hi₁, hY_re₁, hT⟩
    have hc₂ := hCone₂ (Y, T) ⟨hY_lo, hY_hi₂, hY_re₂, hT⟩
    have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
    have ht₀_lt : ‖t₀‖ < (2 * T_max) / seq.m_seq n := by
      dsimp [t₀]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hm_pos.le]
      exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hT hm_pos
    have hs_eq : s₁ n (y₀, t₀) = s₂ n (y₀, t₀) := by
      let ι : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => ((y₀.re : ℂ) + z * Complex.I, t₀)
      have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι :=
        ((differentiable_const _).add
          (differentiable_id.mul (differentiable_const Complex.I))).prodMk
          (differentiable_const t₀)
      let W : Set ℂ := ι ⁻¹' (U₁ n ∩ U₂ n)
      have hW_open : IsOpen W := (hOpen₁.inter hOpen₂).preimage hι_diff.continuous
      let f₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => s₁ n (ι z)
      let f₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => s₂ n (ι z)
      have hf₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f₁ W :=
        (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hW_open).mpr

      exact hJ_div _ _
    have hJ_curr_eq : (F_seq k (Y + a_n) - F_seq k Y) / a_n =
        (s_w k n ((s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y) + t, t) -
          s_w k n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, t)) / t := by
      change ((s_w k n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (Y + a_n), t) - s_n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) -
        (s_w k n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y, t) - s_n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)) / a_n = _
      rw [hy_next]
      exact hJ_div _ _
    dsimp only
    rw [hs_prev_eq, hs_curr_eq, hJ_prev_eq, hJ_curr_eq]
    exact h_rec_phys
  have hY_star_pos : 0 < -Y_star.im := lt_trans hD₀_pos hY_star_lo
  have hY_star_mem : Y_star ∈ Ω_inf :=
    ⟨hY_star_lo, lt_trans hY_star_re (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hY_star_pos)⟩
  let L_pkg : DfmcExtractedLimit X P kind seq D₀ C_anc α A T_max :=
    { Y_star := Y_star
      T_star := T_star
      S_star := S_star
      φ := φ
      F_seq := F_seq
      T_star_ne := hT_star_ne
      T_star_lt := hT_star_lt
      Y_star_mem := hY_star_mem
      φ_strictMono := hφ_mono
      S_star_holo := hS_holo
      S_star_bound := hS_bnd
      F_conv := hF_conv
      F_deriv_conv := hF_deriv_conv
      local_holo_and_recurrence := h_loc_rec }
  refine ⟨L_pkg, ?_⟩
  change S_star Y_star ≠ S_cand (Y_star, T_star)
  have hF_Y_star : ∀ k : ℕ, ε / 2 ≤ ‖F_seq k Y_star - S_cand (Y_star, T_star)‖ := by
    intro k
    have hk_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    have hY_re3 : |Y_star.re| < (A + 3) * (-Y_star.im) :=
      lt_trans hY_star_re (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) hY_star_pos)
    have h_eq : F_seq k Y_star = rescaledLift seq (s_tilde (φ k)) (φ k) Y_star T_star :=
      h_vert_uniq (A + 3) (D_top + (k : ℝ) + 6) (A + 2) (D_top + 4)
        (N_w k) N_init (U_w k) U_phys (s_w k) s_tilde (δ_w k) δ_base
        (hWit_m k) hWit (φ k) (hφ_ge_Nw k) (hν_init (σ k))
        Y_star T_star (lt_of_le_of_lt hD₀_ge hY_star_lo) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        hY_re3 hY_star_mem.2 hT_star_lt2
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hν_sep (σ k)
  have h_lim_norm : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ‖F_seq k Y_star - S_cand (Y_star, T_star)‖)
      Filter.atTop (nhds ‖S_star Y_star - S_cand (Y_star, T_star)‖) :=
    ((hF_conv.tendsto_at hY_star_mem).sub tendsto_const_nhds).norm
  have h_lim_ge : ε / 2 ≤ ‖S_star Y_star - S_cand (Y_star, T_star)‖ :=
    ge_of_tendsto h_lim_norm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF_Y_star)
  intro h_eq_lim
  rw [h_eq_lim, sub_self, norm_zero] at h_lim_ge
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_cone_open_conv : ∀ (D_c A_c : ℝ),
      IsOpen { Y : ℂ | D_c < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < A_c * (-Y.im) } ∧
      Convex ℝ { Y : ℂ | D_c < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < A_c * (-Y.im) } := by
    intro D_c A_c
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Set.ofPred_and]
      have hc_im : Continuous (fun Y : ℂ => -Y.im) := Complex.continuous_im.neg
      have hc_re : Continuous (fun Y : ℂ => |Y.re|) := continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re
      exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt hc_re (continuous_const.mul hc_im))
    · rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      have him : -(a • x + b • y).im = a * (-x.im) + b * (-y.im) := by
        simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul]; ring
      have hre : (a • x + b • y).re = a * x.re + b * y.re := by
        simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [him]
        calc D_c = (a + b) * D_c := by rw [hab, one_mul]
          _ = a * D_c + b * D_c := add_mul a b D_c
          _ < a * (-x.im) + b * (-y.im) :=
              add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx.1 ha) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy.1 hb)
      · rw [hre, him]
        calc |a * x.re + b * y.re| ≤ |a * x.re| + |b * y.re| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |x.re| + b * |y.re| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ha, abs_of_pos hb]
          _ < a * (A_c * (-x.im)) + b * (A_c * (-y.im)) :=
              add_lt_add (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx.2 ha) (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy.2 hb)
          _ = A_c * (a * (-x.im) + b * (-y.im)) := by ring

  have h_secant_bound : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      ∀ (c w L_val : ℂ) (M_b : ℝ), w ≠ 0 →
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        c + (θ : ℂ) * w ∈ U ∧ ‖deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) - L_val‖ ≤ M_b) →
      ‖(g (c + w) - g c) / w - L_val‖ ≤ M_b := by
    intro g U hU_open hg_holo c w L_val M_b hw_ne h_seg
    have h_seg_in : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, c + (θ : ℂ) * w ∈ U :=
      fun θ hθ => (h_seg θ hθ).1
    have h_aff_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => c + (t : ℂ) * w) :=
      continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have h_deriv_seg : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => g (c + (t : ℂ) * w))
          (w * deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w)) θ := by
      intro θ hθ
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hθ
      have hz_in : c + (θ : ℂ) * w ∈ U := h_seg_in θ hθ
      have hg_at : HasDerivAt g (deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w)) (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) :=
        (hg_holo.differentiableAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hz_in)).hasDerivAt
      have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => c + (t : ℂ) * w) w θ := by
        simpa using ((Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := θ)).mul_const w).const_add c
      have h_comp := (hg_at.hasFDerivAt.restrictScalars ℝ).comp_hasDerivAt θ h_lin
      have h_val : ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight (1 : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)
          (deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w))).restrictScalars ℝ) w =
          w * deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) := by simp
      rw [← h_val]
      exact h_comp
    have h_dg_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv g (c + (t : ℂ) * w))
        (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact (hg_holo.deriv hU_open).continuousOn.comp h_aff_cont.continuousOn h_seg_in
    have h_int_w := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv_seg
      (continuousOn_const.mul h_dg_cont).intervalIntegrable
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_int_w
    have h_end : g (c + ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * w) - g (c + ((0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * w) = g (c + w) - g c := by
      simp
    rw [h_end] at h_int_w
    have h_ftc : (g (c + w) - g c) / w = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) := by
      rw [← h_int_w, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hw_ne]
    have h_diff_int : (g (c + w) - g c) / w - L_val =
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) - L_val) := by
      calc (g (c + w) - g c) / w - L_val
          = (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w)) - (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..1, L_val) := by
              rw [h_ftc]; simp [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
        _ = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) - L_val) :=
              (intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_dg_cont.intervalIntegrable
                intervalIntegrable_const).symm
    have h_bnd : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖deriv g (c + (θ : ℂ) * w) - L_val‖ ≤ M_b := by
      intro θ hθ
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hθ
      exact (h_seg θ ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2⟩).2
    have h_ni := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_bnd
    have h_abs1 : |(1 : ℝ) - 0| = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h_abs1, mul_one] at h_ni
    rwa [h_diff_int]

  have hw_exp_re : ∀ z : ℂ, (-Complex.I * z).re = z.im := fun z => by simp

  
  have h_bivar_toolkit : ∀ (S₀ J₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      ∀ (p_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p_inf : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_p : ℕ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ p_inf (Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) →
        (∀ k ≥ K_p,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (p_seq k) (Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ))) →
        TendstoUniformlyOn p_seq p_inf Filter.atTop
          (Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) →
        ContinuousOn (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => p_inf (q.1, J')) q.2)
          (Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', q.2)) q.1)
          (Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ) ∧
        TendstoUniformlyOn
          (fun k (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun J' => p_seq k (q.1, J')) q.2)
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => p_inf (q.1, J')) q.2)
          Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ) ∧
        TendstoUniformlyOn
          (fun k (q : ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (fun S' => p_seq k (S', q.2)) q.1)
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', q.2)) q.1)
          Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ) ∧
        (∀ k ≥ K_p, ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f g : ℂ → ℂ),
          IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
          (∀ Y ∈ U, f Y ∈ Metric.ball S₀ δ ∧ g Y ∈ Metric.ball J₀ δ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Y => deriv (fun J' => p_seq k (f Y, J')) (g Y)) U) := by
    have h_bivar_diff2 : ∀ (S₀ J₀ : ℂ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
        ∀ (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) →
          ContinuousOn (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J')) q.2)
            (Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ) ∧
          (∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f g : ℂ → ℂ),
            IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
            (∀ Y ∈ U, f Y ∈ Metric.ball S₀ δ ∧ g Y ∈ Metric.ball J₀ δ) →
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Y => deriv (fun J' => F (f Y, J')) (g Y)) U) := by
      intro S₀ J₀ δ hδ F hF
      let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)
      let K_δ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall S₀ δ ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ δ
      let K_32 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        Metric.closedBall S₀ (3 * δ / 2) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall J₀ (3 * δ / 2)
      have hK32_sub_W : K_32 ⊆ W :=
        Set.prod_mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
      have hK32_comp : IsCompact K_32 :=
        (isCompact_closedBall S₀ (3 * δ / 2)).prod (isCompact_closedBall J₀ (3 * δ / 2))
      obtain ⟨M_raw, hM_raw⟩ :=
        hK32_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hF.continuousOn.mono hK32_sub_W)
      let M : ℝ := max M_raw 0
      have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
      have hF_le_M : ∀ q ∈ K_32, ‖F q‖ ≤ M := fun q hq => le_trans (hM_raw q hq) (le_max_left _ _)
      have h_lip_slice : ∀ S ∈ Metric.closedBall S₀ δ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun J' => F (S, J')) (Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) ∧
          ∀ z₁ ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (9 * δ / 8), ∀ z₂ ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (9 * δ / 8),
            ‖deriv (fun J' => F (S, J')) z₂ - deriv (fun J' => F (S, J')) z₁‖ ≤
              (32 * M / δ ^ 2) * ‖z₂ - z₁‖ := by
        intro S hS
        have hS_32 : S ∈ Metric.closedBall S₀ (3 * δ / 2) :=
          Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith) hS
        have hS_2δ : S ∈ Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ) :=
          Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hS
        let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun J' => F (S, J')
        have hψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) :=
          hF.comp ((differentiable_const S).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
            (fun _ hJ' => ⟨hS_2δ, hJ'⟩)
        have hdψ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv ψ) (Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ)) :=
          hψ_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
        have h_d1 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (5 * δ / 4), ‖deriv ψ J₁‖ ≤ 4 * M / δ := by
          intro J₁ hJ₁
          have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall J₁ (δ / 4) ⊆ Metric.closedBall J₀ (3 * δ / 2) := by
            intro z hz
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz ⊢
            rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hJ₁
            have htri : dist z J₀ ≤ dist z J₁ + dist J₁ J₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
            linarith
          have h_cb_2δ : Metric.closedBall J₁ (δ / 4) ⊆ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ) :=
            Subset.trans h_cb_sub (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
          have hc := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity : 0 < δ / 4)
            ((hψ_holo.mono h_cb_2δ).diffContOnCl_ball Set.Subset.rfl)
            (fun z hz => hF_le_M (S, z) ⟨hS_32, h_cb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)⟩)
          have h_eq : M / (δ / 4) = 4 * M / δ := by field_simp [hδ.ne']
          rwa [h_eq] at hc
        have h_d2 : ∀ J₂ ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (9 * δ / 8), ‖deriv (deriv ψ) J₂‖ ≤ 32 * M / δ ^ 2 := by
          intro J₂ hJ₂
          have h_cb_sub : Metric.closedBall J₂ (δ / 8) ⊆ Metric.ball J₀ (5 * δ / 4) := by
            intro z hz
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
            rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hJ₂ ⊢
            have htri : dist z J₀ ≤ dist z J₂ + dist J₂ J₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
            linarith
          have h_cb_2δ : Metric.closedBall J₂ (δ / 8) ⊆ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ) :=
            Subset.trans h_cb_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
          have hc := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity : 0 < δ / 8)
            ((hdψ_holo.mono h_cb_2δ).diffContOnCl_ball Set.Subset.rfl)
            (fun z hz => h_d1 z (h_cb_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)))
          have h_eq : (4 * M / δ) / (δ / 8) = 32 * M / δ ^ 2 := by field_simp [hδ.ne']; ring
          rwa [h_eq] at hc
        refine ⟨hψ_holo, fun z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ => ?_⟩
        exact (convex_ball J₀ (9 * δ / 8)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
          (fun _ hz => hdψ_holo.differentiableAt
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz)))
          h_d2 hz₁ hz₂
      let η_m : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => δ / (16 * ((m : ℝ) + 1))
      have hη_pos : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < η_m m := fun m => by dsimp [η_m]; positivity
      have hη_ne : ∀ m : ℕ, (η_m m : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        fun m => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hη_pos m).ne'
      have hη_le : ∀ m : ℕ, η_m m ≤ δ / 16 := by
        intro m
        dsimp [η_m]
        have h_den : (16 : ℝ) ≤ 16 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
          have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
          linarith
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hδ.le (by norm_num) h_den
      have h_err_tend0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (32 * M / δ ^ 2) * η_m m)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h1 : η_m = fun m : ℕ => (δ / 16) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
          ext m; dsimp [η_m]; rw [div_div]
        have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) + 1) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop tendsto_const_nhds
        have hη_t0 : Filter.Tendsto η_m Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          rw [h1]
          exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop h_atTop
        simpa using hη_t0.const_mul (32 * M / δ ^ 2)
      have h_quot_bnd : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ q ∈ K_δ,
          ‖(F (q.1, q.2 + (η_m m : ℂ)) - F q) / (η_m m : ℂ) -
            deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J')) q.2‖ ≤ (32 * M / δ ^ 2) * η_m m := by
        intro m q hq
        obtain ⟨hψ_holo, hψ_lip⟩ := h_lip_slice q.1 hq.1
        have hq2_98 : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (9 * δ / 8) :=
          Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hq.2
        refine h_secant_bound (fun J' => F (q.1, J')) (Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ))
          Metric.isOpen_ball hψ_holo q.2 (η_m m : ℂ)
          (deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J')) q.2) ((32 * M / δ ^ 2) * η_m m) (hη_ne m) ?_
        intro θ hθ
        have h_mul : ‖(θ : ℂ) * (η_m m : ℂ)‖ ≤ η_m m := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg hθ.1, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hη_pos m).le]
          calc θ * η_m m ≤ 1 * η_m m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ.2 (hη_pos m).le
            _ = η_m m := one_mul _
