            calc θ * ‖a_seq k‖ ≤ 1 * ‖a_seq k‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθ.2 (norm_nonneg _)
              _ = ‖a_seq k‖ := one_mul _
          have hz_K32r : Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k ∈ K_32r := by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hY
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            have h_rew : Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k - Y₀ = (Y - Y₀) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k := by ring
            rw [h_rew]
            have htri := norm_add_le (Y - Y₀) ((θ : ℂ) * a_seq k)
            linarith
          refine ⟨hK32r_sub_2r hz_K32r, ?_⟩
          have h1 : ‖deriv (L.F_seq k) (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) -
              deriv L.S_star (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k)‖ < ε_J / 3 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hkdF _ hz_K32r
          have h_dist_δ : dist (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) Y < δ_J := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]
            have h_sub : Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k - Y = (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k := by ring
            rw [h_sub]
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt hmul hka
          have h2 : ‖deriv L.S_star (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) - deriv L.S_star Y‖ < ε_J / 3 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ_J _ hz_K32r Y hY_K32r h_dist_δ
          have htri := dist_triangle (deriv (L.F_seq k) (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k))
            (deriv L.S_star (Y + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k)) (deriv L.S_star Y)
          rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at htri
          linarith)
      rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_sec (by linarith)

    
    let G_k : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun k Y => deriv (fun J' => p_seq k (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y)
    let G_inf : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y => deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.S_star Y, J')) (deriv L.S_star Y)
    have hS_Br₀_in : ∀ Y ∈ B_r₀,
        L.S_star Y ∈ Metric.ball S₀ (δ₁ / 2) ∧ deriv L.S_star Y ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (δ₁ / 2) := by
      intro Y hY
      have hd := Metric.mem_ball.mp hY
      exact ⟨hρ_S (lt_trans hd hr₀_lt_ρS), hρ_J (lt_trans hd hr₀_lt_ρJ)⟩
    have h_ev_Gk : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop,
        k ≥ K₀ ∧ k ≥ K_p ∧
        (∀ Y ∈ B_r₀, L.F_seq k Y ∈ Metric.ball S₀ δ₁ ∧ Δ_seq k Y ∈ Metric.ball J₀ δ₁) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_k k) B_r₀ := by
      have ev_K₀ := Filter.eventually_ge_atTop K₀
      have ev_Kp := Filter.eventually_ge_atTop K_p
      have ev_F := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hF_unif_Br₀) (δ₁ / 2) (by positivity)
      have ev_Δ := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hΔ_unif_Br₀) (δ₁ / 2) (by positivity)
      filter_upwards [ev_K₀, ev_Kp, ev_F, ev_Δ] with k hkK₀ hkKp hkF hkΔ
      have h_in : ∀ Y ∈ B_r₀, L.F_seq k Y ∈ Metric.ball S₀ δ₁ ∧ Δ_seq k Y ∈ Metric.ball J₀ δ₁ := by
        intro Y hY
        obtain ⟨hSY, hdSY⟩ := hS_Br₀_in Y hY
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          calc dist (L.F_seq k Y) S₀
              ≤ dist (L.F_seq k Y) (L.S_star Y) + dist (L.S_star Y) S₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ < δ₁ / 2 + δ₁ / 2 := add_lt_add (by simpa [dist_comm] using hkF Y hY) hSY
            _ = δ₁ := add_halves δ₁
        · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
          calc dist (Δ_seq k Y) J₀
              ≤ dist (Δ_seq k Y) (deriv L.S_star Y) + dist (deriv L.S_star Y) J₀ :=
                dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ < δ₁ / 2 + δ₁ / 2 := add_lt_add (by simpa [dist_comm] using hkΔ Y hY) hdSY
            _ = δ₁ := add_halves δ₁
      have hFk_Br₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (L.F_seq k) B_r₀ :=
        (hK₀ k hkK₀).1.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
      exact ⟨hkK₀, hkKp, h_in,
        h_comp_holo_k k hkKp B_r₀ (L.F_seq k) (Δ_seq k) Metric.isOpen_ball hFk_Br₀
          (hΔ_holo k hkK₀) h_in⟩
    have hdJ_ucont : UniformContinuousOn
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => p_inf (q.1, J')) q.2) K_δ₁ :=
      hKδ₁_comp.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hdJ_inf_cont
    have hG_unif_Br₀ : TendstoUniformlyOn G_k G_inf Filter.atTop B_r₀ := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε_G hε_G
      obtain ⟨δ_G, hδ_G_pos, hδ_G⟩ :=
        Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hdJ_ucont (ε_G / 2) (by positivity)
      have ev_dJ := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hdJ_unif) (ε_G / 2) (by positivity)
      have ev_F := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hF_unif_Br₀) δ_G hδ_G_pos
      have ev_Δ := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hΔ_unif_Br₀) δ_G hδ_G_pos
      filter_upwards [h_ev_Gk, ev_dJ, ev_F, ev_Δ] with k hk_ev hkdJ hkF hkΔ Y hY
      have hq_k : (L.F_seq k Y, Δ_seq k Y) ∈ K_δ₁ :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hk_ev.2.2.1 Y hY).1,
          Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hk_ev.2.2.1 Y hY).2⟩
      have hq_inf : (L.S_star Y, deriv L.S_star Y) ∈ K_δ₁ :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (hS_Br₀_in Y hY).1),
          Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (hS_Br₀_in Y hY).2)⟩
      have h_dist_q : dist (L.F_seq k Y, Δ_seq k Y) (L.S_star Y, deriv L.S_star Y) < δ_G := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        exact ⟨by simpa [dist_comm] using hkF Y hY, by simpa [dist_comm] using hkΔ Y hY⟩
      have h1 : ‖deriv (fun J' => p_seq k (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y) -
          deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y)‖ < ε_G / 2 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hkdJ _ hq_k
      have h2 : ‖deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y) -
          deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.S_star Y, J')) (deriv L.S_star Y)‖ < ε_G / 2 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ_G _ hq_k _ hq_inf h_dist_q
      have htri := dist_triangle
        (deriv (fun J' => p_seq k (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y))
        (deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.F_seq k Y, J')) (Δ_seq k Y))
        (deriv (fun J' => p_inf (L.S_star Y, J')) (deriv L.S_star Y))
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at htri
      rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
      dsimp [G_k, G_inf]
      linarith
    have hG_loc : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn G_k G_inf Filter.atTop B_r₀ :=
      hG_unif_Br₀.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
    have hG_ev_holo : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_k k) B_r₀ :=
      h_ev_Gk.mono fun _ hk => hk.2.2.2
    have hG_inf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_inf B_r₀ :=
      hG_loc.differentiableOn hG_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball
    let K_half : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall Y₀ (r₀ / 2)
    have hK_half_sub : K_half ⊆ B_r₀ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hdG_unif_half : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun k Y => deriv (G_k k) Y) (deriv G_inf) Filter.atTop K_half :=
      (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
        (hG_loc.deriv hG_ev_holo Metric.isOpen_ball) K_half hK_half_sub
        (isCompact_closedBall Y₀ (r₀ / 2))

    
    let D_quo : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => (G_k k Y₀ - G_k k (Y₀ - a_seq k)) / a_seq k
    let R_rhs : ℕ → ℂ :=
      fun k => deriv (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀)
    have hY₀_Br₀ : Y₀ ∈ B_r₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos
    have h_ev_eq : D_quo =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] R_rhs := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_Gk] with k ⟨hkK₀, hkKp, h_in_k, _⟩
      obtain ⟨_, h_rec_k⟩ := (hK₀ k hkK₀).2
      have h_rec_Y₀ := h_rec_k Y₀ hY₀_Br₀
      let n := L.φ k
      let ℓ_c : ℂ := (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)
      let m_c : ℂ := (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
      let t_k : ℂ := L.T_star / m_c
      have hℓ_ne : ℓ_c ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (seq.ℓ_pos n).ne'
      have hm_ne : m_c ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (seq.m_pos n).ne'
      have hΔ_prev : Δ_seq k (Y₀ - a_seq k) =
          (L.F_seq k Y₀ - L.F_seq k (Y₀ - a_seq k)) / a_seq k := by
        dsimp [Δ_seq]
        rw [sub_add_cancel]
      have h_diff_Gk : G_k k Y₀ - G_k k (Y₀ - a_seq k) =
          t_k * deriv (fun s' =>
            P.p_act s' (Δ_seq k Y₀) t_k) (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) := by
        dsimp [G_k, p_seq]
        rw [hΔ_prev]
        have hr : deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) J' t_k) (Δ_seq k Y₀) -
            t_k * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (Δ_seq k Y₀) t_k) (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) =
            deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k (Y₀ - a_seq k)) J' t_k)
              ((L.F_seq k Y₀ - L.F_seq k (Y₀ - a_seq k)) / a_seq k) := h_rec_Y₀
        linear_combination hr
      let φ_inv : ℂ → ℂ := fun s' => (s' - s_base n) / ℓ_c
      have h_pact_eq : (fun s' : ℂ => P.p_act s' (Δ_seq k Y₀) t_k) =
          fun s' : ℂ => p_seq k (φ_inv s', Δ_seq k Y₀) := by
        ext s'
        dsimp [p_seq, φ_inv]
        have hs' : s_base n + ℓ_c * ((s' - s_base n) / ℓ_c) = s' := by
          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_ne, add_sub_cancel]
        rw [hs']
      have hφ_curr : φ_inv (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) = L.F_seq k Y₀ := by
        dsimp [φ_inv]
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hℓ_ne]
      obtain ⟨hFY₀_in, hΔY₀_in⟩ := h_in_k Y₀ hY₀_Br₀
      have hFY₀_2δ₁ : L.F_seq k Y₀ ∈ Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ₁) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hFY₀_in
      have hΔY₀_2δ₁ : Δ_seq k Y₀ ∈ Metric.ball J₀ (2 * δ₁) :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hΔY₀_in
      have h_slice_S_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (Metric.ball S₀ (2 * δ₁)) :=
        (hp_seq_holo k hkKp).comp
          (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn
          (fun _ hS' => ⟨hS', hΔY₀_2δ₁⟩)
      have hd_outer : HasDerivAt (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (R_rhs k) (L.F_seq k Y₀) :=
        (h_slice_S_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hFY₀_2δ₁)).hasDerivAt
      have hd_inner : HasDerivAt φ_inv (ℓ_c⁻¹) (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) := by
        have h1 : φ_inv = fun s' : ℂ => (s' - s_base n) * ℓ_c⁻¹ := by
          ext s'; dsimp [φ_inv]; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        rw [h1]
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀)).sub_const (s_base n)).mul_const
          (ℓ_c⁻¹)
      have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (fun s' => p_seq k (φ_inv s', Δ_seq k Y₀))
          (R_rhs k * ℓ_c⁻¹) (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) := by
        have hd_outer' : HasDerivAt (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (R_rhs k)
            (φ_inv (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀)) := by
          rwa [hφ_curr]
        exact hd_outer'.comp (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) hd_inner
      have h_deriv_chain : deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (Δ_seq k Y₀) t_k)
          (s_base n + ℓ_c * L.F_seq k Y₀) = R_rhs k * ℓ_c⁻¹ := by
        rw [h_pact_eq, hd_comp.deriv]
      have h_tk_ak : t_k * ℓ_c⁻¹ = a_seq k := by
        dsimp [t_k, a_seq, ℓ_c, m_c, n]
        push_cast
        field_simp [hℓ_ne, hm_ne]
      have h_prod_ak : t_k * (R_rhs k * ℓ_c⁻¹) = a_seq k * R_rhs k := by
        rw [← h_tk_ak]; ring
      dsimp [D_quo]
      rw [h_diff_Gk, h_deriv_chain, h_prod_ak, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ha_ne k)]

    
    have hD_tend_lhs : Filter.Tendsto D_quo Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv G_inf Y₀)) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε_D hε_D
      have hdG_cont_Y₀ : ContinuousAt (deriv G_inf) Y₀ :=
        (hG_inf_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball).continuousOn.continuousAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY₀_Br₀)
      obtain ⟨δ_D, hδ_D_pos, hδ_D⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hdG_cont_Y₀ (ε_D / 3) (by positivity)
      have ev_a := ha_tend0.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (lt_min (by positivity : 0 < r₀ / 2) hδ_D_pos))
      have ev_dG := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hdG_unif_half) (ε_D / 3) (by positivity)
      obtain ⟨K_start, hK_start⟩ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hG_ev_holo.and (ev_a.and ev_dG))
      refine ⟨K_start, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hGk_holo, hka, hkdG⟩ := hK_start k hk
      have ha_r2 : ‖a_seq k‖ < r₀ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hka (min_le_left _ _)
      have ha_δ : ‖a_seq k‖ < δ_D := lt_of_lt_of_le hka (min_le_right _ _)
      have h_sec := h_secant_bound (G_k k) B_r₀ Metric.isOpen_ball hGk_holo
        (Y₀ - a_seq k) (a_seq k) (deriv G_inf Y₀) (2 * ε_D / 3) (ha_ne k) (fun θ hθ => by
          have h1_sub_nn : 0 ≤ 1 - θ := by linarith [hθ.2]
          have h_dist_le : ‖(Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k - Y₀‖ ≤ ‖a_seq k‖ := by
            have h_eq : (Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k - Y₀ =
                -(((1 - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * a_seq k) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [h_eq, norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h1_sub_nn]
            calc (1 - θ) * ‖a_seq k‖ ≤ 1 * ‖a_seq k‖ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hθ.1]) (norm_nonneg _)
              _ = ‖a_seq k‖ := one_mul _
          have hz_half : (Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k ∈ K_half := by
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            exact le_trans h_dist_le ha_r2.le
          refine ⟨hK_half_sub hz_half, ?_⟩
          have h1 : ‖deriv (G_k k) ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) -
              deriv G_inf ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k)‖ < ε_D / 3 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hkdG _ hz_half
          have h_dist_δ : dist ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) Y₀ < δ_D := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]
            exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_le ha_δ
          have h2 : ‖deriv G_inf ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k) - deriv G_inf Y₀‖ <
              ε_D / 3 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ_D h_dist_δ
          have htri := dist_triangle
            (deriv (G_k k) ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k))
            (deriv G_inf ((Y₀ - a_seq k) + (θ : ℂ) * a_seq k)) (deriv G_inf Y₀)
          rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at htri
          linarith)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h_sec
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_sec (by linarith)

    
    have hR_tend_rhs : Filter.Tendsto R_rhs Filter.atTop
        (nhds (deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', J₀)) S₀)) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε_R hε_R
      have hdS_ucont : UniformContinuousOn
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', q.2)) q.1) K_δ₁ :=
        hKδ₁_comp.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hdS_inf_cont
      obtain ⟨δ_R, hδ_R_pos, hδ_R⟩ :=
        Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hdS_ucont (ε_R / 2) (by positivity)
      have ev_dS := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hdS_unif) (ε_R / 2) (by positivity)
      have ev_F := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hF_unif_Br₀) δ_R hδ_R_pos
      have ev_Δ := (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hΔ_unif_Br₀) δ_R hδ_R_pos
      obtain ⟨K_r, hK_r⟩ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (h_ev_Gk.and (ev_dS.and (ev_F.and ev_Δ)))
      refine ⟨K_r, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hk_ev, hkdS, hkF, hkΔ⟩ := hK_r k hk
      have hq_k : (L.F_seq k Y₀, Δ_seq k Y₀) ∈ K_δ₁ :=
        ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hk_ev.2.2.1 Y₀ hY₀_Br₀).1,
          Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hk_ev.2.2.1 Y₀ hY₀_Br₀).2⟩
      have hq₀ : (S₀, J₀) ∈ K_δ₁ :=
        ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall_self hδ₁_pos.le, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hδ₁_pos.le⟩
      have h_dist_q : dist (L.F_seq k Y₀, Δ_seq k Y₀) (S₀, J₀) < δ_R := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
        exact ⟨by simpa [S₀, dist_comm] using hkF Y₀ hY₀_Br₀,
          by simpa [J₀, dist_comm] using hkΔ Y₀ hY₀_Br₀⟩
      have h1 : ‖deriv (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀) -
          deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀)‖ < ε_R / 2 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hkdS _ hq_k
      have h2 : ‖deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀) -
          deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', J₀)) S₀‖ < ε_R / 2 := by
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hδ_R _ hq_k _ hq₀ h_dist_q
      have htri := dist_triangle
        (deriv (fun S' => p_seq k (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀))
        (deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', Δ_seq k Y₀)) (L.F_seq k Y₀))
        (deriv (fun S' => p_inf (S', J₀)) S₀)
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm] at htri
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      dsimp [R_rhs]
      linarith

    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hD_tend_lhs (hR_tend_rhs.congr' h_ev_eq.symm)

  clear h_bivar_toolkit h_secant_bound

  
  have hEL_mid : ∀ Y₀ ∈ { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) },
      deriv (fun Y' =>
        deriv (fun J' =>
          frozenActionP kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y')) J')
          (deriv L.S_star Y')) Y₀ =
      deriv (fun S' =>
        frozenActionP kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S'))
          (deriv L.S_star Y₀))
        (L.S_star Y₀) := by
    intro Y₀ hY₀
    obtain ⟨hBall2, _, _, hu_lt, hReg⟩ := hMid_props Y₀ hY₀.1 hY₀.2
    exact h_s3 Y₀ hBall2 hu_lt hReg
  clear h_s3

  obtain ⟨hInf_open, hInf_conv⟩ := h_cone_open_conv D₀ (A + 2)
  obtain ⟨hMid_open, hMid_conv⟩ := h_cone_open_conv D₁ (A + 1)
  have hD₁_pos : 0 < D₁ := lt_trans hD₀ hD₀_lt_D₁
  have hMid_sub_Inf :
      { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } ⊆
      { Y : ℂ | D₀ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 2) * (-Y.im) } := by
    intro Y hY
    have him : D₀ < -Y.im := lt_trans hD₀_lt_D₁ hY.1
    have him_pos : 0 < -Y.im := lt_trans hD₀ him
    exact ⟨him, lt_trans hY.2 (by nlinarith)⟩
  have hS_holo_mid :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ L.S_star { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } :=
    L.S_star_holo.mono hMid_sub_Inf
  have hdS_holo_mid :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv L.S_star) { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } :=
    (L.S_star_holo.deriv hInf_open).mono hMid_sub_Inf
  have hu_holo_mid :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun Y => L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y) * deriv L.S_star Y / 2)
        { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } := by
    have hexp := Complex.differentiable_exp.comp_differentiableOn
      ((differentiableOn_const (-Complex.I)).mul hS_holo_mid)
    exact DifferentiableOn.div
      (((differentiableOn_const (L.T_star * seq.c₀)).mul hexp).mul hdS_holo_mid)
      (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)) (fun _ _ => two_ne_zero)
  have hu_maps_mid :
      Set.MapsTo
        (fun Y => L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y) * deriv L.S_star Y / 2)
        { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
    intro Y hY
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact (hMid_props Y hY.1 hY.2).2.2.2.1
  have hE_alt_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun Y => ((deriv L.S_star Y) ^ 3 / 12) *
          K_ker.G_ker (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y) *
            deriv L.S_star Y / 2))
        { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } := by
    have h12_ne : (12 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
    have h1 := DifferentiableOn.div (hdS_holo_mid.pow 3) (differentiableOn_const (12 : ℂ))
      (fun _ _ => h12_ne)
    exact h1.mul (K_ker.G_ker_holo.comp hu_holo_mid hu_maps_mid)
  have hE_eq_alt : ∀ Y ∈ { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) },
      frozenEnergyE kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y))
        (deriv L.S_star Y) =
      ((deriv L.S_star Y) ^ 3 / 12) *
        K_ker.G_ker (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y) *
          deriv L.S_star Y / 2) :=
    fun Y hY => K_ker.energy_eq _ _ (hMid_props Y hY.1 hY.2).2.2.2.1
  have hE_deriv0 :
      Set.EqOn
        (deriv (fun Y' =>
          frozenEnergyE kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y'))
            (deriv L.S_star Y')))
        0 { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } :=
    K_ker.legendre_deriv_zero _ L.S_star seq.c₀ L.T_star hMid_open hS_holo_mid
      (fun Y hY => (hMid_props Y hY.1 hY.2).2.2.2.1) hEL_mid
  have hE_eq_12 : ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) →
      frozenEnergyE kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star Y))
        (deriv L.S_star Y) = 1 / 12 := by
    have hE_holo_mid := hE_alt_holo.congr hE_eq_alt
    have hE_const : ∀ {y₁ y₂ : ℂ},
        y₁ ∈ { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } →
        y₂ ∈ { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } →
        frozenEnergyE kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star y₁))
          (deriv L.S_star y₁) =
        frozenEnergyE kind (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star y₂))
          (deriv L.S_star y₂) :=
      hMid_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hMid_conv.isPreconnected hE_holo_mid hE_deriv0
    have hG_cont0 : ContinuousAt K_ker.G_ker (0 : ℂ) :=
      ContinuousOn.continuousAt K_ker.G_ker_holo.continuousOn
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (x := (0 : ℂ)) zero_lt_one))
    have hu_t0 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          L.T_star * seq.c₀ *
            Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
            deriv L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (hRay_lam.mul hRay_J).div_const (2 : ℂ)
    have hG_t1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          K_ker.G_ker
            (L.T_star * seq.c₀ *
              Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
              deriv L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
      rw [← K_ker.G_ker_zero]
      exact hG_cont0.tendsto.comp hu_t0
    have h_alt_tend : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun m : ℕ =>
          ((deriv L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ 3 / 12) *
            K_ker.G_ker
              (L.T_star * seq.c₀ *
                Complex.exp (-Complex.I * L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
                deriv L.S_star (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 12 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa using ((hRay_J.pow 3).div_const (12 : ℂ)).mul hG_t1
    have hYm_mid : ∀ m : ℕ,
        -((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈
          { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im ∧ |Y.re| < (A + 1) * (-Y.im) } := by
      intro m
      have him : -(-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 := by simp
      have hre : (-((D₁ + (m : ℝ) + 3 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = 0 := by simp
      refine ⟨by rw [him]; linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) m], ?_⟩
      rw [hre, him, abs_zero]
      positivity
    have hE_Ym_tend := h_alt_tend.congr fun m => (hE_eq_alt _ (hYm_mid m)).symm
    intro Y hY1 hY2
    have hY_mid : Y ∈ { Z : ℂ | D₁ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A + 1) * (-Z.im) } := ⟨hY1, hY2⟩
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique
      (tendsto_const_nhds.congr fun m => (hE_const (hYm_mid m) hY_mid).symm) hE_Ym_tend

  
  have h_eq_mid : ∀ Y ∈ { Z : ℂ | D₁ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A + 1) * (-Z.im) },
      L.S_star Y = Y + M_mod.Δ₀ (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) := by
    intro Y hY
    exact M_mod.cone_ode_uniqueness (L.T_star * seq.c₀) D₁ (A + 1) L.S_star
      hD₁_pos (by positivity) hS_holo_mid hRay_disp
      (fun Z hZ1 hZ2 =>
        let hZ := hMid_sub_Inf ⟨hZ1, hZ2⟩
        ⟨hw_mod_lt Z hZ.1 hZ.2,
         (hMid_props Z hZ1 hZ2).2.2.1,
         (hMid_props Z hZ1 hZ2).2.1,
         hE_eq_12 Z hZ1 hZ2⟩)
      Y hY.1 hY.2
  have hS_model_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun Y => Y + M_mod.Δ₀ (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)))
        { Z : ℂ | D₀ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A + 2) * (-Z.im) } := by
    have hw_diff : Differentiable ℂ
        (fun Y : ℂ => L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)) :=
      (differentiable_const (L.T_star * seq.c₀)).mul
        (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp ((differentiable_const (-Complex.I)).mul differentiable_id))
    refine differentiableOn_id.add (M_mod.Δ₀_holo.comp hw_diff.differentiableOn ?_)
    intro Y hY
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hw_mod_lt Y hY.1 hY.2
  let z₀ : ℂ := -(((D₁ + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hz₀_mid : z₀ ∈ { Z : ℂ | D₁ < -Z.im ∧ |Z.re| < (A + 1) * (-Z.im) } := by
    refine ⟨by simp [z₀], ?_⟩
    have him : -z₀.im = D₁ + 1 := by simp [z₀]
    have hre : z₀.re = 0 := by simp [z₀]
    rw [hre, him, abs_zero]
    positivity
  have h_ev_z₀ :
      L.S_star =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
        (fun Y => Y + M_mod.Δ₀ (L.T_star * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hMid_open.mem_nhds hz₀_mid) h_eq_mid
  have h_eq_inf :=
    (L.S_star_holo.analyticOnNhd hInf_open).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
      (hS_model_holo.analyticOnNhd hInf_open) hInf_conv.isPreconnected
      (hMid_sub_Inf hz₀_mid) h_ev_z₀
  intro Y hY_im hY_re
  exact h_eq_inf ⟨hY_im, hY_re⟩

signature.name: ref_steep_action_perturbation_jets
signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X) :

proof.tactics:
by
  let b₁ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (1, (0, 0))
  let b₂ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (0, (1, 0))
  let b₃ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (0, (0, 1))
  have hb_eq : ∀ u₁ u₂ u₃ : ℂ, u₁ • b₁ + u₂ • b₂ + u₃ • b₃ = (u₁, (u₂, u₃)) := by
    intro u₁ u₂ u₃
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_) <;> simp [b₁, b₂, b₃]

  have h_actA_comp : ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
      (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ) (W : Set E) (f₁ f₂ f₃ : E → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₃ W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ‖f₁ x - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖f₂ x - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖f₃ x‖ < r_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => refSteepActionA P (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x)) W := by
    intro E _ _ z₀ r_s r_t W f₁ f₂ f₃ hP hf₁ hf₂ hf₃ hMaps
    let tup : E → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun x => f₁ x • b₁ + f₂ x • b₂ + f₃ x • b₃
    have htup_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ tup W :=
      ((hf₁.smul_const b₁).add (hf₂.smul_const b₂)).add (hf₃.smul_const b₃)
    have htup_maps : Set.MapsTo tup W (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [show tup x = (f₁ x, (f₂ x, f₃ x)) from hb_eq (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x)]
      exact hMaps x hx
    have hp_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => P.p_act (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x)) W := by
      refine (hP.comp htup_diff htup_maps).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def, tup]
      rw [hb_eq (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x)]
    have hcub_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * (f₂ x) ^ 3) W :=
      (differentiableOn_const (1 / 24 : ℂ)).mul (hf₂.pow 3)
    refine (hp_diff.sub hcub_diff).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    change P.p_act (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x) - (f₂ x) ^ 3 / 24 =
      P.p_act (f₁ x) (f₂ x) (f₃ x) - (1 / 24 : ℂ) * (f₂ x) ^ 3
    ring

  have h_actA_cont : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α]
      (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ) (S : Set α) (g₁ g₂ g₃ : α → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ContinuousOn g₁ S →
      ContinuousOn g₂ S →
      ContinuousOn g₃ S →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ‖g₁ x - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖g₂ x - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖g₃ x‖ < r_t) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => refSteepActionA P (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x)) S := by
    intro α _ z₀ r_s r_t S g₁ g₂ g₃ hP hg₁ hg₂ hg₃ hMaps
    let tup : α → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun x => g₁ x • b₁ + g₂ x • b₂ + g₃ x • b₃
    have htup_cont : ContinuousOn tup S :=
      ((hg₁.smul continuousOn_const).add (hg₂.smul continuousOn_const)).add
        (hg₃.smul continuousOn_const)
    have htup_maps : Set.MapsTo tup S (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [show tup x = (g₁ x, (g₂ x, g₃ x)) from hb_eq (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x)]
      exact hMaps x hx
    have hp_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x => P.p_act (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x)) S := by
      refine (hP.continuousOn.comp htup_cont htup_maps).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [Function.comp_def, tup]
      rw [hb_eq (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x)]
    have hcub_cont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * (g₂ x) ^ 3) S :=
      continuousOn_const.mul (hg₂.pow 3)
    refine (hp_cont.sub hcub_cont).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    change P.p_act (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x) - (g₂ x) ^ 3 / 24 =
      P.p_act (g₁ x) (g₂ x) (g₃ x) - (1 / 24 : ℂ) * (g₂ x) ^ 3
    ring

  have hDiffA_J_on : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t)
        (Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4)) := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP s t hs ht
    exact h_actA_comp z₀ r_s r_t (Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 4))
      (fun _ => s) id (fun _ => t) hP
      (differentiableOn_const s) differentiableOn_id (differentiableOn_const t)
      (fun J' hJ' => ⟨hs, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hJ', ht⟩)

  have hDiffA_s_on : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ J t : ℂ, ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t)
        (Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 4)) := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP J t hJ ht
    exact h_actA_comp z₀ r_s r_t (Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 4))
      id (fun _ => J) (fun _ => t) hP
      differentiableOn_id (differentiableOn_const J) (differentiableOn_const t)
      (fun s' hs' => ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hs', hJ, ht⟩)

  have hDiffA_J : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t) J := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht
    exact (hDiffA_J_on z₀ r_s r_t hP s t hs ht).differentiableAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hJ))

  have hDiffA_s : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t) s := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht
    exact (hDiffA_s_on z₀ r_s r_t hP J t hJ ht).differentiableAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hs))

  have hP_split : ∀ s J' t : ℂ,
      P.p_act s J' t = (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3 + refSteepActionA P s J' t := by
    intro s J' t
    dsimp [refSteepActionA]
    ring

  have hP_deriv_J : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      deriv (fun J' : ℂ => P.p_act s J' t) J =
        (1 / 8 : ℂ) * J ^ 2 + refSteepActionDJ P s J t := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht
    have hd_cub : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3) ((1 / 8 : ℂ) * J ^ 2) J := by
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_pow 3 J).const_mul (1 / 24 : ℂ)
      convert h1 using 1
      ring
    have hd_act : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s J' t)
        (refSteepActionDJ P s J t) J :=
      (hDiffA_J z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht).hasDerivAt
    have hd_sum := hd_cub.add hd_act
    have h_fn : (fun J' : ℂ => P.p_act s J' t) =
        (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J' ^ 3 + refSteepActionA P s J' t) := by
      ext J'
      exact hP_split s J' t
    rw [h_fn]
    exact hd_sum.deriv

  have hP_deriv_s : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      deriv (fun s' : ℂ => P.p_act s' J t) s = refSteepActionDS P s J t := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht
    have hd_act : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' J t)
        (refSteepActionDS P s J t) s :=
      (hDiffA_s z₀ r_s r_t hP s J t hs hJ ht).hasDerivAt
    have hd_sum : HasDerivAt
        (fun s' : ℂ => (1 / 24 : ℂ) * J ^ 3 + refSteepActionA P s' J t)

  have hConj1 : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)

            t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J t) s_0) -
          deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t _hr_s _hr_t hP s_m J_m s_0 t J hsm hJm hs0 hJ ht
    rw [hP_deriv_J z₀ r_s r_t hP s_0 J t hs0 hJ ht,
        hP_deriv_s z₀ r_s r_t hP s_0 J t hs0 hJ ht,

  have h_param_holo : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F q.1 q.2) (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W) →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F τ) W) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ τ in a..b, F τ p) W := by
    intro a b W F hW hCont hHolo p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := ε / 3
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have h2r_lt : 2 * r < ε := by dsimp only [r]; linarith
    have h2r_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball h2r_lt).trans hε_sub
    have hK_compact : IsCompact (Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r)) :=
      isCompact_uIcc.prod (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * r))
    have hK_sub : Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ Set.uIcc a b ×ˢ W :=

    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hCont.mono hK_sub)
    let M : ℝ := max C₀ 0

      intro τ hτ q hq

      intro p hp q hq

      have hp' : dist p p₀ < r := hp
      have hq' : dist q p < r := hq
      linarith [dist_triangle q p p₀]
    have hs_sub : s ⊆ W := fun p hp =>
      h2r_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
        (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith [Metric.mem_ball.mp hp])))
    have h_slice_cont : ∀ p ∈ W, ContinuousOn (fun τ : ℝ => F τ p) (Set.uIcc a b) := fun p hp =>
      hCont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn (fun τ hτ => ⟨hτ, hp⟩)

    have hμ_le : μ₀ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIcc a b) :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc le_rfl
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => F τ p) μ₀ := by
      filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp

      intro n

      simpa [h, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h0

      ((h n)⁻¹ • (F τ (p₀ + h n • e₂) - F τ p₀)) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ
    have hg_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (g_seq n) μ₀ := by
      intro n

        (continuousOn_const (c := (h n)⁻¹)).smul

      have hc2 : ContinuousOn

        (hc1.smul (continuousOn_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ))).add

    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) μ₀ := by
      refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hg_meas ?_
      filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with τ hτ_ioc
      have hτ : τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ_ioc
      have hFD : HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀) p₀ :=

        (hasLineDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp (hFD.hasLineDerivAt e₁)).comp hh_tendsto
      have ht2 :=

        (ht1.smul_const _).add (ht2.smul_const _)

          (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ e₂) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ = fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀ := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun ⟨v₁, v₂⟩ => ?_)
        have hv : ((v₁, v₂) : ℂ × ℂ) = v₁ • e₁ + v₂ • e₂ := by ext <;> simp [e₁, e₂]
        conv_rhs => rw [hv, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_add, (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p₀).map_smul,

      rwa [hL_eq] at ht_sum
    have h_fderiv_bound : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b, ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r := by
      intro τ hτ p hp
      have hball_sub : Metric.ball p r ⊆ W := fun q hq => h2r_sub (hs_2r p hp q hq)

    have h_ae_bound :
        ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℂ (F τ) p‖ ≤ 2 * M / r :=

        ∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIoc a b → ∀ p ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (F τ) (fderiv ℂ (F τ) p) p :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ hτ p hp =>

      (𝕜 := ℂ) (F := fun p τ => F τ p) (F' := fun p τ => fderiv ℂ (F τ) p)

            (((circleMap z₀ R_s θ - s_fn p) ^ 2)⁻¹ *
              refSteepActionA P (circleMap z₀ R_s θ) (J_fn p) p.2))
      have hFS_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => F_s q.1 q.2)
          (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) := by
        have hc_deriv : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap z₀ R_s) q.1) := by
          rw [show (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => deriv (circleMap z₀ R_s) q.1) =
              fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap 0 R_s q.1 * Complex.I by
            ext q; exact deriv_circleMap z₀ R_s q.1]
          exact ((continuous_circleMap 0 R_s).comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_const
        have hc_cm : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => circleMap z₀ R_s q.1) :=
          (continuous_circleMap z₀ R_s).comp continuous_fst
        have hc_s : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => s_fn q.2)
            (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
          hs_holo.continuousOn.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hq => hq.2)
        have hc_J : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => J_fn q.2)
            (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
          hJ_holo.continuousOn.comp continuous_snd.continuousOn (fun _ hq => hq.2)
        have hc_t : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => q.2.2)
            (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
          (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
        have hc_act : ContinuousOn
            (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => refSteepActionA P (circleMap z₀ R_s q.1) (J_fn q.2) q.2.2)
            (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
          h_actA_cont z₀ r_s r_t (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀)
            (fun q => circleMap z₀ R_s q.1) (fun q => J_fn q.2) (fun q => q.2.2) hP
            hc_cm.continuousOn hc_J hc_t (fun q hq => h_mapsS q.1 q.2 hq.2)
        have hc_inv : ContinuousOn
            (fun q : ℝ × (ℂ × ℂ) => ((circleMap z₀ R_s q.1 - s_fn q.2) ^ 2)⁻¹)
            (Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ B₀) :=
          ContinuousOn.inv₀
            ((hc_cm.continuousOn.sub hc_s).pow 2)
            (fun q hq => h_subS_ne q.1 q.2 hq.2)
        exact continuousOn_const.mul (hc_deriv.continuousOn.mul (hc_inv.mul hc_act))
      have hFS_holo : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_s θ) B₀ := by
        intro θ _
        have hd_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((circleMap z₀ R_s θ - s_fn p) ^ 2)⁻¹) B₀ :=
          DifferentiableOn.inv
            (((differentiableOn_const (circleMap z₀ R_s θ)).sub hs_holo).pow 2)
            (fun p hp => h_subS_ne θ p hp)
        have hd_act : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionA P (circleMap z₀ R_s θ) (J_fn p) p.2) B₀ :=
          h_actA_comp z₀ r_s r_t B₀ (fun _ => circleMap z₀ R_s θ) J_fn Prod.snd hP
            (differentiableOn_const _) hJ_holo differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
            (fun p hp => h_mapsS θ p hp)
        exact (differentiableOn_const _).mul ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hd_inv.mul hd_act))
      have hIntS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_s θ p) B₀ :=
        h_param_holo 0 (2 * Real.pi) B₀ F_s hB₀_open hFS_cont hFS_holo
      refine hIntS_holo.congr (fun p hp => ?_)
      have hJ_p : ‖J_fn p - 1‖ < 1 / 4 := by linarith [(hB₀_bounds p hp).2.1]
      have hs_in_Rs : s_fn p ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R_s := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        dsimp only [R_s]
        linarith [(hB₀_bounds p hp).1]
      have hcl_subS : Metric.closedBall z₀ R_s ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 4) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp only [R_s]; linarith)
      have hCauchy := (Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_sq_inv_smul_of_differentiable
        Metric.isOpen_ball hcl_subS
        (hDiffA_s_on z₀ r_s r_t hP (J_fn p) p.2 hJ_p (hB₀_bounds p hp).2.2)
        hs_in_Rs).symm
      change deriv (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionA P s' (J_fn p) p.2) (s_fn p) =
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_s θ p
      rw [hCauchy, circleIntegral_def_Icc, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, ← intervalIntegral.integral_smul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
      simp [F_s, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

  have hConj3 : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (s_fn J_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ s_fn U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ J_fn U →
      (∀ p₀ ∈ U, ∃ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s ∧ 0 < r_t ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) ∧
        ‖s_fn p₀ - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖J_fn p₀ - 1‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ ‖p₀.2‖ < r_t) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDS P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U := by
    intro U s_fn J_fn hU_open hs_holo hJ_holo hLoc
    have h_both : ∀ p₀ ∈ U,
        DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U p₀ ∧
        DifferentiableWithinAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDS P (s_fn p) (J_fn p) p.2) U p₀ := by
      intro p₀ hp₀
      obtain ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hr_s, hr_t, hP, hs₀, hJ₀, ht₀⟩ := hLoc p₀ hp₀
      let B₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        (U ∩ s_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 8)) ∩
          ((U ∩ J_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) ∩
            Prod.snd ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t)
      have hB₀_open : IsOpen B₀ :=
        (hs_holo.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU_open Metric.isOpen_ball).inter
          ((hJ_holo.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hU_open Metric.isOpen_ball).inter
            (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage continuous_snd))
      have hB₀_sub : B₀ ⊆ U := fun _ hp => hp.1.1
      have hp₀_B₀ : p₀ ∈ B₀ :=
        ⟨⟨hp₀, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hs₀⟩,
         ⟨hp₀, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hJ₀⟩,
         by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht₀⟩
      have hB₀_bounds : ∀ p ∈ B₀,
          ‖s_fn p - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧ ‖J_fn p - 1‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_t := by
        intro p hp
        exact ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1.2,
               by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.2.1.2,
               by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.2.2⟩
      obtain ⟨hDJ_B₀, hDS_B₀⟩ :=
        h_local_jets B₀ s_fn J_fn z₀ r_s r_t hB₀_open hr_s hr_t hP
          (hs_holo.mono hB₀_sub) (hJ_holo.mono hB₀_sub) hB₀_bounds
      exact ⟨(hDJ_B₀.differentiableAt (hB₀_open.mem_nhds hp₀_B₀)).differentiableWithinAt,
             (hDS_B₀.differentiableAt (hB₀_open.mem_nhds hp₀_B₀)).differentiableWithinAt⟩
    exact ⟨fun p₀ hp₀ => (h_both p₀ hp₀).1, fun p₀ hp₀ => (h_both p₀ hp₀).2⟩

  have hDiffG_J : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s_0 t J : ℂ, ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s_0 t J hs₀ hJ ht
    let U_J : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t
    have hUJ_open : IsOpen U_J := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    obtain ⟨hDJ_UJ, hDS_UJ⟩ :=
      h_local_jets U_J (fun _ => s_0) Prod.fst z₀ r_s r_t hUJ_open hr_s hr_t hP
        (differentiableOn_const s_0) differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
        (fun p hp =>
          ⟨hs₀,
           by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1,
           by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.2⟩)
    let ι_J : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun J' => (J', t)
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_J :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)
    have hι_maps : Set.MapsTo ι_J (Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8)) U_J :=
      fun _ hJ' => ⟨hJ', by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht⟩
    have hJ_nhds : Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 8) ∈ nhds J :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hJ)
    have hDJ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J' t) J :=
      (hDJ_UJ.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn hι_maps).differentiableAt hJ_nhds
    have hDS_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun J' : ℂ => refSteepActionDS P s_0 J' t) J :=
      (hDS_UJ.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn hι_maps).differentiableAt hJ_nhds
    exact hDJ_at.sub (hDS_at.const_mul t)

  have hDiffDJ_s : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s' : ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P s' J t) s := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s J t hs hJ ht
    let U_s : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 8) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_t
    have hUs_open : IsOpen U_s := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    obtain ⟨hDJ_Us, _⟩ :=
      h_local_jets U_s Prod.fst (fun _ => J) z₀ r_s r_t hUs_open hr_s hr_t hP
        differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (differentiableOn_const J)
        (fun p hp =>
          ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1,
           hJ,
           by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.2⟩)
    let ι_s : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun s' => (s', t)
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_s :=
      differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t)
    have hι_maps : Set.MapsTo ι_s (Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 8)) U_s :=
      fun _ hs' => ⟨hs', by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht⟩
    have hs_nhds : Metric.ball z₀ (r_s / 8) ∈ nhds s :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hs)
    exact (hDJ_Us.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn hι_maps).differentiableAt hs_nhds

  have hConj2 : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t : ℝ), 0 < r_s → 0 < r_t →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ∀ s_m J_m s_0 t J : ℂ,
        ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
        HasDerivAt (fun J' => refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J')
          ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J + deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J) J := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s_m J_m s_0 t J hs₀ hJ ht
    have hd_quad : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (J' ^ 2 - J_m ^ 2))
        ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * J) J := by
      have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 J).sub_const (J_m ^ 2)).const_mul (1 / 8 : ℂ)
      convert h1 using 1
      ring
    have hd_G : HasDerivAt (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t)
        (deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J) J :=
      (hDiffG_J z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s_0 t J hs₀ hJ ht).hasDerivAt
    simpa [refSteepResidual] using
      (hd_quad.add hd_G).sub_const (refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t)

  have h_cauchy_closed : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R C : ℝ),
      0 < R →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ C) →
      ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ C / R := by
    intro f c R C hR hf_diff hf_bnd
    have hf_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.closedBall c R) :=
      fun z hz => (hf_diff z hz).differentiableWithinAt
    have hf_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) :=
      hf_on.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl
    exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR hf_dc
      (fun z hz => hf_bnd z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))

  have hConj4 : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t ρ_s M_a : ℝ) (s_m s_0 J_m t : ℂ),
      0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 0 < ρ_s → 0 ≤ M_a →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (refSteepPolydisk z₀ r_s r_t) →
      ‖J_m - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 32 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s,
          ‖s' - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧
          ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
            ‖refSteepActionA P s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a) →
      (∀ J ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
        ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤
          4096 * M_a + 64 * ‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s) ∧
      ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J_m t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s ∧
      ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J_m t - refSteepActionDJ P s_m J_m t‖ ≤
        (32 * M_a / ρ_s) * ‖s_0 - s_m‖ := by
    intro z₀ r_s r_t ρ_s M_a s_m s_0 J_m t hr_s hr_t hρ_s _hM_a hP hJm ht hBound
    have hJm_in3 : J_m ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    have hJm_lt8 : ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 8 := by linarith
    have hBound0 : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall s_0 ρ_s,
        ‖s' - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧
        ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
          ‖refSteepActionA P s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a := by
      intro s' hs'
      have hθ1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
      have hs'_1 :
          s' ∈ Metric.closedBall ((1 - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * s_m + ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * s_0) ρ_s := by
        simpa using hs'
      exact hBound 1 hθ1 s' hs'_1
    have hs0_self : s_0 ∈ Metric.closedBall s_0 ρ_s := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_s.le
    have hs0_lt8 : ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 := (hBound0 s_0 hs0_self).1
    have hs0_lt4 : ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 := by linarith
    have hDS_s0 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
        ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s := by
      intro J₁ hJ₁
      have hJ₁_lt4 : ‖J₁ - 1‖ < 1 / 4 := by
        have : ‖J₁ - 1‖ ≤ 3 / 32 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hJ₁
        linarith
      exact h_cauchy_closed (fun s' => refSteepActionA P s' J₁ t) s_0 ρ_s M_a hρ_s
        (fun s' hs' =>
          hDiffA_s z₀ r_s r_t hP s' J₁ t (by linarith [(hBound0 s' hs').1]) hJ₁_lt4 ht)
        (fun s' hs' => (hBound0 s' hs').2 J₁ hJ₁)
    refine ⟨?_, hDS_s0 J_m hJm_in3, ?_⟩
    · intro J hJ
      have hJ_dist1 : ‖J - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
        have hJ_Jm : ‖J - J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hJ
        calc ‖J - 1‖ = ‖(J - J_m) + (J_m - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖J - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 / 16 := by linarith
      let r_J : ℝ := 1 / 64
      have hr_J : 0 < r_J := by norm_num
      have hJ1_dist1 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J, ‖J₁ - 1‖ ≤ 5 / 64 := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        have hJ₁_J : ‖J₁ - J‖ ≤ r_J := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hJ₁
        calc ‖J₁ - 1‖ = ‖(J₁ - J) + (J - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖J₁ - J‖ + ‖J - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 5 / 64 := by dsimp only [r_J] at hJ₁_J; linarith
      have hJ1_in3 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J,
          J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32) := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        linarith [hJ1_dist1 J₁ hJ₁]
      have hJ1_lt8 : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J, ‖J₁ - 1‖ < 1 / 8 := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        linarith [hJ1_dist1 J₁ hJ₁]
      have hG_bnd : ∀ J₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall J r_J,
          ‖refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t J₁‖ ≤ M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) := by
        intro J₁ hJ₁
        have hz_in3 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall J₁ r_J,
            z ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32) := by
          intro z hz
          have hz_J₁ : ‖z - J₁‖ ≤ r_J := by
            simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
          have hJ₁_1 : ‖J₁ - 1‖ ≤ 5 / 64 := hJ1_dist1 J₁ hJ₁
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          calc ‖z - 1‖ = ‖(z - J₁) + (J₁ - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖z - J₁‖ + ‖J₁ - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 3 / 32 := by dsimp only [r_J] at hz_J₁; linarith
        have hDJ_J1 : ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / r_J :=
          h_cauchy_closed (fun z => refSteepActionA P s_0 z t) J₁ r_J M_a hr_J
            (fun z hz => by
              have hz3 : ‖z - 1‖ ≤ 3 / 32 := by
                simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz_in3 z hz
              exact hDiffA_J z₀ r_s r_t hP s_0 z t hs0_lt4 (by linarith) ht)
            (fun z hz => (hBound0 s_0 hs0_self).2 z (hz_in3 z hz))
        have hDS_J1 : ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J₁ t‖ ≤ M_a / ρ_s :=
          hDS_s0 J₁ (hJ1_in3 J₁ hJ₁)
        calc ‖refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t J₁‖
            = ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J₁ t - t * refSteepActionDS P s_0 J₁ t‖ := rfl
          _ ≤ ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J₁ t‖ + ‖t * refSteepActionDS P s_0 J₁ t‖ :=
              norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = ‖refSteepActionDJ P s_0 J₁ t‖ + ‖t‖ * ‖refSteepActionDS P s_0 J₁ t‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s) :=
              add_le_add hDJ_J1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDS_J1 (norm_nonneg t))
      have h_raw : ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J‖ ≤
          (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) / r_J :=
        h_cauchy_closed (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) J r_J
          (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) hr_J
          (fun J₁ hJ₁ => hDiffG_J z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s_0 t J₁ hs0_lt8 (hJ1_lt8 J₁ hJ₁) ht)
          hG_bnd
      have h_alg : (M_a / r_J + ‖t‖ * (M_a / ρ_s)) / r_J =
          4096 * M_a + 64 * ‖t‖ * M_a / ρ_s := by
        dsimp only [r_J]
        field_simp [hρ_s.ne']
        ring
      rwa [h_alg] at h_raw
    · let h_DJ : ℂ → ℂ := fun s' => refSteepActionDJ P s' J_m t
      have hz_Jm_in3 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
          z ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz ⊢
        calc ‖z - 1‖ = ‖(z - J_m) + (J_m - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 3 / 32 := by linarith
      have h_seg_data : ∀ σ ∈ segment ℝ s_m s_0,
          DifferentiableAt ℂ h_DJ σ ∧ ‖deriv h_DJ σ‖ ≤ 32 * M_a / ρ_s := by
        intro σ hσ
        rw [segment_eq_image ℝ s_m s_0] at hσ
        rcases hσ with ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩
        set c_θ : ℂ := (1 - θ) • s_m + θ • s_0
        have hc_eq : c_θ = (1 - (θ : ℂ)) * s_m + (θ : ℂ) * s_0 := by
          simp [c_θ, Complex.real_smul]
        have hBθ : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s,
            ‖s' - z₀‖ < r_s / 8 ∧
            ∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall (1 : ℂ) (3 / 32),
              ‖refSteepActionA P s' J' t‖ ≤ M_a := by
          intro s' hs'
          rw [hc_eq] at hs'
          exact hBound θ hθ s' hs'
        have hc_self : c_θ ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_s.le
        have h_diff_σ : DifferentiableAt ℂ h_DJ c_θ :=
          hDiffDJ_s z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP c_θ J_m t (hBθ c_θ hc_self).1 hJm_lt8 ht
        have h_DJ_ball : ∀ s' ∈ Metric.closedBall c_θ ρ_s, ‖h_DJ s'‖ ≤ 32 * M_a := by
          intro s' hs'
          have h_raw_s :=
            h_cauchy_closed (fun z => refSteepActionA P s' z t) J_m (1 / 32) M_a (by norm_num)
              (fun z hz => by
                have hz3 : ‖z - 1‖ ≤ 3 / 32 := by
                  simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz_Jm_in3 z hz
                exact hDiffA_J z₀ r_s r_t hP s' z t (by linarith [(hBθ s' hs').1])
                  (by linarith) ht)
              (fun z hz => (hBθ s' hs').2 z (hz_Jm_in3 z hz))
          have h32 : M_a / (1 / 32 : ℝ) = 32 * M_a := by ring
          rwa [h32] at h_raw_s
        have h_deriv_σ : ‖deriv h_DJ c_θ‖ ≤ 32 * M_a / ρ_s :=
          h_cauchy_closed h_DJ c_θ ρ_s (32 * M_a) hρ_s
            (fun s' hs' => hDiffDJ_s z₀ r_s r_t hr_s hr_t hP s' J_m t (hBθ s' hs').1 hJm_lt8 ht)
            h_DJ_ball
        exact ⟨h_diff_σ, h_deriv_σ⟩
      exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun σ hσ => (h_seg_data σ hσ).1)
        (fun σ hσ => (h_seg_data σ hσ).2)
        (convex_segment s_m s_0)
        (left_mem_segment ℝ s_m s_0)
        (right_mem_segment ℝ s_m s_0)

  exact ⟨hConj1, hConj2, hConj3, hConj4⟩

(X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)

signature.name: ref_steep_holomorphic_step_solver
signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (hJets : RefSteepJetProp X P) :
    RefSteepSolverProp X P

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_core : ∀ s_m s_0 t : ℂ,
      IsRefSteepContractivePt X P s_m s_0 t →
      let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
      let J_p := refSteepSolJ P s_m s_0 t
      (∀ n : ℕ, refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t n ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ‖refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t n - refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t (n + 1)‖ ≤
        (1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t) Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) ∧
      ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t J_m‖ ∧
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J_p -
        t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_p t) s_0 =
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m ∧
      (∀ J' ∈ Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32),
        deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_0 J'' t) J' -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J' t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_m J'' t) J_m →
        J' = J_p) := by
    intro s_m s_0 t hPt
    rcases hPt with
      ⟨_, hJm_one, ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hrs_pos, hrt_pos, hHolo, hsm_z₀, hs0_z₀, ht_rt⟩,
        hG_ball, hres_init⟩
    let J_m : ℂ := (s_0 - s_m) / t
    let R : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => refSteepResidual P s_m J_m s_0 t w
    let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w - (4 : ℂ) * R w
    let u : ℕ → ℂ := refSteepIterJ P s_m s_0 t
    let J_p : ℂ := refSteepSolJ P s_m s_0 t
    let B : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall J_m (1 / 32)
    have hw_one : ∀ w ∈ B, ‖w - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_dist : ‖w - J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      calc ‖w - 1‖ = ‖(w - J_m) + (J_m - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖w - J_m‖ + ‖J_m - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 1 / 32 + 1 / 32 := add_le_add hw_dist hJm_one
        _ = 1 / 16 := by norm_num
    have hT_hasDeriv : ∀ w ∈ B,
        HasDerivAt T (-(w - 1) - (4 : ℂ) * deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_lt : ‖w - 1‖ < 1 / 8 := lt_of_le_of_lt (hw_one w hw) (by norm_num)
      have hR_d : HasDerivAt R ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * w + deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w) w :=
        hJets.2.1 z₀ r_s r_t hrs_pos hrt_pos hHolo s_m J_m s_0 t w hs0_z₀ hw_lt ht_rt
      have hT_raw : HasDerivAt T
          (1 - (4 : ℂ) * ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * w + deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w)) w :=
        (hasDerivAt_id w).sub (hR_d.const_mul (4 : ℂ))
      convert hT_raw using 1
      ring
    have hT_deriv_le : ∀ w ∈ B, ‖deriv T w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [(hT_hasDeriv w hw).deriv]
      have hG_le : ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := hG_ball w hw
      have hw1 : ‖w - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 16 := hw_one w hw
      have h4 : ‖(4 : ℂ) * deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖ =
          4 * ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        norm_num
      calc ‖-(w - 1) - (4 : ℂ) * deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖
          ≤ ‖-(w - 1)‖ + ‖(4 : ℂ) * deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖w - 1‖ + 4 * ‖deriv (refSteepPerturbG P s_0 t) w‖ := by rw [norm_neg, h4]
        _ ≤ 1 / 16 + 4 * (1 / 32) := by linarith
        _ ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    have hT_lip : ∀ w₁ ∈ B, ∀ w₂ ∈ B, ‖T w₂ - T w₁‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w₂ - w₁‖ := by
      intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂
      exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun w hw => (hT_hasDeriv w hw).differentiableAt)
        hT_deriv_le (convex_closedBall J_m (1 / 32)) hw₁ hw₂
    have hJm_mem : J_m ∈ B := Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by norm_num)
    have hTJm_sub : T J_m - J_m = -(4 : ℂ) * R J_m := by
      dsimp [T]
      ring
    have hTJm_norm : ‖T J_m - J_m‖ = 4 * ‖R J_m‖ := by
      rw [hTJm_sub, norm_mul]
      norm_num
    have hT_maps : ∀ w ∈ B, T w ∈ B := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hw_dist : ‖w - J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 32 := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
      have h1 : ‖T w - T J_m‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w - J_m‖ := hT_lip J_m hJm_mem w hw
      calc ‖T w - J_m‖ = ‖(T w - T J_m) + (T J_m - J_m)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖T w - T J_m‖ + ‖T J_m - J_m‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 32) + 4 * (1 / 256) := by
            have : ‖T J_m - J_m‖ ≤ 4 * (1 / 256) := by linarith [hTJm_norm, hres_init]
            linarith
        _ = 1 / 32 := by norm_num
    have hu_zero : u 0 = J_m := rfl
    have hu_succ : ∀ n : ℕ, u (n + 1) = T (u n) := fun _ => rfl
    have hu_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, u n ∈ B := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact hJm_mem
      | succ n ih => rw [hu_succ]; exact hT_maps (u n) ih
    have hu_step : ∀ n : ℕ, dist (u n) (u (n + 1)) ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        rw [hu_zero, hu_succ, hu_zero, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, hTJm_norm, pow_zero, mul_one]
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [hu_succ n, hu_succ (n + 1), dist_eq_norm]
        calc ‖T (u n) - T (u (n + 1))‖
            ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖ :=
              hT_lip (u (n + 1)) (hu_mem (n + 1)) (u n) (hu_mem n)
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist (u n) (u (n + 1)) := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by norm_num)
          _ = (4 * ‖R J_m‖) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
    have hu_step64 : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖u n - u (n + 1)‖ ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro n
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      have h4 : 4 * ‖R J_m‖ ≤ 1 / 64 := by linarith [hres_init]
      exact le_trans (hu_step n) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 (by positivity))
    have hu_cauchy : CauchySeq u :=
      cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2 : ℝ) (4 * ‖R J_m‖) (by norm_num) hu_step
    have hu_lim : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) :=
      hu_cauchy.tendsto_limUnder
    have hJp_mem : J_p ∈ B :=
      Metric.isClosed_closedBall.mem_of_tendsto hu_lim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu_mem)
    have hJp_dist : ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ 8 * ‖R J_m‖ := by
      have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto₀ (1 / 2 : ℝ) (4 * ‖R J_m‖)
        (by norm_num) hu_step hu_lim
      rw [hu_zero, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hd
      calc ‖J_p - J_m‖ ≤ (4 * ‖R J_m‖) / (1 - 1 / 2) := hd
        _ = 8 * ‖R J_m‖ := by ring
    have hT_Jp : T J_p = J_p := by
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u (n + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds J_p) :=
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hu_lim
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => T (u n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (T J_p)) :=
        (hT_hasDeriv J_p hJp_mem).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hu_lim
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h1
    have hR_Jp : R J_p = 0 := by
      have hsub : J_p - (4 : ℂ) * R J_p = J_p := hT_Jp
      have h40 : (4 : ℂ) * R J_p = 0 := by linear_combination -hsub
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h40).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    have hsm_4 : ‖s_m - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 := by linarith
    have hs0_4 : ‖s_0 - z₀‖ < r_s / 4 := by linarith
    have hJm_4 : ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 4 := lt_of_le_of_lt hJm_one (by norm_num)
    have hR_eq : ∀ w ∈ B,
        R w = (deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) w -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' w t) s_0) -
          deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m := by
      intro w hw
      exact hJets.1 z₀ r_s r_t hrs_pos hrt_pos hHolo s_m J_m s_0 t w
        hsm_4 hJm_4 hs0_4 (lt_of_le_of_lt (hw_one w hw) (by norm_num)) ht_rt
    have hRec_Jp :
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_0 J' t) J_p -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_p t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_m J' t) J_m := by
      have h0 := hR_eq J_p hJp_mem
      rw [hR_Jp] at h0
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0.symm
    have hUniq : ∀ J' ∈ B,
        deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_0 J'' t) J' -
          t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J' t) s_0 =
          deriv (fun J'' => P.p_act s_m J'' t) J_m →
        J' = J_p := by
      intro J' hJ'_mem hJ'_eq
      have hRJ' : R J' = 0 := by
        rw [hR_eq J' hJ'_mem]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hJ'_eq
      have hTJ' : T J' = J' := by
        dsimp [T]
        rw [hRJ', mul_zero, sub_zero]
      have hlip := hT_lip J_p hJp_mem J' hJ'_mem
      rw [hTJ', hT_Jp] at hlip
      have hnorm0 : ‖J' - J_p‖ = 0 := by linarith [norm_nonneg (J' - J_p)]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm0)
    exact ⟨hu_mem, hu_step64, hu_lim, hJp_dist, hRec_Jp, hUniq⟩
  refine ⟨fun s_m s_0 t hPt => (h_core s_m s_0 t hPt).2.2.2, ?_⟩
  intro U s_m s_0 hU hs_m hs_0 hContr
  let v : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n p => refSteepIterJ P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2 n
  let v_inf : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => refSteepSolJ P (s_m p) (s_0 p) p.2
  let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toFun := fun p => p.2
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun c p => by simp
      cont := continuous_snd }
  have hsnd : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) U := π₂.differentiableOn
  have hv0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (v 0) U := by
    have hinv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.2)⁻¹) U :=
      hsnd.inv (fun p hp => (hContr p hp).1)
    exact ((hs_0.sub hs_m).mul hinv).congr (fun p _ => div_eq_mul_inv (s_0 p - s_m p) p.2)
  have hDJ_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ
      (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepActionDJ P (s_m p) (v 0 p) p.2) U := by
    refine (hJets.2.2.1 U s_m (v 0) hU hs_m hv0 ?_).1
    intro p₀ hp₀
    rcases hContr p₀ hp₀ with ⟨_, hJm_one, ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hrs, hrt, hHolo, hsm_z₀, _, ht_rt⟩, _, _⟩
    exact ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hrs, hrt, hHolo, hsm_z₀, lt_of_le_of_lt hJm_one (by norm_num), ht_rt⟩
  have hv_holo : ∀ n : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (v n) U := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hv0
    | succ n ih =>
      have hJet_n := hJets.2.2.1 U s_0 (v n) hU hs_0 ih (by
        intro p₀ hp₀
        have hvn_mem := (h_core (s_m p₀) (s_0 p₀) p₀.2 (hContr p₀ hp₀)).1 n
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hvn_mem
        rcases hContr p₀ hp₀ with
          ⟨_, hJm_one, ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hrs, hrt, hHolo, _, hs0_z₀, ht_rt⟩, _, _⟩
        have hvn_one : ‖v n p₀ - 1‖ < 1 / 8 := by
          calc ‖v n p₀ - 1‖ = ‖(v n p₀ - v 0 p₀) + (v 0 p₀ - 1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖v n p₀ - v 0 p₀‖ + ‖v 0 p₀ - 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ 1 / 32 + 1 / 32 := add_le_add hvn_mem hJm_one
            _ < 1 / 8 := by norm_num
        exact ⟨z₀, r_s, r_t, hrs, hrt, hHolo, hs0_z₀, hvn_one, ht_rt⟩)
      have hquad : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (1 / 8 : ℂ) * (v n p ^ 2 - v 0 p ^ 2)) U :=
        ((ih.pow 2).sub (hv0.pow 2)).const_mul (1 / 8 : ℂ)
      have hG_n : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepPerturbG P (s_0 p) p.2 (v n p)) U :=
        hJet_n.1.sub (hsnd.mul hJet_n.2)
      have hRes_n : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => refSteepResidual P (s_m p) (v 0 p) (s_0 p) p.2 (v n p)) U :=
        (hquad.add hG_n).sub hDJ_m
      exact ih.sub (hRes_n.const_mul (4 : ℂ))
  have hslice1 : ∀ y t : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, t)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) y := by
    intro y t
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id y).smul_const ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))).add
      (hasDerivAt_const y ((0 : ℂ), t))
    convert h using 1
    · ext ξ <;> simp
    · ext <;> simp
  have hslice2 : ∀ y t : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (y, ζ)) ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) t := by
    intro y t
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const t (y, (0 : ℂ))).add
      ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))
    convert h using 1
    · ext ζ <;> simp
    · ext <;> simp
  have hfderiv_2d : ∀ (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ g (y, t) →
      ‖fderiv ℂ g (y, t)‖ ≤
        ‖deriv (fun ξ => g (ξ, t)) y‖ + ‖deriv (fun ζ => g (y, ζ)) t‖ := by
    intro g y t hg
    let L := fderiv ℂ g (y, t)
    have hL1 : deriv (fun ξ => g (ξ, t)) y = L (1, 0) :=
      (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y (hslice1 y t)).deriv
    have hL2 : deriv (fun ζ => g (y, ζ)) t = L (0, 1) :=
      (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hslice2 y t)).deriv
    rw [hL1, hL2]
    refine L.opNorm_le_bound (by positivity) (fun h => ?_)
    have hh_eq : h = h.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + h.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    have hLh : L h = h.1 • L (1, 0) + h.2 • L (0, 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hh_eq]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    have hh1 : ‖h.1‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := norm_fst_le h
    have hh2 : ‖h.2‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := norm_snd_le h
    calc ‖L h‖ = ‖h.1 • L (1, 0) + h.2 • L (0, 1)‖ := by rw [hLh]
      _ ≤ ‖h.1 • L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h.2 • L (0, 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖h.1‖ * ‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h.2‖ * ‖L (0, 1)‖ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul]
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ * ‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖h‖ * ‖L (0, 1)‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh1 (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh2 (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = (‖L (1, 0)‖ + ‖L (0, 1)‖) * ‖h‖ := by ring
  intro p₀ hp₀
  obtain ⟨R_open, hR_pos, hBall_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU p₀ hp₀
  let r₀ : ℝ := R_open / 3
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by dsimp [r₀]; positivity
  let P₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball p₀ r₀
  have hP₀_sub : P₀ ⊆ U := by
    intro q hq
    apply hBall_sub
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq ⊢
    dsimp [r₀] at hq
    linarith
  have hfderiv_step : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ p ∈ P₀,
      dist (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) (fderiv ℂ (v (n + 1)) p) ≤
        (1 / (32 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n p hp
    let d_n : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => v n q - v (n + 1) q
    have hd_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d_n U := (hv_holo n).sub (hv_holo (n + 1))
    have hp_dist : dist p p₀ < r₀ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hp_dist
    rcases hp_dist with ⟨hp1_dist, hp2_dist⟩
    have h_s1_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun ξ : ℂ => (ξ, p.2)) (Metric.ball p₀.1 R_open) U := by
      intro ξ hξ
      apply hBall_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mp hξ, lt_trans hp2_dist (by dsimp [r₀]; linarith)⟩
    have h_s1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) (Metric.ball p₀.1 R_open) :=
      hd_holo.comp (fun ξ _ => (hslice1 ξ p.2).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) h_s1_maps
    have h_s1_cb : Metric.closedBall p.1 r₀ ⊆ Metric.ball p₀.1 R_open := by
      intro ξ hξ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hξ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have htri := dist_triangle ξ p.1 p₀.1
      dsimp [r₀] at hξ hp1_dist
      linarith
    have h_s1_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) (Metric.ball p.1 r₀) :=
      h_s1_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_s1_cb
    have h_s1_sph : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.sphere p.1 r₀,
        ‖d_n (ξ, p.2)‖ ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h_in_U : (ξ, p.2) ∈ U :=
        h_s1_maps (h_s1_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hξ))
      exact (h_core (s_m (ξ, p.2)) (s_0 (ξ, p.2)) p.2 (hContr (ξ, p.2) h_in_U)).2.1 n
    have h_deriv1 : ‖deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) p.1‖ ≤
        ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr₀_pos h_s1_dc h_s1_sph
    have h_s2_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun ζ : ℂ => (p.1, ζ)) (Metric.ball p₀.2 R_open) U := by
      intro ζ hζ
      apply hBall_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨lt_trans hp1_dist (by dsimp [r₀]; linarith), Metric.mem_ball.mp hζ⟩
    have h_s2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) (Metric.ball p₀.2 R_open) :=
      hd_holo.comp (fun ζ _ => (hslice2 p.1 ζ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) h_s2_maps
    have h_s2_cb : Metric.closedBall p.2 r₀ ⊆ Metric.ball p₀.2 R_open := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have htri := dist_triangle ζ p.2 p₀.2
      dsimp [r₀] at hζ hp2_dist
      linarith
    have h_s2_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) (Metric.ball p.2 r₀) :=
      h_s2_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_s2_cb
    have h_s2_sph : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere p.2 r₀,
        ‖d_n (p.1, ζ)‖ ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have h_in_U : (p.1, ζ) ∈ U :=
        h_s2_maps (h_s2_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ))
      exact (h_core (s_m (p.1, ζ)) (s_0 (p.1, ζ)) ζ (hContr (p.1, ζ) h_in_U)).2.1 n
    have h_deriv2 : ‖deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) p.2‖ ≤
        ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr₀_pos h_s2_dc h_s2_sph
    have hp_nhds : U ∈ nhds p := hU.mem_nhds (hP₀_sub hp)
    have hvn_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (v n) p := (hv_holo n).differentiableAt hp_nhds
    have hvn1_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (v (n + 1)) p := (hv_holo (n + 1)).differentiableAt hp_nhds
    have hd_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ d_n (p.1, p.2) := hvn_at.sub hvn1_at
    have h_fderiv_eq : fderiv ℂ (v n) p - fderiv ℂ (v (n + 1)) p = fderiv ℂ d_n (p.1, p.2) :=
      (fderiv_sub hvn_at hvn1_at).symm
    rw [dist_eq_norm, h_fderiv_eq]
    calc ‖fderiv ℂ d_n (p.1, p.2)‖
        ≤ ‖deriv (fun ξ => d_n (ξ, p.2)) p.1‖ + ‖deriv (fun ζ => d_n (p.1, ζ)) p.2‖ :=
          hfderiv_2d d_n p.1 p.2 hd_at
      _ ≤ ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ + ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) / r₀ :=
          add_le_add h_deriv1 h_deriv2
      _ = (1 / (32 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
  let g' : ℂ × ℂ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
    fun p => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => fderiv ℂ (v n) p)
  have hg'_lim : ∀ p ∈ P₀,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => fderiv ℂ (v n) p) Filter.atTop (nhds (g' p)) := by
    intro p hp
    have hc : CauchySeq (fun n => fderiv ℂ (v n) p) :=
      cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / (32 * r₀)) (by norm_num)
        (fun n => hfderiv_step n p hp)
    exact hc.tendsto_limUnder
  have hg'_tail : ∀ p ∈ P₀, ∀ n : ℕ,
      dist (g' p) (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) ≤ (1 / (16 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro p hp n
    rw [dist_comm]
    have hd := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2 : ℝ) (1 / (32 * r₀))
      (by norm_num) (fun k => hfderiv_step k p hp) (hg'_lim p hp) n
    calc dist (fderiv ℂ (v n) p) (g' p)
        ≤ (1 / (32 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n / (1 - 1 / 2) := hd
      _ = (1 / (16 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by ring
  have hunif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n p => fderiv ℂ (v n) p) g' Filter.atTop P₀ := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have h_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 / (16 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (1 / (16 * r₀))
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_zero) ε hε
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N, fun n hn p hp => ?_⟩
    have h_lt : (1 / (16 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n < ε := by
      have hd := hN n hn
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 / (16 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
      rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg] at hd
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hg'_tail p hp n) h_lt
  have hv_hasFDeriv : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ P₀, HasFDerivAt (v n) (fderiv ℂ (v n) x) x := by
    intro n x hx
    exact ((hv_holo n).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hP₀_sub hx))).hasFDerivAt
  have hv_ptwise : ∀ x ∈ P₀, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => v n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (v_inf x)) := by
    intro x hx
    exact (h_core (s_m x) (s_0 x) x.2 (hContr x (hP₀_sub hx))).2.2.1
  have h_lim_fderiv : HasFDerivAt v_inf (g' p₀) p₀ :=
    hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn Metric.isOpen_ball hunif hv_hasFDeriv
      hv_ptwise (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos)
  exact h_lim_fderiv.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

by

  · intro β x_start Δ M hβ hx hΔ
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (x_start + u) ^ (1 - β) / (1 - β)
    have h1β_neg : 1 - β < 0 := by linarith only [hβ]
    have h1β_ne : 1 - β ≠ 0 := h1β_neg.ne
    have hg_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → HasDerivAt g ((x_start + u) ^ (-β)) u := by

          Finset.mul_sum _ _ _

            have hsub : 1 - β = -(β - 1) := by ring

  · intro α γ_steep x₀ h_ref m_steep d δ_ceil Δ_slab r M_scale C_init s_init

    let ρ_slab : ℝ := Δ_slab / 32

    have h_cb_in_S : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,

        have h2 : (1 - θ) * (t.im / γ_steep) = (1 / γ_steep) * ((1 - θ) * t.im) := by ring

        exact le_trans h1 (h2 ▸ h3)

          linarith only [hw_im_top]

        exact le_trans hw_re_tri h_add
      have hz'_dep_gt_ρ : Δ_slab / 32 < h_ref - z'.im := by

      have hw_dep_lt_two : h_ref - w.im < 2 * (h_ref - z'.im) := by

      have hz'_re_tri : |z'.re - x₀| ≤ |z'.re - w.re| + |w.re - x₀| := by
        have h_split : z'.re - x₀ = (z'.re - w.re) + (w.re - x₀) := by ring

      have hz'_re_lt : |z'.re - x₀| < L_in * (h_ref - z'.im) := by

        have h_comb : |z'.re - x₀| <
            (2 * m_steep + 2 / γ_steep + 1) * (h_ref - z'.im) := by

informal_problem.statement:
(E : EntireNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : ChordActionPackage E.toExpStripData)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData E.toExpStripData kind)
    (α₀ C_ℓ C_cone : ℝ)
    (hα₁ : 1 / 2 < α₀) (hα₂ : α₀ < 1)
    (hCℓ : 0 < C_ℓ) (hCcone : 0 < C_cone)
    (h_bounds : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < seq.h_seq n ∧ seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ C_ℓ)
    (hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto seq.h_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hlog_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) / Real.log (seq.m_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (hCone : ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im → seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ seq.h_seq n →
      max ‖E.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖) ≤
        C_cone * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) :
    let s_base : ℝ := (3 / 4) * E.s_star
    let ρ_base : ℝ := min (E.r_star / 2) (P.r_rec / 2)
    ∃ (C_init : ℝ) (U_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N_shape : ℕ),
      1 ≤ C_init ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ U_base { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base } ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_base → ‖t‖ < ρ_base →
        E.𝔰 (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) ∧
        U_base (y, -t) = U_base (y, t) ∧
        ‖U_base (y, t)‖ ≤ C_init) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
            (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + seq.h_seq n))
        Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_shape, ∀ s : ℂ,
        seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im →
        seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ (3 / 2) * seq.h_seq n →
        ‖E.f s‖ ≤
          (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖ ≤
          (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)
