        C_cone * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) :
    let s_base : ℝ := (3 / 4) * E.s_star
    let ρ_base : ℝ := min (E.r_star / 2) (P.r_rec / 2)
    ∃ (C_init : ℝ) (U_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N_shape : ℕ),
      1 ≤ C_init ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ U_base { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base } ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_base → ‖t‖ < ρ_base →
        E.𝔰 (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) ∧
        U_base (y, -t) = U_base (y, t) ∧
        ‖U_base (y, t)‖ ≤ C_init) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
            (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + seq.h_seq n))
        Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_shape, ∀ s : ℂ,
        seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im →
        seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ (3 / 2) * seq.h_seq n →
        ‖E.f s‖ ≤
          (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ ∧
        Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖ ≤
          (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  dsimp only
  let s_base : ℝ := (3 / 4) * E.s_star
  let ρ_base : ℝ := min (E.r_star / 2) (P.r_rec / 2)
  have hs_star_pos : 0 < E.s_star := E.s_star_pos
  have hr_star_pos : 0 < E.r_star := E.r_star_pos
  have hr_rec_pos : 0 < P.r_rec := P.r_rec_pos
  have hr_rec_lt : P.r_rec < E.r_star := P.r_rec_lt
  have hs_base_pos : 0 < s_base := by dsimp [s_base]; positivity
  have hs_base_lt : s_base < E.s_star := by dsimp [s_base]; linarith
  have hρ_base_pos : 0 < ρ_base := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hρ_le_rrec : ρ_base ≤ P.r_rec / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hρ_lt_half : ρ_base < E.r_star / 2 := by linarith
  let s_mid : ℝ := (s_base + E.s_star) / 2
  have hs_base_lt_mid : s_base < s_mid := by dsimp [s_mid]; linarith
  have hs_mid_lt : s_mid < E.s_star := by dsimp [s_mid]; linarith
  let R_in : ℝ := (E.r_star / 2 - ρ_base) / 2
  let R₀ : ℝ := (ρ_base + E.r_star / 2) / 2
  let R_out : ℝ := (3 * ρ_base + E.r_star / 2) / 2
  let R_mid : ℝ := R_out + R_in
  have hR_in_pos : 0 < R_in := by dsimp [R_in]; linarith
  have hR₀_pos : 0 < R₀ := by dsimp [R₀]; linarith
  have hR₀_sub : R₀ - ρ_base = R_in := by dsimp [R₀, R_in]; ring
  have hR₀_add : R₀ + ρ_base = R_out := by dsimp [R₀, R_out]; ring
  have hR_out_lt_mid : R_out < R_mid := by dsimp [R_mid]; linarith
  have hR_mid_lt : R_mid < E.r_star := by dsimp [R_mid, R_out, R_in]; linarith
  have hR_out_lt : R_out < E.r_star := lt_trans hR_out_lt_mid hR_mid_lt
  let η₀ : ℝ := min ((E.s_star - s_base) / 4) (R_in / 4)
  have hη₀_pos : 0 < η₀ := lt_min (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hη₀_le_im : η₀ ≤ (E.s_star - s_base) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hη₀_le_rin : η₀ ≤ R_in / 4 := min_le_right _ _

  let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base }
  let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ | |q.1.im| < E.s_star ∧ R_in / 4 < ‖q.2‖ ∧ ‖q.2‖ < E.r_star }
  let f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => (E.𝔰 q - q.1) / q.2 ^ 2
  let c_ϕ : ℝ → ℂ × ℂ := fun ϕ => ((0 : ℂ), (R₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
  let U_base : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
    ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (p + c_ϕ ϕ)

  have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd)).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const))
  have hU₀_sub_T : U₀ ⊆ E.T := by
    intro q hq
    exact E.T_base_subset (Or.inl ⟨hq.1, hq.2.2⟩)
  have hf₀_num_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => E.𝔰 q - q.1) U₀ :=
    (E.𝔰_holo.mono hU₀_sub_T).sub differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
  have hf₀_den_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ 2) U₀ :=
    (by fun_prop : Differentiable ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => q.2 ^ 2)).differentiableOn
  have hf₀_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (q.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) U₀ := by
    refine hf₀_den_holo.inv ?_
    intro q hq
    have hq2_pos : 0 < ‖q.2‖ := lt_trans (by positivity) hq.2.1
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_pos_iff.mp hq2_pos)
  have hf₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ :=
    (hf₀_num_holo.mul hf₀_inv_holo).congr (fun _ _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ _)

  
  let δ_𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => E.𝔰 p - p.1
  have h_per_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y τ : ℂ), |y.im| < E.s_star → ‖τ‖ < E.r_star →
      δ_𝔰 (y + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ), τ) = δ_𝔰 (y, τ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro y τ _ _
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro y τ hy hτ
      set y_n : ℂ := y + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hy_n : |y_n.im| < E.s_star := by simpa [y_n] using hy
      have h_mem_T : (y_n, τ) ∈ E.T := E.T_base_subset (Or.inl ⟨hy_n, hτ⟩)
      have h_step : y + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          y_n + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [y_n]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_step]
      have hqp := E.𝔰_quasiperiodic y_n τ h_mem_T
      have h_eq : δ_𝔰 (y_n + 2 * Real.pi, τ) = δ_𝔰 (y_n, τ) := by
        dsimp [δ_𝔰]
        rw [hqp]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, ih y τ hy hτ]
  have h_per_int : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y τ : ℂ), |y.im| < E.s_star → ‖τ‖ < E.r_star →
      δ_𝔰 (y + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ), τ) = δ_𝔰 (y, τ) := by
    intro k y τ hy hτ
    rcases k with n | n
    · simpa using h_per_nat n y τ hy hτ
    · set y' : ℂ := y + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hy' : |y'.im| < E.s_star := by simpa [y'] using hy
      have h_back : y' + ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = y := by
        simp only [y', Int.cast_negSucc]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h1 := h_per_nat (n + 1) y' τ hy' hτ
      rw [h_back] at h1
      exact h1.symm

  let K_per : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ) :=
    (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-s_mid) s_mid) ×ˢ
      Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_mid
  have hK_comp : IsCompact K_per :=
    (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R_mid)
  let ψ : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => ((q.1.1 : ℂ) + (q.1.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I, q.2)
  have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
  have hψ_maps : Set.MapsTo ψ K_per E.T := by
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with ⟨⟨_, hq_im_lo, hq_im_hi⟩, hq_ball⟩
    have him : |(ψ q).1.im| < E.s_star := by
      have : (ψ q).1.im = q.1.2 := by simp [ψ]
      rw [this, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hτ_lt : ‖(ψ q).2‖ < E.r_star := by
      have hle : ‖q.2‖ ≤ R_mid := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hq_ball
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hR_mid_lt
    exact E.T_base_subset (Or.inl ⟨him, hτ_lt⟩)
  have hδ_cont : ContinuousOn δ_𝔰 E.T :=
    E.𝔰_holo.continuousOn.sub continuous_fst.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨M_per, hM_per⟩ :=
    hK_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hδ_cont.comp hψ_cont.continuousOn hψ_maps)
  let M_per' : ℝ := max M_per 0
  have hM_per'_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_per' := le_max_right _ _
  let C_init : ℝ := max 1 (M_per' / R_in ^ 2)
  have hC_init_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_init := le_max_left _ _

  have hδ_bdd : ∀ y τ : ℂ, |y.im| ≤ s_mid → ‖τ‖ ≤ R_mid → ‖δ_𝔰 (y, τ)‖ ≤ M_per' := by
    intro y τ hy hτ
    have h2pi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    let k : ℤ := ⌊y.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x₀ : ℝ := y.re - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hk_le : (k : ℝ) ≤ y.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
    have hk_lt : y.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hx₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ x₀ := by
      have := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_le
      linarith
    have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp hk_lt
      linarith
    let q₀ : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℂ := ((x₀, y.im), τ)
    have hq₀_mem : q₀ ∈ K_per := by
      refine ⟨⟨⟨hx₀_nonneg, hx₀_le⟩, abs_le.mp hy⟩, ?_⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hτ
    let y₀ : ℂ := (x₀ : ℂ) + (y.im : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hy₀_im : |y₀.im| < E.s_star := by
      have : y₀.im = y.im := by simp [y₀]
      rw [this]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hy hs_mid_lt
    have hτ_lt : ‖τ‖ < E.r_star := lt_of_le_of_lt hτ hR_mid_lt
    have hy_eq : y₀ + (((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) = y := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · simp [y₀, x₀]
      · simp [y₀]
    have h_per := h_per_int k y₀ τ hy₀_im hτ_lt
    rw [hy_eq] at h_per
    rw [h_per]
    exact le_trans (hM_per q₀ hq₀_mem) (le_max_left _ _)

  
  have h_circle_W : ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
      R_in < ‖p.2 + (R₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
      ‖p.2 + (R₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < R_out := by
    intro p hp ϕ
    set ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    set τ : ℂ := p.2 + (R₀ : ℂ) * ζ
    have hR₀ζ_norm : ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ = R₀ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hR₀_pos.le,
        Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    have h_sub_le : R₀ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖p.2‖ := by
      have h_eq : τ - p.2 = (R₀ : ℂ) * ζ := add_sub_cancel_left p.2 ((R₀ : ℂ) * ζ)
      calc R₀ = ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := hR₀ζ_norm.symm
        _ = ‖τ - p.2‖ := by rw [h_eq]
        _ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖p.2‖ := norm_sub_le τ p.2
    have h_add_le : ‖τ‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ + R₀ := by
      calc ‖τ‖ ≤ ‖p.2‖ + ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := norm_add_le p.2 ((R₀ : ℂ) * ζ)
        _ = ‖p.2‖ + R₀ := by rw [hR₀ζ_norm]
    have hp2 : ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base := hp.2
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  have h_ball_in : ∀ p₀ ∈ W, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀), ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
      q + c_ϕ ϕ ∈ U₀ ∧ ‖f₀ (q + c_ϕ ϕ)‖ ≤ 4 * C_init := by
    intro p₀ hp₀ q hq ϕ
    have hq_dist : max (dist q.1 p₀.1) (dist q.2 p₀.2) < 2 * η₀ := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq] using hq
    have hq1_dist : ‖q.1 - p₀.1‖ < 2 * η₀ := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hq_dist
    have hq2_dist : ‖q.2 - p₀.2‖ < 2 * η₀ := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hq_dist
    have hq1_im : |q.1.im| < s_mid := by
      have him_diff : |q.1.im - p₀.1.im| ≤ ‖q.1 - p₀.1‖ := by
        simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (q.1 - p₀.1)
      have him_tri : |q.1.im| ≤ |p₀.1.im| + |q.1.im - p₀.1.im| := by
        calc |q.1.im| = |p₀.1.im + (q.1.im - p₀.1.im)| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |p₀.1.im| + |q.1.im - p₀.1.im| := abs_add_le _ _
      have hp₀_1 : |p₀.1.im| < s_base := hp₀.1
      dsimp [s_mid]
      linarith
    have hq2_norm : ‖q.2‖ < ρ_base + R_in / 2 := by
      have hq2_tri : ‖q.2‖ ≤ ‖p₀.2‖ + ‖q.2 - p₀.2‖ := by
        calc ‖q.2‖ = ‖p₀.2 + (q.2 - p₀.2)‖ := by abel_nf
          _ ≤ ‖p₀.2‖ + ‖q.2 - p₀.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have hp₀_2 : ‖p₀.2‖ < ρ_base := hp₀.2
      linarith
    set ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    set τ : ℂ := q.2 + (R₀ : ℂ) * ζ
    have hqc_eq : q + c_ϕ ϕ = (q.1, τ) := Prod.ext (add_zero q.1) rfl
    have hR₀ζ_norm : ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ = R₀ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hR₀_pos.le,
        Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    have h_sub_le : R₀ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖q.2‖ := by
      have h_eq : τ - q.2 = (R₀ : ℂ) * ζ := add_sub_cancel_left q.2 ((R₀ : ℂ) * ζ)
      calc R₀ = ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := hR₀ζ_norm.symm
        _ = ‖τ - q.2‖ := by rw [h_eq]
        _ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖q.2‖ := norm_sub_le τ q.2
    have h_add_le : ‖τ‖ ≤ ‖q.2‖ + R₀ := by
      calc ‖τ‖ ≤ ‖q.2‖ + ‖(R₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := norm_add_le q.2 ((R₀ : ℂ) * ζ)
        _ = ‖q.2‖ + R₀ := by rw [hR₀ζ_norm]
    have hτ_lo : R_in / 2 < ‖τ‖ := by linarith
    have hτ_hi : ‖τ‖ < R_mid := by dsimp [R_mid]; linarith
    rw [hqc_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨lt_trans hq1_im hs_mid_lt, by linarith, lt_trans hτ_hi hR_mid_lt⟩, ?_⟩
    have h_num : ‖δ_𝔰 (q.1, τ)‖ ≤ M_per' := hδ_bdd q.1 τ hq1_im.le hτ_hi.le
    have h_den : (R_in / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖τ‖ ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hτ_lo.le 2
    have h_cinit_part : M_per' / R_in ^ 2 ≤ C_init := le_max_right _ _
    dsimp [f₀]
    rw [norm_div, norm_pow]
    calc ‖E.𝔰 (q.1, τ) - q.1‖ / ‖τ‖ ^ 2
        ≤ M_per' / ‖τ‖ ^ 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
      _ ≤ M_per' / (R_in / 2) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hM_per'_nonneg (by positivity) h_den
      _ = 4 * (M_per' / R_in ^ 2) := by
          field_simp [hR_in_pos.ne']
          ring
      _ ≤ 4 * C_init := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cinit_part (by norm_num)

  
  have hU_base_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_base W := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    have hc_cont : Continuous c_ϕ := by fun_prop
    let F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p ϕ => f₀ (p + c_ϕ ϕ)
    let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fun p ϕ => fderiv ℂ f₀ (p + c_ϕ ϕ)
    have hF_cont : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀), Continuous (F p) := by
      intro p hp
      exact hf₀_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_const.add hc_cont)
        (fun ϕ => (h_ball_in p₀ hp₀ p hp ϕ).1)
    have hp₀_mem2 : p₀ ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀) := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀,
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F p)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * η₀)] with p hp
      exact (hF_cont p hp).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (F p₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hF_cont p₀ hp₀_mem2).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) :=
      ((measurable_fderiv ℂ f₀).comp (continuous_const.add hc_cont).measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_sub2 : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ η₀, ∀ p' ∈ Metric.ball p η₀,
        p' ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀) := by
      intro p hp p' hp'
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp hp' ⊢
      calc dist p' p₀ ≤ dist p' p + dist p p₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < η₀ + η₀ := add_lt_add hp' hp
        _ = 2 * η₀ := by ring
    have h_has_fderiv : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀), ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun p' => F p' ϕ) (F' p ϕ) p := by
      intro p hp ϕ
      have hmem := (h_ball_in p₀ hp₀ p hp ϕ).1
      have hd := (hf₀_holo.differentiableAt (hU₀_open.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt.comp
        p ((hasFDerivAt_id p).add_const (c_ϕ ϕ))
      rwa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at hd
    have h_fderiv_int :=
      intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (𝕜 := ℂ) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        (s := Metric.ball p₀ η₀) (x₀ := p₀)
        (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi)
        (F := F) (F' := F') (bound := fun _ => 2 * (4 * C_init) / η₀)
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hη₀_pos)
        hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas
        (by
          refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ϕ _ p hp => ?_
          have hp2 : p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (2 * η₀) :=
            Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hp
          have hdiff_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p' => F p' ϕ) (Metric.ball p η₀) :=
            fun p' hp' =>
              (h_has_fderiv p' (h_sub2 p hp p' hp') ϕ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
          have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p' => F p' ϕ)
              (Metric.ball p η₀) (Metric.closedBall (F p ϕ) (2 * (4 * C_init))) := by
            intro p' hp'
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            have hb1 := (h_ball_in p₀ hp₀ p' (h_sub2 p hp p' hp') ϕ).2
            have hb2 := (h_ball_in p₀ hp₀ p hp2 ϕ).2
            calc ‖F p' ϕ - F p ϕ‖ ≤ ‖F p' ϕ‖ + ‖F p ϕ‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
              _ ≤ 4 * C_init + 4 * C_init := add_le_add hb1 hb2
              _ = 2 * (4 * C_init) := by ring
          rw [← (h_has_fderiv p hp2 ϕ).fderiv]
          exact Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hdiff_on hmaps hη₀_pos)
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ϕ _ p hp =>
          h_has_fderiv p (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hp) ϕ)
    exact ((h_fderiv_int.differentiableAt).const_mul (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)).differentiableWithinAt

  
  have h_div : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_base → ‖t‖ < ρ_base →
      E.𝔰 (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) := by
    intro y t hy ht
    have hy_lt : |y.im| < E.s_star := lt_trans hy hs_base_lt
    let B_r : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.r_star
    have hB_nhds : B_r ∈ nhds (0 : ℂ) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_star_pos)
    have h_slice_T : ∀ τ ∈ B_r, (y, τ) ∈ E.T := by
      intro τ hτ
      exact E.T_base_subset (Or.inl ⟨hy_lt, by simpa [B_r] using hτ⟩)
    let g_y : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => E.𝔰 (y, τ) - y
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_y B_r :=
      (E.𝔰_holo.comp ((differentiable_const y).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        (fun τ hτ => h_slice_T τ hτ)).sub (differentiable_const y).differentiableOn
    have hg0 : g_y 0 = 0 := by simp [g_y, E.𝔰_zero y]
    have hg_even : ∀ τ ∈ B_r, g_y (-τ) = g_y τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      dsimp [g_y]
      rw [E.𝔰_even y τ (h_slice_T τ hτ)]
    have hd_at : HasDerivAt g_y (deriv g_y 0) 0 :=
      (hg_holo.differentiableAt hB_nhds).hasDerivAt
    have hd_neg0 : HasDerivAt g_y (deriv g_y 0) (-(0 : ℂ)) := by simpa using hd_at
    have hd_comp : HasDerivAt (g_y ∘ Neg.neg) (deriv g_y 0 * (-1)) 0 :=
      hd_neg0.comp (0 : ℂ) (hasDerivAt_neg (0 : ℂ))
    have hd_alt : HasDerivAt g_y (deriv g_y 0 * (-1)) 0 :=
      hd_comp.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hB_nhds (fun τ hτ => (hg_even τ hτ).symm))
    have hderiv0 : deriv g_y 0 = 0 := by
      have heq : deriv g_y 0 = deriv g_y 0 * (-1) := hd_at.unique hd_alt
      have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * deriv g_y 0 = 0 := by
        calc (2 : ℂ) * deriv g_y 0
            = deriv g_y 0 - deriv g_y 0 * (-1) := by ring
          _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr heq
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    let d₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope g_y 0
    let h_y : ℂ → ℂ := dslope d₁ 0
    have hd₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ d₁ B_r :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hB_nhds).mpr hg_holo
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_y B_r :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hB_nhds).mpr hd₁_holo
    have hd₁0 : d₁ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [d₁]
      rw [dslope_same, hderiv0]
    have hh_mul : ∀ τ : ℂ, τ ^ 2 * h_y τ = E.𝔰 (y, τ) - y := by
      intro τ
      have h1 : τ * d₁ τ = g_y τ := by
        have := sub_smul_dslope g_y 0 τ
        simpa [d₁, hg0] using this
      have h2 : τ * h_y τ = d₁ τ := by
        have := sub_smul_dslope d₁ 0 τ
        simpa [h_y, hd₁0] using this
      calc τ ^ 2 * h_y τ
          = τ * (τ * h_y τ) := by ring
        _ = τ * d₁ τ := by rw [h2]
        _ = g_y τ := h1
        _ = E.𝔰 (y, τ) - y := rfl
    have h_cb : Metric.closedBall t R₀ ⊆ B_r := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_le : ‖z - t‖ ≤ R₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
      have hz_tri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖t‖ + ‖z - t‖ := by
        calc ‖z‖ = ‖t + (z - t)‖ := by abel_nf
          _ ≤ ‖t‖ + ‖z - t‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      change z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.r_star
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have h_eq_sph : ∀ τ ∈ Metric.sphere t |R₀|, f₀ (y, τ) = h_y τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hτ_eq : ‖τ - t‖ = R₀ := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm, abs_of_pos hR₀_pos] using hτ
      have h_sub_le : R₀ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖t‖ := by
        calc R₀ = ‖τ - t‖ := hτ_eq.symm
          _ ≤ ‖τ‖ + ‖t‖ := norm_sub_le τ t
      have hτ_pos : 0 < ‖τ‖ := by linarith
      have hτ_ne : τ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hτ_pos
      dsimp [f₀]
      rw [← hh_mul τ]
      exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ (h_y τ) (pow_ne_zero 2 hτ_ne)
    have hU_eq : U_base (y, t) = h_y t := by
      have h_avg_def :
          U_base (y, t) = Real.circleAverage (fun τ => f₀ (y, τ)) t R₀ := by
        dsimp [U_base]
        rw [Real.circleAverage_def, Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_inv]
        have hcmap : ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
            (y, t) + c_ϕ ϕ = (y, circleMap t R₀ ϕ) := by
          intro ϕ
          ext <;> simp [c_ϕ, circleMap]
        simp_rw [hcmap]
      rw [h_avg_def, Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_eq_sph,
        Real.circleAverage_eq_circleIntegral hR₀_pos.ne']
      have hcauchy := (hh_holo.mono h_cb).circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self hR₀_pos)
      rw [hcauchy, inv_smul_smul₀]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero
        (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero)) Complex.I_ne_zero
    rw [hU_eq]
    exact (hh_mul t).symm

  have hU_base_props : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_base → ‖t‖ < ρ_base →
      E.𝔰 (y, t) - y = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) ∧
      U_base (y, -t) = U_base (y, t) ∧
      ‖U_base (y, t)‖ ≤ C_init := by
    intro y t hy ht
    have h1 := h_div y t hy ht
    have h2 : U_base (y, -t) = U_base (y, t) := by
      by_cases ht0 : t = 0
      · simp [ht0]
      · have h_neg := h_div y (-t) hy (by simpa using ht)
        have hyt_T : (y, t) ∈ E.T :=
          E.T_base_subset (Or.inl ⟨lt_trans hy hs_base_lt, by linarith⟩)
        have h_ev := E.𝔰_even y t hyt_T
        have h_mul_eq : t ^ 2 * U_base (y, -t) = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) := by
          calc t ^ 2 * U_base (y, -t)
              = (-t) ^ 2 * U_base (y, -t) := by ring
            _ = E.𝔰 (y, -t) - y := h_neg.symm
            _ = E.𝔰 (y, t) - y := by rw [h_ev]
            _ = t ^ 2 * U_base (y, t) := h1
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 ht0) h_mul_eq
    have h3 : ‖U_base (y, t)‖ ≤ C_init := by
      have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      have hint :
          ‖∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ ((y, t) + c_ϕ ϕ)‖ ≤
            C_init * |2 * Real.pi - 0| := by
        refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const fun ϕ _ => ?_
        set τ : ℂ := t + (R₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        have hpt_eq : (y, t) + c_ϕ ϕ = (y, τ) := Prod.ext (add_zero y) rfl
        rw [hpt_eq]
        obtain ⟨hτ_lo, hτ_hi⟩ := h_circle_W (y, t) ⟨hy, ht⟩ ϕ
        have h_num : ‖δ_𝔰 (y, τ)‖ ≤ M_per' :=
          hδ_bdd y τ (lt_trans hy hs_base_lt_mid).le (lt_trans hτ_hi hR_out_lt_mid).le
        have h_den : R_in ^ 2 ≤ ‖τ‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hR_in_pos.le hτ_lo.le 2
        dsimp [f₀]
        rw [norm_div, norm_pow]
        calc ‖E.𝔰 (y, τ) - y‖ / ‖τ‖ ^ 2
            ≤ M_per' / ‖τ‖ ^ 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
          _ ≤ M_per' / R_in ^ 2 :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hM_per'_nonneg (pow_pos hR_in_pos 2) h_den
          _ ≤ C_init := le_max_right _ _
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos h2pi_pos] at hint
      dsimp [U_base]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_pos.le]
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ ((y, t) + c_ϕ ϕ)‖
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (C_init * (2 * Real.pi)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint (by positivity)
        _ = C_init := by field_simp [h2pi_pos.ne']
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

  
  let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n
  let η : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.log (Q n) / Real.log (seq.m_seq n)
  have hα_pos : 0 < α₀ := by linarith
  have hm_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, 2 ≤ seq.m_seq n :=
    seq.m_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop 2
  have hh_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
    hh_tendsto.eventually_ge_atTop 1
  have hη_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, |η n| < 1 / (4 * α₀) := by
    have hd := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hlog_tendsto) (1 / (4 * α₀)) (by positivity)
    refine hd.mono ?_
    intro n hn
    rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hn

  have h_rpow_Q : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ seq.m_seq n → (seq.m_seq n) ^ (η n) = Q n := by
    intro n hm2
    have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
    have hh_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n := (h_bounds n).1
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n := seq.ℓ_pos n
    have hQ_pos : 0 < Q n := by dsimp [Q]; positivity
    have hlog_pos : 0 < Real.log (seq.m_seq n) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    calc (seq.m_seq n) ^ (η n)
        = Real.exp (Real.log (seq.m_seq n) * η n) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos hm_pos (η n)
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log (Q n)) := by
          congr 1
          dsimp [η]
          exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hlog_pos.ne'
      _ = Q n := Real.exp_log hQ_pos

  have hlim1 : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h_up_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 4)).comp seq.m_tendsto
    have h_lo_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (0 : ℝ) ≤ (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
      intro n
      have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
      have hh_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n := (h_bounds n).1
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n := seq.ℓ_pos n
      positivity
    have h_hi_ev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (1 + seq.h_seq n / seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ α₀ ≤
          (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
      refine (hm_ev.and hη_ev).mono ?_
      intro n ⟨hm2, hη_lt⟩
      have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
      have hm_ge_one : 1 ≤ seq.m_seq n := by linarith
      have hη_hi : η n < 1 / (4 * α₀) := (abs_lt.mp hη_lt).2
      have hηα : η n * α₀ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hη_hi hα_pos
        have hsimp : (1 / (4 * α₀)) * α₀ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp [hα_pos.ne']
        linarith
      change (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (Q n) ^ α₀ ≤ (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ))
      calc (seq.m_seq n)⁻¹ * (Q n) ^ α₀
          = (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-1 : ℝ) * ((seq.m_seq n) ^ (η n)) ^ α₀ := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one (seq.m_seq n), h_rpow_Q n hm2]
        _ = (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-1 : ℝ) * (seq.m_seq n) ^ (η n * α₀) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul hm_pos.le]
        _ = (seq.m_seq n) ^ ((-1 : ℝ) + η n * α₀) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hm_pos]
        _ ≤ (seq.m_seq n) ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hm_ge_one (by linarith)
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
      tendsto_const_nhds h_up_tendsto h_lo_ev h_hi_ev

  have hlim2 : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n =>
        (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
          (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + seq.h_seq n))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    have h_low_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (seq.m_seq n) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)
        ((tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2)).comp seq.m_tendsto)
    have h_dom_ev :
        (fun n => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (seq.m_seq n) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
          (fun n =>
            (seq.m_seq n) ^ 2 * (seq.ℓ_seq n) ^ (2 * α₀) *
              (seq.h_seq n) ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + seq.h_seq n)) := by
      refine (hm_ev.and (hh_ev.and hη_ev)).mono ?_
      intro n ⟨hm2, hh1, hη_lt⟩
      set m_n : ℝ := seq.m_seq n
      set h_n : ℝ := seq.h_seq n
      set ℓ_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n
      have hm_pos : 0 < m_n := seq.m_pos n
      have hh_pos : 0 < h_n := (h_bounds n).1
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_n := seq.ℓ_pos n
      have hm_ge_one : 1 ≤ m_n := by linarith
      have hη_hi : η n < 1 / (4 * α₀) := (abs_lt.mp hη_lt).2
      have h2αη : 2 * α₀ * η n ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hη_hi hα_pos
        have hsimp : (1 / (4 * α₀)) * α₀ = 1 / 4 := by field_simp [hα_pos.ne']
        linarith
      have hh_split : h_n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) = h_n * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) := by
        calc h_n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀)
            = h_n ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (-2 * α₀)) := by ring_nf
          _ = h_n ^ (1 : ℝ) * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) := Real.rpow_add hh_pos 1 (-2 * α₀)
          _ = h_n * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      have hQ_neg_le : (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀) ≤ ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) := by
        have hdiv_le_Q : h_n / ℓ_n ≤ Q n := by dsimp [Q, h_n, ℓ_n]; linarith
        calc (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀)
            ≤ (h_n / ℓ_n) ^ (-2 * α₀) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (div_pos hh_pos hℓ_pos) hdiv_le_Q (by linarith)
          _ = (h_n * ℓ_n⁻¹) ^ (-2 * α₀) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          _ = h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) * (ℓ_n⁻¹) ^ (-2 * α₀) :=
              Real.mul_rpow hh_pos.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hℓ_pos.le)
          _ = h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) * (ℓ_n ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ^ (-2 * α₀) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_neg_one ℓ_n]
          _ = h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) * ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_mul hℓ_pos.le]; ring_nf
          _ = ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀) := mul_comm _ _
      have hQ_rpow_eq : (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀) = m_n ^ (-(2 * α₀ * η n)) := by
        rw [← h_rpow_Q n hm2]
        change (m_n ^ η n) ^ (-2 * α₀) = m_n ^ (-(2 * α₀ * η n))
        rw [← Real.rpow_mul hm_pos.le]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hh_frac_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ h_n / (1 + h_n) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 1 + h_n)]
        linarith
      have hm_rpow_le : m_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ m_n ^ 2 * (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀) := by
        have hm_sq : m_n ^ (2 : ℝ) = m_n ^ (2 : ℕ) := by norm_cast
        calc m_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
            ≤ m_n ^ ((2 : ℝ) + (-(2 * α₀ * η n))) :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hm_ge_one (by linarith)
          _ = m_n ^ (2 : ℝ) * m_n ^ (-(2 * α₀ * η n)) :=
              Real.rpow_add hm_pos 2 (-(2 * α₀ * η n))
          _ = m_n ^ (2 : ℕ) * (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀) := by
              rw [hm_sq, ← hQ_rpow_eq]
      have h_prod_ge : m_n ^ 2 * (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀) ≤
          m_n ^ 2 * (ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ_neg_le (by positivity)
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_n ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)
          ≤ (h_n / (1 + h_n)) * (m_n ^ 2 * (Q n) ^ (-2 * α₀)) :=
            mul_le_mul hh_frac_ge hm_rpow_le (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (h_n / (1 + h_n)) * (m_n ^ 2 * (ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_ge (by positivity)
        _ = m_n ^ 2 * ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * (h_n * h_n ^ (-2 * α₀)) / (1 + h_n) := by ring
        _ = m_n ^ 2 * ℓ_n ^ (2 * α₀) * h_n ^ (1 - 2 * α₀) / (1 + h_n) := by rw [← hh_split]
    exact Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono' Filter.atTop h_dom_ev h_low_tendsto

  
  obtain ⟨N₀, hCone_N₀⟩ := hCone
  obtain ⟨N_b, hN_b⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.h_div_ℓ_tendsto) 2
  let N_shape : ℕ := max N₀ N_b
  have hShape : ∀ n ≥ N_shape, ∀ s : ℂ,
      seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s.im →
      seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ (3 / 2) * seq.h_seq n →
      ‖E.f s‖ ≤
        (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ ∧
      Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖ ≤
        (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
    intro n hn s hs_lo hs_hi
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hnb : N_b ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have hh_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n := (h_bounds n).1
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n := seq.ℓ_pos n
    have hm_pos : 0 < seq.m_seq n := seq.m_pos n
    have h2ℓ_le_h : 2 * seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp (hN_b n hnb)
    have hδ_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n - s.im := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ_pos hs_lo
    have hmax : max ‖E.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖) ≤
        (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
      by_cases hs_im : 0 ≤ s.im
      · have h1 := hCone_N₀ n hn₀ s hs_lo (by linarith)
        have h_fac_nonneg : 0 ≤ seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
          positivity
        calc max ‖E.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖)
            ≤ C_cone * (seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) := by
              simpa [mul_assoc] using h1
          _ ≤ (3 * C_cone) * (seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) h_fac_nonneg
          _ = (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
              ring
      · push Not at hs_im
        let s_bar : ℂ := starRingEnd ℂ s
        have hs_bar_im : s_bar.im = -s.im := Complex.conj_im s
        have h_bar_lo : seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im := by
          rw [hs_bar_im]; linarith
        have h_bar_hi : seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im ≤ seq.h_seq n := by
          rw [hs_bar_im]; linarith
        have hδ_bar_pos : 0 < seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im := lt_of_lt_of_le hℓ_pos h_bar_lo
        have h_depth_3 : seq.h_seq n - s.im ≤ 3 * (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im) := by
          rw [hs_bar_im]; linarith
        have h_ratio_3 :
            seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im) ≤
              3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) := by
          have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hℓ_pos.le (by positivity) h_depth_3
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3)
          have hcancel :
              3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (3 * (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im))) =
                seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im) := by
            field_simp [hδ_bar_pos.ne']
          rwa [hcancel] at hmul
        have h_rpow_3 :
            (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im)) ^ α₀ ≤
              3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
          calc (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im)) ^ α₀
              ≤ (3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im))) ^ α₀ :=
                Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) h_ratio_3 hα_pos.le
            _ = (3 : ℝ) ^ α₀ * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ :=
                Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)
            _ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hα₂.le) (by positivity)
            _ = 3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
        have hf_norm : ‖E.f s_bar‖ = ‖E.f s‖ := by
          dsimp [s_bar]
          rw [E.f_conj s, Complex.norm_conj]
        have hq_norm : ‖E.q s_bar‖ = ‖E.q s‖ := by
          dsimp [s_bar]
          rw [E.q_conj s, Complex.norm_conj]
        have h_cone_bar := hCone_N₀ n hn₀ s_bar h_bar_lo h_bar_hi
        rw [hf_norm, hq_norm] at h_cone_bar
        calc max ‖E.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖)
            ≤ C_cone * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s_bar.im)) ^ α₀ :=
              h_cone_bar
          _ ≤ C_cone * seq.m_seq n * (3 * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_3 (by positivity)
          _ = (3 * C_cone) * seq.m_seq n * (seq.ℓ_seq n / (seq.h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀ := by
              ring
    exact ⟨le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hmax, le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hmax⟩

  exact ⟨C_init, U_base, N_shape, hC_init_ge_one, hU_base_holo, hU_base_props,
    hlim1, hlim2, hShape⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_conv_lt : ∀ (L H u₁ u₂ a b : ℝ), L < u₁ → u₁ < H → L < u₂ → u₂ < H →
      0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 → L < a * u₁ + b * u₂ ∧ a * u₁ + b * u₂ < H := by
    intro L H u₁ u₂ a b h1 h2 h3 h4 ha hb hab
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp at hab; subst hab; simp [h3, h4]
    · have ha1 : a * L < a * u₁ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h1 ha_pos
      have ha2 : a * u₁ < a * H := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2 ha_pos
      have hb1 : b * L ≤ b * u₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3.le hb
      have hb2 : b * u₂ ≤ b * H := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4.le hb
      have hL : a * L + b * L = L := by linear_combination L * hab
      have hH : a * H + b * H = H := by linear_combination H * hab
      exact ⟨by linarith only [ha1, hb1, hL], by linarith only [ha2, hb2, hH]⟩

  have hVertUniq : ∀ (U₁ U₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₁ f₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y₀ t₀ : ℂ) (δ₀ : ℝ),
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₁ →
      IsDownwardVertConvex U₂ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ U₁ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ U₂ →
      (y₀, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ →
      0 ≤ y₀.im →
      0 < δ₀ →
      (∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f₁ (y, t₀) = f₂ (y, t₀)) →
      f₁ (y₀, t₀) = f₂ (y₀, t₀) := by
    intro U₁ U₂ f₁ f₂ y₀ t₀ δ₀ hU₁ hU₂ hf₁ hf₂ hy₀_mem hy₀_im hδ₀ h_eq_ball
    let V_sl : Set ℂ := { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ U₁ ∩ U₂ }
    have hV_sl_open : IsOpen V_sl :=
      (hU₁.1.inter hU₂.1).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    let γ_seg : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => (y₀.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ_seg :=
      continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    let K_seg : Set ℂ := γ_seg '' Set.Icc 0 y₀.im
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K_seg := isCompact_Icc.image hγ_cont
    have hK_sub : K_seg ⊆ V_sl := by
      rintro _ ⟨τ, ⟨hτ_lo, hτ_hi⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hU₁.2 y₀ t₀ hy₀_mem.1 hy₀_im τ hτ_lo hτ_hi,
             hU₂.2 y₀ t₀ hy₀_mem.2 hy₀_im τ hτ_lo hτ_hi⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_thick⟩ :=
      hK_comp.exists_thickening_subset_open hV_sl_open hK_sub
    let W_rect : Set ℂ :=
      { y : ℂ |
        y₀.re - ε / 3 < y.re ∧ y.re < y₀.re + ε / 3 ∧
        -ε / 3 < y.im ∧ y.im < y₀.im + ε / 3 }
    have hW_rect_open : IsOpen W_rect :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter <|
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter <|
          (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter <|
            isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    have hW_rect_conv : Convex ℝ W_rect := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
      rcases hy₁ with ⟨h1a, h1b, h1c, h1d⟩
      rcases hy₂ with ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c, h2d⟩
      have hre := h_conv_lt (y₀.re - ε / 3) (y₀.re + ε / 3) y₁.re y₂.re a b
        h1a h1b h2a h2b ha hb hab
      have him := h_conv_lt (-ε / 3) (y₀.im + ε / 3) y₁.im y₂.im a b
        h1c h1d h2c h2d ha hb hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [hre.1, hre.2, him.1, him.2]
    have hW_rect_sub : W_rect ⊆ V_sl := by
      intro y hy
      rcases hy with ⟨hy_re_lo, hy_re_hi, hy_im_lo, hy_im_hi⟩
      apply hε_thick
      rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
      let τ : ℝ := min (max y.im 0) y₀.im
      have hτ_lo : 0 ≤ τ := le_min (le_max_right _ _) hy₀_im
      have hτ_hi : τ ≤ y₀.im := min_le_right _ _
      refine ⟨γ_seg τ, ⟨τ, ⟨hτ_lo, hτ_hi⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have hre_diff : |(y - γ_seg τ).re| < ε / 3 := by
        have hre_eq : (y - γ_seg τ).re = y.re - y₀.re := by simp [γ_seg]
        rw [hre_eq, abs_lt]
        exact ⟨by linarith only [hy_re_lo], by linarith only [hy_re_hi]⟩
      have him_diff : |(y - γ_seg τ).im| < ε / 3 := by
        have him_eq : (y - γ_seg τ).im = y.im - τ := by simp [γ_seg]
        rw [him_eq, abs_lt]
        dsimp [τ]
        rcases lt_or_ge y.im 0 with h1 | h1
        · rw [max_eq_right h1.le, min_eq_left hy₀_im]
          exact ⟨by linarith only [hy_im_lo], by linarith only [h1, hε_pos]⟩
        · rw [max_eq_left h1]
          rcases le_or_gt y.im y₀.im with h2 | h2
          · rw [min_eq_left h2]
            exact ⟨by linarith only [hε_pos], by linarith only [hε_pos]⟩
          · rw [min_eq_right h2.le]
            exact ⟨by linarith only [h2, hε_pos], by linarith only [hy_im_hi]⟩
      have hz_eq : y - γ_seg τ =
          ((y - γ_seg τ).re : ℂ) + ((y - γ_seg τ).im : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
        (Complex.re_add_im _).symm
      have hnorm_le : ‖y - γ_seg τ‖ ≤ |(y - γ_seg τ).re| + |(y - γ_seg τ).im| := by
        calc ‖y - γ_seg τ‖
            = ‖((y - γ_seg τ).re : ℂ) + ((y - γ_seg τ).im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := by
                rw [← hz_eq]
          _ ≤ ‖((y - γ_seg τ).re : ℂ)‖ + ‖((y - γ_seg τ).im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |(y - γ_seg τ).re| + |(y - γ_seg τ).im| := by
                rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
                  Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith only [hnorm_le, hre_diff, him_diff, hε_pos]
    let z₀ : ℂ := (y₀.re : ℂ)
    have hz₀_W : z₀ ∈ W_rect :=
      ⟨by simp [z₀]; linarith only [hε_pos],
       by simp [z₀]; linarith only [hε_pos],
       by simp [z₀]; linarith only [hε_pos],
       by simp [z₀]; linarith only [hε_pos, hy₀_im]⟩
    have hy₀_W : y₀ ∈ W_rect :=
      ⟨by linarith only [hε_pos],
       by linarith only [hε_pos],
       by linarith only [hε_pos, hy₀_im],
       by linarith only [hε_pos]⟩
    let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => f₁ (y, t₀)
    let g₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => f₂ (y, t₀)
    have hg₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g₁ W_rect := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd ?_ hW_rect_open
      exact hf₁.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
        (fun y hy => (hW_rect_sub hy).1)
    have hg₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g₂ W_rect := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd ?_ hW_rect_open
      exact hf₂.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const t₀)).differentiableOn
        (fun y hy => (hW_rect_sub hy).2)
    have h_ev : g₁ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] g₂ := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ₀)] with y hy
      exact h_eq_ball y (by simpa [z₀, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy)
    exact hg₁_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hg₂_ana
      hW_rect_conv.isPreconnected hz₀_W h_ev hy₀_W
  have h_s2 : ∀ (W U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (R_Φ : ℝ),
      IsOpen W → IsOpen U₀ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ U₀ →
      1 < R_Φ →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (W ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, Φ (p, 0) = p) →
      (∀ p ∈ W, ∀ ϕ : ℝ, Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (circleAvgCont f₀ Φ) W ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀) →
        circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p = f₀ p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W, ∀ M_bd : ℝ,
        (∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ‖f₀ (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ M_bd) →
        ‖circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p‖ ≤ M_bd) := by
    intro W U₀ f₀ Φ R_Φ hW hU₀ hf₀ hR_Φ hΦ hΦ_zero hΦ_cir
    let domΦ : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) := W ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_Φ
    have hdomΦ_open : IsOpen domΦ := hW.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    let W_good : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) := { x | x ∈ domΦ ∧ Φ x ∈ U₀ }
    have hW_good_open : IsOpen W_good := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      intro x hx
      have hΦ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ x :=
        (hΦ x hx.1).differentiableAt (hdomΦ_open.mem_nhds hx.1)
      exact Filter.inter_mem (hdomΦ_open.mem_nhds hx.1)
        (hΦ_at.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hU₀.mem_nhds hx.2))
    let H_comp : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ := fun x => f₀ (Φ x)
    have hH_comp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_comp W_good := by
      intro x hx
      have hΦ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ x :=
        (hΦ x hx.1).differentiableAt (hdomΦ_open.mem_nhds hx.1)
      have hf₀_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ f₀ (Φ x) :=
        (hf₀ (Φ x) hx.2).differentiableAt (hU₀.mem_nhds hx.2)
      exact (hf₀_at.comp x hΦ_at).differentiableWithinAt
    let e_cir : ℝ → ℂ := fun ϕ => Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have he_cont : Continuous e_cir :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have he_norm : ∀ ϕ : ℝ, ‖e_cir ϕ‖ = 1 := fun ϕ =>
      Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I ϕ
    let L_inl : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p, (0 : ℂ))) 0
    have hL₀ : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p, (0 : ℂ))) L_inl 0 :=
      (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const (0 : ℂ))).hasFDerivAt
    have hL_all : ∀ (q : ℂ × ℂ) (z : ℂ), HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p, z)) L_inl q := by
      intro q z
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p - q) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ℂ × ℂ)) q :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id q).sub_const q
      have hL₀_q : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p, (0 : ℂ))) L_inl (q - q) := by
        simpa only [sub_self] using hL₀
      have h2 := HasFDerivAt.comp (f := fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p - q) q hL₀_q h1
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at h2
      have h3 := h2.add_const (q, z)
      convert h3 using 1
      ext p <;> simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p₀ hp₀
      let K_cir : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) := (fun ϕ : ℝ => (p₀, e_cir ϕ)) '' Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have hK_cir_comp : IsCompact K_cir :=
        isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_const.prodMk he_cont)
      have hK_cir_sub : K_cir ⊆ W_good := by
        rintro _ ⟨ϕ, _, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hp₀, ?_⟩, hΦ_cir p₀ hp₀ ϕ⟩
        simp [Metric.mem_ball, he_norm ϕ, hR_Φ]
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_thick⟩ :=
        hK_cir_comp.exists_thickening_subset_open hW_good_open hK_cir_sub
      let η : ℝ := δ / 4
      have hη_pos : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; positivity
      let ψ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, e_cir q.2)
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := continuous_fst.prodMk (he_cont.comp continuous_snd)
      let K_img : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
        ψ '' (Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
      have hK_img_comp : IsCompact K_img :=
        ((isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * η)).prod isCompact_Icc).image hψ_cont
      have hK_img_sub : K_img ⊆ W_good := by
        rintro _ ⟨⟨q, ϕ⟩, ⟨hq_ball, hϕ_Icc⟩, rfl⟩
        apply hδ_thick
        rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
        refine ⟨(p₀, e_cir ϕ), ⟨ϕ, hϕ_Icc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        have hd_eq : dist (q, e_cir ϕ) (p₀, e_cir ϕ) = dist q p₀ := by
          simp [Prod.dist_eq, dist_nonneg]
        rw [hd_eq]
        have hq_le : dist q p₀ ≤ 2 * η := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq_ball
        dsimp [η] at hq_le
        linarith
      obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ :=
        hK_img_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hH_comp_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_img_sub)
      let M₀ : ℝ := max C₀ 0
      let F : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p ϕ => H_comp (p, e_cir ϕ)
      let F' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
        fun p ϕ => (fderiv ℂ H_comp (p, e_cir ϕ)).comp L_inl
      have h_mem_good : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η), ∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          (q, e_cir ϕ) ∈ K_img := fun q hq ϕ hϕ => ⟨(q, ϕ), ⟨hq, hϕ⟩, rfl⟩
      have hF_fderiv_closed : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η),
          ∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          HasFDerivAt (fun p' => F p' ϕ) (F' q ϕ) q := by
        intro q hq ϕ hϕ
        have hx_good : (q, e_cir ϕ) ∈ W_good := hK_img_sub (h_mem_good q hq ϕ hϕ)
        have hH_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ H_comp (q, e_cir ϕ) :=
          (hH_comp_holo _ hx_good).differentiableAt (hW_good_open.mem_nhds hx_good)
        exact hH_at.hasFDerivAt.comp q (hL_all q (e_cir ϕ))
      have h_uIoc_sub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ⊆ Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le (by positivity)]
        exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
      have hs_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ η ∈ nhds p₀ :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)
      have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀,
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F p)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
        have hp_cl : p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
          have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
          linarith
        have h_cont_p : ContinuousOn (F p) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
          refine hH_comp_holo.continuousOn.comp (continuous_const.prodMk he_cont).continuousOn ?_
          intro ϕ hϕ
          exact hK_img_sub (h_mem_good p hp_cl ϕ hϕ)
        exact (h_cont_p.mono h_uIoc_sub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (F p₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        have hp₀_cl : p₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η) :=
          Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity)
        have h_cont_p₀ : ContinuousOn (F p₀) (Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by positivity)]
          refine hH_comp_holo.continuousOn.comp (continuous_const.prodMk he_cont).continuousOn ?_
          intro ϕ hϕ
          exact hK_img_sub (h_mem_good p₀ hp₀_cl ϕ hϕ)
        exact h_cont_p₀.intervalIntegrable
      have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' p₀)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        have h_meas_comp : Measurable
            (fun T : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ => T.comp L_inl) :=
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ℂ).flip L_inl).continuous.measurable
        have h_meas_curve : Measurable (fun ϕ : ℝ => (p₀, e_cir ϕ)) :=
          (continuous_const.prodMk he_cont).measurable
        exact (h_meas_comp.comp ((measurable_fderiv ℂ H_comp).comp h_meas_curve)).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF'_bound : ∀ᵐ ϕ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
          ϕ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
          ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ η, ‖F' p ϕ‖ ≤ 2 * M₀ / η := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ϕ hϕ p hp => ?_)
        have hϕ_Icc : ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := h_uIoc_sub hϕ
        have hball_sub : Metric.ball p η ⊆ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η) := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
          have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
          have h2 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
          have h3 := dist_triangle q p p₀
          linarith
        have hF_diff_ball : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p' => F p' ϕ) (Metric.ball p η) :=
          fun q hq => (hF_fderiv_closed q (hball_sub hq) ϕ hϕ_Icc).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
        have hF_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun p' => F p' ϕ) (Metric.ball p η)
            (Metric.closedBall (F p ϕ) (2 * M₀)) := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          have hq_norm : ‖F q ϕ‖ ≤ M₀ :=
            le_trans (hC₀ _ (h_mem_good q (hball_sub hq) ϕ hϕ_Icc)) (le_max_left _ _)
          have hp_norm : ‖F p ϕ‖ ≤ M₀ :=
            le_trans (hC₀ _ (h_mem_good p (hball_sub (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)) ϕ hϕ_Icc))
              (le_max_left _ _)
          have htri := norm_sub_le (F q ϕ) (F p ϕ)
          linarith
        have hfderiv_eq : fderiv ℂ (fun p' => F p' ϕ) p = F' p ϕ :=
          (hF_fderiv_closed p (hball_sub (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)) ϕ hϕ_Icc).fderiv
        rw [← hfderiv_eq]
        exact Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hF_diff_ball hF_maps hη_pos
      have h_int_deriv := intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        hs_nhds hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas hF'_bound
        (intervalIntegrable_const : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ => 2 * M₀ / η) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ϕ hϕ p hp =>
          hF_fderiv_closed p (by
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
            have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
            linarith) ϕ (h_uIoc_sub hϕ)))
      exact (h_int_deriv.const_mul (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro p hp h_disk
      let h : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => f₀ (Φ (p, ζ))
      have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_lt : ‖ζ‖ < R_Φ := by
          have hle : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hζ
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hR_Φ
        have hx_good : (p, ζ) ∈ W_good := ⟨⟨hp, by simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hζ_lt⟩, h_disk ζ hζ⟩
        have hH_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ H_comp (p, ζ) :=

        have h_pair : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (p, z)) ζ :=

        exact (hH_at.comp ζ h_pair).differentiableWithinAt
      have hcauchy := hh_holo.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self zero_lt_one)
      have havg := Real.circleAverage_eq_circleIntegral (f := h) (c := 0) (R := 1) one_ne_zero
      rw [hcauchy] at havg
      have h2pi_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
        simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, Complex.I_ne_zero]
      have havg_eq : Real.circleAverage h 0 1 = h 0 := by
        rw [havg, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_smul]
      have h_def : Real.circleAverage h 0 1 = circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p := by
        rw [Real.circleAverage_def]
        simp [circleAvgCont, h, circleMap, Complex.real_smul, mul_comm]
      calc circleAvgCont f₀ Φ p
          = Real.circleAverage h 0 1 := h_def.symm
        _ = h 0 := havg_eq
        _ = f₀ p := by dsimp [h]; rw [hΦ_zero p hp]
    · intro p _ M_bd h_bd
      have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      have h_int_le :
          ‖∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (Φ (p, e_cir ϕ))‖ ≤
            M_bd * |2 * Real.pi - 0| := by
        refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun ϕ hϕ => ?_)
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le h2pi_pos.le] at hϕ
        exact h_bd ϕ (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hϕ)
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos h2pi_pos] at h_int_le
      dsimp [circleAvgCont]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg h2pi_pos.le]
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ‖∫ ϕ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), f₀ (Φ (p, e_cir ϕ))‖

  intro hBump α K₀ γ₀ hα₁ hα₂ hK₀ hγ₀_pos hγ₀_lt

  intro x₀ h_ref s_base ρ_base m_aux d r M_scale C_st C_init s_base_fn U_base s_steep
    hs_base hs_le_h hρ_base hm_aux hd h4d hr hM_scale hC_st hC_init hr_small hC_init_le
    m_steep_init A₀ δ_seed U_base_dom W_steep_init Ω_mid
    hU_holo hU_props hs_steep_holo hs_steep_props hs_steep_base

  have hδ_seed_pos : 0 < δ_seed := by dsimp [δ_seed]; positivity
  have hδ_seed_lt_16 : δ_seed < s_base / 16 := by
    dsimp [δ_seed]
    exact div_lt_div_of_pos_left hs_base (by norm_num) (by linarith)

  
  let U_bh : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < ρ_base }
  have hc_depth : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => h_ref - p.1.im) :=
    continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)
  have hc_re : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => |p.1.re - x₀|) :=
    continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)
  have hc_t : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ‖p.2‖) := continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd
  have hc_rpow : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((h_ref - p.1.im) / d) ^ α) :=
    (hc_depth.div_const d).rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hα_pos.le)

  have hU_bh_open : IsOpen U_bh :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hc_t continuous_const)
  have hU_bh_sub : U_bh ⊆ U_base_dom := fun p hp => ⟨by linarith [hp.1], hp.2⟩

  have hW_open : IsOpen W_steep_init :=

      (isOpen_lt hc_depth continuous_const).inter <|

  have hW_conv : IsDownwardVertConvex W_steep_init := by
    refine ⟨hW_open, fun y t hyt _ τ hτ_lo hτ_hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hyt with ⟨hp1, _, hp3, hp4, hp5⟩
    have hy'_re : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = y.re := by simp
    have hy'_im : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = τ := by simp
    have hδ_pos : 0 < h_ref - y.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
    have hδ_le : h_ref - y.im ≤ h_ref - τ := by linarith
    have hrpow_le : ((h_ref - y.im) / d) ^ α ≤ ((h_ref - τ) / d) ^ α :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ_le hd.le) hα_pos.le
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hp5⟩

    · rw [hy'_im]; linarith
    · rw [hy'_re, hy'_im]

    · rw [hy'_im]

  have hΩ_conv : IsDownwardVertConvex Ω_mid := by
    refine ⟨hΩ_open, fun y t hyt _ τ hτ_lo hτ_hi => ?_⟩
    rcases hyt with ⟨hp1, _, hp3, hp4⟩
    have hy'_re : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = y.re := by simp
    have hy'_im : ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = τ := by simp
    have hδ_pos : 0 < h_ref - y.im := lt_trans (by positivity) hp1
    have hδ_le : h_ref - y.im ≤ h_ref - τ := by linarith
    have hrpow_le : ((h_ref - y.im) / d) ^ α ≤ ((h_ref - τ) / d) ^ α :=

    · rw [hy'_im]; linarith

  let U_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (s_steep p - p.1) / p.2 ^ 2
  have hU_steep_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_steep W_steep_init := by

    have hp2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) W_steep_init :=

    have hp2_inv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) W_steep_init :=

    exact ((hs_steep_holo.sub hp1).mul hp2_inv).congr (fun _ _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ _)
  have hU_steep_norm : ∀ p ∈ W_steep_init,
      ‖U_steep p‖ ≤ C_st * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by

  have hPatches : ∀ p_star ∈ Ω_mid,
      ∃ (V B : Set ℂ) (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),

    let x_star : ℝ := p_star.1.re
    let σ_star : ℝ := p_star.1.im
    let t_star : ℂ := p_star.2

    change ‖t_star‖ < R₀ at ht_star_lt

      linarith only [ht_star_lt]

    let μ_y : ℝ := min (δ_seed / 2) (δ_h / (24 * (2 + C_bump_init)))

    have hμ_y_le_seed : μ_y ≤ δ_seed / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hμ_y_le_δh : (2 + C_bump_init) * μ_y ≤ δ_h / 24 := by
      have hle : μ_y ≤ δ_h / (24 * (2 + C_bump_init)) := min_le_right _ _
      have hden_pos : 0 < 24 * (2 + C_bump_init) := by positivity

    have hμ_t_le_R₀ : μ_t ≤ (R₀ - ‖t_star‖) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hμ_t_le_γ : μ_t ≤ γ_init * R₀ / 10 := min_le_right _ _

    let V : Set ℂ :=
      { y : ℂ |

        -δ_seed < y.im ∧ y.im < max σ_star 0 + μ_y }
    let B : Set ℂ := Metric.ball t_star μ_t

    have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter <|
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter <|
          (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter <|
            isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    have hV_conv : Convex ℝ V := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
      rcases hy₁ with ⟨h1a, h1b, h1c, h1d⟩
      rcases hy₂ with ⟨h2a, h2b, h2c, h2d⟩
      have hre := h_conv_lt (x_star - μ_y) (x_star + μ_y) y₁.re y₂.re a b
        h1a h1b h2a h2b ha hb hab
      have him := h_conv_lt (-δ_seed) (max σ_star 0 + μ_y) y₁.im y₂.im a b
        h1c h1d h2c h2d ha hb hab
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [hre.1, hre.2, him.1, him.2]
    have hp1_V : p_star.1 ∈ V := by
      have hmax : σ_star ≤ max σ_star 0 := le_max_left _ _
      exact ⟨by dsimp [x_star]; linarith only [hμ_y_pos],
        by dsimp [x_star]; linarith only [hμ_y_pos],
        hσ_star_lo, by dsimp [σ_star] at *; linarith only [hmax, hμ_y_pos]⟩
    have hV_re : ∀ y ∈ V, (y.re : ℂ) ∈ V := by
      intro y hy
      have hmax : 0 ≤ max σ_star 0 := le_max_right _ _
      exact ⟨by simp [hy.1], by simp [hy.2.1],
        by simp; linarith only [hδ_seed_pos],
        by simp; linarith only [hmax, hμ_y_pos]⟩
    have hB_open : IsOpen B := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hp2_B : p_star.2 ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball_self hμ_t_pos

    let Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q =>
      (q.1.1 - Complex.I * (q.1.1 - (x_star : ℂ)) * g q.2,

    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ ((V ×ˢ B) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r')) := by
      have h_q11 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => q.1.1)
          ((V ×ˢ B) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r')) :=
        (differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_fst).differentiableOn
      have h_q12 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => q.1.2)
          ((V ×ˢ B) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r')) :=
        (differentiable_snd.comp differentiable_fst).differentiableOn
      have h_g : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => g q.2)
          ((V ×ˢ B) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / r')) :=
        hg_holo.comp differentiableOn_snd (fun _ h => h.2)
      have h_fst := h_q11.sub (((differentiableOn_const Complex.I).mul
        (h_q11.sub (differentiableOn_const (x_star : ℂ)))).mul h_g)
      have h_snd := h_q12.add
        ((differentiableOn_const ((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ)).mul differentiableOn_snd)
      exact fun x hx => (h_fst x hx).prodMk (h_snd x hx)
    have hΦ_zero : ∀ q ∈ V ×ˢ B, Φ (q, 0) = q := by
      intro q _

    have h2δ_seed_eq : 2 * δ_seed * (1 + C_bump_init) = s_base / 8 := by
      dsimp [δ_seed]
      have hne : 1 + C_bump_init ≠ 0 := by positivity

    have hΦ_disk_common : ∀ q ∈ V ×ˢ B, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
        ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖ < 4 * R₀ ∧
        ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖ < ρ_base ∧
        (2 / 3) * δ_h < h_ref - (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im := by
      intro q hq ζ hζ
      rcases hq with ⟨⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, hσ_lo, hσ_hi⟩, ht_ball⟩
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using hζ
      obtain ⟨hg_norm, hg_im_lo, hg_im_hi⟩ := hg_disk ζ hζ
      have hg_re_abs : |(g ζ).re| ≤ C_bump_init :=
        le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
      have ht_dist : ‖q.2 - t_star‖ < μ_t := by
        simpa [B, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht_ball
      have htc_lt : ‖q.2‖ < R₀ := by
        have htri : ‖q.2‖ ≤ ‖t_star‖ + ‖q.2 - t_star‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le t_star (q.2 - t_star)
        linarith only [htri, ht_dist, hμ_t_le_R₀, ht_star_lt]
      have ht'_lt_4R₀ : ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖ < 4 * R₀ := by
        dsimp [Φ]
        have htri := norm_add_le q.2 (((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ)
        have hmul_n : ‖((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ‖ ≤ 3 * R₀ := by
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) hζ_norm
        linarith only [htri, htc_lt, hmul_n]
      have h4R₀_lt_ρ : 4 * R₀ < ρ_base := by
        have hrpow_le : (δ_h / d) ^ α ≤ (2 * h_ref / d) ^ α :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
            (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ_h_lt_2h.le hd.le) hα_pos.le
        have h4 : 4 * R₀ ≤ 4 * r * (2 * h_ref / d) ^ α := by
          dsimp [R₀]
          have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * r)
          linarith only [hmul]
        have hpos_fac : 0 < r * (2 * h_ref / d) ^ α := by positivity
        linarith only [h4, hpos_fac, hr_small]
      let u : ℝ := q.1.re - x_star
      let σ : ℝ := q.1.im
      have hu_abs : |u| < μ_y :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by dsimp [u]; linarith only [hy_lo], by dsimp [u]; linarith only [hy_hi]⟩
      have hy'_im : (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im = σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) - u * (g ζ).re := by
        dsimp [Φ, u, σ]
        simp [mul_assoc]
        ring
      have h1_gim_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + (g ζ).im := by linarith only [hg_im_lo]
      have h1_gim_lt_2 : 1 + (g ζ).im < 2 := by
        dsimp [η_init] at hg_im_hi
        have h8K : 1 / (8 * K₀) < 1 := (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith only [hK₀])
        linarith only [hg_im_hi, h8K]
      have hmax_nonneg : 0 ≤ max σ_star 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hσ_term_le :
          σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ max σ_star 0 * (1 + η_init) + 2 * μ_y := by
        have h1 : σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ (max σ_star 0 + μ_y) * (1 + (g ζ).im) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ_hi.le h1_gim_nonneg
        have h2 : max σ_star 0 * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ max σ_star 0 * (1 + η_init) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith only [hg_im_hi]) hmax_nonneg
        have h3 : μ_y * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ 2 * μ_y := by nlinarith only [hμ_y_pos, h1_gim_lt_2]
        linarith only [h1, h2, h3]
      have hu_term_lt : -u * (g ζ).re < C_bump_init * μ_y := by
        have h1 : -u * (g ζ).re ≤ |u * (g ζ).re| := by
          have hneg := neg_le_abs (u * (g ζ).re)
          linarith only [hneg]
        rw [abs_mul] at h1
        have h2 : |u| * |(g ζ).re| ≤ |u| * C_bump_init :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_re_abs (abs_nonneg u)
        have h3 : |u| * C_bump_init < μ_y * C_bump_init :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hu_abs hCb
        linarith only [h1, h2, h3]
      have hy'_im_lt : (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im < max σ_star 0 * (1 + η_init) + δ_h / 24 := by
        rw [hy'_im]
        linarith only [hσ_term_le, hu_term_lt, hμ_y_le_δh]
      refine ⟨ht'_lt_4R₀, lt_trans ht'_lt_4R₀ h4R₀_lt_ρ, ?_⟩
      rcases le_or_gt 0 σ_star with hσ_ge | hσ_neg
      · rw [max_eq_left hσ_ge] at hy'_im_lt
        have hη_bound : σ_star * η_init < δ_h / 4 := by
          dsimp [η_init]
          have h0 : σ_star * (1 / (8 * K₀)) = σ_star / (8 * K₀) := by ring
          have h1 : σ_star / (8 * K₀) ≤ h_ref / (8 * K₀) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hσ_star_hi.le (by positivity)
          have h2 : h_ref / (8 * K₀) = (h_ref / (2 * K₀)) / 4 := by ring

        have hσ_eq : σ_star = h_ref - δ_h := by dsimp [δ_h]; ring
        linarith only [hy'_im_lt, hη_bound, hσ_eq, hδ_h_pos]
      · rw [max_eq_right hσ_neg.le] at hy'_im_lt
        have hδ_lt_17 : δ_h < (17 / 16) * h_ref := by
          linarith only [hδ_hi, hδ_seed_lt_16, hs_le_h]
        linarith only [hy'_im_lt, hδ_lt_17, hδ_h_pos]

    have hΦ_seed : ∀ q ∈ V ×ˢ B, |q.1.im| < δ_seed →
        ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (q, ζ) ∈ U_bh := by
      intro q hq hσ_abs ζ hζ
      obtain ⟨_, ht'_ρ, _⟩ := hΦ_disk_common q hq ζ hζ
      rcases hq with ⟨⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, _, _⟩, _⟩
      obtain ⟨hg_norm, _, _⟩ := hg_disk ζ hζ
      have hg_re_abs : |(g ζ).re| ≤ C_bump_init :=
        le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
      have hg_im_abs : |(g ζ).im| ≤ C_bump_init :=

      let u : ℝ := q.1.re - x_star
      let σ : ℝ := q.1.im

        lt_of_lt_of_le

          hμ_y_le_seed
      have hy'_im : (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im = σ + σ * (g ζ).im - u * (g ζ).re := by
        dsimp [Φ, u, σ]
        simp [mul_assoc]
        ring
      refine ⟨?_, ht'_ρ⟩
      rw [hy'_im]
      have htri1 : |σ + σ * (g ζ).im - u * (g ζ).re| ≤
          |σ + σ * (g ζ).im| + |u * (g ζ).re| := abs_sub _ _
      have htri2 : |σ + σ * (g ζ).im| ≤ |σ| + |σ * (g ζ).im| := abs_add_le _ _
      rw [abs_mul] at htri1 htri2
      have h1 : |σ| * |(g ζ).im| ≤ δ_seed * C_bump_init :=
        mul_le_mul hσ_abs.le hg_im_abs (abs_nonneg _) hδ_seed_pos.le
      have h2 : |u| * |(g ζ).re| ≤ (δ_seed / 2) * C_bump_init :=
        mul_le_mul hu_abs.le hg_re_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      linarith only [htri1, htri2, hσ_abs, h1, h2, hδ_seed_pos, h2δ_seed_eq, hs_base]

    have hΦ_cir : ∀ q ∈ V ×ˢ B, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        let ζ := Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        Φ (q, ζ) ∈ U_bh ∨
        (Φ (q, ζ) ∈ W_steep_init ∧ (2 / 3) * δ_h < h_ref - (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im) := by
      intro q hq ϕ ζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ = 1 := Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I ϕ
      have hζ_sph : ζ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp [hζ_norm]
      have hζ_cl : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, hζ_norm]
      obtain ⟨ht'_4R₀, ht'_ρ, hdepth_23⟩ := hΦ_disk_common q hq ζ hζ_cl
      rcases hq with ⟨⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, hσ_lo, hσ_hi⟩, ht_ball⟩
      obtain ⟨hg_norm, hg_im_lo, hg_im_hi⟩ := hg_disk ζ hζ_cl
      have hg_re_abs : |(g ζ).re| ≤ C_bump_init :=
        le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
      let u : ℝ := q.1.re - x_star
      let σ : ℝ := q.1.im
      have hu_abs : |u| < μ_y :=
        abs_lt.mpr ⟨by dsimp [u]; linarith only [hy_lo], by dsimp [u]; linarith only [hy_hi]⟩
      have hu_seed : |u| < δ_seed / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hu_abs hμ_y_le_seed
      have hmax_lt_h : max σ_star 0 < h_ref := max_lt hσ_star_hi hh_ref
      have hσ_abs_lt : |σ| < h_ref + s_base := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        exact ⟨by dsimp [σ] at *; linarith only [hσ_lo, hδ_seed_lt_16, hs_base, hh_ref],
          by dsimp [σ] at *; linarith only [hσ_hi, hmax_lt_h, hμ_y_le_seed, hδ_seed_lt_16, hs_base]⟩
      have hy'_re : (Φ (q, ζ)).1.re = x_star + u * (1 + (g ζ).im) + σ * (g ζ).re := by
        dsimp [Φ, u, σ]
        simp [mul_assoc]
        ring
      have hy'_im : (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im = σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) - u * (g ζ).re := by
        dsimp [Φ, u, σ]
        simp [mul_assoc]
        ring
      have h1_gim_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + (g ζ).im := by linarith only [hg_im_lo]
      have h1_gim_lt_2 : 1 + (g ζ).im < 2 := by
        dsimp [η_init] at hg_im_hi
        have h8K : 1 / (8 * K₀) < 1 := (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith only [hK₀])
        linarith only [hg_im_hi, h8K]

      rcases le_or_gt |(c + ζ).im| ((6 / 5) * γ_init * ‖c + ζ‖) with h_col | h_steep
      · left
        obtain ⟨_, hg_col_hi⟩ := hg_col_raw ζ hζ_sph h_col
        have hg_col_bound : 1 + (g ζ).im ≤ s_base / (16 * (h_ref + s_base)) :=
          le_trans hg_col_hi hCerr_r'
        refine ⟨?_, ht'_ρ⟩
        rw [hy'_im]
        have htri : |σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) - u * (g ζ).re| ≤
            |σ * (1 + (g ζ).im)| + |u * (g ζ).re| := abs_sub _ _
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1_gim_nonneg] at htri
        have h1 : |σ| * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ s_base / 16 := by
          calc |σ| * (1 + (g ζ).im)
              ≤ (h_ref + s_base) * (s_base / (16 * (h_ref + s_base))) :=
                mul_le_mul hσ_abs_lt.le hg_col_bound h1_gim_nonneg (by positivity)
            _ = s_base / 16 := by
                have hne : h_ref + s_base ≠ 0 := by positivity
                field_simp [hne]
        have h2 : |u| * |(g ζ).re| ≤ (δ_seed / 2) * C_bump_init :=
          mul_le_mul hu_seed.le hg_re_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        linarith only [htri, h1, h2, hδ_seed_pos, h2δ_seed_eq, hs_base]
      · right
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hdepth_23⟩
        · linarith only [hd, h4d, hδ_lo, hdepth_23]
        · rw [hy'_im]
          have h1 : -2 * δ_seed ≤ σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) := by
            rcases le_or_gt 0 σ with hσ0 | hσ0
            · have hpos_p : 0 ≤ σ * (1 + (g ζ).im) := mul_nonneg hσ0 h1_gim_nonneg
              linarith only [hpos_p, hδ_seed_pos]
            · nlinarith only [hσ_lo, hσ0, h1_gim_nonneg, h1_gim_lt_2]
          have h2 : u * (g ζ).re ≤ (δ_seed / 2) * C_bump_init := by
            have hle : u * (g ζ).re ≤ |u * (g ζ).re| := le_abs_self _
            rw [abs_mul] at hle
            exact le_trans hle
              (mul_le_mul hu_seed.le hg_re_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          have h3 : 0 ≤ δ_seed * C_bump_init := mul_nonneg hδ_seed_pos.le hCb.le
          linarith only [h1, h2, h3, hδ_seed_pos, h2δ_seed_eq, hs_base]
        · rw [hy'_re]
          have hsub : x_star + u * (1 + (g ζ).im) + σ * (g ζ).re - x₀ =
              (x_star - x₀) + (u * (1 + (g ζ).im) + σ * (g ζ).re) := by ring
          rw [hsub]
          have htri1 := abs_add_le (x_star - x₀) (u * (1 + (g ζ).im) + σ * (g ζ).re)
          have htri2 := abs_add_le (u * (1 + (g ζ).im)) (σ * (g ζ).re)
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1_gim_nonneg] at htri2
          have hu2 : |u| * (1 + (g ζ).im) ≤ 2 * μ_y := by
            nlinarith only [abs_nonneg u, hu_abs, h1_gim_nonneg, h1_gim_lt_2]
          have h2μ : 2 * μ_y ≤ 2 * δ_h := by
            nlinarith only [hμ_y_pos, hCb, hμ_y_le_δh, hδ_h_pos]
          have h2h_le : 2 * h_ref ≤ 4 * K₀ * δ_h := by
            have hdiv := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * K₀)).mp hδ_lo
            linarith only [hdiv]
          have hσ_g : |σ| * |(g ζ).re| ≤ 4 * K₀ * C_bump_init * δ_h := by
            have hσ2 : |σ| ≤ 2 * h_ref := by linarith only [hσ_abs_lt, hs_le_h]
            calc |σ| * |(g ζ).re|
                ≤ (2 * h_ref) * C_bump_init :=
                  mul_le_mul hσ2 hg_re_abs (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
              _ ≤ (4 * K₀ * δ_h) * C_bump_init :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2h_le hCb.le
              _ = 4 * K₀ * C_bump_init * δ_h := by ring
          have hsum_lt :
              |(x_star - x₀) + (u * (1 + (g ζ).im) + σ * (g ζ).re)| <
                m_steep_init * (δ_h / 2) := by
            dsimp [m_steep_init]
            nlinarith only [htri1, htri2, hx_star_re, hu2, h2μ, hσ_g, hCb, hδ_h_pos]
          have h_half_lt : m_steep_init * (δ_h / 2) <
              m_steep_init * (h_ref - (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith only [hδ_h_pos, hdepth_23]) hm_steep_pos
          exact lt_trans hsum_lt h_half_lt
        · have h23_rpow : (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ α := by
            simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge
              (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2 / 3) (by norm_num : (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hα₂.le
          have hrpow_mul : ((2 / 3) * δ_h / d) ^ α = (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ α * (δ_h / d) ^ α := by
            rw [show (2 / 3) * δ_h / d = (2 / 3) * (δ_h / d) by ring]
            exact Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)
          have hrpow_mono : ((2 / 3) * δ_h / d) ^ α ≤
              ((h_ref - (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im) / d) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity)
              (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdepth_23.le hd.le) hα_pos.le
          calc ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖
              < 4 * R₀ := ht'_4R₀
            _ < 10 * (2 / 3 : ℝ) * R₀ := by linarith only [hR₀_pos]
            _ ≤ 10 * (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ α * R₀ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h23_rpow (by norm_num)) hR₀_pos.le
            _ = 10 * r * ((2 / 3) * δ_h / d) ^ α := by
                dsimp [R₀]; rw [hrpow_mul]; ring
            _ ≤ 10 * r * ((h_ref - (Φ (q, ζ)).1.im) / d) ^ α :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_mono (by positivity)
        · let w₀ : ℂ := t_star + ((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ζ
          let Δ_t : ℂ := q.2 - t_star
          have ht'_eq : (Φ (q, ζ)).2 = w₀ + Δ_t := by dsimp [Φ, w₀, Δ_t]; ring
          have hw₀_eq : w₀ = ((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (c + ζ) := by
            dsimp [w₀, c]
            have hne : ((3 * R₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
              Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
            field_simp [hne]
          have hcz_gt : 2 / 3 < ‖c + ζ‖ := by
            have htri : ‖ζ‖ ≤ ‖c + ζ‖ + ‖c‖ := by
