            linarith only [hζ_norm, htri, hc_lt]
          have hw₀_norm : ‖w₀‖ = 3 * R₀ * ‖c + ζ‖ := by
            rw [hw₀_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          have hw₀_gt : 2 * R₀ < ‖w₀‖ := by nlinarith only [hw₀_norm, hcz_gt, hR₀_pos]
          have hw₀_im : |w₀.im| = 3 * R₀ * |(c + ζ).im| := by
            have him : w₀.im = 3 * R₀ * (c + ζ).im := by rw [hw₀_eq]; simp
            rw [him, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
          have hw₀_steep : (6 / 5) * γ_init * ‖w₀‖ < |w₀.im| := by
            rw [hw₀_norm, hw₀_im]
            have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_steep (by positivity : 0 < 3 * R₀)
            linarith only [hmul]
          have hΔ_lt : ‖Δ_t‖ < γ_init * R₀ / 10 :=
            lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa [B, Δ_t, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using ht_ball)
              hμ_t_le_γ
          have hΔ_im : |Δ_t.im| < γ_init * R₀ / 10 :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hΔ_lt
          have ht'_norm_le : ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + ‖Δ_t‖ := by
            rw [ht'_eq]; exact norm_add_le w₀ Δ_t
          have hw₀_im_le : |w₀.im| ≤ |(Φ (q, ζ)).2.im| + |Δ_t.im| := by
            have hsub : w₀.im = (Φ (q, ζ)).2.im - Δ_t.im := by rw [ht'_eq]; simp
            rw [hsub]
            exact abs_sub _ _
          have hγ_Δ : γ_init * ‖Δ_t‖ < γ_init * R₀ / 10 := by
            nlinarith only [hγ_pos, hγ_lt_8, norm_nonneg Δ_t, hΔ_lt]
          have hγR_pos : 0 < γ_init * R₀ := mul_pos hγ_pos hR₀_pos
          have hw₀_steep' : (6 / 5) * (γ_init * ‖w₀‖) < |w₀.im| := by
            have heq : (6 / 5) * (γ_init * ‖w₀‖) = (6 / 5) * γ_init * ‖w₀‖ := by ring
            linarith only [heq, hw₀_steep]
          have hγ_t' : γ_init * ‖(Φ (q, ζ)).2‖ ≤ γ_init * ‖w₀‖ + γ_init * ‖Δ_t‖ := by
            have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht'_norm_le hγ_pos.le
            linarith only [hmul]
          have hγ_w₀ : 2 * (γ_init * R₀) < γ_init * ‖w₀‖ := by
            have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw₀_gt hγ_pos
            linarith only [hmul]
          linarith only [hγR_pos, hγ_t', hγ_w₀, hw₀_steep', hw₀_im_le, hγ_Δ, hΔ_im]

    let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := circleAvgCont U_comb Φ
    have hΦ_cir_U₀ : ∀ q ∈ V ×ˢ B, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        Φ (q, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀_comb := by
      intro q hq ϕ
      rcases hΦ_cir q hq ϕ with h_bh | ⟨h_st, _⟩
      · exact Or.inr h_bh
      · exact Or.inl h_st
    obtain ⟨hH_holo, hH_eval, hH_bd⟩ :=
      h_s2 (V ×ˢ B) U₀_comb U_comb Φ (1 / r') (hV_open.prod hB_open)
        hU₀_comb_open hU_comb_holo h1_lt_inv hΦ_holo hΦ_zero hΦ_cir_U₀

    refine ⟨V, B, H, hV_open, hV_conv, hp1_V, hV_re, hB_open, hp2_B, hH_holo, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq hq_im
      have hq_bh : q ∈ U_bh := by
        have h0 := hΦ_seed q hq hq_im 0 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one)
        rwa [hΦ_zero q hq] at h0
      have h_eq1 : H q = U_comb q :=
        hH_eval q hq (fun ζ hζ => Or.inr (hΦ_seed q hq hq_im ζ hζ))
      rw [h_eq1, hU_comb_bh q hq_bh]
      exact ⟨hq_bh, rfl⟩
    · refine hH_bd p_star ⟨hp1_V, hp2_B⟩ (A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α)) (fun ϕ _ => ?_)
      rcases hΦ_cir p_star ⟨hp1_V, hp2_B⟩ ϕ with h_bh | ⟨h_st, h_depth⟩
      · rw [hU_comb_bh _ h_bh]
        have hub : ‖U_base (Φ (p_star, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ C_init :=
          (hU_props _ _ (hU_bh_sub h_bh)).2.2
        have hrpow_le : (2 * h_ref) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hδ_h_pos hδ_h_lt_2h.le (by linarith only [hα₁])
        calc ‖U_base (Φ (p_star, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖
            ≤ C_init := hub
          _ ≤ M_scale ^ 2 * (2 * h_ref) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := hC_init_le
          _ ≤ M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity)
          _ = 1 * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by ring
          _ ≤ A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA₀_ge_one (by positivity)) (by positivity)
      · rw [hU_comb_st _ h_st]
        have hst_b := hU_steep_norm _ h_st
        have hrpow_le :
            (h_ref - (Φ (p_star, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤
              ((2 / 3) * δ_h) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) h_depth.le (by linarith only [hα₁])
        have h23_eq : ((2 / 3) * δ_h) ^ (1 - 2 * α) =
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
          rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hδ_h_pos.le]
          congr 1
          have h_inv : (2 / 3 : ℝ) = (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ) := by
            rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]; norm_num
          rw [h_inv, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
          ring_nf
        have hA₀_st : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st ≤ A₀ := le_max_right _ _
        calc ‖U_steep (Φ (p_star, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖
            ≤ C_st * M_scale ^ 2 *
                (h_ref - (Φ (p_star, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
              hst_b
          _ ≤ C_st * M_scale ^ 2 * ((2 / 3) * δ_h) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le (by positivity)
          _ = ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) * C_st) * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
              rw [h23_eq]; ring
          _ ≤ A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * δ_h ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA₀_st (by positivity)) (by positivity)

  
  clear h_s2 hBump_apply h_conv_lt U_steep hU_steep_holo hU_steep_norm
    U_comb hU_comb_st hU_comb_bh U₀_comb hU₀_comb_open hU_comb_holo
  let V_ch : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, Set ℂ := fun p hp => (hPatches p hp).choose
  let B_ch : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, Set ℂ := fun p hp => (hPatches p hp).choose_spec.choose
  let H_ch : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p hp =>
    (hPatches p hp).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose
  have h_ch_spec : ∀ (p : ℂ × ℂ) (hp : p ∈ Ω_mid),
      IsOpen (V_ch p hp) ∧ Convex ℝ (V_ch p hp) ∧ p.1 ∈ V_ch p hp ∧
      (∀ y ∈ V_ch p hp, (y.re : ℂ) ∈ V_ch p hp) ∧
      IsOpen (B_ch p hp) ∧ p.2 ∈ B_ch p hp ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_ch p hp) (V_ch p hp ×ˢ B_ch p hp) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ V_ch p hp ×ˢ B_ch p hp, |q.1.im| < δ_seed →
        q ∈ U_bh ∧ H_ch p hp q = U_base q) ∧
      ‖H_ch p hp p‖ ≤ A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
    fun p hp => (hPatches p hp).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec
  clear_value V_ch B_ch H_ch
  clear hPatches

  have h_overlap : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : ℂ × ℂ) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Ω_mid) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ Ω_mid) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
      q₀ ∈ V_ch p₁ hp₁ ×ˢ B_ch p₁ hp₁ →
      q₀ ∈ V_ch p₂ hp₂ ×ˢ B_ch p₂ hp₂ →
      H_ch p₁ hp₁ q₀ = H_ch p₂ hp₂ q₀ := by
    intro p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ q₀ hq₁ hq₂
    obtain ⟨hV₁_open, hV₁_conv, _, hV₁_re, _, _, hH₁_holo, hH₁_seed, _⟩ := h_ch_spec p₁ hp₁
    obtain ⟨hV₂_open, hV₂_conv, _, hV₂_re, _, _, hH₂_holo, hH₂_seed, _⟩ := h_ch_spec p₂ hp₂
    let V₁₂ : Set ℂ := V_ch p₁ hp₁ ∩ V_ch p₂ hp₂
    have hV₁₂_open : IsOpen V₁₂ := hV₁_open.inter hV₂_open
    have hV₁₂_pre : IsPreconnected V₁₂ := (hV₁_conv.inter hV₂_conv).isPreconnected
    have hy₀_mem : q₀.1 ∈ V₁₂ := ⟨hq₁.1, hq₂.1⟩
    let z₀ : ℂ := (q₀.1.re : ℂ)
    have hz₀_mem : z₀ ∈ V₁₂ := ⟨hV₁_re q₀.1 hq₁.1, hV₂_re q₀.1 hq₂.1⟩
    let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => H_ch p₁ hp₁ (y, q₀.2)
    let g₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => H_ch p₂ hp₂ (y, q₀.2)
    have hg₁_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g₁ V₁₂ := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd ?_ hV₁₂_open
      exact hH₁_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q₀.2)).differentiableOn
        (fun y hy => ⟨hy.1, hq₁.2⟩)
    have hg₂_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g₂ V₁₂ := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd ?_ hV₁₂_open
      exact hH₂_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const q₀.2)).differentiableOn
        (fun y hy => ⟨hy.2, hq₂.2⟩)
    have h_ev : g₁ =ᶠ[nhds z₀] g₂ := by
      have hO_nhds : V₁₂ ∩ Metric.ball z₀ δ_seed ∈ nhds z₀ :=
        (hV₁₂_open.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hz₀_mem, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_seed_pos⟩
      filter_upwards [hO_nhds] with y hy
      have hy_im : |y.im| < δ_seed := by
        have hy_dist : ‖y - z₀‖ < δ_seed := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy.2
        have him_eq : y.im = (y - z₀).im := by simp [z₀]
        rw [him_eq]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hy_dist
      dsimp [g₁, g₂]
      rw [(hH₁_seed (y, q₀.2) ⟨hy.1.1, hq₁.2⟩ hy_im).2,
          (hH₂_seed (y, q₀.2) ⟨hy.1.2, hq₂.2⟩ hy_im).2]
    exact hg₁_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hg₂_ana hV₁₂_pre hz₀_mem h_ev hy₀_mem

  let U_mid : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => if hp : p ∈ Ω_mid then H_ch p hp p else 0
  have hU_mid_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_mid Ω_mid := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨hV₀_open, _, hp₀_1, _, hB₀_open, hp₀_2, hH₀_holo, _, _⟩ := h_ch_spec p₀ hp₀
    let W₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Ω_mid ∩ (V_ch p₀ hp₀ ×ˢ B_ch p₀ hp₀)
    have hW₀_open : IsOpen W₀ := hΩ_open.inter (hV₀_open.prod hB₀_open)
    have hp₀_W₀ : p₀ ∈ W₀ := ⟨hp₀, hp₀_1, hp₀_2⟩
    have h_eq_W₀ : ∀ q ∈ W₀, U_mid q = H_ch p₀ hp₀ q := by
      intro q hq
      simp only [U_mid, hq.1, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact h_overlap q p₀ hq.1 hp₀ q
        ⟨(h_ch_spec q hq.1).2.2.1, (h_ch_spec q hq.1).2.2.2.2.2.1⟩ hq.2
    have h_diff_W₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_mid W₀ :=
      (hH₀_holo.mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr h_eq_W₀
    exact ((h_diff_W₀ p₀ hp₀_W₀).differentiableAt
      (hW₀_open.mem_nhds hp₀_W₀)).differentiableWithinAt

  have hU_mid_seed : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, |p.1.im| < δ_seed →
      p ∈ U_bh ∧ U_mid p = U_base p := by
    intro p hp hp_im
    simp only [U_mid, hp, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (h_ch_spec p hp).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 p
      ⟨(h_ch_spec p hp).2.2.1, (h_ch_spec p hp).2.2.2.2.2.1⟩ hp_im

  have hU_mid_norm : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid,
      ‖U_mid p‖ ≤ A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [U_mid, hp, ↓reduceDIte]
    exact (h_ch_spec p hp).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2

  clear_value U_mid
  clear V_ch B_ch H_ch h_ch_spec h_overlap

  let s_band₀ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => p.1 + p.2 ^ 2 * U_mid p
  have hs_band₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_band₀ Ω_mid := by
    have hp1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1) Ω_mid :=
      differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
    have hp2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.2) Ω_mid :=
      differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
    exact hp1.add ((hp2.pow 2).mul hU_mid_holo)

  have hs_band₀_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, (y, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ Ω_mid → s_band₀ (y, 0) = y := by
    intro y _
    simp [s_band₀]

  have hs_band₀_disp : ∀ y₀ t₀ : ℂ, (y₀, t₀) ∈ Ω_mid →
      ‖s_band₀ (y₀, t₀) - y₀‖ ≤
        A₀ * ‖t₀‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y₀.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
    intro y₀ t₀ hy₀
    have h_sub : s_band₀ (y₀, t₀) - y₀ = t₀ ^ 2 * U_mid (y₀, t₀) := by
      dsimp [s_band₀]; ring
    rw [h_sub, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    have h_ub := hU_mid_norm (y₀, t₀) hy₀
    calc ‖t₀‖ ^ 2 * ‖U_mid (y₀, t₀)‖
        ≤ ‖t₀‖ ^ 2 * (A₀ * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y₀.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ub (by positivity)
      _ = A₀ * ‖t₀‖ ^ 2 * M_scale ^ 2 * (h_ref - y₀.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by ring

  have hs_band₀_seed : ∀ p ∈ Ω_mid, |p.1.im| < δ_seed → s_band₀ p = s_base_fn p := by
    intro p hp hp_im
    obtain ⟨hp_bh, h_eq_U⟩ := hU_mid_seed p hp hp_im
    have h_div := (hU_props p.1 p.2 (hU_bh_sub hp_bh)).1
    dsimp [s_band₀]
    rw [h_eq_U]
    linear_combination -h_div

  have hΩ_neg : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_mid → (y, -t) ∈ Ω_mid := by
    intro y t hyt
    exact ⟨hyt.1, hyt.2.1, hyt.2.2.1, by simpa only [norm_neg] using hyt.2.2.2⟩

  have hs_band₀_even_seed : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Ω_mid → |y.im| < δ_seed →
      s_band₀ (y, -t) = s_band₀ (y, t) := by
    intro y t hyt hy_im
    obtain ⟨hp_bh, h_eq1⟩ := hU_mid_seed (y, t) hyt hy_im
    obtain ⟨_, h_eq2⟩ := hU_mid_seed (y, -t) (hΩ_neg y t hyt) hy_im
    have hU_even := (hU_props y t (hU_bh_sub hp_bh)).2.1
    dsimp [s_band₀]
    rw [h_eq1, h_eq2, hU_even]
    ring

  clear_value s_band₀

  refine ⟨s_band₀, hs_band₀_holo, ?_, hs_band₀_zero, hs_band₀_seed, ?_⟩
  · intro y₀ t₀ hy₀
    refine ⟨?_, hs_band₀_disp y₀ t₀ hy₀⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge y₀.im 0 with hy₀_neg | hy₀_nonneg
    · have hy₀_im : |y₀.im| < δ_seed := by
        rw [abs_of_neg hy₀_neg]
        have h21 := hy₀.2.1
        linarith only [h21]
      exact hs_band₀_even_seed y₀ t₀ hy₀ hy₀_im
    · let f_neg : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => s_band₀ (p.1, -p.2)
      have hf_neg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_neg Ω_mid :=
        hs_band₀_holo.comp (differentiable_fst.prodMk differentiable_snd.neg).differentiableOn
          (fun p hp => hΩ_neg p.1 p.2 hp)
      have hy₀_re_mem : ((y₀.re : ℂ), t₀) ∈ Ω_mid := by
        have h0 := hΩ_conv.2 y₀ t₀ hy₀ hy₀_nonneg 0 le_rfl hy₀_nonneg
        simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using h0
      have h_slice_open : IsOpen { y : ℂ | (y, t₀) ∈ Ω_mid } :=
        hΩ_open.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_ball⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp h_slice_open (y₀.re : ℂ) hy₀_re_mem
      let δ₀ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ_seed
      have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ_seed_pos
      have h_seed_ball : ∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (y₀.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ → f_neg (y, t₀) = s_band₀ (y, t₀) := by
        intro y hy_ball
        have hy_mem : (y, t₀) ∈ Ω_mid :=
          hδ₁_ball (by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy_ball (min_le_left _ _))
        have hy_im : |y.im| < δ_seed := by
          have him_eq : y.im = (y - (y₀.re : ℂ)).im := by
            simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
          rw [him_eq]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _)
            (lt_of_lt_of_le hy_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        exact hs_band₀_even_seed y t₀ hy_mem hy_im
      exact hVertUniq Ω_mid Ω_mid f_neg s_band₀ y₀ t₀ δ₀
        hΩ_conv hΩ_conv hf_neg_holo hs_band₀_holo ⟨hy₀, hy₀⟩ hy₀_nonneg hδ₀_pos h_seed_ball
  · intro p hp
    have h_steep_seed : ∀ q ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init, |q.1.im| < δ_seed →
        s_band₀ q = s_steep q := by
      intro q hq hq_im
      obtain ⟨hq_bh, _⟩ := hU_mid_seed q hq.1 hq_im
      rw [hs_band₀_seed q hq.1 hq_im, (hs_steep_base q hq.2 hq_bh.1 hq_bh.2).symm]
    rcases lt_or_ge p.1.im 0 with hp_neg | hp_nonneg
    · refine h_steep_seed p hp ?_
      rw [abs_of_neg hp_neg]
      have h21 := hp.1.2.1
      linarith only [h21]
    · have hp_re_mem : ((p.1.re : ℂ), p.2) ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init :=
        ⟨by
          have h0 := hΩ_conv.2 p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp_nonneg 0 le_rfl hp_nonneg
          simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using h0,
         by
          have h0 := hW_conv.2 p.1 p.2 hp.2 hp_nonneg 0 le_rfl hp_nonneg
          simpa only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using h0⟩
      have h_slice_open : IsOpen { y : ℂ | (y, p.2) ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init } :=
        (hΩ_open.inter hW_open).preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_ball⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp h_slice_open (p.1.re : ℂ) hp_re_mem
      let δ₀ : ℝ := min δ₁ δ_seed
      have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hδ₁_pos hδ_seed_pos
      have h_seed_ball : ∀ y : ℂ, ‖y - (p.1.re : ℂ)‖ < δ₀ →
          s_band₀ (y, p.2) = s_steep (y, p.2) := by
        intro y hy_ball
        have hy_mem : (y, p.2) ∈ Ω_mid ∩ W_steep_init :=
          hδ₁_ball (by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy_ball (min_le_left _ _))
        have hy_im : |y.im| < δ_seed := by
          have him_eq : y.im = (y - (p.1.re : ℂ)).im := by
            simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
          rw [him_eq]
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _)
            (lt_of_lt_of_le hy_ball (min_le_right _ _))
        exact h_steep_seed (y, p.2) hy_mem hy_im
      exact hVertUniq Ω_mid W_steep_init s_band₀ s_steep p.1 p.2 δ₀
        hΩ_conv hW_conv hs_band₀_holo hs_steep_holo hp hp_nonneg hδ₀_pos h_seed_ball

by
  intro X hD_strip P α γ_rec hα1 hα2 hγ1 hγ2 x₀ h_ref d δ_top m₀ R_par M_scale C_disp s_cone
    hd h4d hm₀ hR_par hM_scale hC_disp Ω_rec hShape hs_holo hs_disp hs_steep_rec
    y t₀ δ_y hδ_lo hδ_hi hy_re ht₀_ne ht₀_lt hR_le h_sf_cond h_disp_cond
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_y := by linarith

  
  have hΩ_open : IsOpen Ω_rec := by
    have hc_im : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1.im) :=
      Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst
    have hc_depth : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => h_ref - p.1.im) :=
      continuous_const.sub hc_im
    have hc_re : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => |p.1.re - x₀|) :=
      continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)
    have hc_cone : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => m₀ * (h_ref - p.1.im)) :=
      continuous_const.mul hc_depth
    have hc_t : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ‖p.2‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc_depth).inter <|
      (isOpen_lt hc_depth continuous_const).inter <|
        (isOpen_lt hc_re hc_cone).inter (isOpen_lt hc_t continuous_const)

  have h_ball_in_Ω : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4),
      ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y ≤ h_ref - z.im ∧ (z, t') ∈ Ω_rec := by
    intro z hz t' ht'
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have him_abs : |z.im - y.im| ≤ δ_y / 4 := by
      have h1 : |(z - y).im| ≤ ‖z - y‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - y)
      simpa using le_trans h1 hz
    have hre_abs : |z.re - y.re| ≤ δ_y / 4 := by
      have h1 : |(z - y).re| ≤ ‖z - y‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - y)
      simpa using le_trans h1 hz
    have him_bounds := abs_le.mp him_abs
    have h_depth_lo : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y ≤ h_ref - z.im := by
      dsimp [δ_y] at *; linarith
    have h_depth_hi : h_ref - z.im ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y := by
      dsimp [δ_y] at *; linarith
    refine ⟨h_depth_lo, ?_, ?_, ?_, ht'⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · have htri : |z.re - x₀| ≤ |z.re - y.re| + |y.re - x₀| := abs_sub_le z.re y.re x₀
      have hre_sum : |z.re - x₀| < m₀ * ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y) := by linarith
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hre_sum (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_depth_lo (by linarith))

  let g : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun t' z => s_cone (z, t') - z
  let B_disp : ℝ := 2 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α)
  have hB_disp_le : B_disp ≤ δ_y / 512 := by
    have hrpow_split : δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) = δ_y * δ_y ^ (-2 * α) := by
      have heq : (1 : ℝ) - 2 * α = 1 + (-2 * α) := by ring
      rw [heq, Real.rpow_add hδ_pos 1 (-2 * α), Real.rpow_one]
    have hB_eq : B_disp = (1 / 32 : ℝ) * (64 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (-2 * α)) * δ_y := by
      dsimp [B_disp]
      rw [hrpow_split]
      ring
    rw [hB_eq]
    have h1 : (1 / 32 : ℝ) * (64 * C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * δ_y ^ (-2 * α)) ≤
        (1 / 32 : ℝ) * (1 / 16) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_disp_cond (by norm_num)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hδ_pos.le
    linarith

  have hg_bound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4), ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      ‖g t' z‖ ≤ B_disp := by
    intro z hz t' ht'
    obtain ⟨h_depth_lo, h_mem⟩ := h_ball_in_Ω z hz t' ht'
    have hdisp := hs_disp z t' h_mem
    have h_half_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y ≤ h_ref - z.im := by linarith
    have hrpow1 : (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) h_half_le (by linarith)
    have hrpow2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) ^ (1 - 2 * α) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) :=
      Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hδ_pos.le
    have h_two_pow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ 2 := by
      have heq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) := by
        calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * α)
            = ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by norm_num
          _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-1 : ℝ) * (1 - 2 * α)) := (Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) _ _).symm
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) := by ring_nf
      rw [heq]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * α - 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
    have hrpow_le : (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ≤ 2 * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α) := by
      rw [hrpow2] at hrpow1
      exact le_trans hrpow1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_two_pow (by positivity))
    have h_depth_pos : 0 < h_ref - z.im := by linarith
    have ht_sq : ‖t'‖ ^ 2 ≤ R_par ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg t') ht'.le 2
    calc ‖g t' z‖
        ≤ C_disp * ‖t'‖ ^ 2 * (h_ref - z.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) := hdisp
      _ ≤ C_disp * R_par ^ 2 * (2 * δ_y ^ (1 - 2 * α)) := by
          refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht_sq hC_disp) hrpow_le
            (Real.rpow_nonneg h_depth_pos.le _) (by positivity)
      _ = B_disp := by dsimp [B_disp]; ring

  
  have hg_at : ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4), DifferentiableAt ℂ (g t') z := by
    intro t' ht' z hz
    have h_mem : (z, t') ∈ Ω_rec := (h_ball_in_Ω z hz t' ht').2
    have hs_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ s_cone (z, t') :=
      hs_holo.differentiableAt (hΩ_open.mem_nhds h_mem)
    have h_pair : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (w, t')) z :=
      differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const t')
    exact (hs_at.comp z h_pair).sub differentiableAt_id

  have hg_deriv_bound : ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8), ‖deriv (g t') w‖ ≤ 1 / 64 := by
    intro t' ht' w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw
    have h_sub_cb : Metric.closedBall w (δ_y / 8) ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall' (by linarith)
    have hg_on4 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (g t') (Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4)) :=
      fun z hz => (hg_at t' ht' z hz).differentiableWithinAt
    have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (g t') (Metric.ball w (δ_y / 8)) :=
      hg_on4.diffContOnCl_ball h_sub_cb
    have h_sph : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere w (δ_y / 8), ‖g t' ζ‖ ≤ B_disp :=
      fun ζ hζ => hg_bound ζ (h_sub_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ)) t' ht'
    have hcauchy :=
      Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le (by positivity : 0 < δ_y / 8) hdc h_sph
    calc ‖deriv (g t') w‖
        ≤ B_disp / (δ_y / 8) := hcauchy
      _ ≤ (δ_y / 512) / (δ_y / 8) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hB_disp_le (by positivity)
      _ = 1 / 64 := by field_simp [hδ_pos.ne']; ring

  let U_punc : Set ℂ := { t' : ℂ | ‖t'‖ < R_par ∧ t' ≠ 0 }
  let s_prev_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' => s_cone (y - t', t')
  let s_curr_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' => s_cone (y, t')
  let s_next_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' => s_cone (y + t', t')
  let J_prev_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' => (s_curr_fn t' - s_prev_fn t') / t'
  let J_curr_fn : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' => (s_next_fn t' - s_curr_fn t') / t'

  have h_shifts_in_ball8 : ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      y - t' ∈ Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8) ∧
      y ∈ Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8) ∧
      y + t' ∈ Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8) := by
    intro t' ht'
    have ht'_lt8 : ‖t'‖ < δ_y / 8 := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity), ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have : y - t' - y = -t' := by ring
      rw [this, norm_neg]
      exact ht'_lt8
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have : y + t' - y = t' := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact ht'_lt8

  have h_ball8_sub_cb4 : Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8) ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (δ_y / 4) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    linarith

  have h_shifts_in_Ω : ∀ t' : ℂ, ‖t'‖ < R_par →
      (y - t', t') ∈ Ω_rec ∧ (y, t') ∈ Ω_rec ∧ (y + t', t') ∈ Ω_rec := by
    intro t' ht'
    obtain ⟨hm, hc, hp⟩ := h_shifts_in_ball8 t' ht'
    exact ⟨(h_ball_in_Ω _ (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hm) t' ht').2,
      (h_ball_in_Ω _ (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hc) t' ht').2,
      (h_ball_in_Ω _ (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hp) t' ht').2⟩

  have h_state_bounds : ∀ t' ∈ U_punc,
      ‖s_curr_fn t' - y‖ < (δ_y / 2) / 4 ∧
      ‖s_prev_fn t' - y‖ < (δ_y / 2) / 4 ∧
      ‖J_curr_fn t' - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧
      ‖J_prev_fn t' - 1‖ < 1 / 4 := by
    intro t' ⟨ht'_lt, ht'_ne⟩
    have ht'_pos : 0 < ‖t'‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ht'_ne
    obtain ⟨hm8, hc8, hp8⟩ := h_shifts_in_ball8 t' ht'_lt
    have hg_at8 : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y (δ_y / 8), DifferentiableAt ℂ (g t') w :=
      fun w hw => hg_at t' ht'_lt w (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hw)
    have hmvt_curr : ‖g t' (y + t') - g t' y‖ ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * ‖(y + t') - y‖ :=
      (convex_ball y (δ_y / 8)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        hg_at8 (hg_deriv_bound t' ht'_lt) hc8 hp8
    have hmvt_prev : ‖g t' y - g t' (y - t')‖ ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) * ‖y - (y - t')‖ :=
      (convex_ball y (δ_y / 8)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        hg_at8 (hg_deriv_bound t' ht'_lt) hm8 hc8
    have hJ_curr_eq : J_curr_fn t' - 1 = (g t' (y + t') - g t' y) / t' := by
      dsimp [J_curr_fn, s_next_fn, s_curr_fn, g]
      field_simp [ht'_ne]
      ring
    have hJ_prev_eq : J_prev_fn t' - 1 = (g t' y - g t' (y - t')) / t' := by
      dsimp [J_prev_fn, s_curr_fn, s_prev_fn, g]
      field_simp [ht'_ne]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ‖g t' y‖ ≤ B_disp := hg_bound y (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hc8) t' ht'_lt
      change ‖g t' y‖ < (δ_y / 2) / 4
      linarith
    · have hs_prev_eq : s_prev_fn t' - y = g t' (y - t') - t' := by
        dsimp [s_prev_fn, g]; ring
      rw [hs_prev_eq]
      have h1 : ‖g t' (y - t') - t'‖ ≤ ‖g t' (y - t')‖ + ‖t'‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      have h2 : ‖g t' (y - t')‖ ≤ B_disp := hg_bound (y - t') (h_ball8_sub_cb4 hm8) t' ht'_lt
      linarith
    · rw [hJ_curr_eq, norm_div]
      have hsub : (y + t') - y = t' := by ring
      rw [hsub] at hmvt_curr
      have hdiv : ‖g t' (y + t') - g t' y‖ / ‖t'‖ ≤ 1 / 64 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ ht'_pos).mpr hmvt_curr
      linarith
    · rw [hJ_prev_eq, norm_div]
      have hsub : y - (y - t') = t' := by ring
      rw [hsub] at hmvt_prev
      have hdiv : ‖g t' y - g t' (y - t')‖ / ‖t'‖ ≤ 1 / 64 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ ht'_pos).mpr hmvt_prev
      linarith

  
  let r_s : ℝ := δ_y / 2
  let r_t : ℝ := 2 * R_par
  let M₀ : ℝ := 2 * M_scale * δ_y ^ (-α)
  let U_act : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - y‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t }
  let F_act : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => P.p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2

  have hF_act_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_act U_act := by
    refine (P.small_field y r_s r_t M₀
      (by dsimp [r_s]; positivity)
      (by dsimp [r_t]; positivity)
      (by dsimp [r_s, r_t]; linarith)
      (by dsimp [M₀]; positivity)
      (by
        have heq : r_t * M₀ = 4 * R_par * M_scale * δ_y ^ (-α) := by
          dsimp [r_t, M₀]; ring
        rw [heq]; exact h_sf_cond)
      (by rw [hD_strip]; exact Set.subset_univ _)
      ?_).1
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    have him_lt : |w.im - y.im| < δ_y / 2 := by
      have h1 : |(w - y).im| ≤ ‖w - y‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - y)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa using h1) (by dsimp [r_s] at hw; exact hw)
    have him_bounds := abs_lt.mp him_lt
    have hw_lo : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y < h_ref - w.im := by dsimp [δ_y] at *; linarith
    have hw_hi : h_ref - w.im < (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y := by dsimp [δ_y] at *; linarith
    have hw_d : d ≤ h_ref - w.im := by linarith
    have hw_top : h_ref - w.im ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_top := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hf_w, hq_w⟩ := hShape w hw_d hw_top
    have hrpow1 : (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) ^ (-α) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hw_lo.le (by linarith)
    have hrpow2 : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) ^ (-α) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) * δ_y ^ (-α) :=
      Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hδ_pos.le
    have h_two_α : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) ≤ 2 := by
      have heq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-α) = (2 : ℝ) ^ α := by
        calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)
            = ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (-α) := by norm_num
          _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℝ)) ^ (-α) := by rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ ((-1 : ℝ) * (-α)) := (Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num) _ _).symm
          _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ α := by ring_nf
      rw [heq]
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ α ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        _ = 2 := Real.rpow_one 2
    have h_bound_M₀ : M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ≤ M₀ := by
      have hrpow_le : (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α) ≤ 2 * δ_y ^ (-α) := by
        rw [hrpow2] at hrpow1
        exact le_trans hrpow1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_two_α (by positivity))
      calc M_scale * (h_ref - w.im) ^ (-α)
          ≤ M_scale * (2 * δ_y ^ (-α)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_le hM_scale.le
        _ = M₀ := by dsimp [M₀]; ring
    exact ⟨le_trans hf_w h_bound_M₀, le_trans hq_w h_bound_M₀⟩

  have hU_act_open : IsOpen U_act := by
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => ‖q.1 - y‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const)
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => ‖q.2.1 - 1‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const)
    have hc3 : Continuous (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => ‖q.2.2‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
    exact (isOpen_lt hc1 continuous_const).inter <|
      (isOpen_lt hc2 continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt hc3 continuous_const)

  
  have h_param_deriv_at :
      ∀ (t₁ : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < ε → DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ε) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun t' => deriv (fun w => Φ (t', w)) 0) t₁ := by
    intro t₁ ε Φ hε hΦ
    let r : ℝ := ε / 4
    have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
    let K : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) (3 * r)
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ Metric.ball (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ε := by
      intro p hp
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have hp' : dist p (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ≤ 3 * r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp
      dsimp [r] at hp'
      linarith
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) (3 * r)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hΦ.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
    let M₁ : ℝ := max M 0
    have hM₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ M₁ := le_max_right _ _
    have h_in_K : ∀ t' w : ℂ, dist t' t₁ ≤ 2 * r → ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * r → (t', w) ∈ K := by
      intro t' w ht' hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq]
      exact max_le (by linarith) (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith)
    have hΦ_at_K : ∀ p ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ p :=
      fun p hp => hΦ.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hK_sub hp))
    let w_fn : ℝ → ℂ := circleMap 0 r
    let κ_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => deriv (circleMap 0 r) θ * ((w_fn θ - 0) ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hw_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖w_fn θ‖ = r := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [w_fn]
      rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hr]
    have hw_sq_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, (w_fn θ - 0) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro θ
      rw [sub_zero]
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_pos_iff.mp (by rw [hw_norm θ]; exact hr))
    have hderiv_cm_eq : deriv (circleMap 0 r) = fun θ => w_fn θ * Complex.I :=
      funext (deriv_circleMap 0 r)
    have hκ_cont : Continuous κ_fn := by
      dsimp [κ_fn]
      rw [hderiv_cm_eq]
      exact ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const).mul
        ((((continuous_circleMap 0 r).sub continuous_const).pow 2).inv₀ hw_sq_ne)
    have hκ_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖κ_fn θ‖ = r⁻¹ := by
      intro θ
      dsimp [κ_fn]
      rw [deriv_circleMap, sub_zero, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
        norm_inv, norm_pow, hw_norm θ]
      field_simp [hr.ne']
    let G_int : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun t' θ => κ_fn θ * Φ (t', w_fn θ)
    let G_int' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ :=
      fun t' θ => κ_fn θ * ((fderiv ℂ Φ (t', w_fn θ)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
    have hG_cont_θ : ∀ t' ∈ Metric.ball t₁ r, Continuous (G_int t') := by
      intro t' ht'
      have ht'_le : dist t' t₁ ≤ 2 * r := le_trans (Metric.mem_ball.mp ht').le (by linarith)
      refine hκ_cont.mul <| hΦ.continuousOn.comp_continuous
        (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap 0 r)) fun θ =>
          hK_sub (h_in_K t' (w_fn θ) ht'_le (by rw [hw_norm θ]; linarith))
    have hG_meas : ∀ᶠ t' in nhds t₁,
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (G_int t')
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₁ hr] with t' ht'
      exact (hG_cont_θ t' ht').aestronglyMeasurable
    have hG_int : IntervalIntegrable (G_int t₁) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hG_cont_θ t₁ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hG'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (G_int' t₁)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      have hm_pt : Measurable (fun θ : ℝ => (t₁, w_fn θ)) :=
        (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap 0 r)).measurable
      have hm_fd : Measurable (fun θ : ℝ => (fderiv ℂ Φ (t₁, w_fn θ)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))).continuous.measurable.comp
          ((measurable_fderiv ℂ Φ).comp hm_pt)
      exact (hκ_cont.measurable.mul hm_fd).aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_has_deriv : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ t' ∈ Metric.ball t₁ r,
        HasDerivAt (fun ζ => G_int ζ θ) (G_int' t' θ) t' := by
      intro θ t' ht'
      have ht'_le : dist t' t₁ ≤ 2 * r := le_trans (Metric.mem_ball.mp ht').le (by linarith)
      have hp_K : (t', w_fn θ) ∈ K := h_in_K t' (w_fn θ) ht'_le (by rw [hw_norm θ]; linarith)
      have hd_inner : HasDerivAt (fun ζ : ℂ => (ζ, w_fn θ)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) t' :=
        (hasDerivAt_id t').prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t' (w_fn θ))
      exact ((hΦ_at_K _ hp_K).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t' hd_inner).const_mul (κ_fn θ)
    have h_bound : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ t' ∈ Metric.ball t₁ r, ‖G_int' t' θ‖ ≤ M₁ / r ^ 2 := by
      intro θ t' ht'
      have ht'_lt : dist t' t₁ < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp ht'
      have h_cb_in_K : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall t' r, (ζ, w_fn θ) ∈ K := by
        intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_le : dist ζ t' ≤ r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hζ
        have h_dist : dist ζ t₁ ≤ 2 * r := by
          calc dist ζ t₁ ≤ dist ζ t' + dist t' t₁ := dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add hζ_le ht'_lt.le
            _ = 2 * r := by ring
        exact h_in_K ζ (w_fn θ) h_dist (by rw [hw_norm θ]; linarith)
      have h_slice_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun ζ => Φ (ζ, w_fn θ)) (Metric.closedBall t' r) := by
        intro ζ hζ
        exact ((hΦ_at_K _ (h_cb_in_K ζ hζ)).comp ζ
          (differentiableAt_id.prodMk (differentiableAt_const (w_fn θ)))).differentiableWithinAt
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun ζ => Φ (ζ, w_fn θ)) (Metric.ball t' r) :=
        h_slice_on.diffContOnCl_ball Set.Subset.rfl
      have h_sph : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.sphere t' r, ‖Φ (ζ, w_fn θ)‖ ≤ M₁ := fun ζ hζ =>
        le_trans (hM _ (h_cb_in_K ζ (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hζ))) (le_max_left _ _)
      have hcauchy := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr hdc h_sph
      have hd_eq : ((fderiv ℂ Φ (t', w_fn θ)) ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ))) =
          deriv (fun ζ => Φ (ζ, w_fn θ)) t' := by
        have ht'_le : dist t' t₁ ≤ 2 * r := le_trans ht'_lt.le (by linarith)
        have hp_K : (t', w_fn θ) ∈ K := h_in_K t' (w_fn θ) ht'_le (by rw [hw_norm θ]; linarith)
        exact (((hΦ_at_K _ hp_K).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t'
          ((hasDerivAt_id t').prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t' (w_fn θ))))).deriv.symm
      dsimp [G_int']
      rw [norm_mul, hκ_norm θ, hd_eq]
      calc r⁻¹ * ‖deriv (fun ζ => Φ (ζ, w_fn θ)) t'‖
          ≤ r⁻¹ * (M₁ / r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcauchy (by positivity)
        _ = M₁ / r ^ 2 := by field_simp [hr.ne']
    have h_int_deriv :=
      (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₁ hr) hG_meas hG_int hG'_meas
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ t' ht' => h_bound θ t' ht')
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ t' ht' => h_has_deriv θ t' ht')).2
    have h_int_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
        (fun t' => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_int t' θ) t₁ :=
      h_int_deriv.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    have h_rep : (fun t' => deriv (fun w => Φ (t', w)) 0) =ᶠ[nhds t₁]
        (fun t' => (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_int t' θ) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₁ hr] with t' ht'
      have ht'_le : dist t' t₁ ≤ 2 * r := le_trans (Metric.mem_ball.mp ht').le (by linarith)
      have hw_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => Φ (t', w)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_le : ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * r := ( by simpa using Metric.mem_ball.mp hw : ‖w‖ < 2 * r ).le
        exact ((hΦ_at_K _ (h_in_K t' w ht'_le hw_le)).comp w
          ((differentiableAt_const t').prodMk differentiableAt_id)).differentiableWithinAt
      have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r) := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        have : dist w 0 ≤ r := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hw
        linarith
      rw [← Complex.cderiv_eq_deriv Metric.isOpen_ball hw_on hr hcb_sub]
      simp only [Complex.cderiv, circleIntegral, smul_eq_mul, G_int, κ_fn, w_fn, mul_assoc]
    exact h_int_diff.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_rep

  have hU_punc_open : IsOpen U_punc :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const).inter (isOpen_ne.preimage continuous_id)

  have hs_prev_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_prev_fn U_punc :=
    hs_holo.comp ((differentiableOn_const y).sub differentiableOn_id |>.prodMk differentiableOn_id)
      (fun t' ht' => (h_shifts_in_Ω t' ht'.1).1)
  have hs_curr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_curr_fn U_punc :=
    hs_holo.comp ((differentiableOn_const y).prodMk differentiableOn_id)
      (fun t' ht' => (h_shifts_in_Ω t' ht'.1).2.1)
  have hs_next_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_next_fn U_punc :=
    hs_holo.comp ((differentiableOn_const y).add differentiableOn_id |>.prodMk differentiableOn_id)
      (fun t' ht' => (h_shifts_in_Ω t' ht'.1).2.2)

  have hJ_prev_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_prev_fn U_punc :=
    (hs_curr_holo.sub hs_prev_holo).div differentiableOn_id (fun _ ht' => ht'.2)
  have hJ_curr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_curr_fn U_punc :=
    (hs_next_holo.sub hs_curr_holo).div differentiableOn_id (fun _ ht' => ht'.2)

  have hdJ_curve_holo : ∀ (a b : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ a U_punc → DifferentiableOn ℂ b U_punc →
      (∀ t' ∈ U_punc, (a t', (b t', t')) ∈ U_act) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t' => deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (a t') J' t') (b t')) U_punc := by
    intro a b ha hb hmaps t₁ ht₁
    let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (a p.1, (p.2 + b p.1, p.1))
    let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ U_punc ∧ Ψ p ∈ U_act }
    have hΨ_holo_all : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (U_punc ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (ha.comp differentiableOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1)).prodMk <|
        (differentiableOn_snd.add (hb.comp differentiableOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1))).prodMk
          differentiableOn_fst
    have hW_nhds : W ∈ nhds (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) := by
      have h1 : U_punc ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ) ∈ nhds (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) :=
        (hU_punc_open.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨ht₁, trivial⟩
      have hΨ_cont : ContinuousAt Ψ (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) :=
        (hΨ_holo_all.differentiableAt h1).continuousAt
      have hΨ_mem : Ψ (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_act := by
        simpa [Ψ] using hmaps t₁ ht₁
      exact Filter.inter_mem
        (continuous_fst.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hU_punc_open.mem_nhds ht₁))
        (hΨ_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (hU_act_open.mem_nhds hΨ_mem))
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball_W⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW_nhds
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_act ∘ Ψ) (Metric.ball (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ε) :=
      hF_act_holo.comp
        (hΨ_holo_all.mono fun p hp => ⟨(hball_W hp).1, trivial⟩)
        (fun p hp => (hball_W hp).2)
    have h_at := h_param_deriv_at t₁ ε (F_act ∘ Ψ) hε hΦ_holo
    have h_eq : (fun t' => deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (a t') J' t') (b t')) =
        (fun t' => deriv (fun w => (F_act ∘ Ψ) (t', w)) 0) := by
      ext t'
      have hshift := deriv_comp_add_const (fun J' => P.p_act (a t') J' t') (b t') (0 : ℂ)
      simpa [F_act, Ψ] using hshift.symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_at.differentiableWithinAt

  have hdS_curve_holo : ∀ (a b : ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ a U_punc → DifferentiableOn ℂ b U_punc →
      (∀ t' ∈ U_punc, (a t', (b t', t')) ∈ U_act) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t' => deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (b t') t') (a t')) U_punc := by
    intro a b ha hb hmaps t₁ ht₁
    let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.2 + a p.1, (b p.1, p.1))
    let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ U_punc ∧ Ψ p ∈ U_act }
    have hΨ_holo_all : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ψ (U_punc ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (differentiableOn_snd.add (ha.comp differentiableOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1))).prodMk <|
        (hb.comp differentiableOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1)).prodMk differentiableOn_fst
    have hW_nhds : W ∈ nhds (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) := by
      have h1 : U_punc ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ) ∈ nhds (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) :=
        (hU_punc_open.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨ht₁, trivial⟩
      have hΨ_cont : ContinuousAt Ψ (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) :=
        (hΨ_holo_all.differentiableAt h1).continuousAt
      have hΨ_mem : Ψ (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ U_act := by
        simpa [Ψ] using hmaps t₁ ht₁
      exact Filter.inter_mem
        (continuous_fst.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hU_punc_open.mem_nhds ht₁))
        (hΨ_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (hU_act_open.mem_nhds hΨ_mem))
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball_W⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW_nhds
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_act ∘ Ψ) (Metric.ball (t₁, (0 : ℂ)) ε) :=
      hF_act_holo.comp
        (hΨ_holo_all.mono fun p hp => ⟨(hball_W hp).1, trivial⟩)
        (fun p hp => (hball_W hp).2)
    have h_at := h_param_deriv_at t₁ ε (F_act ∘ Ψ) hε hΦ_holo
    have h_eq : (fun t' => deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (b t') t') (a t')) =
        (fun t' => deriv (fun w => (F_act ∘ Ψ) (t', w)) 0) := by
      ext t'
      have hshift := deriv_comp_add_const (fun s' => P.p_act s' (b t') t') (a t') (0 : ℂ)
      simpa [F_act, Ψ] using hshift.symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_at.differentiableWithinAt

  have hγ_curr_maps : ∀ t' ∈ U_punc, (s_curr_fn t', (J_curr_fn t', t')) ∈ U_act := by
    intro t' ht'
    obtain ⟨hsc, _, hJc, _⟩ := h_state_bounds t' ht'
    exact ⟨hsc, hJc, by dsimp [r_t]; linarith [ht'.1]⟩
  have hγ_prev_maps : ∀ t' ∈ U_punc, (s_prev_fn t', (J_prev_fn t', t')) ∈ U_act := by
    intro t' ht'
    obtain ⟨_, hsp, _, hJp⟩ := h_state_bounds t' ht'
    exact ⟨hsp, hJp, by dsimp [r_t]; linarith [ht'.1]⟩

  let F_res : ℂ → ℂ := fun t' =>
    deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_curr_fn t') J' t') (J_curr_fn t') -
      t' * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' (J_curr_fn t') t') (s_curr_fn t') -
      deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (s_prev_fn t') J' t') (J_prev_fn t')

  have hF_res_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_res U_punc :=
    ((hdJ_curve_holo s_curr_fn J_curr_fn hs_curr_holo hJ_curr_holo hγ_curr_maps).sub
      (differentiableOn_id.mul
        (hdS_curve_holo s_curr_fn J_curr_fn hs_curr_holo hJ_curr_holo hγ_curr_maps))).sub
      (hdJ_curve_holo s_prev_fn J_prev_fn hs_prev_holo hJ_prev_holo hγ_prev_maps)

  have hF_res_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F_res U_punc :=
    hF_res_holo.analyticOnNhd hU_punc_open

  
  have h_prop : ∀ (H V : Set ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ),
      H ⊆ U_punc → Convex ℝ H → IsOpen V → V ⊆ H → w₀ ∈ V →
      (∀ t' ∈ V, F_res t' = 0) → ∀ t' ∈ H, F_res t' = 0 := by
    intro H V w₀ hH_sub hH_conv hV_open hV_sub hw₀ hV_zero t' ht'
    have h_ev : F_res =ᶠ[nhds w₀] 0 :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hw₀) hV_zero
    have h_eqOn :=
      (hF_res_ana.mono hH_sub).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hH_conv.isPreconnected (hV_sub hw₀) h_ev
    simpa using h_eqOn ht'

  let H_up : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par ∩ { t' : ℂ | 0 < t'.im }
  let H_right : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par ∩ { t' : ℂ | 0 < t'.re }
  let H_left : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par ∩ { t' : ℂ | t'.re < 0 }
  let H_down : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par ∩ { t' : ℂ | t'.im < 0 }

  have hH_up_open : IsOpen H_up :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)
  have hH_right_open : IsOpen H_right :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re)
  have hH_left_open : IsOpen H_left :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const)
  have hH_down_open : IsOpen H_down :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)

  have hH_up_sub : H_up ⊆ U_punc := by
    intro t' ⟨hb, him⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hb, ?_⟩
    intro h0; subst h0; simp at him
  have hH_right_sub : H_right ⊆ U_punc := by
    intro t' ⟨hb, hre⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hb, ?_⟩
    intro h0; subst h0; simp at hre
  have hH_left_sub : H_left ⊆ U_punc := by
    intro t' ⟨hb, hre⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hb, ?_⟩
    intro h0; subst h0; simp at hre
  have hH_down_sub : H_down ⊆ U_punc := by
    intro t' ⟨hb, him⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hb, ?_⟩
    intro h0; subst h0; simp at him

  have hH_up_conv : Convex ℝ H_up :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R_par).inter
      ((convex_Ioi (0 : ℝ)).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap)
  have hH_right_conv : Convex ℝ H_right :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R_par).inter
      ((convex_Ioi (0 : ℝ)).linear_preimage Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap)
  have hH_left_conv : Convex ℝ H_left :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R_par).inter
      ((convex_Iio (0 : ℝ)).linear_preimage Complex.reCLM.toLinearMap)
  have hH_down_conv : Convex ℝ H_down :=
    (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) R_par).inter
      ((convex_Iio (0 : ℝ)).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap)

  
  let V_steep : Set ℂ := { t' : ℂ | ‖t'‖ < R_par ∧ γ_rec * ‖t'‖ < t'.im }
  have hV_steep_open : IsOpen V_steep :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm) Complex.continuous_im)
  have hV_steep_sub : V_steep ⊆ H_up := by
    intro t' ⟨ht'_lt, ht'_im⟩
    exact ⟨by simpa using ht'_lt, lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) ht'_im⟩
  let w_up : ℂ := ((R_par / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hw_up_mem : w_up ∈ V_steep := by
    have hw_norm : ‖w_up‖ = R_par / 2 := by
      dsimp [w_up]
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have hw_im : w_up.im = R_par / 2 := by simp [w_up]
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    rw [hw_norm, hw_im]
    nlinarith
  have hV_steep_zero : ∀ t' ∈ V_steep, F_res t' = 0 := by
    intro t' ⟨ht'_lt, ht'_steep⟩
    obtain ⟨hmΩ, hcΩ, hpΩ⟩ := h_shifts_in_Ω t' ht'_lt
    have hrec := hs_steep_rec y t' ht'_steep hmΩ hcΩ hpΩ
    dsimp [F_res, s_curr_fn, s_prev_fn, s_next_fn, J_curr_fn, J_prev_fn]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hrec
  have hZero_up : ∀ t' ∈ H_up, F_res t' = 0 :=
    h_prop H_up V_steep w_up hH_up_sub hH_up_conv hV_steep_open hV_steep_sub hw_up_mem hV_steep_zero

  
  let w_ur : ℂ := ((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hw_ur_mem : w_ur ∈ H_up ∩ H_right := by
    have hw_norm : ‖w_ur‖ < R_par := by
      have h1 : ‖w_ur‖ ≤ ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      have h2 : ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h3 : ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h2]
      linarith
    have hw_ball : w_ur ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par := by simpa using hw_norm
    exact ⟨⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_ur]; positivity⟩, ⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_ur]; positivity⟩⟩
  have hZero_right : ∀ t' ∈ H_right, F_res t' = 0 :=
    h_prop H_right (H_up ∩ H_right) w_ur hH_right_sub hH_right_conv
      (hH_up_open.inter hH_right_open) Set.inter_subset_right hw_ur_mem
      (fun t' ht' => hZero_up t' ht'.1)

  
  let w_ul : ℂ := -((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hw_ul_mem : w_ul ∈ H_up ∩ H_left := by
    have hw_norm : ‖w_ul‖ < R_par := by
      have h1 : ‖w_ul‖ ≤ ‖-((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      have h2 : ‖-((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [norm_neg, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h3 : ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have hw_ball : w_ul ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par := by simpa using hw_norm
    exact ⟨⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_ul]; positivity⟩, ⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_ul]; linarith⟩⟩
  have hZero_left : ∀ t' ∈ H_left, F_res t' = 0 :=
    h_prop H_left (H_up ∩ H_left) w_ul hH_left_sub hH_left_conv
      (hH_up_open.inter hH_left_open) Set.inter_subset_right hw_ul_mem
      (fun t' ht' => hZero_up t' ht'.1)

  
  let w_dr : ℂ := ((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hw_dr_mem : w_dr ∈ H_right ∩ H_down := by
    have hw_norm : ‖w_dr‖ < R_par := by
      have h1 : ‖w_dr‖ ≤ ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ + ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ :=
        norm_sub_le _ _
      have h2 : ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h3 : ‖((R_par / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = R_par / 4 := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, h2]
      linarith
    have hw_ball : w_dr ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par := by simpa using hw_norm
    exact ⟨⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_dr]; positivity⟩, ⟨hw_ball, by simp [w_dr]; linarith⟩⟩
  have hZero_down : ∀ t' ∈ H_down, F_res t' = 0 :=
    h_prop H_down (H_right ∩ H_down) w_dr hH_down_sub hH_down_conv
      (hH_right_open.inter hH_down_open) Set.inter_subset_right hw_dr_mem
      (fun t' ht' => hZero_right t' ht'.1)

  
  have ht₀_ball : t₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R_par := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    linarith
  have hF_t₀ : F_res t₀ = 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy t₀.im 0 with him_neg | him_zero | him_pos
    · exact hZero_down t₀ ⟨ht₀_ball, him_neg⟩
    · have hre_ne : t₀.re ≠ 0 := by
        intro hre_zero
        apply ht₀_ne
        exact Complex.ext hre_zero him_zero
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hre_ne with hre_neg | hre_pos
      · exact hZero_left t₀ ⟨ht₀_ball, hre_neg⟩
      · exact hZero_right t₀ ⟨ht₀_ball, hre_pos⟩
    · exact hZero_up t₀ ⟨ht₀_ball, him_pos⟩
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hF_t₀

proof.tactics:
by
  let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
  let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
  let U_T_all : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star)
  have h_norm_c0_pos : 0 < ‖seq.c₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr seq.c₀_ne_zero
  have hT_pos : 0 < T_star := inv_pos.mpr h_norm_c0_pos
  have hTc_ne : (T_star : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hT_pos.ne'
  have h_norm_c0_ne : (‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_norm_c0_pos.ne'
  have h_unit : (expParamStar seq : ℂ) * seq.c₀ = Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    have h_pol := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I seq.c₀
    calc (expParamStar seq : ℂ) * seq.c₀
        = (‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * seq.c₀ := by simp [expParamStar]
      _ = (‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
            nth_rw 2 [← h_pol]
            rfl
      _ = ((‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * (‖seq.c₀‖ : ℂ)) * Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
            ring
      _ = Complex.exp ((expArgC0 seq : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
            rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h_norm_c0_ne, one_mul]
  have h_zero : expShearOffset (expParamStar seq) (expParamStar seq : ℂ) = 0 := by
    change -Complex.I * Complex.log ((T_star : ℂ) / (T_star : ℂ)) = 0
    rw [div_self hTc_ne, Complex.log_one, mul_zero]
  have h_slit_and_bounds : ∀ T : ℂ, ‖T - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star →
      T / (T_star : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧
      T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < 2 * T_star ∧
      |(expShearOffset T_star T).im| < 1 ∧
      |(expShearOffset T_star T).re| < 4 := by
    intro T hT
    set z : ℂ := T / (T_star : ℂ)
    have hTc_norm : ‖(T_star : ℂ)‖ = T_star := Complex.norm_of_nonneg hT_pos.le
    have hz_sub : z - 1 = (T - (T_star : ℂ)) / (T_star : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [sub_div, div_self hTc_ne]
    have hz_dist : ‖z - 1‖ < 15 / 32 := by
      rw [hz_sub, norm_div, hTc_norm]
      exact (div_lt_iff₀ hT_pos).mpr hT
    have hz_re_sub : |(z - 1).re| < 15 / 32 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - 1)) hz_dist
    have hz_re_gt : 17 / 32 < z.re := by
      have h1 : (z - 1).re = z.re - 1 := by simp
      rw [h1, abs_lt] at hz_re_sub
      linarith
    have hz_re_pos : 0 < z.re := by linarith
    have hz_slit : z ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hz_re_pos)
    have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : z.re = 0 := by simp [z, h0]
      linarith
    have hT_norm : ‖T‖ < 2 * T_star := by
      have h1 : ‖T‖ ≤ ‖T - (T_star : ℂ)‖ + ‖(T_star : ℂ)‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (T - (T_star : ℂ)) (T_star : ℂ)
      rw [hTc_norm] at h1
      linarith
    have hz_norm_gt : 1 / 2 < ‖z‖ := by
      have h1 : z.re ≤ |z.re| := le_abs_self z.re
      have h2 : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm z
      linarith
    have hz_norm_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := by linarith
    have hz_norm_lt : ‖z‖ < 2 := by
      have h1 : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (z - 1) 1
      simp only [norm_one] at h1
      linarith
    have hlog2_lt_one : Real.log 2 < 1 := by
      linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
    have h_log_lo : -1 < Real.log ‖z‖ := by
      have h1 : Real.log (1 / 2) < Real.log ‖z‖ := Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) hz_norm_gt
      have h2 : Real.log (1 / 2) = -Real.log 2 := by rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
      linarith
    have h_log_hi : Real.log ‖z‖ < 1 :=
      lt_trans (Real.log_lt_log hz_norm_pos hz_norm_lt) hlog2_lt_one
    have h_im_bound : |(expShearOffset T_star T).im| < 1 := by
      have h_im_eq : (expShearOffset T_star T).im = -Real.log ‖z‖ := by
        simp [expShearOffset, z, Complex.log_re]
      rw [h_im_eq, abs_neg, abs_lt]
      exact ⟨h_log_lo, h_log_hi⟩
    have h_re_bound : |(expShearOffset T_star T).re| < 4 := by
      have h_re_eq : (expShearOffset T_star T).re = Complex.arg z := by
        simp [expShearOffset, z, Complex.log_im]
      rw [h_re_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_arg_le_pi z) Real.pi_lt_four
    exact ⟨hz_slit, hT_ne, hT_norm, h_im_bound, h_re_bound⟩
  have h_shear_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (expShearOffset T_star) U_T_all := by
    have h_div_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun T : ℂ => T / (T_star : ℂ)) U_T_all :=
      differentiableOn_id.div_const (T_star : ℂ)
    have h_maps : ∀ T ∈ U_T_all, T / (T_star : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
      intro T hT
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hT
      exact (h_slit_and_bounds T hT).1
    exact (h_div_holo.clog h_maps).const_mul (-Complex.I)
  have h_shear_bounds : ∀ T ∈ U_T_all,
      T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < 2 * T_star ∧
      |(expShearOffset T_star T).im| < 1 ∧
      |(expShearOffset T_star T).re| < 4 := by
    intro T hT
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hT
    exact (h_slit_and_bounds T hT).2
  have h_cancel : ∀ Y_tilde T : ℂ,
      ‖T - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star →
      T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y_tilde + expShearOffset T_star T)) =
        expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde := by
    intro Y_tilde T hT
    have hb := h_slit_and_bounds T hT
    have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := hb.2.1
    set z : ℂ := T / (T_star : ℂ)
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hT_ne hTc_ne
    have h_exp_arg : -Complex.I * (Y_tilde + expShearOffset T_star T) =
        -Complex.I * Y_tilde - Complex.log z := by
      dsimp [expShearOffset, z]
      calc -Complex.I * (Y_tilde + -Complex.I * Complex.log (T / (T_star : ℂ)))
          = -Complex.I * Y_tilde + (Complex.I * Complex.I) * Complex.log (T / (T_star : ℂ)) := by
              ring
        _ = -Complex.I * Y_tilde - Complex.log (T / (T_star : ℂ)) := by
              rw [Complex.I_mul_I]
              ring
    rw [h_exp_arg, Complex.exp_sub, Complex.exp_log hz_ne]
    have h_alg : T * seq.c₀ * (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y_tilde) / z) =
        ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀) * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y_tilde) := by
      dsimp [z]
      field_simp [hT_ne, hTc_ne]
    rw [h_alg, h_unit, ← Complex.exp_add]
    unfold expShearedModelW
    congr 1
    dsimp [α_c]
    ring
  have hw_decomp : ∀ Y_tilde : ℂ,
      -Complex.I * (Y_tilde - (α_c : ℂ)) =
        (Y_tilde.im : ℂ) + ((α_c - Y_tilde.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    intro Y_tilde
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  have hw_norm : ∀ Y_tilde : ℂ, ‖expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde‖ = Real.exp Y_tilde.im := by
    intro Y_tilde
    unfold expShearedModelW
    rw [hw_decomp Y_tilde, Complex.norm_exp]
    simp
  have hw_polar : ∀ Y_tilde : ℂ,
      expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde =
        (Real.exp Y_tilde.im : ℂ) *
          (Complex.cos ((α_c - Y_tilde.re : ℝ) : ℂ) +
            Complex.sin ((α_c - Y_tilde.re : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    intro Y_tilde
    unfold expShearedModelW
    rw [hw_decomp Y_tilde, Complex.exp_add, Complex.ofReal_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I]
  have hw_re : ∀ Y_tilde : ℂ,
      (expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde).re =
        Real.exp Y_tilde.im * Real.cos (α_c - Y_tilde.re) := by
    intro Y_tilde
    rw [hw_polar Y_tilde, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have h_mem_lt_log_R : ∀ Y_tilde T : ℂ,
      ‖T - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M := by
    intro Y_tilde T hT h_im
    refine ⟨hT, Or.inl (Or.inl ?_)⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hw_norm]
    calc Real.exp Y_tilde.im < Real.exp (Real.log M.R) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h_im
      _ = M.R := Real.exp_log M.R_pos
  have h_mem_sector : ∀ (sgn : ℝ) (Y_tilde T : ℂ),
      (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ‖T - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star →
      Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν →
      |Y_tilde.re - (α_c - sgn * M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ →
      (Y_tilde, T) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M := by
    intro sgn Y_tilde T hsgn hT h_im_hi h_re
    by_cases h_im_lo : Y_tilde.im < Real.log M.R
    · exact h_mem_lt_log_R Y_tilde T hT h_im_lo
    · have h_im_ge : Real.log M.R ≤ Y_tilde.im := not_lt.mp h_im_lo
      have h_w_lo : M.R * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν) < ‖expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde‖ := by
        rw [hw_norm]
        have h1 : Real.log M.R + (-4 * M.ν) < Y_tilde.im := by linarith [M.ν_pos]
        calc M.R * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν)
            = Real.exp (Real.log M.R) * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν) := by rw [Real.exp_log M.R_pos]
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log M.R + (-4 * M.ν)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
          _ < Real.exp Y_tilde.im := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h1
      have h_w_hi : ‖expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde‖ < M.R * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) := by
        rw [hw_norm]
        calc Real.exp Y_tilde.im
            < Real.exp (Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h_im_hi
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log M.R) * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) := Real.exp_add _ _
          _ = M.R * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) := by rw [Real.exp_log M.R_pos]
      set ψ : ℝ := α_c - Y_tilde.re
      have hψ_dist : |ψ - sgn * M.θ| < 2 * M.δ_θ := by
        have h_neg : ψ - sgn * M.θ = -(Y_tilde.re - (α_c - sgn * M.θ)) := by dsimp [ψ]; ring
        rw [h_neg, abs_neg]
        exact h_re
      rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl
      · simp only [one_mul] at hψ_dist
        have hψ_bounds : -(Real.pi / 2) < ψ ∧ ψ < Real.pi / 2 := by
          have := abs_lt.mp hψ_dist
          constructor <;> linarith [M.θ_pos, M.θ_lt, M.δ_θ_lt]
        have hψ_Ioc : ψ ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hψ_bounds.1, hψ_bounds.2, Real.pi_pos]
        have h_cos_pos : 0 < Real.cos ψ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo hψ_bounds
        have hw_re_pos : 0 < (expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde).re := by
          rw [hw_re Y_tilde]
          exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) h_cos_pos
        have hw_arg : Complex.arg (expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde) = ψ := by
          rw [hw_polar Y_tilde]
          exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I (Real.exp_pos Y_tilde.im) hψ_Ioc
        refine ⟨hT, Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hw_re_pos, h_w_lo, h_w_hi, ?_⟩)⟩
        rwa [hw_arg]
      · have hψ_plus : |ψ + M.θ| < 2 * M.δ_θ := by
          have : ψ - (-1 : ℝ) * M.θ = ψ + M.θ := by ring
          rwa [this] at hψ_dist
        have hψ_bounds : -(Real.pi / 2) < ψ ∧ ψ < Real.pi / 2 := by
          have := abs_lt.mp hψ_plus
          constructor <;> linarith [M.θ_pos, M.θ_lt, M.δ_θ_lt]
        have hψ_Ioc : ψ ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := by
          constructor <;> linarith [hψ_bounds.1, hψ_bounds.2, Real.pi_pos]
        have h_cos_pos : 0 < Real.cos ψ := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo hψ_bounds
        have hw_re_pos : 0 < (expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde).re := by
          rw [hw_re Y_tilde]
          exact mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) h_cos_pos
        have hw_arg : Complex.arg (expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde) = ψ := by
          rw [hw_polar Y_tilde]
          exact Complex.arg_mul_cos_add_sin_mul_I (Real.exp_pos Y_tilde.im) hψ_Ioc
        refine ⟨hT, Or.inr ⟨hw_re_pos, h_w_lo, h_w_hi, ?_⟩⟩
        rwa [hw_arg]
  have h_open_sec : ∀ c : ℝ, IsOpen
      { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ M.R * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν) < ‖w‖ ∧
        ‖w‖ < M.R * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) ∧ |Complex.arg w - c| < 2 * M.δ_θ } := by
    intro c
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro w₀ hw₀
    rcases hw₀ with ⟨hw_re, hw_lo, hw_hi, hw_arg⟩
    have hw_slit : w₀ ∈ Complex.slitPlane := Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl hw_re)
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, 0 < w.re :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hw_re
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, M.R * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν) < ‖w‖ :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hw_lo
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, ‖w‖ < M.R * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const).mem_nhds hw_hi
    have h_cont_arg : ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ => |Complex.arg w - c|) w₀ :=
      ((Complex.continuousAt_arg hw_slit).sub continuousAt_const).abs
    have h4 : ∀ᶠ w in nhds w₀, |Complex.arg w - c| < 2 * M.δ_θ :=
      h_cont_arg.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hw_arg)
    filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3, h4] with w h1w h2w h3w h4w
    exact ⟨h1w, h2w, h3w, h4w⟩
  have h_open_inner : IsOpen (branchInnerDomain M.R M.ν M.θ M.δ_θ) := by
    have h_minus : branchSectorMinus M.R M.ν M.θ M.δ_θ =
        { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ M.R * Real.exp (-4 * M.ν) < ‖w‖ ∧
          ‖w‖ < M.R * Real.exp (2 * M.ν) ∧ |Complex.arg w - (-M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ } := by
      ext w
      simp [branchSectorMinus, sub_neg_eq_add]
    unfold branchInnerDomain branchSectorPlus
    rw [h_minus]
    exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.union (h_open_sec M.θ)).union (h_open_sec (-M.θ))
  have h_inner_reg : IsRegularFrozenModel seq
      (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M) := by
    have hw_diff : Differentiable ℂ (expShearedModelW α_c) := by
      unfold expShearedModelW
      fun_prop
    have h_dom_open : IsOpen (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) := by
      unfold expShearedInnerDomain
      exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const).norm continuous_const).inter
        (h_open_inner.preimage (hw_diff.continuous.comp continuous_fst))
    have h_mod_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (expShearedInnerModel seq M) (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => p.1) (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) :=
        differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => expShearOffset T_star p.2) (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) :=
        h_shear_holo.comp differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
          (fun p hp => by simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hp.1)
      have h3 : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => M.Δ_inner (expShearedModelW α_c p.1)) (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) :=
        M.Δ_inner_holo.comp (hw_diff.comp differentiable_fst).differentiableOn (fun p hp => hp.2)
      exact (h1.add h2).add h3
    refine ⟨h_dom_open, h_mod_holo, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    rcases p with ⟨Y_tilde, T⟩
    set w₀ : ℂ := expShearedModelW α_c Y_tilde
    have h_lam : T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * expShearedInnerModel seq M (Y_tilde, T)) =
        w₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * M.Δ_inner w₀) := by
      change T * seq.c₀ *
        Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y_tilde + expShearOffset T_star T + M.Δ_inner w₀)) =
        w₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * M.Δ_inner w₀)
      have h_split : -Complex.I * (Y_tilde + expShearOffset T_star T + M.Δ_inner w₀) =
          -Complex.I * (Y_tilde + expShearOffset T_star T) + (-Complex.I * M.Δ_inner w₀) := by
        ring
      rw [h_split, Complex.exp_add, ← mul_assoc, h_cancel Y_tilde T hp.1]
    have h_deriv_w : HasDerivAt (expShearedModelW α_c) (-Complex.I * w₀) Y_tilde := by
      have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => -Complex.I * (Y' - (α_c : ℂ))) (-Complex.I) Y_tilde := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id Y_tilde).sub_const (α_c : ℂ)).const_mul (-Complex.I)
      have h_cexp := h_lin.cexp
      have h_eq : Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (Y_tilde - (α_c : ℂ))) * (-Complex.I) =
          -Complex.I * w₀ := by
        dsimp [w₀, expShearedModelW]
        ring
      rwa [h_eq] at h_cexp
    have h_deriv_Δ : HasDerivAt M.Δ_inner (deriv M.Δ_inner w₀) w₀ :=
      (M.Δ_inner_holo.differentiableAt (h_open_inner.mem_nhds hp.2)).hasDerivAt
    have h_deriv_comp : HasDerivAt
        (fun Y' : ℂ => M.Δ_inner (expShearedModelW α_c Y'))
        (-Complex.I * w₀ * deriv M.Δ_inner w₀) Y_tilde := by
      have hc := h_deriv_Δ.comp Y_tilde h_deriv_w
      have h_eq : deriv M.Δ_inner w₀ * (-Complex.I * w₀) =
          -Complex.I * w₀ * deriv M.Δ_inner w₀ := by ring
      rwa [h_eq] at hc
    have h_deriv_S : HasDerivAt
        (fun Y' : ℂ => expShearedInnerModel seq M (Y', T))
        (1 - Complex.I * w₀ * deriv M.Δ_inner w₀) Y_tilde := by
      have h_id_sh : HasDerivAt (fun Y' : ℂ => Y' + expShearOffset T_star T) 1 Y_tilde :=
        (hasDerivAt_id Y_tilde).add_const (expShearOffset T_star T)
      have h_sum := h_id_sh.add h_deriv_comp
      have h_eq : 1 + (-Complex.I * w₀ * deriv M.Δ_inner w₀) =

              = expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (Y + expShearOffset T_star T) +
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * a_n := by ring
            _ = expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (Y + expShearOffset T_star T) +
                  T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) := by rw [h_la]
        · rfl
      unfold SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence
      dsimp only
      change deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y, T)) J'
            (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          (((expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y + a_n, T)) -
            (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y, T))) / (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))) -
        (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) *
          deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s'
            (((expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y + a_n, T)) -
              (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y, T))) / (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
            (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y, T)) =
        deriv (fun J' => P.p_act (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y - a_n, T)) J'
            (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          (((expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y, T)) -
            (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_sh (Y - a_n, T))) / (T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
      rw [h_curr_eq, h_prev_eq, h_next_eq]
      exact h_rec_Y₀
    · intro K hK_comp hK_sub
      have hK'_comp : IsCompact (Ψ '' K) :=
        hK_comp.image_of_continuousOn (hΨ_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
      have hK'_sub : Ψ '' K ⊆ coneSet := by
        rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
        exact (hΨ_maps q (hK_sub hq)).1
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₁, _, hN₁⟩ := h_conv_deep (Ψ '' K) hK'_comp hK'_sub ε hε
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N₁, fun n hn q hq => ?_⟩
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, ← (hΨ_maps q (hK_sub hq)).2.2]
      exact hN₁ n hn (Ψ q) (Set.mem_image_of_mem Ψ hq)
  exact
    { T_star_pos := hT_pos
      unit_c₀ := h_unit
      shear_zero := h_zero
      shear_holo_bounds := ⟨h_shear_holo, h_shear_bounds⟩
      inner_model_reg := h_inner_reg
      mem_inner_of_lt_log_R := h_mem_lt_log_R
      mem_inner_of_sector := h_mem_sector
      arcsin_collar := h_arcsin
      deep_sheared_init := h_deep_init }
