proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro V_mod S_star T_max R_rad η M_g η_plus U_T_prev K_T_prev U_T_c
    x_lo x_c_lo x_c_hi x_hi H_prev_bot y_bot y_top H_c_bot H_c_top g
    hReg hT_max hR_rad hη hM_g hη_plus
    hUT_prev_open hKT_prev_comp hKT_sub_UT hUT_sub_ball hUT_c_open
    hx_lo hx_c hx_hi hy_prev_bot hy_bot_top hHc_prev hHc_bot_top
    δ_y y_mid U_prev B_rec W_c
    hHc_bot_lt hg_diff hg_zero hg_bound hTc_cir hTc_disk hDip
    hB_rec_mod hDisk_mod hRay
    N₀ S_prev hS_prev_holo hS_prev_strip hS_prev_rec hS_prev_conv
  
  let closedComplexRect (a b c d : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
    { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ b ∧ c ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ d }
  have hOpenRect : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, IsOpen (complexRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d
    have h_eq : complexRect a b c d = Complex.reProdIm (Set.Ioo a b) (Set.Ioo c d) := by
      ext z
      simp [complexRect, Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_Ioo, and_assoc]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact IsOpen.reProdIm isOpen_Ioo isOpen_Ioo
  have hCompRect : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, IsCompact (closedComplexRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d
    have h_eq : closedComplexRect a b c d = Complex.reProdIm (Set.Icc a b) (Set.Icc c d) := by
      ext z
      simp [closedComplexRect, Complex.mem_reProdIm, Set.mem_Icc, and_assoc]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact IsCompact.reProdIm isCompact_Icc isCompact_Icc
  
  have hx_lo_hi : x_lo < x_hi := by linarith
  have hδ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y := by dsimp [δ_y]; linarith
  have hy_bot_δ_lt_mid : y_bot + δ_y < y_mid := by dsimp [δ_y, y_mid]; linarith
  have hy_mid_lt_32 : y_mid < y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y := by dsimp [δ_y, y_mid]; linarith
  have hy_32_lt_1 : y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y < y_top - δ_y := by linarith
  have hy_1_lt_top : y_top - δ_y < y_top := by linarith
  have hB_rec_sub_U_prev : B_rec ⊆ U_prev := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2.1, lt_trans hy_prev_bot hp.1.2.2.1, hp.1.2.2.2⟩, hp.2⟩
  
  let U_T_steep (σ : ℝ) : Set ℂ := U_T_prev ∩ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im }
  let K_T_steep (σ : ℝ) : Set ℂ := K_T_prev ∩ { T' : ℂ | (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ σ * T'.im }
  let K_steep (σ : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    closedComplexRect (x_c_lo - M_g) (x_c_hi + M_g) y_mid (H_c_top + η_plus) ×ˢ K_T_steep σ
  have h_steep_sigma : ∀ (σ : ℝ), (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
      ∃ (W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W_steep ∧
        K_steep σ ⊆ W_steep ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.2 ∈ U_T_steep σ) ∧
        N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
          expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
          S_ext n p = S_prev n p) ∧
        TendstoUniformlyOn S_ext S_star Filter.atTop (K_steep σ) := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hUT_σ_open : IsOpen (U_T_steep σ) :=
      hUT_prev_open.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_im))
    have hUT_σ_sub : U_T_steep σ ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } := by
      intro T hT
      exact ⟨hT.2, mem_ball_zero_iff.mp (hUT_sub_ball hT.1)⟩
    let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { p : ℂ × ℂ |
        x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
        y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T_steep σ }
    have hB_init_sub_B_rec : B_init ⊆ B_rec := by
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2.1⟩, hp.2.2.2.2.1⟩
    have hB_init_sub_U_prev : B_init ⊆ U_prev :=
      hB_init_sub_B_rec.trans hB_rec_sub_U_prev
    have hB_init_mod : B_init ⊆ V_mod :=
      hB_init_sub_B_rec.trans hB_rec_mod
    have hKT_σ_comp : IsCompact (K_T_steep σ) :=
      hKT_prev_comp.inter_right
        (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_im))
    have hK_steep_comp : IsCompact (K_steep σ) :=
      (hCompRect _ _ _ _).prod hKT_σ_comp
    have hK_steep_sub : K_steep σ ⊆
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T_steep σ } := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, _⟩, hT_K, hT_steep⟩ := hp
      have hT_steep' : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ σ * p.2.im := hT_steep
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, hKT_sub_UT hT_K,
        show η < σ * p.2.im by linarith⟩
    have hK_steep_ray :
        ∀ p ∈ K_steep σ, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
          let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
          let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
          (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
            (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
          x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
          (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi := by
      intro p hp τ hτ
      obtain ⟨⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, him_hi⟩, hT_K, hT_steep⟩ := hp
      have hτ' : τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid p.1.im := by
        rwa [max_eq_right him_lo] at hτ
      exact hRay σ hσ p.1 p.2 hre_lo hre_hi him_lo him_hi hT_K hT_steep τ hτ'
    obtain ⟨W_steep, hW_open, hK_sub_W, _, hW_bounds, _, hW_cont⟩ :=
      hTrack.steep_vertical_passage V_mod S_star σ η T_max (U_T_steep σ)
        x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top (K_steep σ)
        hReg hσ hη hT_max hUT_σ_open hUT_σ_sub hx_lo_hi hy_bot_top
        hB_init_mod hK_steep_comp hK_steep_sub hK_steep_ray
    obtain ⟨N_st, S_ext, hN₀_le, hS_ext_holo, hS_ext_strip, hS_ext_eq, hS_ext_conv⟩ :=
      hW_cont N₀ S_prev
        (fun n hn => (hS_prev_holo n hn).mono hB_init_sub_U_prev)
        (fun n hn Y T hT h0 hm hp =>
          hS_prev_rec n hn Y T hT
            (hB_init_sub_B_rec h0) (hB_init_sub_B_rec hm) (hB_init_sub_B_rec hp))
        (fun K hK hK_sub => hS_prev_conv K hK (hK_sub.trans hB_init_sub_U_prev))
    exact ⟨W_steep, N_st, S_ext, hW_open, hK_sub_W,
      fun p hp => (hW_bounds hp).2.2.2,
      hN₀_le, hS_ext_holo, hS_ext_strip, hS_ext_eq, hS_ext_conv⟩
  obtain ⟨W_steep_plus, N_st_plus, S_ext_plus,
    hWp_open, hKp_sub_Wp, hWp_UT, hN₀_le_Np,
    hSp_holo, hSp_strip, hSp_eq, hSp_conv⟩ := h_steep_sigma 1 (Or.inl rfl)
  obtain ⟨W_steep_minus, N_st_minus, S_ext_minus,
    hWm_open, hKm_sub_Wm, hWm_UT, _,
    hSm_holo, hSm_strip, hSm_eq, hSm_conv⟩ := h_steep_sigma (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
  let N_st : ℕ := max N_st_plus N_st_minus
  have hN₀_le_Nst : N₀ ≤ N_st := le_trans hN₀_le_Np (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hWp_Wm_disj : ∀ q : ℂ × ℂ, q ∈ W_steep_plus → q ∈ W_steep_minus → False := by
    intro q hqp hqm
    have hp_im : η < 1 * q.2.im := (hWp_UT q hqp).2
    have hm_im : η < (-1) * q.2.im := (hWm_UT q hqm).2
    linarith
  let U_low : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    complexRect x_lo x_hi H_prev_bot (y_top - δ_y) ×ˢ U_T_prev
  have hU_low_open : IsOpen U_low := (hOpenRect _ _ _ _).prod hUT_prev_open
  have hU_low_sub_U_prev : U_low ⊆ U_prev := by
    intro q hq
    exact ⟨⟨hq.1.1, hq.1.2.1, hq.1.2.2.1, lt_trans hq.1.2.2.2 hy_1_lt_top⟩, hq.2⟩
  let U₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (U_low ∪ W_steep_plus) ∪ W_steep_minus
  have hU₀_open : IsOpen U₀ := (hU_low_open.union hWp_open).union hWm_open
  let S₀ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    if q ∈ W_steep_plus then S_ext_plus n q
    else if q ∈ W_steep_minus then S_ext_minus n q
    else S_prev n q
  have hS₀_on_Wp : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ q ∈ W_steep_plus, S₀ n q = S_ext_plus n q := by
    intro n q hq
    simp [S₀, hq]
  have hS₀_on_Wm : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ q ∈ W_steep_minus, S₀ n q = S_ext_minus n q := by
    intro n q hq
    have hnotp : q ∉ W_steep_plus := fun hqp => hWp_Wm_disj q hqp hq
    simp [S₀, hnotp, hq]
  have hS₀_on_U_low : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q ∈ U_low, S₀ n q = S_prev n q := by
    intro n hn q hq
    have hq_im : q.1.im < y_top - δ_y := hq.1.2.2.2
    by_cases hqp : q ∈ W_steep_plus
    · rw [hS₀_on_Wp n q hqp]
      exact hSp_eq n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) q hqp hq_im
    · by_cases hqm : q ∈ W_steep_minus
      · rw [hS₀_on_Wm n q hqm]
        exact hSm_eq n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) q hqm hq_im
      · simp [S₀, hqp, hqm]
  
  have hS₀_holo : ∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₀ n) U₀ := by
    intro n hn
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₀_le_Nst hn
    have hnp : N_st_plus ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hnm : N_st_minus ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have h_low : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₀ n) U_low :=
      ((hS_prev_holo n hn₀).mono hU_low_sub_U_prev).congr (hS₀_on_U_low n hn)
    have h_p : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₀ n) W_steep_plus :=
      (hSp_holo n hnp).congr (hS₀_on_Wp n)
    have h_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₀ n) W_steep_minus :=
      (hSm_holo n hnm).congr (hS₀_on_Wm n)
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with (hq_low | hq_p) | hq_m
    · exact (h_low.differentiableAt (hU_low_open.mem_nhds hq_low)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact (h_p.differentiableAt (hWp_open.mem_nhds hq_p)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact (h_m.differentiableAt (hWm_open.mem_nhds hq_m)).differentiableWithinAt
  let f₀ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₀ n q
  have hf₀_holo : ∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (f₀ n) U₀ := by
    intro n hn
    exact ((hS₀_holo n hn).const_mul (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)).const_add (expBasePt seq n)
  have hf₀_strip : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q ∈ U₀, f₀ n q ∈ X.D_strip := by
    intro n hn q hq
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₀_le_Nst hn
    have hnp : N_st_plus ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hnm : N_st_minus ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    rcases hq with (hq_low | hq_p) | hq_m
    · dsimp [f₀]
      rw [hS₀_on_U_low n hn q hq_low]
      exact hS_prev_strip n hn₀ q (hU_low_sub_U_prev hq_low)
    · dsimp [f₀]
      rw [hS₀_on_Wp n q hq_p]
      exact hSp_strip n hnp q hq_p
    · dsimp [f₀]
      rw [hS₀_on_Wm n q hq_m]
      exact hSm_strip n hnm q hq_m
  
  let K_low : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    closedComplexRect (x_c_lo - M_g) (x_c_hi + M_g)
      (H_c_bot - M_g) (y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y) ×ˢ K_T_prev
  have hK_low_comp : IsCompact K_low := (hCompRect _ _ _ _).prod hKT_prev_comp
  have hK_low_sub_U_low : K_low ⊆ U_low := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨⟨hre_lo, hre_hi, him_lo, him_hi⟩, hT_K⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩, hKT_sub_UT hT_K⟩
  let K_all : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := (K_low ∪ K_steep 1) ∪ K_steep (-1)
  have hK_all_sub_U₀ : K_all ⊆ U₀ := by
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with (hq_low | hq_p) | hq_m
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (hK_low_sub_U_low hq_low))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (hKp_sub_Wp hq_p))
    · exact Or.inr (hKm_sub_Wm hq_m)
  have hS_prev_conv_low : TendstoUniformlyOn S_prev S_star Filter.atTop K_low :=
    hS_prev_conv K_low hK_low_comp (hK_low_sub_U_low.trans hU_low_sub_U_prev)
  have hS₀_conv_K_all : TendstoUniformlyOn S₀ S_star Filter.atTop K_all := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N_low, hN_low⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hS_prev_conv_low ε hε)
    obtain ⟨N_p, hN_p⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hSp_conv ε hε)
    obtain ⟨N_m, hN_m⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hSm_conv ε hε)
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N_st (max N_low (max N_p N_m)), fun n hn q hq => ?_⟩
    have hn_st : N_st ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_r : max N_low (max N_p N_m) ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have hn_low : N_low ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_r
    have hn_pm : max N_p N_m ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_r
    have hn_p : N_p ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_pm
    have hn_m : N_m ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn_pm
    rcases hq with (hq_low | hq_p) | hq_m
    · rw [hS₀_on_U_low n hn_st q (hK_low_sub_U_low hq_low)]
      exact hN_low n hn_low q hq_low
    · rw [hS₀_on_Wp n q (hKp_sub_Wp hq_p)]
      exact hN_p n hn_p q hq_p
    · rw [hS₀_on_Wm n q (hKm_sub_Wm hq_m)]
      exact hN_m n hn_m q hq_m
  
  let Φ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun x =>
    (x.1.1 + g x.2, x.1.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * x.2)
  have hΦ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ :=
    ((differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_fst).add
      (hg_diff.comp differentiable_snd)).prodMk
    ((differentiable_snd.comp differentiable_fst).add
      (differentiable_snd.const_mul (R_rad : ℂ)))
  have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (W_c ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (3 / 2)) :=
    hΦ_diff.differentiableOn
  have hΦ_zero : ∀ p ∈ W_c, Φ (p, 0) = p := by
    intro p _
    exact Prod.ext (by simp [Φ, hg_zero]) (by simp [Φ])
  
  have hΦ_cir_K : ∀ p ∈ W_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
      Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ K_all := by
    intro p hp ϕ
    let ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [ζ]
      rw [Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    obtain ⟨hg_norm, hg_im_hi⟩ := hg_bound ζ hζ_norm
    have hg_re_abs : |(g ζ).re| ≤ M_g := le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
    have hg_im_abs : |(g ζ).im| ≤ M_g := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hg_norm
    rw [abs_le] at hg_re_abs hg_im_abs
    obtain ⟨⟨hp_re_lo, hp_re_hi, hp_im_lo, hp_im_hi⟩, hp_T⟩ := hp
    have hY'_re_lo : x_c_lo - M_g ≤ (p.1 + g ζ).re := by simp; linarith
    have hY'_re_hi : (p.1 + g ζ).re ≤ x_c_hi + M_g := by simp; linarith
    have hY'_im_lo : H_c_bot - M_g ≤ (p.1 + g ζ).im := by simp; linarith
    have hY'_im_hi : (p.1 + g ζ).im ≤ H_c_top + η_plus := by simp; linarith
    have hT'_K : p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ ∈ K_T_prev := hTc_cir p.2 hp_T ϕ
    by_cases h_im : (p.1 + g ζ).im ≤ y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨⟨hY'_re_lo, hY'_re_hi, hY'_im_lo, h_im⟩, hT'_K⟩)
    · have h_im' : y_top - (3 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_y < (p.1 + g ζ).im := lt_of_not_ge h_im
      have hY'_im_mid : y_mid ≤ (p.1 + g ζ).im := by linarith
      have hT'_not_small : ¬ |(p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ).im| ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η := by
        intro h_small
        have h_dip := hDip p.2 hp_T ϕ h_small
        have h_add_im : (p.1 + g ζ).im = p.1.im + (g ζ).im := Complex.add_im _ _
        linarith
      have hT'_gt : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η < |(p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ).im| :=
        lt_of_not_ge hT'_not_small
      by_cases hT_sign : 0 ≤ (p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ).im
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg hT_sign] at hT'_gt
        exact Or.inl (Or.inr
          ⟨⟨hY'_re_lo, hY'_re_hi, hY'_im_mid, hY'_im_hi⟩, hT'_K,
            show (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ 1 * (p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ).im by linarith⟩)
      · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hT_sign)] at hT'_gt
        exact Or.inr
          ⟨⟨hY'_re_lo, hY'_re_hi, hY'_im_mid, hY'_im_hi⟩, hT'_K,
            show (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η ≤ (-1) * (p.2 + (R_rad : ℂ) * ζ).im by linarith⟩
  have hΦ_cir_U₀ : ∀ p ∈ W_c, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
      Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ∈ U₀ :=
    fun p hp ϕ => hK_all_sub_U₀ (hΦ_cir_K p hp ϕ)
  
  have hWc_open : IsOpen W_c := (hOpenRect _ _ _ _).prod hUT_c_open
  let N₁ : ℕ := N_st
  let S_next : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n p =>
    (circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)
  have h_cadc : ∀ n ≥ N₁,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ) W_c ∧
      (∀ p ∈ W_c, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀) →
        circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p = f₀ n p) ∧
      (∀ (U_star : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (f_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U_star →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ f_star U_star →
        ∀ p ∈ W_c, (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U_star) →
          ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
            (∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
              ‖f₀ n (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
                f_star (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ B) →
            ‖circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - f_star p‖ ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ (X' : ExpStripData), IsExpObstructionStrip X' →
        (∀ q ∈ U₀, f₀ n q ∈ X'.D_strip) →
        ∀ p ∈ W_c, circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p ∈ X'.D_strip) :=
    fun n hn =>
      hDisk.circle_average_disk_continuation W_c U₀ (f₀ n) Φ
        hWc_open hU₀_open (hf₀_holo n hn) hΦ_holo hΦ_zero hΦ_cir_U₀
  refine ⟨N₁, S_next, hN₀_le_Nst, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    have h_eq : S_next n = fun p =>
        (circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - expBasePt seq n) * ((seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
      ext p
      exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (((h_cadc n hn).1).sub_const (expBasePt seq n)).mul_const ((seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)⁻¹)
  · intro n hn p hp
    have hℓ_ne : (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (seq.ℓ_pos n).ne'
    have h_id : expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_next n p =
        circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p := by
      dsimp [S_next]
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_ne, add_sub_cancel]
    rw [h_id]
    exact (h_cadc n hn).2.2.2 X hX (hf₀_strip n hn) p hp
  · intro n hn p hp hp_im
    have hℓ_ne : (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (seq.ℓ_pos n).ne'
    have h_disk_low : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U_low := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp hζ
      obtain ⟨hg_norm, hg_im_hi⟩ := hg_bound ζ hζ_norm
      have hg_re_abs : |(g ζ).re| ≤ M_g := le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
      have hg_im_abs : |(g ζ).im| ≤ M_g := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hg_norm
      rw [abs_le] at hg_re_abs hg_im_abs
      obtain ⟨⟨hp_re_lo, hp_re_hi, hp_im_lo, _⟩, hp_T⟩ := hp
      have hre_1 : x_lo < (p.1 + g ζ).re := by simp; linarith
      have hre_2 : (p.1 + g ζ).re < x_hi := by simp; linarith
      have him_1 : H_prev_bot < (p.1 + g ζ).im := by simp; linarith
      have him_2 : (p.1 + g ζ).im < y_top - δ_y := by simp; linarith
      exact ⟨⟨hre_1, hre_2, him_1, him_2⟩, hTc_disk p.2 hp_T ζ hζ⟩
    have h_disk_U₀ : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1, Φ (p, ζ) ∈ U₀ :=
      fun ζ hζ => Or.inl (Or.inl (h_disk_low ζ hζ))
    have hp_low : p ∈ U_low := by
      have h0 : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp
      simpa [hΦ_zero p hp] using h_disk_low 0 h0
    have h_avg_eq : circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p = f₀ n p :=
      (h_cadc n hn).2.1 p hp h_disk_U₀
    dsimp [S_next]
    rw [h_avg_eq]
    dsimp [f₀]
    rw [hS₀_on_U_low n hn p hp_low, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hℓ_ne]
  · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
    obtain ⟨N_conv, hN_conv⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
        (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hS₀_conv_K_all (ε / 2) hε2)
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N₁ N_conv, fun n hn p hp => ?_⟩
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_c : N_conv ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < seq.ℓ_seq n := seq.ℓ_pos n
    have hℓ_ne : (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hℓ_pos.ne'
    have hℓ_norm : ‖(seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)‖ = seq.ℓ_seq n := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hℓ_pos.le]
    let f_star_n : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q =>
      expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_star q
    have hf_star_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_star_n V_mod :=
      (hReg.2.1.const_mul (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)).const_add (expBasePt seq n)
    let B : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * (ε / 2)
    have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := mul_nonneg hℓ_pos.le hε2.le
    have h_cir_bound : ∀ ϕ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ‖f₀ n (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) -
          f_star_n (Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))‖ ≤ B := by
      intro ϕ _
      let q : ℂ × ℂ := Φ (p, Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      have hq_K : q ∈ K_all := hΦ_cir_K p hp ϕ
      have hq_dist : ‖S₀ n q - S_star q‖ ≤ ε / 2 := by
        have hd := hN_conv n hn_c q hq_K
        rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hd
        exact hd.le
      have h_diff_eq : f₀ n q - f_star_n q =
          (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * (S₀ n q - S_star q) := by
        dsimp [f₀, f_star_n]
        ring
      change ‖f₀ n q - f_star_n q‖ ≤ B
      rw [h_diff_eq, norm_mul, hℓ_norm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq_dist hℓ_pos.le
    have h_avg_le : ‖circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - f_star_n p‖ ≤ B :=
      (h_cadc n hn₁).2.2.1 V_mod f_star_n hReg.1 hf_star_holo p hp
        (hDisk_mod p hp) B hB_nonneg h_cir_bound
    have h_quot_eq : S_next n p - S_star p =
        (circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - f_star_n p) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [S_next, f_star_n]
      field_simp [hℓ_ne]
      ring
    rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev, h_quot_eq, norm_div, hℓ_norm]
    have h_div_le :
        ‖circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - f_star_n p‖ / seq.ℓ_seq n ≤ ε / 2 := by
      calc ‖circleAvgCont (f₀ n) Φ p - f_star_n p‖ / seq.ℓ_seq n
          ≤ B / seq.ℓ_seq n := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_avg_le hℓ_pos.le
        _ = ε / 2 := mul_div_cancel_left₀ (ε / 2) hℓ_pos.ne'
    linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  intro V_mod S_star T_max U_T K_T x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ y_seed δ_r N₀ S_seq
    hMod hT_max hδ_r hUT_open hKT_comp hKT_sub hUT_sub
    hx hy hy_seed_lo hy_seed_hi hRect_sub hS_holo hS_conv h_seed
  rcases K_T.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩
  · exact ⟨N₀, le_rfl, fun _ _ _ hT => False.elim hT⟩
  let closedRect : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Set ℂ := fun a b c d =>
    { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ b ∧ c ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ d }
  have h_closedRect_comp : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, IsCompact (closedRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d
    let φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
    have h_eq : closedRect a b c d = φ '' (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d) := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨(z.re, z.im), ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.1⟩, ⟨hz.2.2.1, hz.2.2.2⟩⟩, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [φ]
      · rintro ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨⟨hu₁, hu₂⟩, ⟨hv₁, hv₂⟩⟩, rfl⟩
        have hre : (φ (u, v)).re = u := by simp [φ]
        have him : (φ (u, v)).im = v := by simp [φ]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hφ_cont
  have h_openRect_open : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, IsOpen (complexRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
      ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
  have h_openRect_conv : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, Convex ℝ (complexRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ u v hu hv huv
    have hre : (u • z₁ + v • z₂).re = u * z₁.re + v * z₂.re := by simp
    have him : (u • z₁ + v • z₂).im = u * z₁.im + v * z₂.im := by simp
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu with rfl | hu_pos
    · have hv1 : v = 1 := by linarith
      subst hv1
      simpa using hz₂
    · have ha : u * a + v * a = a := by rw [← add_mul, huv, one_mul]
      have hb : u * b + v * b = b := by rw [← add_mul, huv, one_mul]
      have hc : u * c + v * c = c := by rw [← add_mul, huv, one_mul]
      have hd : u * d + v * d = d := by rw [← add_mul, huv, one_mul]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hre]
        have h1 : u * a < u * z₁.re := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁.1 hu_pos
        have h2 : v * a ≤ v * z₂.re := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz₂.1.le hv
        linarith
      · rw [hre]
        have h1 : u * z₁.re < u * b := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁.2.1 hu_pos
        have h2 : v * z₂.re ≤ v * b := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz₂.2.1.le hv
        linarith
      · rw [him]
        have h1 : u * c < u * z₁.im := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁.2.2.1 hu_pos
        have h2 : v * c ≤ v * z₂.im := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz₂.2.2.1.le hv
        linarith
      · rw [him]
        have h1 : u * z₁.im < u * d := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz₁.2.2.2 hu_pos
        have h2 : v * z₂.im ≤ v * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz₂.2.2.2.le hv
        linarith
  let R_full : Set ℂ := complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂
  let K₁ : Set ℂ := closedRect (x₁ + δ_r / 4) (x₂ - δ_r / 4) (y₁ + δ_r / 4) (y₂ - δ_r / 4)
  let K₂ : Set ℂ := closedRect (x₁ + δ_r / 2) (x₂ - δ_r / 2) (y₁ + δ_r / 2) (y₂ - δ_r / 2)
  let K_target : Set ℂ := closedRect (x₁ + δ_r) (x₂ - δ_r) (y₁ + δ_r) (y₂ - δ_r)
  let R_target : Set ℂ := complexRect (x₁ + δ_r) (x₂ - δ_r) (y₁ + δ_r) (y₂ - δ_r)
  have hR_full_open : IsOpen R_full := h_openRect_open _ _ _ _
  have hR_target_open : IsOpen R_target := h_openRect_open _ _ _ _
  have hR_target_preconn : IsPreconnected R_target := (h_openRect_conv _ _ _ _).isPreconnected
  have hR_sub_Kt : R_target ⊆ K_target := fun z hz =>
    ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2.1.le, hz.2.2.1.le, hz.2.2.2.le⟩
  have hKt_sub_K₂ : K_target ⊆ K₂ := fun z hz =>
    ⟨by linarith [hz.1], by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.2]⟩
  have hK₂_sub_K₁ : K₂ ⊆ K₁ := fun z hz =>
    ⟨by linarith [hz.1], by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.2]⟩
  have hK₁_sub_Rf : K₁ ⊆ R_full := fun z hz =>
    ⟨by linarith [hz.1], by linarith [hz.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.1], by linarith [hz.2.2.2]⟩
  let Y_mid : ℂ := (((x₁ + x₂) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (((y₁ + y₂) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hY_mid_Kt : Y_mid ∈ K_target := by
    have hre : Y_mid.re = (x₁ + x₂) / 2 := by simp [Y_mid]
    have him : Y_mid.im = (y₁ + y₂) / 2 := by simp [Y_mid]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  let K_st : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := K_target ×ˢ K_T
  have hK_st_comp : IsCompact K_st := (h_closedRect_comp _ _ _ _).prod hKT_comp
  have hK₁T_comp : IsCompact (K₁ ×ˢ K_T) := (h_closedRect_comp _ _ _ _).prod hKT_comp
  have hK₂T_comp : IsCompact (K₂ ×ˢ K_T) := (h_closedRect_comp _ _ _ _).prod hKT_comp
  have hK₁T_sub_Rf : K₁ ×ˢ K_T ⊆ R_full ×ˢ U_T := Set.prod_mono hK₁_sub_Rf hKT_sub
  have hK₁T_sub_V : K₁ ×ˢ K_T ⊆ V_mod := hK₁T_sub_Rf.trans hRect_sub
  have hK₂T_sub_V : K₂ ×ˢ K_T ⊆ V_mod :=
    (Set.prod_mono hK₂_sub_K₁ Subset.rfl).trans hK₁T_sub_V
  have hK_st_sub_V : K_st ⊆ V_mod :=
    (Set.prod_mono hKt_sub_K₂ Subset.rfl).trans hK₂T_sub_V
  
  rcases hMod with ⟨hV_open, hS_star_holo, hMod_reg⟩
  let J_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1
  have hJ_star_cont : ContinuousOn J_star V_mod := by
    let π₁₂ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, q.2.1)
    have hπ₁₂ : Differentiable ℂ π₁₂ :=
      differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_snd)
    let U_3d : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := π₁₂ ⁻¹' V_mod
    have hU3d_open : IsOpen U_3d := hV_open.preimage hπ₁₂.continuous
    have hF3d_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => S_star (π₁₂ q)) U_3d :=
      hS_star_holo.comp hπ₁₂.differentiableOn (fun _ hq => hq)
    have hD₁_holo :=
      (hDisk.partial_derivs_holo_3d U_3d (fun q => S_star (π₁₂ q)) hU3d_open hF3d_holo).1
    let ι₁₂ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (p.1, p.2, 0)
    have hι₁₂ : Differentiable ℂ ι₁₂ :=
      differentiable_fst.prodMk (differentiable_snd.prodMk (differentiable_const 0))
    have hJ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ J_star V_mod :=
      hD₁_holo.comp hι₁₂.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp)
    exact hJ_holo.continuousOn
  let F_act : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    P.p_act (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1) q.2.1 (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ))
  let F_DS : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    deriv (fun S' => F_act n (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1
  let F_DJ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    deriv (fun J' => F_act n (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1
  let polydisk : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := fun c r =>
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - c.1‖ < r ∧ ‖q.2.1 - c.2.1‖ < r ∧ ‖q.2.2 - c.2.2‖ < r }
  have h_poly_open : ∀ (c : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ), IsOpen (polydisk c r) := by
    intro c r

      (fun w hw => ⟨hw, hT_U⟩)
  let q_curr : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun Y => (g Y, (g (Y + a_n) - g Y) / a_n, T)
  let q_prev : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun Y => (g (Y - a_n), (g Y - g (Y - a_n)) / a_n, T)
  have hq_in_Q : ∀ Y ∈ R_target, q_curr Y ∈ Q_reg ∧ q_prev Y ∈ Q_reg := by
    intro Y hY_rt
    have hY_Kt : Y ∈ K_target := hR_sub_Kt hY_rt
    have hY_K₂ : Y ∈ K₂ := hKt_sub_K₂ hY_Kt
    have hY_K₁ : Y ∈ K₁ := hK₂_sub_K₁ hY_K₂
    have h1 : ‖g Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < δ_reg := by
      have := h_sup_bound n hnu (Y, T) ⟨hY_K₁, hT⟩
      linarith [min_le_left (δ_reg / 2) (r_c * (δ_reg / 4))]
    have hYm_cb : Y - a_n ∈ Metric.closedBall Y (δ_r / 2) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have : (Y - a_n) - Y = -a_n := by ring
      rw [this, norm_neg]
      exact ha_lt_half_δ.le
    have hYm_K₂ : Y - a_n ∈ K₂ := h_cb_Kt_K₂ Y hY_Kt hYm_cb
    have hYm_K₁ : Y - a_n ∈ K₁ := hK₂_sub_K₁ hYm_K₂
    have h2 : ‖g (Y - a_n) - S_star (Y, T)‖ < δ_reg := by
      have h2a := h_sup_bound n hnu (Y - a_n, T) ⟨hYm_K₁, hT⟩
      have hdist_Ym : dist (Y - a_n, T) (Y, T) < η_S := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, dist_eq_norm]
        have : (Y - a_n) - Y = -a_n := by ring
        rw [this, norm_neg, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg a_n)]
        exact ha_lt_ηS
      have h2b := hη_S (Y - a_n, T) ⟨hYm_K₂, hT⟩ (Y, T) ⟨hY_K₂, hT⟩ hdist_Ym
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2b
      calc ‖g (Y - a_n) - S_star (Y, T)‖
          = ‖(g (Y - a_n) - S_star (Y - a_n, T)) + (S_star (Y - a_n, T) - S_star (Y, T))‖ := by
              ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖g (Y - a_n) - S_star (Y - a_n, T)‖ + ‖S_star (Y - a_n, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ < δ_reg := by linarith [min_le_left (δ_reg / 2) (r_c * (δ_reg / 4))]
    let B_ρ : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall Y ‖a_n‖
    let ψ_lin : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => g Z - J_star (Y, T) * Z
    have hB_sub_K₂ : B_ρ ⊆ K₂ :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall ha_lt_half_δ.le).trans (h_cb_Kt_K₂ Y hY_Kt)
    have hψ_diff : ∀ Z ∈ B_ρ, DifferentiableAt ℂ ψ_lin Z := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hZ_Rf : Z ∈ R_full := hK₁_sub_Rf (hK₂_sub_K₁ (hB_sub_K₂ hZ))
      exact (hg_holo.differentiableAt (hR_full_open.mem_nhds hZ_Rf)).sub
        (differentiableAt_id.const_mul (J_star (Y, T)))
    have hψ_deriv_le : ∀ Z ∈ B_ρ, ‖deriv ψ_lin Z‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hZ_K₂ : Z ∈ K₂ := hB_sub_K₂ hZ
      have hZ_Rf : Z ∈ R_full := hK₁_sub_Rf (hK₂_sub_K₁ hZ_K₂)
      have hg_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ g Z :=
        hg_holo.differentiableAt (hR_full_open.mem_nhds hZ_Rf)
      have hlin_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => J_star (Y, T) * w) (J_star (Y, T)) Z := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id Z).const_mul (J_star (Y, T))
      have hd_eq : deriv ψ_lin Z = deriv g Z - J_star (Y, T) :=
        (hg_at.hasDerivAt.sub hlin_hd).deriv
      rw [hd_eq]
      have hc := h_cauchy_deriv n hnu₀ Z hZ_K₂ T hT
      have hZ_dist : ‖Z - Y‖ ≤ ‖a_n‖ := by
        simpa [B_ρ, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hZ
      have hdist_Z : dist (Z, T) (Y, T) < η_J := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, dist_eq_norm, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hZ_dist ha_lt_ηJ
      have hj := hη_J (Z, T) ⟨hZ_K₂, hT⟩ (Y, T) ⟨hY_K₂, hT⟩ hdist_Z
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at hj
      calc ‖deriv g Z - J_star (Y, T)‖
          = ‖(deriv g Z - J_star (Z, T)) + (J_star (Z, T) - J_star (Y, T))‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖deriv g Z - J_star (Z, T)‖ + ‖J_star (Z, T) - J_star (Y, T)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg := by linarith
    have hY_B : Y ∈ B_ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self ha_pos.le
    have hYp_B : Y + a_n ∈ B_ρ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have : (Y + a_n) - Y = a_n := by ring
      rw [this]
    have hYm_B : Y - a_n ∈ B_ρ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have : (Y - a_n) - Y = -a_n := by ring
      rw [this, norm_neg]
    have h3 : ‖(g (Y + a_n) - g Y) / a_n - J_star (Y, T)‖ < δ_reg := by
      have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        hψ_diff hψ_deriv_le (convex_closedBall Y ‖a_n‖) hY_B hYp_B
      have hdiff_eq : (Y + a_n) - Y = a_n := by ring
      have hψ_sub : ψ_lin (Y + a_n) - ψ_lin Y = (g (Y + a_n) - g Y) - J_star (Y, T) * a_n := by
        dsimp [ψ_lin]; ring
      rw [hdiff_eq, hψ_sub] at hmvt
      have hquot :
          ((g (Y + a_n) - g Y) - J_star (Y, T) * a_n) / a_n =
            (g (Y + a_n) - g Y) / a_n - J_star (Y, T) := by
        rw [sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ ha_ne]
      have hnorm_le : ‖(g (Y + a_n) - g Y) / a_n - J_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg := by
        rw [← hquot, norm_div]
        exact (div_le_iff₀ ha_pos).mpr hmvt
      linarith
    have h4 : ‖(g Y - g (Y - a_n)) / a_n - J_star (Y, T)‖ < δ_reg := by
      have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        hψ_diff hψ_deriv_le (convex_closedBall Y ‖a_n‖) hYm_B hY_B
      have hdiff_eq : Y - (Y - a_n) = a_n := by ring
      have hψ_sub : ψ_lin Y - ψ_lin (Y - a_n) = (g Y - g (Y - a_n)) - J_star (Y, T) * a_n := by
        dsimp [ψ_lin]; ring
      rw [hdiff_eq, hψ_sub] at hmvt
      have hquot :
          ((g Y - g (Y - a_n)) - J_star (Y, T) * a_n) / a_n =
            (g Y - g (Y - a_n)) / a_n - J_star (Y, T) := by
        rw [sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ ha_ne]
      have hnorm_le : ‖(g Y - g (Y - a_n)) / a_n - J_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg := by
        rw [← hquot, norm_div]
        exact (div_le_iff₀ ha_pos).mpr hmvt
      linarith
    have hT_zero : ‖T - T‖ < δ_reg := by simp [hδ_reg_pos]
    exact ⟨hQ_mem_of_dist (Y, T) ⟨hY_Kt, hT⟩ (q_curr Y) h1 h3 hT_zero,
      hQ_mem_of_dist (Y, T) ⟨hY_Kt, hT⟩ (q_prev Y) h2 h4 hT_zero⟩
  
  let Δ_res : ℂ → ℂ := fun Y =>
    (F_DJ n (q_curr Y) - a_n * F_DS n (q_curr Y)) - F_DJ n (q_prev Y)
  have h_shift_Rf : ∀ Y ∈ R_target, ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < δ_r → Y + w ∈ R_full := by
    intro Y hY w hw
    have hre : |w.re| < δ_r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_re_le_norm w) hw
    have him : |w.im| < δ_r := lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w) hw
    rw [abs_lt] at hre him
    have hre_add : (Y + w).re = Y.re + w.re := by simp
    have him_add : (Y + w).im = Y.im + w.im := by simp
    exact ⟨by linarith [hY.1], by linarith [hY.2.1],
      by linarith [hY.2.2.1], by linarith [hY.2.2.2]⟩
  have ha_lt_δ : ‖a_n‖ < δ_r := by linarith
  have hg_id_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g R_target :=
    hg_holo.mono (hR_sub_Kt.trans (hKt_sub_K₂.trans (hK₂_sub_K₁.trans hK₁_sub_Rf)))
  have hg_add_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Y => g (Y + a_n)) R_target :=
    hg_holo.comp (differentiable_id.add_const a_n).differentiableOn
      (fun Y hY => h_shift_Rf Y hY a_n ha_lt_δ)
  have hg_sub_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Y => g (Y - a_n)) R_target :=
    hg_holo.comp (differentiable_id.sub_const a_n).differentiableOn
      (fun Y hY => by
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h_shift_Rf Y hY (-a_n) (by simpa using ha_lt_δ))
  have hqc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q_curr R_target :=
    hg_id_holo.prodMk
      (((hg_add_holo.sub hg_id_holo).div_const a_n).prodMk (differentiableOn_const T))
  have hqp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q_prev R_target :=
    hg_sub_holo.prodMk
      (((hg_id_holo.sub hg_sub_holo).div_const a_n).prodMk (differentiableOn_const T))
  rcases hF_partials_holo n hn_reg with ⟨hFDS_holo, hFDJ_holo⟩
  have hΔ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_res R_target :=
    ((hFDJ_holo.comp hqc_holo (fun Y hY => (hq_in_Q Y hY).1)).sub
      ((hFDS_holo.comp hqc_holo (fun Y hY => (hq_in_Q Y hY).1)).const_mul a_n)).sub
      (hFDJ_holo.comp hqp_holo (fun Y hY => (hq_in_Q Y hY).2))
  have hΔ_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Δ_res R_target := hΔ_holo.analyticOnNhd hR_target_open
  have h0_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ)) R_target :=
    (differentiableOn_const (0 : ℂ)).analyticOnNhd hR_target_open
  let Y₀ : ℂ := (((x₁ + x₂) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((((y₁ + δ_r) + y_top_ov) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hY₀_re : Y₀.re = (x₁ + x₂) / 2 := by simp [Y₀]
  have hY₀_im : Y₀.im = ((y₁ + δ_r) + y_top_ov) / 2 := by simp [Y₀]
  have hy_ov_le_top : y_top_ov ≤ y₂ - δ_r := min_le_right _ _
  have hy_ov_le_seed : y_top_ov ≤ y_seed := min_le_left _ _
  have hY₀_mem : Y₀ ∈ R_target := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have h_in_seed_of_lt : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w - Y₀‖ < 2 * r_seed → w ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed := by
    intro w hw
    have hr1 : r_seed ≤ (x₂ - x₁ - 2 * δ_r) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr2 : r_seed ≤ (y_top_ov - (y₁ + δ_r)) / 4 := min_le_right _ _
    have hre : |w.re - Y₀.re| < 2 * r_seed := by
      calc |w.re - Y₀.re| = |(w - Y₀).re| := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖w - Y₀‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - Y₀)
        _ < 2 * r_seed := hw
    have him : |w.im - Y₀.im| < 2 * r_seed := by
      calc |w.im - Y₀.im| = |(w - Y₀).im| := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖w - Y₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - Y₀)
        _ < 2 * r_seed := hw
    rw [hY₀_re, abs_lt] at hre
    rw [hY₀_im, abs_lt] at him
    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have h_ball_vanish : ∀ Y ∈ Metric.ball Y₀ r_seed, Δ_res Y = 0 := by
    intro Y hY_ball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hY_ball
    have hr1 : r_seed ≤ (x₂ - x₁ - 2 * δ_r) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr2 : r_seed ≤ (y_top_ov - (y₁ + δ_r)) / 4 := min_le_right _ _
    have hY_rt : Y ∈ R_target := by
      have hre : |Y.re - Y₀.re| < r_seed := by
        calc |Y.re - Y₀.re| = |(Y - Y₀).re| := by simp
          _ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Y - Y₀)
          _ < r_seed := hY_ball
      have him : |Y.im - Y₀.im| < r_seed := by
        calc |Y.im - Y₀.im| = |(Y - Y₀).im| := by simp
          _ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Y - Y₀)
          _ < r_seed := hY_ball
      rw [hY₀_re, abs_lt] at hre
      rw [hY₀_im, abs_lt] at him
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hY_seed : Y ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed :=
      h_in_seed_of_lt Y (by linarith)
    have hYm_seed : Y - a_n ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed := by
      refine h_in_seed_of_lt (Y - a_n) ?_
      calc ‖(Y - a_n) - Y₀‖ = ‖(Y - Y₀) - a_n‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ + ‖a_n‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ < 2 * r_seed := by linarith
    have hYp_seed : Y + a_n ∈ complexRect x₁ x₂ y₁ y_seed := by
      refine h_in_seed_of_lt (Y + a_n) ?_
      calc ‖(Y + a_n) - Y₀‖ = ‖(Y - Y₀) + a_n‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ + ‖a_n‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < 2 * r_seed := by linarith
    have h_rec_seed := h_seed n hn₀ Y T hT hY_seed hYm_seed hYp_seed
    exact (hRec_iff n hn_reg g Y T hT_ne (hq_in_Q Y hY_rt).1).mp h_rec_seed
  have h_ev : Δ_res =ᶠ[nhds Y₀] (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds Y₀ hr_seed_pos) h_ball_vanish
  have h_eqOn :=
    hΔ_ana.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq h0_ana hR_target_preconn hY₀_mem h_ev
  intro Y hY_rt
  exact (hRec_iff n hn_reg g Y T hT_ne (hq_in_Q Y hY_rt).1).mpr (h_eqOn hY_rt)

signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)

    (hDisk : DiskContinuationToolkitProp)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro ν' hν'_pos hν'_lt
  let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
  let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
  let r₀ : ℝ := T_star / 32
  let X₁ : ℝ := |α_c| + M.θ + 10
  let U_T_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
  have hT_star_pos : 0 < T_star := hBridge.T_star_pos
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by dsimp [r₀]; positivity
  have hν'_lt_one : ν' < 1 := lt_trans hν'_lt M.ν_lt_one
  have hX₁_gt_10 : 10 < X₁ := by dsimp [X₁]; linarith [abs_nonneg α_c, M.θ_pos]
  have hX₁_pos : 0 < X₁ := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁_ge, hDeepInit⟩ := hBridge.deep_sheared_init
  let D_slab : ℝ := max (D₁ + 6) (-Real.log M.R + 60)
  have hD_slab_1 : D₁ + 6 ≤ D_slab := le_max_left _ _
  have hD_slab_2 : -Real.log M.R + 60 ≤ D_slab := le_max_right _ _
  let H_1_bot : ℝ := -D_slab - ν' - 3
  let H_cut_0 : ℝ := -D_slab - ν' - 3 / 2
  let H_1_top : ℝ := Real.log M.R - ν'
  let C_dip_1 : ℝ := Real.log M.R - ν' + D_slab + 4
  let M_g_1 : ℝ := 8 * C_dip_1
  let η_plus_1 : ℝ := ν' / 2
  let y_bot : ℝ := -D_slab - 4
  let y_top : ℝ := -D_slab
  let H_deep_bot : ℝ := H_1_bot - M_g_1 - 4
  have hH1_lt_55 : H_1_bot < Real.log M.R - 55 := by dsimp [H_1_bot]; linarith
  have hH1_lt_cut : H_1_bot + 1 < H_cut_0 := by dsimp [H_1_bot, H_cut_0]; linarith
  have hHcut_lt_50 : H_cut_0 < Real.log M.R - 50 := by dsimp [H_cut_0]; linarith
  have hC_dip_pos : 0 < C_dip_1 := by dsimp [C_dip_1]; linarith
  have hM_g_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_g_1 := by dsimp [M_g_1]; positivity
  have hη_plus_pos : 0 < η_plus_1 := by dsimp [η_plus_1]; positivity
  have hHdeep_lt : H_deep_bot < -D₁ - 4 := by dsimp [H_deep_bot, H_1_bot, M_g_1]; linarith
  
  let R_rad : ℝ := 8 * r₀
  have hR_rad_pos : 0 < R_rad := by dsimp [R_rad]; positivity
  let K_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
  let K_cov : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (T_star : ℂ) (2 * r₀)
  let K_T_prev : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (T_star : ℂ) (11 * r₀)
  let U_T_all : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star)
  let x₀ : ↥K_cov → ℝ := fun c => -c.1.im / R_rad
  have hx₀_mem : ∀ c : ↥K_cov, x₀ c ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (1 / 4) := by
    intro c
    have hc_norm : ‖c.1 - (T_star : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * r₀ := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp c.2
    have hc_im : |c.1.im| ≤ 2 * r₀ := by
      have h1 : (c.1 - (T_star : ℂ)).im = c.1.im := by simp
      rw [← h1]
      exact le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hc_norm
    rw [abs_le] at hc_im
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [x₀]; rw [le_div_iff₀ hR_rad_pos]; dsimp [R_rad]; linarith
    · dsimp [x₀]; rw [div_le_iff₀ hR_rad_pos]; dsimp [R_rad]; linarith
  let ϕ₁ : ↥K_cov → ℝ := fun c => Real.arcsin (x₀ c)
  let ϕ₂ : ↥K_cov → ℝ := fun c => Real.pi - ϕ₁ c
  have h_poly : ∀ c : ↥K_cov, ∃ (δ_ϕ : ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < δ_ϕ ∧
      Differentiable ℂ g ∧
      g 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g ζ‖ ≤ 8 * C_dip_1 ∧ (g ζ).im ≤ η_plus_1) ∧
      (∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        (∃ k : ℤ, |ϕ - ϕ₁ c - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ ∨
                  |ϕ - ϕ₂ c - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ) →
        (g (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤ -C_dip_1) :=
    fun c => hDisk.binomial_dip_poly (ϕ₁ c) (ϕ₂ c) C_dip_1 η_plus_1 hC_dip_pos hη_plus_pos
  choose δ_ϕ g_c hδ_ϕ_pos hg_holo hg_zero hg_bounds hg_dip using h_poly
  let η_c : ↥K_cov → ℝ := fun c => (r₀ / 2) * min 1 (δ_ϕ c)
  have hη_c_pos : ∀ c : ↥K_cov, 0 < η_c c :=
    fun c => mul_pos (by positivity) (lt_min zero_lt_one (hδ_ϕ_pos c))
  have hη_c_le : ∀ c : ↥K_cov, η_c c ≤ r₀ / 2 := by
    intro c
    dsimp [η_c]
    have := min_le_left 1 (δ_ϕ c)
    nlinarith
  let B_c : ↥K_cov → Set ℂ := fun c => Metric.ball c.1 (η_c c / 4)
  have h_cov_all : K_cov ⊆ ⋃ c : ↥K_cov, B_c c := by

    let f₁ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => S_c c₁ n (Z, T)
    let f₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => S_c c₂ n (Z, T)
    have hf₁_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₁ R_1_full :=
      (hSc_holo c₁ n (le_trans (hNc_le_glue c₁) hn)).comp
        (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const T)).differentiableOn
        (fun _ hZ => ⟨hZ, hT₁⟩)
    have hf₂_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₂ R_1_full :=
      (hSc_holo c₂ n (le_trans (hNc_le_glue c₂) hn)).comp
        (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const T)).differentiableOn
        (fun _ hZ => ⟨hZ, hT₂⟩)
    let Y₀ : ℂ := (((H_1_bot + H_cut_0) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hY₀_low : Y₀ ∈ R_low := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [Y₀]; linarith
      · simp [Y₀]; linarith
      · simp [Y₀]; linarith
      · simp [Y₀]; linarith
    have hev : f₁ =ᶠ[nhds Y₀] f₂ := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hRlow_open.mem_nhds hY₀_low) ?_
      intro Z hZ
      dsimp [f₁, f₂]
      rw [hSc_low_eq c₁ n hn (Z, T) ⟨hZ, hT₁⟩, hSc_low_eq c₂ n hn (Z, T) ⟨hZ, hT₂⟩]
    exact (hf₁_diff.analyticOnNhd hR1_open).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq
      (hf₂_diff.analyticOnNhd hR1_open) hR1_preconn (hRlow_sub_R1 hY₀_low) hev hY
  let S₁ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n q =>
    if h : ∃ c : ↥t_fin, q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ B_c c.1 then
      S_c (Classical.choose h) n q
    else 0
  have hS₁_eq_Sc : ∀ n ≥ N_glue, ∀ (c : ↥t_fin), ∀ q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ B_c c.1,
      S₁ n q = S_c c n q := by
    intro n hn c q hq
    dsimp only [S₁]
    split_ifs with hex
    · have h_ch := Classical.choose_spec hex
      exact h_overlap_eq n hn (Classical.choose hex) c q.1 q.2 hq.1 h_ch.2 hq.2
    · exact False.elim (hex ⟨c, hq⟩)
  have hS₁_low_eq : ∀ n ≥ N_glue, ∀ q ∈ R_low ×ˢ U_T_open,
      S₁ n q = S_prev n q := by
    intro n hn q hq
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hq.2 with ⟨c, hqc⟩
    rw [hS₁_eq_Sc n hn c q ⟨hRlow_sub_R1 hq.1, hqc⟩]
    exact hSc_low_eq c n hn q ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩
  have hS₁_holo_open : ∀ n ≥ N_glue, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₁ n) (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_open) := by
    intro n hn q hq
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hq.2 with ⟨c, hqc⟩
    let V : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := R_1_full ×ˢ B_c c.1
    have hV_open : IsOpen V := hR1_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hqV : q ∈ V := ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩
    have hSc_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ (S_c c n) q :=
      (hSc_holo c n (le_trans (hNc_le_glue c) hn)).differentiableAt (hV_open.mem_nhds hqV)
    have hev : S₁ n =ᶠ[nhds q] S_c c n :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hV_open.mem_nhds hqV) (fun p hp => hS₁_eq_Sc n hn c p hp)
    exact (hSc_at.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).differentiableWithinAt
  have hS₁_conv_open :
      TendstoUniformlyOn S₁ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
        (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_open) := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have h_each : ∀ c : ↥t_fin, ∃ N_ε : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_ε, ∀ q ∈ R_1_full ×ˢ B_c c.1,
        dist (expShearedInnerModel seq M q) (S_c c n q) < ε := by
      intro c
      exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
        (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hSc_conv c) ε hε)
    choose N_ε hN_ε using h_each
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N_glue (Finset.univ.sup N_ε), ?_⟩
    intro n hn q hq
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hq.2 with ⟨c, hqc⟩
    have hn_glue : N_glue ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_c : N_ε c ≤ n :=
      le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ c)) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
    rw [hS₁_eq_Sc n hn_glue c q ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩]
    exact hN_ε c n hn_c q ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩
  
  let δ_r : ℝ := ν' / 8
  have hδ_r_pos : 0 < δ_r := by dsimp [δ_r]; positivity
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁_ge_glue, hN₁_rec⟩ :=
    hRec (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M)
      T_max U_T_open K_1
      (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_1_top H_cut_0 δ_r
      N_glue S₁
      hBridge.inner_model_reg hT_max_pos hδ_r_pos
      hUT_open_isOpen (isCompact_closedBall _ _) hK1_sub_Uopen
      (by
        intro T hT
        rcases hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 T (hUopen_sub_Uall hT) with ⟨hT_ne, hT_norm, _, _⟩
        exact ⟨hT_ne, hT_norm⟩)
      (by dsimp [δ_r]; linarith)
      (by dsimp [δ_r, H_1_top]; linarith)
      (by dsimp [δ_r]; linarith)
      (by dsimp [H_1_top]; linarith)
      (by
        intro p hp
        have hT_dist : ‖p.2 - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star := by
          simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hUopen_sub_Uall hp.2
        have hY_im : p.1.im < Real.log M.R := by
          have h1 : p.1.im < H_1_top := hp.1.2.2.2
          dsimp [H_1_top] at h1
          linarith
        exact hBridge.mem_inner_of_lt_log_R p.1 p.2 hT_dist hY_im)
      hS₁_holo_open
      (fun K _ hK_sub => hS₁_conv_open.mono hK_sub)
      (by
        intro n hn Y T hT hY hY_sub hY_add
        have hn_init : N_init ≤ n := le_trans hNinit_le_glue hn
        have hT_open : T ∈ U_T_open := hK1_sub_Uopen hT
        have hT_all : T ∈ U_T_all := hUopen_sub_Uall hT_open
        rcases hInit_n n hn_init with ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hSsh_rec⟩
        have h_base := hSsh_rec Y T hT_all (hRlow_sub_Rdeep hY)
          (hRlow_sub_Rdeep hY_sub) (hRlow_sub_Rdeep hY_add)
        have heq_prev :
            S₁ n (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) =
              shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n
                (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) :=
          hS₁_low_eq n hn _ ⟨hY_sub, hT_open⟩
        have heq_curr :
            S₁ n (Y, T) = shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n (Y, T) :=
          hS₁_low_eq n hn (Y, T) ⟨hY, hT_open⟩
        have heq_next :
            S₁ n (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) =
              shearedRescaledLift seq (s_tilde n) n
                (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) :=
          hS₁_low_eq n hn _ ⟨hY_add, hT_open⟩
        unfold SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence at h_base ⊢
        dsimp only at h_base ⊢
        rw [heq_prev, heq_curr, heq_next]
        exact h_base)
  
  refine ⟨H_1_bot, H_cut_0, N₁, U_phys, s_tilde, δ_base, S₁,
    hH1_lt_55, hH1_lt_cut, hHcut_lt_50, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    have hn_glue : N_glue ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_ge_glue hn
    have hn_init : N_init ≤ n := le_trans hNinit_le_glue hn_glue
    rcases hInit_n n hn_init with
      ⟨hU_conv, hδ_pos, hs_holo, hs_strip, hs_base, h_toPhys, _, _, _⟩
    refine ⟨hU_conv, hδ_pos, hs_holo, hs_strip, hs_base, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q hq
      have hq_open : q.2 ∈ U_T_open := hUT1_sub_Uopen hq.2
      have hq_all : q.2 ∈ U_T_all := hUopen_sub_Uall hq_open
      refine ⟨h_toPhys q ⟨hRlow_sub_Rdeep hq.1, hq_all⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hS₁_low_eq n hn_glue q ⟨hq.1, hq_open⟩]
      have hℓ_ne : (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (seq.ℓ_pos n).ne'
      change expBasePt seq n +
          (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) *
            ((s_tilde n (shearedToPhys seq n q) - expBasePt seq n) / (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ)) =
          s_tilde n (shearedToPhys seq n q)
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hℓ_ne]
      ring
    · exact (hS₁_holo_open n hn_glue).mono (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl hUT1_sub_Uopen)
    · intro q hq
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hUT1_sub_Uopen hq.2) with ⟨c, hqc⟩
      rw [hS₁_eq_Sc n hn_glue c q ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩]
      exact hSc_strip c n (le_trans (hNc_le_glue c) hn_glue) q ⟨hq.1, hqc⟩
    · intro Y T hT hY
      have hY' : Y ∈ complexRect (-X₁ + δ_r) (X₁ - δ_r) (H_1_bot + δ_r) (H_1_top - δ_r) :=
        hRect_mono le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl (by dsimp [H_1_top, δ_r]; linarith) hY
      exact hN₁_rec n hn T (hUT1_sub_K1 hT) Y hY'
  · exact hS₁_conv_open.mono (Set.prod_mono Set.Subset.rfl hUT1_sub_Uopen)

signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (M : BranchMonodromyPackage kind)
    (hDisk : DiskContinuationToolkitProp)
    (hBridge : ShearedModelAndDeepBridgeProp X P kind seq M)
    (hLift : ShearedDiskLiftProp X P kind seq)
    (hRec : VertRecurrenceProp X P kind seq)
    (hStage1 : StageOneShearedProp X P kind seq M) :
    Nonempty (RadialBypassPatchesData X P kind seq M)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let _ := hX
  let T_star : ℝ := expParamStar seq
  have hT_star_pos : 0 < T_star := hBridge.T_star_pos
  let α_c : ℝ := expArgC0 seq
  let r₀ : ℝ := T_star / 32
  have hr₀_pos : 0 < r₀ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ_ϕ2, g₀, hδ_ϕ2_pos, hg₀_diff, hg₀_zero, hg₀_unit, hg₀_dip⟩ :=
    hDisk.binomial_dip_poly 0 Real.pi 5 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  let η₂ : ℝ := (r₀ / 8) * min 1 δ_ϕ2
  have hmin_pos : 0 < min (1 : ℝ) δ_ϕ2 := lt_min zero_lt_one hδ_ϕ2_pos
  have hmin_le_one : min (1 : ℝ) δ_ϕ2 ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hη₂_pos : 0 < η₂ := by positivity
  have hη₂_le : η₂ ≤ r₀ / 8 := by
    dsimp [η₂]
    nlinarith
  let D_drift : ℝ := 40 + 20 * T_star / η₂ + 1
  have hD_drift_pos : 0 < D_drift := by positivity
  let ν' : ℝ := min (M.ν / 2) (M.δ_θ / (8 * D_drift))
  have hν'_pos : 0 < ν' := lt_min (by linarith [M.ν_pos]) (div_pos M.δ_θ_pos (by positivity))
  have hν'_le_half_ν : ν' ≤ M.ν / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hν'_lt : ν' < M.ν := by linarith [M.ν_pos]
  have hν'_lt_half : ν' < 1 / 2 := by linarith [M.ν_lt_one]
  have h_drift_sum : (40 + 20 * T_star / η₂) * ν' < M.δ_θ / 8 := by
    have h1 : ν' ≤ M.δ_θ / (8 * D_drift) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : ν' * (8 * D_drift) ≤ M.δ_θ := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp h1
    dsimp [D_drift] at h2
    nlinarith
  have h_40ν_lt : 40 * ν' < M.δ_θ / 8 := by
    have : 0 < (20 * T_star / η₂) * ν' := by positivity
    linarith
  let ε_patch : ℝ := min (ν' / 24) (M.δ_θ / 24)
  have hε_patch_pos : 0 < ε_patch := lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos])
  have hε_patch_le_ν : ε_patch ≤ ν' / 24 := min_le_left _ _
  have hε_patch_le_δ : ε_patch ≤ M.δ_θ / 24 := min_le_right _ _
  have hε_patch_lt_ν : ε_patch < ν' / 12 := by linarith
  have hε_patch_lt_δ : ε_patch < M.δ_θ / 12 := by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]

  let X₁ : ℝ := |α_c| + M.θ + 10
  let U_T_all : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star)
  let U_T_1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * r₀)
  let U_T_2 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (T_star : ℂ) (η₂ / 2)
  let H_cut_1 : ℝ := Real.log M.R - (15 / 4 : ℝ) * ν'
  let Rect2 : ℝ → Set ℂ := fun sgn =>
    complexRect
      (α_c - sgn * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4)
      (α_c - sgn * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
      (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν')
      (Real.log M.R + (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
  let TargetCenter : ℝ → ℂ := fun sgn =>
    ((α_c - sgn * M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

  have h_UT2_sub_UT1 : U_T_2 ⊆ U_T_1 :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have h_UT1_sub_all : U_T_1 ⊆ U_T_all :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [r₀]; linarith)
  have h_UT2_sub_all : U_T_2 ⊆ U_T_all := h_UT2_sub_UT1.trans h_UT1_sub_all

  have h_rect_open : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, IsOpen (complexRect a b c d) := by
    intro a b c d
    have h1 : IsOpen { z : ℂ | a < z.re } := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
    have h2 : IsOpen { z : ℂ | z.re < b } := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const
    have h3 : IsOpen { z : ℂ | c < z.im } := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
    have h4 : IsOpen { z : ℂ | z.im < d } := isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
    simpa only [complexRect, Set.inter_def, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))

  have h_rec_congr : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ),
      f₁ (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        f₂ (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) →
      f₁ Y = f₂ Y →
      f₁ (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        f₂ (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq f₁ n Y T →
      SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq f₂ n Y T := by
    intro f₁ f₂ n Y T hprev hcurr hnext hrec
    dsimp only [SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence] at hrec ⊢
    rwa [← hprev, ← hcurr, ← hnext]

  have h_x_bounds : ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      -X₁ + ν' / 8 < (α_c - sgn * M.θ) - M.δ_θ ∧
        (α_c - sgn * M.θ) + M.δ_θ < X₁ - ν' / 8 := by
    intro sgn hsgn
    have hpi : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
    have hθ_lt_one : M.θ < 1 := by linarith [M.θ_lt]
    have hδ_lt : M.δ_θ < 1 / 2 := by linarith [M.δ_θ_lt]
    have hα_lo : -|α_c| ≤ α_c := neg_abs_le α_c
    have hα_hi : α_c ≤ |α_c| := le_abs_self α_c
    rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> dsimp [X₁] <;>
      linarith [M.θ_pos, M.δ_θ_pos, hν'_pos, hν'_lt_half]

  obtain ⟨H_1_bot, H_cut_0, N₁, U_phys, s_tilde, δ_base, S₁,
    hH1_lt, hH1_cut, hHcut_lt, hS₁_props, hS₁_conv⟩ :=
    hStage1 ν' hν'_pos hν'_lt
  let R_1_full : Set ℂ := complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot (Real.log M.R - ν')
  let R_1_rec : Set ℂ :=
    complexRect (-X₁ + ν' / 8) (X₁ - ν' / 8)
      (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - (9 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')

  
  have h_sector_lift : ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ∃ (N₂ : ℕ) (S₂ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        N₁ ≤ N₂ ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N₂, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₂ n) (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N₂, ∀ p ∈ Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2,
          expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₂ n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N₂, ∀ p ∈ Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2,
          p.1.im < Real.log M.R - (13 / 4 : ℝ) * ν' → S₂ n p = S₁ n p) ∧
        TendstoUniformlyOn S₂ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
          (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2) := by
    intro sgn hsgn
    let x_ctr : ℝ := α_c - sgn * M.θ
    let K_T_prev : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (T_star : ℂ) ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * r₀)
    let g₂ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => (ν' : ℂ) * g₀ ζ
    have hK_sub_UT1 : K_T_prev ⊆ U_T_1 :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hUT1_sub_ball : U_T_1 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * T_star) := by
      intro T hT
      have hT_all : T ∈ U_T_all := h_UT1_sub_all hT
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using
        (hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 T hT_all).2.1
    have hg₂_diff : Differentiable ℂ g₂ := hg₀_diff.const_mul (ν' : ℂ)
    have hg₂_zero : g₂ 0 = 0 := by simp [g₂, hg₀_zero]
    have hg₂_unit : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 → ‖g₂ ζ‖ ≤ 40 * ν' ∧ (g₂ ζ).im ≤ ν' := by
      intro ζ hζ
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg₀_unit ζ hζ
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · calc ‖(ν' : ℂ) * g₀ ζ‖ = ‖(ν' : ℂ)‖ * ‖g₀ ζ‖ := norm_mul _ _
          _ = ν' * ‖g₀ ζ‖ := by rw [Complex.norm_of_nonneg hν'_pos.le]
          _ ≤ 40 * ν' := by nlinarith
      · have him : ((ν' : ℂ) * g₀ ζ).im = ν' * (g₀ ζ).im := by simp
        rw [him]
        nlinarith
    have h_disk_in_K : ∀ T_c ∈ U_T_2, ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 →
        T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ ∈ K_T_prev := by
      intro T_c hTc ζ hζ
      have hTc_lt : ‖T_c - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < η₂ / 2 := by
        simpa [U_T_2, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hTc
      have hrζ : ‖(r₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ ≤ r₀ := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hr₀_pos.le]
        nlinarith
      have h_tri : ‖T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ - (T_star : ℂ)‖ ≤
          ‖T_c - (T_star : ℂ)‖ + ‖(r₀ : ℂ) * ζ‖ := by
        have h_eq : T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ - (T_star : ℂ) =
            (T_c - (T_star : ℂ)) + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      simp only [K_T_prev, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    have h_circle_in_K : ∀ T_c ∈ U_T_2, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ∈ K_T_prev := by
      intro T_c hTc ϕ
      exact h_disk_in_K T_c hTc _ (Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I ϕ).le
    have h_cball_in_UT1 : ∀ T_c ∈ U_T_2, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
        T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ ∈ U_T_1 := by
      intro T_c hTc ζ hζ
      have hζ' : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hζ
      exact hK_sub_UT1 (h_disk_in_K T_c hTc ζ hζ')
    have h_dip : ∀ T_c ∈ U_T_2, ∀ ϕ : ℝ,
        |(T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂ →
        (Real.log M.R + (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ν') +
          (g₂ (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤
          (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν') -
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
              (((Real.log M.R - 2 * ν') - (Real.log M.R - 3 * ν')) / 4) := by
      intro T_c hTc ϕ h_im_le
      have hTc_lt : ‖T_c - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < η₂ / 2 := by
        simpa [U_T_2, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hTc
      have hTc_im : |T_c.im| < η₂ / 2 := by
        have h1 : |(T_c - (T_star : ℂ)).im| ≤ ‖T_c - (T_star : ℂ)‖ :=
          Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        have h2 : (T_c - (T_star : ℂ)).im = T_c.im := by simp
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      have hexp_im :
          (T_c + (r₀ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
            T_c.im + r₀ * Real.sin ϕ := by
        simp [Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
      rw [hexp_im] at h_im_le
      have hr_sin : |r₀ * Real.sin ϕ| ≤ 2 * η₂ := by
        rw [abs_le] at h_im_le ⊢
        rw [abs_lt] at hTc_im
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hr_sin' : r₀ * |Real.sin ϕ| ≤ r₀ * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 δ_ϕ2) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr₀_pos] at hr_sin
        have h2η : 2 * η₂ = r₀ * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 δ_ϕ2) := by
          dsimp [η₂]
          ring
        linarith
      have hsin_le : |Real.sin ϕ - 0| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * min 1 δ_ϕ2 := by
        rw [sub_zero]
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hr_sin' hr₀_pos
      have h_col :=
        hBridge.arcsin_collar 0 δ_ϕ2 (by constructor <;> norm_num) hδ_ϕ2_pos ϕ hsin_le
      have h_col' : ∃ k : ℤ,
          |ϕ - 0 - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ2 ∨
          |ϕ - Real.pi - 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ)| ≤ δ_ϕ2 := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk | hk⟩ := h_col
        · rw [Real.arcsin_zero] at hk
          exact ⟨k, Or.inl hk⟩
        · rw [Real.arcsin_zero, sub_zero] at hk
          exact ⟨k, Or.inr hk⟩
      have hg₀_im := hg₀_dip ϕ h_col'
      have hg₂_im : (g₂ (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im ≤ -5 * ν' := by
        have him : (g₂ (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im =
            ν' * (g₀ (Complex.exp ((ϕ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im := by
          simp [g₂]
        rw [him]
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have hB_rec_mod :
        complexRect (x_ctr - M.δ_θ) (x_ctr + M.δ_θ)
          (Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν') ×ˢ U_T_1 ⊆
          expShearedInnerDomain seq M := by
      intro p hp
      have hpT : ‖p.2 - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star := by
        simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using h_UT1_sub_all hp.2
      have hp_im : p.1.im < Real.log M.R := by linarith [hp.1.2.2.2]
      exact hBridge.mem_inner_of_lt_log_R p.1 p.2 hpT hp_im
    have hW_disk_mod :
        ∀ p ∈ Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1,
          (p.1 + g₂ ζ, p.2 + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ) ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M := by
      intro p hp ζ hζ
      have hζ_norm : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hζ
      obtain ⟨hg_norm, hg_im⟩ := hg₂_unit ζ hζ_norm
      have hg_re : |(g₂ ζ).re| ≤ 40 * ν' := le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hg_norm
      have hT_mem : p.2 + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ ∈ U_T_all :=
        h_UT1_sub_all (h_cball_in_UT1 p.2 hp.2 ζ hζ)
      have hT_dist : ‖p.2 + (r₀ : ℂ) * ζ - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star := by
        simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hT_mem
      have hY_im : (p.1 + g₂ ζ).im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν := by
        have him : (p.1 + g₂ ζ).im = p.1.im + (g₂ ζ).im := by simp
        rw [him]
        linarith [hp.1.2.2.2, M.ν_pos]
      have hY_re : |(p.1 + g₂ ζ).re - (α_c - sgn * M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ := by
        have hre : (p.1 + g₂ ζ).re = p.1.re + (g₂ ζ).re := by simp
        rw [hre, abs_lt]
        rw [abs_le] at hg_re
        constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1, hp.1.2.1, M.δ_θ_pos]
      exact hBridge.mem_inner_of_sector sgn _ _ hsgn hT_dist hY_im hY_re
    have h_rays : ∀ (σ : ℝ), (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) →
        ∀ (Y' T' : ℂ),
          (x_ctr - M.δ_θ / 4) - 40 * ν' ≤ Y'.re →
          Y'.re ≤ (x_ctr + M.δ_θ / 4) + 40 * ν' →
          ((Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') + (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν')) / 2 ≤ Y'.im →
          Y'.im ≤ (Real.log M.R + (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ν') + ν' →
          T' ∈ K_T_prev →
          (3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂ ≤ σ * T'.im →
          ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc
            (((Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') + (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν')) / 2) Y'.im,
            let y_mid : ℝ := ((Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') + (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν')) / 2
            let Y_vert : ℂ := (Y'.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * T'.im)
            (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
              (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T', T') ∈ expShearedInnerDomain seq M) ∧
            x_ctr - M.δ_θ < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re ∧
            (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re < x_ctr + M.δ_θ := by
      intro σ hσ Y' T' hY_lo hY_hi hY_im_lo hY_im_hi hT'_K hT'_steep τ hτ
      let y_mid : ℝ := ((Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') + (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν')) / 2
      let Y_vert : ℂ := (Y'.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
      let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * T'.im)
      have hT'_all : T' ∈ U_T_all := h_UT1_sub_all (hK_sub_UT1 hT'_K)
      have hT'_norm : ‖T'‖ < 2 * T_star := (hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 T' hT'_all).2.1
      have hT'_dist : ‖T' - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star := by
        simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hT'_all
      have hσ_im_pos : 0 < σ * T'.im := by linarith
      have hτ_diff_nonneg : 0 ≤ τ - y_mid := by
        dsimp [y_mid] at hτ ⊢
        linarith [hτ.1]
      have hτ_diff_le : τ - y_mid ≤ (35 / 8 : ℝ) * ν' := by
        dsimp [y_mid] at hτ ⊢
        linarith [hτ.2]
      have hs_end_nonneg : 0 ≤ s_end := div_nonneg hτ_diff_nonneg hσ_im_pos.le
      have hs_end_le : s_end ≤ 10 * (ν' / η₂) := by
        have hmul1 : s_end * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂) ≤ s_end * (σ * T'.im) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT'_steep hs_end_nonneg
        have hmul2 : s_end * (σ * T'.im) = τ - y_mid :=
          div_mul_cancel₀ (τ - y_mid) hσ_im_pos.ne'
        have hmul3 : (10 * (ν' / η₂)) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂) = 15 * ν' := by
          field_simp [hη₂_pos.ne']
          ring
        have hmul4 : s_end * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂) ≤
            (10 * (ν' / η₂)) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * η₂) := by
          linarith
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul4 (by positivity)
      have hσ_norm : ‖(σ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      have h_ray_bounds : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
          |(Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re - x_ctr| < (3 / 8 : ℝ) * M.δ_θ ∧
          (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν := by
        intro s hs
        have hs_le : s ≤ 10 * (ν' / η₂) := le_trans hs.2 hs_end_le
        have hshift_norm : ‖(s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T'‖ ≤ (20 * T_star / η₂) * ν' := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hs.1, hσ_norm, mul_one]
          have h1 : s * ‖T'‖ ≤ (10 * (ν' / η₂)) * (2 * T_star) :=
            mul_le_mul hs_le hT'_norm.le (norm_nonneg T') (by positivity)
          have h2 : (10 * (ν' / η₂)) * (2 * T_star) = (20 * T_star / η₂) * ν' := by ring
          linarith
        have hshift_re : |((s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re| ≤ (20 * T_star / η₂) * ν' :=
          le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hshift_norm
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have hre : (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re =
              Y'.re - ((s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').re := by simp [Y_vert]
          rw [hre, abs_lt]
          rw [abs_le] at hshift_re
          constructor <;> linarith
        · have him : (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * T').im = τ - s * (σ * T'.im) := by
            simp [Y_vert, mul_assoc]
          have hs_prod : 0 ≤ s * (σ * T'.im) := mul_nonneg hs.1 hσ_im_pos.le
          rw [him]
          linarith [hτ.2, M.ν_pos]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro s hs
        obtain ⟨hre, him⟩ := h_ray_bounds s hs
        exact hBridge.mem_inner_of_sector sgn _ _ hsgn hT'_dist him
          (lt_trans hre (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]))
      · obtain ⟨hre_end, _⟩ := h_ray_bounds s_end ⟨hs_end_nonneg, le_rfl⟩
        rw [abs_lt] at hre_end
        constructor <;> linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]
    obtain ⟨hx_lo_gt, hx_hi_lt⟩ := h_x_bounds sgn hsgn
    have hU_prev_sub :
        complexRect (x_ctr - M.δ_θ) (x_ctr + M.δ_θ)
          (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν') ×ˢ U_T_1 ⊆

    obtain ⟨N₂, S₂, hN₁_le, hS₂_holo, hS₂_strip, hS₂_eq, hS₂_conv⟩ :=
      hLift
        (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M)
        (2 * T_star) r₀ η₂ (40 * ν') ν'
        U_T_1 K_T_prev U_T_2
        (x_ctr - M.δ_θ) (x_ctr - M.δ_θ / 4) (x_ctr + M.δ_θ / 4) (x_ctr + M.δ_θ)
        (H_1_bot + ν' / 8) (Real.log M.R - 3 * ν') (Real.log M.R - 2 * ν')
        (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') (Real.log M.R + (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
        g₂
        hBridge.inner_model_reg
        (by positivity) hr₀_pos hη₂_pos (by positivity) hν'_pos
        Metric.isOpen_ball (isCompact_closedBall _ _) hK_sub_UT1 hUT1_sub_ball
        Metric.isOpen_ball
        (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]) (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]) (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos])
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (by linarith)
        hg₂_diff hg₂_zero hg₂_unit h_circle_in_K h_cball_in_UT1 h_dip
        hB_rec_mod hW_disk_mod h_rays
        N₁ S₁
        (fun n hn => (hS₁_props n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.1.mono hU_prev_sub)
        (fun n hn p hp => (hS₁_props n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 p (hU_prev_sub hp))
        (fun n hn Y T _ hYT _ _ =>
          (hS₁_props n hn).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 Y T hYT.2 (hB_rec_Y_sub hYT.1))
        (fun _ _ hK => hS₁_conv.mono (hK.trans hU_prev_sub))
    refine ⟨N₂, S₂, hN₁_le, hS₂_holo, hS₂_strip, ?_, hS₂_conv⟩
    intro n hn p hp hp_im
    exact hS₂_eq n hn p hp (by linarith)

  obtain ⟨N₂_plus, S₂_plus, hN₁_le_plus, hS₂_plus_holo, hS₂_plus_strip,

  obtain ⟨N₂_minus, S₂_minus, hN₁_le_minus, hS₂_minus_holo, hS₂_minus_strip,

  let δ_r : ℝ := min (ν' / 8) (M.δ_θ / 8)
  have hδ_r_pos : 0 < δ_r := lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos])
  have hδ_r_le_ν : δ_r ≤ ν' / 8 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_r_le_δ : δ_r ≤ M.δ_θ / 8 := min_le_right _ _
  have hT_star_mem_UT2 : (T_star : ℂ) ∈ U_T_2 :=

  have hT_star_mem_UT1 : (T_star : ℂ) ∈ U_T_1 := h_UT2_sub_UT1 hT_star_mem_UT2

  have h_ball_in_shrunk : ∀ sgn : ℝ,

    rw [abs_lt] at hZ_re hZ_im
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩

  have h_shrunk_sub_rect2 : ∀ sgn : ℝ,
      complexRect
        ((α_c - sgn * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) + δ_r)
        ((α_c - sgn * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4) - δ_r)
        ((Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') + δ_r)
