    intro sgn Z hZ
    exact ⟨by linarith [hZ.1], by linarith [hZ.2.1],
      by linarith [hZ.2.2.1], by linarith [hZ.2.2.2]⟩

  have h_ball_sub_rect2 : ∀ sgn : ℝ,
      Metric.ball (TargetCenter sgn) (3 * ε_patch) ⊆ Rect2 sgn :=
    fun sgn => (h_ball_in_shrunk sgn).trans (h_shrunk_sub_rect2 sgn)

  have h_model_slice_eq : ∀ Z : ℂ,
      expShearedInnerModel seq M (Z, (T_star : ℂ)) =
        Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) := by
    intro Z
    dsimp [expShearedInnerModel, expShearedModelW]
    rw [hBridge.shear_zero, add_zero]
    have h_exp_arg : -Complex.I * (Z - (α_c : ℂ)) =
        (α_c : ℂ) * Complex.I + (-Complex.I * Z) := by ring
    rw [h_exp_arg, Complex.exp_add, ← hBridge.unit_c₀]

  have h_slice_conv : ∀ (sgn : ℝ) (S₂ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      TendstoUniformlyOn S₂ (expShearedInnerModel seq M) Filter.atTop
        (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n Z => S₂ n (Z, (T_star : ℂ)))
        (fun Z => Z + M.Δ_inner ((T_star : ℂ) * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)))
        Filter.atTop
        (Metric.closedBall (TargetCenter sgn) (2 * ε_patch)) := by
    intro sgn S₂ hS₂_c
    let ι : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun Z => (Z, (T_star : ℂ))
    have h_sub : Metric.closedBall (TargetCenter sgn) (2 * ε_patch) ⊆
        ι ⁻¹' (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2) := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hZ_ball : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter sgn) (3 * ε_patch) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
      exact ⟨h_ball_sub_rect2 sgn hZ_ball, hT_star_mem_UT2⟩
    have h1 := (hS₂_c.comp ι).mono h_sub
    exact h1.congr_right (fun Z _ => h_model_slice_eq Z)

  have h_rec_step : ∃ N_rec : ℕ, N₂_plus ≤ N_rec ∧
      ∀ n ≥ N_rec, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch),
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq
          (fun W => S₂_plus n (W, (T_star : ℂ))) n Z (T_star : ℂ) := by
    have hUT2_bounds : U_T_2 ⊆ { T : ℂ | T ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T‖ < 2 * T_star } := by
      intro T hT
      have hT_all := h_UT2_sub_all hT
      exact ⟨(hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 T hT_all).1,
        (hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 T hT_all).2.1⟩
    have hRect2_mod : Rect2 1 ×ˢ U_T_2 ⊆ expShearedInnerDomain seq M := by
      intro q hq
      have hT_dist : ‖q.2 - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < (15 / 32 : ℝ) * T_star := by
        simpa [U_T_all, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using h_UT2_sub_all hq.2
      have hY_im : q.1.im < Real.log M.R + 2 * M.ν := by
        linarith [hq.1.2.2.2, M.ν_pos]
      have hY_re : |q.1.re - (α_c - 1 * M.θ)| < 2 * M.δ_θ := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith [hq.1.1, hq.1.2.1, M.δ_θ_pos]
      exact hBridge.mem_inner_of_sector 1 q.1 q.2 (Or.inl rfl) hT_dist hY_im hY_re
    obtain ⟨hx1_lo, hx1_hi⟩ := h_x_bounds 1 (Or.inl rfl)
    have h_seed : ∀ n ≥ N₂_plus, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ∈ ({(T_star : ℂ)} : Set ℂ) →
        Y ∈ complexRect (α_c - 1 * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) (α_c - 1 * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
          (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') H_cut_1 →
        Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
          complexRect (α_c - 1 * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) (α_c - 1 * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
            (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') H_cut_1 →
        Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
          complexRect (α_c - 1 * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) (α_c - 1 * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
            (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') H_cut_1 →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S₂_plus n (Z, T)) n Y T := by
      intro n hn Y T hT_mem hY hY_m hY_p
      have hT_eq : T = (T_star : ℂ) := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hT_mem
      subst hT_eq
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans hN₁_le_plus hn
      have h_eq_on_seed : ∀ W : ℂ,
          W ∈ complexRect (α_c - 1 * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) (α_c - 1 * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
            (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') H_cut_1 →
          S₁ n (W, (T_star : ℂ)) = S₂_plus n (W, (T_star : ℂ)) := by
        intro W hW
        have hW_rect2 : W ∈ Rect2 1 :=
          ⟨hW.1, hW.2.1, hW.2.2.1, by dsimp [H_cut_1] at hW; linarith [hW.2.2.2]⟩
        exact (hS₂_plus_eq n hn (W, (T_star : ℂ)) ⟨hW_rect2, hT_star_mem_UT2⟩
          (by dsimp [H_cut_1] at hW; linarith [hW.2.2.2])).symm
      have hY_R1rec : Y ∈ R_1_rec :=
        ⟨by linarith [hY.1], by linarith [hY.2.1],
          by linarith [hY.2.2.1], by dsimp [H_cut_1] at hY; linarith [hY.2.2.2]⟩
      exact h_rec_congr
        (fun Z => S₁ n (Z, (T_star : ℂ)))
        (fun Z => S₂_plus n (Z, (T_star : ℂ)))
        n Y (T_star : ℂ)
        (h_eq_on_seed _ hY_m) (h_eq_on_seed _ hY) (h_eq_on_seed _ hY_p)
        ((hS₁_props n hn₁).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 Y (T_star : ℂ) hT_star_mem_UT1 hY_R1rec)
    obtain ⟨N_rec, hN₂_le_rec, hRec_out⟩ :=
      hRec
        (expShearedInnerDomain seq M) (expShearedInnerModel seq M)
        (2 * T_star) U_T_2 ({(T_star : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)
        (α_c - 1 * M.θ - M.δ_θ / 4) (α_c - 1 * M.θ + M.δ_θ / 4)
        (Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν') (Real.log M.R + (7 / 8 : ℝ) * ν')
        H_cut_1 δ_r N₂_plus S₂_plus
        hBridge.inner_model_reg (by positivity) hδ_r_pos
        Metric.isOpen_ball isCompact_singleton
        (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hT_star_mem_UT2)
        hUT2_bounds
        (by linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]) (by linarith)
        (by dsimp [H_cut_1]; linarith) (by dsimp [H_cut_1]; linarith)
        hRect2_mod
        hS₂_plus_holo
        (fun _ _ hK => hS₂_plus_conv.mono hK)
        h_seed
    refine ⟨N_rec, hN₂_le_rec, ?_⟩
    intro n hn Z hZ
    exact hRec_out n hn (T_star : ℂ) (Set.mem_singleton _) Z (h_ball_in_shrunk 1 hZ)

  obtain ⟨N_rec, hN₂_le_rec, hS₂_plus_rec⟩ := h_rec_step

  
  obtain ⟨N_h, hN_h⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (seq.h_div_ℓ_tendsto.eventually_gt_atTop (max (3 - H_cut_0) (|Real.log M.R| + 2)))
  let N_patch : ℕ := max (max N₁ N_h) (max N₂_plus (max N₂_minus N_rec))

  let Layer0 : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      p ∈ U_phys n ∧
      (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2 ∈ U_T_2 ∧
      (physToSheared seq n p).1.im < H_cut_0 }
  let Layer1 : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2 ∈ U_T_2 ∧
      (physToSheared seq n p).1 ∈ complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_cut_1 }
  let Layer2 : ℝ → ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun sgn n =>
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      (seq.m_seq n : ℂ) * p.2 ∈ U_T_2 ∧
      (physToSheared seq n p).1 ∈ Rect2 sgn }
  let GluedDom : ℝ → ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := fun sgn n =>
    Layer0 n ∪ Layer1 n ∪ Layer2 sgn n
  let GluedFn : ℝ → (ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun sgn S₂ n p =>
    if p ∈ Layer2 sgn n then
      expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₂ n (physToSheared seq n p)
    else if p ∈ Layer1 n then
      expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p)
    else
      s_tilde n p
  let δ_zero : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    min (min (δ_base n / 2) (seq.ℓ_seq n)) (η₂ / (6 * seq.m_seq n))

  have h_gluing : ∀ (sgn : ℝ) (S₂ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (N₂ : ℕ),
      (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      (∀ n ≥ N₂, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S₂ n) (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2)) →
      (∀ n ≥ N₂, ∀ p ∈ Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2,
        expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S₂ n p ∈ X.D_strip) →
      (∀ n ≥ N₂, ∀ p ∈ Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2,
        p.1.im < Real.log M.R - (13 / 4 : ℝ) * ν' → S₂ n p = S₁ n p) →
      ∀ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n → N₂ ≤ n → N_h ≤ n →
        let t₀_n : ℝ := T_star / seq.m_seq n
        let x₀_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (α_c - sgn * M.θ)
        IsDownwardVertConvex (GluedDom sgn n) ∧
        0 < δ_zero n ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) (GluedDom sgn n) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ GluedDom sgn n, GluedFn sgn S₂ n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n → ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
          (y, t) ∈ GluedDom sgn n ∧ GluedFn sgn S₂ n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η →
          η ≤ seq.h_seq n + seq.ℓ_seq n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4) →
          ((x₀_n : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ GluedDom sgn n) ∧
        (∀ Z ∈ Rect2 sgn,
          (expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ GluedDom sgn n ∧
          rescaledLift seq (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) n Z (T_star : ℂ) =
            S₂ n (Z, (T_star : ℂ))) := by
    intro sgn S₂ N₂ hsgn hS₂_holo hS₂_strip hS₂_eq n hn₁ hn₂ hnh
    let ℓ_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n
    let m_n : ℝ := seq.m_seq n
    have hℓ_pos : 0 < ℓ_n := seq.ℓ_pos n
    have hm_pos : 0 < m_n := seq.m_pos n
    have hℓ_ne : (ℓ_n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hℓ_pos.ne'
    have hm_ne : (m_n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hm_pos.ne'
    obtain ⟨hU0_dvc, hδ_base_pos, hs_tilde_holo, hs_tilde_strip,
      hs_tilde_base, hS₁_attach, hS₁_holo, hS₁_strip, _⟩ := hS₁_props n hn₁
    have hh_ratio : max (3 - H_cut_0) (|Real.log M.R| + 2) < seq.h_seq n / ℓ_n :=
      hN_h n hnh
    have hh_ratio_1 : 3 - H_cut_0 < seq.h_seq n / ℓ_n :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hh_ratio
    have hh_ratio_2 : |Real.log M.R| + 2 < seq.h_seq n / ℓ_n :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hh_ratio

    have h_inv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, shearedToPhys seq n (physToSheared seq n p) = p := by
      intro p
      ext
      · dsimp [shearedToPhys, physToSheared]
        change expBasePt seq n +
            (ℓ_n : ℂ) *
              (((p.1 - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) -
                expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * p.2)) +
                expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * p.2)) = p.1
        field_simp [hℓ_ne]
        ring
      · dsimp [shearedToPhys, physToSheared]
        change ((m_n : ℂ) * p.2) / (m_n : ℂ) = p.2
        field_simp [hm_ne]

    let Ω_T2 : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | (m_n : ℂ) * p.2 ∈ U_T_2 }
    have hΩ_open : IsOpen Ω_T2 :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)
    have h_snd_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (m_n : ℂ) * p.2) :=
      (differentiable_snd : Differentiable ℂ (Prod.snd : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)).const_mul (m_n : ℂ)
    have h_lin_diff : Differentiable ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ)) := by
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using
        ((differentiable_fst : Differentiable ℂ (Prod.fst : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)).sub_const
          (expBasePt seq n)).mul_const (ℓ_n : ℂ)⁻¹
    have h_maps_Ω_all : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (m_n : ℂ) * p.2) Ω_T2 U_T_all :=
      fun _ hp => h_UT2_sub_all hp
    have h_shear_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * p.2)) Ω_T2 :=
      hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.1.fun_comp h_snd_diff.differentiableOn h_maps_Ω_all
    have h_pts_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (physToSheared seq n) Ω_T2 :=
      (h_lin_diff.differentiableOn.sub h_shear_diff).prodMk h_snd_diff.differentiableOn
    have h_fst_pts_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (physToSheared seq n p).1) Ω_T2 :=
      continuous_fst.comp_continuousOn h_pts_diff.continuousOn

    have hL0_open : IsOpen (Layer0 n) := by
      have h_pre : IsOpen (Ω_T2 ∩ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (physToSheared seq n p).1) ⁻¹'
          { z : ℂ | z.im < H_cut_0 }) :=
        h_fst_pts_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ_open
          (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
      have h_eq : Layer0 n = U_phys n ∩
          (Ω_T2 ∩ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (physToSheared seq n p).1) ⁻¹'
            { z : ℂ | z.im < H_cut_0 }) := by
        ext p
        exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hU0_dvc.1.inter h_pre
    have hL1_open : IsOpen (Layer1 n) :=
      h_fst_pts_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ_open (h_rect_open _ _ _ _)
    have hL2_open : IsOpen (Layer2 sgn n) :=
      h_fst_pts_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ_open (h_rect_open _ _ _ _)
    have hGlued_open : IsOpen (GluedDom sgn n) :=
      (hL0_open.union hL1_open).union hL2_open

    
    have h_disj_02 : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ Layer0 n → p ∉ Layer2 sgn n := by
      intro p hp0 hp2
      have h1 : (physToSheared seq n p).1.im < H_cut_0 := hp0.2.2
      have h2 : Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν' < (physToSheared seq n p).1.im :=
        hp2.2.2.2.1
      linarith
    have h_ov_10 : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ Layer1 n →
        (physToSheared seq n p).1.im < H_cut_0 →
        p ∈ Layer0 n ∧
        expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p) = s_tilde n p := by
      intro p hp1 hp_im
      have hq_mem : physToSheared seq n p ∈
          complexRect (-X₁) X₁ H_1_bot H_cut_0 ×ˢ U_T_1 :=
        ⟨⟨hp1.2.1, hp1.2.2.1, hp1.2.2.2.1, hp_im⟩, h_UT2_sub_UT1 hp1.1⟩
      obtain ⟨hp_phys, h_eq⟩ := hS₁_attach (physToSheared seq n p) hq_mem
      rw [h_inv p] at hp_phys h_eq
      exact ⟨⟨hp_phys, hp1.1, hp_im⟩, h_eq⟩
    obtain ⟨hx_sgn_lo, hx_sgn_hi⟩ := h_x_bounds sgn hsgn
    have h_ov_21 : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p ∈ Layer2 sgn n →
        (physToSheared seq n p).1.im < H_cut_1 →
        p ∈ Layer1 n ∧
        S₂ n (physToSheared seq n p) = S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p) := by
      intro p hp2 hp_im
      have hp1 : p ∈ Layer1 n :=
        ⟨hp2.1, ⟨by linarith [hp2.2.1, M.δ_θ_pos],
          by linarith [hp2.2.2.1, M.δ_θ_pos],
          by linarith [hp2.2.2.2.1], hp_im⟩⟩
      have h_eq : S₂ n (physToSheared seq n p) = S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p) :=
        hS₂_eq n hn₂ (physToSheared seq n p) ⟨hp2.2, hp2.1⟩
          (by dsimp [H_cut_1] at hp_im; linarith)
      exact ⟨hp1, h_eq⟩

    have h_fn_on_L2 : ∀ p ∈ Layer2 sgn n,
        GluedFn sgn S₂ n p =
          expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * S₂ n (physToSheared seq n p) := by
      intro p hp2
      dsimp [GluedFn]
      rw [if_pos hp2]
    have h_fn_on_L1 : ∀ p ∈ Layer1 n,
        GluedFn sgn S₂ n p =
          expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p) := by
      intro p hp1
      dsimp [GluedFn]
      by_cases hp2 : p ∈ Layer2 sgn n
      · rw [if_pos hp2, (h_ov_21 p hp2 hp1.2.2.2.2).2]
      · rw [if_neg hp2, if_pos hp1]
    have h_fn_on_L0 : ∀ p ∈ Layer0 n, GluedFn sgn S₂ n p = s_tilde n p := by
      intro p hp0
      have hp_not_2 : p ∉ Layer2 sgn n := h_disj_02 p hp0
      dsimp [GluedFn]
      rw [if_neg hp_not_2]
      by_cases hp1 : p ∈ Layer1 n
      · rw [if_pos hp1]
        exact (h_ov_10 p hp1 hp0.2.2).2
      · rw [if_neg hp1]

    have h_maps_L1 : Set.MapsTo (physToSheared seq n) (Layer1 n) (R_1_full ×ˢ U_T_1) := by
      intro p hp1
      have hp1_im : (physToSheared seq n p).1.im < H_cut_1 := hp1.2.2.2.2
      exact ⟨⟨hp1.2.1, hp1.2.2.1, hp1.2.2.2.1,
        by dsimp [H_cut_1] at hp1_im; linarith⟩, h_UT2_sub_UT1 hp1.1⟩
    have h_maps_L2 : Set.MapsTo (physToSheared seq n) (Layer2 sgn n)
        (Rect2 sgn ×ˢ U_T_2) :=
      fun _ hp2 => ⟨hp2.2, hp2.1⟩

    have h_holo_L0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) (Layer0 n) :=
      (hs_tilde_holo.mono (fun _ hp0 => hp0.1)).congr h_fn_on_L0
    have h_holo_L1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) (Layer1 n) := by
      have hc : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => S₁ n (physToSheared seq n p)) (Layer1 n) :=
        hS₁_holo.fun_comp (h_pts_diff.mono (fun _ hp1 => hp1.1)) h_maps_L1
      exact (DifferentiableOn.const_add (expBasePt seq n)
        (hc.const_mul (ℓ_n : ℂ))).congr h_fn_on_L1
    have h_holo_L2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) (Layer2 sgn n) := by
      have hc : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => S₂ n (physToSheared seq n p)) (Layer2 sgn n) :=
        (hS₂_holo n hn₂).fun_comp (h_pts_diff.mono (fun _ hp2 => hp2.1)) h_maps_L2
      exact (DifferentiableOn.const_add (expBasePt seq n)
        (hc.const_mul (ℓ_n : ℂ))).congr h_fn_on_L2

    have hGlued_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) (GluedDom sgn n) := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with (hp0 | hp1) | hp2
      · exact (h_holo_L0.differentiableAt (hL0_open.mem_nhds hp0)).differentiableWithinAt
      · exact (h_holo_L1.differentiableAt (hL1_open.mem_nhds hp1)).differentiableWithinAt
      · exact (h_holo_L2.differentiableAt (hL2_open.mem_nhds hp2)).differentiableWithinAt

    have hGlued_strip : ∀ p ∈ GluedDom sgn n, GluedFn sgn S₂ n p ∈ X.D_strip := by
      intro p hp
      rcases hp with (hp0 | hp1) | hp2
      · rw [h_fn_on_L0 p hp0]
        exact hs_tilde_strip p hp0.1
      · rw [h_fn_on_L1 p hp1]
        exact hS₁_strip _ (h_maps_L1 hp1)
      · rw [h_fn_on_L2 p hp2]
        exact hS₂_strip n hn₂ _ (h_maps_L2 hp2)

    
    let y_shift : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun y s => (y.re : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have h_pts_vert : ∀ (y t : ℂ) (s : ℝ),
        (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y s, t)).1 =
          (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1 + (((s - y.im) / ℓ_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ∧
        (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y s, t)).2 = (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).2 := by
      intro y t s
      refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      have hy_diff : y_shift y s - expBasePt seq n =
          (y - expBasePt seq n) + ((s - y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [y_shift]
      dsimp [physToSheared]
      change (y_shift y s - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) -
          expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * t) =
        ((y - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) -
          expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * t)) +
          (((s - y.im) / ℓ_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      rw [hy_diff]
      push_cast
      ring

    have h_dvc_L0 : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Layer0 n → 0 ≤ y.im →
        ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im → (y_shift y τ, t) ∈ Layer0 n := by
      intro y t hyt hy_im τ hτ0 hτy
      have h_phys : (y_shift y τ, t) ∈ U_phys n := hU0_dvc.2 y t hyt.1 hy_im τ hτ0 hτy
      have h_div_nonpos : (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n ≤ 0 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      have him_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ, t)).1.im =
          (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.im + (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n := by
        rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ).1]
        simp
      exact ⟨h_phys, hyt.2.1, by linarith [hyt.2.2]⟩

    have h_dvc_L1 : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Layer1 n → 0 ≤ y.im →
        ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im → (y_shift y τ, t) ∈ Layer0 n ∪ Layer1 n := by
      intro y t hyt hy_im τ hτ0 hτy
      let q_im : ℝ := (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.im
      have h_re_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ, t)).1.re =
          (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.re := by
        rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ).1]
        simp
      have h_im_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ, t)).1.im =
          q_im + (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n := by
        rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ).1]
        simp [q_im]
      have h_div_nonpos : (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n ≤ 0 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      by_cases h_stay : H_1_bot < q_im + (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hyt.1, by rw [h_re_eq]; exact hyt.2.1,
          by rw [h_re_eq]; exact hyt.2.2.1,
          by rw [h_im_eq]; exact h_stay,
          by rw [h_im_eq]; linarith [hyt.2.2.2.2]⟩
      · push Not at h_stay
        let h_target_0 : ℝ := (H_1_bot + min H_cut_0 q_im) / 2
        let τ_0 : ℝ := y.im + ℓ_n * (h_target_0 - q_im)
        have h_min_gt : H_1_bot < min H_cut_0 q_im :=
          lt_min (by linarith) hyt.2.2.2.1
        have h_t0_gt : H_1_bot < h_target_0 := by dsimp [h_target_0]; linarith
        have h_t0_lt_cut : h_target_0 < H_cut_0 := by
          have : min H_cut_0 q_im ≤ H_cut_0 := min_le_left _ _
          dsimp [h_target_0]
          linarith
        have h_t0_lt_q : h_target_0 < q_im := by
          have : min H_cut_0 q_im ≤ q_im := min_le_right _ _
          dsimp [h_target_0]
          linarith
        have hτ_lt_τ0 : τ < τ_0 := by
          have h1 : (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n < h_target_0 - q_im := by linarith
          have h2 : τ - y.im < (h_target_0 - q_im) * ℓ_n := (div_lt_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp h1
          dsimp [τ_0]
          linarith
        have h_im_τ0 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_0, t)).1.im = h_target_0 := by
          have h1 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_0, t)).1.im =
              q_im + (τ_0 - y.im) / ℓ_n := by
            rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ_0).1]
            simp [q_im]
          have h2 : (τ_0 - y.im) / ℓ_n = h_target_0 - q_im := by
            dsimp [τ_0]
            field_simp [hℓ_pos.ne']
            ring
          linarith
        have h_re_τ0 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_0, t)).1.re =
            (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.re := by
          rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ_0).1]
          simp
        have h_mem_L1_τ0 : (y_shift y τ_0, t) ∈ Layer1 n :=
          ⟨hyt.1, by rw [h_re_τ0]; exact hyt.2.1,
            by rw [h_re_τ0]; exact hyt.2.2.1,
            by rw [h_im_τ0]; exact h_t0_gt,
            by rw [h_im_τ0]; linarith [hyt.2.2.2.2]⟩
        have h_mem_L0_τ0 : (y_shift y τ_0, t) ∈ Layer0 n :=
          (h_ov_10 (y_shift y τ_0, t) h_mem_L1_τ0 (by rw [h_im_τ0]; exact h_t0_lt_cut)).1
        have hy_shift_idem : y_shift (y_shift y τ_0) τ = y_shift y τ := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [y_shift]
        have hy_τ0_im : (y_shift y τ_0).im = τ_0 := by simp [y_shift]
        have h_step0 := h_dvc_L0 (y_shift y τ_0) t h_mem_L0_τ0
          (by rw [hy_τ0_im]; linarith) τ hτ0 (by rw [hy_τ0_im]; linarith)
        rw [hy_shift_idem] at h_step0
        exact Or.inl h_step0

    have h_dvc_L2 : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ Layer2 sgn n → 0 ≤ y.im →
        ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im → (y_shift y τ, t) ∈ GluedDom sgn n := by
      intro y t hyt hy_im τ hτ0 hτy
      let H_2_bot : ℝ := Real.log M.R - (19 / 4 : ℝ) * ν'
      let q_im : ℝ := (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.im
      have h_re_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ, t)).1.re =
          (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.re := by
        rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ).1]
        simp
      have h_im_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ, t)).1.im =
          q_im + (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n := by
        rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ).1]
        simp [q_im]
      have h_div_nonpos : (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n ≤ 0 :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      by_cases h_stay : H_2_bot < q_im + (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hyt.1, by rw [h_re_eq]; exact hyt.2.1,
          by rw [h_re_eq]; exact hyt.2.2.1,
          by rw [h_im_eq]; exact h_stay,
          by rw [h_im_eq]; linarith [hyt.2.2.2.2]⟩
      · push Not at h_stay
        let h_target_1 : ℝ := (H_2_bot + min H_cut_1 q_im) / 2
        let τ_1 : ℝ := y.im + ℓ_n * (h_target_1 - q_im)
        have h_min_gt : H_2_bot < min H_cut_1 q_im :=
          lt_min (by dsimp [H_2_bot, H_cut_1]; linarith) hyt.2.2.2.1
        have h_t1_gt : H_2_bot < h_target_1 := by dsimp [h_target_1]; linarith
        have h_t1_lt_cut : h_target_1 < H_cut_1 := by
          have : min H_cut_1 q_im ≤ H_cut_1 := min_le_left _ _
          dsimp [h_target_1]
          linarith
        have h_t1_lt_q : h_target_1 < q_im := by
          have : min H_cut_1 q_im ≤ q_im := min_le_right _ _
          dsimp [h_target_1]
          linarith
        have hτ_lt_τ1 : τ < τ_1 := by
          have h1 : (τ - y.im) / ℓ_n < h_target_1 - q_im := by linarith
          have h2 : τ - y.im < (h_target_1 - q_im) * ℓ_n := (div_lt_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp h1
          dsimp [τ_1]
          linarith
        have h_im_τ1 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_1, t)).1.im = h_target_1 := by
          have h1 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_1, t)).1.im =
              q_im + (τ_1 - y.im) / ℓ_n := by
            rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ_1).1]
            simp [q_im]
          have h2 : (τ_1 - y.im) / ℓ_n = h_target_1 - q_im := by
            dsimp [τ_1]
            field_simp [hℓ_pos.ne']
            ring
          linarith
        have h_re_τ1 : (physToSheared seq n (y_shift y τ_1, t)).1.re =
            (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.re := by
          rw [(h_pts_vert y t τ_1).1]
          simp
        have h_mem_L2_τ1 : (y_shift y τ_1, t) ∈ Layer2 sgn n :=
          ⟨hyt.1, by rw [h_re_τ1]; exact hyt.2.1,
            by rw [h_re_τ1]; exact hyt.2.2.1,
            by rw [h_im_τ1]; exact h_t1_gt,
            by rw [h_im_τ1]; linarith [hyt.2.2.2.2]⟩
        have h_mem_L1_τ1 : (y_shift y τ_1, t) ∈ Layer1 n :=
          (h_ov_21 (y_shift y τ_1, t) h_mem_L2_τ1 (by rw [h_im_τ1]; exact h_t1_lt_cut)).1
        have hy_shift_idem : y_shift (y_shift y τ_1) τ = y_shift y τ := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [y_shift]
        have hy_τ1_im : (y_shift y τ_1).im = τ_1 := by simp [y_shift]
        have h_step1 := h_dvc_L1 (y_shift y τ_1) t h_mem_L1_τ1
          (by rw [hy_τ1_im]; linarith) τ hτ0 (by rw [hy_τ1_im]; linarith)
        rw [hy_shift_idem] at h_step1
        exact Or.inl h_step1

    have hGlued_dvc : IsDownwardVertConvex (GluedDom sgn n) := by
      refine ⟨hGlued_open, ?_⟩
      intro y t hyt hy_im τ hτ0 hτy
      rcases hyt with (hp0 | hp1) | hp2
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (h_dvc_L0 y t hp0 hy_im τ hτ0 hτy))
      · exact Or.inl (h_dvc_L1 y t hp1 hy_im τ hτ0 hτy)
      · exact h_dvc_L2 y t hp2 hy_im τ hτ0 hτy

    
    let t₀_n : ℝ := T_star / m_n
    let x₀_n : ℝ := seq.x_seq n + ℓ_n * (α_c - sgn * M.θ)
    have hδ_zero_pos : 0 < δ_zero n :=
      lt_min (lt_min (by positivity) hℓ_pos) (by positivity)
    have hm_t₀ : (m_n : ℂ) * (t₀_n : ℂ) = (T_star : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [t₀_n]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hm_ne]

    have h_base_poly : ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - (x₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
        ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < δ_zero n →
        (y, t) ∈ GluedDom sgn n ∧ GluedFn sgn S₂ n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t) := by
      intro y t hy_ball ht_ball
      have hδz_le1 : δ_zero n ≤ δ_base n / 2 :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hδz_le2 : δ_zero n ≤ ℓ_n :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hδz_le3 : δ_zero n ≤ η₂ / (6 * m_n) := min_le_right _ _
      have hy_im_abs : |y.im| < δ_zero n := by
        have h1 := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - (x₀_n : ℂ))
        have h2 : (y - (x₀_n : ℂ)).im = y.im := by simp
        rw [h2] at h1
        linarith
      have hy_im_base : |y.im| < δ_base n := by linarith
      have hy_im_lt_ℓ : y.im < ℓ_n := by
        rw [abs_lt] at hy_im_abs
        linarith
      have hmt_dist : ‖(m_n : ℂ) * t - (T_star : ℂ)‖ < η₂ / 2 := by
        have h_eq : (m_n : ℂ) * t - (T_star : ℂ) = (m_n : ℂ) * (t - (t₀_n : ℂ)) := by
          rw [← hm_t₀]
          ring
        rw [h_eq, norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hm_pos.le]
        have h1 : m_n * ‖t - (t₀_n : ℂ)‖ < m_n * (η₂ / (6 * m_n)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_ball hδz_le3) hm_pos
        have h2 : m_n * (η₂ / (6 * m_n)) = η₂ / 6 := by
          field_simp [hm_pos.ne']
        linarith
      have hmt_UT2 : (m_n : ℂ) * t ∈ U_T_2 := by
        simpa [U_T_2, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hmt_dist
      have hmt_all : (m_n : ℂ) * t ∈ U_T_all := h_UT2_sub_all hmt_UT2
      obtain ⟨_, hmt_norm, hβ_im, _⟩ := hBridge.shear_holo_bounds.2 ((m_n : ℂ) * t) hmt_all
      have ht_norm : ‖t‖ < 4 * T_star / m_n := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hm_pos.le] at hmt_norm
        exact (lt_div_iff₀ hm_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨hyt_phys, hyt_𝔰⟩ := hs_tilde_base y t hy_im_base ht_norm
      have hq_im_lt : (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.im < H_cut_0 := by
        have h_lin_eq : (y - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) =
            (((y.re - seq.x_seq n) / ℓ_n : ℝ) : ℂ) +
              (((y.im - seq.h_seq n) / ℓ_n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          have hy_sub : y - expBasePt seq n =
              ((y.re - seq.x_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) +
                ((y.im - seq.h_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [expBasePt]
          rw [hy_sub]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hq_im_eq : (physToSheared seq n (y, t)).1.im =
            y.im / ℓ_n - seq.h_seq n / ℓ_n -
              (expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * t)).im := by
          dsimp [physToSheared]
          change ((y - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) -
              expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * t)).im = _
          rw [Complex.sub_im, h_lin_eq]
          simp [sub_div]
        have hy_div_lt : y.im / ℓ_n < 1 := (div_lt_one hℓ_pos).mpr hy_im_lt_ℓ
        rw [abs_lt] at hβ_im
        rw [hq_im_eq]
        linarith
      have hyt_L0 : (y, t) ∈ Layer0 n := ⟨hyt_phys, hmt_UT2, hq_im_lt⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inl (Or.inl hyt_L0), (h_fn_on_L0 (y, t) hyt_L0).trans hyt_𝔰⟩

    have h_slice_Z : ∀ Z ∈ Rect2 sgn,
        (expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ GluedDom sgn n ∧
        rescaledLift seq (GluedFn sgn S₂ n) n Z (T_star : ℂ) =
          S₂ n (Z, (T_star : ℂ)) := by
      intro Z hZ
      let pZ : ℂ × ℂ := (expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * Z, (t₀_n : ℂ))
      have h_pts_pZ : physToSheared seq n pZ = (Z, (T_star : ℂ)) := by
        ext
        · dsimp [physToSheared, pZ]
          change ((expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * Z - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) -
              expShearOffset T_star ((m_n : ℂ) * (t₀_n : ℂ))) = Z
          rw [hm_t₀, hBridge.shear_zero, sub_zero]
          field_simp [hℓ_ne]
          ring
        · dsimp [physToSheared, pZ]
          exact hm_t₀
      have hpZ_L2 : pZ ∈ Layer2 sgn n := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · change (m_n : ℂ) * (t₀_n : ℂ) ∈ U_T_2
          rw [hm_t₀]
          exact hT_star_mem_UT2
        · rw [h_pts_pZ]
          exact hZ
      refine ⟨Or.inr hpZ_L2, ?_⟩
      have ht₀_eq : (T_star : ℂ) / (m_n : ℂ) = (t₀_n : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [t₀_n]
        push_cast
        rfl
      dsimp [rescaledLift]
      change (GluedFn sgn S₂ n (expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * Z,
          (T_star : ℂ) / (m_n : ℂ)) - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) = _
      rw [ht₀_eq]
      change (GluedFn sgn S₂ n pZ - expBasePt seq n) / (ℓ_n : ℂ) = _
      rw [h_fn_on_L2 pZ hpZ_L2, h_pts_pZ]
      field_simp [hℓ_ne]
      ring

    have h_vert_seg : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η →
        η ≤ seq.h_seq n + ℓ_n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4) →
        ((x₀_n : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈ GluedDom sgn n := by
      intro η hη0 hη_hi
      let b_n : ℝ := seq.h_seq n + ℓ_n * (Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4)
      have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := by
        have h_abs : -|Real.log M.R| ≤ Real.log M.R := neg_abs_le _
        have h_gt : (|Real.log M.R| + 2) * ℓ_n < seq.h_seq n :=
          (lt_div_iff₀ hℓ_pos).mp hh_ratio_2
        dsimp [b_n]
        nlinarith
      let Z_top : ℂ :=
        ((α_c - sgn * M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          ((Real.log M.R + 3 * ν' / 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hZ_top_mem : Z_top ∈ Rect2 sgn := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [Z_top] <;> linarith [M.δ_θ_pos]
      have hp_top_eq : expBasePt seq n + (ℓ_n : ℂ) * Z_top =
          (x₀_n : ℂ) + (b_n : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [expBasePt, Z_top, x₀_n, b_n] <;> ring
      have hp_top_mem : ((x₀_n : ℂ) + (b_n : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀_n : ℂ)) ∈
          GluedDom sgn n := by
        rw [← hp_top_eq]
        exact (h_slice_Z Z_top hZ_top_mem).1
      have h_dvc_app := hGlued_dvc.2 ((x₀_n : ℂ) + (b_n : ℂ) * Complex.I) (t₀_n : ℂ)
        hp_top_mem (by simp; linarith) η hη0 (by simp; exact hη_hi)
      have h_re_simp : (((x₀_n : ℂ) + (b_n : ℂ) * Complex.I).re : ℂ) = (x₀_n : ℂ) := by
        simp
      rwa [h_re_simp] at h_dvc_app

    exact ⟨hGlued_dvc, hδ_zero_pos, hGlued_holo, hGlued_strip,
      h_base_poly, h_vert_seg, h_slice_Z⟩

  
  let U_plus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := GluedDom 1
  let U_minus : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) := GluedDom (-1)
  let s_plus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := GluedFn 1 S₂_plus
  let s_minus : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := GluedFn (-1) S₂_minus

  have h_one_sub : α_c - (1 : ℝ) * M.θ = α_c - M.θ := by ring
  have h_neg_one_sub : α_c - (-1 : ℝ) * M.θ = α_c + M.θ := by ring
  have hY_plus_eq : TargetCenter 1 =
      ((α_c - M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    simp [TargetCenter]
  have hY_minus_eq : TargetCenter (-1) =
      ((α_c + M.θ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((Real.log M.R + ν' / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    dsimp [TargetCenter]
    rw [h_neg_one_sub]

  refine ⟨{
    ν' := ν'
    ε_patch := ε_patch
    N_patch := N_patch
    U_plus := U_plus
    U_minus := U_minus
    s_plus := s_plus
    s_minus := s_minus
    δ_zero := δ_zero
    ν'_pos := hν'_pos
    ν'_lt := hν'_lt
    ε_patch_pos := hε_patch_pos
    ε_patch_lt_ν := hε_patch_lt_ν
    ε_patch_lt_δ := hε_patch_lt_δ
    patch_props := ?_
    conv_plus := ?_
    conv_minus := ?_
  }⟩
  · intro n hn
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hnh : N_h ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn₂_p : N₂_plus ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn₂_m : N₂_minus ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn
    have hn_rec : N_rec ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn
    obtain ⟨h_dvc_p, hδz_pos, h_holo_p, h_strip_p, h_base_p, h_vert_p, h_slice_p⟩ :=
      h_gluing 1 S₂_plus N₂_plus (Or.inl rfl)
        hS₂_plus_holo hS₂_plus_strip hS₂_plus_eq n hn₁ hn₂_p hnh
    obtain ⟨h_dvc_m, _, h_holo_m, h_strip_m, h_base_m, _, h_slice_m⟩ :=
      h_gluing (-1) S₂_minus N₂_minus (Or.inr rfl)
        hS₂_minus_holo hS₂_minus_strip hS₂_minus_eq n hn₁ hn₂_m hnh
    dsimp only [] at h_base_p h_vert_p h_base_m ⊢
    rw [h_one_sub] at h_base_p h_vert_p
    rw [h_neg_one_sub] at h_base_m
    refine ⟨h_dvc_p, h_dvc_m, hδz_pos, h_holo_p, h_strip_p, h_holo_m, h_strip_m,
      h_base_p, h_base_m, h_vert_p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro Z hZ
      have hZ' : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch) := by
        rw [hY_plus_eq]
        exact hZ
      exact (h_slice_p Z (h_ball_sub_rect2 1 hZ')).1
    · intro Z hZ
      have hZ' : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter (-1)) (3 * ε_patch) := by
        rw [hY_minus_eq]
        exact hZ
      exact (h_slice_m Z (h_ball_sub_rect2 (-1) hZ')).1
    · intro Z hZ hZ_m hZ_p
      have hZ_3 : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch) := by
        rw [hY_plus_eq]
        exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
      have hZ_m' :
          Z - (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
            Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch) := by
        rw [hY_plus_eq]
        exact hZ_m
      have hZ_p' :
          Z + (T_star : ℂ) / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈
            Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch) := by
        rw [hY_plus_eq]
        exact hZ_p
      have h_eq_W : ∀ W ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch),
          S₂_plus n (W, (T_star : ℂ)) =
            rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n W (T_star : ℂ) :=
        fun W hW => (h_slice_p W (h_ball_sub_rect2 1 hW)).2.symm
      exact h_rec_congr
        (fun W => S₂_plus n (W, (T_star : ℂ)))
        (fun W => rescaledLift seq (s_plus n) n W (T_star : ℂ))
        n Z (T_star : ℂ)
        (h_eq_W _ hZ_m') (h_eq_W _ hZ_3) (h_eq_W _ hZ_p')
        (hS₂_plus_rec n hn_rec Z hZ_3)
  · have hc := h_slice_conv 1 S₂_plus hS₂_plus_conv
    rw [hY_plus_eq] at hc
    refine hc.congr (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N_patch, fun n hn Z hZ => ?_⟩)
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hnh : N_h ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn₂_p : N₂_plus ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, h_slice_p⟩ :=
      h_gluing 1 S₂_plus N₂_plus (Or.inl rfl)
        hS₂_plus_holo hS₂_plus_strip hS₂_plus_eq n hn₁ hn₂_p hnh
    have hZ_ball : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter 1) (3 * ε_patch) := by
      rw [hY_plus_eq]
      exact Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
    exact (h_slice_p Z (h_ball_sub_rect2 1 hZ_ball)).2.symm
  · have hc := h_slice_conv (-1) S₂_minus hS₂_minus_conv
    rw [hY_minus_eq] at hc
    refine hc.congr (Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N_patch, fun n hn Z hZ => ?_⟩)
    have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hnh : N_h ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn₂_m : N₂_minus ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, h_slice_m⟩ :=
      h_gluing (-1) S₂_minus N₂_minus (Or.inr rfl)
        hS₂_minus_holo hS₂_minus_strip hS₂_minus_eq n hn₁ hn₂_m hnh
    have hZ_ball : Z ∈ Metric.ball (TargetCenter (-1)) (3 * ε_patch) := by
      rw [hY_minus_eq]
      exact Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
    exact (h_slice_m Z (h_ball_sub_rect2 (-1) hZ_ball)).2.symm
