signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) :
    RctFrozenJetAndELProp X P kind seq

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hX
  have h_polydisk_eq_ball : ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ),
      { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < ρ ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < ρ ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < ρ } =
        Metric.ball (S₀, (J₀, T₀)) ρ := by
    intro S₀ J₀ T₀ ρ
    ext q
    change (‖q.1 - S₀‖ < ρ ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < ρ ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < ρ) ↔
      dist q (S₀, (J₀, T₀)) < ρ
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm,
      max_lt_iff, max_lt_iff]

  let e₁ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((1 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
  let e₂ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
  have he₁_norm : ‖e₁‖ = 1 := by simp [e₁, Prod.norm_def]
  have he₂_norm : ‖e₂‖ = 1 := by simp [e₂, Prod.norm_def]

  have h_slice_3d : ∀ (G : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ),
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => G p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q →
      rctActDS G q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 =
        (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => G p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) e₁ ∧
      rctActDJ G q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 =
        (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => G p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) e₂ := by
    intro G q hDiff
    let G_tup : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ := fun p => G p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
    constructor
    · let γ₁ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun S' => ((0 : ℂ), (q.2.1, q.2.2)) + S' • e₁
      have hγ₁_eq : ∀ S' : ℂ, γ₁ S' = (S', (q.2.1, q.2.2)) := by
        intro S'; ext <;> simp [γ₁, e₁]
      have hγ₁_q : γ₁ q.1 = q := by rw [hγ₁_eq]
      have hγ₁_d : HasDerivAt γ₁ e₁ q.1 := by
        have hd : HasDerivAt γ₁ ((0 : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + (1 : ℂ) • e₁) q.1 :=
          (hasDerivAt_const q.1 ((0 : ℂ), (q.2.1, q.2.2))).add ((hasDerivAt_id q.1).smul_const e₁)
        rwa [zero_add, one_smul] at hd
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt G_tup (fderiv ℂ G_tup q) (γ₁ q.1) := by
        rw [hγ₁_q]; exact hDiff.hasFDerivAt
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (G_tup ∘ γ₁) ((fderiv ℂ G_tup q) e₁) q.1 :=
        hfd.comp_hasDerivAt q.1 hγ₁_d
      have hfun : G_tup ∘ γ₁ = fun S' => G S' q.2.1 q.2.2 := by
        funext S'; simp [Function.comp, G_tup, hγ₁_eq]
      rw [hfun] at hcomp
      exact hcomp.deriv
    · let γ₂ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun J' => (q.1, ((0 : ℂ), q.2.2)) + J' • e₂
      have hγ₂_eq : ∀ J' : ℂ, γ₂ J' = (q.1, (J', q.2.2)) := by
        intro J'; ext <;> simp [γ₂, e₂]
      have hγ₂_q : γ₂ q.2.1 = q := by rw [hγ₂_eq]
      have hγ₂_d : HasDerivAt γ₂ e₂ q.2.1 := by
        have hd : HasDerivAt γ₂ ((0 : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + (1 : ℂ) • e₂) q.2.1 :=
          (hasDerivAt_const q.2.1 (q.1, ((0 : ℂ), q.2.2))).add ((hasDerivAt_id q.2.1).smul_const e₂)
        rwa [zero_add, one_smul] at hd
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt G_tup (fderiv ℂ G_tup q) (γ₂ q.2.1) := by
        rw [hγ₂_q]; exact hDiff.hasFDerivAt
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt (G_tup ∘ γ₂) ((fderiv ℂ G_tup q) e₂) q.2.1 :=
        hfd.comp_hasDerivAt q.2.1 hγ₂_d
      have hfun : G_tup ∘ γ₂ = fun J' => G q.1 J' q.2.2 := by
        funext J'; simp [Function.comp, G_tup, hγ₂_eq]
      rw [hfun] at hcomp
      exact hcomp.deriv

  have h_weierstrass : ∀ (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (r R : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
      (G_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ) (G_lim : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
      0 < r → r < R →
      (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_seq n) (Metric.ball q₀ R)) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn G_seq G_lim Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ R) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G_lim (Metric.ball q₀ r) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n c => fderiv ℂ (G_seq n) c)
        (fun c => fderiv ℂ G_lim c) Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ r) := by
    intro q₀ r R N₀ G_seq G_lim hr_pos hrR hHolo hConv
    let δ : ℝ := (R - r) / 2
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
    let s : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball q₀ (r + δ)
    have hs_open : IsOpen s := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hr_sub_s : Metric.ball q₀ r ⊆ s := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hs_sub_R : s ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by dsimp [δ]; linarith)
    have hc_ball_sub : ∀ c ∈ s, Metric.ball c δ ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R := by
      intro c hc z hz
      simp only [Metric.mem_ball, s] at hc hz ⊢
      calc dist z q₀ ≤ dist z c + dist c q₀ := dist_triangle z c q₀
        _ < δ + (r + δ) := add_lt_add hz hc
        _ = R := by dsimp [δ]; ring
    let H : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ := fun k => G_seq (k + N₀)
    have hH_holo : ∀ k : ℕ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (H k) (Metric.ball q₀ R) :=
      fun k => hHolo (k + N₀) (Nat.le_add_left N₀ k)
    have hH_conv : TendstoUniformlyOn H G_lim Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ R) := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hConv ⊢
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hConv ε hε)
      exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨N₁, fun k hk x hx => hN₁ (k + N₀) (by omega) x hx⟩
    let H' : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun k c => fderiv ℂ (H k) c
    have hH'_cauchy : UniformCauchySeqOn H' Filter.atTop s := by
      rw [Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
        Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff.mp hH_conv.uniformCauchySeqOn (ε * δ / 4) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨K, fun j hj k hk c hc => ?_⟩
      have h_sub_c := hc_ball_sub c hc
      have h_diff_jk : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => H j z - H k z) (Metric.ball c δ) :=
        ((hH_holo j).mono h_sub_c).sub ((hH_holo k).mono h_sub_c)
      have h_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun z => H j z - H k z) (Metric.ball c δ)
          (Metric.closedBall (H j c - H k c) (ε * δ / 2)) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h1 : ‖H j z - H k z‖ < ε * δ / 4 := by
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hK j hj k hk z (h_sub_c hz)
        have h2 : ‖H j c - H k c‖ < ε * δ / 4 := by
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hK j hj k hk c (hs_sub_R hc)
        calc ‖(H j z - H k z) - (H j c - H k c)‖
            ≤ ‖H j z - H k z‖ + ‖H j c - H k c‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ε * δ / 2 := by linarith
      have h_bound := Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball h_diff_jk h_maps hδ_pos
      have hc_R : c ∈ Metric.ball q₀ R := hs_sub_R hc
      have h_fderiv_sub : fderiv ℂ (fun z => H j z - H k z) c = H' j c - H' k c :=
        fderiv_sub
          ((hH_holo j).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hc_R))
          ((hH_holo k).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hc_R))
      rw [h_fderiv_sub] at h_bound
      have h_div : (ε * δ / 2) / δ = ε / 2 := by field_simp [hδ_pos.ne']
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      linarith
    let g' : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
      fun c => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun k => H' k c)
    have hH'_pt : ∀ c ∈ s, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => H' k c) Filter.atTop (nhds (g' c)) :=
      fun c hc => (hH'_cauchy.cauchySeq hc).tendsto_limUnder
    have hH'_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn H' g' Filter.atTop s :=
      hH'_cauchy.tendstoUniformlyOn_of_tendsto hH'_pt
    have hG_fderiv_s : ∀ c ∈ s, HasFDerivAt G_lim (g' c) c := fun c hc =>
      hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn hs_open hH'_unif
        (fun k x hx =>
          ((hH_holo k).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hs_sub_R hx))).hasFDerivAt)
        (fun x hx => (hH_conv.mono hs_sub_R).tendsto_at hx) hc
    have hG_holo_r : DifferentiableOn ℂ G_lim (Metric.ball q₀ r) :=
      fun c hc => (hG_fderiv_s c (hr_sub_s hc)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    have hg'_eq : ∀ c ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r, g' c = fderiv ℂ G_lim c :=
      fun c hc => ((hG_fderiv_s c (hr_sub_s hc)).fderiv).symm
    refine ⟨hG_holo_r, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mp ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hH'_unif.mono hr_sub_s)) ε hε)
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨K + N₀, fun n hn c hc => ?_⟩
    have hn_eq : (n - N₀) + N₀ = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
    have hk := hK (n - N₀) (by omega) c hc
    simpa [H', H, hn_eq, hg'_eq c hc] using hk

  have h_dir_holo : ∀ (v : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ), ‖v‖ = 1 →
      ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun w : ℂ => F (q + w • v)) 0) U := by
    intro v hv U F hU hF q₀ hq₀
    obtain ⟨R_u, hR_u_pos, hR_u_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU q₀ hq₀
    let R₀ : ℝ := R_u / 5
    have hR₀_pos : 0 < R₀ := by dsimp [R₀]; positivity
    let K₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ (4 * R₀)
    have hK₀_sub : K₀ ⊆ U :=
      Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [R₀]; linarith)) hR_u_sub
    obtain ⟨M_raw, hM_raw⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall q₀ (4 * R₀)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hF.mono hK₀_sub).continuousOn
    let M₀ : ℝ := max 1 M_raw
    have hM₀_pos : 0 < M₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
    have hF_bnd : ∀ z ∈ K₀, ‖F z‖ ≤ M₀ :=
      fun z hz => le_trans (hM_raw z hz) (le_max_right _ _)
    let G_seq : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ :=
      fun k q => (F (q + (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • v) - F q) * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)
    let G_lim : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ := fun q => deriv (fun w : ℂ => F (q + w • v)) 0
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / R₀)
    have hk_step_lt : ∀ k ≥ N₀, ‖(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹)‖ < R₀ := by
      intro k hk
      have hk1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
      have h_gt : 1 / R₀ < (k + 1 : ℕ) :=
        lt_trans hN₀_gt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)
      have h_inv : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ < R₀ := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div]
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hk1_pos).mpr (by have := (div_lt_iff₀ hR₀_pos).mp h_gt; linarith)
      rwa [norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
    have hG_seq_holo : ∀ k ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (G_seq k) (Metric.ball q₀ (2 * R₀)) := by
      intro k hk
      let shift : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := fun q => q + (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • v
      have hshift_diff : Differentiable ℂ shift := differentiable_id.add_const _
      have hshift_maps : Set.MapsTo shift (Metric.ball q₀ (2 * R₀)) U := by
        intro q hq
        apply hK₀_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have hq' : ‖q - q₀‖ < 2 * R₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq
        have hstep := hk_step_lt k hk
        have h_eq : shift q - q₀ = (q - q₀) + (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • v := by dsimp [shift]; abel
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(q - q₀) + (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • v‖
            ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ + ‖(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) • v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖q - q₀‖ + ‖(((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹)‖ := by rw [norm_smul, hv, mul_one]
          _ ≤ 4 * R₀ := by linarith
      have hq_sub : Metric.ball q₀ (2 * R₀) ⊆ U :=
        Subset.trans
          (Subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)))
          hK₀_sub
      exact ((hF.comp hshift_diff.differentiableOn hshift_maps).sub (hF.mono hq_sub)).mul_const _
    have hG_conv : TendstoUniformlyOn G_seq G_lim Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ (2 * R₀)) := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      let C_err : ℝ := 4 * M₀ / R₀ ^ 2
      have hC_err_pos : 0 < C_err := by dsimp [C_err]; positivity
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (C_err / ε)
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N₀ N₁, fun k hk q hq => ?_⟩
      have hk₀ : N₀ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk
      have hk₁ : N₁ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk
      let φ_q : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => F (q + w • v)
      let D_w : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * R₀)
      have hφ_maps : ∀ w ∈ D_w, q + w • v ∈ K₀ := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have hq' : ‖q - q₀‖ < 2 * R₀ := by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hq
        have hw' : ‖w‖ < 2 * R₀ := by simpa [D_w, Metric.mem_ball] using hw
        have h_eq : (q + w • v) - q₀ = (q - q₀) + w • v := by abel
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(q - q₀) + w • v‖ ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ + ‖w • v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖q - q₀‖ + ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_smul, hv, mul_one]
          _ ≤ 4 * R₀ := by linarith
      have hφ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ_q D_w := by
        have hlin : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => q + w • v) :=
          (differentiable_const q).add (differentiable_id.smul_const v)
        exact hF.comp hlin.differentiableOn (fun w hw => hK₀_sub (hφ_maps w hw))
      have h0_Dw : (0 : ℂ) ∈ D_w := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
      let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope φ_q 0
      let g₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope g₁ 0
      have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ D_w :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_Dw)).mpr hφ_holo
      have hg₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₂ D_w :=
        (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_Dw)).mpr hg₁_holo
      have hcb_Dw : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀ ⊆ D_w :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
      have hg₁_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀, ‖g₁ w‖ ≤ 2 * M₀ / R₀ := by
        intro w hw
        have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) := hg₁_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcb_Dw
        have hw_cl : w ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) := by rwa [closure_ball 0 hR₀_pos.ne']
        refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hdc ?_ hw_cl
        intro z hz
        rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hR₀_pos.ne', Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz
        have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hz; linarith
        have hg₁_z : g₁ z = (φ_q z - φ_q 0) / z := by
          simp [g₁, dslope_of_ne _ hz_ne, slope_def_field]
        rw [hg₁_z, norm_div, hz]
        have hz_Dw : z ∈ D_w := hcb_Dw (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hz])
        have hnum : ‖φ_q z - φ_q 0‖ ≤ 2 * M₀ := by
          calc ‖φ_q z - φ_q 0‖ ≤ ‖φ_q z‖ + ‖φ_q 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ ≤ M₀ + M₀ := add_le_add (hF_bnd _ (hφ_maps z hz_Dw)) (hF_bnd _ (hφ_maps 0 h0_Dw))
            _ = 2 * M₀ := by ring
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hR₀_pos.le
      have hg₂_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀, ‖g₂ w‖ ≤ C_err := by
        intro w hw
        have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) := hg₂_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcb_Dw
        have hw_cl : w ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) := by rwa [closure_ball 0 hR₀_pos.ne']
        refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hdc ?_ hw_cl
        intro z hz
        rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hR₀_pos.ne', Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz
        have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hz; linarith
        have hg₂_z : g₂ z = (g₁ z - g₁ 0) / z := by
          simp [g₂, dslope_of_ne _ hz_ne, slope_def_field]
        rw [hg₂_z, norm_div, hz]
        have hz_cb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀ := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hz]
        have h0_cb : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR₀_pos.le
        have hnum : ‖g₁ z - g₁ 0‖ ≤ 4 * M₀ / R₀ := by
          calc ‖g₁ z - g₁ 0‖ ≤ ‖g₁ z‖ + ‖g₁ 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * M₀ / R₀ + 2 * M₀ / R₀ := add_le_add (hg₁_bnd z hz_cb) (hg₁_bnd 0 h0_cb)
            _ = 4 * M₀ / R₀ := by ring
        calc ‖g₁ z - g₁ 0‖ / R₀ ≤ (4 * M₀ / R₀) / R₀ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hR₀_pos.le
          _ = C_err := by dsimp [C_err]; field_simp [hR₀_pos.ne']
      let w_k : ℂ := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹
      have hwk_ne : w_k ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero k))
      have hwk_cb : w_k ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R₀ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact (hk_step_lt k hk₀).le
      have hg₁_wk : g₁ w_k = G_seq k q := by
        dsimp [g₁]
        rw [dslope_of_ne _ hwk_ne, slope_def_field, sub_zero]
        dsimp [φ_q, G_seq, w_k]
        rw [zero_smul, add_zero, div_inv_eq_mul]
      have hg₁_0 : g₁ 0 = G_lim q := dslope_same φ_q 0
      have hdiff_eq : G_seq k q - G_lim q = w_k * g₂ w_k := by
        rw [← hg₁_wk, ← hg₁_0]
        simpa [g₂] using (sub_smul_dslope g₁ 0 w_k).symm
      rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev, hdiff_eq, norm_mul]
      have hk1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (k + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
      have hwk_norm : ‖w_k‖ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [w_k]
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_natCast]
      rw [hwk_norm]
      have h_le : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖g₂ w_k‖ ≤ C_err / (k + 1 : ℕ) := by
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg₂_bnd w_k hwk_cb) (by positivity)
      have h_lt : C_err / (k + 1 : ℕ) < ε := by
        have h_gt : C_err / ε < (k + 1 : ℕ) :=
          lt_trans hN₁_gt (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk₁)
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hk1_pos).mpr (by have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp h_gt; linarith)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_le h_lt
    obtain ⟨hG_lim_holo, _⟩ :=
      h_weierstrass q₀ R₀ (2 * R₀) N₀ G_seq G_lim hR₀_pos (by linarith) hG_seq_holo hG_conv
    exact (hG_lim_holo.differentiableAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hR₀_pos))).differentiableWithinAt

  have hPartial3d : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ)) (F : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ F U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) U ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1) U := by
    intro U F hU hF
    constructor
    · have h1 := h_dir_holo e₁ he₁_norm U F hU hF
      have h_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun w : ℂ => F (q + w • e₁)) 0) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) q.1) := by
        funext q
        let h_q : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => F (q + w • e₁)
        have hfun : (fun S' => F (S', q.2.1, q.2.2)) = (fun S' => h_q (S' + (-q.1))) := by
          funext S'
          dsimp [h_q]
          congr 1
          ext <;> simp [e₁]
        rw [hfun, deriv_comp_add_const h_q (-q.1) q.1, add_neg_cancel]
      rwa [h_eq] at h1
    · have h2 := h_dir_holo e₂ he₂_norm U F hU hF
      have h_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun w : ℂ => F (q + w • e₂)) 0) =
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) q.2.1) := by
        funext q
        let h_q : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => F (q + w • e₂)
        have hfun : (fun J' => F (q.1, J', q.2.2)) = (fun J' => h_q (J' + (-q.2.1))) := by
          funext J'
          dsimp [h_q]
          congr 1
          ext <;> simp [e₂]
        rw [hfun, deriv_comp_add_const h_q (-q.2.1) q.2.1, add_neg_cancel]
      rwa [h_eq] at h2

  have h_slice_conv : ∀ (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (r : ℝ) (N₀ : ℕ)
      (A_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (A_lim : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ r)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ r) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n c => fderiv ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) c)
        (fun c => fderiv ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) c)
        Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ r) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n q => rctActDS (A_seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q => rctActDS A_lim q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ r) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n q => rctActDJ (A_seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q => rctActDJ A_lim q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ r) := by
    intro q₀ r N₀ A_seq A_lim hHoloSeq hHoloLim hFdConv
    constructor
    · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mp ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hFdConv) ε hε)
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N₀ N₁, fun n hn q hq => ?_⟩
      have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have h_lim := (h_slice_3d A_lim q (hHoloLim.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq))).1
      have h_seq := (h_slice_3d (A_seq n) q ((hHoloSeq n hn₀).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq))).1
      rw [dist_eq_norm, h_lim, h_seq, ← _root_.sub_apply]
      calc ‖(fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) e₁‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ * ‖e₁‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ e₁
        _ = dist (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
              (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) := by
            rw [he₁_norm, mul_one, dist_eq_norm]
        _ < ε := hN₁ n hn₁ q hq
    · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ :=
        Filter.eventually_atTop.mp ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hFdConv) ε hε)
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N₀ N₁, fun n hn q hq => ?_⟩
      have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have h_lim := (h_slice_3d A_lim q (hHoloLim.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq))).2
      have h_seq := (h_slice_3d (A_seq n) q ((hHoloSeq n hn₀).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq))).2
      rw [dist_eq_norm, h_lim, h_seq, ← _root_.sub_apply]
      calc ‖(fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) e₂‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ * ‖e₂‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ e₂
        _ = dist (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_lim p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
              (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => A_seq n p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q) := by
            rw [he₂_norm, mul_one, dist_eq_norm]
        _ < ε := hN₁ n hn₁ q hq

  have h_lip_ball : ∀ (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (r C : ℝ) (G : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ),
      0 ≤ C →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G (Metric.ball q₀ r) →
      (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r, ‖fderiv ℂ G q‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
        (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r →
        (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r →
        ‖G (S₁, (J₁, T)) - G (S₂, (J₂, T))‖ ≤ C * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) := by
    intro q₀ r C G hC hDiff hBnd S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T hq₁ hq₂
    have h_mvt : ‖G (S₁, (J₁, T)) - G (S₂, (J₂, T))‖ ≤
        C * ‖(S₁, (J₁, T)) - (S₂, (J₂, T))‖ :=
      Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le
        (fun z hz => ((hDiff.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt).hasFDerivWithinAt)
        hBnd (convex_ball q₀ r) hq₂ hq₁
    have h_prod : ‖(S₁, (J₁, T)) - (S₂, (J₂, T))‖ ≤ ‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖ := by
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, sub_self, norm_zero,
        max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact max_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _))
        (le_add_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _))
    exact le_trans h_mvt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod hC)

  have h_chart_jets :
      ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
        IsRegularFrozenState kind
          (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
        let μ₀ : ℂ := rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₀ J₀ T₀
        μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ (r_c : ℝ) (N_c : ℕ) (M_c : ℝ),
          0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧
          let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
            { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
              ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
          (∀ n ≥ N_c,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
            (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
              ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
              ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
              ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
              ‖rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
              ‖rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
              ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
            (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
              (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
              ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
                M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
              ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤
                M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))) ∧
          (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_ε ≥ N_c, ∀ n ≥ N_ε,
            ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
              (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
              ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
              ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
              ‖(rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₁ J₁ T -
                  rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₁ J₁ T) -
                (rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) S₂ J₂ T -
                  rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₂ J₂ T)‖ ≤
                ε * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖)) ∧
          (∀ n ≥ N_c, ∀ (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (Y T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 →
            let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            let D_prev : ℂ := (S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - a_n)) / a_n
            let D_curr : ℂ := (S_fn (Y + a_n) - S_fn Y) / a_n
            (S_fn Y, (D_curr, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            (S_fn (Y - a_n), (D_prev, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
            rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T -
              a_n * rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T =
              rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) (S_fn (Y - a_n)) D_prev T) := by
    intro S₀ J₀ T₀ hReg
    dsimp only
    let μ₀ : ℂ := rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) S₀ J₀ T₀
    have hμ₀_ne : μ₀ ≠ 0 := by
      cases kind with
      | firstField => exact hReg.2
      | secondField => exact hReg.2.2
    refine ⟨hμ₀_ne, ?_⟩
    let q₀ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (S₀, (J₀, T₀))
    obtain ⟨δ_reg, N_reg, hδ_pos, hScaledHolo₀, hScaledConv₀⟩ :=
      P.frozen_conv kind seq S₀ J₀ T₀ hReg
    rw [h_polydisk_eq_ball S₀ J₀ T₀ δ_reg] at hScaledHolo₀ hScaledConv₀
    have hScaledHolo : ∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          (Metric.ball q₀ δ_reg) := hScaledHolo₀
    have hScaledConv : TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        Filter.atTop (Metric.ball q₀ δ_reg) := hScaledConv₀

    
    let R₁ : ℝ := (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg
    have hR₁_pos : 0 < R₁ := by dsimp [R₁]; positivity
    have hR₁_lt : R₁ < δ_reg := by dsimp [R₁]; linarith
    obtain ⟨hModHolo₁, hFdConv₁⟩ :=
      h_weierstrass q₀ R₁ δ_reg N_reg
        (fun n q => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q => rctModelActionP kind seq q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        hR₁_pos hR₁_lt hScaledHolo hScaledConv
    have hScaledHolo₁ : ∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctScaledActionP P seq n q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) :=
      fun n hn => (hScaledHolo n hn).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hR₁_lt.le)
    obtain ⟨hConvDS₁, hConvDJ₁⟩ :=
      h_slice_conv q₀ R₁ N_reg (rctScaledActionP P seq) (rctModelActionP kind seq)
        hScaledHolo₁ hModHolo₁ hFdConv₁
    obtain ⟨hModDS₁, hModDJ₁⟩ := hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball hModHolo₁
    obtain ⟨hModDJS₁, _⟩ := (hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball hModDS₁).symm
    obtain ⟨hModDSJ₁, hModDJJ₁⟩ := hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball hModDJ₁
    have hScaledJets₁ : ∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) := by
      intro n hn
      obtain ⟨hDS, hDJ⟩ := hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hScaledHolo₁ n hn)
      obtain ⟨_, hDJS⟩ := hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball hDS
      obtain ⟨hDSJ, hDJJ⟩ := hPartial3d (Metric.ball q₀ R₁) _ Metric.isOpen_ball hDJ
      exact ⟨hDS, hDJ, hDJJ, hDSJ, hDJS⟩

    
    let R₂ : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_reg
    have hR₂_pos : 0 < R₂ := by dsimp [R₂]; positivity
    have hR₂_lt : R₂ < R₁ := by dsimp [R₂, R₁]; linarith
    obtain ⟨_, hFdConvDS₂⟩ :=
      h_weierstrass q₀ R₂ R₁ N_reg
        (fun n q => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        hR₂_pos hR₂_lt (fun n hn => (hScaledJets₁ n hn).1) hConvDS₁
    obtain ⟨_, hFdConvDJ₂⟩ :=
      h_weierstrass q₀ R₂ R₁ N_reg
        (fun n q => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        (fun q => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        hR₂_pos hR₂_lt (fun n hn => (hScaledJets₁ n hn).2.1) hConvDJ₁
    have hSub₂₁ : Metric.ball q₀ R₂ ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hR₂_lt.le
    obtain ⟨_, hConvDJS₂⟩ :=
      h_slice_conv q₀ R₂ N_reg
        (fun n => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n))
        (rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq))
        (fun n hn => (hScaledJets₁ n hn).1.mono hSub₂₁)
        (hModDS₁.mono hSub₂₁) hFdConvDS₂
    obtain ⟨hConvDSJ₂, hConvDJJ₂⟩ :=
      h_slice_conv q₀ R₂ N_reg
        (fun n => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n))
        (rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq))
        (fun n hn => (hScaledJets₁ n hn).2.1.mono hSub₂₁)
        (hModDJ₁.mono hSub₂₁) hFdConvDJ₂

    
    have hq₀_mem₂ : q₀ ∈ Metric.ball q₀ R₂ := Metric.mem_ball_self hR₂_pos
    have hModDJJ_cont : ContinuousAt
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) q₀ :=
      (hModDJJ₁.mono hSub₂₁).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq₀_mem₂) |>.continuousAt
    have hμ₀_pos : 0 < (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by
      have : 0 < ‖μ₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hμ₀_ne
      positivity
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀_pos, hr₀_ball⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hModDJJ_cont _ hμ₀_pos
    let r_c : ℝ := min r₀ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg)
    have hr_c_pos : 0 < r_c := lt_min hr₀_pos (by positivity)
    have hr_c_le_r₀ : r_c ≤ r₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_c_le_qtr : r_c ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg := min_le_right _ _
    have hr_c_lt_R₂ : r_c < R₂ := by dsimp [R₂]; linarith
    have hr_c_lt_R₁ : r_c < R₁ := lt_trans hr_c_lt_R₂ hR₂_lt
    have hSub_c₂ : Metric.ball q₀ r_c ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_c_lt_R₂.le
    have hSub_c₁ : Metric.ball q₀ r_c ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_c_lt_R₁.le

    let K₁ : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall q₀ R₂
    have hK₁_comp : IsCompact K₁ := isCompact_closedBall q₀ R₂
    have hK₁_sub₁ : K₁ ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R₁ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR₂_lt
    obtain ⟨B_DS, hB_DS⟩ := hK₁_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDS₁.mono hK₁_sub₁).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B_DJ, hB_DJ⟩ := hK₁_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDJ₁.mono hK₁_sub₁).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B_DSJ, hB_DSJ⟩ := hK₁_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDSJ₁.mono hK₁_sub₁).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B_DJS, hB_DJS⟩ := hK₁_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDJS₁.mono hK₁_sub₁).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B_DJJ, hB_DJJ⟩ := hK₁_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDJJ₁.mono hK₁_sub₁).continuousOn
    let B₀ : ℝ := max 0 (max (max B_DS B_DJ) (max B_DSJ (max B_DJS B_DJJ)))
    have hB₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ B₀ := le_max_left _ _
    have hModJets_bound : ∀ q ∈ K₁,
        ‖rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B₀ ∧
        ‖rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B₀ ∧
        ‖rctActDSJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B₀ ∧
        ‖rctActDJS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B₀ ∧
        ‖rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B₀ := by
      intro q hq
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact le_trans (hB_DS q hq) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
      · exact le_trans (hB_DJ q hq) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
      · exact le_trans (hB_DSJ q hq) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)))
      · exact le_trans (hB_DJS q hq) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))
      · exact le_trans (hB_DJJ q hq) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))))

    let r_step : ℝ := (1 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_reg
    have hr_step_pos : 0 < r_step := by dsimp [r_step]; positivity
    have hModFd_bound : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_c,
        ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ ≤
          (2 * B₀) / r_step ∧
        ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ ≤
          (2 * B₀) / r_step := by
      intro q hq
      have h_ball_K₁ : Metric.ball q r_step ⊆ K₁ := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq hz
        calc dist z q₀ ≤ dist z q + dist q q₀ := dist_triangle z q q₀
          _ ≤ r_step + r_c := by linarith
          _ ≤ R₂ := by dsimp [r_step, R₂]; linarith
      have h_ball_R₁ : Metric.ball q r_step ⊆ Metric.ball q₀ R₁ := Subset.trans h_ball_K₁ hK₁_sub₁
      have hq_K₁ : q ∈ K₁ := h_ball_K₁ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_step_pos)
      constructor
      · refine Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hModDS₁.mono h_ball_R₁) ?_ hr_step_pos
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        calc ‖rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2 -
                rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖
            ≤ ‖rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2‖ +
                ‖rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ B₀ + B₀ := add_le_add (hModJets_bound z (h_ball_K₁ hz)).1 (hModJets_bound q hq_K₁).1
          _ = 2 * B₀ := by ring
      · refine Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hModDJ₁.mono h_ball_R₁) ?_ hr_step_pos
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        calc ‖rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2 -
                rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖
            ≤ ‖rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2‖ +
                ‖rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ B₀ + B₀ := add_le_add (hModJets_bound z (h_ball_K₁ hz)).2.1 (hModJets_bound q hq_K₁).2.1
          _ = 2 * B₀ := by ring

    
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDS₁.mono hSub_c₁)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDJ₁.mono hSub_c₁)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDSJ₂.mono hSub_c₂)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₄, hN₄⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDJS₂.mono hSub_c₂)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₅, hN₅⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDJJ₂.mono hSub_c₂)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₆, hN₆⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDJJ₂.mono hSub_c₂)) ((1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖) hμ₀_pos)
    obtain ⟨N₇, hN₇⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hFdConvDS₂.mono hSub_c₂)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    obtain ⟨N₈, hN₈⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hFdConvDJ₂.mono hSub_c₂)) 1 zero_lt_one)
    let N_c : ℕ := max N_reg (max (max (max N₁ N₂) (max N₃ N₄)) (max (max N₅ N₆) (max N₇ N₈)))
    let M_c : ℝ := max B₀ ((2 * B₀) / r_step) + 1
    have hM_c_pos : 0 < M_c := by
      have : 0 ≤ max B₀ ((2 * B₀) / r_step) := le_trans hB₀_nonneg (le_max_left _ _)
      dsimp [M_c]; linarith

    refine ⟨r_c, N_c, M_c, hr_c_pos, hM_c_pos, ?_⟩
    rw [h_polydisk_eq_ball S₀ J₀ T₀ r_c]
    change DifferentiableOn ℂ _ (Metric.ball q₀ r_c) ∧ _
    refine ⟨hModHolo₁.mono hSub_c₁, hModDS₁.mono hSub_c₁, hModDJ₁.mono hSub_c₁,
      hModDJJ₁.mono hSub_c₁, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro n hn
      have hn_reg : N_reg ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn_rest := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hn₁ : N₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₂ : N₂ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₃ : N₃ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₄ : N₄ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₅ : N₅ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₆ : N₆ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₇ : N₇ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn_rest
      have hn₈ : N₈ ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn_rest
      obtain ⟨hSJ_DS, hSJ_DJ, hSJ_DJJ, hSJ_DSJ, hSJ_DJS⟩ := hScaledJets₁ n hn_reg
      refine ⟨(hScaledHolo₁ n hn_reg).mono hSub_c₁, hSJ_DS.mono hSub_c₁, hSJ_DJ.mono hSub_c₁,
        hSJ_DJJ.mono hSub_c₁, hSJ_DSJ.mono hSub_c₁, hSJ_DJS.mono hSub_c₁, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro q hq
        have hq_K₁ : q ∈ K₁ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hSub_c₂ hq)
        have hModB := hModJets_bound q hq_K₁
        have h_B₀_le : B₀ + 1 ≤ M_c := by
          dsimp [M_c]; linarith [le_max_left B₀ ((2 * B₀) / r_step)]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hd₁ : ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by
            have h := hN₆ n hn₆ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have hd₂ : ‖rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ <
              (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by
            have hq_r₀ : dist q q₀ < r₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) hr_c_le_r₀
            simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hr₀_ball hq_r₀
          calc ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖
              ≤ ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
                  rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ +
                ‖rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ :=
                norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
            _ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by linarith
        · have hd : ‖rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < 1 := by
            have h := hN₁ n hn₁ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            (rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          linarith [hModB.1]
        · have hd : ‖rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < 1 := by
            have h := hN₂ n hn₂ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            (rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          linarith [hModB.2.1]
        · have hd : ‖rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDSJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < 1 := by
            have h := hN₃ n hn₃ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (rctActDSJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            (rctActDSJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          linarith [hModB.2.2.1]
        · have hd : ‖rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDJS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < 1 := by
            have h := hN₄ n hn₄ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (rctActDJS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            (rctActDJS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          linarith [hModB.2.2.2.1]
        · have hd : ‖rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 -
              rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ < 1 := by
            have h := hN₅ n hn₅ q hq
            rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h
            exact h
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (rctActDJJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            (rctActDJJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
          linarith [hModB.2.2.2.2]
      · intro S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T hq₁ hq₂
        have h_fd_le : ((2 * B₀) / r_step) + 1 ≤ M_c := by
          dsimp [M_c]; linarith [le_max_right B₀ ((2 * B₀) / r_step)]
        constructor
        · refine h_lip_ball q₀ r_c M_c
            (fun q => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            hM_c_pos.le (hSJ_DS.mono hSub_c₁) ?_ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T hq₁ hq₂
          intro q hq
          have hd : ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ < 1 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hN₇ n hn₇ q hq
          have := norm_sub_norm_le
            (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctScaledActionP P seq n) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
            (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
          linarith [(hModFd_bound q hq).1]
        · refine h_lip_ball q₀ r_c M_c
            (fun q => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
            hM_c_pos.le (hSJ_DJ.mono hSub_c₁) ?_ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T hq₁ hq₂
          intro q hq
          have hd : ‖fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q -
              fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q‖ < 1 := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hN₈ n hn₈ q hq
          have := norm_sub_norm_le
            (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctScaledActionP P seq n) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
            (fderiv ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) q)
          linarith [(hModFd_bound q hq).2]
    · 
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
        ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDS₁.mono hSub_c₁)) ε hε)
      obtain ⟨M₂, hM₂⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
        ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hConvDJ₁.mono hSub_c₁)) ε hε)
      obtain ⟨M₃, hM₃⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
        ((Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hFdConvDJ₂.mono hSub_c₂)) ε hε)
      refine ⟨max N_c (max M₁ (max M₂ M₃)), le_max_left _ _, fun n hn S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T hq₁ hq₂ => ?_⟩
      have hn_c : N_c ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hn_reg : N_reg ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn_c
      have hm_rest := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have hm₁ : M₁ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm_rest

        hmul.sub hΦ_comp
      simpa only [Function.comp, hγ_Y] using hsub
    have hE_const : E_fn =ᶠ[nhds Y] fun _ => (1 / 12 : ℂ) := by
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds Y hδ₁_pos) (fun Z hZ => ?_)
      have hEn := (hModel.2.2 (Z, T) (hZT_mem Z hZ)).1
      simpa [E_fn, Function.comp, hγ_eq, Φ_J, Φ, rctModelActionP, rctActDJ, frozenEnergyE, φ] using hEn
    have hE_zero : HasDerivAt E_fn 0 Y :=
      (hasDerivAt_const Y (1 / 12 : ℂ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hE_const
    have h_eq_zero := hE_hd.unique hE_zero
    rw [hL_eval J₀ (deriv (deriv φ) Y)] at h_eq_zero
    have h_prod_zero : J₀ * ((fderiv ℂ Φ_J (S₀, J₀)) (J₀, deriv (deriv φ) Y) - Φ_S (S₀, J₀)) = 0 := by
      linear_combination h_eq_zero
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_prod_zero with hJ_z | h_sub_z
    · exact False.elim (hJ₀_ne hJ_z)
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_z

  refine ⟨hJ_holo, ?_⟩
  
  have h_local_el : ∀ p₀ ∈ V_mod, ∃ (ρ₀ C₀ : ℝ), 0 < ρ₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ ρ₀, ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ ρ₀ →
        let Y : ℂ := p.1
        let T : ℂ := p.2
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
        let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
        (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
        ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ∧
        ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T -
            a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T) -
          rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T)) D_prev T‖ ≤
          C₀ * ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro p₀ hp₀
    let Y₀ : ℂ := p₀.1
    let T₀ : ℂ := p₀.2
    let J₀ : ℂ := J_star_fn p₀
    obtain ⟨_, r_c, _, _, hr_c_pos, _, _, hModDS_c, hModDJ_c, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
      h_chart_jets (S_star p₀) J₀ T₀ (hModel.2.2 p₀ hp₀).2
    rw [h_polydisk_eq_ball (S_star p₀) J₀ T₀ r_c] at hModDS_c hModDJ_c
    let q_base : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (S_star p₀, (J₀, T₀))
    let K_jet : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.closedBall q_base (r_c / 2)
    have hK_jet_sub : K_jet ⊆ Metric.ball q_base r_c :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hK_jet_comp : IsCompact K_jet := isCompact_closedBall q_base (r_c / 2)
    obtain ⟨B_DS₀, hB_DS₀⟩ :=
      hK_jet_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDS_c.mono hK_jet_sub).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨B_DJ₀, hB_DJ₀⟩ :=
      hK_jet_comp.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hModDJ_c.mono hK_jet_sub).continuousOn
    let B_jet : ℝ := max 1 (max B_DS₀ B_DJ₀)
    have hB_jet_pos : 0 < B_jet := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
    have hJet_bnd : ∀ q ∈ K_jet,
        ‖rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B_jet ∧
        ‖rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ B_jet := by
      intro q hq
      exact ⟨le_trans (hB_DS₀ q hq) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)),
        le_trans (hB_DJ₀ q hq) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))⟩

    obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hModel.1 p₀ hp₀
    have hS_cont : ContinuousAt S_star p₀ :=
      (hModel.2.1.differentiableAt (hModel.1.mem_nhds hp₀)).continuousAt
    have hJ_cont : ContinuousAt J_star_fn p₀ :=
      (hJ_holo.differentiableAt (hModel.1.mem_nhds hp₀)).continuousAt
    obtain ⟨r_S, hr_S_pos, hr_S_ball⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hS_cont (r_c / 4) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨r_J, hr_J_pos, hr_J_ball⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hJ_cont (r_c / 4) (by positivity)
    let ρ : ℝ := (1 / 5 : ℝ) * min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c)
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by
      have : 0 < min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c) :=
        lt_min (lt_min hr_V_pos hr_S_pos) (lt_min hr_J_pos hr_c_pos)
      dsimp [ρ]; positivity
    have h5ρ_le_V : 5 * ρ ≤ r_V := by
      have : min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c) ≤ r_V :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      dsimp [ρ]; linarith
    have h5ρ_le_S : 5 * ρ ≤ r_S := by
      have : min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c) ≤ r_S :=
        le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      dsimp [ρ]; linarith
    have h5ρ_le_J : 5 * ρ ≤ r_J := by
      have : min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c) ≤ r_J :=
        le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
      dsimp [ρ]; linarith
    have h5ρ_le_rc : 5 * ρ ≤ r_c := by
      have : min (min r_V r_S) (min r_J r_c) ≤ r_c :=
        le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
      dsimp [ρ]; linarith
    have h4ρ_V : Metric.ball p₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ V_mod :=
      Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) hr_V_sub
    have h4ρ_S : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (4 * ρ), ‖S_star q - S_star p₀‖ < r_c / 4 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq' : dist q p₀ < r_S := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) (by linarith)
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hr_S_ball hq'
    have h4ρ_J : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (4 * ρ), ‖J_star_fn q - J₀‖ < r_c / 4 := by
      intro q hq
      have hq' : dist q p₀ < r_J := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hq) (by linarith)
      simpa [dist_eq_norm, J₀] using hr_J_ball hq'

    let M_g : ℝ := ‖J₀‖ + r_c / 4 + 1
    have hM_g_pos : 0 < M_g := by dsimp [M_g]; positivity
    let M_h : ℝ := (2 + 2 * ρ) * B_jet
    have hM_h_pos : 0 < M_h := by dsimp [M_h]; positivity
    let C₀ : ℝ := max (max M_g (M_g / ρ)) (4 * M_h / (9 * ρ ^ 2))
    have hC₀_pos : 0 < C₀ :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hM_g_pos (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
    have hMg_le_C₀ : M_g ≤ C₀ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hMgρ_le_C₀ : M_g / ρ ≤ C₀ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
    have hMh_le_C₀ : 4 * M_h / (9 * ρ ^ 2) ≤ C₀ := le_max_right _ _

    refine ⟨ρ, C₀, hρ_pos, hC₀_pos, ?_⟩
    intro p hp a ha_pos ha_le
    dsimp only
    let Y : ℂ := p.1
    let T : ℂ := p.2
    have ha_ne : a ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp ha_pos
    have hp_dist : ‖Y - Y₀‖ < ρ ∧ ‖T - T₀‖ < ρ := by
      have hp' : dist p p₀ < ρ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hp
      rwa [Prod.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, max_lt_iff] at hp'
    let U_Y : Set ℂ := Metric.ball Y₀ (4 * ρ)
    have hY_mem_U : Y ∈ U_Y := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; linarith [hp_dist.1]
    have hU_Y_4ρ : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, (Z, T) ∈ Metric.ball p₀ (4 * ρ) := by
      intro Z hZ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq]
      exact max_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp hZ) (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith [hp_dist.2])
    have hU_Y_V : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, (Z, T) ∈ V_mod := fun Z hZ => h4ρ_V (hU_Y_4ρ Z hZ)

    let φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => S_star (Z, T)
    have hφ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ U_Y := by
      let j_T : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun Z => Z • u₁ + ((0 : ℂ), T)
      have hj_T_eq : ∀ Z : ℂ, j_T Z = (Z, T) := by intro Z; ext <;> simp [j_T, u₁]
      have hj_T_diff : Differentiable ℂ j_T := (differentiable_id.smul_const u₁).add_const _
      have hc := hModel.2.1.comp hj_T_diff.differentiableOn
        (fun Z hZ => by rw [hj_T_eq]; exact hU_Y_V Z hZ)
      have hfun : S_star ∘ j_T = φ := by funext Z; simp [Function.comp, hj_T_eq, φ]
      rwa [hfun] at hc
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := dslope φ Y
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_Y :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).mpr hφ_holo
    have hg_Y : g Y = deriv φ Y := dslope_same φ Y

    
    have hg_near_J₀ : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, ‖g Z - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 4 := by
      let ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => φ Z - J₀ * Z
      have hψ_mvt : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, ‖ψ Z - ψ Y‖ ≤ (r_c / 4) * ‖Z - Y‖ := by
        intro Z hZ
        refine Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
          (f' := fun W => deriv φ W - J₀) ?_ ?_ (convex_ball Y₀ (4 * ρ)) hY_mem_U hZ
        · intro W hW
          have hφW : HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ W) W :=
            (hφ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hW)).hasDerivAt
          have hJW : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => J₀ * x) J₀ W := by
            simpa [mul_one] using (hasDerivAt_id W).const_mul J₀
          exact (hφW.sub hJW).hasDerivWithinAt
        · intro W hW
          exact (h4ρ_J (W, T) (hU_Y_4ρ W hW)).le
      intro Z hZ
      by_cases hZY : Z = Y
      · rw [hZY, hg_Y]
        exact (h4ρ_J (Y, T) (hU_Y_4ρ Y hY_mem_U)).le
      · have h_rel : (Z - Y) * (g Z - J₀) = ψ Z - ψ Y := by
          have hd : (Z - Y) * g Z = φ Z - φ Y := by simpa [g] using sub_smul_dslope φ Y Z
          dsimp [ψ]
          linear_combination hd
        have h_norm_mul : ‖Z - Y‖ * ‖g Z - J₀‖ ≤ (r_c / 4) * ‖Z - Y‖ := by
          rw [← norm_mul, h_rel]
          exact hψ_mvt Z hZ
        have hZY_pos : 0 < ‖Z - Y‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr hZY
        have h_norm_mul' : ‖Z - Y‖ * ‖g Z - J₀‖ ≤ ‖Z - Y‖ * (r_c / 4) := by
          linarith
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_norm_mul' hZY_pos
    have hg_bnd : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, ‖g Z‖ ≤ M_g := by
      intro Z hZ
      have h1 := hg_near_J₀ Z hZ
      have h2 := norm_sub_norm_le (g Z) J₀
      dsimp [M_g]; linarith

    
    let g₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope g Y
    have hg₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g₁ U_Y :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).mpr hg_holo
    have h_cb_2ρ : Metric.closedBall Y (2 * ρ) ⊆ U_Y := by
      intro Z hZ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hZ
      calc dist Z Y₀ ≤ dist Z Y + dist Y Y₀ := dist_triangle Z Y Y₀
        _ < 2 * ρ + ρ := by
            have : dist Y Y₀ < ρ := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hp_dist.1
            linarith
        _ < 4 * ρ := by linarith
    have hg₁_bnd : ∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y (2 * ρ), ‖g₁ Z‖ ≤ M_g / ρ := by
      intro Z hZ
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g₁ (Metric.ball Y (2 * ρ)) := hg₁_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_cb_2ρ
      have hZ_cl : Z ∈ closure (Metric.ball Y (2 * ρ)) := by
        rwa [closure_ball Y (by positivity : (2 * ρ : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
      refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hdc ?_ hZ_cl
      intro W hW
      rw [frontier_ball Y (by positivity : (2 * ρ : ℝ) ≠ 0), Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at hW
      have hWY_ne : W ≠ Y := by
        intro heq; rw [heq, sub_self, norm_zero] at hW; linarith
      have hW_U : W ∈ U_Y := h_cb_2ρ (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hW])
      have hg₁_W : g₁ W = (g W - g Y) / (W - Y) := by
        simp [g₁, dslope_of_ne _ hWY_ne, slope_def_field]
      rw [hg₁_W, norm_div, hW]
      have h_num : ‖g W - g Y‖ ≤ 2 * M_g := by
        calc ‖g W - g Y‖ ≤ ‖g W‖ + ‖g Y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ M_g + M_g := add_le_add (hg_bnd W hW_U) (hg_bnd Y hY_mem_U)
          _ = 2 * M_g := by ring
      calc ‖g W - g Y‖ / (2 * ρ) ≤ (2 * M_g) / (2 * ρ) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
        _ = M_g / ρ := by field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']

    
    have hY_plus_cb : Y + a ∈ Metric.closedBall Y (2 * ρ) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]; linarith
    have hY_minus_cb : Y - a ∈ Metric.closedBall Y (2 * ρ) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have : (Y - a) - Y = -a := by ring
      rw [this, norm_neg]; linarith
    have hV_minus : (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod := hU_Y_V (Y - a) (h_cb_2ρ hY_minus_cb)
    have hV_plus : (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod := hU_Y_V (Y + a) (h_cb_2ρ hY_plus_cb)
    have hg_curr_eq : g (Y + a) = (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a := by
      have hne : Y + a ≠ Y := by intro h; apply ha_ne; linear_combination h
      have hsub : (Y + a) - Y = a := by ring
      simp [g, φ, dslope_of_ne _ hne, slope_def_field, hsub]
    have hg_prev_eq : g (Y - a) = (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a := by
      have hne : Y - a ≠ Y := by intro h; exact ha_ne (sub_eq_self.mp h)
      have hsub : (Y - a) - Y = -a := by ring
      simp only [g, φ, dslope_of_ne _ hne, slope_def_field, hsub, div_neg, ← neg_div, neg_sub]
    have h_step_plus : ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ := by
      have hid : S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T) = a * g (Y + a) := by
        rw [hg_curr_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha_ne]
      rw [hid, norm_mul, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg_bnd (Y + a) (h_cb_2ρ hY_plus_cb)) (norm_nonneg a))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMg_le_C₀ (norm_nonneg a))
    have h_step_minus : ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ := by
      have hid : S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T) = a * g (Y - a) := by
        rw [hg_prev_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha_ne]
      rw [hid, norm_mul, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg_bnd (Y - a) (h_cb_2ρ hY_minus_cb)) (norm_nonneg a))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMg_le_C₀ (norm_nonneg a))
    have h_D_curr_diff : ‖(S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a - deriv φ Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ := by
      rw [← hg_curr_eq, ← hg_Y]
      have hid : g (Y + a) - g Y = a * g₁ (Y + a) := by
        have h1 := sub_smul_dslope g Y (Y + a)
        have hsub : (Y + a) - Y = a := by ring
        simpa [g₁, hsub] using h1.symm
      rw [hid, norm_mul, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg₁_bnd (Y + a) hY_plus_cb) (norm_nonneg a))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMgρ_le_C₀ (norm_nonneg a))
    have h_D_prev_diff : ‖(S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a - deriv φ Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ := by
      rw [← hg_prev_eq, ← hg_Y]
      have hid : g (Y - a) - g Y = (-a) * g₁ (Y - a) := by
        have h1 := sub_smul_dslope g Y (Y - a)
        have hsub : (Y - a) - Y = -a := by ring
        simpa [g₁, hsub] using h1.symm
      rw [hid, norm_mul, norm_neg, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg₁_bnd (Y - a) hY_minus_cb) (norm_nonneg a))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMgρ_le_C₀ (norm_nonneg a))

    
    have h2_deriv_g : 2 * deriv g Y = deriv (deriv φ) Y := by
      have hg'_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv g) U_Y := hg_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h_d1 : ∀ Z ∈ U_Y, g Z + (Z - Y) * deriv g Z = deriv φ Z := by
        intro Z hZ
        have hgZ : HasDerivAt g (deriv g Z) Z :=
          (hg_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ)).hasDerivAt
        have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun W => W - Y) 1 Z := (hasDerivAt_id Z).sub_const Y
        have h_lhs : HasDerivAt (fun W => (W - Y) * g W) (1 * g Z + (Z - Y) * deriv g Z) Z :=
          hlin.mul hgZ
        have h_fun_eq : (fun W => (W - Y) * g W) = (fun W => φ W - φ Y) := by
          funext W; simpa [g] using sub_smul_dslope φ Y W
        rw [h_fun_eq] at h_lhs
        have h_rhs : HasDerivAt (fun W => φ W - φ Y) (deriv φ Z) Z := by
          simpa using ((hφ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ)).hasDerivAt).sub_const (φ Y)
        have hu := h_lhs.unique h_rhs
        linear_combination hu
      have hgY_hd : HasDerivAt g (deriv g Y) Y :=
        (hg_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).hasDerivAt
      have hg'Y_hd : HasDerivAt (deriv g) (deriv (deriv g) Y) Y :=
        (hg'_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).hasDerivAt
      have hlinY : HasDerivAt (fun W => W - Y) 1 Y := (hasDerivAt_id Y).sub_const Y
      have h_lhs2 : HasDerivAt (fun W => g W + (W - Y) * deriv g W)
          (deriv g Y + (1 * deriv g Y + (Y - Y) * deriv (deriv g) Y)) Y :=
        hgY_hd.add (hlinY.mul hg'Y_hd)
      have h_ev : (fun W => g W + (W - Y) * deriv g W) =ᶠ[nhds Y] deriv φ :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U) h_d1
      have h_rhs2 : HasDerivAt (deriv φ)
          (deriv g Y + (1 * deriv g Y + (Y - Y) * deriv (deriv g) Y)) Y :=
        h_lhs2.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev.symm
      have hd2 := h_rhs2.deriv
      linear_combination -hd2

    
    let B_a : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * ρ)
    let Φ_J : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun x => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) x.1 x.2 T
    let Φ_S : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun x => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) x.1 x.2 T
    let h_res : ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      (Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w)) - w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))) - Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))
    have hw_U_plus : ∀ w ∈ B_a, Y + w ∈ U_Y := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw ⊢
      have : (Y + w) - Y₀ = (Y - Y₀) + w := by ring
      rw [this]
      calc ‖(Y - Y₀) + w‖ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < ρ + 2 * ρ := add_lt_add hp_dist.1 (by simpa using hw)
        _ < 4 * ρ := by linarith
    have hw_U_minus : ∀ w ∈ B_a, Y - w ∈ U_Y := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw ⊢
      have : (Y - w) - Y₀ = (Y - Y₀) - w := by ring
      rw [this]
      calc ‖(Y - Y₀) - w‖ ≤ ‖Y - Y₀‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ < ρ + 2 * ρ := add_lt_add hp_dist.1 (by simpa using hw)
        _ < 4 * ρ := by linarith

    let ι_T : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun x => x.1 • e₁ + x.2 • e₂ + ((0 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), T))
    have hι_T_eq : ∀ x : ℂ × ℂ, ι_T x = (x.1, (x.2, T)) := by
      intro x; ext <;> simp [ι_T, e₁, e₂]
    have hι_T_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_T :=
      ((differentiable_fst.smul_const _).add (differentiable_snd.smul_const _)).add_const _

    let U₂_jet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { x : ℂ × ℂ | ‖x.1 - S_star p₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖x.2 - J₀‖ < r_c }
    have hU₂_open : IsOpen U₂_jet := by
      have : U₂_jet = Metric.ball (S_star p₀, J₀) r_c := by
        ext x
        change (‖x.1 - S_star p₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖x.2 - J₀‖ < r_c) ↔ dist x (S_star p₀, J₀) < r_c
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, max_lt_iff]
      rw [this]; exact Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hι_T_maps : Set.MapsTo ι_T U₂_jet (Metric.ball q_base r_c) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hι_T_eq, Metric.mem_ball, Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      refine max_lt hx.1 (max_lt hx.2 ?_)
      linarith [hp_dist.2, h5ρ_le_rc]
    have hΦ_J_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ_J U₂_jet := by
      have hc := hModDJ_c.comp hι_T_diff.differentiableOn hι_T_maps
      have hfun : ((fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) ∘ ι_T) = Φ_J := by
        funext x; simp [Function.comp, hι_T_eq, Φ_J]
      rwa [hfun] at hc
    have hΦ_S_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ_S U₂_jet := by
      have hc := hModDS_c.comp hι_T_diff.differentiableOn hι_T_maps
      have hfun : ((fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) ∘ ι_T) = Φ_S := by
        funext x; simp [Function.comp, hι_T_eq, Φ_S]
      rwa [hfun] at hc

    let γ_curr : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun w => φ Y • u₁ + g (Y + w) • u₂
    let γ_prev : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun w => φ (Y - w) • u₁ + g (Y - w) • u₂
    have hγ_curr_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, γ_curr w = (φ Y, g (Y + w)) := by
      intro w; ext <;> simp [γ_curr, u₁, u₂]
    have hγ_prev_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, γ_prev w = (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w)) := by
      intro w; ext <;> simp [γ_prev, u₁, u₂]
    have h_add_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => Y + w) := differentiable_id.const_add Y
    have h_sub_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ => Y - w) := (differentiable_const Y).sub differentiable_id
    have hγ_curr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ γ_curr B_a :=
      (differentiableOn_const (φ Y • u₁)).add
        ((hg_holo.comp h_add_diff.differentiableOn hw_U_plus).smul_const u₂)
    have hγ_prev_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ γ_prev B_a :=
      ((hφ_holo.comp h_sub_diff.differentiableOn hw_U_minus).smul_const u₁).add
        ((hg_holo.comp h_sub_diff.differentiableOn hw_U_minus).smul_const u₂)
    have hγ_curr_mem : ∀ w ∈ B_a, γ_curr w ∈ U₂_jet ∧ ι_T (γ_curr w) ∈ K_jet := by
      intro w hw
      have hS_lt : ‖φ Y - S_star p₀‖ < r_c / 4 := h4ρ_S (Y, T) (hU_Y_4ρ Y hY_mem_U)
      have hg_le : ‖g (Y + w) - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 4 := hg_near_J₀ (Y + w) (hw_U_plus w hw)
      refine ⟨⟨by rw [hγ_curr_eq]; linarith, by rw [hγ_curr_eq]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hγ_curr_eq, hι_T_eq, Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq,
        dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      exact max_le (by linarith) (max_le (by linarith) (by linarith [hp_dist.2, h5ρ_le_rc]))
    have hγ_prev_mem : ∀ w ∈ B_a, γ_prev w ∈ U₂_jet ∧ ι_T (γ_prev w) ∈ K_jet := by
      intro w hw
      have hYw_U : Y - w ∈ U_Y := hw_U_minus w hw
      have hS_lt : ‖φ (Y - w) - S_star p₀‖ < r_c / 4 := h4ρ_S (Y - w, T) (hU_Y_4ρ (Y - w) hYw_U)
      have hg_le : ‖g (Y - w) - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 4 := hg_near_J₀ (Y - w) hYw_U
      refine ⟨⟨by rw [hγ_prev_eq]; linarith, by rw [hγ_prev_eq]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hγ_prev_eq, hι_T_eq, Metric.mem_closedBall, Prod.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq,
        dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      exact max_le (by linarith) (max_le (by linarith) (by linarith [hp_dist.2, h5ρ_le_rc]))

    have hh_eq_comp : h_res = fun w =>
        ((Φ_J ∘ γ_curr) w - w * (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) w) - (Φ_J ∘ γ_prev) w := by
      funext w; simp [h_res, Function.comp, hγ_curr_eq, hγ_prev_eq]
    have hh_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_res B_a := by
      rw [hh_eq_comp]
      have h1 := hΦ_J_holo.comp hγ_curr_holo (fun w hw => (hγ_curr_mem w hw).1)
      have h2 := differentiableOn_id.mul (hΦ_S_holo.comp hγ_curr_holo (fun w hw => (hγ_curr_mem w hw).1))
      have h3 := hΦ_J_holo.comp hγ_prev_holo (fun w hw => (hγ_prev_mem w hw).1)
      exact (h1.sub h2).sub h3
    have hh_bnd : ∀ w ∈ B_a, ‖h_res w‖ ≤ M_h := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * ρ := by
        have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
        rw [dist_zero_right] at this
        exact this.le
      have hc_jet := hJet_bnd (ι_T (γ_curr w)) (hγ_curr_mem w hw).2
      have hp_jet := hJet_bnd (ι_T (γ_prev w)) (hγ_prev_mem w hw).2
      rw [hγ_curr_eq, hι_T_eq] at hc_jet
      rw [hγ_prev_eq, hι_T_eq] at hp_jet
      have h_tri1 : ‖h_res w‖ ≤
          ‖Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))‖ := by
        dsimp [h_res]
        calc ‖(Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w)) - w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))) - Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))‖
            ≤ ‖Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w)) - w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))‖ :=
              norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))‖ := by
              linarith [norm_sub_le (Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w))) (w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w)))]
      have h_mul_le : ‖w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ ≤ (2 * ρ) * B_jet := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul hw_norm hc_jet.1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      calc ‖h_res w‖
          ≤ ‖Φ_J (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖w * Φ_S (φ Y, g (Y + w))‖ + ‖Φ_J (φ (Y - w), g (Y - w))‖ := h_tri1
        _ ≤ B_jet + (2 * ρ) * B_jet + B_jet := add_le_add (add_le_add hc_jet.2 h_mul_le) hp_jet.2
        _ = M_h := by dsimp [M_h]; ring

    have hh_zero : h_res 0 = 0 := by simp [h_res]
    have hh_deriv_zero : deriv h_res 0 = 0 := by
      have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B_a := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
      let x_base : ℂ × ℂ := (φ Y, deriv φ Y)
      have hx_mem : x_base ∈ U₂_jet := by
        have hm := (hγ_curr_mem 0 h0_mem).1
        rwa [hγ_curr_eq, add_zero, hg_Y] at hm
      have hΦJ_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ_J x_base :=
        hΦ_J_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂_open.mem_nhds hx_mem)
      have hΦS_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ_S x_base :=
        hΦ_S_holo.differentiableAt (hU₂_open.mem_nhds hx_mem)
      have hgY_hd : HasDerivAt g (deriv g Y) Y :=
        (hg_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).hasDerivAt
      have hφY_hd : HasDerivAt φ (deriv φ Y) Y :=
        (hφ_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hY_mem_U)).hasDerivAt
      have hg_add_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g (Y + w)) (deriv g Y) 0 := by
        have h_add : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Y + w) (0 + 1) 0 :=
          (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) Y).add (hasDerivAt_id 0)
        rw [zero_add] at h_add
        have hc : HasDerivAt (g ∘ fun w => Y + w) (deriv g Y * 1) 0 := by
          refine HasDerivAt.comp 0 ?_ h_add
          rwa [add_zero]
        rw [mul_one] at hc
        exact hc
      have h_sub_w : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Y - w) (-1) 0 := by
        have hs : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => Y - w) (0 - 1) 0 :=
          (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) Y).sub (hasDerivAt_id 0)
        rwa [zero_sub] at hs
      have hg_sub_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => g (Y - w)) (-deriv g Y) 0 := by
        have hc : HasDerivAt (g ∘ fun w => Y - w) (deriv g Y * (-1)) 0 := by
          refine HasDerivAt.comp 0 ?_ h_sub_w
          rwa [sub_zero]
        rwa [mul_neg_one] at hc
      have hφ_sub_hd : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => φ (Y - w)) (-deriv φ Y) 0 := by
        have hc : HasDerivAt (φ ∘ fun w => Y - w) (deriv φ Y * (-1)) 0 := by
          refine HasDerivAt.comp 0 ?_ h_sub_w
          rwa [sub_zero]
        rwa [mul_neg_one] at hc
      have hγ_curr_hd : HasDerivAt γ_curr ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) 0 := by
        have h1 := (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℂ) (φ Y • u₁)).add (hg_add_hd.smul_const u₂)
        have hv : (0 : ℂ × ℂ) + deriv g Y • u₂ = ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) := by
          ext <;> simp [u₂]
        rwa [hv] at h1
      have hγ_prev_hd : HasDerivAt γ_prev (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y) 0 := by
        have h1 := (hφ_sub_hd.smul_const u₁).add (hg_sub_hd.smul_const u₂)
        have hv : (-deriv φ Y) • u₁ + (-deriv g Y) • u₂ = (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y) := by
          ext <;> simp [u₁, u₂]
        rwa [hv] at h1
      have hγ_curr_0 : γ_curr 0 = x_base := by rw [hγ_curr_eq, add_zero, hg_Y]
      have hγ_prev_0 : γ_prev 0 = x_base := by rw [hγ_prev_eq, sub_zero, hg_Y]
      let L_J := fderiv ℂ Φ_J x_base
      have h_term1 : HasDerivAt (Φ_J ∘ γ_curr) (L_J ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y)) 0 := by
        refine HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 ?_ hγ_curr_hd
        rw [hγ_curr_0]; exact hΦJ_at.hasFDerivAt
      have hΦS_curr_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) 0 := by
        refine DifferentiableAt.comp 0 ?_ hγ_curr_hd.differentiableAt
        rw [hγ_curr_0]; exact hΦS_at
      have h_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun w => w * (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) w) (Φ_S x_base) 0 := by
        have hm : HasDerivAt (fun w => w * (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) w)
            (1 * (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) 0 + (0 : ℂ) * deriv (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) 0) 0 :=
          (hasDerivAt_id 0).mul hΦS_curr_diff.hasDerivAt
        have hval : 1 * (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) 0 + (0 : ℂ) * deriv (Φ_S ∘ γ_curr) 0 = Φ_S x_base := by
          simp [Function.comp, hγ_curr_0]
        rwa [hval] at hm
      have h_term3 : HasDerivAt (Φ_J ∘ γ_prev) (L_J (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y)) 0 := by
        refine HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 ?_ hγ_prev_hd
        rw [hγ_prev_0]; exact hΦJ_at.hasFDerivAt
      have hh_hd : HasDerivAt h_res
          ((L_J ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) - Φ_S x_base) - L_J (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y)) 0 := by
        rw [hh_eq_comp]
        exact (h_term1.sub h_term2).sub h_term3
      have h_vec_eq : ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) - (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y) =
          (deriv φ Y, deriv (deriv φ) Y) := by
        refine Prod.ext (by simp) ?_
        dsimp
        linear_combination h2_deriv_g
      have h_lin : L_J ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) - L_J (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y) = Φ_S x_base := by
        rw [← L_J.map_sub, h_vec_eq]
        exact hContEL p (hU_Y_V Y hY_mem_U)
      have h_val_zero : (L_J ((0 : ℂ), deriv g Y) - Φ_S x_base) - L_J (-deriv φ Y, -deriv g Y) = 0 := by
        linear_combination h_lin
      rw [h_val_zero] at hh_hd
      exact hh_hd.deriv

    
    have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ B_a := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
    let h₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope h_res 0
    let h₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope h₁ 0
    have hh₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₁ B_a :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)).mpr hh_holo
    have hh₂_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h₂ B_a :=
      (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds h0_mem)).mpr hh₁_holo
    have hh₁_zero : h₁ 0 = 0 := by dsimp [h₁]; rw [dslope_same, hh_deriv_zero]
    have hh_factor : ∀ w : ℂ, w ^ 2 * h₂ w = h_res w := by
      intro w
      have hf1 : w * h₁ w = h_res w := by
        have := sub_smul_dslope h_res 0 w
        simpa [h₁, hh_zero] using this
      have hf2 : w * h₂ w = h₁ w := by
        have := sub_smul_dslope h₁ 0 w
        simpa [h₂, hh₁_zero] using this
      calc w ^ 2 * h₂ w = w * (w * h₂ w) := by ring
        _ = w * h₁ w := by rw [hf2]
        _ = h_res w := hf1
    let r_m : ℝ := (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ
    have hr_m_pos : 0 < r_m := by dsimp [r_m]; positivity
    have h_cb_rm : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_m ⊆ B_a :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by dsimp [r_m]; linarith)
    have hh₂_bnd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_m, ‖h₂ w‖ ≤ 4 * M_h / (9 * ρ ^ 2) := by
      intro w hw
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ h₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_m) := hh₂_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_cb_rm
      have hw_cl : w ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_m) := by
        rwa [closure_ball (0 : ℂ) hr_m_pos.ne']
      refine Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hdc ?_ hw_cl
      intro z hz
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hr_m_pos.ne', Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] at hz
      have hz_B : z ∈ B_a := h_cb_rm (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hz])
      have h_prod_le : r_m ^ 2 * ‖h₂ z‖ ≤ M_h := by
        have h1 : ‖z ^ 2 * h₂ z‖ = r_m ^ 2 * ‖h₂ z‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz]
        rw [← h1, hh_factor z]
        exact hh_bnd z hz_B
      have hrm2_pos : 0 < r_m ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_div : ‖h₂ z‖ ≤ M_h / r_m ^ 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hrm2_pos, mul_comm]
        exact h_prod_le
      have h_eq_rhs : M_h / r_m ^ 2 = 4 * M_h / (9 * ρ ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [r_m]
        field_simp [hρ_pos.ne']
        ring
      rwa [h_eq_rhs] at h_div

    have ha_cb : a ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r_m := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp [r_m]; linarith
    have h_res_a : ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T))
          ((S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a) T -
        a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T))
          ((S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a) T) -
        rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T))
          ((S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a) T‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hg_curr_eq, ← hg_prev_eq]
      change ‖h_res a‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖a‖ ^ 2
      rw [← hh_factor a, norm_mul, norm_pow, mul_comm]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hh₂_bnd a ha_cb) (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMh_le_C₀ (by positivity))
    exact ⟨hV_minus, hV_plus, h_step_plus, h_step_minus, h_D_prev_diff, h_D_curr_diff, h_res_a⟩

  
  intro K hK hK_sub
  by_cases hK_ne : K.Nonempty
  · let ρ_fn : K → ℝ := fun x => (h_local_el x.1 (hK_sub x.2)).choose
    let C_fn : K → ℝ := fun x => (h_local_el x.1 (hK_sub x.2)).choose_spec.choose
    have h_spec : ∀ x : K, 0 < ρ_fn x ∧ 0 < C_fn x ∧
        ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball x.1 (ρ_fn x), ∀ a : ℂ, 0 < ‖a‖ → ‖a‖ ≤ ρ_fn x →
          let Y : ℂ := p.1
          let T : ℂ := p.2
          let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
          let D_prev : ℂ := (S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)) / a
          let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / a
          (Y - a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧ (Y + a, T) ∈ V_mod ∧
          ‖S_star (Y + a, T) - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ C_fn x * ‖a‖ ∧
          ‖S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - a, T)‖ ≤ C_fn x * ‖a‖ ∧
          ‖D_prev - J_star‖ ≤ C_fn x * ‖a‖ ∧
          ‖D_curr - J_star‖ ≤ C_fn x * ‖a‖ ∧
          ‖(rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T -
              a * rctActDS (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y, T)) D_curr T) -
            rctActDJ (rctModelActionP kind seq) (S_star (Y - a, T)) D_prev T‖ ≤
            C_fn x * ‖a‖ ^ 2 :=
      fun x => (h_local_el x.1 (hK_sub x.2)).choose_spec.choose_spec
    obtain ⟨t, ht_cover⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover
      (fun x : K => Metric.ball x.1 (ρ_fn x))
      (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
      (fun p hp => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (h_spec ⟨p, hp⟩).1⟩)
    have ht_ne : t.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hK_ne
      have h_mem := ht_cover hp₀
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at h_mem
      obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := h_mem
      exact ⟨i, hi⟩
    let a_max : ℝ := t.inf' ht_ne ρ_fn
    let C_EL : ℝ := t.sup' ht_ne C_fn
    have ha_max_pos : 0 < a_max :=
      (Finset.lt_inf'_iff ht_ne).mpr (fun i _ => (h_spec i).1)
    have hC_EL_pos : 0 < C_EL := by
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := ht_ne
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (h_spec i₀).2.1 (Finset.le_sup' C_fn hi₀)
    refine ⟨a_max, C_EL, ha_max_pos, hC_EL_pos, fun p hp a ha_pos ha_le => ?_⟩
    have h_mem := ht_cover hp
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at h_mem
    obtain ⟨i, hi_t, hp_ball⟩ := h_mem
    have ha_i : ‖a‖ ≤ ρ_fn i := le_trans ha_le (Finset.inf'_le ρ_fn hi_t)
    have hC_i : C_fn i ≤ C_EL := Finset.le_sup' C_fn hi_t
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩ := (h_spec i).2.2 p hp_ball a ha_pos ha_i
    refine ⟨h1, h2,
      le_trans h3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_i (norm_nonneg a)),
      le_trans h4 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_i (norm_nonneg a)),
      le_trans h5 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_i (norm_nonneg a)),
      le_trans h6 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_i (norm_nonneg a)),
      le_trans h7 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_i (by positivity))⟩
  · refine ⟨1, 1, zero_lt_one, zero_lt_one, fun p hp => False.elim (hK_ne ⟨p, hp⟩)⟩

signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hJetEL : RctFrozenJetAndELProp X P kind seq) :
