proof.tactics:
by
  intro V_mod S_star K_corr σ T_max L_max hMod hK_comp hK_sub hσ hT_max hL_max hK_T
  obtain ⟨hJ_holo, hEL_all⟩ := hJetEL.model_euler_lagrange V_mod S_star hMod
  obtain ⟨a_max, C_EL, ha_max_pos, hC_EL_pos, hEL_K⟩ := hEL_all K_corr hK_comp hK_sub
  refine ⟨hJ_holo, ⟨a_max, C_EL, ha_max_pos, hC_EL_pos, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp a ha_pos ha_le
    obtain ⟨hVm1, hVm2, hS1, hS2, hD1, hD2, _⟩ := hEL_K p hp a ha_pos ha_le
    exact ⟨hVm1, hVm2, hS1, hS2, hD1, hD2⟩
  · have h_runChain_add :
        ∀ (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) (n d k₁ : ℕ) (Y₀ T : ℂ) (q₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
          let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (d + k₁) Y₀ T q₀ =
            rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k₁
              (Y₀ + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
              (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n d Y₀ T q₀) := by
      intro Ψ n d k₁ Y₀ T q₀
      dsimp only []
      induction k₁ with
      | zero =>
        simp [rctRunCorridorChain]
      | succ m ih =>
        have h_add : d + (m + 1) = (d + m) + 1 := Nat.add_assoc d m 1
        rw [h_add]
        simp only [rctRunCorridorChain]
        rw [ih]
        have hY_eq :
            Y₀ + ((d + m : ℕ) : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
              (Y₀ + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ))) +
                (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hY_eq]
    have h_model_fst :
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (Y T : ℂ), (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T).1 = S_star (Y, T) := by
      intro n Y T
      unfold cseModelState rctInitSymplecticState
      dsimp only []
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    by_cases hK_ne : K_corr.Nonempty
    · have hAtlas : CseCorridorAtlasProp X P kind seq :=
        corridor_atlas_and_step_consistency X hX P kind seq hJetEL
          single_chart_symplectic_step_solver
      obtain ⟨η_corr, r_tube, r_init_atl, C_Lip, C_cons, N_atl, δ₀, Ψ,
        hη_pos, hr_tube_pos, hr_init_atl_pos, hC_Lip_pos, hC_cons_pos,
        hδ₀_nonneg, hδ₀_tendsto, hAtlas_rest⟩ :=
        hAtlas V_mod S_star K_corr σ T_max hMod hK_ne hK_comp hK_sub hσ hT_max hK_T
      dsimp only [] at hAtlas_rest
      rcases hAtlas_rest with
        ⟨hU_open, hU_sub, h_exact, h_init_conv, h_step_lip, h_mod_def,
         h_strip, h_init_holo, h_step_holo⟩
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      let E_exp : ℝ := Real.exp (C_Lip * L_max * T_max)
      have hE_exp_pos : 0 < E_exp := Real.exp_pos _
      let C_Gron : ℝ := E_exp * (C_cons + C_cons * L_max * T_max + 1)
      have hC_Gron_pos : 0 < C_Gron := by positivity
      let r_thresh : ℝ := r_tube / (3 * C_Gron)
      have hr_thresh_pos : 0 < r_thresh := by positivity
      let r_init : ℝ := min r_init_atl r_thresh
      have hr_init_pos : 0 < r_init := lt_min hr_init_atl_pos hr_thresh_pos
      have hr_init_le_atl : r_init ≤ r_init_atl := min_le_left _ _
      have hr_init_le_thresh : r_init ≤ r_thresh := min_le_right _ _
      obtain ⟨N_δ, hN_δ⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hδ₀_tendsto) r_thresh hr_thresh_pos
      let N_eng : ℕ := max N_atl N_δ
      have h_gronwall :
          ∀ (n : ℕ), N_eng ≤ n → ∀ (K_n : ℕ),
            (K_n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max →
            ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
              T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
              (∀ k ≤ K_n,
                (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) *
                    (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)), T) ∈ U_corr) →
              ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
                ‖(S_curr - S_prev) /
                    ((σ : ℂ) * (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ))) -
                  deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖ < r_init →
              ∀ k ≤ K_n,
                let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
                let e_init : ℝ :=
                  ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
                    ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                      deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
                let q_k :=
                  rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T
                    (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T)
                let q_mod_k :=
                  cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
                ‖q_k.1 - q_mod_k.1‖ + ‖q_k.2 - q_mod_k.2‖ ≤
                  C_Gron * (e_init + δ₀ n) ∧
                ‖q_k.1 - q_mod_k.1‖ + ‖q_k.2 - q_mod_k.2‖ ≤ r_tube := by
        intro n hn K_n hK_len Y₀ T S_prev S_curr hT_ne hT_le h_traj he_init
        have hn_atl : N_atl ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
        have hn_δ : N_δ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
        have hδ_lt : δ₀ n < r_thresh := by
          have hd := hN_δ n hn_δ
          rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (hδ₀_nonneg n)] at hd
        let b_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
        have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let e_init : ℝ :=
          ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
        have he_nonneg : 0 ≤ e_init := by positivity
        have hδ_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ₀ n := hδ₀_nonneg n
        have ha_norm : ‖a_n‖ = ‖T‖ / b_n := by
          dsimp [a_n]
          rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb_pos.le]
        let α_n : ℝ := 1 + C_Lip * ‖a_n‖
        have hα_ge_one : 1 ≤ α_n := by
          dsimp [α_n]
          have : 0 ≤ C_Lip * ‖a_n‖ := by positivity
          linarith
        have hα_nonneg : 0 ≤ α_n := by linarith
        let q₀ : ℂ × ℂ := rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T
        let q_k : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun k => rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T q₀
        let Y_k : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n
        let q_mod_k : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun k => cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_k k) T
        let d_k : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ‖(q_k k).1 - (q_mod_k k).1‖ + ‖(q_k k).2 - (q_mod_k k).2‖
        have h_conseq :
            ∀ k ≤ K_n,
              d_k k ≤ α_n ^ k * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                (k : ℝ) * α_n ^ k * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ →
              d_k k ≤ C_Gron * (e_init + δ₀ n) ∧ d_k k ≤ r_tube := by
          intro k hk hd_inv
          have hk_cast : (k : ℝ) ≤ (K_n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hk
          have hk_div : (k : ℝ) / b_n ≤ L_max :=
            le_trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hk_cast hb_pos.le) hK_len
          have hka_le : (k : ℝ) * ‖a_n‖ ≤ L_max * T_max := by
            rw [ha_norm]
            calc (k : ℝ) * (‖T‖ / b_n)
                = ((k : ℝ) / b_n) * ‖T‖ := by ring
              _ ≤ L_max * T_max :=
                  mul_le_mul hk_div hT_le (norm_nonneg T) hL_max.le
          have hα_exp : α_n ≤ Real.exp (C_Lip * ‖a_n‖) := by
            dsimp [α_n]
            linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (C_Lip * ‖a_n‖)]
          have hα_pow_le : α_n ^ k ≤ E_exp := by
            calc α_n ^ k
                ≤ (Real.exp (C_Lip * ‖a_n‖)) ^ k :=
                  pow_le_pow_left₀ hα_nonneg hα_exp k
              _ = Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * (C_Lip * ‖a_n‖)) :=
                  (Real.exp_nat_mul (C_Lip * ‖a_n‖) k).symm
              _ ≤ Real.exp (C_Lip * L_max * T_max) := by
                  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
                  have hmul : C_Lip * ((k : ℝ) * ‖a_n‖) ≤ C_Lip * (L_max * T_max) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hka_le hC_Lip_pos.le
                  linarith
          have h_term1 :
              α_n ^ k * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) ≤
                E_exp * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) := by
            have h1 : 0 ≤ C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) := by positivity
            calc α_n ^ k * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)
                = α_n ^ k * (C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)) := by ring
              _ ≤ E_exp * (C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα_pow_le h1
              _ = E_exp * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) := by ring
          have h_term2 :
              (k : ℝ) * α_n ^ k * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ ≤
                E_exp * C_cons * L_max * T_max * δ₀ n := by
            have h_prod :
                α_n ^ k * ((k : ℝ) * ‖a_n‖) ≤ E_exp * (L_max * T_max) :=
              mul_le_mul hα_pow_le hka_le (by positivity) hE_exp_pos.le
            have h2 : 0 ≤ C_cons * δ₀ n := by positivity
            calc (k : ℝ) * α_n ^ k * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖
                = (α_n ^ k * ((k : ℝ) * ‖a_n‖)) * (C_cons * δ₀ n) := by ring
              _ ≤ (E_exp * (L_max * T_max)) * (C_cons * δ₀ n) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod h2
              _ = E_exp * C_cons * L_max * T_max * δ₀ n := by ring
          have hd_le_gron : d_k k ≤ C_Gron * (e_init + δ₀ n) := by
            have h_extra : 0 ≤ E_exp * (C_cons * L_max * T_max * e_init + (e_init + δ₀ n)) := by
              positivity
            dsimp [C_Gron]
            linarith
          have hd_le_tube : d_k k ≤ r_tube := by
            have he_lt_th : e_init < r_thresh := lt_of_lt_of_le he_init hr_init_le_thresh
            have hsum_lt : e_init + δ₀ n < 2 * r_thresh := by linarith
            have hmul_lt : C_Gron * (e_init + δ₀ n) < C_Gron * (2 * r_thresh) :=
              mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsum_lt hC_Gron_pos
            have h23 : C_Gron * (2 * r_thresh) = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * r_tube := by
              dsimp [r_thresh]
              field_simp [hC_Gron_pos.ne']
            linarith
          exact ⟨hd_le_gron, hd_le_tube⟩
        have h_ind :
            ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ K_n →
              d_k k ≤ α_n ^ k * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                (k : ℝ) * α_n ^ k * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero =>
            intro _
            have h0_mem : (Y₀, T) ∈ U_corr := by
              simpa using h_traj 0 (Nat.zero_le K_n)
            have he_lt_atl : e_init < r_init_atl := lt_of_lt_of_le he_init hr_init_le_atl
            have h0_bound :
                ‖q₀.1 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T).1‖ +
                  ‖q₀.2 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T).2‖ ≤
                  C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) :=
              h_init_conv n hn_atl Y₀ T S_prev S_curr h0_mem hT_ne hT_le he_lt_atl
            have hd0_eq : d_k 0 =
                ‖q₀.1 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T).1‖ +
                  ‖q₀.2 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T).2‖ := by
              dsimp [d_k, q_k, q_mod_k, Y_k, rctRunCorridorChain]
              rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
            have h_rhs :
                α_n ^ 0 * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                    ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α_n ^ 0 * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ =
                  C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) := by
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [hd0_eq, h_rhs]
            exact h0_bound
          | succ m ih =>
            intro hm1
            have hm : m ≤ K_n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hm1
            have h_ih := ih hm
            have hd_m_tube : d_k m ≤ r_tube := (h_conseq m hm h_ih).2
            have hm_mem : (Y_k m, T) ∈ U_corr := h_traj m hm
            let q_mid : ℂ × ℂ := Ψ n (Y_k m, T) (q_mod_k m)
            have hq_step : q_k (m + 1) = Ψ n (Y_k m, T) (q_k m) := rfl
            have hY_step : Y_k (m + 1) = Y_k m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n := by
              dsimp [Y_k]
              push_cast
              ring
            have hq_mod_step :
                q_mod_k (m + 1) = cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_k m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T := by
              dsimp [q_mod_k]
              rw [hY_step]
            have h_mod_zero :
                ‖(q_mod_k m).1 - (q_mod_k m).1‖ + ‖(q_mod_k m).2 - (q_mod_k m).2‖ ≤ r_tube := by
              simp [hr_tube_pos.le]
            have h_lip :
                ‖(q_k (m + 1)).1 - q_mid.1‖ + ‖(q_k (m + 1)).2 - q_mid.2‖ ≤ α_n * d_k m :=
              h_step_lip n hn_atl (Y_k m) T (q_k m) (q_mod_k m)
                hm_mem hT_ne hT_le hd_m_tube h_mod_zero
            have h_def :
                ‖q_mid.1 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_k m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T).1‖ +
                  ‖q_mid.2 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_k m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T).2‖ ≤
                  C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ :=
              h_mod_def n hn_atl (Y_k m) T hm_mem hT_ne hT_le
            have h_tri1 :
                ‖(q_k (m + 1)).1 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).1‖ ≤
                  ‖(q_k (m + 1)).1 - q_mid.1‖ + ‖q_mid.1 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).1‖ := by
              simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using
                norm_add_le ((q_k (m + 1)).1 - q_mid.1) (q_mid.1 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).1)
            have h_tri2 :
                ‖(q_k (m + 1)).2 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).2‖ ≤
                  ‖(q_k (m + 1)).2 - q_mid.2‖ + ‖q_mid.2 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).2‖ := by
              simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using
                norm_add_le ((q_k (m + 1)).2 - q_mid.2) (q_mid.2 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).2)
            have hd_step : d_k (m + 1) ≤ α_n * d_k m + C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ := by
              have h2 :
                  ‖q_mid.1 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).1‖ + ‖q_mid.2 - (q_mod_k (m + 1)).2‖ ≤
                    C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ := by
                rw [hq_mod_step]
                exact h_def
              dsimp [d_k]
              linarith
            have hα_pow_ge_one : 1 ≤ α_n ^ (m + 1) := one_le_pow₀ hα_ge_one
            have h_def_absorb :
                C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ ≤ α_n ^ (m + 1) * (C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) := by
              have h_nonneg_def : 0 ≤ C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ := by positivity
              calc C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖
                  = 1 * (C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) := (one_mul _).symm
                _ ≤ α_n ^ (m + 1) * (C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) :=
                    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hα_pow_ge_one h_nonneg_def
            have h_mul_ih :
                α_n * d_k m ≤
                  α_n * (α_n ^ m * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                    (m : ℝ) * α_n ^ m * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ih hα_nonneg
            have h_alg :
                α_n * (α_n ^ m * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                    (m : ℝ) * α_n ^ m * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) +
                  α_n ^ (m + 1) * (C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) =
                α_n ^ (m + 1) * C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n) +
                  ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * α_n ^ (m + 1) * C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖ := by
              push_cast
              ring
            linarith
        intro k hk
        exact h_conseq k hk (h_ind k hk)
      refine ⟨η_corr, r_init, C_Gron, N_eng, δ₀, Ψ,
        hη_pos, hr_init_pos, hC_Gron_pos, hδ₀_nonneg, hδ₀_tendsto, ?_⟩
      dsimp only []
      refine ⟨hU_open, hU_sub, h_runChain_add Ψ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro n hn Y T S_fn hYT hT_ne hT_le hRec hS1 hS2 hS3 hD1 hD2
        exact h_exact n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) Y T S_fn hYT hT_ne hT_le hRec
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hS1 hr_init_le_atl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hS2 hr_init_le_atl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hS3 hr_init_le_atl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hD1 hr_init_le_atl)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hD2 hr_init_le_atl)
      · intro n hn K_n hK_len Y₀ T S_prev S_curr hT_ne hT_le h_traj he_init k hk
        have ⟨hd_gron, hd_tube⟩ :=
          h_gronwall n hn K_n hK_len Y₀ T S_prev S_curr hT_ne hT_le h_traj he_init k hk
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_k :=
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k Y₀ T
            (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T)
        let Y_k : ℂ := Y₀ + (k : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n
        have h_fst_eq : (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y_k T).1 = S_star (Y_k, T) :=
          h_model_fst n Y_k T
        have hS_le_d :
            ‖q_k.1 - S_star (Y_k, T)‖ ≤
              ‖q_k.1 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y_k T).1‖ +
                ‖q_k.2 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y_k T).2‖ := by
          rw [h_fst_eq]
          linarith [norm_nonneg (q_k.2 - (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y_k T).2)]
        have hS_gron :
            ‖q_k.1 - S_star (Y_k, T)‖ ≤
              C_Gron *
                ((‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
                    ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
                      deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖) +
                  δ₀ n) :=
          le_trans hS_le_d hd_gron
        have hS_tube : ‖q_k.1 - S_star (Y_k, T)‖ ≤ r_tube :=
          le_trans hS_le_d hd_tube
        have h_in_strip : expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q_k.1 ∈ X.D_strip :=
          h_strip n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) Y_k T q_k.1 (h_traj k hk) hS_tube
        exact ⟨hS_gron, h_in_strip⟩
      · intro n hn K_n hK_len W Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn
          hW_open hY₀_holo hT_holo hSp_holo hSc_holo hw_all
        have hn_atl : N_atl ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
        have h_holo_both :
            ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ K_n →
              DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                  (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                    (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1)
                W ∧
              DifferentiableOn ℂ
                (fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                  (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n k (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                    (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).2)
                W := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero =>
            intro _
            simp only [rctRunCorridorChain]
            refine h_init_holo n hn_atl W Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn
              hW_open hY₀_holo hT_holo hSp_holo hSc_holo ?_
            intro w hw
            rcases hw_all w hw with ⟨hTw_ne, hTw_le, hw_traj, hw_err⟩
            have h0_mem : (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr := by
              have h0 := hw_traj 0 (Nat.zero_le K_n)
              rwa [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_mul, add_zero] at h0
            exact ⟨h0_mem, hTw_ne, hTw_le, lt_of_lt_of_le hw_err hr_init_le_atl⟩
          | succ m ih =>
            intro hm1
            have hm : m ≤ K_n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hm1
            obtain ⟨hS_m_holo, hPm_holo⟩ := ih hm
            let Y_m_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
              Y₀_fn w + (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) *
                (T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ))
            have hYm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Y_m_fn W := by
              have h_eq :
                  Y_m_fn =
                    fun w : ℂ × ℂ =>
                      Y₀_fn w +
                        ((m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) *
                          (((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹)) * T_fn w := by
                ext w
                dsimp [Y_m_fn]
                rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
                ring
              rw [h_eq]
              exact hY₀_holo.add (hT_holo.const_mul _)
            simp only [rctRunCorridorChain]
            refine h_step_holo n hn_atl W Y_m_fn T_fn
              (fun w =>
                (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                  (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1)
              (fun w =>
                (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                  (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).2)
              hW_open hYm_holo hT_holo hS_m_holo hPm_holo ?_
            intro w hw
            rcases hw_all w hw with ⟨hTw_ne, hTw_le, hw_traj, hw_err⟩
            have hm_mem : (Y_m_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr := hw_traj m hm
            have hd_tube :
                ‖(rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                    (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).1 -
                  (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_m_fn w) (T_fn w)).1‖ +
                ‖(rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w)
                    (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w))).2 -
                  (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_m_fn w) (T_fn w)).2‖ ≤ r_tube :=
              (h_gronwall n hn K_n hK_len (Y₀_fn w) (T_fn w) (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w)
                hTw_ne hTw_le hw_traj hw_err m hm).2
            exact ⟨hm_mem, hTw_ne, hTw_le, hd_tube⟩
        intro k hk
        exact (h_holo_both k hk).1
    · have hK_empty : K_corr = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hK_ne
      refine ⟨1, 1, 1, 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ _ q => q,
        zero_lt_one, zero_lt_one, zero_lt_one,
        fun _ => le_rfl, tendsto_const_nhds, ?_⟩
      dsimp only []
      have hU_empty : { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < (1 : ℝ) } = ∅ := by
        ext p
        simp [hK_empty]
      refine ⟨hU_empty ▸ isOpen_empty, hU_empty ▸ Set.empty_subset V_mod,
        h_runChain_add (fun _ _ q => q), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro n _ Y T _ hYT
        rw [hU_empty] at hYT
        exact False.elim hYT
      · intro n _ K_n _ Y₀ T _ _ _ _ h_traj
        have h0 :
            (Y₀ + ((0 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) *
                (T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)), T) ∈
              { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < (1 : ℝ) } :=
          h_traj 0 (Nat.zero_le K_n)
        rw [hU_empty] at h0
        exact False.elim h0
      · intro n _ K_n _ W Y₀_fn T_fn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hw_all k _ w hw
        rcases hw_all w hw with ⟨_, _, hw_traj, _⟩
        have h0 :
            (Y₀_fn w + ((0 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) *
                (T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)), T_fn w) ∈
              { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < (1 : ℝ) } :=
          hw_traj 0 (Nat.zero_le K_n)
        rw [hU_empty] at h0
        exact False.elim h0

corridor_symplectic_step_and_gronwall.definitions:
noncomputable def cseChartG (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b σ : ℝ) (S T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  if 0 < σ then
    rctActDJ F S D T - a * rctActDS F S D T
  else
    rctActDJ F (S - a * D) D T

noncomputable def cseChartNewton (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  D - μ₀⁻¹ * (cseChartG F b σ S T D - P_mom)

noncomputable def cseChartIter (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => J₀
  | m + 1 => cseChartNewton F μ₀ b σ S P_mom T (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T m)

noncomputable def cseChartRoot (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T)

noncomputable def cseChartStep (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  let D : ℂ := cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T
  if 0 < σ then
    (S + a * D, P_mom + a * rctActDS F S D T)
  else
    let S_next : ℂ := S - a * D
    (S_next, P_mom - a * rctActDS F S_next D T)

def CseChartActionJet (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧ μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
  let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
    ‖rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
  (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
    (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
    ‖rctActDS F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDS F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDJ F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))

def CseStepSmall (J₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c b : ℝ) (T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  ‖a‖ ≤ 1 ∧
  ‖a‖ * (1 + ‖J₀‖ + r_c) ≤ r_c / 4 ∧
  ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) ≤ min (‖μ₀‖ / 8) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / 32)

def CseInChartDom (S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c : ℝ) (S P_mom T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ‖S - S₀‖ < min (r_c / 4) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / (32 * M_c)) ∧
  ‖P_mom - P₀‖ < (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c ∧
  ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T

def CseSingleChartSolverProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c b σ : ℝ),
    CseChartActionJet F S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ r_c M_c →
    0 < r_T → r_T ≤ r_c → 0 < b →
    (∀ T : ℂ, ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T →
      ‖rctActDJ F S₀ J₀ T - P₀‖ ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c) →
    (∀ S P_mom T : ℂ,
      CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S P_mom T →
      CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
      ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 2 ∧
      cseChartG F b σ S T (cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T) = P_mom ∧
      ∀ D_test : ℂ, ‖D_test - J₀‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * r_c →
        ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - D_test‖ ≤
          (2 / ‖μ₀‖) * ‖cseChartG F b σ S T D_test - P_mom‖) ∧
    (let C_D : ℝ := 2 * (2 * M_c + 1) / ‖μ₀‖
     let C_step : ℝ := C_D + M_c * (1 + 2 * C_D)
     ∀ S₁ P₁ S₂ P₂ T : ℂ,
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₁ P₁ T →
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₂ P₂ T →
       CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
       let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
       let q₁' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₁ P₁ T
       let q₂' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₂ P₂ T
       ‖q₁'.1 - q₂'.1‖ + ‖q₁'.2 - q₂'.2‖ ≤
         (1 + C_step * ‖a‖) * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖P₁ - P₂‖)) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_fn P_fn T_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
      (∀ w ∈ W,
        CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) ∧
        CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b (T_fn w)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W)

noncomputable def cseModelState {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_star (Y, T)) T

def CseCorridorAtlasProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    K_corr.Nonempty → IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    ∃ (η_corr r_tube r_init_atl C_Lip C_cons : ℝ) (N_atl : ℕ) (δ₀ : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_tube ∧ 0 < r_init_atl ∧ 0 < C_Lip ∧ 0 < C_cons ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ₀ n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ₀ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
        (Y₀, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let e_init : ℝ :=
          ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
        e_init < r_init_atl →
        let q₀ := rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T
        ‖q₀.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₀.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        ‖q₁.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖q₂.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₂.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).1 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).2 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).2‖ ≤
          (1 + C_Lip * ‖a_n‖) * (‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        let q_mod_next := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).1 - q_mod_next.1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).2 - q_mod_next.2‖ ≤ C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T S : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → ‖S - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ r_tube →
        expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init_atl) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y_fn T_fn S_fn P_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_fn w) (T_fn w)
          ‖S_fn w - q_mod.1‖ + ‖P_fn w - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).2) W)

noncomputable def cseChartG (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b σ : ℝ) (S T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  if 0 < σ then
    rctActDJ F S D T - a * rctActDS F S D T
  else
    rctActDJ F (S - a * D) D T

noncomputable def cseChartNewton (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T D : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  D - μ₀⁻¹ * (cseChartG F b σ S T D - P_mom)

noncomputable def cseChartIter (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => J₀
  | m + 1 => cseChartNewton F μ₀ b σ S P_mom T (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T m)

noncomputable def cseChartRoot (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T)

noncomputable def cseChartStep (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (μ₀ J₀ : ℂ) (b σ : ℝ)
    (S P_mom T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  let D : ℂ := cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T
  if 0 < σ then
    (S + a * D, P_mom + a * rctActDS F S D T)
  else
    let S_next : ℂ := S - a * D
    (S_next, P_mom - a * rctActDS F S_next D T)

def CseChartActionJet (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧ μ₀ ≠ 0 ∧
  let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧
  (∀ q ∈ Q_c,
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ ∧
    ‖rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDSJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c ∧
    ‖rctActDJJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2‖ ≤ M_c) ∧
  (∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
    (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
    ‖rctActDS F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDS F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖) ∧
    ‖rctActDJ F S₁ J₁ T - rctActDJ F S₂ J₂ T‖ ≤ M_c * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖))

def CseStepSmall (J₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c M_c b : ℝ) (T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
  ‖a‖ ≤ 1 ∧
  ‖a‖ * (1 + ‖J₀‖ + r_c) ≤ r_c / 4 ∧
  ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) ≤ min (‖μ₀‖ / 8) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / 32)

def CseInChartDom (S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c : ℝ) (S P_mom T : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ‖S - S₀‖ < min (r_c / 4) (‖μ₀‖ * r_c / (32 * M_c)) ∧
  ‖P_mom - P₀‖ < (1 / 16 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c ∧
  ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T

def CseSingleChartSolverProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S₀ J₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ : ℂ) (r_c r_T M_c b σ : ℝ),
    CseChartActionJet F S₀ J₀ T₀ μ₀ r_c M_c →
    0 < r_T → r_T ≤ r_c → 0 < b →
    (∀ T : ℂ, ‖T - T₀‖ < r_T →
      ‖rctActDJ F S₀ J₀ T - P₀‖ ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c) →
    (∀ S P_mom T : ℂ,
      CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S P_mom T →
      CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
      ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 2 ∧
      cseChartG F b σ S T (cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T) = P_mom ∧
      ∀ D_test : ℂ, ‖D_test - J₀‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * r_c →
        ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - D_test‖ ≤
          (2 / ‖μ₀‖) * ‖cseChartG F b σ S T D_test - P_mom‖) ∧
    (let C_D : ℝ := 2 * (2 * M_c + 1) / ‖μ₀‖
     let C_step : ℝ := C_D + M_c * (1 + 2 * C_D)
     ∀ S₁ P₁ S₂ P₂ T : ℂ,
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₁ P₁ T →
       CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S₂ P₂ T →
       CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
       let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
       let q₁' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₁ P₁ T
       let q₂' := cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ S₂ P₂ T
       ‖q₁'.1 - q₂'.1‖ + ‖q₁'.2 - q₂'.2‖ ≤
         (1 + C_step * ‖a‖) * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖P₁ - P₂‖)) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_fn P_fn T_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
      (∀ w ∈ W,
        CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) ∧
        CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b (T_fn w)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun w => (cseChartStep F μ₀ J₀ b σ (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W)

noncomputable def cseModelState {X : ExpStripData} (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    {kind : ExpProfileKind} (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (Y T : ℂ) : ℂ × ℂ :=
  let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
  rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_star (Y, T)) T

def CseCorridorAtlasProp (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (K_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ))
    (σ T_max : ℝ),
    IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
    K_corr.Nonempty → IsCompact K_corr → K_corr ⊆ V_mod →
    (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < T_max →
    (∀ p ∈ K_corr, ‖p.2‖ ≤ T_max) →
    ∃ (η_corr r_tube r_init_atl C_Lip C_cons : ℝ) (N_atl : ℕ) (δ₀ : ℕ → ℝ)
      (Ψ : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ),
      0 < η_corr ∧ 0 < r_tube ∧ 0 < r_init_atl ∧ 0 < C_Lip ∧ 0 < C_cons ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ δ₀ n) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto δ₀ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      let U_corr : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | ∃ q ∈ K_corr, ‖p - q‖ < η_corr }
      IsOpen U_corr ∧ U_corr ⊆ V_mod ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let J_star : ℂ := deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
        ‖S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn Y - S_star (Y, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        ‖(S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - S_fn Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < r_init_atl →
        Ψ n (Y, T)
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) (S_fn Y) T) =
          rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_fn Y) (S_fn (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) T) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y₀ T S_prev S_curr : ℂ),
        (Y₀, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let e_init : ℝ :=
          ‖S_curr - S_star (Y₀, T)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr - S_prev) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y₀‖
        e_init < r_init_atl →
        let q₀ := rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y₀ T
        ‖q₀.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₀.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ C_cons * (e_init + δ₀ n)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ) (q₁ q₂ : ℂ × ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        ‖q₁.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖q₂.1 - q_mod.1‖ + ‖q₂.2 - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube →
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).1 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q₁).2 - (Ψ n (Y, T) q₂).2‖ ≤
          (1 + C_Lip * ‖a_n‖) * (‖q₁.1 - q₂.1‖ + ‖q₁.2 - q₂.2‖)) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → T ≠ 0 → ‖T‖ ≤ T_max →
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ Y T
        let q_mod_next := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) T
        ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).1 - q_mod_next.1‖ +
          ‖(Ψ n (Y, T) q_mod).2 - q_mod_next.2‖ ≤ C_cons * δ₀ n * ‖a_n‖) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (Y T S : ℂ),
        (Y, T) ∈ U_corr → ‖S - S_star (Y, T)‖ ≤ r_tube →
        expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let a_n : ℂ := T_fn w / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          ‖S_curr_fn w - S_star (Y₀_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
            ‖(S_curr_fn w - S_prev_fn w) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T_fn w)) (Y₀_fn w)‖ < r_init_atl) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun w => (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ (S_prev_fn w) (S_curr_fn w) (T_fn w)).2) W) ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_atl, ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Y_fn T_fn S_fn P_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Y_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ P_fn W →
        (∀ w ∈ W,
          (Y_fn w, T_fn w) ∈ U_corr ∧ T_fn w ≠ 0 ∧ ‖T_fn w‖ ≤ T_max ∧
          let q_mod := cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_fn w) (T_fn w)
          ‖S_fn w - q_mod.1‖ + ‖P_fn w - q_mod.2‖ ≤ r_tube) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).1) W ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).2) W)

(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hEngine : RctCorridorStepEngineProp X P kind seq) :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (T₀ Y_plus : ℂ)
      (ε_plus L_max : ℝ) (S_init : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (N_base : ℕ) (N_step : ℕ → ℕ),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      T₀ ≠ 0 → 0 < ε_plus → 0 < L_max →
      Metric.closedBall Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) ×ˢ ({T₀} : Set ℂ) ⊆ V_mod →
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall Y_plus ε_plus, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L_max,
        (Z + (τ : ℂ) * T₀, T₀) ∈ V_mod) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_init n) (Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus))) →
      (∀ n ≥ N_base, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus),
        Z - T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        Z + T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) →
        SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n Z T₀) →
      TendstoUniformlyOn S_init (fun Z => S_star (Z, T₀))
        Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall Y_plus (2 * ε_plus)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, (N_step n : ℝ) / (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) ≤ L_max) →
      ∃ (N_tr : ℕ) (S_chain : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
        N_base ≤ N_tr ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_chain n j) (Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          S_chain n 0 Z = S_init n Z ∧ S_chain n 1 Z = S_init n (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ n ≥ N_tr, ∀ j < N_step n, ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
          let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
          Z + a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus →
          S_chain n (j + 1) Z = S_chain n j (Z + a_n)) ∧
        (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ ≥ N_tr, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ j ≤ N_step n,
          ∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus,
            let a_n : ℂ := T₀ / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            ‖S_chain n j Z - S_star (Z + (j : ℂ) * a_n, T₀)‖ < ε)

      have hne : ((b n : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := hb_c_ne n
      push_cast
      field_simp [hne]
      ring
    rw [h_pt_eq]
    apply hK_sub_U
    exact Or.inr ⟨(Z, τ), ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hZ, ⟨hτ_nonneg, hτ_le⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨N_tr, S_chain, hN_tr_base, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn j hj
    have hn_base : N_base ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_base hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_eng hn
    rcases j with _ | m
    · exact (hInit_holo n hn_base).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
    · obtain ⟨hm_div, h_corr⟩ := h_traj n m hj
      obtain ⟨ha_lt_q, h_small_n⟩ := hN_tr n hn
      let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball Y_plus ε_plus ×ˢ Set.univ
      have hW_open : IsOpen W := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_univ
      let Y₀_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w.1 + a n
      let T_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun _ => T₀
      let S_prev_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w => S_init n w.1
      let S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w => S_init n (w.1 + a n)
      have hY₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Y₀_fn W :=
        (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const (a n))).differentiableOn
      have hT_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ T_fn W := differentiableOn_const T₀
      have hSp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn W := by
        refine (hInit_holo n hn_base).comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn ?_
        intro w hw
        exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hw.1
      have hSc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn W := by
        refine (hInit_holo n hn_base).comp
          (differentiable_fst.add (differentiable_const (a n))).differentiableOn ?_
        intro w hw
        have hw1 : ‖w.1 - Y_plus‖ < ε_plus := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hw.1
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_eq : w.1 + a n - Y_plus = (w.1 - Y_plus) + a n := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(w.1 - Y_plus) + a n‖
            ≤ ‖w.1 - Y_plus‖ + ‖a n‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < ε_plus + ε_plus / 4 := add_lt_add hw1 ha_lt_q
          _ < 3 * ε_plus := by linarith
      have h2d := hParam_holo n hn_eng m hm_div W Y₀_fn T_fn S_prev_fn S_curr_fn
        hW_open hY₀_holo hT_holo hSp_holo hSc_holo ?_ m le_rfl
      · refine h2d.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (0 : ℂ))).differentiableOn ?_
        intro Z hZ
        exact ⟨hZ, trivial⟩
      · intro w hw
        refine ⟨hT₀, le_rfl, h_corr w.1 hw.1, ?_⟩
        simpa [Y₀_fn, T_fn, S_prev_fn, S_curr_fn, a, b] using (h_small_n w.1 hw.1).2.2.2.2.2
  · intro n _ Z _
    exact ⟨rfl, hS_chain_one n Z⟩
  · intro n hn j hj Z hZ a_n _hZa_in
    have hn_base : N_base ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_base hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_eng hn
    rcases j with _ | m
    · exact hS_chain_one n Z
    · obtain ⟨ha_lt_q, h_small_n⟩ := hN_tr n hn
      obtain ⟨h_s0, h_s1, h_s2, h_d0, h_d1, _⟩ := h_small_n Z hZ
      have hZ_norm : ‖Z - Y_plus‖ < ε_plus := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hZ
      have hZa_norm : ‖Z + a n - Y_plus‖ < (5 / 4 : ℝ) * ε_plus := by
        have h_eq : Z + a n - Y_plus = (Z - Y_plus) + a n := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(Z - Y_plus) + a n‖
            ≤ ‖Z - Y_plus‖ + ‖a n‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < ε_plus + ε_plus / 4 := add_lt_add hZ_norm ha_lt_q
          _ = (5 / 4 : ℝ) * ε_plus := by ring
      have hZa_b2 : Z + a n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (2 * ε_plus) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        linarith
      have hZa_sub_b3 : (Z + a n) - a n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
        exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hZ
      have hZa_add_b3 : (Z + a n) + a n ∈ Metric.ball Y_plus (3 * ε_plus) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_eq : (Z + a n) + a n - Y_plus = (Z + a n - Y_plus) + a n := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ‖(Z + a n - Y_plus) + a n‖
            ≤ ‖Z + a n - Y_plus‖ + ‖a n‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < (5 / 4 : ℝ) * ε_plus + ε_plus / 4 := add_lt_add hZa_norm ha_lt_q
          _ < 3 * ε_plus := by linarith
      have h_rec : SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (S_init n) n (Z + a n) T₀ :=
        hInit_rec n hn_base (Z + a n) hZa_b2 hZa_sub_b3 hZa_add_b3
      have hZa_U : (Z + a n, T₀) ∈ U_corr :=
        hK_sub_U (Or.inl ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hZa_b2, rfl⟩)
      have h_step := hStep_rec n hn_eng (Z + a n) T₀ (S_init n) hZa_U hT₀ le_rfl h_rec
        (by simpa [a, b] using h_s0)
        h_s1
        (by simpa [a, b] using h_s2)
        (by simpa [a, b] using h_d0)
        (by simpa [a, b] using h_d1)
      let q₀ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun W =>
        rctInitSymplecticState P seq n 1 (S_init n W) (S_init n (W + a n)) T₀
      have h_one_step :
          rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ 1 n 1 (Z + a n) T₀ (q₀ Z) = q₀ (Z + a n) := by
        simpa [rctRunCorridorChain, q₀, a, b] using h_step
      change (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ 1 n (m + 1) (Z + a n) T₀ (q₀ Z)).1 =
        (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ 1 n m ((Z + a n) + a n) T₀ (q₀ (Z + a n))).1
      rw [Nat.add_comm m 1, hChain_add n 1 m (Z + a n) T₀ (q₀ Z), h_one_step]
      congr 1
      congr 2
      simp [a, b]
  · intro ε hε
    let η_ε : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (ε / (3 * C_Gron))
    have hη_ε_pos : 0 < η_ε := lt_min (half_pos hε) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N_init_ε, _, _, hN_init_ε⟩ := h_init_small η_ε hη_ε_pos
    obtain ⟨N_δ_ε, hN_δ_ε⟩ :=
      Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hδ_tendsto (ε / (3 * C_Gron)) (by positivity)
    let N₁ : ℕ := max N_tr (max N_init_ε N_δ_ε)
    refine ⟨N₁, le_max_left _ _, fun n hn j hj Z hZ => ?_⟩
    have hn_tr : N_tr ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans hN_tr_eng hn_tr
    have hn_init : N_init_ε ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn_δ : N_δ_ε ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    rcases j with _ | m
    · have h0_eq : Z + ((0 : ℕ) : ℂ) * a n = Z := by simp
      change ‖S_init n Z - S_star (Z + ((0 : ℕ) : ℂ) * a n, T₀)‖ < ε
      rw [h0_eq]
      have hs0 := ((hN_init_ε n hn_init).2 Z hZ).1
      have hle : η_ε ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨hm_div, h_corr⟩ := h_traj n m hj
      have he_tr :
          ‖S_init n (Z + a n) - S_star (Z + a n, T₀)‖ +
            ‖(S_init n (Z + a n) - S_init n Z) / (((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T₀)) (Z + a n)‖ < r_init := by
        rw [h1_mul]
        exact ((hN_tr n hn_tr).2 Z hZ).2.2.2.2.2
      have h_gron :=
        (hGronwall n hn_eng m hm_div (Z + a n) T₀ (S_init n Z) (S_init n (Z + a n))
          hT₀ le_rfl (h_corr Z hZ) he_tr m le_rfl).1
      have h_pt :
          (Z + a n) + (m : ℂ) * ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a n = Z + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * a n := by
        push_cast
        ring
      change ‖(rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ 1 n m (Z + a n) T₀
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n 1 (S_init n Z) (S_init n (Z + a n)) T₀)).1 -
        S_star (Z + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * a n, T₀)‖ < ε
      rw [← h_pt]
      have he_ε :
          ‖S_init n (Z + a n) - S_star (Z + a n, T₀)‖ +
            ‖(S_init n (Z + a n) - S_init n Z) / (((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T₀)) (Z + a n)‖ < ε / (3 * C_Gron) := by
        rw [h1_mul]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (((hN_init_ε n hn_init).2 Z hZ).2.2.2.2.2) (min_le_right _ _)
      have hδ_lt : δ_mod n < ε / (3 * C_Gron) := by
        have hd := hN_δ_ε n hn_δ
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (hδ_nonneg n)] at hd
        exact hd
      have h_bound :
          C_Gron *
            ((‖S_init n (Z + a n) - S_star (Z + a n, T₀)‖ +
              ‖(S_init n (Z + a n) - S_init n Z) / (((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T₀)) (Z + a n)‖) + δ_mod n) < ε := by
        have hsum_lt :
            (‖S_init n (Z + a n) - S_star (Z + a n, T₀)‖ +
              ‖(S_init n (Z + a n) - S_init n Z) / (((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a n) -
                deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T₀)) (Z + a n)‖) + δ_mod n <
            ε / (3 * C_Gron) + ε / (3 * C_Gron) := add_lt_add he_ε hδ_lt
        have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsum_lt hC_Gron_pos
        have h_eq : C_Gron * (ε / (3 * C_Gron) + ε / (3 * C_Gron)) = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * ε := by
          field_simp [hC_Gron_pos.ne']
          ring
        linarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_gron h_bound

informal_problem.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hEngine : RctCorridorStepEngineProp X P kind seq) :
    ∀ (V_mod : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (S_star : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
      (σ η T_max : ℝ) (U_T : Set ℂ) (x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top : ℝ)
      (K_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
      IsRegularFrozenModel seq V_mod S_star →
      (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → 0 < η → 0 < T_max →
      IsOpen U_T →
      U_T ⊆ { T : ℂ | η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max } →
      x_lo < x_hi → y_bot < y_top →
      (let B_init : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
          y_bot < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < y_top ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T }
       let y_mid : ℝ := (y_bot + y_top) / 2
       let δ_y : ℝ := (y_top - y_bot) / 4
       B_init ⊆ V_mod →
       IsCompact K_steep →
       K_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
         x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
         y_bot + δ_y ≤ p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } →
       (∀ p ∈ K_steep, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc y_mid (max y_mid p.1.im),
         let Y_vert : ℂ := (p.1.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I
         let s_end : ℝ := (τ - y_mid) / (σ * p.2.im)
         (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s_end,
           (Y_vert - (s : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2, p.2) ∈ V_mod) ∧
         x_lo < (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re ∧
         (Y_vert - (s_end : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * p.2).re < x_hi) →
       ∃ W_steep : Set (ℂ × ℂ),
         IsOpen W_steep ∧
         K_steep ⊆ W_steep ∧
         W_steep ⊆ V_mod ∧
         W_steep ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
           x_lo < p.1.re ∧ p.1.re < x_hi ∧
           y_bot + δ_y / 2 < p.1.im ∧ p.2 ∈ U_T } ∧
         (∀ Y T : ℂ, (Y, T) ∈ W_steep →
           ∀ τ : ℝ, y_bot + δ_y ≤ τ → τ ≤ Y.im →
             ((Y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, T) ∈ W_steep) ∧
         ∀ (N₀ : ℕ) (S_low : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_low n) B_init) →
           (∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
             (Y, T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ B_init →
             SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y T) →
           (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ B_init →
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_low S_star Filter.atTop K) →
           ∃ (N_st : ℕ) (S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
             N₀ ≤ N_st ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_steep) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep,
               expBasePt seq n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * S_ext n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
             (∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p.1.im < y_top - δ_y →
               S_ext n p = S_low n p) ∧
             TendstoUniformlyOn S_ext S_star Filter.atTop K_steep)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hX
  intro V_mod S_star σ η T_max U_T x_lo x_hi y_bot y_top K_steep
    hMod hσ hη hT_max hUT_open hUT_sub hx hy
    B_init y_mid δ_y hB_sub hK_comp hK_sub hRays
  by_cases hK_ne : K_steep.Nonempty
  swap
  · have hK_eq : K_steep = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hK_ne
    refine ⟨∅, isOpen_empty, by simp [hK_eq], Set.empty_subset _, Set.empty_subset _,
      fun _ _ h => False.elim h, fun N₀ S_low _ _ _ => ⟨N₀, S_low, le_rfl,
        fun _ _ => differentiableOn_empty,
        fun _ _ _ h => False.elim h,
        fun _ _ _ h _ => False.elim h,
        by rw [hK_eq]; exact tendstoUniformlyOn_empty⟩⟩
  have hδ_y_pos : 0 < δ_y := by
    change 0 < (y_top - y_bot) / 4
    linarith
  have hy_mid_eq : y_mid = y_bot + 2 * δ_y := by
    change (y_bot + y_top) / 2 = y_bot + 2 * ((y_top - y_bot) / 4)
    ring
  have hy_top_eq : y_top = y_bot + 4 * δ_y := by
    change y_top = y_bot + 4 * ((y_top - y_bot) / 4)
    ring
  let y_cut : ℝ := y_top - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y
  have hy_cut_eq : y_cut = y_mid + (5 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y := by
    dsimp only [y_cut]
    rw [hy_top_eq, hy_mid_eq]
    ring
  have hσ_abs : |σ| = 1 := by
    rcases hσ with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hσ_norm : ‖(σ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, hσ_abs]
  have h_T_props : ∀ T ∈ U_T, η < σ * T.im ∧ ‖T‖ < T_max ∧ T ≠ 0 := by
    intro T hT
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hUT_sub hT
    refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Complex.zero_im, mul_zero] at h1
    linarith
  have h_rect_comp : ∀ a b c d : ℝ,
      IsCompact { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ b ∧ c ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ d } := by
    intro a b c d
    let φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun u => (u.1 : ℂ) + (u.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ := by fun_prop
    have h_eq : { z : ℂ | a ≤ z.re ∧ z.re ≤ b ∧ c ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ d } =
        φ '' (Set.Icc a b ×ˢ Set.Icc c d) := by
      ext z
