        ‖S_low n (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)‖ < ε ∧
        ‖(S_low n (Y, T) - S_low n (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < ε ∧
        ‖(S_low n (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_low n (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) - J_star‖ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    let δ_u : ℝ := min (ε / 2) ((ε / 3) * ρ_pad)
    have hδ_u_pos : 0 < δ_u := lt_min (half_pos hε) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N_u, hN_u⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp
        (hSlow_conv K_outer hK_outer_comp hK_outer_sub_B) δ_u hδ_u_pos)
    let B_req : ℝ := max 1 (max (T_max / ρ_pad) (max (T_max / a_max) (3 * C_EL * T_max / ε)))
    obtain ⟨N_b, hN_b⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.b_tendsto) B_req
    refine ⟨max N₀ (max N_u N_b), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro n hn p ⟨hY_core, hT_KT⟩
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_u : N_u ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn_b : N_b ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    dsimp only
    set Y : ℂ := p.1
    set T : ℂ := p.2
    set b_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
    have hb_ge : B_req ≤ b_n := hN_b n hn_b
    have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
    obtain ⟨_, hT_norm, hT_ne⟩ := h_T_props T (hK_T_sub hT_KT)
    set a_n : ℂ := T / (b_n : ℂ)
    have ha_norm : ‖a_n‖ = ‖T‖ / b_n := by
      dsimp [a_n]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hb_pos]
    have ha_pos : 0 < ‖a_n‖ := by
      rw [ha_norm]
      exact div_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hT_ne) hb_pos
    have hσa_norm : ‖(σ : ℂ) * a_n‖ = ‖a_n‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, hσ_norm, one_mul]
    have hσa_pos : 0 < ‖(σ : ℂ) * a_n‖ := by rwa [hσa_norm]
    have ha_lt_pad : ‖a_n‖ < ρ_pad := by
      rw [ha_norm, div_lt_iff₀ hb_pos]
      have h1 : T_max / ρ_pad ≤ b_n :=
        le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hb_ge
      have h2 := (div_le_iff₀ hρ_pad_pos).mp h1
      linarith
    have ha_lt_amax : ‖a_n‖ < a_max := by
      rw [ha_norm, div_lt_iff₀ hb_pos]
      have h1 : T_max / a_max ≤ b_n :=
        le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hb_ge
      have h2 := (div_le_iff₀ ha_max_pos).mp h1
      linarith
    have ha_EL_lt : C_EL * ‖a_n‖ < ε / 3 := by
      rw [ha_norm, mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ hb_pos]
      have h1 : 3 * C_EL * T_max / ε ≤ b_n :=
        le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hb_ge
      have h2 := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp h1
      have h3 : C_EL * ‖T‖ < C_EL * T_max := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hT_norm hC_EL_pos
      linarith
    
    have h_Z_outer : ∀ Z : ℂ, ‖Z - Y‖ ≤ 2 * ρ_pad → Z ∈ R_outer := by
      intro Z hZ
      obtain ⟨hY1, hY2, hY3, hY4⟩ := hY_core
      have hre := le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Z - Y)) hZ
      have him := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (Z - Y)) hZ
      rw [Complex.sub_re, abs_le] at hre
      rw [Complex.sub_im, abs_le] at him
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by dsimp [y_cut] at hY4; linarith⟩
    have hYT_out : (Y, T) ∈ K_outer := ⟨h_Z_outer Y (by simp; positivity), hT_KT⟩
    have hY_sub_a_out : (Y - a_n, T) ∈ K_outer :=
      ⟨h_Z_outer (Y - a_n) (by simpa using le_trans ha_lt_pad.le (by linarith)), hT_KT⟩
    have hY_add_a_out : (Y + a_n, T) ∈ K_outer :=
      ⟨h_Z_outer (Y + a_n) (by simpa using le_trans ha_lt_pad.le (by linarith)), hT_KT⟩
    have hY_sub_σa_out : (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) ∈ K_outer :=
      ⟨h_Z_outer (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)
        (by rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, hσa_norm]; linarith), hT_KT⟩
    have hY_add_σa_out : (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) ∈ K_outer :=
      ⟨h_Z_outer (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n)
        (by rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hσa_norm]; linarith), hT_KT⟩
    have h_val_err : ∀ q ∈ K_outer, ‖S_low n q - S_star q‖ < δ_u := by
      intro q hq
      have hd := hN_u n hn_u q hq
      rwa [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hd
    have hδ_u_lt_ε : δ_u < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hε)
    
    let U_rect : Set ℂ :=
      { Z : ℂ | x_lo < Z.re ∧ Z.re < x_hi ∧ y_bot < Z.im ∧ Z.im < y_top }
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => S_low n (Z, T) - S_star (Z, T)
    have h_maps_U : Set.MapsTo (fun Z : ℂ => (Z, T)) U_rect B_init :=
      fun Z ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, hK_T_sub hT_KT⟩
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g U_rect := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Z : ℂ => S_low n (Z, T)) U_rect :=
        (hSlow_holo n hn₀).comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const T)) h_maps_U
      have h2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun Z : ℂ => S_star (Z, T)) U_rect :=
        hMod.2.1.comp (differentiableOn_id.prodMk (differentiableOn_const T))
          (fun Z hZ => hB_sub (h_maps_U hZ))
      exact h1.sub h2
    have h_cb_sub : ∀ W ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad, Metric.closedBall W ρ_pad ⊆ R_outer := by
      intro W hW Z hZ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hW
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hZ
      apply h_Z_outer Z
      have htri : ‖Z - Y‖ ≤ ‖Z - W‖ + ‖W - Y‖ := by
        calc ‖Z - Y‖ = ‖(Z - W) + (W - Y)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖Z - W‖ + ‖W - Y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      linarith
    have hR_outer_sub_U : R_outer ⊆ U_rect :=
      fun Z ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_deriv_g : ∀ W ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad, ‖deriv g W‖ ≤ ε / 3 := by
      intro W hW
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Metric.ball W ρ_pad) :=
        hg_holo.diffContOnCl_ball (fun Z hZ => hR_outer_sub_U (h_cb_sub W hW hZ))
      have h_sph : ∀ Z ∈ Metric.sphere W ρ_pad, ‖g Z‖ ≤ (ε / 3) * ρ_pad := by
        intro Z hZ
        have hZ_out : (Z, T) ∈ K_outer :=
          ⟨h_cb_sub W hW (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hZ), hT_KT⟩
        exact le_trans (h_val_err (Z, T) hZ_out).le (min_le_right _ _)
      have h_le := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρ_pad_pos hdc h_sph
      have h_simp : (ε / 3) * ρ_pad / ρ_pad = ε / 3 :=
        mul_div_cancel_right₀ (ε / 3) hρ_pad_pos.ne'
      rwa [h_simp] at h_le
    have hg_diffAt : ∀ W ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad, DifferentiableAt ℂ g W := by
      intro W hW
      have hW_U : W ∈ U_rect :=
        hR_outer_sub_U (h_cb_sub W hW (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pad_pos.le))
      have hU_open : IsOpen U_rect :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
          ((isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_re continuous_const).inter
            ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
              (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)))
      exact (hg_holo W hW_U).differentiableAt (hU_open.mem_nhds hW_U)
    have h_mvt := fun z₁ z₂ (hz₁ : z₁ ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad) (hz₂ : z₂ ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad) =>
      (convex_ball Y ρ_pad).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hg_diffAt h_deriv_g hz₂ hz₁
    have hY_ball : Y ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_pad_pos
    have hY_sub_ball : Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, hσa_norm]
      exact ha_lt_pad
    have hY_add_ball : Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n ∈ Metric.ball Y ρ_pad := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hσa_norm]
      exact ha_lt_pad
    have hEL_p := hEL_diff p (Or.inl ⟨hY_core, hT_KT⟩) ((σ : ℂ) * a_n)
      hσa_pos (by rw [hσa_norm]; exact ha_lt_amax.le)
    
    have h_dd_prev :
        ‖(S_low n (Y, T) - S_low n (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
          deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ < ε := by
      have h_split :
          (S_low n (Y, T) - S_low n (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
            deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y =
          (g Y - g (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) +
            ((S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y) := by
        dsimp [g]; ring
      rw [h_split]
      have h1 : ‖(g Y - g (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n)‖ ≤ ε / 3 := by
        rw [norm_div, div_le_iff₀ hσa_pos]
        have hm := h_mvt Y (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) hY_ball hY_sub_ball
        have heq : Y - (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n) = (σ : ℂ) * a_n := by ring
        rwa [heq] at hm
      have h2 : ‖(S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
          deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a_n‖ := by
        have h_el := hEL_p.2.2.2.2.1
        rwa [hσa_norm] at h_el
      calc _ ≤ ‖(g Y - g (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n)‖ +
            ‖(S_star (Y, T) - S_star (Y - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < ε := by linarith
    have h_dd_curr :
        ‖(S_low n (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_low n (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
          deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ < ε := by
      have h_split :
          (S_low n (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_low n (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
            deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y =
          (g (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - g Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) +
            ((S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y) := by
        dsimp [g]; ring
      rw [h_split]
      have h1 : ‖(g (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - g Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n)‖ ≤ ε / 3 := by
        rw [norm_div, div_le_iff₀ hσa_pos]
        have hm := h_mvt (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) Y hY_add_ball hY_ball
        have heq : Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n - Y = (σ : ℂ) * a_n := by ring
        rwa [heq] at hm
      have h2 : ‖(S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
          deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ ≤ C_EL * ‖a_n‖ := by
        have h_el := hEL_p.2.2.2.2.2
        rwa [hσa_norm] at h_el
      calc _ ≤ ‖(g (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n) - g Y) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n)‖ +
            ‖(S_star (Y + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T) - S_star (Y, T)) / ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
              deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', T)) Y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < ε := by linarith
    exact ⟨hK_outer_sub_B hYT_out, hK_outer_sub_B hY_sub_a_out, hK_outer_sub_B hY_add_a_out,
      hK_outer_sub_B hY_sub_σa_out, hK_outer_sub_B hY_add_σa_out,
      lt_trans (h_val_err _ hYT_out) hδ_u_lt_ε,
      lt_trans (h_val_err _ hY_sub_σa_out) hδ_u_lt_ε,
      lt_trans (h_val_err _ hY_add_σa_out) hδ_u_lt_ε,
      h_dd_prev, h_dd_curr⟩
  
  obtain ⟨N_r, _, hN_r⟩ := h_jet_approx (r_init / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨N_B, hN_B⟩ := (Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp seq.b_tendsto) B_min
  let N_st : ℕ := max (max N_strip N_r) (max N_eng N_B)
  have hN₀_le_st : N₀ ≤ N_st :=
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
  
  have hR_core_seg : ∀ (Y_start δ : ℂ) (d m : ℕ),
      m ≤ d → Y_start ∈ R_core → Y_start + (d : ℂ) * δ ∈ R_core →
      Y_start + (m : ℂ) * δ ∈ R_core := by
    intro Y_start δ d m hmd h0 hd
    by_cases hd0 : d = 0
    · subst hd0
      have hm0 : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hmd
      subst hm0
      simpa using h0
    · have hd_pos : 0 < (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0)
      let θ : ℝ := (m : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)
      have hθ_0 : 0 ≤ θ := div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) hd_pos.le
      have h1_θ : 0 ≤ 1 - θ := by
        have : θ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hd_pos).mpr (Nat.cast_le.mpr hmd)
        linarith
      set Z_d : ℂ := Y_start + (d : ℂ) * δ
      have h_comb : Y_start + (m : ℂ) * δ =
          ((1 - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Y_start + (θ : ℂ) * Z_d := by
        have hmul : θ * (d : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) := div_mul_cancel₀ (m : ℝ) hd_pos.ne'
        have hmul_c : (θ : ℂ) * (d : ℂ) = (m : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hmul
        calc Y_start + (m : ℂ) * δ = Y_start + ((θ : ℂ) * (d : ℂ)) * δ := by rw [hmul_c]
          _ = ((1 - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Y_start + (θ : ℂ) * Z_d := by
              dsimp [Z_d]; push_cast; ring
      rw [h_comb]
      obtain ⟨h0_1, h0_2, h0_3, h0_4⟩ := h0
      obtain ⟨hd_1, hd_2, hd_3, hd_4⟩ := hd
      have hc1 := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0_1 h1_θ)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_1 hθ_0)
      have hc2 := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0_2 h1_θ)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_2 hθ_0)
      have hc3 := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0_3 h1_θ)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_3 hθ_0)
      have hc4 := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0_4 h1_θ)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_4 hθ_0)
      have hre_eq : (((1 - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Y_start + (θ : ℂ) * Z_d).re =
          (1 - θ) * Y_start.re + θ * Z_d.re := by simp
      have him_eq : (((1 - θ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Y_start + (θ : ℂ) * Z_d).im =
          (1 - θ) * Y_start.im + θ * Z_d.im := by simp
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hre_eq]
        calc x_lo + c_x = (1 - θ) * (x_lo + c_x) + θ * (x_lo + c_x) := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 - θ) * Y_start.re + θ * Z_d.re := hc1
      · rw [hre_eq]
        calc (1 - θ) * Y_start.re + θ * Z_d.re
            ≤ (1 - θ) * (x_hi - c_x) + θ * (x_hi - c_x) := hc2
          _ = x_hi - c_x := by ring
      · rw [him_eq]
        calc y_bot + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y
            = (1 - θ) * (y_bot + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y) + θ * (y_bot + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_y) := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 - θ) * Y_start.im + θ * Z_d.im := hc3
      · rw [him_eq]
        calc (1 - θ) * Y_start.im + θ * Z_d.im
            ≤ (1 - θ) * y_cut + θ * y_cut := hc4
          _ = y_cut := by ring
  
  have h_slab_prom : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ (Y_start T : ℂ) (d : ℕ),
      T ∈ K_T →
      let a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
      Y_start ∈ R_core →
      Y_start + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n ∈ R_core →
      rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n d Y_start T
        (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
          (S_low n (Y_start - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T))
          (S_low n (Y_start, T)) T) =
      rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
        (S_low n (Y_start + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T))
        (S_low n (Y_start + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) T := by
    intro n hn Y_start T d hT_KT
    dsimp only
    set a_n : ℂ := T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    intro hY0 hYd
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₀_le_st hn
    have hn_r : N_r ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    obtain ⟨_, hT_norm, hT_ne⟩ := h_T_props T (hK_T_sub hT_KT)
    have h_ind : ∀ m ≤ d,
        rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m Y_start T
          (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
            (S_low n (Y_start - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T))
            (S_low n (Y_start, T)) T) =
        rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
          (S_low n (Y_start + (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T))
          (S_low n (Y_start + (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) T := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro _
        simp [rctRunCorridorChain]
      | succ m ih =>
        intro hm_succ
        have hm_le : m ≤ d := Nat.le_of_succ_le hm_succ
        have hYm_core : Y_start + (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n ∈ R_core := by
          simpa [mul_assoc] using hR_core_seg Y_start ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) d m hm_le hY0
            (by simpa [mul_assoc] using hYd)
        set Y_m : ℂ := Y_start + (m : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n
        obtain ⟨hB0, hB_sub_a, hB_add_a, _, _, he0, he_prev, he_curr, hd_prev, hd_curr⟩ :=
          hN_r n hn_r (Y_m, T) ⟨hYm_core, hT_KT⟩
        have h_rec : SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T)) n Y_m T :=
          hSlow_rec n hn₀ Y_m T hT_ne hB0 hB_sub_a hB_add_a
        have hYm_U : (Y_m, T) ∈ U_corr := hK_corr_sub_U (Or.inl ⟨hYm_core, hT_KT⟩)
        have h_step := hStep_rec n hn_eng Y_m T (fun Z => S_low n (Z, T))
          hYm_U hT_ne hT_norm.le h_rec
          (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        calc rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (m + 1) Y_start T _
            = Ψ n (Y_m, T) (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n m Y_start T _) := rfl
          _ = Ψ n (Y_m, T)
                (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
                  (S_low n (Y_m - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_low n (Y_m, T)) T) := by
              rw [ih hm_le]
          _ = rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
                (S_low n (Y_m, T)) (S_low n (Y_m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n, T)) T := h_step
          _ = _ := by
              have h_next : Y_start + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n =
                  Y_m + (σ : ℂ) * a_n := by
                dsimp [Y_m]; push_cast; ring
              rw [h_next, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact h_ind d le_rfl
  
  let k_fn : ℕ → K_high → ℕ := fun n q => ⌊(seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) * s_c q⌋₊
  let Y0_fn : ℕ → K_high → (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ := fun n q p =>
    p.1 - (k_fn n q : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * (p.2 / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ))
  let g_chain : ℕ → K_high → (ℂ × ℂ) → ℂ := fun n q p =>
    let a_n : ℂ := p.2 / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    (rctRunCorridorChain seq Ψ σ n (k_fn n q) (Y0_fn n q p) p.2
      (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, p.2))
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p, p.2))
        p.2)).1
  have h_init_fst : ∀ n S_prev S_curr T,
      (rctInitSymplecticState P seq n σ S_prev S_curr T).1 = S_curr := by
    intro n S_prev S_curr T
    unfold rctInitSymplecticState
    dsimp only
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  
  have h_ov1 : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q ∈ F_balls, ∀ p ∈ B_q q, p ∈ W_low →
      g_chain n q p = S_low n p := by
    intro n hn q _ p hpB hpLow
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    obtain ⟨hpT_KT, hY0_core, _⟩ := h_ball_props q (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) (hN_B n hn_B) p hpB
    have hp_core : p.1 ∈ R_core := (hW_low_sub_core hpLow).1
    set a_n : ℂ := p.2 / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have h_end_eq : Y0_fn n q p + (k_fn n q : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n = p.1 := by
      dsimp [Y0_fn, a_n]; ring
    have h_prom := h_slab_prom n hn (Y0_fn n q p) p.2 (k_fn n q) hpT_KT hY0_core
      (by rwa [h_end_eq])
    dsimp [g_chain]
    rw [h_prom, h_init_fst, h_end_eq]
  
  have h_ov2_le : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q₁ ∈ F_balls, ∀ q₂ ∈ F_balls,
      k_fn n q₁ ≤ k_fn n q₂ → ∀ p ∈ B_q q₁, p ∈ B_q q₂ →
      g_chain n q₂ p = g_chain n q₁ p := by
    intro n hn q₁ _ q₂ _ hkle p hp1 hp2
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    obtain ⟨hpT_KT, hY0_1, _⟩ := h_ball_props q₁ (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) (hN_B n hn_B) p hp1
    obtain ⟨_, hY0_2, _⟩ := h_ball_props q₂ (seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n) (hN_B n hn_B) p hp2
    obtain ⟨d, hd_eq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hkle
    have hk2_eq : k_fn n q₂ = d + k_fn n q₁ := by omega
    set a_n : ℂ := p.2 / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have h_shift_Y0 : Y0_fn n q₂ p + (d : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n = Y0_fn n q₁ p := by
      dsimp [Y0_fn, a_n]
      rw [hk2_eq]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_prom := h_slab_prom n hn (Y0_fn n q₂ p) p.2 d hpT_KT hY0_2
      (by rwa [h_shift_Y0])
    dsimp [g_chain]
    rw [hk2_eq, hChain_add n d (k_fn n q₁) (Y0_fn n q₂ p) p.2 _, h_prom, h_shift_Y0]
  have h_ov2 : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q₁ ∈ F_balls, ∀ q₂ ∈ F_balls,
      ∀ p ∈ B_q q₁, p ∈ B_q q₂ → g_chain n q₁ p = g_chain n q₂ p := by
    intro n hn q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ p hp1 hp2
    rcases le_total (k_fn n q₁) (k_fn n q₂) with hle | hle
    · exact (h_ov2_le n hn q₁ hq₁ q₂ hq₂ hle p hp1 hp2).symm
    · exact h_ov2_le n hn q₂ hq₂ q₁ hq₁ hle p hp2 hp1
  
  have hg_holo_ball : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q ∈ F_balls,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_chain n q) (B_q q) := by
    intro n hn q hqF
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₀_le_st hn
    have hn_r : N_r ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    set b_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
    have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
    have hk_ratio : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ L_max := by
      have hk_le : (k_fn n q : ℝ) ≤ b_n * s_c q :=
        Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hb_pos.le (hs_c_nonneg q))
      have hdiv : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ s_c q := (div_le_iff₀ hb_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      have hsc_le : s_c q ≤ ∑ i ∈ F_balls, s_c i :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hs_c_nonneg i) hqF
      dsimp [L_max]
      linarith
    have hY0_diff : Differentiable ℂ (Y0_fn n q) := by
      dsimp [Y0_fn]
      fun_prop
    have ha_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => w.2 / (b_n : ℂ)) := by fun_prop
    let S_prev_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      S_low n (Y0_fn n q w - (σ : ℂ) * (w.2 / (b_n : ℂ)), w.2)
    let S_curr_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w =>
      S_low n (Y0_fn n q w, w.2)
    have h_w_core : ∀ w ∈ B_q q, (Y0_fn n q w, w.2) ∈ K_core := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hw_KT, hw_Y0, _⟩ := h_ball_props q b_n (hN_B n hn_B) w hw
      exact ⟨hw_Y0, hw_KT⟩
    have hS_prev_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_prev_fn (B_q q) := by
      refine (hSlow_holo n hn₀).comp
        (((hY0_diff.sub (ha_diff.const_mul (σ : ℂ))).differentiableOn).prodMk
          differentiable_snd.differentiableOn) ?_
      intro w hw
      exact (hN_r n hn_r _ (h_w_core w hw)).2.2.2.1
    have hS_curr_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_curr_fn (B_q q) := by
      refine (hSlow_holo n hn₀).comp
        (hY0_diff.differentiableOn.prodMk differentiable_snd.differentiableOn) ?_
      intro w hw
      exact (hN_r n hn_r _ (h_w_core w hw)).1
    refine hChain_holo n hn_eng (k_fn n q) hk_ratio (B_q q)
      (Y0_fn n q) Prod.snd S_prev_fn S_curr_fn (hB_q_open q)
      hY0_diff.differentiableOn differentiable_snd.differentiableOn
      hS_prev_holo hS_curr_holo ?_ (k_fn n q) le_rfl
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hw_KT, _, hw_steps⟩ := h_ball_props q b_n (hN_B n hn_B) w hw
    obtain ⟨_, hw_T_norm, hw_T_ne⟩ := h_T_props w.2 (hK_T_sub hw_KT)
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, he0, _, _, hd_prev, _⟩ := hN_r n hn_r _ (h_w_core w hw)
    refine ⟨hw_T_ne, hw_T_norm.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      exact hK_corr_sub_U (hw_steps k hk)
    · dsimp [S_curr_fn, S_prev_fn]
      linarith
  
  let S_ext : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun n p =>
    @dite _ (p ∈ W_low) (Classical.propDecidable _)
      (fun _ => S_low n p)
      (fun _ =>
        @dite _ (∃ q : K_high, q ∈ F_balls ∧ p ∈ B_q q) (Classical.propDecidable _)
          (fun h => g_chain n (Classical.choose h) p)
          (fun _ => S_low n p))
  have hS_ext_on_low : ∀ n, ∀ p ∈ W_low, S_ext n p = S_low n p := by
    intro n p hp
    simp only [S_ext, hp, ↓reduceDIte]
  have hS_ext_on_ball : ∀ n ≥ N_st, ∀ q ∈ F_balls, ∀ p ∈ B_q q,
      S_ext n p = g_chain n q p := by
    intro n hn q hqF p hpB
    dsimp only [S_ext]
    split_ifs with hpLow hEx
    · exact (h_ov1 n hn q hqF p hpB hpLow).symm
    · obtain ⟨h_ch_F, h_ch_B⟩ := Classical.choose_spec hEx
      exact h_ov2 n hn _ h_ch_F q hqF p h_ch_B hpB
    · exact False.elim (hEx ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩)
  have hW_cover : ∀ p ∈ W_steep, p ∈ W_low ∨ ∃ q : K_high, q ∈ F_balls ∧ p ∈ B_q q := by
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpLow : p ∈ W_low
    · exact Or.inl hpLow
    · have hp_high := hW_diff_sub_high p hp hpLow
      have hp_cov := hF_balls_cov hp_high
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hp_cov
      obtain ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩ := hp_cov
      exact Or.inr ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩
  refine ⟨N_st, S_ext, hN₀_le_st, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro n hn p hp
    have hn₀ : N₀ ≤ n := le_trans hN₀_le_st hn
    rcases hW_cover p hp with hpLow | ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩
    · have h_on_low : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) W_low :=
        ((hSlow_holo n hn₀).mono (fun z hz => hK_core_sub_B (hW_low_sub_core hz))).congr
          (fun z hz => hS_ext_on_low n z hz)
      exact ((h_on_low p hpLow).differentiableAt (hW_low_open.mem_nhds hpLow)).differentiableWithinAt
    · have h_on_ball : DifferentiableOn ℂ (S_ext n) (B_q q) :=
        (hg_holo_ball n hn q hqF).congr (fun z hz => hS_ext_on_ball n hn q hqF z hz)
      exact ((h_on_ball p hpB).differentiableAt ((hB_q_open q).mem_nhds hpB)).differentiableWithinAt
  · 
    intro n hn p hp
    have hn_strip : N_strip ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn_r : N_r ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    rcases hW_cover p hp with hpLow | ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩
    · rw [hS_ext_on_low n p hpLow]
      exact h_strip_core n hn_strip p (hW_low_sub_core hpLow)
    · rw [hS_ext_on_ball n hn q hqF p hpB]
      set b_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
      have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
      have hk_ratio : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ L_max := by
        have hk_le : (k_fn n q : ℝ) ≤ b_n * s_c q :=
          Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hb_pos.le (hs_c_nonneg q))
        have hdiv : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ s_c q := (div_le_iff₀ hb_pos).mpr (by linarith)
        have hsc_le : s_c q ≤ ∑ i ∈ F_balls, s_c i :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hs_c_nonneg i) hqF
        dsimp [L_max]; linarith
      obtain ⟨hpT_KT, hY0_core, hp_steps⟩ := h_ball_props q b_n (hN_B n hn_B) p hpB
      obtain ⟨_, hpT_norm, hpT_ne⟩ := h_T_props p.2 (hK_T_sub hpT_KT)
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, he0, _, _, hd_prev, _⟩ :=
        hN_r n hn_r (Y0_fn n q p, p.2) ⟨hY0_core, hpT_KT⟩
      exact (hChain_gron n hn_eng (k_fn n q) hk_ratio (Y0_fn n q p) p.2
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p - (σ : ℂ) * (p.2 / (b_n : ℂ)), p.2))
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p, p.2))
        hpT_ne hpT_norm.le (fun k hk => hK_corr_sub_U (hp_steps k hk))
        (by linarith) (k_fn n q) le_rfl).2
  · 
    intro n _ p hp h_im
    apply hS_ext_on_low n p
    exact ⟨hp, by dsimp [y_cut]; linarith⟩
  · 
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N_c1, hN_c1⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hUnif_core ε hε)
    let ε_jet : ℝ := min (r_init / 4) (ε / (4 * C_Gron))
    have hε_jet_pos : 0 < ε_jet := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N_c2, _, hN_c2⟩ := h_jet_approx ε_jet hε_jet_pos
    obtain ⟨N_c3, hN_c3⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hδ_mod_tendsto) (ε / (2 * C_Gron)) (by positivity))
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max N_st (max N_c1 (max N_c2 N_c3)), ?_⟩
    intro n hn p hpK
    have hn_st : N_st ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
    have hn_c1 : N_c1 ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn
    have hn_c2 : N_c2 ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn
    have hn_c3 : N_c3 ≤ n :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hn
    have hn_eng : N_eng ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn_st
    have hn_B : N_B ≤ n := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hn_st
    rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
    rcases hW_cover p (hS_cov hpK) with hpLow | ⟨q, hqF, hpB⟩
    · rw [hS_ext_on_low n p hpLow]
      have hd := hN_c1 n hn_c1 p (hW_low_sub_core hpLow)
      rwa [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hd
    · rw [hS_ext_on_ball n hn_st q hqF p hpB]
      set b_n : ℝ := seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
      have hb_pos : 0 < b_n := mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
      have hk_ratio : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ L_max := by
        have hk_le : (k_fn n q : ℝ) ≤ b_n * s_c q :=
          Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hb_pos.le (hs_c_nonneg q))
        have hdiv : (k_fn n q : ℝ) / b_n ≤ s_c q := (div_le_iff₀ hb_pos).mpr (by linarith)
        have hsc_le : s_c q ≤ ∑ i ∈ F_balls, s_c i :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hs_c_nonneg i) hqF
        dsimp [L_max]; linarith
      obtain ⟨hpT_KT, hY0_core, hp_steps⟩ := h_ball_props q b_n (hN_B n hn_B) p hpB
      obtain ⟨_, hpT_norm, hpT_ne⟩ := h_T_props p.2 (hK_T_sub hpT_KT)
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, he0, _, _, hd_prev, _⟩ :=
        hN_c2 n hn_c2 (Y0_fn n q p, p.2) ⟨hY0_core, hpT_KT⟩
      have hε_jet_r : ε_jet ≤ r_init / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      have hε_jet_g : ε_jet ≤ ε / (4 * C_Gron) := min_le_right _ _
      set a_n : ℂ := p.2 / (b_n : ℂ)
      set e_init : ℝ :=
        ‖S_low n (Y0_fn n q p, p.2) - S_star (Y0_fn n q p, p.2)‖ +
          ‖(S_low n (Y0_fn n q p, p.2) - S_low n (Y0_fn n q p - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, p.2)) /
              ((σ : ℂ) * a_n) -
            deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) (Y0_fn n q p)‖
      have he_lt_r : e_init < r_init := by
        dsimp only [e_init]
        dsimp only at he0 hd_prev
        linarith
      have he_lt_ε : e_init < ε / (2 * C_Gron) := by
        have h_half : ε / (4 * C_Gron) + ε / (4 * C_Gron) = ε / (2 * C_Gron) := by
          field_simp [hC_Gron_pos.ne']; ring
        dsimp only [e_init]
        dsimp only at he0 hd_prev
        linarith
      have h_gron := (hChain_gron n hn_eng (k_fn n q) hk_ratio (Y0_fn n q p) p.2
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p - (σ : ℂ) * a_n, p.2))
        (S_low n (Y0_fn n q p, p.2))
        hpT_ne hpT_norm.le (fun k hk => hK_corr_sub_U (hp_steps k hk))
        he_lt_r (k_fn n q) le_rfl).1
      have h_end_eq : (Y0_fn n q p + (k_fn n q : ℂ) * (σ : ℂ) * a_n, p.2) = p := by
        ext <;> [ (dsimp [Y0_fn, a_n]; ring) ; rfl ]
      rw [h_end_eq] at h_gron
      have hδ_lt : δ_mod n < ε / (2 * C_Gron) := by
        have hd := hN_c3 n hn_c3
        rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hd
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hd
      have h_sum_lt : e_init + δ_mod n < ε / C_Gron := by
        have : ε / (2 * C_Gron) + ε / (2 * C_Gron) = ε / C_Gron := by
          field_simp [hC_Gron_pos.ne']; ring
        linarith
      have h_mul_lt : C_Gron * (e_init + δ_mod n) < ε := by
        have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_sum_lt hC_Gron_pos
        rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ ε hC_Gron_pos.ne'] at hm
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_gron h_mul_lt

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S)
    (β a C_N C₁ : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβhalf : β < 1 / 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hCN : 1 ≤ C_N) (hC1 : 0 < C₁)
    (D : BootConeNegativePartData S β a C_N C₁) :
    ∃ C_quad C_p : ℝ, 0 < C_quad ∧ 0 < C_p ∧
      (∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
        ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
          rowMomentFull S k ≤ C_quad * N k ∧
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.exp (-k) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im|) ≤
            C_quad * (N k) ^ 2 ∧
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2) ^
              ((4 * a + 3) / (4 * a + 2))) ≤ C_p) ∧
      (∀ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → ∃ C_tile : ℝ, 0 < C_tile ∧
        ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
          ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
            Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤ C_tile * N k)

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)

      rintro r ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact hRatio_improved k (Set.mem_Ici.mp hk)
    have hCstar_sq_fp : C_star ^ 2 ≤ K₁ + K₂ * (1 + C_star) ^ m := by
      have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hCstar_nonneg hCstar_le_M 2
      rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hM_rhs_sq_nonneg] at hsq
    have hYoung_fp : K₂ * (1 + C_star) ^ m ≤
        1 / 2 + (1 / 2) * C_star ^ 2 + K₂ * (4 * K₂) ^ (m / (2 - m)) := by
      have hw1 : 0 ≤ m / 2 := by linarith
      have hw2 : 0 ≤ 1 - m / 2 := by linarith
      have h4K : 0 < 4 * K₂ := by positivity
      let p₁ : ℝ := (4 * K₂)⁻¹ * (1 + C_star) ^ 2
      let p₂ : ℝ := (4 * K₂) ^ (m / (2 - m))
      have hp₁ : 0 ≤ p₁ := by positivity
      have hp₂ : 0 ≤ p₂ := Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt h4K) _
      have hgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted hw1 hw2 hp₁ hp₂
        (by ring : m / 2 + (1 - m / 2) = 1)
      have hlhs : p₁ ^ (m / 2) * p₂ ^ (1 - m / 2) = (1 + C_star) ^ m := by
        dsimp [p₁, p₂]
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (sq_nonneg _), Real.inv_rpow (le_of_lt h4K),
          ← Real.rpow_two (1 + C_star), ← Real.rpow_mul (by linarith),
          ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h4K),
          show (2 : ℝ) * (m / 2) = m by ring,
          show m / (2 - m) * (1 - m / 2) = m / 2 by
            have : 2 - m ≠ 0 := by linarith
            field_simp]
        have hpos : (4 * K₂) ^ (m / 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h4K _)
        calc ((4 * K₂) ^ (m / 2))⁻¹ * (1 + C_star) ^ m * (4 * K₂) ^ (m / 2)
            = (((4 * K₂) ^ (m / 2))⁻¹ * (4 * K₂) ^ (m / 2)) * (1 + C_star) ^ m := by ring
          _ = (1 + C_star) ^ m := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos, one_mul]
      have hrhs : (m / 2) * p₁ + (1 - m / 2) * p₂ ≤ p₁ + p₂ := by nlinarith
      have h1 : (1 + C_star) ^ m ≤ p₁ + p₂ := by linarith
      have h2 : K₂ * (1 + C_star) ^ m ≤ K₂ * (p₁ + p₂) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (le_of_lt hK₂_pos)
      have h3 : K₂ * p₁ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 + C_star) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [p₁]
        have : K₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hK₂_pos
        field_simp
      have hsq : (1 + C_star) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + C_star ^ 2) := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - C_star)]
      nlinarith
    have hCstar_sq_le : C_star ^ 2 ≤ C₀ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hC₀_sq_pos)]
      dsimp [C₀_sq]
      linarith
    have hCstar_le_C0 : C_star ≤ C₀ :=
      (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hCstar_sq_le (le_of_lt hC₀_pos)).2
    intro k hk
    have hNk_nonneg : 0 ≤ N k := le_trans zero_le_one (hN.one_le k hk)
    exact le_trans (hRatio_star k hk) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCstar_le_C0 hNk_nonneg)
  
  let C_quad : ℝ := max C₀ (C_V * (1 + C₀) ^ m)
  let C_p : ℝ := C_V * (1 + C₀) ^ 2
  have hC_quad_pos : 0 < C_quad := lt_of_lt_of_le hC₀_pos (le_max_left _ _)
  have hC_p_pos : 0 < C_p := by dsimp [C_p]; positivity
  refine ⟨C_quad, C_p, hC_quad_pos, hC_p_pos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro N hN k hk
    have hNk_nonneg : 0 ≤ N k := le_trans zero_le_one (hN.one_le k hk)
    have hlin := hLinear_bound N hN k hk
    obtain ⟨hV_L1, hV_Lp⟩ :=
      hConeMom N C₀ k hN (le_of_lt hC₀_pos) (hLinear_bound N hN) hk
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hV_Lp⟩
    · exact le_trans hlin (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hNk_nonneg)
    · exact le_trans hV_L1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (sq_nonneg _))
  · intro A hA
    obtain ⟨C_t2, hC_t2_pos, hTileRows⟩ := hInt.tile_L2_from_rows A hA
    let M_scale : ℝ := C₀ * C_N * Real.exp (max β a * (A + 1))
    have hM_scale_pos : 0 < M_scale := by dsimp [M_scale]; positivity
    let C_tile_sq : ℝ := C_t2 * (1 + 2 * (A + 1) * M_scale ^ 2)
    have hC_tile_sq_pos : 0 < C_tile_sq := by dsimp [C_tile_sq]; positivity
    let C_tile : ℝ := Real.sqrt C_tile_sq
    refine ⟨C_tile, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hC_tile_sq_pos, ?_⟩
    intro N hN k hk
    have hNk_ge_one : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    have hNk_nonneg : 0 ≤ N k := le_trans zero_le_one hNk_ge_one
    have hNk_sq_ge_one : 1 ≤ (N k) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    let a_lim : ℝ := max k₀ (k - A - 1)
    let b_lim : ℝ := k + A + 1
    have ha_le_b : a_lim ≤ b_lim := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hb_sub_a : b_lim - a_lim ≤ 2 * (A + 1) := by
      have : k - A - 1 ≤ a_lim := le_max_right _ _
      dsimp [b_lim]
      linarith
    have hrow_win_pt : ∀ l ∈ Set.Icc a_lim b_lim,
        (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2 ≤ M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by
      intro l hl
      have hl_k0 : k₀ ≤ l := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hl.1
      have hl_lo : k - A - 1 ≤ l := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hl.1
      have habs : |l - k| ≤ A + 1 :=
        abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by dsimp [b_lim] at hl; linarith [hl.2], by linarith⟩
      have hNl_le : N l ≤ C_N * N k * Real.exp (max β a * (A + 1)) :=
        hEnv_window N hN (A + 1) k l (by linarith) hk hl_k0 habs
      have hrm_le : rowMomentFull S l ≤ M_scale * N k := by
        calc rowMomentFull S l
            ≤ C₀ * N l := hLinear_bound N hN l hl_k0
          _ ≤ C₀ * (C_N * N k * Real.exp (max β a * (A + 1))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNl_le (le_of_lt hC₀_pos)
          _ = M_scale * N k := by dsimp [M_scale]; ring
      calc (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2
          ≤ (M_scale * N k) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hrm_nonneg l) hrm_le 2
        _ = M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hI_rows_le : (∫ l in a_lim..b_lim, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (A + 1) * M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by
      by_cases hInt_rows :
          IntervalIntegrable (fun l => (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a_lim b_lim
      · have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on ha_le_b hInt_rows intervalIntegrable_const
          hrow_win_pt
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hmono
        have hfac : 0 ≤ M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by positivity
        calc (∫ l in a_lim..b_lim, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2)
            ≤ (b_lim - a_lim) * (M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2) := hmono
          _ ≤ (2 * (A + 1)) * (M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb_sub_a hfac
          _ = 2 * (A + 1) * M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by ring
      · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_undef hInt_rows]
        positivity
    have htile_sq : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤
        (C_tile * N k) ^ 2 := by
      have ht := hTileRows k hk
      change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤
        C_t2 * (1 + ∫ l in a_lim..b_lim, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) at ht
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2)
          ≤ C_t2 * (1 + ∫ l in a_lim..b_lim, (rowMomentFull S l) ^ 2) := ht
        _ ≤ C_t2 * ((N k) ^ 2 + 2 * (A + 1) * M_scale ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2) := by
            nlinarith [hC_t2_pos, hNk_sq_ge_one, hI_rows_le]
        _ = C_tile_sq * (N k) ^ 2 := by dsimp [C_tile_sq]; ring
        _ = C_tile ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hC_tile_sq_pos)]
        _ = (C_tile * N k) ^ 2 := by ring
    exact Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hNk_nonneg, htile_sq⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCoshId : ∀ X : ℝ,
      Real.cosh X - 1 = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp |X| * (1 - Real.exp (-|X|)) ^ 2 := by
    intro X
    rw [← Real.cosh_abs, Real.cosh_eq]
    have hexp : Real.exp |X| * Real.exp (-|X|) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
    calc
      (Real.exp |X| + Real.exp (-|X|)) / 2 - 1
        = (Real.exp |X| - 2 * (Real.exp |X| * Real.exp (-|X|)) +
            (Real.exp |X| * Real.exp (-|X|)) * Real.exp (-|X|)) / 2 := by
          rw [hexp]; ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp |X| * (1 - Real.exp (-|X|)) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hCoshGeOne : ∀ X : ℝ, 1 ≤ Real.cosh X := by
    intro X
    have h := hCoshId X
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp |X| * (1 - Real.exp (-|X|)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have hOneSubCosPos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → θ < Real.pi → 0 < 1 - Real.cos θ := by
    intro θ hθ0 hθpi
    have hsin2 : 0 < Real.sin (θ / 2) :=
      Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hc2 : Real.cos θ = 2 * Real.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by
      have := Real.cos_two_mul (θ / 2)
      rwa [show 2 * (θ / 2) = θ by ring] at this
    have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ / 2)
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hsin2
    linarith
  have hGeomSummable : ∀ C r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r < 1 →
      Summable (fun n : ℤ => C * r ^ n.natAbs) := by
    intro C r hr0 hr1
    have hg : Summable (fun k : ℕ => C * r ^ k) :=
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one hr0 hr1).mul_left C
    apply Summable.of_nat_of_neg
    · simpa only [Int.natAbs_natCast] using hg
    · simpa only [Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast] using hg
  have hTermDom : ∀ h' y U₀ : ℝ, 0 < h' → 0 < y → y < h' → 0 < U₀ →
      ∃ C_dom r : ℝ, 0 < C_dom ∧ 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n)) ∧
        (∀ u : ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-U₀) U₀, ∀ n : ℤ,
          bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n ≤ C_dom * r ^ n.natAbs) := by
    intro h' y U₀ hh' hy0 hyh _
    have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    let θ : ℝ := Real.pi * (h' - y) / h'
    have hθ0 : 0 < θ := div_pos (mul_pos hpi (by linarith)) hh'
    have hθpi : θ < Real.pi := (div_lt_iff₀ hh').mpr (by nlinarith)
    have hsinθ : 0 < Real.sin θ := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hθ0 hθpi
    have h1cos : 0 < 1 - Real.cos θ := hOneSubCosPos θ hθ0 hθpi
    have hDenLB : ∀ u : ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ,
        1 - Real.cos θ ≤
          Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / h') - Real.cos θ := by
      intro u n
      linarith [hCoshGeOne (Real.pi * (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / h')]
    have hContTerm : ∀ n : ℤ, Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n) := by
      intro n
      unfold bootStripPoissonTerm
      apply Continuous.div continuous_const
      · exact (Real.continuous_cosh.comp
          ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).div_const h')).sub
          continuous_const
      · intro u; linarith [hDenLB u n]
    have hPosTerm : ∀ u : ℝ, ∀ n : ℤ, 0 < bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n := by
      intro u n
      unfold bootStripPoissonTerm
      exact div_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)) hsinθ) (by linarith [hDenLB u n])
    let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-(Real.pi ^ 2 / h'))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.exp_pos _
    have hr_lt_one : r < 1 :=
      Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (neg_neg_of_pos (div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hpi) hh'))
    let N₀ : ℕ := Nat.ceil (U₀ / Real.pi) + 1
    let M_core : ℝ := (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin θ / (1 - Real.cos θ)
    have hM_pos : 0 < M_core :=
      div_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)) hsinθ) h1cos
    let C_tail0 : ℝ := Real.sin θ / (h' * (1 - r) ^ 2)
    have hCtail0_pos : 0 < C_tail0 :=
      div_pos hsinθ (mul_pos hh' (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)))
    let C_dom : ℝ := max (M_core * (r ^ N₀)⁻¹) C_tail0
    have hCdom_pos : 0 < C_dom := lt_of_lt_of_le hCtail0_pos (le_max_right _ _)
    refine ⟨C_dom, r, hCdom_pos, hr_pos, hr_lt_one, hContTerm, hPosTerm, ?_⟩
    intro u hu n
    have hu_abs : |u| ≤ U₀ := abs_le.mpr hu
    by_cases hn : N₀ ≤ n.natAbs
    · have hN0_pos : 1 ≤ n.natAbs := by omega
      have hU_lt : U₀ < Real.pi * (N₀ : ℝ) := by
        have hceil := (div_le_iff₀ hpi).mp (Nat.le_ceil (U₀ / Real.pi))
        have hN0_eq : (N₀ : ℝ) = (Nat.ceil (U₀ / Real.pi) : ℝ) + 1 := by
          dsimp [N₀]; push_cast; rfl
        rw [hN0_eq]; linarith
      have hn_real : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ (n.natAbs : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
      have h2pi_n : |2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)| = 2 * Real.pi * (n.natAbs : ℝ) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; simp
      have hshift_lb : Real.pi * (n.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ |u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)| := by
        have htri : |2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)| ≤ |u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)| + |u| := by
          have := abs_add_le (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) (-u)
          simpa [abs_neg] using this
        have hpi_n : Real.pi * (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi * (n.natAbs : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn_real hpi.le
        linarith
      let X : ℝ := Real.pi * (u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)) / h'
      have hX_abs : (n.natAbs : ℝ) * (Real.pi ^ 2 / h') ≤ |X| := by
        dsimp [X]
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpi, abs_of_pos hh']
        calc
          (n.natAbs : ℝ) * (Real.pi ^ 2 / h')
            = (Real.pi * (Real.pi * (n.natAbs : ℝ))) / h' := by ring
          _ ≤ (Real.pi * |u + 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ)|) / h' :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hshift_lb hpi.le) hh'.le
      have hX_abs1 : Real.pi ^ 2 / h' ≤ |X| := by
        have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n.natAbs : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hN0_pos
        have hp2 : 0 ≤ Real.pi ^ 2 / h' := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have hexp_neg : Real.exp (-|X|) ≤ r :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hX_abs1)
      have hsq_lb : (1 - r) ^ 2 ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-|X|)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 2
      have hexp_pos_pow : (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp |X| := by
        have hr_inv : (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ = Real.exp ((n.natAbs : ℝ) * (Real.pi ^ 2 / h')) := by
          dsimp [r]; rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_neg]; congr 1; ring
        rw [hr_inv]; exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hX_abs
      have hDen_tail :
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ * (1 - r) ^ 2 ≤ Real.cosh X - Real.cos θ := by
        have h1 : Real.cosh X - 1 ≤ Real.cosh X - Real.cos θ := by
          linarith [Real.cos_le_one θ]
        rw [hCoshId X] at h1
        have hprod :
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ * (1 - r) ^ 2 ≤
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp |X| * (1 - Real.exp (-|X|)) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_pos_pow (by positivity))
            hsq_lb (by positivity) (by positivity)
        linarith
      have hTerm_le : bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n ≤ C_tail0 * r ^ n.natAbs := by
        change (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin θ / (Real.cosh X - Real.cos θ) ≤ C_tail0 * r ^ n.natAbs
        have hden_pos : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ * (1 - r) ^ 2 := by positivity
        calc
          (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin θ / (Real.cosh X - Real.cos θ)
            ≤ (2 * h')⁻¹ * Real.sin θ / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (r ^ n.natAbs)⁻¹ * (1 - r) ^ 2) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hden_pos hDen_tail
          _ = C_tail0 * r ^ n.natAbs := by
              dsimp [C_tail0]
              have hr_ne : r ^ n.natAbs ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hr_pos.ne'
              have h1r_ne : (1 - r) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by linarith)
              field_simp [hh'.ne', hr_ne, h1r_ne]
      exact le_trans hTerm_le
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))
    · have hn_le : n.natAbs ≤ N₀ := le_of_not_ge hn
      have hpow : r ^ N₀ ≤ r ^ n.natAbs := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hr_pos.le hr_lt_one.le hn_le
      have hTerm_core : bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n ≤ M_core := by
        unfold bootStripPoissonTerm
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h1cos (hDenLB u n)
      have hrN_pos : 0 < r ^ N₀ := pow_pos hr_pos N₀
      have h1 : M_core ≤ (M_core * (r ^ N₀)⁻¹) * r ^ n.natAbs := by
        calc
          M_core = (M_core * (r ^ N₀)⁻¹) * r ^ N₀ := by field_simp [hrN_pos.ne']
          _ ≤ (M_core * (r ^ N₀)⁻¹) * r ^ n.natAbs :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity)
      exact le_trans (le_trans hTerm_core h1)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (pow_nonneg hr_pos.le _))
  have hContTermAll : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → 0 < y → y < h' → ∀ n : ℤ,
      Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n) := by
    intro h' y hh' hy0 hyh
    exact (hTermDom h' y 1 hh' hy0 hyh zero_lt_one).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2.2.1
  have hPosTermAll : ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → 0 < y → y < h' → ∀ n : ℤ,
      0 < bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y n := by
    intro h' y u hh' hy0 hyh
    exact (hTermDom h' y 1 hh' hy0 hyh zero_lt_one).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2.2.2.1 u
  have hSummablePt : ∀ h' y u : ℝ, 0 < h' → 0 < y → y < h' →
      Summable (bootStripPoissonTerm h' u y) := by
    intro h' y u hh' hy0 hyh
    obtain ⟨C_dom, r, _, hr0, hr1, _, hPos, hDom⟩ :=
      hTermDom h' y (|u| + 1) hh' hy0 hyh (by positivity)
    have hu_mem : u ∈ Set.Icc (-(|u| + 1)) (|u| + 1) :=
      ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le u], by linarith [le_abs_self u]⟩
    exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      (fun n => (hPos u n).le)
      (fun n => hDom u hu_mem n)
      (hGeomSummable C_dom r hr0.le hr1)
  have hCont : ∀ h' y : ℝ, 0 < h' → 0 < y → y < h' →
      Continuous (fun u : ℝ => bootStripPoissonKernel h' u y) := by
    intro h' y hh' hy0 hyh
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro u₀
    let U₀ : ℝ := |u₀| + 1
    obtain ⟨C_dom, r, _, hr0, hr1, hContTerm, hPos, hDom⟩ :=
      hTermDom h' y U₀ hh' hy0 hyh (by dsimp [U₀]; positivity)

    have hIota_mem : ∀ x y : ℝ, y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h' → ι x y ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro x y hy
      change |(ι x y).im| < S.H
      have him : (ι x y).im = y := by simp [ι]
      rw [him, abs_of_nonneg hy.1]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hy.2 hhH
    let H_diff : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => F_V s - S.V s
    have hH_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_diff U_strip :=
      hF_holo.sub (S.V_holo.mono hU_sub)
    let u_fn : ℂ → ℝ := fun s => (H_diff s).im
    let v_fn : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => (S.V (ι p.1 p.2)).im
    have hv_per : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h',
        Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => v_fn (x, y)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro y hy x
      dsimp [v_fn]
      have harg : ι (x + 2 * Real.pi) y = ι x y + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [ι]; push_cast; ring
      rw [harg, S.V_periodic (ι x y) (hIota_mem x y hy)]
    have hu_per : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y < h' →
        Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => u_fn (ι x y)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro y hy0 hyh x
      dsimp [u_fn, H_diff, ι]
      rw [hF_per x y hy0 hyh]
      have hv := hv_per y ⟨hy0.le, hyh.le⟩ x
      dsimp [v_fn, ι] at hv
      rw [hv]
    have hFloor : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ x_red ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ∃ k : ℤ, x = x_red + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x
      let k : ℤ := Int.floor (x / (2 * Real.pi))
      refine ⟨x - (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi), ?_, k, by ring⟩
      have hm1 : (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ x :=
        (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.floor_le _)
      have hm2 : x < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one _)
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    suffices hZero : u_fn (ι x₀ y₀) = 0 by
      dsimp [u_fn, H_diff, ι] at hZero
      linarith
    by_contra hne
    let ε : ℝ := |u_fn (ι x₀ y₀)| / 2
    have hε : 0 < ε := half_pos (abs_pos.mpr hne)
    let K₀ : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h'
    have hK₀_compact : IsCompact K₀ := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hv_contOn : ContinuousOn v_fn K₀ := by
      have hmap_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ι p.1 p.2) := by
        dsimp [ι]; fun_prop
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ι p.1 p.2) K₀ (horizStrip S.H) :=
        fun p hp => hIota_mem p.1 p.2 hp.2
      exact Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
        (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmaps)
    have hv_unif := hK₀_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hv_contOn
    rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at hv_unif
    obtain ⟨δ_V, hδ_V, huc_V⟩ := hv_unif (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    have hv_vert : ∀ x y₁ y₂ : ℝ, y₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h' → y₂ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h' →
        |y₁ - y₂| < δ_V → |v_fn (x, y₁) - v_fn (x, y₂)| ≤ ε / 2 := by
      intro x y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ hdy
      obtain ⟨x_red, hx_red, k, rfl⟩ := hFloor x
      have hp1 := (hv_per y₁ hy₁).int_mul k x_red
      have hp2 := (hv_per y₂ hy₂).int_mul k x_red
      dsimp [v_fn] at hp1 hp2 ⊢
      rw [hp1, hp2]
      have hd : dist (x_red, y₁) (x_red, y₂) < δ_V := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, Real.dist_eq, max_eq_right (abs_nonneg _)]
        exact hdy
      exact (huc_V (x_red, y₁) ⟨hx_red, hy₁⟩ (x_red, y₂) ⟨hx_red, hy₂⟩ hd).le
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hB₁⟩ := hBot (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hT₂⟩ := hTop (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    let η : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min (min y₀ (h' - y₀)) (min δ_V (min δ₁ δ₂))
    have hη_pos : 0 < η :=
      mul_pos (by positivity) (lt_min (lt_min hy₀ (by linarith))
        (lt_min hδ_V (lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂)))
    have h2η_le : 2 * η ≤ min (min y₀ (h' - y₀)) (min δ_V (min δ₁ δ₂)) := by
      dsimp [η]; linarith
    have hη_lt_y₀ : η < y₀ := by
      have : 2 * η ≤ y₀ := le_trans h2η_le (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      linarith
    have hy₀_lt_hη : y₀ < h' - η := by
      have : 2 * η ≤ h' - y₀ := le_trans h2η_le (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      linarith
    have hη_lt_δV : η < δ_V := by
      have : 2 * η ≤ δ_V := le_trans h2η_le (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      linarith
    have hη_lt_δ₁ : η < δ₁ := by
      have : 2 * η ≤ δ₁ := le_trans h2η_le
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)))
      linarith
    have hη_lt_δ₂ : η < δ₂ := by
      have : 2 * η ≤ δ₂ := le_trans h2η_le
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)))
      linarith
    have hη_lt_h' : η < h' := by linarith
    have hhη_pos : 0 < h' - η := by linarith
    have hu_bot_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |u_fn (ι x η)| ≤ ε := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hB₁ x η hη_pos hη_lt_δ₁ hη_lt_h'
      have hv0 : v_fn (x, 0) = 0 := by
        dsimp [v_fn, ι]; simp [hInt.real_axis_im_zero x]
      have h2 := hv_vert x η 0 ⟨hη_pos.le, hη_lt_h'.le⟩ ⟨le_rfl, hh'.le⟩
        (by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hη_pos]; exact hη_lt_δV)
      rw [hv0, sub_zero] at h2
      dsimp [u_fn, H_diff, ι]
      dsimp [v_fn, ι] at h2
      linarith [abs_sub (F_V ((x : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
        (S.V ((x : ℂ) + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im]
    have hu_top_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |u_fn (ι x (h' - η))| ≤ ε := by
      intro x
      have h1 := hT₂ x (h' - η) hhη_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h2 := hv_vert x h' (h' - η) ⟨hh'.le, le_rfl⟩ ⟨hhη_pos.le, by linarith⟩
        (by rw [show h' - (h' - η) = η by ring, abs_of_pos hη_pos]; exact hη_lt_δV)
      dsimp [u_fn, H_diff, ι]
      dsimp [v_fn, ι] at h2
      have heq :
          (F_V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
              (S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
            ((F_V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
                (S.V ((x : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im) +
              ((S.V ((x : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
                (S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      linarith [abs_add_le
        ((F_V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
          (S.V ((x : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im)
        ((S.V ((x : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
          (S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((h' - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im)]
    let U_η : Set ℂ := { s : ℂ | η < s.im ∧ s.im < h' - η }
    let C_η : Set ℂ := { s : ℂ | η ≤ s.im ∧ s.im ≤ h' - η }
    have hUη_open : IsOpen U_η :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
    have hUη_preconn : IsPreconnected U_η := by
      have hpre : U_η = Complex.imLm ⁻¹' Set.Ioo η (h' - η) := rfl
      rw [hpre]
      exact ((convex_Ioo η (h' - η)).linear_preimage Complex.imLm).isPreconnected
    have hCη_closed : IsClosed C_η :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
    have hUη_sub_Cη : U_η ⊆ C_η := fun s hs => ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
    have hCη_sub_U : C_η ⊆ U_strip := fun s hs =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hη_pos hs.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hs.2 (by linarith)⟩
    have hCl_sub_Cη : closure U_η ⊆ C_η := closure_minimal hUη_sub_Cη hCη_closed
    have hIota_cl : ∀ x_s : ℝ, ι x_s η ∈ closure U_η := by
      intro x_s
      rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro r hr
      let t : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min r (h' - 2 * η)
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := mul_pos (by positivity) (lt_min hr (by linarith))
      have ht_lt_r : t < r := by
        have : 2 * t ≤ r := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_left r (h' - 2 * η)]
        linarith
      have ht_lt_span : t < h' - 2 * η := by
        have : 2 * t ≤ h' - 2 * η := by dsimp [t]; linarith [min_le_right r (h' - 2 * η)]
        linarith
      refine ⟨ι x_s (η + t), ?_, ?_⟩
      · change η < (ι x_s (η + t)).im ∧ (ι x_s (η + t)).im < h' - η
        simp [ι]; constructor <;> linarith
      · rw [Complex.dist_eq]
        have hdiff : ι x_s η - ι x_s (η + t) = -((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          dsimp [ι]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hdiff, norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          Complex.norm_of_nonneg ht_pos.le]
        exact ht_lt_r
    have hSignBound : ∀ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → σ * u_fn (ι x₀ y₀) ≤ ε := by
      intro σ hσ
      let f_σ : ℂ → ℂ := fun s => Complex.exp (-((σ : ℂ) * Complex.I * H_diff s))
      have hf_holo_U : DifferentiableOn ℂ f_σ U_strip :=
        ((hH_holo.const_mul ((σ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).neg).cexp
      have hf_diffCont : DiffContOnCl ℂ f_σ U_η :=
        (hf_holo_U.mono (Set.Subset.trans hCl_sub_Cη hCη_sub_U)).diffContOnCl
      have hf_norm : ∀ s : ℂ, ‖f_σ s‖ = Real.exp (σ * u_fn s) := by
        intro s
        dsimp [f_σ]
        rw [Complex.norm_exp]
        congr 1
        simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, u_fn]
      let R_η : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc η (h' - η)
      have hR_compact : IsCompact R_η := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
      have hR_nonempty : R_η.Nonempty :=
        ⟨(0, y₀), ⟨Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr h2pi_pos.le, ⟨hη_lt_y₀.le, hy₀_lt_hη.le⟩⟩⟩
      have hu_cont_R : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => σ * u_fn (ι p.1 p.2)) R_η := by
        have hmap_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ι p.1 p.2) := by
          dsimp [ι]; fun_prop
        have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ι p.1 p.2) R_η U_strip := by
          intro p hp
          change 0 < (ι p.1 p.2).im ∧ (ι p.1 p.2).im < h'
          simp [ι]
          exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hη_pos hp.2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hp.2.2 (by linarith)⟩
        exact continuousOn_const.mul
          (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
            (hH_holo.continuousOn.comp hmap_cont.continuousOn hmaps))
      obtain ⟨⟨x_s, y_s⟩, hxy_mem, hxy_max⟩ :=
        hR_compact.exists_isMaxOn hR_nonempty hu_cont_R
      have hMaxCη : ∀ s ∈ C_η, σ * u_fn s ≤ σ * u_fn (ι x_s y_s) := by
        intro s hs
        obtain ⟨x_red, hx_red, k, hx_eq⟩ := hFloor s.re
        have hs_iota : s = ι s.re s.im := by
          dsimp [ι]; exact (Complex.re_add_im s).symm
        have hy_in : 0 < s.im ∧ s.im < h' := hCη_sub_U hs
        have hper_s := (hu_per s.im hy_in.1 hy_in.2).int_mul k x_red
        rw [hs_iota, hx_eq, hper_s]
        have hmem_R : (x_red, s.im) ∈ R_η := ⟨hx_red, hs⟩
        exact hxy_max hmem_R
      have h0_le : σ * u_fn (ι x₀ y₀) ≤ σ * u_fn (ι x_s y_s) := by
        apply hMaxCη
        change η ≤ (ι x₀ y₀).im ∧ (ι x₀ y₀).im ≤ h' - η
        simp [ι, hη_lt_y₀.le, hy₀_lt_hη.le]
      have hAbsSigma : ∀ r : ℝ, σ * r ≤ |r| := by
        intro r
        rcases hσ with rfl | rfl
        · simpa using le_abs_self r
        · simpa using neg_le_abs r
      by_cases hbdry : y_s = η ∨ y_s = h' - η
      · rcases hbdry with rfl | rfl
        · exact le_trans h0_le (le_trans (hAbsSigma _) (hu_bot_bd x_s))
        · exact le_trans h0_le (le_trans (hAbsSigma _) (hu_top_bd x_s))
      · rw [not_or] at hbdry
        have hys_lo : η < y_s := lt_of_le_of_ne hxy_mem.2.1 (Ne.symm hbdry.1)
        have hys_hi : y_s < h' - η := lt_of_le_of_ne hxy_mem.2.2 hbdry.2
        have hc_mem : ι x_s y_s ∈ U_η := by
          change η < (ι x_s y_s).im ∧ (ι x_s y_s).im < h' - η
          simp [ι, hys_lo, hys_hi]
        have hc_max_norm : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ f_σ) U_η (ι x_s y_s) := by
          intro s hs
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf_norm]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hMaxCη s (hUη_sub_Cη hs))
        have hConstCl :=
          Complex.norm_eqOn_closure_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn
            hUη_preconn hUη_open hf_diffCont hc_mem hc_max_norm
        have hEqBot : ‖f_σ (ι x_s η)‖ = ‖f_σ (ι x_s y_s)‖ :=
          hConstCl (hIota_cl x_s)
        rw [hf_norm, hf_norm] at hEqBot
        have hValEq : σ * u_fn (ι x_s η) = σ * u_fn (ι x_s y_s) :=
          Real.exp_injective hEqBot
        exact le_trans h0_le
          (le_trans hValEq.symm.le (le_trans (hAbsSigma _) (hu_bot_bd x_s)))
    have hpos_bd : u_fn (ι x₀ y₀) ≤ ε := by
      simpa using hSignBound 1 (Or.inl rfl)
    have hneg_bd : -u_fn (ι x₀ y₀) ≤ ε := by
      simpa using hSignBound (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
    have habs_bd : |u_fn (ι x₀ y₀)| ≤ ε := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, hpos_bd⟩
    have hpos_abs : 0 < |u_fn (ι x₀ y₀)| := abs_pos.mpr hne
    dsimp [ε] at habs_bd
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨c_core, hc_pos, hCoreBound⟩ := hCore
  refine
    { kernel_cont := fun h' y hh' _ hy0 hyh => hCont h' y hh' hy0 hyh
      kernel_periodic := fun h' y hh' _ hy0 hyh => hPer h' y hh' hy0 hyh
      kernel_nonneg := fun h' y u hh' _ hy0 hyh => hNonneg h' y u hh' hy0 hyh
      kernel_integral := fun h' y hh' _ hy0 hyh => hIntegral h' y hh' hy0 hyh
      kernel_core_lower := ⟨c_core, hc_pos,
        fun h' y u hh' _ hy0 hyh hLy huL => hCoreBound h' y u hh' hy0 hyh hLy huL⟩
      strip_harmonic_V := ?_ }
  intro h' y x hh' hhH hy0 hyh
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (S.V ((ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
  have hg_mem : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro ξ
    change |(((ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| < S.H
    simp [abs_of_pos hh', hhH]
  have hg_cont : Continuous g := by
    rw [← continuousOn_univ]
    have hmap : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by fun_prop
    exact Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
      (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp hmap.continuousOn (fun ξ _ => hg_mem ξ))
  have hg_per : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro ξ
    dsimp [g]
    have harg : ((ξ + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I =
        ((ξ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    rw [harg, S.V_periodic _ (hg_mem ξ)]
  obtain ⟨F_V, hF_holo, hF_im⟩ := hHoloLift h' g hh' hg_cont
  have hF_per : ∀ x' y' : ℝ, 0 < y' → y' < h' →
      (F_V (((x' + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im =
        (F_V ((x' : ℂ) + (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im := by
    intro x' y' hy'0 hy'h
    rw [hF_im (x' + 2 * Real.pi) y' hy'0 hy'h, hF_im x' y' hy'0 hy'h]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun ξ _ => ?_
    have harg : x' + 2 * Real.pi - ξ = (x' - ξ) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    have hk : bootStripPoissonKernel h' ((x' - ξ) + 2 * Real.pi) y' =
        bootStripPoissonKernel h' (x' - ξ) y' := hPer h' y' hh' hy'0 hy'h (x' - ξ)
    rw [harg, hk]
  have hF_bot : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' y' : ℝ, 0 < y' → y' < δ → y' < h' →
      |(F_V ((x' : ℂ) + (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤ ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨⟨δ, hδ, hB⟩, _⟩ := hApprox h' g hh' hg_cont hg_per ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x' y' hy'0 hy'δ hy'h => ?_⟩
    rw [hF_im x' y' hy'0 hy'h]
    exact hB x' y' hy'0 hy'δ hy'h
  have hF_top : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' y' : ℝ, 0 < y' → h' - δ < y' → y' < h' →
      |(F_V ((x' : ℂ) + (y' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im -
        (S.V ((x' : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤ ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨δ, hδ, hT⟩⟩ := hApprox h' g hh' hg_cont hg_per ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x' y' hy'0 hy'δ hy'h => ?_⟩
    rw [hF_im x' y' hy'0 hy'h]
    exact hT x' y' hy'0 hy'δ hy'h
  rw [hUniq h' hh' hhH F_V hF_holo hF_per hF_bot hF_top x y hy0 hyh,
    hF_im x y hy0 hyh]

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S)
    (hStrip : UcbStripPoissonData S)
    (β a C_N C₁ C_quad C_p p : ℝ)
    (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβhalf : β < 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hCN : 1 ≤ C_N) (hC1 : 0 < C₁)
    (hCq : 0 < C_quad) (hCp : 0 < C_p) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hL1 : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Real.exp (-k) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im|) ≤
          C_quad * (N k) ^ 2)
    (hLp : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2) ^ p) ≤ C_p) :
    ∃ η C_conc : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 < C_conc ∧
      ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
        ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),

          _ ≤ (12 / Real.pi) * (5 * Real.pi) * (R * σ) := by
              apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hRσ_pos)
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hMd_lt) (by positivity)
          _ = 60 * R * σ := by field_simp; ring
      have hw_enl : ∀ ξ x : ℝ, |x - ξ| ≤ 2 * R * d_k → w₁ ξ ≤ w₂ x :=
        fun ξ x hdist => hSoftEnl M_k J d_k (2 * R * d_k) ξ x hdk_pos (le_of_lt h2Rdk_pos) hdist
      set B_int : ℝ := 280 * Real.pi * C_row * σ ^ ζ_top
      have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B_int :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (le_of_lt hC_row)) (le_of_lt hσζ_pos)
      have hB_bound : ∀ l : ℝ, k - 1 ≤ l → l ≤ k + 1 →
          (∑ ν ∈ J, ∫ u in (cellMid M_k ν - d_k)..(cellMid M_k ν + d_k),
            Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im| / (N k) ^ 2) ≤ B_int := by
        intro l hl_low hl_hi
        have hl_ge_k0 : k₀ ≤ l := by linarith
        obtain ⟨hFl_c, hFl_p⟩ := hF_cont_per l hl_ge_k0
        let F_l : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im| / (N k) ^ 2
        have hFl_cont : Continuous F_l := hFl_c.div_const _
        have hFl_per : Function.Periodic F_l (2 * Real.pi) := fun u =>
          congrArg (fun z => z / (N k) ^ 2) (hFl_p u)
        have hFl_nn : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ F_l u := fun u =>
          div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (abs_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
        have hov := hSoftOverlap k hk_ge1 J F_l hFl_cont hFl_per hFl_nn
        have hrow := hRow N hN k l σ hk_deep hl_low hl_hi hσ_low hσ_le1 w₁ w₂
          hw₁_cont hw₁_per hw₁_bnds hw₂_cont hw₂_per hw₂_bnds hw₁_mass hw₂_mass hw_enl
        have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
        have hrow_unnorm : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w₁ u * F_l u) ≤
            2 * Real.pi * (C_row * σ ^ ζ_top) := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrow (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
          have hsimp : (2 * Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w₁ u * F_l u) =
              ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w₁ u * F_l u := by field_simp
          linarith
        dsimp only [B_int]
        linarith
      have hsum_A := hAk_sum J B_int hB_nn hB_bound
      have hcoeff_le : (2 * Real.exp k / (M_k : ℝ)) * (280 * Real.pi) ≤ 140 := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hMk_pos_R]
        nlinarith
      have hσ_le_ζ : σ ≤ σ ^ ζ_top := by
        have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hσ_pos hσ_le1 (by linarith : ζ_top ≤ 1)
        simpa using this
      calc (∑ ν ∈ J, A_k ν) / (M_k : ℝ)
          ≤ C_cell * (σ + (2 * Real.exp k / (M_k : ℝ)) * B_int) := hsum_A
        _ = C_cell * (σ + ((2 * Real.exp k / (M_k : ℝ)) * (280 * Real.pi)) * (C_row * σ ^ ζ_top)) := by
            dsimp only [B_int]; ring
        _ ≤ C_cell * (σ ^ ζ_top + 140 * (C_row * σ ^ ζ_top)) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (le_of_lt hC_cell)
            exact add_le_add hσ_le_ζ
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff_le
                (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC_row) (le_of_lt hσζ_pos)))
        _ = C_sel * σ ^ ζ_top := by dsimp only [C_sel]; ring
    have hmom := hDyad M_k hMk_pos A_k hAk_nn hAk_sel
    have hBmom_eq : B_mom = (B_mom ^ (1 / (2 + η))) ^ (2 + η) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hB_mom), one_div_mul_cancel (by linarith), Real.rpow_one]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x) / N k) ^ (2 + η))
        ≤ (∑ ν : Fin M_k, (A_k ν) ^ (1 + η / 2)) / (M_k : ℝ) := hAk_int
      _ ≤ B_mom := hmom
      _ = (B_mom ^ (1 / (2 + η))) ^ (2 + η) := hBmom_eq
      _ ≤ C_conc ^ (2 + η) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hB_mom) _) (le_max_right _ _) (by linarith)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_s2 : ∀ (r_star H r₀ L_M : ℝ) (Δ : ℂ → ℝ) (M : ℝ → ℝ),
      0 < r₀ → r₀ < r_star → 0 < H → 0 ≤ L_M →
      (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, 0 ≤ Δ t ∧ Δ t ≤ H) →
      UpperSemicontinuousOn Δ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star) →
      (∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_star →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun θ : ℝ => Δ (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
          (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        Δ t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Δ (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
      (∀ u v : ℝ, |M u - M v| ≤ L_M * |u - v|) →
      (∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ M u ∧ M u ≤ H) →
      (∀ u : ℝ, r₀ / 2 ≤ |u| → M u = H) →
      (∀ u : ℝ, |u| ≤ r₀ → Δ (u : ℂ) ≤ M u) →
      ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ ≤ r₀ → t.im ≠ 0 →
        Δ t ≤ H + (4 * H / r₀) * |t.im| + Real.pi⁻¹ *
          (∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, (|t.im| / ((t.re - u) ^ 2 + |t.im| ^ 2)) * (M u - H)) := by
    clear S hInt β a C_N C₁ hβ0 hβhalf ha hCN hC1 D
    intro r_star H r₀ L_M Δ M hr₀_pos hr₀_lt hH_pos hLM_nonneg hΔ_bounds hΔ_usc hΔ_submean
      hM_lip hM_bounds hM_outer hΔ_real
    have h_arctan_le : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z → Real.arctan z ≤ z := by
      intro z hz
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hz with rfl | hz_pos
      · simp [Real.arctan_zero]
      · obtain ⟨c, _, hc_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope Real.arctan
          (fun t => 1 / (1 + t ^ 2)) hz_pos Real.continuous_arctan.continuousOn
          (fun t _ => Real.hasDerivAt_arctan t)
        rw [Real.arctan_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero] at hc_eq
        have h_inv_le : 1 / (1 + c ^ 2) ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
        rw [hc_eq] at h_inv_le
        exact (div_le_one hz_pos).mp h_inv_le
    have hM_cont : Continuous M := by
      rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      intro u₀ ε hε
      refine ⟨ε / (L_M + 1), by positivity, fun u hu => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hu ⊢
      calc
        |M u - M u₀| ≤ L_M * |u - u₀| := hM_lip u u₀
        _ ≤ (L_M + 1) * |u - u₀| := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (u - u₀)]
        _ < (L_M + 1) * (ε / (L_M + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu (by positivity)
        _ = ε := by
          have hne : L_M + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
          field_simp [hne]
    have hP_int_eq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < y →
        (∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, y / ((x - u) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) =
          Real.arctan ((r₀ - x) / y) + Real.arctan ((r₀ + x) / y) := by
      intro x y hy
      have hP_c : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => y / ((x - u) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) :=
        continuous_const.div (((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const)
          (fun u => by positivity)
      have h_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc (-r₀) r₀,
          HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.arctan ((u - x) / y)) (y / ((x - u) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) u := by
        intro u _
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => (u - x) / y) (1 / y) u :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const x).div_const y
        have hd2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_arctan ((u - x) / y)).comp u hd1
        change HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.arctan ((u - x) / y)) _ u at hd2
        convert hd2 using 1
        have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
        have hden_ne : (x - u) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [hy_ne, hden_ne]
        ring
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv (hP_c.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      have h_neg_arg : (-r₀ - x) / y = -((r₀ + x) / y) := by ring
      rw [h_neg_arg, Real.arctan_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
    set U_uhp : Set ℂ := { t : ℂ | 0 < t.im }
    have hU_uhp_open : IsOpen U_uhp := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
    set D_cl : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r₀ ∩ { t : ℂ | 0 ≤ t.im }
    set D_int : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₀ ∩ { t : ℂ | 0 < t.im }
    let U : ℂ → ℝ := fun t =>
      if 0 < t.im then
        H + (4 * H / r₀) * t.im + Real.pi⁻¹ *
          ∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, (t.im / ((t.re - u) ^ 2 + t.im ^ 2)) * (M u - H)
      else
        M t.re
    let 𝓕_U : ℂ → ℂ := fun t =>
      Complex.I * (H : ℂ) + ((4 * H / r₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * t - ((Real.pi⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))
    have h𝓕_im : ∀ t ∈ U_uhp, (𝓕_U t).im = U t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht_im : 0 < t.im := ht
      have h_sub_ne : ∀ u : ℝ, t - (u : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro u h0
        have him := congrArg Complex.im h0
        simp at him
        linarith
      have h_cont_int : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))) := by
        refine Continuous.div ?_ (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal) h_sub_ne
        exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hM_cont.sub continuous_const)
      have h_iv_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ)))
          MeasureTheory.volume (-r₀) r₀ := h_cont_int.intervalIntegrable (-r₀) r₀
      have h_comm := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm h_iv_int
      have h_im_integrand : ∀ u : ℝ,
          (((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))).im =
            -((t.im / ((t.re - u) ^ 2 + t.im ^ 2)) * (M u - H)) := by
        intro u
        rw [Complex.div_im]
        have hns : Complex.normSq (t - (u : ℂ)) = (t.re - u) ^ 2 + t.im ^ 2 := by
          simp [Complex.normSq_apply]
          ring
        rw [hns]
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.sub_im, zero_mul, zero_div,
          zero_sub]
        ring
      have h_im_int : (∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))).im =
          -(∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, (t.im / ((t.re - u) ^ 2 + t.im ^ 2)) * (M u - H)) := by
        have hc1 : (∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))).im =
            ∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, (((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))).im := h_comm.symm
        rw [hc1, ← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun u _ => h_im_integrand u
      have hUt_def : U t = H + (4 * H / r₀) * t.im + Real.pi⁻¹ *
          ∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, (t.im / ((t.re - u) ^ 2 + t.im ^ 2)) * (M u - H) := by
        simp [U, ht_im]
      rw [hUt_def]
      simp only [𝓕_U, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, h_im_int]
      ring
    have h𝓕_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝓕_U U_uhp := by
      intro t₀ ht₀
      have hy₀ : 0 < t₀.im := ht₀
      let s : Set ℂ := Metric.ball t₀ (t₀.im / 2)
      have hs_nhds : s ∈ nhds t₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₀ (by positivity)
      have hs_im : ∀ t ∈ s, t₀.im / 2 < t.im := by
        intro t ht
        have hdist : ‖t - t₀‖ < t₀.im / 2 := by simpa [s, dist_eq_norm] using ht
        have him_diff : |t.im - t₀.im| < t₀.im / 2 :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (t - t₀)) hdist
        linarith [(abs_lt.mp him_diff).1]
      have hs_norm : ∀ t ∈ s, ∀ u : ℝ, t₀.im / 2 < ‖t - (u : ℂ)‖ := by
        intro t ht u
        have him := hs_im t ht
        calc
          t₀.im / 2 < t.im := him
          _ ≤ |t.im| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |(t - (u : ℂ)).im| := by simp
          _ ≤ ‖t - (u : ℂ)‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
      let F : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun t u => ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ))
      let F' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun t u => -(((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ)) ^ 2)
      have hF_cont : ∀ t ∈ s, Continuous (F t) := by
        intro t ht
        refine Continuous.div (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hM_cont.sub continuous_const))
          (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal) fun u h0 => ?_
        have hn := hs_norm t ht u
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at hn
        linarith
      have hF'_cont : Continuous (F' t₀) := by
        have ht₀_mem : t₀ ∈ s := Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity)
        refine Continuous.neg (Continuous.div
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hM_cont.sub continuous_const))
          ((continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_ofReal).pow 2) fun u h0 => ?_)
        have hn := hs_norm t₀ ht₀_mem u
        have h0' : t₀ - (u : ℂ) = 0 := eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero h0
        rw [h0', norm_zero] at hn
        linarith
      have h_hasDeriv_int : HasDerivAt (fun t => ∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, F t u)
          (∫ u in (-r₀)..r₀, F' t₀ u) t₀ := by
        refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
          (bound := fun _ => 4 * H / t₀.im ^ 2) hs_nhds ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2
        · filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with t ht
          exact (hF_cont t ht).aestronglyMeasurable
        · exact (hF_cont t₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity))).intervalIntegrable _ _
        · exact hF'_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u _ t ht => ?_
          have hn : t₀.im / 2 ≤ ‖t - (u : ℂ)‖ := le_of_lt (hs_norm t ht u)
          have hM_abs : |M u - H| ≤ H :=
            abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hM_bounds u).1], by linarith [(hM_bounds u).2]⟩
          simp only [F', norm_neg, norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_pow]
          calc
            |M u - H| / ‖t - (u : ℂ)‖ ^ 2
              ≤ H / (t₀.im / 2) ^ 2 := by
                refine div_le_div₀ hH_pos.le hM_abs (by positivity) ?_
                gcongr
            _ = 4 * H / t₀.im ^ 2 := by ring
        · exact intervalIntegrable_const
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u _ t ht => ?_
          have h_ne : t - (u : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            have hn := hs_norm t ht u
            rw [h0, norm_zero] at hn
            linarith
          have hd := (hasDerivAt_const t ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ)).div
            ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const (u : ℂ)) h_ne
          have h_deriv_eq : (0 * (t - (u : ℂ)) - ((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) * 1) / (t - (u : ℂ)) ^ 2 =
              F' t u := by
            change _ = -(((M u - H : ℝ) : ℂ) / (t - (u : ℂ)) ^ 2)
            ring
          exact h_deriv_eq ▸ hd
      have h𝓕_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ 𝓕_U t₀ := by
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => Complex.I * (H : ℂ) + ((4 * H / r₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * t)
            (((4 * H / r₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * 1) t₀ :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id t₀).const_mul _).const_add _
        exact (hd1.sub (h_hasDeriv_int.const_mul ((Real.pi⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ))).differentiableAt
      exact h𝓕_at.differentiableWithinAt
    have hU_mean : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall t₀ ρ ⊆ U_uhp →
        U t₀ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            U (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      intro t₀ ρ hρ h_sub
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ 𝓕_U (Metric.ball t₀ ρ) := h𝓕_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_sub
      have hc_raw := hdc.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ)
      have hρ_ne : (ρ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hρ)
      have h_unfold : (∮ z in C(t₀, ρ), (z - t₀)⁻¹ • 𝓕_U z) =
          Complex.I * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 𝓕_U (circleMap t₀ ρ θ) := by
        rw [circleIntegral, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
        have hE_ne : Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
        simp only [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_sub_center, circleMap_zero, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp [hρ_ne, hE_ne]
      rw [h_unfold] at hc_raw
      have h_cancel : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 𝓕_U (circleMap t₀ ρ θ)) =
          (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) * 𝓕_U t₀ := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
        simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hc_raw
      have h_circ_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => 𝓕_U (circleMap t₀ ρ θ)) :=
        h𝓕_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap t₀ ρ) fun θ =>
          h_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere t₀ hρ.le θ))
      have h_im_eq := congrArg Complex.imCLM h_cancel
      rw [← Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (h_circ_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)] at h_im_eq
