        linarith [(abs_le.mp hw_im_diff).2]
      have hw_im_pos : 0 < w.im := by linarith [S.H_pos]
      have hw_strip : w ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        change |w.im| < S.H
        rw [abs_of_pos hw_im_pos]
        linarith
      set δ_w : ℝ := S.H - w.im
      have hδ_lo : d_k / 2 ≤ δ_w := by linarith
      have hδ_hi : δ_w ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_k := by linarith
      have h_tube : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, (w, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
        intro t ht
        have ht_lt : ‖t‖ < ρ := by simpa using ht
        have ht_bound : S.H - S.h_X t ≤ d_k / 4 := hWidth t (le_of_lt ht_lt)
        have hconj_norm : ‖starRingEnd ℂ t‖ ≤ ρ := by
          rw [Complex.norm_conj]
          exact le_of_lt ht_lt
        have hconj_bound : S.H - S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ t) ≤ d_k / 4 :=
          hWidth (starRingEnd ℂ t) hconj_norm
        refine ⟨lt_trans ht_lt hρ_lt, ?_, ?_⟩
        · linarith [S.H_pos]
        · linarith
      set g_w : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => S.𝔰 (w, t)
      have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_w (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) := by
        have hpair : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun t : ℂ => (w, t)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
          ((differentiable_const w).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
        exact S.𝔰_holo.comp hpair h_tube
      set Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => (δ_w : ℂ) + Complex.I * (g_w t - w)
      have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
        (differentiableOn_const (δ_w : ℂ)).add
          ((hg_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const w)).const_mul Complex.I)
      have hΦ_zero : Φ 0 = (δ_w : ℂ) := by
        simp [Φ, g_w, S.𝔰_zero w hw_strip]
      have hΦ_re_pos : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ, 0 < (Φ t).re := by
        intro t ht
        have hs_mem : S.𝔰 (w, t) ∈ horizStrip S.H := S.𝔰_maps_to (w, t) (h_tube t ht)
        have hs_im : |(S.𝔰 (w, t)).im| < S.H := hs_mem
        have hs_im_lt : (S.𝔰 (w, t)).im < S.H := (abs_lt.mp hs_im).2
        have hre : (Φ t).re = S.H - (S.𝔰 (w, t)).im := by
          simp [Φ, g_w, δ_w]
        linarith
      have hΦ_iter2 : iteratedDeriv 2 Φ 0 = 2 * Complex.I * S.V w := by
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_one]
        have h_eq_deriv : ∀ᶠ t in nhds (0 : ℂ), deriv Φ t = Complex.I * deriv g_w t := by
          filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) hρ_pos] with t ht
          have hg_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ g_w t :=
            (hg_holo t ht).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht)
          have hhd : HasDerivAt Φ (Complex.I * deriv g_w t) t := by
            simpa [Φ] using ((hg_at.hasDerivAt.sub_const w).const_mul Complex.I).const_add (δ_w : ℂ)
          exact hhd.deriv
        rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq h_eq_deriv, deriv_const_mul_field,
          S.𝔰_deriv2_t_zero w hw_strip]
        ring
      set r : ℝ := ρ / 2
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := by positivity
      have hr_ne : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hr_pos)
      have hcl_sub : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by simp only [r]; linarith)
      have hΦ_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ Φ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
        hΦ_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcl_sub
      have hΦz_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Φ z * z) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ) :=
        hΦ_holo.mul differentiableOn_id
      have hΦz_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Φ z * z) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
        hΦz_holo.diffContOnCl_ball hcl_sub
      set E : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have hE_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, E θ ≠ 0 := fun θ => Complex.exp_ne_zero _
      have hΦ_circ_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)) :=
        hΦ_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap 0 r) fun θ =>
          hcl_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hr_pos.le θ))
      have h_c1_raw := hΦ_dc.circleIntegral_one_div_sub_center_pow_smul hr_pos 2
      rw [hΦ_iter2] at h_c1_raw
      have h_c1 : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
          2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.V w := by
        have h_unfold : (∮ z in C((0 : ℂ), r), (1 / (z - 0) ^ (2 + 1)) • Φ z) =
            (Complex.I / (r : ℂ) ^ 2) *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [circleIntegral, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
          have h_ne := hE_ne θ
          simp only [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_zero, smul_eq_mul, E]
          field_simp [hr_ne, h_ne]
          ring
        rw [h_unfold] at h_c1_raw
        have h_rhs : ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I / ((2 : ℕ).factorial : ℂ)) •
            (2 * Complex.I * S.V w)) = -2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * S.V w := by
          norm_num [smul_eq_mul]
          linear_combination 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * S.V w * Complex.I_sq
        rw [h_rhs] at h_c1_raw
        have h_mul := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => -((r : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.I) * z) h_c1_raw
        have h_lhs_simp : -((r : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.I) * ((Complex.I / (r : ℂ) ^ 2) *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [hr_ne]
          simp [Complex.I_sq]
        rw [h_lhs_simp] at h_mul
        linear_combination h_mul
      have h_c2_raw := hΦz_dc.circleIntegral_eq_zero hr_pos.le
      have h_c2_pre : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * E θ ^ 2) = 0 := by
        have h_unfold : (∮ z in C((0 : ℂ), r), Φ z * z) =
            ((r : ℂ) ^ 2 * Complex.I) *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * E θ ^ 2 := by
          rw [circleIntegral, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
          simp only [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_zero, smul_eq_mul, E]
          ring
        rw [h_unfold] at h_c2_raw
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_c2_raw with h_coef | h_int
        · exfalso
          exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hr_ne) Complex.I_ne_zero h_coef
        · exact h_int
      have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * E θ ^ 2)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        refine (hΦ_circ_cont.mul ?_).intervalIntegrable _ _
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).pow 2
      have h_c2 : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹) = 0 := by
        have h_conj := congrArg (Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap) h_c2_pre
        rw [map_zero,
          ← Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm h_int2] at h_conj
        refine Eq.trans ?_ h_conj
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
        have h_conj_E : starRingEnd ℂ (E θ) = (E θ)⁻¹ := by
          simp only [E, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I,
            mul_neg, Complex.exp_neg]
        change _ = starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * E θ ^ 2)
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, h_conj_E, inv_pow]
      have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        refine (hΦ_circ_cont.mul ?_).intervalIntegrable _ _
        refine Continuous.inv₀ ?_ (fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hE_ne θ))
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).pow 2
      have h_int1_conj : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun θ : ℝ => starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by
        refine ((Complex.continuous_conj.comp hΦ_circ_cont).mul ?_).intervalIntegrable _ _
        refine Continuous.inv₀ ?_ (fun θ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hE_ne θ))
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).pow 2
      have h_sum : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.V w =
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ((2 * (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        calc
          2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.V w
            = (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹) +
                (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
              rw [h_c1, h_c2, add_zero]
          _ = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) + starRingEnd ℂ (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ))) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
              rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int1 h_int1_conj]
              refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => by ring
          _ = ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                ((2 * (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
              refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
              rw [Complex.add_conj]
      have h_c0_raw := hΦ_dc.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos)
      rw [hΦ_zero] at h_c0_raw
      have h_c0 : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re) =
          2 * Real.pi * δ_w := by
        have h_unfold : (∮ z in C((0 : ℂ), r), (z - 0)⁻¹ • Φ z) =
            Complex.I * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ) := by
          rw [circleIntegral, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
          have h_ne := hE_ne θ
          simp only [deriv_circleMap, circleMap_zero, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp [hr_ne, h_ne]
        rw [h_unfold] at h_c0_raw
        have h_cancel : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)) =
            2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (δ_w : ℂ) := by
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ Complex.I_ne_zero
          simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using h_c0_raw
        have h_re := congrArg Complex.reCLM h_cancel
        rw [← Complex.reCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
          (hΦ_circ_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)] at h_re
        simpa using h_re
      have h_norm_eq : ‖2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (r : ℂ) ^ 2 * S.V w‖ =
          2 * Real.pi * r ^ 2 * ‖S.V w‖ := by
        simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
      have h_norm_le : 2 * Real.pi * r ^ 2 * ‖S.V w‖ ≤ 4 * Real.pi * δ_w := by
        rw [← h_norm_eq, h_sum]
        calc
          ‖∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              ((2 * (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (E θ ^ 2)⁻¹‖
            ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), 2 * (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re := by
              refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (by positivity) ?_ ?_
              · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ _ => ?_
                have h_mem_ball : circleMap 0 r θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ :=
                  hcl_sub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hr_pos.le θ))
                have hre_pos : 0 < (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re := hΦ_re_pos _ h_mem_ball
                have hE_norm : ‖(E θ ^ 2)⁻¹‖ = 1 := by
                  simp [E, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
                rw [norm_mul, hE_norm, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                  abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
              · exact (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_re.comp hΦ_circ_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
          _ = 2 * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Φ (circleMap 0 r θ)).re :=
              intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
          _ = 4 * Real.pi * δ_w := by rw [h_c0]; ring
      have hV_bound : ‖S.V w‖ ≤ 12 * d_k / ρ ^ 2 := by
        have hr2_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi * r ^ 2 := by positivity
        have h1 : ‖S.V w‖ ≤ (4 * Real.pi * δ_w) / (2 * Real.pi * r ^ 2) :=
          (le_div_iff₀ hr2_pos).mpr (by linarith)
        have h2 : (4 * Real.pi * δ_w) / (2 * Real.pi * r ^ 2) = 8 * δ_w / ρ ^ 2 := by
          simp only [r]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos, ne_of_gt hρ_pos]
          ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        calc
          ‖S.V w‖ ≤ 8 * δ_w / ρ ^ 2 := h1
          _ ≤ 8 * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_k) / ρ ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = 12 * d_k / ρ ^ 2 := by ring
      calc
        d_k * ‖S.V w‖ ≤ d_k * (12 * d_k / ρ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV_bound hd_pos.le
        _ = 12 * (d_k / ρ) ^ 2 := by ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_sup : sSup ((fun w : ℂ => d_k * ‖S.V w‖) ''
          Metric.closedBall (bootRowPt S k x₀) (d_k / 2)) ≤ 12 * (d_k / ρ) ^ 2 := by
        refine csSup_le ?_ ?_
        · exact (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr (by positivity)).image _
        · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
          exact h_ball_V w hw
      have h_rb := hRowBall k x₀ hk
      set X : ℝ := d_k / ρ
      have hX_pos : 0 < X := by positivity
      have h_sq : (d_k * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x₀)) ^ 2 ≤
          (max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup)) * (1 + X)) ^ 2 := by
        have h_c_sq : 13 * C_sup ≤ (max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup))) ^ 2 := by
          calc
            13 * C_sup = (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup)) ^ 2 :=
              (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)).symm
            _ ≤ (max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup))) ^ 2 := by
              gcongr
              exact le_max_right _ _
        calc
          (d_k * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x₀)) ^ 2
            ≤ C_sup * (1 + sSup ((fun w : ℂ => d_k * ‖S.V w‖) ''
                Metric.closedBall (bootRowPt S k x₀) (d_k / 2))) := h_rb
          _ ≤ C_sup * (1 + 12 * X ^ 2) := by gcongr
          _ ≤ C_sup * (13 * (1 + X) ^ 2) := by
              gcongr
              nlinarith
          _ = (13 * C_sup) * (1 + X) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ (max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup))) ^ 2 * (1 + X) ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = (max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup)) * (1 + X)) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_rhs_nonneg : 0 ≤ max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup)) * (1 + X) := by positivity
      nlinarith
    · have h_center : bootRowPt S k x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (bootRowPt S k x₀) (d_k / 2) :=
        Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity)
      have h_v := h_ball_V (bootRowPt S k x₀) h_center
      calc
        d_k * |(S.V (bootRowPt S k x₀)).im|
          ≤ d_k * ‖S.V (bootRowPt S k x₀)‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hd_pos.le
        _ ≤ 12 * (d_k / ρ) ^ 2 := h_v
        _ ≤ max 12 (Real.sqrt (13 * C_sup)) * (d_k / ρ) ^ 2 := by
            gcongr
            exact le_max_left _ _
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, c₂, hr₀_pos, hr₀_le_rstar, hc₂_pos, hMaj⟩ := h_s1
  obtain ⟨C_cb, hC_cb_pos, hCB⟩ := h_s3
  refine ⟨C_cb * max (1 + c₂⁻¹) ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2), by positivity, ?_⟩
  have hr₀_lt_rstar : r₀ < S.r_star := by linarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have hΔ_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star,
      0 ≤ S.H - S.h_X t ∧ S.H - S.h_X t ≤ S.H := by
    intro t ht
    have hb := S.h_X_bounds t ht
    exact ⟨by linarith [hb.2], by linarith [hb.1, S.s_star_pos]⟩
  have hΔ_usc : UpperSemicontinuousOn (fun t : ℂ => S.H - S.h_X t)
      (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star) := by
    intro t ht y hy
    exact (S.h_X_lsc t ht (S.H - y) (by linarith)).mono fun z hz => by linarith
  intro N hN hMono k hk x
  obtain ⟨hρ_pos, hρ_le_r₀, M, L_M, hLM_nonneg, hM_lip, hM_bounds, hM_outer,
    hΔ_real, hM_ρ, hPoisson_ρ⟩ := hMaj N hN hMono k hk
  set ρ_k : ℝ := c₂ * Real.exp (-k) / ((1 + k) * N k)
  have hWidth : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ ≤ ρ_k → S.H - S.h_X t ≤ Real.exp (-k) / 4 := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases ht_im : t.im = 0
    · have ht_eq : t = (t.re : ℂ) := Complex.ext rfl ht_im
      have hre_le : |t.re| ≤ ρ_k := by
        have h1 := ht
        rw [ht_eq, Complex.norm_real] at h1
        exact h1
      rw [ht_eq]
      exact le_trans (hΔ_real t.re (le_trans hre_le hρ_le_r₀)) (hM_ρ t.re hre_le)
    · have h1 := h_s2 S.r_star S.H r₀ L_M (fun z => S.H - S.h_X z) M
        hr₀_pos hr₀_lt_rstar S.H_pos hLM_nonneg hΔ_bounds hΔ_usc S.deficit_subharmonic
        hM_lip hM_bounds hM_outer hΔ_real t (le_trans ht hρ_le_r₀) ht_im
      have him_pos : 0 < |t.im| := abs_pos.mpr ht_im
      have hxy_sq : t.re ^ 2 + |t.im| ^ 2 ≤ ρ_k ^ 2 := by
        rw [sq_abs]
        have hns : Complex.normSq t ≤ ρ_k ^ 2 := by
          rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
          gcongr
        simpa [Complex.normSq_apply, sq] using hns
      exact le_trans h1 (hPoisson_ρ t.re |t.im| him_pos hxy_sq)
  obtain ⟨h_mod, h_vim⟩ := hCB k ρ_k hk hρ_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt hρ_le_r₀ hr₀_lt_rstar) hWidth x
  have hk_ge_one : 1 ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk
  have hNk_ge_one : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
  have h1kN_ge_one : 1 ≤ (1 + k) * N k := by nlinarith
  have h1kN_pos : 0 < (1 + k) * N k := by positivity
  have h_ratio : Real.exp (-k) / ρ_k = c₂⁻¹ * ((1 + k) * N k) := by
    simp only [ρ_k]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc₂_pos, ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos (-k)), ne_of_gt h1kN_pos]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x)
        ≤ C_cb * (1 + Real.exp (-k) / ρ_k) := h_mod
      _ = C_cb * (1 + c₂⁻¹ * ((1 + k) * N k)) := by rw [h_ratio]
      _ ≤ C_cb * ((1 + c₂⁻¹) * ((1 + k) * N k)) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hC_cb_pos.le
          nlinarith
      _ ≤ C_cb * (max (1 + c₂⁻¹) ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2) * ((1 + k) * N k)) := by
          gcongr
          exact le_max_left _ _
      _ = C_cb * max (1 + c₂⁻¹) ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2) * (1 + k) * N k := by ring
  · calc
      Real.exp (-k) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im|
        ≤ C_cb * (Real.exp (-k) / ρ_k) ^ 2 := h_vim
      _ = C_cb * ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2)) := by
          rw [h_ratio]
          ring
      _ ≤ C_cb * (max (1 + c₂⁻¹) ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2) * ((1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2)) := by
          gcongr
          exact le_max_right _ _
      _ = C_cb * max (1 + c₂⁻¹) ((c₂⁻¹) ^ 2) * (1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hCrit : CriticalWallData S) :
    BootRealWallTransferProp S ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < S.r_star → ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < y.im → y.im < S.h_X (t : ℂ) →

    have h_gt : S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) < (g y).im := lt_of_not_ge h_not_le
    let η : ℝ := min (((g y).im - (S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ))) / 2) ((S.h_X (t : ℂ) - y.im) / 2)
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := by
      refine lt_min ?_ ?_
      · linarith
      · linarith
    have hη_le1 : η ≤ ((g y).im - (S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ))) / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hη_le2 : η ≤ (S.h_X (t : ℂ) - y.im) / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    let B : ℝ := S.h_X (t : ℂ) - η
    let M : ℝ := S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) + η
    have hy_lt_B : y.im < B := by dsimp [B]; linarith
    have hB_pos : 0 < B := lt_trans hy_pos hy_lt_B
    have hB_lt_hX : B < S.h_X (t : ℂ) := by dsimp [B]; linarith
    have hM_lt_gy : M < (g y).im := by dsimp [M]; linarith
    have ht_ball : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Complex.norm_real] using ht_lt
    obtain ⟨hs_le_hX, hhX_le_H⟩ := S.h_X_bounds (t : ℂ) ht_ball
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by dsimp [M]; linarith
    let S_cl : Set ℂ := { z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.im ∧ z.im ≤ B }
    have h_in_tube : ∀ z ∈ S_cl, (z, (t : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨by simpa [Complex.norm_real] using ht_lt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp
        rw [Complex.conj_ofReal]
        linarith [S.s_star_pos, hz.1]
      · dsimp
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hz.2 hB_lt_hX
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g S_cl := by
      have h_pair : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (z, (t : ℂ))) S_cl :=
        (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (t : ℂ))).differentiableOn
      exact (S.𝔰_holo.fun_comp h_pair h_in_tube).sub differentiableOn_id
    have hg_per : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ B →
        g (z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) = g z := by
      intro z hz0 hzB
      have hmem : (z, (t : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := h_in_tube z ⟨hz0, hzB⟩
      have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (z, (t : ℂ)) hmem
      dsimp [g] at hqp ⊢
      have hcast : z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) = z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast, hqp]
      ring
    have hg_bot : ∀ x : ℝ, (g (x : ℂ)).im ≤ M := by
      intro x
      have hx_mem : (x : ℂ) ∈ S_cl := ⟨by simp, by simpa using le_of_lt hB_pos⟩
      have hconj := S.𝔰_conj ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ)) (h_in_tube (x : ℂ) hx_mem)
      dsimp at hconj
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
      have him0 : (S.𝔰 ((x : ℂ), (t : ℂ))).im = 0 := Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
      have hg_im0 : (g (x : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
        dsimp [g]
        simp [him0]
      linarith
    have hg_top : ∀ z : ℂ, z.im = B → (g z).im ≤ M := by
      intro z hzB
      have hz_mem : z ∈ S_cl := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hmaps := S.𝔰_maps_to (z, (t : ℂ)) (h_in_tube z hz_mem)
      have him_lt_H : (S.𝔰 (z, (t : ℂ))).im < S.H :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hmaps
      have hg_im : (g z).im = (S.𝔰 (z, (t : ℂ))).im - B := by
        dsimp [g]
        simp [hzB]
      dsimp [M, B] at hg_im ⊢
      linarith
    have hy_le_M : (g y).im ≤ M :=
      hPeriodicStrip g (2 * Real.pi) B M Real.two_pi_pos hB_pos hg_holo hg_per hg_bot hg_top
        y (le_of_lt hy_pos) (le_of_lt hy_lt_B)
    linarith

    (β a C_N C₁ A : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (ha : 0 < a) (hCN : 1 ≤ C_N) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hA : 1 ≤ A) :
    (∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
      Continuous (tileSupModulus S A l) ∧

      ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
        (∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), tileSupModulus S A l x) ≤ C_t1 * N l) ∧
        (∀ M_r : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_r →
          (∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → rowMomentFull S j ≤ M_r * N j) →
          ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
            Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A l x) ^ 2) ≤
              C_t2 * (1 + M_r) * N l)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hOpen_H : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_submean : ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (z₀ : ℂ) (r p : ℝ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ h (horizStrip S.H) → 0 < r → 0 < p →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      ‖h z₀‖ ^ p ≤ (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ r, ‖h w‖ ^ p := by
    intro h z₀ r p hh hr hp hball
    let U : Set ℂ := horizStrip S.H
    have hU : IsOpen U := hOpen_H
    by_cases hz₀ : h z₀ = 0
    · simp only [hz₀, norm_zero, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
      refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) ?_
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg fun w => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) p
    · have h_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h U := (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn hU).mpr hh
      have hCont_cl : ContinuousOn (fun w => ‖h w‖ ^ p) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) :=
        ((hh.continuousOn.mono hball).norm).rpow_const fun _ _ => Or.inr hp.le
      have hInt_r : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => ‖h w‖ ^ p)
          (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (hCont_cl.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set
          Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
      have h_inner : ∀ r' : ℝ, 0 < r' → r' < r →
          Real.pi * r' ^ 2 * ‖h z₀‖ ^ p ≤ ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ r, ‖h w‖ ^ p := by
        intro r' hr'_pos hr'_lt
        let Z_r : Set ℂ := {z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r' | h z = 0}
        have hFin_Z : Z_r.Finite := by
          by_contra hInf
          have hInf' : Z_r.Infinite := hInf
          obtain ⟨w, hw_cl, hw_acc⟩ :=
            hInf'.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r') fun z hz => hz.1
          rw [accPt_iff_frequently_nhdsNE] at hw_acc
          have hfreq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin w {w}ᶜ, h z = 0 := hw_acc.mono fun z hz => hz.2
          have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr'_lt hw_cl
          have h_ana_ball : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h (Metric.ball z₀ r) :=
            h_ana.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hball)
          have hEqZero := h_ana_ball.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
            (convex_ball z₀ r).isPreconnected hw_ball hfreq
          exact hz₀ (hEqZero (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
        let E_rad : Set ℝ := (fun z : ℂ => ‖z - z₀‖) '' Z_r
        have hNull_rad : MeasureTheory.volume E_rad = 0 :=
          (hFin_Z.image _).countable.measure_zero MeasureTheory.volume
        have h_circle : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 r', ρ ∉ E_rad →
            2 * Real.pi * ρ * ‖h z₀‖ ^ p ≤
              ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
                ρ * ‖h (z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm (ρ, θ))‖ ^ p := by
          intro ρ hρ_mem hρ_not_bad
          have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := hρ_mem.1
          have hρ_lt_r' : ρ < r' := hρ_mem.2
          have hρ_abs : |ρ| = ρ := abs_of_pos hρ_pos
          have hsub_ρ : Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ| ⊆ U := by
            rw [hρ_abs]
            exact (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (hρ_lt_r'.le.trans hr'_lt.le)).trans hball
          have h_sph_ne : ∀ x ∈ Metric.sphere z₀ ρ, h x ≠ 0 := by
            intro x hx hzx
            apply hρ_not_bad
            refine ⟨x, ⟨?_, hzx⟩, ?_⟩
            · exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall.trans
                (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ_lt_r'.le) hx
            · simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_sphere.mp hx
          have h_ana_ρ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h (Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ|) := h_ana.mono hsub_ρ
          have h_mero_ρ : MeromorphicOn h (Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ|) :=
            fun x hx => (h_ana_ρ x hx).meromorphicAt
          have h_ana_z0 : AnalyticAt ℂ h z₀ :=
            h_ana z₀ (hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le))
          have h_ord_z0 : meromorphicOrderAt h z₀ = 0 :=
            (tendsto_ne_zero_iff_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero h_ana_z0.meromorphicAt).mp
              ⟨h z₀, hz₀, h_ana_z0.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt⟩
          have h_trail_z0 : meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt h z₀ = h z₀ :=
            h_ana_z0.meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt_of_ne_zero hz₀
          let D := MeromorphicOn.divisor h (Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ|)
          have hD_z0 : D z₀ = 0 := by
            simp [D, MeromorphicOn.divisor_def, h_ord_z0]
          have hD_nonneg : ∀ u : ℂ, 0 ≤ D u :=
            fun u => MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_nonneg h_ana_ρ u
          have h_finsum_nonneg :
              0 ≤ ∑ᶠ u : ℂ, (D u : ℝ) * Real.log (ρ * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹) := by
            refine finsum_nonneg fun u => ?_
            by_cases hu_z0 : u = z₀
            · subst hu_z0; simp [hD_z0]
            · by_cases hu_mem : u ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ |ρ|
              · have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖z₀ - u‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr (Ne.symm hu_z0)
                have hnorm_le : ‖z₀ - u‖ ≤ ρ := by
                  rw [← hρ_abs, norm_sub_rev]
                  simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu_mem
                have h_one_le : 1 ≤ ρ * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹ := by
                  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, one_le_div hnorm_pos]
                  exact hnorm_le
                exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hD_nonneg u) (Real.log_nonneg h_one_le)
              · have hDu : D u = 0 := by simp [D, hu_mem]
                simp [hDu]
          have h_jensen := MeromorphicOn.circleAverage_log_norm hρ_pos.ne' h_mero_ρ
          have h_log_le : Real.log ‖h z₀‖ ≤ Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖h x‖) z₀ ρ := by
            rw [h_jensen]
            change Real.log ‖h z₀‖ ≤
              (∑ᶠ u : ℂ, (D u : ℝ) * Real.log (ρ * ‖z₀ - u‖⁻¹)) +
                (D z₀ : ℝ) * Real.log ρ + Real.log ‖meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt h z₀‖
            rw [hD_z0, h_trail_z0]
            linarith
          let t_set : Set ℝ := Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
          let f_ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => p * Real.log ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖
          have h_cmap_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ := fun θ =>
            norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_sph_ne _ (circleMap_mem_sphere z₀ hρ_pos.le θ))
          have h_cmap_mem_U : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap z₀ ρ θ ∈ U := fun θ => by
            refine hsub_ρ ?_
            rw [hρ_abs]
            exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall (circleMap_mem_sphere z₀ hρ_pos.le θ)
          have hCont_h_cmap : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)) :=
            hh.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap z₀ ρ) h_cmap_mem_U
          have hCont_fρ : Continuous f_ρ :=
            continuous_const.mul ((hCont_h_cmap.norm).log fun θ => (h_cmap_pos θ).ne')
          have hExp_fρ : Real.exp ∘ f_ρ = fun θ => ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p := by
            ext θ
            simp only [Function.comp_apply, f_ρ]
            rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (h_cmap_pos θ), mul_comm]
          have ht_vol : MeasureTheory.volume t_set = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) := by
            simp [t_set, Real.volume_Ioc]
          have ht_ne_zero : MeasureTheory.volume t_set ≠ 0 := by
            rw [ht_vol]
            exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne'
          have ht_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume t_set ≠ ⊤ := by
            rw [ht_vol]
            exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
          have ht_real : MeasureTheory.volume.real t_set = 2 * Real.pi := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.real, ht_vol, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le]
          have hConv := ConvexOn.map_set_average_le (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) convexOn_exp
            Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn isClosed_univ ht_ne_zero ht_ne_top
            (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
            hCont_fρ.integrableOn_Ioc
            (Real.continuous_exp.comp hCont_fρ).integrableOn_Ioc
          have h_avg_fρ :
              (⨍ θ in t_set, f_ρ θ) = p * Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖h x‖) z₀ ρ := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, ht_real, smul_eq_mul, Real.circleAverage_def,
              smul_eq_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
            simp only [f_ρ, t_set, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
            ring
          have h_avg_exp : (⨍ θ in t_set, Real.exp (f_ρ θ)) =
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, ht_real, smul_eq_mul,
              intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
            congr 1
            refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc fun θ _ => ?_
            exact congrFun hExp_fρ θ
          have h_rpow_z0 : ‖h z₀‖ ^ p ≤
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p := by
            have hz0_pos : 0 < ‖h z₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz₀
            calc
              ‖h z₀‖ ^ p = Real.exp (Real.log ‖h z₀‖ * p) := Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz0_pos p
              _ = Real.exp (p * Real.log ‖h z₀‖) := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ Real.exp (p * Real.circleAverage (fun x => Real.log ‖h x‖) z₀ ρ) :=
                Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_le hp.le)
              _ = Real.exp (⨍ θ in t_set, f_ρ θ) := by rw [h_avg_fρ]
              _ ≤ ⨍ θ in t_set, Real.exp (f_ρ θ) := hConv
              _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
                    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p := h_avg_exp
          have hPer_cmap :
              Function.Periodic (fun θ : ℝ => ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p) (2 * Real.pi) :=
            fun θ => by simp [periodic_circleMap z₀ ρ θ]
          have h_shift : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p) =
              ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p := by
            have h1 := hPer_cmap.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-Real.pi) 0
            have ha1 : -Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = Real.pi := by ring
            have ha2 : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := by ring
            rw [ha1, ha2] at h1
            exact h1.symm
          have h_cmap_polar :
              ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap z₀ ρ θ = z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm (ρ, θ) := by
            intro θ
            rw [circleMap, Complex.polarCoord_symm_apply, Complex.exp_mul_I]
            simp [Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]
          have h_pi_le : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
          have h_int_eq : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p) =
              ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
                ‖h (z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm (ρ, θ))‖ ^ p := by
            rw [h_shift, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h_pi_le,
              MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
            refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo fun θ _ => ?_
            rw [h_cmap_polar]
          have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rpow_z0 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ρ)
          calc
            2 * Real.pi * ρ * ‖h z₀‖ ^ p
                ≤ 2 * Real.pi * ρ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
                    ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖h (circleMap z₀ ρ θ)‖ ^ p) := h_mul
            _ = ρ * ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
                  ‖h (z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm (ρ, θ))‖ ^ p := by
                rw [h_int_eq]
                have h2pi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
                field_simp [h2pi]
            _ = ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
                  ρ * ‖h (z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm (ρ, θ))‖ ^ p := by
                rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        let g_pol : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q => q.1 * ‖h (z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm q)‖ ^ p
        have h_pol_mem : ∀ q ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) r' ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
            z₀ + Complex.polarCoord.symm q ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r := by
          intro q hq
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_self_add_left, Complex.polarCoord_symm_apply]
          have h_unit : ‖(Real.cos q.2 : ℂ) + (Real.sin q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ = 1 := by
            simp [Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin, Complex.norm_cos_add_sin_mul_I]
          rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hq.1.1, h_unit, mul_one]
          exact hq.1.2.trans hr'_lt.le
        have hCont_pol : ContinuousOn g_pol (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) r' ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
          have hCont_symm : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => z₀ + (Complex.polarCoord.symm q : ℂ)) := by
            have hc : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => z₀ + (Complex.polarCoord.symm q : ℂ)) =
                fun q => z₀ + (q.1 : ℂ) * ((Real.cos q.2 : ℂ) + (Real.sin q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
              ext q; simp [Complex.polarCoord_symm_apply]
            rw [hc]
            continuity
          exact continuousOn_fst.mul (hCont_cl.comp hCont_symm.continuousOn h_pol_mem)
        have hInt_pol_box : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn g_pol
            (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r' ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi)
            (MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
          change MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn g_pol
            (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r' ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) MeasureTheory.volume
          exact (hCont_pol.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
            (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
        have hInt_lhs : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun ρ : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * ρ * ‖h z₀‖ ^ p)
            (Set.Ioo 0 r') MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).mul continuous_const).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact
            isCompact_Icc).mono_set Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self

                rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_box, Set.indicator_of_mem h_targ]
                dsimp only [F_ind, g_pol]
                rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_ball, smul_eq_mul]

      have h_lim_le : Real.pi * r ^ 2 * ‖h z₀‖ ^ p ≤ ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ r, ‖h w‖ ^ p :=
        le_of_tendsto h_tendsto_lhs

  have h_fubini : ∀ (L j₁ j₂ : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ L → j₁ ≤ j₂ → Real.exp (-j₁) < S.H →
      ContinuousOn G (horizStrip S.H) →
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z) →
      let R_x : ℝ → Set ℂ := fun x =>
        { w : ℂ | |w.re - x| ≤ L ∧ S.H - Real.exp (-j₁) ≤ w.im ∧ w.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-j₂) }
      IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ∫ w in R_x x, G w) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContinuousOn
        (fun j : ℝ => Real.exp (-j) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *

          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            G ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    intro L j₁ j₂ G hL hj hexp hG_cont hG_per R_x
    let y₁ : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-j₁)
    let y₂ : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-j₂)
    have hy1_pos : 0 < y₁ := by dsimp [y₁]; linarith
    have hy12 : y₁ ≤ y₂ := by
      dsimp [y₁, y₂]
      have : Real.exp (-j₂) ≤ Real.exp (-j₁) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hy2_lt : y₂ < S.H := by
      dsimp [y₂]
      linarith [Real.exp_pos (-j₂)]
    let clampY : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => max y₁ (min y₂ y)
    have hclamp_mem : ∀ y : ℝ, clampY y ∈ Set.Icc y₁ y₂ :=
      fun y => ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hy12 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hclamp_eq : ∀ {y : ℝ}, y ∈ Set.Icc y₁ y₂ → clampY y = y := by
      intro y hy
      simp only [clampY, min_eq_right hy.2, max_eq_right hy.1]
    let ψ_c : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun q => (q.1 : ℂ) + ((clampY q.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ_c :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_snd))).mul continuous_const)
    have hψ_strip : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, ψ_c q ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro q
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hclamp_mem q.2
      have h_im : (ψ_c q).im = clampY q.2 := by simp [ψ_c]
      change |(ψ_c q).im| < S.H
      rw [h_im, abs_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le hy1_pos h1)]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h2 hy2_lt

      intro y x

        push_cast; ring

      exact hG_per _ (hψ_strip (x, y))
    let K_vy : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (-L) L ×ˢ Set.Icc y₁ y₂
    have hKvy_compact : IsCompact K_vy := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have h_rect_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, (∫ w in R_x x, G w) = ∫ p in K_vy, G_ext (x + p.1, p.2) := by
      intro x

      have hemb1 := Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm.measurableEmbedding

        have him : (Complex.measurableEquivRealProd.symm (u, v)).im = v := rfl

        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h3, h4⟩

        constructor

        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩; exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, h3⟩

      exact hGext_cont.comp ((continuous_fst.add (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).prodMk

  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := le_max_left 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
  have hexp_k₀ : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have h1 : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
    have h2 : -k₀ ≤ Real.log (S.H / 20) := by linarith
    calc
      Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  have hM_cont : ContinuousOn (shapeModulus S) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    continuous_max.comp_continuousOn
      (S.f_holo.continuousOn.norm.prodMk
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm))
  have hM_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, shapeModulus S (z + 2 * Real.pi) = shapeModulus S z := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [shapeModulus, S.f_periodic z hz, S.q_periodic z hz]
  have hM_nonneg : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ shapeModulus S z :=
    fun z => le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _)
  have hM_sq : ∀ z : ℂ, (shapeModulus S z) ^ 2 = max (‖S.f z‖ ^ 2) ‖S.q z‖ := by
    intro z
    dsimp [shapeModulus]
    rcases le_total ‖S.f z‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖) with hle | hle
    · have hsq : ‖S.f z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S.q z‖ := by
        calc
          ‖S.f z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hle 2
          _ = ‖S.q z‖ := Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [max_eq_right hle, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _), max_eq_right hsq]
    · have hsq : ‖S.q z‖ ≤ ‖S.f z‖ ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ‖S.q z‖ = (Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)).symm
          _ ≤ ‖S.f z‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hle 2
      rw [max_eq_left hle, max_eq_left hsq]
  have hM_int_per : ∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      shapeModulus S (z + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) = shapeModulus S z := by
    intro n
    induction n using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => intro z _; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro z hz
      have hz' : |z.im| < S.H := hz
      have hzk : z + (((((k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        change |(z + (((((k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ))).im| < S.H
        simpa using hz'
      have hcast : z + (((((k : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (z + (((((k : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ))) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast, hM_per _ hzk, ih z hz]
    | pred k ih =>
      intro z hz
      have hz' : |z.im| < S.H := hz
      have hzk : z + ((((-(k : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        change |(z + ((((-(k : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)).im| < S.H
        simpa using hz'
      have hcast : z + ((((-(k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
          (z + ((((-(k : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [← hM_per _ hzk, ← hcast, ih z hz]
  have hTile_trans : ∀ (l x : ℝ),
      upperStripTile S A l x = (fun w : ℂ => (x : ℂ) + w) '' upperStripTile S A l 0 := by
    intro l x
    ext s
    constructor
    · intro hs
      refine ⟨s - (x : ℂ), ?_, by ring⟩
      rcases hs with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
      refine ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa [wallDepth] using h2,
        by simpa [wallDepth] using h3, by simpa [wallDepth] using h4⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨by simpa using h1, by simpa [wallDepth] using h2,
        by simpa [wallDepth] using h3, ?_⟩
      have hre : ((x : ℂ) + w).re - x = w.re - 0 := by simp
      have him : wallDepth S ((x : ℂ) + w) = wallDepth S w := by simp [wallDepth]
      rw [hre, him]
      exact h4
  have hTile_sub_strip : ∀ (l x : ℝ), upperStripTile S A l x ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro l x s hs
    rcases hs with ⟨h1, h2, _, _⟩
    change |s.im| < S.H
    rw [abs_of_nonneg h1]
    have hd_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) := by positivity
    dsimp [wallDepth] at h2
    linarith
  have hK0_nonempty : ∀ l : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l → (upperStripTile S A l 0).Nonempty := by
    intro l hl
    let d_min : ℝ := Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l)
    refine ⟨((S.H - d_min : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_⟩
    have hexp_nA : Real.exp (-A) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have hexp_nl : Real.exp (-l) ≤ S.H / 20 :=
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)).trans hexp_k₀
    have hd_le_H20 : d_min ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      dsimp [d_min]
      calc
        Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) ≤ 1 * (S.H / 20) :=
          mul_le_mul hexp_nA hexp_nl (by positivity) zero_le_one
        _ = S.H / 20 := one_mul _
    have hd_le_expA : d_min ≤ Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (by positivity)
    have hd_nonneg : 0 ≤ d_min := by positivity
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp; linarith [S.H_pos]
    · simp only [wallDepth, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_sub_cancel]
      exact le_rfl
    · simp only [wallDepth, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_sub_cancel]
      exact le_min (by linarith [S.H_pos]) hd_le_expA
    · simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.I_im, mul_one, sub_zero, abs_zero, wallDepth, Complex.mul_im, add_zero,
        sub_sub_cancel]
      positivity
  have hK0_compact : ∀ l : ℝ, IsCompact (upperStripTile S A l 0) := by
    intro l
    let K_big : Set ℂ :=
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
        (Set.Icc (-A * S.H) (A * S.H) ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 S.H)
    have hKbig_compact : IsCompact K_big :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
    have hClosed : IsClosed (upperStripTile S A l 0) := by
      have hc1 : IsClosed {s : ℂ | 0 ≤ s.im} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
      have hc2 : IsClosed {s : ℂ | Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) ≤ wallDepth S s} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)
      have hc3 : IsClosed {s : ℂ | wallDepth S s ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l))} :=
        isClosed_le (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
      have hc4 : IsClosed {s : ℂ | |s.re - 0| ≤ A * wallDepth S s} :=
        isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
          (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))
      exact hc1.inter (hc2.inter (hc3.inter hc4))
    refine hKbig_compact.of_isClosed_subset hClosed fun s hs => ?_
    rcases hs with ⟨h1, h2, _, h4⟩
    have hd_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) := by positivity
    dsimp [wallDepth] at h2 h4
    have him_le : s.im ≤ S.H := by linarith
    have hre_abs : |s.re| ≤ A * S.H := by
      have : A * (S.H - s.im) ≤ A * S.H := by nlinarith
      simpa using h4.trans this
    rw [abs_le] at hre_abs
    exact ⟨(s.re, s.im), ⟨⟨by linarith [hre_abs.1], hre_abs.2⟩, h1, him_le⟩, Complex.re_add_im s⟩
  have hTile_compact : ∀ l x : ℝ, IsCompact (upperStripTile S A l x) := by
    intro l x
    rw [hTile_trans l x]
    exact (hK0_compact l).image (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have hTile_nonempty : ∀ l x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l → (upperStripTile S A l x).Nonempty := by
    intro l x hl
    rw [hTile_trans l x]
    exact (hK0_nonempty l hl).image _
  have hTile_bdd : ∀ l x : ℝ, BddAbove (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) :=
    fun l x => (hTile_compact l x).bddAbove_image (hM_cont.mono (hTile_sub_strip l x))
  have hTile_nonneg : ∀ l x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l → 0 ≤ tileSupModulus S A l x := by
    intro l x hl
    obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := hTile_nonempty l x hl
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      ((hM_nonneg s₀).trans (le_csSup (hTile_bdd l x) ⟨s₀, hs₀, rfl⟩))
  have hTileContPer : ∀ l : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l →
      Continuous (tileSupModulus S A l) ∧
      Function.Periodic (tileSupModulus S A l) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro l hl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
      intro x₀ ε hε
      let y_top : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l)
      let K_box : Set ℂ :=
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          (Set.Icc (x₀ - A * S.H - 1) (x₀ + A * S.H + 1) ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 y_top)
      have hKbox_compact : IsCompact K_box :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
      have hKbox_sub : K_box ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
        rintro _ ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨_, hv0, hvt⟩, rfl⟩
        change |((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
        have him : ((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = v := by simp
        rw [him, abs_of_nonneg hv0]
        dsimp [y_top] at hvt
        linarith [show 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) by positivity]
      obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
        (hKbox_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hM_cont.mono hKbox_sub))
        (ε / 2 * Real.exp l) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨min δ₁ 1, lt_min hδ₁_pos zero_lt_one, fun x hx_dist => ?_⟩
      have hx_lt_δ1 : |x - x₀| < δ₁ := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using lt_of_lt_of_le hx_dist (min_le_left _ _)
      have hx_le_1 : |x - x₀| ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hx_dist (min_le_right _ _))
      have hmem_box : ∀ (y : ℝ), |y - x₀| ≤ 1 → ∀ w ∈ upperStripTile S A l 0,
          (y : ℂ) + w ∈ K_box := by
        intro y hy w hw
        rcases hw with ⟨hw1, hw2, _, hw4⟩
        dsimp [wallDepth] at hw2 hw4
        have hw_re : |w.re| ≤ A * S.H := by
          have : A * (S.H - w.im) ≤ A * S.H := by nlinarith
          simpa using hw4.trans this
        rw [abs_le] at hw_re hy
        refine ⟨(y + w.re, w.im), ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, hw1, by dsimp [y_top]; linarith⟩, ?_⟩
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp
      have hsup_le1 : sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) ≤
          sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x₀) + ε / 2 * Real.exp l := by
        refine csSup_le ((hTile_nonempty l x hl).image _) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        rw [hTile_trans l x] at hs
        rcases hs with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        have h_xw : (x : ℂ) + w ∈ K_box := hmem_box x hx_le_1 w hw
        have h_x0w : (x₀ : ℂ) + w ∈ K_box := hmem_box x₀ (by simp) w hw
        have h_dist_w : dist ((x : ℂ) + w) ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) < δ₁ := by
          have hd : dist ((x : ℂ) + w) ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) = |x - x₀| := by
            rw [dist_add_right, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
              Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rwa [hd]
        have h_diff := hδ₁ ((x : ℂ) + w) h_xw ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) h_x0w h_dist_w
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_diff
        have h_le_sup0 : shapeModulus S ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) ≤
            sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x₀) := by
          refine le_csSup (hTile_bdd l x₀) ⟨(x₀ : ℂ) + w, ?_, rfl⟩
          rw [hTile_trans l x₀]
          exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        linarith [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp h_diff.le).1]
      have hsup_le2 : sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x₀) ≤
          sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) + ε / 2 * Real.exp l := by
        refine csSup_le ((hTile_nonempty l x₀ hl).image _) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
        rw [hTile_trans l x₀] at hs
        rcases hs with ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        have h_xw : (x : ℂ) + w ∈ K_box := hmem_box x hx_le_1 w hw
        have h_x0w : (x₀ : ℂ) + w ∈ K_box := hmem_box x₀ (by simp) w hw
        have h_dist_w : dist ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) ((x : ℂ) + w) < δ₁ := by
          rw [dist_comm]
          have hd : dist ((x : ℂ) + w) ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) = |x - x₀| := by
            rw [dist_add_right, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
              Real.norm_eq_abs]
          rwa [hd]
        have h_diff := hδ₁ ((x₀ : ℂ) + w) h_x0w ((x : ℂ) + w) h_xw h_dist_w
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_diff
        have h_le_supx : shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + w) ≤
            sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) := by
          refine le_csSup (hTile_bdd l x) ⟨(x : ℂ) + w, ?_, rfl⟩
          rw [hTile_trans l x]
          exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        linarith [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp h_diff.le).1]
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      dsimp [tileSupModulus]
      have hcancel : Real.exp (-l) * (ε / 2 * Real.exp l) = ε / 2 := by
        rw [Real.exp_neg]
        field_simp [(Real.exp_pos l).ne']
      have hb1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsup_le1 (Real.exp_pos (-l)).le
      have hb2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsup_le2 (Real.exp_pos (-l)).le
      have h_abs : |Real.exp (-l) * sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) -
          Real.exp (-l) * sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x₀)| ≤ ε / 2 := by
        rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      linarith
    · intro x
      dsimp [tileSupModulus]
      congr 2
      rw [hTile_trans l (x + 2 * Real.pi), hTile_trans l x, ← Set.image_comp, ← Set.image_comp]
      refine Set.image_congr fun w hw => ?_
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      have hxw_strip : (x : ℂ) + w ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        refine hTile_sub_strip l x ?_
        rw [hTile_trans l x]
        exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      have hadd : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + w = ((x : ℂ) + w) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [hadd, hM_per _ hxw_strip]

  
  have hM_disk_1 : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      shapeModulus S z₀ ≤ (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ r, shapeModulus S w := by
    intro z₀ r hr hball
    have hInt_M : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (shapeModulus S)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      ((hM_cont.mono hball).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hInt_f : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => ‖S.f w‖)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (((S.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hball).norm).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hInt_q : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      ((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
        (S.q_holo.continuousOn.mono hball).norm).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hf1 := h_submean S.f z₀ r 1 S.f_holo hr zero_lt_one hball
    simp only [Real.rpow_one] at hf1
    have hq1 := h_submean S.q z₀ r (1 / 2) S.q_holo hr (by norm_num) hball
    simp only [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at hq1
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact hf1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hInt_f hInt_M Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
          fun w _ => le_max_left _ _) (by positivity))
    · exact hq1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hInt_q hInt_M Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
          fun w _ => le_max_right _ _) (by positivity))
  have hM_disk_2 : ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      (shapeModulus S z₀) ^ 2 ≤
        (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ r, (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2 := by
    intro z₀ r hr hball
    have hInt_M2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (((hM_cont.mono hball).pow 2).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hInt_f2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => ‖S.f w‖ ^ 2)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      ((((S.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hball).norm).pow 2).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hInt_q1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => ‖S.q w‖)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (((S.q_holo.continuousOn.mono hball).norm).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hf2 := h_submean S.f z₀ r 2 S.f_holo hr zero_lt_two hball
    simp only [Real.rpow_two] at hf2
    have hq2 := h_submean S.q z₀ r 1 S.q_holo hr zero_lt_one hball
    simp only [Real.rpow_one] at hq2
    rw [hM_sq z₀]
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · exact hf2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hInt_f2 hInt_M2 Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
          fun w _ => by rw [hM_sq w]; exact le_max_left _ _) (by positivity))
    · exact hq2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hInt_q1 hInt_M2 Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
          fun w _ => by rw [hM_sq w]; exact le_max_right _ _) (by positivity))

  
  let y_shal : ℝ := S.H - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀)
  have hy_shal_pos : 0 < y_shal := by dsimp [y_shal]; linarith [S.H_pos]
  let K_low : Set ℂ :=
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 y_shal)
  have hKlow_compact : IsCompact K_low :=
    (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
  have hKlow_sub : K_low ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨_, hv0, hvt⟩, rfl⟩
    change |((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < S.H
    have him : ((u : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = v := by simp
    rw [him, abs_of_nonneg hv0]
    dsimp [y_shal] at hvt
    linarith [Real.exp_pos (-k₀)]
  have h0_mem_Klow : (0 : ℂ) ∈ K_low :=
    ⟨(0, 0), ⟨⟨le_rfl, Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩, le_rfl, hy_shal_pos.le⟩, by simp⟩

  let W_A : ℝ := (A + 1) * Real.exp A

    intro l x hl j₁ j₂ L_l R_rect

    have hexp_j1 : Real.exp (-j₁) ≤ S.H / 20 :=

    have hR_sub_strip : R_rect ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by

    have hInt_R1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (shapeModulus S) R_rect MeasureTheory.volume :=

    have hInt_R2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w => (shapeModulus S w) ^ 2)

    let I₁ : ℝ := ∫ w in R_rect, shapeModulus S w

    let r_l : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l)

      have heA : Real.exp (-A) ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * A) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]

        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]

      calc
        Real.pi * (1 / 2 * Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l)) ^ 2 *

    have h_pt_bounds : ∀ s ∈ upperStripTile S A l x,

      intro s hs

                _ = (1 / 2 * Real.exp (-A) + A * Real.exp A) * Real.exp (-l) := by ring

            have hdw_le_j1 : wallDepth S w ≤ Real.exp (-j₁) := by

                rw [hj1_eq]
                have hexp_split : Real.exp (-(l - A - 1)) = Real.exp 1 * (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l)) := by

                rw [hexp_split]
                calc
                  wallDepth S w ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * wallDepth S s := hdw_hi
                  _ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l)) := by nlinarith
                  _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l)) :=
                        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
              · have hj1_eq : j₁ = k₀ := max_eq_left hmax
                rw [hj1_eq]

            dsimp [wallDepth] at hdw_le_j1
            linarith
          · have hdw_lo : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * wallDepth S s ≤ wallDepth S w := by
              dsimp [wallDepth] at *

            have hdw_ge_j2 : Real.exp (-j₂) ≤ wallDepth S w := by
              have hexp_split : Real.exp (-j₂) = Real.exp (-1) * (Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l)) := by
                dsimp [j₂]
                rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
                congr 1; ring
              rw [hexp_split]

        have hball_strip : Metric.closedBall s r_l ⊆ horizStrip S.H :=

        have h_open_sub_R : Metric.ball s r_l ⊆ R_rect :=

          have hrew1 : (Real.exp (-l)) ^ 2 * (shapeModulus S s) ^ 2 =

            calc

              _ = (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * I₂ := by rw [hexp_cancel2]; ring

    let B₁ : ℝ := Real.exp (-l) * M_low + (4 * Real.exp (2 * A) / Real.pi) * Real.exp l * I₁

    rw [h_split_x2] at h_avg_le2
    have h_deep_sq :
        c₂ * (2 * W_A) * Real.exp (-l) *
          (∫ j in j₁..j₂, Real.exp (-j) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-j) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ^ 2)) ≤
        K₂ * M_r ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 := by
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_j_bound2 (by dsimp [c₂]; positivity : 0 ≤ c₂ * (2 * W_A))
      dsimp [K₂, c₂] at hm ⊢
      linarith
    have h_one_le_fac : 1 ≤ (1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (1 + M_r) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : 1 ≤ (N l) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith
    have h_Mr_le_fac : M_r ^ 2 ≤ (1 + M_r) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_Mlow_term : M_low ^ 2 ≤ M_low ^ 2 * ((1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2) :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right (sq_nonneg M_low) h_one_le_fac
    have h_K2_term : K₂ * M_r ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 ≤ K₂ * ((1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2) := by
      calc
        K₂ * M_r ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 = K₂ * (N l) ^ 2 * M_r ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ K₂ * (N l) ^ 2 * (1 + M_r) ^ 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Mr_le_fac (by positivity)
        _ = K₂ * ((1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2) := by ring
    have h_Ct2_sq : C_t2 ^ 2 = M_low ^ 2 + K₂ + 1 :=
      Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    refine Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    calc
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S A l x) ^ 2
          ≤ M_low ^ 2 + K₂ * M_r ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 := by linarith
      _ ≤ (M_low ^ 2 + K₂ + 1) * ((1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2) := by
            linarith [show 0 ≤ (1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 by positivity]
      _ = C_t2 ^ 2 * (1 + M_r) ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 := by rw [h_Ct2_sq]; ring
      _ = (C_t2 * (1 + M_r) * N l) ^ 2 := by ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hC₁
  have hβ₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ β₁ := le_trans hβ (le_of_lt hββ₁)
  have hδb_H4 : δ_b ≤ S.H / 4 := le_trans hδb_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδb_exp : δ_b ≤ Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) / 2 :=
    le_trans hδb_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hMod_nonneg : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ shapeModulus S z :=
    fun z => le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hMod_cont : ContinuousOn (shapeModulus S) (horizStrip S.H) := by
    unfold shapeModulus
    exact ContinuousOn.sup (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.f_holo.continuousOn)
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
        (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn S.q_holo.continuousOn))
  have h_norm_le : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ |z.re| + |z.im| := by
    intro z
    calc
      ‖z‖ = ‖(z.re : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := by rw [Complex.re_add_im]
      _ ≤ ‖(z.re : ℂ)‖ + ‖(z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |z.re| + |z.im| := by simp
  
  have hConeProps : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Continuous (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) ∧
        Function.Periodic (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x := by
    intro N hN k hk
    have hNk : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    let K_cone : Set ℂ :=
      { w : ℂ | Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ S.H - w.im ∧
        S.H - w.im ≤ δ_b ∧
        |w.re| ≤ L * (S.H - w.im) }
    have hK_closed : IsClosed K_cone := by
      change IsClosed ({ w : ℂ | Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ S.H - w.im } ∩
        ({ w : ℂ | S.H - w.im ≤ δ_b } ∩ { w : ℂ | |w.re| ≤ L * (S.H - w.im) }))
      exact (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)).inter
        ((isClosed_le (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
          (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re)
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))))
    have hK_im : ∀ w ∈ K_cone, |w.im| < S.H := by
      intro w hw
      rcases hw with ⟨hw1, hw2, _⟩
      have hexp : 0 < Real.exp (-k) / 20 := div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
    have hK_ball : K_cone ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (L * δ_b + S.H) := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have him : |w.im| ≤ S.H := le_of_lt (hK_im w hw)
      rcases hw with ⟨_, hw2, hw3⟩
      have hre : |w.re| ≤ L * δ_b :=
        le_trans hw3 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw2 (le_of_lt hL_pos))
      linarith [h_norm_le w]
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K_cone :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (L * δ_b + S.H)).of_isClosed_subset hK_closed hK_ball
    have hUniv_compact : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set ↥K_cone) :=
      isCompact_iff_isCompact_univ.mp hK_compact
    let F : ℝ → ↥K_cone → ℝ := fun x w =>
      ((S.H - w.1.im) * shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + w.1)) /
        (N k * ((S.H - w.1.im) / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁)
    have hBoot_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x = 1 + sSup (F x '' Set.univ) := by
      intro x
      unfold bootConeCost
      congr 1
      apply congrArg sSup
      ext v
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨s, hs1, hs2, hs3, rfl⟩
        have hw_mem : s - (x : ℂ) ∈ K_cone := by
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · simpa [wallDepth] using hs1
          · simpa [wallDepth] using hs2
          · simpa [wallDepth] using hs3
        refine ⟨⟨s - (x : ℂ), hw_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have h_add : (x : ℂ) + (s - (x : ℂ)) = s := add_sub_cancel (x : ℂ) s
        simp [F, wallDepth, h_add]
      · rintro ⟨w, _, rfl⟩
        rcases w with ⟨w, hw1, hw2, hw3⟩
        refine ⟨(x : ℂ) + w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [wallDepth] using hw1
        · simpa [wallDepth] using hw2
        · simpa [wallDepth] using hw3
        · simp [F, wallDepth]
    have hφ_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ↥K_cone => (p.1 : ℂ) + p.2.1) :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
    have hφ_mem : ∀ p : ℝ × ↥K_cone, (p.1 : ℂ) + p.2.1 ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro p
      simpa [horizStrip] using hK_im p.2.1 p.2.2
    have hDepth_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ↥K_cone => S.H - p.2.1.im) :=
      continuous_const.sub (Complex.continuous_im.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))
    have hRatio_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ↥K_cone => (S.H - p.2.1.im) / Real.exp (-k)) :=
      hDepth_cont.div_const (Real.exp (-k))
    have hRpow_cont :
        Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ↥K_cone => ((S.H - p.2.1.im) / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁) :=
      hRatio_cont.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hβ₁_nonneg)
    have hDen_ne : ∀ p : ℝ × ↥K_cone, N k * ((S.H - p.2.1.im) / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁ ≠ 0 := by
      intro p
      have hw1 : Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ S.H - p.2.1.im := p.2.2.1
      have hdepth_pos : 0 < S.H - p.2.1.im :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)) hw1
      have hrat_pos : 0 < (S.H - p.2.1.im) / Real.exp (-k) :=
        div_pos hdepth_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
      exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNk) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hrat_pos β₁))
    have hUncurry_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F) := by
      change Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ↥K_cone =>
        ((S.H - p.2.1.im) * shapeModulus S ((p.1 : ℂ) + p.2.1)) /
          (N k * ((S.H - p.2.1.im) / Real.exp (-k)) ^ β₁))
      exact (hDepth_cont.mul (hMod_cont.comp_continuous hφ_cont hφ_mem)).div
        (continuous_const.mul hRpow_cont) hDen_ne
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_eq : bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k = fun x => 1 + sSup (F x '' Set.univ) :=
        funext hBoot_eq
      rw [h_eq]
      exact continuous_const.add (hUniv_compact.continuous_sSup hUncurry_cont)
    · intro x
      rw [hBoot_eq (x + 2 * Real.pi), hBoot_eq x]
      congr 2
      have hF_per : F (x + 2 * Real.pi) = F x := by
        funext w
        have hz_mem : (x : ℂ) + w.1 ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          simpa [horizStrip] using hK_im w.1 w.2
        have hshift : (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + w.1) = ((x : ℂ) + w.1) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          push_cast
          ring
        have hmod_eq : shapeModulus S (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + w.1) =
            shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + w.1) := by
          rw [hshift]
          unfold shapeModulus
          rw [S.f_periodic _ hz_mem, S.q_periodic _ hz_mem]
        dsimp [F]
        rw [hmod_eq]
      rw [hF_per]
    · intro x
      rw [hBoot_eq x]
      suffices h0 : 0 ≤ sSup (F x '' Set.univ) by linarith
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro v ⟨w, _, rfl⟩
      have hw1 : Real.exp (-k) / 20 ≤ S.H - w.1.im := w.2.1
      have hdepth_pos : 0 < S.H - w.1.im :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)) hw1
      have hrat_pos : 0 < (S.H - w.1.im) / Real.exp (-k) :=
        div_pos hdepth_pos (Real.exp_pos _)
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hdepth_pos) (hMod_nonneg _))
        (mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hNk) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hrat_pos β₁)))
  
  have h20_lt_exp3 : (20 : ℝ) < Real.exp 3 := by
    have he1 : (2.718 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 := lt_trans (by norm_num) Real.exp_one_gt_d9
    have he2 : (2.718 : ℝ) * 2.718 < Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by nlinarith
    have he3_val : (20 : ℝ) < (2.718 * 2.718) * 2.718 := by norm_num
    have he3 : Real.exp 3 = (Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1) * Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [show (3 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 + 1 by norm_num, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
    rw [he3]
    nlinarith
  have hConeDom : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k x : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x ≤
          Real.exp 1 * (1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (Nat.ceil (k - criticalDepthThreshold S) + 5),
            Real.exp (-β₁ * ((n : ℝ) - 3)) *
              (tileSupModulus S (max 3 (L + 1))
                (max (criticalDepthThreshold S) (k + 3 - (n : ℝ))) x / N k)) := by
    intro N hN k x hk
    have hNk : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    have hNk_pos : 0 < N k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNk
    let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
    let A : ℝ := max 3 (L + 1)
    have hA_ge3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ A := le_max_left _ _
    have hA_geL : L ≤ A := le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_right 3 (L + 1))
    have hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A := le_trans (by norm_num) hA_ge3
    let M_lvl : ℕ := Nat.ceil (k - k₀) + 5
    let l_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => max k₀ (k + 3 - (m : ℝ))
    let T_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
      Real.exp (-β₁ * ((m : ℝ) - 3)) * (tileSupModulus S A (l_fn m) x / N k)
    have hTile_nonneg : ∀ l : ℝ, 0 ≤ tileSupModulus S A l x := by
      intro l
      unfold tileSupModulus
      apply mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro y ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
      exact hMod_nonneg z
    have hT_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ T_fn m := by
      intro m
      exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
        (div_nonneg (hTile_nonneg (l_fn m)) (le_of_lt hNk_pos))
    have hSum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, T_fn m :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => hT_nonneg m)
    have hTile_bdd : ∀ l : ℝ, BddAbove (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A l x) := by
      intro l
      have hClosed : IsClosed (upperStripTile S A l x) := by
        change IsClosed ({ z : ℂ | 0 ≤ z.im } ∩
          ({ z : ℂ | Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) ≤ S.H - z.im } ∩
            ({ z : ℂ | S.H - z.im ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-l)) } ∩
              { z : ℂ | |z.re - x| ≤ A * (S.H - z.im) })))
        exact (isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          ((isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)).inter
            ((isClosed_le (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter
              (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
                (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)))))
      have hSubStrip : upperStripTile S A l x ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
        intro z hz
        rcases hz with ⟨hz1, hz2, _, _⟩
        have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-l) :=
          mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Real.exp_pos _)
        have hdepth : S.H - z.im = wallDepth S z := rfl
        change |z.im| < S.H
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos, hz2, hdepth]
      have hSubBall : upperStripTile S A l x ⊆
          Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (|x| + A * S.H + S.H) := by

        apply Finset.sum_le_sum

          N2 (fun x => 1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, c_fn n * tileSupModulus S A (l_fn n) x) :=

          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro n _

by
  
  let α₁ : ℝ := 1 - β₁
  have hβ₁_pos : 0 < β₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt hβ hββ₁

    lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (half_pos hε₀_pos) (half_pos S.r_star_pos))

    linarith

    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hctay_pos : 0 < c_tay := half_pos hc₀_pos
  have hctay_lt : c_tay < S.r_star / 2 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (half_lt_self hc₀_pos) hc₀_le_rstar

  have hCtay_ge_coeff : 512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2) ≤ C_tay := le_max_right _ _

      Real.exp (-k) < Real.exp (Real.log δ_min) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hneg_k

      Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le 2 hR₀_pos hdc hsph
    have hiter : iteratedDeriv 2 h_y 0 = 2 * V₀ := by
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero, hh_deriv2, V₀]
    rw [hiter, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat] at hcauchy
    have hfac : (Nat.factorial 2 : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [hfac] at hcauchy
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hR₀_pos 2)).mp hcauchy
    linarith
  have deriv_even_zero : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) →
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, F (-w) = F w) →
      deriv F 0 = 0 := by
    intro F hF_holo hF_even
    have hF_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ F 0 := hF_holo.differentiableAt hBr_nhds
    have hF_at_neg0 : HasDerivAt F (deriv F 0) (-(0 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa using hF_at.hasDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => F (-w)) (deriv F 0 * (-1)) 0 :=
      hF_at_neg0.comp 0 (hasDerivAt_neg (0 : ℂ))
    have hev : (fun w : ℂ => F (-w)) =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] F :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hBr_nhds hF_even
    have heq : deriv F 0 * (-1) = deriv F 0 := by
      rw [← hcomp.deriv, hev.deriv_eq]
    have h2 : (2 : ℂ) * deriv F 0 = 0 := by linear_combination -heq
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  let G₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => h_y w - w ^ 2 * V₀
  let G₁ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope G₀ 0
  let G₂ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope G₁ 0
  let G₃ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope G₂ 0
  let G₄ : ℂ → ℂ := dslope G₃ 0
  have hG₀ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G₀ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    hh_holo.sub ((differentiableOn_id.pow 2).mul (differentiableOn_const V₀))
  have hG₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G₁ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hBr_nhds).mpr hG₀
  have hG₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G₂ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hBr_nhds).mpr hG₁
  have hG₃ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G₃ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hBr_nhds).mpr hG₂
  have hG₄ : DifferentiableOn ℂ G₄ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
    (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope hBr_nhds).mpr hG₃
  have hG₀_zero : G₀ 0 = 0 := by simp [G₀, hh_zero]
  have hmul₁ : ∀ w : ℂ, w * G₁ w = G₀ w := by
    intro w
    have hs := sub_smul_dslope G₀ 0 w
    simpa [G₁, hG₀_zero] using hs
  have hG₀_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, G₀ (-w) = G₀ w := by
    intro w hw
    simp [G₀, hh_even w hw]
  have hG₁_zero : G₁ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [show G₁ 0 = deriv G₀ 0 from dslope_same G₀ 0]
    exact deriv_even_zero G₀ hG₀ hG₀_even
  have hmul₂ : ∀ w : ℂ, w * G₂ w = G₁ w := by
    intro w
    have hs := sub_smul_dslope G₁ 0 w
    simpa [G₂, hG₁_zero] using hs
  have hG₀_eq_sq : ∀ w : ℂ, w ^ 2 * G₂ w = G₀ w := by
    intro w
    calc
      w ^ 2 * G₂ w = w * (w * G₂ w) := by ring
      _ = w * G₁ w := by rw [hmul₂ w]
      _ = G₀ w := hmul₁ w
  have hG₂_zero : G₂ 0 = 0 := by
    have hG₂_der_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv G₂) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      hG₂.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hh_der_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv h_y) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
      hh_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hd1_ev : deriv G₀ =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => 2 * z * G₂ z + z ^ 2 * deriv G₂ z) := by
      filter_upwards [hBr_nhds] with z hz
      have hG₂_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ G₂ z :=
        hG₂.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
      have hd_prod : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 * G₂ w)
          ((2 * z ^ (2 - 1)) * G₂ z + z ^ 2 * deriv G₂ z) z :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 z).mul hG₂_at.hasDerivAt
      have hfun : G₀ = (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 * G₂ w) := funext fun w => (hG₀_eq_sq w).symm
      rw [hfun, hd_prod.deriv]
      ring
    have hd1_at0 : deriv (deriv G₀) 0 = 2 * G₂ 0 := by
      rw [hd1_ev.deriv_eq]
      have hG₂_0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ G₂ 0 := hG₂.differentiableAt hBr_nhds
      have hdG₂_0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv G₂) 0 := hG₂_der_holo.differentiableAt hBr_nhds
      have ht1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => 2 * z * G₂ z)
          ((2 * 1) * G₂ 0 + (2 * 0) * deriv G₂ 0) 0 :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul (2 : ℂ)).mul hG₂_0.hasDerivAt
      have ht2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z ^ 2 * deriv G₂ z)
          ((2 * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 - 1)) * deriv G₂ 0 + (0 : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv G₂) 0) 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (0 : ℂ)).mul hdG₂_0.hasDerivAt
      have ht_sum : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => 2 * z * G₂ z + z ^ 2 * deriv G₂ z)
          (((2 * 1) * G₂ 0 + (2 * 0) * deriv G₂ 0) +
            ((2 * (0 : ℂ) ^ (2 - 1)) * deriv G₂ 0 + (0 : ℂ) ^ 2 * deriv (deriv G₂) 0)) 0 :=
        ht1.add ht2
      rw [ht_sum.deriv]
      ring
    have hd2_ev : deriv G₀ =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun z : ℂ => deriv h_y z - 2 * z * V₀) := by
      filter_upwards [hBr_nhds] with z hz
      have hh_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ h_y z :=
        hh_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
      have hsub : HasDerivAt G₀ (deriv h_y z - (2 * z ^ (2 - 1)) * V₀) z :=
        hh_at.hasDerivAt.sub ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 z).mul_const V₀)
      rw [hsub.deriv]
      ring
    have hd2_at0 : deriv (deriv G₀) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hd2_ev.deriv_eq]
      have hdh_0 : DifferentiableAt ℂ (deriv h_y) 0 := hh_der_holo.differentiableAt hBr_nhds
      have ht : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => deriv h_y z - 2 * z * V₀)
          (deriv (deriv h_y) 0 - (2 * (1 : ℂ)) * V₀) 0 :=
        hdh_0.hasDerivAt.sub (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℂ)).const_mul (2 : ℂ)).mul_const V₀)
      rw [ht.deriv, hh_deriv2]
      dsimp [V₀]
      ring
    have h2G₂ : (2 : ℂ) * G₂ 0 = 0 := by rw [← hd1_at0, hd2_at0]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2G₂).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  have hmul₃ : ∀ w : ℂ, w * G₃ w = G₂ w := by
    intro w
    have hs := sub_smul_dslope G₂ 0 w
    simpa [G₃, hG₂_zero] using hs
  have hG₂_even : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, G₂ (-w) = G₂ w := by
    intro w hw
    by_cases hw0 : w = 0
    · simp [hw0]
    · apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hw0)
      calc
        w ^ 2 * G₂ (-w) = (-w) ^ 2 * G₂ (-w) := by ring
        _ = G₀ (-w) := hG₀_eq_sq (-w)
        _ = G₀ w := hG₀_even w hw
        _ = w ^ 2 * G₂ w := (hG₀_eq_sq w).symm
  have hG₃_zero : G₃ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [show G₃ 0 = deriv G₂ 0 from dslope_same G₂ 0]
    exact deriv_even_zero G₂ hG₂ hG₂_even
  have hmul₄ : ∀ w : ℂ, w * G₄ w = G₃ w := by
    intro w
    have hs := sub_smul_dslope G₃ 0 w
    simpa [G₄, hG₃_zero] using hs
  have hG₀_eq_quart : ∀ w : ℂ, w ^ 4 * G₄ w = G₀ w := by
    intro w
    calc
      w ^ 4 * G₄ w = w ^ 2 * (w * (w * G₄ w)) := by ring
      _ = w ^ 2 * (w * G₃ w) := by rw [hmul₄ w]
      _ = w ^ 2 * G₂ w := by rw [hmul₃ w]
      _ = G₀ w := hG₀_eq_sq w
  have hG₄_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ G₄ (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) :=
    hG₄.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR₀_lt)
  have hG₄_front : ∀ z ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀), ‖G₄ z‖ ≤ 2 * M_err / R₀ ^ 4 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) hR₀_pos.ne'] at hz
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = R₀ := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hz
    have hprod : R₀ ^ 4 * ‖G₄ z‖ ≤ 2 * M_err := by
      calc
        R₀ ^ 4 * ‖G₄ z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ 4 * ‖G₄ z‖ := by rw [hz_norm]
        _ = ‖z ^ 4 * G₄ z‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        _ = ‖G₀ z‖ := by rw [hG₀_eq_quart z]
        _ = ‖h_y z - z ^ 2 * V₀‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ ‖h_y z‖ + ‖z ^ 2 * V₀‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖h_y z‖ + R₀ ^ 2 * ‖V₀‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz_norm]
        _ ≤ M_err + M_err := add_le_add (hh_bound z (le_of_eq hz_norm)) hV₀_bound
        _ = 2 * M_err := by ring
    exact (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hR₀_pos 4)).mpr (by linarith)

  
  let z_par : ℝ := |t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)
  have hz_pos : 0 < z_par := div_pos (mul_pos ht_pos hNk_pos) hexp_pos
  have ht_le_half_r : |t| ≤ r / 2 := by
