      dsimp [z_par, r, B]
      field_simp [hNk_pos.ne', hexp_pos.ne', hc₀_pos.ne', hb_pos.ne']
    have hcoef : z_par * b / c₀ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hc₀_pos]
      dsimp [c_tay] at hzb
      linarith
    rw [ht_eq]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoef hr_pos.le
    linarith
  have ht_le_R₀ : |t| ≤ R₀ := by dsimp [R₀]; linarith
  have ht_lt_r : |t| < r := lt_of_le_of_lt ht_le_R₀ hR₀_lt
  have ht_norm : ‖(t : ℂ)‖ = |t| := Complex.norm_real t
  have ht_cl : (t : ℂ) ∈ closure (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R₀) := by
    rw [closure_ball (0 : ℂ) hR₀_pos.ne', Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, ht_norm]
    exact ht_le_R₀
  have hG₄_t : ‖G₄ (t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * M_err / R₀ ^ 4 :=
    Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hG₄_dc hG₄_front ht_cl
  have hG₀_t_bound : ‖G₀ (t : ℂ)‖ ≤
      (512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-k) * z_par ^ 4 * b ^ 4 := by
    have h1 : ‖G₀ (t : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * M_err * (|t| / R₀) ^ 4 := by
      calc
        ‖G₀ (t : ℂ)‖ = ‖(t : ℂ) ^ 4 * G₄ (t : ℂ)‖ := by rw [hG₀_eq_quart (t : ℂ)]
        _ = |t| ^ 4 * ‖G₄ (t : ℂ)‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, ht_norm]
        _ ≤ |t| ^ 4 * (2 * M_err / R₀ ^ 4) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG₄_t (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) 4)
        _ = 2 * M_err * (|t| / R₀) ^ 4 := by ring
    have h2 : 2 * M_err * (|t| / R₀) ^ 4 =
        (512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-k) * z_par ^ 4 * b ^ 4 := by
      have hrat : |t| / R₀ = 4 * z_par * b / (3 * c₀) := by
        dsimp [z_par, R₀, r, B]
        field_simp [hNk_pos.ne', hexp_pos.ne', hc₀_pos.ne', hb_pos.ne']
      rw [hrat]
      dsimp [M_err]
      field_simp [hc₀_pos.ne']
      ring
    linarith
  have ht_ball_rstar : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, ht_norm]
    exact ht_lt
  have hhX_t_bounds := S.h_X_bounds (t : ℂ) ht_ball_rstar
  have hy_im_lt_hX : y.im < S.h_X (t : ℂ) := by
    rw [hy_im]
    linarith [hΔ, hexp_pos]
  have hyt_tube : (y, (t : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hy_im_lt_hX⟩
    · rw [ht_norm]; exact ht_lt
    · rw [Complex.conj_ofReal]
      linarith [hhX_t_bounds.1, S.s_star_pos, hy_im_pos]
  have ht_ball_r : (t : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, ht_norm]
    exact ht_lt_r
  have hhy_t_eq : h_y (t : ℂ) = S.𝔰 (y, (t : ℂ)) - y := by
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hy_cone_mem (t : ℂ) ht_ball_r
    have heq := (hs_props (y, (t : ℂ)) hc1 hc2 hc3 hc4).2.2.2.2 hyt_tube
    dsimp [h_y]
    rw [heq]
  have hstrip_at_t : (S.𝔰 (y, (t : ℂ)) - y).im ≤ S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) :=
    hStrip t ht_lt y hy_im_pos hy_im_lt_hX
  have ht2_V_im : t ^ 2 * (S.V y).im ≤
      (S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) +
        (512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-k) * z_par ^ 4 * b ^ 4 := by
    have hG₀_im : (G₀ (t : ℂ)).im = (S.𝔰 (y, (t : ℂ)) - y).im - t ^ 2 * (S.V y).im := by
      dsimp [G₀, V₀]
      rw [hhy_t_eq, Complex.sub_im, ← Complex.ofReal_pow t 2, Complex.im_ofReal_mul]
    have hneg_im : -(G₀ (t : ℂ)).im ≤ ‖G₀ (t : ℂ)‖ :=
      le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _)
    linarith
  have ht2_pos : 0 < t ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs]

  have hΔ_nonneg : 0 ≤ S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) := by linarith [hhX_t_bounds.2]
  let R_num : ℝ := (S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) +
    (512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-k) * z_par ^ 4 * b ^ 4

    positivity

      _ ≤ (Real.exp (-k) / (N k) ^ 2) * (R_num / t ^ 2) := h1
  have halg_split : (Real.exp (-k) / (N k) ^ 2) * (R_num / t ^ 2) =
      ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2 +
        (512 * C_cp / (9 * c₀ ^ 2)) * (z_par ^ 2 * b ^ 4) := by
    have hz2_eq : z_par ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2 / (Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [z_par]
      rw [div_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]
    have hz4_eq : z_par ^ 4 = z_par ^ 2 * z_par ^ 2 := by ring
    dsimp [R_num]
    rw [hz4_eq, hz2_eq]
    field_simp [hexp_pos.ne', hNk_pos.ne', ht2_pos.ne']
  have hterm1_nn : 0 ≤ ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (div_nonneg hΔ_nonneg hexp_pos.le) (sq_nonneg z_par)
  have hterm2_nn : 0 ≤ z_par ^ 2 * b ^ 4 := by positivity
  calc
    Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2
        ≤ ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2 +

    _ ≤ C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2) +
          C_tay * (z_par ^ 2 * b ^ 4) := by

          calc

            _ ≤ C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2) :=

    _ = C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z_par ^ 2 + z_par ^ 2 * b ^ 4) := by

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (β a C_N C₁ δ_b L β₁ L_tr δ_star_tr C_b1 K_tay c_tay C_tay : ℝ)
    (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hββ₁ : β < β₁) (hβ₁ : β₁ < 1 / 2) (ha : 0 < a) (hCN : 1 ≤ C_N) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁)
    (hδb_pos : 0 < δ_b) (hδb_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2)
    (hLtr_pos : 0 < L_tr) (hLtr_le : L_tr ≤ L)
    (hδtr_pos : 0 < δ_star_tr) (hδtr_lt : δ_star_tr < δ_b)
    (hCb1_pos : 0 < C_b1)
    (hKtay : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_tay)
    (hctay_pos : 0 < c_tay) (hctay_lt : c_tay < S.r_star / 2)
    (hCtay_pos : 0 < C_tay)
    (hTransAt : ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
      ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < min d₀ (δ_star_tr / 4) →
        0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
        (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
          |s.re - x₀| ≤ L_tr * wallDepth S s →
          r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ (1 - β₁)) →
        ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < S.r_star → |t| ≤ r / 2 →
          S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ 2 * d)
    (hConeProps : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Continuous (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) ∧
        Function.Periodic (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x)
    (hConeL1 : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x) ≤ C_b1)
    (hTay : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k x t : ℝ, K_tay ≤ k → 0 < |t| → |t| < S.r_star →
        (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) * bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x ≤ c_tay →
        S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ Real.exp (-k) / 2 →
        Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤
          C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) /
            (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 +
            (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x) ^ 4)) :
    ∃ c_w z₀ C_w C_neg : ℝ,

        have hexp_eq : Real.exp (-k) = 2 * d := by dsimp [d]; ring
        have h1 : c_w * Real.exp (-k) ≤ (ε_tr / (4 * M_b1)) * (2 * d) := by
          rw [hexp_eq]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcw_le_tr (by positivity)
        have h2 : c_w * Real.exp (-k) / N k ≤ ((ε_tr / (4 * M_b1)) * (2 * d)) / N k :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hNk_pos)
        have h3 : ((ε_tr / (4 * M_b1)) * (2 * d)) / N k = r / 2 := by
          dsimp [r]; field_simp; ring
        linarith
      have h_res := hTr d x₀ r ε_tr hd_pos hd_lt_dlim hr_pos hr_le_d
        hε_tr_pos hε_tr_le_ε₀ h_cone_tr t ht_lt_rstar ht_le_half_r
      have h2d : 2 * d = Real.exp (-k) := by dsimp [d]; ring
      linarith
  
  
  
  let γ : ℝ := 1 / (1 + a)
  have h1a_pos : 0 < 1 + a := by linarith
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := one_div_pos.mpr h1a_pos
  have hγ_lt_one : γ < 1 := by
    dsimp [γ]; rw [div_lt_one h1a_pos]; linarith
  have hCN_pos : 0 < C_N := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCN
  let z₀ : ℝ := c_w / C_N
  have hz₀_pos : 0 < z₀ := div_pos hcw_pos hCN_pos
  let C_w : ℝ := (C_N / c_w) ^ γ
  have hCw_pos : 0 < C_w := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hCN_pos hcw_pos) γ
  have hWidthHolder : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k t : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        |t| < S.r_star →
        |t| * N k / Real.exp (-k) ≤ z₀ →
        S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤
          C_w * Real.exp (-k) * (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ (1 / (1 + a)) := by
    intro N hN k t hk _ hz_le
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst ht0
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, S.h_X_zero, sub_self, abs_zero, zero_mul, zero_div]
      change (0 : ℝ) ≤ C_w * Real.exp (-k) * (0 : ℝ) ^ γ
      rw [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hγ_pos), mul_zero]
    · have ht_pos : 0 < |t| := abs_pos.mpr ht0
      have hNk_pos : 0 < N k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hN.one_le k hk)
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
      let z : ℝ := |t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)
      have hz_pos : 0 < z := by positivity
      let u : ℝ := (C_N / c_w) * z
      have hu_pos : 0 < u := by positivity
      have hu_le_one : u ≤ 1 := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz_le (by positivity : 0 ≤ C_N / c_w)
        have hcancel : (C_N / c_w) * z₀ = 1 := by dsimp [z₀]; field_simp
        linarith
      have hlog_nonpos : Real.log u ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos (le_of_lt hu_pos) hu_le_one
      let h : ℝ := -γ * Real.log u
      have hh_nonneg : 0 ≤ h := by nlinarith
      let j : ℝ := k + h
      have hk_le_j : k ≤ j := by dsimp [j]; linarith
      have hj_ge_k₀ : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j := le_trans hk hk_le_j
      have hNj_pos : 0 < N j := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hN.one_le j hj_ge_k₀)
      have hNj_fine : N j ≤ C_N * N k * Real.exp (a * (j - k)) :=
        hN.fine_bound j k hk hk_le_j
      have hexp_j_id :
          c_w * Real.exp (-j) = |t| * (C_N * N k * Real.exp (a * (j - k))) := by
        have hexp_arg : -j = (-k + Real.log u) + a * (j - k) := by
          dsimp [j, h, γ]
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [hexp_arg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hu_pos]
        dsimp [u, z]
        field_simp
      have ht_j : |t| ≤ c_w * Real.exp (-j) / N j := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hNj_pos, hexp_j_id]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNj_fine (le_of_lt ht_pos)
      have h_lev := hWidthLevel N hN j t hj_ge_k₀ ht_j
      have hexp_j_rpow :
          Real.exp (-j) = C_w * Real.exp (-k) * z ^ (1 / (1 + a)) := by
        have harg : -j = -k + Real.log u * γ := by dsimp [j, h]; ring
        rw [harg, Real.exp_add, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos hu_pos]
        dsimp [u, C_w, γ]
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
        ring
      linarith
  
  
  
  let m : ℝ := 4 * (2 - γ) / (4 - γ)
  have h4γ_pos : 0 < 4 - γ := by linarith
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    have h2γ_pos : 0 < 2 - γ := by linarith
    positivity
  let R_shal : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ
      Set.Icc (S.H - Real.exp (-k₀)) (S.H - Real.exp (-K_tay))
  let K_shal : Set ℂ := φ '' R_shal
  have hKshal_compact : IsCompact K_shal := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hφ_cont
  have hexp_k₀_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have hSH20 : 0 < S.H / 20 := by linarith [S.H_pos]
    rw [← Real.exp_log hSH20]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
  have hKshal_sub : K_shal ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
    rintro z ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨_, hv1, hv2⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [φ, horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-K_tay)]⟩
  obtain ⟨M_V0, hM_V0⟩ :=
    hKshal_compact.bddAbove_image (S.V_holo.continuousOn.norm.mono hKshal_sub)
  let M_V : ℝ := max M_V0 0
  have hMV_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_V := le_max_right _ _
  have hShal_bound : ∀ k x : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → k ≤ K_tay →
      max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 ≤ M_V := by
    intro k x hk_lo hk_hi
    have hexp_k_le : Real.exp (-k) ≤ Real.exp (-k₀) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have hexp_Ktay_le : Real.exp (-K_tay) ≤ Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => S.V (bootRowPt S k u)
    have hg_per : Function.Periodic g (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro u
      have hu_mem : bootRowPt S k u ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        simp only [bootRowPt, horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
        exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-k)]⟩
      have hpt_eq : bootRowPt S k (u + 2 * Real.pi) = bootRowPt S k u + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [bootRowPt]; push_cast; ring
      dsimp [g]
      rw [hpt_eq]
      exact S.V_periodic (bootRowPt S k u) hu_mem
    let n : ℤ := ⌊x / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x' : ℝ := x - (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have hx'_eq : g x' = g x := hg_per.sub_int_mul_eq n
    have hx'_lo : 0 ≤ x' := by
      have hfl : (n : ℝ) ≤ x / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le (x / (2 * Real.pi))
      have hmul : (n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp hfl
      dsimp [x']; linarith
    have hx'_hi : x' ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have hfl : x / (2 * Real.pi) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / (2 * Real.pi))
      have hmul : x < ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi) := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi_pos).mp hfl
      dsimp [x']; linarith
    have hpt_mem : bootRowPt S k x' ∈ K_shal :=
      ⟨(x', S.H - Real.exp (-k)), ⟨⟨hx'_lo, hx'_hi⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    have hnorm_le : ‖g x‖ ≤ M_V := by
      rw [← hx'_eq]
      exact le_trans (hM_V0 ⟨bootRowPt S k x', hpt_mem, rfl⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    exact max_le (le_trans (Complex.im_le_norm _) hnorm_le) hMV_nonneg
  let w_cap : ℝ := ((2 * C_w)⁻¹) ^ (1 + a)
  have hw_cap_pos : 0 < w_cap := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) (1 + a)
  let c_opt : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap)
  have hcopt_pos : 0 < c_opt := by
    have hmin : 0 < min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap) :=
      lt_min (lt_min S.r_star_pos hz₀_pos) (lt_min hctay_pos hw_cap_pos)
    dsimp [c_opt]; linarith
  have hcopt_lt_rstar : c_opt < S.r_star := by
    have h1 : min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap) ≤ min S.r_star z₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have h2 : min S.r_star z₀ ≤ S.r_star := min_le_left _ _
    dsimp [c_opt]; linarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have hcopt_le_z₀ : c_opt ≤ z₀ := by
    have h1 : min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap) ≤ min S.r_star z₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have h2 : min S.r_star z₀ ≤ z₀ := min_le_right _ _
    dsimp [c_opt]; linarith
  have hcopt_le_ctay : c_opt ≤ c_tay := by
    have h1 : min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap) ≤ min c_tay w_cap := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : min c_tay w_cap ≤ c_tay := min_le_left _ _
    dsimp [c_opt]; linarith
  have hcopt_le_wcap : c_opt ≤ w_cap := by
    have h1 : min (min S.r_star z₀) (min c_tay w_cap) ≤ min c_tay w_cap := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : min c_tay w_cap ≤ w_cap := min_le_right _ _
    dsimp [c_opt]; linarith
  have hCw_copt_half : C_w * c_opt ^ γ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hrpow : c_opt ^ γ ≤ w_cap ^ γ :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hcopt_pos) hcopt_le_wcap (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
    have hwcap_rpow : w_cap ^ γ = (2 * C_w)⁻¹ := by
      dsimp [w_cap, γ]
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), mul_one_div_cancel (ne_of_gt h1a_pos), Real.rpow_one]
    calc
      C_w * c_opt ^ γ ≤ C_w * w_cap ^ γ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow (le_of_lt hCw_pos)
      _ = C_w * (2 * C_w)⁻¹ := by rw [hwcap_rpow]
      _ = 1 / 2 := by field_simp
  let C_neg : ℝ := max (M_V + 1) (C_tay * (C_w * c_opt ^ (γ - 2) + c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ)))
  have hCneg_pos : 0 < C_neg :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : 0 < M_V + 1) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hSubquad : ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
      ∀ k x : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
        Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤
          C_neg * (bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x) ^
            (4 * (2 - 1 / (1 + a)) / (4 - 1 / (1 + a))) := by
    intro N hN k x hk
    let b : ℝ := bootConeCost S δ_b L β₁ N k x
    have hb_ge_one : 1 ≤ b := (hConeProps N hN k hk).2.2 x
    have hb_pos : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hb_ge_one
    have hk_ge_one : 1 ≤ k := le_trans hk₀_ge_one hk
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    have hexp_le_one : Real.exp (-k) ≤ 1 := by
      simpa using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith : -k ≤ 0)
    have hNk_ge_one : 1 ≤ N k := hN.one_le k hk
    have hNk_pos : 0 < N k := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNk_ge_one
    have hNk_sq_ge_one : 1 ≤ (N k) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    rcases lt_or_ge k K_tay with hk_shal | hk_deep
    · 
      have hmax_le : max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 ≤ M_V :=
        hShal_bound k x hk (le_of_lt hk_shal)
      have hmax_nonneg : 0 ≤ max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hlhs_le_MV :
          Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤ M_V := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        have h1 : Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 ≤ 1 * M_V :=
          mul_le_mul hexp_le_one hmax_le hmax_nonneg zero_le_one
        have h2 : 1 * M_V ≤ M_V * (N k) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        linarith
      have hbm_ge_one : 1 ≤ b ^ m := Real.one_le_rpow hb_ge_one (le_of_lt hm_pos)
      have hMV_le_Cneg : M_V + 1 ≤ C_neg := le_max_left _ _
      have hCneg_le : C_neg ≤ C_neg * b ^ m :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_right (le_of_lt hCneg_pos) hbm_ge_one
      change Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤ C_neg * b ^ m
      linarith
    · 
      let θ : ℝ := 4 / (4 - γ)
      have hθ_pos : 0 < θ := div_pos (by norm_num) h4γ_pos
      let z : ℝ := c_opt * b ^ (-θ)
      have hz_pos : 0 < z := mul_pos hcopt_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hb_pos (-θ))
      have hb_negθ_le_one : b ^ (-θ) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hb_ge_one (by linarith)
      have hz_le_copt : z ≤ c_opt := by
        dsimp [z]; nlinarith
      have hz_le_z₀ : z ≤ z₀ := le_trans hz_le_copt hcopt_le_z₀
      let t : ℝ := z * Real.exp (-k) / N k
      have ht_pos : 0 < t := by positivity
      have ht_abs : |t| = t := abs_of_pos ht_pos
      have ht_abs_pos : 0 < |t| := by rw [ht_abs]; exact ht_pos
      have ht_z : |t| * N k / Real.exp (-k) = z := by
        rw [ht_abs]; dsimp [t]; field_simp
      have ht_le_z : |t| ≤ z := by
        rw [ht_abs]
        refine (div_le_iff₀ hNk_pos).mpr ?_
        have h1 : z * Real.exp (-k) ≤ z * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le_one (le_of_lt hz_pos)
        have h2 : z * 1 ≤ z * N k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNk_ge_one (le_of_lt hz_pos)
        linarith
      have ht_lt_rstar : |t| < S.r_star :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans ht_le_z hz_le_copt) hcopt_lt_rstar
      have hzb_le_ctay : (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) * b ≤ c_tay := by
        rw [ht_z]
        have h_exp_neg : -θ + 1 ≤ 0 := by
          have heq : -θ + 1 = -γ / (4 - γ) := by
            dsimp [θ]; field_simp; ring
          rw [heq]
          exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt h4γ_pos)
        have h_b_pow : b ^ (-θ) * b = b ^ (-θ + 1) := by
          conv_lhs => rhs; rw [← Real.rpow_one b]
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hb_pos]
        have h_b_le_one : b ^ (-θ + 1) ≤ 1 :=
          Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hb_ge_one h_exp_neg
        calc
          z * b = c_opt * (b ^ (-θ) * b) := by dsimp [z]; ring
          _ = c_opt * b ^ (-θ + 1) := by rw [h_b_pow]
          _ ≤ c_opt * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_b_le_one (le_of_lt hcopt_pos)
          _ = c_opt := mul_one _
          _ ≤ c_tay := hcopt_le_ctay
      have h_hol := hWidthHolder N hN k t hk ht_lt_rstar (by rw [ht_z]; exact hz_le_z₀)
      rw [ht_z] at h_hol
      have h_hol_γ : S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ C_w * Real.exp (-k) * z ^ γ := h_hol
      have h_def_half : S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ) ≤ Real.exp (-k) / 2 := by
        have hz_rpow : z ^ γ ≤ c_opt ^ γ :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt hz_pos) hz_le_copt (le_of_lt hγ_pos)
        have h1 : C_w * z ^ γ ≤ 1 / 2 :=
          le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz_rpow (le_of_lt hCw_pos)) hCw_copt_half
        have h2 : C_w * Real.exp (-k) * z ^ γ = (C_w * z ^ γ) * Real.exp (-k) := by ring
        have h3 : (C_w * z ^ γ) * Real.exp (-k) ≤ (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-k) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hexp_pos)
        linarith
      have h_tay_raw := hTay N hN k x t hk_deep ht_abs_pos ht_lt_rstar hzb_le_ctay h_def_half
      change Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤
        C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) /
          (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 +
          (|t| * N k / Real.exp (-k)) ^ 2 * b ^ 4) at h_tay_raw
      rw [ht_z] at h_tay_raw
      have h_div_exp : (S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k) ≤ C_w * z ^ γ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hexp_pos]
        linarith
      have h_term1_le :
          ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z ^ 2 ≤ C_w * (z ^ γ / z ^ 2) := by
        calc
          ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z ^ 2
              ≤ (C_w * z ^ γ) / z ^ 2 :=
                div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_div_exp (sq_nonneg z)
          _ = C_w * (z ^ γ / z ^ 2) := by ring
      have h_id1 : z ^ γ / z ^ (2 : ℕ) = c_opt ^ (γ - 2) * b ^ m := by
        have h2 : z ^ (2 : ℕ) = z ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
        rw [h2, ← Real.rpow_sub hz_pos]
        dsimp [z]
        rw [Real.mul_rpow (le_of_lt hcopt_pos) (le_of_lt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hb_pos (-θ))),
          ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hb_pos)]
        have hexp1 : (-θ) * (γ - 2) = m := by dsimp [θ, m]; ring
        rw [hexp1]
      have h_id2 : z ^ (2 : ℕ) * b ^ (4 : ℕ) = c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ) * b ^ m := by
        have hsq : z ^ (2 : ℕ) * b ^ (4 : ℕ) =
            c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ) * ((b ^ (-θ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) * b ^ (4 : ℕ)) := by
          dsimp [z]; ring
        rw [hsq]
        have hb2 : (b ^ (-θ)) ^ (2 : ℕ) = (b ^ (-θ)) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
        have hb4 : b ^ (4 : ℕ) = b ^ (4 : ℝ) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
        rw [hb2, hb4, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hb_pos), ← Real.rpow_add hb_pos]
        have hexp2 : (-θ) * 2 + 4 = m := by dsimp [θ, m]; field_simp; ring
        rw [hexp2]
      have h_rhs_le :
          C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * b ^ 4) ≤
            C_neg * b ^ m := by
        have hsum :
            ((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * b ^ 4 ≤
              (C_w * c_opt ^ (γ - 2) + c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ)) * b ^ m := by
          have := add_le_add_right h_term1_le (z ^ 2 * b ^ 4)
          rw [h_id1, h_id2] at this
          linarith
        calc
          C_tay * (((S.H - S.h_X (t : ℂ)) / Real.exp (-k)) / z ^ 2 + z ^ 2 * b ^ 4)
              ≤ C_tay * ((C_w * c_opt ^ (γ - 2) + c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ)) * b ^ m) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (le_of_lt hCtay_pos)
          _ = (C_tay * (C_w * c_opt ^ (γ - 2) + c_opt ^ (2 : ℕ))) * b ^ m := by ring
          _ ≤ C_neg * b ^ m :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _)
                  (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hb_pos) m)
      change Real.exp (-k) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S k x)).im) 0 / (N k) ^ 2 ≤ C_neg * b ^ m
      exact le_trans h_tay_raw h_rhs_le
  
  
  
  exact ⟨c_w, z₀, C_w, C_neg, hcw_pos, hcw_lt_half_r, hz₀_pos, hCw_pos, hCneg_pos,
    hWidthLevel, hWidthHolder, hSubquad⟩

(hSfca : SfcaVolterraKernelProp) :

signature.name: volterra_ode_uniqueness_wronskian_and_lip
signature.statement:
(hSfca : SfcaVolterraKernelProp) :
    VolterraODEProp ∧ VolterraLipHoloProp

proof.tactics:
by
  have hIterEq : ∀ (Q init : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ),
      volterraIter Q init m w = sfcaVolterraIter init Q m w := by
    intro Q init m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro w
      rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro w
      simp only [volterraIter, sfcaVolterraIter, ih]
  have hc0_eq : c0Kernel = sfcaVolterraC := by
    funext Q w
    simp only [c0Kernel, sfcaVolterraC, hIterEq]
  have hk0_eq : k0Kernel = sfcaVolterraK := by
    funext Q w
    simp only [k0Kernel, sfcaVolterraK, hIterEq]
  have hc0d_eq : c0Deriv = sfcaVolterraCDeriv := by
    funext Q w
    simp only [c0Deriv, sfcaVolterraCDeriv, hc0_eq]
  have hk0d_eq : k0Deriv = sfcaVolterraKDeriv := by
    funext Q w
    simp only [k0Deriv, sfcaVolterraKDeriv, hk0_eq]

  have hIntIcc : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume 0 u := by
    intro f hf u hu
    apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu.1]
    exact hf.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hu.2)

  have hPrimDerivWithin : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f v) (f w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
    intro f hf w hw
    let clamp : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => max 0 (min 1 t)
    have hclamp_cont : Continuous clamp :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
    have hclamp_mem : ∀ t : ℝ, clamp t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun t => ⟨le_max_left 0 (min 1 t), max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 t)⟩
    have hclamp_id : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, clamp t = t := by
      intro t ht
      dsimp [clamp]
      rw [min_eq_right ht.2, max_eq_right ht.1]
    let f_ext : ℝ → ℂ := f ∘ clamp
    have hf_ext_cont : Continuous f_ext := hf.comp_continuous hclamp_cont hclamp_mem
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f_ext v) (f_ext w) w :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (hf_ext_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 w)
        (hf_ext_cont.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds w))
        hf_ext_cont.continuousAt
    have hfw : f_ext w = f w := congrArg f (hclamp_id w hw)
    rw [hfw] at hd
    have hdw : HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f_ext v) (f w)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := hd.hasDerivWithinAt
    have h_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f v) = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f_ext v := by
      intro u hu
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v hv
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu.1] at hv
      have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hu.2⟩
      exact (congrArg f (hclamp_id v hv_mem)).symm
    exact hdw.congr h_eq (h_eq w hw)

  have hPrimContOn : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    fun f hf w hw => (hPrimDerivWithin f hf w hw).continuousWithinAt

  have hKernelSplit : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f v) =
          (u : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, f v) - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * f v := by
    intro f hf u hu
    have hvf_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * f v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hf
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => (u : ℂ) * f v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 u :=
      hIntIcc _ (continuousOn_const.mul hf) u hu
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * f v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 u :=
      hIntIcc _ hvf_cont u hu
    have h_congr : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * f v) =
        ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u : ℂ) * f v - (v : ℂ) * f v) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v _
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_congr, intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1 h2, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

  have hODE : VolterraODEProp := by
    intro Q hQ
    have hLaws := hSfca.ode_laws Q hQ
    rw [← hc0_eq, ← hk0_eq, ← hc0d_eq, ← hk0d_eq] at hLaws
    rcases hLaws with ⟨hc_cont, hk_cont, hcd_cont, hkd_cont, hfp, hc0, hcd0, hk0, hkd0, hIoo⟩
    refine ⟨hc0, hcd0, hk0, hkd0, hc_cont, hcd_cont, hk_cont, hkd_cont, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      let g_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Q v * c0Kernel Q v
      let g_k : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Q v * k0Kernel Q v
      have hg_c : ContinuousOn g_c (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ.mul hc_cont
      have hg_k : ContinuousOn g_k (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ.mul hk_cont
      have hvg_c : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * g_c v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hg_c
      have hvg_k : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * g_k v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hg_k
      have hcd_dw : HasDerivWithinAt (c0Deriv Q) (Q w * c0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w :=
        hPrimDerivWithin g_c hg_c w hw
      have hkd_dw : HasDerivWithinAt (k0Deriv Q) (Q w * k0Kernel Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
        have h1 := (hasDerivWithinAt_const w (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (1 : ℂ)).add
          (hPrimDerivWithin g_k hg_k w hw)
        have h_val : (0 : ℂ) + g_k w = Q w * k0Kernel Q w := zero_add _
        rw [h_val] at h1
        exact h1
      have hid_dw : HasDerivWithinAt (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
        have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id w).ofReal_comp.hasDerivWithinAt (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        rw [Complex.ofReal_one] at h1
        exact h1
      have hc_dw : HasDerivWithinAt (c0Kernel Q) (c0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
        let F_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
          1 + ((u : ℂ) * c0Deriv Q u - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * g_c v)
        have hF_dw : HasDerivWithinAt F_c
            ((0 : ℂ) + (((1 : ℂ) * c0Deriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * c0Kernel Q w)) -
              (w : ℂ) * g_c w))
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w :=
          (hasDerivWithinAt_const w (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (1 : ℂ)).add
            ((hid_dw.mul hcd_dw).sub (hPrimDerivWithin _ hvg_c w hw))
        have h_val : (0 : ℂ) + (((1 : ℂ) * c0Deriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * c0Kernel Q w)) -
            (w : ℂ) * g_c w) = c0Deriv Q w := by
          dsimp [g_c]
          ring
        rw [h_val] at hF_dw
        have hc_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, c0Kernel Q u = F_c u := by
          intro u hu
          have hfp_c := (hfp u hu).1
          have h_assoc : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * c0Kernel Q v) =
              ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * g_c v := by
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
            intro v _
            dsimp [g_c]
            ring
          rw [hfp_c, h_assoc, hKernelSplit g_c hg_c u hu]
          rfl
        exact hF_dw.congr hc_eq (hc_eq w hw)
      have hk_dw : HasDerivWithinAt (k0Kernel Q) (k0Deriv Q w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
        let F_k : ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
          (u : ℂ) * k0Deriv Q u - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * g_k v
        have hF_dw : HasDerivWithinAt F_k
            (((1 : ℂ) * k0Deriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * k0Kernel Q w)) - (w : ℂ) * g_k w)
            (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w :=
          (hid_dw.mul hkd_dw).sub (hPrimDerivWithin _ hvg_k w hw)
        have h_val : ((1 : ℂ) * k0Deriv Q w + (w : ℂ) * (Q w * k0Kernel Q w)) -
            (w : ℂ) * g_k w = k0Deriv Q w := by
          dsimp [g_k]
          ring
        rw [h_val] at hF_dw
        have hk_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, k0Kernel Q u = F_k u := by
          intro u hu
          have hfp_k := (hfp u hu).2
          have h_assoc : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * k0Kernel Q v) =
              ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * g_k v := by
            apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
            intro v _
            dsimp [g_k]
            ring
          rw [hfp_k, h_assoc, hKernelSplit g_k hg_k u hu]
          dsimp [F_k, k0Deriv, g_k]
          ring
        exact hF_dw.congr hk_eq (hk_eq w hw)
      exact ⟨hc_dw, hcd_dw, hk_dw, hkd_dw⟩
    · intro y y' hy_cont hy'_cont hy_ode
      let u : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => y w - (y 0 * c0Kernel Q w + y' 0 * k0Kernel Q w)
      let u' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => y' w - (y 0 * c0Deriv Q w + y' 0 * k0Deriv Q w)
      have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := by simp [u, hc0, hk0]
      have hu'0 : u' 0 = 0 := by simp [u', hcd0, hkd0]
      have hu_cont : ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hy_cont.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hc_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hk_cont))
      have hu'_cont : ContinuousOn u' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hy'_cont.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hcd_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hkd_cont))
      have hu_Ioo : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt u (u' x) x ∧ HasDerivAt u' (Q x * u x) x := by
        intro x hx
        have hx_mem : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
        have hnhds : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds x := Icc_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2
        have hy_d : HasDerivAt y (y' x) x := (hy_ode x hx_mem).1.hasDerivAt hnhds
        have hy'_d : HasDerivAt y' (Q x * y x) x := (hy_ode x hx_mem).2.hasDerivAt hnhds
        obtain ⟨hc_d, hcd_d, hk_d, hkd_d⟩ := hIoo x hx
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt u
            (y' x - (y 0 * c0Deriv Q x + y' 0 * k0Deriv Q x)) x :=
          hy_d.sub ((hc_d.const_mul (y 0)).add (hk_d.const_mul (y' 0)))
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt u'
            (Q x * y x - (y 0 * (Q x * c0Kernel Q x) + y' 0 * (Q x * k0Kernel Q x))) x :=
          hy'_d.sub ((hcd_d.const_mul (y 0)).add (hkd_d.const_mul (y' 0)))
        have h_val2 : Q x * y x - (y 0 * (Q x * c0Kernel Q x) + y' 0 * (Q x * k0Kernel Q x)) =
            Q x * u x := by
          dsimp [u]
          ring
        rw [h_val2] at hd2
        exact ⟨hd1, hd2⟩
      have hu'_int : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u' w = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * u v := by
        intro w hw
        have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
          (hu'_cont.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2))
          (fun x hx => (hu_Ioo x ⟨hx.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 hw.2⟩).2)
          (hIntIcc _ (hQ.mul hu_cont) w hw)
        rw [hu'0, sub_zero] at hftc
        exact hftc.symm
      have hu_int : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          u w = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v := by
        intro w hw
        let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => ((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * u' x + u x
        have hΦ_cont : ContinuousOn Φ (Set.Icc 0 w) := by
          have hw_sub : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => ((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc 0 w) :=
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
          exact (hw_sub.mul (hu'_cont.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2))).add
            (hu_cont.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2))
        have hΦ_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 w,
            HasDerivAt Φ (((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q x * u x) x := by
          intro x hx
          have hx_Ioo : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 hw.2⟩
          obtain ⟨hu_d, hu'_d⟩ := hu_Ioo x hx_Ioo
          have hw_d : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ((w - t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-1 : ℂ) x := by
            have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_const x w).sub (hasDerivAt_id x)).ofReal_comp
            have h_eq : ((0 - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) = (-1 : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
            rw [h_eq] at h1
            exact h1
          have hd := (hw_d.mul hu'_d).add hu_d
          have h_val : (-1 : ℂ) * u' x + ((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q x * u x) + u' x =
              ((w - x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q x * u x := by ring
          rw [h_val] at hd
          exact hd
        have h_int : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w := by
          have hw_sub : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
          exact hIntIcc _ ((hw_sub.mul hQ).mul hu_cont) w hw
        have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
          hΦ_cont hΦ_deriv h_int
        have hΦw : Φ w = u w := by simp [Φ]
        have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = 0 := by simp [Φ, hu0, hu'0]
        rw [hΦw, hΦ0, sub_zero] at hftc
        exact hftc.symm
      have hIcc_ne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).Nonempty := ⟨0, le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
      obtain ⟨v_Q, _, hv_Q⟩ :=
        isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_ne (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hQ)
      obtain ⟨v_u, _, hv_u⟩ :=
        isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_ne (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hu_cont)
      let M : ℝ := ‖Q v_Q‖
      let B : ℝ := ‖u v_u‖
      have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := norm_nonneg _
      have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := norm_nonneg _
      have hQ_le : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q v‖ ≤ M := fun v hv => hv_Q hv
      have hu_le : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖u v‖ ≤ B := fun v hv => hv_u hv
      have h_fact : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖u w‖ ≤ B * ((M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
          intro w hw
          simpa using hu_le w hw
        | succ m ih =>
          intro w hw
          rw [hu_int w hw]
          let C_maj : ℝ := B * M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)
          have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
              ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v‖ ≤ C_maj * v ^ m := by
            refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
            have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
            have hwv_nn : 0 ≤ w - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2
            have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
              rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hwv_nn]
              linarith [hv.1, hw.2]
            have hQv := hQ_le v hv_mem
            have huv := ih v hv_mem
            calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * u v‖
                = ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖ * ‖u v‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
              _ ≤ (1 * M) * (B * ((M * v) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ))) := by
                  refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hwv_le hQv (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                    huv (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
              _ = C_maj * v ^ m := by
                  dsimp [C_maj]
                  rw [mul_pow]
                  ring
          have h_maj_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => C_maj * v ^ m)
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow m)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
          have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae h_maj_int
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow,
            zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), sub_zero] at h_int_le
          have h_rhs : C_maj * (w ^ (m + 1) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) =
              B * ((M * w) ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by
            dsimp [C_maj]
            rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_pow]
            have hm1 : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
            have hmf : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
            field_simp [hm1, hmf]
          rwa [h_rhs] at h_int_le
      have hu_zero : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        have h_all : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖u w‖ ≤ B * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) := by
          intro m
          have hMw_le : (M * w) ^ m ≤ M ^ m := by
            refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hM_nn hw.1) ?_ m
            nlinarith [hw.2]
          have h_div_le : (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) ≤ M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hMw_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
          exact le_trans (h_fact m w hw) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div_le hB_nn)
        have h_lim0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M).tendsto_atTop_zero
        have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => B * (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using h_lim0.const_mul B
        exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp (ge_of_tendsto' h_lim h_all)
      intro w hw
      have hy_eq : y w = y 0 * c0Kernel Q w + y' 0 * k0Kernel Q w :=
        sub_eq_zero.mp (hu_zero w hw)
      have hu'_zero : u' w = 0 := by
        rw [hu'_int w hw]
        have h_congr : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q v * u v) = ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..w, (0 : ℂ) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
          intro v hv
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hw.1] at hv
          dsimp only
          rw [hu_zero v ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩, mul_zero]
        rw [h_congr, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      exact ⟨hy_eq, sub_eq_zero.mp hu'_zero⟩
    · intro g g' hg_cont hg'_cont hg_ode
      let W : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => k0Deriv Q w * g w - k0Kernel Q w * g' w
      have hW_cont : ContinuousOn W (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        (hkd_cont.mul hg_cont).sub (hk_cont.mul hg'_cont)
      have hW_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt W 0 x := by
        intro x hx
        have hx_mem : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
        have hnhds : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds x := Icc_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2
        have hg_d : HasDerivAt g (g' x) x := (hg_ode x hx_mem).2.1.hasDerivAt hnhds
        have hg'_d : HasDerivAt g' (Q x * g x) x := (hg_ode x hx_mem).2.2.hasDerivAt hnhds
        obtain ⟨_, _, hk_d, hkd_d⟩ := hIoo x hx
        have hd := (hkd_d.mul hg_d).sub (hk_d.mul hg'_d)
        have h_val : (Q x * k0Kernel Q x) * g x + k0Deriv Q x * g' x -
            (k0Deriv Q x * g' x + k0Kernel Q x * (Q x * g x)) = 0 := by ring
        rw [h_val] at hd
        exact hd
      have hW_const : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, W w = g 0 := by
        intro w hw
        have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hw.1
          (hW_cont.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hw.2))
          (fun x hx => hW_deriv x ⟨hx.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hx.2 hw.2⟩)
          intervalIntegrable_const
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_zero] at hftc
        have hW0 : W 0 = g 0 := by simp [W, hkd0, hk0]
        rw [hW0] at hftc
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hftc.symm
      let q_fn : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => k0Kernel Q w / g w
      have hq_cont : ContinuousOn q_fn (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        hk_cont.div hg_cont (fun w hw => (hg_ode w hw).1)
      have hq_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
          HasDerivAt q_fn (g 0 * (g x)⁻¹ ^ 2) x := by
        intro x hx
        have hx_mem : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
        have hnhds : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∈ nhds x := Icc_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2
        have hg_d : HasDerivAt g (g' x) x := (hg_ode x hx_mem).2.1.hasDerivAt hnhds
        have hk_d : HasDerivAt (k0Kernel Q) (k0Deriv Q x) x := (hIoo x hx).2.2.1
        have hd := hk_d.div hg_d (hg_ode x hx_mem).1
        have hWx : k0Deriv Q x * g x - k0Kernel Q x * g' x = g 0 := hW_const x hx_mem
        have h_val : (k0Deriv Q x * g x - k0Kernel Q x * g' x) / g x ^ 2 =
            g 0 * (g x)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
          rw [hWx, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
        rw [h_val] at hd
        exact hd
      have hg_inv_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℝ => g 0 * (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
        continuousOn_const.mul ((hg_cont.inv₀ (fun w hw => (hg_ode w hw).1)).pow 2)
      have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le zero_le_one
        hq_cont hq_deriv (hIntIcc _ hg_inv_cont 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
      have hq0 : q_fn 0 = 0 := by simp [q_fn, hk0]
      rw [hq0, sub_zero] at hftc
      have hg1_ne : g 1 ≠ 0 := (hg_ode 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
      calc k0Kernel Q 1 = q_fn 1 * g 1 := by
            dsimp [q_fn]
            exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hg1_ne).symm
        _ = (g 0 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2) * g 1 := by rw [← hftc]
        _ = g 0 * g 1 * ∫ w in (0 : ℝ)..1, (g w)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring

  have hLipHolo : VolterraLipHoloProp := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro M Δ Q₁ Q₂ hM hΔ hQ₁ hQ₂ hBds
      have hexp_tsum : (∑' m : ℕ, M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) = Real.exp M :=
        (congr_fun (Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ.trans NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum_div) M).symm
      have hSumExp : Summable (fun m : ℕ => M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) :=
        Real.summable_pow_div_factorial M
      have hSingleIter : ∀ (Q init : ℝ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q v‖ ≤ M) →
          ContinuousOn init (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖init v‖ ≤ 1) →
          (∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (volterraIter Q init m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
            ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
              ‖volterraIter Q init m w‖ ≤ (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ∧
          (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            Summable (fun m : ℕ => volterraIter Q init m w) ∧
            ‖∑' m : ℕ, volterraIter Q init m w‖ ≤ Real.exp M) := by
        intro Q init hQ hQM hinit_c hinit_b
        have h_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (volterraIter Q init m) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
            ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
              ‖volterraIter Q init m w‖ ≤ (M * w) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
          intro m
          induction m with
          | zero =>
            refine ⟨hinit_c, fun w hw => ?_⟩
            simpa [volterraIter] using hinit_b w hw
          | succ m ih =>
            rcases ih with ⟨hm_cont, hm_bd⟩
            let gm : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Q v * volterraIter Q init m v
            have hgm_cont : ContinuousOn gm (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hQ.mul hm_cont
            have hvgm_cont : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => (v : ℂ) * gm v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul hgm_cont
            have h_next_cont : ContinuousOn (volterraIter Q init (m + 1)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
              let F_m : ℝ → ℂ := fun u =>
                (u : ℂ) * (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, gm v) - ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, (v : ℂ) * gm v
              have hF_cont : ContinuousOn F_m (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
                (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn.mul (hPrimContOn gm hgm_cont)).sub
                  (hPrimContOn _ hvgm_cont)
              refine hF_cont.congr (fun u hu => ?_)
              simp only [volterraIter]
              have h_assoc : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u,
                  ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * volterraIter Q init m v) =
                  ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, ((u - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * gm v := by
                apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
                intro v _
                dsimp [gm]
                ring
              rw [h_assoc, hKernelSplit gm hgm_cont u hu]
            refine ⟨h_next_cont, fun w hw => ?_⟩
            simp only [volterraIter]
            let C_maj : ℝ := M ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ)
            have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
                ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * volterraIter Q init m v‖ ≤ C_maj * v ^ m := by
              refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
              have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
              have hwv_nn : 0 ≤ w - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2
              have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
                rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hwv_nn]
                linarith [hv.1, hw.2]
              calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q v * volterraIter Q init m v‖
                  = ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q v‖ * ‖volterraIter Q init m v‖ := by
                      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
                _ ≤ (1 * M) * ((M * v) ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) := by
                    refine mul_le_mul
                      (mul_le_mul hwv_le (hQM v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                      (hm_bd v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
                _ = C_maj * v ^ m := by
                    dsimp [C_maj]
                    rw [mul_pow]
                    ring
            have h_maj_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => C_maj * v ^ m)
                MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow m)).intervalIntegrable 0 w
            have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae h_maj_int
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow,
              zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), sub_zero] at h_int_le
            have h_rhs : C_maj * (w ^ (m + 1) / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) =
                (M * w) ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
              dsimp [C_maj]
              rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_pow]
              have hm1 : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              have hmf : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
              field_simp [hm1, hmf]
            rwa [h_rhs] at h_int_le
        refine ⟨h_ind, fun w hw => ?_⟩
        have h_term_le : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖volterraIter Q init m w‖ ≤ M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
          intro m
          have hMw_le : (M * w) ^ m ≤ M ^ m := by
            refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg hM hw.1) ?_ m
            nlinarith [hw.2]
          exact le_trans ((h_ind m).2 w hw)
            (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hMw_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
        have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖volterraIter Q init m w‖) :=
          Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_term_le hSumExp
        have h_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => volterraIter Q init m w) :=
          hSumExp.of_norm_bounded h_term_le
        have h_tsum_le : ‖∑' m : ℕ, volterraIter Q init m w‖ ≤ Real.exp M := by
          calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, volterraIter Q init m w‖
              ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖volterraIter Q init m w‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
            _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ) :=
                h_sum_norm.tsum_le_tsum h_term_le hSumExp
            _ = Real.exp M := hexp_tsum
        exact ⟨h_sum, h_tsum_le⟩
      have hDiffIter : ∀ (init : ℝ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn init (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖init v‖ ≤ 1) →
          ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            ‖(∑' k : ℕ, volterraIter Q₁ init k w) -
              (∑' k : ℕ, volterraIter Q₂ init k w)‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ := by
        intro init hinit_c hinit_b
        obtain ⟨hInd₁, hSum₁⟩ :=
          hSingleIter Q₁ init hQ₁ (fun v hv => (hBds v hv).1) hinit_c hinit_b
        obtain ⟨hInd₂, hSum₂⟩ :=
          hSingleIter Q₂ init hQ₂ (fun v hv => (hBds v hv).2.1) hinit_c hinit_b
        let d : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun k w => volterraIter Q₁ init k w - volterraIter Q₂ init k w
        have hd_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
            ‖d (m + 1) w‖ ≤ Δ * M ^ m * w ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
          intro m
          induction m with
          | zero =>
            intro w hw
            dsimp [d, volterraIter]
            have hw_sub : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
            have h1_int : IntervalIntegrable
                (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * init v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              hIntIcc _ ((hw_sub.mul hQ₁).mul hinit_c) w hw
            have h2_int : IntervalIntegrable
                (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * init v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              hIntIcc _ ((hw_sub.mul hQ₂).mul hinit_c) w hw
            rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1_int h2_int]
            have h_congr : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w,
                (((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * init v - ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * init v)) =
                ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * init v := by
              apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
              intro v _
              ring
            rw [h_congr]
            have h_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * init v‖ ≤
                Δ * |w - 0| := by
              apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
              intro v hv
              rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hw.1] at hv
              have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
              have hwv_nn : 0 ≤ w - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2
              have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
                rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hwv_nn]
                linarith [hv.1, hw.2]
              calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * init v‖
                  = ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖Q₁ v - Q₂ v‖ * ‖init v‖ := by
                      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
                _ ≤ (1 * Δ) * 1 := by
                    refine mul_le_mul
                      (mul_le_mul hwv_le (hBds v hv_mem).2.2 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                      (hinit_b v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
                _ = Δ := by ring
            have hw_abs : |w - 0| = w := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hw.1]
            rw [hw_abs] at h_le
            simpa using h_le
          | succ m ih =>
            intro w hw
            let u₁ := volterraIter Q₁ init (m + 1)
            let u₂ := volterraIter Q₂ init (m + 1)
            change ‖(∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * u₁ v) -
              (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * u₂ v)‖ ≤
              Δ * M ^ (m + 1) * w ^ (m + 2) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)
            have hw_sub : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn
            have h1_int : IntervalIntegrable
                (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * u₁ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              hIntIcc _ ((hw_sub.mul hQ₁).mul (hInd₁ (m + 1)).1) w hw
            have h2_int : IntervalIntegrable
                (fun v : ℝ => ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * u₂ v) MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              hIntIcc _ ((hw_sub.mul hQ₂).mul (hInd₂ (m + 1)).1) w hw
            rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1_int h2_int]
            let C_m : ℝ := Δ * (M ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) +
              M * (Δ * M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ))
            have h_ae : ∀ᵐ v ∂MeasureTheory.volume, v ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) w →
                ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * u₁ v - ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * u₂ v‖ ≤
                  C_m * v ^ (m + 1) := by
              refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v hv => ?_)
              have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
              have hwv_nn : 0 ≤ w - v := sub_nonneg.mpr hv.2
              have hwv_le : ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
                rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hwv_nn]
                linarith [hv.1, hw.2]
              have h_alg : ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₁ v * u₁ v - ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * Q₂ v * u₂ v =
                  ((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * u₁ v + Q₂ v * d (m + 1) v) := by
                dsimp [d, u₁, u₂]
                ring
              have hu₁_v : ‖u₁ v‖ ≤ (M ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ (m + 1) := by
                have h1 := (hInd₁ (m + 1)).2 v hv_mem
                rwa [mul_pow, ← div_mul_eq_mul_div] at h1
              have hd_v : ‖d (m + 1) v‖ ≤ (Δ * M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ (m + 1) := by
                have h1 := ih v hv_mem
                rwa [← div_mul_eq_mul_div] at h1
              have h_inner : ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * u₁ v + Q₂ v * d (m + 1) v‖ ≤ C_m * v ^ (m + 1) := by
                calc ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * u₁ v + Q₂ v * d (m + 1) v‖
                    ≤ ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * u₁ v‖ + ‖Q₂ v * d (m + 1) v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
                  _ = ‖Q₁ v - Q₂ v‖ * ‖u₁ v‖ + ‖Q₂ v‖ * ‖d (m + 1) v‖ := by
                      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
                  _ ≤ Δ * ((M ^ (m + 1) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ (m + 1)) +
                        M * ((Δ * M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * v ^ (m + 1)) := by
                      refine add_le_add
                        (mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).2.2 hu₁_v (norm_nonneg _) hΔ)
                        (mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).2.1 hd_v (norm_nonneg _) hM)
                  _ = C_m * v ^ (m + 1) := by
                      dsimp [C_m]
                      ring
              rw [h_alg, norm_mul]
              calc ‖((w - v : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ * ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * u₁ v + Q₂ v * d (m + 1) v‖
                  ≤ 1 * (C_m * v ^ (m + 1)) :=
                    mul_le_mul hwv_le h_inner (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
                _ = C_m * v ^ (m + 1) := one_mul _
            have h_maj_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun v : ℝ => C_m * v ^ (m + 1))
                MeasureTheory.volume 0 w :=
              (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow (m + 1))).intervalIntegrable 0 w
            have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hw.1 h_ae h_maj_int
            rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow,
              zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero (m + 1)), sub_zero] at h_int_le
            have h_rhs : C_m * (w ^ (m + 1 + 1) / (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) =
                Δ * M ^ (m + 1) * w ^ (m + 2) / ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
              dsimp [C_m]
              rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
              have hm1 : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              have hm2 : (m : ℝ) + 1 + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              have hmf : (m.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m)
              field_simp [hm1, hm2, hmf]
              ring
            rwa [h_rhs] at h_int_le
        intro w hw
        have hs₁ := (hSum₁ w hw).1
        have hs₂ := (hSum₂ w hw).1
        have hd_sum : Summable (fun k : ℕ => d k w) := hs₁.sub hs₂
        have h_shift : (∑' k : ℕ, volterraIter Q₁ init k w) -
            (∑' k : ℕ, volterraIter Q₂ init k w) = ∑' m : ℕ, d (m + 1) w := by
          rw [← hs₁.tsum_sub hs₂]
          change (∑' k : ℕ, d k w) = ∑' m : ℕ, d (m + 1) w
          rw [hd_sum.tsum_eq_zero_add]
          have hd0 : d 0 w = 0 := sub_self _
          rw [hd0, zero_add]
        rw [h_shift]
        have h_term : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖d (m + 1) w‖ ≤ (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Δ := by
          intro m
          have hw_pow : w ^ (m + 1) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hw.1 hw.2
          calc ‖d (m + 1) w‖
              ≤ Δ * M ^ m * w ^ (m + 1) / (m.factorial : ℝ) := hd_ind m w hw
            _ ≤ Δ * M ^ m * 1 / (m.factorial : ℝ) := by
                refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_pow (by positivity)
            _ = (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Δ := by ring
        have h_sum_maj : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Δ) :=
          hSumExp.mul_right Δ
        have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖d (m + 1) w‖) :=
          Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_term h_sum_maj
        calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, d (m + 1) w‖
            ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖d (m + 1) w‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
          _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Δ :=
              h_sum_norm.tsum_le_tsum h_term h_sum_maj
          _ = (∑' m : ℕ, M ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) * Δ := tsum_mul_right
          _ = Real.exp M * Δ := by rw [hexp_tsum]
      have hinit_1_b : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := fun _ _ => by simp
      have hinit_v_b : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖(v : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        intro v hv
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hv.1]
        exact hv.2
      have hc₁_bd : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖c0Kernel Q₁ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M :=
        fun v hv => ((hSingleIter Q₁ (fun _ => 1) hQ₁ (fun u hu => (hBds u hu).1)
          continuousOn_const hinit_1_b).2 v hv).2
      have hk₁_bd : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖k0Kernel Q₁ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M :=
        fun v hv => ((hSingleIter Q₁ (fun u => (u : ℂ)) hQ₁ (fun u hu => (hBds u hu).1)
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hinit_v_b).2 v hv).2
      have hc_diff : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖c0Kernel Q₁ v - c0Kernel Q₂ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ :=
        hDiffIter (fun _ => 1) continuousOn_const hinit_1_b
      have hk_diff : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖k0Kernel Q₁ v - k0Kernel Q₂ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ :=
        hDiffIter (fun u => (u : ℂ)) Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn hinit_v_b
      have hODE₁ := hODE Q₁ hQ₁
      have hODE₂ := hODE Q₂ hQ₂
      have hc₁_cont : ContinuousOn (c0Kernel Q₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hODE₁.2.2.2.2.1
      have hk₁_cont : ContinuousOn (k0Kernel Q₁) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hODE₁.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      have hc₂_cont : ContinuousOn (c0Kernel Q₂) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hODE₂.2.2.2.2.1
      have hk₂_cont : ContinuousOn (k0Kernel Q₂) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hODE₂.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      intro w hw
      have hw_abs : |w - 0| = w := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hw.1]
      have hcd₁_w : ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ M * Real.exp M := by
        have h_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * c0Kernel Q₁ v‖ ≤
            (M * Real.exp M) * |w - 0| := by
          apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          intro v hv
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hw.1] at hv
          have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).1 (hc₁_bd v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) hM
        rw [hw_abs] at h_le
        exact le_trans h_le (mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg hM (Real.exp_pos M).le) hw.2)
      have hkd₁_w : ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w‖ ≤ 1 + M * Real.exp M := by
        have h_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * k0Kernel Q₁ v‖ ≤
            (M * Real.exp M) * |w - 0| := by
          apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          intro v hv
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hw.1] at hv
          have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).1 (hk₁_bd v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) hM
        rw [hw_abs] at h_le
        have h_int_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * k0Kernel Q₁ v‖ ≤ M * Real.exp M :=
          le_trans h_le (mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg hM (Real.exp_pos M).le) hw.2)
        calc ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w‖
            = ‖(1 : ℂ) + ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * k0Kernel Q₁ v‖ := rfl
          _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * k0Kernel Q₁ v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 + M * Real.exp M := by simp [h_int_le]
      have hDerivDiff : ∀ (y₁ y₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn y₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          ContinuousOn y₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
          (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₁ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M) →
          (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖y₁ v - y₂ v‖ ≤ Real.exp M * Δ) →
          ‖(∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * y₁ v) - (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₂ v * y₂ v)‖ ≤
            (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ := by
        intro y₁ y₂ hy₁_c hy₂_c hy₁_bd hy_diff
        have h1_int := hIntIcc (fun v => Q₁ v * y₁ v) (hQ₁.mul hy₁_c) w hw
        have h2_int := hIntIcc (fun v => Q₂ v * y₂ v) (hQ₂.mul hy₂_c) w hw
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1_int h2_int]
        have h_le : ‖∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, (Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v)‖ ≤
            ((1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ) * |w - 0| := by
          apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
          intro v hv
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hw.1] at hv
          have hv_mem : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1.le, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
          have h_alg : Q₁ v * y₁ v - Q₂ v * y₂ v =
              (Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₁ v + Q₂ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v) := by ring
          rw [h_alg]
          calc ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₁ v + Q₂ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v)‖
              ≤ ‖(Q₁ v - Q₂ v) * y₁ v‖ + ‖Q₂ v * (y₁ v - y₂ v)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖Q₁ v - Q₂ v‖ * ‖y₁ v‖ + ‖Q₂ v‖ * ‖y₁ v - y₂ v‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
            _ ≤ Δ * Real.exp M + M * (Real.exp M * Δ) := by
                refine add_le_add
                  (mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).2.2 (hy₁_bd v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) hΔ)
                  (mul_le_mul (hBds v hv_mem).2.1 (hy_diff v hv_mem) (norm_nonneg _) hM)
            _ = (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ := by ring
        rw [hw_abs] at h_le
        have h_nn : 0 ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ := by positivity
        exact le_trans h_le (mul_le_of_le_one_right h_nn hw.2)
      have hcd_diff_w : ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ :=
        hDerivDiff (c0Kernel Q₁) (c0Kernel Q₂) hc₁_cont hc₂_cont hc₁_bd hc_diff
      have hkd_diff_w : ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ (1 + M) * Real.exp M * Δ := by
        have h_sub : k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w =
            (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₁ v * k0Kernel Q₁ v) -
              (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, Q₂ v * k0Kernel Q₂ v) := by
          dsimp [k0Deriv]
          ring
        rw [h_sub]
        exact hDerivDiff (k0Kernel Q₁) (k0Kernel Q₂) hk₁_cont hk₂_cont hk₁_bd hk_diff
      exact ⟨hc₁_bd w hw, hk₁_bd w hw, hcd₁_w, hkd₁_w,
        hc_diff w hw, hk_diff w hw, hcd_diff_w, hkd_diff_w⟩
    · intro U Q a₀ a₁ hU hQ_cont hQ_holo ha₀ ha₁
      have hPH := hSfca.param_holo U Q hU hQ_cont hQ_holo
      rw [← hc0_eq, ← hk0_eq, ← hc0d_eq, ← hk0d_eq] at hPH
      rcases hPH with ⟨hc_pcont, hk_pcont, hcd_pcont, hkd_pcont, h_slice⟩
      have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
      have hc1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => c0Kernel (Q p) 1) U := (h_slice 1 h1_mem).1
      have hk1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => k0Kernel (Q p) 1) U := (h_slice 1 h1_mem).2.1
      have hPertHolo : ∀ sgn : ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => k0Kernel (pertPotential sgn (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p)) 1) U := by
        intro sgn
        let P_sgn : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun p w => pertPotential sgn (Q p) (a₀ p) (a₁ p) w
        have ha₀_c : ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => a₀ q.1) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          ha₀.continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun _ hq => hq.1)
        have ha₁_c : ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => a₁ q.1) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          ha₁.continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun _ hq => hq.1)
        have hP_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => P_sgn q.1 q.2)
            (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
          dsimp [P_sgn, pertPotential]
          have hFw_c := (ha₀_c.mul hc_pcont).add (ha₁_c.mul hk_pcont)
          have hFpw_c := (ha₀_c.mul hcd_pcont).add (ha₁_c.mul hkd_pcont)
          exact (hQ_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hFpw_c)).sub
            (continuousOn_const.mul (hFw_c.pow 2))
        have hP_holo : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => P_sgn p w) U := by
          intro w hw
          dsimp [P_sgn, pertPotential]
          rcases h_slice w hw with ⟨hc_w, hk_w, hcd_w, hkd_w⟩
          have hFw_h := (ha₀.mul hc_w).add (ha₁.mul hk_w)
          have hFpw_h := (ha₀.mul hcd_w).add (ha₁.mul hkd_w)
          exact ((hQ_holo w hw).sub ((differentiableOn_const _).mul hFpw_h)).sub
            ((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hFw_h.pow 2))
        have hPH_sgn := hSfca.param_holo U P_sgn hU hP_cont hP_holo
        rw [← hk0_eq] at hPH_sgn
        exact (hPH_sgn.2.2.2.2 1 h1_mem).2.1
      exact ⟨hc1_holo, hk1_holo, hPertHolo 1, hPertHolo (-1)⟩

  exact ⟨hODE, hLipHolo⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(hSfca : SfcaVolterraKernelProp)
    (hODE : VolterraODEProp)
    (hLip : VolterraLipHoloProp) :
    (∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 ∧
      kPlusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      kMinusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      canonRoot Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, slNumerator Q (-w₀) (-w₁) = slNumerator Q w₀ w₁) ∧
    (∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
      let b₁' := a₀ * c0Deriv Q 1 + a₁ * k0Deriv Q 1
      canonRoot (fun w => Q (1 - w)) (-b₁) b₁' = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      -a₀ = (-b₁) * c0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 +
        b₁' * k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1) ∧
    (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ u v : ℂ, slNumerator (fun w => Q (1 - w)) u v = slNumerator Q (-v) (-u)) ∧
    (∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ = (k0Kernel Q 1) ^ 2) ∧
    k0Kernel (fun _ => 0) 1 = 1 ∧
    (∀ lam : ℂ, 0 < ‖lam‖ → ‖lam‖ < 1 →
      slDivided (fun _ => 0) lam 0 =
        (lam / 2 - Complex.sin (lam / 2)) / (4 * (lam / 2) ^ 3)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun lam : ℂ => (lam / 2 - Complex.sin (lam / 2)) / (4 * (lam / 2) ^ 3))
      (nhdsWithin 0 {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhds (1 / 24 : ℂ))
