proof.tactics:
by
  let _ := hLip
  
  have hIter : ∀ (Q init : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (w : ℝ),
      volterraIter Q init m w = sfcaVolterraIter init Q m w := by
    intro Q init m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro w; rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro w
      simp only [volterraIter, sfcaVolterraIter, ih]

  have hc0_eq : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ), c0Kernel Q w = sfcaVolterraC Q w := by
    intro Q w
    simp only [c0Kernel, sfcaVolterraC, hIter]

  have hk0_eq : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w : ℝ), k0Kernel Q w = sfcaVolterraK Q w := by
    intro Q w
    simp only [k0Kernel, sfcaVolterraK, hIter]

  have k0Kernel_one_congr : ∀ (P₁ P₂ : ℝ → ℂ),
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, P₁ w = P₂ w) → k0Kernel P₁ 1 = k0Kernel P₂ 1 := by
    intro P₁ P₂ hP
    have hIter_congr : ∀ (init : ℝ → ℂ) (m : ℕ),
        ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, volterraIter P₁ init m w = volterraIter P₂ init m w := by
      intro init m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro w _; rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        intro w hw
        simp only [volterraIter]
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro v hv
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hw.1] at hv
        have hv1 : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hw.2⟩
        dsimp only
        rw [hP v hv1, ih v hv1]
    simp only [k0Kernel]
    exact tsum_congr (fun m => hIter_congr (fun v => (v : ℂ)) m 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩)

  have hc0_zero : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, c0Kernel (fun _ => 0) w = 1 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hc0_eq]
    exact (hSfca.zero_pot w hw).1

  have hk0_zero : k0Kernel (fun _ => 0) 1 = 1 := by
    rw [hk0_eq]
    have h1 := (hSfca.zero_pot 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).2
    rw [Complex.ofReal_one] at h1
    exact h1

  have hk0_rev_symm : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 := by
    intro Q hQ
    rw [hk0_eq, hk0_eq]
    exact hSfca.rev_symm Q hQ

  have hkp_neg : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      kPlusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁ := by
    intro Q a₀ a₁
    have hpot : pertPotential 1 Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = pertPotential (-1) Q a₀ a₁ := by
      funext w
      dsimp [pertPotential]
      ring
    simp only [kPlusVal, kMinusVal, hpot]

  have hkm_neg : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      kMinusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁ := by
    intro Q a₀ a₁
    have hpot : pertPotential (-1) Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = pertPotential 1 Q a₀ a₁ := by
      funext w
      dsimp [pertPotential]
      ring
    simp only [kPlusVal, kMinusVal, hpot]

  have hcanon_neg : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      canonRoot Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ := by
    intro Q a₀ a₁
    dsimp only [canonRoot]
    rw [hkp_neg Q a₀ a₁, hkm_neg Q a₀ a₁]
    set kp := kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁
    set km := kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁
    have hsum : km + kp = kp + km := add_comm km kp
    have hprod : 4 * km * kp = 4 * kp * km := by ring
    rw [hsum, hprod]

  have hslNum_neg : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (w₀ w₁ : ℂ),
      slNumerator Q (-w₀) (-w₁) = slNumerator Q w₀ w₁ := by
    intro Q w₀ w₁
    dsimp only [slNumerator]
    have h_slope : ((-w₁) - (-w₀) * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1 =
        -((w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1) := by ring
    rw [h_slope, hcanon_neg]

  have hConj1 : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 ∧
      kPlusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      kMinusVal Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      canonRoot Q (-a₀) (-a₁) = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, slNumerator Q (-w₀) (-w₁) = slNumerator Q w₀ w₁ :=
    fun Q a₀ a₁ hQ =>
      ⟨hk0_rev_symm Q hQ, hkp_neg Q a₀ a₁, hkm_neg Q a₀ a₁, hcanon_neg Q a₀ a₁, hslNum_neg Q⟩

  
  have hConj2 : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₀ a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      let b₁ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
      let b₁' := a₀ * c0Deriv Q 1 + a₁ * k0Deriv Q 1
      canonRoot (fun w => Q (1 - w)) (-b₁) b₁' = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ ∧
      -a₀ = (-b₁) * c0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 +
        b₁' * k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 := by
    intro Q a₀ a₁ hQ
    dsimp only
    set I01 : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    set φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun w => 1 - w
    set Q_rev : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q (1 - w)
    set b₁ : ℂ := a₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + a₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
    set b₁' : ℂ := a₀ * c0Deriv Q 1 + a₁ * k0Deriv Q 1
    have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ I01 I01 := by
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨by linarith [hw.2], by linarith [hw.1]⟩
    have hφ_cont : Continuous φ := continuous_const.sub continuous_id
    have hQ_rev : ContinuousOn Q_rev I01 := hQ.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn hφ_maps
    have hdφ : ∀ w ∈ I01, HasDerivWithinAt φ (-1 : ℝ) I01 w := by
      intro w _
      have hd := ((hasDerivAt_const w (1 : ℝ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id' w)).hasDerivWithinAt (s := I01)
      have h_sub : (0 : ℝ) - 1 = -1 := by norm_num
      rw [h_sub] at hd
      exact hd
    obtain ⟨hc0_0, hc0'_0, hk0_0, hk0'_0, hc0_cont, hc0'_cont, hk0_cont, hk0'_cont,
      hd_base, _, _⟩ := hODE Q hQ
    let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => a₀ * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w
    let F' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => a₀ * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w
    have hF_0 : F 0 = a₀ := by simp [F, hc0_0, hk0_0]
    have hF_1 : F 1 = b₁ := rfl
    have hF'_1 : F' 1 = b₁' := rfl
    have hF_cont : ContinuousOn F I01 :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hc0_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hk0_cont)
    have hF'_cont : ContinuousOn F' I01 :=
      (continuousOn_const.mul hc0'_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hk0'_cont)
    have hdF : ∀ u ∈ I01, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' u) I01 u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨hdc0, _, hdk0, _⟩ := hd_base u hu
      exact (hdc0.const_mul a₀).add (hdk0.const_mul a₁)
    have hdF' : ∀ u ∈ I01, HasDerivWithinAt F' (Q u * F u) I01 u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨_, hdc0', _, hdk0'⟩ := hd_base u hu
      have hd := (hdc0'.const_mul a₀).add (hdk0'.const_mul a₁)
      have h_eq : a₀ * (Q u * c0Kernel Q u) + a₁ * (Q u * k0Kernel Q u) = Q u * F u := by
        dsimp [F]; ring
      rw [h_eq] at hd
      exact hd
    let G : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => -(F (φ w))
    let G' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => F' (φ w)
    have hG_0 : G 0 = -b₁ := by
      dsimp [G, φ]
      rw [sub_zero, hF_1]
    have hG'_0 : G' 0 = b₁' := by
      dsimp [G', φ]
      rw [sub_zero, hF'_1]
    have hG_1 : G 1 = -a₀ := by
      dsimp [G, φ]
      rw [sub_self, hF_0]
    have hG_cont : ContinuousOn G I01 := (hF_cont.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn hφ_maps).neg
    have hG'_cont : ContinuousOn G' I01 := hF'_cont.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn hφ_maps
    have hdG : ∀ w ∈ I01,
        HasDerivWithinAt G (G' w) I01 w ∧ HasDerivWithinAt G' (Q_rev w * G w) I01 w := by
      intro w hw
      have hφw : φ w ∈ I01 := hφ_maps hw
      constructor
      · have hd1 := (HasDerivWithinAt.scomp w (hdF (φ w) hφw) (hdφ w hw) hφ_maps).neg
        change HasDerivWithinAt G (-((-1 : ℝ) • F' (φ w))) I01 w at hd1
        have h_eq : -((-1 : ℝ) • F' (φ w)) = G' w := by
          rw [neg_one_smul, neg_neg]
        rw [h_eq] at hd1
        exact hd1
      · have hd2 := HasDerivWithinAt.scomp w (hdF' (φ w) hφw) (hdφ w hw) hφ_maps
        change HasDerivWithinAt G' ((-1 : ℝ) • (Q (φ w) * F (φ w))) I01 w at hd2
        have h_eq : (-1 : ℝ) • (Q (φ w) * F (φ w)) = Q_rev w * G w := by
          rw [neg_one_smul]
          dsimp [Q_rev, G, φ]
          ring
        rw [h_eq] at hd2
        exact hd2
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hUniq_rev, _⟩ := hODE Q_rev hQ_rev
    have hG_sol := hUniq_rev G G' hG_cont hG'_cont hdG
    have h_init_rev : -a₀ = (-b₁) * c0Kernel Q_rev 1 + b₁' * k0Kernel Q_rev 1 := by
      have h1 := (hG_sol 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
      rw [hG_1, hG_0, hG'_0] at h1
      exact h1
    have h_k_sgn : ∀ sgn : ℂ,
        k0Kernel (pertPotential sgn Q_rev (-b₁) b₁') 1 =
          k0Kernel (pertPotential sgn Q a₀ a₁) 1 := by
      intro sgn
      let P_sgn : ℝ → ℂ := pertPotential sgn Q a₀ a₁
      have hP_cont : ContinuousOn P_sgn I01 :=
        (hQ.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hF'_cont)).sub
          (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont.pow 2))
      have h_congr : ∀ w ∈ I01, pertPotential sgn Q_rev (-b₁) b₁' w = P_sgn (1 - w) := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hGw, hG'w⟩ := hG_sol w hw
        rw [hG_0, hG'_0] at hGw hG'w
        dsimp only [pertPotential, P_sgn]
        rw [← hGw, ← hG'w]
        dsimp [Q_rev, G, G', F, F', φ]
        ring
      rw [k0Kernel_one_congr _ (fun w => P_sgn (1 - w)) h_congr, hk0_rev_symm P_sgn hP_cont]
    have hkp_rev : kPlusVal Q_rev (-b₁) b₁' = kPlusVal Q a₀ a₁ := h_k_sgn 1
    have hkm_rev : kMinusVal Q_rev (-b₁) b₁' = kMinusVal Q a₀ a₁ := h_k_sgn (-1)
    have hcanon_rev : canonRoot Q_rev (-b₁) b₁' = canonRoot Q a₀ a₁ := by
      simp only [canonRoot, hkp_rev, hkm_rev]
    exact ⟨hcanon_rev, h_init_rev⟩

  have hConj3 : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ u v : ℂ, slNumerator (fun w => Q (1 - w)) u v = slNumerator Q (-v) (-u) := by
    intro Q hQ hk0 u v
    set Q_rev : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q (1 - w)
    have hk0_rev_eq : k0Kernel Q_rev 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 := hk0_rev_symm Q hQ
    have hk0_rev : k0Kernel Q_rev 1 ≠ 0 := by rwa [hk0_rev_eq]
    let α₀ : ℂ := -v
    let α₁ : ℂ := (-u - (-v) * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1
    let β₁ : ℂ := α₀ * c0Kernel Q 1 + α₁ * k0Kernel Q 1
    let β₁' : ℂ := α₀ * c0Deriv Q 1 + α₁ * k0Deriv Q 1
    have hβ₁ : β₁ = -u := by
      dsimp [β₁, α₀, α₁]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk0]
      ring
    have hneg_β₁ : -β₁ = u := by rw [hβ₁, neg_neg]
    obtain ⟨hroot_eq, hval_eq⟩ := hConj2 Q α₀ α₁ hQ
    change canonRoot Q_rev (-β₁) β₁' = canonRoot Q α₀ α₁ at hroot_eq
    change -α₀ = (-β₁) * c0Kernel Q_rev 1 + β₁' * k0Kernel Q_rev 1 at hval_eq
    have hneg_α₀ : -α₀ = v := neg_neg v
    rw [hneg_β₁] at hroot_eq hval_eq
    rw [hneg_α₀] at hval_eq
    have hβ₁'_eq : β₁' = (v - u * c0Kernel Q_rev 1) / k0Kernel Q_rev 1 := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hk0_rev]
      linear_combination -hval_eq
    dsimp only [slNumerator]
    rw [← hβ₁'_eq, hk0_rev_eq, hroot_eq]

  
  have hasDerivWithinAt_primitive_Icc : ∀ F : ℝ → ℂ,
      ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, F v) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun u : ℝ => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, F v) (F w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
    intro F hF_cont
    let clamp01 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => max 0 (min 1 t)
    have hclamp_cont : Continuous clamp01 :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id)
    have hclamp_mem : ∀ t : ℝ, clamp01 t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun t => ⟨le_max_left 0 _, max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 t)⟩
    have hclamp_eq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, clamp01 t = t := by
      intro t ht
      dsimp [clamp01]
      rw [min_eq_right ht.2, max_eq_right ht.1]
    let F_ext : ℝ → ℂ := F ∘ clamp01
    have hF_ext : Continuous F_ext := hF_cont.comp_continuous hclamp_cont hclamp_mem
    let A : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, F v
    let A_ext : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..u, F_ext v
    have hd_ext : ∀ w : ℝ, HasDerivAt A_ext (F_ext w) w := fun w =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
        (hF_ext.intervalIntegrable 0 w)
        (hF_ext.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter MeasureTheory.volume (nhds w))
        hF_ext.continuousAt
    have hA_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, A u = A_ext u := by
      intro u hu
      dsimp [A, A_ext]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro v hv
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu.1] at hv
      have hv1 : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hu.2⟩
      dsimp [F_ext]
      rw [hclamp_eq v hv1]
    have hA_ext_cont : Continuous A_ext :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun w => (hd_ext w).continuousAt)
    refine ⟨hA_ext_cont.continuousOn.congr hA_eq, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    have hd_w : HasDerivWithinAt A_ext (F w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
      have hd := (hd_ext w).hasDerivWithinAt (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      have hFw : F_ext w = F w := by
        dsimp [F_ext]
        rw [hclamp_eq w hw]
      rw [hFw] at hd
      exact hd
    exact hd_w.congr hA_eq (hA_eq w hw)

  have hConj4 : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ : ℂ),
      ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ = (k0Kernel Q 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro Q a₁ hQ
    by_cases ha₁ : a₁ = 0
    · subst ha₁
      have hpot1 : pertPotential 1 Q 0 0 = Q := by
        funext w; simp [pertPotential]
      have hpot2 : pertPotential (-1) Q 0 0 = Q := by
        funext w; simp [pertPotential]
      simp only [kPlusVal, kMinusVal, hpot1, hpot2, sq]
    · set I01 : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
      obtain ⟨_, _, hk0_0, hk0'_0, _, _, hk0_cont, hk0'_cont, hd_base, _, _⟩ := hODE Q hQ
      let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => a₁ * k0Kernel Q w
      let F' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => a₁ * k0Deriv Q w
      let A : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..w, F v
      have hF_0 : F 0 = 0 := by simp [F, hk0_0]
      have hF'_0 : F' 0 = a₁ := by simp [F', hk0'_0]
      have hA_0 : A 0 = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_same
      have hF_cont : ContinuousOn F I01 := continuousOn_const.mul hk0_cont
      have hF'_cont : ContinuousOn F' I01 := continuousOn_const.mul hk0'_cont
      obtain ⟨hA_cont, hdA⟩ := hasDerivWithinAt_primitive_Icc F hF_cont
      have hdF : ∀ w ∈ I01, HasDerivWithinAt F (F' w) I01 w := by
        intro w hw
        exact (hd_base w hw).2.2.1.const_mul a₁
      have hdF' : ∀ w ∈ I01, HasDerivWithinAt F' (Q w * F w) I01 w := by
        intro w hw
        have hd := (hd_base w hw).2.2.2.const_mul a₁
        have h_eq : a₁ * (Q w * k0Kernel Q w) = Q w * F w := by dsimp [F]; ring
        rw [h_eq] at hd
        exact hd
      let Q_α : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α w => Q w + 3 * α * F' w + α ^ 2 * (F w) ^ 2
      let g_α : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α w => F w * Complex.exp (α * A w)
      let g_α' : ℂ → ℝ → ℂ := fun α w => (F' w + α * (F w) ^ 2) * Complex.exp (α * A w)
      have h_gauge : ∀ α : ℂ, F 1 * Complex.exp (α * A 1) = a₁ * k0Kernel (Q_α α) 1 := by
        intro α
        have hQα_cont : ContinuousOn (Q_α α) I01 :=
          (hQ.add (continuousOn_const.mul hF'_cont)).add
            (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont.pow 2))
        have hexp_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => Complex.exp (α * A w)) I01 :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_const.mul hA_cont)
        have hg_cont : ContinuousOn (g_α α) I01 := hF_cont.mul hexp_cont
        have hg'_cont : ContinuousOn (g_α' α) I01 :=
          (hF'_cont.add (continuousOn_const.mul (hF_cont.pow 2))).mul hexp_cont
        have hg_0 : g_α α 0 = 0 := by simp [g_α, hF_0]
        have hg'_0 : g_α' α 0 = a₁ := by simp [g_α', hF_0, hF'_0, hA_0]
        have hdg : ∀ w ∈ I01,
            HasDerivWithinAt (g_α α) (g_α' α w) I01 w ∧
            HasDerivWithinAt (g_α' α) (Q_α α w * g_α α w) I01 w := by
          intro w hw
          have hd_exp : HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => Complex.exp (α * A u))
              (Complex.exp (α * A w) * (α * F w)) I01 w :=
            ((hdA w hw).const_mul α).cexp
          constructor
          · have hd1 := (hdF w hw).mul hd_exp
            change HasDerivWithinAt (g_α α)
              (F' w * Complex.exp (α * A w) + F w * (Complex.exp (α * A w) * (α * F w)))
              I01 w at hd1
            have h_eq :
                F' w * Complex.exp (α * A w) + F w * (Complex.exp (α * A w) * (α * F w)) =
                  g_α' α w := by
              dsimp [g_α']; ring
            rw [h_eq] at hd1
            exact hd1
          · have hdF2 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun u => (F u) ^ 2)
                (F' w * F w + F w * F' w) I01 w := by
              simp only [sq]
              exact (hdF w hw).mul (hdF w hw)
            have hd2 := ((hdF' w hw).add (hdF2.const_mul α)).mul hd_exp
            change HasDerivWithinAt (g_α' α)
              ((Q w * F w + α * (F' w * F w + F w * F' w)) * Complex.exp (α * A w) +
                (F' w + α * (F w) ^ 2) * (Complex.exp (α * A w) * (α * F w)))
              I01 w at hd2
            have h_eq :
                (Q w * F w + α * (F' w * F w + F w * F' w)) * Complex.exp (α * A w) +
                  (F' w + α * (F w) ^ 2) * (Complex.exp (α * A w) * (α * F w)) =
                Q_α α w * g_α α w := by
              dsimp [Q_α, g_α]; ring
            rw [h_eq] at hd2
            exact hd2
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hUniq_α, _⟩ := hODE (Q_α α) hQα_cont
        have h1 := (hUniq_α (g_α α) (g_α' α) hg_cont hg'_cont hdg 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
        rw [hg_0, hg'_0, zero_mul, zero_add] at h1
        exact h1
      have hQ_plus : Q_α (-Complex.I / 2) = pertPotential 1 Q 0 a₁ := by
        funext w
        dsimp [Q_α, pertPotential, F, F']
        linear_combination ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * (a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2) * Complex.I_sq
      have hQ_minus : Q_α (Complex.I / 2) = pertPotential (-1) Q 0 a₁ := by
        funext w
        dsimp [Q_α, pertPotential, F, F']
        linear_combination ((1 / 4 : ℂ) * (a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2) * Complex.I_sq
      have hp := h_gauge (-Complex.I / 2)
      rw [hQ_plus] at hp
      have hm := h_gauge (Complex.I / 2)
      rw [hQ_minus] at hm
      change F 1 * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * A 1) = a₁ * kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ at hp
      change F 1 * Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * A 1) = a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ at hm
      have h_mul : a₁ ^ 2 * (kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁) =
          a₁ ^ 2 * (k0Kernel Q 1) ^ 2 := by
        calc a₁ ^ 2 * (kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁)
            = (a₁ * kPlusVal Q 0 a₁) * (a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁) := by ring
          _ = (F 1 * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * A 1)) *
                (F 1 * Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * A 1)) := by rw [← hp, ← hm]
          _ = (F 1) ^ 2 *
                (Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * A 1) * Complex.exp ((Complex.I / 2) * A 1)) := by
              ring
          _ = (F 1) ^ 2 * Complex.exp ((-Complex.I / 2) * A 1 + (Complex.I / 2) * A 1) := by
              rw [← Complex.exp_add]
          _ = (F 1) ^ 2 * Complex.exp 0 := by
              have h_zero : (-Complex.I / 2) * A 1 + (Complex.I / 2) * A 1 = 0 := by ring
              rw [h_zero]
          _ = a₁ ^ 2 * (k0Kernel Q 1) ^ 2 := by
              rw [Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
              dsimp [F]
              ring
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 ha₁) h_mul

  
  have h_sin_rem : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 →
      ‖Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 4 := by
    intro z hz
    let P₄ : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range 4, x ^ m / (m.factorial : ℂ)
    have hP₄_eq : ∀ x : ℂ, P₄ x = 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 3 / 6 := by
      intro x
      dsimp [P₄]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have hP₄_comb : (P₄ (-z * Complex.I) - P₄ (z * Complex.I)) * Complex.I =
        2 * (z - z ^ 3 / 6) := by
      rw [hP₄_eq (-z * Complex.I), hP₄_eq (z * Complex.I)]
      linear_combination (-2 * z - z ^ 3 / 3 * (Complex.I ^ 2 - 1)) * Complex.I_sq
    have h_diff_id : 2 * (Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) =
        ((Complex.exp (-z * Complex.I) - P₄ (-z * Complex.I)) -
          (Complex.exp (z * Complex.I) - P₄ (z * Complex.I))) * Complex.I := by
      have h2s := Complex.two_sin z
      linear_combination h2s + hP₄_comb
    have h_norm1 : ‖-z * Complex.I‖ = ‖z‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    have h_norm2 : ‖z * Complex.I‖ = ‖z‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    have hb1 : ‖Complex.exp (-z * Complex.I) - P₄ (-z * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        ‖z‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96 : ℝ) := by
      have hb := Complex.exp_bound (x := -z * Complex.I) (by rwa [h_norm1]) (n := 4) (by norm_num)
      rw [h_norm1] at hb
      refine le_trans hb ?_
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have hb2 : ‖Complex.exp (z * Complex.I) - P₄ (z * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        ‖z‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96 : ℝ) := by
      have hb := Complex.exp_bound (x := z * Complex.I) (by rwa [h_norm2]) (n := 4) (by norm_num)
      rw [h_norm2] at hb
      refine le_trans hb ?_
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    have h2_norm : 2 * ‖Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)‖ =
        ‖2 * (Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6))‖ := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    have h_sum_le : 2 * ‖Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)‖ ≤
        ‖z‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96 : ℝ) + ‖z‖ ^ 4 * (5 / 96 : ℝ) := by
      rw [h2_norm, h_diff_id, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
      exact le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add hb1 hb2)
    have hz4_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 4 := by positivity
    linarith

  have h_sinc_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < 1 / 2 → Complex.sin z / z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz_ne hz_lt
    have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne
    have hz_le_one : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hrem := h_sin_rem z hz_le_one
    have h_alg : Complex.sin z / z - 1 =
        (Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) / z - z ^ 2 / 6 := by
      field_simp [hz_ne]
      ring
    have h_div_le : ‖(Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) / z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 3 := by
      rw [norm_div]
      calc ‖Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)‖ / ‖z‖
          ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 4 / ‖z‖ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrem hz_pos.le
        _ = ‖z‖ ^ 3 := by
            field_simp [hz_pos.ne']
    have h_z2_norm : ‖z ^ 2 / (6 : ℂ)‖ = ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 6 := by
      rw [norm_div, norm_pow, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    have h_lt_one : ‖Complex.sin z / z - 1‖ < 1 := by
      rw [h_alg]
      calc ‖(Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) / z - z ^ 2 / 6‖
          ≤ ‖(Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) / z‖ + ‖z ^ 2 / (6 : ℂ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 3 + ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 6 := by rw [h_z2_norm]; linarith
        _ < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖z‖]
    intro h_zero
    rw [h_zero, zero_sub, norm_neg, norm_one] at h_lt_one
    exact lt_irrefl (1 : ℝ) h_lt_one

  have h_quot_bound : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ 1 →
      ‖(z - Complex.sin z) / (4 * z ^ 3) - (1 / 24 : ℂ)‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z hz_ne hz_le
    have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz_ne
    have hrem := h_sin_rem z hz_le
    have h_alg : (z - Complex.sin z) / (4 * z ^ 3) - (1 / 24 : ℂ) =
        -(Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)) / (4 * z ^ 3) := by
      field_simp [hz_ne]
      ring
    have h_den_norm : ‖(4 : ℂ) * z ^ 3‖ = 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 3 := by
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_pow]
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 3 := by positivity
    rw [h_alg, norm_div, norm_neg, h_den_norm]
    calc ‖Complex.sin z - (z - z ^ 3 / 6)‖ / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 3)
        ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 4 / (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 3) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrem h_den_pos.le
      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ := by
          field_simp [hz_pos.ne']

  have hConj6 : ∀ lam : ℂ, 0 < ‖lam‖ → ‖lam‖ < 1 →
      slDivided (fun _ => 0) lam 0 =
        (lam / 2 - Complex.sin (lam / 2)) / (4 * (lam / 2) ^ 3) := by
    intro lam hlam_pos hlam_lt
    set Q₀ : ℝ → ℂ := fun _ => 0
    set z : ℂ := lam / 2
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hlam_pos
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hlam_ne two_ne_zero
    have hlam_eq : lam = 2 * z := by dsimp [z]; ring
    have hz_lt_half : ‖z‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      linarith
    have hc0_Q₀_1 : c0Kernel Q₀ 1 = 1 := hc0_zero 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    have hk0_Q₀_1 : k0Kernel Q₀ 1 = 1 := hk0_zero
    have hc0'_Q₀ : ∀ w : ℝ, c0Deriv Q₀ w = 0 := by
      intro w
      simp [c0Deriv, Q₀]
    have hb₁_eq : lam * c0Kernel Q₀ 1 + 0 * k0Kernel Q₀ 1 = lam := by
      rw [hc0_Q₀_1]; ring
    have hDiv_branch : slDivided Q₀ lam 0 = (1 - canonRoot Q₀ lam 0) / (lam * lam) := by
      dsimp only [slDivided]
      rw [hb₁_eq, hk0_Q₀_1]
      split_ifs with h_cond
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (h_cond ⟨hlam_ne, hlam_ne⟩)
    let P_z : ℝ → ℂ := fun _ => -z ^ 2
    have hpert_eq : ∀ (sgn : ℂ), ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        pertPotential sgn Q₀ lam 0 w = P_z w := by
      intro sgn w hw
      dsimp only [pertPotential, P_z, Q₀]
      rw [hc0_zero w hw, hc0'_Q₀ w, hlam_eq]
      ring
    have hkp_z : kPlusVal Q₀ lam 0 = k0Kernel P_z 1 :=
      k0Kernel_one_congr _ P_z (hpert_eq 1)
    have hkm_z : kMinusVal Q₀ lam 0 = k0Kernel P_z 1 :=
      k0Kernel_one_congr _ P_z (hpert_eq (-1))
    let y : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) / z
    let y' : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z)
    have hy_cont : Continuous y := by
      dsimp [y]; fun_prop
    have hy'_cont : Continuous y' := by
      dsimp [y']; fun_prop
    have hy_0 : y 0 = 0 := by simp [y]
    have hy'_0 : y' 0 = 1 := by simp [y']
    have hdy : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivWithinAt y (y' w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w ∧
        HasDerivWithinAt y' (P_z w * y w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w := by
      intro w _
      constructor
      · have hd1 :=
          ((((hasDerivAt_id' (w : ℂ)).mul_const z).csin.div_const z).comp_ofReal).hasDerivWithinAt
            (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        change HasDerivWithinAt y ((Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z) * ((1 : ℂ) * z)) / z)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w at hd1
        have h_eq : (Complex.cos ((w : ℂ) * z) * ((1 : ℂ) * z)) / z = y' w := by
          dsimp [y']
          field_simp [hz_ne]
        rw [h_eq] at hd1
        exact hd1
      · have hd2 :=
          ((((hasDerivAt_id' (w : ℂ)).mul_const z).ccos).comp_ofReal).hasDerivWithinAt
            (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
        change HasDerivWithinAt y' (-Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) * ((1 : ℂ) * z))
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) w at hd2
        have h_eq : -Complex.sin ((w : ℂ) * z) * ((1 : ℂ) * z) = P_z w * y w := by
          dsimp [P_z, y]
          field_simp [hz_ne]
        rw [h_eq] at hd2
        exact hd2
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hUniq_Pz, _⟩ := hODE P_z continuousOn_const
    have hk0_Pz : k0Kernel P_z 1 = Complex.sin z / z := by
      have h1 := (hUniq_Pz y y' hy_cont.continuousOn hy'_cont.continuousOn hdy
        1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).1
      rw [hy_0, hy'_0, zero_mul, zero_add, one_mul] at h1
      dsimp [y] at h1
      rw [one_mul] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    set u : ℂ := Complex.sin z / z
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := h_sinc_ne_zero z hz_ne hz_lt_half
    have hcanon_Q₀ : canonRoot Q₀ lam 0 = u := by
      dsimp only [canonRoot]
      rw [hkp_z, hkm_z, hk0_Pz]
      have h_sq : (u + u) ^ 2 = 4 * u * u := by ring
      have h4u_ne : 4 * u * u ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hu_ne) hu_ne
      rw [h_sq, div_self h4u_ne, Complex.log_one, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
      ring
    rw [hDiv_branch, hcanon_Q₀]
    dsimp [u]
    rw [hlam_eq]
    field_simp [hz_ne]
    ring

  have hConj7 : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun lam : ℂ => (lam / 2 - Complex.sin (lam / 2)) / (4 * (lam / 2) ^ 3))
      (nhdsWithin 0 {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) (nhds (1 / 24 : ℂ)) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨min 2 (4 * ε), lt_min zero_lt_two (by positivity), ?_⟩
    intro lam hlam_mem h_dist
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hlam_mem
    rw [dist_zero_right] at h_dist
    have hlam_lt2 : ‖lam‖ < 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le h_dist (min_le_left _ _)
    have hlam_lt4ε : ‖lam‖ < 4 * ε := lt_of_lt_of_le h_dist (min_le_right _ _)
    set z : ℂ := lam / 2
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hlam_ne two_ne_zero
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = ‖lam‖ / 2 := by
      dsimp [z]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    have hz_le1 : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hz_lt2ε : ‖z‖ < 2 * ε := by linarith
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    calc ‖(z - Complex.sin z) / (4 * z ^ 3) - (1 / 24 : ℂ)‖
        ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z‖ := h_quot_bound z hz_ne hz_le1
      _ < ε := by linarith

  exact ⟨hConj1, hConj2, hConj3, hConj4, hk0_zero, hConj6, hConj7⟩

(hODE : VolterraODEProp)
    (hLip : VolterraLipHoloProp)
    (hRevK : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      k0Kernel (fun w => Q (1 - w)) 1 = k0Kernel Q 1)
    (hWronskProd : ∀ (Q : ℝ → ℂ) (a₁ : ℂ), ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
      kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ = (k0Kernel Q 1) ^ 2)
    (hRevNum : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 →
      ∀ u v : ℂ, slNumerator (fun w => Q (1 - w)) u v = slNumerator Q (-v) (-u))
    (Q₀ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hQ₀ : ContinuousOn Q₀ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hk0_Q₀ : k0Kernel Q₀ 1 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ_Q r_b M_num : ℝ,
      0 < δ_Q ∧ 0 < r_b ∧ 0 < M_num ∧
      (∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ,
        ContinuousOn Q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
        k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => slNumerator Q z.1 z.2)
          (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b)) ∧
        ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ < 2 * r_b → ‖w₁‖ < 2 * r_b →
          ‖slNumerator Q w₀ w₁‖ ≤ M_num ∧
          slNumerator Q 0 w₁ = 0 ∧
          slNumerator Q w₀ 0 = 0) ∧
      (∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (Δ : ℝ),
        0 ≤ Δ →
        ContinuousOn Q₁ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        ContinuousOn Q₂ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖Q₁ w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q ∧ ‖Q₂ w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q ∧ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
        ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖w₁‖ ≤ r_b →
          ‖slNumerator Q₁ w₀ w₁ - slNumerator Q₂ w₀ w₁‖ ≤ M_num * Δ) ∧
      (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ),
        IsOpen U →
        ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => Q q.1 q.2) (U ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Q p w) U) →
        (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖Q p w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) →
        ∀ z₀ z₁ : ℂ, ‖z₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖z₁‖ ≤ r_b →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => slNumerator (Q p) z₀ z₁) U)

proof.tactics:
by
  let I : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ I := ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
  have h1_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ I := ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩

  
  obtain ⟨w_max, _, hw_max⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, h0_mem⟩ (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn hQ₀)
  let M₀ : ℝ := max 1 ‖Q₀ w_max‖
  have hM₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ M₀ := le_max_left _ _
  have hQ₀_bdd : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q₀ w‖ ≤ M₀ :=
    fun w hw => le_trans (hw_max hw) (le_max_right _ _)
  let κ₀ : ℝ := ‖k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖
  have hκ₀_pos : 0 < κ₀ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hk0_Q₀
  let E₀ : ℝ := Real.exp (M₀ + 1)
  have hE₀_pos : 0 < E₀ := Real.exp_pos _
  have hE₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ E₀ := Real.one_le_exp (by linarith)
  let B₀ : ℝ := (2 + M₀) * E₀
  have hB₀_ge_three : 3 ≤ B₀ := by dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
  have hB₀_pos : 0 < B₀ := by linarith
  let δ_Q : ℝ := min 1 (κ₀ / (4 * E₀))
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_Q := lt_min zero_lt_one (by positivity)
  have hδ_le_one : δ_Q ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hE₀_δ_le : E₀ * δ_Q ≤ κ₀ / 4 := by
    have h1 : δ_Q ≤ κ₀ / (4 * E₀) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hE₀_pos.le
    have h3 : E₀ * (κ₀ / (4 * E₀)) = κ₀ / 4 := by
      field_simp [hE₀_pos.ne']
    rwa [h3] at h2
  let K_a : ℝ := 3 * (1 + E₀) / κ₀
  have hKa_pos : 0 < K_a := by positivity
  let K_F : ℝ := (2 + K_a) * B₀
  have hKF_pos : 0 < K_F := by positivity
  have hKF_ge_six : 6 ≤ K_F := by dsimp [K_F]; nlinarith
  have hKa_le_KF : K_a ≤ K_F := by dsimp [K_F]; nlinarith
  let E_pert : ℝ := Real.exp (M₀ + 2)
  have hE_pert_pos : 0 < E_pert := Real.exp_pos _
  let r_b : ℝ := min (1 / (2 * K_F)) (κ₀ / (32 * E_pert * K_F))
  have hrb_pos : 0 < r_b := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hKF_rb_le_half : K_F * r_b ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h1 : r_b ≤ 1 / (2 * K_F) := min_le_left _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hKF_pos.le
    have h3 : K_F * (1 / (2 * K_F)) = 1 / 2 := by
      field_simp [hKF_pos.ne']
    rwa [h3] at h2
  have hrb_le_one : r_b ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hKa_rb_le_half : K_a * r_b ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKa_le_KF hrb_pos.le) hKF_rb_le_half
  have hE_pert_rb_le : E_pert * (2 * K_F * r_b) ≤ κ₀ / 16 := by
    have h1 : r_b ≤ κ₀ / (32 * E_pert * K_F) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * E_pert * K_F)
    have h3 : (2 * E_pert * K_F) * (κ₀ / (32 * E_pert * K_F)) = κ₀ / 16 := by
      field_simp [hE_pert_pos.ne', hKF_pos.ne']
      ring
    calc E_pert * (2 * K_F * r_b)
        = (2 * E_pert * K_F) * r_b := by ring
      _ ≤ (2 * E_pert * K_F) * (κ₀ / (32 * E_pert * K_F)) := h2
      _ = κ₀ / 16 := h3
  let C_a : ℝ := 3 * B₀ / κ₀
  have hCa_pos : 0 < C_a := by positivity
  let C_F : ℝ := (2 + C_a) * B₀
  have hCF_pos : 0 < C_F := by positivity
  let C_k : ℝ := E_pert * (1 + 2 * C_F)
  have hCk_pos : 0 < C_k := by positivity
  let L_num : ℝ := B₀ + 10 * C_k
  have hL_num_pos : 0 < L_num := by positivity
  let M_num : ℝ := max 1 (max κ₀ L_num)
  have hM_num_pos : 0 < M_num := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_left _ _)
  have hκ₀_le_M : κ₀ ≤ M_num := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hL_le_M : L_num ≤ M_num := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)

  have hnorm_3I2 : ‖(3 * Complex.I / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 3 / 2 := by
    rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I]
    norm_num
  have hnorm_14 : ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [norm_div]
    norm_num

  
  let cSqrt : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ)
  have hcSqrt_one : cSqrt 1 = 1 := by
    dsimp [cSqrt]
    rw [Complex.log_one, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]
  have hcSqrt_half : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 / 4 < ζ.re → cSqrt ζ ^ 2 = ζ ∧ 1 / 2 < (cSqrt ζ).re := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have hζ_ne : ζ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hζ
      linarith
    have hsq : cSqrt ζ ^ 2 = ζ := by
      dsimp [cSqrt]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add]
      have h_add : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ = Complex.log ζ := by
        ring
      rw [h_add, Complex.exp_log hζ_ne]
    refine ⟨hsq, ?_⟩
    have him_eq : ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).im = (Complex.log ζ).im / 2 := by
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    have him_lo : -(Real.pi / 2) ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).im := by
      rw [him_eq]
      linarith [Complex.neg_pi_lt_log_im ζ]
    have him_hi : ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log ζ).im ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by
      rw [him_eq]
      linarith [Complex.log_im_le_pi ζ]
    have hre_nonneg : 0 ≤ (cSqrt ζ).re := by
      dsimp [cSqrt]
      rw [Complex.exp_re]
      exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨him_lo, him_hi⟩)
    have hre_sq : ζ.re = (cSqrt ζ).re ^ 2 - (cSqrt ζ).im ^ 2 := by
      calc ζ.re = (cSqrt ζ ^ 2).re := by rw [hsq]
        _ = (cSqrt ζ * cSqrt ζ).re := by rw [sq]
        _ = (cSqrt ζ).re ^ 2 - (cSqrt ζ).im ^ 2 := by
            rw [Complex.mul_re]
            ring
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (cSqrt ζ).im]
  have hcSqrt_lip : ∀ ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ, 1 / 4 < ζ₁.re → 1 / 4 < ζ₂.re →
      ‖cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂‖ ≤ ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ := by
    intro ζ₁ ζ₂ hζ₁ hζ₂
    obtain ⟨hsq₁, hre₁⟩ := hcSqrt_half ζ₁ hζ₁
    obtain ⟨hsq₂, hre₂⟩ := hcSqrt_half ζ₂ hζ₂
    have hsum_gt : 1 < ‖cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂‖ := by
      have h1 : 1 < (cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂).re := by
        rw [Complex.add_re]
        linarith
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Complex.re_le_norm _)
    have hprod : (cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂) * (cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂) = ζ₁ - ζ₂ := by
      calc (cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂) * (cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂)
          = cSqrt ζ₁ ^ 2 - cSqrt ζ₂ ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = ζ₁ - ζ₂ := by rw [hsq₁, hsq₂]
    calc ‖cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂‖
        = ‖cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂‖ * ‖cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_gt.le (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖(cSqrt ζ₁ - cSqrt ζ₂) * (cSqrt ζ₁ + cSqrt ζ₂)‖ := (norm_mul _ _).symm
      _ = ‖ζ₁ - ζ₂‖ := by rw [hprod]
  have hcSqrt_sub_one : ∀ ζ : ℂ, 1 / 4 < ζ.re → ‖cSqrt ζ - 1‖ ≤ ‖ζ - 1‖ := by
    intro ζ hζ
    simpa [hcSqrt_one] using hcSqrt_lip ζ 1 hζ (by norm_num)

  
  let IsBasePot : (ℝ → ℂ) → Prop := fun Q =>
    ContinuousOn Q I ∧
    (∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M₀ + 1) ∧
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ ∧
    ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀

  have hBallToBase : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, ContinuousOn Q I →
      (∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ < δ_Q) → IsBasePot Q := by
    intro Q hQ hQ_close
    have hQ_bdd : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q w‖ ≤ M₀ + 1 := by
      intro w hw
      calc ‖Q w‖ = ‖(Q w - Q₀ w) + Q₀ w‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖Q w - Q₀ w‖ + ‖Q₀ w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ δ_Q + M₀ := add_le_add (hQ_close w hw).le (hQ₀_bdd w hw)
        _ ≤ M₀ + 1 := by linarith
    have hk0_diff : ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ ≤ κ₀ / 4 := by
      have h1 := (hLip.1 (M₀ + 1) δ_Q Q Q₀ (by linarith) hδ_pos.le hQ hQ₀
        (fun w hw => ⟨hQ_bdd w hw, le_trans (hQ₀_bdd w hw) (by linarith), (hQ_close w hw).le⟩)
        1 h1_mem).2.2.2.2.2.1
      exact le_trans h1 hE₀_δ_le
    have hk0_lo : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ := by
      have h_tri : κ₀ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ + ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ := by
        calc κ₀ = ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - (k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1)‖ := by dsimp [κ₀]; ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ + ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      linarith
    have hk0_hi : ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀ := by
      have h_tri : ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ + κ₀ := by
        calc ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ = ‖(k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1) + k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q 1 - k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ + ‖k0Kernel Q₀ 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      linarith
    exact ⟨hQ, hQ_bdd, hk0_lo, hk0_hi⟩

  
  let SingleOut : (ℝ → ℂ) → ℂ → ℂ → Prop := fun Q u v =>
    let a₁ := (v - u * c0Kernel Q 1) / k0Kernel Q 1
    let kp := kPlusVal Q u a₁
    let km := kMinusVal Q u a₁
    let Ξ := 4 * kp * km / (kp + km) ^ 2
    k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 ∧
    ‖a₁‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (∀ w ∈ I,
      ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
      ‖pertPotential 1 Q u a₁ w‖ ≤ M₀ + 2 ∧
      ‖pertPotential (-1) Q u a₁ w‖ ≤ M₀ + 2) ∧
    ContinuousOn (pertPotential 1 Q u a₁) I ∧
    ContinuousOn (pertPotential (-1) Q u a₁) I ∧
    kp + km ≠ 0 ∧
    κ₀ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ ∧
    ‖(kp + km) / 2‖ ≤ 2 * κ₀ ∧
    ‖(kp - km) / (kp + km)‖ ≤ 1 / 11 ∧
    Ξ - 1 = -((kp - km) / (kp + km)) ^ 2 ∧
    120 / 121 ≤ Ξ.re ∧
    Ξ ∈ Complex.slitPlane ∧
    ‖cSqrt Ξ‖ ≤ 2 ∧
    canonRoot Q u a₁ ^ 2 = kp * km ∧
    ‖slNumerator Q u v‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖k0Kernel Q 1‖ ∧
    ‖slNumerator Q u v‖ ≤ κ₀

  have hSingleEnv : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, IsBasePot Q →
      ∀ u v : ℂ, ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * r_b → ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * r_b → SingleOut Q u v := by
    intro Q ⟨hQ_cont, hQ_bdd, hk0_lo, hk0_hi⟩ u v hu hv
    dsimp only [SingleOut]
    set k₀ : ℂ := k0Kernel Q 1
    have hk0_pos : 0 < ‖k₀‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hk0_lo
    have hk0_ne : k₀ ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hk0_pos
    have hBaseK : ∀ w ∈ I,
        ‖c0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ E₀ ∧ ‖c0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ B₀ ∧
        ‖k0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ B₀ ∧ ‖c0Deriv Q w‖ ≤ B₀ ∧ ‖k0Deriv Q w‖ ≤ B₀ := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hc0_w, hk0_w, hc0d_w, hk0d_w, _⟩ :=
        hLip.1 (M₀ + 1) 0 Q Q (by linarith) le_rfl hQ_cont hQ_cont
          (fun t ht => ⟨hQ_bdd t ht, hQ_bdd t ht, by simp⟩) w hw
      refine ⟨hc0_w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
      · dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
      · dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
      · dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
    set a₁ : ℂ := (v - u * c0Kernel Q 1) / k₀
    have ha₁_bound : ‖a₁‖ ≤ K_a * r_b := by
      have hmul : a₁ * k₀ = v - u * c0Kernel Q 1 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk0_ne
      have hc0_1 : ‖c0Kernel Q 1‖ ≤ E₀ := (hBaseK 1 h1_mem).1
      have h_rhs : ‖v - u * c0Kernel Q 1‖ ≤ 2 * (1 + E₀) * r_b := by
        calc ‖v - u * c0Kernel Q 1‖
            ≤ ‖v‖ + ‖u * c0Kernel Q 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = ‖v‖ + ‖u‖ * ‖c0Kernel Q 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul]
          _ ≤ 2 * r_b + (2 * r_b) * E₀ :=
              add_le_add hv (mul_le_mul hu hc0_1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = 2 * (1 + E₀) * r_b := by ring
      have h_lhs : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀ * ‖a₁‖ ≤ ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (K_a * r_b) := by
        have h_eq : ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (K_a * r_b) = (9 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 + E₀) * r_b := by
          dsimp [K_a]
          field_simp [hκ₀_pos.ne']
          ring
        calc (3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀ * ‖a₁‖
            ≤ ‖k₀‖ * ‖a₁‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk0_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖a₁ * k₀‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ = ‖v - u * c0Kernel Q 1‖ := by rw [hmul]
          _ ≤ 2 * (1 + E₀) * r_b := h_rhs
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 + E₀) * r_b := by nlinarith
          _ = ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (K_a * r_b) := h_eq.symm
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_lhs (by positivity)
    have ha₁_le_one : ‖a₁‖ ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have hField : ∀ w ∈ I,
        ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ K_F * r_b ∧
        ‖u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w‖ ≤ K_F * r_b := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨_, hc0_B, hk0_B, hc0d_B, hk0d_B⟩ := hBaseK w hw
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · calc ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖
            ≤ ‖u * c0Kernel Q w‖ + ‖a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖u‖ * ‖c0Kernel Q w‖ + ‖a₁‖ * ‖k0Kernel Q w‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (2 * r_b) * B₀ + (K_a * r_b) * B₀ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul hu hc0_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
                (mul_le_mul ha₁_bound hk0_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = K_F * r_b := by dsimp [K_F]; ring
      · calc ‖u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w‖
            ≤ ‖u * c0Deriv Q w‖ + ‖a₁ * k0Deriv Q w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖u‖ * ‖c0Deriv Q w‖ + ‖a₁‖ * ‖k0Deriv Q w‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ (2 * r_b) * B₀ + (K_a * r_b) * B₀ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul hu hc0d_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
                (mul_le_mul ha₁_bound hk0d_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = K_F * r_b := by dsimp [K_F]; ring
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hc0_cont, hc0d_cont, hk0_cont, hk0d_cont, _⟩ := hODE Q hQ_cont
    have hPertSgn : ∀ sgn : ℂ, ‖sgn‖ = 1 →
        ContinuousOn (pertPotential sgn Q u a₁) I ∧
        (∀ w ∈ I, ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w‖ ≤ M₀ + 2) ∧
        ‖k0Kernel (pertPotential sgn Q u a₁) 1 - k₀‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
      intro sgn hsgn
      have hFw_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) I :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul hc0_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hk0_cont)
      have hFpw_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w) I :=
        (continuousOn_const.mul hc0d_cont).add (continuousOn_const.mul hk0d_cont)
      have hP_cont : ContinuousOn (pertPotential sgn Q u a₁) I :=
        (hQ_cont.sub (continuousOn_const.mul hFpw_cont)).sub
          (continuousOn_const.mul (hFw_cont.pow 2))
      have hP_diff : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w - Q w‖ ≤ 2 * K_F * r_b := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hFw_le, hFpw_le⟩ := hField w hw
        have hFw_half : ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 :=
          le_trans hFw_le hKF_rb_le_half
        have hFw_sq : ‖(u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2‖ ≤ K_F * r_b := by
          rw [norm_pow, sq]
          have h1 : ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ *
              ‖u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w‖ ≤ (K_F * r_b) * (1 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul hFw_le hFw_half (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          linarith [mul_pos hKF_pos hrb_pos]
        have h_sub_eq : pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w - Q w =
            -(sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * (u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w) +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2) := by
          dsimp [pertPotential]
          ring
        rw [h_sub_eq, norm_neg]
        calc ‖sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * (u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w) +
                (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2‖
            ≤ ‖sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * (u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w)‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖sgn‖ * ‖(3 * Complex.I / 2 : ℂ)‖ * ‖u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w‖ +
                ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ)‖ * ‖(u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ = (3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u * c0Deriv Q w + a₁ * k0Deriv Q w‖ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖(u * c0Kernel Q w + a₁ * k0Kernel Q w) ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [hsgn, hnorm_3I2, hnorm_14, one_mul]
          _ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (K_F * r_b) + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (K_F * r_b) := by linarith
          _ ≤ 2 * K_F * r_b := by linarith [mul_pos hKF_pos hrb_pos]
      have hP_bdd : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w‖ ≤ M₀ + 2 := by
        intro w hw
        have hd := hP_diff w hw
        have hq := hQ_bdd w hw
        have h_tri : ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w‖ ≤
            ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w - Q w‖ + ‖Q w‖ := by
          calc ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w‖
              = ‖(pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w - Q w) + Q w‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖pertPotential sgn Q u a₁ w - Q w‖ + ‖Q w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        linarith
      have hk_diff : ‖k0Kernel (pertPotential sgn Q u a₁) 1 - k₀‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
        have h1 := (hLip.1 (M₀ + 2) (2 * K_F * r_b) (pertPotential sgn Q u a₁) Q
          (by linarith) (by positivity) hP_cont hQ_cont
          (fun w hw => ⟨hP_bdd w hw, le_trans (hQ_bdd w hw) (by linarith), hP_diff w hw⟩)
          1 h1_mem).2.2.2.2.2.1
        have h2 : E_pert * (2 * K_F * r_b) ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
          calc E_pert * (2 * K_F * r_b) ≤ κ₀ / 16 := hE_pert_rb_le
            _ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by linarith
        exact le_trans h1 h2
      exact ⟨hP_cont, hP_bdd, hk_diff⟩
    obtain ⟨hP1_cont, hP1_bdd, hkp_diff⟩ := hPertSgn 1 norm_one
    obtain ⟨hPm1_cont, hPm1_bdd, hkm_diff⟩ := hPertSgn (-1) (by simp)
    set kp : ℂ := kPlusVal Q u a₁
    set km : ℂ := kMinusVal Q u a₁
    change ‖kp - k₀‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ at hkp_diff
    change ‖km - k₀‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ at hkm_diff
    have hH_diff : ‖(kp + km) / 2 - k₀‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
      have h_eq : (kp + km) / 2 - k₀ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((kp - k₀) + (km - k₀)) := by ring
      have hnorm_12 : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ = 1 / 2 := by rw [norm_div]; norm_num
      rw [h_eq, norm_mul, hnorm_12]
      have h_sum := norm_add_le (kp - k₀) (km - k₀)
      linarith [hkp_diff, hkm_diff]
    have hS_lo_k0 : (11 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ := by
      have h_eq : (2 : ℂ) * k₀ = (kp + km) - ((kp - k₀) + (km - k₀)) := by ring
      have h2k : 2 * ‖k₀‖ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ + (‖kp - k₀‖ + ‖km - k₀‖) := by
        calc 2 * ‖k₀‖ = ‖(2 : ℂ) * k₀‖ := by rw [norm_mul]; norm_num
          _ = ‖(kp + km) - ((kp - k₀) + (km - k₀))‖ := by rw [h_eq]
          _ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ + ‖(kp - k₀) + (km - k₀)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ + (‖kp - k₀‖ + ‖km - k₀‖) :=
              add_le_add le_rfl (norm_add_le _ _)
      linarith [hkp_diff, hkm_diff]
    have hS_lo_κ0 : κ₀ ≤ ‖kp + km‖ := by linarith
    have hS_ne : kp + km ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hκ₀_pos hS_lo_κ0)
    have hH_hi_k0 : ‖(kp + km) / 2‖ ≤ (13 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
      have h_tri : ‖(kp + km) / 2‖ ≤ ‖(kp + km) / 2 - k₀‖ + ‖k₀‖ := by
        calc ‖(kp + km) / 2‖ = ‖((kp + km) / 2 - k₀) + k₀‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖(kp + km) / 2 - k₀‖ + ‖k₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      linarith
    have hH_hi_κ0 : ‖(kp + km) / 2‖ ≤ 2 * κ₀ := by linarith
    have hD_hi : ‖kp - km‖ ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
      calc ‖kp - km‖ = ‖(kp - k₀) - (km - k₀)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖kp - k₀‖ + ‖km - k₀‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by linarith [hkp_diff, hkm_diff]
    set q : ℂ := (kp - km) / (kp + km)
    have hq_le : ‖q‖ ≤ 1 / 11 := by
      have hmul : q * (kp + km) = kp - km := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hS_ne
      have h_ineq : ((11 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖) * ‖q‖ ≤ ((11 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖) * (1 / 11 : ℝ) := by
        calc ((11 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖) * ‖q‖
            ≤ ‖kp + km‖ * ‖q‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS_lo_k0 (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖q * (kp + km)‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ = ‖kp - km‖ := by rw [hmul]
          _ ≤ (1 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := hD_hi
          _ = ((11 / 6 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖) * (1 / 11 : ℝ) := by ring
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_ineq (by positivity)
    set Ξ : ℂ := 4 * kp * km / (kp + km) ^ 2
    have hΞ_sub_eq : Ξ - 1 = -q ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [Ξ, q]
      field_simp [hS_ne]
      ring
    have hΞ_sub_le : ‖Ξ - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 121 := by
      rw [hΞ_sub_eq, norm_neg, norm_pow]
      calc ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 11 : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq_le 2
        _ = 1 / 121 := by norm_num
    have hΞ_re : 120 / 121 ≤ Ξ.re := by
      have h1 : |(Ξ - 1).re| ≤ ‖Ξ - 1‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (Ξ - 1)
      have h2 : (Ξ - 1).re = Ξ.re - 1 := by simp
      rw [h2, abs_le] at h1
      linarith [h1.1, hΞ_sub_le]
    have hΞ_re_gt : 1 / 4 < Ξ.re := by linarith
    have hΞ_slit : Ξ ∈ Complex.slitPlane :=
      Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith))
    have hR_sub_one : ‖cSqrt Ξ - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 121 :=
      le_trans (hcSqrt_sub_one Ξ hΞ_re_gt) hΞ_sub_le
    have hR_norm : ‖cSqrt Ξ‖ ≤ 2 := by
      have h_tri : ‖cSqrt Ξ‖ ≤ ‖cSqrt Ξ - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by
        calc ‖cSqrt Ξ‖ = ‖(cSqrt Ξ - 1) + 1‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖cSqrt Ξ - 1‖ + ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_one] at h_tri
      linarith
    have hCanon_sq : canonRoot Q u a₁ ^ 2 = kp * km := by
      have hR_sq : cSqrt Ξ ^ 2 = Ξ := (hcSqrt_half Ξ hΞ_re_gt).1
      change (((kp + km) / 2) * cSqrt Ξ) ^ 2 = kp * km
      calc (((kp + km) / 2) * cSqrt Ξ) ^ 2
          = ((kp + km) / 2) ^ 2 * cSqrt Ξ ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = ((kp + km) / 2) ^ 2 * Ξ := by rw [hR_sq]
        _ = kp * km := by
            dsimp [Ξ]
            field_simp [hS_ne]
            ring
    have hNum_k0 : ‖slNumerator Q u v‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
      have h_decomp : slNumerator Q u v =
          (k₀ - (kp + km) / 2) + ((kp + km) / 2) * (1 - cSqrt Ξ) := by
        change k₀ - ((kp + km) / 2) * cSqrt Ξ = _
        ring
      have h1 : ‖k₀ - (kp + km) / 2‖ ≤ (1 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
        exact hH_diff
      have h2 : ‖1 - cSqrt Ξ‖ ≤ 1 / 121 := by
        rw [norm_sub_rev]
        exact hR_sub_one
      have h3 : ‖((kp + km) / 2) * (1 - cSqrt Ξ)‖ ≤
          ((13 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖) * (1 / 121 : ℝ) := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul hH_hi_k0 h2 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      rw [h_decomp]
      calc ‖(k₀ - (kp + km) / 2) + ((kp + km) / 2) * (1 - cSqrt Ξ)‖
          ≤ ‖k₀ - (kp + km) / 2‖ + ‖((kp + km) / 2) * (1 - cSqrt Ξ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ := by linarith
    have hNum_κ0 : ‖slNumerator Q u v‖ ≤ κ₀ := by linarith
    refine ⟨hk0_ne, ha₁_le_one, ?_, hP1_cont, hPm1_cont, hS_ne, hS_lo_κ0, hH_hi_κ0,
      hq_le, hΞ_sub_eq, hΞ_re, hΞ_slit, hR_norm, hCanon_sq, hNum_k0, hNum_κ0⟩
    intro w hw
    exact ⟨le_trans (hField w hw).1 hKF_rb_le_half, hP1_bdd w hw, hPm1_bdd w hw⟩

  
  have hVanishLeft : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, IsBasePot Q →
      ∀ v : ℂ, ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * r_b → slNumerator Q 0 v = 0 := by
    intro Q hBase v hv
    have h0_le : ‖(0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * r_b := by simp [hrb_pos.le]
    have hOut := hSingleEnv Q hBase 0 v h0_le hv
    set k₀ : ℂ := k0Kernel Q 1
    set a₁ : ℂ := (v - (0 : ℂ) * c0Kernel Q 1) / k₀
    have hk0_ne : k₀ ≠ 0 := hOut.1
    have hk0_pos : 0 < ‖k₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hk0_ne
    have hCanon_sq : canonRoot Q 0 a₁ ^ 2 = kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ :=
      hOut.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hNum_le : ‖slNumerator Q 0 v‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖k₀‖ :=
      hOut.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have hW := hWronskProd Q a₁ hBase.1
    have h_factor : (canonRoot Q 0 a₁ - k₀) * (canonRoot Q 0 a₁ + k₀) = 0 := by
      calc (canonRoot Q 0 a₁ - k₀) * (canonRoot Q 0 a₁ + k₀)
          = canonRoot Q 0 a₁ ^ 2 - k₀ ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = kPlusVal Q 0 a₁ * kMinusVal Q 0 a₁ - k₀ ^ 2 := by rw [hCanon_sq]
        _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hW
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_factor with h_sub | h_add
    · have h_eq : canonRoot Q 0 a₁ = k₀ := sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub
      change k₀ - canonRoot Q 0 a₁ = 0
      rw [h_eq, sub_self]
    · exfalso
      have h_eq : canonRoot Q 0 a₁ = -k₀ := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h_add
      have h_num_eq : slNumerator Q 0 v = (2 : ℂ) * k₀ := by
        change k₀ - canonRoot Q 0 a₁ = (2 : ℂ) * k₀
        rw [h_eq]
        ring
      have h_norm_eq : ‖slNumerator Q 0 v‖ = 2 * ‖k₀‖ := by
        rw [h_num_eq, norm_mul]
        norm_num
      linarith

  have hVanishRight : ∀ Q : ℝ → ℂ, IsBasePot Q →
      ∀ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ ≤ 2 * r_b → slNumerator Q u 0 = 0 := by
    intro Q hBase u hu
    rcases hBase with ⟨hQ_cont, hQ_bdd, hk0_lo, hk0_hi⟩
    let Q_rev : ℝ → ℂ := fun w => Q (1 - w)
    have h_flip_cont : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => 1 - w) :=
      continuous_const.sub continuous_id
    have h_flip_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun w : ℝ => 1 - w) I I := by
      intro w ⟨hw0, hw1⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hQ_rev_cont : ContinuousOn Q_rev I :=
      hQ_cont.comp h_flip_cont.continuousOn h_flip_maps
    have hQ_rev_bdd : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q_rev w‖ ≤ M₀ + 1 :=
      fun w hw => hQ_bdd (1 - w) (h_flip_maps hw)
    have hk0_rev_eq : k0Kernel Q_rev 1 = k0Kernel Q 1 := hRevK Q hQ_cont
    have hBase_rev : IsBasePot Q_rev :=
      ⟨hQ_rev_cont, hQ_rev_bdd, by rwa [hk0_rev_eq], by rwa [hk0_rev_eq]⟩
    have hk0_ne : k0Kernel Q 1 ≠ 0 :=
      norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hk0_lo)
    have h_left := hVanishLeft Q_rev hBase_rev (-u) (by simpa using hu)
    have h_rev := hRevNum Q hQ_cont hk0_ne 0 (-u)
    simpa using h_rev.symm.trans h_left

  
  have hUnifiedHolo : ∀ (Ω : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (P : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ → ℂ) (w₀_fn w₁_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen Ω →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => P q.1 q.2) (Ω ×ˢ I) →
      (∀ w ∈ I, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => P p w) Ω) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w₀_fn Ω →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ w₁_fn Ω →
      (∀ p ∈ Ω,
        let a₁ := (w₁_fn p - w₀_fn p * c0Kernel (P p) 1) / k0Kernel (P p) 1
        let kp := kPlusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) a₁
        let km := kMinusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) a₁
        k0Kernel (P p) 1 ≠ 0 ∧
        kp + km ≠ 0 ∧
        4 * kp * km / (kp + km) ^ 2 ∈ Complex.slitPlane) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => slNumerator (P p) (w₀_fn p) (w₁_fn p)) Ω := by
    intro Ω P w₀_fn w₁_fn hΩ hP_cont hP_holo hw₀_holo hw₁_holo h_adm
    obtain ⟨hc0_holo, hk0_holo, _, _⟩ :=
      hLip.2 Ω P (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) hΩ hP_cont hP_holo
        (differentiableOn_const 0) (differentiableOn_const 0)
    let a₁_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p => (w₁_fn p - w₀_fn p * c0Kernel (P p) 1) / k0Kernel (P p) 1
    have ha₁_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ a₁_fn Ω := by
      have hnum : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => w₁_fn p - w₀_fn p * c0Kernel (P p) 1) Ω :=
        hw₁_holo.sub (hw₀_holo.mul hc0_holo)
      intro p hp
      have h_eq : a₁_fn =
          (fun q => (w₁_fn q - w₀_fn q * c0Kernel (P q) 1) * (k0Kernel (P q) 1)⁻¹) := by
        funext q
        exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hnum p hp).mul ((hk0_holo p hp).fun_inv (h_adm p hp).1)
    obtain ⟨_, _, hkp_holo, hkm_holo⟩ :=
      hLip.2 Ω P w₀_fn a₁_fn hΩ hP_cont hP_holo hw₀_holo ha₁_holo
    let S_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p => kPlusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p) + kMinusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p)
    have hS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_fn Ω := hkp_holo.add hkm_holo
    let Ξ_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
      fun p => 4 * kPlusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p) *
        kMinusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p) / (S_fn p) ^ 2
    have hΞ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Ξ_fn Ω := by
      have hnum : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p => 4 * kPlusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p) *
            kMinusVal (P p) (w₀_fn p) (a₁_fn p)) Ω :=
        ((differentiableOn_const (4 : ℂ)).mul hkp_holo).mul hkm_holo
      have hden : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => (S_fn p) ^ 2) Ω := hS_holo.pow 2
      intro p hp
      have h_eq : Ξ_fn =
          (fun q => 4 * kPlusVal (P q) (w₀_fn q) (a₁_fn q) *
            kMinusVal (P q) (w₀_fn q) (a₁_fn q) * ((S_fn q) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        funext q
        exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hnum p hp).mul ((hden p hp).fun_inv (pow_ne_zero 2 (h_adm p hp).2.1))
    have hlog_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => Complex.log (Ξ_fn p)) Ω :=
      hΞ_holo.clog (fun p hp => (h_adm p hp).2.2)
    have hexp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p => Complex.exp ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.log (Ξ_fn p))) Ω :=
      ((differentiableOn_const (1 / 2 : ℂ)).mul hlog_holo).cexp
    have hH_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => S_fn p / 2) Ω := by
      have h_eq : (fun p => S_fn p / 2) = (fun p => S_fn p * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹) := by
        funext p
        exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hS_holo.mul (differentiableOn_const (2 : ℂ)⁻¹)
    exact hk0_holo.sub (hH_holo.mul hexp_holo)

  
  have hTwoPotLip : ∀ (Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ → ℂ) (Δ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ Δ →
      IsBasePot Q₁ →
      IsBasePot Q₂ →
      (∀ w ∈ I, ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ ≤ Δ) →
      ∀ w₀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ ≤ r_b → ‖w₁‖ ≤ r_b →
        ‖slNumerator Q₁ w₀ w₁ - slNumerator Q₂ w₀ w₁‖ ≤ L_num * Δ := by
    intro Q₁ Q₂ Δ hΔ hBase₁ hBase₂ hDiff w₀ w₁ hw₀ hw₁
    have hw₀_le_one : ‖w₀‖ ≤ 1 := le_trans hw₀ hrb_le_one
    have hw₀_2rb : ‖w₀‖ ≤ 2 * r_b := by linarith
    have hw₁_2rb : ‖w₁‖ ≤ 2 * r_b := by linarith
    have hOut₁ := hSingleEnv Q₁ hBase₁ w₀ w₁ hw₀_2rb hw₁_2rb
    have hOut₂ := hSingleEnv Q₂ hBase₂ w₀ w₁ hw₀_2rb hw₁_2rb
    rcases hBase₁ with ⟨hQ₁_cont, hQ₁_bdd, hk0₁_lo, _⟩
    rcases hBase₂ with ⟨hQ₂_cont, hQ₂_bdd, _, _⟩
    obtain ⟨hk0₁_ne, ha₁₁_le, hPt₁, hP1₁_cont, hPm1₁_cont, hS₁_ne, hS₁_lo, _, hq₁_le,
      hΞ₁_sub, hΞ₁_re, _, hR₁_norm, _, _, _⟩ := hOut₁
    obtain ⟨hk0₂_ne, ha₁₂_le, hPt₂, hP1₂_cont, hPm1₂_cont, hS₂_ne, _, hH₂_hi, hq₂_le,
      hΞ₂_sub, hΞ₂_re, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := hOut₂
    have hQ₂_ker : ∀ w ∈ I, ‖k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ ∧ ‖k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨_, hk0_w, _, hk0d_w, _⟩ :=
        hLip.1 (M₀ + 1) 0 Q₂ Q₂ (by linarith) le_rfl hQ₂_cont hQ₂_cont
          (fun t ht => ⟨hQ₂_bdd t ht, hQ₂_bdd t ht, by simp⟩) w hw
      exact ⟨by dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith, by dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith⟩
    have hKer_diff : ∀ w ∈ I,
        ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ * Δ ∧
        ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ * Δ ∧
        ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ * Δ ∧
        ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ ≤ B₀ * Δ := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hdc0, hdk0, hdc0', hdk0'⟩ :=
        hLip.1 (M₀ + 1) Δ Q₁ Q₂ (by linarith) hΔ hQ₁_cont hQ₂_cont
          (fun t ht => ⟨hQ₁_bdd t ht, hQ₂_bdd t ht, hDiff t ht⟩) w hw
      have hE₀_le_B₀ : E₀ ≤ B₀ := by dsimp [B₀]; nlinarith
      have h1M_eq : (1 + (M₀ + 1)) * E₀ * Δ = B₀ * Δ := by dsimp [B₀]; ring
      exact ⟨le_trans hdc0 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE₀_le_B₀ hΔ),
        le_trans hdk0 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hE₀_le_B₀ hΔ),
        by linarith [hdc0', h1M_eq],
        by linarith [hdk0', h1M_eq]⟩
    set a₁₁ : ℂ := (w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₁ 1) / k0Kernel Q₁ 1
    set a₁₂ : ℂ := (w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₂ 1) / k0Kernel Q₂ 1
    have ha₁_diff : ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖ ≤ C_a * Δ := by
      have hm1 : a₁₁ * k0Kernel Q₁ 1 = w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₁ 1 :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk0₁_ne
      have hm2 : a₁₂ * k0Kernel Q₂ 1 = w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₂ 1 :=
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk0₂_ne
      have h_id : (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₁ 1 =
          -(w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ 1 - c0Kernel Q₂ 1) +
            a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1)) := by
        calc (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₁ 1
            = a₁₁ * k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - a₁₂ * k0Kernel Q₂ 1 -
                a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1) := by ring
          _ = (w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₁ 1) - (w₁ - w₀ * c0Kernel Q₂ 1) -
                a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1) := by rw [hm1, hm2]
          _ = -(w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ 1 - c0Kernel Q₂ 1) +
                a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1)) := by ring
      obtain ⟨hdc0_1, hdk0_1, _, _⟩ := hKer_diff 1 h1_mem
      have h_rhs : ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₁ 1‖ ≤ 2 * B₀ * Δ := by
        rw [h_id, norm_neg]
        calc ‖w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ 1 - c0Kernel Q₂ 1) +
                a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1)‖
            ≤ ‖w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ 1 - c0Kernel Q₂ 1)‖ +
                ‖a₁₂ * (k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖w₀‖ * ‖c0Kernel Q₁ 1 - c0Kernel Q₂ 1‖ +
                ‖a₁₂‖ * ‖k0Kernel Q₁ 1 - k0Kernel Q₂ 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ 1 * (B₀ * Δ) + 1 * (B₀ * Δ) :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul hw₀_le_one hdc0_1 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                (mul_le_mul ha₁₂_le hdk0_1 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
          _ = 2 * B₀ * Δ := by ring
      have h_lhs : ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖ ≤ ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (C_a * Δ) := by
        have h_eq : ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (C_a * Δ) = (9 / 4 : ℝ) * B₀ * Δ := by
          dsimp [C_a]
          field_simp [hκ₀_pos.ne']
          ring
        calc ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖
            ≤ ‖k0Kernel Q₁ 1‖ * ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk0₁_lo (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₁ 1‖ := by rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
          _ ≤ 2 * B₀ * Δ := h_rhs
          _ ≤ (9 / 4 : ℝ) * B₀ * Δ := by nlinarith
          _ = ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * κ₀) * (C_a * Δ) := h_eq.symm
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_lhs (by positivity)
    have hPertDiff : ∀ sgn : ℂ, ‖sgn‖ = 1 →
        ∀ w ∈ I,
          ‖pertPotential sgn Q₁ w₀ a₁₁ w - pertPotential sgn Q₂ w₀ a₁₂ w‖ ≤
            (1 + 2 * C_F) * Δ := by
      intro sgn hsgn w hw
      obtain ⟨hdc0, hdk0, hdc0', hdk0'⟩ := hKer_diff w hw
      obtain ⟨hk0₂_B, hk0d₂_B⟩ := hQ₂_ker w hw
      let F₁ : ℂ := w₀ * c0Kernel Q₁ w + a₁₁ * k0Kernel Q₁ w
      let F₂ : ℂ := w₀ * c0Kernel Q₂ w + a₁₂ * k0Kernel Q₂ w
      let Fp₁ : ℂ := w₀ * c0Deriv Q₁ w + a₁₁ * k0Deriv Q₁ w
      let Fp₂ : ℂ := w₀ * c0Deriv Q₂ w + a₁₂ * k0Deriv Q₂ w
      have hF_diff : ‖F₁ - F₂‖ ≤ C_F * Δ := by
        have h_id : F₁ - F₂ =
            w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w) +
            a₁₁ * (k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w) +
            (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₂ w := by
          dsimp [F₁, F₂]; ring
        rw [h_id]
        calc ‖w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w) +
                a₁₁ * (k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w) +
                (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₂ w‖
            ≤ ‖w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w) +
                a₁₁ * (k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖w₀ * (c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖a₁₁ * (k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ :=
              add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ = ‖w₀‖ * ‖c0Kernel Q₁ w - c0Kernel Q₂ w‖ +
              ‖a₁₁‖ * ‖k0Kernel Q₁ w - k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ +
              ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖ * ‖k0Kernel Q₂ w‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ 1 * (B₀ * Δ) + 1 * (B₀ * Δ) + (C_a * Δ) * B₀ :=
              add_le_add
                (add_le_add
                  (mul_le_mul hw₀_le_one hdc0 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                  (mul_le_mul ha₁₁_le hdk0 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one))
                (mul_le_mul ha₁_diff hk0₂_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = C_F * Δ := by dsimp [C_F]; ring
      have hFp_diff : ‖Fp₁ - Fp₂‖ ≤ C_F * Δ := by
        have h_id : Fp₁ - Fp₂ =
            w₀ * (c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w) +
            a₁₁ * (k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w) +
            (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Deriv Q₂ w := by
          dsimp [Fp₁, Fp₂]; ring
        rw [h_id]
        calc ‖w₀ * (c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w) +
                a₁₁ * (k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w) +
                (a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Deriv Q₂ w‖
            ≤ ‖w₀ * (c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w) +
                a₁₁ * (k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖w₀ * (c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖a₁₁ * (k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w)‖ +
              ‖(a₁₁ - a₁₂) * k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ :=
              add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ = ‖w₀‖ * ‖c0Deriv Q₁ w - c0Deriv Q₂ w‖ +
              ‖a₁₁‖ * ‖k0Deriv Q₁ w - k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ +
              ‖a₁₁ - a₁₂‖ * ‖k0Deriv Q₂ w‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
          _ ≤ 1 * (B₀ * Δ) + 1 * (B₀ * Δ) + (C_a * Δ) * B₀ :=
              add_le_add
                (add_le_add
                  (mul_le_mul hw₀_le_one hdc0' (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
                  (mul_le_mul ha₁₁_le hdk0' (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one))
                (mul_le_mul ha₁_diff hk0d₂_B (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = C_F * Δ := by dsimp [C_F]; ring
      have hF_sum_le : ‖F₁ + F₂‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have hF₁_le : ‖F₁‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := (hPt₁ w hw).1
        have hF₂_le : ‖F₂‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := (hPt₂ w hw).1
        calc ‖F₁ + F₂‖ ≤ ‖F₁‖ + ‖F₂‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 := add_le_add hF₁_le hF₂_le
          _ = 1 := by norm_num
      have hF_sq_diff : ‖F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2‖ ≤ C_F * Δ := by
        have h_sq_eq : F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2 = (F₁ + F₂) * (F₁ - F₂) := by ring
        rw [h_sq_eq, norm_mul]
        calc ‖F₁ + F₂‖ * ‖F₁ - F₂‖
            ≤ 1 * (C_F * Δ) :=
              mul_le_mul hF_sum_le hF_diff (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = C_F * Δ := one_mul _
      have hP_eq : pertPotential sgn Q₁ w₀ a₁₁ w - pertPotential sgn Q₂ w₀ a₁₂ w =

          ≤ ‖(Q₁ w - Q₂ w) - sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * (Fp₁ - Fp₂)‖ +
              ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ + ‖sgn * (3 * Complex.I / 2) * (Fp₁ - Fp₂)‖ +
              ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ) * (F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2)‖ :=
              add_le_add (norm_sub_le _ _) le_rfl
        _ = ‖Q₁ w - Q₂ w‖ + ‖sgn‖ * ‖(3 * Complex.I / 2 : ℂ)‖ * ‖Fp₁ - Fp₂‖ +
              ‖(1 / 4 : ℂ)‖ * ‖F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]

              (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖F₁ ^ 2 - F₂ ^ 2‖ := by
              rw [hsgn, hnorm_3I2, hnorm_14, one_mul]

    have hkp_diff : ‖kPlusVal Q₁ w₀ a₁₁ - kPlusVal Q₂ w₀ a₁₂‖ ≤ C_k * Δ := by

        (pertPotential 1 Q₁ w₀ a₁₁) (pertPotential 1 Q₂ w₀ a₁₂)
        (by linarith) (by positivity) hP1₁_cont hP1₂_cont
        (fun w hw => ⟨(hPt₁ w hw).2.1, (hPt₂ w hw).2.1, hPertDiff 1 norm_one w hw⟩)
        1 h1_mem).2.2.2.2.2.1
      simpa [kPlusVal, C_k, E_pert, mul_assoc] using h1
    have hkm_diff : ‖kMinusVal Q₁ w₀ a₁₁ - kMinusVal Q₂ w₀ a₁₂‖ ≤ C_k * Δ := by

        1 h1_mem).2.2.2.2.2.1
      simpa [kMinusVal, C_k, E_pert, mul_assoc] using h1

    set km₁ : ℂ := kMinusVal Q₁ w₀ a₁₁
    set kp₂ : ℂ := kPlusVal Q₂ w₀ a₁₂
    set km₂ : ℂ := kMinusVal Q₂ w₀ a₁₂

    set S₂ : ℂ := kp₂ + km₂

    set q₂ : ℂ := (kp₂ - km₂) / S₂

    set Ξ₂ : ℂ := 4 * kp₂ * km₂ / S₂ ^ 2

        _ ≤ 2 * C_k * Δ := by linarith
    have hH_diff : ‖S₁ / 2 - S₂ / 2‖ ≤ C_k * Δ := by

      have hm2 : q₂ * S₂ = kp₂ - km₂ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hS₂_ne

              add_le_add hD_diff

        have h_eq : κ₀ * ((4 * C_k / κ₀) * Δ) = 4 * C_k * Δ := by

            ≤ ‖S₁‖ * ‖q₁ - q₂‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS₁_lo (norm_nonneg _)

          _ ≤ 4 * C_k * Δ := h_rhs
          _ = κ₀ * ((4 * C_k / κ₀) * Δ) := h_eq.symm
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_lhs hκ₀_pos
    have hΞ_diff : ‖Ξ₁ - Ξ₂‖ ≤ (4 * C_k / κ₀) * Δ := by
      have h_id : Ξ₁ - Ξ₂ = -(q₁ + q₂) * (q₁ - q₂) := by

      rw [h_id, norm_mul, norm_neg]

    have hR_diff : ‖cSqrt Ξ₁ - cSqrt Ξ₂‖ ≤ (4 * C_k / κ₀) * Δ :=

    have hCanon_diff : ‖canonRoot Q₁ w₀ a₁₁ - canonRoot Q₂ w₀ a₁₂‖ ≤ 10 * C_k * Δ := by

        change (S₁ / 2) * cSqrt Ξ₁ - (S₂ / 2) * cSqrt Ξ₂ = _

      have h_term1 : ‖(S₁ / 2 - S₂ / 2) * cSqrt Ξ₁‖ ≤ 2 * C_k * Δ := by

      have h_term2 : ‖(S₂ / 2) * (cSqrt Ξ₁ - cSqrt Ξ₂)‖ ≤ 8 * C_k * Δ := by

        have h_cancel : (2 * κ₀) * ((4 * C_k / κ₀) * Δ) = 8 * C_k * Δ := by

      rw [h_id]

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (r_b : ℝ) (N : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_b →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => N z.1 z.2)
        (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b)) →
      (∀ w₁ : ℂ, ‖w₁‖ < 2 * r_b → N 0 w₁ = 0) →
      (∀ w₀ : ℂ, ‖w₀‖ < 2 * r_b → N w₀ 0 = 0) →
      ∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ, ‖b₀‖ < r_b / 2 → ‖b₁‖ < r_b / 2 →
        bivarHybridDiv N b₀ b₁ =
          (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                N ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
                  ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) /
                (((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - b₀) *
                  ((r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I) - b₁))) ∧
    (∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (G : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => G x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
        (U ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) →
      (∀ θ₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ∀ θ₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G p θ₀ θ₁) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p =>
          ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G p θ₀ θ₁)
        U) ∧
    (∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ),
      (∀ u v : ℂ, F₂ u v = F₁ (-v) (-u)) →
      bivarHybridDiv F₂ (-b₁) (-b₀) = bivarHybridDiv F₁ b₀ b₁)

by
  have hdslope_const_mul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℂ),
      dslope (fun z => c * h z) 0 u = c * dslope h 0 u := by
    intro c h u
    by_cases hu : u = 0
    · subst hu
      simp only [dslope_same, deriv_const_mul_field]
    · simp only [dslope_of_ne _ hu, slope_def_field, sub_zero]
      ring

  have hdslope_comp_mul : ∀ (T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 → ∀ (h : ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℂ),
      dslope (fun z => h (T * z)) 0 u = T * dslope h 0 (T * u) := by
    intro T hT h u
    by_cases hu : u = 0
    · subst hu
      simp only [mul_zero, dslope_same, deriv_comp_mul_left, smul_eq_mul]
    · have hTu : T * u ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hT hu
      simp only [dslope_of_ne _ hu, dslope_of_ne _ hTu, slope_def_field, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      field_simp [hT, hu]

        T ^ 2 * dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => M w₀ w₁) 0 (T * u₁)) 0 (T * u₀) := by
    intro T hT M u₀ u₁

        (fun z₀ => T * dslope (fun w₁ => M (T * z₀) w₁) 0 (T * u₁)) := by
      funext z₀
      exact hdslope_comp_mul T hT (fun w₁ => M (T * z₀) w₁) u₁
    rw [h_inner, hdslope_const_mul T,
      hdslope_comp_mul T hT (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => M w₀ w₁) 0 (T * u₁)) u₀]
