      (∀ u v : ℂ, B u v = A (-v) (-u)) →
      ∀ b₀ b₁ : ℂ,
        dslope (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => B z₀ z₁) 0 (-b₀)) 0 (-b₁) =
          dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => A w₀ w₁) 0 b₀) 0 b₁ := by
    intro A B hAB b₀ b₁
    have h_fn : (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => B z₀ z₁) 0 (-b₀)) =
        (fun z₀ => dslope (fun z₁ => A ((-1 : ℂ) * z₁) ((-1 : ℂ) * z₀)) 0 (-b₀)) := by
      funext z₀
      congr 1
      funext z₁
      simp [hAB z₀ z₁]
    rw [h_fn, hbivar_dslope_scale (-1) (by norm_num) (fun w₁ w₀ => A w₀ w₁) (-b₁) (-b₀)]
    have h1 : (-1 : ℂ) * -b₀ = b₀ := by ring
    have h2 : (-1 : ℂ) * -b₁ = b₁ := by ring
    rw [h1, h2]
    ring

  have hBivarRev : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (b₀ b₁ : ℂ),
      (∀ u v : ℂ, F₂ u v = F₁ (-v) (-u)) →
      bivarHybridDiv F₂ (-b₁) (-b₀) = bivarHybridDiv F₁ b₀ b₁ := by
    intro F₁ F₂ b₀ b₁ hF
    have hF_symm : ∀ u v : ℂ, F₁ u v = F₂ (-v) (-u) := by
      intro u v
      rw [hF (-v) (-u), neg_neg, neg_neg]
    dsimp only [bivarHybridDiv]
    split_ifs with h_nz' h_nz h_nz
    · rw [hF (-b₁) (-b₀), neg_neg, neg_neg]
      ring
    · exact False.elim (h_nz ⟨neg_ne_zero.mp h_nz'.2, neg_ne_zero.mp h_nz'.1⟩)
    · exact False.elim (h_nz' ⟨neg_ne_zero.mpr h_nz.2, neg_ne_zero.mpr h_nz.1⟩)
    · have h_t1 := h_swap_order F₁ F₂ hF b₀ b₁
      have h_t2 := (h_swap_order F₂ F₁ hF_symm (-b₁) (-b₀)).symm
      simp only [neg_neg] at h_t2
      rw [h_t1, h_t2, add_comm]

  let J : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have huIcc : Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) = J := Set.uIcc_of_le h2pi_pos.le
  have huIoc_sub : Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ⊆ J :=
    huIcc ▸ Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc

  have hParamHolo1D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {H : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ},
      IsOpen W →
      ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => H q.1 q.2) (W ×ˢ J) →
      (∀ θ ∈ J, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => H p θ) W) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H p θ) W := by
    let π₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.fst
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_fst }
    let π₂ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := Prod.snd
            map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
        cont := continuous_snd }
    let e₁ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := fun u => (u, 0)
            map_add' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp }
        cont := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
    let e₂ : ℂ →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { toLinearMap :=
          { toFun := fun u => (0, u)
            map_add' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp
            map_smul' := fun _ _ => by ext <;> simp }
        cont := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id }

    have hfderiv_decomp : ∀ {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {L : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ} {q : ℂ × ℂ},
        HasFDerivAt g L q →
        HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (L (1, 0)) q.1 ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (L (0, 1)) q.2 ∧
        L = π₁.smulRight (deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1) +
          π₂.smulRight (deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2) := by
      intro g L q hg
      have hemb₁ : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) e₁ q.1 := by
        have h_eq : (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) = (fun u : ℂ => e₁ u + (0, q.2)) := by
          ext u <;> simp [e₁]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact e₁.hasFDerivAt.add_const (0, q.2)
      have hemb₂ : HasFDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) e₂ q.2 := by
        have h_eq : (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) = (fun u : ℂ => e₂ u + (q.1, 0)) := by
          ext u <;> simp [e₂]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact e₂.hasFDerivAt.add_const (q.1, 0)
      have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (L (1, 0)) q.1 :=
        (hg.comp q.1 hemb₁).hasDerivAt
      have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (L (0, 1)) q.2 :=
        (hg.comp q.2 hemb₂).hasDerivAt
      refine ⟨hd₁, hd₂, ?_⟩
      rw [hd₁.deriv, hd₂.deriv]
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have hv_eq : v = v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        ext <;> simp
      calc L v = L (v.1 • ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)) + v.2 • ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ))) := by rw [← hv_eq]
        _ = v.1 • L (1, 0) + v.2 • L (0, 1) := by rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
        _ = (π₁.smulRight (L (1, 0)) + π₂.smulRight (L (0, 1))) v := rfl

    have hCauchy2D : ∀ {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} {g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ} {q₀ : ℂ × ℂ} {r C : ℝ},
        IsOpen W →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g W →
        0 < r →
        0 ≤ C →
        Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) ⊆ W →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r), ‖g x‖ ≤ C) →
        ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r, ‖fderiv ℂ g q‖ ≤ 2 * C / r := by
      intro W g q₀ r C hW hg hr hC0 hsub hbnd q hq
      have hq_dist : ‖q - q₀‖ < r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_ball.mp hq
      have hq_mem : q ∈ W := hsub (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr
        (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith))
      have hg_at : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℂ g q) q :=
        (hg.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hq_mem)).hasFDerivAt
      obtain ⟨_, _, hL_eq⟩ := hfderiv_decomp hg_at
      have hslice₁_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall q.1 r, (u, q.2) ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) := by
        intro u hu
        have hu_r : ‖u - q.1‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · calc ‖u - q₀.1‖ = ‖(u - q.1) + (q.1 - q₀.1)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖u - q.1‖ + ‖q.1 - q₀.1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ r + ‖q - q₀‖ := by
                refine add_le_add hu_r ?_
                rw [Prod.norm_def]
                exact le_max_left _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
        · calc ‖q.2 - q₀.2‖ ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
      have hslice₂_sub : ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall q.2 r, (q.1, u) ∈ Metric.closedBall q₀ (2 * r) := by
        intro u hu
        have hu_r : ‖u - q.2‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hu
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · calc ‖q.1 - q₀.1‖ ≤ ‖q - q₀‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
        · calc ‖u - q₀.2‖ = ‖(u - q.2) + (q.2 - q₀.2)‖ := by ring_nf
            _ ≤ ‖u - q.2‖ + ‖q.2 - q₀.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ r + ‖q - q₀‖ := by
                refine add_le_add hu_r ?_
                rw [Prod.norm_def]
                exact le_max_right _ _
            _ ≤ 2 * r := by linarith
      have hd₁_le : ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ ≤ C / r := by
        have hdiff₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) (Metric.closedBall q.1 r) := by
          have hemb_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (u, q.2)) := fun u => by
            have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (z, q.2)) = (fun z : ℂ => e₁ z + (0, q.2)) := by
              ext z <;> simp [e₁]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact (e₁.hasFDerivAt.add_const (0, q.2)).differentiableAt
          exact hg.comp hemb_diff.differentiableOn (fun u hu => hsub (hslice₁_sub u hu))
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
          (hdiff₁.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl)
          (fun u hu => hbnd (u, q.2) (hslice₁_sub u (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu)))
      have hd₂_le : ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ ≤ C / r := by
        have hdiff₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) (Metric.closedBall q.2 r) := by
          have hemb_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun u : ℂ => (q.1, u)) := fun u => by
            have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (q.1, z)) = (fun z : ℂ => e₂ z + (q.1, 0)) := by
              ext z <;> simp [e₂]
            rw [h_eq]
            exact (e₂.hasFDerivAt.add_const (q.1, 0)).differentiableAt
          exact hg.comp hemb_diff.differentiableOn (fun u hu => hsub (hslice₂_sub u hu))
        exact Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hr
          (hdiff₂.diffContOnCl_ball Subset.rfl)
          (fun u hu => hbnd (q.1, u) (hslice₂_sub u (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hu)))
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
      have hv₁ : ‖v.1‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_left _ _
      have hv₂ : ‖v.2‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [Prod.norm_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
      calc ‖fderiv ℂ g q v‖
          = ‖v.1 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1 +
              v.2 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := by
            rw [hL_eq]
            rfl
        _ ≤ ‖v.1 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ +
              ‖v.2 * deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖v.1‖ * ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (u, q.2)) q.1‖ +
              ‖v.2‖ * ‖deriv (fun u : ℂ => g (q.1, u)) q.2‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (C / r) + ‖v‖ * (C / r) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hv₁ hd₁_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul hv₂ hd₂_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = (2 * C / r) * ‖v‖ := by ring

    intro W H hW hH_cont hH_holo p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀_pos, hball_R₀⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW p₀ hp₀
    let r : ℝ := R₀ / 3
    have hr : 0 < r := by positivity
    have hcb_sub : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ⊆ W := by
      refine Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball ?_) hball_R₀
      dsimp [r]
      linarith
    have hball_sub : Metric.ball p₀ r ⊆ W :=
      Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))) hcb_sub
    let K : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ) := Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r) ×ˢ J
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ W ×ˢ J := Set.prod_mono_left hcb_sub
    have hK_comp : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * r)).prod isCompact_Icc
    have hK_ne : K.Nonempty :=
      ⟨(p₀, 0), Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by positivity), ⟨le_rfl, h2pi_pos.le⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨p_max, _, hp_max⟩ := hK_comp.exists_isMaxOn hK_ne
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hH_cont.mono hK_sub))
    let C : ℝ := ‖H p_max.1 p_max.2‖
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := norm_nonneg _
    have hHbnd : ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * r), ∀ θ ∈ J, ‖H p θ‖ ≤ C :=
      fun p hp θ hθ => hp_max (show (p, θ) ∈ K from ⟨hp, hθ⟩)
    have hHp_cont : ∀ p ∈ W, ContinuousOn (H p) J :=
      fun p hp => hH_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn
        (fun θ hθ => ⟨hp, hθ⟩)
    let H' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
      fun p θ => fderiv ℂ (fun q => H q θ) p
    have hH'p₀_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (H' p₀)
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      let δ : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => ((r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      have hδ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := fun n => by positivity
      have hδ_lt : ∀ n : ℕ, r / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < r := by
        intro n
        have hden : (1 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
        exact div_lt_self hr hden
      have hδ_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, δ n ≠ 0 :=
        fun n => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hδ_pos n).ne'
      have hδ_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖δ n‖ < r := by
        intro n
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hδ_pos n)]
        exact hδ_lt n
      have hδ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
        have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r / ((n : ℝ) + 2))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 2)
              Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
            tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
          simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop h_atTop
        have h_c : Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
          rw [Complex.ofReal_zero] at h
          exact h
        exact tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within _ h_c
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hδ_ne)
      have hp₁_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, (p₀.1 + δ n, p₀.2) ∈ W := by
        intro n
        apply hball_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        simp [hδ_norm n]
      have hp₂_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, (p₀.1, p₀.2 + δ n) ∈ W := by
        intro n
        apply hball_sub
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.norm_def]
        simp [hδ_norm n]
      let dq₁ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n θ => (δ n)⁻¹ * (H (p₀.1 + δ n, p₀.2) θ - H p₀ θ)
      let dq₂ : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n θ => (δ n)⁻¹ * (H (p₀.1, p₀.2 + δ n) θ - H p₀ θ)
      let L_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) := fun n θ =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁ (dq₁ n θ) +
          ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂ (dq₂ n θ)
      have hL_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (L_seq n)
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        intro n
        have hdq₁_c : ContinuousOn (dq₁ n) J :=
          continuousOn_const.mul ((hHp_cont _ (hp₁_mem n)).sub (hHp_cont p₀ hp₀))
        have hdq₂_c : ContinuousOn (dq₂ n) J :=
          continuousOn_const.mul ((hHp_cont _ (hp₂_mem n)).sub (hHp_cont p₀ hp₀))
        have hL_c : ContinuousOn (L_seq n) J :=
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁).continuous.comp_continuousOn
            hdq₁_c).add
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂).continuous.comp_continuousOn
            hdq₂_c)
        exact (hL_c.mono huIoc_sub).aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_uIoc
      have hL_lim : ∀ᵐ θ ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => L_seq n θ) Filter.atTop (nhds (H' p₀ θ)) := by
        filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_uIoc] with θ hθ
        have hθ_J : θ ∈ J := huIoc_sub hθ
        have hg_at : HasFDerivAt (fun q => H q θ) (H' p₀ θ) p₀ :=
          ((hH_holo θ hθ_J).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp₀)).hasFDerivAt
        obtain ⟨hd₁, hd₂, hL_eq⟩ := hfderiv_decomp hg_at
        rw [hd₁.deriv, hd₂.deriv] at hL_eq
        have ht₁ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dq₁ n θ) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (H' p₀ θ (1, 0))) :=
          (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hd₁).comp hδ_tendsto
        have ht₂ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => dq₂ n θ) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (H' p₀ θ (0, 1))) :=
          (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero.mp hd₂).comp hδ_tendsto
        rw [hL_eq]
        exact (((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₁).continuous.tendsto _).comp
          ht₁).add
          (((ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ π₂).continuous.tendsto _).comp ht₂)
      exact aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hL_meas hL_lim
    have hFDeriv : HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H p θ)
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H' p₀ θ) p₀ := by
      apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
        (𝕜 := ℂ) (s := Metric.ball p₀ r) (bound := fun _ => 2 * C / r)
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr)
      · filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hr] with p hp
        exact ((hHp_cont p (hball_sub hp)).mono huIoc_sub).aestronglyMeasurable
          measurableSet_uIoc
      · exact ((hHp_cont p₀ hp₀).mono (le_of_eq huIcc)).intervalIntegrable
      · exact hH'p₀_meas
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ hθ p hp => ?_)
        exact hCauchy2D hW (hH_holo θ (huIoc_sub hθ)) hr hC0 hcb_sub
          (fun x hx => hHbnd x hx θ (huIoc_sub hθ)) p hp
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ hθ p hp => ?_)
        exact ((hH_holo θ (huIoc_sub hθ)).differentiableAt
          (hW.mem_nhds (hball_sub hp))).hasFDerivAt
    exact hFDeriv.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

  have hDoubleHolo : ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (G : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => G x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
        (U ×ˢ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))) →
      (∀ θ₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        ∀ θ₁ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G p θ₀ θ₁) U) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p =>
          ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G p θ₀ θ₁)
        U := by
    intro U G hU hG_cont hG_holo
    let I₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ :=
      fun p θ₀ => ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G p θ₀ θ₁
    have hI₁_holo : ∀ θ₀ ∈ J, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => I₁ p θ₀) U := by
      intro θ₀ hθ₀
      have hSlice_cont : ContinuousOn (fun q : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ => G q.1 θ₀ q.2) (U ×ˢ J) := by

  have hCauchy : ∀ (r_b : ℝ) (N : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ),

    let z_c : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => (r_b : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)

    let U_b : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (r_b / 2) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (r_b / 2)

          have h_eq : (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => H₁ p θ₁) =

            funext p

          rw [h_eq]

        have hW₁_int_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *

          have hw₀_lt : ‖w₀‖ < 2 * r_b := by

          have hz₁_c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => z_c x.2.2) (U_b ×ˢ (J ×ˢ J)) :=
            (hz_c_cont.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)).continuousOn
          have hp₀_c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => x.1.1) (U_b ×ˢ (J ×ˢ J)) :=
            (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn
          have hp₁_c : ContinuousOn (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => x.1.2) (U_b ×ˢ (J ×ˢ J)) :=
            (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst).continuousOn
          have h_den_c : ContinuousOn
              (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => (z_c x.2.1 - x.1.1) * (z_c x.2.2 - x.1.2))
              (U_b ×ˢ (J ×ˢ J)) :=
            (hz₀_c.sub hp₀_c).mul (hz₁_c.sub hp₁_c)
          have h_eq : (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ => G_M x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2) =
              (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℝ × ℝ =>
                M (z_c x.2.1) (z_c x.2.2) * ((z_c x.2.1 - x.1.1) * (z_c x.2.2 - x.1.2))⁻¹) := by
            funext x
            exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
          rw [h_eq]
          exact h_num_c.mul (h_den_c.inv₀ (fun x hx => hDen_ne x.1 hx.1 x.2.1 x.2.2))
        have hGM_holo : ∀ θ₀ ∈ J, ∀ θ₁ ∈ J, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => G_M p θ₀ θ₁) U_b := by
          intro θ₀ _ θ₁ _ p hp
          have h_den_h : DifferentiableOn ℂ
              (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (z_c θ₀ - q.1) * (z_c θ₁ - q.2)) U_b :=
            ((differentiableOn_const (z_c θ₀)).sub differentiable_fst.differentiableOn).mul
              ((differentiableOn_const (z_c θ₁)).sub differentiable_snd.differentiableOn)
          have h_eq : (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => G_M q θ₀ θ₁) =
              (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => M (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁) *
                ((z_c θ₀ - q.1) * (z_c θ₁ - q.2))⁻¹) := by
            funext q
            exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
          rw [h_eq]
          exact (differentiableWithinAt_const _).mul
            ((h_den_h p hp).fun_inv (hDen_ne p hp θ₀ θ₁))
        have hInt_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
            (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_M p θ₀ θ₁) U_b :=
          (hDoubleHolo U_b G_M hUb_open hGM_cont hGM_holo).const_mul _
        refine hInt_holo.congr (fun p hp => ?_)
        exact hRep p.1 p.2
          (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.1)
          (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hp.2)
      exact ⟨hProd, hRep, hHoloUb⟩

    obtain ⟨hProd₁, hRep₁, hHolo₁⟩ := hIterDslope N hN_holo hN_zero₁ hN_zero₀
    let N_swap : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun w₁ w₀ => N w₀ w₁
    have hN_swap_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ × ℂ => N_swap z.1 z.2)
        (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r_b)) :=
      hN_holo.comp (differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst).differentiableOn
        (fun z hz => ⟨hz.2, hz.1⟩)
    obtain ⟨hProd₂, _, hHolo₂_swap⟩ := hIterDslope N_swap hN_swap_holo hN_zero₀ hN_zero₁
    have hHolo₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 p.1) 0 p.2) U_b :=
      hHolo₂_swap.comp (differentiable_snd.prodMk differentiable_fst).differentiableOn
        (fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩)

    obtain ⟨nzSeq, h_nzSeq⟩ : ∃ nzSeq : ℂ → ℕ → ℂ,
        ∀ b : ℂ, ‖b‖ < r_b / 2 →
          (∀ n : ℕ, nzSeq b n ≠ 0 ∧ ‖nzSeq b n‖ < r_b / 2) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (nzSeq b) Filter.atTop (nhds b) := by
      refine ⟨fun b n => if b = 0 then ((r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) else b, ?_⟩
      intro b hb
      by_cases hb0 : b = 0
      · subst hb0
        simp only [↓reduceIte]
        refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hpos : 0 < r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by positivity
          have hnorm : ‖((r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hpos.le]
          refine ⟨Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpos.ne', ?_⟩
          rw [hnorm, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          nlinarith [hrb, Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
        · have h_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            have h_eq : (fun n : ℕ => r_b / (4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1))) =
                (fun n : ℕ => (r_b / 4) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
              funext n
              have hne : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              field_simp [hne]
            rw [h_eq]
            simpa using tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (r_b / 4)
          have hc := (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h_real
          rwa [Complex.ofReal_zero] at hc
      · simp only [hb0, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨hb0, hb⟩, tendsto_const_nhds⟩

    let D₁ : ℂ := dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => N w₀ w₁) 0 b₁) 0 b₀
    let D₂ : ℂ := dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 b₀) 0 b₁
    let I_cauchy : ℂ :=
      (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∫ θ₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ∫ θ₁ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            N (z_c θ₀) (z_c θ₁) / ((z_c θ₀ - b₀) * (z_c θ₁ - b₁))
    have hD₁_eq : D₁ = I_cauchy := hRep₁ b₀ b₁ hb₀ hb₁
    have hb_mem : (b₀, b₁) ∈ U_b :=
      ⟨by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hb₀,
       by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hb₁⟩
    have hD_eq : D₂ = D₁ := by
      obtain ⟨hu₀_prop, hu₀_lim⟩ := h_nzSeq b₀ hb₀
      obtain ⟨hu₁_prop, hu₁_lim⟩ := h_nzSeq b₁ hb₁
      let p_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun n => (nzSeq b₀ n, nzSeq b₁ n)
      have hp_lim : Filter.Tendsto p_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (b₀, b₁)) :=
        hu₀_lim.prodMk_nhds hu₁_lim
      have hCont₁ : ContinuousAt
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => N w₀ w₁) 0 p.2) 0 p.1) (b₀, b₁) :=
        (hHolo₁.differentiableAt (hUb_open.mem_nhds hb_mem)).continuousAt
      have hCont₂ : ContinuousAt
          (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 p.1) 0 p.2) (b₀, b₁) :=
        (hHolo₂.differentiableAt (hUb_open.mem_nhds hb_mem)).continuousAt
      have h_seq_eq : ∀ n : ℕ,
          dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n) =
            dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n) := by
        intro n
        have hu₀_2rb : ‖nzSeq b₀ n‖ < 2 * r_b := lt_trans (hu₀_prop n).2 (by linarith)
        have hu₁_2rb : ‖nzSeq b₁ n‖ < 2 * r_b := lt_trans (hu₁_prop n).2 (by linarith)
        have hp1 := hProd₁ (nzSeq b₀ n) (nzSeq b₁ n) hu₀_2rb hu₁_2rb
        have hp2 := hProd₂ (nzSeq b₁ n) (nzSeq b₀ n) hu₁_2rb hu₀_2rb
        dsimp only [N_swap] at hp2
        have h_mul_ne : nzSeq b₀ n * nzSeq b₁ n ≠ 0 :=
          mul_ne_zero (hu₀_prop n).1 (hu₁_prop n).1
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ h_mul_ne
        calc nzSeq b₀ n * nzSeq b₁ n *
              dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n)
            = nzSeq b₁ n * nzSeq b₀ n *
              dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n) := by ring
          _ = N (nzSeq b₀ n) (nzSeq b₁ n) := hp2
          _ = nzSeq b₀ n * nzSeq b₁ n *
              dslope (fun w₀ => dslope (fun w₁ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n) :=
                hp1.symm
      have hLim₂ : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds D₂) :=
        hCont₂.tendsto.comp hp_lim
      have hLim₁ : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => dslope (fun w₁ => dslope (fun w₀ => N w₀ w₁) 0 (nzSeq b₀ n)) 0 (nzSeq b₁ n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds D₁) :=
        (hCont₁.tendsto.comp hp_lim).congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (h_seq_eq n).symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hLim₂ hLim₁

    dsimp only [bivarHybridDiv]
    split_ifs with h_nz
    · have hp1 := hProd₁ b₀ b₁ (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h_prod : D₁ * (b₀ * b₁) = N b₀ b₁ := by
        dsimp only [D₁]
        linear_combination hp1
      rw [← h_prod, mul_div_cancel_right₀ D₁ (mul_ne_zero h_nz.1 h_nz.2)]
      exact hD₁_eq
    · change (1 / 2 : ℂ) * D₁ + (1 / 2 : ℂ) * D₂ = I_cauchy
      rw [hD_eq, hD₁_eq]
      ring

  exact ⟨hCauchy, hDoubleHolo, hBivarRev⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F S₀ J₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c b σ hJet _hr_T hr_T_le _hb hAnchor
  rcases hJet with ⟨hr_c, hM_c, hμ₀, hJet_rest⟩
  let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c }
  change DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) Q_c ∧ _ at hJet_rest
  rcases hJet_rest with
    ⟨_hF_holo, hDS_holo, hDJ_holo, _hDJJ_holo, _hDSJ_holo, _hDJS_holo, hQ_bounds, hQ_lip⟩
  have hμ₀_pos : 0 < ‖μ₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hμ₀
  
  have hQ_open : IsOpen Q_c := by
    have h1 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const))
        continuous_const
    have h3 : IsOpen { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c } :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const))
        continuous_const
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  let e₁ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((1 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
  let e₂ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
  let e₃ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))
  have hγ_S : ∀ S D T : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun S' : ℂ => (S', (D, T))) e₁ S := by
    intro S D T
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun S' : ℂ => S' • e₁ + ((0 : ℂ), (D, T))) ((1 : ℂ) • e₁ + 0) S :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id S).smul_const e₁).add (hasDerivAt_const S ((0 : ℂ), (D, T)))
    have heq : (fun S' : ℂ => S' • e₁ + ((0 : ℂ), (D, T))) = (fun S' : ℂ => (S', (D, T))) := by
      ext S' <;> simp [e₁]
    have hv : (1 : ℂ) • e₁ + 0 = e₁ := by simp
    rwa [heq, hv] at h1
  have hγ_J : ∀ S D T : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => (S, (J', T))) e₂ D := by
    intro S D T
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun J' : ℂ => ((S, ((0 : ℂ), T)) : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + J' • e₂)
        (0 + (1 : ℂ) • e₂) D :=
      (hasDerivAt_const D (S, ((0 : ℂ), T))).add ((hasDerivAt_id D).smul_const e₂)
    have heq : (fun J' : ℂ => ((S, ((0 : ℂ), T)) : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + J' • e₂) =
        (fun J' : ℂ => (S, (J', T))) := by
      ext J' <;> simp [e₂]
    have hv : (0 : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + (1 : ℂ) • e₂ = e₂ := by simp
    rwa [heq, hv] at h1
  have hγ_slant : ∀ S D T a : ℂ,
      HasDerivAt (fun D' : ℂ => (S - a * D', (D', T))) ((-a) • e₁ + e₂) D := by
    intro S D T a
    let v_sl : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := (-a) • e₁ + e₂
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun D' : ℂ => ((S, ((0 : ℂ), T)) : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + D' • v_sl)
        (0 + (1 : ℂ) • v_sl) D :=
      (hasDerivAt_const D (S, ((0 : ℂ), T))).add ((hasDerivAt_id D).smul_const v_sl)
    have heq : (fun D' : ℂ => ((S, ((0 : ℂ), T)) : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + D' • v_sl) =
        (fun D' : ℂ => (S - a * D', (D', T))) := by
      ext D' <;> simp [v_sl, e₁, e₂]
      ring
    have hv : (0 : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) + (1 : ℂ) • v_sl = v_sl := by simp
    rwa [heq, hv] at h1
  have hDom_Qc : ∀ S P_mom T : ℂ,
      CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S P_mom T →
      CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
      (S₀, (J₀, T)) ∈ Q_c ∧
      ∀ D : ℂ, ‖D - J₀‖ < r_c →
        (S, (D, T)) ∈ Q_c ∧ (S - (T / (b : ℂ)) * D, (D, T)) ∈ Q_c := by
    intro S P_mom T hDom hSmall
    rcases hDom with ⟨hS_dom, _hP_dom, hT_dom⟩
    rcases hSmall with ⟨_ha_one, ha_shift, _ha_jet⟩
    have hT_rc : ‖T - T₀‖ < r_c := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_dom hr_T_le
    have hS_quarter : ‖S - S₀‖ < r_c / 4 := lt_of_lt_of_le hS_dom (min_le_left _ _)
    have hS_rc : ‖S - S₀‖ < r_c := by linarith
    refine ⟨⟨by simp [hr_c], by simp [hr_c], hT_rc⟩, fun D hD => ?_⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hS_rc, hD, hT_rc⟩, ⟨?_, hD, hT_rc⟩⟩
    let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
    have hD_norm : ‖D‖ ≤ 1 + ‖J₀‖ + r_c := by
      have h1 : ‖D‖ ≤ ‖J₀‖ + ‖D - J₀‖ := by
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le J₀ (D - J₀)
      linarith
    have haD_le : ‖a * D‖ ≤ r_c / 4 := by
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_norm (norm_nonneg a)) ha_shift
    have h_sub : ‖(S - a * D) - S₀‖ ≤ ‖S - S₀‖ + ‖a * D‖ := by
      have h_eq : (S - a * D) - S₀ = (S - S₀) - a * D := by ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact norm_sub_le (S - S₀) (a * D)
    linarith
  
  have hCore : ∀ S P_mom T : ℂ,
      CseInChartDom S₀ T₀ P₀ μ₀ r_c r_T M_c S P_mom T →
      CseStepSmall J₀ μ₀ r_c M_c b T →
      (∀ m : ℕ, cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T m ∈ Metric.closedBall J₀ (r_c / 2)) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ,
        dist (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T m)
          (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T (m + 1)) ≤ (r_c / 4) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T)) ∧
      ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - J₀‖ ≤ r_c / 2 ∧
      cseChartG F b σ S T (cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T) = P_mom ∧
      (∀ D_test : ℂ, ‖D_test - J₀‖ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * r_c →
        ‖cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T - D_test‖ ≤
          (2 / ‖μ₀‖) * ‖cseChartG F b σ S T D_test - P_mom‖) := by
    intro S P_mom T hDom hSmall
    obtain ⟨hq₀, hQc_D⟩ := hDom_Qc S P_mom T hDom hSmall
    rcases hDom with ⟨hS_dom, hP_dom, hT_dom⟩
    rcases hSmall with ⟨_ha_one, _ha_shift, ha_jet⟩
    let a : ℂ := T / (b : ℂ)
    let G : ℂ → ℂ := cseChartG F b σ S T
    let N : ℂ → ℂ := cseChartNewton F μ₀ b σ S P_mom T
    let u : ℕ → ℂ := cseChartIter F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T
    let D_star : ℂ := cseChartRoot F μ₀ J₀ b σ S P_mom T
    have haMJ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖a‖ * M_c * ‖J₀‖ := by positivity
    have haM_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖a‖ * M_c := by positivity
    have ha_split : ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) = ‖a‖ * M_c + ‖a‖ * M_c * ‖J₀‖ := by ring
    have ha_jet1 : ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) ≤ ‖μ₀‖ / 8 :=
      le_trans ha_jet (min_le_left _ _)
    have ha_jet2 : ‖a‖ * M_c * (1 + ‖J₀‖) ≤ ‖μ₀‖ * r_c / 32 :=
      le_trans ha_jet (min_le_right _ _)
    have haM_le1 : ‖a‖ * M_c ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by linarith
    have haM_le2 : ‖a‖ * M_c ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c := by linarith
    have haMJ_le : M_c * (‖a‖ * ‖J₀‖) ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ * r_c := by linarith
    
    have hcomp_deriv : ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (L : (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)
        (γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (v : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) (z : ℂ),
        HasFDerivAt H L (γ z) → HasDerivAt γ v z →
        HasDerivAt (fun z' => H (γ z')) (L v) z :=
      fun _ _ _ _ z hH hγ => HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt z hH hγ
    have hN_deriv : ∀ D : ℂ, ‖D - J₀‖ < r_c →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ N D ∧ ‖deriv N D‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      intro D hD
      have hG_deriv : ∃ g' : ℂ, HasDerivAt G g' D ∧ ‖g' - μ₀‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀‖ := by
        by_cases hσ : 0 < σ
        · have hq : (S, (D, T)) ∈ Q_c := (hQc_D D hD).1
          have hDJ_at := (hDJ_holo.differentiableAt (hQ_open.mem_nhds hq)).hasFDerivAt
          have hDJ_comp : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun D' : ℂ => rctActDJ F S D' T) D :=
            (hcomp_deriv (fun q => rctActDJ F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) _

        rw [dist_eq_norm, ← hfderiv_eq]
        calc ‖fderiv ℂ d_m w‖
            ≤ ‖deriv (fun ξ : ℂ => d_m (ξ, w.2)) w.1‖ +
              ‖deriv (fun ζ : ℂ => d_m (w.1, ζ)) w.2‖ := h2d
          _ ≤ ((r_c / 4) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) / r₀ +
              ((r_c / 4) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) / r₀ := add_le_add hderiv₁ hderiv₂
          _ = (r_c / (2 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
      
      let g' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
        fun w => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun m => fderiv ℂ (v m) w)
      have hunif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun m w => fderiv ℂ (v m) w) g' Filter.atTop B_w₀ := by
        rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
        intro ε hε
        have h_pow_zero : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun m : ℕ => (r_c / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using
            (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
              (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)).const_mul (r_c / r₀)
        filter_upwards [(Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp h_pow_zero ε hε)] with m hm w hw
        have hcauchy_w : CauchySeq (fun k => fderiv ℂ (v k) w) :=
          cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2) (r_c / (2 * r₀)) (by norm_num) (hfderiv_step w hw)
        have hlim_w : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℂ (v k) w) Filter.atTop (nhds (g' w)) :=
          hcauchy_w.tendsto_limUnder
        have htail := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2) (r_c / (2 * r₀))
          (by norm_num) (hfderiv_step w hw) hlim_w m
        have htail_eq : (r_c / (2 * r₀)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m / (1 - 1 / 2) =
            (r_c / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
        rw [htail_eq] at htail
        have hm' : (r_c / r₀) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m < ε := by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at hm
          exact hm
        rw [dist_comm]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt htail hm'
      
      have hv_fderiv : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ w ∈ B_w₀, HasFDerivAt (v m) (fderiv ℂ (v m) w) w :=
        fun m w hw => ((hv m).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hBw₀_sub hw))).hasFDerivAt
      have hv_pt : ∀ w ∈ B_w₀, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => v m w) Filter.atTop (nhds (D_fn w)) := by
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨hDom_w, hSmall_w⟩ := hDomW w (hBw₀_sub hw)
        exact (hCore (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) hDom_w hSmall_w).2.2.1
      have hD_at : HasFDerivAt D_fn (g' w₀) w₀ :=
        hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn Metric.isOpen_ball hunif hv_fderiv hv_pt
          (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀_pos)
      exact hD_at.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    
    have hD_Qc : ∀ w ∈ W,
        (S_fn w, (D_fn w, T_fn w)) ∈ Q_c ∧
        (S_fn w - a_fn w * D_fn w, (D_fn w, T_fn w)) ∈ Q_c := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨hDom_w, hSmall_w⟩ := hDomW w hw
      have hD_le := (hCore (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) hDom_w hSmall_w).2.2.2.1
      exact (hDom_Qc (S_fn w) (P_fn w) (T_fn w) hDom_w hSmall_w).2 (D_fn w) (by linarith)
    by_cases hσ : 0 < σ
    · have hDS_D := hcomp3 (fun q => rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        S_fn D_fn T_fn hDS_holo hS_holo hD_holo hT_holo (fun w hw => (hD_Qc w hw).1)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (hS_holo.add (ha_holo.mul hD_holo)).congr
          (fun w _ => by simp [cseChartStep, a_fn, D_fn, hσ])
      · exact (hP_holo.add (ha_holo.mul hDS_D)).congr
          (fun w _ => by simp [cseChartStep, a_fn, D_fn, hσ])
    · let S_next_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun w => S_fn w - a_fn w * D_fn w
      have hSn_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_next_fn W := hS_holo.sub (ha_holo.mul hD_holo)
      have hDS_D := hcomp3 (fun q => rctActDS F q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
        S_next_fn D_fn T_fn hDS_holo hSn_holo hD_holo hT_holo (fun w hw => (hD_Qc w hw).2)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hSn_holo.congr
          (fun w _ => by simp [cseChartStep, a_fn, D_fn, S_next_fn, hσ])
      · exact (hP_holo.sub (ha_holo.mul hDS_D)).congr
          (fun w _ => by simp [cseChartStep, a_fn, D_fn, S_next_fn, hσ])

signature.statement:
(X : ExpStripData) (hX : IsExpObstructionStrip X)
    (P : ChordActionPackage X) (kind : ExpProfileKind)
    (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
    (hJetEL : RctFrozenJetAndELProp X P kind seq)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let _ := hX
  have h_comp3 :
      ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (f₁ f₂ f₃ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ × ℂ),
        DifferentiableAt ℂ H (f₁ w₀, (f₂ w₀, f₃ w₀)) →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ f₁ w₀ →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ f₂ w₀ →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ f₃ w₀ →
        DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => H (f₁ w, (f₂ w, f₃ w))) w₀ := by
    intro H f₁ f₂ f₃ w₀ hH hf₁ hf₂ hf₃
    let e₁ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((1 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
    let e₂ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), ((1 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)))
    let e₃ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := ((0 : ℂ), ((0 : ℂ), (1 : ℂ)))
    let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ × ℂ := fun w => f₁ w • e₁ + f₂ w • e₂ + f₃ w • e₃
    have hΦ_eq : ∀ w, Φ w = (f₁ w, (f₂ w, f₃ w)) := by
      intro w
      ext <;> simp [Φ, e₁, e₂, e₃]
    have hΦ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ w₀ :=
      ((hf₁.smul_const e₁).add (hf₂.smul_const e₂)).add (hf₃.smul_const e₃)
    have hH' : DifferentiableAt ℂ H (Φ w₀) := by rwa [hΦ_eq w₀]
    have hcomp : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => H (Φ w)) w₀ := hH'.comp w₀ hΦ_diff
    simpa only [hΦ_eq] using hcomp
  have h_Qc_ball :
      ∀ (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ) (r_c : ℝ),
        { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < r_c } =
          Metric.ball (S₀, (J₀, T₀)) r_c := by
    intro S₀ J₀ T₀ r_c
    ext ⟨s, j, t⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.norm_def,
      max_lt_iff]
  intro V_mod S_star K_corr σ T_max hMod hK_ne hK_comp hK_sub hσ hT_max hK_T
  let b_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n
  have hb_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < b_seq n := fun n => mul_pos (seq.ℓ_pos n) (seq.m_pos n)
  let F_inf : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := rctModelActionP kind seq
  let F_n : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n => rctScaledActionP P seq n
  let J_star_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => deriv (fun Y' => S_star (Y', p.2)) p.1
  let P_anch_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => rctActDJ F_inf (S_star p) (J_star_fn p) p.2
  obtain ⟨hJ_holo, hEL_all⟩ := hJetEL.model_euler_lagrange V_mod S_star hMod
  have h_init_pos :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (S_prev S_curr T : ℂ),
        rctInitSymplecticState P seq n 1 S_prev S_curr T =
          (S_curr,
            rctActDJ (F_n n) S_prev ((S_curr - S_prev) / (T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ))) T) := by
    intro n S_prev S_curr T
    unfold rctInitSymplecticState
    rw [if_pos zero_lt_one]
  have h_init_neg :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (S_prev S_curr T : ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        rctInitSymplecticState P seq n (-1) S_prev S_curr T =
          (S_curr,
            rctActDJ (F_n n) S_curr ((S_prev - S_curr) / a_n) T -
              a_n * rctActDS (F_n n) S_curr ((S_prev - S_curr) / a_n) T) := by
    intro n S_prev S_curr T
    unfold rctInitSymplecticState
    rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬ (0 : ℝ) < -1)]
  have h_mod_pos :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (Z T : ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        cseModelState P seq S_star n 1 Z T =
          (S_star (Z, T),
            rctActDJ (F_n n) (S_star (Z - a_n, T))
              ((S_star (Z, T) - S_star (Z - a_n, T)) / a_n) T) := by
    intro n Z T
    let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    change rctInitSymplecticState P seq n 1
      (S_star (Z - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_star (Z, T)) T = _
    rw [show Z - ((1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a_n = Z - a_n by push_cast; ring]
    exact h_init_pos n (S_star (Z - a_n, T)) (S_star (Z, T)) T
  have h_mod_neg :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (Z T : ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let D_curr : ℂ := (S_star (Z + a_n, T) - S_star (Z, T)) / a_n
        cseModelState P seq S_star n (-1) Z T =
          (S_star (Z, T),
            rctActDJ (F_n n) (S_star (Z, T)) D_curr T -
              a_n * rctActDS (F_n n) (S_star (Z, T)) D_curr T) := by
    intro n Z T
    let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
    change rctInitSymplecticState P seq n (-1)
      (S_star (Z - ((-1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a_n, T)) (S_star (Z, T)) T = _
    rw [show Z - ((-1 : ℝ) : ℂ) * a_n = Z + a_n by push_cast; ring]
    exact h_init_neg n (S_star (Z + a_n, T)) (S_star (Z, T)) T
  have h_G_pos :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (S T D : ℂ),
        cseChartG (F_n n) (b_seq n) 1 S T D =
          rctActDJ (F_n n) S D T - (T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) * rctActDS (F_n n) S D T := by
    intro n S T D
    unfold cseChartG
    rw [if_pos zero_lt_one]
  have h_G_neg :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (S T D : ℂ),
        cseChartG (F_n n) (b_seq n) (-1) S T D =
          rctActDJ (F_n n) (S - (T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)) * D) D T := by
    intro n S T D
    unfold cseChartG
    rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬ (0 : ℝ) < -1)]
  have h_step_pos :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (μ J S P_mom T : ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let D : ℂ := cseChartRoot (F_n n) μ J (b_seq n) 1 S P_mom T
        cseChartStep (F_n n) μ J (b_seq n) 1 S P_mom T =
          (S + a_n * D, P_mom + a_n * rctActDS (F_n n) S D T) := by
    intro n μ J S P_mom T
    unfold cseChartStep
    rw [if_pos zero_lt_one]
  have h_step_neg :
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (μ J S P_mom T : ℂ),
        let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
        let D : ℂ := cseChartRoot (F_n n) μ J (b_seq n) (-1) S P_mom T
        cseChartStep (F_n n) μ J (b_seq n) (-1) S P_mom T =
          (S - a_n * D, P_mom - a_n * rctActDS (F_n n) (S - a_n * D) D T) := by
    intro n μ J S P_mom T
    unfold cseChartStep
    rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬ (0 : ℝ) < -1)]
  
  let S₀ : ↥K_corr → ℂ := fun i => S_star i.1
  let J₀ : ↥K_corr → ℂ := fun i => J_star_fn i.1
  let T₀ : ↥K_corr → ℂ := fun i => i.1.2
  let P₀ : ↥K_corr → ℂ := fun i => P_anch_fn i.1
  let μ₀ : ↥K_corr → ℂ := fun i => rctActDJJ F_inf (S₀ i) (J₀ i) (T₀ i)
  have h_pt :
      ∀ i : ↥K_corr,
        ∃ tup : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℕ,
          let r_c : ℝ := tup.1
          let M_c : ℝ := tup.2.1
          let r_T : ℝ := tup.2.2.1
          let ρ : ℝ := tup.2.2.2.1
          let N_anch : ℕ := tup.2.2.2.2
          let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
            { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
              ‖q.1 - S₀ i‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀ i‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀ i‖ < r_c }
          μ₀ i ≠ 0 ∧
          0 < r_c ∧ 0 < M_c ∧ 0 < r_T ∧ r_T ≤ r_c ∧ 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ r_T ∧
          Metric.closedBall i.1 ρ ⊆ V_mod ∧
          (∀ q ∈ Metric.ball i.1 ρ,
            ‖S_star q - S₀ i‖ <
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min (r_c / 4) (‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c / (32 * M_c)) ∧
            ‖J_star_fn q - J₀ i‖ < (1 / 8 : ℝ) * r_c ∧
            ‖P_anch_fn q - P₀ i‖ < (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c) ∧
          (∀ n ≥ N_anch,
            CseChartActionJet (F_n n) (S₀ i) (J₀ i) (T₀ i) (μ₀ i) r_c M_c ∧
            (∀ T : ℂ, ‖T - T₀ i‖ < r_T →
              ‖rctActDJ (F_n n) (S₀ i) (J₀ i) T - P₀ i‖ ≤
                (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c)) ∧
          (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N_ε : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_ε,
            ∀ S₁ J₁ S₂ J₂ T : ℂ,
              (S₁, (J₁, T)) ∈ Q_c → (S₂, (J₂, T)) ∈ Q_c →
              ‖rctActDS (F_n n) S₁ J₁ T - rctActDS F_inf S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
              ‖rctActDJ (F_n n) S₁ J₁ T - rctActDJ F_inf S₁ J₁ T‖ ≤ ε ∧
              ‖(rctActDJ (F_n n) S₁ J₁ T - rctActDJ F_inf S₁ J₁ T) -
                (rctActDJ (F_n n) S₂ J₂ T - rctActDJ F_inf S₂ J₂ T)‖ ≤
                ε * (‖S₁ - S₂‖ + ‖J₁ - J₂‖)) ∧
          (∀ n ≥ N_anch, ∀ (S_fn : ℂ → ℂ) (Y T : ℂ), T ≠ 0 →
            let a_n : ℂ := T / ((b_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ)
            let D_prev : ℂ := (S_fn Y - S_fn (Y - a_n)) / a_n
            let D_curr : ℂ := (S_fn (Y + a_n) - S_fn Y) / a_n
            (S_fn Y, (D_curr, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            (S_fn (Y - a_n), (D_prev, T)) ∈ Q_c →
            SatisfiesScaledChordRecurrence P seq S_fn n Y T →
            rctActDJ (F_n n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T -
              a_n * rctActDS (F_n n) (S_fn Y) D_curr T =
              rctActDJ (F_n n) (S_fn (Y - a_n)) D_prev T) := by
    intro i
    have hi_mod : i.1 ∈ V_mod := hK_sub i.2
    have h_reg : IsRegularFrozenState kind
        (T₀ i * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀ i)) (J₀ i) :=
      (hMod.2.2 i.1 hi_mod).2
    obtain ⟨hμ₀_ne, r_c, N_c, M_c, hr_c_pos, hM_c_pos, h_jets_rest⟩ :=
      hJetEL.chart_jets (S₀ i) (J₀ i) (T₀ i) h_reg
    dsimp only [] at h_jets_rest
    rcases h_jets_rest with
      ⟨_, _, hDJ_inf_holo, _, h_scaled_n, h_conv_c, h_rec_c⟩
    have hμ₀_pos : 0 < ‖μ₀ i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hμ₀_ne
    let Q_c : Set (ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) :=
      { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
        ‖q.1 - S₀ i‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀ i‖ < r_c ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀ i‖ < r_c }
    have hQ_eq : Q_c = Metric.ball (S₀ i, (J₀ i, T₀ i)) r_c :=
      h_Qc_ball (S₀ i) (J₀ i) (T₀ i) r_c
    have hQ_open : IsOpen Q_c := hQ_eq ▸ Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hq₀_mem : (S₀ i, (J₀ i, T₀ i)) ∈ Q_c := by
      rw [hQ_eq]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr_c_pos
    let Φ_DJ : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => rctActDJ F_inf q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2
    have hΦ_DJ_contAt : ContinuousAt Φ_DJ (S₀ i, (J₀ i, T₀ i)) :=
      hDJ_inf_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hQ_open.mem_nhds hq₀_mem)
    have hT_slice_contAt : ContinuousAt (fun T : ℂ => rctActDJ F_inf (S₀ i) (J₀ i) T) (T₀ i) :=
      ContinuousAt.comp (g := Φ_DJ) (f := fun T : ℂ => (S₀ i, (J₀ i, T))) hΦ_DJ_contAt
        (continuous_const.continuousAt.prodMk
          (continuous_const.continuousAt.prodMk continuous_id.continuousAt))
    have hε_anch_pos : 0 < (1 / 64 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c := by positivity
    obtain ⟨δ_T, hδ_T_pos, hδ_T⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hT_slice_contAt ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c) hε_anch_pos
    let r_T : ℝ := min δ_T r_c
    have hr_T_pos : 0 < r_T := lt_min hδ_T_pos hr_c_pos
    have hr_T_le : r_T ≤ r_c := min_le_right _ _
    obtain ⟨N_anch, hN_anch_ge, hN_anch_conv⟩ :=
      h_conv_c ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c) hε_anch_pos
    obtain ⟨δ_V, hδ_V_pos, hδ_V_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hMod.1 i.1 hi_mod
    have hV_nhds : V_mod ∈ nhds i.1 := hMod.1.mem_nhds hi_mod
    have hS_contAt : ContinuousAt S_star i.1 := hMod.2.1.continuousOn.continuousAt hV_nhds
    have hJ_contAt : ContinuousAt J_star_fn i.1 := hJ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt hV_nhds
    have hP_contAt : ContinuousAt P_anch_fn i.1 :=
      ContinuousAt.comp (g := Φ_DJ)
        (f := fun q : ℂ × ℂ => (S_star q, (J_star_fn q, q.2))) hΦ_DJ_contAt
        (hS_contAt.prodMk (hJ_contAt.prodMk continuous_snd.continuousAt))
    let r_S : ℝ := min (r_c / 4) (‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c / (32 * M_c))
    have hr_S_pos : 0 < r_S := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hS_contAt ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_S) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hJ_contAt ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * r_c) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃_pos, hδ₃⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hP_contAt ((1 / 32 : ℝ) * ‖μ₀ i‖ * r_c) (by positivity)
    let ρ : ℝ := min (min (δ_V / 2) (r_T / 2)) (min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃))
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ :=
      lt_min (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))

        rcases hw_all w hw.1 with ⟨hYT_U, hTw_ne, hTw_le, hw_tube⟩
        have hq_mod_near := h_model_near_anchor n hn (Y_fn w) (T_fn w) hYT_U hTw_ne hTw_le
        dsimp only [] at hw_tube hq_mod_near
        have h_anch_2 :
            ‖S_fn w - S_star (Y_fn w, T_fn w)‖ +
              ‖P_fn w - P_anch_fn (Y_fn w, T_fn w)‖ ≤ 2 * r_tube := by
          have h1 :=
            norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (S_fn w)
              (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_fn w) (T_fn w)).1
              (S_star (Y_fn w, T_fn w))
          have h2 :=
            norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (P_fn w)
              (cseModelState P seq S_star n σ (Y_fn w) (T_fn w)).2
              (P_anch_fn (Y_fn w, T_fn w))
          linarith [hr_tube_pos]
        obtain ⟨hdom, hsm, hΨ_eq⟩ :=
          h_in_chart n hn i hi (Y_fn w) (T_fn w) (S_fn w) (P_fn w) hw.2 h_anch_2
        exact ⟨⟨hdom, hsm⟩, hΨ_eq⟩
      obtain ⟨h_holo1_chart, h_holo2_chart⟩ :=
        (hSolver (F_n n) (S₀ i) (J₀ i) (T₀ i) (P₀ i) (μ₀ i)
          (r_c i) (r_T i) (M_c i) (b_seq n) σ
          hjet_i (hr_T_pos i) (hr_T_le i) (hb_pos n) hanch_i).2.2
          W₀ S_fn P_fn T_fn hW₀_open
          (hS_holo.mono hW₀_sub) (hP_holo.mono hW₀_sub) (hT_holo.mono hW₀_sub)
          (fun w hw => (h_on_W₀ w hw).1)
      have h_holo1_W₀ :
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).1) W₀ :=
        h_holo1_chart.congr (fun w hw => congrArg Prod.fst (h_on_W₀ w hw).2)
      have h_holo2_W₀ :
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (Ψ n (Y_fn w, T_fn w) (S_fn w, P_fn w)).2) W₀ :=
        h_holo2_chart.congr (fun w hw => congrArg Prod.snd (h_on_W₀ w hw).2)
      have hW₀_nhds : W₀ ∈ nhds w₀ := hW₀_open.mem_nhds hw₀_mem
      exact ⟨h_holo1_W₀.differentiableAt hW₀_nhds, h_holo2_W₀.differentiableAt hW₀_nhds⟩
    exact ⟨fun w₀ hw₀ => (h_at w₀ hw₀).1.differentiableWithinAt,
           fun w₀ hw₀ => (h_at w₀ hw₀).2.differentiableWithinAt⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(m : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hm_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D)
    (hm_one : m 1 = 1)
    (hm_le : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → m D ≤ D⁻¹)
    (hm_conv : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun D => Real.log (m D))) :
    ∃ p ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ,
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      Monotone (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < p x) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u) ∧
      (∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
        IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧
        (∫ y in a..b, p y) = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp b))) - (-Real.log (m (Real.exp a)))) ∧
      Continuous ρ_c ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ_c x ∧ ρ_c x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c u) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, x ≤ y →
        ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ≤ (-Real.log (m (Real.exp y))) - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * y) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∃ w : ℝ, x ≤ w ∧
        ρ_c w = -Real.log (m (Real.exp w)) ∧
        ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v →
        (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo u v, ρ_c w < -Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) →
        ρ_c v - ρ_c u = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hm_one
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => Real.log (m D)
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))
  let ψ_minus : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => derivWithin ψ (Set.Iio D) D
  let ψ_plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun D => derivWithin ψ (Set.Ioi D) D
  let p : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp x * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp x))
  let p_plus : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp x * (-ψ_plus (Real.exp x))
  have h_mem_int : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → D ∈ interior (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro D hD
    rw [isOpen_Ioi.interior_eq]
    exact hD
  have hψ_cont : ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Ioi 0) := hm_conv.continuousOn isOpen_Ioi
  have hρ_cont : Continuous ρ :=
    (hψ_cont.comp_continuous Real.continuous_exp (fun x => Real.exp_pos x)).neg
  have hψ_le_neg_log : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → ψ D ≤ -Real.log D := by
    intro D hD
    have hlog := Real.log_le_log (hm_pos D hD) (hm_le D hD)
    rwa [Real.log_inv] at hlog
  have hρ_ge : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ x := by
    intro x
    have h := hψ_le_neg_log (Real.exp x) (Real.exp_pos x)
    rw [Real.log_exp] at h
    dsimp only [ρ, ψ] at h ⊢
    linarith
  have hψ_minus_mono : MonotoneOn ψ_minus (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have h := hm_conv.monotoneOn_leftDeriv
    rwa [isOpen_Ioi.interior_eq] at h
  have hψ_plus_mono : MonotoneOn ψ_plus (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    have h := hm_conv.monotoneOn_rightDeriv
    rwa [isOpen_Ioi.interior_eq] at h
  have hψ_minus_le_plus : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → ψ_minus D ≤ ψ_plus D := by
    intro D hD
    exact hm_conv.leftDeriv_le_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior (h_mem_int D hD)
  have hψ_plus_neg : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → ψ_plus D < 0 := by
    intro D hD
    let D₂ : ℝ := max (D + 1) (Real.exp (-ψ D + 1))
    have hD_lt_D₂ : D < D₂ := by
      have : D + 1 ≤ D₂ := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    have hD₂_pos : 0 < D₂ := lt_trans hD hD_lt_D₂
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-ψ D + 1) ≤ D₂ := le_max_right _ _
    have hlog_D₂ : -ψ D + 1 ≤ Real.log D₂ := by
      have h := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (-ψ D + 1)) hexp_le
      rwa [Real.log_exp] at h
    have hψ_D₂ : ψ D₂ ≤ -Real.log D₂ := hψ_le_neg_log D₂ hD₂_pos
    have h_diff_neg : ψ D₂ - ψ D < 0 := by linarith
    have h_sub_pos : 0 < D₂ - D := sub_pos.mpr hD_lt_D₂
    have h_slope_le : ψ_plus D ≤ slope ψ D D₂ :=
      hm_conv.rightDeriv_le_slope_of_mem_interior (h_mem_int D hD) hD₂_pos hD_lt_D₂
    rw [slope_def_field] at h_slope_le
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_slope_le (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h_diff_neg h_sub_pos)
  have hp_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < p x := by
    intro x
    have hD : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
    have h1 : ψ_minus (Real.exp x) ≤ ψ_plus (Real.exp x) := hψ_minus_le_plus _ hD
    have h2 : ψ_plus (Real.exp x) < 0 := hψ_plus_neg _ hD
    exact mul_pos hD (by linarith)
  have hp_exp : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u := by
    intro u v huv
    have heu : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp u := Real.exp_pos u
    have hev : (0 : ℝ) < Real.exp v := Real.exp_pos v
    have hm : ψ_minus (Real.exp u) ≤ ψ_minus (Real.exp v) :=
      hψ_minus_mono heu hev (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr huv)
    have hmul : Real.exp v * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp v)) ≤ Real.exp v * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp u)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_neg hm) (le_of_lt hev)
    have hexp_eq : Real.exp v = Real.exp (v - u) * Real.exp u := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_add_cancel]
    dsimp only [p]
    calc Real.exp v * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp v))
        ≤ Real.exp v * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp u)) := hmul
      _ = (Real.exp (v - u) * Real.exp u) * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp u)) := by rw [hexp_eq]
      _ = Real.exp (v - u) * (Real.exp u * (-ψ_minus (Real.exp u))) := by ring
  have h_deriv_right : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivWithinAt ρ (p_plus x) (Set.Ioi x) x := by
    intro x
    have h_outer : HasDerivWithinAt ψ (ψ_plus (Real.exp x)) (Set.Ioi (Real.exp x)) (Real.exp x) :=
      hm_conv.hasDerivWithinAt_rightDeriv_of_mem_interior (h_mem_int (Real.exp x) (Real.exp_pos x))
    have h_inner : HasDerivWithinAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) (Set.Ioi x) x :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_exp x).hasDerivWithinAt
    have h_maps : Set.MapsTo Real.exp (Set.Ioi x) (Set.Ioi (Real.exp x)) :=
      fun y hy => Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hy
    have h_comp : HasDerivWithinAt (-(ψ ∘ Real.exp)) (-(ψ_plus (Real.exp x) * Real.exp x)) (Set.Ioi x) x :=
      (HasDerivWithinAt.comp x h_outer h_inner h_maps).neg
    exact h_comp.congr_deriv (by dsimp only [p_plus]; ring)
  have hg_anti : Antitone (fun x : ℝ => -ψ_plus (Real.exp x)) := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact neg_le_neg (hψ_plus_mono (Real.exp_pos x) (Real.exp_pos y) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hxy))
  have hp_plus_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable p_plus MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b
    exact (hg_anti.intervalIntegrable).continuousOn_mul Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn
  let f_mono : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ψ_minus (Real.exp x)
  have hf_mono : Monotone f_mono := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact hψ_minus_mono (Real.exp_pos x) (Real.exp_pos y) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hxy)
  have h_eq_of_cont : ∀ x : ℝ, ContinuousAt f_mono x → p_plus x = p x := by
    intro x hcont
    have h_le1 : f_mono x ≤ ψ_plus (Real.exp x) := hψ_minus_le_plus (Real.exp x) (Real.exp_pos x)
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
    have hx_gt : ∀ n : ℕ, x < x_seq n := by
      intro n
      dsimp only [x_seq]
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      linarith
    have h_le_seq : ∀ n : ℕ, ψ_plus (Real.exp x) ≤ f_mono (x_seq n) := by
      intro n
      have hex : 0 < Real.exp x := Real.exp_pos x
      have hexn : 0 < Real.exp (x_seq n) := Real.exp_pos (x_seq n)
      have hlt : Real.exp x < Real.exp (x_seq n) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (hx_gt n)
      have hs1 : ψ_plus (Real.exp x) ≤ slope ψ (Real.exp x) (Real.exp (x_seq n)) :=
        hm_conv.rightDeriv_le_slope_of_mem_interior (h_mem_int _ hex) hexn hlt
      have hs2 : slope ψ (Real.exp x) (Real.exp (x_seq n)) ≤ ψ_minus (Real.exp (x_seq n)) :=
        hm_conv.slope_le_leftDeriv_of_mem_interior hex (h_mem_int _ hexn) hlt
      exact le_trans hs1 hs2
    have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds x) := by
      simpa only [add_zero] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds (x := x)).add (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))
    have hf_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f_mono (x_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (f_mono x)) :=
      hcont.tendsto.comp hx_tendsto
    have h_neg_le : -f_mono x ≤ -ψ_plus (Real.exp x) :=
      le_of_tendsto' hf_tendsto.neg (fun n => neg_le_neg (h_le_seq n))
    have h_eq_deriv : ψ_plus (Real.exp x) = ψ_minus (Real.exp x) := by
      dsimp only [f_mono] at h_le1 h_neg_le
      linarith
    dsimp only [p_plus, p]
    rw [h_eq_deriv]
  have hp_ae : ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume, p_plus x = p x := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
    have h_sub : {x : ℝ | ¬p_plus x = p x} ⊆ {x : ℝ | ¬ContinuousAt f_mono x} := by
      intro x hx hcont
      exact hx (h_eq_of_cont x hcont)
    exact (hf_mono.countable_not_continuousAt.mono h_sub).measure_zero MeasureTheory.volume
  have hp_ftc : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
      IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧
      (∫ y in a..b, p y) = ρ b - ρ a := by
    intro a b hab
    have hp_int_ab : IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b :=
      (hp_plus_int a b).congr_ae (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae hp_ae)
    have h_ftc_plus : (∫ y in a..b, p_plus y) = ρ b - ρ a :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le hab hρ_cont.continuousOn
        (fun x _ => h_deriv_right x) (hp_plus_int a b)
    have h_congr : (∫ y in a..b, p y) = ∫ y in a..b, p_plus y :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae (hp_ae.mono fun y hy _ => hy.symm)
    exact ⟨hp_int_ab, h_congr.trans h_ftc_plus⟩
  have hρ_mono : Monotone ρ := by
    intro a b hab
    have h_eq := (hp_ftc a b hab).2
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ y in a..b, p y :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun y _ => le_of_lt (hp_pos y))
    linarith
  let f_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => ρ v - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * v
  let I : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => sInf (f_c '' Set.Ici x)
  let ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x + I x
  have hf_cont : Continuous f_c := hρ_cont.sub (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
  have hf_ge : ∀ v : ℝ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) * v ≤ f_c v := by
    intro v
    have h := hρ_ge v
    dsimp only [f_c]
    linarith
  have h_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, (f_c '' Set.Ici x).Nonempty :=
    fun x => ⟨f_c x, x, le_refl x, rfl⟩
  have h_bdd : ∀ x : ℝ, BddBelow (f_c '' Set.Ici x) := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨(1 / 4 : ℝ) * x, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hv' : x ≤ v := hv
    have hfv := hf_ge v
    linarith
  have hI_lo : ∀ x : ℝ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) * x ≤ I x := by
    intro x
    refine le_csInf (h_ne x) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hv' : x ≤ v := hv
    have hfv := hf_ge v
    linarith
  have hI_hi : ∀ x : ℝ, I x ≤ f_c x :=
    fun x => csInf_le (h_bdd x) ⟨x, le_refl x, rfl⟩
  have hρc_bounds : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ_c x ∧ ρ_c x ≤ ρ x := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hI_lo x
    have h2 := hI_hi x
    dsimp only [ρ_c, f_c] at h1 h2 ⊢
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hI_mono : Monotone I := by
    intro u v huv
    exact csInf_le_csInf (h_bdd u) (h_ne v) (Set.image_mono (Set.Ici_subset_Ici.mpr huv))
  have hρc_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c u := by
    intro u v huv
    have h := hI_mono huv
    dsimp only [ρ_c]
    linarith
  have hρc_lb : ∀ x y : ℝ, x ≤ y → ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x ≤ ρ y - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * y := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h : I x ≤ f_c y := csInf_le (h_bdd x) ⟨y, hxy, rfl⟩
    dsimp only [ρ_c, f_c] at h ⊢
    linarith
  have hI_att : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ w : ℝ, x ≤ w ∧ I w = f_c w ∧ I x = f_c w := by
    intro x
    let R_x : ℝ := max (x + 1) (4 * f_c x + 1)
    have hxR : x ≤ R_x := by
      have : x + 1 ≤ R_x := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    obtain ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_min⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMinOn (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hxR) hf_cont.continuousOn
    rw [isMinOn_iff] at hw_min
    have hxw : x ≤ w := hw_mem.1
    have hfw_le_fx : f_c w ≤ f_c x := hw_min x ⟨le_refl x, hxR⟩
    have hfw_global : ∀ v : ℝ, x ≤ v → f_c w ≤ f_c v := by
      intro v hxv
      by_cases hvR : v ≤ R_x
      · exact hw_min v ⟨hxv, hvR⟩
      · have hvR' : R_x < v := lt_of_not_ge hvR
        have h4 : 4 * f_c x + 1 ≤ R_x := le_max_right _ _
        have hfv := hf_ge v
        linarith
    have hIx : I x = f_c w := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact csInf_le (h_bdd x) ⟨w, hxw, rfl⟩
      · refine le_csInf (h_ne x) ?_
        rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
        exact hfw_global v hv
    have hIw : I w = f_c w := by
      apply le_antisymm (hI_hi w)
      refine le_csInf (h_ne w) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact hfw_global v (le_trans hxw hv)
    exact ⟨w, hxw, hIw, hIx⟩
  have hρc_att : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ w : ℝ, x ≤ w ∧ ρ_c w = ρ w ∧
      ρ_c x - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * x = ρ w - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨w, hxw, hIw, hIx⟩ := hI_att x
    refine ⟨w, hxw, ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [ρ_c, f_c] at hIw ⊢; linarith
    · dsimp only [ρ_c, f_c] at hIx ⊢; linarith
  have hI_osc : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ∃ z ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ I b - I a ∧ I b - I a ≤ f_c b - f_c z := by
    intro a b hab
    have h0 : 0 ≤ I b - I a := sub_nonneg.mpr (hI_mono hab)
    obtain ⟨w, haw, hIw, hIa⟩ := hI_att a
    by_cases hbw : b ≤ w
    · refine ⟨b, ⟨hab, le_refl b⟩, h0, ?_⟩
      have h1 : I a ≤ I b := hI_mono hab
      have h2 : I b ≤ I w := hI_mono hbw
      linarith
    · have hbw' : w < b := lt_of_not_ge hbw
      refine ⟨w, ⟨haw, le_of_lt hbw'⟩, h0, ?_⟩
      have hIb : I b ≤ f_c b := hI_hi b
      linarith
  have hI_cont : Continuous I := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro x₀
    rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hf_cont.continuousAt (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hx ⊢
    rcases le_total x x₀ with hxx₀ | hx₀x
    · obtain ⟨z, ⟨hxz, hzx₀⟩, h_nonneg, h_upper⟩ := hI_osc x x₀ hxx₀
      have h_abs_eq : |I x - I x₀| = I x₀ - I x := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
      have hz_dist : dist z x₀ < δ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]
        rw [abs_lt] at hx ⊢
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hf_z : |f_c z - f_c x₀| < ε / 2 := by
        simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hδ hz_dist
      rw [abs_lt] at hf_z
      linarith
    · obtain ⟨z, ⟨hx₀z, hzx⟩, h_nonneg, h_upper⟩ := hI_osc x₀ x hx₀x
      have h_abs_eq : |I x - I x₀| = I x - I x₀ := abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg
      have hz_dist : dist z x₀ < δ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]
        rw [abs_lt] at hx ⊢
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hx_dist : dist x x₀ < δ := by rwa [Real.dist_eq]
      have hf_z : |f_c z - f_c x₀| < ε / 2 := by
        simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hδ hz_dist
      have hf_x : |f_c x - f_c x₀| < ε / 2 := by
        simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hδ hx_dist
      rw [abs_lt] at hf_z hf_x
      linarith
  have hρc_cont : Continuous ρ_c := (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).add hI_cont
  have hρc_flat : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo u v, ρ_c w < ρ w) →
      ρ_c v - ρ_c u = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) := by
    intro u v huv h_nontouch
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le huv with rfl | hlt
    · ring
    · have hI_const : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo u v, I x = I v := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨w, hxw, hcw, hcx⟩ := hρc_att x
        have hvw : v ≤ w := by
          by_contra hw_lt
          have hw_lt' : w < v := lt_of_not_ge hw_lt
          have hw_mem : w ∈ Set.Ioo u v := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hx.1 hxw, hw_lt'⟩
          exact (ne_of_lt (h_nontouch w hw_mem)) hcw
        have hIv_le : I v ≤ f_c w := csInf_le (h_bdd v) ⟨w, hvw, rfl⟩
        have hIx_eq : I x = f_c w := by
          dsimp only [ρ_c, f_c] at hcx ⊢
          linarith
        have hIx_le : I x ≤ I v := hI_mono (le_of_lt hx.2)
        linarith
      let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => u + (v - u) * (1 / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))
      have hx_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, x_seq n ∈ Set.Ioo u v := by
        intro n
        dsimp only [x_seq]
        have hvu : 0 < v - u := sub_pos.mpr hlt
        have hden : (1 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
          push_cast
          linarith
        have hden_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := lt_trans zero_lt_one hden
        have hfrac_pos : 0 < 1 / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := one_div_pos.mpr hden_pos
        have hfrac_lt_one : 1 / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) < 1 := by
          rw [div_lt_one hden_pos]
          exact hden
        constructor
        · have : 0 < (v - u) * (1 / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) := mul_pos hvu hfrac_pos
          linarith
        · nlinarith
      have h_tendsto_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) :=
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
      have hx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds u) := by
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (u + (v - u) * 0)) :=
          (tendsto_const_nhds (x := u)).add ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := v - u)).mul h_tendsto_zero)
        simpa using h1
      have hI_seq_u : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => I (x_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (I u)) :=
        hI_cont.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx_tendsto
      have hI_seq_eq : (fun n => I (x_seq n)) = fun _ => I v := by
        ext n
        exact hI_const (x_seq n) (hx_mem n)
      rw [hI_seq_eq] at hI_seq_u
      have hI_eq : I v = I u := tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hI_seq_u
      dsimp only [ρ_c]
      linarith
  exact ⟨p, ρ_c, hρ_cont, hρ_mono, hρ_ge, hp_pos, hp_exp, hp_ftc,
    hρc_cont, hρc_bounds, hρc_lo, hρc_lb, hρc_att, hρc_flat⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h_vitali : ∀ (H r : ℝ → ℝ) (σ : ℝ),
      Monotone H → 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 6 → H 1 - H 0 ≤ σ →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 3 : ℝ) (2 / 3), 0 < r t ∧ r t ≤ σ) →
      ∃ t_star ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 3 : ℝ) (2 / 3),
        H (t_star + r t_star) - H (t_star - r t_star) ≤ 18 * σ * r t_star := by
    intro H r σ hH hσ_pos hσ_le hH_diff hr
    by_contra h_bad
    have h_gt : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 3 : ℝ) (2 / 3),
        18 * σ * r t < H (t + r t) - H (t - r t) := by
      intro t ht
      by_contra hle
      exact h_bad ⟨t, ht, not_lt.mp hle⟩
    let J : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (1 / 3 : ℝ) (2 / 3)
    have h_cov_J : J ⊆ ⋃ t ∈ J, Set.Ioo (t - r t) (t + r t) := by
      intro t ht
      refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
      have hrt : 0 < r t := (hr t ht).1
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨b', hb'_sub, hb'_fin, hb'_cov⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.elim_finite_subcover_image (fun t _ => isOpen_Ioo) h_cov_J
    let S₀ : Finset ℝ := hb'_fin.toFinset
    have hS₀_sub : ∀ t ∈ S₀, t ∈ J := by
      intro t ht
      exact hb'_sub (hb'_fin.mem_toFinset.mp ht)
    have hS₀_cov : J ⊆ ⋃ t ∈ S₀, Set.Ioo (t - r t) (t + r t) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hb'_cov hx) with ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨t, hb'_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr ht, hxt⟩
    have h_greedy : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ S : Finset ℝ, S.card = n → (∀ t ∈ S, 0 < r t) →
        ∃ G : Finset ℝ, G ⊆ S ∧
          (∀ a ∈ G, ∀ b ∈ G, a ≠ b → r a + r b ≤ |a - b|) ∧
          (⋃ t ∈ S, Set.Ioo (t - r t) (t + r t)) ⊆
            ⋃ a ∈ G, Set.Ioo (a - 3 * r a) (a + 3 * r a) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro S hcard hS_pos
        rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hS_ne
        · refine ⟨∅, Finset.Subset.refl _, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro a ha; simp at ha
          · intro x hx
            rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx with ⟨t, ht, _⟩
            simp at ht
        · obtain ⟨a, ha_mem, ha_max⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S r hS_ne
          have hra_pos : 0 < r a := hS_pos a ha_mem
          let S' : Finset ℝ := S.filter (fun t => r a + r t ≤ |t - a|)
          have hS'_sub : S' ⊆ S := Finset.filter_subset _ S
          have ha_not_mem : a ∉ S' := by
            intro ha'
            have h1 : r a + r a ≤ |a - a| := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha').2
            rw [sub_self, abs_zero] at h1
            linarith
          have hS'_ssub : S' ⊂ S :=
            (Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset hS'_sub).mpr ⟨a, ha_mem, ha_not_mem⟩
          have hS'_card : S'.card < n := hcard ▸ Finset.card_lt_card hS'_ssub
          obtain ⟨G', hG'_sub, hG'_sep, hG'_cov⟩ :=
            ih S'.card hS'_card S' rfl (fun t ht => hS_pos t (hS'_sub ht))
          refine ⟨insert a G', Finset.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨ha_mem, hG'_sub.trans hS'_sub⟩,
            ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro x hx y hy hxy
            rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx'
            · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
              · exact False.elim (hxy rfl)
              · have hyS' : r x + r y ≤ |y - x| := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hG'_sub hy')).2
                rwa [abs_sub_comm] at hyS'
            · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy with rfl | hy'
              · have hxS' : r y + r x ≤ |x - y| := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (hG'_sub hx')).2
                linarith
              · exact hG'_sep x hx' y hy' hxy
          · intro x hx
            rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hx with ⟨t, htS, hxt⟩
            by_cases ht_sep : r a + r t ≤ |t - a|
            · have htS' : t ∈ S' := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨htS, ht_sep⟩
              have hxG' := hG'_cov (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨t, htS', hxt⟩)
              rcases Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxG' with ⟨b, hbG', hxb⟩
              exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨b, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hbG', hxb⟩
            · refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a, Finset.mem_insert_self a G', ?_⟩
              have h_abs := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_not_ge ht_sep)
              have h_le : r t ≤ r a := ha_max t htS
              exact ⟨by linarith [hxt.1, h_abs.1], by linarith [hxt.2, h_abs.2]⟩
    obtain ⟨G, hG_sub, hG_sep, hG_cov⟩ :=
      h_greedy S₀.card S₀ rfl (fun t ht => (hr t (hS₀_sub t ht)).1)
    have hG_J : ∀ a ∈ G, a ∈ J := fun a ha => hS₀_sub a (hG_sub ha)
    have hJ_cov : J ⊆ ⋃ a ∈ G, Set.Ioo (a - 3 * r a) (a + 3 * r a) := hS₀_cov.trans hG_cov
    have h_meas_enn : ENNReal.ofReal ((2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1 / 3) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (∑ a ∈ G, 6 * r a) := by
      calc ENNReal.ofReal ((2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1 / 3)
          = MeasureTheory.volume J := Real.volume_Icc.symm
        _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ a ∈ G, Set.Ioo (a - 3 * r a) (a + 3 * r a)) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_mono hJ_cov
        _ ≤ ∑ a ∈ G, MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioo (a - 3 * r a) (a + 3 * r a)) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le G (fun a => Set.Ioo (a - 3 * r a) (a + 3 * r a))
        _ = ∑ a ∈ G, ENNReal.ofReal (6 * r a) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
            rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
            ring_nf
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ a ∈ G, 6 * r a) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg]
            intro a ha
            have hra : 0 < r a := (hr a (hG_J a ha)).1
            linarith
    have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ G, 6 * r a := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a ha => ?_)
      have hra : 0 < r a := (hr a (hG_J a ha)).1
      linarith
    have h_sum_ge_raw : (2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1 / 3 ≤ ∑ a ∈ G, 6 * r a :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff h_sum_nonneg).mp h_meas_enn
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h_sum_ge_raw
    have h_sum_r_ge : (1 / 18 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ a ∈ G, r a := by linarith
    have hG_ne : G.Nonempty := by
      rcases G.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
      · simp at h_sum_r_ge; norm_num at h_sum_r_ge
      · exact hne
    have h_tele : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ K : Finset ℝ, K.card = n → ∀ L U : ℝ, L ≤ U →
        (∀ a ∈ K, L ≤ a - r a ∧ a + r a ≤ U) →
        (∀ a ∈ K, ∀ b ∈ K, a ≠ b → r a + r b ≤ |a - b|) →
        ∑ a ∈ K, (H (a + r a) - H (a - r a)) ≤ H U - H L := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro K hcard L U hLU hK_lu hK_sep
        rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hK_ne
        · simp [sub_nonneg.mpr (hH hLU)]
        · let m_star : ℝ := K.max' hK_ne
          have hm_mem : m_star ∈ K := Finset.max'_mem K hK_ne
          let K' : Finset ℝ := K.erase m_star
          have hK'_card : K'.card < n := hcard ▸ Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hm_mem
          let U' : ℝ := m_star - r m_star
          have hLU' : L ≤ U' := (hK_lu m_star hm_mem).1
          have hK'_lu : ∀ a ∈ K', L ≤ a - r a ∧ a + r a ≤ U' := by
            intro a ha
            have ha_mem : a ∈ K := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha
            have ha_ne : a ≠ m_star := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ha
            have ha_le : a ≤ m_star := Finset.le_max' K a ha_mem
            have hsep : r a + r m_star ≤ |a - m_star| := hK_sep a ha_mem m_star hm_mem ha_ne
            rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)] at hsep
            exact ⟨(hK_lu a ha_mem).1, by change a + r a ≤ m_star - r m_star; linarith⟩
          have hK'_sep : ∀ a ∈ K', ∀ b ∈ K', a ≠ b → r a + r b ≤ |a - b| :=
            fun a ha b hb hab =>
              hK_sep a (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha) b (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hb) hab
          have h_ih := ih K'.card hK'_card K' rfl L U' hLU' hK'_lu hK'_sep
          have h_top : H (m_star + r m_star) ≤ H U := hH (hK_lu m_star hm_mem).2
          have h_split := Finset.sum_erase_add K (fun a => H (a + r a) - H (a - r a)) hm_mem
          linarith
    have hG_lu : ∀ a ∈ G, 0 ≤ a - r a ∧ a + r a ≤ 1 := by
      intro a ha
      have haJ := hG_J a ha
      have hra := (hr a haJ).2
      exact ⟨by linarith [haJ.1], by linarith [haJ.2]⟩
    have h_sum_le : ∑ a ∈ G, (H (a + r a) - H (a - r a)) ≤ σ := by
      have h1 := h_tele G.card G rfl 0 1 (by norm_num) hG_lu hG_sep
      linarith
    have h_sum_lt : ∑ a ∈ G, (18 * σ * r a) < ∑ a ∈ G, (H (a + r a) - H (a - r a)) :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hG_ne (fun a ha => h_gt a (hG_J a ha))
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h_sum_lt
    nlinarith

  
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))
  have h_scale : ∀ (z B : ℝ),
      200 ≤ B → ρ_c z = ρ z → Real.exp 2 * B ^ 2 ≤ p z →
      ∃ x : ℝ,
        z - 2 / 3 ≤ x ∧
        B ^ 2 ≤ p x ∧
        ρ_c (x + (Real.sqrt (p x))⁻¹) = ρ (x + (Real.sqrt (p x))⁻¹) ∧
        (∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ (Real.sqrt (p x))⁻¹ →
          |p (x + h) - p x| ≤ (78 / B) * p x ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * p x ≤ p (x + h)) := by
    intro z B hB hz_contact hz_slope
    have hexp1_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by
      have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)
      linarith
    have hexp2_eq : Real.exp 2 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      norm_num
    have hp_ge_34 : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (z - 1) z, (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ p y := by
      intro y hy
      have hpz_le : p z ≤ Real.exp 1 * p y := by
        have h1 : p z ≤ Real.exp (z - y) * p y := hp_exp y z hy.2
        have h2 : Real.exp (z - y) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hy.1])
        exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (le_of_lt (hp_pos y)))
      have hexp1_pos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
      have hB2 : 1 ≤ B ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hpz_ge : 2 * Real.exp 1 ≤ p z := by nlinarith [hz_slope, hexp2_eq, hB2]
      nlinarith [hpz_ge, hpz_le, hexp1_pos]
    have hρ_inc : ∀ a b : ℝ, z - 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ z →
        ρ a - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * a ≤ ρ b - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * b := by
      intro a b haz hab hbz
      have hint := hp_int a b hab
      have hmono : (∫ y in a..b, (3 / 4 : ℝ)) ≤ ∫ y in a..b, p y :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab intervalIntegrable_const hint.1
          (fun y hy => hp_ge_34 y ⟨le_trans haz hy.1, le_trans hy.2 hbz⟩)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, hint.2] at hmono
      change (b - a) * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ρ b - ρ a at hmono
      linarith
    have h_all_contact : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (z - 1) z, ρ_c u = ρ u := by
      intro u hu
      apply le_antisymm (hρc_bounds u).2
      obtain ⟨w, huw, _, hw_eq⟩ := hρc_att u
      change ρ_c u - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * u = ρ w - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w at hw_eq
      by_cases hwz : w ≤ z
      · have h1 := hρ_inc u w hu.1 huw hwz
        linarith
      · have hzw : z ≤ w := le_of_not_ge hwz
        have h1 := hρ_inc u z hu.1 hu.2 (le_refl z)
        have h2 : ρ_c z - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * z ≤ ρ w - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w := hρc_lb z w hzw
        linarith [hz_contact]
    let H : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.exp (t / 2) / Real.sqrt (p (z - 1 + t))
    let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (Real.sqrt (p (z - 1 + t)))⁻¹
    let σ : ℝ := Real.exp (1 / 2) / Real.sqrt (p z)
    have hH_mono : Monotone H := by
      intro t₁ t₂ ht
