        have hid : (1 - t) * (1 + t + 2 * t ^ 2) = 1 + t ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * t) := by ring
        rw [hid]
        nlinarith
      have hexp : 1 + t + 2 * t ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (t + 2 * t ^ 2) := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (t + 2 * t ^ 2)
        linarith
      have hmul : 1 ≤ (1 - t) * Real.exp (t + 2 * t ^ 2) :=
        le_trans hpoly (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (le_of_lt h1mt_pos))
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (-t - 2 * t ^ 2) ≤ 1 - t := by
        calc Real.exp (-t - 2 * t ^ 2)
            ≤ ((1 - t) * Real.exp (t + 2 * t ^ 2)) * Real.exp (-t - 2 * t ^ 2) := by
              nlinarith [Real.exp_pos (-t - 2 * t ^ 2)]
          _ = (1 - t) * (Real.exp (t + 2 * t ^ 2) * Real.exp (-t - 2 * t ^ 2)) := by ring
          _ = 1 - t := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add]
              have hz0 : t + 2 * t ^ 2 + (-t - 2 * t ^ 2) = 0 := by ring
              rw [hz0, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
      have hlog : -t - 2 * t ^ 2 ≤ Real.log (1 - t) := by
        calc -t - 2 * t ^ 2 = Real.log (Real.exp (-t - 2 * t ^ 2)) :=
              (Real.log_exp _).symm
          _ ≤ Real.log (1 - t) := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hexp_le
      linarith
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨h_lo, le_trans h_hi (by positivity)⟩

  have h_exp_lip : ∀ a b C : ℝ, a ≤ C → b ≤ C →
      |Real.exp a - Real.exp b| ≤ Real.exp C * |a - b| := by
    intro a b C ha hb
    rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
    · rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hab)),
        abs_sub_comm a b, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
      have h1 : (a - b + 1) * Real.exp b ≤ Real.exp a := by
        calc (a - b + 1) * Real.exp b
            ≤ Real.exp (a - b) * Real.exp b :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp (a - b)) (Real.exp_nonneg b)
          _ = Real.exp a := by rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_add_cancel]
      have h2 : Real.exp b - Real.exp a ≤ Real.exp b * (b - a) := by linarith
      exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hb) (by linarith))
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hba)),
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba)]
      have h1 : (b - a + 1) * Real.exp a ≤ Real.exp b := by
        calc (b - a + 1) * Real.exp a
            ≤ Real.exp (b - a) * Real.exp a :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp (b - a)) (Real.exp_nonneg a)
          _ = Real.exp b := by rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_add_cancel]
      have h2 : Real.exp a - Real.exp b ≤ Real.exp a * (a - b) := by linarith
      exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ha) (by linarith))

  refine ⟨⟨x_seq, P_seq, Real.exp 2, Real.exp_pos 2,
    fun j => ⟨hx_nonneg j, by linarith [hP_ge_40000 j]⟩,
    hx_top, hP_top, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact]
    intro K hK
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨B_hi, hB_hi⟩ := hK.bddAbove
    obtain ⟨B_lo, hB_lo⟩ := hK.bddBelow
    let M : ℝ := max 1 (max |B_hi| |B_lo|)
    have hM_ge : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have hK_bound : ∀ u ∈ K, |u| ≤ M := by
      intro u hu
      have h1 : u ≤ B_hi := hB_hi hu
      have h2 : B_lo ≤ u := hB_lo hu
      have h3 : |B_hi| ≤ max |B_hi| |B_lo| := le_max_left _ _
      have h4 : |B_lo| ≤ max |B_hi| |B_lo| := le_max_right _ _
      have h5 : max |B_hi| |B_lo| ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le B_lo], by linarith [le_abs_self B_hi]⟩
    let η_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => 2 * M * ε_seq j + 2 * M ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹
    have hη_zero : Filter.Tendsto η_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => 2 * M * ε_seq j) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * M * 0)) :=
        hε_zero.const_mul (2 * M)
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => 2 * M ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (2 * M ^ 2 * 0)) :=
        (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hP_top).const_mul (2 * M ^ 2)
      simpa [η_seq] using h1.add h2
    let δ' : ℝ := min 1 (δ / (2 * Real.exp (M + 1)))
    have hδ'_pos : 0 < δ' :=
      lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hδ (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _)))
    have hev_P : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, 16 * M ^ 2 ≤ P_seq j :=
      hP_top.eventually_ge_atTop (16 * M ^ 2)
    have hev_η : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, η_seq j < δ' :=
      hη_zero.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ'_pos)
    filter_upwards [hev_P, hev_η] with j hjP hjη u huK
    have hu_abs : |u| ≤ M := hK_bound u huK
    have hPj_pos : 0 < P_seq j := by linarith [hP_ge_40000 j]
    have h4M_le_Pj : 4 * M ≤ P_seq j := by nlinarith
    have h4M_le_sqrt : 4 * M ≤ Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := by
      have hsq : (4 * M) ^ 2 ≤ P_seq j := by linarith
      calc 4 * M = Real.sqrt ((4 * M) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    let t : ℝ := u / P_seq j
    have ht_quarter : |t| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      dsimp [t]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hPj_pos, div_le_iff₀ hPj_pos]
      linarith
    have ht_half : |t| ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have h1mt_pos : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith [(abs_le.mp ht_quarter).2]
    let h : ℝ := Real.log (1 - t)
    have hh_quad : |h + t| ≤ 2 * t ^ 2 := h_log_quad t ht_half
    have hh_le_2t : |h| ≤ 2 * |t| := by
      have htri : |h| ≤ |h + t| + |t| := by
        calc |h| = |(h + t) - t| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |h + t| + |t| := abs_sub _ _
      have ht_sq : t ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := (sq_abs t).symm
      rw [ht_sq] at hh_quad
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg t]
    have hh_le_2MP : |h| ≤ 2 * M / P_seq j := by
      have h1 : 2 * |t| ≤ 2 * M / P_seq j := by
        dsimp [t]
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hPj_pos]
        have : 2 * (|u| / P_seq j) = 2 * |u| / P_seq j := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hPj_pos)
      exact le_trans hh_le_2t h1
    have hh_le_rj : |h| ≤ (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹ := by
      have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hPj_pos
      have h1 : 2 * M / P_seq j ≤ (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_eq_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hPj_pos hsqrt_pos]
        have hsq : Real.sqrt (P_seq j) * Real.sqrt (P_seq j) = P_seq j :=
          Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt hPj_pos)
        nlinarith
      exact le_trans hh_le_2MP h1
    have h_arg_eq : Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 - u / P_seq j) = Real.exp (x_seq j + h) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log h1mt_pos]
    rw [h_arg_eq, hm_ratio (x_seq j) (x_seq j + h), Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
    let E : ℝ := -(ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j))
    change |Real.exp E - Real.exp u| < δ
    have h_inc := h_int_inc j h hh_le_rj
    have hε_nonneg : 0 ≤ ε_seq j := by
      dsimp [ε_seq]
      exact div_nonneg (by norm_num) (by linarith [hB_ge j])
    have h_inc_bound : |(ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j)) - P_seq j * h| ≤ 2 * M * ε_seq j := by
      have h1 : ε_seq j * P_seq j * |h| ≤ ε_seq j * P_seq j * (2 * M / P_seq j) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh_le_2MP (mul_nonneg hε_nonneg (le_of_lt hPj_pos))
      have h2 : ε_seq j * P_seq j * (2 * M / P_seq j) = 2 * M * ε_seq j := by
        have hne : P_seq j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hPj_pos
        field_simp
      linarith
    have h_pt_bound : P_seq j * |h + t| ≤ 2 * M ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹ := by
      have h1 : P_seq j * |h + t| ≤ P_seq j * (2 * t ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh_quad (le_of_lt hPj_pos)
      have h2 : P_seq j * (2 * t ^ 2) = 2 * u ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [t]
        have hne : P_seq j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hPj_pos
        field_simp
      have hu2 : u ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs u]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg u]
      have h3 : 2 * u ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * M ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hPj_pos))
      linarith
    have hEu_ident : E - u =
        -((ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j)) - P_seq j * h) - P_seq j * (h + t) := by
      dsimp [E, t]
      have hne : P_seq j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hPj_pos
      field_simp
      ring
    have hEu_le : |E - u| ≤ η_seq j := by
      rw [hEu_ident]
      calc |-((ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j)) - P_seq j * h) - P_seq j * (h + t)|
          ≤ |-((ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j)) - P_seq j * h)| + |P_seq j * (h + t)| :=
            abs_sub _ _
        _ = |(ρ (x_seq j + h) - ρ (x_seq j)) - P_seq j * h| + P_seq j * |h + t| := by
            rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hPj_pos]
        _ ≤ 2 * M * ε_seq j + 2 * M ^ 2 * (P_seq j)⁻¹ := add_le_add h_inc_bound h_pt_bound
    have hη_lt1 : η_seq j < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hjη (min_le_left _ _)
    have hη_lt_div : η_seq j < δ / (2 * Real.exp (M + 1)) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hjη (min_le_right _ _)
    have hE_le : E ≤ M + 1 := by
      linarith [(abs_le.mp hu_abs).2, (abs_le.mp hEu_le).2]
    have hu_le : u ≤ M + 1 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hu_abs).2]
    have h_lip := h_exp_lip E u (M + 1) hE_le hu_le
    have h_prod : Real.exp (M + 1) * η_seq j < δ / 2 := by
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (M + 1) := Real.exp_pos _
      have h1 : Real.exp (M + 1) * η_seq j <
          Real.exp (M + 1) * (δ / (2 * Real.exp (M + 1))) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hη_lt_div hexp_pos
      have h2 : Real.exp (M + 1) * (δ / (2 * Real.exp (M + 1))) = δ / 2 := by
        have hne : Real.exp (M + 1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hexp_pos
        field_simp
      rwa [h2] at h1
    have h_le_prod : Real.exp (M + 1) * |E - u| ≤ Real.exp (M + 1) * η_seq j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEu_le (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    linarith

  · 
    intro j v hv
    have hPj_ge : 40000 ≤ P_seq j := hP_ge_40000 j
    have hPj_pos : 0 < P_seq j := by linarith
    have hsqrt_ge : 200 ≤ Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := by
      have hsq : (200 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ P_seq j := by linarith
      calc (200 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((200 : ℝ) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)).symm
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
    let r_j : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹
    have hrj_pos : 0 < r_j := inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hrj_le : r_j ≤ 1 / 200 := by
      dsimp [r_j]
      rw [inv_eq_one_div]
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hsqrt_ge
    have hw_ge1 : 1 ≤ 1 + v / P_seq j := by
      have : 0 ≤ v / P_seq j := div_nonneg hv (le_of_lt hPj_pos)
      linarith
    let z : ℝ := Real.log (1 + v / P_seq j)
    have hz_nonneg : 0 ≤ z := Real.log_nonneg hw_ge1
    have h_arg_eq : Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 + v / P_seq j) = Real.exp (x_seq j + z) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by linarith)]
    have h_rhs_eq : Real.exp 2 * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) =
        Real.exp (2 - (5 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + v)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1 + v), ← Real.exp_add]
      ring_nf
    rw [h_arg_eq, hm_ratio (x_seq j) (x_seq j + z), h_rhs_eq, Real.exp_le_exp]
    suffices h_goal : (5 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + v) ≤ 2 + (ρ (x_seq j + z) - ρ (x_seq j)) by
      linarith
    have hexp_neg2 : Real.exp (-2) ≤ 1 / 3 := by
      have h1 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
        have := Real.add_one_le_exp (2 : ℝ)
        linarith
      have h2 : 3 * Real.exp (-2) ≤ 1 := by
        calc 3 * Real.exp (-2)
            ≤ Real.exp 2 * Real.exp (-2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_nonneg (-2))
          _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      linarith
    rcases le_or_gt z r_j with hzr | hrz
    · 
      have hint := hp_int (x_seq j) (x_seq j + z) (by linarith)
      have h_int_lo : (∫ y in (x_seq j)..(x_seq j + z), ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j)) ≤
          ∫ y in (x_seq j)..(x_seq j + z), p y := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) intervalIntegrable_const hint.1 ?_
        intro y hy
        have hy_abs : |y - x_seq j| ≤ (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹ := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hy.1])]
          exact le_trans (by linarith [hy.2]) hzr
        have hfl := ((hx_spec j).2.2.2 (y - x_seq j) hy_abs).2
        have hy_eq : x_seq j + (y - x_seq j) = y := by ring
        rwa [hy_eq] at hfl
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, hint.2] at h_int_lo
      change ((x_seq j + z) - x_seq j) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j) ≤
        ρ (x_seq j + z) - ρ (x_seq j) at h_int_lo
      have hexp_z_le : Real.exp z ≤ 1 + 2 * z := by
        have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-z)
        have h2 : (1 - z) * Real.exp z ≤ 1 := by
          calc (1 - z) * Real.exp z
              = (-z + 1) * Real.exp z := by ring
            _ ≤ Real.exp (-z) * Real.exp z :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.exp_nonneg z)
            _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
        nlinarith
      have hv_le_2Pz : v ≤ 2 * P_seq j * z := by
        have hez : Real.exp z = 1 + v / P_seq j := Real.exp_log (by linarith)
        rw [hez] at hexp_z_le
        have hdiv : v / P_seq j ≤ 2 * z := by linarith
        have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hPj_pos).mp hdiv
        linarith
      have hlog_1pv : Real.log (1 + v) - 2 ≤ (1 + v) / 3 - 1 := by
        have hpos1 : 0 < 1 + v := by linarith
        have hpos2 : 0 < Real.exp (-2) := Real.exp_pos (-2)
        have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (mul_pos hpos1 hpos2)
        rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hpos1) (ne_of_gt hpos2), Real.log_exp] at h1
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · 
      let w_j : ℝ := x_seq j + r_j
      have hint := hp_int (x_seq j) w_j (by dsimp [w_j]; linarith)
      have h_int_lo : (∫ y in (x_seq j)..w_j, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j)) ≤
          ∫ y in (x_seq j)..w_j, p y := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by dsimp [w_j]; linarith)
          intervalIntegrable_const hint.1 ?_
        intro y hy
        have hy_abs : |y - x_seq j| ≤ (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹ := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hy.1])]
          dsimp [w_j, r_j] at hy
          linarith [hy.2]
        have hfl := ((hx_spec j).2.2.2 (y - x_seq j) hy_abs).2
        have hy_eq : x_seq j + (y - x_seq j) = y := by ring
        rwa [hy_eq] at hfl
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, hint.2] at h_int_lo
      change (w_j - x_seq j) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j) ≤ ρ w_j - ρ (x_seq j) at h_int_lo
      have hrP_eq : (w_j - x_seq j) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := by
        have hsub : w_j - x_seq j = (Real.sqrt (P_seq j))⁻¹ := by dsimp [w_j, r_j]; ring
        rw [hsub]
        let sP : ℝ := Real.sqrt (P_seq j)
        have hsP_sq : P_seq j = sP * sP := (Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt hPj_pos)).symm
        have hsP_ne : sP ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by dsimp [sP]; linarith)
        change sP⁻¹ * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * P_seq j) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sP
        rw [hsP_sq]
        field_simp
      rw [hrP_eq] at h_int_lo
      have h_env_lo : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (z - r_j) ≤ ρ (x_seq j + z) - ρ w_j := by
        have h1 : ρ_c w_j - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * w_j ≤
            ρ (x_seq j + z) - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (x_seq j + z) :=
          hρc_lb w_j (x_seq j + z) (by dsimp [w_j]; linarith)
        have h_cont : ρ_c w_j = ρ w_j := (hx_spec j).2.2.1
        dsimp [w_j] at h1 h_cont ⊢
        linarith
      have hlog_1pv : Real.log (1 + v) ≤ 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt (P_seq j)) + z := by
        have h1 : 1 + v ≤ Real.sqrt (P_seq j) ^ 2 * Real.exp z := by
          rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hPj_pos), Real.exp_log (by linarith)]
          have hne : P_seq j ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hPj_pos
          have hid : P_seq j * (1 + v / P_seq j) = P_seq j + v := by field_simp
          linarith
        have hsqrt_ne : Real.sqrt (P_seq j) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
        calc Real.log (1 + v)
            ≤ Real.log (Real.sqrt (P_seq j) ^ 2 * Real.exp z) :=
              Real.log_le_log (by linarith) h1
          _ = Real.log (Real.sqrt (P_seq j) ^ 2) + Real.log (Real.exp z) :=
              Real.log_mul (pow_ne_zero 2 hsqrt_ne) (ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos z))
          _ = 2 * Real.log (Real.sqrt (P_seq j)) + z := by
              rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_exp]
              norm_num
      have hlog_sqrt : Real.log (Real.sqrt (P_seq j)) - 2 ≤
          Real.sqrt (P_seq j) / 3 - 1 := by
        have hpos1 : 0 < Real.sqrt (P_seq j) := by linarith
        have hpos2 : 0 < Real.exp (-2) := Real.exp_pos (-2)
        have h1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (mul_pos hpos1 hpos2)
        rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hpos1) (ne_of_gt hpos2), Real.log_exp] at h1
        nlinarith
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(m p ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ K₁ : ℝ)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁)
    (hρ_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))))
    (hp_exp : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u)
    (hp_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
      IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧
      (∫ y in a..b, p y) = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp b))) - (-Real.log (m (Real.exp a))))
    (hρc_cont : Continuous ρ_c)
    (hρc_bounds : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ_c x ∧ ρ_c x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x)))
    (hρc_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c u)
    (hρc_flat : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo u v, ρ_c w < -Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) →
      ρ_c v - ρ_c u = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u))
    (h_bdd : ∀ z : ℝ, x₀ ≤ z → ρ_c z = -Real.log (m (Real.exp z)) → p z ≤ K₁) :
    (∀ u v : ℝ, x₀ ≤ u → u ≤ v → ρ_c v - ρ_c u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
    ∃ r : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → r x = ρ_c x) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ r v - r u) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → r v - r u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ r x)

signature.name: bounded_contact_envelope_lipschitz
signature.statement:
(m p ρ_c : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ K₁ : ℝ)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁)
    (hρ_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))))
    (hp_exp : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → p v ≤ Real.exp (v - u) * p u)
    (hp_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b →
      IntervalIntegrable p MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧
      (∫ y in a..b, p y) = (-Real.log (m (Real.exp b))) - (-Real.log (m (Real.exp a))))
    (hρc_cont : Continuous ρ_c)
    (hρc_bounds : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ ρ_c x ∧ ρ_c x ≤ -Real.log (m (Real.exp x)))
    (hρc_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c u)
    (hρc_flat : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v →
      (∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo u v, ρ_c w < -Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) →
      ρ_c v - ρ_c u = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u))
    (h_bdd : ∀ z : ℝ, x₀ ≤ z → ρ_c z = -Real.log (m (Real.exp z)) → p z ≤ K₁) :
    (∀ u v : ℝ, x₀ ≤ u → u ≤ v → ρ_c v - ρ_c u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
    ∃ r : ℝ → ℝ,
      (∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → r x = ρ_c x) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ r v - r u) ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → r v - r u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ r x)

proof.tactics:
by
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))
  have hK₁_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K₁ := by linarith
  have h_exp_comb : ∀ σ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ → 0 ≤ τ →
      σ + (Real.exp τ - 1) ≤ Real.exp (σ + τ) - 1 := by
    intro σ τ hσ hτ
    have h1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp τ := Real.one_le_exp hτ
    have h2 : σ ≤ σ * Real.exp τ := le_mul_of_one_le_right hσ h1
    have h3 : σ * Real.exp τ + Real.exp τ ≤ Real.exp (σ + τ) := by
      calc σ * Real.exp τ + Real.exp τ
          = (σ + 1) * Real.exp τ := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.exp σ * Real.exp τ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp σ) (Real.exp_nonneg τ)
        _ = Real.exp (σ + τ) := (Real.exp_add σ τ).symm
    linarith
  have h_exp_lin : ∀ δ : ℝ, (1 - δ) * (Real.exp δ - 1) ≤ δ := by
    intro δ
    have h1 : (-δ + 1) * Real.exp δ ≤ 1 := by
      calc (-δ + 1) * Real.exp δ
          ≤ Real.exp (-δ) * Real.exp δ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.add_one_le_exp (-δ)) (Real.exp_nonneg δ)
        _ = Real.exp (-δ + δ) := (Real.exp_add (-δ) δ).symm
        _ = 1 := by rw [neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
    have h2 : (1 - δ) * (Real.exp δ - 1) = (-δ + 1) * Real.exp δ - 1 + δ := by ring
    linarith
  have h_post_contact : ∀ a₁ b : ℝ, x₀ ≤ a₁ → a₁ ≤ b → ρ_c a₁ = ρ a₁ →
      ρ_c b - ρ_c a₁ ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) := by
    intro a₁ b hx₀a₁ ha₁b ha₁_eq
    have hp_a₁ : p a₁ ≤ K₁ := h_bdd a₁ hx₀a₁ ha₁_eq
    have hp_le : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a₁ b, p y ≤ K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁) := by
      intro y hy
      calc p y ≤ Real.exp (y - a₁) * p a₁ := hp_exp a₁ y hy.1
        _ ≤ Real.exp (y - a₁) * K₁ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp_a₁ (Real.exp_nonneg (y - a₁))
        _ = K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁) := mul_comm _ _
    have hg_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁)) :=
      continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
    have hg_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁))
        MeasureTheory.volume a₁ b :=
      hg_cont.intervalIntegrable a₁ b
    have hint_le : (∫ y in a₁..b, p y) ≤ ∫ y in a₁..b, K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on ha₁b (hp_int a₁ b ha₁b).1 hg_int hp_le
    have hint_eval :
        (∫ y in a₁..b, K₁ * Real.exp (y - a₁)) = K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right Real.exp a₁,
        sub_self, integral_exp, Real.exp_zero]
    have hρ_diff : ρ b - ρ a₁ ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) := by
      rw [← (hp_int a₁ b ha₁b).2, ← hint_eval]
      exact hint_le
    have hρc_b : ρ_c b ≤ ρ b := (hρc_bounds b).2
    linarith
  have h_step : ∀ a b : ℝ, x₀ ≤ a → a ≤ b →
      ρ_c b - ρ_c a ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a) - 1) := by
    intro a b ha hab
    let C : Set ℝ := Set.Icc a b ∩ {z : ℝ | ρ_c z = ρ z}
    rcases C.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hC_empty | hC_ne
    · have h_no_contact : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ρ_c w < ρ w := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_le : ρ_c w ≤ ρ w := (hρc_bounds w).2
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne hw_le
        intro h_eq
        have hw_mem : w ∈ C := ⟨⟨le_of_lt hw.1, le_of_lt hw.2⟩, h_eq⟩
        rw [hC_empty] at hw_mem
        exact hw_mem
      have h_flat : ρ_c b - ρ_c a = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (b - a) := hρc_flat a b hab h_no_contact
      have h_ba_nonneg : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.mpr hab
      have h1 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (b - a) ≤ K₁ * (b - a) := by
        have h34 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ K₁ := by linarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h34 h_ba_nonneg
      have h2 : K₁ * (b - a) ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a) - 1) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hK₁_nonneg
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (b - a)]
      linarith
    · have hC_closed : IsClosed C := isClosed_Icc.inter (isClosed_eq hρc_cont hρ_cont)
      have hC_bdd : BddBelow C := ⟨a, fun z hz => hz.1.1⟩
      let a₁ : ℝ := sInf C
      have ha₁_mem : a₁ ∈ C := IsClosed.csInf_mem hC_closed hC_ne hC_bdd
      have haa₁ : a ≤ a₁ := ha₁_mem.1.1
      have ha₁b : a₁ ≤ b := ha₁_mem.1.2
      have ha₁_eq : ρ_c a₁ = ρ a₁ := ha₁_mem.2
      have h_left_no_contact : ∀ w ∈ Set.Ioo a a₁, ρ_c w < ρ w := by
        intro w hw
        have hw_le : ρ_c w ≤ ρ w := (hρc_bounds w).2
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne hw_le
        intro h_eq
        have hw_mem : w ∈ C := ⟨⟨le_of_lt hw.1, le_trans (le_of_lt hw.2) ha₁b⟩, h_eq⟩
        have ha₁_le_w : a₁ ≤ w := csInf_le hC_bdd hw_mem
        linarith [hw.2]
      have h_left_flat : ρ_c a₁ - ρ_c a = (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (a₁ - a) :=
        hρc_flat a a₁ haa₁ h_left_no_contact
      have h_left_le : ρ_c a₁ - ρ_c a ≤ K₁ * (a₁ - a) := by
        have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ a₁ - a := sub_nonneg.mpr haa₁
        have h34 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ K₁ := by linarith
        linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h34 h_nonneg]
      have h_right_le : ρ_c b - ρ_c a₁ ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) :=
        h_post_contact a₁ b (le_trans ha haa₁) ha₁b ha₁_eq
      have h_comb : (a₁ - a) + (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) ≤ Real.exp (b - a) - 1 := by
        have h_sum : (a₁ - a) + (b - a₁) = b - a := by ring
        rw [← h_sum]
        exact h_exp_comb (a₁ - a) (b - a₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr haa₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr ha₁b)
      have h_comb_K₁ :
          K₁ * (a₁ - a) + K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1) ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a) - 1) := by
        calc K₁ * (a₁ - a) + K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1)
            = K₁ * ((a₁ - a) + (Real.exp (b - a₁) - 1)) := by ring
          _ ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp (b - a) - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_comb hK₁_nonneg
      linarith
  have hρc_lip : ∀ u v : ℝ, x₀ ≤ u → u ≤ v → ρ_c v - ρ_c u ≤ K₁ * (v - u) := by
    intro u v hu huv
    refine le_of_not_gt fun h_gt => ?_
    have hd_pos : 0 < v - u := lt_of_not_ge fun h_le => by
      have huv_eq : u = v := le_antisymm huv (by linarith)
      subst huv_eq
      linarith
    set d : ℝ := v - u
    set D : ℝ := ρ_c v - ρ_c u
    set η : ℝ := D - K₁ * d
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := sub_pos.mpr h_gt
    obtain ⟨N, hN_gt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max d (d * D / η))
    have hd_lt_N : d < (N : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hN_gt
    have hquot_lt_N : d * D / η < (N : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hN_gt
    have hN_pos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := lt_trans hd_pos hd_lt_N
    have hN_ne : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hN_pos
    set δ : ℝ := d / (N : ℝ)
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := div_pos hd_pos hN_pos
    have hδ_lt_one : δ < 1 := (div_lt_one hN_pos).mpr hd_lt_N
    have h1δ_pos : 0 < 1 - δ := sub_pos.mpr hδ_lt_one
    have h_gap : K₁ * d < (1 - δ) * D := by
      have h1 : d * D < (N : ℝ) * η := (div_lt_iff₀ hη_pos).mp hquot_lt_N
      have h2 : δ * D < η := by
        have : δ * D = (d * D) / (N : ℝ) := by ring
        rw [this, div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
        linarith
      linarith [show (1 - δ) * D = D - δ * D by ring]
    let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => u + (k : ℝ) * δ
    have ht_step : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        ρ_c (t (k + 1)) - ρ_c (t k) ≤ K₁ * (Real.exp δ - 1) := by
      intro k _
      have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * δ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
      have htk_ge : x₀ ≤ t k := by dsimp [t]; linarith
      have htk_diff : t (k + 1) - t k = δ := by dsimp [t]; push_cast; ring
      have htk_le : t k ≤ t (k + 1) := by linarith [hδ_pos, htk_diff]
      have h_sub := h_step (t k) (t (k + 1)) htk_ge htk_le
      rwa [htk_diff] at h_sub
    have h_sum_le : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (ρ_c (t (k + 1)) - ρ_c (t k))) ≤
        ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range N, (K₁ * (Real.exp δ - 1)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum ht_step
    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => ρ_c (t k)) N,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at h_sum_le
    have ht0 : t 0 = u := by dsimp [t]; simp
    have htN : t N = v := by
      dsimp [t]
      have : (N : ℝ) * δ = d := mul_div_cancel₀ d hN_ne
      rw [this]
      linarith [show d = v - u from rfl]
    rw [htN, ht0] at h_sum_le
    have hD_le : D ≤ (N : ℝ) * (K₁ * (Real.exp δ - 1)) := h_sum_le
    have h_mult : (1 - δ) * D ≤ K₁ * d := by
      calc (1 - δ) * D
          ≤ (1 - δ) * ((N : ℝ) * (K₁ * (Real.exp δ - 1))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD_le (le_of_lt h1δ_pos)
        _ = ((N : ℝ) * K₁) * ((1 - δ) * (Real.exp δ - 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((N : ℝ) * K₁) * δ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_lin δ) (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hN_pos) hK₁_nonneg)
        _ = K₁ * ((N : ℝ) * δ) := by ring
        _ = K₁ * d := by rw [mul_div_cancel₀ d hN_ne]
    linarith
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if x₀ ≤ x then ρ_c x else ρ_c x₀ + (x - x₀)
  refine ⟨hρc_lip, r, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    simp only [r, hx, ↓reduceIte]
  · intro u v huv
    by_cases hu : x₀ ≤ u
    · have hv : x₀ ≤ v := le_trans hu huv
      simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
      exact hρc_lo u v huv
    · by_cases hv : x₀ ≤ v
      · simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_lo_v : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - x₀) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c x₀ := hρc_lo x₀ v hv
        linarith
      · simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
        linarith
  · intro u v huv
    by_cases hu : x₀ ≤ u
    · have hv : x₀ ≤ v := le_trans hu huv
      simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
      exact hρc_lip u v hu huv
    · by_cases hv : x₀ ≤ v
      · simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_hi_v : ρ_c v - ρ_c x₀ ≤ K₁ * (v - x₀) := hρc_lip x₀ v le_rfl hv
        have h_left : x₀ - u ≤ K₁ * (x₀ - u) := le_mul_of_one_le_left (by linarith) hK₁
        linarith [show K₁ * (v - x₀) + K₁ * (x₀ - u) = K₁ * (v - u) by ring]
      · simp only [r, hu, hv, ↓reduceIte]
        have h_uv : v - u ≤ K₁ * (v - u) := le_mul_of_one_le_left (by linarith) hK₁
        linarith
  · intro x hx
    simp only [r, hx, ↓reduceIte]
    exact (hρc_bounds x).1

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ K₁ : ℝ)
    (hx₀ : 0 ≤ x₀)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁)
    (hr_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ r v - r u)
    (hr_hi : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → r v - r u ≤ K₁ * (v - u))
    (hr_ge : ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ r x) :
    ∃ (m_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (q_star : ℝ → ℝ) (lam : ℝ),
      1 ≤ lam ∧
      lam ≤ K₁ ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ m_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Continuous q_star ∧
      q_star 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → q_star v - q_star u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun j u => r (m_seq j + u) - r (m_seq j)) q_star Filter.atTop

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨Ω_set, M_sup, lam, hΩ_closed, _, hlam_lo, hlam_hi, hΩ_shift, hΩ_approx,
      hM_lim, hM_le, hM_att⟩ :=
    shift_omega_limit_subadditive_slope r x₀ K₁ hx₀ hK₁ hr_lo hr_hi hr_ge
  have : CompactSpace ↥Ω_set := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hΩ_closed.isCompact
  let τ_Ω : ↥Ω_set ≃ₜ ↥Ω_set :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨fun k : ℤ => x.1 (k + 1), (hΩ_shift x.1).mp x.2⟩
      invFun := fun x =>
        ⟨fun k : ℤ => x.1 (k - 1),
          (hΩ_shift (fun k : ℤ => x.1 (k - 1))).mpr
            (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using x.2)⟩
      left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (funext fun k => by simp)
      right_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (funext fun k => by simp)
      continuous_toFun := by
        refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
        exact continuous_pi fun k : ℤ => (continuous_apply (k + 1)).comp continuous_subtype_val
      continuous_invFun := by
        refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
        exact continuous_pi fun k : ℤ => (continuous_apply (k - 1)).comp continuous_subtype_val }
  have hτ_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ↥Ω_set) (m : ℤ), ((τ_Ω^[k]) x).1 m = x.1 (m + (k : ℤ)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x m
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x m
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih]
      exact congrArg x.1 (by dsimp [τ_Ω]; omega)
  have hτ_symm_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ↥Ω_set) (m : ℤ),
      ((τ_Ω.symm^[k]) x).1 m = x.1 (m - (k : ℤ)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x m
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x m
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply, ih]
      exact congrArg x.1 (by dsimp [τ_Ω]; omega)
  let φ_fwd : ↥Ω_set → ℝ := fun x => (x.1 0 : ℝ)
  have hφ_fwd_cont : Continuous φ_fwd :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp ((continuous_apply (0 : ℤ)).comp continuous_subtype_val)
  choose ξ_max hξ_max_mem hξ_max_sum using hM_att
  let x_seq : ℕ → ↥Ω_set := fun n => ⟨ξ_max n, hξ_max_mem n⟩
  have h_emp : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), φ_fwd ((τ_Ω^[k]) (x_seq n))) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    have h_eq : (fun n : ℕ =>
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), φ_fwd ((τ_Ω^[k]) (x_seq n))) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) =
        (fun n : ℕ => M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      funext n
      congr 1
      calc
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), φ_fwd ((τ_Ω^[k]) (x_seq n))
            = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (ξ_max n (k : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
              dsimp [φ_fwd, x_seq]
              rw [hτ_iter k ⟨ξ_max n, hξ_max_mem n⟩ 0, zero_add]
        _ = M_sup (n + 1) := hξ_max_sum n
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hM_lim
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ_prob, hτ_pres, hτ_symm_pres, h_mean_fwd⟩ :=
    krylov_bogoliubov_maximal_invariant_measure ↥Ω_set τ_Ω φ_fwd x_seq lam hφ_fwd_cont h_emp
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hμ_prob
  have hK₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ K₁ := by linarith
  have hφ_fwd_bdd : ∀ x : ↥Ω_set, |φ_fwd x| ≤ K₁ := by
    intro x
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(x.1 0).2.1], (x.1 0).2.2⟩
  have h_upper_fwd : ∀ x : ↥Ω_set, ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), φ_fwd ((τ_Ω^[k]) x)) ≤ M_sup (n + 1) := by
    intro x n
    calc

    intro x

        omega
      rw [h_idx]

    garsia_subadditive_maximal_cesaro_ae ↥Ω_set μ τ_Ω.symm φ_bwd M_sup K₁ lam

      (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (x_star.1 (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))

    refine hx_bwd.congr fun n => ?_
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    dsimp [φ_bwd]

by
  have _ := And.intro hq_cont hq_lip
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -Real.log (m (Real.exp x))
  
  have hp_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, p y ≤ Real.exp 1 * (ρ y - ρ (y - 1)) := by
    intro y
    have hy : y - 1 ≤ y := by linarith
    have hint := hp_int (y - 1) y hy
    have hmono : ∫ s in (y - 1)..y, Real.exp (-1) * p y ≤ ∫ s in (y - 1)..y, p s := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hy intervalIntegrable_const hint.1
      intro s hs
      have hs_hi : p y ≤ Real.exp (y - s) * p s := hp_exp s y hs.2
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (y - s) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [hs.1])
      have hps_nonneg : 0 ≤ p s := le_of_lt (hp_pos s)
      have hpy_le : p y ≤ Real.exp 1 * p s :=
        le_trans hs_hi (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp_le hps_nonneg)
      calc Real.exp (-1) * p y
          ≤ Real.exp (-1) * (Real.exp 1 * p s) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpy_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
        _ = (Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp 1) * p s := by ring
        _ = p s := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, hint.2] at hmono
    have h1 : Real.exp (-1) * p y ≤ ρ y - ρ (y - 1) := by linarith
    calc p y
        = (Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-1)) * p y := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
      _ = Real.exp 1 * (Real.exp (-1) * p y) := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * (ρ y - ρ (y - 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1))
  let L_int : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun a b => Real.exp 1 * (ρ b - ρ (a - 1))
  have hL_int_nonneg : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → 0 ≤ L_int a b := fun a b hab =>
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1)) (sub_nonneg.mpr (hρ_mono (by linarith)))
  have hρ_lip_le : ∀ a b x₁ x₂ : ℝ, a ≤ x₁ → x₁ ≤ x₂ → x₂ ≤ b →
      ρ x₂ - ρ x₁ ≤ L_int a b * (x₂ - x₁) := by
    intro a b x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₁₂ hx₂
    have hint := hp_int x₁ x₂ hx₁₂
    have hmono : ∫ y in x₁..x₂, p y ≤ ∫ y in x₁..x₂, L_int a b := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hx₁₂ hint.1 intervalIntegrable_const

      have h2 : ρ (a - 1) ≤ ρ (y - 1) := hρ_mono (by linarith [hx₁, hy.1])

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1))
    rw [hint.2, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at hmono
    exact hmono
  have hρ_lip_abs : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ∀ x₁ ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ x₂ ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |ρ x₂ - ρ x₁| ≤ L_int a b * |x₂ - x₁| := by
    intro a b _ x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂
    rcases le_total x₁ x₂ with hle | hge
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hρ_mono hle)), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)]
      exact hρ_lip_le a b x₁ x₂ hx₁.1 hle hx₂.2
    · rw [abs_sub_comm (ρ x₂) (ρ x₁), abs_sub_comm x₂ x₁,

      exact hρ_lip_le a b x₂ x₁ hx₂.1 hge hx₁.2

    (tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact.mp hq_lim {z} isCompact_singleton).tendsto_at

  have h_contact : ∀ u w : ℝ, u < w → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - u) < q_star w - q_star u →

        _ = L_fn R' / (M : ℝ) := mul_one_div _ _
        _ ≤ (L_fn R' + 1) / (M : ℝ) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hM_pos)
        _ < ε / 4 := h_step_small
    have h_mid : |g (σ j) x_k - ρ_star x_k| < ε / 2 := hj k hk_mem
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
    calc |g (σ j) u - ρ_star u|
        = |(g (σ j) u - g (σ j) x_k) + (g (σ j) x_k - ρ_star x_k) +
            (ρ_star x_k - ρ_star u)| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |g (σ j) u - g (σ j) x_k| + |g (σ j) x_k - ρ_star x_k| +
            |ρ_star x_k - ρ_star u| := by
          linarith [abs_add_le (g (σ j) u - g (σ j) x_k) (g (σ j) x_k - ρ_star x_k),
            abs_add_le ((g (σ j) u - g (σ j) x_k) + (g (σ j) x_k - ρ_star x_k))
              (ρ_star x_k - ρ_star u)]
      _ < ε / 4 + ε / 2 + ε / 4 := by linarith
      _ = ε := by ring
  let x_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => b_seq (σ j)
  have hρ_star_loc_unif : TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun j u => ρ (x_seq j + u) - ρ (x_seq j)) ρ_star Filter.atTop := by
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact]
    intro K hK
    obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b⟩ := Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (c := (0 : ℝ)).mp hK.isBounded
    let R : ℕ := Nat.ceil (max r_b 0)
    have hK_sub : K ⊆ Set.Icc (-(R : ℝ)) (R : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      have hcb := hr_b hx
      rw [Real.closedBall_eq_Icc, zero_sub, zero_add] at hcb
      have hr_le : r_b ≤ (R : ℝ) :=
        le_trans (le_max_left r_b 0) (Nat.le_ceil (max r_b 0))
      exact ⟨by linarith [hcb.1], by linarith [hcb.2]⟩
    exact (h_unif_Icc R).mono hK_sub
  
  have h_idx_mono : StrictMono (fun j => σ j + J₀) :=
    fun i j hij => Nat.add_lt_add_right (hσ hij) J₀
  have hx_seq_ge_x₀ : ∀ j : ℕ, x₀ ≤ x_seq j := by
    intro j
    have h := hb_ge (σ j)
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (σ j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    dsimp [x_seq]; linarith
  have hx_seq_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j := fun j => le_trans hx₀ (hx_seq_ge_x₀ j)
  have hx_seq_top : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    hm_seq_top.comp h_idx_mono.tendsto_atTop
  have h_sand : ∀ u w : ℝ, u < w → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - u) < q_star w - q_star u →
      q_star u - C₀ ≤ ρ_star u ∧ ρ_star u ≤ q_star u + K₁ * (w - u) := by
    intro u w huw hslope
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := h_contact u w huw hslope
    have hq_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun j => r (x_seq j + u) - r (x_seq j))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (q_star u)) :=
      (hq_pt u).comp h_idx_mono.tendsto_atTop
    have hev_lo : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, (r (x_seq j + u) - r (x_seq j)) - C₀ ≤ g (σ j) u := by
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨K, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      have hk_ge : K ≤ σ j + J₀ :=
        le_trans hj (le_trans (hσ.id_le j) (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
      rcases hK (σ j + J₀) hk_ge with ⟨h_ru, h_lo_u, _⟩
      have h_rx : x₀ ≤ x_seq j := hx_seq_ge_x₀ j
      have hr1 : r (x_seq j + u) = ρ_c (x_seq j + u) := hr_eq _ h_ru
      have hr2 : r (x_seq j) = ρ_c (x_seq j) := hr_eq _ h_rx
      have hgap := (hb_gap (σ j)).2
      dsimp [x_seq, b_seq, g] at hr1 hr2 hgap ⊢
      linarith
    have hev_hi : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop,
        g (σ j) u ≤ (r (x_seq j + u) - r (x_seq j)) + K₁ * (w - u) := by
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨K, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      have hk_ge : K ≤ σ j + J₀ :=
        le_trans hj (le_trans (hσ.id_le j) (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
      rcases hK (σ j + J₀) hk_ge with ⟨h_ru, _, h_hi_u⟩
      have h_rx : x₀ ≤ x_seq j := hx_seq_ge_x₀ j
      have hr1 : r (x_seq j + u) = ρ_c (x_seq j + u) := hr_eq _ h_ru
      have hr2 : r (x_seq j) = ρ_c (x_seq j) := hr_eq _ h_rx
      have hgap := (hb_gap (σ j)).1
      dsimp [x_seq, b_seq, g] at hr1 hr2 hgap ⊢
      linarith
    exact ⟨le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (hq_sub.sub tendsto_const_nhds) (hρ_star_pt u) hev_lo,
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (hρ_star_pt u) (hq_sub.add tendsto_const_nhds) hev_hi⟩
  have h_slope_symm : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ, M ≤ |u| → |ρ_star u / u - lam| < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    let η : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (ε / (4 * (K₁ + 1)))
    have hη_pos : 0 < η := lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hε (by linarith))
    have hη_le_half : η ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hK₁η_lt : K₁ * η < ε / 4 := by
      have hle : η ≤ ε / (4 * (K₁ + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
      calc K₁ * η ≤ K₁ * (ε / (4 * (K₁ + 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (by linarith)
        _ < (K₁ + 1) * (ε / (4 * (K₁ + 1))) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by linarith) (div_pos hε (by linarith))
        _ = ε / 4 := by field_simp [show (K₁ + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
    let τ : ℝ := min ((1 / 16 : ℝ) * η) (ε / 4)
    have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hτ_le_η : τ ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η := min_le_left _ _
    have hτ_le_ε : τ ≤ ε / 4 := min_le_right _ _
    obtain ⟨A_pos, hA_pos⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hq_top τ hτ_pos)
    obtain ⟨A_neg, hA_neg⟩ := Filter.eventually_atBot.mp
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hq_bot τ hτ_pos)
    let M : ℝ := max 1 (max (2 * |A_pos|) (max (2 * |A_neg|) (4 * (C₀ + 1) / ε)))
    have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    have hM_ge_Apos : 2 * |A_pos| ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hM_ge_Aneg : 2 * |A_neg| ≤ M :=
      le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    have hM_ge_C₀ : 4 * (C₀ + 1) / ε ≤ M :=
      le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
    have hq_approx : ∀ y : ℝ, M / 2 ≤ |y| →
        |q_star y / y - lam| < τ ∧ |q_star y - lam * y| ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |y| := by
      intro y hy
      have hy_abs_pos : 0 < |y| := by linarith
      have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hy_abs_pos
      have h_ratio : |q_star y / y - lam| < τ := by
        rcases le_or_gt 0 y with hy_nn | hy_neg
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg hy_nn] at hy
          have hy_ge : A_pos ≤ y := by linarith [le_abs_self A_pos]
          simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hA_pos y hy_ge
        · rw [abs_of_neg hy_neg] at hy
          have hy_le : y ≤ A_neg := by linarith [le_abs_self (-A_neg), abs_neg A_neg]
          simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hA_neg y hy_le
      refine ⟨h_ratio, ?_⟩
      have h_eq : q_star y - lam * y = y * (q_star y / y - lam) := by field_simp [hy_ne]
      rw [h_eq, abs_mul]
      calc |y| * |q_star y / y - lam|
          ≤ |y| * τ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt h_ratio) (le_of_lt hy_abs_pos)
        _ ≤ |y| * ((1 / 16 : ℝ) * η) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hτ_le_η (le_of_lt hy_abs_pos)
        _ = (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |y| := by ring
    refine ⟨M, hM_ge_one, fun u hu => ?_⟩
    have hu_abs_pos : 0 < |u| := by linarith
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hu_abs_pos
    let w : ℝ := u + η * |u|
    have hw_sub : w - u = η * |u| := by dsimp [w]; ring
    have hu_lt_w : u < w := by
      have : 0 < η * |u| := mul_pos hη_pos hu_abs_pos
      linarith
    have hw_bounds : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * |u| ≤ |w| ∧ |w| ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * |u| := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hu_ne with hu_neg | hu_pos
      · have habs_u : |u| = -u := abs_of_neg hu_neg
        have hw_eq : w = (1 - η) * u := by dsimp [w]; rw [habs_u]; ring
        have h1η_pos : 0 < 1 - η := by linarith
        have hw_neg : w < 0 := by rw [hw_eq]; exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h1η_pos hu_neg
        have habs_w : |w| = (1 - η) * |u| := by
          rw [abs_of_neg hw_neg, hw_eq, habs_u]
          ring
        rw [habs_w]
        exact ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hu_abs_pos),
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hu_abs_pos)⟩
      · have habs_u : |u| = u := abs_of_pos hu_pos
        have hw_eq : w = (1 + η) * u := by dsimp [w]; rw [habs_u]; ring
        have hw_pos : 0 < w := by rw [hw_eq]; exact mul_pos (by linarith) hu_pos
        have habs_w : |w| = (1 + η) * |u| := by
          rw [abs_of_pos hw_pos, hw_eq, habs_u]
        rw [habs_w]
        exact ⟨mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hu_abs_pos),
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hu_abs_pos)⟩
    have hqu := hq_approx u (by linarith)
    have hqw := hq_approx w (by linarith [hw_bounds.1])
    have h_slope_uw : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - u) < q_star w - q_star u := by
      have hqu_hi : q_star u ≤ lam * u + (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |u| := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hqu.2).2]
      have hqw_lo : lam * w - (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |w| ≤ q_star w := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp hqw.2).1]
      have hw_err : (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |w| ≤ (3 / 32 : ℝ) * η * |u| := by
        have h1 : (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * |w| ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) * η * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * |u|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_bounds.2 (by positivity)
        linarith
      have hlam_diff : η * |u| ≤ lam * (w - u) := by
        rw [hw_sub]
        exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) hlam
      have hpos_ηu : 0 < η * |u| := mul_pos hη_pos hu_abs_pos
      linarith
    rcases h_sand u w hu_lt_w h_slope_uw with ⟨h_sand_lo, h_sand_hi⟩
    rw [hw_sub] at h_sand_hi
    have hK₁ηu_nn : 0 ≤ K₁ * (η * |u|) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have h_diff_abs : |ρ_star u - q_star u| ≤ C₀ + K₁ * η * |u| := by
      apply abs_le.mpr
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_div_diff : |ρ_star u / u - q_star u / u| ≤ C₀ / |u| + K₁ * η := by
      rw [← sub_div, abs_div]
      calc |ρ_star u - q_star u| / |u|
          ≤ (C₀ + K₁ * η * |u|) / |u| := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_diff_abs (le_of_lt hu_abs_pos)
        _ = C₀ / |u| + K₁ * η := by rw [add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt hu_abs_pos)]
    have h_C₀_small : C₀ / |u| < ε / 4 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hu_abs_pos]
      have h1 : 4 * (C₀ + 1) / ε ≤ |u| := le_trans hM_ge_C₀ hu
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (le_of_lt (show (0 : ℝ) < ε / 4 by positivity))
      have h_eq : (ε / 4) * (4 * (C₀ + 1) / ε) = C₀ + 1 := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hε]
      linarith
    calc |ρ_star u / u - lam|
        = |(ρ_star u / u - q_star u / u) + (q_star u / u - lam)| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |ρ_star u / u - q_star u / u| + |q_star u / u - lam| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ < (ε / 4 + ε / 4) + ε / 4 := by linarith [hqu.1]
      _ < ε := by linarith
  have hρ_star_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM_one, hM⟩ := h_slope_symm ε hε
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨M, fun u hu => by
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      exact hM u (by rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; exact hu)⟩
  have hρ_star_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨M, hM_one, hM⟩ := h_slope_symm ε hε
    exact Filter.eventually_atBot.mpr ⟨-M, fun u hu => by
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      exact hM u (by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; linarith)⟩
  
  let C_env : ℝ := K₁ + C₀ + |ρ_c x₀| + x₀ + 1
  have hC_env_pos : 0 < C_env := by
    dsimp [C_env]
    linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ_c x₀)]
  have hx_base_lip : ∀ j : ℕ, ρ_c (x_seq j) - ρ_c x₀ ≤ K₁ * (x_seq j - x₀) :=
    fun j => hρc_lip x₀ (x_seq j) le_rfl (hx_seq_ge_x₀ j)
  have hx_base_gap : ∀ j : ℕ, ρ (x_seq j) ≤ ρ_c (x_seq j) + C₀ :=
    fun j => (hb_gap (σ j)).2
  refine ⟨⟨x_seq, ρ_star, lam, C_env, K₁, hlam, hC_env_pos, hK₁,
    hx_seq_nonneg, hx_seq_top, hρ_star_cont, hρ_star_zero,
    hρ_star_top, hρ_star_bot, hρ_star_loc_unif, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro j v hv
    have h1 : ρ_c v ≤ ρ v := (hρc_bounds v).2
    have h2 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - x_seq j) ≤ ρ_c v - ρ_c (x_seq j) := hρc_lo (x_seq j) v hv
    have h3 := hx_base_gap j
    have h4 : 0 ≤ K₁ + |ρ_c x₀| + x₀ + 1 := by linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ_c x₀)]
    dsimp [C_env, ρ] at h1 h3 ⊢
    linarith
  · 
    intro j v hv
    rcases le_or_gt x₀ v with hv_ge | hv_lt
    · have h1 : ρ_c v ≤ ρ v := (hρc_bounds v).2
      have h2 : ρ_c (x_seq j) - ρ_c v ≤ K₁ * (x_seq j - v) := hρc_lip v (x_seq j) hv_ge hv
      have h3 := hx_base_gap j
      have h4 : 0 ≤ K₁ + |ρ_c x₀| + x₀ + 1 := by linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ_c x₀)]
      dsimp [C_env, ρ] at h1 h3 ⊢
      linarith
    · have h1 : v ≤ ρ v := hρ_ge v
      have h2 := hx_base_gap j
      have h3 := hx_base_lip j
      have h4 : ρ_c x₀ ≤ |ρ_c x₀| := le_abs_self _
      have h5 : (K₁ - 1) * v ≤ (K₁ - 1) * x₀ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hv_lt) (by linarith)
      dsimp [C_env, ρ] at h1 h2 ⊢
      linarith
  · 
    intro j
    have h1 := hx_base_gap j
    have h2 := hx_base_lip j
    have h3 : ρ_c x₀ ≤ |ρ_c x₀| := le_abs_self _
    have h4 : 0 ≤ K₁ * x₀ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hx₀
    have h5 : 0 ≤ (C₀ + |ρ_c x₀| + x₀ + 1) * x_seq j :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith [abs_nonneg (ρ_c x₀)]) (hx_seq_nonneg j)
    dsimp [C_env, ρ] at h1 ⊢
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(d_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hda : 0 < d_a)
    (hw_cont : Continuous w)
    (hw_per : Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi))
    (hw_nonneg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y)
    (hw_mean : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1) :
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) = 1 ∧
    Continuous (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) ∧
    Function.Periodic (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) = 1 ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x ∧
      ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x ≤ Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - 1)) ∧
    (∀ B x x' : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → |x' - x| ≤ B * d_a →
      ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x' ≤ 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
  have h2pi_ne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := h2pi_pos.ne'
  have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le
  have hsinh_pos : 0 < Real.sinh d_a := Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hda
  have hcosh_gt_one : 1 < Real.cosh d_a := Real.one_lt_cosh.mpr hda.ne'
  have hcosh_sub_one_pos : 0 < Real.cosh d_a - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hcosh_gt_one
  have hden_ge : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.cosh d_a - 1 ≤ Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos u := by
    intro u
    linarith [Real.cos_le_one u]
  have hden_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos u :=
    fun u => lt_of_lt_of_le hcosh_sub_one_pos (hden_ge u)
  have hker_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < periodicPoissonKernel d_a u :=
    fun u => div_pos hsinh_pos (hden_pos u)
  have hker_le : ∀ u : ℝ, periodicPoissonKernel d_a u ≤ Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - 1) :=
    fun u => div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hsinh_pos.le hcosh_sub_one_pos (hden_ge u)
  have hker_cont : Continuous (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) :=
    continuous_const.div (continuous_const.sub Real.continuous_cos) (fun u => (hden_pos u).ne')
  have hker_per : Function.Periodic (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro u
    dsimp [periodicPoissonKernel]
    rw [Real.cos_periodic u]
  let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-d_a)
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.exp_pos (-d_a)
  have hq_den_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < 1 - r * Real.cos u := by
    intro u
    have hr_lt_one : r < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (neg_lt_zero.mpr hda)
    have hrcos : r * Real.cos u ≤ r := by
      calc r * Real.cos u ≤ r * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.cos_le_one u) hr_pos.le
        _ = r := mul_one r
    linarith
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (r * Real.sin u) / (1 - r * Real.cos u)
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => u + 2 * Real.arctan (q u)
  have hG_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) u := by
    intro u
    have h_num : HasDerivAt (fun t => r * Real.sin t) (r * Real.cos u) u :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sin u).const_mul r
    have h_den : HasDerivAt (fun t => 1 - r * Real.cos t) (r * Real.sin u) u := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => r * Real.cos t) (r * -Real.sin u) u :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_cos u).const_mul r
      have h2 := (hasDerivAt_const u (1 : ℝ)).sub h1
      convert h2 using 1
      ring
    have hq_deriv : HasDerivAt q
        (((r * Real.cos u) * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - (r * Real.sin u) * (r * Real.sin u)) /
          (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2) u :=
      h_num.div h_den (hq_den_pos u).ne'
    have hG_raw : HasDerivAt G
        (1 + 2 * (1 / (1 + q u ^ 2) *
          (((r * Real.cos u) * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - (r * Real.sin u) * (r * Real.sin u)) /
            (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2))) u :=
      (hasDerivAt_id u).add ((hq_deriv.arctan).const_mul 2)
    convert hG_raw using 1
    symm
    have h_sum_sq : (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin u) ^ 2 = 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 := by
      have hsc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq u
      calc (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin u) ^ 2
          = 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 * (Real.sin u ^ 2 + Real.cos u ^ 2) := by ring
        _ = 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [hsc]
        _ = 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_quad_pos : 0 < 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 := by
      rw [← h_sum_sq]
      exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (pow_pos (hq_den_pos u) 2) (sq_nonneg _)
    have h_step1 :
        1 + 2 * (1 / (1 + q u ^ 2) *
          (((r * Real.cos u) * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - (r * Real.sin u) * (r * Real.sin u)) /
            (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2)) =
        (1 - r ^ 2) / (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2) := by
      have hq_den_ne : 1 - r * Real.cos u ≠ 0 := (hq_den_pos u).ne'
      have h_one_add_q2 : 1 + q u ^ 2 = (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2) / (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [div_pow, one_add_div (pow_ne_zero 2 hq_den_ne), h_sum_sq]
      rw [h_one_add_q2]
      have h_num_simp : (r * Real.cos u) * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - (r * Real.sin u) * (r * Real.sin u) =
          r * Real.cos u - r ^ 2 := by
        have hsc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq u
        calc (r * Real.cos u) * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - (r * Real.sin u) * (r * Real.sin u)
            = r * Real.cos u - r ^ 2 * (Real.sin u ^ 2 + Real.cos u ^ 2) := by ring
          _ = r * Real.cos u - r ^ 2 * 1 := by rw [hsc]
          _ = r * Real.cos u - r ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h_num_simp]
      field_simp [hq_den_ne, h_quad_pos.ne']
      ring
    rw [h_step1]
    dsimp [periodicPoissonKernel, r]
    rw [Real.sinh_eq, Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg]
    have hE_pos : 0 < Real.exp d_a := Real.exp_pos d_a
    have hE_ne : Real.exp d_a ≠ 0 := hE_pos.ne'
    have hden_ne : (Real.exp d_a + (Real.exp d_a)⁻¹) / 2 - Real.cos u ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.cosh_eq]
      exact (hden_pos u).ne'
    have hquad_ne : 1 - 2 * (Real.exp d_a)⁻¹ * Real.cos u + ((Real.exp d_a)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_neg]
      exact h_quad_pos.ne'
    field_simp [hE_ne, hden_ne, hquad_ne]
    ring
  have h_ker_int_2pi : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) = 2 * Real.pi := by
    have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun u _ => hG_deriv u) (hker_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by
      simp [G, q]
    have hG2pi : G (2 * Real.pi) = 2 * Real.pi := by
      simp [G, q]
    rw [h_ftc, hG2pi, hG0, sub_zero]
  have h_conj1 : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) = 1 := by
    rw [h_ker_int_2pi, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne]
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y
  have hF_uncurry_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F) :=
    (hker_cont.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).mul (hw_cont.comp continuous_snd)
  have h_conj2 : Continuous (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) := by
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun x => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hF_uncurry_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    exact continuous_const.mul h_int_cont
  have h_conj3 : Function.Periodic (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
    have h_fun : (fun y : ℝ => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x + 2 * Real.pi - y) * w y) =
        (fun y : ℝ => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) := by
      ext y
      have h_eq : x + 2 * Real.pi - y = (x - y) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      rw [h_eq, hker_per (x - y)]
    rw [h_fun]
  have h_conj4 : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) = 1 := by
    let I : Set ℝ := Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    let μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict I
    have hF_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry F)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod μ) := by
      have h_meas_eq : (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod μ =
          MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (I ×ˢ I) := by
        dsimp [μ, I]
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le h2pi_pos.le, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict,
          ← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ]
      rw [h_meas_eq]
      have hK_compact : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) :=
        isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
      have h_int_K : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hF_uncurry_cont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK_compact
      exact h_int_K.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
    have h_swap : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) =
        ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y := by
      have h_lhs : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) =
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y, F x y ∂μ := by
        have h_inner : (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) =
            (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y, F x y ∂μ) := by
          ext x
          exact intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h2pi_pos.le
        rw [h_inner]
      have h_rhs : (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) =
          ∫ y, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) ∂μ :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h2pi_pos.le
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs]
      exact MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hF_int
    have h_inner_x : ∀ y : ℝ, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) = (2 * Real.pi) * w y := by
      intro y
      dsimp [F]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) y]
      have h_per_shift : (∫ u in (0 - y)..(2 * Real.pi - y), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) =
          ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u := by
        have h1 := hker_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq (0 - y) 0
        have ha : (0 - y) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi - y := by ring
        have hb : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := zero_add _
        rw [ha, hb] at h1
        exact h1
      rw [h_per_shift, h_ker_int_2pi]
    dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) = 1
    rw [h_swap]
    have h_inner_fun : (fun y : ℝ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x y) =
        (fun y : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi) * w y) := funext h_inner_x
    rw [h_inner_fun, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi) * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y))
        = ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi)) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) := by ring
      _ = 1 * 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, hw_mean]
      _ = 1 := mul_one 1
  have h_conj5 : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x ∧
      ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x ≤ Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
      exact mul_nonneg h2pi_inv_nonneg
        (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le
          (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (hker_pos (x - y)).le (hw_nonneg y)))
    · let K_max : ℝ := Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - 1)
      have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        ((hker_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hw_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => K_max * w y)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (continuous_const.mul hw_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have h_mono : (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) ≤
          ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_max * w y :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int1 h_int2
          (fun y _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hker_le (x - y)) (hw_nonneg y))
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_mono
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono h2pi_inv_nonneg
      dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (K_max * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) := h_mul
        _ = K_max * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) := by ring
        _ = K_max * 1 := by rw [hw_mean]
        _ = K_max := mul_one K_max
  have h_cosh_quad : d_a ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by
    have hda2_pos : 0 < d_a / 2 := half_pos hda
    have h_sinh_lt : d_a / 2 < Real.sinh (d_a / 2) := Real.self_lt_sinh_iff.mpr hda2_pos
    have h_sinh_sq : (d_a / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.sinh (d_a / 2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hda2_pos.le h_sinh_lt.le 2
    have h_cosh_id : Real.cosh d_a - 1 = 2 * Real.sinh (d_a / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have hA_pos : 0 < Real.exp (d_a / 2) := Real.exp_pos (d_a / 2)
      have hA_ne : Real.exp (d_a / 2) ≠ 0 := hA_pos.ne'
      have hexp_da : Real.exp d_a = Real.exp (d_a / 2) ^ 2 := by
        have h_half : d_a = d_a / 2 + d_a / 2 := (add_halves d_a).symm
        conv_lhs => rw [h_half]
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        ring
      rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.sinh_eq, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_neg, hexp_da]
      field_simp [hA_ne]
      ring
    linarith
  have h_one_sub_cos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 1 - Real.cos θ = 2 * Real.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro θ
    have h2 : θ = 2 * (θ / 2) := by ring
    have hc : Real.cos θ = Real.cos (θ / 2) ^ 2 - Real.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [h2]
      exact Real.cos_two_mul' (θ / 2)
    linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ / 2)]
  have h_cos_shift : ∀ u h : ℝ, 1 - Real.cos (u + h) ≤ 2 * (1 - Real.cos u) + h ^ 2 := by
    intro u h
    have h_split : (u + h) / 2 = u / 2 + h / 2 := by ring
    have h_abs_sin : |Real.sin ((u + h) / 2)| ≤ |Real.sin (u / 2)| + |h| / 2 := by
      rw [h_split, Real.sin_add]
      calc |Real.sin (u / 2) * Real.cos (h / 2) + Real.cos (u / 2) * Real.sin (h / 2)|
          ≤ |Real.sin (u / 2) * Real.cos (h / 2)| + |Real.cos (u / 2) * Real.sin (h / 2)| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |Real.sin (u / 2)| * |Real.cos (h / 2)| + |Real.cos (u / 2)| * |Real.sin (h / 2)| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ |Real.sin (u / 2)| * 1 + 1 * |h / 2| := by
            refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
            · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (abs_nonneg _)
            · exact mul_le_mul (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) Real.abs_sin_le_abs (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = |Real.sin (u / 2)| + |h| / 2 := by
            rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
            ring
    have h_sq1 : Real.sin ((u + h) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (|Real.sin (u / 2)| + |h| / 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (Real.sin ((u + h) / 2))]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h_abs_sin 2
    have h_sq2 : (|Real.sin (u / 2)| + |h| / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.sin (u / 2) ^ 2 + h ^ 2 / 2 := by
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (|Real.sin (u / 2)| - |h| / 2) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h_abs_u : |Real.sin (u / 2)| ^ 2 = Real.sin (u / 2) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
      have h_abs_h : |h| ^ 2 = h ^ 2 := sq_abs _
      nlinarith
    linarith [h_one_sub_cos (u + h), h_one_sub_cos u]
  have h_conj6 : ∀ B x x' : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → |x' - x| ≤ B * d_a →
      ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x' ≤ 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x := by
    intro B x x' hB h_dist
    have h_ker_shift : ∀ y : ℝ,
        periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x' - y) ≤ 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) := by
      intro y
      let u : ℝ := x' - y
      let h : ℝ := x - x'
      have huh : u + h = x - y := by dsimp [u, h]; ring
      have hh_abs : |h| ≤ B * d_a := by
        dsimp [h]
        rw [abs_sub_comm]
        exact h_dist
      have hh_sq : h ^ 2 ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by
        have h1 : h ^ 2 ≤ (B * d_a) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← sq_abs h]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg h) hh_abs 2
        calc h ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 * d_a ^ 2 := by linarith [show (B * d_a) ^ 2 = B ^ 2 * d_a ^ 2 by ring]
          _ ≤ B ^ 2 * (2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cosh_quad (sq_nonneg B)
          _ = 2 * B ^ 2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by ring
      have h_den_cmp : Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x - y) ≤
          2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x' - y)) := by
        have hcs := h_cos_shift u h
        rw [huh] at hcs
        have hcos_le : Real.cos (x' - y) ≤ 1 := Real.cos_le_one (x' - y)
        have hB2_nonneg : 0 ≤ B ^ 2 := sq_nonneg B
        dsimp [u] at hcs
        nlinarith [hcosh_sub_one_pos]
      dsimp [periodicPoissonKernel]
      have hD1 : 0 < Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x - y) := hden_pos (x - y)
      have hD2 : 0 < Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x' - y) := hden_pos (x' - y)
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ hD2 hD1]
      calc Real.sinh d_a * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x - y))
          ≤ Real.sinh d_a * (2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x' - y))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_cmp hsinh_pos.le
        _ = 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * Real.sinh d_a * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (x' - y)) := by ring
    have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y : ℝ => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x' - y) * w y)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      ((hker_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hw_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun y : ℝ => (2 * (1 + B ^ 2)) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul ((hker_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hw_cont)).intervalIntegrable
        0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_mono : (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x' - y) * w y) ≤
        ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (2 * (1 + B ^ 2)) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int1 h_int2 (fun y _ => ?_)
      calc periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x' - y) * w y
          ≤ (2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y)) * w y :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_ker_shift y) (hw_nonneg y)
        _ = (2 * (1 + B ^ 2)) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) := by ring
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_mono
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono h2pi_inv_nonneg
    dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x' - y) * w y
        ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * (1 + B ^ 2)) *
            ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) := h_mul
      _ = 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y) := by ring
  exact ⟨h_conj1, h_conj2, h_conj3, h_conj4, h_conj5, h_conj6⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hStrip : UcbStripPoissonData S) :
    ∃ K_ker C_bal : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S + 1 ≤ K_ker ∧ 0 < C_bal ∧
      ∀ (k_a l : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
        K_ker ≤ k_a →
        k_a + 2 ≤ l →
        Continuous w →
        Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
        (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          |(S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im| * ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
          C_bal * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 *
              ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) +
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              |(S.V (bootRowPt S k_a y)).im| * w y))

        have h_lhs : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi * K_st (y - x)) * w y =
            K_st (y - x) * w y := by
          field_simp [h_2pi_pos.ne']
        have h_rhs : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (C_ker * K_ref (x - y)) * w y =
            (C_ker * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹) * (K_ref (x - y) * w y) := by ring
        linarith
      have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h_2pi_pos.le
        h_int_st (h_int_ref.const_mul (C_ker * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹)) h_pt
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hm
      dsimp [ν, ancestorPoissonDensity, ν_st]
      linarith
  
  have hRowContVim : ∀ r : ℝ, Real.exp (-r) ≤ H / 20 →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (S.V (bootRowPt S r x)).im) := by
    intro r hr_le
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => bootRowPt S r x) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hpt_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, bootRowPt S r x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro x
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-r) := Real.exp_pos (-r)
      have him : (bootRowPt S r x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-r) := by
        dsimp [bootRowPt]
        simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      change |(bootRowPt S r x).im| < S.H
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith
    exact Complex.continuous_im.comp
      (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont hpt_mem)
  let V_fine : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im
  let V_anc : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => (S.V (bootRowPt S k_a y)).im
  have hV_fine_cont : Continuous V_fine := hRowContVim l hdl_le_H20
  have hV_anc_cont : Continuous V_anc := hRowContVim k_a hda_le_H20
  have h_harm : ∀ y : ℝ, V_anc y = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), K_st (y - x) * V_fine x := by
    intro y
    exact hStrip.strip_harmonic_V h' y_a y hh'_pos hh'_lt hya_pos hya_lt
  have h_fubini :
      (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_anc y * w y) =
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_fine x * ν_st x) := by
    have hab : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := h_2pi_pos.le
    let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y x => K_st (y - x) * V_fine x * w y
    have hF_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F) := by
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, F]
      exact ((hK_st_cont.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).mul
        (hV_fine_cont.comp continuous_snd)).mul (hw_cont.comp continuous_fst)
    have hF_int_Icc : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hF_cont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
    have hF_int_Ioc : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F)
        (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hab]
      exact hF_int_Icc.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
    have hF_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry F)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))).prod
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)))) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn,
        show (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) =
          MeasureTheory.volume.prod MeasureTheory.volume from rfl,
        ← MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict] at hF_int_Ioc
      exact hF_int_Ioc
    have h_lhs_eq :
        (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_anc y * w y) =
        ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (∫ x in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), F y x) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => ?_)
      rw [h_harm y, ← intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
    rw [h_lhs_eq, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hF_prod,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    have h_inner : (fun y : ℝ => F y x) = (fun y : ℝ => V_fine x * (K_st (y - x) * w y)) := by
      ext y; dsimp [F]; ring
    rw [h_inner, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  
  let V_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (V_fine x) 0
  let V_neg : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (-V_fine x) 0
  have hV_pos_cont : Continuous V_pos := hV_fine_cont.max continuous_const
  have hV_neg_cont : Continuous V_neg := hV_fine_cont.neg.max continuous_const
  have hV_pos_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ V_pos x := fun x => le_max_right _ 0
  have hV_neg_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ V_neg x := fun x => le_max_right _ 0
  have hV_split : ∀ x : ℝ,
      V_fine x = V_pos x - V_neg x ∧ |V_fine x| = V_pos x + V_neg x := by
    intro x
    dsimp [V_pos, V_neg]
    rcases le_total 0 (V_fine x) with hx | hx
    · rw [max_eq_left hx, max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hx), abs_of_nonneg hx]
      constructor <;> ring
    · rw [max_eq_right hx, max_eq_left (neg_nonneg.mpr hx), abs_of_nonpos hx]
      constructor <;> ring
  have h_st_diff :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_fine x * ν_st x) =
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν_st x) -
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν_st x) := by
    have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => V_fine x * ν_st x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => V_pos x * ν_st x - V_neg x * ν_st x) := by
      ext x
      rw [(hV_split x).1]
      ring
    rw [h_fn]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      ((hV_pos_cont.mul hν_st_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      ((hV_neg_cont.mul hν_st_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
  have h_abs_sum :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_fine x| * ν x) =
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν x) +
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν x) := by
    have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => |V_fine x| * ν x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => V_pos x * ν x + V_neg x * ν x) := by
      ext x
      rw [(hV_split x).2]
      ring
    rw [h_fn]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_add
      ((hV_pos_cont.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      ((hV_neg_cont.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
  have h_neg_cmp :
      c_ker * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν x) ≤
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν_st x := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h_2pi_pos.le
      ((continuous_const.mul (hV_neg_cont.mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      ((hV_neg_cont.mul hν_st_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (fun x _ => ?_)
    calc c_ker * (V_neg x * ν x)
        = V_neg x * (c_ker * ν x) := by ring
      _ ≤ V_neg x * ν_st x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hν_cmp x).1 (hV_neg_nonneg x)
  have h_pos_cmp :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν_st x) ≤
      C_ker * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν x) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h_2pi_pos.le
      ((hV_pos_cont.mul hν_st_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      ((continuous_const.mul (hV_pos_cont.mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      (fun x _ => ?_)
    calc V_pos x * ν_st x
        ≤ V_pos x * (C_ker * ν x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hν_cmp x).2 (hV_pos_nonneg x)
      _ = C_ker * (V_pos x * ν x) := by ring
  have h_anc_abs :
      -(∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_anc y * w y) ≤
      ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_anc y| * w y := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h_2pi_pos.le
      ((hV_anc_cont.mul hw_cont).neg.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      ((hV_anc_cont.abs.mul hw_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (fun y _ => ?_)
    calc -(V_anc y * w y)
        = (-V_anc y) * w y := by ring
      _ ≤ |V_anc y| * w y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (neg_le_abs (V_anc y)) (hw_nonneg y)
  let I_pos : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν x
  let I_neg : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν x
  let I_anc : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_anc y| * w y
  have hI_pos_nonneg : 0 ≤ I_pos :=
    mul_nonneg h_2pi_inv_nonneg
      (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h_2pi_pos.le
        (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hV_pos_nonneg x) (hν_nonneg x)))
  have hI_anc_nonneg : 0 ≤ I_anc :=
    mul_nonneg h_2pi_inv_nonneg
      (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h_2pi_pos.le
        (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hw_nonneg y)))
  have h_raw_neg_bound :
      c_ker * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_neg x * ν x) ≤
      C_ker * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V_pos x * ν x) +
        (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_anc y| * w y) := by
    linarith [h_fubini, h_st_diff, h_neg_cmp, h_pos_cmp, h_anc_abs]
  have hI_neg_bound : c_ker * I_neg ≤ C_ker * I_pos + I_anc := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_raw_neg_bound h_2pi_inv_nonneg
    dsimp [I_neg, I_pos, I_anc]
    linarith
  have h_goal_eq :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_fine x| * ν x) =
      I_pos + I_neg := by
    rw [h_abs_sum]
    dsimp [I_pos, I_neg]
    ring
  change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |V_fine x| * ν x) ≤
    C_bal * (I_pos + I_anc)
  rw [h_goal_eq]
  have h_c_bal_mul : c_ker * C_bal = c_ker + C_ker + 1 := by
    dsimp [C_bal]
    field_simp [hc_ker_pos.ne']
    ring
  have h_mul_le : c_ker * (I_pos + I_neg) ≤ c_ker * (C_bal * (I_pos + I_anc)) := by
    calc c_ker * (I_pos + I_neg)
        = c_ker * I_pos + c_ker * I_neg := by ring
      _ ≤ c_ker * I_pos + (C_ker * I_pos + I_anc) := by linarith
      _ ≤ (c_ker + C_ker + 1) * I_pos + (c_ker + C_ker + 1) * I_anc := by nlinarith
      _ = (c_ker + C_ker + 1) * (I_pos + I_anc) := by ring
      _ = c_ker * (C_bal * (I_pos + I_anc)) := by rw [← h_c_bal_mul]; ring
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_mul_le hc_ker_pos

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S) :
    (∀ A₁ A₂ k x : ℝ, 0 ≤ A₁ → A₁ ≤ A₂ → criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      0 ≤ tileSupModulus S A₁ k x ∧
      Real.exp (-k) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S k x) ≤ tileSupModulus S A₁ k x ∧
      tileSupModulus S A₁ k x ≤ tileSupModulus S A₂ k x) ∧
    (∀ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B → ∃ C_tr : ℝ, 0 < C_tr ∧
      ∀ (k_a q A_coarse : ℝ) (ν : ℝ → ℝ),
        criticalDepthThreshold S + 1 ≤ k_a →
        k_a ≤ q →
        B ≤ A_coarse →
        Continuous ν →
        Function.Periodic ν (2 * Real.pi) →
        (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ν x) →
        (∀ M x x' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → |x' - x| ≤ M * Real.exp (-k_a) →
          ν x' ≤ 2 * (1 + M ^ 2) * ν x) →
        IntervalIntegrable
          (fun l : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (Real.exp (-l) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S l u)) ^ 2 * ν u)
          MeasureTheory.volume (max (k_a - 1) (q - B - 1)) (q + B + 1) ∧
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileSupModulus S B q x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
          Real.exp (-2 * (q - k_a)) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S A_coarse k_a x) ^ 2 * ν x) +
          C_tr * ∫ l in (max (k_a - 1) (q - B - 1))..(q + B + 1),
            ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (Real.exp (-l) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S l u)) ^ 2 * ν u)) ∧
    (∃ C_rc : ℝ, 0 < C_rc ∧
      ∀ (k_a j : ℝ) (ν : ℝ → ℝ),
        criticalDepthThreshold S + 1 ≤ k_a →
        k_a + 1 ≤ j →
        Continuous ν →
        Function.Periodic ν (2 * Real.pi) →
        (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ν x) →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) = 1 →
        (∀ M x x' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → |x' - x| ≤ M * Real.exp (-k_a) →
          ν x' ≤ 2 * (1 + M ^ 2) * ν x) →
        IntervalIntegrable
          (fun l : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im| * ν u)
          MeasureTheory.volume (j - 1) (j + 1) ∧
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (Real.exp (-j) * shapeModulus S (bootRowPt S j x)) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
          C_rc * (1 + ∫ l in (j - 1)..(j + 1),
            ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Real.exp (-l) * |(S.V (bootRowPt S l u)).im| * ν u)))
