proof.tactics:
by
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
  have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := h2pi_pos.ne'
  have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  have hExpRow : ∀ r : ℝ, k₀ ≤ r → Real.exp (-r) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    intro r hr
    have hlog : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_right 1 _) hr
    calc Real.exp (-r) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  have h_re_im : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = x ∧ ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = y :=
    fun x y => ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
  have hRowPt_re : ∀ r u : ℝ, (bootRowPt S r u).re = u :=
    fun r u => (h_re_im u (S.H - Real.exp (-r))).1
  have hRowPt_im : ∀ r u : ℝ, (bootRowPt S r u).im = S.H - Real.exp (-r) :=
    fun r u => (h_re_im u (S.H - Real.exp (-r))).2
  have hRowMem : ∀ r : ℝ, k₀ ≤ r → ∀ u : ℝ, bootRowPt S r u ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro r hr u
    have hexp_le := hExpRow r hr
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-r) := Real.exp_pos (-r)
    change |(bootRowPt S r u).im| < S.H
    rw [hRowPt_im, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hModContOn : ContinuousOn (shapeModulus S) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    continuous_max.comp_continuousOn
      (S.f_holo.continuousOn.norm.prodMk
        (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm))
  have hModNonneg : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 ≤ shapeModulus S s :=
    fun s => le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hModPer : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, shapeModulus S (s + 2 * Real.pi) = shapeModulus S s := by
    intro s hs
    dsimp [shapeModulus]
    rw [S.f_periodic s hs, S.q_periodic s hs]
  
  have hTileSubAndComp : ∀ A k x : ℝ, 0 ≤ A →
      upperStripTile S A k x ⊆ horizStrip S.H ∧ IsCompact (upperStripTile S A k x) := by
    intro A k x hA
    have hSub : upperStripTile S A k x ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro s hs
      have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) := by positivity
      have hwd : Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) ≤ S.H - s.im := hs.2.1
      change |s.im| < S.H
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [hs.1, S.H_pos]
    have hwd_cont : Continuous (wallDepth S) := continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im
    have hClosed : IsClosed (upperStripTile S A k x) :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        ((isClosed_le continuous_const hwd_cont).inter
          ((isClosed_le hwd_cont continuous_const).inter
            (isClosed_le
              (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
              (continuous_const.mul hwd_cont))))
    have hBallSub : upperStripTile S A k x ⊆ Metric.closedBall (x : ℂ) ((A + 1) * S.H) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) := by positivity
      have hwd_pos : 0 < S.H - s.im := lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hs.2.1
      have hwd_le : wallDepth S s ≤ S.H := by

  exact ⟨hConj1, hConj2, hConj3⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hInt : BootInteriorTransferProp S)
    (β a C_N C₁ : ℝ) (hβ0 : 0 ≤ β) (hβhalf : β < 1 / 2)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hCN : 1 ≤ C_N) (hC1 : 0 < C₁)
    (D : BootConeNegativePartData S β a C_N C₁) :
    ∃ C_sub : ℝ, 0 < C_sub ∧
      ∀ (N : ℝ → ℝ) (ν : ℝ → ℝ) (M_t l : ℝ),
        IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
        Continuous ν →
        (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ν x) →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) = 1 →
        0 ≤ M_t →
        (∀ q : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ q →
          Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone q x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤ M_t * N q) →
        criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2) * ν x) ≤
          C_sub * (1 + M_t) ^ (4 * (2 - 1 / (1 + a)) / (4 - 1 / (1 + a)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hβhalf
  have _ := hC1
  have hβ_lt_β1 : β < D.β₁ := D.β_lt_β₁
  let δ : ℝ := (D.β₁ - β) / 2
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-(D.β₁ - β))
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.exp_pos _
  have hr_lt1 : r < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  have hr_ne1 : r ≠ 1 := ne_of_lt hr_lt1
  have h1r_pos : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
  have hCN_pos : 0 < C_N := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCN
  have hCdom_pos : 0 < D.C_dom := D.C_dom_pos
  have hCneg_pos : 0 < D.C_neg := D.C_neg_pos
  let K_sum : ℝ := C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) / (1 - r) ^ 2
  have hKsum_pos : 0 < K_sum := by dsimp [K_sum]; positivity
  let C_b2w : ℝ := 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (1 + K_sum)
  have hCb2w_pos : 0 < C_b2w := by dsimp [C_b2w]; positivity
  let C_sub : ℝ := D.C_neg * (C_b2w + 1)
  have hCsub_pos : 0 < C_sub := by dsimp [C_sub]; positivity
  let γ : ℝ := 1 / (1 + a)
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := by dsimp [γ]; positivity
  have hγ_lt1 : γ < 1 := by
    dsimp [γ]
    rw [div_lt_one (by linarith)]
    linarith
  let m : ℝ := 4 * (2 - γ) / (4 - γ)
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    dsimp [m]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hm_lt2 : m < 2 := by
    have h2m : 2 - m = 2 * γ / (4 - γ) := by
      dsimp [m]
      field_simp [show (4 - γ : ℝ) ≠ 0 by linarith]
      ring
    have h2m_pos : 0 < 2 - m := by
      rw [h2m]
      exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have h_geom : ∀ M : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M, r ^ n ≤ 1 / (1 - r) := by
    intro M
    have h_eq : (r ^ M - 1) / (r - 1) = (1 - r ^ M) / (1 - r) := by
      rw [div_eq_div_iff (by linarith) (by linarith)]
      ring
    rw [geom_sum_eq hr_ne1, h_eq]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [pow_pos hr_pos M]) h1r_pos.le
  refine ⟨C_sub, hCsub_pos, ?_⟩
  intro N ν M_t l hN hν_cont hν_nonneg hν_mean hMt hTile hl
  have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
  have h2pi_inv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h2pi_pos.le
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  have hNl_ge1 : 1 ≤ N l := hN.one_le l hl
  have hNl_pos : 0 < N l := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hNl_ge1
  have hNl_sq_pos : 0 < (N l) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hNl_pos
  have hAcone_nonneg : 0 ≤ D.A_cone := le_trans zero_le_one D.one_le_A_cone
  let q_lvl : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => max k₀ (l + 3 - (n : ℝ))
  have hq_ge_k0 : ∀ n : ℕ, k₀ ≤ q_lvl n := fun n => le_max_left _ _
  have hEnvSq : ∀ n : ℕ, (N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2 ≤
      C_N ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro n
    have hn_nonneg : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hNqn_nonneg : 0 ≤ N (q_lvl n) :=
      le_trans zero_le_one (hN.one_le (q_lvl n) (hq_ge_k0 n))
    have hEnv : N (q_lvl n) ≤ C_N * N l * Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ)) := by
      rcases le_total (q_lvl n) l with hqn_le | hl_le
      · have hc := hN.coarse_bound (q_lvl n) l (hq_ge_k0 n) hqn_le
        have hdiff : l - q_lvl n ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
          have : l + 3 - (n : ℝ) ≤ q_lvl n := le_max_right _ _
          linarith
        have hexp : Real.exp (β * (l - q_lvl n)) ≤ Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hβmul : β * (l - q_lvl n) ≤ β * (n : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff hβ0
          linarith
        exact le_trans hc (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity))
      · have hf := hN.fine_bound (q_lvl n) l hl hl_le
        have hdiff : q_lvl n - l ≤ 3 := by
          have hmax : q_lvl n ≤ l + 3 := max_le (by linarith [hl]) (by linarith)
          linarith
        have hexp : Real.exp (a * (q_lvl n - l)) ≤ Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ)) := by
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hamul : a * (q_lvl n - l) ≤ a * 3 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff ha.le
          have hβn : 0 ≤ β * (n : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hβ0 hn_nonneg
          linarith
        exact le_trans hf (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity))
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hNqn_nonneg hEnv 2
    have hexp2 : (Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 =
        Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    calc (N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2
        ≤ (C_N * N l * Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 := hsq
      _ = C_N ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 * (Real.exp (3 * a + β * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = C_N ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ)) := by rw [hexp2]
  let b : ℝ → ℝ := bootConeCost S D.δ_b D.L D.β₁ N l
  obtain ⟨hb_cont, _, hb_ge1⟩ := D.cone_cost_props N hN l hl
  have hb_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ b x := fun x => le_trans zero_le_one (hb_ge1 x)
  let M_lvl : ℕ := Nat.ceil (l - k₀) + 5
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-δ * (n : ℝ))
  let v : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n x =>
    Real.exp (3 * D.β₁ - (β + δ) * (n : ℝ)) *
      (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x / N l)
  have huv_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
       Real.exp (-D.β₁ * ((n : ℝ) - 3)) *
        (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x / N l) = u n * v n x := by
    intro n x
    dsimp [u, v]
    have hexp_eq : Real.exp (-D.β₁ * ((n : ℝ) - 3)) =
        Real.exp (-δ * (n : ℝ)) * Real.exp (3 * D.β₁ - (β + δ) * (n : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp [δ]
      ring
    rw [hexp_eq]
    ring
  have hu_sq : ∀ n : ℕ, (u n) ^ 2 = r ^ n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [u, r]
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    dsimp [δ]
    ring
  have hsum_u_sq : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (u n) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (1 - r) := by
    have h_congr : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (u n) ^ 2 = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, r ^ n :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => hu_sq n)
    rw [h_congr]
    exact h_geom M_lvl
  have hb2_pt : ∀ x : ℝ, (b x) ^ 2 * ν x ≤
      2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ν x +
        (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x := by
    intro x
    have hdom : b x ≤ D.C_dom * (1 + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, u n * v n x) := by
      have hd := D.cone_cost_tile_dom N hN l x hl
      have hsum_eq :
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
            Real.exp (-D.β₁ * ((n : ℝ) - 3)) *
              (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x / N l)) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, u n * v n x :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => huv_eq n x)
      dsimp [b, M_lvl, q_lvl, k₀] at hsum_eq ⊢
      rw [← hsum_eq]
      exact hd
    let Sx : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, u n * v n x
    have hb_sq : (b x) ^ 2 ≤ D.C_dom ^ 2 * (1 + Sx) ^ 2 := by
      calc (b x) ^ 2 ≤ (D.C_dom * (1 + Sx)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (hb_nonneg x) hdom 2
        _ = D.C_dom ^ 2 * (1 + Sx) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h1Sx : (1 + Sx) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + Sx ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - Sx)]
    have hcs : Sx ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 := by
      calc Sx ^ 2
          ≤ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (u n) ^ 2) *
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.range M_lvl) u (fun n => v n x)
        _ ≤ (1 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum_u_sq
              (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun n _ => sq_nonneg (v n x)))
    have hb_sq2 : (b x) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 + (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 := by
      calc (b x) ^ 2
          ≤ D.C_dom ^ 2 * (2 * (1 + Sx ^ 2)) :=
            le_trans hb_sq (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1Sx (sq_nonneg D.C_dom))
        _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 + 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * Sx ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 +
              2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ((1 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2) :=
            add_le_add le_rfl
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcs (by positivity))
        _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 +
              (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb_sq2 (hν_nonneg x)
    calc (b x) ^ 2 * ν x
        ≤ (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 +
            (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2) * ν x := hmul
      _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ν x +
            (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2) * ν x) := by
          ring
      _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ν x +
            (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  have hv_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) := by
    intro n
    have htc : Continuous (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n)) :=
      (hInt.tile_cont_per D.A_cone (q_lvl n) hAcone_nonneg (hq_ge_k0 n)).1
    have hvc : Continuous (v n) :=
      continuous_const.mul (htc.div_const (N l))
    exact (hvc.pow 2).mul hν_cont
  have hsum_v_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ (fun n _ => hv_cont n)
  have hb2_int_le :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
      2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
        (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x := by
    have h_int_lhs : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (b x) ^ 2 * ν x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      ((hb_cont.pow 2).mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_r1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ν x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_r2 : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul hsum_v_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hm_int : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ν x +
            (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int_lhs (h_int_r1.add h_int_r2)
        (fun x _ => hb2_pt x)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int_r1 h_int_r2,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum
        (fun n _ => (hv_cont n).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))] at hm_int
    exact hm_int
  have hv_term_bound : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
        (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a)) * r ^ n := by
    intro n
    let c_n : ℝ := (Real.exp (3 * D.β₁ - (β + δ) * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 / (N l) ^ 2
    have hcn_nonneg : 0 ≤ c_n := by dsimp [c_n]; positivity
    have hv_rewrite : (fun x : ℝ => (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) =
        (fun x : ℝ => c_n * ((tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x)) := by
      ext x
      dsimp [v, c_n]
      ring
    have h_tile_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x :=
      mul_nonneg h2pi_inv_nonneg
        (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg h2pi_pos.le
          (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hν_nonneg x)))
    have h_tile_sq : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
        M_t ^ 2 * (N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2 := by
      have h_sqrt := hTile (q_lvl n) (hq_ge_k0 n)
      have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h_sqrt 2
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_tile_nonneg] at hsq
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x
          ≤ (M_t * N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2 := hsq
        _ = M_t ^ 2 * (N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hexp_rn : (Real.exp (3 * D.β₁ - (β + δ) * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 *
        Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ)) =
        Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) * r ^ n := by
      dsimp [r]
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp [δ]
      ring
    rw [hv_rewrite, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (c_n * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x)
        = c_n * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S D.A_cone (q_lvl n) x) ^ 2 * ν x) := by ring
      _ ≤ c_n * (M_t ^ 2 * (N (q_lvl n)) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tile_sq hcn_nonneg
      _ ≤ c_n * (M_t ^ 2 * (C_N ^ 2 * (N l) ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ)))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hEnvSq n) (sq_nonneg M_t)) hcn_nonneg
      _ = M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 *
            ((Real.exp (3 * D.β₁ - (β + δ) * (n : ℝ))) ^ 2 *
              Real.exp (6 * a + 2 * β * (n : ℝ))) := by
          dsimp [c_n]
          field_simp [hNl_sq_pos.ne']
      _ = (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a)) * r ^ n := by
          rw [hexp_rn]
          ring
  have hsum_v_bound :
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
      M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) / (1 - r) := by
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x)
        ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
            (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a)) * r ^ n :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n _ => hv_term_bound n)
      _ = (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a)) *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, r ^ n :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a)) * (1 / (1 - r)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_geom M_lvl) (by positivity)
      _ = M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) / (1 - r) := by ring
  let Λ : ℝ := 1 + M_t
  have hΛ_pos : 0 < Λ := by dsimp [Λ]; linarith
  have hb_L2 :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x) ≤
      C_b2w * Λ ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2_int_le h2pi_inv_nonneg
    have h_rhs_rw :
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
          (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) =
        2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
          (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x := by
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
              (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
                ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x)
          = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
              (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
                ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
                  ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x) := by
            ring
        _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) +
              (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
                ∑ n ∈ Finset.range M_lvl,
                  (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (v n x) ^ 2 * ν x := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [h_rhs_rw, hν_mean, mul_one] at hmul
    have h_step :
        2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 +
          (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
            (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) / (1 - r)) =
        2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (1 + K_sum * M_t ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [K_sum]
      field_simp [h1r_pos.ne']
    have h_quad : 1 + K_sum * M_t ^ 2 ≤ (1 + K_sum) * Λ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [Λ]
      nlinarith [hKsum_pos.le, hMt, mul_nonneg hKsum_pos.le hMt]
    have hcoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r) := by positivity
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x)
        ≤ 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 +
            (2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 / (1 - r)) *
              (M_t ^ 2 * C_N ^ 2 * Real.exp (6 * D.β₁ + 6 * a) / (1 - r)) :=
          le_trans hmul
            (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_v_bound hcoef_nonneg))
      _ = 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * (1 + K_sum * M_t ^ 2) := h_step
      _ ≤ 2 * D.C_dom ^ 2 * ((1 + K_sum) * Λ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_quad (by positivity)
      _ = C_b2w * Λ ^ 2 := by dsimp [C_b2w]; ring
  have hΛm_pos : 0 < Λ ^ m := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hΛ_pos m
  have hbm_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (b x) ^ m * ν x) :=
    (hb_cont.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hm_pos.le)).mul hν_cont
  have hbm_pt : ∀ x : ℝ, (b x) ^ m * ν x ≤
      (Λ ^ m * (m / 2) / Λ ^ 2) * ((b x) ^ 2 * ν x) +
        (Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2)) * ν x := by
    intro x
    have hbx : 0 ≤ b x := hb_nonneg x
    have hdiv_nonneg : 0 ≤ b x / Λ := div_nonneg hbx hΛ_pos.le
    have h_amgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted
      (show 0 ≤ m / 2 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 1 - m / 2 by linarith)
      (sq_nonneg (b x / Λ)) zero_le_one (by ring)
    rw [Real.one_rpow, mul_one, ← Real.rpow_two (b x / Λ),
      ← Real.rpow_mul hdiv_nonneg, show (2 : ℝ) * (m / 2) = m by ring,
      Real.div_rpow hbx hΛ_pos.le m, Real.rpow_two (b x / Λ)] at h_amgm
    have h1 : (b x) ^ m ≤ ((m / 2) * (b x / Λ) ^ 2 + (1 - m / 2) * 1) * Λ ^ m :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hΛm_pos).mp h_amgm
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (hν_nonneg x)
    calc (b x) ^ m * ν x
        ≤ ((m / 2) * (b x / Λ) ^ 2 + (1 - m / 2) * 1) * Λ ^ m * ν x := h2
      _ = (Λ ^ m * (m / 2) / Λ ^ 2) * ((b x) ^ 2 * ν x) +
            (Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2)) * ν x := by
          rw [div_pow]
          ring
  have hb_Lm :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ m * ν x) ≤
      (C_b2w + 1) * Λ ^ m := by
    let c1 : ℝ := Λ ^ m * (m / 2) / Λ ^ 2
    let c2 : ℝ := Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2)
    have hc1_nonneg : 0 ≤ c1 := by dsimp [c1]; positivity
    have h_int_lhs : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (b x) ^ m * ν x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hbm_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_r1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => c1 * ((b x) ^ 2 * ν x))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul ((hb_cont.pow 2).mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_r2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => c2 * ν x)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (continuous_const.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hm_int : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ m * ν x) ≤
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (c1 * ((b x) ^ 2 * ν x) + c2 * ν x) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int_lhs (h_int_r1.add h_int_r2)
        (fun x _ => hbm_pt x)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int_r1 h_int_r2,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hm_int
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_int h2pi_inv_nonneg
    have h_lin : Λ ^ m * (m / 2) * C_b2w + Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2) ≤ (C_b2w + 1) * Λ ^ m := by
      have h_diff : (C_b2w + 1) * Λ ^ m - (Λ ^ m * (m / 2) * C_b2w + Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2)) =
          Λ ^ m * ((1 - m / 2) * C_b2w + m / 2) := by ring
      have h_inner_pos : 0 ≤ (1 - m / 2) * C_b2w + m / 2 :=
        add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hCb2w_pos.le) (by linarith)
      linarith [mul_nonneg hΛm_pos.le h_inner_pos]
    calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ m * ν x)
        ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (c1 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x) +
            c2 * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x)) := hmul
      _ = c1 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ 2 * ν x) +
            c2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) := by ring
      _ ≤ c1 * (C_b2w * Λ ^ 2) + c2 * 1 := by
          rw [hν_mean]
          exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb_L2 hc1_nonneg) le_rfl
      _ = Λ ^ m * (m / 2) * C_b2w + Λ ^ m * (1 - m / 2) := by
          dsimp [c1, c2]
          field_simp [hΛ_pos.ne']
      _ ≤ (C_b2w + 1) * Λ ^ m := h_lin
  have hRowMem : ∀ x : ℝ, bootRowPt S l x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro x
    have hlog : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ l :=
      le_trans (le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))) hl
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-l) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      calc Real.exp (-l) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) :=
            Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-l) := Real.exp_pos (-l)
    have him : (bootRowPt S l x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-l) := by
      dsimp [bootRowPt]
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    change |(bootRowPt S l x).im| < S.H
    rw [him, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hLhsCont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      (Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2) * ν x) := by
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => bootRowPt S l x) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hVim_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) :=
      Complex.continuous_im.comp (S.V_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont hRowMem)
    exact (((continuous_const.mul (hVim_cont.max continuous_const)).div_const ((N l) ^ 2)).mul
      hν_cont)
  have h_int_target : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2) * ν x)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    hLhsCont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  have h_int_rhs : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => D.C_neg * ((b x) ^ m * ν x))
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
    (continuous_const.mul hbm_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  have h_mono_final :
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2) * ν x) ≤
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), D.C_neg * ((b x) ^ m * ν x) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h2pi_pos.le h_int_target h_int_rhs (fun x _ => ?_)
    have hsub := D.subquad_neg_part N hN l x hl
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsub (hν_nonneg x)
    dsimp [b, m, γ] at hmul ⊢
    linarith
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_mono_final
  have hmul_final := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono_final h2pi_inv_nonneg
  calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (Real.exp (-l) * max ((S.V (bootRowPt S l x)).im) 0 / (N l) ^ 2) * ν x)
      ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (D.C_neg * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ m * ν x) :=
        hmul_final
    _ = D.C_neg * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (b x) ^ m * ν x) := by ring
    _ ≤ D.C_neg * ((C_b2w + 1) * Λ ^ m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb_Lm hCneg_pos.le
    _ = C_sub * (1 + M_t) ^ (4 * (2 - 1 / (1 + a)) / (4 - 1 / (1 + a))) := by
        dsimp [C_sub, Λ, m, γ]
        ring

    (k_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ)

      0 < ε_seq n ∧ 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n))

        C_tail' h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq

proof.tactics:
by
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  let δ_b : ℝ := (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀)
  have hk₀_pos_exp : 0 < Real.exp (-k₀) := Real.exp_pos (-k₀)
  have hexp_k₀_le : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have hk₀_ge : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k₀ := le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))
    have hSH20_pos : 0 < S.H / 20 := by linarith [S.H_pos]
    calc
      Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log hSH20_pos
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_b := by positivity
  have hδ_le : δ_b ≤ S.H / 80 := by
    have h_def : δ_b = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀) := rfl
    linarith
  have hδ_53_lt : (5 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_b < S.H := by linarith [S.H_pos]
  have hδ_72_lt_exp : (7 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b < Real.exp (-k₀) := by
    have h_def : δ_b = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-k₀) := rfl
    linarith
  have hδ_72_lt_H : (7 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b < S.H := by linarith [S.H_pos]
  let d_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-k_seq n)
  let B_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)
  let m_approx : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n D =>
    rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D) / (B_seq n * D)
  have hd_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < d_seq n := fun n => Real.exp_pos (-k_seq n)
  have hB_ge_one : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ B_seq n := fun n => (h_basic n).2.2
  have hB_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < B_seq n := fun n => lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hB_ge_one n)
  have hE_nonneg : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ steepRowEnergy S y := by
    intro y
    unfold steepRowEnergy
    apply mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le)
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le
      (fun x _ => by positivity)
  have h_exp_shift : ∀ (n : ℕ) {D : ℝ}, 0 < D →
      Real.exp (-(k_seq n - Real.log D)) = d_seq n * D := by
    intro n D hD
    have h1 : -(k_seq n - Real.log D) = -k_seq n + Real.log D := by ring
    rw [h1, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log hD]
  have hm_approx_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) {D : ℝ}, 0 < D →
      m_approx n D =
        (d_seq n / B_seq n) * Real.sqrt (steepRowEnergy S (S.H - d_seq n * D)) := by
    intro n D hD
    have hrow : rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D) =
        (d_seq n * D) * Real.sqrt (steepRowEnergy S (S.H - d_seq n * D)) := by
      unfold rowMomentFull
      simp_rw [h_exp_shift n hD]
      rfl
    dsimp only [m_approx]
    rw [hrow]
    have hB_ne : B_seq n ≠ 0 := (hB_pos n).ne'
    have hD_ne : D ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
    field_simp [hB_ne, hD_ne]
  have hm_approx_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℕ) {D : ℝ}, 0 < D → 0 ≤ m_approx n D := by
    intro n D hD
    rw [hm_approx_eq n hD]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hd_pos n).le (hB_pos n).le) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h_energy_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) {D : ℝ}, 0 < D →
      steepRowEnergy S (S.H - d_seq n * D) =
        ((B_seq n / d_seq n) * m_approx n D) ^ 2 := by
    intro n D hD
    have h_sqrt : (B_seq n / d_seq n) * m_approx n D =
        Real.sqrt (steepRowEnergy S (S.H - d_seq n * D)) := by
      rw [hm_approx_eq n hD]
      have hd_ne : d_seq n ≠ 0 := (hd_pos n).ne'
      have hB_ne : B_seq n ≠ 0 := (hB_pos n).ne'
      field_simp [hd_ne, hB_ne]
    rw [h_sqrt, Real.sq_sqrt (hE_nonneg (S.H - d_seq n * D))]
  have h_energy_ratio : ∀ (n : ℕ) {D₁ D₂ : ℝ}, 0 < D₁ → 0 < D₂ → m_approx n D₁ ≠ 0 →
      steepRowEnergy S (S.H - d_seq n * D₂) /
        ((B_seq n / d_seq n) * m_approx n D₁) ^ 2 =
        (m_approx n D₂ / m_approx n D₁) ^ 2 := by
    intro n D₁ D₂ _ hD₂ hm₁_ne
    rw [h_energy_eq n hD₂]
    have hd_ne : d_seq n ≠ 0 := (hd_pos n).ne'
    have hB_ne : B_seq n ≠ 0 := (hB_pos n).ne'
    field_simp [hd_ne, hB_ne, hm₁_ne]
  obtain ⟨x_st, P_st, C_tail, hC_tail, h_xp, _hx_top, hP_top, h_loc_unif, h_tail⟩ :=
    hSteep.exists_data
  let R : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)
  let δ_st : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
    (16 * Real.exp 2 * (2 * Real.exp 1 + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹
  have hR_ge_four : ∀ j : ℕ, 4 ≤ R j := by
    intro j
    dsimp only [R]
    linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j]
  have hδ_st_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < δ_st j := fun j => by
    dsimp only [δ_st]
    positivity
  have hδ_st_le : ∀ j : ℕ, δ_st j ≤ 1 / 48 := by
    intro j
    have he1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
    have he2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 2 := Real.one_le_exp (by norm_num)
    have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg j
    have h_f12 : (48 : ℝ) ≤ 16 * Real.exp 2 * (2 * Real.exp 1 + 1) := by nlinarith
    have h_den : (48 : ℝ) ≤ 16 * Real.exp 2 * (2 * Real.exp 1 + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
      nlinarith
    have h_inv := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 48) h_den
    dsimp only [δ_st]
    linarith
  have h_stage1 : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ k : ℕ,
      3 * ((j : ℝ) + 3) < P_st k ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-R j) (R j),
        |m (Real.exp (x_st k) * (1 - u / P_st k)) / m (Real.exp (x_st k)) - Real.exp u| <
          δ_st j := by
    intro j
    have ev1 : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, 3 * ((j : ℝ) + 3) < P_st k :=
      hP_top.eventually (Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (3 * ((j : ℝ) + 3)))
    have h_unif := tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact.mp h_loc_unif
      (Set.Icc (-R j) (R j)) isCompact_Icc
    have ev2_raw := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp h_unif (δ_st j) (hδ_st_pos j)
    have ev2 : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-R j) (R j),
        |m (Real.exp (x_st k) * (1 - u / P_st k)) / m (Real.exp (x_st k)) - Real.exp u| <
          δ_st j := by
      filter_upwards [ev2_raw] with k hk u hu
      have h_dist := hk u hu
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h_dist
      exact h_dist
    exact (ev1.and ev2).exists
  choose κ hκ using h_stage1
  let D_star : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => Real.exp (x_st (κ j))
  let P_star : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => P_st (κ j)
  let m_star : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => m (D_star j)

      have h_inv_pos : 0 < (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ := by positivity
      have h_alg : (2 * δ_st j) * (2 * Real.exp 1 + 1) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ := by
        dsimp only [δ_st]
        have he1_ne : 2 * Real.exp 1 + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        have he2_ne : Real.exp 2 ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos 2).ne'
        have hj1_ne : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [he1_ne, he2_ne, hj1_ne]
        ring
      calc
        x_u ^ 2 - Real.exp (2 * u) = x_u ^ 2 - (Real.exp u) ^ 2 := by rw [hexp_sq]
        _ = (x_u - Real.exp u) * (x_u + Real.exp u) := by ring
        _ ≤ |x_u - Real.exp u| * (x_u + Real.exp u) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hsum_nonneg
        _ ≤ (2 * δ_st j) * (2 * Real.exp 1 + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul hx_err hsum_le hsum_nonneg (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ := h_alg
        _ ≤ (4 * Real.exp 2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1))⁻¹ := by linarith
    linarith
  have h_local_band : ∀ j : ℕ,
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)) (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2)),
        |h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u| < S.H ∧
        steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j + ℓ_seq j * u) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
          2 * Real.exp (2 * |u|) + 1 := by
    intro j u hu
    have hu_R : u ∈ Set.Icc (-R j) (R j) := by
      refine ⟨?_, hu.2⟩
      dsimp only [R]
      linarith [hu.1]
    obtain ⟨h_strip, h_sq, hx_nonneg, hx_err⟩ := h_band_core j hu_R
    refine ⟨h_strip, ?_⟩
    rw [h_sq]
    let x_u : ℝ := m_approx (ν j) (D_star j * (1 - u / P_star j)) /
      m_approx (ν j) (D_star j)
    change x_u ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (2 * |u|) + 1
    have hx_le : x_u ≤ Real.exp |u| + 1 / 4 := by
      have h1 : x_u - Real.exp u ≤ 2 * δ_st j := (abs_le.mp hx_err).2
      have h2 : Real.exp u ≤ Real.exp |u| := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_abs_self u)
      have h3 : δ_st j ≤ 1 / 48 := hδ_st_le j
      linarith
    have hexp_sq : (Real.exp |u|) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * |u|) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, ← two_mul]
    have h_sq_le : x_u ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp |u| + 1 / 4) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have h_young : (Real.exp |u| + 1 / 4) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Real.exp |u|) ^ 2 + 1 / 8 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.exp |u| - 1 / 4)]
    rw [hexp_sq] at h_young
    linarith
  have h_coarse_tail : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → ℓ_seq j * v ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b →
      |h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v| < S.H ∧
      steepRowEnergy S (h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v) / (m0_seq j) ^ 2 ≤
        C_tail' * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
    intro j v hv hℓv
    let n := ν j
    let D_v : ℝ := D_star j * (1 + v / P_star j)
    have hP_pos := hP_star_pos j
    have hP_ge := hP_star_ge_one j
    have hD_pos := hD_star_pos j
    have hD_ge := hD_star_ge_one j
    have hm_pos_j := hm_star_pos j
    have hd_n := hd_pos n
    have hB_n := hB_pos n
    have hvP_nonneg : 0 ≤ v / P_star j := div_nonneg hv hP_pos.le
    have hDv_ge_D : D_star j ≤ D_v := by
      dsimp only [D_v]
      nlinarith
    have hDv_ge_one : 1 ≤ D_v := le_trans hD_ge hDv_ge_D
    have hDv_pos : 0 < D_v := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hDv_ge_one
    have hlogDv_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log D_v := Real.log_nonneg hDv_ge_one
    have hy_eq : h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v = S.H - d_seq n * D_v := by
      dsimp only [h_seq, ℓ_seq, D_v, n]
      field_simp [hP_pos.ne']
      ring
    have hdDv_eq : d_seq n * D_v = d_seq n * D_star j + ℓ_seq j * v := by
      dsimp only [ℓ_seq, D_v, n]
      field_simp [hP_pos.ne']
    have hdDv_pos : 0 < d_seq n * D_v := mul_pos hd_n hDv_pos
    have hdDv_lt_72 : d_seq n * D_v < (7 / 2 : ℝ) * δ_b := by
      have h1 := hdD_lt_δ j
      linarith [hdDv_eq]
    have h_strip : |h_seq j - ℓ_seq j * v| < S.H := by
      rw [hy_eq]
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith [hδ_72_lt_H]⟩
    have h_thresh : criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n - Real.log D_v := by
      have h_lt_exp : d_seq n * D_v < Real.exp (-k₀) := lt_trans hdDv_lt_72 hδ_72_lt_exp
      have h_log := Real.log_lt_log hdDv_pos h_lt_exp
      rw [Real.log_mul hd_n.ne' hDv_pos.ne'] at h_log
      dsimp only [d_seq] at h_log
      rw [Real.log_exp (-k_seq n), Real.log_exp (-k₀)] at h_log
      change k₀ ≤ k_seq n - Real.log D_v
      linarith
    have hm_approx_pos := hm_approx_star_pos j
    have hm_ge := (hm_approx_star_gt j).le
    have h1v_pos : 0 < 1 + v := by linarith
    have h_unsquared :
        m_approx n D_v / m_approx n (D_star j) ≤
          3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hm_approx_pos]
      rcases le_or_gt v (V_cut j) with hv_le | hv_gt
      · have hDv_hi : D_v ≤ D_star j * (1 + V_cut j / P_star j) := by
          have hvP_le : v / P_star j ≤ V_cut j / P_star j :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hv_le hP_pos.le
          dsimp only [D_v]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hD_pos.le
        have hDv_mem : D_v ∈ I_set j :=
          ⟨le_trans (by linarith : (1 / 3 : ℝ) * D_star j ≤ D_star j) hDv_ge_D,
           le_trans hDv_hi (le_max_right _ _)⟩
        have herr_v : m_approx n D_v - m D_v ≤ η_tail j := by
          have h_abs := (hν j).2.2.2 D_v hDv_mem
          exact le_trans (abs_lt.mp h_abs).2.le (min_le_right _ _)
        have hm_tail : m D_v ≤ m_star j * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          have h_raw := (div_le_iff₀ hm_pos_j).mp (h_tail (κ j) v hv)
          dsimp only [D_v, D_star, P_star, m_star] at h_raw ⊢
          linarith
        have hrpow_mono : (1 + V_cut j) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) ≤ (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          have h1V_pos : 0 < 1 + V_cut j := by linarith [hV_cut_pos j]
          rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1V_pos, Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1v_pos]
          apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
          have hlog_le : Real.log (1 + v) ≤ Real.log (1 + V_cut j) :=
            Real.log_le_log h1v_pos (by linarith)
          linarith
        have hη_le : η_tail j ≤
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          dsimp only [η_tail]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrpow_mono (by positivity)
        have hm_v_le : m_approx n D_v ≤
            (3 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          linarith
        have h3C_nonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1v_pos _).le
        calc
          m_approx n D_v ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := hm_v_le
          _ = (3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j) := by ring
          _ ≤ (3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) * m_approx n (D_star j) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_ge h3C_nonneg
      · have h_norm_v := h_norm n (k_seq n - Real.log D_v) h_thresh
        have habs_eq : |(k_seq n - Real.log D_v) - k_seq n| = Real.log D_v := by
          have h_sub : (k_seq n - Real.log D_v) - k_seq n = -Real.log D_v := by ring
          rw [h_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hlogDv_nonneg]
        rw [habs_eq] at h_norm_v
        have hε_lt : ε_seq n < 1 / 8 := (hν j).2.1
        have hexp_le : Real.exp (ε_seq n * Real.log D_v) ≤
            Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
        have hrow_le : rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D_v) ≤
            B_seq n * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) :=
          le_trans h_norm_v (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le hB_n.le)
        have hm_exp_78 : m_approx n D_v ≤ Real.exp (-(7 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) := by
          dsimp only [m_approx]
          have h_div_exp : Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) / D_v =
              Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v - Real.log D_v) := by
            rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hDv_pos]
          calc
            rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D_v) / (B_seq n * D_v) ≤
                (B_seq n * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v)) / (B_seq n * D_v) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrow_le (mul_pos hB_n hDv_pos).le
            _ = Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) / D_v :=
              mul_div_mul_left _ _ hB_n.ne'
            _ = Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v - Real.log D_v) := h_div_exp
            _ = Real.exp (-(7 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) :=
              congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
        have hDv_lb : (1 + v) / P_star j ≤ D_v := by
          have h1 : (1 + v) / P_star j ≤ (P_star j + v) / P_star j :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hP_pos.le
          have h2 : (P_star j + v) / P_star j = 1 + v / P_star j := by
            rw [add_div, div_self hP_pos.ne']
          have h3 : 1 + v / P_star j ≤ D_v := by
            dsimp only [D_v]
            nlinarith
          linarith
        have hlog_Dv_lb : Real.log (1 + v) - Real.log (P_star j) ≤ Real.log D_v := by
          have h_log := Real.log_le_log (div_pos h1v_pos hP_pos) hDv_lb
          rwa [Real.log_div h1v_pos.ne' hP_pos.ne'] at h_log
        have hL_le : L_cut j ≤ Real.log (1 + v) := by
          have h_lt : Real.exp (L_cut j) < 1 + v := by
            change V_cut j < 1 + v
            linarith
          have h_log := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos (L_cut j)) h_lt.le
          rwa [Real.log_exp] at h_log
        have hL_def :
            (7 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (P_star j) -
              4 * Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) ≤ L_cut j :=
          le_max_right _ _
        have h_lin : -(7 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v ≤
            Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) +
              Real.log (1 + v) * (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          linarith
        have hm_v_le : m_approx n D_v ≤
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
          have h_half_pos : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail := by positivity
          calc
            m_approx n D_v ≤ Real.exp (-(7 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.log D_v) := hm_exp_78
            _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) +
                  Real.log (1 + v) * (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) :=
              Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_lin
            _ = Real.exp (Real.log ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail)) *
                  Real.exp (Real.log (1 + v) * (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) := Real.exp_add _ _
            _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
              rw [Real.exp_log h_half_pos, ← Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1v_pos]
        have hrpow_pos : 0 < (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h1v_pos _
        have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_nonneg hC_tail.le hrpow_pos.le
        calc
          m_approx n D_v ≤
              ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j * C_tail) * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := hm_v_le
          _ = (C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m_star j) := by ring
          _ ≤ (C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) * m_approx n (D_star j) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_ge hC_nonneg
          _ ≤ (3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) * m_approx n (D_star j) := by
            have h1 : C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) ≤
                3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
              nlinarith [hC_tail, hrpow_pos]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hm_approx_pos.le
    refine ⟨h_strip, ?_⟩
    rw [hy_eq, h_energy_ratio n hD_pos hDv_pos hm_approx_pos.ne']
    have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ m_approx n D_v / m_approx n (D_star j) :=
      div_nonneg (hm_approx_nonneg n hDv_pos) hm_approx_pos.le
    have hrpow_sq : ((1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) ^ 2 = (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1v_pos (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)),
        Real.rpow_def_of_pos h1v_pos (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)), sq, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc
      (m_approx n D_v / m_approx n (D_star j)) ^ 2 ≤
          (3 * C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith
      _ = 9 * C_tail ^ 2 * ((1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ))) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = C_tail' * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hrpow_sq]
  exact ⟨C_tail', h_seq, ℓ_seq, m0_seq,
    ⟨by positivity, h_row_basic, hh_tendsto, hℓ_tendsto, hprod_tendsto,
      hratio_tendsto, h_unit_band, h_local_band, h_coarse_tail⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (δ_b C_tail' : ℝ) (h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hδ_pos : 0 < δ_b) (hδ_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2)
    (hDiag : SteepDiagonalRowData S δ_b C_tail' h_seq ℓ_seq m0_seq) :
    ∃ x_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ,
      let ℱ_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun j Z =>
        ((m_seq j)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
          S.f ((x_seq j : ℂ) + (h_seq j : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq j : ℂ) * Z)
      let 𝒬_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun j Z =>
        (((m_seq j) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
          S.q ((x_seq j : ℂ) + (h_seq j : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq j : ℂ) * Z)
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 < m_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun j => ℓ_seq j * m_seq j) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ‖ℱ_seq j 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j 0‖ = 1) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun j => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
              ℱ_seq j (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ^ 2 +
            ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
              𝒬_seq j (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1) ∧
      (∀ R : ℕ, 1 ≤ R → ∃ M_R : ℝ, 0 < M_R ∧ ∃ N_R : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N_R,
        (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2),
          (x_seq j : ℂ) + (h_seq j : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq j : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H) ∧
        (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 1),
          ‖ℱ_seq j Z‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j Z‖ ≤ M_R)) ∧
      (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N_L : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N_L, ∀ s : ℂ,
        ℓ_seq j ≤ h_seq j - s.im →
        h_seq j - s.im ≤ δ_b →
        |s.re - x_seq j| ≤ L * (h_seq j - s.im) →
        shapeModulus S s ≤ C_L * m_seq j * (ℓ_seq j / (h_seq j - s.im)) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ))

        rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, hn1, norm_mul, hn2, hφ_eq, hΦ_def]

      have hU_mean : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), U_fn j x) ≤

  obtain ⟨B_cone, J_cone, hB_cone_pos, hCone⟩ : ∃ (B_cone : ℕ → ℝ) (J_cone : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),

    intro j L hL_ge

      calc Φ s = 1 * Φ s := (one_mul _).symm
        _ = (((h_seq j - s.im) / ℓ_seq j) ^ (9 / 8 : ℝ) *
              ((ℓ_seq j / (h_seq j - s.im)) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ)) ^ 2) * Φ s := by rw [hpow_cancel]
        _ = (((h_seq j - s.im) / ℓ_seq j) ^ (9 / 8 : ℝ) * Φ s) *
              ((ℓ_seq j / (h_seq j - s.im)) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (C_L ^ 2 * (m_seq j) ^ 2) * ((ℓ_seq j / (h_seq j - s.im)) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ)) ^ 2 := hm_mul
        _ = RHS ^ 2 := by dsimp only [RHS]; ring
    dsimp only [shapeModulus]
    rw [hΦ_def s] at hΦ_le_RHS
    refine max_le ?_ ?_
    · have hf_sq : ‖S.f s‖ ^ 2 ≤ RHS ^ 2 := by linarith [norm_nonneg (S.q s)]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (S.f s)]
    · have hq_sq : (Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖) ^ 2 ≤ RHS ^ 2 := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg (S.q s))]
        linarith [sq_nonneg ‖S.f s‖]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg ‖S.q s‖]

(ℱ_seq 𝒬_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (b_seq : ℕ → ℝ)

    (h_orig : ∀ j : ℕ, ‖ℱ_seq j 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j 0‖ = 1)
    (h_circ : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun j => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
            ℱ_seq j (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ^ 2 +
          ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
            𝒬_seq j (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 1))
    (h_balls : ∀ R : ℕ, 1 ≤ R → ∃ M_R : ℝ, 0 < M_R ∧ ∃ N_R : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N_R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝒬_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((R : ℝ) + 1),
        ‖ℱ_seq j Z‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j Z‖ ≤ M_R) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq j)) Z = (b_seq j : ℂ) ^ 2 * 𝒬_seq j Z * ℱ_seq j Z)) :
    ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (c₀ : ℂ),
      StrictMono σ ∧
      c₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      ((TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n Z => ℱ_seq (σ n) Z)
          (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n Z => 𝒬_seq (σ n) Z)
          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop) ∨

          (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop ∧
        TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n Z => 𝒬_seq (σ n) Z)
          (fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop))
