proof.tactics:
by
  
  let K : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun m => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((m : ℝ) + 1)
  have h_balls_m : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M_R : ℝ, 0 < M_R ∧ ∃ N_R : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N_R,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝒬_seq j) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1),
        ‖ℱ_seq j Z‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq j Z‖ ≤ M_R) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1,
        deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq j)) Z = (b_seq j : ℂ) ^ 2 * 𝒬_seq j Z * ℱ_seq j Z) :=
    fun m => h_balls (m + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le m))
  choose M_fn hM_pos N_fn hN_spec using h_balls_m

  have h_lip_pair : ∀ (m j : ℕ), N_fn m ≤ j → ∀ x ∈ K m, ∀ y ∈ K m,
      ‖ℱ_seq j y - ℱ_seq j x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (M_fn m) * ‖y - x‖ ∧
      ‖𝒬_seq j y - 𝒬_seq j x‖ ≤ M_fn m * ‖y - x‖ := by
    intro m j hj
    obtain ⟨hℱ_d, h𝒬_d, h_bd, _⟩ := hN_spec m j hj
    have hcb_sub_ball : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) ⊆
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      linarith
    have hK_sub_ball : K m ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro z hz
      apply hcb_sub_ball
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz ⊢
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_deriv_bd : ∀ w ∈ K m,
        ‖deriv (ℱ_seq j) w‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (M_fn m) ∧ ‖deriv (𝒬_seq j) w‖ ≤ M_fn m := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1 := by
        simpa [K, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hw
      have hcl_sub_cb : Metric.closedBall w 1 ⊆
          Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        have hzw : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - w‖ + ‖w‖ := by
          simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using norm_add_le (z - w) w
        push_cast
        linarith
      have h_sub_open : Metric.closedBall w 1 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) :=
        Subset.trans hcl_sub_cb hcb_sub_ball
      have hℱ_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (ℱ_seq j) (Metric.ball w 1) :=
        ⟨hℱ_d.mono (Subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h_sub_open),
         (hℱ_d.mono (by rw [closure_ball w one_ne_zero]; exact h_sub_open)).continuousOn⟩
      have h𝒬_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (𝒬_seq j) (Metric.ball w 1) :=
        ⟨h𝒬_d.mono (Subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h_sub_open),
         (h𝒬_d.mono (by rw [closure_ball w one_ne_zero]; exact h_sub_open)).continuousOn⟩
      have hℱ_sph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere w 1, ‖ℱ_seq j z‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (M_fn m) := by
        intro z hz
        have h1 := h_bd z (hcl_sub_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
        exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith [norm_nonneg (𝒬_seq j z)])
      have h𝒬_sph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere w 1, ‖𝒬_seq j z‖ ≤ M_fn m := by
        intro z hz
        have h1 := h_bd z (hcl_sub_cb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))
        linarith [sq_nonneg ‖ℱ_seq j z‖]
      have hdℱ := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le one_pos hℱ_dc hℱ_sph
      have hd𝒬 := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le one_pos h𝒬_dc h𝒬_sph
      simpa only [div_one] using And.intro hdℱ hd𝒬
    have hK_conv : Convex ℝ (K m) := convex_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ((m : ℝ) + 1)
    intro x hx y hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hK_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun w hw => (hℱ_d.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hK_sub_ball hw))))
        (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).1) hx hy
    · exact hK_conv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun w hw => (h𝒬_d.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hK_sub_ball hw))))
        (fun w hw => (h_deriv_bd w hw).2) hx hy

  let L_fn : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => max (Real.sqrt (M_fn m)) (M_fn m)
  have hL_nonneg : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ L_fn m := fun m => le_max_of_le_right (hM_pos m).le
  let P_fn : ∀ m : ℕ, ℕ → ↥(K m) → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun m j z => if N_fn m ≤ j then (ℱ_seq j z.1, 𝒬_seq j z.1) else (0, 0)
  have hP_lip : ∀ (m j : ℕ), LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (L_fn m)) (P_fn m j) := by
    intro m j
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le'
    intro x y
    dsimp only [P_fn]
    split_ifs with hj
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h_lip_pair m j hj y.1 y.2 x.1 x.2
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      dsimp only
      refine max_le ?_ ?_
      · exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      · exact le_trans h2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
    · simp only [dist_self]
      exact mul_nonneg (hL_nonneg m) dist_nonneg

  let B_fn : ∀ m : ℕ, ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K m) (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun m j => BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨P_fn m j, (hP_lip m j).continuous⟩
  let S_set : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    fun m => Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (Real.sqrt (M_fn m)) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (M_fn m)
  let A_set : ∀ m : ℕ, Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K m) (ℂ × ℂ)) :=
    fun m => Set.range (B_fn m)

  have hA_comp : ∀ m : ℕ, IsCompact (closure (A_set m)) := by
    intro m
    have hS_comp : IsCompact (S_set m) :=
      (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (Real.sqrt (M_fn m))).prod
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (M_fn m))
    apply BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (S_set m) hS_comp (A_set m)
    · intro f z hf
      rcases hf with ⟨j, rfl⟩
      change P_fn m j z ∈ S_set m
      dsimp only [P_fn, S_set]
      split_ifs with hj
      · obtain ⟨_, _, h_bd, _⟩ := hN_spec m j hj
        have hz_cb : z.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := by
          have hz_K : z.1 ∈ K m := z.2
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz_K ⊢
          push_cast
          linarith
        have h1 := h_bd z.1 hz_cb
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith [norm_nonneg (𝒬_seq j z.1)])
        · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          linarith [sq_nonneg ‖ℱ_seq j z.1‖]
      · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.sqrt_nonneg]
        · simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, (hM_pos m).le]
    · have h_unif_lip : ∀ x : ↥(A_set m),
          LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (L_fn m))
            (fun z : ↥(K m) => (x : BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(K m) (ℂ × ℂ)) z) := by
        intro x
        rcases x.2 with ⟨j, hxj⟩
        rw [← hxj]
        exact hP_lip m j
      exact (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous _ (Real.toNNReal (L_fn m)) h_unif_lip).equicontinuous

  have hPi_comp : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun m : ℕ => closure (A_set m))) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi hA_comp
  obtain ⟨g_lim, _, σ, hσ, h_pi_lim⟩ :=
    hPi_comp.tendsto_subseq (x := fun j m => B_fn m j) (fun j m _ => subset_closure ⟨j, rfl⟩)

  have h_unif_sub : ∀ m : ℕ,
      TendstoUniformly (fun n (z : ↥(K m)) => (ℱ_seq (σ n) z.1, 𝒬_seq (σ n) z.1))
        (fun z => g_lim m z) Filter.atTop := by
    intro m
    have h_bm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => B_fn m (σ n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (g_lim m)) :=
      tendsto_pi_nhds.mp h_pi_lim m
    have h_tu : TendstoUniformly (fun n (z : ↥(K m)) => B_fn m (σ n) z)
        (fun z => g_lim m z) Filter.atTop :=
      BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp h_bm
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff] at h_tu ⊢
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [h_tu ε hε, Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn m)] with n hn hN z
    have hσn : N_fn m ≤ σ n := le_trans hN (hσ.id_le n)
    have hPz : B_fn m (σ n) z = (ℱ_seq (σ n) z.1, 𝒬_seq (σ n) z.1) := by
      change P_fn m (σ n) z = _
      simp [P_fn, hσn]
    simpa only [hPz] using hn z

  have hZ_in_ceil : ∀ Z : ℂ, Z ∈ K (Nat.ceil ‖Z‖) := by
    intro Z
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    linarith [Nat.le_ceil ‖Z‖]

  let ℱ : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => (g_lim (Nat.ceil ‖Z‖) ⟨Z, hZ_in_ceil Z⟩).1
  let 𝒬 : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => (g_lim (Nat.ceil ‖Z‖) ⟨Z, hZ_in_ceil Z⟩).2

  have h_ptwise_eq : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ↥(K m)),
      (g_lim m z).1 = ℱ z.1 ∧ (g_lim m z).2 = 𝒬 z.1 := by
    intro m z
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (ℱ_seq (σ n) z.1, 𝒬_seq (σ n) z.1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (g_lim m z)) :=
      (h_unif_sub m).tendsto_at z
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (ℱ_seq (σ n) z.1, 𝒬_seq (σ n) z.1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (g_lim (Nat.ceil ‖z.1‖) ⟨z.1, hZ_in_ceil z.1⟩)) :=
      (h_unif_sub (Nat.ceil ‖z.1‖)).tendsto_at ⟨z.1, hZ_in_ceil z.1⟩
    have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
    exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst heq, congrArg Prod.snd heq⟩

  have h_unif_on_K : ∀ m : ℕ,
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n Z => ℱ_seq (σ n) Z) ℱ Filter.atTop (K m) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n Z => 𝒬_seq (σ n) Z) 𝒬 Filter.atTop (K m) := by
    intro m
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff, Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    have h_tu_m := Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff.mp (h_unif_sub m)
    refine ⟨fun ε hε => ?_, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [h_tu_m ε hε] with n hn Z hZ
      have h_prod := hn ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      rw [Prod.dist_eq] at h_prod
      rw [← (h_ptwise_eq m ⟨Z, hZ⟩).1]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) h_prod
    · filter_upwards [h_tu_m ε hε] with n hn Z hZ
      have h_prod := hn ⟨Z, hZ⟩
      rw [Prod.dist_eq] at h_prod
      rw [← (h_ptwise_eq m ⟨Z, hZ⟩).2]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) h_prod

  have hℱ_loc : TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n Z => ℱ_seq (σ n) Z) ℱ Filter.atTop := by
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact]
    intro C hC
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hC.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : ℂ)
    let m : ℕ := Nat.ceil (max r 0)
    refine (h_unif_on_K m).1.mono (Subset.trans hr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz ⊢
    have hrm : r ≤ (m : ℝ) := le_trans (le_max_left r 0) (Nat.le_ceil (max r 0))
    linarith

  have h𝒬_loc : TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun n Z => 𝒬_seq (σ n) Z) 𝒬 Filter.atTop := by
    rw [tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff_forall_isCompact]
    intro C hC
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hC.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : ℂ)
    let m : ℕ := Nat.ceil (max r 0)
    refine (h_unif_on_K m).2.mono (Subset.trans hr ?_)
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz ⊢
    have hrm : r ≤ (m : ℝ) := le_trans (le_max_left r 0) (Nat.le_ceil (max r 0))
    linarith

  have hℱ_entire : Differentiable ℂ ℱ := by
    intro Z
    let m : ℕ := Nat.ceil ‖Z‖
    let U : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)
    have hZ_U : Z ∈ U := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have hZm : ‖Z‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil ‖Z‖
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_ev_diff : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq (σ n)) U := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn m)] with n hn
      exact (hN_spec m (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))).1
    have h_diff_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ ℱ U :=
      (hℱ_loc.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (s := U)).differentiableOn h_ev_diff Metric.isOpen_ball
    exact h_diff_on.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ_U)

  have h𝒬_entire : Differentiable ℂ 𝒬 := by
    intro Z
    let m : ℕ := Nat.ceil ‖Z‖
    let U : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)
    have hZ_U : Z ∈ U := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have hZm : ‖Z‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil ‖Z‖
      push_cast
      linarith
    have h_ev_diff : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (𝒬_seq (σ n)) U := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn m)] with n hn
      exact (hN_spec m (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))).2.1
    have h_diff_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝒬 U :=
      (h𝒬_loc.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (s := U)).differentiableOn h_ev_diff Metric.isOpen_ball
    exact h_diff_on.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hZ_U)

  
  have hℱ_pt : ∀ Z : ℂ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℱ_seq (σ n) Z) Filter.atTop (nhds (ℱ Z)) :=
    fun Z => (hℱ_loc.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (s := Set.univ)).tendsto_at (Set.mem_univ Z)
  have h𝒬_pt : ∀ Z : ℂ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 𝒬_seq (σ n) Z) Filter.atTop (nhds (𝒬 Z)) :=
    fun Z => (h𝒬_loc.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (s := Set.univ)).tendsto_at (Set.mem_univ Z)

  have h_lim_orig : ‖ℱ 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬 0‖ = 1 := by
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖ℱ_seq (σ n) 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq (σ n) 0‖)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (‖ℱ 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬 0‖)) :=
      ((hℱ_pt 0).norm.pow 2).add (h𝒬_pt 0).norm
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖ℱ_seq (σ n) 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq (σ n) 0‖)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
      simp only [h_orig, tendsto_const_nhds]
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2

  have h_lim_circ :
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
            ℱ (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ^ 2 +
          ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
            𝒬 (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖)) = 1 := by
    let z_θ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hz_cont : Continuous z_θ :=
      Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have hz_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖z_θ θ‖ = 1 := fun θ => Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I θ
    let ψ_n : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n θ =>
      ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * z_θ θ) * ℱ_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * z_θ θ) * 𝒬_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
      ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * z_θ θ) * ℱ (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * z_θ θ) * 𝒬 (z_θ θ)‖
    have h_int_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ψ_n n θ)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ψ θ)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
        (fun _ : ℝ => Real.exp 2 * M_fn 0)
      · filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn 0)] with n hn
        obtain ⟨hℱ_d0, h𝒬_d0, _, _⟩ := hN_spec 0 (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))
        have hz_in_b0 : ∀ θ : ℝ, z_θ θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) := by
          intro θ
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hz_norm θ]
          norm_num
        have hF_c : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ℱ_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)) :=
          hℱ_d0.continuousOn.comp_continuous hz_cont hz_in_b0
        have hQ_c : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => 𝒬_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)) :=
          h𝒬_d0.continuousOn.comp_continuous hz_cont hz_in_b0
        have hψ_c : Continuous (ψ_n n) := by
          refine Continuous.add ?_ ?_
          · exact (((Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul hz_cont)).mul hF_c).norm).pow 2
          · exact ((Complex.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul hz_cont)).mul hQ_c).norm
        exact hψ_c.aestronglyMeasurable
      · filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn 0)] with n hn
        obtain ⟨_, _, h_bd0, _⟩ := hN_spec 0 (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ => ?_)
        have hψ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ψ_n n θ := by positivity
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hψ_nonneg]
        have hz_cb0 : z_θ θ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, hz_norm θ]
          norm_num
        have h_sum_bd := h_bd0 (z_θ θ) hz_cb0
        have him_le : |(z_θ θ).im| ≤ 1 := by
          simpa [hz_norm θ] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z_θ θ)
        have him_ge : -1 ≤ (z_θ θ).im := (abs_le.mp him_le).1
        have hexp1 : ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_exp]
          have hre1 : (Complex.I * z_θ θ).re ≤ 1 := by
            simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub]
            linarith
          have hexp_le : Real.exp ((Complex.I * z_θ θ).re) ≤ Real.exp 1 :=
            Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre1
          calc
            (Real.exp ((Complex.I * z_θ θ).re)) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp 1) ^ 2 :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.exp_pos _).le hexp_le 2
            _ = Real.exp 2 := by rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; norm_num
        have hexp2 : ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * z_θ θ)‖ ≤ Real.exp 2 := by
          rw [Complex.norm_exp]
          have hre2 : (2 * Complex.I * z_θ θ).re ≤ 2 := by
            have h_eq : (2 : ℂ) * Complex.I * z_θ θ = (2 : ℂ) * (Complex.I * z_θ θ) := by ring
            rw [h_eq]
            simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.re_ofNat, Complex.im_ofNat, Complex.I_re,
              Complex.I_im, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, sub_zero]
            linarith
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre2
        dsimp only [ψ_n]
        rw [norm_mul, mul_pow, norm_mul]
        calc
          ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 * ‖ℱ_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 +
              ‖Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * z_θ θ)‖ * ‖𝒬_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖
            ≤ Real.exp 2 * ‖ℱ_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 +
              Real.exp 2 * ‖𝒬_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖ := by gcongr
          _ = Real.exp 2 * (‖ℱ_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖𝒬_seq (σ n) (z_θ θ)‖) := by ring
          _ ≤ Real.exp 2 * M_fn 0 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_bd (Real.exp_pos 2).le
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ => ?_)
        dsimp only [ψ_n, ψ]
        exact ((((hℱ_pt (z_θ θ)).const_mul _).norm.pow 2).add
          (((h𝒬_pt (z_θ θ)).const_mul _).norm))
    have h1 := h_int_tendsto.const_mul (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹
    have h2 := h_circ.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2

  have h_prod_zero : 𝒬 0 * ℱ 0 = 0 := by
    let U1 : Set ℂ := Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1
    have hU1_sub : U1 ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz ⊢
      linarith
    have h_ev_d1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℱ_seq (σ n)) U1 := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn 0)] with n hn
      exact (hN_spec 0 (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))).1.mono hU1_sub
    have h_ev_d2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n))) U1 := by
      filter_upwards [h_ev_d1] with n hn
      exact hn.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h_d1_lim : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n => deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n)))
        (deriv ℱ) Filter.atTop U1 :=
      (hℱ_loc.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (s := U1)).deriv h_ev_d1 Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h_d2_lim : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n => deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n))))
        (deriv (deriv ℱ)) Filter.atTop U1 :=
      h_d1_lim.deriv h_ev_d2 Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h_d2_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n))) 0)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv (deriv ℱ) 0)) :=
      h_d2_lim.tendsto_at (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos)
    have hb_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => b_seq (σ n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      hb_top.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop
    have hb_inv_real : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (b_seq (σ n))⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp hb_sub
    have hb_inv_c : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      have h_c1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (((b_seq (σ n))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.ofReal_zero] using
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hb_inv_real
      have h_c2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (((b_seq (σ n))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_c1.pow 2
      refine h_c2.congr (fun n => ?_)
      simp [Complex.ofReal_inv, inv_pow]
    have h_rhs_zero : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n))) 0 * ((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_d2_zero.mul hb_inv_c
    have h_ev_eq : (fun n => deriv (deriv (ℱ_seq (σ n))) 0 * ((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
        (fun n => 𝒬_seq (σ n) 0 * ℱ_seq (σ n) 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.Ici_mem_atTop (N_fn 0), hb_sub.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn hb1
      have h_ode := (hN_spec 0 (σ n) (le_trans hn (hσ.id_le n))).2.2.2 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos)
      have hb_ne : (b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by linarith)
      have hb2_ne : (b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hb_ne
      rw [h_ode]
      calc
        (b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2 * 𝒬_seq (σ n) 0 * ℱ_seq (σ n) 0 * ((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹
          = (𝒬_seq (σ n) 0 * ℱ_seq (σ n) 0) * ((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2 * ((b_seq (σ n) : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by ring
        _ = 𝒬_seq (σ n) 0 * ℱ_seq (σ n) 0 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hb2_ne, mul_one]
    have h_prod_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 𝒬_seq (σ n) 0 * ℱ_seq (σ n) 0)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (𝒬 0 * ℱ 0)) :=
      (h𝒬_pt 0).mul (hℱ_pt 0)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_prod_tendsto (h_rhs_zero.congr' h_ev_eq)

  
  let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => Complex.exp (Complex.I * Z) * ℱ Z
  let h : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Z) * 𝒬 Z
  have hg_diff : Differentiable ℂ g :=
    ((differentiable_id.const_mul Complex.I).cexp).mul hℱ_entire
  have hh_diff : Differentiable ℂ h :=
    ((differentiable_id.const_mul (2 * Complex.I)).cexp).mul h𝒬_entire
  have hg0 : g 0 = ℱ 0 := by simp [g]
  have hh0 : h 0 = 𝒬 0 := by simp [h]

  have h_re_avg : ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ F →
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (F (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))).re) = (F 0).re := by
    intro F hF
    have hF_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      ⟨hF.differentiableOn, hF.continuous.continuousOn⟩
    have h2piI_ne : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
        Complex.I_ne_zero
    have h_ca : Real.circleAverage F 0 1 = F 0 := by
      rw [Real.circleAverage_eq_circleIntegral one_ne_zero,
        hF_dc.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos),
        inv_smul_smul₀ h2piI_ne]
    have h_int : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun θ : ℝ => F (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hF.continuous.comp
        (Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const))).intervalIntegrable
        0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_re := congrArg Complex.reCLM h_ca
    rw [Real.circleAverage_def] at h_re
    simp only [circleMap_zero, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h_re
    rw [← Complex.reCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm h_int] at h_re
    exact h_re

  let u₀ : ℂ := if h 0 = 0 then 1 else h 0 / (‖h 0‖ : ℂ)
  have hu₀_norm : ‖u₀‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp only [u₀]
    split_ifs with hh_zero
    · exact norm_one
    · rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _),
        div_self (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hh_zero)]
  have hu₀_conj : u₀ * starRingEnd ℂ u₀ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hu₀_norm, one_pow, Complex.ofReal_one]

  let w : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => starRingEnd ℂ u₀ * h Z
  have hw_diff : Differentiable ℂ w := hh_diff.const_mul (starRingEnd ℂ u₀)
  have hw_rec : ∀ Z : ℂ, u₀ * w Z = h Z := by
    intro Z
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [← mul_assoc, hu₀_conj, one_mul]
  have hw_norm : ∀ Z : ℂ, ‖w Z‖ = ‖h Z‖ := by
    intro Z
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [norm_mul, RingHomIsometric.norm_map, hu₀_norm, one_mul]
  have hw0 : w 0 = (‖h 0‖ : ℂ) := by
    dsimp only [w, u₀]
    split_ifs with hh_zero
    · simp [hh_zero]
    · have hnorm_ne : (‖h 0‖ : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
        Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hh_zero)
      rw [map_div₀, Complex.conj_ofReal, div_mul_eq_mul_div, Complex.conj_mul',
        ← Complex.ofReal_pow, sq, Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hnorm_ne]

  let z_θ : ℝ → ℂ := fun θ => Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hz_cont : Continuous z_θ :=
    Complex.continuous_exp.comp (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
  let φ₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => ‖g (z_θ θ) - g 0‖ ^ 2
  let φ₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => ‖w (z_θ θ)‖ - (w (z_θ θ)).re

  have hφ₁_cont : Continuous φ₁ :=
    (((hg_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont).sub continuous_const).norm).pow 2
  have hφ₂_cont : Continuous φ₂ :=
    ((hw_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont).norm).sub
      (Complex.continuous_re.comp (hw_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont))
  have hφ₁_nonneg : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ₁ θ := fun θ => sq_nonneg _
  have hφ₂_nonneg : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ φ₂ θ := fun θ => sub_nonneg.mpr (Complex.re_le_norm _)

  have h_pt_ident : ∀ θ : ℝ,
      φ₁ θ + φ₂ θ =
        (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖) -
          2 * (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re + ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 - (w (z_θ θ)).re := by
    intro θ
    dsimp only [φ₁, φ₂]
    rw [hw_norm (z_θ θ)]
    have h_sq : ‖g (z_θ θ) - g 0‖ ^ 2 =
        ‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re + ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
      ring
    linarith

  have h_int_sum_zero :
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₁ θ) + (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₂ θ) = 0 := by
    have hi_φ₁ : IntervalIntegrable φ₁ MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hφ₁_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hi_φ₂ : IntervalIntegrable φ₂ MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hφ₂_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_gh_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖) :=
      (((hg_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont).norm).pow 2).add
        ((hh_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont).norm)
    have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re) :=
      Complex.continuous_re.comp (continuous_const.mul (hg_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont))
    have h_fw_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (w (z_θ θ)).re) :=
      Complex.continuous_re.comp (hw_diff.continuous.comp hz_cont)
    have hi_gh : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => ‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      h_gh_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hi_fg : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      h_fg_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hi_fw : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => (w (z_θ θ)).re)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      h_fw_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hi_c : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => ‖g 0‖ ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      intervalIntegrable_const
    have h_add := (intervalIntegral.integral_add hi_φ₁ hi_φ₂).symm
    have h_congr : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (φ₁ θ + φ₂ θ)) =
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖)) -
          2 * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re) +
          (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖g 0‖ ^ 2) -
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (w (z_θ θ)).re) := by
      simp_rw [h_pt_ident]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (((hi_gh.sub (hi_fg.const_mul 2)).add hi_c)) hi_fw]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hi_gh.sub (hi_fg.const_mul 2)) hi_c]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi_gh (hi_fg.const_mul 2)]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have h_avg1 := h_re_avg (fun Z => starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g Z) (hg_diff.const_mul _)
    have h_avg1_val : (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g 0).re = ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Complex.conj_mul', ← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.ofReal_re]
    rw [h_avg1_val] at h_avg1
    have h_avg2 := h_re_avg w hw_diff
    have h_avg2_val : (w 0).re = ‖h 0‖ := by
      rw [hw0, Complex.ofReal_re]
    rw [h_avg2_val] at h_avg2
    have h2pi_ne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
    have h_int_gh : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖)) = 2 * Real.pi := by
      have hc : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖)) = 1 :=
        h_lim_circ
      calc
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖))
          = (2 * Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (‖g (z_θ θ)‖ ^ 2 + ‖h (z_θ θ)‖)) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul]
        _ = 2 * Real.pi := by rw [hc, mul_one]
    have h_int_fg : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re) =
        2 * Real.pi * ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re)
          = (2 * Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (starRingEnd ℂ (g 0) * g (z_θ θ)).re) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul]
        _ = 2 * Real.pi * ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 := congrArg ((2 * Real.pi) * ·) h_avg1
    have h_int_fw : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (w (z_θ θ)).re) = 2 * Real.pi * ‖h 0‖ := by
      calc
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (w (z_θ θ)).re)
          = (2 * Real.pi) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (w (z_θ θ)).re) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2pi_ne, one_mul]
        _ = 2 * Real.pi * ‖h 0‖ := congrArg ((2 * Real.pi) * ·) h_avg2
    have h_int_c : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ‖g 0‖ ^ 2) = 2 * Real.pi * ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    have h_gh0 : ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖h 0‖ = 1 := by
      simpa [hg0, hh0] using h_lim_orig
    calc
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₁ θ) + (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₂ θ)
        = 2 * Real.pi - 2 * (2 * Real.pi * ‖g 0‖ ^ 2) +
            2 * Real.pi * ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 - 2 * Real.pi * ‖h 0‖ := by
          rw [h_add, h_congr, h_int_gh, h_int_fg, h_int_c, h_int_fw]
      _ = 2 * Real.pi * (1 - (‖g 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖h 0‖)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h_gh0, sub_self, mul_zero]

  have h_int1_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₁ θ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le (fun θ _ => hφ₁_nonneg θ)
  have h_int2_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₂ θ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le (fun θ _ => hφ₂_nonneg θ)
  have h_int1_zero : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₁ θ) = 0 := by linarith
  have h_int2_zero : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₂ θ) = 0 := by linarith

  have hφ₁_zero : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), φ₁ θ = 0 := by
    intro θ hθ
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < φ₁ θ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hφ₁_nonneg θ) (Ne.symm hne)
    have hint_pos : 0 < ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₁ t :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_pos Real.two_pi_pos hφ₁_cont.continuousOn
        (fun t _ => hφ₁_nonneg t) ⟨θ, hθ, hpos⟩
    linarith

  have hφ₂_zero : ∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), φ₂ θ = 0 := by
    intro θ hθ
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < φ₂ θ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hφ₂_nonneg θ) (Ne.symm hne)
    have hint_pos : 0 < ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), φ₂ t :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_pos Real.two_pi_pos hφ₂_cont.continuousOn
        (fun t _ => hφ₂_nonneg t) ⟨θ, hθ, hpos⟩
    linarith

  have h_sphere : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖g z - g 0‖ = 0 ∧ (w z).im = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = 1 := by simpa [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz
    let α : ℝ := Complex.arg z
    have hα_mem : α ∈ Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi := Complex.arg_mem_Ioc z
    have hexp_α : Complex.exp ((α : ℂ) * Complex.I) = z := by
      have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I z
      simpa [α, hz_norm] using h1
    let θ : ℝ := if 0 ≤ α then α else α + 2 * Real.pi
    have hθ_mem : θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      dsimp only [θ]
      split_ifs with h0
      · exact ⟨h0, by linarith [hα_mem.2, Real.pi_pos]⟩
      · exact ⟨by linarith [hα_mem.1], by linarith⟩
    have hz_eq : z_θ θ = z := by
      dsimp only [z_θ, θ]
      split_ifs with h0
      · exact hexp_α
      · push_cast
        rw [add_mul, Complex.exp_add, hexp_α, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    have h1 := hφ₁_zero θ hθ_mem
    have h2 := hφ₂_zero θ hθ_mem
    dsimp only [φ₁, φ₂] at h1 h2
    rw [hz_eq] at h1 h2
    have hg_zero : ‖g z - g 0‖ = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h1
    have hw_re_eq : ‖w z‖ = (w z).re := sub_eq_zero.mp h2
    have hw_im_sq : (w z).im ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have h_nsq : (w z).re ^ 2 + (w z).im ^ 2 = ‖w z‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
        ring
      rw [← hw_re_eq] at h_nsq
      linarith
    exact ⟨hg_zero, sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hw_im_sq⟩

  have hg_const : ∀ Z : ℂ, g Z = g 0 := by
    let dg : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g z - g 0
    have hdg_diff : Differentiable ℂ dg := hg_diff.sub (differentiable_const (g 0))
    have hdg_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ dg (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      ⟨hdg_diff.differentiableOn, hdg_diff.continuous.continuousOn⟩
    have hdg_fr : ∀ z ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1), ‖dg z‖ ≤ 0 := by
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero]
      intro z hz
      exact (h_sphere z hz).1.le
    have hdg_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g z = g 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h_le := Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
        Metric.isBounded_ball hdg_dc hdg_fr (subset_closure hz)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp h_le)
    have hg_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g Set.univ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr hg_diff.differentiableOn
    have hc_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => g 0) Set.univ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr
        (differentiable_const (g 0)).differentiableOn
    have h_ev : g =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun _ : ℂ => g 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos)] with z hz
      exact hdg_ball z hz
    intro Z
    exact hg_an.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hc_an isPreconnected_univ
      (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℂ)) h_ev (Set.mem_univ Z)

  have hh_const : ∀ Z : ℂ, h Z = h 0 := by
    let E_pos : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => Complex.exp (Complex.I * w z)
    have hE_diff : Differentiable ℂ E_pos :=
      (hw_diff.const_mul Complex.I).cexp
    have hE_norm : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖E_pos z‖ = Real.exp (-(w z).im) := by
      intro z
      dsimp only [E_pos]
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      simp [Complex.mul_re]
    have hE0_norm : ‖E_pos 0‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hE_norm 0, hw0, Complex.ofReal_im, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    have hE_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ E_pos (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      ⟨hE_diff.differentiableOn, hE_diff.continuous.continuousOn⟩
    have hE_fr : ∀ z ∈ frontier (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1), ‖E_pos z‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [frontier_ball (0 : ℂ) one_ne_zero]
      intro z hz
      rw [hE_norm z, (h_sphere z hz).2, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    have hE_max : IsMaxOn (Norm.norm ∘ E_pos) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) 0 := by
      intro z hz
      change ‖E_pos z‖ ≤ ‖E_pos 0‖
      rw [hE0_norm]
      exact Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
        Metric.isBounded_ball hE_dc hE_fr (subset_closure hz)
    have hE_eqOn : EqOn E_pos (Function.const ℂ (E_pos 0)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) :=
      Complex.eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn_norm
        (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 1).isPreconnected Metric.isOpen_ball
        hE_diff.differentiableOn (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos) hE_max
    have h_deriv_w_zero : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, deriv w z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h_evE : E_pos =ᶠ[nhds z] (fun _ : ℂ => E_pos 0) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz] with ζ hζ
        exact hE_eqOn hζ
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt E_pos 0 z :=
        (h_evE.hasDerivAt_iff).mpr (hasDerivAt_const z (E_pos 0))
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt E_pos (Complex.exp (Complex.I * w z) * (Complex.I * deriv w z)) z :=
        ((hw_diff.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).const_mul Complex.I).cexp
      have h_eq := hd2.unique hd1
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq with hexp0 | hIdw
      · exact False.elim (Complex.exp_ne_zero _ hexp0)
      · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hIdw).resolve_left Complex.I_ne_zero
    have hw_ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, w z = w 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h_le := (convex_ball (0 : ℂ) 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
        (fun ζ _ => hw_diff.differentiableAt)
        (fun ζ hζ => by rw [h_deriv_w_zero ζ hζ, norm_zero])
        (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos) hz
      rw [zero_mul] at h_le
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp h_le)
    have hw_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ w Set.univ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr hw_diff.differentiableOn
    have hwc_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => w 0) Set.univ :=
      (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn isOpen_univ).mpr
        (differentiable_const (w 0)).differentiableOn
    have h_evw : w =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] (fun _ : ℂ => w 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos)] with z hz
      exact hw_ball z hz
    intro Z
    have hwZ : w Z = w 0 :=
      hw_an.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hwc_an isPreconnected_univ
        (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℂ)) h_evw (Set.mem_univ Z)
    rw [← hw_rec Z, hwZ, hw_rec 0]

  
  have hℱ_form : ℱ = fun Z => ℱ 0 * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) := by
    funext Z
    have hgZ : Complex.exp (Complex.I * Z) * ℱ Z = ℱ 0 := by
      simpa [g, hg0] using hg_const Z
    calc
      ℱ Z = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) * (Complex.exp (Complex.I * Z) * ℱ Z) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
        have hsum : -Complex.I * Z + Complex.I * Z = 0 := by ring
        rw [hsum, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
      _ = ℱ 0 * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z) := by rw [hgZ, mul_comm]

  have h𝒬_form : 𝒬 = fun Z => 𝒬 0 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z) := by
    funext Z
    have hhZ : Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Z) * 𝒬 Z = 𝒬 0 := by
      simpa [h, hh0] using hh_const Z
    calc
      𝒬 Z = Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z) * (Complex.exp (2 * Complex.I * Z) * 𝒬 Z) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
        have hsum : -2 * Complex.I * Z + 2 * Complex.I * Z = 0 := by ring
        rw [hsum, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
      _ = 𝒬 0 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z) := by rw [hhZ, mul_comm]

  by_cases hc1 : ℱ 0 = 0
  · have h𝒬0_norm : ‖𝒬 0‖ = 1 := by
      have h1 := h_lim_orig
      rw [hc1, norm_zero] at h1
      linarith
    let c₀ : ℂ := Complex.exp (((Complex.arg (𝒬 0) : ℂ) / 2) * Complex.I)
    have hc₀_ne : c₀ ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    have hc₀_sq : c₀ ^ 2 = 𝒬 0 := by
      dsimp only [c₀]
      rw [sq, ← Complex.exp_add]
      have harg_sum :
          ((Complex.arg (𝒬 0) : ℂ) / 2) * Complex.I +
            ((Complex.arg (𝒬 0) : ℂ) / 2) * Complex.I =
            (Complex.arg (𝒬 0) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by ring
      rw [harg_sum]
      have hpolar := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I (𝒬 0)
      simpa [h𝒬0_norm] using hpolar
    refine ⟨σ, c₀, hσ, hc₀_ne, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have hℱ_zero : ℱ = fun _ => 0 := by
        rw [hℱ_form]
        funext Z
        simp [hc1]
      simpa [hℱ_zero] using hℱ_loc
    · have h𝒬_c₀ : 𝒬 = fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z) := by
        rw [h𝒬_form, hc₀_sq]
      simpa [h𝒬_c₀] using h𝒬_loc
  · have h𝒬0_zero : 𝒬 0 = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp h_prod_zero).resolve_right hc1
    refine ⟨σ, ℱ 0, hσ, hc1, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← hℱ_form]
      exact hℱ_loc
    · have h𝒬_zero : 𝒬 = fun _ => 0 := by
        rw [h𝒬_form]
        funext Z
        simp [h𝒬0_zero]
      simpa [h𝒬_zero] using h𝒬_loc

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (k_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ) (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ_star : ℝ → ℝ)
    (lam C_env P' : ℝ)
    (h_basic : ∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n ∧
      0 < ε_seq n ∧ 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n))
    (hk_top : Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hB_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hε_zero : Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    (h_norm : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
      rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |j - k_seq n|))
    (hm_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D)
    (hm_lim : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n D =>
        rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D) / (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * D))
      m Filter.atTop (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hlam : 1 ≤ lam)
    (hC_env : 0 < C_env)
    (hP' : 1 ≤ P')
    (hx_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j)
    (hρ_cont : Continuous ρ_star)
    (hρ_zero : ρ_star 0 = 0)
    (hρ_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam))
    (hρ_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam))
    (hρ_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun j u =>
        (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j + u)))) -
          (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))))
      ρ_star Filter.atTop)
    (h_right : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, x_seq j ≤ v →
      -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - x_seq j) - C_env ≤
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp v)))
    (h_left : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ x_seq j →
      -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) - P' * (x_seq j - v) - C_env ≤
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp v)))
    (h_x_growth : ∀ j : ℕ, -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) ≤ C_env * (1 + x_seq j)) :
    ∃ (L_lim : ℝ → ℝ) (N_env : ℕ → ℕ),
      (Continuous L_lim ∧
        L_lim 0 = 0 ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atBot (nhds lam)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_env j,
        criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n - x_seq j ∧
        (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k_seq n - x_seq j ∧
        2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (-(k_seq n - x_seq j)) ≤
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) ∧
        (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) ∧
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) ≤
          rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) /
            (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j)) ∧
        (∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
          rowMomentFull S l ≤
            (4 * Real.exp C_env) * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) *
              Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * max (k_seq n - x_seq j - l) 0 +
                P' * max (l - (k_seq n - x_seq j)) 0)) ∧
        IsCriticalEnvelope S (3 / 8) P' 1 (4 * Real.exp C_env)
          (fun l => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) *
            Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * max (k_seq n - x_seq j - l) 0 +
              P' * max (l - (k_seq n - x_seq j)) 0))) ∧
      (∀ n_sel : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ j : ℕ, N_env j ≤ n_sel j) →
        TendstoLocallyUniformly
          (fun j v =>
            Real.exp v *
              (rowMomentFull S (k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j + v) /
                rowMomentFull S (k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)))
          (fun v => Real.exp (L_lim v)) Filter.atTop)

  let L_lim : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => -ρ_star (-v)
  have hL_cont : Continuous L_lim := (hρ_cont.comp continuous_neg).neg
  have hL_zero : L_lim 0 = 0 := by simp [L_lim, hρ_zero]
  have hL_div_eq : (fun v : ℝ => L_lim v / v) = (fun u : ℝ => ρ_star u / u) ∘ Neg.neg := by
    ext v
    simp only [L_lim, Function.comp_apply, neg_div, div_neg]
  have hL_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    rw [hL_div_eq]
    exact hρ_bot.comp Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot
  have hL_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) := by
    rw [hL_div_eq]
    exact hρ_top.comp Filter.tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop
  have h_row_L1_le_L2 : ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
      Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤
      rowMomentFull S k := by
    intro k hk
    have hk_log : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ k :=
      le_trans (le_max_right 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))) hk
    have hH20_pos : 0 < S.H / 20 := by linarith [S.H_pos]
    have hexp_le : Real.exp (-k) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
      calc Real.exp (-k)
          ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
        _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log hH20_pos
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hz_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, z x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro x
      change |(z x).im| < S.H
      have him : (z x).im = S.H - Real.exp (-k) := by
        simp only [z, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      rw [him]
      exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [S.H_pos], by linarith⟩
    have hz_cont : Continuous z := by
      unfold z
      fun_prop
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.f (z x)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hz_cont hz_mem
    have hq_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.q (z x)) :=
      S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hz_cont hz_mem
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => shapeModulus S (z x)
    let h_sq : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖S.f (z x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (z x)‖
    have hg_cont : Continuous g :=
      (hf_cont.norm).max (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hq_cont.norm)
    have hh_cont : Continuous h_sq :=
      ((hf_cont.norm).pow 2).add (hq_cont.norm)
    let M₁ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x
    let M₂ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_sq x
    have hg_sq_le : ∀ x : ℝ, g x ^ 2 ≤ h_sq x := by
      intro x
      change (max ‖S.f (z x)‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (z x)‖)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖S.f (z x)‖ ^ 2 + ‖S.q (z x)‖
      rcases le_total ‖S.f (z x)‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q (z x)‖) with hle | hle
      · rw [max_eq_right hle, Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
        linarith [sq_nonneg ‖S.f (z x)‖]
      · rw [max_eq_left hle]
        linarith [norm_nonneg (S.q (z x))]
    have h_var_nonneg :
        0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x - M₁) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le (fun x _ => sq_nonneg (g x - M₁))
    have h_int_var :
        IntervalIntegrable (fun x => (g x - M₁) ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      ((hg_cont.sub continuous_const).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_g : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hg_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_h : IntervalIntegrable h_sq MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hh_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_int_rhs : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x + M₁ ^ 2)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      ((hh_cont.sub (continuous_const.mul hg_cont)).add continuous_const).intervalIntegrable
        0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_var_le :
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g x - M₁) ^ 2) ≤
          ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x + M₁ ^ 2) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.two_pi_pos.le h_int_var h_int_rhs ?_
      intro x _
      have hgx := hg_sq_le x
      nlinarith
    have h_rhs_eval :
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x + M₁ ^ 2)) =
          (2 * Real.pi) * (M₂ - M₁ ^ 2) := by
      have h1 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x + M₁ ^ 2)) =
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x)) +
            ∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), M₁ ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_add (h_int_h.sub (h_int_g.const_mul (2 * M₁)))
          ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => M₁ ^ 2).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      have h2 : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (h_sq x - 2 * M₁ * g x)) =
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_sq x) -
            2 * M₁ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int_h (h_int_g.const_mul (2 * M₁)),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have h3 : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), M₁ ^ 2) = (2 * Real.pi) * M₁ ^ 2 := by
        simp [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      have hI_g : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x) = (2 * Real.pi) * M₁ := by
        dsimp [M₁]
        field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
      have hI_h : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), h_sq x) = (2 * Real.pi) * M₂ := by
        dsimp [M₂]
        field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
      rw [h1, h2, h3, hI_g, hI_h]
      ring
    have hM1_sq_le : M₁ ^ 2 ≤ M₂ := by
      have h2pi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
      nlinarith [h_var_nonneg, h_var_le, h_rhs_eval]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hM1_sq_le) hexp_pos.le
  let m_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n D =>
    rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - Real.log D) / (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * D)
  let R₀ : ℝ := 12 * (C_env + 1)
  let V_cut : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
    max (R₀ * (1 + x_seq j) + x_seq j) (x_seq j + (j : ℝ) + 1)
  let I_j : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun j => Set.Icc (Real.exp (-V_cut j)) (Real.exp (V_cut j))
  let m₀ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => m (Real.exp (x_seq j))
  let M_loc : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * ((j : ℝ) + 1))
  let δ₁ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j
  let δ₂ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * V_cut j)
  let δ₃ : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (m₀ j) ^ 2 / (4 * (m₀ j + M_loc j) * ((j : ℝ) + 1))
  let δ_tol : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => min (δ₁ j) (min (δ₂ j) (δ₃ j))
  have hm₀_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < m₀ j := fun j => hm_pos _ (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hM_loc_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < M_loc j := fun j => mul_pos (hm₀_pos j) (Real.exp_pos _)
  have hδ_tol_pos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < δ_tol j := by
    intro j
    have hm0 := hm₀_pos j
    have hMloc := hM_loc_pos j
    refine lt_min ?_ (lt_min ?_ ?_)
    · dsimp [δ₁]; positivity
    · dsimp [δ₂]; positivity
    · dsimp [δ₃]; positivity
  have hV_cut_ge_one : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ V_cut j := by
    intro j
    have hx := hx_nonneg j
    have hj : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
    have hmax := le_max_right (R₀ * (1 + x_seq j) + x_seq j) (x_seq j + (j : ℝ) + 1)
    linarith
  have hI_sub : ∀ j : ℕ, I_j j ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    intro j D hD
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hD.1
  have h_exp_mem_I : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, |v| ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 → Real.exp (x_seq j - v) ∈ I_j j := by
    intro j v hv
    rcases abs_le.mp hv with ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
    have hx := hx_nonneg j
    have hV := le_max_right (R₀ * (1 + x_seq j) + x_seq j) (x_seq j + (j : ℝ) + 1)
    exact ⟨Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith), Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)⟩
  have hD0_mem_all : ∀ j : ℕ, Real.exp (x_seq j) ∈ I_j j := by
    intro j
    simpa using h_exp_mem_I j 0 (by rw [abs_zero]; positivity)
  have hm_right_ub : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w : ℝ, x_seq j ≤ w →
      m (Real.exp w) ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - x_seq j)) := by
    intro j w hw
    have hlog : Real.log (m (Real.exp w)) ≤
        Real.log (m₀ j) + (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - x_seq j)) := by
      have h := h_right j w hw
      dsimp [m₀]
      linarith
    have hmw_pos : 0 < m (Real.exp w) := hm_pos _ (Real.exp_pos w)
    calc m (Real.exp w)
        = Real.exp (Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) := (Real.exp_log hmw_pos).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (m₀ j) + (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - x_seq j))) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
      _ = m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w - x_seq j)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (hm₀_pos j)]
  have hm_left_ub : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ w : ℝ, w ≤ x_seq j →
      m (Real.exp w) ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * (x_seq j - w)) := by
    intro j w hw
    have hlog : Real.log (m (Real.exp w)) ≤
        Real.log (m₀ j) + (C_env + P' * (x_seq j - w)) := by
      have h := h_left j w hw
      dsimp [m₀]
      linarith
    have hmw_pos : 0 < m (Real.exp w) := hm_pos _ (Real.exp_pos w)
    calc m (Real.exp w)
        = Real.exp (Real.log (m (Real.exp w))) := (Real.exp_log hmw_pos).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (m₀ j) + (C_env + P' * (x_seq j - w))) :=
          Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog
      _ = m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * (x_seq j - w)) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (hm₀_pos j)]
  have hm_loc_ub : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, |v| ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 →
      m (Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) ≤ M_loc j := by
    intro j v hv
    rcases abs_le.mp hv with ⟨hv1, hv2⟩
    have hj_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    rcases le_total v 0 with hv0 | hv0
    · have hw : x_seq j ≤ x_seq j - v := by linarith
      calc m (Real.exp (x_seq j - v))
          ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * ((x_seq j - v) - x_seq j)) :=
            hm_right_ub j (x_seq j - v) hw
        _ ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (hm₀_pos j).le
            nlinarith [hP']
    · have hw : x_seq j - v ≤ x_seq j := by linarith
      calc m (Real.exp (x_seq j - v))
          ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * (x_seq j - (x_seq j - v))) :=
            hm_left_ub j (x_seq j - v) hw
        _ ≤ m₀ j * Real.exp (C_env + P' * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (hm₀_pos j).le
            nlinarith [hP']
  have h_row_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ,
      rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - u) =
        rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp u * m_seq n (Real.exp u) := by
    intro n u
    have hBn : 0 < rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (h_basic n).2.2
    have hexp : 0 < Real.exp u := Real.exp_pos u
    dsimp [m_seq]
    rw [Real.log_exp u]
    field_simp [hBn.ne', hexp.ne']
  let k₀ : ℝ := criticalDepthThreshold S
  let K_req : ℕ → ℝ := fun j =>
    x_seq j + max k₀ (max ((j : ℝ) + 1) (k₀ + Real.log (8 * ((j : ℝ) + 2))))
  have h_ev : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N,
      K_req j ≤ k_seq n ∧
      ε_seq n ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j * Real.exp (x_seq j) * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) ∧
      (∀ D ∈ I_j j, |m_seq n D - m D| ≤ δ_tol j) := by
    intro j
    have hev1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, K_req j ≤ k_seq n :=
      hk_top.eventually (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (K_req j))
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ε_seq n ≤ 1 / 16 := by
      filter_upwards [hε_zero.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 16))] with n hn
      exact le_of_lt hn
    have hc_pos : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j * Real.exp (x_seq j) :=
      mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hm₀_pos j)) (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hev3 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop,
        (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j * Real.exp (x_seq j) * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) := by
      filter_upwards [hB_top.eventually
        (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (((j : ℝ) + 1) / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j * Real.exp (x_seq j))))]
        with n hn
      linarith [(div_le_iff₀ hc_pos).mp hn]
    have h_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn m_seq m Filter.atTop (I_j j) :=
      (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact isOpen_Ioi).mp hm_lim
        (I_j j) (hI_sub j) isCompact_Icc
    have hev4 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ∀ D ∈ I_j j, |m_seq n D - m D| ≤ δ_tol j := by
      filter_upwards [(Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp h_unif) (δ_tol j) (hδ_tol_pos j)] with n hn
      intro D hD
      have hdist := hn D hD
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at hdist
      exact le_of_lt hdist
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hev1.and (hev2.and (hev3.and hev4)))
  let N_env : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (h_ev j)
  have hN_spec : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_env j,
      K_req j ≤ k_seq n ∧
      ε_seq n ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j * Real.exp (x_seq j) * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) ∧
      (∀ D ∈ I_j j, |m_seq n D - m D| ≤ δ_tol j) :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (h_ev j)
  have h_ratio_err : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_env j, ∀ v : ℝ, |v| ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 →
      |m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) / m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j)) -
        m (Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) / m₀ j| ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro j n hn v hv
    rcases hN_spec j n hn with ⟨_, _, _, hI_err⟩
    let D_v := Real.exp (x_seq j - v)
    let D₀ := Real.exp (x_seq j)
    have hDv_mem : D_v ∈ I_j j := h_exp_mem_I j v hv
    have hD0_mem : D₀ ∈ I_j j := hD0_mem_all j
    have h_err_v : |m_seq n D_v - m D_v| ≤ δ₃ j :=
      le_trans (hI_err D_v hDv_mem) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have h_err_0_1 : |m_seq n D₀ - m₀ j| ≤ δ₁ j :=
      le_trans (hI_err D₀ hD0_mem) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_err_0_3 : |m_seq n D₀ - m₀ j| ≤ δ₃ j :=
      le_trans (hI_err D₀ hD0_mem) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hm0_pos : 0 < m₀ j := hm₀_pos j
    have hm0_half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j ≤ m_seq n D₀ := by
      have h_low := (abs_le.mp h_err_0_1).1
      dsimp [δ₁] at h_low
      linarith
    have hm_seq0_pos : 0 < m_seq n D₀ := by linarith
    have hmDv_pos : 0 < m D_v := hm_pos D_v (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hmDv_le : m D_v ≤ M_loc j := hm_loc_ub j v hv
    have h_alg : m_seq n D_v / m_seq n D₀ - m D_v / m₀ j =
        ((m_seq n D_v - m D_v) * m₀ j + m D_v * (m₀ j - m_seq n D₀)) /
          (m_seq n D₀ * m₀ j) := by
      field_simp [hm_seq0_pos.ne', hm0_pos.ne']
      ring
    have h_num : |(m_seq n D_v - m D_v) * m₀ j + m D_v * (m₀ j - m_seq n D₀)| ≤
        (m₀ j + M_loc j) * δ₃ j := by
      calc |(m_seq n D_v - m D_v) * m₀ j + m D_v * (m₀ j - m_seq n D₀)|
          ≤ |(m_seq n D_v - m D_v) * m₀ j| + |m D_v * (m₀ j - m_seq n D₀)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |m_seq n D_v - m D_v| * m₀ j + m D_v * |m_seq n D₀ - m₀ j| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hm0_pos, abs_of_pos hmDv_pos, abs_sub_comm (m₀ j)]
        _ ≤ δ₃ j * m₀ j + M_loc j * δ₃ j := by
            have h1 : |m_seq n D_v - m D_v| * m₀ j ≤ δ₃ j * m₀ j :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_err_v hm0_pos.le
            have h2 : m D_v * |m_seq n D₀ - m₀ j| ≤ M_loc j * δ₃ j :=
              mul_le_mul hmDv_le h_err_0_3 (abs_nonneg _) (hM_loc_pos j).le
            linarith
        _ = (m₀ j + M_loc j) * δ₃ j := by ring
    have h_den : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (m₀ j) ^ 2 ≤ m_seq n D₀ * m₀ j := by nlinarith
    have h_den_pos : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (m₀ j) ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [h_alg, abs_div, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hm_seq0_pos hm0_pos)]
    calc |(m_seq n D_v - m D_v) * m₀ j + m D_v * (m₀ j - m_seq n D₀)| / (m_seq n D₀ * m₀ j)
        ≤ ((m₀ j + M_loc j) * δ₃ j) / ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (m₀ j) ^ 2) := by
          exact div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hm0_pos.le (hM_loc_pos j).le) (by dsimp [δ₃]; positivity))
            h_num h_den_pos h_den
      _ = 1 / (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          dsimp [δ₃]
          have hsum_ne : m₀ j + M_loc j ≠ 0 := (add_pos hm0_pos (hM_loc_pos j)).ne'
          have hj1_ne : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
          field_simp [hm0_pos.ne', hsum_ne, hj1_ne]
          ring
      _ ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
          have hj1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
          exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hj1_pos (by linarith)
  refine ⟨L_lim, N_env, ⟨hL_cont, hL_zero, hL_top, hL_bot⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j n hn
    rcases hN_spec j n hn with ⟨hK_req, hε_le, hB_large, hI_err⟩
    let K : ℝ := k_seq n - x_seq j
    let B_n : ℝ := rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)
    let B' : ℝ := rowMomentFull S K
    have hBn_ge_one : 1 ≤ B_n := (h_basic n).2.2

      rw [h1, Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log (hm_pos _ (Real.exp_pos _)), Real.exp_log (hm₀_pos j)]
    refine Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr ?_
    intro ε hε
    have hev_exp : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, ∀ v ∈ T_V,
        dist (Real.exp (L_lim v)) (Real.exp (-Δ j (-v))) < ε / 2 :=
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hexp_Δ_unif) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    have hev_J0 : ∀ᶠ j in Filter.atTop, J₀ ≤ j := Filter.eventually_ge_atTop J₀
    have hev_inv : ∀ᶠ j : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) < ε / 2 :=
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).eventually
        (Iio_mem_nhds (half_pos hε))
    filter_upwards [hev_exp, hev_J0, hev_inv] with j hj_exp hj_J0 hj_inv
    intro v hv
    have hv_abs : |v| ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have hv_V : |v| ≤ V := abs_le.mpr hv
      have hj_cast : (J₀ : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hj_J0
      dsimp [V] at hv_V
      linarith
    let n := n_sel j
    have hn : N_env j ≤ n := hn_sel j
    let K_j := k_seq n - x_seq j
    have h_quot_eq :
        Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_j + v) / rowMomentFull S K_j) =
          m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) / m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j)) := by
      have hKv : K_j + v = k_seq n - (x_seq j - v) := by dsimp [K_j]; ring
      rw [hKv, h_row_eq n (x_seq j - v), h_row_eq n (x_seq j)]
      have hBn_pos : 0 < rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (h_basic n).2.2
      have hm0_half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m₀ j ≤ m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j)) := by
        rcases hN_spec j n hn with ⟨_, _, _, hI_err⟩
        have hD0_mem : Real.exp (x_seq j) ∈ I_j j := hD0_mem_all j
        have h_err := le_trans (hI_err (Real.exp (x_seq j)) hD0_mem) (min_le_left _ _)
        have h_low := (abs_le.mp h_err).1
        dsimp [δ₁] at h_low
        linarith
      have hm_seq0_pos : 0 < m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j)) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hm₀_pos j)) hm0_half
      have hexp_prod : Real.exp v * Real.exp (x_seq j - v) = Real.exp (x_seq j) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hexp_xj_ne : Real.exp (x_seq j) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
      calc Real.exp v *
            ((rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j - v) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v))) /
              (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j))))
          = (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * (Real.exp v * Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v))) /
              (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j))) := by ring
        _ = (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v))) /
              (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) *
                m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j))) := by rw [hexp_prod]
        _ = m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j - v)) / m_seq n (Real.exp (x_seq j)) := by
            field_simp [hBn_pos.ne', hexp_xj_ne, hm_seq0_pos.ne']
    have h_err_bound :
        dist (Real.exp (-Δ j (-v)))
          (Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_j + v) / rowMomentFull S K_j)) ≤
          1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm, hexp_Δ_eq j v, h_quot_eq]
      exact h_ratio_err j n hn v hv_abs
    calc dist (Real.exp (L_lim v))
          (Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_j + v) / rowMomentFull S K_j))
        ≤ dist (Real.exp (L_lim v)) (Real.exp (-Δ j (-v))) +
            dist (Real.exp (-Δ j (-v)))
              (Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_j + v) / rowMomentFull S K_j)) :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (hj_exp v hv) (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt h_err_bound hj_inv))
      _ = ε := add_halves ε

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_param_sSup : ∀ (K₀ : Set ℂ) (g : ℂ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ),
      IsCompact K₀ →
      ContinuousOn g (horizStrip S.H) →
      Continuous (Function.uncurry ψ) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ w ∈ K₀, ψ x w ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => sSup ((fun w : ℂ => g (ψ x w)) '' K₀)) := by
    intro K₀ g ψ hK₀ hg hψ_cont hψ_mem
    have : CompactSpace ↥K₀ := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hK₀
    let f_sub : ℝ → ↥K₀ → ℝ := fun x p => g (ψ x p.1)
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ↥K₀ => ψ q.1 q.2.1) :=
      hψ_cont.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))
    have hf_sub_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry f_sub) := by
      change Continuous (g ∘ fun q : ℝ × ↥K₀ => ψ q.1 q.2.1)
      exact hg.comp_continuous hΦ_cont (fun q => hψ_mem q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
    have h_univ_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => sSup (f_sub x '' (Set.univ : Set ↥K₀))) :=
      (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set ↥K₀)).continuous_sSup hf_sub_cont
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => sSup ((fun w : ℂ => g (ψ x w)) '' K₀)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => sSup (f_sub x '' (Set.univ : Set ↥K₀))) := by
      ext x
      congr 1
      change (fun w : ℂ => g (ψ x w)) '' K₀ =
        ((fun w : ℂ => g (ψ x w)) ∘ Subtype.val) '' (Set.univ : Set ↥K₀)
      rw [Set.image_comp, Subtype.coe_image_univ]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_univ_cont
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro d_a w hda hw_cont hw_per hw_nonneg hw_mean
    have hsinh_pos : 0 < Real.sinh d_a := Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr hda
    have hcosh_gt_one : 1 < Real.cosh d_a := Real.one_lt_cosh.mpr hda.ne'
    have hden_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos u := fun u => by
      have hcos := Real.cos_le_one u
      linarith
    have hker_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < periodicPoissonKernel d_a u := fun u =>
      div_pos hsinh_pos (hden_pos u)
    have hker_cont : Continuous (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) :=
      continuous_const.div (continuous_const.sub Real.continuous_cos) (fun u => (hden_pos u).ne')
    have hker_per : Function.Periodic (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) (2 * Real.pi) := fun u => by
      simp only [periodicPoissonKernel, Real.cos_periodic u]
    
    have hker_int : (∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) = 2 * Real.pi := by
      let r : ℝ := Real.exp (-d_a)
      have hr_pos : 0 < r := Real.exp_pos (-d_a)
      have hr_lt_one : r < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (neg_lt_zero.mpr hda)
      have h1mr_pos : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < 1 - r * Real.cos u := fun u => by
        have hcos := Real.cos_le_one u
        nlinarith
      let q_fn : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (r * Real.sin u) / (1 - r * Real.cos u)
      let F_ant : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => u + 2 * Real.arctan (q_fn u)
      have hF_deriv : ∀ u : ℝ, HasDerivAt F_ant (periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) u := by
        intro u
        have hnum_d : HasDerivAt (fun x => r * Real.sin x) (r * Real.cos u) u :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_sin u).const_mul r
        have hden_d : HasDerivAt (fun x => 1 - r * Real.cos x) (r * Real.sin u) u := by
          have h1 := (hasDerivAt_const u (1 : ℝ)).sub ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos u).const_mul r)
          convert h1 using 1
          ring
        have hq_d : HasDerivAt q_fn
            ((r * Real.cos u * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - r * Real.sin u * (r * Real.sin u)) /
              (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2) u :=
          hnum_d.div hden_d (h1mr_pos u).ne'
        have harc_d : HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.arctan (q_fn x))
            ((1 / (1 + q_fn u ^ 2)) *
              ((r * Real.cos u * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - r * Real.sin u * (r * Real.sin u)) /
                (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2)) u :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_arctan (q_fn u)).comp u hq_d
        have hF_raw : HasDerivAt F_ant
            (1 + 2 * ((1 / (1 + q_fn u ^ 2)) *
              ((r * Real.cos u * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - r * Real.sin u * (r * Real.sin u)) /
                (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2))) u :=
          (hasDerivAt_id u).add (harc_d.const_mul 2)
        convert hF_raw using 1
        have hD1_ne : 1 - r * Real.cos u ≠ 0 := (h1mr_pos u).ne'
        have hsc : Real.sin u ^ 2 + Real.cos u ^ 2 = 1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq u
        have hD2_pos : 0 < 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 := by
          have hsq : (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin u) ^ 2 =
              1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 := by
            linear_combination r ^ 2 * hsc
          have hpos1 : 0 < (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (h1mr_pos u)
          have hnn2 : 0 ≤ (r * Real.sin u) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
          linarith
        have hD2_ne : 1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2 ≠ 0 := hD2_pos.ne'
        have h1pq_pos : 0 < 1 + q_fn u ^ 2 := by positivity
        have h_alg1 :
            1 + 2 * ((1 / (1 + q_fn u ^ 2)) *
              ((r * Real.cos u * (1 - r * Real.cos u) - r * Real.sin u * (r * Real.sin u)) /
                (1 - r * Real.cos u) ^ 2)) =
            (1 - r ^ 2) / (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2) := by
          have h1pq_ne : 1 + (r * Real.sin u / (1 - r * Real.cos u)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
            h1pq_pos.ne'
          dsimp [q_fn]
          field_simp
          rw [Real.sin_sq u]
          ring
        have h_alg2 :
            periodicPoissonKernel d_a u = (1 - r ^ 2) / (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos u + r ^ 2) := by
          have hE_ne : Real.exp d_a ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos d_a).ne'
          have hden_ne : Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos u ≠ 0 := (hden_pos u).ne'
          dsimp [periodicPoissonKernel, r]
          rw [Real.sinh_eq, Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg]
          have hden2_ne : (Real.exp d_a + (Real.exp d_a)⁻¹) / 2 - Real.cos u ≠ 0 := by
            rwa [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.cosh_eq]
          have hD2_exp_ne : 1 - 2 * (Real.exp d_a)⁻¹ * Real.cos u + ((Real.exp d_a)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
            rwa [← Real.exp_neg]
          field_simp
          ring
        rw [h_alg1, h_alg2]
      have hint := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
        (fun u _ => hF_deriv u) (hker_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      rw [hint]
      dsimp [F_ant, q_fn]
      simp [Real.sin_zero, Real.sin_two_pi, Real.arctan_zero]
    
    let F_conv : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y
    have hF_conv_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F_conv) :=
      (hker_cont.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd)).mul (hw_cont.comp continuous_snd)
    have hν_cont : Continuous (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) :=
      continuous_const.mul
        (intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          hF_conv_cont 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    have hν_per : Function.Periodic (ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro x
      simp only [ancestorPoissonDensity]
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro y _
      dsimp only
      have hsub : x + 2 * Real.pi - y = (x - y) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      rw [hsub, hker_per (x - y)]
    have hν_nonneg : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x := fun x =>
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le)
        (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le
          (fun y _ => mul_nonneg (hker_pos (x - y)).le (hw_nonneg y)))
    
    have hν_mean :
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) = 1 := by
      let I_set : Set ℝ := Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
      have h_fub :
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y) =
          ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y := by
        have h_int_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry F_conv)
            ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod
              (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict I_set)) := by
          rw [Set.uIoc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict,
            ← MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod]
          have h_comp : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry F_conv)
              (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
              MeasureTheory.volume :=
            hF_conv_cont.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
          exact h_comp.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
        calc
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y)
              = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in I_set, F_conv x y := by
                apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
                intro x _
                exact intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le
          _ = ∫ y in I_set, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y :=
                MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap h_int_prod
          _ = ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y :=
                (intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le).symm
      have h_inner : ∀ y : ℝ,
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y) = (2 * Real.pi) * w y := by
        intro y
        dsimp [F_conv]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
          intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (periodicPoissonKernel d_a) y]
        have h_per_shift :
            (∫ u in (0 - y)..(2 * Real.pi - y), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u) =
            ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a u := by
          have h1 := hker_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-y) 0
          have he1 : 0 - y = -y := by ring
          have he2 : 2 * Real.pi - y = -y + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
          have he3 : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := zero_add _
          rw [he1, he2, h1, he3]
        rw [h_per_shift, hker_int]
      calc
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x)
            = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
                ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F_conv x y) := by
              simp only [ancestorPoissonDensity, F_conv, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
              ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (2 * Real.pi) * w y) := by
              rw [h_fub]
              simp_rw [h_inner]
        _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y := by
              rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
                inv_mul_cancel_left₀ Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
        _ = 1 := hw_mean
    
    refine ⟨hν_cont, hν_per, hν_nonneg, hν_mean, ?_⟩
    intro B h hB hh G hG_cont hG_per
    
    have hda_sq_le : d_a ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by
      have h_lt : d_a / 2 < Real.sinh (d_a / 2) :=
        Real.self_lt_sinh_iff.mpr (by linarith)
      have h_id : Real.cosh d_a - 1 = 2 * Real.sinh (d_a / 2) ^ 2 := by
        have hA_ne : Real.exp (d_a / 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos (d_a / 2)).ne'
        have hd_split : d_a = d_a / 2 + d_a / 2 := by ring
        conv_lhs => rw [hd_split]
        rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.sinh_eq, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg]
        field_simp
        ring
      nlinarith
    
    have hden_comp : ∀ v : ℝ,
        Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (v + h) ≤ 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos v) := by
      intro v
      have h_half : ∀ θ : ℝ, 1 - Real.cos θ = 2 * Real.sin (θ / 2) ^ 2 := fun θ => by
        have h2θ : 2 * (θ / 2) = θ := by ring
        have h1 := Real.cos_two_mul' (θ / 2)
        have h2 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (θ / 2)
        rw [h2θ] at h1
        linarith
      have h_sin_sum : |Real.sin ((v + h) / 2)| ≤ |Real.sin (v / 2)| + |h| / 2 := by
        have hsplit : (v + h) / 2 = v / 2 + h / 2 := by ring
        rw [hsplit, Real.sin_add]
        have hc1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one (h / 2)
        have hc2 := Real.abs_cos_le_one (v / 2)
        have hs2 : |Real.sin (h / 2)| ≤ |h| / 2 := by
          have hs := @Real.abs_sin_le_abs (h / 2)
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] at hs
          exact hs
        calc
          |Real.sin (v / 2) * Real.cos (h / 2) + Real.cos (v / 2) * Real.sin (h / 2)|
              ≤ |Real.sin (v / 2) * Real.cos (h / 2)| + |Real.cos (v / 2) * Real.sin (h / 2)| :=
                abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |Real.sin (v / 2)| * |Real.cos (h / 2)| + |Real.cos (v / 2)| * |Real.sin (h / 2)| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ |Real.sin (v / 2)| * 1 + 1 * (|h| / 2) := by
                gcongr
          _ = |Real.sin (v / 2)| + |h| / 2 := by ring
      have h_sin_sq : Real.sin ((v + h) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Real.sin (v / 2) ^ 2 + h ^ 2 / 2 := by
        have hnn : 0 ≤ |Real.sin ((v + h) / 2)| := abs_nonneg _
        have hsq1 : |Real.sin ((v + h) / 2)| ^ 2 ≤ (|Real.sin (v / 2)| + |h| / 2) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ hnn h_sin_sum 2
        rw [sq_abs] at hsq1
        have hsq2 : |Real.sin (v / 2)| ^ 2 = Real.sin (v / 2) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
        have hsq3 : |h| ^ 2 = h ^ 2 := sq_abs h
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|Real.sin (v / 2)| - |h| / 2)]
      have h_cos_shift : 1 - Real.cos (v + h) ≤ 2 * (1 - Real.cos v) + h ^ 2 := by
        have hh1 := h_half (v + h)
        have hh2 := h_half v
        linarith
      have hh_sq : h ^ 2 ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 * (Real.cosh d_a - 1) := by
        have h1 : |h| ^ 2 ≤ (B * d_a) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg h) hh 2
        rw [sq_abs] at h1
        nlinarith
      have hcos_v := Real.cos_le_one v
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg B]
    
    have hν_shift : ∀ u : ℝ,
        ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w (u - h) ≤
          2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w u := by
      intro u
      have hker_shift : ∀ y : ℝ,
          periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - h - y) * w y ≤
            2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - y) * w y) := by
        intro y
        have hd_ineq : Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (u - y) ≤
            2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos (u - h - y)) := by
          have hv := hden_comp (u - h - y)
          have hsub : u - h - y + h = u - y := by ring
          rwa [hsub] at hv
        have hk_ineq : periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - h - y) ≤
            2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - y) := by
          dsimp [periodicPoissonKernel]
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_div_iff₀ (hden_pos (u - h - y)) (hden_pos (u - y))]
          nlinarith
        calc
          periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - h - y) * w y
              ≤ (2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - y)) * w y :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk_ineq (hw_nonneg y)
          _ = 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - y) * w y) := by ring
      have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun y => periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - h - y) * w y)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        ((hker_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hw_cont).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun y => 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * (periodicPoissonKernel d_a (u - y) * w y))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (continuous_const.mul
          ((hker_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).mul hw_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have h_int_le := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.two_pi_pos.le hint1 hint2

      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_int_le
      dsimp [ancestorPoissonDensity]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_le (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le)
      linarith
    
    let g_int : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (G u) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w (u - h)
    have hg_per : Function.Periodic g_int (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro u
      dsimp [g_int]
      have hsub : u + 2 * Real.pi - h = (u - h) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      rw [hG_per u, hsub, hν_per (u - h)]
    have h_sub_eq :
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (G (x + h)) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) =
        ∫ u in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g_int u := by
      have hcongr : (fun x : ℝ => (G (x + h)) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w x) =
          (fun x : ℝ => g_int (x + h)) := by
        ext x
        dsimp [g_int]
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right]
      rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right g_int h]
      have hper := hg_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq h 0
      rw [zero_add h, add_comm (2 * Real.pi) h, hper, zero_add (2 * Real.pi)]
    have hg_cont : Continuous g_int :=
      (hG_cont.pow 2).mul (hν_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
    have hrhs_cont : Continuous (fun u => 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ((G u) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w u)) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((hG_cont.pow 2).mul hν_cont)
    have h_int_mono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.two_pi_pos.le
      (hg_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
      (hrhs_cont.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))

        calc
          (G u) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w (u - h)
              ≤ (G u) ^ 2 * (2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w u) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hν_shift u) (sq_nonneg (G u))
          _ = 2 * (1 + B ^ 2) * ((G u) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity d_a w u) := by ring)
    rw [h_sub_eq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at h_int_mono
    have h_final := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_mono (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le)
    linarith
  · 
    intro A k hA _hk
    have hM_cont : ContinuousOn (shapeModulus S) (horizStrip S.H) := by
      unfold shapeModulus
      exact continuous_max.comp_continuousOn
