          (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn S.q_holo.continuousOn.norm))
    have hM_per : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, shapeModulus S (z + 2 * Real.pi) = shapeModulus S z := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [shapeModulus, S.f_periodic z hz, S.q_periodic z hz]
    have hM_nonneg : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 ≤ shapeModulus S z := fun z =>
      le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _)
    let K₀ : Set ℂ := upperStripTile S A k 0
    have hTile_shift : ∀ x : ℝ, upperStripTile S A k x = (fun w : ℂ => (x : ℂ) + w) '' K₀ := by
      intro x
      ext s
      constructor
      · intro hs
        refine ⟨s - (x : ℂ), ?_, by ring⟩
        rcases hs with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [Complex.sub_im] using h1
        · simpa [wallDepth, Complex.sub_im] using h2
        · simpa [wallDepth, Complex.sub_im] using h3
        · simpa [wallDepth, Complex.sub_im, Complex.sub_re] using h4
      · rintro ⟨w, ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [Complex.add_im] using h1
        · simpa [wallDepth, Complex.add_im] using h2
        · simpa [wallDepth, Complex.add_im] using h3
        · have hre : (((x : ℂ) + w).re - x) = w.re - 0 := by simp [Complex.add_re]
          rw [hre]
          simpa [wallDepth, Complex.add_im] using h4
    have hTile_sub : ∀ x : ℝ, upperStripTile S A k x ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro x s hs
      rcases hs with ⟨him_nn, hdepth_lo, _, _⟩
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) := by positivity
      dsimp [wallDepth] at hdepth_lo
      dsimp [horizStrip]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg him_nn]
      linarith
    have hK₀_compact : IsCompact K₀ := by
      let K_big : Set ℂ :=
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) ''
          (Set.Icc (-(A * S.H)) (A * S.H) ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 S.H)
      have hK_big : IsCompact K_big :=
        (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
      have hK₀_closed : IsClosed K₀ := by
        have hc1 : IsClosed { w : ℂ | 0 ≤ w.im } :=
          isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
        have hc2 : IsClosed { w : ℂ | Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) ≤ wallDepth S w } :=
          isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im)
        have hc3 : IsClosed { w : ℂ | wallDepth S w ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-k)) } :=
          isClosed_le (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
        have hc4 : IsClosed { w : ℂ | |w.re - 0| ≤ A * wallDepth S w } :=
          isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
            (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))
        exact hc1.inter (hc2.inter (hc3.inter hc4))
      refine hK_big.of_isClosed_subset hK₀_closed ?_
      intro w hw
      rcases hw with ⟨him_nn, hdepth_lo, _, hre_bd⟩
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) := by positivity
      dsimp [wallDepth] at hdepth_lo hre_bd
      have him_le : w.im ≤ S.H := by linarith
      have hre_abs : |w.re| ≤ A * S.H := by
        rw [sub_zero] at hre_bd
        exact hre_bd.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hA)
      refine ⟨(w.re, w.im), ⟨?_, ⟨him_nn, him_le⟩⟩, Complex.re_add_im w⟩
      exact abs_le.mp hre_abs
    have hTile_img : ∀ x : ℝ,
        shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A k x =
          (fun w : ℂ => shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + w)) '' K₀ := by
      intro x
      rw [hTile_shift x, Set.image_image]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have h_sup_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A k x)) := by
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A k x)) =
            (fun x : ℝ => sSup ((fun w : ℂ => shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + w)) '' K₀)) := by
          ext x
          rw [hTile_img x]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_param_sSup K₀ (shapeModulus S) (fun x w => (x : ℂ) + w) hK₀_compact hM_cont
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add continuous_snd)
          (fun x w hw => hTile_sub x (by rw [hTile_shift x]; exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩))
      exact continuous_const.mul h_sup_cont
    · 
      intro x
      simp only [tileSupModulus, hTile_img]
      congr 2
      apply Set.image_congr
      intro w hw
      have hmem : (x : ℂ) + w ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
        hTile_sub x (by rw [hTile_shift x]; exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
      have hadd : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + w = ((x : ℂ) + w) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hadd, hM_per ((x : ℂ) + w) hmem]
    · 
      intro x
      apply mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos (-k)).le
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro v ⟨s, _, rfl⟩
      exact hM_nonneg s
    · 
      intro x s hs
      have hTile_comp : IsCompact (upperStripTile S A k x) := by
        rw [hTile_shift x]
        exact hK₀_compact.image (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      have hbdd : BddAbove (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A k x) :=
        hTile_comp.bddAbove_image (hM_cont.mono (hTile_sub x))
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_csSup hbdd ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩) (Real.exp_pos (-k)).le
  · 
    intro K hK _hKne hKsub d c hd _hc hKdepth
    let g_q : ℂ → ℝ := fun s => c * ‖S.q s‖
    let ψ_q : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ := fun x Z => (x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z

    have hψ_q_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ Z ∈ K, ψ_q x Z ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro x Z hZ

      have hdZ_lt : d * Z.im < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hd hZim
      have hdZ_gt : d * (-Z.im) < S.H := hKdepth Z hZ
      have him_eq : (ψ_q x Z).im = S.H + d * Z.im := by
        simp [ψ_q]
      dsimp [horizStrip]
      rw [him_eq, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    have h_sup_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        sSup ((fun Z : ℂ => c * ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) :=
      h_param_sSup K g_q ψ_q hK hg_q hψ_q_cont hψ_q_mem
    exact continuous_const.min h_sup_cont

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBoot : CriticalBootstrapPackage S)
    (hToolkit : SecondScaleKernelTileToolkit S)
    (k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ) (P' C_env2 : ℝ) (N_env : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hTuple : IsProhibitedCriticalTuple S k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq w_seq)
    (hP' : 1 ≤ P')
    (hC_env2 : 0 < C_env2)
    (hx_nonneg : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j)
    (hm_pos : ∀ D : ℝ, 0 < D → 0 < m D)
    (hN_env : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_env j,
      criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n - x_seq j ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k_seq n - x_seq j ∧
      2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (-(k_seq n - x_seq j)) ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) ∧
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) ≤
        rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) /
          (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j)) ∧
      IsCriticalEnvelope S (3 / 8) P' 1 C_env2
        (fun l => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n - x_seq j) *
          Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * max (k_seq n - x_seq j - l) 0 +
            P' * max (l - (k_seq n - x_seq j)) 0))) :
    ∃ (n_sel : ℕ → ℕ) (ξ_diag : ℕ → ℝ),
      StrictMono n_sel ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, N_env j ≤ n_sel j) ∧
      (∀ L : ℕ, 2 ≤ L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, L ≤ j → ∀ s : ℂ,
          Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) ≤ wallDepth S s →
          wallDepth S s ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) →
          |s.re - ξ_diag j| ≤ (L : ℝ) * wallDepth S s →
          (Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) /
            rowMomentFull S (k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
            C_L * (Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) / wallDepth S s) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∃ M_m : ℝ, 0 < M_m ∧
        ∀ j : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ W ∈ secondScaleCompactRect (2 * m),
          ‖((Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) /
              rowMomentFull S (k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            S.f ((ξ_diag j : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) : ℂ) * W)‖ ≤ M_m) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ j : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ Z ∈ secondScaleCompactRect m,
        ‖((Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) /
            rowMomentFull S (k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_diag j : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            (Real.exp (-(k_seq (n_sel j) - x_seq j)) : ℂ) * Z)‖ ≤
          1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_exp_k0 : Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) ≤ S.H / 20 := by
    have h1 : -Real.log (S.H / 20) ≤ criticalDepthThreshold S := le_max_right _ _
    have h2 : -criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ Real.log (S.H / 20) := by linarith
    calc Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S)
        ≤ Real.exp (Real.log (S.H / 20)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h2
      _ = S.H / 20 := Real.exp_log (by linarith [S.H_pos])
  
  have h_rect_props : ∀ m_idx : ℕ, 1 ≤ m_idx →
      IsCompact (secondScaleCompactRect m_idx) ∧
      (secondScaleCompactRect m_idx).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ Z ∈ secondScaleCompactRect m_idx, Z.im < 0 := by
    intro m_idx hm
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m_idx : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hm)
    have hm_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m_idx : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset
        (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * (m_idx : ℝ))) ?_ ?_
      · have hc1 : IsClosed {Z : ℂ | |Z.re| ≤ (m_idx : ℝ)} :=
          isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re) continuous_const
        have hc2 : IsClosed {Z : ℂ | -(m_idx : ℝ) ≤ Z.im} :=
          isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im
        have hc3 : IsClosed {Z : ℂ | Z.im ≤ -((m_idx : ℝ)⁻¹)} :=
          isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const
        exact hc1.inter (hc2.inter hc3)
      · intro Z hZ
        rcases hZ with ⟨hre, him1, him2⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        have h_im_neg : Z.im ≤ 0 := le_trans him2 (neg_nonpos.mpr (inv_nonneg.mpr hm_pos.le))
        have h_abs_im : |Z.im| ≤ (m_idx : ℝ) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonpos h_im_neg]
          linarith
        exact le_trans (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im Z) (by linarith)
    · refine ⟨-Complex.I, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [hm_pos.le]
      · simp; linarith
      · simp; exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hm_one
    · intro Z hZ
      have h_inv_pos : 0 < (m_idx : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hm_pos
      linarith [hZ.2.2]
  
  have h_cone_maj : ∀ (L : ℕ) (C_w C_t : ℝ), 2 ≤ L → 0 < C_w → 0 < C_t →
      ∃ D_L : ℝ, 0 < D_L ∧
        ∀ (K k_a B' : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
          criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_a → k_a ≤ K → 0 < B' →
          Continuous w → Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
          (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
          (∀ l : ℝ, k_a ≤ l → l ≤ K →
            Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (tileSupModulus S 2 l x) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
              C_w * B' * Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * (K - l))) →
          (∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l → l ≤ k_a →
            Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (tileSupModulus S (L : ℝ) l x) ^ 2 * ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
              C_t * B' * Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * (K - l))) →
          ∃ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous Ψ ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ψ x) ∧
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Ψ x * ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤ D_L ∧
            (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ s : ℂ,
              Real.exp (-K) ≤ wallDepth S s →
              wallDepth S s ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) →
              |s.re - x| ≤ (L : ℝ) * wallDepth S s →
              (Real.exp (-K) / B') * shapeModulus S s ≤
                Real.sqrt (Ψ x) * (Real.exp (-K) / wallDepth S s) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ)) := by

            simp only [s_fn, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
              Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
            ring
          change |(s_fn W).im| < S.H
          rw [him, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
          linarith
        have hg_cont : ContinuousOn
            (fun W : ℂ => (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 * ‖S.q (s_fn W)‖)
            (K_hat j m_idx) :=
          continuousOn_const.mul
            ((S.q_holo.continuousOn.comp
              ((continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn)
              hs_maps).norm)
        exact (h_comp.image_of_continuousOn hg_cont).bddAbove
      refine ⟨hq_cont, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x
        rcases h_ne with ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩
        have h0_le : 0 ≤ sSup ((fun W : ℂ => (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖) '' K_hat j m_idx) :=
          le_trans (by positivity) (le_csSup (hq_bdd x) ⟨W₀, hW₀, rfl⟩)
        exact le_min zero_le_one h0_le
      · intro x hx_lt Z hZ
        have hδ_le_half : δ_q j m_idx ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
        have hδ_le_c : δ_q j m_idx ≤ 1 / (2 * c_j j * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
        have hsup_lt : sSup ((fun W : ℂ => (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖) '' K_hat j m_idx) < δ_q j m_idx := by
          dsimp [q_raw, B_n] at hx_lt
          rcases min_lt_iff.mp hx_lt with h1 | h2
          · linarith
          · exact h2
        let W : ℂ := (Real.exp (x_seq j) : ℂ) * Z
        have hW_mem : W ∈ K_hat j m_idx := ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
        have hW_val_le : (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖ ≤ δ_q j m_idx :=
          le_trans (le_csSup (hq_bdd x) ⟨W, hW_mem, rfl⟩) hsup_lt.le
        have h_pt_eq : (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W = (Real.exp (-K) : ℂ) * Z := by
          dsimp [W, K]
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
          congr 2; ring
        have h_pref : (Real.exp (-K) / B') ^ 2 ≤
            c_j j * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 := by
          have hm_j_pos : 0 < m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) :=
            hm_pos (Real.exp (x_seq j)) (Real.exp_pos _)
          have h1 : Real.exp (-K) / B' ≤
              (2 / m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) := by
            rw [div_le_iff₀ hB'_pos]
            have hexpK : Real.exp (-K) = Real.exp (-k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) := by
              dsimp [K]; rw [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add, neg_neg, Real.exp_add]
            rw [hexpK]
            calc (2 / m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) * B'
                ≥ (2 / m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) *
                    ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) * (B_n * Real.exp (x_seq j))) :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_B' (by positivity)
              _ = Real.exp (-k_seq n) * Real.exp (x_seq j) := by
                  field_simp [hm_j_pos.ne', hBn_pos.ne']
          have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h1 2
          refine le_trans hsq (le_of_eq ?_)
          dsimp [c_j]; ring
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),
          ← h_pt_eq]
        calc (Real.exp (-K) / B') ^ 2 *
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖
            ≤ (c_j j * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2) *
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pref (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = c_j j * ((Real.exp (-k_seq n) / B_n) ^ 2 *
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * W)‖) := by ring
          _ ≤ c_j j * δ_q j m_idx :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW_val_le (hc_j_pos j).le
          _ ≤ c_j j * (1 / (2 * c_j j * ((j : ℝ) + 1))) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_le_c (hc_j_pos j).le
          _ = 1 / (2 * ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
              have hc_ne : c_j j ≠ 0 := (hc_j_pos j).ne'
              have hj_ne : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
              field_simp [hc_ne, hj_ne]
          _ ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
              have hj_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
              exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_one hj_pos (by linarith)
    
    let G1 : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ L ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (j + 2), Ψ_fn L x / A_cone L
    let G2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1), Φ_fn m_idx x / B_rect m_idx
    let G3 : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑ m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1), q_raw n j m_idx x / δ_q j m_idx
    let G_j : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => G1 x + G2 x + G3 x
    have hG1_cont : Continuous G1 := continuous_finsetSum _ fun L hL =>
      (hΨ_fn L hL).1.div_const _
    have hG2_cont : Continuous G2 := continuous_finsetSum _ fun m_idx hm =>
      (hΦ_fn m_idx hm).1.div_const _
    have hG3_cont : Continuous G3 := continuous_finsetSum _ fun m_idx hm =>
      (hq_props m_idx hm).1.div_const _
    have hG1_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ G1 x := fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun L hL =>
      div_nonneg ((hΨ_fn L hL).2.1 x) (hA_cone_pos L).le
    have hG2_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ G2 x := fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun m_idx hm =>
      div_nonneg ((hΦ_fn m_idx hm).2.1 x) (hB_rect_pos m_idx).le
    have hG3_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ G3 x := fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun m_idx hm =>
      div_nonneg ((hq_props m_idx hm).2.1 x) (hδ_q_pos j m_idx).le
    have hG1_int : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G1 x * ν x) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have h_eq : (fun x => G1 x * ν x) =
          (fun x => ∑ L ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (j + 2), (A_cone L)⁻¹ * (Ψ_fn L x * ν x)) := by
        ext x; simp only [G1, Finset.sum_mul, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum, Finset.mul_sum]
      · refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun L hL => ?_) (h_dyadic_sum 2 (j + 2))
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹, mul_assoc]
        calc (A_cone L)⁻¹ * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Ψ_fn L x * ν x)
            ≤ (A_cone L)⁻¹ * D_L L :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΨ_fn L hL).2.2.1 (inv_nonneg.mpr (hA_cone_pos L).le)
          _ = 1 / (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ L) := by
              have hD_ne : D_L L ≠ 0 := (hD_L_pos L).ne'
              dsimp [A_cone]; field_simp [hD_ne]
      · intro L hL
        exact (continuous_const.mul (((hΨ_fn L hL).1).mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hG2_int : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G2 x * ν x) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have h_eq : (fun x => G2 x * ν x) =
          (fun x => ∑ m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1), (B_rect m_idx)⁻¹ * (Φ_fn m_idx x * ν x)) := by
        ext x; simp only [G2, Finset.sum_mul, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum, Finset.mul_sum]
      · refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m_idx hm => ?_) (h_dyadic_sum 1 (j + 1))
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹, mul_assoc]
        calc (B_rect m_idx)⁻¹ *
              ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ_fn m_idx x * ν x)
            ≤ (B_rect m_idx)⁻¹ * M_star m_idx :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΦ_fn m_idx hm).2.2.1
                (inv_nonneg.mpr (hB_rect_pos m_idx).le)
          _ = 1 / (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_idx) := by
              have hM_ne : M_star m_idx ≠ 0 := (hM_star_pos m_idx).ne'
              dsimp [B_rect]; field_simp [hM_ne]
      · intro m_idx hm
        exact (continuous_const.mul (((hΦ_fn m_idx hm).1).mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hG3_int : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G3 x * ν x) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have h_eq : (fun x => G3 x * ν x) =
          (fun x => ∑ m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1),
            (δ_q j m_idx)⁻¹ * (q_raw n j m_idx x * ν x)) := by
        ext x; simp only [G3, Finset.sum_mul, div_eq_inv_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [h_eq, intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum, Finset.mul_sum]
      · refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m_idx hm => ?_) (h_dyadic_sum 1 (j + 1))
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹, mul_assoc]
        calc (δ_q j m_idx)⁻¹ *
              ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q_raw n j m_idx x * ν x)
            ≤ (δ_q j m_idx)⁻¹ * (δ_q j m_idx / (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_idx)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq_int m_idx hm)
                (inv_nonneg.mpr (hδ_q_pos j m_idx).le)
          _ = 1 / (8 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m_idx) := by
              have hδ_ne : δ_q j m_idx ≠ 0 := (hδ_q_pos j m_idx).ne'
              field_simp [hδ_ne]
      · intro m_idx hm
        exact (continuous_const.mul (((hq_props m_idx hm).1).mul hν_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hGj_int : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_j x * ν x) ≤ 3 / 4 := by
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => G1 x * ν x) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (hG1_cont.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => G2 x * ν x) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (hG2_cont.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hi3 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => G3 x * ν x) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        (hG3_cont.mul hν_cont).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hi12 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => G1 x * ν x + G2 x * ν x)
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := hi1.add hi2
      have h_add : (fun x => G_j x * ν x) =
          (fun x => (G1 x * ν x + G2 x * ν x) + G3 x * ν x) := by
        ext x; dsimp [G_j]; ring
      rw [h_add, intervalIntegral.integral_add hi12 hi3, intervalIntegral.integral_add hi1 hi2]
      linarith
    have h_ex_ξ : ∃ ξ : ℝ, G_j ξ < 1 := by
      by_contra h_all
      simp only [not_exists, not_lt] at h_all
      have h_mono : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ν x) ≤
          (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_j x * ν x) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.two_pi_pos.le
          (hν_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (((hG1_cont.add hG2_cont).add hG3_cont).mul hν_cont |>.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (fun x _ => le_mul_of_one_le_left (hν_nonneg x) (h_all x))
      have h1_le : 1 ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G_j x * ν x) := by
        rw [← hν_int1]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mono (by positivity)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_lt⟩ := h_ex_ξ
    refine ⟨ξ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro L hL s h_lo h_hi h_cone
      have h_term : Ψ_fn L ξ / A_cone L ≤ G1 ξ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun L' => Ψ_fn L' ξ / A_cone L')
          (fun L' hL' => div_nonneg ((hΨ_fn L' hL').2.1 ξ) (hA_cone_pos L').le) hL
      have h_le1 : Ψ_fn L ξ / A_cone L ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp [G_j] at hξ_lt
        linarith [hG2_nn ξ, hG3_nn ξ]
      have hΨ_le : Ψ_fn L ξ ≤ A_cone L := by
        rwa [div_le_one (hA_cone_pos L)] at h_le1
      have hwd_pos : 0 < wallDepth S s := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) h_lo
      exact le_trans ((hΨ_fn L hL).2.2.2 ξ s h_lo h_hi h_cone)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hΨ_le)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hwd_pos.le) _))
    · intro m_idx hm W hW
      have h_term : Φ_fn m_idx ξ / B_rect m_idx ≤ G2 ξ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m' => Φ_fn m' ξ / B_rect m')
          (fun m' hm' => div_nonneg ((hΦ_fn m' hm').2.1 ξ) (hB_rect_pos m').le) hm
      have h_le1 : Φ_fn m_idx ξ / B_rect m_idx ≤ 1 := by
        dsimp [G_j] at hξ_lt
        linarith [hG1_nn ξ, hG3_nn ξ]
      have hΦ_le : Φ_fn m_idx ξ ≤ B_rect m_idx := by
        rwa [div_le_one (hB_rect_pos m_idx)] at h_le1
      exact le_trans ((hΦ_fn m_idx hm).2.2.2 ξ W hW) (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hΦ_le)
    · intro m_idx hm Z hZ
      have h_term : q_raw n j m_idx ξ / δ_q j m_idx ≤ G3 ξ :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m' => q_raw n j m' ξ / δ_q j m')
          (fun m' hm' => div_nonneg ((hq_props m' hm').2.1 ξ) (hδ_q_pos j m').le) hm
      have h_lt1 : q_raw n j m_idx ξ / δ_q j m_idx < 1 := by
        dsimp [G_j] at hξ_lt
        linarith [hG1_nn ξ, hG2_nn ξ]
      have hq_lt : q_raw n j m_idx ξ < δ_q j m_idx :=
        (div_lt_one (hδ_q_pos j m_idx)).mp h_lt1
      exact (hq_props m_idx hm).2.2 ξ hq_lt Z hZ
  choose ξ_diag hξ_diag using h_center_each_j
  refine ⟨n_sel, ξ_diag, hn_sel_strict, hn_sel_ge_env, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L hL
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (A_cone L), Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hA_cone_pos L), ?_⟩
    intro j hj s h1 h2 h3
    have hL_mem : L ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (j + 2) := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hL, by omega⟩
    exact (hξ_diag j).1 L hL_mem s h1 h2 h3
  · intro m_idx hm
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (B_rect m_idx), Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hB_rect_pos m_idx), ?_⟩
    intro j hj W hW
    have hm_mem : m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1) := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm, by omega⟩
    exact (hξ_diag j).2.1 m_idx hm_mem W hW
  · intro m_idx hm j hj Z hZ
    have hm_mem : m_idx ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (j + 1) := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm, by omega⟩
    exact (hξ_diag j).2.2 m_idx hm_mem Z hZ

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBoot : CriticalBootstrapPackage S)
    (L_lim : ℝ → ℝ) (lam P' C_env2 : ℝ) (K_diag ξ_diag : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hlam : 1 ≤ lam)
    (hP' : 1 ≤ P')
    (hC_env2 : 0 < C_env2)
    (hL_cont : Continuous L_lim)
    (hL_zero : L_lim 0 = 0)
    (hL_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atTop (nhds lam))
    (hL_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atBot (nhds lam))
    (hK_basic : ∀ j : ℕ,
      criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_diag j ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ K_diag j ∧
      2 * ((j : ℝ) + 2) * Real.exp (-K_diag j) ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) ∧
      (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (K_diag j))
    (h_mom : TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun j v =>
        Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_diag j + v) / rowMomentFull S (K_diag j)))
      (fun v => Real.exp (L_lim v)) Filter.atTop)
    (h_env : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
      rowMomentFull S l ≤
        C_env2 * rowMomentFull S (K_diag j) *
          Real.exp ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * max (K_diag j - l) 0 + P' * max (l - K_diag j) 0))
    (h_cone : ∀ L : ℕ, 2 ≤ L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, L ≤ j → ∀ s : ℂ,
        Real.exp (-K_diag j) ≤ wallDepth S s →
        wallDepth S s ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-criticalDepthThreshold S) →
        |s.re - ξ_diag j| ≤ (L : ℝ) * wallDepth S s →
        (Real.exp (-K_diag j) / rowMomentFull S (K_diag j)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
          C_L * (Real.exp (-K_diag j) / wallDepth S s) ^ (9 / 16 : ℝ))
    (hF_bdd : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∃ M_m : ℝ, 0 < M_m ∧
      ∀ j : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ W ∈ secondScaleCompactRect (2 * m),
        ‖((Real.exp (-K_diag j) / rowMomentFull S (K_diag j) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_diag j : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
            (Real.exp (-K_diag j) : ℂ) * W)‖ ≤ M_m)
    (hQ_vanish : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ j : ℕ, m ≤ j → ∀ Z ∈ secondScaleCompactRect m,
      ‖((Real.exp (-K_diag j) / rowMomentFull S (K_diag j) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        S.q ((ξ_diag j : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (Real.exp (-K_diag j) : ℂ) * Z)‖ ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) :
    Nonempty (SecondScaleFirstFieldData S)

  have hK_compact : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → IsCompact (secondScaleCompactRect m) := by
    intro m hm
    have h_closed : IsClosed (secondScaleCompactRect m) :=
      (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_re) continuous_const).inter
        ((isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
          (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const))
    have h_bdd : Bornology.IsBounded (secondScaleCompactRect m) := by
      rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : ℂ)]
      refine ⟨2 * (m : ℝ), fun Z hZ => ?_⟩
      rcases hZ with ⟨h_re, h_im_lo, h_im_hi⟩
      have hm_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      have h_inv_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((m : ℝ))⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hm_nonneg
      have h_im_abs : |Z.im| ≤ (m : ℝ) := abs_le.mpr ⟨h_im_lo, by linarith⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      linarith [Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im Z]

  have hK_convex : ∀ m : ℕ, Convex ℝ (secondScaleCompactRect m) := by
    intro m Z₁ hZ₁ Z₂ hZ₂ a b ha hb hab
    rcases hZ₁ with ⟨h1_re, h1_lo, h1_hi⟩
    rcases hZ₂ with ⟨h2_re, h2_lo, h2_hi⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,

      calc |a * Z₁.re + b * Z₂.re|
          ≤ |a * Z₁.re| + |b * Z₂.re| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |Z₁.re| + b * |Z₂.re| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
        _ ≤ a * (m : ℝ) + b * (m : ℝ) := by nlinarith
        _ = (m : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
      nlinarith
    · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
      nlinarith
  have h_cushion : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → ∀ Z ∈ secondScaleCompactRect m,

    intro m hm Z hZ

    have hm_ge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.one_le_cast.mpr hm
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hr_le_half : 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by

      linarith
    constructor
    · intro W hW
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hW

      have h_im_diff := abs_le.mp (le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (W - Z)) hW)
      have hZ_re_bds := abs_le.mp hZ_re

      simp only [Complex.sub_im] at h_im_diff
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]

      · rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        linarith
      · rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]

          ring

    · intro W hW

      simp only [Complex.sub_im] at h_im_diff
      have h_top : -((m : ℝ)⁻¹) + 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ)) = -((2 * (m : ℝ))⁻¹) := by
        field_simp [hm_pos.ne']
        ring
      have h_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (2 * (m : ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity

  have h_step : ∀ (k : ℕ) (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ →
      ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∃ L_m : ℂ → ℂ,

    intro k φ hφ

    have hm : 1 ≤ m := Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le k)
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
    let r_m : ℝ := 1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_m := by positivity

    have : CompactSpace ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) :=

    let G_sub : ℕ → ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) → ℂ :=

    have hG_lip : ∀ j : ℕ, LipschitzWith L_lip.toNNReal (G_sub j) := by
      intro j
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' fun x y => ?_
      dsimp only [G_sub]
      split_ifs with hj
      · rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]

      intro j x
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [G_sub]
      split_ifs with hj
      · exact hMm_bdd j hj x.1 ((h_cushion m hm x.1 x.2).1 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_pos.le))
      · rw [norm_zero]
        exact hMm_pos.le
    let g_bcf : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) ℂ :=
      fun j => BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨G_sub j, (hG_lip j).continuous⟩
    have hg_coe : ∀ j : ℕ, (g_bcf j : ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) → ℂ) = G_sub j := by
      intro j
      ext x
      simp [g_bcf]
    let A_set : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) ℂ) :=

      refine BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli

      have h_eq1 : (fun n => (g_bcf (φ (ψ n)) : ↥(secondScaleCompactRect m) → ℂ)) =

    have h_unif_G : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n z => if m ≤ φ (ψ n) then F_diag (φ (ψ n)) z else 0)

    intro ε hε

  let Φ : ℕ → { φ : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono φ } := fun k =>

        ⟨prev.1 ∘ ψ, prev.2.comp (Classical.choose_spec (h_step r prev.1 prev.2)).1⟩) k
  let τ : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => (Φ (n + 1)).1 n

    refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => ?_

    intro k d

      intro r

    | succ d ih =>
      intro r
      let ψ := Classical.choose (h_step (k + d) (Φ (k + d)).1 (Φ (k + d)).2)
      have hψ : StrictMono ψ :=
        (Classical.choose_spec (h_step (k + d) (Φ (k + d)).1 (Φ (k + d)).2)).1
      obtain ⟨s, hs_le, hs_eq⟩ := ih (ψ r)
      exact ⟨s, le_trans (hψ.id_le r) hs_le, hs_eq⟩
  let F : ℂ → ℂ := fun Z => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n => F_diag (τ n) Z)
  have hF_unif_rect : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n Z => F_diag (τ n) Z) F Filter.atTop (secondScaleCompactRect m) := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    let ψ_k := Classical.choose (h_step k (Φ k).1 (Φ k).2)
    obtain ⟨L_k, hL_k⟩ := (Classical.choose_spec (h_step k (Φ k).1 (Φ k).2)).2
    have h_tier_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n Z => F_diag (τ n) Z) L_k Filter.atTop
        (secondScaleCompactRect (k + 1)) := by
      rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hL_k ⊢
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hL_k ε hε)
      refine Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨max k S₀, fun n hn Z hZ => ?_⟩
      have hk_le : k ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hS_le : S₀ ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
      have h_idx_eq : n + 1 = (k + 1) + (n - k) := by omega
      obtain ⟨s, hs_ge, hs_eq⟩ := h_sub_val (k + 1) (n - k) n
      have hτ_eq : τ n = (Φ (k + 1)).1 s := by
        dsimp only [τ]
        rw [h_idx_eq]
        exact hs_eq
      rw [hτ_eq]
      exact hS₀ s (le_trans hS_le hs_ge) Z hZ
    have hF_eq_Lk : ∀ Z ∈ secondScaleCompactRect (k + 1), F Z = L_k Z := fun Z hZ =>
      (h_tier_unif.tendsto_at hZ).limUnder_eq
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h_tier_unif ⊢
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [h_tier_unif ε hε] with n hn Z hZ

    have h_not_freq : ¬ ∃ᶠ w in nhdsWithin z₀ {z₀}ᶜ, F w = 0 := by
      intro h_freq
      have h_eq0 := hF_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero hH_preconn hz₀ h_freq
      rcases hF_nonzero with ⟨z_nz, hz_mem, hz_nz⟩
      exact hz_nz (h_eq0 hz_mem)
    rw [Filter.not_frequently] at h_not_freq
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp h_not_freq
    let r : ℝ := min ((-z₀.im) / 4) (δ₁ / 2)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have hr_le_im : r ≤ (-z₀.im) / 4 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_le_δ : r ≤ δ₁ / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    let m : ℕ := max 1 (Nat.ceil (-z₀.im) + 1)
    have hm : 1 ≤ m := le_max_left 1 _
    have hm_gt_im : -z₀.im < (m : ℝ) := by
      calc -z₀.im ≤ (Nat.ceil (-z₀.im) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
        _ < (Nat.ceil (-z₀.im) : ℝ) + 1 := lt_add_one _
        _ = ((Nat.ceil (-z₀.im) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := (Nat.cast_add_one _).symm
        _ ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_max_right 1 _)
    let U_ball : Set ℂ := Metric.ball z₀ (2 * r)
    have hU_ball_sub_Um : U_ball ⊆ U_strip m := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      have h_im_diff := abs_le.mp (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - z₀)) hw))
      simp only [Complex.sub_im] at h_im_diff
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hUm_sub_H : U_strip m ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane := fun _ hw => hw.2
    have h_cball_sub_Uball : Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ U_ball :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have h_cball_sub_Um : Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ U_strip m :=
      Subset.trans h_cball_sub_Uball hU_ball_sub_Um
    have h_ball_sub_H : Metric.ball z₀ r ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane :=
      Subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Subset.trans h_cball_sub_Um hUm_sub_H)
    have hF_punct_nz : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, w ≠ z₀ → F w ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw hw_ne
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hw
      have hw_ball : w ∈ Metric.ball z₀ δ₁ := Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hw (by linarith))
      exact hδ₁ ⟨hw_ball, Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mpr hw_ne⟩
    
    have hF_conv_ball : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F_seq F Filter.atTop U_ball :=
      hF_conv.mono (Subset.trans hU_ball_sub_Um hUm_sub_H)
    have hF_seq_diff : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_seq n) U_ball :=
      Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨m, fun n hn =>
        ((h_strip m hm (τ n) (le_trans hn (hτ.id_le n))).1).mono hU_ball_sub_Um⟩
    have h_d1_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (deriv ∘ F_seq) (deriv F) Filter.atTop U_ball :=
      hF_conv_ball.deriv hF_seq_diff Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hF_seq_d1_diff : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, DifferentiableOn ℂ ((deriv ∘ F_seq) n) U_ball :=
      hF_seq_diff.mono fun n hn => hn.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball
    have h_d2_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn (deriv ∘ (deriv ∘ F_seq)) (deriv (deriv F))
        Filter.atTop U_ball :=
      h_d1_conv.deriv hF_seq_d1_diff Metric.isOpen_ball
    
    have hSr_comp : IsCompact (Metric.sphere z₀ r) := isCompact_sphere z₀ r
    have hSr_ne : (Metric.sphere z₀ r).Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr hr_pos.le
    have hSr_sub_Uball : Metric.sphere z₀ r ⊆ U_ball :=
      Subset.trans Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall h_cball_sub_Uball
    have hSr_sub_H : Metric.sphere z₀ r ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane :=
      Subset.trans hSr_sub_Uball (Subset.trans hU_ball_sub_Um hUm_sub_H)
    obtain ⟨w_min, hw_min_mem, hw_min⟩ := hSr_comp.exists_isMinOn hSr_ne
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hF_holo.continuousOn.mono hSr_sub_H))
    let m_sph : ℝ := ‖F w_min‖
    have hm_sph_pos : 0 < m_sph := by
      have hw_ne : w_min ≠ z₀ := by
        intro h_eq
        have h_dist : dist w_min z₀ = r := Metric.mem_sphere.mp hw_min_mem
        rw [h_eq, dist_self] at h_dist
        linarith
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (hF_punct_nz w_min (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw_min_mem) hw_ne)
    obtain ⟨w_max, _hw_max_mem, hw_max⟩ := hSr_comp.exists_isMaxOn hSr_ne
      (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (hF_d2_holo.continuousOn.mono hSr_sub_H))
    let M_d2 : ℝ := ‖deriv (deriv F) w_max‖
    have hF_unif_Sr := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
      hF_conv_ball (Metric.sphere z₀ r) hSr_sub_Uball hSr_comp
    have hd2_unif_Sr := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
      h_d2_conv (Metric.sphere z₀ r) hSr_sub_Uball hSr_comp
    obtain ⟨N_a, hN_a⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hF_unif_Sr (m_sph / 2) (by positivity))
    obtain ⟨N_b, hN_b⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp hd2_unif_Sr 1 zero_lt_one)
    let N₁ : ℕ := max m (max N_a N_b)
    let M_q : ℝ := (M_d2 + 1) / (m_sph / 2)
    have hq_ball_bdd : ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖q_seq n w‖ ≤ M_q := by
      intro n hn
      have hm_le_n : m ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
      have hNa_le_n : N_a ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
      have hNb_le_n : N_b ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
      rcases h_strip m hm (τ n) (le_trans hm_le_n (hτ.id_le n)) with ⟨_, hq_holo_n, h_ode_n⟩
      have hq_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (q_seq n) (Metric.ball z₀ r) := by
        refine (hq_holo_n.mono ?_).diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball z₀ hr_pos.ne']
        exact h_cball_sub_Um
      have hq_front : ∀ w ∈ frontier (Metric.ball z₀ r), ‖q_seq n w‖ ≤ M_q := by
        rw [frontier_ball z₀ hr_pos.ne']
        intro w hw
        have hF_min_w : m_sph ≤ ‖F w‖ := isMinOn_iff.mp hw_min w hw
        have hF_dist_w : ‖F w - F_seq n w‖ < m_sph / 2 := by
          simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hN_a n hNa_le_n w hw
        have hFn_gt : m_sph / 2 < ‖F_seq n w‖ := by
          linarith [norm_sub_norm_le (F w) (F_seq n w)]
        have hd2_max_w : ‖deriv (deriv F) w‖ ≤ M_d2 := isMaxOn_iff.mp hw_max w hw
        have hd2_dist_w : ‖deriv (deriv F) w - deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w‖ < 1 := by
          simpa only [Function.comp_apply, dist_eq_norm] using hN_b n hNb_le_n w hw
        have h_rev : ‖deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w - deriv (deriv F) w‖ < 1 := by
          rwa [norm_sub_rev]
        have hd2n_le : ‖deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w‖ ≤ M_d2 + 1 := by
          linarith [norm_sub_norm_le (deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w) (deriv (deriv F) w)]
        have hw_Um : w ∈ U_strip m := h_cball_sub_Um (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
        have h_prod_norm : ‖deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w‖ = ‖q_seq n w‖ * ‖F_seq n w‖ := by
          rw [h_ode_n w hw_Um, norm_mul]
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        calc ‖q_seq n w‖ * (m_sph / 2) ≤ ‖q_seq n w‖ * ‖F_seq n w‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFn_gt.le (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = ‖deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w‖ := h_prod_norm.symm
          _ ≤ M_d2 + 1 := hd2n_le
      intro w hw
      rw [← closure_ball z₀ hr_pos.ne'] at hw
      exact Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le Metric.isBounded_ball hq_dc hq_front hw
    
    have h_bdd_punct : BddAbove
        (norm ∘ (fun w => deriv (deriv F) w / F w) '' (Metric.ball z₀ r \ {z₀})) := by
      refine ⟨M_q, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨hw_ball, hw_not_mem⟩, rfl⟩
      have hw_ne : w ≠ z₀ := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hw_not_mem
      have hw_cball : w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw_ball
      have hw_Uball : w ∈ U_ball := h_cball_sub_Uball hw_cball
      have hFw_nz : F w ≠ 0 := hF_punct_nz w hw_cball hw_ne
      have h_unif_w1 := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
        hF_conv_ball {w} (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hw_Uball) isCompact_singleton
      have h_unif_w2 := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact Metric.isOpen_ball).mp
        h_d2_conv {w} (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hw_Uball) isCompact_singleton
      have h_tends_F : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F_seq n w) Filter.atTop (nhds (F w)) :=
        h_unif_w1.tendsto_at (Set.mem_singleton w)
      have h_tends_d2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (deriv (deriv F) w)) :=
        h_unif_w2.tendsto_at (Set.mem_singleton w)
      have h_tends_div : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w / F_seq n w)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (deriv (deriv F) w / F w)) :=
        h_tends_d2.div h_tends_F hFw_nz
      have h_ev_le : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, ‖deriv (deriv (F_seq n)) w / F_seq n w‖ ≤ M_q := by
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N₁, h_tends_F.eventually_ne hFw_nz] with n hn hFn_nz
        have hm_le_n : m ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn
        have h_ode_w := (h_strip m hm (τ n) (le_trans hm_le_n (hτ.id_le n))).2.2 w
          (h_cball_sub_Um hw_cball)
        rw [h_ode_w, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hFn_nz]
        exact hq_ball_bdd n hn w hw_cball
      exact le_of_tendsto (continuous_norm.continuousAt.tendsto.comp h_tends_div) h_ev_le
    have h_punct_sub_H : Metric.ball z₀ r \ {z₀} ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane :=
      fun _ hw => h_ball_sub_H hw.1
    have h_div_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => deriv (deriv F) w / F w)
        (Metric.ball z₀ r \ {z₀}) :=
      (hF_d2_holo.mono h_punct_sub_H).div (hF_holo.mono h_punct_sub_H) fun w hw =>
        hF_punct_nz w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw.1) (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hw.2)
    have h_upd_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (Function.update (fun w => deriv (deriv F) w / F w) z₀ (Q_lim z₀))
        (Metric.ball z₀ r) :=
      Complex.differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_bddAbove
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ hr_pos) h_div_diff h_bdd_punct
    have hQ_ball : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_lim (Metric.ball z₀ r) := by
      refine h_upd_diff.congr fun w hw => ?_
      by_cases hw_eq : w = z₀
      · subst hw_eq
        simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hw_eq]
        exact hQ_eq_div w (h_ball_sub_H hw)
          (hF_punct_nz w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw) hw_eq)
    exact ⟨r, hr_pos, h_ball_sub_H, hF_punct_nz, hQ_ball⟩
  have hQ_lim_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_lim criticalLowerHalfPlane := by
    intro z₀ hz₀
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, _, _, hQ_ball⟩ := hQ_local z₀ hz₀
    exact (hQ_ball.differentiableAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos))).differentiableWithinAt
  have hderiv2_F : ∀ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, deriv (deriv F) z = Q_lim z * F z := by
    intro z₀ hz₀
    obtain ⟨r, hr_pos, h_ball_sub_H, hF_punct_nz, _⟩ := hQ_local z₀ hz₀
    let w_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => z₀ + (((r / 2) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hw_mem : ∀ k : ℕ, w_seq k ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r ∧ w_seq k ≠ z₀ := by
      intro k
      let δ_k : ℝ := (r / 2) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
      have hδ_k_pos : 0 < δ_k := by positivity
      have hk_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
        linarith
      have hδ_k_lt : δ_k < r := by
        calc δ_k ≤ r / 2 := div_le_self (by positivity) hk_ge_one
          _ < r := by linarith
      constructor
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have h_sub : w_seq k - z₀ = ((δ_k : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp [w_seq, δ_k]
        rw [h_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hδ_k_pos.le]
        exact hδ_k_lt
      · intro h_eq
        have h_zero : ((δ_k : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by
          have : z₀ + ((δ_k : ℝ) : ℂ) = z₀ + 0 := by simpa [w_seq, δ_k] using h_eq
          exact add_left_cancel this
        exact hδ_k_pos.ne' (Complex.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h_zero)
    have hw_ode : ∀ k : ℕ, deriv (deriv F) (w_seq k) = Q_lim (w_seq k) * F (w_seq k) := by
      intro k
      rcases hw_mem k with ⟨hk_ball, hk_ne⟩
      have hFw_nz : F (w_seq k) ≠ 0 :=
        hF_punct_nz (w_seq k) (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hk_ball) hk_ne
      rw [hQ_eq_div (w_seq k) (h_ball_sub_H hk_ball) hFw_nz, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hFw_nz]
    have hw_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto w_seq Filter.atTop (nhds z₀) := by
      rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
      intro ε hε
      refine ⟨Nat.ceil ((r / 2) / ε), fun k hk => ?_⟩
      let δ_k : ℝ := (r / 2) / ((k : ℝ) + 1)
      have hδ_k_pos : 0 < δ_k := by positivity
      have h_sub : w_seq k - z₀ = ((δ_k : ℝ) : ℂ) := by simp [w_seq, δ_k]
      rw [dist_eq_norm, h_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hδ_k_pos.le]
      have h_denom : (r / 2) / ε < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
        calc (r / 2) / ε ≤ (Nat.ceil ((r / 2) / ε) : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
          _ ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hk
          _ < (k : ℝ) + 1 := lt_add_one _
      have h_pos_k : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      exact (div_lt_iff₀ h_pos_k).mpr (by
        have := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp h_denom
        linarith)
    have hc_d2 : ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv F)) z₀ :=
      (hF_d2_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_H.mem_nhds hz₀)).continuousAt
    have hc_Q : ContinuousAt Q_lim z₀ :=
      (hQ_lim_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_H.mem_nhds hz₀)).continuousAt
    have hc_F : ContinuousAt F z₀ :=
      (hF_holo.differentiableAt (isOpen_H.mem_nhds hz₀)).continuousAt
    have h_lhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => deriv (deriv F) (w_seq k)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (deriv (deriv F) z₀)) :=
      hc_d2.tendsto.comp hw_tendsto
    have h_rhs : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Q_lim (w_seq k) * F (w_seq k)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (Q_lim z₀ * F z₀)) :=
      (hc_Q.tendsto.comp hw_tendsto).mul (hc_F.tendsto.comp hw_tendsto)
    have h_lhs' : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Q_lim (w_seq k) * F (w_seq k)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (deriv (deriv F) z₀)) := by
      simpa only [hw_ode] using h_lhs
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_lhs' h_rhs
  
  have h_mom_sub : TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun n v => Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_seq n + v) / rowMomentFull S (K_seq n)))
      (fun v => Real.exp (L_lim v)) Filter.atTop :=
    fun u hu x =>
      let ⟨t, ht, h⟩ := h_mom u hu x
      ⟨t, ht, hτ.tendsto_atTop.eventually h⟩
  exact ⟨{
    F := F
    Q_lim := Q_lim
    L_lim := L_lim
    lam := lam
    β := 3 / 8
    a := P'
    α := 9 / 16
    δ_b := δ_b
    C_env2 := C_env2
    K_seq := K_seq
    ξ_seq := ξ_seq
    F_holo := hF_holo
    Q_lim_holo := hQ_lim_holo
    F_nonzero := hF_nonzero
    deriv2_F := hderiv2_F
    one_le_lam := hlam
    β_pos := by norm_num
    β_lt_half := by norm_num
    a_pos := by linarith
    half_lt_α := by norm_num
    α_lt_one_sub_β := by norm_num
    δ_b_pos := hδ_pos
    δ_b_lt := hδ_lt
    C_env2_pos := hC_env2
    L_lim_cont := hL_cont
    L_lim_zero := hL_zero
    L_lim_slope_top := hL_top
    L_lim_slope_bot := hL_bot
    K_seq_ge := hK_seq_ge
    K_seq_tendsto := hK_tendsto
    B_seq_tendsto := hB_tendsto
    moment_law_conv := h_mom_sub
    global_envelope := fun n l hl => h_env (τ n) l hl
    cone_bound := h_cone_real
    F_conv := hF_conv
    Q_conv := hQ_conv
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam L₀ M_lat C_small : ℝ) (E : Set ℝ)
    (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hM_lat : 0 < M_lat) (hC_small : 0 < C_small)
    (h_upper : ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
      ∃ v₀ : ℝ, 0 < v₀ ∧ ∀ v x : ℝ, v₀ ≤ v → |x| ≤ R →
        ‖F ((x : ℂ) - (Real.exp (-v) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((lam + ε) * v))
    (hE_pos : ∀ u ∈ E, 0 < u)
    (hE_dense : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ v₀ : ℝ, 0 < v₀ ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, v₀ ≤ v →
      ∃ u ∈ E, |v - u| ≤ ε * v)
    (hE_wit : ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
      ∃ u₀ : ℝ, 0 < u₀ ∧ ∀ u ∈ E, u₀ ≤ u → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ R →
        ∃ p δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ |p - x| ≤ L₀ * δ ∧
          |-Real.log δ - u| ≤ ε * u ∧
          Real.exp ((lam - ε) * u) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :
    EpochBandScheduleData F lam L₀ M_lat C_small

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hE_pos
  
  have h_inv4 : ∀ n : ℕ, ((4 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    rw [← mul_inv, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have h_inv16 : ∀ n : ℕ, ((16 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ = ((4 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((4 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    rw [← mul_inv, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  have h_pow32 : ∀ n : ℕ, (32 : ℝ) ^ n = (4 : ℝ) ^ n * (8 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    intro n

      ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j) := by
    intro j z hz_re hz_lo hz_hi
    exact h_master_box j z hz_re hz_lo (hz_hi.trans (hExp_bot j))

  
  have h_wit_common : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x₀ : ℝ), |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        0 < δ_w ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        Real.exp (-u_raw k - ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k) ≤ δ_w ∧
        δ_w ≤ Real.exp (-u_raw k + ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k) ∧
        δ_w ≤ Real.exp (-u_raw k + s_raw k) ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
        Real.exp ((lam - ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹) * u_raw k) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w → |z.re| ≤ 5) := by
    intro k x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨p, δ_w, hδ_pos, hp_dist, hlog_dist, hF_lo⟩ :=
      hu_wit (n_raw k) (u_raw k) (hu_raw_E k) (hu_raw_wit k) x₀ hx₀
    have habs := abs_sub_le_iff.mp hlog_dist
    have hlog_lo : -u_raw k - ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k ≤ Real.log δ_w := by
      linarith [habs.1]
    have hlog_hi : Real.log δ_w ≤ -u_raw k + ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k := by
      linarith [habs.2]
    have hδ_lo : Real.exp (-u_raw k - ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k) ≤ δ_w := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hδ_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog_lo
    have hδ_hi : δ_w ≤ Real.exp (-u_raw k + ((16 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw k))⁻¹ * u_raw k) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hδ_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hlog_hi
    have hδ_hi_s : δ_w ≤ Real.exp (-u_raw k + s_raw k) := by
      refine hδ_hi.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      linarith [h16_le_s k, (hs_bounds k).2]
    have hδ_half : δ_w ≤ Real.exp (-(u_raw k / 2)) := by
      refine hδ_hi_s.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      linarith [hs_le_36 k, hu_raw_ge k]
    have hd_16 : (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 16 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_half (by positivity)).trans (hd_small_at (u_raw k) (hu_raw_V k))
    have hz_re_5 : ∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w → |z.re| ≤ 5 := by
      intro z hz_p
      have htri1 : |z.re| ≤ |z.re - p| + |p| := by
        have := abs_add_le (z.re - p) p
        simpa using this
      have htri2 : |p| ≤ |p - x₀| + |x₀| := by
        have := abs_add_le (p - x₀) x₀
        simpa using this
      linarith
    exact ⟨p, δ_w, hδ_pos, hp_dist, hδ_lo, hδ_hi, hδ_hi_s, hd_16, hF_lo, hz_re_5⟩

  
  have hWit_curr : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a j)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b j)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat) * δ_w ≤ 1 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a j + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)) := by
    intro j x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨p, δ_w, hδ_pos, hp_dist, hδ_lo, hδ_hi, hδ_hi_s, hd_16, hF_lo, hz_re_5⟩ :=
      h_wit_common (j + 1) x₀ hx₀
    refine ⟨p, δ_w, (hExp_curr j).1.trans_le hδ_lo, hδ_hi.trans_lt (hExp_curr j).2,
      hp_dist, by nlinarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_).trans hF_lo
      have h37 := hM_diff_37 j
      have h80 := h80_to_Csmall j
      have h16s := h16_le_s (j + 1)
      dsimp [u] at h37 ⊢
      nlinarith [hlam, (hs_bounds (j + 1)).2]
    · intro z hz_p hz_lo hz_hi
      have hLa_le_2 : L_a j + 3 ≤ L_a (j + 2) + 6 := by
        have := hL_sep j
        have := hL_sep (j + 1)
        have := hL_sep (j + 2)
        have hLb_eq : L_b (j + 1 + 1) = L_b (j + 2) := rfl
        omega
      have hz_lo' : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im :=
        (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hLa_le_2)).trans hz_lo
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (-u_raw (j + 1) + s_raw (j + 1)) ≤
          Real.exp (-u_raw j + s_raw j) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        linarith [(hu_gap j).1, hs_step_hi j, (hs_bounds j).2]
      have hz_hi' : -z.im ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-u_raw j + s_raw j) := by
        have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-u_raw j + s_raw j) := Real.exp_pos _
        linarith
      exact h_master_box j z (hz_re_5 z hz_p) hz_lo' hz_hi'

  
  have hWit_prev : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
      ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b j - 3))⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + M_lat + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top j - C_small * (ε_seq j * u j)) ≤
          ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a (j + 2) + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top j)) := by
    intro j x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨p, δ_w, _, hp_dist, hδ_lo, _, hδ_hi_s, hd_16, hF_lo, hz_re_5⟩ :=
      h_wit_common j x₀ hx₀
    refine ⟨p, δ_w, (hExp_prev j).trans_le hδ_lo, hp_dist, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_).trans hF_lo
      have h37 := hM_diff_37 j
      have h80 := h80_to_Csmall j
      have h16s := h16_le_s j
      have hg := (hu_gap j).2
      have h4s := hs_step_lo j
      dsimp [u] at h37
      nlinarith [hlam, (hs_bounds j).2, (hs_bounds (j + 1)).2]
    · intro z hz_p hz_lo hz_hi
      have hz_hi' : -z.im ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-u_raw j + s_raw j) := by
        have hpos : 0 < Real.exp (-u_raw j + s_raw j) := Real.exp_pos _
        linarith
      exact h_master_box j z (hz_re_5 z hz_p) hz_lo hz_hi'

  
  have hu_step : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ u j ∧ u j + 1 ≤ u (j + 1) := by
    intro j
    dsimp [u]
    constructor
    · linarith [hu_raw_ge (j + 1)]
    · linarith [(hu_gap (j + 1)).1, (hs_bounds (j + 1)).2]
  have hu_top : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    have hj_le : ∀ j : ℕ, (j : ℝ) ≤ u j := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => simp; linarith [(hu_step 0).1]
      | succ j ih =>
        push_cast
        linarith [(hu_step j).2]
    exact Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono hj_le tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hε_bounds : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < ε_seq j ∧ ε_seq j ≤ C_small := by
    intro j
    exact ⟨by positivity, (hn_small_at (n_raw (j + 1)) (hn_raw_N (j + 1))).1⟩
  have hε_anti : Antitone ε_seq :=
    antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun j =>
      inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (hn_ge (j + 1)).2.1))
  have hε_zero : Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hn_shift_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => n_raw (j + 1)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop.mpr (fun M =>
        (Filter.tendsto_atTop.mp hu_top (V M)).mono (fun j hj => hn_step_ge M (u j) hj))
    have h_half : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    refine (h_half.comp hn_shift_top).congr (fun j => ?_)
    simp [ε_seq, inv_pow]
  have hεu_ge : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 / C_small ≤ ε_seq j * u j := by
    intro j
    have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw (j + 1)) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw (j + 1)) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _
    have hi : ((4 : ℝ) ^ (n_raw (j + 1)))⁻¹ ≤ ε_seq j := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) hp
    have hs_le_Xu : s_raw (j + 1) ≤ ε_seq j * u j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi (by linarith [hu_raw_ge (j + 1)])
    exact (hs_bounds (j + 1)).1.trans hs_le_Xu

  exact ⟨u, ε_seq, M_top, L_a, L_b, hu_step, hu_top, hε_bounds, hε_anti, hε_zero,
    hεu_ge, hL_sep, hL_span, hM_bounds, hBox_unif, hWit_curr, hWit_prev⟩
