proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hDrop : ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (R : α → α → Prop) (x : α) (l : List α),
      x ∈ l →
      ∃ h_ne : dyadicDropUntil x l ≠ [],
        (dyadicDropUntil x l).head h_ne = x ∧
        (∀ z ∈ dyadicDropUntil x l, z ∈ l) ∧
        (∀ hl : l ≠ [], (dyadicDropUntil x l).getLast h_ne = l.getLast hl) ∧
        (l.Nodup → (dyadicDropUntil x l).Nodup) ∧
        (List.IsChain R l → List.IsChain R (dyadicDropUntil x l)) := by
    intro α _ R x l hx
    induction l with
    | nil => simp at hx
    | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        simp only [dyadicDropUntil, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨List.cons_ne_nil y ys, by simp, fun _ hz => hz, fun _ => by simp, id, id⟩
      · have hx_ys : x ∈ ys := by
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hmem
          · exact False.elim (hyx rfl)
          · exact hmem
        have hys_ne : ys ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_mem hx_ys
        obtain ⟨hd_ne, hd_head, hd_sub, hd_last, hd_nd, hd_ch⟩ := ih hx_ys
        simp only [dyadicDropUntil, hyx, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ⟨hd_ne, hd_head, fun z hz => List.mem_cons_of_mem y (hd_sub z hz),
          fun _ => (hd_last hys_ne).trans (List.getLast_cons hys_ne).symm,
          fun hnd => hd_nd (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2,
          fun hch => hd_ch hch.tail⟩

  have hErase : ∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (R : α → α → Prop) (L : List α) (hne : L ≠ []),
      List.IsChain R L →
      ∃ (Q : List α) (hQ : Q ≠ []),
        Q.Nodup ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Q, z ∈ L) ∧
        Q.head hQ = L.head hne ∧
        Q.getLast hQ = L.getLast hne ∧
        List.IsChain R Q := by
    intro α _ R L hne hChain
    induction L with
    | nil => exact False.elim (hne rfl)
    | cons a xs ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
        exact ⟨[a], List.cons_ne_nil a [], List.nodup_singleton a,
          fun _ hz => hz, rfl, rfl, List.isChain_singleton a⟩
      | cons b rest =>
        have hxs : b :: rest ≠ [] := List.cons_ne_nil b rest
        obtain ⟨hRab, hChain_xs⟩ := List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hChain
        obtain ⟨tail, ht_ne, ht_nd, ht_sub, ht_head, ht_last, ht_ch⟩ := ih hxs hChain_xs
        by_cases ha : a ∈ tail
        · obtain ⟨hd_ne, hd_head, hd_sub, hd_last, hd_nd, hd_ch⟩ := hDrop R a tail ha
          refine ⟨dyadicDropUntil a tail, hd_ne, hd_nd ht_nd,
            fun z hz => List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ht_sub z (hd_sub z hz)),
            hd_head, ?_, hd_ch ht_ch⟩
          rw [hd_last ht_ne, ht_last, List.getLast_cons hxs]
        · refine ⟨a :: tail, List.cons_ne_nil a tail, List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨ha, ht_nd⟩,
            fun z hz => ?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
          · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hmem
            · simp
            · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (ht_sub z hmem)
          · rw [List.getLast_cons ht_ne, ht_last, List.getLast_cons hxs]
          · cases tail with
            | nil => exact False.elim (ht_ne rfl)
            | cons c cs =>
              have hcb : c = b := ht_head
              subst hcb
              exact List.isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨hRab, ht_ch⟩

  
  let D : ℕ := L_max - L_min
  let W : ℕ := M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9)
  let H : ℕ := 1024 * (2 ^ D - 1)
  let ρ_fine : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹
  have hD_pos : 1 ≤ D := by dsimp [D]; omega
  have hL_add_D : L_min + D = L_max := by dsimp [D]; omega
  have h2D_ge : 2 ≤ 2 ^ D := by
    calc 2 = 2 ^ 1 := rfl
      _ ≤ 2 ^ D := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hD_pos
  have hW_pos : 1 ≤ W := by
    dsimp [W]
    have hpow : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (L_max + 9) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hH_pos : 1 ≤ H := by
    dsimp [H]
    have hsub : 1 ≤ 2 ^ D - 1 := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hρ_fine_pos : 0 < ρ_fine := by dsimp [ρ_fine]; positivity

  have hRowUniv : ∀ j : ℕ,
      let m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
      let q := (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m - 1024
      Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) = 10 + m ∧
      1024 * 2 ^ m ≤ 1024 + j ∧
      1024 + j < 2048 * 2 ^ m ∧
      q < 1024 ∧
      1024 + q = (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m := by
    intro j
    dsimp only
    have hge10 : 10 ≤ Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) :=
      Nat.le_log_of_pow_le Nat.one_lt_two (by omega)
    set m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
    have hlog_eq : Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) = 10 + m := by omega
    have hlo_pow : 2 ^ (10 + m) ≤ 1024 + j := by
      rw [← hlog_eq]
      exact Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
    have hhi_pow : 1024 + j < 2 ^ (10 + m + 1) := by
      have h1 := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self Nat.one_lt_two (1024 + j)
      simpa [hlog_eq, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using h1
    have hlo : 1024 * 2 ^ m ≤ 1024 + j := by
      have hp : 2 ^ (10 + m) = 1024 * 2 ^ m := by rw [pow_add]; norm_num
      omega
    have hhi : 1024 + j < 2048 * 2 ^ m := by
      have hp : 2 ^ (10 + m + 1) = 2048 * 2 ^ m := by
        rw [show 10 + m + 1 = 11 + m by omega, pow_add]
        norm_num
      omega
    have hdiv_ge : 1024 ≤ (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m :=
      (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by positivity)).mpr hlo
    have hdiv_lt : (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m < 2048 :=
      Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hlog_eq, hlo, hhi, by omega, by omega⟩

  have hWidthCancel : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ L_max + 9 →
      ((M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹) = (M_w : ℝ) / 2 := by
    intro m hm
    push_cast
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9 - m) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m = (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9) := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm]
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9) * 2 := by
      rw [show L_max + 10 = (L_max + 9) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    calc (M_w : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9 - m) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹)
        = (M_w : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9 - m) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m) *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹ := by ring
      _ = (M_w : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 9) * 2)⁻¹ := by
            rw [h1, h2]
      _ = (M_w : ℝ) / 2 := by field_simp [h3]

  have hShallowCancel : (1024 : ℝ) * ρ_fine = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [ρ_fine]
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10) = (2 : ℝ) ^ L_max * 1024 := by
      rw [pow_add]
      norm_num
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ L_max ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [h1]
    field_simp [h2]

  have hDeepCancel : (2048 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1) * ρ_fine = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [ρ_fine]
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10) = (2 : ℝ) ^ L_min * (2048 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1)) := by
      have hexp : L_max + 10 = L_min + (11 + (D - 1)) := by omega
      rw [hexp, pow_add, pow_add]
      norm_num
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ L_min ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [h1]
    field_simp [h2, h3]

  have hCell : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < W → j < H →
      let t := dyadicParentIdx i j
      let ρ := dyadicTileSide L_max t
      let x_T := dyadicTileX x_left L_max t
      let d_T := dyadicTileDepth L_max t
      let c_ℂ := dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max t
      dyadicValidTile M_w L_min L_max t ∧
      c_ℂ.re = x_T ∧
      -c_ℂ.im = d_T ∧
      0 < ρ ∧
      1024 * ρ ≤ d_T ∧
      d_T ≤ 2048 * ρ ∧
      x_left + ρ / 2 ≤ x_T ∧
      x_T ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ / 2 ∧
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ / 2 ≤ d_T ∧
      d_T ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ / 2 := by
    intro i j hi hj
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨hlog_eq, _, _, hq_lt, _⟩ := hRowUniv j
    set m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
    set c := i / 2 ^ m
    set q := (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m - 1024
    have ht_eq : dyadicParentIdx i j = (m, c, q) := rfl
    have hm_lt_D : m < D := by
      have hj_bound : 1024 + j < 2 ^ (10 + D) := by
        have hH_eq : H = 1024 * 2 ^ D - 1024 := by
          dsimp [H]
          omega
        have hp : 2 ^ (10 + D) = 1024 * 2 ^ D := by rw [pow_add]; norm_num
        omega
      have hlt := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega : 1024 + j ≠ 0) hj_bound
      omega
    have hm_le : m ≤ L_max + 9 := by dsimp [D] at hm_lt_D; omega
    have hW_split : W = 2 ^ m * (M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m)) := by
      dsimp [W]
      have hp : 2 ^ (L_max + 9) = 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) * 2 ^ m := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_le]
      rw [hp]
      ring
    have hc_lt : c < M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) := by
      dsimp [c]
      exact Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul (by linarith)
    have hValid : dyadicValidTile M_w L_min L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) :=
      ⟨hm_lt_D, hc_lt, hq_lt⟩
    set ρ := dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j)
    have hρ_eq : ρ = (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ_fine := rfl
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ_eq]; positivity
    have hre : (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j)).re =
        dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) := by
      simp [dyadicTileCenter]
    have him : -(dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j)).im =
        dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) := by
      simp [dyadicTileCenter]
    have hq_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg q
    have hq_le : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1023 := by exact_mod_cast (show q ≤ 1023 by omega)
    have hd_lo_aspect : 1024 * ρ ≤ dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) := by
      change 1024 * ρ ≤ (1024 + (q : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hρ_pos.le
    have hd_hi_aspect : dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) ≤ 2048 * ρ := by
      change (1024 + (q : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ ≤ 2048 * ρ
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hρ_pos.le
    have hc_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (c : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg c
    have hx_lo : x_left + ρ / 2 ≤ dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) := by
      change x_left + ρ / 2 ≤ x_left + ((c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
      have hcρ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (c : ℝ) * ρ := mul_nonneg hc_nonneg hρ_pos.le
      linarith
    have hx_hi : dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) ≤
        x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ / 2 := by
      change x_left + ((c : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ / 2
      have hc1 : (c : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (show c + 1 ≤ M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) by omega)
      have hmul : ((c : ℝ) + 1) * ρ ≤ (M_w : ℝ) / 2 := by
        calc ((c : ℝ) + 1) * ρ
            ≤ ((M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 hρ_pos.le
          _ = (M_w : ℝ) / 2 := hWidthCancel m hm_le
      linarith
    have hd_lo_box : ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ / 2 ≤
        dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) := by
      change ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ / 2 ≤ (1024 + (q : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ
      have h1m : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h1024 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ ≤ 1024 * ρ := by
        rw [← hShallowCancel, hρ_eq]
        have hle : ρ_fine ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ_fine :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_left hρ_fine_pos.le h1m
        linarith
      have hqρ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ) * ρ := mul_nonneg hq_nonneg hρ_pos.le
      linarith
    have hd_hi_box : dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i j) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ / 2 := by
      change (1024 + (q : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ρ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ / 2
      have hm_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1) :=
        pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have h2048 : 2048 * ρ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← hDeepCancel, hρ_eq]
        have hle : (2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ_fine ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1) * ρ_fine :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm_pow hρ_fine_pos.le
        linarith
      have hq2048 : (1024 + (q : ℝ) + 1) * ρ ≤ 2048 * ρ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hρ_pos.le
      linarith
    exact ⟨hValid, hre, him, hρ_pos, hd_lo_aspect, hd_hi_aspect,
      hx_lo, hx_hi, hd_lo_box, hd_hi_box⟩

  have hPinL : ∀ j : ℕ, j < H →
      dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx 0 j) =
        x_left + dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx 0 j) / 2 := by
    intro j _
    simp [dyadicTileX, dyadicParentIdx]
    ring

  have hPinR : ∀ j : ℕ, j < H →
      dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) j) =
        x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) j) / 2 := by
    intro j hj
    set m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
    have hm_lt_D : m < D := (hCell 0 j (by omega) hj).1.1
    have hm_le : m ≤ L_max + 9 := by dsimp [D] at hm_lt_D; omega
    set K := M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m)
    have hK_pos : 1 ≤ K := by
      dsimp [K]
      have hp : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
      nlinarith
    have hW_eq : W = K * 2 ^ m := by
      dsimp [W, K]
      have hp : 2 ^ (L_max + 9) = 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - m) * 2 ^ m := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hm_le]
      rw [hp]
      ring
    have h2m_pos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ m := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
    have hdiv : (W - 1) / 2 ^ m = K - 1 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
      · have hmul : (K - 1) * 2 ^ m + 2 ^ m = K * 2 ^ m := by
          have : K - 1 + 1 = K := by omega
          nlinarith
        omega
      · have : K - 1 + 1 = K := by omega
        rw [this, ← hW_eq]
        omega
    have hcast : (((W - 1) / 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) = (K : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [hdiv, Nat.cast_sub hK_pos]
      simp
    have hK_mul : (K : ℝ) * dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) j) =
        (M_w : ℝ) / 2 := hWidthCancel m hm_le
    change x_left + ((((W - 1) / 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) *
        dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) j) =
      x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) j) / 2
    rw [hcast]
    linarith

  have hPinS : ∀ i : ℕ, i < W →
      dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i 0) =
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i 0) / 2 := by
    intro i _
    have hlog0 : Nat.log 2 1024 = 10 := by
      have h10 : (1024 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 10 := by norm_num
      rw [h10, Nat.log_pow Nat.one_lt_two 10]
    have hm0 : (dyadicParentIdx i 0).1 = 0 := by
      simp [dyadicParentIdx, hlog0]
    have hq0 : (dyadicParentIdx i 0).2.2 = 0 := by
      simp [dyadicParentIdx, hlog0]
    have hρ0 : dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i 0) = ρ_fine := by
      simp [dyadicTileSide, hm0, ρ_fine]
    unfold dyadicTileDepth
    rw [hq0, hρ0]
    linarith [hShallowCancel]

  have hPinD : ∀ i : ℕ, i < W →
      dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i (H - 1)) =
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i (H - 1)) / 2 := by
    intro i _
    have h2Dm1_pos : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (D - 1) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by norm_num)
    have h2D_split : 2 ^ D = 2 * 2 ^ (D - 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show D = (D - 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ']
    have hsum_eq : 1024 + (H - 1) = 2048 * 2 ^ (D - 1) - 1 := by
      dsimp [H]
      omega
    have hlogH : Nat.log 2 (1024 + (H - 1)) = 10 + (D - 1) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · have hlt : 1024 + (H - 1) < 2 ^ (10 + (D - 1) + 1) := by
          have hp : 2 ^ (10 + (D - 1) + 1) = 2048 * 2 ^ (D - 1) := by
            rw [show 10 + (D - 1) + 1 = 11 + (D - 1) by omega, pow_add]
            norm_num
          omega
        have := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega : 1024 + (H - 1) ≠ 0) hlt
        omega
      · apply Nat.le_log_of_pow_le Nat.one_lt_two
        have hp : 2 ^ (10 + (D - 1)) = 1024 * 2 ^ (D - 1) := by
          rw [pow_add]
          norm_num
        omega
    have hmH : (dyadicParentIdx i (H - 1)).1 = D - 1 := by
      dsimp [dyadicParentIdx]
      omega
    have hdivH : (1024 + (H - 1)) / 2 ^ (D - 1) = 2047 := by
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le <;> omega
    have hqH : (dyadicParentIdx i (H - 1)).2.2 = 1023 := by
      dsimp [dyadicParentIdx]
      have hm' : Nat.log 2 (1024 + (H - 1)) - 10 = D - 1 := by omega
      rw [hm', hdivH]
    have hρH : dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i (H - 1)) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (D - 1) * ρ_fine := by
      simp [dyadicTileSide, hmH, ρ_fine]
    unfold dyadicTileDepth
    rw [hqH, hρH]
    push_cast
    linarith [hDeepCancel]

  have hInterval1D : ∀ A B m : ℕ, A ≤ B → B ≤ A + 1 →
      |(B : ℝ) * ρ_fine - (((A / 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ_fine)| ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ m * ρ_fine) / 2 := by
    intro A B m hAB hBA
    have hdiv := Nat.div_add_mod A (2 ^ m)
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt A (by positivity : 0 < 2 ^ m)
    have hcomm1 : (A / 2 ^ m) * 2 ^ m = 2 ^ m * (A / 2 ^ m) := mul_comm _ _
    have hcomm2 : (A / 2 ^ m + 1) * 2 ^ m = 2 ^ m * (A / 2 ^ m) + 2 ^ m := by ring
    have hlo_nat : (A / 2 ^ m) * 2 ^ m ≤ B := by omega
    have hhi_nat : B ≤ (A / 2 ^ m + 1) * 2 ^ m := by omega
    have hlo_r : (((A / 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m) * ρ_fine ≤ (B : ℝ) * ρ_fine := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hρ_fine_pos.le
      exact_mod_cast hlo_nat
    have hhi_r : (B : ℝ) * ρ_fine ≤ ((((A / 2 ^ m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m) * ρ_fine := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hρ_fine_pos.le
      exact_mod_cast hhi_nat
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith

  have hSideStep : ∀ ja jb : ℕ, ja ≤ jb + 1 →
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 (1024 + ja) - 10) * ρ_fine ≤
        2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.log 2 (1024 + jb) - 10) * ρ_fine) := by
    intro ja jb hjab
    obtain ⟨hlog_a, _, _, _, _⟩ := hRowUniv ja
    obtain ⟨hlog_b, _, hhi_b, _, _⟩ := hRowUniv jb
    set ma := Nat.log 2 (1024 + ja) - 10
    set mb := Nat.log 2 (1024 + jb) - 10
    have hbound : 1024 + ja < 2 ^ (10 + mb + 2) := by
      have hp : 2 ^ (10 + mb + 2) = 4096 * 2 ^ mb := by
        rw [show 10 + mb + 2 = 12 + mb by omega, pow_add]
        norm_num
      omega
    have hlt := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega : 1024 + ja ≠ 0) hbound
    have hma_le : ma ≤ mb + 1 := by omega
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ ma ≤ 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ mb := by
      calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ma
          ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (mb + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hma_le
        _ = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ mb := pow_succ' 2 mb
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hρ_fine_pos.le
    linarith

  have hAdj : ∀ i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ : ℕ,
      |(i₁ : ℤ) - (i₂ : ℤ)| ≤ 1 → |(j₁ : ℤ) - (j₂ : ℤ)| ≤ 1 →
      let t₁ := dyadicParentIdx i₁ j₁
      let t₂ := dyadicParentIdx i₂ j₂
      (meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max t₁) (dyadicTileSide L_max t₁) ∩
        meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max t₂) (dyadicTileSide L_max t₂)).Nonempty ∧
      |dyadicTileX x_left L_max t₂ - dyadicTileX x_left L_max t₁| ≤
        (dyadicTileSide L_max t₁ + dyadicTileSide L_max t₂) / 2 ∧
      |dyadicTileDepth L_max t₂ - dyadicTileDepth L_max t₁| ≤
        (dyadicTileSide L_max t₁ + dyadicTileSide L_max t₂) / 2 ∧
      dyadicTileSide L_max t₁ / 2 ≤ dyadicTileSide L_max t₂ ∧
      dyadicTileSide L_max t₂ ≤ 2 * dyadicTileSide L_max t₁ := by
    intro i₁ j₁ i₂ j₂ hi_diff hj_diff
    dsimp only
    obtain ⟨hi_lo, hi_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hi_diff
    obtain ⟨hj_lo, hj_hi⟩ := abs_le.mp hj_diff
    let i_star := max i₁ i₂
    let j_star := max j₁ j₂
    let x_star : ℝ := x_left + (i_star : ℝ) * ρ_fine
    let d_star : ℝ := ((1024 + j_star : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ_fine
    let z_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) - (d_star : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hPointIn : ∀ i_n j_n : ℕ,
        i_n ≤ i_star → i_star ≤ i_n + 1 →
        j_n ≤ j_star → j_star ≤ j_n + 1 →
        |x_star - dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)| ≤
          dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) / 2 ∧
        |d_star - dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)| ≤
          dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) / 2 ∧
        z_star ∈ meshClosedSquare
          (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n))
          (dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)) := by
      intro i_n j_n hi1 hi2 hj1 hj2
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hq_sum⟩ := hRowUniv j_n
      set m_n := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j_n) - 10
      have hx_dist : |x_star - dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)| ≤
          dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) / 2 := by
        have h1 := hInterval1D i_n i_star m_n hi1 hi2
        have hdiff : x_star - dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) =
            (i_star : ℝ) * ρ_fine -
              (((i_n / 2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_n * ρ_fine) := by
          dsimp [x_star, dyadicTileX, dyadicTileSide, dyadicParentIdx, m_n, ρ_fine]
          ring
        rw [hdiff]
        exact h1
      have hd_dist : |d_star - dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)| ≤
          dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) / 2 := by
        have h1 := hInterval1D (1024 + j_n) (1024 + j_star) m_n (by omega) (by omega)
        have hq_cast : (1024 : ℝ) + (((dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n).2.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
            (((1024 + j_n) / 2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast hq_sum
        have hdiff : d_star - dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) =
            ((1024 + j_star : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ_fine -
              ((((1024 + j_n) / 2 ^ m_n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ m_n * ρ_fine) := by
          unfold dyadicTileDepth
          rw [← hq_cast]
          dsimp [dyadicTileSide, dyadicParentIdx, m_n, ρ_fine]
        rw [hdiff]
        exact h1
      refine ⟨hx_dist, hd_dist, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hre : (z_star - dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)).re =
            x_star - dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n) := by
          simp [z_star, dyadicTileCenter]
        rw [hre]
        exact hx_dist
      · have him : (z_star - dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)).im =
            -(d_star - dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i_n j_n)) := by
          simp [z_star, dyadicTileCenter]
          ring
        rw [him, abs_neg]
        exact hd_dist
    obtain ⟨hx1, hd1, hz1⟩ := hPointIn i₁ j₁ (le_max_left _ _) (by omega) (le_max_left _ _) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨hx2, hd2, hz2⟩ := hPointIn i₂ j₂ (le_max_right _ _) (by omega) (le_max_right _ _) (by omega)
    refine ⟨⟨z_star, hz1, hz2⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have htri := abs_sub_le (dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₂ j₂)) x_star
        (dyadicTileX x_left L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₁ j₁))
      rw [abs_sub_comm _ x_star] at htri
      linarith
    · have htri := abs_sub_le (dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₂ j₂)) d_star
        (dyadicTileDepth L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₁ j₁))
      rw [abs_sub_comm _ d_star] at htri
      linarith
    · have h12 : dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₁ j₁) ≤
          2 * dyadicTileSide L_max (dyadicParentIdx i₂ j₂) :=
        hSideStep j₁ j₂ (by omega)
      linarith
    · exact hSideStep j₂ j₁ (by omega)

  
  have hSideSum : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ),
      Function.Injective t →
      (∀ k : Fin (m + 1), dyadicValidTile M_w L_min L_max (t k)) →
      (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), dyadicTileSide L_max (t k)) ≤
        512 * (M_w : ℝ) * ((L_max - L_min : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro m t hInj hValid
    let U_layer : ℕ → Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) := fun l =>
      (Finset.range (M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - l)) ×ˢ Finset.range 1024).image
        (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (l, p.1, p.2))
    let U_all : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) := (Finset.range D).biUnion U_layer
    have hsum_img : (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), dyadicTileSide L_max (t k)) =
        ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.image t, dyadicTileSide L_max x := by
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => hInj h)
    have hsub : Finset.univ.image t ⊆ U_all := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hValid k
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(t k).1, Finset.mem_range.mpr h1, ?_⟩
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨((t k).2.1, (t k).2.2), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr h2, Finset.mem_range.mpr h3⟩
      · cases ht : t k with
        | mk a bc =>
          cases bc with
          | mk b c => rfl
    have hle_all : (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.image t, dyadicTileSide L_max x) ≤
        ∑ x ∈ U_all, dyadicTileSide L_max x :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub
        (fun x _ _ => by unfold dyadicTileSide; positivity)
    have hdisj : (↑(Finset.range D) : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint U_layer := by
      intro l₁ _ l₂ _ hne
      refine Finset.disjoint_left.mpr ?_
      intro x hx1 hx2
      obtain ⟨p₁, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx1
      obtain ⟨p₂, _, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx2
      exact hne (congrArg Prod.fst heq).symm
    have hbi : (∑ x ∈ U_all, dyadicTileSide L_max x) =
        ∑ l ∈ Finset.range D, ∑ x ∈ U_layer l, dyadicTileSide L_max x :=
      Finset.sum_biUnion hdisj
    have hlayer_eval : ∀ l ∈ Finset.range D,
        (∑ x ∈ U_layer l, dyadicTileSide L_max x) = 512 * (M_w : ℝ) := by
      intro l hl
      have hl_lt : l < D := Finset.mem_range.mp hl
      have hl_le : l ≤ L_max + 9 := by dsimp [D] at hl_lt; omega
      have hconst : (∑ x ∈ U_layer l, dyadicTileSide L_max x) =
          ∑ _x ∈ U_layer l, ((2 : ℝ) ^ l * ρ_fine) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
        rfl
      have hinj_pair : Function.Injective (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => (l, p.1, p.2)) := by
        intro p₁ p₂ h
        have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd h
        exact Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h2) (congrArg Prod.snd h2)
      have hcard : (U_layer l).card = M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - l) * 1024 := by
        dsimp [U_layer]
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj_pair, Finset.card_product,
          Finset.card_range, Finset.card_range]
      rw [hconst, Finset.sum_const, hcard, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have hmul := hWidthCancel l hl_le
      calc ((M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - l) * 1024 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ l * ρ_fine)
          = 1024 * (((M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - l) : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ l * ρ_fine)) := by
              push_cast; ring
        _ = 1024 * ((M_w : ℝ) / 2) := by rw [hmul]
        _ = 512 * (M_w : ℝ) := by ring
    have hall_eval : (∑ l ∈ Finset.range D, ∑ x ∈ U_layer l, dyadicTileSide L_max x) =
        512 * (M_w : ℝ) * ((L_max - L_min : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hlayer_eval, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      dsimp [D]
      ring
    linarith

  
  let τ : Fin W × Fin H → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := fun g => dyadicParentIdx g.1.val g.2.val
  let adjGrid : (Fin W × Fin H) → (Fin W × Fin H) → Prop :=
    fun g₁ g₂ => |(g₁.1.val : ℤ) - (g₂.1.val : ℤ)| ≤ 1 ∧ |(g₁.2.val : ℤ) - (g₂.2.val : ℤ)| ≤ 1
  let R_touch : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) → (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) → Prop :=
    fun t₁ t₂ =>
      (meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max t₁) (dyadicTileSide L_max t₁) ∩
        meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max t₂) (dyadicTileSide L_max t₂)).Nonempty ∧
      dyadicTileSide L_max t₁ / 2 ≤ dyadicTileSide L_max t₂ ∧
      dyadicTileSide L_max t₂ ≤ 2 * dyadicTileSide L_max t₁

  have hBuildGood : ∀ (L : List (Fin W × Fin H)) (hL_ne : L ≠ []),
      (∀ g ∈ L, isGoodTile (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)) (dyadicTileSide L_max (τ g))) →
      List.IsChain adjGrid L →
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (t : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ),
        t 0 = τ (L.head hL_ne) ∧
        t (Fin.last m) = τ (L.getLast hL_ne) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
          let c := dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t k)
          let ρ := dyadicTileSide L_max (t k)
          0 < ρ ∧
          1024 * ρ ≤ -c.im ∧
          -c.im ≤ 2048 * ρ ∧
          x_left + ρ / 2 ≤ c.re ∧
          c.re ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ / 2 ∧
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ / 2 ≤ -c.im ∧
          -c.im ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ / 2 ∧
          isGoodTile c ρ) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin m,
          (meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t k.castSucc))
              (dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc)) ∩
            meshClosedSquare (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t k.succ))
              (dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ))).Nonempty ∧
          dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc) / 2 ≤ dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ) ∧
          dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ) ≤ 2 * dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc)) ∧
        (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), dyadicTileSide L_max (t k)) ≤
          512 * (M_w : ℝ) * ((L_max - L_min : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    intro L hL_ne hGoodL hChainL
    have hMap_ne : L.map τ ≠ [] := by simp [hL_ne]
    have hMap_ch : List.IsChain R_touch (L.map τ) := by
      refine List.isChain_map_of_isChain τ ?_ hChainL
      intro g₁ g₂ h12
      obtain ⟨hsq, _, _, hr1, hr2⟩ := hAdj g₁.1.val g₁.2.val g₂.1.val g₂.2.val h12.1 h12.2
      exact ⟨hsq, hr1, hr2⟩
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ_ne, hQ_nd, hQ_sub, hQ_head, hQ_last, hQ_ch⟩ :=
      hErase R_touch (L.map τ) hMap_ne hMap_ch
    have hQ_len : 0 < Q.length := List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil.mpr hQ_ne
    let m : ℕ := Q.length - 1
    have hm_len : m + 1 = Q.length := by omega
    let t : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := fun k => Q[k.val]'(by omega)
    have ht_zero : t 0 = τ (L.head hL_ne) := by
      change Q[0]'(by omega) = τ (L.head hL_ne)
      rw [← List.head_eq_getElem hQ_ne, hQ_head, List.head_map]
    have ht_last : t (Fin.last m) = τ (L.getLast hL_ne) := by
      change Q[m]'(by omega) = τ (L.getLast hL_ne)
      have hidx : m = Q.length - 1 := rfl
      simp only [hidx, ← List.getLast_eq_getElem hQ_ne, hQ_last, List.getLast_map]
    have ht_mem_L : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1), ∃ g ∈ L, τ g = t k := by
      intro k
      have hmemQ : t k ∈ Q := List.getElem_mem (by omega)
      exact List.mem_map.mp (hQ_sub (t k) hmemQ)
    have ht_valid : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1), dyadicValidTile M_w L_min L_max (t k) := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨g, _, hgk⟩ := ht_mem_L k
      rw [← hgk]
      exact (hCell g.1.val g.2.val g.1.isLt g.2.isLt).1
    have ht_inj : Function.Injective t := by
      have hinjQ := List.nodup_iff_injective_getElem.mp hQ_nd
      intro k₁ k₂ hk
      have hfin : (⟨k₁.val, by omega⟩ : Fin Q.length) = ⟨k₂.val, by omega⟩ := hinjQ hk
      have hval : k₁.val = k₂.val := congrArg (fun x : Fin Q.length => x.val) hfin
      exact Fin.ext hval
    refine ⟨m, t, ht_zero, ht_last, ?_, ?_, hSideSum m t ht_inj ht_valid⟩
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨g, hgL, hgk⟩ := ht_mem_L k
      dsimp only
      rw [← hgk]
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hρ_pos, hd1, hd2, hx1, hx2, hd3, hd4⟩ :=
        hCell g.1.val g.2.val g.1.isLt g.2.isLt
      have hre : (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)).re = dyadicTileX x_left L_max (τ g) := by
        simp [dyadicTileCenter]
      have him : -(dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)).im = dyadicTileDepth L_max (τ g) := by
        simp [dyadicTileCenter]
      rw [hre, him]
      exact ⟨hρ_pos, hd1, hd2, hx1, hx2, hd3, hd4, hGoodL g hgL⟩
    · intro k
      have hstep := List.isChain_iff_getElem.mp hQ_ch k.val (by omega)
      exact hstep

  have hBuildBad : ∀ (B : List (Fin W × Fin H)) (hB_ne : B ≠ []),
      (∀ g ∈ B, ¬ isGoodTile (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)) (dyadicTileSide L_max (τ g))) →
      List.IsChain adjGrid B →
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (t : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ),
        t 0 = τ (B.head hB_ne) ∧
        t (Fin.last r) = τ (B.getLast hB_ne) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin (r + 1),
          let x_T := dyadicTileX x_left L_max (t k)
          let d_T := dyadicTileDepth L_max (t k)
          let ρ_T := dyadicTileSide L_max (t k)
          0 < ρ_T ∧
          1024 * ρ_T ≤ d_T ∧
          d_T ≤ 2048 * ρ_T ∧
          x_left + ρ_T / 2 ≤ x_T ∧
          x_T ≤ x_left + (M_w : ℝ) / 2 - ρ_T / 2 ∧
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_max)⁻¹ + ρ_T / 2 ≤ d_T ∧
          d_T ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_min)⁻¹ - ρ_T / 2 ∧
          ¬ isGoodTile ((x_T : ℂ) - (d_T : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_T) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin r,
          |dyadicTileX x_left L_max (t k.succ) - dyadicTileX x_left L_max (t k.castSucc)| ≤
            (dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc) + dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ)) / 2 ∧
          |dyadicTileDepth L_max (t k.succ) - dyadicTileDepth L_max (t k.castSucc)| ≤
            (dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc) + dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ)) / 2 ∧
          dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc) / 2 ≤ dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ) ∧
          dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.succ) ≤ 2 * dyadicTileSide L_max (t k.castSucc)) := by
    intro B hB_ne hBadB hChainB
    have hB_len : 0 < B.length := List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil.mpr hB_ne
    let r : ℕ := B.length - 1
    let g_fn : Fin (r + 1) → Fin W × Fin H := fun k => B[k.val]'(by omega)
    let t : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ × ℕ × ℕ := fun k => τ (g_fn k)
    have ht0 : t 0 = τ (B.head hB_ne) := by
      change τ (B[0]'(by omega)) = τ (B.head hB_ne)
      rw [← List.head_eq_getElem hB_ne]
    have htr : t (Fin.last r) = τ (B.getLast hB_ne) := by
      change τ (B[r]'(by omega)) = τ (B.getLast hB_ne)
      have hidx : r = B.length - 1 := rfl
      simp only [hidx, ← List.getLast_eq_getElem hB_ne]
    refine ⟨r, t, ht0, htr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, hρ_pos, hd1, hd2, hx1, hx2, hd3, hd4⟩ :=
        hCell (g_fn k).1.val (g_fn k).2.val (g_fn k).1.isLt (g_fn k).2.isLt
      have hg_mem : g_fn k ∈ B := List.getElem_mem (by omega)
      exact ⟨hρ_pos, hd1, hd2, hx1, hx2, hd3, hd4, hBadB (g_fn k) hg_mem⟩
    · intro k
      have hstep : adjGrid (g_fn k.castSucc) (g_fn k.succ) :=
        List.isChain_iff_getElem.mp hChainB k.val (by omega)
      obtain ⟨_, hx_d, hd_d, hr1, hr2⟩ :=
        hAdj (g_fn k.castSucc).1.val (g_fn k.castSucc).2.val
          (g_fn k.succ).1.val (g_fn k.succ).2.val hstep.1 hstep.2
      exact ⟨hx_d, hd_d, hr1, hr2⟩

  let good : Fin W × Fin H → Bool := fun g =>
    @decide (isGoodTile (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)) (dyadicTileSide L_max (τ g)))
      (Classical.propDecidable _)

  have hAdj4_to_adj : ∀ g₁ g₂ : Fin W × Fin H, meshGridAdj4 g₁ g₂ → adjGrid g₁ g₂ := by
    intro g₁ g₂ h4
    unfold meshGridAdj4 at h4
    have h1 : 0 ≤ |(g₁.1.val : ℤ) - (g₂.1.val : ℤ)| := abs_nonneg _
    have h2 : 0 ≤ |(g₁.2.val : ℤ) - (g₂.2.val : ℤ)| := abs_nonneg _
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

  have hAdj8_to_adj : ∀ g₁ g₂ : Fin W × Fin H, meshGridAdj8 g₁ g₂ → adjGrid g₁ g₂ := by
    intro g₁ g₂ h8
    exact max_le_iff.mp h8

  constructor
  · 
    rcases hDual W H hW_pos hH_pos good with
      ⟨L, hL_ne, hGoodL, hChainL, hHead0, hLastW⟩ |
      ⟨B, hB_ne, hBadB, hChainB, hHead0, hLastH⟩
    · left
      obtain ⟨m, t, ht0, htm, hProps, hStep, hSum⟩ :=
        hBuildGood L hL_ne
          (fun g hg => @of_decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hGoodL g hg))
          (hChainL.imp fun _ _ h => hAdj4_to_adj _ _ h)
      refine ⟨m, fun k => dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileSide L_max (t k), hProps, ?_, ?_, hStep, hSum⟩
      · simp only [ht0, τ, dyadicTileCenter, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im,
          mul_one, sub_zero, sub_self]
        rw [hHead0]
        exact hPinL (L.head hL_ne).2.val (L.head hL_ne).2.isLt
      · simp only [htm, τ, dyadicTileCenter, Complex.sub_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im,
          mul_one, sub_zero, sub_self]
        rw [hLastW]
        exact hPinR (L.getLast hL_ne).2.val (L.getLast hL_ne).2.isLt
    · right
      obtain ⟨r, t, ht0, htr, hProps, hStep⟩ :=
        hBuildBad B hB_ne
          (fun g hg => decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp (hBadB g hg))
          (hChainB.imp fun _ _ h => hAdj8_to_adj _ _ h)
      refine ⟨r, fun k => dyadicTileX x_left L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileDepth L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileSide L_max (t k), hProps, ?_, ?_, hStep⟩
      · simp only [ht0, τ]
        rw [hHead0]
        exact hPinS (B.head hB_ne).1.val (B.head hB_ne).1.isLt
      · simp only [htr, τ]
        rw [hLastH]
        exact hPinD (B.getLast hB_ne).1.val (B.getLast hB_ne).1.isLt
  · 
    let ψ : Fin H × Fin W → Fin W × Fin H :=
      fun p => (p.2, ⟨H - 1 - p.1.val, by omega⟩)
    have hψ_diff : ∀ p q : Fin H × Fin W,
        |((ψ p).1.val : ℤ) - ((ψ q).1.val : ℤ)| = |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| ∧
        |((ψ p).2.val : ℤ) - ((ψ q).2.val : ℤ)| = |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| := by
      intro p q
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      have hp_lt := p.1.isLt
      have hq_lt := q.1.isLt
      have hsub : ((H - 1 - p.1.val : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((H - 1 - q.1.val : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          (q.1.val : ℤ) - (p.1.val : ℤ) := by omega
      dsimp [ψ]
      rw [hsub, abs_sub_comm]
    rcases hDual H W hH_pos hW_pos (fun p => good (ψ p)) with
      ⟨L', hL'_ne, hGoodL', hChainL', hHead0', hLastH'⟩ |
      ⟨B', hB'_ne, hBadB', hChainB', hHead0', hLastW'⟩
    · left
      let L := L'.map ψ
      have hL_ne : L ≠ [] := by simp [L, hL'_ne]
      have hGoodL : ∀ g ∈ L,
          isGoodTile (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)) (dyadicTileSide L_max (τ g)) := by
        intro g hg
        obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hg
        exact @of_decide_eq_true _ (Classical.propDecidable _) (hGoodL' p hp)
      have hChainL : List.IsChain adjGrid L := by
        refine List.isChain_map_of_isChain ψ ?_ hChainL'
        intro p q hpq
        unfold meshGridAdj4 at hpq
        obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := hψ_diff p q
        have h1 : 0 ≤ |(p.1.val : ℤ) - (q.1.val : ℤ)| := abs_nonneg _
        have h2 : 0 ≤ |(p.2.val : ℤ) - (q.2.val : ℤ)| := abs_nonneg _
        exact ⟨by rw [hd1]; omega, by rw [hd2]; omega⟩
      obtain ⟨m, t, ht0, htm, hProps, hStep, hSum⟩ := hBuildGood L hL_ne hGoodL hChainL
      refine ⟨m, fun k => dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileSide L_max (t k), hProps, ?_, ?_, hStep, hSum⟩
      · dsimp only
        have hhead_eq : τ (L.head hL_ne) =
            dyadicParentIdx (L'.head hL'_ne).2.val (H - 1) := by
          dsimp [L]
          rw [List.head_map]
          dsimp [τ, ψ]
          rw [hHead0', Nat.sub_zero]
        have him : -(dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t 0)).im =
            dyadicTileDepth L_max (t 0) := by simp [dyadicTileCenter]
        rw [him, ht0, hhead_eq]
        exact hPinD (L'.head hL'_ne).2.val (L'.head hL'_ne).2.isLt
      · dsimp only
        have hlast_eq : τ (L.getLast hL_ne) =
            dyadicParentIdx (L'.getLast hL'_ne).2.val 0 := by
          dsimp [L]
          rw [List.getLast_map]
          dsimp [τ, ψ]
          rw [hLastH', Nat.sub_self]
        have him : -(dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (t (Fin.last m))).im =
            dyadicTileDepth L_max (t (Fin.last m)) := by simp [dyadicTileCenter]
        rw [him, htm, hlast_eq]
        exact hPinS (L'.getLast hL'_ne).2.val (L'.getLast hL'_ne).2.isLt
    · right
      let B := B'.map ψ
      have hB_ne : B ≠ [] := by simp [B, hB'_ne]
      have hBadB : ∀ g ∈ B,
          ¬ isGoodTile (dyadicTileCenter x_left L_max (τ g)) (dyadicTileSide L_max (τ g)) := by
        intro g hg
        obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hg
        exact decide_eq_false_iff_not.mp (hBadB' p hp)
      have hChainB : List.IsChain adjGrid B := by
        refine List.isChain_map_of_isChain ψ ?_ hChainB'
        intro p q hpq
        obtain ⟨hpq1, hpq2⟩ := max_le_iff.mp hpq
        obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := hψ_diff p q
        exact ⟨by rwa [hd1], by rwa [hd2]⟩
      obtain ⟨r, t, ht0, htr, hProps, hStep⟩ := hBuildBad B hB_ne hBadB hChainB
      refine ⟨r, fun k => dyadicTileX x_left L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileDepth L_max (t k),
        fun k => dyadicTileSide L_max (t k), hProps, ?_, ?_, hStep⟩
      · dsimp only
        have hhead_eq : τ (B.head hB_ne) =
            dyadicParentIdx 0 (H - 1 - (B'.head hB'_ne).1.val) := by
          dsimp [B]
          rw [List.head_map]
          dsimp [τ, ψ]
          rw [hHead0']
        rw [ht0, hhead_eq]
        exact hPinL (H - 1 - (B'.head hB'_ne).1.val) (by omega)
      · dsimp only
        have hlast_eq : τ (B.getLast hB_ne) =
            dyadicParentIdx (W - 1) (H - 1 - (B'.getLast hB'_ne).1.val) := by
          dsimp [B]
          rw [List.getLast_map]
          dsimp [τ, ψ]
          rw [hLastW']
        rw [htr, hlast_eq]
        exact hPinR (H - 1 - (B'.getLast hB'_ne).1.val) (by omega)

graded_dyadic_grid_dichotomy.definitions:
def dyadicDropUntil {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | y :: ys => if y = x then y :: ys else dyadicDropUntil x ys

def dyadicParentIdx (i j : ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ :=
  let m := Nat.log 2 (1024 + j) - 10
  (m, i / 2 ^ m, (1024 + j) / 2 ^ m - 1024)

def dyadicValidTile (M_w L_min L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : Prop :=
  t.1 < L_max - L_min ∧ t.2.1 < M_w * 2 ^ (L_max + 9 - t.1) ∧ t.2.2 < 1024

noncomputable def dyadicTileSide (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (2 : ℝ) ^ t.1 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_max + 10))⁻¹

noncomputable def dyadicTileX (x_left : ℝ) (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  x_left + ((t.2.1 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicTileSide L_max t

noncomputable def dyadicTileDepth (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (1024 + (t.2.2 : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * dyadicTileSide L_max t

noncomputable def dyadicTileCenter (x_left : ℝ) (L_max : ℕ) (t : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (dyadicTileX x_left L_max t : ℂ) - (dyadicTileDepth L_max t : ℂ) * Complex.I

informal_problem.statement:
(F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane)
    (L₀ M_lat C_shad : ℝ) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hC_shad : 0 < C_shad)
    (hSh : DyadicShadowBoundAt L₀ M_lat C_shad) :
    (∀ (L_b L_a : ℕ) (M_top B_low U₀ : ℝ),
      L_b < L_a →
      0 ≤ U₀ →
      0 < M_top - B_low →
      C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) < 1 / 8192 →
      (∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
        ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
          16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
          δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
          |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
          Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
            ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top)) →
      ¬ DyadicBadVertChain (-3) 12 L_b L_a (meshTileIsGood F B_low)) ∧
    (∀ (x_left : ℝ) (L_bot L_top : ℕ) (M_top B_low U₀ : ℝ),
      L_bot < L_top →
      0 ≤ U₀ →
      0 < M_top - B_low →
      C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) < 2 →
      (∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_bot)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - (x_left + 1 / 4)| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_top + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top)) →
      ¬ DyadicBadLatChain x_left 1 L_bot L_top (meshTileIsGood F B_low))

signature.name: bad_dyadic_barriers_exclusion
signature.statement:
(F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane)
    (L₀ M_lat C_shad : ℝ) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hC_shad : 0 < C_shad)
    (hSh : DyadicShadowBoundAt L₀ M_lat C_shad) :
    (∀ (L_b L_a : ℕ) (M_top B_low U₀ : ℝ),
      L_b < L_a →
      0 ≤ U₀ →
      0 < M_top - B_low →
      C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) < 1 / 8192 →
      (∀ x₀ : ℝ, |x₀| ≤ 3 →
        ∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
          16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
          δ_w < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ / 16 ∧
          |p - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
          Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
          (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
            ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top)) →
      ¬ DyadicBadVertChain (-3) 12 L_b L_a (meshTileIsGood F B_low)) ∧
    (∀ (x_left : ℝ) (L_bot L_top : ℕ) (M_top B_low U₀ : ℝ),
      L_bot < L_top →
      0 ≤ U₀ →
      0 < M_top - B_low →
      C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) < 2 →
      (∃ p δ_w : ℝ,
        16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_bot)⁻¹ < δ_w ∧
        |p - (x_left + 1 / 4)| ≤ L₀ * δ_w ∧
        (L₀ + 2) * δ_w ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
        Real.exp (M_top - U₀) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ_w : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ∧
        (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re - p| ≤ M_lat * δ_w →
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_top + 3))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 2 * δ_w →
          ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top)) →
      ¬ DyadicBadLatChain x_left 1 L_bot L_top (meshTileIsGood F B_low))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hC_shad
  have hMeasIcc : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x ρ : Fin N → ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
      a ≤ b →
      Set.Icc a b ⊆ (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x i - ρ i / 2) (x i + ρ i / 2)) →
      b - a ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x i - ρ i / 2) (x i + ρ i / 2)) := by
    intro N x ρ a b hab h_sub
    have h_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume
        (⋃ i : Fin N, Set.Icc (x i - ρ i / 2) (x i + ρ i / 2)) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ((isCompact_iUnion fun i : Fin N => isCompact_Icc).measure_lt_top).ne
    have h_mono := MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub h_ne_top
    rwa [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le hab] at h_mono
  have hCoverU : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x ρ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (∀ k : Fin (n + 1), 0 < ρ k) →
      (∀ k : Fin n, |x k.succ - x k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ k.castSucc + ρ k.succ) / 2) →
      Set.uIcc (x 0) (x (Fin.last n)) ⊆
        (⋃ k : Fin (n + 1), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x ρ hρ _ t ht
      have hlast : (Fin.last 0 : Fin 1) = 0 := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hlast, Set.uIcc_self, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
      subst ht
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, ?_⟩
      have hρ0 := hρ 0
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x ρ hρ hAdj
      let x' : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun k => x k.castSucc
      let ρ' : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun k => ρ k.castSucc
      have hρ' : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1), 0 < ρ' k := fun k => hρ k.castSucc
      have hAdj' : ∀ k : Fin n,
          |x' k.succ - x' k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ' k.castSucc + ρ' k.succ) / 2 := by
        intro k
        exact hAdj k.castSucc
      have h_sub_prev : Set.uIcc (x 0) (x (Fin.last n).castSucc) ⊆
          (⋃ k : Fin (n + 2), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
        intro t ht
        have ht' : t ∈ Set.uIcc (x' 0) (x' (Fin.last n)) := ht
        rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp (ih x' ρ' hρ' hAdj' ht') with ⟨k, hk⟩
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k.castSucc, hk⟩
      let u : Fin (n + 2) := (Fin.last n).castSucc
      let v : Fin (n + 2) := Fin.last (n + 1)
      have hv_eq : (Fin.last n).succ = v := Fin.ext rfl
      have h_uv : |x v - x u| ≤ (ρ u + ρ v) / 2 := by
        have h1 := hAdj (Fin.last n)
        rwa [hv_eq] at h1
      rcases abs_le.mp h_uv with ⟨h_uv_lo, h_uv_hi⟩
      have hρu : 0 < ρ u := hρ u
      have hρv : 0 < ρ v := hρ v
      let m_mid : ℝ := max (x u - ρ u / 2) (x v - ρ v / 2)
      have h_sub_u : Set.uIcc (x u) m_mid ⊆
          (⋃ k : Fin (n + 2), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
        have h_in : Set.uIcc (x u) m_mid ⊆ Set.Icc (x u - ρ u / 2) (x u + ρ u / 2) :=
          Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
            ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)⟩
        exact fun t ht => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, h_in ht⟩
      have h_sub_v : Set.uIcc m_mid (x v) ⊆
          (⋃ k : Fin (n + 2), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
        have h_in : Set.uIcc m_mid (x v) ⊆ Set.Icc (x v - ρ v / 2) (x v + ρ v / 2) :=
          Set.uIcc_subset_Icc ⟨le_max_right _ _, max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)⟩
            ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        exact fun t ht => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨v, h_in ht⟩
      intro t ht
      have h_sp1 : Set.uIcc (x 0) (x v) ⊆ Set.uIcc (x 0) (x u) ∪ Set.uIcc (x u) (x v) :=
        Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_union_uIcc
      have h_sp2 : Set.uIcc (x u) (x v) ⊆ Set.uIcc (x u) m_mid ∪ Set.uIcc m_mid (x v) :=
        Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_union_uIcc
      rcases h_sp1 ht with ht1 | ht2
      · exact h_sub_prev ht1
      · rcases h_sp2 ht2 with ht2a | ht2b
        · exact h_sub_u ht2a
        · exact h_sub_v ht2b
  have hMeasSpan : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x ρ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (∀ k : Fin (n + 1), 0 < ρ k) →
      (∀ k : Fin n, |x k.succ - x k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ k.castSucc + ρ k.succ) / 2) →
      |x (Fin.last n) - x 0| ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ k : Fin (n + 1), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
    intro n x ρ hρ hAdj
    have h_ne_top : MeasureTheory.volume
        (⋃ k : Fin (n + 1), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ((isCompact_iUnion fun k : Fin (n + 1) => isCompact_Icc).measure_lt_top).ne
    have h_mono := MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono (hCoverU n x ρ hρ hAdj) h_ne_top
    rwa [Real.volume_real_interval] at h_mono
  have hCoverExt : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x ρ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      (∀ k : Fin (n + 1), 0 < ρ k) →
      (∀ k : Fin n, |x k.succ - x k.castSucc| ≤ (ρ k.castSucc + ρ k.succ) / 2) →
      Set.Icc (x 0 - ρ 0 / 2) (x (Fin.last n) + ρ (Fin.last n) / 2) ⊆
        (⋃ k : Fin (n + 1), Set.Icc (x k - ρ k / 2) (x k + ρ k / 2)) := by
    intro n x ρ hρ hAdj t ht
    rcases le_or_gt t (x 0) with ht_lo | ht_gt
    · refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, ?_⟩
      have h0 := hρ 0
      exact ⟨ht.1, by linarith⟩
    · rcases le_or_gt (x (Fin.last n)) t with ht_hi | ht_lt
      · refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Fin.last n, ?_⟩
        have hl := hρ (Fin.last n)
        exact ⟨by linarith, ht.2⟩
      · exact hCoverU n x ρ hρ hAdj (Set.Icc_subset_uIcc ⟨ht_gt.le, ht_lt.le⟩)
  have hBadDisk : ∀ (M_top B_low : ℝ) (c_T : ℂ) (ρ_T : ℝ),
      ¬ meshTileIsGood F B_low c_T ρ_T →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c_T (ρ_T / 8),
        ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp (M_top - (M_top - B_low)) := by
    intro M_top B_low c_T ρ_T h_bad z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have h_nneg : 0 ≤ ‖z - c_T‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h_re : |(z - c_T).re| ≤ ρ_T / 2 := by
      have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - c_T)
      linarith
    have h_im : |(z - c_T).im| ≤ ρ_T / 2 := by
      have := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - c_T)
      linarith
    have hz_sq : z ∈ meshClosedSquare c_T ρ_T := ⟨h_re, h_im⟩
    by_contra h_gt
    rw [not_le] at h_gt
    have h_eq : M_top - (M_top - B_low) = B_low := by ring
    rw [h_eq] at h_gt
    exact h_bad ⟨z, hz_sq, h_gt.le⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L_b L_a M_top B_low U₀ hL hU₀ hDiff hRatio hWit hChain
    rcases hChain with ⟨r, x_T, d_T, ρ_T, hTiles, hd0, hdl, hAdj⟩
    have hx0_abs : |x_T 0| ≤ 3 := by
      have h0 := hTiles 0
      rcases h0 with ⟨hρ0, _, _, hx0_lo, hx0_hi, _, _, _⟩
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by norm_num at hx0_hi; linarith⟩
    rcases hWit (x_T 0) hx0_abs with ⟨p, δ_w, hδ_lo, hδ_hi, hp, hF_wit, hF_box⟩
    have h_pow_a_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_w := by linarith
    have hd0_lt : d_T 0 < δ_w / 4 := by
      have h0 := hTiles 0
      rcases h0 with ⟨hρ0, hd0_lo, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
      linarith
    have hx0_lt : |x_T 0 - x_T 0| < δ_w := by
      simpa using hδ_pos
    have hdl_ge : δ_w / 4 ≤ d_T (Fin.last r) := by
      have hl := hTiles (Fin.last r)
      rcases hl with ⟨hρl, hdl_lo, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
      linarith
    classical
    let P : ℕ → Prop := fun k =>
      ∃ hk : k < r + 1, δ_w / 4 ≤ d_T ⟨k, hk⟩ ∨ δ_w ≤ |x_T ⟨k, hk⟩ - x_T 0|
    have h_ex : ∃ k : ℕ, P k := by
      refine ⟨r, Nat.lt_succ_self r, Or.inl ?_⟩
      have hr_eq : (⟨r, Nat.lt_succ_self r⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = Fin.last r := Fin.ext rfl
      rwa [hr_eq]
    let m : ℕ := Nat.find h_ex
    rcases Nat.find_spec h_ex with ⟨hm_lt, hPm⟩
    have hm_pos : 1 ≤ m := by
      by_contra hm0
      have hm_eq : m = 0 := by omega
      have hfin0 : (⟨m, hm_lt⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = 0 := Fin.ext hm_eq
      rw [hfin0] at hPm
      rcases hPm with h1 | h2 <;> linarith
    let j_prev : Fin r := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
    have hj_succ : j_prev.succ = ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ := by
      ext
      dsimp [j_prev]
      omega
    have h_not_prev : ¬ P (m - 1) := Nat.find_min h_ex (by omega)
    have h_prev_bounds : d_T j_prev.castSucc < δ_w / 4 ∧
        |x_T j_prev.castSucc - x_T 0| < δ_w := by
      have hm1_lt : m - 1 < r + 1 := by omega
      have h_not : ¬ (δ_w / 4 ≤ d_T ⟨m - 1, hm1_lt⟩ ∨
          δ_w ≤ |x_T ⟨m - 1, hm1_lt⟩ - x_T 0|) := fun h => h_not_prev ⟨hm1_lt, h⟩
      have hj_cast : (⟨m - 1, hm1_lt⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = j_prev.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hj_cast, not_or, not_le, not_le] at h_not
      exact h_not
    have h_m_bounds : d_T ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ ≤ δ_w / 2 ∧
        |x_T ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ - x_T 0| ≤ 2 * δ_w := by
      rcases hAdj j_prev with ⟨hx_step, hd_step, _, hρ_step⟩
      have h_t_prev := hTiles j_prev.castSucc
      have h_t_succ := hTiles j_prev.succ
      have hρ_prev : 0 < ρ_T j_prev.castSucc := h_t_prev.1
      have hd_prev_lo : 1024 * ρ_T j_prev.castSucc ≤ d_T j_prev.castSucc := h_t_prev.2.1
      have hρ_succ : 0 < ρ_T j_prev.succ := h_t_succ.1
      have hd_diff : d_T j_prev.succ - d_T j_prev.castSucc ≤
          (ρ_T j_prev.castSucc + ρ_T j_prev.succ) / 2 := (abs_le.mp hd_step).2
      have h_tri : |x_T j_prev.succ - x_T 0| ≤
          |x_T j_prev.succ - x_T j_prev.castSucc| + |x_T j_prev.castSucc - x_T 0| :=
        abs_sub_le _ _ _
      rw [← hj_succ]
      exact ⟨by linarith [h_prev_bounds.1], by linarith [h_prev_bounds.1, h_prev_bounds.2]⟩
    let idx : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (r + 1) := fun i => ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
    let τ : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 3))⁻¹
    have hτ_eq : τ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ / 8 := by
      dsimp [τ]
      have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 3) = (2 : ℝ) ^ L_a * 8 := by
        rw [pow_add]
        norm_num
      rw [h_pow, mul_inv]
      ring
    have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := by positivity
    have hτ_lt : τ < δ_w / 4 := by linarith
    have hPref_adm : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
        0 < ρ_T (idx i) ∧
        1024 * ρ_T (idx i) ≤ d_T (idx i) ∧
        d_T (idx i) ≤ 2048 * ρ_T (idx i) ∧
        d_T (idx i) ≤ δ_w / 2 ∧
        |x_T (idx i) - p| ≤ (L₀ + 3) * δ_w ∧
        τ < d_T (idx i) / 4 := by
      intro i
      have h_ti := hTiles (idx i)
      have hρ_i : 0 < ρ_T (idx i) := h_ti.1
      have hd_i_lo1 : 1024 * ρ_T (idx i) ≤ d_T (idx i) := h_ti.2.1
      have hd_i_hi1 : d_T (idx i) ≤ 2048 * ρ_T (idx i) := h_ti.2.2.1
      have hd_i_la : ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ + ρ_T (idx i) / 2 ≤ d_T (idx i) :=
        h_ti.2.2.2.2.2.1
      have h_dx_i : d_T (idx i) ≤ δ_w / 2 ∧ |x_T (idx i) - x_T 0| ≤ 2 * δ_w := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt) with hi_lt | hi_eq
        · have h_not_i : ¬ P i.val := Nat.find_min h_ex hi_lt
          have hi_r : i.val < r + 1 := by omega
          have h_ni : ¬ (δ_w / 4 ≤ d_T ⟨i.val, hi_r⟩ ∨
              δ_w ≤ |x_T ⟨i.val, hi_r⟩ - x_T 0|) := fun h => h_not_i ⟨hi_r, h⟩
          have hi_idx : (⟨i.val, hi_r⟩ : Fin (r + 1)) = idx i := Fin.ext rfl
          rw [hi_idx, not_or, not_le, not_le] at h_ni
          exact ⟨by linarith [h_ni.1], by linarith [h_ni.2]⟩
        · have hi_idx : idx i = ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ := Fin.ext hi_eq
          rwa [hi_idx]
      have hx_p : |x_T (idx i) - p| ≤ (L₀ + 3) * δ_w := by
        have h_tri : |x_T (idx i) - p| ≤ |x_T (idx i) - x_T 0| + |x_T 0 - p| :=
          abs_sub_le _ _ _
        have hp' : |x_T 0 - p| ≤ L₀ * δ_w := by rwa [abs_sub_comm]
        have hL₀_δ : 0 < L₀ * δ_w := mul_pos hL₀ hδ_pos
        linarith [h_dx_i.2]
      exact ⟨hρ_i, hd_i_lo1, hd_i_hi1, h_dx_i.1, hx_p, by linarith⟩
    have hVol_hi : MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin (m + 1),
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) ≤
        C_shad * δ_w * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) :=
      hSh p δ_w τ M_top U₀ (M_top - B_low) F (m + 1)
        (fun i => x_T (idx i)) (fun i => d_T (idx i)) (fun i => ρ_T (idx i))
        hδ_pos hτ_pos hτ_lt hU₀ hDiff hPref_adm hF_holo hF_box hF_wit
        (fun i z hz => hBadDisk M_top B_low _ _ (hTiles (idx i)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 z hz)
    have hVol_lt : MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin (m + 1),
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) <
        δ_w / 8192 := by
      have h_mul : δ_w * (C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low))) < δ_w * (1 / 8192) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hRatio hδ_pos
      have h_comm : C_shad * δ_w * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) =
          δ_w * (C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low))) := by ring
      linarith
    have h_last_eq : idx (Fin.last m) = ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ := Fin.ext rfl
    rcases hPm with hd_exit | hx_exit
    · have hd_hi_m : d_T ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ ≤ 2048 * ρ_T ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ := (hTiles ⟨m, hm_lt⟩).2.2.1
      have hρ_m_ge : δ_w / 8192 ≤ ρ_T (idx (Fin.last m)) := by
        rw [h_last_eq]
        linarith
      have hρ_m_pos : 0 < ρ_T (idx (Fin.last m)) := (hTiles (idx (Fin.last m))).1
      have h_one_le : ρ_T (idx (Fin.last m)) ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real
          (⋃ i : Fin (m + 1),
            Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) := by
        have h1 := hMeasIcc (m + 1) (fun i => x_T (idx i)) (fun i => ρ_T (idx i))
          (x_T (idx (Fin.last m)) - ρ_T (idx (Fin.last m)) / 2)
          (x_T (idx (Fin.last m)) + ρ_T (idx (Fin.last m)) / 2)
          (by linarith) (fun t ht => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Fin.last m, ht⟩)
        linarith
      linarith
    · have hPrefAdj : ∀ i : Fin m,
          |x_T (idx i.succ) - x_T (idx i.castSucc)| ≤
            (ρ_T (idx i.castSucc) + ρ_T (idx i.succ)) / 2 := by
        intro i
        let j : Fin r := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
        have h_cs : idx i.castSucc = j.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
        have h_sc : idx i.succ = j.succ := Fin.ext rfl
        rw [h_cs, h_sc]
        exact (hAdj j).1
      have h_span_le := hMeasSpan m (fun i => x_T (idx i)) (fun i => ρ_T (idx i))
        (fun i => (hTiles (idx i)).1) hPrefAdj
      have h_idx0 : idx 0 = 0 := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [h_last_eq, h_idx0] at h_span_le
      linarith
  · intro x_left L_bot L_top M_top B_low U₀ hL hU₀ hDiff hRatio hWit hChain
    rcases hWit with ⟨p, δ_w, hδ_lo, hp_mid, hδ_small, hF_wit, hF_box⟩
    rcases hChain with ⟨r, x_T, d_T, ρ_T, hTiles, hx0, hxl, hAdj⟩
    have h_pow_bot_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_bot)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_w := by linarith
    have hCoverFull : Set.Icc x_left (x_left + 1 / 2) ⊆
        (⋃ k : Fin (r + 1), Set.Icc (x_T k - ρ_T k / 2) (x_T k + ρ_T k / 2)) := by
      have h1 := hCoverExt r x_T ρ_T (fun k => (hTiles k).1) (fun k => (hAdj k).1)
      have hl_eq : x_T 0 - ρ_T 0 / 2 = x_left := by linarith
      have hr_eq : x_T (Fin.last r) + ρ_T (Fin.last r) / 2 = x_left + 1 / 2 := by
        norm_num at hxl
        linarith
      rwa [hl_eq, hr_eq] at h1
    let τ : ℝ := ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_top + 3))⁻¹
    have hτ_eq : τ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_top)⁻¹ / 8 := by
      dsimp [τ]
      have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (L_top + 3) = (2 : ℝ) ^ L_top * 8 := by
        rw [pow_add]
        norm_num
      rw [h_pow, mul_inv]
      ring
    have h_pow_lt : ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_top)⁻¹ < ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_bot)⁻¹ :=
      inv_strictAnti₀ (by positivity) (pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hL)
    have hτ_pos : 0 < τ := by positivity
    have hτ_lt : τ < δ_w / 4 := by linarith
    have hTileDepth : ∀ k : Fin (r + 1),
        d_T k ≤ δ_w / 2 ∧ ρ_T k < δ_w ∧ τ < d_T k / 4 := by
      intro k
      rcases hTiles k with ⟨hρ_k, hd_k_lo, _, _, _, hd_k_top, hd_k_bot, _⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    classical
    let S_keep : Finset (Fin (r + 1)) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun k : Fin (r + 1) => |x_T k - p| ≤ 2 * δ_w)
    let N : ℕ := S_keep.card
    let e : Fin N ≃ { k // k ∈ S_keep } := S_keep.equivFin.symm
    let idx : Fin N → Fin (r + 1) := fun i => (e i).1
    have hCoverWin : Set.Icc (p - δ_w) (p + δ_w) ⊆
        (⋃ i : Fin N,
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) := by
      intro t ht
      rcases abs_le.mp hp_mid with ⟨hp_lo, hp_hi⟩
      have hL₀_δ_pos : 0 < L₀ * δ_w := mul_pos hL₀ hδ_pos
      have ht_in_full : t ∈ Set.Icc x_left (x_left + 1 / 2) :=
        ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hCoverFull ht_in_full) with ⟨k, hk_Icc⟩
      have hρ_k_lt : ρ_T k < δ_w := (hTileDepth k).2.1
      have hk_abs : |x_T k - p| ≤ 2 * δ_w :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hk_Icc.2, ht.1], by linarith [hk_Icc.1, ht.2]⟩
      have hk_mem : k ∈ S_keep := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ k, hk_abs⟩
      let i : Fin N := e.symm ⟨k, hk_mem⟩
      have hi_eq : idx i = k := by
        dsimp [idx, i]
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ?_⟩
      rwa [hi_eq]
    have hVol_lo : 2 * δ_w ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin N,
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) := by
      have h1 := hMeasIcc N (fun i => x_T (idx i)) (fun i => ρ_T (idx i))
        (p - δ_w) (p + δ_w) (by linarith) hCoverWin
      linarith
    have hLat_adm : ∀ i : Fin N,
        0 < ρ_T (idx i) ∧
        1024 * ρ_T (idx i) ≤ d_T (idx i) ∧
        d_T (idx i) ≤ 2048 * ρ_T (idx i) ∧
        d_T (idx i) ≤ δ_w / 2 ∧
        |x_T (idx i) - p| ≤ (L₀ + 3) * δ_w ∧
        τ < d_T (idx i) / 4 := by
      intro i
      have h_ti := hTiles (idx i)
      have h_di := hTileDepth (idx i)
      have h_mem : idx i ∈ S_keep := (e i).2
      have h_abs : |x_T (idx i) - p| ≤ 2 * δ_w := (Finset.mem_filter.mp h_mem).2
      have hL₀_δ_pos : 0 < L₀ * δ_w := mul_pos hL₀ hδ_pos
      exact ⟨h_ti.1, h_ti.2.1, h_ti.2.2.1, h_di.1, by linarith, h_di.2.2⟩
    have hVol_hi : MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin N,
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) ≤
        C_shad * δ_w * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) :=
      hSh p δ_w τ M_top U₀ (M_top - B_low) F N
        (fun i => x_T (idx i)) (fun i => d_T (idx i)) (fun i => ρ_T (idx i))
        hδ_pos hτ_pos hτ_lt hU₀ hDiff hLat_adm hF_holo hF_box hF_wit
        (fun i z hz => hBadDisk M_top B_low _ _ (hTiles (idx i)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2 z hz)
    have hVol_lt : MeasureTheory.volume.real
        (⋃ i : Fin N,
          Set.Icc (x_T (idx i) - ρ_T (idx i) / 2) (x_T (idx i) + ρ_T (idx i) / 2)) <
        2 * δ_w := by
      have h_mul : δ_w * (C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low))) < δ_w * 2 :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hRatio hδ_pos
      have h_comm : C_shad * δ_w * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low)) =
          δ_w * (C_shad * (U₀ / (M_top - B_low))) := by ring
      linarith
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane)
    (C_route C_len : ℝ) (hC_route : 0 < C_route) (hC_len : 0 < C_len)
    (hRt : DyadicChainRoutingAt C_route C_len) :
    (∀ (L_b L_a : ℕ) (M_top T : ℝ),
      10 ≤ L_b → L_b < L_a → 0 < T →
      (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re| ≤ 5 →

        ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) →
      DyadicGoodHorizChain (-3) 12 L_b L_a (meshTileIsGood F (M_top - 2 * T)) →
      ∃ (γ : List ℂ) (hγ : γ ≠ []),
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace γ,
          -4 ≤ w.re ∧ w.re ≤ 4 ∧
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 1))⁻¹ < -w.im ∧ -w.im < ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 1))⁻¹) ∧
        (γ.head hγ).re ≤ -2.5 ∧
        2.5 ≤ (γ.getLast hγ).re ∧
        meshPolyLength γ ≤ C_len * (6144 * ((L_a - L_b : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace γ,
          Real.exp (M_top - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F w‖ ∧ ‖F w‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top)) ∧

      (∀ z : ℂ, |z.re| ≤ 5 →
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im → -z.im ≤ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ →
        ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) →
      DyadicGoodVertChain x_left 1 (L_b - 3) (L_a2 + 3) (meshTileIsGood F (M_top - 2 * T)) →
      ∃ (σ : List ℂ) (hσ : σ ≠ []),
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace σ,
          x_left - 0.4 < w.re ∧ w.re < x_left + 0.9 ∧ 0 < -w.im) ∧
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 1))⁻¹ ≤ -(σ.head hσ).im ∧
        -(σ.getLast hσ).im ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 1))⁻¹ ∧
        meshPolyLength σ ≤ C_len * (512 * ((L_a2 + 3 - (L_b - 3) : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ meshPolyTrace σ,
          Real.exp (M_top - C_route * T) ≤ ‖F w‖ ∧ ‖F w‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top))

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hC_route
  have hBall_coords : ∀ (z c : ℂ) (R : ℝ), z ∈ Metric.ball c R →
      (c.re - R < z.re ∧ z.re < c.re + R) ∧ (-c.im - R < -z.im ∧ -z.im < -c.im + R) := by
    intro z c R hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    obtain ⟨hre1, hre2⟩ := abs_le.mp (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (z - c))
    obtain ⟨him1, him2⟩ := abs_le.mp (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (z - c))
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at hre1 hre2
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at him1 him2
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hSq_coords : ∀ (w c : ℂ) (s : ℝ), w ∈ meshClosedSquare c s →
      (c.re - s / 2 ≤ w.re ∧ w.re ≤ c.re + s / 2) ∧
      (-c.im - s / 2 ≤ -w.im ∧ -w.im ≤ -c.im + s / 2) := by
    intro w c s hw
    rcases hw with ⟨hw_re, hw_im⟩
    obtain ⟨hre1, hre2⟩ := abs_le.mp hw_re
    obtain ⟨him1, him2⟩ := abs_le.mp hw_im
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at hre1 hre2
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at him1 him2
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hSq_sub_ball : ∀ (w c : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      w ∈ meshClosedSquare c (9 * r) → w ∈ Metric.ball c (100 * r) := by
    intro w c r hr hw
    rcases hw with ⟨hw_re, hw_im⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hnorm : ‖w - c‖ ≤ |(w - c).re| + |(w - c).im| :=
      Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (w - c)
    linarith
  have inv_two_pow_le : ∀ m n : ℕ, n ≤ m → ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹ ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro m n hnm
    exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnm)
  have hShift : ∀ n d : ℕ, ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + d))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ d)⁻¹ := by
    intro n d
    rw [pow_add, mul_inv]
  have hShift1 : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    rw [hShift n 1]
    have h1 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 1)⁻¹ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [h1]
    ring
  have hShift2 : ∀ n : ℕ, 4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    rw [hShift n 2]
    have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [h2]
    ring
  have hShift3 : ∀ n : ℕ, 8 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 3))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    rw [hShift n 3]
    have h3 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 3)⁻¹ = (1 / 8 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [h3]
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L_b L_a M_top T hLb _hLba hT hBox hChain
    rcases hChain with ⟨m, c, ρ, hTile, hHead_re, hLast_re, hAdj, hSum⟩
    have h12 : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 12 := by norm_num
    rw [h12] at hLast_re hSum
    have h2Lb : ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 1024 :=
      (inv_two_pow_le L_b 10 hLb).trans_eq (by norm_num)
    have hLa_pos : 0 < ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 1))⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hLa_shift : 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a + 1))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_a)⁻¹ := hShift1 L_a
    have hLb_shift1 : 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 1))⁻¹ := by
      have h_eq : L_b - 1 + 1 = L_b := by omega
      have h := hShift1 (L_b - 1)
      rwa [h_eq] at h
    have hBallProps : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k), ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) ∧
        (∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare (c k) (ρ k), Real.exp (M_top - 2 * T) ≤ ‖F q‖) := by
      intro k
      rcases hTile k with ⟨hρ_pos, hAsp_lo, _hAsp_hi, hRe_lo, hRe_hi, hIm_lo, hIm_hi, hGood⟩

        refine ⟨by linarith, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩

    · have hSum' : (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ≤ 6144 * ((L_a - L_b : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith

    have h1_nat : ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h1_nat] at hSum
    have h2Lb3 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 3))⁻¹ ≤ 1 / 128 :=
      (inv_two_pow_le (L_b - 3) 7 (by omega)).trans_eq (by norm_num)
    have hLa2_6_pos : 0 < ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 6))⁻¹ := by positivity
    have hLb_shift3 : 8 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 3))⁻¹ := by
      have h_eq : L_b - 3 + 3 = L_b := by omega
      have h := hShift3 (L_b - 3)
      rwa [h_eq] at h
    have hLb_shift31 : 4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 1))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_b - 3))⁻¹ := by
      have h_eq : L_b - 3 + 2 = L_b - 1 := by omega
      have h := hShift2 (L_b - 3)
      rwa [h_eq] at h
    have hLa2_shift31 : 4 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 3))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 1))⁻¹ := by
      have h_eq : L_a2 + 1 + 2 = L_a2 + 3 := by omega
      have h := hShift2 (L_a2 + 1)
      rwa [h_eq] at h
    have hLa2_shift63 : 8 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 6))⁻¹ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 3))⁻¹ := by
      have h_eq : L_a2 + 3 + 3 = L_a2 + 6 := by omega
      have h := hShift3 (L_a2 + 3)
      rwa [h_eq] at h
    have hBallProps2 : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ F (Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k), ‖F z‖ ≤ Real.exp M_top) ∧
        (∃ q ∈ meshClosedSquare (c k) (ρ k), Real.exp (M_top - 2 * T) ≤ ‖F q‖) := by
      intro k

      have hInBox : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (c k) (100 * ρ k),

          ((2 : ℝ) ^ (L_a2 + 6))⁻¹ ≤ -z.im ∧ -z.im ≤ 16 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ L_b)⁻¹ := by
        intro z hz
        rcases hBall_coords z (c k) (100 * ρ k) hz with ⟨⟨hz_re1, hz_re2⟩, ⟨hz_im1, hz_im2⟩⟩
        refine ⟨by linarith, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      refine ⟨hF_holo.mono ?_, ?_, hGood⟩
      · intro z hz
        show z.im < 0
        exact (hInBox z hz).1
      · intro z hz
        rcases hInBox z hz with ⟨_, h1, h2, h3⟩

    rcases hRt m c ρ F M_top T hT (fun k => (hTile k).1) hAdj hBallProps2 with
      ⟨σ, hσ, hσ_head, hσ_last, hσ_sub, hσ_len, hσ_mod_lo⟩
    refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

      rw [h1_nat] at hRe_hi
      rcases hSq_coords w (c k) (9 * ρ k) hwk with ⟨⟨hw_re1, hw_re2⟩, ⟨hw_im1, _hw_im2⟩⟩
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · rcases hTile 0 with ⟨hρ0_pos, hAsp0_lo, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
      rcases hSq_coords (σ.head hσ) (c 0) (ρ 0) hσ_head with ⟨_, ⟨him1, _⟩⟩
      linarith
    · rcases hTile (Fin.last m) with ⟨hρL_pos, hAspL_lo, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩
      rcases hSq_coords (σ.getLast hσ) (c (Fin.last m)) (ρ (Fin.last m)) hσ_last with
        ⟨_, ⟨_, him2⟩⟩
      linarith
    · have hSum' : (∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ρ k) ≤ 512 * ((L_a2 + 3 - (L_b - 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        linarith
      exact hσ_len.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSum' hC_len.le)
    · intro w hw
      refine ⟨hσ_mod_lo w hw, ?_⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hσ_sub hw) with ⟨k, hwk⟩
      exact (hBallProps2 k).2.1 w (hSq_sub_ball w (c k) (ρ k) (hTile k).1 hwk)

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ K₁ : ℝ)
    (hx₀ : 0 ≤ x₀)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁)
    (hr_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ r v - r u)
    (hr_hi : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → r v - r u ≤ K₁ * (v - u))
    (hr_ge : ∀ x : ℝ, x₀ ≤ x → x ≤ r x) :
    ∃ (Ω_set : Set (ℤ → Set.Icc (3 / 4 : ℝ) K₁)) (M_sup : ℕ → ℝ) (lam : ℝ),
      IsClosed Ω_set ∧
      Ω_set.Nonempty ∧
      1 ≤ lam ∧
      lam ≤ K₁ ∧
      (∀ ξ : ℤ → Set.Icc (3 / 4 : ℝ) K₁, ξ ∈ Ω_set ↔ (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + 1)) ∈ Ω_set) ∧
      (∀ ξ ∈ Ω_set, ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ n_j : ℕ,
        x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ (n_j : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ k : ℤ, |k| ≤ (j : ℤ) + 1 →
          |(r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ))) - (ξ k : ℝ)| <
            1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      (∀ ξ ∈ Ω_set, ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) ≤ M_sup (n + 1)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ξ ∈ Ω_set, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) = M_sup (n + 1))
