proof.tactics:
by
  have _ : 0 ≤ x₀ ∧ 1 ≤ K₁ := ⟨hx₀, hK₁⟩
  let I_K := Set.Icc (3 / 4 : ℝ) K₁
  let X := ℤ → I_K
  let ξ_orb : ℕ → X := fun m k =>
    ⟨r ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) - r ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ)), by
      have hlo := hr_lo ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ)) ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) (by linarith)
      have hhi := hr_hi ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ)) ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) (by linarith)
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  let A : ℕ → Set X := fun M => ξ_orb '' Set.Ici M
  let F : ℕ → Set X := fun M => closure (A M)
  let Ω_set : Set X := ⋂ M : ℕ, F M
  have hΩ_closed : IsClosed Ω_set := isClosed_iInter fun _ => isClosed_closure
  have hΩ_comp : IsCompact Ω_set := hΩ_closed.isCompact
  have hΩ_ne : Ω_set.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨ξ₀, φ₀, hφ₀_mono, hφ₀_lim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq ξ_orb
    refine ⟨ξ₀, Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun M => ?_⟩
    refine mem_closure_of_tendsto hφ₀_lim ?_
    exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨M, fun k hk =>
      ⟨φ₀ k, le_trans hk (hφ₀_mono.id_le k), rfl⟩⟩
  let τ : X → X := fun ξ k => ξ (k + 1)
  let τ_inv : X → X := fun ξ k => ξ (k - 1)
  have hτ_cont : Continuous τ := continuous_pi fun k => continuous_apply (k + 1)
  have hτ_inv_cont : Continuous τ_inv := continuous_pi fun k => continuous_apply (k - 1)
  have hτ_orb : ∀ m : ℕ, τ (ξ_orb m) = ξ_orb (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp [τ, ξ_orb]
    have h1 : (m : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      push_cast; ring
    have h2 : (m : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hτ_inv_orb : ∀ m : ℕ, τ_inv (ξ_orb (m + 1)) = ξ_orb m := by
    intro m
    funext k
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp [τ_inv, ξ_orb]
    have h1 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 = (m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1 := by
      push_cast; ring
    have h2 : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((k - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hτ_left_inv : ∀ ξ : X, τ_inv (τ ξ) = ξ := by
    intro ξ
    funext k
    exact congrArg ξ (by omega)
  have hΩ_shift : ∀ ξ : X, ξ ∈ Ω_set ↔ (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + 1)) ∈ Ω_set := by
    intro ξ
    constructor
    · intro hξ
      refine Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun M => ?_
      have h_sub : A M ⊆ τ ⁻¹' F M := by
        rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
        change τ (ξ_orb m) ∈ F M
        rw [hτ_orb m]
        exact subset_closure ⟨m + 1, Nat.le_succ_of_le hm, rfl⟩
      exact closure_minimal h_sub (isClosed_closure.preimage hτ_cont) (Set.mem_iInter.mp hξ M)
    · intro hτξ
      refine Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun M => ?_
      have h_sub : A (M + 1) ⊆ τ_inv ⁻¹' F M := by
        rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
        change τ_inv (ξ_orb m) ∈ F M
        have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by
          change M + 1 ≤ m at hm
          omega
        have hm_le : M ≤ m - 1 := by
          change M + 1 ≤ m at hm
          omega
        rw [hm_eq, hτ_inv_orb (m - 1)]
        exact subset_closure ⟨m - 1, hm_le, rfl⟩
      have h_mem : τ_inv (τ ξ) ∈ F M :=
        closure_minimal h_sub (isClosed_closure.preimage hτ_inv_cont)
          (Set.mem_iInter.mp hτξ (M + 1))
      rwa [hτ_left_inv ξ] at h_mem
  have hτ_iter : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : X), ξ ∈ Ω_set → (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + (m : ℤ))) ∈ Ω_set := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro ξ hξ
      have h_eq : (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) = ξ := by
        funext k
        exact congrArg ξ (by omega)
      rwa [h_eq]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro ξ hξ
      have h_step : (fun k : ℤ => ξ ((k + 1) + (m : ℤ))) ∈ Ω_set :=
        (hΩ_shift (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + (m : ℤ)))).mp (ih ξ hξ)
      have h_eq : (fun k : ℤ => ξ ((k + 1) + (m : ℤ))) =
          (fun k : ℤ => ξ (k + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) := by
        funext k
        exact congrArg ξ (by omega)
      rwa [← h_eq]
  have hΩ_approx : ∀ ξ ∈ Ω_set, ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ n_j : ℕ,
      x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ (n_j : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ k : ℤ, |k| ≤ (j : ℤ) + 1 →
        |(r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ))) - (ξ k : ℝ)| <
          1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro ξ hξ j
    let M_j : ℕ := Nat.ceil x₀ + j
    let J_j : Finset ℤ := Finset.Icc (-((j : ℤ) + 1)) ((j : ℤ) + 1)
    let U_j : Set X := ⋂ k ∈ J_j, {η : X | |(η k : ℝ) - (ξ k : ℝ)| < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)}
    have hU_open : IsOpen U_j := by
      refine isOpen_biInter_finset fun k _ => ?_
      exact isOpen_lt
        (((continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply k)).sub continuous_const).abs)
        continuous_const
    have hξ_U : ξ ∈ U_j := by
      refine Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun k _ => ?_
      change |(ξ k : ℝ) - (ξ k : ℝ)| < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
      positivity
    have hξ_cl : ξ ∈ closure (A M_j) := Set.mem_iInter.mp hξ M_j
    obtain ⟨_, hη_U, n_j, hn_j, rfl⟩ := (mem_closure_iff.mp hξ_cl) U_j hU_open hξ_U
    refine ⟨n_j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_ceil : x₀ ≤ (Nat.ceil x₀ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil x₀
      have hn_j_cast : ((Nat.ceil x₀ + j : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n_j : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (hn_j : M_j ≤ n_j)
      push_cast at hn_j_cast
      linarith
    · intro k hk
      have hk_mem : k ∈ J_j := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp hk)
      exact Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hη_U k hk_mem
  let S : ℕ → X → ℝ := fun N ξ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)
  let M_sup : ℕ → ℝ := fun N => sSup (S N '' Ω_set)
  have hS_cont : ∀ N : ℕ, Continuous (S N) := fun N =>
    continuous_finsetSum (Finset.range N) fun k _ =>
      continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply (k : ℤ))
  have hM_max : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ ξ ∈ Ω_set, M_sup N = S N ξ ∧ ∀ η ∈ Ω_set, S N η ≤ S N ξ := fun N =>
    hΩ_comp.exists_sSup_image_eq_and_ge hΩ_ne (hS_cont N).continuousOn
  have hM_att_all : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ ξ ∈ Ω_set, S N ξ = M_sup N := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_eq, _⟩ := hM_max N
    exact ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_eq.symm⟩
  have hM_le_all : ∀ ξ ∈ Ω_set, ∀ N : ℕ, S N ξ ≤ M_sup N := by
    intro ξ hξ N
    obtain ⟨η, _, hη_eq, hη_ge⟩ := hM_max N
    rw [hη_eq]
    exact hη_ge ξ hξ
  have hM_le : ∀ ξ ∈ Ω_set, ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) ≤ M_sup (n + 1) :=
    fun ξ hξ n => hM_le_all ξ hξ (n + 1)
  have hM_att : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ξ ∈ Ω_set,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) = M_sup (n + 1) :=
    fun n => hM_att_all (n + 1)
  have hSub : Subadditive M_sup := by
    intro m n
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ_mem, hξ_eq⟩ := hM_att_all (m + n)
    rw [← hξ_eq]
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_add (fun k : ℕ => (ξ (k : ℤ) : ℝ)) m n]
    let η : X := fun z => ξ (z + (m : ℤ))
    have hη_mem : η ∈ Ω_set := hτ_iter m ξ hξ_mem
    have h_shift_sum : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (ξ (((m + k : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ℝ)) = S n η := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      dsimp [η]
      exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (ξ z : ℝ)) (by omega)
    rw [h_shift_sum]
    exact add_le_add (hM_le_all ξ hξ_mem m) (hM_le_all η hη_mem n)
  have hBdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun n : ℕ => M_sup n / (n : ℝ)) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ξ₀, hξ₀_mem⟩ := hΩ_ne
    have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ S n ξ₀ := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => ?_
      linarith [(ξ₀ (k : ℤ)).2.1]
    have hM_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_sup n := le_trans h_sum_nonneg (hM_le_all ξ₀ hξ₀_mem n)
    exact div_nonneg hM_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  let lam : ℝ := hSub.lim
  have hM_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    have h_raw := (hSub.tendsto_lim hBdd).comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    refine h_raw.congr fun n => ?_
    dsimp [Function.comp]
    rw [Nat.cast_add_one]
  have hlam_hi : lam ≤ K₁ := by
    have h1 : lam ≤ M_sup 1 / ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hSub.lim_le_div hBdd one_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨ξ₁, _, hξ₁_eq⟩ := hM_att_all 1
    have h2 : M_sup 1 ≤ K₁ := by
      rw [← hξ₁_eq]
      simp only [S, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.cast_zero]
      exact (ξ₁ 0).2.2
    norm_num at h1
    linarith
  have h_orb_tel : ∀ (m N : ℕ), S N (ξ_orb m) = r ((m : ℝ) + (N : ℝ)) - r (m : ℝ) := by
    intro m N
    let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => r ((m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ))
    have h_congr : S N (ξ_orb m) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (g (k + 1) - g k) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      dsimp [ξ_orb, g]
      have h_arg1 : (m : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 = (m : ℝ) + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      have h_arg2 : (m : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg1, h_arg2]
    rw [h_congr, Finset.sum_range_sub g N]
    dsimp [g]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  have hM_ratio_ge_one : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro n
    let N : ℕ := n + 1
    have h_tail_block : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ,
        ℓ ≤ m ∧ (N : ℝ) - 1 / ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1) ≤ S N (ξ_orb m) := by
      intro ℓ
      by_contra! h_lt
      let m₁ : ℕ := max ℓ (Nat.ceil x₀)
      have hm₁_ℓ : ℓ ≤ m₁ := le_max_left _ _
      have hm₁_x₀ : x₀ ≤ (m₁ : ℝ) :=
        le_trans (Nat.le_ceil x₀) (Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_max_right _ _))
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((r (m₁ : ℝ) - (m₁ : ℝ)) * ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1))
      let H : ℕ → ℝ := fun q => r ((m₁ : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ))
      have h_step_le : ∀ q ∈ Finset.range L,
          H (q + 1) - H q ≤ (N : ℝ) - 1 / ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1) := by
        intro q _
        have h_le_m : ℓ ≤ m₁ + q * N := le_trans hm₁_ℓ (Nat.le_add_right m₁ (q * N))
        have h_lt_q := le_of_lt (h_lt (m₁ + q * N) h_le_m)
        rw [h_orb_tel (m₁ + q * N) N] at h_lt_q
        have h_arg1 : ((m₁ + q * N : ℕ) : ℝ) + (N : ℝ) =
            (m₁ : ℝ) + ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        have h_arg2 : ((m₁ + q * N : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m₁ : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        dsimp [H]
        rwa [← h_arg1, ← h_arg2]
      have h_sum_le := Finset.sum_le_sum h_step_le
      rw [Finset.sum_range_sub H L, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at h_sum_le
      have hH0 : H 0 = r (m₁ : ℝ) := by dsimp [H]; simp
      have hHL : H L = r ((m₁ : ℝ) + (L : ℝ) * (N : ℝ)) := rfl
      rw [hH0, hHL] at h_sum_le
      have h_ge_end : (m₁ : ℝ) + (L : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤ r ((m₁ : ℝ) + (L : ℝ) * (N : ℝ)) := by
        refine hr_ge _ ?_
        have hLN : 0 ≤ (L : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) := by positivity
        linarith
      have h_div_le : (L : ℝ) * (1 / ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ r (m₁ : ℝ) - (m₁ : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hℓ_pos : 0 < (ℓ : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (le_of_lt hℓ_pos)
      have h_lhs : (L : ℝ) * (1 / ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1)) * ((ℓ : ℝ) + 1) = (L : ℝ) := by
        field_simp
      linarith
    choose m_seq hm_ge hm_sum using h_tail_block
    obtain ⟨ξ_star, φ, hφ_mono, hφ_lim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq (fun ℓ => ξ_orb (m_seq ℓ))
    have hξ_star_mem : ξ_star ∈ Ω_set := by
      refine Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun M => ?_
      refine mem_closure_of_tendsto hφ_lim ?_
      exact Filter.eventually_atTop.mpr ⟨M, fun k hk =>
        ⟨m_seq (φ k), le_trans hk (le_trans (hφ_mono.id_le k) (hm_ge (φ k))), rfl⟩⟩
    have h_tendsto_S : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => S N (ξ_orb (m_seq (φ k))))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (S N ξ_star)) :=
      ((hS_cont N).tendsto ξ_star).comp hφ_lim
    have h_tendsto_lb : Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (N : ℝ) - 1 / ((φ k : ℝ) + 1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (N : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [sub_zero, Function.comp_def] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (N : ℝ))).sub
          (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.comp hφ_mono.tendsto_atTop)
    have hN_le_S : (N : ℝ) ≤ S N ξ_star :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' h_tendsto_lb h_tendsto_S fun k => hm_sum (φ k)
    have hN_le_M : (N : ℝ) ≤ M_sup N := le_trans hN_le_S (hM_le_all ξ_star hξ_star_mem N)
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by dsimp [N]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hN_cast] at hN_le_M
    exact (one_le_div₀ (by positivity : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1)).mpr hN_le_M
  have hlam_lo : 1 ≤ lam := ge_of_tendsto' hM_lim hM_ratio_ge_one
  exact ⟨Ω_set, M_sup, lam, hΩ_closed, hΩ_ne, hlam_lo, hlam_hi,
    hΩ_shift, hΩ_approx, hM_lim, hM_le, hM_att⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  let σ_seq : ℕ → MeasureTheory.Measure α := fun n =>
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac ((T^[k]) (x_seq n))
  let ν_seq : ℕ → MeasureTheory.Measure α := fun n =>
    (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹) • σ_seq n
  have hν_univ : ∀ n : ℕ, ν_seq n Set.univ = 1 := by
    intro n
    dsimp only [ν_seq, σ_seq]
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply, MeasureTheory.Measure.finsetSum_apply]
    simp only [MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem (Set.mem_univ _), Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_range, nsmul_one, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))
      (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top (n + 1))
  let μ_seq : ℕ → MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure α := fun n =>
    ⟨ν_seq n, ⟨hν_univ n⟩⟩
  have h_emp_int : ∀ (g : α → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
      (∫ x, g x ∂(μ_seq n : MeasureTheory.Measure α)) =
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), g ((T^[k]) (x_seq n))) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro g n
    change (∫ x, g x ∂(ν_seq n)) = _
    dsimp only [ν_seq, σ_seq]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
      MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum_measure
        (fun k _ => MeasureTheory.integrable_dirac enorm_lt_top),
      ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    simp only [MeasureTheory.integral_dirac, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_eq_div]
  obtain ⟨μ_P, h_cl⟩ := exists_clusterPt_of_compactSpace (Filter.map μ_seq Filter.atTop)
  let μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α := (μ_P : MeasureTheory.Measure α)
  have hμ_prob : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ := μ_P.prop
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hμ_prob
  have h_eval : ∀ (F : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure α → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      Continuous F →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F (μ_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds c) →
      F μ_P = c := by
    intro F c hF ht
    exact eq_of_nhds_neBot (h_cl.map hF.continuousAt (Filter.tendsto_map'_iff.mpr ht))
  have h_inv_int : ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction α ℝ,
      (∫ x, g (T x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, g x ∂μ := by
    intro g
    let g_T : BoundedContinuousFunction α ℝ := g.compContinuous ⟨T, T.continuous⟩
    let F_g : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure α → ℝ := fun π =>
      (∫ x, g_T x ∂(π : MeasureTheory.Measure α)) -
        (∫ x, g x ∂(π : MeasureTheory.Measure α))
    have hF_g_cont : Continuous F_g :=
      (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_integral_boundedContinuousFunction g_T).sub
        (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_integral_boundedContinuousFunction g)
    have hF_g_tele : ∀ n : ℕ,
        F_g (μ_seq n) =
          (g ((T^[n + 1]) (x_seq n)) - g (x_seq n)) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro n
      dsimp only [F_g]
      rw [h_emp_int g_T n, h_emp_int g n, ← sub_div, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      congr 1
      have h_step : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (g_T ((T^[k]) (x_seq n)) - g ((T^[k]) (x_seq n))) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (g ((T^[k + 1]) (x_seq n)) - g ((T^[k]) (x_seq n))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        simp only [g_T, BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_compContinuous, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
          Function.comp_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      rw [h_step, Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k : ℕ => g ((T^[k]) (x_seq n))) (n + 1)]
      simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply]
    have h_bound_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => (2 * ‖g‖) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h0 := (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr
        (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (2 * ‖g‖))
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h0
    have hF_g_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F_g (μ_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun n => ?_) h_bound_tendsto
      rw [hF_g_tele n, norm_div, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1)]
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1)
      calc
        ‖g ((T^[n + 1]) (x_seq n)) - g (x_seq n)‖
            ≤ ‖g ((T^[n + 1]) (x_seq n))‖ + ‖g (x_seq n)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖g‖ + ‖g‖ := add_le_add (g.norm_coe_le_norm _) (g.norm_coe_le_norm _)
        _ = 2 * ‖g‖ := (two_mul ‖g‖).symm
    have hF_g_zero : F_g μ_P = 0 := h_eval F_g 0 hF_g_cont hF_g_tendsto
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hF_g_zero
  have h_map_eq : MeasureTheory.Measure.map T μ = μ := by
    refine MeasureTheory.ext_of_forall_integral_eq_of_IsFiniteMeasure fun g => ?_
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_map T.continuous.aemeasurable g.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact h_inv_int g
  have hT_pres : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T μ μ :=
    ⟨T.continuous.measurable, h_map_eq⟩
  have hT_symm_pres : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T.symm μ μ :=
    hT_pres.symm T.toMeasurableEquiv
  let φ_C : C(α, ℝ) := ⟨φ, hφ_cont⟩
  let F_φ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure α → ℝ := fun π =>
    ∫ x, φ_C x ∂(π : MeasureTheory.Measure α)
  have hF_φ_cont : Continuous F_φ :=
    MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_integral_continuousMap φ_C
  have hF_φ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F_φ (μ_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    refine h_emp.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
    exact (h_emp_int φ n).symm
  have h_mean : (∫ x, φ x ∂μ) = lam :=
    h_eval F_φ lam hF_φ_cont hF_φ_tendsto
  exact ⟨μ, hμ_prob, hT_pres, hT_symm_pres, h_mean⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let S : ℕ → α → ℝ := fun n x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, φ ((T^[k]) x)
  have hφ_iter_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : α => φ ((T^[k]) x)) :=
    fun k => hφ_cont.comp (T.continuous.iterate k)
  have hS_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (S n) :=
    fun n => continuous_finsetSum (Finset.range n) (fun k _ => hφ_iter_cont k)
  have hφ_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable φ μ :=
    MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hφ_cont.aestronglyMeasurable K₁
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hφ_bdd x)
  have hS_zero : ∀ x : α, S 0 x = 0 := fun x => by simp [S]
  have hS_succ_left : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), S (n + 1) x = φ x + S n (T x) := by
    intro n x
    dsimp [S]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    ring
  have hS_succ_right : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), S (n + 1) x = S n x + φ ((T^[n]) x) :=
    fun n x => Finset.sum_range_succ (fun k => φ ((T^[k]) x)) n
  have hS_bdd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), |S n x| ≤ (n : ℝ) * K₁ := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x
      simp [hS_zero]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      rw [hS_succ_right]
      calc
        |S n x + φ ((T^[n]) x)| ≤ |S n x| + |φ ((T^[n]) x)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (n : ℝ) * K₁ + K₁ := add_le_add (ih x) (hφ_bdd ((T^[n]) x))
        _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * K₁ := by push_cast; ring
  have hS_int : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (S n) μ :=
    fun n => MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound (hS_cont n).aestronglyMeasurable ((n : ℝ) * K₁)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hS_bdd n x)
  have hS_shift_abs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), |S n (T x) - S n x| ≤ 2 * K₁ := by
    intro n x
    have h_diff : S n (T x) - S n x = φ ((T^[n]) x) - φ x := by
      have h1 := hS_succ_left n x
      have h2 := hS_succ_right n x
      linarith
    rw [h_diff]
    calc
      |φ ((T^[n]) x) - φ x| ≤ |φ ((T^[n]) x)| + |φ x| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ K₁ + K₁ := add_le_add (hφ_bdd ((T^[n]) x)) (hφ_bdd x)
      _ = 2 * K₁ := by ring
  
  let e_T : α ≃ᵐ α := T.toMeasurableEquiv
  have he_T : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (⇑e_T) μ μ := by
    simpa only [e_T, Homeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv_coe] using hT
  have h_int_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (g : α → ℝ), (∫ x, g ((T^[k]) x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, g x ∂μ := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro g
      simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro g
      have h_step : (fun x : α => g ((T^[k + 1]) x)) = (fun x : α => g ((T^[k]) (e_T x))) := by
        funext x
        simp [e_T, Function.iterate_succ_apply]
      rw [h_step, he_T.integral_comp' (fun y => g ((T^[k]) y)), ih g]
  
  let B : ℝ → Set α := fun ε =>
    ⋃ m : ℕ, ⋂ N : ℕ, ⋃ n : ℕ,
      {x : α | N ≤ n} ∩ {x : α | S (n + 1) x < (lam - ε - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1)}
  have hB_meas : ∀ ε : ℝ, MeasurableSet (B ε) := by
    intro ε
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m => MeasurableSet.iInter fun N => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun n => ?_
    exact (MeasurableSet.const (N ≤ n)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (hS_cont (n + 1)) continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hB_step : ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x y : α),
      (∀ n : ℕ, S (n + 1) y ≤ S (n + 1) x + 2 * K₁) → x ∈ B ε → y ∈ B ε := by
    intro ε x y hxy hx
    simp only [B, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with ⟨m, hm⟩
    let m' : ℕ := 2 * m + 1
    refine ⟨m', fun N => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨N_sh, hN_sh⟩ := exists_nat_gt (4 * K₁ * ((m : ℝ) + 1))
    obtain ⟨n, hn_ge, hn_lt⟩ := hm (max N N_sh)
    refine ⟨n, le_trans (le_max_left N N_sh) hn_ge, ?_⟩
    have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hm'_eq : ((m' : ℝ) + 1) = 2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
      dsimp [m']
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_margin_diff : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((m' : ℝ) + 1) = 1 / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      rw [hm'_eq]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hn_sh : (N_sh : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (le_trans (le_max_right N N_sh) hn_ge)
    have h_4K : 4 * K₁ * ((m : ℝ) + 1) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h_2K : 2 * K₁ < (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((m' : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [h_margin_diff]
      have h_pos2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have h_div : 2 * K₁ < ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_pos2]
        linarith
      calc
        2 * K₁ < ((n : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := h_div
        _ = (1 / (2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1))) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
    have h_alg : (lam - ε - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) +
        (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((m' : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) =
        (lam - ε - 1 / ((m' : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
    linarith [hxy n]
  have hB_inv : ∀ (ε : ℝ) (x : α), T x ∈ B ε ↔ x ∈ B ε := by
    intro ε x
    constructor
    · refine hB_step ε (T x) x (fun n => ?_)
      have h := (abs_le.mp (hS_shift_abs (n + 1) x)).1
      linarith
    · refine hB_step ε x (T x) (fun n => ?_)
      have h := (abs_le.mp (hS_shift_abs (n + 1) x)).2
      linarith
  
  have hB_null : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (B ε) = 0 := by
    intro ε hε
    let ψ : α → ℝ := fun x => (lam - ε) - φ x
    let C_ψ : ℝ := |lam - ε| + K₁
    let P : ℕ → α → ℝ := fun n x => (lam - ε) * (n : ℝ) - S n x
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := continuous_const.sub hφ_cont
    have hCψ_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_ψ := add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hK₁
    have hψ_bdd : ∀ x : α, |ψ x| ≤ C_ψ := by
      intro x
      calc
        |ψ x| = |(lam - ε) - φ x| := rfl
        _ ≤ |lam - ε| + |φ x| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ |lam - ε| + K₁ := add_le_add le_rfl (hφ_bdd x)
    have hP_zero : ∀ x : α, P 0 x = 0 := fun x => by simp [P, hS_zero]
    have hP_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), P (n + 1) x = ψ x + P n (T x) := by
      intro n x
      dsimp [P, ψ]
      rw [hS_succ_left n x]
      push_cast
      ring
    let G : ℕ → α → ℝ := fun N =>
      Nat.rec (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ g x => max 0 (ψ x + g (T x))) N
    have hG_zero : ∀ x : α, G 0 x = 0 := fun _ => rfl
    have hG_succ : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), G (N + 1) x = max 0 (ψ x + G N (T x)) := fun _ _ => rfl
    have hG_nonneg : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), 0 ≤ G N x := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero => intro x; exact le_rfl
      | succ N _ => intro x; rw [hG_succ]; exact le_max_left 0 _
    have hG_cont : ∀ N : ℕ, Continuous (G N) := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero => exact continuous_const
      | succ N ih => exact continuous_const.max (hψ_cont.add (ih.comp T.continuous))
    have hG_bdd : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), |G N x| ≤ (N : ℝ) * C_ψ := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
        intro x
        simp [hG_zero]
      | succ N ih =>
        intro x
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hG_nonneg (N + 1) x), hG_succ]
        refine max_le (by positivity) ?_
        have h1 : ψ x ≤ C_ψ := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hψ_bdd x)
        have h2 : G N (T x) ≤ (N : ℝ) * C_ψ := by
          have := ih (T x)
          rwa [abs_of_nonneg (hG_nonneg N (T x))] at this
        calc
          ψ x + G N (T x) ≤ C_ψ + (N : ℝ) * C_ψ := add_le_add h1 h2
          _ = ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * C_ψ := by push_cast; ring
    have hG_mono_step : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), G N x ≤ G (N + 1) x := by
      intro N
      induction N with
      | zero =>
        intro x
        rw [hG_zero]
        exact hG_nonneg 1 x
      | succ N ih =>
        intro x
        change max 0 (ψ x + G N (T x)) ≤ max 0 (ψ x + G (N + 1) (T x))
        exact max_le_max le_rfl (add_le_add le_rfl (ih (T x)))
    have hG_mono : ∀ (x : α), Monotone (fun N : ℕ => G N x) :=
      fun x => monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fun N => hG_mono_step N x)
    have hP_le_G_diag : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : α), P n x ≤ G n x := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro x
        rw [hP_zero, hG_zero]
      | succ n ih =>
        intro x
        rw [hP_succ, hG_succ]
        exact le_trans (add_le_add le_rfl (ih (T x))) (le_max_right 0 _)
    have hP_le_G : ∀ (n N : ℕ) (x : α), n ≤ N → P n x ≤ G N x :=
      fun n N x hn => le_trans (hP_le_G_diag n x) (hG_mono x hn)
    let E_act : ℕ → Set α := fun N => {x : α | 0 < G N x}
    have hE_meas : ∀ N : ℕ, MeasurableSet (E_act N) :=
      fun N => (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hG_cont N)).measurableSet
    have h_hopf : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), G N x - G N (T x) ≤ (E_act N).indicator ψ x := by
      intro N x
      rcases lt_or_ge 0 (G N x) with hx_pos | hx_le
      · have hx_mem : x ∈ E_act N := hx_pos
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx_mem]
        have h_pos_succ : 0 < G (N + 1) x := lt_of_lt_of_le hx_pos (hG_mono_step N x)
        have h_sum_pos : 0 < ψ x + G N (T x) := by
          by_contra h_not_pos
          have h_le : ψ x + G N (T x) ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp h_not_pos
          have h_zero : G (N + 1) x = 0 := by
            rw [hG_succ]
            exact max_eq_left h_le
          linarith
        have h_eq : G (N + 1) x = ψ x + G N (T x) := by
          rw [hG_succ]
          exact max_eq_right (le_of_lt h_sum_pos)
        linarith [hG_mono_step N x]
      · have hx_nmem : x ∉ E_act N := not_lt.mpr hx_le
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_nmem]
        have hx_zero : G N x = 0 := le_antisymm hx_le (hG_nonneg N x)
        linarith [hG_nonneg N (T x)]
    let f_ind : ℕ → α → ℝ := fun N => (B ε).indicator (G N)
    let F_ind : ℕ → α → ℝ := fun N => (B ε ∩ E_act N).indicator ψ
    have hf_diff_le : ∀ (N : ℕ) (x : α), f_ind N x - f_ind N (T x) ≤ F_ind N x := by
      intro N x
      by_cases hxB : x ∈ B ε
      · have hTxB : T x ∈ B ε := (hB_inv ε x).mpr hxB
        dsimp [f_ind, F_ind]
        rw [← Set.indicator_indicator, Set.indicator_of_mem hxB,
          Set.indicator_of_mem hxB, Set.indicator_of_mem hTxB]
        exact h_hopf N x
      · have hTxB : T x ∉ B ε := fun h => hxB ((hB_inv ε x).mp h)
        have hxBE : x ∉ B ε ∩ E_act N := fun h => hxB h.1
        dsimp [f_ind, F_ind]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxB, Set.indicator_of_notMem hTxB,
          Set.indicator_of_notMem hxBE]
        linarith
    have hF_int_nonneg : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∫ x, F_ind N x ∂μ := by
      intro N
      have hf_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (f_ind N) μ :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
          ((hG_cont N).aestronglyMeasurable.indicator (hB_meas ε))
          ((N : ℝ) * C_ψ)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
            le_trans (norm_indicator_le_norm_self (G N) x)
              (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hG_bdd N x))
      have hfT_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f_ind N (T x)) μ :=
        hT.integrable_comp_of_integrable hf_int
      have hF_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (F_ind N) μ :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
          (hψ_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.indicator ((hB_meas ε).inter (hE_meas N)))
          C_ψ
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
            le_trans (norm_indicator_le_norm_self ψ x)
              (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hψ_bdd x))
      have h_mono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono (hf_int.sub hfT_int) hF_int (hf_diff_le N)
      have h_sub : (∫ x, (f_ind N x - f_ind N (T x)) ∂μ) =
          (∫ x, f_ind N x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f_ind N (T x) ∂μ) :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub hf_int hfT_int
      have h_shift : (∫ x, f_ind N (T x) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f_ind N x ∂μ := by
        simpa using h_int_iter 1 (f_ind N)
      change (∫ x, (f_ind N x - f_ind N (T x)) ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x, F_ind N x ∂μ at h_mono
      linarith
    
    let F_inf : α → ℝ := (B ε).indicator ψ
    have hF_tendsto : ∀ x : α, Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => F_ind N x) Filter.atTop (nhds (F_inf x)) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hxB : x ∈ B ε
      · have hxB' := hxB
        simp only [B, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hxB'
        rcases hxB' with ⟨m, hm⟩
        obtain ⟨n₀, _, hn₀_lt⟩ := hm 0
        have hm_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
        have hn₀_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n₀ : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
        have h_strict : S (n₀ + 1) x < (lam - ε) * ((n₀ : ℝ) + 1) := by nlinarith
        have hP_pos : 0 < P (n₀ + 1) x := by
          dsimp [P]
          push_cast
          linarith
        have h_ev : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, F_inf x = F_ind N x := by
          rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
          refine ⟨n₀ + 1, fun N hN => ?_⟩
          have hxE : x ∈ E_act N := lt_of_lt_of_le hP_pos (hP_le_G (n₀ + 1) N x hN)
          have hxBE : x ∈ B ε ∩ E_act N := ⟨hxB, hxE⟩
          dsimp [F_inf, F_ind]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxB, Set.indicator_of_mem hxBE]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h_ev
      · have h_zero : ∀ N : ℕ, F_ind N x = F_inf x := by
          intro N
          have hxBE : x ∉ B ε ∩ E_act N := fun h => hxB h.1
          dsimp [F_inf, F_ind]
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxBE, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxB]
        simp_rw [h_zero]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have h_int_tendsto :
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∫ x, F_ind N x ∂μ) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x, F_inf x ∂μ)) :=
      MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ : α => C_ψ)
        (fun N => hψ_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.indicator ((hB_meas ε).inter (hE_meas N)))
        (MeasureTheory.integrable_const C_ψ)
        (fun N => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
          le_trans (norm_indicator_le_norm_self ψ x) (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hψ_bdd x))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF_tendsto)
    have hF_inf_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x, F_inf x ∂μ := ge_of_tendsto' h_int_tendsto hF_int_nonneg
    have h_lower_B : (∫ x in B ε, φ x ∂μ) ≤ (lam - ε) * μ.real (B ε) := by
      have h_eq1 : (∫ x, F_inf x ∂μ) = ∫ x in B ε, ((lam - ε) - φ x) ∂μ :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_indicator (hB_meas ε)
      have h_eq2 : (∫ x in B ε, ((lam - ε) - φ x) ∂μ) =
          (∫ x in B ε, (lam - ε) ∂μ) - (∫ x in B ε, φ x ∂μ) :=
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (lam - ε)) hφ_int.integrableOn
      have h_eq3 : (∫ x in B ε, (lam - ε) ∂μ) = μ.real (B ε) * (lam - ε) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const]
        simp [smul_eq_mul]
      linarith
    
    let A : Set α := (B ε)ᶜ
    have hA_meas : MeasurableSet A := (hB_meas ε).compl
    have hA_inv : ∀ x : α, T x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A := fun x => not_congr (hB_inv ε x)
    have hA_iter_inv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : α), (T^[k]) x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro x; simp
      | succ k ih =>
        intro x
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', hA_inv ((T^[k]) x), ih x]
    have hA_iter_int : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∫ x, A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x ∂μ) = ∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ := by
      intro k
      have h_ind_eq : A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) =
          fun x => A.indicator φ ((T^[k]) x) := by
        funext x
        by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
        · have hTk : (T^[k]) x ∈ A := (hA_iter_inv k x).mpr hxA
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxA, Set.indicator_of_mem hTk]
        · have hTk : (T^[k]) x ∉ A := fun h => hxA ((hA_iter_inv k x).mp h)
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxA, Set.indicator_of_notMem hTk]
      rw [h_ind_eq, h_int_iter k (A.indicator φ), MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hA_meas]
    have h_upper_A_n : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) ≤ (M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * μ.real A := by
      intro n
      have h_sum_int :
          (∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x ∂μ) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∫ x, A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x ∂μ := by
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun k _ => ?_)
        exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
          ((hφ_iter_cont k).aestronglyMeasurable.indicator hA_meas) K₁
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
            le_trans (norm_indicator_le_norm_self (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x)
              (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hφ_bdd ((T^[k]) x)))
      have h_rhs :
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∫ x, A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x ∂μ) =
          ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) := by
        simp_rw [hA_iter_int]
        simp [Finset.sum_const]
      have h_lhs_fn :
          (fun x : α => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x) =
          A.indicator (S (n + 1)) := by
        funext x
        by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
        · simp [hxA, S]
        · simp [hxA]
      have h_lhs :
          (∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), A.indicator (fun z => φ ((T^[k]) z)) x ∂μ) =
          ∫ x in A, S (n + 1) x ∂μ := by
        rw [h_lhs_fn, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hA_meas]
      have h_eq_sum : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) = ∫ x in A, S (n + 1) x ∂μ := by
        linarith
      have h_le_M : (∫ x in A, S (n + 1) x ∂μ) ≤ μ.real A * M_sup (n + 1) := by
        calc
          (∫ x in A, S (n + 1) x ∂μ) ≤ ∫ x in A, M_sup (n + 1) ∂μ :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono (hS_int (n + 1)).integrableOn
              (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (M_sup (n + 1))) (fun x => h_upper x n)
          _ = μ.real A * M_sup (n + 1) := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const]
            simp [smul_eq_mul]
      have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hn_pos]
      linarith
    have h_upper_A : (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) ≤ lam * μ.real A :=
      ge_of_tendsto' (hM_lim.mul_const (μ.real A)) h_upper_A_n
    have h_split : (∫ x in B ε, φ x ∂μ) + (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) = lam := by
      dsimp [A]
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl (hB_meas ε) hφ_int, h_mean]
    have h_prob_split : μ.real (B ε) + μ.real A = 1 :=
      MeasureTheory.probReal_add_probReal_compl (hB_meas ε)
    have h_eps_le : ε * μ.real (B ε) ≤ 0 := by
      have h_sum_le : (∫ x in B ε, φ x ∂μ) + (∫ x in A, φ x ∂μ) ≤
          (lam - ε) * μ.real (B ε) + lam * μ.real A := add_le_add h_lower_B h_upper_A
      have h_alg_prob : (lam - ε) * μ.real (B ε) + lam * μ.real A =
          lam * (μ.real (B ε) + μ.real A) - ε * μ.real (B ε) := by ring
      rw [h_alg_prob, h_prob_split, mul_one] at h_sum_le
      linarith
    have h_nonneg_real : 0 ≤ μ.real (B ε) := MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg
    have h_real_zero : μ.real (B ε) = 0 := by nlinarith
    exact (MeasureTheory.measureReal_eq_zero_iff (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top μ (B ε))).mp
      h_real_zero
  
  let E_bad : Set α := ⋃ r : ℕ, B (1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1))
  have hE_bad_null : μ E_bad = 0 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null_iff]
    intro r
    exact hB_null (1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity)
  have h_ae : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∉ E_bad :=
    MeasureTheory.measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hE_bad_null
  refine h_ae.mono fun x hx => ?_
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨N_hi, hN_hi⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hM_lim) δ hδ
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 / δ)
  have hr_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (r : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have h_2r_lt : 2 / ((r : ℝ) + 1) < δ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hr_pos]
    have h1 : 2 / δ < (r : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
    have h2 : 2 < δ * ((r : ℝ) + 1) := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp h1
      linarith
    linarith
  have hx_not_Br : x ∉ B (1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1)) := fun h => hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨r, h⟩)
  simp only [B, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    not_exists, not_forall, not_and, not_lt] at hx_not_Br
  obtain ⟨N_lo, hN_lo⟩ := hx_not_Br r
  refine ⟨max N_hi N_lo, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
  have hn_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  constructor
  · have hn_lo : N_lo ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_right N_hi N_lo) hn
    have h_le_S :
        (lam - 1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ S (n + 1) x :=
      hN_lo n hn_lo
    have h_div_lo :
        lam - 2 / ((r : ℝ) + 1) ≤ S (n + 1) x / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hn_pos]
      have h_alg_r :
          (lam - 2 / ((r : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) =
          (lam - 1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1) - 1 / ((r : ℝ) + 1)) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      rw [h_alg_r]
      exact h_le_S
    dsimp [S] at h_div_lo
    linarith
  · have hn_hi : N_hi ≤ n := le_trans (le_max_left N_hi N_lo) hn
    have hM_dist : |M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - lam| < δ := by
      simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hN_hi n hn_hi
    have hM_lt : M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < lam + δ := by
      linarith [(abs_lt.mp hM_dist).2]
    have hS_le_M :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), φ ((T^[k]) x)) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤
          M_sup (n + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (h_upper x n) (le_of_lt hn_pos)
    linarith

(r : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ_star : ℤ → ℝ)
    (x₀ K₁ lam : ℝ)
    (hx₀ : 0 ≤ x₀)
    (hK₁ : 1 ≤ K₁)
    (hr_lo : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - u) ≤ r v - r u)
    (hr_hi : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → r v - r u ≤ K₁ * (v - u))
    (hξ_bdd : ∀ k : ℤ, (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ξ_star k ∧ ξ_star k ≤ K₁)
    (h_fwd : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ_star (k : ℤ)) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      Filter.atTop (nhds lam))
    (h_bwd : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ_star (-1 - (k : ℤ))) / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      Filter.atTop (nhds lam))
    (h_approx : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ n_j : ℕ,
      x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ (n_j : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ k : ℤ, |k| ≤ (j : ℤ) + 1 →
        |(r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ))) - ξ_star k| <
          1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) :
    ∃ (m_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (q_star : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j : ℕ, x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ m_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Continuous q_star ∧
      q_star 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → q_star v - q_star u ≤ K₁ * (v - u)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly (fun j u => r (m_seq j + u) - r (m_seq j)) q_star Filter.atTop

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hx₀
  have _ := hξ_bdd
  choose n_seq hn_ge hn_approx using h_approx
  have hK₁_pos : 0 < K₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hK₁
  have hK₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ K₁ := le_of_lt hK₁_pos
  let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j u => r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + u) - r (n_seq j : ℝ)
  have hf_zero : ∀ j : ℕ, f j 0 = 0 := by
    intro j
    simp [f]
  have hf_ord : ∀ (j : ℕ) {u v : ℝ}, u ≤ v →
      0 ≤ f j v - f j u ∧ f j v - f j u ≤ K₁ * (v - u) := by
    intro j u v huv
    have h_diff : f j v - f j u = r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + v) - r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + u) := by
      dsimp [f]; ring
    have h_le : (n_seq j : ℝ) + u ≤ (n_seq j : ℝ) + v := by linarith
    have h_sub : ((n_seq j : ℝ) + v) - ((n_seq j : ℝ) + u) = v - u := by ring
    have hlo := hr_lo ((n_seq j : ℝ) + u) ((n_seq j : ℝ) + v) h_le
    have hhi := hr_hi ((n_seq j : ℝ) + u) ((n_seq j : ℝ) + v) h_le
    rw [h_sub] at hlo hhi
    rw [h_diff]
    exact ⟨by linarith, hhi⟩
  have hf_lip : ∀ (j : ℕ) (u v : ℝ), |f j v - f j u| ≤ K₁ * |v - u| := by
    intro j u v
    rcases le_total u v with huv | hvu
    · obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hf_ord j huv
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h0, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huv)]
      exact h1
    · obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hf_ord j hvu
      rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg h0, abs_sub_comm v u, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hvu)]
      exact h1
  have hf_bdd : ∀ (j : ℕ) (u : ℝ), f j u ∈ Set.Icc (-K₁ * |u|) (K₁ * |u|) := by
    intro j u
    have h := hf_lip j 0 u
    rw [hf_zero j, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h
    have h' := abs_le.mp h
    exact ⟨by linarith [h'.1], h'.2⟩
  let Y := ∀ q : ℚ, Set.Icc (-K₁ * |(q : ℝ)|) (K₁ * |(q : ℝ)|)
  let y_seq : ℕ → Y := fun j q => ⟨f j (q : ℝ), hf_bdd j (q : ℝ)⟩
  obtain ⟨y_star, σ, hσ, hy_lim⟩ := CompactSpace.tendsto_subseq y_seq
  have hQ_lim : ∀ q : ℚ, Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f (σ j) (q : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop (nhds (y_star q : ℝ)) := by
    intro q
    exact ((continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply q)).tendsto y_star).comp hy_lim
  have hR_conv : ∀ u : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f (σ j) u) Filter.atTop (nhds L) := by
    intro u
    refine cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mpr ?_)
    intro ε hε
    have hδ : 0 < ε / (3 * K₁) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨q, hq_lo, hq_hi⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (by linarith : u - ε / (3 * K₁) < u + ε / (3 * K₁))
    have h_uq : |u - (q : ℝ)| < ε / (3 * K₁) := abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_qu : |(q : ℝ) - u| < ε / (3 * K₁) := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact h_uq
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp (hQ_lim q).cauchySeq (ε / 3) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨N, fun i hi j hj => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have h_mid : |f (σ i) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) (q : ℝ)| < ε / 3 := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN i hi j hj
    have h_left : |f (σ i) u - f (σ i) (q : ℝ)| < ε / 3 := by
      calc |f (σ i) u - f (σ i) (q : ℝ)|
          ≤ K₁ * |u - (q : ℝ)| := hf_lip (σ i) (q : ℝ) u
        _ < K₁ * (ε / (3 * K₁)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_uq hK₁_pos
        _ = ε / 3 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hK₁_pos]
    have h_right : |f (σ j) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) u| < ε / 3 := by
      calc |f (σ j) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) u|
          ≤ K₁ * |(q : ℝ) - u| := hf_lip (σ j) u (q : ℝ)
        _ < K₁ * (ε / (3 * K₁)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_qu hK₁_pos
        _ = ε / 3 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hK₁_pos]
    calc |f (σ i) u - f (σ j) u|
        = |(f (σ i) u - f (σ i) (q : ℝ)) + (f (σ i) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) (q : ℝ)) +
            (f (σ j) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) u)| := congrArg _root_.abs (by ring)
      _ ≤ |f (σ i) u - f (σ i) (q : ℝ)| + |f (σ i) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) (q : ℝ)| +
            |f (σ j) (q : ℝ) - f (σ j) u| :=
          le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      _ < ε / 3 + ε / 3 + ε / 3 := by linarith
      _ = ε := by ring
  choose q_star hq_pt using hR_conv
  have hq_zero : q_star 0 = 0 := by
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f (σ j) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa only [hf_zero] using
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hq_pt 0) h0
  have hq_lip : ∀ u v : ℝ, |q_star v - q_star u| ≤ K₁ * |v - u| := by
    intro u v
    exact le_of_tendsto (((hq_pt v).sub (hq_pt u)).abs)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun j => hf_lip (σ j) u v)
  have hq_hi : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ v → q_star v - q_star u ≤ K₁ * (v - u) := by
    intro u v huv
    calc q_star v - q_star u
        ≤ |q_star v - q_star u| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ K₁ * |v - u| := hq_lip u v
      _ = K₁ * (v - u) := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huv)]
  have hq_cont : Continuous q_star := by
    refine Metric.continuous_iff.mpr fun b ε hε => ⟨ε / K₁, div_pos hε hK₁_pos, fun a hab => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hab ⊢
    calc |q_star a - q_star b|
        ≤ K₁ * |a - b| := hq_lip b a
      _ < K₁ * (ε / K₁) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hab hK₁_pos
      _ = ε := mul_div_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hK₁_pos)
  have hq_unif : TendstoLocallyUniformly
      (fun j u => f (σ j) u) q_star Filter.atTop := by
    refine Metric.tendstoLocallyUniformly_iff.mpr fun ε hε x => ?_
    refine ⟨Metric.ball x (ε / (3 * K₁)), Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by positivity), ?_⟩
    have h_ev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (hq_pt x)) (ε / 3) (by linarith)
    filter_upwards [h_ev] with j hj y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hj ⊢
    have h_yx : |q_star y - q_star x| < ε / 3 := by
      calc |q_star y - q_star x|
          ≤ K₁ * |y - x| := hq_lip x y
        _ < K₁ * (ε / (3 * K₁)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy hK₁_pos
        _ = ε / 3 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hK₁_pos]
    have h_xy_dist : |x - y| < ε / (3 * K₁) := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hy
    have h_fj : |f (σ j) x - f (σ j) y| < ε / 3 := by
      calc |f (σ j) x - f (σ j) y|
          ≤ K₁ * |x - y| := hf_lip (σ j) y x
        _ < K₁ * (ε / (3 * K₁)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_xy_dist hK₁_pos
        _ = ε / 3 := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hK₁_pos]
    have h_mid : |q_star x - f (σ j) x| < ε / 3 := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hj
    calc |q_star y - f (σ j) y|
        = |(q_star y - q_star x) + (q_star x - f (σ j) x) + (f (σ j) x - f (σ j) y)| :=
          congrArg _root_.abs (by ring)
      _ ≤ |q_star y - q_star x| + |q_star x - f (σ j) x| + |f (σ j) x - f (σ j) y| :=
          le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl)
      _ < ε / 3 + ε / 3 + ε / 3 := by linarith
      _ = ε := by ring
  have h_maj_zero : ∀ N : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto
      (fun j : ℕ => (N : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro N
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop (1 : ℝ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  have h_tel_fwd : ∀ N : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f j (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ξ_star (k : ℤ))) := by
    intro N
    refine tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr (squeeze_zero'
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ (h_maj_zero N))
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with j hj
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_sum : f j (N : ℝ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        (r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ))) := by
      have h1 := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k : ℕ => r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + (k : ℝ))) N
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h1
      dsimp [f]
      rw [← h1]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      push_cast
      rw [← add_assoc]
    rw [h_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
            ((r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ))) -
              ξ_star (k : ℤ))|
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
            |(r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) - r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((k : ℤ) : ℝ))) -
              ξ_star (k : ℤ)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => le_of_lt (hn_approx j (k : ℤ) ?_)
          have hk_lt : k < N := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg k)]
          omega
      _ = (N : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div]
  have h_tel_bwd : ∀ N : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f j (-(N : ℝ))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (-(∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ξ_star (-1 - (k : ℤ))))) := by
    intro N
    refine tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr (squeeze_zero'
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => norm_nonneg _) ?_ (h_maj_zero N))
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with j hj
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_sum : f j (-(N : ℝ)) = -(∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        (r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) -
          r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ)))) := by
      have h1 := Finset.sum_range_sub' (fun k : ℕ => r ((n_seq j : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))) N
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] at h1
      have h2 : f j (-(N : ℝ)) = -(r (n_seq j : ℝ) - r ((n_seq j : ℝ) - (N : ℝ))) := by
        dsimp [f]
        rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]
        ring
      rw [h2, ← h1]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      congr 1 <;> (congr 1; push_cast; ring)
    have h_abs_neg : ∀ a b : ℝ, |(-a) - (-b)| = |a - b| := fun a b => by
      rw [neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm]
    rw [h_sum, h_abs_neg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
            ((r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) -
                r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) -
              ξ_star (-1 - (k : ℤ)))|
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
            |(r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1) -
                r ((n_seq j : ℝ) + ((-1 - (k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ))) -
              ξ_star (-1 - (k : ℤ))| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => le_of_lt (hn_approx j (-1 - (k : ℤ)) ?_)
          have hk_lt : k < N := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)]
          omega
      _ = (N : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one_div]
  have h_slope_interp : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ u v : ℝ, |g v - g u| ≤ K₁ * |v - u|) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => g ((n : ℝ) + 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => g u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    intro g hg_lip hg_nat
    let m : ℝ → ℕ := fun u => ⌊u - 1⌋₊
    let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (m u : ℝ) + 1
    have hm_top : Filter.Tendsto m Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      refine tendsto_nat_floor_atTop.comp ?_
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, id_eq] using
        Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop (-1 : ℝ) Filter.tendsto_id
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => g (w u) / w u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) :=
      hg_nat.comp hm_top
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => w u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
      have h_lo_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => 1 - (1 : ℝ) / u) Filter.atTop (nhds 1) := by
        simpa only [sub_zero, id_eq] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub
          ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).div_atTop Filter.tendsto_id)
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' h_lo_lim tendsto_const_nhds ?_ ?_
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
        have hu_pos : 0 < u := by linarith
        have hw_gt : u - 1 ≤ w u := le_of_lt (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (u - 1))
        calc 1 - (1 : ℝ) / u = (u - 1) / u := by rw [sub_div, div_self (ne_of_gt hu_pos)]
          _ ≤ w u / u := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw_gt (le_of_lt hu_pos)
      · filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
        have hu_pos : 0 < u := by linarith
        have hw_le : w u ≤ u := by
          have := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ u - 1)
          dsimp [w, m]
          linarith
        calc w u / u ≤ u / u := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hw_le (le_of_lt hu_pos)
          _ = 1 := div_self (ne_of_gt hu_pos)
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (g u - g (w u)) / u) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_
        ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := K₁)).div_atTop Filter.tendsto_id)
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
      dsimp only [id_eq]
      have hu_pos : 0 < u := by linarith
      have hw_le : w u ≤ u := by
        have := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ u - 1)
        dsimp [w, m]; linarith
      have hw_gt : u - 1 < w u := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (u - 1)
      have h_abs_uw : |u - w u| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        linarith
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos hu_pos]
      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (le_of_lt hu_pos)
      calc |g u - g (w u)| ≤ K₁ * |u - w u| := hg_lip (w u) u
        _ ≤ K₁ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_abs_uw hK₁_nonneg
        _ = K₁ := mul_one K₁
    have h_comb : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun u : ℝ => (g (w u) / w u) * (w u / u) + (g u - g (w u)) / u)
        Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
      simpa using (h1.mul h2).add h3
    refine h_comb.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with u hu
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hw_ne : w u ≠ 0 := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m u : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      dsimp [w]; linarith
    field_simp [hu_ne, hw_ne]
    ring
  let m_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (n_seq (σ j) : ℝ)
  have hm_ge : ∀ j : ℕ, x₀ + (j : ℝ) ≤ m_seq j := by
    intro j
    have hj_le : (j : ℝ) ≤ (σ j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_le.mpr (hσ.id_le j)
    exact le_trans (by linarith) (hn_ge (σ j))
  have hm_top : Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono hm_ge
      (Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left Filter.atTop x₀ tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  have hq_pos_int : ∀ n : ℕ,
      q_star ((n : ℝ) + 1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ_star (k : ℤ) := by
    intro n
    have h_sub := (h_tel_fwd (n + 1)).comp hσ.tendsto_atTop
    have h_pt : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f (σ j) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (q_star ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_succ] using hq_pt ((n : ℝ) + 1)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_pt h_sub
  have hq_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    refine h_slope_interp q_star hq_lip ?_
    simpa only [hq_pos_int] using h_fwd
  let q_rev : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => -q_star (-v)
  have hq_rev_lip : ∀ u v : ℝ, |q_rev v - q_rev u| ≤ K₁ * |v - u| := by
    intro u v
    have h_eq1 : |q_rev v - q_rev u| = |q_star (-u) - q_star (-v)| :=
      congrArg _root_.abs (by dsimp [q_rev]; ring)
    have h_eq2 : |(-u) - (-v)| = |v - u| := congrArg _root_.abs (by ring)
    rw [h_eq1]
    calc |q_star (-u) - q_star (-v)|
        ≤ K₁ * |(-u) - (-v)| := hq_lip (-v) (-u)
      _ = K₁ * |v - u| := by rw [h_eq2]
  have hq_neg_int : ∀ n : ℕ,
      q_rev ((n : ℝ) + 1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ξ_star (-1 - (k : ℤ)) := by
    intro n
    have h_sub := (h_tel_bwd (n + 1)).comp hσ.tendsto_atTop
    have h_pt : Filter.Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => f (σ j) (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (q_star (-((n : ℝ) + 1)))) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_succ] using hq_pt (-((n : ℝ) + 1))
    have h_eq := tendsto_nhds_unique h_pt h_sub
    dsimp [q_rev]
    rw [h_eq, neg_neg]
  have hq_rev_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => q_rev v / v) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) := by
    refine h_slope_interp q_rev hq_rev_lip ?_
    simpa only [hq_neg_int] using h_bwd
  have hq_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun u => q_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) := by
    have h_comp := hq_rev_top.comp Filter.tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop
    refine h_comp.congr fun u => ?_
    dsimp [Function.comp, q_rev]
    rw [neg_neg, neg_div_neg_eq]
  exact ⟨m_seq, q_star, hm_ge, hm_top, hq_cont, hq_zero, hq_hi, hq_top, hq_bot, hq_unif⟩

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    (∀ L : ℝ, Measurable (adaptiveStepRadius S P L)) ∧
    (∀ L : ℝ, 2 ≤ L → IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P (L ^ 2) (adaptiveStepRadius S P L)) ∧
    ∃ C_clk : ℝ, WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk

proof.tactics:
by
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N :=
    div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_mem : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh : 0 < sliceHeight S P.N :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_mem).1
  have hTop : AdaptiveStepTopPackage S P :=
    adaptive_step_topological_admissibility S P
  have hPoisson : StripPoissonToolkitProp (sliceHeight S P.N) :=
    strip_poisson_harmonic_toolkit (sliceHeight S P.N) hh
  refine ⟨fun L => (hTop.cont L).measurable, adaptive_step_analytic_bounds S P hTop, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨2 * (sliceHeight S P.N) ^ 2, ?_⟩
  refine
    { C_clk_pos := by positivity
      walk_in_reg := fun M ρ hAdm =>
        (admissible_walk_martingale_and_wall_exit S P M ρ hAdm).walk_in_reg
      walk_stops := fun M ρ hAdm =>
        tangential_safe_boundary_stopping S P M ρ hAdm hPoisson
          (admissible_walk_martingale_and_wall_exit S P M ρ hAdm)
      walk_clock := fun M ρ hAdm =>
        (admissible_walk_martingale_and_wall_exit S P M ρ hAdm).walk_clock
      impact_sq_sum := fun M ρ hAdm =>
        (admissible_walk_martingale_and_wall_exit S P M ρ hAdm).impact_sq_sum }

adaptive_walk_step_and_stopping.definitions:
structure AdaptiveStepTopPackage (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  cont : ∀ L : ℝ, Continuous (adaptiveStepRadius S P L)
  periodic : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    adaptiveStepRadius S P L (y + 2 * Real.pi) = adaptiveStepRadius S P L y
  nonneg : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ adaptiveStepRadius S P L y
  pos_iff : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    0 < adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ↔ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  le_sing_dist : ∀ L : ℝ, ∀ y : ℂ,
    adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)
  denom_ge_one : ∀ y : ℂ, 1 ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y
  safe_ball_sub_and_le : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    ∀ k : Fin P.N, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y),
      ζ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y

          Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ⊆
            horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all := by
      intro M ρ hAdm om m
      have hmem : walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all := by
        induction m with
        | zero =>
            refine ⟨?_, P.real_not_mem_Z_all (om 0)⟩
            simp [walkPos, horizStrip, hh_pos]
        | succ k ih =>
            rcases hBallSub hAdm ih with ⟨hρ_pos, hsub⟩
            apply hsub
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, walkPos, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left,
              norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ_pos,
              Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
      rcases hBallSub hAdm hmem with ⟨hpos, hsub⟩
      exact ⟨hmem, hpos, hsub⟩
    have hWalkMeas : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
        ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) := by
      intro M ρ hAdm m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
          exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)
      | succ k ih =>
          have h1 : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om k) : ℂ)) :=
            Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp ih)
          have h2 : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => Complex.exp ((om (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
            Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
              ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply (k + 1))).mul
                measurable_const)
          exact ih.add (h1.mul h2)
    have hPrefixReg : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
        ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {f : ℂ → α},
          Measurable (Set.domRestrict (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) f) →
          ∀ m : ℕ, shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix m (fun om => f (walkPos ρ om m)) := by
      intro M ρ hAdm α _ f hf m
      let omExt : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → WalkSpace :=
        fun p k => if hk : k < m + 1 then p ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hk⟩ else 0
      have hOmExtMeas : Measurable omExt := by
        refine Measurable.of_eval fun k => ?_
        by_cases hk : k < m + 1
        · have hEq : (fun p : Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ => omExt p k) =
              fun p => p ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hk⟩ := by
            ext p; dsimp only [omExt]; rw [dif_pos hk]
          rw [hEq]; exact measurable_pi_apply _
        · have hEq : (fun p : Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ => omExt p k) = fun _ => 0 := by
            ext p; dsimp only [omExt]; rw [dif_neg hk]
          rw [hEq]; exact measurable_const
      have hWalkEq : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ k ≤ m,
          walkPos ρ (omExt (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (m + 1)) om)) k = walkPos ρ om k := by
        intro om k hk
        induction k with
        | zero =>
            have h0 : 0 < m + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ m
            change (if hk0 : 0 < m + 1 then om 0 else 0 : ℝ) = (om 0 : ℂ)
            rw [dif_pos h0]
        | succ l ihl =>
            have hl : l ≤ m := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
            have hl1 : l + 1 < m + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ hk
            have hstep : omExt (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (m + 1)) om) (l + 1) = om (l + 1) := by
              change (if h : l + 1 < m + 1 then om (l + 1) else 0) = om (l + 1)
              rw [dif_pos hl1]
            rw [walkPos, walkPos, ihl hl, hstep]
      let gSub : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ↥(horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) :=
        fun p => ⟨walkPos ρ (omExt p) m, (hClosedBallWalk hAdm (omExt p) m).1⟩
      have hgSubMeas : Measurable gSub :=
        ((hWalkMeas hAdm m).comp hOmExtMeas).subtype_mk
      refine ⟨fun p => Set.domRestrict (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) f (gSub p),
        hf.comp hgSubMeas, ?_⟩
      intro om
      dsimp only [gSub, Set.domRestrict_apply]
      rw [hWalkEq om m le_rfl]
    have hUnifIntegral : ∀ G : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable G → (∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |G x| ≤ B) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable G unifTwoPiMeasure ∧
        (∫ x, G x ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) =
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G x := by
      intro G hG ⟨B, hB⟩
      have hInt : MeasureTheory.Integrable G unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hG.aestronglyMeasurable B
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hB)
      refine ⟨hInt, ?_⟩
      rw [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul,
        ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le,
        MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
    have hEvalZero : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable F → (∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |F x| ≤ B) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => F (om 0)) walkMeasure ∧
        (∫ om, F (om 0) ∂walkMeasure) =
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x := by
      intro F hF ⟨B, hB⟩
      have hIntWalk : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => F (om 0)) walkMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
          (hF.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).aestronglyMeasurable B
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => hB (om 0))
      have hMap0 : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) walkMeasure =
          unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
      refine ⟨hIntWalk, ?_⟩
      have h1 := (hUnifIntegral F hF ⟨B, hB⟩).2
      rw [← h1, ← hMap0,
        MeasureTheory.integral_map (measurable_pi_apply 0).aemeasurable]
      rw [hMap0]
      exact hF.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hStepPair : ∀ {𝕜 : Type} [RCLike 𝕜] {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ},
        IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → 𝕜) (K : ℂ → ℂ → 𝕜),
          shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix n H →
          (∃ B_H : ℝ, ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖H om‖ ≤ B_H) →
          Measurable (Set.indicator
            ((horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ×ˢ
              (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all))
            (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => K p.1 p.2)) →
          (∃ B_K : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
            ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y), ‖K y z‖ ≤ B_K) →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))) walkMeasure ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
              (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n))) walkMeasure ∧
          (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure) =
            ∫ om, H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
              (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure := by
      intro 𝕜 _ M ρ hAdm n H K ⟨h₀, hh₀_meas, hh₀_eq⟩ ⟨B_H, hBH⟩ hK_meas ⟨B_K, hBK⟩
      let Ω_reg := horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
      have hΩ_meas : MeasurableSet Ω_reg := P.reg_open.measurableSet
      let S_ball : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := {p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ Ω_reg ∧ p.2 ∈ Ω_reg ∧ dist p.2 p.1 ≤ ρ p.1}
      have hSet_meas : MeasurableSet S_ball := by
        have h1 : MeasurableSet {p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ Ω_reg} := hΩ_meas.preimage measurable_fst
        have h2 : MeasurableSet {p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ Ω_reg} := hΩ_meas.preimage measurable_snd
        have h3 : MeasurableSet {p : ℂ × ℂ | dist p.2 p.1 ≤ ρ p.1} :=
          measurableSet_le (continuous_snd.dist continuous_fst).measurable
            (hAdm.measurable.comp measurable_fst)
        exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
      let K_ind : ℂ × ℂ → 𝕜 := Set.indicator (Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg) (fun p => K p.1 p.2)
      let K₀ : ℂ × ℂ → 𝕜 := Set.indicator S_ball K_ind
      have hK₀_meas : Measurable K₀ := hK_meas.indicator hSet_meas
      let BK' : ℝ := max B_K 0
      have hBK'_nonneg : 0 ≤ BK' := le_max_right _ _
      have hK₀_bound : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ‖K₀ p‖ ≤ BK' := by
        intro p
        by_cases hp : p ∈ S_ball
        · have hp2 : p ∈ Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg := ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1⟩
          simp only [K₀, K_ind, Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hp2]
          exact le_trans (hBK p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2.2) (le_max_left _ _)
        · simp [K₀, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, hBK'_nonneg]
      have hK₀_agree : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ θ : ℝ,
          K₀ (y, circleMap y (ρ y) θ) = K y (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) := by
        intro y hy θ
        rcases hBallSub hAdm hy with ⟨hρ_pos, hsub⟩
        have hdist : dist (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) y ≤ ρ y := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm, circleMap_sub_center, norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hρ_pos]
        have hz_reg : circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Ω_reg := hsub hdist
        have hp1 : (y, circleMap y (ρ y) θ) ∈ S_ball := ⟨hy, hz_reg, hdist⟩
        have hp2 : (y, circleMap y (ρ y) θ) ∈ Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg := ⟨hy, hz_reg⟩
        simp [K₀, K_ind, Set.indicator_of_mem hp1, Set.indicator_of_mem hp2]
      let omExt : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → WalkSpace :=
        fun p k => if hk : k < n + 1 then p ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hk⟩ else 0
      have hOmExtMeas : Measurable omExt := by
        refine Measurable.of_eval fun k => ?_
        by_cases hk : k < n + 1
        · have hEq : (fun p : Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ => omExt p k) =
              fun p => p ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr hk⟩ := by
            ext p; dsimp only [omExt]; rw [dif_pos hk]
          rw [hEq]; exact measurable_pi_apply _
        · have hEq : (fun p : Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ => omExt p k) = fun _ => 0 := by
            ext p; dsimp only [omExt]; rw [dif_neg hk]
          rw [hEq]; exact measurable_const
      have hWalkEq : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ k ≤ n,
          walkPos ρ (omExt (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)) k = walkPos ρ om k := by
        intro om k hk
        induction k with
        | zero =>
            have h0 : 0 < n + 1 := Nat.zero_lt_succ n
            change (if hk0 : 0 < n + 1 then om 0 else 0 : ℝ) = (om 0 : ℂ)
            rw [dif_pos h0]
        | succ l ihl =>
            have hl : l ≤ n := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk
            have hl1 : l + 1 < n + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ hk
            have hstep : omExt (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om) (l + 1) = om (l + 1) := by
              change (if h : l + 1 < n + 1 then om (l + 1) else 0) = om (l + 1)
              rw [dif_pos hl1]
            rw [walkPos, walkPos, ihl hl, hstep]
      let yPref : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p => walkPos ρ (omExt p) n
      have hyPrefMeas : Measurable yPref := (hWalkMeas hAdm n).comp hOmExtMeas
      have hyPrefReg : ∀ p, yPref p ∈ Ω_reg := fun p => (hClosedBallWalk hAdm (omExt p) n).1
      let Φ : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ → 𝕜 :=
        fun q => h₀ q.1 * K₀ (yPref q.1, circleMap (yPref q.1) (ρ (yPref q.1)) q.2)
      have hCircMeas : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
          circleMap (yPref q.1) (ρ (yPref q.1)) q.2) := by
        have h1 : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => yPref q.1) :=
          hyPrefMeas.comp measurable_fst
        have h2 : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => (ρ (yPref q.1) : ℂ)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp h1)
        have h3 : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
            Complex.exp ((q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)
        dsimp only [circleMap]
        exact h1.add (h2.mul h3)
      have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ :=
        (hh₀_meas.comp measurable_fst).mul
          (hK₀_meas.comp ((hyPrefMeas.comp measurable_fst).prodMk hCircMeas))
      let BH' : ℝ := max B_H 0
      have hBH_ext : ∀ p : Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ, ‖h₀ p‖ ≤ BH' := by
        intro p
        have hres : Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) (omExt p) = p := by
          ext ⟨k, hk⟩
          have hk_lt : k < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          change (if h : k < n + 1 then p ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr h⟩ else 0) = p ⟨k, hk⟩
          rw [dif_pos hk_lt]
        have := hBH (omExt p)
        rw [hh₀_eq (omExt p), hres] at this
        exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
      have hΦ_bound : ∀ q, ‖Φ q‖ ≤ BH' * BK' := by
        intro q
        dsimp only [Φ]
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hBH_ext q.1) (hK₀_bound _) (norm_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _)
      let fPref : WalkSpace → (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) := Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1))
      let fNext : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => om (n + 1)
      have hfPrefMeas : Measurable fPref :=
        Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1
      have hfNextMeas : Measurable fNext := measurable_pi_apply (n + 1)
      have hStepId : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
          H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) = Φ (fPref om, fNext om) := by
        intro om
        have hy_eq : yPref (fPref om) = walkPos ρ om n := hWalkEq om n le_rfl
        have hy_reg : walkPos ρ om n ∈ Ω_reg := (hClosedBallWalk hAdm om n).1
        have hstep : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) = circleMap (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) (om (n + 1)) := by
          simp [walkPos, circleMap]
        dsimp only [Φ, fNext]
        rw [← hh₀_eq om, hy_eq, hK₀_agree (walkPos ρ om n) hy_reg (om (n + 1)), ← hstep]
      have hIntLHS : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))) walkMeasure := by
        have hIntΦ : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => Φ (fPref om, fNext om)) walkMeasure :=
          MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
            (hΦ_meas.comp (hfPrefMeas.prodMk hfNextMeas)).aestronglyMeasurable
            (BH' * BK') (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => hΦ_bound _)
        exact hIntΦ.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => (hStepId om).symm)
      refine ⟨hIntLHS, ?_⟩
      have hIndepAll :=
        ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_infinitePi
          (P := fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => measurable_id)
      have hDisj : Disjoint (Finset.range (n + 1)) ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_singleton_right, Finset.mem_range]
        omega
      have hIndepFin :=
        hIndepAll.indepFun_finset (Finset.range (n + 1)) {n + 1} hDisj
          (fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _)
      have hIndepPair : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun fPref fNext walkMeasure :=
        hIndepFin.comp measurable_id
          (measurable_pi_apply (⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self (n + 1)⟩ : ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ)))
      have hMapNext : MeasureTheory.Measure.map fNext walkMeasure = unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (n + 1)
      let μPref := MeasureTheory.Measure.map fPref walkMeasure
      have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μPref :=
        ⟨by rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hfPrefMeas MeasurableSet.univ,
              Set.preimage_univ, MeasureTheory.measure_univ]⟩
      have hMapProd : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun om => (fPref om, fNext om)) walkMeasure =
          μPref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure := by
        rw [← hMapNext]
        exact (ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
          hfPrefMeas.aemeasurable hfNextMeas.aemeasurable).mp hIndepPair
      have hIntProd : MeasureTheory.Integrable Φ (μPref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΦ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (BH' * BK')
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hΦ_bound)
      have hLHS_eq : (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure) =
          ∫ p, (∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) ∂μPref := by
        calc
          (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure)
            = ∫ om, Φ (fPref om, fNext om) ∂walkMeasure :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hStepId)
          _ = ∫ q, Φ q ∂MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun om => (fPref om, fNext om)) walkMeasure := by
              symm
              apply MeasureTheory.integral_map (hfPrefMeas.prodMk hfNextMeas).aemeasurable
              rw [hMapProd]
              exact hΦ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable
          _ = ∫ q, Φ q ∂(μPref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) := by rw [hMapProd]
          _ = ∫ p, (∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) ∂μPref :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_prod Φ hIntProd
      have hInnerEq : ∀ p : Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ,
          (∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) =
            h₀ p * Real.circleAverage (K (yPref p)) (yPref p) (ρ (yPref p)) := by
        intro p
        have hy_reg : yPref p ∈ Ω_reg := hyPrefReg p
        calc
          (∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure)
            = h₀ p * ∫ θ, K₀ (yPref p, circleMap (yPref p) (ρ (yPref p)) θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure := by
              dsimp only [Φ]
              exact MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul (h₀ p) _
          _ = h₀ p * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ •
                ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  K₀ (yPref p, circleMap (yPref p) (ρ (yPref p)) θ)) := by
              congr 1
              rw [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
                ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le,
                MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc,
                ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
          _ = h₀ p * Real.circleAverage (K (yPref p)) (yPref p) (ρ (yPref p)) := by
              rw [Real.circleAverage_def]
              congr 2
              apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
              intro θ _
              exact hK₀_agree (yPref p) hy_reg θ
      let Ψ : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → 𝕜 := fun p => ∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure
      have hΨ_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable Ψ μPref := hIntProd.integral_prod_left
      have hΨ_walk_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => Ψ (fPref om)) walkMeasure :=
        (MeasureTheory.integrable_map_measure hΨ_int.aestronglyMeasurable hfPrefMeas.aemeasurable).mp
          hΨ_int
      have hAvgEq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
          Ψ (fPref om) = H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
            (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
        intro om
        dsimp only [Ψ]
        rw [hInnerEq (fPref om), ← hh₀_eq om]
        dsimp only [yPref, fPref]
        rw [hWalkEq om n le_rfl]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hΨ_walk_int.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hAvgEq)
      calc
        (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure)
          = ∫ p, Ψ p ∂μPref := hLHS_eq
        _ = ∫ om, Ψ (fPref om) ∂walkMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_map hfPrefMeas.aemeasurable hΨ_int.aestronglyMeasurable
        _ = ∫ om, H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
              (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hAvgEq)
    have hHoloMeanVar : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} {r : ℝ},
        IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → 0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ U →
        Real.circleAverage f y r = f y ∧
        Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) y r = (f y).re ∧
        Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).im) y r = (f y).im ∧
        Real.circleAverage (fun z => ‖f z - f y‖ ^ 2) y r =
          2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r ∧
        r ^ 2 * ‖deriv f y‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r := by

            ((hgθ_cont.pow 2).sub (continuous_const.mul hgθ_cont)).intervalIntegrable _ _
          have hIntB : IntervalIntegrable (fun _ : ℝ => μ ^ 2)
              MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) := intervalIntegrable_const
          have h1 : (fun θ => (gθ θ - μ) ^ 2) =
              (fun θ => (gθ θ ^ 2 - 2 * μ * gθ θ) + μ ^ 2) := by ext θ; ring
          have hSubEq := intervalIntegral.integral_sub (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
            (f := fun θ => gθ θ ^ 2) (g := fun θ => 2 * μ * gθ θ)
            ((hgθ_cont.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
            ((continuous_const.mul hgθ_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))

            intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
            sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]

          dsimp only [μ, gθ]
          rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul]
          have h2pi_ne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
          field_simp
        have hInt2 : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), gθ θ ^ 2) =
            2 * Real.pi * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ‖f z - f y‖ ^ 2) y r := by
          dsimp only [gθ]
          rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul]
          have h2pi_ne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
          field_simp
        rw [hExpand, hInt1, hInt2] at hNonneg
        nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      have hDerivSq : r ^ 2 * ‖deriv f y‖ ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 2 := by
        have hprod : 0 ≤ r * ‖deriv f y‖ := mul_nonneg hr.le (norm_nonneg _)

        let M_set : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun n =>

        have hTelescopeMask : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace),

        have hExp_u_eq : (∫ om, (A_s sgn).indicator

      have hDisjA : Disjoint (A_s 1) (A_s (-1)) := by

        have hSubBoth : {om | sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om (σ_p om)) ≤ d₀ ∧

    have hRetreatProp : SliceRetreatBoundProp S P := by

      have hDepthPosLeH : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),

          linarith [abs_nonneg (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)).im]
        refine ⟨hd_pos, hd_le, ?_⟩

        linarith [Real.log_le_log hd_pos hd_le]

        have hTermBound : ∀ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)) ×ˢ I_M,

          _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)) ×ˢ I_M, (Real.exp 1 / M ^ 4) :=

          _ = (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)) ×ˢ I_M).card : ℝ) * (Real.exp 1 / M ^ 4) := by

              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCardProd (by positivity)

          _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp 1 * (P.N : ℝ) / M := by

                ((a m om) ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Δ m om * starRingEnd ℂ (Δ m om)) := by
              simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]; ring
            rw [h1, Complex.mul_conj, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,

          have hm_lt : m < N_cap := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
          have hMeasDiag : Measurable (fun om => (a m om) ^ 2 * ‖Δ m om‖ ^ 2) :=
