              ((continuous_norm.measurable.comp
                ((hPrefMeas (hImpactPref i (m + 1))).sub (hPrefMeas (hImpactPref i m)))).pow_const 2)
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hMeasDiag.aestronglyMeasurable (S.H ^ 2)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          have ha1 : (a m om) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by rw [(ha_bounds m om).2.2]; exact (ha_bounds m om).2.1
          have hΔ1 : ‖Δ m om‖ ^ 2 ≤ S.H ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hStepBounds m om).1 2

        · have hSymm : term n m = term m n := by
            ext om
            dsimp only [term]
            have hconj : starRingEnd ℂ ((a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om *
                starRingEnd ℂ ((a m om : ℂ) * Δ m om)) =
                (a m om : ℂ) * Δ m om * starRingEnd ℂ ((a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om) := by
              simp only [map_mul, RingHomCompTriple.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]

      have hZSqId : (fun om => ‖Z om‖ ^ 2) =

          rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
        rw [h1]
        dsimp only [Z, term]
        rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, Complex.re_sum]
      have hZSqInt : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖Z om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
          ((continuous_norm.measurable.comp hZ_meas).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
          (((N_cap : ℝ) * S.H) ^ 2)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hZ_bound om) 2)
      have hZSqExpLe : (∫ om, ‖Z om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤ q_K := by
        have hSumInt1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N_cap, term n m om) walkMeasure :=
          fun n hn => MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum _ (fun m hm => hTermInt n hn m hm)

            = ∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N_cap, term n m om) ∂walkMeasure := by
              rw [hZSqId]
          _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∫ om, term n m om ∂walkMeasure := by
              rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ hSumInt1]

              exact MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ (fun m hm => hTermInt n hn m hm)

              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
              rw [Finset.sum_eq_single n]
              · apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
                filter_upwards with om
                dsimp only [term]

                    ((a n om) ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Δ n om * starRingEnd ℂ (Δ n om)) := by

                rw [h1, Complex.mul_conj, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,

          _ = ∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, (a n om) ^ 2 * ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure := by
              symm
              refine MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ fun n hn => ?_
              have hDiagId : (fun om => (a n om) ^ 2 * ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2) = term n n := by
                ext om
                dsimp only [term]
                have h1 : (a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om * starRingEnd ℂ ((a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om) =
                    ((a n om) ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Δ n om * starRingEnd ℂ (Δ n om)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]; ring
                rw [h1, Complex.mul_conj, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,
                  Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
              rw [hDiagId]
              exact hTermInt n hn n hn
          _ ≤ ∫ _om : WalkSpace, q_K ∂walkMeasure := by
              refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono ?_ (MeasureTheory.integrable_const q_K) hClockCap
              refine MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum _ fun n hn => ?_
              have hDiagId : (fun om => (a n om) ^ 2 * ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2) = term n n := by
                ext om
                dsimp only [term]
                have h1 : (a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om * starRingEnd ℂ ((a n om : ℂ) * Δ n om) =
                    ((a n om) ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Δ n om * starRingEnd ℂ (Δ n om)) := by
                  simp only [map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]; ring
                rw [h1, Complex.mul_conj, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_mul,
                  Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
              rw [hDiagId]
              exact hTermInt n hn n hn
          _ = q_K := by simp
      have hSubZ : E_cap N_cap ⊆ {om : WalkSpace | r_exit ^ 2 ≤ ‖Z om‖ ^ 2} := by
        intro om ⟨_, hQ, hexit⟩
        have hZ_eq : Z om =
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (η_pure N_cap om)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure N_cap om)) := by
          have hSubRange : Finset.Ico (T_pure N_cap om) (η_pure N_cap om) ⊆ Finset.range N_cap := by
            intro n hn
            exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn).2 (hη_le om))
          have hSumIco : Z om = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (T_pure N_cap om) (η_pure N_cap om), Δ n om := by
            dsimp only [Z]
            rw [← Finset.sum_subset hSubRange]
            · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
              rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn with ⟨hn1, hn2⟩
              have hSub2 : Finset.Ico (T_pure N_cap om) (n + 1) ⊆
                  Finset.Ico (T_pure N_cap om) (η_pure N_cap om) :=
                Finset.Ico_subset_Ico_right (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn2)
              have hQn : (∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico (T_pure N_cap om) (n + 1), q_fn (walkPos ρ om l)) ≤ q_K :=
                le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hSub2 (fun l _ _ => hq_nonneg _)) hQ
              have hnA : om ∈ A_set n := ⟨hn1, hn2, hQn⟩
              simp [a, Set.indicator_of_mem hnA]
            · intro n _ hn_not
              have hn_notA : om ∉ A_set n := by
                rintro ⟨hn1, hn2, _⟩
                exact hn_not (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hn1, hn2⟩)
              simp [a, Set.indicator_of_notMem hn_notA]
          rw [hSumIco]
          exact hTelescopeIco (fun k => sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om k)) (hT_le_η om)
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hZ_eq]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hexit.le 2
      have hMarkov := MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => sq_nonneg (‖Z om‖)) hZSqInt (r_exit ^ 2)
      have hMeasLe : walkMeasure.real (E_cap N_cap) ≤ q_K / r_exit ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : walkMeasure.real (E_cap N_cap) ≤
            walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace | r_exit ^ 2 ≤ ‖Z om‖ ^ 2} :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hSubZ
        have hr2_pos : 0 < r_exit ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hr2_pos, mul_comm]
        exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hr2_pos.le) (le_trans hMarkov hZSqExpLe)
      have hq_div : q_K / r_exit ^ 2 ≤ 2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (sq_nonneg r_exit)
      exact le_trans hMeasLe hq_div
    have hMonoCap : Monotone E_cap := by
      intro N₁ N₂ hN₁₂ om ⟨hHits, hQ, hexit⟩
      have hσ_eq : ∀ j ∈ J, σ_pure N₂ j om = σ_pure N₁ j om := by
        intro j hj
        have h1 : σ_pure N₁ j om ≤ N₁ := hFindMin' _ (Or.inl le_rfl)
        have hd1 : sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om (σ_pure N₁ j om)) ≤ d := hHits j hj
        apply le_antisymm
        · exact hFindMin' _ (Or.inr hd1)
        · refine le_of_not_gt fun hlt => ?_
          have hmin := @Nat.find_min
            (fun m => N₁ ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
            (Classical.decPred _) _ (σ_pure N₂ j om) hlt
          have hspec : N₂ ≤ σ_pure N₂ j om ∨
              sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om (σ_pure N₂ j om)) ≤ d :=
            @Nat.find_spec
              (fun m => N₂ ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
              (Classical.decPred _) _
          rcases hspec with hge2 | hd2
          · omega
          · exact hmin (Or.inr hd2)
      have hT_eq : T_pure N₂ om = T_pure N₁ om :=
        Finset.sup'_congr hJ rfl (fun j hj => hσ_eq j hj)
      have hη_eq : η_pure N₂ om = η_pure N₁ om := by
        have hT_le_η1 : T_pure N₁ om ≤ η_pure N₁ om :=
          (@Nat.find_spec
            (fun m => T_pure N₁ om ≤ m ∧
              (N₁ ≤ m ∨ r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
                sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure N₁ om))‖))
            (Classical.decPred _) _).1
        have hη1_le : η_pure N₁ om ≤ N₁ :=
          hFindMin' _ ⟨Finset.sup'_le hJ _ (fun j _ => hFindMin' _ (Or.inl le_rfl)),
            Or.inl le_rfl⟩
        apply le_antisymm
        · exact hFindMin' _ ⟨by rw [hT_eq]; exact hT_le_η1, Or.inr (by rw [hT_eq]; exact hexit)⟩
        · refine le_of_not_gt fun hlt => ?_
          have hmin := @Nat.find_min (fun m => T_pure N₁ om ≤ m ∧ _)
            (Classical.decPred _) _ (η_pure N₂ om) hlt
          have hspec : T_pure N₂ om ≤ η_pure N₂ om ∧
              (N₂ ≤ η_pure N₂ om ∨
                r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (η_pure N₂ om)) -
                  sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure N₂ om))‖) :=
            @Nat.find_spec
              (fun m => T_pure N₂ om ≤ m ∧
                (N₂ ≤ m ∨ r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
                  sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure N₂ om))‖))
              (Classical.decPred _)
              ⟨N₂, Finset.sup'_le hJ _ (fun j _ => hFindMin' _ (Or.inl le_rfl)), Or.inl le_rfl⟩
          rw [hT_eq] at hspec
          rcases hspec.2 with hge2 | hex2
          · omega
          · exact hmin ⟨hspec.1, Or.inr hex2⟩
      refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hσ_eq j hj]; exact hHits j hj
      · rw [hT_eq, hη_eq]; exact hQ
      · rw [hT_eq, hη_eq]; exact hexit
    let E_target : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om),
        q_fn (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om))‖}
    have hSubUnion : E_target ⊆ ⋃ N_cap : ℕ, E_cap N_cap := by
      intro om ⟨hQ, hexit⟩
      let τ := sliceStopTau S P ρ M om
      let T_J := sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om
      let η := sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om
      have hσ_le_τ : ∀ j : Fin P.N, sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om ≤ τ :=
        fun j => hFindMin' _ (Or.inl le_rfl)
      have hTJ_le_τ : T_J ≤ τ := Finset.sup'_le hJ _ (fun j _ => hσ_le_τ j)
      have hTJ_le_η : T_J ≤ η :=
        (@Nat.find_spec
          (fun m => T_J ≤ m ∧
            (τ ≤ m ∨ r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om T_J)‖))
          (Classical.decPred _) _).1
      have hη_le_τ : η ≤ τ := hFindMin' _ ⟨hTJ_le_τ, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
      have hTJ_lt_η : T_J < η := by
        refine lt_of_le_of_ne hTJ_le_η fun hEq => ?_
        change r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om η) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om T_J)‖ at hexit
        rw [hEq, sub_self, norm_zero] at hexit
        linarith
      have hTJ_lt_τ : T_J < τ := lt_of_lt_of_le hTJ_lt_η hη_le_τ
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨τ, ?_⟩
      have hσ_eq : ∀ j ∈ J, σ_pure τ j om = sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om := by
        intro j _
        rfl
      have hHits : ∀ j ∈ J, sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om (σ_pure τ j om)) ≤ d := by
        intro j hj
        rw [hσ_eq j hj]
        have hlt : sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om < τ :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup' (fun k => sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d k om) hj) hTJ_lt_τ
        have hspec := @Nat.find_spec
          (fun m => τ ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
          (Classical.decPred _) ⟨τ, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
        exact hspec.resolve_left (not_le.mpr hlt)
      have hT_eq : T_pure τ om = T_J :=
        Finset.sup'_congr hJ rfl (fun j hj => hσ_eq j hj)
      have hη_eq : η_pure τ om = η := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · exact hFindMin' _ ⟨by rw [hT_eq]; exact hTJ_le_η, Or.inr (by rw [hT_eq]; exact hexit)⟩
        · refine le_of_not_gt fun hlt => ?_
          have hmin := @Nat.find_min (fun m => T_J ≤ m ∧ _)
            (Classical.decPred _) _ (η_pure τ om) hlt
          have hspec : T_pure τ om ≤ η_pure τ om ∧
              (τ ≤ η_pure τ om ∨
                r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (η_pure τ om)) -
                  sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure τ om))‖) :=
            @Nat.find_spec
              (fun m => T_pure τ om ≤ m ∧
                (τ ≤ m ∨ r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
                  sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (T_pure τ om))‖))
              (Classical.decPred _)
              ⟨τ, Finset.sup'_le hJ _ (fun j _ => hFindMin' _ (Or.inl le_rfl)), Or.inl le_rfl⟩
          rw [hT_eq] at hspec
          exact hmin hspec
      refine ⟨hHits, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hT_eq, hη_eq]; exact hQ
      · rw [hT_eq, hη_eq]; exact hexit
    have hUnionBound : walkMeasure.real (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, E_cap N_cap) ≤ 2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2 := by
      have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2 := by positivity
      rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hMonoCap.measure_iUnion]
      have hSupLe : (⨆ N_cap : ℕ, walkMeasure (E_cap N_cap)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2) := by
        refine iSup_le fun N_cap => ?_
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure (E_cap N_cap))]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hCapBound N_cap)
      exact le_trans (ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hSupLe)
        (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hB_nonneg).le
    exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hSubUnion) hUnionBound
  obtain ⟨C_hit, hHitPos, hFirstHit⟩ := hPart2
  obtain ⟨hRet, hRemClock⟩ := hPart3
  exact ⟨hRet, C_hit, 9, ⟨hHitPos, by norm_num, hFirstHit, hRemClock, hPart4⟩⟩

slice_hitting_and_clock_bounds.definitions:
def shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (n : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → α) : Prop :=
  ∃ h₀ : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → α,
    Measurable h₀ ∧ ∀ om : WalkSpace, H om = h₀ (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)

def shcbWalkPrefixEvent (n : ℕ) (A : Set WalkSpace) : Prop :=
  ∃ S₀ : Set (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ),
    MeasurableSet S₀ ∧ A = Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) ⁻¹' S₀

structure ShcbWalkCircleStepToolkit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  isProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure
  sliceHeight_bounds : S.s_star ≤ sliceHeight S P.N ∧ sliceHeight S P.N ≤ S.H
  impact_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N))
  impact_maps_to : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N),
    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H
  impact_real_im_zero : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ x : ℝ,
    (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)).im = 0 ∧
    sliceShapeDepth S P j (x : ℂ) = S.H
  closedBall_in_reg : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
      walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
      0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m) ∧
      Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ⊆
        horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  walkPos_measurable : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m)
  prefix_of_measurable_reg : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {f : ℂ → α},
      Measurable (Set.domRestrict (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) f) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix m (fun om => f (walkPos ρ om m))
  eval_zero_integral : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ, Measurable F → (∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, |F x| ≤ B) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => F (om 0)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, F (om 0) ∂walkMeasure) =
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F x
  step_pair_integral : ∀ {𝕜 : Type} [RCLike 𝕜] {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ},
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → 𝕜) (K : ℂ → ℂ → 𝕜),
      shcbWalkDependsOnPrefix n H →
      (∃ B_H : ℝ, ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖H om‖ ≤ B_H) →
      Measurable (Set.indicator
        ((horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ×ˢ
          (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all))
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => K p.1 p.2)) →
      (∃ B_K : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y), ‖K y z‖ ≤ B_K) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))) walkMeasure ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
          (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n))) walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, H om * K (walkPos ρ om n) (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∂walkMeasure) =
        ∫ om, H om * Real.circleAverage (K (walkPos ρ om n))
          (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure
  holo_circle_mean_and_var : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} {r : ℝ},
    IsOpen U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → 0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ U →
    Real.circleAverage f y r = f y ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).re) y r = (f y).re ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => (f z).im) y r = (f y).im ∧
    Real.circleAverage (fun z => ‖f z - f y‖ ^ 2) y r =
      2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r ∧
    r ^ 2 * ‖deriv f y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * Real.circleAverage (fun z => ((f z).im - (f y).im) ^ 2) y r

def ShcbFirstHitDomProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_hit : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d r_int : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos ρ om (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))

def ShcbRemainingClockTailProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_rem : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d B : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P ρ M d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)

def ShcbStoppedDisplacementProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop :=
  ∀ M d r_exit q_K : ℝ, ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
    i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceDiskExit S P ρ M d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ M d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    StoppedLogDeficitProp S P ∧
    ∃ C_inv : ℝ, AdmissibleModifiedInverseProp S P C_inv

by

      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, 0 < sliceSingDist S P y ∧
        ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 ∧

    have hρ_le_sing : ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y := by

    have h_sing_pos : 0 < sliceSingDist S P y := by linarith
    refine ⟨h_sing_pos, hρ_le_100, hρ_le_sing, ?_⟩
    intro ζ hζ

    by_contra h_not
    have h_mem_comp : ζ ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P := h_not
    have h_inf : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ :=

    linarith
  have h_ind_meas : ∀ {f : ℂ → ℝ}, ContinuousOn f Ω_reg →

    have h_open : IsOpen (Ω_reg ∩ f ⁻¹' U) := hf.isOpen_inter_preimage P.reg_open hU
    by_cases h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ U
    · have h_eq : Ω_reg.indicator f ⁻¹' U = (Ω_reg ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ∪ Ω_regᶜ := by
        ext z

    · have h_eq : Ω_reg.indicator f ⁻¹' U = Ω_reg ∩ f ⁻¹' U := by

  have h_core : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ),

      (∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, g y ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (C₀ M_up : ℝ), 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ M_up →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),

        ∀ (M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ), IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          ∀ (Good : ℂ → Prop),
            MeasurableSet {y ∈ Ω_reg | Good y} →

            ∀ (B₁ : ℝ), 0 < M_up + B₁ →

                (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁) := by
    intro g hg_holo hg_ne C₀ M_up hC₀ hM_up hg_real M ρ hAdm Good hGood_meas hGood_step B₁ hMB₁
    
    have h_walk_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ, walkPos ρ om m ∈ Ω_reg := by
      intro om m
      induction m with
      | zero => exact h_real_in_reg (om 0)
      | succ n ih =>
          have h_cball := (h_adm_ball_sub hAdm (walkPos ρ om n) ih).2.2.2
          apply h_cball
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := hAdm.nonneg _
          have h_diff : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) - walkPos ρ om n =
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
            simp [walkPos]
          rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    
    let subRestrict : ∀ {j m : ℕ}, j ≤ m →
        (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → (Finset.range (j + 1) → ℝ) :=
      fun hjm p i =>
        p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr
          (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2) (Nat.succ_le_succ hjm))⟩
    have h_sub_meas : ∀ {j m : ℕ} (hjm : j ≤ m), Measurable (subRestrict hjm) := by
      intro j m hjm
      exact Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply _
    let walkPrefixPos : (m : ℕ) → (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ :=
      fun m => Nat.rec
        (motive := fun n => (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ)
        (fun p => (p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : ℂ))
        (fun n prev p =>
          let y := prev (subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) p)
          y + (ρ y : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp ((p ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))⟩ : ℂ) *
              Complex.I))
        m
    have h_pref_props : ∀ m : ℕ,
        Measurable (walkPrefixPos m) ∧
        (∀ p, walkPrefixPos m p ∈ Ω_reg) ∧
        (∀ om : WalkSpace,
          walkPos ρ om m = walkPrefixPos m ((Finset.range (m + 1)).restrict om)) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
          · intro p; exact h_real_in_reg _
          · intro om; rfl
      | succ n ih =>
          rcases ih with ⟨h_meas_n, h_reg_n, h_eq_n⟩
          have h_y_meas : Measurable (fun p : Finset.range (n + 2) → ℝ =>
              walkPrefixPos n (subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) p)) :=
            h_meas_n.comp (h_sub_meas (Nat.le_succ n))
          have h_exp_meas : Measurable (fun p : Finset.range (n + 2) → ℝ =>
              Complex.exp ((p ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))⟩ : ℂ) *
                Complex.I)) :=
            Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
              ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)).mul measurable_const)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact h_y_meas.add
              ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp h_y_meas)).mul h_exp_meas)
          · intro p
            let y := walkPrefixPos n (subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) p)
            have hy : y ∈ Ω_reg := h_reg_n _
            have h_cball := (h_adm_ball_sub hAdm y hy).2.2.2
            apply h_cball
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
            have h_diff : walkPrefixPos (n + 1) p - y =
                (ρ y : ℂ) * Complex.exp
                  ((p ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))⟩ : ℂ) *
                    Complex.I) := by
              change (y + _) - y = _
              ring
            rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn,
              Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
          · intro om
            have h_sub_eq : subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) ((Finset.range (n + 2)).restrict om) =
                (Finset.range (n + 1)).restrict om := rfl
            let p_prev := subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) ((Finset.range (n + 2)).restrict om)
            show walkPos ρ om n +
                (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
              walkPrefixPos n p_prev +
                (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p_prev) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            dsimp only [p_prev]
            rw [h_sub_eq, ← h_eq_n om]
    have h_walk_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) := by
      intro m
      have h_eq : (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) =
          (walkPrefixPos m) ∘ (Finset.range (m + 1)).restrict := by
        funext om
        exact (h_pref_props m).2.2 om
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (h_pref_props m).1.comp (Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1)
    
    have h_log_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖) Ω_reg :=
      (hg_holo.continuousOn.norm).log fun y hy => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hg_ne y hy)
    let L_g : ℂ → ℝ := Ω_reg.indicator (fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖)
    have hLg_meas : Measurable L_g := h_ind_meas h_log_cont
    have hLg_eq : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, L_g y = Real.log ‖g y‖ := fun y hy => Set.indicator_of_mem hy _
    let G_set : Set ℂ := {y ∈ Ω_reg | Good y}
    let E_def : Set WalkSpace :=
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m : ℕ, (∀ l < m, Good (walkPos ρ om l)) ∧

      ext om

      refine ⟨fun ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ => ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩, fun ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩ => ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · intro l hl; exact ⟨h_walk_reg om l, hm1 l hl⟩
      · rw [hLg_eq _ (h_walk_reg om m)]; exact hm2

    have hE_def_meas : MeasurableSet E_def := by

      refine MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m => ?_

      · exact hGood_meas.preimage (h_walk_meas l)
      · exact isOpen_Iio.measurableSet.preimage (hLg_meas.comp (h_walk_meas m))

    
    let A₀ : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | om 0 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)}
    have hA₀_meas : MeasurableSet A₀ :=
      measurableSet_Ico.preimage (measurable_pi_apply 0)
    have hA₀_compl_null : walkMeasure A₀ᶜ = 0 := by
      have h_pre : A₀ᶜ = (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ := rfl
      rw [h_pre, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0)
        measurableSet_Ico.compl]
      have h_eval : walkMeasure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) = unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
      rw [h_eval]
      simp [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ico.compl]
    let K₀ : Set ℂ := Complex.ofReal '' Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
    have hK₀_cpt : IsCompact K₀ := isCompact_Icc.image Complex.continuous_ofReal
    have hK₀_ne : K₀.Nonempty := ⟨0, ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩, Complex.ofReal_zero⟩⟩
    have h_sing_cont : Continuous (sliceSingDist S P) :=
      Metric.continuous_infDist_pt (sliceRegClosedComp S P)
    obtain ⟨y_min, hy_min_mem, hy_min_le⟩ :=
      hK₀_cpt.exists_isMinOn hK₀_ne h_sing_cont.continuousOn
    let d₀ : ℝ := sliceSingDist S P y_min
    have hy_min_reg : y_min ∈ Ω_reg := by
      rcases hy_min_mem with ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
      exact h_real_in_reg x
    have hd₀_pos : 0 < d₀ := (h_adm_ball_sub hAdm y_min hy_min_reg).1
    let K_col : ℕ → Set ℂ := fun k =>
      Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * Real.pi + (k : ℝ)) ∩
        {w : ℂ | (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ k * d₀ ≤ sliceSingDist S P w}
    have hK_col_cpt_sub : ∀ k : ℕ, IsCompact (K_col k) ∧ K_col k ⊆ Ω_reg := by
      intro k
      have hcpt : IsCompact (K_col k) :=
        (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) _).inter_right
          (isClosed_le continuous_const h_sing_cont)
      refine ⟨hcpt, fun w hw => ?_⟩
      have h_pos_k : 0 < (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ k * d₀ := by positivity
      have hw_dist : (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ k * d₀ ≤ sliceSingDist S P w := hw.2
      by_contra h_not
      have h_zero : sliceSingDist S P w = 0 := Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem h_not
      linarith
    have hK_col_step : ∀ {k : ℕ} {y y' : ℂ}, y ∈ K_col k → ‖y' - y‖ ≤ ρ y →
        y' ∈ K_col (k + 1) := by
      intro k y y' hy h_step
      have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := (hK_col_cpt_sub k).2 hy
      rcases h_adm_ball_sub hAdm y hy_reg with ⟨_, hρ_100, hρ_sing, _⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        have hy_norm : ‖y‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi + (k : ℝ) := by
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy.1
        have h_tri : ‖y'‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖y' - y‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le y (y' - y)
        push_cast
        linarith
      · change (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * d₀ ≤ sliceSingDist S P y'
        have h_lip : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ sliceSingDist S P y' + dist y y' :=
          Metric.infDist_le_infDist_add_dist
        have h_dist : dist y y' ≤ ρ y := by
          rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
          exact h_step
        have hy_sing : (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ k * d₀ ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := hy.2
        have h99 : (99 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y ≤ sliceSingDist S P y' := by linarith
        calc
          (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * d₀
            = (99 / 100 : ℝ) * ((99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ k * d₀) := by ring
          _ ≤ (99 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_sing (by norm_num)
          _ ≤ sliceSingDist S P y' := h99
    have h_pref_in_col : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ),
        p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ k)⟩ ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) →
        walkPrefixPos k p ∈ K_col k := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro p hp0
          refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
            change ‖(p ⟨0, _⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ _
            rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hp0.1]
            simpa using hp0.2.le
          · change (99 / 100 : ℝ) ^ 0 * d₀ ≤ sliceSingDist S P (p ⟨0, _⟩ : ℂ)
            rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
            exact hy_min_le ⟨p ⟨0, _⟩, ⟨hp0.1, hp0.2.le⟩, rfl⟩
      | succ n ih =>
          intro p hp0
          let p_sub := subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) p
          have hp_sub0 : p_sub ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ ∈
              Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := hp0
          have hy_col : walkPrefixPos n p_sub ∈ K_col n := ih p_sub hp_sub0
          apply hK_col_step hy_col
          have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPrefixPos n p_sub) := hAdm.nonneg _
          have h_diff : walkPrefixPos (n + 1) p - walkPrefixPos n p_sub =
              (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p_sub) : ℂ) * Complex.exp
                ((p ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1))⟩ : ℂ) *
                  Complex.I) := by
            change (walkPrefixPos n p_sub + _) - walkPrefixPos n p_sub = _
            ring
          rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    have hLg_col_bound : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ w ∈ K_col k, ‖L_g w‖ ≤ B := by
      intro k
      have h_cont_col : ContinuousOn L_g (K_col k) :=
        (h_log_cont.congr fun w hw => hLg_eq w hw).mono (hK_col_cpt_sub k).2
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (hK_col_cpt_sub k).1.exists_bound_of_continuousOn h_cont_col
      exact ⟨max B 0, le_max_right _ _, fun w hw => le_trans (hB w hw) (le_max_left _ _)⟩

    
    let KeepGoing : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun k =>
      A₀ ∩ ⋂ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        {om : WalkSpace | walkPos ρ om j ∈ G_set ∧ -B₁ ≤ L_g (walkPos ρ om j)}
    let Z : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun k =>
      Nat.rec
        (A₀.indicator fun om => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om 0))
        (fun n prev om =>
          prev om + (KeepGoing n).indicator
            (fun om' => L_g (walkPos ρ om' n) - L_g (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1))) om)
        k
    
    have hZ_inv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        0 ≤ Z k om ∧
        (om ∈ A₀ →
          (∀ j < k, walkPos ρ om j ∈ G_set ∧ -B₁ ≤ L_g (walkPos ρ om j)) →
          Z k om = M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om k)) ∧
        (om ∈ A₀ →
          (∃ m ≤ k, (∀ l < m, walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_set) ∧ L_g (walkPos ρ om m) < -B₁) →
          M_up + B₁ ≤ Z k om) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro om
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
            · change 0 ≤ A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om
              rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
              have h_mem_Icc : om 0 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := ⟨hA.1, hA.2.le⟩
              have h_up := (hg_real (om 0) h_mem_Icc).2
              have h_eq0 : L_g (walkPos ρ om 0) = Real.log ‖g (om 0)‖ :=
                hLg_eq _ (h_real_in_reg (om 0))
              linarith
            · change 0 ≤ A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om
              rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hA]
          · intro hA _
            change A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om = _
            exact Set.indicator_of_mem hA _
          · intro hA ⟨m, hm_le, _, hm_low⟩
            have hm0 : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm_le
            subst hm0
            change M_up + B₁ ≤ A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
            linarith
      | succ n ih =>
          intro om
          rcases ih om with ⟨h_nn_n, h_act_n, h_dom_n⟩
          have h_step_eq : Z (n + 1) om = Z n om +
              (KeepGoing n).indicator
                (fun om' => L_g (walkPos ρ om' n) - L_g (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1))) om := rfl
          have h_when_keep : om ∈ KeepGoing n →
              Z (n + 1) om = M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ∧ 0 ≤ Z (n + 1) om := by
            intro hK
            have hA : om ∈ A₀ := hK.1
            have h_all : ∀ j ≤ n, walkPos ρ om j ∈ G_set ∧ -B₁ ≤ L_g (walkPos ρ om j) := by
              intro j hj
              have h_inter := Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hK.2 j
                (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
              exact h_inter
            have hZn : Z n om = M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om n) :=
              h_act_n hA fun j hj => h_all j (Nat.le_of_lt hj)
            have hZn1 : Z (n + 1) om = M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) := by
              rw [h_step_eq, hZn, Set.indicator_of_mem hK]
              ring
            refine ⟨hZn1, ?_⟩
            have h_good_n : Good (walkPos ρ om n) := (h_all n le_rfl).1.2
            let z_step : ℂ :=
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            have hz_norm : ‖z_step‖ ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := by
              have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := hAdm.nonneg _
              simp [z_step, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn]
            have h_up1 : Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))‖ ≤ M_up := by
              simpa [walkPos, z_step] using
                (hGood_step (walkPos ρ om n) (h_walk_reg om n) h_good_n).2 z_step hz_norm
            rw [hZn1, hLg_eq _ (h_walk_reg om (n + 1))]
            linarith
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · by_cases hK : om ∈ KeepGoing n
            · exact (h_when_keep hK).2
            · rw [h_step_eq, Set.indicator_of_notMem hK, add_zero]
              exact h_nn_n
          · intro hA h_lt
            have hK : om ∈ KeepGoing n := by
              refine ⟨hA, Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun j hj => ?_⟩
              exact h_lt j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
            exact (h_when_keep hK).1
          · intro hA ⟨m, hm_le, hm_good, hm_low⟩
            by_cases h_prev : ∃ m' ≤ n,
                (∀ l < m', walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_set) ∧ L_g (walkPos ρ om m') < -B₁
            · rcases h_prev with ⟨m', hm'_le, hm'_good, hm'_low⟩
              have h_not_keep : om ∉ KeepGoing n := by
                intro hK
                have h_m' := Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hK.2 m'
                  (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm'_le))
                linarith [h_m'.2]
              rw [h_step_eq, Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_keep, add_zero]
              exact h_dom_n hA ⟨m', hm'_le, hm'_good, hm'_low⟩
            · have hm_eq : m = n + 1 := by
                rcases Nat.of_le_succ hm_le with hm_le_n | rfl
                · exfalso
                  exact h_prev ⟨m, hm_le_n, hm_good, hm_low⟩
                · rfl
              subst hm_eq
              have hK : om ∈ KeepGoing n := by
                refine ⟨hA, Set.mem_iInter₂.mpr fun j hj => ?_⟩
                have hj_lt : j < n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
                have hj_le : j ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj_lt
                refine ⟨hm_good j hj_lt, ?_⟩
                by_contra h_neg
                exact h_prev ⟨j, hj_le, fun l hl => hm_good l (lt_trans hl hj_lt),
                  lt_of_not_ge h_neg⟩
              rw [(h_when_keep hK).1]
              linarith

    
    have hZ_int_exp : ∀ k : ℕ,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (Z k) walkMeasure ∧
        (∫ om, Z k om ∂walkMeasure) = ∫ om, Z 0 om ∂walkMeasure := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
          obtain ⟨B0, hB0_nn, hB0⟩ := hLg_col_bound 0
          have hZ0_meas : Measurable (Z 0) :=
            (measurable_const.sub (hLg_meas.comp (h_walk_meas 0))).indicator hA₀_meas
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hZ0_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (M_up + B0)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
          · change ‖A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om‖ ≤ _
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
            have h_col0 : walkPos ρ om 0 ∈ K_col 0 := by
              rw [(h_pref_props 0).2.2 om]
              exact h_pref_in_col 0 _ hA
            calc
              ‖M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om 0)‖
                ≤ ‖M_up‖ + ‖L_g (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
              _ = M_up + ‖L_g (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ := by
                  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hM_up]
              _ ≤ M_up + B0 := by linarith [hB0 _ h_col0]
          · change ‖A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_g (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om‖ ≤ _
            rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hA, norm_zero]
            linarith
      | succ n ih =>
          rcases ih with ⟨hInt_n, hExp_n⟩
          let S_idx : Finset ℕ := Finset.range (n + 1)
          let X_pref : WalkSpace → (S_idx → ℝ) := S_idx.restrict
          let X_next : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => om (n + 1)
          have hX_pref_meas : Measurable X_pref :=
            Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1
          have hX_next_meas : Measurable X_next := measurable_pi_apply (n + 1)
          let KeepPref : Set (S_idx → ℝ) :=
            {p | p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ ∈
                Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)} ∩
              ⋂ j : Fin (n + 1),
                {p | walkPrefixPos j.1 (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) p) ∈ G_set ∧
                  -B₁ ≤ L_g (walkPrefixPos j.1 (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) p))}
          have hKeepPref_meas : MeasurableSet KeepPref := by
            refine (measurableSet_Ico.preimage (measurable_pi_apply _)).inter ?_
            refine MeasurableSet.iInter fun j => ?_
            have hj_meas : Measurable (fun p : S_idx → ℝ =>
                walkPrefixPos j.1 (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) p)) :=
              (h_pref_props j.1).1.comp (h_sub_meas (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2))
            exact (hGood_meas.preimage hj_meas).inter
              (isClosed_Ici.measurableSet.preimage (hLg_meas.comp hj_meas))
          have hKeep_iff : ∀ om : WalkSpace, X_pref om ∈ KeepPref ↔ om ∈ KeepGoing n := by
            intro om
            simp only [KeepPref, KeepGoing, A₀, X_pref, Set.mem_inter_iff,
              Set.mem_iInter, Finset.mem_range]
            refine and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h j hj => ?_, fun h j => ?_⟩
            · have h_sub_eq :
                  subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj) (S_idx.restrict om) =
                    (Finset.range (j + 1)).restrict om := rfl
              have h_pos_eq : walkPos ρ om j =
                  walkPrefixPos j (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hj) (S_idx.restrict om)) := by
                rw [h_sub_eq, ← (h_pref_props j).2.2 om]
              simpa [h_pos_eq] using h ⟨j, hj⟩
            · have h_sub_eq :
                  subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) (S_idx.restrict om) =
                    (Finset.range (j.1 + 1)).restrict om := rfl
              have h_pos_eq : walkPos ρ om j.1 =
                  walkPrefixPos j.1
                    (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp j.2) (S_idx.restrict om)) := by
                rw [h_sub_eq, ← (h_pref_props j.1).2.2 om]
              simpa [← h_pos_eq] using h j.1 j.2
          let Φ : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ :=
            (KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)).indicator fun q =>
              L_g (walkPrefixPos n q.1) -
                L_g (circleMap (walkPrefixPos n q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n q.1)) q.2)
          have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ := by
            have hy_q : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ => walkPrefixPos n q.1) :=
              (h_pref_props n).1.comp measurable_fst
            have h_cmap : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ =>
                circleMap (walkPrefixPos n q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n q.1)) q.2) := by
              simp only [circleMap]
              exact hy_q.add
                ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp hy_q)).mul
                  (Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
                    ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)))
            exact ((hLg_meas.comp hy_q).sub (hLg_meas.comp h_cmap)).indicator
              (hKeepPref_meas.prod MeasurableSet.univ)
          obtain ⟨Bn, hBn_nn, hBn⟩ := hLg_col_bound n
          obtain ⟨Bn1, hBn1_nn, hBn1⟩ := hLg_col_bound (n + 1)
          have hΦ_bound : ∀ q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖Φ q‖ ≤ Bn + Bn1 := by
            intro ⟨p, θ⟩
            by_cases hp : p ∈ KeepPref
            · have h_mem : (p, θ) ∈ KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hp, trivial⟩
              dsimp only [Φ]
              rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_mem]
              have hy_col : walkPrefixPos n p ∈ K_col n := h_pref_in_col n p hp.1
              have hc_col : circleMap (walkPrefixPos n p) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p)) θ ∈
                  K_col (n + 1) := by
                apply hK_col_step hy_col
                have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPrefixPos n p) := hAdm.nonneg _
                simp [circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn]
              have hb1 := hBn _ hy_col
              have hb2 := hBn1 _ hc_col
              calc
                ‖L_g (walkPrefixPos n p) -
                    L_g (circleMap (walkPrefixPos n p) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p)) θ)‖
                  ≤ ‖L_g (walkPrefixPos n p)‖ +
                      ‖L_g (circleMap (walkPrefixPos n p) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p)) θ)‖ :=
                    norm_sub_le _ _
                _ ≤ Bn + Bn1 := add_le_add hb1 hb2
            · have h_nmem : (p, θ) ∉ KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun h => hp h.1
              dsimp only [Φ]
              rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h_nmem, norm_zero]
              linarith
          let ΔZ : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => Φ (X_pref om, X_next om)
          have hΔZ_eq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
              (KeepGoing n).indicator
                (fun om' => L_g (walkPos ρ om' n) - L_g (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1))) om =
              ΔZ om := by
            intro om
            have hy_eq : walkPos ρ om n = walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om) := (h_pref_props n).2.2 om
            have hy1_eq : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) =
                circleMap (walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om)) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om)))
                  (X_next om) := by
              simp [walkPos, circleMap, ← hy_eq, X_next]
            by_cases hK : om ∈ KeepGoing n
            · have hp : X_pref om ∈ KeepPref := (hKeep_iff om).mpr hK
              have hp_prod : (X_pref om, X_next om) ∈ KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                ⟨hp, trivial⟩
              simp only [ΔZ, Φ, Set.indicator_of_mem hK, Set.indicator_of_mem hp_prod,
                hy_eq, hy1_eq]
            · have hp : X_pref om ∉ KeepPref := fun h => hK ((hKeep_iff om).mp h)
              have hp_prod : (X_pref om, X_next om) ∉ KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                fun h => hp h.1
              simp only [ΔZ, Φ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hK, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp_prod]
          have hΔZ_meas : Measurable ΔZ := hΦ_meas.comp (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas)
          have hΔZ_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable ΔZ walkMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΔZ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (Bn + Bn1)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => hΦ_bound (X_pref om, X_next om))
          
          have h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun (i : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) => om i)
              walkMeasure :=
            ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_infinitePi (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => measurable_id)
          have h_disj : Disjoint S_idx ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by simp [S_idx]
          have h_fin := h_indep.indepFun_finset S_idx {n + 1} h_disj
            (fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _)
          have h_pair : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X_pref X_next walkMeasure := by
            have hp0 := h_fin.comp measurable_id
              (measurable_pi_apply ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩)
            have h_eq1 : (id ∘ fun (a : WalkSpace) (i : S_idx) => a ↑i) = X_pref := rfl
            have h_eq2 : ((fun f : ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ) → ℝ =>
                f ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩) ∘
                fun (a : WalkSpace) (i : ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ)) => a ↑i) = X_next := rfl
            rwa [h_eq1, h_eq2] at hp0
          let μ_pref := walkMeasure.map X_pref
          have hProbPref : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ_pref :=
            ⟨by rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hX_pref_meas MeasurableSet.univ]; simp⟩
          have h_map_prod : walkMeasure.map (fun om => (X_pref om, X_next om)) =
              μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure := by
            rw [(ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
              hX_pref_meas.aemeasurable hX_next_meas.aemeasurable).mp h_pair]
            congr 1
            exact MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (n + 1)
          have hΦ_int_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable Φ (μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) :=
            MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΦ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (Bn + Bn1)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hΦ_bound)
          have hΔZ_zero : (∫ om, ΔZ om ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
            have h_m1 : (∫ om, ΔZ om ∂walkMeasure) =
                ∫ q, Φ q ∂(walkMeasure.map (fun om => (X_pref om, X_next om))) :=
              (MeasureTheory.integral_map (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas).aemeasurable
                hΦ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
            rw [h_m1, h_map_prod, MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hΦ_int_prod]
            have h_inner : ∀ p : S_idx → ℝ, (∫ θ, Φ (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
              intro p
              by_cases hp : p ∈ KeepPref
              · let y := walkPrefixPos n p
                have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := (h_pref_props n).2.1 p
                have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
                have hcball : Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg :=
                  (h_adm_ball_sub hAdm y hy_reg).2.2.2
                have h_fn_eq : (fun θ : ℝ => Φ (p, θ)) =
                    fun θ : ℝ => Real.log ‖g y‖ - Real.log ‖g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)‖ := by
                  funext θ
                  have hp_prod : (p, θ) ∈ KeepPref ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hp, trivial⟩
                  dsimp only [Φ]
                  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp_prod, hLg_eq y hy_reg]
                  have hc_reg : circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Ω_reg := by
                    apply hcball
                    simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn]
                  rw [hLg_eq _ hc_reg]
                rw [h_fn_eq]
                have h_circle_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
                    Real.log ‖g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)‖) := by
                  have h_cm_cont : Continuous (circleMap y (ρ y)) := continuous_circleMap _ _
                  have h_cm_maps : Set.MapsTo (circleMap y (ρ y)) Set.univ Ω_reg := by
                    intro θ _
                    apply hcball
                    simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn]
                  exact h_log_cont.comp_continuous h_cm_cont fun θ => h_cm_maps trivial
                have h_circle_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun θ : ℝ => Real.log ‖g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)‖) unifTwoPiMeasure := by
                  have h_col_c : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ K_col (n + 1) := by
                    intro θ
                    apply hK_col_step (h_pref_in_col n p hp.1)
                    dsimp only [y, circleMap]
                    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                      abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
                  refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
                    h_circle_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable Bn1
                    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => ?_)
                  have hc_reg : circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Ω_reg := (hK_col_cpt_sub (n + 1)).2 (h_col_c θ)
                  rw [← hLg_eq _ hc_reg]
                  exact hBn1 _ (h_col_c θ)
                rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _) h_circle_int]
                have h_const_int : (∫ _ : ℝ, Real.log ‖g y‖ ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) =
                    Real.log ‖g y‖ := by
                  simp
                have hr_abs : Metric.closedBall y |ρ y| ⊆ Ω_reg := by
                  simpa [abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn] using hcball
                have h_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Metric.closedBall y |ρ y|) :=
                  (hg_holo.analyticOnNhd P.reg_open).mono hr_abs
                have h_avg : Real.circleAverage (fun z => Real.log ‖g z‖) y (ρ y) =
                    Real.log ‖g y‖ :=
                  h_ana.circleAverage_log_norm_of_ne_zero fun z hz => hg_ne z (hr_abs hz)
                have h_c_int : (∫ θ, Real.log ‖g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)‖ ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) =
                    Real.log ‖g y‖ := by
                  rw [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
                    MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
                  have h_toR : ((ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹).toReal = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by

    have hZ0_le : ∀ om : WalkSpace, Z 0 om ≤ M_up + C₀ := by

        have h_eq0 : L_g (walkPos ρ om 0) = Real.log ‖g (om 0)‖ :=

      intro k
      have h_ind_le : ∀ om : WalkSpace,

        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_mem]

          simp only [E_fin, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter,

        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h_mem]
          exact (hZ_inv k om).1
      have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          ((A₀ ∩ E_fin k).indicator fun _ => M_up + B₁) walkMeasure :=
        (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _).indicator (hA₀_meas.inter (hE_fin_meas k))
      have h_markov : (M_up + B₁) * walkMeasure.real (A₀ ∩ E_fin k) ≤ M_up + C₀ := by
        have h_int_ind : (∫ om, (A₀ ∩ E_fin k).indicator (fun _ => M_up + B₁) om ∂walkMeasure) =
            walkMeasure.real (A₀ ∩ E_fin k) * (M_up + B₁) := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_const _ (hA₀_meas.inter (hE_fin_meas k)),
            smul_eq_mul, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
        have h_mono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_ind_int (hZ_int_exp k).1 h_ind_le
        rw [h_int_ind, (hZ_int_exp k).2] at h_mono
        linarith

      have h_ne_top : walkMeasure (A₀ ∩ E_fin k) ≠ ⊤ := MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal h_ne_top]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_le
    have h_mono_seq : Monotone (fun k : ℕ => A₀ ∩ E_fin k) := by
      intro i j hij om ⟨hA, hEi⟩
      refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
      simp only [E_fin, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range] at hEi ⊢
      rcases hEi with ⟨m, hm, h_rest⟩

      exact Nat.lt_succ_self m
    have h_A0_def_le : walkMeasure (A₀ ∩ E_def) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁)) := by

        by_cases (fun hA : om ∈ A₀ => Or.inl ⟨hA, hom⟩) Or.inr
      calc

        _ ≤ walkMeasure (A₀ ∩ E_def) + walkMeasure A₀ᶜ := MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _
        _ = walkMeasure (A₀ ∩ E_def) := by rw [hA₀_compl_null, add_zero]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁)) := h_A0_def_le
    refine ⟨h_walk_reg, hE_def_meas, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    have h_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁) := div_nonneg (by linarith) hMB₁.le
    calc
      (walkMeasure E_def).toReal
        ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal ((M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁))).toReal :=

      _ = (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁) := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h_ratio_nn

  
  
  
  have h_speed : ∃ C_f : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
      ‖S.f s‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0)) := by
    let k₀ := hBudget.k₀
    let H_int := S.H - Real.exp (-k₀)
    have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k₀) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hH_int_lt : H_int < S.H := by linarith
    let rectMap : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have h_rect_cont : Continuous rectMap :=
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
    let K_rect : Set ℂ :=
      rectMap '' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H_int) H_int)
    have hK_rect_cpt : IsCompact K_rect :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image h_rect_cont
    have hK_rect_sub : K_rect ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, y⟩, ⟨_, hy⟩, rfl⟩
      have hy_abs : |y| ≤ H_int := abs_le.mpr hy
      have him : (rectMap (x, y)).im = y := by simp [rectMap]
      change |(rectMap (x, y)).im| < S.H
      rw [him]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨M_int, hM_int⟩ :=
      hK_rect_cpt.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (S.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_rect_sub)
    let M_int' := max M_int 0
    have hM_int'_nn : 0 ≤ M_int' := le_max_right _ _
    have h_per_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip S.H →
        S.f (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)) = S.f z := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro z _; simp
      | succ m ih =>
          intro z hz
          have hz' : z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
            have him : (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)).im = z.im := by
              norm_cast; simp
            simpa [horizStrip, him] using hz
          have h_add : z + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) =
              (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
            push_cast; ring
          rw [h_add, S.f_periodic _ hz', ih z hz]
    have h_per_int : ∀ (m : ℤ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip S.H →
        S.f (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)) = S.f z := by
      intro m z hz
      cases m with
      | ofNat n => simpa using h_per_nat n z hz
      | negSucc n =>
          let z' := z + (Int.negSucc n : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)
          have hz' : z' ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
            have him : z'.im = z.im := by
              dsimp only [z']; norm_cast; simp
            simpa [horizStrip, him] using hz
          have h_back : z' + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) = z := by
            dsimp only [z']
            rw [Int.cast_negSucc]
            push_cast; ring
          have h1 := h_per_nat (n + 1) z' hz'
          rw [h_back] at h1
          exact h1.symm
    let C_f := max (max hBudget.C_env 1 + 3) (M_int' + 1)
    have hCf_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_f := by
      have : 1 ≤ max hBudget.C_env 1 + 3 := by linarith [le_max_right hBudget.C_env 1]
      exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨C_f, hCf_ge_one, fun s hs => ?_⟩
    let L := max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0
    have hL_nn : 0 ≤ L := le_max_right _ _
    by_cases h_slab : |s.im| ≤ H_int
    · let u := s.re / (2 * Real.pi)
      let m : ℤ := -⌊u⌋
      let s' := s + (m : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi : ℂ)
      have hs'_eq : S.f s' = S.f s := h_per_int m s hs
      have hs'_im : s'.im = s.im := by
        simp [s']
      have hs'_re : s'.re = 2 * Real.pi * Int.fract u := by
        have h1 : s'.re = s.re + (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
          simp [s']
        have h2 : u * (2 * Real.pi) = s.re := div_mul_cancel₀ _ Real.two_pi_pos.ne'
        rw [h1, Int.fract]
        dsimp only [m]
        push_cast
        linarith
      have hs'_mem : s' ∈ K_rect := by
        refine ⟨(s'.re, s'.im), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Complex.re_add_im s'⟩
        · rw [hs'_re]
          refine ⟨mul_nonneg Real.two_pi_pos.le (Int.fract_nonneg u), ?_⟩
          nlinarith [Int.fract_lt_one u, Real.two_pi_pos]
        · rw [hs'_im]
          exact abs_le.mp h_slab
      have h_norm : ‖S.f s‖ ≤ M_int' := by
        rw [← hs'_eq]
        exact le_trans (hM_int s' hs'_mem) (le_max_left _ _)
      have h_m_le_exp : M_int' ≤ Real.exp M_int' := by
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp M_int']
      have h_exp_mono : Real.exp M_int' ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + L)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hCf_m : M_int' + 1 ≤ C_f := le_max_right _ _
        nlinarith
      exact le_trans h_norm (le_trans h_m_le_exp h_exp_mono)
    · have h_slab' : H_int < |s.im| := lt_of_not_ge h_slab
      let δ := S.H - |s.im|
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by
        have : |s.im| < S.H := hs
        linarith
      have hδ_lt : δ < Real.exp (-k₀) := by linarith
      let k := -Real.log δ
      have hk_gt : k₀ < k := by
        have hlog := Real.log_lt_log hδ_pos hδ_lt
        rw [Real.log_exp] at hlog
        linarith
      have hk_nn : 0 ≤ k := by linarith [hBudget.k₀_ge_one]
      have hL_eq : L = k := max_eq_left hk_nn
      have hexp_neg_k : Real.exp (-k) = δ := by
        simp [k, Real.exp_log hδ_pos]
      let w : ℂ := (s.re : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hw_bound : ‖S.f w‖ ≤ Real.exp (hBudget.C_env + 3 * k) := by
        have h_row := hBudget.row_sup_poly_bound k hk_gt.le s.re
        have hq_nn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        have h1 : ‖S.f w‖ ≤ Real.exp k * (hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2) := by
          have h_id : Real.exp k * Real.exp (-k) = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
          calc
            ‖S.f w‖ ≤ ‖S.f w‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖ := le_add_of_nonneg_right hq_nn
            _ = (Real.exp k * Real.exp (-k)) * (‖S.f w‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖) := by rw [h_id, one_mul]
            _ = Real.exp k * (Real.exp (-k) * (‖S.f w‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q w‖)) := by ring
            _ ≤ Real.exp k * (hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_row (Real.exp_pos k).le
        have h_1k : (1 + k) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * k) := by
          have h_le : 1 + k ≤ Real.exp k := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp k]
          have h_sq : (1 + k) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp k) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h_le 2
          have h_exp2 : (Real.exp k) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * k) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; push_cast; ring
          linarith
        have h_cenv : hBudget.C_env ≤ Real.exp hBudget.C_env := by
          linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp hBudget.C_env]
        calc
          ‖S.f w‖ ≤ Real.exp k * (hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2) := h1
          _ ≤ Real.exp k * (Real.exp hBudget.C_env * Real.exp (2 * k)) := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.exp_pos k).le
              exact mul_le_mul h_cenv h_1k (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = Real.exp (hBudget.C_env + 3 * k) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      have hs_eq_w : ‖S.f s‖ = ‖S.f w‖ := by
        by_cases him_nn : 0 ≤ s.im
        · have hs_w : s = w := by
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w, hexp_neg_k, δ, abs_of_nonneg him_nn]
          rw [hs_w]
        · have him_neg : s.im < 0 := lt_of_not_ge him_nn
          have h_conj_w : starRingEnd ℂ s = w := by
            apply Complex.ext <;> simp [w, hexp_neg_k, δ, abs_of_neg him_neg]
          rw [← Complex.norm_conj (S.f s), ← S.f_conj s hs, h_conj_w]
      rw [hs_eq_w]
      refine le_trans hw_bound (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      have hCf_env : max hBudget.C_env 1 + 3 ≤ C_f := le_max_left _ _
      have h_cenv_le : hBudget.C_env ≤ max hBudget.C_env 1 := le_max_left _ _
      have h_one_le : 1 ≤ max hBudget.C_env 1 := le_max_right _ _
      change hBudget.C_env + 3 * k ≤ C_f * (1 + L)
      rw [hL_eq]
      nlinarith

          ((h_sin_d0_holo r).const_mul (S.c : ℂ)) ?_
        intro y hy
        exact mul_ne_zero (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr S.c_pos.ne')
          (P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy r)
      dsimp only [OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply]
      split_ifs
      · exact h_m0.sub h_vd_raw
      · exact h_m0.sub (differentiableOn_const 0)
      · exact differentiableOn_const 1
      · exact differentiableOn_const 0
    have h_sum_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin P.N), fun y =>
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin P.N, P.B_mat I F y (σ i) i) Ω_reg := by
      refine DifferentiableOn.sum fun σ _ => ?_
      have h_prod : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (∏ i : Fin P.N, fun y => P.B_mat I F y (σ i) i) Ω_reg :=
        DifferentiableOn.finsetProd fun i _ => h_entry (σ i) i
      exact (h_prod.const_mul ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ)).congr fun y _ => by
        simp [Finset.prod_apply]
    refine h_sum_holo.congr fun y _ => ?_
    rw [Matrix.det_apply', Finset.sum_apply]

  
  have h_strip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_pos_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg := by
    intro j
    rw [continuousOn_pi]
    intro coord y hy
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    let s := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y
    have hs_mem : s ∈ horizStrip S.H := (h_imp_holo_maps j.val).2 hy.1
    have hf_ne : S.f s ≠ 0 := P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j
    have h_imp_cont : ContinuousAt (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y :=
      ((h_imp_holo_maps j.val).1.differentiableAt
        (h_strip_open.mem_nhds hy.1)).continuousAt
    have hΓ := S.Γ_reg_holo s hs_mem hf_ne
    fin_cases coord
    · exact ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun z => S.Γ z 0) (f := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val)
        hΓ.1.continuousAt h_imp_cont
    · exact ContinuousAt.comp (g := fun z => S.Γ z 1) (f := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val)
        hΓ.2.continuousAt h_imp_cont
  have h_depth_cont : ∀ i : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (sliceLogDepth S P i) Ω_reg := by
    intro i
    have h_s_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceShapeDepth S P i) Ω_reg :=
      continuousOn_const.sub
        (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
          (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
            (((h_imp_holo_maps i.val).1.continuousOn).mono Set.sdiff_subset)))
    refine (h_s_cont.log ?_).neg
    intro y hy
    have hs : |((sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val y)).im| < S.H := (h_imp_holo_maps i.val).2 hy.1
    change S.H - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val y).im| ≠ 0
    linarith
  have h_geom_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceGeomCost S P) Ω_reg := by
    refine ContinuousOn.finset_sup'_apply Finset.univ_nonempty fun j _ => ?_
    have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖) Ω_reg :=
      ((h_ang_holo j.val).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset).norm
    have hc2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖)) Ω_reg :=
      (continuousOn_const.add (h_pos_cont j).norm).log fun y _ => by
        dsimp only [Pi.add_apply]
        positivity
    have hc3 : ContinuousOn (fun y => |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖|) Ω_reg :=
      continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
        ((h_sin_d0_holo j).continuousOn.norm.log fun y hy =>
          norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy j))
    have hc4 : ContinuousOn (fun y => |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|) Ω_reg :=
      continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
        ((h_ℓ_holo j).continuousOn.norm.log fun y hy =>
          norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.reg_chord_ne_zero y hy j))
    exact ((hc1.add hc2).add hc3).add hc4

  
  let h_pair_bound : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)),
      ∃ C_q : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_q ∧ (I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          |Real.log ‖(P.B_mat I F x).det‖| ≤ C_q) := by
    intro I F
    by_cases h_prop : I ⊂ Finset.univ ∧ Disjoint I F
    · have h_cont_x : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log ‖(P.B_mat I F x).det‖)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := by
        have h_log_det : ContinuousOn (fun y : ℂ => Real.log ‖(P.B_mat I F y).det‖) Ω_reg :=
          ((h_B_holo I F).continuousOn.norm).log fun y hy =>
            norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.modified_det_ne_zero y hy I F h_prop.1 h_prop.2)
        exact h_log_det.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousOn fun x _ => h_real_in_reg x
      obtain ⟨C_q, hC_q⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn h_cont_x
      refine ⟨max C_q 0, le_max_right _ _, fun _ _ x hx => ?_⟩
      exact le_trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC_q x hx) (le_max_left _ _)
    · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun hI hIF => False.elim (h_prop ⟨hI, hIF⟩)⟩
  let C_det : ℝ :=
    ∑ q : Finset (Fin P.N) × Finset (Fin P.N), Classical.choose (h_pair_bound q.1 q.2)
  have hC_det_nn : 0 ≤ C_det :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun q _ => (Classical.choose_spec (h_pair_bound q.1 q.2)).1
  have hC_det_bound : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C_det ≤ Real.log ‖(P.B_mat I F x).det‖ ∧ Real.log ‖(P.B_mat I F x).det‖ ≤ C_det := by
    intro I F hI hIF x hx
    have h_spec := (Classical.choose_spec (h_pair_bound I F)).2 hI hIF x hx
    have h_le_sum : Classical.choose (h_pair_bound I F) ≤ C_det :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun q : Finset (Fin P.N) × Finset (Fin P.N) =>
        Classical.choose (h_pair_bound q.1 q.2))
        (fun q _ => (Classical.choose_spec (h_pair_bound q.1 q.2)).1)
        (Finset.mem_univ (I, F))
    exact abs_le.mp (le_trans h_spec h_le_sum)

  
  have h_leibniz : ∀ (M_mat : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ) {A : ℝ},
      0 ≤ A → (∀ r c, ‖M_mat r c‖ ≤ A) →
      ‖M_mat.det‖ ≤ (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * A ^ P.N := by
    intro M_mat A hA hM
    rw [Matrix.det_apply']
    calc
      ‖∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin P.N), (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) * ∏ i : Fin P.N, M_mat (σ i) i‖
        ≤ ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin P.N),
            ‖((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin P.N, M_mat (σ i) i‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin P.N), A ^ P.N := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => ?_
          have h_sign : ‖((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) * ∏ i : Fin P.N, M_mat (σ i) i‖ =
              ‖∏ i : Fin P.N, M_mat (σ i) i‖ := by
            rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) with h | h <;> simp [h]
          rw [h_sign, norm_prod]
          calc
            ∏ i : Fin P.N, ‖M_mat (σ i) i‖ ≤ ∏ _i : Fin P.N, A := by
              gcongr with i
              exact hM (σ i) i
            _ = A ^ P.N := by simp
      _ = (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * A ^ P.N := by simp [Fintype.card_perm]

  let K₁ : ℝ := (P.N.factorial : ℝ) + (P.N : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c + 3 * C_f + 4)
  have hK₁_pos : 0 < K₁ := by
    have : 0 < 2 / S.c := div_pos zero_lt_two S.c_pos
    have : 0 < (P.N.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos P.N
    positivity
  have h_B_entry_and_det : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)) {U : ℝ}, 1 ≤ U →
      ∀ {y w : ℂ}, y ∈ Ω_reg → w ∈ Ω_reg →
        sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ U →
        (∀ i ∈ I, sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ U) →
        (∀ j : Fin P.N,
          |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j w)‖ - Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| ≤ 1 ∧
          |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j w‖ - Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖| ≤ 1 ∧
          |Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val w‖ -
            Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖| ≤ 1) →
        let A_U := (4 + 2 / S.c) * Real.exp ((3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))
        1 ≤ A_U ∧
        (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * A_U ^ P.N ≤ Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) ∧
        ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖P.B_mat I F w r c‖ ≤ A_U := by
    intro I F U hU y w hy hw h_geom h_depth h_jumps
    let E_exp := Real.exp ((3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))
    let A_U := (4 + 2 / S.c) * E_exp
    have hE_ge_one : 1 ≤ E_exp := by
      apply Real.one_le_exp
      nlinarith
    have h2c_pos : 0 < 2 / S.c := div_pos zero_lt_two S.c_pos
    have hAU_ge_one : 1 ≤ A_U := by
      dsimp only [A_U]
      nlinarith
    have h_fact_bound : (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * A_U ^ P.N ≤ Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) := by
      have h_f1 : (P.N.factorial : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (P.N.factorial : ℝ) := by
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (P.N.factorial : ℝ)]
      have h_c1 : 4 + 2 / S.c ≤ Real.exp (4 + 2 / S.c) := by
        linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (4 + 2 / S.c)]
      have h_AU_exp : A_U ≤ Real.exp ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U)) := by
        dsimp only [A_U, E_exp]
        rw [Real.exp_add]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_c1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have h_pow : A_U ^ P.N ≤
          Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) := by
        calc
          A_U ^ P.N
            ≤ (Real.exp ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) ^ P.N :=
              pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h_AU_exp P.N
          _ = Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      calc
        (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * A_U ^ P.N
          ≤ Real.exp (P.N.factorial : ℝ) *
              Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) :=
            mul_le_mul h_f1 h_pow (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) +
              (P.N : ℝ) * ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) := by
            apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
            have h_diff_eq : K₁ * (1 + U) -
                ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) + (P.N : ℝ) * ((4 + 2 / S.c) + (3 * C_f + 4) * (1 + U))) =
                (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * U + (P.N : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) * U := by
              dsimp only [K₁]
              ring
            have h_diff_nn : 0 ≤ (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * U + (P.N : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) * U := by
              positivity
            linarith
    have h_inv_bounds : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖(Complex.sin (P.d0 j w))⁻¹‖ ≤ Real.exp (U + 1) ∧
        ‖(P.ℓ_slice j w)⁻¹‖ ≤ Real.exp (U + 1) := by
      intro j
      have hj_sup := (Finset.sup'_le_iff Finset.univ_nonempty _).mp h_geom j (Finset.mem_univ j)
      have h_pos_log : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) :=
        Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y)])
      have h_ang_nn : 0 ≤ ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have h_sin_abs : |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| ≤ U := by
        linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖)]
      have h_ell_abs : |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖| ≤ U := by
        linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖)]
      have h_sin_w : -(U + 1) ≤ Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j w)‖ := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp h_sin_abs).1, (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (h_jumps j).1).2]
      have h_ell_w : -(U + 1) ≤ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j w‖ := by
        linarith [(abs_le.mp h_ell_abs).1, (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (h_jumps j).2.1).2]
      have h_sin_pos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j w)‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero w hw j)
      have h_ell_pos : 0 < ‖P.ℓ_slice j w‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_chord_ne_zero w hw j)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_inv]
        have h_ge : Real.exp (-(U + 1)) ≤ ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j w)‖ := by
          rw [← Real.exp_log h_sin_pos]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_sin_w
        calc
          (‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j w)‖)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp (-(U + 1)))⁻¹ :=
            inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) h_ge
          _ = Real.exp (U + 1) := by rw [← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg]
      · rw [norm_inv]
        have h_ge : Real.exp (-(U + 1)) ≤ ‖P.ℓ_slice j w‖ := by
          rw [← Real.exp_log h_ell_pos]
          exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_ell_w
        calc
          (‖P.ℓ_slice j w‖)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp (-(U + 1)))⁻¹ :=
            inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) h_ge
          _ = Real.exp (U + 1) := by rw [← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg]
    refine ⟨hAU_ge_one, h_fact_bound, fun r c => ?_⟩
    dsimp only [OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply]
    by_cases h_mem : r ∈ I ∪ F ∧ c ∈ I ∪ F
    · simp only [h_mem, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
      have h_ell_le_E : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖(P.ℓ_slice j w)⁻¹‖ ≤ E_exp := by
        intro j
        refine le_trans (h_inv_bounds j).2 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
        nlinarith
      have h_m0_le : ‖jacobiM0 P.N (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i w) r c‖ ≤ 4 * E_exp := by
        dsimp only [jacobiM0, Matrix.of_apply]
        have ht1 : ‖if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) w)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤
            2 * E_exp := by
          split_ifs
          · calc
              ‖(P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) w)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹‖
                ≤ ‖(P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) w)⁻¹‖ + ‖(P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹‖ := norm_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ E_exp + E_exp := add_le_add (h_ell_le_E _) (h_ell_le_E _)
              _ = 2 * E_exp := by ring
          · simp; linarith
        have ht2 : ‖if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤ E_exp := by
          split_ifs
          · exact h_ell_le_E _
          · simp; linarith
        have ht3 : ‖if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c w)⁻¹ else 0‖ ≤ E_exp := by
          split_ifs
          · exact h_ell_le_E _
          · simp; linarith
        calc
          ‖(if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) w)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0) +
              (if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0) +
              (if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c w)⁻¹ else 0)‖
            ≤ ‖(if r = c then (P.ℓ_slice (cycPrev P.N r) w)⁻¹ + (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0) +
                (if c = cycNext P.N r then (P.ℓ_slice r w)⁻¹ else 0)‖ +
              ‖if r = cycNext P.N c then (P.ℓ_slice c w)⁻¹ else 0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (2 * E_exp + E_exp) + E_exp :=
              add_le_add (le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (add_le_add ht1 ht2)) ht3
          _ = 4 * E_exp := by ring
      have h_vd_le : ‖if r = c ∧ r ∈ I then
          jacobiVDiag P.N S.c (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val w) (fun i => P.d0 i w) r
          else 0‖ ≤ (2 / S.c) * E_exp := by
        split_ifs with hri
        · have hs_mem : sliceImpactSeq S P.N r.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
            (h_imp_holo_maps r.val).2 hy.1
          have h_d_le : max (-Real.log (S.H - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N r.val y).im|)) 0 ≤ U :=
            max_le (h_depth r hri.2) (by linarith)
          have h_fy : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val y‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + U)) := by
            refine le_trans (hf_bound _ hs_mem) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
            nlinarith
          have h_fy_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val y‖ :=
            norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy r)
          have h_log_fy : Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val y‖ ≤ C_f * (1 + U) :=
            (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_fy_pos).mpr h_fy
          have h_log_fw : Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ ≤ C_f * (1 + U) + 1 := by
            linarith [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp (h_jumps r).2.2).1]
          have h_fw_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ :=
            norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero w hw r)
          have h_fw : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + U) + 1) :=
            (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_fw_pos).mp h_log_fw
          have h_sin_inv := (h_inv_bounds r).1
          rw [norm_inv] at h_sin_inv
          dsimp only [jacobiVDiag]
          rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, norm_pow, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos S.c_pos]
          have h_eq_mul : 2 * ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ ^ 3 /
              (S.c * ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 r w)‖) =
              (2 / S.c) * (‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ ^ 3 *
                (‖Complex.sin (P.d0 r w)‖)⁻¹) := by
            ring
          rw [h_eq_mul]
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ h2c_pos.le
          calc
            ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r.val w‖ ^ 3 * (‖Complex.sin (P.d0 r w)‖)⁻¹
              ≤ (Real.exp (C_f * (1 + U) + 1)) ^ 3 * Real.exp (U + 1) :=
                mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fw 3) h_sin_inv
                  (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
            _ = Real.exp (3 * (C_f * (1 + U) + 1) + (U + 1)) := by
                rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]; push_cast; ring_nf
            _ ≤ E_exp := by
                apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
                nlinarith
        · simp
          exact mul_nonneg h2c_pos.le (by linarith)
      calc
        ‖jacobiM0 P.N (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i w) r c -
            (if r = c ∧ r ∈ I then
              jacobiVDiag P.N S.c (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val w) (fun i => P.d0 i w) r
            else 0)‖
          ≤ ‖jacobiM0 P.N (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i w) r c‖ +
              ‖if r = c ∧ r ∈ I then
                jacobiVDiag P.N S.c (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val w) (fun i => P.d0 i w) r
              else 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ 4 * E_exp + (2 / S.c) * E_exp := add_le_add h_m0_le h_vd_le
        _ = A_U := by dsimp only [A_U]; ring
    · simp only [h_mem, ↓reduceIte]
      split_ifs <;> simp <;> linarith

  
  
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro g hg_holo hg_ne ⟨C₀, hC₀, hg_real⟩
    refine ⟨2 * C₀ + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro M B₀ B₁ hB₀ hB₁ ρ hAdm h_jump

    let Good : ℂ → Prop := fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖ ≤ B₀
