      have h_log_c : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖) Ω_reg :=
        (hg_holo.continuousOn.norm).log fun y hy => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hg_ne y hy)
      have h_open_gt : IsOpen (Ω_reg ∩ (fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi B₀) :=
        h_log_c.isOpen_inter_preimage P.reg_open isOpen_Ioi
      have h_eq : {y ∈ Ω_reg | Good y} =
          Ω_reg \ (Ω_reg ∩ (fun y => Real.log ‖g y‖) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi B₀) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Good, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_inter_iff,
          Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi, not_and, not_lt]
        exact ⟨fun ⟨hy, hle⟩ => ⟨hy, fun _ => hle⟩, fun ⟨hy, h⟩ => ⟨hy, h hy⟩⟩
      rw [h_eq]
      exact P.reg_open.measurableSet.diff h_open_gt.measurableSet
    have hg_real_up : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖g x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖g x‖ ≤ M_up := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨(hg_real x hx).1, le_trans (hg_real x hx).2 (le_max_right _ _)⟩
    have hGood_step : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Good y →
        Real.log ‖g y‖ ≤ M_up ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → Real.log ‖g (y + z)‖ ≤ M_up := by
      intro y hy hG
      have h1 : B₀ + 1 ≤ M_up := le_max_left _ _
      refine ⟨by linarith [hG], fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have hj := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (h_jump y hy z hz)).1
      linarith [hG]
    have h_res := (h_core g hg_holo hg_ne C₀ M_up hC₀ hM_up_nn hg_real_up M ρ hAdm
      Good hGood_meas hGood_step B₁ hMB₁_pos).2.2
    have h_sub : {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ B₀) ∧
        Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -B₁} ⊆
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m : ℕ,
        (∀ l < m, Good (walkPos ρ om l)) ∧ Real.log ‖g (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -B₁} := by
      intro om ⟨m, _, hm1, hm2⟩
      exact ⟨m, hm1, hm2⟩
    have h_mono := MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
    have h_num : M_up + C₀ ≤ (2 * C₀ + 1) * (1 + B₀) := by
      have hM_le : M_up ≤ B₀ + 1 + C₀ := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have h_den : 1 + B₁ ≤ M_up + B₁ := by linarith
    have h_frac : (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁) ≤ (2 * C₀ + 1) * (1 + B₀) / (1 + B₁) := by
      calc
        (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁)
          ≤ ((2 * C₀ + 1) * (1 + B₀)) / (M_up + B₁) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num hMB₁_pos.le
        _ ≤ ((2 * C₀ + 1) * (1 + B₀)) / (1 + B₁) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by linarith) h_den
    exact le_trans h_mono (le_trans h_res h_frac)

  · 
    let C_B : ℝ := max 1 (max C_det (2 * K₁ + 1))
    have hCB_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_B := le_max_left _ _
    have hCB_det : C_det ≤ C_B := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hCB_K1 : 2 * K₁ + 1 ≤ C_B := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
    let C_inv : ℝ := 2 * C_B
    refine ⟨C_inv, { C_inv_pos := by linarith, inv_bound := ?_ }⟩
    intro M U V ρ hAdm hU hUV I F hI hIF
    let g_det : ℂ → ℂ := fun y => (P.B_mat I F y).det
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g_det Ω_reg := h_B_holo I F
    have hg_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, g_det y ≠ 0 := fun y hy => P.modified_det_ne_zero y hy I F hI hIF
    let M_up : ℝ := C_B * (1 + U)
    have hM_up_nn : 0 ≤ M_up := by positivity
    have hMV_pos : 0 < M_up + V := by linarith
    let Good_U : ℂ → Prop := fun y =>
      sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ U ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ U
    have hGood_meas : MeasurableSet {y ∈ Ω_reg | Good_U y} := by
      have h_g_open : IsOpen (Ω_reg ∩ sliceGeomCost S P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi U) :=
        h_geom_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage P.reg_open isOpen_Ioi
      have h_d_open : ∀ i : Fin P.N, IsOpen (Ω_reg ∩ sliceLogDepth S P i ⁻¹' Set.Ioi U) :=
        fun i => (h_depth_cont i).isOpen_inter_preimage P.reg_open isOpen_Ioi
      have h_eq : {y ∈ Ω_reg | Good_U y} =
          (Ω_reg \ (Ω_reg ∩ sliceGeomCost S P ⁻¹' Set.Ioi U)) ∩
            ⋂ i ∈ I, (Ω_reg \ (Ω_reg ∩ sliceLogDepth S P i ⁻¹' Set.Ioi U)) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Good_U, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_sdiff,
          Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_iInter, not_and, not_lt]
        exact ⟨fun ⟨hy, hg, hd⟩ => ⟨⟨hy, fun _ => hg⟩, fun i hi => ⟨hy, fun _ => hd i hi⟩⟩,
          fun ⟨⟨hy, hg⟩, hd⟩ => ⟨hy, hg hy, fun i hi => (hd i hi).2 hy⟩⟩
      rw [h_eq]
      refine (P.reg_open.measurableSet.diff h_g_open.measurableSet).inter ?_
      exact Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun i _ =>
        P.reg_open.measurableSet.diff (h_d_open i).measurableSet
    have hg_real : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C_B ≤ Real.log ‖g_det x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖g_det x‖ ≤ M_up := by
      intro x hx
      have hd := hC_det_bound I F hI hIF x hx
      refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
      have : C_B ≤ M_up := by dsimp only [M_up]; nlinarith
      linarith
    have hGood_step : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Good_U y →
        Real.log ‖g_det y‖ ≤ M_up ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → Real.log ‖g_det (y + z)‖ ≤ M_up := by
      intro y hy ⟨hg_y, hd_y⟩
      have h_step_z : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → Real.log ‖g_det (y + z)‖ ≤ M_up := by
        intro z hz
        have hw_reg : y + z ∈ Ω_reg := by
          apply (h_adm_ball_sub hAdm y hy).2.2.2
          simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
        have h_j : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (y + z))‖ - Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| ≤ 1 ∧
            |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y + z)‖ - Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖| ≤ 1 ∧
            |Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)‖ -
              Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖| ≤ 1 :=
          fun j => ⟨hAdm.jump_log_sin_d0 y hy z hz j,
            hAdm.jump_log_chord y hy z hz j,
            hAdm.jump_log_speed y hy z hz j⟩
        rcases h_B_entry_and_det I F hU hy hw_reg hg_y hd_y h_j with ⟨hAU, h_f_exp, h_ent⟩
        have h_det_norm : ‖g_det (y + z)‖ ≤ Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) :=
          le_trans (h_leibniz (P.B_mat I F (y + z)) (by linarith) h_ent) h_f_exp
        have h_det_pos : 0 < ‖g_det (y + z)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hg_ne _ hw_reg)
        have h_log_le : Real.log ‖g_det (y + z)‖ ≤ K₁ * (1 + U) :=
          (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_det_pos).mpr h_det_norm
        have hK1_le_CB : K₁ ≤ C_B := by linarith
        dsimp only [M_up]
        nlinarith
      refine ⟨?_, h_step_z⟩
      simpa using h_step_z 0 (by simpa using hAdm.nonneg y)
    rcases h_core g_det hg_holo hg_ne C_B M_up (by linarith) hM_up_nn hg_real M ρ hAdm
      Good_U hGood_meas hGood_step V hMV_pos with ⟨h_walk_reg, hE_meas, hE_prob⟩
    let E_bad : Set WalkSpace :=
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m : ℕ, (∀ l < m, Good_U (walkPos ρ om l)) ∧
        Real.log ‖g_det (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -V}
    refine ⟨E_bad, hE_meas, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_num : M_up + C_B ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) := by
        dsimp only [M_up, C_inv]; nlinarith
      have h_den : 1 + V ≤ M_up + V := by
        dsimp only [M_up]; nlinarith
      have h_frac : (M_up + C_B) / (M_up + V) ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) := by
        calc
          (M_up + C_B) / (M_up + V)
            ≤ (C_inv * (1 + U)) / (M_up + V) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num hMV_pos.le
          _ ≤ (C_inv * (1 + U)) / (1 + V) :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by dsimp only [C_inv]; positivity) (by linarith) h_den
      exact le_trans hE_prob h_frac
    · intro om hom_not_bad m _hm_tau h_geom_m h_hist_m
      have h_good_all : ∀ n ≤ m, Good_U (walkPos ρ om n) := by
        intro n hn
        refine ⟨h_geom_m n hn, fun i hi => ?_⟩
        have hn_mem : n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn)
        have h_sup : sliceLogDepth S P i (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ sliceHistory S P ρ om i m :=
          Finset.le_sup' (f := fun k => sliceLogDepth S P i (walkPos ρ om k)) hn_mem
        exact le_trans h_sup (h_hist_m i hi)
      have h_det_ge : -V ≤ Real.log ‖g_det (walkPos ρ om m)‖ := by
        by_contra h_lt
        exact hom_not_bad ⟨m, fun l hl => h_good_all l hl.le, lt_of_not_ge h_lt⟩
      let y_m := walkPos ρ om m
      have hym_reg : y_m ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_reg om m
      let B := P.B_mat I F y_m
      have hB_det_ne : B.det ≠ 0 := hg_ne y_m hym_reg
      let B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ := (B.det)⁻¹ • B.adjugate
      refine ⟨B_inv, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_adjugate, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB_det_ne, one_smul]
      · rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.adjugate_mul, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB_det_ne, one_smul]
      · intro r c
        have h_j0 : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y_m)‖ - Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y_m)‖| ≤ 1 ∧
            |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y_m‖ - Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y_m‖| ≤ 1 ∧
            |Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y_m‖ -
              Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y_m‖| ≤ 1 := by
          intro j; simp
        rcases h_B_entry_and_det I F hU hym_reg hym_reg (h_good_all m le_rfl).1
          (h_good_all m le_rfl).2 h_j0 with ⟨hAU, h_f_exp, h_ent⟩
        have h_adj_norm : ‖B.adjugate r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) := by
          rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
          refine le_trans (h_leibniz (B.updateRow c (Pi.single r 1)) (by linarith) ?_) h_f_exp
          intro i k
          rw [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
          split_ifs with hic
          · by_cases hkr : k = r
            · subst hkr; simp; linarith
            · simp [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hkr]; linarith
          · exact h_ent i k
        have h_det_pos : 0 < ‖B.det‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hB_det_ne
        have h_det_inv_norm : ‖(B.det)⁻¹‖ ≤ Real.exp V := by
          rw [norm_inv]
          have h_ge : Real.exp (-V) ≤ ‖B.det‖ := by
            rw [← Real.exp_log h_det_pos]
            exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_det_ge
          calc
            (‖B.det‖)⁻¹ ≤ (Real.exp (-V))⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (Real.exp_pos _) h_ge
            _ = Real.exp V := by rw [← Real.exp_neg, neg_neg]
        dsimp only [B_inv]
        rw [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul]
        calc
          ‖(B.det)⁻¹‖ * ‖B.adjugate r c‖
            ≤ Real.exp V * Real.exp (K₁ * (1 + U)) :=
              mul_le_mul h_det_inv_norm h_adj_norm (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = Real.exp (V + K₁ * (1 + U)) := (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
          _ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V) := by
              apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
              dsimp only [C_inv]
              nlinarith

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (hLogDef : StoppedLogDeficitProp S P) :

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (hLogDef : StoppedLogDeficitProp S P) :
    ∃ σ₀ : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ HasUniformPowerGeometry S P σ₀

proof.tactics:
by
  let ρ₀ : ℝ := hBudget.ρ
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := hBudget.ρ_pos
  have hρ₀_lt : ρ₀ < 1 := hBudget.ρ_lt_one
  let η : ℝ := (1 - ρ₀) / 10
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  let ρ₁ : ℝ := ρ₀ + η
  let ρ₂ : ℝ := ρ₀ + 2 * η
  let γ : ℝ := ρ₀ + 7 * η
  let σ₃ : ℝ := ρ₀ + 8 * η
  let σ₀ : ℝ := ρ₀ + 9 * η
  let b : ℝ := 1 / 100
  have hb_pos : 0 < b := by norm_num [b]
  have hσ₀_pos : 0 < σ₀ := by dsimp [σ₀, η]; linarith
  have hσ₀_lt : σ₀ < 1 := by dsimp [σ₀, η]; linarith
  refine ⟨σ₀, hσ₀_pos, hσ₀_lt, 1, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  have hAdmMono : ∀ {M₁ M₂ : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, 2 ≤ M₁ → M₁ ≤ M₂ →
      IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M₂ ρ → IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M₁ ρ := by
    intro M₁ M₂ ρ hM₁ hM₁₂ h₂
    have h_sq : Real.exp (-M₂ ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-M₁ ^ 2) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hM₁₂ 2))
    have h_cube : Real.exp (-M₂ ^ 3) ≤ Real.exp (-M₁ ^ 3) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hM₁₂ 3))
    refine
      { scale_ge_two := hM₁
        measurable := h₂.measurable
        periodic := h₂.periodic
        cont_on := h₂.cont_on
        nonneg := h₂.nonneg
        pos_iff := h₂.pos_iff
        le_sing_dist := h₂.le_sing_dist
        small_shape_step := ?_
        jump_log_speed := h₂.jump_log_speed
        jump_log_sin_d0 := h₂.jump_log_sin_d0
        jump_log_chord := h₂.jump_log_chord
        jump_angle := h₂.jump_angle
        jump_pos := h₂.jump_pos
        taylor_impact := ?_
        taylor_angle := ?_
        taylor_pos₀ := ?_
        taylor_pos₁ := ?_
        taylor_support := ?_ }
    · intro y hy z hz j
      have h_step := h₂.small_shape_step y hy z hz j
      have h_depth_nonneg : 0 ≤ sliceShapeDepth S P j y := by
        have h_prod : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-M₂ ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j y :=
          le_trans (norm_nonneg _) h_step
        exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h_prod (Real.exp_pos _)
      exact le_trans h_step (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq h_depth_nonneg)
    · intro y hy z hz j
      refine le_trans (h₂.taylor_impact y hy z hz j) ?_
      have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ y := h₂.nonneg y
      nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz j
      refine le_trans (h₂.taylor_angle y hy z hz j) ?_
      have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ y := h₂.nonneg y
      nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz j
      refine le_trans (h₂.taylor_pos₀ y hy z hz j) ?_
      have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ y := h₂.nonneg y
      nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz j
      refine le_trans (h₂.taylor_pos₁ y hy z hz j) ?_
      have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ y := h₂.nonneg y
      nlinarith
    · intro y hy z hz j
      refine le_trans (h₂.taylor_support y hy z hz j) ?_
      have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ y := h₂.nonneg y
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cube (by positivity)) hρ
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  let E_init : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | om 0 ∉ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)}
  have hE_init_zero : walkMeasure.real E_init = 0 := by
    have hmp := measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
    have h_eq : E_init = (Function.eval 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ := rfl
    have h_meas : walkMeasure E_init = 0 := by
      rw [h_eq, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0) measurableSet_Ico.compl]
      change (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Function.eval 0)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure)))
        (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ = 0
      rw [hmp.map_eq]
      simp [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply, measurableSet_Ico.compl]
    simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, h_meas]
  have hN_pos : 0 < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three)
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := by
    dsimp [sliceParamT0]
    exact div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_ball : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  let h_sl : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  have hh_sl_pos : 0 < h_sl :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_ball).1
  have h_horiz_open : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip r) := fun r =>
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h_sl \ P.Z_all
  have h_real_in_reg : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω_reg := fun x =>
    ⟨by simp [horizStrip, hh_sl_pos], P.real_not_mem_Z_all x⟩
  have h_pair_maps : ∀ k : ℤ,
      Set.MapsTo
        (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
        (horizStrip h_sl) (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) := by
    intro k z hz
    have hz_lt : -h_sl < z.im ∧ z.im < h_sl := abs_lt.mp hz
    have ht₀_norm : ‖(sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht₀_ball
    refine ⟨ht₀_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.1
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.2
  have h_impact_holo : ∀ k : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k) (horizStrip h_sl) := by
    intro k
    have h_pair_diff :
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
          (horizStrip h_sl) :=
      (differentiableOn_id.add (differentiableOn_const _)).prodMk (differentiableOn_const _)
    exact S.𝔰_holo.comp h_pair_diff (h_pair_maps k)
  have h_impact_maps : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h_sl,
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N k z ∈ horizStrip S.H := fun k z hz =>
    S.𝔰_maps_to _ (h_pair_maps k hz)

      have h3 : 0 ≤ (2 * C_star + Real.log 4) / (2 * b) := by positivity
      have h4 : 0 ≤ (Real.log 4 + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi + (P.N : ℝ) + 1) / b := by
        positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    have h_σ₃_pos : 0 < 1 + M ^ σ₃ := by
      linarith [Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos σ₃]
    have h_num : 1 + 9 * (b * G) ≤ (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star * (1 + M ^ σ₃) := by
      have h1 : 1 + 9 * (b * G) ≤ (1 + 9 * b) * G := by linarith [hG_ge_one]
      have h2 : (1 + 9 * b) * G ≤ (1 + 9 * b) * (ε_star * M ^ σ₃) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG_le_eps_σ₃ (by positivity)
      have h3 : (1 + 9 * b) * (ε_star * M ^ σ₃) ≤ (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star * (1 + M ^ σ₃) := by
        have : 0 ≤ (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star := by positivity
        linarith
      exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 h3)
    have h_div : C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * (b * G)) / (1 + M ^ σ₃) ≤ C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ h_σ₃_pos]
      calc
        C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * (b * G)) ≤ C_ℓ * ((1 + 9 * b) * ε_star * (1 + M ^ σ₃)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_num hC_ℓ_gt.le
        _ = C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star * (1 + M ^ σ₃) := by ring
    calc
      (P.N : ℝ) * (C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * (b * G)) / (1 + M ^ σ₃))
          ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * (C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * b) * ε_star) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_div hN_pos.le
      _ = ((3 * (P.N : ℝ) * C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * b)) * ε_star) / 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ δ / 3 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by norm_num)
  let E_ang : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
        r_star < ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ∨
        r_star < |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om m))‖|}
  let E_mart : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      M ^ (1 + η - γ) <
        (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ) ∨
      ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
        (∃ ι : Fin 2,
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * (b * G)) <
            ‖sliceModPosMart S P (b * G) r_star j ι (walkPos ρ om) m‖) ∨
        Real.exp (-(b * G) / 3) <
          ‖sliceTinySupMart S P (b * G) r_star j (walkPos ρ om) m‖}
  let E_chord : Fin P.N → Set WalkSpace := fun j =>
    {om : WalkSpace |
      ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ 9 * (b * G)) ∧
        Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om m)‖ < -M ^ σ₃}
  have hE_ang_le : walkMeasure.real E_ang ≤ δ / 3 := hM₁ M hM₁_le ρ hAdm
  have hE_mart_le : walkMeasure.real E_mart ≤ δ / 3 := hM₂ M hM₂_le ρ hAdm
  have hσ₃_ge_one : 1 ≤ M ^ σ₃ := Real.one_le_rpow hM_ge_one (by dsimp [σ₃]; linarith)
  have hE_chord_union_le :
      walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j) ≤ δ / 3 := by
    calc
      walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j)
          ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), walkMeasure.real (E_chord j) :=
            MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            (C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * (b * G)) / (1 + M ^ σ₃)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
          refine le_trans (hC_ℓ_bound j M (9 * (b * G)) (M ^ σ₃) h_chord_exp_bound.2 hσ₃_ge_one ρ hAdm) ?_
          have h_le_C : C_ℓ_fn j ≤ C_ℓ := Finset.le_sup' C_ℓ_fn hj
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le_C (by linarith [h_chord_exp_bound.2]))
            (by linarith [hσ₃_ge_one])
      _ = (P.N : ℝ) * (C_ℓ * (1 + 9 * (b * G)) / (1 + M ^ σ₃)) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ δ / 3 := h_chord_prob_bound
  have h_target_sub :
      {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
          M ^ σ₀ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m)} ⊆
      ((E_init ∪ E_ang) ∪ E_mart) ∪ (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j) := by
    intro om ⟨m_bad, hm_bad_le, hm_bad_gt⟩
    by_contra h_not_bad
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, not_or, not_exists] at h_not_bad
    rcases h_not_bad with ⟨⟨⟨hom_init, hom_ang⟩, hom_mart⟩, hom_chord⟩
    have hom0_Icc : om 0 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have hom0_Ico : om 0 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        by_contra h_not_Ico
        exact hom_init h_not_Ico
      exact Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hom0_Ico
    have h_not_ang : ∀ n ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ r_star ∧
        |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om n))‖| ≤ r_star := by
      intro n hn j
      constructor
      · by_contra hgt
        exact hom_ang ⟨n, hn, j, Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge hgt)⟩
      · by_contra hgt
        exact hom_ang ⟨n, hn, j, Or.inr (lt_of_not_ge hgt)⟩
    have h_sw_le :
        (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ) ≤
          M ^ (1 + η - γ) := by
      by_contra hgt
      exact hom_mart (Or.inl (lt_of_not_ge hgt))
    have h_not_mart : ∀ n ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        (∀ ι : Fin 2,
          ‖sliceModPosMart S P (b * G) r_star j ι (walkPos ρ om) n‖ ≤
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * (b * G))) ∧
        ‖sliceTinySupMart S P (b * G) r_star j (walkPos ρ om) n‖ ≤
          Real.exp (-(b * G) / 3) := by
      intro n hn j
      constructor
      · intro ι
        by_contra hgt
        exact hom_mart (Or.inr ⟨n, hn, j, Or.inl ⟨ι, lt_of_not_ge hgt⟩⟩)
      · by_contra hgt
        exact hom_mart (Or.inr ⟨n, hn, j, Or.inr (lt_of_not_ge hgt)⟩)
    have h_step_bounds : ∀ n ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n ≤ Real.exp (8 * (b * G)) ∧
        ∀ j : Fin P.N, Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ 9 * (b * G) := by
      intro n hn
      have h_abel :=
        deterministic_abel_position_reconstruction S P (b * G) r_star C_X0 n (walkPos ρ om)
          (by positivity) hr_star_ge_one hC_X0_ge
          (fun l _ => (hBase.walk_in_reg M ρ hAdm om l).1)
          (fun j => hC_X0_bound (om 0) hom0_Icc j)
          (fun l hl j => h_not_ang l (le_trans hl hn) j)
          (fun l hl j => h_not_mart l (le_trans hl hn) j)
          h_absorb
      have h_sw_mono :
          sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n ≤
            sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.range_mono hn))
      have h_sw_n_le :
          (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n : ℝ) ≤ M ^ (1 + η - γ) :=
        le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr h_sw_mono) h_sw_le
      have h_mult_le :
          (1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) ≤
            Real.exp (C_star * r_star) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_log (by linarith : 0 < 1 + 6 * P.C_rec), ← Real.exp_add]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        dsimp [C_star]
        nlinarith [hlog_Crec_pos, hr_star_ge_one]
      have h_pow_le :
          ((1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star)) ^
              (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n + 1) ≤
            Real.exp ((M ^ (1 + η - γ) + 1) * (C_star * r_star)) := by
        calc
          ((1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star)) ^
              (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n + 1)
              ≤ (Real.exp (C_star * r_star)) ^
                  (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n + 1) :=
                pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_mult_le _
          _ = Real.exp (((sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
                (C_star * r_star)) :=
              (Real.exp_nat_mul _ _).symm
          _ ≤ Real.exp ((M ^ (1 + η - γ) + 1) * (C_star * r_star)) := by
              apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
              push_cast
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have h_max_eq : max (1 + C_X0) (4 * Real.exp (6 * (b * G))) =
          Real.exp (Real.log 4 + 6 * (b * G)) := by
        rw [max_eq_right h_init_le_base, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
      have hR_le : sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n ≤ Real.exp (8 * (b * G)) := by
        calc
          sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n
              ≤ ((1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star)) ^
                  (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * G) (walkPos ρ om) n + 1) *
                max (1 + C_X0) (4 * Real.exp (6 * (b * G))) := h_abel
          _ ≤ Real.exp ((M ^ (1 + η - γ) + 1) * (C_star * r_star)) *
                Real.exp (Real.log 4 + 6 * (b * G)) := by
              rw [h_max_eq]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pow_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = Real.exp ((M ^ (1 + η - γ) + 1) * (C_star * r_star) + Real.log 4 + 6 * (b * G)) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
          _ ≤ Real.exp (8 * (b * G)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_pos_exp_bound
      refine ⟨hR_le, ?_⟩
      intro j
      have hy_n : walkPos ρ om n ∈ Ω_reg := (hBase.walk_in_reg M ρ hAdm om n).1
      have h_sup_ang :
          Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) ≤ r_star :=
        Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun k _ => (h_not_ang n hn k).1
      have h_theta :
          ‖P.θ_seq j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤
            (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi + (P.N : ℝ) * r_star := by
        refine le_trans (hStrip.odd_cycle_theta_bound _ hy_n j) ?_
        nlinarith [hN_pos]
      have h_sup_pos_le :
          1 + Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) ≤
            sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n := by
        dsimp [sliceRunningPosMax]
        have hn_mem : n ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
        linarith [Finset.le_sup'
          (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖) hn_mem]
      have h_chord_norm : ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ Real.exp (9 * (b * G)) := by
        calc
          ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om n)‖
              ≤ 4 * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ *
                  (1 + Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
                    (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖)) :=
                hStrip.chord_upper_bound _ hy_n j
          _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log 4) *
                Real.exp ((2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi + (P.N : ℝ) * r_star) *
                Real.exp (8 * (b * G)) := by
              rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
              have h_t1 :
                  4 * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤
                    4 * Real.exp ((2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi + (P.N : ℝ) * r_star) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_theta) (by norm_num)
              have h_sup_pos_nonneg :
                  0 ≤ 1 + Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
                    (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) := by
                obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ :=
                  (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).Nonempty)
                have hk₀_le := Finset.le_sup'
                  (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) hk₀
                linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N k₀.val (walkPos ρ om n))]
              exact mul_le_mul h_t1 (le_trans h_sup_pos_le hR_le) h_sup_pos_nonneg (by positivity)
          _ = Real.exp (Real.log 4 + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
                (P.N : ℝ) * r_star + 8 * (b * G)) := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
          _ ≤ Real.exp (9 * (b * G)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_chord_exp_bound.1
      have h_chord_pos : 0 < ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om n)‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_chord_ne_zero _ hy_n j)
      simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log h_chord_pos h_chord_norm
    have h_cost_le : sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m_bad) ≤ M ^ σ₀ := by
      dsimp [sliceGeomCost]
      refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun j _ => ?_
      have h_ang_j := h_not_ang m_bad hm_bad_le j
      have h_step_m := h_step_bounds m_bad hm_bad_le
      have h_pos_j :
          Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖) ≤ 8 * (b * G) := by
        have hm_mem : m_bad ∈ Finset.range (m_bad + 1) :=
          Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m_bad)
        have h1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖ ≤
            Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖) :=
          Finset.le_sup' (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖)
            (Finset.mem_univ j)
        have h2 : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖) ≤
            (Finset.range (m_bad + 1)).sup'
              ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ m_bad)⟩
              (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
                fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖) :=
          Finset.le_sup'
            (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
              fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖) hm_mem
        have h_le_R : 1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖ ≤ Real.exp (8 * (b * G)) :=
          le_trans (by dsimp [sliceRunningPosMax]; linarith) h_step_m.1
        simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h_le_R
      have h_chord_lower : -M ^ σ₃ ≤ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖ := by
        by_contra hlt
        have h_mem_chord : om ∈ E_chord j :=
          ⟨m_bad, hm_bad_le,
            fun l hl => (h_step_bounds l (le_trans hl.le hm_bad_le)).2 j,
            lt_of_not_ge hlt⟩
        exact hom_chord j (Finset.mem_univ j) h_mem_chord
      have h_chord_abs :
          |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖| ≤ max (9 * (b * G)) (M ^ σ₃) := by
        refine abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · linarith [le_max_right (9 * (b * G)) (M ^ σ₃)]
        · exact le_trans (h_step_m.2 j) (le_max_left _ _)
      have h_q1 : r_star ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ := by
        nlinarith [hr_star_le_eps_σ₀, hε_le_quarter, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos σ₀]
      have h_q2 : 8 * (b * G) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ := by
        dsimp [b]
        nlinarith [hG_le_eps_σ₀, hε_le_quarter, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos σ₀]
      have h_q4 : max (9 * (b * G)) (M ^ σ₃) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ := by
        refine max_le ?_ ?_
        · dsimp [b]
          nlinarith [hG_le_eps_σ₀, hε_le_quarter, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos σ₀]
        · nlinarith [hσ₃_le_eps_σ₀, hε_le_quarter, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos σ₀]
      calc
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖ +
            Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖) +
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om m_bad))‖| +
            |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖|
            ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ +
                (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * M ^ σ₀ :=
              add_le_add
                (add_le_add
                  (add_le_add (le_trans h_ang_j.1 h_q1) (le_trans h_pos_j h_q2))
                  (le_trans h_ang_j.2 h_q1))
                (le_trans h_chord_abs h_q4)
        _ = M ^ σ₀ := by ring
    exact not_lt_of_ge h_cost_le hm_bad_gt
  calc
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
          M ^ σ₀ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m)}
        ≤ walkMeasure.real
            (((E_init ∪ E_ang) ∪ E_mart) ∪
              (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_target_sub
    _ ≤ walkMeasure.real ((E_init ∪ E_ang) ∪ E_mart) +
          walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j) :=
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (walkMeasure.real (E_init ∪ E_ang) + walkMeasure.real E_mart) +
          walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j) :=
        add_le_add (MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (E_init ∪ E_ang) E_mart) le_rfl
    _ ≤ ((walkMeasure.real E_init + walkMeasure.real E_ang) + walkMeasure.real E_mart) +
          walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_chord j) :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add (MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le E_init E_ang) le_rfl) le_rfl
    _ ≤ ((0 + δ / 3) + δ / 3) + δ / 3 := by
        rw [hE_init_zero]
        exact add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add le_rfl hE_ang_le) hE_mart_le) hE_chord_union_le
    _ = δ := by ring

structure StripAngleAndAmplitudeData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) : Prop where
  speed_amp_cap : ∃ C_f : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
    ‖S.f s‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0))
  odd_cycle_theta_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
      (P.N : ℝ) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖)
  odd_cycle_d0_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    ‖P.d0 j y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
      ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖)
  chord_upper_bound : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,

stopped_geometry_exponent_bootstrap.definitions:
noncomputable def slicePhaseDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sliceHeight S P.N - |y.im|

noncomputable def bootRunningPosMax (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 + (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ fun l =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun k : Fin P.N =>
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖

noncomputable def bootEps0 (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 - σ) / 4

noncomputable def bootGapEta (N : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  bootEps0 σ / (3 * ((N : ℝ) + 2))

noncomputable def bootGapXi (N : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (ν : Fin (N + 1)) : ℝ :=
  σ + bootEps0 σ / 3 + (2 * (ν.val : ℝ) + 1) * bootGapEta N σ

subgoal_signatures.name: late_stopped_angle_and_support_martingale_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (M H₀ B_geom B_clk η_ang lam : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hAdm : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ)
    (hH₀_le : H₀ ≤ M) (hB_geom : 0 ≤ B_geom) (hB_clk : 0 < B_clk)
    (hη : 0 < η_ang) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        ((slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om l))⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om l)) ^ 2 ≤ B_clk) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om ≤ n → n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om →
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ B_geom ∧
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) *
            ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ η_ang) ∧
      ¬ (∀ m : ℕ, sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om ≤ m → m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om →
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om))‖ ≤ lam ∧
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om) m,
            ((bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)))‖ ≤ lam)} ≤
    8 * (P.N : ℝ) * ((1 + 4 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom)) * η_ang ^ 2 +
      Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) * B_clk / lam ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk) :

subgoal_signatures.name: pigeonhole_jacobi_angle_deriv_suppression
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (C_inv σ : ℝ) (hC_inv : 0 < C_inv) (hσ_pos : 0 < σ) (hσ_lt : σ < 1) :
    ∃ M_sup : ℝ, 2 ≤ M_sup ∧
      ∀ M : ℝ, M_sup ≤ M →
        ∀ (y : ℂ) (K_vec : Fin P.N → ℝ),
          y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all →
          M ^ (σ + bootEps0 σ) ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty K_vec →
          sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ M ^ σ →
          (∀ j : Fin P.N, K_vec j - 4 * Real.log M ≤ sliceLogDepth S P j y) →
          (∀ (ν : Fin (P.N + 1)) (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
            (∀ i ∈ I, K_vec i ≤ M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ / 4)) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F y = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N,
                ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ / 2))) →
          ∀ j : Fin P.N,
            slicePhaseDepth S P y * ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(1 / 32 : ℝ) * M ^ (σ + bootEps0 σ / 3))

subgoal_signatures.name: slice_late_freezing_and_chord_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    (∀ j : Fin P.N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.ℓ_slice j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, P.ℓ_slice j y ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ≤ C₀)) ∧
    (∃ C_lat C_exp : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_lat ∧ 1 ≤ C_exp ∧
      ∀ (B_init lam : ℝ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (a b : ℕ),
        1 ≤ B_init → 0 < lam → lam ≤ Real.exp (-C_exp * B_init) → a ≤ b →
        (∀ m ≤ b, y_seq m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) →
        (∀ m ≤ a, sliceGeomCost S P (y_seq m) ≤ B_init) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, a ≤ m → m ≤ b → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq a)‖ ≤ lam) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, a ≤ m → m ≤ b → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a m,
            ((bootRunningPosMax S P y_seq n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1)) -
                sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)))‖ ≤ lam) →
        ∀ m ≤ b, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖ +
            Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖) +
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (y_seq m))‖| ≤ C_lat * B_init ∧
          Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y_seq m)‖ ≤ C_lat * B_init)

        ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) 4,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),

                stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u) ≤
            C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)

        ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |h x| ≤ B := by
      intro h hh_cont hh_per

        (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) hh_cont.continuousOn
      refine ⟨max C₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => ?_⟩

        K ^ (7 : ℕ) := by
      have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK_tail_le (pow_nonneg hK_nn 6)
      have hr : K * K ^ (6 : ℕ) = K ^ (7 : ℕ) := by ring
      linarith only [h, hr]
    have h_le_pow : 4 * A.C_glob ^ (2 : ℕ) * K ^ (6 : ℕ) ≤
        (K / 20) ^ (7 : ℕ) / ((7 : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) := by
      rw [div_pow, div_div]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith only [h_mulK6])
    have h_le_exp : 4 * A.C_glob ^ (2 : ℕ) * K ^ (6 : ℕ) ≤ Real.exp (K / 20) :=
      le_trans h_le_pow h_fac
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (K / 20) := Real.exp_pos _
    calc (4 * A.C_glob ^ (2 : ℕ) * K ^ (6 : ℕ)) * Real.exp (-K / 20)
        = (4 * A.C_glob ^ (2 : ℕ) * K ^ (6 : ℕ)) * (Real.exp (K / 20))⁻¹ := by
          rw [neg_div, Real.exp_neg]
      _ ≤ Real.exp (K / 20) * (Real.exp (K / 20))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le_exp (inv_nonneg.mpr hexp_pos.le)
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hexp_pos.ne'
  have hDef_v : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S v x) -
          truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2) ≤
      A.C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) :=
    (A.small_moment_row_l2 K hK_amp_le hSmall v hv_band).2.2.2
  have hDef_vs : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S (v + s) x) -
          truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S (v + s) x)) ^ 2) ≤
      A.C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) :=
    (A.small_moment_row_l2 K hK_amp_le hSmall (v + s) hvs_band).2.2.2
  have hOne_le_K50 : 1 ≤ K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow (by linarith only [hK200]) (by norm_num)
  have hC_amp_le_cube : A.C_amp ≤ A.C_amp ^ (3 : ℕ) := by
    nlinarith only [hC_amp_ge1, sq_nonneg (A.C_amp - 1)]
  have hOne_le_cube : 1 ≤ A.C_amp ^ (3 : ℕ) := le_trans hC_amp_ge1 hC_amp_le_cube
  have hOne_le_CK : 1 ≤ A.C_amp ^ (3 : ℕ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith only [hOne_le_cube, hOne_le_K50]
  have hCK_le_cube : A.C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ A.C_amp ^ (3 : ℕ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_amp_le_cube hK50_nn
  change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        ∫ u : ℝ,
          (truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
            truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2 * κ u) ≤
      C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)
  rw [hB_mod_def] at hIntMK_le
  rw [hC_inc_def]
  have hCK_nn : 0 ≤ A.C_amp ^ (3 : ℕ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hK50_nn
  linarith only [hSplit, hDef_vs, hDef_v, hIntMK_le, hTailCrush, hOne_le_CK, hCK_le_cube, hCK_nn]

proof.tactics:
by
  let h₀ : ℝ := K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)
  let R : ℝ := K ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ)
  let q : ℝ := (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K / s
  let M : ℕ := Nat.floor q + 1
  let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K + (m : ℝ) * s
  let O : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), stepOccupDensity S ε h₀ s x v
  let stepVar : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        ∫ u : ℝ,
          (truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
            truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2 *
          stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u
  let B_chain : ℝ := (25 * (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt C_inc) + 4 * C_inc) * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ)
  
  have hs_lo : 2 ≤ s := hs.1
  have hs_hi : s ≤ 4 := hs.2
  have hs_pos : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ s := by linarith
  have hK_pos : 0 < K := by linarith
  have hK_ge_one : 1 ≤ K := by linarith
  have hh₀_pos : 0 < h₀ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos _
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hK_pos _
  have h4_le_K27 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (27 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    calc (4 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt ((4 : ℝ) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt K := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
      _ ≤ K ^ (27 / 50 : ℝ) := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
          exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by norm_num)
  have h4h₀_le_R : 4 * h₀ ≤ R := by
    calc 4 * h₀ ≤ K ^ (27 / 50 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4_le_K27 (le_of_lt hh₀_pos)
      _ = K ^ ((27 / 50 : ℝ) + (3 / 50 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
      _ = R := by dsimp only [R]; norm_num
  have hh₀_lt_R : h₀ < R := by linarith
  have hR_sub_ge : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R ≤ R - h₀ := by linarith
  have hR_sq_sub : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * R ^ 2 ≤ (R - h₀) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp only [q]
    positivity
  have hqs : q * s = (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K := by
    dsimp only [q]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hs_pos)
  have hq_le : q ≤ (2 / 5 : ℝ) * K := by
    have h1 : q * s ≤ ((2 / 5 : ℝ) * K) * s := by nlinarith [hqs, hs_lo, hK_pos]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h1 hs_pos
  have hfloor_le_q : (Nat.floor q : ℝ) ≤ q := Nat.floor_le hq_nonneg
  have hM_cast : (M : ℝ) = (Nat.floor q : ℝ) + 1 := by
    dsimp only [M]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hM_le_K : (M : ℝ) ≤ K := by linarith
  have hM_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (M : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg M
  have hMs_gt : (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K < (M : ℝ) * s := by
    have hlt : q < (M : ℝ) := by
      rw [hM_cast]
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one q
    nlinarith [hqs, hs_pos, hlt]
  have hMs_le : (M : ℝ) * s ≤ (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K + 4 := by
    have hfl_s : (Nat.floor q : ℝ) * s ≤ (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K := by
      nlinarith [hfloor_le_q, hs_pos, hqs]
    nlinarith [hM_cast, hfl_s, hs_hi]
  have hc0 : c 0 = (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K := by
    dsimp only [c]
    simp
  have hc_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, c (m + 1) = c m + s := by
    intro m
    dsimp only [c]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hcM_gt : (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K < c M := by
    dsimp only [c]
    linarith
  have hcM_le4 : c M ≤ (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K + 4 := by
    dsimp only [c]
    linarith
  have hc_ge_v0 : ∀ m : ℕ, (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K ≤ c m := by
    intro m
    dsimp only [c]
    have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    nlinarith
  have hc_le_hi : ∀ m < M, c m ≤ (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K := by
    intro m hm
    have hm_le : m ≤ Nat.floor q := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hm
    have hm_cast : (m : ℝ) ≤ q := le_trans (Nat.cast_le.mpr hm_le) hfloor_le_q
    have hms : (m : ℝ) * s ≤ (4 / 5 : ℝ) * K := by nlinarith [hm_cast, hs_pos, hqs]
    dsimp only [c]
    linarith
  have h_band_cap : (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K + 4 ≤ (49 / 25 : ℝ) * K := by linarith
  have h_depth_v : ∀ v : ℝ, K ≤ v →
      0 < Real.exp (-(v + s)) ∧
      Real.exp (-(v + s)) < Real.exp (-v) ∧
      Real.exp (-v) < S.H := by
    intro v hv
    have h1 : 0 < Real.exp (-(v + s)) := Real.exp_pos _
    have h2 : Real.exp (-(v + s)) < Real.exp (-v) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have h3 : Real.exp (-v) ≤ Real.exp (-K) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have h4 : Real.exp (-v) < S.H := by linarith [hDepth, S.H_pos]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h4⟩
  
  have h_row_mem : ∀ w : ℝ, Real.exp (-w) < S.H → ∀ x : ℝ,
      upperRowPt S w x ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro w hw x
    change |(upperRowPt S w x).im| < S.H
    simp only [upperRowPt, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
    exact abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-w), S.H_pos], by linarith [Real.exp_pos (-w)]⟩
  have h_row_cont : ∀ w : ℝ, Real.exp (-w) < S.H →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S w x)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hpt_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => upperRowPt S w x) := by
      unfold upperRowPt
      exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hf_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => S.f (upperRowPt S w x)) :=
      S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous hpt_cont (h_row_mem w hw)
    have hmax_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => max ‖S.f (upperRowPt S w x)‖ ε) :=
      hf_cont.norm.max continuous_const
    unfold truncLogSpeed
    exact Continuous.log hmax_cont (fun x => ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hε (le_max_right _ _)))
  have h_row_per : ∀ w : ℝ, Real.exp (-w) < S.H →
      Function.Periodic (fun x : ℝ => truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S w x)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro w hw x
    have hpt_shift : upperRowPt S w (x + 2 * Real.pi) = upperRowPt S w x + 2 * Real.pi := by
      unfold upperRowPt
      push_cast
      ring
    simp only [truncLogSpeed, hpt_shift, S.f_periodic (upperRowPt S w x) (h_row_mem w hw x)]
  
  have hO_nonneg : ∀ v : ℝ, K ≤ v → 0 ≤ O v := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v v hv
    dsimp only [O]
    refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by positivity) ?_)
    intro x _
    unfold stepOccupDensity
    split_ifs
    · refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => ?_)
      exact mul_nonneg (le_min (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
        (le_of_lt (hKern.kernel_pos _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H u))
    · exact le_rfl
  have hStepVar_nonneg : ∀ v : ℝ, K ≤ v → 0 ≤ stepVar v := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v v hv
    dsimp only [stepVar]
    refine mul_nonneg (by positivity) (intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by positivity) ?_)
    intro x _
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun u => ?_)
    exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
      (le_of_lt (hKern.kernel_pos _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H u))
  
  have hK_mul_1_50 : K * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) = K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    calc K * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) = K ^ (1 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ = K ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
      _ = K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have hsqrt_K51 : Real.sqrt (K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)) = K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hK_pos)]
    norm_num
  have hh₀_sq_le : h₀ * h₀ ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    calc h₀ * h₀ = K ^ ((3 / 50 : ℝ) + (3 / 50 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
      _ ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by norm_num)
  have hh₀_R_le : h₀ * R ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    calc h₀ * R = K ^ ((3 / 50 : ℝ) + (3 / 5 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
      _ ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by norm_num)
  have hh₀_K51_le : h₀ * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    calc h₀ * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ) = K ^ ((3 / 50 : ℝ) + (51 / 100 : ℝ)) :=
          (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
      _ ≤ K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hK_ge_one (by norm_num)
  have hK_post_eq : K * h₀ ^ 2 * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) = K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2 := by
    have hR2 : R ^ 2 = K ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := by
      calc R ^ 2 = K ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 5 : ℝ) := sq R
        _ = K ^ ((3 / 5 : ℝ) + (3 / 5 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
        _ = K ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    have hh₀2 : h₀ ^ 2 = K ^ (6 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      calc h₀ ^ 2 = K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) := sq h₀
        _ = K ^ ((3 / 50 : ℝ) + (3 / 50 : ℝ)) := (Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _).symm
        _ = K ^ (6 / 50 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    calc K * h₀ ^ 2 * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)
        = K ^ (1 : ℝ) * K ^ (6 / 50 : ℝ) * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_one, hh₀2]
      _ = K ^ ((1 : ℝ) + (6 / 50 : ℝ) + (51 / 50 : ℝ)) := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hK_pos, ← Real.rpow_add hK_pos]
      _ = K ^ ((47 / 50 : ℝ) + (6 / 5 : ℝ)) := by norm_num
      _ = K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * K ^ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_add hK_pos _ _
      _ = K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2 := by rw [hR2]
  
  have h_chain_bound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s,
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m)) ≤ B_chain := by
    intro t ht
    let g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m x => truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (t + c m) x)
    let κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m u =>
      stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(t + c m + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-(t + c m))) u
    have htc : ∀ m : ℕ, t + c (m + 1) = t + c m + s := by
      intro m
      rw [hc_succ m, ← add_assoc]
    have hK_le_tc : ∀ m : ℕ, K ≤ t + c m := by
      intro m
      linarith [ht.1, hc_ge_v0 m]
    have h_tan := hTanaka M h₀ R g κ hh₀_pos hh₀_lt_R
      (fun m _ => h_row_cont (t + c m) (h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)).2.2)
      (fun m _ => h_row_per (t + c m) (h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)).2.2)
      (fun m _ => by
        obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)
        exact hKern.kernel_cont _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H)
      (fun m _ u => by
        obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)
        exact le_of_lt (hKern.kernel_pos _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H u))
      (fun m _ => by
        obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)
        exact hKern.kernel_integrable _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H)
      (fun m _ => by
        obtain ⟨hd'0, hd'_lt_d, hd_lt_H⟩ := h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)
        exact hKern.kernel_integral_one _ _ hd'0 hd'_lt_d hd_lt_H)
      (fun m _ x => by
        dsimp only [g, κ]
        rw [htc m]
        exact hKern.trunc_submean ε (t + c m) (t + c m + s) x hε (by linarith)
          (h_depth_v (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m)).2.2)
    have h_lhs_eq : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m)) =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (if |g m x| ≤ h₀ then
              ∫ u : ℝ, min ((g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2) (h₀ ^ 2) * κ m u
            else 0) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [O, stepOccupDensity, g, κ]
      simp only [htc m]
    let V : ℝ := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, stepVar (t + c m)
    have hV_eq : V =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u) := by
      dsimp only [V]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
      dsimp only [stepVar, g, κ]
      simp only [htc m]
    rw [← h_lhs_eq, ← hV_eq] at h_tan
    have hV_nonneg : 0 ≤ V :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => hStepVar_nonneg (t + c m) (hK_le_tc m))
    have hV_le : V ≤ C_inc * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      have h_sum_le : V ≤ ∑ _m ∈ Finset.range M, (C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m hm => ?_)
        have hm_lt : m < M := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
        have h_mem_band : t + c m ∈ Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((49 / 25 : ℝ) * K) := by
          refine ⟨by linarith [ht.1, hc_ge_v0 m], ?_⟩
          linarith [ht.2, hs_hi, hc_le_hi m hm_lt, h_band_cap]
        exact hStep (t + c m) h_mem_band
      have h_const_sum : (∑ _m ∈ Finset.range M, (C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ))) =
          (M : ℝ) * (C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      have h_step_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hC) (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) _)
      calc V ≤ (M : ℝ) * (C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by linarith [h_sum_le, h_const_sum]
        _ ≤ K * (C_inc * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_le_K h_step_nonneg
        _ = C_inc * (K * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = C_inc * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ) := by rw [hK_mul_1_50]
    have hsqrt_V_le : Real.sqrt V ≤ Real.sqrt C_inc * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      calc Real.sqrt V ≤ Real.sqrt (C_inc * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hV_le
        _ = Real.sqrt C_inc * Real.sqrt (K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hC) _
        _ = Real.sqrt C_inc * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ) := by rw [hsqrt_K51]
    have hh₀_sqrtV_le : h₀ * Real.sqrt V ≤ Real.sqrt C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      calc h₀ * Real.sqrt V ≤ h₀ * (Real.sqrt C_inc * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt_V_le (le_of_lt hh₀_pos)
        _ = Real.sqrt C_inc * (h₀ * K ^ (51 / 100 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh₀_K51_le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have h_term1 : 25 * h₀ * (h₀ + 2 * R + 2 * Real.sqrt V) ≤
        25 * (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt C_inc) * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      have hexp : 25 * h₀ * (h₀ + 2 * R + 2 * Real.sqrt V) =
          25 * (h₀ * h₀ + 2 * (h₀ * R) + 2 * (h₀ * Real.sqrt V)) := by ring
      linarith [hexp, hh₀_sq_le, hh₀_R_le, hh₀_sqrtV_le]
    have h_term2 : (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V / (R - h₀) ^ 2 ≤
        4 * C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      have hnum_nonneg : 0 ≤ (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM_nonneg (sq_nonneg h₀)) hV_nonneg
      have hR2_pos : 0 < R ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hR_pos
      have hnum_le : (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V ≤ C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2 := by
        calc (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V ≤ K * h₀ ^ 2 * V :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_le_K (sq_nonneg h₀)) hV_nonneg
          _ ≤ K * h₀ ^ 2 * (C_inc * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV_le (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hK_pos) (sq_nonneg h₀))
          _ = C_inc * (K * h₀ ^ 2 * K ^ (51 / 50 : ℝ)) := by ring
          _ = C_inc * (K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2) := by rw [hK_post_eq]
          _ = C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2 := by ring
      calc (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V / (R - h₀) ^ 2
          ≤ (M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V / ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * R ^ 2) :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum_nonneg (by positivity) hR_sq_sub
        _ = (4 * ((M : ℝ) * h₀ ^ 2 * V)) * (R ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ ≤ (4 * (C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) * R ^ 2)) * (R ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hnum_le]) (by positivity)
        _ = (4 * C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ)) * R ^ 2 / R ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 4 * C_inc * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) :=
            mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt hR2_pos)
    dsimp only [B_chain]
    linarith [h_tan, h_term1, h_term2]
  
  have hO_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K + 8 →
      IntervalIntegrable O MeasureTheory.volume a b := by
    intro a b ha hab hb
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Icc_of_le hab]
    exact hInt.mono_set (fun v hv => ⟨le_trans ha hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hb⟩)
  have hO_int_adj : ∀ m < M,
      IntervalIntegrable O MeasureTheory.volume (c m) (c (m + 1)) := by
    intro m hm
    rw [hc_succ m]
    exact hO_int (c m) (c m + s) (hc_ge_v0 m) (by linarith) (by linarith [hc_le_hi m hm, hs_hi])
  have hO_int_shift : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range M,
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => O (t + c m)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 s := by
    intro m hm
    have hm_lt : m < M := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
    have hint_cm : IntervalIntegrable O MeasureTheory.volume (c m) (c m + s) :=
      hO_int (c m) (c m + s) (hc_ge_v0 m) (by linarith) (by linarith [hc_le_hi m hm_lt, hs_hi])
    have hcomp := hint_cm.comp_add_right (c m)
    simpa only [sub_self, add_sub_cancel_left] using hcomp
  have h_telescope : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m)) =
      ∫ v in ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v := by
    calc (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m))
        = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, O (t + c m) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hO_int_shift
      _ = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ∫ v in (c m)..(c (m + 1)), O v := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right O (c m), zero_add, add_comm s (c m),
            ← hc_succ m]
      _ = ∫ v in (c 0)..(c M), O v :=
          intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals hO_int_adj
      _ = ∫ v in ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v := by rw [hc0]
  have h_sum_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m))
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 s := by
    have h_fn_eq : (fun t : ℝ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m)) =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, fun t : ℝ => O (t + c m) := by
      ext t
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [h_fn_eq]
    exact IntervalIntegrable.sum (Finset.range M) (fun m hm => hO_int_shift m hm)
  have hB_chain_nonneg : 0 ≤ B_chain := by
    dsimp only [B_chain]
    positivity
  have h_int_cM_le : (∫ v in ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v) ≤
      (100 * (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt C_inc) + 16 * C_inc) * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← h_telescope]
    have hmono : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, O (t + c m)) ≤
        ∫ _t in (0 : ℝ)..s, B_chain :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hs_nonneg h_sum_int intervalIntegrable_const h_chain_bound
    have hconst : (∫ _t in (0 : ℝ)..s, B_chain) = s * B_chain := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero]
    have hsB : s * B_chain ≤ 4 * B_chain :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs_hi hB_chain_nonneg
    have h4B : 4 * B_chain =
        (100 * (3 + 2 * Real.sqrt C_inc) + 16 * C_inc) * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ) := by
      dsimp only [B_chain]
      ring
    linarith [hmono, hconst, hsB, h4B]
  have h_split : (∫ v in ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K), O v) +
      (∫ v in ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v) =
      ∫ v in ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals ?_ ?_
    · exact hO_int ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K) le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · exact hO_int ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K) (c M) (by linarith) (le_of_lt hcM_gt)
        (by linarith [hcM_le4])
  have h_tail_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ v in ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K)..(c M), O v := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (le_of_lt hcM_gt) (fun v hv => ?_)
    exact hO_nonneg v (by linarith [hv.1])
  linarith [h_int_cM_le, h_split, h_tail_nonneg]
