signature.name: adaptive_step_topological_admissibility
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    AdaptiveStepTopPackage S P

proof.tactics:
by
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h \ P.Z_all
  let F_closed : Set ℂ := sliceRegClosedComp S P
  have hF_eq : F_closed = Ω_regᶜ := rfl
  have hF_closed : IsClosed F_closed := P.reg_open.isClosed_compl
  have hF_ne : F_closed.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨(h : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_⟩
    rw [hF_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff]
    intro hz
    have him : ((h : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = h := by simp
    have hlt : |((h : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < h := hz.1
    rw [him] at hlt
    exact not_lt_of_ge (le_abs_self h) hlt
  have hSing_cont : Continuous (sliceSingDist S P) :=
    Metric.continuous_infDist_pt F_closed
  have hSing_nonneg : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ sliceSingDist S P y :=
    fun y => Metric.infDist_nonneg
  have hSing_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∉ Ω_reg → sliceSingDist S P y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem (show y ∈ F_closed from hy)
  have hSing_pos_iff : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 < sliceSingDist S P y ↔ y ∈ Ω_reg := by
    intro y
    have h1 := hF_closed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos (x := y) hF_ne
    simp only [hF_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hSing_per : ∀ y : ℂ, sliceSingDist S P (y + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceSingDist S P y := by
    intro y
    let τ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => w + (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)
    have h_iso : Isometry τ := isometry_add_right ((2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ))
    have h_inv : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ F_closed ↔ τ w ∈ F_closed := by
      intro w
      change ¬ (|w.im| < h ∧ w ∉ P.Z_all) ↔ ¬ (|(τ w).im| < h ∧ τ w ∉ P.Z_all)
      have him : (τ w).im = w.im := by simp [τ]
      have hZ : w ∈ P.Z_all ↔ τ w ∈ P.Z_all := P.Z_all_periodic w
      rw [him, ← hZ]
    have h_img : τ '' F_closed = F_closed := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact (h_inv w).mp hw
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨z - (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ), ?_, sub_add_cancel z _⟩
        exact (h_inv _).mpr (by simpa only [τ, sub_add_cancel] using hz)
    have key := Metric.infDist_image (t := F_closed) (x := y) h_iso
    rw [h_img] at key
    exact key
  have hSafe_sub : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y) ⊆ Ω_reg := by
    intro y hy ζ hζ
    have hd_pos : 0 < sliceSingDist S P y := (hSing_pos_iff y).mpr hy
    have hr_lt : sliceSafeBallRad S P y < sliceSingDist S P y := by
      unfold sliceSafeBallRad
      have hmin : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    have hζ_ball : ζ ∈ Metric.ball y (sliceSingDist S P y) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr_lt hζ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] at hζ_ball
    by_contra hζ_not
    have h_le : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ :=
      Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (show ζ ∈ F_closed from hζ_not)
    linarith
  have hr_cont : Continuous (sliceSafeBallRad S P) := by
    unfold sliceSafeBallRad
    exact continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.min hSing_cont)
  have hr_nonneg : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ sliceSafeBallRad S P y := by
    intro y
    unfold sliceSafeBallRad
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (le_min zero_le_one (hSing_nonneg y))
  have hTerm_nonneg : ∀ (k : Fin P.N) (ζ : ℂ), 0 ≤ sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ := by
    intro k ζ
    unfold sliceLocalSupTerm
    positivity
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 P.N
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hTube_mem : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip h,
      (ζ + (m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro m ζ hζ
    rcases abs_lt.mp (show |ζ.im| < h from hζ) with ⟨h_neg, h_pos⟩
    refine ⟨ht₀_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [Complex.conj_ofReal]
      exact h_neg
    · simp
      exact h_pos
  have hImpact_maps : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip h,
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N m ζ ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro m ζ hζ
    exact S.𝔰_maps_to _ (hTube_mem m ζ hζ)
  have hImpact_cont : ∀ (m : ℤ), ContinuousOn (sliceImpactSeq S P.N m) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro m
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun ζ => (ζ + (m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ :=
      (continuous_id.add continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const
    exact S.𝔰_holo.continuousOn.comp hΦ_cont.continuousOn (fun ζ hζ => hTube_mem m ζ hζ)
  have hSpeed_cont : ∀ (m : ℤ), ContinuousOn (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N m) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro m
    exact S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp (hImpact_cont m) (fun ζ hζ => hImpact_maps m ζ hζ)
  have hAngle_cont : ∀ (m : ℤ), ContinuousOn (sliceAngleSeq S P.N m) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro m
    exact S.ϕ_holo.continuousOn.comp (hImpact_cont m) (fun ζ hζ => hImpact_maps m ζ hζ)
  have hNormPowInv_cont : ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ), ContinuousOn g Ω_reg → (∀ ζ ∈ Ω_reg, g ζ ≠ 0) →
      ContinuousOn (fun ζ => ‖g ζ‖ ^ 6) Ω_reg ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun ζ => (‖g ζ‖ ^ 6)⁻¹) Ω_reg := by
    intro g hg hg_ne
    have h_pow : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => ‖g ζ‖ ^ 6) Ω_reg :=
      (continuous_norm.continuousOn.comp hg (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)).pow 6
    refine ⟨h_pow, h_pow.inv₀ ?_⟩
    intro ζ hζ
    exact pow_ne_zero 6 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hg_ne ζ hζ))
  have hTerm_contOn : ∀ (k : Fin P.N), ContinuousOn (sliceLocalSupTerm S P k) Ω_reg := by
    intro k
    have h_sp0 : ContinuousOn (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val) Ω_reg :=
      (hSpeed_cont k.val).mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_sp1 : ContinuousOn (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1)) Ω_reg :=
      (hSpeed_cont ((k.val : ℤ) + 1)).mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_ang : ContinuousOn (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val) Ω_reg :=
      (hAngle_cont k.val).mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_theta : ContinuousOn (P.θ_seq k.val) Ω_reg :=
      (P.θ_holo k.val).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_d0 : ContinuousOn (P.d0 k) Ω_reg := h_theta.sub h_ang
    have h_sin : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => Complex.sin (P.d0 k ζ)) Ω_reg :=
      Complex.continuous_sin.continuousOn.comp h_d0 (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    have h_lnum : ContinuousOn (P.ℓ_num k) Ω_reg :=
      (P.ℓ_num_holo k).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_ell : ContinuousOn (P.ℓ_slice k) Ω_reg := by
      refine h_lnum.div (h_sp0.mul h_sp1) ?_
      intro ζ hζ h_den
      apply P.reg_chord_ne_zero ζ hζ k
      change P.ℓ_slice k ζ = 0
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice
      rw [h_den, div_zero]
    rcases hNormPowInv_cont _ h_sp0 (fun ζ hζ => P.reg_speed_ne_zero ζ hζ k) with ⟨hc1, hc2⟩
    rcases hNormPowInv_cont _ h_sin (fun ζ hζ => P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero ζ hζ k) with ⟨hc4, hc5⟩
    rcases hNormPowInv_cont _ h_ell (fun ζ hζ => P.reg_chord_ne_zero ζ hζ k) with ⟨hc6, hc7⟩
    have hc3 : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => Real.exp (6 * |(sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ).im|)) Ω_reg := by
      have him : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ).im) Ω_reg :=
        Complex.continuous_im.continuousOn.comp h_ang (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      have habs : ContinuousOn (fun ζ => |(sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ).im|) Ω_reg :=
        continuous_abs.continuousOn.comp him (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      exact Real.continuous_exp.continuousOn.comp
        (continuousOn_const.mul habs) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    exact (((((hc1.add hc2).add hc3).add hc4).add hc5).add hc6).add hc7
  have hImpact_qper : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip h,
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N m (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceImpactSeq S P.N m ζ + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro m ζ hζ
    unfold sliceImpactSeq
    have h_arg : ζ + 2 * Real.pi + (m : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) =
        (ζ + (m : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    rw [h_arg]
    exact S.𝔰_quasiperiodic _ (hTube_mem m ζ hζ)
  have hTerm_per : ∀ (k : Fin P.N), ∀ ζ ∈ horizStrip h,
      sliceLocalSupTerm S P k (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ := by
    intro k ζ hζ
    have h_sp0 : sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceSpeedSeq S P.N k.val ζ := by
      unfold sliceSpeedSeq
      rw [hImpact_qper k.val ζ hζ]
      exact S.f_periodic _ (hImpact_maps k.val ζ hζ)
    have h_sp1 : sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) =
        sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) ζ := by
      unfold sliceSpeedSeq
      rw [hImpact_qper ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) ζ hζ]
      exact S.f_periodic _ (hImpact_maps ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) ζ hζ)
    have h_ang : sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) =
        sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ + 2 * Real.pi := by
      unfold sliceAngleSeq
      rw [hImpact_qper k.val ζ hζ]
      exact S.ϕ_quasiperiodic _ (hImpact_maps k.val ζ hζ)
    have h_ang_im : (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (ζ + 2 * Real.pi)).im =
        (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val ζ).im := by
      rw [h_ang]
      simp
    have h_d0 : P.d0 k (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = P.d0 k ζ := by
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.d0
      rw [P.θ_quasiperiodic k.val ζ hζ, h_ang]
      ring
    have h_ell : P.ℓ_slice k (ζ + 2 * Real.pi) = P.ℓ_slice k ζ := by
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice
      rw [P.ℓ_num_periodic k ζ hζ, h_sp0, h_sp1]
    unfold sliceLocalSupTerm
    rw [h_sp0, h_ang_im, h_d0, h_ell]
  let B₁ : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1
  have hAff_mem_ball : ∀ (y : ℂ), ∀ u ∈ B₁,
      y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u ∈ Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y) := by
    intro y u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hu
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hr_nonneg y)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hr_nonneg y) hu
  have hAff_mem_reg : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ u ∈ B₁,
      y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u ∈ Ω_reg := by
    intro y hy u hu
    exact hSafe_sub y hy (hAff_mem_ball y u hu)
  let M_sup : Fin P.N → ℂ → ℝ := fun k y =>
    sSup ((fun u : ℂ => sliceLocalSupTerm S P k (y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u)) '' B₁)
  have hM_contOn : ∀ k : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (M_sup k) Ω_reg := by
    intro k
    have : CompactSpace ↥B₁ := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)
    let ψ : ↥Ω_reg × ↥B₁ → ℂ := fun p =>
      (p.1 : ℂ) + (sliceSafeBallRad S P (p.1 : ℂ) : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)
    have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ :=
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp
          (hr_cont.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst))).mul
          (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))
    have hψ_mem : ∀ p : ↥Ω_reg × ↥B₁, ψ p ∈ Ω_reg :=
      fun p => hAff_mem_reg p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2.1 p.2.2
    let f : ↥Ω_reg → ↥B₁ → ℝ := fun y u => sliceLocalSupTerm S P k (ψ (y, u))
    have hf_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry f) :=
      (hTerm_contOn k).comp_continuous hψ_cont hψ_mem
    have h_sup_cont : Continuous (fun y : ↥Ω_reg => sSup (f y '' Set.univ)) :=
      isCompact_univ.continuous_sSup hf_cont
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    have h_eq : (Ω_reg.domRestrict (M_sup k)) = (fun y : ↥Ω_reg => sSup (f y '' Set.univ)) := by
      ext y
      let g_y : ℂ → ℝ := fun u =>
        sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ((y : ℂ) + (sliceSafeBallRad S P (y : ℂ) : ℂ) * u)
      have h_fy : f y = g_y ∘ Subtype.val := rfl
      rw [Set.domRestrict_apply, h_fy, Set.image_univ, Set.range_comp, Subtype.range_coe]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_sup_cont
  have hM_le : ∀ (k : Fin P.N), ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
      ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y),
        sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ≤ M_sup k y := by
    intro k y hy ζ hζ
    let r : ℝ := sliceSafeBallRad S P y
    let g_y : ℂ → ℝ := fun u => sliceLocalSupTerm S P k (y + (r : ℂ) * u)
    have hα_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℂ => y + (r : ℂ) * u) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
    have hg_cont : ContinuousOn g_y B₁ :=
      (hTerm_contOn k).comp hα_cont.continuousOn (fun u hu => hAff_mem_reg y hy u hu)
    have h_bdd : BddAbove (g_y '' B₁) :=
      ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1).image_of_continuousOn hg_cont).bddAbove
    have h_mem : sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ∈ g_y '' B₁ := by
      by_cases hr0 : r = 0
      · have hζ_eq : ζ = y := by
          have hr0' : sliceSafeBallRad S P y = 0 := hr0
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hr0'] at hζ
          exact dist_le_zero.mp hζ
        refine ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one, ?_⟩
        simp [g_y, hr0, hζ_eq]
      · have hr_nonneg_y : 0 ≤ r := hr_nonneg y
        have hrc_ne : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr0
        refine ⟨(ζ - y) / (r : ℂ), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_div, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr_nonneg_y, ← dist_eq_norm]
          exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hζ) hr_nonneg_y
        · dsimp only [g_y]
          rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hrc_ne, add_sub_cancel]
    exact le_csSup h_bdd h_mem
  have hM_nonneg : ∀ (k : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ), 0 ≤ M_sup k y := by
    intro k y
    apply Real.sSup_nonneg
    rintro _ ⟨u, _, rfl⟩
    exact hTerm_nonneg k _
  have hDenom_ge_one : ∀ y : ℂ, 1 ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y := by
    intro y
    unfold sliceLocalSupDenom
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin P.N, M_sup k y :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => hM_nonneg k y)
    linarith
  have hSafe_ball_sub_and_le : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ k : Fin P.N,
      ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (sliceSafeBallRad S P y),
        ζ ∈ Ω_reg ∧ sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y := by
    intro y hy k ζ hζ
    refine ⟨hSafe_sub y hy hζ, ?_⟩
    have h1 : sliceLocalSupTerm S P k ζ ≤ M_sup k y := hM_le k y hy ζ hζ
    have h2 : M_sup k y ≤ ∑ j : Fin P.N, M_sup j y :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hM_nonneg j y) (Finset.mem_univ k)
    have h3 : ∑ j : Fin P.N, M_sup j y ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y := by
      unfold sliceLocalSupDenom
      change ∑ j : Fin P.N, M_sup j y ≤ 1 + ∑ j : Fin P.N, M_sup j y
      linarith
    exact le_trans h1 (le_trans h2 h3)
  have hC_pos : ∀ L : ℝ,
      0 < Real.exp (-4 * (max L 2) ^ 7) / (10000 * (1 + S.H + S.c) ^ 3) := by
    intro L
    have hH := S.H_pos
    have hc := S.c_pos
    positivity
  have hC_le : ∀ L : ℝ,
      Real.exp (-4 * (max L 2) ^ 7) / (10000 * (1 + S.H + S.c) ^ 3) ≤ 1 / 100 := by
    intro L
    have hmax : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max L 2 := le_trans (by norm_num) (le_max_right L 2)
    have hexp : Real.exp (-4 * (max L 2) ^ 7) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have hp : 0 ≤ (max L 2) ^ 7 := pow_nonneg hmax 7
      linarith
    have hbase : 1 ≤ 1 + S.H + S.c := by linarith [S.H_pos, S.c_pos]
    have hpow : 1 ≤ (1 + S.H + S.c) ^ 3 := one_le_pow₀ hbase
    have hden_pos : 0 < 10000 * (1 + S.H + S.c) ^ 3 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hden_pos]
    linarith
  have hStep_nonneg : ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : ℂ), 0 ≤ adaptiveStepRadius S P L y := by
    intro L y
    unfold adaptiveStepRadius
    have hC := le_of_lt (hC_pos L)
    have hden : 0 ≤ sliceLocalSupDenom S P y := le_trans zero_le_one (hDenom_ge_one y)
    exact mul_nonneg hC (div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_min zero_le_one (hSing_nonneg y)) 4) hden)
  have hStep_pos_iff : ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : ℂ),
      0 < adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ↔ y ∈ Ω_reg := by
    intro L y
    constructor
    · intro hpos
      by_contra hy
      have h0 : sliceSingDist S P y = 0 := hSing_zero y hy
      unfold adaptiveStepRadius at hpos
      rw [h0, min_eq_right zero_le_one] at hpos
      norm_num at hpos
    · intro hy
      unfold adaptiveStepRadius
      have hd_pos : 0 < min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) :=
        lt_min zero_lt_one ((hSing_pos_iff y).mpr hy)
      have hden_pos : 0 < sliceLocalSupDenom S P y :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hDenom_ge_one y)
      exact mul_pos (hC_pos L) (div_pos (pow_pos hd_pos 4) hden_pos)
  have hStep_le_sing : ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : ℂ),
      adaptiveStepRadius S P L y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) := by
    intro L y
    unfold adaptiveStepRadius
    let d : ℝ := min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := le_min zero_le_one (hSing_nonneg y)
    have hd1 : d ≤ 1 := min_le_left 1 _
    have hd3 : d ^ 3 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hd0 hd1
    have hd4_le_d : d ^ 4 ≤ d := by
      calc d ^ 4 = d ^ 3 * d := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd3 hd0
      _ = d := one_mul d
    have hfrac_le : d ^ 4 / sliceLocalSupDenom S P y ≤ d :=
      le_trans (div_le_self (pow_nonneg hd0 4) (hDenom_ge_one y)) hd4_le_d
    have hfrac_nonneg : 0 ≤ d ^ 4 / sliceLocalSupDenom S P y :=
      div_nonneg (pow_nonneg hd0 4) (le_trans zero_le_one (hDenom_ge_one y))
    exact mul_le_mul (hC_le L) hfrac_le hfrac_nonneg (by norm_num)
  have hStep_per : ∀ (L : ℝ) (y : ℂ),
      adaptiveStepRadius S P L (y + 2 * Real.pi) = adaptiveStepRadius S P L y := by
    intro L y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Ω_reg
    · have hd_eq : sliceSingDist S P (y + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceSingDist S P y := hSing_per y
      have hr_eq : sliceSafeBallRad S P (y + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceSafeBallRad S P y := by
        unfold sliceSafeBallRad
        rw [hd_eq]
      have hDen_eq : sliceLocalSupDenom S P (y + 2 * Real.pi) = sliceLocalSupDenom S P y := by
        unfold sliceLocalSupDenom
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        congr 1
        refine Set.image_congr fun u hu => ?_
        rw [hr_eq]
        have hζ_mem : y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u ∈ horizStrip h :=
          (hAff_mem_reg y hy u hu).1
        have h_add : (y + 2 * Real.pi) + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u =
            (y + (sliceSafeBallRad S P y : ℂ) * u) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
        rw [h_add]
        exact hTerm_per k _ hζ_mem
      unfold adaptiveStepRadius
      rw [hd_eq, hDen_eq]
    · have hy2 : y + 2 * Real.pi ∉ Ω_reg := by
        intro hy2_in
        have hd_pos : 0 < sliceSingDist S P y := by
          rw [← hSing_per y]
          exact (hSing_pos_iff _).mpr hy2_in
        exact hy ((hSing_pos_iff y).mp hd_pos)
      unfold adaptiveStepRadius
      rw [hSing_zero _ hy2, hSing_zero _ hy, min_eq_right zero_le_one]
      norm_num
  have hStep_cont : ∀ L : ℝ, Continuous (adaptiveStepRadius S P L) := by
    intro L
    have hDen_contOn : ContinuousOn (sliceLocalSupDenom S P) Ω_reg :=
      continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hM_contOn k))
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro y₀
    by_cases hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω_reg
    · have hDen_at : ContinuousAt (sliceLocalSupDenom S P) y₀ :=
        hDen_contOn.continuousAt (P.reg_open.mem_nhds hy₀)
      have hDen_ne : sliceLocalSupDenom S P y₀ ≠ 0 :=
        ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hDenom_ge_one y₀))
      have hNum_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℂ => (min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)) ^ 4) :=
        (continuous_const.min hSing_cont).pow 4
      unfold adaptiveStepRadius
      exact continuousAt_const.mul (hNum_cont.continuousAt.div hDen_at hDen_ne)
    · have hd0 : sliceSingDist S P y₀ = 0 := hSing_zero y₀ hy₀
      have hval0 : adaptiveStepRadius S P L y₀ = 0 := by
        unfold adaptiveStepRadius
        rw [hd0, min_eq_right zero_le_one]
        norm_num
      rw [ContinuousAt, hval0]
      let g : ℂ → ℝ := fun y => (1 / 100 : ℝ) * min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y)
      have hg_cont : Continuous g :=
        continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.min hSing_cont)
      have hg0 : g y₀ = 0 := by
        simp [g, hd0]
      have hg_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto g (nhds y₀) (nhds 0) := by
        rw [← hg0]
        exact hg_cont.continuousAt
      exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
        tendsto_const_nhds hg_tendsto (hStep_nonneg L) (hStep_le_sing L)
  exact
    { cont := hStep_cont
      periodic := hStep_per
      nonneg := hStep_nonneg
      pos_iff := hStep_pos_iff
      le_sing_dist := hStep_le_sing
      denom_ge_one := hDenom_ge_one
      safe_ball_sub_and_le := hSafe_ball_sub_and_le }

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_strip_cayley : ∀ (H : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℂ) (r_y : ℝ),
      0 < r_y → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball y r_y) →
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball y r_y, |(f ζ).im| < H) →
      (∀ ζ : ℂ, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → θ < 1 → ‖ζ - y‖ ≤ θ * r_y →
        ‖f ζ - f y‖ ≤ (2 * ‖ζ - y‖ / ((1 - θ) * r_y)) * (H - |(f y).im|)) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ r_y / 4 → ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y r,
        ‖deriv f ζ‖ ≤ 2 * H / r) := by
    intro H f y r_y hr_y hf_holo hf_maps
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Metric.ball y r_y := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_y
    have hfy_im : |(f y).im| < H := hf_maps y hy_mem
    let δ_y : ℝ := H - |(f y).im|
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ_y := sub_pos.mpr hfy_im
    let ε : ℝ := if 0 ≤ (f y).im then 1 else -1
    have hε_norm : ‖(ε : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
      dsimp only [ε]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hε_fy : ε * (f y).im = |(f y).im| := by
      dsimp only [ε]; split_ifs with h0
      · simp [abs_of_nonneg h0]
      · simp [abs_of_neg (not_le.mp h0)]
    have hε_le : ∀ a : ℝ, ε * a ≤ |a| := by
      intro a; dsimp only [ε]; split_ifs
      · simpa using le_abs_self a
      · simpa using neg_le_abs a
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (H : ℂ) + (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I * (f w - ((f y).re : ℂ))
    have hg_re : ∀ w : ℂ, (g w).re = H - ε * (f w).im := by
      intro w
      simp only [g, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_assoc, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, one_mul,
        Complex.sub_im]
      ring
    have hg_im : ∀ w : ℂ, (g w).im = ε * ((f w).re - (f y).re) := by
      intro w
      simp only [g, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_add, mul_assoc, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, zero_mul, add_zero, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, one_mul,
        Complex.sub_re]
    have hg_y : g y = (δ_y : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · rw [hg_re y, Complex.ofReal_re, hε_fy]
      · rw [hg_im y, Complex.ofReal_im]; ring
    have hg_sub_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, g w - (δ_y : ℂ) = (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I * (f w - f y) := by
      intro w; rw [← hg_y]; dsimp only [g]; ring
    have hg_sub_norm : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖g w - (δ_y : ℂ)‖ = ‖f w - f y‖ := by
      intro w; rw [hg_sub_eq w, norm_mul, norm_mul, hε_norm, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, one_mul]
    have hg_re_pos : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y r_y, 0 < (g w).re := by
      intro w hw
      linarith [hg_re w, hf_maps w hw, hε_le (f w).im]
    have hg_den_ne : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y r_y, g w + (δ_y : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro w hw h0
      have hre : (g w + (δ_y : ℂ)).re = (g w).re + δ_y := by simp
      rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      linarith [hg_re_pos w hw]
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (g w - (δ_y : ℂ)) / (g w + (δ_y : ℂ))
    have hΦ_y : Φ y = 0 := by simp [Φ, hg_y]
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball y r_y) :=
      (differentiableOn_const _).add
        (((differentiableOn_const _).mul (differentiableOn_const _)).mul
          (hf_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)))
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball y r_y) :=
      (hg_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)).div
        (hg_holo.add (differentiableOn_const _)) hg_den_ne
    have hΦ_maps : Set.MapsTo Φ (Metric.ball y r_y) (Metric.closedBall (Φ y) 1) := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hΦ_y, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [Φ]
      rw [norm_div, div_le_one (norm_pos_iff.mpr (hg_den_ne w hw)),
        Complex.norm_def, Complex.norm_def]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_re,
        Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero, add_zero]
      nlinarith [hg_re_pos w hw, hδ_pos]
    have h_osc : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → θ < 1 → ‖ζ - y‖ ≤ θ * r_y →
        ‖f ζ - f y‖ ≤ (2 * ‖ζ - y‖ / ((1 - θ) * r_y)) * δ_y := by
      intro ζ θ _hθ₀ hθ₁ hζ_le
      have hζ_mem : ζ ∈ Metric.ball y r_y := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; nlinarith
      have h_sp := Complex.dist_le_div_mul_dist_of_mapsTo_ball hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hζ_mem
      rw [hΦ_y, dist_zero_right, dist_eq_norm] at h_sp
      have hΦ_le_θ : ‖Φ ζ‖ ≤ θ := by
        calc ‖Φ ζ‖ ≤ 1 / r_y * ‖ζ - y‖ := h_sp
          _ ≤ 1 / r_y * (θ * r_y) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hζ_le (by positivity)
          _ = θ := by field_simp
      have h_alg : (1 - Φ ζ) * (g ζ - (δ_y : ℂ)) = 2 * (δ_y : ℂ) * Φ ζ := by
        have hne := hg_den_ne ζ hζ_mem
        dsimp only [Φ]
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_norm_eq : ‖(1 : ℂ) - Φ ζ‖ * ‖f ζ - f y‖ = 2 * δ_y * ‖Φ ζ‖ := by
        have h1 := congrArg norm h_alg
        rw [norm_mul, hg_sub_norm ζ, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos] at h1
        exact h1
      have h_one_sub : 1 - θ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) - Φ ζ‖ := by
        have h2 := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) (Φ ζ)
        rw [norm_one] at h2
        linarith
      have h_one_sub_pos : 0 < 1 - θ := sub_pos.mpr hθ₁
      have h_prod : (1 - θ) * ‖f ζ - f y‖ ≤ 2 * δ_y * (1 / r_y * ‖ζ - y‖) := by
        calc (1 - θ) * ‖f ζ - f y‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) - Φ ζ‖ * ‖f ζ - f y‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_one_sub (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = 2 * δ_y * ‖Φ ζ‖ := h_norm_eq
          _ ≤ 2 * δ_y * (1 / r_y * ‖ζ - y‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sp (by positivity)
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos h_one_sub_pos hr_y)]
      have h_rhs : 2 * δ_y * (1 / r_y * ‖ζ - y‖) * r_y = 2 * ‖ζ - y‖ * δ_y := by
        field_simp
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod hr_y.le]
    refine ⟨h_osc, ?_⟩
    intro r hr_pos hr_le ζ hζ
    let f₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => f w - f y
    have h_sub_ball : Metric.closedBall ζ r ⊆ Metric.ball y r_y := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have h_tri : ‖w - y‖ ≤ ‖w - ζ‖ + ‖ζ - y‖ := by
        simpa using norm_add_le (w - ζ) (ζ - y)
      linarith
    have hf₀_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f₀ (Metric.ball y r_y) :=
      hf_holo.sub (differentiableOn_const _)
    have hf₀_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ f₀ (Metric.ball ζ r) :=
      hf₀_holo.diffContOnCl_ball h_sub_ball
    have hf₀_sph : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere ζ r, ‖f₀ w‖ ≤ 2 * H := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_cb : w ∈ Metric.closedBall ζ r := Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw_cb hζ
      have h_tri : ‖w - y‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y := by
        have h1 : ‖w - y‖ ≤ ‖w - ζ‖ + ‖ζ - y‖ := by
          simpa using norm_add_le (w - ζ) (ζ - y)

    let ρ_y : ℝ := adaptiveStepRadius S P L y

    have h_ang_deriv_pt : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall y r,

    have h_b5_jump_ang :

          have hCHc_ne : C_Hc ≠ 0 := (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hCHc_ge_one).ne'
          have hB_ne : B ≠ 0 := hB_pos.ne'
          field_simp
          ring
        have h_sub_fac :
            (4096 * (S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2 * E_L) / (10000 * C_Hc ^ 3 * B) ≤
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          have hr2 : r ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hr_pos.le hr_le_one
          have hp1 : (S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2 ≤ C_Hc ^ 3 * B := by
            calc (S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2 ≤ C_Hc ^ 3 * 1 :=
                  mul_le_mul hH_CHc2_le_CHc3 hr2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
              _ ≤ C_Hc ^ 3 * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hB_ge_one (by positivity)
          have hp2 : ((S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2) * E_L ≤
              (C_Hc ^ 3 * B) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) :=
            mul_le_mul hp1 hEL_le_M3 hEL_pos.le (by positivity)
          calc 4096 * (S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2 * E_L =
              4096 * (((S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2) * E_L) := by ring
            _ ≤ 4096 * ((C_Hc ^ 3 * B) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2 (by norm_num)
            _ ≤ 5000 * ((C_Hc ^ 3 * B) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (by positivity)
            _ = 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * (10000 * C_Hc ^ 3 * B) := by ring
        rw [h_eq]
        calc ((4096 * (S.H * C_Hc ^ 2) * r ^ 2 * E_L) / (10000 * C_Hc ^ 3 * B)) *
              (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖)
            ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sub_fac (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) := by ring
      calc ‖sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y -
            deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖
          ≤ (2 * K₁_sup / r₁) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := h_tay
        _ ≤ (2 * K₁_sup / r₁) * (ρ_y * ρ_y) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz_sq (by positivity)
        _ = ((2 * K₁_sup / r₁) * ρ_y) * ρ_y := by ring
        _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ_y :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_fac hρ_nonneg
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ_y := by ring
    exact ⟨h_b1_small_shape, h_b2_log_spd, h_b3_log_sin, h_b4_log_chd,
      h_b5_jump_ang, h_b6_jump_pos, h_b7_tay_imp, h_b8_tay_ang,
      h_b9_tay_pos₀, h_b10_tay_pos₁, h_b11_tay_sup⟩
  exact
    { scale_ge_two := hM_ge_two
      measurable := (hTop.cont L).measurable
      periodic := hTop.periodic L
      cont_on := (hTop.cont L).continuousOn
      nonneg := hTop.nonneg L
      pos_iff := hTop.pos_iff L

      jump_log_chord := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.1
      jump_angle := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.2.1
      jump_pos := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.2.2.1
      taylor_impact := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      taylor_angle := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      taylor_pos₀ := fun y hy z hz j => (h_pt y hy z hz j).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have h_ker_denom_pos : ∀ (h' sgn t v : ℝ), 0 < h' → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → |v| < h' →
      0 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * t / (2 * h')) - sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) := by
    intro h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv
    have hv' := abs_lt.mp hv
    have h2h : 0 < 2 * h' := by positivity
    have hβ_lt : Real.pi * v / (2 * h') < Real.pi / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.2 Real.pi_pos]
    have hβ_gt : -(Real.pi / 2) < Real.pi * v / (2 * h') := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.1 Real.pi_pos]
    have hcos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) :=
      Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨hβ_gt, hβ_lt⟩
    have hsgn_sq : sgn ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have h_sin_sq : (sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * v / (2 * h'))) ^ 2 < 1 := by
      calc (sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * v / (2 * h'))) ^ 2
          = sgn ^ 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 1 - Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) ^ 2 := by rw [hsgn_sq, one_mul, Real.sin_sq]
        _ < 1 := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hcos]
    have h_cosh : 1 ≤ Real.cosh (Real.pi * t / (2 * h')) := Real.one_le_cosh _
    nlinarith

  have h_ker_pos : ∀ (h' sgn t v : ℝ), 0 < h' → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → |v| < h' →
      0 < stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v := by
    intro h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv
    have hv' := abs_lt.mp hv
    have h2h : 0 < 2 * h' := by positivity
    have hβ_lt : Real.pi * v / (2 * h') < Real.pi / 2 := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.2 Real.pi_pos]
    have hβ_gt : -(Real.pi / 2) < Real.pi * v / (2 * h') := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.1 Real.pi_pos]
    have hcos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) :=
      Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨hβ_gt, hβ_lt⟩
    have hden := h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv
    exact div_pos hcos (by positivity)

  have h_ker_mass : ∀ (h' sgn v : ℝ), 0 < h' → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → |v| < h' →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ t : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v) = 1 / 2 + sgn * v / (2 * h') := by
    intro h' sgn v hh' hsgn hv
    have hv' := abs_lt.mp hv
    have h2h : 0 < 2 * h' := by positivity
    let c : ℝ := Real.pi / (2 * h')
    have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
    let β : ℝ := Real.pi * v / (2 * h')
    have hβ_lt : β < Real.pi / 2 := by
      dsimp [β]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.2 Real.pi_pos]
    have hβ_gt : -(Real.pi / 2) < β := by
      dsimp [β]
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ h2h]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.1 Real.pi_pos]
    have hcos : 0 < Real.cos β := Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨hβ_gt, hβ_lt⟩
    have hsgn_sq : sgn ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
      Real.pi⁻¹ * Real.arctan ((Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β)
    have hF_deriv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v) t := by
      intro t
      have hct_eq : c * t = Real.pi * t / (2 * h') := by dsimp [c]; ring
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => c * x) c t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul c
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (c * x)) (Real.exp (c * t) * c) t := h1.exp
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (c * x) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β)
          ((Real.exp (c * t) * c) / Real.cos β) t :=
        (h2.sub_const _).div_const _
      have h4 := (h3.arctan).const_mul Real.pi⁻¹
      convert h4 using 1
      have h_cosh_id : 2 * Real.exp (c * t) * Real.cosh (c * t) = Real.exp (c * t) ^ 2 + 1 := by
        rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg]
        have hexp : Real.exp (c * t) ≠ 0 := Real.exp_ne_zero _
        field_simp
      have h_sq_id : Real.cos β ^ 2 + (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) ^ 2 =
          2 * Real.exp (c * t) * (Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) := by
        calc Real.cos β ^ 2 + (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) ^ 2
            = (Real.cos β ^ 2 + sgn ^ 2 * Real.sin β ^ 2) +
                Real.exp (c * t) ^ 2 - 2 * sgn * Real.exp (c * t) * Real.sin β := by ring
          _ = (Real.exp (c * t) ^ 2 + 1) - 2 * sgn * Real.exp (c * t) * Real.sin β := by
                rw [hsgn_sq, one_mul, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; ring
          _ = 2 * Real.exp (c * t) * (Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) := by
                rw [← h_cosh_id]; ring
      have hden_pos : 0 < Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β := by
        rw [hct_eq]
        exact h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv
      have h_sum_pos : 0 < Real.cos β ^ 2 + (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) ^ 2 := by
        positivity
      have h_pi_c : Real.pi⁻¹ * c = (2 * h')⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [c]
        field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hh'.ne']
      unfold stripPoissonKernel
      rw [← hct_eq]
      change Real.cos β / (4 * h' * (Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β)) =
        Real.pi⁻¹ * (1 / (1 + ((Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β) ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp (c * t) * c / Real.cos β))
      have h_rhs : Real.pi⁻¹ * (1 / (1 + ((Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β) ^ 2) *
          (Real.exp (c * t) * c / Real.cos β)) =
          (Real.pi⁻¹ * c) * (Real.exp (c * t) * Real.cos β /
            (Real.cos β ^ 2 + (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) ^ 2)) := by
        field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hcos.ne', h_sum_pos.ne']
      rw [h_rhs, h_pi_c, h_sq_id]
      field_simp [hh'.ne', (Real.exp_pos (c * t)).ne', hden_pos.ne']
      norm_num
    have hF_top : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2)) := by
      have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => c * t) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc Filter.tendsto_id
      have h_exp : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (c * t)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Real.tendsto_exp_atTop.comp h_lin
      have h_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β)
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
        simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using h_exp.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
      have h_div : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β)
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        h_sub.atTop_div_const hcos
      have h_atan_raw : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun t : ℝ => Real.arctan ((Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.pi / 2)) :=
        (Real.tendsto_arctan_atTop.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds).comp h_div
      have h_atan : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.pi⁻¹ * (Real.pi / 2))) :=
        h_atan_raw.const_mul Real.pi⁻¹
      convert h_atan using 2
      field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne']
    have hF_bot : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atBot (nhds (-(sgn * v / (2 * h')))) := by
      have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => c * t) Filter.atBot Filter.atBot :=
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atBot hc Filter.tendsto_id
      have h_exp : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (c * t)) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) :=
        Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp h_lin
      have h_arg : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (Real.exp (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β)
          Filter.atBot (nhds ((0 - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β)) :=
        (h_exp.sub tendsto_const_nhds).div_const _
      have h_atan : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atBot
          (nhds (Real.pi⁻¹ * Real.arctan ((0 - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β))) :=
        ((Real.continuous_arctan.continuousAt.tendsto).comp h_arg).const_mul Real.pi⁻¹
      convert h_atan using 2
      have h_tan : (0 - sgn * Real.sin β) / Real.cos β = Real.tan (-sgn * β) := by
        rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;>
          simp [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg, neg_div]
      have h_mem : -sgn * β ∈ Set.Ioo (-(Real.pi / 2)) (Real.pi / 2) := by
        rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> simp <;> constructor <;> linarith
      rw [h_tan, Real.arctan_tan h_mem.1 h_mem.2]
      dsimp [β]
      field_simp [Real.pi_pos.ne', hh'.ne']
    have h_int_Ioi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
        (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg
        (hF_deriv 0).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        (fun t _ => hF_deriv t)
        (fun t _ => le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv))
        hF_top
    have h_val_Ioi : (∫ t in Set.Ioi 0, stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v) = 1 / 2 - F 0 :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg'
        (fun t _ => hF_deriv t)
        (fun t _ => le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' sgn t v hh' hsgn hv))
        hF_top
    have h_even : ∀ t : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (-t) v = stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v := by
      intro t
      simp only [stripPoissonKernel, mul_neg, neg_div, Real.cosh_neg]
    have h_int_Iio : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
        (Set.Iio 0) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h_int_Ioi' : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
          (Set.Ioi (-(0 : ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume := by
        simpa only [neg_zero] using h_int_Ioi
      simpa only [h_even] using h_int_Ioi'.comp_neg_Iio
    have h_int_Iic : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
        (Set.Iic 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_int_Iio.congr_set_ae MeasureTheory.Iio_ae_eq_Iic.symm
    have h_val_Iic : (∫ t in Set.Iic 0, stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v) =
        F 0 - (-(sgn * v / (2 * h'))) :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto'
        (fun t _ => hF_deriv t) h_int_Iic hF_bot
    have h_int_univ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v)
        Set.univ MeasureTheory.volume := by
      rw [← Set.Iic_union_Ioi]
      exact h_int_Iic.union h_int_Ioi
    have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Iic (0 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
      Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun _ hx1 hx2 => not_lt_of_ge (Set.mem_Iic.mp hx1) (Set.mem_Ioi.mp hx2))
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.integrableOn_univ.mp h_int_univ, ?_⟩
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ)),
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Iic h_int_Ioi,
      h_val_Iic, h_val_Ioi]
    ring

  have h_ker_ball_dom : ∀ (h' : ℝ) (y₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ), 0 < h' → 0 ≤ r₀ →
      Metric.closedBall y₀ r₀ ⊆ horizStrip h' →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ r₀, ∀ (sgn x : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
          stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im ≤
            C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y₀.re - x) 0 := by
    intro h' y₀ r₀ hh' hr₀ hsub
    let z_star : ℂ := y₀ + (if 0 ≤ y₀.im then (r₀ : ℂ) else -(r₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.I
    have hz_mem : z_star ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ r₀ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have hdiff : z_star - y₀ = (if 0 ≤ y₀.im then (r₀ : ℂ) else -(r₀ : ℂ)) * Complex.I := by
        dsimp [z_star]; ring
      rw [hdiff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
      split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.norm_real, abs_of_nonneg hr₀]
    have hz_strip : |z_star.im| < h' := hsub hz_mem
    have hz_im : |z_star.im| = |y₀.im| + r₀ := by
      dsimp [z_star]
      split_ifs with h_im
      · simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one,
          Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg h_im, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      · have h_im' : y₀.im < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h_im
        simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_im, mul_one, Complex.neg_im, Complex.ofReal_im, neg_zero, Complex.I_re,
          mul_zero, add_zero]
        rw [abs_of_neg h_im', abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
        ring
    let H₁ : ℝ := |y₀.im| + r₀
    have hH₁_lt : H₁ < h' := by dsimp [H₁]; rwa [← hz_im]
    have hH₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ H₁ := by positivity
    let c : ℝ := Real.pi / (2 * h')
    have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
    have hcH₁_lt : c * H₁ < Real.pi / 2 := by
      dsimp [c]
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hH₁_lt Real.pi_pos]
    have hcos_H₁ : 0 < Real.cos (c * H₁) :=
      Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos, mul_nonneg hc.le hH₁_nonneg], hcH₁_lt⟩
    have hsin_H₁_lt_one : Real.sin (c * H₁) < 1 := by
      have hsq : Real.sin (c * H₁) ^ 2 < 1 := by
        rw [Real.sin_sq]
        nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hcos_H₁]
      nlinarith
    let c₁ : ℝ := 1 - Real.sin (c * H₁)
    have hc₁_pos : 0 < c₁ := sub_pos.mpr hsin_H₁_lt_one
    refine ⟨2 * Real.cosh (c * r₀) / c₁, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro y hy sgn x hsgn
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have hy_im_le : |y.im| ≤ H₁ := by
      have h1 : |y.im - y₀.im| ≤ ‖y - y₀‖ := by
        simpa only [Complex.sub_im] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - y₀)
      dsimp [H₁]
      linarith [abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub y.im y₀.im]
    have hy_re_le : |y₀.re - y.re| ≤ r₀ := by
      have h1 : |y₀.re - y.re| ≤ ‖y₀ - y‖ := by
        simpa only [Complex.sub_re] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (y₀ - y)
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at h1
      exact le_trans h1 hy
    have h_sin_le : sgn * Real.sin (c * y.im) ≤ Real.sin (c * H₁) := by
      have h_eq : sgn * Real.sin (c * y.im) = Real.sin (sgn * (c * y.im)) := by
        rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Real.sin_neg]
      have h_abs : |sgn * (c * y.im)| ≤ c * H₁ := by
        have hsgn_abs : |sgn| = 1 := by rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
        rw [abs_mul, hsgn_abs, one_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_im_le hc.le
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
        (by linarith [(abs_le.mp h_abs).1])
        hcH₁_lt.le
        (abs_le.mp h_abs).2
    let A : ℝ := c * (y.re - x)
    let B_sh : ℝ := c * (y₀.re - y.re)
    have hAB : c * (y₀.re - x) = A + B_sh := by dsimp [A, B_sh]; ring
    have h_cosh_A_ge : 1 ≤ Real.cosh A := Real.one_le_cosh A
    have hsin_H₁_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sin (c * H₁) :=
      Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (mul_nonneg hc.le hH₁_nonneg) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
    have h_den_ge : c₁ * Real.cosh A ≤ Real.cosh A - sgn * Real.sin (c * y.im) := by
      dsimp [c₁]
      nlinarith
    have h_sinh_abs : ∀ u : ℝ, |Real.sinh u| ≤ Real.cosh u := by
      intro u
      rw [abs_le]
      have hsq := Real.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq u
      have hc_pos := Real.cosh_pos u
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    have h_cosh_B : Real.cosh B_sh ≤ Real.cosh (c * r₀) := by
      have hB_abs : |B_sh| ≤ c * r₀ := by
        dsimp [B_sh]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy_re_le hc.le
      exact Real.cosh_le_cosh.mpr (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hc.le hr₀)])
    have h_cosh_shift : Real.cosh (c * (y₀.re - x)) ≤ 2 * Real.cosh (c * r₀) * Real.cosh A := by
      rw [hAB, Real.cosh_add]
      have h2 := h_sinh_abs B_sh
      have h3 : Real.sinh A * Real.sinh B_sh ≤ |Real.sinh A| * |Real.sinh B_sh| := by
        simpa only [abs_mul] using le_abs_self (Real.sinh A * Real.sinh B_sh)
      have h4 : |Real.sinh A| * |Real.sinh B_sh| ≤ Real.cosh A * Real.cosh (c * r₀) :=
        mul_le_mul (h_sinh_abs A) (le_trans h2 h_cosh_B) (abs_nonneg _) (Real.cosh_pos A).le
      have h5 : Real.cosh A * Real.cosh B_sh ≤ Real.cosh A * Real.cosh (c * r₀) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cosh_B (Real.cosh_pos A).le
      linarith
    have h_cos_le : Real.cos (c * y.im) ≤ 1 := Real.cos_le_one _
    unfold stripPoissonKernel
    have hA_eq : Real.pi * (y.re - x) / (2 * h') = A := by dsimp [A, c]; ring
    have hA0_eq : Real.pi * (y₀.re - x) / (2 * h') = c * (y₀.re - x) := by dsimp [c]; ring
    have hyim_eq : Real.pi * y.im / (2 * h') = c * y.im := by dsimp [c]; ring
    rw [hA_eq, hA0_eq, hyim_eq]
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_div, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]
    have h_coshA_pos : 0 < Real.cosh A := Real.cosh_pos A
    have h_cosh0_pos : 0 < Real.cosh (c * (y₀.re - x)) := Real.cosh_pos _
    calc Real.cos (c * y.im) / (4 * h' * (Real.cosh A - sgn * Real.sin (c * y.im)))
        ≤ 1 / (4 * h' * (c₁ * Real.cosh A)) := by
          exact div_le_div₀ zero_le_one h_cos_le (by positivity)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_ge (by positivity))
      _ ≤ (2 * Real.cosh (c * r₀) / c₁) * (1 / (4 * h' * Real.cosh (c * (y₀.re - x)))) := by
          rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_one, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          have h_scaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cosh_shift (show 0 ≤ 4 * h' * c₁ by positivity)
          linarith

  have h_ker_tail_dom : ∀ (h' δ sgn t v : ℝ), 0 < h' → 0 < δ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      |v| < h' → δ ≤ |t| →
      stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v ≤
        (Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) /
          (1 - (Real.cosh (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')))⁻¹)) *
          stripPoissonKernel h' 1 t 0 := by
    intro h' δ sgn t v hh' hδ hsgn hv hδt
    let c : ℝ := Real.pi / (2 * h')
    have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
    have hcδ_pos : 0 < c * δ := by positivity
    have h_cosh_δ_gt_one : 1 < Real.cosh (c * δ) := by
      rw [Real.cosh_eq]
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (c * δ) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hexp_gt : 1 < Real.exp (c * δ) := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hcδ_pos
      have hsq : 0 < (Real.exp (c * δ) - 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hexp_gt)
      rw [Real.exp_neg, lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
      have : (Real.exp (c * δ) - 1) ^ 2 =
          Real.exp (c * δ) * (Real.exp (c * δ) + (Real.exp (c * δ))⁻¹ - 2) := by
        field_simp [hexp_pos.ne']
        ring
      nlinarith
    have h_cosh_le : Real.cosh (c * δ) ≤ Real.cosh (c * t) := by
      refine Real.cosh_le_cosh.mpr ?_
      rw [abs_of_pos hcδ_pos, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδt hc.le
    let η_δ : ℝ := 1 - (Real.cosh (c * δ))⁻¹
    have hη_pos : 0 < η_δ := sub_pos.mpr (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ h_cosh_δ_gt_one)
    have h_inv_le : (Real.cosh (c * t))⁻¹ ≤ (Real.cosh (c * δ))⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (Real.cosh_pos _) h_cosh_le
    have h_one_le : 1 ≤ (1 - η_δ) * Real.cosh (c * t) := by
      have h_sub_eq : 1 - η_δ = (Real.cosh (c * δ))⁻¹ := by dsimp [η_δ]; ring
      rw [h_sub_eq]
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_le (Real.cosh_pos (c * t)).le
      rwa [inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.cosh_pos (c * t)).ne'] at h_mul
    have h_sin_le_one : sgn * Real.sin (c * v) ≤ 1 := by
      rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl
      · linarith [Real.sin_le_one (c * v)]
      · linarith [Real.neg_one_le_sin (c * v)]
    have h_den_ge : η_δ * Real.cosh (c * t) ≤ Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin (c * v) := by
      linarith
    have hv' := abs_lt.mp hv
    have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos (c * v) := by
      apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
      constructor
      · dsimp [c]; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.1 Real.pi_pos]
      · dsimp [c]; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.2 Real.pi_pos]
    unfold stripPoissonKernel
    have hct_eq : Real.pi * t / (2 * h') = c * t := by dsimp [c]; ring
    have hcv_eq : Real.pi * v / (2 * h') = c * v := by dsimp [c]; ring
    have hcδ_eq : Real.pi * δ / (2 * h') = c * δ := by dsimp [c]; ring
    rw [hct_eq, hcv_eq, hcδ_eq]
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_div, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]
    change Real.cos (c * v) / (4 * h' * (Real.cosh (c * t) - sgn * Real.sin (c * v))) ≤
      (Real.cos (c * v) / η_δ) * (1 / (4 * h' * Real.cosh (c * t)))
    have h_rhs_eq : (Real.cos (c * v) / η_δ) * (1 / (4 * h' * Real.cosh (c * t))) =
        Real.cos (c * v) / (4 * h' * (η_δ * Real.cosh (c * t))) := by
      field_simp [hη_pos.ne', hh'.ne', (Real.cosh_pos (c * t)).ne']
    rw [h_rhs_eq]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hcos_pos.le (by positivity)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_den_ge (by positivity))

  have h_ker_circleAvg : ∀ (h' sgn x : ℝ), 0 < h' → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ∀ (y : ℂ) (R : ℝ), Metric.closedBall y |R| ⊆ horizStrip h' →
        Real.circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (z.re - x) z.im) y R =
          stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im := by
    intro h' sgn x hh' hsgn y R hsub
    let c : ℝ := Real.pi / (2 * h')
    let D : ℂ → ℂ := fun z =>
      Complex.exp ((c : ℂ) * (z - (x : ℂ))) - (sgn : ℂ) * Complex.I
    let W : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => ((2 * h' : ℂ) * D z)⁻¹
    have hsgn_sq : sgn ^ 2 = 1 := by rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    have hD_re_im : ∀ z : ℂ,
        (D z).re = Real.exp (c * (z.re - x)) * Real.cos (c * z.im) ∧
        (D z).im = Real.exp (c * (z.re - x)) * Real.sin (c * z.im) - sgn := by
      intro z
      dsimp [D]
      simp [Complex.exp_re, Complex.exp_im]
    have hW_eq_ker : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h',
        (W z).re = stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (z.re - x) z.im ∧
        (2 * h' : ℂ) * D z ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_abs : |z.im| < h' := hz
      have hz' := abs_lt.mp hz_abs
      let α : ℝ := c * (z.re - x)
      let β : ℝ := c * z.im
      have hcos : 0 < Real.cos β := by
        apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
        constructor
        · dsimp [β, c]; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz'.1 Real.pi_pos]
        · dsimp [β, c]; rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz'.2 Real.pi_pos]
      rcases hD_re_im z with ⟨hDre, hDim⟩
      change (D z).re = Real.exp α * Real.cos β at hDre
      change (D z).im = Real.exp α * Real.sin β - sgn at hDim
      have hD_ne : D z ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have : (D z).re = 0 := by rw [h0, Complex.zero_re]
        rw [hDre] at this
        have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp α := Real.exp_pos α
        nlinarith
      have h2h_ne : (2 * h' : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by positivity : (2 * h' : ℝ) ≠ 0)
      have h_prod_ne : (2 * h' : ℂ) * D z ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero h2h_ne hD_ne
      refine ⟨?_, h_prod_ne⟩
      have h_normSq : Complex.normSq (D z) =
          2 * Real.exp α * (Real.cosh α - sgn * Real.sin β) := by
        rw [Complex.normSq_apply, hDre, hDim]
        have h_cosh_id : 2 * Real.exp α * Real.cosh α = Real.exp α ^ 2 + 1 := by
          rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg]
          field_simp [(Real.exp_pos α).ne']
        calc Real.exp α * Real.cos β * (Real.exp α * Real.cos β) +
              (Real.exp α * Real.sin β - sgn) * (Real.exp α * Real.sin β - sgn)
            = Real.exp α ^ 2 * (Real.cos β ^ 2 + Real.sin β ^ 2) + sgn ^ 2 -
                2 * sgn * Real.exp α * Real.sin β := by ring
          _ = (Real.exp α ^ 2 + 1) - 2 * sgn * Real.exp α * Real.sin β := by
                rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, hsgn_sq]; ring
          _ = 2 * Real.exp α * (Real.cosh α - sgn * Real.sin β) := by
                rw [← h_cosh_id]; ring
      have hW_re : (W z).re = (2 * h')⁻¹ * ((D z).re / Complex.normSq (D z)) := by
        dsimp [W]
        rw [_root_.mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]
        have h2h_cast : ((2 * h' : ℂ))⁻¹ = (((2 * h')⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_cast
        rw [h2h_cast, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
          Complex.inv_re]
      rw [hW_re, hDre, h_normSq]
      unfold stripPoissonKernel
      have hα_eq : Real.pi * (z.re - x) / (2 * h') = α := by dsimp [α, c]; ring
      have hβ_eq : Real.pi * z.im / (2 * h') = β := by dsimp [β, c]; ring
      rw [hα_eq, hβ_eq]
      have hden_pos : 0 < Real.cosh α - sgn * Real.sin β := by
        rw [← hα_eq, ← hβ_eq]
        exact h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn (z.re - x) z.im hh' hsgn hz_abs
      field_simp [hh'.ne', (Real.exp_pos α).ne', hden_pos.ne']
      norm_num
    have h_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h') :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    have hW_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip h') := by
      have hD_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => (2 * h' : ℂ) * D z) := by
        dsimp [D]
        fun_prop
      exact hD_diff.differentiableOn.inv (fun z hz => (hW_eq_ker z hz).2)
    have hW_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W (horizStrip h') :=
      hW_diff.analyticOnNhd h_open
    have h_harm : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (fun z => (W z).re) (Metric.closedBall y |R|) := by
      intro z hz
      exact (hW_an z (hsub hz)).harmonicAt_re
    have h_avg_W : Real.circleAverage (fun z => (W z).re) y R = (W y).re :=
      h_harm.circleAverage_eq
    have hy_mem : y ∈ horizStrip h' :=
      hsub (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (abs_nonneg R))
    have h_eq_sphere : Set.EqOn
        (fun z : ℂ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (z.re - x) z.im)
        (fun z : ℂ => (W z).re) (Metric.sphere y |R|) := by
      intro z hz
      exact ((hW_eq_ker z (hsub (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))).1).symm
    rw [Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_eq_sphere, h_avg_W, (hW_eq_ker y hy_mem).1]

  
  
  
  have h_shift_ker : ∀ (h' sgn u v : ℝ), 0 < h' → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → |v| < h' →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (u - x) v)
        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (u - x) v) = 1 / 2 + sgn * v / (2 * h') := by
    intro h' sgn u v hh' hsgn hv
    rcases h_ker_mass h' sgn v hh' hsgn hv with ⟨h_int, h_eq⟩
    refine ⟨h_int.comp_sub_left u, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub_left_eq_self
      (fun t => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn t v) MeasureTheory.volume u]
    exact h_eq

  have h_term_int : ∀ (h' B : ℝ) (ϕ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < h' → Measurable ϕ →
      (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ x| ≤ B) →
      ∀ (sgn : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h',
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => ϕ x * stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im)
          MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro h' B ϕ hh' hϕ_meas hϕ_bd sgn hsgn y hy
    have hK_int := (h_shift_ker h' sgn y.re y.im hh' hsgn hy).1
    have hK_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im) := by
      unfold stripPoissonKernel
      refine continuous_const.div (by fun_prop) (fun x => ?_)
      have hpos := h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im hh' hsgn hy
      positivity
    refine (hK_int.const_mul B).mono' (hϕ_meas.mul hK_cont.measurable).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    have hK_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im hh' hsgn hy)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hK_pos]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hϕ_bd x) hK_pos

  have h_int_part : ∀ (h' : ℝ), 0 < h' →
      ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        Measurable ϕ_pos → Measurable ϕ_neg → 0 ≤ B →
        (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_pos x| ≤ B) → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_neg x| ≤ B) →
        ContinuousOn (stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg) (horizStrip h') ∧
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h', |stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg y| ≤ B) ∧
        (∀ y : ℂ, ∀ R : ℝ, Metric.closedBall y |R| ⊆ horizStrip h' →
          Real.circleAverage (stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg) y R =
            stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg y) := by
    intro h' hh' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg B hϕ_pos hϕ_neg hB hB_pos hB_neg
    have h_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h') :=
      isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_open.continuousOn_iff]
      intro y₀ hy₀
      have hy₀_abs : |y₀.im| < h' := hy₀
      let r₀ : ℝ := (h' - |y₀.im|) / 2
      have hr₀ : 0 < r₀ := by dsimp [r₀]; linarith
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall y₀ r₀ ⊆ horizStrip h' := by
        intro y hy
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hy
        have h1 : |y.im - y₀.im| ≤ ‖y - y₀‖ := by
          simpa only [Complex.sub_im] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - y₀)
        change |y.im| < h'
        dsimp [r₀] at hy
        linarith [abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub y.im y₀.im]
      obtain ⟨C, hC_pos, hC_dom⟩ := h_ker_ball_dom h' y₀ r₀ hh' hr₀.le hsub
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => 2 * B * C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y₀.re - x) 0
      have h_bound_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable bound MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (h_shift_ker h' 1 y₀.re 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).1.const_mul (2 * B * C)
      refine MeasureTheory.continuousAt_of_dominated ?_ ?_ h_bound_int ?_
      · refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y₀ hr₀) (fun y hy => ?_)
        have hy_strip : y ∈ horizStrip h' := hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
        exact ((h_term_int h' B ϕ_pos hh' hϕ_pos hB_pos 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy_strip).add
          (h_term_int h' B ϕ_neg hh' hϕ_neg hB_neg (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy_strip)).aestronglyMeasurable
      · refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y₀ hr₀) (fun y hy => ?_)
        have hy_cb : y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ r₀ := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy
        have hy_strip : y ∈ horizStrip h' := hsub hy_cb
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
        have h1_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im hh' (Or.inl rfl) hy_strip)
        have h2_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im hh' (Or.inr rfl) hy_strip)
        have h1_dom := hC_dom y hy_cb 1 x (Or.inl rfl)
        have h2_dom := hC_dom y hy_cb (-1) x (Or.inr rfl)
        calc ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
                ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖
            ≤ ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im‖ +
                ‖ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |ϕ_pos x| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
                |ϕ_neg x| * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im := by
              simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1_pos, abs_of_nonneg h2_pos]
          _ ≤ B * (C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y₀.re - x) 0) +
                B * (C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y₀.re - x) 0) :=
              add_le_add (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_pos x) h1_pos)
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_dom hB))
                (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_neg x) h2_pos)
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2_dom hB))
          _ = bound x := by dsimp [bound]; ring
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
        have hc_ker : ∀ (sgn : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
            ContinuousAt (fun y : ℂ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (y.re - x) y.im) y₀ := by
          intro sgn hsgn
          unfold stripPoissonKernel
          have h_num : Continuous (fun y : ℂ => Real.cos (Real.pi * y.im / (2 * h'))) := by
            fun_prop
          have h_den : Continuous (fun y : ℂ =>
              4 * h' * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * (y.re - x) / (2 * h')) -
                sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * y.im / (2 * h')))) := by
            fun_prop
          have hpos := h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn (y₀.re - x) y₀.im hh' hsgn hy₀_abs
          exact h_num.continuousAt.div h_den.continuousAt (by positivity)
        exact ((hc_ker 1 (Or.inl rfl)).const_mul (ϕ_pos x)).add
          ((hc_ker (-1) (Or.inr rfl)).const_mul (ϕ_neg x))
    · intro y hy
      have h_int_pos := h_term_int h' B ϕ_pos hh' hϕ_pos hB_pos 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy
      have h_int_neg := h_term_int h' B ϕ_neg hh' hϕ_neg hB_neg (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy
      have hK_pos_int := (h_shift_ker h' 1 y.re y.im hh' (Or.inl rfl) hy).1
      have hK_neg_int := (h_shift_ker h' (-1) y.re y.im hh' (Or.inr rfl) hy).1
      unfold stripPoissonExt
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine le_trans (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) ?_
      have h_pt : ∀ x : ℝ,
          ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
            ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖ ≤
          B * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
            B * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im := by
        intro x
        have h1 := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im hh' (Or.inl rfl) hy)
        have h2 := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im hh' (Or.inr rfl) hy)
        calc ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
                ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖
            ≤ ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im‖ +
                ‖ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |ϕ_pos x| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
                |ϕ_neg x| * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im := by
              simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg h2]
          _ ≤ B * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
                B * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_pos x) h1)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_neg x) h2)
      calc (∫ x : ℝ, ‖ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
              ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im‖)
          ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, (B * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
              B * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im) :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono (h_int_pos.add h_int_neg).norm
              ((hK_pos_int.const_mul B).add (hK_neg_int.const_mul B)) h_pt
        _ = B * (∫ x : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im) +
              B * (∫ x : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im) := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hK_pos_int.const_mul B) (hK_neg_int.const_mul B),

        _ = B := by
            rw [(h_shift_ker h' 1 y.re y.im hh' (Or.inl rfl) hy).2,
              (h_shift_ker h' (-1) y.re y.im hh' (Or.inr rfl) hy).2]
            ring
    · intro y R hsub
      rw [← Real.circleAverage_abs_radius]
      let r : ℝ := |R|
      have hr : 0 ≤ r := abs_nonneg R
      obtain ⟨C, hC_pos, hC_dom⟩ := h_ker_ball_dom h' y r hh' hr hsub
      let f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun θ x =>
        ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im +
        ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im
      have h_cmap_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap y r θ ∈ Metric.closedBall y r :=
        fun θ => circleMap_mem_closedBall y hr θ
      have h_cmap_cont : Continuous (circleMap y r) := continuous_circleMap y r
      have hf_meas : Measurable (Function.uncurry f) := by
        have hc_ker_prod : ∀ (sgn : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
            Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
              stripPoissonKernel h' sgn ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2) (circleMap y r p.1).im) := by
          intro sgn hsgn
          unfold stripPoissonKernel
          have hc_re : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (circleMap y r p.1).re) :=
            Complex.continuous_re.comp (h_cmap_cont.comp continuous_fst)
          have hc_im : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (circleMap y r p.1).im) :=
            Complex.continuous_im.comp (h_cmap_cont.comp continuous_fst)
          have h_num : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
              Real.cos (Real.pi * (circleMap y r p.1).im / (2 * h'))) := by
            fun_prop
          have h_den : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
              4 * h' * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2) / (2 * h')) -

            fun_prop

            (circleMap y r p.1).im hh' hsgn hp_strip

        exact ((hϕ_pos.comp measurable_snd).mul (hc_ker_prod 1 (Or.inl rfl)).measurable).add
          ((hϕ_neg.comp measurable_snd).mul (hc_ker_prod (-1) (Or.inr rfl)).measurable)
      have hf_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry f)
          ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
        have h_uIoc : Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi) = Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
