        have h_const_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
          rw [h_uIoc]
          exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const (by rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
        have h_dom_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun x : ℝ => 2 * B * C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) 0)
            MeasureTheory.volume :=
          (h_shift_ker h' 1 y.re 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).1.const_mul (2 * B * C)
        refine (h_const_int.mul_prod h_dom_int).mono' hf_meas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_)
        have hp_cb := h_cmap_mem p.1
        have hp_strip := hsub hp_cb
        have h1_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
          (circleMap y r p.1).im hh' (Or.inl rfl) hp_strip)
        have h2_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' (-1) ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
          (circleMap y r p.1).im hh' (Or.inr rfl) hp_strip)
        have h1_dom := hC_dom _ hp_cb 1 p.2 (Or.inl rfl)
        have h2_dom := hC_dom _ hp_cb (-1) p.2 (Or.inr rfl)
        calc ‖Function.uncurry f p‖
            ≤ ‖ϕ_pos p.2 * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
                  (circleMap y r p.1).im‖ +
              ‖ϕ_neg p.2 * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
                  (circleMap y r p.1).im‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = |ϕ_pos p.2| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
                  (circleMap y r p.1).im +
              |ϕ_neg p.2| * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((circleMap y r p.1).re - p.2)
                  (circleMap y r p.1).im := by
              simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1_pos, abs_of_nonneg h2_pos]
          _ ≤ B * (C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - p.2) 0) +
              B * (C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - p.2) 0) :=
              add_le_add (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_pos p.2) h1_pos)
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_dom hB))
                (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_neg p.2) h2_pos)
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2_dom hB))
          _ = (1 : ℝ) * (2 * B * C * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - p.2) 0) := by ring
      rw [Real.circleAverage_def (f := stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg), smul_eq_mul]
      change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ x : ℝ, f θ x) = _
      rw [MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hf_prod,
        ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      unfold stripPoissonExt
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      have hc_θ : ∀ (sgn : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
          Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            stripPoissonKernel h' sgn ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im) := by
        intro sgn hsgn
        unfold stripPoissonKernel
        have hc_re : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (circleMap y r θ).re) :=
          Complex.continuous_re.comp h_cmap_cont
        have hc_im : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => (circleMap y r θ).im) :=
          Complex.continuous_im.comp h_cmap_cont
        have h_num : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            Real.cos (Real.pi * (circleMap y r θ).im / (2 * h'))) := by
          fun_prop
        have h_den : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
            4 * h' * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) / (2 * h')) -
              sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * (circleMap y r θ).im / (2 * h')))) := by
          fun_prop
        refine h_num.div h_den (fun θ => ?_)
        have hp_strip : |(circleMap y r θ).im| < h' := hsub (h_cmap_mem θ)
        have hpos := h_ker_denom_pos h' sgn ((circleMap y r θ).re - x)
          (circleMap y r θ).im hh' hsgn hp_strip
        positivity
      have hi1 := ((hc_θ 1 (Or.inl rfl)).intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        0 (2 * Real.pi)).const_mul (ϕ_pos x)
      have hi2 := ((hc_θ (-1) (Or.inr rfl)).intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
        0 (2 * Real.pi)).const_mul (ϕ_neg x)
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi1 hi2,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      have hsub_r : Metric.closedBall y |r| ⊆ horizStrip h' := by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hr]
      have h_ca1 := h_ker_circleAvg h' 1 x hh' (Or.inl rfl) y r hsub_r
      have h_ca2 := h_ker_circleAvg h' (-1) x hh' (Or.inr rfl) y r hsub_r
      rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul] at h_ca1 h_ca2
      calc (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ((ϕ_pos x * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im) +
              ϕ_neg x * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im)
          = ϕ_pos x * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im) +
              ϕ_neg x * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((circleMap y r θ).re - x) (circleMap y r θ).im) := by
            ring
        _ = ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
              ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (y.re - x) y.im := by
            rw [h_ca1, h_ca2]

  have h_period_part : ∀ (h' : ℝ), 0 < h' →
      ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        Measurable ϕ_pos → Measurable ϕ_neg →
        Function.Periodic ϕ_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic ϕ_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
        0 ≤ B → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_pos x| ≤ B) → (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_neg x| ≤ B) →
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg (x : ℂ)) =
        (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (ϕ_pos x + ϕ_neg x)) := by
    intro h' hh' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg B hϕ_pos hϕ_neg hper_pos hper_neg _hB hB_pos hB_neg
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => ϕ_pos u + ϕ_neg u
    let K₀ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => stripPoissonKernel h' 1 t 0
    have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ := hϕ_pos.add hϕ_neg
    have hΦ_per : Function.Periodic Φ (2 * Real.pi) := hper_pos.add hper_neg
    have hΦ_bd : ∀ u : ℝ, |Φ u| ≤ 2 * B := fun u =>
      le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith [hB_pos u, hB_neg u])
    have hK₀_eq_neg : ∀ t : ℝ, stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) t 0 = K₀ t := by
      intro t; simp [K₀, stripPoissonKernel]
    have h_ext_real : ∀ x : ℝ, stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg (x : ℂ) =
        ∫ t : ℝ, Φ (x - t) * K₀ t := by
      intro x
      unfold stripPoissonExt
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub_left_eq_self
        (fun u => ϕ_pos u * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 ((x : ℂ).re - u) (x : ℂ).im +
          ϕ_neg u * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) ((x : ℂ).re - u) (x : ℂ).im)
        MeasureTheory.volume x]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))
      simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_sub_cancel, hK₀_eq_neg]
      dsimp [Φ, K₀]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_ext_real]
    let g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x t => Φ (x - t) * K₀ t
    have hK₀_cont : Continuous K₀ := by
      dsimp [K₀, stripPoissonKernel]
      refine continuous_const.div ?_ (fun t => by
        have hpos := h_ker_denom_pos h' 1 t 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])
        positivity)
      fun_prop
    have hg_meas : Measurable (Function.uncurry g) :=
      (hΦ_meas.comp (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd)).mul (hK₀_cont.measurable.comp measurable_snd)
    have hg_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry g)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
      have h_uIoc : Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi) = Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        Set.uIoc_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le
      have h_const_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
        rw [h_uIoc]
        exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const (by rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
      have hK₀_int := (h_ker_mass h' 1 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).1
      refine (h_const_int.mul_prod (hK₀_int.const_mul (2 * B))).mono' hg_meas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => ?_)
      have hK_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 p.2 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh']))
      simp only [Function.uncurry, g, K₀, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hK_pos, one_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΦ_bd (p.1 - p.2)) hK_pos
    change (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ t : ℝ, g x t) = _
    rw [MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hg_prod]
    have h_inner : ∀ t : ℝ, (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g x t) =
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Φ x) * K₀ t := by
      intro t
      dsimp [g]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right Φ t]
      have h_per_eq := hΦ_per.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-t) 0
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) - t = -t := by ring
      have h2 : 2 * Real.pi - t = -t + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      have h3 : (0 : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi = 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      rw [h1, h2, h_per_eq, h3]
    simp_rw [h_inner]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      (h_ker_mass h' 1 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).2]
    dsimp [Φ]
    ring

  
  
  
  have h_bdry_upper : ∀ (h' : ℝ), 0 < h' →
      ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ),
        Continuous ϕ_pos → Continuous ϕ_neg →
        Function.Periodic ϕ_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic ϕ_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
        ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          Filter.Tendsto (stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg)
            (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h'))
            (nhds (ϕ_pos x₀)) := by
    intro h' hh' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg hcont_pos hcont_neg hper_pos hper_neg x₀
    have h_exists_M : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_pos x| ≤ M) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_neg x| ≤ M) := by
      have h_comp : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) := isCompact_Icc
      have h_ne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty := ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩⟩
      have h_max_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => max |ϕ_pos x| |ϕ_neg x|) :=
        (continuous_abs.comp hcont_pos).max (continuous_abs.comp hcont_neg)
      obtain ⟨x_max, _, hx_max⟩ := h_comp.exists_isMaxOn h_ne h_max_cont.continuousOn
      let M : ℝ := max |ϕ_pos x_max| |ϕ_neg x_max|
      refine ⟨M, le_max_of_le_left (abs_nonneg _), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x
        let k : ℤ := ⌊x / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        let x' : ℝ := x - k * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hx'_mem : x' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
          have h1 := Int.floor_le (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          have h2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          rw [le_div_iff₀ Real.two_pi_pos] at h1
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ Real.two_pi_pos] at h2
          dsimp [x', k]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h_eq : ϕ_pos x = ϕ_pos x' := by
          have := hper_pos.int_mul k x'
          dsimp [x'] at this ⊢
          have h_add : x - ↑k * (2 * Real.pi) + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi) = x := by ring
          rwa [h_add] at this
        rw [h_eq]
        exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hx_max hx'_mem)
      · intro x
        let k : ℤ := ⌊x / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
        let x' : ℝ := x - k * (2 * Real.pi)
        have hx'_mem : x' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := by
          have h1 := Int.floor_le (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          have h2 := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / (2 * Real.pi))
          rw [le_div_iff₀ Real.two_pi_pos] at h1
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ Real.two_pi_pos] at h2
          dsimp [x', k]
          exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h_eq : ϕ_neg x = ϕ_neg x' := by
          have := hper_neg.int_mul k x'
          dsimp [x'] at this ⊢
          have h_add : x - ↑k * (2 * Real.pi) + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi) = x := by ring
          rwa [h_add] at this
        rw [h_eq]
        exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hx_max hx'_mem)
    obtain ⟨M, hM_nonneg, hM_pos, hM_neg⟩ := h_exists_M
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont_pos.continuousAt (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    let δ : ℝ := δ₁ / 2
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := half_pos hδ₁_pos
    have h_cosh_gt : 1 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) := by
      have hcδ_pos : 0 < Real.pi * δ / (2 * h') := by positivity
      rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_neg, lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hexp_gt : 1 < Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) := Real.one_lt_exp_iff.mpr hcδ_pos
      have hsq : 0 < (Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) - 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hexp_gt)
      have : (Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) - 1) ^ 2 =
          Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) *
            (Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')) + (Real.exp (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')))⁻¹ - 2) := by
        field_simp [hexp_pos.ne']
        ring
      nlinarith
    let η_δ : ℝ := 1 - (Real.cosh (Real.pi * δ / (2 * h')))⁻¹
    have hη_δ_pos : 0 < η_δ := sub_pos.mpr (inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ h_cosh_gt)
    let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => M * Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) / η_δ
    let g₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => 2 * M * (1 / 2 - v / (2 * h'))
    have hg₁_cont : Continuous g₁ := by dsimp [g₁]; fun_prop
    have hg₂_cont : Continuous g₂ := by dsimp [g₂]; fun_prop
    have hg₁_val : g₁ h' = 0 := by
      dsimp [g₁]
      have : Real.pi * h' / (2 * h') = Real.pi / 2 := by field_simp [hh'.ne']
      rw [this, Real.cos_pi_div_two, mul_zero, zero_div]
    have hg₂_val : g₂ h' = 0 := by
      dsimp [g₂]
      have : h' / (2 * h') = 1 / 2 := by field_simp [hh'.ne']
      rw [this, sub_self, mul_zero]
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁_pos, hη₁⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hg₁_cont.continuousAt (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂_pos, hη₂⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hg₂_cont.continuousAt (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨min δ (min η₁ η₂), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro y hy_strip hy_dist
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hy_dist
    let u : ℝ := y.re
    let v : ℝ := y.im
    have hv_abs : |v| < h' := hy_strip
    have hu_close : |u - x₀| < δ := by
      have h1 : |u - x₀| ≤ ‖y - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := by
        simpa [u] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (y - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hy_dist (min_le_left _ _))
    have hv_close : |v - h'| < min η₁ η₂ := by
      have h1 : |v - h'| ≤ ‖y - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ := by
        simpa [v] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hy_dist (min_le_right _ _))
    have hg₁_lt : g₁ v < ε / 3 := by
      have h := hη₁ (lt_of_lt_of_le hv_close (min_le_left _ _))
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hg₁_val, sub_zero] at h
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h
    have hg₂_lt : g₂ v < ε / 3 := by
      have h := hη₂ (lt_of_lt_of_le hv_close (min_le_right _ _))
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hg₂_val, sub_zero] at h
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h
    have hP_pos_int := (h_shift_ker h' 1 u v hh' (Or.inl rfl) hv_abs).1
    have hP_neg_int := (h_shift_ker h' (-1) u v hh' (Or.inr rfl) hv_abs).1
    have hP0_int := (h_shift_ker h' 1 u 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).1
    have h_int1 := h_term_int h' M ϕ_pos hh' hcont_pos.measurable hM_pos 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy_strip
    have h_int2 := h_term_int h' M ϕ_neg hh' hcont_neg.measurable hM_neg (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy_strip
    have h_unit : ϕ_pos x₀ = ∫ x : ℝ,
        (ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (hP_pos_int.const_mul _) (hP_neg_int.const_mul _),
        MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
        (h_shift_ker h' 1 u v hh' (Or.inl rfl) hv_abs).2,
        (h_shift_ker h' (-1) u v hh' (Or.inr rfl) hv_abs).2]
      ring
    have h_diff_eq : stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg y - ϕ_pos x₀ =
        ∫ x : ℝ, ((ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          (ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) := by
      conv_lhs => rhs; rw [h_unit]
      unfold stripPoissonExt
      have h_int_sum1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
            ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        h_int1.add h_int2
      have h_int_sum2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
            ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (hP_pos_int.const_mul (ϕ_pos x₀)).add (hP_neg_int.const_mul (ϕ_pos x₀))
      change (∫ x : ℝ, (ϕ_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          ϕ_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v)) -
        (∫ x : ℝ, (ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          ϕ_pos x₀ * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v)) = _
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_int_sum1 h_int_sum2]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      dsimp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    rw [Real.dist_eq, h_diff_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) ?_
    let C_tail : ℝ := 2 * M * Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) / η_δ
    have hC_tail_nonneg : 0 ≤ C_tail := by
      have hv' := abs_lt.mp hv_abs
      have hcos_pos : 0 < Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) := by
        apply Real.cos_pos_of_mem_Ioo
        constructor
        · rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.1 Real.pi_pos]
        · rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; linarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv'.2 Real.pi_pos]
      dsimp [C_tail]
      positivity
    have h_pt : ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖(ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          (ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v‖ ≤
        (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 +
          (2 * M) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v := by
      intro x
      have hK1_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 (u - x) v hh' (Or.inl rfl) hv_abs)
      have hK2_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' (-1) (u - x) v hh' (Or.inr rfl) hv_abs)
      have hK0_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h' 1 (u - x) 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh']))
      have h_term2 : ‖(ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v‖ ≤
          (2 * M) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hK2_pos]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (by linarith [hM_neg x, hM_pos x₀])) hK2_pos
      have h_term1 : ‖(ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v‖ ≤
          (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
            C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hK1_pos]
        rcases lt_or_ge |u - x| δ with h_near | h_far
        · have hx_dist : dist x x₀ < δ₁ := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq]
            have : |x - u| = |u - x| := abs_sub_comm x u
            dsimp [δ] at h_near hu_close
            linarith [abs_sub_le x u x₀]
          have h_osc := hδ₁ hx_dist
          rw [Real.dist_eq] at h_osc
          have h_le1 : |ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v ≤
              (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_osc.le hK1_pos
          linarith [mul_nonneg hC_tail_nonneg hK0_pos]
        · have h_tail := h_ker_tail_dom h' δ 1 (u - x) v hh' hδ_pos (Or.inl rfl) hv_abs h_far
          have h_bd : |ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀| ≤ 2 * M :=
            le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (by linarith [hM_pos x, hM_pos x₀])
          have h_le2 : |ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v ≤
              C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 := by
            calc |ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀| * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v
                ≤ (2 * M) * ((Real.cos (Real.pi * v / (2 * h')) / η_δ) *
                    stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0) :=
                  mul_le_mul h_bd h_tail hK1_pos (by positivity)
              _ = C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 := by dsimp [C_tail]; ring
          linarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ ε / 3 by positivity) hK1_pos]
      exact le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
    have h_lhs_inner : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          (ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      have h1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => (ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v)
          MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (h_int1.sub (hP_pos_int.const_mul (ϕ_pos x₀))).congr
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by dsimp [Pi.sub_apply, u, v]; ring))
      have h2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => (ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v)
          MeasureTheory.volume :=
        (h_int2.sub (hP_neg_int.const_mul (ϕ_pos x₀))).congr
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by dsimp [Pi.sub_apply, u, v]; ring))
      exact h1.add h2
    have h_lhs_int := h_lhs_inner.norm
    have h_rhs12_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hP_pos_int.const_mul (ε / 3)).add (hP0_int.const_mul C_tail)
    have h_rhs3_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (2 * M) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hP_neg_int.const_mul (2 * M)
    have h_rhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
          C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 +
          (2 * M) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_rhs12_int.add h_rhs3_int
    calc (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(ϕ_pos x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
            (ϕ_neg x - ϕ_pos x₀) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v‖)
        ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ((ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v +
            C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0 +
            (2 * M) * stripPoissonKernel h' (-1) (u - x) v) :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_int h_pt
      _ = (ε / 3) * (1 / 2 + 1 * v / (2 * h')) + C_tail * (1 / 2 + 1 * 0 / (2 * h')) +
            (2 * M) * (1 / 2 + (-1) * v / (2 * h')) := by
          have hr1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun x : ℝ => (ε / 3) * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) v) MeasureTheory.volume :=
            hP_pos_int.const_mul (ε / 3)
          have hr2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun x : ℝ => C_tail * stripPoissonKernel h' 1 (u - x) 0) MeasureTheory.volume :=
            hP0_int.const_mul C_tail
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add h_rhs12_int h_rhs3_int,
            MeasureTheory.integral_add hr1 hr2,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
            (h_shift_ker h' 1 u v hh' (Or.inl rfl) hv_abs).2,
            (h_shift_ker h' 1 u 0 hh' (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh'])).2,
            (h_shift_ker h' (-1) u v hh' (Or.inr rfl) hv_abs).2]
      _ = (ε / 3) * (1 / 2 + v / (2 * h')) + g₁ v + g₂ v := by
          dsimp [C_tail, g₁, g₂]; ring
      _ < ε := by
          have hv_lt : v < h' := (abs_lt.mp hv_abs).2
          have h_mass_lt : 1 / 2 + v / (2 * h') < 1 := by
            have : v / (2 * h') < 1 / 2 := by
              rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
              linarith
            linarith
          nlinarith

  have h_bdry_part : ∀ (h' : ℝ), 0 < h' →
      ∀ (ϕ_pos ϕ_neg : ℝ → ℝ),
        Continuous ϕ_pos → Continuous ϕ_neg →
        Function.Periodic ϕ_pos (2 * Real.pi) → Function.Periodic ϕ_neg (2 * Real.pi) →
        ∀ x₀ : ℝ,
          Filter.Tendsto (stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg)
            (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h'))
            (nhds (ϕ_pos x₀)) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg)
            (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) - (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h'))
            (nhds (ϕ_neg x₀)) := by
    intro h' hh' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg hcont_pos hcont_neg hper_pos hper_neg x₀
    refine ⟨h_bdry_upper h' hh' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg hcont_pos hcont_neg hper_pos hper_neg x₀, ?_⟩
    have h_conj_ext : ∀ z : ℂ,
        stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_pos ϕ_neg z =
          stripPoissonExt h' ϕ_neg ϕ_pos (starRingEnd ℂ z) := by
      intro z
      unfold stripPoissonExt
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      simp only [Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im, stripPoissonKernel,
        mul_neg, neg_div, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      ring
    have h_conj_pt : starRingEnd ℂ ((x₀ : ℂ) - (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        (x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h_conj_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (starRingEnd ℂ)
        (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) - (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h'))
        (nhdsWithin ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h' : ℂ) * Complex.I) (horizStrip h')) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← h_conj_pt]
        exact Complex.continuous_conj.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun z hz => ?_)
        have hz_abs : |z.im| < h' := hz
        change |(starRingEnd ℂ z).im| < h'
        simpa [Complex.conj_im] using hz_abs
    have h_swapped :=
      (h_bdry_upper h' hh' ϕ_neg ϕ_pos hcont_neg hcont_pos hper_neg hper_pos x₀).comp h_conj_tendsto
    exact h_swapped.congr (fun z => (h_conj_ext z).symm)

  
  
  
  have h_cavg_im_sq : ∀ (c : ℂ) (r : ℝ),
      Real.circleAverage (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2) c r = c.im ^ 2 + r ^ 2 / 2 := by
    intro c r
    let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ =>
      ((c.im ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - ((2 * c.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ζ - c) -
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (ζ - c) ^ 2
    have hP_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ P Set.univ := by
      have hP_diff : Differentiable ℂ P := by dsimp [P]; fun_prop
      exact hP_diff.differentiableOn.analyticOnNhd isOpen_univ
    have hP_harm : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (fun ζ => (P ζ).re) (Metric.closedBall c |r|) :=
      fun ζ _ => (hP_an ζ trivial).harmonicAt_re
    have hP_cavg : Real.circleAverage (fun ζ => (P ζ).re) c r = c.im ^ 2 := by
      rw [hP_harm.circleAverage_eq]
      dsimp [P]
      simp
    have hP_re : ∀ ζ : ℂ, (P ζ).re + ‖ζ - c‖ ^ 2 / 2 = ζ.im ^ 2 := by
      intro ζ
      rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
      dsimp [P]
      simp only [sq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
      ring
    have h_sphere : Set.EqOn (fun ζ : ℂ => ζ.im ^ 2)
        (fun ζ : ℂ => (P ζ).re + r ^ 2 / 2) (Metric.sphere c |r|) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
      dsimp only
      rw [← hP_re ζ, hζ, sq_abs]
    have hP_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun ζ : ℂ => (P ζ).re) c r := by
      have hP_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℂ => (P ζ).re) := by dsimp [P]; fun_prop
      exact hP_cont.continuousOn.circleIntegrable'
    have h_const_ci : CircleIntegrable (fun _ : ℂ => r ^ 2 / 2) c r :=
      continuousOn_const.circleIntegrable'
    rw [Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_sphere,
      Real.circleAverage_fun_add hP_ci h_const_ci,
      hP_cavg, Real.circleAverage_const]

  refine
    { cont_on_and_bound := h_int_part h hh
      real_period_integral := h_period_part h hh

  intro v v_pos v_neg B hv_cont hv_per hB hv_bd hv_cavg
    hv_pos_meas hv_neg_meas _hv_pos_per _hv_neg_per hv_pm_bd hv_ae
  let h_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (1 - 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 2)) * h
  let ϕ_seq_pos : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k x => v ((x : ℂ) + (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  let ϕ_seq_neg : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k x => v ((x : ℂ) - (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hh_seq_bounds : ∀ k : ℕ, h / 2 ≤ h_seq k ∧ h_seq k < h := by
    intro k
    have hk2_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]
    have hk2_pos : 0 < (k : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith
    have h_inv_le : 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hk2_ge
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    dsimp [h_seq]
    exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  have hϕ_seq_props : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Continuous (ϕ_seq_pos k) ∧ Continuous (ϕ_seq_neg k) ∧
      Function.Periodic (ϕ_seq_pos k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      Function.Periodic (ϕ_seq_neg k) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |ϕ_seq_pos k x| ≤ B ∧ |ϕ_seq_neg k x| ≤ B) := by
    intro k
    rcases hh_seq_bounds k with ⟨hhk_ge, hhk_lt⟩
    have hhk_pos : 0 < h_seq k := lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hh) hhk_ge
    have h_up_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) + (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip h := by
      intro x
      change |((x : ℂ) + (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < h
      simpa [abs_of_pos hhk_pos] using hhk_lt
    have h_dn_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) - (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip h := by
      intro x
      change |((x : ℂ) - (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I).im| < h
      simpa [abs_of_pos hhk_pos] using hhk_lt
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hv_cont.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) h_up_mem
    · exact hv_cont.comp_continuous (by fun_prop) h_dn_mem
    · intro x
      dsimp [ϕ_seq_pos]
      have h_arg : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          ((x : ℂ) + (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, hv_per _ (h_up_mem x)]
    · intro x
      dsimp [ϕ_seq_neg]
      have h_arg : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) - (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I =
          ((x : ℂ) - (h_seq k : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_arg, hv_per _ (h_dn_mem x)]
    · intro x
      exact ⟨hv_bd _ (h_up_mem x), hv_bd _ (h_dn_mem x)⟩

  
  have h_narrow_rep : ∀ (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ), z ∈ horizStrip (h_seq k) →
      v z = stripPoissonExt (h_seq k) (ϕ_seq_pos k) (ϕ_seq_neg k) z := by
    intro k
    let hk : ℝ := h_seq k
    rcases hh_seq_bounds k with ⟨hhk_ge, hhk_lt⟩
    have hhk_pos : 0 < hk := lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hh) hhk_ge
    rcases hϕ_seq_props k with ⟨hc_pos, hc_neg, hp_pos, hp_neg, hbd_pm⟩
    let S_hk : Set ℂ := { z : ℂ | |z.im| ≤ hk }
    have hS_sub : S_hk ⊆ horizStrip h := fun z hz => lt_of_le_of_lt hz hhk_lt
    let U_k : ℂ → ℝ := fun z =>
      if |z.im| < hk then
        stripPoissonExt hk (ϕ_seq_pos k) (ϕ_seq_neg k) z
      else if 0 ≤ z.im then
        ϕ_seq_pos k z.re
      else
        ϕ_seq_neg k z.re
    have hUk_per : ∀ z : ℂ, U_k (z + 2 * Real.pi) = U_k z := by
      intro z
      have him : (z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).im = z.im := by simp
      have hre : (z + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)).re = z.re + 2 * Real.pi := by simp
      simp only [U_k, him, hre]
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · unfold stripPoissonExt
        rw [him, hre]
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
          (fun x : ℝ => ϕ_seq_pos k x * stripPoissonKernel hk 1 (z.re + 2 * Real.pi - x) z.im +
            ϕ_seq_neg k x * stripPoissonKernel hk (-1) (z.re + 2 * Real.pi - x) z.im)
          (2 * Real.pi)]
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))

            abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * hk by positivity)]
          dsimp [β_star]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity)
            (by linarith)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Real.sin_le_sin_of_le_of_le_pi_div_two
          (by linarith [(abs_le.mp h_abs).1])
          hβ_star_lt.le
          (abs_le.mp h_abs).2
      have h_cosh_le : Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h)) ≤
          Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * hk)) := by
        refine Real.cosh_le_cosh.mpr ?_
        rw [abs_div, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos,
          abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * h by positivity),
          abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * hk by positivity)]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by positivity) (by dsimp [hk]; linarith)
      have h_cosh_ge1 : 1 ≤ Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * hk)) := Real.one_le_cosh _
      have h_den_ge : (1 - c_star) * Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h)) ≤
          Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * hk)) -
            sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * w / (2 * hk)) := by
        nlinarith
      have h_cos_le : Real.cos (Real.pi * w / (2 * hk)) ≤ 1 := Real.cos_le_one _
      unfold stripPoissonKernel
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_div, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]
      have h_cosh_h_pos : 0 < Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h)) := Real.cosh_pos _
      calc Real.cos (Real.pi * w / (2 * hk)) /
            (4 * hk * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * hk)) -
              sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * w / (2 * hk))))
          ≤ 1 / (2 * h * ((1 - c_star) * Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h)))) := by
            refine div_le_div₀ zero_le_one h_cos_le (by positivity) ?_
            have : 2 * h ≤ 4 * hk := by dsimp [hk]; linarith
            exact mul_le_mul this h_den_ge (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = (2 / (1 - c_star)) * (1 / (4 * h * Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h)))) := by
            field_simp [h1mc_pos.ne', hh.ne', h_cosh_h_pos.ne']
            norm_num
    let F_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m x =>
      ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) 1 (u - x) w +
      ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) (-1) (u - x) w
    let F_lim : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      v_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (u - x) w +
      v_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h (-1) (u - x) w
    let g_dom : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      (4 * B / (1 - c_star)) * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (u - x) 0
    have hg_dom_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g_dom MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (h_shift_ker h 1 u 0 hh (Or.inl rfl) (by simp [hh])).1.const_mul _
    have hF_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F_seq m) MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro m
      rcases hh_seq_bounds (k₀ + m) with ⟨hhk_ge, _⟩
      have hhk_pos : 0 < h_seq (k₀ + m) := lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hh) hhk_ge
      have hy_hk : y ∈ horizStrip (h_seq (k₀ + m)) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hh_star_gt (hk_ge_star m)
      rcases hϕ_seq_props (k₀ + m) with ⟨hc_pos, hc_neg, _, _, hbd_pm⟩
      exact ((h_term_int (h_seq (k₀ + m)) B (ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m)) hhk_pos hc_pos.measurable
        (fun x => (hbd_pm x).1) 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy_hk).add
        (h_term_int (h_seq (k₀ + m)) B (ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m)) hhk_pos hc_neg.measurable
        (fun x => (hbd_pm x).2) (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy_hk)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hF_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, ‖F_seq m x‖ ≤ g_dom x := by
      intro m
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      rcases hh_seq_bounds (k₀ + m) with ⟨hhk_ge, _⟩
      have hhk_pos : 0 < h_seq (k₀ + m) := lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hh) hhk_ge
      have hw_hk : |w| < h_seq (k₀ + m) := lt_of_lt_of_le hh_star_gt (hk_ge_star m)
      have h1_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos (h_seq (k₀ + m)) 1 (u - x) w hhk_pos (Or.inl rfl) hw_hk)
      have h2_pos := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos (h_seq (k₀ + m)) (-1) (u - x) w hhk_pos (Or.inr rfl) hw_hk)
      rcases (hϕ_seq_props (k₀ + m)).2.2.2.2 x with ⟨hb1, hb2⟩
      have hd1 := h_unif_ker m 1 x (Or.inl rfl)
      have hd2 := h_unif_ker m (-1) x (Or.inr rfl)
      dsimp [F_seq, g_dom]
      calc ‖ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) 1 (u - x) w +
              ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) (-1) (u - x) w‖
          ≤ ‖ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) 1 (u - x) w‖ +
              ‖ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m) x * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) (-1) (u - x) w‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m) x| * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) 1 (u - x) w +
              |ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m) x| * stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) (-1) (u - x) w := by
            simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h1_pos, abs_of_nonneg h2_pos]
        _ ≤ B * ((2 / (1 - c_star)) * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (u - x) 0) +
              B * ((2 / (1 - c_star)) * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (u - x) 0) :=
            add_le_add (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb1 h1_pos)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd1 hB))
              (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb2 h2_pos)
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd2 hB))
        _ = (4 * B / (1 - c_star)) * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (u - x) 0 := by ring
    have hh_seq_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => h_seq (k₀ + m)) Filter.atTop (nhds h) := by
      have h_inv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => 1 / (((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h_atTop : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)
            Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
          have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (m : ℝ) + ((k₀ : ℝ) + 2))
              Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
            tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_add tendsto_const_nhds
          exact h1.congr (fun m => by push_cast; ring)
        simpa only [one_div, Function.comp_def] using tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp h_atTop
      have h_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (1 - 1 / (((k₀ + m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2)) * h)
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 - 0) * h)) :=
        (tendsto_const_nhds.sub h_inv).mul tendsto_const_nhds
      simpa [h_seq] using h_sub
    have h_ker_tend : ∀ (sgn x : ℝ), (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => stripPoissonKernel (h_seq (k₀ + m)) sgn (u - x) w)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (stripPoissonKernel h sgn (u - x) w)) := by
      intro sgn x hsgn
      have h_cat : ContinuousAt
          (fun h' : ℝ => stripPoissonKernel h' sgn (u - x) w) h := by
        unfold stripPoissonKernel
        have h_div_w : ContinuousAt (fun h' : ℝ => Real.pi * w / (2 * h')) h :=
          continuousAt_const.div (continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id) (by positivity)
        have h_div_u : ContinuousAt (fun h' : ℝ => Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h')) h :=
          continuousAt_const.div (continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id) (by positivity)
        have h_num_c : ContinuousAt (Real.cos ∘ fun h' : ℝ => Real.pi * w / (2 * h')) h :=
          Real.continuous_cos.continuousAt.comp h_div_w
        have h_num : ContinuousAt (fun h' : ℝ => Real.cos (Real.pi * w / (2 * h'))) h := h_num_c
        have h_cosh_c : ContinuousAt (Real.cosh ∘ fun h' : ℝ => Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h')) h :=
          Real.continuous_cosh.continuousAt.comp h_div_u
        have h_sin_c : ContinuousAt (Real.sin ∘ fun h' : ℝ => Real.pi * w / (2 * h')) h :=
          Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp h_div_w
        have h_den : ContinuousAt (fun h' : ℝ =>
            4 * h' * (Real.cosh (Real.pi * (u - x) / (2 * h')) -
              sgn * Real.sin (Real.pi * w / (2 * h')))) h :=
          (continuousAt_const.mul continuousAt_id).mul
            (h_cosh_c.sub (continuousAt_const.mul h_sin_c))
        have h_den_pos := h_ker_denom_pos h sgn (u - x) w hh hsgn hw_abs
        exact h_num.div h_den (by positivity)
      exact h_cat.tendsto.comp hh_seq_tend
    have hF_ae_lim : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => F_seq m x) Filter.atTop (nhds (F_lim x)) := by
      filter_upwards [hv_ae] with x ⟨hx_pos, hx_neg⟩
      have h_shift_idx : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => m + k₀) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat k₀
      have hx_pos' : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ϕ_seq_pos (k₀ + m) x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (v_pos x)) :=
        (hx_pos.comp h_shift_idx).congr (fun m => by
          dsimp [Function.comp_def, ϕ_seq_pos, h_seq]
          rw [add_comm m k₀])
      have hx_neg' : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ϕ_seq_neg (k₀ + m) x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (v_neg x)) :=
        (hx_neg.comp h_shift_idx).congr (fun m => by
          dsimp [Function.comp_def, ϕ_seq_neg, h_seq]
          rw [add_comm m k₀])
      exact (hx_pos'.mul (h_ker_tend 1 x (Or.inl rfl))).add
        (hx_neg'.mul (h_ker_tend (-1) x (Or.inr rfl)))
    have h_int_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∫ x : ℝ, F_seq m x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ x : ℝ, F_lim x)) :=
      MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence g_dom
        hF_meas hg_dom_int hF_bound hF_ae_lim
    have h_const_seq : ∀ m : ℕ, (∫ x : ℝ, F_seq m x) = v y := by
      intro m
      have hy_hk : y ∈ horizStrip (h_seq (k₀ + m)) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hh_star_gt (hk_ge_star m)
      exact (h_narrow_rep (k₀ + m) y hy_hk).symm
    have h_tend_vy : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∫ x : ℝ, F_seq m x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (v y)) := by
      simp_rw [h_const_seq]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_tend_vy h_int_tend

  
  intro n y hy
  let ϕ_n_pos : ℝ → ℝ := ϕ_seq_pos n
  let ϕ_n_neg : ℝ → ℝ := ϕ_seq_neg n
  rcases hϕ_seq_props n with ⟨hc_pos, hc_neg, _, _, hbd_pm⟩
  let Δ_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => v_pos x - ϕ_n_pos x
  let Δ_neg : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => v_neg x - ϕ_n_neg x
  let P_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => stripPoissonKernel h 1 (y.re - x) y.im
  let P_neg : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => stripPoissonKernel h (-1) (y.re - x) y.im
  have hΔ_pos_meas : Measurable Δ_pos := hv_pos_meas.sub hc_pos.measurable
  have hΔ_neg_meas : Measurable Δ_neg := hv_neg_meas.sub hc_neg.measurable
  have hΔ_pos_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |Δ_pos x| ≤ 2 * B := fun x =>
    le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (by linarith [(hv_pm_bd x).1, (hbd_pm x).1])
  have hΔ_neg_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |Δ_neg x| ≤ 2 * B := fun x =>
    le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (by linarith [(hv_pm_bd x).2, (hbd_pm x).2])
  have hΔ_pos_sq_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |Δ_pos x ^ 2| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), ← sq_abs]
    nlinarith [hΔ_pos_bd x, abs_nonneg (Δ_pos x)]
  have hΔ_neg_sq_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, |Δ_neg x ^ 2| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), ← sq_abs]
    nlinarith [hΔ_neg_bd x, abs_nonneg (Δ_neg x)]
  have h_iv_pos := h_term_int h B v_pos hh hv_pos_meas (fun x => (hv_pm_bd x).1) 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy
  have h_iv_neg := h_term_int h B v_neg hh hv_neg_meas (fun x => (hv_pm_bd x).2) (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy
  have h_iϕ_pos := h_term_int h B ϕ_n_pos hh hc_pos.measurable (fun x => (hbd_pm x).1) 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy
  have h_iϕ_neg := h_term_int h B ϕ_n_neg hh hc_neg.measurable (fun x => (hbd_pm x).2) (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy
  have h_iΔ_pos := h_term_int h (2 * B) Δ_pos hh hΔ_pos_meas hΔ_pos_bd 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy
  have h_iΔ_neg := h_term_int h (2 * B) Δ_neg hh hΔ_neg_meas hΔ_neg_bd (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy
  have h_iΔ2_pos := h_term_int h (4 * B ^ 2) (fun x => Δ_pos x ^ 2) hh
    (hΔ_pos_meas.pow_const 2) hΔ_pos_sq_bd 1 (Or.inl rfl) y hy
  have h_iΔ2_neg := h_term_int h (4 * B ^ 2) (fun x => Δ_neg x ^ 2) hh
    (hΔ_neg_meas.pow_const 2) hΔ_neg_sq_bd (-1) (Or.inr rfl) y hy
  have h_iP_pos := (h_shift_ker h 1 y.re y.im hh (Or.inl rfl) hy).1
  have h_iP_neg := (h_shift_ker h (-1) y.re y.im hh (Or.inr rfl) hy).1
  let c_diff : ℝ := v y - stripPoissonExt h ϕ_n_pos ϕ_n_neg y
  have h_int_Δ : (∫ x : ℝ, (Δ_pos x * P_pos x + Δ_neg x * P_neg x)) = c_diff := by
    dsimp [c_diff]
    rw [h_full_rep y hy]
    unfold stripPoissonExt
    have h_sum_v : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => v_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
          v_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h (-1) (y.re - x) y.im) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_iv_pos.add h_iv_neg
    have h_sum_ϕ : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => ϕ_n_pos x * stripPoissonKernel h 1 (y.re - x) y.im +
          ϕ_n_neg x * stripPoissonKernel h (-1) (y.re - x) y.im) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_iϕ_pos.add h_iϕ_neg
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_sum_v h_sum_ϕ]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    dsimp [Pi.sub_apply, Δ_pos, Δ_neg, P_pos, P_neg]
    ring
  have h_int_P : (∫ x : ℝ, (P_pos x + P_neg x)) = 1 := by
    have h_iP_pos' : MeasureTheory.Integrable P_pos MeasureTheory.volume := h_iP_pos
    have h_iP_neg' : MeasureTheory.Integrable P_neg MeasureTheory.volume := h_iP_neg
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add h_iP_pos' h_iP_neg']
    dsimp [P_pos, P_neg]
    rw [(h_shift_ker h 1 y.re y.im hh (Or.inl rfl) hy).2,
      (h_shift_ker h (-1) y.re y.im hh (Or.inr rfl) hy).2]
    ring
  let W_n : ℝ := stripPoissonExt h (fun x => Δ_pos x ^ 2) (fun x => Δ_neg x ^ 2) y
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ,
      ((Δ_pos x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_pos x + (Δ_neg x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_neg x) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun x => ?_)
    have h1 := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h 1 (y.re - x) y.im hh (Or.inl rfl) hy)
    have h2 := le_of_lt (h_ker_pos h (-1) (y.re - x) y.im hh (Or.inr rfl) hy)
    positivity
  have h_expand : (∫ x : ℝ,
      ((Δ_pos x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_pos x + (Δ_neg x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_neg x)) =
      W_n - c_diff ^ 2 := by
    have h_id : ∀ x : ℝ,
        (Δ_pos x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_pos x + (Δ_neg x - c_diff) ^ 2 * P_neg x =
        (Δ_pos x ^ 2 * P_pos x + Δ_neg x ^ 2 * P_neg x) -
          (2 * c_diff) * (Δ_pos x * P_pos x + Δ_neg x * P_neg x) +
          c_diff ^ 2 * (P_pos x + P_neg x) := fun _ => by ring
    simp_rw [h_id]
    have hi1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Δ_pos x ^ 2 * P_pos x + Δ_neg x ^ 2 * P_neg x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_iΔ2_pos.add h_iΔ2_neg
    have hi_Δ : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => Δ_pos x * P_pos x + Δ_neg x * P_neg x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_iΔ_pos.add h_iΔ_neg
    have hi2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (2 * c_diff) * (Δ_pos x * P_pos x + Δ_neg x * P_neg x))
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hi_Δ.const_mul (2 * c_diff)
    have hi12 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => (Δ_pos x ^ 2 * P_pos x + Δ_neg x ^ 2 * P_neg x) -
          (2 * c_diff) * (Δ_pos x * P_pos x + Δ_neg x * P_neg x)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hi1.sub hi2
    have hi_P : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => P_pos x + P_neg x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      h_iP_pos.add h_iP_neg
    have hi3 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ => c_diff ^ 2 * (P_pos x + P_neg x)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hi_P.const_mul (c_diff ^ 2)
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hi12 hi3, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hi1 hi2,
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      h_int_Δ, h_int_P]
    dsimp [W_n, stripPoissonExt, P_pos, P_neg]
    ring
  rw [h_expand] at h_nonneg
  change c_diff ^ 2 ≤ W_n
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  have h_int_const : ∀ c : ℝ, (∫ _ : WalkSpace, c ∂walkMeasure) = c := fun c => by
    simp [MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  let A₀ : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | om 0 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)}
  have hA₀_meas : MeasurableSet A₀ := measurableSet_Ico.preimage (measurable_pi_apply 0)
  have hA₀_compl_null : walkMeasure A₀ᶜ = 0 := by
    have h_pre : A₀ᶜ = (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ := rfl
    rw [h_pre, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0) measurableSet_Ico.compl]
    change (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure)))
      (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ = 0
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0]
    simp [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ico.compl]
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h \ P.Z_all
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_mem : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_mem).1
  have h_strip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_real_in_strip : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := fun x => by
    simp [horizStrip, hh_pos]
  have h_impact_reg : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip h) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ horizStrip h, |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val w).im| < S.H) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)).im = 0) := by
    intro j
    let ι_j : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun w =>
      (w + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ))
    have hι_diff : Differentiable ℂ ι_j :=
      (differentiable_id.add (differentiable_const _)).prodMk (differentiable_const _)
    have hι_maps : Set.MapsTo ι_j (horizStrip h) (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) := by
      intro w hw
      rcases abs_lt.mp (show |w.im| < h from hw) with ⟨hw_lo, hw_hi⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [ι_j, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos] using
          P.t₀_lt_r_star
      · have h_im : (ι_j w).1.im = w.im := by simp [ι_j]
        have h_hx : S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ (ι_j w).2) = h := by
          simp [ι_j, Complex.conj_ofReal, h, sliceHeight]
        linarith
      · have h_im : (ι_j w).1.im = w.im := by simp [ι_j]
        have h_hx : S.h_X (ι_j w).2 = h := rfl
        linarith
    refine ⟨S.𝔰_holo.comp hι_diff.differentiableOn hι_maps,
      fun w hw => S.𝔰_maps_to (ι_j w) (hι_maps hw), ?_⟩
    intro x
    have hc := S.𝔰_conj (ι_j (x : ℂ)) (hι_maps (h_real_in_strip x))
    have h1 : starRingEnd ℂ (ι_j (x : ℂ)).1 = (ι_j (x : ℂ)).1 := by simp [ι_j]
    have h2 : starRingEnd ℂ (ι_j (x : ℂ)).2 = (ι_j (x : ℂ)).2 := by simp [ι_j]
    rw [h1, h2] at hc
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hc.symm

  
  
  
  have h_reg_ball : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
      ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 ∧
      ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y ∧
      0 < sliceSingDist S P y ∧
      Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := by
    intro y hy
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (hAdm.pos_iff y).mpr hy
    have h_le := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have h_le_100 : ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 :=
      le_trans h_le (by linarith [min_le_left (1 : ℝ) (sliceSingDist S P y)])
    have h_le_ds : ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y :=
      le_trans h_le (by linarith [min_le_right (1 : ℝ) (sliceSingDist S P y)])
    have hds_pos : 0 < sliceSingDist S P y := by linarith
    refine ⟨h_le_100, h_le_ds, hds_pos, ?_⟩
    intro ζ hζ
    by_contra hζ_not
    have hζ_comp : ζ ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P := hζ_not
    have h_inf : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ := Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hζ_comp
    rw [dist_comm] at h_inf
    linarith [Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hζ]
  have h_walk_step_eq : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (m : ℕ),
      walkPos ρ om (m + 1) = circleMap (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) (om (m + 1)) :=
    fun om m => by simp [walkPos, circleMap]
  have h_circleMap_norm : ∀ (y : ℂ) (r θ : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → ‖circleMap y r θ - y‖ = r := by
    intro y r θ hr
    simp only [circleMap, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
  have h_walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
      walkPos ρ om m ∈ Ω_reg ∧ 0 < ρ (walkPos ρ om m) := by
    intro om m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        have hy₀ : walkPos ρ om 0 ∈ Ω_reg :=
          ⟨h_real_in_strip (om 0), P.real_not_mem_Z_all (om 0)⟩
        exact ⟨hy₀, (hAdm.pos_iff _).mpr hy₀⟩
    | succ m ih =>
        have h_mem_ball : walkPos ρ om (m + 1) ∈
            Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, h_walk_step_eq,
            h_circleMap_norm _ _ _ ih.2.le]
        have hy₁ : walkPos ρ om (m + 1) ∈ Ω_reg := (h_reg_ball _ ih.1).2.2.2 h_mem_ball
        exact ⟨hy₁, (hAdm.pos_iff _).mpr hy₁⟩

  
  
  
  let Xm : (m : ℕ) → WalkSpace → (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) :=
    fun m => (Finset.range (m + 1)).restrict
  let prefSigma : ℕ → MeasurableSpace WalkSpace :=
    fun m => MeasurableSpace.comap (Xm m) inferInstance
  have hXm_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (Xm m) :=
    fun m => measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1)
  have h_pref_le : ∀ m : ℕ, prefSigma m ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace WalkSpace) :=
    fun m => (hXm_meas m).comap_le
  have h_pref_mono : ∀ {j k : ℕ}, j ≤ k → prefSigma j ≤ prefSigma k := by
    intro j k hjk
    let π_jk : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → (Finset.range (j + 1) → ℝ) :=
      fun p i => p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2) (Nat.add_le_add_right hjk 1))⟩
    have hπ_meas : Measurable π_jk := measurable_pi_iff.mpr (fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _)
    dsimp only [prefSigma]
    change MeasurableSpace.comap (π_jk ∘ Xm k) inferInstance ≤ _
    rw [← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
    exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono hπ_meas.comap_le
  have h_coord_pref_meas : ∀ {k m : ℕ}, k ≤ m →
      @Measurable WalkSpace ℝ (prefSigma m) _ (fun om => om k) := by
    intro k m hkm
    let idx : Finset.range (m + 1) := ⟨k, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hkm)⟩
    have hXm_self : @Measurable WalkSpace (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) (prefSigma m) _ (Xm m) :=
      fun s hs => ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact fun s hs => hXm_self ((measurable_pi_apply idx) hs)
  let F_step : ℂ × ℝ → ℂ :=
    fun p => p.1 + (ρ p.1 : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have hF_step_meas : Measurable F_step :=
    measurable_fst.add
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp measurable_fst)).mul
        (Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
          ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)))
  have h_walk_adapted : ∀ m : ℕ,
      @Measurable WalkSpace ℂ (prefSigma m) _ (fun om => walkPos ρ om m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        exact fun s hs => (h_coord_pref_meas le_rfl) (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable hs)
    | succ m ih =>
        have hy_m : @Measurable WalkSpace ℂ (prefSigma (m + 1)) _ (fun om => walkPos ρ om m) :=
          ih.mono (h_pref_mono (Nat.le_succ m)) le_rfl
        have hom_m1 : @Measurable WalkSpace ℝ (prefSigma (m + 1)) _ (fun om => om (m + 1)) :=
          h_coord_pref_meas le_rfl
        have h_pair : @Measurable WalkSpace (ℂ × ℝ) (prefSigma (m + 1)) _
            (fun om => (walkPos ρ om m, om (m + 1))) :=
          Measurable.prodMk (m := prefSigma (m + 1)) hy_m hom_m1
        exact fun s hs => h_pair (hF_step_meas hs)
  have h_walk_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) :=
    fun m => (h_walk_adapted m).mono (h_pref_le m) le_rfl
  let extZero : (m : ℕ) → (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → WalkSpace :=
    fun m p n => if hn : n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) then p ⟨n, hn⟩ else 0
  have h_Xm_ext : ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ), Xm m (extZero m p) = p := by
    intro m p
    ext i
    dsimp only [Xm, Finset.restrict, extZero]
    simp only [i.2, ↓reduceDIte]
  have h_ext_pref_meas : ∀ m : ℕ,
      @Measurable (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) WalkSpace _ (prefSigma m) (extZero m) := by
    rintro m s ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
    change MeasurableSet ((Xm m ∘ extZero m) ⁻¹' B)
    rw [show Xm m ∘ extZero m = id from funext (h_Xm_ext m)]
    exact hB
  have h_factor_real : ∀ (m : ℕ) {H : WalkSpace → ℝ},
      @Measurable WalkSpace ℝ (prefSigma m) _ H →
      ∀ om : WalkSpace, H (extZero m (Xm m om)) = H om := by
    intro m H hH om
    rcases hH (measurableSet_singleton (H om)) with ⟨B, _, hB⟩
    have hom : Xm m om ∈ B := by
      change om ∈ Xm m ⁻¹' B
      rw [hB]
      rfl
    have hext : extZero m (Xm m om) ∈ H ⁻¹' {H om} := by
      rw [← hB]
      change Xm m (extZero m (Xm m om)) ∈ B
      rwa [h_Xm_ext]
    exact hext
  have h_walk_depends : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
      (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → walkPos ρ om₁ k = walkPos ρ om₂ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [walkPos, h_eq 0 le_rfl]
    | succ k ih =>
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have hk := ih om₁ om₂ (fun l hl => h_eq l (Nat.le_succ_of_le hl))
        simp [walkPos, hk, h_eq (k + 1) le_rfl]
  have h_walk_ext : ∀ (m : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
      walkPos ρ (extZero m (Xm m om)) m = walkPos ρ om m := by
    intro m om
    refine h_walk_depends m _ _ (fun l hl => ?_)
    have hl_mem : l ∈ Finset.range (m + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hl)
    dsimp only [extZero, Xm, Finset.restrict]
    simp only [hl_mem, ↓reduceDIte]
  have h_impact_walk_meas : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ),
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
    intro j n
    have h_sub : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        (⟨walkPos ρ om n, (h_walk_in_reg om n).1.1⟩ : horizStrip h)) :=
      (h_walk_meas n).subtype_mk
    exact ((continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp
      (h_impact_reg j).1.continuousOn).measurable).comp h_sub
  have h_logDepth_meas : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ),
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
    intro j n
    exact (Real.measurable_log.comp
      (measurable_const.sub (continuous_abs.measurable.comp
        (Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp (h_impact_walk_meas j n))))).neg
  have h_hist_meas : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (m : ℕ),
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) :=
    fun j m => Finset.measurable_range_sup'' (fun n _ => h_logDepth_meas j n)
  have h_Hmax_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) := by
    intro m
    have h1 := Finset.measurable_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (f := fun j om => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) (fun j _ => h_hist_meas j m)
    have h_eq : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j om => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) =
        (fun om => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) :=
      funext (fun om => Finset.sup'_apply _ _ om)
    rwa [h_eq] at h1
  have h_tau_meas : Measurable (sliceStopTau S P ρ M) := by
    let P_stop : WalkSpace → ℕ → Prop := fun om m =>
      M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)
    let E_stop : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun m => {om : WalkSpace | P_stop om m}
    have hE_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, MeasurableSet (E_stop m) :=
      fun m => measurableSet_Ici.preimage (h_Hmax_meas m)
    refine measurable_to_countable' (fun k => ?_)
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        have h_eq : sliceStopTau S P ρ M ⁻¹' {0} = E_stop 0 ∪ (⋃ m : ℕ, E_stop m)ᶜ := by
          ext om
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_union,
            Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
          change @dite _ (∃ m : ℕ, P_stop om m) (Classical.propDecidable _)
            (fun h_ex => @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex) (fun _ => 0) = 0 ↔
            P_stop om 0 ∨ ∀ x : ℕ, ¬ P_stop om x
          by_cases h_ex : ∃ m : ℕ, P_stop om m
          · rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h_ex)]
            constructor
            · intro h0
              left
              have hspec := @Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex
              rwa [h0] at hspec
            · rintro (h0 | h_none)
              · exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (@Nat.find_min' _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex 0 h0)
              · rcases h_ex with ⟨m, hm⟩
                exact False.elim (h_none m hm)
          · rw [dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (eq_false h_ex)]
            simp only [true_iff]
            right
            intro x hx
            exact h_ex ⟨x, hx⟩
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hE_meas 0).union (MeasurableSet.iUnion hE_meas).compl
    | succ n =>
        have h_eq : sliceStopTau S P ρ M ⁻¹' {n + 1} =
            E_stop (n + 1) \ (⋃ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), E_stop l) := by
          ext om
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_sdiff,
            Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, not_exists]
          change @dite _ (∃ m : ℕ, P_stop om m) (Classical.propDecidable _)
            (fun h_ex => @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex) (fun _ => 0) = n + 1 ↔
            P_stop om (n + 1) ∧ ∀ x : ℕ, x < n + 1 → ¬ P_stop om x
          by_cases h_ex : ∃ m : ℕ, P_stop om m
          · rw [dite_eq_left_of_eq_true (eq_true h_ex)]
            constructor
            · intro h_find
              refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
              · have hspec := @Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex
                rwa [h_find] at hspec
              · intro x hx
                rw [← h_find] at hx
                exact @Nat.find_min _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex x hx
            · rintro ⟨hn1, h_min⟩
              have h_le : @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex ≤ n + 1 :=
                @Nat.find_min' _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex (n + 1) hn1
              by_contra h_ne
              have h_lt : @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex < n + 1 :=
                lt_of_le_of_ne h_le h_ne
              exact h_min _ h_lt (@Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex)
          · rw [dite_eq_right_of_eq_false (eq_false h_ex)]
            simp only [(Nat.succ_ne_zero n).symm, false_iff, not_and]
            intro hn1 _
            exact False.elim (h_ex ⟨n + 1, hn1⟩)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hE_meas (n + 1)).diff
          ((Finset.range (n + 1)).measurableSet_biUnion (fun l _ => hE_meas l))
  have h_step_exp : ∀ (m : ℕ) (H : WalkSpace → ℝ) (Φ : ℂ → ℂ → ℝ) (B : ℝ),
      @Measurable WalkSpace ℝ (prefSigma m) _ H →
      ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry Φ) (Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg) →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ θ : ℝ,
        |H om * Φ (walkPos ρ om m) (circleMap (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) θ)| ≤ B) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om * Φ (walkPos ρ om m) (walkPos ρ om (m + 1))) walkMeasure ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => H om *
          Real.circleAverage (Φ (walkPos ρ om m)) (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)))
        walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, H om * Φ (walkPos ρ om m) (walkPos ρ om (m + 1)) ∂walkMeasure) =
        ∫ om, H om *
          Real.circleAverage (Φ (walkPos ρ om m)) (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m))
          ∂walkMeasure := by
    intro m H Φ B hH hΦ hB
    let H_pref : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun p => H (extZero m p)
    let y_pref : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p => walkPos ρ (extZero m p) m
    have hH_pref_meas : Measurable H_pref := fun s hs => (h_ext_pref_meas m) (hH hs)
    have hy_pref_meas : Measurable y_pref :=
      fun s hs => (h_ext_pref_meas m) ((h_walk_adapted m) hs)
    let pair_map : ((Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℂ × ℂ :=
      fun q => (y_pref q.1, circleMap (y_pref q.1) (ρ (y_pref q.1)) q.2)
    have h_cm_meas : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        circleMap (y_pref q.1) (ρ (y_pref q.1)) q.2) := by
      have hy1 : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => y_pref q.1) :=
        hy_pref_meas.comp measurable_fst
      exact hy1.add
        ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp hy1)).mul
          (Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)))
    have h_pair_meas : Measurable pair_map :=
      (hy_pref_meas.comp measurable_fst).prodMk h_cm_meas
    have h_pair_mem : ∀ q : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ, pair_map q ∈ Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg := by
      rintro ⟨p, θ⟩
      have hy_in : y_pref p ∈ Ω_reg := (h_walk_in_reg (extZero m p) m).1
      have h_in_ball : circleMap (y_pref p) (ρ (y_pref p)) θ ∈
          Metric.closedBall (y_pref p) (ρ (y_pref p)) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, h_circleMap_norm _ _ _ (hAdm.nonneg _)]
      exact ⟨hy_in, (h_reg_ball _ hy_in).2.2.2 h_in_ball⟩
    let Ψ : ((Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun q => H_pref q.1 * Function.uncurry Φ (pair_map q)
    have h_pair_sub : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        (⟨pair_map q, h_pair_mem q⟩ : ↑(Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg))) :=
      h_pair_meas.subtype_mk
    have hΨ_meas : Measurable Ψ :=
      (hH_pref_meas.comp measurable_fst).mul
        (((continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hΦ).measurable).comp h_pair_sub)
    have hΨ_bound : ∀ q, ‖Ψ q‖ ≤ B := by
      rintro ⟨p, θ⟩
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hB (extZero m p) θ
    let Z_map : WalkSpace → (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ := fun om => (Xm m om, om (m + 1))
    let μ_pref := MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Xm m) walkMeasure
    have hμ_pref_prob : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ_pref :=
      ⟨by rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (hXm_meas m) MeasurableSet.univ,
            Set.preimage_univ, MeasureTheory.measure_univ]⟩
    have hZ_meas : Measurable Z_map := (hXm_meas m).prodMk (measurable_pi_apply (m + 1))
    have h_map_eq : MeasureTheory.Measure.map Z_map walkMeasure =
        μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure := by
      have h_iindep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun
          (fun (i : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) => om i) walkMeasure :=
        ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_infinitePi
          (P := fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (fun _ => measurable_id)
      have h_disj : Disjoint (Finset.range (m + 1)) ({m + 1} : Finset ℕ) :=
        Finset.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr (by simp)
      have h_fin := h_iindep.indepFun_finset (Finset.range (m + 1)) {m + 1} h_disj
        (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i)
      let idx_m1 : ({m + 1} : Finset ℕ) := ⟨m + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self (m + 1)⟩
      have h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (Xm m)
          (fun om : WalkSpace => om (m + 1)) walkMeasure :=
        h_fin.comp measurable_id (measurable_pi_apply idx_m1)
      rw [(ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
          (hXm_meas m).aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply (m + 1)).aemeasurable).mp h_indep]
      congr 1
      exact MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (m + 1)
    have hΨ_int_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable Ψ (μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) :=
      MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΨ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable B
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hΨ_bound)
    have hΨ_int_map : MeasureTheory.Integrable Ψ (MeasureTheory.Measure.map Z_map walkMeasure) :=
      h_map_eq.symm ▸ hΨ_int_prod
    have hΨ_comp : ∀ om : WalkSpace,

        have h_eq := (h_step_exp m (fun _ => 1) (fun _ w => U w) B
          measurable_const hΦ_cont hΦ_bd).2.2
        simp only [one_mul] at h_eq
        rw [h_eq]
        have h_pt : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
            Real.circleAverage U (walkPos ρ om m) (ρ (walkPos ρ om m)) = U (walkPos ρ om m) :=
          fun om => hU_avg _ (h_walk_in_reg om m).1
        simp_rw [h_pt]
