                rcases Nat.of_le_succ hle with hjk | rfl
                · exact hj j hjk
                · exact hk1
              · rintro ⟨hA, hj⟩
                exact ⟨⟨hA, fun j hjk => hj j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjk)⟩, hj (k + 1) le_rfl⟩
        let Z : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun k =>
          Nat.rec
            (fun om => A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_q (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om)
            (fun j Z_prev om =>
              Z_prev om +
                (KeepGoing j).indicator
                  (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' j) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (j + 1))) om) k
        have hZ0_eq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
            Z 0 om = A₀.indicator (fun om' => M_up - L_q (walkPos ρ om' 0)) om :=
          fun _ => rfl
        have hZ_props : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
            ((om ∈ A₀ ∧ ∀ j < k, om ∈ stepOK j) → Z k om = M_up - L_q (walkPos ρ om k)) ∧
            0 ≤ Z k om ∧
            ((om ∈ A₀ ∧ (∀ j ≤ k, ‖walkPos ρ om j - q‖ ≤ R) ∧
              ∃ m ≤ k, L_q (walkPos ρ om m) < -B₁) → M_up + B₁ ≤ Z k om) := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero =>
              intro om
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rintro ⟨hA, _⟩
                rw [hZ0_eq, Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
              · by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
                · rw [hZ0_eq, Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
                  have hy0_ne : 0 < ‖walkPos ρ om 0 - q‖ :=
                    norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_ne_on_reg _ (h_walk_in_reg om 0).1)
                  have hy0_le : ‖walkPos ρ om 0 - q‖ ≤ R + 1 := by
                    have h_tri : ‖(om 0 : ℂ) - q‖ ≤ ‖(om 0 : ℂ)‖ + ‖q‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
                    have hom0 : ‖(om 0 : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
                      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hA.1]
                      exact le_of_lt hA.2
                    dsimp only [walkPos, R]
                    linarith [hR_nat0]
                  have hlog : L_q (walkPos ρ om 0) ≤ M_up := Real.log_le_log hy0_ne hy0_le
                  linarith
                · rw [hZ0_eq, Set.indicator_of_notMem hA]
              · rintro ⟨hA, _, ⟨m, hm0, hlt⟩⟩
                have hm_eq : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm0
                subst hm_eq
                rw [hZ0_eq, Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
                linarith
          | succ k ih =>
              intro om
              rcases ih om with ⟨ih_act, ih_nonneg, ih_cross⟩
              have hZ_succ : Z (k + 1) om = Z k om +
                  (KeepGoing k).indicator
                    (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (k + 1))) om := rfl
              have h_act_succ : (om ∈ A₀ ∧ ∀ j < k + 1, om ∈ stepOK j) →
                  Z (k + 1) om = M_up - L_q (walkPos ρ om (k + 1)) := by
                rintro ⟨hA, hj⟩
                have h_in_keep : om ∈ KeepGoing k :=
                  (hKeep_iff k om).mpr ⟨hA, fun j hle => hj j (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hle)⟩
                have hZk := ih_act ⟨hA, fun j hlt => hj j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hlt)⟩
                rw [hZ_succ, Set.indicator_of_mem h_in_keep, hZk]
                ring
              refine ⟨h_act_succ, ?_, ?_⟩
              · rcases Classical.em (om ∈ KeepGoing k) with h_in_keep | h_in_keep
                · rcases (hKeep_iff k om).mp h_in_keep with ⟨hA, hj⟩
                  have hZk1 := h_act_succ ⟨hA, fun j hlt => hj j (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt)⟩
                  rw [hZk1]
                  have hyk_R : ‖walkPos ρ om k - q‖ ≤ R := (hj k le_rfl).1
                  have hρ1 : ρ (walkPos ρ om k) ≤ 1 :=
                    le_trans (h_reg_ball _ (h_walk_in_reg om k).1).1 (by norm_num)
                  have hyk1_le : ‖walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - q‖ ≤ R + 1 := by
                    have h_tri : ‖walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - q‖ ≤
                        ‖walkPos ρ om k - q‖ + ‖walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - walkPos ρ om k‖ := by
                      simpa using norm_add_le (walkPos ρ om k - q)
                        (walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - walkPos ρ om k)
                    have h_st : ‖walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - walkPos ρ om k‖ = ρ (walkPos ρ om k) := by
                      rw [h_walk_step_eq, h_circleMap_norm _ _ _ (hAdm.nonneg _)]
                    linarith
                  have hyk1_pos : 0 < ‖walkPos ρ om (k + 1) - q‖ :=
                    norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_ne_on_reg _ (h_walk_in_reg om (k + 1)).1)
                  have hlog : L_q (walkPos ρ om (k + 1)) ≤ M_up :=
                    Real.log_le_log hyk1_pos hyk1_le
                  linarith
                · rw [hZ_succ, Set.indicator_of_notMem h_in_keep, add_zero]
                  exact ih_nonneg
              · rintro ⟨hA, hj_R, ⟨m, hm_le, hm_lt⟩⟩
                by_cases h_prev : ∃ m' ≤ k, L_q (walkPos ρ om m') < -B₁
                · rcases h_prev with ⟨m', hm'_le, hm'_lt⟩
                  have h_not_keep : om ∉ KeepGoing k := by
                    intro h_in
                    have h_ok := ((hKeep_iff k om).mp h_in).2 m' hm'_le
                    linarith [h_ok.2]
                  rw [hZ_succ, Set.indicator_of_notMem h_not_keep, add_zero]
                  exact ih_cross ⟨hA, fun j hjk => hj_R j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hjk),
                    ⟨m', hm'_le, hm'_lt⟩⟩
                · have h_all_ok : ∀ j < k + 1, om ∈ stepOK j := by
                    intro j hj_lt
                    have hj_le : j ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hj_lt
                    refine ⟨hj_R j (Nat.le_succ_of_le hj_le), ?_⟩
                    by_contra h_neg
                    exact h_prev ⟨j, hj_le, lt_of_not_ge h_neg⟩
                  have hm_eq : m = k + 1 := by
                    rcases Nat.of_le_succ hm_le with hmk | rfl
                    · exact False.elim (h_prev ⟨m, hmk, hm_lt⟩)
                    · rfl
                  subst hm_eq
                  rw [h_act_succ ⟨hA, h_all_ok⟩]
                  linarith
        have hZ_int_and_exp : ∀ k : ℕ,
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (Z k) walkMeasure ∧
            (∫ om, Z k om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ M_up + C₀ := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero =>
              have hZ0_meas : Measurable (Z 0) :=
                (measurable_const.sub (hLq_meas.comp (h_walk_meas 0))).indicator hA₀_meas
              have hZ0_bd : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖Z 0 om‖ ≤ M_up + B_col 0 := by
                intro om
                rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hZ0_eq]
                by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
                · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
                  have h1 := hB_col_le 0 _ (h_walk_in_col 0 om hA)
                  rw [abs_le] at h1 ⊢
                  exact ⟨by linarith [hM_up_pos, hB_col_nonneg 0], by linarith [hM_up_pos]⟩
                · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hA, abs_zero]
                  linarith [hM_up_pos, hB_col_nonneg 0]
              have hZ0_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Z 0) walkMeasure :=
                MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hZ0_meas.aestronglyMeasurable
                  (M_up + B_col 0) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hZ0_bd)
              refine ⟨hZ0_int, ?_⟩
              have hZ0_le : ∀ om : WalkSpace, Z 0 om ≤ M_up + C₀ := by
                intro om
                rw [hZ0_eq]
                by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
                · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA]
                  dsimp only [walkPos]
                  linarith [hLq_real_lb (om 0)]
                · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hA]
                  linarith [hM_up_pos, hC₀_nonneg]
              calc ∫ om, Z 0 om ∂walkMeasure
                _ ≤ ∫ _ : WalkSpace, (M_up + C₀) ∂walkMeasure :=
                    MeasureTheory.integral_mono hZ0_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _) hZ0_le
                _ = M_up + C₀ := h_int_const _
          | succ k ih =>
              have hH_meas : @Measurable WalkSpace ℝ (prefSigma k) _
                  ((KeepGoing k).indicator 1) :=
                Measurable.indicator (m := prefSigma k) measurable_const (hKeep_pref k)
              have hΦ_cont : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry (fun y w : ℂ => L_q y - L_q w))
                  (Ω_reg ×ˢ Ω_reg) :=
                (hLq_cont.comp continuousOn_fst (fun _ hp => hp.1)).sub
                  (hLq_cont.comp continuousOn_snd (fun _ hp => hp.2))
              have hΦ_bd : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ θ : ℝ,
                  |(KeepGoing k).indicator (1 : WalkSpace → ℝ) om *
                    (L_q (walkPos ρ om k) -
                      L_q (circleMap (walkPos ρ om k) (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) θ))| ≤
                  B_col k + B_col (k + 1) := by
                intro om θ
                rcases Classical.em (om ∈ KeepGoing k) with h_in | h_in
                · have hA : om ∈ A₀ := ((hKeep_iff k om).mp h_in).1
                  have hy_col : walkPos ρ om k ∈ K_col k := h_walk_in_col k om hA
                  have hw_col : circleMap (walkPos ρ om k) (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) θ ∈
                      K_col (k + 1) :=
                    hK_col_step k _ _ hy_col
                      (le_of_eq (h_circleMap_norm _ _ _ (hAdm.nonneg _)))
                  have h1 := hB_col_le k _ hy_col
                  have h2 := hB_col_le (k + 1) _ hw_col
                  simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem h_in, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
                  rw [abs_le] at h1 h2 ⊢
                  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
                · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem h_in, zero_mul, abs_zero]
                  linarith [hB_col_nonneg k, hB_col_nonneg (k + 1)]
              have h_inc := h_step_exp k ((KeepGoing k).indicator 1)
                (fun y w => L_q y - L_q w) (B_col k + B_col (k + 1))
                hH_meas hΦ_cont hΦ_bd
              have h_inc_eq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
                  (KeepGoing k).indicator
                    (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (k + 1))) om =
                  (KeepGoing k).indicator 1 om *
                    (L_q (walkPos ρ om k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om (k + 1))) :=
                fun om => h_ind_mul (KeepGoing k) _ om
              have h_inc_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                  (fun om : WalkSpace => (KeepGoing k).indicator
                    (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (k + 1))) om)
                  walkMeasure := by
                simpa only [← h_inc_eq] using h_inc.1
              have h_inc_zero : (∫ om, (KeepGoing k).indicator
                  (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (k + 1))) om
                  ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
                simp_rw [h_inc_eq]
                rw [h_inc.2.2]
                have h_pt : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
                    Real.circleAverage (fun w => L_q (walkPos ρ om k) - L_q w)
                      (walkPos ρ om k) (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) = 0 := by
                  intro om
                  let y₀ := walkPos ρ om k
                  have hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω_reg := (h_walk_in_reg om k).1
                  let r := ρ y₀
                  have hr : 0 < r := (h_walk_in_reg om k).2
                  have hball_sub : Metric.closedBall y₀ r ⊆ Ω_reg := (h_reg_ball y₀ hy₀).2.2.2
                  have hc_Lq : CircleIntegrable L_q y₀ r :=
                    ((hLq_cont.mono hball_sub).mono
                      Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall).circleIntegrable hr.le
                  change Real.circleAverage ((fun _ => L_q y₀) - L_q) y₀ r = 0
                  rw [Real.circleAverage_sub (circleIntegrable_const _ _ _) hc_Lq,
                    Real.circleAverage_const, hLq_cavg y₀ hy₀, sub_self]
                simp [h_pt]
              have hZ_succ_eq : Z (k + 1) = fun om => Z k om +
                  (KeepGoing k).indicator
                    (fun om' => L_q (walkPos ρ om' k) - L_q (walkPos ρ om' (k + 1))) om := rfl
              rw [hZ_succ_eq]
              refine ⟨ih.1.add h_inc_int, ?_⟩
              rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add ih.1 h_inc_int, h_inc_zero, add_zero]
              exact ih.2
        let W_kn : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun k =>
          A₀ ∩ (⋂ l : ℕ, {om : WalkSpace | ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖ ≤ R}) ∩
            (⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), {om : WalkSpace | L_q (walkPos ρ om m) < -B₁})
        have hW_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet (W_kn k) := by
          intro k
          have h1 : MeasurableSet (⋂ l : ℕ, {om : WalkSpace | ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖ ≤ R}) :=
            MeasurableSet.iInter (fun l => measurableSet_Iic.preimage
              ((continuous_norm.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).measurable.comp
                (h_walk_meas l)))
          have h2 : MeasurableSet
              (⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), {om : WalkSpace | L_q (walkPos ρ om m) < -B₁}) :=
            (Finset.range (k + 1)).measurableSet_biUnion
              (fun m _ => measurableSet_Iio.preimage (hLq_meas.comp (h_walk_meas m)))
          exact (hA₀_meas.inter h1).inter h2
        have hW_mono : Monotone W_kn := by
          intro j k hjk om ⟨hA_R, hm⟩
          refine ⟨hA_R, ?_⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢
          rcases hm with ⟨m, hm_lt, hm_neg⟩
          exact ⟨m, lt_of_lt_of_le hm_lt (Nat.add_le_add_right hjk 1), hm_neg⟩
        have hW_le_k : ∀ k : ℕ,
            walkMeasure (W_kn k) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((M_up + C₀) / (M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          intro k
          have h_denom_pos : 0 < M_up + B₁ := by
            dsimp only [B₁]
            have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
            linarith [hM_up_pos]
          have h_pt_dom : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
              (M_up + B₁) * (W_kn k).indicator 1 om ≤ Z k om := by
            intro om
            rcases Classical.em (om ∈ W_kn k) with hom | hom
            · have ⟨⟨hA, hR_all⟩, hm_un⟩ := hom
              simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hR_all
              simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range] at hm_un
              rcases hm_un with ⟨m, hm_lt, hm_neg⟩
              simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hom, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
              exact (hZ_props k om).2.2
                ⟨hA, fun j _ => hR_all j, ⟨m, Nat.le_of_lt_succ hm_lt, hm_neg⟩⟩
            · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hom, mul_zero]
              exact (hZ_props k om).2.1
          have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun om : WalkSpace => (M_up + B₁) * (W_kn k).indicator 1 om) walkMeasure :=
            ((MeasureTheory.integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (hW_meas k)).const_mul (M_up + B₁)
          have h_int_le := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_ind_int (hZ_int_and_exp k).1 h_pt_dom
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one (hW_meas k)]
            at h_int_le
          have h_real_le : walkMeasure.real (W_kn k) ≤ (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + B₁) :=
            (le_div_iff₀' h_denom_pos).mpr (le_trans h_int_le (hZ_int_and_exp k).2)
          have h_assoc : M_up + B₁ = M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
            dsimp [B₁]
            ring
          rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, h_assoc] at h_real_le
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure (W_kn k))]
          exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_le
        have h_ER_sub : E_R ⊆ ⋃ k : ℕ, W_kn k := by
          rintro om ⟨hA, hR_all, h_tend⟩
          have h_tend_norm : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => dist (walkPos ρ om m) q)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
            tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mp h_tend
          have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-B₁) := Real.exp_pos _
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_tend_norm (Real.exp (-B₁)) hexp_pos)
          have hm_dist : ‖walkPos ρ om m - q‖ < Real.exp (-B₁) := by
            simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hm m le_rfl
          have hm_pos : 0 < ‖walkPos ρ om m - q‖ :=
            norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_ne_on_reg _ (h_walk_in_reg om m).1)
          have hm_log : L_q (walkPos ρ om m) < -B₁ :=
            (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hm_pos).mpr hm_dist
          refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, ⟨⟨hA, Set.mem_iInter.mpr hR_all⟩, ?_⟩⟩
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
            ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m), hm_log⟩⟩
        calc walkMeasure E_R
          _ ≤ walkMeasure (⋃ k : ℕ, W_kn k) := MeasureTheory.measure_mono h_ER_sub
          _ = ⨆ k : ℕ, walkMeasure (W_kn k) := hW_mono.measure_iUnion
          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((M_up + C₀) / (M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1)) := iSup_le hW_le_k
      by_contra h_ne_zero
      have hc_pos : 0 < (walkMeasure E_R).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_pos h_ne_zero (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure E_R)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((M_up + C₀) / (walkMeasure E_R).toReal)
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have h_denom_pos : 0 < M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [hM_up_pos]
      have h_toReal_le : (walkMeasure E_R).toReal ≤ (M_up + C₀) / (M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1) := by
        have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (h_ER_le_n n)
        rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (by linarith) h_denom_pos.le)] at h1
      have h_mul1 : M_up + C₀ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (walkMeasure E_R).toReal :=
        (div_le_iff₀ hc_pos).mp hn
      have h_mul2 : (walkMeasure E_R).toReal * (M_up + (n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ M_up + C₀ :=
        (le_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos).mp h_toReal_le
      nlinarith
    have h_A0_q_sub : {om : WalkSpace | om ∈ A₀ ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} ⊆
        ⋃ R_nat : ℕ, {om : WalkSpace | om ∈ A₀ ∧
          (∀ l : ℕ, ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖ ≤ 2 * Real.pi + ‖q‖ + 1 + (R_nat : ℝ)) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} := by
      rintro om ⟨hA, h_tend⟩
      obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_tend 1 one_pos
      let S_max : ℝ := (Finset.range (M₀ + 1)).sup'
        ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ M₀)⟩
        (fun l => ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖)
      obtain ⟨R_nat, hR_nat⟩ := exists_nat_ge S_max
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨R_nat, hA, ?_, h_tend⟩
      intro l
      by_cases hl : l ≤ M₀
      · have hl_le : ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖ ≤ S_max :=
          Finset.le_sup' (f := fun j => ‖walkPos ρ om j - q‖)
            (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hl))
        linarith [Real.two_pi_pos, norm_nonneg q]
      · have hl_ge : M₀ ≤ l := le_of_not_ge hl
        have hl_lt : ‖walkPos ρ om l - q‖ < 1 := by
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hM₀ l hl_ge
        have hR_nat0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R_nat : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg R_nat
        linarith [Real.two_pi_pos, norm_nonneg q]
    have h_A0_q_null : walkMeasure {om : WalkSpace | om ∈ A₀ ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} = 0 :=
      MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null h_A0_q_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null h_ER_null)
    have h_full_sub : {om : WalkSpace |
        Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} ⊆
        {om : WalkSpace | om ∈ A₀ ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} ∪ A₀ᶜ := by
      intro om hom
      by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hom⟩
      · exact Or.inr hA
    exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null h_full_sub
      (MeasureTheory.measure_union_null h_A0_q_null hA₀_compl_null)
  have h_avoid_Z_ae : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, ∀ q ∈ P.Z_all,
      ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
    have h_eq : {om : WalkSpace | ¬ ∀ q ∈ P.Z_all,
        ¬ Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} =
        ⋃ q ∈ P.Z_all, {om : WalkSpace |
          Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds q)} := by
      ext om
      simp
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_null_iff hZ_countable).mpr h_polar

  
  
  
  let x_inf : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => om 0 + d_inf om
  let sgn_inf : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => if 0 ≤ y_im_inf om then 1 else -1
  have hx_inf_meas : Measurable x_inf := (measurable_pi_apply 0).add hd_inf_meas
  have hsgn_inf_meas : Measurable sgn_inf :=
    Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Ici.preimage hy_im_inf_meas) measurable_const measurable_const
  refine
    { walk_in_reg := h_walk_in_reg
      walk_clock := h_walk_clock
      impact_sq_sum := h_impact_sq_sum
      harmonic_expectation_eq := h_harm_exp
      ae_wall_exit_and_impact_im_conv := ⟨x_inf, sgn_inf, v_inf,
        hx_inf_meas, hsgn_inf_meas, hv_inf_meas, ?_⟩ }
  filter_upwards [hd_conv, hy_im_conv, hv_inf_conv, h_avoid_Z_ae] with om hd_om hy_om hv_om hZ_om
  have hx_om : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (walkPos ρ om m).re) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (x_inf om)) := by
    have h_eq : (fun m : ℕ => (walkPos ρ om m).re) = fun m : ℕ => om 0 + d_re m om := by
      ext m
      simp [d_re]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hd_om.const_add (om 0)
  let y_lim : ℂ := (x_inf om : ℂ) + (y_im_inf om : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hy_walk_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) Filter.atTop (nhds y_lim) := by
    have h_eq : (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om m) =
        fun m : ℕ => ((walkPos ρ om m).re : ℂ) + ((walkPos ρ om m).im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      ext m
      exact (Complex.re_add_im _).symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hx_om).add
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hy_om).mul_const Complex.I)
  have hy_im_le : |y_im_inf om| ≤ h :=
    le_of_tendsto' (continuous_abs.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hy_om)
      (fun m => le_of_lt (h_walk_in_reg om m).1.1)
  have hy_im_abs_eq : |y_im_inf om| = h := by
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_lt : |y_im_inf om| < h := lt_of_le_of_ne hy_im_le h_ne
    have hy_lim_strip : y_lim ∈ horizStrip h := by
      simpa [horizStrip, y_lim] using h_lt
    have hy_lim_not_Z : y_lim ∉ P.Z_all := fun h_in => hZ_om y_lim h_in hy_walk_conv
    have hy_lim_reg : y_lim ∈ Ω_reg := ⟨hy_lim_strip, hy_lim_not_Z⟩
    have hy_shift_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => walkPos ρ om (m + 1))
        Filter.atTop (nhds y_lim) :=
      (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mpr hy_walk_conv
    have hρ_to_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ρ (walkPos ρ om m))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h_norm_conv : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun m : ℕ => ‖walkPos ρ om (m + 1) - walkPos ρ om m‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self] using (hy_shift_conv.sub hy_walk_conv).norm
      have h_eq : (fun m : ℕ => ‖walkPos ρ om (m + 1) - walkPos ρ om m‖) =
          fun m : ℕ => ρ (walkPos ρ om m) := by
        ext m
        rw [h_walk_step_eq, h_circleMap_norm _ _ _ (hAdm.nonneg _)]
      rwa [h_eq] at h_norm_conv
    have hρ_cont_at : ContinuousAt ρ y_lim :=
      hAdm.cont_on.continuousAt (P.reg_open.mem_nhds hy_lim_reg)
    have hρ_to_val : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ρ (walkPos ρ om m))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (ρ y_lim)) :=
      hρ_cont_at.tendsto.comp hy_walk_conv
    have hρ_zero : ρ y_lim = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hρ_to_val hρ_to_zero
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y_lim := (hAdm.pos_iff y_lim).mpr hy_lim_reg
    linarith
  have hsgn_cases : (sgn_inf om = 1 ∨ sgn_inf om = -1) ∧
      y_im_inf om = sgn_inf om * h := by
    by_cases h_nonneg : 0 ≤ y_im_inf om
    · have hsgn_eq : sgn_inf om = 1 := by simp [sgn_inf, h_nonneg]
      refine ⟨Or.inl hsgn_eq, ?_⟩
      rw [hsgn_eq, one_mul]
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg] at hy_im_abs_eq
    · have hsgn_eq : sgn_inf om = -1 := by simp [sgn_inf, h_nonneg]
      refine ⟨Or.inr hsgn_eq, ?_⟩
      rw [hsgn_eq, neg_one_mul]
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h_nonneg)] at hy_im_abs_eq
      linarith
  refine ⟨hsgn_cases.1, ?_, hv_om⟩
  have hy_lim_eq : y_lim =
      (x_inf om : ℂ) + ((sgn_inf om * sliceHeight S P.N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    dsimp only [y_lim, h]
    rw [hsgn_cases.2]
  rwa [← hy_lim_eq]

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hAdm : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ)
    (hPoisson : StripPoissonToolkitProp (sliceHeight S P.N))
    (hWalk : AdmissibleWalkWallExitProp S P M ρ) :
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  haveI hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N :=
    div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_mem : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh_pos : 0 < h :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_mem).1
  have h_strip_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have h_walk_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        dsimp only [walkPos]
        exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)
    | succ m ih =>
        have hρ_m : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om m) : ℂ)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp ih)
        have hexp_m : Measurable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => Complex.exp ((om (m + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
            ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp
              (measurable_pi_apply (m + 1))).mul_const Complex.I)
        dsimp only [walkPos]
        exact ih.add (hρ_m.mul hexp_m)
  have h_comp_walk_meas : ∀ {U : ℂ → ℝ}, ContinuousOn U (horizStrip h) →
      ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => U (walkPos ρ om m)) := by
    intro U hU m
    have h_sub : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        (⟨walkPos ρ om m, (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1⟩ : horizStrip h)) :=
      (h_walk_meas m).subtype_mk
    exact (continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hU).measurable.comp h_sub
  have h_safe_ball : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ P.Z_all,
      Metric.closedBall y |ρ y| ⊆ horizStrip h := by
    intro y hy w hw
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (hAdm.pos_iff y).mpr hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, abs_of_pos hρ_pos, dist_comm] at hw
    by_contra hw_not
    have hw_comp : w ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P := fun hw_reg => hw_not hw_reg.1
    have h_inf : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y w :=
      Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hw_comp
    have h_le : ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y :=
      le_trans (hAdm.le_sing_dist y)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right 1 _) (by norm_num))
    linarith
  
  let v_im : Fin P.N → ℂ → ℝ := fun j y => (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im
  let h_approx : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) * h
  let tr_pos : Fin P.N → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun j n x => v_im j ((x : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  let tr_neg : Fin P.N → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ :=
    fun j n x => v_im j ((x : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  let lim_pos : Fin P.N → ℝ → ℝ := fun j x =>
    max (-S.H) (min S.H (Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => tr_pos j n x)))
  let lim_neg : Fin P.N → ℝ → ℝ := fun j x =>
    max (-S.H) (min S.H (Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => tr_neg j n x)))
  have hp_tube : ∀ (j : Fin P.N), ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      (y + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)) ∈
        finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro j y hy
    have hy_lt : -h < y.im ∧ y.im < h := abs_lt.mp hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht₀_mem
    · simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.intCast_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact hy_lt.1
    · simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.intCast_im, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact hy_lt.2
  have hs_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    have h_aff : Differentiable ℂ
        (fun y : ℂ => (y + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ),
          (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ))) :=
      Differentiable.prodMk (differentiable_id.add (differentiable_const _))
        (differentiable_const _)
    exact S.𝔰_holo.comp h_aff.differentiableOn (fun y hy => hp_tube j y hy)
  have hv_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (v_im j) (horizStrip h) :=
    fun j => Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn (hs_holo j).continuousOn
  have hv_per : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      v_im j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = v_im j y := by
    intro j y hy
    have h_eq : y + 2 * Real.pi + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) =
        (y + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
    have hq := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic _ (hp_tube j y hy)
    dsimp only [v_im, sliceImpactSeq] at *
    rw [h_eq, hq]
    simp
  have hv_lt_H : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, |v_im j y| < S.H :=
    fun j y hy => S.𝔰_maps_to _ (hp_tube j y hy)
  have hv_le_H : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, |v_im j y| ≤ S.H :=
    fun j y hy => le_of_lt (hv_lt_H j y hy)
  have hv_harm : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y : ℂ, ∀ r : ℝ,
      0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ horizStrip h →
      Real.circleAverage (v_im j) y r = v_im j y := by
    intro j y r hr hsub
    have hs_an : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip h) :=
      (hs_holo j).analyticOnNhd h_strip_open
    have h_harm_ball : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (v_im j) (Metric.closedBall y |r|) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [abs_of_pos hr] at hz
      exact (hs_an z (hsub hz)).harmonicAt_im
    exact h_harm_ball.circleAverage_eq
  have hh_approx_bounds : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < h_approx n ∧ h_approx n < h := by
    intro n
    have hn2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2 := by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))]
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    have h_inv_le : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hn2
    dsimp only [h_approx]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hz_pos_mem : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      (x : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip h := by
    intro n x
    rcases hh_approx_bounds n with ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp [horizStrip, abs_of_pos h0, h1]
  have hz_neg_mem : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      (x : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip h := by
    intro n x
    rcases hh_approx_bounds n with ⟨h0, h1⟩
    simp [horizStrip, abs_of_pos h0, h1]
  have htr_pos_cont : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ), Continuous (tr_pos j n) := by
    intro j n
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    exact (hv_cont j).comp_continuous hc (hz_pos_mem n)
  have htr_neg_cont : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ), Continuous (tr_neg j n) := by
    intro j n
    have hc : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (x : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.sub continuous_const
    exact (hv_cont j).comp_continuous hc (hz_neg_mem n)
  have htr_pos_per : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ), Function.Periodic (tr_pos j n) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro j n x
    have heq : (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        ((x : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    dsimp only [tr_pos]
    rw [heq]
    exact hv_per j _ (hz_pos_mem n x)
  have htr_neg_per : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ), Function.Periodic (tr_neg j n) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro j n x
    have heq : (((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        ((x : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * Real.pi := by push_cast; ring
    dsimp only [tr_neg]
    rw [heq]
    exact hv_per j _ (hz_neg_mem n x)
  have htr_pos_bdd : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |tr_pos j n x| ≤ S.H :=
    fun j n x => hv_le_H j _ (hz_pos_mem n x)
  have htr_neg_bdd : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |tr_neg j n x| ≤ S.H :=
    fun j n x => hv_le_H j _ (hz_neg_mem n x)
  have hlim_pos_meas : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (lim_pos j) := by
    intro j
    have h_lu : Measurable
        (fun x : ℝ => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => tr_pos j n x)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.limUnder
        (fun n => (htr_pos_cont j n).stronglyMeasurable)).measurable
    exact measurable_const.max (measurable_const.min h_lu)
  have hlim_neg_meas : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (lim_neg j) := by
    intro j
    have h_lu : Measurable
        (fun x : ℝ => Filter.limUnder Filter.atTop (fun n : ℕ => tr_neg j n x)) :=
      (MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable.limUnder
        (fun n => (htr_neg_cont j n).stronglyMeasurable)).measurable
    exact measurable_const.max (measurable_const.min h_lu)
  have hlim_pos_per : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Function.Periodic (lim_pos j) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro j x
    dsimp only [lim_pos]
    have hseq : (fun n : ℕ => tr_pos j n (x + 2 * Real.pi)) = (fun n : ℕ => tr_pos j n x) :=
      funext (fun n => htr_pos_per j n x)
    rw [hseq]
  have hlim_neg_per : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Function.Periodic (lim_neg j) (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro j x
    dsimp only [lim_neg]
    have hseq : (fun n : ℕ => tr_neg j n (x + 2 * Real.pi)) = (fun n : ℕ => tr_neg j n x) :=
      funext (fun n => htr_neg_per j n x)
    rw [hseq]
  have hlim_bdd : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (x : ℝ), |lim_pos j x| ≤ S.H ∧ |lim_neg j x| ≤ S.H := by
    intro j x
    have hH : -S.H ≤ S.H := by linarith [S.H_pos]
    constructor
    · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hH (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le hH (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hh_approx_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h_approx Filter.atTop (nhds h) := by
    have h_inv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp
        (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc,
        one_add_one_eq_two] using h1
    simpa [h_approx] using ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 : ℝ))).sub h_inv).mul_const h
  let goodBC : ℝ → Prop := fun x =>
    (∀ j : Fin P.N,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => tr_pos j n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (lim_pos j x)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => tr_neg j n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (lim_neg j x))) ∧
    (∃ j : Fin P.N, |lim_pos j x| = S.H) ∧
    (∃ j : Fin P.N, |lim_neg j x| = S.H)
  have h_ae_bc : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, goodBC x := by
    refine P.boundary_contact.mono ?_
    intro x hbc
    obtain ⟨s_pos, h_cone_pos, j_pos, hj_pos⟩ := hbc 1 (Or.inl rfl)
    obtain ⟨s_neg, h_cone_neg, j_neg, hj_neg⟩ := hbc (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
    have hz_pos_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => (x : ℂ) + (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + ((1 * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (h - |y.im|)}) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_⟩
      · have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (h_approx n : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (h : ℂ)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hh_approx_tendsto
        simpa [one_mul] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (x : ℂ))).add (hc.mul_const Complex.I)
      · intro n
        rcases hh_approx_bounds n with ⟨h0, h1⟩
        refine ⟨hz_pos_mem n x, ?_⟩
        simp [abs_of_pos h0]
        linarith
    have hz_neg_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => (x : ℂ) - (h_approx n : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        Filter.atTop
        (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (((-1 : ℝ) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ (1 : ℝ) * (h - |y.im|)}) := by
      refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_⟩
      · have hc : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (h_approx n : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (h : ℂ)) :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hh_approx_tendsto
        have h_lim : (x : ℂ) - (h : ℂ) * Complex.I =
            (x : ℂ) + (((-1 : ℝ) * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by push_cast; ring
        rw [← h_lim]
        exact (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (x : ℂ))).sub (hc.mul_const Complex.I)
      · intro n
        rcases hh_approx_bounds n with ⟨h0, h1⟩
        refine ⟨hz_neg_mem n x, ?_⟩
        simp [abs_of_pos h0]
        linarith
    have h_pos_eq : ∀ j : Fin P.N,

              ((hψ_cont r).measurable.indicator measurableSet_Ico).aestronglyMeasurable
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
            by_cases hxI : x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
            · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hxI, Real.norm_eq_abs, hψ_bdd r x]
            · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxI]
          have h_le_vol : (∫ x, (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).indicator (ψ r) x) ≤
              MeasureTheory.volume.real S_O := by
            rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one hSO_meas]
            exact MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_ψ_ind_int h_SO_int h_pt_le
          have h_vol_le : MeasureTheory.volume.real S_O ≤ ε := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ← ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hε.le]
            exact ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hO_fund_lt.le
          exact le_trans h_le_vol h_vol_le
        have h_real_le : walkMeasure.real (A_seq r) ≤ ε / (2 * Real.pi) := by
          have h1 := le_trans h_int_Ar
            (le_of_eq (h_exit_expect (ψ r) (hψ_cont r) (hψ_per r) (hψ_bdd r)))
          have h2 : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ψ r x) ≤
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ε :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_int_ψ_le (inv_nonneg.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le)
          have h_eq : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ε = ε / (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
          linarith
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure (A_seq r)),
          ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_le
      calc
        walkMeasure {om : WalkSpace | x_inf om ∈ N_null}
          ≤ walkMeasure (⋃ r : ℕ, A_seq r) := MeasureTheory.measure_mono h_sub_union
        _ = ⨆ r : ℕ, walkMeasure (A_seq r) := hA_mono.measure_iUnion
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε / (2 * Real.pi)) := iSup_le hA_bound
    by_contra hm_ne
    have hm_pos : 0 < (walkMeasure {om : WalkSpace | x_inf om ∈ N_null}).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_pos hm_ne (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
    let m_val : ℝ := (walkMeasure {om : WalkSpace | x_inf om ∈ N_null}).toReal
    let ε₀ : ℝ := min (Real.pi / 2) (Real.pi * m_val)
    have hε₀_pos : 0 < ε₀ := lt_min (half_pos Real.pi_pos) (mul_pos Real.pi_pos hm_pos)
    have hε₀_lt : ε₀ < Real.pi :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self Real.pi_pos)
    have h_le_of := h_eps_bound ε₀ hε₀_pos hε₀_lt
    have h_toReal_le : m_val ≤ ε₀ / (2 * Real.pi) := by
      have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h_le_of
      rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg hε₀_pos.le Real.two_pi_pos.le)] at h1
    have hε₀_le : ε₀ ≤ Real.pi * m_val := min_le_right _ _
    have h_div_le : ε₀ / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ m_val / 2 := by
      calc
        ε₀ / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ (Real.pi * m_val) / (2 * Real.pi) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hε₀_le Real.two_pi_pos.le
        _ = m_val / 2 := by
          have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_pos.ne'
          field_simp [hpi]
    linarith [hm_pos]
  
  have h_walk_bc : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, goodBC (x_inf om) := by
    have h_vol_null : MeasureTheory.volume {x : ℝ | ¬ goodBC x} = 0 :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp h_ae_bc
    exact MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mpr (h_null_avoid {x : ℝ | ¬ goodBC x} h_vol_null)
  have h_id_site : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
        v_inf j om = if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then lim_pos j (x_inf om) else lim_neg j (x_inf om) := by
    intro j
    let B : ℝ := S.H
    have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B := S.H_pos.le
    let U_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ := fun n => stripPoissonExt h (tr_pos j n) (tr_neg j n)
    let Δ_pos : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n x => (lim_pos j x - tr_pos j n x) ^ 2
    let Δ_neg : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n x => (lim_neg j x - tr_neg j n x) ^ 2
    let W_seq : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ := fun n => stripPoissonExt h (Δ_pos n) (Δ_neg n)
    let δ_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
      (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Δ_pos n x + Δ_neg n x)
    have h_dom_pt : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
        (v_im j y - U_seq n y) ^ 2 ≤ W_seq n y :=
      hPoisson.slice_l2_domination (v_im j) (lim_pos j) (lim_neg j) B
        (hv_cont j) (hv_per j) hB_nonneg (hv_le_H j) (hv_harm j)
        (hlim_pos_meas j) (hlim_neg_meas j) (hlim_pos_per j) (hlim_neg_per j)
        (hlim_bdd j) (h_ae_bc.mono fun x hx => hx.1 j)
    have hΔ_pos_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (Δ_pos n) :=
      fun n => (continuous_pow 2).measurable.comp
        ((hlim_pos_meas j).sub (htr_pos_cont j n).measurable)
    have hΔ_neg_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (Δ_neg n) :=
      fun n => (continuous_pow 2).measurable.comp
        ((hlim_neg_meas j).sub (htr_neg_cont j n).measurable)
    have hΔ_pos_per : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Periodic (Δ_pos n) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro n x
      dsimp only [Δ_pos]
      rw [hlim_pos_per j x, htr_pos_per j n x]
    have hΔ_neg_per : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Periodic (Δ_neg n) (2 * Real.pi) := by
      intro n x
      dsimp only [Δ_neg]
      rw [hlim_neg_per j x, htr_neg_per j n x]
    have hΔ_pos_bdd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |Δ_pos n x| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro n x
      have h1 := abs_le.mp (hlim_bdd j x).1
      have h2 := abs_le.mp (htr_pos_bdd j n x)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      dsimp only [Δ_pos]
      nlinarith
    have hΔ_neg_bdd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |Δ_neg n x| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro n x
      have h1 := abs_le.mp (hlim_bdd j x).2
      have h2 := abs_le.mp (htr_neg_bdd j n x)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      dsimp only [Δ_neg]
      nlinarith
    let G_seq : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun n om =>
      (v_inf j om - (if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then tr_pos j n (x_inf om) else tr_neg j n (x_inf om))) ^ 2
    let G_inf : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om =>
      (v_inf j om - (if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then lim_pos j (x_inf om) else lim_neg j (x_inf om))) ^ 2
    have hG_le_δ : ∀ n : ℕ, (∫ om, G_seq n om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ δ_seq n := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨hU_cont, hU_bdd, _⟩ :=
        hPoisson.cont_on_and_bound (tr_pos j n) (tr_neg j n) B
          (htr_pos_cont j n).measurable (htr_neg_cont j n).measurable
          hB_nonneg (htr_pos_bdd j n) (htr_neg_bdd j n)
      obtain ⟨hW_cont, hW_bdd, hW_harm⟩ :=
        hPoisson.cont_on_and_bound (Δ_pos n) (Δ_neg n) (4 * B ^ 2)
          (hΔ_pos_meas n) (hΔ_neg_meas n) (by positivity) (hΔ_pos_bdd n) (hΔ_neg_bdd n)
      let F_step : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun m om =>
        (v_im j (walkPos ρ om m) - U_seq n (walkPos ρ om m)) ^ 2
      have hF_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, Measurable (F_step m) := fun m =>
        (continuous_pow 2).measurable.comp
          ((h_comp_walk_meas (hv_cont j) m).sub (h_comp_walk_meas hU_cont m))
      have hF_bdd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), ‖F_step m om‖ ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
        intro m om
        have hy : walkPos ρ om m ∈ horizStrip h := (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1
        have h1 := abs_le.mp (hv_le_H j _ hy)
        have h2 := abs_le.mp (hU_bdd _ hy)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        dsimp only [F_step]
        nlinarith
      have hF_int_le : ∀ m : ℕ, (∫ om, F_step m om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ δ_seq n := by
        intro m
        have hW_exp : (∫ om, W_seq n (walkPos ρ om m) ∂walkMeasure) = δ_seq n := by
          rw [hWalk.harmonic_expectation_eq (W_seq n) (4 * B ^ 2) hW_cont hW_bdd
            (fun y hy => hW_harm y (ρ y) (h_safe_ball y hy)) m]
          exact hPoisson.real_period_integral (Δ_pos n) (Δ_neg n) (4 * B ^ 2)
            (hΔ_pos_meas n) (hΔ_neg_meas n) (hΔ_pos_per n) (hΔ_neg_per n)
            (by positivity) (hΔ_pos_bdd n) (hΔ_neg_bdd n)
        rw [← hW_exp]
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono ?_ ?_ (fun om =>
          h_dom_pt n _ (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1)
        · exact (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (4 * B ^ 2)).mono'
            (hF_meas m).aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_bdd m))
        · refine (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (4 * B ^ 2)).mono'
            (h_comp_walk_meas hW_cont m).aestronglyMeasurable
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact hW_bdd _ (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1
      have hF_ae_conv : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
          Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => F_step m om) Filter.atTop (nhds (G_seq n om)) := by
        refine (h_walk_ae.and
          (h_poisson_tendsto_ae (tr_pos j n) (tr_neg j n)
            (htr_pos_cont j n) (htr_neg_cont j n)
            (htr_pos_per j n) (htr_neg_per j n))).mono ?_
        intro om ⟨⟨_, _, hv_conv⟩, hU_conv⟩
        exact ((hv_conv j).sub hU_conv).pow 2
      have hF_dct : Filter.Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∫ om, F_step m om ∂walkMeasure)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ om, G_seq n om ∂walkMeasure)) :=
        MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
          (fun _ : WalkSpace => 4 * B ^ 2)
          (fun m => (hF_meas m).aestronglyMeasurable)
          (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (4 * B ^ 2))
          (fun m => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_bdd m))
          hF_ae_conv
      exact le_of_tendsto' hF_dct hF_int_le
    have hδ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto δ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h_int_zero : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Δ_pos n x + Δ_neg n x))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ _x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (0 : ℝ))) := by
        refine intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
          (fun _ : ℝ => 8 * B ^ 2) ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
            ((hΔ_pos_meas n).add (hΔ_neg_meas n)).aestronglyMeasurable
        · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x _ => ?_
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          have h1 := hΔ_pos_bdd n x
          have h2 := hΔ_neg_bdd n x
          exact le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) (by linarith)
        · refine h_ae_bc.mono fun x hx _ => ?_
          rcases hx.1 j with ⟨htp, htn⟩
          have hp0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Δ_pos n x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            simpa [Δ_pos] using (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := lim_pos j x)).sub htp).pow 2)
          have hn0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Δ_neg n x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
            simpa [Δ_neg] using (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := lim_neg j x)).sub htn).pow 2)
          simpa using hp0.add hn0
      simpa [δ_seq] using h_int_zero.const_mul (4 * Real.pi)⁻¹
    have hv_inf_ae_bdd : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, |v_inf j om| ≤ B := by
      refine h_walk_ae.mono ?_
      intro om ⟨_, _, hv_conv⟩
      exact le_of_tendsto' (continuous_abs.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hv_conv j))
        (fun m => hv_le_H j _ (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1)
    have hG_seq_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (G_seq n) := by
      intro n
      have h_ite : Measurable
          (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then tr_pos j n (x_inf om) else tr_neg j n (x_inf om)) :=
        Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Ici.preimage hsgn_meas)
          ((htr_pos_cont j n).measurable.comp hx_meas)
          ((htr_neg_cont j n).measurable.comp hx_meas)
      exact (continuous_pow 2).measurable.comp ((hv_meas j).sub h_ite)
    have hG_inf_meas : Measurable G_inf := by
      have h_ite : Measurable
          (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then lim_pos j (x_inf om) else lim_neg j (x_inf om)) :=
        Measurable.ite (measurableSet_Ici.preimage hsgn_meas)
          ((hlim_pos_meas j).comp hx_meas)
          ((hlim_neg_meas j).comp hx_meas)
      exact (continuous_pow 2).measurable.comp ((hv_meas j).sub h_ite)
    have hG_seq_ae_bdd : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, ‖G_seq n om‖ ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      refine hv_inf_ae_bdd.mono fun om hvb => ?_
      have h1 := abs_le.mp hvb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      dsimp only [G_seq]
      by_cases hs : 0 ≤ sgn_inf om
      · rw [if_pos hs]
        have h2 := abs_le.mp (htr_pos_bdd j n (x_inf om))
        nlinarith
      · rw [if_neg hs]
        have h2 := abs_le.mp (htr_neg_bdd j n (x_inf om))
        nlinarith
    have hG_inf_ae_bdd : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, ‖G_inf om‖ ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
      refine hv_inf_ae_bdd.mono fun om hvb => ?_
      have h1 := abs_le.mp hvb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      dsimp only [G_inf]
      by_cases hs : 0 ≤ sgn_inf om
      · rw [if_pos hs]
        have h2 := abs_le.mp (hlim_bdd j (x_inf om)).1
        nlinarith
      · rw [if_neg hs]
        have h2 := abs_le.mp (hlim_bdd j (x_inf om)).2
        nlinarith
    have hG_ae_conv : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => G_seq n om) Filter.atTop (nhds (G_inf om)) := by
      refine h_walk_bc.mono fun om hbc => ?_
      rcases hbc.1 j with ⟨htp, htn⟩
      dsimp only [G_seq, G_inf]
      by_cases hs : 0 ≤ sgn_inf om
      · simp only [if_pos hs]
        exact (tendsto_const_nhds.sub htp).pow 2
      · simp only [if_neg hs]
        exact (tendsto_const_nhds.sub htn).pow 2
    have hG_dct : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ om, G_seq n om ∂walkMeasure)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (∫ om, G_inf om ∂walkMeasure)) :=
      MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
        (fun _ : WalkSpace => 4 * B ^ 2)
        (fun n => (hG_seq_meas n).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (4 * B ^ 2))
        hG_seq_ae_bdd
        hG_ae_conv
    have hG_inf_int_le : (∫ om, G_inf om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 0 :=
      le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hG_dct hδ_tendsto (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hG_le_δ)
    have hG_inf_int_zero : (∫ om, G_inf om ∂walkMeasure) = 0 :=
      le_antisymm hG_inf_int_le (MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))
    have hG_inf_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable G_inf walkMeasure :=
      (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (4 * B ^ 2)).mono'
        hG_inf_meas.aestronglyMeasurable hG_inf_ae_bdd
    have hG_inf_ae_zero : G_inf =ᵐ[walkMeasure] 0 :=
      (MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
        hG_inf_integrable).mp hG_inf_int_zero
    refine hG_inf_ae_zero.mono fun om hom => ?_
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hom)
  
  have h_id_all : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      v_inf j om = if 0 ≤ sgn_inf om then lim_pos j (x_inf om) else lim_neg j (x_inf om) :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr h_id_site
  refine ((h_walk_ae.and h_walk_bc).and h_id_all).mono ?_
  intro om ⟨⟨⟨hsgn, _, hv_conv⟩, _, ⟨j_pos, hj_pos⟩, ⟨j_neg, hj_neg⟩⟩, h_id⟩
  have h_contact : ∃ j₀ : Fin P.N, |v_inf j₀ om| = S.H := by
    rcases hsgn with hs1 | hsn1
    · refine ⟨j_pos, ?_⟩
      rw [h_id j_pos, if_pos (by linarith)]
      exact hj_pos
    · refine ⟨j_neg, ?_⟩
      rw [h_id j_neg, if_neg (by linarith)]
      exact hj_neg
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := h_contact
  have h_depth_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun m : ℕ => sliceShapeDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => S.H - |u|) := continuous_const.sub continuous_abs
    have ht := hc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hv_conv j₀)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, sliceShapeDepth, hj₀, sub_self] using ht
  have h_ev_lt : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      sliceShapeDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m) < Real.exp (-M) :=
    h_depth_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (Real.exp_pos (-M)))
  obtain ⟨m, hm_lt⟩ := h_ev_lt.exists
  have h_depth_pos : 0 < sliceShapeDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m) := by
    have hlt : |v_im j₀ (walkPos ρ om m)| < S.H :=
      hv_lt_H j₀ _ (hWalk.walk_in_reg om m).1.1
    dsimp only [sliceShapeDepth, v_im] at *
    linarith
  have hM_le_log : M ≤ sliceLogDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m) := by
    have hlog : Real.log (sliceShapeDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m)) ≤ -M :=
      (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_depth_pos).mpr (le_of_lt hm_lt)
    dsimp only [sliceLogDepth]
    linarith
  have h_le_hist : sliceLogDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ sliceHistory S P ρ om j₀ m :=
    Finset.le_sup' (fun n => sliceLogDepth S P j₀ (walkPos ρ om n))
      (Finset.self_mem_range_succ m)
  have h_le_sup : sliceHistory S P ρ om j₀ m ≤
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) :=
    Finset.le_sup' (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) (Finset.mem_univ j₀)
  exact ⟨m, le_trans hM_le_log (le_trans h_le_hist h_le_sup)⟩

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) :

proof.tactics:
by
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega
  have hN_odd : Odd N :=
    ⟨Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 1, by dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega⟩
  have hN_even_pred : Even (N - 1) :=
    ⟨Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 1, by dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega⟩
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three)
  have ht0_pos : 0 < t₀ := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : t₀ < S.r_star := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ S.r_star_pos).mp hfl
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have hN_mul_t0 : (N : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hN_pos)
  have hN_mul_t0_ℂ : (N : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hN_mul_t0
  have ht0_mem : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by

            field_simp [hD]
  
  have h_reg_deriv_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      (∀ k : Fin N, sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val y ≠ 0) →
      ∀ j : Fin N,
        deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 0) y =
          -(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) *
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y ∧
        deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 1) y =
          (S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) *
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y := by
    intro y hy h_speed j
    let s : ℂ := sliceImpactSeq S N j.val y
    have hs_mem : s ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_impact_maps_to j.val y hy
    have hfs : S.f s ≠ 0 := h_speed j
    have hs_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y :=
      (h_impact_holo j.val).differentiableAt ((h_strip_open h).mem_nhds hy)
    have hΓ_diff := S.Γ_reg_holo s hs_mem hfs
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change deriv ((fun w => S.Γ w 0) ∘ sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y = _
      rw [deriv_comp y hΓ_diff.1 hs_diff, S.Γ_deriv₀ s hs_mem hfs]
      rfl
    · change deriv ((fun w => S.Γ w 1) ∘ sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y = _
      rw [deriv_comp y hΓ_diff.2 hs_diff, S.Γ_deriv₁ s hs_mem hfs]
      rfl
  have h_reg_deriv_sup : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      (∀ k : Fin N, sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val y ≠ 0) →
      ∀ j : Fin N,
        deriv (sliceSupportSeq S N j.val) y =
          (-slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) +
            slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)) *
          deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y := by
    intro y hy h_speed j
    let s : ℂ := sliceImpactSeq S N j.val y
    have hs_mem : s ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_impact_maps_to j.val y hy
    have hfs : S.f s ≠ 0 := h_speed j
    have hs_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y :=
      (h_impact_holo j.val).differentiableAt ((h_strip_open h).mem_nhds hy)
    have hH0_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.H0 s :=
      S.H0_holo.differentiableAt ((h_strip_open S.H).mem_nhds hs_mem)
    have hϕ_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.ϕ s :=
      S.ϕ_holo.differentiableAt ((h_strip_open S.H).mem_nhds hs_mem)
    have hd_sup : deriv (sliceSupportSeq S N j.val) y =
        deriv S.H0 s * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y :=
      deriv_comp y hH0_diff hs_diff
    have hd_ang : deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y =
        S.f s * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y := by
      have hc : deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y =
          deriv S.ϕ s * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y :=
        deriv_comp y hϕ_diff hs_diff
      rw [hc, S.deriv_ϕ s hs_mem]
    rw [hd_sup, hd_ang, S.H0_deriv s hs_mem hfs]
    dsimp [slicePosSeq, sliceAngleSeq, s]
    ring
  
  have h_pos_rec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      (∀ k : Fin N, sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val y ≠ 0) →
      (∀ k : Fin N,
        Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ B_ang B_sup : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_ang → 0 ≤ B_sup →
        (∀ k : Fin N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y‖ +
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin
              (oddSliceTheta S k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y)‖| ≤ B_ang) →
        (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceSupportSeq S N k.val y‖ ≤ B_sup) →
        ∀ j : Fin N,
          ‖slicePosSeq S N j.val y‖ ≤
            oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup := by
    intro y hy h_speed h_sin B_ang B_sup hB_ang hB_sup h_ang_bd h_sup_bd j
    let prev : Fin N → Fin N := @cycPrev N (oddSliceNeZero S)
    let next : Fin N → Fin N := @cycNext N (oddSliceNeZero S)
    have h_next_prev : ∀ k : Fin N, next (prev k) = k := by
      intro k
      ext
      dsimp [next, prev, cycNext, cycPrev]
      rw [Nat.mod_add_mod, show k.val + N - 1 + 1 = k.val + N by omega,
        Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt k.isLt]
    have h_prev_iter : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ N → ∀ k : Fin N,
        (prev^[r] k).val = (k.val + N - r) % N := by
      intro r hr
      induction r with
      | zero =>
        intro k
        simp [Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt k.isLt]
      | succ r ih =>
        intro k
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        dsimp [prev, cycPrev]
        rw [ih (by omega) k,
          show (k.val + N - r) % N + N - 1 = (k.val + N - r) % N + (N - 1) by omega,
          Nat.mod_add_mod,
          show k.val + N - r + (N - 1) = (k.val + N - (r + 1)) + N by omega,
          Nat.add_mod_right]
    have h_prev_N : ∀ k : Fin N, prev^[N] k = k := by
      intro k
      ext
      rw [h_prev_iter N le_rfl k, show k.val + N - N = k.val by omega,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt k.isLt]
    let X : Fin N → Fin 2 → ℂ := fun k => slicePosSeq S N k.val y
    let ψ : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y
    let θ : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => oddSliceTheta S k.val y
    let d : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => θ k - ψ k
    let H0 : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => sliceSupportSeq S N k.val y
    let p : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => X k 0 * Complex.cos (θ k) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (θ k)
    let T_tan : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => -X k 0 * Complex.sin (ψ k) + X k 1 * Complex.cos (ψ k)
    have h_refl_trig : ∀ k : Fin N,
        Complex.cos (θ (prev k)) = Complex.cos (ψ k - d k) ∧
        Complex.sin (θ (prev k)) = Complex.sin (ψ k - d k) := by
      intro k
      have h_alg : 2 * ψ k - θ k = ψ k - d k := by dsimp [d]; ring
      by_cases hk0 : k.val = 0
      · have hpv : (prev k).val = N - 1 := by
          dsimp [prev, cycPrev]
          rw [hk0, zero_add, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
        have hpv_int : ((prev k).val : ℤ) = -1 + (N : ℤ) := by omega
        have h_sum0 := h_θ_sum 0 y hy
        rw [show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 by norm_num] at h_sum0
        have h_sh := h_θ_shift_N (-1) y hy
        have h_eq : θ (prev k) = (ψ k - d k) + 2 * Real.pi := by
          dsimp [θ, ψ] at h_alg ⊢
          rw [hpv_int, h_sh]
          rw [hk0, Nat.cast_zero] at h_alg ⊢
          linear_combination h_sum0 + h_alg
        rw [h_eq, Complex.cos_add_two_pi, Complex.sin_add_two_pi]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · have hpv : (prev k).val = k.val - 1 := by
          dsimp [prev, cycPrev]
          rw [show k.val + N - 1 = (k.val - 1) + N by omega, Nat.add_mod_right,
            Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
        have hpv_int : ((prev k).val : ℤ) = (k.val : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
        have h_sumk := h_θ_sum k.val y hy
        have h_eq : θ (prev k) = ψ k - d k := by
          dsimp [θ, ψ] at h_alg ⊢
          rw [hpv_int]
          linear_combination h_sumk + h_alg
        rw [h_eq]
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hp_prev_proj : ∀ k : Fin N,
        p (prev k) = X k 0 * Complex.cos (θ (prev k)) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (θ (prev k)) := by
      intro k
      let km : Fin N := prev k
      have h_ch := h_reg_chord_vec y hy h_speed km
      have h_nx : slicePosSeq S N ((km.val : ℤ) + 1) y = X k := by
        rw [← h_next_Γ km y hy h_speed]
        change slicePosSeq S N (next (prev k)).val y = slicePosSeq S N k.val y
        rw [h_next_prev k]
      have h0 : X k 0 - X km 0 =
          -(oddSliceChordNum S km y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N km.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((km.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
            Complex.sin (θ km) := by
        simpa [h_nx, X, θ] using h_ch.1
      have h1 : X k 1 - X km 1 =
          (oddSliceChordNum S km y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N km.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((km.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
            Complex.cos (θ km) := by
        simpa [h_nx, X, θ] using h_ch.2
      dsimp [p]
      change X km 0 * Complex.cos (θ km) + X km 1 * Complex.sin (θ km) =
        X k 0 * Complex.cos (θ km) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (θ km)
      linear_combination -Complex.cos (θ km) * h0 - Complex.sin (θ km) * h1
    have hH0_proj : ∀ k : Fin N,
        H0 k = X k 0 * Complex.cos (ψ k) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (ψ k) :=
      fun k => S.H0_eq _ (h_impact_maps_to k.val y hy) (h_speed k)
    have hp_sum_diff : ∀ k : Fin N,
        p (prev k) + p k = 2 * H0 k * Complex.cos (d k) ∧
        p k - p (prev k) = 2 * T_tan k * Complex.sin (d k) := by
      intro k
      have h_th_cos : Complex.cos (θ k) = Complex.cos (ψ k + d k) :=
        congrArg Complex.cos (by dsimp [d]; ring)
      have h_th_sin : Complex.sin (θ k) = Complex.sin (ψ k + d k) :=
        congrArg Complex.sin (by dsimp [d]; ring)
      have h_proj := hp_prev_proj k
      have h_trig := h_refl_trig k
      have h_sup := hH0_proj k
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · change p (prev k) + (X k 0 * Complex.cos (θ k) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (θ k)) =
          2 * H0 k * Complex.cos (d k)
        rw [h_proj, h_trig.1, h_trig.2, h_th_cos, h_th_sin,
          Complex.cos_sub (ψ k) (d k), Complex.sin_sub (ψ k) (d k),
          Complex.cos_add (ψ k) (d k), Complex.sin_add (ψ k) (d k), h_sup]
        ring
      · change (X k 0 * Complex.cos (θ k) + X k 1 * Complex.sin (θ k)) - p (prev k) =
          2 * (-X k 0 * Complex.sin (ψ k) + X k 1 * Complex.cos (ψ k)) * Complex.sin (d k)
        rw [h_proj, h_trig.1, h_trig.2, h_th_cos, h_th_sin,
          Complex.cos_sub (ψ k) (d k), Complex.sin_sub (ψ k) (d k),
          Complex.cos_add (ψ k) (d k), Complex.sin_add (ψ k) (d k)]
        ring
    have hp_formula : ∀ k : Fin N,
        p k = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * H0 (prev^[m] k) * Complex.cos (d (prev^[m] k)) := by
      intro k
      let a_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * p (prev^[m] k)
      have h_step : ∀ m : ℕ,
          a_seq m - a_seq (m + 1) =
            2 * ((-1 : ℂ) ^ m * H0 (prev^[m] k) * Complex.cos (d (prev^[m] k))) := by
        intro m
        change (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * p (prev^[m] k) - (-1 : ℂ) ^ (m + 1) * p (prev^[m + 1] k) = _
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', pow_succ]
        linear_combination (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * (hp_sum_diff (prev^[m] k)).1
      have h_tel := Finset.sum_range_sub' a_seq N
      have h_lhs : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (a_seq m - a_seq (m + 1)) =
          2 * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
            (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * H0 (prev^[m] k) * Complex.cos (d (prev^[m] k)) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => h_step m
      have h_rhs : a_seq 0 - a_seq N = 2 * p k := by
        change (-1 : ℂ) ^ 0 * p (prev^[0] k) - (-1 : ℂ) ^ N * p (prev^[N] k) = 2 * p k
        rw [pow_zero, one_mul, Function.iterate_zero_apply, h_prev_N k, hN_odd.neg_one_pow]
        ring
      rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_tel
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0) h_tel.symm
    
    have h_ang_parts : ∀ k : Fin N,
        ‖ψ k‖ ≤ B_ang ∧ |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖| ≤ B_ang := by
      intro k
      have hbd := h_ang_bd k
      exact ⟨by linarith [abs_nonneg (Real.log ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖)],
        by linarith [norm_nonneg (ψ k)]⟩
    have h_sin_d_bounds : ∀ k : Fin N,
        ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang ∧
        (‖Complex.sin (d k)‖)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
      intro k
      have h_pos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_sin k)
      have habs := abs_le.mp (h_ang_parts k).2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← Real.exp_log h_pos]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr habs.2
      · rw [← Real.exp_log h_pos, ← Real.exp_neg]
        exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [habs.1])
    have h_cos_d_bound : ∀ k : Fin N, ‖Complex.cos (d k)‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp B_ang := by
      intro k
      have h_sq_eq : Complex.cos (d k) ^ 2 = 1 - Complex.sin (d k) ^ 2 := by
        linear_combination Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (d k)
      have h_sq_le : ‖Complex.cos (d k)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 + ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖ ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖Complex.cos (d k)‖ ^ 2
            = ‖Complex.cos (d k) ^ 2‖ := (norm_pow _ 2).symm
          _ = ‖1 - Complex.sin (d k) ^ 2‖ := by rw [h_sq_eq]
          _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖Complex.sin (d k) ^ 2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ = 1 + ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖ ^ 2 := by rw [norm_one, norm_pow]
      have h_le_one_add : ‖Complex.cos (d k)‖ ≤ 1 + ‖Complex.sin (d k)‖ := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Complex.cos (d k)), norm_nonneg (Complex.sin (d k))]
      have h_one_le : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp B_ang := Real.one_le_exp hB_ang
      linarith [(h_sin_d_bounds k).1]
    have hp_bound : ∀ k : Fin N, ‖p k‖ ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup := by
      intro k
      rw [hp_formula k]
      calc ‖∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * H0 (prev^[m] k) * Complex.cos (d (prev^[m] k))‖
          ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
              ‖(-1 : ℂ) ^ m * H0 (prev^[m] k) * Complex.cos (d (prev^[m] k))‖ :=
            norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _m ∈ Finset.range N, (B_sup * (2 * Real.exp B_ang)) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul (h_sup_bd (prev^[m] k)) (h_cos_d_bound (prev^[m] k))
              (norm_nonneg _) hB_sup
        _ = 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
            ring
    have hT_bound : ‖T_tan j‖ ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup := by
      have h_diff := (hp_sum_diff j).2
      have h_sin_pos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin (d j)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h_sin j)
      have h_prod : 2 * ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (d j)‖ ≤
          4 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup := by
        calc 2 * ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (d j)‖
            = ‖2 * T_tan j * Complex.sin (d j)‖ := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat]
          _ = ‖p j - p (prev j)‖ := by rw [← h_diff]
          _ ≤ ‖p j‖ + ‖p (prev j)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup +
              2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup :=
            add_le_add (hp_bound j) (hp_bound (prev j))
          _ = 4 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup := by ring
      have h_div : ‖T_tan j‖ =
          (2 * ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (d j)‖) / 2 * (‖Complex.sin (d j)‖)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt h_sin_pos]
      rw [h_div]
      calc (2 * ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (d j)‖) / 2 * (‖Complex.sin (d j)‖)⁻¹
          ≤ (2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp B_ang * B_sup) * Real.exp B_ang := by
            refine mul_le_mul (by linarith) (h_sin_d_bounds j).2
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h_sin_pos)) (by positivity)
        _ = 2 * (N : ℝ) * (Real.exp B_ang * Real.exp B_ang) * B_sup := by ring
        _ = 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, show B_ang + B_ang = 2 * B_ang by ring]
    have h_psi_trig : ‖Complex.cos (ψ j)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang ∧
        ‖Complex.sin (ψ j)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
      have h_p1 : ‖Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
        calc ‖Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)‖
            ≤ Real.exp ‖ψ j * Complex.I‖ := Complex.norm_exp_le_exp_norm _
          _ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
              rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
              exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (h_ang_parts j).1
      have h_p2 : ‖Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
        calc ‖Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)‖
            ≤ Real.exp ‖-ψ j * Complex.I‖ := Complex.norm_exp_le_exp_norm _
          _ ≤ Real.exp B_ang := by
              rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
              exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (h_ang_parts j).1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Complex.cos]
        calc ‖(Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)) / 2‖
            = ‖Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I) + Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)‖ / 2 := by
              rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
          _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)‖ + ‖Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)‖) / 2 := by
              gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (Real.exp B_ang + Real.exp B_ang) / 2 := by gcongr
          _ = Real.exp B_ang := by ring
      · rw [Complex.sin]
        calc ‖(Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)) * Complex.I / 2‖
            = ‖Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)‖ / 2 := by
              rw [norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_ofNat]
          _ ≤ (‖Complex.exp (-ψ j * Complex.I)‖ + ‖Complex.exp (ψ j * Complex.I)‖) / 2 := by
              gcongr; exact norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ (Real.exp B_ang + Real.exp B_ang) / 2 := by gcongr
          _ = Real.exp B_ang := by ring
    have hX0_eq : X j 0 = H0 j * Complex.cos (ψ j) - T_tan j * Complex.sin (ψ j) := by
      have hs := hH0_proj j
      dsimp [T_tan]
      linear_combination -Complex.cos (ψ j) * hs - X j 0 * Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (ψ j)
    have hX1_eq : X j 1 = H0 j * Complex.sin (ψ j) + T_tan j * Complex.cos (ψ j) := by
      have hs := hH0_proj j
      dsimp [T_tan]
      linear_combination -Complex.sin (ψ j) * hs - X j 1 * Complex.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (ψ j)
    have h_exp1 : Real.exp B_ang ≤ Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      unfold oddSliceCRec
      nlinarith [hN_pos, hB_ang]
    have h_exp3 : Real.exp (3 * B_ang) ≤ Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      unfold oddSliceCRec
      nlinarith [hN_pos, hB_ang]
    have h_coord_le : ∀ (u v c_psi s_psi : ℂ),
        ‖u‖ ≤ B_sup →
        ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup →
        ‖c_psi‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang →
        ‖s_psi‖ ≤ Real.exp B_ang →
        ‖u‖ * ‖c_psi‖ + ‖v‖ * ‖s_psi‖ ≤
          oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup := by
      intro u v c_psi s_psi hu hv hc hs
      have h1 : ‖u‖ * ‖c_psi‖ ≤ B_sup * Real.exp B_ang :=
        mul_le_mul hu hc (norm_nonneg _) hB_sup
      have h2 : ‖v‖ * ‖s_psi‖ ≤ (2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup) * Real.exp B_ang :=
        mul_le_mul hv hs (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have h2_eq : (2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup) * Real.exp B_ang =
          2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (3 * B_ang) * B_sup := by
        calc (2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * B_sup) * Real.exp B_ang
            = 2 * (N : ℝ) * (Real.exp (2 * B_ang) * Real.exp B_ang) * B_sup := by ring
          _ = 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (3 * B_ang) * B_sup := by
              rw [← Real.exp_add, show 2 * B_ang + B_ang = 3 * B_ang by ring]
      rw [h2_eq] at h2
      have h3 : B_sup * Real.exp B_ang ≤ B_sup * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp1 hB_sup
      have h4 : 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (3 * B_ang) * B_sup ≤
          2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup := by
        gcongr
      have hC_ge : 2 * (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ oddSliceCRec S := by
        unfold oddSliceCRec; dsimp [N]; linarith
      have h_exp_pos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup := by positivity
      have h5 : (2 * (N : ℝ) + 1) * (Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup) ≤
          oddSliceCRec S * (Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_ge h_exp_pos
      linarith
    have hRHS_nonneg : 0 ≤ oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup := by
      unfold oddSliceCRec; positivity
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hRHS_nonneg).mpr (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
    · change ‖X j 0‖ ≤ _
      rw [hX0_eq]
      calc ‖H0 j * Complex.cos (ψ j) - T_tan j * Complex.sin (ψ j)‖
          ≤ ‖H0 j * Complex.cos (ψ j)‖ + ‖T_tan j * Complex.sin (ψ j)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖H0 j‖ * ‖Complex.cos (ψ j)‖ + ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (ψ j)‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup :=
            h_coord_le _ _ _ _ (h_sup_bd j) hT_bound h_psi_trig.1 h_psi_trig.2
    · change ‖X j 1‖ ≤ _
      rw [hX1_eq]
      calc ‖H0 j * Complex.sin (ψ j) + T_tan j * Complex.cos (ψ j)‖
          ≤ ‖H0 j * Complex.sin (ψ j)‖ + ‖T_tan j * Complex.cos (ψ j)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖H0 j‖ * ‖Complex.sin (ψ j)‖ + ‖T_tan j‖ * ‖Complex.cos (ψ j)‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
        _ ≤ oddSliceCRec S * Real.exp (oddSliceCRec S * B_ang) * B_sup :=
            h_coord_le _ _ _ _ (h_sup_bd j) hT_bound h_psi_trig.2 h_psi_trig.1
  exact {
    impact_holo := h_impact_holo
    impact_maps_to := h_impact_maps_to
    impact_quasiperiodic := h_impact_quasi
    impact_shift_N := h_impact_shift_N
    impact_conj := h_impact_conj
    holoScaledPos_holo := h_K_holo
    holoScaledPos_periodic := h_K_periodic
    holoScaledPos_eq := h_K_eq
    θ_holo := h_θ_holo
    θ_quasiperiodic := h_θ_quasi
    θ_shift_N := h_θ_shift_N
    θ_conj := h_θ_conj
    θ_sum := h_θ_sum
    θ_real := h_θ_real
    θ_eq_stateTheta := h_θ_eq_state
    θ_eq_gl_strip := h_θ_eq_gl_strip
    ℓ_num_holo := h_ℓ_num_holo
    ℓ_num_periodic := h_ℓ_num_periodic
    ℓ_real := h_ℓ_real
    reg_chord_vec_pt := h_reg_chord_vec
    reg_deriv_pos_pt := h_reg_deriv_pos
    reg_deriv_support_pt := h_reg_deriv_sup
    pos_reconstruction_pt := h_pos_rec
  }
