proof.tactics:
by
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let inst : NeZero N := oddSliceNeZero S
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_odd : Odd N :=
    ⟨Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) + 1, by dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega⟩
  have hN_pos_nat : 0 < N := by omega
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_pos_nat
  have hN_ne_zero : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN_pos_nat.ne'
  have ht0_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 N := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : sliceParamT0 N < S.r_star := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ S.r_star_pos).mp hfl
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have ht0_mem : (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht0_pos]
    exact ht0_lt
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht0_mem).1
  have h_open_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_real_in_strip : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := by
    intro x
    simp [horizStrip, hh_pos]
  have hA_ne_zero : S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hpos := S.A_real_pos (sliceParamT0 N) ht0_pos ht0_lt
    rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  have h_d0_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, ∀ j : Fin N,
      stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j =
        oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y := by
    intro y hy j
    unfold stateD0
    rw [← hChord.θ_eq_stateTheta y hy j]
    rfl
  have h_speed_next : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, ∀ j : Fin N,
      sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y =
        sliceSpeedSeq S N (@cycNext N inst j).val y := by
    intro y hy j
    by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < N
    · have hcyc : (@cycNext N inst j).val = j.val + 1 := by
        dsimp [cycNext]
        exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj
      rw [hcyc]
      push_cast
      rfl
    · have hj_eq : j.val + 1 = N := by omega
      have hcyc : (@cycNext N inst j).val = 0 := by
        dsimp [cycNext]
        rw [hj_eq, Nat.mod_self]
      have hcast : (j.val : ℤ) + 1 = 0 + (N : ℤ) := by omega
      rw [hcyc, hcast]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, sliceSpeedSeq]
      rw [hChord.impact_shift_N 0 y hy]
      exact S.f_periodic _ (hChord.impact_maps_to 0 y hy)
  let cycNextEquiv : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) :=
    { toFun := @cycNext N inst
      invFun := @cycPrev N inst
      left_inv := fun j => by
        ext
        dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
        by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < N
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj]
          have h1 : j.val + 1 + N - 1 = j.val + N := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
        · have hj_eq : j.val + 1 = N := by omega
          rw [hj_eq, Nat.mod_self]
          have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = j.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
      right_inv := fun j => by
        ext
        dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
        by_cases hj : j.val = 0
        · rw [hj]
          have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = N - 1 := by omega
          have hlt : N - 1 < N := by omega
          have h2 : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_self]
        · have h1 : j.val + N - 1 = (j.val - 1) + N := by omega
          have hlt : j.val - 1 < N := by omega
          have h2 : j.val - 1 + 1 = j.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt] }
  have h_delta_ne_zero : ∀ z : Fin N → ℂ,
      (∀ m : Fin N, stateChordNum S z m ≠ 0) →
      (∀ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m) ≠ 0) →
      stateDeltaRow S z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hch hsn
    unfold stateDeltaRow
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun m _ => hch m))
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun m _ => hsn m))
  
  have h_f_holo : ∀ k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro k
    exact S.f_holo.comp (hChord.impact_holo k.val)
      (fun y hy => hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)
  have h_phi_holo : ∀ k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => S.ϕ (oddSliceStateVec S y k)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro k
    exact S.ϕ_holo.comp (hChord.impact_holo k.val)
      (fun y hy => hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)
  have h_shifted_holo : ∀ (j : Fin N) (m : ℕ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateShiftedAngle S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j m) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j m
    unfold stateShiftedAngle
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact h_phi_holo _
    · exact (h_phi_holo _).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
  have h_theta_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateTheta S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    unfold stateTheta
    exact (differentiableOn_const _).add
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_sum (fun m _ => (differentiableOn_const _).mul (h_shifted_holo j m)))
  have h_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    unfold stateD0
    exact (h_theta_holo j).sub (h_phi_holo j)
  have h_sin_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    exact Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (h_d0_holo j)
  have h_chord_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) (horizStrip h) :=
    hChord.ℓ_num_holo
  have h_delta_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) (horizStrip h) := by
    unfold stateDeltaRow
    exact (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m)).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m))
  have h_M0_entry_holo : ∀ i k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedM0Entry S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro i k
    unfold stateClearedM0Entry
    have hP_sin : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => ∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m))
        (horizStrip h) :=
      DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m)
    have hP_ell : ∀ r : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) m)
        (horizStrip h) :=
      fun r => DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m)
    refine ((?_ : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ (horizStrip h)).add ?_).add ?_
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact (((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).add
          (((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _))).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hki : k = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) i
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hik' : i = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) k
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((((h_f_holo _).mul (h_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin)
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have h_VDiag_holo : ∀ i : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedVDiag S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro i
    unfold stateClearedVDiag
    exact ((((differentiableOn_const _).mul ((h_f_holo i).pow 3)).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_chord_holo m))).mul
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun m _ => h_sin_d0_holo m)))
  have h_B_entry_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (i k : Fin N),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro I F i k
    simp only [stateClearedB, Matrix.of_apply]
    by_cases hIF : i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F
    · simp only [hIF, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · by_cases hiI : k ∈ I
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          exact (h_M0_entry_holo k k).sub (h_VDiag_holo k)
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_false, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
          exact h_M0_entry_holo k k
      · simp only [hik, false_and, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
        exact h_M0_entry_holo i k
    · simp only [hIF, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact h_delta_holo
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have h_det_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro I F
    have h_eq : (fun y => (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det) =
        fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            ∏ i : Fin N, stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) (σ i) i := by
      ext y
      rw [Matrix.det_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun σ _ =>
      (differentiableOn_const _).mul
        (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd fun i _ => h_B_entry_holo I F (σ i) i)
  have h_impact_deriv_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y) (horizStrip h) := by
    intro j
    exact (hChord.impact_holo j.val).deriv h_open_strip
  
  have h_real_not_Z : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ oddSliceZAll S := by
    intro x hxZ
    have hx_strip : (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := h_real_in_strip x
    have hpos := (odd_slice_real_collar_positivity_and_symplectic_sum S hChord x).1
    have hf_nz : ∀ k : Fin N, sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val x ≠ 0 := by
      intro k hk0
      have hre := (hpos k).1.1
      rw [hk0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hsin_nz : ∀ k : Fin N,
        Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S k.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro k hk0
      have hre := (hpos k).2.1.1
      rw [hk0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hchord_nz : ∀ k : Fin N, oddSliceChordNum S k x ≠ 0 :=
      fun k => (hpos k).2.2.1
    rcases hxZ.2 with ⟨j, hj0 | hj0 | hj0⟩ | ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, hdet0⟩
    · exact hf_nz j hj0
    · rw [h_d0_eq x hx_strip j] at hj0
      exact hsin_nz j hj0
    · exact hchord_nz j hj0
    · have hpt := odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord x hx_strip
        hf_nz hsin_nz hchord_nz
      let ℓ_r : Fin N → ℝ := fun i =>
        (oddSliceChordNum S i x /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) x)).re
      let w_r : Fin N → ℝ := fun i =>
        (jacobiNullVec N S.c
          (fun m => sliceSpeedSeq S N m.val x)
          (fun m => oddSliceTheta S m.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N m.val x)
          (fun m => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N m.val) x) i).re
      have hℓ_pos : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ℓ_r i := fun i => (hpos i).2.2.2.1.1
      have hw_pos : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < w_r i := fun i => (hpos i).2.2.2.2.1
      have hℓ_cast : (fun i : Fin N => (ℓ_r i : ℂ)) =
          (fun i : Fin N => oddSliceChordNum S i x /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) x)) := by
        funext i
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [ℓ_r]
        · simpa using ((hpos i).2.2.2.1.2).symm
      have hw_cast : (fun i : Fin N => (w_r i : ℂ)) =
          jacobiNullVec N S.c
            (fun m => sliceSpeedSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun m => oddSliceTheta S m.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun m => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N m.val) x) := by
        funext i
        apply Complex.ext
        · simp [w_r]
        · simpa using ((hpos i).2.2.2.2.2).symm
      have h_null_r :
          (@jacobiH N inst S.c
            (fun m => sliceSpeedSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun m => oddSliceTheta S m.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ))).mulVec (fun i => (w_r i : ℂ)) = 0 := by
        rw [hℓ_cast, hw_cast]
        exact hpt.2.1
      have hdet_mod_nz :
          (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c
            (fun m => sliceSpeedSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun m => oddSliceTheta S m.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N m.val x)
            (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i x /
              (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) x))
            I F).det ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hℓ_cast]
        exact odd_cycle_modified_jacobi_det_ne_zero N hN_odd S.c _ _ ℓ_r w_r
          hℓ_pos hw_pos h_null_r I F hI hIF
      have hsin_state_nz : ∀ m : Fin N,
          Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S x) m) ≠ 0 := by
        intro m
        rw [h_d0_eq x hx_strip m]
        exact hsin_nz m
      have hdelta_nz : stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S x) ≠ 0 :=
        h_delta_ne_zero (oddSliceStateVec S x) hchord_nz hsin_state_nz
      have hB_eq := hpt.2.2.1 I F
      have hdet_cleared :
          (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S x)).det ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hB_eq, Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero N hdelta_nz) hdet_mod_nz
      exact hdet_cleared hdet0
  
  have h_strip_per : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip h ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip h := by
    intro y
    simp [horizStrip]
  have h_Z_obs_per : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h,
      (∀ k : Fin N,
        S.f (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi) k) = S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y k) ∧
        stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k =
          stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) k ∧
        stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k =
          stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) k) ∧
      (∀ I F : Finset (Fin N),
        stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) =
          stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)) := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip h := (h_strip_per y).mp hy
    have hf_p : ∀ k : Fin N,
        S.f (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi) k) = S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y k) := by
      intro k
      unfold oddSliceStateVec
      rw [hChord.impact_quasiperiodic k.val y hy]
      exact S.f_periodic _ (hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)
    have hd0_p : ∀ k : Fin N,
        stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k =
          stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) k := by
      intro k
      rw [h_d0_eq (y + 2 * Real.pi) hy' k, h_d0_eq y hy k,
        hChord.θ_quasiperiodic k.val y hy]
      unfold sliceAngleSeq
      rw [hChord.impact_quasiperiodic k.val y hy,
        S.ϕ_quasiperiodic _ (hChord.impact_maps_to k.val y hy)]
      ring
    have hch_p : ∀ k : Fin N,
        stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) k =
          stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) k :=
      fun k => hChord.ℓ_num_periodic k y hy
    refine ⟨fun k => ⟨hf_p k, hd0_p k, hch_p k⟩, ?_⟩
    intro I F
    have hdel_p : stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) =
        stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y) := by
      unfold stateDeltaRow
      simp only [hch_p, hd0_p]
    have hM0_p : ∀ i k : Fin N,
        stateClearedM0Entry S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) i k =
          stateClearedM0Entry S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i k := by
      intro i k
      unfold stateClearedM0Entry
      simp only [hf_p, hd0_p, hch_p]
    have hV_p : ∀ i : Fin N,
        stateClearedVDiag S (oddSliceStateVec S (y + 2 * Real.pi)) i =
          stateClearedVDiag S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i := by
      intro i
      unfold stateClearedVDiag
      simp only [hf_p, hd0_p, hch_p]
    ext i k
    simp only [stateClearedB, Matrix.of_apply, hM0_p, hV_p, hdel_p]
  have h_Z_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ oddSliceZAll S ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ oddSliceZAll S := by
    intro y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, hcond⟩
      have hy' : y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStrip h := (h_strip_per y).mp hy
      obtain ⟨hobs, hB⟩ := h_Z_obs_per y hy
      refine ⟨hy', ?_⟩
      rcases hcond with ⟨j, hj | hj | hj⟩ | ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, hdet⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inl (by rw [(hobs j).1]; exact hj)⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [(hobs j).2.1]; exact hj))⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [(hobs j).2.2]; exact hj))⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, by rw [hB I F]; exact hdet⟩
    · rintro ⟨hy', hcond⟩
      have hy : y ∈ horizStrip h := (h_strip_per y).mpr hy'
      obtain ⟨hobs, hB⟩ := h_Z_obs_per y hy
      refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
      rcases hcond with ⟨j, hj | hj | hj⟩ | ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, hdet⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inl (by rw [← (hobs j).1]; exact hj)⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inl (by rw [← (hobs j).2.1]; exact hj))⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [← (hobs j).2.2]; exact hj))⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, by rw [← hB I F]; exact hdet⟩
  
  obtain ⟨h_strip_eq, h_strip_zeros⟩ := strip_holo_real_eqOn_and_compact_zeros_finite h hh_pos
  let ι : Type :=
    Sum (Fin N) (Sum (Fin N) (Sum (Fin N)
      { p : Finset (Fin N) × Finset (Fin N) // p.1 ⊂ Finset.univ ∧ Disjoint p.1 p.2 }))
  let g_fam : ι → ℂ → ℂ := fun a y =>
    match a with
    | Sum.inl j => S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j)
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl j) => Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j)
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j)) => stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr p)) =>
        (stateClearedB S p.val.1 p.val.2 (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det
  have hg_holo : ∀ a : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g_fam a) (horizStrip h) := by
    rintro (j | j | j | p)
    · exact h_f_holo j
    · exact h_sin_d0_holo j
    · exact h_chord_holo j
    · exact h_det_holo p.val.1 p.val.2
  have h_Z_iff_fam : ∀ y : ℂ,
      y ∈ oddSliceZAll S ↔ y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∃ a : ι, g_fam a y = 0 := by
    intro y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, ⟨j, hj | hj | hj⟩ | ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, hdet⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Sum.inl j, hj⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Sum.inr (Sum.inl j), hj⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl j)), hj⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ⟨(I, F), hI, hIF⟩)), hdet⟩
    · rintro ⟨hy, (j | j | j | ⟨⟨I, F⟩, hI, hIF⟩), ha⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inl ha⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inl ha)⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inr ha)⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨hy, Or.inr ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, ha⟩⟩
  have hg_nz : ∀ a : ι, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, g_fam a x₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨0, fun ha0 => h_real_not_Z 0 ?_⟩
    rw [h_Z_iff_fam]
    exact ⟨h_real_in_strip 0, a, ha0⟩
  obtain ⟨h_fam_open, h_fam_fin⟩ := h_strip_zeros ι g_fam hg_holo hg_nz
  have h_reg_eq : horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S =
      { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∀ a : ι, g_fam a y ≠ 0 } := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, h_Z_iff_fam]
    tauto
  have h_reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S) := by
    rw [h_reg_eq]
    exact h_fam_open
  have h_Z_eq_fam : oddSliceZAll S =
      { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∃ a : ι, g_fam a y = 0 } := by
    ext y
    exact h_Z_iff_fam y
  have h_Z_compact_fin : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < h →
      (oddSliceZAll S ∩
        { y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ h - ε }).Finite := by
    intro ε hε1 hε2
    rw [h_Z_eq_fam]
    exact h_fam_fin ε hε1 hε2
  
  have h_reg_speed : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ j : Fin N, sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy j h0
    exact hy.2 ⟨hy.1, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inl h0⟩⟩
  have h_reg_sin_d0 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ j : Fin N,
        Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy j h0
    rw [← h_d0_eq y hy.1 j] at h0
    exact hy.2 ⟨hy.1, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inl h0)⟩⟩
  have h_reg_chord_num : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ j : Fin N, oddSliceChordNum S j y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy j h0
    exact hy.2 ⟨hy.1, Or.inl ⟨j, Or.inr (Or.inr h0)⟩⟩
  have h_reg_chord : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ j : Fin N,
        oddSliceChordNum S j y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy j
    rw [h_speed_next y hy.1 j]
    exact div_ne_zero (h_reg_chord_num y hy j)
      (mul_ne_zero (h_reg_speed y hy j) (h_reg_speed y hy (@cycNext N inst j)))
  have h_jacobi_M0 : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ j : Fin N,
        2 * sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y =
          (@jacobiM0 N inst
            (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
              (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
            (jacobiNullVec N S.c
              (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
              (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
              (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y)) j := by
    intro y hy j
    exact (odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord y hy.1
      (h_reg_speed y hy) (h_reg_sin_d0 y hy) (h_reg_chord_num y hy)).1 j
  have h_jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      (@jacobiH N inst S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => oddSliceChordNum S j y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
        (jacobiNullVec N S.c
          (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
          (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
          (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y)) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact (odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord y hy.1
      (h_reg_speed y hy) (h_reg_sin_d0 y hy) (h_reg_chord_num y hy)).2.1
  have h_mod_det_nz : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S,
      ∀ I F : Finset (Fin N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
        (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
          I F).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy I F hI hIF hdet0
    have hB_eq := (odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord y hy.1
      (h_reg_speed y hy) (h_reg_sin_d0 y hy) (h_reg_chord_num y hy)).2.2.1 I F
    have hdet_cl : (stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det = 0 := by
      rw [hB_eq, Matrix.det_smul, hdet0, mul_zero]
    exact hy.2 ⟨hy.1, Or.inr ⟨I, F, hI, hIF, hdet_cl⟩⟩
  
  have h_cleared_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S x) j) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) x) ^ 2 *
        (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S x i)) ^ 2) *
        (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S x)) ^ N =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
        (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S x j)) ^ 4 *
        (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S x) i) *
        (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S x)).det := by
    intro x j
    have hx_strip : (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := h_real_in_strip x
    obtain ⟨hpos, hsymp⟩ := odd_slice_real_collar_positivity_and_symplectic_sum S hChord x
    let f_vec : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val x
    let d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val x - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val x
    let ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ := fun i =>
      oddSliceChordNum S i x /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) x)
    let sp_vec : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) x
    let w : Fin N → ℂ := jacobiNullVec N S.c f_vec d0_vec sp_vec
    have hf_nz : ∀ i : Fin N, f_vec i ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi0
      have hre := (hpos i).1.1
      dsimp [f_vec] at hi0
      rw [hi0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hsin_nz : ∀ i : Fin N, Complex.sin (d0_vec i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi0
      have hre := (hpos i).2.1.1
      dsimp [d0_vec] at hi0
      rw [hi0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hchord_nz : ∀ i : Fin N, oddSliceChordNum S i x ≠ 0 :=
      fun i => (hpos i).2.2.1
    have hℓ_nz : ∀ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi0
      have hre := (hpos i).2.2.2.1.1
      dsimp [ℓ_vec] at hi0
      rw [hi0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hw_nz : ∀ i : Fin N, w i ≠ 0 := by
      intro i hi0
      have hre := (hpos i).2.2.2.2.1
      dsimp [w, f_vec, d0_vec, sp_vec] at hi0
      rw [hi0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
    have hpt := odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord x hx_strip
      hf_nz hsin_nz hchord_nz
    have htree := cycle_jacobi_deleted_cofactor_eq_tree_sum N hN_ge_three S.c
      f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec w hℓ_nz hpt.2.1 j
    let γ : Fin N → ℂ := fun s => w s * w (@cycNext N inst s) / ℓ_vec s
    have hγ_nz : ∀ s : Fin N, γ s ≠ 0 := fun s =>
      div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (hw_nz s) (hw_nz (@cycNext N inst s))) (hℓ_nz s)
    have herase_eq : ∀ r : Fin N,
        (∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, γ s) =
          (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * (ℓ_vec r / (w r * w (@cycNext N inst r))) := by
      intro r
      have hmul := Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ γ (Finset.mem_univ r)
      have hw1 := hw_nz r
      have hw2 := hw_nz (@cycNext N inst r)
      have hl := hℓ_nz r
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hγ_nz r)
      rw [hmul]
      dsimp [γ]
      field_simp
    have hsum_gamma :
        (∑ r : Fin N, ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, γ s) =
          (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * ((N : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)) := by
      calc
        (∑ r : Fin N, ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, γ s)
            = ∑ r : Fin N, (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * (ℓ_vec r / (w r * w (@cycNext N inst r))) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => herase_eq r)
        _ = (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * ∑ r : Fin N, (ℓ_vec r / (w r * w (@cycNext N inst r))) := by
          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * ((N : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)) := by
          rw [hsymp]
    let P_w : ℂ := ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2
    let P_ℓ : ℂ := ∏ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i
    have hP_w : P_w ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hw_nz i))
    have hP_ℓ : P_ℓ ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hℓ_nz i)
    have hprod_gamma : ∏ s : Fin N, γ s = ((w j) ^ 2 * P_w) / P_ℓ := by
      dsimp [γ, P_w, P_ℓ]
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      have hshift : (∏ s : Fin N, w (@cycNext N inst s)) = ∏ s : Fin N, w s :=
        Equiv.prod_comp cycNextEquiv w
      rw [hshift, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      have hsq : (∏ s : Fin N, w s * w s) = ∏ s : Fin N, (w s) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun s _ => (sq (w s)).symm)
      rw [hsq, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => (w i) ^ 2) (Finset.mem_univ j)]
    let D_j : ℂ :=
      (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
    have htree_eq :
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * P_w * D_j =
          (((w j) ^ 2 * P_w) / P_ℓ) * ((N : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)) := by
      calc
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * P_w * D_j
            = ∑ r : Fin N, ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, γ s := htree
        _ = (∏ s : Fin N, γ s) * ((N : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)) := hsum_gamma
        _ = (((w j) ^ 2 * P_w) / P_ℓ) * ((N : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)) := by
          rw [hprod_gamma]
    have hcof_x :
        (w j) ^ 2 =
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) * P_ℓ * D_j := by
      have h_cl :
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * P_w * D_j * P_ℓ * S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) =
            (w j) ^ 2 * P_w * (N : ℂ) := by
        rw [htree_eq]
        field_simp
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hP_w
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hN_ne_zero
      have hR :
          P_w * ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) * P_ℓ * D_j) *
            (N : ℂ) =
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * P_w * D_j * P_ℓ * S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) := by
        field_simp
      rw [hR, h_cl]
      ring
    exact (hpt.2.2.2 j).mp hcof_x
  have h_cleared_strip : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) *
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y) ^ 2 *
        (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y i)) ^ 2) *
        (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) ^ N =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
        (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j)) ^ 4 *
        (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) *
        (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det := by
    intro y hy j
    have hLHS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z =>
          ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S z) j) *
              deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) z) ^ 2 *
            (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S z i)) ^ 2) *
            (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S z)) ^ N)
        (horizStrip h) :=
      (((((differentiableOn_const _).mul (h_sin_d0_holo j)).mul
        (h_impact_deriv_holo j)).pow 2).mul
        (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun i _ => (h_f_holo i).pow 2))).mul
        (h_delta_holo.pow N)
    have hRHS_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z =>
          (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) *
            (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
            (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S z j)) ^ 4 *
            (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S z) i) *
            (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S z)).det)
        (horizStrip h) :=
      ((((differentiableOn_const _).mul ((h_f_holo j).pow 4)).mul
        (DifferentiableOn.fun_finsetProd (fun i _ => h_chord_holo i))).mul
        (h_det_holo (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅))
    exact h_strip_eq _ _ hLHS_holo hRHS_holo (fun x => h_cleared_real x j) y hy
  have h_cofactor_reg : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h \ oddSliceZAll S, ∀ j : Fin N,
      (jacobiNullVec N S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) *
        (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
        (∏ i : Fin N,
          (oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
        (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
          (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det := by
    intro y hy j
    exact ((odd_slice_pointwise_jacobi_and_cleared_B S hChord y hy.1
      (h_reg_speed y hy) (h_reg_sin_d0 y hy) (h_reg_chord_num y hy)).2.2.2 j).mpr
      (h_cleared_strip y hy.1 j)
  exact {
    Z_all_subset := fun _ hy => hy.1
    reg_open := h_reg_open
    real_not_mem_Z_all := h_real_not_Z
    Z_all_periodic := h_Z_periodic
    Z_all_compact_finite := h_Z_compact_fin
    reg_speed_ne_zero := h_reg_speed
    reg_sin_d0_ne_zero := h_reg_sin_d0
    reg_chord_ne_zero := h_reg_chord
    jacobi_null := h_jacobi_null
    jacobi_M0_mulVec := h_jacobi_M0
    modified_det_ne_zero := h_mod_det_nz
    cofactor_norm := h_cofactor_reg
    cleared_cofactor_eq := h_cleared_strip
  }

subgoal_signatures.name: cycle_jacobi_deleted_cofactor_eq_tree_sum
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N)
    (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec w : Fin N → ℂ)

by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hs1 : ∀ (M : ℝ), 0 < M → ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ),

        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, g (y + 2 * Real.pi) = g y) →
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, ‖g y‖ ≤ M) →
        ∃ (ψ : ℝ → ℂ) (C_rem : ℝ),
          MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable ψ MeasureTheory.volume ∧
          0 ≤ C_rem ∧
          ∀ u d : ℝ, 0 < d → d ≤ h / 2 →
            ‖g ((u : ℂ) + ((h - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) -
              ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
                (∫ t in (u - Real.pi)..(u + Real.pi),
                  ((Real.sinh d / (Real.cosh d - Real.cos (u - t)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ψ t)‖ ≤
              C_rem * d := by
      intro M hM g hg_holo hg_per hg_bdd
      let T : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi
      have hT_pos : 0 < T := mul_pos zero_lt_two Real.pi_pos
      have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
      have hT_fact : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨hT_pos⟩
      let g_slice : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun v x => g ((x : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have h_mem_strip : ∀ (v x : ℝ), |v| < h → (x : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ horizStrip h := by
        intro v x hv
        simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
        exact hv
      have hg_slice_cont : ∀ (v : ℝ), |v| < h → Continuous (g_slice v) := by
        intro v hv
        exact hg_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const) (fun x => h_mem_strip v x hv)
      have hg_slice_per : ∀ (v : ℝ), |v| < h → Function.Periodic (g_slice v) T := by
        intro v hv x
        dsimp [g_slice, T]
        have h_eq : ((x + 2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I =
            ((x : ℂ) + (v : ℂ) * Complex.I) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact hg_per _ (h_mem_strip v x hv)
      let G_cont : ∀ (v : ℝ), |v| < h → C(AddCircle T, ℂ) := fun v hv =>
        ⟨AddCircle.liftIco T 0 (g_slice v),
          AddCircle.liftIco_continuous
            (by rw [← hg_slice_per v hv 0, zero_add])
            (hg_slice_cont v hv).continuousOn⟩
      have hG_coe : ∀ (v : ℝ) (hv : |v| < h) (x : ℝ),
          G_cont v hv (x : AddCircle T) = g_slice v x := by
        intro v hv x

        have hx₀_mem : x₀ ∈ Set.Ico 0 T := by
          have h1 : (k : ℝ) * T ≤ x := (le_div_iff₀ hT_pos).mp (Int.floor_le (x / T))
          have h2 : x < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * T := (div_lt_iff₀ hT_pos).mp (Int.lt_floor_add_one (x / T))

          have hx_eq : x = x₀ + k • T := by dsimp [x₀]; rw [zsmul_eq_mul]; ring
          conv_lhs => rw [hx_eq]
          rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul, AddCircle.coe_period, zsmul_zero,
            add_zero]

          have hx_eq : x = x₀ + k * T := by dsimp [x₀]; ring
          conv_lhs => rw [hx_eq]
          exact (hg_slice_per v hv).int_mul k x₀

        rw [h_coe_eq, AddCircle.liftIco_zero_coe_apply hx₀_mem, h_per_eq]
      have hG_norm : ∀ (v : ℝ) (hv : |v| < h) (z : AddCircle T), ‖G_cont v hv z‖ ≤ M := by
        intro v hv z

        rw [hG_coe v hv x]
        exact hg_bdd _ (h_mem_strip v x hv)

        intro m x
        rw [fourier_coe_apply]
        congr 1
        dsimp [T]

        field_simp [ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos]

            · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hv0] at hy_im

              exact ⟨by linarith [hy_im.1], hy_im.2⟩
            · rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hv0] at hy_im
              rw [abs_of_nonpos hv0, abs_le]
              exact ⟨by linarith [hy_im.1], by linarith [hy_im.2]⟩

        simp only [Complex.zero_re, Complex.zero_im, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul, add_zero,
          zero_add] at h_rect

        have hw_im : w_top.im = v := by simp [w_top]

            rcases le_total 0 v with hv0 | hv0
            · rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hv0] at hτ

        filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds z₀ hρ₀_pos)] with z hz
        exact hF_zero_ball z hz
      have hF_eq_zero := hF_analytic.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
        h_strip_conv.isPreconnected hz₀_strip h_freq
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_nz⟩ := hF_nz
      have hx₀_strip : (x₀ : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := by simp [horizStrip, hh]
      exact hx₀_nz (hF_eq_zero hx₀_strip)
    intro F hF_holo hF_nz
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
    by_contra h_not_null
    have h_not_null' : MeasureTheory.volume
        {x : ℝ | Filter.Tendsto F
          (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)})
          (nhds 0)} ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [Classical.not_not] using h_not_null
    obtain ⟨K, δ₀, δ_seq, hK_compact, hK_pos, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le, hδ_seq, hF_bdd, hF_small⟩ :=
      hs4 F hF_holo.continuousOn h_not_null'
    exact hs5 F hF_holo hF_nz K δ₀ δ_seq hK_compact hK_pos hδ₀_pos hδ₀_le hδ_seq hF_bdd hF_small

noncomputable def clearedReflectE (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let Km := holoScaledPos S s_m
  let K0 := holoScaledPos S s_0
  let Kp := holoScaledPos S s_p
  let fm := S.f s_m
  let f0 := S.f s_0
  let fp := S.f s_p
  let c0 := Complex.cos (S.ϕ s_0)
  let sn0 := Complex.sin (S.ϕ s_0)

    (-dm0 * sn0 + dm1 * c0) * (dp0 * c0 + dp1 * sn0)

structure ReturnMapNormalFormData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  ρ_0 : ℝ
  ρ_v : ℝ
  ρ_1 : ℝ
  ρ_v1 : ℝ
  ρ_s : ℝ
  ρ_bounds :
    0 < ρ_1 ∧ ρ_1 ≤ ρ_0 ∧ ρ_0 < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 2 ∧
    0 < ρ_v1 ∧ ρ_v1 ≤ ρ_v ∧ 0 < ρ_s
  s0_arc : ℂ → ℂ
  s1_arc : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_arc_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_arc
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  s1_arc_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s1_arc
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  s0_arc_in_strip :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      s0_arc u ∈ horizStrip S.H
  s0_inv_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv
      (Metric.ball (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s)
  s0_arc_left_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1,
      s0_arc u ∈
        Metric.ball
          (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s ∧
      s0_inv (s0_arc u) = u
  s0_inv_right_inv :
    ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball
        (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s,
      s0_inv w ∈
        Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ∧
      s0_arc (s0_inv w) = w
  F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  σ : ℂ → ℂ
  A_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  F_plus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_minus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  σ_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ σ
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0)
  σ_ne_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      σ u ≠ 0
  rem_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_plus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
        F_plus (u, v) =
          (u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v),
           v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v))
  F_minus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
        F_minus (u, v) =
          (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),
           v + deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_minus (u, v))
  F_mutual_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1,
        F_plus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∧
        F_minus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∧
        F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v)
  slice_at_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      S.𝔰 (y, (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = s0_arc y ∧
      S.𝔰 (y + (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = s1_arc y
  chartV_deriv_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      deriv (fun t => S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))))
        (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) =
        (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (σ y)⁻¹
  subheight_tube_step :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball
            ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2),
          y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_μ,
            (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈
              Metric.ball
                (s0_arc ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ρ_s ∧
            (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
              Metric.ball ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ_1 ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1 ∧
            (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) ∈
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_edge : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (ρ_1 / 2) →
              (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))).im <
                sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
              F_plus (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                (s0_inv
                  (S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)), t)),
                 S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                   s1_arc
                     (s0_inv
                       (S.𝔰
                         (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)),
                           t)))))

def steepCorridorSet (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_edge δ_cor r_steep : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < δ_cor ∧
    sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - 2 * δ_cor < p.1.im ∧
    p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) + δ_cor / 2 ∧
    0 < ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_steep ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ / 3 <
      |(p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)).im| }

  x_edge : ℝ
  δ_cor : ℝ
  r_steep : ℝ
  δ_cor_pos : 0 < δ_cor
  δ_cor_lt : δ_cor < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 4 ∧ δ_cor < S.s_star / 2
  r_steep_pos : 0 < r_steep
  r_steep_lt : r_steep < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S)
  S_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  S_steep_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_steep (steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep)
  S_steep_in_strip :
    ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep, S_steep p ∈ horizStrip S.H
  S_steep_agrees :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ ≤ r_steep ∧
        ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep,
          p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_μ →
          S_steep p = S.𝔰 p

def steepCorridorSet (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_edge δ_cor r_steep : ℝ) :
    Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    |p.1.re - x_edge| < δ_cor ∧
    sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - 2 * δ_cor < p.1.im ∧
    p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) + δ_cor / 2 ∧
    0 < ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_steep ∧
    ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ / 3 <
      |(p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)).im| }

structure SteepSliceSectorData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  x_edge : ℝ
  δ_cor : ℝ
  r_steep : ℝ
  δ_cor_pos : 0 < δ_cor
  δ_cor_lt : δ_cor < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) / 4 ∧ δ_cor < S.s_star / 2
  r_steep_pos : 0 < r_steep
  r_steep_lt : r_steep < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S)
  S_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  S_steep_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_steep (steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep)
  S_steep_in_strip :
    ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep, S_steep p ∈ horizStrip S.H
  S_steep_agrees :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ ≤ r_steep ∧
        ∀ p ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor r_steep,
          p.1.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ‖p.2 - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)‖ < r_μ →
          S_steep p = S.𝔰 p

      rw [hcast, Complex.ofReal_re]
    have h_rhs_M : (∫ _ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), M ^ (2 : ℕ)) = 2 * Real.pi * M ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]

    have h_sum_le : ‖a₀‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) + ‖a₂‖ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ M ^ (2 : ℕ) :=

  have h_s3 : (∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2), ‖g w‖ ≤ 2) →

    intro hg_le_2 hg0_le
    have hderiv_le : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4), ‖deriv g z‖ ≤ 8 := by

      have hcb_z : Metric.closedBall z (1 / 4) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 2) := by
        intro ζ hζ

        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4) hdcc hsp_le

    let ρ : ℝ := η / 16

        hZ_inf'.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) ρ) (fun _ hw => hw.1)

  by_contra h_not_le

      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * t)
      linarith
    have h4 : 1 ≤ (1 - t) * (1 + 2 * t) := by nlinarith
    have h5 : Real.exp t ≤ (1 - t) * (1 + 2 * t) * Real.exp t := by

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S)
    (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget)
    (L₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hC₂ : 0 < C₂) :
    ∃ K_cone C_cone : ℝ, A.K_amp ≤ K_cone ∧ 0 < C_cone ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, K_cone ≤ K →
        (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
          rowMomentFull S v ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) →
        ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K p.1 p.2)
          (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc ((6 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((9 / 5 : ℝ) * K)) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ Set.Icc ((6 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((9 / 5 : ℝ) * K),
          (∫ x₀ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x₀ k) ≤
            C_cone * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ x₀ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
          ∀ k ∈ Set.Icc ((6 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((9 / 5 : ℝ) * K),
          ∀ z₁ ∈ horizStrip S.H,
            |truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
              (1 / 4 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) →
            |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀) -
                truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
              K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) →
            coneCurvEnvelope S L₀ C₁ C₂ K x₀ k ≤ K ^ (2 / 50 : ℝ) →
            0 < z₁.im →
            |z₁.re - x₀| ≤ L₀ * wallDepth S z₁ →
            k - C₁ * Real.log k ≤ -Real.log (wallDepth S z₁) →
            -Real.log (wallDepth S z₁) ≤ k + C₂ →
            let x₁ : ℝ := z₁.re
            let δ₁ : ℝ := wallDepth S z₁
            let v₁ : ℝ := -Real.log δ₁
            let δ₂ : ℝ := Real.exp (-3) * δ₁
            let z₂ : ℂ := (x₁ : ℂ) + ((S.H - δ₂ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
            v₁ ∈ Set.Icc ((23 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ((37 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ∧
            0 < δ₁ ∧ δ₁ < S.H / 8 ∧
            0 < δ₂ ∧ δ₂ < S.H / 8 ∧
            tileCurvBound S x₁ δ₁ ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ∧
            tileCurvBound S x₁ δ₂ ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ∧
            (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₁ (3 * δ₁ / 8),
              |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) ∧
            (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₂ (3 * δ₂ / 8),
              |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) ∧
            (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₁ (δ₁ / 2),
              Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ) ∧
            (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₂ (δ₂ / 2),
              Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ))

        calc |x - x₀| ≤ |x₁ - x₀| := hx_dist
          _ ≤ L₀ * δ₁ := hz₁_re
          _ ≤ L₀ * Real.exp (-w_top) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le_dtop hL₀.le
          _ ≤ 21 * L₀ * Real.exp (-w_top) := by
              have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-w_top) := Real.exp_pos _
              nlinarith only [hexp_pos, hL₀]
      exact hOsc_tile x w_top hw_top_lo (by linarith only [hw_top_le_k, hC₂]) hx_cone z hz)
    have h_div_le : 4 * |x₁ - x₀| / Real.exp (-w_top) ≤ 4 * L₀ := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)]
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le_dtop hL₀.le
      linarith only [hz₁_re, hmul]
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [h_div_le]) hStep_nn)

  have hx₁_cone_on : ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc w_top (v₁ + 3),
      |x₁ - x₀| ≤ 21 * L₀ * Real.exp (-w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hd_le : δ₁ ≤ Real.exp 3 * Real.exp (-w) := by
      rw [← hexp_v₁, ← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hw.2])
    calc |x₁ - x₀| ≤ L₀ * δ₁ := hz₁_re
      _ ≤ L₀ * (Real.exp 3 * Real.exp (-w)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd_le hL₀.le
      _ = Real.exp 3 * (L₀ * Real.exp (-w)) := by ring
      _ ≤ 21 * (L₀ * Real.exp (-w)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hExp3_lt_21.le (by positivity)
      _ = 21 * L₀ * Real.exp (-w) := by ring

  have hLeg3a : |localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁) - localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₁)| ≤
      (4 * C₂ + 1) * stepBnd := by
    have h1 := hVertChain stepBnd hStep_nn x₁ w_top v₁ hw_top_le_v₁ (fun w hw z hz =>
      hOsc_tile x₁ w (le_trans hw_top_lo hw.1) (by linarith only [hw.2, hv₁_hi])
        (hx₁_cone_on w ⟨hw.1, by linarith only [hw.2]⟩) z hz)
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only [hv₁_sub_wtop]) hStep_nn)

  have hLeg3b : |localAmp S (upperRowPt S (v₁ + 3) x₁) - localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁)| ≤
      13 * stepBnd := by
    have h1 := hVertChain stepBnd hStep_nn x₁ v₁ (v₁ + 3) (by linarith only) (fun w hw z hz =>
      hOsc_tile x₁ w (by linarith only [hv₁_lo, hw.1]) (by linarith only [hw.2, hv₁_hi])
        (hx₁_cone_on w ⟨le_trans hw_top_le_v₁ hw.1, hw.2⟩) z hz)
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only) hStep_nn)

  have hChain_budget : (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd +
      |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    have hBase_amp : |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) + K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      have h_tri : |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
          |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀) - truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀)| +
            |truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀)| := by
        simpa using abs_add_le
          (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀) - truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀))
          (truncLogSpeed S (A.epsK K) (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have h_rpow : K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h1_le_K (by norm_num)
      linarith only [h_tri, hDiff, hTrunc, h_rpow]
    have hΔ_bound : 4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18 ≤
        (800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : 4 * Δ_lo ≤ 800 * C₁ * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [Δ_lo]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLog2K (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * C₁)
        linarith only [this]
      have h2 : 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18 ≤
          (4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) := by
        simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1_rpow100
          (by positivity : 0 ≤ 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18)
      linarith only [h1, h2]
    have h_rpow_merge : K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) = K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hK_pos]
      norm_num
    have h_osc_le : (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd ≤
        2 * A.C_amp * (800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      calc (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd
          ≤ ((800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) *
              (A.C_amp * (2 * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hΔ_bound hStep_nn
        _ = 2 * A.C_amp * (800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) *
              (K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)) := by ring
        _ = 2 * A.C_amp * (800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
            rw [h_rpow_merge]
    have h_sum_le : (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd +
        |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) + M_amp * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
      have hm : M_amp * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) = K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) +
          2 * A.C_amp * (800 * C₁ + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * K ^ (3 / 100 : ℝ) := by
        rw [hM_amp_def]
        ring
      linarith only [h_osc_le, hBase_amp, hm]
    linarith only [h_sum_le, hMamp_bound]

  have hAmp₁ : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₁ (3 * δ₁ / 8),
      |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [← hpt_z₁, ← hexp_v₁] at hζ
    have hDisk1 := hOsc_tile x₁ v₁ hv₁_lo (by linarith only [hv₁_hi])
      (hx₁_cone_on v₁ ⟨hw_top_le_v₁, by linarith only⟩) ζ hζ
    have h_tot : |localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
        (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 4) * stepBnd := by
      have ht1 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S ζ)
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have ht2 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₁)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have ht3 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₁))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₀)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      linarith only [ht1, ht2, ht3, hDisk1, hLeg3a, hLeg2, hLeg1]
    have h_tri : |localAmp S ζ| ≤
        |localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| +
          |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| := by
      simpa using abs_add_le
        (localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
    have h_le18 : (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 4) * stepBnd ≤
        (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only) hStep_nn
    linarith only [h_tri, h_tot, h_le18, hChain_budget]

  have hAmp₂ : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₂ (3 * δ₂ / 8),
      |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [← hpt_z₂, ← hexp_v₁_3] at hζ
    have hDisk2 := hOsc_tile x₁ (v₁ + 3) (by linarith only [hv₁_lo]) (by linarith only [hv₁_hi])
      (hx₁_cone_on (v₁ + 3) ⟨by linarith only [hw_top_le_v₁], le_rfl⟩) ζ hζ
    have h_tot : |localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
        (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd := by
      have ht0 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S ζ)
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S (v₁ + 3) x₁)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have ht1 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S (upperRowPt S (v₁ + 3) x₁))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have ht2 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₁)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have ht3 := abs_sub_le (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₁))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w_top x₀)) (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
      have h17 : |localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| ≤
          (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 17) * stepBnd := by
        linarith only [ht0, ht1, ht2, ht3, hDisk2, hLeg3b, hLeg3a, hLeg2, hLeg1]
      have h17_le : (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 17) * stepBnd ≤
          (4 * Δ_lo + 4 * L₀ + 4 * C₂ + 18) * stepBnd :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith only) hStep_nn
      exact le_trans h17 h17_le
    have h_tri : |localAmp S ζ| ≤
        |localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| +
          |localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀)| := by
      simpa using abs_add_le
        (localAmp S ζ - localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
        (localAmp S (upperRowPt S k x₀))
    linarith only [h_tri, h_tot, hChain_budget]

  have hGlobal_lower : ∀ w : ℝ, w ≤ v₁ + 3 → Real.exp (-w) < S.H / 8 →
      ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S w x₁) (Real.exp (-w) / 2),
        Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ := by
    intro w hw_le hd_lt8 ζ hζ
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hζ
    have hζ_im : |ζ.im - (S.H - Real.exp (-w))| ≤ Real.exp (-w) / 2 := by
      have h := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ - upperRowPt S w x₁)
      have him : (ζ - upperRowPt S w x₁).im = ζ.im - (S.H - Real.exp (-w)) := by
        simp only [upperRowPt, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      rw [him] at h
      exact le_trans h hζ
    have hζ_im_pos : 0 < ζ.im := by
      have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-w) := Real.exp_pos _
      linarith only [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp hζ_im).2, hd_lt8, hexp_pos]
    have hζ_im_hi : ζ.im ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-w) / 2 := by
      linarith only [(abs_sub_le_iff.mp hζ_im).1]
    have hexp_half : Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) ≤ Real.exp (-w) / 2 := by
      have hw1 : w + 1 ≤ (41 / 20 : ℝ) * K := by
        linarith only [hw_le, hv₁_band.2, h200_le_K]
      calc Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K)
          ≤ Real.exp (-(w + 1)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith only [hw1])
        _ = Real.exp (-w) * Real.exp (-1) := by
            rw [show -(w + 1) = -w + (-1) by ring, Real.exp_add]
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-w) * (1 / 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hExp_neg1_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-w) / 2 := by ring
    have h_abs_im : |ζ.im| ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) := by
      rw [abs_of_pos hζ_im_pos]
      linarith only [hζ_im_hi, hexp_half]
    have h_glob := (abs_le.mp (A.global_amp_poly_bound K hKamp_le_K ζ h_abs_im)).1
    have h_log_eps : Real.log (A.epsK K) = -A.C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K := by
      dsimp [AmplitudeDeficitData.epsK]
      exact Real.log_exp _
    linarith only [h_glob, h_log_eps, hK_pos]

  have hEps₁ : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₁ (δ₁ / 2),
      Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [← hpt_z₁, ← hexp_v₁] at hζ
    exact hGlobal_lower v₁ (by linarith only) (by rwa [hexp_v₁]) ζ hζ
  have hEps₂ : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall z₂ (δ₂ / 2),
      Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [← hpt_z₂, ← hexp_v₁_3] at hζ
    exact hGlobal_lower (v₁ + 3) le_rfl (by rwa [hexp_v₁_3]) ζ hζ

  exact ⟨hv₁_band, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁_lt, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂_lt,
    hCurv₁, hCurv₂, hAmp₁, hAmp₂, hEps₁, hEps₂⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S)
    (hKern : StripExitKernelData S)
    (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget)
    (c_star c₂ : ℝ) (hc_star : 0 < c_star) (hc₂ : 0 < c₂)
    (h_udisk : ∀ g : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) →
      (∃ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g w ≠ 0) →
      (c_star ^ (2 : ℕ) / 1024) * ‖g 0‖ ≤ ‖deriv (deriv g) 0‖ →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun w : ℂ => |Real.log ‖g w‖|)
        (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1) MeasureTheory.volume →
      c₂ ≤ (Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ w in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, |Real.log ‖g w‖|) :
    ∃ K_win C_win : ℝ, A.K_amp ≤ K_win ∧ 0 < C_win ∧
      ∀ K x₁ v₁ : ℝ,
        K_win ≤ K →
        Real.exp (-v₁) < S.H / 8 →
        c_star / 2 ≤ Real.exp (-v₁) * Real.sqrt ‖S.q (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁)‖ →
        tileCurvBound S x₁ (Real.exp (-v₁)) ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) →
        tileCurvBound S x₁ (Real.exp (-(v₁ + 3))) ≤ 2 * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁) (3 * Real.exp (-v₁) / 8),
          |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S (v₁ + 3) x₁) (3 * Real.exp (-(v₁ + 3)) / 8),
          |localAmp S ζ| ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S v₁ x₁) (Real.exp (-v₁) / 2),
          Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S (v₁ + 3) x₁) (Real.exp (-(v₁ + 3)) / 2),
          Real.log (A.epsK K) ≤ localAmp S ζ) →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2)
          (Set.Icc (x₁ - Real.exp (-v₁) / 16) (x₁ + Real.exp (-v₁) / 16) ×ˢ
            Set.Icc (v₁ - 1 / 10) (v₁ + 1 / 10))
          MeasureTheory.volume →
        1 ≤ C_win *
          ∫ p in Set.Icc (x₁ - Real.exp (-v₁) / 16) (x₁ + Real.exp (-v₁) / 16) ×ˢ
              Set.Icc (v₁ - 1 / 10) (v₁ + 1 / 10),
            rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2 * Real.exp p.2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have hOpen_strip : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have hf_cont : ContinuousOn S.f (horizStrip S.H) := S.f_holo.continuousOn
  have hq_cont : ContinuousOn S.q (horizStrip S.H) := S.q_holo.continuousOn
  have hderiv_f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (deriv S.f) (horizStrip S.H) :=
    (S.f_holo.analyticOnNhd hOpen_strip).deriv.differentiableOn
  have hC_amp_pos : 0 < A.C_amp := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one A.one_le_C_amp
  have hC_glob_pos : 0 < A.C_glob := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one A.one_le_C_glob
  have hVol_ball : ∀ (a : ℂ) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r →
      MeasureTheory.volume.real (Metric.ball a r) = Real.pi * r ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
    intro a r hr
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, Complex.volume_ball, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
      ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr]
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hClosedBall_strip : ∀ (x d : ℝ), 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
      Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 2) ⊆
        horizStrip S.H ∧
      0 ≤ tileCurvBound S x d := by
    intro x d hd_pos hd_lt
    set z₀ : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hSub : Metric.closedBall z₀ (d / 2) ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro ζ hζ
      have hnorm : ‖ζ - z₀‖ ≤ d / 2 := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hζ
      have him_diff : |(ζ - z₀).im| ≤ d / 2 := le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hnorm
      have hz₀_im : z₀.im = S.H - d := by
        simp only [z₀, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      have him_abs : |ζ.im - (S.H - d)| ≤ d / 2 := by simpa [Complex.sub_im, hz₀_im] using him_diff
      change |ζ.im| < S.H

      dsimp [c_wt, K_low, B₁, r₁, r₂, C_win]
      rw [hδ₂_eq, Real.exp_neg]
      have hpi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
      have hc₂_ne : c₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₂
      have hexp3_ne : Real.exp 3 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos 3)
      have hδ₁_ne : δ₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ₁_pos
      field_simp [hpi_ne, hc₂_ne, hexp3_ne, hδ₁_ne]
      ring
    rw [hId] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 hBox₁_int_low
  have hC_win_pos : 0 < C_win := by positivity
  calc (1 : ℝ) = C_win * C_win⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hC_win_pos)).symm
    _ ≤ C_win * ∫ p in Box₁, rowOccupDensity S ε_K h₀ p.1 p.2 * Real.exp p.2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTotal_low hC_win_pos.le
