proof.tactics:
by
  have _unused_hyps : 0 < ε_trunc ∧ 0 < h₀ ∧ 1 ≤ K := ⟨hε, hh₀, hK⟩
  let v_lo : ℝ := (11 / 10 : ℝ) * K
  let v_hi : ℝ := (19 / 10 : ℝ) * K
  let I_v : Set ℝ := Set.Icc v_lo v_hi
  let ρ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => rowOccupDensity S ε_trunc h₀ p.1 p.2
  have hv_lo_neg : -v_lo = -(11 / 10 : ℝ) * K := by dsimp [v_lo]; ring
  have hDepth' : Real.exp (-v_lo) < S.H := by rwa [hv_lo_neg]
  have hWidth' : L_w * Real.exp (-v_lo) ≤ Real.pi := by rwa [hv_lo_neg]
  have hTrunc_per : ∀ w y : ℝ, v_lo ≤ w →
      truncLogSpeed S ε_trunc (upperRowPt S w (y + 2 * Real.pi)) =
        truncLogSpeed S ε_trunc (upperRowPt S w y) := by
    intro w y hw
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-w) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hexp_lt : Real.exp (-w) < S.H :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hw)) hDepth'
    have hmem : upperRowPt S w y ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      have him : (upperRowPt S w y).im = S.H - Real.exp (-w) := by
        simp only [upperRowPt, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
      change |(upperRowPt S w y).im| < S.H
      rw [him, abs_lt]
      exact ⟨by linarith [hexp_pos, hexp_lt], by linarith [hexp_pos]⟩
    have hshift : upperRowPt S w (y + 2 * Real.pi) = upperRowPt S w y + 2 * Real.pi := by
      dsimp [upperRowPt]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hf_eq : S.f (upperRowPt S w (y + 2 * Real.pi)) = S.f (upperRowPt S w y) := by
      rw [hshift]
      exact S.f_periodic (upperRowPt S w y) hmem
    dsimp [truncLogSpeed]
    rw [hf_eq]
  have hNonneg : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, v_lo ≤ p.2 → 0 ≤ ρ p := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp only [ρ]
    unfold rowOccupDensity
    split_ifs
    · refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by norm_num) fun s hs => ?_
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg fun u => ?_
      have hd_lt : Real.exp (-p.2) < S.H :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hp)) hDepth'
      have hd'_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-(p.2 + s)) := Real.exp_pos _
      have hd'_lt_d : Real.exp (-(p.2 + s)) < Real.exp (-p.2) :=
        Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith [hs.1])
      have hk_pos : 0 < stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(p.2 + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-p.2)) u :=
        hKern.kernel_pos (Real.exp (-p.2)) (Real.exp (-(p.2 + s))) hd'_pos hd'_lt_d hd_lt u
      exact mul_nonneg (le_min (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)) (le_of_lt hk_pos)
    · exact le_rfl
  have hPer : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, v_lo ≤ p.2 → ρ (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = ρ p := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp only [ρ]
    unfold rowOccupDensity
    rw [hTrunc_per p.2 p.1 hp]
    split_ifs
    · refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun s hs => ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 4)] at hs
      have hvs : v_lo ≤ p.2 + s := by linarith [hp, hs.1]
      congr 1
      ext u
      have hu_eq : p.1 + 2 * Real.pi + u = p.1 + u + 2 * Real.pi := by ring
      rw [hu_eq, hTrunc_per (p.2 + s) (p.1 + u) hvs]
    · rfl
  let Q_m1 : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (-2 * Real.pi) 0 ×ˢ I_v
  let Q_0 : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ I_v
  let Q_p1 : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (2 * Real.pi) (4 * Real.pi) ×ˢ I_v
  let Q_ext : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (-2 * Real.pi) (4 * Real.pi) ×ˢ I_v
  have hMeas_m1 : MeasurableSet Q_m1 := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hMeas_0 : MeasurableSet Q_0 := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hMeas_p1 : MeasurableSet Q_p1 := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hMeas_ext : MeasurableSet Q_ext := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hInt0 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn ρ Q_0 MeasureTheory.volume := hInt
  have hInt0_ind : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Q_0.indicator ρ) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_0).mpr hInt0
  let c_pos : ℝ × ℝ := (2 * Real.pi, 0)
  have hShift_m1 : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Q_0.indicator ρ (p + c_pos)) = Q_m1.indicator ρ := by
    funext p
    have hp_eq : p + c_pos = (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) := by
      ext <;> simp [c_pos]
    have hmem_iff : p + c_pos ∈ Q_0 ↔ p ∈ Q_m1 := by
      rw [hp_eq]
      simp only [Q_0, Q_m1, I_v, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h.1.1], by linarith [h.1.2]⟩, h.2⟩
    by_cases hp : p ∈ Q_m1
    · have hp' : p + c_pos ∈ Q_0 := hmem_iff.mpr hp
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp', Set.indicator_of_mem hp, hp_eq]
      exact hPer p hp.2.1
    · have hp' : p + c_pos ∉ Q_0 := fun h => hp (hmem_iff.mp h)
      simp [hp, hp']
  have hInt_m1_ind : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Q_m1.indicator ρ) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [← hShift_m1]
    exact hInt0_ind.comp_add_right c_pos
  have hInt_m1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn ρ Q_m1 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_m1).mp hInt_m1_ind
  have hEq_m1 : (∫ q in Q_m1, ρ q) = ∫ q in Q_0, ρ q := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_m1, ← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_0,
      ← hShift_m1]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (Q_0.indicator ρ) c_pos
  let c_neg : ℝ × ℝ := (-2 * Real.pi, 0)
  have hShift_p1 : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Q_0.indicator ρ (p + c_neg)) = Q_p1.indicator ρ := by
    funext p
    have hp_eq : p + c_neg = (p.1 - 2 * Real.pi, p.2) := by
      ext
      · simp [c_neg]; ring
      · simp [c_neg]
    have hmem_iff : p + c_neg ∈ Q_0 ↔ p ∈ Q_p1 := by
      rw [hp_eq]
      simp only [Q_0, Q_p1, I_v, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h.1.1], by linarith [h.1.2]⟩, h.2⟩
    by_cases hp : p ∈ Q_p1
    · have hp' : p + c_neg ∈ Q_0 := hmem_iff.mpr hp
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp', Set.indicator_of_mem hp, hp_eq]
      have hper_sub := hPer (p.1 - 2 * Real.pi, p.2) hp.2.1
      dsimp only at hper_sub
      have h_add : p.1 - 2 * Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = p.1 := sub_add_cancel p.1 (2 * Real.pi)
      have h_pair : (p.1 - 2 * Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = p := by
        ext <;> simp [h_add]
      rw [h_pair] at hper_sub
      exact hper_sub.symm
    · have hp' : p + c_neg ∉ Q_0 := fun h => hp (hmem_iff.mp h)
      simp [hp, hp']
  have hInt_p1_ind : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Q_p1.indicator ρ) MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [← hShift_p1]
    exact hInt0_ind.comp_add_right c_neg
  have hInt_p1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn ρ Q_p1 MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_p1).mp hInt_p1_ind
  have hEq_p1 : (∫ q in Q_p1, ρ q) = ∫ q in Q_0, ρ q := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_p1, ← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_0,
      ← hShift_p1]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (Q_0.indicator ρ) c_neg
  have hQext_eq : Q_ext = (Q_m1 ∪ Q_0) ∪ Q_p1 := by
    ext q
    simp only [Q_ext, Q_m1, Q_0, Q_p1, I_v, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · intro hq
      rcases le_total q.1 0 with h0 | h0
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨⟨hq.1.1, h0⟩, hq.2⟩)
      · rcases le_total q.1 (2 * Real.pi) with h2 | h2
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨⟨h0, h2⟩, hq.2⟩)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h2, hq.1.2⟩, hq.2⟩
    · intro hq
      have hpi := Real.pi_pos
      rcases hq with (h_m1 | h_0) | h_p1
      · exact ⟨⟨h_m1.1.1, by linarith [h_m1.1.2]⟩, h_m1.2⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h_0.1.1], by linarith [h_0.1.2]⟩, h_0.2⟩
      · exact ⟨⟨by linarith [h_p1.1.1], h_p1.1.2⟩, h_p1.2⟩
  have hInt_ext : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn ρ Q_ext MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [hQext_eq]
    exact (hInt_m1.union hInt0).union hInt_p1
  refine ⟨hInt_ext, ?_⟩
  have hInt_ext_ind : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Q_ext.indicator ρ) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_ext).mpr hInt_ext
  have hTriple : (∫ q in Q_ext, ρ q) ≤ 3 * ∫ q in Q_0, ρ q := by
    have hInd_le : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ,
        Q_ext.indicator ρ q ≤ (Q_m1.indicator ρ + Q_0.indicator ρ + Q_p1.indicator ρ) q := by
      intro q
      dsimp only [Pi.add_apply]
      have hm1_nn : 0 ≤ Q_m1.indicator ρ q := Set.indicator_nonneg (fun p hp => hNonneg p hp.2.1) q
      have h0_nn : 0 ≤ Q_0.indicator ρ q := Set.indicator_nonneg (fun p hp => hNonneg p hp.2.1) q
      have hp1_nn : 0 ≤ Q_p1.indicator ρ q := Set.indicator_nonneg (fun p hp => hNonneg p hp.2.1) q
      by_cases hq : q ∈ Q_ext
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
        have hq_u : q ∈ (Q_m1 ∪ Q_0) ∪ Q_p1 := hQext_eq ▸ hq
        rcases hq_u with (hq_m1 | hq_0) | hq_p1
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq_m1]; linarith
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq_0]; linarith
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq_p1]; linarith
      · have h0 : Q_ext.indicator ρ q = 0 := by simp [hq]
        linarith
    have hInt_m1_0 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => Q_m1.indicator ρ x + Q_0.indicator ρ x) MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hInt_m1_ind.add hInt0_ind
    have hInt_sum3 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun x : ℝ × ℝ => (Q_m1.indicator ρ x + Q_0.indicator ρ x) + Q_p1.indicator ρ x)
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      hInt_m1_0.add hInt_p1_ind
    have hMono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hInt_ext_ind hInt_sum3 hInd_le
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hInt_m1_0 hInt_p1_ind,
      MeasureTheory.integral_add hInt_m1_ind hInt0_ind,
      MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_ext,
      MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_m1,
      MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_0,
      MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_p1,
      hEq_m1, hEq_p1] at hMono
    linarith
  intro hWin
  let μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ) := MeasureTheory.volume
  let R_K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc ((6 / 5 : ℝ) * K) ((9 / 5 : ℝ) * K)
  have hMeas_RK : MeasurableSet R_K := measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
  have hCompact_RK : IsCompact R_K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  let W : ℝ × ℝ → Set (ℝ × ℝ) := fun p =>
    {q : ℝ × ℝ |
      q.2 ∈ I_v ∧ |q.1 - p.1| ≤ L_w * Real.exp (-q.2) ∧
      p.2 - Δ_lo ≤ q.2 ∧ q.2 ≤ p.2 + Δ_hi}
  have hMeas_W : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, MeasurableSet (W p) := by
    intro p
    have h1 : IsClosed {q : ℝ × ℝ | q.2 ∈ I_v} := isClosed_Icc.preimage continuous_snd
    have h2 : IsClosed {q : ℝ × ℝ | |q.1 - p.1| ≤ L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)} :=
      isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_const))
        (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_snd.neg))
    have h3 : IsClosed {q : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 - Δ_lo ≤ q.2} :=
      isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_snd
    have h4 : IsClosed {q : ℝ × ℝ | q.2 ≤ p.2 + Δ_hi} :=
      isClosed_le continuous_snd continuous_const
    exact (h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))).measurableSet
  let Ω_W : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ)) := {r | r.1 ∈ E_typ ∧ r.2 ∈ W r.1}
  have hMeas_ΩW : MeasurableSet Ω_W := by
    have hClosed_rel : IsClosed {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | r.2 ∈ W r.1} := by
      have h1 : IsClosed {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | r.2.2 ∈ I_v} :=
        isClosed_Icc.preimage (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
      have h2 : IsClosed {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | |r.2.1 - r.1.1| ≤ L_w * Real.exp (-r.2.2)} :=
        isClosed_le
          (continuous_abs.comp
            ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).sub (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)))
          (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).neg))
      have h3 : IsClosed {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | r.1.2 - Δ_lo ≤ r.2.2} :=
        isClosed_le ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)
          (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
      have h4 : IsClosed {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | r.2.2 ≤ r.1.2 + Δ_hi} :=
        isClosed_le (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
          ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst).add continuous_const)
      exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))
    have hEq : Ω_W = (E_typ ×ˢ Set.univ) ∩ {r : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) | r.2 ∈ W r.1} := by
      ext r
      simp [Ω_W]
    rw [hEq]
    exact (hMeas.prod MeasurableSet.univ).inter hClosed_rel.measurableSet
  have hW_sub_Qext : ∀ p ∈ E_typ, W p ⊆ Q_ext := by
    intro p hp q hq
    have hp_RK : p ∈ R_K := hSub hp
    have hw : L_w * Real.exp (-q.2) ≤ Real.pi := by
      have hexp_le : Real.exp (-q.2) ≤ Real.exp (-v_lo) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg hq.1.1)
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp_le (le_of_lt hLw)) hWidth'
    have habs := abs_sub_le_iff.mp hq.2.1
    have hpi := Real.pi_pos
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith [hp_RK.1.1, habs.2, hw], by linarith [hp_RK.1.2, habs.1, hw]⟩, hq.1⟩
  let f₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := R_K.indicator 1
  have hRK_ne_top : μ R_K ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt hCompact_RK.measure_lt_top
  have hf₁_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable f₁ μ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_RK]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hRK_ne_top
  have hE_ne_top : μ E_typ ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hSub) hCompact_RK.measure_lt_top)
  have hE_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (E_typ.indicator (1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)) μ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hE_ne_top
  let g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := Q_ext.indicator (fun q => ρ q * Real.exp q.2)
  have hg_int_on : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ρ q * Real.exp q.2) Q_ext μ := by
    have h_bdd_exp : ∀ᵐ q : ℝ × ℝ ∂(μ.restrict Q_ext),
        ‖Real.exp q.2‖ ≤ Real.exp v_hi := by
      refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' hMeas_ext).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
      intro q hq
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hq.2.2
    have h1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp q.2 * ρ q) (μ.restrict Q_ext) :=
      hInt_ext.bdd_mul ((Real.continuous_exp.comp continuous_snd).aestronglyMeasurable) h_bdd_exp
    simpa [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn, mul_comm] using h1
  have hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hMeas_ext).mpr hg_int_on
  let M : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := Function.uncurry fun p q => f₁ p * g q
  have hM_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable M (μ.prod μ) := hf₁_int.mul_prod hg_int
  let H : (ℝ × ℝ) × (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ := Ω_W.indicator M
  have hH_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable H (μ.prod μ) := hM_int.indicator hMeas_ΩW
  have hLower_p : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
      E_typ.indicator (1 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) p ≤ C_win * ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ E_typ
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp]
      dsimp only [Pi.one_apply]
      have hp_RK : p ∈ R_K := hSub hp
      have hf₁_p : f₁ p = 1 := by simp [f₁, hp_RK]
      have hSlice_p : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (p, q)) =
          (W p).indicator (fun q => ρ q * Real.exp q.2) := by
        funext q
        by_cases hq : q ∈ W p
        · have hpq : (p, q) ∈ Ω_W := ⟨hp, hq⟩
          have hq_ext : q ∈ Q_ext := hW_sub_Qext p hp hq
          simp [H, M, g, hpq, hq, hq_ext, hf₁_p]
        · have hpq : (p, q) ∉ Ω_W := fun h => hq h.2
          simp [H, hpq, hq]
      rw [hSlice_p, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator (hMeas_W p)]
      exact hWin p hp
    · have hSlice_zero : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => H (p, q)) = 0 := by
        funext q
        have hpq : (p, q) ∉ Ω_W := fun h => hp h.1
        simp [H, hpq]
      simp [hp, hSlice_zero]
  have hInt_p_H : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ) μ :=
    hH_int.integral_prod_left
  have hStep_pq : μ.real E_typ ≤ C_win * ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ) ∂μ := by
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hE_ind_int (hInt_p_H.const_mul C_win) hLower_p
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_one hMeas, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      ← MeasureTheory.integral_prod H hH_int, MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm H hH_int] at h1
    exact h1
  have hUpper_q : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ,
      (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ) ≤ 2 * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * Q_ext.indicator ρ q := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq : q ∈ Q_ext
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
      have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ q := hNonneg q hq.2.1
      have hg_eq : g q = ρ q * Real.exp q.2 := Set.indicator_of_mem hq _
      have hg_nn : 0 ≤ g q := by
        rw [hg_eq]
        exact mul_nonneg hρ_nn (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
      let S_q : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p, q)) ⁻¹' Ω_W
      have hMeas_Sq : MeasurableSet S_q :=
        hMeas_ΩW.preimage (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).measurable
      have hSlice_q : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H (p, q)) = S_q.indicator (fun _ => g q) := by
        funext p
        by_cases hp : p ∈ S_q
        · have hpq : (p, q) ∈ Ω_W := hp
          have hp_RK : p ∈ R_K := hSub hpq.1
          have hf₁_p : f₁ p = 1 := by simp [f₁, hp_RK]
          simp [H, M, S_q, hp, hpq, hf₁_p]
        · have hpq : (p, q) ∉ Ω_W := hp
          simp [H, S_q, hp, hpq]
      rw [hSlice_q, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_const (g q) hMeas_Sq, smul_eq_mul]
      set B_q : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
        Set.Icc (q.1 - L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) (q.1 + L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc (q.2 - Δ_hi) (q.2 + Δ_lo)
      have hSq_sub_Bq : S_q ⊆ B_q := by
        intro p hp
        have hq_Wp : q ∈ W p := hp.2
        have habs := abs_sub_le_iff.mp hq_Wp.2.1
        exact ⟨⟨by linarith [habs.1], by linarith [habs.2]⟩,
          ⟨by linarith [hq_Wp.2.2.2], by linarith [hq_Wp.2.2.1]⟩⟩
      have hBq_ne_top : μ B_q ≠ ⊤ :=
        ne_of_lt (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).measure_lt_top
      have hVol_Sq : μ.real S_q ≤ (2 * L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) := by
        have hmono : μ.real S_q ≤ μ.real B_q :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hSq_sub_Bq hBq_ne_top
        have hBq_eq : μ.real B_q = (2 * L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) := by
          dsimp [μ, B_q]
          rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, MeasureTheory.measureReal_prod_prod,
            Real.volume_real_Icc, Real.volume_real_Icc]
          have hlen1 : (q.1 + L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) - (q.1 - L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) =
              2 * L_w * Real.exp (-q.2) := by ring
          have hlen2 : (q.2 + Δ_lo) - (q.2 - Δ_hi) = Δ_lo + Δ_hi := by ring
          rw [hlen1, hlen2, max_eq_left (by positivity), max_eq_left (by positivity)]
        exact hBq_eq ▸ hmono
      calc μ.real S_q * g q
          ≤ ((2 * L_w * Real.exp (-q.2)) * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi)) * g q :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hVol_Sq hg_nn
        _ = 2 * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ρ q * (Real.exp (-q.2) * Real.exp q.2) := by
            rw [hg_eq]; ring
        _ = 2 * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ρ q := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    · have hg_zero : g q = 0 := by simp [g, hq]
      have hSlice_zero : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H (p, q)) = 0 := by
        funext p
        by_cases hpq : (p, q) ∈ Ω_W <;> simp [H, M, hpq, hg_zero]
      simp [hq, hSlice_zero]
  have hInt_q_H : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ) μ :=
    hH_int.integral_prod_right
  have hMono_q := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hInt_q_H
    (hInt_ext_ind.const_mul (2 * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi))) hUpper_q
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hMeas_ext] at hMono_q
  have hMul_C := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMono_q (le_of_lt hC_win)
  have hBound_ext : MeasureTheory.volume.real E_typ ≤
      2 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ∫ q in Q_ext, ρ q := by
    calc MeasureTheory.volume.real E_typ
        ≤ C_win * ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (p, q) ∂μ) ∂μ := hStep_pq
      _ ≤ C_win * (2 * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ∫ q in Q_ext, ρ q) := hMul_C
      _ = 2 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ∫ q in Q_ext, ρ q := by ring
  have hCoeff_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) := by positivity
  calc MeasureTheory.volume.real E_typ
      ≤ (2 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi)) * ∫ q in Q_ext, ρ q := hBound_ext
    _ ≤ (2 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi)) * (3 * ∫ q in Q_0, ρ q) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hTriple hCoeff_nn
    _ = 6 * C_win * L_w * (Δ_lo + Δ_hi) * ∫ q in Q_0, ρ q := by ring

signature.name: strip_angle_majorant_and_amplitude_cap
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    StripAngleAndAmplitudeData S hBudget P

proof.tactics:
by
 have h_part1 :
     ∃ C_f : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
       ‖S.f s‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0)) := by
  let k₀ : ℝ := hBudget.k₀
  have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
  have hexp_k₀_lt : Real.exp (-k₀) < S.H / 10 := hBudget.exp_neg_k₀_lt
  have hH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  let H₀ : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-k₀)
  have hH₀_pos : 0 < H₀ := by dsimp [H₀]; linarith
  have hH₀_lt_H : H₀ < S.H := by dsimp [H₀]; linarith [Real.exp_pos (-k₀)]
  have hf_per_nat : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, ∀ n : ℕ,
      S.f (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = S.f z := by
    intro z hz n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
        have hz_n : z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
          simpa [horizStrip] using hz
        have h_eq : z + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
            (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_eq, S.f_periodic _ hz_n, ih]
  have hf_per_int : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, ∀ m : ℤ,
      S.f (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = S.f z := by
    intro z hz m
    rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg m with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
    · exact_mod_cast hf_per_nat z hz n
    · have hz' : z - (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
        simpa [horizStrip] using hz
      have h1 := hf_per_nat (z - (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) hz' n
      have h_eq1 : z + ((- (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
          z - (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by push_cast; ring
      have h_eq2 : z - (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) = z := by
        ring
      rw [h_eq2] at h1
      rw [h_eq1, h1.symm]
  let φ_rect : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let R_int : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H₀) H₀
  have hR_compact : IsCompact R_int := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hR_nonempty : R_int.Nonempty :=
    ⟨(0, 0), ⟨le_rfl, Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have hφ_cont : Continuous φ_rect := by
    dsimp [φ_rect]
    fun_prop
  have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ_rect R_int (horizStrip S.H) := by
    intro p hp
    simpa [horizStrip, φ_rect] using lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_le.mpr hp.2) hH₀_lt_H
  have h_norm_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖S.f (φ_rect p)‖) R_int :=
    (S.f_holo.continuousOn.comp hφ_cont.continuousOn hφ_maps).norm
  obtain ⟨p_max, _, hp_max⟩ := hR_compact.exists_isMaxOn hR_nonempty h_norm_cont
  let M_int : ℝ := max ‖S.f (φ_rect p_max)‖ 1
  have hM_int_ge_one : 1 ≤ M_int := le_max_right _ _
  have hM_int_pos : 0 < M_int := by linarith
  let C_f : ℝ := max (Real.log M_int) hBudget.C_env + 3
  have hlog_M_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log M_int := Real.log_nonneg hM_int_ge_one
  have hC_f_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_f := by
    have : 0 ≤ max (Real.log M_int) hBudget.C_env := le_trans hlog_M_nonneg (le_max_left _ _)
    dsimp [C_f]; linarith
  refine ⟨C_f, hC_f_ge_one, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hs_lt : |s.im| < S.H := hs
  let δ : ℝ := S.H - |s.im|
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  let k : ℝ := -Real.log δ
  have hexp_neg_k : Real.exp (-k) = δ := by
    dsimp [k]; rw [neg_neg, Real.exp_log hδ_pos]
  rcases le_total k k₀ with hk_le | hk₀_le
  · have hδ_ge : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ δ := by
      rw [← hexp_neg_k]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have him_abs : |s.im| ≤ H₀ := by dsimp [δ, H₀] at hδ_ge ⊢; linarith
    let m : ℤ := ⌊s.re / (2 * Real.pi)⌋
    let x_red : ℝ := s.re - (m : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
    have h2pi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
    have hx_nonneg : 0 ≤ x_red := by
      have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ s.re / (2 * Real.pi) := Int.floor_le _
      have h2 := (le_div_iff₀ h2pi).mp h1
      dsimp [x_red]; linarith
    have hx_le : x_red ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
      have h1 : s.re / (2 * Real.pi) < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have h2 := (div_lt_iff₀ h2pi).mp h1
      dsimp [x_red]; linarith
    have hp_mem : (x_red, s.im) ∈ R_int := ⟨⟨hx_nonneg, hx_le⟩, abs_le.mp him_abs⟩
    have hφ_eq : φ_rect (x_red, s.im) = s + ((-m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) := by
      dsimp [φ_rect, x_red]
      have h_re_im : (s.re : ℂ) + (s.im : ℂ) * Complex.I = s := Complex.re_add_im s
      push_cast
      linear_combination h_re_im
    have hf_eq : S.f s = S.f (φ_rect (x_red, s.im)) := by
      rw [hφ_eq, hf_per_int s hs (-m)]
    have h_le_M : ‖S.f s‖ ≤ M_int := by
      rw [hf_eq]
      exact le_trans (hp_max hp_mem) (le_max_left _ _)
    have h_log_le : Real.log M_int ≤ C_f * (1 + max k 0) := by
      have h1 : Real.log M_int ≤ C_f := by
        have := le_max_left (Real.log M_int) hBudget.C_env
        dsimp [C_f]; linarith
      have h2 : 0 ≤ max k 0 := le_max_right k 0
      nlinarith
    calc
      ‖S.f s‖ ≤ M_int := h_le_M
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log M_int) := (Real.exp_log hM_int_pos).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max k 0)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_le
  · have hk_pos : 0 < k := by linarith
    have hmax_k : max k 0 = k := max_eq_left hk_pos.le
    let y_pt : ℂ := (s.re : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have h_row := hBudget.row_sup_poly_bound k hk₀_le s.re
    have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ‖S.q y_pt‖ := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k) := Real.exp_pos (-k)
    have h_prod : Real.exp (-k) * ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤ hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2 := by
      have : Real.exp (-k) * ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤
          Real.exp (-k) * (‖S.f y_pt‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q y_pt‖) := by nlinarith
      exact le_trans this h_row
    have h_fy_le1 : ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤ hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2 * Real.exp k := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod (Real.exp_pos k).le
      have hcancel : Real.exp (-k) * ‖S.f y_pt‖ * Real.exp k = ‖S.f y_pt‖ := by
        calc
          Real.exp (-k) * ‖S.f y_pt‖ * Real.exp k =
              (Real.exp (-k) * Real.exp k) * ‖S.f y_pt‖ := by ring
          _ = 1 * ‖S.f y_pt‖ := by rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
          _ = ‖S.f y_pt‖ := one_mul _
      linarith
    have hC_le_exp : hBudget.C_env ≤ Real.exp hBudget.C_env :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp hBudget.C_env)
    have h1k_le_exp : 1 + k ≤ Real.exp k := by
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp k]
    have h1k_sq : (1 + k) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * k) := by
      calc
        (1 + k) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp k) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) h1k_le_exp 2
        _ = Real.exp (2 * k) := by rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h_fy_le2 : ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤ Real.exp (hBudget.C_env + 3 * k) := by
      calc
        ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤ hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2 * Real.exp k := h_fy_le1
        _ ≤ Real.exp hBudget.C_env * Real.exp (2 * k) * Real.exp k := by
            have hA : hBudget.C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp hBudget.C_env * Real.exp (2 * k) :=
              mul_le_mul hC_le_exp h1k_sq (by positivity) (Real.exp_pos _).le
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (hBudget.C_env + 3 * k) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h_exp_le : hBudget.C_env + 3 * k ≤ C_f * (1 + max k 0) := by
      rw [hmax_k]
      have hC_env_le : hBudget.C_env + 3 ≤ C_f := by
        have := le_max_right (Real.log M_int) hBudget.C_env
        dsimp [C_f]; linarith
      calc
        hBudget.C_env + 3 * k ≤ (hBudget.C_env + 3) * (1 + k) := by
          have := hBudget.C_env_pos; nlinarith
        _ ≤ C_f * (1 + k) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC_env_le (by linarith)
    have h_fy_bound : ‖S.f y_pt‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max k 0)) :=
      le_trans h_fy_le2 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_exp_le)
    have hy_im : S.H - Real.exp (-k) = |s.im| := by
      rw [hexp_neg_k]; dsimp [δ]; ring
    rcases le_or_gt 0 s.im with him_nonneg | him_neg
    · have hy_eq : y_pt = s := by
        dsimp [y_pt]
        rw [hy_im, abs_of_nonneg him_nonneg]
        exact Complex.re_add_im s
      have h_norm_eq : ‖S.f y_pt‖ = ‖S.f s‖ := by rw [hy_eq]
      rwa [← h_norm_eq]
    · have hy_eq : y_pt = starRingEnd ℂ s := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [y_pt, hy_im, abs_of_neg him_neg]
      have h_norm_eq : ‖S.f y_pt‖ = ‖S.f s‖ := by
        rw [hy_eq, S.f_conj s hs, Complex.norm_conj]
      rwa [← h_norm_eq]

 have h_part2 :
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
       ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
         (P.N : ℝ) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
           (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖)) ∧
     (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
       ‖P.d0 j y‖ ≤ (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi +
         ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty

         (1 + Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty

    have hH_comp_diff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ |R| \ (∅ : Set ℂ), DifferentiableAt ℂ H_comp z := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_cb : z ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ |R| := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz.1
      have hd_sj : DifferentiableAt ℂ s_j z :=
        hs_j_holo.differentiableAt (h_open_sl.mem_nhds (h_sub_sl hz_cb))
      have hd_F : DifferentiableAt ℂ F_ext (s_j z) :=
        hF_ext_holo.differentiableAt (h_open_HK.mem_nhds (h_maps_HK hz_cb))
      exact hd_F.comp z hd_sj
    have h_ca_holo := circleAverage_of_differentiable_on_off_countable
      Set.countable_empty hH_comp_cont hH_comp_diff
    have h_ci : CircleIntegrable H_comp y₀ R := by
      refine (hH_comp_cont.mono ?_).circleIntegrable hR.le
      rw [hR_abs]; exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall
    have h_comm := Complex.reCLM.circleAverage_comp_comm h_ci
    simp only [Function.comp_def, Complex.reCLM_apply] at h_comm
    have h_eq_sp : Set.EqOn (fun y => U_K (s_j y)) (fun y => (H_comp y).re)
        (Metric.sphere y₀ |R|) := by
      intro y hy
      exact hU_re (s_j y) (h_maps_HK (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hy))
    have hy₀_cb : y₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ |R| := by
      rw [hR_abs]; exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR.le
    rw [Real.circleAverage_congr_sphere h_eq_sp, h_comm, h_ca_holo,
      ← hU_re (s_j y₀) (h_maps_HK hy₀_cb)]

 exact h_part5

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (C_clk ρ₁ ρ₂ δ : ℝ)
    (hStrip : StripAngleAndAmplitudeData S hBudget P)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (hLogDef : StoppedLogDeficitProp S P)
    (hρ₁ : hBudget.ρ < ρ₁) (hρ₂ : ρ₁ < ρ₂) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ M₁ : ℝ, 2 ≤ M₁ ∧
      ∀ M : ℝ, M₁ ≤ M →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
              M ^ ρ₂ < ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ∨
              M ^ ρ₂ < |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om m))‖|} ≤ δ

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  let E_0 : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | om 0 ∉ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)}
  have hE_0_zero : walkMeasure.real E_0 = 0 := by
    have h_pre : E_0 = (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ := rfl
    have h_meas : walkMeasure E_0 = 0 := by
      rw [h_pre, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0) measurableSet_Ico.compl]
      have h_eval : walkMeasure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) = unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
      rw [h_eval]
      simp [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ico.compl]
    simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, h_meas]
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < P.N := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have hN_ge_three_real : (3 : ℝ) ≤ P.N := by
    exact_mod_cast P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_ball : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  let h_sl : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  have hh_sl_pos : 0 < h_sl :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_ball).1
  have h_horiz_open : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip r) := fun r =>
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h_sl \ P.Z_all
  have h_real_in_reg : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω_reg := fun x =>
    ⟨by simp [horizStrip, hh_sl_pos], P.real_not_mem_Z_all x⟩
  have h_pair_maps : ∀ k : ℤ,
      Set.MapsTo
        (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
        (horizStrip h_sl) (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) := by
    intro k z hz
    have hz_lt : -h_sl < z.im ∧ z.im < h_sl := abs_lt.mp hz
    have ht₀_norm : ‖(sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht₀_ball
    refine ⟨ht₀_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.1
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.2
  have h_impact_holo : ∀ k : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k) (horizStrip h_sl) := by
    intro k
    have h_pair_diff :
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
          (horizStrip h_sl) :=
      (differentiableOn_id.add (differentiableOn_const _)).prodMk (differentiableOn_const _)
    exact S.𝔰_holo.comp h_pair_diff (h_pair_maps k)
  have h_impact_maps : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h_sl,
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N k z ∈ horizStrip S.H := fun k z hz =>
    S.𝔰_maps_to _ (h_pair_maps k hz)
  have h_impact_real_im : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : ℝ), (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k (x : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
    intro k x
    let p : ℂ × ℂ := ((x : ℂ) + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ))
    have hp : p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := h_pair_maps k (h_real_in_reg x).1
    have h_conj := S.𝔰_conj p hp
    have hp1 : starRingEnd ℂ p.1 = p.1 := by dsimp only [p]; simp
    have hp2 : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 = p.2 := by dsimp only [p]; simp
    rw [hp1, hp2] at h_conj
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h_conj
    rw [Complex.conj_im] at him
    change (S.𝔰 p).im = 0
    linarith
  have hIcc_nonempty : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨0, Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩
  have h_imp_bound_each : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∃ C_j : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_j ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_j := by
    intro j
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖) :=
      ((h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal
        (fun x => (h_real_in_reg x).1)).norm
    obtain ⟨x_max, _, hx_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_nonempty h_cont.continuousOn
    exact ⟨‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x_max : ℂ)‖, norm_nonneg _, fun x hx => hx_max hx⟩
  choose C_s0_fn hC_s0_nonneg hC_s0_le using h_imp_bound_each
  let C_s0 : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty C_s0_fn
  have hC_s0_ge : 0 ≤ C_s0 := by
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).Nonempty)
    exact le_trans (hC_s0_nonneg j₀) (Finset.le_sup' C_s0_fn hj₀)
  have hC_s0_bound : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_s0 := fun x hx j =>
    le_trans (hC_s0_le j x hx) (Finset.le_sup' C_s0_fn (Finset.mem_univ j))
  have h_ind_meas : ∀ {β : Type} [TopologicalSpace β] [MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β] [Zero β]
      {V : Set ℂ} {f : ℂ → β}, IsOpen V → ContinuousOn f V → Measurable (V.indicator f) := by
    intro β _ _ _ _ V f hV hf
    rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := β)]
    refine measurable_generateFrom fun U hU => ?_
    have h_open : IsOpen (V ∩ f ⁻¹' U) := hf.isOpen_inter_preimage hV hU
    by_cases h0 : (0 : β) ∈ U
    · have h_eq : V.indicator f ⁻¹' U = (V ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ∪ Vᶜ := by
        ext z; by_cases hz : z ∈ V <;> simp [Set.indicator, hz, h0]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_open.measurableSet.union hV.measurableSet.compl
    · have h_eq : V.indicator f ⁻¹' U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' U := by
        ext z; by_cases hz : z ∈ V <;> simp [Set.indicator, hz, h0]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_open.measurableSet
  have h_unif_eq_circleAvg : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℝ) (y : ℂ) (R : ℝ),
      (∫ θ, f (circleMap y R θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = Real.circleAverage f y R := by
    intro f y R
    rw [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
      MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
    have h_toR : ((ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹).toReal = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le]
    rw [h_toR, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, Real.circleAverage_def]

  
  
  
  have h_euler_sin : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.sin]
    have h1 : ‖Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (-w * Complex.I).re = w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self w.im) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (w * Complex.I).re = -w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (neg_le_abs w.im) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    calc
      ‖(Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)) * Complex.I / 2‖
          = ‖Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I) - Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)‖ * ‖Complex.I‖ /
              ‖(2 : ℂ)‖ := by rw [norm_div, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ (Real.exp ‖w‖ + Real.exp ‖w‖) * 1 / 2 := by
            rw [Complex.norm_I, Complex.norm_ofNat]
            gcongr
            exact le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add h1 h2)
      _ = Real.exp ‖w‖ := by ring
  have h_sin_log_def : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∃ C_g : ℝ, 0 < C_g ∧
      ∀ M B₀ B₁ : ℝ, 1 ≤ B₀ → 1 ≤ B₁ →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
              (∀ l < m, Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om l))‖ ≤ B₀) ∧
              Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om m))‖ < -B₁} ≤
            C_g * (1 + B₀) / (1 + B₁) := by
    intro j
    have h_ang_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip h_sl) :=
      S.ϕ_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)
    have h_d0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.d0 j) (horizStrip h_sl) :=
      (P.θ_holo j.val).sub h_ang_holo
    have h_sin_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)) Ω_reg :=
      (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn h_d0_holo).mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_sin_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Complex.sin (P.d0 j y) ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy j
    have h_sin_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.sin (P.d0 j (x : ℂ))) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      exact (h_sin_holo.differentiableAt (P.reg_open.mem_nhds (h_real_in_reg x))).continuousAt.comp
        Complex.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt
    have h_log_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (x : ℂ))‖|) :=
      (h_sin_cont.norm.log fun x => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (h_sin_ne _ (h_real_in_reg x))).abs
    obtain ⟨x_max, _, hx_max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_nonempty h_log_cont.continuousOn
    have h_compact_bound : ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (x : ℂ))‖ ∧
          Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (x : ℂ))‖ ≤ C₀ :=
      ⟨|Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (x_max : ℂ))‖|, abs_nonneg _, fun x hx => abs_le.mp (hx_max hx)⟩
    obtain ⟨C_g, hC_g_pos, hC_g⟩ :=
      hLogDef (fun y => Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)) h_sin_holo h_sin_ne h_compact_bound
    exact ⟨C_g, hC_g_pos, fun M B₀ B₁ hB₀ hB₁ ρ hAdm =>
      hC_g M B₀ B₁ hB₀ hB₁ ρ hAdm (fun y hy z hz => hAdm.jump_log_sin_d0 y hy z hz j)⟩
  choose C_sin_fn hC_sin_pos hC_sin_bound using h_sin_log_def
  let C_sin : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty C_sin_fn
  have hC_sin_gt : 0 < C_sin := by
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).Nonempty)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hC_sin_pos j₀) (Finset.le_sup' C_sin_fn hj₀)

  
  
  
  obtain ⟨C_har, hC_har_pos, h_maj⟩ := hStrip.angle_strip_majorant
  let ρ₀ : ℝ := hBudget.ρ
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := hBudget.ρ_pos
  have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ := lt_trans hρ₀_pos hρ₁
  have hρ₂_pos : 0 < ρ₂ := lt_trans hρ₁_pos hρ₂
  let C_d0 : ℝ := 1 + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi + ((P.N : ℝ) + 1)
  have hC_d0_pos : 0 < C_d0 := by positivity
  let ε_a : ℝ := 1 / (3 * (C_s0 + 1))
  let ε_b : ℝ := δ / (4 * (P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_har * (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * ρ₀)))
  let ε_c : ℝ := δ / (4 * (P.N : ℝ) * (18 * S.H ^ 2))
  let ε_d : ℝ := min (C_d0⁻¹) (δ / (2 * (P.N : ℝ) * C_sin * C_d0))
  have h2_pow_pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * ρ₀) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) (2 * ρ₀)
  have hS_H_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have hε_a_pos : 0 < ε_a := by positivity
  have hε_b_pos : 0 < ε_b := by positivity
  have hε_c_pos : 0 < ε_c := by positivity
  have hε_d_pos : 0 < ε_d := lt_min (inv_pos.mpr hC_d0_pos) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M_a, hM_a⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hρ₁_pos).eventually (ge_mem_nhds hε_a_pos))
  obtain ⟨M_b, hM_b⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < 2 * (ρ₁ - ρ₀))).eventually (ge_mem_nhds hε_b_pos))
  obtain ⟨M_c, hM_c⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < 2 * ρ₁)).eventually (ge_mem_nhds hε_c_pos))
  obtain ⟨M_d, hM_d⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    ((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < ρ₂ - ρ₁)).eventually (ge_mem_nhds hε_d_pos))
  let M₁ : ℝ := max (max 2 hBudget.k₀) (max (max M_a M_b) (max M_c M_d))
  refine ⟨M₁, le_trans (le_max_left 2 hBudget.k₀) (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro M hM₁_le ρ hAdm
  have hM_ge_two : 2 ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left 2 hBudget.k₀) (le_max_left _ _)) hM₁_le
  have hk₀_le_M : hBudget.k₀ ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right 2 hBudget.k₀) (le_max_left _ _)) hM₁_le
  have hM_rhs : max (max M_a M_b) (max M_c M_d) ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM₁_le
  have hMa_le : M_a ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM_rhs)
  have hMb_le : M_b ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM_rhs)
  have hMc_le : M_c ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM_rhs)
  have hMd_le : M_d ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM_rhs)
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M := by linarith

  
  
  
  have h_walk_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ, walkPos ρ om m ∈ Ω_reg :=
    fun om m => (hBase.walk_in_reg M ρ hAdm om m).1
  have h_adm_ball_sub : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
      0 < ρ y ∧ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := by
    intro y hy
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (hAdm.pos_iff y).mpr hy
    have h_le := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have hρ_le_sing : ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y := by
      have : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    refine ⟨hρ_pos, fun ζ hζ => ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm] at hζ
    by_contra h_not
    have h_inf : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ :=
      Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem (h_not : ζ ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P)
    linarith
  let subRestrict : ∀ {r m : ℕ}, r ≤ m →
      (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → (Finset.range (r + 1) → ℝ) :=
    fun hrm p i =>
      p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2) (Nat.succ_le_succ hrm))⟩
  have h_sub_meas : ∀ {r m : ℕ} (hrm : r ≤ m), Measurable (subRestrict hrm) := by
    intro r m _
    exact Measurable.of_eval fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _
  let walkPrefixPos : (m : ℕ) → (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ :=
    fun m => Nat.rec
      (motive := fun n => (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ)
      (fun p => (p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : ℂ))
      (fun n prev p =>
        let y := prev (subRestrict (Nat.le_succ n) p)
        y + (ρ y : ℂ) *

                  (Finset.range (l + 1)).restrict om := rfl
              have h_pos_eq : walkPos ρ om l =
                  walkPrefixPos l (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hl) (S_idx.restrict om)) := by
                rw [h_sub_eq, ← (h_pref_props l).2.2 om]
              simpa [h_pos_eq] using h ⟨l, hl⟩
            · have h_sub_eq : subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.2) (S_idx.restrict om) =
                  (Finset.range (l.1 + 1)).restrict om := rfl
              have h_pos_eq : walkPos ρ om l.1 =
                  walkPrefixPos l.1
                    (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.2) (S_idx.restrict om)) := by
                rw [h_sub_eq, ← (h_pref_props l.1).2.2 om]
              simpa [← h_pos_eq] using h l.1 l.2
          let Φ_U : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ :=
            (KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)).indicator fun q =>
              U_tilde (circleMap (walkPrefixPos n q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n q.1)) q.2) -
                U_tilde (walkPrefixPos n q.1)
          have hΦ_U_meas : Measurable Φ_U := by
            have hy_q : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ => walkPrefixPos n q.1) :=
              (h_pref_props n).1.comp measurable_fst
            have h_cmap : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ =>
                circleMap (walkPrefixPos n q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n q.1)) q.2) := by
              simp only [circleMap]
              exact hy_q.add
                ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp hy_q)).mul
                  (Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
                    ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)))
            exact ((hU_tilde_meas.comp h_cmap).sub (hU_tilde_meas.comp hy_q)).indicator
              (hKeepPrefU_meas.prod MeasurableSet.univ)
          have hΦ_U_bound : ∀ q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖Φ_U q‖ ≤ 2 * B_UK := by
            intro ⟨p, θ⟩
            by_cases hp : p ∈ KeepPrefU
            · have hp_prod : (p, θ) ∈ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hp, trivial⟩
              dsimp only [Φ_U]
              rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp_prod]
              have hb1 := hU_tilde_bounds (circleMap (walkPrefixPos n p) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n p)) θ)
              have hb2 := hU_tilde_bounds (walkPrefixPos n p)
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
              constructor <;> linarith
            · have hp_n : (p, θ) ∉ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun h => hp h.1
              dsimp only [Φ_U]
              rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp_n, norm_zero]
              linarith
          let ΔZ : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => Φ_U (X_pref om, X_next om)
          have hΔZ_eq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
              (KeepU n).indicator
                (fun om' => U_tilde (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - U_tilde (walkPos ρ om' n)) om =
              ΔZ om := by
            intro om
            have hy_eq : walkPos ρ om n = walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om) := (h_pref_props n).2.2 om
            have hy1_eq : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) =
                circleMap (walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om)) (ρ (walkPrefixPos n (X_pref om)))
                  (X_next om) := by
              simp [walkPos, circleMap, ← hy_eq, X_next]
            by_cases hK : om ∈ KeepU n
            · have hp_prod : (X_pref om, X_next om) ∈ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                ⟨(hKeepU_iff om).mpr hK, trivial⟩
              simp only [ΔZ, Φ_U, Set.indicator_of_mem hK, Set.indicator_of_mem hp_prod,
                hy_eq, hy1_eq]
            · have hp_n : (X_pref om, X_next om) ∉ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                fun h => hK ((hKeepU_iff om).mp h.1)
              simp only [ΔZ, Φ_U, Set.indicator_of_notMem hK, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp_n]
          have hΔZ_meas : Measurable ΔZ := hΦ_U_meas.comp (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas)
          have hΔZ_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable ΔZ walkMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΔZ_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (2 * B_UK)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => hΦ_U_bound (X_pref om, X_next om))
          let μ_pref := walkMeasure.map X_pref
          have _ : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ_pref := (h_prod_step n).1
          have hΦ_int_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable Φ_U (μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) :=
            MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hΦ_U_meas.aestronglyMeasurable (2 * B_UK)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hΦ_U_bound)
          have hΔZ_zero : (∫ om, ΔZ om ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
            have h_m1 : (∫ om, ΔZ om ∂walkMeasure) =
                ∫ q, Φ_U q ∂(walkMeasure.map (fun om => (X_pref om, X_next om))) :=
              (MeasureTheory.integral_map (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas).aemeasurable
                hΦ_U_meas.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
            rw [h_m1, (h_prod_step n).2, MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hΦ_int_prod]
            have h_inner : ∀ p : S_idx → ℝ, (∫ θ, Φ_U (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
              intro p
              by_cases hp : p ∈ KeepPrefU
              · have hp_n := Set.mem_iInter.mp hp ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
                have h_sub_id : subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) p = p := rfl
                let y := walkPrefixPos n p
                have hy_G : y ∈ G_M := by simpa only [y, h_sub_id] using hp_n.1
                have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := ((hG_M_iff y).mp hy_G).1
                have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (h_adm_ball_sub y hy_reg).1
                have hy_V : y ∈ V_j :=
                  h_step_in_V hy_G y (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ_pos.le)
                have hc_V : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ V_j := by
                  intro θ
                  apply h_step_in_V hy_G
                  simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hρ_pos.le]
                have h_fn_eq : (fun θ : ℝ => Φ_U (p, θ)) =
                    fun θ : ℝ => U_K (s_j (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) - U_K (s_j y) := by
                  funext θ
                  have hp_prod : (p, θ) ∈ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hp, trivial⟩
                  dsimp only [Φ_U, U_tilde, y]
                  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp_prod, Set.indicator_of_mem (hc_V θ),
                    Set.indicator_of_mem hy_V]
                rw [h_fn_eq]
                have h_c_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => U_K (s_j (circleMap y (ρ y) θ))) := by
                  have h_sj_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => s_j (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) :=
                    (h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.comp_continuous
                      (continuous_circleMap _ _) fun θ => (hc_V θ).1
                  exact hU_cont.comp_continuous h_sj_cont fun θ => (hc_V θ).2
                have h_c_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun θ : ℝ => U_K (s_j (circleMap y (ρ y) θ))) unifTwoPiMeasure := by
                  refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_c_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
                    B_UK (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => ?_)
                  have hb := hU_bounds (s_j (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) (hc_V θ).2
                  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans (sq_nonneg _) hb.1)]
                  exact hb.2
                rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_c_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)]
                have h_avg_eq :
                    Real.circleAverage (fun z => U_K (s_j z)) y (ρ y) = U_K (s_j y) :=
                  hU_avg j y (ρ y) hρ_pos fun z hz => h_step_in_V hy_G z hz
                rw [h_unif_eq_circleAvg (fun z => U_K (s_j z)) y (ρ y), h_avg_eq]
                simp
              · have h_fn0 : (fun θ : ℝ => Φ_U (p, θ)) = 0 := by
                  funext θ
                  have hp_n : (p, θ) ∉ KeepPrefU ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun h => hp h.1
                  exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hp_n _
                simp [h_fn0]
            simp [h_inner]
          have hZ_succ_eq : Z_U (n + 1) = fun om => Z_U n om + ΔZ om := by
            funext om
            exact congrArg (Z_U n om + ·) (hΔZ_eq om)
          rw [hZ_succ_eq]
          refine ⟨hInt_n.add hΔZ_int, ?_⟩
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hInt_n hΔZ_int, hExp_n, hΔZ_zero, add_zero]
    have hZ0_int_le : (∫ om, Z_U 0 om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀) := by
      let f0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => U_K (s_j (x : ℂ))
      have hf0_cont : Continuous f0 :=
        hU_cont.comp_continuous
          ((h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal
            fun x => (h_real_in_reg x).1)
          fun x => (h_real_in_V x).2
      have hZ0_eq : Z_U 0 = fun om : WalkSpace => f0 (om 0) := by
        funext om
        change U_tilde (om 0 : ℂ) = U_K (s_j (om 0 : ℂ))
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem (h_real_in_V (om 0)) _
      have h_eval : walkMeasure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) = unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
      have h_map : (∫ om, Z_U 0 om ∂walkMeasure) = ∫ x, f0 x ∂unifTwoPiMeasure := by
        rw [hZ0_eq, ← h_eval]
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_map (measurable_pi_apply 0).aemeasurable
          hf0_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
      rw [h_map, unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
        MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
      have h_toR : ((ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹).toReal = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le]
      rw [h_toR, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le, smul_eq_mul]
      exact hU_int j
    let E_U_fin : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun k =>
      ⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        ((⋂ l ∈ Finset.range m, (fun om => walkPos ρ om l) ⁻¹' G_M) ∩
          (fun om => U_tilde (walkPos ρ om m)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi lam)
    have hE_U_fin_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet (E_U_fin k) := by
      intro k
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun m _ => ?_
      refine (Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l _ => hG_M_meas.preimage (h_walk_meas l)).inter ?_
      exact isOpen_Ioi.measurableSet.preimage (hU_tilde_meas.comp (h_walk_meas m))
    have h_fin_bound : ∀ k : ℕ,
        walkMeasure (E_U_fin k) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam) := by
      intro k
      have h_ind_le : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
          (E_U_fin k).indicator (fun _ => lam) om ≤ Z_U k om := by
        intro om
        by_cases h_mem : om ∈ E_U_fin k
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h_mem]
          simp only [E_U_fin, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_inter_iff,
            Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi] at h_mem
          rcases h_mem with ⟨m, hm_lt, hm_good, hm_gt⟩
          exact (hZ_U_inv k om).2.2 ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hm_lt, hm_good, hm_gt⟩
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h_mem]
          exact (hZ_U_inv k om).1.1
      have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          ((E_U_fin k).indicator fun _ => lam) walkMeasure :=
        (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _).indicator (hE_U_fin_meas k)
      have h_markov : lam * walkMeasure.real (E_U_fin k) ≤ C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀) := by
        have h_int_ind : (∫ om, (E_U_fin k).indicator (fun _ => lam) om ∂walkMeasure) =
            walkMeasure.real (E_U_fin k) * lam := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_const _ (hE_U_fin_meas k), smul_eq_mul,
            MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
        have h_mono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_ind_int (hZ_U_int_exp k).1 h_ind_le
        rw [h_int_ind, (hZ_U_int_exp k).2] at h_mono
        linarith
      have h_real_le : walkMeasure.real (E_U_fin k) ≤ (C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam :=
        (le_div_iff₀ hlam_pos).mpr (by linarith)
      rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] at h_real_le
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_le
    have h_mono_seq : Monotone E_U_fin := by
      intro a b hab om hom
      simp only [E_U_fin, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range] at hom ⊢
      rcases hom with ⟨m, hm, hrest⟩
      exact ⟨m, lt_of_lt_of_le hm (Nat.succ_le_succ hab), hrest⟩
    have h_union_le : walkMeasure (⋃ k : ℕ, E_U_fin k) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam) := by
      rw [h_mono_seq.measure_iUnion]
      exact iSup_le h_fin_bound
    have hE_1_sub : E_1 j ⊆ ⋃ k : ℕ, E_U_fin k := by
      rintro om ⟨m, hm_tau, hm_gt⟩
      have hm_pre : ∀ l < m, walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_M := h_tau_pre om hm_tau
      have hm_V : walkPos ρ om m ∈ V_j := by
        cases m with
        | zero => exact h_real_in_V (om 0)
        | succ n =>
            apply h_step_in_V (hm_pre n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
            rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
            have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := hAdm.nonneg _
            have h_diff : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) - walkPos ρ om n =
                (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
              simp [walkPos]
            rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn,
              Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
      have h_ut_gt : lam < U_tilde (walkPos ρ om m) := by
        dsimp only [U_tilde]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm_V]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hm_gt (hU_bounds _ hm_V.2).1
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m, ?_⟩
      simp only [E_U_fin, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter,
        Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi]
      exact ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_self m, hm_pre, h_ut_gt⟩
    have hE_1_meas_le : walkMeasure (E_1 j) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam) :=
      le_trans (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hE_1_sub) h_union_le
    have h_ratio_nn : 0 ≤ (C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam := by
      refine div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_har_pos.le ?_) hlam_pos.le
      exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by dsimp [K]; linarith) _
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    calc
      (walkMeasure (E_1 j)).toReal
          ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal ((C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam)).toReal :=
            ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hE_1_meas_le
      _ = (C_har * K ^ (2 * ρ₀)) / lam := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h_ratio_nn

  
  
  
  let E_2 : Fin P.N → Set WalkSpace := fun j =>
    {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
      lam < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2}
  have hE_2_bound : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      walkMeasure.real (E_2 j) ≤ (2 * S.H ^ 2) / lam := by
    intro j
    let s_j : ℂ → ℂ := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
    let s_tilde : ℂ → ℂ := (horizStrip h_sl).indicator s_j
    have hs_tilde_meas : Measurable s_tilde :=
      h_ind_meas (h_horiz_open h_sl) (h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn
    have hs_tilde_eq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h_sl, s_tilde y = s_j y :=
      fun y hy => Set.indicator_of_mem hy _
    have h_step_le_H : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ Ω_reg → ∀ {z : ℂ}, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y →
        ‖s_j (y + z) - s_j y‖ ≤ S.H := by
      intro y hy z hz
      have h_st := hAdm.small_shape_step y hy z hz j
      have h_exp_le_one : Real.exp (-M ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      have hs_H : |(s_j y).im| < S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
      have hδ_nn : 0 ≤ sliceShapeDepth S P j y := by
        dsimp only [sliceShapeDepth, s_j]; linarith
      have hδ_le_H : sliceShapeDepth S P j y ≤ S.H := by
        dsimp only [sliceShapeDepth, s_j]; linarith [abs_nonneg (s_j y).im]
      calc
        ‖s_j (y + z) - s_j y‖
            ≤ Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j y := h_st
        _ ≤ 1 * S.H := mul_le_mul h_exp_le_one hδ_le_H hδ_nn zero_le_one
        _ = S.H := one_mul S.H
    have h_walk_step_le_H : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ),
        ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ S.H := by
      intro om n
      rw [hs_tilde_eq _ (h_walk_reg om (n + 1)).1, hs_tilde_eq _ (h_walk_reg om n).1]
      let z_step : ℂ := (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      have hz : ‖z_step‖ ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := by
        simp [z_step, abs_of_nonneg (hAdm.nonneg _)]
      simpa only [walkPos, z_step] using h_step_le_H (h_walk_reg om n) hz
    let KeepD : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun n =>
      ⋂ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        {om : WalkSpace | walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_M ∧
          ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om l) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam}
    have hKeepD_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, MeasurableSet (KeepD n) := by
      intro n
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l _ => ?_
      refine (hG_M_meas.preimage (h_walk_meas l)).inter ?_
      have h_diff_meas : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om l) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2) :=
        (((hs_tilde_meas.comp (h_walk_meas l)).sub
          (hs_tilde_meas.comp (h_walk_meas 0))).norm).pow_const 2
      exact isClosed_Iic.measurableSet.preimage h_diff_meas
    let ΔD : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n =>
      (KeepD n).indicator fun om => s_tilde (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om n)
    have hΔD_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (ΔD n) := fun n =>
      ((hs_tilde_meas.comp (h_walk_meas (n + 1))).sub
        (hs_tilde_meas.comp (h_walk_meas n))).indicator (hKeepD_meas n)
    have hΔD_norm : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), ‖ΔD n om‖ ≤ S.H := by
      intro n om
      by_cases hK : om ∈ KeepD n
      · dsimp only [ΔD]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hK]
        exact h_walk_step_le_H om n
      · dsimp only [ΔD]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hK, norm_zero]
        exact hS_H_pos.le
    let D : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun k =>
      Nat.rec (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (fun n prev om => prev om + ΔD n om) k
    have hD_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (D k) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact measurable_const
      | succ n ih => exact ih.add (hΔD_meas n)
    have hD_inv : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        ‖D k om‖ ≤ (k : ℝ) * S.H ∧
        ((∀ l < k, walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_M ∧
          ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om l) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam) →
          D k om = s_tilde (walkPos ρ om k) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)) ∧
        ((∃ m ≤ k, (∀ l < m, walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_M) ∧
          lam < ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om m) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2) →
          lam ≤ ‖D k om‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro om
          refine ⟨by simp [D], fun _ => by simp [D], ?_⟩
          rintro ⟨m, hm_le, _, hm_gt⟩
          have hm0 : m = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hm_le
          subst hm0
          simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
            zero_pow] at hm_gt
          linarith
      | succ n ih =>
          intro om
          rcases ih om with ⟨h_norm_n, h_act_n, h_dom_n⟩
          have h_step_eq : D (n + 1) om = D n om + ΔD n om := rfl
          have h_when_keep : om ∈ KeepD n →
              D (n + 1) om = s_tilde (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0) := by
            intro hK
            have h_all : ∀ l ≤ n, walkPos ρ om l ∈ G_M ∧
                ‖s_tilde (walkPos ρ om l) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam :=
              fun l hl => Set.mem_iInter₂.mp hK l (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hl))
            have hDn : D n om = s_tilde (walkPos ρ om n) - s_tilde (walkPos ρ om 0) :=
              h_act_n fun l hl => h_all l (Nat.le_of_lt hl)
            rw [h_step_eq, hDn]
            dsimp only [ΔD]
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hK]
            ring
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩

    have hD_sq_int : ∀ k : ℕ,

      intro k
      refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
        (((hD_meas k).norm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (((k : ℝ) * S.H) ^ 2)

        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖ΔD n om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
      intro n

        (((hΔD_meas n).norm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (S.H ^ 2)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)

          have hX_next_meas : Measurable X_next := measurable_pi_apply (n + 1)
          let u_pref : (S_idx → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p =>
            s_tilde (walkPrefixPos n p) - s_tilde (walkPrefixPos 0 (subRestrict (Nat.zero_le n) p))

              s_tilde (walkPrefixPos n p)

            ⋂ l : Fin (n + 1),

                ‖s_tilde (walkPrefixPos l.1 (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.2) p)) -
                  s_tilde (walkPrefixPos 0 (subRestrict (Nat.zero_le n) p))‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam}

            hs_tilde_meas.comp ((h_pref_props 0).1.comp (h_sub_meas (Nat.zero_le n)))
          have hKeepPrefD_meas : MeasurableSet KeepPrefD := by
            refine MeasurableSet.iInter fun l => ?_
            have hl_meas : Measurable (fun p : S_idx → ℝ =>
                walkPrefixPos l.1 (subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.2) p)) :=

            · have h_sub_eq : subRestrict (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hl) (X_pref om) =

          have hΦ_cross_bound : ∀ q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ,

            intro ⟨p, θ⟩

              have hu_sq : ‖u_pref p‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam := by simpa only [u_pref, h_sub_id] using hp_n.2
              have hu_le : ‖u_pref p‖ ≤ lam + 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (u_pref p)]
              let y := walkPrefixPos n p
              have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := (h_pref_props n).2.1 p

              have hc_reg : circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Ω_reg := by

              have h_uim : |(u_pref p).im| ≤ lam + 1 :=
                le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hu_le
              have h_vre : |(v_step p θ).re| ≤ S.H :=

              have h_vim : |(v_step p θ).im| ≤ S.H :=

          have h_expand_fn : (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖D (n + 1) om‖ ^ 2) =

            MeasureTheory.integral_add h_pair_int h_cross_int,
            MeasureTheory.integral_add (hD_sq_int n) (hΔD_sq_int n),
            ih, h_cross_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have hD_l2_le : ∀ k : ℕ, (∫ om, ‖D k om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 2 * S.H ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      rw [hD_orthog k, ← MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range k)
        (fun n _ => hΔD_sq_int n)]
      have h_ae_le : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, ‖ΔD n om‖ ^ 2) ≤
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
              ‖s_j (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - s_j (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 := by
        filter_upwards [hBase.walk_stops M ρ hAdm] with om h_stop

          exact h_not_E2 ⟨n, hn, lt_of_not_ge hgt⟩
        have h_t1 :
            ‖S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ := by
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)), hM_ρ₁_pos]
        have h_t2 :
            ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ := by
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om 0)), hM_ρ₁_pos]
        have h_t3 : ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om 0)‖ ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ :=
          le_trans (hC_s0_bound (om 0) hom0_Icc k) h_Cs0_le
        let a1 := S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)
        let a2 := sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om 0)
        let a3 := sliceImpactSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om 0)
        have h_id : sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n) = a1 + a2 + a3 := by
          dsimp only [sliceAngleSeq, a1, a2, a3]
          ring
        rw [h_id]
        calc
          ‖a1 + a2 + a3‖ ≤ ‖a1 + a2‖ + ‖a3‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖a1‖ + ‖a2‖ + ‖a3‖ := add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
          _ ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ + (1 / 3 : ℝ) * M ^ ρ₁ :=
                add_le_add (add_le_add h_t1 h_t2) h_t3
          _ = M ^ ρ₁ := by ring
      have h_log_sin_upper : ∀ n ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∀ k : Fin P.N,
          Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ B₀ := by
        intro n hn k
        have hy_n : walkPos ρ om n ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_reg om n
        have h_sup_le : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun i : Fin P.N => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) ≤ M ^ ρ₁ :=
          Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun i _ => h_ang_le_ρ₁ n hn i
        have hd0_le : ‖P.d0 k (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ B₀ := by
          refine le_trans (hStrip.odd_cycle_d0_bound _ hy_n k) ?_
          dsimp only [B₀]
          nlinarith [hN_pos]
        have h_sin_le : ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ Real.exp B₀ :=
          le_trans (h_euler_sin _) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hd0_le)
        have h_sin_pos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k (walkPos ρ om n))‖ :=
          norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero _ hy_n k)
        simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log h_sin_pos h_sin_le
      rcases h_viol with h_ang_gt | h_sin_abs_gt
      · exfalso
        have h_le : ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j_bad.val (walkPos ρ om m_bad)‖ ≤ M ^ ρ₂ :=
          le_trans (h_ang_le_ρ₁ m_bad hm_bad_le j_bad) hM_ρ₁_le_ρ₂
        linarith
      · have h_up : Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j_bad (walkPos ρ om m_bad))‖ ≤ M ^ ρ₂ :=
          le_trans (h_log_sin_upper m_bad hm_bad_le j_bad) hB₀_le_ρ₂
        have h_low : Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j_bad (walkPos ρ om m_bad))‖ < -M ^ ρ₂ := by
          rcases lt_abs.mp h_sin_abs_gt with h1 | h2
          · linarith
          · linarith
        exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_univ j_bad)
          ⟨m_bad, hm_bad_le,
            fun l hl => h_log_sin_upper l (le_trans hl.le hm_bad_le) j_bad, h_low⟩
  calc
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
          M ^ ρ₂ < ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ ∨
          M ^ ρ₂ < |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (walkPos ρ om m))‖|}
        ≤ walkMeasure.real
            (E_ang_bad ∪ (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_sin j)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_target_sub
    _ ≤ walkMeasure.real E_ang_bad +
          walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_sin j) :=
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ δ / 2 + δ / 2 := add_le_add hE_ang_bad_le hE_sin_union_le
    _ = δ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (C_clk ρ₂ γ η b δ : ℝ)
    (hStrip : StripAngleAndAmplitudeData S hBudget P)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (hρ₂_pos : 0 < ρ₂) (hρ₂_lt : ρ₂ < γ) (hγ_lt : γ < 1)
    (hη_pos : 0 < η) (hb_pos : 0 < b) (hδ_pos : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ M₂ : ℝ, 2 ≤ M₂ ∧
      ∀ M : ℝ, M₂ ≤ M →
        ∀ ρ : ℂ → ℝ, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
            M ^ (1 + η - γ) <
              (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * M ^ γ) (walkPos ρ om)
                (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ) ∨
            ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
              (∃ ι : Fin 2,
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * (b * M ^ γ)) <
                  ‖sliceModPosMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j ι (walkPos ρ om) m‖) ∨
              Real.exp (-(b * M ^ γ) / 3) <
                ‖sliceTinySupMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j (walkPos ρ om) m‖} ≤ δ

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (C_clk ρ₂ γ η b δ : ℝ)
    (hStrip : StripAngleAndAmplitudeData S hBudget P)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hSH_pos : 0 < S.H := S.H_pos
  have hSc_pos : 0 < S.c := S.c_pos
  
  
  
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  let A₀ : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | om 0 ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)}
  have hA₀_meas : MeasurableSet A₀ :=
    measurableSet_Ico.preimage (measurable_pi_apply 0)
  have hA₀_compl_null : walkMeasure A₀ᶜ = 0 := by
    have h_pre : A₀ᶜ = (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) ⁻¹' (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))ᶜ := rfl
    rw [h_pre, ← MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply (measurable_pi_apply 0) measurableSet_Ico.compl]
    have h_eval : walkMeasure.map (fun om : WalkSpace => om 0) = unifTwoPiMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) 0
    rw [h_eval]
    simp [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Ico.compl]
  have hA₀_compl_real : walkMeasure.real A₀ᶜ = 0 := by
    simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hA₀_compl_null]

  
  
  
  have h_tiny_inv : ∀ (bG : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      0 < bG →
      sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n = true →
      Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)‖ < -bG := by
    intro bG j y_seq n hbG
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simp [sliceIsTiny]
    | succ k _ =>
        simp only [sliceIsTiny]
        cases ht : sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq k
        · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          intro h_dec
          have h_le : Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ ≤ -2 * bG :=
            of_decide_eq_true h_dec
          linarith
        · simp only [↓reduceIte]
          exact fun h_dec => of_decide_eq_true h_dec

  have h_mod_inv : ∀ (bG : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ),
      0 < bG →
      -2 * bG < Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq 0)‖ →
      sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n = false →
      -2 * bG < Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)‖ := by
    intro bG j y_seq n hbG h0
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro _
        exact h0
    | succ k _ =>
        simp only [sliceIsTiny]
        cases ht : sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq k
        · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          intro h_dec
          have h_nle : ¬ (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ ≤ -2 * bG) :=
            of_decide_eq_false h_dec
          linarith
        · simp only [↓reduceIte]
          intro h_dec
          have h_nlt : ¬ (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ < -bG) :=
            of_decide_eq_false h_dec
          linarith

  have h_switches_le : ∀ (bG U_max C_init : ℝ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (K : ℕ),
      0 < bG → 0 ≤ U_max →
      (∀ j : Fin P.N, -C_init ≤ Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq 0)‖) →
      (∀ j : Fin P.N, Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq K)‖ ≤ U_max) →
      bG * (sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq K : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (∑ j : Fin P.N, ∑ n ∈ Finset.range K,
          if !sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n then
            -Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1))‖ +
              Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)‖
          else 0) +
        2 * (P.N : ℝ) * (U_max + C_init) := by
    intro bG U_max C_init y_seq K hbG hU_nn h_init_lo h_term_hi
    let a_seq : Fin P.N → ℕ → ℝ := fun j n =>
      Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)‖
    let t_seq : Fin P.N → ℕ → Bool := fun j n =>
      sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n
    let M_hold : Fin P.N → ℕ → ℝ := fun j k =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k,
        if !t_seq j n then -a_seq j (n + 1) + a_seq j n else 0
    let S_all : Fin P.N → ℕ → ℝ := fun j k =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k,
        if t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0
    have h_site : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        bG * S_all j K ≤ 2 * M_hold j K + 2 * (U_max + C_init) := by
      intro j
      let Φ : ℕ → ℝ := fun k =>
        2 * M_hold j k - bG * S_all j k +
          (if t_seq j k then -bG else 2 * (a_seq j k + bG))
      have hΦ_mono : ∀ k : ℕ, Φ 0 ≤ Φ k := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => exact le_rfl
        | succ n ih =>
            refine le_trans ih ?_
            have hM_step : M_hold j (n + 1) = M_hold j n +
                (if !t_seq j n then -a_seq j (n + 1) + a_seq j n else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_range_succ _ n
            have hS_step : S_all j (n + 1) = S_all j n +
                (if t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) :=
              Finset.sum_range_succ _ n
            dsimp only [Φ]
            rw [hM_step, hS_step]
            have ht_succ : t_seq j (n + 1) =
                (if t_seq j n then decide (a_seq j (n + 1) < -bG)
                 else decide (a_seq j (n + 1) ≤ -2 * bG)) := rfl
            cases htn : t_seq j n <;> cases htn1 : t_seq j (n + 1)
            · simp only [Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false]
              linarith
            · have h_dec : decide (a_seq j (n + 1) ≤ -2 * bG) = true := by
                simpa [htn, htn1] using ht_succ.symm
              have ha_le : a_seq j (n + 1) ≤ -2 * bG := of_decide_eq_true h_dec
              simp only [Bool.not_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true]
              linarith
            · have h_dec : decide (a_seq j (n + 1) < -bG) = false := by
                simpa [htn, htn1] using ht_succ.symm
              have ha_ge : ¬ (a_seq j (n + 1) < -bG) := of_decide_eq_false h_dec
              simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq,
                not_false_eq_true]
              linarith
            · simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false]
              linarith
      have hΦ0 : Φ 0 = 2 * (a_seq j 0 + bG) := by
        simp [Φ, M_hold, S_all, t_seq, sliceIsTiny]
      have hΦK := hΦ_mono K
      rw [hΦ0] at hΦK
      dsimp only [Φ] at hΦK
      have ha0 : -C_init ≤ a_seq j 0 := h_init_lo j
      have haK : a_seq j K ≤ U_max := h_term_hi j
      cases htK : t_seq j K
      · simp only [htK, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hΦK
        linarith
      · simp only [htK, ↓reduceIte] at hΦK
        linarith
    have h_card_le : (sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq K : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j : Fin P.N, S_all j K := by
      classical
      have h_sub :
          ((Finset.range K).filter fun n => ∃ j : Fin P.N, t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1)) ⊆
          Finset.univ.biUnion (fun j : Fin P.N =>
            (Finset.range K).filter fun n => t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1)) := by
        intro n hn
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hn ⊢
        rcases hn with ⟨hn_r, j, hj⟩
        exact ⟨j, hn_r, hj⟩
      have h_nat : sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq K ≤
          ∑ j : Fin P.N, ((Finset.range K).filter fun n => t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1)).card := by
        dsimp only [sliceJointSwitches]
        have h_fc : ((Finset.range K).filter fun n =>
              ∃ j : Fin P.N, sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n ≠ sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (n + 1)) =
            ((Finset.range K).filter fun n => ∃ j : Fin P.N, t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1)) := by
          ext n; simp [t_seq]
        rw [h_fc]
        exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card h_sub) Finset.card_biUnion_le
      calc
        (sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq K : ℝ)
          ≤ ((∑ j : Fin P.N,
              ((Finset.range K).filter fun n => t_seq j n ≠ t_seq j (n + 1)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
            Nat.cast_le.mpr h_nat
        _ = ∑ j : Fin P.N, S_all j K := by
            push_cast
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
            dsimp only [S_all]
            rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
            split_ifs <;> simp
    calc
      bG * (sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq K : ℝ)
        ≤ bG * ∑ j : Fin P.N, S_all j K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_card_le hbG.le
