      _ = ∑ j : Fin P.N, bG * S_all j K := Finset.mul_sum _ _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin P.N, (2 * M_hold j K + 2 * (U_max + C_init)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => h_site j
      _ = 2 * (∑ j : Fin P.N, M_hold j K) + 2 * (P.N : ℝ) * (U_max + C_init) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
            Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          ring

  
  
  
  let h_sl : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h_sl \ P.Z_all
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < P.N := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_ball : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh_sl_pos : 0 < h_sl :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_ball).1
  have h_horiz_open : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (horizStrip r) := fun r =>
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have h_real_in_reg : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω_reg := fun x =>
    ⟨by simp [horizStrip, hh_sl_pos], P.real_not_mem_Z_all x⟩
  have h_pair_maps : ∀ k : ℤ,
      Set.MapsTo
        (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
        (horizStrip h_sl) (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) := by
    intro k z hz
    have hz_lt : -h_sl < z.im ∧ z.im < h_sl := abs_lt.mp hz
    have ht₀_norm : ‖(sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht₀_ball
    refine ⟨ht₀_norm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.1
    · simpa [sliceHeight, h_sl] using hz_lt.2
  have h_impact_holo : ∀ k : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N k) (horizStrip h_sl) := by
    intro k
    have h_pair_diff :
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun z : ℂ => (z + (k : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)))
          (horizStrip h_sl) :=
      (differentiableOn_id.add (differentiableOn_const _)).prodMk (differentiableOn_const _)
    exact S.𝔰_holo.comp h_pair_diff (h_pair_maps k)
  have h_impact_maps : ∀ k : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h_sl,
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N k z ∈ horizStrip S.H := fun k z hz =>
    S.𝔰_maps_to _ (h_pair_maps k hz)
  have h_speed_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
    fun j => (S.f_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)).mono Set.sdiff_subset
  have h_angle_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
    fun j => (S.ϕ_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)).mono Set.sdiff_subset
  have h_support_holo : ∀ j : Fin P.N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
    fun j => (S.H0_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)).mono Set.sdiff_subset
  have h_pos_diffAt : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (ι : Fin 2), ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y := by
    intro j ι y hy
    have hs_in_H : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
    have hf_ne : S.f (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) ≠ 0 := P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j
    have h_imp_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y :=
      (h_impact_holo j.val).differentiableAt ((h_horiz_open h_sl).mem_nhds hy.1)
    have hΓ_da := S.Γ_reg_holo _ hs_in_H hf_ne
    fin_cases ι
    · exact DifferentiableAt.comp y hΓ_da.1 h_imp_da
    · exact DifferentiableAt.comp y hΓ_da.2 h_imp_da
  have h_pos_holo : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (ι : Fin 2),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) Ω_reg :=
    fun j ι y hy => (h_pos_diffAt j ι y hy).differentiableWithinAt
  have h_pos_norm_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ContinuousOn (fun w => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w‖) Ω_reg :=
    fun j => (continuousOn_pi.mpr fun ι => (h_pos_holo j ι).continuousOn).norm
  have h_logSpeed_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖) Ω_reg :=
    fun j => (h_speed_holo j).continuousOn.norm.log fun y hy =>
      norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j)
  have h_logDepth_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (sliceLogDepth S P j) Ω_reg := by
    intro j
    have h_depth_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceShapeDepth S P j) Ω_reg :=
      continuousOn_const.sub
        (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
          (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn
            ((h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset)))
    refine (h_depth_cont.log fun y hy => ?_).neg
    have hs_H : |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| < S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
    dsimp [sliceShapeDepth]
    linarith

  
  have hIcc_ne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨0, Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩
  have h_init_each : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∃ C_j : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_j ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C_j ≤ Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ∧
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_j := by
    intro j
    have h_cont_abs : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
        |Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖|) :=
      ((h_logSpeed_cont j).comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal h_real_in_reg).abs
    obtain ⟨x_m, _, hx_m⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hIcc_ne h_cont_abs.continuousOn
    exact ⟨|Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x_m : ℂ)‖|, abs_nonneg _,
      fun x hx => abs_le.mp (hx_m hx)⟩
  choose C_init_fn hC_init_nn hC_init_bd using h_init_each
  let C_init : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty C_init_fn
  have hC_init_ge : 0 ≤ C_init := by
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).Nonempty)
    exact le_trans (hC_init_nn j₀) (Finset.le_sup' C_init_fn hj₀)
  have hC_init_real : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      -C_init ≤ Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ∧
      Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (x : ℂ)‖ ≤ C_init := by
    intro x hx j
    have h_le : C_init_fn j ≤ C_init := Finset.le_sup' C_init_fn (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h_bd := hC_init_bd j x hx
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  
  obtain ⟨C_f, hC_f_ge_one, h_speed_cap⟩ := hStrip.speed_amp_cap

  
  have h_adm_cball : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 ∧ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := by
    intro M ρ hAdm y hy
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (hAdm.pos_iff y).mpr hy
    have h_le := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have hρ_100 : ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 := by
      have : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    have hρ_sing : ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * sliceSingDist S P y := by
      have : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := min_le_right _ _
      linarith
    refine ⟨hρ_100, fun ζ hζ => ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm] at hζ
    by_contra h_not
    have h_inf : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ := Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem h_not
    linarith

  have h_depth_speed_upper : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        sliceLogDepth S P j y ≤ M →
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)‖ ≤ C_f * (M + 2) := by
    intro M ρ hAdm y hy z hz j h_ld
    have hM2 : 2 ≤ M := hAdm.scale_ge_two
    have hyz_reg : y + z ∈ Ω_reg := by
      apply (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).2
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    let d_y := sliceShapeDepth S P j y
    let d_yz := sliceShapeDepth S P j (y + z)
    have hd_y_pos : 0 < d_y := by
      have hs_H : |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| < S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
      dsimp [d_y, sliceShapeDepth]; linarith
    have h_exp_M : Real.exp (-M) ≤ d_y := by
      have h_log_ge : -M ≤ Real.log d_y := by
        dsimp [sliceLogDepth, d_y] at h_ld; linarith
      simpa [Real.exp_log hd_y_pos] using Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_log_ge
    have h_step := hAdm.small_shape_step y hy z hz j
    have h_im_diff : |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)).im| -
        |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| ≤ Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d_y := by
      calc
        |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)).im| - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im|
          ≤ |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)).im - (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| :=
            abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
        _ = |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| := by simp
        _ ≤ ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
            Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * d_y := h_step
    have hd_yz_ge : (1 - Real.exp (-M ^ 2)) * d_y ≤ d_yz := by
      dsimp [d_y, d_yz, sliceShapeDepth] at h_im_diff ⊢
      linarith
    have he_neg1 : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have he1 : 2 ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
      have h_mul : Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp 1 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num; linarith
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_mul (Real.exp_pos 1)
    have he_negM2 : Real.exp (-M ^ 2) ≤ 1 / 5 := by
      have he4 : 5 ≤ Real.exp 4 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (4 : ℝ)]
      have he_neg4 : Real.exp (-4) ≤ 1 / 5 := by
        have h_mul : Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp 4 ≤ (1 / 5 : ℝ) * Real.exp 4 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num; linarith
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_mul (Real.exp_pos 4)
      exact le_trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)) he_neg4
    have hd_yz_exp : Real.exp (-(M + 1)) ≤ d_yz := by
      have h_fac : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 - Real.exp (-M ^ 2) := by linarith
      calc
        Real.exp (-(M + 1))
          = Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp (-M) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
        _ ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-M ^ 2)) * d_y :=
            mul_le_mul h_fac h_exp_M (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith)
        _ ≤ d_yz := hd_yz_ge
    have hd_yz_pos : 0 < d_yz := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) hd_yz_exp
    have h_log_dyz : -Real.log d_yz ≤ M + 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hd_yz_exp
      rw [Real.log_exp] at this
      linarith
    have h_max_le : max (-Real.log d_yz) 0 ≤ M + 1 :=
      max_le h_log_dyz (by linarith)
    have hs_yz : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
      h_impact_maps j.val (y + z) hyz_reg.1
    have hf_cap := h_speed_cap _ hs_yz
    have hf_le : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (M + 2)) := by
      refine le_trans hf_cap (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      change C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log d_yz) 0) ≤ C_f * (M + 2)
      nlinarith
    have hf_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (y + z)‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero _ hyz_reg j)
    simpa only [Real.log_exp] using Real.log_le_log hf_pos hf_le

  
  have h_avg_logSpeed : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
        Real.circleAverage (fun w => Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val w‖) y (ρ y) =
          Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := by
    intro M ρ hAdm j y hy
    have hr : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall y |ρ y| ⊆ Ω_reg := by
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr] using (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).2
    have h_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val) (Metric.closedBall y |ρ y|) :=
      ((h_speed_holo j).analyticOnNhd P.reg_open).mono hcb
    exact h_ana.circleAverage_log_norm_of_ne_zero fun z hz => P.reg_speed_ne_zero z (hcb hz) j

  have h_avg_pos : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (ι : Fin 2), ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
        Real.circleAverage (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y (ρ y) =
          slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y ι := by
    intro M ρ hAdm j ι y hy
    have hr : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall y |ρ y| ⊆ Ω_reg := by
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr] using (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).2
    exact circleAverage_of_differentiable_on_off_countable Set.countable_empty
      ((h_pos_holo j ι).continuousOn.mono hcb) fun z hz =>
        h_pos_diffAt j ι z (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz.1))

  have h_avg_support : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
        Real.circleAverage (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y (ρ y) =
          sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y := by
    intro M ρ hAdm j y hy
    have hr : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall y |ρ y| ⊆ Ω_reg := by
      simpa [abs_of_nonneg hr] using (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).2
    exact circleAverage_of_differentiable_on_off_countable Set.countable_empty
      ((h_support_holo j).continuousOn.mono hcb) fun z hz =>
        (h_support_holo j).differentiableAt
          (P.reg_open.mem_nhds (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz.1)))

  
  have h_sin_le : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.sin, norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, RCLike.norm_ofNat]
    have h1 : ‖Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (-w * Complex.I).re = w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (w * Complex.I).re = -w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    have h_sub := norm_sub_le (Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp (w * Complex.I))
    linarith

  have h_cos_le : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖Complex.cos w‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.cos, norm_div, RCLike.norm_ofNat]
    have h1 : ‖Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (w * Complex.I).re = -w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (neg_le_abs _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hre : (-w * Complex.I).re = w.im := by simp
      rw [hre]
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (Complex.abs_im_le_norm w)
    have h_add := norm_add_le (Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I))
    linarith

  have h_imp_lin_le : ∀ {M : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ ≤
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y := by
    intro M ρ hAdm y hy z hz j
    let ds := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y
    let lin := deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z
    have h_tay : ‖ds - lin‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y :=
      hAdm.taylor_impact y hy z hz j
    have h_eq : lin = ds - (ds - lin) := by ring
    calc
      ‖lin‖ = ‖ds - (ds - lin)‖ := congrArg norm h_eq
      _ ≤ ‖ds‖ + ‖ds - lin‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y := by linarith

  have h_mod_step_sq : ∀ {M bG r_star : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      S.c * Real.exp r_star ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp bG →
      5 * bG ≤ M ^ 3 →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (ι : Fin 2),
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ r_star →
        -2 * bG < Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ →
        ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) ι - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y ι‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) *
            ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 +
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by
    intro M bG r_star ρ hAdm hc_le h5bG y hy z hz j ι h_ang h_mod
    have hM2 : 2 ≤ M := hAdm.scale_ge_two
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have hf_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j)
    have hf_gt : Real.exp (-2 * bG) < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := by
      simpa [Real.exp_log hf_pos] using Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h_mod
    have hf_inv_le : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp (2 * bG) := by
      have h_mul : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖⁻¹ * ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤
          Real.exp (2 * bG) * ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := by
        rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hf_pos.ne']
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) = Real.exp (2 * bG) * Real.exp (-2 * bG) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; norm_num
          _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * bG) * ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_gt.le (Real.exp_pos _).le
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h_mul hf_pos
    have hf_inv_sq : ‖(sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2‖ ≤ Real.exp (4 * bG) := by
      rw [norm_pow, norm_inv]
      calc
        (‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖⁻¹) ^ 2
          ≤ (Real.exp (2 * bG)) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hf_inv_le 2
        _ = Real.exp (4 * bG) := by rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h_deriv_coeff :
        ‖deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y * z‖ ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
      have h_trig : ‖if ι = 0 then Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)
          else Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp r_star := by
        split_ifs
        · exact le_trans (h_sin_le _) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_ang)
        · exact le_trans (h_cos_le _) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_ang)
      have h_dp := P.reg_deriv_pos y hy j
      have h_norm_dp : ‖deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y * z‖ ≤
          S.c * Real.exp (4 * bG) * Real.exp r_star *
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
        fin_cases ι
        · change ‖deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 0) y * z‖ ≤ _
          rw [h_dp.1]
          have h_sin_r : ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp r_star := by
            simpa using h_trig
          calc
            ‖-(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
                Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) *
                deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖
              = ‖(S.c : ℂ)‖ * ‖(sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2‖ *
                  ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
                rw [mul_assoc _ (deriv _ y) z, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_neg]
            _ = S.c * ‖(sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2‖ *
                  ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
                rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg S.c_pos.le]
            _ ≤ S.c * Real.exp (4 * bG) * Real.exp r_star *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_inv_sq S.c_pos.le)
                  h_sin_r (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        · change ‖deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w 1) y * z‖ ≤ _
          rw [h_dp.2]
          have h_cos_r : ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp r_star := by
            simpa using h_trig
          calc
            ‖(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
                Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) *
                deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖
              = S.c * ‖(sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2‖ *
                  ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
                rw [mul_assoc _ (deriv _ y) z, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul,
                  Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg S.c_pos.le]
            _ ≤ S.c * Real.exp (4 * bG) * Real.exp r_star *
                  ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
                refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul
                  (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf_inv_sq S.c_pos.le)
                  h_cos_r (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      refine le_trans h_norm_dp ?_
      have h_coeff : S.c * Real.exp (4 * bG) * Real.exp r_star ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) := by
        calc
          S.c * Real.exp (4 * bG) * Real.exp r_star
            = (S.c * Real.exp r_star) * Real.exp (4 * bG) := by ring
          _ ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp bG) * Real.exp (4 * bG) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) := by
              rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_coeff (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_tay_pos :
        ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) ι - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y ι -
            deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y * z‖ ≤
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y := by
      fin_cases ι
      · exact hAdm.taylor_pos₀ y hy z hz j
      · exact hAdm.taylor_pos₁ y hy z hz j
    let dX := slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) ι - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y ι
    let linX := deriv (fun w => slicePosSeq S P.N j.val w ι) y * z
    let ds := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y
    have hdX_eq : dX = linX + (dX - linX) := by ring
    have he1 : Real.exp (5 * bG) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have he2 : Real.exp (-M ^ 3) ≤ 1 := by
      have hM3_nn : 0 ≤ M ^ 3 := by positivity
      exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have h_imp_lin := h_imp_lin_le hAdm y hy z hz j
    have hdX_norm : ‖dX‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ y := by
      have h1 : ‖dX‖ ≤ ‖linX‖ + ‖dX - linX‖ :=
        (congrArg norm hdX_eq).trans_le (norm_add_le linX (dX - linX))
      have h2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) *
          (‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y) +
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ y := by
        have h_p1 : (Real.exp (5 * bG) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y ≤ 1 * ρ y :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he1 hρ_nn
        have h_p2 : Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤ 1 * ρ y :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he2 hρ_nn
        linarith
      have h3 : ‖linX‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) *
          (‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y) :=
        le_trans h_deriv_coeff (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_imp_lin (by positivity))
      linarith
    calc
      ‖dX‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ y) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hdX_norm 2
      _ ≤ 2 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖ds‖) ^ 2 +
            2 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ y) ^ 2 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (5 * bG) * ‖ds‖ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ρ y)]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (Real.exp (5 * bG)) ^ 2 * ‖ds‖ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) * ‖ds‖ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by
          rw [sq (Real.exp (5 * bG)), ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf

  have h_tiny_step_linear : ∀ {M bG r_star R : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ R →
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ r_star →
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ < -bG →
        ‖(R : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) *
            ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
          (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y := by
    intro M bG r_star R ρ hAdm y hy z hz j hR h_ang h_tiny
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hR
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have hf_pos : 0 < ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j)
    have hf_le : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ Real.exp (-bG) := by
      exact le_of_lt (by simpa [Real.exp_log hf_pos] using Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h_tiny)
    have hs_in_H : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
    have h_imp_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y :=
      (h_impact_holo j.val).differentiableAt ((h_horiz_open h_sl).mem_nhds hy.1)
    have h_ϕ_da : DifferentiableAt ℂ S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) :=
      S.ϕ_holo.differentiableAt ((h_horiz_open S.H).mem_nhds hs_in_H)
    have h_ang_deriv : deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y =
        sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y := by
      change deriv (S.ϕ ∘ sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y = _
      rw [deriv_comp y h_ϕ_da h_imp_da, S.deriv_ϕ _ hs_in_H]
      rfl
    have hX0_le : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ ≤ R :=
      le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y) 0) (by linarith)
    have hX1_le : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ ≤ R :=
      le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y) 1) (by linarith)
    have h_sin_r : ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp r_star :=
      le_trans (h_sin_le _) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_ang)
    have h_cos_r : ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp r_star :=
      le_trans (h_cos_le _) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_ang)
    have h_comb_le :
        ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
            slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          2 * R * Real.exp r_star := by
      have ht1 : ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          R * Real.exp r_star := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_neg]
        exact mul_le_mul hX0_le h_sin_r (norm_nonneg _) hR_pos.le
      have ht2 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          R * Real.exp r_star := by
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul hX1_le h_cos_r (norm_nonneg _) hR_pos.le
      have h_add := norm_add_le
        (-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y))
        (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y))
      linarith
    have h_sup_lin :
        ‖deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ ≤
          2 * R * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
      have h_eq_d : deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y * z =
          (-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
            slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)) *
          (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * (deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z)) := by
        rw [P.reg_deriv_support y hy j, h_ang_deriv]; ring
      rw [h_eq_d, norm_mul, norm_mul]
      calc
        ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
            slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ *
          (‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖)
          ≤ (2 * R * Real.exp r_star) *
              (Real.exp (-bG) * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖) := by
            refine mul_le_mul h_comb_le ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf_le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = 2 * R * (Real.exp r_star * Real.exp (-bG)) *
              ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by ring
        _ = 2 * R * Real.exp (r_star - bG) *
              ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add, sub_eq_add_neg]
    let dH := sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y
    let linH := deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y * z
    let ds := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y
    have h_tay_sup : ‖dH - linH‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y := by
      refine le_trans (hAdm.taylor_support y hy z hz j) ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR (by norm_num))
          (Real.exp_pos _).le) hρ_nn
    have hdH_eq : dH = linH + (dH - linH) := by ring
    have h_imp_lin := h_imp_lin_le hAdm y hy z hz j
    have hdH_norm :
        ‖dH‖ ≤ R * (2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * ‖ds‖ +
          (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y) := by
      have h1 : ‖dH‖ ≤ ‖linH‖ + ‖dH - linH‖ :=
        (congrArg norm hdH_eq).trans_le (norm_add_le linH (dH - linH))
      have h2 : ‖linH‖ ≤ 2 * R * Real.exp (r_star - bG) *
          (‖ds‖ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y) :=
        le_trans h_sup_lin (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_imp_lin (by positivity))
      linarith
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg hR_pos.le]
    calc
      R⁻¹ * ‖dH‖
        ≤ R⁻¹ * (R * (2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * ‖ds‖ +
            (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdH_norm (inv_nonneg.mpr hR_pos.le)
      _ = 2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * ‖ds‖ +
            (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y :=
          inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hR_pos.ne' _

  have h_tiny_step_norm : ∀ {M bG r_star R : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ R →
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ r_star →
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ < -bG →
        ‖(R : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * (S.H + 1) + 1 := by
    intro M bG r_star R ρ hAdm y hy z hz j hR h_ang h_tiny
    have hM2 : 2 ≤ M := hAdm.scale_ge_two
    have h_lin := h_tiny_step_linear hAdm y hy z hz j hR h_ang h_tiny
    have hρ_le_one : ρ y ≤ 1 := le_trans (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).1 (by norm_num)
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have heM2 : Real.exp (-M ^ 2) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
    have heM3 : Real.exp (-M ^ 3) ≤ 1 := by
      have hM3_nn : 0 ≤ M ^ 3 := by positivity
      exact Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have hd_le_H : sliceShapeDepth S P j y ≤ S.H := by
      dsimp [sliceShapeDepth]; linarith [abs_nonneg (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im]
    have hd_nn : 0 ≤ sliceShapeDepth S P j y := by
      have hs_H : |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| < S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
      dsimp [sliceShapeDepth]; linarith
    have hds_le : ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ S.H := by
      calc
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖
          ≤ Real.exp (-M ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j y := hAdm.small_shape_step y hy z hz j
        _ ≤ 1 * S.H := mul_le_mul heM2 hd_le_H hd_nn zero_le_one
        _ = S.H := one_mul _
    have h_rem_le : (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤
        Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2 := by
      have h_prod1 : Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤ 1 :=
        le_trans (mul_le_mul heM3 hρ_le_one hρ_nn zero_le_one) (by norm_num)
      calc
        (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
          = (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y) := by ring
        _ ≤ (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod1 (by positivity)
        _ = Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2 := mul_one _
    have h_main_le :
        2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) *
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤
        2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * S.H :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hds_le (by positivity)
    have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (r_star - bG) := Real.exp_pos _
    linarith

  have h_tiny_step_sq : ∀ {M bG r_star R : ℝ} {ρ : ℂ → ℝ}, IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ →
      0 < bG →
      2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) →
      Real.exp (-M ^ 3) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) →
      ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ R →
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ r_star →
        Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ < -bG →
        ‖(R : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
          Real.exp (-bG) *
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
              ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 +
             (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2) := by
    intro M bG r_star R ρ hAdm hbG h_exp1 h_exp2 y hy z hz j hR h_ang h_tiny
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have h_lin := h_tiny_step_linear hAdm y hy z hz j hR h_ang h_tiny
    have he_half_le : Real.exp (-bG / 2) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have h_coeff_one : Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
    let ds := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y
    have h_step_half :
        ‖(R : ℂ)⁻¹ * (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) * (‖ds‖ + ρ y) := by
      have ht1 : 2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * ‖ds‖ ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) * ‖ds‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_exp1 (norm_nonneg _)
      have ht2 : (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) * ρ y := by
        calc
          (Real.exp (r_star - bG) + 1 / 2) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y
            ≤ 1 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2)) * ρ y := by
              refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hρ_nn
              exact mul_le_mul h_coeff_one h_exp2 (Real.exp_pos _).le zero_le_one
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) * ρ y := by ring
      linarith
    calc
      ‖(R : ℂ)⁻¹ * (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ^ 2
        ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) * (‖ds‖ + ρ y)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_step_half 2
      _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-bG / 2)) ^ 2 * (‖ds‖ + ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (Real.exp (-bG / 2)) ^ 2 * (2 * ‖ds‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (ρ y) ^ 2) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖ds‖ - ρ y)]
      _ = (Real.exp (-bG / 2)) ^ 2 * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ds‖ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = Real.exp (-bG) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ds‖ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ y) ^ 2) := by
          rw [sq (Real.exp (-bG / 2)), ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf

  
  
  
  let η₀ : ℝ := min η (min (γ - ρ₂) γ)
  have hη₀_pos : 0 < η₀ :=
    lt_min hη_pos (lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hρ₂_lt) (lt_trans hρ₂_pos hρ₂_lt))
  let C_log : ℝ := max 0 (Real.log (max 4 (2 * S.c)))
  have hC_log_nn : 0 ≤ C_log := le_max_left _ _
  have hlog2_pos : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hC_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk := hBase.C_clk_pos
  let D_big : ℝ :=
    1 + (C_init + 1) / b +
      6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) +
      (2 + 2 * C_log) / b +
      (5 * b + Real.log 2) +
      3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) +
      9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ)
  have hD_big_ge_one : 1 ≤ D_big := by
    have t1 : 0 ≤ (C_init + 1) / b := by positivity
    have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
    have t3 : 0 ≤ (2 + 2 * C_log) / b := by positivity
    have t4 : 0 ≤ 5 * b + Real.log 2 := by positivity
    have t5 : 0 ≤ 3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
    have t6 : 0 ≤ 9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
    dsimp [D_big]; linarith
  have hD_big_pos : 0 < D_big := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hD_big_ge_one
  let ε_star : ℝ := D_big⁻¹
  have hε_star_pos : 0 < ε_star := inv_pos.mpr hD_big_pos
  have h_le_of_le_D : ∀ K_req : ℝ, K_req ≤ D_big → K_req * ε_star ≤ 1 := by
    intro K_req hK
    calc
      K_req * ε_star ≤ D_big * D_big⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (inv_nonneg.mpr hD_big_pos.le)
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hD_big_pos.ne'
  have h_le_mul_of_div : ∀ {A B : ℝ}, 0 < B → A / B ≤ D_big → A * ε_star ≤ B := by
    intro A B hB hAB
    have hk : (A / B) * ε_star ≤ 1 := h_le_of_le_D (A / B) hAB
    calc
      A * ε_star = ((A / B) * ε_star) * B := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_right_comm (A * B⁻¹) ε_star B, mul_assoc A B⁻¹ B,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ hB.ne', mul_one]
      _ ≤ 1 * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk hB.le
      _ = B := one_mul B
  obtain ⟨M_eps, hM_eps⟩ :=
    Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
      ((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hη₀_pos).eventually (ge_mem_nhds hε_star_pos))
  refine ⟨max 2 M_eps, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro M hM₂_le ρ hAdm
  have hM_ge_two : 2 ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hM₂_le
  have hMeps_le : M_eps ≤ M := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hM₂_le
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hM_ge_one : 1 ≤ M := by linarith
  have hM_neg_η₀ : M ^ (-η₀) ≤ ε_star := hM_eps M hMeps_le
  have h_gap : ∀ α β : ℝ, α + η₀ ≤ β → M ^ α ≤ ε_star * M ^ β := by
    intro α β hαβ
    have h1 : M ^ (α - β) ≤ M ^ (-η₀) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hM_ge_one (by linarith)
    have h2 : M ^ (α - β) ≤ ε_star := le_trans h1 hM_neg_η₀
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hM_pos.le β)
    rwa [← Real.rpow_add hM_pos, sub_add_cancel] at h3

  let G_scale : ℝ := M ^ γ
  let bG : ℝ := b * G_scale
  let r_star : ℝ := M ^ ρ₂
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := lt_trans hρ₂_pos hρ₂_lt
  have hG_ge_one : 1 ≤ G_scale := Real.one_le_rpow hM_ge_one hγ_pos.le
  have hbG_pos : 0 < bG := mul_pos hb_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hG_ge_one)
  have h_one_le_eps_G : 1 ≤ ε_star * G_scale := by
    have h0 : η₀ ≤ γ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    simpa [G_scale] using h_gap 0 γ (by linarith)
  have hr_star_le_eps_G : r_star ≤ ε_star * G_scale := by
    have h1 : η₀ ≤ γ - ρ₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    exact h_gap ρ₂ γ (by linarith)
  have hG_le_eps_M3 : G_scale ≤ ε_star * M ^ (3 : ℕ) := by
    have h1 : η₀ ≤ γ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h_rpow : G_scale ≤ ε_star * M ^ (3 : ℝ) := h_gap γ 3 (by linarith)
    simpa [Real.rpow_natCast] using h_rpow
  have hM_neg_η : M ^ (-η) ≤ ε_star := by
    have h1 : η₀ ≤ η := min_le_left _ _
    exact le_trans (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hM_ge_one (by linarith)) hM_neg_η₀

  
  have h_mod_init_cond : -2 * bG < -C_init := by
    have h_mul : (C_init + 1) * ε_star ≤ b := by
      apply h_le_mul_of_div hb_pos
      have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t3 : 0 ≤ (2 + 2 * C_log) / b := by positivity
      have t4 : 0 ≤ 5 * b + Real.log 2 := by positivity
      have t5 : 0 ≤ 3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t6 : 0 ≤ 9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    have hbG_ge : C_init + 1 ≤ bG := by
      calc
        C_init + 1 ≤ (C_init + 1) * (ε_star * G_scale) :=
          le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) h_one_le_eps_G
        _ = ((C_init + 1) * ε_star) * G_scale := by ring
        _ ≤ b * G_scale := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
    linarith

  have h_rstar_Clog_le : r_star + C_log ≤ bG / 2 := by
    have h_mul : (2 + 2 * C_log) * ε_star ≤ b := by
      apply h_le_mul_of_div hb_pos
      have t1 : 0 ≤ (C_init + 1) / b := by positivity
      have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t4 : 0 ≤ 5 * b + Real.log 2 := by positivity
      have t5 : 0 ≤ 3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t6 : 0 ≤ 9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    have ht1 : C_log ≤ C_log * (ε_star * G_scale) :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_right hC_log_nn h_one_le_eps_G
    have ht2 : ((2 + 2 * C_log) * ε_star) * G_scale ≤ b * G_scale :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
    dsimp [bG]
    linarith

  have h_Sc_exp_cond : S.c * Real.exp r_star ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp bG := by
    have h_2Sc : 2 * S.c ≤ Real.exp C_log := by
      have h_max_pos : 0 < max 4 (2 * S.c) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)
      calc
        2 * S.c ≤ max 4 (2 * S.c) := le_max_right _ _
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log (max 4 (2 * S.c))) := (Real.exp_log h_max_pos).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp C_log := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_max_right _ _)
    have h_prod : 2 * S.c * Real.exp r_star ≤ Real.exp bG := by
      calc
        2 * S.c * Real.exp r_star
          ≤ Real.exp C_log * Real.exp r_star :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_2Sc (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (r_star + C_log) := by rw [← Real.exp_add, add_comm]
        _ ≤ Real.exp bG := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith

  have h_tiny_exp1_cond : 2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) := by
    have h_4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp C_log := by
      have h_max_pos : 0 < max 4 (2 * S.c) := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)
      calc
        (4 : ℝ) ≤ max 4 (2 * S.c) := le_max_left _ _
        _ = Real.exp (Real.log (max 4 (2 * S.c))) := (Real.exp_log h_max_pos).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp C_log := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_max_right _ _)
    have h_prod : 4 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) ≤ Real.exp (-bG / 2) := by
      calc
        4 * Real.exp (r_star - bG)
          ≤ Real.exp C_log * Real.exp (r_star - bG) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_4 (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (r_star + C_log - bG) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-bG / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    linarith

  have h_5bG_M3_both : 5 * bG + Real.log 2 ≤ M ^ 3 := by
    have h_mul : (5 * b + Real.log 2) * ε_star ≤ 1 := by
      apply h_le_of_le_D
      have t1 : 0 ≤ (C_init + 1) / b := by positivity
      have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t3 : 0 ≤ (2 + 2 * C_log) / b := by positivity
      have t5 : 0 ≤ 3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t6 : 0 ≤ 9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    calc
      5 * bG + Real.log 2
        ≤ 5 * b * G_scale + Real.log 2 * G_scale := by
          dsimp [bG]
          linarith [le_mul_of_one_le_right hlog2_pos.le hG_ge_one]
      _ = (5 * b + Real.log 2) * G_scale := by ring
      _ ≤ (5 * b + Real.log 2) * (ε_star * M ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG_le_eps_M3 (by positivity)
      _ = ((5 * b + Real.log 2) * ε_star) * M ^ 3 := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * M ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
      _ = M ^ 3 := one_mul _

  have h_5bG_cond : 5 * bG ≤ M ^ 3 := by linarith
  have h_tiny_exp2_cond : Real.exp (-M ^ 3) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) := by
    have h_arg : -M ^ 3 ≤ -Real.log 2 + (-bG / 2) := by linarith
    calc
      Real.exp (-M ^ 3)
        ≤ Real.exp (-Real.log 2 + (-bG / 2)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_arg
      _ = (Real.exp (Real.log 2))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-bG / 2) := by
          rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-bG / 2) := by
          rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]; norm_num

  
  
  
  have hρ_meas : Measurable ρ := hAdm.measurable
  have hρ_nn : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg
  have h_walk_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ k : ℕ, walkPos ρ om k ∈ Ω_reg :=
    fun om k => (hBase.walk_in_reg M ρ hAdm om k).1
  have h_cball : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg :=
    fun y hy => (h_adm_cball hAdm y hy).2

  let prefDet : ∀ {α : Type}, ℕ → (WalkSpace → α) → Prop :=
    fun n F => ∀ om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace, (∀ k ≤ n, om₁ k = om₂ k) → F om₁ = F om₂

  have h_walk_mp : ∀ m : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) ∧
      prefDet m (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        refine ⟨Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0), ?_⟩
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [walkPos, h_eq 0 le_rfl]
    | succ n ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨hm_n, hp_n⟩
        have h_exp : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
            ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply (n + 1))).mul measurable_const)
        refine ⟨hm_n.add ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hρ_meas.comp hm_n)).mul h_exp), ?_⟩
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have hn_eq : walkPos ρ om₁ n = walkPos ρ om₂ n :=
          hp_n om₁ om₂ fun k hk => h_eq k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
        simp [walkPos, hn_eq, h_eq (n + 1) le_rfl]

  have h_obs : ∀ {E : Type} [TopologicalSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
      (F : ℂ → E) (m : ℕ),
      ContinuousOn F Ω_reg →
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => F (walkPos ρ om m)) ∧
      prefDet m (fun om : WalkSpace => F (walkPos ρ om m)) := by
    intro E _ _ _ F m hF
    have h_dom : Continuous (Ω_reg.domRestrict F) :=
      continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hF
    have h_sub : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        (⟨walkPos ρ om m, h_walk_reg om m⟩ : Ω_reg)) :=
      (h_walk_mp m).1.subtype_mk
    refine ⟨h_dom.measurable.comp h_sub, ?_⟩
    intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
    exact congrArg F ((h_walk_mp m).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq)

  have h_decide_meas : ∀ (p : WalkSpace → Prop) {inst : DecidablePred p},
      MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | p om} →
      Measurable (fun om => @decide (p om) (inst om)) := by
    intro p inst hp
    refine measurable_to_countable' fun b_val => ?_
    cases b_val
    · have : (fun om => @decide (p om) (inst om)) ⁻¹' {false} = {om | p om}ᶜ := by
        ext om; simp
      rw [this]; exact hp.compl
    · have : (fun om => @decide (p om) (inst om)) ⁻¹' {true} = {om | p om} := by
        ext om; simp
      rw [this]; exact hp

  let extZero : (n : ℕ) → (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → WalkSpace :=
    fun n u k => if hk : k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) then u ⟨k, hk⟩ else 0
  have h_extZero_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (extZero n) := by
    intro n
    refine Measurable.of_eval fun k => ?_
    by_cases hk : k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1)
    · simp only [extZero, dif_pos hk]
      exact measurable_pi_apply (⟨k, hk⟩ : Finset.range (n + 1))
    · simp only [extZero, dif_neg hk]
      exact measurable_const
  have h_extZero_restrict : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) (k : ℕ), k ≤ n →
      extZero n ((Finset.range (n + 1)).restrict om) k = om k := by
    intro n om k hk
    have hk' : k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)
    dsimp only [extZero]
    rw [dif_pos hk']
    rfl

  have h_one_step_complex : ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (Φ : WalkSpace → ℂ) (H : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ C →
      Measurable Φ → prefDet n Φ →
      ContinuousOn H Ω_reg →
      (∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Real.circleAverage H y (ρ y) = H y) →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace,
        ‖Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ C) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n)))
        walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
    intro n C Φ H hC hΦ_meas hΦ_pref hH_cont hH_avg h_bound
    let S_idx : Finset ℕ := Finset.range (n + 1)
    let X_pref : WalkSpace → (S_idx → ℝ) := S_idx.restrict
    let X_next : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => om (n + 1)
    have hX_pref_meas : Measurable X_pref :=
      Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1
    have hX_next_meas : Measurable X_next := measurable_pi_apply (n + 1)
    have hH_dom : Continuous (Ω_reg.domRestrict H) :=
      continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict.mp hH_cont
    let y_fn : (S_idx → ℝ) → ℂ := fun u => walkPos ρ (extZero n u) n
    have hy_meas : Measurable y_fn := (h_walk_mp n).1.comp (h_extZero_meas n)
    have hy_reg : ∀ u : S_idx → ℝ, y_fn u ∈ Ω_reg := fun u => h_walk_reg (extZero n u) n
    have h_cmap_reg : ∀ q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ,
        circleMap (y_fn q.1) (ρ (y_fn q.1)) q.2 ∈ Ω_reg := by
      intro q
      apply h_cball _ (hy_reg q.1)
      have hr : 0 ≤ ρ (y_fn q.1) := hρ_nn _
      simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hr]
    let F_prod : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ → ℂ := fun q =>
      Φ (extZero n q.1) *
        (H (circleMap (y_fn q.1) (ρ (y_fn q.1)) q.2) - H (y_fn q.1))
    have hF_prod_meas : Measurable F_prod := by
      have h1 : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ => Φ (extZero n q.1)) :=
        (hΦ_meas.comp (h_extZero_meas n)).comp measurable_fst
      have h_cm : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ =>
          circleMap (y_fn q.1) (ρ (y_fn q.1)) q.2) := by
        simp only [circleMap]
        have hy1 : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ => y_fn q.1) :=
          hy_meas.comp measurable_fst
        exact hy1.add
          ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hρ_meas.comp hy1)).mul
            (Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
              ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)))
      have h2 : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ =>
          H (circleMap (y_fn q.1) (ρ (y_fn q.1)) q.2)) :=
        hH_dom.measurable.comp (h_cm.subtype_mk (h := h_cmap_reg))
      have h3 : Measurable (fun q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ => H (y_fn q.1)) :=
        hH_dom.measurable.comp ((hy_meas.comp measurable_fst).subtype_mk (h := fun q => hy_reg q.1))
      exact h1.mul (h2.sub h3)
    have hF_prod_eq_upd : ∀ (u : S_idx → ℝ) (θ : ℝ),
        F_prod (u, θ) =
          let om' := Function.update (extZero n u) (n + 1) θ
          Φ om' * (H (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om' n)) := by
      intro u θ
      let om' := Function.update (extZero n u) (n + 1) θ
      have h_le : ∀ k ≤ n, om' k = extZero n u k := by
        intro k hk
        exact Function.update_of_ne (by omega) _ _
      have hΦ_eq : Φ om' = Φ (extZero n u) := hΦ_pref om' (extZero n u) h_le
      have hy_eq : walkPos ρ om' n = y_fn u := (h_walk_mp n).2 om' (extZero n u) h_le
      have hy1_eq : walkPos ρ om' (n + 1) = circleMap (y_fn u) (ρ (y_fn u)) θ := by
        simp [walkPos, circleMap, hy_eq, om']
      dsimp only [F_prod]
      rw [← hΦ_eq, ← hy1_eq, ← hy_eq]
    have hF_prod_bound : ∀ q : (S_idx → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖F_prod q‖ ≤ C := by
      intro ⟨u, θ⟩
      rw [hF_prod_eq_upd u θ]
      exact h_bound _
    have hF_comp : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
        F_prod (X_pref om, X_next om) =
          Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
      intro om
      have h_le : ∀ k ≤ n, extZero n (X_pref om) k = om k := h_extZero_restrict n om
      have hΦ_eq : Φ (extZero n (X_pref om)) = Φ om := hΦ_pref _ _ h_le
      have hy_eq : y_fn (X_pref om) = walkPos ρ om n := (h_walk_mp n).2 _ _ h_le
      have hy1_eq : circleMap (y_fn (X_pref om)) (ρ (y_fn (X_pref om))) (X_next om) =
          walkPos ρ om (n + 1) := by
        simp [walkPos, circleMap, hy_eq, X_next]
      dsimp only [F_prod]
      rw [hΦ_eq, hy1_eq, hy_eq]
    have h_step_meas : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n))) := by
      have : (fun om : WalkSpace => Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n))) =
          fun om => F_prod (X_pref om, X_next om) := by
        funext om; exact (hF_comp om).symm
      rw [this]
      exact hF_prod_meas.comp (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas)
    have h_step_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n)))
        walkMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_step_meas.aestronglyMeasurable C
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_bound)
    refine ⟨h_step_int, ?_⟩
    have h_indep : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun (i : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) => om i)
        walkMeasure :=
      ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun_infinitePi (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => measurable_id)
    have h_disj : Disjoint S_idx ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by simp [S_idx]
    have h_fin := h_indep.indepFun_finset S_idx {n + 1} h_disj
      (fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _)
    have h_pair : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X_pref X_next walkMeasure := by
      have hp0 := h_fin.comp measurable_id
        (measurable_pi_apply ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩)
      have h_eq1 : (id ∘ fun (a : WalkSpace) (i : S_idx) => a ↑i) = X_pref := rfl
      have h_eq2 : ((fun f : ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ) → ℝ =>
          f ⟨n + 1, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩) ∘
          fun (a : WalkSpace) (i : ({n + 1} : Finset ℕ)) => a ↑i) = X_next := rfl
      rwa [h_eq1, h_eq2] at hp0
    let μ_pref := walkMeasure.map X_pref
    have hProbPref : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ_pref :=
      ⟨by rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.map_apply hX_pref_meas MeasurableSet.univ]; simp⟩
    have h_map_prod : walkMeasure.map (fun om => (X_pref om, X_next om)) =
        μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure := by
      rw [(ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
        hX_pref_meas.aemeasurable hX_next_meas.aemeasurable).mp h_pair]
      congr 1
      exact MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi_map_eval (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure) (n + 1)
    have hF_int_prod : MeasureTheory.Integrable F_prod (μ_pref.prod unifTwoPiMeasure) :=
      MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hF_prod_meas.aestronglyMeasurable C
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF_prod_bound)
    have h_eq_int : (∫ om, Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n)) ∂walkMeasure) =
        ∫ q, F_prod q ∂(walkMeasure.map (fun om => (X_pref om, X_next om))) := by
      have h_lhs : (fun om : WalkSpace => Φ om * (H (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - H (walkPos ρ om n))) =
          fun om => F_prod (X_pref om, X_next om) := by
        funext om; exact (hF_comp om).symm
      rw [h_lhs]
      exact (MeasureTheory.integral_map (hX_pref_meas.prodMk hX_next_meas).aemeasurable
        hF_prod_meas.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    rw [h_eq_int, h_map_prod, MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hF_int_prod]
    have h_inner : ∀ u : S_idx → ℝ, (∫ θ, F_prod (u, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
      intro u
      let y := y_fn u
      have hy : y ∈ Ω_reg := hy_reg u
      have hy_cb : Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := h_cball y hy
      have hr : 0 ≤ ρ y := hρ_nn y
      have h_cm_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) := by
        intro θ
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hr]
      have h_cm_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => H (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) :=
        (hH_cont.mono hy_cb).comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap y (ρ y)) h_cm_mem
      obtain ⟨M_H, hM_H⟩ :=
        (isCompact_closedBall y (ρ y)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hH_cont.mono hy_cb)
      have h_cm_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun θ : ℝ => H (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_cm_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable M_H
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => hM_H _ (h_cm_mem θ))
      change (∫ θ, Φ (extZero n u) * (H (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) - H y) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_cm_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (H y))]
      have h_c_int : (∫ θ, H (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = H y := by
        rw [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure,
          MeasureTheory.restrict_Ico_eq_restrict_Ioc]
        have h_toR : ((ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹).toReal = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := by
          rw [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.two_pi_pos.le]
        rw [h_toR, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le Real.two_pi_pos.le]
        simpa [Real.circleAverage_def] using hH_avg y hy
      have h_const : (∫ _ : ℝ, H y ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = H y := by simp
      rw [h_c_int, h_const, sub_self, mul_zero]
    simp [h_inner]

  have h_zero_mean_real : ∀ (N_cap : ℕ) (B_step : ℝ) (mask : ℕ → WalkSpace → Bool) (g : ℂ → ℝ),
      0 ≤ B_step →
      ContinuousOn g Ω_reg →
      (∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Real.circleAverage g y (ρ y) = g y) →
      (∀ n < N_cap, Measurable (mask n) ∧ prefDet n (mask n)) →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n < N_cap, mask n om = true →
        |g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - g (walkPos ρ om n)| ≤ B_step) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
          if mask n om then -g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) + g (walkPos ρ om n) else 0)
        walkMeasure ∧
      (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
        if mask n om then -g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) + g (walkPos ρ om n) else 0)
        ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
    intro N_cap B_step mask g hB_nn hg_cont hg_avg hmask h_step_bd
    let gC : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (g w : ℂ)
    have hgC_cont : ContinuousOn gC Ω_reg :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hg_cont
    have hgC_avg : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Real.circleAverage gC y (ρ y) = gC y := by
      intro y hy
      have hr : 0 ≤ ρ y := hρ_nn y
      have hy_cb : Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := h_cball y hy
      have h_cm_mem : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap y (ρ y) θ ∈ Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) := by
        intro θ
        simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, circleMap, abs_of_nonneg hr]
      have h_cm_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) :=
        (hg_cont.mono hy_cb).comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap y (ρ y)) h_cm_mem
      have h_ii : IntervalIntegrable (fun θ : ℝ => g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ))
          MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
        h_cm_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
      let I_real : ℝ := ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)
      have h_comm0 :
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.ofRealCLM (g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ))) =
            Complex.ofRealCLM I_real :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
          (f := fun θ => g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ)) h_ii
      have h_comm : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) : ℂ)) =
          (I_real : ℂ) := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply] using h_comm0
      calc
        Real.circleAverage gC y (ρ y)
          = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (g (circleMap y (ρ y) θ) : ℂ) :=
            Real.circleAverage_def
        _ = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ • (I_real : ℂ) := by rw [h_comm]
        _ = Complex.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_real) := by
            rw [Complex.real_smul, Complex.ofReal_mul]
        _ = Complex.ofReal (Real.circleAverage g y (ρ y)) := by
            dsimp only [I_real]
            rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul]
        _ = gC y := by rw [hg_avg y hy]
    have h_each : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            if mask n om then -g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) + g (walkPos ρ om n) else 0)
          walkMeasure ∧
        (∫ om, (if mask n om then -g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) + g (walkPos ρ om n) else 0)
          ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
      intro n hn
      have hn_lt : n < N_cap := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
      let Φ_n : WalkSpace → ℂ := fun om => if mask n om then (-1 : ℂ) else 0
      have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ_n :=
        (measurable_of_countable (fun b_val : Bool => if b_val then (-1 : ℂ) else 0)).comp
          (hmask n hn_lt).1
      have hΦ_pref : prefDet n Φ_n := by
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [Φ_n, (hmask n hn_lt).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq]
      have hΦ_bd : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
          ‖Φ_n om * (gC (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - gC (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ B_step := by
        intro om
        cases h_b : mask n om
        · simp [Φ_n, h_b, hB_nn]
        · have h_abs := h_step_bd om n hn_lt h_b
          have h_norm : ‖Φ_n om * (gC (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - gC (walkPos ρ om n))‖ =
              |g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - g (walkPos ρ om n)| := by
            simp [Φ_n, h_b, gC, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real]
          linarith
      rcases h_one_step_complex n B_step Φ_n gC hB_nn hΦ_meas hΦ_pref hgC_cont hgC_avg hΦ_bd with
        ⟨h_int_C, h_zero_C⟩
      have h_re_eq : (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            if mask n om then -g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) + g (walkPos ρ om n) else 0) =
          fun om => Complex.reCLM (Φ_n om * (gC (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - gC (walkPos ρ om n))) := by
        funext om
        cases h_b : mask n om <;> simp [Φ_n, h_b, gC] <;> ring
      rw [h_re_eq]
      refine ⟨Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp h_int_C, ?_⟩
      rw [Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm h_int_C, h_zero_C, map_zero]
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum _ fun n hn => (h_each n hn).1, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ fun n hn => (h_each n hn).1]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => (h_each n hn).2

  have h_l2_maximal : ∀ (N_cap : ℕ) (B_step lam : ℝ) (coeff : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 ≤ B_step → 0 < lam →
      ContinuousOn G Ω_reg →
      (∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Real.circleAverage G y (ρ y) = G y) →
      (∀ n < N_cap, Measurable (coeff n) ∧ prefDet n (coeff n)) →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n < N_cap,
        ‖coeff n om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ B_step) →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ N_cap,
          lam < ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
            coeff n om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))‖} ≤
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
          ∫ om, ‖coeff n om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ^ 2
            ∂walkMeasure) / lam ^ 2 := by
    intro N_cap B_step lam coeff G hB_nn hlam hG_cont hG_avg hcoeff h_step_bd
    let Δ : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
      coeff n om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))
    let W : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun m om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, Δ n om
    have hΔ_mp : ∀ n < N_cap, Measurable (Δ n) ∧ prefDet (n + 1) (Δ n) := by
      intro n hn
      have h1 := h_obs G (n + 1) hG_cont
      have h0 := h_obs G n hG_cont
      refine ⟨(hcoeff n hn).1.mul (h1.1.sub h0.1), ?_⟩
      intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have hc : coeff n om₁ = coeff n om₂ :=
        (hcoeff n hn).2 om₁ om₂ fun k hk => h_eq k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
      have hg1 : G (walkPos ρ om₁ (n + 1)) = G (walkPos ρ om₂ (n + 1)) := h1.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have hg0 : G (walkPos ρ om₁ n) = G (walkPos ρ om₂ n) :=
        h0.2 om₁ om₂ fun k hk => h_eq k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
      simp [Δ, hc, hg1, hg0]
    have hW_mp : ∀ m ≤ N_cap,
        Measurable (W m) ∧ prefDet m (W m) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖W m om‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) * B_step := by
      intro m hm
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun n hn =>
          (hΔ_mp n (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm)).1
      · intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
        have hn_lt : n < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
        exact (hΔ_mp n (lt_of_lt_of_le hn_lt hm)).2 om₁ om₂ fun k hk =>
          h_eq k (le_trans hk hn_lt)
      · intro om
        calc
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, Δ n om‖
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, ‖Δ n om‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range m, B_step :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn =>
                h_step_bd om n (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm)
          _ = (m : ℝ) * B_step := by simp
    let notHit : ℕ → WalkSpace → Bool := fun n om =>
      decide (∀ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W l om‖ ≤ lam)
    have h_notHit_mp : ∀ n < N_cap, Measurable (notHit n) ∧ prefDet n (notHit n) := by
      intro n hn
      have h_set_eq : {om : WalkSpace | ∀ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W l om‖ ≤ lam} =
          ⋂ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), {om : WalkSpace | ‖W l om‖ ≤ lam} := by
        ext om; simp
      have h_ms : MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | ∀ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W l om‖ ≤ lam} := by
        rw [h_set_eq]
        refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l hl => ?_
        have hl_le : l ≤ N_cap := le_trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)) hn.le
        exact isClosed_Iic.measurableSet.preimage (hW_mp l hl_le).1.norm
      refine ⟨h_decide_meas _ h_ms, ?_⟩
      intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have h_iff : (∀ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W l om₁‖ ≤ lam) ↔
          (∀ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W l om₂‖ ≤ lam) := by
        refine forall₂_congr fun l hl => ?_
        have hl_le_n : l ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
        have hl_le_N : l ≤ N_cap := le_trans hl_le_n hn.le
        rw [(hW_mp l hl_le_N).2.1 om₁ om₂ fun k hk => h_eq k (le_trans hk hl_le_n)]
      dsimp only [notHit]
      exact decide_eq_decide.mpr h_iff
    let Δ_tilde : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
      if notHit n om then Δ n om else 0
    let W_tilde : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun m om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, Δ_tilde n om
    have hΔ_tilde_mp : ∀ n < N_cap,
        Measurable (Δ_tilde n) ∧ prefDet (n + 1) (Δ_tilde n) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ≤ B_step := by
      intro n hn
      have h_meas : Measurable (Δ_tilde n) := by
        have h_eq : Δ_tilde n = fun om =>
            (if notHit n om then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * Δ n om := by
          funext om; dsimp only [Δ_tilde]; cases notHit n om <;> simp
        rw [h_eq]
        exact ((measurable_of_countable (fun b_val : Bool => if b_val then (1 : ℂ) else 0)).comp
          (h_notHit_mp n hn).1).mul (hΔ_mp n hn).1
      refine ⟨h_meas, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have h1 : notHit n om₁ = notHit n om₂ :=
          (h_notHit_mp n hn).2 om₁ om₂ fun k hk => h_eq k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)
        have h2 : Δ n om₁ = Δ n om₂ := (hΔ_mp n hn).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [Δ_tilde, h1, h2]
      · intro om
        cases h_b : notHit n om
        · simp [Δ_tilde, h_b, hB_nn]
        · have h_eq_d : Δ_tilde n om = Δ n om := by simp [Δ_tilde, h_b]
          rw [h_eq_d]
          exact h_step_bd om n hn
    have hW_tilde_mp : ∀ m ≤ N_cap,
        Measurable (W_tilde m) ∧ prefDet m (W_tilde m) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, ‖W_tilde m om‖ ≤ (m : ℝ) * B_step := by
      intro m hm
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun n hn =>
          (hΔ_tilde_mp n (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm)).1
      · intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
        have hn_lt : n < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
        exact (hΔ_tilde_mp n (lt_of_lt_of_le hn_lt hm)).2.1 om₁ om₂ fun k hk =>
          h_eq k (le_trans hk hn_lt)
      · intro om
        calc
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, Δ_tilde n om‖
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range m, B_step :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn =>
                (hΔ_tilde_mp n (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm)).2.2 om
          _ = (m : ℝ) * B_step := by simp
    have h_orth : ∀ m ≤ N_cap,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖W_tilde m om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
        (∫ om, ‖W_tilde m om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, ∫ om, ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
          intro _
          have h_zero_fn : (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖W_tilde 0 om‖ ^ 2) = fun _ => 0 := by
            funext om; simp [W_tilde]
          rw [h_zero_fn]
          simp
      | succ n ih =>
          intro hn_succ
          have hn : n < N_cap := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hn_succ
          rcases ih hn.le with ⟨hInt_W, hEq_W⟩
          have hΔ_sq_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun om => ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
            have hm_sq : Measurable (fun om => ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2) :=
              ((hΔ_tilde_mp n hn).1.norm).pow_const 2
            refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hm_sq.aestronglyMeasurable (B_step ^ 2)
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
            exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ((hΔ_tilde_mp n hn).2.2 om) 2
          let Φ_cross : WalkSpace → ℂ := fun om =>
            (if notHit n om then coeff n om else 0) * starRingEnd ℂ (W_tilde n om)
          have hΦ_cross_meas : Measurable Φ_cross := by
            have h_c : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => if notHit n om then coeff n om else 0) := by
              have : (fun om : WalkSpace => if notHit n om then coeff n om else 0) =
                  fun om => (if notHit n om then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * coeff n om := by
                funext om; cases notHit n om <;> simp
              rw [this]
              exact ((measurable_of_countable (fun b_val : Bool => if b_val then (1 : ℂ) else 0)).comp
                (h_notHit_mp n hn).1).mul (hcoeff n hn).1
            exact h_c.mul (Complex.continuous_conj.measurable.comp (hW_tilde_mp n hn.le).1)
          have hΦ_cross_pref : prefDet n Φ_cross := by
            intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
            simp [Φ_cross, (h_notHit_mp n hn).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq,
              (hcoeff n hn).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq, (hW_tilde_mp n hn.le).2.1 om₁ om₂ h_eq]
          have hΦ_cross_bd : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
              ‖Φ_cross om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤
                (n : ℝ) * B_step ^ 2 := by
            intro om
            have h_prod_eq : Φ_cross om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n)) =
                Δ_tilde n om * starRingEnd ℂ (W_tilde n om) := by
              cases h_b : notHit n om <;>
                simp [Φ_cross, Δ_tilde, Δ, h_b, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
            rw [h_prod_eq, norm_mul, RCLike.norm_conj]
            calc
              ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ * ‖W_tilde n om‖
                ≤ B_step * ((n : ℝ) * B_step) :=
                  mul_le_mul ((hΔ_tilde_mp n hn).2.2 om) ((hW_tilde_mp n hn.le).2.2 om)
                    (norm_nonneg _) hB_nn
              _ = (n : ℝ) * B_step ^ 2 := by ring
          rcases h_one_step_complex n ((n : ℝ) * B_step ^ 2) Φ_cross G (by positivity)
            hΦ_cross_meas hΦ_cross_pref hG_cont hG_avg hΦ_cross_bd with ⟨hInt_C, hZero_C⟩
          let cross_re : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om =>
            2 * Complex.reCLM (Φ_cross om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n)))
          have h_cross_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable cross_re walkMeasure :=
            (Complex.reCLM.integrable_comp hInt_C).const_mul 2
          have h_cross_zero : (∫ om, cross_re om ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
            dsimp only [cross_re]
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hInt_C,
              hZero_C, map_zero, mul_zero]
          have h_expand : (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖W_tilde (n + 1) om‖ ^ 2) =
              fun om => (‖W_tilde n om‖ ^ 2 + cross_re om) + ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2 := by
            funext om
            have h_sum : W_tilde (n + 1) om = W_tilde n om + Δ_tilde n om :=
              Finset.sum_range_succ _ n
            have h_inner_eq : inner ℝ (W_tilde n om) (Δ_tilde n om) =
                Complex.reCLM (Φ_cross om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n))) := by
              have h_prod_eq : Φ_cross om * (G (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - G (walkPos ρ om n)) =
                  Δ_tilde n om * starRingEnd ℂ (W_tilde n om) := by
                cases h_b : notHit n om <;>
                  simp [Φ_cross, Δ_tilde, Δ, h_b, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]
              rw [h_prod_eq]
              simp [Complex.inner]
            rw [h_sum, norm_add_sq_real, h_inner_eq]
          rw [h_expand]
          have hInt_W_cr : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun om => ‖W_tilde n om‖ ^ 2 + cross_re om) walkMeasure :=
            hInt_W.add h_cross_int
          refine ⟨hInt_W_cr.add hΔ_sq_int, ?_⟩
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hInt_W_cr hΔ_sq_int,
            MeasureTheory.integral_add hInt_W h_cross_int,
            hEq_W, h_cross_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    have h_var_le : (∫ om, ‖W_tilde N_cap om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∫ om, ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure := by
      rw [(h_orth N_cap le_rfl).2]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun n hn => ?_
      have hn_lt : n < N_cap := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
      have hInt1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
        have hm_sq : Measurable (fun om => ‖Δ_tilde n om‖ ^ 2) :=
          ((hΔ_tilde_mp n hn_lt).1.norm).pow_const 2
        refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hm_sq.aestronglyMeasurable (B_step ^ 2)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ((hΔ_tilde_mp n hn_lt).2.2 om) 2
      have hInt2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
        have hm_sq : Measurable (fun om => ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2) :=
          ((hΔ_mp n hn_lt).1.norm).pow_const 2
        refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hm_sq.aestronglyMeasurable (B_step ^ 2)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h_step_bd om n hn_lt) 2
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono hInt1 hInt2 fun om => ?_
      cases h_b : notHit n om
      · simp [Δ_tilde, h_b, sq_nonneg]
      · simp [Δ_tilde, h_b]
    let E_max : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ≤ N_cap, lam < ‖W m om‖}
    have hE_max_eq : E_max =
        ⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (N_cap + 1), {om : WalkSpace | lam < ‖W m om‖} := by
      ext om; simp [E_max, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    have hE_max_meas : MeasurableSet E_max := by
      rw [hE_max_eq]
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun m hm => ?_
      have hm_le : m ≤ N_cap := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
      exact isOpen_Ioi.measurableSet.preimage (hW_mp m hm_le).1.norm
    have h_ind_le : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
        E_max.indicator (fun _ => lam ^ 2) om ≤ ‖W_tilde N_cap om‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro om
      by_cases hom : om ∈ E_max
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hom]
        classical
        let m_star := Nat.find hom
        have hm_spec : m_star ≤ N_cap ∧ lam < ‖W m_star om‖ := Nat.find_spec hom
        have h_eq_stop : W_tilde N_cap om = W m_star om := by
          dsimp only [W_tilde, W]
          rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hm_spec.1)]
          · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
            have hn_lt : n < m_star := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
            have h_nh : notHit n om = true := by
              simp only [notHit, decide_eq_true_eq]
              intro l hl
              have hl_lt : l < m_star := lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hl) hn_lt
              have hl_le_N : l ≤ N_cap := le_trans hl_lt.le hm_spec.1
              have h_min := Nat.find_min hom hl_lt
              by_contra h_gt
              exact h_min ⟨hl_le_N, lt_of_not_ge h_gt⟩
            simp [Δ_tilde, h_nh]
          · intro n _ hn_not_m
            have hm_le_n : m_star ≤ n := le_of_not_gt (Finset.mem_range.not.mp hn_not_m)
            have h_nh : notHit n om = false := by
              simp only [notHit, decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_forall]
              exact ⟨m_star, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm_le_n),
                not_le_of_gt hm_spec.2⟩
            simp [Δ_tilde, h_nh]
        rw [h_eq_stop]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hlam.le hm_spec.2.le 2
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hom]
        exact sq_nonneg _
    have h_ind_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (E_max.indicator fun _ => lam ^ 2) walkMeasure :=
      (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _).indicator hE_max_meas
    have h_cheb : lam ^ 2 * walkMeasure.real E_max ≤ ∫ om, ‖W_tilde N_cap om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure := by
      have h_int_ind : (∫ om, E_max.indicator (fun _ => lam ^ 2) om ∂walkMeasure) =
          walkMeasure.real E_max * lam ^ 2 := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator_const _ hE_max_meas, smul_eq_mul,
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
      have h_mono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_ind_int (h_orth N_cap le_rfl).1 h_ind_le
      linarith
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hlam)]
    linarith

  
  
  
  let mask₀ : WalkSpace → Bool := fun om => decide (om ∈ A₀)
  have h_mask₀_mp : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable mask₀ ∧ prefDet n mask₀ := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨h_decide_meas _ hA₀_meas, ?_⟩
    intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
    have h0 : om₁ 0 = om₂ 0 := h_eq 0 (Nat.zero_le n)
    simp [mask₀, A₀, h0]

  
  let H_sup : WalkSpace → ℕ → ℝ := fun om n =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun k => sliceHistory S P ρ om k n)
  have hH_sup_mono : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ}, m₁ ≤ m₂ → H_sup om m₁ ≤ H_sup om m₂ := by
    intro om m₁ m₂ hm
    refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun k _ => ?_
    refine le_trans ?_ (Finset.le_sup' (fun i => sliceHistory S P ρ om i m₂) (Finset.mem_univ k))
    dsimp [sliceHistory]
    exact Finset.sup'_mono _ (Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hm)) _

  have h_sup_meas : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (F : ι → WalkSpace → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, Measurable (F i)) → Measurable (fun om => s.sup' hs (fun i => F i om)) := by
    intro ι s hs F hF
    have h_fn : (fun om => s.sup' hs (fun i => F i om)) = s.sup' hs F := by
      funext om; exact (Finset.sup'_apply hs F om).symm
    rw [h_fn]
    exact Finset.sup'_induction (p := Measurable) hs F
      (fun g₁ hg₁ g₂ hg₂ => continuous_max.measurable.comp (hg₁.prodMk hg₂)) hF

  have hH_sup_mp : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun om => H_sup om n) ∧ prefDet n (fun om => H_sup om n) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine h_sup_meas Finset.univ Finset.univ_nonempty _ fun k _ => ?_
      dsimp [sliceHistory]
      refine h_sup_meas (Finset.range (n + 1)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ _
        fun l _ => (h_obs (sliceLogDepth S P k) l (h_logDepth_cont k)).1
    · intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
      dsimp only [H_sup, sliceHistory]
      refine Finset.sup'_congr Finset.univ_nonempty rfl fun k _ => ?_
      refine Finset.sup'_congr _ rfl fun l hl => ?_
      have hl_le : l ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
      exact (h_obs (sliceLogDepth S P k) l (h_logDepth_cont k)).2 om₁ om₂
        fun r hr => h_eq r (le_trans hr hl_le)

  let activeM : ℕ → WalkSpace → Bool := fun n om => decide (H_sup om n < M)
  have h_activeM_mp : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (activeM n) ∧ prefDet n (activeM n) := by
    intro n
    have h_ms : MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | H_sup om n < M} :=
      isOpen_Iio.measurableSet.preimage (hH_sup_mp n).1
    refine ⟨h_decide_meas _ h_ms, ?_⟩
    intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
    simp [activeM, (hH_sup_mp n).2 om₁ om₂ h_eq]

  have h_tiny_mp : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ),
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) ∧
      prefDet n (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) := by
    intro j n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        refine ⟨measurable_const, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    | succ k ih =>
        have h_log_k1 := h_obs (fun y => Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖) (k + 1)
          (h_logSpeed_cont j)
        have hd1 : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (k + 1))‖ < -bG)) :=
          h_decide_meas _ (isOpen_Iio.measurableSet.preimage h_log_k1.1)
        have hd2 : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (k + 1))‖ ≤ -2 * bG)) :=
          h_decide_meas _ (isClosed_Iic.measurableSet.preimage h_log_k1.1)
        have h_meas_succ : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (k + 1)) := by
          have h_eq : (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (k + 1)) =
              (fun p : Bool × Bool × Bool => if p.1 then p.2.1 else p.2.2) ∘
              (fun om => (sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) k,
                (decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (k + 1))‖ < -bG),
                 decide (Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (k + 1))‖ ≤ -2 * bG)))) := by
            funext om; simp [sliceIsTiny]
          rw [h_eq]
          exact (measurable_of_countable _).comp (ih.1.prodMk (hd1.prodMk hd2))
        refine ⟨h_meas_succ, ?_⟩
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have h_prev : sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om₁) k =
