            sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om₂) k :=
          ih.2 om₁ om₂ fun r hr => h_eq r (Nat.le_succ_of_le hr)
        have h_cur := h_log_k1.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [sliceIsTiny, h_prev, h_cur]

  have h_angCut_mp : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n) ∧
      prefDet n (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n) := by
    intro n
    have h_eq_set :
        {om : WalkSpace | ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ k : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ r_star} =
        ⋂ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ⋂ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
          {om : WalkSpace | ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ r_star} := by
      ext om; simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    have h_ms : MeasurableSet
        {om : WalkSpace | ∀ l ≤ n, ∀ k : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖ ≤ r_star} := by
      rw [h_eq_set]
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l _ => ?_
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun k _ => ?_
      exact isClosed_Iic.measurableSet.preimage
        (h_obs (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val) l (h_angle_holo k).continuousOn).1.norm
    have h_meas_ac : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n) := by
      dsimp only [sliceAngCutOK]
      exact h_decide_meas _ h_ms
    refine ⟨h_meas_ac, ?_⟩
    intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
    have h_iff :
        (∀ l ≤ n, ∀ k : Fin P.N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om₁ l)‖ ≤ r_star) ↔
        (∀ l ≤ n, ∀ k : Fin P.N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om₂ l)‖ ≤ r_star) := by
      refine forall₂_congr fun l hl => forall_congr' fun k => ?_
      have h_ang_eq : sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om₁ l) =
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om₂ l) :=
        (h_obs (sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val) l (h_angle_holo k).continuousOn).2 om₁ om₂
          fun r hr => h_eq r (le_trans hr hl)
      rw [h_ang_eq]
    simp [sliceAngCutOK, h_iff]

  have h_runMax_mp : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n) ∧
      prefDet n (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only [sliceRunningPosMax]
      refine measurable_const.add ?_
      refine h_sup_meas (Finset.range (n + 1)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ _
        fun l _ => ?_
      exact h_sup_meas Finset.univ Finset.univ_nonempty _ fun k _ =>
        (h_obs (fun w => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val w‖) l (h_pos_norm_cont k)).1
    · intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
      dsimp only [sliceRunningPosMax]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sup'_congr _ rfl fun l hl => ?_
      have hl_le : l ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
      refine Finset.sup'_congr Finset.univ_nonempty rfl fun k _ => ?_
      exact (h_obs (fun w => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val w‖) l (h_pos_norm_cont k)).2 om₁ om₂
        fun r hr => h_eq r (le_trans hr hl_le)

  
  let E_stops : Set WalkSpace := {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ H_sup om m}
  have hE_stops_ae : ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure, om ∈ E_stops :=
    hBase.walk_stops M ρ hAdm
  have hE_stops_compl_null : walkMeasure E_stopsᶜ = 0 :=
    MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp hE_stops_ae
  have hE_stops_compl_real : walkMeasure.real E_stopsᶜ = 0 := by
    simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hE_stops_compl_null]

  have h_active_iff_tau : ∀ om ∈ E_stops, ∀ n : ℕ,
      (activeM n om = true ↔ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) := by
    intro om hom n
    have hom' : ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) := hom
    have h_tau_eq : sliceStopTau S P ρ M om =
        @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) hom' := by
      dsimp only [sliceStopTau]
      rw [dif_pos hom']
    rw [h_tau_eq]
    simp only [activeM, decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨fun h_lt => ?_, fun hn_lt => ?_⟩
    · by_contra h_ge
      have h_le : @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) hom' ≤ n := not_lt.mp h_ge
      have h_spec : M ≤ H_sup om (@Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) hom') :=
        @Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) hom'
      have h_m := hH_sup_mono om h_le
      linarith
    · have h_min := @Nat.find_min _ (Classical.decPred _) hom' n hn_lt
      linarith

  
  let τ_tr : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℕ := fun N_cap om =>
    @Nat.find (fun m : ℕ => N_cap ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m) (Classical.decPred _)
      ⟨N_cap, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
  have hτ_tr_le : ∀ (N_cap : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), τ_tr N_cap om ≤ N_cap :=
    fun N_cap om => @Nat.find_min' _ (Classical.decPred _) _ N_cap (Or.inl le_rfl)
  have hτ_tr_lt_iff : ∀ (N_cap n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), n < N_cap →
      (n < τ_tr N_cap om ↔ activeM n om = true) := by
    intro N_cap n om hn_N
    simp only [activeM, decide_eq_true_eq]
    refine ⟨fun hn_lt => ?_, fun h_lt => ?_⟩
    · have h_min := @Nat.find_min (fun m : ℕ => N_cap ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m)
        (Classical.decPred _) ⟨N_cap, Or.inl le_rfl⟩ n hn_lt
      push_neg at h_min
      exact h_min.2
    · by_contra h_ge
      have h_le : τ_tr N_cap om ≤ n := not_lt.mp h_ge
      have h_spec := @Nat.find_spec (fun m : ℕ => N_cap ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m)
        (Classical.decPred _) ⟨N_cap, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
      change N_cap ≤ τ_tr N_cap om ∨ M ≤ H_sup om (τ_tr N_cap om) at h_spec
      rcases h_spec with hN_le | hM_le
      · omega
      · linarith [hH_sup_mono om h_le]
  have hτ_tr_le_iff : ∀ (N_cap k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
      τ_tr N_cap om ≤ k ↔ (N_cap ≤ k ∨ M ≤ H_sup om k) := by
    intro N_cap k om
    refine ⟨fun hk => ?_, fun hk => @Nat.find_min' _ (Classical.decPred _) _ k hk⟩
    have h_spec := @Nat.find_spec (fun m : ℕ => N_cap ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m)
      (Classical.decPred _) ⟨N_cap, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
    rcases h_spec with hN | hM
    · exact Or.inl (le_trans hN hk)
    · exact Or.inr (le_trans hM (hH_sup_mono om hk))
  have hτ_tr_meas : ∀ N_cap : ℕ, Measurable (τ_tr N_cap) := by
    intro N_cap
    have h_le_ms : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | τ_tr N_cap om ≤ k} := by
      intro k
      have h_eq : {om : WalkSpace | τ_tr N_cap om ≤ k} =
          {om | N_cap ≤ k} ∪ {om | M ≤ H_sup om k} := by
        ext om; exact hτ_tr_le_iff N_cap k om
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (MeasurableSet.const _).union (isClosed_Ici.measurableSet.preimage (hH_sup_mp k).1)
    refine measurable_to_countable' fun k => ?_
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        have : τ_tr N_cap ⁻¹' {0} = {om | τ_tr N_cap om ≤ 0} := by ext om; simp
        rw [this]; exact h_le_ms 0
    | succ r =>
        have : τ_tr N_cap ⁻¹' {r + 1} =
            {om | τ_tr N_cap om ≤ r + 1} \ {om | τ_tr N_cap om ≤ r} := by
          ext om; simp; omega
        rw [this]; exact (h_le_ms (r + 1)).diff (h_le_ms r)
  have hτ_tr_mono : ∀ {N₁ N₂ : ℕ}, N₁ ≤ N₂ → ∀ om : WalkSpace, τ_tr N₁ om ≤ τ_tr N₂ om := by
    intro N₁ N₂ hN om
    rw [hτ_tr_le_iff]
    have h_spec := @Nat.find_spec (fun m : ℕ => N₂ ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m)
      (Classical.decPred _) ⟨N₂, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
    rcases h_spec with hN₂ | hM
    · exact Or.inl (le_trans hN hN₂)
    · exact Or.inr hM
  have hτ_tr_eq_tau : ∀ om ∈ E_stops,
      τ_tr (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) om = sliceStopTau S P ρ M om := by
    intro om hom
    apply le_antisymm (hτ_tr_le _ om)
    by_contra h_lt
    push_neg at h_lt
    have h_act : activeM (τ_tr (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) om) om = true :=
      (h_active_iff_tau om hom _).mpr h_lt
    simp only [activeM, decide_eq_true_eq] at h_act
    have h_spec := @Nat.find_spec
      (fun m : ℕ => sliceStopTau S P ρ M om ≤ m ∨ M ≤ H_sup om m)
      (Classical.decPred _) ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
    change sliceStopTau S P ρ M om ≤ τ_tr (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) om ∨
      M ≤ H_sup om (τ_tr (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) om) at h_spec
    rcases h_spec with h_ge | h_M
    · omega
    · linarith

  
  let Λ_sw : ℝ := M ^ (1 + η - γ)
  have hΛ_sw_pos : 0 < Λ_sw := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hM_pos _
  let E_sw : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      Λ_sw < (sliceJointSwitches S P bG (walkPos ρ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ)}
  have hE_sw_le : walkMeasure.real E_sw ≤ δ / 3 := by
    let U_max : ℝ := C_f * (M + 2) + C_init
    have hU_max_nn : 0 ≤ U_max := by positivity
    let B_sw : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N_cap =>
      A₀ ∩ {om : WalkSpace |
        Λ_sw < (sliceJointSwitches S P bG (walkPos ρ om) (τ_tr N_cap om) : ℝ)}
    have hB_sw_meas : ∀ N_cap : ℕ, MeasurableSet (B_sw N_cap) := by
      intro N_cap
      have h_eq : B_sw N_cap = A₀ ∩ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (N_cap + 1),
          ({om | τ_tr N_cap om = k} ∩
            {om | Λ_sw < (sliceJointSwitches S P bG (walkPos ρ om) k : ℝ)}) := by
        ext om
        simp only [B_sw, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff,
          Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        refine ⟨fun ⟨hA, hgt⟩ => ⟨hA, τ_tr N_cap om, hτ_tr_le N_cap om, rfl, hgt⟩,
          fun ⟨hA, k, _, hk, hgt⟩ => ⟨hA, hk ▸ hgt⟩⟩
      rw [h_eq]
      refine hA₀_meas.inter (Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun k _ => ?_)
      have h1 : MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | τ_tr N_cap om = k} :=
        (hτ_tr_meas N_cap) (MeasurableSet.singleton k)
      have h_sw_meas : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          (sliceJointSwitches S P bG (walkPos ρ om) k : ℝ)) := by
        have h_sum_eq : (fun om : WalkSpace =>
              (sliceJointSwitches S P bG (walkPos ρ om) k : ℝ)) =
            fun om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k,
              if decide (∃ j : Fin P.N,
                  sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n ≠
                    sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (n + 1)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
          funext om
          dsimp only [sliceJointSwitches]
          rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
          split_ifs with h1 h2 h2 <;> simp_all
        rw [h_sum_eq]
        refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun n _ => ?_
        have h_ex_eq : {om : WalkSpace | ∃ j : Fin P.N,
              sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n ≠
                sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (n + 1)} =
            ⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
              {om | sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n ≠
                sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (n + 1)} := by
          ext om; simp
        have h_ex_ms : MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | ∃ j : Fin P.N,
            sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n ≠
              sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (n + 1)} := by
          rw [h_ex_eq]
          refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun j _ => ?_
          have h_pair_t : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
              (sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n,
               sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) (n + 1))) :=
            (h_tiny_mp j n).1.prodMk (h_tiny_mp j (n + 1)).1
          exact h_pair_t (MeasurableSet.of_discrete (s := {p : Bool × Bool | p.1 ≠ p.2}))
        exact (measurable_of_countable (fun b_val : Bool => if b_val then (1 : ℝ) else 0)).comp
          (h_decide_meas _ h_ex_ms)
      exact h1.inter (isOpen_Ioi.measurableSet.preimage h_sw_meas)

    have hB_sw_bound : ∀ N_cap : ℕ,
        walkMeasure (B_sw N_cap) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (P.N : ℝ) * (U_max + C_init) / (bG * Λ_sw)) := by
      intro N_cap
      let mask_j : Fin P.N → ℕ → WalkSpace → Bool := fun j n om =>
        (mask₀ om && activeM n om) && !sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n
      let Z_j : Fin P.N → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun j om =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
          if mask_j j n om then
            -Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1))‖ +
              Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖
          else 0
      have hZ_j_int_zero : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (Z_j j) walkMeasure ∧
          (∫ om, Z_j j om ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
        intro j
        refine h_zero_mean_real N_cap 1 (mask_j j)
          (fun y => Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖) zero_le_one
          (h_logSpeed_cont j) (h_avg_logSpeed hAdm j) (fun n _ => ?_) (fun om n _ _ => ?_)
        · have hm0 := h_mask₀_mp n
          have hm1 := h_activeM_mp n
          have hm2 := h_tiny_mp j n
          have h_m : Measurable (mask_j j n) := by
            have : mask_j j n =
                (fun p : Bool × Bool × Bool => (p.1 && p.2.1) && !p.2.2) ∘
                (fun om => (mask₀ om, (activeM n om, sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n))) := rfl
            rw [this]
            exact (measurable_of_countable _).comp (hm0.1.prodMk (hm1.1.prodMk hm2.1))

          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om)
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
                (if n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om then
                  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2
                else 0) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_n
          _ = ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range N_cap).filter (· < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) *
                  ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
          _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) *
                  ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
              intro n hn
              exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
          _ = V_dom om := by
              dsimp only [V_dom]
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_var_total : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∫ om, Δ_sq n om ∂walkMeasure) ≤
          Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk := by
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ fun n hn => hΔ_sq_int n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)]
        calc
          (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om) ∂walkMeasure)
            ≤ ∫ om, V_dom om ∂walkMeasure :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_sum_int hV_dom_int h_ae_le
          _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) *
                (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                  ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) +
              (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                  (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) := by
              dsimp only [V_dom]
              rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (h_imp_int.1.const_mul _) (h_clk_int.1.const_mul _),
                MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (10 * bG) * (2 * S.H ^ 2) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk := by
              refine add_le_add
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_imp_int.2 (by positivity))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_clk_int.2 (by positivity))
          _ = Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk := by ring
      have hB_sub : B_mod N_cap ⊆
          {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ≤ N_cap,
            lam_mod < ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
              coeff_mod n om *
                (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ι -
                  slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n) ι)‖} := by
        intro om ⟨hA, hS, h_tau_N, m, hm_tau, hgt⟩
        refine ⟨m, le_trans hm_tau h_tau_N, ?_⟩
        have hm0_t : mask₀ om = true := decide_eq_true hA
        have h_eq_mart :
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
              coeff_mod n om *
                (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) ι -
                  slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n) ι)) =
            sliceModPosMart S P bG r_star j ι (walkPos ρ om) m := by
          dsimp only [sliceModPosMart, coeff_mod]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
          have hn_tau : n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om := lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm_tau
          have h_act : activeM n om = true := (h_active_iff_tau om hS n).mpr hn_tau
          cases sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n <;>
            cases sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n <;>
            simp [hm0_t, h_act]
        rwa [h_eq_mart]
      have h_real_B : walkMeasure.real (B_mod N_cap) ≤
          (Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2 :=
        le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hB_sub)
          (le_trans h_l2 (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_var_total (sq_nonneg _)))
      rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] at h_real_B
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_B

    have hB_mod_mono : Monotone B_mod := by
      intro N₁ N₂ hN om ⟨hA, hS, h_tau, hex⟩
      exact ⟨hA, hS, le_trans h_tau hN, hex⟩
    have h_sub_mod : E_mod j ι ⊆ (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_mod N_cap) ∪ A₀ᶜ ∪ E_stopsᶜ := by
      intro om hom
      by_cases hA : om ∈ A₀
      · by_cases hS : om ∈ E_stops
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, hA, hS, le_rfl, hom⟩))
        · exact Or.inr hS
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hA)
    have h_meas_mod : walkMeasure (E_mod j ι) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          ((Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2) := by
      calc
        walkMeasure (E_mod j ι)
          ≤ walkMeasure ((⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_mod N_cap) ∪ A₀ᶜ ∪ E_stopsᶜ) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_mono h_sub_mod
        _ ≤ walkMeasure ((⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_mod N_cap) ∪ A₀ᶜ) + walkMeasure E_stopsᶜ :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _
        _ ≤ walkMeasure (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_mod N_cap) + walkMeasure A₀ᶜ + walkMeasure E_stopsᶜ :=
            add_le_add (MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _) le_rfl
        _ = walkMeasure (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_mod N_cap) := by
            rw [hA₀_compl_null, hE_stops_compl_null, add_zero, add_zero]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
              ((Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2) := by
            rw [hB_mod_mono.measure_iUnion]
            exact iSup_le hB_mod_bound
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ (Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2 := by
      positivity
    calc
      (walkMeasure (E_mod j ι)).toReal
        ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal
            ((Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2)).toReal :=
          ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h_meas_mod
      _ = (Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2 :=
          ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h_nn

  have hE_mod_union_le :
      walkMeasure.real
        (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
          ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι) ≤ δ / 3 := by
    have h_single_le :
        (Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2 ≤
          ((4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (2 * b)) * ε_star := by
      have he10 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (10 * bG) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
      have h_num : Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk ≤
          Real.exp (10 * bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) := by nlinarith
      have h_lam_sq : lam_mod ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (12 * bG) := by
        dsimp only [lam_mod]
        rw [mul_pow, sq (Real.exp (6 * bG)), ← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
      have h_exp2 : 2 * bG ≤ Real.exp (2 * bG) :=
        le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * bG))
      have h_inv_2bG : (2 * bG)⁻¹ ≤ ε_star / (2 * b) := by
        rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ (by positivity)]
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε_star * G_scale := h_one_le_eps_G
          _ = (ε_star / (2 * b)) * (2 * bG) := by dsimp [bG]; field_simp
      calc
        (Real.exp (10 * bG) * S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_mod ^ 2
          ≤ (Real.exp (10 * bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk)) /
              ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (12 * bG)) := by
            rw [h_lam_sq]
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
        _ = (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) * (Real.exp (10 * bG) / Real.exp (12 * bG)) := by ring
        _ = (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) * (Real.exp (2 * bG))⁻¹ := by
            congr 1
            rw [← Real.exp_sub, show 10 * bG - 12 * bG = -(2 * bG) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
        _ ≤ (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) * (2 * bG)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_exp2) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) * (ε_star / (2 * b)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_2bG (by positivity)
        _ = ((4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (2 * b)) * ε_star := by ring
    have h_mul_D : (3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk)) * ε_star ≤ b * δ := by
      apply h_le_mul_of_div (mul_pos hb_pos hδ_pos)
      have t1 : 0 ≤ (C_init + 1) / b := by positivity
      have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t3 : 0 ≤ (2 + 2 * C_log) / b := by positivity
      have t4 : 0 ≤ 5 * b + Real.log 2 := by positivity
      have t6 : 0 ≤ 9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    calc
      walkMeasure.real
          (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι)
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            walkMeasure.real (⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            ∑ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), walkMeasure.real (E_mod j ι) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            ∑ _ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)),
              (((4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (2 * b)) * ε_star) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun ι _ =>
            le_trans (hE_mod_each j ι) h_single_le
      _ = (P.N : ℝ) * (2 * (((4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (2 * b)) * ε_star)) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = ((3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk)) * ε_star) / (3 * b) := by ring
      _ ≤ (b * δ) / (3 * b) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_mul_D (by positivity)
      _ = δ / 3 := by field_simp

  
  let lam_tiny : ℝ := Real.exp (-bG / 3)
  have hlam_tiny_pos : 0 < lam_tiny := Real.exp_pos _
  let E_tiny : Fin P.N → Set WalkSpace := fun j =>
    {om : WalkSpace |
      ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        lam_tiny < ‖sliceTinySupMart S P bG r_star j (walkPos ρ om) m‖}
  have hE_tiny_each : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      walkMeasure.real (E_tiny j) ≤
        Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2 := by
    intro j
    let B_tiny : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N_cap =>
      {om : WalkSpace |
        om ∈ E_stops ∧ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om ≤ N_cap ∧
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
          lam_tiny < ‖sliceTinySupMart S P bG r_star j (walkPos ρ om) m‖}
    let B_step_tiny : ℝ := 2 * Real.exp (r_star - bG) * (S.H + 1) + 1
    have hB_step_tiny_nn : 0 ≤ B_step_tiny := by positivity
    have hB_tiny_bound : ∀ N_cap : ℕ,
        walkMeasure (B_tiny N_cap) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal
            (Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2) := by
      intro N_cap
      let coeff_tiny : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
        if activeM n om &&
            (sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n &&
              sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) then
          ((sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ))⁻¹
        else 0
      have hc_mp : ∀ n < N_cap, Measurable (coeff_tiny n) ∧ prefDet n (coeff_tiny n) := by
        intro n _
        have hm1 := h_activeM_mp n
        have hm2 := h_angCut_mp n
        have hm3 := h_tiny_mp j n
        have hmR := h_runMax_mp n
        have h_ind_m : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            if activeM n om &&
                (sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n &&
                  sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) := by
          have : (fun om : WalkSpace =>
                if activeM n om &&
                    (sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n &&
                      sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) =
              (fun p : Bool × Bool × Bool => if p.1 && (p.2.1 && p.2.2) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) ∘
              (fun om => (activeM n om,
                (sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n,
                 sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n))) := rfl
          rw [this]
          exact (measurable_of_countable _).comp (hm1.1.prodMk (hm2.1.prodMk hm3.1))
        have h_inv_m : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            ((sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ))⁻¹) :=
          (Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp hmR.1).inv
        have h_m : Measurable (coeff_tiny n) := by
          have : coeff_tiny n = fun om =>
              (if activeM n om &&
                  (sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n &&
                    sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n) then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
                ((sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ))⁻¹ := by
            funext om
            dsimp only [coeff_tiny]
            split_ifs <;> simp
          rw [this]
          exact h_ind_m.mul h_inv_m
        refine ⟨h_m, fun om₁ om₂ h_eq => ?_⟩
        simp [coeff_tiny, hm1.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq, hm2.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq,
          hm3.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq, hmR.2 om₁ om₂ h_eq]
      have h_pos_le_R : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ),
          1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤
            sliceRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n := by
        intro om n
        dsimp only [sliceRunningPosMax]
        have h1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤
            Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖) :=
          Finset.le_sup' (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖)
            (Finset.mem_univ j)
        have h2 := Finset.le_sup'
          (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (walkPos ρ om l)‖)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
        linarith
      have hc_step_bd : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n < N_cap,
          ‖coeff_tiny n om *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ≤ B_step_tiny := by
        intro om n _
        dsimp only [coeff_tiny]
        split_ifs with h_cond
        · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond
          rcases h_cond with ⟨_, h_ac, h_is_tiny⟩
          have hn_tiny : Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ < -bG :=
            h_tiny_inv bG j (walkPos ρ om) n hbG_pos h_is_tiny
          have hn_ang : ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ r_star :=
            (of_decide_eq_true h_ac) n le_rfl j
          let z_step : ℂ :=
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          have hz_le : ‖z_step‖ ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := by
            simp [z_step, abs_of_nonneg (hρ_nn _)]
          simpa [walkPos, z_step, B_step_tiny] using h_tiny_step_norm hAdm
            (walkPos ρ om n) (h_walk_reg om n) z_step hz_le j (h_pos_le_R om n) hn_ang hn_tiny
        · simp [hB_step_tiny_nn]
      have h_l2 := h_l2_maximal N_cap B_step_tiny lam_tiny coeff_tiny
        (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) hB_step_tiny_nn hlam_tiny_pos
        (h_support_holo j).continuousOn (h_avg_support hAdm j) hc_mp hc_step_bd
      let Δ_sq : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun n om =>
        ‖coeff_tiny n om *
          (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ^ 2
      have hΔ_sq_int : ∀ n < N_cap, MeasureTheory.Integrable (Δ_sq n) walkMeasure := by
        intro n hn
        have hm : Measurable (Δ_sq n) :=
          (((hc_mp n hn).1.mul
            ((h_obs (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) (n + 1) (h_support_holo j).continuousOn).1.sub
             (h_obs (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) n (h_support_holo j).continuousOn).1)).norm).pow_const 2
        refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable (B_step_tiny ^ 2)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hc_step_bd om n hn) 2
      have h_sum_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
          (fun om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om) walkMeasure :=
        MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum _ fun n hn => hΔ_sq_int n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
      let V_dom : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om =>
        Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
            ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2) +
        Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om), (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2)
      have h_imp_int := hBase.impact_sq_sum M ρ hAdm j
      have h_clk_int := hBase.walk_clock M ρ hAdm
      have hV_dom_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable V_dom walkMeasure :=
        (h_imp_int.1.const_mul _).add (h_clk_int.1.const_mul _)
      have h_ae_le : (fun om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om) ≤ᵐ[walkMeasure] V_dom := by
        filter_upwards [hE_stops_ae] with om hom_stops
        have h_each_n : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
            Δ_sq n om ≤
              if n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om then
                Real.exp (-bG) *
                  ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                   (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2)
              else 0 := by
          intro n _
          dsimp only [Δ_sq, coeff_tiny]
          split_ifs with h_cond h_tau h_tau
          · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond
            rcases h_cond with ⟨_, h_ac, h_is_tiny⟩
            have hn_tiny : Real.log ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ < -bG :=
              h_tiny_inv bG j (walkPos ρ om) n hbG_pos h_is_tiny
            have hn_ang : ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ r_star :=
              (of_decide_eq_true h_ac) n le_rfl j
            let z_step : ℂ :=
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om n) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            have hz_le : ‖z_step‖ ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := by
              simp [z_step, abs_of_nonneg (hρ_nn _)]
            simpa [walkPos, z_step] using h_tiny_step_sq hAdm hbG_pos h_tiny_exp1_cond
              h_tiny_exp2_cond (walkPos ρ om n) (h_walk_reg om n) z_step hz_le j
              (h_pos_le_R om n) hn_ang hn_tiny
          · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h_cond
            exfalso
            exact h_tau ((h_active_iff_tau om hom_stops n).mp h_cond.1)
          · simp only [zero_mul, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow]
            positivity
          · simp
        calc
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om)
            ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap,
                (if n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om then
                  Real.exp (-bG) *
                    ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                     (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2)
                else 0) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each_n
          _ = ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range N_cap).filter (· < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                (Real.exp (-bG) *
                  ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                   (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2)) := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
          _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                (Real.exp (-bG) *
                  ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                   (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2)) := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun _ _ _ => by positivity)
              intro n hn
              exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
          _ = V_dom om := by
              dsimp only [V_dom]
              have h_dist : ∀ n, Real.exp (-bG) *
                  ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                   (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) =
                  Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                    ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                      sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2 +
                  Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 := fun _ => by ring
              simp_rw [h_dist, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have h_var_total : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, ∫ om, Δ_sq n om ∂walkMeasure) ≤
          Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) := by
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ fun n hn => hΔ_sq_int n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)]
        calc
          (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_cap, Δ_sq n om) ∂walkMeasure)
            ≤ ∫ om, V_dom om ∂walkMeasure :=
              MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_sum_int hV_dom_int h_ae_le
          _ = Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                  ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                    sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) +
              Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
                (∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
                  (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) := by
              dsimp only [V_dom]
              rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (h_imp_int.1.const_mul _) (h_clk_int.1.const_mul _),
                MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
          _ ≤ Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 * S.H ^ 2) +
              Real.exp (-bG) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk := by
              refine add_le_add
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_imp_int.2 (by positivity))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_clk_int.2 (by positivity))
          _ = Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) := by ring
      have hB_sub : B_tiny N_cap ⊆
          {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ≤ N_cap,
            lam_tiny < ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
              coeff_tiny n om *
                (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                  sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))‖} := by
        intro om ⟨hS, h_tau_N, m, hm_tau, hgt⟩
        refine ⟨m, le_trans hm_tau h_tau_N, ?_⟩
        have h_eq_mart :
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
              coeff_tiny n om *
                (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                  sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))) =
            sliceTinySupMart S P bG r_star j (walkPos ρ om) m := by
          dsimp only [sliceTinySupMart, coeff_tiny]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
          have hn_tau : n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om := lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hm_tau
          have h_act : activeM n om = true := (h_active_iff_tau om hS n).mpr hn_tau
          cases sliceAngCutOK S P r_star (walkPos ρ om) n <;>
            cases sliceIsTiny S P bG j (walkPos ρ om) n <;>
            simp [h_act]
        rwa [h_eq_mart]
      have h_real_B : walkMeasure.real (B_tiny N_cap) ≤
          Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2 :=
        le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono hB_sub)
          (le_trans h_l2 (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_var_total (sq_nonneg _)))
      rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] at h_real_B
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_real_B

    have hB_tiny_mono : Monotone B_tiny := by
      intro N₁ N₂ hN om ⟨hS, h_tau, hex⟩
      exact ⟨hS, le_trans h_tau hN, hex⟩
    have h_sub_tiny : E_tiny j ⊆ (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_tiny N_cap) ∪ E_stopsᶜ := by
      intro om hom
      by_cases hS : om ∈ E_stops
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, hS, le_rfl, hom⟩)
      · exact Or.inr hS
    have h_meas_tiny : walkMeasure (E_tiny j) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2) := by
      calc
        walkMeasure (E_tiny j)
          ≤ walkMeasure ((⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_tiny N_cap) ∪ E_stopsᶜ) :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_mono h_sub_tiny
        _ ≤ walkMeasure (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_tiny N_cap) + walkMeasure E_stopsᶜ :=
            MeasureTheory.measure_union_le _ _
        _ = walkMeasure (⋃ N_cap : ℕ, B_tiny N_cap) := by rw [hE_stops_compl_null, add_zero]
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
              (Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2) := by
            rw [hB_tiny_mono.measure_iUnion]
            exact iSup_le hB_tiny_bound
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2 := by
      positivity
    calc
      (walkMeasure (E_tiny j)).toReal
        ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal
            (Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2)).toReal :=
          ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h_meas_tiny
      _ = Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2 :=
          ENNReal.toReal_ofReal h_nn

  have hE_tiny_union_le :
      walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j) ≤ δ / 3 := by
    have h_single_le :
        Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2 ≤
          (3 * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / b) * ε_star := by
      have h_lam_sq : lam_tiny ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * bG / 3) := by
        dsimp only [lam_tiny]
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]
        ring_nf
      have h_exp3 : bG / 3 ≤ Real.exp (bG / 3) :=
        le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp (bG / 3))
      have h_inv_3 : (bG / 3)⁻¹ ≤ (3 / b) * ε_star := by
        rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ (by positivity)]
        calc
          (1 : ℝ) ≤ ε_star * G_scale := h_one_le_eps_G
          _ = ((3 / b) * ε_star) * (bG / 3) := by dsimp [bG]; field_simp
      calc
        Real.exp (-bG) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / lam_tiny ^ 2
          = (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) * (Real.exp (-bG) / Real.exp (-2 * bG / 3)) := by
            rw [h_lam_sq]; ring
        _ = (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) * (Real.exp (bG / 3))⁻¹ := by
            congr 1
            rw [← Real.exp_sub, show -bG - (-2 * bG / 3) = -(bG / 3) by ring, Real.exp_neg]
        _ ≤ (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) * (bG / 3)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_exp3) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) * ((3 / b) * ε_star) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_3 (by positivity)
        _ = (3 * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / b) * ε_star := by ring
    have h_mul_D : (9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk)) * ε_star ≤ b * δ := by
      apply h_le_mul_of_div (mul_pos hb_pos hδ_pos)
      have t1 : 0 ≤ (C_init + 1) / b := by positivity
      have t2 : 0 ≤ 6 * (P.N : ℝ) * (3 * C_f + 2 * C_init) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      have t3 : 0 ≤ (2 + 2 * C_log) / b := by positivity
      have t4 : 0 ≤ 5 * b + Real.log 2 := by positivity
      have t5 : 0 ≤ 3 * (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * S.H ^ 2 + 2 * C_clk) / (b * δ) := by positivity
      dsimp [D_big]; linarith
    calc
      walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j)
        ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), walkMeasure.real (E_tiny j) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            ((3 * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / b) * ε_star) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => le_trans (hE_tiny_each j) h_single_le
      _ = (P.N : ℝ) * ((3 * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk) / b) * ε_star) := by
          simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = ((9 * (P.N : ℝ) * (S.H ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * C_clk)) * ε_star) / (3 * b) := by ring
      _ ≤ (b * δ) / (3 * b) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_mul_D (by positivity)
      _ = δ / 3 := by field_simp

  
  have h_target_sub :
      {om : WalkSpace |
        M ^ (1 + η - γ) <
          (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * M ^ γ) (walkPos ρ om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ) ∨
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
          (∃ ι : Fin 2,
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * (b * M ^ γ)) <
              ‖sliceModPosMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j ι (walkPos ρ om) m‖) ∨
          Real.exp (-(b * M ^ γ) / 3) <
            ‖sliceTinySupMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j (walkPos ρ om) m‖} ⊆
      (E_sw ∪
        (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
          ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι)) ∪
        (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j) := by
    intro om hom
    rcases hom with h_sw | ⟨m, hm, j, h_mart⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl h_sw)
    · rcases h_mart with ⟨ι, h_mod_gt⟩ | h_tiny_gt
      · refine Or.inl (Or.inr ?_)
        exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_univ j)
          (Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_univ ι) ⟨m, hm, h_mod_gt⟩)
      · refine Or.inr ?_
        exact Set.mem_biUnion (Finset.mem_univ j) ⟨m, hm, h_tiny_gt⟩

  calc
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        M ^ (1 + η - γ) <
          (sliceJointSwitches S P (b * M ^ γ) (walkPos ρ om)
            (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om) : ℝ) ∨
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om, ∃ j : Fin P.N,
          (∃ ι : Fin 2,
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * (b * M ^ γ)) <
              ‖sliceModPosMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j ι (walkPos ρ om) m‖) ∨
          Real.exp (-(b * M ^ γ) / 3) <
            ‖sliceTinySupMart S P (b * M ^ γ) (M ^ ρ₂) j (walkPos ρ om) m‖}
      ≤ walkMeasure.real
          ((E_sw ∪
            (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
              ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι)) ∪
            (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j)) :=
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_target_sub
    _ ≤ walkMeasure.real
          (E_sw ∪
            (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
              ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι)) +
        walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j) :=
        MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ (walkMeasure.real E_sw +
          walkMeasure.real
            (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
              ⋃ ι ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)), E_mod j ι)) +
        walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), E_tiny j) :=
        add_le_add (MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le _ _) le_rfl
    _ ≤ (δ / 3 + δ / 3) + δ / 3 :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add hE_sw_le hE_mod_union_le) hE_tiny_union_le
    _ = δ := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG r_star C_X0 : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hbG : 0 < bG) (hr_star : 1 ≤ r_star) (hC_X0 : 0 ≤ C_X0)
    (hy_reg : ∀ m ≤ T, y_seq m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all)
    (hy_init : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq 0)‖ ≤ C_X0)
    (hy_ang : ∀ m ≤ T, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤ r_star ∧
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (y_seq m))‖| ≤ r_star)
    (hy_mart : ∀ m ≤ T, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      (∀ ι : Fin 2,
        ‖sliceModPosMart S P bG r_star j ι y_seq m‖ ≤
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (6 * bG)) ∧
      ‖sliceTinySupMart S P bG r_star j y_seq m‖ ≤ Real.exp (-bG / 3))
    (h_absorb : 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp (2 * P.C_rec * r_star - bG / 3) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq T ≤
      ((1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star)) ^
        (sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq T + 1) *
      max (1 + C_X0) (4 * Real.exp (6 * bG))

signature.statement:

    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (bG r_star C_X0 : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ)

      ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤ r_star ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let S_step : ℕ → ℝ := fun l =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun k : Fin P.N =>
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖
  have hR_eq : ∀ n : ℕ,
      sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n =
        1 + (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ S_step :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have hPos_le_step : ∀ (l : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq l)‖ ≤ S_step l := fun l j =>
    Finset.le_sup' (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hS_step_nonneg : ∀ l : ℕ, 0 ≤ S_step l := by
    intro l
    obtain ⟨j₀, _⟩ := (Finset.univ_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).Nonempty)
    exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hPos_le_step l j₀)
  have hStep_le_sup : ∀ {l n : ℕ}, l ≤ n →
      S_step l ≤ (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ S_step := by
    intro l n hln
    exact Finset.le_sup' S_step (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hln))
  have hPos_le_R : ∀ {l n : ℕ}, l ≤ n → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq l)‖ ≤ sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n := by
    intro l n hln j
    rw [hR_eq]
    linarith [hPos_le_step l j, hStep_le_sup hln]
  have hR_ge_one : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n := by
    intro n
    rw [hR_eq]
    linarith [hS_step_nonneg 0, hStep_le_sup (Nat.zero_le n)]
  have hR_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n := fun n =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hR_ge_one n)
  have hR_nonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n := fun n =>
    (hR_pos n).le
  have hR_ne_zero_ℂ : ∀ n : ℕ, (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := fun n =>
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hR_pos n).ne'
  have hR_mono : ∀ {n₁ n₂ : ℕ}, n₁ ≤ n₂ →
      sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n₁ ≤ sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq n₂ := by
    intro n₁ n₂ hn
    rw [hR_eq n₁, hR_eq n₂]
    have hsub : Finset.range (n₁ + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (n₂ + 1) :=
      Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hn)
    linarith [Finset.sup'_mono S_step hsub ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n₁)⟩]
  have hR_zero : sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq 0 ≤ 1 + C_X0 := by
    rw [hR_eq 0]
    have h0 : (Finset.range 1).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0)⟩ S_step ≤ C_X0 := by
      refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun l hl => ?_
      have hl0 : l = 0 := Nat.lt_one_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
      subst hl0
      exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun j _ => hy_init j
    linarith
  have hR_succ : ∀ k : ℕ,
      sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) =
        max (1 + S_step (k + 1)) (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq k) := by
    intro k
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [hR_eq (k + 1)]
      have hsup_le :
          (Finset.range (k + 2)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ (k + 1))⟩ S_step ≤
            max (S_step (k + 1))
              ((Finset.range (k + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ k)⟩ S_step) := by
        refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun l hl => ?_
        have hlt : l < k + 2 := Finset.mem_range.mp hl
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hlt with hlk | rfl
        · exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup' S_step (Finset.mem_range.mpr hlk)) (le_max_right _ _)
        · exact le_max_left _ _
      rcases le_max_iff.mp hsup_le with h1 | h2
      · exact le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)

    simp [sliceJointSwitches]
  have hN_sw_succ : ∀ k : ℕ,
      (sw k → sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq (k + 1) = sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k + 1) ∧
      (¬ sw k → sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq (k + 1) = sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k) := by
    intro k
    constructor
    · intro hsw
      rw [hN_sw_eq (k + 1), hN_sw_eq k, Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert]
      simp [hsw, Finset.mem_filter]
    · intro hnsw
      rw [hN_sw_eq (k + 1), hN_sw_eq k, Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert]
      simp [hnsw]
  let a_last : ℕ → ℕ := fun k =>
    Nat.rec 0 (fun n prev => if sw n then n + 1 else prev) k
  let e_exp : ℕ → ℕ := fun m =>
    match m with
    | 0 => 0
    | k + 1 => sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k + 1
  have ha_succ : ∀ k : ℕ, a_last (k + 1) = if sw k then k + 1 else a_last k := fun _ => rfl
  have hN_sw_mono : ∀ {k₁ k₂ : ℕ}, k₁ ≤ k₂ →
      sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k₁ ≤ sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k₂ := by
    intro k₁ k₂ hk
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.range_mono hk))
  have he_mono : ∀ {m₁ m₂ : ℕ}, m₁ ≤ m₂ → e_exp m₁ ≤ e_exp m₂ := by
    intro m₁ m₂ hm
    cases m₁ with
    | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
    | succ k₁ =>
        cases m₂ with
        | zero => omega
        | succ k₂ =>
            dsimp only [e_exp]
            exact Nat.succ_le_succ (hN_sw_mono (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm))
  have ha_le : ∀ k : ℕ, a_last k ≤ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact le_rfl
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [ha_succ]
        split_ifs
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact Nat.le_succ_of_le ih
  have ha_no_sw : ∀ (k n : ℕ), a_last k ≤ n → n < k → ¬ sw n := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro n _ hn
        omega
    | succ k ih =>
        intro n han hn
        rw [ha_succ] at han
        split_ifs at han with hsw
        · omega
        · rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hn with hlt | rfl
          · exact ih n han hlt
          · exact hsw
  have ha_const : ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N) (n : ℕ),
      a_last k ≤ n → n < k + 1 →
        sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq n = sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (a_last k) := by
    intro k j n han hn
    have h_shift : ∀ r : ℕ, a_last k + r < k + 1 →
        sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (a_last k + r) = sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (a_last k) := by
      intro r
      induction r with
      | zero =>
          intro _
          simp
      | succ r ihr =>
          intro hr
          have h_nosw : ¬ sw (a_last k + r) := ha_no_sw k (a_last k + r) (by omega) (by omega)
          have h_step_eq :
              sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (a_last k + r) =
                sliceIsTiny S P bG j y_seq (a_last k + r + 1) := by
            by_contra hne
            exact h_nosw ⟨j, hne⟩
          have h_assoc : a_last k + (r + 1) = a_last k + r + 1 := by omega
          rw [h_assoc, ← h_step_eq]
          exact ihr (by omega)
    have hn_eq : n = a_last k + (n - a_last k) := (Nat.add_sub_of_le han).symm
    rw [hn_eq]
    exact h_shift (n - a_last k) (by omega)
  have ha_exp : ∀ k : ℕ, e_exp (a_last k) = sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        change 0 = sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq 0
        exact hN_sw_zero.symm
    | succ k ih =>
        rw [ha_succ]
        split_ifs with hsw
        · change sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq k + 1 = sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq (k + 1)
          exact ((hN_sw_succ k).1 hsw).symm
        · rw [ih]
          exact ((hN_sw_succ k).2 hsw).symm
  let A_mult : ℝ := (1 + 6 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star)
  let B_base : ℝ := max (1 + C_X0) (4 * Real.exp (6 * bG))
  have hC_rec_pos : 0 < P.C_rec := P.C_rec_pos
  have h_exp_r_ge_one : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) :=
    Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hA_ge_one : 1 ≤ A_mult := by
    dsimp only [A_mult]
    nlinarith
  have h_exp_bG_ge_one : 1 ≤ Real.exp (6 * bG) :=
    Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
  have hB_ge_4exp : 4 * Real.exp (6 * bG) ≤ B_base := le_max_right _ _
  have hB_ge_init : 1 + C_X0 ≤ B_base := le_max_left _ _
  have hB_ge_four : 4 ≤ B_base := by linarith
  have hB_nonneg : 0 ≤ B_base := by linarith
  have h_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ T →
      sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq m ≤ A_mult ^ (e_exp m) * B_base := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
        intro hm
        cases m with
        | zero =>
            dsimp only [e_exp]
            rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
            exact le_trans hR_zero hB_ge_init
        | succ k =>
            rcases le_total (1 + S_step (k + 1)) (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq k) with h_plat | h_rec
            · have h_eq_prev :
                  sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) = sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq k := by
                rw [hR_succ k, max_eq_right h_plat]
              rw [h_eq_prev]
              refine le_trans (ih k (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.le_of_succ_le hm)) ?_
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (pow_le_pow_right₀ hA_ge_one (he_mono (Nat.le_succ k))) hB_nonneg
            · have h_eq_rec :
                  sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) = 1 + S_step (k + 1) := by
                rw [hR_succ k, max_eq_left h_rec]
              let a' : ℕ := a_last k
              have ha'_le_k : a' ≤ k := ha_le k
              have ha'_lt : a' < k + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_of_le ha'_le_k
              have ha'_le_T : a' ≤ T := le_trans ha'_lt.le hm
              let B_sup : ℝ :=
                2 * Real.exp r_star *
                    (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) +
                  4 * Real.exp (-bG / 3) * sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1)
              have hB_sup_nonneg : 0 ≤ B_sup := by
                have := hR_nonneg a'
                have := hR_nonneg (k + 1)
                dsimp only [B_sup]
                positivity
              have h_sup_all : ∀ k' : Fin P.N,
                  ‖sliceSupportSeq S P.N k'.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ ≤ B_sup := fun k' =>
                h_const_interval ha'_lt.le hm k' (ha_const k k')
              have h_ang_all : ∀ k' : Fin P.N,
                  ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k'.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ +
                    |Real.log ‖Complex.sin
                      (P.θ_seq k'.val (y_seq (k + 1)) -
                        sliceAngleSeq S P.N k'.val (y_seq (k + 1)))‖| ≤ 2 * r_star := by
                intro k'
                have hk' := hy_ang (k + 1) hm k'
                change ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k'.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ +
                  |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k' (y_seq (k + 1)))‖| ≤ 2 * r_star
                linarith [hk'.1, hk'.2]
              have h_pos_all : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
                  ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (k + 1))‖ ≤
                    P.C_rec * Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * B_sup :=
                P.pos_reconstruction (y_seq (k + 1)) (hy_reg (k + 1) hm)
                  (2 * r_star) B_sup (by positivity) hB_sup_nonneg h_ang_all h_sup_all
              have hS_k1_le :
                  S_step (k + 1) ≤ P.C_rec * Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * B_sup :=
                Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun j _ => h_pos_all j
              have h_expand :
                  P.C_rec * Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * B_sup =
                    2 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                        (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) +
                      (4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp (2 * P.C_rec * r_star - bG / 3)) *
                        sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) := by
                dsimp only [B_sup]
                have hexp1 :
                    Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * Real.exp r_star =
                      Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_add]
                  congr 1
                  ring
                have hexp2 :
                    Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * Real.exp (-bG / 3) =
                      Real.exp (2 * P.C_rec * r_star - bG / 3) := by
                  rw [← Real.exp_add]
                  congr 1
                  ring
                calc
                  P.C_rec * Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) *
                      (2 * Real.exp r_star *
                          (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) +
                        4 * Real.exp (-bG / 3) * sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1))
                      = 2 * P.C_rec * (Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * Real.exp r_star) *
                          (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) +
                        4 * P.C_rec * (Real.exp (P.C_rec * (2 * r_star)) * Real.exp (-bG / 3)) *
                          sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) := by ring
                  _ = 2 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                          (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) +
                        (4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp (2 * P.C_rec * r_star - bG / 3)) *
                          sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) := by
                        rw [hexp1, hexp2]
              have h_abs_term :
                  (4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp (2 * P.C_rec * r_star - bG / 3)) *
                      sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) ≤
                    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_absorb (hR_nonneg (k + 1))
              have hR_k1_pre :
                  sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1) ≤
                    2 + 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                      (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) := by
                linarith [h_eq_rec, hS_k1_le, h_expand, h_abs_term]
              let Q : ℝ := A_mult ^ (e_exp a') * B_base
              have hR_a'_le : sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' ≤ Q :=
                ih a' ha'_lt ha'_le_T
              have h_pow_ge_one : 1 ≤ A_mult ^ (e_exp a') := one_le_pow₀ hA_ge_one
              have hB_le_Q : B_base ≤ Q := by
                dsimp only [Q]
                nlinarith
              have hQ_ge_four : 4 ≤ Q := le_trans hB_ge_four hB_le_Q
              have hQ_nonneg : 0 ≤ Q := by linarith
              have h_two_le : 2 ≤ Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * Q := by
                nlinarith
              have h_sum_le_Q :
                  sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Q := by
                linarith [hR_a'_le, hB_ge_4exp, hB_le_Q]
              have h_second_le :
                  4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                      (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) ≤
                    6 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * Q := by
                have h_coeff_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) := by
                  positivity
                calc
                  4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                      (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG))
                      ≤ 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * Q) :=
                        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_le_Q h_coeff_nonneg
                  _ = 6 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * Q := by ring
              have h_exp_step : e_exp a' + 1 = e_exp (k + 1) :=
                congrArg (· + 1) (ha_exp k)
              calc
                sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq (k + 1)
                    ≤ 2 + 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) *
                        (sliceRunningPosMax S P y_seq a' + 2 * Real.exp (6 * bG)) := hR_k1_pre
                _ ≤ Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * Q +
                      6 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((2 * P.C_rec + 1) * r_star) * Q :=
                      add_le_add h_two_le h_second_le
                _ = A_mult * Q := by dsimp only [A_mult]; ring
                _ = A_mult ^ (e_exp a' + 1) * B_base := by
                      dsimp only [Q]; rw [pow_succ']; ring
                _ = A_mult ^ (e_exp (k + 1)) * B_base := by rw [h_exp_step]
  have he_T_le : e_exp T ≤ sliceJointSwitches S P bG y_seq T + 1 := by
    cases T with
    | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
    | succ k =>
        dsimp only [e_exp]
        exact Nat.succ_le_succ (hN_sw_mono (Nat.le_succ k))
  exact le_trans (h_ind T le_rfl)
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ hA_ge_one he_T_le) hB_nonneg)

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (M H₀ B_geom B_clk η_ang lam : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hAdm : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M ρ)
    (hH₀_le : H₀ ≤ M) (hB_geom : 0 ≤ B_geom) (hB_clk : 0 < B_clk)
    (hη : 0 < η_ang) (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
      (∑ l ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        ((slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om l))⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om l)) ^ 2 ≤ B_clk) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om ≤ n → n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om →
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ B_geom ∧
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) *
            ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ η_ang) ∧
      ¬ (∀ m : ℕ, sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om ≤ m → m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ M om →
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om))‖ ≤ lam ∧
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceStopTau S P ρ H₀ om) m,
            ((bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)))‖ ≤ lam)} ≤
    8 * (P.N : ℝ) * ((1 + 4 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom)) * η_ang ^ 2 +
      Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) * B_clk / lam ^ 2
