proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hB_geom
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  
  have h_meas_ind : ∀ {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [Zero Y]
      {U : Set ℂ}, IsOpen U → ∀ {F : ℂ → Y}, ContinuousOn F U → Measurable (U.indicator F) := by
    intro Y _ _ _ _ U hU F hF
    refine measurable_of_isOpen fun V hV => ?_
    have h_open : IsOpen (U ∩ F ⁻¹' V) := hF.isOpen_inter_preimage hU hV
    by_cases h0 : (0 : Y) ∈ V
    · have h_eq : U.indicator F ⁻¹' V = (U ∩ F ⁻¹' V) ∪ Uᶜ := by
        ext z
        by_cases hz : z ∈ U <;> simp [Set.indicator, hz, h0]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_open.measurableSet.union hU.measurableSet.compl
    · have h_eq : U.indicator F ⁻¹' V = U ∩ F ⁻¹' V := by
        ext z
        by_cases hz : z ∈ U <;> simp [Set.indicator, hz, h0]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_open.measurableSet
  have h_cont_sup' : ∀ {ι X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : Set X}
      (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → X → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, ContinuousOn (f i) A) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => s.sup' hs (fun i => f i x)) A := by
    intro ι X _ A s hs f hf
    induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
    | singleton a =>
        simpa using hf a (Finset.mem_singleton_self a)
    | cons a t hat hne ih =>
        have h_eq : (fun x => (Finset.cons a t hat).sup' (Finset.cons_nonempty hat) (fun i => f i x)) =
            fun x => max (f a x) (t.sup' hne (fun i => f i x)) := by
          ext x
          simp [Finset.sup'_cons hne]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hf a (Finset.mem_cons_self a t)).sup
          (ih (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hi)))
  have h_meas_sup' : ∀ {ι Ω : Type} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
      (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → Ω → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ s, Measurable (f i)) →
      Measurable (fun x => s.sup' hs (fun i => f i x)) := by
    intro ι Ω _ s hs f hf
    induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
    | singleton a =>
        simpa using hf a (Finset.mem_singleton_self a)
    | cons a t hat hne ih =>
        have h_eq : (fun x => (Finset.cons a t hat).sup' (Finset.cons_nonempty hat) (fun i => f i x)) =
            fun x => max (f a x) (t.sup' hne (fun i => f i x)) := by
          ext x
          simp [Finset.sup'_cons hne]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (hf a (Finset.mem_cons_self a t)).max
          (ih (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hi)))
  
  have h_maximal : ∀ (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n : ℕ,
        Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ⊆ U) →
      ∀ (g : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ g U →
      ∀ (w : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ W_pre : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ,
        Measurable W_pre ∧
          ∀ om : WalkSpace, w n om = W_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)) →
      ∀ (Q : ℝ), 0 ≤ Q →
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ N_hor : ℕ,
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          ‖w n om * (g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - g (walkPos ρ om n))‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q) →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m : ℕ, lam < ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
          w n om * (g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - g (walkPos ρ om n))‖} ≤
        Q / lam ^ 2 := by
    intro U hU_open h_walk_U g hg_holo w hw_adapt Q hQ_nn h_quad
    have hρ_meas : Measurable ρ := hAdm.measurable
    have hρ_nn : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg
    let walkPrefixPos : ∀ (n : ℕ), (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun n =>
      Nat.rec
        (motive := fun k => (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ)
        (fun p => (p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : ℂ))
        (fun k prev p =>
          let y := prev (fun i =>
            p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2))⟩)
          y + (ρ y : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp
              ((p ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1))⟩ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        n
    have h_pref_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (walkPrefixPos n) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          exact Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
      | succ k ih =>
          have h_tr : Measurable (fun (p : Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ) (i : Finset.range (k + 1)) =>
              p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2))⟩) :=
            Measurable.of_eval fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _
          have hy_meas : Measurable (fun p : Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ =>
              walkPrefixPos k (fun i =>
                p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2))⟩)) :=
            ih.comp h_tr
          have h_ang : Measurable (fun p : Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ =>
              Complex.exp
                ((p ⟨k + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (k + 1))⟩ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
            Complex.measurable_exp.comp
              ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)).mul measurable_const)
          exact hy_meas.add ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hρ_meas.comp hy_meas)).mul h_ang)
    have h_pref_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        walkPos ρ om n = walkPrefixPos n (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          intro om; rfl
      | succ k ih =>
          intro om
          change walkPos ρ om k +
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om k) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = _
          rw [ih om]
          rfl
    let om_ext : ∀ (k : ℕ), (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ → WalkSpace :=
      fun k p θ i =>
        if hi : i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) then p ⟨i, hi⟩
        else if i = k + 1 then θ
        else 0
    have h_om_ext_restr : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) (θ : ℝ),
        Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) (om_ext k p θ) = p := by
      intro k p θ
      ext ⟨i, hi⟩
      dsimp only [Finset.restrict, om_ext]
      rw [dif_pos hi]
    have h_om_ext_next : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) (θ : ℝ),
        om_ext k p θ (k + 1) = θ := by
      intro k p θ
      have h_not : k + 1 ∉ Finset.range (k + 1) := by simp [Finset.mem_range]
      dsimp only [om_ext]
      rw [dif_neg h_not, if_pos rfl]
    have h_pref_ball : ∀ (k : ℕ) (p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ),
        Metric.closedBall (walkPrefixPos k p) (ρ (walkPrefixPos k p)) ⊆ U := by
      intro k p
      have h1 := h_walk_U (om_ext k p 0) k
      rw [h_pref_eq k (om_ext k p 0), h_om_ext_restr] at h1
      exact h1
    let g_meas : ℂ → ℂ := U.indicator g
    have hg_meas : Measurable g_meas := h_meas_ind hU_open hg_holo.continuousOn
    have hg_meas_eq : ∀ z ∈ U, g_meas z = g z := fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_mem hz g
    let W_pre : ∀ n : ℕ, (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun n => Classical.choose (hw_adapt n)
    have hW_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (W_pre n) := fun n => (Classical.choose_spec (hw_adapt n)).1
    have hW_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        w n om = W_pre n (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om) :=
      fun n => (Classical.choose_spec (hw_adapt n)).2
    let D : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
      w n om * (g (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - g (walkPos ρ om n))
    let Z : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun m om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, D n om
    have hD_norm : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), ‖D n om‖ ≤ Real.sqrt Q := by
      intro n om
      have h_sq : ‖D n om‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q := by
        refine le_trans ?_ (h_quad om (n + 1))
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun l _ => sq_nonneg ‖D l om‖)
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
      rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (D n om))]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq
    let trunc : ∀ {l k : ℕ}, l ≤ k → (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → (Finset.range (l + 1) → ℝ) :=
      fun hlk p i =>
        p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2) (Nat.succ_le_succ hlk))⟩
    have h_trunc_meas : ∀ {l k : ℕ} (hlk : l ≤ k), Measurable (trunc hlk) := by
      intro l k hlk
      exact Measurable.of_eval fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _
    let Z_pre : ∀ (k m : ℕ), (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun k m p =>
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
        if hn : n + 1 ≤ k then
          W_pre n (trunc (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn) p) *
            (g_meas (walkPrefixPos (n + 1) (trunc hn p)) -
              g_meas (walkPrefixPos n (trunc (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn) p)))
        else 0
    have hZ_pre_meas : ∀ k m : ℕ, Measurable (Z_pre k m) := by
      intro k m
      dsimp only [Z_pre]
      refine Finset.measurable_sum (Finset.range m) fun n _ => ?_
      by_cases hn : n + 1 ≤ k
      · simp only [dif_pos hn]
        exact ((hW_meas n).comp (h_trunc_meas (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn))).mul
          ((hg_meas.comp ((h_pref_meas (n + 1)).comp (h_trunc_meas hn))).sub
            (hg_meas.comp ((h_pref_meas n).comp (h_trunc_meas (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn)))))
      · simp only [dif_neg hn]
        exact measurable_const
    have hZ_pre_eq : ∀ {k m : ℕ}, m ≤ k → ∀ om : WalkSpace,
        Z m om = Z_pre k m (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om) := by
      intro k m hmk om
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      have hn1 : n + 1 ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hn) hmk)
      simp only [dif_pos hn1]
      have h_y1 : walkPos ρ om (n + 1) ∈ U :=
        h_walk_U om (n + 1) (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
      have h_y0 : walkPos ρ om n ∈ U :=
        h_walk_U om n (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
      have ht1 : trunc hn1 (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om) =
          Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 2)) om := rfl
      have ht0 : trunc (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn1) (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om) =
          Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om := rfl
      rw [ht1, ht0, ← h_pref_eq (n + 1) om, ← h_pref_eq n om,
        hg_meas_eq _ h_y1, hg_meas_eq _ h_y0, ← hW_eq n om]
    let keep_pre : ∀ k : ℕ, Set (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) := fun k =>
      {p | ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖Z_pre k m p‖ ≤ lam}
    have h_keep_pre_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet (keep_pre k) := by
      intro k
      have h_eq : keep_pre k =
          ⋂ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), {p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ | ‖Z_pre k m p‖ ≤ lam} := by
        ext p; simp [keep_pre]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun m _ =>
        measurableSet_le (continuous_norm.measurable.comp (hZ_pre_meas k m)) measurable_const
    let keep : ℕ → WalkSpace → Prop := fun k om => ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ‖Z m om‖ ≤ lam
    have h_keep_iff : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        keep k om ↔ Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om ∈ keep_pre k := by
      intro k om
      simp only [keep, keep_pre, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      refine forall₂_congr fun m hm => ?_
      rw [hZ_pre_eq (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)) om]
    open Classical in
    let D_tilde : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun k om => if keep k om then D k om else 0
    let Z_tilde : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun k =>
      Nat.rec (fun _ => 0) (fun j prev om => prev om + D_tilde j om) k
    have hZ_tilde_adapt : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ Zt_pre : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ,
        Measurable Zt_pre ∧
        (∀ om : WalkSpace, Z_tilde k om = Zt_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om)) ∧
        (∀ p : Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ, ‖Zt_pre p‖ ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Q) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨fun _ => 0, measurable_const, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => by simp⟩
      | succ k ih =>
          rcases ih with ⟨Zt_k, hZt_meas, hZt_eq, _hZt_bd⟩
          let hk_le : k ≤ k + 1 := Nat.le_succ k
          let D_tilde_pre : (Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p =>
            (keep_pre k).indicator (fun q =>
              W_pre k q *
                (g_meas (walkPrefixPos (k + 1) p) - g_meas (walkPrefixPos k q)))
              (trunc hk_le p)
          have hDt_meas : Measurable D_tilde_pre := by
            have h_ind_eq : D_tilde_pre =
                ((trunc hk_le) ⁻¹' (keep_pre k)).indicator (fun p : Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ =>
                  W_pre k (trunc hk_le p) *
                    (g_meas (walkPrefixPos (k + 1) p) -
                      g_meas (walkPrefixPos k (trunc hk_le p)))) := by
              ext p
              by_cases hp : trunc hk_le p ∈ keep_pre k <;>
                simp [D_tilde_pre, Set.indicator, hp]
            rw [h_ind_eq]
            refine Measurable.indicator ?_ ((h_keep_pre_meas k).preimage (h_trunc_meas hk_le))
            exact ((hW_meas k).comp (h_trunc_meas hk_le)).mul
              ((hg_meas.comp (h_pref_meas (k + 1))).sub
                (hg_meas.comp ((h_pref_meas k).comp (h_trunc_meas hk_le))))
          let Zt_next : (Finset.range (k + 2) → ℝ) → ℂ :=
            fun p => Zt_k (trunc hk_le p) + D_tilde_pre p
          have hZt_next_eq : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
              Z_tilde (k + 1) om = Zt_next (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 2)) om) := by
            intro om
            change Z_tilde k om + D_tilde k om = _
            have h_tr_eq : trunc hk_le (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 2)) om) =
                Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om := rfl
            have h_y1 : walkPos ρ om (k + 1) ∈ U :=
              h_walk_U om (k + 1) (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
            have h_y0 : walkPos ρ om k ∈ U :=
              h_walk_U om k (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
            have hDt_eq : D_tilde k om =
                D_tilde_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 2)) om) := by
              by_cases hk_om : keep k om
              · have hk_pre : Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om ∈ keep_pre k :=
                  (h_keep_iff k om).mp hk_om
                simp only [D_tilde, if_pos hk_om, D_tilde_pre, h_tr_eq,
                  Set.indicator_of_mem hk_pre, ← h_pref_eq (k + 1) om, ← h_pref_eq k om,
                  hg_meas_eq _ h_y1, hg_meas_eq _ h_y0, ← hW_eq k om, D]
              · have hk_pre : Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om ∉ keep_pre k :=
                  fun h => hk_om ((h_keep_iff k om).mpr h)
                simp only [D_tilde, if_neg hk_om, D_tilde_pre, h_tr_eq,
                  Set.indicator_of_notMem hk_pre]
            simp only [Zt_next, h_tr_eq, ← hZt_eq om, ← hDt_eq]
          refine ⟨Zt_next, (hZt_meas.comp (h_trunc_meas hk_le)).add hDt_meas, hZt_next_eq, ?_⟩
          intro p
          let om_p := om_ext (k + 1) p 0
          have h_eq_p : Zt_next p = Z_tilde k om_p + D_tilde k om_p := by
            rw [← h_om_ext_restr (k + 1) p 0, ← hZt_next_eq om_p]
          rw [h_eq_p, hZt_eq om_p]
          have hDt_le : ‖D_tilde k om_p‖ ≤ Real.sqrt Q := by
            by_cases hk_p : keep k om_p
            · simp only [D_tilde, if_pos hk_p]
              exact hD_norm k om_p
            · simp only [D_tilde, if_neg hk_p, norm_zero]
              exact Real.sqrt_nonneg Q
          calc
            ‖Zt_k (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om_p) + D_tilde k om_p‖
              ≤ ‖Zt_k (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om_p)‖ + ‖D_tilde k om_p‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt Q := add_le_add (_hZt_bd _) hDt_le
            _ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Q := by push_cast; ring
    have hD_tilde_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (D_tilde k) := by
      intro k
      have h_sub : D_tilde k = fun om => Z_tilde (k + 1) om - Z_tilde k om := by
        ext om
        change D_tilde k om = (Z_tilde k om + D_tilde k om) - Z_tilde k om
        ring
      rw [h_sub]
      rcases hZ_tilde_adapt (k + 1) with ⟨Zt1, hZt1_m, hZt1_eq, _⟩
      rcases hZ_tilde_adapt k with ⟨Zt0, hZt0_m, hZt0_eq, _⟩
      have h_eq2 : (fun om => Z_tilde (k + 1) om - Z_tilde k om) =
          fun om => Zt1 (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 2)) om) -
            Zt0 (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om) := by
        ext om; rw [hZt1_eq om, hZt0_eq om]
      rw [h_eq2]
      exact (hZt1_m.comp (Finset.measurable_restrict _)).sub
        (hZt0_m.comp (Finset.measurable_restrict _))
    have hZ_tilde_int_sq : ∀ k : ℕ,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖Z_tilde k om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
      intro k
      rcases hZ_tilde_adapt k with ⟨Zt_k, hZt_m, hZt_eq, hZt_bd⟩
      have h_m : Measurable (fun om => ‖Z_tilde k om‖ ^ 2) := by
        have h_eq : (fun om => ‖Z_tilde k om‖ ^ 2) =
            fun om => ‖Zt_k (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om)‖ ^ 2 := by
          ext om; rw [hZt_eq om]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable.comp (hZt_m.comp (Finset.measurable_restrict _))
      refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_m.aestronglyMeasurable
        (((k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Q) ^ 2) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), hZt_eq om]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hZt_bd _) 2
    have hD_tilde_int_sq : ∀ k : ℕ,
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om => ‖D_tilde k om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
      intro k
      have h_m : Measurable (fun om => ‖D_tilde k om‖ ^ 2) :=
        (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable.comp (hD_tilde_meas k)
      refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound h_m.aestronglyMeasurable Q
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      by_cases hk_om : keep k om
      · simp only [D_tilde, if_pos hk_om]
        have h1 := hD_norm k om
        calc
          ‖D k om‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt Q) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
          _ = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQ_nn
      · simp only [D_tilde, if_neg hk_om, norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
          zero_pow]
        exact hQ_nn
    have h_orth_step : ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∫ om, ‖Z_tilde (k + 1) om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
          (∫ om, ‖Z_tilde k om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) +
            (∫ om, ‖D_tilde k om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) := by
      intro k
      rcases hZ_tilde_adapt k with ⟨Zt_k, hZt_m, hZt_eq, hZt_bd⟩
      let c_pre : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ :=
        (keep_pre k).indicator (fun p => starRingEnd ℂ (Zt_k p) * W_pre k p)
      have hc_meas : Measurable c_pre :=
        Measurable.indicator
          ((Complex.continuous_conj.measurable.comp hZt_m).mul (hW_meas k))
          (h_keep_pre_meas k)
      let Φ : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>
        (c_pre q.1 *
          (g_meas (circleMap (walkPrefixPos k q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos k q.1)) q.2) -
            g_meas (walkPrefixPos k q.1))).re
      have h_circ_meas : Measurable (fun q : ℂ × ℝ × ℝ => circleMap q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) := by
        refine Continuous.measurable ?_
        unfold circleMap
        fun_prop
      have hΦ_meas : Measurable Φ := by
        have h_cm : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
            circleMap (walkPrefixPos k q.1) (ρ (walkPrefixPos k q.1)) q.2) :=
          h_circ_meas.comp (((h_pref_meas k).comp measurable_fst).prodMk
            (((hρ_meas.comp ((h_pref_meas k).comp measurable_fst))).prodMk measurable_snd))
        exact Complex.continuous_re.measurable.comp
          ((hc_meas.comp measurable_fst).mul
            ((hg_meas.comp h_cm).sub (hg_meas.comp ((h_pref_meas k).comp measurable_fst))))
      let X_pre : WalkSpace → (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) := Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1))
      let X_next : WalkSpace → ℝ := fun om => om (k + 1)
      have hΦ_pt : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
          (starRingEnd ℂ (Z_tilde k om) * D_tilde k om).re = Φ (X_pre om, X_next om) := by
        intro om
        have hy0_eq : walkPos ρ om k = walkPrefixPos k (X_pre om) := h_pref_eq k om
        have hy1_eq : walkPos ρ om (k + 1) =
            circleMap (walkPrefixPos k (X_pre om)) (ρ (walkPrefixPos k (X_pre om))) (X_next om) := by
          change walkPos ρ om k +
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om k) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = _
          rw [hy0_eq]
          rfl
        have hy0_U : walkPos ρ om k ∈ U :=
          h_walk_U om k (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
        have hy1_U : walkPos ρ om (k + 1) ∈ U :=
          h_walk_U om (k + 1) (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (hρ_nn _))
        by_cases hk_om : keep k om
        · have hk_pre : X_pre om ∈ keep_pre k := (h_keep_iff k om).mp hk_om
          dsimp only [D_tilde, Φ, c_pre, D]
          rw [if_pos hk_om, Set.indicator_of_mem hk_pre, ← hy1_eq, ← hy0_eq,
            hg_meas_eq _ hy1_U, hg_meas_eq _ hy0_U, hZt_eq om, hW_eq k om]
          dsimp only [X_pre]
          rw [mul_assoc]
        · have hk_pre : X_pre om ∉ keep_pre k := fun h => hk_om ((h_keep_iff k om).mpr h)
          simp only [D_tilde, if_neg hk_om, mul_zero, Complex.zero_re, Φ, c_pre,
            Set.indicator_of_notMem hk_pre, zero_mul]
      have hΦ_bd : ∀ q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ, ‖Φ q‖ ≤ (k : ℝ) * Q := by
        intro ⟨p, θ⟩
        let om₀ := om_ext k p θ
        have h1 : Φ (p, θ) = (starRingEnd ℂ (Z_tilde k om₀) * D_tilde k om₀).re := by
          have hp := hΦ_pt (om_ext k p θ)
          dsimp only [X_pre, X_next] at hp
          rw [h_om_ext_restr k p θ, h_om_ext_next k p θ] at hp
          exact hp.symm
        rw [h1, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have h_abs : |(starRingEnd ℂ (Z_tilde k om₀) * D_tilde k om₀).re| ≤
            ‖starRingEnd ℂ (Z_tilde k om₀) * D_tilde k om₀‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        refine le_trans h_abs ?_
        rw [norm_mul, RingHomIsometric.norm_map, hZt_eq om₀]
        have hDt_le : ‖D_tilde k om₀‖ ≤ Real.sqrt Q := by
          by_cases hk0 : keep k om₀
          · simp only [D_tilde, if_pos hk0]; exact hD_norm k om₀
          · simp only [D_tilde, if_neg hk0, norm_zero]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg Q
        calc
          ‖Zt_k (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om₀)‖ * ‖D_tilde k om₀‖
            ≤ ((k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt Q) * Real.sqrt Q :=
              mul_le_mul (hZt_bd _) hDt_le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (k : ℝ) * (Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt Q) := by ring
          _ = (k : ℝ) * Q := by rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hQ_nn]
      have h_pre_meas : Measurable X_pre := Finset.measurable_restrict _

      linarith
    · rw [Complex.cos, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have h_add := norm_add_le (Complex.exp (w * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp (-w * Complex.I))
      linarith
  have h_step_bounds : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y →
      sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ B_geom →
      (∀ j : Fin P.N, slicePhaseDepth S P y * ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤ η_ang) →
      (∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (2 * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
            ((slicePhaseDepth S P y)⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) * (ρ y) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ R_pos : ℝ, (∀ k : Fin P.N, 1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y‖ ≤ R_pos) →
        ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖(R_pos : ℂ)⁻¹ * (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ^ 2 ≤
            (8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
              ((slicePhaseDepth S P y)⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) * (ρ y) ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy z hz h_geom h_dang
    let r_y : ℝ := slicePhaseDepth S P y
    have hr_pos : 0 < r_y := (h_ball_reg y hy).1
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg y
    have h_d_le : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤ η_ang * r_y⁻¹ := by
      intro j
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_dang j) (inv_nonneg.mpr hr_pos.le)
      have h2 : r_y⁻¹ * (r_y * ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖) =
          ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr_pos.ne', one_mul]
      rw [h2] at h1
      linarith
    have h_exp_sq : (Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := by
      rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]
      exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
    constructor
    · intro j
      let Δψ := sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y
      let ψ' := deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y
      have h_tri : ‖Δψ‖ ≤ (η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by
        have h_eq : Δψ = (Δψ - ψ' * z) + ψ' * z := by ring
        calc
          ‖Δψ‖ = ‖(Δψ - ψ' * z) + ψ' * z‖ := congrArg norm h_eq
          _ ≤ ‖Δψ - ψ' * z‖ + ‖ψ' * z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y + ‖ψ'‖ * ‖z‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul]
                exact add_le_add (hAdm.taylor_angle y hy z hz j) le_rfl
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y + (η_ang * r_y⁻¹) * ρ y :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul (h_d_le j) hz (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = (η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by ring
      have h_sq1 : ‖Δψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
          ((η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_tri 2
      refine le_trans h_sq1 ?_
      have h_ab : (η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 ≤
          2 * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := by
        have h0 : 0 ≤ (η_ang * r_y⁻¹ - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        nlinarith [h_exp_sq]
      have h_fac : 2 * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) ≤
          (2 * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) * (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) := by
        have hr2 : 0 ≤ r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        have he : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := Real.exp_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      calc
        ((η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y) ^ 2
          = (η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ ((2 * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) * (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1)) *
              (ρ y) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans h_ab h_fac) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (2 * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
              (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
    · intro R_pos hR_ge j
      have h1_le_R : 1 ≤ R_pos :=
        le_trans (by linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y)]) (hR_ge j)
      have hR_pos : 0 < R_pos := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one h1_le_R
      have hX_le_R : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ R_pos := by linarith [hR_ge j]
      have hX0 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ ≤ R_pos :=
        le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y) 0) hX_le_R
      have hX1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ ≤ R_pos :=
        le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y) 1) hX_le_R
      have hψ_le_B : ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤ B_geom := by
        have h_mem := Finset.le_sup' (f := fun k : Fin P.N =>
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N k.val y‖ +
            Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val y‖) +
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 k y)‖| +
            |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice k y‖|) (Finset.mem_univ j)
        have h_log_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) :=
          Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [norm_nonneg (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y)])
        have h_abs1 : 0 ≤ |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| := abs_nonneg _
        have h_abs2 : 0 ≤ |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖| := abs_nonneg _
        change _ ≤ sliceGeomCost S P y at h_mem
        linarith
      have h_sin_le : ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_geom :=
        le_trans (h_sin_cos_exp _).1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hψ_le_B)
      have h_cos_le : ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ Real.exp B_geom :=
        le_trans (h_sin_cos_exp _).2 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hψ_le_B)
      have h_dsup_le : ‖deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤
          R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹) := by
        rw [P.reg_deriv_support y hy j, norm_mul]
        have h_lin_comb :
            ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
              slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤
            2 * R_pos * Real.exp B_geom := by
          calc
            ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
                slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖
              ≤ ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ +
                  ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ :=
                norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ * ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ +
                  ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ * ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_mul]
            _ ≤ R_pos * Real.exp B_geom + R_pos * Real.exp B_geom :=
                add_le_add
                  (mul_le_mul hX0 h_sin_le (norm_nonneg _) hR_pos.le)
                  (mul_le_mul hX1 h_cos_le (norm_nonneg _) hR_pos.le)
            _ = 2 * R_pos * Real.exp B_geom := by ring
        calc
          ‖-slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) +
              slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ *
              ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖
            ≤ (2 * R_pos * Real.exp B_geom) * (η_ang * r_y⁻¹) :=
              mul_le_mul h_lin_comb (h_d_le j) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹) := by ring
      let ΔH := sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y
      let H' := deriv (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val) y
      have h_ΔH : ‖ΔH‖ ≤
          R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by
        have h_eq : ΔH = (ΔH - H' * z) + H' * z := by ring
        have h_rem : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y ≤
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R_pos * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hR_ge j) (by positivity))
              (Real.exp_nonneg _))
            hρ_nn
        calc
          ‖ΔH‖ = ‖(ΔH - H' * z) + H' * z‖ := congrArg norm h_eq
          _ ≤ ‖ΔH - H' * z‖ + ‖H' * z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R_pos * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y + ‖H'‖ * ‖z‖ := by
                rw [norm_mul]
                exact add_le_add (le_trans (hAdm.taylor_support y hy z hz j) h_rem) le_rfl
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R_pos * Real.exp (-M ^ 3) * ρ y +
                (R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹)) * ρ y :=
                add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul h_dsup_le hz (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
          _ = R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ +
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by ring
      have h_norm_scaled : ‖(R_pos : ℂ)⁻¹ * ΔH‖ ≤
          (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR_pos]
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ΔH (inv_nonneg.mpr hR_pos.le)
        have h2 : R_pos⁻¹ *
            (R_pos * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y) =
            (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hR_pos.ne', one_mul]
        rwa [h2] at h1
      have h_sq1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_norm_scaled 2
      refine le_trans h_sq1 ?_
      have h_expB_sq : (Real.exp B_geom) ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * B_geom) := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add]
        exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
      have h_ab : (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 ≤
          8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := by
        have h0 : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ -
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        have h_t1 : 2 * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹) ^ 2 =
            8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
          calc
            2 * (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹) ^ 2
              = 8 * (Real.exp B_geom) ^ 2 * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring
            _ = 8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := by rw [h_expB_sq]
        nlinarith [h_t1, h_exp_sq]
      have h_fac : 8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) ≤
          (8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
            (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) := by
        have hr2 : 0 ≤ r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        have heB : 0 ≤ Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 := by positivity
        have heM : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := Real.exp_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      calc
        ((2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) * ρ y) ^ 2
          = (2 * Real.exp B_geom * η_ang * r_y⁻¹ + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M ^ 3)) ^ 2 *
              (ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ ((8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
              (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1)) * (ρ y) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_trans h_ab h_fac) (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = (8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom) * η_ang ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
              (r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by ring
  
  have h_in_reg : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ), walkPos ρ om n ∈ Ω_reg :=
    fun om n => (hBase.walk_in_reg M ρ hAdm om n).1
  have h_walk_ball : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ),
      Metric.closedBall (walkPos ρ om n) (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ⊆ Ω_reg :=
    fun om n => (h_ball_reg _ (h_in_reg om n)).2
  let activeCut : WalkSpace → ℕ → Prop := fun om n =>
    H₀ ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j n) ∧
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j n) < M ∧
    sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ B_geom ∧
    (∀ j : Fin P.N,
      slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) *
        ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤ η_ang) ∧
    ∑ l ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      ((slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om l))⁻¹ ^ 2 + 1) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om l)) ^ 2 ≤ B_clk
  open Classical in
  let w_ang : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om => if activeCut om n then 1 else 0
  open Classical in
  let w_sup : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
    if activeCut om n then (bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0
  
  have h_weights_adapt :
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ W_pre : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ,
        Measurable W_pre ∧
          ∀ om : WalkSpace, w_ang n om = W_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ W_pre : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ,
        Measurable W_pre ∧
          ∀ om : WalkSpace, w_sup n om = W_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)) := by
    let walkPref : ∀ (k : ℕ), (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun k =>
      Nat.rec
        (motive := fun m => (Finset.range (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ)
        (fun p => (p ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ : ℂ))
        (fun m prev p =>
          let y := prev (fun i =>
            p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2))⟩)
          y + (ρ y : ℂ) *
            Complex.exp
              ((p ⟨m + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (m + 1))⟩ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        k
    have h_wp_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (walkPref k) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply _)
      | succ m ih =>
          have h_tr : Measurable (fun (p : Finset.range (m + 2) → ℝ) (i : Finset.range (m + 1)) =>
              p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2))⟩) :=
            Measurable.of_eval fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _
          have hy_m := ih.comp h_tr
          have h_ang : Measurable (fun p : Finset.range (m + 2) → ℝ =>
              Complex.exp
                ((p ⟨m + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (m + 1))⟩ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
            Complex.measurable_exp.comp
              ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp
                (measurable_pi_apply
                  (⟨m + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (m + 1))⟩ :
                    Finset.range (m + 2)))).mul
                measurable_const)
          exact hy_m.add ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp hy_m)).mul h_ang)
    have h_wp_eq : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        walkPos ρ om k = walkPref k (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (k + 1)) om) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => intro _; rfl
      | succ m ih =>
          intro om
          change walkPos ρ om m +
              (ρ (walkPos ρ om m) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (m + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = _
          rw [ih om]; rfl
    let geom_ind : ℂ → ℝ := Ω_reg.indicator (sliceGeomCost S P)
    let logd_ind : Fin P.N → ℂ → ℝ := fun j => Ω_reg.indicator (sliceLogDepth S P j)
    let pos_ind : Fin P.N → ℂ → ℝ := fun j =>
      Ω_reg.indicator (fun y => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖)
    let dang_ind : Fin P.N → ℂ → ℝ := fun j =>
      Ω_reg.indicator (fun y =>
        slicePhaseDepth S P y * ‖deriv (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) y‖)
    have h_phd_cont : Continuous (slicePhaseDepth S P) :=
      continuous_const.sub (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
    have h_geom_m : Measurable geom_ind := h_meas_ind hΩ_open h_geom_cont
    have h_logd_m : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (logd_ind j) :=
      fun j => h_meas_ind hΩ_open (h_logd_cont j)
    have h_pos_m : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (pos_ind j) :=
      fun j => h_meas_ind hΩ_open (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (h_pos_cont j))
    have h_dang_m : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (dang_ind j) :=
      fun j => h_meas_ind hΩ_open
        (h_phd_cont.continuousOn.mul (continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn (h_dang_cont j)))
    have h_pre_all : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ∃ (S_pre : Set (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ)) (R_pre : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ),
          MeasurableSet S_pre ∧ Measurable R_pre ∧
          (∀ om : WalkSpace,
            (activeCut om n ↔ Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om ∈ S_pre) ∧
            bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n =
              R_pre (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om)) := by
      intro n
      let tr : ∀ {l : ℕ}, l ≤ n → (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → (Finset.range (l + 1) → ℝ) :=
        fun hln p i =>
          p ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp i.2) (Nat.succ_le_succ hln))⟩
      have h_tr_m : ∀ {l : ℕ} (hln : l ≤ n), Measurable (tr hln) :=
        fun _ => Measurable.of_eval fun _ => measurable_pi_apply _
      let y_at : ∀ (l : ℕ), l ≤ n → (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ :=
        fun l hln p => walkPref l (tr hln p)
      have hy_at_m : ∀ (l : ℕ) (hln : l ≤ n), Measurable (y_at l hln) :=
        fun l hln => (h_wp_meas l).comp (h_tr_m hln)
      have hy_at_eq : ∀ (l : ℕ) (hln : l ≤ n) (om : WalkSpace),
          y_at l hln (Finset.restrict (Finset.range (n + 1)) om) = walkPos ρ om l := by
        intro l hln om
        exact (h_wp_eq l om).symm
      let hist_pre : Fin P.N → (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun j p =>
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ n)⟩ fun l =>
          if hl : l ≤ n then logd_ind j (y_at l hl p) else 0
      have h_hist_m : ∀ j : Fin P.N, Measurable (hist_pre j) := by
        intro j
        refine h_meas_sup' (Finset.range (n + 1)) _ _ fun l hl => ?_
        have hln : l ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)
        have h_eq : (fun p => if h : l ≤ n then logd_ind j (y_at l h p) else 0) =

        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
          w_ang n om *
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) =
        sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om τ₀) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hm_ge]
      have h_z : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range τ₀,
          w_ang n om *
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => ?_
        have hn_not := h_act_before n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
        simp [w_ang, hn_not]
      have h_ico : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico τ₀ m,
          w_ang n om *
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico τ₀ m,
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
        rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn with ⟨hn1, hn2⟩
        have hn_act := h_act_on n hn1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hn2 hm_le)
        simp [w_ang, hn_act]
      rw [h_z, zero_add, h_ico]
      exact Finset.sum_Ico_sub (fun k => sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om k)) hm_ge
    have h_sup_sum :
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m,
          w_sup n om *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico τ₀ m,
          ((bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hm_ge]
      have h_z : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range τ₀,
          w_sup n om *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) = 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => ?_
        have hn_not := h_act_before n (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
        simp [w_sup, hn_not]
      have h_ico : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico τ₀ m,
          w_sup n om *
            (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico τ₀ m,
            ((bootRunningPosMax S P (walkPos ρ om) n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
                sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n))) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
        rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn with ⟨hn1, hn2⟩
        have hn_act := h_act_on n hn1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hn2 hm_le)
        simp [w_sup, hn_act]
      rw [h_z, zero_add, h_ico]
    by_cases h_ang_ok :
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om τ₀)‖ ≤ lam
    · right
      exact ⟨m, by rw [h_sup_sum]; exact h_bad h_ang_ok⟩
    · left
      exact ⟨m, by rw [h_ang_sum]; exact lt_of_not_ge h_ang_ok⟩
  have h_union_le :
      walkMeasure.real E_target ≤
        (P.N : ℝ) * (Q_ang / lam ^ 2 + Q_sup / lam ^ 2) := by
    calc
      walkMeasure.real E_target
        ≤ walkMeasure.real (⋃ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), (E_ang j ∪ E_sup j)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub_union (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), walkMeasure.real (E_ang j ∪ E_sup j) :=
          MeasureTheory.measureReal_biUnion_finset_le Finset.univ (fun j => E_ang j ∪ E_sup j)
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
            (walkMeasure.real (E_ang j) + walkMeasure.real (E_sup j)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (E_ang j) (E_sup j)
      _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)), (Q_ang / lam ^ 2 + Q_sup / lam ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => add_le_add (h_meas_ang j) (h_meas_sup j)
      _ = (P.N : ℝ) * (Q_ang / lam ^ 2 + Q_sup / lam ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine le_trans h_union_le ?_
  have h_sum_Q :
      (P.N : ℝ) * (Q_ang / lam ^ 2 + Q_sup / lam ^ 2) =
        ((2 + 8 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom)) * η_ang ^ 2 + Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          ((P.N : ℝ) * B_clk / lam ^ 2) := by
    dsimp only [Q_ang, Q_sup, C_ang, C_sup]
    ring
  have h_rhs_eq :
      8 * (P.N : ℝ) * ((1 + 4 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom)) * η_ang ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) * B_clk / lam ^ 2 =
        (8 * (1 + 4 * Real.exp (2 * B_geom)) * η_ang ^ 2 + 8 * Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3)) *
          ((P.N : ℝ) * B_clk / lam ^ 2) := by
    ring
  rw [h_sum_Q, h_rhs_eq]
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by positivity)
  have he1 : 0 < Real.exp (2 * B_geom) := Real.exp_pos _
  have he2 : 0 < Real.exp (-2 * M ^ 3) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hη2 : 0 < η_ang ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hη
  nlinarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  haveI hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  have hN_pos : 0 < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    exact div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_mem : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh_pos : 0 < sliceHeight S P.N := by
    unfold sliceHeight
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_mem).1
  have h_log_h_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (sliceHeight S P.N + 1) :=
    Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁_ge, hDerivCap⟩ := slice_cofactor_impact_deriv_cap S hBudget P
  let D : ℝ := C₁ + 4
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    dsimp only [D]
    linarith
  intro δ hδ
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  let M_ph : ℝ :=
    max (max 2 (-Real.log S.H + 1))
      (max (4 / h)
        (max (2 * (18 + 8 * (P.N : ℝ)) / δ)
          (64 * (Real.log (h + 1) + 4 * D) / δ)))
  have h2_le_Mph : 2 ≤ M_ph :=
    le_trans (le_max_left 2 (-Real.log S.H + 1)) (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨M_ph, h2_le_Mph, ?_⟩
  intro M hM_ge ρ hAdm2M
  have hM_two : 2 ≤ M := le_trans h2_le_Mph hM_ge
  have hM_one : 1 ≤ M := by linarith
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hM_H : -Real.log S.H + 1 ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right 2 (-Real.log S.H + 1)) (le_max_left _ _)) hM_ge
  have hM_h : 4 / sliceHeight S P.N ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hM_ge
  have hM_deep : 2 * (18 + 8 * (P.N : ℝ)) / δ ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hM_ge
  have hM_clk : 64 * (Real.log (h + 1) + 4 * D) / δ ≤ M :=
    le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))) hM_ge
  have hStep : PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ :=
    walk_step_expectation_toolkit S P C_clk (2 * M) hBase ρ hAdm2M
  let ε : ℝ := Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := Real.exp_pos _
  have hε_le : ε ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp only [ε]
    rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
    nlinarith
  have h_log_ε : Real.log ε = -4 * (C₁ + 4) * M := by
    dsimp only [ε]
    exact Real.log_exp _
  let E_target : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
      M ^ 2 < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2}
  let E_no_stop : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace | ¬ ∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)}
  let E_deep : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
      ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)}
  let E_clk : Set WalkSpace :=
    {om : WalkSpace |
      (∀ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        ε ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n)) ∧
      M ^ 2 < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M om),
        (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2}
  have h_sub : E_target ⊆ E_no_stop ∪ (E_deep ∪ E_clk) := by
    intro om ⟨h_geom, h_sum⟩
    by_cases h_stop : ∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)
    · by_cases h_hit : ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
          slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h_stop, h_geom, h_hit⟩)
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨?_, h_sum⟩)
        intro n hn
        by_contra h_lt
        exact h_hit ⟨n, hn, le_of_not_ge h_lt⟩
    · exact Or.inl h_stop
  have h_meas_no_stop : walkMeasure.real E_no_stop = 0 := by
    have h_ae : walkMeasure E_no_stop = 0 :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp (hBase.walk_stops (2 * M) ρ hAdm2M)
    simp [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, h_ae]
  have h_meas_deep : walkMeasure.real E_deep ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have h_s3 := deep_phase_hit_exclusion_on_good_geom S P C₁ M ρ
      hAdm2M hStep hC₁_ge hM_two hM_H hM_h (hDerivCap M hM_two)
    refine le_trans h_s3 ?_
    have h_M_le_exp : M ≤ Real.exp M :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp M)
    have h_M_exp_neg : M * Real.exp (-M) ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        M * Real.exp (-M) ≤ Real.exp M * Real.exp (-M) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_M_le_exp (Real.exp_nonneg (-M))
        _ = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
    have h_deep_mul : 2 * (18 + 8 * (P.N : ℝ)) ≤ M * δ :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hM_deep
    have h_exp_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-M) := Real.exp_nonneg (-M)
    nlinarith
  have h_meas_clk : walkMeasure.real E_clk ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have hM2_pos : 0 < M ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hM_pos
    have h_s4 := truncated_phase_clock_convex_barrier S P M ε (M ^ 2) ρ
      hStep hε_pos hε_le hM2_pos
    refine le_trans h_s4 ?_
    rw [h_log_ε, div_le_iff₀ hM2_pos]
    have h_clk_mul : 64 * (Real.log (h + 1) + 4 * D) ≤ M * δ :=
      (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hM_clk
    dsimp only [h, D] at h_clk_mul ⊢
    nlinarith
  have h_mono : walkMeasure.real E_target ≤
      walkMeasure.real (E_no_stop ∪ (E_deep ∪ E_clk)) :=
    MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
  have h_u1 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) E_no_stop (E_deep ∪ E_clk)
  have h_u2 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) E_deep E_clk
  linarith

stopped_phase_depth_and_clock_bound.definitions:
def phClkSetDependsUpTo (n : ℕ) (E : Set WalkSpace) : Prop :=
  MeasurableSet E ∧
    ∀ om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace, (∀ k ≤ n, om₁ k = om₂ k) → (om₁ ∈ E ↔ om₂ ∈ E)

noncomputable def phClkWallDist (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (sgn : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sliceHeight S P.N - sgn * y.im

noncomputable def phClkConcaveBarrier (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (sgn R : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  phClkWallDist S P sgn y * (4 * R - phClkWallDist S P sgn y)

noncomputable def phClkConvexBarrier (h ε v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -Real.log (h + ε - v) - Real.log (h + ε + v) + 2 * Real.log (h + ε)

structure PhClkStepToolkitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) : Prop where
  prob_walk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure
  walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n : ℕ,
    walkPos ρ om n ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    0 < slicePhaseDepth S P y ∧
    ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * slicePhaseDepth S P y
  walkPos_depends : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
    (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → walkPos ρ om₁ k = walkPos ρ om₂ k
  measurable_im : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (walkPos ρ om k).im)
  measurable_rho : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => ρ (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_logDepth : ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_geomCost : ∀ k : ℕ,
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om k))
  wall_linear_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) = 0
  wall_concave_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn R : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) =
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ om, E.indicator
        (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) om ∂walkMeasure
  masked_impact_l2 : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (E : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (N_hor : ℕ),
    (∀ n : ℕ, phClkSetDependsUpTo n (E n)) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
      ∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        ‖(E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure
  imag_step_lower_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (L q : ℂ → ℝ) (B_q : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Icc (-sliceHeight S P.N) (sliceHeight S P.N)) →
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, 0 ≤ q y ∧ q y ≤ B_q) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ ρ y →
      L y * δ + 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ ψ (y.im + δ) - ψ y.im) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤
      (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
        (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im) ∂walkMeasure)

structure PhClkStepToolkitProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) : Prop where
  prob_walk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure
  walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n : ℕ,
    walkPos ρ om n ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
  reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
    0 < slicePhaseDepth S P y ∧
    ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * slicePhaseDepth S P y
  walkPos_depends : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
    (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → walkPos ρ om₁ k = walkPos ρ om₂ k
  measurable_im : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (walkPos ρ om k).im)
  measurable_rho : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => ρ (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_logDepth : ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om k))
  measurable_geomCost : ∀ k : ℕ,
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om k))
  wall_linear_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) = 0
  wall_concave_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (sgn R : ℝ) (E : Set WalkSpace),
    (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → phClkSetDependsUpTo n E →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (E.indicator fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, E.indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R (walkPos ρ om n)) om ∂walkMeasure) =
      -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ om, E.indicator
        (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) om ∂walkMeasure
  masked_impact_l2 : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (E : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (N_hor : ℕ),
    (∀ n : ℕ, phClkSetDependsUpTo n (E n)) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace =>
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
      ∫ om, (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
        ‖(E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)) om‖ ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure
  imag_step_lower_drift : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (L q : ℂ → ℝ) (B_q : ℝ),
    ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Icc (-sliceHeight S P.N) (sliceHeight S P.N)) →
    Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n)) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, 0 ≤ q y ∧ q y ≤ B_q) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ ρ y →
      L y * δ + 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ ψ (y.im + δ) - ψ y.im) →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im)) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤
      (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
        (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im) ∂walkMeasure)

by
  
  have h_sp : ∀ (y : ℂ) (r H : ℝ) (s : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r → DifferentiableOn ℂ s (Metric.ball y r) →
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball y r, s ζ ∈ horizStrip H) →
      r * ‖deriv s y‖ ≤ 2 * (H - |(s y).im|) := by
    intro y r H s hr hs_holo hs_maps
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Metric.ball y r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    have hsy_im : |(s y).im| < H := hs_maps y hy_mem
    let δ : ℝ := H - |(s y).im|
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := sub_pos.mpr hsy_im
    let ε : ℝ := if 0 ≤ (s y).im then 1 else -1
    have hε_abs : |ε| = 1 := by
      dsimp only [ε]
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hε_norm : ‖(ε : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, hε_abs]
    have hε_sy : ε * (s y).im = |(s y).im| := by
      dsimp only [ε]
      split_ifs with h0
      · rw [one_mul, abs_of_nonneg h0]
      · rw [neg_one_mul, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h0)]
    have hε_le_abs : ∀ x : ℝ, ε * x ≤ |x| := by
      intro x
      dsimp only [ε]
      split_ifs
      · rw [one_mul]; exact le_abs_self x
      · rw [neg_one_mul]; exact neg_le_abs x
    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => (H : ℂ) + Complex.I * (ε : ℂ) * (s ζ - ((s y).re : ℂ))
    have hg_re : ∀ ζ : ℂ, (g ζ).re = H - ε * (s ζ).im := by
      intro ζ
      simp only [g, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
      ring
    have hg_im : ∀ ζ : ℂ, (g ζ).im = ε * ((s ζ).re - (s y).re) := by
      intro ζ
      simp only [g, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.sub_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
      ring
    have hgy : g y = (δ : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext
      · rw [hg_re y, hε_sy, Complex.ofReal_re]
      · rw [hg_im y, sub_self, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im]
    have hg_re_pos : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball y r, 0 < (g ζ).re := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [hg_re ζ]
      have h1 : |(s ζ).im| < H := hs_maps ζ hζ
      have h2 : ε * (s ζ).im ≤ |(s ζ).im| := hε_le_abs (s ζ).im
      linarith
    have hg_den_ne : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball y r, g ζ + (δ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ h0
      have hre : (g ζ + (δ : ℂ)).re = 0 := by rw [h0, Complex.zero_re]
      have hpos : 0 < (g ζ + (δ : ℂ)).re := by
        rw [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
        linarith [hg_re_pos ζ hζ]
      linarith
    let Φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun ζ => (g ζ - (δ : ℂ)) / (g ζ + (δ : ℂ))
    have hΦ_y : Φ y = 0 := by
      dsimp only [Φ]
      rw [hgy, sub_self, zero_div]
    have hg_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball y r) :=
      ((hs_holo.sub_const _).const_mul _).const_add _
    have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball y r) :=
      (hg_holo.sub_const _).div (hg_holo.add_const _) hg_den_ne
    have hΦ_maps : Set.MapsTo Φ (Metric.ball y r) (Metric.closedBall (Φ y) 1) := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [hΦ_y, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      dsimp only [Φ]
      rw [norm_div]
      have hden_pos : 0 < ‖g ζ + (δ : ℂ)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hg_den_ne ζ hζ)
      rw [div_le_one hden_pos]
      rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
      rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero, add_zero]
      have hpos := hg_re_pos ζ hζ
      nlinarith
    have hs_at : HasDerivAt s (deriv s y) y :=
      (hs_holo.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy_mem)).hasDerivAt
    have hg_at : HasDerivAt g (Complex.I * (ε : ℂ) * deriv s y) y :=
      ((hs_at.sub_const _).const_mul (Complex.I * (ε : ℂ))).const_add (H : ℂ)
    have hden_y_ne : g y + (δ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := hg_den_ne y hy_mem
    have hΦ_at : HasDerivAt Φ
        (((Complex.I * (ε : ℂ) * deriv s y) * (g y + (δ : ℂ)) -
          (g y - (δ : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * (ε : ℂ) * deriv s y)) /
          (g y + (δ : ℂ)) ^ 2) y :=
      (hg_at.sub_const _).div (hg_at.add_const _) hden_y_ne
    have hΦ_deriv_eq : deriv Φ y = (Complex.I * (ε : ℂ) * deriv s y) / (2 * (δ : ℂ)) := by
      rw [hΦ_at.deriv, hgy]
      have hδ_c_ne : (δ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hδ_pos.ne'
      field_simp [hδ_c_ne]
      ring
    have hΦ_deriv_norm : ‖deriv Φ y‖ = ‖deriv s y‖ / (2 * δ) := by
      rw [hΦ_deriv_eq, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, hε_norm, one_mul, one_mul,
        norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos]
    have h_bound := Complex.norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hΦ_holo hΦ_maps hr
    rw [hΦ_deriv_norm] at h_bound
    have h2δ_pos : 0 < 2 * δ := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h2δ_pos hr] at h_bound
    linarith

  
  have h_pigeon : ∀ (M : ℝ) (K_vec : Fin P.N → ℝ),
      2 ≤ M →
      M ^ (σ + bootEps0 σ) ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty K_vec →
      ∃ (ν : Fin (P.N + 1)) (I : Finset (Fin P.N)),
        I ⊂ Finset.univ ∧
        (∀ i ∈ I, K_vec i ≤ M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin P.N, j ∉ I → M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ) ≤ K_vec j) := by
    intro M K_vec hM hK_sup
    have hM_gt_one : 1 < M := by linarith
    have hε₀_pos : 0 < bootEps0 σ := by unfold bootEps0; linarith
    have hη_pos : 0 < bootGapEta P.N σ := by unfold bootGapEta; positivity
    have h_sep : ∀ ν₁ ν₂ : Fin (P.N + 1), ν₁ < ν₂ →
        M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν₁ + bootGapEta P.N σ) < M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν₂ := by
      intro ν₁ ν₂ hlt
      refine Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hM_gt_one ?_
      have hnat : ν₁.val + 1 ≤ ν₂.val := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt
      have hreal : (ν₁.val : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (ν₂.val : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
      unfold bootGapXi
      nlinarith
    have h_gap : ∃ ν : Fin (P.N + 1), ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        K_vec j ≤ M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν ∨
        M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ) ≤ K_vec j := by
      by_contra h_no
      have h_all : ∀ ν : Fin (P.N + 1), ∃ j : Fin P.N,
          M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν < K_vec j ∧
          K_vec j < M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ) := by
        intro ν
        by_contra hν_ok
        apply h_no
        refine ⟨ν, fun j => ?_⟩
        by_cases h1 : K_vec j ≤ M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν
        · exact Or.inl h1
        · exact Or.inr (le_of_not_gt fun h2 => hν_ok ⟨j, lt_of_not_ge h1, h2⟩)
      let g : Fin (P.N + 1) → Fin P.N := fun ν => Classical.choose (h_all ν)
      have hg_spec : ∀ ν : Fin (P.N + 1),
          M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν < K_vec (g ν) ∧
          K_vec (g ν) < M ^ (bootGapXi P.N σ ν + bootGapEta P.N σ) :=
        fun ν => Classical.choose_spec (h_all ν)
      have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin P.N) < Fintype.card (Fin (P.N + 1)) := by
        simp [Fintype.card_fin]
      obtain ⟨ν₁, ν₂, hne, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt g hcard
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
      · have h1 := (hg_spec ν₁).2
        have h2 := h_sep ν₁ ν₂ hlt
        have h3 := (hg_spec ν₂).1
        rw [heq] at h1
        linarith
      · have h1 := (hg_spec ν₂).2
        have h2 := h_sep ν₂ ν₁ hgt
        have h3 := (hg_spec ν₁).1
        rw [← heq] at h1
        linarith
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := h_gap
    let I : Finset (Fin P.N) :=
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin P.N => K_vec i ≤ M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν)
    refine ⟨ν, I, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ I)]
      obtain ⟨j_star, hj_univ, hj_eq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty K_vec
      refine ⟨j_star, hj_univ, ?_⟩
      intro hj_in
      have hj_le : K_vec j_star ≤ M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj_in).2
      have h_xi_lt : bootGapXi P.N σ ν < σ + bootEps0 σ := by
        have hν_le : (ν.val : ℝ) ≤ (P.N : ℝ) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ ν.isLt
        have h_denom_pos : 0 < 3 * ((P.N : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
        have h_term_lt : (2 * (ν.val : ℝ) + 1) * bootGapEta P.N σ < 2 * bootEps0 σ / 3 := by
          unfold bootGapEta
          rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3)]
          nlinarith
        unfold bootGapXi
        linarith
      have h_pow_lt : M ^ bootGapXi P.N σ ν < M ^ (σ + bootEps0 σ) :=
        Real.rpow_lt_rpow_of_exponent_lt hM_gt_one h_xi_lt
      rw [hj_eq] at hK_sup
      linarith
    · intro i hi

  have h_elim : ∀ (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec z : Fin P.N → ℂ)
      (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)) (B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ)
      (B_M0 B_V B_del B_inv_entry : ℝ),
      Disjoint I F →
      0 ≤ B_M0 → 0 ≤ B_V → 0 ≤ B_del → 0 ≤ B_inv_entry →
      (jacobiH P.N S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec).mulVec z = 0 →
      B_inv * modifiedJacobiB P.N S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec I F = 1 →
      (∀ i k : Fin P.N, ‖jacobiM0 P.N ℓ_vec i k‖ ≤ B_M0) →
      (∀ i ∈ F, ‖jacobiVDiag P.N S.c f_vec d0_vec i‖ ≤ B_V) →
      (∀ k : Fin P.N, k ∉ I ∪ F → ‖z k‖ ≤ B_del) →
      (∀ r col : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r col‖ ≤ B_inv_entry) →
      (P.N : ℝ) * B_inv_entry * B_V ≤ 1 / 2 →
      ∀ k : Fin P.N, ‖z k‖ ≤ max B_del (2 * (P.N : ℝ) ^ 2 * B_inv_entry * B_M0 * B_del) := by
    intro f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec z I F B_inv B_M0 B_V B_del B_inv_entry
      hDisj hBM0 hBV hBdel hBinv_nn hNull hLeftInv hM0_bound hV_bound hDel_bound hInv_bound hContract
    let M0 := jacobiM0 P.N ℓ_vec
    let V := jacobiVDiag P.N S.c f_vec d0_vec
    let B := modifiedJacobiB P.N S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec I F
    have hRow : ∀ i : Fin P.N, ∑ k : Fin P.N, M0 i k * z k = V i * z i := by
      intro i
      have hi := congrFun hNull i
      simp only [jacobiH, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        Matrix.mulVec_diagonal] at hi
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    let z_ret : Fin P.N → ℂ := fun k => if k ∈ I ∪ F then z k else 0
    let rhs : Fin P.N → ℂ := fun i =>
      (if i ∈ F then V i * z_ret i else 0) -
      (if i ∈ I ∪ F then ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), M0 i k * z k else 0)
    have hB_mul : B.mulVec z_ret = rhs := by
      ext i
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      by_cases hi : i ∈ I ∪ F
      · rw [← Finset.sum_sdiff (Finset.subset_univ (I ∪ F))]
        have h_sdiff_zero : ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), B i k * z_ret k = 0 := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
          have hk_not : k ∉ I ∪ F := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk).2
          simp only [z_ret, hk_not, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
        rw [h_sdiff_zero, zero_add]
        have h_on : ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, B i k * z_ret k =
            (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, M0 i k * z k) -
            (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then V i * z k else 0) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
          simp only [B, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply, hi, hk, and_self, ↓reduceIte,
            z_ret, sub_mul]
          split_ifs <;> ring
        rw [h_on]
        have h_split_M0 := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun k => M0 i k * z k) (Finset.subset_univ (I ∪ F))
        have h_sum_IUF : ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, M0 i k * z k =
            V i * z i - ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), M0 i k * z k := by
          rw [hRow i] at h_split_M0
          exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' h_split_M0
        rw [h_sum_IUF]
        by_cases hiI : i ∈ I
        · have hiF : i ∉ F := Finset.disjoint_left.mp hDisj hiI
          have h_diag_sum : (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then V i * z k else 0) = V i * z i := by
            have h1 : (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then V i * z k else 0) =
                ∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, if i = k then V i * z k else 0 := by
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
              simp [hiI]
            rw [h1, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
            simp only [hi, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [h_diag_sum]
          simp only [rhs, hiF, hi, ↓reduceIte]
          ring
        · have hiF : i ∈ F := by
            rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hi with h1 | h2
            · exact absurd h1 hiI
            · exact h2
          have h_diag_zero : (∑ k ∈ I ∪ F, if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then V i * z k else 0) = 0 := by
            refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
            simp [hiI]
          rw [h_diag_zero, sub_zero]
          simp only [rhs, hiF, hi, ↓reduceIte, z_ret]
      · have hiF : i ∉ F := fun hF => hi (Finset.mem_union_right I hF)
        simp only [rhs, hiF, hi, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
        by_cases hik : i = k
        · subst hik
          simp only [z_ret, hi, ↓reduceIte, mul_zero]
        · have hnot : ¬ (i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F) := fun h => hi h.1
          simp only [B, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply, hnot, hik, ↓reduceIte, zero_mul]
    have hz_eq : z_ret = B_inv.mulVec rhs := by
      rw [← hB_mul, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hLeftInv, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    let Z_max : ℝ := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun r : Fin P.N => ‖z_ret r‖)
    have hZ_nn : 0 ≤ Z_max := by
      have r₀ : Fin P.N := ⟨0, NeZero.pos P.N⟩
      exact le_trans (norm_nonneg (z_ret r₀))
        (Finset.le_sup' (fun r : Fin P.N => ‖z_ret r‖) (Finset.mem_univ r₀))
    have hrhs_bound : ∀ col : Fin P.N, ‖rhs col‖ ≤ B_V * Z_max + (P.N : ℝ) * B_M0 * B_del := by
      intro col
      dsimp only [rhs]
      refine le_trans (norm_sub_le _ _) (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
      · split_ifs with hF
        · rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hV_bound col hF)
            (Finset.le_sup' (fun r : Fin P.N => ‖z_ret r‖) (Finset.mem_univ col))
            (norm_nonneg _) hBV
        · rw [norm_zero]; positivity
      · split_ifs with hUF
        · refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) ?_
          have h_each : ∀ k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), ‖M0 col k * z k‖ ≤ B_M0 * B_del := by
            intro k hk
            rw [norm_mul]
            exact mul_le_mul (hM0_bound col k) (hDel_bound k (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hk).2)
              (norm_nonneg _) hBM0
          have h_card : ((Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F)).card : ℝ) ≤ (P.N : ℝ) := by
            have h1 : (Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F)).card ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)).card :=
              Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_univ _)
            rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
            exact_mod_cast h1
          calc
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), ‖M0 col k * z k‖
              ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F), (B_M0 * B_del) := Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
            _ = ((Finset.univ \ (I ∪ F)).card : ℝ) * (B_M0 * B_del) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            _ ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * (B_M0 * B_del) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_card (mul_nonneg hBM0 hBdel)
            _ = (P.N : ℝ) * B_M0 * B_del := by ring
        · rw [norm_zero]; positivity
    have hZ_contract :
        Z_max ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Z_max + (P.N : ℝ) ^ 2 * B_inv_entry * B_M0 * B_del := by
      refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun r _ => ?_
      have hr_eq : z_ret r = ∑ col : Fin P.N, B_inv r col * rhs col := by
        have h1 := congrFun hz_eq r
        simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h1
      rw [hr_eq]
      calc
        ‖∑ col : Fin P.N, B_inv r col * rhs col‖
          ≤ ∑ col : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r col * rhs col‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _col : Fin P.N, B_inv_entry * (B_V * Z_max + (P.N : ℝ) * B_M0 * B_del) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun col _ => ?_
          rw [norm_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (hInv_bound r col) (hrhs_bound col) (norm_nonneg _) hBinv_nn
        _ = (P.N : ℝ) * (B_inv_entry * (B_V * Z_max + (P.N : ℝ) * B_M0 * B_del)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = ((P.N : ℝ) * B_inv_entry * B_V) * Z_max +
              (P.N : ℝ) ^ 2 * B_inv_entry * B_M0 * B_del := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Z_max + (P.N : ℝ) ^ 2 * B_inv_entry * B_M0 * B_del := by nlinarith
    have hZ_le : Z_max ≤ 2 * (P.N : ℝ) ^ 2 * B_inv_entry * B_M0 * B_del := by linarith
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k ∈ I ∪ F
    · have hzk : z k = z_ret k := by simp only [z_ret, hk, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [hzk]
      exact le_trans (Finset.le_sup' (fun r : Fin P.N => ‖z_ret r‖) (Finset.mem_univ k))
        (le_trans hZ_le (le_max_right _ _))
    · exact le_trans (hDel_bound k hk) (le_max_left _ _)

  
  have h_rpow_bound : ∀ {K β M : ℝ}, 0 < β → 1 ≤ K → K ^ (1 / β) ≤ M → K ≤ M ^ β := by

    have h_pow_nn : 0 ≤ K ^ (1 / β) := Real.rpow_nonneg hK_nn _
    calc
      K = K ^ ((1 / β) * β) := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel hβ.ne', Real.rpow_one]
      _ = (K ^ (1 / β)) ^ β := Real.rpow_mul hK_nn (1 / β) β
      _ ≤ M ^ β := Real.rpow_le_rpow h_pow_nn hKM hβ.le

      rw [Real.log_rpow hM_pos (α / 2)] at h1
      linarith
    have h_half_split : M ^ α = M ^ (α / 2) * M ^ (α / 2) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show α = α / 2 + α / 2 by ring]
      exact Real.rpow_add hM_pos (α / 2) (α / 2)

    calc
      ‖∑ k : Fin P.N, M0_y j_target k * z k‖
        ≤ ∑ k : Fin P.N, ‖M0_y j_target k * z k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _k : Fin P.N, (4 * Real.exp (M ^ σ)) * Real.exp (-H_star / 16) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
        rw [norm_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hM0_entry j_target k) (hz_all k) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (4 * (P.N : ℝ)) * (Real.exp (M ^ σ) * Real.exp (-H_star / 16)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * M ^ α) *
            (Real.exp (M ^ σ) * Real.exp (-H_star / 16)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_4N_exp (by positivity)
      _ = Real.exp ((1 / 64 : ℝ) * M ^ α + M ^ σ + (-H_star / 16)) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(1 / 32 : ℝ) * M ^ α) := by
        refine Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_
        linarith
  dsimp only [r_y, α, ε₀] at h_2ry_norm
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    (∀ j : Fin P.N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.ℓ_slice j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, P.ℓ_slice j y ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ≤ C₀)) ∧
    (∃ C_lat C_exp : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_lat ∧ 1 ≤ C_exp ∧
      ∀ (B_init lam : ℝ) (y_seq : ℕ → ℂ) (a b : ℕ),
        1 ≤ B_init → 0 < lam → lam ≤ Real.exp (-C_exp * B_init) → a ≤ b →
        (∀ m ≤ b, y_seq m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) →
        (∀ m ≤ a, sliceGeomCost S P (y_seq m) ≤ B_init) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, a ≤ m → m ≤ b → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m) - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq a)‖ ≤ lam) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, a ≤ m → m ≤ b → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a m,
            ((bootRunningPosMax S P y_seq n : ℂ)⁻¹ *
              (sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq (n + 1)) -
                sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq n)))‖ ≤ lam) →
        ∀ m ≤ b, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
          ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖ +
            Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖) +
            |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j (y_seq m))‖| ≤ C_lat * B_init ∧
          Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y_seq m)‖ ≤ C_lat * B_init)
