proof.tactics:
by
  have hN_pos : 0 < P.N := lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have hN_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (P.N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN_pos
  have hN_ne_R : (P.N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hN_pos_R.ne'
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 P.N
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos_R
  have ht₀_lt : t₀ < S.r_star := P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have ht₀_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t₀ := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
  have ht₀_ball : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, ht₀_norm]
    exact ht₀_lt
  have hh_pos : 0 < sliceHeight S P.N :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_ball).1
  have h_tube : ∀ (r : ℤ) {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro r y hy
    have hy_lt : |y.im| < sliceHeight S P.N := hy
    have hy_abs : -sliceHeight S P.N < y.im ∧ y.im < sliceHeight S P.N := abs_lt.mp hy_lt
    have him : (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)).im = y.im := by
      simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star
      rw [ht₀_norm]
      exact ht₀_lt
    · change -S.h_X (starRingEnd ℂ (t₀ : ℂ)) < (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)).im
      rw [Complex.conj_ofReal, him]
      exact hy_abs.1
    · change (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)).im < S.h_X (t₀ : ℂ)
      rw [him]
      exact hy_abs.2
  have h_impact_mem : ∀ (r : ℤ) {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N r y ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro r y hy
    exact S.𝔰_maps_to _ (h_tube r hy)
  have h_trig : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖Complex.cos z‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ ∧ ‖Complex.sin z‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 : ‖Complex.exp (z * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      calc (z * Complex.I).re ≤ |(z * Complex.I).re| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ‖z * Complex.I‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        _ = ‖z‖ := by simp
    have h2 : ‖Complex.exp (-z * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖z‖ := by
      rw [Complex.norm_exp]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      calc (-z * Complex.I).re ≤ |(-z * Complex.I).re| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ‖-z * Complex.I‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
        _ = ‖z‖ := by simp
    constructor
    · rw [Complex.cos, norm_div, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have h_add := norm_add_le (Complex.exp (z * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp (-z * Complex.I))
      linarith
    · rw [Complex.sin, norm_div, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_ofNat]
      have h_sub := norm_sub_le (Complex.exp (-z * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp (z * Complex.I))
      linarith

  
  have h_speed_holo : ∀ r : ℤ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N r) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N)) := by
    intro r
    have h_phi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y : ℂ => (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)))
        (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N)) :=
      (differentiableOn_id.add (differentiableOn_const _)).prodMk (differentiableOn_const _)
    have h_imp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N r)
        (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N)) :=
      S.𝔰_holo.fun_comp h_phi_holo (fun y hy => h_tube r hy)
    exact S.f_holo.fun_comp h_imp_holo (fun y hy => h_impact_mem r hy)
  have h_part1 : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.ℓ_slice j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, P.ℓ_slice j y ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
        -C₀ ≤ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ∧ Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j x‖ ≤ C₀) := by
    intro j
    let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all
    have h_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, P.ℓ_slice j y ≠ 0 := fun y hy => P.reg_chord_ne_zero y hy j
    have h_den_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
        sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy h0
      apply h_ne y hy
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice
      rw [h0, div_zero]
    have h_num_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.ℓ_num j) Ω_reg :=
      (P.ℓ_num_holo j).mono Set.diff_subset
    have h_den_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun y => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)
        Ω_reg :=
      ((h_speed_holo j.val).mono Set.diff_subset).mul
        ((h_speed_holo ((j.val : ℤ) + 1)).mono Set.diff_subset)
    have h_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (P.ℓ_slice j) Ω_reg :=
      h_num_on.div h_den_on h_den_ne
    have h_real_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ Ω_reg := by
      intro x
      refine ⟨?_, P.real_not_mem_Z_all x⟩
      change |(x : ℂ).im| < sliceHeight S P.N
      simp [hh_pos]
    have h_cont_c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => P.ℓ_slice j (x : ℂ)) :=
      h_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous Complex.continuous_ofReal h_real_mem
    have h_cont_log : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (x : ℂ)‖) :=
      Continuous.log h_cont_c.norm (fun x => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (h_ne (x : ℂ) (h_real_mem x)))
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) h_cont_log.continuousOn
    refine ⟨h_holo, h_ne, max 0 C, le_max_left 0 C, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hx_abs : |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (x : ℂ)‖| ≤ max 0 C := by
      calc |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (x : ℂ)‖|
        _ = ‖Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j (x : ℂ)‖‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ C := hC x hx
        _ ≤ max 0 C := le_max_right 0 C
    exact abs_le.mp hx_abs

  
  have hNt₀_R : (P.N : ℝ) * t₀ = 2 * Real.pi := by
    dsimp only [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ (2 * Real.pi) hN_ne_R
  have hNt₀_C : (P.N : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    have h1 : (((P.N : ℝ) * t₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      congrArg Complex.ofReal hNt₀_R
    push_cast at h1
    exact h1
  have h_imp_shift : ∀ (r : ℤ) {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      sliceImpactSeq S P.N (r + (P.N : ℤ)) y = sliceImpactSeq S P.N r y + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro r y hy
    have h_arg : y + ((r + (P.N : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) =
        (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      calc y + ((r + (P.N : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)
        _ = y + ((r : ℂ) + (P.N : ℂ)) * (t₀ : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
        _ = (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) + (P.N : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) := by ring
        _ = (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) + (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by rw [hNt₀_C]
    unfold sliceImpactSeq
    change S.𝔰 (y + ((r + (P.N : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) =
      S.𝔰 (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi
    rw [h_arg]
    exact S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (y + (r : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) (h_tube r hy)
  have h_ang_shift : ∀ (r : ℤ) {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      sliceAngleSeq S P.N (r + (P.N : ℤ)) y = sliceAngleSeq S P.N r y + 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro r y hy
    unfold sliceAngleSeq
    rw [h_imp_shift r hy]
    exact S.ϕ_quasiperiodic _ (h_impact_mem r hy)
  have h_pos_wrap : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all →
      slicePosSeq S P.N (P.N : ℤ) y = slicePosSeq S P.N 0 y := by
    intro y hy
    let j₀ : Fin P.N := ⟨0, hN_pos⟩
    have hf0 : S.f (sliceImpactSeq S P.N 0 y) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [sliceSpeedSeq, j₀] using P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j₀
    have h_imp0 := h_imp_shift 0 hy.1
    rw [zero_add] at h_imp0
    unfold slicePosSeq
    rw [h_imp0]
    exact S.Γ_periodic _ (h_impact_mem 0 hy.1) hf0
  have h_theta_alt : ∀ (r : ℤ) {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      P.θ_seq r y = -(Real.pi : ℂ) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N (r + (k : ℤ) + 1) y := by
    intro r y hy
    let u : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * P.θ_seq (r + (k : ℤ)) y
    have h_step : ∀ k : ℕ,
        u k - u (k + 1) = 2 * ((-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N (r + (k : ℤ) + 1) y) := by
      intro k
      have h_idx1 : (r + (k : ℤ) + 1) - 1 = r + (k : ℤ) := by ring
      have h_idx2 : r + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = r + (k : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      have h_sum_k := P.θ_sum (r + (k : ℤ) + 1) y hy
      rw [h_idx1] at h_sum_k
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [pow_succ, h_idx2]
      linear_combination (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * h_sum_k
    have h_tele : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (u k - u (k + 1)) = u 0 - u P.N :=
      Finset.sum_range_sub' u P.N
    have h_lhs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (u k - u (k + 1)) =
        2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N (r + (k : ℤ) + 1) y := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h_step k
    have h_odd : (-1 : ℂ) ^ P.N = -1 := Odd.neg_one_pow P.N_odd
    have h_rhs : u 0 - u P.N = 2 * P.θ_seq r y + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      dsimp only [u]
      rw [pow_zero, one_mul, Int.ofNat_zero, add_zero, h_odd, P.θ_shift_N r y hy]
      ring
    rw [h_lhs, h_rhs] at h_tele
    linear_combination -(1 / 2 : ℂ) * h_tele
  have h_wrap_ang : ∀ (j : Fin P.N) (k : ℕ), k < P.N →
      ∃ i : Fin P.N,
        (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N),
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y = sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y ∨
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y =
            sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ y₁ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N), ∀ y₂ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N),
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂ -
            sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁ =
          sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y₂ - sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y₁) := by
    intro j k hk
    by_cases hlt : j.val + k + 1 < P.N
    · refine ⟨⟨j.val + k + 1, hlt⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y _hy
        left
        have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1 = ((j.val + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx]
      · intro y₁ _hy₁ y₂ _hy₂
        have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1 = ((j.val + k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx]
    · have hsub_lt : j.val + k + 1 - P.N < P.N := by omega
      refine ⟨⟨j.val + k + 1 - P.N, hsub_lt⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y hy
        right
        have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1 =
            ((j.val + k + 1 - P.N : ℕ) : ℤ) + (P.N : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx]
        exact h_ang_shift _ hy
      · intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂
        have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1 =
            ((j.val + k + 1 - P.N : ℕ) : ℤ) + (P.N : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx, h_ang_shift _ hy₂, h_ang_shift _ hy₁]
        ring
  have h_norm_pi : ‖(Real.pi : ℂ)‖ = Real.pi := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  have h_norm_2pi : ‖(2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)‖ = 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_ofNat, h_norm_pi]
  have h_cyc_norm : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      ∀ (A : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → (∀ i : Fin P.N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ≤ A) →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi ∧
        ‖P.d0 j y‖ ≤ ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi := by
    intro y hy A _hA hψ j
    have h_theta : ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi := by
      rw [h_theta_alt j.val hy]
      calc
        ‖-(Real.pi : ℂ) +
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y‖
          ≤ ‖-(Real.pi : ℂ)‖ +
              ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ Real.pi +
              ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, ‖(-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y‖ := by
            rw [norm_neg, h_norm_pi]
            exact add_le_add le_rfl (norm_sum_le _ _)
        _ ≤ Real.pi + ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (A + 2 * Real.pi) := by
            refine add_le_add le_rfl (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_)
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul]
            obtain ⟨i, hi_val, _⟩ := h_wrap_ang j k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
            rcases hi_val y hy with h_eq1 | h_eq2
            · rw [h_eq1]
              linarith [hψ i, Real.pi_pos]
            · rw [h_eq2]
              calc ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y + 2 * Real.pi‖
                _ ≤ ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y‖ + ‖(2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
                _ = ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y‖ + 2 * Real.pi := by rw [h_norm_2pi]
                _ ≤ A + 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [hψ i]
        _ = (P.N : ℝ) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
            ring
    refine ⟨h_theta, ?_⟩
    unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.d0
    calc ‖P.θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖
      _ ≤ ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ + ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ ((P.N : ℝ) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi) + A := add_le_add h_theta (hψ j)
      _ = ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * A + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi := by ring
  have h_cyc_diff : ∀ {y₁ y₂ : ℂ},
      y₁ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) → y₂ ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) →
      ∀ (Δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ Δ →
      (∀ i : Fin P.N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y₂ - sliceAngleSeq S P.N i.val y₁‖ ≤ Δ) →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖P.d0 j y₂ - P.d0 j y₁‖ ≤ ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Δ := by
    intro y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ Δ _hΔ hψ_diff j
    have h_theta_sub : P.θ_seq j.val y₂ - P.θ_seq j.val y₁ =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k *
          (sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂ -
            sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁) := by
      rw [h_theta_alt j.val hy₂, h_theta_alt j.val hy₁]
      have h_sub_sum :
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂) -
          (∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k *
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂ -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => (mul_sub _ _ _).symm
      linear_combination h_sub_sum
    have h_theta_le : ‖P.θ_seq j.val y₂ - P.θ_seq j.val y₁‖ ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * Δ := by
      rw [h_theta_sub]
      calc
        ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, (-1 : ℂ) ^ k *
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂ -
              sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁)‖
          ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P.N, ‖(-1 : ℂ) ^ k *
              (sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₂ -
                sliceAngleSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) + 1) y₁)‖ :=
            norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range P.N, Δ := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => ?_
            rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, one_mul]
            obtain ⟨i, _, hi_diff⟩ := h_wrap_ang j k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
            rw [hi_diff y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂]

        _ = (P.N : ℝ) * Δ := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have h_d0_eq : P.d0 j y₂ - P.d0 j y₁ =
        (P.θ_seq j.val y₂ - P.θ_seq j.val y₁) -
          (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₂ - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₁) := by
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.d0
      ring
    rw [h_d0_eq]
    calc ‖(P.θ_seq j.val y₂ - P.θ_seq j.val y₁) -
            (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₂ - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₁)‖
      _ ≤ ‖P.θ_seq j.val y₂ - P.θ_seq j.val y₁‖ +
            ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₂ - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y₁‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ (P.N : ℝ) * Δ + Δ := add_le_add h_theta_le (hψ_diff j)
      _ = ((P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Δ := by ring
  have h_sup_le : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        ‖sliceSupportSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤
          2 * ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ * Real.exp ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := by
    intro y hy j
    have hs_j : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H := h_impact_mem j.val hy.1
    have hf_j : S.f (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) ≠ 0 := P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j
    have hH0 := S.H0_eq (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) hs_j hf_j
    change ‖S.H0 (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ ≤ _

    have hX0 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=

    have hX1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
      norm_le_pi_norm (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y) 1
    rcases h_trig (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y) with ⟨hcos, hsin⟩
    calc
      ‖S.Γ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) 0 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y)) +

      _ = ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ * ‖Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ +
            ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ * ‖Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y)‖ := by

      _ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ * Real.exp ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
            ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ * Real.exp ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul hX0 hcos (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul hX1 hsin (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = 2 * ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ * Real.exp ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ := by ring
  have h_chord_le : ∀ {y : ℂ}, y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all →
      ∀ (R_pos : ℝ), 0 ≤ R_pos → (∀ i : Fin P.N, ‖slicePosSeq S P.N i.val y‖ ≤ R_pos) →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖ ≤ 4 * R_pos * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ := by
    intro y hy R_pos _hR_nn hX_le j
    have hX_next : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y‖ ≤ R_pos := by
      by_cases hlt : j.val + 1 < P.N
      · have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + 1 = ((j.val + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx]
        exact hX_le ⟨j.val + 1, hlt⟩
      · have h_idx : (j.val : ℤ) + 1 = (P.N : ℤ) := by omega
        rw [h_idx, h_pos_wrap hy]
        exact hX_le ⟨0, hN_pos⟩
    have hΔ0 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ ≤ 2 * R_pos := by
      calc ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖
        _ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0‖ + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y‖ + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=

        _ ≤ R_pos + R_pos := add_le_add hX_next (hX_le j)
        _ = 2 * R_pos := by ring
    have hΔ1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ ≤ 2 * R_pos := by
      calc ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖
        _ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1‖ + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y‖ + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖ :=
          add_le_add (norm_le_pi_norm _ 1) (norm_le_pi_norm _ 1)
        _ ≤ R_pos + R_pos := add_le_add hX_next (hX_le j)
        _ = 2 * R_pos := by ring
    rcases P.reg_chord_vec y hy j with ⟨hc0, hc1⟩
    have h_ell_id : P.ℓ_slice j y =
        -(slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0) *
          Complex.sin (P.θ_seq j.val y) +
        (slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1) *
          Complex.cos (P.θ_seq j.val y) := by
      unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice
      rw [hc0, hc1]
      calc
        P.ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)
          = (P.ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
              (Complex.sin (P.θ_seq j.val y) ^ 2 + Complex.cos (P.θ_seq j.val y) ^ 2) := by
            rw [Complex.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]
        _ = _ := by ring
    rcases h_trig (P.θ_seq j.val y) with ⟨hcos_θ, hsin_θ⟩
    rw [h_ell_id]
    calc
      ‖-(slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0) *
          Complex.sin (P.θ_seq j.val y) +
        (slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1) *
          Complex.cos (P.θ_seq j.val y)‖
        ≤ ‖-(slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0) *
              Complex.sin (P.θ_seq j.val y)‖ +
            ‖(slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1) *
              Complex.cos (P.θ_seq j.val y)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 0‖ *
            ‖Complex.sin (P.θ_seq j.val y)‖ +
          ‖slicePosSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y 1‖ *
            ‖Complex.cos (P.θ_seq j.val y)‖ := by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 * R_pos) * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ + (2 * R_pos) * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul hΔ0 hsin_θ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
            (mul_le_mul hΔ1 hcos_θ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
      _ = 4 * R_pos * Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val y‖ := by ring
  clear h_tube h_impact_mem h_speed_holo hNt₀_R hNt₀_C h_imp_shift h_ang_shift h_pos_wrap
    h_theta_alt h_wrap_ang h_norm_pi h_norm_2pi

  
  have h_sin_log_pert : ∀ (z₀ z₁ : ℂ) (B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B →
      Real.exp (-B) ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ →
      ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ ≤ Real.exp B →
      Real.exp (‖z₀‖ + ‖z₁ - z₀‖) * ‖z₁ - z₀‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B) →
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin z₁‖| ≤ B + 1 := by
    intro z₀ z₁ B hB h_low h_high h_small
    set r : ℝ := ‖z₁ - z₀‖
    have hr : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg _
    have h_diff_sin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, DifferentiableAt ℂ Complex.sin w :=
      fun w _ => Complex.differentiable_sin.differentiableAt
    have h_bound_sin : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖deriv Complex.sin w‖ ≤ Real.exp (‖z₀‖ + r) := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Complex.deriv_sin]
      refine le_trans (h_trig w).1 (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_)
      have hdist : ‖w - z₀‖ ≤ r := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hw
      calc ‖w‖ = ‖z₀ + (w - z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ‖w - z₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + r := by linarith
    have h_mvt : ‖Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B) :=
      le_trans
        (Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le h_diff_sin h_bound_sin (convex_closedBall z₀ r)
          (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr) (by simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, r]))
        h_small
    have h_sin1_low : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B) ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ := by
      have h_tri : ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ + ‖Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀‖ := by
        calc ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ = ‖Complex.sin z₁ - (Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ + ‖Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      linarith
    have h_sin1_high : ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp B := by
      have h_tri : ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ + ‖Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀‖ := by
        calc ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ = ‖Complex.sin z₀ + (Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀)‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₀‖ + ‖Complex.sin z₁ - Complex.sin z₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-B) ≤ Real.exp B := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_2_le_e : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
    have h_em1_le : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h_prod : Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp 1 = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        norm_num
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_2_le_e (Real.exp_pos (-1)).le
      linarith
    have h_exp_low : Real.exp (-(B + 1)) ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ := by
      calc Real.exp (-(B + 1))
        _ = Real.exp (-1 + -B) := congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
        _ = Real.exp (-1) * Real.exp (-B) := Real.exp_add (-1) (-B)
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-B) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_em1_le (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ ≤ ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ := h_sin1_low
    have h_exp_high : ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ ≤ Real.exp (B + 1) := by
      calc ‖Complex.sin z₁‖
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.exp B := h_sin1_high
        _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * Real.exp B :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_2_le_e (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (1 + B) := (Real.exp_add 1 B).symm
        _ = Real.exp (B + 1) := congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
    have h_sin1_pos : 0 < ‖Complex.sin z₁‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos _) h_exp_low
    exact abs_le.mpr
      ⟨(Real.le_log_iff_exp_le h_sin1_pos).mpr h_exp_low,
       (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_sin1_pos).mpr h_exp_high⟩
  clear h_trig

  
  have h_abel : ∀ (R : ℕ → ℝ) (h : ℕ → ℂ) (a b : ℕ) (lam : ℝ),
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < R n) → Monotone R → 0 ≤ lam →
      (∀ m : ℕ, a ≤ m → m ≤ b →
        ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a m, ((R n : ℂ)⁻¹ * (h (n + 1) - h n))‖ ≤ lam) →
      ∀ u : ℕ, a ≤ u → u ≤ b → ‖h u - h a‖ ≤ 2 * lam * R b := by
    intro R h a b lam hR_pos hR_mono hlam hD
    let D : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a m, ((R n : ℂ)⁻¹ * (h (n + 1) - h n))
    have h_ident : ∀ d : ℕ,
        h (a + d) - h a =
          (R (a + d) : ℂ) * D (a + d) -
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1)) := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero =>
          simp [D]
      | succ d ih =>
          have h_step_D : D (a + d + 1) =
              D (a + d) + (R (a + d) : ℂ)⁻¹ * (h (a + d + 1) - h (a + d)) :=
            Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top (Nat.le_add_right a d)
              (fun n => (R n : ℂ)⁻¹ * (h (n + 1) - h n))
          have hR_ne : (R (a + d) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hR_pos (a + d)).ne'
          have h_diff_h : h (a + d + 1) - h (a + d) =
              (R (a + d) : ℂ) * (D (a + d + 1) - D (a + d)) := by
            rw [h_step_D, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hR_ne]
          have h_idx : a + (d + 1) = a + d + 1 := by omega
          calc
            h (a + (d + 1)) - h a
              = (h (a + d) - h a) + (h (a + d + 1) - h (a + d)) := by
                rw [h_idx]; ring
            _ = ((R (a + d) : ℂ) * D (a + d) -
                  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1))) +
                (R (a + d) : ℂ) * (D (a + d + 1) - D (a + d)) := by
                rw [ih, h_diff_h]
            _ = (R (a + (d + 1)) : ℂ) * D (a + (d + 1)) -
                ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
                  (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1)) := by
                rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, h_idx]
                push_cast
                ring
    intro u hau hub
    set d : ℕ := u - a
    have had : a + d = u := Nat.add_sub_of_le hau
    have h1 : ‖(R (a + d) : ℂ) * D (a + d)‖ ≤ R u * lam := by
      rw [had, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hR_pos u)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD u hau hub) (hR_pos u).le
    have h2 : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range d,
        (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1))‖ ≤ (R u - R a) * lam := by
      calc
        ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1))‖
          ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, ‖(((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1))‖ :=
            norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (R (a + (i + 1)) - R (a + i)) * lam := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
            have hi_lt : i < d := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
            have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) :=
              sub_nonneg.mpr (hR_mono (Nat.le_succ (a + i)))
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h_sub_nn]
            have h_assoc : a + (i + 1) = a + i + 1 := by omega
            rw [h_assoc]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD (a + i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)) h_sub_nn
        _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (R (a + (i + 1)) - R (a + i))) * lam :=
            (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
        _ = (R u - R a) * lam := by
            rw [Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i => R (a + i)) d, had, Nat.add_zero]
    have h_eq : h u - h a = (R (a + d) : ℂ) * D (a + d) -
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1)) := by
      rw [← had]
      exact h_ident d
    have h_norm := norm_sub_le ((R (a + d) : ℂ) * D (a + d))
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, (((R (a + i + 1) - R (a + i) : ℝ) : ℂ) * D (a + i + 1)))

    have hRb_lin : R b ≤ 2 + 2 * Real.exp B_init +
        4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) := by linarith
    have h1_le_e : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) :=
      Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
    have heB_le_e : Real.exp B_init ≤ Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have h4p4C_exp : 4 + 4 * P.C_rec ≤ Real.exp ((4 + 4 * P.C_rec) * B_init) :=
      le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp ((4 + 4 * P.C_rec) * B_init))
    calc R b
      _ ≤ 2 + 2 * Real.exp B_init + 4 * P.C_rec * Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) := hRb_lin
      _ ≤ (4 + 4 * P.C_rec) * Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) := by linarith
      _ ≤ Real.exp ((4 + 4 * P.C_rec) * B_init) * Real.exp ((4 * P.C_rec + 2) * B_init) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4p4C_exp (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
  clear h_sup_le h_abel hR_ge_one hR_pos hR_mono h_sup_a h_late_pos hRb_self h_coeff_half

  
  have hB_le_Clat : B_init ≤ C_lat * B_init := le_mul_of_one_le_left hB_nn hC_lat_ge
  have h_10_le_Clat : (8 * P.C_rec + 10) * B_init ≤ C_lat * B_init :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp only [C_lat]; linarith) hB_nn
  intro m hm j
  rcases le_total m a with hma | ham
  · have h_eb := h_early_bounds hma j
    exact ⟨le_trans h_eb.2.2.2.1 hB_le_Clat, le_trans h_eb.2.2.2.2 hB_le_Clat⟩
  · have h1pX_le_Rb : ∀ i : Fin P.N,
        1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N i.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init) := by
      intro i
      have h_s1 : ‖slicePosSeq S P.N i.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤
          Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq m)‖) :=
        Finset.le_sup' (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq m)‖)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have h_s2 :
          Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq m)‖) ≤
          (Finset.range (b + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ b)⟩
            (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
              (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖)) :=
        Finset.le_sup'
          (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm))
      have hRb_def : R b = 1 + (Finset.range (b + 1)).sup'
          ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ b)⟩
          (fun l => Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
            (fun k : Fin P.N => ‖slicePosSeq S P.N k.val (y_seq l)‖)) := rfl
      linarith
    have h_log_1pX : Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val (y_seq m)‖) ≤
        (8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init :=
      (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (by positivity)).mpr (h1pX_le_Rb j)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hψ_m := h_late_ang ham hm j
      have hsin_m := h_late_sin ham hm j
      linarith
    · have hX_le_exp : ∀ i : Fin P.N,
          ‖slicePosSeq S P.N i.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init) :=
        fun i => by linarith [h1pX_le_Rb i]
      have h_ell_norm := h_chord_le (hy_reg m hm) (Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init))
        (Real.exp_pos _).le hX_le_exp j
      have h4_le_exp : (4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (4 * B_init) :=
        le_trans (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp (4 * B_init))
      have hθ_exp : Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val (y_seq m)‖ ≤
          Real.exp ((2 * (P.N : ℝ) + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi) * B_init) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (h_late_theta ham hm j)
      have h_ell_le_Clat : ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y_seq m)‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_lat * B_init) := by
        calc ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y_seq m)‖
          _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init) *
                Real.exp ‖P.θ_seq j.val (y_seq m)‖ := h_ell_norm
          _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * B_init) * Real.exp ((8 * P.C_rec + 6) * B_init) *
                Real.exp ((2 * (P.N : ℝ) + (2 * (P.N : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi) * B_init) := by
              refine mul_le_mul
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4_le_exp (Real.exp_pos _).le)
                hθ_exp (Real.exp_pos _).le (by positivity)
          _ = Real.exp (C_lat * B_init) := by
              dsimp only [C_lat]
              rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
              exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
      have h_ell_pos : 0 < ‖P.ℓ_slice j (y_seq m)‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (P.reg_chord_ne_zero (y_seq m) (hy_reg m hm) j)
      exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp h_ell_pos).mpr h_ell_le_Clat

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three)
  have hN_ne_ℂ : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hN_pos)
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  have ht0_pos : 0 < t₀ := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : t₀ < S.r_star := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ S.r_star_pos).mp hfl
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have ht0_mem : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht0_pos]
    exact ht0_lt
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht0_mem).1
  have hA_ne : S.A (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hA_re := S.A_real_pos t₀ ht0_pos ht0_lt
    rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hA_re
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hA_re
  have hc_ne : (S.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt S.c_pos)
  have h_fin_nonempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  let ρ₀ : ℝ :=
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Finset.univ.inf' h_fin_nonempty (fun j : Fin N => S.H - |(s_lim j).im|)
  have hρ₀_pos : 0 < ρ₀ := by
    dsimp [ρ₀]
    refine mul_pos (by norm_num) ((Finset.lt_inf'_iff h_fin_nonempty).mpr fun j _ => ?_)
    have hj : |(s_lim j).im| < S.H := h_in_strip j
    linarith
  let B₀ : Set (Fin N → ℂ) := Metric.ball s_lim ρ₀
  have hB₀_strip : ∀ z ∈ B₀, ∀ j : Fin N, z j ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro z hz j
    have hz_j : dist (z j) (s_lim j) < ρ₀ :=
      (dist_pi_lt_iff hρ₀_pos).mp (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) j
    have hρ₀_le : ρ₀ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (S.H - |(s_lim j).im|) := by
      dsimp [ρ₀]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) (by norm_num)
    have him_diff : |(z j).im - (s_lim j).im| ≤ dist (z j) (s_lim j) := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, ← Complex.sub_im]
      exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    have him_tri : |(z j).im| - |(s_lim j).im| ≤ |(z j).im - (s_lim j).im| :=
      abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
    dsimp [horizStrip]
    linarith

  
  have h_finprod_holo : ∀ (t : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)))
      (F_p : Fin (oddSliceN S) → (Fin (oddSliceN S) → ℂ) → ℂ),
      (∀ i ∈ t, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F_p i) B₀) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∏ i ∈ t, F_p i z) B₀ := by
    intro t F_p hF_p
    induction t using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [differentiableOn_const]
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      have h_eq : (fun z => ∏ i ∈ insert a s, F_p i z) =
          fun z => F_p a z * ∏ i ∈ s, F_p i z := by
        ext z; exact Finset.prod_insert ha
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hF_p a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).mul
        (ih fun i hi => hF_p i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
  have hz_proj_holo : ∀ k : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : Fin N → ℂ => z k) B₀ :=
    fun k => (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).differentiableOn
  have hz_f_holo : ∀ k : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.f (z k)) B₀ :=
    fun k => S.f_holo.comp (hz_proj_holo k) (fun z hz => hB₀_strip z hz k)
  have hz_phi_holo : ∀ k : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.ϕ (z k)) B₀ :=
    fun k => S.ϕ_holo.comp (hz_proj_holo k) (fun z hz => hB₀_strip z hz k)
  have hz_K_holo : ∀ (k : Fin N) (i : Fin 2),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (z k) i) B₀ :=
    fun k i => (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo i).comp (hz_proj_holo k) (fun z hz => hB₀_strip z hz k)
  have hz_shifted_holo : ∀ (j : Fin N) (m : ℕ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateShiftedAngle S z j m) B₀ := by
    intro j m
    unfold stateShiftedAngle
    split_ifs with hm
    · exact hz_phi_holo _
    · exact (hz_phi_holo _).sub (differentiableOn_const _)
  have hz_theta_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateTheta S z j) B₀ := by
    intro j
    unfold stateTheta
    exact (differentiableOn_const _).add
      (DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun m _ => (differentiableOn_const _).mul (hz_shifted_holo j m))
  have hz_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateD0 S z j) B₀ := by
    intro j
    unfold stateD0
    exact (hz_theta_holo j).sub (hz_phi_holo j)
  have hz_sin_d0_holo : ∀ j : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j)) B₀ :=
    fun j => Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (hz_d0_holo j)
  have hz_chord_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateChordNum S z j) B₀ := by
    intro j
    unfold stateChordNum
    exact ((((hz_f_holo j).mul (hz_K_holo _ 0)).sub
      ((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_K_holo j 0))).neg.mul
        (Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn (hz_theta_holo j))).add
      ((((hz_f_holo j).mul (hz_K_holo _ 1)).sub
        ((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_K_holo j 1))).mul
        (Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn (hz_theta_holo j)))
  have hz_delta_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateDeltaRow S z) B₀ := by
    unfold stateDeltaRow
    exact (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun m z => stateChordNum S z m)
      fun m _ => hz_chord_holo m).mul
      (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun m z => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))
        fun m _ => hz_sin_d0_holo m)
  have hz_M0_holo : ∀ i k : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateClearedM0Entry S z i k) B₀ := by
    intro i k
    unfold stateClearedM0Entry
    have hP_sin : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => ∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)) B₀ :=
      h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun m z => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))
        fun m _ => hz_sin_d0_holo m
    have hP_ell : ∀ r : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => ∏ m ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, stateChordNum S z m) B₀ :=
      fun r => h_finprod_holo (Finset.univ.erase r) (fun m z => stateChordNum S z m)
        fun m _ => hz_chord_holo m
    refine ((?_ : DifferentiableOn ℂ _ B₀).add ?_).add ?_
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact ((((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).add
          (((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _))).mul hP_sin
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hki : k = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) i
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact (((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin
      · simp only [hki, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
    · by_cases hik' : i = @cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) k
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact (((hz_f_holo _).mul (hz_f_holo _)).mul (hP_ell _)).mul hP_sin
      · simp only [hik', ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have hz_VDiag_holo : ∀ i : Fin N,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateClearedVDiag S z i) B₀ := by
    intro i
    unfold stateClearedVDiag
    exact (((differentiableOn_const _).mul ((hz_f_holo i).pow 3)).mul
      (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun m z => stateChordNum S z m)
        fun m _ => hz_chord_holo m)).mul
      (h_finprod_holo (Finset.univ.erase i) (fun m z => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m))
        fun m _ => hz_sin_d0_holo m)
  have hz_B_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (i k : Fin N),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => stateClearedB S I F z i k) B₀ := by
    intro I F i k
    simp only [stateClearedB, Matrix.of_apply]
    by_cases hIF : i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F
    · simp only [hIF, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · by_cases hiI : k ∈ I
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          exact (hz_M0_holo k k).sub (hz_VDiag_holo k)
        · simp only [hik, hiI, and_false, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
          exact hz_M0_holo k k
      · simp only [hik, false_and, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
        exact hz_M0_holo i k
    · simp only [hIF, ↓reduceIte]
      by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact hz_delta_holo
      · simp only [hik, ↓reduceIte]
        exact differentiableOn_const 0
  have hz_det_holo : ∀ (I F : Finset (Fin N)),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => (stateClearedB S I F z).det) B₀ := by
    intro I F
    have h_eq : (fun z => (stateClearedB S I F z).det) =
        fun z => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℂ) *
            ∏ i : Fin N, stateClearedB S I F z (σ i) i := by
      ext z
      rw [Matrix.det_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]; rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact DifferentiableOn.fun_sum fun σ _ =>
      (differentiableOn_const _).mul
        (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun i z => stateClearedB S I F z (σ i) i)
          fun i _ => hz_B_holo I F (σ i) i)
  let cofNum : (Fin N → ℂ) → Fin N → ℂ := fun z j =>
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (t₀ : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) * (S.f (z j)) ^ 4 *
      (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S z i) *
      (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ z).det
  let cofDen : (Fin N → ℂ) → Fin N → ℂ := fun z j =>
    ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j)) ^ 2 *
      (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) *
      (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N
  let cofG : (Fin N → ℂ) → Fin N → ℂ := fun z j => cofNum z j / cofDen z j
  have hcofNum_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => cofNum z j) B₀ := by
    intro j
    dsimp [cofNum]
    exact ((((differentiableOn_const _).mul ((hz_f_holo j).pow 4)).mul
      (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun i z => stateChordNum S z i)
        fun i _ => hz_chord_holo i)).mul
      (hz_det_holo (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅))
  have hcofDen_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => cofDen z j) B₀ := by
    intro j
    dsimp [cofDen]
    exact (((((differentiableOn_const _).mul (hz_sin_d0_holo j)).pow 2).mul
      (h_finprod_holo Finset.univ (fun i z => (S.f (z i)) ^ 2)
        fun i _ => (hz_f_holo i).pow 2)).mul
      (hz_delta_holo.pow N))
  have hcofNum_lim_ne : ∀ j : Fin N, cofNum s_lim j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    dsimp [cofNum]
    refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) (h_det_ne j)
    · exact pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
    · exact div_ne_zero hA_ne hN_ne_ℂ
    · exact pow_ne_zero 4 (h_f_ne j)
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => h_chord_ne i
  have hcofDen_lim_ne : ∀ j : Fin N, cofDen s_lim j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    dsimp [cofDen]
    refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact pow_ne_zero 2 (mul_ne_zero hc_ne (h_sin_ne j))
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => pow_ne_zero 2 (h_f_ne i)
    · refine pow_ne_zero N ?_
      unfold stateDeltaRow
      exact mul_ne_zero
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun m _ => h_chord_ne m)
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun m _ => h_sin_ne m)
  let w_lim : Fin N → ℂ := fun j => cofG s_lim j
  have hw_lim_ne : ∀ j : Fin N, w_lim j ≠ 0 :=
    fun j => div_ne_zero (hcofNum_lim_ne j) (hcofDen_lim_ne j)
  have hs_lim_mem : s_lim ∈ B₀ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ₀_pos
  have hB₀_nhds : B₀ ∈ nhds s_lim := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hs_lim_mem
  have h_ev_all : ∀ᶠ z in nhds s_lim, ∀ j : Fin N,
      S.f (z j) ≠ 0 ∧
      Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) ≠ 0 ∧
      stateChordNum S z j ≠ 0 ∧
      cofDen z j ≠ 0 ∧
      dist (cofG z j / w_lim j) 1 < 1 / 2 := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro j
    have h_f_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => S.f (z j)) s_lim :=
      (hz_f_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt hB₀_nhds
    have h_sin_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j)) s_lim :=
      (hz_sin_d0_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt hB₀_nhds
    have h_chord_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => stateChordNum S z j) s_lim :=
      (hz_chord_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt hB₀_nhds
    have h_num_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => cofNum z j) s_lim :=
      (hcofNum_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt hB₀_nhds
    have h_den_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => cofDen z j) s_lim :=
      (hcofDen_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt hB₀_nhds
    have h_u_ca : ContinuousAt (fun z => cofG z j / w_lim j) s_lim :=
      (h_num_ca.div h_den_ca (hcofDen_lim_ne j)).div continuousAt_const (hw_lim_ne j)
    have h_u_lim : cofG s_lim j / w_lim j = 1 := div_self (hw_lim_ne j)
    have h_u_ev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds s_lim, dist (cofG z j / w_lim j) 1 < 1 / 2 := by
      have hm : Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 2) ∈ nhds (cofG s_lim j / w_lim j) := by
        rw [h_u_lim]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds 1 (by norm_num)
      exact h_u_ca.tendsto hm
    filter_upwards [h_f_ca.eventually_ne (h_f_ne j),
      h_sin_ca.eventually_ne (h_sin_ne j),
      h_chord_ca.eventually_ne (h_chord_ne j),
      h_den_ca.eventually_ne (hcofDen_lim_ne j), h_u_ev] with z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  obtain ⟨r_u0, hr_u0_pos, hr_u0_spec⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp h_ev_all
  let ρ₁ : ℝ := min (ρ₀ / 2) (r_u0 / 2)
  have hρ₁_pos : 0 < ρ₁ := by positivity
  let B₁ : Set (Fin N → ℂ) := Metric.ball s_lim ρ₁
  have hB₁_sub_B₀ : B₁ ⊆ B₀ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (half_le_self hρ₀_pos.le))
  have hB₁_props : ∀ z ∈ B₁, ∀ j : Fin N,
      z j ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
      S.f (z j) ≠ 0 ∧
      Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) ≠ 0 ∧
      stateChordNum S z j ≠ 0 ∧
      cofDen z j ≠ 0 ∧
      dist (cofG z j / w_lim j) 1 < 1 / 2 := by
    intro z hz j
    have hz_d : dist z s_lim < r_u0 :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz)
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (half_le_self hr_u0_pos.le))
    exact ⟨hB₀_strip z (hB₁_sub_B₀ hz) j, hr_u0_spec hz_d j⟩
  have hu_slit : ∀ z ∈ B₁, ∀ j : Fin N, cofG z j / w_lim j ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro z hz j
    rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
    left
    have hd : ‖cofG z j / w_lim j - 1‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using (hB₁_props z hz j).2.2.2.2.2
    have hre : |(cofG z j / w_lim j - 1).re| ≤ ‖cofG z j / w_lim j - 1‖ :=
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    have hre' : (cofG z j / w_lim j - 1).re = (cofG z j / w_lim j).re - 1 := by simp
    rw [hre'] at hre
    linarith [(abs_le.mp hre).1]
  let g_plus : (Fin N → ℂ) → Fin N → ℂ := fun z j =>
    Complex.exp (Complex.log (w_lim j) / 2) *
      Complex.exp (Complex.log (cofG z j / w_lim j) / 2)
  have hg_plus_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => g_plus z j) B₁ := by
    intro j
    have hG_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => cofG z j) B₁ := by
      have h_eq : (fun z => cofG z j) = fun z => cofNum z j * (cofDen z j)⁻¹ := by
        ext z; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact ((hcofNum_holo j).mono hB₁_sub_B₀).mul
        (((hcofDen_holo j).mono hB₁_sub_B₀).inv fun z hz => (hB₁_props z hz j).2.2.2.2.1)
    have hu_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => cofG z j / w_lim j) B₁ := by
      have h_eq : (fun z => cofG z j / w_lim j) = fun z => cofG z j * (w_lim j)⁻¹ := by
        ext z; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hG_holo.mul (differentiableOn_const _)
    have hlog_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun z => Complex.log (cofG z j / w_lim j) / 2) B₁ := by
      have h_eq : (fun z => Complex.log (cofG z j / w_lim j) / 2) =
          fun z => Complex.log (cofG z j / w_lim j) * (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
        ext z; exact div_eq_mul_inv _ _
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hu_holo.clog (fun z hz => hu_slit z hz j)).mul (differentiableOn_const _)
    exact (differentiableOn_const _).mul hlog_holo.cexp
  have hg_plus_sq : ∀ z ∈ B₁, ∀ j : Fin N,
      (g_plus z j) ^ 2 = cofG z j ∧ g_plus z j ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz j
    refine ⟨?_, mul_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _) (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)⟩
    dsimp [g_plus]
    rw [mul_pow, sq, ← Complex.exp_add, add_halves, Complex.exp_log (hw_lim_ne j),
      sq, ← Complex.exp_add, add_halves,
      Complex.exp_log (Complex.slitPlane_ne_zero (hu_slit z hz j)),
      mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hw_lim_ne j)]

  
  let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let C_full : Set ℂ :=
    {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ |y.re - x_star| ≤ 2 * (h - |y.im|)}
  have h_cone_rad : ∀ j : Fin N, ∃ r_c : ℝ, 0 < r_c ∧
      ∀ y ∈ C_full, dist y y_star < r_c →
        dist (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val y) (s_lim j) < ρ₁ / 4 := by
    intro j
    exact Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp (h_lim j) (ρ₁ / 4) (by positivity)
  let r_c_fn : Fin N → ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (h_cone_rad j)
  have hr_c_pos : ∀ j : Fin N, 0 < r_c_fn j :=
    fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (h_cone_rad j)).1
  have hr_c_spec : ∀ (j : Fin N), ∀ y ∈ C_full, dist y y_star < r_c_fn j →
      dist (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val y) (s_lim j) < ρ₁ / 4 :=
    fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (h_cone_rad j)).2
  let r_c_min : ℝ := Finset.univ.inf' h_fin_nonempty r_c_fn
  have hr_c_min_pos : 0 < r_c_min :=
    (Finset.lt_inf'_iff h_fin_nonempty).mpr fun j _ => hr_c_pos j
  let δ₁ : ℝ := min (r_c_min / 4) (h / 4)
  have hδ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁ := by positivity
  have hδ₁_lt_half : δ₁ < h / 2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  let truncCone : Set ℂ :=
    {y : ℂ | h - δ₁ < y.im ∧ y.im < h ∧ |y.re - x_star| < 2 * (h - y.im)}
  have hCone_open : IsOpen truncCone := by
    refine (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter ?_
    refine (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const).inter ?_
    exact isOpen_lt
      (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const))
      (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.sub Complex.continuous_im))
  have hCone_convex : Convex ℝ truncCone := by
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
    rcases hy₁ with ⟨hy₁_lo, hy₁_hi, hy₁_re⟩
    rcases hy₂ with ⟨hy₂_lo, hy₂_hi, hy₂_re⟩
    have him_eq : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im = a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im := by simp
    have hre_eq : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).re = a * y₁.re + b * y₂.re := by simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [him_eq]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp at hab; subst hab; simpa using hy₂_lo
      · have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁_lo ha_pos
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂_lo.le hb
        nlinarith
    · rw [him_eq]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp at hab; subst hab; simpa using hy₂_hi
      · have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁_hi ha_pos
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂_hi.le hb
        nlinarith
    · rw [hre_eq, him_eq]
      have h_split : a * y₁.re + b * y₂.re - x_star =
          a * (y₁.re - x_star) + b * (y₂.re - x_star) := by linear_combination x_star * hab
      rw [h_split]
      have h_tri : |a * (y₁.re - x_star) + b * (y₂.re - x_star)| ≤
          a * |y₁.re - x_star| + b * |y₂.re - x_star| := by
        calc |a * (y₁.re - x_star) + b * (y₂.re - x_star)|
            ≤ |a * (y₁.re - x_star)| + |b * (y₂.re - x_star)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = a * |y₁.re - x_star| + b * |y₂.re - x_star| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
      · simp at hab; subst hab; linarith
      · have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁_re ha_pos
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂_re.le hb
        nlinarith
  have hCone_pre : IsPreconnected truncCone := hCone_convex.isPreconnected
  have hCone_sub : truncCone ⊆ horizStrip h := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, _⟩
    have hy_im_pos : 0 < y.im := by linarith
    dsimp [horizStrip]
    rw [abs_of_pos hy_im_pos]
    exact hy_hi
  have hCone_ball : ∀ y ∈ truncCone, oddSliceStateVec S y ∈ Metric.ball s_lim (ρ₁ / 4) := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, hy_re⟩
    have hy_im_pos : 0 < y.im := by linarith
    have hy_full : y ∈ C_full := by
      refine ⟨hCone_sub ⟨hy_lo, hy_hi, hy_re⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [abs_of_pos hy_im_pos]
      exact hy_re.le
    have hy_dist_min : dist y y_star < r_c_min := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have h_re : (y - y_star).re = y.re - x_star := by simp [y_star]
      have h_im : (y - y_star).im = y.im - h := by simp [y_star]
      have h_le := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (y - y_star)
      rw [h_re, h_im] at h_le
      have h_im_abs : |y.im - h| = h - y.im := by
        rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      have hδ₁_le : δ₁ ≤ r_c_min / 4 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    refine Metric.mem_ball.mpr ((dist_pi_lt_iff (by positivity)).mpr fun j => ?_)
    have hr_le : r_c_min ≤ r_c_fn j := Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
    exact hr_c_spec j y hy_full (lt_of_lt_of_le hy_dist_min hr_le)
  have hCone_B₁ : ∀ y ∈ truncCone, oddSliceStateVec S y ∈ B₁ := by
    intro y hy
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) (hCone_ball y hy)
  let y₀_cone : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + ((h - δ₁ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hy₀_cone : y₀_cone ∈ truncCone := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [y₀_cone] <;> linarith
  have h_open_h : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  let q_fn : Fin N → ℂ → ℂ := fun j y =>
    deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y / g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j
  have hq_cont : ∀ j : Fin N, ContinuousOn (q_fn j) truncCone := by
    intro j
    have hd_cont : ContinuousOn (deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)) truncCone :=
      ((hChord.impact_holo j.val).deriv h_open_h).continuousOn.mono hCone_sub
    have hvec_cont : ContinuousOn (oddSliceStateVec S) truncCone :=
      continuousOn_pi.mpr fun k => (hChord.impact_holo k.val).continuousOn.mono hCone_sub
    have hgp_cont : ContinuousOn (fun y => g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) truncCone :=
      (hg_plus_holo j).continuousOn.comp hvec_cont hCone_B₁
    exact hd_cont.div hgp_cont (fun y hy => (hg_plus_sq _ (hCone_B₁ y hy) j).2)
  have hq_pm : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ y ∈ truncCone, q_fn j y = 1 ∨ q_fn j y = -1 := by
    intro j y hy
    have hy_B₁ : oddSliceStateVec S y ∈ B₁ := hCone_B₁ y hy
    have h_cc := hJac.cleared_cofactor_eq y (hCone_sub hy) j
    have h_lhs :
        ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) *
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y) ^ 2 *
          (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y i)) ^ 2) *
          (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) ^ N =
        (deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y) ^ 2 * cofDen (oddSliceStateVec S y) j := by
      dsimp [cofDen]
      ring
    change _ = cofNum (oddSliceStateVec S y) j at h_cc
    rw [h_lhs] at h_cc
    have hden_ne : cofDen (oddSliceStateVec S y) j ≠ 0 :=
      (hB₁_props _ hy_B₁ j).2.2.2.2.1
    have h_sq_eq : (deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y) ^ 2 =
        (g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) ^ 2 := by
      rw [(hg_plus_sq _ hy_B₁ j).1]
      exact (eq_div_iff hden_ne).mpr h_cc
    have hgp_ne : g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j ≠ 0 := (hg_plus_sq _ hy_B₁ j).2
    have hq_sq : (q_fn j y) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      dsimp [q_fn]
      rw [div_pow, h_sq_eq, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 hgp_ne)]
    have h_fac : (q_fn j y - 1) * (q_fn j y + 1) = 0 := by
      linear_combination hq_sq
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h_fac with h1 | h2
    · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp h1)
    · exact Or.inr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h2)
  let ε_sgn : Fin N → ℂ := fun j => q_fn j y₀_cone

    intro j
    rcases hq_pm j y₀_cone hy₀_cone with h1 | h2
    · dsimp [ε_sgn]; rw [h1]; exact one_ne_zero
    · dsimp [ε_sgn]; rw [h2]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero
  have hCone_ode : ∀ y ∈ truncCone, ∀ j : Fin N,
      deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y = ε_sgn j * g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j := by
    intro y hy j
    have hq_eq : q_fn j y = ε_sgn j := by

      have hcont_re : ContinuousOn (fun z => (q_fn j z).re) truncCone :=

      rcases hq_pm j y hy with hy1 | hy_neg1 <;>

      · exact hne (hy1.trans hy0_1.symm)

      · have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((q_fn j y).re) ((q_fn j y₀_cone).re) := by

        obtain ⟨z, hzU, hz0⟩ := hCone_pre.intermediate_value hy hy₀_cone hcont_re hmem

      · exact hne (hy_neg1.trans hy0_neg1.symm)
    have hgp_ne : g_plus (oddSliceStateVec S y) j ≠ 0 :=
      (hg_plus_sq _ (hCone_B₁ y hy) j).2
    exact (div_eq_iff hgp_ne).mp hq_eq

  
  let g : (Fin N → ℂ) → (Fin N → ℂ) := fun z j => ε_sgn j * g_plus z j
  have hg_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => g z j) B₁ :=
    fun j => (differentiableOn_const (ε_sgn j)).mul (hg_plus_holo j)
  have hg_ne : ∀ z ∈ B₁, ∀ j : Fin N, g z j ≠ 0 :=

  have hg_pi : DifferentiableOn ℂ g B₁ := differentiableOn_pi.mpr hg_holo
  let K₇₈ : Set (Fin N → ℂ) := Metric.closedBall s_lim (7 * ρ₁ / 8)
  have hK₇₈_sub : K₇₈ ⊆ B₁ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall s_lim (7 * ρ₁ / 8)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hg_pi.continuousOn.mono hK₇₈_sub)
  let M_g : ℝ := max C₀ 0
  have hM_g_nonneg : 0 ≤ M_g := le_max_right _ _
  have hM_g_bound : ∀ z ∈ K₇₈, ‖g z‖ ≤ M_g :=
    fun z hz => le_trans (hC₀ z hz) (le_max_left _ _)
  let L_g : ℝ := 8 * M_g / ρ₁
  have hL_g_nonneg : 0 ≤ L_g := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM_g_nonneg) hρ₁_pos.le
  let K₃₄ : Set (Fin N → ℂ) := Metric.closedBall s_lim (3 * ρ₁ / 4)
  have hK₃₄_sub₇₈ : K₃₄ ⊆ K₇₈ := Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
  have hK₃₄_sub : K₃₄ ⊆ B₁ := Subset.trans hK₃₄_sub₇₈ hK₇₈_sub
  have hg_fderiv_le : ∀ z ∈ K₃₄, ‖fderiv ℂ g z‖ ≤ L_g := by
    intro z hz
    have hg_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ g z :=
      hg_pi.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hK₃₄_sub hz))
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hL_g_nonneg fun v => ?_
    by_cases hv : ‖v‖ = 0
    · rw [norm_eq_zero.mp hv, map_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero]
    · let w_dir : Fin N → ℂ := ((‖v‖ : ℂ)⁻¹) • v
      have hw_norm : ‖w_dir‖ = 1 := by
        simp [w_dir, norm_smul, Complex.norm_real, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]
      let φ : ℂ → (Fin N → ℂ) := fun ζ => g (z + ζ • w_dir)
      have h_line_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun ζ : ℂ => z + ζ • w_dir) :=
        (differentiable_const z).add (differentiable_id.smul_const w_dir)
      have h_maps : MapsTo (fun ζ : ℂ => z + ζ • w_dir) (Metric.ball 0 (ρ₁ / 7)) B₁ := by
        intro ζ hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have hz_dist : ‖z - s_lim‖ ≤ 3 * ρ₁ / 4 := by
          simpa [K₃₄, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
        calc ‖z + ζ • w_dir - s_lim‖ = ‖(z - s_lim) + ζ • w_dir‖ := by
              rw [sub_add_eq_add_sub]
          _ ≤ ‖z - s_lim‖ + ‖ζ • w_dir‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖z - s_lim‖ + ‖ζ‖ * ‖w_dir‖ := by rw [norm_smul]
          _ ≤ 3 * ρ₁ / 4 + (ρ₁ / 7) * 1 := by rw [hw_norm]; linarith
          _ < ρ₁ := by linarith

          hγ_cont.continuousOn (fun τ hτ => hγ_mem y hy τ hτ)).const_smul (y - y_init)
      have h_int0 : IntervalIntegrable
          (fun τ => (y - y_init) • g (Φ n (γ y τ))) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
        refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
        exact ((hg_pi.comp (hΦ_props n).1
          (fun w hw => hK₃₄_sub (hΦ_k34 n w hw))).continuousOn.comp
          hγ_cont.continuousOn (fun τ hτ => hγ_mem y hy τ hτ)).const_smul (y - y_init)
      have h_eq : Φ (n + 2) y - Φ (n + 1) y =
          ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            ((y - y_init) • g (Φ (n + 1) (γ y τ)) - (y - y_init) • g (Φ n (γ y τ))) := by
        dsimp [Φ]
        rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int0]
      rw [h_eq]
      have hy_lt : ‖y - y_init‖ < r_ode := by
        simpa [B_ode, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hy
      have h_bd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ‖(y - y_init) • g (Φ (n + 1) (γ y τ)) - (y - y_init) • g (Φ n (γ y τ))‖ ≤
            (ρ₁ / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by
        intro τ hτ
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
        have hτ_icc : τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hτ.1.le, hτ.2⟩
        have hw_ode : γ y τ ∈ B_ode := hγ_mem y hy τ hτ_icc
        rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul]
        have h_lip_step := hg_lip _ (hΦ_k34 n _ hw_ode) _ (hΦ_k34 (n + 1) _ hw_ode)
        have h_ih_step := ih (γ y τ) hw_ode
        calc ‖y - y_init‖ * ‖g (Φ (n + 1) (γ y τ)) - g (Φ n (γ y τ))‖
            ≤ r_ode * (L_g * ((ρ₁ / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)) := by
              refine mul_le_mul hy_lt.le ?_ (norm_nonneg _) hr_ode_pos.le
              exact le_trans h_lip_step
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_ih_step hL_g_nonneg)
          _ = (r_ode * L_g) * ((ρ₁ / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((ρ₁ / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr_ode_L (by positivity)
          _ = (ρ₁ / 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) := by ring
      have h_est := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_bd
      simpa using h_est
  let s_tilde : ℂ → (Fin N → ℂ) :=
    fun y => Φ 0 y + ∑' n : ℕ, (Φ (n + 1) y - Φ n y)
  have h_sum_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun m y => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (Φ (n + 1) y - Φ n y))
      (fun y => ∑' n : ℕ, (Φ (n + 1) y - Φ n y)) Filter.atTop B_ode :=
    tendstoUniformlyOn_tsum_nat (summable_geometric_two.mul_left (ρ₁ / 2)) hΦ_diff
  have hΦ_unif : TendstoUniformlyOn Φ s_tilde Filter.atTop B_ode := by
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h_sum_unif ⊢
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [h_sum_unif ε hε] with m hm y hy
    have h_tel := Finset.sum_range_sub (fun n => Φ n y) m
    have h_eq : dist (s_tilde y) (Φ m y) =
        dist (∑' n : ℕ, (Φ (n + 1) y - Φ n y))
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (Φ (n + 1) y - Φ n y)) := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      congr 1
      dsimp [s_tilde]
      rw [h_tel]
      abel
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hm y hy
  have hΦ_loc_unif : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn Φ s_tilde Filter.atTop B_ode :=
    hΦ_unif.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
  have hs_tilde_holo_pi : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde B_ode :=
    hΦ_loc_unif.differentiableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hΦ_props n).1) Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hs_tilde_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => s_tilde y j) B_ode :=
    differentiableOn_pi.mp hs_tilde_holo_pi
  have hs_tilde_k34 : ∀ y ∈ B_ode, s_tilde y ∈ K₃₄ := by
    intro y hy
    have h_pt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖Φ n y - z_init‖) Filter.atTop
        (nhds ‖s_tilde y - z_init‖) :=
      ((hΦ_unif.tendsto_at hy).sub_const z_init).norm
    have h_le : ‖s_tilde y - z_init‖ ≤ ρ₁ / 2 :=
      le_of_tendsto h_pt (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hΦ_props n).2.1 y hy)
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
    calc ‖s_tilde y - s_lim‖ = ‖(s_tilde y - z_init) + (z_init - s_lim)‖ := by
          rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖s_tilde y - z_init‖ + ‖z_init - s_lim‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ρ₁ / 2 + ρ₁ / 4 := add_le_add h_le hz_init_ball.le
      _ = 3 * ρ₁ / 4 := by ring
  have hs_tilde_B₁ : ∀ y ∈ B_ode, s_tilde y ∈ B₁ :=
    fun y hy => hK₃₄_sub (hs_tilde_k34 y hy)
  have hs_tilde_deriv_pi : ∀ y ∈ B_ode, deriv s_tilde y = g (s_tilde y) := by
    intro y hy
    have h_d_conv := (hΦ_loc_unif.deriv
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hΦ_props n).1) Metric.isOpen_ball).tendsto_at hy
    have h_d_shift : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => deriv (Φ (n + 1)) y) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (deriv s_tilde y)) :=
      h_d_conv.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    have h_d_eq : (fun n => deriv (Φ (n + 1)) y) = (fun n => g (Φ n y)) := by
      funext n; exact ((hΦ_props n).2.2 y hy).deriv
    rw [h_d_eq] at h_d_shift
    have hg_cont_at : ContinuousAt g (s_tilde y) :=
      (hg_pi.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hs_tilde_B₁ y hy))).continuousAt
    have h_rhs_conv : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g (Φ n y)) Filter.atTop (nhds (g (s_tilde y))) :=
      hg_cont_at.tendsto.comp (hΦ_unif.tendsto_at hy)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_d_shift h_rhs_conv
  have hs_tilde_deriv : ∀ y ∈ B_ode, ∀ j : Fin N,
      deriv (fun z => s_tilde z j) y = g (s_tilde y) j := by
    intro y hy j
    have hd_at : HasDerivAt s_tilde (g (s_tilde y)) y := by
      rw [← hs_tilde_deriv_pi y hy]
      exact (hs_tilde_holo_pi.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).hasDerivAt
    exact (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
      y hd_at)).deriv
  have hs_tilde_init : s_tilde y_init = z_init := by
    have h_pt := hΦ_unif.tendsto_at (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_ode_pos)
    have h_const : (fun n => Φ n y_init) = fun _ => z_init := by
      funext n
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n _ => simp [Φ]
    rw [h_const] at h_pt
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_pt tendsto_const_nhds

  
  let s_orig : ℂ → (Fin N → ℂ) := oddSliceStateVec S
  have hs_orig_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y => s_orig y j) truncCone :=
    fun j => (hChord.impact_holo j.val).mono hCone_sub
  obtain ⟨r_u, hr_u_pos, hr_u_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hCone_open y_init hy_init_cone
  let r_eq : ℝ := min (r_ode / 2) (r_u / 2)
  have hr_eq_pos : 0 < r_eq := by positivity
  let K_loc : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall y_init r_eq
  have hK_loc_ode : K_loc ⊆ B_ode :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hr_ode_pos))
  have hK_loc_U : K_loc ⊆ truncCone :=
    Subset.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (half_lt_self hr_u_pos))) hr_u_sub
  have hs_orig_holo_pi : DifferentiableOn ℂ s_orig truncCone :=
    differentiableOn_pi.mpr hs_orig_holo
  have hs_orig_hd : ∀ w ∈ K_loc, HasDerivAt s_orig (g (s_orig w)) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_U : w ∈ truncCone := hK_loc_U hw
    have hd := (hs_orig_holo_pi.differentiableAt (hCone_open.mem_nhds hw_U)).hasDerivAt
    have h_eq : deriv s_orig w = g (s_orig w) := by
      ext j
      have h_proj := (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin N → ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
        w hd)).deriv
      exact h_proj.symm.trans (hCone_ode w hw_U j)
    rwa [h_eq] at hd
  have hs_tilde_hd : ∀ w ∈ K_loc, HasDerivAt s_tilde (g (s_tilde w)) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_ode : w ∈ B_ode := hK_loc_ode hw
    have hd := (hs_tilde_holo_pi.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw_ode)).hasDerivAt
    rwa [hs_tilde_deriv_pi w hw_ode] at hd
  have h_int_rep : ∀ (f : ℂ → (Fin N → ℂ)),
      f y_init = z_init →
      ContinuousOn f K_loc →
      (∀ w ∈ K_loc, f w ∈ K₃₄) →
      (∀ w ∈ K_loc, HasDerivAt f (g (f w)) w) →
      ∀ y ∈ K_loc, f y - z_init = ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (y - y_init) • g (f (γ y τ)) := by
    intro f hf_init hf_cont hf_k34 hf_hd y hy
    have hy_d : ‖y - y_init‖ ≤ r_eq := by
      simpa [K_loc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hy
    have hγ_loc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ y τ ∈ K_loc := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_trans (hγ_dist y τ hτ) hy_d
    have h_step_hd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (γ y t)) ((y - y_init) • g (f (γ y τ))) τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) τ := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id τ).ofReal_comp
      have hγ_τ : HasDerivAt (γ y) (y - y_init) τ := by
        dsimp [γ]
        simpa using (h_ofReal.mul_const (y - y_init)).const_add y_init
      exact (hf_hd (γ y τ) (hγ_loc τ hτ)).scomp τ hγ_τ
    have hγ_cont : Continuous (γ y) :=
      continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have h_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ => (y - y_init) • g (f (γ y τ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact ((hg_pi.continuousOn.comp hf_cont (fun w hw => hK₃₄_sub (hf_k34 w hw))).comp
        hγ_cont.continuousOn hγ_loc).const_smul (y - y_init)
    have h_ftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_step_hd h_int
    have h1 : γ y 1 = y := by simp [γ]
    have h0 : γ y 0 = y_init := by simp [γ]
    rw [h1, h0, hf_init] at h_ftc
    exact h_ftc.symm
  have hs_orig_k34 : ∀ w ∈ K_loc, s_orig w ∈ K₃₄ := by
    intro w hw
    have hw_b := hCone_ball w (hK_loc_U hw)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hw_b
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by linarith)
  have h_diff_cont : ContinuousOn (fun w => ‖s_tilde w - s_orig w‖) K_loc :=
    ((hs_tilde_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_ode).sub
      (hs_orig_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_U)).norm
  obtain ⟨w_max, hw_max_mem, hw_max⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y_init r_eq).exists_isMaxOn
    ⟨y_init, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr_eq_pos.le⟩ h_diff_cont
  let D : ℝ := ‖s_tilde w_max - s_orig w_max‖
  have hD_nonneg : 0 ≤ D := norm_nonneg _
  have hD_le_half : D ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D := by
    have h_rep1 := h_int_rep s_tilde hs_tilde_init
      (hs_tilde_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_ode)
      (fun w hw => hs_tilde_k34 w (hK_loc_ode hw)) hs_tilde_hd w_max hw_max_mem
    have h_rep2 := h_int_rep s_orig rfl
      (hs_orig_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_U)
      hs_orig_k34 hs_orig_hd w_max hw_max_mem
    have hw_d : ‖w_max - y_init‖ ≤ r_eq := by
      simpa [K_loc, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw_max_mem
    have hw_lt : ‖w_max - y_init‖ ≤ r_ode :=
      le_trans hw_d (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (half_le_self hr_ode_pos.le))
    have hγ_loc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, γ w_max τ ∈ K_loc := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      exact le_trans (hγ_dist w_max τ hτ) hw_d
    have hγ_cont : Continuous (γ w_max) :=
      continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
    have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ => (w_max - y_init) • g (s_tilde (γ w_max τ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact ((hg_pi.continuousOn.comp (hs_tilde_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_ode)
        (fun w hw => hK₃₄_sub (hs_tilde_k34 w (hK_loc_ode hw)))).comp
        hγ_cont.continuousOn hγ_loc).const_smul (w_max - y_init)
    have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ => (w_max - y_init) • g (s_orig (γ w_max τ)))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable ?_
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      exact ((hg_pi.continuousOn.comp (hs_orig_holo_pi.continuousOn.mono hK_loc_U)
        (fun w hw => hK₃₄_sub (hs_orig_k34 w hw))).comp
        hγ_cont.continuousOn hγ_loc).const_smul (w_max - y_init)
    have h_sub_eq : s_tilde w_max - s_orig w_max =
        ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          ((w_max - y_init) • g (s_tilde (γ w_max τ)) -
            (w_max - y_init) • g (s_orig (γ w_max τ))) := by
      have : s_tilde w_max - s_orig w_max =
          (s_tilde w_max - z_init) - (s_orig w_max - z_init) := by abel
      rw [this, h_rep1, h_rep2, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int2]
    have h_bd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖(w_max - y_init) • g (s_tilde (γ w_max τ)) -
          (w_max - y_init) • g (s_orig (γ w_max τ))‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hτ
      have hτ_icc : τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hτ.1.le, hτ.2⟩
      have hw_τ : γ w_max τ ∈ K_loc := hγ_loc τ hτ_icc
      rw [← smul_sub, norm_smul]
      have h_lip_w := hg_lip _ (hs_orig_k34 _ hw_τ) _ (hs_tilde_k34 _ (hK_loc_ode hw_τ))
      have h_le_D : ‖s_tilde (γ w_max τ) - s_orig (γ w_max τ)‖ ≤ D := hw_max hw_τ
      calc ‖w_max - y_init‖ * ‖g (s_tilde (γ w_max τ)) - g (s_orig (γ w_max τ))‖
          ≤ r_ode * (L_g * D) := by
            refine mul_le_mul hw_lt ?_ (norm_nonneg _) hr_ode_pos.le
            exact le_trans h_lip_w (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le_D hL_g_nonneg)
        _ = (r_ode * L_g) * D := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr_ode_L hD_nonneg
    have h_est := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const h_bd
    calc D = ‖s_tilde w_max - s_orig w_max‖ := rfl
      _ = ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            ((w_max - y_init) • g (s_tilde (γ w_max τ)) -
              (w_max - y_init) • g (s_orig (γ w_max τ)))‖ := by rw [h_sub_eq]
      _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * D := by simpa using h_est
  have hD_zero : D = 0 := by linarith
  have hs_loc_eq : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_init r_eq, s_tilde y = s_orig y := by
    intro y hy
    have h_le : ‖s_tilde y - s_orig y‖ ≤ D := hw_max (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
    rw [hD_zero] at h_le
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp h_le)

  
  have h_dist_init_star : dist y_init y_star = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_arc := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h_diff : y_init - y_star = ((-(2 / 3 : ℝ) * δ_arc : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      dsimp [y_init, y_star]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_diff, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
    ring
  have h_arc_sub_ode : Metric.ball y_star δ_arc ⊆ B_ode := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
    have h_tri := dist_triangle y y_star y_init
    rw [dist_comm y_star y_init, h_dist_init_star] at h_tri
    linarith
  have h_strip_convex : Convex ℝ (horizStrip h) := by
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ a b ha hb hab
    change |y₁.im| < h at hy₁
    change |y₂.im| < h at hy₂
    change |(a • y₁ + b • y₂).im| < h
    have him_eq : (a • y₁ + b • y₂).im = a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im := by simp
    rw [him_eq]
    have h_tri : |a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im| ≤ a * |y₁.im| + b * |y₂.im| := by
      calc |a * y₁.im + b * y₂.im| ≤ |a * y₁.im| + |b * y₂.im| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = a * |y₁.im| + b * |y₂.im| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha_pos
    · simp at hab; subst hab; linarith
    · have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy₁ ha_pos
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy₂.le hb
      nlinarith
  let U_ov : Set ℂ := Metric.ball y_star δ_arc ∩ horizStrip h
  have hU_ov_open : IsOpen U_ov := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter h_open_h
  have hU_ov_pre : IsPreconnected U_ov :=
    ((convex_ball y_star δ_arc).inter h_strip_convex).isPreconnected
  have hy_init_ov : y_init ∈ U_ov := by
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by rw [h_dist_init_star]; linarith), hCone_sub hy_init_cone⟩
  have hs_agrees_ov : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_arc, y ∈ horizStrip h →
      ∀ j : Fin N, s_tilde y j = sliceImpactSeq S N j.val y := by
    intro y hy_ball hy_strip j
    have ha₁ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun z => s_tilde z j) U_ov :=
      ((hs_tilde_holo j).mono (Subset.trans inter_subset_left h_arc_sub_ode)).analyticOnNhd
        hU_ov_open
    have ha₂ : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) U_ov :=
      ((hChord.impact_holo j.val).mono inter_subset_right).analyticOnNhd hU_ov_open
    have hev : (fun z => s_tilde z j) =ᶠ[nhds y_init] sliceImpactSeq S N j.val := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds y_init hr_eq_pos] with z hz
      exact congr_fun (hs_loc_eq z hz) j
    exact ha₁.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq ha₂ hU_ov_pre hy_init_ov hev
      ⟨hy_ball, hy_strip⟩

  exact ⟨{
    δ_arc := δ_arc
    δ_arc_pos := hδ_arc_pos
    δ_arc_lt_half_h := hδ_arc_lt_half_h
    s_ext := s_tilde
    s_ext_holo := fun j => (hs_tilde_holo j).mono h_arc_sub_ode
    s_ext_in_strip := fun y hy j => (hB₁_props _ (hs_tilde_B₁ y (h_arc_sub_ode hy)) j).1
    s_ext_agrees := hs_agrees_ov
    s_ext_f_ne := fun y hy j => (hB₁_props _ (hs_tilde_B₁ y (h_arc_sub_ode hy)) j).2.1
    s_ext_sin_ne := fun y hy j => (hB₁_props _ (hs_tilde_B₁ y (h_arc_sub_ode hy)) j).2.2.1
    s_ext_chord_ne := fun y hy j => (hB₁_props _ (hs_tilde_B₁ y (h_arc_sub_ode hy)) j).2.2.2.1
    s_ext_deriv_ne := fun y hy j => by
      rw [hs_tilde_deriv y (h_arc_sub_ode hy) j]
      exact hg_ne _ (hs_tilde_B₁ y (h_arc_sub_ode hy)) j
  }⟩

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
