proof.tactics:
by
  have hRefl : ClearedReflectionArcProp S x_star A :=
    cleared_reflection_tube_and_partials S hChord x_star A
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := cyclic_ift_conjugated_return_map S x_star A hRefl
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three
  have hN_ne_C : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three)
  rcases C.δ_bounds with ⟨hδ1_pos, hδ1_lt_δ0, hδ0_le_arc, hδv1_pos, hδv1_lt_δv0⟩
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    have h_lt : A.δ_arc < h / 2 := A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    have h_pos_arc : 0 < A.δ_arc := A.δ_arc_pos
    linarith
  let δ_half : ℝ := C.δ_1 / 2
  let y_sub : ℂ := y_star - (δ_half : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let μ_sub : ℝ := C.δ_1 / 4
  have hμ_pos : 0 < μ_sub := by
    dsimp [μ_sub]
    linarith
  have hμ_lt_h : μ_sub < h := by
    have h_lt : A.δ_arc < h / 2 := A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    dsimp [μ_sub]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨r_step, hr_step_pos, _, h_step⟩ := C.arc_subheight_step μ_sub hμ_pos hμ_lt_h
  let r_sub : ℝ := C.δ_1 / 8
  let r_b : ℝ := min (r_sub / 2) ((N : ℝ) * (r_step / 2))
  have hr_sub_pos : 0 < r_sub := by
    dsimp [r_sub]
    linarith
  have hr_b_pos : 0 < r_b := by
    dsimp [r_b]
    exact lt_min (half_pos hr_sub_pos) (mul_pos hN_pos_R (half_pos hr_step_pos))
  have hr_b_le : r_b ≤ r_sub / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hy_sub_diff : y_sub - y_star = -((δ_half : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    dsimp [y_sub]
    ring
  have hy_sub_dist : ‖y_sub - y_star‖ = C.δ_1 / 2 := by
    rw [hy_sub_diff, norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (half_pos hδ1_pos)]
  have hy_sub_im : y_sub.im = h - C.δ_1 / 2 := by
    dsimp only [y_sub, y_star]
    simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
      Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    dsimp [δ_half]
    ring
  have hy_in_34 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub,
      y ∈ Metric.ball y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * C.δ_1) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy ⊢
    have h_tri : ‖y - y_star‖ ≤ ‖y - y_sub‖ + ‖y_sub - y_star‖ := by
      simpa using norm_add_le (y - y_sub) (y_sub - y_star)
    dsimp [r_sub] at hy
    linarith [hy_sub_dist]
  have hy_in_δ0 : Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ⊆ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h34 := hy_in_34 y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at h34 ⊢
    linarith
  have hy_im_sub : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub, y.im < h - μ_sub := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have him_le : (y - y_sub).im ≤ ‖y - y_sub‖ := Complex.im_le_norm (y - y_sub)
    have him_eq : y.im = y_sub.im + (y - y_sub).im := by
      rw [← Complex.add_im, add_sub_cancel]
    dsimp [r_sub, μ_sub] at hy ⊢
    linarith [hy_sub_im]
  let t_loc : ℂ → ℂ := fun b => (t₀ : ℂ) + b / (N : ℂ)
  have ht_loc_mem : ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b,
      t_loc b ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_step := by
    intro b hb
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have h_diff : t_loc b - (t₀ : ℂ) = b / (N : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [t_loc]
      ring
    rw [h_diff, norm_div]
    have hN_norm : ‖(N : ℂ)‖ = (N : ℝ) := Complex.norm_natCast N
    rw [hN_norm, div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos_R]
    have hb_le : r_b ≤ (N : ℝ) * (r_step / 2) := min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  let U_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (p.1, t_loc p.2))
  let V_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 (p.1 + t_loc p.2, t_loc p.2) - arcS1 S A (U_loc p)
  let dom_loc : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b
  have h_step_loc : ∀ p ∈ dom_loc,
      (p.1, t_loc p.2) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
      (p.1 + t_loc p.2, t_loc p.2) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
      S.𝔰 (p.1, t_loc p.2) ∈ arcS0 S A '' Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ∧
      (U_loc p, V_loc p) ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.δ_v1 := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 := h_step p.1 (hy_in_34 p.1 hp.1) (hy_im_sub p.1 hp.1) (t_loc p.2) (ht_loc_mem p.2 hp.2)
    exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2.1, h1.2.2.1, h1.2.2.2.1⟩
  have ht_loc_diff : Differentiable ℂ t_loc :=
    (differentiable_const (t₀ : ℂ)).add (differentiable_id.div_const (N : ℂ))
  have h_map1_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1, t_loc p.2)) dom_loc :=
    (differentiable_fst.prodMk (ht_loc_diff.comp differentiable_snd)).differentiableOn
  have h_map2_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + t_loc p.2, t_loc p.2)) dom_loc :=
    ((differentiable_fst.add (ht_loc_diff.comp differentiable_snd)).prodMk
      (ht_loc_diff.comp differentiable_snd)).differentiableOn
  have h_s0_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1, t_loc p.2)) dom_loc :=
    S.𝔰_holo.comp h_map1_diff (fun p hp => (h_step_loc p hp).1)
  have h_s1_comp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1 + t_loc p.2, t_loc p.2)) dom_loc :=
    S.𝔰_holo.comp h_map2_diff (fun p hp => (h_step_loc p hp).2.1)
  have hU_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_loc dom_loc :=
    C.s0_inv_holo_on_image.comp h_s0_comp (fun p hp => (h_step_loc p hp).2.2.1)
  have h_arcS1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (arcS1 S A) (Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc) :=
    A.s_ext_holo ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
  have hV_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_loc dom_loc :=
    h_s1_comp.sub (h_arcS1_holo.comp hU_holo (fun p hp => by
      have hU_mem : U_loc p ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_1 := (h_step_loc p hp).2.2.2.1
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hU_mem ⊢
      linarith))
  have hUV_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub, U_loc (y, 0) = y ∧ V_loc (y, 0) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy_δ0 : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 := hy_in_δ0 hy
    have hy_im_h : y.im < h := lt_trans (hy_im_sub y hy) (by linarith)
    have ht0_eq : t_loc 0 = (t₀ : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [t_loc]
      simp
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := C.arc_slice_at_t0 y hy_δ0 hy_im_h
    have hU0 : U_loc (y, 0) = y := by
      dsimp [U_loc]
      rw [ht0_eq, hs0]
      exact C.s0_left_inv y hy_δ0
    refine ⟨hU0, ?_⟩
    dsimp [V_loc]
    rw [hU0, ht0_eq, hs1, sub_self]
  have hUV_conj : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub (r_sub / 2), ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b,
      (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.δ_v0 ∧
      C.F_plus (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) = (U_loc (y + b, b), V_loc (y + b, b)) := by
    intro y hy b hb
    have hy_full : y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
      linarith
    have hp_mem : (y, b) ∈ dom_loc := ⟨hy_full, hb⟩
    have hUV_1 : (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) ∈
        Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.δ_v0 := by
      rcases (h_step_loc (y, b) hp_mem).2.2.2 with ⟨hU1, hV1⟩
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hU1 ⊢; linarith
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hV1 ⊢; linarith
    refine ⟨hUV_1, ?_⟩
    have hyb_full : y + b ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy ⊢
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hb
      have h_tri : ‖y + b - y_sub‖ ≤ ‖y - y_sub‖ + ‖b‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_eq_add_sub] using norm_add_le (y - y_sub) b
      linarith [hr_b_le]
    have h_shift_eq :
        y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t_loc b - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = y + b := by
      have ht_sub : t_loc b - (t₀ : ℂ) = b / (N : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [t_loc]
        ring
      change y + (N : ℂ) * (t_loc b - (t₀ : ℂ)) = y + b
      rw [ht_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hN_ne_C]
    have h_eq := (h_step y (hy_in_34 y hy_full) (hy_im_sub y hy_full)
      (t_loc b) (ht_loc_mem b hb)).2.2.2.2
      (h_shift_eq.symm ▸ hy_in_34 (y + b) hyb_full)
      (h_shift_eq.symm ▸ hy_im_sub (y + b) hyb_full)
    rw [h_shift_eq] at h_eq
    exact h_eq
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := holomorphic_conjugacy_normal_form y_star C.δ_0 C.δ_v0 C.δ_1 C.δ_v1
    ⟨hδ1_pos, hδ1_lt_δ0, hδv1_pos, hδv1_lt_δv0⟩
    C.F_plus C.F_minus C.F_plus_holo C.F_minus_holo C.F_plus_zero C.F_minus_zero
    (fun u hu v hv =>
      ⟨(C.F_mutual_inv u hu v hv).1, (C.F_mutual_inv u hu v hv).2.2.1⟩)
    y_sub r_sub r_b ⟨hr_sub_pos, hr_b_pos, hr_b_le⟩ hy_in_δ0
    U_loc V_loc hU_holo hV_holo hUV_zero hUV_conj
  exact edge_recentering_and_subheight_step S x_star A C E

return_map_normal_form_extraction.definitions:
noncomputable def arcS0 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) {x_star : ℝ}
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  A.s_ext u ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

noncomputable def arcS1 (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) {x_star : ℝ}
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) (u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  A.s_ext u ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩

structure ClearedReflectionArcProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) : Prop where
  analytic_at_strip :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => clearedReflectE S p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
        ((s_m, s_0), s_p)
  periodic_m :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S (s_m + 2 * Real.pi) s_0 s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_0 :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m (s_0 + 2 * Real.pi) s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_p :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 (s_p + 2 * Real.pi) = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  subheight_tube_vanish :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_tube : ℝ, 0 < r_tube ∧ r_tube < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ),
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_tube,
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ oddSliceN S + 1 →
              (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ oddSliceN S →
              clearedReflectE S
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t)) = 0)
  arc_vanish :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        clearedReflectE S
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
          (A.s_ext y j)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) = 0
  arc_partials_ne_zero :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        deriv
          (fun z =>
            clearedReflectE S
              (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
              (A.s_ext y j) z)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv
          (fun w =>
            clearedReflectE S w
              (A.s_ext y j)
              (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)))
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0

structure ConjugatedReturnMapArcData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) where
  δ_0 : ℝ
  δ_v0 : ℝ
  δ_1 : ℝ
  δ_v1 : ℝ
  δ_bounds : 0 < δ_1 ∧ δ_1 < δ_0 ∧ δ_0 ≤ A.δ_arc ∧ 0 < δ_v1 ∧ δ_v1 < δ_v0
  s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_arc_open_map :
    ∀ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U →
      U ⊆ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 →
      IsOpen (arcS0 S A '' U)
  s0_inv_holo_on_image :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv
      (arcS0 S A ''
        Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0)
  s0_left_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      s0_inv (arcS0 S A u) = u
  F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_plus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_minus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_plus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_minus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_minus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_mutual_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
        F_plus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v)
  arc_slice_at_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      S.𝔰 (y, (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = arcS0 S A y ∧
      S.𝔰 (y + (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) =
        arcS1 S A y
  arc_subheight_step :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball
            ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1),
          y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_μ,
            (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈
              arcS0 S A ''
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ∧
            (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
              Metric.ball
                ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1 ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 ∧
            (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) ∈
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                  ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1) →
              (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))).im <
                sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
              F_plus
                (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)),
                 S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                (s0_inv
                  (S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)), t)),
                 S.𝔰
                   (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                   arcS1 S A
                     (s0_inv
                       (S.𝔰
                         (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)),
                           t)))))

structure ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion (y_star : ℂ) (δ_0 δ_v1 : ℝ)
    (F_plus F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) where
  ρ_v : ℝ
  ρ_v_pos : 0 < ρ_v
  ρ_v_le : ρ_v ≤ δ_v1
  σ : ℂ → ℂ
  A_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  σ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball y_star δ_0)
  σ_nonzero_exists : ∃ y_sub ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, σ y_sub ≠ 0
  rem_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_plus_eq :

  F_minus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_minus (u, v) =
        (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),

structure ClearedReflectionArcProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) : Prop where
  analytic_at_strip :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => clearedReflectE S p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
        ((s_m, s_0), s_p)
  periodic_m :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S (s_m + 2 * Real.pi) s_0 s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_0 :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m (s_0 + 2 * Real.pi) s_p = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  periodic_p :
    ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 (s_p + 2 * Real.pi) = clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p
  subheight_tube_vanish :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_tube : ℝ, 0 < r_tube ∧ r_tube < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ),
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_tube,
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ oddSliceN S + 1 →
              (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ oddSliceN S →
              clearedReflectE S
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t))
                (S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t)) = 0)
  arc_vanish :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        clearedReflectE S
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
          (A.s_ext y j)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) = 0
  arc_partials_ne_zero :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) A.δ_arc,
      ∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
        deriv
          (fun z =>
            clearedReflectE S
              (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j))
              (A.s_ext y j) z)
          (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv
          (fun w =>
            clearedReflectE S w
              (A.s_ext y j)
              (A.s_ext y (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)))
          (A.s_ext y (@cycPrev (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) j)) ≠ 0

structure ConjugatedReturnMapArcData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) where
  δ_0 : ℝ
  δ_v0 : ℝ
  δ_1 : ℝ
  δ_v1 : ℝ
  δ_bounds : 0 < δ_1 ∧ δ_1 < δ_0 ∧ δ_0 ≤ A.δ_arc ∧ 0 < δ_v1 ∧ δ_v1 < δ_v0
  s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ
  s0_arc_open_map :
    ∀ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U →
      U ⊆ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 →
      IsOpen (arcS0 S A '' U)
  s0_inv_holo_on_image :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv
      (arcS0 S A ''
        Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0)
  s0_left_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      s0_inv (arcS0 S A u) = u
  F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ
  F_plus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_minus_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus
      (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0)
  F_plus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_minus_zero :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      F_minus (u, 0) = (u, 0)
  F_mutual_inv :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1,
      ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
        F_plus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (u, v) ∈
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
        F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v)
  arc_slice_at_t0 :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0,
      y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      S.𝔰 (y, (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) = arcS0 S A y ∧
      S.𝔰 (y + (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) =
        arcS1 S A y
  arc_subheight_step :
    ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball
            ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1),
          y.im < sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
          ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) r_μ,
            (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
            S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈
              arcS0 S A ''
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_0 ∧
            (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
              Metric.ball
                ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I) δ_1 ×ˢ
                Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 ∧
            (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) ∈
                Metric.ball
                  ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                  ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1) →
              (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ))).im <
                sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) - μ →
              F_plus
                (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)),
                 S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - arcS1 S A (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                (s0_inv
                  (S.𝔰 (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)), t)),
                 S.𝔰
                   (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                   arcS1 S A
                     (s0_inv
                       (S.𝔰
                         (y + (oddSliceN S : ℂ) * (t - (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)),
                           t)))))

structure ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion (y_star : ℂ) (δ_0 δ_v1 : ℝ)
    (F_plus F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) where
  ρ_v : ℝ
  ρ_v_pos : 0 < ρ_v
  ρ_v_le : ρ_v ≤ δ_v1
  σ : ℂ → ℂ
  A_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  B_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  σ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ σ (Metric.ball y_star δ_0)
  σ_nonzero_exists : ∃ y_sub ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, σ y_sub ≠ 0
  rem_holo :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ A_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ B_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v)
  F_plus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_plus (u, v) =
        (u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v),
         v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v))
  F_minus_eq :
    ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_minus (u, v) =
        (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),
         v + deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_minus (u, v))

by
  classical
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S

  let t₀ : ℂ := (t₀_r : ℂ)
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N

  let stepMap : Bool → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ) := fun pos => if pos then M.F_plus else M.F_minus
  let chartU : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun y t => M.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))
  let chartV : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun y t => S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - M.s1_arc (chartU y t)
  let chartZ : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun y t => (chartU y t, chartV y t)
  let p₀ : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => (M.σ u)⁻¹
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three
  have hN_ne_C : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hN_pos
  have ht0_pos : 0 < t₀_r := by
    dsimp [t₀_r, sliceParamT0]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : t₀_r < S.r_star := by
    dsimp [t₀_r, sliceParamT0]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=

    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have ht0_mem : t₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    dsimp [t₀]
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0_pos]
    exact ht0_lt

  have hh_pos : 0 < h := lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos hh_ge_s_star

  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min (lt_min hρ1_pos hh_pos) S.s_star_pos)
  have h64δ_ρ1 : 64 * δ ≤ M.ρ_1 := by
    have h1 : min (min M.ρ_1 h) S.s_star ≤ M.ρ_1 :=
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have h64δ_h : 64 * δ ≤ h := by
    have h1 : min (min M.ρ_1 h) S.s_star ≤ h :=
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have h64δ_s : 64 * δ ≤ S.s_star := by
    have h1 : min (min M.ρ_1 h) S.s_star ≤ S.s_star := min_le_right _ _

  have h_mul_nat_re : ∀ (k : ℕ) (w : ℂ), ((k : ℂ) * w).re = (k : ℝ) * w.re :=

  have hbStep_norm : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖bStep t‖ = (N : ℝ) * ‖t - t₀‖ := by
    intro t
    dsimp [bStep]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_natCast]
  
  have hSubheight : ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < h →
      ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - t₀_r ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => chartZ p.1 p.2)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_edge (M.ρ_1 / 2) ∧
            p.1.im < h - μ ∧ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball t₀ r_μ } ∧

    intro μ hμ_pos hμ_lt
    obtain ⟨r_μ, hr_pos, hr_lt, hTube⟩ := M.subheight_tube_step μ hμ_pos hμ_lt
    refine ⟨r_μ, hr_pos, hr_lt, ?_, ?_⟩
    · let W : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
        { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_edge (M.ρ_1 / 2) ∧

    let r_e : ℝ := min (M.ρ_1 / 6) 1

    have hyk_im : |y_k.im - h| < (5 / 2 : ℝ) * δ := by

  have hMultiStep : ∀ (μ r_μ : ℝ),

  have hOverlap_le : ∀ (pos₀ : Bool) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ}, m₁ ≤ m₂ →

    intro pos₀ m₁ m₂ hm q hq1 hq2
    let b_tilde := dirStep pos₀ q.2
    let w : ℂ := q.1 - (m₂ : ℂ) * b_tilde
    have ht_slab : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball t₀ r_slab := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hq1.1.2.2.2.2.1 hr_steep_le_slab
    have htr2 := hTraj pos₀ m₂ q hq2
    have hw_shift : w + ((m₂ - m₁ : ℕ) : ℂ) * b_tilde = q.1 - (m₁ : ℂ) * b_tilde := by

      rw [Nat.cast_sub hm]
      ring

      have him1 : (w + (j : ℂ) * b_tilde).im = w.im + (j : ℝ) * b_tilde.im := by
        rw [Complex.add_im, h_mul_nat_im]
      have him2 : (q.1 - (m₁ : ℂ) * b_tilde).im =
          w.im + ((m₂ - m₁ : ℕ) : ℝ) * b_tilde.im := by
        rw [← hw_shift, Complex.add_im, h_mul_nat_im]
      have hj_le : (j : ℝ) * b_tilde.im ≤ ((m₂ - m₁ : ℕ) : ℝ) * b_tilde.im :=

    have h_iter := hMultiStep δ r_slab

  have hOverlap : ∀ (pos₀ : Bool) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ),

    · exact hOverlap_le pos₀ hm q hq1 hq2
    · exact (hOverlap_le pos₀ hm q hq2 hq1).symm

  have hChart_holo : ∀ (pos₀ : Bool) (m₀ : ℕ),

    change fixedBranch (decide (0 ≤ (q.2 - t₀).im)) (stepCount q) q = fixedBranch pos₀ m₀ q

      have hall : ∀ j ≤ m_p,

        intro j hj

        have hj_le : (j : ℝ) * b_tilde.im ≤ (m_p : ℝ) * b_tilde.im :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hj) (le_of_lt htr.2.2.2.1)
        have hμ'_le : μ' ≤ μ := min_le_left _ _

      have h_iter := hMultiStep μ' r_μ'
        (fun y hy hy_im t ht pos hy' hy'_im =>
          (hStep_μ' y hy hy_im t ht).2.2 pos hy' hy'_im)
        pos_p p.2 ht_ball w m_p hall
      rw [hw_end] at h_iter
      have hp_end := hall m_p le_rfl
      rw [hw_end] at hp_end
      dsimp [S_steep, fixedBranch]
      change M.s0_arc (((stepMap pos_p)^[m_p] (chartZ w p.2)).1) = S.𝔰 p

        ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_b → b < S.h_X t := by
    intro b hb
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (t₀ : ℂ) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star), b < S.h_X t :=
      S.h_X_lsc (t₀ : ℂ) ht₀_mem b hb
    rw [nhdsWithin_eq_nhds.mpr (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ht₀_mem)] at hev
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev
    refine ⟨min r₁ (S.r_star - t₀), lt_min hr₁_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht₀_lt), min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    apply hr₁
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le ht (min_le_left _ _)

  
  let x_edge : ℝ := K.x_edge
  let δ_cor : ℝ := K.δ_cor
  have hδ_cor_pos : 0 < δ_cor := K.δ_cor_pos
  have hδ_cor_lt_h : δ_cor < h / 4 := K.δ_cor_lt.1
  let η : ℝ := δ_cor / 8
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hη_lt_h : 32 * η < h := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hδ_eq : δ_cor = 8 * η := by dsimp [η]; ring
  let μ₀ : ℝ := η / 4
  have hμ₀_pos : 0 < μ₀ := by dsimp [μ₀]; linarith
  have hμ₀_lt : μ₀ < h := by dsimp [μ₀]; linarith
  obtain ⟨r_tube, hr_tube_pos, hr_tube_le, hr_tube_hX⟩ :=
    h_lsc_radius (h - η / 8) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r_μ₀, hr_μ₀_pos, hr_μ₀_le, h_agrees_μ₀⟩ :=
    K.S_steep_agrees μ₀ hμ₀_pos hμ₀_lt
  let r : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * min r_tube r_μ₀
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min hr_tube_pos hr_μ₀_pos)
  have hr_le_tube : 2 * r ≤ r_tube := by
    dsimp [r]; linarith [min_le_left r_tube r_μ₀]
  have hr_le_μ₀ : 2 * r ≤ r_μ₀ := by
    dsimp [r]; linarith [min_le_right r_tube r_μ₀]

  let A_ζ : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | (9 / 10 : ℝ) < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < 11 / 10 }
  let A_shal : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ζ ∈ A_ζ ∧ |ζ.im| < (5 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ }
  let A_steep : Set ℂ := { ζ : ℂ | ζ ∈ A_ζ ∧ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ < |ζ.im| }
  let D_a : Set ℂ := { a : ℂ | |a.re - x_edge| < η ∧ h - 3 * η < a.im ∧ a.im < h + η / 4 }
  let I_low : Set ℂ := { a : ℂ | |a.re - x_edge| < η ∧ h - 3 * η < a.im ∧ a.im < h - (7 / 4 : ℝ) * η }

  have hAζ_open : IsOpen A_ζ :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hAshal_open : IsOpen A_shal :=
    hAζ_open.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm))
  have hAsteep_open : IsOpen A_steep :=
    hAζ_open.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)
      (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im))
  have hDa_open : IsOpen D_a :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const))
  have hIlow_open : IsOpen I_low :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_re.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_im).inter
        (isOpen_lt Complex.continuous_im continuous_const))
  have hIlow_sub : I_low ⊆ D_a := fun a ha => ⟨ha.1, ha.2.1, by linarith [ha.2.2]⟩

  let a₀ : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + ((h - (9 / 4 : ℝ) * η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have ha₀_low : a₀ ∈ I_low := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [a₀, hη_pos]
    · simp [a₀]; linarith
    · simp [a₀]; linarith
  have ha₀_Da : a₀ ∈ D_a := hIlow_sub ha₀_low

  have h_conv_lt : ∀ {x₁ x₂ A B u₁ u₂ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ u₁ → 0 ≤ u₂ → u₁ + u₂ = 1 → A < x₁ → x₁ < B → A < x₂ → x₂ < B →
      A < u₁ * x₁ + u₂ * x₂ ∧ u₁ * x₁ + u₂ * x₂ < B := by
    intro x₁ x₂ A B u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu hx1A hx1B hx2A hx2B
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hu₁ with rfl | hu₁_pos
    · have hu₂' : u₂ = 1 := by linarith
      subst hu₂'; exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · have hA1 : u₁ * A < u₁ * x₁ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx1A hu₁_pos
      have hA2 : u₂ * A ≤ u₂ * x₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx2A.le hu₂
      have hB1 : u₁ * x₁ < u₁ * B := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx1B hu₁_pos
      have hB2 : u₂ * x₂ ≤ u₂ * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx2B.le hu₂
      have hAu : u₁ * A + u₂ * A = A := by linear_combination A * hu
      have hBu : u₁ * B + u₂ * B = B := by linear_combination B * hu
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  have hDa_convex : Convex ℝ D_a := by
    intro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂ u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu
    have hre : (u₁ • a₁ + u₂ • a₂).re - x_edge =
        u₁ * (a₁.re - x_edge) + u₂ * (a₂.re - x_edge) := by
      have hu₂_eq : u₂ = 1 - u₁ := by linarith
      simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, hu₂_eq]
      ring
    have him : (u₁ • a₁ + u₂ • a₂).im = u₁ * a₁.im + u₂ * a₂.im := by
      simp [Complex.real_smul]
    rcases abs_lt.mp ha₁.1 with ⟨ha₁_re1, ha₁_re2⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp ha₂.1 with ⟨ha₂_re1, ha₂_re2⟩
    have hre_bounds := h_conv_lt hu₁ hu₂ hu ha₁_re1 ha₁_re2 ha₂_re1 ha₂_re2
    have him_bounds := h_conv_lt hu₁ hu₂ hu ha₁.2.1 ha₁.2.2 ha₂.2.1 ha₂.2.2
    exact ⟨by rw [hre, abs_lt]; exact hre_bounds, by rw [him]; exact him_bounds.1,
      by rw [him]; exact him_bounds.2⟩

  have hAζ_cover : ∀ ζ ∈ A_ζ, ζ ∈ A_shal ∨ ζ ∈ A_steep := by
    intro ζ hζ
    by_cases hlt : |ζ.im| < (5 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hζ, hlt⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hζ, by linarith [hζ.1]⟩

  have h_sphere_in_Aζ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, z ∈ A_ζ := by
    intro z hz
    have hzn : ‖z‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hz
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

  let Ψ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun p => (p.1 - (η : ℂ) * Complex.I * p.2 ^ 2, (t₀ : ℂ) + (r : ℂ) * p.2)
  have hΨ_diff : Differentiable ℂ Ψ := by
    refine Differentiable.prodMk ?_ ?_
    · exact differentiable_fst.sub ((differentiable_const _).mul (differentiable_snd.pow 2))
    · exact (differentiable_const _).add ((differentiable_const _).mul differentiable_snd)

  have h_sq_re : ∀ ζ : ℂ, (ζ ^ 2).re = ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ζ.im ^ 2 := by
    intro ζ
    have hns : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = ζ.re * ζ.re + ζ.im * ζ.im := by
      rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply]
    rw [sq, Complex.mul_re, hns]
    ring
  have hΨ_fst_re : ∀ a ζ : ℂ, (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.re = a.re + η * (ζ ^ 2).im := by
    intro a ζ
    dsimp [Ψ]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hΨ_fst_im : ∀ a ζ : ℂ, (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im = a.im - η * (ζ ^ 2).re := by
    intro a ζ
    dsimp [Ψ]
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  have hΨ_snd_sub : ∀ a ζ : ℂ, (Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ) = (r : ℂ) * ζ := by
    intro a ζ
    dsimp [Ψ]
    ring

  have hΨ_base : ∀ a ∈ D_a, ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ < 11 / 10 →
      |(Ψ (a, ζ)).1.re - x_edge| < δ_cor ∧
      0 < (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im ∧
      h - 2 * δ_cor < (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im ∧
      (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im < h + δ_cor / 2 ∧
      ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_tube ∧
      ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_μ₀ ∧
      h - η / 8 < S.h_X (Ψ (a, ζ)).2 := by
    intro a ha ζ hζ
    have hζ_sq : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 < 121 / 100 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg ζ]
    have h_re_abs : |(ζ ^ 2).re| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 :=
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (ζ ^ 2)).trans_eq (norm_pow ζ 2)
    have h_im_abs : |(ζ ^ 2).im| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 :=
      (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (ζ ^ 2)).trans_eq (norm_pow ζ 2)
    rcases abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h_re_abs hζ_sq) with ⟨hre_lo, hre_hi⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h_im_abs hζ_sq) with ⟨him_lo, him_hi⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp ha.1 with ⟨ha_re1, ha_re2⟩
    have ht_norm_eq : ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ = r * ‖ζ‖ := by
      rw [hΨ_snd_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    have ht_lt_tube : ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_tube := by
      rw [ht_norm_eq]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg ζ]
    have ht_lt_μ₀ : ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_μ₀ := by
      rw [ht_norm_eq]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg ζ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ht_lt_tube, ht_lt_μ₀, hr_tube_hX _ ht_lt_tube⟩
    · rw [hΨ_fst_re, hδ_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [hΨ_fst_im]
      nlinarith [ha.2.1]
    · rw [hΨ_fst_im, hδ_eq]
      nlinarith [ha.2.1]
    · rw [hΨ_fst_im, hδ_eq]
      nlinarith [ha.2.2]

  have hΨ_shal : ∀ a ∈ D_a, ∀ ζ ∈ A_shal,
      (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im < h - μ₀ ∧ Ψ (a, ζ) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro a ha ζ hζ
    have hb := hΨ_base a ha ζ hζ.1.2
    have him_sq : ζ.im ^ 2 < (25 / 144 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ |ζ.im| := abs_nonneg ζ.im
      have h2 : |ζ.im| < (5 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ := hζ.2
      have h3 : |ζ.im| ^ 2 = ζ.im ^ 2 := sq_abs ζ.im
      nlinarith
    have hnorm_sq : (81 / 100 : ℝ) < ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hζ.1.1]
    have hre_gt : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (ζ ^ 2).re := by
      rw [h_sq_re]; nlinarith
    have him_lt_μ₀ : (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im < h - μ₀ := by
      rw [hΨ_fst_im]
      dsimp [μ₀]
      nlinarith [ha.2.2]
    refine ⟨him_lt_μ₀, h_mem_tube _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2.2.2.2.1 hr_tube_le) hb.2.1 ?_⟩
    have hμ₀_eq : μ₀ = η / 4 := rfl
    linarith [hb.2.2.2.2.2.2, hη_pos, him_lt_μ₀, hμ₀_eq]

  have hΨ_low : ∀ a ∈ I_low, ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ < 11 / 10 →
      (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im < h - μ₀ ∧ Ψ (a, ζ) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro a ha ζ hζ
    have hb := hΨ_base a (hIlow_sub ha) ζ hζ
    have hζ_sq : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 < 121 / 100 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg ζ]
    have h_re_abs : |(ζ ^ 2).re| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 :=
      (Complex.abs_re_le_norm (ζ ^ 2)).trans_eq (norm_pow ζ 2)
    have hre_lo : -(121 / 100 : ℝ) < (ζ ^ 2).re := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h_re_abs hζ_sq)).1
    have him_lt_μ₀ : (Ψ (a, ζ)).1.im < h - μ₀ := by
      rw [hΨ_fst_im]
      dsimp [μ₀]
      nlinarith [ha.2.2]
    refine ⟨him_lt_μ₀, h_mem_tube _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2.2.2.2.1 hr_tube_le) hb.2.1 ?_⟩
    have hμ₀_eq : μ₀ = η / 4 := rfl
    linarith [hb.2.2.2.2.2.2, hη_pos, him_lt_μ₀, hμ₀_eq]

  have hΨ_steep : ∀ a ∈ D_a, ∀ ζ ∈ A_steep,
      Ψ (a, ζ) ∈ steepCorridorSet S x_edge δ_cor K.r_steep := by
    intro a ha ζ hζ
    have hb := hΨ_base a ha ζ hζ.1.2
    have ht_norm_eq : ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ = r * ‖ζ‖ := by
      rw [hΨ_snd_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    have ht_im_eq : |((Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)).im| = r * |ζ.im| := by
      rw [hΨ_snd_sub, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero,
        abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    refine ⟨hb.1, hb.2.2.1, hb.2.2.2.1, ?_, lt_of_lt_of_le hb.2.2.2.2.2.1 hr_μ₀_le, ?_⟩
    · rw [ht_norm_eq]; nlinarith [hζ.1.1, hr_pos]
    · change ‖(Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ / 3 < |((Ψ (a, ζ)).2 - (t₀ : ℂ)).im|
      rw [ht_norm_eq, ht_im_eq]
      nlinarith [hζ.2, hr_pos]

  let F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
    fun p => if |p.2.im| < (5 / 12 : ℝ) * ‖p.2‖ then S.𝔰 (Ψ p) else K.S_steep (Ψ p)

  have hF_eq_shal : ∀ p ∈ D_a ×ˢ A_shal, F p = S.𝔰 (Ψ p) := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [F, hp.2.2, ↓reduceIte]
  have hF_eq_steep : ∀ p ∈ D_a ×ˢ A_steep, F p = K.S_steep (Ψ p) := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp [F]
    split_ifs with hlt
    · have hshal : p.2 ∈ A_shal := ⟨hp.2.1, hlt⟩
      have hb := hΨ_base p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2.1.2
      exact (h_agrees_μ₀ (Ψ p) (hΨ_steep p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2)
        (hΨ_shal p.1 hp.1 p.2 hshal).1 hb.2.2.2.2.2.1).symm
    · rfl

  have hF_U1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (D_a ×ˢ A_shal) :=
    (S.𝔰_holo.comp hΨ_diff.differentiableOn
      (fun p hp => (hΨ_shal p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2).2)).congr hF_eq_shal
  have hF_U2 : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (D_a ×ˢ A_steep) :=
    (K.S_steep_holo.comp hΨ_diff.differentiableOn
      (fun p hp => hΨ_steep p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2)).congr hF_eq_steep
  have hF_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F (D_a ×ˢ A_ζ) := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hAζ_cover p.2 hp.2 with h1 | h2
    · exact (hF_U1.differentiableAt
        ((hDa_open.prod hAshal_open).mem_nhds ⟨hp.1, h1⟩)).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact (hF_U2.differentiableAt
        ((hDa_open.prod hAsteep_open).mem_nhds ⟨hp.1, h2⟩)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hF_strip : ∀ p ∈ D_a ×ˢ A_ζ, F p ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro p hp
    rcases hAζ_cover p.2 hp.2 with h1 | h2
    · rw [hF_eq_shal p ⟨hp.1, h1⟩]
      exact S.𝔰_maps_to _ (hΨ_shal p.1 hp.1 p.2 h1).2
    · rw [hF_eq_steep p ⟨hp.1, h2⟩]
      exact K.S_steep_in_strip _ (hΨ_steep p.1 hp.1 p.2 h2)
  have hF_low : ∀ a ∈ I_low, ∀ ζ ∈ A_ζ, F (a, ζ) = S.𝔰 (Ψ (a, ζ)) := by
    intro a ha ζ hζ
    rcases hAζ_cover ζ hζ with h1 | h2
    · exact hF_eq_shal (a, ζ) ⟨hIlow_sub ha, h1⟩
    · rw [hF_eq_steep (a, ζ) ⟨hIlow_sub ha, h2⟩]
      have hb := hΨ_base a (hIlow_sub ha) ζ hζ.2
      exact h_agrees_μ₀ (Ψ (a, ζ)) (hΨ_steep a (hIlow_sub ha) ζ h2)
        (hΨ_low a ha ζ hζ.2).1 hb.2.2.2.2.2.1

  
  have h_circle_param_holo :
      ∀ (W_G : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) (G : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) → ℂ) (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)),
        IsOpen W_G →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ G W_G →
        IsOpen U →
        (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1, (p, z) ∈ W_G) →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun p => (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (p, circleMap 0 1 θ))
          U := by
    intro W_G G U hWG_open hG_diff hU_open h_maps p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨r_b, hr_b_pos, hr_b_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p₀ hp₀
    let η_b : ℝ := r_b / 3
    have hη_b_pos : 0 < η_b := by dsimp [η_b]; linarith
    have hcb_sub_U : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) ⊆ U := by
      intro q hq
      apply hr_b_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hq) (by dsimp [η_b]; linarith)
    let K_prod : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K_prod :=
      (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b)).prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) 1)
    have hK_sub_WG : K_prod ⊆ W_G := by
      intro x hx
      exact h_maps x.1 (hcb_sub_U hx.1) x.2 hx.2
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
      hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hG_diff.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_WG)
    let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hG_le_M : ∀ x ∈ K_prod, ‖G x‖ ≤ M :=
      fun x hx => le_trans (hM₀ x hx) (le_max_left M₀ 0)
    let L_inl : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ℂ × ℂ)).prod (0 : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    let ℱ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => G (p, circleMap 0 1 θ)
    let ℱ' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
      fun p θ => (fderiv ℂ G (p, circleMap 0 1 θ)).comp L_inl
    have h_fderiv_q : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b), ∀ θ : ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun p' => ℱ p' θ) (ℱ' q θ) q := by
      intro q hq θ
      have hmem : (q, circleMap 0 1 θ) ∈ W_G :=
        hK_sub_WG ⟨hq, circleMap_mem_sphere 0 zero_le_one θ⟩
      have hG_at : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℂ G (q, circleMap 0 1 θ)) (q, circleMap 0 1 θ) :=
        (hG_diff.differentiableAt (hWG_open.mem_nhds hmem)).hasFDerivAt
      exact hG_at.comp q ((hasFDerivAt_id q).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const (circleMap 0 1 θ) q))
    have hℱ_cont : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b), Continuous (ℱ q) := by
      intro q hq
