      have hz := DiffContOnCl.circleIntegral_eq_zero zero_le_one hkw_dc
      unfold circleIntegral at hz
      simp only [deriv_circleMap, smul_eq_mul] at hz
      have h_congr : ∀ θ : ℝ,
          circleMap 0 1 θ * Complex.I * (w / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)) =
            Complex.I * (w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)) := by
        intro θ; ring
      simp_rw [h_congr, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hz
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left Complex.I_ne_zero

    have h_cont_k1 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ)) :=
      (continuous_circleMap 0 1).div ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).sub continuous_const) h_sub_ne
    have h_cont_k2 : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)) :=
      (continuous_const.mul (continuous_circleMap 0 1)).div
        (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_circleMap 0 1))) h_one_sub_ne
    have h_P_mass : (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), P_ζ θ) = 2 * Real.pi := by
      have hsum :
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        have hadd := (intervalIntegral.integral_add
          (h_cont_k1.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          (h_cont_k2.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi))).symm
        simp_rw [h_kernel_eq] at hadd
        rw [← hadd, h_int_1, h_int_2, add_zero]
        push_cast; rfl
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal] at hsum
      exact Complex.ofReal_injective hsum

    have hFa_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)) :=
      hF_holo.continuousOn.comp_continuous
        (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap 0 1))
        (fun θ => ⟨ha, h_sphere_in_Aζ _ (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 zero_le_one θ)⟩)

    have hFtilde_poisson :
        F_tilde (a, ζ) =
          (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have hJ0 : J_hat (a, w) = 0 := hJhat_zero a ha w hw_ball
      calc
        F_tilde (a, ζ) = F_tilde (a, ζ) + J_hat (a, w) := by rw [hJ0, add_zero]
        _ = (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ((∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ)) +
                (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) *
                    (w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)))) := by
            dsimp [F_tilde, J_hat]; ring
        _ = (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ) +
                  F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) *
                    (w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ))) := by
            congr 1
            have hi1 : Continuous
                (fun θ : ℝ => F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ)) :=
              (hFa_cont.mul (continuous_circleMap 0 1)).div
                ((continuous_circleMap 0 1).sub continuous_const) h_sub_ne
            exact (intervalIntegral.integral_add
              (hi1.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
              ((hFa_cont.mul h_cont_k2).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))).symm
        _ = (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
              ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
            congr 1
            refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
            calc
              F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ) +
                  F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * (w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)) =
                F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) *
                  (circleMap 0 1 θ / (circleMap 0 1 θ - ζ) +
                    w * circleMap 0 1 θ / (1 - w * circleMap 0 1 θ)) := by ring
              _ = F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [h_kernel_eq θ]

    have hFP_int : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun θ : ℝ => F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hFa_cont.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hP_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hFtilde_im :
        (F_tilde (a, ζ)).im =
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ := by
      rw [hFtilde_poisson, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero]
      congr 1
      have hcomm := (ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_comp_comm Complex.imCLM hFP_int).symm
      change Complex.imCLM (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ)) = _
      rw [hcomm]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun θ _ => ?_
      change (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ) * ((P_ζ θ : ℝ) : ℂ)).im = _
      simp [Complex.mul_im]

    have h_nonempty_Icc : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr Real.two_pi_pos.le⟩
    have h_abs_im_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => |(F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im|) :=
      continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp hFa_cont)
    obtain ⟨θ_star, _, hθ_max⟩ :=
      isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn h_nonempty_Icc h_abs_im_cont.continuousOn
    let M_a : ℝ := |(F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ_star)).im|
    have hMa_lt : M_a < S.H :=
      hF_strip (a, circleMap 0 1 θ_star)
        ⟨ha, h_sphere_in_Aζ _ (circleMap_mem_sphere 0 zero_le_one θ_star)⟩
    have h_prod_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => |(F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ|) :=
      continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_im.comp hFa_cont).mul hP_cont)
    have h_mono :
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |(F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ|) ≤
          ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), M_a * P_ζ θ := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on Real.two_pi_pos.le
        (h_prod_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
        ((continuous_const.mul hP_cont).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)) ?_
      intro θ hθ
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hP_nonneg θ)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hθ_max hθ) (hP_nonneg θ)
    have h_inv_pos : 0 < (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos
    change |(F_tilde (a, ζ)).im| < S.H
    rw [hFtilde_im, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h_inv_pos]
    have h_abs_int :
        |∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ| ≤
          M_a * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      calc
        |∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ|
          ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), |(F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ| :=
            intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs Real.two_pi_pos.le
        _ ≤ ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), M_a * P_ζ θ := h_mono
        _ = M_a * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), P_ζ θ := intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = M_a * (2 * Real.pi) := by rw [h_P_mass]
    have h_scaled :
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            |∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ| ≤ M_a := by
      calc
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
            |∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F (a, circleMap 0 1 θ)).im * P_ζ θ|
          ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (M_a * (2 * Real.pi)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_abs_int h_inv_pos.le
        _ = M_a := by field_simp [Real.two_pi_pos.ne']
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_scaled hMa_lt

  
  let ε : ℝ := (1 / 8 : ℝ) * min S.s_star (min r η)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (lt_min S.s_star_pos (lt_min hr_pos hη_pos))
  have hε_lt_s_star : ε < S.s_star := by
    have hle : min S.s_star (min r η) ≤ S.s_star := min_le_left _ _
    dsimp [ε]; linarith [S.s_star_pos]
  have hε_le_r : 8 * ε ≤ r := by
    have hle : min S.s_star (min r η) ≤ r := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    dsimp [ε]; linarith
  have hε_le_η : 8 * ε ≤ η := by
    have hle : min S.s_star (min r η) ≤ η := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    dsimp [ε]; linarith

  let ζ_map : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) / (r : ℂ)
  let Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun p => (p.1 + (η : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ζ_map p.2) ^ 2, ζ_map p.2)
  let g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => F_tilde (Φ_inv p)

  have hζ_map_diff : Differentiable ℂ ζ_map :=
    (differentiable_id.sub (differentiable_const _)).div_const (r : ℂ)
  have hΦ_inv_diff : Differentiable ℂ Φ_inv :=
    (differentiable_fst.add
      ((differentiable_const _).mul ((hζ_map_diff.comp differentiable_snd).pow 2))).prodMk
      (hζ_map_diff.comp differentiable_snd)

  have hΨ_Φ_inv : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, Ψ (Φ_inv p) = p := by
    intro p
    have hr_ne : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr_pos.ne'
    ext1
    · dsimp [Ψ, Φ_inv]; ring
    · dsimp [Ψ, Φ_inv, ζ_map]
      rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hr_ne, add_sub_cancel]

  have h_Φ_shift_norm : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε →
      ‖ζ_map p.2‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - p.1‖ < η / 64 := by
    intro p hp2
    have hζ_norm_eq : ‖ζ_map p.2‖ = ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ / r := by
      dsimp [ζ_map]
      rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
    have hζ_lt : ‖ζ_map p.2‖ < 1 / 8 := by
      rw [hζ_norm_eq, div_lt_iff₀ hr_pos]
      linarith
    refine ⟨hζ_lt, ?_⟩
    have hsub_eq : (Φ_inv p).1 - p.1 = (η : ℂ) * Complex.I * (ζ_map p.2) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [Φ_inv]; ring
    rw [hsub_eq, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hη_pos,
      Complex.norm_I, mul_one, norm_pow]
    have hsq : ‖ζ_map p.2‖ ^ 2 < 1 / 64 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ζ_map p.2)]
    nlinarith

  let y_edge : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have h_Wε_maps : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      ‖p.1 - y_edge‖ < ε → ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε →
      Φ_inv p ∈ D_a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    intro p hp1 hp2
    obtain ⟨hζ_lt, hshift_lt⟩ := h_Φ_shift_norm p hp2
    have hdist_y : ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge‖ < η / 4 := by
      have htri : ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge‖ ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - p.1‖ + ‖p.1 - y_edge‖ := by
        simpa [sub_add_sub_cancel] using norm_add_le ((Φ_inv p).1 - p.1) (p.1 - y_edge)
      linarith
    have hre_diff : |(Φ_inv p).1.re - x_edge| ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge‖ := by
      have hre_eq : ((Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge).re = (Φ_inv p).1.re - x_edge := by
        simp [y_edge]
      rw [← hre_eq]
      exact Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    have him_diff : |(Φ_inv p).1.im - h| ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge‖ := by
      have him_eq : ((Φ_inv p).1 - y_edge).im = (Φ_inv p).1.im - h := by
        simp [y_edge]
      rw [← him_eq]
      exact Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    rcases abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt him_diff hdist_y) with ⟨him_lo, him_hi⟩
    refine ⟨⟨lt_of_le_of_lt hre_diff (by linarith), by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact lt_trans hζ_lt (by norm_num)

  have hg_Wε : DifferentiableOn ℂ g
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1 - y_edge‖ < ε ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } :=
    hFtilde_holo.comp hΦ_inv_diff.differentiableOn (fun p hp => h_Wε_maps p hp.1 hp.2)

  have hg_strip_Wε : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      ‖p.1 - y_edge‖ < ε → ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
    fun p hp1 hp2 => hFtilde_strip (Φ_inv p) (h_Wε_maps p hp1 hp2)

  obtain ⟨r_patch, hr_patch_pos, hr_patch_le, hr_patch_hX⟩ :=
    h_lsc_radius (h - ε / 16) (by linarith)
  let δ : ℝ := min ε (r_patch / 2)
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min hε_pos (half_pos hr_patch_pos)
  have hδ_le_ε : δ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_lt_rpatch : δ < r_patch :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)

  let V_bridge : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      |p.1.re - x_edge| < η / 2 ∧
      h - (5 / 2 : ℝ) * η < p.1.im ∧
      p.1.im < h - ε / 8 ∧
      ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }
  let V_seed : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ |
      |p.1.re - x_edge| < η / 2 ∧
      h - (5 / 2 : ℝ) * η < p.1.im ∧
      p.1.im < h - 2 * η ∧
      ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }

  have hVbridge_open : IsOpen V_bridge :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
      continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)).inter
        ((isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst) continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)))
  have hVseed_open : IsOpen V_seed :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const))
      continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst)).inter
        ((isOpen_lt (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst) continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)))

  let p₀ : ℂ × ℂ :=
    ((x_edge : ℂ) + ((h - (9 / 4 : ℝ) * η : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ))
  have hp₀_seed : p₀ ∈ V_seed := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [p₀, hη_pos]
    · simp [p₀]; linarith
    · simp [p₀]; linarith
    · simp [p₀, hδ_pos]
  have hp₀_bridge : p₀ ∈ V_bridge :=
    ⟨hp₀_seed.1, hp₀_seed.2.1, by linarith [hp₀_seed.2.2.1], hp₀_seed.2.2.2⟩

  have hVbridge_convex : Convex ℝ V_bridge := by
    intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu
    have hre : (u₁ • p₁ + u₂ • p₂).1.re - x_edge =
        u₁ * (p₁.1.re - x_edge) + u₂ * (p₂.1.re - x_edge) := by
      have hu₂_eq : u₂ = 1 - u₁ := by linarith
      simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, Complex.add_re, Complex.real_smul, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, hu₂_eq]
      ring
    have him : (u₁ • p₁ + u₂ • p₂).1.im = u₁ * p₁.1.im + u₂ * p₂.1.im := by
      simp [Complex.real_smul]
    rcases abs_lt.mp hp₁.1 with ⟨hp₁_re1, hp₁_re2⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp hp₂.1 with ⟨hp₂_re1, hp₂_re2⟩
    have hre_bounds := h_conv_lt hu₁ hu₂ hu hp₁_re1 hp₁_re2 hp₂_re1 hp₂_re2
    have him_bounds := h_conv_lt hu₁ hu₂ hu hp₁.2.1 hp₁.2.2.1 hp₂.2.1 hp₂.2.2.1
    refine ⟨by rw [hre, abs_lt]; exact hre_bounds, by rw [him]; exact him_bounds.1,
      by rw [him]; exact him_bounds.2, ?_⟩
    have hu₂_eq : u₂ = 1 - u₁ := by linarith
    have hsub2 : (u₁ • p₁ + u₂ • p₂).2 - (t₀ : ℂ) =
        u₁ • (p₁.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) + u₂ • (p₂.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
      simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd, Complex.real_smul, hu₂_eq]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hsub2]
    have htri : ‖u₁ • (p₁.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)) + u₂ • (p₂.2 - (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤
        u₁ * ‖p₁.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ + u₂ * ‖p₂.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ := by
      refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) ?_
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hu₁, Real.norm_of_nonneg hu₂]
    have hnorm_lt := (h_conv_lt hu₁ hu₂ hu (by linarith [norm_nonneg (p₁.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)), hδ_pos] : -δ < ‖p₁.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖)
      hp₁.2.2.2 (by linarith [norm_nonneg (p₂.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)), hδ_pos] : -δ < ‖p₂.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖) hp₂.2.2.2).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt htri hnorm_lt

  have hVbridge_maps_Φ : ∀ p ∈ V_bridge, Φ_inv p ∈ D_a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hζ_lt, hshift_lt⟩ := h_Φ_shift_norm p (lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2.2.2 hδ_le_ε)
    have hre_le : |(Φ_inv p).1.re - p.1.re| ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - p.1‖ := by
      simpa using Complex.abs_re_le_norm ((Φ_inv p).1 - p.1)
    have him_le : |(Φ_inv p).1.im - p.1.im| ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - p.1‖ := by
      simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm ((Φ_inv p).1 - p.1)
    rcases abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hre_le hshift_lt) with ⟨hre1, hre2⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt him_le hshift_lt) with ⟨him1, him2⟩
    rcases abs_lt.mp hp.1 with ⟨hp_re1, hp_re2⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, by linarith [hp.2.1], by linarith [hp.2.2.1, hε_pos]⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_trans hζ_lt (by norm_num)

  have hg_Vbridge : DifferentiableOn ℂ g V_bridge :=
    hFtilde_holo.comp hΦ_inv_diff.differentiableOn hVbridge_maps_Φ

  have hVbridge_tube : V_bridge ⊆ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro p hp
    have ht_lt_rp : ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < r_patch := lt_trans hp.2.2.2 hδ_lt_rpatch
    exact h_mem_tube p (lt_of_lt_of_le ht_lt_rp hr_patch_le)
      (by linarith [hp.2.1, hη_lt_h])
      (by linarith [hp.2.2.1, hr_patch_hX p.2 ht_lt_rp, hε_pos])

  have h𝔰_Vbridge : DifferentiableOn ℂ S.𝔰 V_bridge :=
    S.𝔰_holo.mono hVbridge_tube

  have hg_eq_seed : ∀ p ∈ V_seed, g p = S.𝔰 p := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hζ_lt, hshift_lt⟩ := h_Φ_shift_norm p (lt_of_lt_of_le hp.2.2.2 hδ_le_ε)
    have hp_bridge : p ∈ V_bridge :=
      ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, by linarith [hp.2.2.1, hε_le_η, hε_pos], hp.2.2.2⟩
    have hDa_mem : (Φ_inv p).1 ∈ D_a := (hVbridge_maps_Φ p hp_bridge).1
    have him_le : |(Φ_inv p).1.im - p.1.im| ≤ ‖(Φ_inv p).1 - p.1‖ := by
      simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm ((Φ_inv p).1 - p.1)
    have him_hi : (Φ_inv p).1.im - p.1.im < η / 64 :=
      (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt him_le hshift_lt)).2
    have h_in_low : (Φ_inv p).1 ∈ I_low :=
      ⟨hDa_mem.1, hDa_mem.2.1, by linarith [hp.2.2.1]⟩
    have h_in_ball : (Φ_inv p).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 :=
      (hVbridge_maps_Φ p hp_bridge).2
    change F_tilde (Φ_inv p) = S.𝔰 p
    rw [hFtilde_low (Φ_inv p).1 h_in_low (Φ_inv p).2 h_in_ball, hΨ_Φ_inv p]

  have hg_eq_bridge : ∀ p ∈ V_bridge, g p = S.𝔰 p := by
    intro p hp
    let γ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => p₀ + z • (p - p₀)
    have hγ_diff : Differentiable ℂ γ :=
      (differentiable_const p₀).add (differentiable_id.smul_const (p - p₀))
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = p₀ := by simp [γ]
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = p := by simp [γ]
    let U_z : Set ℂ := γ ⁻¹' V_bridge
    have hUz_open : IsOpen U_z := hVbridge_open.preimage hγ_diff.continuous
    have h0_Uz : (0 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := by show γ 0 ∈ V_bridge; rw [hγ0]; exact hp₀_bridge
    have h1_Uz : (1 : ℂ) ∈ U_z := by show γ 1 ∈ V_bridge; rw [hγ1]; exact hp
    have hUz_convex : Convex ℝ U_z := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ u₁ u₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu
      show γ (u₁ • z₁ + u₂ • z₂) ∈ V_bridge
      have hu₂_eq : u₂ = 1 - u₁ := by linarith
      have hγ_aff : γ (u₁ • z₁ + u₂ • z₂) = u₁ • γ z₁ + u₂ • γ z₂ := by
        ext1 <;>
        · simp only [γ, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd,
            Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Complex.real_smul, smul_eq_mul, hu₂_eq]
          push_cast
          ring
      rw [hγ_aff]
      exact hVbridge_convex hz₁ hz₂ hu₁ hu₂ hu
    let h_line : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => g (γ z) - S.𝔰 (γ z)
    have hline_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_line U_z :=
      (hg_Vbridge.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz)).sub
        (h𝔰_Vbridge.comp hγ_diff.differentiableOn (fun _ hz => hz))
    have hline_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h_line U_z := hline_diff.analyticOnNhd hUz_open
    have hline_ev : h_line =ᶠ[nhds (0 : ℂ)] 0 := by
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr
        ⟨γ ⁻¹' V_seed, (hVseed_open.preimage hγ_diff.continuous).mem_nhds ?_, ?_⟩
      · show γ 0 ∈ V_seed; rw [hγ0]; exact hp₀_seed
      · intro z hz
        show g (γ z) - S.𝔰 (γ z) = 0
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hg_eq_seed (γ z) hz)
    have h1_zero : h_line 1 = 0 :=
      hline_ana.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
        hUz_convex.isPreconnected h0_Uz hline_ev h1_Uz
    dsimp [h_line] at h1_zero
    rw [hγ1] at h1_zero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h1_zero

  have hg_overlap : ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
      |p.1.re - x_edge| < ε / 4 →
      |p.1.im - (S.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
      ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ →
      g p = S.𝔰 p := by
    intro p hre him ht
    apply hg_eq_bridge p
    have hh_eq : S.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = h := rfl
    rw [hh_eq] at him
    rcases abs_lt.mp him with ⟨him1, him2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ht⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · linarith

  exact S.no_patch_at_real_wall t₀ x_edge ε ht₀_abs hε_pos hε_lt_s_star
    ⟨g, hg_Wε, hg_strip_Wε, δ, hδ_pos, hδ_le_ε, hg_overlap⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N] (hN_odd : Odd N)
    (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (ℓ_r w_r : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hℓ : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ℓ_r i) (hw : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < w_r i)
    (h_null : (@jacobiH N inst c f_vec d0_vec (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ))).mulVec
      (fun i => (w_r i : ℂ)) = 0)
    (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (hI : I ⊂ Finset.univ) (hIF : Disjoint I F) :
    (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ)) I F).det ≠ 0

signature.name: odd_cycle_modified_jacobi_det_ne_zero
signature.statement:
(N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N] (hN_odd : Odd N)
    (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (ℓ_r w_r : Fin N → ℝ)
    (hℓ : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < ℓ_r i) (hw : ∀ i : Fin N, 0 < w_r i)
    (h_null : (@jacobiH N inst c f_vec d0_vec (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ))).mulVec
      (fun i => (w_r i : ℂ)) = 0)
    (I F : Finset (Fin N)) (hI : I ⊂ Finset.univ) (hIF : Disjoint I F) :
    (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ)) I F).det ≠ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hN_pos : 0 < N := NeZero.pos N
  let cycNextEquiv : Equiv.Perm (Fin N) :=
    { toFun := @cycNext N inst
      invFun := @cycPrev N inst
      left_inv := fun j => by
        ext
        dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
        by_cases hj : j.val + 1 < N
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj]
          have h1 : j.val + 1 + N - 1 = j.val + N := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
        · have hj_eq : j.val + 1 = N := by omega
          rw [hj_eq, Nat.mod_self]
          have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = j.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
      right_inv := fun j => by
        ext
        dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
        by_cases hj : j.val = 0
        · rw [hj]
          have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = N - 1 := by omega
          have hlt : N - 1 < N := by omega
          have h2 : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_self]
        · have h1 : j.val + N - 1 = (j.val - 1) + N := by omega
          have hlt : j.val - 1 < N := by omega
          have h2 : j.val - 1 + 1 = j.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt] }
  let finMod : ℕ → Fin N := fun m => ⟨m % N, Nat.mod_lt m hN_pos⟩
  have h_finMod_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, @cycNext N inst (finMod m) = finMod (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    ext
    dsimp [cycNext, finMod]
    exact Nat.mod_add_mod m N 1
  have h_finMod_N : finMod N = finMod 0 := by
    ext
    simp [finMod]
  have h_finMod_val : ∀ j : Fin N, finMod j.val = j := by
    intro j
    ext
    dsimp [finMod]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt
  let ℓ_c : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ)
  let w_c : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => (w_r i : ℂ)
  let M0_r : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun i k =>
      (if i = k then (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ else 0) +
      (if k = @cycNext N inst i then (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ else 0) +
      (if i = @cycNext N inst k then (ℓ_r k)⁻¹ else 0)
  let V_r : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => (M0_r.mulVec w_r i) / w_r i
  let H_r : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ := M0_r - Matrix.diagonal V_r
  let B_r : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun i k =>
      if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
        M0_r i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then V_r i else 0)
      else if i = k then 1 else 0
  have hM0_cast : ∀ i k : Fin N, ((M0_r i k : ℝ) : ℂ) = @jacobiM0 N inst ℓ_c i k := by
    intro i k
    simp only [M0_r, jacobiM0, ℓ_c, Matrix.of_apply]
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> rfl
  have hM0_mulVec_cast : ∀ i : Fin N,
      ((M0_r.mulVec w_r i : ℝ) : ℂ) = (@jacobiM0 N inst ℓ_c).mulVec w_c i := by
    intro i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul, hM0_cast, w_c]
  have hV_mul : ∀ i : Fin N, V_r i * w_r i = M0_r.mulVec w_r i := by
    intro i
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ (M0_r.mulVec w_r i) (hw i).ne'
  have hV_cast : ∀ i : Fin N, jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec i = (V_r i : ℂ) := by
    intro i
    have h0 : ((@jacobiH N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_c).mulVec w_c) i = 0 := by
      simpa [ℓ_c, w_c] using congr_fun h_null i
    rw [jacobiH, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    have hw_ne : (w_r i : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (hw i).ne'
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hw_ne
    calc
      jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec i * (w_r i : ℂ)
          = (@jacobiM0 N inst ℓ_c).mulVec w_c i := h0.symm
      _ = ((M0_r.mulVec w_r i : ℝ) : ℂ) := (hM0_mulVec_cast i).symm
      _ = ((V_r i * w_r i : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hV_mul i]
      _ = (V_r i : ℂ) * (w_r i : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
  have hB_map :
      Complex.ofRealHom.mapMatrix B_r = @modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_c I F := by
    ext i k
    change ((B_r i k : ℝ) : ℂ) = (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_c I F) i k
    simp only [B_r, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_zero,
      hM0_cast, hV_cast]
  have hM0_bilin : ∀ x y : Fin N → ℝ,
      dotProduct x (M0_r.mulVec y) =
        ∑ j : Fin N,
          (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * (x j + x (@cycNext N inst j)) * (y j + y (@cycNext N inst j)) := by
    intro x y
    have h_entry : ∀ i k : Fin N,
        x i * (M0_r i k * y k) =
          (if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (if k = @cycNext N inst i then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (if i = @cycNext N inst k then x i * (ℓ_r k)⁻¹ * y k else 0) := by
      intro i k
      simp only [M0_r, Matrix.of_apply]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    have h_expand :
        dotProduct x (M0_r.mulVec y) =
          (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
            if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
            if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
            if k = @cycNext N inst i then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) +
          (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
            if i = @cycNext N inst k then x i * (ℓ_r k)⁻¹ * y k else 0) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum, h_entry, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hS1 :
        (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
          if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * y k else 0) =
        ∑ j : Fin N, x (@cycNext N inst j) * (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * y (@cycNext N inst j) := by
      have h1 :
          (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
            if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * y k else 0) =
          ∑ i : Fin N, x i * (ℓ_r (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * y i := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        simp
      rw [h1, ← Equiv.sum_comp cycNextEquiv]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      have hprev : @cycPrev N inst (@cycNext N inst j) = j := cycNextEquiv.left_inv j
      dsimp [cycNextEquiv]
      rw [hprev]
    have hS2 :
        (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
          if i = k then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) =
        ∑ j : Fin N, x j * (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * y j := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      simp
    have hS3 :
        (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
          if k = @cycNext N inst i then x i * (ℓ_r i)⁻¹ * y k else 0) =
        ∑ j : Fin N, x j * (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * y (@cycNext N inst j) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      simp
    have hS4 :
        (∑ i : Fin N, ∑ k : Fin N,
          if i = @cycNext N inst k then x i * (ℓ_r k)⁻¹ * y k else 0) =
        ∑ j : Fin N, x (@cycNext N inst j) * (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * y j := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      simp
    rw [h_expand, hS1, hS2, hS3, hS4]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hM0_symm : ∀ x y : Fin N → ℝ,
      dotProduct x (M0_r.mulVec y) = dotProduct y (M0_r.mulVec x) := by
    intro x y
    rw [hM0_bilin x y, hM0_bilin y x]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hM0_nonneg : ∀ u : Fin N → ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct u (M0_r.mulVec u) := by
    intro u
    rw [hM0_bilin u u]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_
    have hℓ_inv : 0 < (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (hℓ j)
    have hsq : 0 ≤ (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) * (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) :=
      mul_self_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have hM0_eq_zero : ∀ u : Fin N → ℝ, dotProduct u (M0_r.mulVec u) = 0 → u = 0 := by
    intro u hu0
    rw [hM0_bilin u u] at hu0
    have hterm_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
        0 ≤ (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) * (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) := by
      intro j _
      have hℓ_inv : 0 < (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (hℓ j)
      have hsq : 0 ≤ (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) * (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) :=
        mul_self_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have hterm_zero := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg).mp hu0
    have hstep : ∀ j : Fin N, u (@cycNext N inst j) = -u j := by
      intro j
      have hj := hterm_zero j (Finset.mem_univ j)
      have hℓ_ne : (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (hℓ j).ne'
      have hmul : (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) * (u j + u (@cycNext N inst j)) = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hj with h1 | h2
        · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h1a | h1b
          · exact absurd h1a hℓ_ne
          · rw [h1b, zero_mul]
        · rw [h2, mul_zero]
      have hsum : u j + u (@cycNext N inst j) = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp hmul
      linarith
    let U : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => u (finMod m)
    have hU_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, U m = (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * U 0 := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => simp
      | succ m ih =>
        have hm1 : U (m + 1) = -U m := by
          dsimp [U]
          rw [← h_finMod_succ m, hstep (finMod m)]
        rw [hm1, ih]
        ring
    have hUN_eq : U N = U 0 := by
      dsimp [U]
      rw [h_finMod_N]
    have hUN_neg : U N = -U 0 := by
      rw [hU_pow N, hN_odd.neg_one_pow]
      ring
    have hU0 : U 0 = 0 := by linarith
    funext j
    calc
      u j = U j.val := by dsimp [U]; rw [h_finMod_val j]
      _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j.val * U 0 := hU_pow j.val
      _ = 0 := by rw [hU0, mul_zero]
  have hH_quad : ∀ z : Fin N → ℝ,
      dotProduct z (H_r.mulVec z) =
        -∑ j : Fin N,
          (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) *
            (z j / w_r j - z (@cycNext N inst j) / w_r (@cycNext N inst j)) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    let q : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => z i / w_r i
    have hz_eq : z = fun i => w_r i * q i := by
      funext i
      dsimp [q]
      exact (mul_div_cancel₀ (z i) (hw i).ne').symm
    have hM0_z :
        dotProduct z (M0_r.mulVec z) =
          dotProduct (fun i => w_r i * q i) (M0_r.mulVec (fun i => w_r i * q i)) := by
      rw [← hz_eq]
    have hdiag :
        dotProduct z ((Matrix.diagonal V_r).mulVec z) =
          dotProduct (fun i => w_r i * (q i) ^ 2) (M0_r.mulVec w_r) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have hzi : z i = w_r i * q i := congr_fun hz_eq i
      rw [hzi, ← hV_mul i]
      ring
    have hsub :
        dotProduct z (H_r.mulVec z) =
          dotProduct z (M0_r.mulVec z) - dotProduct z ((Matrix.diagonal V_r).mulVec z) := by
      dsimp [H_r]
      rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub]
    rw [hsub, hM0_z, hdiag,
      hM0_bilin (fun i => w_r i * q i) (fun i => w_r i * q i),
      hM0_bilin (fun i => w_r i * (q i) ^ 2) w_r,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    dsimp [q]
    ring
  have hH_nonpos : ∀ z : Fin N → ℝ, dotProduct z (H_r.mulVec z) ≤ 0 := by
    intro z
    rw [hH_quad z]
    have hsum_nonneg :
        0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin N,
          (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) *
            (z j / w_r j - z (@cycNext N inst j) / w_r (@cycNext N inst j)) ^ 2 := by
      refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_
      have hpos : 0 < (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hℓ j)) (hw j)) (hw (@cycNext N inst j))
      exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have hH_eq_zero : ∀ z : Fin N → ℝ,
      (∀ i : Fin N, i ∉ I → z i = 0) → dotProduct z (H_r.mulVec z) = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz_supp hz0
    rw [hH_quad z, neg_eq_zero] at hz0
    let q : Fin N → ℝ := fun i => z i / w_r i
    have hterm_nonneg : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
        0 ≤ (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) *
          (q j - q (@cycNext N inst j)) ^ 2 := by
      intro j _
      have hpos : 0 < (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hℓ j)) (hw j)) (hw (@cycNext N inst j))
      exact mul_nonneg hpos.le (sq_nonneg _)
    have hterm_zero := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hterm_nonneg).mp hz0
    have hq_step : ∀ j : Fin N, q (@cycNext N inst j) = q j := by
      intro j
      have hj := hterm_zero j (Finset.mem_univ j)
      have hpos : 0 < (ℓ_r j)⁻¹ * w_r j * w_r (@cycNext N inst j) :=
        mul_pos (mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hℓ j)) (hw j)) (hw (@cycNext N inst j))
      have hsq : (q j - q (@cycNext N inst j)) ^ 2 = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hj).resolve_left hpos.ne'
      have hsub : q j - q (@cycNext N inst j) = 0 :=
        mul_self_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [sq] using hsq)
      linarith
    let Q : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => q (finMod m)
    have hQ_const : ∀ m : ℕ, Q m = Q 0 := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        dsimp [Q]
        rw [← h_finMod_succ m, hq_step (finMod m)]
        exact ih
    obtain ⟨k₀, _, hk₀_not_I⟩ := Finset.exists_of_ssubset hI
    have hzk₀ : z k₀ = 0 := hz_supp k₀ hk₀_not_I
    have hQ0 : Q 0 = 0 := by
      have hqk₀ : q k₀ = 0 := by
        dsimp [q]
        rw [hzk₀, zero_div]
      calc
        Q 0 = Q k₀.val := (hQ_const k₀.val).symm
        _ = q k₀ := by dsimp [Q]; rw [h_finMod_val k₀]
        _ = 0 := hqk₀
    funext i
    have hqi : q i = 0 := by
      calc
        q i = Q i.val := by dsimp [Q]; rw [h_finMod_val i]
        _ = Q 0 := hQ_const i.val
        _ = 0 := hQ0
    calc
      z i = w_r i * q i := (mul_div_cancel₀ (z i) (hw i).ne').symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hqi, mul_zero]
  have hB_ker : ∀ z : Fin N → ℝ, B_r.mulVec z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz_out : ∀ i : Fin N, i ∉ I ∪ F → z i = 0 := by
      intro i hi_out
      have hi0 : (B_r.mulVec z) i = 0 := congr_fun hz i
      have hrow : (B_r.mulVec z) i = ∑ k : Fin N, if i = k then z k else 0 := by
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, B_r, Matrix.of_apply]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        have hnot : ¬ (i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F) := fun h => hi_out h.1
        simp only [hnot, ↓reduceIte, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul]
      simpa [hrow] using hi0
    let z_I : Fin N → ℝ := fun k => if k ∈ I then z k else 0
    let z_F : Fin N → ℝ := fun k => if k ∈ F then z k else 0
    have hz_split : z = z_I + z_F := by
      funext k
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, z_I, z_F]
      by_cases hkI : k ∈ I
      · have hkF : k ∉ F := Finset.disjoint_left.mp hIF hkI
        simp [hkI, hkF]
      · by_cases hkF : k ∈ F
        · simp [hkI, hkF]
        · have hk_out : k ∉ I ∪ F := by
            simp [Finset.mem_union, hkI, hkF]
          simp [hkI, hkF, hz_out k hk_out]
    have hz_in : ∀ i : Fin N, i ∈ I ∪ F →
        M0_r.mulVec z i - (if i ∈ I then V_r i * z i else 0) = 0 := by
      intro i hi_in
      have hi0 : (B_r.mulVec z) i = 0 := congr_fun hz i
      have hterm : ∀ k : Fin N,
          B_r i k * z k =
            M0_r i k * z k - (if i = k then (if i ∈ I then V_r i * z k else 0) else 0) := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk_in : k ∈ I ∪ F
        · simp only [B_r, Matrix.of_apply, hi_in, hk_in, and_self, ↓reduceIte]
          by_cases hik : i = k
          · subst hik
            by_cases hiI : i ∈ I <;> simp [hiI, sub_mul]
          · simp only [hik, false_and, ↓reduceIte]
            ring
        · have hzk : z k = 0 := hz_out k hk_in
          rw [hzk]
          simp
      have hsum :
          (B_r.mulVec z) i = M0_r.mulVec z i - (if i ∈ I then V_r i * z i else 0) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hterm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
          Finset.sum_ite_eq Finset.univ i (fun k => if i ∈ I then V_r i * z k else 0),
          Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
      linarith
    have hdot_F : dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z_I) + dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z_F) = 0 := by
      have h0 : dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z) = 0 := by
        simp only [dotProduct]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases hiF : i ∈ F
        · have hi_in : i ∈ I ∪ F := Finset.mem_union_right I hiF
          have hi_not_I : i ∉ I := Finset.disjoint_right.mp hIF hiF
          have hMi := hz_in i hi_in
          simp only [hi_not_I, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero] at hMi
          rw [hMi, mul_zero]
        · simp [z_F, hiF]
      rw [hz_split, Matrix.mulVec_add, dotProduct_add] at h0
      exact h0
    have hdot_I : dotProduct z_I (H_r.mulVec z_I) + dotProduct z_I (M0_r.mulVec z_F) = 0 := by
      have h0 : dotProduct z_I (H_r.mulVec z_I + M0_r.mulVec z_F) = 0 := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Pi.add_apply]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases hiI : i ∈ I
        · have hi_in : i ∈ I ∪ F := Finset.mem_union_left F hiI
          have hMi := hz_in i hi_in
          have hz_eq_I : z i = z_I i := by simp [z_I, hiI]
          simp only [hiI, ↓reduceIte, hz_eq_I] at hMi
          rw [hz_split, Matrix.mulVec_add, Pi.add_apply] at hMi
          have hHi : H_r.mulVec z_I i = M0_r.mulVec z_I i - V_r i * z_I i := by
            dsimp [H_r]
            rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal]
          have hsum_i : H_r.mulVec z_I i + M0_r.mulVec z_F i = 0 := by linarith
          rw [hsum_i, mul_zero]
        · simp [z_I, hiI]
      rw [dotProduct_add] at h0
      exact h0
    have hsym_IF : dotProduct z_I (M0_r.mulVec z_F) = dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z_I) :=
      hM0_symm z_I z_F
    have hle_H : dotProduct z_I (H_r.mulVec z_I) ≤ 0 := hH_nonpos z_I
    have hge_M : 0 ≤ dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z_F) := hM0_nonneg z_F
    have hzF_quad : dotProduct z_F (M0_r.mulVec z_F) = 0 := by linarith
    have hzI_quad : dotProduct z_I (H_r.mulVec z_I) = 0 := by linarith
    have hzF_zero : z_F = 0 := hM0_eq_zero z_F hzF_quad
    have hzI_supp : ∀ i : Fin N, i ∉ I → z_I i = 0 := by
      intro i hiI
      simp [z_I, hiI]
    have hzI_zero : z_I = 0 := hH_eq_zero z_I hzI_supp hzI_quad
    rw [hz_split, hzI_zero, hzF_zero, add_zero]
  have hB_inj : Function.Injective B_r.mulVec := by
    intro u v huv
    have hsub : B_r.mulVec (u - v) = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, huv, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hB_ker (u - v) hsub)
  have hB_unit : IsUnit B_r := (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit).mp hB_inj
  have hdet_r_ne : B_r.det ≠ 0 := ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det B_r).mp hB_unit).ne_zero
  have hdet_c :
      (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec (fun i => (ℓ_r i : ℂ)) I F).det = (B_r.det : ℂ) := by
    rw [← hB_map, ← RingHom.map_det Complex.ofRealHom B_r]
    rfl
  rw [hdet_c]
  exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hdet_r_ne

informal_problem.statement:
(N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N)
    (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec w : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hℓ : ∀ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i ≠ 0)
    (h_null : (@jacobiH N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec).mulVec w = 0)
    (j : Fin N) :
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2) *
      (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det =
    ∑ r : Fin N, ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r,
      (w s * w (@cycNext N inst s) / ℓ_vec s)

signature.name: cycle_jacobi_deleted_cofactor_eq_tree_sum
signature.statement:
(N : ℕ) [inst : NeZero N] (hN : 3 ≤ N)
    (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec w : Fin N → ℂ)
    (hℓ : ∀ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i ≠ 0)
    (h_null : (@jacobiH N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec).mulVec w = 0)
    (j : Fin N) :
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2) *
      (@modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det =
    ∑ r : Fin N, ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r,
      (w s * w (@cycNext N inst s) / ℓ_vec s)

proof.tactics:
by
  have _ := hℓ
  have hN_pos : 0 < N := NeZero.pos N
  
  have h_prev_next : ∀ x : Fin N, @cycPrev N inst (@cycNext N inst x) = x := by
    intro x
    ext
    dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
    by_cases hx : x.val + 1 < N
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]
      have h1 : x.val + 1 + N - 1 = x.val + N := by omega
      rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]
    · have hx_eq : x.val + 1 = N := by omega
      rw [hx_eq, Nat.mod_self]
      have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = x.val := by omega
      rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]
  have h_next_prev : ∀ x : Fin N, @cycNext N inst (@cycPrev N inst x) = x := by
    intro x
    ext
    dsimp [cycNext, cycPrev]
    by_cases hx : x.val = 0
    · rw [hx]
      have h1 : 0 + N - 1 = N - 1 := by omega
      have hlt : N - 1 < N := by omega
      have h2 : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
      rw [h1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_self]
    · have h1 : x.val + N - 1 = (x.val - 1) + N := by omega
      have hlt : x.val - 1 < N := by omega
      have h2 : x.val - 1 + 1 = x.val := by omega
      rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt x.isLt]
  have h_eq_cycNext_iff : ∀ i m : Fin N, i = @cycNext N inst m ↔ m = @cycPrev N inst i := by
    intro i m
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [h, h_prev_next]
    · intro h; rw [h, h_next_prev]
  have h_ne_cycNext : ∀ i : Fin N, i ≠ @cycNext N inst i := by
    intro i h
    have hval : i.val = (i.val + 1) % N := congr_arg Fin.val h
    by_cases hi : i.val + 1 < N
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi] at hval; omega
    · have hi_eq : i.val + 1 = N := by omega
      rw [hi_eq, Nat.mod_self] at hval; omega
  let e_j : Fin ((N - 1) + 1) ≃ Fin N :=
    { toFun := fun m => ⟨(j.val + m.val) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ hN_pos⟩
      invFun := fun r => ⟨(r.val + N - j.val) % N, by
        have hlt := Nat.mod_lt (r.val + N - j.val) hN_pos
        omega⟩
      left_inv := fun m => by
        ext
        dsimp
        have hm : m.val < N := by omega
        by_cases hjm : j.val + m.val < N
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hjm]
          have h1 : j.val + m.val + N - j.val = m.val + N := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm]
        · have h1 : j.val + m.val = (j.val + m.val - N) + N := by omega
          have hlt : j.val + m.val - N < N := by omega
          have h2 : (j.val + m.val - N) + N - j.val = m.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm]
      right_inv := fun r => by
        ext
        dsimp
        by_cases hjr : j.val ≤ r.val
        · have h1 : r.val + N - j.val = (r.val - j.val) + N := by omega
          have hlt : r.val - j.val < N := by omega
          have h2 : j.val + (r.val - j.val) = r.val := by omega
          rw [h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.isLt]
        · have hlt : r.val + N - j.val < N := by omega
          have h1 : j.val + (r.val + N - j.val) = r.val + N := by omega
          rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt, h1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt r.isLt] }
  have hE1 : e_j 0 = j := by
    ext
    change (j.val + 0) % N = j.val
    rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
  have hE2 : ∀ m : Fin ((N - 1) + 1), e_j m = j ↔ m = 0 := by
    intro m
    rw [← hE1]
    exact e_j.injective.eq_iff
  have hE2_succ : ∀ a : Fin (N - 1), e_j a.succ ≠ j := by
    intro a h
    exact Fin.succ_ne_zero a ((hE2 a.succ).mp h)
  have hE3 : ∀ a : Fin (N - 1), @cycNext N inst (e_j a.castSucc) = e_j a.succ := by
    intro a
    ext
    change ((j.val + a.val) % N + 1) % N = (j.val + (a.val + 1)) % N
    rw [Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.add_assoc]
  have hE3_prev : ∀ a : Fin (N - 1), @cycPrev N inst (e_j a.succ) = e_j a.castSucc := by
    intro a
    rw [← hE3 a, h_prev_next]
  have hE4 : ∀ a b : Fin (N - 1),
      e_j b.succ = @cycNext N inst (e_j a.succ) ↔ a.val + 1 = b.val := by
    intro a b
    have h_rhs_val : (@cycNext N inst (e_j a.succ)).val = (j.val + (a.val + 2)) % N := by
      change ((j.val + (a.val + 1)) % N + 1) % N = (j.val + (a.val + 2)) % N
      rw [Nat.mod_add_mod]
      have h_assoc : j.val + (a.val + 1) + 1 = j.val + (a.val + 2) := by omega
      rw [h_assoc]
    by_cases ha : a.val + 2 < N
    · let m2 : Fin ((N - 1) + 1) := ⟨a.val + 2, by omega⟩
      have hm2 : @cycNext N inst (e_j a.succ) = e_j m2 := by
        ext
        exact h_rhs_val
      rw [hm2, e_j.injective.eq_iff, Fin.ext_iff]
      change b.val + 1 = a.val + 2 ↔ a.val + 1 = b.val
      omega
    · have ha_eq : a.val + 2 = N := by omega
      have hm0 : @cycNext N inst (e_j a.succ) = e_j 0 := by
        ext
        rw [h_rhs_val, ha_eq, Nat.add_mod_right, hE1, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt j.isLt]
      rw [hm0, e_j.injective.eq_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hb; exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero b hb)
      · intro hab; omega

  
  let γ : Fin N → ℂ := fun s => w s * w (@cycNext N inst s) / ℓ_vec s
  let M0 : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ := @jacobiM0 N inst ℓ_vec
  let V : Fin N → ℂ := jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec
  have h_Vw : ∀ i : Fin N, V i * w i = M0.mulVec w i := by
    intro i
    have hi := congr_fun h_null i
    dsimp [jacobiH] at hi
    rw [Matrix.sub_mulVec, Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.mulVec_diagonal, sub_eq_zero] at hi
    exact hi.symm
  have h_M0_mulVec : ∀ i : Fin N,
      M0.mulVec w i =
        ((ℓ_vec (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹) * w i +
        (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ * w (@cycNext N inst i) +
        (ℓ_vec (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ * w (@cycPrev N inst i) := by
    intro i
    simp only [M0, jacobiM0, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply]
    have h_term : ∀ m : Fin N,
        ((if i = m then (ℓ_vec (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
         (if m = @cycNext N inst i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
         (if i = @cycNext N inst m then (ℓ_vec m)⁻¹ else 0)) * w m =
        (if i = m then ((ℓ_vec (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹) * w m else 0) +
        (if m = @cycNext N inst i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ * w m else 0) +
        (if m = @cycPrev N inst i then (ℓ_vec m)⁻¹ * w m else 0) := by
      intro m
      simp only [h_eq_cycNext_iff i m]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => h_term m]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
      Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have h_M0_diag : ∀ i : Fin N,
      M0 i i = (ℓ_vec (@cycPrev N inst i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ := by
    intro i
    simp only [M0, jacobiM0, Matrix.of_apply, ↓reduceIte, h_ne_cycNext i, add_zero]
  have h_diag_gamma : ∀ i : Fin N,
      (-w i) * (w i * (M0 i i - V i)) = γ (@cycPrev N inst i) + γ i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (-w i) * (w i * (M0 i i - V i)) =
        -(w i) ^ 2 * M0 i i + w i * (V i * w i) := by ring
    rw [h1, h_M0_diag i, h_Vw i, h_M0_mulVec i]
    dsimp [γ]
    rw [h_next_prev i]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring

  
  let B_j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
    @modifiedJacobiB N inst c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅
  let u : Fin N → ℂ := fun i => if i = j then 1 else -w i
  let v : Fin N → ℂ := fun k => if k = j then 1 else w k
  let A_1 : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i k => v k * B_j i k
  let M_sc : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ := Matrix.of fun i k => u i * A_1 i k
  have h_prod_u : (∏ i : Fin N, u i) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ u (Finset.mem_univ j)]
    have huj : u j = 1 := by simp [u]
    rw [huj, one_mul]
    have h_congr : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, u i) =
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, ((-1 : ℂ) * w i) := by
      refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
      have hne : i ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
      simp [u, hne]
    rw [h_congr, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const,
      Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h_prod_v : (∏ k : Fin N, v k) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ v (Finset.mem_univ j)]
    have hvj : v j = 1 := by simp [v]
    rw [hvj, one_mul]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    have hne : i ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
    simp [v, hne]
  have h_lhs_eq_Msc :
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2) * B_j.det = M_sc.det := by
    have hdet1 : M_sc.det = (∏ i : Fin N, u i) * A_1.det := Matrix.det_mul_column u A_1
    have hdet2 : A_1.det = (∏ k : Fin N, v k) * B_j.det := Matrix.det_mul_row v B_j
    rw [hdet1, hdet2, h_prod_u, h_prod_v]
    have h_sq : (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i) =
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (sq (w i)).symm
    calc
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (w i) ^ 2) * B_j.det
          = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) *
              ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i)) * B_j.det := by
            rw [h_sq]
      _ = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i) *
            ((∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, w i) * B_j.det) := by ring

  
  have h_det_row0 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℂ),
      (∀ b : Fin (n + 1), b ≠ 0 → A 0 b = 0) →
      A.det = A 0 0 * (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det := by
    intro n A hzero
    rw [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero A]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (n + 1))]
    · simp [Fin.succAbove_zero]
    · intro b _ hb
      rw [hzero b hb]
      ring
    · intro h0
      exact False.elim (h0 (Finset.mem_univ 0))

  
  let pathLap : ∀ (k : ℕ), (ℕ → ℂ) → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℂ :=
    fun k β => Matrix.of fun a b =>
      if a.val = b.val then β a.val + β (a.val + 1)
      else if a.val + 1 = b.val then -β (a.val + 1)
      else if b.val + 1 = a.val then -β (b.val + 1)
      else 0
  let β0 : ℕ → ℂ := fun s => γ ⟨(j.val + s) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ hN_pos⟩
  have hβ0_ej : ∀ m : Fin ((N - 1) + 1), β0 m.val = γ (e_j m) := fun _ => rfl
  let M' : Matrix (Fin ((N - 1) + 1)) (Fin ((N - 1) + 1)) ℂ := M_sc.submatrix e_j e_j
  have hM'_det_eq : M'.det = M_sc.det := Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self e_j M_sc
  have hM'_00 : M' 0 0 = 1 := by
    simp [M', M_sc, A_1, B_j, modifiedJacobiB, u, v, hE1]
  have hM'_0b : ∀ m : Fin ((N - 1) + 1), m ≠ 0 → M' 0 m = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hne : j ≠ e_j m := fun h => hm ((hE2 m).mp h.symm)
    simp [M', M_sc, A_1, B_j, modifiedJacobiB, u, v, hE1, hne]
  have hM'_sub : M'.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = pathLap (N - 1) β0 := by
    ext a b
    change M_sc (e_j a.succ) (e_j b.succ) = pathLap (N - 1) β0 a b
    set i := e_j a.succ
    set k := e_j b.succ
    have hi_ne : i ≠ j := hE2_succ a
    have hk_ne : k ≠ j := hE2_succ b
    have h_entry : M_sc i k = (-w i) * (w k * B_j i k) := by
      simp [M_sc, A_1, u, v, hi_ne, hk_ne]
    rw [h_entry]
    have hβ_a : β0 a.val = γ (@cycPrev N inst i) := by
      change β0 (a.castSucc).val = γ (@cycPrev N inst (e_j a.succ))
      rw [hβ0_ej a.castSucc, hE3_prev a]
    have hβ_a1 : β0 (a.val + 1) = γ i := hβ0_ej a.succ
    have hβ_b1 : β0 (b.val + 1) = γ k := hβ0_ej b.succ
    by_cases hab : a.val = b.val
    · have hab_eq : a = b := Fin.ext hab
      have hik : i = k := by simp [i, k, hab_eq]
      have hB : B_j i k = M0 i i - V i := by
        rw [← hik]
        simp [B_j, modifiedJacobiB, M0, V, hi_ne]
      rw [hB, ← hik, h_diag_gamma i, ← hβ_a, ← hβ_a1]
      simp only [pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, ↓reduceIte]
    · have hab_ne : a ≠ b := fun h => hab (congr_arg Fin.val h)
      have hik_ne : i ≠ k := fun h => hab_ne (Fin.succ_injective _ (e_j.injective h))
      have hB : B_j i k =
          (if k = @cycNext N inst i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
          (if i = @cycNext N inst k then (ℓ_vec k)⁻¹ else 0) := by
        simp [B_j, modifiedJacobiB, jacobiM0, hi_ne, hk_ne, hik_ne]
      rw [hB]
      have h_ki : k = @cycNext N inst i ↔ a.val + 1 = b.val := hE4 a b
      have h_ik : i = @cycNext N inst k ↔ b.val + 1 = a.val := hE4 b a
      by_cases hab1 : a.val + 1 = b.val
      · have hba1 : b.val + 1 ≠ a.val := by omega
        have hki_t : k = @cycNext N inst i := h_ki.mpr hab1
        have hik_f : i ≠ @cycNext N inst k := fun h => hba1 (h_ik.mp h)
        simp only [hik_f, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
        simp only [hki_t, ↓reduceIte]
        simp only [pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← hab1, hβ_a1]
        dsimp only [γ]
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
      · by_cases hba1 : b.val + 1 = a.val
        · have hki_f : k ≠ @cycNext N inst i := fun h => hab1 (h_ki.mp h)
          have hik_t : i = @cycNext N inst k := h_ik.mpr hba1
          simp only [hki_f, ↓reduceIte, zero_add]
          simp only [hik_t, ↓reduceIte]
          simp only [pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, hba1, ↓reduceIte]
          rw [← hba1, hβ_b1]
          dsimp only [γ]
          rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
        · have hki_f : k ≠ @cycNext N inst i := fun h => hab1 (h_ki.mp h)
          have hik_f : i ≠ @cycNext N inst k := fun h => hba1 (h_ik.mp h)
          simp only [hki_f, hik_f, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, hba1, ↓reduceIte]
          ring
  have hMsc_eq_path : M_sc.det = (pathLap (N - 1) β0).det := by
    rw [← hM'_det_eq, h_det_row0 (N - 1) M' hM'_0b, hM'_00, one_mul, hM'_sub]

  
  let L_mat : ∀ (k : ℕ), Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ :=
    fun k => Matrix.of fun a q =>
      if a.val = q.val then 1
      else if a.val = q.val + 1 then -1
      else 0
  let U_mat : ∀ (k : ℕ), (ℕ → ℂ) → Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ :=
    fun k β => Matrix.of fun q b =>
      if q.val = b.val then β (q.val + 1)
      else if q.val + 1 = b.val then -β (q.val + 1)
      else 0
  have hL_det : ∀ k : ℕ, (L_mat k).det = 1 := by
    intro k
    have hL_tri : (L_mat k).IsLowerTriangular := by
      intro a q haq
      have hlt : a.val < q.val := OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual.mp haq
      have h1 : a.val ≠ q.val := by omega
      have h2 : a.val ≠ q.val + 1 := by omega
      simp [L_mat, h1, h2]
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular (L_mat k) hL_tri]
    simp [L_mat]
  have hU_det : ∀ (k : ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℂ),
      (U_mat k β).det = ∏ q : Fin (k + 1), β (q.val + 1) := by
    intro k β
    have hU_tri : (U_mat k β).IsUpperTriangular := by
      intro q b hbq
      have hlt : b.val < q.val := hbq
      have h1 : q.val ≠ b.val := by omega
      have h2 : q.val + 1 ≠ b.val := by omega
      simp [U_mat, h1, h2]
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular hU_tri]
    simp [U_mat]
  have hLU_row0 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℂ) (b : Fin (k + 1)),
      (L_mat k * U_mat k β) 0 b + (if b = 0 then β 0 else 0) = pathLap (k + 1) β 0 b := by
    intro k β b
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (k + 1))]
    · have hL00 : L_mat k 0 0 = 1 := by simp [L_mat]
      rw [hL00, one_mul]
      by_cases hb0 : b = 0
      · subst hb0
        simp only [U_mat, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_zero, ↓reduceIte]
        ring
      · have hb_val : (0 : ℕ) ≠ b.val := fun h => hb0 (Fin.ext h.symm)
        simp [U_mat, pathLap, hb0, hb_val]
    · intro q _ hq0
      have hq_val : (0 : ℕ) ≠ q.val := fun h => hq0 (Fin.ext h.symm)
      have hL0q : L_mat k 0 q = 0 := by
        simp [L_mat, hq_val]
      rw [hL0q, zero_mul]
    · intro h0; exact False.elim (h0 (Finset.mem_univ 0))
  have hLU_row_ne0 : ∀ (k : ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℂ) (a b : Fin (k + 1)), a ≠ 0 →
      (L_mat k * U_mat k β) a b = pathLap (k + 1) β a b := by
    intro k β a b ha0
    have ha_pos : 0 < a.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => ha0 (Fin.ext h))
    let a_prev : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨a.val - 1, by omega⟩
    have hap_ne : a_prev ≠ a := by
      intro h
      have hv : a.val - 1 = a.val := congr_arg Fin.val h
      omega
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ a)]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase (Finset.univ.erase a) _
      (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hap_ne, Finset.mem_univ a_prev⟩)]
    have hrest : ∑ q ∈ (Finset.univ.erase a).erase a_prev,
        L_mat k a q * U_mat k β q b = 0 := by
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => ?_
      have hq_ap : q ≠ a_prev := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).1
      have hq_a : q ≠ a := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).2).1
      have hv1 : a.val ≠ q.val := fun h => hq_a (Fin.ext h.symm)
      have hv2 : a.val ≠ q.val + 1 := by
        intro h
        apply hq_ap
        ext
        dsimp [a_prev]
        omega
      have hLaq : L_mat k a q = 0 := by simp [L_mat, hv1, hv2]
      rw [hLaq, zero_mul]
    rw [hrest, add_zero]
    have hLaa : L_mat k a a = 1 := by simp [L_mat]
    have hLaap : L_mat k a a_prev = -1 := by
      have hv2 : a.val = a_prev.val + 1 := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
      simp [L_mat, hv2]
    rw [hLaa, hLaap, one_mul, neg_one_mul]
    by_cases hab : a.val = b.val
    · have hap1 : a_prev.val ≠ b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
      have hap2 : a_prev.val + 1 = b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
      simp only [U_mat, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hap1, hap2, ↓reduceIte]
      ring
    · by_cases hab1 : a.val + 1 = b.val
      · have hap1 : a_prev.val ≠ b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
        have hap2 : a_prev.val + 1 ≠ b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
        simp only [U_mat, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, hap1, hap2, ↓reduceIte]
        ring
      · by_cases hba1 : b.val + 1 = a.val
        · have hap1 : a_prev.val = b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
          simp only [U_mat, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, hba1, hap1, ↓reduceIte]
          ring
        · have hap1 : a_prev.val ≠ b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
          have hap2 : a_prev.val + 1 ≠ b.val := by dsimp [a_prev]; omega
          simp only [U_mat, pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, hab, hab1, hba1, hap1, hap2, ↓reduceIte]
          ring

  
  have h_path_det : ∀ (k : ℕ) (β : ℕ → ℂ),
      (pathLap k β).det = ∑ r : Fin (k + 1), ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, β s.val := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro β
      rw [Matrix.det_isEmpty, Fin.sum_univ_one]
      have hempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).erase 0 = ∅ := by
        ext s
        simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false,
          not_not]
        exact Subsingleton.elim s 0
      rw [hempty, Finset.prod_empty]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro β
      let P : Matrix (Fin (k + 1)) (Fin (k + 1)) ℂ := L_mat k * U_mat k β
      let e0 : Fin (k + 1) → ℂ := fun b => if b = 0 then β 0 else 0
      have h_upd : pathLap (k + 1) β = P.updateRow 0 (P 0 + e0) := by
        ext a b
        by_cases ha0 : a = 0
        · subst ha0
          rw [Matrix.updateRow_self, Pi.add_apply]
          exact (hLU_row0 k β b).symm
        · rw [Matrix.updateRow_ne ha0]
          exact (hLU_row_ne0 k β a b ha0).symm
      have hP_det : P.det = ∏ q : Fin (k + 1), β (q.val + 1) := by
        dsimp [P]
        rw [Matrix.det_mul, hL_det k, hU_det k β, one_mul]
      have h_e0_zero : ∀ b : Fin (k + 1), b ≠ 0 → (P.updateRow 0 e0) 0 b = 0 := by
        intro b hb
        simp [e0, hb]
      have h_e0_00 : (P.updateRow 0 e0) 0 0 = β 0 := by
        simp [e0]
      have h_sub_eq : (P.updateRow 0 e0).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
          pathLap k (fun s => β (s + 1)) := by
        ext a b
        rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.updateRow_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero a)]
        dsimp [P]
        rw [hLU_row_ne0 k β a.succ b.succ (Fin.succ_ne_zero a)]
        simp only [pathLap, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.val_succ]
        have hc1 : (a.val + 1 = b.val + 1) ↔ (a.val = b.val) := by omega
        have hc2 : (a.val + 1 + 1 = b.val + 1) ↔ (a.val + 1 = b.val) := by omega
        have hc3 : (b.val + 1 + 1 = a.val + 1) ↔ (b.val + 1 = a.val) := by omega
        simp only [hc1, hc2, hc3]
      have h_lhs_split :
          (pathLap (k + 1) β).det =
            (∏ q : Fin (k + 1), β (q.val + 1)) +
            β 0 * ∑ m : Fin (k + 1), ∏ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, β (q.val + 1) := by
        rw [h_upd, Matrix.det_updateRow_add P 0 (P 0) e0, Matrix.updateRow_eq_self, hP_det,
          h_det_row0 k (P.updateRow 0 e0) h_e0_zero, h_e0_00, h_sub_eq, ih (fun s => β (s + 1))]
      rw [h_lhs_split,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ (f := fun r : Fin ((k + 1) + 1) => ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, β s.val)]
      let emb : Fin (k + 1) ↪ Fin ((k + 1) + 1) := ⟨Fin.succ, Fin.succ_injective _⟩
      have herase0 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((k + 1) + 1))).erase 0 =
          Finset.univ.map emb := by
        rw [Fin.univ_succ, Finset.erase_cons]
      have h_r0 : (∏ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((k + 1) + 1))).erase 0, β s.val) =
          ∏ q : Fin (k + 1), β (q.val + 1) := by
        rw [herase0, Finset.prod_map]
        rfl
      have h_rm : ∀ m : Fin (k + 1),
          (∏ s ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((k + 1) + 1))).erase m.succ, β s.val) =
            β 0 * ∏ q ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, β (q.val + 1) := by
        intro m
        have h0_mem : (0 : Fin ((k + 1) + 1)) ∈ Finset.univ.erase m.succ :=
          Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Fin.succ_ne_zero m).symm, Finset.mem_univ 0⟩
        rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ h0_mem, Fin.val_zero]
        congr 1
        have hmap_er : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((k + 1) + 1))).erase m.succ).erase 0 =
            (Finset.univ.erase m).map emb := by
          rw [Finset.erase_right_comm, herase0]
          exact (Finset.map_erase emb Finset.univ m).symm
        rw [hmap_er, Finset.prod_map]
        rfl
      rw [h_r0, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => h_rm m, ← Finset.mul_sum]

  
  rw [h_lhs_eq_Msc, hMsc_eq_path, h_path_det (N - 1) β0]
  have h_prod_ej : ∀ m : Fin ((N - 1) + 1),
      (∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, β0 s.val) =
        ∏ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase (e_j m), γ t := by
    intro m
    have hmap : (Finset.univ.erase m).map e_j.toEmbedding = Finset.univ.erase (e_j m) := by
      rw [Finset.map_erase, Finset.map_univ_equiv]
      rfl
    rw [← hmap, Finset.prod_map]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => h_prod_ej m]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp e_j (fun r : Fin N => ∏ t ∈ Finset.univ.erase r, γ t)

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hChord : OddSliceChordProp S) (y : ℂ)
    (hy : y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S)))
    (hf_nz : ∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y ≠ 0)
    (hsin_nz : ∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val y) ≠ 0)
    (hchord_nz : ∀ k : Fin (oddSliceN S), oddSliceChordNum S k y ≠ 0) :
    (∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      2 * sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
        deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y =
        (@jacobiM0 (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S)
          (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
              sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
          (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
            (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y)) j) ∧
    ((@jacobiH (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
      (fun j => oddSliceChordNum S j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => oddSliceTheta S j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ I F : Finset (Fin (oddSliceN S)),
      stateClearedB S I F (oddSliceStateVec S y) =
        stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y) •
          @modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
            (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
              (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
                sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
            I F) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      ((jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
          (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
          (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S),
            (oddSliceChordNum S i y /
              (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
                sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
          (@modifiedJacobiB (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) S.c
            (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y)
            (fun i => oddSliceChordNum S i y /
              (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val y *
                sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
            (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det) ↔
      (((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (oddSliceStateVec S y) j) *
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val) y) ^ 2 *
          (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y i)) ^ 2) *
          (stateDeltaRow S (oddSliceStateVec S y)) ^ (oddSliceN S) =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (oddSliceN S - 1) *
          (S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) / (oddSliceN S : ℂ)) *
          (S.f (oddSliceStateVec S y j)) ^ 4 *
          (∏ i : Fin (oddSliceN S), stateChordNum S (oddSliceStateVec S y) i) *
          (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ (oddSliceStateVec S y)).det))

      have hp_jn := hproj_pt jn

    linear_combination hproj_rhs

      have hj_cast : (j.val : ℤ) = 0 := by omega

  have h_M0 : ∀ j : Fin N,

    let jn : Fin N := @cycNext N inst j

      simp only [jacobiM0, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply]

              (if j = @cycNext N inst k then (ℓ_vec k)⁻¹ else 0)) * w k) =

    rw [← h_M0 j]
    dsimp [jacobiVDiag, w, jacobiNullVec]

  let z : Fin N → ℂ := oddSliceStateVec S y

  have hd0_eq : d0_vec = fun i => stateD0 S z i := by

    rw [hChord.θ_eq_stateTheta y hy i]

  have hsin_z_nz : ∀ k : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k
    rw [← congr_fun hd0_eq k]

  have h_edge_clear : ∀ r : Fin N,
      stateDeltaRow S z * (ℓ_z r)⁻¹ =
        S.f (z r) * S.f (z (@cycNext N inst r)) *

          (∏ m : Fin N, Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)) := by
    intro r
    unfold stateDeltaRow
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (stateChordNum S z) (Finset.mem_univ r)]
    dsimp [ℓ_z]
    have hch : stateChordNum S z r ≠ 0 := hchord_nz r
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_M0_clear : ∀ i k : Fin N,
      stateDeltaRow S z * (@jacobiM0 N inst ℓ_z i k) = stateClearedM0Entry S z i k := by
    intro i k
    simp only [jacobiM0, Matrix.of_apply, stateClearedM0Entry]
    simp only [mul_add, mul_ite, mul_zero]
    rw [h_edge_clear (@cycPrev N inst i), h_next_prev i, h_edge_clear i, h_edge_clear k]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have h_V_clear : ∀ i : Fin N,
      stateDeltaRow S z *
        jacobiVDiag N S.c (fun m => S.f (z m)) (fun m => stateD0 S z m) i =
      stateClearedVDiag S z i := by
    intro i
    unfold stateDeltaRow jacobiVDiag stateClearedVDiag
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
      (fun m => Complex.sin (stateD0 S z m)) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    have hsn : Complex.sin (stateD0 S z i) ≠ 0 := hsin_z_nz i
    field_simp
  have h_B_eq : ∀ I F : Finset (Fin N),
      stateClearedB S I F z =
        stateDeltaRow S z •
          @modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec I F := by
    intro I F
    rw [hf_eq, hd0_eq, hℓ_eq]
    ext i k
    simp only [stateClearedB, modifiedJacobiB, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hIF : i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F
    · simp only [hIF, and_self, ↓reduceIte, mul_sub, mul_ite, mul_zero]
      rw [h_M0_clear i k, h_V_clear i]
    · simp only [hIF, ↓reduceIte, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  have h_cofactor_iff : ∀ j : Fin N,
      ((w j) ^ 2 =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
          (∏ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i) *
          (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det) ↔
      (((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) * sp_vec j) ^ 2 *
          (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) *
          (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
          (S.f (z j)) ^ 4 *
          (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S z i) *
          (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ z).det) := by
    intro j
    have hP_f2_nz : (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => pow_ne_zero 2 (hf_nz i)
    have hΔ_nz : stateDeltaRow S z ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun m _ => hchord_nz m)
        (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun m _ => hsin_z_nz m)
    let K : ℂ := (S.f (z j)) ^ 4 * (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) * (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N
    have hK_nz : K ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 4 (hf_nz j)) hP_f2_nz) (pow_ne_zero N hΔ_nz)
    have hLHS : K * (w j) ^ 2 =
        ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) * sp_vec j) ^ 2 *
          (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) *
          (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N := by
      have hw_j : w j =
          (S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) * (S.f (z j))⁻¹ ^ 2 * sp_vec j := by
        dsimp [w, jacobiNullVec]
        rw [hf_eq, hd0_eq]
      have hfj_sq : (S.f (z j)) ^ 4 * (w j) ^ 2 =
          ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (stateD0 S z j) * sp_vec j) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hw_j]
        have hfj : S.f (z j) ≠ 0 := hf_nz j
        field_simp
      dsimp [K]
      linear_combination (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) * (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N * hfj_sq
    have hprod_ell :
        (∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2) * (∏ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i) =
          ∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S z i := by
      rw [hℓ_eq]
      dsimp [ℓ_z]
      rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      have hshift : (∏ i : Fin N, S.f (z (@cycNext N inst i))) = ∏ i : Fin N, S.f (z i) :=
        Equiv.prod_comp cycNextEquiv (fun i => S.f (z i))
      have hsq : (∏ i : Fin N, S.f (z i)) * (∏ i : Fin N, S.f (z i)) =
          ∏ i : Fin N, (S.f (z i)) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => (sq (S.f (z i))).symm
      rw [hshift, hsq]
      exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hP_f2_nz
    have hdet_cl :
        (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ z).det =
          (stateDeltaRow S z) ^ N *
            (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det := by
      rw [h_B_eq (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅, Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hRHS :
        K * ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
            (∏ i : Fin N, ℓ_vec i) *
            (@modifiedJacobiB N inst S.c f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det) =
        (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
          (S.f (z j)) ^ 4 *
          (∏ i : Fin N, stateChordNum S z i) *
          (stateClearedB S (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅ z).det := by
      rw [hdet_cl, ← hprod_ell]
      dsimp [K]
      ring
    rw [← mul_right_inj' hK_nz, hLHS, hRHS]
  exact ⟨h_M0, h_H_null, h_B_eq, h_cofactor_iff⟩

(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hChord : OddSliceChordProp S) (x : ℝ) :
    (∀ j : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      (0 < (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x).re ∧
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x).im = 0) ∧
      (0 < (Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val x -
          sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x)).re ∧
        (Complex.sin (oddSliceTheta S j.val x -
          sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x)).im = 0) ∧
      oddSliceChordNum S j x ≠ 0 ∧
      (0 < (oddSliceChordNum S j x /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x)).re ∧
        (oddSliceChordNum S j x /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) j.val x *
            sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x)).im = 0) ∧
      (0 < (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val x - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) x) j).re ∧
        (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
          (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val x - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) x) j).im = 0)) ∧
    (∑ k : Fin (oddSliceN S),
      (oddSliceChordNum S k x /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) k.val x *
          sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) x)) /
      (jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val x - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
        (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) x) k *
       jacobiNullVec (oddSliceN S) S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
        (fun i => oddSliceTheta S i.val x - sliceAngleSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val x)
        (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S (oddSliceN S) i.val) x)
        (@cycNext (oddSliceN S) (oddSliceNeZero S) k))) =
      (oddSliceN S : ℂ) / S.A (sliceParamT0 (oddSliceN S) : ℂ)
