proof.tactics:
by
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let inst : NeZero N := oddSliceNeZero S
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_pos_nat : 0 < N := by omega
  have hN_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN_pos_nat
  have hN_ne_zero_real : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hN_pos.ne'
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  have ht0_pos : 0 < t₀ := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos) hN_pos
  have ht0_lt : t₀ < S.r_star := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN_pos]
    have hfl : Real.pi / S.r_star < (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1 :=
      Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.pi / S.r_star)
    have hpi_lt : Real.pi < ((Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 1) * S.r_star :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ S.r_star_pos).mp hfl
    have hN_cast : (N : ℝ) = 2 * (Nat.floor (Real.pi / S.r_star) : ℝ) + 3 := by
      dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hN_cast]
    nlinarith [S.r_star_pos]
  have ht0_norm : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ = t₀ := by
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0_pos]
  have ht0_norm_lt : ‖(t₀ : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
    rw [ht0_norm]
    exact ht0_lt
  have ht0_mem : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    simpa using ht0_norm_lt
  have hA_ne_zero : S.A (t₀ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hpos := S.A_real_pos t₀ ht0_pos ht0_lt
    rw [h0, Complex.zero_re] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  
  let U_low : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < S.s_star / 2 ∧ ‖p.2‖ < S.r_star }
  let U_gl : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < S.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < S.r_star }
  have hU_gl_open : IsOpen U_gl :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_fst))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have hU_low_tube : ∀ p ∈ U_low, p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro p hp
    have hw_mem : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by simpa using hp.2
    have hwc_mem : starRingEnd ℂ p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
      simpa [Complex.norm_conj] using hp.2
    have hb1 := (S.h_X_bounds p.2 hw_mem).1
    have hb2 := (S.h_X_bounds (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) hwc_mem).1
    have him := abs_lt.mp hp.1
    refine ⟨hp.2, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith [S.s_star_pos]
  have hs_diff_at : ∀ p ∈ U_low, DifferentiableAt ℂ S.𝔰 p := fun p hp =>
    S.𝔰_holo.differentiableAt (S.tube_open.mem_nhds (hU_low_tube p hp))
  have hs_in_H : ∀ p ∈ U_low, S.𝔰 p ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro p hp
    exact lt_trans (S.𝔰_lower_strip_im p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2) S.s_star_lt_H
  have hf_s_nz : ∀ p ∈ U_low, S.f (S.𝔰 p) ≠ 0 := fun p hp =>
    S.f_lower_strip_ne_zero (S.𝔰 p) (S.𝔰_lower_strip_im p.1 p.2 hp.1 hp.2)
  have hΓ_diff_at : ∀ p ∈ U_low,
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ => S.Γ ζ 0) (S.𝔰 p) ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun ζ => S.Γ ζ 1) (S.𝔰 p) := fun p hp =>
    S.Γ_reg_holo (S.𝔰 p) (hs_in_H p hp) (hf_s_nz p hp)
  have hΘ_diff_at : ∀ p ∈ U_gl, DifferentiableAt ℂ S.Θ_gl p := fun p hp =>
    S.Θ_gl_holo.differentiableAt (hU_gl_open.mem_nhds hp)
  have hp_diff_at : ∀ p ∈ U_gl, DifferentiableAt ℂ S.p_gl p := fun p hp =>
    S.p_gl_holo.differentiableAt (hU_gl_open.mem_nhds hp)
  
  have h_real_pair_low : ∀ v : ℝ, ((v : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ U_low := fun v =>
    ⟨by simp [S.s_star_pos], ht0_norm_lt⟩
  have hs_real_im : ∀ v : ℝ, (S.𝔰 ((v : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).im = 0 := by
    intro v
    have hconj := S.𝔰_conj ((v : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) (hU_low_tube _ (h_real_pair_low v))
    simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
  let D₁ : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => deriv (fun u' : ℂ => S.𝔰 (u', (t₀ : ℂ))) (v : ℂ)
  let D₂ : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => S.𝔰 ((v : ℂ), t')) (t₀ : ℂ)
  have hu1_diff : ∀ w : ℂ, |w.im| < S.s_star / 2 →
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u' : ℂ => S.𝔰 (u', (t₀ : ℂ))) w := by
    intro w hw
    exact (hs_diff_at (w, (t₀ : ℂ)) ⟨hw, ht0_norm_lt⟩).comp w
      (((hasDerivAt_id w).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const w (t₀ : ℂ))).differentiableAt)
  have hD₁_real_pos : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 < (D₁ v).re ∧ (D₁ v).im = 0 := by
    intro v
    have hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun u' : ℂ => S.𝔰 (u', (t₀ : ℂ))) (v : ℂ) :=
      hu1_diff (v : ℂ) (by simp [S.s_star_pos])
    have h_re : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (S.𝔰 ((r : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re) (D₁ v).re v :=
      hg.hasDerivAt.real_of_complex
    have h_ofReal_re : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((S.𝔰 ((r : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re : ℂ))
        ((D₁ v).re : ℂ) v :=
      h_re.ofReal_comp
    have h_comp : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => S.𝔰 ((r : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))) (D₁ v) v :=
      hg.hasDerivAt.comp_ofReal
    have hfun : (fun r : ℝ => ((S.𝔰 ((r : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re : ℂ)) =
        (fun r : ℝ => S.𝔰 ((r : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))) := by
      funext r
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hs_real_im r]
    rw [hfun] at h_ofReal_re
    have hD_eq : D₁ v = ((D₁ v).re : ℂ) := h_comp.unique h_ofReal_re
    have hD_im : (D₁ v).im = 0 := by
      have := congr_arg Complex.im hD_eq
      simpa using this
    have hD_pos : 0 < (D₁ v).re := by
      rw [h_re.deriv.symm]
      exact (S.real_collar_chord v t₀ ht0_pos ht0_lt).2.2.1
    exact ⟨hD_pos, hD_im⟩
  have hD₁_nz : ∀ v : ℝ, D₁ v ≠ 0 := by
    intro v hv0
    have hre := (hD₁_real_pos v).1
    rw [hv0, Complex.zero_re] at hre
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hre
  have h_impact_deriv_eq : ∀ (m : ℤ) (v : ℝ),
      deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N m) (v : ℂ) = D₁ (v + (m : ℝ) * t₀) := by
    intro m v
    let u_m : ℝ := v + (m : ℝ) * t₀
    have hbase : (v : ℂ) + (m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = (u_m : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [u_m]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun u' : ℂ => S.𝔰 (u', (t₀ : ℂ))) (D₁ u_m)
        ((v : ℂ) + (m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) := by
      rw [hbase]
      exact (hu1_diff (u_m : ℂ) (by simp [S.s_star_pos])).hasDerivAt
    have hshift : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => y + (m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ)) 1 (v : ℂ) := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (v : ℂ)).add_const ((m : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ))
    have hcomp := hg.comp (v : ℂ) hshift
    simp only [mul_one] at hcomp
    exact hcomp.deriv
  
  have hf_collar_pos : ∀ u : ℝ,
      0 < (S.f (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)))).re ∧
      (S.f (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)))).im = 0 := by
    intro u
    let σ_u : ℝ := (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
    have hs_eq : S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) = (σ_u : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [σ_u, hs_real_im u]
    rw [hs_eq]
    exact S.f_real_pos σ_u
  have hϕ_collar_im : ∀ u : ℝ, (S.ϕ (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)))).im = 0 := by
    intro u
    let σ_u : ℝ := (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))).re
    have hs_eq : S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) = (σ_u : ℂ) := by
      apply Complex.ext <;> simp [σ_u, hs_real_im u]
    rw [hs_eq]
    have hmem : (σ_u : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by simp [horizStrip, S.H_pos]
    have hconj := S.ϕ_conj (σ_u : ℂ) hmem
    simp only [Complex.conj_ofReal] at hconj
    exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hconj.symm
  have hsin_collar_pos : ∀ u : ℝ,
      0 < (Complex.sin (S.Θ_gl (((u + t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) -
          S.ϕ (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))))).re ∧
      (Complex.sin (S.Θ_gl (((u + t₀ / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) -
          S.ϕ (S.𝔰 ((u : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ))))).im = 0 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨hΘ_im, _, _, _, _, _, hd_pos, hd_lt, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
      S.real_collar_chord u t₀ ht0_pos ht0_lt

    rw [h_xi_my] at hy_p_d hy_Θ_d
    rw [h_xi_py] at hy_Θ_d
    rw [h_xi_mt] at ht_p_d ht_Θ_d
    rw [h_xi_pt] at ht_Θ_d
    
    have hsymp := S.symplectic_gl z₀ (t₀ : ℂ) (by simp [z₀, S.s_star_pos]) ht0_norm_lt
    rw [hy_p_d, ht_p_d, hy_Θ_d, ht_Θ_d] at hsymp
    have hW1 := hW_col_nz u
    have hW2 := hW_col_nz (u + t₀)
    have hsymp_step1 :
        W_col u *
            ((W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) + W_col (u + t₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ (u + t₀))) /
              (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) -
          W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) *
            ((W_col u + W_col (u + t₀)) / (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) =
          S.A (t₀ : ℂ) := by
      linear_combination hsymp
    have hsymp_cleared :
        S.A (t₀ : ℂ) * (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ) =
          W_col u * W_col (u + t₀) * (1 + (ρ (u + t₀) - ρ u)) := by
      calc
        S.A (t₀ : ℂ) * (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)
            = (W_col u *
                  ((W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) +
                      W_col (u + t₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ (u + t₀))) /
                    (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) -
                W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) *
                  ((W_col u + W_col (u + t₀)) / (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ))) *
              (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ) := by rw [hsymp_step1]
        _ = W_col u *
              (((W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) +
                    W_col (u + t₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ (u + t₀))) /
                  (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) *
                (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) -
              W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) *
                (((W_col u + W_col (u + t₀)) / (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) *
                  (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)) := by ring
        _ = W_col u *
              (W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) +
                W_col (u + t₀) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ (u + t₀))) -
              W_col u * (-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + ρ u) * (W_col u + W_col (u + t₀)) := by
          rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hℓ_u_nz, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hℓ_u_nz]
        _ = W_col u * W_col (u + t₀) * (1 + (ρ (u + t₀) - ρ u)) := by ring
    rw [div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hW1 hW2)]
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hA_ne_zero
    calc
      S.A (t₀ : ℂ) * (S.ℓ_chord u t₀ : ℂ)
          = W_col u * W_col (u + t₀) * (1 + (ρ (u + t₀) - ρ u)) := hsymp_cleared
      _ = (S.A (t₀ : ℂ) * (S.A (t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹) *
            (W_col u * W_col (u + t₀) * (1 + (ρ (u + t₀) - ρ u))) := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hA_ne_zero, one_mul]
      _ = S.A (t₀ : ℂ) *
            ((1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * (1 + (ρ (u + t₀) - ρ u)) *
              (W_col u * W_col (u + t₀))) := by
        rw [one_div]
        ring
  
  have h_second_conjunct :
      (∑ k : Fin N,
        (oddSliceChordNum S k x /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val x *
            sliceSpeedSeq S N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) x)) /
        (w_vec k * w_vec (@cycNext N inst k))) =
      (N : ℂ) / S.A (t₀ : ℂ) := by
    let g : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ρ (x + (m : ℝ) * t₀)
    have h_term : ∀ k : Fin N,
        (oddSliceChordNum S k x /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val x *
            sliceSpeedSeq S N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) x)) /
        (w_vec k * w_vec (@cycNext N inst k)) =
        (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * (1 + (g (k.val + 1) - g k.val)) := by
      intro k
      rw [hChord.ℓ_real k x, hw_eq_W_col k, hw_cycNext k]
      have hstep := h_step_symp (x + (k.val : ℝ) * t₀)
      have hg_succ : g (k.val + 1) = ρ (x + (k.val : ℝ) * t₀ + t₀) := by
        dsimp [g]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hg_succ]
      exact hstep
    have hg_per : g N = g 0 := by
      dsimp [g, ρ]
      have hN_step : x + (N : ℝ) * t₀ = x + 2 * Real.pi := by
        dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
        field_simp [hN_ne_zero_real]
      have h0_step : x + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t₀ = x := by norm_num
      rw [hN_step, h0_step, hD₁_per x, hD₂_per x]
    calc
      (∑ k : Fin N,
          (oddSliceChordNum S k x /
            (sliceSpeedSeq S N k.val x *
              sliceSpeedSeq S N ((k.val : ℤ) + 1) x)) /
          (w_vec k * w_vec (@cycNext N inst k)))
          = ∑ k : Fin N, (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * (1 + (g (k.val + 1) - g k.val)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => h_term k)
      _ = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * (1 + (g (m + 1) - g m)) :=
        Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
          (fun m => (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * (1 + (g (m + 1) - g m))) N
      _ = (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + (g (m + 1) - g m)) := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) *
            ((∑ _m ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℂ)) +
              ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (g (m + 1) - g m)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = (1 / S.A (t₀ : ℂ)) * ((N : ℂ) + (g N - g 0)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
          Finset.sum_range_sub g N]
      _ = (N : ℂ) / S.A (t₀ : ℂ) := by
        rw [hg_per]
        ring
  exact ⟨h_first_conjunct, h_second_conjunct⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) :
    (∀ F G : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (horizStrip h) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip h) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, F x = G x) →
      ∀ y ∈ horizStrip h, F y = G y) ∧
    (∀ (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (g : ι → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ a : ι, DifferentiableOn ℂ (g a) (horizStrip h)) →
      (∀ a : ι, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, g a x₀ ≠ 0) →
      IsOpen { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∀ a : ι, g a y ≠ 0 } ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < h →
        ({ y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∃ a : ι, g a y = 0 } ∩
          { y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ h - ε }).Finite)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  have h_real_mem : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := by
    intro x
    simp [horizStrip, hh]
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip h := by
    simpa using h_real_mem 0
  have h_strip_eq_preimage : horizStrip h = Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-h) h := by
    ext y
    change |y.im| < h ↔ -h < y.im ∧ y.im < h
    exact abs_lt
  have h_preconn : IsPreconnected (horizStrip h) := by
    rw [h_strip_eq_preimage]
    exact ((convex_Ioo (-h) h).linear_preimage Complex.imCLM.toLinearMap).isPreconnected
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F G hF hG hFG y hy
    have hF_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (horizStrip h) := hF.analyticOnNhd h_open
    have hG_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ G (horizStrip h) := hG.analyticOnNhd h_open
    let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)
    let x_seq : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => (r n : ℂ)
    have hr_tend : Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) :=
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hx_tend : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
      simpa [x_seq, Function.comp_def] using (Complex.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp hr_tend
    have hx_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, x_seq n ∈ ({(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := by
      intro n
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, x_seq, Complex.ofReal_eq_zero]
      have hn : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      exact one_div_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hn)
    have hx_nhdsNE : Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds_of_eventually_within x_seq hx_tend
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hx_ne)
    have h_freq_nat : ∃ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, F (x_seq n) = G (x_seq n) :=
      Filter.Frequently.of_forall (fun n => hFG (r n))
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ, F z = G z :=
      hx_nhdsNE.frequently h_freq_nat
    exact hF_anal.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq hG_anal h_preconn h0_mem h_freq hy
  · intro ι hι_fin g hg hg_nz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_eq_set :
          { y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip h ∧ ∀ a : ι, g a y ≠ 0 } =
            horizStrip h ∩ ⋂ a : ι, (horizStrip h ∩ g a ⁻¹' {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage,
          Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hy, ha⟩
          exact ⟨hy, fun a => ⟨hy, ha a⟩⟩
        · rintro ⟨hy, ha⟩
          exact ⟨hy, fun a => (ha a).2⟩
      rw [h_eq_set]
      refine h_open.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun a => ?_)
      exact (hg a).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage h_open isOpen_compl_singleton
    · intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
      let K_eps : Set ℂ :=
        { y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ h - ε }
      have hK_sub : K_eps ⊆ horizStrip h := by
        intro y hy
        simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        linarith [hy.2]
      have hK_closed : IsClosed K_eps :=
        (isClosed_Icc.preimage Complex.continuous_re).inter
          (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const)
      have hK_ball : K_eps ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * Real.pi + h) := by
        intro y hy
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        have hre_nonneg : 0 ≤ y.re := hy.1.1
        have hre_le : |y.re| ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg hre_nonneg]
          exact hy.1.2
        have him_le : |y.im| ≤ h := by linarith [hy.2]
        exact le_trans (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im y) (add_le_add hre_le him_le)
      have hK_compact : IsCompact K_eps :=
        (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * Real.pi + h)).of_isClosed_subset hK_closed hK_ball
      let Z : ι → Set ℂ := fun a => { y : ℂ | y ∈ K_eps ∧ g a y = 0 }
      have hZ_fin : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Finite := by
        intro a
        by_contra h_not_fin
        have h_inf : (Z a).Infinite := Set.not_finite.mp h_not_fin
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀_K, hy₀_acc⟩ :=
          h_inf.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact hK_compact (fun _ hz => hz.1)
        have h_freq_Z : ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ, z ∈ Z a :=
          accPt_iff_frequently_nhdsNE.mp hy₀_acc
        have h_freq_zero : ∃ᶠ z : ℂ in nhdsWithin y₀ {y₀}ᶜ, g a z = 0 :=
          h_freq_Z.mono (fun _ hz => hz.2)
        have h_eq_zero : Set.EqOn (g a) 0 (horizStrip h) :=
          ((hg a).analyticOnNhd h_open).eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero
            h_preconn (hK_sub hy₀_K) h_freq_zero
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀_nz⟩ := hg_nz a
        exact hx₀_nz (h_eq_zero (h_real_mem x₀))
      refine (Set.finite_iUnion hZ_fin).subset ?_
      rintro y ⟨⟨_, a, ha0⟩, hyK⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a, hyK, ha0⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_speed_cap : ∃ C_f : ℝ, 1 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H,
      ‖S.f s‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_f * (1 + max (-Real.log (S.H - |s.im|)) 0)) := by
    let k₀ : ℝ := hBudget.k₀
    have hk₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀ := hBudget.k₀_ge_one
    have hexp_k₀_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-k₀) := Real.exp_pos (-k₀)
    have hexp_k₀_lt_H : Real.exp (-k₀) < S.H := by
      have h1 := hBudget.exp_neg_k₀_lt
      have h2 := S.H_pos
      linarith
    let H_int : ℝ := S.H - Real.exp (-k₀)
    have hH_int_pos : 0 < H_int := by dsimp only [H_int]; linarith
    have hH_int_lt_H : H_int < S.H := by dsimp only [H_int]; linarith
    let Φ_rect : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p => (p.1 : ℂ) + (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ_rect := by
      refine Continuous.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst) ?_
      exact Continuous.mul (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd) continuous_const
    let K_rect : Set ℂ :=
      Φ_rect '' (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H_int) H_int)
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K_rect :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image hΦ_cont
    have hK_sub : K_rect ⊆ horizStrip S.H := by
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, v⟩, ⟨_, hv⟩, rfl⟩
      simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Φ_rect, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im,
        Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, mul_one, mul_zero,
        add_zero, zero_add]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_le.mpr hv) hH_int_lt_H
    obtain ⟨M_int, hM_int⟩ :=
      hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (S.f_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_sub)
    have h_real_shift_mem : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H, ∀ x : ℝ,
        z + (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
      intro z hz x
      simp only [horizStrip, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Complex.add_im, Complex.ofReal_im, add_zero] at hz ⊢
      exact hz
    have hf_per_nat : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        S.f (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = S.f z := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          intro z _
          simp
      | succ n ih =>
          intro z hz
          have hz_n : z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
            have h_eq : z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
                z + (((n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [h_eq]
            exact h_real_shift_mem z hz _
          have h_split : z + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) =
              (z + (n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) + 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [h_split, S.f_periodic _ hz_n, ih z hz]
    have hf_per_int : ∀ (m : ℤ), ∀ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
        S.f (z + (m : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) = S.f z := by
      intro m z hz
      cases m with
      | ofNat n =>
          simpa using hf_per_nat n z hz
      | negSucc n =>
          let w : ℂ := z + (Int.negSucc n : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))
          have hw_mem : w ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
            have h_eq : w = z + (((Int.negSucc n : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              dsimp only [w]
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [h_eq]
            exact h_real_shift_mem z hz _
          have hw_back : w + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) = z := by
            dsimp only [w]
            rw [Int.negSucc_eq]
            push_cast
            ring
          have h1 := hf_per_nat (n + 1) w hw_mem
          rw [hw_back] at h1
          exact h1.symm
    let C₀ : ℝ := max hBudget.C_env 1
    let A₀ : ℝ := max M_int 0 + 1
    let C_f : ℝ := max (C₀ + 3) A₀
    have hC₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ C₀ := le_max_right _ _
    have hC_f_ge_one : 1 ≤ C_f :=
      le_trans (by linarith : 1 ≤ C₀ + 3) (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨C_f, hC_f_ge_one, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    have hs_im : |s.im| < S.H := hs
    let δ : ℝ := S.H - |s.im|
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by dsimp only [δ]; linarith
    let K_pos : ℝ := max (-Real.log δ) 0
    have hK_pos_nn : 0 ≤ K_pos := le_max_right _ _
    by_cases h_slab : |s.im| ≤ H_int
    · let u : ℝ := s.re / (2 * Real.pi)
      let m : ℤ := ⌊u⌋
      let x₀ : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * Int.fract u
      have h2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := Real.two_pi_pos
      have hx₀_nonneg : 0 ≤ x₀ := mul_nonneg h2pi_pos.le (Int.fract_nonneg u)
      have hx₀_le : x₀ ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
        have hlt : Int.fract u ≤ 1 := (Int.fract_lt_one u).le
        nlinarith
      have hs₀_mem_K : Φ_rect (x₀, s.im) ∈ K_rect :=
        ⟨(x₀, s.im), ⟨⟨hx₀_nonneg, hx₀_le⟩, abs_le.mp h_slab⟩, rfl⟩

        ‖∏ i : Fin P.N, P.ℓ_slice i y‖ * ‖B_mat.det‖
          ≤ Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * 2 * M) *
              ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N *
                Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 2) * M)) :=
            mul_le_mul h_chord_prod h_det_exp (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N *
              (Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * 2 * M) *
                Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 2) * M)) := by ring
        _ = (P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N *
              Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            exact congrArg _ (congrArg Real.exp (by ring))
    have h_pre_le :
        ‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ *
            ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N) ≤ K_pre := by
      have h_eq :
          ‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ *
              ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N) =
            ‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ * (P.N.factorial : ℝ) *
              (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N := by ring
      rw [h_eq]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    have h_arg_le : Real.log K_pre + (P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M ≤ 2 * (C_w * M) := by
      dsimp only [C_w]
      nlinarith
    calc
      ‖P.w_vec y j‖ ^ 2
        = ‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ *
            (‖∏ i : Fin P.N, P.ℓ_slice i y‖ * ‖B_mat.det‖) := by
          rw [hw_sq_eq, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ ‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ *
            ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N *
              Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod_bound (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = (‖S.A (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) / (P.N : ℂ)‖ *
            ((P.N.factorial : ℝ) * (4 + 2 / S.c) ^ P.N)) *
            Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M) := by ring
      _ ≤ K_pre * Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pre_le (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log K_pre) * Real.exp ((P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M) := by
          rw [Real.exp_log hK_pre_pos]
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log K_pre + (P.N : ℝ) * (9 * C_f + 4) * M) :=
          (Real.exp_add _ _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * (C_w * M)) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_arg_le
      _ = (Real.exp (C_w * M)) ^ 2 := by
          rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
          exact congrArg Real.exp (by push_cast; ring)
  have hw_le : ‖P.w_vec y j‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_w * M) :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)).mp hw_sq_le
  have hc_ne : (S.c : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hc_pos.ne'
  have hsin_ne : Complex.sin (P.d0 j y) ≠ 0 := P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy j
  have hf_ne : sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y ≠ 0 := P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j
  have hf2_ne : (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hf_ne
  have h_inv_w : deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y =
      (S.c : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Complex.sin (P.d0 j y))⁻¹ *
        (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2 * P.w_vec y j := by
    dsimp only [OddPeriodicSliceData.w_vec, jacobiNullVec]
    rw [inv_pow]
    calc
      deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y
        = ((S.c : ℂ)⁻¹ * (S.c : ℂ)) *
            ((Complex.sin (P.d0 j y))⁻¹ * Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)) *
            ((sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2 * ((sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2)⁻¹) *
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y := by
          rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc_ne, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsin_ne, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf2_ne]
          ring
      _ = (S.c : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Complex.sin (P.d0 j y))⁻¹ *
            (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2 *
            ((S.c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (P.d0 j y) * ((sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y) ^ 2)⁻¹ *
              deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y) := by ring
  have hc_inv_le : ‖(S.c : ℂ)⁻¹‖ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log K_c * M) := by
    rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc_pos]
    calc
      (S.c)⁻¹ ≤ K_c := le_max_right _ _
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log K_c) := (Real.exp_log hK_c_pos).symm
      _ ≤ Real.exp (Real.log K_c * M) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hf2_le : ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (6 * C_f * M) := by
    calc
      ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 ≤ B_f ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hf_seq j) 2
      _ = Real.exp ((2 : ℕ) * (3 * C_f * M)) := (Real.exp_nat_mul _ 2).symm
      _ = Real.exp (6 * C_f * M) := congrArg Real.exp (by push_cast; ring)
  rw [h_inv_w, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow]
  calc
    ‖(S.c : ℂ)⁻¹‖ * ‖(Complex.sin (P.d0 j y))⁻¹‖ *
        ‖sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ^ 2 * ‖P.w_vec y j‖
      ≤ Real.exp (Real.log K_c * M) * Real.exp (2 * M) *
          Real.exp (6 * C_f * M) * Real.exp (C_w * M) := by
        refine mul_le_mul ?_ hw_le (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        refine mul_le_mul ?_ hf2_le (by positivity) (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul hc_inv_le (h_geom_i j).2.2 (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    _ = Real.exp (C₁ * M) := by
        dsimp only [C₁]
        rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
        exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)

signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C_clk M_adm : ℝ)
    (hBase : WalkBaseAndStopProp S P C_clk)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (hAdm : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P M_adm ρ) :
    PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ

proof.tactics:
by
  haveI hProbUnif : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure unifTwoPiMeasure := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    simp only [unifTwoPiMeasure, MeasureTheory.Measure.smul_apply,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ, smul_eq_mul, Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel
      (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.two_pi_pos).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  haveI hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := by
    dsimp only [walkMeasure]
    infer_instance
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  let Ω_reg : Set ℂ := horizStrip h \ P.Z_all
  have hN_pos : 0 < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < sliceParamT0 P.N := by
    unfold sliceParamT0
    exact div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have ht₀_mem : (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) S.r_star := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
    exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    dsimp only [h]
    unfold sliceHeight
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le S.s_star_pos (S.h_X_bounds _ ht₀_mem).1
  have h_walk_in_reg : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ n : ℕ, walkPos ρ om n ∈ Ω_reg :=
    fun om n => (hBase.walk_in_reg M_adm ρ hAdm om n).1
  have h_rho_nn : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm.nonneg
  have h_rho_le_cent : ∀ y : ℂ, ρ y ≤ 1 / 100 := by
    intro y
    have h1 := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have h2 : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ 1 := min_le_left 1 _
    linarith
  have h_rho_le_one : ∀ y : ℂ, ρ y ≤ 1 := fun y => le_trans (h_rho_le_cent y) (by norm_num)
  have h_reg_phase_depth : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
      0 < slicePhaseDepth S P y ∧ ρ y ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * slicePhaseDepth S P y := by
    intro y hy
    have hy_im : |y.im| < h := hy.1
    have hy_bounds := abs_lt.mp hy_im
    have h_depth_eq : slicePhaseDepth S P y = h - |y.im| := rfl
    have h_depth_pos : 0 < slicePhaseDepth S P y := by
      rw [h_depth_eq]
      linarith
    refine ⟨h_depth_pos, ?_⟩
    let p : ℂ := (y.re : ℂ) + ((if 0 ≤ y.im then h else -h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
    have hp_im : p.im = if 0 ≤ y.im then h else -h := by
      simp [p]
    have hp_abs_im : |p.im| = h := by
      rw [hp_im]
      split_ifs
      · exact abs_of_pos hh_pos
      · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hh_pos]
    have hp_not_strip : p ∉ horizStrip h := by
      intro hp_in
      have hp_lt : |p.im| < h := hp_in
      linarith
    have hp_comp : p ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P := by
      intro hp_reg
      exact hp_not_strip hp_reg.1
    have h_dist_eq : dist y p = slicePhaseDepth S P y := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, h_depth_eq]
      by_cases hy0 : 0 ≤ y.im
      · have h_sub : y - p = ((y.im - h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [p, hy0]
        rw [h_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hy0, abs_sub_comm,
          abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < h - y.im)]
      · have hy_neg : y.im < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hy0
        have h_sub : y - p = ((y.im + h : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
          apply Complex.ext <;> simp [p, hy0]
        have h_abs_y : |y.im| = -y.im := abs_of_neg hy_neg
        have h_pos_add : 0 < y.im + h := by linarith
        rw [h_sub, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, h_abs_y, abs_of_pos h_pos_add]
        ring
    have h_sing_le : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P y := by
      rw [← h_dist_eq]
      exact Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hp_comp
    have h1 := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have h2 : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := min_le_right 1 _
    linarith
  have h_adm_cball_sub : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, Metric.closedBall y (ρ y) ⊆ Ω_reg := by
    intro y hy ζ hζ
    have hρ_pos : 0 < ρ y := (hAdm.pos_iff y).mpr hy
    have h1 := hAdm.le_sing_dist y
    have h2 : min 1 (sliceSingDist S P y) ≤ sliceSingDist S P y := min_le_right 1 _
    have hρ_lt_sing : ρ y < sliceSingDist S P y := by linarith
    have h_dist_le : dist y ζ ≤ ρ y := by
      rw [dist_comm]
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hζ
    by_contra hζ_not_reg
    have hζ_comp : ζ ∈ sliceRegClosedComp S P := hζ_not_reg
    have h_sing_le : sliceSingDist S P y ≤ dist y ζ :=
      Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hζ_comp
    linarith
  have h_walkPos_depends : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
      (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → walkPos ρ om₁ k = walkPos ρ om₂ k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        simp [walkPos, h_eq 0 le_rfl]
    | succ k ih =>
        intro om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have hk := ih om₁ om₂ (fun l hl => h_eq l (Nat.le_succ_of_le hl))
        have hk1 := h_eq (k + 1) le_rfl
        simp [walkPos, hk, hk1]
  have h_walk_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => walkPos ρ om k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        dsimp only [walkPos]
        exact Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)
    | succ k ih =>
        have h_rho_k : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om k) : ℂ)) :=
          Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp ih)
        have h_exp_k : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            Complex.exp ((om (k + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
          Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
            ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_pi_apply (k + 1))).mul measurable_const)
        dsimp only [walkPos]
        exact ih.add (h_rho_k.mul h_exp_k)
  have h_meas_im : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => (walkPos ρ om k).im) :=
    fun k => Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp (h_walk_meas k)
  have h_meas_rho : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) :=
    fun k => hAdm.measurable.comp (h_walk_meas k)
  have h_reg_comp_meas :
      ∀ {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
        {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {g : α → ℂ} (hg : Measurable g)
        (h_mem : ∀ a, g a ∈ Ω_reg) {F : ℂ → X} (hF : ContinuousOn F Ω_reg),
        Measurable (fun a => F (g a)) := by
    intro X _ _ _ α _ g hg h_mem F hF
    have hg_sub : Measurable (fun a => (⟨g a, h_mem a⟩ : ↥Ω_reg)) := hg.subtype_mk
    exact (hF.domRestrict).measurable.comp hg_sub
  have h_horiz_open : IsOpen (horizStrip h) :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im)
  have h_impact_holo_maps : ∀ m : ℤ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N m) (horizStrip h) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h, sliceImpactSeq S P.N m z ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro m
    let φ : ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun z => (z + (m : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ))
    have hφ_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (horizStrip h) :=
      ((differentiable_id.add (differentiable_const _)).prodMk
        (differentiable_const _)).differentiableOn
    have hφ_maps : Set.MapsTo φ (horizStrip h) (finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) := by
      intro z hz
      have hz_im : |z.im| < h := hz
      have hz_bounds := abs_lt.mp hz_im
      have h_norm_t0 : ‖(sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)‖ < S.r_star := by
        rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
        exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
      have h_conj_t0 : starRingEnd ℂ (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) = (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ) :=
        Complex.conj_ofReal _
      have h_im_shift : (z + (m : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 P.N : ℂ)).im = z.im := by
        simp
      refine ⟨h_norm_t0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp only [φ]
        rw [h_conj_t0, h_im_shift]
        exact hz_bounds.1
      · dsimp only [φ]
        rw [h_im_shift]
        exact hz_bounds.2
    exact ⟨S.𝔰_holo.comp hφ_diff hφ_maps, fun z hz => S.𝔰_maps_to (φ z) (hφ_maps hz)⟩
  have h_impact_holo : ∀ m : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceImpactSeq S P.N m) (horizStrip h) :=
    fun m => (h_impact_holo_maps m).1
  have h_impact_maps : ∀ m : ℤ, ∀ z ∈ horizStrip h, sliceImpactSeq S P.N m z ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
    fun m => (h_impact_holo_maps m).2
  have h_meas_logDepth : ∀ (k : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om k)) := by
    intro k j
    have h_sj_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
      (h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
    have h_depth_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceShapeDepth S P j) Ω_reg :=
      continuousOn_const.sub (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn
        (Complex.continuous_im.comp_continuousOn h_sj_cont))
    have h_depth_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, sliceShapeDepth S P j y ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hs_in : |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im| < S.H :=
        h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
      unfold sliceShapeDepth
      linarith
    have h_log_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceLogDepth S P j) Ω_reg :=
      (h_depth_cont.log h_depth_ne).neg
    exact h_reg_comp_meas (h_walk_meas k) (fun om => h_walk_in_reg om k) h_log_cont
  have h_meas_geomCost : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om k)) := by
    intro k
    have h_term_cont : ∀ j : Fin P.N, ContinuousOn (fun y : ℂ =>
        ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
          Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
          |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| +
          |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|) Ω_reg := by
      intro j
      have h_ang_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) (horizStrip h) :=
        S.ϕ_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)
      have h_ang_cont : ContinuousOn (sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
        h_ang_holo.continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖) Ω_reg :=
        h_ang_cont.norm
      have h_pos_cont : ContinuousOn (slicePosSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg := by
        refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt fun y hy => ?_
        have hs_in : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
          h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
        have hf_ne : S.f (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y) ≠ 0 :=
          P.reg_speed_ne_zero y hy j
        have hΓ := S.Γ_reg_holo _ hs_in hf_ne
        have hs_contAt : ContinuousAt (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y :=
          (h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn.continuousAt (h_horiz_open.mem_nhds hy.1)
        refine continuousAt_pi.mpr (Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
        · exact hΓ.1.continuousAt.comp hs_contAt
        · exact hΓ.2.continuousAt.comp hs_contAt
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖)) Ω_reg :=
        (continuousOn_const.add h_pos_cont.norm).log fun y _ =>
          ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_add_of_nonneg_right (norm_nonneg _)))
      have h_d0_cont : ContinuousOn (P.d0 j) Ω_reg :=
        ((P.θ_holo j.val).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset).sub h_ang_cont
      have h3 : ContinuousOn (fun y => |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖|) Ω_reg :=
        (((Complex.continuous_sin.comp_continuousOn h_d0_cont).norm).log fun y hy =>
          norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.reg_sin_d0_ne_zero y hy j)).abs
      have h_f_j : ContinuousOn (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val) Ω_reg :=
        (S.f_holo.comp (h_impact_holo j.val) (h_impact_maps j.val)).continuousOn.mono
          Set.sdiff_subset
      have h_f_j1 : ContinuousOn (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1)) Ω_reg :=
        (S.f_holo.comp (h_impact_holo ((j.val : ℤ) + 1))
          (h_impact_maps ((j.val : ℤ) + 1))).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
      have h_num_cont : ContinuousOn (P.ℓ_num j) Ω_reg :=
        (P.ℓ_num_holo j).continuousOn.mono Set.sdiff_subset
      have h_den_ne : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg,
          sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y ≠ 0 := by
        intro y hy h_zero
        have h_ell_ne : P.ℓ_slice j y ≠ 0 := P.reg_chord_ne_zero y hy j
        unfold OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice at h_ell_ne
        rw [h_zero, div_zero] at h_ell_ne
        exact h_ell_ne rfl
      have h_ell_cont : ContinuousOn (P.ℓ_slice j) Ω_reg :=
        h_num_cont.div (h_f_j.mul h_f_j1) h_den_ne
      have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun y => |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|) Ω_reg :=
        ((h_ell_cont.norm).log fun y hy =>
          norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (P.reg_chord_ne_zero y hy j)).abs
      exact ((h1.add h2).add h3).add h4

            rw [hy_eq]
            dsimp only [phClkConcaveBarrier, phClkWallDist, walkPos, X_next]
            rw [h_step_im]
            rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> ring
          · have hpre : X_pref n om ∉ E_pre := fun hp => hom ((hE_iff om).mp hp)
            have hnmem : (X_pref n om, X_next n om) ∉ E_pre ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
              fun hmem => hpre hmem.1
            rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hom, Set.indicator_of_notMem hom]
            dsimp only [G_conc]
            rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hnmem]
            ring
        have h_fun_eq : f_target =
            fun om => G_conc (X_pref n om, X_next n om) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * f_rho om :=
          funext h_decomp
        have hf_rho_half : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * f_rho om) walkMeasure :=
          hf_rho_int.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
        have hf_target_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable f_target walkMeasure := by
          rw [h_fun_eq]
          exact hf_conc_int.sub hf_rho_half
        refine ⟨hf_target_int, hf_rho_int, ?_⟩
        change (∫ om, f_target om ∂walkMeasure) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ om, f_rho om ∂walkMeasure
        rw [h_fun_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hf_conc_int hf_rho_half,
          hf_conc_zero, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        ring
      masked_impact_l2 := by
        intro j E N_hor hE
        let s_j : ℂ → ℂ := sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
        have hs_j_cont_strip : ContinuousOn s_j (horizStrip h) :=
          (h_impact_holo j.val).continuousOn
        have hs_j_cont_reg : ContinuousOn s_j Ω_reg :=
          hs_j_cont_strip.mono Set.sdiff_subset
        have hs_j_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => s_j (walkPos ρ om k)) :=
          fun k => h_reg_comp_meas (h_walk_meas k) (fun om => h_walk_in_reg om k) hs_j_cont_reg
        have h_step_le_H : ∀ y ∈ Ω_reg, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y → ‖s_j (y + z) - s_j y‖ ≤ S.H := by
          intro y hy z hz
          have h_sm := hAdm.small_shape_step y hy z hz j
          have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-M_adm ^ 2) ≤ 1 :=
            Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg M_adm])
          have hs_in : |(s_j y).im| < S.H := h_impact_maps j.val y hy.1
          have h_depth_nn : 0 ≤ sliceShapeDepth S P j y := by
            unfold sliceShapeDepth
            dsimp only [s_j] at hs_in
            linarith
          have h_depth_le : sliceShapeDepth S P j y ≤ S.H := by
            unfold sliceShapeDepth
            linarith [abs_nonneg (s_j y).im]
          calc
            ‖s_j (y + z) - s_j y‖ ≤ Real.exp (-M_adm ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j y := h_sm
            _ ≤ 1 * S.H := mul_le_mul h_exp_le h_depth_le h_depth_nn zero_le_one
            _ = S.H := one_mul S.H
        let d : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
          (E n).indicator (fun om : WalkSpace =>
            s_j (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) - s_j (walkPos ρ om n)) om
        have hd_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (d n) :=
          fun n => ((hs_j_meas (n + 1)).sub (hs_j_meas n)).indicator (hE n).1
        have hd_bound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), ‖d n om‖ ≤ S.H := by
          intro n om
          dsimp only [d]
          by_cases hom : om ∈ E n
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hom]
            let y := walkPos ρ om n
            let z : ℂ := (ρ y : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
            have hz : ‖z‖ ≤ ρ y := by
              simp [z, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, abs_of_nonneg (h_rho_nn y)]
            dsimp only [walkPos]
            exact h_step_le_H y (h_walk_in_reg om n) z hz
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hom, norm_zero]
            exact S.H_pos.le
        have hd_sq_int : ∀ n : ℕ,
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖d n om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
          intro n
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
            (((hd_meas n).norm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (S.H ^ 2)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hd_bound n om) 2
        let Z : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun k om => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, d n om
        have hZ_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (Z k) :=
          fun k => Finset.measurable_sum (Finset.range k) fun n _ => hd_meas n
        have hZ_bound : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), ‖Z k om‖ ≤ (k : ℝ) * S.H := by
          intro k om
          calc
            ‖Z k om‖ ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, ‖d n om‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
            _ ≤ ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range k, S.H := Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ => hd_bound n om
            _ = (k : ℝ) * S.H := by simp
        have hZ_sq_int : ∀ k : ℕ,
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => ‖Z k om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
          intro k
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
            (((hZ_meas k).norm).pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable (((k : ℝ) * S.H) ^ 2)
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hZ_bound k om) 2
        have hZ_dep : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),

          intro k om₁ om₂ h_eq
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
          have hn_lt : n < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
          have hn_le : n ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt hn_lt
          have hn1_le : n + 1 ≤ k := hn_lt
          have h_mem_iff : om₁ ∈ E n ↔ om₂ ∈ E n :=
            (hE n).2 om₁ om₂ fun l hl => h_eq l (le_trans hl hn_le)
          have hy_n := h_walkPos_depends n om₁ om₂ fun l hl => h_eq l (le_trans hl hn_le)
          have hy_n1 := h_walkPos_depends (n + 1) om₁ om₂ fun l hl => h_eq l (le_trans hl hn1_le)
          dsimp only [d]
          by_cases h1 : om₁ ∈ E n
          · have h2 : om₂ ∈ E n := h_mem_iff.mp h1
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2, hy_n, hy_n1]
          · have h2 : om₂ ∉ E n := fun hm => h1 (h_mem_iff.mpr hm)
            rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
        have h_orth : ∀ k : ℕ,
            (∫ om, ‖Z k om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.range k, ∫ om, ‖d n om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure := by
          intro k
          induction k with
          | zero =>
              simp [Z]
          | succ k ih =>
              let E_pre_k : Set (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) := padPrefix k ⁻¹' (E k)
              have hE_pre_meas : MeasurableSet E_pre_k := (hE k).1.preimage (h_pad_meas k)
              have hE_iff : ∀ om : WalkSpace, X_pref k om ∈ E_pre_k ↔ om ∈ E k :=
                fun om => (hE k).2 _ _ (fun l hl => h_pad_restrict_eq k om hl)
              let z_p : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p => Z k (padPrefix k p)
              let y_p : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p => walkPos ρ (padPrefix k p) k
              have hz_p_meas : Measurable z_p := (hZ_meas k).comp (h_pad_meas k)
              have hy_p_meas : Measurable y_p := (h_walk_meas k).comp (h_pad_meas k)
              let stepPt : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ → ℂ :=
                fun q => circleMap (y_p q.1) (ρ (y_p q.1)) q.2
              have h_stepPt_meas : Measurable stepPt := by
                have hm_c : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => y_p q.1) :=
                  hy_p_meas.comp measurable_fst
                have hm_r : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
                    (ρ (y_p q.1) : ℂ)) :=
                  Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (hAdm.measurable.comp hm_c)
                have hm_e : Measurable (fun q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
                    Complex.exp ((q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)) :=
                  Complex.continuous_exp.measurable.comp
                    ((Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp measurable_snd).mul measurable_const)
                dsimp only [stepPt, circleMap]
                exact hm_c.add (hm_r.mul hm_e)
              have h_stepPt_reg : ∀ q, stepPt q ∈ Ω_reg := by
                intro q
                have hy_reg : y_p q.1 ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix k q.1) k
                exact h_adm_cball_sub (y_p q.1) hy_reg
                  (circleMap_mem_closedBall (y_p q.1) (h_rho_nn _) q.2)
              have hs_step_meas : Measurable (fun q => s_j (stepPt q)) :=
                h_reg_comp_meas h_stepPt_meas h_stepPt_reg hs_j_cont_reg
              have hs_base_meas : Measurable
                  (fun q : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => s_j (y_p q.1)) :=
                h_reg_comp_meas (hy_p_meas.comp measurable_fst)
                  (fun q => h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix k q.1) k) hs_j_cont_reg
              let G_cross : (Finset.range (k + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ :=

                have h_im :=

                    (Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp h_diff)

                  (hE_pre_meas.prod MeasurableSet.univ)

                by_cases hq : q ∈ E_pre_k ×ˢ Set.univ

                  let w : ℂ := (ρ (y_p q.1) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((q.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                  have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ ρ (y_p q.1) := by
                    simp [w, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, abs_of_nonneg (h_rho_nn _)]
                  have h_step_eq : stepPt q = y_p q.1 + w := by simp [stepPt, circleMap, w]
                  have hs_diff_norm : ‖s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)‖ ≤ S.H := by
                    rw [h_step_eq]
                    exact h_step_le_H (y_p q.1) (h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix k q.1) k) w hw_norm
                  have hz_re : |(z_p q.1).re| ≤ (k : ℝ) * S.H :=
                    le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hz_norm
                  have hz_im : |(z_p q.1).im| ≤ (k : ℝ) * S.H :=
                    le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hz_norm
                  have hd_re : |(s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).re| ≤ S.H :=
                    le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) hs_diff_norm
                  have hd_im : |(s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).im| ≤ S.H :=
                    le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) hs_diff_norm
                  have hp_re :
                      |(z_p q.1).re * (s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).re| ≤
                        (k : ℝ) * S.H ^ 2 := by
                    rw [abs_mul]
                    calc
                      |(z_p q.1).re| * |(s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).re|
                        ≤ ((k : ℝ) * S.H) * S.H :=
                          mul_le_mul hz_re hd_re (abs_nonneg _)
                            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) S.H_pos.le)
                      _ = (k : ℝ) * S.H ^ 2 := by ring
                  have hp_im :
                      |(z_p q.1).im * (s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).im| ≤
                        (k : ℝ) * S.H ^ 2 := by
                    rw [abs_mul]
                    calc
                      |(z_p q.1).im| * |(s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).im|
                        ≤ ((k : ℝ) * S.H) * S.H :=
                          mul_le_mul hz_im hd_im (abs_nonneg _)
                            (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) S.H_pos.le)
                      _ = (k : ℝ) * S.H ^ 2 := by ring
                  have h_sum_abs := abs_add_le
                    ((z_p q.1).re * (s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).re)
                    ((z_p q.1).im * (s_j (stepPt q) - s_j (y_p q.1)).im)
                  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
                  linarith
                · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hq, norm_zero]
                  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg k))
                    (sq_nonneg S.H)
              have hG_zero : ∀ p, (∫ θ, G_cross (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
                intro p
                by_cases hp : p ∈ E_pre_k
                · let y : ℂ := y_p p
                  let R : ℝ := ρ y
                  have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix k p) k
                  have hR_nn : 0 ≤ R := h_rho_nn y
                  have h_cball : Metric.closedBall y R ⊆ horizStrip h :=
                    (h_adm_cball_sub y hy_reg).trans Set.sdiff_subset
                  have h_ana : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ s_j (horizStrip h) :=
                    (h_impact_holo j.val).analyticOnNhd h_horiz_open
                  have h_harm_re : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (fun w => (s_j w).re)
                      (Metric.closedBall y |R|) := by
                    rw [abs_of_nonneg hR_nn]
                    intro w hw
                    exact (h_ana w (h_cball hw)).harmonicAt_re
                  have h_harm_im : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (fun w => (s_j w).im)
                      (Metric.closedBall y |R|) := by
                    rw [abs_of_nonneg hR_nn]
                    intro w hw
                    exact (h_ana w (h_cball hw)).harmonicAt_im
                  have h_circ_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => s_j (circleMap y R θ)) :=
                    hs_j_cont_strip.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap y R)
                      (fun θ => h_cball (circleMap_mem_closedBall y hR_nn θ))
                  have h_circ_bound : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖s_j (circleMap y R θ)‖ ≤ ‖s_j y‖ + S.H := by
                    intro θ
                    let w : ℂ := (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
                    have hw : ‖w‖ ≤ ρ y := by
                      simp [w, R, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, abs_of_nonneg hR_nn]
                    have h_cm : circleMap y R θ = y + w := by simp [circleMap, w]
                    have h_diff_le := h_step_le_H y hy_reg w hw
                    calc
                      ‖s_j (circleMap y R θ)‖ = ‖s_j y + (s_j (y + w) - s_j y)‖ := by
                        rw [h_cm, add_sub_cancel]
                      _ ≤ ‖s_j y‖ + ‖s_j (y + w) - s_j y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
                      _ ≤ ‖s_j y‖ + S.H := by linarith
                  have h_re_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ : ℝ => (s_j (circleMap y R θ)).re) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
                      (Complex.continuous_re.comp h_circ_cont).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
                      (‖s_j y‖ + S.H)
                      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => by
                        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
                        exact le_trans (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _) (h_circ_bound θ))
                  have h_im_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ : ℝ => (s_j (circleMap y R θ)).im) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
                      (Complex.continuous_im.comp h_circ_cont).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable
                      (‖s_j y‖ + S.H)
                      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => by
                        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
                        exact le_trans (Complex.abs_im_le_norm _) (h_circ_bound θ))
                  have h_re_avg :
                      (∫ θ, (s_j (circleMap y R θ)).re ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = (s_j y).re := by
                    have h_ca := h_harm_re.circleAverage_eq
                    rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul] at h_ca
                    rw [h_unif_interval]
                    exact h_ca
                  have h_im_avg :
                      (∫ θ, (s_j (circleMap y R θ)).im ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = (s_j y).im := by
                    have h_ca := h_harm_im.circleAverage_eq
                    rw [Real.circleAverage_def, smul_eq_mul] at h_ca
                    rw [h_unif_interval]
                    exact h_ca
                  have h_diff_re_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ : ℝ => (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).re) unifTwoPiMeasure := by
                    simp only [Complex.sub_re]
                    exact h_re_int.sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (s_j y).re)
                  have h_diff_im_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ : ℝ => (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).im) unifTwoPiMeasure := by
                    simp only [Complex.sub_im]
                    exact h_im_int.sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (s_j y).im)
                  have h_diff_re_zero :
                      (∫ θ, (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).re ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
                    simp only [Complex.sub_re]
                    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_re_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _),
                      h_re_avg, MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ,
                      smul_eq_mul, one_mul, sub_self]
                  have h_diff_im_zero :
                      (∫ θ, (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).im ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = 0 := by
                    simp only [Complex.sub_im]
                    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_im_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _),
                      h_im_avg, MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ,
                      smul_eq_mul, one_mul, sub_self]
                  have h_eq : (fun θ => G_cross (p, θ)) = fun θ =>
                      (2 * (z_p p).re) * (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).re +
                        (2 * (z_p p).im) * (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).im := by
                    ext θ
                    have hmem : (p, θ) ∈ E_pre_k ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := ⟨hp, trivial⟩
                    dsimp only [G_cross]
                    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
                    dsimp only [stepPt, y, R]
                    ring
                  have h_c_re : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ => (2 * (z_p p).re) * (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).re)
                      unifTwoPiMeasure := h_diff_re_int.const_mul _
                  have h_c_im : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun θ => (2 * (z_p p).im) * (s_j (circleMap y R θ) - s_j y).im)
                      unifTwoPiMeasure := h_diff_im_int.const_mul _
                  rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_add h_c_re h_c_im,
                    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_diff_re_zero, mul_zero,
                    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_diff_im_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
                · have h_eq : (fun θ => G_cross (p, θ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
                    ext θ
                    have hnmem : (p, θ) ∉ E_pre_k ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                      fun hmem => hp hmem.1
                    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hnmem _
                  rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
              rcases h_step_zero k G_cross (4 * (k : ℝ) * S.H ^ 2) hG_meas hG_bound hG_zero with
                ⟨h_cross_int, h_cross_zero⟩
              have h_expand : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
                  ‖Z (k + 1) om‖ ^ 2 =
                    (‖Z k om‖ ^ 2 + ‖d k om‖ ^ 2) + G_cross (X_pref k om, X_next k om) := by
                intro om
                have h_sum : Z (k + 1) om = Z k om + d k om := Finset.sum_range_succ _ k
                have h_norm_add : ∀ u v : ℂ,
                    ‖u + v‖ ^ 2 = (‖u‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2) + 2 * (u.re * v.re + u.im * v.im) := by
                  intro u v
                  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
                    ← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_apply,
                    Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.normSq_apply]
                  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
                  ring
                rw [h_sum, h_norm_add]
                congr 1
                have hz_eq : z_p (X_pref k om) = Z k om :=
                  hZ_dep k _ _ fun l hl => h_pad_restrict_eq k om hl
                have hy_eq : y_p (X_pref k om) = walkPos ρ om k := h_walk_pad k om le_rfl
                by_cases hom : om ∈ E k
                · have hpre : X_pref k om ∈ E_pre_k := (hE_iff om).mpr hom
                  have hmem : (X_pref k om, X_next k om) ∈ E_pre_k ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                    ⟨hpre, trivial⟩
                  dsimp only [G_cross, d]
                  rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hom, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
                  have h_step_eq : stepPt (X_pref k om, X_next k om) = walkPos ρ om (k + 1) := by
                    simp [stepPt, circleMap, hy_eq, walkPos, X_next]
                  rw [hz_eq, hy_eq, h_step_eq]
                · have hpre : X_pref k om ∉ E_pre_k := fun hp => hom ((hE_iff om).mp hp)
                  have hnmem : (X_pref k om, X_next k om) ∉ E_pre_k ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) :=
                    fun hmem => hpre hmem.1
                  dsimp only [G_cross, d]
                  rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hom, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnmem]
                  simp
              have h_fun_eq : (fun om => ‖Z (k + 1) om‖ ^ 2) =
                  fun om => (‖Z k om‖ ^ 2 + ‖d k om‖ ^ 2) + G_cross (X_pref k om, X_next k om) :=
                funext h_expand
              have h_zk_dk_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
                  (fun om => ‖Z k om‖ ^ 2 + ‖d k om‖ ^ 2) walkMeasure :=
                (hZ_sq_int k).add (hd_sq_int k)
              change (∫ om, ‖Z (k + 1) om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) =
                ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∫ om, ‖d n om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure
              rw [h_fun_eq,
                MeasureTheory.integral_add h_zk_dk_int h_cross_int,
                MeasureTheory.integral_add (hZ_sq_int k) (hd_sq_int k),
                h_cross_zero, add_zero, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
        refine ⟨hZ_sq_int N_hor, ?_⟩
        rw [h_orth N_hor,
          ← MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) fun n _ => hd_sq_int n]
      imag_step_lower_drift := by
        intro n ψ L q B_q hψ_cont hq_meas hq_bounds h_quad
        obtain ⟨B_ψ, hB_ψ⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hψ_cont
        have h_icc_comp_meas : ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] {v : α → ℝ}
            (hv : Measurable v) (h_mem : ∀ a, v a ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h),
            Measurable (fun a => ψ (v a)) := by
          intro α _ v hv h_mem
          have hv_sub : Measurable (fun a => (⟨v a, h_mem a⟩ : ↥(Set.Icc (-h) h))) :=
            hv.subtype_mk
          exact (hψ_cont.domRestrict).measurable.comp hv_sub
        have h_im_mem_icc : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
            (walkPos ρ om k).im ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h := by
          intro k om
          have hy_lt : |(walkPos ρ om k).im| < h := (h_walk_in_reg om k).1
          have hb := abs_lt.mp hy_lt
          exact ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.le⟩
        have h_psi_int : ∀ k : ℕ,
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om k).im))
              walkMeasure := by
          intro k
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
            (h_icc_comp_meas (h_meas_im k) (h_im_mem_icc k)).aestronglyMeasurable B_ψ
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => hB_ψ _ (h_im_mem_icc k om))
        have h_q_rho_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) walkMeasure := by
          refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
            (hq_meas.mul ((h_meas_rho n).pow_const 2)).aestronglyMeasurable B_q
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om => ?_)
          have hq_b := hq_bounds (walkPos ρ om n) (h_walk_in_reg om n)
          have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 :=
            mul_nonneg hq_b.1 (sq_nonneg _)
          have h_rho_sq : (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
            nlinarith [h_rho_nn (walkPos ρ om n), h_rho_le_one (walkPos ρ om n)]
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h_prod_nn]
          calc
            q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2
              ≤ B_q * 1 := mul_le_mul hq_b.2 h_rho_sq (sq_nonneg _)
                  (le_trans hq_b.1 hq_b.2)
            _ = B_q := mul_one B_q
        refine ⟨h_q_rho_int, h_psi_int n, h_psi_int (n + 1), ?_⟩
        let y_p : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℂ := fun p => walkPos ρ (padPrefix n p) n
        have hy_p_meas : Measurable y_p := (h_walk_meas n).comp (h_pad_meas n)
        have h_step_im_icc : ∀ r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ,
            (y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2 ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h := by
          intro r
          have hy_reg : y_p r.1 ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix n r.1) n
          have hy_lt : |(y_p r.1).im| < h := hy_reg.1
          have hρ_step : ρ (y_p r.1) ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * (h - |(y_p r.1).im|) :=
            (h_reg_phase_depth (y_p r.1) hy_reg).2
          have h_delta_abs : |ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2| ≤ ρ (y_p r.1) := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_rho_nn _)]
            exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (h_rho_nn _) (Real.abs_sin_le_one _)
          have h_abs_le : |(y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2| ≤ h := by
            have h_tri := abs_add_le (y_p r.1).im (ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2)
            linarith
          exact abs_le.mp h_abs_le
        have h_base_im_icc : ∀ r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ,
            (y_p r.1).im ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h :=
          fun r => h_im_mem_icc n (padPrefix n r.1)
        let G_excess : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ := fun r =>
          ψ ((y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2) - ψ ((y_p r.1).im) -
            q (y_p r.1) * (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2
        have hG_meas : Measurable G_excess := by
          have hm_im : Measurable (fun r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => (y_p r.1).im) :=
            Complex.continuous_im.measurable.comp (hy_p_meas.comp measurable_fst)
          have hm_step_im : Measurable (fun r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ =>
              (y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2) :=
            hm_im.add ((hAdm.measurable.comp (hy_p_meas.comp measurable_fst)).mul
              (Real.continuous_sin.measurable.comp measurable_snd))
          have hm_psi1 := h_icc_comp_meas hm_step_im h_step_im_icc
          have hm_psi0 := h_icc_comp_meas hm_im h_base_im_icc
          have hm_q : Measurable (fun r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => q (y_p r.1)) :=
            (hq_meas.comp (h_pad_meas n)).comp measurable_fst
          have hm_rho2 : Measurable
              (fun r : (Finset.range (n + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2) :=
            (hAdm.measurable.comp (hy_p_meas.comp measurable_fst)).pow_const 2
          exact (hm_psi1.sub hm_psi0).sub (hm_q.mul hm_rho2)
        have hG_bound : ∀ r, ‖G_excess r‖ ≤ 2 * B_ψ + B_q := by
          intro r
          dsimp only [G_excess]
          have hb1 : ‖ψ ((y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2)‖ ≤ B_ψ :=
            hB_ψ _ (h_step_im_icc r)
          have hb0 : ‖ψ ((y_p r.1).im)‖ ≤ B_ψ := hB_ψ _ (h_base_im_icc r)
          have hq_b := hq_bounds (y_p r.1) (h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix n r.1) n)
          have h_rho_sq : (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
            nlinarith [h_rho_nn (y_p r.1), h_rho_le_one (y_p r.1)]
          have hbq : ‖q (y_p r.1) * (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2‖ ≤ B_q := by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hq_b.1 (sq_nonneg _))]
            calc
              q (y_p r.1) * (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2 ≤ B_q * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul hq_b.2 h_rho_sq (sq_nonneg _) (le_trans hq_b.1 hq_b.2)
              _ = B_q := mul_one B_q
          have ht1 := norm_sub_le
            (ψ ((y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2) - ψ ((y_p r.1).im))
            (q (y_p r.1) * (ρ (y_p r.1)) ^ 2)
          have ht2 := norm_sub_le
            (ψ ((y_p r.1).im + ρ (y_p r.1) * Real.sin r.2))
            (ψ ((y_p r.1).im))
          linarith
        have hG_nn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ ∫ θ, G_excess (p, θ) ∂unifTwoPiMeasure := by
          intro p
          let y : ℂ := y_p p
          have hy_reg : y ∈ Ω_reg := h_walk_in_reg (padPrefix n p) n
          let g_lhs : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
            (L y * ρ y) * Real.sin θ + (2 * q y * (ρ y) ^ 2) * Real.sin θ ^ 2
          let g_rhs : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ =>
            ψ (y.im + ρ y * Real.sin θ) - ψ y.im
          have hg_lhs_1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun θ => (L y * ρ y) * Real.sin θ) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
            h_sin_int.const_mul _
          have hg_lhs_2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun θ => (2 * q y * (ρ y) ^ 2) * Real.sin θ ^ 2) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
            h_sin_sq_int.const_mul _
          have hg_lhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g_lhs unifTwoPiMeasure :=
            hg_lhs_1.add hg_lhs_2
          have h_psi_theta_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => ψ (y.im + ρ y * Real.sin θ)) :=
            hψ_cont.comp_continuous
              (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul Real.continuous_sin))
              (fun θ => h_step_im_icc (p, θ))
          have h_psi_theta_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun θ : ℝ => ψ (y.im + ρ y * Real.sin θ)) unifTwoPiMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_bound
              h_psi_theta_cont.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable B_ψ
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => hB_ψ _ (h_step_im_icc (p, θ)))
          have hg_rhs_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable g_rhs unifTwoPiMeasure :=
            h_psi_theta_int.sub (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)
          have h_pw_le : g_lhs ≤ g_rhs := by
            intro θ
            have h_delta : |ρ y * Real.sin θ| ≤ ρ y := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_rho_nn y)]
              exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (h_rho_nn y) (Real.abs_sin_le_one θ)
            have hq_step := h_quad y hy_reg (ρ y * Real.sin θ) h_delta
            dsimp only [g_lhs, g_rhs]
            linarith [show (L y * ρ y) * Real.sin θ + (2 * q y * (ρ y) ^ 2) * Real.sin θ ^ 2 =
              L y * (ρ y * Real.sin θ) + 2 * q y * (ρ y * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 by ring]
          have h_mono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hg_lhs_int hg_rhs_int h_pw_le
          have h_lhs_val : (∫ θ, g_lhs θ ∂unifTwoPiMeasure) = q y * (ρ y) ^ 2 := by
            dsimp only [g_lhs]
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hg_lhs_1 hg_lhs_2,
              MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_int_sin, mul_zero, zero_add,
              MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_int_sin_sq]
            ring
          rw [h_lhs_val] at h_mono
          have h_eq : (fun θ => G_excess (p, θ)) = fun θ => g_rhs θ - q y * (ρ y) ^ 2 := rfl
          rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hg_rhs_int (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _),
            MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
          linarith
        have h_total_nn := h_step_nonneg n G_excess (2 * B_ψ + B_q) hG_meas hG_bound hG_nn
        have h_fun_eq : (fun om => G_excess (X_pref n om, X_next n om)) =
            fun om => ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) - ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im) -
              q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 := by
          ext om
          dsimp only [G_excess]
          have hy_eq : y_p (X_pref n om) = walkPos ρ om n := h_walk_pad n om le_rfl
          rw [hy_eq]
          have h_im_eq : (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im =
              (walkPos ρ om n).im + ρ (walkPos ρ om n) * Real.sin (X_next n om) := by
            dsimp only [walkPos, X_next]
            exact h_step_im _ _ _
          rw [h_im_eq]
        have h_psi_diff_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om => ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) - ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im)) walkMeasure :=
          (h_psi_int (n + 1)).sub (h_psi_int n)
        rw [h_fun_eq,
          MeasureTheory.integral_sub h_psi_diff_int h_q_rho_int,
          MeasureTheory.integral_sub (h_psi_int (n + 1)) (h_psi_int n)] at h_total_nn
        linarith }

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C₁ M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hAdm2M : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P (2 * M) ρ)
    (hStep : PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ)
    (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁) (hM_two : 2 ≤ M)
    (hM_H : -Real.log S.H + 1 ≤ M)
    (hM_h : 4 / sliceHeight S P.N ≤ M)
    (hDerivCap : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
      sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ 2 * M →
      (∀ i : Fin P.N, sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ 2 * M) →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤ Real.exp (C₁ * M)) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
      ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)} ≤
      (18 + 8 * (P.N : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-M)
