signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (C₁ M : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hAdm2M : IsScaleAdmissibleStep S P (2 * M) ρ)
    (hStep : PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ)
    (hC₁ : 1 ≤ C₁) (hM_two : 2 ≤ M)
    (hM_H : -Real.log S.H + 1 ≤ M)
    (hM_h : 4 / sliceHeight S P.N ≤ M)
    (hDerivCap : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all,
      sliceGeomCost S P y ≤ 2 * M →
      (∀ i : Fin P.N, sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ 2 * M) →
      ∀ j : Fin P.N, ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y‖ ≤ Real.exp (C₁ * M)) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
      ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)} ≤
      (18 + 8 * (P.N : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-M)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hProbWalk : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := hStep.prob_walk
  let _ := hM_H
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    have h0_reg := hStep.walk_in_reg (fun _ => 0) 0
    have h0_pd := (hStep.reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step _ h0_reg).1
    unfold slicePhaseDepth at h0_pd
    have h_abs : 0 ≤ |(walkPos ρ (fun _ => 0) 0).im| := abs_nonneg _
    dsimp only [h]
    linarith
  let d_ph : ℝ := Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)
  let R_ph : ℝ := Real.exp (-2 * (C₁ + 4) * M)
  let T_clk : ℝ := Real.exp (-5 * (C₁ + 4) * M)
  let B_step : ℝ := 2 * Real.exp (C₁ * M)
  let r_jump : ℝ := Real.exp (-2 * M)
  have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hd_pos : 0 < d_ph := Real.exp_pos _
  have hR_pos : 0 < R_ph := Real.exp_pos _
  have hT_pos : 0 < T_clk := Real.exp_pos _
  have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B_step := by dsimp only [B_step]; positivity
  have hr_pos : 0 < r_jump := Real.exp_pos _
  have hd_lt_R : d_ph < R_ph := by
    dsimp only [d_ph, R_ph]
    exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have hR_le_h4 : R_ph ≤ h / 4 := by
    have h4_le_Mh : 4 ≤ M * h := (div_le_iff₀ hh_pos).mp hM_h
    have hM_le_exp : M ≤ Real.exp (2 * (C₁ + 4) * M) := by
      have h1 : M ≤ 2 * (C₁ + 4) * M + 1 := by nlinarith
      exact le_trans h1 (Real.add_one_le_exp (2 * (C₁ + 4) * M))
    have h4R : 4 * R_ph ≤ h := by
      calc
        4 * R_ph ≤ (M * h) * R_ph :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4_le_Mh hR_pos.le
        _ = h * (M * R_ph) := by ring
        _ ≤ h * (Real.exp (2 * (C₁ + 4) * M) * R_ph) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM_le_exp hR_pos.le) hh_pos.le
        _ = h := by
          dsimp only [R_ph]
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          have hexp0 : 2 * (C₁ + 4) * M + -2 * (C₁ + 4) * M = 0 := by ring
          rw [hexp0, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    linarith
  have h_rat_ret : d_ph / R_ph ≤ Real.exp (-M) := by
    dsimp only [d_ph, R_ph]
    rw [← Real.exp_sub]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
  have h_rat_clk : 8 * R_ph * d_ph / T_clk ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-M) := by
    have h_eq :
        8 * R_ph * d_ph / T_clk =
          8 * Real.exp ((-2 * (C₁ + 4) * M + -4 * (C₁ + 4) * M) - (-5 * (C₁ + 4) * M)) := by
      dsimp only [R_ph, d_ph, T_clk]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_sub]
    rw [h_eq]
    have hexp :
        Real.exp ((-2 * (C₁ + 4) * M + -4 * (C₁ + 4) * M) - (-5 * (C₁ + 4) * M)) ≤
          Real.exp (-M) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    linarith
  have h_rat_disp : B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-M) := by
    have hB2 : B_step ^ 2 = 4 * Real.exp (2 * (C₁ * M)) := by
      dsimp only [B_step]
      rw [mul_pow, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      norm_num
    have hr2 : r_jump ^ 2 = Real.exp (2 * (-2 * M)) := by
      dsimp only [r_jump]
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      norm_num
    have h_eq :
        B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2 =
          4 * Real.exp ((2 * (C₁ * M) + -5 * (C₁ + 4) * M) - 2 * (-2 * M)) := by
      rw [hB2, hr2]
      dsimp only [T_clk]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, mul_div_assoc, ← Real.exp_sub]
    rw [h_eq]
    have hexp :
        Real.exp ((2 * (C₁ * M) + -5 * (C₁ + 4) * M) - 2 * (-2 * M)) ≤ Real.exp (-M) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    linarith

  have h_mono_iUnion : ∀ (B : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (c : ℝ),
      0 ≤ c → Monotone B → (∀ N : ℕ, walkMeasure.real (B N) ≤ c) →
      walkMeasure.real (⋃ N : ℕ, B N) ≤ c := by
    intro B c hc hB h_le
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hB.measure_iUnion]
    refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hc (iSup_le fun N => ?_)
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure (B N))]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h_le N)

  have h_markov_le : ∀ (f : WalkSpace → ℝ) (B val : ℝ),
      (∀ om : WalkSpace, 0 ≤ f om) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable f walkMeasure →
      (∫ om, f om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ B →
      0 < val →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace | val ≤ f om} ≤ B / val := by
    intro f B val hf_nn hf_int h_int hval
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hval]
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf_nn) hf_int val
    linarith

  have h_sum_ind_Ico : ∀ {α : Type} [AddCommMonoid α]
      (E : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (N_hor m b : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) (Φ : ℕ → WalkSpace → α),
      b ≤ N_hor →
      (∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, om ∈ E n ↔ n ∈ Finset.Ico m b) →
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, (E n).indicator (Φ n) om) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m b, Φ n om := by
    intro α _ E N_hor m b om Φ hb h_iff
    classical
    have h1 : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, (E n).indicator (Φ n) om) =
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, (if om ∈ E n then Φ n om else 0) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => Set.indicator_apply (E n) (Φ n) om
    rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨hn, hmem⟩ => (h_iff n (Finset.mem_range.mpr hn)).mp hmem, fun hn => ?_⟩
    have hn_lt : n < N_hor := lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn).2 hb
    exact ⟨hn_lt, (h_iff n (Finset.mem_range.mpr hn_lt)).mpr hn⟩

  have h_sum_ind_zero : ∀ {α : Type} [AddCommMonoid α]
      (E : ℕ → Set WalkSpace) (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace) (Φ : ℕ → WalkSpace → α),
      (∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, om ∉ E n) →
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, (E n).indicator (Φ n) om) = 0 := by
    intro α _ E N_hor om Φ h_none
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => Set.indicator_of_notMem (h_none n hn) (Φ n)

  let maxHist : WalkSpace → ℕ → ℝ := fun om k =>
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j k)

  have hHist_mono : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (j : Fin P.N) {k₁ k₂ : ℕ},
      k₁ ≤ k₂ → sliceHistory S P ρ om j k₁ ≤ sliceHistory S P ρ om j k₂ := by
    intro om j k₁ k₂ hk
    unfold sliceHistory
    refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun r hr => ?_
    refine Finset.le_sup' (fun l => sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om l)) ?_
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (Finset.mem_range.mp hr) (Nat.succ_le_succ hk))

  have hMaxHist_mono : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) {k₁ k₂ : ℕ},
      k₁ ≤ k₂ → maxHist om k₁ ≤ maxHist om k₂ := by
    intro om k₁ k₂ hk
    dsimp only [maxHist]
    refine Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun j hj => ?_
    exact le_trans (hHist_mono om j hk)
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun i => sliceHistory S P ρ om i k₂) hj)

  have hMaxHist_meas_lt : ∀ (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ),
      MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | maxHist om k < L} := by
    intro k L
    have h_eq : {om : WalkSpace | maxHist om k < L} =
        ⋂ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.N)),
          ⋂ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
            {om : WalkSpace | sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om r) < L} := by
      ext om
      simp only [maxHist, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.sup'_lt_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
      exact forall_congr' fun j => imp_congr_right fun _ => by
        unfold sliceHistory
        exact Finset.sup'_lt_iff _
    rw [h_eq]
    refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun j _ => ?_
    refine Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun r _ => ?_
    exact measurableSet_lt (hStep.measurable_logDepth r j) measurable_const

  have hMaxHist_dep : ∀ (k : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
      (∀ l ≤ k, om₁ l = om₂ l) → maxHist om₁ k = maxHist om₂ k := by
    intro k om₁ om₂ h_eq
    have h_sh : ∀ j : Fin P.N, sliceHistory S P ρ om₁ j k = sliceHistory S P ρ om₂ j k := by
      intro j
      unfold sliceHistory
      refine Finset.sup'_congr _ rfl fun r hr => ?_
      have hr_le : r ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hr)
      rw [hStep.walkPos_depends r om₁ om₂ (fun l hl => h_eq l (le_trans hl hr_le))]
    dsimp only [maxHist]
    exact Finset.sup'_congr _ rfl fun j _ => h_sh j

  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 P.N
  have hN_pos : 0 < (P.N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) P.N_ge_three
  have ht₀_pos : 0 < t₀ := div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hN_pos
  have hTube_mem : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N), ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      (y + ((j.val : ℤ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    intro y hy j
    have hy_lt : -S.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) < y.im ∧ y.im < S.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) := abs_lt.mp hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht₀_pos]
      exact P.t₀_lt_r_star
    · rw [Complex.conj_ofReal]
      simpa using hy_lt.1
    · simpa using hy_lt.2

  have hShapeDepth_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N), ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      0 < sliceShapeDepth S P j y := by
    intro y hy j
    have hs_mem : sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
      S.𝔰_maps_to _ (hTube_mem y hy j)
    unfold sliceShapeDepth
    exact sub_pos.mpr hs_mem

  have hStepCap : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin P.N),
      sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ 2 * M →
      maxHist om n < 2 * M →
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)‖ ≤
        B_step * ρ (walkPos ρ om n) := by
    intro om n j hG hH
    let y : ℂ := walkPos ρ om n
    have hy : y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all := hStep.walk_in_reg om n
    have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ ρ y := hAdm2M.nonneg y
    have hLogLe : ∀ i : Fin P.N, sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ 2 * M := by
      intro i
      have h1 : sliceLogDepth S P i y ≤ sliceHistory S P ρ om i n := by
        unfold sliceHistory
        exact Finset.le_sup' (fun r => sliceLogDepth S P i (walkPos ρ om r))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
      have h2 : sliceHistory S P ρ om i n ≤ maxHist om n :=
        Finset.le_sup' (fun k => sliceHistory S P ρ om k n) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      linarith
    let z : ℂ := (ρ y : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (n + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    have hz : ‖z‖ = ρ y := by
      simp only [z, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hρ_nn,
        Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
    have h_tay := hAdm2M.taylor_impact y hy z (le_of_eq hz) j
    have h_der := hDerivCap y hy hG hLogLe j
    have h_split :
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y =
          (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y -
            deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z) +
          deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z := by ring
    have h_cube_nn : 0 ≤ (2 * M) ^ 3 := by positivity
    have h_cm_nn : 0 ≤ C₁ * M := by positivity
    have h_exp_cmp : Real.exp (-(2 * M) ^ 3) ≤ Real.exp (C₁ * M) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have h_norm_le :
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖ ≤
          B_step * ρ y := by
      calc
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y‖
          ≤ ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (y + z) - sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y -
              deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ +
            ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) y * z‖ := by
            conv_lhs => rw [h_split]
            exact norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(2 * M) ^ 3) * ρ y +
              Real.exp (C₁ * M) * ρ y := by
            rw [norm_mul, hz]
            gcongr
        _ ≤ B_step * ρ y := by
            dsimp only [B_step]
            nlinarith
    simpa only [walkPos, y, z] using h_norm_le

  have hTau_props : ∀ (L : ℝ) (om : WalkSpace),
      (∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ maxHist om m) →
      L ≤ maxHist om (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ↔ maxHist om k < L) := by
    intro L om h_ex
    have h_eq : sliceStopTau S P ρ L om = @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex := by
      dsimp only [maxHist] at h_ex
      simp only [sliceStopTau, h_ex, ↓reduceDIte]
    have h_spec : L ≤ maxHist om (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om) := by
      rw [h_eq]
      exact @Nat.find_spec _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex
    refine ⟨h_spec, fun k => ⟨fun hk => ?_, fun hlt => ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h_eq] at hk
      exact lt_of_not_ge (@Nat.find_min _ (Classical.decPred _) h_ex k hk)
    · by_contra hge
      have hle : sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ k := le_of_not_gt hge
      exact not_lt_of_ge (le_trans h_spec (hMaxHist_mono om hle)) hlt

  have hStopJump : ∀ om : WalkSpace,
      (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ maxHist om m) →
      sliceStopTau S P ρ M om ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om ↔ maxHist om k < M) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om ↔ maxHist om k < 2 * M) ∧
      2 * M ≤ maxHist om (sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om) ∧
      ∃ j_star : Fin P.N, ∀ m < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        r_jump ≤
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om)) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ := by
    intro om h_ex_2M
    have h_ex_M : ∃ m : ℕ, M ≤ maxHist om m := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h_ex_2M
      exact ⟨m, le_trans (by linarith) hm⟩
    obtain ⟨hM_spec, hM_iff⟩ := hTau_props M om h_ex_M
    obtain ⟨h2M_spec, h2M_iff⟩ := hTau_props (2 * M) om h_ex_2M
    set τ₁ := sliceStopTau S P ρ M om
    set τ₂ := sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om
    have hτ₁_le_τ₂ : τ₁ ≤ τ₂ := by
      by_contra hlt
      have h1 : maxHist om τ₂ < M := (hM_iff τ₂).mp (lt_of_not_ge hlt)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨j_star, _, hj_eq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun j : Fin P.N => sliceHistory S P ρ om j τ₂)
    have hj_ge : 2 * M ≤ sliceHistory S P ρ om j_star τ₂ := by
      dsimp only [maxHist] at h2M_spec
      linarith
    obtain ⟨k_star, hk_mem, hk_eq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'
      ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ τ₂)⟩
      (fun n : ℕ => sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om n))
    have hk_ge : 2 * M ≤ sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om k_star) := by
      unfold sliceHistory at hj_ge
      linarith
    have hk_le : k_star ≤ τ₂ := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk_mem)
    have hk_eq_τ₂ : k_star = τ₂ := by
      by_contra hne
      have hk_lt : k_star < τ₂ := lt_of_le_of_ne hk_le hne
      have h1 : sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om k_star) ≤
          sliceHistory S P ρ om j_star k_star := by
        unfold sliceHistory
        exact Finset.le_sup' (fun n => sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om n))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self k_star))
      have h2 : sliceHistory S P ρ om j_star k_star ≤ maxHist om k_star :=
        Finset.le_sup' (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j k_star) (Finset.mem_univ j_star)
      have h3 : maxHist om k_star < 2 * M := (h2M_iff k_star).mp hk_lt
      linarith
    rw [hk_eq_τ₂] at hk_ge
    have hδ₂_pos : 0 < sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om τ₂) :=
      hShapeDepth_pos _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om τ₂).1 j_star
    have hδ₂_le : sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om τ₂) ≤ Real.exp (-2 * M) := by
      unfold sliceLogDepth at hk_ge
      rw [← Real.exp_log hδ₂_pos]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    refine ⟨hτ₁_le_τ₂, hM_iff, h2M_iff, h2M_spec, ⟨j_star, fun m hm => ?_⟩⟩
    have hm_hist : maxHist om m < M := (hM_iff m).mp hm
    have hm_ld : sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) < M := by
      have h1 : sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) ≤
          sliceHistory S P ρ om j_star m := by
        unfold sliceHistory
        exact Finset.le_sup' (fun n => sliceLogDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om n))
          (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
      have h2 : sliceHistory S P ρ om j_star m ≤ maxHist om m :=
        Finset.le_sup' (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m) (Finset.mem_univ j_star)
      linarith
    have hδm_pos : 0 < sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) :=
      hShapeDepth_pos _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om m).1 j_star
    have hδm_gt : Real.exp (-M) < sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) := by
      unfold sliceLogDepth at hm_ld
      rw [← Real.exp_log hδm_pos]
      exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    have h2_lt_expM : 2 < Real.exp M :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (Real.add_one_le_exp M)
    have h_exp_gap : 2 * Real.exp (-2 * M) < Real.exp (-M) := by
      calc
        2 * Real.exp (-2 * M) < Real.exp M * Real.exp (-2 * M) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2_lt_expM hr_pos
        _ = Real.exp (-M) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          exact congrArg Real.exp (by ring)
    have h_diff_im :
        sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om τ₂) ≤
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om τ₂) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ := by
      calc
        sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceShapeDepth S P j_star (walkPos ρ om τ₂)
          = |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om τ₂)).im| -
              |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)).im| := by
            unfold sliceShapeDepth
            ring
        _ ≤ |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om τ₂)).im -
              (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)).im| :=
            abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub _ _
        _ = |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om τ₂) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)).im| := by
            rw [Complex.sub_im]
        _ ≤ ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om τ₂) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j_star.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖ :=
            Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
    dsimp only [r_jump]
    linarith

  let BadWall : ℝ → Set WalkSpace := fun sgn =>
    {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ maxHist om m) ∧
      (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
        sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
      ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
        phClkWallDist S P sgn (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ d_ph}

  have hWallBound : ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      walkMeasure.real (BadWall sgn) ≤ (9 + 4 * (P.N : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-M) := by
    intro sgn hsgn
    let u : ℂ → ℝ := phClkWallDist S P sgn
    have hu_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N), 0 < u y := by
      intro y hy
      change |y.im| < sliceHeight S P.N at hy
      have hy_lt := abs_lt.mp hy
      dsimp only [u, phClkWallDist]
      rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> linarith
    have hu_meas : ∀ k : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => u (walkPos ρ om k)) := by
      intro k
      dsimp only [u, phClkWallDist]
      exact measurable_const.sub (measurable_const.mul (hStep.measurable_im k))

    let isFirstHit : WalkSpace → ℕ → Prop := fun om m =>
      u (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d_ph ∧
      (∀ l < m, d_ph < u (walkPos ρ om l)) ∧
      maxHist om m < M

    have h_hit_unique : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) {m₁ m₂ : ℕ},
        isFirstHit om m₁ → isFirstHit om m₂ → m₁ = m₂ := by
      intro om m₁ m₂ h₁ h₂
      rcases lt_trichotomy m₁ m₂ with hlt | rfl | hgt
      · exfalso
        exact not_lt_of_ge h₁.1 (h₂.2.1 m₁ hlt)
      · rfl
      · exfalso
        exact not_lt_of_ge h₂.1 (h₁.2.1 m₂ hgt)

    have h_hit_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, MeasurableSet {om : WalkSpace | isFirstHit om m} := by
      intro m
      have h_eq : {om : WalkSpace | isFirstHit om m} =
          {om : WalkSpace | u (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d_ph} ∩
          ((⋂ l ∈ Finset.range m, {om : WalkSpace | d_ph < u (walkPos ρ om l)}) ∩
            {om : WalkSpace | maxHist om m < M}) := by
        ext om
        simp only [isFirstHit, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter,
          Finset.mem_range]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (measurableSet_le (hu_meas m) measurable_const).inter
        ((Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l _ =>
            measurableSet_lt measurable_const (hu_meas l)).inter
          (hMaxHist_meas_lt m M))

    have h_hit_dep : ∀ (m : ℕ) (om₁ om₂ : WalkSpace),
        (∀ k ≤ m, om₁ k = om₂ k) → (isFirstHit om₁ m ↔ isFirstHit om₂ m) := by
      intro m om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have hm_pos : walkPos ρ om₁ m = walkPos ρ om₂ m :=
        hStep.walkPos_depends m om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have hm_hist : maxHist om₁ m = maxHist om₂ m :=
        hMaxHist_dep m om₁ om₂ h_eq
      have hl_pos : ∀ l < m, walkPos ρ om₁ l = walkPos ρ om₂ l := fun l hl =>
        hStep.walkPos_depends l om₁ om₂ (fun k hk => h_eq k (le_trans hk (le_of_lt hl)))
      dsimp only [isFirstHit]
      rw [hm_pos, hm_hist]
      refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_left fun _ =>
        forall_congr' fun l => imp_congr_right fun hl => ?_
      rw [hl_pos l hl]

    let activeWall : WalkSpace → ℕ → ℕ → Prop := fun om m n =>
      m ≤ n ∧
      isFirstHit om m ∧
      maxHist om n < 2 * M ∧
      ∀ l ∈ Finset.Icc m n, u (walkPos ρ om l) < R_ph

    have h_act_base : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) (m : ℕ),
        isFirstHit om m → activeWall om m m := by
      intro om m hm
      refine ⟨le_rfl, hm, lt_trans hm.2.2 (by linarith), fun l hl => ?_⟩
      have hlm : l = m := by simp at hl; exact hl
      rw [hlm]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hm.1 hd_lt_R

    have h_act_down : ∀ (om : WalkSpace) {m n₁ n₂ : ℕ},
        m ≤ n₁ → n₁ ≤ n₂ → activeWall om m n₂ → activeWall om m n₁ := by
      intro om m n₁ n₂ hmn₁ hn₁₂ h₂
      refine ⟨hmn₁, h₂.2.1, lt_of_le_of_lt (hMaxHist_mono om hn₁₂) h₂.2.2.1, fun l hl => ?_⟩
      have hl' : l ∈ Finset.Icc m n₂ :=
        Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl).1, le_trans (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl).2 hn₁₂⟩
      exact h₂.2.2.2 l hl'

    let E_wall : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun n =>
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), activeWall om m n}

    have hE_wall_dep : ∀ n : ℕ, phClkSetDependsUpTo n (E_wall n) := by
      intro n
      refine ⟨?_, fun om₁ om₂ h_eq => ?_⟩
      · have h_eq_set : E_wall n =
            ⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              ({om : WalkSpace | isFirstHit om m} ∩
                ({om : WalkSpace | maxHist om n < 2 * M} ∩
                  ⋂ l ∈ Finset.Icc m n, {om : WalkSpace | u (walkPos ρ om l) < R_ph})) := by
          ext om
          simp only [E_wall, activeWall, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range,
            Nat.lt_succ_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
          refine ⟨fun ⟨m, hmn, _, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨m, hmn, h1, h2, h3⟩,
            fun ⟨m, hmn, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨m, hmn, hmn, h1, h2, h3⟩⟩
        rw [h_eq_set]
        refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun m _ => ?_
        exact (h_hit_meas m).inter
          ((hMaxHist_meas_lt n (2 * M)).inter
            (Finset.measurableSet_biInter _ fun l _ =>
              measurableSet_lt (hu_meas l) measurable_const))
      · simp only [E_wall, activeWall, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
        refine exists_congr fun m => and_congr_right fun hmn => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
        have h_hit_eq := h_hit_dep m om₁ om₂ (fun k hk => h_eq k (le_trans hk hmn))
        have hn_hist := hMaxHist_dep n om₁ om₂ h_eq
        rw [h_hit_eq, hn_hist]
        refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ =>
          forall_congr' fun l => imp_congr_right fun hl => ?_
        have hln : l ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl).2
        rw [hStep.walkPos_depends l om₁ om₂ (fun k hk => h_eq k (le_trans hk hln))]

    have h_wall_interval : ∀ (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
        (∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, om ∉ E_wall n) ∨
        ∃ m n_stop : ℕ,
          isFirstHit om m ∧
          m < n_stop ∧
          n_stop ≤ N_hor ∧
          (∀ r : ℕ, m ≤ r → (N_hor ≤ r ∨ ¬ activeWall om m r) → n_stop ≤ r) ∧
          (N_hor ≤ n_stop ∨ ¬ activeWall om m n_stop) ∧
          (∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, om ∈ E_wall n ↔ n ∈ Finset.Ico m n_stop) := by
      intro N_hor om
      classical
      by_cases h_ex : ∃ m < N_hor, isFirstHit om m
      · right
        obtain ⟨m, hm_lt_N, hm_hit⟩ := h_ex
        let P_stop : ℕ → Prop := fun r => m ≤ r ∧ (N_hor ≤ r ∨ ¬ activeWall om m r)
        have hP_ex : ∃ r : ℕ, P_stop r := ⟨N_hor, le_of_lt hm_lt_N, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
        let n_stop : ℕ := Nat.find hP_ex
        have hP_spec : P_stop n_stop := Nat.find_spec hP_ex
        have hn_le_N : n_stop ≤ N_hor :=
          Nat.find_min' hP_ex ⟨le_of_lt hm_lt_N, Or.inl le_rfl⟩
        have hm_lt_stop : m < n_stop := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_ne hP_spec.1 ?_
          intro h_eq_m
          rw [← h_eq_m] at hP_spec
          rcases hP_spec.2 with hN_le | h_not_act
          · exact not_lt_of_ge hN_le hm_lt_N
          · exact h_not_act (h_act_base om m hm_hit)
        refine ⟨m, n_stop, hm_hit, hm_lt_stop, hn_le_N,
          fun r hmr hr => Nat.find_min' hP_ex ⟨hmr, hr⟩,
          hP_spec.2, fun n hn => ?_⟩
        have hn_lt_N : n < N_hor := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
        refine ⟨fun hmem => ?_, fun hn_ico => ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨m', hm'_mem, hm'_act⟩ := hmem
          have hm'_eq : m' = m := h_hit_unique om hm'_act.2.1 hm_hit
          rw [hm'_eq] at hm'_act
          refine Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hm'_act.1, ?_⟩
          by_contra hge
          have hstop_le_n : n_stop ≤ n := le_of_not_gt hge
          rcases hP_spec.2 with hN_le | h_not_act
          · exact not_lt_of_ge (le_trans hN_le hstop_le_n) hn_lt_N
          · exact h_not_act (h_act_down om hP_spec.1 hstop_le_n hm'_act)
        · rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn_ico with ⟨hmn, hn_lt_stop⟩
          have h_not_P : ¬ P_stop n := Nat.find_min hP_ex hn_lt_stop
          have h_act_n : activeWall om m n := by
            by_contra h_na
            exact h_not_P ⟨hmn, Or.inr h_na⟩
          exact ⟨m, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmn), h_act_n⟩
      · left
        intro n hn hmem
        obtain ⟨m, hm_mem, hm_act⟩ := hmem
        have hm_lt_N : m < N_hor :=
          lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hm_mem))
            (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
        exact h_ex ⟨m, hm_lt_N, hm_act.2.1⟩

    
    let E_ret : Set WalkSpace :=
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m k : ℕ,
        isFirstHit om m ∧ m ≤ k ∧ maxHist om k < 2 * M ∧ R_ph ≤ u (walkPos ρ om k)}
    have h_meas_ret : walkMeasure.real E_ret ≤ Real.exp (-M) := by
      let f_ret : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun N_hor om =>
        d_ph + ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E_wall n).indicator
            (fun om' => u (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - u (walkPos ρ om' n)) om
      have hf_ret_nn : ∀ (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), 0 ≤ f_ret N_hor om := by
        intro N_hor om
        rcases h_wall_interval N_hor om with h_none |
            ⟨m, n_stop, hm_hit, hm_lt_stop, hstop_le_N, _, _, h_iff⟩
        · dsimp only [f_ret]
          rw [h_sum_ind_zero E_wall N_hor om _ h_none, add_zero]
          exact hd_pos.le
        · dsimp only [f_ret]
          rw [h_sum_ind_Ico E_wall N_hor m n_stop om
            (fun n om' => u (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - u (walkPos ρ om' n))
            hstop_le_N h_iff]
          have h_tel := Finset.sum_Ico_sub (fun k => u (walkPos ρ om k)) (le_of_lt hm_lt_stop)
          rw [h_tel]
          have hu_stop_pos : 0 < u (walkPos ρ om n_stop) :=
            hu_pos _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om n_stop).1
          have hm_le_d : u (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d_ph := hm_hit.1
          linarith
      have hf_ret_markov : ∀ N_hor : ℕ,
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace | R_ph ≤ f_ret N_hor om} ≤ d_ph / R_ph := by
        intro N_hor
        have h_drift := fun n : ℕ =>
          hStep.wall_linear_drift n sgn (E_wall n) hsgn (hE_wall_dep n)
        have h_sum_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
              (E_wall n).indicator
                (fun om' => u (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - u (walkPos ρ om' n)) om)
            walkMeasure :=
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) fun n _ => (h_drift n).1
        have hf_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (f_ret N_hor) walkMeasure :=
          (MeasureTheory.integrable_const d_ph).add h_sum_int
        have hf_int_eq : (∫ om, f_ret N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) = d_ph := by
          dsimp only [f_ret]
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add (MeasureTheory.integrable_const d_ph) h_sum_int,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul,
            MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) (fun n _ => (h_drift n).1)]
          have h0 : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
              ∫ om, (E_wall n).indicator
                (fun om' => u (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - u (walkPos ρ om' n)) om
                ∂walkMeasure) = 0 :=
            Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n _ => (h_drift n).2
          linarith
        exact h_markov_le (f_ret N_hor) d_ph R_ph (hf_ret_nn N_hor) hf_int
          (le_of_eq hf_int_eq) hR_pos
      let B_ret : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N₀ =>
        {om : WalkSpace | ∀ N_hor ≥ N₀, R_ph ≤ f_ret N_hor om}
      have hB_ret_mono : Monotone B_ret := by
        intro N₁ N₂ hN om hom N_hor hN_hor
        exact hom N_hor (le_trans hN hN_hor)
      have hB_ret_le : ∀ N₀ : ℕ, walkMeasure.real (B_ret N₀) ≤ d_ph / R_ph := by
        intro N₀
        have h_sub : B_ret N₀ ⊆ {om : WalkSpace | R_ph ≤ f_ret N₀ om} :=
          fun om hom => hom N₀ le_rfl
        exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub) (hf_ret_markov N₀)
      have h_union_le : walkMeasure.real (⋃ N₀ : ℕ, B_ret N₀) ≤ d_ph / R_ph :=
        h_mono_iUnion B_ret (d_ph / R_ph) (by positivity) hB_ret_mono hB_ret_le
      have h_sub_ret : E_ret ⊆ ⋃ N₀ : ℕ, B_ret N₀ := by
        intro om ⟨m, k, hm_hit, hmk, hk_hist, hk_ge_R⟩
        classical
        have hk_not_act : ¬ activeWall om m k := by
          intro h_act
          have hk_mem : k ∈ Finset.Icc m k := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hmk, le_rfl⟩
          exact not_lt_of_ge hk_ge_R (h_act.2.2.2 k hk_mem)
        let Q_stop : ℕ → Prop := fun r => m ≤ r ∧ ¬ activeWall om m r
        have hQ_ex : ∃ r : ℕ, Q_stop r := ⟨k, hmk, hk_not_act⟩
        let k_stop : ℕ := Nat.find hQ_ex
        have hQ_spec : Q_stop k_stop := Nat.find_spec hQ_ex
        have hk_stop_le_k : k_stop ≤ k := Nat.find_min' hQ_ex ⟨hmk, hk_not_act⟩
        have hm_lt_kstop : m < k_stop := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_ne hQ_spec.1 ?_
          intro heq
          rw [← heq] at hQ_spec
          exact hQ_spec.2 (h_act_base om m hm_hit)
        have h_ge_R_at_kstop : R_ph ≤ u (walkPos ρ om k_stop) := by
          by_contra hlt_R
          have hu_lt : u (walkPos ρ om k_stop) < R_ph := lt_of_not_ge hlt_R
          have hkstop_hist : maxHist om k_stop < 2 * M :=
            lt_of_le_of_lt (hMaxHist_mono om hk_stop_le_k) hk_hist
          have h_all_lt : ∀ l ∈ Finset.Icc m k_stop, u (walkPos ρ om l) < R_ph := by
            intro l hl
            rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl with ⟨hml, hlk⟩
            rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hlk with rfl | hl_lt
            · exact hu_lt
            · have h_not_Q : ¬ Q_stop l := Nat.find_min hQ_ex hl_lt
              have hl_act : activeWall om m l := by
                by_contra hna
                exact h_not_Q ⟨hml, hna⟩
              exact hl_act.2.2.2 l (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hml, le_rfl⟩)
          exact hQ_spec.2 ⟨hQ_spec.1, hm_hit, hkstop_hist, h_all_lt⟩
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨k_stop, fun N_hor hN_hor => ?_⟩
        rcases h_wall_interval N_hor om with h_none |
            ⟨m', n_stop, hm'_hit, hm'_lt_stop, hstop_le_N, hstop_min, hstop_spec, h_iff⟩
        · exfalso
          have hm_lt_N : m < N_hor := lt_of_lt_of_le hm_lt_kstop hN_hor
          have hom_m : om ∈ E_wall m :=
            ⟨m, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m), h_act_base om m hm_hit⟩
          exact h_none m (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm_lt_N) hom_m
        · have hm'_eq : m' = m := h_hit_unique om hm'_hit hm_hit
          rw [hm'_eq] at hm'_lt_stop hstop_min hstop_spec h_iff
          have hn_le_kstop : n_stop ≤ k_stop :=
            hstop_min k_stop hQ_spec.1 (Or.inr hQ_spec.2)
          have hn_eq_kstop : n_stop = k_stop := by
            refine le_antisymm hn_le_kstop ?_
            by_contra hlt_n
            have hn_lt_kstop : n_stop < k_stop := lt_of_not_ge hlt_n
            rcases hstop_spec with hN_le | hna_stop
            · exact not_lt_of_ge hN_le (lt_of_lt_of_le hn_lt_kstop hN_hor)
            · exact Nat.find_min hQ_ex hn_lt_kstop ⟨le_of_lt hm'_lt_stop, hna_stop⟩
          dsimp only [f_ret]
          rw [h_sum_ind_Ico E_wall N_hor m n_stop om
            (fun n om' => u (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - u (walkPos ρ om' n))
            hstop_le_N h_iff]
          rw [Finset.sum_Ico_sub (fun r => u (walkPos ρ om r)) (le_of_lt hm'_lt_stop),
            hn_eq_kstop]
          have hm_le_d : u (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d_ph := hm_hit.1
          linarith
      exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub_ret)
        (le_trans h_union_le h_rat_ret)

    
    let E_clk : Set WalkSpace :=
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m K : ℕ,
        isFirstHit om m ∧ m ≤ K ∧
        (∀ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K, maxHist om n < 2 * M ∧ u (walkPos ρ om n) < R_ph) ∧
        T_clk < ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K, (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2}
    have h_meas_clk : walkMeasure.real E_clk ≤ 8 * Real.exp (-M) := by
      let Ψ : ℂ → ℝ := phClkConcaveBarrier S P sgn R_ph
      let g_conc : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun N_hor om =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E_wall n).indicator
            (fun om' => Ψ (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - Ψ (walkPos ρ om' n)) om
      let S_clk : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun N_hor om =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          (E_wall n).indicator (fun om' => (ρ (walkPos ρ om' n)) ^ 2) om
      have hg_lower : ∀ (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
          -4 * R_ph * d_ph ≤ g_conc N_hor om := by
        intro N_hor om
        rcases h_wall_interval N_hor om with h_none |
            ⟨m, n_stop, hm_hit, hm_lt_stop, hstop_le_N, _, _, h_iff⟩
        · dsimp only [g_conc]
          rw [h_sum_ind_zero E_wall N_hor om _ h_none]
          nlinarith
        · dsimp only [g_conc]
          rw [h_sum_ind_Ico E_wall N_hor m n_stop om
            (fun n om' => Ψ (walkPos ρ om' (n + 1)) - Ψ (walkPos ρ om' n))
            hstop_le_N h_iff]
          rw [Finset.sum_Ico_sub (fun r => Ψ (walkPos ρ om r)) (le_of_lt hm_lt_stop)]
          have hu_m_pos : 0 < u (walkPos ρ om m) :=
            hu_pos _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om m).1
          have hu_m_le : u (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d_ph := hm_hit.1
          have hΨ_m_le : Ψ (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 4 * R_ph * d_ph := by
            dsimp only [Ψ, phClkConcaveBarrier]
            change u (walkPos ρ om m) * (4 * R_ph - u (walkPos ρ om m)) ≤ 4 * R_ph * d_ph
            nlinarith
          let r : ℕ := n_stop - 1
          have hr_succ : r + 1 = n_stop := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_of_lt hm_lt_stop)
          have hm_le_r : m ≤ r := Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hm_lt_stop
          have hr_lt_stop : r < n_stop := by omega
          have hr_lt_N : r < N_hor := lt_of_lt_of_le hr_lt_stop hstop_le_N
          have hom_r : om ∈ E_wall r :=
            (h_iff r (Finset.mem_range.mpr hr_lt_N)).mpr
              (Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hm_le_r, hr_lt_stop⟩)
          obtain ⟨m', _, hm'_act⟩ := hom_r
          have hm'_eq : m' = m := h_hit_unique om hm'_act.2.1 hm_hit
          rw [hm'_eq] at hm'_act
          have hu_r_lt : u (walkPos ρ om r) < R_ph :=
            hm'_act.2.2.2 r (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm_le_r, le_rfl⟩)
          have h_pd_eq_u : slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om r) = u (walkPos ρ om r) := by
            have hu_r_h4 : h - sgn * (walkPos ρ om r).im < h / 4 :=
              lt_of_lt_of_le hu_r_lt hR_le_h4
            unfold slicePhaseDepth
            dsimp only [u, phClkWallDist]
            rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl
            · have him_pos : 0 < (walkPos ρ om r).im := by linarith
              rw [abs_of_pos him_pos, one_mul]
            · have him_neg : (walkPos ρ om r).im < 0 := by linarith
              rw [abs_of_neg him_neg]
              ring
          have h_pd_step := hStep.reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om r)
          have hu_r_pos : 0 < u (walkPos ρ om r) := by
            rw [← h_pd_eq_u]
            exact h_pd_step.1
          have hρ_r_le : ρ (walkPos ρ om r) ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * u (walkPos ρ om r) := by
            rw [← h_pd_eq_u]
            exact h_pd_step.2
          have hρ_r_nn : 0 ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om r) := hAdm2M.nonneg _
          let z_r : ℂ := (ρ (walkPos ρ om r) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (r + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          have hz_r_im : |z_r.im| ≤ ρ (walkPos ρ om r) := by
            calc
              |z_r.im| ≤ ‖z_r‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm z_r
              _ = ρ (walkPos ρ om r) := by
                simp only [z_r, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                  abs_of_nonneg hρ_r_nn, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one]
          have h_im_next : (walkPos ρ om n_stop).im = (walkPos ρ om r).im + z_r.im := by
            rw [← hr_succ]
            simp only [walkPos, z_r, Complex.add_im]
          have hu_next_bounds :
              0 < u (walkPos ρ om n_stop) ∧ u (walkPos ρ om n_stop) < 4 * R_ph := by
            have hz_bounds := abs_le.mp hz_r_im
            have hu_diff : u (walkPos ρ om n_stop) = u (walkPos ρ om r) - sgn * z_r.im := by
              dsimp only [u, phClkWallDist]
              rw [h_im_next]
              ring
            rw [hu_diff]
            rcases hsgn with rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> linarith
          have hΨ_stop_pos : 0 < Ψ (walkPos ρ om n_stop) := by
            dsimp only [Ψ, phClkConcaveBarrier]
            change 0 < u (walkPos ρ om n_stop) * (4 * R_ph - u (walkPos ρ om n_stop))
            exact mul_pos hu_next_bounds.1 (sub_pos.mpr hu_next_bounds.2)
          linarith
      have hS_clk_nn : ∀ (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace), 0 ≤ S_clk N_hor om := by
        intro N_hor om
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ =>
          Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) om
      have hS_clk_markov : ∀ N_hor : ℕ,
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace | T_clk ≤ S_clk N_hor om} ≤
            8 * R_ph * d_ph / T_clk := by
        intro N_hor
        have h_cd := fun n : ℕ =>
          hStep.wall_concave_drift n sgn R_ph (E_wall n) hsgn (hE_wall_dep n)
        have hg_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (g_conc N_hor) walkMeasure :=
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) fun n _ => (h_cd n).1
        have hS_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (S_clk N_hor) walkMeasure :=
          MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) fun n _ => (h_cd n).2.1
        have hg_int_eq :
            (∫ om, g_conc N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) =
              -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ om, S_clk N_hor om ∂walkMeasure := by
          dsimp only [g_conc, S_clk]
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) (fun n _ => (h_cd n).1),
            MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor) (fun n _ => (h_cd n).2.1),
            Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => (h_cd n).2.2
        have h_low_int :
            -4 * R_ph * d_ph ≤ ∫ om, g_conc N_hor om ∂walkMeasure := by
          have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_mono
            (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (-4 * R_ph * d_ph)) hg_int (hg_lower N_hor)
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul] at h1
          exact h1
        have hS_int_le : (∫ om, S_clk N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ 8 * R_ph * d_ph := by
          linarith
        exact h_markov_le (S_clk N_hor) (8 * R_ph * d_ph) T_clk (hS_clk_nn N_hor)
          hS_int hS_int_le hT_pos
      let B_clk : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N_hor =>
        {om : WalkSpace | T_clk ≤ S_clk N_hor om}
      have hB_clk_mono : Monotone B_clk := by
        intro N₁ N₂ hN om hom
        exact le_trans (show T_clk ≤ S_clk N₁ om from hom)
          (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hN) fun n _ _ =>
            Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) om)
      have h_union_clk : walkMeasure.real (⋃ N_hor : ℕ, B_clk N_hor) ≤
          8 * R_ph * d_ph / T_clk :=
        h_mono_iUnion B_clk (8 * R_ph * d_ph / T_clk) (by positivity) hB_clk_mono hS_clk_markov
      have h_sub_clk : E_clk ⊆ ⋃ N_hor : ℕ, B_clk N_hor := by
        intro om ⟨m, K, hm_hit, hmK, h_act_K, hT_lt⟩
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨K, le_trans (le_of_lt hT_lt) ?_⟩
        have h_ico_sub : Finset.Ico m K ⊆ Finset.range K :=
          fun n hn => Finset.mem_range.mpr (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn).2
        have h_eq_on_ico :
            (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K, (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2) =
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K,
                (E_wall n).indicator (fun om' => (ρ (walkPos ρ om' n)) ^ 2) om := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
          rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn with ⟨hmn, hnK⟩
          have hom_n : om ∈ E_wall n := by
            refine ⟨m, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmn), hmn, hm_hit,
              (h_act_K n hn).1, fun l hl => ?_⟩
            have hl_ico : l ∈ Finset.Ico m K :=
              Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl).1,
                lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hl).2 hnK⟩
            exact (h_act_K l hl_ico).2
          exact (Set.indicator_of_mem hom_n
            (fun om' : WalkSpace => (ρ (walkPos ρ om' n)) ^ 2)).symm
        rw [h_eq_on_ico]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_ico_sub fun n _ _ =>
          Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) om
      exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub_clk)
        (le_trans h_union_clk h_rat_clk)

    
    let activeDisp : WalkSpace → ℕ → ℕ → Prop := fun om m n =>
      m ≤ n ∧
      isFirstHit om m ∧
      maxHist om n < 2 * M ∧
      sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ 2 * M ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2 ≤ T_clk

    let E_disp_mask : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun n =>
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), activeDisp om m n}

    have hE_disp_dep : ∀ n : ℕ, phClkSetDependsUpTo n (E_disp_mask n) := by
      intro n
      refine ⟨?_, fun om₁ om₂ h_eq => ?_⟩
      · have h_eq_set : E_disp_mask n =
            ⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              ({om : WalkSpace | isFirstHit om m} ∩
                ({om : WalkSpace | maxHist om n < 2 * M} ∩
                  ({om : WalkSpace | sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ 2 * M} ∩
                    {om : WalkSpace |
                      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2 ≤ T_clk}))) := by
          ext om
          simp only [E_disp_mask, activeDisp, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion,
            Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
          refine ⟨fun ⟨m, hmn, _, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨m, hmn, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩,
            fun ⟨m, hmn, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ => ⟨m, hmn, hmn, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩⟩
        rw [h_eq_set]
        refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun m _ => ?_
        have h_sum_meas : Measurable
            (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2) :=
          Finset.measurable_sum (Finset.Icc m n) fun k _ => by
            have hm : Measurable
                (fun om : WalkSpace => ρ (walkPos ρ om k) * ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) :=
              (hStep.measurable_rho k).mul (hStep.measurable_rho k)
            simpa only [sq] using hm
        exact (h_hit_meas m).inter
          ((hMaxHist_meas_lt n (2 * M)).inter
            ((measurableSet_le (hStep.measurable_geomCost n) measurable_const).inter
              (measurableSet_le h_sum_meas measurable_const)))
      · simp only [E_disp_mask, activeDisp, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
        refine exists_congr fun m => and_congr_right fun hmn => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
        have h_hit_eq := h_hit_dep m om₁ om₂ (fun k hk => h_eq k (le_trans hk hmn))
        have hn_hist := hMaxHist_dep n om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have hn_pos := hStep.walkPos_depends n om₁ om₂ h_eq
        have h_sum_eq :
            (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om₁ k)) ^ 2) =
              ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om₂ k)) ^ 2 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
          have hkn : k ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2
          rw [hStep.walkPos_depends k om₁ om₂ (fun l hl => h_eq l (le_trans hl hkn))]
        rw [h_hit_eq, hn_hist, hn_pos, h_sum_eq]

    let E_disp_j : Fin P.N → Set WalkSpace := fun j =>
      {om : WalkSpace | ∃ m K : ℕ,
        isFirstHit om m ∧ m ≤ K ∧
        (∀ n < K, maxHist om n < 2 * M) ∧
        2 * M ≤ maxHist om K ∧
        (∀ n < K, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K, (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ≤ T_clk) ∧
        r_jump ≤
          ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om K) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m)‖}

    have h_meas_disp_each : ∀ j : Fin P.N,
        walkMeasure.real (E_disp_j j) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-M) := by
      intro j
      let Δ : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun n om =>
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om (n + 1)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om n)
      let Z_sum : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℂ := fun N_hor om =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, (E_disp_mask n).indicator (Δ n) om
      let Q_sum : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun N_hor om =>
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, ‖(E_disp_mask n).indicator (Δ n) om‖ ^ 2
      have hQ_pathwise : ∀ (N_hor : ℕ) (om : WalkSpace),
          Q_sum N_hor om ≤ B_step ^ 2 * T_clk := by
        intro N_hor om
        classical
        let S_act : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range N_hor).filter (fun n => om ∈ E_disp_mask n)
        have hQ_filter : Q_sum N_hor om = ∑ n ∈ S_act, ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2 := by
          dsimp only [Q_sum, S_act]
          rw [Finset.sum_filter]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
          by_cases hmem : om ∈ E_disp_mask n
          · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem, hmem, ↓reduceIte]
          · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem, hmem, ↓reduceIte, norm_zero, sq, zero_mul]
        rw [hQ_filter]
        by_cases h_ne : S_act.Nonempty
        · let n_last : ℕ := S_act.max' h_ne
          have hn_last_mem : n_last ∈ S_act := Finset.max'_mem S_act h_ne
          have hom_last : om ∈ E_disp_mask n_last := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn_last_mem).2
          obtain ⟨m, _, hm_last⟩ := hom_last
          have hS_sub : S_act ⊆ Finset.Icc m n_last := by
            intro n hn
            have hn_le_last : n ≤ n_last := Finset.le_max' S_act n hn
            obtain ⟨m', _, hm'_act⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
            have hm'_eq : m' = m := h_hit_unique om hm'_act.2.1 hm_last.2.1
            rw [hm'_eq] at hm'_act
            exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hm'_act.1, hn_le_last⟩
          have h_term_le : ∀ n ∈ S_act,
              ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2 ≤ B_step ^ 2 * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 := by
            intro n hn
            obtain ⟨m', _, hm'_act⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2
            have h1 := hStepCap om n j hm'_act.2.2.2.1 hm'_act.2.2.1
            have h2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg (Δ n om)) h1 2
            simpa only [mul_pow] using h2
          calc
            (∑ n ∈ S_act, ‖Δ n om‖ ^ 2)
              ≤ ∑ n ∈ S_act, B_step ^ 2 * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum h_term_le
            _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n_last, B_step ^ 2 * (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2 :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hS_sub fun _ _ _ => by positivity
            _ = B_step ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n_last, (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2 := by
                rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
            _ ≤ B_step ^ 2 * T_clk :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm_last.2.2.2.2 (sq_nonneg B_step)
        · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h_ne, Finset.sum_empty]
          positivity
      have hZ_markov : ∀ N_hor : ℕ,
          walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace | r_jump ^ 2 ≤ ‖Z_sum N_hor om‖ ^ 2} ≤
            B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2 := by
        intro N_hor
        obtain ⟨hZ_int, hZ_eq_Q⟩ := hStep.masked_impact_l2 j E_disp_mask N_hor hE_disp_dep
        have hQ_int_le : (∫ om, Q_sum N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ B_step ^ 2 * T_clk := by
          by_cases hQ_int : MeasureTheory.Integrable (Q_sum N_hor) walkMeasure
          · have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hQ_int
              (MeasureTheory.integrable_const (B_step ^ 2 * T_clk)) (hQ_pathwise N_hor)
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul] at h1
            exact h1
          · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_undef hQ_int]
            positivity
        have hZ_int_le : (∫ om, ‖Z_sum N_hor om‖ ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤ B_step ^ 2 * T_clk := by
          rw [hZ_eq_Q]
          exact hQ_int_le
        exact h_markov_le (fun om => ‖Z_sum N_hor om‖ ^ 2) (B_step ^ 2 * T_clk) (r_jump ^ 2)
          (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) hZ_int hZ_int_le (sq_pos_of_pos hr_pos)
      let B_disp : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N₀ =>
        {om : WalkSpace | ∀ N_hor ≥ N₀, r_jump ^ 2 ≤ ‖Z_sum N_hor om‖ ^ 2}
      have hB_disp_mono : Monotone B_disp := by
        intro N₁ N₂ hN om hom N_hor hN_hor
        exact hom N_hor (le_trans hN hN_hor)
      have hB_disp_le : ∀ N₀ : ℕ,
          walkMeasure.real (B_disp N₀) ≤ B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2 := by
        intro N₀
        have h_sub : B_disp N₀ ⊆ {om : WalkSpace | r_jump ^ 2 ≤ ‖Z_sum N₀ om‖ ^ 2} :=
          fun om hom => hom N₀ le_rfl
        exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub) (hZ_markov N₀)
      have h_union_disp : walkMeasure.real (⋃ N₀ : ℕ, B_disp N₀) ≤
          B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2 :=
        h_mono_iUnion B_disp (B_step ^ 2 * T_clk / r_jump ^ 2) (by positivity)
          hB_disp_mono hB_disp_le
      have h_sub_disp : E_disp_j j ⊆ ⋃ N₀ : ℕ, B_disp N₀ := by
        intro om ⟨m, K, hm_hit, hmK, h_hist_lt, h_hist_ge, h_geom_lt, h_clk_le, h_jump⟩
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨K, fun N_hor hN_hor => ?_⟩
        have h_iff_K : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
            om ∈ E_disp_mask n ↔ n ∈ Finset.Ico m K := by
          intro n _
          refine ⟨fun hmem => ?_, fun hn_ico => ?_⟩
          · obtain ⟨m', _, hm'_act⟩ := hmem
            have hm'_eq : m' = m := h_hit_unique om hm'_act.2.1 hm_hit
            rw [hm'_eq] at hm'_act
            refine Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hm'_act.1, ?_⟩
            by_contra hge
            have hK_le_n : K ≤ n := le_of_not_gt hge
            exact not_lt_of_ge (le_trans h_hist_ge (hMaxHist_mono om hK_le_n)) hm'_act.2.2.1
          · rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn_ico with ⟨hmn, hnK⟩
            have h_icc_sub : Finset.Icc m n ⊆ Finset.Ico m K :=
              fun k hk => Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).1,
                lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hk).2 hnK⟩
            have h_sum_le : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc m n, (ρ (walkPos ρ om k)) ^ 2 ≤ T_clk :=
              le_trans
                (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg h_icc_sub fun _ _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
                h_clk_le
            exact ⟨m, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmn), hmn, hm_hit,
              h_hist_lt n hnK, h_geom_lt n hnK, h_sum_le⟩
        have hZ_eq : Z_sum N_hor om =
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om K) -
              sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om m) := by
          dsimp only [Z_sum]
          rw [h_sum_ind_Ico E_disp_mask N_hor m K om Δ hN_hor h_iff_K]
          exact Finset.sum_Ico_sub
            (fun r => sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos ρ om r)) hmK
        rw [hZ_eq]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hr_pos.le h_jump 2
      exact le_trans (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_sub_disp)
        (le_trans h_union_disp h_rat_disp)

    have h_meas_disp_all :
        walkMeasure.real (⋃ j : Fin P.N, E_disp_j j) ≤
          4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M) := by
      calc
        walkMeasure.real (⋃ j : Fin P.N, E_disp_j j)
          ≤ ∑ j : Fin P.N, walkMeasure.real (E_disp_j j) :=
            MeasureTheory.measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le E_disp_j
        _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin P.N, (4 * Real.exp (-M)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => h_meas_disp_each j
        _ = (P.N : ℝ) * (4 * Real.exp (-M)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = 4 * (P.N : ℝ) * Real.exp (-M) := by ring

    have h_bad_sub :
        BadWall sgn ⊆ E_ret ∪ (E_clk ∪ ⋃ j : Fin P.N, E_disp_j j) := by
      intro om ⟨h_stop, h_geom, ⟨n₀, hn₀_lt, hn₀_wall⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨hτ₁_le_τ₂, hM_iff, h2M_iff, h2M_spec, ⟨j_star, hj_jump⟩⟩ :=
        hStopJump om h_stop
      set τ₁ := sliceStopTau S P ρ M om
      set τ₂ := sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om
      classical
      have h_wall_ex : ∃ n : ℕ, u (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ d_ph := ⟨n₀, hn₀_wall⟩
      let m : ℕ := Nat.find h_wall_ex
      have hm_le_n₀ : m ≤ n₀ := Nat.find_min' h_wall_ex hn₀_wall
      have hm_lt_τ₁ : m < τ₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt hm_le_n₀ hn₀_lt
      have hm_le_τ₂ : m ≤ τ₂ := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hm_lt_τ₁ hτ₁_le_τ₂)
      have hm_hit : isFirstHit om m :=
        ⟨Nat.find_spec h_wall_ex,
          fun l hl => lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min h_wall_ex hl),
          (hM_iff m).mp hm_lt_τ₁⟩
      by_cases h_ret : ∃ k ∈ Finset.Ico m τ₂, R_ph ≤ u (walkPos ρ om k)
      · obtain ⟨k, hk_ico, hk_R⟩ := h_ret
        rcases Finset.mem_Ico.mp hk_ico with ⟨hmk, hk_lt_τ₂⟩
        exact Or.inl ⟨m, k, hm_hit, hmk, (h2M_iff k).mp hk_lt_τ₂, hk_R⟩
      · by_cases h_clk : T_clk < ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico m τ₂, (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2
        · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨m, τ₂, hm_hit, hm_le_τ₂, ?_, h_clk⟩)
          intro n hn_ico
          have hn_lt_τ₂ : n < τ₂ := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hn_ico).2
          refine ⟨(h2M_iff n).mp hn_lt_τ₂, ?_⟩
          by_contra hge_R
          exact h_ret ⟨n, hn_ico, not_lt.mp hge_R⟩
        · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j_star, m, τ₂, hm_hit, hm_le_τ₂,
            fun n hn => (h2M_iff n).mp hn, h2M_spec,
            fun n hn => h_geom n (le_of_lt hn),
            le_of_not_gt h_clk, hj_jump m hm_lt_τ₁⟩))

    have h_mono_bad :=
      MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_bad_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
    have h_u1 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) E_ret
      (E_clk ∪ ⋃ j : Fin P.N, E_disp_j j)
    have h_u2 := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure) E_clk
      (⋃ j : Fin P.N, E_disp_j j)
    linarith

  have h_target_sub :
      {om : WalkSpace |
        (∃ m : ℕ, 2 * M ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
          (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m)) ∧
        (∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P ρ (2 * M) om,
          sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ 2 * M) ∧
        ∃ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M om,
          slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ≤ Real.exp (-4 * (C₁ + 4) * M)} ⊆
      BadWall 1 ∪ BadWall (-1) := by
    intro om ⟨h_stop, h_geom, ⟨n, hn_lt, hn_pd⟩⟩
    by_cases him : 0 ≤ (walkPos ρ om n).im
    · left
      refine ⟨h_stop, h_geom, ⟨n, hn_lt, ?_⟩⟩
      unfold phClkWallDist
      unfold slicePhaseDepth at hn_pd
      rw [abs_of_nonneg him] at hn_pd
      dsimp only [d_ph]
      linarith
    · right
      refine ⟨h_stop, h_geom, ⟨n, hn_lt, ?_⟩⟩
      unfold phClkWallDist
      unfold slicePhaseDepth at hn_pd
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge him)] at hn_pd
      dsimp only [d_ph]
      linarith

  have h_w1 := hWallBound 1 (Or.inl rfl)
  have h_wm1 := hWallBound (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
  have h_mono_target :=
    MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_target_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _)
  have h_u_walls := MeasureTheory.measureReal_union_le (μ := walkMeasure)
    (BadWall 1) (BadWall (-1))
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (M_stop ε B_clk : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hStep : PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ)
    (hε_pos : 0 < ε) (hε_le : ε ≤ 1) (hB_pos : 0 < B_clk) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∀ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om,
        ε ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n)) ∧
      B_clk < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om),
        (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2} ≤
      32 * (Real.log (sliceHeight S P.N + 1) - Real.log ε) / B_clk

signature.name: truncated_phase_clock_convex_barrier
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (M_stop ε B_clk : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ → ℝ)
    (hStep : PhClkStepToolkitProp S P ρ)
    (hε_pos : 0 < ε) (hε_le : ε ≤ 1) (hB_pos : 0 < B_clk) :
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∀ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om,
        ε ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n)) ∧
      B_clk < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om),
        (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
          (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2} ≤
      32 * (Real.log (sliceHeight S P.N + 1) - Real.log ε) / B_clk

proof.tactics:
by
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure walkMeasure := hStep.prob_walk
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S P.N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    let om₀ : WalkSpace := fun _ => 0
    have h0_pos : 0 < slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om₀ 0) :=
      (hStep.reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step _ (hStep.walk_in_reg om₀ 0)).1
    simpa [h, slicePhaseDepth, walkPos, Complex.ofReal_im] using h0_pos
  let C_bar : ℝ := Real.log (h + 1) - Real.log ε
  let B_target : ℝ := 32 * C_bar / B_clk
  have h_log_h1_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (h + 1) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [hh_pos])
  have h_log_ε_np : Real.log ε ≤ 0 := Real.log_nonpos hε_pos.le hε_le
  have hC_bar_nn : 0 ≤ C_bar := by dsimp only [C_bar]; linarith
  have hB_target_nn : 0 ≤ B_target :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC_bar_nn) hB_pos.le
  have h_quad_log : ∀ u : ℝ, |u| ≤ 1 / 5 → (1 / 4 : ℝ) * u ^ 2 ≤ -Real.log (1 - u) - u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_lt1 : |u| < 1 := by linarith
    have h_one_sub_pos : 0 < 1 - |u| := by linarith
    have h_tay := Real.abs_log_sub_add_sum_range_le hu_lt1 2
    have h_sum_eq : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 2, u ^ (i + 1) / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) = u + u ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_sum_eq] at h_tay
    have h_le_abs : u + u ^ 2 / 2 + Real.log (1 - u) ≤ |u| ^ 3 / (1 - |u|) :=
      le_trans (le_abs_self _) h_tay
    have h_rem_le : |u| ^ 3 / (1 - |u|) ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * u ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ h_one_sub_pos]
      have h_abs3 : |u| ^ 3 = u ^ 2 * |u| := by
        calc
          |u| ^ 3 = |u| ^ 2 * |u| := by ring
          _ = u ^ 2 * |u| := by rw [sq_abs]
      rw [h_abs3]
      have h_4u : |u| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 - |u|) := by linarith
      have hu2_nn : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 := sq_nonneg u
      calc
        u ^ 2 * |u| ≤ u ^ 2 * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 - |u|)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_4u hu2_nn
        _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * u ^ 2 * (1 - |u|) := by ring
    linarith
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := phClkConvexBarrier h ε
  have hψ_cont : ContinuousOn ψ (Set.Icc (-h) h) := by
    dsimp only [ψ, phClkConvexBarrier]
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => h + ε - v) (Set.Icc (-h) h) :=
      continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun v : ℝ => h + ε + v) (Set.Icc (-h) h) :=
      continuousOn_const.add continuousOn_id
    have h1_ne : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h, h + ε - v ≠ 0 :=
      fun v hv => by linarith [hv.1, hv.2, hε_pos]
    have h2_ne : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h, h + ε + v ≠ 0 :=
      fun v hv => by linarith [hv.1, hv.2, hε_pos]
    exact ((h1.log h1_ne).neg.sub (h2.log h2_ne)).add continuousOn_const
  have hψ_zero : ψ 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp only [ψ, phClkConvexBarrier]
    simp only [sub_zero, add_zero]
    ring
  have hψ_upper : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (-h) h, ψ v ≤ C_bar := by
    intro v ⟨hv_lo, hv_hi⟩
    dsimp only [ψ, phClkConvexBarrier, C_bar]
    have h_he_pos : 0 < h + ε := by linarith
    have h_sub_pos : 0 < h + ε - v := by linarith
    have h_add_pos : 0 < h + ε + v := by linarith
    have h_prod_le : ε * (h + ε) ≤ (h + ε - v) * (h + ε + v) := by
      have h_id : (h + ε - v) * (h + ε + v) - ε * (h + ε) = (h - v) * (h + v) + h * ε := by ring
      have h_hv_nn : 0 ≤ (h - v) * (h + v) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h_he_mul : 0 < h * ε := mul_pos hh_pos hε_pos
      linarith
    have h_log_prod :
        Real.log ε + Real.log (h + ε) ≤ Real.log (h + ε - v) + Real.log (h + ε + v) := by
      rw [← Real.log_mul hε_pos.ne' h_he_pos.ne', ← Real.log_mul h_sub_pos.ne' h_add_pos.ne']
      exact Real.log_le_log (mul_pos hε_pos h_he_pos) h_prod_le
    have h_log_he_le : Real.log (h + ε) ≤ Real.log (h + 1) :=
      Real.log_le_log h_he_pos (by linarith)
    linarith
  let L : ℂ → ℝ := fun y => (h + ε - y.im)⁻¹ - (h + ε + y.im)⁻¹
  let q_1d : ℝ → ℝ := (Set.Ici ε).indicator (fun r : ℝ => (1 / 32 : ℝ) * r⁻¹ ^ 2)
  let q : ℂ → ℝ := fun y => q_1d (slicePhaseDepth S P y)
  let B_q : ℝ := (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ε⁻¹ ^ 2
  have hq1d_meas : Measurable q_1d :=
    (measurable_const.mul (measurable_id.inv.pow_const 2)).indicator measurableSet_Ici
  have hq_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => q (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
    intro n
    have h_depth_meas : Measurable (fun om : WalkSpace => slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n)) := by
      unfold slicePhaseDepth
      exact measurable_const.sub (continuous_abs.measurable.comp (hStep.measurable_im n))
    exact hq1d_meas.comp h_depth_meas
  have hq_nonneg_all : ∀ y : ℂ, 0 ≤ q y :=
    fun _ => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => by positivity) _
  have hq_bounds : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, 0 ≤ q y ∧ q y ≤ B_q := by
    intro y _hy
    refine ⟨hq_nonneg_all y, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [q, q_1d, B_q]
    by_cases hr : slicePhaseDepth S P y ∈ Set.Ici ε
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
      have hr_ge : ε ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P y := hr
      have h_inv_le : (slicePhaseDepth S P y)⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ hε_pos hr_ge
      have h_inv_nn : 0 ≤ (slicePhaseDepth S P y)⁻¹ :=
        inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans hε_pos.le hr_ge)
      have h_sq_le : (slicePhaseDepth S P y)⁻¹ ^ 2 ≤ ε⁻¹ ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ h_inv_nn h_inv_le 2
      linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
      positivity
  have h_step_ineq : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all, ∀ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ ρ y →
      L y * δ + 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ ψ (y.im + δ) - ψ y.im := by
    intro y hy δ hδ
    obtain ⟨hr_pos, hρ_le⟩ := hStep.reg_phase_depth_pos_and_step y hy
    let v : ℝ := y.im
    let r_y : ℝ := slicePhaseDepth S P y
    change 0 < r_y at hr_pos
    have hδ_le : |δ| ≤ (1 / 100 : ℝ) * r_y := le_trans hδ hρ_le
    have hr_def : r_y = h - |v| := rfl
    let Dp : ℝ := h + ε - v
    let Dm : ℝ := h + ε + v
    have hDp_def : Dp = h + ε - v := rfl
    have hDm_def : Dm = h + ε + v := rfl
    have hDp_ge : r_y + ε ≤ Dp := by linarith [hr_def, hDp_def, le_abs_self v]
    have hDm_ge : r_y + ε ≤ Dm := by linarith [hr_def, hDm_def, neg_le_abs v]
    have hDp_pos : 0 < Dp := by linarith
    have hDm_pos : 0 < Dm := by linarith
    let up : ℝ := δ / Dp
    let um : ℝ := -δ / Dm
    have hup_abs : |up| ≤ 1 / 5 := by
      dsimp only [up]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hDp_pos, div_le_iff₀ hDp_pos]
      linarith
    have hum_abs : |um| ≤ 1 / 5 := by
      dsimp only [um]
      rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hDm_pos, div_le_iff₀ hDm_pos]
      linarith
    have h1_up_pos : 0 < 1 - up := by linarith [le_abs_self up, hup_abs]
    have h1_um_pos : 0 < 1 - um := by linarith [le_abs_self um, hum_abs]
    have h_fac_p : h + ε - (v + δ) = Dp * (1 - up) := by
      have h_mul_div : Dp * up = δ := mul_div_cancel₀ δ hDp_pos.ne'
      calc
        h + ε - (v + δ) = Dp - Dp * up := by rw [h_mul_div]; dsimp only [Dp]; ring
        _ = Dp * (1 - up) := by ring
    have h_fac_m : h + ε + (v + δ) = Dm * (1 - um) := by
      have h_mul_div : Dm * um = -δ := mul_div_cancel₀ (-δ) hDm_pos.ne'
      calc
        h + ε + (v + δ) = Dm - Dm * um := by rw [h_mul_div]; dsimp only [Dm]; ring
        _ = Dm * (1 - um) := by ring
    have h_diff_ψ : ψ (v + δ) - ψ v = -Real.log (1 - up) - Real.log (1 - um) := by
      dsimp only [ψ, phClkConvexBarrier]
      rw [h_fac_p, h_fac_m,
        Real.log_mul hDp_pos.ne' h1_up_pos.ne',
        Real.log_mul hDm_pos.ne' h1_um_pos.ne']
      dsimp only [Dp, Dm]
      ring
    have h_L_eq : L y * δ = up + um := by
      dsimp only [L, v, up, um, Dp, Dm]
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    have h_qp := h_quad_log up hup_abs
    have h_qm := h_quad_log um hum_abs
    have h_u_lower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * up ^ 2 + (1 / 4 : ℝ) * um ^ 2 := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 v with hv0 | hv0
      · have hDp_eq : Dp = r_y + ε := by
          rw [hDp_def, hr_def, abs_of_nonneg hv0]
          ring
        have hup_sq : up ^ 2 = (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 := by
          dsimp only [up]
          rw [hDp_eq, div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
        have hum_nn : 0 ≤ um ^ 2 := sq_nonneg um
        rw [hup_sq]
        linarith
      · have hDm_eq : Dm = r_y + ε := by
          rw [hDm_def, hr_def, abs_of_neg hv0]
          ring
        have hum_sq : um ^ 2 = (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 := by
          dsimp only [um]
          rw [hDm_eq, div_eq_mul_inv]
          ring
        have hup_nn : 0 ≤ up ^ 2 := sq_nonneg up
        rw [hum_sq]
        linarith
    have h_q_le : 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2 := by
      change 2 * (Set.Ici ε).indicator (fun r : ℝ => (1 / 32 : ℝ) * r⁻¹ ^ 2) r_y * δ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 * δ ^ 2
      by_cases hr : r_y ∈ Set.Ici ε
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
        have hr_ge : ε ≤ r_y := hr
        have h_re_pos : 0 < r_y + ε := by linarith
        have h_re_le : r_y + ε ≤ 2 * r_y := by linarith
        have h_inv : (2 * r_y)⁻¹ ≤ (r_y + ε)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ h_re_pos h_re_le
        have h_2r_inv_eq : (2 * r_y)⁻¹ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹ := by
          have h_2r_ne : 2 * r_y ≠ 0 := by positivity
          apply mul_left_cancel₀ h_2r_ne
          rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h_2r_ne]
          calc
            1 = r_y * r_y⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ hr_pos.ne').symm
            _ = (2 * r_y) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹) := by ring
        rw [h_2r_inv_eq] at h_inv
        have h_half_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹ := by positivity
        have h_sq_inv : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ (r_y + ε)⁻¹ ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ h_half_nn h_inv 2
        have h_sq_lhs : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹) ^ 2 = (1 / 4 : ℝ) * r_y⁻¹ ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [h_sq_lhs] at h_sq_inv
        have h_δ2_nn : 0 ≤ δ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg δ
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq_inv h_δ2_nn
        linarith
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
        simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul]
        positivity
    change L y * δ + 2 * q y * δ ^ 2 ≤ ψ (v + δ) - ψ v
    linarith
  have h_drift_pkg := fun n : ℕ =>
    hStep.imag_step_lower_drift n ψ L q B_q hψ_cont (hq_meas n) hq_bounds h_step_ineq
  let S_q : ℕ → WalkSpace → ℝ := fun N_hor om =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2
  let A : ℕ → Set WalkSpace := fun N_hor =>
    {om : WalkSpace | (1 / 32 : ℝ) * B_clk ≤ S_q N_hor om}
  have hA_bound : ∀ N_hor : ℕ, walkMeasure.real (A N_hor) ≤ B_target := by
    intro N_hor
    have h_int_Sq : MeasureTheory.Integrable (S_q N_hor) walkMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor)
        (fun n _ => (h_drift_pkg n).1)
    have h_int_sum_eq :
        (∫ om, S_q N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) =
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
            ∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum (Finset.range N_hor)
        (fun n _ => (h_drift_pkg n).1)
    have h_sum_tele :
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
          ∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure) ≤
          (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om N_hor).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
            (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om 0).im) ∂walkMeasure) := by
      calc
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
            ∫ om, q (walkPos ρ om n) * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 ∂walkMeasure)
          ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N_hor,
              ((∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om (n + 1)).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
                (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om n).im) ∂walkMeasure)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun n _ => (h_drift_pkg n).2.2.2
        _ = (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om N_hor).im) ∂walkMeasure) -
              (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om 0).im) ∂walkMeasure) :=
            Finset.sum_range_sub (fun k => ∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om k).im) ∂walkMeasure) N_hor
    have h_init_zero : (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om 0).im) ∂walkMeasure) = 0 := by
      have h_fn_zero : (fun om : WalkSpace => ψ ((walkPos ρ om 0).im)) = fun _ => 0 := by
        ext om
        simp only [walkPos, Complex.ofReal_im, hψ_zero]
      simp [h_fn_zero]
    have h_term_le : (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om N_hor).im) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_bar := by
      have h_ptwise : ∀ om : WalkSpace, ψ ((walkPos ρ om N_hor).im) ≤ C_bar := by
        intro om
        have h_im_lt : |(walkPos ρ om N_hor).im| < h := (hStep.walk_in_reg om N_hor).1
        exact hψ_upper _ (abs_le.mp (le_of_lt h_im_lt))
      calc
        (∫ om, ψ ((walkPos ρ om N_hor).im) ∂walkMeasure)
          ≤ ∫ _om, C_bar ∂walkMeasure :=
            MeasureTheory.integral_mono (h_drift_pkg N_hor).2.1
              (MeasureTheory.integrable_const C_bar) h_ptwise
        _ = C_bar := by
            rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const, MeasureTheory.probReal_univ, one_smul]
    have h_int_le : (∫ om, S_q N_hor om ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_bar := by
      linarith
    have h_Sq_nn : 0 ≤ᵐ[walkMeasure] S_q N_hor :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun om =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun n _ =>
          mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg_all _) (sq_nonneg _)
    have h_markov :
        ((1 / 32 : ℝ) * B_clk) * walkMeasure.real (A N_hor) ≤
          ∫ om, S_q N_hor om ∂walkMeasure :=
      MeasureTheory.mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg h_Sq_nn h_int_Sq ((1 / 32 : ℝ) * B_clk)
    have h_mul_le : ((1 / 32 : ℝ) * B_clk) * walkMeasure.real (A N_hor) ≤ C_bar :=
      le_trans h_markov h_int_le
    dsimp only [B_target]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hB_pos]
    linarith
  have hA_mono : Monotone A := by
    intro N₁ N₂ hN₁₂ om hom
    exact le_trans hom (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hN₁₂)
      fun n _ _ => mul_nonneg (hq_nonneg_all _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have h_union_le : walkMeasure.real (⋃ N_hor : ℕ, A N_hor) ≤ B_target := by
    have h_enn : walkMeasure (⋃ N_hor : ℕ, A N_hor) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B_target := by
      rw [hA_mono.measure_iUnion]
      refine iSup_le fun N_hor => ?_
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure (A N_hor))]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hA_bound N_hor)
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ← ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hB_target_nn]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top h_enn
  have h_lhs_sub :
      {om : WalkSpace |
        (∀ n < sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om,
          ε ≤ slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n)) ∧
        B_clk < ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om),
          (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 *
            (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2} ⊆
        ⋃ N_hor : ℕ, A N_hor := by
    intro om ⟨h_depth, h_sum⟩
    let τ : ℕ := sliceStopTau S P ρ M_stop om
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨τ, ?_⟩
    change (1 / 32 : ℝ) * B_clk ≤ S_q τ om
    have h_Sq_eq : S_q τ om = (1 / 32 : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range τ,
        (slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n))⁻¹ ^ 2 * (ρ (walkPos ρ om n)) ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [S_q, q, q_1d]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      have hn_lt : n < τ := Finset.mem_range.mp hn
      have hr_mem : slicePhaseDepth S P (walkPos ρ om n) ∈ Set.Ici ε := h_depth n hn_lt
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr_mem, mul_assoc]
    dsimp only [τ] at h_Sq_eq ⊢
    rw [h_Sq_eq]
    linarith
  exact le_trans
    (MeasureTheory.measureReal_mono h_lhs_sub (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top walkMeasure _))
    h_union_le

signature.name: cleared_reflection_tube_and_partials
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hChord : OddSliceChordProp S) (x_star : ℝ)
    (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star) :
    ClearedReflectionArcProp S x_star A

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_open_H : IsOpen (horizStrip S.H) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const
  let B_refl : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun ψ u0 u1 v0 v1 =>
    (u0 * Complex.cos ψ + u1 * Complex.sin ψ) * (-v0 * Complex.sin ψ + v1 * Complex.cos ψ) +
      (-u0 * Complex.sin ψ + u1 * Complex.cos ψ) * (v0 * Complex.cos ψ + v1 * Complex.sin ψ)
  have hB_tan : ∀ (ψ a b α β : ℂ),
      B_refl ψ (-a * Complex.sin α) (a * Complex.cos α) (-b * Complex.sin β) (b * Complex.cos β) =
        -a * b * Complex.sin (α + β - 2 * ψ) := by
    intro ψ a b α β
    dsimp only [B_refl]
    have h_ang : α + β - 2 * ψ = (α - ψ) + (β - ψ) := by ring
    rw [h_ang, Complex.sin_add (α - ψ) (β - ψ),
      Complex.sin_sub α ψ, Complex.cos_sub α ψ,
      Complex.sin_sub β ψ, Complex.cos_sub β ψ]
    ring
  have hE_eq_B : ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      clearedReflectE S s_m s_0 s_p =
        B_refl (S.ϕ s_0)
          (S.f s_m * holoScaledPos S s_0 0 - S.f s_0 * holoScaledPos S s_m 0)
          (S.f s_m * holoScaledPos S s_0 1 - S.f s_0 * holoScaledPos S s_m 1)
          (S.f s_0 * holoScaledPos S s_p 0 - S.f s_p * holoScaledPos S s_0 0)
          (S.f s_0 * holoScaledPos S s_p 1 - S.f s_p * holoScaledPos S s_0 1) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hE_holo : ∀ {U : Set ℂ} {gm g0 gp : ℂ → ℂ},
      DifferentiableOn ℂ gm U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g0 U → DifferentiableOn ℂ gp U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, gm z ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, g0 z ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, gp z ∈ horizStrip S.H) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => clearedReflectE S (gm z) (g0 z) (gp z)) U := by
    intro U gm g0 gp hgm hg0 hgp hgm_in hg0_in hgp_in
    unfold clearedReflectE
    have hfm : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.f (gm z)) U := S.f_holo.comp hgm hgm_in
    have hf0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.f (g0 z)) U := S.f_holo.comp hg0 hg0_in
    have hfp : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.f (gp z)) U := S.f_holo.comp hgp hgp_in
    have hKm0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (gm z) 0) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 0).comp hgm hgm_in
    have hKm1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (gm z) 1) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 1).comp hgm hgm_in
    have hK00 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (g0 z) 0) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 0).comp hg0 hg0_in
    have hK01 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (g0 z) 1) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 1).comp hg0 hg0_in
    have hKp0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (gp z) 0) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 0).comp hgp hgp_in
    have hKp1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => holoScaledPos S (gp z) 1) U :=
      (hChord.holoScaledPos_holo 1).comp hgp hgp_in
    have hϕ0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => S.ϕ (g0 z)) U := S.ϕ_holo.comp hg0 hg0_in
    have hc0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.cos (S.ϕ (g0 z))) U :=
      Complex.differentiable_cos.comp_differentiableOn hϕ0
    have hsn0 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.sin (S.ϕ (g0 z))) U :=
      Complex.differentiable_sin.comp_differentiableOn hϕ0
    have hdm0 := (hfm.mul hK00).sub (hf0.mul hKm0)
    have hdm1 := (hfm.mul hK01).sub (hf0.mul hKm1)
    have hdp0 := (hf0.mul hKp0).sub (hfp.mul hK00)
    have hdp1 := (hf0.mul hKp1).sub (hfp.mul hK01)
    exact (((hdm0.mul hc0).add (hdm1.mul hsn0)).mul ((hdp0.neg.mul hsn0).add (hdp1.mul hc0))).add
      (((hdm0.neg.mul hsn0).add (hdm1.mul hc0)).mul ((hdp0.mul hc0).add (hdp1.mul hsn0)))
  
  have h_analytic : ∀ s_m s_0 s_p : ℂ,
      s_m ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_0 ∈ horizStrip S.H → s_p ∈ horizStrip S.H →
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => clearedReflectE S p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)
        ((s_m, s_0), s_p) := by
    intro s_m s_0 s_p hsm hs0 hsp
    unfold clearedReflectE
    let p₀ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ := ((s_m, s_0), s_p)
    let π₁ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ)
    let π₂ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ)
    let π₃ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ
    have hfm : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun p : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => S.f p.1.1) p₀ :=
      (S.f_holo.analyticAt (h_open_H.mem_nhds hsm)).comp (π₁.analyticAt p₀)

      rw [hChord.holoScaledPos_eq z hz_in hfz i, hChord.holoScaledPos_eq a ha hfa i]

      have h1 := hΓ0_diff.hasDerivAt

        ((S.c : ℂ) * (S.f z₀)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (S.ϕ z₀)) z₀ := by
