      let bm : ℂ := (S.c : ℂ) * S.f s0 / S.f sm
      let qm : ℂ := deriv S.f sm / S.f sm
      have hdm0_fun : (fun w => S.f w * holoScaledPos S s0 0 - S.f s0 * holoScaledPos S w 0) =
          fun w => -D_vec s0 w 0 := by
        funext w; dsimp [D_vec]; ring
      have hdm1_fun : (fun w => S.f w * holoScaledPos S s0 1 - S.f s0 * holoScaledPos S w 1) =
          fun w => -D_vec s0 w 1 := by
        funext w; dsimp [D_vec]; ring
      have hdm0_hd :
          HasDerivAt (fun w => S.f w * holoScaledPos S s0 0 - S.f s0 * holoScaledPos S w 0)
            (qm * dm0 + bm * Complex.sin (S.ϕ sm)) sm := by
        rw [hdm0_fun]
        convert hd0_sm.neg using 1
        dsimp [qm, bm, dm0, D_vec]
        ring
      have hdm1_hd :
          HasDerivAt (fun w => S.f w * holoScaledPos S s0 1 - S.f s0 * holoScaledPos S w 1)
            (qm * dm1 - bm * Complex.cos (S.ϕ sm)) sm := by
        rw [hdm1_fun]
        convert hd1_sm.neg using 1
        dsimp [qm, bm, dm1, D_vec]
        ring
      have hd_fun_m :
          HasDerivAt (fun w => clearedReflectE S w s0 sp)
            (((qm * dm0 + bm * Complex.sin (S.ϕ sm)) * c0 +
                (qm * dm1 - bm * Complex.cos (S.ϕ sm)) * sn0) *
                (-dp0 * sn0 + dp1 * c0) +
              (-(qm * dm0 + bm * Complex.sin (S.ϕ sm)) * sn0 +
                (qm * dm1 - bm * Complex.cos (S.ϕ sm)) * c0) *
                (dp0 * c0 + dp1 * sn0)) sm := by
        have h_term1 := ((hdm0_hd.mul (hasDerivAt_const sm c0)).add
          (hdm1_hd.mul (hasDerivAt_const sm sn0))).mul
          (hasDerivAt_const sm (-dp0 * sn0 + dp1 * c0))
        have h_term2 := ((hdm0_hd.neg.mul (hasDerivAt_const sm sn0)).add
          (hdm1_hd.mul (hasDerivAt_const sm c0))).mul
          (hasDerivAt_const sm (dp0 * c0 + dp1 * sn0))
        have h_raw : HasDerivAt (fun w => clearedReflectE S w s0 sp) _ sm :=
          (h_term1.add h_term2).congr_of_eventuallyEq
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => rfl)
        convert h_raw using 1
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
        ring
      have hd_val_m :
          deriv (fun w => clearedReflectE S w s0 sp) sm =
            -bm * ℓ_ext j y * Complex.sin (stateD0 S (A.s_ext y) jm) := by
        rw [hd_fun_m.deriv]
        have h_split :
            (((qm * dm0 + bm * Complex.sin (S.ϕ sm)) * c0 +
                (qm * dm1 - bm * Complex.cos (S.ϕ sm)) * sn0) *
                (-dp0 * sn0 + dp1 * c0) +
              (-(qm * dm0 + bm * Complex.sin (S.ϕ sm)) * sn0 +
                (qm * dm1 - bm * Complex.cos (S.ϕ sm)) * c0) *
                (dp0 * c0 + dp1 * sn0)) =
            qm * clearedReflectE S sm s0 sp +
              B_refl (ψ_ext j y) (-(-bm) * Complex.sin (ψ_ext jm y))
                ((-bm) * Complex.cos (ψ_ext jm y)) dp0 dp1 := by
          dsimp [clearedReflectE, B_refl, dm0, dm1, dp0, dp1, D_vec, c0, sn0, ψ_ext, s0, sm]
          ring
        rw [h_split, hE0, mul_zero, zero_add, hdp0_Δ, hdp1_Δ,
          h_id1_0 j y hy, h_id1_1 j y hy]
        rw [hB_tan (ψ_ext j y) (-bm) (ℓ_ext j y) (ψ_ext jm y) (θ_ext j y)]
        have h_id2_j := h_id2 j y hy
        have h_ang_eq :
            ψ_ext jm y + θ_ext j y - 2 * ψ_ext j y =
              -stateD0 S (A.s_ext y) jm + c_wrap j := by
          dsimp [stateD0, θ_ext, ψ_ext]
          linear_combination h_id2_j
        rw [h_ang_eq, h_sin_wrap_add (-stateD0 S (A.s_ext y) jm) j, Complex.sin_neg]
        ring
      change deriv (fun w => clearedReflectE S w s0 sp) sm ≠ 0
      rw [hd_val_m]
      have hbm_ne : bm ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hc_ne hf0) hfm
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hbm_ne) (A.s_ext_chord_ne y hy j))
        (A.s_ext_sin_ne y hy jm)
  exact {
    analytic_at_strip := h_analytic
    periodic_m := h_per_m
    periodic_0 := h_per_0
    periodic_p := h_per_p
    subheight_tube_vanish := h_subheight_tube
    arc_vanish := h_arc_vanish
    arc_partials_ne_zero := h_arc_partials
  }

informal_problem.statement:

    (hRefl : ClearedReflectionArcProp S x_star A) :

signature.name: cyclic_ift_conjugated_return_map
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (x_star : ℝ) (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star)
    (hRefl : ClearedReflectionArcProp S x_star A) :
    Nonempty (ConjugatedReturnMapArcData S x_star A)

proof.tactics:
by
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let inst : NeZero N := oddSliceNeZero S
  have hN : 3 ≤ N := by dsimp [N, oddSliceN]; omega
  have hN_ne_C : (N : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN)
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  have hNt0 : (N : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    dsimp [t₀, sliceParamT0]
    push_cast
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ _ hN_ne_C
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    have h1 := A.δ_arc_pos
    have h2 := A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    dsimp [h, N] at *
    linarith
  let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hy_star_arc : y_star ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := Metric.mem_ball_self A.δ_arc_pos

  
  let f0 : ℂ → ℂ := arcS0 S A
  let f1 : ℂ → ℂ := arcS1 S A
  have hf0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f0 (Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc) :=
    A.s_ext_holo ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
  have hf1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f1 (Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc) :=
    A.s_ext_holo ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
  have hf0_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc, deriv f0 u ≠ 0 :=
    fun u hu => A.s_ext_deriv_ne u hu ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
  have hf0_an : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc, AnalyticAt ℂ f0 u :=
    fun u hu => hf0_holo.analyticAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu)
  let hf0_strict := fun (u : ℂ) (hu : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc) =>
    (hf0_an u hu).hasStrictDerivAt.hasStrictFDerivAt_equiv (hf0_deriv u hu)
  let φ0 : OpenPartialHomeomorph ℂ ℂ := (hf0_strict y_star hy_star_arc).toOpenPartialHomeomorph f0
  have hφ0_coe : (φ0 : ℂ → ℂ) = f0 := (hf0_strict y_star hy_star_arc).toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
  have hy_src0 : y_star ∈ φ0.source :=
    (hf0_strict y_star hy_star_arc).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  obtain ⟨r_src0, hr_src0_pos, hr_src0_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp φ0.open_source y_star hy_src0
  let δ_chart : ℝ := min A.δ_arc r_src0
  have hδ_chart_pos : 0 < δ_chart := lt_min A.δ_arc_pos hr_src0_pos
  have hδ_chart_le : δ_chart ≤ A.δ_arc := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_chart_sub_arc : Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ⊆ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_chart_le
  have hδ_chart_sub_src : Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ⊆ φ0.source :=
    Subset.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)) hr_src0_sub
  let s0_inv : ℂ → ℂ := φ0.symm
  have hs0_open_map : ∀ U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U → U ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart → IsOpen (f0 '' U) := by
    intro U hU_open hU_sub
    have h_open := φ0.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hU_open (Subset.trans hU_sub hδ_chart_sub_src)
    rwa [hφ0_coe] at h_open
  have hs0_left_inv_chart : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart, s0_inv (f0 u) = u := by
    intro u hu
    have h_left := φ0.left_inv (hδ_chart_sub_src hu)
    have h_eq : φ0 u = f0 u := congrFun hφ0_coe u
    rwa [h_eq] at h_left
  have hs0_right_inv_on : ∀ {S₀ : Set ℂ}, S₀ ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart →
      ∀ w ∈ f0 '' S₀, s0_inv w ∈ S₀ ∧ f0 (s0_inv w) = w := by
    intro S₀ hS₀ w hw
    rcases hw with ⟨u, hu_S₀, rfl⟩
    have h_eq := hs0_left_inv_chart u (hS₀ hu_S₀)
    exact ⟨h_eq.symm ▸ hu_S₀, congrArg f0 h_eq⟩
  have hs0_inv_diffAt : ∀ w ∈ f0 '' Metric.ball y_star δ_chart, DifferentiableAt ℂ s0_inv w := by
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hu_R : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := hδ_chart_sub_arc hu
    have hu_src : u ∈ φ0.source := hδ_chart_sub_src hu
    let e_u : ℂ ≃L[ℂ] ℂ :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut ℂ (Units.mk0 (deriv f0 u) (hf0_deriv u hu_R))
    have hφ0_an_u : AnalyticAt ℂ (φ0 : ℂ → ℂ) u := by rw [hφ0_coe]; exact hf0_an u hu_R
    have hφ0_fderiv_u : fderiv ℂ (φ0 : ℂ → ℂ) u = (e_u : ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) := by
      rw [hφ0_coe]; exact (hf0_strict u hu_R).hasFDerivAt.fderiv
    have h_symm_an : AnalyticAt ℂ φ0.symm (φ0 u) :=
      φ0.analyticAt_symm' hu_src hφ0_an_u hφ0_fderiv_u
    have h_eq : φ0 u = f0 u := congrFun hφ0_coe u
    rw [h_eq] at h_symm_an
    exact h_symm_an.differentiableAt
  have hs0_inv_holo_chart : DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_inv (f0 '' Metric.ball y_star δ_chart) :=
    fun w hw => (hs0_inv_diffAt w hw).differentiableWithinAt

  
  have h_ift_polydisk : ∀ (G : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ) (p₀ : ℂ × ℂ) (w₀ : ℂ),
      AnalyticAt ℂ G (p₀, w₀) → G (p₀, w₀) = 0 → deriv (fun w => G (p₀, w)) w₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (r_p r_w : ℝ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_p ∧ r_p ≤ r_w ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball p₀ r_p) ∧
        g p₀ = w₀ ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r_p,
          g p ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r_w ∧
          G (p, g p) = 0 ∧
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r_w, G (p, w) = 0 → w = g p) := by
    intro G p₀ w₀ hG_an hG0 hG_part
    let α : ℂ := deriv (fun w => G (p₀, w)) w₀
    have hα : α ≠ 0 := hG_part
    let D : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := fderiv ℂ G (p₀, w₀)
    have hG_strict : HasStrictFDerivAt G D (p₀, w₀) := hG_an.hasStrictFDerivAt
    have h_ι_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (p₀, w)) ((0, 0), 1) w₀ :=
      (hasDerivAt_const w₀ p₀).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id w₀)
    have hD_unit : D ((0, 0), 1) = α :=
      (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt w₀ hG_strict.hasFDerivAt h_ι_deriv).deriv.symm
    have hD_decomp : ∀ (δp : ℂ × ℂ) (δw : ℂ), D (δp, δw) = D (δp, 0) + δw * α := by
      intro δp δw
      have hq : (δp, δw) = (δp, (0 : ℂ)) + δw • (((0 : ℂ), (0 : ℂ)), (1 : ℂ)) := by
        ext <;> simp
      rw [hq, map_add, map_smul, hD_unit, smul_eq_mul]
    let π₁ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] (ℂ × ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ
    let π₂ : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ
    let ι₁ : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) := ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ
    let L_fwd : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) := π₁.prod D
    let L_bwd : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      π₁.prod (α⁻¹ • (π₂ - D.comp (ι₁.comp π₁)))
    have hL_left : Function.LeftInverse L_bwd L_fwd := by
      rintro ⟨δp, δw⟩
      ext
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · change α⁻¹ * (D (δp, δw) - D (δp, 0)) = δw
        rw [hD_decomp δp δw]
        field_simp [hα]
        ring
    have hL_right : Function.RightInverse L_bwd L_fwd := by
      rintro ⟨δp, δζ⟩
      ext
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · change D (δp, α⁻¹ * (δζ - D (δp, 0))) = δζ
        rw [hD_decomp δp (α⁻¹ * (δζ - D (δp, 0)))]
        field_simp [hα]
        ring
    let e : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ≃L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse L_fwd L_bwd hL_left hL_right
    let Ψ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ := fun q => (q.1, G q)
    have hΨ_strict : HasStrictFDerivAt Ψ (e : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)) (p₀, w₀) :=
      (π₁.hasStrictFDerivAt).prodMk hG_strict
    have hΨ_an : AnalyticAt ℂ Ψ (p₀, w₀) := (π₁.analyticAt (p₀, w₀)).prod hG_an
    let ℋ : OpenPartialHomeomorph ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      hΨ_strict.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Ψ
    have hℋ_coe : (ℋ : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) = Ψ := hΨ_strict.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
    have h_src0 : (p₀, w₀) ∈ ℋ.source := hΨ_strict.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    have hℋ_pt : ℋ (p₀, w₀) = (p₀, 0) := by
      rw [congrFun hℋ_coe (p₀, w₀)]
      simp [Ψ, hG0]
    have h_symm_pt : ℋ.symm (p₀, 0) = (p₀, w₀) := by
      rw [← hℋ_pt]; exact ℋ.left_inv h_src0
    have h_symm_an : AnalyticAt ℂ ℋ.symm (p₀, 0) := by
      have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (ℋ : _ → _) (p₀, w₀) := by rw [hℋ_coe]; exact hΨ_an
      have h2 : fderiv ℂ (ℋ : _ → _) (p₀, w₀) = ↑e := by
        rw [hℋ_coe]; exact hΨ_strict.hasFDerivAt.fderiv
      have h3 := ℋ.analyticAt_symm' h_src0 h1 h2
      rwa [hℋ_pt] at h3
    let g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => (ℋ.symm (p, 0)).2
    have hg_an0 : AnalyticAt ℂ g p₀ := by
      have h_symm_an' : AnalyticAt ℂ ℋ.symm (ι₁ p₀) := h_symm_an
      have h_c1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (ℋ.symm ∘ ι₁) p₀ := h_symm_an'.comp (ι₁.analyticAt p₀)
      exact (π₂.analyticAt ((ℋ.symm ∘ ι₁) p₀)).comp h_c1
    have hg_pt : g p₀ = w₀ := by dsimp [g]; rw [h_symm_pt]
    obtain ⟨r_w, hr_w_pos, hr_w_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp ℋ.open_source (p₀, w₀) h_src0
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁_pos, hr₁_an⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hg_an0.eventually_analyticAt
    have h_tgt0 : (p₀, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ ℋ.target := by rw [← hℋ_pt]; exact ℋ.map_source h_src0
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂_pos, hr₂_tgt⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp ℋ.open_target (p₀, 0) h_tgt0
    have h_pre_w : g ⁻¹' Metric.ball w₀ r_w ∈ nhds p₀ := by
      refine hg_an0.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ?_)
      rw [hg_pt]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr_w_pos
    obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃_pos, hr₃_w⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_pre_w
    let r_p : ℝ := min (min r_w r₁) (min r₂ r₃)
    have hr_p_pos : 0 < r_p := lt_min (lt_min hr_w_pos hr₁_pos) (lt_min hr₂_pos hr₃_pos)
    have hr_p_le_w : r_p ≤ r_w := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_p_le_1 : r_p ≤ r₁ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hr_p_le_2 : r_p ≤ r₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_p_le_3 : r_p ≤ r₃ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    refine ⟨r_p, r_w, g, hr_p_pos, hr_p_le_w, ?_, hg_pt, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      exact (hr₁_an (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_le_1 hp)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro p hp
      have hp_w : p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r_w := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_le_w hp
      have hp_2 : p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_le_2 hp
      have hp_3 : p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ r₃ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_p_le_3 hp
      have hgp_mem : g p ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r_w := hr₃_w hp_3
      have hp0_tgt : (p, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ ℋ.target := by
        apply hr₂_tgt
        rw [← ball_prod_same]
        exact ⟨hp_2, Metric.mem_ball_self hr₂_pos⟩
      have h_rinv : Ψ (ℋ.symm (p, 0)) = (p, 0) := by
        rw [← hℋ_coe]; exact ℋ.right_inv hp0_tgt
      have h_fst_eq : (ℋ.symm (p, 0)).1 = p := congrArg Prod.fst h_rinv
      have h_G_zero : G (p, g p) = 0 := by
        have h_snd_eq : G (ℋ.symm (p, 0)) = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd h_rinv
        have h_eta : ℋ.symm (p, 0) = (p, g p) := Prod.ext h_fst_eq rfl
        rwa [h_eta] at h_snd_eq
      refine ⟨hgp_mem, h_G_zero, ?_⟩
      intro w hw hGw
      have hpw_src : (p, w) ∈ ℋ.source := by
        apply hr_w_sub
        rw [← ball_prod_same]
        exact ⟨hp_w, hw⟩
      have hℋ_pw : ℋ (p, w) = (p, 0) := by
        rw [congrFun hℋ_coe (p, w)]
        simp [Ψ, hGw]
      have h_linv := ℋ.left_inv hpw_src
      rw [hℋ_pw] at h_linv
      exact (congrArg Prod.snd h_linv).symm

  
  let s_star_pt : Fin N → ℂ := fun j => A.s_ext y_star j
  have hs_star_strip : ∀ j : Fin N, s_star_pt j ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
    fun j => A.s_ext_in_strip y_star hy_star_arc j
  let q_minus : Fin N → ℂ × ℂ := fun j => (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j), s_star_pt j)
  let q_plus : Fin N → ℂ × ℂ := fun j => (s_star_pt j, s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j))
  let G_fwd : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ := fun q => clearedReflectE S q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2
  let perm_bwd : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ).prod
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ))).prod
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℂ ℂ ℂ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ℂ))
  let G_bwd : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ := G_fwd ∘ perm_bwd
  have h_ex_plus : ∀ j : Fin N,
      ∃ (r_p r_w : ℝ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_p ∧ r_p ≤ r_w ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (q_minus j) r_p) ∧
        g (q_minus j) = s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus j) r_p,
          g p ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) r_w ∧
          clearedReflectE S p.1 p.2 (g p) = 0 ∧
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) r_w,
            clearedReflectE S p.1 p.2 w = 0 → w = g p) := by
    intro j
    exact h_ift_polydisk G_fwd (q_minus j) (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j))
      (hRefl.analytic_at_strip _ _ _ (hs_star_strip _) (hs_star_strip _) (hs_star_strip _))
      (hRefl.arc_vanish y_star hy_star_arc j)
      (hRefl.arc_partials_ne_zero y_star hy_star_arc j).1
  have h_ex_minus : ∀ j : Fin N,
      ∃ (r_p r_w : ℝ) (g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        0 < r_p ∧ r_p ≤ r_w ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball (q_plus j) r_p) ∧
        g (q_plus j) = s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus j) r_p,
          g p ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) r_w ∧
          clearedReflectE S (g p) p.1 p.2 = 0 ∧
          ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) r_w,
            clearedReflectE S w p.1 p.2 = 0 → w = g p) := by
    intro j
    have h_an_fwd : AnalyticAt ℂ G_fwd (perm_bwd (q_plus j, s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j))) :=
      hRefl.analytic_at_strip (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) (s_star_pt j)
        (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) (hs_star_strip _) (hs_star_strip _) (hs_star_strip _)
    have h_an_bwd : AnalyticAt ℂ G_bwd (q_plus j, s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) :=
      h_an_fwd.comp (perm_bwd.analyticAt _)
    exact h_ift_polydisk G_bwd (q_plus j) (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j))
      h_an_bwd
      (hRefl.arc_vanish y_star hy_star_arc j)
      (hRefl.arc_partials_ne_zero y_star hy_star_arc j).2
  choose r_p_plus r_w_plus g_plus hg_plus_pos hg_plus_le hg_plus_holo hg_plus_pt hg_plus_uniq
    using h_ex_plus
  choose r_p_minus r_w_minus g_minus hg_minus_pos hg_minus_le hg_minus_holo hg_minus_pt
    hg_minus_uniq using h_ex_minus
  let η_orb : ℝ :=
    Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j : Fin N => min (r_p_plus j) (r_p_minus j))
  have hη_pos : 0 < η_orb := by
    rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
    intro j _
    exact lt_min (hg_plus_pos j) (hg_minus_pos j)
  have hη_le_plus : ∀ j : Fin N, η_orb ≤ r_p_plus j :=
    fun j => le_trans (Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hη_le_minus : ∀ j : Fin N, η_orb ≤ r_p_minus j :=
    fun j => le_trans (Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) (min_le_right _ _)
  let T_plus : Fin N → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun j p => (p.2, g_plus j p)
  let T_minus : Fin N → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun j p => (g_minus j p, p.1)
  have hT_plus_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (T_plus j) (Metric.ball (q_minus j) η_orb) :=
    fun j => differentiable_snd.differentiableOn.prodMk
      ((hg_plus_holo j).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_plus j)))
  have hT_minus_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (T_minus j) (Metric.ball (q_plus j) η_orb) :=
    fun j => ((hg_minus_holo j).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_minus j))).prodMk
      differentiable_fst.differentiableOn
  have hT_plus_pt : ∀ j : Fin N, T_plus j (q_minus j) = q_plus j := by
    intro j; dsimp [T_plus, q_minus, q_plus]; rw [hg_plus_pt j]
  have hT_minus_pt : ∀ j : Fin N, T_minus j (q_plus j) = q_minus j := by
    intro j; dsimp [T_minus, q_minus, q_plus]; rw [hg_minus_pt j]
  have hT_step_uniq : ∀ (j : Fin N) (u₁ u₂ u₃ : ℂ),
      u₁ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) η_orb →
      u₂ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) η_orb →
      u₃ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) η_orb →
      clearedReflectE S u₁ u₂ u₃ = 0 →
      T_plus j (u₁, u₂) = (u₂, u₃) ∧ T_minus j (u₂, u₃) = (u₁, u₂) := by
    intro j u₁ u₂ u₃ hu₁ hu₂ hu₃ hE
    have hp_plus : (u₁, u₂) ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus j) (r_p_plus j) := by
      apply Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_plus j)
      rw [← ball_prod_same]; exact ⟨hu₁, hu₂⟩
    have hw_plus : u₃ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) (r_w_plus j) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (hη_le_plus j) (hg_plus_le j)) hu₃
    have hp_minus : (u₂, u₃) ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus j) (r_p_minus j) := by
      apply Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_minus j)
      rw [← ball_prod_same]; exact ⟨hu₂, hu₃⟩
    have hw_minus : u₁ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) (r_w_minus j) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (hη_le_minus j) (hg_minus_le j)) hu₁
    have h1 := (hg_plus_uniq j (u₁, u₂) hp_plus).2.2 u₃ hw_plus hE
    have h2 := (hg_minus_uniq j (u₂, u₃) hp_minus).2.2 u₁ hw_minus hE
    exact ⟨Prod.ext rfl h1.symm, Prod.ext h2.symm rfl⟩
  have hT_left_inv : ∀ (j : Fin N) (w : ℂ × ℂ),
      w ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus j) η_orb →
      T_plus j w ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus j) η_orb →
      T_minus j (T_plus j w) = w := by
    intro j w hw hTw
    have hw_prod : w ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) η_orb ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) η_orb := by rwa [ball_prod_same]
    have hTw_prod : T_plus j w ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) η_orb ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) η_orb := by rwa [ball_prod_same]
    have hw_rp : w ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus j) (r_p_plus j) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_plus j) hw
    have hE : clearedReflectE S w.1 w.2 (g_plus j w) = 0 := (hg_plus_uniq j w hw_rp).2.1
    exact (hT_step_uniq j w.1 w.2 (g_plus j w) hw_prod.1 hw_prod.2 hTw_prod.2 hE).2
  have hT_right_inv : ∀ (j : Fin N) (ζ : ℂ × ℂ),
      ζ ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus j) η_orb →
      T_minus j ζ ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus j) η_orb →
      T_plus j (T_minus j ζ) = ζ := by
    intro j ζ hζ hTζ
    have hζ_prod : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) η_orb ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst j)) η_orb := by rwa [ball_prod_same]
    have hTζ_prod : T_minus j ζ ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst j)) η_orb ×ˢ
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) η_orb := by rwa [ball_prod_same]
    have hζ_rp : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus j) (r_p_minus j) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (hη_le_minus j) hζ
    have hE : clearedReflectE S (g_minus j ζ) ζ.1 ζ.2 = 0 := (hg_minus_uniq j ζ hζ_rp).2.1
    exact (hT_step_uniq j (g_minus j ζ) ζ.1 ζ.2 hTζ_prod.1 hζ_prod.1 hζ_prod.2 hE).1

  
  let idx : ℕ → Fin N := fun m => ⟨m % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
  let j_fwd : ℕ → Fin N := fun m => idx (m + 1)
  let P : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ := fun m => (s_star_pt (idx m), s_star_pt (idx (m + 1)))
  have h_prev_jfwd : ∀ m : ℕ, @cycPrev N inst (j_fwd m) = idx m := by
    intro m; apply Fin.ext; dsimp [cycPrev, j_fwd, idx]
    have h1 : (m + 1) % N + N - 1 = (m + 1) % N + (N - 1) := by omega
    have h2 : m + 1 + (N - 1) = m + N := by omega
    rw [h1, Nat.mod_add_mod, h2, Nat.add_mod_right]
  have h_next_jfwd : ∀ m : ℕ, @cycNext N inst (j_fwd m) = idx (m + 2) := by
    intro m; apply Fin.ext; dsimp [cycNext, j_fwd, idx]
    rw [Nat.mod_add_mod]
  have hq_minus_jfwd : ∀ m : ℕ, q_minus (j_fwd m) = P m := by
    intro m; dsimp [q_minus, P, j_fwd]; rw [h_prev_jfwd m]
  have hq_plus_jfwd : ∀ m : ℕ, q_plus (j_fwd m) = P (m + 1) := by
    intro m; dsimp [q_plus, P, j_fwd]; rw [h_next_jfwd m]
  let fin0 : Fin N := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let fin1 : Fin N := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have h_idx0 : idx 0 = fin0 := by
    apply Fin.ext; dsimp [idx, fin0]
  have h_idx1 : idx 1 = fin1 := by
    apply Fin.ext; dsimp [idx, fin1]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have h_idxN : idx N = idx 0 := by apply Fin.ext; dsimp [idx]; simp
  have h_idxN1 : idx (N + 1) = idx 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext; dsimp [idx]; rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mod_right]
  let q₀ : ℂ × ℂ := (f0 y_star, f1 y_star)
  have hf0_eq_fin0 : ∀ u : ℂ, f0 u = A.s_ext u fin0 := fun _ => rfl
  have hf1_eq_fin1 : ∀ u : ℂ, f1 u = A.s_ext u fin1 := fun _ => rfl
  have hP0_eq : P 0 = q₀ := by
    dsimp [P, q₀, s_star_pt]
    rw [h_idx0, h_idx1, hf0_eq_fin0, hf1_eq_fin1]
  have hPN_eq : P N = q₀ := by
    dsimp [P]; rw [h_idxN, h_idxN1]; exact hP0_eq

  let chainFwd : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun m => Nat.rec (fun w => w) (fun k ih w => T_plus (j_fwd k) (ih w)) m
  let chainBwd : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ :=
    fun m => Nat.rec (fun w => w) (fun k ih w => ih (T_minus (j_fwd k) w)) m
  have h_chains : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (chainFwd m (P 0) = P m ∧ chainBwd m (P m) = P 0) ∧
      (∃ r_m : ℝ, 0 < r_m ∧ r_m ≤ η_orb ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (chainFwd m) (Metric.ball (P 0) r_m) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (P 0) r_m,
          chainFwd m w ∈ Metric.ball (P m) η_orb ∧ chainBwd m (chainFwd m w) = w) ∧
      (∃ s_m : ℝ, 0 < s_m ∧ s_m ≤ η_orb ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (chainBwd m) (Metric.ball (P m) s_m) ∧
        ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (P m) s_m,
          chainBwd m ζ ∈ Metric.ball (P 0) η_orb ∧ chainFwd m (chainBwd m ζ) = ζ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨⟨rfl, rfl⟩,
        ⟨η_orb, hη_pos, le_rfl, differentiableOn_id, fun w hw => ⟨hw, rfl⟩⟩,
        ⟨η_orb, hη_pos, le_rfl, differentiableOn_id, fun ζ hζ => ⟨hζ, rfl⟩⟩⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨⟨hF_pt, hB_pt⟩, ⟨r_m, hr_m_pos, hr_m_le, hF_holo, hF_prop⟩,
        ⟨s_m, hs_m_pos, hs_m_le, hB_holo, hB_prop⟩⟩
      have hF_pt_succ : chainFwd (m + 1) (P 0) = P (m + 1) := by
        change T_plus (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m (P 0)) = P (m + 1)
        rw [hF_pt, ← hq_minus_jfwd m, hT_plus_pt (j_fwd m), hq_plus_jfwd m]
      have hB_pt_succ : chainBwd (m + 1) (P (m + 1)) = P 0 := by
        change chainBwd m (T_minus (j_fwd m) (P (m + 1))) = P 0
        rw [← hq_plus_jfwd m, hT_minus_pt (j_fwd m), hq_minus_jfwd m, hB_pt]
      have hF_cont : ContinuousAt (chainFwd m) (P 0) :=
        hF_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_m_pos))
      have hTp_holo_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ (T_plus (j_fwd m)) (Metric.ball (P m) η_orb) := by
        rw [← hq_minus_jfwd m]; exact hT_plus_holo (j_fwd m)
      have hTp_cont : ContinuousAt (T_plus (j_fwd m)) (chainFwd m (P 0)) := by
        rw [hF_pt]
        exact hTp_holo_m.continuousOn.continuousAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))
      have h_comp_cont : ContinuousAt (chainFwd (m + 1)) (P 0) := hTp_cont.comp hF_cont
      have h_pre_fwd : (chainFwd (m + 1)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) η_orb ∈ nhds (P 0) := by
        refine h_comp_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ?_)
        rw [hF_pt_succ]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos
      obtain ⟨δ_f, hδ_f_pos, hδ_f_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_pre_fwd
      let r_next : ℝ := min r_m δ_f
      have hr_next_pos : 0 < r_next := lt_min hr_m_pos hδ_f_pos
      have hr_next_le_m : r_next ≤ r_m := min_le_left _ _
      have hr_next_le_η : r_next ≤ η_orb := le_trans hr_next_le_m hr_m_le
      have hF_next_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (chainFwd (m + 1)) (Metric.ball (P 0) r_next) :=
        hTp_holo_m.comp (hF_holo.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_next_le_m))
          (fun w hw => (hF_prop w (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_next_le_m hw)).1)
      have hTm_holo_m : DifferentiableOn ℂ (T_minus (j_fwd m)) (Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) η_orb) := by
        rw [← hq_plus_jfwd m]; exact hT_minus_holo (j_fwd m)
      have hTm_cont : ContinuousAt (T_minus (j_fwd m)) (P (m + 1)) :=
        hTm_holo_m.continuousOn.continuousAt
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))
      have hTm_pt_m : T_minus (j_fwd m) (P (m + 1)) = P m := by
        rw [← hq_plus_jfwd m, hT_minus_pt (j_fwd m), hq_minus_jfwd m]
      have h_pre_bwd : (T_minus (j_fwd m)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (P m) s_m ∈ nhds (P (m + 1)) := by
        refine hTm_cont.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ?_)
        rw [hTm_pt_m]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hs_m_pos
      obtain ⟨δ_b, hδ_b_pos, hδ_b_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_pre_bwd
      let s_next : ℝ := min η_orb δ_b
      have hs_next_pos : 0 < s_next := lt_min hη_pos hδ_b_pos
      have hs_next_le_η : s_next ≤ η_orb := min_le_left _ _
      have hB_next_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (chainBwd (m + 1)) (Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) s_next) :=
        hB_holo.comp (hTm_holo_m.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball hs_next_le_η))
          (fun ζ hζ => hδ_b_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hζ))
      refine ⟨⟨hF_pt_succ, hB_pt_succ⟩,
        ⟨r_next, hr_next_pos, hr_next_le_η, hF_next_holo, ?_⟩,
        ⟨s_next, hs_next_pos, hs_next_le_η, hB_next_holo, ?_⟩⟩
      · intro w hw
        have hw_m : w ∈ Metric.ball (P 0) r_m := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_next_le_m hw
        have hw_f : w ∈ Metric.ball (P 0) δ_f := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hw
        have h_in_next : chainFwd (m + 1) w ∈ Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) η_orb := hδ_f_sub hw_f
        refine ⟨h_in_next, ?_⟩
        change chainBwd m (T_minus (j_fwd m) (T_plus (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m w))) = w
        have hu_in : chainFwd m w ∈ Metric.ball (q_minus (j_fwd m)) η_orb := by
          rw [hq_minus_jfwd m]; exact (hF_prop w hw_m).1
        have hTu_in : T_plus (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m w) ∈ Metric.ball (q_plus (j_fwd m)) η_orb := by
          rw [hq_plus_jfwd m]; exact h_in_next
        rw [hT_left_inv (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m w) hu_in hTu_in]
        exact (hF_prop w hw_m).2
      · intro ζ hζ
        have hζ_η : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) η_orb := Metric.ball_subset_ball hs_next_le_η hζ
        have hζ_b : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (P (m + 1)) δ_b :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hζ
        have hu_sm : T_minus (j_fwd m) ζ ∈ Metric.ball (P m) s_m := hδ_b_sub hζ_b
        refine ⟨(hB_prop _ hu_sm).1, ?_⟩
        change T_plus (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m (chainBwd m (T_minus (j_fwd m) ζ))) = ζ
        rw [(hB_prop _ hu_sm).2]
        apply hT_right_inv (j_fwd m) ζ
        · rwa [hq_plus_jfwd m]
        · rw [hq_minus_jfwd m]; exact Metric.ball_subset_ball hs_m_le hu_sm

  rcases h_chains N with ⟨⟨hRN_pt_fwd, hRN_pt_bwd⟩, ⟨r_N, hr_N_pos, _, hRN_fwd_holo, hRN_fwd_prop⟩,
    ⟨s_N, hs_N_pos, _, hRN_bwd_holo, hRN_bwd_prop⟩⟩
  let R_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := chainFwd N
  let R_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := chainBwd N
  let r_out : ℝ := min r_N s_N
  have hr_out_pos : 0 < r_out := lt_min hr_N_pos hs_N_pos
  have hR_plus_pt : R_plus q₀ = q₀ :=
    (congrArg R_plus hP0_eq.symm).trans (hRN_pt_fwd.trans hPN_eq)
  have hR_minus_pt : R_minus q₀ = q₀ :=
    (congrArg R_minus hPN_eq.symm).trans (hRN_pt_bwd.trans hP0_eq)
  have hR_plus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_plus (Metric.ball q₀ r_out) := by
    rw [← hP0_eq]
    exact hRN_fwd_holo.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _))
  have hR_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ R_minus (Metric.ball q₀ r_out) := by
    rw [← hPN_eq]
    exact hRN_bwd_holo.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _))
  have hR_left_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_out, R_minus (R_plus w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← hP0_eq] at hw
    exact (hRN_fwd_prop w (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hw)).2
  have hR_right_inv : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_out, R_plus (R_minus w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← hPN_eq] at hw
    exact (hRN_bwd_prop w (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hw)).2
  have hR_orbit_unique : ∀ z : ℕ → ℂ,
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 → ‖z k - s_star_pt (idx k)‖ < η_orb) →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → clearedReflectE S (z (k - 1)) (z k) (z (k + 1)) = 0) →
      R_plus (z 0, z 1) = (z N, z (N + 1)) := by
    intro z hz_near hz_vanish
    have h_ind : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → chainFwd m (z 0, z 1) = (z m, z (m + 1)) := by
      intro m hm
      induction m with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ m ihm =>
        change T_plus (j_fwd m) (chainFwd m (z 0, z 1)) = (z (m + 1), z (m + 2))
        rw [ihm (by omega)]
        have hu1 : z m ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycPrev N inst (j_fwd m))) η_orb := by
          rw [h_prev_jfwd m, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          exact hz_near m (by omega)
        have hu2 : z (m + 1) ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (j_fwd m)) η_orb := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          exact hz_near (m + 1) (by omega)
        have hu3 : z (m + 2) ∈ Metric.ball (s_star_pt (@cycNext N inst (j_fwd m))) η_orb := by
          rw [h_next_jfwd m, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
          exact hz_near (m + 2) (by omega)
        have hE : clearedReflectE S (z m) (z (m + 1)) (z (m + 2)) = 0 :=
          hz_vanish (m + 1) (by omega) hm
        exact (hT_step_uniq (j_fwd m) (z m) (z (m + 1)) (z (m + 2)) hu1 hu2 hu3 hE).1
    exact h_ind N le_rfl

  have h_arc_near_ex : ∀ j : Fin N,
      ∃ r_j : ℝ, 0 < r_j ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_star r_j,
        ‖A.s_ext y j - s_star_pt j‖ < min η_orb r_out := by
    intro j
    have h_cont : ContinuousAt (fun y => A.s_ext y j) y_star :=
      (A.s_ext_holo j).continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy_star_arc)
    have h_pre : (fun y => A.s_ext y j) ⁻¹'
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt j) (min η_orb r_out) ∈ nhds y_star :=
      h_cont.preimage_mem_nhds
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_min hη_pos hr_out_pos)))
    obtain ⟨r_j, hr_j_pos, hr_j_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_pre
    refine ⟨r_j, hr_j_pos, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hr_j_sub hy
  choose r_arc_j hr_arc_j_pos hr_arc_j_near using h_arc_near_ex
  let δ_fix : ℝ := min A.δ_arc (Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty r_arc_j)
  have hδ_fix_pos : 0 < δ_fix := by
    refine lt_min A.δ_arc_pos ?_
    rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]; exact fun j _ => hr_arc_j_pos j
  have hδ_fix_le_arc : δ_fix ≤ A.δ_arc := min_le_left _ _
  have h_arc_near : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_fix, ∀ j : Fin N,
      ‖A.s_ext y j - s_star_pt j‖ < η_orb ∧ ‖A.s_ext y j - s_star_pt j‖ < r_out := by
    intro y hy j
    have hy_j : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star (r_arc_j j) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball
        (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ j))) hy
    have hlt := hr_arc_j_near j y hy_j
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_left _ _), lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_right _ _)⟩
  have hR_fix_arc : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_fix,
      R_plus (f0 y, f1 y) = (f0 y, f1 y) ∧ R_minus (f0 y, f1 y) = (f0 y, f1 y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hy_arc : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ_fix_le_arc hy
    let z_y : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => A.s_ext y (idx k)
    have hz0 : z_y 0 = f0 y := by dsimp [z_y]; rw [h_idx0, ← hf0_eq_fin0]
    have hz1 : z_y 1 = f1 y := by dsimp [z_y]; rw [h_idx1, ← hf1_eq_fin1]
    have hzN : z_y N = f0 y := by dsimp [z_y]; rw [h_idxN]; exact hz0
    have hzN1 : z_y (N + 1) = f1 y := by dsimp [z_y]; rw [h_idxN1]; exact hz1
    have h_rp : R_plus (f0 y, f1 y) = (f0 y, f1 y) := by
      have h_orb : R_plus (z_y 0, z_y 1) = (z_y N, z_y (N + 1)) := by
        apply hR_orbit_unique z_y
        · intro k _; exact (h_arc_near y hy (idx k)).1
        · intro k hk1 hkN
          have h_prev : idx (k - 1) = @cycPrev N inst (j_fwd (k - 1)) := by
            rw [h_prev_jfwd (k - 1)]
          have h_curr : idx k = j_fwd (k - 1) := by
            dsimp [j_fwd]; congr 1; omega
          have h_next : idx (k + 1) = @cycNext N inst (j_fwd (k - 1)) := by
            rw [h_next_jfwd (k - 1)]; congr 1; omega
          dsimp [z_y]
          rw [h_prev, h_curr, h_next]
          exact hRefl.arc_vanish y hy_arc (j_fwd (k - 1))
      rwa [hz0, hz1, hzN, hzN1] at h_orb
    have h_in_out : (f0 y, f1 y) ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_out := by
      rw [← ball_prod_same]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hf0_eq_fin0]
        exact (h_arc_near y hy fin0).2
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hf1_eq_fin1]
        exact (h_arc_near y hy fin1).2
    have h_rm : R_minus (f0 y, f1 y) = (f0 y, f1 y) := by
      have h_li := hR_left_inv (f0 y, f1 y) h_in_out
      rwa [h_rp] at h_li
    exact ⟨h_rp, h_rm⟩

  
  let W_chart : Set ℂ := f0 '' Metric.ball y_star δ_chart
  have hW_chart_open : IsOpen W_chart := hs0_open_map _ Metric.isOpen_ball Subset.rfl
  let Φ : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => (f0 p.1, f1 p.1 + p.2)
  let Φ_inv : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun w => (s0_inv w.1, w.2 - f1 (s0_inv w.1))
  let F_plus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => Φ_inv (R_plus (Φ p))
  let F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ := fun p => Φ_inv (R_minus (Φ p))
  have hΦ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ (Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have h_fst_map : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ),
        p.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := fun p hp => hδ_chart_sub_arc hp.1
    exact (hf0_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn h_fst_map).prodMk
      ((hf1_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn h_fst_map).add
        differentiable_snd.differentiableOn)
  have hΦ_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Φ_inv (W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    have hu_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w : ℂ × ℂ => s0_inv w.1) (W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      hs0_inv_holo_chart.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hu_maps : ∀ w ∈ W_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ),
        s0_inv w.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc :=
      fun w hw => hδ_chart_sub_arc (hs0_right_inv_on Subset.rfl w.1 hw.1).1
    exact hu_holo.prodMk (differentiable_snd.differentiableOn.sub (hf1_holo.comp hu_holo hu_maps))
  have hΦ_left_inv : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ),
      Φ_inv (Φ p) = p := by
    rintro ⟨u, v⟩ hp
    dsimp [Φ, Φ_inv]
    rw [hs0_left_inv_chart u hp.1]
    ext <;> simp
  have hΦ_right_inv : ∀ w ∈ W_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ), Φ (Φ_inv w) = w := by
    rintro ⟨w₀, w₁⟩ hw
    dsimp [Φ, Φ_inv]
    rw [(hs0_right_inv_on Subset.rfl w₀ hw.1).2]
    ext <;> simp
  have hΦ_pt : Φ (y_star, 0) = q₀ := by dsimp [Φ, q₀]; simp
  have hq0_in_W : q₀ ∈ W_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ) :=
    ⟨⟨y_star, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_chart_pos, rfl⟩, trivial⟩
  have hΦ_cont0 : ContinuousAt Φ (y_star, 0) :=
    hΦ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ_chart_pos, trivial⟩)
  have hRp_cont0 : ContinuousAt R_plus q₀ :=
    hR_plus_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_out_pos))
  have hRm_cont0 : ContinuousAt R_minus q₀ :=
    hR_minus_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_out_pos))
  have h_nhds_0 :
      (Φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball q₀ r_out ∩
        (R_plus ∘ Φ) ⁻¹' (W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ) ∩
        (R_minus ∘ Φ) ⁻¹' (W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ)) ∈ nhds (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) := by
    refine Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
    · refine hΦ_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ?_)
      rw [hΦ_pt]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr_out_pos
    · have hc : ContinuousAt (R_plus ∘ Φ) (y_star, 0) := by
        refine ContinuousAt.comp ?_ hΦ_cont0; rw [hΦ_pt]; exact hRp_cont0
      refine hc.preimage_mem_nhds ((hW_chart_open.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hΦ_pt, hR_plus_pt]; exact hq0_in_W
    · have hc : ContinuousAt (R_minus ∘ Φ) (y_star, 0) := by
        refine ContinuousAt.comp ?_ hΦ_cont0; rw [hΦ_pt]; exact hRm_cont0
      refine hc.preimage_mem_nhds ((hW_chart_open.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hΦ_pt, hR_minus_pt]; exact hq0_in_W
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀_pos, hρ₀_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_0
  let δ_0 : ℝ := min (min (δ_chart / 2) δ_fix) ρ₀
  let δ_v0 : ℝ := ρ₀
  have hδ0_pos : 0 < δ_0 := lt_min (lt_min (half_pos hδ_chart_pos) hδ_fix_pos) hρ₀_pos
  have hδ0_lt_chart : δ_0 < δ_chart :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)) (half_lt_self hδ_chart_pos)
  have hδ0_lt_arc : δ_0 < A.δ_arc := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ0_lt_chart hδ_chart_le
  have hδ0_le_arc : δ_0 ≤ A.δ_arc := le_of_lt hδ0_lt_arc
  have hδ0_le_fix : δ_0 ≤ δ_fix := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hδ0_le_ρ0 : δ_0 ≤ ρ₀ := min_le_right _ _
  let D₀ : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0
  have hD₀_open : IsOpen D₀ := Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hD₀_sub_ρ0 : D₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) ρ₀ := by
    intro p hp
    rw [← ball_prod_same]
    exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_ρ0 hp.1, hp.2⟩
  have hD₀_sub_chart : D₀ ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart ×ˢ Set.univ :=
    fun p hp => ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart) hp.1, trivial⟩
  have hF_plus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus D₀ := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => R_plus (Φ p)) D₀ :=
      hR_plus_holo.comp (hΦ_holo.mono hD₀_sub_chart) (fun p hp => (hρ₀_sub (hD₀_sub_ρ0 hp)).1.1)
    exact hΦ_inv_holo.comp h1 (fun p hp => (hρ₀_sub (hD₀_sub_ρ0 hp)).1.2)
  have hF_minus_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus D₀ := by
    have h1 : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p => R_minus (Φ p)) D₀ :=
      hR_minus_holo.comp (hΦ_holo.mono hD₀_sub_chart) (fun p hp => (hρ₀_sub (hD₀_sub_ρ0 hp)).1.1)
    exact hΦ_inv_holo.comp h1 (fun p hp => (hρ₀_sub (hD₀_sub_ρ0 hp)).2)
  have hF_plus_zero : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_fix : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_fix := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_fix hu
    have hu_chart : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart) hu
    have hΦu0 : Φ (u, 0) = (f0 u, f1 u) := by dsimp [Φ]; simp
    change Φ_inv (R_plus (Φ (u, 0))) = (u, 0)
    rw [hΦu0, (hR_fix_arc u hu_fix).1, ← hΦu0]
    exact hΦ_left_inv (u, 0) ⟨hu_chart, trivial⟩
  have hF_minus_zero : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, F_minus (u, 0) = (u, 0) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_fix : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_fix := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_fix hu
    have hu_chart : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart) hu
    have hΦu0 : Φ (u, 0) = (f0 u, f1 u) := by dsimp [Φ]; simp
    change Φ_inv (R_minus (Φ (u, 0))) = (u, 0)
    rw [hΦu0, (hR_fix_arc u hu_fix).2, ← hΦu0]
    exact hΦ_left_inv (u, 0) ⟨hu_chart, trivial⟩

  have hy0_D₀ : (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ D₀ := ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0_pos, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ₀_pos⟩
  have hFp_cont0 : ContinuousAt F_plus (y_star, 0) :=
    hF_plus_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD₀_open.mem_nhds hy0_D₀)
  have hFm_cont0 : ContinuousAt F_minus (y_star, 0) :=
    hF_minus_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (hD₀_open.mem_nhds hy0_D₀)
  have h_nhds_1 : (F_plus ⁻¹' D₀ ∩ F_minus ⁻¹' D₀) ∈ nhds (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) := by
    refine Filter.inter_mem ?_ ?_
    · refine hFp_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds (hD₀_open.mem_nhds ?_)
      rw [hF_plus_zero y_star (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0_pos)]; exact hy0_D₀
    · refine hFm_cont0.preimage_mem_nhds (hD₀_open.mem_nhds ?_)
      rw [hF_minus_zero y_star (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0_pos)]; exact hy0_D₀
  obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁_pos, hρ₁_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h_nhds_1
  let δ_1 : ℝ := min (δ_0 / 2) ρ₁
  let δ_v1 : ℝ := min (δ_v0 / 2) ρ₁
  have hδ1_pos : 0 < δ_1 := lt_min (half_pos hδ0_pos) hρ₁_pos
  have hδ1_lt_δ0 : δ_1 < δ_0 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hδ0_pos)
  have hδv1_pos : 0 < δ_v1 := lt_min (half_pos hρ₀_pos) hρ₁_pos
  have hδv1_lt_δv0 : δ_v1 < δ_v0 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hρ₀_pos)
  have hF_mutual_inv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
      F_plus (u, v) ∈ D₀ ∧ F_minus (u, v) ∈ D₀ ∧
      F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧ F_plus (F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v) := by
    intro u hu v hv
    have hp_D₀ : (u, v) ∈ D₀ :=
      ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ1_lt_δ0) hu,
       Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδv1_lt_δv0) hv⟩
    have hp_ρ1 : (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) ρ₁ := by
      rw [← ball_prod_same]
      exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hu,
             Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hv⟩
    have hp_ρ0 : (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball (y_star, (0 : ℂ)) ρ₀ := hD₀_sub_ρ0 hp_D₀
    have hΦ_in : Φ (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball q₀ r_out := (hρ₀_sub hp_ρ0).1.1
    have hRp_W : R_plus (Φ (u, v)) ∈ W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ := (hρ₀_sub hp_ρ0).1.2
    have hRm_W : R_minus (Φ (u, v)) ∈ W_chart ×ˢ Set.univ := (hρ₀_sub hp_ρ0).2
    have hFp_D₀ : F_plus (u, v) ∈ D₀ := (hρ₁_sub hp_ρ1).1
    have hFm_D₀ : F_minus (u, v) ∈ D₀ := (hρ₁_sub hp_ρ1).2
    refine ⟨hFp_D₀, hFm_D₀, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Φ_inv (R_minus (Φ (Φ_inv (R_plus (Φ (u, v)))))) = (u, v)
      rw [hΦ_right_inv _ hRp_W, hR_left_inv _ hΦ_in, hΦ_left_inv _ (hD₀_sub_chart hp_D₀)]
    · change Φ_inv (R_plus (Φ (Φ_inv (R_minus (Φ (u, v)))))) = (u, v)
      rw [hΦ_right_inv _ hRm_W, hR_right_inv _ hΦ_in, hΦ_left_inv _ (hD₀_sub_chart hp_D₀)]

  
  have h_arc_slice_t0 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, y.im < h →
      S.𝔰 (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = f0 y ∧ S.𝔰 (y + (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) = f1 y := by
    intro y hy hy_im
    have hy_arc : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_arc hy
    have h_dist : ‖y - y_star‖ < h / 2 := by
      have hd : ‖y - y_star‖ < A.δ_arc := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy_arc
      exact lt_trans hd A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    have him_diff : (y - y_star).im = y.im - h := by
      dsimp [y_star]
      simp [Complex.mul_im]
    have habs_im : |y.im - h| < h / 2 := by
      rw [← him_diff]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - y_star)) h_dist
    have hy_strip : y ∈ horizStrip h := by
      change |y.im| < h
      rw [abs_lt] at habs_im ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, hy_im⟩
    have h0 := A.s_ext_agrees y hy_arc hy_strip ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
    have h1 := A.s_ext_agrees y hy_arc hy_strip ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
    dsimp [sliceImpactSeq] at h0 h1
    simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at h0
    simp only [Int.cast_one, one_mul] at h1
    exact ⟨h0.symm, h1.symm⟩

  
  let B_in : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1)
  let U_mid : Set ℂ := Metric.ball y_star ((7 / 8 : ℝ) * δ_1)
  let B_mid : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall y_star ((7 / 8 : ℝ) * δ_1)
  have h_in_sub_mid : B_in ⊆ U_mid :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have h_Umid_sub_Bmid : U_mid ⊆ B_mid := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have h_Bmid_sub_δ0 : B_mid ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have h_Bmid_sub_chart : B_mid ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_chart :=
    Subset.trans h_Bmid_sub_δ0 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart))
  have h_Bmid_sub_arc : B_mid ⊆ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc :=
    Subset.trans h_Bmid_sub_δ0 (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_arc)
  let K_in : Set ℂ := f0 '' B_in
  let W_mid : Set ℂ := f0 '' U_mid
  let K_mid : Set ℂ := f0 '' B_mid
  have hK_in_compact : IsCompact K_in :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).image_of_continuousOn
      (hf0_holo.continuousOn.mono (Subset.trans h_in_sub_mid (Subset.trans h_Umid_sub_Bmid h_Bmid_sub_arc)))
  have hK_mid_compact : IsCompact K_mid :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).image_of_continuousOn (hf0_holo.continuousOn.mono h_Bmid_sub_arc)
  have hW_mid_open : IsOpen W_mid :=
    hs0_open_map U_mid Metric.isOpen_ball (Subset.trans h_Umid_sub_Bmid h_Bmid_sub_chart)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀_pos, hε₀_thick⟩ :=
    hK_in_compact.exists_thickening_subset_open hW_mid_open (Set.image_mono h_in_sub_mid)
  have hs0_inv_cont_Kmid : ContinuousOn s0_inv K_mid :=
    hs0_inv_holo_chart.continuousOn.mono (Set.image_mono h_Bmid_sub_chart)
  have hs0_inv_uc : UniformContinuousOn s0_inv K_mid :=
    hK_mid_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hs0_inv_cont_Kmid
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁_pos, hε₁_uc⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hs0_inv_uc ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1) (by linarith)
  have hf1_s0_cont_Kmid : ContinuousOn (fun w => f1 (s0_inv w)) K_mid :=
    hf1_holo.continuousOn.comp hs0_inv_cont_Kmid
      (fun w hw => h_Bmid_sub_arc (hs0_right_inv_on h_Bmid_sub_chart w hw).1)
  have hf1_s0_uc : UniformContinuousOn (fun w => f1 (s0_inv w)) K_mid :=
    hK_mid_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hf1_s0_cont_Kmid
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂_pos, hε₂_uc⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hf1_s0_uc (δ_v1 / 2) (half_pos hδv1_pos)
  let ε_s : ℝ := min (min ε₀ ε₁) (min ε₂ (δ_v1 / 2))
  have hε_s_pos : 0 < ε_s :=
    lt_min (lt_min hε₀_pos hε₁_pos) (lt_min hε₂_pos (half_pos hδv1_pos))
  have hε_s_le_0 : ε_s ≤ ε₀ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_s_le_1 : ε_s ≤ ε₁ := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hε_s_le_2 : ε_s ≤ ε₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_s_le_v1 : ε_s ≤ δ_v1 / 2 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)

  refine ⟨{
    δ_0 := δ_0
    δ_v0 := δ_v0
    δ_1 := δ_1
    δ_v1 := δ_v1
    δ_bounds := ⟨hδ1_pos, hδ1_lt_δ0, hδ0_le_arc, hδv1_pos, hδv1_lt_δv0⟩
    s0_inv := s0_inv
    s0_arc_open_map := fun U hU_open hU_sub =>
      hs0_open_map U hU_open
        (Subset.trans hU_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart)))
    s0_inv_holo_on_image :=
      hs0_inv_holo_chart.mono
        (Set.image_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart)))
    s0_left_inv := fun u hu =>
      hs0_left_inv_chart u (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart) hu)
    F_plus := F_plus
    F_minus := F_minus
    F_plus_holo := hF_plus_holo
    F_minus_holo := hF_minus_holo
    F_plus_zero := hF_plus_zero
    F_minus_zero := hF_minus_zero
    F_mutual_inv := hF_mutual_inv
    arc_slice_at_t0 := h_arc_slice_t0
    arc_subheight_step := ?_
  }⟩
  intro μ hμ_pos hμ_lt_h
  obtain ⟨r_tube, hr_tube_pos, hr_tube_lt, h_tube⟩ :=
    hRefl.subheight_tube_vanish (μ / 2) (half_pos hμ_pos) (by linarith)
  let z_orb : ℂ → ℂ → ℕ → ℂ := fun y t k =>
    if k < N then S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) else S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) - 2 * Real.pi
  let U_strip_y : Set ℂ := horizStrip (h - μ / 2) ∩ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc
  have hU_strip_open : IsOpen U_strip_y :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp Complex.continuous_im) continuous_const).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
  let D_sub : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := U_strip_y ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_tube
  have hD_sub_open : IsOpen D_sub := hU_strip_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball
  have h_shift_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)) D_sub →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => z_orb p.1 p.2 k) D_sub := by
    intro k hc
    dsimp [z_orb]
    split_ifs
    · exact hc
    · exact hc.sub continuousOn_const
  have h_s_shift_cont : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)) D_sub := by
    intro k hk
    have h_map : Continuous (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => (p.1 + (k : ℂ) * p.2, p.2)) :=
      (continuous_fst.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_snd)).prodMk continuous_snd
    exact S.𝔰_holo.continuousOn.comp h_map.continuousOn
      (fun p hp => (h_tube p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.2).1 k hk)
  let d0_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 p - f0 p.1
  let d1_fn : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 (p.1 + p.2, p.2) - f1 p.1
  have hd0_cont : ContinuousOn d0_fn D_sub := by
    have hs0_c : ContinuousOn S.𝔰 D_sub := by
      have h0 := h_s_shift_cont 0 (by omega)
      simpa using h0
    exact hs0_c.sub (hf0_holo.continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.1.2))
  have hd1_cont : ContinuousOn d1_fn D_sub := by
    have hs1_c : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1 + p.2, p.2)) D_sub := by
      have h1 := h_s_shift_cont 1 (by omega)
      simpa using h1
    exact hs1_c.sub (hf1_holo.continuousOn.comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.1.2))
  let O_good : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    (D_sub ∩ d0_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_s) ∩
    (D_sub ∩ d1_fn ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ε_s) ∩
    ⋂ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (N + 2))),
      (D_sub ∩ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => z_orb p.1 p.2 k.val) ⁻¹'
        Metric.ball (s_star_pt (idx k.val)) η_orb)
  have hO_good_open : IsOpen O_good := by
    refine ((hd0_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hD_sub_open Metric.isOpen_ball).inter
      (hd1_cont.isOpen_inter_preimage hD_sub_open Metric.isOpen_ball)).inter ?_
    refine isOpen_biInter_finset (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact (h_shift_cont k.val (h_s_shift_cont k.val (by omega))).isOpen_inter_preimage
      hD_sub_open Metric.isOpen_ball
  let K_μ : Set ℂ := B_in ∩ {y : ℂ | y.im ≤ h - μ}
  have hK_μ_compact : IsCompact K_μ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).inter_right (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)
  have h_Kμ_sub : K_μ ×ˢ {(t₀ : ℂ)} ⊆ O_good := by
    rintro ⟨y, t⟩ ⟨⟨hy_Bin_raw, hy_im_raw⟩, ht_eq⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht_eq
    subst ht_eq
    have hy_Bin : y ∈ B_in := hy_Bin_raw
    have hy_im_le : y.im ≤ h - μ := hy_im_raw
    have hy_δ0 : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 :=
      h_Bmid_sub_δ0 (h_Umid_sub_Bmid (h_in_sub_mid hy_Bin))
    have hy_arc : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_arc hy_δ0
    have h_dist_half : ‖y - y_star‖ < h / 2 := by
      have hd : ‖y - y_star‖ < A.δ_arc := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy_arc
      exact lt_trans hd A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    have him_diff : (y - y_star).im = y.im - h := by
      dsimp [y_star]; simp [Complex.mul_im]
    have habs_im : |y.im - h| < h / 2 := by
      rw [← him_diff]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.abs_im_le_norm (y - y_star)) h_dist_half
    have hy_strip_sub : y ∈ horizStrip (h - μ / 2) := by
      change |y.im| < h - μ / 2
      rw [abs_lt] at habs_im ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hy_strip_h : y ∈ horizStrip h := by
      change |y.im| < h
      rw [abs_lt] at habs_im ⊢
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have ht0_ball : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_tube := Metric.mem_ball_self hr_tube_pos
    have hp_Dsub : (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ D_sub := ⟨⟨hy_strip_sub, hy_arc⟩, ht0_ball⟩
    obtain ⟨hs0_t0, hs1_t0⟩ := h_arc_slice_t0 y hy_δ0 (by linarith)
    refine ⟨⟨⟨hp_Dsub, ?_⟩, ⟨hp_Dsub, ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, d0_fn, hs0_t0, sub_self]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε_s_pos
    · simp only [Set.mem_preimage, d1_fn, hs1_t0, sub_self]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε_s_pos
    · simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
      intro k _
      refine ⟨hp_Dsub, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage]
      have hz_eq : z_orb y (t₀ : ℂ) k.val = A.s_ext y (idx k.val) := by
        have hk_cases : k.val < N ∨ k.val = N ∨ k.val = N + 1 := by omega
        rcases hk_cases with hk_lt | hk_N | hk_N1
        · simp only [z_orb, hk_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          have h_idx_k : idx k.val = ⟨k.val, hk_lt⟩ := by
            apply Fin.ext; dsimp [idx]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hk_lt
          rw [h_idx_k, A.s_ext_agrees y hy_arc hy_strip_h ⟨k.val, hk_lt⟩]
          dsimp [sliceImpactSeq]; norm_cast
        · rw [hk_N]
          simp only [z_orb, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte, hNt0]
          have hy_tube0 : (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
            have h0 := (h_tube y hy_strip_sub (t₀ : ℂ) ht0_ball).1 0 (by omega)
            simpa using h0
          have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) hy_tube0
          dsimp at hqp
          rw [hqp, add_sub_cancel_right, hs0_t0, h_idxN, h_idx0, ← hf0_eq_fin0]
        · rw [hk_N1]
          have h_not_lt : ¬ (N + 1 < N) := by omega
          simp only [z_orb, h_not_lt, ↓reduceIte]
          have h_arg : y + ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (t₀ : ℂ) = (y + (t₀ : ℂ)) + 2 * Real.pi := by
            push_cast; linear_combination hNt0
          have hy_tube1 : (y + (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
            have h1 := (h_tube y hy_strip_sub (t₀ : ℂ) ht0_ball).1 1 (by omega)
            simpa using h1
          have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (y + (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) hy_tube1
          dsimp at hqp
          rw [h_arg, hqp, add_sub_cancel_right, hs1_t0, h_idxN1, h_idx1, ← hf1_eq_fin1]
      rw [hz_eq, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      exact (h_arc_near y (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_fix hy_δ0) (idx k.val)).1

  obtain ⟨U_y, V_t, _, hV_t_open, hK_sub_Uy, ht0_sub_Vt, hUV_sub_O⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma hK_μ_compact isCompact_singleton hO_good_open h_Kμ_sub
  obtain ⟨r_V, hr_V_pos, hr_V_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV_t_open (t₀ : ℂ) (ht0_sub_Vt (Set.mem_singleton _))
  let r_μ : ℝ := min r_V (r_tube / 2)
  have hr_μ_pos : 0 < r_μ := lt_min hr_V_pos (half_pos hr_tube_pos)
  have hr_μ_lt : r_μ < S.r_star - t₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (lt_trans (half_lt_self hr_tube_pos) hr_tube_lt)
  refine ⟨r_μ, hr_μ_pos, hr_μ_lt, ?_⟩
  intro y hy_ball hy_im t ht_ball
  have h_pt_O : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1), z.im < h - μ →
      (z, t) ∈ O_good := by
    intro z hz_ball hz_im
    have hz_K : z ∈ K_μ := ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz_ball, le_of_lt hz_im⟩
    exact hUV_sub_O ⟨hK_sub_Uy hz_K, hr_V_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) ht_ball)⟩
  have hyt_O : (y, t) ∈ O_good := h_pt_O y hy_ball hy_im
  have hyt_Dsub : (y, t) ∈ D_sub := hyt_O.1.1.1
  have hy_tube_all := (h_tube y hyt_Dsub.1.1 t hyt_Dsub.2).1
  have hy_vanish_all := (h_tube y hyt_Dsub.1.1 t hyt_Dsub.2).2
  have hyt_tube0 : (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by simpa using hy_tube_all 0 (by omega)
  have hyt_tube1 : (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    simpa using hy_tube_all 1 (by omega)
  have hd0_lt : ‖S.𝔰 (y, t) - f0 y‖ < ε_s := by
    have hm := hyt_O.1.1.2
    rwa [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hm
  have hd1_lt : ‖S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - f1 y‖ < ε_s := by
    have hm := hyt_O.1.2.2
    rwa [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hm
  have hy_Bin : y ∈ B_in := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy_ball
  have hw0_Kin : f0 y ∈ K_in := ⟨y, hy_Bin, rfl⟩
  have hw0_Kmid : f0 y ∈ K_mid :=
    Set.image_mono (Subset.trans h_in_sub_mid h_Umid_sub_Bmid) hw0_Kin
  have hw_Wmid : S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ W_mid := by
    apply hε₀_thick
    rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
    exact ⟨f0 y, hw0_Kin, by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd0_lt hε_s_le_0⟩
  have hw_Kmid : S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ K_mid := Set.image_mono h_Umid_sub_Bmid hw_Wmid
  have hw_img_δ0 : S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ f0 '' Metric.ball y_star δ_0 :=
    Set.image_mono (Subset.trans h_Umid_sub_Bmid h_Bmid_sub_δ0) hw_Wmid
  have hs0_y : s0_inv (f0 y) = y :=
    hs0_left_inv_chart y (h_Bmid_sub_chart (h_Umid_sub_Bmid (h_in_sub_mid hy_Bin)))
  have hU_mem : s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_1 := by
    have hd_inv : dist (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))) (s0_inv (f0 y)) < (1 / 4 : ℝ) * δ_1 :=
      hε₁_uc _ hw_Kmid _ hw0_Kmid
        (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd0_lt hε_s_le_1)
    rw [hs0_y] at hd_inv
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy_ball ⊢
    linarith [dist_triangle (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))) y y_star]
  have hV_mem : S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - f1 (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 := by
    have hd_f1 : ‖f1 (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))) - f1 y‖ < δ_v1 / 2 := by
      have h_uc := hε₂_uc _ hw_Kmid _ hw0_Kmid
        (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hd0_lt hε_s_le_2)
      rwa [hs0_y, dist_eq_norm] at h_uc
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have h_tri : ‖S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - f1 (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))‖ ≤
        ‖S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - f1 y‖ + ‖f1 y - f1 (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))‖ := by
      simpa using norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (S.𝔰 (y + t, t)) (f1 y)
        (f1 (s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t))))
    rw [norm_sub_rev (f1 y)] at h_tri
    linarith [lt_of_lt_of_le hd1_lt hε_s_le_v1]
  refine ⟨hyt_tube0, hyt_tube1, hw_img_δ0, ⟨hU_mem, hV_mem⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hy'_ball hy'_im
  let y' : ℂ := y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ))
  have hy't_O : (y', t) ∈ O_good := h_pt_O y' hy'_ball hy'_im
  have hy'_tube_all := (h_tube y' hy't_O.1.1.1.1.1 t hy't_O.1.1.1.2).1
  have hy't_tube0 : (y', t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    simpa using hy'_tube_all 0 (by omega)
  have hy't_tube1 : (y' + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X := by
    simpa using hy'_tube_all 1 (by omega)
  have hz_near_all : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 → ‖z_orb y t k - s_star_pt (idx k)‖ < η_orb := by
    intro k hk
    let k_fin : Fin (N + 2) := ⟨k, by omega⟩
    have hm := hyt_O.2
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter] at hm
    have h_pre := (hm k_fin (Finset.mem_univ k_fin)).2
    rwa [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at h_pre
  have hz_strip : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N + 1 → z_orb y t m ∈ horizStrip S.H := by
    intro m hm
    have hw_strip : S.𝔰 (y + (m : ℂ) * t, t) ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
      S.𝔰_maps_to _ (hy_tube_all m hm)
    dsimp [z_orb]
    split_ifs
    · exact hw_strip
    · change |(S.𝔰 (y + (m : ℂ) * t, t) - 2 * Real.pi).im| < S.H
      have him_eq : (S.𝔰 (y + (m : ℂ) * t, t) - 2 * Real.pi).im =
          (S.𝔰 (y + (m : ℂ) * t, t)).im := by
        simp [Complex.sub_im]
      rw [him_eq]; exact hw_strip
  have hz_vanish : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N →
      clearedReflectE S (z_orb y t (k - 1)) (z_orb y t k) (z_orb y t (k + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk1 hkN
    have h_raw := hy_vanish_all k hk1 hkN
    have hkm1_lt : k - 1 < N := by omega
    have h_km1 : z_orb y t (k - 1) = S.𝔰 (y + ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t) := by
      simp only [z_orb, hkm1_lt, ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases hk_lt : k + 1 < N
    · have hk_lt' : k < N := by omega
      have h_k : z_orb y t k = S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) := by
        simp only [z_orb, hk_lt', ↓reduceIte]
      have h_kp1 : z_orb y t (k + 1) = S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t) := by
        simp only [z_orb, hk_lt, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [h_km1, h_k, h_kp1]; exact h_raw
    · by_cases hk_eq_N : k = N
      · have hk_not : ¬ (k < N) := by omega
        have h_k_add : z_orb y t k + 2 * Real.pi = S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) := by
          simp only [z_orb, hk_not, ↓reduceIte]; ring
        have h_kp1_add : z_orb y t (k + 1) + 2 * Real.pi =
            S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t) := by
          simp only [z_orb, hk_lt, ↓reduceIte]; ring
        have hp1 := hRefl.periodic_0 (z_orb y t (k - 1)) (z_orb y t k)
          (z_orb y t (k + 1) + 2 * Real.pi) (hz_strip k (by omega))
        have hp2 := hRefl.periodic_p (z_orb y t (k - 1)) (z_orb y t k)
          (z_orb y t (k + 1)) (hz_strip (k + 1) (by omega))
        rw [← hp2, ← hp1, h_km1, h_k_add, h_kp1_add]; exact h_raw
      · have hk_lt' : k < N := by omega
        have h_k : z_orb y t k = S.𝔰 (y + (k : ℂ) * t, t) := by
          simp only [z_orb, hk_lt', ↓reduceIte]
        have h_kp1_add : z_orb y t (k + 1) + 2 * Real.pi =
            S.𝔰 (y + ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t, t) := by
          simp only [z_orb, hk_lt, ↓reduceIte]; ring
        have hp2 := hRefl.periodic_p (z_orb y t (k - 1)) (z_orb y t k)
          (z_orb y t (k + 1)) (hz_strip (k + 1) (by omega))
        rw [← hp2, h_km1, h_k, h_kp1_add]; exact h_raw
  have hR_orb_eq := hR_orbit_unique (z_orb y t) hz_near_all hz_vanish
  have hz0_eq : z_orb y t 0 = S.𝔰 (y, t) := by
    have h0_lt : 0 < N := by omega
    simp only [z_orb, h0_lt, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hz1_eq : z_orb y t 1 = S.𝔰 (y + t, t) := by
    have h1_lt : 1 < N := by omega
    simp only [z_orb, h1_lt, ↓reduceIte, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  have hzN_eq : z_orb y t N = S.𝔰 (y', t) := by
    simp only [z_orb, lt_irrefl, ↓reduceIte]
    have h_arg : y + (N : ℂ) * t = y' + 2 * Real.pi := by
      dsimp [y']; linear_combination hNt0
    have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (y', t) hy't_tube0
    dsimp at hqp
    rw [h_arg, hqp, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hzN1_eq : z_orb y t (N + 1) = S.𝔰 (y' + t, t) := by
    have h_not_lt : ¬ (N + 1 < N) := by omega
    simp only [z_orb, h_not_lt, ↓reduceIte]
    have h_arg : y + ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * t = (y' + t) + 2 * Real.pi := by
      dsimp [y']; push_cast; linear_combination hNt0
    have hqp := S.𝔰_quasiperiodic (y' + t, t) hy't_tube1
    dsimp at hqp
    rw [h_arg, hqp, add_sub_cancel_right]
  rw [hz0_eq, hz1_eq, hzN_eq, hzN1_eq] at hR_orb_eq
  have hw_Wchart : (S.𝔰 (y, t), S.𝔰 (y + t, t)) ∈ W_chart ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℂ) :=
    ⟨Set.image_mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ0_lt_chart)) hw_img_δ0, trivial⟩
  change Φ_inv (R_plus (Φ (Φ_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t), S.𝔰 (y + t, t))))) =
    Φ_inv (S.𝔰 (y', t), S.𝔰 (y' + t, t))
  rw [hΦ_right_inv _ hw_Wchart, hR_orb_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(y_star : ℂ) (δ_0 δ_v0 δ_1 δ_v1 : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ_1 ∧ δ_1 < δ_0 ∧ 0 < δ_v1 ∧ δ_v1 < δ_v0)
    (F_plus F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (hFp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0))
    (hFm_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_minus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0))
    (hFp_zero : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0))
    (hFm_zero : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, F_minus (u, 0) = (u, 0))
    (hF_inv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
      F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
      F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v))
    (y_sub : ℂ) (r_sub r_b : ℝ)
    (hr_sub : 0 < r_sub ∧ 0 < r_b ∧ r_b ≤ r_sub / 2)
    (h_sub_ball : Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_0)
    (U_loc V_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hU_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_loc (Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b))
    (hV_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_loc (Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b))
    (hUV_zero : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub r_sub, U_loc (y, 0) = y ∧ V_loc (y, 0) = 0)
    (hUV_conj : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_sub (r_sub / 2), ∀ b ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b,
      (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
      F_plus (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) = (U_loc (y + b, b), V_loc (y + b, b))) :
    Nonempty (ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion y_star δ_0 δ_v1 F_plus F_minus)

(y_star : ℂ) (δ_0 δ_v0 δ_1 δ_v1 : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ_1 ∧ δ_1 < δ_0 ∧ 0 < δ_v1 ∧ δ_v1 < δ_v0)
    (F_plus F_minus : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ × ℂ)
    (hFp_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F_plus (Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0))

    (hF_inv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1,
      F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧
      F_minus (F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v))
    (y_sub : ℂ) (r_sub r_b : ℝ)
    (hr_sub : 0 < r_sub ∧ 0 < r_b ∧ r_b ≤ r_sub / 2)
    (h_sub_ball : Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ⊆ Metric.ball y_star δ_0)
    (U_loc V_loc : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (hU_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U_loc (Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b))
    (hV_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V_loc (Metric.ball y_sub r_sub ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_b))

      (U_loc (y, b), V_loc (y, b)) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v0 ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases hδ with ⟨hδ1_pos, hδ1_lt_δ0, hδv1_pos, hδv1_lt_δv0⟩
  have hδ0_pos : 0 < δ_0 := lt_trans hδ1_pos hδ1_lt_δ0
  have hδv0_pos : 0 < δ_v0 := lt_trans hδv1_pos hδv1_lt_δv0
  rcases hr_sub with ⟨hr_sub_pos, hr_b_pos, hr_b_le⟩
  
  have h_circle_param_holo : ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ∀ (W_G : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ)), IsOpen W_G →
      ∀ (G : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ G W_G →
      ∀ (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)), IsOpen U →
      (∀ p ∈ U, ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, (p, z) ∈ W_G) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun p : ℂ × ℂ =>
          (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G (p, circleMap 0 r θ))
        U := by
    intro r hr W_G hWG_open G hG_diff U hU_open h_maps p₀ hp₀
    obtain ⟨r_ball, hr_ball_pos, hr_ball_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU_open p₀ hp₀
    let η_b : ℝ := r_ball / 3
    have hη_pos : 0 < η_b := by dsimp [η_b]; linarith
    have hcb_sub_U : Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) ⊆ U := by
      intro q hq
      apply hr_ball_sub
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      dsimp [η_b] at hq
      linarith
    have hball_sub_cb : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ η_b,
        Metric.ball p η_b ⊆ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) := by
      intro p hp q hq
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hp hq
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have h_tri : dist q p₀ ≤ dist q p + dist p p₀ := dist_triangle q p p₀
      linarith
    let K_prod : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r
    have hK_compact : IsCompact K_prod :=
      (isCompact_closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b)).prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : ℂ) r)
    have hK_sub_WG : K_prod ⊆ W_G := fun x hx => h_maps x.1 (hcb_sub_U hx.1) x.2 hx.2
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ :=
      hK_compact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hG_diff.continuousOn.mono hK_sub_WG)
    let M : ℝ := max M₀ 0
    have hM_bound : ∀ x ∈ K_prod, ‖G x‖ ≤ M :=
      fun x hx => le_trans (hM₀ x hx) (le_max_left M₀ 0)
    let L_inl : (ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (ℂ × ℂ)).prod 0
    let ℱ : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ := fun p θ => G (p, circleMap 0 r θ)
    let ℱ' : (ℂ × ℂ) → ℝ → ((ℂ × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
      fun p θ => (fderiv ℂ G (p, circleMap 0 r θ)).comp L_inl
    have h_in_K : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b), ∀ θ : ℝ,
        (q, circleMap 0 r θ) ∈ K_prod :=
      fun q hq θ => ⟨hq, circleMap_mem_sphere 0 hr.le θ⟩
    have h_fderiv_q : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b), ∀ θ : ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun p' => ℱ p' θ) (ℱ' q θ) q := by
      intro q hq θ
      have hG_at : DifferentiableAt ℂ G (q, circleMap 0 r θ) :=
        hG_diff.differentiableAt (hWG_open.mem_nhds (hK_sub_WG (h_in_K q hq θ)))
      have h_inner : HasFDerivAt (fun p' : ℂ × ℂ => (p', circleMap 0 r θ)) L_inl q :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id q).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const (circleMap 0 r θ) q)
      exact hG_at.hasFDerivAt.comp q h_inner
    have hℱ_cont : ∀ q ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b), Continuous (ℱ q) := by
      intro q hq
      exact hG_diff.continuousOn.comp_continuous
        (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap 0 r))
        (fun θ => hK_sub_WG (h_in_K q hq θ))
    have hp₀_cb : p₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by linarith)
    have hs_nhds : Metric.ball p₀ η_b ∈ nhds p₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds p₀ hη_pos
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀,
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (ℱ p)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict MeasureTheory.volume (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      filter_upwards [hs_nhds] with p hp
      exact (hℱ_cont p (hball_sub_cb p hp (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos))).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hF_int : IntervalIntegrable (ℱ p₀) MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hℱ_cont p₀ hp₀_cb).intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    have hF'_meas : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (ℱ' p₀)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict MeasureTheory.volume (Set.uIoc 0 (2 * Real.pi))) := by
      have h_comp : Measurable (fun L : ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ => L.comp L_inl) :=
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (ℂ × ℂ) ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) ℂ).flip L_inl).continuous.measurable
      have h_fd : Measurable (fderiv ℂ G) := measurable_fderiv ℂ G
      have h_pt : Measurable (fun θ : ℝ => (p₀, circleMap (0 : ℂ) r θ)) :=
        (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_circleMap 0 r)).measurable
      exact (h_comp.comp (h_fd.comp h_pt)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_bound : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball p₀ η_b, ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖ℱ' p θ‖ ≤ (2 * M) / η_b := by
      intro p hp θ
      have hp_cb : p ∈ Metric.closedBall p₀ (2 * η_b) :=
        hball_sub_cb p hp (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)
      have hg_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q => ℱ q θ) (Metric.ball p η_b) :=
        fun q hq =>
          (h_fderiv_q q (hball_sub_cb p hp hq) θ).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      have hg_maps : Set.MapsTo (fun q => ℱ q θ) (Metric.ball p η_b)
          (Metric.closedBall (ℱ p θ) (2 * M)) := by
        intro q hq
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h1 : ‖ℱ q θ‖ ≤ M := hM_bound _ (h_in_K q (hball_sub_cb p hp hq) θ)
        have h2 : ‖ℱ p θ‖ ≤ M := hM_bound _ (h_in_K p hp_cb θ)
        have h_tri : ‖ℱ q θ - ℱ p θ‖ ≤ ‖ℱ q θ‖ + ‖ℱ p θ‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        linarith
      have h_est := Complex.norm_fderiv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hg_diff hg_maps hη_pos
      rwa [(h_fderiv_q p hp_cb θ).fderiv] at h_est
    have h_int_deriv :=
      intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le hs_nhds hF_meas hF_int
        hF'_meas
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ p hp => h_bound p hp θ))
        intervalIntegrable_const
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ p hp =>
          h_fderiv_q p (hball_sub_cb p hp (Metric.mem_ball_self hη_pos)) θ))
    exact (h_int_deriv.differentiableAt.const_mul (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)).differentiableWithinAt
  
  have holo_v_div : ∀ (U_1 : Set ℂ), IsOpen U_1 → ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ H (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
      (∀ u ∈ U_1, H (u, 0) = 0) →
      ∃ Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Q (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 2)) ∧
        ∀ u ∈ U_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 2), H (u, v) = v * Q (u, v) := by
    intro U_1 hU1_open R hR H hH_holo hH_zero
    let r : ℝ := R / 2
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := half_pos hR
    have hr_lt_R : r < R := half_lt_self hR
    let Q : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p =>
      (((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          H (p.1, circleMap 0 r θ) / (circleMap 0 r θ - p.2)
    refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · let W_G : Set ((ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ) :=
        {x | (x.1.1, x.2) ∈ U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∧ x.2 - x.1.2 ≠ 0}
      have hWG_open : IsOpen W_G :=
        ((hU1_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).preimage
          ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)).inter
          (isOpen_ne.preimage (continuous_snd.sub (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)))
      have hG_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => H (x.1.1, x.2) / (x.2 - x.1.2)) W_G := by
        have hnum : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => H (x.1.1, x.2)) W_G :=
          hH_holo.comp
            (((differentiable_fst.comp differentiable_fst).prodMk differentiable_snd).differentiableOn)
            (fun _ hx => hx.1)
        have hinv : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun x : (ℂ × ℂ) × ℂ => (x.2 - x.1.2)⁻¹) W_G :=
          differentiableOn_inv.comp
            ((differentiable_snd.sub (differentiable_snd.comp differentiable_fst)).differentiableOn)
            (fun _ hx => hx.2)
        exact (hnum.mul hinv).congr (fun _ _ => div_eq_mul_inv _ _)
      have h_maps : ∀ p ∈ U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
          (p, z) ∈ W_G := by
        intro p hp z hz
        have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = r := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hz
        have hv_norm : ‖p.2‖ < r := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp.2
        refine ⟨⟨hp.1, mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
        intro h_eq
        have hzv : z = p.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp h_eq
        rw [hzv] at hz_norm
        linarith
      exact h_circle_param_holo r hr_pos W_G hWG_open _ hG_diff
        (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) (hU1_open.prod Metric.isOpen_ball) h_maps
    · intro u hu v hv
      let h_u : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => H (u, z)
      have h_hu : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_u (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
        hH_holo.comp ((differentiable_const u).prodMk differentiable_id).differentiableOn
          (fun z hz => ⟨hu, hz⟩)
      have h_dc : DiffContOnCl ℂ h_u (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) :=
        h_hu.diffContOnCl_ball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr_lt_R)
      have hc_v := h_dc.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul hv
      have hc_0 := h_dc.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul (Metric.mem_ball_self hr_pos)
      have h_hu0 : h_u 0 = 0 := hH_zero u hu
      rw [circleIntegral] at hc_v hc_0
      simp only [deriv_circleMap, smul_eq_mul, sub_zero, h_hu0, mul_zero] at hc_v hc_0
      have hv_norm : ‖v‖ < r := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hv
      have hζ_norm : ∀ θ : ℝ, ‖circleMap 0 r θ‖ = r := by
        intro θ
        rw [norm_circleMap_zero, abs_of_pos hr_pos]
      have hζ_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap 0 r θ ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ h0
        have := hζ_norm θ
        rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
        linarith
      have hζv_ne : ∀ θ : ℝ, circleMap 0 r θ - v ≠ 0 := by
        intro θ h0
        have hzv : circleMap 0 r θ = v := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
        have := hζ_norm θ
        rw [hzv] at this
        linarith
      have h_hu_circ : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => h_u (circleMap 0 r θ)) :=
        h_hu.continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_circleMap 0 r)
          (fun θ => mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (by rw [hζ_norm θ]; exact hr_lt_R))
      have hg1_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
          circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ - v)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ))) :=
        ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const).mul
          ((((continuous_circleMap 0 r).sub continuous_const).inv₀ hζv_ne).mul h_hu_circ)
      have hg0_cont : Continuous (fun θ : ℝ =>
          circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ))) :=
        ((continuous_circleMap 0 r).mul continuous_const).mul
          (((continuous_circleMap 0 r).inv₀ hζ_ne).mul h_hu_circ)
      have h_sub_int : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ - v)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ)) -
           circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ))) =
          2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * h_u v := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
          (hg1_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi))
          (hg0_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 (2 * Real.pi)), hc_v, hc_0, sub_zero]
      have h_congr : ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ - v)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ)) -
           circleMap 0 r θ * Complex.I * ((circleMap 0 r θ)⁻¹ * h_u (circleMap 0 r θ))) =
          (Complex.I * v) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            H (u, circleMap 0 r θ) / (circleMap 0 r θ - v) := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun θ _ => ?_)
        have h1 := hζ_ne θ
        have h2 := hζv_ne θ
        dsimp [h_u]
        field_simp [h1, h2]
        ring
      rw [h_congr] at h_sub_int
      have h_pi_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
      have h_two_pi_ne : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero h_pi_ne
      have h_fac_ne : 2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero h_two_pi_ne Complex.I_ne_zero
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ h_fac_ne
      dsimp [Q, h_u] at h_sub_int ⊢
      rw [← h_sub_int]
      push_cast
      field_simp [h_pi_ne]
  have holo_v_jet2 : ∀ (U_1 : Set ℂ), IsOpen U_1 → ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ H (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
      (∀ u ∈ U_1, H (u, 0) = 0) →
      ∃ (c_1 : ℂ → ℂ) (Q_2 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ c_1 U_1 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_2 (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 4)) ∧
        ∀ u ∈ U_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 4),
          H (u, v) = c_1 u * v + v ^ 2 * Q_2 (u, v) := by
    intro U_1 hU1_open R hR H hH_holo hH_zero
    obtain ⟨Q_1, hQ1_holo, hQ1_eq⟩ := holo_v_div U_1 hU1_open R hR H hH_holo hH_zero
    have hR2_pos : 0 < R / 2 := half_pos hR
    let c_1 : ℂ → ℂ := fun u => Q_1 (u, 0)
    have hc1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ c_1 U_1 :=
      hQ1_holo.comp (differentiable_id.prodMk (differentiable_const (0 : ℂ))).differentiableOn
        (fun u hu => ⟨hu, Metric.mem_ball_self hR2_pos⟩)
    let H_1 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => Q_1 p - c_1 p.1
    have hH1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H_1 (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 2)) :=
      hQ1_holo.sub (hc1_holo.comp differentiable_fst.differentiableOn (fun _ hp => hp.1))
    have hH1_zero : ∀ u ∈ U_1, H_1 (u, 0) = 0 := fun u _ => sub_self (Q_1 (u, 0))
    obtain ⟨Q_2, hQ2_holo, hQ2_eq⟩ :=
      holo_v_div U_1 hU1_open (R / 2) hR2_pos H_1 hH1_holo hH1_zero
    have hR4_eq : R / 2 / 2 = R / 4 := by ring
    rw [hR4_eq] at hQ2_holo hQ2_eq
    refine ⟨c_1, Q_2, hc1_holo, hQ2_holo, ?_⟩
    intro u hu v hv
    have hv2 : v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 2) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hv
    have h1 := hQ1_eq u hu v hv2
    have h2 := hQ2_eq u hu v hv
    dsimp [H_1] at h2
    have hQ1_val : Q_1 (u, v) = c_1 u + v * Q_2 (u, v) := eq_add_of_sub_eq' h2
    rw [h1, hQ1_val]
    ring
  have holo_v_jet3 : ∀ (U_1 : Set ℂ), IsOpen U_1 → ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      ∀ (H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      DifferentiableOn ℂ H (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) →
      (∀ u ∈ U_1, H (u, 0) = 0) →
      ∃ (c_1 c_2 : ℂ → ℂ) (Q_3 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
        DifferentiableOn ℂ c_1 U_1 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ c_2 U_1 ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_3 (U_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (R / 8)) ∧
