                (v * q_v v) ^ 2 * A_minus (F_plus (u, v)) - u := by ring
          _ = u_p v + σ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) +
                (v * q_v v) ^ 2 * A_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v) - u := by
              rw [hFp_eq]
          _ = (F_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v)).1 - u := by
              rw [← hFm1_jet (u_p v) hup_δ0 (v * q_v v) hvq_ρ]
          _ = (F_minus (F_plus (u, v))).1 - u := by rw [← hFp_eq]
          _ = u - u := by rw [congrArg Prod.fst h_inv_eq]
          _ = v * 0 := by ring
      have h_lim_lhs : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun v : ℂ =>
            σ u + v * A_plus (u, v) + σ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v +
              v * q_v v ^ 2 * A_minus (F_plus (u, v)))
          flt0
          (nhds (σ u + 0 * A_plus (u, 0) + σ_minus u * 1 + 0 * 1 ^ 2 * A_minus (u, 0))) :=
        ((tendsto_const_nhds.add (ht_id.mul ht_Ap)).add (ht_σm.mul ht_qv)).add
          ((ht_id.mul (ht_qv.pow 2)).mul ht_Am)
      have h_uniq := tendsto_nhds_unique (h_lim_lhs.congr' h_ev1) tendsto_const_nhds
      linear_combination h_uniq
    have h_lamm_eq : lam_minus u = 1 := by
      have h_ev2 : (fun v : ℂ =>
          lam_minus (u_p v) * q_v v + v * τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
            v ^ 2 * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v))) =ᶠ[flt0]
          (fun _ : ℂ => 1) := by
        filter_upwards [hev_v] with v ⟨hv_ne, hv_ρ, hFp_mem⟩
        have hv_δv1 : v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 :=
          Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_v_le hv_ρ
        have h_inv_eq := (hF_inv u hu v hv_δv1).2
        have hFp_eq := hFp_form v hv_ρ
        have hup_δ0 : u_p v ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 := by
          have := hFp_mem.1; rwa [hFp_eq] at this
        have hvq_ρ : v * q_v v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v := by
          have := hFp_mem.2; rwa [hFp_eq] at this
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hv_ne
        calc v * (lam_minus (u_p v) * q_v v + v * τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
              v ^ 2 * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)))
            = lam_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) ^ 2 +
                (v * q_v v) ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)) := by ring
          _ = lam_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) ^ 2 +
                (v * q_v v) ^ 3 * B_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v) := by rw [hFp_eq]
          _ = (F_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v)).2 := by
              rw [← hFm2_jet (u_p v) hup_δ0 (v * q_v v) hvq_ρ]
          _ = (F_minus (F_plus (u, v))).2 := by rw [← hFp_eq]
          _ = v := congrArg Prod.snd h_inv_eq
          _ = v * 1 := by ring
      have h_lim_lhs : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun v : ℂ =>
            lam_minus (u_p v) * q_v v + v * τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
              v ^ 2 * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)))
          flt0
          (nhds (lam_minus u * 1 + 0 * τ_minus u * 1 ^ 2 + 0 ^ 2 * 1 ^ 3 * B_minus (u, 0))) :=
        ((ht_lamm.mul ht_qv).add ((ht_id.mul ht_τm).mul (ht_qv.pow 2))).add
          (((ht_id.pow 2).mul (ht_qv.pow 3)).mul ht_Bm)
      have h_uniq := tendsto_nhds_unique (h_lim_lhs.congr' h_ev2) tendsto_const_nhds
      linear_combination h_uniq
    exact ⟨h_σm_eq, h_lamm_eq⟩
  have hσm_all : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, σ_minus u = -σ u :=
    ball_analytic_eqOn σ_minus (fun u => -σ u) hσm_holo hσ_holo.neg
      y_star δ_1 hδ1_pos h_δ1_sub_δ0 (fun w hw => (h_inv_order1 w hw).1)
  have hlamm_all : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, lam_minus u = 1 :=
    ball_analytic_eqOn lam_minus (fun _ => 1) hlamm_holo (differentiableOn_const 1)
      y_star δ_1 hδ1_pos h_δ1_sub_δ0 (fun w hw => (h_inv_order1 w hw).2)
  have h_inv_order2 : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_1, τ_minus u = deriv σ u := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_δ0 : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 := h_δ1_sub_δ0 hu
    have ht_id : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => v) flt0 (nhds 0) :=
      Filter.tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have ht_uv_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => (u, v)) (nhds 0) (nhds (u, 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.prodMk_nhds Filter.tendsto_id
    have ht_Fp_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => F_plus (u, v)) (nhds 0) (nhds (u, 0)) := by
      have h0 : F_plus (u, 0) = (u, 0) := hFp_zero u hu_δ0
      rw [← h0]
      exact (hFp_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hu_δ0, Metric.mem_ball_self hδv0_pos⟩)).tendsto.comp ht_uv_nhds
    have ht_Ap_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => A_plus (u, v)) (nhds 0)
        (nhds (A_plus (u, 0))) :=
      (hAp_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hu_δ0, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_v_pos⟩)).tendsto.comp ht_uv_nhds
    have ht_Bp_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => B_plus (u, v)) (nhds 0)
        (nhds (B_plus (u, 0))) :=
      (hBp_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hu_δ0, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_v_pos⟩)).tendsto.comp ht_uv_nhds
    let u_p : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v)
    let q_v : ℂ → ℂ := fun v => 1 - deriv σ u * v + v ^ 2 * B_plus (u, v)
    have ht_up_nhds : Filter.Tendsto u_p (nhds 0) (nhds u) := by
      have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => u + σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_plus (u, v))
          (nhds 0) (nhds (u + σ u * 0 + 0 ^ 2 * A_plus (u, 0))) :=
        (tendsto_const_nhds.add (tendsto_const_nhds.mul Filter.tendsto_id)).add
          ((Filter.tendsto_id.pow 2).mul ht_Ap_nhds)
      simpa [u_p] using h
    have ht_qv : Filter.Tendsto q_v flt0 (nhds 1) := by
      have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => 1 - deriv σ u * v + v ^ 2 * B_plus (u, v))
          (nhds 0) (nhds (1 - deriv σ u * 0 + 0 ^ 2 * B_plus (u, 0))) :=
        (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (tendsto_const_nhds.mul Filter.tendsto_id)).add
          ((Filter.tendsto_id.pow 2).mul ht_Bp_nhds)
      exact (by simpa [q_v] using h : Filter.Tendsto q_v (nhds 0) (nhds 1)).mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have ht_Bp : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => B_plus (u, v)) flt0 (nhds (B_plus (u, 0))) :=
      ht_Bp_nhds.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have ht_τm : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => τ_minus (u_p v)) flt0 (nhds (τ_minus u)) :=
      ((hτm_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hu_δ0)).tendsto.comp ht_up_nhds).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have ht_Bm : Filter.Tendsto (fun v : ℂ => B_minus (F_plus (u, v))) flt0
        (nhds (B_minus (u, 0))) :=
      ((hBm_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
          ⟨hu_δ0, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_v_pos⟩)).tendsto.comp ht_Fp_nhds).mono_left
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hev_v : ∀ᶠ v : ℂ in flt0,
        v ≠ 0 ∧ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∧
          F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v := by
      have h1 : {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ ∈ flt0 := self_mem_nhdsWithin
      have h2 : Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v ∈ flt0 :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0 hρ_v_pos)
      have h3 : {v : ℂ | F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v} ∈
          flt0 :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (ht_Fp_nhds.eventually
          ((Metric.isOpen_ball.prod Metric.isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
            ⟨hu_δ0, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ_v_pos⟩))
      filter_upwards [h1, h2, h3] with v hv1 hv2 hv3
      exact ⟨hv1, hv2, hv3⟩
    have hFp_form : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v, F_plus (u, v) = (u_p v, v * q_v v) := by
      intro v hv
      rw [hFp_eq_all u hu_δ0 v hv]
      refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
      dsimp [q_v]
      ring
    have h_ev_v2 : (fun v : ℂ =>
        -deriv σ u + v * B_plus (u, v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
          v * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v))) =ᶠ[flt0]
        (fun _ : ℂ => 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hev_v] with v ⟨hv_ne, hv_ρ, hFp_mem⟩
      have hv_δv1 : v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ_v1 :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ_v_le hv_ρ
      have h_inv_eq := (hF_inv u hu v hv_δv1).2
      have hFp_eq := hFp_form v hv_ρ
      have hup_δ0 : u_p v ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0 := by
        have := hFp_mem.1; rwa [hFp_eq] at this
      have hvq_ρ : v * q_v v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v := by
        have := hFp_mem.2; rwa [hFp_eq] at this
      have hvq_expand : 1 * (v * q_v v) = v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v) := by
        dsimp [q_v]; ring
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hv_ne)
      calc v ^ 2 * (-deriv σ u + v * B_plus (u, v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
            v * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)))
          = (v - deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_plus (u, v)) +
              τ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) ^ 2 +
              (v * q_v v) ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)) - v := by ring
        _ = 1 * (v * q_v v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) ^ 2 +
              (v * q_v v) ^ 3 * B_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v) - v := by
            rw [hvq_expand, hFp_eq]
        _ = lam_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * (v * q_v v) ^ 2 +
              (v * q_v v) ^ 3 * B_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v) - v := by
            rw [hlamm_all (u_p v) hup_δ0]
        _ = (F_minus (u_p v, v * q_v v)).2 - v := by
            rw [← hFm2_jet (u_p v) hup_δ0 (v * q_v v) hvq_ρ]
        _ = (F_minus (F_plus (u, v))).2 - v := by rw [← hFp_eq]
        _ = v - v := by rw [congrArg Prod.snd h_inv_eq]
        _ = v ^ 2 * 0 := by ring
    have h_lim_lhs : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun v : ℂ =>
          -deriv σ u + v * B_plus (u, v) + τ_minus (u_p v) * q_v v ^ 2 +
            v * q_v v ^ 3 * B_minus (F_plus (u, v)))
        flt0
        (nhds (-deriv σ u + 0 * B_plus (u, 0) + τ_minus u * 1 ^ 2 +
          0 * 1 ^ 3 * B_minus (u, 0))) :=
      ((tendsto_const_nhds.add (ht_id.mul ht_Bp)).add (ht_τm.mul (ht_qv.pow 2))).add
        ((ht_id.mul (ht_qv.pow 3)).mul ht_Bm)
    have h_uniq := tendsto_nhds_unique (h_lim_lhs.congr' h_ev_v2) tendsto_const_nhds
    linear_combination h_uniq
  have hτm_all : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, τ_minus u = deriv σ u :=
    ball_analytic_eqOn τ_minus (deriv σ) hτm_holo (hσ_holo.deriv Metric.isOpen_ball)
      y_star δ_1 hδ1_pos h_δ1_sub_δ0 h_inv_order2
  have hFm_eq_all : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_star δ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v,
      F_minus (u, v) =
        (u - σ u * v + v ^ 2 * A_minus (u, v),
         v + deriv σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * B_minus (u, v)) := by
    intro u hu v hv
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [hFm1_jet u hu v hv, hσm_all u hu]
      ring
    · rw [hFm2_jet u hu v hv, hlamm_all u hu, hτm_all u hu]
      ring
  exact ⟨{
    ρ_v := ρ_v
    ρ_v_pos := hρ_v_pos
    ρ_v_le := hρ_v_le
    σ := σ
    A_plus := A_plus
    B_plus := B_plus
    A_minus := A_minus
    B_minus := B_minus
    σ_holo := hσ_holo
    σ_nonzero_exists := hσ_nonzero_exists
    rem_holo := ⟨hAp_holo, hBp_holo, hAm_holo, hBm_holo⟩
    F_plus_eq := hFp_eq_all
    F_minus_eq := hFm_eq_all
  }⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (x_star : ℝ) (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star)
    (C : ConjugatedReturnMapArcData S x_star A)
    (E : ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion
      ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      C.δ_0 C.δ_v1 C.F_plus C.F_minus) :
    Nonempty (ReturnMapNormalFormData S)

signature.name: edge_recentering_and_subheight_step
signature.statement:
(S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (x_star : ℝ) (A : ExtendedPeriodicSliceArc S x_star)
    (C : ConjugatedReturnMapArcData S x_star A)
    (E : ConjugacyNormalFormExpansion
      ((x_star : ℂ) + (sliceHeight S (oddSliceN S) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      C.δ_0 C.δ_v1 C.F_plus C.F_minus) :
    Nonempty (ReturnMapNormalFormData S)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let N : ℕ := oddSliceN S
  let t₀ : ℝ := sliceParamT0 N
  let h : ℝ := sliceHeight S N
  let y_star : ℂ := (x_star : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hN_ge_three : 3 ≤ N := by
    dsimp [N, oddSliceN]
    omega
  have hN_pos_R : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hN_ge_three
  have hN_ne_R : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hN_pos_R
  have hh_pos : 0 < h := by
    have h_lt : A.δ_arc < h / 2 := A.δ_arc_lt_half_h
    have h_pos_arc : 0 < A.δ_arc := A.δ_arc_pos
    linarith
  rcases C.δ_bounds with ⟨hδ1_pos, hδ1_lt_δ0, hδ0_le_arc, hδv1_pos, hδv1_lt_δv0⟩
  have hδ0_pos : 0 < C.δ_0 := lt_trans hδ1_pos hδ1_lt_δ0
  have hρv_pos : 0 < E.ρ_v := E.ρ_v_pos
  have hρv_le_δv1 : E.ρ_v ≤ C.δ_v1 := E.ρ_v_le
  have hρv_lt_δv0 : E.ρ_v < C.δ_v0 := lt_of_le_of_lt hρv_le_δv1 hδv1_lt_δv0

  
  have hx_edge_exists : ∃ x_edge : ℝ, |x_edge - x_star| < C.δ_1 / 2 ∧
      E.σ ((x_edge : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h_all_zero
    push Not at h_all_zero
    have hσ_anal : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ E.σ (Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0) :=
      E.σ_holo.analyticOnNhd Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hB0_preconn : IsPreconnected (Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0) :=
      (convex_ball y_star C.δ_0).isPreconnected
    have hy_star_mem : y_star ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 :=
      Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0_pos
    have h_freq : ∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin y_star {y_star}ᶜ, E.σ z = 0 := by
      rw [Filter.frequently_iff]
      intro U hU
      obtain ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hU
      let δ : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (C.δ_1 / 4)
      have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_min (half_pos hε_pos) (by linarith)
      let x : ℝ := x_star + δ
      let z : ℂ := (x : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
      have hz_sub : z - y_star = (δ : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [z, x, y_star]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hz_dist : dist z y_star = δ := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, hz_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδ_pos]
      have hz_ball : z ∈ Metric.ball y_star ε := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, hz_dist]
        have : δ ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
        linarith
      have hz_ne : z ∈ ({y_star}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := by
        simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        intro h_eq
        have h0 : (δ : ℂ) = 0 := by rw [← hz_sub, h_eq, sub_self]
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hδ_pos) h0
      refine ⟨z, hε_sub ⟨hz_ball, hz_ne⟩, ?_⟩
      have hx_abs : |x - x_star| < C.δ_1 / 2 := by
        have : x - x_star = δ := by dsimp [x]; ring
        rw [this, abs_of_pos hδ_pos]
        have : δ ≤ C.δ_1 / 4 := min_le_right _ _
        linarith
      exact h_all_zero x hx_abs
    have h_eq_zero : Set.EqOn E.σ 0 (Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0) :=
      hσ_anal.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq_zero hB0_preconn hy_star_mem h_freq
    obtain ⟨y_sub, hy_sub_mem, hy_sub_ne⟩ := E.σ_nonzero_exists
    exact hy_sub_ne (h_eq_zero hy_sub_mem)
  obtain ⟨x_edge, hx_edge_dist, hσ_edge_ne⟩ := hx_edge_exists

  
  let y_edge : ℂ := (x_edge : ℂ) + (h : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hy_edge_dist : dist y_edge y_star = |x_edge - x_star| := by
    have h_sub : y_edge - y_star = ((x_edge - x_star : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      dsimp [y_edge, y_star]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [dist_eq_norm, h_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hy_edge_B0 : y_edge ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, hy_edge_dist]
    linarith
  have hσ_cont_edge : ContinuousAt E.σ y_edge :=
    E.σ_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy_edge_B0)
  obtain ⟨r_σ, hr_σ_pos, hr_σ_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hσ_cont_edge.eventually_ne hσ_edge_ne)
  let ρ_0 : ℝ := min (r_σ / 2) (min (C.δ_1 / 4) (h / 3))
  have hρ0_pos : 0 < ρ_0 :=
    lt_min (half_pos hr_σ_pos) (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith))
  have hρ0_le_rσ : ρ_0 ≤ r_σ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hρ0_le_δ1_4 : ρ_0 ≤ C.δ_1 / 4 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρ0_le_h3 : ρ_0 ≤ h / 3 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hρ0_lt_half_h : ρ_0 < h / 2 := by linarith
  have hσ_ne_zero : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0, E.σ u ≠ 0 := by
    intro u hu
    exact hr_σ_sub (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hu)
  have h_ball_ρ0_sub_34 :
      Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ⊆ Metric.ball y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * C.δ_1) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
    have h_tri : dist u y_star ≤ dist u y_edge + dist y_edge y_star :=
      dist_triangle u y_edge y_star
    linarith [hy_edge_dist]
  have h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ1 : Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ⊆ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_1 :=
    Subset.trans h_ball_ρ0_sub_34 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
  have h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 : Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ⊆ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 :=
    Subset.trans h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ1 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hδ1_lt_δ0))
  have h_ball_ρ0_sub_arc : Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ⊆ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc :=
    Subset.trans h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 (Metric.ball_subset_ball hδ0_le_arc)

  let s0_arc : ℂ → ℂ := arcS0 S A
  let s1_arc : ℂ → ℂ := arcS1 S A
  have hs0_arc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s0_arc (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0) :=
    (A.s_ext_holo ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩).mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_arc
  have hs1_arc_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ s1_arc (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0) :=
    (A.s_ext_holo ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩).mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_arc
  have hs0_arc_in_strip : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0, s0_arc u ∈ horizStrip S.H :=
    fun u hu => A.s_ext_in_strip u (h_ball_ρ0_sub_arc hu) ⟨0, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩
  have h_prod_sub_0 :
      Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v ⊆
        Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.δ_v0 :=
    Set.prod_mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hρv_lt_δv0))
  have hF_plus_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ C.F_plus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) :=
    C.F_plus_holo.mono h_prod_sub_0
  have hF_minus_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ C.F_minus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) :=
    C.F_minus_holo.mono h_prod_sub_0
  have hσ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ E.σ (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0) :=
    E.σ_holo.mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0
  have h_prod_sub_rem :
      Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v ⊆
        Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v :=
    Set.prod_mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 Subset.rfl
  have hrem_holo :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ E.A_plus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ E.B_plus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ E.A_minus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ E.B_minus (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v) :=
    ⟨E.rem_holo.1.mono h_prod_sub_rem,
     E.rem_holo.2.1.mono h_prod_sub_rem,
     E.rem_holo.2.2.1.mono h_prod_sub_rem,
     E.rem_holo.2.2.2.mono h_prod_sub_rem⟩
  have hF_plus_eq :
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v,
        C.F_plus (u, v) =
          (u + E.σ u * v + v ^ 2 * E.A_plus (u, v),
           v - deriv E.σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * E.B_plus (u, v)) :=
    fun u hu v hv => E.F_plus_eq u (h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 hu) v hv
  have hF_minus_eq :
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v,
        C.F_minus (u, v) =
          (u - E.σ u * v + v ^ 2 * E.A_minus (u, v),
           v + deriv E.σ u * v ^ 2 + v ^ 3 * E.B_minus (u, v)) :=
    fun u hu v hv => E.F_minus_eq u (h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 hu) v hv

  
  let w_edge : ℂ := s0_arc y_edge
  have h_img_open : IsOpen (s0_arc '' Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0) :=
    C.s0_arc_open_map (Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0) Metric.isOpen_ball h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0
  have hw_edge_mem : w_edge ∈ s0_arc '' Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 :=
    ⟨y_edge, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ0_pos, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ_s, hρs_pos, h_ball_ρs_sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp h_img_open w_edge hw_edge_mem
  have hs0_inv_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ C.s0_inv (Metric.ball w_edge ρ_s) :=
    C.s0_inv_holo_on_image.mono
      (Subset.trans h_ball_ρs_sub (Set.image_mono h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0))
  have hs0_inv_right_inv :
      ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w_edge ρ_s,
        C.s0_inv w ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ∧ s0_arc (C.s0_inv w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, hu_ρ0, rfl⟩ := h_ball_ρs_sub hw
    have h_left : C.s0_inv (s0_arc u) = u := C.s0_left_inv u (h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 hu_ρ0)
    exact ⟨h_left.symm ▸ hu_ρ0, by rw [h_left]⟩
  have hs0_cont_edge : ContinuousAt s0_arc y_edge :=
    hs0_arc_holo.continuousOn.continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ0_pos))
  obtain ⟨r_s1, hr_s1_pos, hr_s1_sub⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
      (hs0_cont_edge.tendsto (Metric.ball_mem_nhds w_edge (half_pos hρs_pos)))
  let ρ_1 : ℝ := min (r_s1 / 2) (ρ_0 / 2)
  have hρ1_pos : 0 < ρ_1 := lt_min (half_pos hr_s1_pos) (half_pos hρ0_pos)
  have hρ1_le_half_ρ0 : ρ_1 ≤ ρ_0 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hρ1_le_ρ0 : ρ_1 ≤ ρ_0 := by linarith
  have h_s0_half_margin : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_1, dist (s0_arc u) w_edge < ρ_s / 2 := by
    intro u hu
    have hu_rs1 : u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge r_s1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
      have : ρ_1 ≤ r_s1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
      linarith
    exact Metric.mem_ball.mp (hr_s1_sub hu_rs1)
  have hs0_arc_left_inv :
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_1,
        s0_arc u ∈ Metric.ball w_edge ρ_s ∧ C.s0_inv (s0_arc u) = u := by
    intro u hu
    have h_half := h_s0_half_margin u hu
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith), ?_⟩
    exact C.s0_left_inv u (h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 (Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ1_le_ρ0 hu))

  
  let K_uv : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
    Metric.closedBall y_edge (ρ_0 / 2) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (E.ρ_v / 2)
  have hK_uv_compact : IsCompact K_uv :=
    (isCompact_closedBall y_edge (ρ_0 / 2)).prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (E.ρ_v / 2))
  have hK_uv_sub : K_uv ⊆ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v :=
    Set.prod_mono
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
  let ε_uv : ℝ := min (ρ_0 / 2) E.ρ_v
  have hε_uv_pos : 0 < ε_uv := lt_min (half_pos hρ0_pos) hρv_pos
  obtain ⟨δ_p, hδ_p_pos, hδ_p⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
      (hK_uv_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hF_plus_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_uv_sub))
      ε_uv hε_uv_pos
  obtain ⟨δ_m, hδ_m_pos, hδ_m⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
      (hK_uv_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hF_minus_holo.continuousOn.mono hK_uv_sub))
      ε_uv hε_uv_pos
  let ρ_v1 : ℝ := min (E.ρ_v / 2) (min δ_p δ_m)
  have hρv1_pos : 0 < ρ_v1 :=
    lt_min (half_pos hρv_pos) (lt_min hδ_p_pos hδ_m_pos)
  have hρv1_le_half_ρv : ρ_v1 ≤ E.ρ_v / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hρv1_le_ρv : ρ_v1 ≤ E.ρ_v := by linarith
  have hρv1_le_δp : ρ_v1 ≤ δ_p := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρv1_le_δm : ρ_v1 ≤ δ_m := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hF_mutual_inv :
      ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_1, ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1,
        C.F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v ∧
        C.F_minus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v ∧
        C.F_minus (C.F_plus (u, v)) = (u, v) ∧
        C.F_plus (C.F_minus (u, v)) = (u, v) := by
    intro u hu v hv
    have hu_ρ0 : u ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ1_le_ρ0 hu
    have hu_δ0 : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 := h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 hu_ρ0
    have hu_δ1 : u ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_1 := h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ1 hu_ρ0
    have hv_δv1 : v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) C.δ_v1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans hρv1_le_ρv hρv_le_δv1) hv
    have hu_cb : u ∈ Metric.closedBall y_edge (ρ_0 / 2) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hu) hρ1_le_half_ρ0)
    have hv_cb : v ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (E.ρ_v / 2) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hv) hρv1_le_half_ρv)
    have h0_cb : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (E.ρ_v / 2) :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt (half_pos hρv_pos))
    have huv_mem : (u, v) ∈ K_uv := ⟨hu_cb, hv_cb⟩
    have hu0_mem : (u, (0 : ℂ)) ∈ K_uv := ⟨hu_cb, h0_cb⟩
    have h_dist_uv : dist (u, v) (u, (0 : ℂ)) = dist v 0 := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_right dist_nonneg]
    have hv_dist : dist v 0 < ρ_v1 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hv
    have hFp_dist : dist (C.F_plus (u, v)) (u, 0) < ε_uv := by
      rw [← C.F_plus_zero u hu_δ0]
      exact hδ_p (u, v) huv_mem (u, 0) hu0_mem (by linarith)
    have hFm_dist : dist (C.F_minus (u, v)) (u, 0) < ε_uv := by
      rw [← C.F_minus_zero u hu_δ0]
      exact hδ_m (u, v) huv_mem (u, 0) hu0_mem (by linarith)
    have hε_le1 : ε_uv ≤ ρ_0 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hε_le2 : ε_uv ≤ E.ρ_v := min_le_right _ _
    have hu_dist : dist u y_edge < ρ_1 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hu
    have hFp_in : C.F_plus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hFp_dist
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hFp_dist.2 hε_le2)⟩
      have h_tri := dist_triangle (C.F_plus (u, v)).1 u y_edge
      linarith [hFp_dist.1]
    have hFm_in : C.F_minus (u, v) ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) E.ρ_v := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hFm_dist
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr ?_, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le hFm_dist.2 hε_le2)⟩
      have h_tri := dist_triangle (C.F_minus (u, v)).1 u y_edge
      linarith [hFm_dist.1]
    have h_inv := (C.F_mutual_inv u hu_δ1 v hv_δv1).2.2
    exact ⟨hFp_in, hFm_in, h_inv.1, h_inv.2⟩

  
  have h_slice_at_t0 :
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_edge (ρ_1 / 2), y.im < h →
        S.𝔰 (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = s0_arc y ∧ S.𝔰 (y + (t₀ : ℂ), (t₀ : ℂ)) = s1_arc y := by
    intro y hy hy_im
    have hy_ρ0 : y ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hy
    exact C.arc_slice_at_t0 y (h_ball_ρ0_sub_δ0 hy_ρ0) hy_im

  have h_subheight_tube_step :
      ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → μ < h →
        ∃ r_μ : ℝ, 0 < r_μ ∧ r_μ < S.r_star - t₀ ∧
          ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y_edge (ρ_1 / 2),
            y.im < h - μ →
            ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_μ,
              (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
              (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
              S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball w_edge ρ_s ∧
              (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)), S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) ∈
                Metric.ball y_edge ρ_1 ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) ρ_v1 ∧
              (y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ Metric.ball y_edge (ρ_1 / 2) →
                (y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ))).im < h - μ →
                C.F_plus (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)),
                    S.𝔰 (y + t, t) - s1_arc (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y, t)))) =
                  (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ)), t)),
                   S.𝔰 (y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ)) + t, t) -
                     s1_arc (C.s0_inv (S.𝔰 (y + (N : ℂ) * (t - (t₀ : ℂ)), t))))) := by
    intro μ hμ_pos hμ_lt_h
    obtain ⟨r_μ1, hr_μ1_pos, hr_μ1_lt, h_step1⟩ := C.arc_subheight_step μ hμ_pos hμ_lt_h
    obtain ⟨r_μ2, hr_μ2_pos, _, h_step2⟩ :=
      C.arc_subheight_step (μ / 2) (half_pos hμ_pos) (by linarith)
    let r_0 : ℝ := min (r_μ1 / 2) (r_μ2 / 2)
    have hr_0_pos : 0 < r_0 := lt_min (half_pos hr_μ1_pos) (half_pos hr_μ2_pos)
    let K_edge : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall y_edge (ρ_1 / 2) ∩ {y : ℂ | y.im ≤ h - μ}
    let K_prod : Set (ℂ × ℂ) := K_edge ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (t₀ : ℂ) r_0
    have hK_prod_compact : IsCompact K_prod :=
      ((isCompact_closedBall y_edge (ρ_1 / 2)).inter_right
        (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)).prod
        (isCompact_closedBall (t₀ : ℂ) r_0)
    let f_s0 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 (p.1, p.2)
    let U_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => C.s0_inv (f_s0 p)
    let V_map : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => S.𝔰 (p.1 + p.2, p.2) - s1_arc (U_map p)
    have h_K_step : ∀ p ∈ K_prod,
        (p.1, p.2) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (p.1 + p.2, p.2) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        f_s0 p ∈ s0_arc '' Metric.ball y_star C.δ_0 ∧
        U_map p ∈ Metric.ball y_star A.δ_arc := by
      intro p hp
      have hp1_ρ0 : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_0 := by
        have hp1_cb : dist p.1 y_edge ≤ ρ_1 / 2 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp.1.1
        exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith)
      have hp1_34 : p.1 ∈ Metric.ball y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * C.δ_1) := h_ball_ρ0_sub_34 hp1_ρ0
      have hp1_im2 : p.1.im < h - μ / 2 := by
        have hp1_le : p.1.im ≤ h - μ := hp.1.2
        linarith
      have hp2_μ2 : p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_μ2 := by
        have hp2_cb : dist p.2 (t₀ : ℂ) ≤ r_0 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hp.2
        have hr0_le : r_0 ≤ r_μ2 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
        exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (by linarith)
      have hs := h_step2 p.1 hp1_34 hp1_im2 p.2 hp2_μ2
      have hU_δ1 : U_map p ∈ Metric.ball y_star C.δ_1 := hs.2.2.2.1.1
      exact ⟨hs.1, hs.2.1, hs.2.2.1,
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (le_of_lt hδ1_lt_δ0) hδ0_le_arc) hU_δ1⟩
    have hf_s0_cont : ContinuousOn f_s0 K_prod :=
      S.𝔰_holo.continuousOn.comp
        (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn
        (fun p hp => (h_K_step p hp).1)
    have hf_s1_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => S.𝔰 (p.1 + p.2, p.2)) K_prod :=
      S.𝔰_holo.continuousOn.comp
        ((continuous_fst.add continuous_snd).prodMk continuous_snd).continuousOn
        (fun p hp => (h_K_step p hp).2.1)
    have hU_cont : ContinuousOn U_map K_prod :=
      C.s0_inv_holo_on_image.continuousOn.comp hf_s0_cont
        (fun p hp => (h_K_step p hp).2.2.1)
    have hV_cont : ContinuousOn V_map K_prod :=
      hf_s1_cont.sub
        ((A.s_ext_holo ⟨1, by unfold oddSliceN; omega⟩).continuousOn.comp hU_cont
          (fun p hp => (h_K_step p hp).2.2.2))
    obtain ⟨δ_s0, hδ_s0_pos, hδ_s0⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
        (hK_prod_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hf_s0_cont)
        (ρ_s / 2) (half_pos hρs_pos)
    obtain ⟨δ_U, hδ_U_pos, hδ_U⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
        (hK_prod_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hU_cont)
        (ρ_1 / 2) (half_pos hρ1_pos)
    obtain ⟨δ_V, hδ_V_pos, hδ_V⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
        (hK_prod_compact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hV_cont)
        ρ_v1 hρv1_pos
    let r_μ : ℝ := min r_0 (min δ_s0 (min δ_U δ_V))
    have hr_μ_pos : 0 < r_μ :=
      lt_min hr_0_pos (lt_min hδ_s0_pos (lt_min hδ_U_pos hδ_V_pos))
    have hr_μ_le_r0 : r_μ ≤ r_0 := min_le_left _ _
    have hr_μ_le_δs0 : r_μ ≤ δ_s0 := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hr_μ_le_δU : r_μ ≤ δ_U :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hr_μ_le_δV : r_μ ≤ δ_V :=
      le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hr0_le_μ1 : r_0 ≤ r_μ1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    refine ⟨r_μ, hr_μ_pos, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro y hy hy_im t ht
    have hy_ρ1 : y ∈ Metric.ball y_edge ρ_1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hy
    have hy_34 : y ∈ Metric.ball y_star ((3 / 4 : ℝ) * C.δ_1) :=
      h_ball_ρ0_sub_34 (Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ1_le_ρ0 hy_ρ1)
    have ht_μ1 : t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_μ1 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) ht
    have hs1 := h_step1 y hy_34 hy_im t ht_μ1
    have hy_K : y ∈ K_edge :=
      ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy, le_of_lt hy_im⟩
    have ht_cb : t ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₀ : ℂ) r_0 :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr_μ_le_r0 ht)
    have ht0_cb : (t₀ : ℂ) ∈ Metric.closedBall (t₀ : ℂ) r_0 :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt hr_0_pos)
    have hyt_K : (y, t) ∈ K_prod := ⟨hy_K, ht_cb⟩
    have hyt0_K : (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ K_prod := ⟨hy_K, ht0_cb⟩
    have h_dist_yt : dist (y, t) (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = dist t (t₀ : ℂ) := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_right dist_nonneg]
    have ht_dist : dist t (t₀ : ℂ) < r_μ := Metric.mem_ball.mp ht
    obtain ⟨hs0_t0, hs1_t0⟩ := h_slice_at_t0 y hy (by linarith)
    have hf_s0_t0 : f_s0 (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = s0_arc y := hs0_t0
    have hU_t0 : U_map (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = y := by
      dsimp [U_map]
      rw [hf_s0_t0]
      exact (hs0_arc_left_inv y hy_ρ1).2
    have hV_t0 : V_map (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0 := by
      dsimp [V_map]
      rw [hU_t0, hs1_t0, sub_self]
    have hs0_in_ρs : S.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ Metric.ball w_edge ρ_s := by
      have h_uc := hδ_s0 (y, t) hyt_K (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) hyt0_K (by linarith)

import Mathlib
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-!
# Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar (Definition 1.1 & Theorem 1.2)

Formal problem statement for **Definition 1.1** and **Theorem 1.2** from:
OpenAI, *Rigidity of Smooth Billiards with a Continuous Caustic Collar*,
September 24, 2026.
https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/Rigidity-of-Smooth-Billiards-with-a-Continuous-Caustic-Collar-September-24-2026/paper.pdf

## Mathematical Statement (Section 1, p. 4)

**Definition 1.1 (A continuous caustic collar).**
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a bounded strictly convex domain whose boundary is a
$C^\infty$ simple closed regular curve with positive curvature. A *smooth closed convex caustic*
is a $C^\infty$ simple closed regular curve in $\Omega$, bounding a strictly convex set, such that
a billiard segment tangent to the curve remains tangent after reflection at either endpoint. Here
reflection of an incoming unit velocity $v$ at a boundary point with outward unit normal $n$ is
$$v \longmapsto v - 2(v \cdot n)n.$$
A *continuous caustic collar* consists of a relatively open set $A \subset \overline{\Omega}$
containing $\partial\Omega$ and a homeomorphism
$$H_0 : \mathbb{S}^1 \times [0, 1) \longrightarrow A$$
such that $H_0(\mathbb{S}^1 \times \{0\}) = \partial\Omega$, and
$H_0(\mathbb{S}^1 \times \{b\})$ is a smooth closed convex caustic for every $0 < b < 1$.

**Theorem 1.2.**
*If $\Omega$ has a continuous caustic collar, then $\Omega$ is an ellipse. Equivalently, there are
$c \in \mathbb{R}^2$ and a real symmetric positive-definite matrix $Q$ such that*
$$\Omega = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : (x - c)^T Q (x - c) < 1\}.$$
*Circles are included.*
-/

open ContDiff Set Topology Metric Matrix

/-- The Euclidean plane `ℝ²`. -/
abbrev Plane : Type := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

/-- The unit circle `𝕊¹ ⊂ ℝ²`. -/
abbrev UnitCircle : Type := Metric.sphere (0 : Plane) 1

/-- The two-dimensional determinant (cross product) `det(u, v) = u₀ v₁ - u₁ v₀` of two planar
vectors `u, v ∈ ℝ²`. -/
def det2 (u v : Plane) : ℝ :=
  u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0

/-- The signed curvature `κ_γ(t) = det(γ'(t), γ''(t)) / ‖γ'(t)‖³` of a plane curve `γ : ℝ → ℝ²`
at parameter `t ∈ ℝ`. -/
noncomputable def signedCurvature (γ : ℝ → Plane) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  det2 (deriv γ t) (deriv (deriv γ) t) / ‖deriv γ t‖ ^ 3

/-- A map `γ : ℝ → ℝ²` is a `C^∞` simple closed regular parametrization of a curve `C ⊆ ℝ²`
with period `L > 0` if:
1. `0 < L`,
2. `γ` is `C^∞` smooth (`ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ`),
3. `γ` is `L`-periodic (`Function.Periodic γ L`),
4. `γ` is simple (injective on `ℝ / Lℤ`, i.e., `γ(t₁) = γ(t₂) → t₁ - t₂ ∈ Lℤ`),
5. `γ` is regular (`γ'(t) ≠ 0` for all `t ∈ ℝ`), and
6. the image of `γ` is `C` (`range γ = C`). -/
structure IsSmoothSimpleClosedRegularParam (γ : ℝ → Plane) (L : ℝ) (C : Set Plane) : Prop where
  /-- The period `L` is strictly positive. -/
  period_pos : 0 < L
  /-- `γ` is `C^∞` smooth on `ℝ`. -/
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ γ
  /-- `γ` has period `L`. -/
  periodic : Function.Periodic γ L
  /-- `γ` is injective modulo `L`. -/
  simple : ∀ t₁ t₂ : ℝ, γ t₁ = γ t₂ → ∃ k : ℤ, t₁ - t₂ = k * L
  /-- `γ` is regular everywhere (`γ'(t) ≠ 0`). -/
  regular : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv γ t ≠ 0
  /-- The image of `γ` is `C`. -/
  range_eq : Set.range γ = C

/-- A subset `C ⊆ ℝ²` is a `C^∞` simple closed regular curve with positive curvature if it admits
a (counterclockwise) `C^∞` simple closed regular parametrization `γ : ℝ → ℝ²` of some positive
period `L > 0` whose signed curvature `κ_γ(t) > 0` is strictly positive for all `t ∈ ℝ`. -/
def IsSmoothPositiveCurvatureCurve (C : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ (γ : ℝ → Plane) (L : ℝ),
    IsSmoothSimpleClosedRegularParam γ L C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < signedCurvature γ t

/-- A subset `Ω ⊆ ℝ²` is a bounded strictly convex domain if it is open, nonempty, bounded,
convex, and for any two distinct points `x, y ∈ Ω̄`, the open line segment `(x, y)` lies in `Ω`. -/
structure IsBoundedStrictlyConvexDomain (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop where
  /-- `Ω` is an open subset of `ℝ²`. -/
  isOpen : IsOpen Ω
  /-- `Ω` is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : Ω.Nonempty
  /-- `Ω` is bounded. -/
  isBounded : Bornology.IsBounded Ω
  /-- `Ω` is convex. -/
  convex : Convex ℝ Ω
  /-- Strict convexity: for any distinct `x, y ∈ Ω̄`, the open segment `(x, y)` lies in `Ω`. -/
  openSegment_subset : ∀ x ∈ closure Ω, ∀ y ∈ closure Ω, x ≠ y → openSegment ℝ x y ⊆ Ω

/-- The standing geometric hypothesis on the billiard table `Ω ⊂ ℝ²` in **Definition 1.1**:
`Ω` is a bounded strictly convex domain whose boundary `∂Ω` (`frontier Ω`) is a `C^∞` simple
closed regular curve with positive curvature. -/
structure IsSmoothPositivelyCurvedBilliardDomain (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop where
  /-- `Ω` is a bounded strictly convex planar domain. -/
  domain : IsBoundedStrictlyConvexDomain Ω
  /-- `∂Ω` is a `C^∞` simple closed regular curve with positive curvature. -/
  boundary_smooth_pos_curvature : IsSmoothPositiveCurvatureCurve (frontier Ω)

/-- A vector `n ∈ ℝ²` is the outward unit normal to `Ω` at a boundary point `p ∈ ∂Ω` if:
1. `‖n‖ = 1` (`n` is a unit vector),
2. `⟨n, γ'(t)⟩ = 0` (`n` is normal/orthogonal to the boundary tangent `γ'(t)` at `p = γ(t)`), and
3. `⟨x - p, n⟩ ≤ 0` for all `x ∈ Ω` (`n` points outward from `Ω`). -/
def IsOutwardUnitNormal (Ω : Set Plane) (p n : Plane) : Prop :=
  ‖n‖ = 1 ∧
  (∃ (γ : ℝ → Plane) (L : ℝ) (t : ℝ),
    IsSmoothSimpleClosedRegularParam γ L (frontier Ω) ∧
    γ t = p ∧
    inner ℝ n (deriv γ t) = 0) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ Ω, inner ℝ (x - p) n ≤ 0

/-- Billiard reflection of an incoming unit velocity `v ∈ ℝ²` at a boundary point with outward
unit normal `n ∈ ℝ²` (**Definition 1.1**):
$$v \longmapsto v - 2(v \cdot n)n.$$ -/
noncomputable def billiardReflect (n v : Plane) : Plane :=
  v - (2 * inner ℝ v n) • n

/-- A billiard segment `[p, q]` (with endpoints `p, q ∈ ∂Ω`, `p ≠ q`) is tangent to a curve
parametrized by `α : ℝ → ℝ²` if `[p, q]` meets the curve at some point `α(t)` where the tangent
vector `α'(t)` is parallel to the segment direction `q - p`. -/
def IsBilliardSegmentTangentTo (α : ℝ → Plane) (p q : Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ t : ℝ, α t ∈ segment ℝ p q ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, deriv α t = c • (q - p)

/-- **Definition 1.1** (Smooth closed convex caustic):
A *smooth closed convex caustic* in `Ω` is a `C^∞` simple closed regular curve `C ⊂ Ω`, bounding a
strictly convex set `U`, such that a billiard segment `[p, q]` (with `p, q ∈ ∂Ω`, `p ≠ q`) tangent
to `C` remains tangent to `C` after billiard reflection `v ↦ v - 2(v · n)n` at either endpoint
`q` or `p`. -/
def IsSmoothClosedConvexCaustic (Ω C : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  C ⊆ Ω ∧
  (∃ U : Set Plane, IsBoundedStrictlyConvexDomain U ∧ frontier U = C) ∧
  ∃ (α : ℝ → Plane) (L : ℝ),
    IsSmoothSimpleClosedRegularParam α L C ∧
    ∀ p ∈ frontier Ω, ∀ q ∈ frontier Ω, p ≠ q →
      IsBilliardSegmentTangentTo α p q →
      (∀ n_q : Plane, IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω q n_q →
        ∃ r ∈ frontier Ω, r ≠ q ∧
          (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ r = q + s • billiardReflect n_q (‖q - p‖⁻¹ • (q - p))) ∧
          IsBilliardSegmentTangentTo α q r) ∧
      (∀ n_p : Plane, IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω p n_p →
        ∃ r ∈ frontier Ω, r ≠ p ∧
          (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ r = p + s • billiardReflect n_p (‖p - q‖⁻¹ • (p - q))) ∧
          IsBilliardSegmentTangentTo α p r)

/-- The slice `H₀(𝕊¹ × {b}) ⊆ ℝ²` of a collar map `H₀ : 𝕊¹ × [0, 1) → A` at parameter
`b ∈ [0, 1)`. -/
def collarSlice {A : Set Plane} (H₀ : (UnitCircle × Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ≃ₜ A)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : b ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) : Set Plane :=
  Set.range (fun θ : UnitCircle => (H₀ (θ, ⟨b, hb⟩) : Plane))

/-- **Definition 1.1** (A continuous caustic collar):
A *continuous caustic collar* of `Ω` consists of a relatively open set `A ⊂ Ω̄` containing `∂Ω`
and a homeomorphism `H₀ : 𝕊¹ × [0, 1) → A` such that `H₀(𝕊¹ × {0}) = ∂Ω`, and
`H₀(𝕊¹ × {b})` is a smooth closed convex caustic in `Ω` for every `0 < b < 1`. -/
def HasContinuousCausticCollar (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ A : Set Plane,
    A ⊆ closure Ω ∧
    frontier Ω ⊆ A ∧
    (∃ V : Set Plane, IsOpen V ∧ A = V ∩ closure Ω) ∧
    ∃ H₀ : (UnitCircle × Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) ≃ₜ A,
      collarSlice H₀ 0 (by simp) = frontier Ω ∧
      ∀ b : ℝ, ∀ hb0 : 0 < b, ∀ hb1 : b < 1,
        IsSmoothClosedConvexCaustic Ω (collarSlice H₀ b ⟨le_of_lt hb0, hb1⟩)

/-- A planar domain `Ω ⊂ ℝ²` is an ellipse (with circles included) if there exist `c ∈ ℝ²` and a
real symmetric positive-definite `2 × 2` matrix `Q` such that
`Ω = {x ∈ ℝ² : (x - c)^T Q (x - c) < 1}` (**Theorem 1.2**). -/
def IsEllipse (Ω : Set Plane) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Plane, ∃ Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
    Q.IsSymm ∧ Q.PosDef ∧
    Ω = { x : Plane | (x - c).ofLp ⬝ᵥ Q.mulVec (x - c).ofLp < 1 }

/-- **Theorem 1.2** (Near-boundary Birkhoff conjecture / physical-collar rigidity):
Let `Ω ⊂ ℝ²` be a bounded strictly convex domain whose boundary is a `C^∞` simple closed regular
curve with positive curvature. If `Ω` has a continuous caustic collar, then `Ω` is an ellipse:
there are `c ∈ ℝ²` and a real symmetric positive-definite matrix `Q` such that
`Ω = {x ∈ ℝ² : (x - c)^T Q (x - c) < 1}` (circles are included). -/

noncomputable def unitNormalVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ]


noncomputable def unitTangentVec (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  (WithLp.equiv 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm ![-Real.sin θ, Real.cos θ]


noncomputable def supportAction1_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) -
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


noncomputable def supportAction2_ℂ (h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  deriv h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) +
    h_ℂ ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Complex.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)


def horizStrip (H : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { s : ℂ | |s.im| < H }


def finiteWallTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star ∧ -h_X (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) < p.1.im ∧ p.1.im < h_X p.2 }


noncomputable def frozenFirstFieldG (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if z = 0 then 1 else 3 * (Complex.sin z - z * Complex.cos z) / z ^ 3


structure SupportLazutkinData (Ω : Set Plane) where
  c₀ : Plane
  c₀_mem : c₀ ∈ Ω
  h : ℝ → ℝ
  h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h
  h_periodic : Function.Periodic h (2 * Real.pi)
  h_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ
  r_pos : ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < h θ + deriv (deriv h) θ
  frontier_eq : frontier Ω =
    Set.range (fun θ : ℝ => c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ)
  ϕ : ℝ → ℝ
  c : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  ϕ_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ϕ
  ϕ_deriv_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < deriv ϕ x
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ (x + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ x + 2 * Real.pi
  lazutkin_norm : ∀ x : ℝ, (h (ϕ x) + deriv (deriv h) (ϕ x)) * (deriv ϕ x) ^ 3 = c


def HasTrigSpeed {Ω : Set Plane} (L : SupportLazutkinData Ω) : Prop :=
  ∃ B₀ C₀ D₀ : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    (deriv L.ϕ x) ^ 2 = C₀ + B₀ * Real.cos (2 * L.ϕ x) + D₀ * Real.sin (2 * L.ϕ x)


structure AnalyticGlancingCollar (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  s₀ : ℝ
  s_h : ℝ
  s₀_pos : 0 < s₀
  s_h_pos : 0 < s_h
  h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  h_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ h_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s_h))
  ϕ_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s₀))
  ϕ_ℂ_maps_to : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h)
  h_ℂ_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = h θ
  ϕ_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ_ℂ x = ϕ x
  h_ℂ_periodic : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = h_ℂ w
  h_ℂ_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h),
    h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ w)
  ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ_ℂ z + 2 * Real.pi
  ϕ_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    ϕ_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z)
  ϕ_ℂ_deriv_ne_zero : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), deriv ϕ_ℂ z ≠ 0
  lazutkin_norm_ℂ : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    (h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (ϕ_ℂ z)) * (deriv ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 3 = c
  s₁ : ℝ
  r₁ : ℝ
  r₁_pos : 0 < r₁
  r₁_lt_s₁ : r₁ < s₁
  s₁_le_s₀ : s₁ ≤ s₀
  U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  U_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ U { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s₁ ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r₁ }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁)
  U_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  U_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)
  U_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → U (y, 0) = y
  U_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))
  U_maps_to : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ + r₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀)
  U_real_deriv_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, |t| < r₁ →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (U (x', t)).re) x
  U_real_step_pos : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ →
    0 < (U (x + t, t)).re - (U (x, t)).re ∧
    0 < ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) ∧
    ϕ ((U (x + t, t)).re) - ϕ ((U (x, t)).re) < Real.pi
  glancing_stationary : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
      supportAction2_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  symplectic_jacobian : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s₁ → ‖t‖ < r₁ →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y' + t, t)))) y *
      deriv (fun t' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => -supportAction1_ℂ h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t'))) (ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t', t')))) t *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => ϕ_ℂ (U (y', t))) y = A t
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r₁, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₁ → 0 < (A t).re


structure EntireNonisotropicStrip where
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_entire : Differentiable ℂ ϕ
  f_entire : Differentiable ℂ f
  q_entire : Differentiable ℂ q
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s : ℂ, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s : ℂ, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s : ℂ, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s : ℂ, q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s : ℂ, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ0 : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 0) (horizStrip s_star) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => Γ0 s 1) (horizStrip s_star)
  Γ0_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,
    deriv (fun z => Γ0 z 0) s = -c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ0_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star,
    deriv (fun z => Γ0 z 1) s = c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, Γ0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ0 s
  Γ0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ0 s i)
  T : Set (ℂ × ℂ)
  T_open : IsOpen T
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ T
  T_param_subset : T ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ T
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y + x, t) ∈ T
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (y, -t) ∈ T
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ T
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 T
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y : ℂ, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = 𝔰 (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T → 𝔰 (y, -t) = 𝔰 (y, t)
  𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ T →
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 (y, t))
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  θ_edge : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    θ_edge (x - t) t + θ_edge x t = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    θ_edge x t - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 = -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (θ_edge x t) ∧
    Γ0 (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ0 (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 = ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = 𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ T


structure FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip where
  H : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  s_star : ℝ
  r_star : ℝ
  H_pos : 0 < H
  c_pos : 0 < c
  r_star_pos : 0 < r_star
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  s_star_lt_H : s_star < H
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : r_star < s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : r_star < Real.pi
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStrip H)
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStrip H)
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStrip H)
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv ϕ s = f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv f) s = 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStrip H) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 1) (horizStrip H)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStrip H)
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 0) s ∧ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun z => Γ z 1) s
  Γ_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 0) s = -c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  Γ_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv (fun z => Γ z 1) s = c * (f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)
  Γ_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → Γ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = Γ s
  Γ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Γ (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (Γ s i)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (ϕ s) + Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (ϕ s)) * f s
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  𝔰 : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  A : ℂ → ℂ
  Θ_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  p_gl : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ 𝔰 (finiteWallTube r_star h_X)
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 p ∈ horizStrip H
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, 𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (p.1 + 2 * Real.pi, p.2) = 𝔰 p + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X, 𝔰 (p.1, -p.2) = 𝔰 p
  𝔰_conj : ∀ p ∈ finiteWallTube r_star h_X,
    𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ p.1, starRingEnd ℂ p.2) = starRingEnd ℂ (𝔰 p)
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  V_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStrip H)
  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H, V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip H, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => 𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip H,
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  Θ_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Θ_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  p_gl_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ p_gl { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_star }
  A_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ A (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star)
  A_odd : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (-t) = -A t
  A_conj : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_star, A (starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (A t)
  A_deriv_zero : deriv A 0 = c / 4
  A_real_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star → 0 < (A t).re
  symplectic_gl : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_star → ‖t‖ < r_star →
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => p_gl (y', t)) y * deriv (fun t' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y, t')) t -
    deriv (fun t' : ℂ => p_gl (y, t')) t * deriv (fun y' : ℂ => Θ_gl (y', t)) y = A t
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r_star →
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (ϕ (𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    Γ (𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        Γ (𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < r_star → 0 < ε → ε < s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = 𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = 𝔰 p


noncomputable def shapeModulus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  max ‖S.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖S.q s‖)


def wallDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (s : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - s.im


structure CriticalWallData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  critical_upper_bound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) < S.H →
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        Real.exp ((1 + ε) * k)
  critical_lower_unbounded : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ K₀ : ℝ, ∃ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k ∧
    Real.exp (-k) < S.H ∧
    ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
      Real.exp ((1 - ε) * k) ≤
        shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  cone_passage : ∀ α m₀ δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m₀ → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L δ_star : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < δ_star ∧ δ_star < δ_b ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                d < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
                |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
                ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α } ∧
            (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
              d < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_star →
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) →
              ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
              s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
              s_tilde (p.1, -p.2) = s_tilde p ∧
              ‖s_tilde p - p.1‖ ≤
                C * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
              (δ_star / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
              (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_tilde p = S.𝔰 p))
  deep_first_field_model : ∀ d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < d_seq n ∧ 0 < B_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto d_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto B_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    (∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      d_seq n ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - ξ_seq n| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
      (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S s ≤ C_A * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      F Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    ∀ A₀ T₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → 0 < T₀ →
      ∃ D₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧
        ∃ S_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_lim
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } ∧
          (∀ T Y : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) →
            (S_lim (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
            S_lim (-T, Y) = S_lim (T, Y) ∧
            ‖S_lim (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 3 *
              frozenFirstFieldG
                (T * F (S_lim (T, Y)) * deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y / 2) = 1) ∧
          (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
              ‖(S.𝔰 ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                  p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) -
                (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ) - S_lim p‖ < ε)
  exp_profile_obstruction : ∀ x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ c₀ : ℂ, ∀ α₀ δ_b : ℝ,
    c₀ ≠ 0 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n < S.H ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ 0 < m_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H) →
    Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (S.H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ((TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop) ∨
     (TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop)) →
    ¬ (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - s.im → h_seq n - s.im ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L * (h_seq n - s.im) →
      shapeModulus S s ≤ C_L * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)
  log_deficit_bound : ∃ C_def : ℝ, 0 < C_def ∧
    ∀ z₀ : ℂ, ∀ Δ K : ℝ, 0 < Δ →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖) (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4),
        Δ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖ ≤
          C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖))
  poly_growth_witness : ∀ C_p A_p δ_p : ℝ, 0 < C_p → 0 < A_p → 0 < δ_p →
    (∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, wallDepth S s ≤ δ_p →
      wallDepth S s * shapeModulus S s ≤
        C_p * (1 + Real.log (1 / wallDepth S s)) ^ A_p) →
    ∃ L₀ C₁ C₂ c_star k_star : ℝ,
      0 < L₀ ∧ 0 < C₁ ∧ 0 < C₂ ∧ 0 < c_star ∧ 1 ≤ k_star ∧
      ∀ k x₀ : ℝ, k_star ≤ k →
        ∃ z ∈ horizStrip S.H,
          0 < z.im ∧
          |z.re - x₀| ≤ L₀ * wallDepth S z ∧
          k - C₁ * Real.log k ≤ -Real.log (wallDepth S z) ∧
          -Real.log (wallDepth S z) ≤ k + C₂ ∧
          c_star ≤ wallDepth S z * (‖S.f z‖ + Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖)


noncomputable def rowMomentF (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2)


noncomputable def rowMomentFull (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k) * Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖))


structure CriticalAngleBudgetData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  k₀ : ℝ
  C_env : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  k₀_ge_one : 1 ≤ k₀
  exp_neg_k₀_lt : Real.exp (-k₀) < S.H / 10
  C_env_pos : 0 < C_env
  ρ_pos : 0 < ρ
  ρ_lt_one : ρ < 1
  moment_poly_bound : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → rowMomentFull S k ≤ C_env * (1 + k)
  row_sup_poly_bound : ∀ k : ℝ, k₀ ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ,
    Real.exp (-k) *
      (‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ +
        Real.sqrt ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ≤
      C_env * (1 + k) ^ 2
  angle_budget : ∀ K : ℝ, k₀ ≤ K →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2)
      (Set.Icc k₀ K) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (∫ v in k₀..K, (rowMomentF S v) ^ 2) ≤ C_env * K ^ (2 * ρ)
  single_center_vanishing_exclusion :
    ∀ c_exp α₀ δ_b : ℝ,
      0 < c_exp → c_exp < 1 / 2 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 - c_exp →
      0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
      ∃ L_star : ℝ, 0 < L_star ∧
        ∀ k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ C₀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ → 0 < C₁ →
          (∀ n : ℕ, k₀ ≤ k_seq n) →
          Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, k₀ ≤ l →
            rowMomentFull S l ≤
              C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (c_exp * |l - k_seq n|)) →
          (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
            Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
              C₁ * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ α₀) →
          ¬ (TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
              (fun n Z =>
                ((Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
                  S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
              (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } ∧
            TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
              (fun n Z =>
                ((Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
                  S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
              (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 })

noncomputable def frozenSecondFieldG (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (12 * ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℂ) ^ m * w ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) /
    (1 + ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℂ) ^ m * w ^ m / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ))

def CriticalUpperBoundProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ K₀ : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) < S.H →
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        Real.exp ((1 + ε) * k)

def ConePassageProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α m₀ δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m₀ → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L δ_star : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < δ_star ∧ δ_star < δ_b ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C ε₀ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < d₀ ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε₀ →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                d < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
                |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
                ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α } ∧
            (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
              d < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_star →
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m₀ * (S.H - p.1.im) →
              ‖p.2‖ < r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
              s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
              s_tilde (p.1, -p.2) = s_tilde p ∧
              ‖s_tilde p - p.1‖ ≤
                C * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
              (δ_star / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X) ∧
              (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_tilde p = S.𝔰 p))

def DeepFirstFieldModelProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, ∀ F : ℂ → ℂ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ F { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < d_seq n ∧ 0 < B_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto d_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto B_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    (∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      d_seq n ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - ξ_seq n| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
      (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S s ≤ C_A * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          S.f ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      F Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    ∀ A₀ T₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → 0 < T₀ →
      ∃ D₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧
        ∃ S_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_lim
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } ∧
          (∀ T Y : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) →
            (S_lim (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
            S_lim (-T, Y) = S_lim (T, Y) ∧
            ‖S_lim (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 3 *
              frozenFirstFieldG
                (T * F (S_lim (T, Y)) * deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y / 2) = 1) ∧
          (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
              ‖(S.𝔰 ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                  p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) -
                (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ) - S_lim p‖ < ε)

def DeepSecondFieldModelProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ d_seq B_seq ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, ∀ Q : ℂ → ℂ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ Q { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →

    (∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      d_seq n ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - ξ_seq n| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
      (d_seq n / B_seq n) * shapeModulus S s ≤ C_A * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →

      (fun n Z =>
