          S.f ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n Z =>
        ((d_seq n / B_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
          S.q ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
      Q Filter.atTop { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 } →
    ∀ A₀ T₀ : ℝ, 0 < A₀ → 0 < T₀ →
      ∃ D₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C₀ ∧
        ∃ S_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ S_lim
            { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } ∧
          (∀ T Y : ℂ, ‖T‖ < T₀ → D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) →
            (S_lim (T, Y)).im < 0 ∧
            S_lim (-T, Y) = S_lim (T, Y) ∧
            ‖S_lim (T, Y) - Y‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
            ‖(T / 2) ^ 2 * Q (S_lim (T, Y)) *
              (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 2‖ < 2 ∧
            (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 3 *
              frozenSecondFieldG
                ((T / 2) ^ 2 * Q (S_lim (T, Y)) *
                  (deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => S_lim (T, Y')) Y) ^ 2) = 1) ∧
          (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < A₀ * (-Y.im) → S_lim (0, Y) = Y) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.1‖ < T₀ ∧ D₀ < -p.2.im ∧ |p.2.re| < A₀ * (-p.2.im) } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X →
              ‖(S.𝔰 ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d_seq n : ℂ) * p.2,
                  p.1 * (d_seq n : ℂ) / (B_seq n : ℂ)) -
                (ξ_seq n : ℂ) - (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I) / (d_seq n : ℂ) - S_lim p‖ < ε)

def ExpProfileObstructionProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ c₀ : ℂ, ∀ α₀ δ_b : ℝ,
    c₀ ≠ 0 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, h_seq n < S.H ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ 0 < m_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds S.H) →
    Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (S.H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    ((TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop) ∨
     (TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            S.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop)) →
    ¬ (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → ∃ C_L : ℝ, 0 < C_L ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - s.im → h_seq n - s.im ≤ δ_b →
      |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L * (h_seq n - s.im) →
      shapeModulus S s ≤ C_L * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)

def EntireExpProfileObstructionProp (E : EntireNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ x_seq h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ c₀ : ℂ, ∀ α₀ C_ℓ C_cone : ℝ,
    c₀ ≠ 0 → 1 / 2 < α₀ → α₀ < 1 → 0 < C_ℓ → 0 < C_cone →
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < h_seq n ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ ℓ_seq n ≤ C_ℓ ∧ 0 < m_seq n) →
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => Real.log (1 + h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) / Real.log (m_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    ((TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            E.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            E.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop) ∨
     (TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            E.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun n Z =>
          (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
            E.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
        (fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z)) Filter.atTop)) →
    ¬ (∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
      ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - s.im → h_seq n - s.im ≤ h_seq n →
      max ‖E.f s‖ (Real.sqrt ‖E.q s‖) ≤
        C_cone * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - s.im)) ^ α₀)

def LogDeficitBoundProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∃ C_def : ℝ, 0 < C_def ∧
    ∀ z₀ : ℂ, ∀ Δ K : ℝ, 0 < Δ →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ horizStrip S.H →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖S.f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖) (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4),
        Δ * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖ ≤
          C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
            ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖S.f w‖))

def HasFiniteUpperGrowthOrder (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∃ P K₀ : ℝ, 1 < P ∧ ∀ k : ℝ, K₀ ≤ k → Real.exp (-k) < S.H →
    ∀ x : ℝ,
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
        Real.exp (P * k)

noncomputable def glancingTheta {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  C.ϕ_ℂ (C.U (y, t))

noncomputable def glancingOffset {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -supportAction1_ℂ C.h_ℂ (glancingTheta C y t) (glancingTheta C (y + t) t)

noncomputable def glancingDualLine {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (y t : ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![Complex.cos (glancingTheta C y t) / glancingOffset C y t,
    Complex.sin (glancingTheta C y t) / glancingOffset C y t]

noncomputable def glancingMidAngle {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (glancingTheta C (y - t / 2) t + glancingTheta C (y + t / 2) t) / 2

noncomputable def glancingImpact {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (y t : ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![C.h_ℂ (glancingMidAngle C y t) * Complex.cos (glancingMidAngle C y t) -
      deriv C.h_ℂ (glancingMidAngle C y t) * Complex.sin (glancingMidAngle C y t),
    C.h_ℂ (glancingMidAngle C y t) * Complex.sin (glancingMidAngle C y t) +
      deriv C.h_ℂ (glancingMidAngle C y t) * Complex.cos (glancingMidAngle C y t)]

noncomputable def glancingBoundaryCurve {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) (s : ℂ) :
    Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s) -
      deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s),
    C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Complex.sin (C.ϕ_ℂ s) +
      deriv C.h_ℂ (C.ϕ_ℂ s) * Complex.cos (C.ϕ_ℂ s)]

def horizStripENNR (H : ENNReal) : Set ℂ :=
  { s : ℂ | ENNReal.ofReal |s.im| < H }

def meroTubeENNR (r_base : ℝ) (h_W : ℂ → ENNReal) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ |
    ‖p.2‖ < r_base ∧
    ENNReal.ofReal (-p.1.im) < h_W (starRingEnd ℂ p.2) ∧
    ENNReal.ofReal p.1.im < h_W p.2 }

structure MeroOn2D (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) where
  rad : ℂ × ℂ → ℝ
  num : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  den : (ℂ × ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  rad_pos : ∀ p ∈ W, 0 < rad p
  ball_sub : ∀ p ∈ W, Metric.ball p (rad p) ⊆ W
  num_holo : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableOn ℂ (num p) (Metric.ball p (rad p))
  den_holo : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableOn ℂ (den p) (Metric.ball p (rad p))
  den_ne_zero : ∀ p ∈ W, ∃ q ∈ Metric.ball p (rad p), den p q ≠ 0
  compat : ∀ p₁ ∈ W, ∀ p₂ ∈ W,
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p₁ (rad p₁) ∩ Metric.ball p₂ (rad p₂),
      num p₁ q * den p₂ q = num p₂ q * den p₁ q

def MeroEqOn {W₁ W₂ : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F₁ : MeroOn2D W₁) (F₂ : MeroOn2D W₂)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ W₁ ∩ W₂ ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p (min (F₁.rad p) (F₂.rad p)),
    F₁.num p q * F₂.den p q = F₂.num p q * F₁.den p q

def MeroAgreesHolo {W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (F : MeroOn2D W) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
    (U : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ W ∧
  ∀ p ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ F.rad p ∧ Metric.ball p r ⊆ U ∧
    ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p r, F.num p q = f q * F.den p q

noncomputable def iterDerivY : ℕ → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  | 0, f => f
  | m + 1, f => fun p => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => iterDerivY m f (y', p.2)) p.1

noncomputable def iterDerivYT (α β : ℕ) (f : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] (fun t' : ℂ => iterDerivY α f (p.1, t'))) p.2

noncomputable def iterDeriv1D (β : ℕ) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((fun g : ℂ → ℂ => deriv g)^[β] A) t

abbrev LineJetVar (M : ℕ) : Type :=
  Fin 2 × Fin 2 × Fin (M + 1) × Fin (M + 1)

abbrev PointJetVar (M : ℕ) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin 2 × Fin 2 × Fin (M + 1) × Fin (M + 1)) (Fin (M + 1))

noncomputable def lineJetEnv (M : ℕ) (E₀ E₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    LineJetVar M → ℂ :=
  fun v =>
    if v.1 = 0 then
      iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₀ v.2.1) p
    else
      iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (E₁ v.2.1) p

noncomputable def pointJetEnv (M : ℕ) (P₀ P₁ : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) :
    PointJetVar M → ℂ
  | Sum.inl v =>
      if v.1 = 0 then
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (P₀ v.2.1) p
      else
        iterDerivYT v.2.2.1.1 v.2.2.2.1 (P₁ v.2.1) p
  | Sum.inr β =>
      iterDeriv1D β.1 A p.2

structure EndpointDeterminationData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) where
  s_det : ℝ
  r_det : ℝ
  s_det_pos : 0 < s_det
  s_det_le_s₁ : s_det ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_det_le_s₀ : s_det ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_det_pos : 0 < r_det
  r_det_lt_s_det : r_det < s_det / 4
  r_det_lt_r₁ : r_det < C.r₁ / 2
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_det → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_det →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  dualLine_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  impact_holo : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_det ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * r_det }
  line_determination :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j < k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
        (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ)
        (Disc : MvPolynomial (LineJetVar M) ℂ),
        (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (lineJetEnv M
                (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
                (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
                (y, t))
              (Q d) *
            (glancingDualLine C (y + (j : ℂ) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
        (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / (k : ℝ) ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (lineJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              (y, t))
            (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (lineJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingDualLine C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              (y, t))
            Disc ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ (env : LineJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
          MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
          MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin D,
            (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)
  point_determination :
    ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < j → j ≤ k → ∀ ι : Fin 2,
      ∃ (M D : ℕ) (_hD : 1 ≤ D)
        (Q : Fin (D + 1) → MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ)
        (Disc : MvPolynomial (PointJetVar M) ℂ),
        (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det → ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1),
            MvPolynomial.eval
              (pointJetEnv M
                (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
                (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
                C.A (y, t))
              (Q d) *
            (glancingDualLine C (y + ((j : ℂ) - 1 / 2) * t) t ι) ^ (d : ℕ) = 0) ∧
        (∃ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s_det ∧ ‖t‖ < r_det / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (pointJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              C.A (y, t))
            (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 ∧
          MvPolynomial.eval
            (pointJetEnv M
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C q.1 q.2 c)
              (fun c q => glancingImpact C (q.1 + (k : ℂ) * q.2) q.2 c)
              C.A (y, t))
            Disc ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ (env : PointJetVar M → ℂ) (z : ℂ),
          MvPolynomial.eval env (Q (Fin.last D)) ≠ 0 →
          MvPolynomial.eval env Disc ≠ 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin (D + 1), MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d) * z ^ (d : ℕ) = 0 →
          ∑ d : Fin D,
            (((d : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * MvPolynomial.eval env (Q d.succ) * z ^ (d : ℕ) ≠ 0)

structure MeromorphicCollarData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω) where
  s_base : ℝ
  r_base : ℝ
  s_base_pos : 0 < s_base
  s_base_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_base_le_s₀ : s_base ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_base_pos : 0 < r_base
  r_base_lt_s_base : r_base < s_base / 4
  r_base_lt_r₁ : r_base < C.r₁ / 2
  r_base_lt_pi : r_base < Real.pi
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_base →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  h_X : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_L : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_X_ge : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, ENNReal.ofReal s_base ≤ h_X t
  h_L_eq : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base,
    h_L t = h_X t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2)
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_L_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_L (-t) = h_L t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_L_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_L (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_X_supermean : ∀ (t₀ : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_base →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_X t₀
  L_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_L)
  X_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_X)
  L_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (L_mero i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  X_agrees : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  no_patch_X_at_real : ∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < r_base → h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (X_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }
  no_patch_L_at_real : ∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < r_base → h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (L_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }
  mero_disk_continuation :
    ∀ (r_w ρ R : ℝ) (w₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ),
      0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → ρ < R → 0 < r₀ →
      Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w →
      ∀ (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))
        (F₀ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
        MeroEqOn F F₀ (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
        ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
          MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR r_base h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ_slice z i

def HasIsotropicCenter {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) : Prop :=
  ∃ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∃ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ u p ∧ u p ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z

noncomputable def signTestH1 (K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)

noncomputable def robustDiskRadius (K k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k - signTestH1 K / 4)

noncomputable def upperRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

noncomputable def lowerRowPt (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (x : ℂ) - ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I

def HasRobustSignDisk (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ((∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-signTestH1 K)) ∨
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (upperRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖)) ∧
  ((∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      ‖S.f ζ‖ ≤ Real.exp (-signTestH1 K)) ∨
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (lowerRowPt S k x) (3 * robustDiskRadius K k),
      Real.exp (signTestH1 K) ≤ ‖S.f ζ‖))

def cycNext (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

def cycPrev (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (j : Fin N) : Fin N :=
  ⟨(j.val + N - 1) % N, Nat.mod_lt _ (NeZero.pos N)⟩

noncomputable def jacobiM0 (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    (if i = k then (ℓ_vec (cycPrev N i))⁻¹ + (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if k = cycNext N i then (ℓ_vec i)⁻¹ else 0) +
    (if i = cycNext N k then (ℓ_vec k)⁻¹ else 0)

noncomputable def jacobiVDiag (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  2 * (f_vec j) ^ 3 / ((c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j))

noncomputable def jacobiH (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec - Matrix.diagonal (jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec)

noncomputable def modifiedJacobiB (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (c : ℝ)
    (f_vec d0_vec ℓ_vec : Fin N → ℂ) (I F : Finset (Fin N)) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ :=
  Matrix.of fun i k =>
    if i ∈ I ∪ F ∧ k ∈ I ∪ F then
      jacobiM0 N ℓ_vec i k - (if i = k ∧ i ∈ I then jacobiVDiag N c f_vec d0_vec i else 0)
    else if i = k then 1 else 0

noncomputable def jacobiNullVec (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f_vec d0_vec sp_vec : Fin N → ℂ)
    (j : Fin N) : ℂ :=
  (c : ℂ) * Complex.sin (d0_vec j) * (f_vec j)⁻¹ ^ 2 * sp_vec j

noncomputable def sliceParamT0 (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  2 * Real.pi / (N : ℝ)

noncomputable def sliceHeight (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  S.h_X (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ)

noncomputable def sliceImpactSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.𝔰 (y + (j : ℂ) * (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))

noncomputable def sliceAngleSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.ϕ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSpeedSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.f (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def sliceSupportSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  S.H0 (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

noncomputable def slicePosSeq (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (N : ℕ)
    (j : ℤ) (y : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  S.Γ (sliceImpactSeq S N j y)

structure OddPeriodicSliceData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  N : ℕ
  instNeZero : NeZero N
  N_odd : Odd N
  N_ge_three : 3 ≤ N
  t₀_lt_r_star : sliceParamT0 N < S.r_star
  θ_seq : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ
  θ_holo : ∀ j : ℤ, DifferentiableOn ℂ (θ_seq j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  θ_quasiperiodic : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_shift_N : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j + (N : ℤ)) y = θ_seq j y + 2 * Real.pi
  θ_conj : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (θ_seq j y)
  θ_sum : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    θ_seq (j - 1) y + θ_seq j y = 2 * sliceAngleSeq S N j y
  θ_real : ∀ j : ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    θ_seq j x =
      S.Θ_gl ((x : ℂ) + ((((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * sliceParamT0 N : ℝ) : ℂ), (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ))
  ℓ_num : Fin N → ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_num_holo : ∀ j : Fin N, DifferentiableOn ℂ (ℓ_num j) (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N))
  ℓ_num_periodic : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N),
    ℓ_num j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = ℓ_num j y
  ℓ_real : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ x : ℝ,
    ℓ_num j x / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val x * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) x) =
      (S.ℓ_chord (x + (j.val : ℝ) * sliceParamT0 N) (sliceParamT0 N) : ℂ)
  C_rec : ℝ
  C_rec_pos : 0 < C_rec
  Z_all : Set ℂ
  Z_all_subset : Z_all ⊆ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N)
  reg_open : IsOpen (horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all)
  real_not_mem_Z_all : ∀ x : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ∉ Z_all
  Z_all_periodic : ∀ y : ℂ, y ∈ Z_all ↔ y + 2 * Real.pi ∈ Z_all
  Z_all_compact_finite : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < sliceHeight S N →
    (Z_all ∩ {y : ℂ | y.re ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ∧ |y.im| ≤ sliceHeight S N - ε}).Finite
  reg_speed_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y ≠ 0
  reg_sin_d0_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y) ≠ 0
  reg_chord_vec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 0 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 =
      -(ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.sin (θ_seq j.val y) ∧
    slicePosSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y 1 - slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 =
      (ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)) *
        Complex.cos (θ_seq j.val y)
  reg_deriv_pos : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 0) y =
      -(S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y ∧
    deriv (fun z => slicePosSeq S N j.val z 1) y =
      (S.c : ℂ) * (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y
  reg_deriv_support : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    deriv (sliceSupportSeq S N j.val) y =
      (-slicePosSeq S N j.val y 0 * Complex.sin (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y) +
        slicePosSeq S N j.val y 1 * Complex.cos (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)) *
      deriv (sliceAngleSeq S N j.val) y
  pos_reconstruction : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ B_ang B_sup : ℝ, 0 ≤ B_ang → 0 ≤ B_sup →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y‖ +
        |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (θ_seq k.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N k.val y)‖| ≤ B_ang) →
      (∀ k : Fin N, ‖sliceSupportSeq S N k.val y‖ ≤ B_sup) →
      ∀ j : Fin N, ‖slicePosSeq S N j.val y‖ ≤ C_rec * Real.exp (C_rec * B_ang) * B_sup
  jacobi_null : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    (@jacobiH N instNeZero S.c
      (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
      (fun j => ℓ_num j y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
      (jacobiNullVec N S.c
        (fun j => sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N j.val y)
        (fun j => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y)) = 0
  jacobi_M0_mulVec : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    2 * sliceSpeedSeq S N j.val y * deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val) y =
      (@jacobiM0 N instNeZero
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))).mulVec
        (jacobiNullVec N S.c
          (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
          (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y)) j
  modified_det_ne_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all,
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        I F).det ≠ 0
  cofactor_norm : ∀ y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) \ Z_all, ∀ j : Fin N,
    (jacobiNullVec N S.c
      (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
      (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S N i.val) y) j) ^ 2 =
    (-1 : ℂ) ^ (N - 1) * (S.A (sliceParamT0 N : ℂ) / (N : ℂ)) *
      (∏ i : Fin N, (ℓ_num i y /
        (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))) *
      (@modifiedJacobiB N instNeZero S.c
        (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => θ_seq i.val y - sliceAngleSeq S N i.val y)
        (fun i => ℓ_num i y /
          (sliceSpeedSeq S N i.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S N ((i.val : ℤ) + 1) y))
        (Finset.univ.erase j) ∅).det
  boundary_contact : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume,
    ∀ sgn : ℝ, (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) →
      ∃ s_lim : Fin N → ℂ,
        (∀ A_cone : ℝ, 0 < A_cone → ∀ j : Fin N,
          Filter.Tendsto (sliceImpactSeq S N j.val)
            (nhdsWithin ((x : ℂ) + ((sgn * sliceHeight S N : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
              {y : ℂ | y ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S N) ∧
                |y.re - x| ≤ A_cone * (sliceHeight S N - |y.im|)})
            (nhds (s_lim j))) ∧
        ∃ j : Fin N, |(s_lim j).im| = S.H

instance instNeZeroOddSliceN (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) :
    NeZero P.N :=
  P.instNeZero

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.d0 {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.θ_seq j.val y - sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.ℓ_slice {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  P.ℓ_num j y / (sliceSpeedSeq S P.N j.val y * sliceSpeedSeq S P.N ((j.val : ℤ) + 1) y)

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.B_mat {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (I F : Finset (Fin P.N)) (y : ℂ) :
    Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ :=
  modifiedJacobiB P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => P.ℓ_slice i y) I F

noncomputable def OddPeriodicSliceData.w_vec {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) (y : ℂ) : Fin P.N → ℂ :=
  jacobiNullVec P.N S.c
    (fun i => sliceSpeedSeq S P.N i.val y)
    (fun i => P.d0 i y)
    (fun i => deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) y)

noncomputable def unifTwoPiMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ :=
  (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ •
    MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))

abbrev WalkSpace : Type := ℕ → ℝ

noncomputable def walkMeasure : MeasureTheory.Measure WalkSpace :=
  MeasureTheory.Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => unifTwoPiMeasure)

noncomputable def walkPos (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ → ℂ
  | 0 => (om 0 : ℂ)
  | m + 1 =>
      walkPos ρ om m + (ρ (walkPos ρ om m) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((om (m + 1) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

noncomputable def sliceShapeDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - |(sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val y).im|

noncomputable def sliceLogDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (j : Fin P.N) (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  -Real.log (sliceShapeDepth S P j y)

noncomputable def sliceGeomCost (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (y : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty fun j : Fin P.N =>
    ‖sliceAngleSeq S P.N j.val y‖ +
      Real.log (1 + ‖slicePosSeq S P.N j.val y‖) +
      |Real.log ‖Complex.sin (P.d0 j y)‖| +
      |Real.log ‖P.ℓ_slice j y‖|

noncomputable def sliceHistory (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) (j : Fin P.N) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (Finset.range (m + 1)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ m)⟩ fun n =>
    sliceLogDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om n)

noncomputable def sliceStopTau (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @dite _
    (∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun j => sliceHistory S P ρ om j m))
    (Classical.propDecidable _)
    (fun h => @Nat.find _ (Classical.decPred _) h)
    (fun _ => 0)

noncomputable def sliceFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (j : Fin P.N) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨ sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos ρ om m) ≤ d)
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨sliceStopTau S P ρ L om, Or.inl le_rfl⟩

noncomputable def sliceLastFirstHit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  J.sup' hJ fun j => sliceFirstHit S P ρ L d j om

noncomputable def sliceDiskExit (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S)
    (ρ : ℂ → ℝ) (L d r_exit : ℝ) (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N)
    (om : WalkSpace) : ℕ :=
  @Nat.find
    (fun m : ℕ =>
      sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om ≤ m ∧
        (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om ≤ m ∨
          r_exit < ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om m) -
            sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val (walkPos ρ om (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om))‖))
    (Classical.decPred _)
    ⟨max (sliceLastFirstHit S P ρ L d J hJ om) (sliceStopTau S P ρ L om),
      le_max_left _ _, Or.inl (le_max_right _ _)⟩

structure StoppedSliceGeometryData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (P : OddPeriodicSliceData S) where
  stepRadius : ℝ → ℂ → ℝ
  L_min : ℝ
  C_inv : ℝ
  C_hit : ℝ
  C_clk : ℝ
  C_rem : ℝ
  L_min_ge_two : 2 ≤ L_min
  C_inv_pos : 0 < C_inv
  C_hit_pos : 0 < C_hit
  C_clk_pos : 0 < C_clk
  C_rem_pos : 0 < C_rem
  stepRadius_measurable : ∀ L : ℝ, Measurable (stepRadius L)
  walk_in_reg_domain : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    walkPos (stepRadius L) om m ∈ horizStrip (sliceHeight S P.N) \ P.Z_all ∧
    0 < stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_small_step : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → ∀ om : WalkSpace, ∀ m : ℕ,
    m < sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om → ∀ j : Fin P.N,
      ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (m + 1)) -
        sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ≤
      Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)
  walk_stops_ae : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    ∀ᵐ om : WalkSpace ∂walkMeasure,
      ∃ m : ℕ, L ≤ Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun j => sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om j m)
  walk_clock_bound : ∀ L : ℝ, L_min ≤ L →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun om : WalkSpace => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
        (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) walkMeasure ∧
    (∫ om, (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
      (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2) ∂walkMeasure) ≤ C_clk
  all_power_geometry : ∀ σ δ : ℝ, 0 < σ → 0 < δ →
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, L_min ≤ L₁ ∧ ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
      walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
        ∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
          L ^ σ < sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)} ≤ δ
  modified_inverse_bound : ∀ L U V : ℝ, L_min ≤ L → 1 ≤ U → U ≤ V →
    ∀ I F : Finset (Fin P.N), I ⊂ Finset.univ → Disjoint I F →
      ∃ E_bad : Set WalkSpace, MeasurableSet E_bad ∧
        walkMeasure.real E_bad ≤ C_inv * (1 + U) / (1 + V) ∧
        ∀ om : WalkSpace, om ∉ E_bad →
          ∀ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
            (∀ n ≤ m, sliceGeomCost S P (walkPos (stepRadius L) om n) ≤ U) →
            (∀ i ∈ I, sliceHistory S P (stepRadius L) om i m ≤ U) →
            ∃ B_inv : Matrix (Fin P.N) (Fin P.N) ℂ,
              P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) * B_inv = 1 ∧
              B_inv * P.B_mat I F (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) = 1 ∧
              ∀ r c : Fin P.N, ‖B_inv r c‖ ≤ Real.exp (C_inv * V)
  first_hit_interval_domination : ∀ L d r_int : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N, ∀ E : Set ℝ,
    L_min ≤ L → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    100 * Real.exp (-L ^ 2) * d ≤ r_int →
    MeasurableSet E → (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ E ↔ x + 2 * Real.pi ∈ E) →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∃ m ≤ sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om,
        sliceShapeDepth S P j (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m) ≤ d) ∧
      Set.Ioo
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om))).re - r_int)
        ((sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val
          (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om))).re + r_int) ⊆
        E} ≤
    C_hit * MeasureTheory.volume.real (E ∩ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi))
  remaining_clock_tail : ∀ L d B : ℝ, ∀ j : Fin P.N,
    L_min ≤ L → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 1 ≤ B → d * Real.exp (B / 4) < S.H / 4 →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      d ^ 2 * Real.exp B <
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d j om)
            (sliceStopTau S P (stepRadius L) L om),
          ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N j.val) (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ^ 2 *
            (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2} ≤
    C_rem * Real.exp (-B / 4)
  stopped_displacement_bound : ∀ L d r_exit q_K : ℝ,
    ∀ (J : Finset (Fin P.N)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (i : Fin P.N),
    L_min ≤ L → i ∈ J → 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → 0 < r_exit → 0 < q_K →
    walkMeasure.real {om : WalkSpace |
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico (sliceLastFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d J hJ om)
          (sliceDiskExit S P (stepRadius L) L d r_exit J hJ i om),
        (2 * ‖deriv (sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val) (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)‖ ^ 2 +
          Real.exp (-2 * L ^ 3)) *
          (stepRadius L (walkPos (stepRadius L) om m)) ^ 2 ≤ q_K) ∧
      r_exit <
        ‖sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceDiskExit S P (stepRadius L) L d r_exit J hJ i om)) -
          sliceImpactSeq S P.N i.val
            (walkPos (stepRadius L) om (sliceLastFirstHit S P (stepRadius L) L d J hJ om))‖} ≤
    2 * q_K / r_exit ^ 2

def criticalLowerHalfPlane : Set ℂ :=
  { z : ℂ | z.im < 0 }


noncomputable def criticalDepthThreshold (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ℝ :=
  max 1 (-Real.log (S.H / 20))


def upperStripTile (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (A k x : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { s : ℂ |
    0 ≤ s.im ∧
    Real.exp (-A) * Real.exp (-k) ≤ wallDepth S s ∧
    wallDepth S s ≤ min (S.H / 2) (Real.exp A * Real.exp (-k)) ∧
    |s.re - x| ≤ A * wallDepth S s }


noncomputable def tileSupModulus (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (A k x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-k) * sSup (shapeModulus S '' upperStripTile S A k x)


noncomputable def periodicPoissonKernel (d_a u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.sinh d_a / (Real.cosh d_a - Real.cos u)


noncomputable def ancestorPoissonDensity (d_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), periodicPoissonKernel d_a (x - y) * w y


structure IsCriticalEnvelope (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (β a C_N C₁ : ℝ) (N : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  one_le : ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k → 1 ≤ N k
  coarse_bound : ∀ j k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k →
    N j ≤ C_N * N k * Real.exp (β * (k - j))
  fine_bound : ∀ j k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k → k ≤ j →
    N j ≤ C_N * N k * Real.exp (a * (j - k))
  first_moment_bound : ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
    Real.exp (-k) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ≤ C₁ * N k
  finite_ratio : ∃ M_fin : ℝ, 0 < M_fin ∧
    ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k → rowMomentFull S k ≤ M_fin * N k


structure CriticalBootstrapPackage (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  unweighted_bootstrap :
    ∀ β a C_N C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 1 ≤ C_N → 0 < C₁ →
      ∃ C_boot η : ℝ, 0 < C_boot ∧ 0 < η ∧
        (∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
          (∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
            rowMomentFull S k ≤ C_boot * N k ∧
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              Real.exp (-k) *
                |(S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im|) ≤
              C_boot * (N k) ^ 2 ∧
            (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
              (Real.exp (-k) *
                shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
                N k) ^ (2 + η)) ≤
              C_boot ^ (2 + η)) ∧
          (MonotoneOn N (Set.Ici (criticalDepthThreshold S)) →
            ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k → ∀ x : ℝ,
              Real.exp (-k) *
                shapeModulus S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≤
                C_boot * (1 + k) * N k ∧
              Real.exp (-k) *
                |(S.V ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤
                C_boot * (1 + k) ^ 2 * (N k) ^ 2)) ∧
        (∀ A : ℝ, 1 ≤ A → ∃ C_tile : ℝ, 0 < C_tile ∧
          ∀ N : ℝ → ℝ, IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
            ∀ k : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k →
              Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                (tileSupModulus S A k x) ^ 2) ≤ C_tile * N k)
  weighted_bootstrap :
    ∀ β a C_N C₁ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 1 ≤ C_N → 0 < C₁ → 1 ≤ A →
      ∃ K_anc A_coarse : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_anc ∧ A ≤ A_coarse ∧
        ∀ M_coarse M_anc : ℝ, 0 < M_coarse → 0 < M_anc →
          ∃ C_w : ℝ, 0 < C_w ∧
            ∀ (N : ℝ → ℝ) (k_a : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
              IsCriticalEnvelope S β a C_N C₁ N →
              K_anc ≤ k_a →
              Continuous w →
              Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) →
              (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w y) →
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w y) = 1 →
              (∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k_a + 3 →
                Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  (tileSupModulus S A_coarse j x) ^ 2 *
                    ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
                  M_coarse * N j) →
              (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                |(S.V ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_a) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| * w y) ≤
                M_anc * (N k_a) ^ 2 / Real.exp (-k_a) →
              ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
                Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  (tileSupModulus S A j x) ^ 2 *
                    ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_a)) w x) ≤
                  C_w * N j
  quiet_cone_exclusion :
    ∀ α δ_b : ℝ, 1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
      ∃ L_star : ℝ, 0 < L_star ∧
        ∀ β a C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β → β < 1 / 2 → 0 < a → 0 < C₀ →
          ∀ k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ,
            (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_seq n) →
            Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
            (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
              rowMomentFull S l ≤ C₀ * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) *
                Real.exp (β * max (k_seq n - l) 0 + a * max (l - k_seq n) 0)) →
            ¬ (∀ c_depth ε : ℝ, 0 < c_depth → 0 < ε →
              ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
                c_depth * Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
                wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
                |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
                (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) *
                  shapeModulus S s * (wallDepth S s / Real.exp (-k_seq n)) ^ α ≤ ε)


def ProhibitedCriticalSequence (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∃ (k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_anc_seq n ∧
      k_anc_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
      0 < ε_seq n ∧
      1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
      rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |j - k_seq n|)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto k_anc_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => k_seq n - k_anc_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq n) ∧
      Function.Periodic (w_seq n) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w_seq n y) ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w_seq n y) = 1) ∧
    (∀ β A : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ A →
      ∃ C_βA : ℝ, 0 < C_βA ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
        ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k_anc_seq n + 3 →
          Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (tileSupModulus S A j x) ^ 2 *
              ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x) ≤
            C_βA * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (β * (k_seq n - j))) ∧
    (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ C_β : ℝ, 0 < C_β ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          |(S.V ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| *
            w_seq n y) ≤
          C_β * (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
            Real.exp (2 * β * (k_seq n - k_anc_seq n)) / Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) ∧
    (∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
            (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
              ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) *
            ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0))


structure SecondScaleFirstFieldData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  F : ℂ → ℂ
  Q_lim : ℂ → ℂ
  L_lim : ℝ → ℝ
  lam : ℝ
  β : ℝ
  a : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  δ_b : ℝ
  C_env2 : ℝ
  K_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  ξ_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  F_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ F criticalLowerHalfPlane
  Q_lim_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Q_lim criticalLowerHalfPlane
  F_nonzero : ∃ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, F z ≠ 0
  deriv2_F : ∀ z ∈ criticalLowerHalfPlane, deriv (deriv F) z = Q_lim z * F z
  one_le_lam : 1 ≤ lam
  β_pos : 0 < β
  β_lt_half : β < 1 / 2
  a_pos : 0 < a
  half_lt_α : 1 / 2 < α
  α_lt_one_sub_β : α < 1 - β
  δ_b_pos : 0 < δ_b
  δ_b_lt : δ_b < S.H / 2
  C_env2_pos : 0 < C_env2
  L_lim_cont : Continuous L_lim
  L_lim_zero : L_lim 0 = 0
  L_lim_slope_top : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atTop (nhds lam)
  L_lim_slope_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => L_lim v / v) Filter.atBot (nhds lam)
  K_seq_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ K_seq n ∧ 1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (K_seq n)
  K_seq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto K_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  B_seq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (K_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  moment_law_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n v => Real.exp v * (rowMomentFull S (K_seq n + v) / rowMomentFull S (K_seq n)))
    (fun v => Real.exp (L_lim v)) Filter.atTop
  global_envelope : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ l →
    rowMomentFull S l ≤ C_env2 * rowMomentFull S (K_seq n) *
      Real.exp (β * max (K_seq n - l) 0 + a * max (l - K_seq n) 0)
  cone_bound : ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C_A : ℝ, 0 < C_A ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ s : ℂ,
    Real.exp (-K_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
    wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
    |s.re - ξ_seq n| ≤ A * wallDepth S s →
    (Real.exp (-K_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (K_seq n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
      C_A * (Real.exp (-K_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ α
  F_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
    (fun n Z =>
      ((Real.exp (-K_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (K_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        S.f ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-K_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
    F Filter.atTop criticalLowerHalfPlane
  Q_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
    (fun n Z =>
      ((Real.exp (-K_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (K_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        S.q ((ξ_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-K_seq n) : ℂ) * Z))
    (fun _ => 0) Filter.atTop criticalLowerHalfPlane


structure FirstFieldMeshHypotheses (F : ℂ → ℂ) (lam : ℝ) : Prop where
  upper_growth :
    ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
      ∃ v₀ : ℝ, 0 < v₀ ∧ ∀ v x : ℝ, v₀ ≤ v → |x| ≤ R →
        ‖F ((x : ℂ) - (Real.exp (-v) : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Real.exp ((lam + ε) * v)
  epochs_and_witnesses :
    ∃ (L₀ : ℝ) (E : Set ℝ),
      0 < L₀ ∧
      (∀ u ∈ E, 0 < u) ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ v₀ : ℝ, 0 < v₀ ∧ ∀ v : ℝ, v₀ ≤ v → ∃ u ∈ E, |v - u| ≤ ε * v) ∧
      (∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε →
        ∃ u₀ : ℝ, 0 < u₀ ∧ ∀ u ∈ E, u₀ ≤ u → ∀ x : ℝ, |x| ≤ R →
          ∃ p δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ |p - x| ≤ L₀ * δ ∧
            |-Real.log δ - u| ≤ ε * u ∧
            Real.exp ((lam - ε) * u) ≤ ‖F ((p : ℂ) - (δ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)

noncomputable def supportAction1_ℝ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  deriv h ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) -
    h ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Real.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)

noncomputable def supportAction2_ℝ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  deriv h ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Real.sin ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2) +
    h ((θ₁ + θ₂) / 2) * Real.cos ((θ₂ - θ₁) / 2)

def glancingDomain (ν s d : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < d ∧ |p.1.im| < s - ν * |p.2.im| }

def IsAdmissibleGlancingCand (s d η_adm : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ U (glancingDomain 0 s d) ∧
  (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s d →
    U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = U (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
  (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s d → U (y, -t) = U (y, t)) ∧
  (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s d →
    U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (U (y, t))) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 → ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 s d →
    ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') y‖ ≤ η_adm)

structure RationalCollarData (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  b₀ : ℝ
  δ_col : ℝ
  τ₀ : ℝ
  b₀_pos : 0 < b₀
  δ_col_pos : 0 < δ_col
  δ_col_lt_pi : δ_col < Real.pi
  τ₀_pos : 0 < τ₀
  F_col : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  F_col_cont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F_col p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo 0 b₀ ×ˢ Set.univ)
  F_col_quasiperiodic : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀, ∀ x : ℝ,
    F_col b (x + 2 * Real.pi) = F_col b x + 2 * Real.pi
  F_col_strictMono_x : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀, StrictMono (F_col b)
  F_col_strictMono_b : ∀ b₁ b₂ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < b₀ → ∀ x : ℝ,
    F_col b₁ x < F_col b₂ x
  F_col_step_bounds : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀, ∀ x : ℝ,
    0 < F_col b x - x ∧ ϕ (F_col b x) - ϕ x < Real.pi
  F_col_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ b₁ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ ∧ b₁ ≤ b₀ ∧
    ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁, ∀ x : ℝ, F_col b x - x < ε
  F_col_stationary : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀, ∀ x : ℝ,
    -supportAction1_ℝ h (ϕ (F_col b x)) (ϕ (F_col b (F_col b x))) =
      supportAction2_ℝ h (ϕ x) (ϕ (F_col b x))
  collar_fills_steps : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ, 0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ < δ_col →
    ∃! b : ℝ, b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀ ∧ F_col b x₀ = x₁
  forward_step_unique : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ x₂' : ℝ,
    0 < ϕ x₁ - ϕ x₀ → ϕ x₁ - ϕ x₀ < Real.pi →
    0 < ϕ x₂ - ϕ x₁ → ϕ x₂ - ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
    0 < ϕ x₂' - ϕ x₁ → ϕ x₂' - ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
    -supportAction1_ℝ h (ϕ x₁) (ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ h (ϕ x₀) (ϕ x₁) →
    -supportAction1_ℝ h (ϕ x₁) (ϕ x₂') = supportAction2_ℝ h (ϕ x₀) (ϕ x₁) →
    x₂ = x₂'
  rational_leaf_all_periodic : ∀ l q : ℕ, 0 < l → 0 < q → Nat.Coprime l q →
    (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ) < τ₀ →
    (∃ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀, ∀ x : ℝ, (F_col b)^[q] x = x + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₀,
      (∃ x₀ : ℝ, (F_col b)^[q] x₀ = x₀ + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) →
      ∀ x : ℝ, (F_col b)^[q] x = x + 2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ))

def IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (r₀ : ℕ) (M : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (r₀ : WithTop ℕ∞) w ∧
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r₀ → ∀ x : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv k w x| ≤ M

def IsBoundedStripExt (r₀ : ℕ) (σ M : ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  DifferentiableOn ℂ W (horizStrip σ) ∧
  (∀ x : ℝ, W x = w x) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (z + 2 * Real.pi) = W z) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, W (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (W z)) ∧
  (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r₀ → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ‖iteratedDeriv k W z‖ ≤ M)

structure HighFreqActionSystem (u_table : ℝ → ℝ) where
  C_coeff : ℤ → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℂ
  b_mult : ℤ → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℂ)
  N_vanish : ℕ
  N_vanish_pos : 1 ≤ N_vanish
  C_zero : ∀ n : ℤ, (N_vanish : ℤ) ≤ |n| → C_coeff n (fun _ => 0) = 0
  C_table_zero : ∀ n : ℤ, (N_vanish : ℤ) ≤ |n| → C_coeff n u_table = 0
  C_conj_symm : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, C_coeff (-n) w = starRingEnd ℂ (C_coeff n w)
  b_mult_conj_symm : ∀ n : ℤ, ∀ w : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
    b_mult (-n) w x = starRingEnd ℂ (b_mult n w x)
  deriv_and_bounds : ∀ (m : ℕ) (M : ℝ), 2 ≤ m → 0 < M →
    ∃ (K : ℝ) (N_m : ℕ), 0 < K ∧ N_vanish ≤ N_m ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ), (N_m : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ), IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
          ContDiff ℝ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) (b_mult n w) ∧
          Function.Periodic (b_mult n w) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
          (∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ), Function.Periodic v (2 * Real.pi) →
            ContDiff ℝ ((m + 15 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) v →
            HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => C_coeff n (fun x => w x + t * v x))
              (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
                  Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * b_mult n w x * (v x : ℂ)) 0) ∧
          (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => b_mult n w y - 1) x‖ ≤ K / |(n : ℝ)|)) ∧
        (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ x : ℝ,
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => b_mult n w₁ y - b_mult n w₂ y) x‖ ≤
              (K / |(n : ℝ)|) *
                sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ m + 15, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
                  r = |iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂) y| })) ∧
      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (n : ℤ), σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 → (N_m : ℤ) ≤ |n| →
        K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
        (∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w →
          IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w W →
          ∃ B : ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ B (horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
            (∀ x : ℝ, B x = b_mult n w x) ∧
            (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ), B (z + 2 * Real.pi) = B z) ∧
            (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
              ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => B ζ - 1) z‖ ≤ K / |(n : ℝ)|)) ∧
        (∀ (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ B₁ B₂ : ℂ → ℂ),
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₁ →
          IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M w₂ →
          IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₁ W₁ →
          IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M w₂ W₂ →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ B₁ (horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ B₂ (horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) →
          (∀ x : ℝ, B₁ x = b_mult n w₁ x) →
          (∀ x : ℝ, B₂ x = b_mult n w₂ x) →
          ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
            ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => B₁ ζ - B₂ ζ) z‖ ≤
              (K / |(n : ℝ)|) *
                sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ m + 15, ∃ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
                  r = ‖iteratedDeriv j (W₁ - W₂) ζ‖ }))

structure AnalyticBoundaryData (Ω : Set Plane) extends RationalCollarData Ω where
  s₀ : ℝ
  s_h : ℝ
  s₀_pos : 0 < s₀
  s_h_pos : 0 < s_h
  u_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  h_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ_ℂ : ℂ → ℂ
  u_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ u_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s₀))
  u_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, u_ℂ x = Real.log (deriv ϕ x)
  u_ℂ_periodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), u_ℂ (z + 2 * Real.pi) = u_ℂ z
  u_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    u_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_ℂ z)

  ϕ_ℂ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ_ℂ (horizStrip (2 * s₀))
  ϕ_ℂ_maps_to : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀), ϕ_ℂ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h)
  h_ℂ_real : ∀ θ : ℝ, h_ℂ θ = h θ
  ϕ_ℂ_real : ∀ x : ℝ, ϕ_ℂ x = ϕ x
  h_ℂ_periodic : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h), h_ℂ (w + 2 * Real.pi) = h_ℂ w
  h_ℂ_conj : ∀ w ∈ horizStrip (2 * s_h),
    h_ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ w) = starRingEnd ℂ (h_ℂ w)
  ϕ_ℂ_quasiperiodic : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),

  ϕ_ℂ_conj : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),

  lazutkin_norm_ℂ : ∀ z ∈ horizStrip (2 * s₀),
    (h_ℂ (ϕ_ℂ z) + deriv (deriv h_ℂ) (ϕ_ℂ z)) * (deriv ϕ_ℂ z) ^ 3 = c

structure GlancingActionAndStepData {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  C_step : ℝ
  c_small : ℝ
  B₀ : ℕ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le : s_act ≤ B.s₀
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt : d_act < s_act / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le : η_adm ≤ 1 / 4
  C_step_pos : 0 < C_step
  c_small_pos : 0 < c_small
  c_small_le : c_small ≤ η_adm / 4
  E_op : (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) → (ℂ × ℂ → ℂ)
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (E_op U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      E_op U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = E_op U (y, t) ∧
      E_op U (y, -t) = E_op U (y, t) ∧
      E_op U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (E_op U (y, t))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), E_op U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      E_op U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖E_op U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖E_op (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (E_op U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => E_op (U_seq n) p) Filter.atTop (nhds (E_op U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, E_op U p = 0) →
    ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| + ‖t‖ < s → ‖t‖ < d →
      -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  newton_step : ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
    Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ) ≤ ε →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * η_adm / 4) U →
    C_step * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B₀ * ε ≤ c_small →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖E_op U p‖ ≤ ε) →
    ∃ ΔU : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ ΔU (glancingDomain 0 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ)) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ) →
        ΔU (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = ΔU (y, t)) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ) →
        ΔU (y, -t) = ΔU (y, t)) ∧
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ) →
        ΔU (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (ΔU (y, t))) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 3 → ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 0 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ) →
        ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => ΔU (y', t)) y‖ ≤
          C_step * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B₀ * ε) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 (s - 20 * δ) (d - 20 * δ),
        ‖E_op (fun q => U q + ΔU q) p‖ ≤
          C_step * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B₀ * ε ^ 2)

def lmLowerHalfPlane : Set ℂ :=
  { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 }

def lmCompactRect (r : ℕ) : Set ℂ :=
  { Z : ℂ |
    Z.re ∈ Set.Icc (-((r : ℝ) + 2)) ((r : ℝ) + 2) ∧
    Z.im ∈ Set.Icc (-((r : ℝ) + 3)) (-(1 / ((r : ℝ) + 2))) }

noncomputable def lmRescaledF (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.exp (-k) / rowMomentFull S k : ℝ) : ℂ) *
    S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z)

noncomputable def lmRescaledQ (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (k x : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((Real.exp (-k) / rowMomentFull S k : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
    S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * Z)

noncomputable def lmRowModerateMeas (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  MeasureTheory.volume.real
    {x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) |
      Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤ ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ∧
      ‖S.f (upperRowPt S k x)‖ ≤ Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}

noncomputable def lmBoxModerateFraction (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (K k x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume.real
    {p : ℝ × ℝ |
      p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2 ∧
      Real.exp (-K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ)) ≤
        ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
          (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ∧
      ‖S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Real.exp (-k) : ℂ) * ((p.1 : ℂ) - (p.2 : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖ ≤
        Real.exp (K ^ (1 / 200 : ℝ))}

structure NormalizedCenterEnvelope (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) (L_star C_cone : ℝ)
    (M_exhaust : ℕ → ℝ) (k_seq x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  C_cone_pos : 0 < C_cone
  M_exhaust_pos : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < M_exhaust r
  k_ge_k₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ k_seq n
  k_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  moment_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  normal_level : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ l : ℝ, hBudget.k₀ ≤ l →
    rowMomentFull S l ≤
      rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp ((1 / 8 : ℝ) * |l - k_seq n|)
  cone_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
    Real.exp (-k_seq n) ≤ wallDepth S s →
    wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-hBudget.k₀) / 8 →
    |s.re - x_seq n| ≤ L_star * wallDepth S s →
    (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) * shapeModulus S s ≤
      C_cone * (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / wallDepth S s) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  compact_exhaust_bound : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, r ≤ n → ∀ Z ∈ lmCompactRect r,
    (x_seq n : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
    ‖lmRescaledF S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖lmRescaledQ S (k_seq n) (x_seq n) Z‖ ≤ M_exhaust r

inductive ExpProfileKind where
  | firstField
  | secondField

noncomputable def frozenActionP (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      ∑' m : ℕ, (-1 : ℂ) ^ m * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * m + 2) * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))
  | .secondField =>
      (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 2 : ℕ) : ℂ) * J ^ (2 * m + 3) * lam ^ (2 * m) /
        (8 * (4 : ℂ) ^ m * ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ))) /
        Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2)

noncomputable def frozenEnergyE (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J * deriv (frozenActionP kind lam) J - frozenActionP kind lam J

def IsRegularFrozenState (kind : ExpProfileKind) (lam J : ℂ) : Prop :=
  match kind with
  | .firstField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .firstField lam)) J ≠ 0
  | .secondField =>
      J ≠ 0 ∧ Complex.cosh (lam * J / 2) ≠ 0 ∧
        deriv (deriv (frozenActionP .secondField lam)) J ≠ 0

  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

    (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : ExpStripData where

  𝔰 := S.𝔰

structure IsExpObstructionStrip (X : ExpStripData) : Prop where
  c_pos : 0 < X.c
  s_star_pos : 0 < X.s_star
  r_star_pos : 0 < X.r_star
  r_star_lt_half_s_star : X.r_star < X.s_star / 2
  r_star_lt_pi : X.r_star < Real.pi
  D_strip_open : IsOpen X.D_strip
  D_strip_convex : Convex ℝ X.D_strip
  base_strip_subset : horizStrip X.s_star ⊆ X.D_strip
  D_strip_add_real : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, ∀ x : ℝ, s + (x : ℂ) ∈ X.D_strip
  D_strip_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ X.D_strip
  D_strip_vert_balanced : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, ∀ y : ℝ, |y| ≤ |s.im| →
    (s.re : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I ∈ X.D_strip
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.ϕ X.D_strip
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.f X.D_strip
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.q X.D_strip
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, deriv X.ϕ s = X.f s
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, deriv (deriv X.f) s = X.q s * X.f s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.q s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.f s)
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ X.D_strip, X.q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.q s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (X.f x).re ∧ (X.f x).im = 0
  f_lower_strip_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, X.f s ≠ 0
  Γ_base_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => X.Γ_base s 0) (horizStrip X.s_star) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun s => X.Γ_base s 1) (horizStrip X.s_star)
  Γ_base_deriv₀ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star,
    deriv (fun z => X.Γ_base z 0) s = -X.c * (X.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.sin (X.ϕ s)
  Γ_base_deriv₁ : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star,
    deriv (fun z => X.Γ_base z 1) s = X.c * (X.f s)⁻¹ ^ 2 * Complex.cos (X.ϕ s)
  Γ_base_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, X.Γ_base (s + 2 * Real.pi) = X.Γ_base s
  Γ_base_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip X.s_star, ∀ i : Fin 2,
    X.Γ_base (starRingEnd ℂ s) i = starRingEnd ℂ (X.Γ_base s i)
  Tube_open : IsOpen X.Tube
  Tube_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < X.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < X.r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.1 ∈ X.D_strip ∧ p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ X.Tube
  Tube_param_subset : X.Tube ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < X.r_star }
  Tube_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y + (x : ℂ), t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → (y, -t) ∈ X.Tube
  Tube_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ X.Tube
  𝔰_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ X.𝔰 X.Tube
  𝔰_maps_to : ∀ p ∈ X.Tube, X.𝔰 p ∈ X.D_strip
  𝔰_lower_strip_im : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < X.s_star / 2 → ‖t‖ < X.r_star →
    X.𝔰 (y, t) ∈ horizStrip X.s_star
  𝔰_zero : ∀ y ∈ X.D_strip, X.𝔰 (y, 0) = y
  𝔰_quasiperiodic : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    X.𝔰 (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t) + 2 * Real.pi
  𝔰_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube → X.𝔰 (y, -t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)
  𝔰_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ X.Tube →
    X.𝔰 (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (X.𝔰 (y, t))
  𝔰_mean_zero : ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < X.r_star →
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (X.𝔰 (x, t) - x)) = 0
  real_collar_reflection : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < X.r_star →
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (X.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (X.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x - t) t + X.θ_edge x t = 2 * (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge (x + 2 * Real.pi) t = X.θ_edge x t + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    X.θ_edge x t - (X.ϕ (X.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < X.ℓ_chord x t ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin (X.θ_edge x t) ∧
    X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - X.Γ_base (X.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      X.ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos (X.θ_edge x t)
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < X.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        (∀ p ∈ W, s_tilde p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ X.Tube

structure ExpSequenceData (X : ExpStripData) (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  x_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  h_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  ℓ_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  m_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  c₀ : ℂ
  c₀_ne_zero : c₀ ≠ 0
  ℓ_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ℓ_seq n
  m_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < m_seq n
  m_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto m_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  b_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  h_div_ℓ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
  exhausts_ℂ : ∀ R_exh : ℝ, 0 < R_exh → ∃ N_exh : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N_exh, ∀ Z : ℂ,
    ‖Z‖ ≤ R_exh →
      (x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z ∈ X.D_strip
  f_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      ((m_seq n)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.f ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun Z => c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Z)
     | .secondField => fun _ => 0)
    Filter.atTop
  q_conv : TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun n Z =>
      (((m_seq n) ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        X.q ((x_seq n : ℂ) + (h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I + (ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Z))
    (match kind with
     | .firstField => fun _ => 0
     | .secondField => fun Z => c₀ ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-2 * Complex.I * Z))
    Filter.atTop

structure ChordActionPackage (X : ExpStripData) where
  p_act : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ
  η_sf : ℝ
  C_sf : ℝ
  r_rec : ℝ
  η_sf_pos : 0 < η_sf
  C_sf_pos : 0 < C_sf
  r_rec_pos : 0 < r_rec
  r_rec_lt : r_rec < X.r_star
  p_act_zero : ∀ s J : ℂ, p_act s J 0 = J ^ 3 / 24
  small_field : ∀ (s₀ : ℂ) (r_s r_t M₀ : ℝ),
    0 < r_s → 0 < r_t → 4 * r_t ≤ r_s → 0 ≤ M₀ → r_t * M₀ ≤ η_sf →
    Metric.ball s₀ r_s ⊆ X.D_strip →
    (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball s₀ r_s, ‖X.f w‖ ≤ M₀ ∧ Real.sqrt ‖X.q w‖ ≤ M₀) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ => p_act q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ | ‖q.1 - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.1 - 1‖ < 1 / 4 ∧ ‖q.2.2‖ < r_t } ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 8 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 8 → ‖t‖ < r_t / 2 →
      p_act (s + t * J) J (-t) = p_act s J t) ∧
    (∀ s J t : ℂ, ‖s - s₀‖ < r_s / 4 → ‖J - 1‖ < 1 / 4 → ‖t‖ < r_t →
      ‖p_act s J t - J ^ 3 / 24‖ ≤ C_sf * ‖t‖ ^ 2 * M₀ ^ 2)
  base_recurrence : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < X.s_star / 3 → 0 < ‖t‖ → ‖t‖ < r_rec →
    let s_prev := X.𝔰 (y - t, t)
    let s_curr := X.𝔰 (y, t)
    let s_next := X.𝔰 (y + t, t)
    let J_prev := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
    let J_curr := (s_next - s_curr) / t
    deriv (fun J' => p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
      t * deriv (fun s' => p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
      deriv (fun J' => p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev
  frozen_conv : ∀ (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind)
      (S₀ J₀ T₀ : ℂ),
    IsRegularFrozenState kind (T₀ * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S₀)) J₀ →
    ∃ (δ_reg : ℝ) (N_reg : ℕ), 0 < δ_reg ∧
      (∀ n ≥ N_reg,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ
          (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
            p_act
              ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
                (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
              q.2.1
              (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
          { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
            ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ) =>
          p_act
            ((seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * q.1)
            q.2.1
            (q.2.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)))
        (fun q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ =>
          frozenActionP kind (q.2.2 * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * q.1)) q.2.1)
        Filter.atTop
        { q : ℂ × ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖q.1 - S₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.1 - J₀‖ < δ_reg ∧ ‖q.2.2 - T₀‖ < δ_reg }

def DeepInitializedModelData (X : ExpStripData) (P : ChordActionPackage X)
    (kind : ExpProfileKind) (seq : ExpSequenceData X kind) : Prop :=
  ∀ T_max : ℝ, 0 < T_max →
    ∃ (D₀ C_deep α : ℝ) (S_deep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < D₀ ∧ 0 < C_deep ∧ 1 / 2 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ S_deep { p : ℂ × ℂ | D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } ∧
      (∀ Y T : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → ‖T‖ < T_max →
        ‖S_deep (Y, T) - Y‖ ≤ C_deep * ‖T‖ ^ 2 * (-Y.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
        S_deep (Y, -T) = S_deep (Y, T) ∧
        frozenEnergyE kind
          (T * seq.c₀ * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_deep (Y, T)))
          (deriv (fun Y' => S_deep (Y', T)) Y) = 1 / 12) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → S_deep (Y, 0) = Y) ∧
      (∀ A D_top : ℝ, 0 < A → D₀ + 2 < D_top →
        ∃ (N_init : ℕ) (U_phys : ℕ → Set (ℂ × ℂ))
          (s_tilde : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (δ_base : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ n ≥ N_init,
            let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
            let coneSet : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
                |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max }
            IsOpen (U_phys n) ∧
            0 < δ_base n ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → 0 ≤ y.im →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ y.im →
                ((y.re : ℂ) + (τ : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → (y, -t) ∈ U_phys n) ∧
            DifferentiableOn ℂ (s_tilde n) (U_phys n) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ U_phys n, s_tilde n p ∈ X.D_strip) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ U_phys n → s_tilde n (y, -t) = s_tilde n (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < δ_base n → ‖t‖ < T_max / seq.m_seq n →
              (y, t) ∈ U_phys n ∧ (y, t) ∈ X.Tube ∧ s_tilde n (y, t) = X.𝔰 (y, t)) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ coneSet,
              (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) ∈ U_phys n ∧
              0 < (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1).im) ∧
            (∀ Y T : ℂ, T ≠ 0 →
              (Y, T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y - T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              (Y + T / ((seq.ℓ_seq n * seq.m_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ), T) ∈ coneSet →
              let t : ℂ := T / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)
              let y : ℂ := s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * Y
              let s_prev : ℂ := s_tilde n (y - t, t)
              let s_curr : ℂ := s_tilde n (y, t)
              let s_next : ℂ := s_tilde n (y + t, t)
              let J_prev : ℂ := (s_curr - s_prev) / t
              let J_curr : ℂ := (s_next - s_curr) / t
              deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_curr J' t) J_curr -
                t * deriv (fun s' => P.p_act s' J_curr t) s_curr =
                deriv (fun J' => P.p_act s_prev J' t) J_prev)) ∧
          (∀ K : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsCompact K →
            K ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ |
              D₀ < -p.1.im ∧ -p.1.im < D_top ∧
              |p.1.re| < A * (-p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < T_max } →
            ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₁ : ℕ, N_init ≤ N₁ ∧ ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ p ∈ K,
              let s_n : ℂ := (seq.x_seq n : ℂ) + (seq.h_seq n : ℂ) * Complex.I
              ‖(s_tilde n (s_n + (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) * p.1, p.2 / (seq.m_seq n : ℂ)) - s_n) /
                  (seq.ℓ_seq n : ℂ) - S_deep p‖ < ε))

def branchSectorPlus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w - θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchSectorMinus (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R * Real.exp (-4 * ν) < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp (2 * ν) ∧
    |Complex.arg w + θ| < 2 * δ_θ }

def branchInnerDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R ∪ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ ∪ branchSectorMinus R ν θ δ_θ

def branchOuterDomain (R ν θ δ_θ : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  { w : ℂ | 0 < w.re ∧ R < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < R * Real.exp ν ∧
    |Complex.arg w| < θ + δ_θ }

structure BranchMonodromyPackage (kind : ExpProfileKind) where
  R : ℝ
  ν : ℝ
  θ : ℝ
  δ_θ : ℝ
  r_uniq : ℝ
  Δ_inner : ℂ → ℂ
  Δ_outer : ℂ → ℂ
  R_pos : 0 < R
  ν_pos : 0 < ν
  ν_lt_one : ν < 1
  θ_pos : 0 < θ
  θ_lt : θ < Real.pi / 4
  δ_θ_pos : 0 < δ_θ
  δ_θ_lt : δ_θ < θ / 2
  r_uniq_pos : 0 < r_uniq
  r_uniq_lt : r_uniq < R
  Δ_inner_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_inner (branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_outer_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Δ_outer (branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ)
  Δ_inner_zero : Δ_inner 0 = 0
  Δ_inner_even_ball : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R, Δ_inner (-w) = Δ_inner w
  local_uniqueness : ∀ (w_coeff : ℂ) (D₁ : ℝ) (S_loc : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < D₁ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ S_loc { Y : ℂ | D₁ < -Y.im } →
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ D₂ : ℝ, D₁ < D₂ ∧ ∀ Y : ℂ, D₂ < -Y.im → ‖S_loc Y - Y‖ < ε) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im → ‖w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y)‖ < r_uniq) →
    (∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      frozenEnergyE kind
        (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * S_loc Y))
        (deriv S_loc Y) = 1 / 12) →
    ∀ Y : ℂ, D₁ < -Y.im →
      S_loc Y = Y + Δ_inner (w_coeff * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Y))
  inner_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchInnerDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_inner w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_inner w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  outer_regular_energy : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ,
    let lam := w * Complex.exp (-Complex.I * Δ_outer w)
    let J := 1 - Complex.I * w * deriv Δ_outer w
    frozenEnergyE kind lam J = 1 / 12 ∧ IsRegularFrozenState kind lam J
  overlap_plus_eq : ∀ w ∈ branchOuterDomain R ν θ δ_θ ∩ branchSectorPlus R ν θ δ_θ,
    Δ_outer w = Δ_inner w
  monodromy_minus_ne : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u → u < ν →
    let w_minus := (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((u : ℂ) - (θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
    Δ_outer w_minus ≠ Δ_inner w_minus

noncomputable def shiftWidthENNR (w : ENNReal) (δ : ℝ) : ENNReal :=
  if w = ⊤ then ⊤ else ENNReal.ofReal (w.toReal + δ)

def shiftedMeroTube (r_star : ℝ) (h_X : ℂ → ENNReal) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  meroTubeENNR r_star (fun t => shiftWidthENNR (h_X t) (b_shift t).im)

def shiftedLiftMap (𝔰_raw : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  𝔰_raw (p.1 - b_shift p.2, p.2)

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingTheta {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingTheta C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

noncomputable def shiftedGlancingOffset {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (b_shift : ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  glancingOffset C (p.1 - b_shift p.2) p.2

structure NonisotropicCurveData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  a : ℂ → ℂ
  ϕ : ℂ → ℂ
  f : ℂ → ℂ
  a_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ a (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  ϕ_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ ϕ (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  a_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a s ≠ 0
  deriv_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv ϕ s = f s
  exp_ϕ : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), Complex.exp (Complex.I * ϕ s) = a s
  deriv_a : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv a s = Complex.I * f s * a s
  base_ϕ_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, ϕ s = C.ϕ_ℂ s ∧ f s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  ϕ_quasiperiodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (s + 2 * Real.pi) = ϕ s + 2 * Real.pi
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  a_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), a (s + 2 * Real.pi) = a s
  ϕ_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), ϕ (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (ϕ s)
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_base_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip M.s_base, f s ≠ 0
  f_nonconstant : ∃ x : ℝ, deriv f x ≠ 0
  Γ : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ s 0) (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0)) ∧

  Γ_reg_holo : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), f s ≠ 0 →
