structure SpeedAndCollarPackage {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  q : ℂ → ℂ
  H0 : ℂ → ℂ
  V : ℂ → ℂ
  ℓ_chord : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    K.f s = 0 → deriv K.f s ≠ 0 ∧ deriv (deriv K.f) s = 0
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (deriv K.f) s = q s * K.f s
  q_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (s + 2 * Real.pi) = q s
  q_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), q (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (q s)
  H0_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ H0 (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  H0_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (s + 2 * Real.pi) = H0 s
  H0_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), H0 (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (H0 s)
  H0_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    H0 s = K.Γ s 0 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s)
  H0_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), K.f s ≠ 0 →
    deriv H0 s = (-K.Γ s 0 * Complex.sin (K.ϕ s) + K.Γ s 1 * Complex.cos (K.ϕ s)) * K.f s
  V_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ V (horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0))
  V_periodic : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (s + 2 * Real.pi) = V s
  V_conj : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), V (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (V s)
  V_mean_zero : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), V x) = 0
  𝔰_deriv_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0), deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t)) 0 = 0
  𝔰_deriv2_t_zero : ∀ y ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv (deriv (fun t : ℂ => L.𝔰 (y, t))) 0 = 2 * V y
  V_deriv : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    deriv V s = (1 / 120 : ℂ) *
      (K.f s ^ 2 + 8 * q s -
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (K.f x ^ 2 + 8 * q x))
  real_collar_chord : ∀ x t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < L.r_star →
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    (L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t)).im = 0 ∧
    0 < deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (L.𝔰 (x', t)).re) x ∧
    0 < (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)).re - (L.𝔰 (x, t)).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x - t / 2, t)).re + (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re = 2 * (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + 2 * Real.pi + t / 2, t)).re = (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re + 2 * Real.pi ∧
    0 < (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re ∧
    (L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re - (K.ϕ (L.𝔰 (x, t))).re < Real.pi / 2 ∧
    0 < ℓ_chord x t ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 0 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 =
      -ℓ_chord x t * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x + t, t)) 1 - K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 =
      ℓ_chord x t * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) ∧
    L.p_gl (x + t / 2, t) =
      K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 0 * Real.cos ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re) +
        K.Γ (L.𝔰 (x, t)) 1 * Real.sin ((L.Θ_gl (x + t / 2, t)).re)

structure EntireTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) where
  T_open : IsOpen L.T_norm
  T_base_subset :
    ({ p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < L.s_star ∧ ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star } ∪
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 = 0 }) ⊆ L.T_norm
  T_param_subset : L.T_norm ⊆ { p : ℂ × ℂ | ‖p.2‖ < L.r_star }
  T_vertically_star_shaped : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 1 →
    ((y.re : ℂ) + ((η * y.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_horiz_invariant : ∀ y t : ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y + x, t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_even : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (y, -t) ∈ L.T_norm
  T_conj : ∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ L.T_norm → (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) ∈ L.T_norm
  real_vertical_promotion : ∀ t₀ x₀ b : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < b →
    (∃ W : Set (ℂ × ℂ), IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → η ≤ b → ((x₀ : ℂ) + (η : ℝ) * Complex.I, (t₀ : ℂ)) ∈ W) ∧
      ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde W ∧
        ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ y t : ℂ, ‖y - x₀‖ < δ₀ → ‖t - t₀‖ < δ₀ →
          (y, t) ∈ W ∧ s_tilde (y, t) = L.𝔰 (y, t)) →
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| ≤ b ∧ ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ } ⊆ L.T_norm

structure FiniteWallTubeObstructionData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) (K : NonisotropicCurveData C M)
    (L : NormalizedGlobalLiftData C M K) (H : ℝ) where
  h_X : ℂ → ℝ
  tube_eq : finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X = L.T_norm
  H_pos : 0 < H
  s_star_lt_H : L.s_star < H
  h_X_bounds : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, L.s_star ≤ h_X t ∧ h_X t ≤ H
  h_X_zero : h_X 0 = H
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) L.r_star)
  tube_open : IsOpen (finiteWallTube L.r_star h_X)
  deficit_subharmonic : ∀ t₀ : ℂ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < L.r_star →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun θ : ℝ => H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
      (Set.Icc 0 (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    H - h_X t₀ ≤ (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
      ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (H - h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)))
  no_patch_at_real_wall : ∀ t₀ x₀ ε : ℝ, |t₀| < L.r_star → 0 < ε → ε < L.s_star →
    ¬ ∃ g : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε } ∧
      (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
        ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (h_X t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε →
        ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε → g p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 →
          |p.1.im - (h_X t₀ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 →
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ → g p = L.𝔰 p
  no_full_scale_cone_passage : ∀ δ_star : ℝ, 0 < δ_star → δ_star < H - L.s_star →
    ∃ d₀ : ℝ, 0 < d₀ ∧ ∀ d x₀ : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d₀ →
      ¬ ∃ s_tilde : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ s_tilde
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im ∧ H - p.1.im < δ_star ∧
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) ∧ ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d } ∧
        (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
          d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
          |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
          s_tilde p ∈ horizStrip H) ∧
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
            d / 10 < H - p.1.im → H - p.1.im < δ_star →
            δ_star / 2 < H - p.1.im →
            |p.1.re - x₀| < 50 * (H - p.1.im) → ‖p.2‖ < η → ‖p.2‖ < 2 * d →
            s_tilde p = L.𝔰 p

def smallChordDomain (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (η_SL : ℝ) : Set (ℂ × ℂ) :=
  { q : ℂ × ℂ |
    q.1 ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧ q.1 + q.2 ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
    ‖q.2 * S.f q.1‖ < η_SL ∧
    ‖q.2 ^ 2 * deriv S.f q.1‖ < η_SL ∧
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖q.2 ^ 2 * S.q (q.1 + (w : ℂ) * q.2)‖ < η_SL }

noncomputable def frozenPhiFirst (Λ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if Λ = 0 then (1 / 24 : ℂ)
  else (Λ / 2 - Complex.sin (Λ / 2)) / (4 * (Λ / 2) ^ 3)

noncomputable def frozenPhiSecond (μ : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∑' m : ℕ, ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * μ ^ m / ((2 * m + 3).factorial : ℂ)) /
    (2 * (1 + ∑' m : ℕ, μ ^ m / ((2 * m).factorial : ℂ)))

noncomputable def smallChordActionP (Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (s J t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  J ^ 3 * Phi (s, t * J)

structure SmallFieldChordActionData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  η_SL : ℝ
  C_SL : ℝ
  Phi : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  η_SL_pos : 0 < η_SL
  η_SL_lt : η_SL < 1 / 4
  C_SL_pos : 0 < C_SL
  domain_open : IsOpen (smallChordDomain S η_SL)
  Phi_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ Phi (smallChordDomain S η_SL)
  Phi_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip S.H, Phi (s, 0) = 1 / 24
  Phi_rev : ∀ s h : ℂ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    (s + h, -h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    Phi (s + h, -h) = Phi (s, h)
  Phi_bound : ∀ s h : ℂ, ∀ M_q : ℝ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    0 ≤ M_q →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)‖ ≤ M_q) →
    ‖Phi (s, h) - 1 / 24‖ ≤
      C_SL * (M_q + ‖h * S.f s‖ ^ 2 + ‖h ^ 2 * deriv S.f s‖ ^ 2)
  Phi_approx_first : ∀ s h : ℂ, ∀ M_q : ℝ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    0 ≤ M_q →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h)‖ ≤ M_q) →
    ‖Phi (s, h) - frozenPhiFirst (h * S.f s)‖ ≤
      C_SL * (M_q + ‖h ^ 2 * deriv S.f s‖)
  Phi_approx_second : ∀ s h μ : ℂ, ∀ M_diff : ℝ,
    (s, h) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL →
    ‖μ‖ < η_SL →
    0 ≤ M_diff →
    (∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖h ^ 2 * S.q (s + (w : ℂ) * h) - μ‖ ≤ M_diff) →
    ‖Phi (s, h) - frozenPhiSecond μ‖ ≤
      C_SL * (M_diff + ‖h * S.f s‖ + ‖h ^ 2 * deriv S.f s‖)
  exact_recurrence : ∀ H₁ : ℝ, 0 < H₁ → H₁ < S.H →
    ∃ r_sub : ℝ, 0 < r_sub ∧ r_sub < S.r_star ∧
      ∀ y t : ℂ, y ∈ horizStrip H₁ → ‖t‖ < r_sub →
        (y, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y + t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (y - t, t) ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X ∧
        (t ≠ 0 →
          let s_m := S.𝔰 (y - t, t)
          let s_0 := S.𝔰 (y, t)
          let s_p := S.𝔰 (y + t, t)
          let J_m := (s_0 - s_m) / t
          let J_p := (s_p - s_0) / t
          (s_m, s_0 - s_m) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL ∧
          (s_0, s_p - s_0) ∈ smallChordDomain S η_SL ∧
          ‖J_m - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          ‖J_p - 1‖ < 1 / 16 ∧
          deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP Phi s_0 J' t) J_p -
            t * deriv (fun s' => smallChordActionP Phi s' J_p t) s_0 =
            deriv (fun J' => smallChordActionP Phi s_m J' t) J_m)

def SteepSectorPassageProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop :=
  ∀ α m_steep γ_steep δ_ceil δ_b : ℝ,
    1 / 2 < α → α < 1 → 0 < m_steep → 0 < γ_steep → γ_steep < 1 / 4 →
    0 < δ_ceil → δ_ceil < δ_b → δ_b < S.H / 2 →
    ∃ L : ℝ, m_steep ≤ L ∧
      ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → ∃ C_st ε_st d_st : ℝ, 0 < C_st ∧ 0 < ε_st ∧ 0 < d_st ∧
        ∀ d x₀ r ε : ℝ, 0 < d → d < d_st → 0 < r → r ≤ K * d → 0 < ε → ε ≤ ε_st →
          (∀ s : ℂ, d / 10 ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ δ_b →
            |s.re - x₀| ≤ L * wallDepth S s →
            r * shapeModulus S s ≤ ε * (d / wallDepth S s) ^ α) →
          ∃ s_steep : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
            DifferentiableOn ℂ s_steep
              { p : ℂ × ℂ |
                d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im ∧ S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil ∧
                |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) ∧
                ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α ∧
                γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| } ∧
            (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ,
              d / 2 < S.H - p.1.im → S.H - p.1.im < δ_ceil →
              |p.1.re - x₀| < m_steep * (S.H - p.1.im) →
              ‖p.2‖ < 10 * r * ((S.H - p.1.im) / d) ^ α →
              γ_steep * ‖p.2‖ < |p.2.im| →
              s_steep p ∈ horizStrip S.H ∧
              s_steep (p.1, -p.2) = s_steep p ∧
              ‖s_steep p - p.1‖ ≤
                C_st * (1 + (ε / r) * d ^ α) ^ 2 * ‖p.2‖ ^ 2 * (S.H - p.1.im) ^ (1 - 2 * α) ∧
              (p ∈ finiteWallTube S.r_star S.h_X → s_steep p = S.𝔰 p))

def UniversalDiskLogDeficitProp : Prop :=
  ∃ C_def : ℝ, 0 < C_def ∧
    ∀ (U : Set ℂ) (f q : ℂ → ℂ),
      IsOpen U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ q U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) z = q z * f z) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0 → deriv f z ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (z₀ : ℂ) (Δ K : ℝ), 0 < Δ →
        Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ ⊆ U →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ Δ, ‖f z‖ ≤ Real.exp K) →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun w : ℂ => K - Real.log ‖f w‖) (Metric.ball z₀ Δ) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ (Δ / 4),
          Δ * Real.sqrt ‖q z‖ ≤
            C_def * (1 + (Real.pi * Δ ^ 2)⁻¹ *
              ∫ w in Metric.ball z₀ Δ, (K - Real.log ‖f w‖))

structure PeriodicShapeField (U : Set ℂ) (s_star : ℝ) (f q : ℂ → ℂ) : Prop where
  isOpen_U : IsOpen U
  s_star_pos : 0 < s_star
  lower_strip_subset : horizStrip s_star ⊆ U
  slab_mem : ∀ w ∈ U, ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ |w.im| → z ∈ U
  f_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U
  q_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ q U
  deriv2_f : ∀ s ∈ U, deriv (deriv f) s = q s * f s
  f_periodic : ∀ s ∈ U, f (s + 2 * Real.pi) = f s
  f_conj : ∀ s ∈ U, f (starRingEnd ℂ s) = starRingEnd ℂ (f s)
  f_real_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < (f x).re ∧ (f x).im = 0
  f_lower_ne_zero : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip s_star, f s ≠ 0
  f_simple_zeros : ∀ s ∈ U, f s = 0 → deriv f s ≠ 0

noncomputable def rowLogSup (f : ℂ → ℂ) (y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (sSup ((fun x : ℝ => ‖f ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ''
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)))

def EntireScalePackage (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (C_ℓ C_h C_f : ℝ),
    0 < C_ℓ ∧ 0 < C_h ∧ 0 < C_f ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < h_seq n ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ ℓ_seq n ≤ C_ℓ ∧ 0 < m_seq n ∧
      m_seq n = Real.exp (ρ (h_seq n)) ∧ h_seq n ≤ C_h * ρ (h_seq n) ∧ 1 ≤ ρ (h_seq n)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ρ (h_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (1 + h_seq n / ℓ_seq n) / Real.log (m_seq n))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |Real.log (ℓ_seq n)| / ρ (h_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ M_u η : ℝ, 0 < M_u → 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ u : ℝ, |u| ≤ M_u →
      ρ (h_seq n + ℓ_seq n * u) ≤ ρ (h_seq n) + u + η) ∧
    (∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ y : ℝ, ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - y → h_seq n - y ≤ h_seq n →
      Real.exp (ρ y) ≤ C_f * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - y)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))

def FiniteWallScalePackage (H : ℝ) (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (δ_b C_f : ℝ) (h_seq ℓ_seq m_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
    0 < δ_b ∧ δ_b < H / 2 ∧ 0 < C_f ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < h_seq n ∧ h_seq n < H ∧ 0 < ℓ_seq n ∧ 0 < m_seq n ∧
      m_seq n = Real.exp (ρ (h_seq n)) ∧ 1 ≤ ρ (h_seq n)) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto h_seq Filter.atTop (nhds H) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto ℓ_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ρ (h_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ℓ_seq n * m_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (H - h_seq n) / ℓ_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => |Real.log (ℓ_seq n)| / ρ (h_seq n)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ M_u η : ℝ, 0 < M_u → 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀, ∀ u : ℝ, |u| ≤ M_u →
      |h_seq n + ℓ_seq n * u| < H ∧ ρ (h_seq n + ℓ_seq n * u) ≤ ρ (h_seq n) + u + η) ∧
    (∃ N₁ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₁, ∀ y : ℝ, ℓ_seq n ≤ h_seq n - y → h_seq n - y ≤ δ_b →
      0 < y ∧ y < H ∧
      Real.exp (ρ y) ≤ C_f * m_seq n * (ℓ_seq n / (h_seq n - y)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ))

def superlinearLowerHalfPlane : Set ℂ :=
  { Z : ℂ | Z.im < 0 }


noncomputable def superlinearRescaledF (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (x d m : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((m⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.f ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)


noncomputable def superlinearRescaledQ (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (x d m : ℝ) (Z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (((m ^ 2)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I + (d : ℂ) * Z)


structure SuperlinearRecordScales (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) where
  α₁ : ℝ
  α₂ : ℝ
  P : ℝ
  k₀ : ℝ
  one_lt_α₁ : 1 < α₁
  α₁_lt_α₂ : α₁ < α₂
  α₂_lt_P : α₂ < P
  one_le_k₀ : 1 ≤ k₀
  exp_neg_k₀_le_half_H : Real.exp (-k₀) ≤ S.H / 2
  k_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  d_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  m_seq : ℕ → ℝ
  x_max : ℕ → ℝ
  k_seq_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, k₀ + (n : ℝ) ≤ k_seq n
  d_seq_eq : ∀ n : ℕ, d_seq n = Real.exp (-k_seq n)
  m_seq_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ m_seq n
  m_seq_lower : ∀ n : ℕ, Real.exp (α₂ * k_seq n) ≤ m_seq n
  m_seq_upper : ∀ n : ℕ, m_seq n ≤ Real.exp (P * k_seq n)
  x_max_mem : ∀ n : ℕ, x_max n ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)
  x_max_attains : ∀ n : ℕ,
    shapeModulus S ((x_max n : ℂ) + ((S.H - d_seq n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = m_seq n
  coarse_tail_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
    d_seq n ≤ wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ Real.exp (-k₀) →
    shapeModulus S s ≤ m_seq n * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ α₁
  fine_cap_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : ℂ,
    0 < wallDepth S s → wallDepth S s ≤ d_seq n →
    shapeModulus S s ≤ m_seq n * (d_seq n / wallDepth S s) ^ P


def SuperlinearPureExtractionProp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (R : SuperlinearRecordScales S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono φ → ∀ (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ),
    ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (F Q : ℂ → ℂ),
      StrictMono ψ ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Q superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun k Z => superlinearRescaledF S (x_seq (ψ k))
          (R.d_seq (φ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ (ψ k))) Z)
        F Filter.atTop superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun k Z => superlinearRescaledQ S (x_seq (ψ k))
          (R.d_seq (φ (ψ k))) (R.m_seq (φ (ψ k))) Z)
        Q Filter.atTop superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      ((∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, F Z = 0) ∨
        (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, Q Z = 0)) ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im →
        max ‖F Z‖ (Real.sqrt ‖Q Z‖) ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-R.α₁))


structure SuperlinearLimitingLiftData (α₁ : ℝ) where
  D₁ : ℝ
  C₁ : ℝ
  D₀ : ℝ
  D₁_pos : 0 < D₁
  C₁_pos : 0 < C₁
  D₀_pos : 0 < D₀
  S_inf : ℂ → ℂ
  S_inf_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ S_inf superlinearLowerHalfPlane
  S_inf_maps_to : ∀ Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, S_inf Y ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane
  S_inf_anchor : ∀ x D : ℝ, D₁ ≤ D →
    ‖S_inf ((x : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I) - ((x : ℂ) - (D : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      C₁ * D ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
  pure_energy_branch :
    (∃ F : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      ‖F (-Complex.I)‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im → ‖F Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-α₁)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < -Y.im →
        (deriv S_inf Y) ^ 3 *
          frozenFirstFieldG (F (S_inf Y) * deriv S_inf Y / 2) = 1)) ∨
    (∃ Q : ℂ → ℂ,
      DifferentiableOn ℂ Q superlinearLowerHalfPlane ∧
      Real.sqrt ‖Q (-Complex.I)‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ Z ∈ superlinearLowerHalfPlane, 1 ≤ -Z.im → Real.sqrt ‖Q Z‖ ≤ (-Z.im) ^ (-α₁)) ∧
      (∀ Y : ℂ, D₀ < -Y.im → |Y.re| < -Y.im →
        (deriv S_inf Y) ^ 3 *
          frozenSecondFieldG ((1 / 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 * Q (S_inf Y) * (deriv S_inf Y) ^ 2) = 1))

noncomputable def stripSymDepth (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  S.H - |z.im|

noncomputable def localAmp (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (‖S.f z‖ + stripSymDepth S z * ‖deriv S.f z‖)

noncomputable def truncLogSpeed (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (max ‖S.f z‖ ε)

noncomputable def tileCurvBound (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) (x d : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 + sSup ((fun z : ℂ => stripSymDepth S z * Real.sqrt ‖S.q z‖) ''
    Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 2))

noncomputable def stripExitKernel (H_p y₀ u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2 * H_p)⁻¹ *
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) * Real.cos (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p))) /
    (Real.cosh (Real.pi * u / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2 - Real.sin (Real.pi * y₀ / (2 * H_p)) ^ 2)

noncomputable def rowOccupDensity (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (ε h₀ x v : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  if |truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)| ≤ h₀ then
    ∫ s in (2 : ℝ)..(4 : ℝ),
      ∫ u : ℝ,
        min ((truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S (v + s) (x + u)) -
          truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x)) ^ 2) (h₀ ^ 2) *
        stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-(v + s))) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u
  else 0

def DiscreteTanakaProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : ℕ) (h R : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (κ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
    0 < h → h < R →
    (∀ m ≤ M, Continuous (g m)) →
    (∀ m ≤ M, Function.Periodic (g m) (2 * Real.pi)) →
    (∀ m < M, Continuous (κ m)) →
    (∀ m < M, ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ m u) →
    (∀ m < M, MeasureTheory.Integrable (κ m) MeasureTheory.volume) →
    (∀ m < M, (∫ u : ℝ, κ m u) = 1) →
    (∀ m < M, ∀ x : ℝ, g m x ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, g (m + 1) (x + u) * κ m u) →
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (if |g m x| ≤ h then
          ∫ u : ℝ, min ((g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2) (h ^ 2) * κ m u
        else 0)) ≤
      25 * h * (h + 2 * R + 2 * Real.sqrt
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u))) +
      (M : ℝ) * h ^ 2 *
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M,
          (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (∫ u : ℝ, (g (m + 1) (x + u) - g m x) ^ 2 * κ m u)) /
        (R - h) ^ 2

structure StripExitKernelData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip) : Prop where
  kernel_cont : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    Continuous (stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d))
  kernel_pos : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u
  kernel_integrable : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d)) MeasureTheory.volume
  kernel_integral_one : ∀ d d' : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H →
    (∫ u : ℝ, stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u) = 1
  kernel_tail_le : ∀ d d' R : ℝ, 0 < d' → d' < d → d < S.H → 0 < R →
    (∫ u in {u : ℝ | R * d < |u|}, stripExitKernel (S.H - d') (S.H - d) u) ≤ 1 / R
  kernel_core_ge : ∀ d s u : ℝ, 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    s ∈ Set.Icc (2 : ℝ) (4 : ℝ) → |u| ≤ 2 * d →
    (120 * d)⁻¹ ≤ stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-s) * d) (S.H - d) u
  trunc_submean : ∀ ε v v' x : ℝ, 0 < ε → v < v' → Real.exp (-v) < S.H →
    truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v x) ≤
      ∫ u : ℝ, truncLogSpeed S ε (upperRowPt S v' (x + u)) *
        stripExitKernel (S.H - Real.exp (-v')) (S.H - Real.exp (-v)) u

structure AmplitudeDeficitData (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S) where
  C_amp : ℝ
  C_glob : ℝ
  K_amp : ℝ
  one_le_C_amp : 1 ≤ C_amp
  one_le_C_glob : 1 ≤ C_glob
  K_amp_ge : max hBudget.k₀ 200 ≤ K_amp
  tile_amp_osc : ∀ x d : ℝ, 0 < d → d < S.H / 4 →
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (3 * d / 8),
      |localAmp S z - localAmp S ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)| ≤
        C_amp * tileCurvBound S x d
  disk_raw_and_trunc_l2 : ∀ x d r ε : ℝ,
    0 < d → d < S.H / 4 → d / 16 ≤ r → r ≤ d / 8 → 0 < ε →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) (d / 2),
      Real.log ε ≤ localAmp S z) →
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun ζ : ℂ => (localAmp S ζ - Real.log ‖S.f ζ‖) ^ 2)
      (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun ζ : ℂ => (localAmp S ζ - truncLogSpeed S ε ζ) ^ 2)
      (Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
    (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ *
      (∫ ζ in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r,
        (localAmp S ζ - Real.log ‖S.f ζ‖) ^ 2) ≤
      C_amp * (tileCurvBound S x d) ^ 2 ∧
    (Real.pi * r ^ 2)⁻¹ *
      (∫ ζ in Metric.ball ((x : ℂ) + ((S.H - d : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) r,
        (localAmp S ζ - truncLogSpeed S ε ζ) ^ 2) ≤
      C_amp * (tileCurvBound S x d) ^ 2
  global_amp_poly_bound : ∀ K : ℝ, K_amp ≤ K →
    ∀ z : ℂ, |z.im| ≤ S.H - Real.exp (-(41 / 20 : ℝ) * K) →
      |localAmp S z| ≤ C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ)
  small_moment_row_l2 : ∀ K : ℝ, K_amp ≤ K →
    (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
      rowMomentFull S v ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) →
    ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc K (2 * K),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (tileCurvBound S x (Real.exp (-w))) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ => (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w x) -
          truncLogSpeed S (Real.exp (-C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K))
            (upperRowPt S w x)) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi)) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (tileCurvBound S x (Real.exp (-w))) ^ 2) ≤
        C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ) ∧
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (localAmp S (upperRowPt S w x) -
            truncLogSpeed S (Real.exp (-C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K))
              (upperRowPt S w x)) ^ 2) ≤
        C_amp * K ^ (1 / 50 : ℝ)

noncomputable def AmplitudeDeficitData.epsK {S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip}
    {hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S} (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget) (K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-A.C_glob * K ^ (3 : ℕ) - 10 * K)

def SmallMomentOccupationBound (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    {hBudget : CriticalAngleBudgetData S} (A : AmplitudeDeficitData S hBudget) : Prop :=
  ∃ C_occ K_occ : ℝ, 0 < C_occ ∧ A.K_amp ≤ K_occ ∧
    ∀ K : ℝ, K_occ ≤ K →
      (∀ v ∈ Set.Icc ((9 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((21 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
        rowMomentFull S v ≤ K ^ (1 / 100 : ℝ)) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K))
        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
      (∫ p in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) ×ˢ
          Set.Icc ((11 / 10 : ℝ) * K) ((19 / 10 : ℝ) * K),
        rowOccupDensity S (A.epsK K) (K ^ (3 / 50 : ℝ)) p.1 p.2) ≤
        C_occ * K ^ (47 / 50 : ℝ)

def IsProhibitedCriticalTuple (S : FiniteWallNonisotropicStrip)
    (k_seq k_anc_seq ε_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n : ℕ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ k_anc_seq n ∧
    k_anc_seq n ≤ k_seq n ∧
    0 < ε_seq n ∧
    1 ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto ε_seq Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j →
    rowMomentFull S j ≤ rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (ε_seq n * |j - k_seq n|)) ∧
  Filter.Tendsto k_anc_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => k_seq n - k_anc_seq n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
  (∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq n) ∧
    Function.Periodic (w_seq n) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    (∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ w_seq n y) ∧
    (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), w_seq n y) = 1) ∧
  (∀ β A : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 → 1 ≤ A →
    ∃ C_βA : ℝ, 0 < C_βA ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      ∀ j : ℝ, criticalDepthThreshold S ≤ j → j ≤ k_anc_seq n + 3 →
        Real.sqrt ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (tileSupModulus S A j x) ^ 2 *
            ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x) ≤
          C_βA * rowMomentFull S (k_seq n) * Real.exp (β * (k_seq n - j))) ∧
  (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → β < 1 / 2 →
    ∃ C_β : ℝ, 0 < C_β ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N₀,
      (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        |(S.V ((y : ℂ) + ((S.H - Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| *
          w_seq n y) ≤
        C_β * (rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp (2 * β * (k_seq n - k_anc_seq n)) / Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) ∧
  (∀ K : Set ℂ, IsCompact K → K.Nonempty → K ⊆ criticalLowerHalfPlane →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        min 1 (sSup ((fun Z : ℂ =>
          (Real.exp (-k_seq n) / rowMomentFull S (k_seq n)) ^ 2 *
            ‖S.q ((x : ℂ) + (S.H : ℂ) * Complex.I +
              (Real.exp (-k_seq n) : ℂ) * Z)‖) '' K)) *
          ancestorPoissonDensity (Real.exp (-k_anc_seq n)) (w_seq n) x)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

structure MomentLawSteepBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq P_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (C_tail : ℝ),
      0 < C_tail ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j ∧ 1 ≤ P_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Filter.Tendsto P_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 - u / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))
        Real.exp Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v →
        m (Real.exp (x_seq j) * (1 + v / P_seq j)) / m (Real.exp (x_seq j)) ≤
          C_tail * (1 + v) ^ (-(5 / 8 : ℝ)))

structure MomentLawBoundedBranch (m : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  exists_data :
    ∃ (x_seq : ℕ → ℝ) (ρ_star : ℝ → ℝ) (lam C_env P' : ℝ),
      1 ≤ lam ∧
      0 < C_env ∧
      1 ≤ P' ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ x_seq j) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto x_seq Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Continuous ρ_star ∧
      ρ_star 0 = 0 ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atTop (nhds lam) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun u => ρ_star u / u) Filter.atBot (nhds lam) ∧
      TendstoLocallyUniformly
        (fun j u =>
          (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j + u)))) -
            (-Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j)))))
        ρ_star Filter.atTop ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, x_seq j ≤ v →
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) + (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (v - x_seq j) - C_env ≤
          -Real.log (m (Real.exp v))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, ∀ v : ℝ, v ≤ x_seq j →
        -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) - P' * (x_seq j - v) - C_env ≤
          -Real.log (m (Real.exp v))) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, -Real.log (m (Real.exp (x_seq j))) ≤ C_env * (1 + x_seq j))

structure LocalPositiveCenterGerm (n : ℕ) where
  c : ℝ
  δ₀ : ℝ
  c_pos : 0 < c
  δ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀
  Z_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  W_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  a_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  f_loc : ℂ → ℂ
  u_a : ℂ → ℂ
  N_Z : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  N_W : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  D_ZW : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ
  Z_mero : MeromorphicAt Z_loc 0
  W_mero : MeromorphicAt W_loc 0
  u_a_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_a 0
  u_a_ne_zero : u_a 0 ≠ 0
  a_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → a_loc z = z ^ n * u_a z
  reg_on_punctured : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ →
    AnalyticAt ℂ Z_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ W_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_loc z ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_loc z ∧
    a_loc z ≠ 0 ∧
    f_loc z ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv Z_loc z = Complex.I * (c : ℂ) * a_loc z / (f_loc z) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv W_loc z = -Complex.I * (c : ℂ) / (a_loc z * (f_loc z) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_loc z = Complex.I * f_loc z * a_loc z
  N_Z_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_Z (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  N_W_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ N_W (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  D_ZW_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ D_ZW (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) δ₀)
  D_ZW_slice_ne_zero : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → D_ZW (z, 0) ≠ 0
  slice_Z_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → N_Z (z, 0) = Z_loc z * D_ZW (z, 0)
  slice_W_eq : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₀ → N_W (z, 0) = W_loc z * D_ZW (z, 0)
  even_Z : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
    N_Z (z, -t) * D_ZW (z, t) = N_Z (z, t) * D_ZW (z, -t)
  even_W : ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z‖ < δ₀ → ‖t‖ < δ₀ →
    N_W (z, -t) * D_ZW (z, t) = N_W (z, t) * D_ZW (z, -t)
  rank_one_punc : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < δ₀ →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
      D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧
      deriv (fun z' => N_Z (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z *
        deriv (fun t' => N_W (z, t') / D_ZW (z, t')) t =
      deriv (fun t' => N_Z (z, t') / D_ZW (z, t')) t *
        deriv (fun z' => N_W (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z
  iso_reflect_punc : ∀ z₀ : ℂ, 0 < ‖z₀‖ → ‖z₀‖ < δ₀ →
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ z t : ℂ, ‖z - z₀‖ < r → ‖t‖ < r →
      D_ZW (z, t) ≠ 0 ∧ D_ZW (z - t, t) ≠ 0 ∧ D_ZW (z + t, t) ≠ 0 ∧
      (N_Z (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t) - N_Z (z - t, t) / D_ZW (z - t, t)) *
        (N_Z (z + t, t) / D_ZW (z + t, t) - N_Z (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t)) *
        (deriv (fun z' => N_W (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z) ^ 2 =
      (N_W (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t) - N_W (z - t, t) / D_ZW (z - t, t)) *
        (N_W (z + t, t) / D_ZW (z + t, t) - N_W (z, t) / D_ZW (z, t)) *
        (deriv (fun z' => N_Z (z', t) / D_ZW (z', t)) z) ^ 2

structure RationalProfileData {n : ℕ} (G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n) where
  ne_three : n ≠ 3
  Z₀ : ℂ
  W₀ : ℂ
  u_Z : ℂ → ℂ
  u_W : ℂ → ℂ
  δ₁ : ℝ
  δ₁_pos : 0 < δ₁
  δ₁_le : δ₁ ≤ G.δ₀
  u_Z_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_Z 0
  u_W_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ u_W 0
  u_Z_ne_zero : u_Z 0 ≠ 0
  u_W_ne_zero : u_W 0 ≠ 0
  Z_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ → G.Z_loc z - Z₀ = z ^ (n + 3) * u_Z z
  W_expansion : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < δ₁ →
    G.W_loc z - W₀ = z ^ ((3 : ℤ) - (n : ℤ)) * u_W z
  R₀ : ℝ
  R₀_pos : 0 < R₀
  U_germ : ℂ → ℂ
  U_germ_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ U_germ 0
  U_germ_zero : U_germ 0 = 1
  ξ : ℂ → ℂ
  ξ_def : ∀ w : ℂ, R₀ < ‖w‖ → ξ w = w * U_germ w⁻¹ ∧ ξ w ≠ 0
  poly_power_rational : ∀ (Q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ) (b : ℤ) (u_Q : ℂ → ℂ),
    AnalyticAt ℂ u_Q 0 → u_Q 0 ≠ 0 →
    (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin (0 : ℂ) {(0 : ℂ)}ᶜ,
      MvPolynomial.eval ![G.Z_loc z, G.W_loc z] Q = z ^ b * u_Q z) →
    ∃ (P_rat Q_rat : Polynomial ℂ) (R_Q : ℝ),
      Q_rat ≠ 0 ∧ R₀ < R_Q ∧
      ∀ w : ℂ, R_Q < ‖w‖ → Q_rat.eval w ≠ 0 ∧ (ξ w) ^ b * Q_rat.eval w = P_rat.eval w
  profile_reflection_eq : ∀ w : ℂ, R₀ + 1 < ‖w‖ →
    ((3 - (n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) *
      ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3) - (ξ w) ^ ((n : ℤ) + 3)) =
    (((n : ℤ) + 3 : ℤ) : ℂ) ^ 2 *
      (ξ w) ^ (2 * (((n : ℤ) + 3) - (3 - (n : ℤ)))) *
      ((ξ (w + 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ))) *
      ((ξ (w - 1)) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)) - (ξ w) ^ (3 - (n : ℤ)))

structure CollarIsotropicBridge {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (M : MeromorphicCollarData C) where
  real_base : ∀ x : ℝ,
    (x : ℂ) ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) ∧
    (x : ℂ) ∉ M.E_disc ∧
    M.a_mero x = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ x)
  a_periodic_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    s + 2 * Real.pi ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (s + 2 * Real.pi) = M.a_mero s
  a_conj_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    s ∉ M.E_disc →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0) →
    starRingEnd ℂ s ∉ M.E_disc →
    M.a_mero (starRingEnd ℂ s) * starRingEnd ℂ (M.a_mero s) = 1
  order_ne_top : ∀ q ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    meromorphicOrderAt M.a_mero q ≠ ⊤
  positive_germ_of_center : ∀ p ∈ horizStripENNR (M.h_X 0),
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
      n ≠ 0 → AnalyticAt ℂ u p → u p ≠ 0 →
      (∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin p {p}ᶜ, M.a_mero z = (z - p) ^ n * u z) →
      ∃ G : LocalPositiveCenterGerm n.natAbs,
        ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ G.δ₀ →
          (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ < ε →
            G.Z_loc (-z) = G.Z_loc z ∧ G.W_loc (-z) = G.W_loc z ∧ G.a_loc (-z) = -G.a_loc z) →
          M.h_X 0 = ⊤ ∧
          ∀ s : ℂ, s ∉ M.E_disc → 2 * p - s ∉ M.E_disc → M.a_mero (2 * p - s) = -M.a_mero s

noncomputable def r_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  B.h_ℂ w + deriv (deriv B.h_ℂ) w

noncomputable def normAction1_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) + B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X))

noncomputable def normAction2_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (B.c : ℂ)) *
    (supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ X) (B.ϕ_ℂ Y) - B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ Y))

noncomputable def normAction12_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X Y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ X * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ Y / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ X + B.ϕ_ℂ Y) / 2) *
    Complex.sin ((B.ϕ_ℂ Y - B.ϕ_ℂ X) / 2)

noncomputable def normActionRem_ℂ {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) (X b : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 6 : ℂ) * ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    ((1 - τ : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 3 *
      iteratedDeriv 4 (fun b' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X (X + b')) ((τ : ℂ) * b)

noncomputable def sinc_ℂ (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), Complex.cos ((τ : ℂ) * z)

noncomputable def fourierDiffMult (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * sinc_ℂ ((n : ℂ) * t / 2)

noncomputable def fourierCoeff_ℂ (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (n : ℤ) (t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * F ((x : ℂ), t)

noncomputable def glancingDiffOp (v : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => v (y', p.2)) (p.1 + (μ : ℂ) * p.2)

noncomputable def glancingAvgPlus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingAvgMinus (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ), deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - (lam : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingSecondAvg (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ lam in (0 : ℝ)..(1 : ℝ),
    (∫ μ in (-lam)..lam, deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t))) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t))

noncomputable def glancingResidualOp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let Up := deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) y
  let A_p := glancingAvgPlus U y t
  let A_m := glancingAvgMinus U y t
  let C_pm := glancingSecondAvg U y t
  (1 / 8 : ℂ) * Up * (A_p + A_m) * C_pm +
    t * Up *
      (A_p ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (t * A_p) -
        A_m ^ 4 * normActionRem_ℂ B (U (y, t)) (-t * A_m))

noncomputable def glancingPhaseSlope {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (y t : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∫ μ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 : ℝ),
    deriv B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + (μ : ℂ) * t, t)) *
      deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + (μ : ℂ) * t)

noncomputable def glancingLinCoeff {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) : ℂ :=
  let y := p.1
  let t := p.2
  let U_m := U (y - t / 2, t)
  let U_p := U (y + t / 2, t)
  let W := glancingPhaseSlope B U y t
  (deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_m * deriv B.ϕ_ℂ U_p / (2 * (B.c : ℂ))) *
    r_ℂ B ((B.ϕ_ℂ U_m + B.ϕ_ℂ U_p) / 2) *
    W * sinc_ℂ (t * W) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y - t / 2) *
    deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t)) (y + t / 2)

structure GlancingScalePackage {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω) where
  s_act : ℝ
  d_act : ℝ
  η_adm : ℝ
  M_act : ℝ
  M_E : ℝ
  C_quad : ℝ
  s_act_pos : 0 < s_act
  s_act_le_half_s₀ : s_act ≤ B.s₀ / 2
  s_act_le_one : s_act ≤ 1
  d_act_pos : 0 < d_act
  d_act_lt_half_s_act : d_act < s_act / 2
  d_act_lt_one : d_act < 1
  d_act_lt_half_δ_col : d_act < B.δ_col / 2
  d_act_lt_half_τ₀ : d_act < B.τ₀ / 2
  η_adm_pos : 0 < η_adm
  η_adm_le_inv32 : η_adm ≤ 1 / 32
  η_adm_le_quarter_s₀ : η_adm ≤ B.s₀ / 4
  M_act_pos : 0 < M_act
  M_E_pos : 0 < M_E
  C_quad_pos : 0 < C_quad
  partial_y_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', p.2)) p.1) W
  partial_t_holo : ∀ (W : Set (ℂ × ℂ)) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    IsOpen W → DifferentiableOn ℂ U W →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => deriv (fun t' : ℂ => U (p.1, t')) p.2) W
  real_step_collar : ∀ x₀ x₁ : ℝ,
    0 < x₁ - x₀ → x₁ - x₀ ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * d_act →
    x₁ - x₀ < B.δ_col ∧ 0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ ∧ B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi
  E_op_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U) (glancingDomain 1 s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, -t) = glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingResidualOp B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U (y, t))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d → (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), glancingResidualOp B U (x, t)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s →
      glancingResidualOp B U (y, 0) =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0)) y) ^ 2 *
          deriv (deriv (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', 0))) y)
  formal_perturbation :
    ∀ (s s' d η_prev η_next M_prev M_u : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (U_prev : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (u_j : ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s' → s' < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 ≤ η_prev → η_prev < η_next → η_next ≤ η_adm →
      0 < M_prev → 0 < M_u → 1 ≤ j →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_prev U_prev →
      (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| < s → U_prev (y, 0) = y) →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U_prev p‖ ≤ M_prev * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j)) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ u_j (horizStrip s) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (y + 2 * Real.pi) = u_j y) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, u_j (starRingEnd ℂ y) = starRingEnd ℂ (u_j y)) →
      (∀ y ∈ horizStrip s, ‖u_j y‖ ≤ M_u) →
      ∃ (d₁ M_next : ℝ), 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ ≤ d ∧ d₁ < s' / 2 ∧ 0 < M_next ∧
        IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s' d₁ η_next
          (fun p => U_prev p + u_j p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j)) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s' d₁,
          ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => U_prev q + u_j q.1 * q.2 ^ (2 * j)) p -
            (glancingResidualOp B U_prev p +
              (1 / 4 : ℂ) * deriv (deriv u_j) p.1 * p.2 ^ (2 * j))‖ ≤
            M_next * ‖p.2‖ ^ (2 * j + 2))
  E_op_cont : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U_seq : ℕ → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ) (U_lim : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm (U_seq n)) →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U_lim →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℂ × ℂ) =>
          iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_seq n (y', p.2) - U_lim (y', p.2)) p.1)
        (fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) Filter.atTop (glancingDomain 0 s d)) →
    ∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => glancingResidualOp B (U_seq n) p)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (glancingResidualOp B U_lim p))
  stationarity_equiv : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    (∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < s → ‖t‖ < d → U (y, t) ∈ horizStrip (2 * B.s₀)) →
    (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, glancingResidualOp B U p = 0) →
    ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| + ‖t‖ < s → ‖t‖ < d →
      -supportAction1_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y + t, t))) =
        supportAction2_ℂ B.h_ℂ (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y - t, t))) (B.ϕ_ℂ (U (y, t)))
  normAction1_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction2_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction12_holo : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q : ℂ × ℂ => normAction12_ℂ B q.1 q.2)
    (horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) ×ˢ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2))
  normAction_diag_periodic : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction1_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction2_ℂ B X Y ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (X + 2 * Real.pi) (Y + 2 * Real.pi) = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_conj : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    normAction1_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction1_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction2_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction2_ℂ B X Y) ∧
    normAction12_ℂ B (starRingEnd ℂ X) (starRingEnd ℂ Y) =
      starRingEnd ℂ (normAction12_ℂ B X Y)
  normAction2_eq_neg_swap : ∀ X Y : ℂ, normAction2_ℂ B X Y = -normAction1_ℂ B Y X
  deriv_normAction1_right : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun Y' : ℂ => normAction1_ℂ B X Y') Y = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  deriv_normAction2_left : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) → Y ∈ horizStrip (3 * B.s₀ / 2) →
    deriv (fun X' : ℂ => normAction2_ℂ B X' Y) X = normAction12_ℂ B X Y
  normAction_real_stationary_iff : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ : ℝ,
    normAction1_ℂ B (x₁ : ℂ) (x₂ : ℂ) + normAction2_ℂ B (x₀ : ℂ) (x₁ : ℂ) = 0 ↔
      -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁)
  normAction_bound : ∀ X Y : ℂ,
    X ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) → Y ∈ horizStrip (5 * B.s₀ / 4) →
    ‖normAction1_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction2_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act ∧
    ‖normAction12_ℂ B X Y‖ ≤ M_act
  residual_and_linCoeff_ne_zero : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (u : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → t ≠ 0 → ‖t‖ < d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => u y' - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ ^ 3 * deriv u y *
          (normAction1_ℂ B (u y) (u (y + t)) + normAction2_ℂ B (u (y - t)) (u y))) ∧
    (∀ y : ℂ, |y.im| + |t.im| / 2 < σ →
      glancingLinCoeff B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) =
        t⁻¹ * normAction12_ℂ B (u (y - t / 2)) (u (y + t / 2)) *
          deriv u (y - t / 2) * deriv u (y + t / 2))
  enlarged_holo_and_bounds : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (V_t : Set ℂ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → IsOpen V_t → V_t ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) d_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U (horizStrip σ ×ˢ V_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ V_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingResidualOp B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| < σ →
      ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ M_E) ∧
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | p.2 ∈ V_t ∧ |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ } ∧
    (∀ p : ℂ × ℂ, p.2 ∈ V_t → |p.1.im| + |p.2.im| / 2 < σ →
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U p - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  linCoeff_props : ∀ (s d : ℝ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < s → s ≤ s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ d_act → d < s / 2 →
    IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d η_adm U →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U) (glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d) ∧
    (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain (1 / 2) s d →
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (y, -t) = glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) ∧
      glancingLinCoeff B U (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) =
        starRingEnd ℂ (glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t)) ∧
      ‖4 * glancingLinCoeff B U (y, t) - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 4)
  slice_quad_approx : ∀ (σ ρ : ℝ) (y t : ℂ) (u v : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → σ ≤ s_act → ‖t‖ < d_act → |y.im| + |t.im| < σ →
    0 ≤ ρ → ρ ≤ η_adm / 8 →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ u (horizStrip σ) →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ v (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => u z' - z') z‖ ≤ η_adm) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun z' : ℂ => deriv u z' * v z') z‖ ≤ ρ) →
    ‖glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1 + deriv u q.1 * v q.1) (y, t) -
      glancingResidualOp B (fun q => u q.1) (y, t) -
      (glancingDiffOp
        (fun q =>
          glancingLinCoeff B (fun r => u r.1) (q.1, t) *
            glancingDiffOp (fun r => v r.1) (q.1, t))
        (y, t) +
        deriv
          (fun z : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B (fun r => u r.1) (z, t) * v z)
          y)‖ ≤ C_quad * ρ ^ 2
  exact_jet_deriv : ∀ (t₀ σ σ' r_t : ℝ) (U_cand : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < t₀ → 0 < r_t → t₀ + r_t ≤ d_act →
    0 < σ' → σ' + r_t ≤ σ → σ ≤ s_act →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ U_cand (horizStrip σ ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t) →
    (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) r_t,
      ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun y' : ℂ => U_cand (y', t) - y') z‖ ≤ 5 * η_adm / 4) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, glancingResidualOp B U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ)) = 0) →
    ∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ',
      let u_star : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => U_cand (z, (t₀ : ℂ))
      let z_jet : ℂ → ℂ :=
        fun z => deriv (fun t : ℂ => U_cand (z, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) / deriv u_star z
      deriv (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U_cand (y, t)) (t₀ : ℂ) =
        glancingDiffOp
          (fun q =>
            glancingLinCoeff B U_cand (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) *
              (glancingDiffOp (fun r => z_jet r.1) (q.1, (t₀ : ℂ)) + ((t₀ : ℂ))⁻¹))
          (y, (t₀ : ℂ))

def RationalCompatProp {Ω : Set Plane} (B : AnalyticBoundaryData Ω)
    (S : GlancingScalePackage B) : Prop :=
  ∃ (C_rat : ℝ) (B_rat : ℕ), 0 < C_rat ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ε : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → s ≤ S.s_act → 0 < d → d ≤ S.d_act → d < s / 2 →
      0 < δ → δ < d / 100 → 0 < ε → ε < 1 → 1 ≤ N →
      IsAdmissibleGlancingCand s d (3 * S.η_adm / 4) U →
      C_rat * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_rat * ε ≤ 1 →
      (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain 1 s d, ‖glancingResidualOp B U p‖ ≤ ε) →
      ∀ (l : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
        l ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ q → q ≤ N → Nat.Coprime l.natAbs q →
        let t₀ : ℝ := (2 * Real.pi * (l : ℝ)) / (q : ℝ)
        |t₀| < d - 2 * δ →
        ∃ W_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ,
          DifferentiableOn ℂ W_jet
            (horizStrip (s - 8 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 8 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
            W_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = W_jet (y, t)) ∧
          (let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
           let g_jet : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ := fun p => glancingLinCoeff B U p * glancingDiffOp W_jet p
           DifferentiableOn ℂ g_jet
             (horizStrip (s - 9 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 9 * δ), ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8),
             g_jet (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = g_jet (y, t) ∧
             ‖g_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ∧
             ‖glancingDiffOp W_jet (y, t)‖ ≤ C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U p + glancingDiffOp g_jet p)
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ) ×ˢ Metric.ball (t₀ : ℂ) (δ / 8)) ∧
           DifferentiableOn ℂ
             (fun y : ℂ =>
               deriv
                 (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
                 (t₀ : ℂ))
             (horizStrip (s - 10 * δ)) ∧
           (∀ y ∈ horizStrip (s - 10 * δ),
             ‖glancingResidualOp B U (y, (t₀ : ℂ)) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, (t₀ : ℂ))‖ ≤
               C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2 ∧
             ‖deriv
                 (fun t : ℂ => glancingResidualOp B U (y, t) + glancingDiffOp g_jet (y, t))
                 (t₀ : ℂ)‖ ≤
               C_rat * Q ^ B_rat * ε ^ 2))

def BufferedFourierDivProp : Prop :=
  (∀ (σ M : ℝ) (G : ℂ → ℂ),
    0 < σ → 0 ≤ M → DifferentiableOn ℂ G (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ z ∈ horizStrip σ, G (z + 2 * Real.pi) = G z ∧ ‖G z‖ ≤ M) →
    (∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0‖ ≤ M * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * σ)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ,
      HasSum
        (fun n : ℤ =>
          fourierCoeff_ℂ (fun p => G p.1) n 0 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * y))
        (G y))) ∧
  (∀ (σ : ℝ) (t : ℂ) (G : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
    |t.im| / 2 < σ →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun y : ℂ => G (y, t)) (horizStrip σ) →
    (∀ y ∈ horizStrip σ, G (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = G (y, t)) →
    ∀ n : ℤ,
      fourierCoeff_ℂ (glancingDiffOp G) n t = fourierDiffMult n t * fourierCoeff_ℂ G n t) ∧
  ∃ (C_div : ℝ) (B_div : ℕ), 0 < C_div ∧
    ∀ (s d δ ν M η : ℝ) (N j₀ a b J : ℕ) (F : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < s → 0 < d → d < 1 → d < s / 2 → 0 < δ → δ < d / 100 →
      (ν = 1 / 2 ∨ ν = 1) → 1 ≤ N →
      j₀ ≤ a → j₀ + 1 ≤ b → max a (b + 1) + 1 ≤ J → J ≤ 20 →
      0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ η →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ F (glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ)) →
      (∀ y t : ℂ, (y, t) ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) (d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ) →
        F (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (y, -t) = F (y, t) ∧
        F (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (F (y, t)) ∧
        ‖F (y, t)‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - (j₀ : ℝ) * δ →
        (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j : ℤ),
        1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) → j ≠ 0 →
        |(2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ)| < d - (b : ℝ) * δ →
        ‖fourierCoeff_ℂ F n (((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ≤
          η * Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ))) →
      ∃ (H_mode R_mode : ℤ → ℂ → ℂ),
        (∀ n : ℤ, n = 0 ∨ (N : ℤ) < |n| → ∀ t : ℂ, H_mode n t = 0 ∧ R_mode n t = 0) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ |n| → |n| ≤ (N : ℤ) →
          DifferentiableOn ℂ (H_mode n)
            (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
          Differentiable ℂ (R_mode n) ∧
          (∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ),
            fourierDiffMult n t * H_mode n t = fourierCoeff_ℂ F n t - R_mode n t ∧
            ‖R_mode n t‖ + ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ‖deriv (R_mode n) t‖ ≤
              C_div * (1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹) ^ B_div * η *
                Real.exp (-|(n : ℝ)| * (s - (a : ℝ) * δ - |t.im| / 2)))) ∧
        (let H : ℂ × ℂ → ℂ :=
          fun p =>
            ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
              H_mode n p.2 * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * p.1)
         let Q := 1 + (N : ℝ) + δ⁻¹
         DifferentiableOn ℂ H
           (glancingDomain 0 (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ)) ∧
         (∀ y t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < d - ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * δ →
           H (y + 2 * Real.pi, t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (y, -t) = H (y, t) ∧
           H (starRingEnd ℂ y, starRingEnd ℂ t) = starRingEnd ℂ (H (y, t)) ∧
           (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H ((x : ℂ), t)) = 0) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain (ν - 1 / 2) (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖H p‖ ≤ C_div * Q ^ B_div * (M + η)) ∧
         (∀ p ∈ glancingDomain ν (s - (J : ℝ) * δ) (d - (J : ℝ) * δ),
           ‖glancingDiffOp H p - F p‖ ≤
             C_div * Q ^ B_div * (η + M * Real.exp (-(N : ℝ) * δ))))

noncomputable def supportBoundaryPt (c₀ : Plane) (h : ℝ → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) : Plane :=
  c₀ + h θ • unitNormalVec θ + deriv h θ • unitTangentVec θ

def phaseStrip (h : ℝ → ℝ) : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  { z : ℝ × ℝ | -h (z.1 + Real.pi) < z.2 ∧ z.2 < h z.1 }

structure SupportBoundaryPackage (Ω : Set Plane) extends SupportLazutkinData Ω where
  r₀ : ℝ
  r₀_pos : 0 < r₀
  closedBall_subset : Metric.closedBall c₀ (2 * r₀) ⊆ Ω
  two_r₀_le_h : ∀ θ : ℝ, 2 * r₀ ≤ h θ
  Γ_mem_frontier : ∀ θ : ℝ, supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ ∈ frontier Ω
  Γ_inj_mod_two_pi : ∀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ,
    supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₁ = supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ₂ →
    ∃ k : ℤ, θ₁ - θ₂ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
  Γ_outward_normal : ∀ θ : ℝ,
    IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω (supportBoundaryPt c₀ h θ) (unitNormalVec θ)
  support_bound_closure : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ closure Ω,
    inner ℝ (x - c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) ≤ h θ

structure SupportPhaseMapData (Ω : Set Plane) (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω) where
  Theta_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  P_plus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  Theta_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  P_minus : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  Theta_plus_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Theta_plus z.1 z.2) (phaseStrip B.h)
  Theta_minus_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Theta_minus z.1 z.2) (phaseStrip B.h)
  Theta_plus_bounds : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    θ < Theta_plus θ p ∧ Theta_plus θ p < θ + 2 * Real.pi
  Theta_minus_bounds : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    θ - 2 * Real.pi < Theta_minus θ p ∧ Theta_minus θ p < θ
  Theta_plus_quasiperiodic : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    Theta_plus (θ + 2 * Real.pi) p = Theta_plus θ p + 2 * Real.pi
  Theta_plus_strictAnti_p : ∀ θ p₁ p₂ : ℝ,
    (θ, p₁) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → (θ, p₂) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → p₁ < p₂ →
    Theta_plus θ p₂ < Theta_plus θ p₁
  Theta_plus_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ_p : ℝ, 0 < δ_p ∧
    ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → B.h θ - p < δ_p →
      Theta_plus θ p - θ < ε ∧ B.r₀ < P_plus θ p
  Theta_minus_tendsto_zero : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ_p : ℝ, 0 < δ_p ∧
    ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h → B.h θ - p < δ_p →
      θ - Theta_minus θ p < ε ∧ B.r₀ < P_minus θ p
  Theta_plus_eq : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    -supportAction1_ℝ B.h θ (Theta_plus θ p) = p ∧
    P_plus θ p = supportAction2_ℝ B.h θ (Theta_plus θ p)
  P_minus_eq : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    P_minus θ p = -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (Theta_minus θ p) θ
  Phi_maps_to : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    (Theta_plus θ p, P_plus θ p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h ∧
    (Theta_minus θ p, P_minus θ p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h
  Phi_left_inv : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    Theta_minus (Theta_plus θ p) (P_plus θ p) = θ ∧
    P_minus (Theta_plus θ p) (P_plus θ p) = p
  Phi_right_inv : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    Theta_plus (Theta_minus θ p) (P_minus θ p) = θ ∧
    P_plus (Theta_minus θ p) (P_minus θ p) = p
  Phi_measure_preserving : ∀ S : Set (ℝ × ℝ), MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ phaseStrip B.h →
    MeasureTheory.volume ((fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (Theta_plus z.1 z.2, P_plus z.1 z.2)) '' S) =
      MeasureTheory.volume S
  forward_step_unique : ∀ x₀ x₁ x₂ x₂' : ℝ,
    0 < B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ → B.ϕ x₁ - B.ϕ x₀ < Real.pi →
    0 < B.ϕ x₂ - B.ϕ x₁ → B.ϕ x₂ - B.ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
    0 < B.ϕ x₂' - B.ϕ x₁ → B.ϕ x₂' - B.ϕ x₁ < Real.pi →
    -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂) = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) →
    -supportAction1_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₁) (B.ϕ x₂') = supportAction2_ℝ B.h (B.ϕ x₀) (B.ϕ x₁) →
    x₂ = x₂'
  chord_reflection : ∀ θ p : ℝ, (θ, p) ∈ phaseStrip B.h →
    ∃ P Q : Plane, P ∈ frontier Ω ∧ Q ∈ frontier Ω ∧ P ≠ Q ∧
      Q - P = ‖Q - P‖ • unitTangentVec θ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Ω, inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec θ) = p → y ∈ segment ℝ P Q) ∧
      (∃ n_Q : Plane, IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω Q n_Q ∧
        ∀ R ∈ frontier Ω, R ≠ Q →
          (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ R = Q + s • billiardReflect n_Q (‖Q - P‖⁻¹ • (Q - P))) →
          (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ Q R,
            inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (Theta_plus θ p)) = P_plus θ p) ∧
          R - Q = ‖R - Q‖ • unitTangentVec (Theta_plus θ p)) ∧
      (∃ n_P : Plane, IsOutwardUnitNormal Ω P n_P ∧
        ∀ R' ∈ frontier Ω, R' ≠ P →
          (∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ R' = P + s • billiardReflect n_P (‖P - Q‖⁻¹ • (P - Q))) →
          (∀ y ∈ segment ℝ P R',
            inner ℝ (y - B.c₀) (unitNormalVec (Theta_minus θ p)) = P_minus θ p) ∧
          P - R' = ‖P - R'‖ • unitTangentVec (Theta_minus θ p))

structure PhaseCollarGraphData (Ω : Set Plane) (B : SupportBoundaryPackage Ω)
    (P : SupportPhaseMapData Ω B) where
  b_init : ℝ
  b_init_pos : 0 < b_init
  g_col : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
  g_col_cont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => g_col z.1 z.2) (Set.Ioo 0 b_init ×ˢ Set.univ)
  g_col_periodic : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, Function.Periodic (g_col b) (2 * Real.pi)
  g_col_bounds : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ, B.r₀ < g_col b θ ∧ g_col b θ < B.h θ
  g_col_strictAnti_b : ∀ b₁ b₂ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ → b₁ < b₂ → b₂ < b_init → ∀ θ : ℝ,
    g_col b₂ θ < g_col b₁ θ
  g_col_tendsto_h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ b₁ : ℝ, 0 < b₁ ∧ b₁ ≤ b_init ∧
    ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b₁, ∀ θ : ℝ, B.h θ - g_col b θ < ε
  g_col_invariant : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
    P.P_plus θ (g_col b θ) = g_col b (P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ))
  F_raw_strictMono_θ : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init,
    StrictMono (fun θ : ℝ => P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ))
  F_raw_step_lt_pi : ∀ b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b_init, ∀ θ : ℝ,
    P.Theta_plus θ (g_col b θ) - θ < Real.pi

def MeroDiskContinuationProp : Prop :=
  ∀ (r_w ρ R : ℝ) (w₀ : ℂ) (r₀ : ℝ),
    0 < r_w → 0 < ρ → ρ < R → 0 < r₀ →
    Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w →
    ∀ (F : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }))
      (F₀ : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)),
      MeroEqOn F F₀ (Metric.ball w₀ r₀ ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R }) →
      ∃ F_ext : MeroOn2D (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R),
        MeroEqOn F_ext F (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_w ×ˢ { ζ : ℂ | ρ < ‖ζ‖ ∧ ‖ζ‖ < R })

structure CollarWidthTubeData {Ω : Set Plane} (C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω)
    (hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C) where
  s_base : ℝ
  r_base : ℝ
  s_base_pos : 0 < s_base
  s_base_le_det : s_base ≤ hDet.s_det
  s_base_le_s₁ : s_base ≤ C.s₁ / 4
  s_base_le_s₀ : s_base ≤ C.s₀ / 2
  r_base_pos : 0 < r_base
  r_base_le_det : r_base ≤ hDet.r_det
  r_base_lt_s_base : r_base < s_base / 4
  r_base_lt_r₁ : r_base < C.r₁ / 2
  r_base_lt_pi : r_base < Real.pi
  offset_ne_zero : ∀ y t : ℂ, |y.im| < 2 * s_base → ‖t‖ < 2 * r_base →
    glancingOffset C y t ≠ 0
  h_X : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_L : ℂ → ENNReal
  h_X_ge_two : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, ENNReal.ofReal (2 * s_base) ≤ h_X t
  h_L_eq : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base,
    h_L t = h_X t + ENNReal.ofReal (|t.im| / 2)
  h_X_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_X (-t) = h_X t
  h_L_even : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base, h_L (-t) = h_L t
  h_X_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_X (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_L_lsc : LowerSemicontinuousOn h_L (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base)
  h_X_supermean : ∀ (t₀ : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ‖t₀‖ + ρ < r_base →
    ∀ q : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous q → Function.Periodic q (2 * Real.pi) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ q θ ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (q θ) < h_X (t₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), q θ) ≤ h_X t₀
  L_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_L)
  X_mero : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D (meroTubeENNR r_base h_X)
  L_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (L_mero i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  X_agrees_two : ∀ i : Fin 2,
    MeroAgreesHolo (X_mero i) (fun p => glancingImpact C p.1 p.2 i)
      { p : ℂ × ℂ | |p.1.im| < 2 * s_base ∧ ‖p.2‖ < r_base }
  h_L_maximal : ∀ (t : ℂ) (b δ : ℝ),
    t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base → s_base < b → 0 < δ →
    Metric.ball t δ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r_base →
    ∀ G : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D ({ y : ℂ | -s_base < y.im ∧ y.im < b } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (G i) (fun p => glancingDualLine C p.1 p.2 i)
        ({ y : ℂ | |y.im| < s_base } ×ˢ Metric.ball t δ)) →
      ENNReal.ofReal b ≤ h_L t
  real_interval_countable_transfer : ∀ (t₀ δ_star M : ℝ) (E_cnt : Set ℝ),
    0 < δ_star → |t₀| + δ_star < r_base → E_cnt.Countable →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ_star) (t₀ + δ_star) \ E_cnt,
      ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t : ℂ)) →
    ENNReal.ofReal M ≤ h_L (t₀ : ℂ)

def NoPatchAtRealProp {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) : Prop :=
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_X (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.X_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ }) ∧
  (∀ t₀ x₀ H₁ ε : ℝ,
    |t₀| < W.r_base → W.h_L (t₀ : ℂ) = ENNReal.ofReal H₁ → 0 < ε → ε < W.s_base →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → MeroOn2D
        { p : ℂ × ℂ |
          ‖p.1 - ((x₀ : ℂ) + (H₁ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ < ε ∧
          ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < ε },
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ε ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, MeroEqOn (g i) (W.L_mero i)
          { p : ℂ × ℂ |
            |p.1.re - x₀| < ε / 4 ∧
            |p.1.im - (H₁ - ε / 2)| < ε / 4 ∧
            ‖p.2 - (t₀ : ℂ)‖ < δ })

structure ZeroSliceCollarData {Ω : Set Plane} {C : AnalyticGlancingCollar Ω}
    {hDet : EndpointDeterminationData C} (W : CollarWidthTubeData C hDet) where
  Γ_slice : ℂ → (Fin 2 → ℂ)
  a_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  f_mero : ℂ → ℂ
  E_disc : Set ℂ
  E_disc_sub : E_disc ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)
  E_disc_base_disjoint : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base, s ∉ E_disc
  E_disc_isolated : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0),
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball s r ⊆ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r, z ≠ s → z ∉ E_disc
  Γ_mero : MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 0) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0)) ∧
    MeromorphicOn (fun s => Γ_slice s 1) (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  a_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn a_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  f_mero_mero : MeromorphicOn f_mero (horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0))
  slice_base_eq : ∀ s ∈ horizStrip W.s_base,
    Γ_slice s = glancingBoundaryCurve C s ∧
    a_mero s = Complex.exp (Complex.I * C.ϕ_ℂ s) ∧
    f_mero s = deriv C.ϕ_ℂ s
  slice_reg : ∀ s ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0), s ∉ E_disc →
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ a_mero s ∧
    AnalyticAt ℂ f_mero s ∧
    a_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    f_mero s ≠ 0 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s + Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      Complex.I * C.c * a_mero s / (f_mero s) ^ 2 ∧
    deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 0) s - Complex.I * deriv (fun z => Γ_slice z 1) s =
      -Complex.I * C.c / (a_mero s * (f_mero s) ^ 2) ∧
    deriv a_mero s = Complex.I * f_mero s * a_mero s ∧
    ∃ (r_s : ℝ) (X_loc : Fin 2 → ℂ × ℂ → ℂ),
      0 < r_s ∧
      Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s ⊆ meroTubeENNR W.r_base W.h_X ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, z ∈ horizStripENNR (W.h_X 0) ∧ z ∉ E_disc) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, MeroAgreesHolo (W.X_mero i) (X_loc i) (Metric.ball (s, (0 : ℂ)) r_s)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball s r_s, X_loc i (z, 0) = Γ_slice z i)
  no_1d_patch_Γ : ∀ (H₀ x_star sgn ε : ℝ),
    W.h_X 0 = ENNReal.ofReal H₀ → (sgn = 1 ∨ sgn = -1) → 0 < ε →
    ¬ ∃ g : Fin 2 → ℂ → ℂ,
      MeromorphicOn (g 0)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      MeromorphicOn (g 1)
        (Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε) ∧
      ∃ V_overlap : Set ℂ,
        IsOpen V_overlap ∧ V_overlap.Nonempty ∧
        V_overlap ⊆
          Metric.ball ((x_star : ℂ) + ((sgn * H₀ : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) ε ∩
            horizStrip H₀ ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ V_overlap, g i z = Γ_slice z i

noncomputable def primPhi_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ζ in (0 : ℝ)..z, Real.exp (w ζ)

noncomputable def midpoint_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (primPhi_ℝ w) ((primPhi_ℝ w X + primPhi_ℝ w Y) / 2)

noncomputable def normAction_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
      (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)) -
    (∫ z in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..Y,
      (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w z)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z))

noncomputable def normAction1_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (w X) * ∫ z in X..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
    Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w z)

def IsCandidateRealMesh (q : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (X : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  X 0 = x ∧
  X q = x + 2 * Real.pi ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
    |X j - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
    |(X (j + 1) - X j) - 2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ)| ≤ (q : ℝ)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ j : ℕ, q < j → X j = 0)

def IsStationaryRealMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (X : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsCandidateRealMesh q x X ∧
  ∀ j : ℕ, j + 1 < q →
    normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X (j + 2)) - normAction1_ℝ w (X (j + 1)) (X j) = 0

def HasUniqueGlobalMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  4 ≤ q ∧
  Function.Periodic w (2 * Real.pi) ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (4 : WithTop ℕ∞) w ∧
  ∀ x : ℝ, ∃! X : ℕ → ℝ, IsStationaryRealMesh q w x X

open Classical in
noncomputable def realMesh (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  if h : HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w then Classical.choose (h.2.2.2 x).exists else fun _ => 0

noncomputable def critAction_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range q, normAction_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))

open Classical in
noncomputable def globalC_coeff (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 0
  else if HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w then
    -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      (((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
        ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * (critAction_ℝ n.natAbs w x : ℂ))
  else 0

noncomputable def cellKernelMinus_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w z - primPhi_ℝ w X)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z) -
    Real.exp (w z) * ∫ ζ in z..(midpoint_ℝ w X Y),
      Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w ζ - primPhi_ℝ w X) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)

noncomputable def cellKernelPlus_ℝ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (X Y z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * (1 - Real.cos (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w z)) * Real.exp (-2 * w z) -
    Real.exp (w z) * ∫ ζ in (midpoint_ℝ w X Y)..z,
      Real.sin (primPhi_ℝ w Y - primPhi_ℝ w ζ) * Real.exp (-2 * w ζ)

noncomputable def halfCellMinus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j +
    α * (midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) - realMesh q w x j)

noncomputable def halfCellPlus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) +
    α * (realMesh q w x (j + 1) - midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)))

noncomputable def halfCellInvMinus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (halfCellMinus_ℝ q w j α) z

noncomputable def halfCellInvPlus_ℝ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (α z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Function.invFun (halfCellPlus_ℝ q w j α) z

open Classical in
noncomputable def globalB_mult (n : ℤ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 1
  else if HasUniqueGlobalMesh n.natAbs w then
    -(((n.natAbs : ℝ) ^ 2 / (6 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n.natAbs,
        ∫ α in (0 : ℝ)..1,
          (let x_m := halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m j
           let Y_m := realMesh n.natAbs w x_m (j + 1)
           let μ_m := midpoint_ℝ w X_m Y_m
           let term_m : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelMinus_ℝ w X_m Y_m z * (μ_m - X_m) *
               deriv (halfCellInvMinus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_m - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           let x_p := halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α z
           let X_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p j
           let Y_p := realMesh n.natAbs w x_p (j + 1)
           let μ_p := midpoint_ℝ w X_p Y_p
           let term_p : ℂ :=
             ((cellKernelPlus_ℝ w X_p Y_p z * (Y_p - μ_p) *
               deriv (halfCellInvPlus_ℝ n.natAbs w j α) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
               Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (n : ℂ) * ((x_p - z : ℝ) : ℂ))
           term_m + term_p)
  else 1

noncomputable def realDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (2 * Real.pi),
    r = |iteratedDeriv j (w₁ - w₂) y| }

noncomputable def stripDiffSup (r₀ : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  sSup { r : ℝ | ∃ j ≤ r₀, ∃ ζ ∈ horizStrip σ,
    r = ‖iteratedDeriv j (W₁ - W₂) ζ‖ }

noncomputable def realMeshDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  realMesh q w x j - (x + 2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))

noncomputable def realMidpointDisp (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1)) -
    (realMesh q w x j + (realMesh q w x (j + 1) - realMesh q w x j) / 2)

structure StationaryMeshSystem (m : ℕ) (M₁ : ℝ) where
  R_mesh : ℝ
  K_mesh : ℝ
  N_mesh : ℕ
  R_mesh_pos : 0 < R_mesh
  K_mesh_pos : 0 < K_mesh
  N_mesh_ge_four : 4 ≤ N_mesh
  real_mesh_props : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    HasUniqueGlobalMesh q w ∧
    realMeshDisp q w 0 = 0 ∧
    realMeshDisp q w q = 0 ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      Function.Periodic (realMeshDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMeshDisp q w j) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMeshDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      Function.Periodic (realMidpointDisp q w j) (2 * Real.pi) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ((m + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (realMidpointDisp q w j) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
          |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w j y) x| ≤
          R_mesh) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * |iteratedDeriv k (realMidpointDisp q w j) x| ≤ R_mesh))
  real_mesh_lip : ∀ (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMeshDisp q w₁ j y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ =>
          (realMeshDisp q w₁ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₁ j y) -
            (realMeshDisp q w₂ (j + 1) y - realMeshDisp q w₂ j y)) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ x : ℝ,
      (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        |iteratedDeriv k (fun y : ℝ => realMidpointDisp q w₁ j y - realMidpointDisp q w₂ j y) x| ≤
        R_mesh * realDiffSup (m + 15) w₁ w₂)
  strip_mesh_ext : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w W →
    ∃ (X_ℂ μ_ℂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
      (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        X_ℂ 0 z = z ∧ X_ℂ q z = z + ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ j x = realMesh q w x j) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = X_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (X_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          X_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ j ζ - (ζ + ((2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ))) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w (realMesh q w x j) (realMesh q w x (j + 1))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (z + 2 * Real.pi) = μ_ℂ j z + 2 * Real.pi) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j (starRingEnd ℂ z) = starRingEnd ℂ (μ_ℂ j z)) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          μ_ℂ j z ∈ horizStrip σ) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 3 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ =>
                (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) - ((2 * Real.pi / (q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh) ∧
        (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 → ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
          (q : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            ‖iteratedDeriv k
              (fun ζ : ℂ => μ_ℂ j ζ - (X_ℂ j ζ + (X_ℂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ j ζ) / 2)) z‖ ≤
            R_mesh))
  strip_mesh_lip : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (w₁ w₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℂ → ℂ)
      (X_ℂ₁ μ_ℂ₁ X_ℂ₂ μ_ℂ₂ : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ),
    σ ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
    N_mesh ≤ q →
    K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₁ →
    IsPeriodicSmoothBounded (m + 15) M₁ w₂ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₁ W₁ →
    IsBoundedStripExt (m + 15) σ M₁ w₂ W₂ →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (X_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₁ j x = realMesh q w₁ x j) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, X_ℂ₂ j x = realMesh q w₂ x j)) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₁ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (μ_ℂ₂ j) (horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₁ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₁ (realMesh q w₁ x j) (realMesh q w₁ x (j + 1))) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, μ_ℂ₂ j x = midpoint_ℝ w₂ (realMesh q w₂ x j) (realMesh q w₂ x (j + 1)))) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →
      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
        (q : ℝ) ^ 2 * ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ => X_ℂ₁ j ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧
    (∀ j : ℕ, j < q → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m + 2 →

          ‖iteratedDeriv k (fun ζ : ℂ =>
            (X_ℂ₁ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₁ j ζ) - (X_ℂ₂ (j + 1) ζ - X_ℂ₂ j ζ)) z‖ ≤
          R_mesh * stripDiffSup (m + 15) σ W₁ W₂) ∧

      ∀ z ∈ horizStrip ((1 - K_mesh / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * σ),
